en: 'It CAN'T go straight, you know, if you pin it all on one side,' Alice said, as she gently put it right for her; 'and, dear me, what a state your hair is in!' 'The brush has got entangled in it!' the Queen said with a sigh.
uz: U to'g'ri o'tishi mumkin emas, bilasiz, agar hamma narsani bir tomonga yopib qo'ysangiz, - dedi Alisa, uni o'zi uchun muloyimlik bilan to'g'ri o'rnatadi; va, azizim, sochlaring qanday holatda! - deb so'radi.

en: 'And I lost the comb yesterday.' Alice carefully released the brush, and did her best to get the hair into order.
uz: Kecha esa pishirishni yo'qotib yubordim, - deb o'ylaydi Ailis. - Pishirmani ehtiyotkorlik bilan tashlab, sochlarni to'g'rilash uchun qo'lidan kelganini qildi.

en: 'Come, you look rather better now!' she said, after altering most of the pins.
uz: U ko'pgina pinlarni o'zgartirganidan so'ng: Buy, hozir ancha yaxshi ko'rinyapsan! - dedi.

en: 'But really you should have a lady's maid!' 'I'm sure I'll take you with pleasure!' the Queen said.
uz: Agar sizda xonadon xizmatchisi bo'lsa kerak! - deb aytdi Qirolicha.

en: 'Twopence a week, and jam every other day.' Alice couldn't help laughing, as she said, 'I don't want you to hire ME—and I don't care for jam.' 'It's very good jam,' said the Queen.
uz: Havfada ikki pensiya va har ikki kun jam. Alisa kulishidan bosh tortmay: Meni ishga olishni istamayman va jamni yoqtirmayman, - dedi.

en: 'Well, I don't want any TO-DAY, at any rate.' 'You couldn't have it if you DID want it,' the Queen said.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, uni olishingiz mumkin emas, - dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'The rule is, jam to-morrow and jam yesterday—but never jam to-day.' 'It MUST come sometimes to jam to-day,' Alice objected.
uz: Qonun shundaki, ertaga jam, kecha jam, lekin hech qachon bugun jam qilmang. U ba'zan barcha kuni jam bo'lishi kerak, deb aytdi Ailis.

en: 'No, it can't,' said the Queen.
uz: Yo'q, bu mumkin emas, - dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'It's jam every OTHER day: to-day isn't any OTHER day, you know.' 'I don't understand you,' said Alice.
uz: Bu har bir KUNI jamdir: bugun KUNI boshqa kun emas, bilasiz. - Men sizni tushunmayman, - dedi Alisa.

en: 'It's dreadfully confusing!' 'That's the effect of living backwards,' the Queen said kindly: 'it always makes one a little giddy at first—' 'Living backwards!' Alice repeated in great astonishment.
uz: Bu dahshatli chalg'itadigan narsa! - deb javob berdi Qirolicha xushmuomalalik bilan: Boshida bu odamni doimo biroz chalg'itadi, - deb aytdi.

en: 'I never heard of such a thing!' '—but there's one great advantage in it, that one's memory works both ways.' 'I'm sure MINE only works one way.' Alice remarked.
uz: Men hech qachon bunday narsa haqida eshitmaganman!Ammo uning bir katta afzalligi bor, chunki xotira ikki yo'lda ham ishlaydi. Men mening faqat bitta yo'lda ishlayotganidan shubhalanaman, - deb ta'kidladi Alice.

en: 'I can't remember things before they happen.' 'It's a poor sort of memory that only works backwards,' the Queen remarked.
uz: Men narsalar sodir bo'lishidan oldin ularni eslay olmayman. Bu faqat orqaga qarab ishlaydigan kamtar xotira turi, - deb ta'kidladi Qirolicha.

en: 'What sort of things do YOU remember best?' Alice ventured to ask.
uz: Siz qaysi narsalarni eng yaxshi eslaysiz? - deb so'rashga jur'at qildi Alice.

en: 'Oh, things that happened the week after next,' the Queen replied in a careless tone.
uz: Oh, keyingi haftadan keyin sodir bo'lgan narsalar, deb javob berdi Qirolicha beparvo tonda.

en: 'For instance, now,' she went on, sticking a large piece of plaster [band-aid] on her finger as she spoke, 'there's the King's Messenger.
uz: Misol uchun, hozir, - dedi u, gapirganida o'z barmog'iga katta gipsni qo'yib, boshqa yerda shohning elchisi bor.

en: He's in prison now, being punished: and the trial
uz: Hozir u qamoqda, jazolanmoqda va sud o'tkaziladi.

en: doesn't even begin till next Wednesday: and of course the crime comes last of all.' 'Suppose he never commits the crime?' said Alice.
uz: U hatto kelgusi chorshanbagacha boshlanmaydi va albatta jinoyat oxirgi bo'ladi. Agar u jinoyatni hech qachon sodir etmasa? - dedi Alice.

en: 'That would be all the better, wouldn't it?' the Queen said, as she bound the plaster round her finger with a bit of ribbon.
uz: Bu shunchalik yaxshi bo'lardi, shunday emasmi? - dedi Qirolicha, o'z barmog'i bilan maydonni biroz lent bilan bog'lab.

en: Alice felt there was no denying THAT.
uz: Alice buni inkor etishning iloji yo'qligini his qildi.

en: 'Of course it would be all the better,' she said: 'but it wouldn't be all the better his being punished.' 'You're wrong THERE, at any rate,' said the Queen: 'were YOU ever punished?' 'Only for faults,' said Alice.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, siz U yerda xato qilyapsiz, - dedi Qirolicha. Siz hech qachon jazolanmaganmisiz? - dedi Alice. - Faqatgina xatolar uchun.

en: 'And you were all the better for it, I know!' the Queen said triumphantly.
uz: Sening ham bu ish uchun yaxshiroq ekaningni bilaman! - dedi Qirolicha g'alaba bilan.

en: 'Yes, but then I HAD done the things I was punished for,' said Alice: 'that makes all the difference.' 'But if you HADN'T done them,' the Queen said, 'that would have been better still; better, and better, and better!' Her voice went higher with each 'better,' till it got quite to a squeak at last.
uz: Ha, lekin keyin men jazolanayotgan narsalarni qildim, dedi Alisa: bu muhim ahamiyatga ega. - Agar siz buni qilmagan bo'lsangiz, deb aytdi Qirolicha, bu hali ham yaxshiroq bo'lardi; yaxshiroq, yaxshiroq va yaxshiroq va yaxshiroq! Uning ovozi har bir yaxshi bilan balandlashib borardi, oxir-oqibat u bir qichqiriqga yetdi.

en: Alice was just beginning to say 'There's a mistake somewhere—,' when the Queen began screaming so loud that she had to leave the sentence unfinished.
uz: Alice Bir joyda xato bor deyishni boshlaganida, Qirolicha shunday baland ovoz bilan qichqirishni boshladiki, so'zni tugallanmagan holda qoldirish kerak bo'ldi.

en: 'Oh, oh, oh!' shouted the Queen, shaking her hand about as if she wanted to shake it off.
uz: Oh, oh, oh! - deb qichqirdi Qirolicha, xuddi uni o'chirib tashlamoqchi bo'lganidek qo'lini silkitdi.

en: 'My finger's bleeding!
uz: Mening barmog'im qon ketmoqda!

en: Oh, oh, oh, oh!' Her screams were so exactly like the whistle of a steam-engine, that Alice had to hold both her hands over her ears.
uz: Oh, oh, oh, oh! - deb qichqirishlari xuddi bug' motori pishirishidan o'zgacha bo'lgan, shu bois Aliza qo'llarini quloqlari ustida ushlab turishi kerak edi.

en: 'What IS the matter?' she said, as soon as there was a chance of making herself heard.
uz: U: Nima bo'ldi? - deb so'radi, o'zini eshitishga imkon paydo bo'lganidan so'ng.

en: 'Have you pricked your finger?' 'I haven't pricked it YET,' the Queen said, 'but I soon shall— oh, oh, oh!' 'When do you expect to do it?' Alice asked, feeling very much inclined to laugh.
uz: Siz barmog'ingizni tishladingizmi? - deb so'radi Qirolicha. - Hattoki tishlamaganman, lekin tez orada o'laman! - deb so'radi. - Buni qachon qilishingizni kutyapsiz? - deb so'radi Alisa, ko'p kulishga moyil bo'lib.

en: 'When I fasten my shawl again,' the poor Queen groaned out: 'the brooch will come undone directly.
uz: Men shalimni yana bog'laganimda, - deb qayg'urgan kambag'al Qirolicha: brush to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'q qilinadi.

en: Oh, oh!' As she said the words the brooch flew open, and the Queen clutched wildly at it, and tried to clasp it again.
uz: Oh, oh! deb so'zlarni aytganda, bukka ochildi va Qirolicha uni qattiq ushlab, yana ushlab turishga harakat qildi.

en: 'Take care!' cried Alice.
uz: O'zingizni ehtiyot qiling! - deb baqirgan Alice.

en: 'You're holding it all crooked!' And she caught at the brooch; but it was too late: the pin had slipped, and the Queen had pricked her finger.
uz: Sen hamma narsani buzib qo'yyapsan! - dedi va u ko'krakni ushlab oldi; lekin u juda kech edi: pin chiqqandi va Qirolicha o'z barmog'ini uribdi.

en: 'That accounts for the bleeding, you see,' she said to Alice with a smile.
uz: Bu qon ketishining sababidir, ko'ryapsizmi, - dedi u o'z tabassumida Alisaga.

en: 'Now you understand the way things happen here.' 'But why don't you scream now?' Alice asked, holding her hands ready to put over her ears again.
uz: Hndi siz bu yerda nimalar sodir bo'layotganini tushunasiz, - deb so'radi Alisa qo'llarini ushlab, yana quloqlarini yopishga tayyor bo'lib.

en: 'Why, I've done all the screaming already,' said the Queen.
uz: Nima uchun, men allaqachon hamma qichqiriqlarni qildim, dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'What would be the good of having it all over again?' By this time it was getting light.
uz: Buni yana boshdan kechirsak nima foyda? deb o'ylashim kerak edi.

en: 'The crow must have flown away, I think,' said Alice: 'I'm so glad it's gone.
uz: Qoraq o'tib ketgan bo'lishi kerak, deb o'ylayman, - dedi Alisa. Men u ketganiga juda xursandman.

en: I thought it was the night coming on.' 'I wish _I_ could manage to be glad!' the Queen said.
uz: Men kechasi yaqinlashib ketayotgandek o'yladim. - Agar men xursand bo'lishga muvaffaq bo'lsam! - dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'Only I never can remember the rule.
uz: Faqat men hech qachon qoidani eslay olmayman.

en: You must be very happy, living in this wood, and being glad whenever you like!' 'Only it is so VERY lonely here!' Alice said in a melancholy voice; and at the thought of her loneliness two large tears came rolling down her cheeks.
uz: Bu o'rmonda yashayotganingiz va xohlaganingizda xursand bo'lganingiz uchun juda baxtli bo'lishingiz kerak! - deb o'yladi Ailis melanxolis ovoz bilan.

en: 'Oh, don't go on like that!' cried the poor Queen, wringing her hands in despair.
uz: Oh, bunday davom etma! - deb qo'lini cho'zgan kambag'al Qirolicha.

en: 'Consider what a great girl you are.
uz: O'zingiz qanday ajoyib qiz ekanligingizni o'ylab ko'ring.

en: Consider what a long way you've come to-day.
uz: Bugun qancha uzoq yo'l bosib o'tganingizni o'ylab ko'ring.

en: Consider what o'clock it is.
uz: Soat qancha bo'lganini o'ylab ko'ring.

en: Consider anything, only don't cry!' Alice could not help laughing at this, even in the midst of her tears.
uz: Hamma narsani o'ylab ko'ring, lekin yig'lamang! - deb o'ylaydi Alice, hatto ko'z yoshlariga ham qo'shilib.

en: 'Can YOU keep from crying by considering things?' she asked.
uz: U: Bularni ko'rib, yig'lamagan bo'la olasizmi? - deb so'radi.

en: 'That's the way it's done,' the Queen said with great decision: 'nobody can do two things at once, you know.
uz: Bu shunday amalga oshiriladi, - deb aytdi Qirolicha katta qaror bilan: Hokim bir vaqtning o'zida ikki narsani qila olmaydi, bilasiz.

en: Let's consider your age to begin with—how old are you?' 'I'm seven and a half exactly.' 'You needn't say exactually,' the Queen remarked: 'I can believe it without that.
uz: Sizning yoshingizni qanday yoshda bo'lishingiz bilan boshlashimiz kerak? Men to'g'ri yetti yarim yoshdaman. Siz to'g'ri deb aytishingiz shart emas, - deb aytdi kraliça.

en: Now I'll give YOU something to believe.
uz: Endi sizlarga ishonishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsani beraman.

en: I'm just one hundred and one, five months and a day.' 'I can't believe THAT!' said Alice.
uz: Men atigi yuz bir yoshda, besh oy va bir kun. - BUNGA ishonolmayman! - dedi Alisa.

en: 'Can't you?' the Queen said in a pitying tone.
uz: Siz qila olmaysizmi? - dedi Qirolicha rahm-shafqat so'zlarida.

en: 'Try again: draw a long breath, and shut your eyes.' Alice laughed.
uz: Qayta sinab ko'ring: uzoq nafas oling va ko'zlaringizni yoping, - deb o'ylagan Alice.

en: 'There's no use trying,' she said: 'one CAN'T believe impossible things.' 'I daresay you haven't had much practice,' said the Queen.
uz: Mulohazakor narsalarga ishonishning foydasi yo'q, - dedi u. Men aytamanki, sizda juda ko'p mashq bo'lmagan, dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'When I was your age, I always did it for half-an-hour a day.
uz: Men sizning yoshingizdagi bo'lsam, har kuni yarim soat davomida buni qilardim.

en: Why, sometimes I've believed as many as six impossible things before breakfast.
uz: Ba'zan men kechki ovqatdan oldin oltita imkonsiz narsaga ishonardim.

en: There goes the shawl again!'
uz: Yana shal ketadi!

en: The brooch had come undone as she spoke, and a sudden gust of wind blew the Queen's shawl across a little brook.
uz: U gapirganida, ko'krak o'chirib ketibdi va to'satdan shamol shamol quyonining shali kichik ko'krakdan o'tib ketdi.

en: The Queen spread out her arms again, and went flying after it, and this time she succeeded in catching it for herself.
uz: Qirolicha yana qo'llarini ko'tardi va uning orqasidan uchib ketdi va bu safar uni o'zi ushlab oldi.

en: 'I've got it!' she cried in a triumphant tone.
uz: U g'alaba qozonadigan ovoz bilan: Menda bor! - deb baqirdi.

en: 'Now you shall see me pin it on again, all by myself!' 'Then I hope your finger is better now?' Alice said very politely, as she crossed the little brook after the Queen.
uz: Hndi uni yana o'zim o'zim qo'yib qo'yishimni ko'rasiz! - deb o'ylayman. O'shanda barmog'ingiz endi sog'lomroq bo'lishini umid qilaman, - dedi Alisa, quvonch ila Qirolicha orqasidan kichik daryo bo'ylab o'tib borganida.

en: * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * 'Oh, much better!' cried the Queen, her voice rising to a squeak as she went on.
uz: * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * Oh, ancha yaxshiroq! - deb qichqirdi Qirolicha.

en: Be-e-ehh!' The last word ended in a long bleat, so like a sheep that Alice quite started.
uz: Be-e-ehh! so'zining oxirgi so'zi uzoq ovoz bilan yakunlandi, bu esa xuddi qo'y kabi bo'ldi.

en: She looked at the Queen, who seemed to have suddenly wrapped herself up in wool.
uz: U qiroliga qaradi, u birdan o'zini yog'ochga o'rab olgan bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: Alice rubbed her eyes, and looked again.
uz: Alisa ko'zlarini o'chirib, yana ko'rdi.

en: She couldn't make out what had happened at all.
uz: U nima bo'lganini aniq tushunolmadi.

en: And was that really—was it really a SHEEP that was sitting on the other side of the counter?
uz: Va bu, haqiqatan ham, tezkorning boshqa tomonida o'tirgan qo'y bo'lganmi?

en: Rub as she could, she could make nothing more of it: she was in a little dark shop, leaning with her elbows on the counter, and opposite to her was an old Sheep, sitting in an arm- chair knitting, and every now and then leaving off to look at her through a great pair of spectacles.
uz: U imkon qadar ko'proq harakat qilib, undan boshqa hech narsa qila olmagan: u kichik qorong'i do'konda, qo'lqovoshi bilan ish stolida tiklangan edi va uning orqasida bir qariya Qo'y o'tirgan edi, u ko'krakli o'rindiqda tikkan edi va vaqti-vaqti bilan uni katta ko'zoynaklar orqali ko'rish uchun ketardi.

en: 'What is it you want to buy?' the Sheep said at last, looking up for a moment from her knitting.
uz: Siz nima sotib olishni xohlaysiz? deb so'radi qo'y, so'ng bir muncha vaqt o'z tikishidan nazar solib.

en: 'I don't QUITE know yet,' Alice said, very gently.
uz: Men hali bilmayman, - dedi Alisa juda muloyimlik bilan.

en: 'I should like to look all round me first, if I might.' 'You may look in front of you, and on both sides, if you like,' said the Sheep: 'but you can't look ALL round you—unless you've got eyes at the back of your head.' But these, as it happened, Alice had NOT got: so she contented herself with turning round, looking at the shelves as she came to them.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, avval atrofimni ko'rishni istayman, - dedi Qo'zi. Agar xohlasangiz, oldingizga va har ikki tomonga qaray olasiz, lekin boshingizning orqasida ko'zlaringiz bo'lmasa, atrofingizni ham ko'rolmaysiz, - dedi Qo'zi.

en: The shop seemed to be full of all manner of curious things— but the oddest part of it all was, that whenever she looked hard at any shelf, to make out exactly what it had on it, that particular shelf was
uz: Do'kon har xil g'ayritabiiy narsalar bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lib tuyuldi, lekin eng g'ayritabiiy narsa shundaki, u har qanday raftga diqqat bilan qaraganida, unda nima borligini aniq bilish uchun, ushbu raftning o'ziga xos qismi edi.

en: always quite empty: though the others round it were crowded as full as they could hold.
uz: Har doim to'liq bo'sh: garchi atrofidagilar ham o'zlari to'liq to'lib-tosh bo'lsa-da.

en: 'Things flow about so here!' she said at last in a plaintive tone, after she had spent a minute or so in vainly pursuing a large bright thing, that looked sometimes like a doll and sometimes like a work- box, and was always in the shelf next above the one she was looking at.
uz: Bu yerda hamma narsa shu tarzda o'tadi! - dedi u, nihoyat, bir daqiqa yoki undan ko'proq vaqtni katta, yorqin narsa orqasidan quvishda o'tkazganidan so'ng, u ba'zan qo'g'irchoqqa, ba'zan esa ish qutisiga o'xshaydigan va har doim ko'z o'ngida turgan shelfda o'tiradi.

en: 'And this one is the most provoking of all—but I'll tell you what—' she added, as a sudden thought struck her, 'I'll follow it up to the very top shelf of all.
uz: Bu esa eng hayratlanarli, lekin men sizga nima deyman, - deb qo'shimcha qildi u, birdan o'ziga kelgan fikrga ko'ra: Men uni eng yuqori shelfga qadar kuzatib boraman.

en: It'll puzzle it to go through the ceiling, I expect!' But even this plan failed: the 'thing' went through the ceiling as quietly as possible, as if it were quite used to it.
uz: Shu bilan birga, hatto bu reja ham muvaffaqiyatsiz tug'ildi: ish iloji boricha sekinlik bilan, xuddi o'ziga juda odatlangan bo'lgani kabi, plafondan o'tdi.

en: 'Are you a child or a teetotum?' the Sheep said, as she took up another pair of needles.
uz: Qo'y yana bir juft ignalarni ko'tarib: Siz bolamisiz yoki bepul? - dedi.

en: 'You'll make me giddy soon, if you go on turning round like that.' She was now working with fourteen pairs at once, and Alice couldn't help looking at her in great astonishment.
uz: Agar o'zingizni shunday aylantirib yursangiz, meni tezda ko'ngildan o'tkazib yuborasiz, - deb aytdi u. Endi u bir vaqtning o'zida o'n to'rt juftlik bilan ishlayotgan edi va Ailis uni hayratda qoldirib ko'rishni istamagan.

en: 'How CAN she knit with so many?' the puzzled child thought to herself.
uz: U shunchalar bilan qanday bog'lanishi mumkin? - deb o'ylagan hayron bo'lgan bola o'zicha o'ylagan.

en: 'She gets more and more like a porcupine every minute!' 'Can you row?' the Sheep asked, handing her a pair of knitting- needles as she spoke.
uz: U har bir daqiqada bo'yinturug'ga o'xshaydi! - deb so'radi qo'y, u gapirganida unga bir juft tikuv ignalarini uzatdi.

en: 'Yes, a little—but not on land—and not with needles—' Alice was beginning to say, when suddenly the needles turned into oars in her hands, and she found they were in a little boat, gliding along between banks: so there was nothing for it but to do her best.
uz: Ha, biroz, lekin quruqlikda emas va ignalar bilan emas, - deb aytishni boshlagan Alice, birdan o'z qo'llarida ignalar quliga aylandi va ular kichik qayiqda, banklar o'rtasida o'tib ketayotganini ko'rdi: shuning uchun qo'lidan kelganini qilishdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: 'Feather!' cried the Sheep, as she took up another pair of needles.
uz: Qo'y yana bir juft ignalarni qo'lga olib, G'ildirak! deb baqirdi.

en: This didn't sound like a remark that needed any answer, so Alice said nothing, but pulled away.
uz: Bu javobga muhtoj bo'lgan so'z kabi tuyulmadi, shuning uchun Alisa hech narsa aytmadi, lekin ketib ketdi.

en: There was something very queer about the water, she thought, as every now and then the oars got fast in it, and would hardly come out again.
uz: U o'ylaganidek, suvda juda g'alati bir narsa bor edi, chunki vaqti-vaqti bilan qayiqlar unga tez kirib, yana chiqishi qiyin edi.

en: Feather!' the Sheep cried again, taking more needles.
uz: Tovuq! - deb qo'zi yana baqirib, yana ilovalar oldi.

en: 'You'll be catching a crab directly.' 'A dear little crab!' thought Alice.
uz: Siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri krabni tutasiz. - Qizim, kichik krab! - deb o'yladi Alice.

en: 'I should like that.' 'Didn't you hear me say Feather?' the Sheep cried angrily, taking up quite a bunch of needles.
uz: Men buni yaxshi ko'rardim. Sen meni Tovush deb aytishimni eshitmadingmi? - dedi Qo'zi g'azablanib, ko'pgina ignalarni qo'lga oldi.

en: 'Indeed I did,' said Alice: 'you've said it very often—and very loud.
uz: Haqiqatan ham shunday qildim, - dedi Alisa. - Siz buni ko'pincha va juda baland ovoz bilan aytgandirsiz.

en: Please, where ARE the crabs?' 'In the water, of course!' said the Sheep, sticking some of the needles into her hair, as her hands were full.
uz: Iltimos, karvalar qayerda? - dedi Qo'zi, qo'llari to'liq bo'lgani uchun, sochlariga ignalar qo'yib: U suvda, albatta! - dedi.

en: 'WHY do you say feather so often?' Alice asked at last, rather vexed.
uz: NIMIGA shuncha ko'p to'y deyasan? - deb so'radi Ailis nihoyat, juda xafa bo'lib.

en: 'I'm not a bird!' 'You are,' said the Sheep: 'you're a little goose.' This offended Alice a little, so there was no more conversation for a minute or two, while the boat glided gently on, sometimes among beds of weeds (which made the oars stick fast in the water, worse then ever), and sometimes under trees, but always with the same tall river-banks frowning over their heads.
uz: Men qush emasman! - dedi Qo'y: Sen kichkina g'ozasan, - deb aytdi.Bu Aliceni biroz xafa qildi, shuning uchun bir-ikki daqiqa davomida suhbat bo'lmadi, qayiq esa salqin o'tib ketdi, ba'zida begona o'tlar o'rtasida (bu g'o'llarni suvda tez-tez yopib qo'ydi, bundan ham yomon), ba'zida daraxtlar ostida, lekin har doim o'sha yirik daryolar boshlari ustida burib turardi.

en: There are some scented rushes!' Alice cried in a sudden transport of delight.
uz: Ba'zi xushbo'y ko'rinishlar bor! - deb o'ylagan Alice kutilmaganda quvonchga to'lib-toshdi.

en: 'There really are—and SUCH beauties!' 'You needn't say please to ME about 'em' the Sheep said, without looking up from her knitting: 'I didn't put 'em there, and I'm not going to take 'em away.' 'No, but I meant—please, may we wait and pick some?' Alice pleaded.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 7 Tඐඍ Lඑ඗ඖ ඉඖඌ ගඐඍ Uඖඑඋ඗කඖ The next moment soldiers came running through the wood, at first in twos and threes, then ten or twenty together, and at last in such crowds that they seemed to fill the whole forest.
uz: Keyingi daqiqada askarlar o'rmon orqali yugurib kelishdi, avval ikkitadan va uchdan, so'ngra o'n yoki yigirma kishidan iborat bo'lib, oxir-oqibat shunchalik ko'pchilik bo'lib, o'rmonni to'ldirib yubordilar.

en: Alice got behind a tree, for fear of being run over, and watched them go by.
uz: Alice o'tkir daraxt orasiga tushib ketishidan qo'rqib, ularning o'tishini kuzatdi.

en: She thought that in all her life she had never seen soldiers so uncertain on their feet: they were always tripping over something or other, and whenever one went down, several more always fell over him, so that the ground was soon covered with little heaps of men.
uz: U o'z hayotida hech qachon o'z oyoqlarida bunday o'rnaksiz askarlarni ko'rmaganini o'ylagan: ular har doim bir narsadan yoki boshqa narsadan qochib ketishgan va har safar biri pastga tushganda, bir necha kishi uning ustiga tushib ketishgan, shuning uchun yer tez orada erkaklarning kichik to'plamlari bilan qoplangan.

en: Then came the horses.
uz: So'ngra otlar keldi.

en: Having four feet, these managed rather better than the foot-soldiers: but even THEY stumbled now and then; and it seemed to be a regular rule that, whenever a horse stumbled the rider fell off instantly.
uz: To'rt oyoqlari bo'lgan bu otlar piyoda askarlaridan ancha yaxshiroq ishlaydilar: lekin hatto ular ham vaqti-vaqti bilan qoqinib turardilar; va bu odat tusiga kirganidek, har safar ot qoqinib turganda, otar darhol tushadi.

en: The confusion got worse every moment, and Alice was very glad to get out of the wood into an open place, where she found the White King seated on the ground, busily writing in his memorandum-book.
uz: Xavfsizlik kun sayin kuchayib borar edi va Alisa o'rmondan chiqib, ochiq joyga chiqib, oq shohni yerga o'tirib, o'z yozuvlar kitobiga mashg'ul bo'lib yozayotganini ko'rishdan juda xursand edi.

en: 'I've sent them all!' the King cried in a tone of delight, on seeing Alice.
uz: Men ularning barchasini yubordim! - deb hayqirdi podshoh Alizani ko'rib quvonchga to'lib.

en: 'Did you happen to meet any soldiers, my dear, as you came through the wood?' 'Yes, I did,' said Alice: 'several thousand, I should think.' 'Four thousand two hundred and seven, that's the exact number,' the King said, referring to his book.
uz: O'rmonda bo'lganingizda biron bir askar bilan uchrashganmisiz, azizim? - Ha, men shunday qildim, dedi Alisa: Bir necha ming, deb o'ylayman. - To'rt ming ikki yuz yetti, bu aniq raqam, - dedi shoh o'z kitobini nazarda tutgan holda.

en: 'I couldn't send all the horses, you know, because two of them are wanted in the game.
uz: Men barcha otlarni yuborolmadim, chunki ularning ikkitasi o'yinda talab qilinadi.

en: And I haven't sent the two Messengers, either.
uz: Men ham ikki elchini yuborganim yo'q.

en: They're both gone to the town.
uz: Ikkalasi ham shaharga ketishdi.

en: Just look along the road, and tell me if you can see either of them.' 'I see nobody on the road,' said Alice.
uz: Yo'l bo'ylab ko'ring va agar ulardan birini ko'rishga qodir bo'lsangiz, ayting. - Yo'lda hech kimni ko'rmayapman, - dedi Alice.

en: 'I only wish _I_ had such eyes,' the King remarked in a fretful tone.
uz: Men faqat shunday ko'zlarim bo'lganini xohlayman, - dedi shoh g'azablangan so'z bilan.

en: 'To be able to see Nobody!
uz: Hech kimni ko'rishga qodir bo'lish!

en: And at that distance, too!
uz: Va shu masofada ham!

en: Why, it's as much as _I_ can do to see real people, by this light!' All this was lost on Alice, who was still looking intently along the road, shading her eyes with one hand.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, haqiqiy odamlarni bu yorug'lik bilan ko'rish uchun men qila olaman! - deb o'ylaydi Alice, yo'l bo'ylab nazar solib, ko'zlarini bir qo'li bilan soyalab yurgan.

en: 'I see somebody now!' she exclaimed at last.
uz: Men endi kimnidir ko'ryapman! - dedi u oxir-oqibat.

en: 'But he's coming very slowly—and what curious attitudes he goes into!' (For the messenger kept skipping up and down, and wriggling like an eel, as he came along, with his great hands spread out like fans on each side.) 'Not at all,' said the King.
uz: Ammo u juda sekin keladi va u qanday g'ayritabiiy nuqtai nazarga ega bo'ladi! (Shuningdek, elchi ko'tarib-ko'tarib, o'zlarining katta qo'llarini har tarafdan fanlar kabi tarqatgan bo'lsa-da, qo'rqinchli bo'lib o'tirgan edi.)

en: 'He's an Anglo-Saxon Messenger— and those are Anglo-Saxon attitudes.
uz: U anglosaksiya elchisi va bu anglosaksiyalik munosabatlar.

en: He only does them when he's happy.
uz: U ularni faqat baxtli bo'lganda qiladi.

en: His name is Haigha.' (He pronounced it so as to rhyme with 'mayor.') 'I love my love with an H,' Alice couldn't help beginning, 'because he is Happy.
uz: Uning ismi Haigha. (U buni mayor bilan qisqa so'zlar bilan aytadi) Men o'z sevgimni H bilan sevaman, - deb aytdi Alisa boshlanishni qo'ldan boyitmadi, chunki u baxtli.

en: I hate him with an H, because he is Hideous.
uz: Men uni H bilan nafratlayman, chunki u dahshatli.

en: I fed him with—with—with Ham-sandwiches and Hay.
uz: Men uni ham-sandvich va hay bilan oziqlantirdim.

en: His name is Haigha, and he lives—' 'He lives on the Hill,' the King remarked simply, without the least idea that he was joining in the game, while Alice was still hesitating for the name of a town beginning with H.
uz: Uning ismi Haigha va u yashaydi' U tog'da yashaydi, - deb aytdi shoh, u o'yinga qo'shilishidan hech qanday g'ayratsiz, ammo Alisa hali ham H bilan boshlanadigan shaharning nomi haqida shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: 'The other Messenger's called Hatta.
uz: 'O'zga elchining ismi Hatta.

en: I must have TWO, you know—to come and go.
uz: Men ikki kishiga ega bo'lishim kerak, siz buni bilasiz, keling va keting.

en: One to come, and one to go.' 'I beg your pardon?' said Alice.
uz: Birining kelishi, birining ketishi kerak. - Kechirasizmi? - dedi Alisa.

en: 'It isn't respectable to beg,' said the King.
uz: Tayyorlik qilish hurmatga sazovor emas, dedi shoh.

en: 'I only meant that I didn't understand,' said Alice.
uz: Men shunchaki tushunmaganimni aytdim, - dedi Ailis.

en: 'Why one to come and one to go?' 'Didn't I tell you?' the King repeated impatiently.
uz: Nima uchun bir kishi kelishi va bir kishi ketishi kerak? - deb so'radi. - Men sizga aytmagan edimmi? - dedi podshoh sabrsizlik bilan.

en: 'I must have Two —to fetch and carry.
uz: Mening ikkita qo'lim bo'lishi kerak, uni olib ketishim kerak.

en: One to fetch, and one to carry.' At this moment the Messenger arrived: he was far too much out of breath to say a word, and could only wave his hands about, and make the most fearful faces at the poor King.
uz: O'sha paytda elchi keldi: u bir so'zni aytish uchun nafasidan tashqari puch edi va faqat qo'llarini o'girib, kambag'al shohga qo'rqinchli yuzlarni ko'tarishi mumkin edi.

en: 'This young lady loves you with an H,' the King said, introducing Alice in the hope of turning off the Messenger's attention from himself—but it was no use—the Anglo-Saxon attitudes only got more extraordinary every moment, while the great eyes rolled wildly from side to side.
uz: Bu qiz sizni H bilan sevadi, - dedi Podshoh, Elisni o'zidan elchining e'tiborini o'chirib yuborish umidi bilan tanishtirdi, ammo bu foydasiz edi.Anglosaksiyalik munosabatlar har bir daqiqada yanada g'alati bo'lib borardi, katta ko'zlar esa bir-biriga vahshiy o'zgarib borardi.

en: 'You alarm me!' said the King.
uz: Siz meni qo'rqitasiz! - dedi shoh.

en: 'I feel faint—Give me a ham sandwich!' On which the Messenger, to Alice's great amusement, opened a bag that hung round his neck, and handed a sandwich to the King, who devoured it greedily.
uz: Men o'zimni befoyda his qilaman Menga hamon sendvichi bering! - deb aytdi, unda Elishning katta zavq-shafqatini his etib, uning bo'yni atrofida osilgan sumkani ochib, sendvichni shohga berdi va shoh uni ochko'zlik bilan yutib yubordi.

en: 'Another sandwich!' said the King.
uz: Boshqa sandvich! dedi shoh.

en: 'There's nothing but hay left now,' the Messenger said, peeping into the bag.
uz: Bundan buyon haydan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi, dedi elchi, sumkaga qarab.

en: 'Hay, then,' the King murmured in a faint whisper.
uz: Ha, shunday bo'lsa-da, - deb xaloyiq bir so'z bilan shovqin qildi.

en: Alice was glad to see that it revived him a good deal.
uz: Alice bu uni juda ham tiriltirganini ko'rib xursand bo'ldi.

en: 'There's nothing like eating hay when you're faint,' he remarked to her, as he munched away.
uz: U ayolga shunday dedi: O'z aqldan ozganingizda hayni yeyishdan ko'ra yaxshiroq narsa yo'q.

en: 'I should think throwing cold water over you would be better,' Alice suggested: 'or some sal-volatile.' 'I didn't say there was nothing BETTER,' the King replied.
uz: Senga sovuq suv tashlash yaxshiroq bo'ladi, deb o'ylayman, - deb aytdi Alisa, yoki sal-volatsial. Men hech narsa yaxshiroq emas, demaganman, deb javob berdi shoh.

en: 'I said there was nothing LIKE it.' Which Alice did not venture to deny.
uz: Men shunday hech narsa yo'qligini aytdim, deb aytdim, ammo Alicaning bu gapni inkor etishga jur'at etgani yo'q.

en: 'Who did you pass on the road?' the King went on, holding out his hand to the Messenger for some more hay.
uz: Yo'lda kimni o'tkazib yubordingiz? - deb so'radi shoh, qo'lini elchiga uzatib, yana ko'proq hay olishni so'radi.

en: 'Nobody,' said the Messenger.
uz: Hatto kim, dedi elchi.

en: 'Quite right,' said the King: 'this young lady saw him too.
uz: To'g'ri, - dedi shoh: - bu qiz ham uni ko'rdi.

en: So of course Nobody walks slower than you.' 'I do my best,' the Messenger said in a sulky tone.
uz: Shunday qilib, hech kim sizdan sekin yurmaydi. - Men qo'limdan kelganini qilaman, - dedi elchi.

en: 'I'm sure nobody walks much faster than I do!' 'He can't do that,' said the King, 'or else he'd have been here first.
uz: Mening o'zimdan ham tezroq yuradigan hech kim yo'qligiga aminman! - dedi Podshoh. - U buni qila olmaydi, aks holda u birinchi bo'lib kelgan bo'lar edi.

en: However, now you've got your breath, you may tell us what's happened in the town.' 'I'll whisper it,' said the Messenger, putting his hands to his mouth in the shape of a trumpet, and stooping so as to get close to the King's ear.
uz: Biroq, endi nafas olganingizdan so'ng, shaharda nimalar sodir bo'lganini bizga aytib berishingiz mumkin. - Men shoshib beraman, - dedi elchi, qo'llarini qo'liga qo'yib, qo'liga qo'shiq shaklida qo'ydi va shohning quloqlariga yaqinlashish uchun egildi.

en: Alice was sorry for this, as she wanted to hear the news too.
uz: Alice bu haqda xafa bo'ldi, chunki u ham yangiliklarni eshitishni xohlagan.

en: However, instead of whispering, he simply shouted at the top of his voice 'They're at it again!' 'Do you call THAT a whisper?' cried the poor King, jumping up and shaking himself.
uz: Biroq, u g'ayratli bo'lishning o'rniga, shunchaki ovozini baland qilib: Ular yana o'z ishlarida! - deb baqirdi. SEN O'SHNI g'ayrat deb atayapsanmi? - deb baqirdi kambag'al shoh, ko'tarilib, o'zini silkitdi.

en: 'If you do such a thing again, I'll have you buttered!
uz: Agar siz yana shunday ish qilsangiz, men sizni mast qilaman!

en: It went through and through my head like an earthquake!' 'It would have to be a very tiny earthquake!' thought Alice.
uz: U mening boshimga zilzila kabi o'tib o'tdi! - Bu juda kichik zilzila bo'lishi kerak! - deb o'yladi Alisa.

en: 'Who are at it again?' she ventured to ask.
uz: Undan yana kim o'zini tutadi? - deb so'radi u.

en: 'Why the Lion and the Unicorn, of course,' said the King.
uz: Nima uchun Arslon va bir burchak, albatta, dedi Podshoh.

en: 'Fighting for the crown?' 'Yes, to be sure,' said the King: 'and the best of the joke is, that it's MY crown all the while!
uz: Makka uchun kurashish? - Ha, shubhasiz, dedi shoh: va hazilning eng yaxshi tomoni shundaki, bu har doim MANGIING tojidir!

en: Let's run and see them.' And they trotted off, Alice repeating to herself, as she ran, the words of the old song:— 'The Lion and the Unicorn were fighting for the crown: The Lion beat the Unicorn all round the town.
uz: Kelinglar, ularni ko'rishga yugurib boraylik, - deyishdi va Alice o'z-o'zidan oldingi qo'shiqdagi so'zlarni takrorlay boshladi: Sher va Yolg'iz taxt uchun jang qilar edilar: Sher butun shaharni Yolg'izga urib yubordi.

en: Some gave them white bread, some gave them brown; Some gave them plum-cake and drummed them out of town.' 'Does—the one—that wins—get the crown?' she asked, as well as she could, for the run was putting her quite out of breath.
uz: Ba'zilari ularga oq non, ba'zilari qora, ba'zilari plum kekini berib, ularni shahardan tashqariga haydab chiqardilar. Qo'lga chiqqan kishi tojni oladimi? - deb so'radi u, qo'lidan kelgancha, chunki chopish uni nafasdan mahrum qilardi.

en: 'Dear me, no!' said the King.
uz: - Yo'q, azizim! - dedi shoh.

en: 'What an idea!' 'Would you—be good enough,' Alice panted out, after running a little further, 'to stop a minute—just to get—one's breath again?' 'I'm GOOD enough,' the King said, 'only I'm not strong enough.
uz: Bu qanday g'oya! - deb o'yladi Alisa, biroz ko'proq yugurib ketgach, bir minut to'xtatib, yana bir marta nafas olish uchun yetarlicha yaxshi bo'larmidingiz? - dedi shoh. - Men yetarlicha yaxshiman, faqat yetarlicha kuchli emasman.

en: You see, a minute goes by so fearfully quick.
uz: Bir daqiqa juda tez o'tadi.

en: You might as well try to stop a Bandersnatch!' Alice had no more breath for talking, so they trotted on in silence, till they came in sight of a great crowd, in the middle of which the Lion and Unicorn were fighting.
uz: Siz ham Bandersnatchni to'xtatishga urinib ko'ring! - deb gapirish uchun Alice nafasini olmagan, shuning uchun ular sukut saqlashdi va katta xaloyiqning ko'zlariga ko'rinadi, ularning o'rtasida Arslon va Yulduz jang qilmoqda edi.

en: They were in such a cloud of dust, that at first Alice could not make out which was which: but she soon managed to distinguish the Unicorn by his horn.
uz: Ular shunday chang bulutida edilarki, dastlab Alice qaysi biri qaysi biri ekanligini aniqlay olmagan edi: lekin u tez orada birqornni uning shoxidan ajratib olishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: They placed themselves close to where Hatta, the other messenger, was standing watching the fight, with a cup of tea in one hand and a piece of bread-and-butter in the other.
uz: Ular o'zlarini boshqa elchi Hatta jangni kuzatib turgan joyga yaqin joylashtirdilar, bir qo'lida choy, boshqasida esa non va yog'och to'plami bilan.

en: 'He's only just out of prison, and he hadn't finished his tea when he was sent in,' Haigha whispered to Alice: 'and they only give them oyster-shells in there—so you see he's very hungry and thirsty.
uz: U qamoqxonadan hozirgina chiqibdi va uni olib kirganida choynini tamomlagani yo'q edi, - deb Haigha Alicega shov-shuv qilib aytdi: Ularga faqat ostir qo'pollari beriladi, shuning uchun u juda och va chanqoq ekanligini ko'rasiz.

en: How are you, dear child?' he went on, putting his arm affectionately round Hatta's neck.
uz: Xo'sh, yaxshi bola? - deb so'radi u, qo'lini mehribonlik ila Hatta bo'yni atrofida qo'yib.

en: Hatta looked round and nodded, and went on with his bread and butter.
uz: Hatta atrofini ko'rib, boshini yumdi va non va yog'ini olib davom etdi.

en: 'Were you happy in prison, dear child?' said Haigha.
uz: Haigha shunday dedi: Havfxonada baxtli bo'ldingmi, aziz bola?

en: Hatta looked round once more, and this time a tear or two trickled down his cheek: but not a word would he say.
uz: Hatta yana bir bor atrofini ko'rdi va bu safar uning burchakidan bir-ikki yosh oqib ketdi: lekin u bir so'z ham aytmadi.

en: 'Speak, can't you!' Haigha cried impatiently.
uz: Haigha sabrsizlik bilan yig'ladi: Shuning uchun gapir, qila olmaysanmi?

en: But Hatta only munched away, and drank some more tea.
uz: Ammo Hatta faqatgina bir oz ichdi va yana biroz choy ichdi.

en: 'Speak, won't you!' cried the King.
uz: O'zing gapirasanmi? - deb baqirdi shoh.

en: 'How are they getting on with the fight?' Hatta made a desperate effort, and swallowed a large piece of bread-and-butter.
uz: Ular jangni qanday davom ettirishmoqda? - deb so'rashdi Hatta.U juda ko'p harakat qilib, katta non va yog'ni yutib yubordi.

en: 'They're getting on very well,' he said in a choking voice: 'each of them has been down about eighty-seven times.' 'Then I suppose they'll soon bring the white bread and the brown?' Alice ventured to remark.
uz: Ular juda yaxshi munosabatda, - dedi u qo'rqinchli ovoz bilan: Ularning har biri taxminan sakson yettita marta tushdi. Shunday bo'lsa, tez orada oq non va qalin nonni olib kelishadi, deb o'ylaymanmi? - deb aytdi Alice.

en: 'It's waiting for 'em now,' said Hatta: 'this is a bit of it as I'm eating.' There was a pause in the fight just then, and the Lion and the Unicorn sat down, panting, while the King called out 'Ten minutes allowed for refreshments!' Haigha and Hatta set to work at once, carrying rough trays of white and brown bread.
uz: Ularni hozir kutib turibdi, dedi Hatta: Bu men ovqatlanayotganimda biroz o'zgaradi. O'sha paytda jangda to'xtatish bo'ldi va Arslon va Yolg'oqchi o'tirdi, o'z ko'zlarini ko'tardi, Podshoh esa: O'n daqiqa davomida ichimliklar bo'lishi mumkin! - deb baqirdi.

en: Alice took a piece to taste, but it was VERY dry.
uz: Alice bir qismini tanlagan, ammo u juda quruq edi.

en: 'I don't think they'll fight any more to-day,' the King said to Hatta: 'go and order the drums to begin.' And Hatta went bounding away like a grasshopper.
uz: Bugun ular yana jang qilmaydi deb o'ylayman, - dedi shoh Hattaga: yo'q borib, davullarni boshlashni buyurib qo'ying.

en: For a minute or two Alice stood silent, watching him.
uz: Bir-ikki daqiqa davomida Alisa uning ko'z o'ngida turib, sukut saqladi.

en: Suddenly she brightened up.
uz: Toʻsatdan u yorqinlashdi.

en: 'Look, look!' she cried, pointing eagerly.
uz: Qarang, qarang! - deb qayg'urdi u, qizg'in ko'rsatdi.

en: 'There's the White Queen running across the country!
uz: O'sha oq momaqaldor mamlakatni bosib o'tmoqda!

en: She came flying out of the wood over yonder—How fast those Queens CAN run!' 'There's some enemy after her, no doubt,' the King said, without even looking round.
uz: U o'rmondan uzib chiqib keldi!Bu Queenslar qanchalik tez yugurishi mumkin! Uning orqasida dushman bor, shubhasiz, - dedi shoh, hatto atrofini ko'rmasdan.

en: 'That wood's full of them.' 'But aren't you going to run and help her?' Alice asked, very much surprised at his taking it so quietly.
uz: O'sha daraxt ular bilan to'lib-toshgan, - deb so'radi Alice, uning bu so'zlarni shunday xotirjamlik bilan qabul qilganiga juda hayron bo'lib.

en: 'No use, no use!' said the King.
uz: Xullas, hech qanday foydasi yo'q! - dedi shoh.

en: 'She runs so fearfully quick.
uz: U juda tez yuradi.

en: You might as well try to catch a Bandersnatch!
uz: Siz ham Bandersnatchni ushlab turishga harakat qilishingiz mumkin!

en: But I'll make a memorandum about her, if you like—She's a dear good creature,' he repeated softly to himself, as he opened his memorandum-book.
uz: Ammo men u haqida xat yozaman, agar xohlasangizU juda yaxshi mavjudot, - deb o'zi o'zi uchun o'zi o'zi uchun o'zicha takrorladi u o'zining xat kitobini ochib.

en: 'Do you spell creature with a double e?' At this moment the Unicorn sauntered by them, with his hands in his pockets.
uz: Yaratilish ni ikki marta e bilan yozasizmi? - deb so'rashdi.O'sha paytda bir burchak ular tomonidan, qo'llarini to'pkalarida saqlab qo'ydi.

en: 'I had the best of it this time?' he said to the King, just glancing at him as he passed.
uz: Bu safar men eng yaxshisini ko'rdimmi? - dedi u shohga, u o'tib ketayotganda unga qarab.

en: 'A little—a little,' the King replied, rather nervously.
uz: Ozgina, deb javob berdi shoh, biroz g'azablanib.

en: 'You shouldn't have run him through with your horn, you know.' 'It didn't hurt him,' the Unicorn said carelessly, and he was going on, when his eye happened to fall upon Alice: he turned round rather
uz: O'z qo'rg'oningiz bilan uni o'chirib yubormas edingiz. - Uni hech qanday zarar ko'rsatmadi, - deb beparvolik bilan so'radi Yolg'orchoq va u davom etib borar edi, lekin uning ko'zi Alizaga tushib qoldi: u o'zini o'zgartirdi

en: instantly, and stood for some time looking at her with an air of the deepest disgust.
uz: O'sha zahoti, bir muncha vaqt turib, unga chuqur jirkanchlik bilan qaradim.

en: 'What—is—this?' he said at last.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u: Bu nima? - dedi.

en: 'This is a child!' Haigha replied eagerly, coming in front of Alice to introduce her, and spreading out both his hands towards her in an Anglo-Saxon attitude.
uz: Bu bola! - deb Haigha qizg'in javob berdi va Alisaning oldiga kelib, uni tanishtirdi va anglosaksiyalik munosabatda bo'lib, qo'lini unga uzatdi.

en: 'We only found it to-day.
uz: Biz uni faqat bugun topdik.

en: It's as large as life, and twice as natural!' 'I always thought they were fabulous monsters!' said the Unicorn.
uz: Bu hayot kabi katta va ikki baravar tabiiy! - deb o'yladim, ular ajoyib qudratli hayvonlar edi, - dedi Yulduz.

en: 'Is it alive?' 'It can talk,' said Haigha, solemnly.
uz: U tirikmi? - dedi Haigha tantanali ravishda.

en: The Unicorn looked dreamily at Alice, and said 'Talk, child.' Alice could not help her lips curling up into a smile as she began: 'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too!
uz: Yolg'orq Alicega tushlikcha qarab: Hikmatli bo'ling, bola, - dedi.Alice o'z og'izlarini tabassumga aylantirib: Bilasizmi, men ham Yolg'orqlarni ajoyib qudratli qudratli hayvon deb o'ylardim!

en: I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we HAVE seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.
uz: Men hech qachon tirik odamni ko'rmaganman! - dedi YUNIKORN, - Hndi biz bir-birimizni ko'rdik, agar menga ishonsangiz, men ham sizga ishonaman.

en: Is that a bargain?' 'Yes, if you like,' said Alice.
uz: Bu shartnoma emasmi? - deb so'radi Alisa. - Ha, xohlasangiz.

en: 'Come, fetch out the plum-cake, old man!' the Unicorn went on, turning from her to the King.
uz: Kel, plum kekini olib kel, keksan! - dedi bir burchak, undan shohga qarab.

en: 'None of your brown bread for me!' 'Certainly—certainly!' the King muttered, and beckoned to Haigha.
uz: Menga hech qanday qo'rqinchli noningiz yo'q! - deb gapirgan shoh Haighaga ishora qildi.

en: 'Open the bag!' he whispered.
uz: U: Kofirni och! - deb shov-shuv qildi.

en: Not that one— that's full of hay!' Haigha took a large cake out of the bag, and gave it to Alice to hold, while he got out a dish and carving-knife.
uz: Bu hay bilan to'la emas! - dedi Haigha sumkasidan katta kekni olib chiqib, Alisga ushlab turishga berdi, u esa idish va o'q qilichni olib chiqdi.

en: How they all came out of it Alice couldn't guess.
uz: Ularning hammasi qanday paydo bo'lganini Alice tasavvur ham qila olmagan.

en: It was just like a conjuring-trick, she thought.
uz: Bu xuddi sehrgarlik hiylasi kabi edi, deb o'yladi u.

en: The Lion had joined them while this was going on: he looked very tired and sleepy, and his eyes were half shut.
uz: Bu voqealar sodir bo'lganida, Arslon ularga qo'shilgan edi: u juda charchagan va uxlagan ko'rinardi va ko'zlari yarim yopilgan edi.

en: 'What's this!' he said, blinking lazily at Alice, and speaking in a deep hollow tone that sounded like the tolling of a great bell.
uz: Bu nima! - dedi u, o'z ko'zidan Alicega ko'z tikib, katta qo'ng'iroq tovushini eshitadigan chuqur holsiz ovoz bilan gapirdi.

en: 'Ah, what IS it, now?' the Unicorn cried eagerly.
uz: A, nima bo'ldi? deb Unicorn g'ayrat bilan baqirdi.

en: 'You'll never guess!
uz: Siz hech qachon tasavvur qila olmaysiz!

en: _I_ couldn't.' The Lion looked at Alice wearily.
uz: __I_ couldn't.' Arslon Alicega charchagancha qarab qo'ydi.

en: 'Are you animal—vegetable —or mineral?' he said, yawning at every other word.
uz: Siz hayvonlar sabzavotlar yoki minerallar bo'lasizmi? - dedi u, har bir so'zning o'rniga qichqirib.

en: 'It's a fabulous monster!' the Unicorn cried out, before Alice could reply.
uz: Bu ajoyib qudratli hayvon! - deb qichqirdi Yulduz, lekin Aliz javob bera olmagan edi.

en: 'Then hand round the plum-cake, Monster,' the Lion said, lying down and putting his chin on this paws.
uz: Shundan keyin qo'lingizda plum kekini aylantiring, haykal, - dedi Arslon, o'tirib, o'z qanilarini bu oyoqlarga qo'ydi.

en: 'And sit down, both of you,' (to the King and the Unicorn): 'fair play with the cake, you know!' The King was evidently very uncomfortable at having to sit down between the two great creatures; but there was no other place for him.
uz: Va ikkalasi ham o'tiringlar, - deb (qirol va bir buyrakga): Pek bilan adolatli o'yin qilinglar, bilasizlarmi! - deb aytdi. Qirol ikki buyuk mavjudot o'rtasida o'tirishga majbur bo'lganida juda noqulay bo'lgan edi, ammo uning uchun boshqa joy yo'q edi.

en: 'What a fight we might have for the crown, NOW!' the Unicorn said, looking slyly up at the crown, which the poor King was nearly shaking off his head, he trembled so much.
uz: Hndi biz toj uchun qanday kurash olib borishimiz mumkin! - dedi bir burchak, kambag'al shoh boshini deyarli titratayotgan tojga g'ayrat ila qarab, juda titradi.

en: 'I should win easy,' said the Lion.
uz: Men osonlikcha g'alaba qozonishim kerak, dedi Arslon.

en: 'I'm not so sure of that,' said the Unicorn.
uz: Men bunga amin emasman, - dedi Yolg'orq.

en: 'Why, I beat you all round the town, you chicken!' the Lion replied angrily, half getting up as he spoke.
uz: Men seni shahar atrofida urdim, sen g'alati! - deb javob berdi Arslon g'azabga to'lib, gapirganida yarim turdi.

en: Here the King interrupted, to prevent the quarrel going on: he was very nervous, and his voice quite quivered.
uz: Bu yerda shoh urushning oldini olish uchun to'xtatdi: u juda g'ayratli edi va uning ovozi juda titraydi.

en: 'All round the town?' he said.
uz: U: Butun shahar atrofida? - deb javob berdi.

en: 'That's a good long way.
uz: Bu yaxshi uzoq yo'l.

en: Did you go by the old bridge, or the market-place?
uz: Eski ko'prikdan yoki bozordan o'tganmisiz?

en: You get the best view by the old bridge.' 'I'm sure I don't know,' the Lion growled out as he lay down again.
uz: Eski ko'prikdan eng yaxshi ko'rinish bor. Mening bilmasligimga aminman, - deb aytdi Arslon yana yotganida.

en: 'There was too much dust to see anything.
uz: Hech narsa ko'rish uchun juda ko'p chang bor edi.

en: What a time the Monster is, cutting up that cake!' Alice had seated herself on the bank of a little brook, with the great dish on her knees, and was sawing away diligently with the knife.
uz: Hayvon o'sha kekni kesib o'tishi naqadar ajoyib vaqt! - deb o'yladi Ailis, katta idishni tiz cho'kib, kichkina daryo qirg'og'ining yonida o'tirib, o'z pichoqlari bilan g'ayrat bilan o'rab olib ketayotgan edi.

en: 'It's very provoking!' she said, in reply to the Lion (she was getting quite used to being called 'the Monster').
uz: Bu juda hayratlanarli! - dedi u, sherga javob berib (u Monster deb atalishga odatlanib borayotgan edi).

en: 'I've cut several slices already, but they always join on again!' 'You don't know how to manage Looking-glass cakes,' the Unicorn remarked.
uz: Men allaqachon bir necha bo'lakni kesib yubordim, lekin ular har doim yana bir joyga qo'shilishadi! - deb aytdi Yolg'iz.

en: 'Hand it round first, and cut it afterwards.' This sounded nonsense, but Alice very obediently got up, and carried the dish round, and the cake divided itself into three pieces as she did so.
uz: Birincha uni yuziga oling, keyin esa kesib tashlang, - degan so'zlar behuda tuyulgan, lekin Alixa juda itoatkorlik bilan turib, idishni yuzaga keltirdi va kek o'zini uchta qismga bo'lib bo'linib ketdi.

en: 'NOW cut it up,' said the Lion, as she returned to her place with the empty dish.
uz: BUZ uni kesib tashlang, - dedi Arslon, bo'sh idish bilan o'z joyga qaytayotganida.

en: 'I say, this isn't fair!' cried the Unicorn, as Alice sat with the knife in her hand, very much puzzled how to begin.
uz: Men aytaman, bu adolatli emas! - deb hayqirdi Yolg'orq, Alice o'z qo'lida pichoq bilan o'tirib, qanday boshlash kerakligini juda o'ylamagan edi.

en: 'The Monster has given the Lion twice as much as me!' 'She's kept none for herself, anyhow,' said the Lion.
uz: Mustur sherga mendan ikki baravar ko'proq pul berdi! - deb aytdi sher. U hech qachon o'zi uchun hech narsa saqlamagan.

en: 'Do you like plum-cake, Monster?' But before Alice could answer him, the drums began.
uz: Sening plum kekini yoqadimi, Monster? - deb so'raganida, Alice unga javob bera olmaguncha, davomlar boshlandi.

en: Where the noise came from, she couldn't make out: the air seemed full of it, and it rang through and through her head till she felt quite deafened.
uz: Qayerdan kelgan tovushni bilmas edi: havo u bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lib ko'rinardi va u o'zini juda kar his qilguniga qadar uning boshiga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: She started to her feet and sprang across the little brook in her terror, * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * and had just time to see the Lion and the Unicorn rise to their feet, with angry looks at being interrupted in their feast, before she dropped to her knees, and put her hands over her ears, vainly trying to shut out the dreadful uproar.
'If THAT doesn't drum them out of town,' she thought to herself, 'nothing ever will!'
uz: Agar bu ularni shahardan tashqariga chiqarmasa, - deb o'yladi u o'zicha, biror narsa hech qachon bo'lmaydi!

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 8 Iග'ඛ ඕඡ ඗ඟඖ Iඖඞඍඖගඑ඗ඖ After a while the noise seemed gradually to die away, till all was dead silence, and Alice lifted up her head in some alarm.
uz: Ig'ඛ o'zoj ඟ Iga so'ng bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, shov-shuv asta-sekin yo'q bo'lib ketayotganga o'xshaydi, hamma narsa o'lik-to'xtashga to'g'ri keladi, va Alisa boshini ko'tarib qo'rqadi.

en: There was no one to be seen, and her first thought was that she must have been dreaming about the Lion and the Unicorn and those queer Anglo-Saxon Messengers.
uz: Hech kim ko'rinmas edi va uning birinchi fikri shuki, u Arslon va Yolg'oq va o'sha g'ayritabiiy Anglosaksiya elchilari haqida orzu qilgan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: However, there was the great dish still lying at her feet, on which she had tried to cut the plum- cake, 'So I wasn't dreaming, after all,' she said to herself, 'unless—unless we're all part of the same dream.
uz: Biroq, uning oyoqlari oldida hali ham katta idish bor edi, uning ustida u plum kekini kesishga harakat qilgan edi. Shu bois men tush ko'rmayapman, deb o'yladi u o'ziga, agar biz hammamiz bir xil orzunning bir qismi bo'lmasak.

en: Only I do hope it's MY dream, and not the Red King's!
uz: Faqat men bu mening orzuim bo'lishini umid qilaman, Qizil Shohning emas!

en: I don't like belonging to another person's dream,' she went on in a rather complaining tone: 'I've a great mind to go and wake him, and see what happens!' At this moment her thoughts were interrupted by a loud shouting of 'Ahoy!
uz: Men boshqa odamning orzulariga tegishli bo'lishni yoqtirmayman, - deb davom ettirgan u, kamroq shikoyat qiladigan so'zlar bilan davom etdi: Men uni uyg'otishga borishim va nima bo'lishini ko'rib chiqish uchun juda yaxshi ongim bor! Shu payt uning fikrlari baland ovoz bilan Ahoy! deb qichqiriq bilan to'xtatildi.

en: Check!' and a Knight dressed in crimson armour came galloping down upon her, brandishing a great club.
uz: Shukr! va qizil rangli qurol kiygan shogirdi uning ustiga kelib, katta klubni ko'tardi.

en: Just as he reached her, the horse stopped suddenly: 'You're my prisoner!' the Knight cried, as he tumbled off his horse.
uz: U ayolga yetib borganida, ot toʻxtadi: Sen mening mahbusimsan! - deb farishta otidan qulab yubordi.

en: Startled as she was, Alice was more frightened for him than for herself at the moment, and watched him with some anxiety as he mounted again.
uz: O'zi qo'rqib qolgan bo'lsa-da, Alice hozirgi paytda o'zi uchun emas, balki undan ko'proq qo'rqqan va u yana o'z mashinasiga minayotganini qayg'u bilan kuzatgan.

en: As soon as he was comfortably in the saddle, he began once more 'You're my—' but here another voice broke in 'Ahoy!
uz: O'tirganidan so'ng, u yana Sen mening o'g'limsan deb boshladi, ammo bu yerda yana bir ovoz Ahoy!

en: Check!' and Alice looked round in some surprise for the new enemy.
uz: Tekshirish! - deb o'yladi va Alisa yangi dushman uchun hayronlik bilan atrofini ko'rdi.

en: This time it was a White Knight.
uz: Bu safar esa oq ravon bo'lgan.

en: He drew up at Alice's side, and tumbled off his horse just as the Red Knight had done: then he got on again, and the two Knights sat and looked at each other for some time without speaking.
uz: U Alisaning yonida o'tirib, Qizil Ravoning qilganidek, otidan tushdi: so'ngra yana o'tirib, ikki Ravon bir-biriga gapirmasdan biroz vaqt o'tirdi va bir-birlariga qarab turdi.

en: Alice looked from one to the other in some bewilderment.
uz: Alisa bir-biridan xafa bo'lib qarab turdi.

en: 'She's MY prisoner, you know!' the Red Knight said at last.
uz: Qizil Qirg'iz oxir-oqibat dedi: U mening mahbusimdir.

en: 'Yes, but then _I_ came and rescued her!' the White Knight replied.
uz: Ha, lekin keyin _I_ kelib uni qutqardi! - deb javob berdi Oq lovchi.

en: 'Well, we must fight for her, then,' said the Red Knight, as he took up his helmet (which hung from the saddle, and was something the shape of a horse's head), and put it on.
uz: O'sha paytda biz uning uchun kurashishimiz kerak, - dedi Qizil Ravnat, qo'shinini olib, uni kiyib qo'ydi.

en: 'You will observe the Rules of Battle, of course?' the White Knight remarked, putting on his helmet too.
uz: Siz, albatta, jang qoidalariga rioya qilasizmi? - dedi Oq Qavdogar, qo'shiqni ham kiyib.

en: 'I always do,' said the Red Knight, and they began banging away at each other with such fury that Alice got behind a tree to be out of the way of the blows.
uz: Men har doim shunday qilaman, - dedi Qizil Ravvat, ular bir-birlariga shunday g'azab bilan urishni boshlashdiki, Alice urishlardan uzoqda bo'lish uchun daraxt ortiga o'tirdi.

en: 'I wonder, now, what the Rules of Battle are,' she said to herself, as she watched the fight, timidly peeping out from her hiding-place: 'one Rule seems to be, that if one Knight hits the other, he knocks him off his horse, and if he misses, he tumbles off himself—and another Rule seems to be that they hold their clubs with their arms, as if they were Punch and Judy—What a noise they make when they tumble!
uz: U o'ziga shunday dedi: Men endi jang qoidalari qanday bo'lishini o'ylayman, - deb o'zi o'ylab qo'ydi, u o'zini yashirgan joyidan qo'rqqancha ko'z o'ngidan ko'tarib turardi: Bir qoida, agar bitta qoidasi boshqa qoidani ursa, uni otidan quvib qo'yadi va agar u yo'qotsa, o'zini quvib qo'yadi.

en: Just like a whole set of fire- irons falling into the fender!
uz: To'g'ri, to'liq olov temirlari to'plamga tushib ketgani kabi!

en: And how quiet the horses are!
uz: Va otlar qanchalik hushyor!

en: They let them get on and off them just as if they were tables!' Another Rule of Battle, that Alice had not noticed, seemed to be that they always fell on their heads, and the battle ended with their both falling off in this way, side by side: when they got up again, they shook hands, and then the Red Knight mounted and galloped off.
uz: Ular ularni stollar kabi qo'yib tushirishardi! - deb aytishdi.Alis ko'rmagan yana bir jang qoidasi shundaki, ular doimo boshlari ustiga tushib qolishgan va jang o'z-o'zidan shu tarzda, yonma-yon tushib ketish bilan yakunlangan edi: ular yana turib qo'l urishganida, Qizil Ravnat o'zini qo'lga oldi va o'zini qo'lga oldi.

en: 'It was a glorious victory, wasn't it?' said the White Knight, as he came up panting.
uz: Bu ulug'vor g'alaba edi, shunday emasmi? - dedi Oq Qavdogar.

en: 'I don't know,' Alice said doubtfully.
uz: Bila olmayman, - dedi Ailis shubha bilan.

en: 'I don't want to be anybody's prisoner.
uz: Men hech kimning mahbusini bo'lishni istamayman.

en: I want to be a Queen.' 'So you will, when you've crossed the next brook,' said the White Knight.
uz: Men Qirol bo'lishni istayman, - dedi Oq Ravon.

en: 'I'll see you safe to the end of the wood—and then I must go back, you know.
uz: Sizni o'rmonning oxirigacha xavfsiz ko'raman va keyin qaytib borishim kerak, bilasizmi.

en: That's the end of my move.' 'Thank you very much,' said Alice.
uz: Bu mening harakatimning oxiri. - Qo'p rahmat, dedi Alisa.

en: 'May I help you off with your helmet?' It was evidently more than he could manage by himself; however, she managed to shake him out of it at last.
uz: Sening kasklaring bilan yordam bersam bo'ladimi? - deb so'raganidan ko'ra, bu uning o'zi qila olmagan narsa edi, ammo ayol uni nihoyat qo'zg'atishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: 'Now one can breathe more easily,' said the Knight, putting back his shaggy hair with both hands, and turning his gentle face and large mild eyes to Alice.
uz: Hndi inson osonroq nafas oladi, - dedi Ravvat, ikki qo'li bilan o'z sochlarini qaytarib, o'z yuzini va katta ko'zlarini Alicega qaratdi.

en: She thought she had never seen such a strange-looking soldier in all her life.
uz: U o'z hayotida hech qachon bunday g'ayritabiiy ko'rinadigan askarni ko'rmaganini his qildi.

en: He was dressed in tin armour, which seemed to fit him very badly, and he had a queer-shaped little deal box fastened across his shoulder, upside-down, and with the lid hanging open.
uz: U o'ziga juda yomon mos keladigan qalinlik bilan kiyim kiygan edi va o'z shoxidan o'girib, bosh ko'tarib, qopqog'i ochiq bo'lgan kichkina, xaroba shaklidagi qadoqxonasi bor edi.

en: Alice looked at it with great curiosity.
uz: Alixa uni katta qiziqish bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

en: 'I see you're admiring my little box.' the Knight said in a friendly tone.
uz: Men ko'rib turibmanki, siz mening kichkina qutimga hayratda bo'lasiz, - dedi qo'ng'irchoq do'stona tomonda.

en: 'It's my own invention—to keep clothes and sandwiches in.
uz: Kiyim-kechak va sendvichlarni saqlash mening o'zimning ixtiroimdir.

en: You see I carry it upside-down, so that the rain can't get in.' 'But the things can get OUT,' Alice gently remarked.
uz: Ko'ryapsizmi, men uni bosh ko'tarib olib boraman, shunda yomg'ir kirishi mumkin emas. - Ammo narsalar O'TKIRIB ketishi mumkin, - deb muloyimlik bilan ta'kidladi Alisa.

en: 'Do you know the lid's open?' 'I didn't know it,' the Knight said, a shade of vexation passing over his face.
uz: Bilasizmi kiyimning qopqog'i ochiq? - deb so'ragan Ravnat, yuzidan g'am-g'azab soyasi o'tib ketayotgan edi.

en: 'Then all the things must have fallen out!
uz: Shunday qilib, bularning hammasi o'z-o'zidan chiqib ketgan bo'lishi kerak!

en: And the box is no use without them.' He unfastened it as he spoke, and was just going to throw it into the bushes, when a sudden thought seemed to strike him, and he hung it carefully on a tree.
uz: U gapirganida qutisini ochib, o'simliklarga tashlamoqchi bo'lganida, to'satdan bir fikr unga tushib qoldi va u uni taxtarlik bilan daraxtga osib qo'ydi.

en: 'Can you guess why I did that?' he said to Alice.
uz: Nima uchun bunday qilganimni tasavvur qila olasizmi? - deb so'radi u Alisaga.

en: Alice shook her head.
uz: Alice boshini shovqirdi.

en: 'In hopes some bees may make a nest in it—then I should get the honey.' 'But you've got a bee-hive—or something like one—fastened to the saddle,' said Alice.
uz: Ba'zi asalari o'z uyini qurishi mumkin, deb umid qilaman, - dedi Alice, shunda men o'sha o'simlikni olib kelishim kerak.

en: 'Yes, it's a very good bee-hive,' the Knight said in a discontented tone, 'one of the best kind.
uz: Ha, bu juda yaxshi uy, - dedi Ravvatim norozi tonda, bu eng yaxshi uy.

en: But not a single bee has come near it yet.
uz: Ammo hali unga birorta o'simlik ham yaqinlashmagan.

en: And the other thing is a mouse-trap.
uz: Boshqa narsa esa tovuq tuzoqidir.

en: I suppose the mice keep the bees out—or the bees keep the mice out, I don't know which.' 'I was wondering what the mouse-trap was for,' said Alice.
uz: O'ylaymanki, tovuqlar asalarni tashqarida saqlaydi yoki asalari esa tovuqlarni tashqarida saqlaydi, ammo qaysiini bilmayman. - Men tovuq tuzoqining nima maqsadi borligini o'yladim, - dedi Alice.

en: 'It isn't very likely there would be any mice on the horse's back.' 'Not very likely, perhaps,' said the Knight: 'but if they DO come, I don't choose to have them running all about.' 'You see,' he went on after a pause, 'it's as well to be provided for EVERYTHING.
uz: Atning orqasida tovuqlar bo'lishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas. Agar bo'lmasa, ehtimol, - dedi qo'ng'iz: agar ular kelsa, men ularni to'g'ri yo'ldan ozdirishni xohlamayman. Ko'ryapsizmi, dedi u to'xtatishdan so'ng davom etib, U hamma narsa uchun ta'minlangan bo'lishi ham yaxshi.

en: That's the reason the horse has all those anklets round his feet.' 'But what are they for?' Alice asked in a tone of great curiosity.
uz: Shuning uchun otning oyoqlari atrofida barcha bu to'qnashuvlar bor. - Ammo ular nima uchun? - deb so'radi Alice katta qiziqish bilan.

en: 'To guard against the bites of sharks,' the Knight replied.
uz: Sharaqlarning urishiga qarshi qo'riqlanish uchun, - deb javob berdi Ravvat.

en: 'It's an invention of my own.
uz: Bu mening o'zimning ixtiroim.

en: I'll go with you to the end of the wood—What's the dish for?' 'It's meant for plum-cake,' said Alice.
uz: Men siz bilan o'rmonning oxirigacha boramanQani ovqat nima uchun? - deb so'radi Alice.

en: 'We'd better take it with us,' the Knight said.
uz: Biz uni o'zimiz bilan olib ketsak yaxshi bo'lardi, dedi Ravnat.

en: 'It'll come in handy if we find any plum-cake.
uz: Agar plum kekini topsak, bu bizga yordam beradi.

en: Help me to get it into this bag.' This took a very long time to manage, though Alice held the bag open very carefully, because the Knight was so VERY awkward in putting in the dish: the first two or three times that he tried he fell in himself instead.
uz: Bu ishni amalga oshirish uchun juda ko'p vaqt kerak bo'ldi, ammo Alixa sumkani juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ochib qo'ydi, chunki Ravnat pishirishni qo'yishda juda noqulay bo'lgan: birinchi ikki yoki uch marta harakat qilganida o'ziga tushdi.

en: 'It's rather a tight fit, you see,' he said, as they got it in at last; 'There are so many candlesticks in the bag.' And he hung it to the saddle, which was already loaded with bunches of carrots, and fire-irons, and many other things.
uz: U: Bilasizmi, bu juda qattiq mos keladi, - dedi, oxir-oqibat ular uni olib kirganlarida; Sakada juda ko'p chiroqlar bor, - dedi va uni allaqachon karotlar, olov temirlari va boshqa ko'plab narsalar bilan to'ldirilgan saddelga osib qo'ydi.

en: 'I hope you've got your hair well fastened on?' he continued, as they set off.
uz: Istiyof qilamanki, sochlaringizni yaxshi o'rnatgansiz? - deb davom etdi u, ular jo'nab ketayotganda.

en: 'Only in the usual way,' Alice said, smiling.
uz: - Faqat odatdagidek, - dedi Alisa tabassum bilan.

en: 'That's hardly enough,' he said, anxiously.
uz: Bu deyarli yetarli emas, dedi u tashvishlanib.

en: 'You see the wind is so VERY strong here.
uz: Mana, shamol bu yerda juda kuchli.

en: It's as strong as soup.' 'Have you invented a plan for keeping the hair from being blown off?' Alice enquired.
uz: Sularning sochlarini o'chirishdan saqlab qolish uchun biron bir reja yaratganmisiz? - deb so'radi Alisa.

en: 'Not yet,' said the Knight.
uz: Hazrgacha emas, dedi Ravnat.

en: 'But I've got a plan for keeping it from FALLING off.' 'I should like to hear it, very much.' 'First you take an upright stick,' said the Knight.
uz: Ammo uning tushib ketmasligi uchun mening rejalarim bor. - Men uni eshitishni juda xohlayman. - Avvalo siz to'g'ri tikilgan tayoqni oling, - dedi Ravnat.

en: 'Then you make your hair creep up it, like a fruit-tree.
uz: Keyin sochlaringizni meva daraxti kabi ko'tarasiz.

en: Now the reason hair falls off is because it hangs DOWN—things never fall UPWARDS, you know.
uz: Endi sochlarning tushib ketishining sababi, chunki u tushdan oshib ketadi.

en: It's a plan of my own invention.
uz: Bu mening o'zim yaratgan reja.

en: You may try it if you like.' It didn't sound a comfortable plan, Alice thought, and for a few minutes she walked on in silence, puzzling over the idea, and every now and then stopping to help the poor Knight, who certainly was NOT a good rider.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, sinab ko'rishingiz mumkin, deb o'yladi Alisa, bu qulay reja kabi ko'rinmadi va u bir necha daqiqa davomida xotirjamlik bilan o'z fikrini o'ylab yurdi va vaqti-vaqti bilan kambag'al Ravnatga yordam berish uchun to'xtadi, chunki u, albatta, yaxshi haydovchi emas edi.

en: Whenever the horse stopped (which it did very often), he fell off in front; and whenever it went on again (which it generally did rather suddenly), he fell off behind.
uz: Ot to'xtab qolganda (ko'pincha shunday bo'lgan) oldidan tushib ketardi, yana davom etganda (odatda to'satdan sodir bo'lgan) orqa tomondan tushib ketardi.

en: Otherwise he kept on pretty well, except that he had a habit of now and then falling off sideways; and as he generally did this on the side on which Alice was walking, she soon found that it was the best plan not to walk QUITE close to the horse.
uz: Aks holda u juda yaxshi yo'l tutardi, lekin vaqti-vaqti bilan yonboshiga tushib ketish odati bor edi; va u odatda buni Alisaning yurgan tomonida qilganligi sababli, u tezda eng yaxshi rejani atga yaqin kelmaslik ekanligini aniqladi.

en: 'I'm afraid you've not had much practice in riding,' she ventured to say, as she was helping him up from his fifth tumble.
uz: Demak, siz haydashda juda ko'p mashq qilmagansiz, - deb aytishga jur'at qildi u, unga beshinchi to'sqinligidan o'tishga yordam berar edi.

en: The Knight looked very much surprised, and a little offended at the remark.
uz: Ravon juda hayratda va biroz xafa bo'lgan holda ko'rindi.

en: 'What makes you say that?' he asked, as he scrambled back
uz: Nima uchun shunday deysiz? - deb so'radi u, qaytib kelib.

en: into the saddle, keeping hold of Alice's hair with one hand, to save himself from falling over on the other side.
uz: O'zini boshqa tomondan tushib ketishdan saqlab qolish uchun, bir qo'li bilan Alizning sochlarini ushlab, saddasiga kiradi.

en: 'Because people don't fall off quite so often, when they've had much practice.' 'I've had plenty of practice,' the Knight said very gravely: 'plenty of practice!' Alice could think of nothing better to say than 'Indeed?' but she said it as heartily as she could.
uz: Men ko'p mashq qildim, - dedi Qavdogar juda jiddiy: Ko'p mashq qildim! - deb aytdi.Alis Haqiqatan ham? degan so'zlardan yaxshiroq hech narsa o'ylamagan, lekin u buni imkon qadar samimiylik bilan aytdi.

en: They went on a little way in silence after this, the Knight with his eyes shut, muttering to himself, and Alice watching anxiously for the next tumble.
uz: Bundan so'ng ular bir oz sukut saqlashdi, Ravnat ko'zlarini yopib, o'z-o'zidan g'iybat qildi, Alisa esa keyingi qulab tushish uchun tashvish bilan kuzatib turdi.

en: 'The great art of riding,' the Knight suddenly began in a loud voice, waving his right arm as he spoke, 'is to keep—' Here the sentence ended as suddenly as it had begun, as the Knight fell heavily on the top of his head exactly in the path where Alice was walking.
uz: Shayot qilishning buyuk san'ati, - deb qo'ng'iroq qilib boshladi Ravnat, o'ng qo'lini o'qib gapirganida, qo'shishni davom ettirishdir Bu yerda gap boshlanganidek to'satdan tugadi, chunki Ravnat o'z boshiga qattiq tushib, xuddi Alisaning yurgan yo'lidan tushib qoldi.

en: She was quite frightened this time, and said in an anxious tone, as she picked him up, 'I hope no bones are broken?' 'None to speak of,' the Knight said, as if he didn't mind breaking two or three of them.
uz: Bu safar u juda qo'rqqan va uni ko'tarib olgach, tashvishlangan so'zlar bilan: Uchog'im tuprog'i bo'lmaganini umid qilamanmi? - deb aytdi.

en: 'The great art of riding, as I was saying, is—to keep your balance properly.
uz: Men aytganimdek, haydashning buyuk san'ati - muvozanatni to'g'ri saqlashdir.

en: Like this, you know—' He let go the bridle, and stretched out both his arms to show Alice what he meant, and this time he fell flat on his back, right under the horse's feet.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'zingiz bilasiz' U marvaridni bo'shatdi va Alicega nimani nazarda tutishini ko'rsatish uchun qo'llarini uzdi va bu safar u otning oyoqlari ostiga o'tirib, orqaga yiqildi.

en: 'Plenty of practice!' he went on repeating, all the time that Alice was getting him on his feet again.
uz: Ko'p mashq! - deb takrorlashdi u, Alice uni yana to'g'rilab turishiga qaramay.

en: 'Plenty of practice!' 'It's too ridiculous!' cried Alice, losing all her patience this time.
uz: Ko'p mashq! - deb o'yladi Ailis, bu safar sabr-toqatini yo'qotdi.

en: 'You ought to have a wooden horse on wheels, that you ought!' 'Does that kind go smoothly?' the Knight asked in a tone of great interest, clasping his arms round the horse's neck as he spoke, just in time to save himself from tumbling off again.
uz: O'g'ilning g'ildiraklari ustida yog'och ot bo'lishi kerak, shunday bo'lishi kerak! - deb so'radi qo'ng'irovchi, qo'llarini otning bo'yniga to'plab gapirganida, o'zini yana tushishdan saqlab qolish uchun o'z vaqtida.

en: 'Much more smoothly than a live horse,' Alice said, with a little scream of laughter, in spite of all she could do to prevent it.
uz: Ochiq otdan ko'ra ancha osonroq, deb aytdi Ailis, bu hodisani oldini olish uchun qo'lidan kelgan barcha narsaga qaramay, bir oz qichqiriq bilan.

en: 'I'll get one,' the Knight said thoughtfully to himself.
uz: Birini olsam bo'ladi, - deb otasi o'z-o'zidan o'ylab so'radi.

en: 'One or two— several.' There was a short silence after this, and then the Knight went on again.
uz: Bir yoki ikki ko'p. Shundan so'ng biroz sukut bo'ldi, so'ngra Ravnat yana davom etdi.

en: 'I'm a great hand at inventing things.
uz: Men narsalarni ixtiro qilishda juda yaxshi qo'lim.

en: Now, I daresay you noticed, that last time you picked me up, that I was looking rather thoughtful?'
uz: Endi aytamanki, oxirgi marta mendan o'tirganingizda, juda mulohaza yuritib ko'rinayotganimni sezganmisiz?

en: 'You WERE a little grave,' said Alice.
uz: SING kichik qabr bo'lganing uchun, - dedi Ailis.

en: 'Well, just then I was inventing a new way of getting over a gate— would you like to hear it?' 'Very much indeed,' Alice said politely.
uz: O'sha paytda men darvoza o'tishning yangi usulini yaratgan edim, uni eshitishni xohlaysizmi? - deb so'radi Alisa xushmuomalalik bilan.

en: 'I'll tell you how I came to think of it,' said the Knight.
uz: Men sizga buni qanday qilib o'yladim, deb aytaman, - dedi Ravnat.

en: 'You see, I said to myself, The only difficulty is with the feet: the HEAD is high enough already. Now, first I put my head on the top of the gate— then I stand on my head—then the feet are high enough, you see— then I'm over, you see.' 'Yes, I suppose you'd be over when that was done,' Alice said thoughtfully: 'but don't you think it would be rather hard?' 'I haven't tried it yet,' the Knight said, gravely: 'so I can't tell for certain—but I'm afraid it WOULD be a little hard.' He looked so vexed at the idea, that Alice changed the subject hastily.
uz: Bilasizmi, men o'zimga: Yegan qiyinchilik - oyoqlarda: TASh allaqachon yetarlicha baland. - deb aytdim. - Endi, avval boshimni darvoza ustiga qo'ydim, so'ngra boshimda turibman, so'ngra oyoqlar yetarlicha baland bo'ldi, - deb aytdim.

en: 'What a curious helmet you've got!' she said cheerfully.
uz: Bu qanday g'alati kask ekan! - dedi u quvonch bilan.

en: 'Is that your invention too?' The Knight looked down proudly at his helmet, which hung from the saddle.
uz: Bu sizning ham ixtiroingizmi? - deb so'ragan Ravvator shodlik bilan o'z kaskidan ko'z tushirdi.

en: 'Yes,' he said, 'but I've invented a better one than that— like a sugar loaf.
uz: Ha, - dedi u, - lekin men bundan ham yaxshiroq birini, masalan, shakarli nonni yaratdim.

en: When I used to wear it, if I fell off the horse, it always touched the ground directly.
uz: Uni kiyganimda, agar otdan tushsam, u har doim to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yerga tegardi.

en: So I had a VERY little way to fall, you see—But there WAS the danger of falling INTO it, to be sure.
uz: Shunday qilib, tushish uchun juda kam yo'l bor edi, lekin shubhasiz, u yerga tushish xavfi bor edi.

en: That happened to me once—and the worst of it was, before I could get out again, the other White Knight came and put it on.
uz: Bu menga bir marta sodir bo'ldi va eng og'ir narsa shundaki, men yana chiqishimdan oldin, boshqa oq ravon kelib uni kiyib qo'ydi.

en: He thought it was his own helmet.' The knight looked so solemn about it that Alice did not dare to laugh.
uz: U bu uning o'z kaskasi deb o'ylagan edi, - deb aytdi u. Qahramon bu haqda o'ta tantanali ko'rinishga ega bo'lgani uchun, Alisa kulishga jur'at etmadi.

en: 'I'm afraid you must have hurt him,' she said in a trembling voice, 'being on the top of his head.' 'I had to kick him, of course,' the Knight said, very seriously.
uz: Agar siz uning boshida bo'lganingizda, unga zarar yetkazgan bo'lsangiz kerak, - dedi u titrangan ovoz bilan. Men uni urishim kerak edi, albatta, dedi Ravon, juda jiddiy.

en: 'And then he took the helmet off again—but it took hours and hours to get me out.
uz: So'ngra u yana kaskani olib tashladi, lekin meni undan chiqarish uchun soatlar va soatlar kerak bo'ldi.

en: I was as fast as—as lightning, you know.' 'But that's a different kind of fastness,' Alice objected.
uz: Men chaqmoq kabi tez edim, bilasiz. - Lekin bu boshqa tezlik, - deb aytdi Ailis.

en: The Knight shook his head.
uz: Qavdogar boshini silkitdi.

en: 'It was all kinds of fastness with me, I can assure you!' he said.
uz: U: Men bilan bu har qanday tezlik edi, sizga shuni aytaman!

en: He raised his hands in some excitement as he said this, and instantly rolled out of the saddle, and fell headlong into a deep ditch.
uz: Bu so'zlarni aytganida u qo'llarini ko'tardi va darhol o'rindiqdan chiqib, chuqur chuqur chuqurlikka tushib ketdi.

en: Alice ran to the side of the ditch to look for him.
uz: Alice uni izlash uchun cho'g'ning yon tomoniga yugurdi.

en: She was rather startled by the fall, as for some time he had kept on very well, and
uz: U tushib qolishidan juda hayratda edi, chunki u bir muncha vaqt davomida juda yaxshi o'zini tuta olgan edi.

en: she was afraid that he really WAS hurt this time.
uz: Bu safar u chindan ham jarohatlanganidan qo'rqardi.

en: However, though she could see nothing but the soles of his feet, she was much relieved to hear that he was talking on in his usual tone.
uz: Biroq, u uning oyoq ostilaridan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmagan bo'lsa-da, uning odatdagi tovushida gapirayotganini eshitib, juda xotirjam bo'ldi.

en: 'All kinds of fastness,' he repeated: 'but it was careless of him to put another man's helmet on—with the man in it, too.' 'How CAN you go on talking so quietly, head downwards?' Alice asked, as she dragged him out by the feet, and laid him in a heap on the bank.
uz: U yana yana shunday dedi: Butuncha qat'iylik, lekin u boshqa odamning kaskini kiyishi uchun beparvolik qilgan edi.  Siz qanday qilib shuncha xotirjam gapirishni davom ettira olasiz, boshingizni pastga tikasiz? - deb so'radi Alisa, uni oyoqlari bilan olib chiqib, qirg'oqqa to'plangan joyga qo'ydi.

en: The Knight looked surprised at the question.
uz: Ravon savolga hayron ko'rindi.

en: 'What does it matter where my body happens to be?' he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Tamrimning qayerda bo'lishiga nima bog'liq?

en: 'My mind goes on working all the same.
uz: Mening ongim hali ham ishlamoqda.

en: In fact, the more head downwards I am, the more I keep inventing new things.' 'Now the cleverest thing of the sort that I ever did,' he went on after a pause, 'was inventing a new pudding during the meat- course.' 'In time to have it cooked for the next course?' said Alice.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, boshim pastga tushsa, men yangi narsalarni ixtiro qilaveraman. Hndi men qilgan eng aqlli ish, - dedi u to'xtatishdan so'ng, - go'sht-tushida yangi puddingni ixtiro qilish edi. - Boshqa taom uchun pishirish vaqti keldimi? - dedi Alice.

en: 'Well, not the NEXT course,' the Knight said in a slow thoughtful tone: 'no, certainly not the next COURSE.' 'Then it would have to be the next day.
uz: Hmm, NEXT kursiga emas, - dedi qotib, muloyim so'z bilan: Yo'q, albatta keyingi kursga emas, - deb aytdi.

en: I suppose you wouldn't have two pudding-courses in one dinner?' 'Well, not the NEXT day,' the Knight repeated as before: 'not the next DAY.
uz: O'ylaymanki, siz bir kechki ovqatda ikkita pudding-kursni o'tkazmaysizmi? - Hmm, NEXT kun emas, - deb takrorladi Qavdogar avvalgidek: Yaqin kun emas.

en: In fact,' he went on, holding his head down, and his voice getting lower and lower, 'I don't believe that pudding ever WAS cooked!
uz: Aslida, - dedi u, boshini past olib, ovozi tobora pastga tushayotgan holda, - bu pudding hech qachon pishirilganligiga ishonmayman!

en: In fact, I don't believe that pudding ever WILL be cooked!
uz: Aslida, bu pudding hech qachon pishirilishiga ishonmayman!

en: And yet it was a very clever pudding to invent.' 'What did you mean it to be made of?' Alice asked, hoping to cheer him up, for the poor Knight seemed quite low-spirited about it.
uz: U nimaga tayyor bo'lishi kerak edi? - deb so'radi Aliz, uni xursand qilish niyatida, chunki kambag'al Ravnat bu borada juda kam bo'lgan ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan.
