en: 'It began with blotting paper,' the Knight answered with a groan.
uz: Bu qog'ozni o'chirib tashlash bilan boshlandi, - deb javob berdi Ravvat.

en: 'That wouldn't be very nice, I'm afraid—' 'Not very nice ALONE,' he interrupted, quite eagerly: 'but you've no idea what a difference it makes mixing it with other things—such as gunpowder and sealing-wax.
uz: Bu juda yaxshi bo'lmasdi, qorimkim Yegancha yaxshi emas, - dedi u, juda xohish-irodam bilan: Ammo siz buni boshqa narsalar bilan aralashtirib qo'yish qanday farq qilishi haqida hech qanday tasavvurga ega emassiz, masalan, qorong'i va muhrli shamol.

en: And here I must leave you.' They had just come to the end of the wood.
uz: Mana, men sizlarni tashlab ketishim kerak, deb aytishdi.

en: Alice could only look puzzled: she was thinking of the pudding.
uz: Alice faqat g'alati ko'rinishga ega edi: u puddingni o'ylayotgan edi.

en: 'You are sad,' the Knight said in an anxious tone: 'let me sing you a song to comfort you.'
uz: Siz xafa bo'lasiz, - dedi qo'ng'irqo'r tashvishlangan tovush bilan: Sizni tasalli beradigan bir qo'shiq kuylayman.

en: 'Is it very long?' Alice asked, for she had heard a good deal of poetry that day.
uz: U juda uzoqmi? - deb so'radi Ailis, chunki u kuni ko'pgina she'riy so'zlarni eshitgan edi.

en: 'It's long,' said the Knight, 'but very, VERY beautiful.
uz: Uzoq, - dedi qotib, - lekin juda, juda chiroyli.

en: Everybody that hears me sing it—either it brings the TEARS into their eyes, or else—' 'Or else what?' said Alice, for the Knight had made a sudden pause.
uz: Meni tinglagan har bir kishi uni kuylaydi, ya'ni u ularning ko'zlariga yoshlar tushiradi, ya'ni ya'ni boshqa nima? deb aytadi Alisa, chunki Ravnat to'xtatdi.

en: 'Or else it doesn't, you know.
uz: Yoki yo'q, bilasiz.

en: The name of the song is called HADDOCKS' EYES.' 'Oh, that's the name of the song, is it?' Alice said, trying to feel interested.
uz: Qo'shiqning nomi HADDOCKS' OYES deb nomlanadi. 'Oh, bu qo'shiqning ismi, shundaymi?' - dedi Alisa qiziqish ko'rsatishga harakat qilib.

en: 'No, you don't understand,' the Knight said, looking a little vexed.
uz: Yo'q, siz buni tushunmayapsiz, - dedi Ravon, biroz xafa bo'lib ko'rindi.

en: 'That's what the name is CALLED.
uz: Ushbu nom KOLD..

en: The name really IS THE AGED AGED MAN.' 'Then I ought to have said That's what the SONG is called?' Alice corrected herself.
uz: Ism haqiqatan ham THE AGED AGED MAN deb ataladi. 'Shuning uchun men SONG deb ataladi deb aytishim kerak edi, - deb o'zini to'g'riladi Alisa.

en: 'No, you oughtn't: that's quite another thing!
uz: Yo'q, bunday qilmasligingiz kerak: bu boshqa narsa!

en: The SONG is called WAYS AND MEANS: but that's only what it's CALLED, you know!' 'Well, what IS the song, then?' said Alice, who was by this time completely bewildered.
uz: Qo'shiqning nomi YOLlar va ma'nolar deb nomlanadi: ammo bu faqatgina uning NOMODIRI, bilasiz! - deb so'radi Alice, bu vaqtgacha butunlay g'alati bo'lgan.

en: 'I was coming to that,' the Knight said.
uz: Men shunga yaqinlashib kelayotgan edim, - dedi Ravnat.

en: 'The song really IS A- SITTING ON A GATE: and the tune's my own invention.' So saying, he stopped his horse and let the reins fall on its neck: then, slowly beating time with one hand, and with a faint smile lighting up his gentle foolish face, as if he enjoyed the music of his song, he began.
uz: Qo'shiq haqiqatan ham A-SITING ON A GATE: va qo'shiq mening o'zimning ixtiroimdir. Shunday qilib, u otini to'xtatdi va uning bo'yniga quvib qo'ydi: keyin, bir qo'li bilan vaqtni sekin-sekin urib, o'zining muloyim ahmoq yuzini yorqin tabassum bilan yoritdi, xuddi o'z qo'shiqining musiqasidan zavqlanayotgandek, u boshladi.

en: Of all the strange things that Alice saw in her journey Through The Looking-Glass, this was the one that she always remembered most clearly.
uz: Alice ko'z o'ngida ko'rgan barcha g'ayritabiiy narsalardan, bu u har doim eng aniq eslab qolgan narsa edi.

en: Years afterwards she could bring the whole scene back again, as if it had been only yesterday—the mild blue eyes and kindly smile of the Knight—the setting sun gleaming through his hair, and shining on his armour in a blaze of light that quite dazzled her— the horse quietly moving about, with the reins hanging loose on his neck, cropping the grass at her feet—and the black shadows of the forest behind—all this she took in like a picture, as, with one hand shading her eyes, she leant against a tree, watching the strange pair, and listening, in a half dream, to the melancholy music of the song.
uz: Keyinchalik u butun ko'rinishni yana o'tkazishi mumkin edi, xuddi o'tgan kun bo'lgani kabi, kechqurun - shavalning yengil ko'k ko'zlari va mehribon tabassumlari, sochlari orqali shishayotgan quyosh botishidan so'ng uning qurol-yarog'ini yorug'lik nurlari bilan yorug' qilib ko'rsatdi, bu uni juda ko'ngildan o'chirdi, otning bo'yniga o'g'rilar oshib, uning oyoqlari ostidagi o'tlarni o'chirdi va orqalaridan turgan o'rmonning qora soyalarini suratga tushirdi, chunki u bir qo'li bilan ko'zlarini sochib, daraxtga toshdi, g'alati juftni ko'rib, yarim tushda qo'shiq musiqasini tingladi.

en: 'But the tune ISN'T his own invention,' she said to herself: 'it's I GIVE THEE ALL, I CAN NO MORE.' She stood and listened very attentively, but no tears came into her eyes.
uz: U o'ziga shunday dedi: Ammo bu qo'shiq uning o'zi yaratmagan, bu Men senga hamma narsani beraman, men boshqa hech narsa qila olmayman.

en: 'I'll tell thee everything I can; There's little to relate.
uz: Senga qo'limdan kelganicha hamma narsani aytib beraman; aytish uchun juda oz narsa bor.

en: I saw an aged aged man, A-sitting on a gate.
uz: Men bir keksa odamni ko'rdim, u bir darvozada o'tirgan edi.

en: Who are you, aged man? I said, and how is it you live? And his answer trickled through my head Like water through a sieve.
uz: Men: Sen kimsan, keksa? - deb so'radim va uning javobi boshimga suvib ketdi.

en: He said I look for butterflies That sleep among the wheat: I make them into mutton-pies, And sell them in the street.
uz: U shunday dedi: Men bug'doy o'rtasida uxlaydigan ko'kraklarni izlayman: ularni qo'y cho'g'iga aylantiraman va ko'chada sotaman.

en: I sell them unto men, he said, Who sail on stormy seas; And that's the way I get my bread— A trifle, if you please. But I was thinking of a plan To dye one's whiskers green, And always use so large a fan That they could not be seen.
uz: Men ularni odamlarga sotaman, - dedi u, - buzg'unli dengizlarda kemada bo'lganlar, shu yo'sin nonim bor. - Agar xohlasangiz, kichik narsa. - Lekin men o'ylayotgan edim.

en: So, having no reply to give To what the old man said, I cried, Come, tell me how you live! And thumped him on the head.
uz: Shunday qilib, keksa odamning so'zlariga javob berolmay, Kel, qanday yashayotganingni ayt, deb baqirib, boshini urdim.

en: His accents mild took up the tale: He said I go my ways, And when I find a mountain-rill, I set it in a blaze; And thence they make a stuff they call Rolands' Macassar Oil— Yet twopence-halfpenny is all They give me for my toil. But I was thinking of a way To feed oneself on batter,
uz: Uning yengil nufuzli aksentlari hikoyani davom ettirdi: Men o'z yo'llarim bilan boraman, tog'ning yonib chiqishiga to'g'ri kelganimda, uni yonib tashlayman; va shundan ular Rolandsning Macassar moyini deb atagan narsalarni ishlab chiqarishadi.

en: And so go on from day to day Getting a little fatter.
uz: Shunday qilib, kundan-kunga ko'proq semizlanib keting.

en: I shook him well from side to side, Until his face was blue: Come, tell me how you live, I cried, And what it is you do! He said I hunt for haddocks' eyes Among the heather bright, And work them into waistcoat-buttons In the silent night.
uz: Men uni yonma-yon silkitib, yuzi ko'k bo'lgunga qadar: Bila, menga qanday yashayotganingni aytib ber, - deb o'yladim, Va nima qilayotganingni ayt! - dedi u. - Men qo'rqoqlarning ko'zlarini yoritib, ular bilan chiroyli ko'ylak tugmalariga aylanaman.

en: And these I do not sell for gold Or coin of silvery shine But for a copper halfpenny, And that will purchase nine.
uz: Va men bularni oltin yoki kumush tanga uchun sotmayman, balki mis yarim tanga uchun sotaman va bu to'qqizta pulni sotib oladi.

en: I sometimes dig for buttered rolls, Or set limed twigs for crabs; I sometimes search the grassy knolls For wheels of Hansom-cabs.
uz: Ba'zan yog'ochli rullarni qidirib topaman, ba'zan karvalar uchun cho'g'li shoxlarni o'rnataman; ba'zan o'tli qo'lchoqlarni Hansom-kabinalarining velosipedlarini qidirib topaman.

en: And that's the way (he gave a wink) By which I get my wealth— And very gladly will I drink Your Honour's noble health. I heard him then, for I had just Completed my design To keep the Menai bridge from rust By boiling it in wine.
uz: Va shu yo'l bilan (o'z ko'z o'ngini cho'zdi) O'z boyligimni o'z ichiga oladi Va men juda xursand bo'lib, Oliy Hukmdoringizning ulug'vor salomatligini ichaman. Men uni o'sha paytda eshitdim, chunki men Menai ko'prasini sharobga qaynatish orqali rangdan saqlab qolish uchun loyihamni to'xtatdim.

en: I thanked much for telling me The way he got his wealth, But chiefly for his wish that he Might drink my noble health.
uz: O'z boyligini qanday topganini aytib berganingiz uchun juda minnatdorman, lekin eng asosiysi, mening noyob sog'lig'imni ichish istagi uchun.

en: And now, if e'er by chance I put My fingers into glue Or madly squeeze a right-hand foot Into a left-hand shoe, Or if I drop upon my toe A very heavy weight, I weep, for it reminds me so,
uz: Endi esa, agar men o'zimning barmoqlarimni yopishqoqqa qo'ysam yoki o'ng qo'limni o'ng qo'lim bilan o'ng qo'limni o'ng qo'limga cho'qqizib qo'ysam yoki to'g'limga juda og'ir og'ir narsa tushsa, yig'layman, chunki bu menga shunday eslatadi,

en: Of that old man I used to know— Whose look was mild, whose speech was slow, Whose hair was whiter than the snow, Whose face was very like a crow, With eyes, like cinders, all aglow, Who seemed distracted with his woe, Who rocked his body to and fro, And muttered mumblingly and low, As if his mouth were full of dough, Who snorted like a buffalo— That summer evening, long ago, A-sitting on a gate.' As the Knight sang the last words of the ballad, he gathered up the reins, and turned his horse's head along the road by which they had come.
uz: O'sha keksa odamni bilgan edim Uning ko'z ko'rinishi yengil, so'zlari sekin, sochlari qordan oq edi, yuzi qo'rg'onga o'xshardi, ko'zlari ko'rinadigan kulga o'xshardi, butun ko'zlari yoqib ketdi, U o'z qayg'usi bilan chalg'ib ketgan edi, O'z tanasini burib-burib qo'zg'atardi, O'z og'zini xamirturush bilan to'ldirgan, O'sha yozgi kechada, uzoq vaqt oldin, buffalo singari qichqirdi, bir darvozada o'tirardi.

en: 'You've only a few yards to go,' he said,' down the hill and over that little brook, and then you'll be a Queen— But you'll stay and see me off first?' he added as Alice turned with an eager look in the direction to which he pointed.
uz: U: Sizga faqat bir necha metrcha yo'l qolgan, - dedi, toshni pastlab, o'sha kichik daryo ustidan borasiz va keyin siz kralicha bo'lasiz, lekin siz avval qoling va meni ko'rishga ketasizmi? - deb qo'shimcha qildi.

en: You'll wait and wave your handkerchief when I get to that turn in the road?
uz: Men yo'lning bu burchasiga yetib kelganimda, siz meni kutib, to'foningizni o'ynashingiz mumkinmi?

en: I think it'll encourage me, you see.' 'Of course I'll wait,' said Alice: 'and thank you very much for coming so far—and for the song—I liked it very much.' 'I hope so,' the Knight said doubtfully: 'but you didn't cry so much as I thought you would.' So they shook hands, and then the Knight rode slowly away into the forest.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu meni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, ko'rasiz. - Albatta, kutaman, - dedi Alice: - va bu qadar kelganingiz uchun juda minnatdorman va qo'shiq uchunMen juda yaxshi ko'rdim. - Umid qilamanki, - dedi Knight shubha ostiga: Ammo siz o'ylagandek yig'lamagansiz. Shunday qilib, ular qo'l urishdi va keyin Knight sekin-sekin o'rmonga chiqib ketdi.

en: 'It won't take long to see him OFF, I expect,' Alice said to herself, as she stood watching him.
uz: Uni OFF ko'rish uchun ko'p vaqt kerak bo'lmaydi, deb o'ylayman, - deb o'ylagan Alice uni kuzatib turganida.

en: Right on his head as usual!
uz: Odatdagidek, to'g'ri boshida!

en: However, he gets on again pretty easily—that comes of having so many things hung round the horse—' So she went on talking to herself, as she watched the horse walking leisurely along the road, and the Knight tumbling off, first on one side and then on the other.
uz: Biroq, u juda osonlikcha qaytadi, chunki ot atrofida shuncha narsalar oshib turadi. Shunday qilib, u o'zi bilan gaplashishni davom ettirdi va otni yo'l bo'ylab sekinlik bilan yurganini va qo'shin birinchi navbatda bir tomondan, so'ngra boshqa tomondan tushayotganini ko'rdi.

en: After the fourth or fifth tumble he reached the turn, and then she waved her handkerchief to him, and waited till he was out of sight.
uz: To'rtinchi yoki beshinchi tushishidan so'ng u burchakga yetdi, keyin u unga to'plamini o'girib, ko'rinmasligini kutdi.

en: 'I hope it encouraged him,' she said, as she turned to run down the hill: 'and now for the last brook, and to be a Queen!
uz: Ushbu uni dalda berganini umid qilaman, - dedi u tepalikdan pastga qarab: Va endi so'nggi daryoga va Qirolicha bo'lishga!

en: sounds!' A very few steps brought her to the edge of the brook.
uz: Bir necha qadamlar uni daryo bo'yiga olib keldi.

en: 'The Eighth Square at last!' she cried as she bounded across, * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * and threw herself down to rest on a lawn as soft as moss, with little flower-beds dotted about it here and there.
'Oh, how glad I am to get here!
uz: Oh, men bu yerga kelganimdan juda xursandman!

en: And what IS this on my head?' she exclaimed in a tone of dismay, as she put her hands up to something very heavy, and fitted tight all round her head.
uz: Bu mening boshimda nima? - deb qo'llarini og'ir narsa ustiga ko'tarib, o'z boshini qattiq o'rab olganida, u qo'rqinchli so'z aytdi.

en: 'But how CAN it have got there without my knowing it?' she said to herself, as she lifted it off, and set it on her lap to make out what it could possibly be.
uz: O'zim bilmagan holda, u qanday qilib u yerga yetib bordi? - deb o'ziga so'radi u, uni ko'tarib, o'z qoshiga qo'ydi va nima bo'lishi mumkinligini aniqladi.

en: It was a golden crown.
uz: Bu oltin toj edi.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 9 Qඝඍඍඖ Aඔඑඋඍ 'Well, this IS grand!' said Alice.
uz: 9 soatdan so'ng: Bu juda ajoyib! - dedi Alisa.

en: 'I never expected I should be a Queen so soon—and I'll tell you what it is, your majesty,' she went on in a severe tone (she was always rather fond of scolding herself), 'it'll never do for you to be lolling about on the grass like that!
uz: Men bunday tezda Qirolicha bo'lishimni hech qachon kutmagan edim va nima ekanligini sizga aytib beraman, majestetingiz, - dedi u qattiq tovushda (ular har doim o'zlarini tanqid qilishni yaxshi ko'rishgan), Siz uchun hech qachon o'tda o'tirib yurish kerak emas!

en: Queens have to be dignified, you know!' So she got up and walked about—rather stiffly just at first, as she was afraid that the crown might come off: but she comforted herself with the thought that there was nobody to see her, 'and if I really am a Queen,' she said as she sat down again, 'I shall be able to manage it quite well in time.' Everything was happening so oddly that she didn't feel a bit surprised at finding the Red Queen and the White Queen sitting close to her, one on each side: she would have liked very much to ask them how they came there, but she feared it would not be quite civil.
uz: Qirollar hurmatga sazovor bo'lishi kerak, bilasiz! - deb so'radi u. Shunday qilib, u o'rnidan turib, boshida biroz qattiq yurdi, chunki u toj tushishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardi: lekin uni ko'radigan hech kim yo'qligi fikrida o'zini tasalli berdi: Agar men haqiqatan ham Qirol bo'lsam, - dedi u yana o'tirib, men buni o'z vaqtida yaxshi o'tkazaman. Hamma narsa shunchalik g'alati bo'lib o'tganki, qizil Qirol va oq Qirolning yonida, bir-biridan o'tirganini ko'rib, o'zini biroz ajablantirmay qo'ydi: u ulardan u yerga qanday kelganini so'rashni juda yaxshi ko'rgandi, lekin u o'zini juda xushmuomala qilmaslikdan qo'rqardi.

en: However, there would be no harm, she thought, in asking if the game was over.
uz: Biroq, o'yin tugadi-yo'qmi deb so'rash hech qanday zarar keltirmaydi, deb o'yladi u.

en: 'Please, would you tell me—' she began, looking timidly at the Red Queen.
uz: Xullas, menga aytasizmi? deb boshladi u, qizil kralichaga qo'rqqancha qarab.

en: 'Speak when you're spoken to!' The Queen sharply interrupted her.
uz: O'zingiz bilan gaplashganda gapiring! - deb so'raganida, Qirolicha uni keskin aralashtirdi.

en: 'But if everybody obeyed that rule,' said Alice, who was always ready for a little argument, 'and if you only spoke when you were spoken to, and the other person always waited for YOU to begin, you see nobody would ever say anything, so that—' 'Ridiculous!' cried the Queen.
uz: Agar hamma bu qoidaga rioya qilsa, - dedi Alice, u har doim kichik bahsga tayyor edi, agar siz faqat o'zingiz bilan gaplashganingizda gapirgan bo'lsangiz va boshqa kishi har doim SIZni boshlashni kutgan bo'lsangiz, hech kim hech qachon biron narsa aytmas edi, shuning uchun Qizaloq! deb baqirdi.

en: 'Why, don't you see, child—' here she broke off with a frown, and, after thinking for a minute, suddenly changed the subject of the conversation.
uz: Nega, ko'rmadingmi, bola, - deb gapni burun ko'tardi u, bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'rgach, suhbat mavzusini to'satdan o'zgartirdi.

en: 'What do you mean by If you really are a Queen?
uz: Agar siz haqiqatan ham kraliça bo'lsangiz, degan so'zlar bilan nima demoqchisiz?

en: What right have you to call yourself so?
uz: O'zingizni shunday atashga qanday haqingiz bor?

en: You can't be a Queen, you know, till you've passed the proper examination.
uz: Bilasizmi, siz to'g'ri imtihondan o'tmaguningizcha kralicha bo'la olmaysiz.

en: And the sooner we begin it, the better.' 'I only said if!' poor Alice pleaded in a piteous tone.
uz: Va biz qanchalik tezroq boshlashimiz, shunchalik yaxshi. - Men faqat agar deb aytdim! - dedi kambag'al Alice achinarli so'z bilan.

en: The two Queens looked at each other, and the Red Queen remarked, with a little shudder, 'She SAYS she only said if—' 'But she said a great deal more than that!' the White Queen moaned, wringing her hands.
uz: Ikkala kraliça bir-birlariga qaradi va qizil kraliça biroz titrab: U faqat agar deb aytadi, deb aytadi, - deb aytadi.

en: 'Oh, ever so much more than that!' 'So you did, you know,' the Red Queen said to Alice.
uz: Oh, bundan ham ko'proq! - deb aytdi qizil kralicha Alicega.

en: 'Always speak the truth—think before you speak—and write it down afterwards.' 'I'm sure I didn't mean—' Alice was beginning, but the Red Queen interrupted her impatiently.
uz: Har doim haqiqatni gapirishdan oldin o'ylab ko'ring va keyin yozing. Mening fikrim yo'qligiga aminman - deb o'ylay boshlagan Alice, lekin Qizil Qiroli qizni sabrsizlik bilan to'xtatib qo'ydi.

en: 'That's just what I complain of!
uz: Men shunga shikoyat qilyapman!

en: You SHOULD have meant!
uz: Siz ma'nosini aytishingiz kerak edi!

en: What do you suppose is the use of child without any meaning?
uz: Sizningcha, boladan foydalangan holda nima bo'ladi?

en: Even a joke should have some meaning—and a child's more important than a joke, I hope.
uz: Umid qilamanki, hatto hazilning ham ma'nosi bo'lishi kerak va bola hazildan muhimroqdir.

en: You couldn't deny that, even if you tried with both hands.' 'I don't deny things with my HANDS,' Alice objected.
uz: Men o'z qo'llarim bilan hech narsani inkor qilmayman, - deb o'yladi Ailis.

en: 'Nobody said you did,' said the Red Queen.
uz: Sizni hech kim aytmadi, dedi qizil kralicha.

en: 'I said you couldn't if you tried.' 'She's in that state of mind,' said the White Queen, 'that she wants to deny SOMETHING—only she doesn't know what to deny!' 'A nasty, vicious temper,' the Red Queen remarked; and then there was an uncomfortable silence for a minute or two.
uz: Agar harakat qilsangiz, qila olmaysiz, deb aytdim, - dedi Oq Qirol. - O'zi shunday fikrda, u biror narsani inkor qilishni xohlaydi, faqat nima qilishni bilmaydi! - dedi Qizil Qirol. - Yomon, yovuz tuyg'u, keyin bir-ikki daqiqa noqulay tinchlik hukm surdi.

en: The Red Queen broke the silence by saying to the White Queen, 'I invite you to Alice's dinner-party this afternoon.' The White Queen smiled feebly, and said 'And I invite YOU.' 'I didn't know I was to have a party at all,' said Alice; 'but if there is to be one, I think _I_ ought to invite the guests.' 'We gave you the opportunity of doing it,' the Red Queen remarked: 'but I daresay you've not had many lessons in manners yet?' 'Manners are not taught in lessons,' said Alice.
uz: Qizil kraliça oq kraliçaga: Men sizni shu kechqurun Alisning kechki ovqatga taklif qilaman, - deb so'rab, tinchlikni buzdi. Oq kraliça qo'rqinchli tabassum qilib: Men sizni taklif qilaman, - dedi. Men bir marta ham partiyam bo'lishini bilmasdim, dedi Alisa; agar shunday bo'lsa, men mehmonlarni taklif qilishim kerak deb o'ylayman. Biz sizga buni qilish imkoniyatini berdik, deb aytdi Qizil kraliça: Ammo sizda odatdan ko'p darslar bo'lmaganini aytishga jur'at qilaman? - dedi Alisa.

en: 'Lessons teach you to do sums, and things of that sort.' 'And you do Addition?' the White Queen asked.
uz: Darslar sizga summalarni va shunga o'xshash narsalarni qilishni o'rgatadi. - Va siz qo'shimcha qilishni o'rganasizmi? - deb so'radi Oq Qirolicha.

en: 'What's one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one?'
uz: Bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir va bir nima?

en: 'I don't know,' said Alice.
uz: Bila olmayman, dedi Alisa.

en: 'I lost count.' 'She can't do Addition,' the Red Queen interrupted.
uz: Men hisobni yo'qotdim. U qo'shimcha qila olmaydi, - dedi Qizil Qirolicha.

en: 'Can you do Subtraction?
uz: Siz chekishni qila olasizmi?

en: Take nine from eight.' 'Nine from eight I can't, you know,' Alice replied very readily: 'but—' 'She can't do Subtraction,' said the White Queen.
uz: To'qqizdan to'qqizini ol. - Men to'qqizdan to'qqizini ololmayman, bilasiz, - deb javob berdi Alisa juda tezlik bilan. - Lekin O'zi kamaytirishni qila olmaydi, dedi Oq Qiroli.

en: 'Can you do Division?
uz: Siz Division bilan shug'ullanishingiz mumkinmi?

en: Divide a loaf by a knife—what's the answer to that?' 'I suppose—' Alice was beginning, but the Red Queen answered for her.
uz: Nonni pichoq bilan bo'lish nima javob? - deb o'ylayman, - deb boshlagan Alice, lekin Qizil Qiroli qizning o'rniga javob berdi.

en: 'Bread-and-butter, of course.
uz: Roti va yog'och, albatta.

en: Try another Subtraction sum.
uz: Boshqa bir kamaytirish summasini sinab ko'ring.

en: Take a bone from a dog: what remains?' Alice considered.
uz: Itdan bir suyakni olib tashlash: nima qoladi? deb o'yladi Alisa.

en: 'The bone wouldn't remain, of course, if I took it —and the dog wouldn't remain; it would come to bite me —and I'm sure I shouldn't remain!' 'Then you think nothing would remain?' said the Red Queen.
uz: Agar uni olib qo'ysam, suyak qolmaydi, it ham qolmaydi, u meni urishga kelishi mumkin, men ham qolmasligimga aminman, - dedi qizil kralicha.

en: 'I think that's the answer.' 'Wrong, as usual,' said the Red Queen: 'the dog's temper would remain.' 'But I don't see how—' 'Why, look here!' the Red Queen cried.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, bu javobdir. To'g'ri, har doimgidek, dedi Qizil Qirolicha: itning g'azabi qolishi mumkin. Ammo men buni qanday tushunmayapman. Nima uchun, bu yerga qaranglar! - deb qichqirdi Qizil Qirolicha.

en: 'The dog would lose its temper, wouldn't it?' 'Perhaps it would,' Alice replied cautiously.
uz: Ito g'azabini yo'qotadi, shunday emasmi? - deb javob berdi Alisa ehtiyotkorlik bilan.

en: 'Then if the dog went away, its temper would remain!' the Queen exclaimed triumphantly.
uz: Agar it ketsa, uning g'azabi qoladi, - deb shohlik xotini g'alaba bilan baqirib yubordi.

en: Alice said, as gravely as she could, 'They might go different ways.' But she couldn't help thinking to herself, 'What dreadful nonsense we ARE talking!' 'She can't do sums a BIT!' the Queens said together, with great emphasis.
uz: Alice iloji boricha jiddiyroq: Ular turli yo'llar bilan ketishlari mumkin, - dedi, ammo o'z o'ylashiga qo'shilib: Biz nima haqida gapirayotganmiz! - deb o'ylay olmadi.

en: 'Can YOU do sums?' Alice said, turning suddenly on the White Queen, for she didn't like being found fault with so much.
uz: SHOQ qila olasizmi? - dedi Ailis, toʻsatdan Oq Qirolichaga qaradi, chunki u juda koʻp aybdor boʻlganini yoqtirmasdi.

en: The Queen gasped and shut her eyes.
uz: Qirolicha nafas olib, ko'zlarini yopdi.

en: 'I can do Addition, if you give me time—but I can do Subtraction, under ANY circumstances!' 'Of course you know your A B C?' said the Red Queen.
uz: Agar menga vaqt bersang, qo'shish mumkin, lekin men har qanday holatda kamaytirish mumkin! - deb aytdi qizil kralicha.

en: 'To be sure I do.' said Alice.
uz: Men buni qilyapman, deb ishonch hosil qilish uchun, - dedi Alice.

en: 'So do I,' the White Queen whispered: 'we'll often say it over together, dear.
uz: Men ham shundayman, - deb shoshirdi Oq Qiroli: Biz buni tez-tez birgalikda aytamiz, aziz.

en: And I'll tell you a secret—I can read words of one letter!
uz: Va men sizga bir sirni aytaman, bir harfning so'zlarini o'qishim mumkin!

en: However, don't be discouraged.
uz: Biroq, tushkunlikka tushmang.

en: You'll come to it in time.'
uz: Vaqt o'tgach, o'zingizni shunday his qilasiz.

en: Here the Red Queen began again.
uz: Bu yerda Qizil Kraliça yana boshlandi.

en: 'Can you answer useful questions?' she said.
uz: Siz foydali savollarga javob bera olasizmi? - dedi u.

en: 'How is bread made?' 'I know THAT!' Alice cried eagerly.
uz: Nimaga non tayyorlanadi? - deb o'ylaydi Alisa.

en: 'You take some flour—' 'Where do you pick the flower?' the White Queen asked.
uz: Siz unni olib ketasiz, qushni qayerdan yig'asiz? deb so'radi Oq Qirolicha.

en: 'In a garden, or in the hedges?' 'Well, it isn't PICKED at all,' Alice explained: 'it's GROUND —' 'How many acres of ground?' said the White Queen.
uz: O'rmondami yoki to'siqlardami? - deb so'radi Alice: Bu yerni ko'rish kerak emas, deb tushuntirdi. Bu yerni ko'rish kerakmi? - deb so'radi Oq Qirolicha.

en: 'You mustn't leave out so many things.' 'Fan her head!' the Red Queen anxiously interrupted.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha tashvishlanib: Uning boshini yoqtir! - deb to'xtatdi.

en: 'She'll be feverish after so much thinking.' So they set to work and fanned her with bunches of leaves, till she had to beg them to leave off, it blew her hair about so.
uz: U shuncha ko'p o'ylab ko'rganidan so'ng issiq bo'ladi. Shunday qilib, ular ishga kirishdi va uni bir necha barglar bilan o'ldirishdi, hatto ularni qo'yib yuborishlarini iltijo qilishlari kerak bo'lgunga qadar, sochlari o'sha qadar puflab ketdi.

en: 'She's all right again now,' said the Red Queen.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: U endi yana yaxshi.

en: 'Do you know Languages?
uz: 'Siz tillarni bilasizmi?

en: What's the French for fiddle-de-dee?' 'Fiddle-de-dee's not English,' Alice replied gravely.
uz: Fiddle-de-dee ingliz tilida emas, - deb javob berdi Alice jiddiy.

en: 'Who ever said it was?' said the Red Queen.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: Buni kim aytdi? - dedi.

en: Alice thought she saw a way out of the difficulty this time.
uz: Bu safar Alice qiyinchiliklardan xalos bo'lishning bir yo'lini ko'rdi deb o'yladi.

en: 'If you'll tell me what language fiddle-de-dee is, I'll tell you the French for it!' she exclaimed triumphantly.
uz: Agar siz menga fiddle-de-dee qaysi tilda ishlatilishini aytsangiz, men sizga fransuz tilini aytaman! - dedi u g'alaba bilan.

en: But the Red Queen drew herself up rather stiffly, and said 'Queens never make bargains.' 'I wish Queens never asked questions,' Alice thought to herself.
uz: Lekin Qizil Qirolicha o'zini juda qattiq qo'yib, Qirolichalar hech qachon oldi-sotdi qilmaydi deb aytdi.

en: 'Don't let us quarrel,' the White Queen said in an anxious tone.
uz: Bizda bahslashishga yo'l qo'ymang, - dedi Oq Qirolicha tashvishlanayotgan tonda.

en: 'What is the cause of lightning?' 'The cause of lightning,' Alice said very decidedly, for she felt quite certain about this, 'is the thunder—no, no!' she hastily corrected herself.
uz: Biroqning sababi nima? - dedi Ailis juda qat'iy, chunki u bu haqda o'zini juda aniq his qilgan edi, - bu g'ildirak, yo'q! - deb o'zini tezda tuzatdi.

en: 'I meant the other way.' 'It's too late to correct it,' said the Red Queen: 'when you've once said a thing, that fixes it, and you must take the consequences.' 'Which reminds me—' the White Queen said, looking down and nervously clasping and unclasping her hands, 'we had SUCH a thunderstorm last Tuesday—I mean one of the last set of Tuesdays, you know.' Alice was puzzled.
uz: Men boshqa tomondan aytmoqchi edim. - Qizil Qirolicha shunday dedi: Bir marta gapirganingizda, bu uni tuzatadi va siz oqibatlarni qabul qilishingiz kerak. - Bu menga eslatadi. - Oq Qirolicha pastga qarab, qo'llarini g'ayrat bilan yopib qo'ydi, - O'tgan seshanba kuni shunday bo'ron bo'ldi.

en: 'In OUR country,' she remarked, 'there's only one day at a time.' The Red Queen said, 'That's a poor thin way of doing things.
uz: BIZ mamlakatimizda bir kunning o'zida kun bor, - dedi qizil kraliça.

en: Now HERE, we mostly have days and nights two or three at a time, and
uz: Hozir bu erda bizda asosan bir vaqtning o'zida ikki yoki uch kun va kechasi bor va

en: sometimes in the winter we take as many as five nights together—for warmth, you know.' 'Are five nights warmer than one night, then?' Alice ventured to ask.
uz: Ba'zan qishda biz birga besh kecha o'tkazamiz. Besh kecha bir kechaga qaraganda issiqroqmi? deb so'rashga jur'at qildi.

en: 'Five times as warm, of course.' 'But they should be five times as COLD, by the same rule—' 'Just so!' cried the Red Queen.
uz: Besh barobar issiq, albatta. Ammo ular bir xil qoidaga ko'ra, besh barobar sovuq bo'lishi kerak, - deb baqirdi Qizil Qirolicha.

en: 'Five times as warm, AND five times as cold—just as I'm five times as rich as you are, AND five times as clever!' Alice sighed and gave it up.
uz: Besh marta issiq va besh marta sovuq, xuddi men sening besh marta boy va besh marta aqlli bo'lganimdek! - deb o'yladi Alisa va taslim bo'ldi.

en: 'It's exactly like a riddle with no answer!' she thought.
uz: Bu javobsiz jumboq kabi! - deb o'yladi u.

en: 'Humpty Dumpty saw it too,' the White Queen went on in a low voice, more as if she were talking to herself.
uz: Humpty Dumpty ham buni ko'rdi, deb davom etdi Oq Qirolicha, ko'proq o'zi bilan gaplashgandek.

en: 'He came to the door with a corkscrew in his hand—' 'What did he want?' said the Red Queen.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: U qo'lida korksikr bilan eshikga keldi, deb so'radi.

en: 'He said he WOULD come in,' the White Queen went on, 'because he was looking for a hippopotamus.
uz: U O'ZI keladi, dedi, deb davom etdi Oq Qirolicha, chunki u ipopotam izlayotgan edi.

en: Now, as it happened, there wasn't such a thing in the house, that morning.' 'Is there generally?' Alice asked in an astonished tone.
uz: O'sha kuni ertalab uyda bunday narsa yo'q edi. - Umuman bo'ladimi? - deb so'radi Alisa hayron tonda.

en: 'Well, only on Thursdays,' said the Queen.
uz: To'g'ri, faqat payshanba kunlari, - dedi Qirolicha.

en: 'I know what he came for,' said Alice: 'he wanted to punish the fish, because—' Here the White Queen began again.
uz: Men uning nima uchun kelganini bilaman, - dedi Alice: U baliqlarni jazolashni xohlagan, chunki Bu erda Oq Qirolicha yana boshlandi.

en: 'It was SUCH a thunderstorm, you can't think!' ('She NEVER could, you know,' said the Red Queen.) 'And part of the roof came off, and ever so much thunder got in—and it went rolling round the room in great lumps—and knocking over the tables and things—till I was so frightened, I couldn't remember my own name!' Alice thought to herself, 'I never should TRY to remember my name in the middle of an accident!
uz: UChUN g'amgin bo'ldi, o'ylay olmaysiz! - dedi Qizil Qirolicha. - So'ngra tomning bir qismi tushdi va shuncha g'amgin g'amgin tushdi va xona atrofida katta bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lib, stollar va boshqa narsalarni burib yubordi, hatto men shunchalik qo'rqdimki, o'z ismimni eslay olmayman! - deb o'ylagan Alice, Qarshiligimda o'z ismimni eslashga hech qachon harakat qilmasligim kerak!

en: Where would be the use of it?' but she did not say this aloud, for fear of hurting the poor Queen's feeling.
uz: Bu qanday foyda keltiradi?' deb so'ragan, ammo u bu so'zni og'ir kraliçaning his-tuyg'usini og'ritishidan qo'rqqan holda baland ovoz bilan aytmadi.

en: 'Your Majesty must excuse her,' the Red Queen said to Alice, taking one of the White Queen's hands in her own, and gently stroking it: 'she means well, but she can't help saying foolish things, as a general rule.'
uz: Qizil kraliça Alicega shunday dedi: Mening majlisi uni kechirishi kerak, - Oq kraliçaning qo'lidan birini olib, uni muloyimlik bilan o'chirib qo'ydi: U yaxshi niyatda gapiryapti, lekin odatda o'ziga o'xshaydigan ahmoqona so'zlarni aytadi.

en: The White Queen looked timidly at Alice, who felt she OUGHT to say something kind, but really couldn't think of anything at the moment.
uz: Oq Qiroli qiz Alicega qo'rqqancha qaradi va u o'zini mehribon bir narsa aytishi kerakligini his qiladi, ammo hozirda hech narsa haqida o'ylamaydi.

en: 'She never was really well brought up,' the Red Queen went on: 'but it's amazing how good-tempered she is!
uz: U hech qachon yaxshi tarbiyalangan emas edi, deb davom etdi Qizil Qirolicha: lekin u qanchalik xushmuomala bo'lishi ajablanarli!

en: Pat her on the head, and see how pleased she'll be!' But this was more than Alice had courage to do.
uz: Uning boshiga qo'l urib, ko'ring, u qanchalik xursand bo'ladi! - deb aytdi, ammo bu Alicega jasoratli bo'lishdan ko'ra ko'proq ish bo'ldi.

en: 'A little kindness—and putting her hair in papers—would do wonders with her—' The White Queen gave a deep sigh, and laid her head on Alice's shoulder.
uz: Bir oz mehribonlik va sochlarini qog'ozlarga qo'yish u bilan mo'jizalar yaratadi, deb aytadi Oq Qiroli qiz chuqur nafas olib, boshini Alisning yelkasiga qo'ydi.

en: 'I AM so sleepy?' she moaned.
uz: Men juda uxlaymanmi? - deb qayg'urdi u.

en: 'She's tired, poor thing!' said the Red Queen.
uz: U charchagan, kambag'al! - dedi Qizil Qirolicha.

en: 'Smooth her hair — lend her your nightcap—and sing her a soothing lullaby.' 'I haven't got a nightcap with me,' said Alice, as she tried to obey the first direction: 'and I don't know any soothing lullabies.' 'I must do it myself, then,' said the Red Queen, and she began: 'Hush-a-by lady, in Alice's lap!
uz: O'z sochlarini yumshat  unga kechki sovg'angni qarzing va unga tinchlantiruvchi uyqu qo'shiqlarini kuylagin. Men bilan kechki sovg'am yo'q, dedi Alisa, birinchi yo'l-yo'riqga rioya qilishga harakat qilib: va men hech qanday tinchlantiruvchi uyqu qo'shiqlarini bilmayman. Shuning uchun o'zim buni qilishim kerak, dedi Qizil Qirolicha va u boshladi: Hush-a-by lady, Alisaning qo'lida!

en: Till the feast's ready, we've time for a nap: When the feast's over, we'll go to the ball— Red Queen, and White Queen, and Alice, and all!
uz: Bayram tayyor bo'lmaguncha, biroz uxlashimiz mumkin: Bayram tugaganida, biz tantanaga boramiz Qizil Qiroli, Oq Qiroli, Alisa va hamma narsa!

en: 'And now you know the words,' she added, as she put her head down on Alice's other shoulder, 'just sing it through to ME.
uz: Va endi so'zlarni bilasiz, - deb qo'shimcha qildi u, boshini Alisning boshqa shoxariga qo'yib, o'zini menga o'qib bering.

en: I'm getting sleepy, too.' In another moment both Queens were fast asleep, and snoring loud.
uz: Men ham uxlab ketyapman. Boshqa bir daqiqada ikkala quynes ham tez uxlab, baland ovoz bilan qichqirishgan.

en: 'What AM I to do?' exclaimed Alice, looking about in great perplexity, as first one round head, and then the other, rolled down from her shoulder, and lay like a heavy lump in her lap.
uz: Men nima qilsam bo'ladi? - deb o'yladi Alisa, o'zini juda g'alati ko'rib, avval bir boshni aylanib, keyin boshini o'z shoxlaridan qulab, yonida og'ir to'plam kabi yotganini ko'rdi.

en: 'I don't think it EVER happened before, that any one had to take care of two Queens asleep at once!
uz: Mening fikrimcha, hech kim bir vaqtning o'zida ikki uyqushtirgan Queensni boqishi kerak bo'lgan hech qachon sodir bo'lmagan!

en: No, not in all the History of England—it couldn't, you know, because there never was more than one Queen at a time.
uz: Yo'q, Angliya tarixida hech qachon birdan ko'proq kraliça bo'lmaganligi sababli, bunday bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: 'Do wake up, you heavy things!' she went on in an impatient tone; but there was no answer but a gentle snoring.
uz: O'zingizni uyg'otinglar, og'ir narsalar! - deb davom etdi u sabrsizlik bilan; lekin javob bo'lmaganicha, yonib-yugurib qichqirishdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: The snoring got more distinct every minute, and sounded more like a tune: at last she could even make out the words, and she listened so eagerly that, when the two great heads vanished from her lap, she hardly missed them.
uz: Xorqlash har bir daqiqada yanada aniqroq bo'lib borardi va musiqaga o'xshardi: nihoyat, u hatto so'zlarni aniqlay oldi va u shunchalik jon kuydirdiki, ikkita katta bosh uning qoshiqidan yo'qolganda, ularni juda ham sog'inib qolmadi.

en: She was standing before an arched doorway over which were the words QUEEN ALICE in large letters, and on each side of the arch there was a bell-handle; one was marked 'Visitors' Bell,' and the other 'Servants' Bell.' 'I'll wait till the song's over,' thought Alice, 'and then I'll ring—the— WHICH bell must I ring?' she went on, very much puzzled by the names.
uz: U qo'rqinchli eshik oldida turgan edi, uning ustida katta harflarda QIROLLA ALIS so'zlari yozilgan edi va qo'rqinchning har bir tomonida qo'ng'iroq qo'llari bor edi; bittasi Tavvalchilar qo'ng'iroqlari, ikkinchisi esa Xizmatchilar qo'ng'iroqlari deb yozilgan edi. Qo'ng'iroq tugaguniga qadar kutaman, deb o'yladi Alisa, va keyin qaysi qo'ng'iroqni qo'ng'iroq qilaman? deb o'yladi.

en: 'I'm not a visitor, and I'm not a servant.
uz: Men mehmon emasman, xizmatkor ham emasman.

en: There OUGHT to be one marked Queen, you know—' Just then the door opened a little way, and a creature with a long beak put its head out for a moment and said 'No admittance till the week after next!' and shut the door again with a bang.
uz: O'SHANDA Qanonicha deb yozilgan bir kishi bo'lishi kerak edi, o'sha paytda eshik biroz ochildi va uzoq burchakli mavjudot bir zumga boshini ko'tarib: Kengacha bir hafta o'tgach kirishga ruxsat yo'q! - deb aytdi va eshikni yana bir marta shovqin bilan yopdi.

en: Alice knocked and rang in vain for a long time, but at last, a very old Frog, who was sitting under a tree, got up and hobbled slowly towards her: he was dressed in bright yellow, and had enormous boots on.
uz: Alice uzoq vaqt davomida to'qnashdi va to'qnashdi, lekin nihoyat, daraxt ostida o'tirgan juda keksa Frog o'rnidan turib, uning yo'liga sekin-sekin shovqin qildi: u chiroyli sariq kiyim kiygan va ulkan poyabzal kiygan edi.

en: 'What is it, now?' the Frog said in a deep hoarse whisper.
uz: Hndi nima bor? - deb so'radi Qoraq chuqur qichqiriq bilan.

en: Alice turned round, ready to find fault with anybody.
uz: Alisa o'girilib, har kimda ayb topishga tayyor edi.

en: 'Where's the servant whose business it is to answer the door?' she began angrily.
uz: U g'azabga to'lib: Ochiq eshikni ochish ishiga ega bo'lgan xizmatkor qayerda? - deb boshladi.

en: 'Which door?' said the Frog.
uz: Qanday eshik? deb so'radi Qoraq.

en: Alice almost stamped with irritation at the slow drawl in which he spoke.
uz: U gapirgan sekinlik bilan Alice deyarli g'azabga to'ldi.

en: 'THIS door, of course!' The Frog looked at the door with his large dull eyes for a minute: then he went nearer and rubbed it with his thumb, as if he were trying whether the paint would come off; then he looked at Alice.
uz: BUN darvoza, albatta! - deb, Qaroq bir daqiqa davomida katta, chiroyli ko'zlari bilan eshikga qaradi: so'ngra yaqinlashib, barmog'i bilan o'tkazib, bo'yoq tushadimi yoki yo'qmi, deb o'ylaydi. So'ngra Alisaga qarab turadi.

en: 'To answer the door?' he said.
uz: Qo'rningni ochish uchunmi? - dedi u.

en: 'What's it been asking of?' He was so hoarse that Alice could scarcely hear him.
uz: Nima haqida so'ragan? - deb o'yladi u. U shunchalik qichqiriq ediki, Aliza uni hatto eshitolmadi.

en: 'I don't know what you mean,' she said.
uz: U: Nima demoqchi ekanligingizni bilmayman.

en: 'I talks English, doesn't I?' the Frog went on.
uz: Men ingliz tilida gapiryapman, shunday emasmi? - deb davom etdi Frog.

en: What did it ask you?' 'Nothing!' Alice said impatiently.
uz: U senga nima so'ragan? - deb so'radi. - Hech narsa! - dedi Alisa sabrsizlik bilan.

en: 'I've been knocking at it!' 'Shouldn't do that—shouldn't do that—' the Frog muttered.
uz: Men unga taqillatib yuribman! - deb o'ylaydi Qoraq.

en: 'Vexes it, you know.' Then he went up and gave the door a kick with one of his great feet.
uz: O'zingiz bilasiz, - deb gapirganidan so'ng, u o'zining katta oyoqlaridan biri bilan eshikni urdi.

en: 'You let IT alone,' he panted out, as he hobbled back to his tree, 'and it'll let YOU alone, you know.' At this moment the door was flung open, and a shrill voice was heard singing: 'To the Looking-Glass world it was Alice that said,
uz: SING O'ZINGni tashlab ketasan, - dedi u o'z daraxtining oldiga qaytganida, u SINGni tashlab ketadi, bilasizmi.O'sha paytda eshik ochildi va bir shrill ovoz: O'z ko'zlari bilan ko'rinadigan dunyoga Alice shunday degan edi:

en: I've a sceptre in hand, I've a crown on my head; Let the Looking-Glass creatures, whatever they be, Come and dine with the Red Queen, the White Queen, and me.' And hundreds of voices joined in the chorus: 'Then fill up the glasses as quick as you can, And sprinkle the table with buttons and bran: Put cats in the coffee, and mice in the tea— And welcome Queen Alice with thirty-times-three!' Then followed a confused noise of cheering, and Alice thought to herself, 'Thirty times three makes ninety.
uz: Men qo'limda sceptr, boshimda toj bor; Qizil oyna mavjudotlari, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, Qizil Qirol, Oq Qirol va men bilan birga ovqatlanishga kelinglar. Va chorusga yuzlab ovozlar qo'shildi: Shundan so'ng oynalarni imkon qadar tezroq to'ldiringlar, stolga tugmalar va maydalar bilan to'ldiringlar: Qahvaga mushuklar, choyga tuproqlar qo'yinglar Va Qirolxo'ri Elisni o'ttiz marta uch marta kutib olinglar! So'ngra g'ayratli quvonch ovozi bo'ldi va Elis o'zicha: O'ttiz marta uch marta to'qqiz marta to'qqiz marta.

en: I wonder if any one's counting?' In a minute there was silence again, and the same shrill voice sang another verse; 'O Looking-Glass creatures, quothe Alice, draw near!
uz: Bir daqiqadan so'ng yana sessizlik paydo bo'ldi va o'sha shrill ovoz yana bir oyatni kuyladi; Ey ko'z ko'rinadigan mavjudotlar, - deb aytdi Alisa, - yaqinlashinglar!

en: 'Tis an honour to see me, a favour to hear: 'Tis a privilege high to have dinner and tea Along with the Red Queen, the White Queen, and me!' Then came the chorus again:— 'Then fill up the glasses with treacle and ink, Or anything else that is pleasant to drink: Mix sand with the cider, and wool with the wine— And welcome Queen Alice with ninety-times-nine!' 'Ninety times nine!' Alice repeated in despair, 'Oh, that'll never be done!
uz: Meni ko'rish katta sharafdir, eshitish katta muborakdir: Qizil Qirol, Oq Qirol va men bilan birga kechki ovqat va choy o'tkazish katta sharafdir! - deb aytishdi. Keyin yana bir chor keldi: Shundan so'ng, ko'zlaringiz ichimlik uchun yoqimli bo'lgan har qanday narsa bilan to'ldiring: sidr bilan qumni aralashtiring, sharob bilan yog'ochni aralashtiring Va qiroli Alisni to'qqiz marta to'qqiz marta kutib oling! To'qqiz marta to'qqiz marta! deb aytdi.

en: I'd better go in at once—' and there was a dead silence the moment she appeared.
uz: O'sha zahoti ichkariga kirsam yaxshi bo'lardi' va u paydo bo'lganda o'lik xotirjamlik bo'lgan.

en: Alice glanced nervously along the table, as she walked up the large hall, and noticed that there were about fifty guests, of all kinds: some were animals, some birds, and there were even a few flowers among them.
uz: Alice katta zalga chiqib, stol bo'ylab g'ayrat bilan ko'z ochdi va o'rtalarida taxminan ellik nafar mehmon borligini payqadi: ba'zilari hayvonlar, ba'zilari qushlar va hatto bir nechta gullar ham bor edi.

en: 'I'm glad they've come without waiting to be asked,' she thought: 'I should never have known who were the right people to invite!' There were three chairs at the head of the table; the Red and White Queens had already taken two of them, but the middle one was empty.
uz: Men ular so'ralishni kutmasdan kelganidan xursandman, deb o'yladi u: Men hech qachon kimni taklif qilish uchun to'g'ri odam ekanligini bilmas edim! - deb o'yladi.

en: Alice sat down in it, rather uncomfortable in the silence, and longing for some one to speak.
uz: O'zi o'tirgan Alice, so'zsizlikda o'zini noqulay his qilib, kimnidir gapirishni orzu qilardi.

en: At last the Red Queen began.
uz: Oxir-oqibat Qizil Qirol boshlandi.

en: 'You've missed the soup and fish,' she said.
uz: Supani va baliqni sog'inib qoldingiz, dedi u.

en: 'Put on the joint!' And the waiters set a leg of mutton before
uz: Jintingni kiying! - deb so'rashdi va xizmatkorlar qo'y oyoqlarini qo'yib qo'yishdi.

en: Alice, who looked at it rather anxiously, as she had never had to carve a joint before.
uz: Alice bu haqda qayg'urib o'ylab ko'rdi, chunki u ilgari hech qachon qo'shni o'rnatishga majbur bo'lmagan.

en: 'You look a little shy; let me introduce you to that leg of mutton,' said the Red Queen.
uz: Siz biroz uyatchan ko'rinasiz; sizga o'sha qo'y oyoqlarini tanishtiraman, dedi Qizil Qirolicha.

en: 'Alice—Mutton; Mutton—Alice.' The leg of mutton got up in the dish and made a little bow to Alice; and Alice returned the bow, not knowing whether to be frightened or amused.
uz: Alice Mutton; Mutton Alice. Qo'y oyoqlari pishirgichga tushib, Alizaga kichik bir sajda qildilar va Aliza qo'rqish yoki o'yin qilish kerakligini bilmay, sajda qilishni qaytarib berdi.

en: 'May I give you a slice?' she said, taking up the knife and fork, and looking from one Queen to the other.
uz: Senga bir bo'lak bersam bo'ladimi? - dedi u, o'sha qilich va furqonni olib, bir qirolidan boshqasiga qarab.

en: 'Certainly not,' the Red Queen said, very decidedly: 'it isn't etiquette to cut any one you've been introduced to.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: Haqiqatan ham yo'q, - dedi, juda qat'iylik bilan: Sizni tanishtirgan har bir kishini kesish odob emas.

en: Remove the joint!' And the waiters carried it off, and brought a large plum-pudding in its place.
uz: Qo'shni olib tashlanglar! - deb so'rashdi va xizmatkorlar uni olib ketishdi va uning o'rniga ulkan plum pudding keltirishdi.

en: 'I won't be introduced to the pudding, please,' Alice said rather hastily, 'or we shall get no dinner at all.
uz: Meni pudding bilan tanishtirmaysiz, iltimos, - dedi Ailis shoshilinchlik bilan, yoki kechki ovqatga hech qachon bormaymiz.

en: May I give you some?' But the Red Queen looked sulky, and growled 'Pudding—Alice; Alice—Pudding.
uz: Sizga bir oz bersam bo'ladimi? - deb so'radi qizil kraliça, lekin qizil ko'rinish bilan PuddingAlice; AlicePudding deb qichqirdi.

en: Remove the pudding!' and the waiters took it away so quickly that Alice couldn't return its bow.
uz: Puddingni olib tashlang! - deb so'radi va xizmatkorlar uni shunday tez olib ketishdiki, Alisa uning qo'lini qaytarib berolmadi.

en: However, she didn't see why the Red Queen should be the only one to give orders, so, as an experiment, she called out 'Waiter!
uz: Biroq, u nima uchun Qizil Qirolning o'zi buyrug'lar berishini tushunmadi, shuning uchun u tajriba sifatida: O'g'lim!

en: Bring back the pudding!' and there it was again in a moment like a conjuring-trick.
uz: Puddingni qaytarib keling! - dedi va bir lahzada u yana sehrgarlik hiylasi kabi paydo bo'ldi.

en: It was so large that she couldn't help feeling a LITTLE shy with it, as she had been with the mutton; however, she conquered her shyness by a great effort and cut a slice and handed it to the Red Queen.
uz: U shunchalik katta bo'lganki, qo'zi bilan bo'lgani kabi, u bilan ozgina uyalgan bo'lishi mumkin edi; ammo u o'zining uyalganligini katta harakat bilan yengib, bir bo'lak kesib, Qizil Qirolga berdi.

en: 'What impertinence!' said the Pudding.
uz: Bu qanday beparvolik! - dedi Pudding.

en: 'I wonder how you'd like it, if I were to cut a slice out of YOU, you creature!' It spoke in a thick, suety sort of voice, and Alice hadn't a word to say in reply: she could only sit and look at it and gasp.
uz: Agar men Sendan bir bo'lak kessam, o'zingni qanday yoqtirasan, deb o'ylayman, ey yaratilish! - deb so'zlashdi u zich, go'zal tovush bilan, va Ailis javob uchun so'z aytolmadi: u faqat o'tirib, unga qarab, nafas oladigan edi.

en: 'Make a remark,' said the Red Queen: 'it's ridiculous to leave all the conversation to the pudding!' 'Do you know, I've had such a quantity of poetry repeated to me to-day,' Alice began, a little frightened at finding that, the moment she opened her lips, there was dead silence, and all eyes were fixed upon her; 'and it's a very curious thing, I think— every poem was about fishes in some way.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: Qo'p suhbatni pudingga tashlab ketish g'alati! - dedi. Bilasizmi, bugun menga shuncha ko'p she'rlar takrorlandi, - deb boshladi Alisa, ozgina qo'rqib, o'z og'zini ochgan paytda o'lik xotirjamlik bo'lib qoldi va hamma uning ko'zlariga qaragan edi.

en: Do you know why they're so fond of fishes, all about here?'
uz: Bu yerda nima uchun baliqlarni shunchalik yaxshi ko'rishganini bilasizmi?

en: She spoke to the Red Queen, whose answer was a little wide of the mark.
uz: Qizil Qiroli bilan suhbatlashdi, uning javobi biroz keng edi.

en: 'As to fishes,' she said, very slowly and solemnly, putting her mouth close to Alice's ear, 'her White Majesty knows a lovely riddle—all in poetry—all about fishes.
uz: O'z og'zini Alisning quloqlariga yaqinlashtirib, baliqlarga nisbatan, - dedi u, juda sekin va tantanali ravishda, - uning Oq Oliyosi baliqlar haqida she'rlarda ajoyib raqibni biladi.

en: Shall she repeat it?' 'Her Red Majesty's very kind to mention it,' the White Queen murmured into Alice's other ear, in a voice like the cooing of a pigeon.
uz: Uni takrorlay oladimi? - deb so'zlab o'tdi. - Qizil Qiroli qizil majlisi buni aytib berish uchun juda mehribon bo'ldi, - deb o'yladi oq kralicha Alice ning boshqa quloqlariga, qo'zi cho'qqisi kabi ovoz bilan.

en: 'It would be SUCH a treat!
uz: Bu shunday yaxshilik bo'lardi!

en: May I?' 'Please do,' Alice said very politely.
uz: Xullas, shunday qilsam bo'ladimi? - deb so'radi Alisa xushmuomalalik bilan.

en: The White Queen laughed with delight, and stroked Alice's cheek.
uz: Oq Qiroli qiz quvonch bilan kulishdi va Alisning shavqasini o'qib qo'ydilar.

en: Then she began: 'First, the fish must be caught. That is easy: a baby, I think, could have caught it.
uz: Keyin u: Birinchida baliqni tutish kerak, - deb boshladi. Bu oson: menimcha, chaqaloq uni tutishi mumkin edi.

en: Next, the fish must be bought. That is easy: a penny, I think, would have bought it.
uz: Bundan keyin baliq sotib olinishi kerak. Bu oson: men o'ylaymanki, bir tanga uni sotib olgan bo'lar edi.

en: Now cook me the fish! That is easy, and will not take more than a minute.
uz: Bugun menga baliqni pishiring! - bu oson va bir daqiqadan ko'proq vaqt ketmaydi.

en: Let it lie in a dish! That is easy, because it already is in it.
uz: Shunni idishda qo'yib qo'yinglar! - bu oson, chunki u allaqachon ichkarida.

en: Let me sup! It is easy to set such a dish on the table.
uz: Men ovqatlanishimga ruxsat bering! - degan so'zlarni aytish oson. Bunday taomni jadvalga qo'yish oson.

en: Take the dish-cover up! Ah, THAT is so hard that I fear I'm unable!
uz: Saniqni ko'tarib ol! - deb aytish juda qiyin, men qo'rqamanki, qila olmayman!

en: For it holds it like glue— Holds the lid to the dish, while it lies in the middle: Which is easiest to do, Un-dish-cover the fish, or dishcover the riddle?' 'Take a minute to think about it, and then guess,' said the Red Queen.
uz: Chunki u uni yopishqoq kabi ushlab turadi O'rta qismida bo'lib turgan idishning qopqog'ini ushlab turadi: qaysi ishni qilish osonroq: baliqni idishdan o'chirib tashlashmi yoki sirni idishdan o'chirib tashlashmi? Bu haqda bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'ring va keyin tasavvur qiling, - dedi qizil kraliça.

en: 'Meanwhile, we'll drink your health—Queen Alice's health!' she screamed at the top of her voice, and all the guests began drinking it directly, and very queerly they managed it: some of them put their glasses upon their heads like extinguishers, and drank all that trickled down their faces—others upset the decanters, and drank the wine as it ran off the edges of the table—and three of them (who looked like kangaroos) scrambled into the dish of roast mutton, and began eagerly lapping up the gravy, 'just like pigs in a trough!' thought Alice.
uz: O'sha paytda biz sizning sog'lig'ingizni ichamizQueen Alice sog'lig'ini! - deb u o'z ovozi bilan qichqirdi va barcha mehmonlar uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ichishni boshladilar va juda g'ayritabiiy tarzda uni bajardilar: ba'zilari o'tkirlar kabi ko'zlarini ko'zlari ustiga ko'rinishlarini qo'yib, yuzlariga to'kilgan hamma narsani ichdilarBa'zilari dekantorlarni xafa qildilarVa dasturxonaning chetlaridan chiqib ketayotgan sharobni ichdilarUlar (kangurolarga o'xshaydigan) uchta kishi to'kilgan qo'zi cho'g'ining taomlariga aralashib, shoshiq-tashq qilib, sovutni: to'shan cho'g'irlar kabi qo'lga tushadi! - deb o'yladi Alice.

en: 'You ought to return thanks in a neat speech,' the Red Queen said, frowning at Alice as she spoke.
uz: Siz minnatdorchilikni yaxshi nutq bilan qaytarishingiz kerak, - dedi qizil kraliça, u gapirayotganda Alizaga ko'z tikib.

en: 'We must support you, you know,' the White Queen whispered, as Alice got up to do it, very obediently, but a little frightened.
uz: Biz sizni qo'llab-quvvatlashimiz kerak, bilasiz, - deb xuloflantirdi Oq Qirolicha, chunki Alisa buni qilish uchun turdi, juda itoatkorlik bilan, ammo biroz qo'rqqan.

en: 'Thank you very much,' she whispered in reply, 'but I can do quite well without.' 'That wouldn't be at all the thing,' the Red Queen said very decidedly: so Alice tried to submit to it with a good grace.
uz: Qizil Qirolicha: Sizga katta rahmat, - deb javob berdi, - lekin mensiz juda yaxshi bo'laman. - Bu hech qanday narsa bo'lmaydi, - dedi qizil Qirolicha juda qat'iylik bilan: shuning uchun Alice unga yaxshi inoyat bilan bo'ysunishga harakat qildi.

en: ('And they DID push so!' she said afterwards, when she was telling her sister the history of the feast.
uz: (Ular buni qo'llab-quvvatladilar! - dedi u keyinchalik, opasiga bayram tarixi haqida aytib berganda.

en: 'You would have thought they wanted to squeeze me flat!') In fact it was rather difficult for her to keep in her place while she made her speech: the two Queens pushed her so, one on each side, that they nearly lifted her up into the air: 'I rise to return thanks—' Alice began: and she really DID rise as she spoke, several inches; but she got hold of the edge of the table, and managed to pull herself down again.
uz: Siz meni to'xtatmoqchi deb o'ylayotgandirsiz!) Aslida, nutq so'zlayotganida o'z joyida qolish qiyin edi: ikki quyen uni har bir tomondan bir tomondan shunchalik itardiki, deyarli uni havoga ko'tarishdi: Men minnatdorchilikni qaytarish uchun turaman - deb boshladi Alisa: va u gapirganida bir necha santimetr balandlikda ko'tarildi; lekin u stol bo'yiga qo'shildi va o'zini yana pastga tushirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: 'Take care of yourself!' screamed the White Queen, seizing Alice's hair with both her hands.
uz: O'zingga g'amxo'rlik qil! - deb baqirdi Oq Qirolicha, Elisning sochlarini ikki qo'li bilan ushlab oldi.

en: 'Something's going to happen!' And then (as Alice afterwards described it) all sorts of things happened in a moment.
uz: Bir narsa sodir bo'ladi! Keyin (Alis keyinchalik tasvirlaganidek) bir lahzada turli xil narsalar sodir bo'ldi.

en: The candles all grew up to the ceiling, looking something like a bed of rushes with fireworks at the top.
uz: Shishalarning barchasi plafongacha o'sib bordi va ustida o't qo'yilgan o't qo'yib, o't qo'yib, o't qo'yib qo'yishdi.

en: As to the bottles, they each took a pair of plates, which they hastily fitted on as wings, and so, with forks for legs, went fluttering about in all directions: 'and very like birds they look,' Alice thought to herself, as well as she could in the dreadful confusion that was beginning.
uz: Shishalarga kelsak, har biri bir juft plakat olib, ularni darhol qanotlar sifatida o'rnatdi va shunda, oyoqlari uchun furqonlar bilan, har tomonga o'z-o'zlariga o'xshaydilar: Ular qushlarga o'xshaydilar, deb o'yladi Alisa, boshlanayotgan dahshatli chalg'ilikda o'zi ham o'zicha o'yladi.

en: At this moment she heard a hoarse laugh at her side, and turned to see what was the matter with the White Queen; but, instead of the Queen, there was the leg of mutton sitting in the chair.
uz: O'sha paytda u o'z yonida qichqiriq eshitdi va Oq Qiroli bilan nima sodir bo'lganini ko'rish uchun o'girilibdi; lekin Qiroli o'rniga o'tirgan kursiga qo'zi oyoqlari o'tirgan edi.

en: 'Here I am!' cried a voice from the soup tureen, and Alice turned again, just in time to see the Queen's broad good-natured face grinning at her for a moment over the edge of the tureen, before she disappeared into the soup.
uz: Men keldim! - deb so'zlashdi turenlarning so'ngidan, Alisa yana o'girilib, kraliçaning keng va mehribon yuzini ko'rish uchun o'z vaqtida turenning chegaralarida bir zumga unga tabassum bilan qarab, o'sha paytdan keyin uni supka ichida yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: There was not a moment to be lost.
uz: Hech bir vaqt yo'qolmagan.

en: Already several of the guests were lying down in the dishes, and the soup ladle was walking up the table towards Alice's chair, and beckoning to her impatiently to get out of its way.
uz: Ko'pgina mehmonlar allaqachon idishlarda yotgan edilar va shov-shuv qozonasi o'z yo'lidan chiqib ketish uchun Alice kursi tomon stolni ko'tarib borayotgan edi.

en: 'I can't stand this any longer!' she cried as she jumped up and seized the table-cloth with both hands: one good pull, and plates, dishes, guests, and candles came crashing down together in a heap on the floor.
uz: Men buni ko'proq ko'ra olmayman! - deb qayg'urdi u, o'z qo'li bilan o'rnidan turib, stol to'plamini qo'lga oldi: bitta yaxshi tortib, pillalar, idishlar, mehmonlar va shamollar erdagi to'plamda bir-biriga tushib tushdi.

en: 'And as for YOU,' she went on, turning fiercely upon the Red Queen, whom she considered as the cause of all the mischief—but the Queen was no longer at her side—she had suddenly dwindled down to the size of a little doll, and was now on the table, merrily running round and round after her own shawl, which was trailing behind her.
uz: Senga kelsak, - dedi u, qizil kralichaga qattiq qarab, uni barcha yomonlikning sababchisi deb hisoblagan, ammo kralicha endi uning yonida emas edi.U birdan kichkina qo'g'irchoq o'lchamlariga kamayib, endi stol ustida o'tirib, o'z shalining orqasidan quvongan.

en: At any other time, Alice would have felt surprised at this, but she was far too much excited to be surprised at anything NOW.
uz: Boshqa paytlarda Alice bunga hayron bo'lgan bo'lar edi, lekin hozir hech narsa uni hayratda qoldirmasligi uchun juda hayajonlangan edi.

en: 'As for YOU,' she repeated, catching hold of the little creature in the very act of jumping over a bottle which had just lighted upon the table, 'I'll shake you into a kitten, that I will!'
uz: Senga kelsak, - deb takrorladi u, kichkina mavjudotni stol ustiga yonib turgan shisha ustidan sakrash bilan birga ushlab, Seni kichkina qushga aylantiraman, shunday bo'ladi!

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 10 Sඐඉඓඑඖඏ She took her off the table as she spoke, and shook her backwards and forwards with all her might.
uz: U gapirganida, qizni stoldan olib chiqib, butun kuchini ishga solib, orqaga va oldinga shovqin qildi.

en: The Red Queen made no resistance whatever; only her face grew very small, and her eyes got large and green: and still, as Alice went on shaking her, she kept on growing shorter—and fatter—and softer —and rounder—and—
uz: Qizil Qirolicha hech qanday qarshilik ko'rsatmadi; faqat uning yuzi juda kichkina, ko'zlari esa katta va yashil bo'ldi: va hali ham, Alice uni titratishda davom etgani sayin, u qisqa va semiz va yumshatgan va yuzaga kelgan.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 11 Wඉඓඑඖඏ —and it really WAS a kitten, after all.

uz: Sening majestating bu qadar baland ovoz bilan gapirmasligi kerak, - dedi Ailis ko'zlarini o'rab, kichkintoyga hurmat ila, ammo ba'zi darajada qat'iylik bilan murojaat qildi.

en: 'You woke me out of oh!
uz: Sen meni ohdan uyg'otding!

en: And you've been along with me, Kitty—all through the Looking-Glass world.
uz: Va siz men bilan birga bo'ldingiz, Kitty, ko'z-ko'z dunyo bo'ylab.

en: Did you know it, dear?' It is a very inconvenient habit of kittens (Alice had once made the remark) that, whatever you say to them, they ALWAYS purr.

en: 'If they would only purr for yes and mew for no, or any rule of that sort,' she had said, 'so that one could keep up a conversation!
uz: Agar ular faqat ha va yo'q deb qichqirishsa yoki boshqa qoidalar bo'lsa edi, - dedi u, ya'ni suhbatni davom ettirish uchun!

en: But how CAN you talk with a person if they always say the same thing?' On this occasion the kitten only purred: and it was impossible to guess whether it meant 'yes' or 'no.' So Alice hunted among the chessmen on the table till she had found the Red Queen: then she went down on her knees on the hearth-rug, and put the kitten and the Queen to look at each other.
uz: Ammo ular doimo bir xil so'zlarni aytishsa, qanday qilib odam bilan gaplashsa bo'ladi? - deb so'rashdi.Bu safar kichkinagina faqat qichqirdi: va bu ha yoki yo'q degan ma'noni anglatadimi, deb taxmin qilish mumkin emas edi.Shunday qilib, Alixa qizil Qirolicha topmaguncha jadvaldagi shaxmatchilar orasida ov qilardi: so'ngra u o'z dizlariga tiz cho'kdi va kichkinagini va Qirolichani bir-birlariga qarab turishga majbur qildi.

en: 'Now, Kitty!' she cried, clapping her hands triumphantly.
uz: Hndi, Kitty! - deb baqirib, qo'llarini g'alaba bilan tatib qo'ydi.

en: 'Confess that was what you turned into!' ('But it wouldn't look at it,' she said, when she was explaining the thing afterwards to her sister: 'it turned away its head, and pretended not to see it: but it looked a LITTLE ashamed of itself, so I think it MUST have been the Red Queen.') 'Sit up a little more stiffly, dear!' Alice cried with a merry laugh.
uz: Aytingki, bu sizning o'zingizni o'zgartirganingiz edi! (Ammo u bunga qaramasdi, deb aytdi u, keyinchalik opasiga buni tushuntirib berganda: U boshini o'zgartirdi va uni ko'rmaganidek ko'rindi: lekin u o'zidan bir oz o'zini o'ylagandek ko'rindi, shuning uchun men o'ylaymanki, u Qizil Qirolicha bo'lishi kerak edi.) Biroz qattiqroq o'tir, aziz! - deb o'ylagan Alice quvonchli tabassum bilan yig'ladi.

en: 'And curtsey while you're thinking what to—what to purr.
uz: Va nima qilish kerakligini o'ylab yurganingizda, tez-tez o'tiring.

en: WILL Dinah have finished with your White Majesty, I wonder?
uz: DINAH sizning oq majlisi bilan ishini tugatgan bo'ladimi, deb o'ylayman.

en: That must be the reason you were so untidy in my dream— Dinah!
uz: Aynan shu sababdan tushimda siz juda tartibsiz bo'lgansiz, Dina!

en: do you know that you're scrubbing a White Queen?
uz: Siz oq kralichalarni yuvganingizni bilarmidingiz?

en: Really, it's most disrespectful of you!
uz: Haqiqatan ham, bu sizdan juda hurmatsizlikdir!

en: 'And what did DINAH turn to, I wonder?' she prattled on, as she settled comfortably down, with one elbow in the rug, and her chin in her hand, to watch the kittens.
uz: DINA nimaga murojaat qildi, deb o'ylayman, - deb o'yladi u, kichkintoylarni kuzatib turish uchun cho'lda bir qo'lqovog'i va qo'lida cho'qqisini qo'yib, qulaylik bilan o'tiribdi.

en: 'Tell me, Dinah, did you turn to Humpty Dumpty?
uz: Menga ayting, Dina, siz ham Humpty Dumptyga murojaat qildingizmi?

en: I THINK you did—however, you'd better not mention it to your friends just yet, for I'm not sure.
uz: O'ZIMGA o'ylaymanki, siz buni hozircha do'stlaringizga aytmasangiz yaxshi bo'lardi, chunki bunga amin emasman.

en: 'By the way, Kitty, if only you'd been really with me in my dream, there was one thing you WOULD have enjoyed—I had such a quantity of poetry said to me, all about fishes!
uz: Agar sen mening orzuimda men bilan bo'lganingda edi, Kitty, bir narsadan zavqlanarding, menga shuncha she'rlar aytilgan edi, bularning barchasi baliqlar haqida edi!

en: To-morrow morning you shall have a real treat.
uz: Ertalab ertalab siz uchun haqiqiy taom bo'ladi.

en: All the time you're eating your breakfast, I'll repeat The Walrus and the Carpenter to you; and then you can make believe it's oysters, dear!
uz: Siz kechki ovqatni yeganingizda, men sizga Sovul va cho'g'irchi ni takrorlayman; keyin siz uchuqlar ekanligiga ishonishingiz mumkin, aziz!

en: 'Now, Kitty, let's consider who it was that dreamed it all.
uz: Endi, Kitty, keling, bularning barchasini orzu qilgan kim ekanligini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: This is a serious question, my dear, and you should NOT go on licking your paw like that—as if Dinah hadn't washed you this morning!
uz: Bu jiddiy savol, azizim, va siz bu ertalab Dina sizni yuvmaganidek, oyoq kiyimingizni shunda yulib yurmasligingiz kerak!

en: You see, Kitty, it MUST have been either me or the Red King.
uz: Ko'ryapsanmi, Kitty, bu men yoki Qizil Shoh bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: He was part of my dream, of course—but then I was part of his dream, too!
uz: Albatta, u mening orzularimning bir qismi edi, lekin keyin men ham uning orzularining bir qismi bo'ldim!

en: WAS it the Red King, Kitty?
uz: QOʻL QIRIQ KING boʻlganmi, Kitty?

en: You were his wife, my dear, so you ought to know—Oh, Kitty, DO help to settle it!
uz: Sen uning xotini bo'lgan eding, azizim, shuning uchun bilishing kerak, Kitty, buni hal qilishga yordam ber!

en: I'm sure your paw can wait!' But the provoking kitten only began on the other paw, and pretended it hadn't heard the question.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, qo'lingiz kutishi mumkin! - deb aytdi, lekin qo'zg'atuvchi qush faqat boshqa qo'lingizdan boshladi va so'rovni eshitmaganidek qildi.

en: Which do YOU think it was?
uz: Siz qaysi biri deb o'ylaysiz?

en: — A boat beneath a sunny sky, Lingering onward dreamily In an evening of July— Children three that nestle near, Eager eye and willing ear, Pleased a simple tale to hear— Long has paled that sunny sky: Echoes fade and memories die.
uz: Quyoshli osmon ostida qayiq, orzu bilan orqaga surib yurish Iyul oyi kechasi Uch nafar bola yaqin joyda yashaydi, ko'z va quloq ko'rishdan zavqlanadi, oddiy hikoyani eshitishdan mamnun bo'ladi Quyoshli osmon uzoq vaqtdan buyon ko'tarilmoqda: o'z-o'zidan so'ng so'z o'qadi va xotiralar o'ladi.

en: Autumn frosts have slain July.
uz: Joriy yilning iyul oyida kuzgi sovuqlar o'tdi.

en: Still she haunts me, phantomwise, Alice moving under skies
uz: Hndi ham u meni, xudojo'ylik bilan aytganda, Alice osmon ostida harakatlanayotganini kuzatib bormoqda.

en: Never seen by waking eyes.
uz: Hech qachon uyg'oq ko'zlar bilan ko'rmagan.

en: Children yet, the tale to hear, Eager eye and willing ear, Lovingly shall nestle near.
uz: Bolalar, eshitish uchun hikoya, Ishonchli ko'z va tayyor quloq, Sevgisi yaqin joyda yashaydi.
