en: A few years ago the world was suddenly astounded by hearing of an experiment of a most novel and daring nature, altogether unprecedented in the annals of science.
uz: Bir necha yil oldin dunyo, ilm-fan tarixida hech qachon ko'rilmagan, eng yangi va jasoratli tajriba haqida eshitib, birdan hayratda qoldi.

en: CLUB, a society of artillerymen started in America during the great Civil War, had conceived the idea of nothing less than establishing direct communication with the Moon by means of a projectile!
uz: Buyuk Fuqarolar urushi davrida Amerikada tashkil etilgan "CLUB" to'qnashuvchilar jamiyati, oy bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri muloqotni o'rnatishdan boshqa hech narsa g'oya qilmagan!

en: President Barbican, the originator of the enterprise, was strongly encouraged in its feasibility by the astronomers of Cambridge Observatory, and took upon himself to provide all the means necessary to secure its success.
uz: Prezident Barbican, ushbu tadbirning asoschisi, Cambridge Observatoriyasining astronomlari tomonidan uning amalga oshirilishi borasida kuchli rag'batlantirildi va uning muvaffaqiyatini ta'minlash uchun zarur bo'lgan barcha vositalarni taqdim etishni o'z zimmasiga oldi.

en: Having realized by means of a public subscription the sum of nearly five and a half millions of dollars, he immediately set himself to work at the necessary gigantic labors.
uz: Taxminan besh yarim million dollarga teng bo'lgan mablag'ni ommaviy obuna orqali amalga oshirib, u darhol kerakli ulkan ishlar bilan shug'ullanishga kirishdi.

en: In accordance with the Cambridge men's note, the cannon intended to discharge the projectile was to be planted in some country not further than ൣ൩° north or south from the equator, so that it might be aimed vertically at the Moon in the zenith.
uz: Kembridž erkaklari notasiga ko'ra, o'g'ilni oqish uchun mo'ljallangan to'qima ekvatordan ° shimoliy yoki janubiygacha bo'lmagan bir mamlakatga joylashtirilishi kerak edi, shuning uchun u o'zining zirvaxida oyga vertikal ravishda qaratilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The bullet was to be animated with an initial velocity of ൢൣ,ൡൡൡ yards to the second.
uz: O'qni birinchi tezlikda sekundga , yard tezligi bilan harakatlantirish kerak edi.

en: It was to be fired off on the night of December ൢst, at thirteen minutes and twenty seconds before eleven o'clock, precisely.
uz: U dekabr kechasi, soat o'n birdan o'n uch daqiqa va yigirma soniya oldin, aniqroq o'chirilishi kerak edi.

en: Four days afterwards it was to hit the Moon, at the very moment that she reached her perigee, that is to say, her nearest point to the Earth, about ൣൣ൩,ൡൡൡ miles distant.
uz: To'rt kun o'tgach, u o'z perigeysiga, ya'ni Yerga eng yaqin nuqtasiga, taxminan , mil uzoqlikda yetib kelgan paytda oyga tushib ketishi kerak edi.

en: The leading members of the Club, namely President Barbican, Secretary Marston, Major Elphinstone and General Morgan, forming the executive committee, held several meetings to discuss the shape and material of the bullet, the nature and position of the cannon, and the quantity and quality of the powder.
uz: Klubning yetakchi a'zolari, ya'ni prezident Barbican, kotibi Marston, major Elfinston va general Morgan ijroiya qo'mitasini tashkil etgan holda, bir necha uchrashuvlar o'tkazdi va o'qning shakli va materialini, to'qnashning xususiyati va joylashuvini, shuningdek, kukunning miqdori va sifatini muhokama qildilar.

en: The decision soon arrived at was as follows: ൢst—The bullet was to be a hollow aluminium shell, its diameter nine feet, its walls a foot in thickness, and its weight ൢ൪,ൣ൦ൡ pounds; ൣnd—The cannon was to be a columbiad ൪ൡൡ feet in length, a well of that depth forming the vertical mould in which it was to be cast, and ൤rd—The powder was to be ൥ൡൡ thousand pounds of gun cotton, which, by developing more than ൣൡൡ thousand millions of cubic feet of gas under the projectile, would easily send it as far as our satellite.
uz: Tez orada qaror quyidagicha bo'ldi: stTovushning diametri to'qqiz fut, devorlari bir fut qalchoq, va og'irligi , funt; ndTovushning uzunligi  fut bo'lishi kerak edi, bu chuqurlikdagi quduq uni quyish kerak bo'lgan vertikal shaklni hosil qiladi va rdTovushning miqdori  ming funt quruq bomba bo'lishi kerak edi, shunda o'q ostidagi gazning ming milliondan ortiq kub fut ishlab chiqarib, uni osonlikcha bizning satelitimizga qadar yuboradi.

en: These questions settled, Barbican, aided by Murphy, the Chief Engineer of the Cold Spring Iron Works, selected a spot in Florida, near the ൣ൨th degree north latitude, called Stony Hill, where after the
uz: Ushbu savollar hal qilindi, Barbican, sovuq bahor temir zavodining bosh muhandisi Murfi yordamida Floridadagi Stony Hill deb nomlangan shimoliy kenglikning yaqinidagi joyni tanladi.

en: performance of many wonderful feats in mining engineering, the Columbiad was successfully cast.
uz: Konchilik muhandisligi sohasida ko'plab ajoyib yutuqlarga ega bo'lgan Columbiad muvaffaqiyatli ishga tushirildi.

en: Things had reached this state when an incident occurred which excited the general interest a hundred fold.
uz: Bu holatda bo'lgan voqea yuz berganida, umumiy qiziqish yuz baravar ko'paygan.

en: A Frenchman from Paris, Michel Ardan by name, eccentric, but keen and shrewd as well as daring, demanded, by the Atlantic telegraph, permission to be enclosed in the bullet so that he might be carried to the Moon, where he was curious to make certain investigations.
uz: Parijlik frantsuz Michel Ardan ismli kishi, eksentrik, ammo g'ayratli va g'ayratli va jasoratli bo'lib, Atlantika telegrafidan oyga olib ketish uchun o'qning ichiga qo'yish uchun ruxsat so'radi, u erda u muayyan tekshiruvlar o'tkazish uchun qiziqarli edi.

en: Received in America with great enthusiasm, Ardan held a great meeting, triumphantly carried his point, reconciled Barbican to his mortal foe, a certain Captain M'Nicholl, and even, by way of clinching the reconciliation, induced both the newly made friends to join him in his contemplated trip to the Moon.
uz: Amerikada katta g'ayrat bilan qabul qilingan Ardan katta uchrashuv o'tkazdi, o'z fikrini g'alaba bilan amalga oshirdi, Barbicanni o'z o'lim dushmani bo'lgan kapitan M'Nicholl bilan yarashtirdi va hatto yarashishni amalga oshirish yo'lida yangi do'stlarni u bilan birga oyga sayohat qilishga undadi.

en: The bullet, so modified as to become a hollow conical cylinder with plenty of room inside, was further provided with powerful water- springs and readily-ruptured partitions below the floor, intended to deaden the dreadful concussion sure to accompany the start.
uz: O'sha o'q, ichida ko'p joy bor bo'sh shkalatli silindrga aylanishi uchun o'zgartirilgan va uning ichida kuchli suv manbalari va er ostidagi osonlikcha parchalanadigan bo'shliqlar mavjud edi, bu esa boshlanishni kuzatib boradigan dahshatli sarosimni o'ldirish uchun mo'ljallangan edi.

en: It was supplied with provisions for a year, water for a few months, and gas for nearly two weeks.
uz: Bu shaharga bir yillik rizq-ro'z, bir necha oylik suv va qariyb ikki haftalik gaz ta'minlangan.

en: A self-acting apparatus, of ingenious construction, kept the confined atmosphere sweet and healthy by manufacturing pure oxygen and absorbing carbonic acid.
uz: O'z-o'zidan harakatlanadigan qurilma, naqshli qurilma, cheklangan muhitni sof kislorod ishlab chiqarish va karbonik kislotani sug'orish orqali shirin va sog'lom saqlab qoldi.

en: Finally, the Gun Club had constructed, at enormous expense, a gigantic telescope, which, from the summit of Long's Peak, could pursue the Projectile as it winged its way through the regions of space.
uz: Nihoyat, Gun Club ulkan xarajatlar evaziga ulkan teleskop qurdi, u Long's Peakning sammitidan kosmik hududlar orqali o'z yo'llarini ko'targanida Projectile-ni kuzatib borishi mumkin edi.

en: Everything at last was ready.
uz: Nihoyat hamma narsa tayyor edi.

en: On December ൢst, at the appointed moment, in the midst of an immense concourse of spectators, the departure took place, and, for the first time in the world's history, three human beings quitted our terrestrial globe with some possibility in their favor of finally reaching a point of destination in the inter-planetary spaces.
uz: Dekabr oyida, belgilangan vaqtda, ko'z o'ngida ko'z o'ngida katta ko'z-ko'z to'plamida, uch kishi sayyoramiz tarixida birinchi marta yer yuzini tashlab ketishdi va nihoyat sayyoralararo kosmosda yo'nalish joylariga yetib kelish imkoniyati bor edi.

en: They expected to accomplish their journey in ൪൨ hours, ൢ൤ minutes and ൣൡ seconds, consequently reaching the Lunar surface precisely at midnight on December ൦-൧, the exact moment when the Moon would be full.
uz: Ular sayohatni  soat,  daqiqa va  soniya ichida yakunlashni kutishgan va shu sababli dekabr oyida aynan yarim kechada, aynan oy to'liq bo'lgan paytda, oy yuziga yetib kelishgan.

en: Unfortunately, the instantaneous explosion of such a vast quantity of gun-cotton, by giving rise to a violent commotion in the atmosphere, generated so much vapor and mist as to render the
uz: Afsuski, bunday katta miqdordagi qaltonning darhol portlashi atmosferada shiddatli shov-shuvga sabab bo'lib, buzg'unchilikni keltirib chiqardi.

en: Moon invisible for several nights to the innumerable watchers in the Western Hemisphere, who vainly tried to catch sight of her.
uz: G'arbiy yarim jahonning son-sanoqsiz kuzatuvchilari uchun oy bir necha kecha ko'rinmas edi, ular uni ko'rishga behuda harakat qilishdi.

en: In the meantime, J.T.
uz: Shu bilan birga, J.T.

en: Marston, the Secretary of the Gun Club, and a most devoted friend of Barbican's, had started for Long's Peak, Colorado, on the summit of which the immense telescope, already alluded to, had been erected; it was of the reflecting kind, and possessed power sufficient to bring the Moon within a distance of five miles.
uz: Gun Club kotibi va Barbicanning eng sodiq do'sti Marston Long's Peak, Kolorado shahriga yo'l oldi, uning tepalig'ida allaqachon eslatilgan ulkan teleskop o'rnatilgan edi; u o'z aks ettiruvchi turiga ega edi va oyni besh mil masofada olib kelish uchun etarlicha kuchga ega edi.

en: While Marston was prosecuting his long journey with all possible speed, Professor Belfast, who had charge of the telescope, was endeavoring to catch a glimpse of the Projectile, but for a long time with no success.
uz: Marston uzoq sayohatini imkon qadar tez davom ettirganida, teleskopni boshqaradigan professor Belfast "Projektil"ni ko'rib chiqish uchun ko'p harakat qildi, ammo uzoq vaqt davomida muvaffaqiyatsiz.

en: The hazy, cloudy weather lasted for more than a week, to the great disgust of the public at large.
uz: Bu bulutli havo bir haftadan ko'proq vaqt davom etdi, bu esa keng ko'pchilikni norozi qildi.

en: People even began to fear that further observation would have to be deferred to the ൤d of the following month, January, as during the latter half of December the waning Moon could not possibly give light enough to render the Projectile visible.
uz: Odamlar hatto keyingi oy, yanvar oyining d kunigacha kuzatuvning davom etishi kerak bo'lishidan qo'rqishni boshlashdi, chunki dekabr oyining oxirgi yarmida bo'shayib borayotgan Oy, ehtimol, Proyektni ko'rinishga yetarlicha yorug'lik bermaydi.

en: At last, however, to the unbounded satisfaction of all, a violent tempest suddenly cleared the sky, and on the ൢ൤th of December, shortly after midnight, the Moon, verging towards her last quarter, revealed herself sharp and bright on the dark background of the starry firmament.
uz: Biroq, nihoyat, hammaning cheksiz mamnuniyatiga, kuchli bo'ron osmonni to'satdan tozaladi va dekabr oyining 6th kuni, yarim tunning o'tib ketishi bilanoq, oy o'zining so'nggi choragiga yaqinlashib, o'zini yulduzli osmondagi qorong'i fonda keskin va yorqin ko'rsatdi.

en: That same morning, a few hours before Marston's arrival at the summit of Long's Peak, a very remarkable telegram had been dispatched by Professor Belfast to the Smithsonian Institute, Washington.
uz: O'sha kuni ertalab, Marstonning Long's Peak sammitida yetib kelishidan bir necha soat oldin, professor Belfast tomonidan Washingtonning Smithsonian institutiga juda diqqatga sazovor telegramma yuborilgan edi.

en: It announced: That on December ൢ൤th, at ൣ o'clock in the morning, the Projectile shot from Stony Hill had been perceived by Professor Belfast and his assistants; that, deflected a little from its course by some unknown cause, it had not reached its mark, though it had approached near enough to be affected by the Lunar attraction; and that, its rectilineal motion having become circular, it should henceforth continue to describe a regular orbit around the Moon, of which in fact it had become the Satellite.
uz: U shunday e'lon qildi: dekabr oyida, tungi soat 6 da, Stony Hilldan o'tgan "Projektil" o'qlari professor Belfast va uning yordamchilari tomonidan kuzatilganligi; biron bir noma'lum sabab tufayli biroz yo'ldan ozdirilganligi, o'z nishoniga yetmaganligi, ammo o'ziga yaqinlashganligi va oyning jozibadorligi ta'sir qilishi uchun yetarlicha yaqinlashganligi; va uning to'g'ri chiziq harakatlari aylanarli bo'lganligi sababli, u bundan buyon o'zining oy atrofidagi muntazam orbitasini tasvirlashni davom ettirishi kerakligi, aslida u o'zidan o'tgan Satelitga aylandi.

en: The dispatch went on further to state: That the elements of the new heavenly body had not yet been calculated, as at least three different observations, taken at different times, were necessary to determine them.
uz: Joʻnatilgan xabarda yana shunday deyilgan: Yangi osmondagi jismning elementlari hali hisoblanmagan, chunki ularni aniqlash uchun kamida uchta turli xil kuzatish kerak edi.

en: Projectile from the Lunar surface, however, might be set down roughly at roughly ൣ൩൤൤ miles.
uz: Biroq, oy yuzasidan chiqarilgan proyektil taxminan  milgacha joylashtirilishi mumkin.

en: The dispatch concluded with the following hypotheses, positively pronounced to be the only two possible: Either, ൢ, The Lunar attraction would finally prevail, in which case the travellers would reach their destination; or ൣ, The Projectile, kept whirling forever in an immutable orbit, would go on revolving around the Moon till time should be no more.
uz: Yo'lga qo'yish quyidagi g'oyalar bilan yakunlandi: yoki , Ayning jozibadorligi nihoyat g'alaba qozonadi, shu holda sayohatchilar o'z yo'nalishlariga etib boradilar; yoki , O'zgarmas orbitada doimo aylanib boradigan Projectile vaqt o'tmaguncha oy atrofida aylanishni davom ettiradi.

en: In either alternative, what should be the lot of the daring adventurers?
uz: Har ikkala variantda ham, jasoratli sarguzashtchilarning nasibasi qanday bo'lishi kerak?

en: They had, it is true, abundant provisions to last them for some time, but even supposing that they did reach the Moon and thereby completely establish the practicability of their daring enterprise, how were they ever to get back?
uz: To'g'ri, ular bir muncha vaqt davom etishlari uchun mo'l-ko'l rizq-ro'z ega edilar, lekin hatto oyga yetib, shu bilan birga jasoratli ishlarining amalga oshishini to'liq tasdiqlagan bo'lsa-da, qayerdan qaytib kelishlari mumkin edi?

en: Could they ever get back?
uz: Ular qaytib kelishlari mumkinmi?

en: or ever even be heard from?
uz: yoki hatto bu haqda hech qachon eshitish mumkinmi?

en: Questions of this nature, freely discussed by the ablest pens of the day, kept the public mind in a very restless and excited condition.
uz: O'sha davrning eng zo'r ruhoniylari tomonidan erkin muhokama qilinadigan bunday savollar jamoatchilikni juda g'ayratli va hayajonli holatda saqlab qoldi.

en: We must be pardoned here for making a little remark which, however, astronomers and other scientific men of sanguine temperament would do well to ponder over.
uz: Bu yerda bir oz gapirganimiz uchun kechirim so'rashimiz kerak, lekin bu haqda astronomlar va boshqa qonli olimlar mulohaza yuritishlari kerak.

en: An observer cannot be too cautious in announcing to the public his discovery when it is of a nature purely speculative.
uz: Ko'zlovchi o'zining kashfiyotini faqat spekulativ xususiyatga ega bo'lganda, uning e'lon qilinishini e'lon qilishda juda ehtiyotkor bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Nobody is obliged to discover a planet, or a comet, or even a satellite, but, before announcing to the world that you have made such a discovery, first make sure that such is really the fact.
uz: Hech kim sayyora, kometa yoki hatto satelitni kashf etishga majbur emas, lekin dunyoga bunday kashfiyotingiz haqida xabar berishdan oldin, bu haqiqat ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

en: Because, you know, should it afterwards come out that you have done nothing of the kind, you make yourself a butt for the stupid jokes of the lowest newspaper scribblers.
uz: Chunki, agar keyinchalik siz hech narsa qilmaganingiz aniqlansa, siz o'zingizni eng past gazeta o'qituvchilarning ahmoqona hazillari uchun o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning qo'lingizga aylantiring.

en: Belfast had never thought of this.
uz: Belfast bu haqda hech qachon o'ylamagan edi.

en: Impelled by his irrepressible rage for discovery—the furor inveniendi ascribed to all astronomers by Aurelius Priscus—he had therefore been guilty of an indiscretion highly un-scientific when his famous telegram, launched to the world at large from the summit of the Rocky Mountains, pronounced so dogmatically on the only possible issues of the great enterprise.
uz: Aurelius Priscus tomonidan barcha astronomlarga aytilgan kashfiyotlar g'azabini qo'zg'atish uchun g'azablanmagan g'azabini qo'zg'atgan u, shu sababli, uning Rocky tog'lari tepaligidan butun dunyoga yuborilgan mashhur telegrammasi buyuk ishning yagona iloji bo'lgan masalalarini dogmatik ravishda e'lon qilganida juda ilmiy bo'lmagan kamchilikda aybdor bo'lgan.

en: The truth was that his telegram contained two very important errors: ൢ.
uz: Haqiqat shundaki, uning telegrammasida ikkita juda muhim xato bor edi: ..

en: Error of observation, as facts afterwards proved; the Projectile was not seen on the ൢ൤th and could not have been on that day, so that the little black spot which Belfast professed to have seen was most certainly not the Projectile; ൣ.
uz: Ko'rib chiqish noto'g'riligi, keyinchalik faktlar isbotlaganidek; O'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanmagan va o'sha kuni bo'lishi mumkin emas edi, shuning uchun Belfast ko'rgan kichik qora nuqta o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanmagan edi.

en: Error of theory regarding the
uz: Nazariy xatolar   haqida

en: final fate of the Projectile, since to make it become the Moon's satellite was flying in the face of one of the great fundamental laws of Theoretical Mechanics.
uz: Projektilning taqdiri, chunki uni oyga aylanuvchi satelitga aylantirish teoretik mexanikaning asosiy qonunlaridan biriga zid edi.

en: Only one, therefore, the first, of the hypotheses so positively announced, was capable of realization.
uz: Shuning uchun faqat birinchi, shu qadar ijobiy e'lon qilingan g'oyalarning biri amalga oshishga qodir edi.

en: The travellers—that is to say if they still lived—might so combine and unite their own efforts with those of the Lunar attraction as actually to succeed at last in reaching the Moon's surface.

en: Underneath this bullet is piled a charge of ൥ൡൡ thousand pounds of gun-cotton, equivalent to ൢ൧ൡൡ thousand pounds of ordinary gunpowder!
uz: Ushbu o'qning pastki qismida o'q-quruqning ming funtligi to'plandi, bu esa odatdagi o'q-po'dordan o'n ming funtga teng!

en: And at this very instant our friend Murphy, chronometer in hand, eye on dial, finger on discharger, is counting the last seconds and getting ready to launch us into the limitless regions of planetary—" "Ardan, dear friend," interrupted Barbican, in a grave tone, "a serious moment is now at hand.
uz: Va shu paytning o'zida do'stimiz Murfi, qo'lida xronometr, ko'z o'ngida, barmoq o'ngida, so'nggi soniyalarni sanayapti va bizni sayyoramizning cheksiz mintaqalariga jo'natishga tayyorlanmoqda. "Ardan, aziz do'stim", - dedi Barbican og'ir so'zlar bilan.

en: Let us meet it with some interior recollection.
uz: Keling, uni ichki xotira bilan uchrataylik.

en: Give me your hands, my dear friends." "Certainly," said Ardan, with tears in his voice, and already at the other extreme of his apparent levity.
uz: Menga qo'lingizni bering, aziz do'stlarim". - Albatta, - dedi Ardan, ovozi yoshga to'lib, ko'rinadigan yengilligining boshqa chetida edi.

en: The three brave men united in one last, silent, but warm and impulsively affectionate pressure.
uz: Uchta jasoratli kishi oxirgi, sukut saqlash, lekin iliq va impulssiyaviy muhabbatli bosimda birlashgan.

en: "And now, great God, our Creator, protect us!
uz: "Va endi, buyuk Xudoyimiz, Yaratuvchimiz, bizni himoya qil!

en: In Thee we trust!" prayed Barbican, the others joining him with folded hands and bowed heads.
uz: Senga ishonamiz!" - deb ibodat qildi Barbican, qolganlar qo'llarini qo'yib, boshlarini egib qo'shdilar.

en: "Ten, forty-six!" whispered the Captain, as he and Ardan quietly took their places on the mattresses.
uz: "O'n, qirq olti!" - deb shov-shuv qildi kapitan, u Ardan bilan o'rinlarini o'rindiqlarga o'rnatdi.

en: Only forty seconds more!
uz: Faqat qirq soniya qolgan!

en: Barbican rapidly extinguishes the gas and lies down beside his companions.
uz: Barbican tezda gazni o'chirib qo'ydi va do'stlari yonida o'tirdi.

en: The deathlike silence now reigning in the Projectile is interrupted only by the sharp ticking of the chronometer as it beats the seconds.
uz: Hozirda Projectile-da hukm surayotgan o'limga o'xshaydigan sukut faqat xronometrning sekundalarni urishida keskin tiklanishi bilan kesib tashlanadi.

en: Suddenly, a dreadful shock is felt, and the Projectile, shot up by the instantaneous development of ൣൡൡ,ൡൡൡ millions of cubic feet of gas, is flying into space with inconceivable rapidity!
uz: Toʻsatdan dahshatli shok tutildi va gazning oʻz vaqtida rivojlanishi natijasida oʻqilgan Projectile oʻz vaqtida gʻoyat tezlikda koʻrinmaydigan tezlikda kosmosiga uchib bormoqda!

en: THE FIRST HALF HOUR.
uz: Birinchi yarim soat.

en: What had taken place within the Projectile?
uz: Projektil ichida nimalar sodir bo'lgan?

en: What effect had been produced by the frightful concussion?
uz: Qo'rqinchli shovqin qanday ta'sirga olib keldi?

en: Had Barbican's ingenuity been attended with a fortunate result?
uz: Barbicanning aql-idrokliligi omadli natijalarga erishganmi?

en: Had the shock been sufficiently deadened by the springs, the buffers, the water layers, and the partitions so readily ruptured?
uz: Chiquvchi, buferlar, suv qatlamlari va o'tlar bu qadar osonlikcha yorilib ketganidan shok yetarlicha o'chirib ketganmi?

en: Had their combined effect succeeded in counteracting the tremendous violence of a velocity of ൢൣ,ൡൡൡ yards a second, actually sufficient to carry them from London to New York in six minutes?
uz: Ularning qo'shilgan ta'siri soniyaga , metr tezlikda sodir bo'ladigan dahshatli zo'ravonlikka qarshi turishga muvaffaq bo'lganmi, bu esa ularni Londondan Nyu-Yorkga olti daqiqada olib ketishga yetarlimi?

en: These, and a hundred other questions of a similar nature were asked that night by the millions who had been watching the explosion from the base of Stony Hill.
uz: Ushbu va shunga o'xshash yuzlab boshqa savollar o'sha kecha Stony Hillning poydevori bo'ylab portlashni kuzatgan millionlab odamlar tomonidan so'ralgan edi.

en: Themselves they forgot altogether for the moment; they forgot everything in their absorbing anxiety regarding the fate of the daring travellers.
uz: Ular o'z-o'zlarini hozirgi vaqtda butunlay unutdilar; ular jasoratli sayohatchilarning taqdirini o'ylash bilan bog'liq tashvishlarida hamma narsani unutdilar.

en: Had one among them, our friend Marston, for instance, been favored with a glimpse at the interior of the projectile, what would he have seen?
uz: Agar ulardan biri, masalan, do'stimiz Marston, raketa ichki qismini ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganida edi, u nima ko'rgan bo'lardi?

en: Nothing at all at first, on account of the darkness; except that the walls had solidly resisted the frightful shock.
uz: Boshida qorong'ilik tufayli hech narsa yo'q edi; faqat devorlar dahshatli shokaga qattiq qarshi turishgan.

en: Not a crack, nor a bend, nor a dent could be perceived; not even the slightest injury had the admirably constructed piece of mechanical workmanship endured.
uz: Hech qanday bo'g'rilik, buyrak yoki bo'g'rilik ko'rinmas edi; hatto eng kichik jarohat ham ajoyib tarzda qurilgan mexanik ish usuliga chidam bermagan.

en: It had not yielded an inch to the enormous pressure, and, far from melting and falling back to earth, as had been so seriously apprehended, in showers of blazing aluminium, it was still as strong
uz: U juda katta bosimga bir santimetr ham qarshi turmagan va o'sha paytgacha olovli alyuminiy suvlar ostiga tushib, yer yuziga erib tushishdan uzoqda, hali ham kuchli edi.

en: in every respect as it had been on the very day that it left the Cold Spring Iron Works, glittering like a silver dollar.
uz: Har jihatdan, u Qozog'i bahor temir zavodidan chiqqan kunida xuddi kumush dollarga o'xshaydigan shinamlik bilan chiqib ketgandek edi.

en: Of real damage there was actually none, and even the disorder into which things had been thrown in the interior by the violent shock was comparatively slight.
uz: Aslida hech qanday haqiqiy zarar ko'rsatilmagan va hatto kuchli shok tufayli ichki joyga tashlangan narsalarning tartibsizligi ham nisbatan kam edi.

en: A few small objects lying around loose had been furiously hurled against the ceiling, but the others appeared not to have suffered the slightest injury.
uz: Bir necha kichik narsalar toshbo'ron bo'lib, ustunga g'azab bilan tashlangan edi, ammo qolganlari eng kichik zarar ko'rmagan edi.

en: The straps that fastened them up were unfrayed, and the fixtures that held them down were uncracked.
uz: Ularni bog'lagan kamarlar buzib bo'lmadi va ularni ushlab turadigan asboblar buzib bo'lmadi.

en: The partitions beneath the disc having been ruptured, and the water having escaped, the false floor had been dashed with tremendous violence against the bottom of the Projectile, and on this disc at this moment three human bodies could be seen lying perfectly still and motionless.
uz: Diskning pastki devorlar parchalandi va suv o'tib ketdi, soxta qavat Projectilning pastki qismiga nisbatan dahshatli zo'ravonlik bilan yorilib tushdi va ushbu diskda hozir uchta inson tanasi to'liq to'xtab va harakatsiz yotganini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: Were they three corpses?
uz: Ular uchta jasadmi?

en: Had the Projectile suddenly become a great metallic coffin bearing its ghastly contents through the air with the rapidity of a lightning flash?
uz: Birdan Projectile o'zining dahshatli tarkibini chaqmoqning tezligi bilan havo orqali olib yuradigan katta metall qovushga aylandimi?

en: In a very few minutes after the shock, one of the bodies stirred a little, the arms moved, the eyes opened, the head rose and tried to look around; finally, with some difficulty, the body managed to get on its knees.
uz: Shokdan bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, jasadlardan biri biroz harakatlandi, qo'llar harakatlandi, ko'zlar ochildi, bosh ko'tarildi va atrofga qarashga harakat qildi; nihoyat, ba'zi qiyinchiliklar bilan jasad tiz cho'kdi.

en: It was the Frenchman!
uz: Bu frantsuzlik edi!

en: He held his head tightly squeezed between his hands for some time as if to keep it from splitting.
uz: Boshini qo'llari o'rtasida qattiq bosib, bir muncha vaqt uni bo'linib ketmasligi uchun ushlab turdi.

en: Then he felt himself rapidly all over, cleared his throat with a vigorous "hem!" listened to the sound critically for an instant, and then said to himself in a relieved tone, but in his native tongue: "One man all right!
uz: Keyin u o'zini tezda ko'tarib oldi, og'zini kuchli "hem!" so'zi bilan tozaladi, bir daqiqa davomida ovozni tanqidiy tingladi, so'ngra o'ziga yengil tovushda, ammo ona tilida: "Bir kishi yaxshi!

en: Call the roll for the others!" He tried to rise, but the effort was too great for his strength.
uz: Boshqalar uchun ro'yxatni chaqiring!" - deb o'tirishga harakat qildi, ammo kuchlari yetarli emas edi.

en: He fell back again, his brain swimming, his eyes bursting, his head splitting.
uz: U yana o'tib ketdi, miyasi ko'tarildi, ko'zlari puchdi, boshlari parchalanib ketdi.

en: His state very much resembled that of a young man waking up in the morning after his first tremendous "spree." "Br—rr!" he muttered to himself, still talking French; "this reminds me of one of my wild nights long ago in the Quartier Latin, only decidedly more so!" Lying quietly on his back for a while, he could soon feel that the circulation of his blood, so suddenly and violently arrested by the terrific shock, was gradually recovering its regular flow; his heart
uz: Uning holati birinchi dahshatli "spree" dan keyin ertalab uyg'onadigan yosh yigitga o'xshardi. "Brrr!" deb o'z-o'ziga qichqirdi u hali ham frantsuz tilida gapirgan holda; "bu menga uzoq vaqt oldin lotin kvartirasida o'tkazgan yovvoyi kechalarimdan birini eslatadi, ammo bundan ham ko'proq!" - deb o'yladi u. Bir muncha vaqtning o'zida xotirjamlik bilan o'tirgan u, tez orada uning qon aylanishi, dahshatli shok tufayli to'xtatib qo'yilgan, asta-sekin o'zining doimiy oqimini tiklay borayotganini his qilishi mumkin edi.

en: grew more normal in its action; his head became clearer, and the pain less distracting.
uz: Uning harakatlari odatiy holga aylandi; uning boshi aniqroq bo'ldi va og'riqning chalg'itishi kamaydi.

en: "Time to call that roll," he at last exclaimed in a voice with some pretensions to firmness; "Barbican!
uz: "O'sha ro'yxatni chaqirish vaqti keldi", - dedi u nihoyat qat'iylik bilan bir ovozda; "Barbican!

en: MacNicholl!" He listens anxiously for a reply.
uz: MacNicholl!" deb javobni tashvish bilan tinglaydi.

en: A snow-wrapt grave at midnight is not more silent.
uz: Tun yarimida qor bilan o'ralgan qabr shu qadar ham sessiz emas.

en: In vain does he try to catch even the faintest sound of breathing, though he listens intently enough to hear the beating of their hearts; but he hears only his own.
uz: Garchi u ularning yurak urishlarini eshitish uchun diqqat bilan tinglagan bo'lsa-da, u hatto nafas olishning eng salqin ovozini ham to'xtatishga harakat qiladi; lekin u faqat o'zining ovozini eshitadi.

en: "Call that roll again!" he mutters in a voice far less assured than before; "Barbican!
uz: "O'sha rulni yana chaqir!" - deb o'ylaydi u avvalgidek ko'proq ishonchga ega bo'lmagan ovoz bilan; "Barbican!

en: MacNicholl!" The same fearful unearthly stillness.
uz: MacNicholl!" - degan qo'rqinchli, yer yuzidagi tinchlik.

en: "The thing is getting decidedly monotonous!" he exclaimed, still speaking French.
uz: "Bu narsa qat'iy monoton bo'lib bormoqda!" - deb u hali ham frantsuz tilida gapirgan.

en: Then rapidly recovering his consciousness as the full horror of the situation began to break on his mind, he went on muttering audibly: "Have they really hopped the twig?
uz: O'shanda vaziyatning dahshatli hollari uning ongida tushib ketayotganida, u tezda ongini tiklay boshladi va eshitib bo'ladigan tarzda: "Agar ular chindan ham qo'lga tushdilarmi?

en: what has not been able to knock the life out of one little Frenchman can't have killed two Americans!
uz: Kichik frantsuz kishining hayotini yo'q qilishga qodir bo'lmagan narsa ikki amerikalik kishini o'ldira olmagan bo'lishi mumkin emas!

en: But first and foremost, let us enlighten the situation!" So saying, he contrived without much difficulty to get on his feet.
uz: Ammo avvalo, vaziyatni aniqlashtiraylik!" - dedi u va o'z oyoqlariga turish uchun qiyinchiliksiz harakat qildi.

en: Balancing himself then for a moment, he began groping about for the gas.
uz: Keyin o'zini bir muncha vaqt muvozanatga solib, gazni qidirishni boshladi.

en: But he stopped suddenly.
uz: Ammo u to'xtab qo'ydi.

en: "Hold on a minute!" he cried; "before lighting this match, let us see if the gas has been escaping.
uz: "Bir daqiqa turing-da!" - deb baqirdi u. "Bu o'yinchoqni yoqishdan oldin, gaz chiqib ketayotganini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: Setting fire to a mixture of air and hydrogen would make a pretty how-do-you-do!
uz: Havo va gidrogen aralashmasidan olov o'rnatish juda yaxshi qanday qilish kerakligini yaratadi!

en: Such an explosion would infallibly burst the Projectile, which so far seems all right, though I'm blest if I can tell whether we're moving or not." He began sniffing and smelling to discover if possible the odor of escaped gas.
uz: Bunday portlatish "Projektil"ni to'lib-toshmasdan buzadi, bu hozircha yaxshi ko'rinadi, ammo harakatlanayotganimizni yoki yo'qligini aniqlay olsam, baxtsizman". U, iloji bo'lsa, o'tgan gazning xushbo'yligini topish uchun hidlash va hidlashni boshladi.

en: He could not detect the slightest sign of anything of the kind.
uz: U bunday holatning eng kichik belgilarini ham aniqlay olmagan.

en: This gave him great courage.
uz: Bu unga katta jasorat ato etdi.

en: He knew of course that his senses were not yet in good order, still he thought he might trust them so far as to be certain that the gas had not escaped and that consequently all the other receptacles were uninjured.
uz: Albatta, u o'z his-tuyg'ularining hali yaxshi holatda emasligini bilardi, ammo u ularga ishonishi mumkinligini his qilib, gazning chiqib ketmaganligiga va shu sababli boshqa barcha idishlarning jarohatlanmaganligiga amin bo'lishi mumkinligini bilardi.

en: At the touch of the match, the gas burst into light and burned with a steady flame.
uz: O'yinchoq tutilganda, gaz yorug'likka tushib, doimiy olov bilan yondi.

en: Ardan immediately bent anxiously over the prostrate bodies of his friends.
uz: Ardan darhol o'z do'stlarining ustun bo'lgan jasadlari ustida tashvish bilan yonboshladi.

en: They lay on each other like inert masses, M'Nicholl stretched across Barbican.
uz: Ular bir-biriga o'xshaydi, M'Nicholl Barbican o'rtasida uzilgan inert massasi kabi yonboshlagan.

en: Ardan first lifted up the Captain, laid him on the sofa, opened his clenched hands, rubbed them, and slapped the palms vigorously.
uz: Ardan avvaliga kapitanni ko'tarib, uni kanepasiga qo'ydi, qo'llarini ochdi, ularni aralashtirdi va qo'l qo'llarini qattiq urdi.

en: Then he went all over the body carefully, kneading it, rubbing it, and gently patting it.
uz: So'ngra u butun tanani ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'rab olib, uni pishirib, silkitib, muloyimlik bilan taqillatdi.

en: In such intelligent efforts to restore suspended circulation, he seemed perfectly at home, and after a few minutes his patience was rewarded by seeing the Captain's pallid face gradually recover its natural color, and by feeling his heart gradually beat with a firm pulsation.
uz: Ayniqsa, qon aylanishini tiklash uchun bunday aqlli harakatlarda u o'zini yaxshi his qilgan va bir necha daqiqadan so'ng uning sabr-toqatini kapitanning bo'sh yuzida o'zining tabiiy rangini o'zgartirganini ko'rish va yuragining qat'iy pulsatsiya bilan tushib ketayotganini his qilish bilan mukofotlandi.

en: At last M'Nicholl opened his eyes, stared at Ardan for an instant, pressed his hand, looked around searchingly and anxiously, and at last whispered in a faint voice: "How's Barbican?" "Barbican is all right, Captain," answered Ardan quietly, but still speaking French.
uz: Oxiri M'Nichol ko'zlarini ochib, bir daqiqa Ardanga qaradi, qo'lini bosadi, atrofini o'ylab ko'radi va tashvishlanib, oxir-oqibat: "Barbican qanday?" deb o'ylaydi: "Barbican yaxshi, kapitan", - deb javob berdi Ardan xotirjamlik bilan, ammo hali ham frantsuz tilida gapiradi.

en: "I'll attend to him in a jiffy.
uz: "O'sha zahoti unga qarab turaman.

en: He had to wait for his turn.
uz: U o'z navbatini kutishi kerak edi.

en: I began with you because you were the top man.
uz: Men sen bilan boshladim, chunki sen eng yaxshi odam eding.

en: We'll see in a minute what we can do for dear old Barby (ce cher Barbican)!" In less than thirty seconds more, the Captain not only was able to sit up himself, but he even insisted on helping Ardan to lift Barbican, and deposit him gently on the sofa.
uz: Bir daqiqadan so'ng, sevimli eski Barbi uchun nima qilishimiz mumkinligini ko'ramiz!" - deb aytdi.O'ttiz soniyadan kam vaqt ichida kapitan o'zini o'zi o'tqazishga muvaffaq bo'ldi, balki Ardanni Barbicanni ko'tarishga va uni sofada muloyimlik bilan joylashtirishga yordam berishga rag'batlantirdi.

en: HELPED ARDAN TO LIFT BARBICAN.
uz: Barbikanni ko'tarishga yordam berdi.

en: The poor President had evidently suffered more from the concussion than either of his companions.
uz: Chindan ham, kambag'al Prezident o'z sheriklaridan ko'ra ko'proq sarosimaga duch kelgan.

en: As they took off his coat they were at first terribly shocked at the sight of a great patch of blood staining his shirt bosom, but they were inexpressibly relieved at finding that it proceeded from a slight contusion of the shoulder, little more than skin deep.
uz: Uning kiyimini olib tashlayotganda, birinchi navbatda, uning ko'ylak ko'krakida katta qon to'plami bo'lganini ko'rib, juda hayron bo'lishdi, ammo bu ko'krakning kichik bir shikastlanishi, taning chuqurligidan kamroq bo'lganini bilib, ko'ngillari ko'tarilmay ketdi.

en: Every approved operation that Ardan had performed for the Captain, both now repeated for Barbican, but for a long time with nothing like a favorable result.
uz: Ardan kapitan uchun amalga oshirgan har bir tasdiqlangan operatsiya endi Barbican uchun takrorlanadi, ammo uzoq vaqt davomida hech qanday ijobiy natijaga ega bo'lmagan.

en: Ardan at first tried to encourage the Captain by whispers of a lively and hopeful nature, but not yet understanding why M'Nicholl did not deign to make a single reply, he grew reserved by degrees and at last would not speak a single word.
uz: Ardan boshida kapitanni jonli va umidvor xotiralar bilan dalda berishga harakat qildi, ammo M'Nichollning nima uchun bitta ham javob berishga munosib emasligini tushunmay, o'zidan-o'zi ehtiyot bo'lib, oxir-oqibat bitta ham so'z aytmadi.

en: He worked at Barbican, however, just as before.
uz: Biroq, u avvalgidek Barbicanda ishlagan.

en: M'Nicholl interrupted himself every moment to lay his ear on the breast of the unconscious man.
uz: M'Nicholl o'zini har bir daqiqada o'zi aralashtirib, o'z quloqini befarq odamning ko'ksiga qo'ydi.

en: At first he had shaken his head quite despondingly, but by degrees he found himself more and more encouraged to persist.
uz: Boshida u boshini juda tushkunlikka tushirdi, lekin asta-sekin o'zini ko'proq va ko'proq chidash uchun rag'batlantirdi.

en: "He breathes!" he whispered at last.
uz: "U nafas oladi!" - dedi u, nihoyat, shov-shuv qilib.

en: "Yes, he has been breathing for some time," replied Ardan, quietly, still unconsciously speaking French.
uz: "Ha, u bir muncha vaqtdan beri nafas olmoqda", deb javob berdi Ardan, xotirjamlik bilan, hali ham bexabar fransuz tilida gapirmoqda.

en: "A little more rubbing and pulling and pounding will make him as spry as a young grasshopper." They worked at him, in fact, so vigorously, intelligently and perseveringly, that, after what they considered a long hour's labor, they had the delight of seeing the pale face assume a healthy hue, the inert limbs give signs of returning animation, and the breathing become strong and regular.
uz: "Ozgina ko'proq silkitish, tortish va urish uni kichkinagina chigirtka kabi chiroyli qiladi". Ular, aslida, u bilan shunchalik kuch bilan, aqlli va chidamli ishladilarki, ular uzoq soatlik mehnat deb hisoblaganidan so'ng, o'zlarining ko'ngillari bilan ko'rinish uchun chiroyli yuz sog'lom nuqtaga ega bo'lganini, inert a'zolari qayta tiklanayotganini, nafas olish kuchli va muntazam bo'lganini ko'rishdan zavqlanishdi.

en: At last, Barbican suddenly opened his eyes, started into an upright position on the sofa, took his friends by the hands, and, in a voice showing complete consciousness, demanded eagerly: "Ardan, M'Nicholl, are we moving?" His friends looked at each other, a little amused, but more perplexed.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, Barbican ko'zlarini to'xtatmay ochdi, sofa ustida tik turibdi, do'stlarini qo'lidan ushlab oldi va to'liq ongli ovoz bilan: "Ardan, M'Nicholl, harakatlanyapmizmi?" - deb talab qildi. Do'stlari bir-birlariga biroz qiziqarli, ammo ko'proq g'alati ko'rindi.

en: In their anxiety regarding their own and their friend's recovery, they had never thought of asking such a question.
uz: Ular o'zlarining va do'stlarining sog'ayishi haqida tashvishlanib, bunday savol berishni hech qachon o'ylamagan edilar.

en: His words recalled them at once to a full sense of their situation.
uz: Uning so'zlari ularni o'z vazifasi haqida to'liq tushunishga undadi.

en: Blessed if I can tell!" said Ardan, still speaking French.
uz: Agar buni bilsam, baraka topaman!" - dedi Ardan, hali ham frantsuz tilida gapirgan.

en: "We may be lying fifty feet deep in a Florida marsh, for all I know," observed M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Men bilganimcha, biz Floridadagi maydonchada ellik metr chuqurlikda yotgan bo'lishimiz mumkin", - deb ta'kidladi.

en: "Or, likely as not, in the bottom of the Gulf of Mexico," suggested Ardan, still in French.
uz: "Yoki, ehtimol yo'q, Meksika ko'rfazining tubida", deb aytdi Ardan, hali ham frantsuz tilida.

en: "Suppose we find out," observed Barbican, jumping up to try, his voice as clear and his step as firm as ever.
uz: "Agar biz buni bilib olsak", - deb aytdi Barbican, harakat qilish uchun o'zidan-o'zini pastga chiqarib, o'z ovozini ochiq va qadamlarini har doimgidek qat'iy ko'rsatdi.

en: But trying is one thing, and finding out another.
uz: Ammo harakat qilish - bu bir narsa, boshqa narsani bilishdan iborat.

en: Having no means of comparing themselves with external objects, they could not possibly tell whether they were moving, or at an absolute stand-still.
uz: O'zlarini tashqi asboblar bilan solishtirishning iloji yo'qligi sababli, ular harakatlanayotganini yoki mutlaqo to'xtab turganini bilmas edilar.

en: Though our Earth is whirling us continually around the Sun at the tremendous speed of ൦ൡൡ miles a minute, its inhabitants are totally unconscious of the slightest motion.
uz: Garchi Yer sayyoramiz Quyosh atrofida doimiy ravishda bir daqiqada ming kilometr tezlikda aylanib borayotgan bo'lsa-da, uning aholisi eng kam harakatni ham bilmaydilar.

en: It was the same with our travellers.
uz: Bizning sayohatchilarimiz ham xuddi shunday edi.

en: Through their own personal consciousness they could tell absolutely nothing.
uz: Ular o'z shaxsiy onglari orqali hech narsa aytolmasdi.

en: "Well, I swan to man!" cried the Captain, who always swore a little when his feelings got beyond his control; "Ardan, the Boss has got the rig on both of us this time, but rough as it is on you it is a darned sight more so on me.

en: "It sounds like French, I'd say to myself," continued the Captain, "but I know it's English, and by and by, when this whirring goes out of my head, I shall easily understand it." Ardan now looked as if he was beginning to see the joke.

Coolly and mechanically, as if seated at his desk, in his office, Barbican opened his memorandum book, wrote a receipt on a blank page, dated, signed and sealed it, and then handed it to the Captain, who put it away carefully among the other papers of his portfolio.
uz: "Ha, men birini afzal ko'raman, agar bu juda ko'p muammo bo'lmasa", - deb javob berdi M'Nicholl; "bu nizolarni saqlaydi". Barbican sovuq va mexanik tarzda, xuddi o'z ish stolida, ofisida o'tirganidek, o'z yozuvlar daftarini ochdi, bo'sh sahifaga rasmga yozdi, sanaladi, imzolanadi va muhrlanadi, so'ngra uni kapitanga topshirdi, u esa uni o'z portfelidagi boshqa qog'ozlar orasida ehtiyotkorlik bilan joylashtirdi.

en: Ardan, taking off his hat, made a profound bow to both of his companions, without saying a word.
uz: Ardan to'pini olib, bir so'z aytmasdan, o'z hamkorlariga chuqur sajda qildi.

en: Such formality, under such extraordinary circumstances, actually paralysed his tongue for the moment.
uz: Bunday rasmiylik, bunday noyob holatlarda, hozircha uning tilini to'sqinlik qildi.

en: No wonder that he could not understand those Americans.
uz: Shuning uchun u amerikaliklarni tushunmaganidan ajablanarli emas.

en: Even Indians would have surprised him by an exhibition of such stoicism.
uz: Hatto hindistonliklar ham bunday stoikchilikni ko'rsatganida uni hayratda qoldirishardi.

en: After indulging in silent wonder for a minute or two, he joined his companions who were now busy looking out at the starry sky.
uz: Bir-ikki daqiqa davomida xotirjamlik bilan shug'ullangach, u hozir yulduzli osmonni ko'rib turgan do'stlariga qo'shildi.

en: "Where is the Moon?" he asked.
uz: "Oy qayerda?" deb so'radi u.

en: "How is it that we cannot see her?" "The fact of our not seeing her," answered Barbican, "gives me very great satisfaction in one respect; it shows that our Projectile was shot so rapidly out of the Columbiad that it had not time to be impressed with the slightest revolving motion—for us a most fortunate matter.
uz: "Biz uni qanday qilib ko'rmayapmiz?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Uni ko'rmaganimiz bir jihatdan menga juda katta mamnuniyat baxsh etadi; bu bizga ko'rsatib turibdiki, biz o'z raketalarimizni Columbiaddan shunchalik tezroq chiqarib yuborganini ko'rsatadiki, biz uchun eng baxtli bo'lgan eng kichik aylanuvchi harakat bilan ta'sirlanishga vaqt bo'lmagan.

en: As for the rest—see, there is Cassiopeia, a little to the left is Andromeda, further down is the great square of Pegasus, and to the southwest Fomalhaut can be easily seen swallowing the Cascade.
uz: Qolgan joylarga kelsak, Kassiopeya bor, biroz chap tomon Andromeda bor, pastda Pegasusning buyuk maydoni bor va janubi-g'arbiy Fomalhaut kaskadani yutib ketayotganini ko'rish mumkin.

en: All this shows we are looking west and consequently
uz: Bularning barchasi biz g'arbga qarayotganimizni ko'rsatadi va natijada

en: cannot see the Moon, which is approaching the zenith from the east.
uz: Sharqdan o'zining eng yuqori darajasiga yaqinlashib kelayotgan oyni ko'rish mumkin emas.

en: Open the other light—But hold on!
uz: Boshqa yorug'likni oching, lekin to'xtang!

en: What can this be?" The three travellers, looking westwardly in the direction of Alpherat, saw a brilliant object rapidly approaching them.
uz: Bu nima bo'lishi mumkin?" - deb so'rashgan uchta sayohatchi g'arbga qarab Alferat tomon qaraganida, ularga tezda yaqinlashib kelayotgan chiroyli ob'ektni ko'rishdi.

en: At a distance, it looked like a dusky moon, but the side turned towards the Earth blazed with a bright light, which every moment became more intense.
uz: Uzoqdan ko'rinadigan oyga o'xshardi, ammo yer yuziga qaragan tomoni yorug' yorug' yorug'lik bilan yorib, har bir daqiqada yanada kuchliroq bo'ldi.

en: It came towards them with prodigious velocity and, what was worse, its path lay so directly in the course of the Projectile that a collision seemed inevitable.
uz: U g'ayritabiiy tezlikda ularga yaqinlashdi va bundan ham og'irroq bo'lsa-da, uning yo'li raketa yo'lida shunchalik to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lganki, to'qnashish qochishi mumkin bo'lmagan edi.

en: As it moved onward, from west to east, they could easily see that it rotated on its axis, like all heavenly bodies; in fact, it somewhat resembled a Moon on a small scale, describing its regular orbit around the Earth.
uz: U g'arbdan sharqqa o'tib ketayotganda, barcha samoviy jismlar kabi o'z o'zida aylanishini osonlikcha ko'rishardi; aslida u kichik hajmdagi oyga o'xshardi va uning Yer atrofidagi muntazam orbitasini tasvirlagan.

en: "Mille tonerres!" cried Ardan, greatly excited; "what is that?
uz: "Mille tonerres!" - dedi Ardan juda hayajonlanib, "bu nima?

en: Can it be another projectile?" M'Nicholl, wiping his spectacles, looked again, but made no reply.
uz: Bu boshqa bir o'q bo'lishi mumkinmi?" - dedi M'Nicholl, ko'z ko'zlari ko'rinishini o'chirib, yana bir bor ko'rib qoldi, lekin javob bermadi.

en: Barbican looked puzzled and uneasy.
uz: Barbican g'alati va noqulay ko'rinardi.

en: A collision was quite possible, and the results, even if not frightful in the highest degree, must be extremely deplorable.
uz: To'qnashish juda mumkin edi va natijalar, hatto eng katta darajada qo'rqinchli bo'lmasa-da, juda achinarli bo'lishi kerak.

en: The Projectile, if not absolutely dashed to pieces, would be diverted from its own course and dragged along in a new one in obedience to the irresistible attraction of this furious asteroid.
uz: O'z yo'nalishidan o'zgartirilgan bo'lsa-da, o'z yo'nalishidan o'zgarib, ushbu g'azablangan asteroidning qarshilik ko'rsatmaydigan jozibasiga bo'ysunib, yangi asteroidga olib boriladi.

en: Barbican fully realized that either alternative involved the complete failure of their enterprise.
uz: Barbican har bir variant ularning ishlarining to'liq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashishini to'liq tushundi.

en: He kept perfectly still, but, never losing his presence of mind, he curiously looked on the approaching object with a gladiatorial eye, as if seeking to detect some unguarded point in his terrible adversary.
uz: U mukammal darajada to'xtamaydi, lekin hech qachon ongini yo'qotmay, o'z qo'rqinchli dushmanidagi biron bir qo'riqlanmagan nuqtani aniqlashni istaganidek, u yaqinlashib kelayotgan ob'ektga gladiatorlik ko'zi bilan qiziqarli tarzda qaradi.

en: The Captain was equally silent; he looked like a man who had fully made up his mind to regard every possible contingency with the most stoical indifference.
uz: Kapten ham o'zini tutmadi; u har qanday vaziyatni to'liq o'ylab ko'rgan odamga o'xshardi.

en: But Ardan's tongue, more fluent than ever, rattled away incessantly.
uz: Ammo Ardanning tili, har qachongidan ham ko'proq oqilona bo'lib, to'xtamasdan shov-shuv qilib ketdi.

en: Look!" he exclaimed, in tones so perfectly expressive of his rapidly alternating feelings as to render the medium of words totally unnecessary.
uz: Qaranglar!" - deb hayqirdi u, o'zlarining tezda o'zgarib turadigan his-tuyg'ularini to'liq ifodalaydigan tovushlar bilan so'zlarning vositaini mutlaqo zaruriy qilmay qo'ydi.

en: "How rapidly the cursed thing is nearing us!
uz: "Qanday tezda la'natlangan narsa bizga yaqinlashmoqda!

en: Plague take your ugly phiz, the more I know you, the less I like you!
uz: O'zingizning qo'rqinchli fikringizni darg'azab tuting, men sizni qanchalik yaxshi bilsam, shunchalik ham sizga ozgina yoqaman!

en: Every second she doubles in size!
uz: Har bir soniyada u o'lchamini ikki baravar ko'paytiradi!

en: Come, Madame Projectile!
uz: Keling, xonim Projectile!

en: Stir your stumps a little livelier, old lady!
uz: Tovushlaringizni biroz tirikroq uyg'oting, keksa ayol!

en: He's making for you as straight as an arrow!
uz: U siz uchun o'q kabi to'g'ri yo'l tutmoqda!

en: We're going right in his way, or he's coming in ours, I can't say which.
uz: Biz uning yo'liga to'g'ri boramiz yoki u bizning yo'limizda keladi, qaysiini aytolmayman.

en: It's taking a mean advantage of us either way.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu bizdan afzallik ko'rsatmoqda.

en: As for ourselves—what can we do!
uz: O'zimiz uchun nima qilishimiz mumkin!

en: Before such a monster as that we are
uz: Biz o'zimiz kabi hayvonni ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: as helpless as three men in a little skiff shooting down the rapids to the brink of Niagara!
uz: Uch kishi kichik kemaga o'tirib, Niagara daryosining chegaralarigacha bo'lgan shovqinlarni tushirganidek, yordamsiz!

en: Now for it!" Nearer and nearer it came, but without noise, without sparks, without a trail, though its lower part was brighter than ever.
uz: Endi yo'q!" - deb yaqinlashdi, lekin shovqinsiz, chiroqsiz, izsiz, ammo pastki qismi har qachongidan ham yorqinroq edi.

en: Its path lying little above them, the nearer it came the more the collision seemed inevitable.
uz: Uning yo'li ularning ustida juda oz joylashgan bo'lsa-da, u qanchalik yaqinlashsa, to'qnashish shunchalik ham qochmasdek tuyulgan.

en: Imagine yourself caught on a narrow railroad bridge at midnight with an express train approaching at full speed, its reflector already dazzling you with its light, the roar of the cars rattling in your ears, and you may conceive the feelings of the travellers.
uz: Tasavvur qiling, kechasi yarim kechada tor temir yo'l ko'prikida tezda yaqinlashib kelayotgan jadal poyezdda o'zingizni tutgan bo'lsangiz, uning o'ziga xos ko'rinishi sizni allaqachon nurlari bilan mashg'ul qilmoqda, quloqlaringizda mashinalarning qichqiriqlari qichqirmoqda va siz sayohatchilarning his-tuyg'ularini tasavvur qila olasiz.

en: At last it was so near that the travellers started back in affright, with eyes shut, hair on end, and fully believing their last hour had come.
uz: Nihoyat u shunchalik yaqinlashib qoldiki, sayohatchilar qo'rqib, ko'zlarini yopib, sochlarini to'kib qo'yib, so'nggi soati kelganiga amin bo'lib qaytishdi.

en: Even then Ardan had his mot.
uz: Hatto o'shanda Ardan o'z motini aytdi.

en: "We can neither switch off, down brakes, nor clap on more steam!
uz: "Biz na o'chirib, na frenlarni pastga tushira olamiz, na yana bir o'simlik uchun qo'l urishimiz mumkin!

en: Hard luck!" In an instant all was over.
uz: Qattiq omad!" Bir lahzada hamma narsa tugadi.

en: The velocity of the Projectile was fortunately great enough to carry it barely above the dangerous point; and in a flash the terrible bolide disappeared rapidly several hundred yards beneath the affrighted travellers.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, O'g'ilning tezligi uni xavfli nuqtadan kamdan-kam yuqoriga ko'tarib borishga etarlicha katta edi; bir chaqmoq ichida esa dahshatli bolid qo'rqinchli sayohatchilardan bir necha yuz metr pastda tezda yo'qoldi.

en: And may you never come back!" cried Ardan, hardly able to breathe.
uz: Va hech qachon qaytib kelmasligingni xohlayman! - dedi Ardan, nafas olishni qiyinlashtirib.

en: "It's perfectly outrageous!
uz: "Bu juda dahshatli!

en: Not room enough in infinite space to let an unpretending bullet like ours move about a little without incurring the risk of being run over by such a monster as that!
uz: O'zimiz kabi o'ziga xos o'yinchiga o'xshash qurg'oqchilikni o'z ichiga olmagan o'yinchiga o'z ichiga o'ynash xavfi tug'ilmasdan, cheksiz joyda kamroq joy topishga imkon bermaydi!

en: Do you know, Barbican?" "I do," was the reply.
uz: Bilasizmi, Barbican?" - deb javob berdilar.

en: What is it that he don't know?
uz: U nima bilmaydi?

en: Eh, Captain?" "It is a simple bolide, but one of such enormous dimensions that the Earth's attraction has made it a satellite." "What!" cried Ardan, "another satellite besides the Moon?
uz: Eh, kapitan?" - "Bu oddiy bolid, ammo uning o'lchamlari shunchalik katta bo'lganki, Yerning jozibadorligi uni satelitga aylantirgan.

en: I hope there are no more of them!" "They are pretty numerous," replied Barbican; "but they are so small and they move with such enormous velocity that they are very seldom seen.
uz: "Ular juda ko'p", - dedi Barbican, - lekin ular juda kichik va ular shunchalik tez harakatlanadilarki, ularni kamdan-kam ko'rish mumkin.

en: Petit, the Director of the Observatory of Toulouse, who these last years has devoted much time and care to the observation of bolides, has calculated that the very one we have just encountered moves with such astonishing swiftness that it accomplishes its revolution around the Earth in about ൤ hours and ൣൡ minutes!"
uz: Toʻlzo observatoriyasi direktori Petit, soʻnggi yillarda bolidlarni kuzatishga koʻp vaqt va eʼtiborni sarflagan boʻlsa-da, biz uchratgan bolidning juda ajoyib tezlikda harakatlanishini hisoblab chiqdi va u deyarli  soat va  daqiqada Yer atrofida aylanishini amalga oshiradi!"

en: "Whew!" whistled Ardan, "where should we be now if it had struck us!" "You don't mean to say, Barbican," observed M'Nicholl, "that Petit has seen this very one?" "So it appears," replied Barbican.
uz: "Uh!" - deb o'qiydi Ardan, "agar bu bizga tushib ketsa, endi qayerda bo'lishimiz kerak edi!" - M'Nicholl: "Sen aytmoqchi emassan, Barbican, - deb aytdi. - Kichik yigit aynan shu birini ko'rganmi?" - deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "And do all astronomers admit its existence?" asked the Captain.
uz: "Va barcha astronomlar uning mavjudligini tan olishadimi?" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "Well, some of them have their doubts," replied Barbican— "If the unbelievers had been here a minute or two ago," interrupted Ardan, "they would never express a doubt again." "If Petit's calculation is right," continued Barbican, "I can even form a very good idea as to our distance from the Earth." "It seems to me Barbican can do what he pleases here or elsewhere," observed Ardan to the Captain.
uz: "Agar imonsizlar bir yoki ikki daqiqa oldin bu yerda bo'lganlarida, hech qachon yana shubha bildirmas edilar", - dedi Ardan. "Agar Petitning hisob-kitoblari to'g'ri bo'lsa", dedi Barbican. "Men hatto Yerdan uzoqligimizga nisbatan juda yaxshi tasavvurga ega bo'laman". "Menga o'xshaydi, Barbican bu yerda yoki boshqa joyda xohlaganini qila oladi", - deb aytdi Ardan kapitanga.

en: "Let us see, Barbican," asked M'Nicholl; "where has Petit's calculation placed us?" "The bolide's distance being known," replied Barbican, "at the moment we met it we were a little more than ൦ thousand miles from the Earth's surface." "Five thousand miles already!" cried Ardan, "why we have only just started!" "Let us see about that," quietly observed the Captain, looking at his chronometer, and calculating with his pencil.
uz: "Qarang, Barbican", - deb so'radi M'Nicholl; "Petitning hisob-kitoblari bizni qayerga joylashtirdi?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. "Bolidning masofasi ma'lum bo'lgani uchun, biz uni uchratgan paytda biz Yer yuzidan bir oz ko'proq kilometr uzoqlikda edik". "Besh ming kilometrdan oshdi!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, "Nima biz hali boshlanmaymiz!" - deb o'yladi Ardan. "Buni ko'rib chiqaylik", - dedi kapitan xonometriga qarab va qalam bilan hisob-kitob qilib.

en: "It is now ൢൡ minutes past eleven; we have therefore been ൣ൤ minutes on the road.
uz: "Hndi soat o'n bir daqiqa o'tdi, shuning uchun biz yo'lda bir necha daqiqa bo'ldik.

en: Supposing our initial velocity of ൢൡ,ൡൡൡ yards or nearly seven miles a second, to have been kept up, we should by this time be about ൪,ൡൡൡ miles from the Earth; but by allowing for friction and gravity, we can hardly be more than ൦,൦ൡൡ miles.
uz: Agar bizning dastlabki tezligimiz , yards yoki deyarli yetti mil sekundda saqlansa, bu vaqtgacha biz Yerdan taxminan , mil uzoqlikda bo'lishimiz kerak; lekin chiziq va gravitatsiyaga yo'l qo'yib, biz deyarli , mildan ortiq bo'la olmaymiz.

en: Yes, friend Barbican, Petit does not seem to be very wrong in his calculations." But Barbican hardly heard the observation.
uz: Ha, do'stim Barbican, Petit hisob-kitoblarida juda ham xato qilmagan bo'lib tuyuladi". Ammo Barbican bu fikrni kamdan-kam eshitgan.

en: He had not yet answered the puzzling question that had already presented itself to them for solution; and until he had done so he could not attend to anything else.
uz: U hali ularga hal qilinish uchun o'zini taqdim etgan g'alati savolga javob bermagan edi; va buni qilmaguncha, boshqa hech narsa bilan shug'ullanolmagan.

en: "That's all very well and good, Captain," he replied in an absorbed manner, "but we have not yet been able to account for a very strange phenomenon.
uz: "Bu juda yaxshi va yaxshi, kapitan", deb javob berdi u o'ziga xos tarzda, "lekin biz hali juda g'alati hodisani tushuntira olmaymiz.

en: Why didn't we hear the report?" No one replying, the conversation came to a stand-still, and Barbican, still absorbed in his reflections, began clearing the second
uz: Nima uchun biz xabarni eshitmadik?" - deb so'rashdi. - Hech kim javob bermadi, suhbat to'xtadi, Barbican esa o'z fikrlarida davom etib, ikkinchisini aniqlay boshladi.

en: light of its external shutter.
uz: Tashqi shutterning yorug'ligi.

en: In a few minutes the plate dropped, and the Moon beams, flowing in, filled the interior of the Projectile with her brilliant light.
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng plakat tushdi va oy nurlari o'tib, o'z yorug'ligini ko'rsatdi.

en: The Captain immediately put out the gas, from motives of economy as well as because its glare somewhat interfered with the observation of the interplanetary regions.
uz: Kapitan darhol gazni o'chirib qo'ydi, chunki uning yorqinligi sayyoralararo mintaqalarni kuzatishga xalaqit berardi.

en: The Lunar disc struck the travellers as glittering with a splendor and purity of light that they had never witnessed before.
uz: Ay disklari sayohatchilarni ilgari hech qachon ko'rmagan chiroyli va sof nur bilan parlash bilan hayratda qoldirdi.

en: The beams, no longer strained through the misty atmosphere of the Earth, streamed copiously in through the glass and coated the interior walls of the Projectile with a brilliant silvery plating.
uz: Yerdagi bulutli atmosfera orqali ko'tarilmagan balog'lar shisha orqali ko'p miqdorda oqib kirib, Projectilning ichki devorlarini parcha-parcha kumush qoplama bilan qopladilar.

en: The intense blackness of the sky enhanced the dazzling radiance of the Moon.
uz: Osmonning qattiq qoraligi oyning chiroyli nurini kuchaytirdi.

en: Even the stars blazed with a new and unequalled splendor, and, in the absence of a refracting atmosphere, they flamed as bright in the close proximity of the Moon as in any other part of the sky.
uz: Hatto yulduzlar ham yangi va o'zgacha chiroyli nur bilan parlashardi va buzg'unchi atmosfera yo'qligida oy yaqinligida osmondagi har qanday joyda bo'lgani kabi parlashardi.

en: You can easily conceive the interest with which these bold travellers gazed on the Starry Queen, the final object of their daring journey.
uz: Ushbu jasoratli sayohatchilar o'zlarining jasoratli sayohatlarining yakuniy ob'ekti bo'lgan Yulduzli Qirolichaga qanday qiziqish bilan qaraganini osonlikcha tasavvur qila olasiz.

en: She was now insensibly approaching the zenith, the mathematical point which she was to reach four days later.
uz: U endi to'rt kun o'tgach erishadigan matematik nuqta bo'lgan zenitga befarq ravishda yaqinlashayotgan edi.

en: They presented their telescopes, but her mountains, plains, craters and general characteristics hardly came out a particle more sharply than if they had been viewed from the Earth.
uz: Ular teleskoplarini taqdim etishdi, ammo uning tog'lari, tekisliklari, kraterlari va umumiy xususiyatlari Yerdan ko'rib chiqilganidan ko'ra keskinroq bir zarracha chiqmagan.

en: Still, her light, unobstructed by air or vapor, shimmered with a lustre actually transplendent.
uz: Biroq, uning yorug'ligi havo yoki bug'lar tomonidan to'siqsiz, aslida transplendent shisha bilan parlashardi.

en: Her disc shone like a mirror of polished platins.
uz: Uning disklari polizlangan platinalar ko'rinishi kabi porloq edi.

en: The travellers remained for some time absorbed in the silent contemplation of the glorious scene.
uz: Sayohatchilar bir muncha vaqt shuhratli ko'rinishning sukunatli mulohazalarida mashg'ul bo'lishdi.

en: "How they're gazing at her this very moment from Stony Hill!" said the Captain at last to break the silence.
uz: "Ular shu payt Stony Hilldan unga qanday qarayaptilar!" - dedi kapitan so'ng tinchlikni buzish uchun.

en: "By Jove!" cried Ardan; "It's true!
uz: "Jove bilan!" - deb baqirdi Ardan; "Haqiqatan ham shunday!

en: Captain you're right.
uz: Kapitan, siz haqsiz.

en: We were near forgetting our dear old Mother, the Earth.
uz: Biz qadimgi onamiz Yerni deyarli unutib qo'ydik.

en: What ungrateful children!
uz: Qanday ham shukrsiz bolalar!

en: Let me feast my eyes once more on the blessed old creature!" Barbican, to satisfy his companion's desire, immediately commenced to clear away the disc which covered the floor of the Projectile and prevented them from getting at the lower light.
uz: Bir bor ko'zimni qutlug'lik va qadimgi yaratilishga qaratayin!" - deb aytdi Barbican, sherigining istaklarini qondirish uchun darhol Projectilning qavatini qoplagan diskni tozalay boshladi va ularni pastki yorug'likka yetib bormaslikka to'sqinlik qildi.

en: This disc, though it had been dashed to the bottom of the Projectile with great violence, was still as strong as ever, and, being made in compartments fastened by screws, to dismount it was no easy
uz: Ushbu disk, Garchi u kuchli zo'ravonlik bilan Projectile quyiga cho'kkan bo'lsa-da, har doimgidek kuchli edi va, shovqinlar bilan bog'langan bo'shliqlarda ishlab chiqilgan bo'lsa-da, uni tushirish oson emas edi

en: Barbican, however, with the help of the others, soon had it all taken apart, and put away the pieces carefully, to serve again in case of need.
uz: Biroq, Barbican, boshqalarning yordami bilan, tez orada bularning barchasini yig'ib tashladi va kerak bo'lganda yana xizmat qilish uchun qismlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan joylashtirdi.

en: A round hole about a foot and a half in diameter appeared, bored through the floor of the Projectile.
uz: Bir yarim fut diametrli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri cho'g' paydo bo'ldi, bu cho'g'ni Projectile yostigi orqali kesib o'tdi.

en: It was closed by a circular pane of plate-glass, which was about six inches thick, fastened by a ring of copper.
uz: U taxminan olti dyuym qalin bo'lgan, misdan yasalgan anjom bilan bog'langan to'rtinchi darajadagi shisha plakatlari bilan yopilgan edi.

en: Below, on the outside, the glass was protected by an aluminium plate, kept in its place by strong bolts and nuts.
uz: Pastda, tashqi tomondan, shisha alyuminiy plakat bilan himoyalangan edi, uni kuchli boltlar va tuxumlar o'rnida saqlab turardi.

en: The latter being unscrewed, the bolts slipped out by their own weight, the shutter fell, and a new communication was established between the interior and the exterior.
uz: Keyinchalik bu chiziqlar o'z og'irligi bilan chiqarib tashlandi, shutter tushdi va ichki va tashqi aloqa o'rtasida yangi aloqa o'rnatildi.

en: Ardan knelt down, applied his eye to the light, and tried to look out.
uz: Ardan tiz cho'kib, ko'zini yorug'likka qaratdi va o'ziga qarab turishga harakat qildi.

en: At first everything was quite dark and gloomy.
uz: Boshida hamma narsa juda qorong'i va qorong'i edi.

en: "I see no Earth!" he exclaimed at last.
uz: "Men Yerni ko'rmayapman!" - dedi u nihoyat.

en: "Don't you see a fine ribbon of light?" asked Barbican, "right beneath us?
uz: "Bizning pastligimizda chiroyli nurni ko'rmayapsizmi?" - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: A thin, pale, silvery crescent?" "Of course I do.
uz: Kam, rang-barang, kumush bo'lak?" - "Agar yo'q, albatta.

en: Can that be the Earth?" "Terra Mater herself, friend Ardan.
uz: Bu Yer bo'lishi mumkinmi?" - "Terra Materning o'zi, do'stim Ardan.

en: That fine fillet of light, now hardly visible on her eastern border, will disappear altogether as soon as the Moon is full.
uz: Sharqiy chegaralarida ko'rinmaydigan bu chiroyli yorug'lik, oy to'liq bo'lganda butunlay yo'qoladi.

en: Then, lying as she will be between the Sun and the Moon, her illuminated face will be turned away from us altogether, and for several days she will be involved in impenetrable darkness." "And that's the Earth!" repeated Ardan, hardly able to believe his eyes, as he continued to gaze on the slight thread of silvery white light, somewhat resembling the appearance of the "Young May Moon" a few hours after sunset.
uz: Keyin, u quyosh va oy o'rtasida yotganida, uning yorug'langan yuzi bizdan butunlay o'zgarib qoladi va bir necha kun davomida u o'tmas zulmatda qoladi". "U yer!" - deb takrorladi Ardan ko'zlariga ishonib bo'lmay, quyosh botgandan bir necha soat o'tgach, "Yigit may oyining" ko'rinishiga o'xshash kumushta oq nurning kichkina bo'g'ini ko'rishda davom etdi.

en: Barbican's explanation was quite correct.
uz: Barbicanning tushuntirishlari juda to'g'ri edi.

en: The Earth, in reference to the Moon or the Projectile, was in her last phase, or octant as it is called, and showed a sharp-horned, attenuated, but brilliant crescent strongly relieved by the black background of the sky.
uz: Yer o'zining oxirgi bosqichida, ya'ni o'tmishda, o'z nomi bilan tanilgan oy yoki proyektilga ishora qilib, keskin sarg'ayib qolgan, kam bo'lgan, ammo ko'kdagi qora fon tufayli kuch bilan yengillashgan yorqin yarim oyni ko'rsatdi.

en: Its light, rendered a little bluish by the density of the atmospheric envelopes, was not quite as brilliant as the Moon's.
uz: Uning yorug'ligi atmosfera qadoqlarining zichligi tufayli biroz ko'k rangli bo'lgan, ammo oyning yorug'ligi kabi chiroyli bo'lmagan.

en: But the Earth's crescent, compared to the Lunar, was of dimensions much greater, being fully ൥ times larger.
uz: Ammo Yerning yarim oy, oy bilan taqqoslaganda, ko'proq o'lchamli bo'lib, to'liq  marta kattaroq bo'lgan.

en: You would have called it a vast, beautiful, but very thin bow extending over the sky.
uz: Siz uni keng, chiroyli, ammo osmon ustiga cho'zilgan juda chiroyli bo'lak deb atagan bo'lardingiz.

en: A few points, brighter than the rest, particularly in its concave part, revealed the presence of lofty mountains, probably the Himalayahs.
uz: Qolganlariga qaraganda bir necha nuqta, ayniqsa uning konkav qismida yorqinroq, baland tog'larning, ehtimol Himalaya tog'larining mavjudligini ko'rsatdi.

en: But they disappeared every
uz: Ammo ular har safar yo'qolgan.

en: now and then under thick vapory spots, which are never seen on the Lunar disc.
uz: Keyin esa, hozirgi vaqtda oy diskida hech qachon ko'rinmaydigan qalin buvushli nuqtalar ostida.

en: They were the thin concentric cloud rings that surround the terrestrial sphere.
uz: Bular yer yuzini o'rab olgan ince konsentrik bulutlar bor edi.

en: However, the travellers' eyes were soon able to trace the rest of the Earth's surface not only with facility, but even to follow its outline with absolute delight.
uz: Biroq, sayohatchilarning ko'zlari tez orada Yer yuzasining qolgan qismini nafaqat osonlikcha, balki butunlay zavq bilan kuzatishga qodir bo'ldi.

en: This was in consequence of two different phenomena, one of which they could easily account for; but the other they could not explain without Barbican's assistance.
uz: Bu ikki xil hodisalar natijasida sodir bo'ldi, ulardan birini ular osonlikcha tushuntira olishdi; ikkinchisini esa ular Barbicanning yordamiisiz tushuntira olishmadi.

en: Never before had mortal eye beheld such a sight.
uz: Bundan oldin hech bir inson ko'zi bunday ko'rinishni ko'rmagan edi.

en: Let us take each in its turn.
uz: Keling, har birimizni o'z navbatida ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: We all know that the ashy light by means of which we perceive what is called the Old Moon in the Young Moon's arms is due to the Earth-shine, or the reflection of the solar rays from the Earth to the Moon.
uz: Hammamiz bilamizki, yosh oyning qo'llarida eski oy deb atalgan narsani ko'rishimiz mumkin bo'lgan kulli nur Yerning yorug'ligi yoki Yerdan oyga quyosh nurlarining aks ettirilishi tufayli paydo bo'ladi.

en: By a phenomenon exactly identical, the travellers could now see that portion of the Earth's surface which was unillumined by the Sun; only, as, in consequence of the different areas of the respective surfaces, the Earthlight is thirteen times more intense than the Moonlight, the dark portion of the Earth's disc appeared considerably more adumbrated than the Old Moon.
uz: To'g'ri o'xshash hodisa tufayli sayohatchilar endi Quyosh nuridan mahrum bo'lgan Yer yuzi qismini ko'rishlari mumkin edi; faqat, har bir yuzining turli joylari natijasida Yer yorug'ligi oy yorug'ligidan o'n uch baravar kuchliroq bo'lgani sababli, Yer diskining qorong'i qismi Eski Oyga qaraganda ancha ko'proq ko'rinadi.

en: But the other phenomenon had burst on them so suddenly that they uttered a cry loud enough to wake up Barbican from his problem.
uz: Ammo boshqa hodisa ular uchun shunchalik to'satdan paydo bo'ldiki, ular Barbicanni o'z muammosidan uyg'otishga qodir bo'lgan darajada baland ovoz bilan baqirdilar.

en: They had discovered a true starry ring!
uz: Ular haqiqiy yulduzli do'stni kashf etishdi!

en: Around the Earth's outline, a ring, of internally well defined thickness, but somewhat hazy on the outside, could easily be traced by its surpassing brilliancy.
uz: Yer atrofida, ichki to'g'ri aniqlangan, lekin tashqi tomondan biroz bulg'a bo'lgan bir bog'liq bog'liq bo'lib, uning chiroyli parvozligi tufayli osonlikcha izlanish olib borilishi mumkin.

en: Neither the Pleiades, the Northern Crown, the Magellanic Clouds nor the great nebulas of Orion, or of Argo, no sparkling cluster, no corona, no group of glittering star-dust that the travellers had ever gazed at, presented such attractions as the diamond ring they now saw encompassing the Earth, just as the brass meridian encompasses a terrestrial globe.
uz: Pleiadlar, Shimoliy toj, Magellan bulutlari, Orion yoki Argo bulutlari, hech qanday parcha-parcha klaster, hech qanday korona, sayohatchilar ko'rgan parcha-parcha yulduzlar guruhi guruhi guruhi, ular hozirgi kunda Yerni qamrab olgan olmos anjom kabi diqqatga sazovor joylarni taqdim etmagan.

en: The resplendency of its light enchanted them, its pure softness delighted them, its perfect regularity astonished them.
uz: Uning yorug'ligi yorug'ligi ularni xarob qildi, uning sofligi ularni quvontirdi, mukammal muntazamligi ularni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: they asked Barbican.
uz: Ular "Barbican"ni so'radilar.

en: In a few words he explained it.
uz: U buni bir necha so'z bilan tushuntirdi.

en: The beautiful luminous ring was simply an optical illusion, produced by the refraction of the terrestrial atmosphere.
uz: Go'zal yorug'lik anjangiz shunchaki yerdagi atmosfera buzilishi natijasida hosil bo'lgan optik illüziya edi.

en: All the stars in the neighborhood of the Earth, and many actually behind it, had their rays refracted, diffused, radiated,
uz: Yerning atrofidagi barcha yulduzlar va ularning orqasidagi ko'plab yulduzlar o'z nurlarini buzgan, tarqalgan, sug'organ.

en: and finally converged to a focus by the atmosphere, as if by a double convex lens of gigantic power.
uz: Va nihoyat atmosfera tomonidan, xuddi ulkan kuchning ikki xil konvekst lensi orqali fokusga yaqinlashdi.

en: Whilst the travellers were profoundly absorbed in the contemplation of this wondrous sight, a sparkling shower of shooting stars suddenly flashed over the Earth's dark surface, making it for a moment as bright as the external ring.
uz: Sayohatchilar bu ajoyib ko'rinishni chuqur o'zlashtirganida, yerning qorong'i yuzasida birdan o'ta chiroqli yulduzlar shamolligi parcha-parcha parcha bo'lib, uni bir daqiqa davomida tashqi tuxum kabi yorqin qildi.

en: Hundreds of bolides, catching fire from contact with the atmosphere, streaked the darkness with their luminous trails, overspreading it occasionally with sheets of electric flame.
uz: Asrlab bolidlar atmosfera bilan muloqot qilish natijasida yong'inga tushib, qorong'ulikni yorug'lik yo'llari bilan yoritib, vaqti-vaqti bilan uni elektr olovining varaqalari bilan qoplab qo'ydilar.

en: The Earth was just then in her perihelion, and we all know that the months of November and December are so highly favorable to the appearance of these meteoric showers that at the famous display of November, ൢ൩൧൧, astronomers counted as many as ൩,ൡൡൡ between midnight and four o'clock.
uz: Yer o'sha paytda perihelion davrida edi va biz hammamiz noyabr va dekabr oylari bu meteoritlarning paydo bo'lishi uchun shunchalik qulay ekanligini bilamizki, noyabr oyidagi mashhur ko'rgazmada astronomlar kechqurun soat 12 dan to'rtgacha ko'pchilikni sanab o'tdilar.

en: Barbican explained the whole matter in a few words.
uz: Barbican butun mavzuni bir necha so'z bilan tushuntirdi.

en: The Earth, when nearest to the sun, occasionally plunges into a group of countless meteors travelling like comets, in eccentric orbits around the grand centre of our solar system.
uz: Yer quyoshga eng yaqin bo'lganida, vaqti-vaqti bilan quyosh tizimimizning katta markazida eksentrik orbitalarda kometalar kabi harakatlanayotgan ko'plab meteorlar guruhiga tushib tushadi.

en: The atmosphere strikes the rapidly moving bodies with such violence as to set them on fire and render them visible to us in beautiful star showers.
uz: Atmosfera tez harakatlanayotgan jismlarga shunday zo'ravonlik bilan uradiki, ularni yong'in bilan yondirib, ajoyib yulduz shoularida bizga ko'rinadi.

en: But to this simple explanation of the famous November meteors Ardan would not listen.
uz: Ammo Ardan noyabr oyidagi mashhur meteorlarning bu oddiy tushuntirilishiga quloq solmadi.

en: He preferred believing that Mother Earth, feeling that her three daring children were still looking at her, though five thousand miles away, shot off her best rocket-signals to show that she still thought of them and would never let them out of her watchful eye.
uz: U Yer onasi, uchta jasoratli farzandining hali ham besh ming mil uzoqlikda unga qarayotganini his qilib, hali ham ular haqida o'ylayotganini va ularni hech qachon hushyor ko'zidan chiqarmasligini ko'rsatish uchun eng yaxshi raketa signallarini o'tkazganini ishonishni afzal ko'rdi.

en: For hours they continued to gaze with indescribable interest on the faintly luminous mass so easily distinguishable among the other heavenly bodies.
uz: Ular soatlab boshqa samoviy jismlar orasida osonlikcha ajralib turadigan samarasiz yorug'lik massasini ifodalab bo'lmaydigan qiziqish bilan kuzatib turishdi.

en: Jupiter blazed on their right, Mars flashed his ruddy light on their left, Saturn with his rings looked like a round white spot on a black wall; even Venus they could see almost directly under them, easily recognizing her by her soft, sweetly scintillant light.
uz: Ularning o'ng tomonida - Yupiter, chap tomonida - Mars, chap tomonida - qizil nurlari, qora devordagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oq nuqtaga o'xshash bo'lgan Saturn, hatto Venusni deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ularning ostida ko'rishardi, uni uning yumshoq, shirin parcha-parcha nuridan osonlikcha tan olishardi.

en: But no planet or constellation possessed any attraction for the travellers, as long as their eyes could trace that shadowy, crescent-edged, diamond-girdled, meteor-furrowed spheroid, the theatre of their existence, the home of so many undying desires, the mysterious cradle of their race!
uz: Ammo sayohatchilar uchun hech qanday sayyora yoki yulduzning jozibadorligi yo'q edi, agar ularning ko'zlari o'sha soyasli, yarim oylik, olmos qoplangan, meteoritlar bilan o'ralgan sferodni, ularning mavjudot teatrini, o'lmas istaklarning uyini, irqlarining sirli cho'qqisini izlaya olmagan bo'lsa!

en: Meantime the Projectile cleaved its way upwards, rapidly, unswervingly, though with a gradually retarding velocity.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Projectile yuqoriga yo'l ochdi, tez, qat'iy, lekin asta-sekin sekinlashib bordi.

en: As the Earth sensibly grew darker, and the travellers' eyes grew dimmer, an irresistible somnolency slowly stole over their weary frames.
uz: Yer ko'proq qorong'i bo'lib, sayohatchilarning ko'zlari ko'proq ko'p bo'lganida, ularning charchagan ramkalari oshib ketganda, beqaror uyqusizlik asta-sekin paydo bo'ldi.

en: extraordinary excitement they had gone through during the last four or five hours, was naturally followed by a profound reaction.
uz: So'nggi to'rt yoki besh soat ichida ular boshdan kechirgan g'alati hayajon tabiiy ravishda chuqur reaktsiyaga uchradi.

en: "Captain, you're nodding," said Ardan at last, after a longer silence than usual; "the fact is, Barbican is the only wake man of the party, because he is puzzling over his problem.
uz: "Kapten, siz bosh og'rib turibsiz", dedi Ardan odatdagidan ko'proq sukutdan so'ng; "aslida, Barbican partiyaning yagona uyg'onuvchi odamidir, chunki u o'z muammosiga befarq.

en: Dum vivimus vivamus!
