uz: Dum vivimus vivamus!

en: As we are asleep let us be asleep!" So saying he threw himself on the mattress, and his companions immediately followed the example.
uz: Biz uxlayotgan ekanmiz, uxlaymiz!" - deb, u o'zini matrasga tashladi va uning hamrohlari darhol o'rnak ko'rsatishdi.

en: They had been lying hardly a quarter of an hour, when Barbican started up with a cry so loud and sudden as instantly to awaken his companions.
uz: Ular deyarli chorak soat davomida yolg'on gapirgan edilar, lekin Barbican o'z sheriklarini uyg'otish uchun darhol shunday baland va to'satdan qichqiriq qildi.

en: The bright moonlight showed them the President sitting up in his bed, his eye blazing, his arms waving, as he shouted in a tone reminding them of the day they had found him in St.
uz: Quyoshning yorug' yorug'ligi ularga Prezidentning o'z yotoqxonasida o'tirganini ko'rsatdi, uning ko'zlari yorqin, qo'llari o'zboshimcha, u St. Petersburgda uni topgan kunini eslatadigan ovoz bilan qichqirdi.

en: I know it!" "What have you got?" cried Ardan, bouncing up and seizing him by the right hand.
uz: Men buni bilaman!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, qochib o'ng qo'lidan tutdi.

en: "What do you know?" cried the Captain, stretching over and seizing him by the left.
uz: "Siz nima bilasiz?" - deb qayratlandi kapitan, qo'lini uzatib, uni chap tomondan ushlab qoldi.

en: "The reason why we did not hear the report!" "Well, why did not we hear it!" asked both rapidly in the same breath.
uz: "Biz xabarni eshitmaganimizning sababi!" - deb so'radilar ikkalasi ham tezda bir nafas olib.

en: "Because we were shot up ൤ൡ times faster than sound can travel!"
uz: "Bizni ovoz sayohat qilishidan ko'ra ko'p marta tezroq ko'tarib yubordilar!"

en: THEY MAKE THEMSELVES AT HOME AND FEEL QUITE COMFORTABLE.
uz: O'zlarini uyda saqlab, o'zlarini juda qulay his qilishadi.

en: This curious explanation given, and its soundness immediately recognized, the three friends were soon fast wrapped in the arms of Morpheus.
uz: Bu g'alati tushuntirish berilgan va uning aniqligi darhol tanilgan, uchta do'st tez orada Morfeyning qo'llariga o'girildi.

en: Where in fact could they have found a spot more favorable for undisturbed repose?
uz: Haqiqatan ham, ular o'zlarini tinch saqlash uchun qulayroq joyni qayerdan topishlari mumkin edi?

en: On land, where the dwellings, whether in populous city or lonely country, continually experience every shock that thrills the Earth's crust?
uz: Qirg'oqda, shaharlarda yoki yolg'iz mamlakatlarda yashaydigan uylar Yer korbasini hayajonlantiradigan har bir shokni doimiy ravishda boshdan kechirishi mumkinmi?

en: At sea, where between waves or winds or paddles or screws or machinery, everything is tremor, quiver or jar?
uz: Dengizda, to'lqinlar, shamollar, padellar, shovutlar yoki mashinalar orasidagi hamma narsa titrash, qovurish yoki idish bo'lgan joyda?

en: In the air, where the balloon is incessantly twirling, oscillating, on account of the ever varying strata of different densities, and even occasionally threatening to spill you out?
uz: Havoda, u yerda ballon doimo aylanib boradi, har xil zichliklarning har doim o'zgaruvchan qatlamlari tufayli oscillatsiya qiladi va hatto vaqti-vaqti bilan sizni to'kib yuborish bilan tahdid qiladi?

en: The Projectile alone, floating grandly through the absolute void, in the midst of the profoundest silence, could offer to its inmates the possibility of enjoying slumber the most complete, repose the most profound.
uz: O'zidan-o'zidan, butun bo'shliq ichida, chuqurroq sukut saqlash o'rtasida baland ko'tarilib, o'z mahbuslariga eng to'liq uyqu, eng chuqur dam olish imkoniyatini taqdim etishi mumkin.

en: There is no telling how long our three daring travellers would have continued to enjoy their sleep, if it had not been suddenly terminated by an unexpected noise about seven o'clock in the morning of December ൣnd, eight hours after their departure.
uz: Bizning uchta jasoratli sayohatchilarimiz uyqusidan qancha vaqt zavqlanishini bilmas edilar, agar u dekabr kuni ertalab soat yetti atrofida kutilmagan shovqin bilan to'xtab qolmagan bo'lsa edi.

en: This noise was most decidedly of barking.
uz: Bu shovqin, aniqrog'i, la'natish edi.

en: It's the dogs!" cried Ardan, springing up at a bound.
uz: Bu itlar!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "They must be hungry!" observed the Captain.
uz: "Ular och bo'lishlari kerak!" - dedi kapitan.

en: "We have forgotten the poor creatures!" cried Barbican.
uz: "Biz kambag'al mavjudotlarni unutib qo'ydik!" - deb baqirdi Barbican.

en: "Where can they have gone to?" asked Ardan, looking for them in all directions.
uz: "Ular qayerga borgan bo'lishi mumkin?" - deb so'radi Ardan, ularni har tomonlama izlab.

en: At last they found one of them hiding under the sofa.
uz: Nihoyat, ulardan biri sofaning ostiga yashiringanini topdilar.

en: Thunderstruck and perfectly bewildered by the terrible shock, the poor animal had kept close in its hiding place, never daring to utter a sound, until at last the pangs of hunger had proved too strong even for its fright.
uz: G'azabli shokdan g'alati bo'lib, g'alati hayvonni qo'rqitib qo'ydi, hech qachon ovoz chiqarishga jur'at qilmay, yashirin joyida yashirinib turardi, nihoyat, ochlik og'rig'i qo'rquvga ham yetarlicha kuchli bo'lganini ko'rsatdi.

en: They readily recognized the amiable Diana, but they could not allure the shivering, whining animal from her retreat without a good deal of coaxing.
uz: Ular yoqimli Dianani tezda tan olishdi, lekin ular qo'rqinchli va g'ayratli hayvonni uning to'xtab qolgan joyidan ko'p harakat qilmasdan jalb qila olishmadi.

en: Ardan talked to her in his most honeyed and seductive accents, while trying to pull her out by the neck.
uz: Ardan qizni bo'yniga olib chiqishga uringanida, u bilan o'zining eng yoqimli va yoqimli aksentlari bilan gaplashdi.

en: "Come out to your friends, charming Diana," he went on, "come out, my beauty, destined for a lofty niche in the temple of canine glory!
uz: "Do'stlaringizga, chiroyli Diana, chiqing, go'zalligim, itlar shon-shuhratining ma'badiga yuksak joyga tayinlangan!

en: Come out, worthy scion of a race deemed worthy by the Egyptians to be a companion of the great god, Anubis, by the Christians, to be a friend of the good Saint Roch!
uz: Chiqaring, Misrliklar buyuk xudo Anubisning hamkori bo'lishga, masihiylar tomonidan yaxshi Aziz Rokning do'sti bo'lishga munosib deb hisoblangan irqning munosib nasli!

en: Come out and partake of a glory before which the stars of Montargis and of St.
uz: Montargis va St. Peterning yulduzlari ko'z o'ngida bo'lgan shon-shuhratdan bahramand bo'linglar.

en: Bernard shall henceforward pale their ineffectual fire!
uz: Bundan buyon Bernard ularning samarasiz olovini o'chirib tashlaydi!

en: Come out, my lady, and let me think o'er the countless multiplication of thy species, so that, while sailing through the interplanetary spaces, we may indulge in endless flights of fancy on the number and variety of thy descendants who will ere long render the Selenitic atmosphere vocal with canine ululation!"
uz: Keling, xonim, men sizning turingizning son-sanoqsiz ko'payishi haqida o'ylab ko'ramiz, shunda biz sayyoralararo makonlarda sayohat qilib, ko'p sonli va turli xil avlodlaringizga o'xshaydigan, ko'pdan-ko'p qahramon bo'lib, Selenitik muhitni qushlar o'qishi bilan so'zlab beramiz!"

en: MORE HUNGRY THAN EITHER.
uz: ETHERdan ko'ra ko'proq och.

en: Diana, whether flattered or not, allowed herself to be dragged out, still uttering short, plaintive whines.
uz: Diana, maqtovga sazovor bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi, o'zini tashlab ketishiga yo'l qo'ydi va hali ham qisqa, xafa bo'lgan g'iybatlarni aytdi.

en: A hasty examination satisfying her friends that she was more frightened than hurt and more hungry than either, they continued their search for her companion.
uz: Uning do'stlarini ishontirgan tezkor tekshiruvdan ko'rinib turganidek, u darddan ko'ra ko'proq qo'rqqan va ikkovidan ham ochroq edi, ular hamkorini izlashni davom ettirishdi.

en: Step this way, sir!" cried Ardan.
uz: Bu yo'ldan qadam bosing, xo'jayinim!" deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: But no Satellite appeared and, what was worse, not the slightest sound indicated his presence.
uz: Ammo hech bir satelit paydo bo'lmadi va bundan ham og'irroq bo'lsa-da, uning hozir bo'lishiga hech qanday tovush ham ishora qilmadi.

en: At last he was discovered on a ledge in the upper portion of the Projectile, whither he had been shot by the terrible concussion.
uz: Nihoyat, u "Projektil"ning yuqori qismidagi bo'g'ida topildi, u erda u dahshatli miyaning sarosimi tufayli o'qilgan edi.

en: Less fortunate than his female companion, the poor
uz: Uning ayol hamkori, kambag'allarga qaraganda kamroq omadli.

en: fellow had received a frightful shock and his life was evidently in great danger.
uz: U dahshatli shokni boshdan kechirgan edi va uning hayoti katta xavf ostida edi.

en: "The acclimatization project looks shaky!" cried Ardan, handing the animal very carefully and tenderly to the others.
uz: "Aklimatizatsiya loyihasi salqin ko'rinadi!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, hayvonni boshqalarga juda ehtiyotkorlik va mehribonlik bilan topshirdi.

en: Poor Satellite's head had been crushed against the roof, but, though recovery seemed hopeless, they laid the body on a soft cushion, and soon had the satisfaction of hearing it give vent to a slight sigh.
uz: Zavqsiz Satelitning boshi toshga cho'mgan edi, ammo sog'ayish umidsiz ko'rinsa-da, ular jasadni yumshak yastakka qo'yishdi va tez orada u biroz nafas olish uchun nafas oladiganini eshitish mamnuniyatini keltirdi.

en: "Good!" said Ardan, "while there's life there's hope.
uz: - Yaxshi! - dedi Ardan, - hayot bo'lsa, umid ham bor.

en: You must not die yet, old boy.
uz: Siz hali o'lmasligingiz kerak, keksa.

en: We know our duty and shall not shirk the responsibility.
uz: Biz o'z burchimizni bilamiz va mas'uliyatdan qochmaymiz.

en: I should rather lose the right arm off my body than be the cause of your death, poor Satellite!
uz: Sening o'limingga sabab bo'lishdan ko'ra, o'ng qo'limni o'zimdan yo'qotib yuborishni afzal ko'raman, kambag'al Satelit!

en: Try a little water?" The suffering creature swallowed the cool draught with evident avidity, then sunk into a deep slumber.
uz: Bir oz suvni sinab ko'ringlarmi?" - deb so'ragan azob chekkan mavjudot sovuq suvni ochiqchasiga ochko'zlik bilan yutib yubordi, so'ngra chuqur uyquga tushdi.

en: The friends, sitting around and having nothing more to do, looked out of the window and began once more to watch the Earth and the Moon with great attention.
uz: Do'stlar o'tirgan va boshqa hech narsa qilmaydigan bo'lib, darchaga qarab, yana bir bor Yer va Oyga diqqat bilan qarashni boshlashdi.

en: The glittering crescent of the Earth was evidently narrower than it had been the preceding evening, but its volume was still enormous when compared to the Lunar crescent, which was now rapidly assuming the proportions of a perfect circle.
uz: Yerning parcha-parcha yarim oylari o'tgan kechaga qaraganda ozroq edi, ammo o'sha oy oy oy oylari bilan taqqoslaganda, uning hajmi hali ham katta edi, chunki u hozirda mukammal to'plamning o'lchamlarini tezda o'z ichiga oladi.

en: "By Jove," suddenly exclaimed Ardan, "why didn't we start at the moment of Full Earth?—that is when our globe and the Sun were in opposition?" "Why should we!" growled M'Nicholl.
uz: "Jove bilan", - dedi Ardan to'satdan, "nima uchun biz to'liq Yer paydo bo'lgan paytda boshlanmadik?Shuningdek, sayyoramiz va Quyosh bir-biriga qarshi turgan paytda?" - deb o'yladi M'Nicholl.

en: "Because in that case we should be now looking at the great continents and the great seas in a new light—the former glittering under the solar rays, the latter darker and somewhat shaded, as we see them on certain maps.
uz: Chunki shunday bo'lsa, biz hozir buyuk qit'alar va dengizlarni yangi yorug'lik bilan ko'rib turishimiz kerak, avvalgilar quyosh nurlari ostida shishlaydi, oxirgilar esa ba'zi xaritalarda ko'rib turganimizdek, qorong'u va biroz soyalashgan.

en: How I should like to get a glimpse at those poles of the Earth, on which the eye of man has never yet lighted!" "True," replied Barbican, "but if the Earth had been Full, the Moon would have been New, that is to say, invisible to us on account of solar irradiation.
uz: Inson ko'zi hali yorug' bo'lmagan Yerning o'sha qirg'oqlarini ko'rishni juda xohlayman! - dedi Barbican. - Haqiqatan ham shunday, lekin agar Yer to'liq bo'lganida, oy yangi bo'lardi, ya'ni quyosh sug'orishi tufayli biz uchun ko'rinmas bo'lardi.

en: Of the two it is much preferable to be able to keep the point of arrival in view rather than the point of departure." "You're right, Barbican," observed the Captain; "besides, once we're in the Moon, the long Lunar night will give us plenty of time to gaze our full at yonder great celestial body, our former home, and still swarming with our fellow beings."
uz: Ikkovidan chiqish nuqtasi emas, kelish nuqtasi ko'rinishda bo'lishi afzalroqdir". "Siz haqsiz, Barbican", - dedi kapitan; "Bundan tashqari, oyga yetib borganimizda, uzoq oy kechasi bizga katta osmon jismimizga, sobiq uyimizga ko'z tikish uchun ko'p vaqt beradi va hali ham o'z jonzodlarimiz bilan to'lib-toshgan".

en: "Our fellow beings no longer, dear boy!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Bizning sheriklarimiz endi yo'q, aziz o'g'lim!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "We inhabit a new world peopled by ourselves alone, the Projectile!
uz: "Biz faqat o'zimiz bilan yashaydigan yangi dunyoda yashayapmiz, bu - Projectile!

en: Ardan is Barbican's fellow being, and Barbican M'Nicholl's.
uz: Ardan Barbicanning hamkori va Barbican M'Nichollning hamkori.

en: Beyond us, outside us, humanity ends, and we are now the only inhabitants of this microcosm, and so we shall continue till the moment when we become Selenites pure and simple." "Which shall be in about eighty-eight hours from now," replied the Captain.
uz: Bizdan tashqarida insoniyat yo'q bo'lib ketadi va biz hozir bu mikrokosmosning yagona aholisi bo'lib qoldik va shu tarzda biz pok va oddiy selenitlarga aylanadigan paytgacha davom etamiz". - Bu hozirdan taxminan sakson sakkiz soat ichida bo'ladi, - dedi kapitan.

en: "Which is as much as to say—?" asked Ardan.
uz: "Qanday so'z aytish mumkin?" deb so'radi Ardan.

en: "That it is half past eight," replied M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl javob berdi: "Shuningdek, soat sakkiz yarim o'tib ketdi.

en: "My regular hour for breakfast," exclaimed Ardan, "and I don't see the shadow of a reason for changing it now." The proposition was most acceptable, especially to the Captain, who frequently boasted that, whether on land or water, on mountain summits or in the depths of mines, he had never missed a meal in all his life.
uz: Ardan: "Buraqchaga o'zimning odatdagi soatim bor va hozir uni o'zgartirish uchun sababni ko'rmayapman", - deb aytdi. "Bu taklif eng maqbul edi, ayniqsa kapitan, u ko'pincha quruqlikda yoki suvda, tog'larning tepaliklarida yoki konlarning chuqurliklarida hech qachon ovqatni o'z hayotida yo'qotganini maqtanardi.

en: In escaping from the Earth, our travellers felt that they had by no means escaped from the laws of humanity, and their stomachs now called on them lustily to fill the aching void.
uz: Bizning sayohatchilarimiz Yerdan qochib ketish orqali insoniyat qonunlaridan hech qachon qochib ketmaganlarini his qilishdi va ularning qorinlari endi og'ir bo'shliqni to'ldirish uchun ularni o'ziga jalb qildi.

en: Ardan, as a Frenchman, claimed the post of chief cook, an important office, but his companions yielded it with alacrity.
uz: Ardan frantsuzlik bilan bosh oshpaz lavozimini egalladi, bu muhim lavozim edi, ammo uning hamkorlari bu lavozimga g'ayrat bilan rozi bo'lishdi.

en: The gas furnished the requisite heat, and the provision chest supplied the materials for their first repast.
uz: Gaz kerakli issiqlikni taqdim etdi va ta'minot qutisi ularning birinchi ovqatlanish uchun materiallarni taqdim etdi.

en: They commenced with three plates of excellent soup, extracted from Liebig's precious tablets, prepared from the best beef that ever roamed over the Pampas.
uz: Ular Liebigning qimmatbaho tabletkalaridan olingan uchta taom ajoyib shov-shuv bilan boshlandilar, bular Pampaslar tepaligidagi eng yaxshi go'shtdan tayyorlangan edi.

en: To this succeeded several tenderloin beefsteaks, which, though reduced to a small bulk by the hydraulic engines of the American Dessicating Company, were pronounced to be fully as tender, juicy and savory as if they had just left the gridiron of a London Club House.
uz: Buning o'rniga bir nechta tenderloyn go'sht-steaklar paydo bo'ldi, ular Amerikan Desikating kompaniyasining gidralik dvigatellari tomonidan kichik hajmga kamaytirilgan bo'lsa-da, Londondagi klub uyining gridironidan chiqqanidek, butunlayin tender, shomli va mazali deb e'lon qilindi.

en: Ardan even swore that they were "bleeding," and the others were too busy to contradict him.
uz: Ardan hatto ular "to'kib ketayotganini" va qolganlari unga qarshi chiqish uchun juda mashg'ul bo'lganini aytdi.

en: Preserved vegetables of various kinds, "fresher than nature," according to Ardan, gave an agreeable variety to the entertainment, and these were followed by several cups of magnificent tea, unanimously allowed to be the best they had ever tasted.
uz: Ardanning so'zlariga ko'ra, turli xil sabzavotlarni saqlab qolish, "tabiodan ko'ra yangi", o'yin-kulg'iga yoqimli turini ato etdi va bundan keyin bir necha qadah ajoyib choy, ular bir ovozda tanlagan eng yaxshi narsa bo'lishiga ruxsat berdi.

en: It was an odoriferous young hyson gathered that very year, and presented to the Emperor of Russia by the famous rebel chief Yakub Kushbegi, and of which Alexander had expressed himself as very happy in
uz: Bu o'sha yili to'plangan va mashhur isyonchi boshchi Yakub Kushbegi tomonidan Rossiya imperatoriga taqdim etilgan xushbo'y yosh hyson edi va uning haqida Aleksandr o'zini juda xursand deb aytgan edi.

en: being able to send a few boxes to his friend, the distinguished President of the Baltimore Gun Club.
uz: U o'z do'stiga, Baltimor quroli klubining hurmatli prezidentiga bir nechta qutilarni yuborishga qodir bo'ldi.

en: To crown the meal, Ardan unearthed an exquisite bottle of Chambertin, and, in glasses sparkling with the richest juice of the Cote d'or, the travellers drank to the speedy union of the Earth and her satellite.
uz: Ovqatni to'ldirish uchun Ardan chiroyli bir shisha Chambertinni kashf etdi va sayohatchilar Cote d'orning eng boy jufti bilan chiroyli shishalarda Yer va uning satelitining tezkor ittifoqiga ichdilar.

en: And, as if his work among the generous vineyards of Burgundy had not been enough to show his interest in the matter, even the Sun wished to join the party.
uz: Borgundiya buyuk uzumzorlari o'rtasida qilgan ishi unga qiziqish ko'rsatishga yetarli emasdek, hatto Quyosh ham partiyaga qo'shilish istagini bildirdi.

en: Precisely at this moment, the Projectile beginning to leave the conical shadow cast by the Earth, the rays of the glorious King of Day struck its lower surface, not obliquely, but perpendicularly, on account of the slight obliquity of the Moon's orbit with that of the Earth.
uz: Aynan shu paytda, o'g'il Yer tomonidan o'tkazilgan shkafli soyani tark etishni boshlagan, kunning ulug'vor Shohi nurlari oy orbitalarining Yer orbitalariga nisbatan kichik bo'shligi tufayli uning pastki yuzasini o'tkir emas, balki ustun bo'ylab urdi.

en: TO THE UNION OF THE EARTH AND HER SATELLITE.
uz: Yer va uning uydonining ittifoqiga.

en: "The Sun," cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: " Quyosh, - deb baqirdi.

en: "Of course," said Barbican, looking at his watch, "he's exactly up to time." "How is it that we see him only through the bottom light of our Projectile?" asked Ardan.
uz: - Albatta, - dedi Barbican, soatlariga qarab, - u to'g'ri vaqtga to'g'ri keladi. - Qanday qilib biz uni faqat o'z projektilimizning pastki yorug'ligi orqali ko'ramiz? - deb so'radi Ardan.

en: "A moment's reflection must tell you," replied Barbican, "that when we started last night, the Sun was almost directly below us; therefore, as we continue to move in a straight line, he must still be in our rear."
uz: "Bir daqiqalik tafakkur sizga aytishi kerak", deb javob berdi Barbican, "biz o'tgan kecha boshlaganimizda Quyosh deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bizdan pastda edi; shuning uchun biz to'g'ri yo'nalishda harakatlanishda davom etayotganimizda, u hali ham ortimizda bo'lishi kerak".

en: "That's clear enough," said the Captain, "but another consideration, I'm free to say, rather perplexes me.
uz: "Bu juda aniq", dedi kapitan, "lekin yana bir fikr, aytishga haqim bor, meni hayratda qoldiradi.

en: Since our Earth lies between us and the Sun, why don't we see the sunlight forming a great ring around the globe, in other words, instead of the full Sun that we plainly see there below, why do we not witness an annular eclipse?" "Your cool, clear head has not yet quite recovered from the shock, my dear Captain;" replied Barbican, with a smile.
uz: Yerimiz biz bilan Quyosh o'rtasida joylashgan bo'lgani uchun, nega quyosh nuri dunyoning atrofida katta do'zaxni shakllantirganini ko'rmaymiz, ya'ni, quyoshning to'liq ko'rinishi o'rniga, nega biz quyoshni to'ldirish bilan ko'rishmaymiz?" - deb so'radi.

en: "For two reasons we can't see the ring eclipse: on account of the angle the Moon's orbit makes with the Earth, the three bodies are not at present in a direct line; we, therefore, see the Sun a little to the west of the earth; secondly, even if they were exactly in a straight line, we should still be far from the point whence an annular eclipse would be visible." "That's true," said Ardan; "the cone of the Earth's shadow must extend far beyond the Moon." "Nearly four times as far," said Barbican; "still, as the Moon's orbit and the Earth's do not lie in exactly the same plane, a Lunar eclipse can occur only when the nodes coincide with the period of the Full Moon, which is generally twice, never more than three times in a year.
uz: "Bizda ikkita sababga ko'ra tuproq tutilishini ko'rishning imkoni yo'q: oyning orbitalari Yer bilan bo'lgan burchak tufayli, uchta jism hozirda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'nalishda emas; shuning uchun biz Quyoshni yerning g'arbida biroz ko'rishimiz mumkin; ikkinchidan, ular to'g'ri yo'nalishda bo'lsa ham, biz hali ham yuzalik tutilish ko'rinadigan nuqtadan uzoq bo'lishimiz kerak. "Bu to'g'ri, - dedi Ardan; "Yerning soyasi koni oydan uzoqroq bo'lishi kerak. "Barbican dedi: "Hatto to'rt barobar uzoqroq", - "Hatto, oyning orbitalari va Yerning orbitalari to'g'ri bir tekislikda bo'lmaganligi sababli, oy tutilishi faqat to'liq oy davri bilan bog'liq bo'lganda sodir bo'lishi mumkin, bu odatda, hech qachon, yiliga ikki marta ko'proq bo'lmaydi.

en: If we had started about four days before the occurrence of a Lunar eclipse, we should travel all the time in the dark.
uz: Agar biz oy tutulishidan taxminan to'rt kun oldin sayohatni boshlagan bo'lsak, doimo qorong'ilikda sayohat qilishimiz kerak edi.

en: This would have been obnoxious for many reasons." "One, for instance?" "An evident one is that, though at the present moment we are moving through a vacuum, our Projectile, steeped in the solar rays, revels in their light and heat.
uz: Bu ko'plab sabablarga ko'ra jirkanch bo'lgan bo'lardi". "Birida, masalan?" "Agar hozirgi paytda biz boshoqqa o'tib ketayotgan bo'lsak-da, quyosh nurlariga cho'mgan bizning proyektilimiz ularning yorug'ligi va issiqligidan zavqlanadi.

en: Hence great saving in gas, an important point in our household economy." In effect, the solar rays, tempered by no genial medium like our atmosphere, soon began to glare and glow with such intensity, that the Projectile under their influence, felt like suddenly passing from winter to summer.
uz: Shuning uchun gazda katta tejash, bu bizning uyimiz iqtisodiyotida muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi". Aslida, quyosh nurlari, atmosfera kabi ajoyib vosita bilan o'zgartirilgan holda, tez orada shunday kuch bilan parlashdiki, ularning ta'siri ostida bo'lgan "Projektil" qishdan yozga birdan o'tib ketayotgandek tuyulardi.

en: Between the Moon overhead and the Sun beneath it was actually inundated with fiery rays.
uz: Oy boshidan ostiga quyosh pastga o'tirganidan keyin, u, aslida, olovli nurlar bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: "One feels good here," cried the Captain, rubbing his hands.
uz: "Bu yerda o'zingizni yaxshi his etasiz", - dedi kapitan qo'llarini silkitib.

en: "A little too good," cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Biroz juda yaxshi", - deb baqirdi.

en: "It's already like a hot-house.
uz: "Bu allaqachon issiqxona kabi.

en: With a little garden clay, I could raise you a splendid crop of peas in twenty-four hours.
uz: Kichik bog'dagi loy bilan sizga yigirma to'rt soat ichida ajoyib ertak hosilini o'stiraman.

en: I hope in heaven the walls of our Projectile won't melt like wax!"
uz: Umid qilamanki, osmonda bizning "Projektil" devorlarimiz shamol kabi erib ketmaydi!"

en: "Don't be alarmed, dear friend," observed Barbican, quietly.
uz: "Qiziqmasang, aziz do'stim", - dedi Barbican, xotirjamlik bilan.

en: "The Projectile has seen the worst as far as heat is concerned; when tearing through the atmosphere, she endured a temperature with which what she is liable to at present stands no comparison.
uz: "Projektil issiqlik jihatidan eng yomon holatni ko'rdi; atmosfera orqali yirtilganida, u hozirgi vaqtda o'z kuchiga ega bo'lgan har qanday issiqlikni ko'rgan.

en: In fact, I should not be astonished if, in the eyes of our friends at Stony Hill, it had resembled for a moment or two a red-hot meteor." "Poor Marston must have looked on us as roasted alive!" observed Ardan.
uz: Darhaqiqat, Stony Hilldagi do'stlarimizning ko'z o'ngida bir-ikki daqiqa qizil meteoritga o'xshasa, hayron bo'lmasdim", - deb aytdi Ardan.

en: "What could have saved us I'm sure I can't tell," replied Barbican.
uz: "Bizni nima qutqarishi mumkin edi, demayman", deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "I must acknowledge that against such a danger, I had made no provision whatever." "I knew all about it," said the Captain, "and on the strength of it, I had laid my fifth wager." "Probably," laughed Ardan, "there was not time enough to get grilled in: I have heard of men who dipped their fingers into molten iron with impunity." Whilst Ardan and the Captain were arguing the point, Barbican began busying himself in making everything as comfortable as if, instead of a four days' journey, one of four years was contemplated.
uz: "Men bunday xavf-xatarga qarshi hech qanday chora ko'rmaganimni e'tirof etishim kerak", - dedi kapitan. "Men bu haqda hamma narsani bilardim va shu sababdan beshinchi bahamni qo'ydim. "Ehtimol", - dedi Ardan kulish bilan, "o'zimni ishontirish uchun yetarlicha vaqt bo'lmagandi: men barmoqlarini jazo chekmasdan eritilgan temirga cho'zgan odamlarni eshitganman". Ardan va kapitan bu haqda bahslashayotganda, Barbican hamma narsani qulay qilib ko'rish bilan band bo'ldi, xuddi to'rt kunlik sayohat o'rniga to'rt yillik sayohat o'yishi haqida o'ylagandek.

en: The reader, no doubt, remembers that the floor of the Projectile contained about ൦ൡ square feet; that the chamber was nine feet high; that space was economized as much as possible, nothing but the most absolute necessities being admitted, of which each was kept strictly in its own place; therefore, the travellers had room enough to move around in with a certain liberty.
uz: O'quvchi, shubhasiz, o'ylaydiki, o'g'ilning tuprog'i taxminan  kvadrat futni o'z ichiga olgan edi; xonaning balandligi to'qqiz futni tashkil etgan edi; o'sha joy iloji boricha ko'proq tejaydigan bo'lgan, faqat eng mutlaq zaruriy narsalar qabul qilingan, ularning har biri o'z joyida qat'iy saqlangan edi; shuning uchun sayohatchilar muayyan erkinlik bilan harakatlanish uchun etarlicha joyga ega edilar.

en: The thick glass window in the floor was quite as solid as any other part of it; but the Sun, streaming in from below, lit up the Projectile strangely, producing some very singular and startling effects of light appearing to come in by the wrong way.
uz: Yerdagi qalin shisha darcha uning boshqa qismlari kabi mustahkam edi; lekin quyosh pastdan oqib, Projectile-ni g'alati tarzda yoritdi va noto'g'ri yo'ldan kirib kelayotgan ko'rinadigan nurning ba'zi bir noyob va dahshatli ta'sirlarini keltirdi.

en: The first thing now to be done was to see after the water cask and the provision chest.
uz: Endi birinchi bo'lib suv qadoqasi va ta'minot quti ko'rish kerak edi.

en: They were not injured in the slightest respect, thanks to the means taken to counteract the shock.
uz: Shokga qarshi kurashish uchun qo'llaniladigan choralar tufayli ular hech qanday zarar ko'rmadilar.

en: The provisions were in good condition, and abundant enough to supply the travellers for a whole year—Barbican having taken care to be on the safe side, in case the Projectile might land in a deserted region of the Moon.
uz: Tovarlar yaxshi holatda edi va butun yil davomida sayohatchilarni ta'minlashga etarlicha ko'p ediBarbican o'zining xavfsiz tomonida bo'lishiga g'amxo'rlik qildi, ehtimol o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi oyning cho'loq hududida tushib qolishi mumkin.

en: As for the water and the other liquors, the travellers had enough only for two months.
uz: Suv va boshqa spirtli ichimliklar haqida gap ketganda, sayohatchilar faqat ikki oyga yetarli edi.

en: Relying on the latest observations of
uz: ning so'nggi kuzatishlariga asoslanib

en: astronomers, they had convinced themselves that the Moon's atmosphere, being heavy, dense and thick in the deep valleys, springs and streams of water could hardly fail to show themselves there.
uz: Astronomlar o'zlarini o'zlari o'ylashgan ediki, oyning atmosfera, chuqur vodiylar, buloqlar va suv oqimlarida og'ir, zich va qalin bo'lgani uchun, o'zini ko'rsatishga imkon yaratadi.

en: During the journey, therefore, and for the first year of their installation on the Lunar continent, the daring travellers would be pretty safe from all danger of hunger or thirst.
uz: Shuning uchun sayohat davomida va oy qit'asida o'rnatilgan birinchi yil davomida jasoratli sayohatchilar ochlik yoki chanqoqlikning barcha xavf-xatarlaridan juda xavfsiz bo'lishadi.

en: The air supply proved also to be quite satisfactory.
uz: Havo ta'minoti ham qoniqarli bo'ldi.

en: The Reiset and Regnault apparatus for producing oxygen contained a supply of chlorate of potash sufficient for two months.
uz: Reiset va Regnaultning kislorod ishlab chiqarish apparati ikki oy davomida etarli miqdorda potash xlorati bilan ta'minlangan.

en: As the productive material had to be maintained at a temperature of between ൨ and ൩ hundred degrees Fahr., a steady consumption of gas was required; but here too the supply far exceeded the demand.
uz: Ishlab chiqarish materialini  va  yuz darajadagi haroratda saqlash kerak bo'lgani uchun, gaz iste'moli doimiy bo'lishi kerak edi; lekin bu erda ham taklif talabdan ancha oshdi.

en: The whole arrangement worked charmingly, requiring only an odd glance now and then.
uz: Butun tuzatish chiroyli ishladi, vaqti-vaqti bilan faqat o'ziga xos ko'rinishga ega bo'lish kerak edi.

en: The high temperature changing the chlorate into a chloride, the oxygen was disengaged gradually but abundantly, every eighteen pounds of chlorate of potash, furnishing the seven pounds of oxygen necessary for the daily consumption of the inmates of the Projectile.
uz: Yuqori harorat xloratni xloridga aylantirganida, kislorod asta-sekin, lekin ko'p miqdorda, har sakkiz kilogramm potash xlorati bilan bo'shatildi, bu esa "Projektil" mahbuslarining kundalik iste'moli uchun zarur bo'lgan yetti kilogramm kislorodni ta'minladi.

en: Still—as the reader need hardly be reminded—it was not sufficient to renew the exhausted oxygen; the complete purification of the air required the absorption of the carbonic acid, exhaled from the lungs.
uz: Biroq, o'quvchiga eslatishga hojat yo'q, chunki bu o'tkirlangan kislorodni yangilash uchun etarli emas edi; havo to'liq tozalash uchun o'pkalardan chiqariladigan karbonik kislotani o'z ichiga olish kerak edi.

en: For nearly ൢൣ hours the atmosphere had been gradually becoming more and more charged with this deleterious gas, produced from the combustion of the blood by the inspired oxygen.
uz: Taxminan  soat davomida atmosfera asta-sekin ilhomlantirilgan kislorod bilan qonni yonishdan hosil bo'lgan bu zararli gaz bilan tobora ko'proq to'ldirilgan edi.

en: The Captain soon saw this, by noticing with what difficulty Diana was panting.
uz: Kapten buni tezda ko'rib, Diananing qanchalik og'ir nafas olganini payqadi.

en: She even appeared to be smothering, for the carbonic acid—as in the famous Grotto del Cane on the banks of Lake Agnano, near Naples —was collecting like water on the floor of the Projectile, on account of its great specific gravity.
uz: U hatto o'zini qo'zg'atadigan ko'rinardi, chunki Navol yaqinidagi Agnano ko'li qirg'og'ida joylashgan mashhur Grotol Cane-dagi karbonik kislotasi o'zining katta maxsus gravitatsiyasi tufayli Projectile-ning ustunida suv kabi to'planayotgan edi.

en: It already threatened the poor dog's life, though not yet endangering that of her masters.
uz: Bu ham kambag'al itning hayotiga tahdid solgan, ammo hali xo'jayinlarining hayotiga xavf solmagan.

en: The Captain, seeing this state of things, hastily laid on the floor one or two cups containing caustic potash and water, and stirred the mixture gently: this substance, having a powerful affinity for carbonic acid, greedily absorbed it, and after a few moments the air was completely purified.
uz: Kapten bu holatni ko'rib, darhol yonma-yo'q bir yoki ikkita kostik potash va suvli kostik qadahni yerga tashladi va aralashtirishni muloyimlik bilan aralashtirdi: karbonik kislotasiga kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatadigan bu modda ochko'zlik bilan uni o'ziga jalb qildi va bir necha daqiqadan so'ng havo to'liq tozalashdi.

en: The others had begun by this time to check off the state of the instruments.
uz: Boshqalar esa shu vaqtgacha asbob-uskunalarning holatini tekshirishni boshlashdi.

en: The thermometer and the barometer were all right, except one self-recorder of which the glass had got broken.
uz: Termometr va barometr yaxshi edi, faqat bitta o'z-o'zidan yozib oluvchi bor edi, uning shishalari buzilgan edi.

en: excellent aneroid barometer, taken safe and sound out of its wadded box, was carefully hung on a hook in the wall.
uz: Yaxshi aneroid barometr, uning qo'ldan tutib olingan, devorga qo'yilgan ho'lga ehtiyotkorlik bilan asilgan.

en: It marked not only the pressure of the air in the Projectile, but also the quantity of the watery vapor that it contained.
uz: U nafaqat "Projektil"dagi havo bosimini, balki udagi suv bug'ining miqdorini ham belgilab qo'ydi.

en: The needle, oscillating a little beyond thirty, pointed pretty steadily at "Fair." The mariner's compasses were also found to be quite free from injury.
uz: O'ttizdan biroz pastga oscillatsiya qiladigan igna "Fair" ga nisbatan qat'iy ravishda ko'rsatilgan. "Marinerning kompaslari ham jarohatdan beparvo bo'lganligi aniqlandi.

en: It is, of course, hardly necessary to say that the needles pointed in no particular direction, the magnetic pole of the Earth being unable at such a distance to exercise any appreciable influence on them.
uz: Albatta, ignalar hech qanday aniq yo'nalishda ko'rsatilmaganligini aytish shart emas, chunki Yerning magnit qutblari bunday masofada ularga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishga qodir emas.

en: But when brought to the Moon, it was expected that these compasses, once more subjected to the influence of the current, would attest certain phenomena.
uz: Ammo oyga olib borilganda, ushbu kompaslar bir marta ham oqim ta'siri ostida bo'lganida, ba'zi hodisalarni tasdiqlaydi deb kutishardi.

en: In any case, it would be interesting to verify if the Earth and her satellite were similarly affected by the magnetic forces.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, Yer va uning uydoni magnit kuchlari tomonidan o'xshash ta'sirga duchor bo'lganmi yoki yo'qmi, uni tekshirish qiziqarli bo'ladi.

en: A hypsometer, or instrument for ascertaining the heights of the Lunar mountains by the barometric pressure under which water boils, a sextant to measure the altitude of the Sun, a theodolite for taking horizontal or vertical angles, telescopes, of indispensable necessity when the travellers should approach the Moon,—all these instruments, carefully examined, were found to be still in perfect working order, notwithstanding the violence of the terrible shock at the start.
uz: Hypsometr yoki oy tog'larining balandligini suv qaynayotgan barometrik bosim bilan aniqlash vositasi, Quyoshning balandligini o'lchash uchun sextant, safarchilar oyga yaqinlashganda kerakli bo'lgan gorizontal yoki vertikal burchaklarni olish uchun teodolit, teleskoplar, bu vositalarning barchasi diqqat bilan tekshirilganida, boshlanishdagi dahshatli shokning zo'ravonligiga qaramay, mukammal holatda ekanligi aniqlandi.

en: As to the picks, spades, and other tools that had been carefully selected by the Captain; also the bags of various kinds of grain and the bundles of various kinds of shrubs, which Ardan expected to transplant to the Lunar plains—they were all still safe in their places around the upper corners of the Projectile.
uz: Kapten tomonidan ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlangan piklar, spedlar va boshqa vositalar haqida gap ketganda, shuningdek, Ardan o'z rejalarida O'n oylik dengizga o'stirmoqchi bo'lgan har xil don va turli daraxtlar to'plamlari haqida gap ketganda, ularning barchasi o'z o'rinlarida saqlanib qolishgan.

en: Some other articles were also up there which evidently possessed great interest for the Frenchman.
uz: Bu yerda fransuzlar uchun katta qiziqish uyg'otgan boshqa maqolalar ham bor edi.

en: What they were nobody else seemed to know, and he seemed to be in no hurry to tell.
uz: Ular nimadan iboratligini boshqa hech kim bilmagan va u aytishga shoshilmagan.

en: Every now and then, he would climb up, by means of iron pins fixed in the wall, to inspect his treasures; whatever they were, he arranged them and rearranged them with evident pleasure, and as he rapidly passed a careful hand through certain mysterious boxes, he joyfully sang in the falsest possible of false voices the lively piece from Nicolo: Le temps est beau, la route est belle, La promenade est un plaisir.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan u o'z xazinalarini tekshirish uchun devorga o'rnatilgan temir cho'g'lar yordamida o'tadi; nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u ularni joylashtirdi va ko'rinadigan zavq bilan qayta joylashtirdi va ba'zi sirli qutilarni tezda ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'tkazganida, u quvonch ila Nicoloning hayajonli qismini soxta ovozlardan eng soxta tarzda kuylardi: Le temps est beau, la route est belle, La promenade est un plaisir.

en: The day is bright, our hearts are light.
uz: Kun yorqin, yuraklarimiz yorqin.

en: How sweet to rove through wood and dell.
uz: O'simlik va o'simlik orqali sayohat qilish juda yoqimli.

en: or the well known air in Mignon: Legères hirondelles, Oiseaux bénis de Dieu, Ouvrez-ouvrez vos ailes, Envolez-vous!
uz: yoki Mignonning yaxshi ma'lum havolari: Light hirondelles, God's Blessing Birds, Ouvrez-open your wings, Envoyez-vous!

en: Farewell, happy Swallows, farewell!
uz: Xo'sh, baxtli qovushlar, xayr!

en: With summer for ever to dwell Ye leave our northern strand For the genial southern land Balmy with breezes bland.
uz: Yozgi vaqt abadiy bo'lib qolishi bilan siz shimoliy sohilni tark etasiz.

en: Barbican was much gratified to find that his rockets and other fireworks had not received the least injury.
uz: Barbican o'zining raketalari va boshqa yong'in-yo'qotlaridan hech qanday zarar ko'rmaganini bilib, juda mamnun edi.

en: He relied upon them for the performance of a very important service as soon as the Projectile, having passed the point of neutral attraction between the Earth and the Moon, would begin to fall with accelerated velocity towards the Lunar surface.
uz: U ular bilan juda muhim xizmatni bajarishga umidvor bo'lgan, chunki o'sha o'tmishda Yer va Oy o'rtasidagi neytral jo'natuv nuqtasini o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lsa, o'sha o'tmishda o'sha o'tmishda oy yuziga qarab tezroq tushishni boshlaydi.

en: This descent, though—thanks to the respective volumes of the attracting bodies—six times less rapid than it would have been on the surface of the Earth, would still be violent enough to dash the Projectile into a thousand pieces.
uz: Bu tushish, agar Yer yuzida bo'lganidan olti baravar kamroq bo'lgan jozibador jismlarning o'z hajmlari tufayli sodir bo'lsa-da, bir mingta qismlarga bo'lib chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada dahshatli bo'ladi.

en: But Barbican confidently expected by means of his powerful rockets to offer very considerable obstruction to the violence of this fall, if not to counteract its terrible effects altogether.
uz: Ammo Barbican o'zining kuchli raketalari yordamida bu kuzdagi zo'ravonlikka juda katta to'sqinlik qilishini, agar uning dahshatli ta'sirlariga to'liq qarshilik ko'rsatmasligini ishonch bilan kutgan.

en: The inspection having thus given general satisfaction, the travellers once more set themselves to watching external space through the lights in the sides and the floor of the Projectile.
uz: Shunday qilib, inspeksiyadan umumiy mamnuniyat topgan sayyohlar yana bir bor o'zlarining tashqi ko'rinishlarini Projectilning yon va yonidagi chiroqlar orqali ko'rib chiqish uchun harakat qilishdi.

en: Everything still appeared to be in the same state as before.
uz: Hamma narsa hali ham avvalgidek edi.

en: Nothing was changed.
uz: Hech narsa o'zgarmagan.

en: The vast arch of the celestial dome glittered with stars, and constellations blazed with a light clear and pure enough to throw an astronomer into an ecstasy of admiration.
uz: Osmondagi qumboqning yirik arxi yulduzlar bilan parlashar edi, yulduzlar yulduzlar bilan parlashar edi, ular yulduzlarning yorug'ligi juda aniq va sof bo'lib, astronomni hayratda qoldirardi.

en: Below them shone the Sun, like the mouth of a white-hot furnace, his dazzling disc defined sharply on the pitch-black back-ground of the sky.
uz: Ulardan pastida quyosh oq issiq pechning og'zidagi singari porlab turardi, uning chiroyli disklari osmonning qora fonida keskin aniqlangan edi.

en: Above them the Moon, reflecting back his rays from her glowing surface, appeared to stand motionless in the midst of the starry host.
uz: Ularning ustida o'zining parcha-parcha nurlarini o'z surasidan aks ettirgan oy yulduzli uy egasining o'rtasida harakatsiz turganidek ko'rindi.

en: A little to the east of the Sun, they could see a pretty large dark spot, like a hole in the sky, the broad silver fringe on one edge fading off into a faint glimmering mist on the other—it was the Earth.
uz: Quyoshdan biroz sharqda, ular osmondagi tosh kabi juda katta qorong'i nuqta ko'rishardi, bir chegaradagi keng kumush bo'lak boshqa chegaradagi yomg'irga aylanib ketardi.Bu Yer edi.

en: Here and there in all directions, nebulous masses gleamed like large flakes of star dust, in which, from nadir to zenith, the eye could trace without a break that vast ring of impalpable star powder, the famous Milky Way, through the midst of which the beams of our glorious Sun struggle with the dusky pallor of a star of only the fourth magnitude.
uz: Bu yerda va u yerda har xil yo'nalishlarda bulutli to'plamlar yulduz tuproqining yirik bo'laklari kabi parvarish qilib turgan edi, unda nadirdan zenitgacha ko'z o'sha yulduz tuprog'idan iborat ulkan anjomni, mashhur Sovuq yo'lini, uning o'rtasida bizning ulug'vor Quyoshimiz nurlari faqat to'rtinchi magnituddagi yulduzning qorong'i bo'lakligi bilan kurashadi.

en: Our observers were never weary of gazing on this magnificent and novel spectacle, of the grandeur of which, it is hardly necessary to say, no description can give an adequate idea.
uz: Bizning kuzatuvchilari ushbu ajoyib va yangilikdagi ko'rgazmani ko'rishdan hech qachon charchamaydilar, uning ulug'vorligi haqida hech qanday tasvir yetarlicha tasavvurga ega emasligini aytish qiyin.

en: What profound reflections it suggested to their understandings!
uz: Bu ularning tushunchalariga qanchalik chuqur mulohazalarni taklif qildi!

en: What vivid emotions it enkindled in their imaginations!
uz: Bu ularning tasavvurlarida qanday hayajonli tuyg'ularni uyg'otdi!

en: Barbican, desirous of commenting the story of the journey while still influenced by these inspiring impressions, noted carefully hour by hour every fact that signalized the beginning of his enterprise.
uz: Ushbu ilhomlantiruvchi taassurotlardan ta'sirlanib, sayohat hikoyasini izohlashga tayyor bo'lgan Barbican o'z ishini boshlagan har bir faktni soat sayin diqqat bilan qayd etdi.

en: He wrote out his notes very carefully and systematically, his round full hand, as business-like as ever, never betraying the slightest emotion.
uz: U o'z yozuvlarini juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan va muntazam ravishda yozgan, o'zining to'liq qo'li bilan, har doimgidek biznes kabi, hech qachon eng kichik his-tuyg'ularga xiyonat qilmagan.

en: The Captain was quite as busy, but in a different way.
uz: Kapten ham xuddi shunday mashg'ul edi, lekin boshqacha tarzda.

en: Pulling out his tablets, he reviewed his calculations regarding the motion of projectiles, their velocities, ranges and paths, their retardations and their accelerations, jotting down the figures with a rapidity wonderful to behold.
uz: O'zining tabletkalarini olib chiqib, u o'z hisob-kitoblarini o'rganib chiqdi: o'qlarning harakatlanishi, ularning tezliklari, masofasi va yo'nalishlari, ularning orqaga surilishi va tezlanishlari, raqamlarni ajoyib tezlikda qayd etdi.

en: Ardan neither wrote nor calculated, but kept up an incessant fire of small talk, now with Barbican, who hardly ever answered him, now with M'Nicholl, who never heard him, occasionally with Diana, who never understood him, but oftenest with himself, because, as he said, he liked not only to talk to a sensible man but also to hear what a sensible man had to say.
uz: Ardan hech qachon yozmadi yoki hisoblamadi, lekin o'zidan-o'zidan suhbatlashishni davom ettirdi, hozir Barbican bilan, u hech qachon javob bermagan, endi M'Nicholl bilan, u hech qachon tinglamagan, vaqti-vaqti bilan Diana bilan, u hech qachon uni tushunmagan, lekin ko'pincha o'zi bilan, chunki u nafaqat aqlli odam bilan gaplashishni, balki aqlli odamning aytadigan gaplarini eshitishni yaxshi ko'rgan.

en: He never stood still for a moment, but kept "bobbing around" with the effervescent briskness of a bee, at one time roosting at the top of the ladder, at another peering through the floor light, now to the right, then to the left, always humming scraps from the Opera Bouffe, but never changing the air.
uz: U hech qachon bir daqiqa ham to'xtab turmagan, balki bir paytlar eshikning yuqori tomoniga o'tirib, boshqa paytlarda yer yorug'ligini ko'rib, endi o'ng tomonga, keyin chap tomonga o'tirib, Opera Bouffe-ning qoldiqlarini doimo qichqirib, hech qachon havo o'zgartirmagan.

en: In the small space which was then a whole world to the travellers, he represented to the life the animation and loquacity of the French, and I need hardly say he played his part to perfection.
uz: O'sha paytda sayohatchilar uchun butun dunyo bo'lgan kichik joyda u frantsuzlarning jonliligi va gapirishchanligini hayotga ifoda etgan va u o'z rolini mukammal o'ynaganini aytishim kerak emas.

en: The eventful day, or, to speak more correctly, the space of twelve hours which with us forms a day, ended for our travellers with an abundant supper, exquisitely cooked.
uz: O'yin-kulg'i bo'lgan kun yoki, to'g'riroq aytganda, biz uchun kunni tashkil etuvchi o'n ikki soatlik vaqt, sayohatchilarimiz uchun juda mo'l-ko'l kechki ovqat bilan yakunlandi.

en: It was highly enjoyed.
uz: Bu juda zavqlandi.

en: No incident had yet occurred of a nature calculated to shake their confidence.
uz: Ularning ishonchini silkitish uchun hisoblangan hech qanday hodisa hali sodir bo'lmagan.

en: Apprehending none therefore, full of hope rather and already certain of success, they were soon lost in a peaceful slumber, whilst the Projectile, moving rapidly, though with a velocity uniformly retarding, still cleaved its way through the pathless regions of the empyrean.
uz: Shuning uchun hech kimni ko'rmay, umidga to'la va muvaffaqiyatga erishish to'g'risida shubhalanmay, ular tez orada tinch uyqusida yo'qolishdi, Projectile esa tez harakatlanayotgan bo'lsa-da, tezligi bir-biridan pasayib borayotgan bo'lsa-da, empireanning yo'lsiz mintaqalari orqali o'z yo'lini kesib o'tdi.

en: A CHAPTER FOR THE CORNELL GIRLS.
uz: Kornel qizlar uchun bob.

en: No incident worth recording occurred during the night, if night indeed it could be called.
uz: Kechasi hech qanday voqea qayd etilishiga arziydigan emas, agar uni kechasi deb atash mumkin bo'lsa.

en: In reality there was now no night or even day in the Projectile, or rather, strictly speaking, it was always night on the upper end of the bullet, and always day on the lower.
uz: Aslida, "Projektil"da kecha yoki hatto kun ham bo'lmagan, aksincha, to'g'ri aytganda, qorong'inning yuqori tomoniga har doim kechasi, past tomoniga esa har doim kunduz bo'lgan.

en: Whenever, therefore, the words night and day occur in our story, the reader will readily understand them as referring to those spaces of time that are so called in our Earthly almanacs, and were so measured by the travellers' chronometers.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar bizning hikoyamizda kechayu kunduz so'zlari paydo bo'lsa, o'quvchi ularni bizning Yerdagi almanaqlarimizda shunday nomlangan va sayohatchilarning xronometrlari bilan o'lchanadigan vaqt maydonlariga ishora qilayotgan deb tushunadi.

en: The repose of our friends must indeed have been undisturbed, if absolute freedom from sound or jar of any kind could secure tranquillity.
uz: Do'stlarimizning dam olishi, agar biron bir tovush yoki qadoqdan mutlaqo xalos bo'lish tinchlikni ta'minlasa, albatta, to'xtatilmagan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: In spite of its immense velocity, the Projectile still seemed to be perfectly motionless.
uz: O'zining ulkan tezligiga qaramay, Projectile hali ham harakatsiz ko'rinardi.

en: Not the slightest sign of movement could be detected.
uz: Hech qanday harakatlanish belgisi ham aniqlanmagan.

en: Change of locality, though ever so rapid, can never reveal itself to our senses when it takes place in a vacuum, or when the enveloping atmosphere travels at the same rate as the moving body.
uz: Mahalliy o'zgarish juda tez bo'lsa-da, bu hech qachon bo'shliqda sodir bo'lganda yoki atrof muhit harakatlanayotgan jism bilan bir xil tezlikda harakatlanayotganda, hissiyotlarimizga ayon bo'lmaydi.

en: Though we are incessantly whirled around the Sun at the rate of about seventy thousand miles an hour, which of us is conscious of the slightest motion?
uz: Garchi biz Quyosh atrofida soatga yetmish ming kilometr tezlikda aylanayotgan bo'lsak-da, qaysi birimiz eng kam harakatni sezyapmiz?

en: In such a case, as far as sensation is concerned, motion and repose are absolutely identical.
uz: Bunday holatda, his-tuyg'ularga ko'ra, harakat va dam olish mutlaqo bir xil.

en: Neither has any effect one way or another on a material body.
uz: Har ikkalasi ham moddiy tanaga bir yo'l yoki boshqa tarzda ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi.

en: Is such a body in motion?
uz: Bunday jism harakatlanadimi?

en: It remains in motion until some obstacle stops it.
uz: U biron bir to'siq uni to'xtatmaguncha harakatda qoladi.

en: It remains at rest until some superior force compels it to
uz: U o'zini tinch tutadi, hatto yuqori kuch uni o'z kuchini yo'qotib qo'yguncha.

en: change its position.
uz: pozitsiyasini o'zgartirish.

en: This indifference of bodies to motion or rest is what physicists call inertia.
uz: Jismlarning harakatga yoki dam olishga nisbatan befarqligi fizikachilar inertiya deb ataydigan.

en: Barbican and his companions, therefore, shut up in the Projectile, could readily imagine themselves to be completely motionless.
uz: Shuning uchun, Barbican va uning sheriklari "Projectila"da o'tirib, o'zlarini butunlay harakatsiz deb tasavvur qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: Had they been outside, the effect would have been precisely the same.
uz: Agar ular tashqarida bo'lganlarida, ta'sir aynan shunday bo'lardi.

en: No rush of air, no jarring sensation would betray the slightest movement.
uz: Hech qanday havo shov-shuvlari, hech qanday tiklangan his-tuyg'ular eng kichik harakatga ham xiyonat qilmaydi.

en: But for the sight of the Moon gradually growing larger above them, and of the Earth gradually growing smaller beneath them, they could safely swear that they were fast anchored in an ocean of deathlike immobility.
uz: Ammo ular ustida o'sib borayotgan oyni va ularning ostidan o'sib borayotgan Yerni ko'rish uchun ular o'limga o'xshaydigan harakatsizlik okeanida tezda quvib qolganlariga qasam ichishlari mumkin edi.

en: Towards the morning of next day (December ൤), they were awakened by a joyful, but quite unexpected sound.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab (dekabr) ular xursandchilik bilan uyg'onib, ammo kutilmagan ovoz bilan uyg'onishdi.

en: doo!" accompanied by a decided flapping of wings.
uz: !" deb qo'shib qo'ydilar.

en: The Frenchman, on his feet in one instant and on the top of the ladder in another, attempted to shut the lid of a half open box, speaking in an angry but suppressed voice: "Stop this hullabaloo, won't you?
uz: Fransiyalik kishi bir lahzada oyoqlari bilan to'xtab, yana bir lahzada sinfning yuqori qismida bo'lib, yarim ochilgan quti qopqog'ini yopishga harakat qildi va g'azablangan, ammo kamsitilgan ovoz bilan gapirdi: "Buni to'xtating, shunday emasmi?

en: Do you want me to fail in my great combination!" "Hello?" cried Barbican and M'Nicholl, starting up and rubbing their eyes.
uz: Siz mening ajoyib kombinatsiyamda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashishimni xohlaysizmi?" - deb baqirdi Barbican va M'Nicholl, boshlash va ko'zlarini silkitish bilan boshlashdi.

en: "What noise was that?" asked Barbican.
uz: - Bu qanday shovqin edi? - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: "Seems to me I heard the crowing of a cock," observed the Captain.
uz: "Menga o'xshaydi, men qichqining qichqirishini eshitdim", - dedi kapitan.

en: "I never thought your ears could be so easily deceived, Captain," cried Ardan, quickly, "Let us try it again," and, flapping his ribs with his arms, he gave vent to a crow so loud and natural that the lustiest chanticleer that ever saluted the orb of day might be proud of it.
uz: "Quloqlaringiz shu qadar oson aldanib ketishini hech qachon o'ylamagan edim, kapitan", - deb xitob qildi Ardan, tezda: "Biz yana sinab ko'raylik", - dedi va qo'llarini qo'llari bilan qo'rg'oqlariga urib, qo'rg'onga shunchalik baland va tabiiy nafas berdiki, kun orbasiga salom bergan eng yoqimli qo'shiqchi bunga faxrlanishi mumkin.

en: The Captain roared right out, and even Barbican snickered, but as they saw that their companion evidently wanted to conceal something, they immediately assumed straight faces and pretended to think no more about the matter.
uz: Kapten darhol qichqirib yubordi va hatto Barbican ham g'alati gaplarni aytdi, lekin ular o'z sheriklari biror narsani yashirmoqchi ekanini ko'rishganida, ular darhol to'g'ri yuz tutishdi va bu haqda boshqa o'ylamasdek ko'rinishdi.

en: "Barbican," said Ardan, coming down the ladder and evidently anxious to change the conversation, "have you any idea of what I was thinking about all night?" "Not the slightest."
uz: "Barbican", dedi Ardan, ustidan pastga tushib, suhbatni o'zgartirishni xohlagan holda, "man butun kecha nima haqida o'ylayotganimni bilasizmi?"

en: "I was thinking of the promptness of the reply you received last year from the authorities of Cambridge University, when you asked them about the feasibility of sending a bullet to the Moon.
uz: "Men o'tgan yili Kembridj universiteti hokimiyatidan oyga o'q yuborish mumkinligi haqida so'raganingizda, sizga berilgan javobning tezligi haqida o'yladim.

en: You know very well by this time what a perfect ignoramus I am in Mathematics.
uz: Bu vaqtga kelib siz matematikada men qanday mukammal jaholatsiz ekanimni yaxshi bilasiz.

en: I own I have been often puzzled when thinking on what grounds they could form such a positive opinion, in a case where I am certain that the calculation must be an exceedingly delicate matter." "The feasibility, you mean to say," replied Barbican, "not exactly of sending a bullet to the Moon, but of sending it to the neutral point between the Earth and the Moon, which lies at about nine-tenths of the journey, where the two attractions counteract each other.
uz: Men o'zimni tez-tez o'ylagandimki, ular qanday asoslar bilan bunday ijobiy fikrni shakllantirishlari mumkin, chunki hisob-kitob juda murakkab masala bo'lishi kerakligiga aminman". "Siz aytmoqchi bo'lgan narsa - aynan oyga o'q yuborish emas, balki Yer va oy o'rtasidagi neytral nuqtaga yuborish mumkinligi, bu yo'lning taxminan to'qqizdan to'qqiz qismi bo'lib, ikki jozibadorlik bir-biriga qarshilik ko'rsatadi.

en: Because that point once passed, the Projectile would reach the Moon's surface by virtue of its own weight." en: Therefore, I maintain that if our Projectile had struck that bolide, its velocity, suddenly checked, would have given rise to a heat capable of completely volatilizing it in less than a second." "Not a doubt of it!" said the Captain.

en: "President," he added after a moment, "haven't they calculated what would be the result, if the Earth were suddenly brought to a stand-still in her journey, through her orbit?" "It has been calculated," answered Barbican, "that in such a case so much heat would be developed as would instantly reduce her to vapor."
uz: "Prezident, - dedi u bir zumdan so'ng qo'shimcha qilib, - agar Yer uning orbitasi orqali sayohatini to'xtatib qo'ysa, natijasi qanday bo'lishini hisoblab chiqmaganmidilar?" - Barbican javob berdi, - hisoblab chiqilganidek, bunday holatda juda ko'p issiqlik paydo bo'ladi va uni bir zumda bug'ga aylantiradi".

en: "Hm!" exclaimed Ardan; "a remarkably simple way for putting an end to the world!" "And supposing the Earth to fall into the Sun?" asked the Captain.
uz: "Hm!" - dedi Ardan, "dunyoga chek qo'yishning juda sodda usuli!" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "Such a fall," answered Barbican, "according to the calculations of Tyndall and Thomson, would develop an amount of heat equal to that produced by sixteen hundred globes of burning coal, each globe equal in size to the earth itself.
uz: "Ushbu kabi tushib ketish, - deb javob berdi Barbican, - Tyndall va Thomson hisob-kitoblariga ko'ra, o'n olti yuzta ko'mir ko'rgichning issiqligi bilan teng miqdorda issiqlik hosil qiladi, har bir ko'rgichning o'lchami Yerning o'ziga teng.

en: Furthermore such a fall would supply the Sun with at least as much heat as he expends in a hundred years!" "A hundred years!

uz: Tyndall va Thomson Men ular o'zlariga bergan har qanday havo uchun osonlikcha uzr bera olaman.

en: "That is precisely what they have done," answered Barbican referring to his memorandum book; "the heat emitted by the Sun," he continued, "is exactly that which would be produced by the combustion of a layer of coal enveloping the Sun's surface, like an atmosphere, ൢ൨ miles in thickness." "How fortunate to have such a handy thing as an atmosphere around us," cried the Frenchman; "it not only enables us to breathe, but it actually keeps us from sizzling up like griskins." en: "By Jove!" he exclaimed at length; "it must be pretty hot up there!" "I should think so," observed the Captain; "especially when you remember that the day up there lasts ൤൧ൡ hours!" "Yes," observed Barbican, "but remember on the other hand that the nights are just as long, and, as the heat escapes by radiation, the mean temperature cannot be much greater than that of interplanetary space." "A high old place for living in!" cried Ardan.

uz: O'sha paytda biz har bir chiziq, yorug'lik va soya quyoshga yaqinlashib borgan sari, darajaga qarab yo'qolib ketayotganini ko'rishimiz kerak edi, hatto nihoyat u o'zining chiroyli nurlarida butunlay yo'qolganini ko'rishimiz kerak edi!

en: But —by the way—Barbican, are there any eclipses in the Moon?" "O yes; solar eclipses" replied Barbican, "must always occur whenever the centres of the three heavenly bodies are in the same line, the Earth occupying the middle place.
uz: Lekin, xolos, Barbican, oyda tutullar bormi?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Ha, ha, quyosh tutullari har doim uchta osmondagi jismning markazlari bir qatorda bo'lganida, Yer o'rta joyda bo'lganida sodir bo'lishi kerak.

en: However, such eclipses must always be annular, as the Earth, projected like a screen on the solar disc, allows more than half of the Sun to be still visible." "How is that?" asked M'Nicholl, "no total eclipses in the Moon?
uz: Biroq, bunday tutulishlar har doim aylanarli bo'lishi kerak, chunki Quyosh diskidagi ekran kabi ko'rinadigan Yer quyoshning yarmidan ko'proq qismini ko'rish imkonini beradi". "Bu qanday?" deb so'radi M'Nicholl, "Ayda to'liq tutulish yo'qmi?

en: Surely the cone of the Earth's shadow must extend far enough to envelop her surface?" "It does reach her, in one sense," replied Barbican, "but it does not in another.
uz: Albatta, Yer soyasining shkaflari uning yuzasini o'rab olish uchun yetarlicha uzoq bo'lishi kerakmi? - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Bu bir ma'noda unga yetadi, ammo boshqa ma'noda yo'q.

en: Remember the great refraction of the solar rays that must be produced by the Earth's atmosphere.
uz: Quyosh nurlarining Yer atmosferasi tomonidan hosil bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan katta buzilishini yodda tuting.

en: It is easy to show that this refraction prevents the Sun from ever being totally invisible.

en: But hang me, if I can endure your Algebra!" "Well then, talking Yankee," replied Barbican with a smile, "the mean distance of the Moon from the Earth being sixty terrestrial radii, the length of the conic shadow, in consequence of atmospheric refraction, is reduced to less than forty-two radii.
uz: Ammo meni asring, agar men sizning algebraga chiday olsam!" - deb javob berdi Barbican tabassum bilan: "Ushbu paytda gapiradigan yanki, oyning Yerdan o'rtacha masofasi oltmish yer radiusida bo'lib, konik soyaning uzunligi atmosferadagi buzilish natijasida qirqdan ikki radiusdan kamroq bo'ladi.

en: Consequently, at the moment of an eclipse, the Moon is far beyond the reach of the real shadow, so that she can see not only the border rays of the Sun, but even those proceeding from his very centre." "Oh then," cried Ardan with a loud laugh, "we have an eclipse of the Sun at the moment when the Sun is quite visible!
uz: Natijada, tutilish paytida oy haqiqiy soyaning qamrovidan uzoqroq, shuning uchun u nafaqat Quyoshning chegara nurlarini, balki o'zining markazidan kelib chiqqanlarini ham ko'radi". "Oh, shunday bo'lsa", - dedi Ardan baland ko'rinishda, "Bizda quyoshning tutilishi quyosh ko'rinadigan paytda sodir bo'ladi!

en: Isn't that very like a bull, Mr.
uz: Bu buqqa o'xshamaydi, shunday emasmi?

en: "Yet it is perfectly true notwithstanding," answered Barbican.
uz: "Shunga qaramay, bu to'liq haq", deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "At such a moment the Sun is not eclipsed, because we can see him: and then again he is eclipsed because we see him only by means of a few of his rays, and even these have lost nearly all their brightness in their passage through the terrestrial atmosphere!" "Barbican is right, friend Michael," observed the Captain slowly: "the same phenomenon occurs on earth every morning at sunrise, when refraction shows us 'the Sun new ris'n Looking through the horizontal misty air, Shorn of his beams.'" "He must be right," said Ardan, who, to do him justice, though quick at seeing a reason, was quicker to acknowledge its justice: "yes, he must be right, because I begin to understand at last very clearly what he really meant.
uz: "O'sha paytda Quyosh tutulmaydi, chunki biz uni ko'rishimiz mumkin: va yana u tutuladi, chunki biz uni faqat bir nechta nurlari orqali ko'ramiz va hatto bu nurlar ham yer atrofidagi atmosfera orqali o'tishda deyarli butun yorug'liklarini yo'qotib qo'ydi!" - deb aytdi kapitan sekinlik bilan: "Barbican to'g'ri, do'stim Maykl, - deb aytdi kapitan. - Yer yuzida har kuni ertalab quyosh chiqish paytida xuddi shu hodisa yuz beradi, chunki refraction bizga "Kosh yangi ko'tarilmoqda, u gorizontal bulutli havo orqali ko'rib, uning soyalarini kesib qo'ydi". "U to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak", dedi Ardan, uni qilish uchun, adolatni ko'rishda tezkor bo'lsa-da, uning adolatini tan olishda tezroq harakat qildi: "Ha, u to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak, chunki men nihoyatda u nimani nazarda tutganini aniq tushunishni boshladim.

en: However, we can judge for ourselves when we get there.—But, apropos of nothing, tell me, Barbican, what do you think of the Moon being an ancient comet, which had come so far within the sphere of the Earth's attraction as to be kept there and turned into a satellite?" "Well, that is an original idea!" said Barbican with a smile.
uz: Biroq, u yerga yetib borganimizda o'zimiz hukm qila olamiz.Agar hech narsa bo'lmasa, ayt, Barbican, oy qadimgi kometa bo'lib, Yerning jozibadorligi sferasiga shunchalik yaqinlashib ketganki, u yerda saqlanib, uydonga aylangan bo'lsa kerak, nima deyish mumkin?" - deb javob berdi Barbican tabassum bilan.

en: "My ideas generally are of that category," observed Ardan with an affectation of dry pomposity.
uz: "O'z fikrlarim odatda o'sha toifadagi", - dedi Ardan quruq pompozitsiya taassurotlari bilan.

en: "Not this time, however, friend Michael," observed M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Bu safar emas, do'stim Maykl", deb aytdi.

en: I'm a plagiarist, am I?" asked the Frenchman, pretending to be irritated.
uz: Men plagiatchi bo'laman, shunday emasmi?" - deb so'radi fransuz, g'azablanayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: "Well, something very like it," observed M'Nicholl quietly.
uz: M'Nicholl xotirjamlik bilan: "Ham, juda o'xshash narsa", - deb ta'kidladi.

en: "Apollonius Rhodius, as I read one evening in the Philadelphia Library, speaks of the Arcadians of Greece having a tradition that their ancestors were so ancient that they inhabited the Earth long before the Moon had ever become our satellite.
uz: "Apollonius Rodius, men Filadelfiya kutubxonasida bir kecha o'qiganimda, Gretsiyaning Arkadiyaliklarining odati borligi haqida gapiradi, ularning ata-bobolari juda qadimiy bo'lib, ular oy bizning satelitimiz bo'lishidan ancha oldin Yerda istiqomat qilishgan.

en: They therefore called them Προσεληνοι or Ante-lunarians.
uz: Shuning uchun ular ularni "Proselunarlar" yoki "Ante-lunarlar" deb atashgan.

en: Now starting with some such wild notion as this, certain scientists have looked on the Moon as an ancient comet brought close enough to the Earth to be retained in its orbit by terrestrial attraction." "Why may not there be something plausible in such a hypothesis?" asked Ardan with some curiosity.
uz: Hozirgi paytda ba'zi olimlar o'zlarining bunday g'ayritabiiy fikrlaridan boshlab, oyni Yerga yetarlicha yaqinlashtirgan qadimgi kometa sifatida ko'rib chiqishdi". "Nima uchun bunday xaloyiqda biron-bir mantiqiy narsa bo'lmasligi mumkin?" - deb savol berdi Ardan qiziquvchanlik bilan.

en: "There is nothing whatever in it," replied Barbican decidedly: "a simple proof is the fact that the Moon does not retain the slightest trace of the vaporous envelope by which comets are always surrounded." "Lost her tail you mean," said Ardan.
uz: "Unda hech narsa yo'q", - dedi Barbican qat'iy javob berdi: "Asl dalil shundaki, oy kometalarning doimo atrofida bo'lgan bug'li qadoqning eng kichik izini saqlab qolmaydi.

en: Easy to account for that!
uz: Buni tushunish oson!

uz: U quyoshga juda yaqinlashib, kesilgan bo'lishi mumkin!" - "U shunday bo'lishi mumkin, do'stim Maykl, lekin bunday yo'l bilan amputatsiya bo'lishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas". - "Yo'q?

en: Why not?" "Because—because—By Jove, I can't say, because I don't know," cried Barbican with a quiet smile on his countenance.
uz: Nima uchun yo'q?" - "Nima uchun? - deb aytolmayman, chunki bilmayman", - deb aytdi Barbican yuzida tinch tabassum bilan.

en: "Oh what a lot of volumes," cried Ardan, "could be made out of what we don't know!" "At present, for instance," observed M'Nicholl, "I don't know what o'clock it is." "Three o'clock!" said Barbican, glancing at his chronometer.
uz: "Oh, qanday ko'p hajmlar", - deb baqirdi Ardan, "biz bilmagan narsalardan tayyorlanishi mumkin!" "Mustakki, hozirda", dedi M'Nicholl, "men soatni bilmayman". "Uch soat!" - dedi Barbican, xronometriga nazar tashlab.

en: "No!" cried Ardan in surprise.
uz: "Yo'q!" - dedi Ardan hayratda.

en: How rapidly the time passes when we are engaged in scientific conversation!
uz: Ilmiy suhbatda ishtirok etayotganimizda vaqt qanchalik tez o'tishi mumkin!

en: I'm getting decidedly too learned!
uz: Men juda ko'p o'rganganman!

en: I feel as if I had swallowed a library!" "I feel," observed M'Nicholl, "as if I had been listening to a lecture on Astronomy in the Star course." "Better stir around a little more," said the Frenchman; "fatigue of body is the best antidote to such severe mental labor as ours.
uz: Men o'zimni kutubxonani yutib yuborganimdek his qilaman!" - dedi M'Nicholl. - O'zimni xuddi Yulduz kursida astronomiya mavzusida o'qigan bo'lsam kerak, deb o'ylayman. - Biroz ko'proq harakatlansa yaxshi bo'lardi, - dedi frantsuz. - Tanadagi charchaganlik bizning kabi og'ir ongimizdagi mehnatga eng yaxshi antidot hisoblanadi.

en: Ardan was coming down the ladder, when his whistling was cut short by a sudden exclamation of surprise.
uz: Ardan daraxtdan tushayotganda, uning pishirishini to'satdan hayratda qolgan bir ovoz kesib qo'ydi.

en: "What's the matter?" asked Barbican quickly, as he looked up and saw the Frenchman pointing to something outside the Projectile.
uz: "Nima bo'ldi?" - deb tezda so'radi Barbican, ko'zlarini ko'tarib, frantsuzli Projectile tashqaridagi narsaga ko'rsatayotganini ko'rdi.

en: Approaching the window, Barbican saw with much surprise a sort of flattened bag floating in space and only a few yards off.
uz: Oynaga yaqinlashganda, Barbican juda hayratda bo'lib, ko'chada uchib borayotgan bir turdagi to'shakni ko'rdi.

en: It seemed perfectly motionless, and, consequently, the travellers knew that it must be animated by the same ascensional movement as themselves.
uz: U juda harakatsiz ko'rinardi va shuning uchun sayohatchilar uning o'zlari kabi yuksak ko'tarilish harakatlari bilan harakatlanishini bilishardi.

en: "What on earth can such a consarn be, Barbican?" asked Ardan, who every now and then liked to ventilate his stock of American slang.
uz: Ardan, vaqti-vaqti bilan amerikalik slangning o'z zaxirasini tozalashni yaxshi ko'rgan kishi: "Bu qanday odam bo'lishi mumkin, Barbican?" - deb so'radi.

en: "Is it one of those particles of meteoric matter you were speaking of just now, caught within the sphere of our Projectile's attraction and accompanying us to the Moon?" "What I am surprised at," observed the Captain, "is that though the specific gravity of that body is far inferior to that of our Projectile, it moves with exactly the same velocity." "Captain," said Barbican, after a moment's reflection, "I know no more what that object is than you do, but I can understand very well why it keeps abreast with the Projectile." "Very well then, why?" "Because, my dear Captain, we are moving through a vacuum, and because all bodies fall or move—the same thing—with equal velocity through a vacuum, no matter what may be their shape or their specific gravity.
uz: "Bu siz hali gapirgan meteorik moddalarning bir qismi bo'ladimi, u bizni o'z projektilimizning jozibadorligi sferasida ushlab, oyga yetaklaydi?" - deb so'radi kapitan. "Mening hayron bo'lishim shundaki, bu jismning aniq gravitatsiyasi bizning projektilimizdan ancha past bo'lsa-da, u xuddi shu tezlikda harakatlanadi". "Kapitan, - dedi Barbican, bir daqiqa mulohaza o'tkazganidan so'ng, - men bu jism nima ekanligini sizdan ham ko'ra bilmayman, lekin u nega o'zi bilan birga bo'lganini yaxshi tushunaman.

en: It is the air alone that makes a difference of weight.
uz: Faqatgina havo og'irlikni farq qiladi.

en: Produce an artificial vacuum in a glass tube and you will see that all objects whatever falling through, whether bits of feather or grains of shot, move with precisely the same rapidity.
uz: Shisha quvurida sun'iy vakum hosil qiling va siz barcha ob'ektlar, ularning ichidan tushib ketayotganlari, xoh parchalar, xoh cho'g'lar, aynan bir xil tezlikda harakatlanishini ko'rasiz.

en: Up here, in space, like cause and like effect." "Correct," assented M'Nicholl.
uz: Bu yerda, kosmosda, sabab va ta'sir kabi". - M'Nicholl: "To'g'ri", deb rozi bo'ldi.

en: "Everything therefore that we shall throw out of the Projectile is bound to accompany us to the Moon." "Well, we were smart!" cried Ardan suddenly.
uz: "Shunday qilib, biz o'tkazib yuboradigan har bir narsa bizni oyga hamroh qiladi". - "Biz aqlli bo'ldik!" - deb qichqirdi Ardan to'satdan.

en: "How so, friend Michael?" asked Barbican.
uz: - Qanday qilib, do'stim Maykl? - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: "Why not have packed the Projectile with ever so many useful objects, books, instruments, tools, et cetera, and fling them out into space once we were fairly started!
uz: "Nima uchun Projektilni shuncha foydali ashyolar, kitoblar, asbob-uskunalar, asbob-uskunalar va hokazolar bilan to'plab, o'zimizni ishga tushirganimizdan so'ng koinotga tashlamagan edik?

en: They would have all followed us safely!
uz: Ular hammasi bizni xavfsiz kuzatib borgan bo'lar edi!

en: Nothing would have been lost!
uz: Hech narsa yo'qolmagan bo'lardi!

en: And—now I think on it—why not fling ourselves out through the window?
uz: Va endi men bu haqda o'ylayman nima uchun o'zimizni darcha orqali tashlamaymiz?

en: Shouldn't we be as safe out there as that bolide?
uz: Biz o'sha bolid kabi xavfsiz bo'lishimiz kerak emasmi?

en: What fun it would be to feel ourselves sustained and upborne in the ether, more highly favored even than the birds, who must keep on flapping their wings continually to prevent themselves from falling!" "Very true, my dear boy," observed Barbican; "but how could we breathe?" "It's a fact," exclaimed the Frenchman.
uz: O'zimizni etyerda qo'llab-quvvatlangan va ko'tarilgan his qilish qanchalik qiziqarli bo'lardi, hatto qushlardan ham ko'ra ko'proq afzal, ular o'zlarini tushib ketmaslik uchun qanotlarini to'xtatib turishlari kerak edi! "Chindan ham to'g'ri, aziz o'g'lim", dedi Barbican; "lekin qanday qilib nafas olishimiz mumkin?" - deb aytdi fransuz.

en: "Hang the air for spoiling our fun!
uz: "O'yin-kulgimizni buzganingiz uchun havoga tashlang!

en: So we must remain shut up in our Projectile?"
uz: Shunday qilib, biz o'z "Projectilimiz"da yopiq qolishimiz kerakmi?"

en: "Not a doubt of it!" —"Oh Thunder!" roared Ardan, suddenly striking his forehead.
uz: "Shubhasiz!" - deb qichqirdi Ardan, to'satdan oldiga urdi.

en: "What ails you?" asked the Captain, somewhat surprised.
uz: "Sizni nima bezovta qilyapti?" - deb so'radi kapitan biroz hayron.

en: "Now I know what that bolide of ours is!
uz: "Hndi men o'zimizning o'yinchiligimizni bilaman!

en: Why didn't we think of it before?
uz: Nima uchun bu haqda ilgari o'ylab ko'rmagan edik?

en: It is no particle of meteoric matter!
uz: Bu meteorik moddalarning hech qanday qismati emas!

en: Nor is it a piece of a shattered planet!" "What is it then?" asked both of his companions in one voice.
uz: U bir-biriga to'g'ri kelmagan sayyora bo'lmagandi!" - deb so'radi uning ikki hamkori bir ovozda.

en: SATELLITE'S BODY FLYING THROUGH SPACE.
uz: SATELITE-ning kosmos orqali uchib borayotgan tanasi.

en: "It is nothing more or less than the body of the dog that we threw out yesterday!"
uz: "Bugun tashlaganimiz itning jasadidan boshqa hech narsa yo'q!"

en: That shapeless, unrecognizable mass, melted, expunged, flat as a bladder under an unexhausted receiver, drained of its air, was poor Satellite's body, flying like a rocket through space, and rising higher and higher in close company with the rapidly ascending Projectile!
uz: O'sha shaklsiz, tan olinmaydigan massasi erib ketgan, o'chirib ketgan, to'liq bo'lmagan qabul qiluvchi ostida cho'g'ay kabi tekis bo'lgan, havoga zarar yetkazgan, bu kambag'al Satelit tanasi edi, kosmos orqali raketa kabi uchib o'tadi va tez ortib borayotgan Projektil bilan yaqin hamkorlikda har doim yuqoriga ko'tarilmoqda!

en: A new phenomenon, therefore, strange but logical, startling but admitting of easy explanation, was now presented to their view, affording a fresh subject for lively discussion.
uz: Shunday qilib, ularning nazarida g'alati, ammo mantiqiy, hayratda qoldiradigan, ammo oson tushuntirishni e'tirof etadigan yangi hodisa paydo bo'ldi, bu esa jonli muhokama uchun yangi mavzu yaratdi.

en: Not that they disputed much about it.
uz: Ular bu haqda ko'p bahslashmagan.

en: They soon agreed on a principle from which they readily deducted the following general law: Every object thrown out of the Projectile should partake of the Projectile's motion: it should therefore follow the same path, and never cease to move until the Projectile itself came to a stand-still.
uz: Tez orada ular bir prinsipga kelishib oldilar, shundan ular quyidagi umumiy qonunni tezda chiqarib olishdi: Yaratuvdan tashlangan har bir ob'ekt Yaratuvchining harakatida ishtirok etishi kerak: shuning uchun u xuddi shu yo'ldan borishi kerak va Yaratuvning o'zi to'xtashga kelmaguncha hech qachon harakatlanishni to'xtatmasligi kerak.

en: But, in sober truth, they were at anything but a loss of subjects of warm discussion.
uz: Ammo, aniq aytganda, ular har qanday narsa bilan shug'ullanishmagan edi.

en: As the end of their journey began to approach, their senses became keener and their sensations vivider.
uz: Ular sayohatining oxiri yaqinlashayotganda, his-tuyg'ularlari yanada o'zgarib, his-tuyg'ularlari yanada jonli bo'ldi.

en: Steeled against surprise, they looked for the unexpected, the strange, the startling; and the only thing at which they would have wondered would be to be five minutes without having something new to wonder at.
uz: O'shanda ular kutilmagan, g'alati, hayratlanarli narsalarni izlashdi va ular faqat besh daqiqa davomida o'ylashlari mumkin bo'lgan narsa - bu yangi narsalarga ega bo'lmaslik edi.

en: Their excited imaginations flew far ahead of the Projectile, whose velocity, by the way, began to be retarded very decidedly by this time, though, of course, the travellers had as yet no means to become aware of it.
uz: Ularning hayajonli tasavvurlari Projectile-dan ancha oldinga uchdi, uning tezligi shu vaqtgacha juda qat'iy ravishda pasayib borishni boshlagan edi, ammo sayohatchilar hali bu haqda o'ylash imkoniyatiga ega emas edilar.

en: The Moon's size on the sky was meantime getting larger and larger; her apparent distance was growing shorter and shorter, until at last they could almost imagine that by putting their hands out they could nearly touch her.
uz: Osmonda oyning o'lchami o'sib borayotgan edi; uning ko'rinishicha masofasi qisqa bo'lib borar edi, nihoyat ular qo'llarini ko'tarib, unga qo'l tegizishlarini tasavvur qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: Next morning, December ൦th, all were up and dressed at a very early hour.
uz: Ertasi kuni, dekabr oyida ertalab hamma o'rnidan turib, kiyingan edi.

en: This was to be the last day of their journey, if all calculations were correct.
uz: Agar barcha hisob-kitoblar to'g'ri bo'lsa, bu ularning sayohatining oxirgi kuni bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: That very night, at ൢൣ o'clock, within nineteen hours at furthest, at the very moment of Full Moon, they were to reach her resplendent surface.
