uz: O'sha kecha, soat o'n to'qqiz soat ichida, to'liq oyni ko'rish paytida ular uning parcha-parcha yuziga yetib kelishdi.

en: At that hour was to be completed the most extraordinary journey ever undertaken by man in ancient or modern times.
uz: O'sha soatda qadimgi yoki zamonaviy davrlarda insoniyat tomonidan yo'lga qo'yilgan eng g'alati sayohat tugashi kerak edi.

en: Naturally enough, therefore, they found themselves unable to sleep after four o'clock in the morning; peering upwards through the windows now visibly glittering under the rays of the Moon, they spent some very exciting hours in gazing at her slowly enlarging disc, and shouting at her with confident and joyful hurrahs.
uz: Shu sababli, ular ertalab soat to'rtdan keyin o'zlarini uxlay olmagan holda ko'rishdi; oy nurlari ostida ko'rinadigan oynalar orqali yuqoriga qarab, ular uning sekin-sekin kenglashib borayotgan diskini ko'rib, unga ishonch va quvonch bilan qichqirib, ba'zi qiziqarli soatlarni o'tkazishdi.

en: The majestic Queen of the Stars had now risen so high in the spangled heavens that she could hardly rise higher.
uz: Yulduzlarning ulug'vor Qirolichasi endi o'z ko'klarida shunchalik yuqoriga ko'tarildiki, u juda yuqoriga ko'tarilishi qiyin edi.

en: In a few degrees more she would reach the exact point of space where her junction with the Projectile was to be effected.
uz: Bir necha daraja o'tib, u o'zidan o'tgan joyga yetib boradi, u erda uning va Projectile o'rtasidagi o'zaro bog'lanish amalga oshiriladi.

en: According to his own observations, Barbican calculated that they should strike her in the northern hemisphere, where her plains, or seas as they are called, are immense, and her mountains are comparatively rare.
uz: Barbican o'z kuzatuvlariga ko'ra, ular uni shimoliy yarim jahon bo'ylab bosib o'tishi kerakligini hisoblagan, chunki uning tekisliklari, yoki dengizlari katta, tog'lari esa kam uchraydigan.

en: This, of course, would be so much the more favorable, if, as was to be apprehended, the lunar atmosphere was confined exclusively to the low lands.
uz: Bu, albatta, agar o'zimiz ko'rganimizdek, oy atmosferasi faqat quyi yerlarga cheklangan bo'lsa, shunchalik qulay bo'lardi.

en: "Besides," as Ardan observed, "a plain is a more suitable landing place than a mountain.
uz: "Bundan tashqari, Ardanning aytishicha, o'rta yer tog'dan ko'ra qulayroq joyiga aylanadi.

en: A Selenite deposited on the top of Mount Everest or even on Mont Blanc, could hardly be considered, in strict language, to have arrived on Earth." "Not to talk," added M'Nicholl, "of the comfort of the thing!
uz: Everest tog'ining yuqori qismida yoki hatto Mont Blanda joylashgan selenit, qat'iy tilda Yerga yetib kelgan deb hisoblanishi mumkin emas.

en: When you land on a plain, there you are.
uz: O'tkir joyga tushganda, u erda bo'lasiz.

en: When you land on a peak or on a steep mountain side, where are you?
uz: Yuqori va baland tog'lar tomonida tushib qolganda, qayerda bo'lasiz?

en: Tumbling over an embankment with the train going forty miles an hour, would be nothing to it." "Therefore, Captain Barbican," cried the Frenchman, "as we should like to appear before the Selenites in full skins, please land us in the snug though unromantic North.
uz: "Shuning uchun, kapitan Barbican", - deb baqirdi frantsuz, "biz Selenitlar oldida to'liq terida ko'rinishni istagan bo'lsak-da, iltimos, bizni yoqimli, garchi romantik bo'lmagan Shimoliy yurtimizga joylashtiring.

en: We shall have time enough to break our necks in the South." Barbican made no reply to his companions, because a new reflection had begun to trouble him, to talk about which would have done no good.
uz: Janubiy mamlakatda bo'lganimizda bo'yinlarimizni sindirish uchun yetarlicha vaqt bo'ladi". - deb aytdi Barbican. - U o'z hamrohlariga javob bermadi, chunki uni yangi bir fikr tashvishga solishni boshladi, bu haqda gapirish hech qanday foyda keltirmagan bo'lardi.

en: There was certainly something wrong.
uz: Shubhasiz, biron narsa noto'g'ri edi.

en: was evidently heading towards the northern hemisphere of the Moon.
uz: O'sha paytda u oyning shimoliy yarim qirrashiga qarab yo'lga tushibdi.

en: What did this prove?
uz: Bu nimani isbotladi?

en: Clearly, a deviation resulting from some cause.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, bu noto'g'ri yo'nalish biror sababdan kelib chiqqan.

en: The bullet, lodged, aimed, and fired with the most careful mathematical precision, had been calculated to reach the very centre of the Moon's disc.
uz: O'z ichiga eng ehtiyotkor matematik aniqlik bilan joylashtirilgan, yo'naltirilgan va o'qilgan qorovul oy diskining o'rtasiga yetishi uchun hisoblangan edi.

en: Clearly it was not going to the centre now.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u endi markazga bormayapti.

en: What could have produced the deviation?
uz: Bu chetlanishni nima keltirib chiqargan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: This Barbican could not tell; nor could he even determine its extent, having no points of sight by which to make his observations.
uz: Ushbu barbican buni ayta olmagan, hatto uning kengligini ham aniqlay olmagan, chunki uning e'tiborini qaratish uchun ko'rinish punktlari yo'q edi.

en: For the present he tried to console himself with the hope that the deviation of the Projectile would be followed by no worse consequence than carrying them towards the northern border of the Moon, where for several reasons it would be comparatively easier to alight.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda u o'zini o'ziga tasalli berishga harakat qilib, o'zidan o'zga hech qanday yomon oqibat yo'q, deb umid qildi. Bu esa ularni oyning shimoliy chegarasiga olib borishdan ko'ra kamroq oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin edi, chunki bir necha sabablarga ko'ra u yerga tushish ancha osonroq bo'ladi.

en: Carefully avoiding, therefore, the use of any expression which might needlessly alarm his companions, he continued to observe the Moon as carefully as he could, hoping every moment to find some grounds for believing that the deviation from the centre was only a slight one.
uz: Shuning uchun u ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'z hamrohlariga ehtiyotkorlik bilan ogohlantiradigan so'zlarni ishlatishdan qochdi va oyni iloji boricha diqqat bilan kuzatishni davom ettirdi, har bir daqiqada uning markazdan o'zgarishining kichik ekaniga ishonish uchun biron-bir asos topishni umid qildi.

en: He almost shuddered at the thought of what would be their situation, if the bullet, missing its aim, should pass the Moon, and plunge into the interplanetary space beyond it.
uz: U deyarli o'z vazifasi qanday bo'lishini o'ylab qo'rqib qolibdi, agar o'z maqsadini yo'qotgan qorovul Oydinni o'tib, uning tashqarisida joylashgan sayyoralararo kosmosga tushib ketsa.

en: As he continued to gaze, the Moon, instead of presenting the usual flatness of her disc, began decidedly to show a surface somewhat convex.
uz: U ko'z o'ngida turganda, oy uning diskining odatdagidek tekisligini ko'rsatmay, biroz egri yuzani aniq ko'rsatishni boshladi.

en: Had the Sun been shining on her obliquely, the shadows would have certainly thrown the great mountains into strong relief.
uz: Agar quyosh uning ustiga o'z-o'zidan nur sochganida edi, soyalar katta tog'larni katta yengillikka tushirgan bo'lardi.

en: The eye could then bury itself deep in the yawning chasms of the craters, and easily follow the cracks, streaks, and ridges which stripe, flecker, and bar the immensity of her plains.
uz: Keyin ko'z o'zini kraterlarning g'iybatli chuqurliklariga chuqur o'rab oladi va o'z o'tkirliklarining ulkanligi bilan bog'liq bo'lgan bo'g'inlar, chiziqlar va shoxlarni osonlikcha kuzatib boradi.

en: But for the present all relief was lost in the dazzling glare.
uz: Ammo hozirgi vaqtda barcha yengillik o'z ko'rinishida yo'qolgan edi.

en: The Captain could hardly distinguish even those dark spots that impart to the full Moon some resemblance to the human face.
uz: Kapten to'liq oyga inson yuziga o'xshashlik beradigan qorong'i nuqtalarni ham farqlab bo'lmaydi.

en: "Face!" cried Ardan: "well, a very fanciful eye may detect a face, though, for the sake of Apollo's beauteous sister, I regret to say, a terribly pockmarked one!" The travellers, now evidently approaching the end of their journey, observed the rapidly increasing world above them with newer and greater curiosity every moment.
uz: Ardan: "Fayz!" - deb baqirdi: "Bola, juda hayajonli ko'z yuzni aniqlashi mumkin, ammo, Afoloning go'zal singlisi uchun, men afsuski, juda ko'p bo'laklangan yuzni aytaman!" - deb aytdi.Sahyorchilar, endi, ko'rinib turganidek, sayohatning oxiriga yaqinlashayotgan edilar, ularning ustidagi tezda o'sib borayotgan dunyoni har bir daqiqada yangi va katta qiziqish bilan kuzatishardi.

en: Their fancies enkindled at the sight of the new and strange scenes dimly presented to their view.
uz: Yangi va g'ayrioddiy ko'rinishlarni ko'rib, ularning xayollari o'zgarib ketdi.

en: In imagination they climbed to the summit of this lofty peak.
uz: Ular tasavvur qilib ko'rishganda, bu yuksak tog'ning cho'qqisiga ko'tarilishdi.

en: themselves down to the abyss of that yawning crater.
uz: Ular o'zlarini o'sha g'alati kraterning chuqurligiga tushirishdi.

en: Here they imagined they saw vast seas hardly kept in their basins by a rarefied atmosphere; there they thought they could trace mighty rivers bearing to vast oceans the tribute of the snowy mountains.
uz: Bu yerda ular keng dengizlarni ko'rishlarini tasavvur qilishdi, chunki bu yerdagi atmosfera oz qolgani uchun ularning hovuzlarida saqlanmagan; u erda ular katta okeanlarga qarli tog'larning hurmatini ko'rsatadigan qudratli daryolarni izlab topishlari mumkin deb o'ylashgan.

en: In the first promptings of their eager curiosity, they peered greedily into her cavernous depths, and almost expected, amidst the deathlike hush of inaudible nature, to surprise some sound from the mystic orb floating up there in eternal silence through a boundless ocean of never ending vacuum.
uz: Ular g'ayratli qiziquvchanliklarining ilk iltijolarida, uning g'or chuqurligiga ochko'zlik bilan qaradilar va deyarli eshitilmaydigan tabiatning o'limli xotirjamligi o'rtasida, cheksiz vakum okeanida abadiy xotirjamlik ichida o'sha yerda suzib turgan mistik orbdan bir tovushni ajablantirishni kutishadi.

en: This last day of their journey left their memories stored with thrilling recollections.
uz: Ularning sayohatining bu oxirgi kuni ularning xotiralarini hayajonli xotiralar bilan saqlab qolgan.

en: They took careful note of the slightest details.
uz: Ular eng kichik tafsilotlarga diqqat bilan e'tibor qaratishgan.

en: As they neared their destination, they felt themselves invaded by a vague, undefined restlessness.
uz: Yo'nalishlariga yaqinlashganda, ular o'zlarini aniqlanmagan, ko'rinmas xavotirga duchor bo'lishganini his qilishdi.

en: But this restlessness would have given way to decided uneasiness, if they had known at what a slow rate they were travelling.
uz: Ammo bu qayg'u, agar ular sayohat qilayotganlarining qanchalik sekinligini bilganlarida, aniq qayg'uga yo'l qo'yishgan bo'lardi.

en: They would have surely concluded that their present velocity would never be able to take them as far as the neutral point, not to talk of passing it.
uz: Ular hozirgi tezligi ularni hech qachon neytral nuqtagacha olib ketolmaydi, deyarli undan o'tish haqida gap ketmas.

en: The reason of such considerable retardation was, that by this time the Projectile had reached such a great distance from the Earth that it had hardly any weight.
uz: Bunday sezilarli kechikishning sababi shundaki, o'sha paytga kelib proyektil Yerdan shunchalik uzoq bo'lganki, u deyarli hech qanday og'irlikka ega bo'lmagan.

en: But even this weight, such as it was, was to be diminished still further, and finally, to vanish altogether as soon as the bullet reached the neutral point, where the two attractions, terrestrial and lunar, should counteract each other with new and surprising effects.
uz: Ammo hatto bu og'irlik ham, shunday bo'lgani kabi, yanada kamayishi va oxir-oqibat, o'qning neytral nuqtaga yetishi bilanoq butunlay yo'qolishi kerak edi, bu yerda ikkita yerdagi va oydagi jozibadorlik bir-biriga yangi va ajablanarli ta'sirlar bilan qarshi turishi kerak edi.

en: Notwithstanding the absorbing nature of his observations, Ardan never forgot to prepare breakfast with his usual punctuality.
uz: O'z ko'rib chiqishlari chiroyli bo'lishiga qaramay, Ardan odatdagidek aniqlik bilan kechki ovqat tayyorlashni hech qachon unutmagan.

en: It was eaten readily and relished heartily.
uz: Bu osonlikcha yeyilgan va ko'ngildan kechirilgan.

en: Nothing could be more exquisite than his calf's foot jelly liquefied and prepared by gas heat, except perhaps his meat biscuits of preserved Texas beef and Southdown mutton.
uz: Hech narsa uning buzoq oyoq jelliga o'xshatilgan va gaz issiqligi bilan tayyorlanganidan ko'ra zo'rroq bo'lishi mumkin emas, balki ehtimol uning Texas go'shti va Southdown qo'zi kabi konservatsiya qilingan go'sht keksalaridan iborat go'sht keksalaridan tashqari.

en: A bottle of Château Yquem and another of Clos de Vougeot, both of superlative excellence in quality and flavor, crowned the repast.
uz: Château Yquem va Clos de Vougeotning shishalari, sifat va taom jihatidan eng zo'rligi bilan ta'minlandi.

en: Their vicinity to the Moon and their incessant glancing at her surface did not prevent the travellers from touching each other's glasses merrily and often.
uz: O'zlarining oyga yaqinligi va uning yuziga to'xtamay nazar tashlashlari sayohatchilarni bir-birlarining ko'zgulariga ko'pincha qo'l urishlariga to'sqinlik qilmadi.

en: Ardan took occasion to remark that the lunar vineyards—if any existed—must be magnificent, considering the intense solar heat they continually experienced.
uz: Ardan o'z navbatida, oydagi uzumzorlar, agar mavjud bo'lsa, ular doimiy ravishda ko'rgan quyoshning kuchli issiqligini hisobga olgan holda ajoyib bo'lishi kerakligini ta'kidladi.

en: Not that he counted on them too confidently, for he told his friends that to provide for the worst he had supplied himself with a few cases of the
uz: U o'zlariga ishonib ishongan emas, chunki u do'stlariga eng yomon holatni bartaraf etish uchun o'ziga bir necha holatni taqdim etganini aytdi.

en: best vintages of Médoc and the Côte d'Or, of which the bottles, then under discussion, might be taken as very favorable specimens.
uz: Médoc va Gold Côtening eng yaxshi o'tlari, shu payt muhokama qilinadigan shishalar juda qulay namunalar sifatida qabul qilinishi mumkin.

en: The Reiset and Regnault apparatus for purifying the air worked splendidly, and maintained the atmosphere in a perfectly sanitary condition.
uz: Havoning tozalash uchun Reiset va Regnault qurilmalari ajoyib ishladi va atmosfera mukammal sanitariya holatida saqlanib qoldi.

en: Not an atom of carbonic acid could resist the caustic potash; and as for the oxygen, according to M'Nicholl's expression, "it was A prime number one!" The small quantity of watery vapor enclosed in the Projectile did no more harm than serving to temper the dryness of the air: many a splendid salon in New York, London, or Paris, and many an auditorium, even of theatre, opera house or Academy of Music, could be considered its inferior in what concerned its hygienic condition.
uz: Karbon kislotasi atomlari ham kastik potashga qarshi tura olmagan; kislorodga kelsak, M'Nichollning so'zlariga ko'ra, "u birinchi birinchi raqam edi!" Projektilda saqlangan kichik miqdordagi suv bug'i havo quruqligini kamaytirishdan ko'ra ko'proq zarar ko'rsatmagan: Nyu-York, London yoki Parijdagi ko'plab ajoyib salonlar va hatto teatr, opera xonasi yoki Musiqa akademiyasi auditoriyasi ham sog'lom holatda kamroq deb hisoblanishi mumkin.

en: To keep it in perfect working order, the apparatus should be carefully attended to.
uz: Uni mukammal holatda saqlab qolish uchun qurilma ehtiyotkorlik bilan ta'minlanishi kerak.

en: This, Ardan looked on as his own peculiar occupation.
uz: Ardan buni o'zining o'ziga xos kasb deb bilgan.

en: He was never tired regulating the tubes, trying the taps, and testing the heat of the gas by the pyrometer.
uz: U quvurlarni tartibga solish, kranlarni sinab ko'rish va gazning issiqligini pirometr orqali sinashdan hech qachon charchamaydi.

en: So far everything had worked satisfactorily, and the travellers, following the example of their friend Marston on a previous occasion, began to get so stout that their own mothers would not know them in another month, should their imprisonment last so long.
uz: Hozircha hamma narsa to'g'ri ishlashi mumkin edi va sayohatchilar o'z do'sti Marstonning o'rnagiga ergashib, o'zlarining onalari ularni bir oy ichida tanib-bilmasligi uchun o'zlarini shunchalik kuchli his qila boshlashdi, agar ularning qamoq jazosi shunchalik uzoq davom etsa.

en: Ardan said they all looked so sleek and thriving that he was reminded forcibly of a nice lot of pigs fattening in a pen for a country fair.
uz: Ardanning aytishicha, ularning barchasi shunchalik chiroyli va gullab-yashgan ko'rinardiki, unga qishloq yarmarkasi uchun maydonda o'tkir bo'lgan juda yaxshi do'stlar haqida o'ylash kerak edi.

en: But how long was this good fortune of theirs going to last?
uz: Ammo ularning bu omadlari qancha davom etadi?

en: Whenever they took their eyes off the Moon, they could not help noticing that they were still attended outside by the spectre of Satellite's corpse and by the other refuse of the Projectile.
uz: Ular oyni ko'zlarini uzganlarida ham, tashqarida hali ham Satelitning jasadi va o'z navbatida, o'zlarining o'zi bilan birga bo'lganidan va o'zlarining o'zi bilan birga bo'lganidan xabardor bo'lishgan.

en: An occasional melancholy howl also attested Diana's recognition of her companion's unhappy fate.
uz: Vaqti-vaqtidagi melanxoly yig'ish, Diana o'z hamkasbining baxtsiz taqdirini tan olishini tasdiqladi.

en: The travellers saw with surprise that these waifs still seemed perfectly motionless in space, and kept their respective distances apart as mathematically as if they had been fastened with nails to a stone wall.
uz: Sayohatchilar bu bevalarning hali ham kosmosda to'liq harakatsiz ko'rinishini hayronlik bilan ko'rishdi va ularning masofasini xuddi tosh devorga to'g'rilab qo'ygani kabi matematik jihatdan ajratib qo'yishdi.

en: "I tell you what, dear boys;" observed Ardan, commenting on this curious phenomenon; "if the concussion had been a little too violent for one of us that night, his survivors would have been seriously embarrassed in trying to get rid of his remains.
uz: "Men sizga nima deyman, aziz bolalar", - dedi Ardan, bu g'alati hodisa haqida so'z yuritib; "agar o'sha kecha birov uchun sarosima juda kuchli bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, uning tirik qolganlari uning qoldiqlaridan qutulishga urinib ko'rishlarida juda hayajonlangan bo'lishardi.

en: With no earth to cover him up, no sea to plunge him into, his corpse would never
uz: Uni qoplaydigan yer yo'q bo'lganda, uni o'ldiradigan dengiz yo'q bo'lganda, uning jasadi hech qachon yo'q bo'lardi.

en: disappear from view, but would pursue us day and night, grim and ghastly like an avenging ghost!" "Ugh!" said the Captain, shuddering at the idea.
uz: ko'rinmasidan yo'q bo'lib, kechayu kunduz bizni kuzatib borardi, qasos oluvchi hayajon kabi qorong'i va qo'rqinchli edi!" - dedi kapitan, bu fikrga qo'rqib.

en: "But, by the bye, Barbican!" cried the Frenchman, dropping the subject with his usual abruptness; "you have forgotten something else!
uz: "Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, Barbican!" - deb baqirdi fransuz, mavzuni odatdagidek tez-tez o'qib qo'ydi; "Siz boshqa narsani unutdingiz!

en: Why didn't you bring a scaphander and an air pump?
uz: Nima uchun o'zingiz bilan "scaphander" va "air pump" olib kelmadingiz?

en: I could then venture out of the Projectile as readily and as safely as the diver leaves his boat and walks about on the bottom of the river!
uz: O'shanda men o'z kemasini tashlab, daryo tubida yuradigan bo'lmish bo'lsak, o'zim ham o'zimni o'zimga o'xshatgan holda va xavfsizlikda "Projectil"dan chiqib ketishim mumkin edi!

en: What fun to float in the midst of that mysterious ether!
uz: O'sha sirli eterning o'rtasida suzish naqadar qiziqarli!

en: to steep myself, aye, actually to revel in the pure rays of the glorious sun!
uz: O'zimni o'z ichiga olish uchun, ha, aslida, ulug'vor quyoshning sof nurlarida zavqlanish uchun!

en: I should have ventured out on the very point of the Projectile, and there I should have danced and postured and kicked and bobbed and capered in a style that Taglioni never dreamed of!" "Shouldn't I like to see you!" cried the Captain grimly, smiling at the idea.
uz: Men o'zimni "Projectil"ning o'zida ko'tarishim kerak edi va u erda men raqs qilib, ko'rinish ko'rsatib, urib, Taglioni hech qachon orzu qilmagan tarzda o'ynashim kerak edi! "Men sizni ko'rishni yoqtirmas edim!" - deb qo'shib qo'ydi kapitan, bu g'oyaga tabassum qilib.

en: "You would not see him long!" observed Barbican quietly.
uz: "Siz uni ko'rish uchun uzoq vaqt kutmaysiz!" - dedi Barbican xotirjamlik bilan.

en: "The air confined in his body, freed from external pressure, would burst him like a shell, or like a balloon that suddenly rises to too great a height in the air!
uz: Uning tanasidagi havo, tashqi bosimdan ozod bo'lib, uni shell kabi, yoki havoda to'satdan juda baland balandlikka ko'tarilgan ballon kabi buzadi!

en: A scaphander would have been a fatal gift.
uz: Skaphander o'z navbatida halokatli sovg'a bo'lgan.

en: Don't regret its absence, friend Michael; never forget this axiom: As long as we are floating in empty space, the only spot where safety is possible is inside the Projectile!" The words "possible" and "impossible" always grated on Ardan's ears.
uz: Uning yo'qligidan afsuslanma, do'stim Maykl; hech qachon bu axiomni unutma: biz bo'sh joyda suzayotgan ekanmiz, xavfsizlikning iloji bor yagona joyi - Projectile ichida!" - degan so'zlar Ardanning quloqlarida "mukofot" va "mukofot" degan so'zlar doim qichqirib turardi.

en: If he had been a lexicographer, he would have rigidly excluded them from his dictionary, both as meaningless and useless.
uz: Agar u leksikograf bo'lganida, ularni so'zlovchidan qat'iylik bilan ajratib qo'ygan bo'lardi, chunki ular ma'nosiz va foydasiz.

en: He was preparing an answer for Barbican, when he was cut out by a sudden observation from M'Nicholl.
uz: U Barbican uchun javob tayyorlab yurganida, M'Nichollning to'satdan kuzatuvi uni kesib qo'ydi.

en: "See here, friends!" cried the Captain; "this going to the Moon is all very well, but how shall we get back?" His listeners looked at each other with a surprised and perplexed air.
uz: "Qaranglar, do'stlar! - deb xitob qildi kapitan. - Oyga borish juda yaxshi, lekin qaytib borishimiz kerakmi?" - Uning tinglovchilari bir-birlariga hayron va g'alati ko'rinishda qarab turishdi.

en: The question, though a very natural one, now appeared to have presented itself to their consideration absolutely for the first time.
uz: Bu savol juda tabiiy bo'lsa-da, endi ular o'zlarini birinchi marta o'ylashlari kerak edi.

en: "What do you mean by such a question, Captain?" asked Barbican in a grave judicial tone.
uz: - Bunday savol bilan nima demoqchisiz, kapitan? - deb so'radi Barbican jiddiy sud tomoni bilan.

en: "Mac, my boy," said Ardan seriously, "don't it strike you as a little out of order to ask how you are to return when you have not got there yet?"
uz: "Mac, o'g'lim, - dedi Ardan jiddiy, - bu sizga hali bormaganingizda qaytib kelishingizni so'rash uchun biroz tashqarida tuyulmayaptimi?"

en: "I don't ask the question with any idea of backing out," observed the Captain quietly; "as a matter of purely scientific inquiry, I repeat my question: how are we to return?" "I don't know," replied Barbican promptly.
uz: "Men bu savolni hech qanday fikr bilan bermayman", - dedi kapitan xotirjamlik bilan; "to'g'ri ilmiy izlanish bo'yicha savolimni takrorlayman: qanday qilib qaytib boramiz?" - Bilmayman, - deb javob berdi Barbican tez orada.

en: "For my part," said Ardan; "if I had known how to get back, I should have never come at all!" "Well!
uz: "O'z navbatimda, - dedi Ardan, - agar men qaytib borishni bilgan bo'lsam, hech qachon kelmas edim!"

en: of all the answers!" said the Captain, lifting his hands and shaking his head.
uz: Barcha javoblardan!" - dedi kapitan qo'llarini ko'tarib, boshini teshiklab.

en: "The best under the circumstances;" observed Barbican; "and I shall further observe that such a question as yours at present is both useless and uncalled for.
uz: "Bu holatda eng yaxshisi", - dedi Barbican, "va men yana shuni ta'kidlaymanki, hozirgi vaqtda siz kabi savol behuda va keraksiz.

en: On some future occasion, when we shall consider it advisable to return, the question will be in order, and we shall discuss it with all the attention it deserves.
uz: Kelajakda, qaytib kelishni tavsiya qilganimizda, bu savol o'rinli bo'ladi va biz uni kerakli e'tibor bilan muhokama qilamiz.

en: Though the Columbiad is at Stony Hill, the Projectile will still be in the Moon." "Much we shall gain by that!
uz: Garchi Kolumbiad Stony Hillda bo'lsa-da, Projektil hali ham oyda bo'ladi". "Bu bizga ko'p foyda keltiradi!

en: A bullet without a gun!" "The gun we can make and the powder too!" replied Barbican confidently.
uz: Qurolsiz o'q!" - deb javob berdi Barbican ishonch bilan.

en: "Metal and sulphur and charcoal and saltpetre are likely enough to be present in sufficient quantities beneath the Moon's surface.
uz: "Metal va kükürt, ko'mir va tuzli gaz o'zlarining ko'pligi bilan oy yuzasi ostida mavjud bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Besides, to return is a problem of comparatively easy solution: we should have to overcome the lunar attraction only—a slight matter—the rest of the business would be readily done by gravity." "Enough said on the subject!" exclaimed Ardan curtly; "how to get back is indefinitely postponed!
uz: Bundan tashqari, qaytib kelish nisbatan oson yechimning muammosi: biz faqat ozgina narsa - oyga jalb qilishni yengishimiz kerak bo'ladi, qolgan ish - gravitatsiya tomonidan osonlikcha amalga oshiriladi". "Bu borada yetarlicha so'z bor!" - dedi Ardan qisqacha; "Qanday qilib qaytib kelish kerakligi cheksiz vaqtga qoldirilgan!

en: How to communicate with our friends on the Earth, is another matter, and, as it seems to me, an extremely easy one." "Let us hear the very easy means by which you propose to communicate with our friends on Earth," asked the Captain, with a sneer, for he was by this time a little out of humor.
uz: Yer yuzidagi do'stlarimiz bilan qanday muloqot qilish kerakligi boshqa masala va, menga ko'rinishicha, juda oson. "Siz yer yuzidagi do'stlarimiz bilan muloqot qilish uchun taklif qilayotgan juda oson usulni eshitamiz", - deb so'radi kapitan, chunki u o'sha paytgacha biroz hazil bo'lgan.

en: "By means of bolides ejected from the lunar volcanoes," replied the Frenchman without an instant's hesitation.
uz: "Oy vulqonlaridan chiqariladigan bolidlar yordamida", deb javob berdi fransuz bir daqiqa ham shubha qilmasdan.

en: "Well said, friend Ardan," exclaimed Barbican.
uz: - Yaxshi so'z, do'stim Ardan, - dedi Barbican.

en: "I am quite disposed to acknowledge the feasibility of your plan.
uz: "Men sizning rejangizning amalga oshishini tan olishga tayyorman.

en: Laplace has calculated that a force five times greater than that of an ordinary cannon would be sufficient to send a bolide from the Moon to the Earth.
uz: Laplace hisoblaganidek, odatdagi to'qinga qaraganda besh baravar ko'proq kuch oydan Yerga bolid yuborish uchun etarli bo'ladi.

en: Now there is no cannon that can vie in force with even the smallest volcano."
uz: Hozirda hatto eng kichik vulqon bilan ham kuch-quvvatda raqobatlasha oladigan to'qima yo'q".

en: "Hurrah!" cried Ardan, delighted at his success; "just imagine the pleasure of sending our letters postage free!
uz: "Hura!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, uning muvaffaqiyatidan mamnun bo'lib, "o'z maktublarimizni pochtabepul yuborish zavqini tasavvur qiling!

en: what a splendid idea!—Dolts that we were for not thinking of it sooner!" "Let us have the splendid idea!" cried the Captain, with some of his old acrimony.
uz: Bu naqadar ajoyib g'oya!Biz buni ilgari o'ylamaganimiz uchun qo'rqardik!" - deb qo'shib qo'ydi kapitan.

en: "Why didn't we fasten a wire to the Projectile?" asked Ardan, triumphantly, "It would have enabled us to exchange telegrams with the Earth!" "Ho!
uz: "Nima uchun biz "Projektil"ga sim qo'ymagan edik?" - deb so'radi Ardan, g'alaba qozonib: "Bu bizga Yer bilan telegrammalar almashish imkonini berardi!" - deb so'radi.

en: ho!" roared the Captain, rapidly recovering his good humor; "decidedly the best joke of the season!
uz: "Ho!" - deb qichqirdi kapitan, tezda o'zining xushmuomalaligini tiklab oldi; "bu mavsumning eng yaxshi hazilidir!

en: Of course you have calculated the weight of a wire ൣ൥ൡ thousand miles long?" "No matter about its weight!" cried the Frenchman impetuously; "we should have laughed at its weight!
uz: Albatta, siz simning og'irligini hisoblab chiqdingizmi?" - deb so'radi fransuz: "Uning og'irligi ahamiyatsiz!" - deb o'yladi. - Biz uning og'irligi bilan kulishimiz kerak edi!

en: We could have tripled the charge of the Columbiad; we could have quadrupled it!—aye, quintupled it, if necessary!" he added in tones evidently increasing in loudness and violence.
uz: Kolumbiadning yukini uch baravar ko'paytirishimiz mumkin edi; to'rt baravar ko'paytirishimiz mumkin edi!Ha, kerak bo'lsa, besh baravar ko'paytirishimiz mumkin edi!" - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u.

en: "Yes, friend Michael," observed Barbican; "but there is a slight and unfortunately a fatal defect in your project.
uz: "Ha, do'stim Maykl, - dedi Barbican; - lekin sizning loyihangizda kichik va afsuski halokatli kamchilik bor.

en: The Earth, by its rotation, would have wrapped our wire around herself, like thread around a spool, and dragged us back almost with the speed of lightning!" "By the Nine gods of Porsena!" cried Ardan, "something is wrong with my head to-day!
uz: Yer o'z aylanishi bilan bizning simimizni o'ziga o'ziga o'rab olgan bo'ladi, xuddi bobok atrofidagi ip kabi, va bizni deyarli chaqmoq tezligi bilan orqaga tortib olib keladi! "Porsenaning To'qqizta xudosi bilan qasamki!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, "Bugun boshimda bir narsa noto'g'ri!

en: My brain is out of joint, and I am making as nice a mess of things as my friend Marston was ever capable of!
uz: Mening miyam bo'sh bo'lib qoldi va men do'stim Marston qila olgani kabi yaxshi tartibsizlikni yaratyapman!

en: By the bye—talking of Marston—if we never return to the Earth, what is to prevent him from following us to the Moon?" "Nothing!" replied Barbican; "he is a faithful friend and a reliable comrade.
uz: Agar biz hech qachon Yerga qaytsak, uni bizni oyga yetkazishdan nima to'sqinlik qiladi?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. - U sodiq do'st va ishonchli sherik.

en: Besides, what is easier?
uz: Bundan tashqari, nima osonroq?

en: Is not the Columbiad still at Stony Hill?
uz: Kolumbiad hali ham Stony Hillda emasmi?

en: Cannot gun-cotton be readily manufactured on any occasion?
uz: Qurol-qoton har qanday vaziyatda osonlikcha ishlab chiqarilishi mumkin emasmi?

en: Will not the Moon again pass through the zenith of Florida?
uz: Oʻsha oy yana Floridan oʻtib oʻtmaydi?

en: Eighteen years from now, will she not occupy exactly the same spot that she does to-day?" "Certainly!" cried Ardan, with increasing enthusiasm, "Marston will come!
uz: O'n sakkiz yildan so'ng, u hozirgi paytda o'zi kabi o'rinni egallamaydi-ku?" - "Chindan ham!" - dedi Ardan g'ayrat bilan: "Marston keladi!

en: and Elphinstone of the torpedo!
uz: va torpidolarning Elfinstoni!

en: and the gallant Bloomsbury, and Billsby the brave, and all our friends of the Baltimore Gun Club!
uz: va jasoratli Bloomsbury, va jasoratli Billsby va Baltimor quroli klubining barcha do'stlarimiz!

en: And we shall receive them with all the honors!
uz: Va biz ularni barcha sharaflar bilan qabul qilamiz!

en: And then we shall establish projectile trains between the Earth and the Moon!
uz: Keyin esa Yer va Oy o'rtasida o'q-o'q poyezdlarini o'rnatamiz!

en: "Hurrah for Secretary Marston!" cried the Captain, with an enthusiasm almost equal to Ardan's.
uz: "Sekretar Marston uchun hurrah!" - deb xitob qildi kapitan, Ardanning g'ayratiga o'xshash g'ayrat bilan.

en: "Hurrah for my dear friend Marston!" cried Barbican, hardly less excited than his comrades.
uz: "Qiziq do'stim Marston uchun hurrah!" - deb baqirdi Barbican, uning tengdoshlariga qaraganda hech qachon kam hayajonlanmagan.

en: Our old acquaintance, Marston, of course could not have heard the joyous acclamations that welcomed his name, but at that moment he certainly must have felt his ears most unaccountably tingling.
uz: O'sha paytdagi tanishimiz Marston, albatta, uning ismini kutib olgan quvonchli qo'shiqlarni eshitmagan bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin u o'sha paytda u o'z quloqlarini o'ziga xos bo'lmagan darajada qichqirib qolganini sezgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: What was he doing at the time?
uz: O'sha paytda u nima qilayotgan edi?

en: He was rattling along the banks of the Kansas River, as fast as an express train could take him, on the road to Long's Peak, where, by means of the great Telescope, he expected to find some traces of the Projectile that contained his friends.
uz: U Kanzas daryosining qirg'og'ida tezda tezlik bilan tezlik bilan tezlik bilan poyezdga o'tib, Long's Peak yo'lidan borar edi, u yerda katta teleskop yordamida do'stlarini o'z ichiga olgan "Projectile"ning izlarini topishni kutardi.

en: He never forgot them for a moment, but of course he little dreamed that his name at that very time was exciting their vividest recollections and their warmest applause.
uz: U ularni hech qachon unutib qo'ymadi, lekin, albatta, o'sha paytda uning ismi ularning eng hayajonli xotiralarini va eng iliq qo'l urishlarini uyg'otishini hech qachon tasavvur ham qilmagan.

en: In fact, their recollections were rather too vivid, and their applause decidedly too warm.
uz: Darhaqiqat, ularning xotiralari juda jonli edi va ularning qo'llab-quvvatlashi juda iliq edi.

en: Was not the animation that prevailed among the guests of the Projectile of a very unusual character, and was it not becoming more and more violent every moment?
uz: O'yinchoqning mehmonlari orasida hukmronlik qilayotgan animatsiya juda noyob xarakterga ega bo'lmaganmi va u har bir daqiqadan ko'proq zo'ravon bo'lib bormaydimi?

en: Could the wine have caused it?
uz: Buni sharob sababchi bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: No; though not teetotallers, they never drank to excess.
uz: Yo'q; garchi ular teetotaller bo'lmasalar ham, hech qachon ortiqcha ichmagan.

en: Could the Moon's proximity, shedding her subtle, mysterious influence over their nervous systems, have stimulated them to a degree that was threatening to border on frenzy?
uz: Oʻzlarining asabiy tizimlariga uning nozik va sirli taʼsirini oʻtkazgan oy yaqinligi ularni gʻazabga tushish xavfi tugʻdiradigan darajada ragʻbatlantirgan boʻlishi mumkinmi?

en: Their faces were as red as if they were standing before a hot fire; their breathing was loud, and their lungs heaved like a smith's bellows; their eyes blazed like burning coals; their voices sounded as loud and harsh as that of a stump speaker trying to make himself heard by an inattentive or hostile crowd; their words popped from their lips like corks from Champagne bottles; their gesticulating became wilder and in fact more alarming—considering the little room left in the Projectile for muscular displays of any kind.
uz: Ularning yuzlari issiq olov oldida turgan kabi qizil edi; nafaslari baland edi va o'z samollari quruqlik qo'rqinchlari singari puflashardi; ko'zlari yonayotgan ko'mir kabi parlashardi; ovozlari o'zini beparvo yoki dushman xaloyiq tomonidan eshitishga urinayotgan qo'pol gapiruvchining ovozi singari baland va qattiq tovush bilan eshitilardi; ularning so'zlari og'zlaridan shampan shishalari qo'rqinchlari kabi chiqib ketardi; ularning qo'llari vahshiy va haqiqatan ham qo'rqinchli bo'ldiProjectilda har qanday mushakli namoyishlar uchun qolgan kichik joyni hisobga olgan holda.

en: But the most extraordinary part of the whole phenomenon was that neither of them, not even Barbican, had the slightest consciousness of any strange or unusual ebullition of spirits either on his own part or on that of the others.
uz: Ammo butun hodisaning eng ajoyib qismi shundaki, ularning hech biri, hatto Barbican ham, o'z yoki boshqalarning ruhi o'ziga xos yoki odatiy emas, deb o'ylamagan.

en: "See here, gentlemen!" said the Captain in a quick imperious manner—the roughness of his old life on the Mississippi would still break out—"See here, gentlemen!
uz: "Qaranglar, xonimlar!" - dedi kapitan tezda imperiyaviy tarzda. - Misisipidagi eski hayotining qahr-qahrligi hali ham o'tishi kerak edi.

en: It seems I'm not to know if we are
uz: Ko'rinishicha, bizda bu borligini bilmasligim kerak.

en: to return from the Moon.
uz: Aydan qaytish uchun.

en: Well!—Pass that for the present!
uz: Xo'sh, hozir uchun o'tkazib yubor!

en: But there is one thing I must know!" "Hear!
uz: Ammo bir narsani bilishim kerak! "

en: hear the Captain!" cried Barbican, stamping with his foot, like an excited fencing master.
uz: Kaptenni tinglang!" - deb qayg'urdi Barbican, oyoqlari bilan toshbo'ron qilib, xuddi g'ayratga to'lgan to'qnashuv ustasi kabi.

en: "There is one thing he must know!" "I want to know what we're going to do when we get there!" "He wants to know what we're going to do when we get there!
uz: "U bilishi kerak bo'lgan bir narsa bor!" "Men u yerga yetib borganimizda nima qilishimizni bilmoqchiman!" "U o'sha yerga yetib borganimizda nima qilishimizni bilmoqchiman!

en: A sensible question!
uz: Bu oqilona savol!

en: Answer it, Ardan!" "Answer it yourself, Barbican!
uz: Javob bering, Ardan!" - deb so'radi. - Javob bering, Barbican!

en: You know more about the Moon than I do!
uz: Siz oy haqida mendan ko'ra ko'proq bilasiz!

en: You know more about it than all the Nasmyths that ever lived!" "I'm blessed if I know anything at all about it!" cried Barbican, with a joyous laugh.
uz: Sen bu haqda barcha nasmitlardan ko'ra ko'proq bilasan!" - deb hayqirib yubordi Barbican.

en: The first eastern shore Marylander or any other simpleton you meet in Baltimore, knows as much about the Moon as I do!
uz: Sharqiy sohildagi birinchi Marylandlik yoki Baltimorda uchratgan har qanday oddiy odam o'sha oy haqida men kabi ko'p narsani biladi!

en: Why we're going there, I can't tell!
uz: Nima uchun biz u yerga boryapmiz, demayman!

en: What we're going to do when we get there, can't tell either!
uz: U yerga yetib borganimizda nima qilishimizni ham aytolmayman!

en: Ardan knows all about it!
uz: Ardan bu haqda hamma narsani biladi!

en: He's taking us there!" "Certainly I can tell!
uz: U bizni o'sha yerga olib bormoqda! - dedi. - Albatta, shuni bilaman!

en: should I have offered to take you there without a good object in view?" cried Ardan, husky with continual roaring.
uz: Sizni ko'rmagan holda olib ketishga taklif qilishim kerak edi", - dedi Ardan, o'ziga xos ovoz bilan.

en: "Answer me that!" "No conundrums!" cried the Captain, in a voice sourer and rougher than ever; "tell us if you can in plain English, what the demon we have come here for!" "I'll tell you if I feel like it," cried Ardan, folding his arms with an aspect of great dignity; "and I'll not tell you if I don't feel like it!" "What's that?" cried Barbican.
uz: "Bu savolga javob bering!" - deb hayqirib yubordi kapitan, soʻnggi paytlardan ham koʻra ogʻirroq va qattiqroq ovoz bilan, - agar bilsangiz, oddiy ingliz tilida bizga ayting, biz bu yerga nima uchun keldik! - Agar xohlasam, sizga aytaman, - dedi Ardan, qoʻllarini katta qadr-qimmatga ega boʻlgan holda toʻkib qoʻydi. - Agar xohlamasam, sizga aytmayman, - dedi Barbican. - Bu nima? - deb hayqirib yubordi.

en: "You'll not give us an answer when we ask you a reasonable question?" "Never!" cried Ardan, with great determination.
uz: "Biz sizga oqilona savol berganimizda javob bermaysizmi?" - dedi Ardan qat'iy qaror bilan.

en: "I'll never answer a question reasonable or unreasonable, unless it is asked in a proper manner!" "None of your French airs here!" exclaimed M'Nicholl, by this time almost completely out of himself between anger and excitement.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Men hech qachon asosli yoki asossiz savolga javob bermayman, agar u to'g'ri tarzda berilmasa!" - deb aytdi.

en: "I don't know where I am; I don't know where I'm going; I don't know why I'm going; you know all about it, Ardan, or at least you think you do!
uz: "Men qaerdaligimni bilmayman; qayerga ketayotganimni bilmayman; nima uchun ketayotganimni bilmayman; sen bu haqda hamma narsani bilasan, Ardan, yoki hech bo'lmaganda o'zingni shunday deb o'ylaysan!

en: Well then, give me a plain answer to a plain question, or by the Thirty-eight States of our glorious Union, I shall know what for!" "Listen, Ardan!" cried Barbican, grappling with the Frenchman, and with some difficulty restraining him from flying at M'Nicholl's throat;
uz: Shunday qilib, menga oddiy savolga aniq javob bering, yoki ulug'vor Ittifoqimizning sakkiz uchinchi shtatlari bilan nima uchun ekanligini bilaman!" - dedi Barbican, fransuz bilan tortishib, M'Nicholning bo'yniga uchib ketishidan to'xtatish qiyin bo'lgan holda.

en: "You ought to tell him!
uz: "Sen unga aytishing kerak!

en: It is only your duty!
uz: Bu faqat sizning burchingizdir!

en: One day you found us both in St.
uz: Bir kuni siz bizni ikkovimizni ham St.

en: Helena woods, where we had no more idea of going to the Moon than of sailing to the South Pole!
uz: Helena o'rmonlari, biz o'zimiz uchun oyga borishga va Janubiy qutbga sayohat qilish haqida ko'proq tasavvurga ega bo'lmagan joy!

en: There you twisted us both around your finger, and induced us to follow you blindly on the most formidable journey ever undertaken by man!
uz: O'sha yerda ikkovimizni ham barmog'ingiz atrofida aylantirib, odamzodning eng dahshatli sayohatida sizni ko'r bo'lib kuzatib borishga majbur qildingiz!

en: And now you refuse to tell us what it was all for!" "I don't refuse, dear old Barbican!
uz: Endi esa nima uchun borligini aytishdan bosh tortyapsan! - deb aytdi. - Men rad etmayman, aziz keksa barbican!

en: To you, at least, I can't refuse anything!" cried Ardan, seizing his friend's hands and wringing them violently.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda senga hech narsa rad qila olmayman!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, do'stining qo'llarini ushlab, ularni zo'ravonlik bilan burib qo'ydi.

en: Then letting them go and suddenly starting back, "you wish to know," he continued in resounding tones, "why we have followed out the grandest idea that ever set a human brain on fire!
uz: Keyin ularni qo'yib yuborib, to'satdan yana boshlanishni boshlaganidan so'ng, "Nima uchun biz insoniyat miyasini yonib yuborgan eng buyuk g'oyaga amal qildik, deb bilmoqchisiz", - deb davom etdi u baland ovoz bilan.

en: Why we have undertaken a journey that for length, danger, and novelty, for fascinating, soul-stirring and delirious sensations, for all that can attract man's burning heart, and satisfy the intensest cravings of his intellect, far surpasses the vividest realities of Dante's passionate dream!
uz: Nima uchun biz uzoqlik, xavf va yangilik, hayajonli, ruhni qo'zg'atadigan va deliriyalovchi his-tuyg'ular, insonning qizg'in qalbini jalb qiladigan va aqlini qondirish uchun eng kuchli istaklarni qondirish mumkin bo'lgan barcha narsalar uchun sayohatni boshladik, bu Dante'ning ishtiyoqli orzuining eng aniq haqiqatlaridan ancha ustun keladi!

en: Well, I will tell you!
uz: Men sizga aytaman!

en: It is to annex another World to the New One!
uz: Bu yangi dunyoga yana bir dunyo qo'shishdir!

en: It is to take possession of the Moon in the name of the United States of America!
uz: Bu Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari nomidan Oyga egalik qilishdir!

en: It is to add a thirty-ninth State to the glorious Union!
uz: Bu ulug'vor Ittifoqqa o'ttiz to'qqizinchi davlatni qo'shishdir!

en: It is to colonize the lunar regions, to cultivate them, to people them, to transport to them some of our wonders of art, science, and industry!
uz: Bu oy mintaqalarini kolonizatsiya qilish, ularni o'stirish, ularga egalik qilish, ularga san'at, fan va sanoatning ba'zi mo'jizalarini olib borishdir!

en: It is to civilize the Selenites, unless they are more civilized already than we are ourselves!
uz: Bu Selenitlarni sivilizatsiya qilishdir, agar ular bizdan ko'ra yanada sivilizatsiyalashgan bo'lmasalar!

en: It is to make them all good Republicans, if they are not so already!" "Provided, of course, that there are Selenites in existence!" sneered the Captain, now sourer than ever, and in his unaccountable excitement doubly irritating.
uz: Bu ularning barchasini yaxshi respublikachi qilish uchun, agar ular allaqachon shunday bo'lmasa!" - "Agar, albatta, Selenitlar mavjud bo'lsa!" - dedi kapitan, endi har qachongidan ham achchiqroq va o'zining noaniq hayajonidan ikki baravar g'azablanayotgan.

en: "Who says there are no Selenites?" cried Ardan fiercely, with fists clenched and brows contracted.
uz: "Selenitlar yo'qligini kim aytadi?" - dedi Ardan og'irlik bilan, qo'llarini to'plab, ko'zlari qisqartirilgan holda.

en: "I do!" cried M'Nicholl stoutly; "I deny the existence of anything of the kind, and I denounce every one that maintains any such whim as a visionary, if not a fool!" Ardan's reply to this taunt was a desperate facer, which, however, Barbican managed to stop while on its way towards the Captain's nose.
uz: M'Nicholl baland ovoz bilan xitob qildi: "Men bunday narsalarning mavjudligini inkor qilaman va har kim o'sha kabi caprichalarga ega bo'lsa, uni aqlsiz yoki aqlsiz deb tanqid qilaman!" Ardanning bu masxaraga bergan javobi juda qattiq edi, ammo Barbican kapitanning burchasiga yaqinlashayotganda to'xtashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: M'Nicholl, seeing himself struck at, immediately assumed such a posture of defence as showed him to be no novice at the business.
uz: M'Nicholl o'zini o'zi o'ldirganini ko'rib, darhol o'zini himoya qilishning o'rnagiga kirdi va bu ishda u yangi emasligini ko'rsatdi.

en: A battle seemed unavoidable; but even at this trying moment Barbican showed himself equal to the emergency.
uz: Urushning oldini olishning iloji yo'qdek tuyulgan edi; lekin hatto bu qiyin damlarda ham Barbican o'zini favqulodda vaziyatga teng ko'rsatdi.

en: "Stop, you crazy fellows!
uz: "Toʻxtatinglar, siz aqldan ozgan yigitlar!

en: you overgrown babies!" he exclaimed, seizing his companions by the collar, and violently swinging them around with his vast strength until they stood back to back; "what are you going to fight about?
uz: Sizlar ko'p ulg'aygan chaqaloqlar! - deb hayqirdi u, do'stlarini bo'yinidan ushlab, o'z qudratini ko'targancha, ularni o'z qudratlari bilan o'rab-o'rab, orqaga qarab turibdi. - Sizlar nima uchun urishasizlar?

en: Suppose there are Lunarians in the Moon!
uz: Ayda lunarlar bor deb tasavvur qiling!

en: Is that a reason why there should be Lunatics in the Projectile!
uz: Shu sababdan o'z o'yinida Lunatiklar bo'lishi kerakmi?

en: But, Ardan, why do you insist on Lunarians?
uz: Ammo, Ardan, nega siz lunariylarga qat'iylik bilan e'tibor qaratyapsiz?

en: Are we so shiftless that we can't do without them when we get to the Moon?" "I don't insist on them!" cried Ardan, who submitted to Barbican like a child.
uz: O'zimizni o'zgartirmasligimiz uchun oyga yetib borganimizda ularsiz yo'l topa olmaymizmi?" - dedi Barbicanga bola kabi bo'ysungan Ardan.

en: "Hang the Lunarians!
uz: "Lunarlarni haydash!

en: Certainly, we can do without them!
uz: Shubhasizki, biz ularsiz yashay olamiz!

en: What do I care for them?
uz: Ular menga nima keragi bor?

en: Down with them!" "Yes, down with the Lunarians!" cried M'Nicholl as spitefully as if he had even the slightest belief in their existence.
uz: "Ha, lunarlar bilan birga!" - deb M'Nicholl, xuddi ularning mavjudligiga hatto eng kam ishonchi bo'lganidek, yomonlik bilan baqirib yubordi.

en: "We shall take possession of the Moon ourselves!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "O'zimiz o'zimiz oyni egallab olamiz!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "Lunarians or no Lunarians!" "We three shall constitute a Republic!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Lunarlar yoki Lunarlar yo'q!" deb baqirdi.

en: "I shall be the House!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Men uy bo'laman!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "And I the Senate!" answered the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Men esa Senatman!" - deb javob berdi.

en: "And Barbican our first President!" shrieked the Frenchman.
uz: "Va Barbican bizning birinchi Prezidentimiz!" - deb qichqirdi frantsuz.

en: "Our first and last!" roared M'Nicholl.
uz: "Bizning birinchi va oxirgi!" - deb qichqirdi M'Nicholl.

en: "No objections to a third term!" yelled Ardan.
uz: "Uchinchi muddatga e'tirof etmaslik kerak!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "He's welcome to any number of terms he pleases!" vociferated M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "O'zi xohlagan har qanday so'zlarga xush kelibsiz!" - dedi.

en: "Hurrah for President Barbican of the Lunatic—I mean of the Lunar Republic!" screamed Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Prezident Barbicanning lunatik davlatiga hurrah! - deb baqirib yubordi.

en: "Long may he wave, and may his shadow never grow less!" shouted Captain M'Nicholl, his eyes almost out of their sockets.
uz: "Uzoq o'ynashi va soyasi hech qachon kamaymasligi mumkin!" - deb baqirdi kapitan M'Nicholl, uning ko'zlari deyarli o'z so'kovlaridan chiqdi.

en: Then with voices reminding you of sand fiercely blown against the window panes, the President and the Senate chanted the immortal Yankee Doodle, whilst the House delivered itself of the Marseillaise, in a style which even the wildest Jacobins in Robespierre's day could hardly have surpassed.
uz: So'ngra prezident va Senat, oyog'lar o'zlarining oyog'lariga qattiq shamollangan qumni eslatgan ovozlar bilan o'lmas Yanki do'dlini qo'shib, uyni Marseillaisdan ozod qildilar, Robesperning davridagi eng yovvoyi yakobinlar ham undan ustun qo'yishmagan tarzda.

en: But long before either song was ended, all three broke out into a dance, wild, insensate, furious, delirious, paroxysmatical.
uz: Ammo qo'shiqlarning har biri yakunlanishidan ko'p vaqt o'tmay, uchta qo'shiq ham vahshiy, aqldan ozgan, g'azabli, delirli va paroxizmli raqsga aylandi.

en: No Orphic festivals on Mount Cithaeron ever raged more wildly.
uz: Cithaeron tog'idagi hech qanday Orf bayramlari bu qadar yovvoyilik bilan o'tkazilmagan.

en: No Bacchic revels on Mount Parnassus were ever more corybantic.
uz: Parnassus tog'ida o'tkaziladigan Bacchic bayramlari hech qachon ko'proq o'tkir bo'lmagan.

en: Diana, demented by the maddening example, joined in the orgie, howling
uz: Diana, bu g'azablantiruvchi misoldan g'alati bo'lib, orgiyaga qo'shildi, uyaldi.

en: and barking frantically in her turn, and wildly jumping as high as the ceiling of the Projectile.
uz: Va o'z navbatida g'azabga to'lib-toshadi va o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'tadi.

en: Then came new accessions to the infernal din.
uz: So'ngra jahannam dinida yangi qo'shilishlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Wings suddenly began to flutter, cocks to crow, hens to cluck; and five or six chickens, managing to escape out of their coop, flew backwards and forwards blindly, with frightened screams, dashing against each other and against the walls of the Projectile, and altogether getting up as demoniacal a hullabaloo as could be made by ten thousand bats that you suddenly disturbed in a cavern where they had slept through the winter.
uz: Birdan qushlar qichqirdi, gʻoʻzlar qichqirdi, tovuqlar qichqirdi, besh yoki olti tovuq esa oʻz hovlisidan qochib ketishga muvaffaq boʻlib, qoʻrqqan qichqiriqlari bilan koʻr boʻlib, orqaga va orqaga uchdi, bir-biriga va Projectile devorlariga qarshi urishdi va bir vaqtning oʻzida oʻn mingta toʻqnashuvlar tomonidan sodir boʻladigan yovvoyi halokatga aylandilar.

en: Then the three companions, no longer able to withstand the overpowering influence of the mysterious force that mastered them, intoxicated, more than drunk, burned by the air that scorched their organs of respiration, dropped at last, and lay flat, motionless, senseless as dabs of clay, on the floor of the Projectile.
uz: Keyin uchta hamkor, ularni boshqargan sirli kuchning kuchli ta'sirini ko'tarishga qodir bo'lmay, mast bo'lishgan, ichkilikbozlikdan ko'ra ko'proq, nafas olish organlarini yondirgan havo tomonidan yondirilgan, nihoyat qulab ketishdi va o'zlariga o'xshaydigan, harakatsiz, lo'zg'orsiz, lo'zg'or kabi befarq holda, Projectilning yotoqxonasiga o'tirdilar.

en: A DEMONIACAL HULLABALOO.
uz: A DEMONIACAL HULLABALOO.

en: What had taken place?
uz: Xo'sh, nima sodir bo'ldi?

en: Whence proceeded this strange intoxication whose consequences might have proved so disastrous?
uz: Qachon bu g'alati mastlik sodir bo'ldi, uning oqibatlari shunchalik dahshatli bo'lishi mumkin edi?

en: A little forgetfulness on Ardan's part had done the whole mischief, but fortunately M'Nicholl was able to remedy it in time.
uz: Ardanning ozgina unutganligi butun zararni yetkazdi, ammo M'Nicholl buni o'z vaqtida bartaraf etishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: After a regular fainting spell several minutes long, the Captain was the first man to return to consciousness and the full recovery of his intellectual faculties.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davom etayotgan muntazam bayondashishdan so'ng, kapitan ongga qaytgan va intellektual qobiliyatlarini to'liq tiklagan birinchi odam bo'ldi.

en: His first feelings were far from pleasant.
uz: Uning ilk his-tuyg'ulari yoqimli bo'lmagan.

en: His stomach gnawed him as if he had not eaten for a week, though he had taken breakfast only a few hours before; his eyes were dim, his brain throbbing, and his limbs shaking.
uz: Uning qorni bir hafta davomida ovqatlanmaganidek, hatto undan bir necha soat oldin ham kechki ovqatni yemagan bo'lsa-da, uni qovurib qo'ydi; ko'zlari so'nib, miyasi urib, a'zolari titraydi.

en: In short, he presented every symptom usually seen in a man dying of starvation.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, u odatda ochlikdan o'layotgan odamda ko'rinadigan har bir alomatni taqdim etdi.

en: Picking himself up with much care and difficulty, he roared out to Ardan for something to eat.
uz: O'zini ko'p ehtiyotkorlik va qiyinchilik bilan ko'tarib, Ardanga ovqat olish uchun chaqirib yubordi.

en: Seeing that the Frenchman was unable or unwilling to respond, he concluded to help himself, by beginning first of all to prepare a little tea.
uz: Fransiyalik javob bera olmaganini yoki bermoqchi emasligini ko'rib, u o'ziga yordam berishga qaror qildi va birinchi navbatda bir oz choy tayyorlashni boshladi.

en: To do this, fire was necessary; so, to light his lamp, he struck a match.
uz: Buning uchun olov kerak edi; shuning uchun u chiroqni yoqish uchun chaqmoqni urdi.

en: But what was his surprise at seeing the sulphur tip of the match blazing with a light so bright and dazzling that his eyes could hardly bear it!
uz: Ammo o'yinchining kükürtli tomoniga shunchalik yorug' va yorug'lik bilan yonayotganini ko'rib, u qanchalik hayron bo'lganini ko'rib, ko'zlari uni ko'rmay qoldi!

en: Touching it to the gas burner, a stream of light flashed forth equal in its intensity to the flame of an electric lamp.
uz: Gaz yonilg'isiga tegib, yorug'lik oqimi o'z kuch-quvvatida elektr lampa olovining o'tlariga teng bo'ldi.

en: Then he understood it all in an instant.
uz: Keyin u hamma narsani bir daqiqada tushundi.

en: The dazzling glare, his maddened
uz: Qarang, uning g'ayratli ko'rinishi, yorqin ko'rinishi.

en: brain, his gnawing stomach—all were now clear as the noon-day Sun.
uz: Uning miyasi, qovurgan qorinlari endi kunduz quyosh kabi aniq edi.

en: "The oxygen!" he cried, and, suddenly stooping down and examining the tap of the air apparatus, he saw that it had been only half turned off.
uz: "Oksygen!" - deb baqirdi u va to'satdan yerga yiqilib, havo apparatining kranini ko'rib chiqib, u yarim o'chirilganini ko'rdi.

en: Consequently the air was gradually getting more and more impregnated with this powerful gas, colorless, odorless, tasteless, infinitely precious, but, unless when strongly diluted with nitrogen, capable of producing fatal disorders in the human system.
uz: Natijada, havo asta-sekin bu kuchli gaz bilan to'lib-toshgan, rangsiz, xushbo'y, mazali bo'lmagan, cheksiz qimmatbaho, ammo nitrogen bilan kuchli qondirilmaganida, inson tizimida halokatli kasalliklarni keltirib chiqarishga qodir bo'lgan.

en: Ardan, startled by M'Nicholl's question about the means of returning from the Moon, had turned the cock only half off.
uz: M'Nichollning oydan qaytib kelish yo'llari to'g'risida bergan so'rovi Ardanni qo'rqitdi, ammo u o'z ko'zini yarimdan o'zgartirgan edi.

en: The Captain instantly stopped the escape of the oxygen, but not one moment too soon.
uz: Kapten darhol kisloroddan chiqib ketishni to'xtatdi, lekin bir daqiqa ham tez emas.

en: It had completely saturated the atmosphere.
uz: Bu atmosferaga to'liq to'ldirgan edi.

en: A few minutes more and it would have killed the travellers, not like carbonic acid, by smothering them, but by burning them up, as a strong draught burns up the coals in a stove.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa ko'proq vaqt o'tgach, u sayohatchilarni o'ldirib qo'ygan bo'lardi, lekin karbonik kislota kabi emas, balki ularni o'ldirib, kuchli oqim cho'g'dagi ko'mirni yondirib yuborganidek, ularni ham yondirib yuboradi.

en: "THE OXYGEN!" HE CRIED.
uz: "OXYG'ON!" - deb hayqirdi u.

en: It took nearly an hour for the air to become pure enough to allow the lungs their natural play.
uz: Havoning samimiyligi samoviy o'yinlarini o'ynash uchun o'ta toza bo'lishi uchun deyarli bir soat kerak bo'ldi.

en: Slowly and by degrees, the travellers recovered from their intoxication; they had actually to sleep off the fumes of the oxygen as a drunkard has to sleep off the effects of his brandy.
uz: Yo'lovchilar asta-sekin mastlikdan omon qolishdi; ular aslida spirtli ichimliklarni ichib, spirtli ichimliklarning ta'siridan uyquga borishi kerak bo'lganidek, kislorod tutqunlaridan uxlashlari kerak edi.

en: When Ardan learned that he was responsible for the whole trouble, do you think the information disconcerted him?
uz: Ardan butun muammolar uchun o'zi javobgar ekanini bilib olgach, bu ma'lumotlar uni hayratda qoldirdi deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: On the contrary, he was rather proud of having done something startling, to break the monotony of the journey; and to put a little life, as he said, into old Barbican and the grim Captain, so as to get a little fun out of such grave philosophers.
uz: Aksincha, u sayohatning monotonligini buzish va, uning aytishicha, keksa Barbican va qorong'i kapitanga bir oz hayot ato etish uchun dahshatli ish qilganidan g'ururlanardi.

en: After laughing heartily at the comical figure cut by his two friends capering like crazy students at the Closerie des Lilas, he went on moralizing on the incident: "For my part, I'm not a bit sorry for having partaken of this fuddling gas.
uz: Ikki do'sti Closerie des Lilasda aqldan ozgan talabalar kabi o'tirgan qo'rqinchli suratga ko'ra ko'ngildan kulgandan so'ng, u hodisa haqida fikr yuritib, shunday dedi: "Mening o'zim uchun bu g'ayratli gazni ichganimdan hech qanday afsusim yo'q.

en: It gives me an idea, dear boys.
uz: Bu menga g'oya beradi, aziz bolalar.

en: Would it not be worth some enterprising fellow's while to establish a sanatorium provided with oxygen chambers, where people of a debilitated state of health could enjoy a few hours of intensely active existence!
uz: Yaxshi dam olgan odamlar bir necha soat davomida faol hayot kechirishlari mumkin bo'lgan kislorod xonalari bilan ta'minlangan sanatoriy o'rnatish uchun ba'zi tadbirkorlarning vaqtini sarflash arziydi!

en: There's money in it, as you Americans say.
uz: Siz amerikaliklar aytganingizdek, unda pul bor.

en: Just suppose balls or parties given in halls where the air would be provided with an extra supply of this enrapturing gas!
uz: O'ylab ko'ring, havoga ushbu yoqimli gazning qo'shimcha ta'minoti taqdim etiladigan zallarda o'tkaziladigan balolar yoki partiyalar bo'ladi!

en: Or, theatres where the atmosphere would be maintained in a highly oxygenated condition.
uz: Yoki atmosfera yuqori kislorodli holatda saqlanadigan teatrlar.

en: What passion, what fire in the actors!
uz: Aktyorlarda naqadar katta ishtiyoq, naqadar katta o't bor!

en: What enthusiasm in the spectators!
uz: Qarang, tomoshabinlar orasida naqadar hayajon bor edi!

en: And, carrying the idea a little further, if, instead of an assembly or an audience, we should oxygenize towns, cities, a whole country—what activity would be infused into the whole people!
uz: Va, bu g'oyani biroz ko'proq ko'tarish uchun, agar yig'ilish yoki tinglovchi o'rniga shaharlar, shaharlar, butun mamlakatni kislorodlashtirishimiz kerak bo'lsa, butun odamlarga qanday faoliyat ko'rsatilishi mumkin!

en: What new life would electrify a stagnant community!
uz: To'xtatgan jamiyatni qanday yangi hayot elektrlashtirishi mumkin!

en: Out of an old used-up nation we could perhaps make a bran-new one, and, for my part, I know more than one state in old Europe where this oxygen experiment might be attended with a decided advantage, or where, at all events, it could do no harm!" The Frenchman spoke so glibly and gesticulated so earnestly that M'Nicholl once more gravely examined the stop-cock; but Barbican damped his enthusiasm by a single observation.
uz: O'sha eski ishlatilgan millatdan biz, ehtimol, yangi bir o'simlikni yaratishimiz mumkin va men eski Evropada bir nechta davlatni bilaman, unda ushbu kislorod tajribasi qat'iy afzallik bilan ishtirok etishi mumkin yoki, hech bo'lmaganda, zarar keltirishi mumkin emas!" - deb gapirgan frantsuz odam o'z so'zini o'zgartirgan va o'ziga shunday qattiq qo'shib qo'yganki, M'Nicholl yana bir bor to'xtatishni jiddiy o'rganib chiqdi; lekin Barbican uning g'ayratini bitta kuzatish bilan susaytirdi.

en: "Friend Michael," said he, "your new and interesting idea we shall discuss at a more favorable opportunity.
uz: U shunday dedi: "Dost Maykl, sizning yangi va qiziqarli g'oyangizni yanada qulay fursatda muhokama qilamiz.

en: At present we want to know where all these cocks and hens have come from." "These cocks and hens?" "Yes." Ardan threw a glance of comical bewilderment on half a dozen or so of splendid barn-yard fowls that were now beginning to recover from the effects of the oxygen.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda biz bu qushlar va tovuqlar qayerdan kelib chiqqanini bilmoqchimiz". "Bu qushlar va tovuqlar?" "Ha". Ardan o'sha paytda kislorodning ta'siridan tiklanishni boshlagan taxminan oltilab ajoyib cho'g'lar ustiga qo'rqinchli ko'z tashladi.

en: For an instant he could not utter a word; then, shrugging his shoulders, he muttered in a low voice: "Catastrophe prematurely exploded!" "What are you going to do with these chickens?" persisted Barbican.
uz: U bir daqiqa davomida bir so'z ham aytolmadi, so'ngra yelkalarini yumib, past ovoz bilan: "Katastrofa o'z vaqtida portlandi!" - deb qichqirdi. "Bu tovuqlarni nima qilmoqchisiz?" - dedi Barbican.

en: "Acclimatize them in the Moon, by Jove!
uz: "Jove tomonidan oyda ularni aklimatizatsiya qiling!

en: what else?" was the ready reply.
uz: Yana nima?" deb javob berdi.

en: "Why conceal them then?" "A hoax, a poor hoax, dear President, which proves a miserable failure!
uz: "Unda nima uchun ularni yashirish kerak?" - deb so'radi. - Bu yolg'on, kambag'al yolg'on, aziz Prezident, bu esa o'zidan-o'zidan g'alati muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraydi!

en: I intended to let them loose on the Lunar Continent at the first favorable opportunity.
uz: Men ularni birinchi qulay fursatda oy qit'asiga yuborishni rejalashtirgan edim.

en: I often had a good laugh to myself, thinking of your astonishment and the Captain's at seeing a lot of American poultry scratching for worms on a Lunar dunghill!" "Ah!
uz: Men ko'pincha o'zim uchun yaxshi kulganman, sizning hayratingiz va kapitanning oylik cho'g'da ko'p amerikalik tuxumlar qurtlar uchun qirib ketayotganini ko'rib, hayratda qolganingizni o'yladim! "

en: wag, jester, incorrigible farceur!" cried Barbican with a smile; "you want no nitrous oxide to put a bee in your bonnet!
uz: Wag, jester, o'zgartirilmaydigan farceur! - deb qo'shib yubordi Barbican tabassum bilan; "Siz o'zingizning qo'rqinchingizga arnayni qo'yish uchun nitrous oksidni istamaysiz!

en: He is always as bad as you and I were for a short time, M'Nicholl, under the laughing gas!
uz: U har doim siz va men qisqa vaqt davomida bo'lganimizdek yomon, M'Nicholl, kulgi gaz ostida!

en: He's never had a sensible moment in his life!" "I can't say the same of you," replied Ardan; "you had at least one sensible moment in all your lives, and that was about an hour ago!" Their incessant chattering did not prevent the friends from at once repairing the disorder of the interior of the Projectile.
uz: U hayotida hech qachon o'z hayotida oqilona bir daqiqaga ega bo'lmagan!" - deb javob berdi Ardan. - Men siz haqingizda ham xuddi shunday aytolmayman; siz butun hayotida hech bo'lmaganda bitta oqilona daqiqaga ega bo'ldingiz va bu taxminan bir soat oldin edi! - Ularning doimiy gapirishlari do'stlarni bir vaqtning o'zida Projectile ichki tartibsizlikni tuzatishdan to'xtatmadi.

en: Cocks and hens were put back in their cages.
uz: Tovuq va tovuqlarni qovurlariga qaytarib qo'yishdi.

en: But while doing so, the friends were astonished to find that the birds, though good sized creatures, and now pretty fat and plump, hardly felt heavier in their hands than if they had been so many sparrows.
uz: Ammo do'stlar buni qilayotib, qushlar yaxshi o'lchamli mavjudot bo'lishlariga qaramay, endi juda ham semiz va ko'p bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, qo'llarida ko'pgina qushlar bo'lganidan ko'ra og'irroq bo'lganini bilib hayron qolishdi.

en: This drew their interested attention to a new phenomenon.
uz: Bu ularning qiziqishlarini yangi hodisaga qaratdi.

en: From the moment they had left the Earth, their own weight, and that of the Projectile and the objects therein contained, had been undergoing a progressive diminution.
uz: Ular Yerni tark etgan paytdan boshlab, o'z vazni, shuningdek, o'z vazni va ulardagi ob'ektlarning og'irligi bosqichma-bosqich kamayib borardi.

en: They might never be able to ascertain this fact with regard to the Projectile, but the moment was now rapidly approaching when the loss of weight would become perfectly sensible, both regarding themselves and the tools and instruments surrounding them.
uz: Ehtimol, ular bu faktni hech qachon Projectile bilan aniqlay olmaydilar, lekin o'zlariga va atrofidagi asbob-uskunalar va asbob-uskunalarga nisbatan ham, o'zlarining og'irligini yo'qotish to'g'ri tushuniladigan vaqt tezda yaqinlashib borardi.

en: Of course, it is quite clear, that this decrease could not be indicated by an ordinary scales, as the weight to balance the object would have lost precisely as much as the object itself.
uz: To'g'ri, bu kamayish oddiy masalada ko'rsatilishi mumkin emasligi aniq, chunki ob'ektni muvozanatlash uchun og'irlik ob'ektning o'zi kabi yo'qolgan bo'ladi.

en: But a spring balance, for instance, in which the tension of the coil is independent of attraction, would have readily given the exact equivalent of the loss.
uz: Ammo, masalan, bobinning g'ayratliligi jozibadorlikdan mustaqil bo'lgan bahor balansida zararning aniq ekvivalenti bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Attraction or weight, according to Newton's well known law, acting in direct proportion to the mass of the attracting body and in inverse proportion to the square of the distance, this consequence clearly follows: Had the Earth been alone in space, or had the other heavenly bodies been suddenly annihilated, the further from the Earth the Projectile would be, the less weight it would have.
uz: Chiroy yoki og'irlik, Nyuutonning mashhur qonuniga ko'ra, jalb qiluvchi jismning massasiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nisbatda va maskaning kvadratiga to'g'ri nisbatda harakat qiladi, bu natijaga aniq erishadi: agar Yer koinotda yolg'iz bo'lganida yoki boshqa samoviy jismlar to'satdan yo'q qilinganida edi, proyektil Yerdan qanchalik uzoqroq bo'lsa, o'sha qadar og'irligi kamroq bo'lardi.

en: However, it would never entirely lose its weight, as the terrestrial attraction would have always made itself felt at no matter what distance.
uz: Biroq, u hech qachon o'z og'irligini to'liq yo'qotmaydi, chunki yerdagi jozibadorlik har doim o'zini qanday masofadan ko'rsa ham his qiladi.

en: But as the Earth is not the only celestial body possessing attraction, it is evident that there may be a point in space where the respective attractions may be entirely annihilated by mutual counteraction.
uz: Ammo Yer faqatgina jozibadorlikka ega bo'lgan samoviy jism bo'lmaganligi sababli, koinotda jozibadorliklar o'zaro ta'sir bilan butunlay yo'q qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan nuqta bo'lishi mumkinligi aniq.

en: Of this phenomenon the present instance was a case in point.
uz: Ushbu hodisa ushbu hodisaga misol bo'ldi.

en: In a short time, the Projectile and its contents would for a few moments be absolutely and completely deprived of all weight whatsoever.
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida, bir necha daqiqa davomida Projectile va uning tarkibi har qanday og'irlikdan mutlaqo va butunlay mahrum bo'ladi.

en: The path described by the Projectile was evidently a line from the Earth to the Moon averaging somewhat less than ൣ൥ൡ,ൡൡൡ miles in length.
uz: Projektil tomonidan tasvirlangan yo'l Yerdan Oygacha bo'lgan yo'nalish bo'lib, o'rtacha uzunligi , mildan kam bo'lgan.

en: According as the distance between the Projectile and the Earth was increasing, the terrestrial attraction was diminishing in the ratio of the square of the distance, and the lunar attraction was augmenting in the same proportion.
uz: Projektil va Yer o'rtasidagi masofani ko'paytirgan sayin, yerdagi jozibadorlik masofani kvadratga nisbatan kamaygan va oydagi jozibadorlik ham o'sha nisbatda ko'paygan.

en: As before observed, the point was not now far off where, the two attractions counteracting each other, the bullet would actually weigh nothing at all.
uz: Avval ko'rganimizdek, ikki ta'sirchan narsa bir-biriga qarshi turganda, to'qnashuvning hech qanday og'irligi yo'q edi.

en: If the masses of the Earth and the Moon had been equal, this should evidently be found half way between the two bodies.
uz: Agar Yer va Oyning massasi teng bo'lgan bo'lsa, bu ikki jism o'rtasidagi o'rta yo'lda bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: But by making allowance for the difference of the respective masses, it was easy to calculate that this point would be situated at the ൪/ൢൡ of the total distance, or, in round numbers, at something less than ൣൢ൧,ൡൡൡ miles from the Earth.
uz: Ammo har bir masa farqini hisobga olgan holda, ushbu nuqta umumiy masofaning / da yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri raqamlarda Yerdan , mildan kamroq joyda joylashganini hisoblash oson edi.

en: At this point, a body that possessed no energy or principle of movement within itself, would remain forever, relatively motionless, suspended like Mahomet's coffin, being equally attracted by the two orbs and nothing impelling it in one direction rather than in the other.
uz: Shu payt ichida o'z ichiga energiya yoki harakat tamoyillariga ega bo'lmagan jism abadiy, nisbatan harakatsiz, Muhammadning ko'krakidan ko'rinadi va ikki ko'krak tomonidan teng darajada jalb qilinadi va hech narsa uni boshqa yo'nalishda emas, balki bir yo'nalishda harakatlantirmaydi.

en: Now the Projectile at this moment was nearing this point; if it reached it, what would be the consequence?
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda proyektil shu nuqtaga yaqinlashayotgan edi; agar u yerga yetib kelsa, natijasi qanday bo'ladi?

en: To this question three answers presented themselves, all possible under the circumstances, but very different in their results.
uz: Ushbu savolga uchta javob paydo bo'ldi, ularning barchasi sharoitlarda mumkin, ammo natijalari juda farq qiladi.

en: Suppose the Projectile to possess velocity enough to pass the neutral point.
uz: Aytaylik, proyektil neytral nuqtadan o'tish uchun etarlicha tezlikka ega.

en: In such case, it would undoubtedly proceed onward to the Moon, being drawn thither by Lunar attraction.
uz: Bunday holatda u shubhasiz o'z yo'lini o'tkazadi va oyning jozibadorligi tufayli o'sha yerga jalb qilinadi.

en: Suppose it lacked the requisite velocity for reaching the neutral point.
uz: Aytaylik, u neytral nuqtaga yetib borish uchun kerakli tezlikka ega bo'lmagan.

en: In such a case it would just as certainly fall back to the Earth, in obedience to the law of Terrestrial attraction.
uz: Bunday holatda u yerdagi jozibadorlik qonuniga bo'ysunib, Yerga qaytib keladi.

en: Suppose it to be animated by just sufficient velocity to reach the neutral point, but not to pass it.
uz: Aytaylik, u neytral nuqtaga yetib borishi uchun yetarlicha tezlikda harakatlanadi, lekin uni o'tkazib yubormaydi.

en: In that case, the Projectile would remain forever in the same spot, perfectly motionless as far as regards the Earth and the Moon, though of course following them both in their annual orbits round the Sun.
uz: Bunday holda, proyektil Yer va Oyga nisbatan to'liq harakatsiz, ammo, albatta, ularning har ikkalasi ham Quyosh atrofida yillik orbitalarida kuzatib boradi.

en: Such was now the state of things, which Barbican tried to explain to his friends, who, it need hardly be said, listened to his remarks with the most intense interest.
uz: Barbican o'z do'stlariga tushuntirib berishga harakat qilgan vaziyat shunday edi, ular, aytishning hojati yo'q, uning gaplarini diqqat bilan tinglashgan.

en: How were they to know, they asked him, the precise instant at which the Projectile would reach the neutral point?
uz: Ular unga: "Projektil neytral nuqtaga yetib boradigan aniq vaqtni qayerdan bilishlari mumkin?" - deb so'radilar.

en: That would be an easy matter, he assured them.
uz: Bu oson ish bo'ladi, deb ishontirdi u.

en: It would be at the very moment when both themselves and all the other objects contained in the Projectile would be completely free from every operation of the law of gravity; in other words, when everything would cease to have weight.
uz: Bu o'zlari ham, loyihada bo'lgan barcha boshqa ob'ektlar ham gravitatsiya qonuni har qanday operatsiyasidan to'liq ozod bo'lgan paytda bo'ladi; ya'ni hamma narsa o'z og'irligini yo'qotganda.

en: This gradual diminution of the action of gravity, the travellers had been for some time noticing, but they had not yet witnessed its total cessation.
uz: Bu yer yuzi gravitatsiyasining asta-sekin kamayishini sayohatchilar bir muncha vaqtdan beri kuzatishgan, ammo ular hali uning to'liq to'xtashini ko'rmagan edilar.

en: But that very morning, about an hour before noon, as the Captain was making some little experiment in Chemistry, he happened by accident to overturn a glass full of water.
uz: Ammo o'sha kuni ertalab, tushdan bir soat oldin, kapitan kimyo bo'yicha kichik tajriba o'tkazganida, u tasodifan suv bilan to'lgan stakanni burib yubordi.

en: What was his surprise at seeing that neither the glass nor the water fell to the floor!
uz: Shisha ham, suv ham yerga tushmaganini ko'rib, u qanchalik hayron qoldi!

en: Both remained suspended in the air almost completely motionless.
uz: Ikkalasi ham havoda to'xtab qolgan, deyarli butunlay harakatsiz edi.

en: "The prettiest experiment I ever saw!" cried Ardan; "let us have more of it!" And seizing the bottles, the arms, and the other objects in the Projectile, he arranged them around each other in the air with some regard to symmetry and proportion.
uz: "Men ko'rgan eng go'zal tajriba!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, "bizda ko'proq bo'lsin!" - deb aytdi va shishalar, qo'llar va o'z ichiga olgan boshqa narsalarni olib, ularni havonda simmetriya va nisbatga qarab bir-biriga aylantirdi.

en: The different articles, keeping strictly each in its own place, formed a very attractive group wonderful to behold.
uz: Turli maqolalar, har biri o'z joyida saqlanib, juda jozibali guruhni tashkil etdi.

en: Diana, placed in the apex of the pyramid, would remind you of those marvellous suspensions in the air performed by Houdin, Herman, and a few other first class wizards.
uz: piramidaning cho'qqisida joylashgan Diana sizga Houdin, Herman va boshqa bir necha birinchi darajali sehrgarlar tomonidan amalga oshirilgan ajoyib havo ostiga tushishlarni eslatadi.

en: Only being kept in her place without being hampered by invisible strings, the animal rather seemed to enjoy the exhibition, though in all probability she was hardly conscious of any thing unusual in her appearance.
uz: Faqat ko'rinmas iplar bilan to'sqinlik qilmasdan o'z joyida saqlanib qolgan hayvon ko'rgazmalardan zavqlanardi, garchi, ehtimol u o'z ko'rinishida hech qanday g'alati narsani bilmagan bo'lsa-da.

en: Our travellers had been fully prepared for such a phenomenon, yet it struck them with as much surprise as if they had never uttered a scientific reason to account for it.
uz: Sayohatchilarimiz bunday hodisa uchun to'liq tayyorgarlik ko'rishgan edi, ammo bu ularni hech qachon ilmiy sababni keltirib chiqarmaganlardek hayratda qoldirdi.

en: They saw that, no longer subject to the ordinary laws of nature, they were now entering the realms of the
uz: Ular tabiiy tabiat qonunlariga amal qilmay, endi o'zlarining olamlarga kirayotganlarini ko'rishdi.

en: They felt that their bodies were absolutely without weight.
uz: Ular o'zlarining tanasidan umuman hech qanday og'irlik yo'qligini his qilishardi.

en: Their arms, fully extended, no longer sought their sides.
uz: Ularning qo'llari to'liq uzilgan bo'lib, endi o'z tomonlarini izlamaydi.

en: Their heads oscillated unsteadily on their shoulders.
uz: Ularning boshlari omon qolmagan holda omon qolishdi.

en: Their feet no longer rested on the floor.
uz: Ularning oyoqlari yer ustida to'xtamaydi.

en: In their efforts to hold themselves straight, they looked like drunken men trying to maintain the perpendicular.
uz: O'zlarini to'g'ri tutishga intilishlarida, ular mast bo'lgan kishilarga o'xshaydilar, ular ustunlikni saqlab qolishga harakat qilishadi.

en: We have all read stories of some men deprived of the power of reflecting light and of others who could not cast a shadow.
uz: Biz hammamiz ayrim insonlarning nurni aks ettirish qobiliyatidan mahrum bo'lganlari va boshqalarning soyani ko'rsatishga qodir bo'lmaganlari haqidagi hikoyalarni o'qiganmiz.

en: But here reality, no fantastic story, showed you men who, through the counteraction of attractive forces, could tell no difference between light substances and heavy substances, and who absolutely had no weight whatever themselves!
uz: Ammo bu erda haqiqat, hech qanday fantastik hikoya emas, sizga jozibadorlik kuchlarining ta'siri bilan yengil moddalar va og'ir moddalar o'rtasidagi farqni aniq bilmaydigan va o'zlari hech qanday og'irlikni ko'rsatmagan odamlarni ko'rsatdi!

en: "Let us take graceful attitudes!" cried Ardan, "and imagine we are playing tableaux!
uz: Ardan: "Biz xushmuomala munosabatlarga ega bo'laylik va tasavvur qiling, biz rasmlar o'ynayapmiz!

en: Let us, for instance, form a grand historical group of the three great goddesses of the nineteenth century.
uz: Misol uchun, keling, o'n to'qqizinchi asrdagi uchta buyuk xudoxonadan iborat ulkan tarixiy guruhni tashkil qilaylik.
