en: Barbican will represent Minerva or Science; the Captain, Bellona or War; while I, as Madre Natura, the newly born goddess of Progress, floating gracefully over you both, extend my hands so, fondly patronizing the one, but grandly ordering off the other, to the regions of eternal night!
uz: Barbican Minerva yoki Fanni, kapitan, Bellona yoki Urushni ifodalaydi; men esa, Madre Natura, yangi tug'ilgan taraqqiyot xudosi sifatida ikkovingiz ustida mehribonlik bilan suzib yurgan holda, qo'llarimni shunday uzataman, birini mehribonlik bilan qo'llab-quvvatlayman, ammo ikkinchisini ulug'vorlik bilan hukm qilaman, abadiy tunning hududlariga!

en: More on your toe, Captain!
uz: Ko'proq to'g'rida bo'ling, kapitan!

en: Your right foot a little higher!
uz: O'ng oyoqingiz biroz yuqoriga chiqsin!

en: Look at Barbican's admirable pose!
uz: Barbicanning ajoyib pozitsiyasiga qarang!

en: Now then, prepare to receive orders for a new tableau!
uz: Endi, yangi jadval uchun buyurtma olish uchun tayyorlaning!

en: Form group à la Jardin Mabille!
uz: Mabille bog'ida guruhni shakllantirish!

en: Change!" In an instant, our travellers, changing attitudes, formed the new group with tolerable success.
uz: O'zgaring!" - degan so'zlarni eshitib, sayohatchilarimiz o'z nuqtai nazarini o'zgartirgan holda, yangi guruhni barqaror muvaffaqiyat bilan tashkil etishdi.

en: Even Barbican, who had been to Paris in his youth, yielding for a moment to the humor of the thing, acted the naif Anglais to the life.
uz: Hatto yoshligida Parijda bo'lgan Barbican ham o'z hayotida angliyalik kabi o'zini ko'rsatdi.

en: The Captain was frisky enough to remind you of a middle-aged Frenchman from the provinces, on a hasty visit to the capital for a few days' fun.
uz: Kapten sizga bir necha kunlik o'yin uchun poytaxtga shoshilinch tashrif buyurgan viloyatlardan bo'lgan o'rta yoshdagi frantsuzni eslatishga yetarlicha chiroyli bo'ldi.

en: Ardan was in raptures.
uz: Ardan o'z oldiga tushdi.

en: if Raphael could only see us!" he exclaimed in a kind of ecstasy.
uz: Rafael bizni ko'rsa edi!" - deb o'ziga xos ekstaziya bilan hayqirdi.

en: "He would paint such a picture as would throw all his other masterpieces in the shade!" "Knock spots out of the best of them by fifty per cent!" cried the Captain, gesticulating well enough à l'étudiant, but rather mixing his metaphors.
uz: "U o'zining boshqa mashhur asarlarini soyasida tashlaydigan bo'lgan rasm chizadi!" - deb hayqirdi kapitan, o'quvchiga yetarlicha qo'pol ish ko'rsatadi, lekin o'z metaforalari bilan aralashtiradi.

en: A GROUP A LA JARDIN MABILLE.
uz: LA JARDIN MABILLE guruhining guruhi.

en: "He should be pretty quick in getting through the job," observed Barbican, the first as usual to recover tranquillity.
uz: "U ishdan juda tez o'tishi kerak", - deb ta'kidladi Barbican, odatdagidek birinchi bo'lib tinchlikni tiklaydi.

en: "As soon as the Projectile will have passed the neutral point—in half an hour at longest—lunar attraction will draw us to the Moon." "We shall have to crawl on the ceiling then like flies," said Ardan.
uz: "Projektil neytral nuqtadan o'tib ketgandan so'ng, eng uzoq oy jozibadorligi bilan yarim soat ichida bizni oyga jalb qiladi.

en: "Not at all," said the Captain; "the Projectile, having its centre of gravity very low, will turn upside down by degrees." "Upside down!" cried Ardan.
uz: "Agar yo'q, - dedi kapitan; - G'arbat markazi juda past bo'lgani sababli, u darajadagi o'zgarishlarga qarab burilishga harakat qiladi. - Burilishga harakat qiling!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "That will be a nice mess!
uz: "Bu juda yaxshi tartibsizlik bo'ladi!

en: everything higgledy-piggledy!"
uz: hamma narsa baland-quruq bo'ladi!"

en: "No danger, friend Michael," said M'Nicholl; "there shall be no disorder whatever; nothing will quit its place; the movement of the Projectile will be effected by such slow degrees as to be imperceptible." "Yes," added Barbican, "as soon as we shall have passed the neutral point, the base of the Projectile, its heaviest part, will swing around gradually until it faces the Moon.
uz: "Xavf yo'q, do'stim Maykl, - dedi M'Nicholl, - qandaydir tartibsizlik bo'lmasligi kerak; hech narsa o'z o'rnidan chiqmaydi; O'g'ilning harakatlanishi ko'rinmas darajada sekin bo'ladi. - Ha, - dedi Barbican, - biz neytral nuqtani o'tgandan so'ng, O'g'ilning eng og'ir qismi bo'lgan poydevorining poydevorini oyga qaraydigancha asta-sekin aylantirib turadi.

en: Before this phenomenon, however, can take place, we must of course cross the line." "Cross the line!" cried the Frenchman; "then let us imitate the sailors when they do the same thing in the Atlantic Ocean!
uz: Biroq, bu hodisa yuz bermasidan oldin, biz, albatta, chegaralarni kesib o'tishimiz kerak". - "Chegaralarni kesib o'tish!" - deb baqirdi frantsuz. - Shunday bo'lsa-da, Atlantika okeanida ham xuddi shunday harakat qilayotgan kemachilarni taqlid qilaylik!

en: Splice the main brace!" A slight effort carried him sailing over to the side of the Projectile.
uz: Asosiy shishqoqni bo'ling!" - deb unga kichik bir urinish bilan o'zini Projectilning yon tomonida ko'tardi.

en: Opening a cupboard and taking out a bottle and a few glasses, he placed them on a tray.
uz: U omborni ochib, bir shisha va bir necha shishalarni olib chiqib, ularni sovg'a ustiga qo'ydi.

en: Then setting the tray itself in the air as on a table in front of his companions, he filled the glasses, passed them around, and, in a lively speech interrupted with many a joyous hurrah, congratulated his companions on their glorious achievement in being the first that ever crossed the lunar line.
uz: So'ng u o'zining do'stlari oldida stol ustida o'rnatgan sovg'ani havoga ko'tardi, ko'zgularni to'ldirdi, ularni o'tkazdi va ko'p quvonchli hurra bilan kesilgan jonli nutqda do'stlarini oy chizig'ini birinchi o'tkazib o'tgan ulug'vor yutuqlari uchun tabrikladi.

en: This counteracting influence of the attractions lasted nearly an hour.
uz: Ushbu diqqatga sazovor joylarning ta'sirini bartaraf etish deyarli bir soat davom etdi.

en: By that time the travellers could keep themselves on the floor without much effort.
uz: O'sha paytgacha sayohatchilar o'zlarini katta harakatlar qilmasdan, yer ustida ushlab turishlari mumkin edi.

en: Barbican also made his companions remark that the conical point of the Projectile diverged a little from the direct line to the Moon, while by an inverse movement, as they could notice through the window of the floor, the base was gradually turning away from the Earth.
uz: Barbican o'z hamkorlariga, "Projektil"ning shkafli nuqtasi oyga o'xshash to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiziqdan biroz farq qilganini aytdi, lekin ular yerning oynasidan ko'rishganidek, o'zlarining harakatlari bilan baza asta-sekin Yerdan uzoqlashayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: The Lunar attraction was evidently getting the better of the Terrestrial.
uz: O'z navbatida, oyning jozibadorligi Yerdagilardan ustun bo'lib borayotgan edi.

en: The fall towards the Moon, though still almost insensible, was certainly beginning.
uz: Oʻshanda hali ham deyarli hissiyotsiz boʻlsa-da, oʻsha paytda oyga qarab tushib ketish boshlanayotgan edi.

en: It could not be more than the eightieth part of an inch in the first second.
uz: Birinchi soniyada bu santimetrning sakkizdan bir qismidan ko'p bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: But by degrees, as the attractive force would increase, the fall would be more decided, and the Projectile, overbalanced by its base, and presenting its cone to the Earth, would descend with accelerated velocity to the Lunar surface.
uz: Ammo asta-sekin, jozibadorlik kuchi ko'paygan sari, tushib ketish yanada aniq bo'ladi va Projectile o'z asosidan ortiqcha muvozanatga ega bo'lib, uning koni Yerga ko'rinadi va tezlashtirilgan tezlikda oy yuziga tushadi.

en: The object of their daring attempt would then be successfully attained.
uz: Keyin ularning jasoratli urinishlarining maqsadi muvaffaqiyatli erishildi.

en: No further obstacle, therefore, being likely to stand in the way of the complete success of the enterprise, the Captain and the Frenchman cordially shook hands with Barbican, all kept congratulating each other on their good fortune as long as the bottle lasted.
uz: Shuning uchun, hech qanday to'siq yo'q bo'lib, ushbu tadbirning to'liq muvaffaqiyatiga to'sqinlik qilmaydi, shuning uchun kapitan va frantsuzlar Barbican bilan qo'l urishdi va shisha davom etgani uchun bir-birlarini omadlari uchun tabriklashdi.

en: They could not talk enough about the wonderful phenomenon lately witnessed; the chief point, the neutralization of the law of gravity, particularly, supplied them with an inexhaustible subject.
uz: Ular yaqinda ko'rgan ajoyib hodisa haqida yetarlicha gapira olishmadi; asosiy nuqta, ayniqsa, gravitatsiya qonuni beqarorligi, ularga tugamaydigan mavzu bilan ta'minlandi.

en: The Frenchman, as usual, as enthusiastic in his fancy, as he was fanciful in his enthusiasm, got off some characteristic remarks.
uz: Fransiyalik, odatdagidek, o'zining zavq-e'tiborini va zavq-e'tiborini o'ziga jalb qilgan bo'lsa-da, ba'zi o'ziga xos so'zlarni aytdi.

en: "What a fine thing it would be, my boys," he exclaimed, "if on Earth we could be so fortunate as we have been here, and get rid of that weight that keeps us down like lead, that rivets us to it like an adamantine chain!
uz: U: "Boshqalarim, agar Yer yuzida biz bu yerda bo'lganimiz kabi omadli bo'lib, bizni olov kabi quvib qo'ygan va adamantin zanjir kabi unga bog'lagan og'irlikni yo'q qilsak, bu naqadar yaxshi bo'lardi!

en: Then should we prisoners become free!
uz: O'shanda biz mahbuslar ozod bo'lishimiz kerak!

en: Adieu forever to all weariness of arms or feet!
uz: Qo'llar yoki oyoqlar bilan charchagan har qanday ishdan abadiy adieu!

en: At present, in order to fly over the surface of the Earth by the simple exertion of our muscles or even to sustain ourselves in the air, we require a muscular force fifty times greater than we possess; but if attraction did not exist, the simplest act of the will, our slightest whim even, would be sufficient to transport us to whatever part of space we wished to visit." "Ardan, you had better invent something to kill attraction," observed M'Nicholl drily; "you can do it if you try.
uz: Hozirgi kunda, mushaklarimizning oddiy kuchi bilan Yer yuzi ustida uchish yoki hatto havoda o'zimizni saqlab qolish uchun bizda mavjud bo'lganidan ellik baravar ko'proq mushak kuchi kerak; lekin agar jalb mavjud bo'lmasa, eng sodda irodasining amallari, hatto eng kichik g'ayratimiz ham bizni ko'rish istagan kosmosning har qanday qismiga olib ketish uchun etarli bo'ladi". "Ardan, siz jozibadorlikni o'ldirish uchun biron bir narsani ixtiro qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi", - dedi M'Nicholl quruqlik bilan; "agar siz harakat qilsangiz, buni qila olasiz.

en: Jackson and Morton have killed pain by sulphuric ether.
uz: Jekson va Morton sulfur eteri yordamida og'riqni o'ldirgan.

en: Suppose you try your hand on attraction!" "It would be worth a trial!" cried Ardan, so full of his subject as not to notice the Captain's jeering tone; "attraction once destroyed, there is an end forever to all loads, packs and burdens!
uz: Aytaylik, siz jozibadorlikni sinab ko'ryapsiz!" - deb hayqirib yubordi Ardan, uning mavzusi bilan shunchalik to'lib-toshganki, kapitanning masxaralash tonini ko'rmaydi; "jozibadorlik bir marta yo'q qilinganida, barcha yuklar, to'plamlar va og'irliklar abadiy yo'q bo'ladi!

en: How the poor omnibus horses would rejoice!
uz: Yomon omnibus otlari qanchalik xursand bo'lishlari mumkin!

en: Adieu forever to all cranes, derricks, capstans, jack-screws, and even hotel-elevators!
uz: Barcha kranlar, derriklar, capstanslar, jack-screws va hatto mehmonxona liftlariga abadiy salom!

en: We could dispense with all ladders, door steps, and even stair-cases!" "And with all houses too," interrupted Barbican; "or, at least, we should dispense with them because we could not have them.
uz: "Va barcha uylar bilan ham", - dedi Barbican, "yoki hech bo'lmaganda, biz ulardan voz kechishimiz kerak, chunki biz ulardan voz kechishimiz mumkin emas.

en: If there was no weight, you could neither make a wall of bricks nor cover your house with a roof.
uz: Agar og'irlik bo'lmaganida, siz ne toshdan devor qurib, na uyingizni tom bilan qoplay olmas edingiz.

en: Even your hat would not stay on your head.
uz: Hatto boshingizdagi to'pka ham sizda qolmaydi.

en: The cars would not stay on the railway nor the boats on the water.
uz: Avtomobillar temir yo'lda qolmaydi, qayiqlar ham suvda qolmaydi.

en: We could not have any water.
uz: Biz suvga ega bo'lmadik.

en: Even the Ocean would leave its bed and float away into space.
uz: Hatto okean ham o'z yotoqidan chiqib, ko'kka ko'tariladi.

en: Nay, the atmosphere itself would leave us, being detained in its place by terrestrial attraction and by nothing else." "Too true, Mr.
uz: Yoʻq, atmosfera oʻzidan bizni tark etadi, yerdagi jozibadorlik va boshqa hech narsa tufayli oʻz oʻrnida saqlanib qoladi.

en: President," replied Ardan after a pause.
uz: Prezident", - deb javob berdi Ardan biroz to'xtab qolganidan so'ng.

en: I acknowledge the corn, as Marston says.
uz: Marston aytganidek, men donni tan olaman.

en: But how you positive fellows do knock holes into our pretty little creations of fancy!"
uz: Ammo siz ijobiy kishilar chiroyli yaratilishlarimizga qanday teshik qo'yishingiz mumkin!

en: "Don't feel so bad about it, Ardan;" observed M'Nicholl; "though there may be no orb from which gravity is excluded altogether, we shall soon land in one, where it is much less powerful than on the Earth." "You mean the Moon!" "Yes, the Moon.
uz: M'Nicholl: "O'zingni yomon his qilma, Ardan", - deb ta'kidladi. - Garchi gravitatsiyani butunlay chetga qo'yib qo'yishga imkon bo'lmasa-da, tez orada u Yerdagiga qaraganda ancha kamroq kuchli bo'lgan bir qirg'oqqa tushib ketamiz.

en: Her mass being ൢ/൩൪ of the Earth's, her attractive power should be in the same proportion; that is, a boy ൢൡ years old, whose weight on Earth is about ൪ൡ lbs., would weigh on the Moon only about ൢ pound, if nothing else were to be taken into consideration.
uz: Uning massasi Yerning massasidan / bo'lgani uchun uning jozibadorligi ham shu nisbatda bo'lishi kerak; ya'ni, Yerda og'irligi taxminan  funt bo'lgan  yoshli bola oyda faqat taxminan  funtni og'irlaydi, agar boshqa hech narsa hisobga olinmasa.

en: But when standing on the surface of the Moon, he is relatively ൥ times nearer to the centre than when he is standing on the surface of the Earth.
uz: Ammo u oy yuzasida turganida, u Yer yuzasida turganidan ko'ra markazga nisbatan  marta yaqinroq turadi.

en: His weight, therefore, having to be increased by the square of the distance, must be sixteen times greater.
uz: Shuning uchun uning og'irligi masofaning kvadratidan ko'payishi uchun o'n olti baravar katta bo'lishi kerak.

en: Now ൢ൧ times ൢ/൩൪ being less than ൢ/൦, it is clear that my weight of ൢ൦ൡ pounds will be cut down to nearly ൤ൡ as soon as we reach the Moon's surface." "And mine?" asked Ardan.
uz: x /  dan kam bo'lganligi sababli, o'zimning / ga teng bo'lgan og'irligim oy yuziga yetganimizdan so'ng deyarli  gacha kamayishi aniq.

en: "Yours will hardly reach ൣ൦ pounds, I should think," was the reply.
uz: "Seningkilar deyarli  kilogrammga yetmaydi, deb o'ylayman", deb javob berdilar.

en: "Shall my muscular strength diminish in the same proportion?" was the next question.
uz: Keyingi savol: "Mening mushaklar kuchi ham shu nisbatda pasayadimi?" edi.

en: "On the contrary, it will be relatively so much the more increased that you can take a stride ൢ൦ feet in width as easily as you can now take one of ordinary length." "We shall be all Samsons, then, in the Moon!" cried Ardan.
uz: - Aksincha, u nisbatan shunchalik ko'payadiki, siz oddiy uzunlikdagi bir qadamni o'tishingiz mumkin bo'lganidek, bir qadam o'tishingiz mumkin bo'ladi. - Biz hammamiz oyda Samson bo'lamiz! - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "Especially," replied M'Nicholl, "if the stature of the Selenites is in proportion to the mass of their globe." "If so, what should be their height?" "A tall man would hardly be twelve inches in his boots!" "They must be veritable Lilliputians then!" cried Ardan; "and we are all to be Gullivers!
uz: M'Nicholl javob berdi: "Agar Selenitlarning balandligi ularning yer yuzi massasiga nisbatda bo'lsa, ayniqsa", - dedi M'Nicholl. "Agar shunday bo'lsa, ularning balandligi qancha bo'lishi kerak?"

en: The old myth of the Giants realized!
uz: Ulug'larning qadimgi afsoni amalga oshdi!

en: Perhaps the Titans that played such famous parts in the prehistoric period of our Earth, were adventurers like ourselves, casually arrived from some great planet!" "Not from such planets as Mercury, Venus or Mars anyhow, friend Michael," observed Barbican.
uz: Ehtimol, bizning Yerimiz tarixiy davrida shu kabi mashhur rol o'ynagan Titanlar biz kabi sarguzashtchilar bo'lgan, ular befarq holda biron bir buyuk sayyondan kelishgan!" - deb aytdi Barbican.

en: "But the inhabitants of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, or Neptune, if they bear the same proportion to their planet that we do ours, must certainly be regular Brobdignagians."
uz: "Ammo Jupiter, Saturn, Uran yoki Neptunning aholisi, agar ular bizning sayyoramizga teng bo'lsa, albatta ular doimiy Brobdignagians bo'lishi kerak".

en: "Let us keep severely away from all planets of the latter class then," said Ardan.
uz: Ardan shunday dedi: "O'shanda oxirgi sinfdagi barcha sayyoralardan juda uzoqda turaylik.

en: "I never liked to play the part of Lilliputian myself.
uz: "Men o'zim Lilliputian rolini o'ynashni hech qachon yoqtirmaganman.

en: But how about the Sun, Barbican?
uz: Ammo Quyoshga nima deyish mumkin, Barbican?

en: I always had a hankering after the Sun!" "The Sun's volume is about ൢ-ൢ/൤ million times greater than that of the Earth, but his density being only about ൢ/൥, the attraction on his surface is hardly ൤ൡ times greater than that of our globe.
uz: Men doimo Quyoshni orzu qilardim!" "K Quyoshning hajmi Yerning hajmiga qaraganda qariyb -/ million marta katta, ammo uning zichligi faqat / atrofida bo'lgani sababli, uning yuzasidagi jozibadorlik bizning sayyoramizning hajmiga qaraganda deyarli - marta katta emas.

en: Still, every proportion observed, the inhabitants of the Sun can't be much less than ൢ൦ൡ or ൢ൧ൡ feet in height." "Mille tonnerres!" cried Ardan, "I should be there like Ulysses among the Cyclops!
uz: Shunga qaramay, ko'rgan har bir nisbatda Quyosh aholisi balandligida  yoki  futdan kam bo'lishi mumkin emas". "Mille tonnerres!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, "Men u erda Sikloplar orasida Ulysses kabi bo'lishim kerak edi!

en: I'll tell you what it is, Barbican; if we ever decide on going to the Sun, we must provide ourselves before hand with a few of your Rodman's Columbiads to frighten off the Solarians!" "Your Columbiads would not do great execution there," observed M'Nicholl; "your bullet would be hardly out of the barrel when it would drop to the surface like a heavy stone pushed off the wall of a house." "Oh!
uz: Men sizga nima ekanligini aytaman, Barbican; agar biz bir kun quyoshga borishga qaror qilsak, sizlarning bir nechta Rodman Kolumbiadlaringiz bilan Solariyaliklarni qo'rqitish uchun o'zimiz bilan birga bo'lishimiz kerak! - deb aytdi M'Nicholl. - Kolumbiadlaringiz u erda katta o'ldirishni amalga oshirmaydilar, - dedi M'Nicholl. - Sizning o'qingiz uy devoridan shovgan og'ir tosh kabi yuzaga tushganda, toshingiz barreldan chiqmaydi.

en: I like that!" laughed the incredulous Ardan.
uz: Menga yoqadi!" - deb kulgan kofir Ardan.

en: "A little calculation, however, shows the Captain's remark to be perfectly just," said Barbican.
uz: "Agar bir oz hisob-kitob qilsak, kapitanning so'zlari to'liq adolatli ekanligini ko'rsatadi", dedi Barbican.

en: "Rodman's ordinary ൢ൦ inch Columbiad requires a charge of ൢൡൡ pounds of mammoth powder to throw a ball of ൦ൡൡ pounds weight.
uz: "Rodmanning odatiy  dyuymli Kolumbiadi uchun  funt og'irlikdagi topni tashlash uchun  funt mammut kukunining yuklanishi kerak.

en: What could such a charge do with a ball weighing ൤ൡ times as much or ൢ൦,ൡൡൡ pounds?
uz: Bunday yuklama toshning og'irligi  marta ko'p yoki , kilogramm bo'lgan top bilan nima qilishi mumkin?

en: Reflect on the enormous weight everything must have on the surface of the Sun!
uz: Quyosh yuzidagi hamma narsa qanchalik og'ir bo'lishi kerakligini o'ylab ko'ring!

en: Your hat, for instance, would weigh ൣൡ or ൤ൡ pounds.
uz: Misol uchun, sizning to'pqangiz  yoki  funtni og'irlaydi.

en: Your cigar nearly a pound.
uz: Sizning sigarangiz deyarli bir funtga yaqin.

en: In short, your own weight on the Sun's surface would be so great, more than two tons, that if you ever fell you should never be able to pick yourself up again!" "Yes," added the Captain, "and whenever you wanted to eat or drink you should rig up a set of powerful machinery to hoist the eatables and drinkables into your mouth." "Enough of the Sun to-day, boys!" cried Ardan, shrugging his shoulders; "I don't contemplate going there at present.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, quyosh yuzidagi sizning o'zingizning og'irligingiz juda katta bo'ladi, ikki tonnadan ortiq, agar siz hech qachon qulab tushsangiz, hech qachon o'zingizni qayta ko'tarishingiz mumkin emas! "Ha, - dedi kapitan, - va har safar ovqatlanish yoki ichish istagingiz bo'lganda, siz o'zingizning og'zingizga ovqat va ichimlik mahsulotlarini ko'tarish uchun kuchli mashinalar to'plamasini o'rnatishingiz kerak.

en: Let us be satisfied with the Moon!
uz: Keling, oy bilan qanoat qilaylik!

en: There, at least, we shall be of some account!"
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, u erda biz biron bir ahamiyatga ega bo'lamiz!"

en: A LITTLE OFF THE TRACK.
uz: Tirikdan bir oz chetlash.

en: Barbican's mind was now completely at rest at least on one subject.
uz: Endi Barbicanning ongi hech bo'lmaganda bitta mavzuda to'liq xotirjam edi.

en: The original force of the discharge had been great enough to send the Projectile beyond the neutral line.
uz: Tushkunlikning dastlabki kuch-quvvatlari raketalarni neytral chiziqdan tashqariga jo'natish uchun etarlicha katta edi.

en: Therefore, there was no longer any danger of its falling back to the Earth.
uz: Shuning uchun uning Yerga qaytishi xavfi yo'q edi.

en: Therefore, there was no longer any danger of its resting eternally motionless on the point of the counteracting attractions.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'zaro bog'liq bo'lgan diqqatga sazovor joylarda u abadiy harakatsiz qolishi xavfi yo'q edi.

en: The next subject to engage his attention was the question: would the Projectile, under the influence of lunar attraction, succeed in reaching its destination?
uz: Uning e'tiborini jalb qilish uchun keyingi mavzu quyidagi savol edi: oyni jalb qilish ta'siri ostida o'z maqsadiga yetib boradimi?

en: The only way in which it could succeed was by falling through a space of nearly ൣ൥,ൡൡൡ miles and then striking the Moon's surface.
uz: Uni muvaffaqiyatga erishishning yagona yo'li deyarli , millik bo'shliq orqali tushib, oy yuziga tushib ketish edi.

en: A most terrific fall!
uz: Eng dahshatli tushib ketish!

en: Even taking the lunar attraction to be only the one- sixth of the Earth's, such a fall was simply bewildering to think of.
uz: Hatto oyning chiroyliligi Yerning oltinidan bir qismiga teng bo'lsa-da, bunday tushib ketish haqida o'ylash g'alati edi.

en: The greatest height to which a balloon ever ascended was seven miles (Glaisher, ൢ൩൧ൣ).
uz: Balonning eng katta balandligi yetti mil (Glaisher, ) edi.

en: Imagine a fall from even that distance!
uz: Hatto shu masofadan tushib tushishni tasavvur qiling!

en: Then imagine a fall from a height of four thousand miles!
uz: O'shanda to'rt ming mil balandlikdan tushib tushib ketishni tasavvur qiling!

en: Yet it was for a fall of this appalling kind on the surface of the Moon that the travellers had now to prepare themselves.
uz: Biroq, sayohatchilar o'zlarini hozir o'zlari tayyorlashi kerak bo'lgan oy yuziga bunday dahshatli tushib tushish uchun edi.

en: Instead of avoiding it, however, they eagerly desired it and would be very much disappointed if they missed it.
uz: Biroq, ular undan qochishning o'rniga, uni juda xohlashgan va uni o'tkazib yuborishsa, juda xafa bo'lishgan.

en: They had taken the best precautions they could devise to guard against the terrific shock.
uz: Ular dahshatli shokdan himoyalanish uchun qo'ldan kelganicha eng yaxshi ehtiyot choralarini ko'rishgan.

en: These were mainly of two kinds: one was intended to counteract as much as possible the fearful results to be expected the instant the Projectile
uz: Bular asosan ikki turdagi edi: bittasi Projectile-ning o'tishi bilan kutilishi mumkin bo'lgan dahshatli natijalarga iloji boricha ko'proq qarshilik ko'rsatish uchun mo'ljallangan edi.

en: touched the lunar surface; the other, to retard the velocity of the fall itself, and thereby to render it less violent.
uz: O'sha paytda u oy yuziga tushibdi, ikkinchisi esa tushib ketish tezligini pasaytirish uchun va shu yo'sin uni kamroq zo'ravon qilish uchun.

en: The best arrangement of the first kind was certainly Barbican's water-contrivance for counteracting the shock at starting, which has been so fully described in our former volume.
uz: Birinchi turdagi eng yaxshi moslama, shubhasiz, Barbicanning avvalgi jildimizda to'liq tasvirlangan, boshlangandagi shokga qarshi kurashish uchun suv bilan ta'minlangan qo'llanmasi edi.

en: (See Baltimore Gun Club, page ൤൦൤.) But unfortunately it could be no longer employed.
uz: Ammo afsuski, u endi ishlatilmaydi.

en: Even if the partitions were in working order, the water—two thousand pounds in weight had been required—was no longer to be had.
uz: Hatto devorlar ishlashi mumkin bo'lganida ham, kerak bo'lgan 2 ming funtlik suv endi mavjud emas edi.

en: The little still left in the tanks was of no account for such a purpose.
uz: Tanklarda qolgan kichik narsalar bunday maqsad uchun hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas edi.

en: Besides, they had not a single drop of the precious liquid to spare, for they were as yet anything but sanguine regarding the facility of finding water on the Moon's surface.
uz: Bundan tashqari, ular uchun qimmatbaho suyuqlikning bir tomchi ham qolmadi, chunki ular o'zlarining oy yuzasida suv topish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishlariga amin bo'lishmagan.

en: Fortunately, however, as the gentle reader may remember, Barbican, besides using water to break the concussion, had provided the movable disc with stout pillars containing a strong buffing apparatus, intended to protect it from striking the bottom too violently after the destruction of the different partitions.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, mehribon o'quvchi eslab qolishi mumkin bo'lganidek, Barbican o'ziga xos diskni suv bilan buzishdan tashqari, turli bo'limlar yo'q bo'lganidan keyin pastki qismini juda qattiq urishdan himoya qilish uchun kuchli buffning usuli mavjud bo'lgan kuchli ustunlar bilan ta'minlagan.

en: These buffers were still good, and, gravity being as yet almost imperceptible, to put them once more in order and adjust them to the disc was not a difficult task.
uz: Ushbu buferlar hali ham yaxshi edi va gravitatsiya hali ham deyarli ko'rinmas edi, shuning uchun ularni yana bir bor tartibga solish va diskga moslashtirish qiyin bo'lmagan.

en: The travellers set to work at once and soon accomplished it.
uz: Sayohatchilar darhol ishga tushishdi va tez orada buni amalga oshirdilar.

en: The different pieces were put together readily—a mere matter of bolts and screws, with plenty of tools to manage them.
uz: Turli bo'laklar osonlikcha bir-biriga qo'shildi - bu boltlar va burchaklar bilan bog'liq bo'lgan, ularni boshqarish uchun juda ko'p vositalar mavjud edi.

en: In a short time the repaired disc rested on its steel buffers, like a table on its legs, or rather like a sofa seat on its springs.
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida tuzatilgan disk uning po'latli buferlariga, oyoqlarida stol kabi, yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sofa o'rindiqlariga o'xshaydi.

en: The new arrangement was attended with at least one disadvantage.
uz: Yangi tuzum kamida bitta kamchilik bilan ta'minlandi.

en: The bottom light being covered up, a convenient view of the Moon's surface could not be had as soon as they should begin to fall in a perpendicular descent.
uz: Chindan ham, quyoshning pastki yorug'ligi qoplangan bo'lgani uchun, oyning yuzi perpendikulyar tarzda tushib ketayotganidan so'ng qulay ko'rinishga ega bo'lmaydi.

en: This, however, was only a slight matter, as the side lights would permit the adventurers to enjoy quite as favorable a view of the vast regions of the Moon as is afforded to balloon travellers when looking down on the Earth over the sides of their car.
uz: Biroq, bu kichik masala edi, chunki yon chiroqlar sarguzashtchilarga oyning keng mintaqalarining ko'rinishlarini o'zlarining avtomobillarining yon tomonlaridan Yerga qarab turganda ballon bilan sayohatchilarga berilgan qulay ko'rinishlardan bahramand bo'lishga imkon beradi.

en: The disc arrangement was completed in about an hour, but it was not till past twelve o'clock before things were restored to their usual order.
uz: Diskni tuzish taxminan bir soat ichida yakunlandi, ammo soat o'n ikki o'tgach, hamma narsa odatdagi tartibga qaytdi.

en: Barbican then tried to make fresh observations regarding the inclination of the Projectile; but to his very decided chagrin he found that it had not yet turned over sufficiently to commence the
uz: Keyin Barbican o'z navbatida, o'g'ilning bo'yin-joyini ko'rib chiqishga harakat qildi; ammo o'zining qat'iy g'amginligiga ko'ra, u o'z boshini boshlash uchun yetarlicha o'girilmaganini topdi.

en: perpendicular fall: on the contrary, it even seemed to be following a curve rather parallel with that of the lunar disc.
uz: Tegishli tushib tushish: aksincha, u hatto oy diskining egasi bilan biroz parallel bo'lgan egri chiziqni o'z ichiga olgan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: The Queen of the Stars now glittered with a light more dazzling than ever, whilst from an opposite part of the sky the glorious King of Day flooded her with his fires.
uz: Yulduzlarning Qiroli endi har qachongidan ko'ra ko'proq yorug'lik bilan parlashar edi, kunning ulug'vor Shohi esa osmonning boshqa qismidan uni o'z olovlari bilan to'ldirdi.

en: The situation began to look a little serious.
uz: Vaziyat biroz jiddiy ko'rinishni boshladi.

en: "Shall we ever get there!" asked the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Biz u yerga yetib boramizmi?" - deb so'radi.

en: "Let us be prepared for getting there, any how," was Barbican's dubious reply.
uz: "Biz u yerga qanday qilib ham yetib borishga tayyor bo'laylik", - deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "You're a pretty pair of suspenders," said Ardan cheerily (he meant of course doubting hesitators, but his fluent command of English sometimes led him into such solecisms).
uz: "Siz chiroyli bir juft qo'riqchilarsiz", - dedi Ardan hayajon bilan (u, albatta, shubha ostiga qo'yganlarni nazarda tutgan, ammo uning ingliz tilini yaxshi bilishi uni ba'zan bunday solikchiliklarga olib boradi).

en: "Certainly we shall get there—and perhaps a little sooner than will be good for us." This reply sharply recalled Barbican to the task he had undertaken, and he now went to work seriously, trying to combine arrangements to break the fall.
uz: Bu javob Barbicanni o'zi boshdan kechirgan vazifani eslatdi va u endi jiddiy ravishda ishga tushdi va to'siqni buzish uchun tadbirlarni birlashtirishga harakat qildi.

en: The reader may perhaps remember Ardan's reply to the Captain on the day of the famous meeting in Tampa.
uz: O'quvchi, ehtimol, Tampadagi mashhur uchrashuv kuni Ardanning kapitanga bergan javobini eslaydi.

en: "Your fall would be violent enough," the Captain had urged, "to splinter you like glass into a thousand fragments." "And what shall prevent me," had been Ardan's ready reply, "from breaking my fall by means of counteracting rockets suitably disposed, and let off at the proper time?" The practical utility of this idea had at once impressed Barbican.
uz: Kapten: "Sizning tushib ketishingiz sizni shisha kabi mingta bo'lak-bo'lakga bo'lib yubora oladigan darajada dahshatli bo'ladi", - deb rag'batlantirgan edi. "Menga nima to'sqinlik qiladi", - degan Ardanning tayyor javobini berdi Ardan: "Men tushib ketishimni kerakli joyda o'rnatilgan raketalarga qarshi kurashish orqali va o'z vaqtida qo'yib yuborishdan to'sqinlik qilaman?" - deb aytdi.

en: It could hardly be doubted that powerful rockets, fastened on the outside to the bottom of the Projectile, could, when discharged, considerably retard the velocity of the fall by their sturdy recoil.
uz: O'zlarining kuchli orqaga qaytishi bilan kuchli raketalar o'tkazib yuborilganida, ular o'zlarining kuchli orqaga qaytishi bilan tushib ketish tezligini sezilarli darajada pasaytirishi mumkinligiga shubha tug'dirilmagan.

en: They could burn in a vacuum by means of oxygen furnished by themselves, as powder burns in the chamber of a gun, or as the volcanoes of the Moon continue their action regardless of the absence of a lunar atmosphere.
uz: Ular o'zlari tomonidan taqdim etilgan kislorod orqali bo'sh joyda yonishlari mumkin, qurol kamerasida chang yonishi yoki oy volkanlari oy atrofidagi atmosfera yo'qligidan qat'i nazar harakatini davom ettirishlari mumkin.

en: Barbican had therefore provided himself with rockets enclosed in strong steel gun barrels, grooved on the outside so that they could be screwed into corresponding holes already made with much care in the bottom of the Projectile.
uz: Shuning uchun Barbican o'ziga kuchli po'lat barrellarida o'rnatilgan raketalar bilan ta'minlangan edi, ular tashqi tomondan o'rnatilgan bo'lib, ular allaqachon o'rnatilgan chuqurliklarga o'rnatilishi mumkin edi.

en: They were just long enough, when flush with the floor inside, to project outside by about six inches.
uz: Ular chindan ham o'n dyuymgacha tashqariga ko'tarilish uchun, ichidagi qavatni ko'targanida, etarlicha uzun edi.

en: They were twenty in number, and formed two concentric circles
uz: Ular yigirma kishidan iborat bo'lib, ikkita konsentrik to'plamni tashkil etishgan.

en: around the dead light.
uz: O'lik nur atrofida.

en: Small holes in the disc gave admission to the wires by which each of the rockets was to be discharged externally by electricity.
uz: Diskdagi kichik teshiklar har bir raketa elektr energiyasi bilan tashqi tomondan chiqariladigan simlarga kirish imkonini berdi.

en: The whole effect was therefore to be confined to the outside.
uz: Shuning uchun butun ta'sir tashqi tomonga cheklanishi kerak edi.

en: The mixtures having been already carefully deposited in each barrel, nothing further need be done than to take away the metallic plugs which had been screwed into the bottom of the Projectile, and replace them by the rockets, every one of which was found to fit its grooved chamber with rigid exactness.
uz: Bu aralashmalar allaqachon har bir donga ehtiyotkorlik bilan joylashtirilganligi sababli, o'z ichiga projektilning pastki qismiga tuxumlangan metall to'plamlarni olib tashlashdan boshqa hech narsa qilishning hojati yo'q va ularni raketalar bilan almashtirish kerak, ularning har biri o'z bo'lak chamasiga qat'iy aniqlik bilan mos keladi.

en: This evidently should have been all done before the disc had been finally laid on its springs.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, bularning barchasi disk oxiriga qadar o'z manzillariga qo'yilishidan oldin amalga oshirilishi kerak edi.

en: But as this had to be lifted up again in order to reach the bottom of the Projectile, more work was to be done than was strictly necessary.
uz: Ammo, o'g'ilning pastki qismiga yetib borish uchun uni yana ko'tarib olish kerak bo'lgani uchun, kerakli bo'lganidan ko'proq ish bajarilishi kerak edi.

en: Though the labor was not very hard, considering that gravity had as yet scarcely made itself felt, M'Nicholl and Ardan were not sorry to have their little joke at Barbican's expense.
uz: Garchi mehnat juda qiyin bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da, chunki gravitatsiya hali ham o'zini his qilmagan edi, ammo M'Nicholl va Ardan o'zlarining kichkina hazilini Barbicanning zararidan o'tkazishdan afsuslanmadilar.

en: The Frenchman began humming "Aliquandoque bonus dormitat Homerus," to a tune from Orphée aux Enfers, and the Captain said something about the Philadelphia Highway Commissioners who pave a street one day, and tear it up the next to lay the gas pipes.
uz: Fransiyalik kishi Orphée aux Enfers qo'shiqidan "Aliquandoque bonus dormitat Homerus", deb qichqiriq boshladi va kapitan bir kuni ko'chaga yo'l ochib, keyingi kuni gaz quvurlarini qo'yish uchun uni parchalab tashlagan Filadelfiya yo'l komisarlari haqida gapirdi.

en: But his friends' humor was all lost on Barbican, who was so wrapped up in his work that he probably never heard a word they said.
uz: Ammo uning do'stlarining humorlari Barbican bilan bo'sh edi, chunki u o'z ishi bilan shunchalik band ediki, ehtimol, ularning so'zlarini hech qachon eshitmagan.

en: Towards three o'clock every preparation was made, every possible precaution taken, and now our bold adventurers had nothing more to do than watch and wait.
uz: Soat uchga yaqin har qanday tayyorgarlik ko'rildi, barcha ehtiyotkorlik choralari ko'rildi va endi jasoratli sarguzashtchilarimiz ko'z-ko'z qilib kutishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmadilar.

en: The Projectile was certainly approaching the Moon.
uz: O'g'illar o'g'li o'g'illari bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'illar bilan birga o'g'rashdi.

en: It had by this time turned over considerably under the influence of attraction, but its own original motion still followed a decidedly oblique direction.
uz: O'sha paytgacha u jozibadorlikning ta'siri ostida sezilarli darajada o'zgargan edi, ammo uning o'z dastlabki harakatlari hali ham qat'iy ravishda oblikviy yo'nalishda davom etgan.

en: The consequence of these two forces might possibly be a tangent, line approaching the edge of the Moon's disc.
uz: Ushbu ikki kuchning natijasi, ehtimol, oy diskining chegarasiga yaqinlashadigan tangent chiziq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: One thing was certain: the Projectile had not yet commenced to fall directly towards her surface; its base, in which its centre of gravity lay, was still turned away considerably from the perpendicular.
uz: Bir narsa aniq edi: Projectile hali uning yuziga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tushishni boshlagan emas edi; uning gravitatsiya markazi joylashgan poydevorining poydevorini hali ham ustun bo'lgan poydevordan ancha uzoqlashtirgan edi.

en: Barbican's countenance soon showed perplexity and even alarm.
uz: Barbicanning ko'rinishi tez orada hayronlik va hatto xavotirni ko'rsatdi.

en: His Projectile was proving intractable to the laws of gravitation.
uz: Uning projektili gravitatsiya qonunlariga qarshi kurashishga qodir emasligini isbotlamoqda edi.

en: The unknown was opening out dimly before him, the great boundless unknown of the starry plains.
uz: Ko'rinmas narsa uning oldiga ko'rinmay ochildi, yulduzli dengizlarning cheksiz ko'rinmas narsalari.

en: In his pride and confidence as a scientist, he had flattered himself with having sounded the
uz: Olim sifatida o'zining mag'rurligi va ishonchida u o'zini o'zi uchun o'zini maqtab, o'zi uchun "" so'zini aytgan edi.

en: consequence of every possible hypothesis regarding the Projectile's ultimate fate: the return to the Earth; the arrival at the Moon; and the motionless dead stop at the neutral point.
uz: Projektilning yakuniy taqdirini ta'kidlaydigan har qanday iloji bo'lgan g'oyalarning natijasi: Yerga qaytish; Oyga kelish; va harakatsiz o'liklarning neytral nuqtaga to'xtashi.

en: But here, a new and incomprehensible fourth hypothesis, big with the terrors of the mystic infinite, rose up before his disturbed mind, like a grim and hollow ghost.
uz: Ammo bu yerda mistik cheksizning dahshatlari bilan katta bo'lgan yangi va tushunarli bo'lmagan to'rtinchi g'oya uning chalg'ib qolgan ongining oldida qorong'i va tuxumli hayajon kabi ko'tarildi.

en: After a few seconds, however, he looked at it straight in the face without wincing.

uz: Uning sheriklari ham xuddi shunday qat'iy bo'lishdi.

en: Whether it was science that emboldened Barbican, his phlegmatic stoicism that propped up the Captain, or his enthusiastic vivacity that cheered the irrepressible Ardan, I cannot exactly say.
uz: Barbicanni qo'llab-quvvatlagan ilm-fanmi, kapitanni qo'llab-quvvatlagan flegmatik stoikizmmi yoki tirishqoq Ardanni quvontirgan g'ayratli jonliligimi, to'g'ri aytolmayman.

en: But certainly they were all soon talking over the matter as calmly as you or I would discuss the advisability of taking a sail on the lake some beautiful evening in July.
uz: Ammo, albatta, ular hammasi tez orada siz yoki men iyul oyidagi go'zal kechalarda ko'lda yelka tashlashning maqsadga muvofiqligini muhokama qilganimizdek, bu masala haqida ham tinchlik bilan gaplashib olishdi.

uz: Ularning birinchi so'zlari o'ziga xos va o'ziga xos edi.

uz: Boshqa odamlar esa o'zlariga savol berishar edilarki, "Proktil" ularni qayerga olib boryapti?

en: Do you think such a question ever occurred to them?
uz: Sizningcha, bunday savol ularga hech qachon kelmaganmi?

uz: Ular shunchaki bir-birlaridan bu yangi va g'alati holatning sababchisi nima bo'lishi mumkinligini so'rashdi.

uz: Ardan shunday deb ta'kidladi: "Ular yo'ldan chiqqan bo'lib ko'rinadi.

uz: "Bu qanday?" - deb javob berdi kapitan. - Mening fikrim shundaki, raketa haqiqiy maqsadga yo'naltirilmagan.

en: Every possible precaution had been taken, I am well aware, but we all know that an inch, a line, even the tenth part of a hair's breadth wrong at the start would have sent us thousands of miles off our course by this time." "What have you to say to that, Barbican?" asked Ardan.
uz: Har qanday ehtiyotkorlik choralari ko'rilgan edi, buni yaxshi bilaman, lekin biz hammamiz bilamizki, bir dyuym, chiziq, hatto boshlanishda to'qnashgan sochlarning o'ninchi qismi ham bizni bu vaqtgacha yo'limizdan minglab millar uzoqlashtirgan bo'lardi".

uz: "O'ylaymanki, boshida hech qanday xato yo'q edi", - deb o'ylagan ishonchli javob edi; "ha, hatto bir satr ham yo'q!

uz: Biz Kolumbiadning mutlaq to'g'riligini isbotlovchi juda ko'p sinovlarni o'tkazdik, bu mavzuda hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: Its direction towards the zenith being incontestable, I don't see why we should not reach the Moon when she comes to the zenith." "Perhaps we're behind time," suggested Ardan.

en: "What have you to say to that, Barbican?" asked the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Sening bunga qanday javobing bor, Barbican?" - deb so'radi.

uz: "Kembridž odamlari sayohatni soat, daqiqa va soniya ichida amalga oshirish kerakligini aytishgan.

en: That's as much as to say that if we're not up to time we shall miss the Moon."
uz: Bu, agar o'z vaqtida bo'lmasak, oyni o'zimizga o'tkazib yuboramiz, deb aytishga tengdir".

en: "Correct," said Barbican.
uz: "To'g'ri", dedi Barbican.

en: "But we can't be behind time.
uz: "Ammo biz vaqtdan ortda qololmaymiz.

uz: Biz dekabr oyida soat  min va  sekunddan oldin  daqiqalarda boshladik va to'rt kun o'tgach, to'g'ri, tun yarimida etib boramiz.

uz: Bugun dekabr ~th Xonimlar, iltimos, soatlaringizni ko'rib chiqinglar.

uz: Endi soat uch yarim bor.

uz: Sakkiz yarim soat bizni sayohatning oxiriga yetkazish uchun etarli.

en: Why should we not arrive there?" "How about being ahead of time?" asked the Captain.
uz: Nima uchun u yerga yetib bormasligimiz kerak?" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "Just so!" said Ardan.
uz: "Shunday!" dedi Ardan.

en: "You know we have discovered the initial velocity to have been greater than was expected." "Not at all!
uz: "Siz bilamanki, biz dastlabki tezlikni kutilganidan katta deb topdik.

uz: Aslo yo'q! - deb baqirdi Barbican. - Agar ozgina tezlikni o'z ichiga olgan bo'lsa, biroz tezlik o'sishi hech qanday zarar yetkazmagan bo'lardi, agar o'g'ilning yo'nalishi to'liq to'g'ri bo'lgan bo'lsa.

en: There must have been a digression.
uz: O'zgarish bo'lishi kerak.

en: We must have been switched off!" "Switched off?
uz: Bizni o'chirib qo'yishgan bo'lishi kerak! "O'chirib qo'yishganmi?

en: By what?" asked both his listeners in one breath.
uz: Nima orqali?" - deb so'radi tinglovchilaridan ikkovi ham bir nafas olishdi.

en: "I can't tell," said Barbican curtly.
uz: "Men buni aytolmayman", - dedi Barbican qisqacha.

en: "Well!" said Ardan; "if Barbican can't tell, there is an end to all further talk on the subject.
uz: "Agar Barbican buni aytolmasa, bu mavzuda bo'lgan barcha gap-so'zlarning oxiri bo'ladi.

en: We're switched off—that's enough for me.
uz: Biz o'chirib qo'yilganmiz, bu men uchun yetarli.

en: Where are we going to?
uz: Qayerga ketyapmiz?

en: What is the use of pestering our brains about it?
uz: Buning uchun miyamizni qiynashning foydasi nimada?

en: We shall soon find out.
uz: Tez orada bilib olamiz.

en: We are floating around in space, and we shall end by hauling up somewhere or other." But in this indifference Barbican was far from participating.
uz: Biz kosmosda aylanib yuramiz va nihoyat qayerda yoki qayerda ko'tarilamiz". Ammo bu befarqlikda Barbican ishtirok etishdan uzoqda edi.

en: Not that he was not prepared to meet the future with a bold and manly heart.
uz: Bu uning kelajakka jasoratli va erkaklik yuragi bilan duch kelishga tayyor emasligini anglatmaydi.

en: It was his inability to answer his own question that rendered him uneasy.
uz: O'z savollariga javob bera olmaganligi uni noqulay qildi.

en: What had switched them off?
uz: Nima ularni o'chirib qo'ydi?

en: He would have given worlds for an answer, but his brain sorely puzzled sought one in vain.
uz: U javob uchun olamlar berardi, lekin uning bejiz o'ylab, behuda bir dunyo izladi.

en: In the mean time, the Projectile continued to turn its side rather than its base towards the Moon; that is, to assume a lateral rather than a direct movement, and this movement was fully participated in by the multitude of the objects that had been thrown outside.
uz: Shu bilan birga, proyektil o'z asosidan ko'ra o'z tomonini oyga qaratishni davom ettirdi; ya'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri harakat qilishning o'rniga yon tomonini ko'tardi va bu harakatda tashqariga tashlangan ko'plab ob'ektlar to'liq ishtirok etdi.

en: Barbican could even convince himself by sighting several points on the lunar surface, by this time hardly more than fifteen or eighteen thousand miles distant, that the velocity of the Projectile instead of accelerating was becoming more and more uniform.
uz: Barbican hatto o'zini o'zini o'zi o'ylashi mumkin edi, chunki u o'n besh yoki o'n sakkiz ming mil masofadan ko'proq masofada bo'lgan oy yuzasida bir nechta nuqtalarni ko'rib chiqdi, ammo bu vaqtga kelib Projectile tezligi tezlashning o'rniga yanada bir xillashib borayotganini ko'rdi.

en: This was another proof that there was no perpendicular fall.
uz: Bu esa perpendikulyar tushib ketishning yo'qligini isbotlaydi.

en: However, though the original impulsive force was still superior to the Moon's attraction,
uz: Biroq, asl impulsiv kuch hali ham oyning jozibadorligidan ustun bo'lsa-da,

en: the travellers were evidently approaching the lunar disc, and there was every reason to hope that they would at last reach a point where, the lunar attraction at last having the best of it, a decided fall should be the result.
uz: Sayohatchilar oy disklariga yaqinlashayotgan edi va ular nihoyat o'zlarining eng yaxshi imkoniyatlarini qo'lga kiritgan oy joyiga yetib kelishlarini umid qilish uchun barcha sabablar bor edi.

en: The three friends, it need hardly be said, continued to make their observations with redoubled interest, if redoubled interest were possible.
uz: Uchta do'st, aytishning hojati yo'q, agar mumkin bo'lsa, ko'paytirilgan qiziqish bilan kuzatishlarini davom ettirgan.

en: But with all their care they could as yet determine nothing regarding the topographical details of our radiant satellite.
uz: Ammo ular o'zlarining ehtiyoji bilan o'zlarining yorqin satelitimizning topografik tafsilotlari haqida hech narsa aniqlay olishmadi.

en: Her surface still reflected the solar rays too dazzlingly to show the relief necessary for satisfactory observation.
uz: Uning yuzi hali ham quyosh nurlarini o'ziga xos ko'rinishda aks ettirgan, ammo u qoniqarli kuzatish uchun zarur bo'lgan yengillikni ko'rsatolmadi.

en: Our travellers kept steadily on the watch looking out of the side lights, till eight o'clock in the evening, by which time the Moon had grown so large in their eyes that she covered up fully half the sky.
uz: Sayohatchilarimiz kechqurun sakkiz soatgacha yon yorug'liklaridan ko'z o'ngida turardilar, shu paytgacha oy ularning ko'zlarida shunchalik katta bo'lganki, osmonning yarmini to'liq qoplagan.

en: At this time the Projectile itself must have looked like a streak of light, reflecting, as it did, the Sun's brilliancy on the one side and the Moon's splendor on the other.
uz: O'sha paytda proyektilning o'zi yorug'lik chizig'iga o'xshashi kerak edi, chunki u quyoshning bir tomondan, oyning boshqa tomondan yorqinligini aks ettirgan.

en: Barbican now took a careful observation and calculated that they could not be much more than ൣ,ൡൡൡ miles from the object of their journey.
uz: Endi Barbican diqqat bilan kuzatdi va ular sayohatning ob'ektidan ko'p uzoqroq bo'lmasligi mumkinligini hisobladi.

en: The velocity of the Projectile he calculated to be about ൧൦ൡ feet per second or ൥൦ൡ miles an hour.
uz: Uning hisob-kitob qilgan tezligi soniyaga 1 metr yoki soatiga 1 kilometr bo'ladi.

en: They had therefore still plenty of time to reach the Moon in about four hours.
uz: Shuning uchun ular hali ham taxminan to'rt soat ichida Oyga yetib kelish uchun yetarlicha vaqtga ega edilar.

en: But though the bottom of the Projectile continued to turn towards the lunar surface in obedience to the law of centripetal force, the centrifugal force was still evidently strong enough to change the path which it followed into some kind of curve, the exact nature of which would be exceedingly difficult to calculate.
uz: Ammo, Garchi proyektilning pastki qismi sentripetal kuch qonuniga bo'ysunib, oy yuziga qarab aylanishni davom ettirgan bo'lsa-da, sentrifugaviy kuch hali ham yo'lni o'zgartirishi uchun kuchli bo'lgani aniq, bu yo'lning aniq tusini hisoblash nihoyatda qiyin bo'ladi.

en: The careful observations that Barbican continued to take did not however prevent him from endeavoring to solve his difficult problem.
uz: Biroq, Barbican davom ettirgan ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatishlar uni qiyin muammosini hal etishga harakat qilishdan to'smadi.

en: The hours passed on, but brought no result.
uz: Soatlar o'tib ketdi, lekin hech qanday natija keltirmadi.

en: That the adventurers were approaching the Moon was evident, but it was just as evident that they should never reach her.
uz: Avventurachilarning oyga yaqinlashishi aniq edi, ammo ular hech qachon u yerga yetib bormasligi ham aniq edi.

en: The nearest point the Projectile could ever possibly attain would only be the result of two opposite forces, the attractive and the repulsive, which, as was now clear, influenced its motion.
uz: Projektil eng yaqin nuqtaga yetib borishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa, faqat ikki qarama-qarshi kuch, jozibador va orzu qiluvchi kuchlarning natijasi bo'ladi, bu esa, hozir aniq bo'lganidek, uning harakatlariga ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

en: Therefore, to land in the Moon was an utter impossibility, and any such idea was to be given up at once and for ever.
uz: Shuning uchun, oyga tushib borish mutlaqo imkonsiz edi va bunday g'oyalardan birdan va abadiy voz kechish kerak edi.

en: What of it!" cried Ardan; after some moments' silence.
uz: Xoʻsh, nima boʻldi!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, bir necha daqiqalik xaloskorlikdan soʻng.

en: "We're not to land in the Moon!
uz: "Biz oyga tushmaymiz!

en: let us do the next best thing—pass close enough to discover her secrets!" But M'Nicholl could not accept the situation so coolly.
uz: keling, keyingi eng yaxshi ishni qilaylik!" - deb uning sirlarini kashf etish uchun yetarlicha yaqinroq o'tib ketaylik! - Ammo M'Nicholl vaziyatni shunchalik sovuq qabul qila olmagan.

en: On the contrary, he decidedly lost his temper, as is occasionally the case with even phlegmatic men.
uz: Aksincha, u o'z g'azabini yo'qotib qo'ydi, ba'zan hatto flegmatik erkaklar bilan ham shunday bo'ladi.

en: He muttered an oath or two, but in a voice hardly loud enough to reach Barbican's ear.
uz: U bir-ikki qasam ichdi, lekin Barbicanning quloqlariga yetarlicha baland ovoz bilan yetmadi.

en: At last, impatient of further restraint, he burst out: "Who the deuce cares for her secrets?
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u yanada cheklanishni istamagan holda: "Kimning sirlari haqida qayg'uradi?

en: To the hangman with her secrets!
uz: Xonadonboshiga uning sirlari bilan!

en: We started to land in the Moon!
uz: Biz oyga tushishni boshladik!

en: That's what's got to be done!
uz: Bu ishni amalga oshirish kerak!

en: That I want or nothing!
uz: Bu men xohlagan yoki hech narsa emas!

en: Confound the darned thing, I say, whatever it was, whether on the Earth or off it, that shoved us off the track!" "On the Earth or off it!" cried Barbican, striking his head suddenly; "now I see it!
uz: "Bizni yo'ldan ozdirib yuborgan bu yovvoyi narsa, men aytaman, u yer yuzida yoki undan tashqarida bo'lgan narsa bo'lsa ham, bu bizni chalg'itadi!" - deb baqirdi Barbican, boshini to'satdan urib: "Hndi men buni ko'ryapman!

en: You're right, Captain!
uz: Siz haqsiz, kapitan!

en: Confound the bolide that we met the first night of our journey!" "Hey?" cried Ardan.
uz: Safarimizning birinchi kechasida uchratgan bolidni chalg'itib qo'ying!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "What do you mean?" asked M'Nicholl.
uz: "Nima deysan?" deb so'radi M'Nicholl.

en: "I mean," replied Barbican, with a voice now perfectly calm, and in a tone of quiet conviction, "that our deviation is due altogether to that wandering meteor." "Why, it did not even graze us!" cried Ardan.
uz: "Demak, - deb javob berdi Barbican, so'z o'zidan so'ng to'liq xotirjam bo'lib, xotirjamlik bilan, - bu noto'g'ri yo'nalishimiz to'liq o'sha aylanayotgan meteoritga bog'liq.

en: "No matter for that," replied Barbican.
uz: "Bu uchun ahamiyat yo'q", deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "Its mass, compared to ours, was enormous, and its attraction was undoubtedly sufficiently great to influence our deviation." "Hardly enough to be appreciable," urged M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Uning massasi biznikiga qaraganda ulkan va uning jozibadorligi, shubhasiz, chetlanishimizga ta'sir qilish uchun etarlicha katta edi.

en: "Right again, Captain," observed Barbican.
uz: "O'zing ham shunday, kapitan", - dedi Barbican.

en: "But just remember an observation of your own made this very afternoon: an inch, a line, even the tenth part of a hair's breadth wrong at the beginning, in a journey of ൣ൥ൡ thousand miles, would be sufficient to make us miss the Moon!"
uz: "Ammo bugun kechqurun qilgan o'zingizning e'tiboringizni to'g'ri yo'lga qo'yganingizni eslang: bir dyuym, bir chiziq, hatto boshida bir sochning o'ninchi qismi ham noto'g'ri bo'lgan, ming millik sayohatda oyni o'tkazib yuborish uchun etarli bo'ladi!"

en: THE OBSERVERS OF THE MOON.
uz: Oy kuzatuvchilari.

en: Barbican's happy conjecture had probably hit the nail on the head.
uz: Barbicanning baxtli taxminlari, ehtimol, boshini o'g'irlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The divergency even of a second may amount to millions of miles if you only have your lines long enough.
uz: Hatto bir soniyalik farq, agar sizning chiziqlaringiz yetarlicha uzoq bo'lsa, millionlab millarga yetishi mumkin.

en: The Projectile had certainly gone off its direct course; whatever the cause, the fact was undoubted.
uz: O'z yo'nalishidan o'tgan bo'lsa kerak; sabab nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, bu haqiqatdan shubhalanmagan.

en: It was a great pity.
uz: Bu katta afsus edi.

en: The daring attempt must end in a failure due altogether to a fortuitous accident, against which no human foresight could have possibly taken precaution.
uz: Jasoratli urinish butunlay baxtsiz hodisa tufayli muvaffaqiyatsiz tugashi kerak, bu hodisaga qarshi hech qanday inson oldindan ko'rish imkoniyati yo'q.

en: Unless in case of the occurrence of some other most improbable accident, reaching the Moon was evidently now impossible.
uz: Agar boshqa hech qanday baxtsiz hodisa yuz bermasa, oyga yetib borish endi imkonsiz bo'lgan.

en: To failure, therefore, our travellers had to make up their minds.
uz: Shuning uchun ham sayohatchilarimiz muvaffaqiyatsizlikka erishish uchun o'z qarorlarini qabul qilishlari kerak edi.

en: But was nothing to be gained by the trip?
uz: Ammo sayohatdan hech narsa foyda ko'rmadi?

en: Though missing actual contact with the Moon, might they not pass near enough to solve several problems in physics and geology over which scientists had been for a long time puzzling their brains in vain?
uz: Ay bilan haqiqiy aloqa yo'q bo'lsa-da, ular olimlar uzoq vaqt davomida behuda o'zlarining miyasini bulg'ovchi fizika va geologiya bo'yicha bir nechta muammolarni hal qilish uchun etarlicha yaqinroq o'tmaydimi?

en: Even this would be some compensation for all their trouble, courage, and intelligence.
uz: Hatto bu ham ularning barcha qiyinchiliklari, jasorati va aql-idroklari uchun kompensatsiya bo'lardi.

en: As to what was to be their own fate, to what doom were themselves to be reserved—they never appeared to think of such a thing.
uz: O'zlarining taqdirlari qanday bo'lishini, o'zlarini qanday taqdirga bag'ishlashlarini ular hech qachon o'ylab ko'rmagan.

en: They knew very well that in the midst of those infinite solitudes they should soon find themselves without air.
uz: Ular o'sha cheksiz yolg'izliklarning o'rtasida tez orada havo yo'q bo'lishini yaxshi bilishgan.

en: The slight supply that kept them from smothering could not possibly last more than five or six days longer.
uz: Ular cho'kishdan saqlanadigan kichik ta'minot besh yoki olti kundan ko'proq davom etishi mumkin emas.

en: as Ardan often exclaimed.
uz: Ardan ko'pincha aytganidek.

en: Five or six days were centuries to our bold adventurers!
uz: Besh yoki olti kun bizning jasoratli sarguzashtchilarimiz uchun asrlar edi!

en: At present every second was a year in events, and infinitely too precious to be squandered away in mere preparations for possible contingencies.
uz: Hozirgi kunda har bir soniya voqealar yili bo'lgan va ehtimoldan yiroq bo'lmagan hodisalarga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun uni sarflash uchun juda qimmatbaho edi.

en: The Moon could never be reached, but was it not possible that her surface could be carefully observed?
uz: Oyga hech qachon yetib bo'lmaydi, ammo uning yuzasini diqqat bilan kuzatish mumkin emasmi?

en: This they set themselves at once to find out.
uz: Bu haqda ular darhol bilib olish uchun o'zlarini qo'zg'atishdi.

en: The distance now separating them from our Satellite they estimated at about ൥ൡൡ miles.
uz: Ular hozir ularni bizning Satelimizdan ajratib turgan masofani taxminan  mil deb hisoblashgan.

en: Therefore relatively to their power of discovering the details of her disc, they were still farther off from the Moon than some of our modern astronomers are to-day, when provided with their powerful telescopes.
uz: Shuning uchun, uning diskining tafsilotlarini kashf etish qobiliyatiga nisbatan, ular o'zlarining kuchli teleskoplari bilan ta'minlangan paytda, hozirgi zamonaviy astronomlarimizning ba'zilariga qaraganda, oydan ancha uzoqroq edilar.

en: We know, for example, that Lord Rosse's great telescope at Parsonstown, possessing a power of magnifying ൧ൡൡൡ times, brings the Moon to within ൥ൡ miles of us; not to speak of Barbican's great telescope on the summit of Long's Peak, by which the Moon, magnified ൥൩,ൡൡൡ times, was brought within ൦ miles of the Earth, where it therefore could reveal with sufficient distinctness every object above ൥ൡ feet in diameter.
uz: Masalan, biz Lord Rossening Parsonstowndagi buyuk teleskopining  marta ko'paytirish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lganligi bilan oyni bizdan  kilometr narida olib borishini bilamiz; Long's Peakning tepaligidagi katta Barbican teleskopidan tashqari, u bilan oy, , marta ko'paytirilgan, Yerdan  kilometr narida olib borilgan, shuning uchun u diametri  metrdan yuqori bo'lgan har bir ob'ektni etarlicha aniq ko'rsatishi mumkin edi.

en: Therefore our adventurers, though at such a comparatively small distance, could not make out the topographical details of the Moon with any satisfaction by their unaided vision.
uz: Shuning uchun bizning sarguzashtchilarimiz, nisbatan kichik masofadan bo'lsa-da, oyning topografik tafsilotlarini o'zlarining yordamsiz ko'rishlari bilan qoniqarsiz aniqlay olishmadi.

en: The eye indeed could easily enough catch the rugged outline of these vast depressions improperly called "Seas," but it could do very little more.
uz: Darhaqiqat, ko'z bu yirik depressiyalarning "dengizlar" deb noto'g'ri nomlangan keskin ko'rinishini juda osonlikcha tushuna oladi, ammo undan ko'ra ko'proq narsani qila olmaydi.

en: Its powers of adjustability seemed to fail before the strange and bewildering scene.
uz: Uning o'zgarish qobiliyati g'ayrioddiy va g'alati ko'rinish oldida puchga chiqqan bo'ldi.

en: The prominence of the mountains vanished, not only through the foreshortening, but also in the dazzling radiation produced by the direct reflection of the solar rays.
uz: Tog'larning obro'si nafaqat qisqartish tufayli, balki quyosh nurlarining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aks ettirilishi natijasida hosil bo'ladigan chiroyli nurlanish natijasida yo'qoldi.

en: After a short time therefore, completely foiled by the blinding glare, the eye turned itself unwillingly away, as if from a furnace of molten silver.
uz: Shu sababli, ko'z ko'z o'z-o'zidan o'zini ko'rmay, qisqa vaqt o'tgach, ko'zning ko'z o'zidan o'zini o'zgartirdi, xuddi erigan kumushdan tayyorlangan pechdan bo'lgani kabi.

en: The spherical surface, however, had long since begun to reveal its convexity.
uz: Biroq, sferik yuza uzoq vaqt oldin o'zining shovqinligini oshkor qilishni boshlagan edi.

en: The Moon was gradually assuming the appearance of a gigantic egg with the smaller end turned towards the Earth.
uz: Oy asta-sekin yer yuziga qarab o'zgartirilgan kichik bo'g'i bilan ulkan tuxumning ko'rinishini qabul qildi.

en: In the earlier days of her formation, while still in a state of mobility, she had been probably a perfect sphere in shape, but, under the influence of terrestrial gravity operating for uncounted ages, she was drawn at last so much towards the centre of attraction as to resemble somewhat a prolate spheriod.
uz: O'sishining dastlabki kunlarida u hali ham harakatlanish holatida bo'lganida, ehtimol mukammal shakldagi sfer bo'lgan, ammo sayyorada ko'p yillar davomida ishlaydigan yer gravitatsiyasi ta'siri ostida, nihoyat u jozibadorlik markaziga shunchalik yaqinlashdiki, biroz o'sib boradigan sferga o'xshaydi.

en: By becoming a satellite, she had lost the native perfect regularity of her outline; her centre of gravity had
uz: Satelitga aylanib, u o'z konturining asl mukammal muntazamligini yo'qotgan edi; uning gravitatsiya markazi o'z ichiga olgan edi.

en: shifted from her real centre; and as a result of this arrangement, some scientists have drawn the conclusion that the Moon's air and water have been attracted to that portion of her surface which is always invisible to the inhabitants of the Earth.
uz: Ayning haqiqiy markazidan o'zgarib ketdi; va ushbu tartibga solish natijasida ba'zi olimlar oyning havo va suvlari uning yuzasidagi har doim Yer aholisi uchun ko'rinmas bo'lgan qismiga jalb qilingan degan xulosaga kelishdi.

en: The convexity of her outline, this bulging prominence of her surface, however, did not last long.
uz: Biroq, uning ko'rinishining shov-shuvliligi, yuzasining bu ko'tarilgan ko'rinishi uzoq davom etmadi.

en: The travellers were getting too near to notice it.
uz: Sayohatchilar buni payqash uchun juda yaqinlashib ketishdi.

en: They were beginning to survey the Moon as balloonists survey the Earth.
uz: Balonchilar Yerni ko'rib chiqayotganda, ular oyni ko'rishni boshlashdi.

en: The Projectile was now moving with great rapidity—with nothing like its initial velocity, but still eight or nine times faster than an express train.
uz: Projektil hozir katta tezlikda harakatlanayotgan edi, ammo uning boshlang'ich tezligiga hech narsa teng emas edi, ammo u hali ham tezlikdagi poyezddan sakkiz yoki to'qqiz baravar tezroq edi.

en: Its line of movement, however, being oblique instead of direct, was so deceptive as to induce Ardan to flatter himself that they might still reach the lunar surface.
uz: Biroq, uning harakatlanish yo'li to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, ko'rinmas bo'lgani uchun, Ardanni o'zini mashg'ul qilish uchun o'zini aldashga undadi, chunki ular hali ham oy yuziga yetib borishi mumkin.

en: He could never persuade himself to believe that they should get so near their aim and still miss it.
uz: U o'zini hech qachon maqsadlariga shunchalik yaqinlashib, uni yo'qotish kerakligiga ishonishga ishontira olmagan.

en: No; nothing might, could, would or should induce him to believe it, he repeated again and again.
uz: Yo'q; hech narsa uni bunga ishonishga undashi mumkin, mumkin yoki kerak emas, deb takrorlagan.

en: But Barbican's pitiless logic left him no reply.
uz: Ammo Barbicanning shafqatsiz mantiqiy nuqtai nazari unga hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: "No, dear friend, no.
uz: "Yo'q, aziz do'stim, yo'q.

en: We can reach the Moon only by a fall, and we don't fall.
uz: Ayga faqat quyosh tushish orqali yetib boramiz va tushmaymiz.

en: Centripetal force keeps us at least for a while under the lunar influence, but centrifugal force drives us away irresistibly." These words were uttered in a tone that killed Ardan's last and fondest hope.
uz: Sentripetal kuch hech bo'lmaganda bir muncha vaqt bizni oy ta'siri ostida saqlaydi, lekin sentrifugal kuch bizni qarshiliksiz yo'ldan ozdiradi". Bu so'zlar Ardanning oxirgi va eng yaxshi umidini o'ldirgan tovush bilan aytildi.

en: The portion of the Moon they were now approaching was her northern hemisphere, found usually in the lower part of lunar maps.
uz: Ayning ular hozir yaqinlashayotgan qismi uning shimoliy yarim qirrasida bo'lib, odatda oy xaritalarining pastki qismida uchraydi.

en: The lens of a telescope, as is well known, gives only the inverted image of the object; therefore, when an upright image is required, an additional glass must be used.
uz: Teleskopning shishalari, yaxshi ma'lumki, faqat ob'ektning o'girilgan tasvirini beradi; shuning uchun, to'g'ri tasvir kerak bo'lganda, qo'shimcha shisha ishlatilishi kerak.

en: But as every additional glass is an additional obstruction to the light, the object glass of a Lunar telescope is employed without a corrector; light is thereby saved, and in viewing the Moon, as in viewing a map, it evidently makes very little difference whether we see her inverted or not.
uz: Ammo har bir qo'shimcha shisha nurga qo'shimcha to'sqinlik qilgani sababli, oy teleskopolarining ob'ekt shishalari tuzatgichsiz ishlatiladi; shunda yorug'lik saqlanadi va oyni ko'rishda, xaritani ko'rishda, biz uni o'girib ko'ryapmizmi yoki yo'qmi, aniqrog'i, juda kam farq qiladi.

en: Maps of the Moon therefore, being drawn from the image formed by the telescope, show the north in the lower part, and vice versa.
uz: Shuning uchun, teleskop tomonidan hosil bo'lgan tasvirdan olingan oy xaritalari quyida shimoliy qismni ko'rsatadi va aksincha.

en: Of this kind was the Mappa Selenographica, by Beer and Maedler, so often previously alluded to and now carefully consulted by Barbican.
uz: Bu turdagi Mappa Selenographica, Beer va Maedler tomonidan, ilgari tez-tez eslatib o'tilgan va hozirda Barbican tomonidan diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqilgan.

en: northern hemisphere, towards which they were now rapidly approaching, presented a strong contrast with the southern, by its vast plains and great depressions, checkered here and there by very remarkable isolated mountains.[A] At midnight the Moon was full.
uz: Shimoliy yarim jahon, ular endi tezda yaqinlashayotgan bo'lsa-da, o'zining keng o'tlar va katta tushlar bilan, shu va shu yerda juda diqqatga sazovor, alohida tog'lar bilan qoplangan janubiy yarim jahon bilan keskin farq qilardi.

en: This was the precise moment at which the travellers would have landed had not that unlucky bolide drawn them off the track.
uz: Bu sayohatchilar o'sha baxtsiz bolida ularni yo'ldan olib ketmaganida, to'g'ri joylashadigan vaqt edi.

en: The Moon was therefore strictly up to time, arriving at the instant rigidly determined by the Cambridge Observatory.
uz: Shuning uchun O'shanda o'z vaqtida kelgan, u Kembridž observatoriyasi tomonidan qat'iy belgilangan vaqtda kelgan.

en: She occupied the exact point, to a mathematical nicety, where our ൣ൩th parallel crossed the perigee.
uz: U aniq nuqta, matematik jihatdan yaxshilik bilan, bizning th parallelimiz perigeyni kesib o'tgan joyni egallab olgan.

en: An observer posted in the bottom of the Columbiad at Stony Hill, would have found himself at this moment precisely under the Moon.
uz: Stony Hilldagi Kolumbiadning pastki qismida joylashtirilgan kuzatuvchi o'zini aynan o'sha paytda oy ostida topgan bo'ladi.

en: The axis of the enormous gun, continued upwards vertically, would have struck the orb of night exactly in her centre.
uz: Ulkan qurolning o'qi vertikal ravishda yuqoriga ko'tarilganida, u tungi qorong'ini uning markazida urgan bo'lardi.

en: It is hardly necessary to tell our readers that, during this memorable night of the ൦th and ൧th of December, the travellers had no desire to close their eyes.
uz: O'quvchilarimizga aytishning zaruriyati yo'qki, dekabr oyining 6 va 8 kunlari kechasi sayohatchilar ko'zlarini yumishni istamadilar.

en: Could they do so, even if they had desired?
uz: Ular xohlagan bo'lsalar ham, buni qila olishadimi?

en: All their faculties, thoughts, and desires, were concentrated in one single word: "Look!" Representatives of the Earth, and of all humanity past and present, they felt that it was with their eyes that the race of man contemplated the lunar regions and penetrated the secrets of our satellite!
uz: Ularning barcha qobiliyatlari, fikrlari va istaklari bitta so'z bilan jamlangan edi: "Qaranglar!" Yer va o'tmishdagi va hozirgi butun insoniyat vakillari insonlar millati oy mintaqalarini ko'rib, u yerning sirlarini o'z ko'zlari bilan ochib olganini his qilishdi!

en: A certain indescribable emotion therefore, combined with an undefined sense of responsibility, held possession of their hearts, as they moved silently from window to window.
uz: Shu sababli, ular o'z xonadonlaridan o'z xonadonlariga sukutdan o'tganlarida, o'zlarining dillarini ifodalab bo'lmaydigan tuyg'u, mas'uliyat hissi bilan birlashtirib, o'zlarining qalbini egallab olgan.

en: Their observations, recorded by Barbican, were vigorously remade, revised, and re-determined, by the others.
uz: Barbican tomonidan qayd etilgan ularning kuzatishlari boshqalar tomonidan puxta qayta ko'rib chiqilgan, qayta ko'rib chiqilgan va qayta aniqlangan.

en: To make them, they had telescopes which they now began to employ with great advantage.
uz: Ularni yaratish uchun ular teleskoplarga ega bo'lishdi va ular endi katta afzallik bilan foydalanishni boshlashdi.

en: To regulate and investigate them, they had the best maps of the day.
uz: Uni tartibga solish va tekshirish uchun ular kunning eng yaxshi xaritalariga ega edilar.

en: Whilst occupied in this silent work, they could not help throwing a short retrospective glance on the former Observers of the Moon.
uz: Ular shu bevafo ish bilan band bo'lganlarida, oldingi oy kuzatuvchilari haqida qisqacha retrospektiv ko'z o'tkazib ko'rishdan bosh tortmadilar.

en: The first of these was Galileo.
uz: Bulardan birinchi bo'lgan Galileo.

en: His slight telescope magnified only thirty times, still, in the spots flecking the lunar surface, like the eyes checkering a peacock's tail, he was the first to discover mountains and even to measure their heights.
uz: Uning yengil teleskopining o'ttiz marta ko'payishi mumkin edi, ammo o'sha paytda o'z ko'zlari pavon quyruqidagi ko'zlar kabi oy yuzasida ko'rinadigan nuqtalarda tog'larni kashf etgan va hatto ularning balandligini o'lchagan u birinchi bo'ldi.

en: These, considering the difficulties
uz: Bularning barchasi qiyinchiliklarni hisobga olgan holda

en: under which he labored, were wonderfully accurate, but unfortunately he made no map embodying his observations.
uz: U ishlagan ma'lumotlar juda aniq edi, ammo, afsuski, u o'z kuzatishlarini aks ettiruvchi xarita yaratmadi.

en: A few years afterwards, Hevel of Dantzic, (ൢ൧ൢൢ-ൢ൧൩൩) a Polish astronomer—more generally known as Hevelius, his works being all written in Latin—undertook to correct Galileo's measurements.
uz: Bir necha yil o'tgach, Polshalik astronom Hevel of Dantzic (-) (-) hamjamiyatda Hevelius deb tanilgan, uning asarlari hammasi Galilejning o'lchovlarini tuzatish uchun lotin tilida yozilgan.

en: But as his method could be strictly accurate only twice a month—the periods of the first and second quadratures—his rectifications could be hardly called successful.
uz: Ammo uning usuli faqat oyiga ikki marta aniq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganligi sababli, birinchi va ikkinchi kvadraturalar davrlarida uning tuzatishlarini muvaffaqiyatli deb atash qiyin edi.

en: Still it is to the labors of this eminent astronomer, carried on uninterruptedly for fifty years in his own observatory, that we owe the first map of the Moon.
uz: Biroq, biz o'z observatoriyasida o'ttiz yil davomida uzluksiz davom ettirgan ushbu taniqli astronomning mehnatlariga Ayning birinchi xaritasini yaratishga qarzdormiz.

en: It was published in ൢ൧൥൨ under the name of Selenographia.
uz: U Selenographia nomli nashr etilgan edi.

en: He represented the circular mountains by open spots somewhat round in shape, and by shaded figures he indicated the vast plains, or, as he called them, the seas, that occupied so much of her surface.
uz: U aylanma tog'larni biroz yuzli bo'lgan ochiq maydonlar bilan tasvirlagan, soyalar bilan esa uning yuzasining katta qismini egallab olgan ulkan tekisliklarni yoki, uning aytganidek, dengizlarni ko'rsatgan.

en: These he designated by names taken from our Earth.
uz: Bularni Yerimizdan olingan ismlar bilan tanladi.

en: His map shows you a Mount Sinai the midst of an Arabia, an Ætna in the centre of a Sicily, Alps, Apennines, Carpathians, a Mediterranean, a Palus Mæolis, a Pontus Euxinus, and a Caspian Sea.
uz: Uning xaritasi sizga Arabistonning o'rtasida Sinay tog'ini, Siciliya, Alplar, Apenninlar, Karpatlar markazidagi Aetna, O'rta yer dengizining, Palus Mæolis, Pontus Euxinus va Kaspiy dengizining markazida joylashgan Ayni Qirg'iziston tog'ini ko'rsatadi.

en: But these names seem to have been given capriciously and at random, for they never recall any resemblance existing between themselves and their namesakes on our globe.
uz: Ammo bu ismlar g'alati va tasodifiy berilgan, chunki ular o'zlarining va bizning sayyoramizdagi o'z nomlaridan hech qanday o'xshashligini eslay olmaydilar.

en: In the wide open spot, for instance, connected on the south with vast continents and terminating in a point, it would be no easy matter to recognize the reversed image of the Indian Peninsula, the Bay of Bengal, and Cochin China.
uz: Misol uchun, janubda yirik qit'alar bilan bog'liq bo'lgan keng ochiq joyda va bir nuqta bilan tugashi mumkin bo'lgan joyda Hind Yarimadasining, Bengal ko'rgazmasi va Kochin Xitoyning o'zgacha tasvirini tan olish oson emas.

en: Naturally, therefore, these names were nearly all soon dropped; but another system of nomenclature, proposed by an astronomer better acquainted with the human heart, met with a success that has lasted to the present day.
uz: Shu sababli, tabiiyki, bu ismlarning hammasi deyarli tez orada yo'qoldi; lekin inson yuragi bilan yaqindan tanish bo'lgan astronom tomonidan taklif etilgan nomenklaturalarning boshqa tizimi bugungi kunga qadar davom etayotgan muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

en: This was Father Riccioli, a Jesuit, and (ൢ൦൪൩-ൢ൧൨ൢ) a contemporary of Hevelius.
uz: Bu, Yezuit bo'lgan va (-) Heveliusning zamondoshi bo'lgan Ota Riccioli edi.

en: In his Astronomia Reformata, (ൢ൧൧൦), he published a rough and incorrect map of the Moon, compiled from observations made by Grimaldi of Ferrara; but in designating the mountains, he named them after eminent astronomers, and this idea of his has been carefully carried out by map makers of later times.
uz: "Astronomia Reformata" () da u Ferraradagi Grimaldi tomonidan kuzatilgan oy xaritasi haqida taxminiy va noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni nashr etdi; lekin tog'larni belgilashda u ularni taniqli astronomlar nomidan nomladi va uning bu fikri keyingi davrdagi xarita ijodkorlari tomonidan diqqat bilan amalga oshirildi.

en: A third map of the Moon was published at Rome in ൢ൧൧൧ by Dominico Cassini of Nice (ൢ൧ൣ൦-ൢ൨ൢൣ), the famous discoverer of Saturn's satellites.
uz: Ayning uchinchi xaritasi Rimda 1976 yilda Saturn sun'iyotlarining taniqli kashfiyotchisi Dominik Kassini (-) tomonidan nashr etilgan.

en: Though somewhat incorrect regarding
uz: Garchi biroz noto'g'ri bo'lsa-da, haqida

en: measurements, it was superior to Riccioli's in execution, and for a long time it was considered a standard work.
uz: O'lchovlar bo'yicha, u ijroda Ricciolidan ustun edi va uzoq vaqt davomida standart ish deb hisoblandi.

en: Copies of this map are still to be found, but Cassini's original copper-plate, preserved for a long time at the Imprimerie Royale in Paris, was at last sold to a brazier, by no less a personage than the Director of the establishment himself, who, according to Arago, wanted to get rid of what he considered useless lumber!
uz: Ushbu xarita nusxalari hali ham topilmagan, ammo Parijdagi Imprimerie Royale-da uzoq vaqt saqlangan Cassini ning misli asbob-uskunalari nihoyat, o'zidan kamroq bo'lmagan bir kishi tomonidan, shuningdek, o'sha muassasa direktorining o'zi tomonidan sotilgan edi, u Aragoga ko'ra, u foydasiz daraxt deb hisoblagan narsadan qutulishni xohlagan edi!

en: La Hire (ൢ൧൥ൡ-ൢ൨ൢ൩), professor of astronomy in the Collège de France, and an accomplished draughtsman, drew a map of the Moon which was thirteen feet in diameter.
uz: Fransiya kollejida astronomiya fani professori va tajribali rassom La Xire (-), o'n uch fut diametrli oy xaritasini chizdi.

en: This map could be seen long afterwards in the library of St.
uz: Ushbu xaritani keyinchalik St. Petersburg kutubxonasida ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: Genevieve, Paris, but it was never engraved.
uz: Geneviev, Parij, lekin hech qachon gravuratsiya qilinmagan.

en: About ൢ൨൧ൡ, Mayer, a famous German astronomer and the director of the observatory of Göttingen, began the publication of a magnificent map of the Moon, drawn after lunar measurements all rigorously verified by himself.
uz: Taxminan , Mayer, taniqli nemis astronomi va Göttingen observatoriyasining direktori, o'zi tomonidan qat'iy tekshirilgan oy o'lchovlaridan keyin suratga olingan oyning ajoyib xaritasi nashr etilishini boshladi.

en: Unfortunately his death in ൢ൨൧ൣ interrupted a work which would have surpassed in accuracy every previous effort of the kind.
uz: Afsuski, -da o'limidan so'ng, o'zidan avvalgi har qanday harakatdan ustun bo'lgan ish o'tkazildi.
