en: Next appears Schroeter of Erfurt (ൢ൨൥൦-ൢ൩ൢ൧), a fine observer (he first discovered the Lunar Rills), but a poor draughtsman: his maps are therefore of little value.
uz: Keyingi qismda Erfurtlik Schroeter (-) paydo bo'ladi, u yaxshi kuzatuvchi (u birinchi marta oyni yoritgan), ammo kambag'al chizuvchi: shuning uchun uning xaritalari kam ahamiyatga ega.

en: Lohrman of Dresden published in ൢ൩൤൩ an excellent map of the Moon, ൢ൦ inches in diameter, accompanied by descriptive text and several charts of particular portions on a larger scale.
uz: Dresdenlik Lohrman  yilda oyning juda yaxshi xaritasi, diametri  dyuymlar bo'lgan, ma'lumotli matn va keng miqyosda muayyan qismlarning bir nechta jadvallari bilan birga nashr etgan.

en: But this and all other maps were thrown completely into the shade by Beer and Maedler's famous Mappa Selenographica, so often alluded to in the course of this work.
uz: Ammo bu va boshqa barcha xaritalar Beer va Maedlerning mashhur Mappa Selenographica tomonidan butunlay soyaga tashlangan, bu ish davomida tez-tez izoh berilgan.

en: This map, projected orthographically—that is, one in which all the rays proceeding from the surface to the eye are supposed to be parallel to each other— gives a reproduction of the lunar disc exactly as it appears.
uz: Bu kartada ortografiyaga ko'ra ko'rinadi, ya'ni yuzadan ko'zgacha barcha nurlar bir-biriga parallel bo'lishi kerak, deb hisoblangan karta oy diskini aynan shunday ko'rinadi.

en: The representation of the mountains and plains is therefore correct only in the central portion; elsewhere, north, south, east, or west, the features, being foreshortened, are crowded together, and cannot be compared in measurement with those in the centre.
uz: Shuning uchun tog'lar va o'tlar faqat o'rta qismida to'g'ri tasvirlanadi; boshqa joylarda, shimoliy, janubiy, sharqiy yoki g'arbda, qisqartirilgan belgilar bir-biriga to'lib-toshgan va o'lchamda markazdagilar bilan taqqoslanmaydi.

en: It is more than three feet square; for convenient reference it is divided into four parts, each having a very full index; in short, this map is in all respects a master piece of lunar cartography.[B]
uz: U uch fut kvadratdan ortiq bo'lib, qulay ma'lumot uchun to'rtta qismga bo'linadi, har biri juda to'liq indeksga ega; qisqacha aytganda, ushbu xarita har jihatdan oy kartografiyasining ustasi hisoblanadi.[B]

en: After Beer and Maedler, we should allude to Julius Schmitt's (of Athens) excellent selenographic reliefs: to Doctor Draper's, and to Father Secchi's successful application of photography to lunar representation; to De La Rue's (of London) magnificent stereographs of the Moon, to be had at every optician's; to the clear and correct map prepared by Lecouturier and Chapuis in ൢ൩൧ൡ; to the many beautiful pictures of the Moon in various phases of illumination obtained by the Messrs.
uz: Beer va Maedlerdan so'ng, biz Julius Schmittning (Atenaslik) ajoyib selenografik relieflariga ishora qilishimiz kerak: Doktor Draperning va Ota Secchining fotografiyani oyni tasvirlashga muvaffaqiyatli qo'llagani; De La Rue (Londonlik) ning har bir optikada bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan oyning ajoyib stereografiyasi; Lecouturier va Chapuis tomonidan  yilda tayyorlangan aniq va to'g'ri xaritasi; xonadonlar tomonidan olingan oyning turli yorug'lik bosqichlarida ko'plab chiroyli rasmlari.

en: Bond of Harvard University; to Rutherford's (of New York) unparalleled lunar photographs; and finally to Nasmyth and Carpenter's wonderful work on the Moon, illustrated by photographs of her surface in detail, prepared from models at which they had been laboring for more than a quarter of the century.
uz: Harvard universiteti Bond; Ruterfordning (Nyu-Yorkning) tengsiz oy fotosuratlariga; va nihoyat, Nasmit va Karpenterning oydagi ajoyib ishiga, uning yuzasini batafsil tasvirlab, ular bir chorak asrdan ziyod vaqt davomida ishlagan modellardan tayyorlangan rasmlar bilan tasvirlangan.

en: Of all these maps, pictures, and projections, Barbican had provided himself with only two—Beer and Maedler's in German, and Lecouturier and Chapuis' in French.
uz: Ushbu barcha xaritalar, rasmlar va proyeksiyalardan Barbican o'ziga ikkigina nemis tilidagi Beer va Maedler, frantsuz tilidagi Lecouturier va Chapuis kitoblarini taqdim etgan.

en: These he considered quite sufficient for all purposes, and certainly they considerably simplified his labors as an observer.
uz: U bularni barcha maqsadlar uchun etarli deb hisoblagan va shubhasizki, ular kuzatuvchi sifatida uning ishini sezilarli darajada soddalashtirgan.

en: His best optical instruments were several excellent marine telescopes, manufactured especially under his direction.
uz: Uning eng yaxshi optik asboblari, ayniqsa uning yo'l-yo'riqchiligida ishlab chiqilgan bir nechta ajoyib dengiz teleskoplari edi.

en: Magnifying the object a hundred times, on the surface of the Earth they would have brought the Moon to within a distance of somewhat less than ൣ൥ൡൡ miles.
uz: Ob'ektni yuz marta ko'paytirgan holda, ular Yer yuzasida oyni bir necha mildan kam masofada olib kelishgan bo'ladi.

en: But at the point to which our travellers had arrived towards three o'clock in the morning, and which could hardly be more than ൢൣ or ൢ൤ൡൡ miles from the Moon, these telescopes, ranging through a medium disturbed by no atmosphere, easily brought the lunar surface to within less than ൢ൤ miles' distance from the eyes of our adventurers.
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarimiz ertalab soat uchga yaqin yetib kelganida va oydan oz-oz uzoqlikda bo'lganida, bu teleskoplar hech qanday atmosfera buzilgan medium orqali o'tgan holda oy yuzini sayohatchilarimizning ko'zidan oz-oz uzoqlikda olib borardi.

en: Therefore they should now see objects in the Moon as clearly as people can see the opposite bank of a river that is about ൢൣ miles wide.
uz: Shuning uchun ular hozir oydagi ob'ektlarni xuddi shunday aniq ko'rishlari kerakki, odamlar deyarli millar keng bo'lgan daryoning qarshisidagi qirg'og'ini ko'rishlari mumkin.

en: "Have you ever seen the Moon?" said a teacher ironically one day in class to one of his pupils.
uz: "Siz hech oyni ko'rganmisiz?" - dedi bir o'qituvchi sinfda bir kuni o'quvchilaridan biriga ironik tarzda.

en: "No, sir;" was the pert reply; "but I think I can safely say I've heard it spoken about." Though saying what he considered a smart thing, the pupil was probably perfectly right.
uz: "Yo'q, xo'jayinim", - deb javob berdi u. "Ammo men buni eshitganimni aytishim mumkin", - deb javob berdi u. "O'zi aqlli deb hisoblagan gapni aytganda, o'quvchi, ehtimol, to'liq haqli edi.

en: Like the immense majority of his fellow beings, he had looked at the Moon, heard her talked of, written poetry about her, but, in the strict sense of the term, he had probably never seen her—that is—scanned her, examined her, surveyed her, inspected her, reconnoitred her—even with an opera glass!
uz: Ko'pgina o'z sheriklari singari u ham oyga qaragan, uning gapirganini eshitgan, u haqida she'r yozgan edi, lekin, so'zning qat'iy ma'nosida, ehtimol u hech qachon uni ko'rmagan, uni tekshirgan, tekshirgan, tekshirgan, hatto opera shisha bilan tanigan!

en: Not one in a thousand, not one in ten thousand, has ever examined even the map of our only Satellite.
uz: Mingdan bir kishi, o'n mingdan bir kishi hech qachon bizning yagona Satelimizning xaritasini ham ko'rmagan.

en: To guard our beloved and intelligent reader against this reproach, we have prepared an excellent reduction of Beer and Maedler's Mappa, on which, for the better understanding of what is to follow, we hope he will occasionally cast a gracious eye.
uz: Sevikli va aqlli o'quvchilarimizni bu ayblanishdan himoya qilish uchun biz Beer va Maedler Mappa-ning ajoyib qisqartirilishini tayyorladik, keyin nima bo'lishini yaxshiroq tushunish uchun, u vaqti-vaqti bilan mehribonlik ko'zlarini o'tkazib yuborishini umid qilamiz.

en: When you look at any map of the Moon, you are struck first of all with one peculiarity.
uz: Ayning har qanday xaritasini ko'rganingizda, birinchi navbatda, bir xil xilma-xillik bilan hayron bo'lasiz.

en: Contrary to the arrangement prevailing in Mars and on our Earth, the continents occupy principally the southern hemisphere of the lunar orb.
uz: Mars va Yerda mavjud bo'lgan tartibga zid ravishda, qit'alar asosan oy orbining janubiy yarim qirrasini egallaydi.

en: Then these continents are far from presenting such sharp and regular outlines as distinguish the Indian Peninsula, Africa, and South America.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu qit'alar Hind Yarimadasini, Afrikani va Janubiy Amerikani ajratib turadigan o'ta aniq va muntazam ko'rinishlarga ega emas.

en: On the contrary, their coasts, angular, jagged, and deeply indented, abound in bays and
uz: Aksincha, ularning burchakli, burchakli va chuqur bo'g'ishlangan sohillari ko'chma-ko'chalar va qirg'oqlarda ko'payadi.

en: They remind you of the coast of Norway, or of the islands in the Sound, where the land seems to be cut up into endless divisions.
uz: Ular sizga Norvegiyaning sohillarini yoki Sounddagi orollarni eslatib turadi, bu yerda yerlar cheksiz bo'linishlarga bo'linadi.

en: If navigation ever existed on the Moon's surface, it must have been of a singularly difficult and dangerous nature, and we can scarcely say which of the two should be more pitied—the sailors who had to steer through these dangerous and complicated passes, or the map-makers who had to designate them on their charts.
uz: Agar hech qachon oy yuzida navigatsiya bo'lgan bo'lsa, u juda qiyin va xavfli bo'lishi kerak edi va ikkovidan qaysi biri bu xavfli va murakkab yo'llardan o'tishi kerak bo'lgan kemachilarga yoki ularni xaritalarida belgilashlari kerak bo'lgan xaritachilarga ko'proq rahm-shafqat ko'rsatishi kerakligini aytolmaymiz.

en: You will also remark that the southern pole of the Moon is much more continental than the northern.
uz: Shuningdek, siz oyning janubiy qutbining shimoliy qutbga qaraganda ancha qit'aviyroq ekanligini ham ta'kidlaysiz.

en: Around the latter, there exists only a slight fringe of lands separated from the other continents by vast "seas." This word "seas"—a term employed by the first lunar map constructors—is still retained to designate those vast depressions on the Moon's surface, once perhaps covered with water, though they are now only enormous plains.
uz: Ikkinchisining atrofida boshqa qit'alardan keng "dengizlar" bilan ajratiladigan quruqliklarning kichik bir chegarasi mavjud. "dengizlar" so'zi - birinchi oy xaritalari tuzatgichilari tomonidan ishlatilgan atama - oy yuzasidagi ulkan bo'shliqlarni belgilash uchun hali ham saqlanib turibdi, bir vaqtlar ehtimol suv bilan qoplangan edi, garchi ular endi faqat ulkan o'tlar bo'lsa-da.

en: In the south, the continents cover nearly the whole hemisphere.
uz: Janubiy qismda qit'alar deyarli butun yarim jahonni qamrab oladi.

en: It is therefore possible that the Selenites have planted their flag on at least one of their poles, whereas the Parrys and Franklins of England, the Kanes and the Wilkeses of America, the Dumont d'Urvilles and the Lamberts of France, have so far met with obstacles completely insurmountable, while in search of those unknown points of our terrestrial globe.
uz: Shuning uchun Selenitlar o'z bayrog'ini kamida bir qimirlatgichlariga o'rnatgan bo'lishi mumkin, Angliyalik Parry va Franklinlar, Amerikalik Kanlar va Wilkeslar, Fransiyaning Dumont d'Urvilles va Lambertslar esa yer yuzining noma'lum nuqtalarini qidirib topganlarida, hozircha to'liq yengilmaydigan to'siqlarga duch kelishgan.

en: The islands—the next feature on the Moon's surface—are exceedingly numerous.
uz: Oʻsha orollar - oy yuzidagi keyingi obʼekt - juda koʻp.

en: Generally oblong or circular in shape and almost as regular in outline as if drawn with a compass, they form vast archipelagoes like the famous group lying between Greece and Asia Minor, which mythology has made the scene of her earliest and most charming legends.
uz: Umuman olganda uzun yoki davraliy shaklda va kompas yordamida chizilganidek, deyarli muntazam bo'lib, ular yirik arxipelaglarni tashkil etadilar, masalan, Gretsiya va Kichik Osiyo o'rtasida joylashgan mashhur guruh kabi, bu mitologiya uning eng qadimgi va eng sevimli afsonalarining ko'rinishini yaratdi.

en: As we gaze at them, the names of Naxos, Tenedos, Milo, and Carpathos rise up before our mind's eye, and we begin looking around for the Trojan fleet and Jason's Argo.
uz: Biz ularga qaraganimizda, Naxos, Tenedos, Milo va Karpatos ismlari ongimiz oldida paydo bo'ladi va biz Troya donanmasi va Jasonaning Argo-ni qidirishni boshlaymiz.

en: This, at least, was Ardan's idea, and at first his eyes would see nothing on the map but a Grecian archipelago.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, bu Ardanning g'oyasi edi va dastlab uning ko'zlari xaritada yunon arxipelagidan boshqa hech narsani ko'rmasdi.

en: But his companions, sound practical men, and therefore totally devoid of sentiment, were reminded by these rugged coasts of the beetling cliffs of New Brunswick and Nova Scotia; so that, where the Frenchman saw the tracks of ancient heroes, the Americans saw only commodious shipping points and favorable sites for trading posts—all, of course, in the purest interest of lunar commerce and industry.
uz: Ammo uning hamrohlari, sog'lom amaliy kishilar va shuning uchun ham butunlay hissiyotsiz bo'lganlar, bu qirg'oq sohillari Nyu-Brunsvik va Novaskotiyaning qirg'oqli qirg'oqlarini eslatardi; shuning uchun frantsuz qadimgi qahramonlarning izlarini ko'rgan joyda, amerikaliklar faqat qulay kemalar va savdo postlari uchun qulay joylarni ko'rishardi, albatta, oy savdo va sanoatining sof manfaatlari uchun.

en: To end our hasty sketch of the continental portion of the Moon, we must say a few words regarding her orthography or mountain systems.
uz: Ayning qit'a qismining shoshilinch skizini tugatish uchun uning ortografiyasi yoki tog'lar tizimlari to'g'risida bir necha so'z aytishimiz kerak.

en: With a fair telescope you can distinguish very readily her mountain chains, her isolated mountains, her circuses or ring formations, and her rills, cracks and radiating streaks.
uz: Yaxshi teleskop yordamida siz uning tog'lar zanjirlarini, alohida tog'larini, sirklarni yoki bog'liq tuzilmalarni, shuningdek, o'zlarining shovqinlari, yoriqlari va radiatsiyalash bo'laklarini juda osonlikcha ajratib olishingiz mumkin.

en: The character of the whole lunar relief is comprised in these divisions.
uz: Butun oy reliefi xarakterini ushbu bo'linmalarga aylantirib qo'ydi.

en: It is a surface prodigiously reticulated, upheaved and depressed, apparently without the slightest order or system.
uz: Bu ajoyib retikulyatsiyali, baland va tushirilgan, ko'rinishicha eng kichik tartib yoki tizimsiz yuza.

en: It is a vast Switzerland, an enormous Norway, where everything is the result of direct plutonic action.
uz: Bu yirik Shveytsariya, yirik Norvegiya, unda hamma narsa to'g'ridan-to'g'ri plutonik harakatlar natijasida sodir bo'ladi.

en: This surface, so rugged, craggy and wrinkled, seems to be the result of successive contractions of the crust, at an early period of the planet's existence.
uz: Bu yirtqich, toshbo'ron va burchakli yuzasi, ko'rinishicha, sayyoramiz mavjud bo'lgan dastlabki davrda, qalinlikning ketma-ket qisqarishining natijasi bo'lib chiqdi.

en: The examination of the lunar disc is therefore highly favorable for the study of the great geological phenomena of our own globe.
uz: Shuning uchun oy diskini tekshirish sayyoramizning katta geologik hodisalarini o'rganish uchun juda qulay.

en: As certain astronomers have remarked, the Moon's surface, though older than the Earth's, has remained younger.
uz: Ba'zi astronomlar aytganidek, oy yuzi Yer yuzasidan kattaroq bo'lsa-da, yoshroq qoldi.

en: That is, it has undergone less change.
uz: Ya'ni, u kamroq o'zgarishlarga duch kelgan.

en: No water has broken through its rugged elevations, filled up its scowling cavities, and by incessant action tended continuously to the production of a general level.
uz: Hech bir suv o'zining balandlikdagi balandliklarini buzmagan, o'zlarining ko'tarilgan hollarini to'ldirmagan va uzluksiz harakatlar bilan doimiy ravishda umumiy darajadagi ishlab chiqarishga moyil bo'lgan.

en: No atmosphere, by its disintegrating, decomposing influence has softened off the rugged features of the plutonic mountains.
uz: Hech bir atmosfera, uning buzib ketayotgan, buzib ketayotgan ta'siri tufayli pluton tog'larining qattiq xususiyatlarini yumshatmagan.

en: Volcanic action alone, unaffected by either aqueous or atmospheric forces, can here be seen in all its glory.
uz: Faqatgina vulqon harakatlari, suvli yoki atmosfera kuchlari tomonidan ta'sirlanmagan holda, bu yerda o'z shon-shuhratida ko'rinadi.

en: In other words the Moon looks now as our Earth did endless ages ago, when "she was void and empty and when darkness sat upon the face of the deep;" eons of ages ago, long before the tides of the ocean and the winds of the atmosphere had begun to strew her rough surface with sand and clay, rock and coal, forest and meadow, gradually preparing it, according to the laws of our beneficent Creator, to be at last the pleasant though the temporary abode of Man!
uz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, oy hozir bizning Yerimiz ko'rinishi bilan cheksiz zamonlar oldin, "u bo'sh va bo'sh edi va qorong'ilik chuqurlik yuzida o'tirganida"; zamonlar oldin, okean to'lqinlari va atmosfera shamollari uning qalin yuzini qum va loy, tosh va ko'mir, o'rmon va o'tlar bilan to'kishni boshlashdan oldin, asta-sekin bizni Yaratuvchimizning qonunlariga muvofiq insonning vaqtinchalik yashash joyi bo'lishiga tayyorlab bormoqda!

en: Having wandered over vast continents, your eye is attracted by the "seas" of dimensions still vaster.
uz: Katta qit'alar bo'ylab sayohat qilganingizdan so'ng, ko'zingiz yanada kengroq o'lchamlarning "dengizlari" tomonidan jalb qilinadi.

en: Not only their shape, situation, and look, remind us of our own oceans, but, again like them, they occupy the greater part of the Moon's surface.
uz: Ularning shakli, holati va tashqi ko'rinishi nafaqat bizning okeanlarimizni eslatadi, balki ular singari, ular oy yuzasining katta qismini egallaydi.

en: The "seas," or, more correctly, plains, excited our travellers' curiosity to a very high degree, and they set themselves at once to examine their nature.
uz: "dengizlar" yoki to'g'riroq aytganda, dengizlar sayohatchilarning qiziqishini juda yuqori darajada uyg'otdi va ular darhol o'zlarining tabiatini o'rganishga harakat qilishdi.

en: The astronomer who first gave names to those "seas" in all probability was a Frenchman.
uz: O'sha "dengizlarga" birinchi marta ism qo'ygan astronom, ehtimol, frantsuzlik edi.

en: Hevelius, however, respected them, even Riccioli did not disturb them, and so they have come down to us.
uz: Biroq, Hevelius ularga hurmat ko'rsatdi, hatto Riccioli ham ularni bezovta qilmadi, shuning uchun ular bizga kelib qolishdi.

en: Ardan laughed heartily at the fancies which they called up, and said the whole thing reminded him of one of those "maps of matrimony" that he had once seen or read of in the works of Scudéry or Cyrano de Bergerac.
uz: Ardan ular keltirib chiqaradigan xayollarga quvonch ila kuldi va bu butun narsa unga bir marta Skuderi yoki Cyrano de Bergerac asarlarida ko'rgan yoki o'qigan "uylanish xaritasi" dan birini eslatganini aytdi.

en: "However," he added, "I must say that this map has much more reality in it than could be found in the sentimental maps of the ൢ൨th century.
uz: "Shunga qaramay", - deb qo'shimcha qildi u, "bu xarita o'nchi asrdagi hissiy xaritalarda topilganidan ko'ra ko'proq haqiqatni o'z ichiga olganini aytishim kerak.

en: In fact, I have no difficulty whatever in calling it the Map of Life!
uz: Aslida, men uni hayot xaritasi deb atashda hech qanday qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmayman!

en: very neatly divided into two parts, the east and the west, the masculine and the feminine.
uz: Bu ikki qismga, sharq va g'arb, erkak va ayol qismlariga juda yaxshi taqsimlangan.

en: The women on the right, and the men on the left!" At such observations, Ardan's companions only shrugged their shoulders.
uz: Ayollar o'ngda, erkaklar chapda!" - degan so'zlarni eshitgan Ardanning do'stlari faqatgina omon qolishdi.

en: A map of the Moon in their eyes was a map of the Moon, no more, no less; their romantic friend might view it as he pleased.
uz: Ularning ko'zidagi oy xaritasi o'sha oy xaritasi edi; ularning romantik do'sti unga xohlagancha qarashi mumkin edi.

en: Nevertheless, their romantic friend was not altogether wrong.
uz: Shunga qaramay, ularning romantik do'sti umuman noto'g'ri emas edi.

en: Judge a little for yourselves.
uz: O'zingiz uchun bir oz hukm qiling.

en: What is the first "sea" you find in the hemisphere on the left?
uz: O'ng tomondagi yarim jahonda uchratgan birinchi "dengiz" nima?

en: The Mare Imbrium or the Rainy Sea, a fit emblem of our human life, beaten by many a pitiless storm.
uz: Mare Imbrium yoki yomg'ir dengiz, insoniy hayotimizning o'ziga xos ramzi, ko'pgina shafqatsiz bo'ronlar tomonidan uringan.

en: In a corresponding part of the southern hemisphere you see Mare Nubium, the Cloudy Sea, in which our poor human reason so often gets befogged.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahonning tegishli qismida siz Mare Nubium, bulutli dengizni ko'rasiz, unda kambag'al inson aql-idrokimiz ko'pincha o'z ichiga oladi.

en: Close to this lies Mare Humorum, the Sea of Humors, where we sail about, the sport of each fitful breeze, "everything by starts and nothing long." Around all, embracing all, lies Oceanus Procellarum, the Ocean of Tempests, where, engaged in one continuous struggle with the gusty whirlwinds, excited by our own passions or those of others, so few of us escape shipwreck.
uz: Buning yaqinida Mare Humorum, biz sayohat qilayotgan Humorlar dengizida, har bir shovqinli shamolning sportida, "barcha narsa boshlanadi va hech narsa uzoq emas". "Barchasini o'rab olgan okean Procellarum, bo'ronlar dengizida joylashgan.

en: And, when disgusted by the difficulties of life, its deceptions, its treacheries and all the other miseries "that flesh is heir to," where do we too often fly to avoid them?
uz: Hayotning qiyinchiliklari, aldashlari, xiyonatlari va boshqa barcha azob-uqubatlardan nafratlanayotganimizda, biz ulardan qochish uchun tez-tez qayerga uchib ketamiz?

en: To the Sinus Iridium or the Sinus Roris, that is Rainbow Gulf and Dewy Gulf whose glittering lights, alas!
uz: Sinus Iridium yoki Sinus Rorisga, ya'ni Rainbow Gulf va Dewy Gulfga, ularning shishqoq chiroqlari, vay bo'lsin!

en: give forth no real illumination to guide our stumbling feet, whose sun-tipped pinnacles have less substance than a dream, whose enchanting waters all evaporate before we can lift a cup-full to our parched lips!
uz: To'sqinlik qilayotgan oyoqlarimizni yo'naltirish uchun hech qanday haqiqiy yorug'lik bermaydi, ularning quyoshli cho'qqizlari tushdan kamroq substansiyaga ega bo'ladi, ularning sehrli suvlari butunlay buzib ketadi, chunki biz o'z quruq og'izlarimizga to'liq qadahni ko'tarib olishimizdan oldin!

en: Showers, storms, fogs, rainbows— is not the whole mortal life of man comprised in these four words?
uz: Shovqinlar, bo'ronlar, tumanlar, yomg'irbo'ylar bu to'rtta so'zdan iborat bo'lgan insonning butun o'lik hayoti emasmi?

en: Now turn to the hemisphere on the right, the women's side, and you also discover "seas," more numerous indeed, but of smaller dimensions and with gentler names, as more befitting the feminine temperament.
uz: Endi o'ngdagi yarim jahonning, ayollar tomoniga buring va siz "dengizlarni" ko'proq ko'paygan, ammo kichikroq o'lchamli va salmoqli nomlarga ega bo'lgan "dengizlarni" ham ko'rasiz.

en: First comes Mare Serenitatis, the Sea of Serenity, so expressive of the calm, tranquil soul of an innocent maiden.
uz: Birinchi bo'lib Mare Serenitatis, tinchlik dengizlari keladi, bu esa bexatar bir qizning tinch va xotirjam ruhini ifodalaydi.

en: Near it is Lacus Somniorum, the Lake of Dreams, in which she loves to gaze at her gilded and rosy future.
uz: Uning yonida Lacus Somniorum, orzular ko'li bor, unda u o'zining oltin va gullab-yashnagan kelajagini ko'rishni yaxshi ko'radi.

en: In the southern division is seen Mare Nectaris, the Sea of Nectar, over whose soft heaving billows she is gently wafted by Love's caressing winds, "Youth on the prow and Pleasure at the helm." Not far off is Mare Fecunditatis, the Sea of Fertility, in which she becomes the happy mother of rejoicing children.
uz: Janubiy bo'limda Mare Nectaris, nectar dengizini ko'rish mumkin, uning ustida sevgi shamollari, "Yoshlik parvozda va zavq paytida".

en: A little north is Mare Crisium, the Sea of Crises where her life and happiness are sometimes exposed to sudden, and unexpected dangers which fortunately, however, seldom end fatally.
uz: Biroz shimoliyda Mare Crisium, uning hayoti va baxtiyorligi ba'zan to'satdan va kutilmagan xavflarga duchor bo'lib, baxtli bo'lishga olib keladi.

en: Far to the left, near the men's side, is Mare Vaporum, the Sea of Vapors, into which, though it is rather small, and full of sunken rocks, she sometimes allows herself to wander, moody, and pouting, and not exactly knowing where she wants to go or what she wants to do.
uz: O'ng chap tomonda, erkaklar yonida, Mare Vaporum, Buvlar dengizidir, u yerga u juda kichik bo'lsa-da, cho'kkan toshlar bilan to'lib-toshsa-da, u ba'zan o'zini ko'rgazishga, ruhiy tuyg'ularga va o'ziga to'sqinlik qilishga ruxsat beradi va u qaerga borishni yoki nima qilishni xohlayotganini aniq bilmaydi.

en: Between the two last expands the great Mare Tranquillitatis, the Sea of Tranquillity, into whose quiet depths are at last absorbed all her simulated passions, all her futile aspirations, all her unglutted desires, and whose unruffled waters are gliding on forever in noiseless current towards Lacus Mortis, the Lake of Death, whose misty shores
uz: Ikkita oxirgi o'rtasida katta Mare Tranquillitatis, Tinchlik dengizining kengligi, uning tinch chuqurliklari nihoyat uning barcha simulyatsiya qilingan ishtiyoqlari, barcha befoyda orzulari, barcha g'amgin istaklarini o'z ichiga oladi va uning to'xtamas suvlari Lacus Mortisga, o'lim ko'lagiga, uning bulutli sohillariga qaraganda doimo shovqinlik qilmoqda.

en: "In ruthless, vast, and gloomy woods are girt." So at least Ardan mused as he stooped over Beer and Maedler's map.
uz: "Qahrsiz, keng va qorong'i o'rmonlar qamoqda". Shunday qilib, hech bo'lmaganda Ardan Beer va Maedlerning xaritasi ustida egrilib o'tirganida o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: Did not these strange successive names somewhat justify his flights of fancy?
uz: Bu g'alati ismlar uning o'yin-kulgilarini biroz oqlamaganmi?

en: Surely they had a wonderful variety of meaning.
uz: Shubhasizki, ular ajoyib ma'nolarga ega edi.

en: Was it by accident or by forethought deep that the two hemispheres of the Moon had been thus so strangely divided, yet, as man to woman, though divided still united, and thus forming even in the cold regions of space a perfect image of our terrestrial existence?
uz: Ayning ikki yarim qirrasining o'ziga xos tarzda bo'linishi tasodif yoki oldindan o'ylab ko'rish natijasida bo'lib o'tganmi, lekin erkak va ayol bo'lishsa-da, ular hali ham birlashgan va hatto kosmoning sovuq hududlarida ham yer yuzidagi mavjudotimizning mukammal tasvirini yaratganmi?

en: Who can say that our romantic French friend was altogether wrong in thus explaining the astute fancies of the old astronomers?
uz: Bizning romantik frantsuz do'stimiz eski astronomlarning aqlli xayollarini shunday tushuntirib, mutlaqo xato qilganini kim aytishi mumkin?

en: His companions, however, it need hardly be said, never saw the "seas" in that light.
uz: Biroq, uning hamrohlari hech qachon "dengizlarni" bunday ko'rinishda ko'rmagan, deb aytish qiyin.

en: They looked on them not with sentimental but with geographical eyes.
uz: Ular ularga sentimental emas, balki geografik ko'zlar bilan qarashgan.

en: They studied this new world and tried to get it by heart, working at it like a school boy at his lessons.
uz: Ular ushbu yangi dunyoni o'rganishdi va uni yoddan o'rganishga harakat qilishdi, uni sinfda o'qiyotgan maktab o'g'li kabi o'rganishardi.

en: They began by measuring its angles and diameters.
uz: Ular uning burchak va diametrini o'lchashdan boshlashdi.

en: To their practical, common sense vision Mare Nubium, the Cloudy Sea, was an immense depression of the surface, sprinkled here and there with a few circular mountains.
uz: Ularning amaliy, aqlli ko'rinishicha, Mare Nubium, Bulutli dengiz, bir nechta aylancha tog'lar bilan to'plangan, yuzning ulkan pastligi edi.

en: Covering a great portion of that part of the southern hemisphere which lies east of the centre, it occupied a space of about ൣ൨ൡ thousand square miles, its central point lying in ൢ൦° south latitude and ൣൡ° east longitude.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahonning markazidan sharqda joylashgan qismining katta qismini qamrab olgan u taxminan  ming kvadrat mil maydoniga ega edi, uning markaziy nuqtasi ° janubiy kenglik va ° sharqiy uzunliklarda joylashgan.

en: Northeast from this lay Oceanus Procellarum, the Ocean of Tempests, the most extensive of all the plains on the lunar disc, embracing a surface of about half a million of square miles, its centre being in ൢൡ° north and ൥൦° east.
uz: Shimoliy-sharqiy tomondagi Oceanus Procellarum - bu shamollar okeani, oy diskidagi barcha tekisliklar orasida eng keng tarqalgan, taxminan yarim million kvadrat mil maydoni bo'lgan dengiz dengiz dengizining shimoli va sharqning markazida joylashgan.

en: From its bosom those wonderful mountains Kepler and Aristarchus lifted their vast ramparts glittering with innumerable streaks radiating in all directions.
uz: Uning qornidan Kepler va Aristarch ajoyib tog'lar o'zlarining ko'p qirrali devorlarini ko'tarib, har tomonga nur sochadigan son-sanoqsiz chiziqlarni ko'tardilar.

en: To the north, in the direction of Mare Frigoris, extends Mare Imbrium, the Sea of Rains, its central point in ൤൦° north and ൣൡ° east.
uz: Shimoliy tomonga, Mare Frigoris yo'nalishida, Mare Imbrium, ya'ni yomg'irlar dengizini, uning markazidagi nuqtasi ° shimoliy va ° sharq bo'lib o'tadi.

en: It is somewhat circular in shape, and it covers a space of about ൤ൡൡ thousand square miles.
uz: U biroz davraliy shaklda bo'lib, taxminan ming kvadrat mil maydonni o'z ichiga oladi.

en: South of Oceanus Procellarum and separated from Mare Nubium by a goodly number of ring mountains, lies the little basin of Mare Humorum, the Sea of Humors, containing only about ൧൧ thousand square miles, its central point having a latitude of ൣ൦° south and a longitude of ൥ൡ° east.
uz: Oceanus Procellarumning janubiy qismida va Mare Nubiumdan bir qator bog'liq tog'lar bilan ajralib, Mare Humorumning kichkina hovli, Humorlar dengizlari joylashgan, u faqat taxminan  ming kvadrat milni o'z ichiga oladi, uning markaziy nuqtasi ° janub eni va ° sharq eniga ega.

en: On the shores of these great seas three "Gulfs" are easily found: Sinus Aestuum, the Gulf of the Tides, northeast of the centre; Sinus
uz: Ushbu ulkan dengizlar qirg'og'ida uchta "Gulf"ni osonlikcha topish mumkin: Sinus Aestuum, Tids ko'rgazmasi, markazning shimoli-sharqida; Sinus

en: Iridium, the Gulf of the Rainbows, northeast of the Mare Imbrium; and Sinus Roris, the Dewy Gulf, a little further northeast.
uz: Iridium, yomg'irboqlar ko'rguvi, Mare Imbriumning shimoli-sharqida; va Sinus Roris, Dewy ko'rguvi, biroz shimoli-sharqida.

en: All seem to be small plains enclosed between chains of lofty mountains.
uz: Ularning barchasi baland tog'lar zanjirlari o'rtasida o'ralgan kichik o'tlardek ko'rinadi.

en: The western hemisphere, dedicated to the ladies, according to Ardan, and therefore naturally more capricious, was remarkable for "seas" of smaller dimensions, but much more numerous.
uz: G'arbiy yarim jahon, Ardanning aytishicha, ayollarga bag'ishlangan va shuning uchun tabiiy ravishda ko'proq capricious, kichikroq o'lchamli, ammo ko'proq ko'p "dengizlar" uchun diqqatga sazovor edi.

en: These were principally: Mare Serenitatis, the Sea of Serenity, ൣ൦° north and ൣൡ° west, comprising a surface of about ൢ൤ൡ thousand square miles; Mare Crisium, the Sea of Crises, a round, well defined, dark depression towards the northwestern edge, ൢ൨° north ൦൦° west, embracing a surface of ൧ൡ thousand square miles, a regular Caspian Sea in fact, only that the plateau in which it lies buried is surrounded by a girdle of much higher mountains.
uz: Bular asosan quyidagilar edi: Mare Serenitatis, Serenity dengiz, ° shimoliy va ° g'arbiy, taxminan  ming kvadrat mil maydoni; Mare Crisium, Crisis dengiz, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aniqlangan, shimoli-g'arbiy bo'yiga qaraydigan qorong'i tushlik, ° shimoliy ° g'arbiy,  ming kvadrat mil maydoni bo'lgan, oddiy Kaspiy dengiz, aslida, faqat o'zidan ko'p baland tog'lar bilan o'ralgan plato atrofida joylashgan.

en: Then towards the equator, with a latitude of ൦° north and a longitude of ൣ൦° west, appears Mare Tranquillitatis, the Sea of Tranquillity, occupying about ൢ൩ൡ thousand square miles.
uz: Keyin ekvator tomon, ° shimoliy va ° g'arb uzunliklari bilan, Mare Tranquillitatis, ya'ni Tinchlik dengizlari paydo bo'ladi, bu dengiz taxminan  ming kvadrat milni tashkil etadi.

en: This communicates on the south with Mare Nectaris, the Sea of Nectar, embracing an extent of about ൥ൣ thousand square miles, with a mean latitude of ൢ൦° south and a longitude of ൤൦° west.
uz: Bu janubiy tomondan Mare Nectaris, ya'ni Nektar dengizini o'z ichiga oladi va taxminan ming kvadrat milni tashkil etadi, o'rtacha eni - janubiy eni - janubiy eni va g'arbiy eni - g'arbiy eni - g'arbiy eni.

en: Southwest from Mare Tranquillitatis, lies Mare Fecunditatis, the Sea of Fertility, the greatest in this hemisphere, as it occupies an extent of more than ൤ൡൡ thousand square miles, its latitude being ൤° south and its longitude ൦ൡ° west.
uz: Mare Tranquillitatisdan janubi-g'arbiy tarafga Mare Fecunditatis, ya'ni Tug'unlik dengizlari joylashgan, bu yarim jahonning eng yirik dengizidir, chunki u ming kvadrat mildan ortiq maydonga ega bo'lib, uning eni janubiy° va g'arbiy° bo'lgan uzunligi bor.

en: For away to the north, on the borders of the Mare Frigoris, or Icy Sea, is seen the small Mare Humboldtianum, or Humboldt Sea, with a surface of about ൢൡ thousand square miles.
uz: Shimoliy tarafda, Mare Frigoris yoki Issiq dengiz chegarasida, kichik Mare Humboldtianum yoki Humboldt dengizining yuzasi taxminan ming kvadrat mil bo'lib, ko'rinadi.

en: Corresponding to this in the southern hemisphere lies the Mare Australe, or South Sea, whose surface, as it extends along the western rim, is rather difficult to calculate.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahonning shu qismiga teng bo'lgan Janubiy dengiz, g'arbiy sohil bo'ylab kengaygan bo'lsa-da, uning yuzini hisoblash qiyin.

en: Finally, right in the centre of the lunar disc, where the equator intersects the first meridian, can be seen Sinus Medii, the Central Gulf, the common property therefore of all the hemispheres, the northern and southern, as well as of the eastern and western.
uz: Va nihoyat, ekvator birinchi meridianni kesib o'tadigan oy diskining markazida Sinus Medii ko'rinadi, ya'ni Markaziy qirg'oq, shuning uchun barcha shimoliy va janubiy, shuningdek, sharqiy va g'arbiy yarim jahonning umumiy mulki.

en: Into these great divisions the surface of our satellite resolved itself before the eyes of Barbican and M'Nicholl.
uz: Ushbu ulkan bo'linmalarga sayyohimizning yuzi Barbican va M'Nichollning ko'z o'ngida o'zini hal qildi.

en: Adding up the various measurements, they found that the surface of her visible hemisphere was about ൨-ൢ/ൣ millions of square miles, of which about the two thirds comprised the volcanoes, the mountain chains, the rings, the islands—in short, the land portion of the lunar surface; the other third
uz: Turli o'lchovlarni qo'shib, ular uning ko'rinadigan yarim jahon yuzasining yuzi millionlab kvadrat milni tashkil etishini aniqladilar, ularning uchdan ikki qismi vulqonlar, tog'lar, do'zaxlar, orollar, qisqacha aytganda, oy yuzasining quruqligi; qolgan uchdan bir qismi esa.

en: comprised the "seas," the "lakes," the "marshes," the "bays" or "gulfs," and the other divisions usually assigned to water.
uz: "dengizlar", "ko'llar", "bo'laklar", "ko'llar" yoki "golflar" va odatda suvga tegishli bo'lgan boshqa bo'linmalardan iborat edi.

en: To all this deeply interesting information, though the fruit of observation the closest, aided and confirmed by calculation the profoundest, Ardan listened with the utmost indifference.
uz: Ushbu qiziqarli ma'lumotlarning barchasini, hatto diqqat bilan kuzatish natijasidan, hisob-kitoblar yordamida eng chuqur tasdiqlanishi va qo'llab-quvvatlanishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, Ardan eng katta befarqlik bilan tingladi.

en: In fact, even his French politeness could not suppress two or three decided yawns, which of course the mathematicians were too absorbed to notice.
uz: Aslida, hatto uning frantsuzcha xushmuomalaligi ham ikki yoki uchta qat'iy qichqirishni yo'qotib qo'ymaydi, bu esa, albatta, matematikachilarning e'tiborini olmaydi.

en: In their enthusiasm they tried to make him understand that though the Moon is ൢ൤-ൢ/ൣ times smaller than our Earth, she can show more than ൦ൡ thousand craters, which astronomers have already counted and designated by specific names.
uz: Ular o'z g'ayratlari bilan uni tushunishga harakat qilishdiki, oy Yerimizdan -/ marta kichik bo'lsa-da, u mingdan ortiq kraterlarni ko'rsatishi mumkin, bu kraterlarni astronomlar allaqachon sanab, aniq nomlar bilan belgilab qo'ygan.

en: "To conclude this portion of our investigation therefore," cried Barbican, clearing his throat, and occupying Aldan's right ear,—"the Moon's surface is a honey combed, perforated, punctured—" "A fistulous, a rugose, salebrous,—" cut in the Captain, close on the left.
uz: "Shunday qilib, biz o'z tergovimizning ushbu qismini yakunlashimiz uchun", - deb baqirib yubordi Barbican, bo'yni ochib, Aldanning o'ng quloqini egallab,"Ayning yuzi - o'tkir, perforatsiyalangan, bo'g'ilgan" "Kaptanning o'rtasida kesilgan, chap tomondan yaqin bo'lgan, o'g'ir, qo'rqinchli."

en: —"And highly cribriform superficies—" cried Barbican.
uz: "Va yuqori darajada o'zgaruvchan yuzalar" deb baqirdi Barbican.

en: —"A sieve, a riddle, a colander—" shouted the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Bir siva, bir raqib, bir ko'lmandir", - deb baqirdi.

en: —"A skimming dish, a buckwheat cake, a lump of green cheese —" went on Barbican—.
uz: "Qizil ovqat, bug'doy keksi, yashil pishloq qovurishi" so'zi Barbicanda davom etdi.

en: —In fact, there is no knowing how far they would have proceeded with their designations, comparisons, and scientific expressions, had not Ardan, driven to extremities by Barbican's last profanity, suddenly jumped up, broken away from his companions, and clapped a forcible extinguisher on their eloquence by putting his hands on their lips and keeping them there awhile.
uz: Agar Ardan Barbicanning so'nggi iflosligi tufayli nihoyasiga yetib bormagan bo'lsa edi, u to'satdan ko'tarilib, o'z sheriklaridan ajralib, qo'llarini og'izlariga qo'yib, ularni bir muncha vaqt ushlab turish orqali ularning so'zlashuvchanligiga silliq o'chirgich qo'yib qo'ygan bo'lsa edi, ular qanchalik uzoq davom etgan bo'lishlari mumkin edi, deb hech kim bilmaydi.

en: Then striking a grand attitude, he looked towards the Moon and burst out in accents of thrilling indignation: "Pardon, O beautiful Diana of the Ephesians!
uz: Keyin katta munosabatda bo'lib, u oyga qarab, hayajonli g'azablangan so'zlar bilan: "Kechirgin, ey Efesliklarning go'zal Diana!

en: Pardon, O Phoebe, thou pearl-faced goddess of night beloved of Greece!
uz: Kechirgin, ey Phoebe, sen, Yunonistonning sevimli, marvarid yuzli kecha xudosi!

en: O Isis, thou sympathetic queen of Nile-washed cities!
uz: Ey Isis, sen, Nildan suvga cho'kkan shaharlarning mehribon qiroli!

en: O Astarte, thou favorite deity of the Syrian hills!
uz: Ey Astart, Suriya tog'larining eng sevimli xudo!

en: O Artemis, thou symbolical daughter of Jupiter and Latona, that is of light and darkness!
uz: Artemis, sen, Yupiter va Latonaning ramziy qizi, yorug'lik va qorong'ilik!

en: O brilliant sister of the radiant Apollo!
uz: Oh, yorqin Apolloning ajoyib singlisi!

en: enshrined in the enchanting strains of Virgil and Homer, which I only half learned at college, and therefore unfortunately forget just now!
uz: Virgil va Homerin sehrli so'zlariga asoslangan, men uni kollejda o'rganganimning yarmidan kam emasman va shuning uchun afsuski hozir unutib qo'yaman!

en: Otherwise what pleasure I should have
uz: Aks holda men qanday zavqga ega bo'lishim kerak?

en: had in hurling them at the heads of Barbican, M'Nicholl, and every other barbarous iconoclast of the nineteenth century!—" Here he stopped short, for two reasons: first he was out of breath; secondly, he saw that the irrepressible scientists had been too busy making observations of their own to hear a single word of what he had uttered, and were probably totally unconscious that he had spoken at all.
uz: Ularni Barbican, M'Nicholl va o'n to'qqizinchi asrning har bir savob ikonoqlastining boshlariga tashlab ketishga majbur bo'lgan!" Bu yerda u ikki sabab bilan to'xtadi: birinchisi, nafas o'tib ketdi; ikkinchidan, u ko'rganki, bosimsiz olimlar o'zlarining kuzatishlari bilan juda band bo'lib, u aytgan so'zlarning bir so'zini ham eshitishmagani uchun, ehtimol, u gapirganidan umuman bexabar edilar.

en: In a few seconds his breath came back in full blast, but the idea of talking when only deaf men were listening was so disconcerting as to leave him actually unable to get off another syllable.
uz: Bir necha soniyadan so'ng uning nafaslari to'liq o'tib ketdi, lekin faqat karlar tinglayotgan paytda gapirish g'oyasi uni shunchalik xavotirga solganki, u boshqa bir silfadan chiqishga qodir emasdi.

en: A BIRD'S EYE VIEW OF THE LUNAR MOUNTAINS.
uz: Oʻz navbatida, oy togʻlarining qush koʻzi koʻrinishi.

en: I am rather inclined to believe myself that not one word of Ardan's rhapsody had been ever heard by Barbican or M'Nicholl.
uz: Men o'zimga ishonishga moyilmanki, Barbican yoki M'Nicholl tomonidan Ardanning rhapsodiyasidan hech bir so'z eshitilmagan.

en: Long before he had spoken his last words, they had once more become mute as statues, and now were both eagerly watching, pencil in hand, spyglass to eye, the northern lunar hemisphere towards which they were rapidly but indirectly approaching.
uz: U so'nggi so'zlarini aytishdan ancha oldin, ular yana bir bor haykal kabi soqovga aylangan edilar va endi ikkalasi ham o'z ko'zlarida qalam, ko'z o'ngida ko'z o'ngida bo'lib, tezda, ammo bevosita yaqinlashib kelayotgan shimoliy oy yarim qirrasini e'tibor bilan kuzatib turishgan.

en: They had fully made up their minds by this time that they were leaving far behind them the central point which they would have probably reached half an hour ago if they had not been shunted off their course by that inopportune bolide.
uz: Bu vaqtgacha ular o'zlarining orqasidan uzoqdan tashlab ketishlarini, ehtimol yarim soat oldin erishgan bo'lishlari mumkin bo'lgan markaziy nuqtani tark etishlarini to'liq qaror qilgan edilar, agar ular o'z yo'llaridan o'tkazib yuborilmagan bo'lsa edi.

en: About half past twelve o'clock, Barbican broke the dead silence by saying that after a careful calculation they were now only about ൩൨൦ miles from the Moon's surface, a distance two hundred miles less in length than the lunar radius, and which was still to be diminished as they advanced further north.
uz: Taxminan soat uch yarim o'n ikki o'tgach, Barbican o'sha bechora so'zni buzdi va aniq hisob-kitoblardan so'ng ular endi oy yuzasidan atigi ikki yuz kilometr uzoqlikda, oy radiusidan ikki yuz kilometr kamroq bo'lgan, ammo ular shimoliy tomonga borgan sari kamayishi kerakligini aytdi.

en: They were at that moment ten degrees north of the equator, almost directly over the ridge lying between the Mare Serenitatis and the Mare Tranquillitatis.
uz: O'sha paytda ular ekvatordan o'n daraja shimolida, deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Mare Serenitatis va Mare Tranquillitatis o'rtasida joylashgan sho'rning ustida edilar.

en: From this latitude all the way up to the north pole the travellers enjoyed a most satisfactory view of the Moon in all directions and under the most favorable conditions.
uz: Ushbu kenglikdan shimoliy qutbga qadar sayohatchilar oyning barcha yo'nalishlarda va eng qulay sharoitlarda eng qoniqarli ko'rinishidan bahramand bo'lishdi.

en: By means of their spyglasses, magnifying a hundred times, they cut down this distance of ൩൨൦ miles to about ൪.
uz: O'zlarining yuz baravar ko'proq ko'rinadigan shishalari yordamida ular bu uzoqlikni taxminan  milga qisqartirib, taxminan  ga yetkazishdi.

en: The great telescope of the Rocky Mountains, by its enormous magnifying power of ൥൩,ൡൡൡ, brought the Moon, it is true, within a distance of ൦ miles, or nearly twice as near; but this advantage of nearness was considerably more than counterbalanced by a want of clearness, resulting from the haziness and refractiveness of the terrestrial atmosphere, not to mention those fatal defects in the reflector that the art of man has not yet succeeded in remedying.
uz: Rocky tog'larining ulkan teleskoplari o'zlarining , ning ulkan ko'paytirish quvvati bilan oyni , kilometr masofasiga, ya'ni deyarli ikki baravar yaqinlashtirdi; ammo yaqinlik bu afzalligi yer atmosferasining soyaligi va buzg'unchiligi natijasida aniqlik yetishmasligi bilan ancha ko'proq o'z o'rniga, inson san'ati hali bartaraf eta olmagan reflektordagi o'ta halokatli nuqsonlarni aytib o'tmasligimiz kerak.

en: Accordingly, our travellers, armed with excellent telescopes—of just power enough to be no injury to clearness,—and posted on unequalled vantage ground, began already to distinguish certain details that had probably never been noticed before by terrestrial observers.
uz: Shuning uchun, bizning sayohatchilarimiz, aniqlikka zarar yetkazmaydigan darajada kuchli teleskoplar bilan jihozlangan va tengsiz ko'rinishdagi joylarda joylashtirilgan, hozirda yer yuzidagi kuzatuvchilar tomonidan ilgari hech qachon e'tiborga olinmagan ba'zi tafsilotlarni aniqlay boshlashdi.

en: Even Ardan, by this time quite recovered from his fit of sentiment and probably infected a little by the scientific enthusiasm of his companions, began to observe and note and observe and note, alternately, with all the sangfroid of a veteran astronomer.
uz: Hatto Ardan ham o'sha paytgacha his-tuyg'ularidan to'lib-toshgan va ehtimol o'z hamkasblarining ilmiy g'ayratidan biroz zarar ko'rgan bo'lsa-da, bir-birini kuzatib, kuzatib, kuzatib, kuzatib turishni boshladi.

en: "Friends," said Barbican, again interrupting a silence that had lasted perhaps ten minutes, "whither we are going I can't say; if we shall ever revisit the Earth, I can't tell.
uz: - Do'stlar, - dedi Barbican, ehtimol o'n daqiqa davom etgan nutqni yana bir bor uzatib, - qayerga borayotganimizni aytolmayman; agar Yerga qaytishimiz mumkin bo'lsa, aytolmayman.

en: Still, it is our duty so to act in all respects as if these labors of ours were one day to be of service to our fellow-creatures.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, barcha jihatlardan amal qilish bizning vazifamizdir, xuddi shu mehnatlarimiz bir kun kelib o'z yaratuvchilarimizga xizmat qilishi kerak bo'lganidek.

en: Let us keep our souls free from every distraction.
uz: Keling, ruhimizni har qanday chalg'itishdan ozod qilaylik.

en: We are now astronomers.
uz: Hozir biz astronomlarmiz.

en: We see now what no mortal eye has ever gazed on before.
uz: Hozir biz hech bir insoniy ko'z ilgari ko'rmagan narsani ko'ramiz.

en: This Projectile is simply a work room of the great Cambridge Observatory lifted into space.
uz: Ushbu proyektil shunchaki kosmosga ko'tarilgan buyuk Kembridž observatoriyasining ish xonasi.

en: Let us take observations!" With these words, he set to work with a renewed ardor, in which his companions fully participated.
uz: Keling, kuzatuvlarni ko'rib chiqaylik!" degan so'zlar bilan u yana bir bor g'ayrat bilan ishga tushdi va uning hamkorlari bu ishda to'liq ishtirok etishdi.

en: The consequence was that they soon had several of the outline maps covered with the best sketches they could make of the Moon's various aspects thus presented under such favorable circumstances.
uz: Natijada, tez orada ular oyning turli jihatlarini suratga olishlari mumkin bo'lgan eng yaxshi eskizlar bilan ko'p martabalarni suratga olishdi.

en: They could now remark not only that they were passing the tenth degree of north latitude, but that the Projectile followed almost directly the twentieth degree of east longitude.
uz: Endi ular nafaqat o'ninchi sharqiy eni o'tib ketayotganini, balki Projectile deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sharqiy uzunlikning yigirma darajasiga ergashganini ta'kidlashlari mumkin edi.

en: "One thing always puzzled me when examining maps of the Moon," observed Ardan, "and I can't say that I see it yet as clearly as if I had thought over the matter.
uz: "Oy xaritalarini ko'rib chiqayotib, meni har doim bir narsa hayratda qoldirdi", - deb aytdi Ardan, "va men buni hali ham o'ylab ko'rganimdek aniq ko'rib turibman, deb aytolmayman.

en: I could understand, when looking through a lens at an object, why we get only its reversed image—a simple law of optics explains that.
uz: Ob'ektni lenza orqali ko'rganimda, nega biz faqat uning orqa tomoniga o'zgartirilgan tasvirini olishimizni tushunib yetaman.

en: Therefore, in a map of
uz: Shuning uchun,ning xaritasida

en: the Moon, as the bottom means the north and the top the south, why does not the right mean the west and the left the east?
uz: O'ng tomoni - shimoli, yuqori tomoni esa janubiy, nega o'ng tomoni - g'arb, chap tomoni esa sharqni anglatmaydi?

en: I suppose I could have made this out by a little thought, but thinking, that is reflection, not being my forte, it is the last thing I ever care to do.
uz: Ehtimol, men buni biroz o'ylab topishim mumkin edi, lekin o'ylash, bu o'ylashdir, bu mening kuchli tomonim emas, bu men qilmoqchi bo'lgan oxirgi narsa.

en: Barbican, throw me a word or two on the subject." "I can see what troubles you," answered Barbican, "but I can also see that one moment's reflection would have put an end to your perplexity.
uz: "Men sizni nima bezovta qilayotganini tushunaman, - dedi Barbican, - lekin bir daqiqa mulohaza yuritish sizning g'alatiligingizga chek qo'yganini ham tushunaman.

en: On ordinary maps of the Earth's surface when the north is the top, the right hand must be the east, the left hand the west, and so on.
uz: Yer yuzasining oddiy xaritalarida shimoli yuqori qismida bo'lganda, o'ng qo'li sharqda, chap qo'li g'arbda bo'lishi kerak va shunga o'xshab.

en: That is simply because we look down from above.
uz: Buning sababi shunchaki yuqoridan pastga qarab turamiz.

en: And such a map seen through a lens will appear reversed in all respects.
uz: Va shisha orqali ko'rilgan bunday xarita har jihatdan o'zgacha ko'rinadi.

en: But in looking at the Moon, that is up from down, we change our position so far that our right hand points west and our left east.
uz: Ammo oyga, ya'ni pastdan yuqoriga qarab, o'z joyimizni shunchalik o'zgartiramizki, o'ng qo'limiz g'arbga, chap qo'limiz esa sharqqa qaratilgan.

en: Consequently, in our reversed map, though the north becomes south, the right remains east, and—" "Enough said!
uz: Natijada, o'zgartirilgan xaritamizda shimoli janubiga aylangan bo'lsa-da, o'ng tomon sharqda qoladi, va" "To'g'ri dedi!"

en: I see it at a glance!
uz: Men buni bir ko'zdan ko'rib turibman!

en: Thank you, Barbican.
uz: Sizga rahmat, Barbican.

en: Why did not they make you a professor of astronomy?
uz: Nima uchun sizni astronomiya professori qilib tayinlamadilar?

en: Your hint will save me a world of trouble."[C] Aided by the Mappa Selenographica, the travellers could easily recognize the different portions of the Moon over which they were now moving.
uz: Sizning g'oyangiz menga ko'p muammolardan qutqaradi".[C] Mappa Selenographica yordamida sayohatchilar o'zlari harakatlanayotgan oyning turli qismlarini osonlikcha tan olishdi.

en: An occasional glance at our reduction of this map, given as a frontispiece, will enable the gentle reader to follow the travellers on the line in which they moved and to understand the remarks and observations in which they occasionally indulged.
uz: Ushbu xaritani qisqartirganimizga vaqti-vaqti bilan nazar tashlash va oldindan ko'rish mehribon o'quvchiga sayohatchilarning harakat qilgan yo'llarini kuzatib borishga va ular vaqti-vaqti bilan qilgan izoh-ishoralar va kuzatishlarni tushunishga imkon beradi.

en: "Where are we now?" asked Ardan.
uz: "Biz endi qayerdamiz?" deb so'radi Ardan.

en: "Over the northern shores of the Mare Nubium," replied Barbican.
uz: "Mar Nubiumning shimoliy sohillarida", deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "But we are still too far off to see with any certainty what they are like.
uz: Ammo biz hali ham ular qanday ekanligini aniq ko'rish uchun juda uzoqdamiz.

en: What is the Mare itself?
uz: Mare o'zi nima?

en: A sea, according to the early astronomers?
uz: Qadimgi astronomlarning fikricha, dengizmi?

en: a plain of solid sand, according to later authority?
uz: Keyinchalik ma'lum bo'lganlarga ko'ra, to'siq qumni o'rab olgan joymi?

en: or an immense forest, according to De la Rue of London, so far the Moon's most successful photographer?
uz: Yoki Londondagi De la Rue ning aytishicha, oyning eng muvaffaqiyatli fotosuratchisi bo'lgan ulkan o'rmonmi?

en: This gentleman's authority, Ardan, would have given you decided support in your famous dispute with the Captain at the meeting near Tampa, for he says very decidedly that the Moon has an atmosphere, very low to be sure but very dense.
uz: Bu xonimning hokimiyati, Ardan, Tampa yaqinidagi uchrashuvda kapitan bilan bo'lgan mashhur bahsingizda sizga qat'iy yordam bergan bo'lardi, chunki u o'zining aytishicha, oyda atmosfera juda past, ammo juda zich.

en: This, however, we must find out for ourselves; and in the meantime let us affirm nothing until we have good grounds for positive assertion."
uz: Biroq, buni o'zimiz aniqlab olishimiz kerak va shu vaqtgacha ijobiy asoslarga ega bo'lmagunimizcha hech narsa tasdiqlamaylik".

en: Mare Nubium, though not very clearly outlined on the maps, is easily recognized by lying directly east of the regions about the centre.
uz: Mare Nubium xaritalarda aniq ko'rsatilmagan bo'lsa-da, markaz atrofidagi mintaqalarning sharqiy tomonida joylashganligi sababli uni osonlikcha tan olish mumkin.

en: It would appear as if this vast plain were sprinkled with immense lava blocks shot forth from the great volcanoes on the right, Ptolemaeus, Alphonse, Alpetragius and Arzachel.
uz: Ko'rinishicha, bu keng o'lchovga o'ng tomondagi katta vulqonlar - Ptolemey, Alfonso, Alpetragius va Arzachel - tomonidan o'tkazilgan ulkan lava bloklari to'lib-toshgan.

en: But the Projectile advanced so rapidly that these mountains soon disappeared, and the travellers were not long before they could distinguish the great peaks that closed the "Sea" on its northern boundary.
uz: Ammo o'g'illar shunchalik tez rivojlanganki, bu tog'lar tez orada yo'qoldi va sayohatchilar "dengiz"ning shimoliy chegarasida joylashgan katta tepaliklarni ajratib ko'rishdi.

en: Here a radiating mountain showed a summit so dazzling with the reflection of the solar rays that Ardan could not help crying out: "It looks like one of the carbon points of an electric light projected on a screen!
uz: Bu yerda quyosh nurining aks ettirishi bilan chiroyli bo'lgan toʻpni koʻrsatgan bir togʻ, Ardan: "Bu ekranda koʻrinadigan elektr yorugʻligining koʻmir nuqtalaridan biriga oʻxshaydi!

en: What do you call it, Barbican?" "Copernicus," replied the President.
uz: Unga qanday ism qo'yasan, Barbican?" - dedi Prezident. - Kopernik.

en: "Let us examine old Copernicus!" This grand crater is deservedly considered one of the greatest of the lunar wonders.
uz: "Qadimgi Kopernikni ko'rib chiqaylik!" Ushbu buyuk krater haqli ravishda oy mo'jizasi orasida eng buyuklaridan biri deb hisoblanadi.

en: It lifts its giant ramparts to upwards of ൢൣ,ൡൡൡ feet above the level of the lunar surface.
uz: U o'zining ulkan devorlarini oy yuzasidan 2 metr yuqoriga ko'taradi.

en: Being quite visible from the Earth and well situated for observation, it is a favorite object for astronomical study; this is particularly the case during the phase existing between Last Quarter and the New Moon, when its vast shadows, projected boldly from the east towards the west, allow its prodigious dimensions to be measured.
uz: Yerdan juda ko'rinadi va kuzatuv uchun yaxshi joylashtirilganligi sababli, u astronomik tadqiqotlar uchun eng sevimli ob'ekt hisoblanadi; bu ayniqsa so'nggi chorak va yangi oy o'rtasidagi davrda, sharqdan g'arbiy tomon jasorat bilan ko'rsatilgan ulkan soyalar uning ajoyib o'lchamlarini o'lchashga imkon beradi.

en: After Tycho, which is situated in the southern hemisphere, Copernicus forms the most important radiating mountain in the lunar disc.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahon bo'ylab joylashgan Tycho ortidan keyin Kopernik oy diskidagi eng muhim radiatsiya qiluvchi tog'ni tashkil etadi.

en: It looms up, single and isolated, like a gigantic light-house, on the peninsula separating Mare Nubium from Oceanus Procellarum on one side and from Mare Imbrium on the other; thus illuminating with its splendid radiation three "Seas" at a time.
uz: U bir tomondan Mare Nubiumni Oceanus Procellarumdan, boshqa tomondan Mare Imbriumdan ajratib turadigan yarim orolida ulkan chiroq kabi yakka va alohida ko'rinadi; shu yo'sin, o'zining ajoyib nurlanishlari bilan bir vaqtning o'zida uchta "dengizni" yoritadi.

en: The wonderful complexity of its bright streaks diverging on all sides from its centre presented a scene alike splendid and unique.
uz: Uning markazidan har tarafdan farq qiladigan yorqin chiziqlarining ajoyib murakkabligi bir xil ajoyib va noyob ko'rinishni taqdim etdi.

en: These streaks, the travellers thought, could be traced further north than in any other direction: they fancied they could detect them even in the Mare Imbrium, but this of course might be owing to the point from which they made their observations.
uz: Sayohatchilar bu chiziqlarni boshqa yo'nalishlardan ko'ra shimoliy tomonga ko'ra ko'proq kuzatish mumkin deb o'ylashgan: ular ularni hatto Mare Imbriumda ham aniqlay olishlarini o'ylashgan, ammo bu, albatta, ular kuzatuvlarini amalga oshirgan nuqtadan kelib chiqqanligi sababli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: At one o'clock in the morning, the Projectile, flying through space, was exactly over this magnificent mountain.
uz: Ertalab soat birda kosmosda uchib o'tgan "Projektil" aynan shu ajoyib tog'ning ustida edi.

en: In spite of the brilliant sunlight that was blazing around them, the travellers could easily recognize the peculiar features of Copernicus.
uz: Ularning atrofida quyoshning parvarishlashiga qaramay, sayohatchilar Kopernikning o'ziga xos xususiyatlarini osonlikcha tan olishardi.

en: It belongs to those ring mountains of the first class called Circuses.
uz: U birinchi sinfdagi sirk tog'lariga tegishli.

en: Like Kepler and Aristarchus, who rule over Oceanus Procellarum, Copernicus, when viewed through our telescopes, sometimes glistens so brightly through the ashy light of the Moon that it has been frequently taken for a volcano in full activity.
uz: Okeanus Procellarum ustidan hukmronlik qiladigan Kepler va Aristark kabi Kopernik ham bizning teleskoplarimiz orqali ko'rilganida, ba'zan oyning kulli nuridan shunchalik yorqin shishalib turadiki, u ko'pincha to'la faollikdagi vulqon deb hisoblangan.

en: Whatever it may have been once, however, it is certainly nothing more now than, like all the other mountains on the visible side of the Moon, an extinct volcano, only with a crater of such exceeding grandeur and sublimity as to throw utterly into the shade everything like it on our Earth.
uz: Biroq, u bir vaqtlar nima bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, hozir u o'z navbatida, oyning ko'rinadigan tomonidagi barcha tog'lar singari, o'lik vulqon bo'lib qolgan, lekin u o'ta buyuk va ulkan bo'lgan kraterga ega bo'lib, Yer yuzidagi barcha o'xshash narsalarni soyasida qoldiradi.

en: The crater of Etna is at most little more than a mile across.
uz: Etna kraterining eni eng ko'pida bir mildan oshmaydi.

en: The crater of Copernicus has a diameter of at least ൦ൡ miles.
uz: Kopernik kraterining diametrlari kamida  mil.

en: Within it, the travellers could easily discover by their glasses an immense number of terraced ridges, probably landslips, alternating with stratifications resulting from successive eruptions.
uz: Uning ichida sayohatchilar ko'zgu ko'zlari orqali ko'p miqdordagi yer yuzi chiziqlarini, ehtimol yer yuzi chiqqani va bir-biridan keyin sodir bo'lgan portlashlardan kelib chiqqan qatlamlar bilan bir-birini almashtirishlarini osonlikcha topishlari mumkin edi.

en: Here and there, but particularly in the southern side, they caught glimpses of shadows of such intense blackness, projected across the plateau and lying there like pitch spots, that they could not tell them from yawning chasms of incalculable depth.
uz: Bu erda va u erda, ayniqsa janubiy tomonda, ular plato bo'ylab ko'tarilib, o'sha joyda o'tirgan, o'sha joyda o'tirgan kuchli qoralik soyalarining ko'rinishlarini ko'rishdi, chunki ular o'zlariga o'xshamaydigan chuqurlikdagi chuqurlikdagi chuqurliklarni aniqlay olishmadi.

en: Outside the crater the shadows were almost as deep, whilst on the plains all around, particularly in the west, so many small craters could be detected that the eye in vain attempted to count them.
uz: Krater tashqarisida soyalar deyarli xuddi shunday chuqur edi, atrofdagi o'tlar, ayniqsa g'arbda, shunchalik ko'p kichik kratyerlarni aniqlab olish mumkin ediki, ko'z ularni sanashga behuda harakat qildi.

en: "Many circular mountains of this kind," observed Barbican, "can be seen on the lunar surface, but Copernicus, though not one of the greatest, is one of the most remarkable on account of those diverging streaks of bright light that you see radiating from its summit.
uz: "O'sha kabi ko'plab aylanma tog'lar ko'rinadi", - deb ta'kidladi Barbican, "shuningdek, Kopernik, eng buyuklaridan biri bo'lmasa-da, eng diqqatga sazovorlaridan biridir, chunki uning samarasidan yorug' yorug'lik nurning o'ziga xos qatlamlarini ko'rish mumkin.

en: By looking steadily into its crater, you can see more cones than mortal eye ever lit on before.
uz: Uning kraterini doimiy ravishda ko'rib, siz o'z ko'zingizdagi ko'zdan ko'ra ko'proq konlarni ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: They are so numerous as to render the interior plateau quite rugged, and were formerly so many openings giving vent to fire and volcanic matter.
uz: Ular juda ko'p bo'lib, ichki platoni juda qattiq qiladilar va ilgari olov va volkanik moddalarga ruxsat beruvchi juda ko'p yoriqlar bo'lgan.

en: A curious and very common arrangement of this internal plateau of lunar craters is its lying at a lower level than the external plains, quite the contrary to a terrestrial crater, which generally has its bottom much higher than the level of the surrounding country.
uz: Ushbu ichki oy kraterlari platolarining g'ayrioddiy va juda keng tarqalgan joylashuvi, uning tashqi o'tlaridan past darajada joylashganligi, asosan, atrofdagi mamlakat darajasidan ancha yuqori bo'lgan yerdagi kraterning aksariyati.

en: It follows therefore that the deep lying curve of the bottom of these ring mountains would give a sphere with a diameter somewhat smaller than the Moon's."
uz: Shuning uchun, bu do'zax tog'larining tubidagi chuqur bo'g'ri chiziq o'z diametriga o'ta kichik bo'lgan sferni beradi".

en: "What can be the cause of this peculiarity?" asked M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Bu xilma-xillikning sababi nima bo'lishi mumkin?" - deb so'radi.

en: "I can't tell;" answered Barbican, "but, as a conjecture, I should say that it is probably to the comparatively smaller area of the Moon and the more violent character of her volcanic action that the extremely rugged character of her surface is mainly due." "Why, it's the Campi Phlegraei or the Fire Fields of Naples over again!" cried Ardan suddenly.
uz: "Men buni aniq ayta olmayman", - deb javob berdi Barbican, - lekin taxmin qilib aytishim kerakki, ayning nisbatan kichik maydoni va uning volkanik harakatining zo'ravonligi tufayli uning yuzasining nihoyatda qattiqligi katta ahamiyatga ega.

en: "There's Monte Barbaro, there's the Solfatara, there is the crater of Astroni, and there is the Monte Nuovo, as plain as the hand on my body!" "The great resemblance between the region you speak of and the general surface of the Moon has been often remarked;" observed Barbican, "but it is even still more striking in the neighborhood of Theophilus on the borders of Mare Nectaris." "That's Mare Nectaris, the gray spot over there on the southwest, isn't it?" asked M'Nicholl; "is there any likelihood of our getting a better view of it?" "Not the slightest," answered Barbican, "unless we go round the Moon and return this way, like a satellite describing its orbit." By this time they had arrived at a point vertical to the mountain centre.
uz: "Monte Barbaro bor, Solfatara bor, Astroni krateri bor va mening tanamdagi qo'lim kabi sodda Mont Nuovo bor!" - deb aytdi Barbican. - Siz gapirgan hudud va oyning umumiy yuzi o'rtasidagi katta o'xshashlik ko'pincha qayd etilgan", - deb ta'kidladi Barbican. - Lekin bu Mare Nectaris chegarasida joylashgan Theophilus atrofida yanada diqqatga sazovorroq. - Bu Mare Nectaris, janubi-g'arbiy qismdagi griy nuqta, shunday emasmi? - deb so'radi M'Nicholl. - Ayni yaxshiroq ko'rishimiz mumkinmi? - deb so'radi M'Nicholl. - "Agar biz oyni aylanib, bu yo'ldan qaytsak, uning orbitalarini tasvirlaydigan satelit paydo bo'ladi", - dedi Barbican.

en: Copernicus's vast ramparts formed a perfect circle or rather a pair of concentric circles.
uz: Kopernikning ulkan devorlari mukammal aylanni yoki aniqrog'i, bir juft konsentrik aylanni tashkil etdi.

en: All around the mountain extended a dark grayish plain of savage aspect, on which the peak shadows projected themselves in sharp relief.
uz: Tog'ning atrofida yovvoyi ko'rinishdagi qorong'i sariq tekislik bo'lib, uning ustida o'z-o'zini keskin ko'rinishda ko'targan soyalar ko'tarildi.

en: In the gloomy bottom of the crater, whose dimensions are vast enough to swallow Mont Blanc body and bones, could be distinguished a magnificent group of cones, at least half a mile in height and glittering like piles of crystal.
uz: Kraterning qorong'i tubida, uning o'lchamlari Mont Blanning tanasi va suyaklarini yutib yuborish uchun etarlicha keng bo'lganida, kamida yarim mil balandlikda va kristall to'plamlari kabi shinam bo'lgan ajoyib konlar guruhi ko'rinadi.

en: Towards the north several breaches could be seen in the ramparts, due probably to a caving in of immense masses accumulated on the summit of the precipitous walls.
uz: Shimoliy tomonga qarab, devorlarda bir nechta burilishlar ko'rinardi, ehtimol bu bu devorlarning cho'qqisida to'plangan ulkan to'plamlarning ko'tarilishi tufayli sodir bo'lgan.

en: As already observed, the surrounding plains were dotted with numberless craters mostly of small dimensions, except Gay Lussac on the north, whose crater was about ൢൣ miles in diameter.
uz: Ko'rib chiqqanimizdek, atrofdagi o'tlar ko'pincha kichik o'lchamli ko'kratorlar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, faqat shimolida Gay Lussac bor edi.

en: Towards the southwest and the immediate east, the plain appeared to be very flat, no protuberance, no prominence of any kind lifting itself above the general dead level.
uz: Janubi-g'arbiy va yaqin sharqqa qaraganda, o'tkir joy juda tekis, ko'tarilmagan, o'zini umumiy o'lik darajadan yuqori ko'targan hech qanday nufuzlilik ko'rinmadi.

en: Towards the north, on the contrary, as far as where the peninsula jutted on Oceanus Procellarum, the plain looked like a sea of lava wildly lashed for a while by a furious hurricane and
uz: Aksincha, shimoliga qarab, yarim orol Oceanus Procellarumga qo'shilganida, o'tkir joy bir vaqt davomida g'azabli bo'ron va   tomonidan vahimaga tushirilgan lava dengizini o'xshatardi.

en: then, when its waves and breakers and driving ridges were at their wildest, suddenly frozen into solidity.
uz: So'ngra uning to'lqinlari, buzuvchilar va haydovchilar o'zlarining eng yovvoyi joylarida bo'lganida, to'satdan qattiqlikka to'xtab qoldi.

en: Over this rugged, rumpled, wrinkled surface and in all directions, ran the wonderful streaks whose radiating point appeared to be the summit of Copernicus.
uz: Bu qo'pol, qovurilgan, burchakli yuza va har tomonlama ajoyib bo'laklar o'tib bordi, ularning radiatsiyalash nuqtasi Kopernikning to'plami bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: Many of them appeared to be ten miles wide and hundreds of miles in length.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi o'n kilometr keng va yuzlab kilometr uzunlikda edi.

en: The travellers disputed for some time on the origin of these strange radii, but could hardly be said to have arrived at any conclusion more satisfactory than that already reached by some terrestrial observers.
uz: Sayohatchilar bu g'alati radiuslarning kelib chiqishi haqida bir muncha vaqt bahslashdilar, ammo ular ba'zi yer yuzidagi kuzatuvchilar tomonidan allaqachon erishilgan natijalardan ko'ra mamnuniyatliroq xulosaga kelishgan deb aytish qiyin edi.

en: To M'Nicholl's question: "Why can't these streaks be simply prolonged mountain crests reflecting the sun's rays more vividly by their superior altitude and comparative smoothness?" Barbican readily replied: "These streaks can't be mountain crests, because, if they were, under certain conditions of solar illumination they should project shadows—a thing which they have never been known to do under any circumstances whatever.
uz: M'Nichollning "Nima uchun bu chiziqlar shunchaki quyosh nurlarini yuqori balandlik va nisbatan sekinlik bilan aniqroq aks ettiradigan uzoq tog'lar bo'lishi mumkin emas?" degan savolga Barbican tezda shunday javob berdi: "Bu chiziqlar tog'lar chiziqlari bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki agar shunday bo'lgan bo'lsalar, quyosh nurining muayyan sharoitlarida soyalar ko'rinishini ko'rsatishlari kerak edi.Bu ular hech qachon hech qanday holatda qilmagan narsa.

en: In fact, it is only during the period of the full Moon that these streaks are seen at all; as soon as the sun's rays become oblique, they disappear altogether—a proof that their appearance is due altogether to peculiar advantages in their surface for the reflection of light." "Dear boys, will you allow me to give my little guess on the subject?" asked Ardan.
uz: Darhaqiqat, bu chiziqlar faqat to'liq oy davrida ko'rinadi; quyosh nurlari bo'sh bo'lganda, ular butunlay yo'qoladi - ularning ko'rinishi ularning yuzasida nurni aks ettirish uchun o'ziga xos afzalliklarga bog'liqligini isbotlaydi.

en: His companions were profuse in expressing their desire to hear it.
uz: Uning do'stlari uni eshitishni xohlayotganlarini ko'rsatishda ko'pchilik edi.

en: "Well then," he resumed, "seeing that these bright streaks invariably start from a certain point to radiate in all directions, why not suppose them to be streams of lava issuing from the crater and flowing down the mountain side until they cooled?" "Such a supposition or something like it has been put forth by Herschel," replied Barbican; "but your own sense will convince you that it is quite untenable when you consider that lava, however hot and liquid it may be at the commencement of its journey, cannot flow on for hundreds of miles, up hills, across ravines, and over plains, all the time in streams of almost exactly equal width."
uz: - Xo'sh, - dedi u yana, - bu yorqin chiziqlar har xil yo'nalishlarda nurlanish uchun muayyan nuqtadan boshlanayotganini ko'rib, nega ular kraterdan chiqib, tog' tomondan sovguncha pastga oqib ketayotgan lava oqimlari deb o'ylamaydilar? - Bu kabi taxmin yoki shunga o'xshash narsa Herschel tomonidan ko'rsatilgan, - dedi Barbican. - Lekin siz o'z aql-idrokingiz bilan o'ylaganicha, lava, sayohatining boshida qanchalik issiq va suyuq bo'lsa-da, to'rt yuz kilometr davom eta olmaydi, tog'larga ko'tarib, gorillalar orqali va o'lchovlar ustidan, deyarli teng kenglikdagi oqimlarda doimo o'tadi.

en: "That theory of yours holds no more water than mine, Ardan," observed M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Sening nazariyangiz mening nazariyamdan ko'ra ko'proq suvga ega emas, Ardan", - deb ta'kidladi.

en: "Correct, Captain," replied the Frenchman; "Barbican has a trick of knocking the bottom out of every weaker vessel.
uz: "To'g'ri, kapitan", deb javob berdi frantsuz, "Barbican har bir zaif kemaning pastini urish hiylasi bilan shug'ullanadi.

en: But let us hear what he has to say on the subject himself.
uz: Lekin keling, bu borada uning o'zi nima deyayotganini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: What is your theory.
uz: Sizning nazariyangiz qanday?

en: Barbican?" "My theory," said Barbican, "is pretty much the same as that lately presented by an English astronomer, Nasmyth, who has devoted much study and reflection to lunar matters.
uz: "Mening nazariyam, - dedi Barbican, - yaqinda ingliz astronom Nasmyth tomonidan taqdim etilgan nazariyaga o'xshaydi, u o'zining ko'p tadqiqotlarini va mulohazalarini oy masalasiga bag'ishlagan.

en: Of course, I only formulate my theory, I don't affirm it.
uz: Albatta, men faqat o'z nazrimni so'zlab beraman, uni tasdiqlamayman.

en: These streaks are cracks, made in the Moon's surface by cooling or by shrinkage, through which volcanic matter has been forced up by internal pressure.
uz: Ushbu bo'laklar - oy yuzida sovuqlik yoki qisqartirish tufayli paydo bo'lgan bo'laklardir, ular orqali ichki bosim vulkanik moddalarni ko'tarishga majbur qildi.

en: The sinking ice of a frozen lake, when meeting with some sharp pointed rock, cracks in a radiating manner: every one of its fissures then admits the water, which immediately spreads laterally over the ice pretty much as the lava spreads itself over the lunar surface.
uz: To'qilgan ko'lning cho'kkan muzlari, o'tkir toshlar bilan uchrashganda, radiatsiyaviy tarzda parchalanib ketadi: uning har bir bo'g'riligi suvni qabul qiladi, bu esa o'z-o'zini lava o'z-o'zini oy yuzi ustida tarqatganidek, darhol muz ustida yonma-yon tarqalib ketadi.

en: This theory accounts for the radiating nature of the streaks, their great and nearly equal thickness, their immense length, their inability to cast a shadow, and their invisibility at any time except at or near the Full Moon.
uz: Ushbu nazariya bu chiziqlarning radiatsiyaviy xususiyati, ularning katta va deyarli teng qalinligi, ulkan uzunligi, soyani tashlash imkoniyati va to'liq oydan tashqari har qanday vaqtda ko'rinmasligini tushuntiradi.

en: Still it is nothing but a theory, and I don't deny that serious objections may be brought against it." "Do you know, dear boys," cried Ardan, led off as usual by the slightest fancy, "do you know what I am thinking of when I look down on the great rugged plains spread out beneath us?" "I can't say, I'm sure," replied Barbican, somewhat piqued at the little attention he had secured for his theory.
uz: Ammo bu shunchaki nazardan boshqa narsa emas va men bunga qarshi jiddiy e'tirozlar keltirilishi mumkinligini inkor etmayman". - deb hayqirdi Ardan, odatdagidek, kamroq o'y-ilash bilan: "Bizning pastimizda tarqalib turgan katta va toshbo'ron o'tkirlarga nazar tashlab ko'rganimda, nima haqida o'ylayotganimni bilasizmi?" - deb o'ylaydi. "Men buni aytolmayman, albatta", - deb javob berdi Barbican nazariga ko'p e'tibor berilmaganidan biroz xafa bo'lib.

en: "Well, what are you thinking of?" asked M'Nicholl.
uz: - Xo'sh, nima haqida o'ylayapsan? - deb so'radi M'Nicholl.

en: "Spillikins!" answered Ardan triumphantly.
uz: "Spillikins!" - deb javob berdi Ardan g'alaba bilan.

en: "Spillikins?" cried his companions, somewhat surprised.
uz: "Spillikins?" - deb hayqirdi uning hamrohlari, biroz ajablanib.

en: These rocks, these blocks, these peaks, these streaks, these cones, these cracks, these ramparts, these escarpments,—what are they but a set of spillikins, though I acknowledge on a grand scale?
uz: Ushbu toshlar, bloklar, to'plar, chiziqlar, shishalar, burchaklar, devorlar, tog'lar - bularning barchasi katta miqyosda e'tirof etilgan bo'lsa-da, bularning barchasi to'plamdan boshqa narsa emasmi?

en: I wish I had a little hook to pull them one by one!"
uz: O'zim ham ularni bir-biridan tortib olish uchun kichkina bir qo'ng'iroqga ega bo'lishim kerak edi!"
