uz: Bu juda katta jang maydonidir.

en: "Oh, do be serious, Ardan!" cried Barbican, a little impatiently.
uz: "O, jiddiy bo'l, Ardan!" - deb ba'zi bir sabrsizlik bilan Barbican hayqirib yubordi.

en: "Certainly," replied Ardan.
uz: Ardan javob berdi: "Chunki, albatta.

en: "Let us be serious, Captain, since seriousness best befits the subject in hand.
uz: "Biz jiddiy bo'laylik, kapitan, chunki jiddiylik mavzuga mos keladi.

en: What do you think of another comparison?
uz: Boshqa bir taqqoslash haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz?

en: Does not this plain look like an immense battle field piled with the bleaching bones of myriads who had slaughtered each other to a man at the bidding of some mighty Caesar?
uz: Bu o'tkir maydonga o'xshash bo'lmagan jang maydoni bo'lib, bir qancha qudratli Qaysarning buyrug'i bilan bir kishiga o'zaro qirib tashlagan o'nlab odamlarning o'g'il suyaklari to'plandi.

en: What do you think of that lofty comparison, hey?" "It is quite on a par with the other," muttered Barbican.
uz: O'sha yuksak taqqoslash haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz, ey?" - deb qichqirdi Barbican.

en: "He's hard to please, Captain," continued Ardan, "but let us try him again!
uz: "Uni mamnun qilish qiyin, kapitan", dedi Ardan davom etib, "lekin uni yana sinab ko'raylik!

en: Does not this plain look like—?"
uz: Bu maydonga o'xshamaydimi?"

en: "My worthy friend," interrupted Barbican, quietly, but in a tone to discourage further discussion, "what you think the plain looks like is of very slight import, as long as you know no more than a child what it really is!" "Bravo, Barbican!
uz: "Mening munosib do'stim", - dedi Barbican, xotirjamlik bilan, ammo boshqa muhokamalarni rag'batlantirish maqsadida, "o'zingizning fikringcha oddiy narsa qanday ko'rinishi juda kam ahamiyatga ega, agar siz uning nima ekanligini bolalikdan ko'ra bilsangiz!"

en: well put!" cried the irrepressible Frenchman.
uz: Yaxshilik!" - deb baqirib yubordi tanqis fransuz.

en: "Shall I ever realize the absurdity of my entering into an argument with a scientist!" But this time the Projectile, though advancing northward with a pretty uniform velocity, had neither gained nor lost in its nearness to the lunar disc.
uz: "Men bir olim bilan bahslashishning absurdligini hech qachon anglay olamanmi?" - deb so'radi u. Ammo bu safar Projectile shimoliga nisbatan bir xil tezlikda harakatlanayotgan bo'lsa-da, oy diskining yaqinligida hech qanday yutuq va yo'qotmagan edi.

en: Each moment altering the character of the fleeting landscape beneath them, the travellers, as may well be imagined, never thought of taking an instant's repose.
uz: Har bir daqiqada ular ostidan o'tib ketadigan landshaftning xarakterini o'zgartirgan sayohatchilar, tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin bo'lganidek, bir daqiqalik dam olish haqida hech qachon o'ylamagan.

en: At about half past one, looking to their right on the west, they saw the summits of another mountain; Barbican, consulting his map, recognized Eratosthenes.
uz: Taxminan soat uch yarimda, ular o'ng tomon g'arbga qarab, boshqa tog'ning tepaliklarini ko'rishdi; Barbican o'z xaritasiga qarab, Eratostenesni tan oldi.

en: This was a ring mountain, about ൤൤ miles in diameter, having, like Copernicus, a crater of immense profundity containing central cones.
uz: Bu deyarli millar bo'lgan, Kopernik kabi katta chuqurlikdagi kraterga ega bo'lgan, markazda konlar mavjud bo'lgan bir do'zax tog' edi.

en: Whilst they were directing their glasses towards its gloomy depths, Barbican mentioned to his friends Kepler's strange idea regarding the formation of these ring mountains.
uz: Ular ko'z ko'zlarini qorong'i chuqurliklarga yo'naltirganida, Barbican do'stlariga Keplerning bu bog'liq tog'larning paydo bo'lishi haqidagi g'ayrioddiy g'oyasini aytib berdi.

en: "They must have been constructed," he said, "by mortal hands." "With what object?" asked the Captain.
uz: "Ular o'lik qo'llar tomonidan qurilgan bo'lishi kerak", dedi u. "Qanday asbob bilan?" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "A very natural one," answered Barbican.
uz: "U juda tabiiy", deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "The Selenites must have undertaken the immense labor of digging these enormous pits at places of refuge in which they could protect themselves against the fierce solar rays that beat against them for ൢ൦ days in succession!" "Not a bad idea, that of the Selenites!" exclaimed Ardan.
uz: "Selenitlar o'zlariga qarshi ketma-ket kunlar davomida urib turgan kuchli quyosh nurlaridan o'zlarini himoya qilish uchun panoh joylarida bu ulkan quduqlarni qazish uchun ulkan mehnat qilishgan bo'lishi kerak!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "An absurd idea!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Bu absurd g'oya!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "But probably Kepler never knew the real dimensions of these craters.
uz: Ammo ehtimol Kepler bu kraterlarning haqiqiy o'lchamlarini hech qachon bilmagan.

en: Barbican knows the trouble and time required to dig a well in Stony Hill only nine hundred feet deep.
uz: Barbican Stony Hilldagi qudratni qazish uchun faqat to'qqiz yuz fut chuqurlikdagi qiyinchilik va vaqtni biladi.

en: To dig out a single lunar crater would take hundreds and hundreds of years, and even then they should be giants who would attempt it!" "Why so?" asked Ardan.
uz: Bironta oy kraterini qazish uchun yuzlab yillar kerak bo'ladi va hatto shunday bo'lsa ham, uni sinab ko'radigan ulkanlar bo'lishi kerak! "Nima uchun?" deb so'radi Ardan.

en: "In the Moon, where gravity is six times less than on the Earth, the labor of the Selenites can't be compared with that of men like us."
uz: "Gravitatsiya Yerdagiga qaraganda olti baravar kamroq bo'lgan oyda Selenitlarning mehnatini biz kabi insonlar bilan solishtirish mumkin emas".

en: "But suppose a Selenite to be six times smaller than a man like us!" urged M'Nicholl.
uz: "Agar Selenit biz kabi odamdan olti baravar kichikroq bo'lsa-yu!" - dedi M'Nicholl.

en: "And suppose a Selenite never had an existence at all!" interposed Barbican with his usual success in putting an end to the argument.
uz: "Agar Selenit hech qachon mavjud bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da!" - dedi Barbican, bahsni tugatishda odatdagi muvaffaqiyati bilan bog'liq.

en: "But never mind the Selenites now.
uz: "Ammo endi Selenitlar haqida tashvishlanmang.

en: Observe Eratosthenes as long as you have the opportunity." "Which will not be very long," said M'Nicholl.
uz: Eratostenni imkoningiz bo'lgancha kuzatib turing". - Bu juda uzoq vaqt o'tmaydi, - dedi M'Nicholl.

en: "He is already sinking out of view too far to the right to be carefully observed." "What are those peaks beyond him?" asked Ardan.
uz: "U allaqachon diqqat bilan kuzatib bo'lmaydigan darajada ko'rinishsiz bo'lib bormoqda". - Ardan so'radi.

en: "The Apennines," answered Barbican; "and those on the left are the Carpathians." "I have seen very few mountain chains or ranges in the Moon," remarked Ardan, after some minutes' observation.
uz: "Apeninlar", - deb javob berdi Barbican; "soq tomonida esa Karpatlar bor. "Men oyda juda oz tog'lar zanjirini yoki shoxlarini ko'rdim", dedi Ardan bir necha daqiqalik kuzatuvdan so'ng.

en: "Mountains chains are not numerous in the Moon," replied Barbican, "and in that respect her oreographic system presents a decided contrast with that of the Earth.
uz: "Oyda tog'lar zanjiri ko'p emas", deb javob berdi Barbican, "va shu munosabat bilan uning oreografiya tizimi Yerdagi bilan aniq farq qiladi.

en: With us the ranges are many, the craters few; in the Moon the ranges are few and the craters innumerable." Barbican might have spoken of another curious feature regarding the mountain ranges: namely, that they are chiefly confined to the northern hemisphere, where the craters are fewest and the "seas" the most extensive.
uz: Bizda tog'lar ko'p, kraterlar oz, oyda kraterlar oz va kraterlar son-sanoqsiz".Barbican tog'lar to'g'risida yana bir qiziqarli xususiyat haqida gapirgan bo'lishi mumkin: ular asosan shimoliy yarim jahon bilan cheklangan, u erda kraterlar eng kam va "dengizlar" eng keng.

en: They skirt the western shores of the Mare Imbrium, over which they rise in immense cliffs, ൢ൩ or ൣൡ thousand feet in height, steep as a wall and casting over the plain intensely black shadows at least ൪ൡ miles long.
uz: Ular Mare Imbriumning g'arbiy sohillari bo'ylab o'tadi va ular ustida katta toshlar, balandligi ming fut yoki ming fut bo'lgan, devor kabi baland va o'tkir bo'lib, o'tkir qora soyalar bilan kamida ming mil uzunlikdagi tekis joyni ko'tarib o'tadi.

en: Huyghens, the highest in the group, the travellers were just barely able to distinguish the sharp angular summit in the far west.
uz: Guruhning eng baland bo'lgan Huyghens, sayohatchilar uzoq g'arbdagi keskin burchakli sammitni kamdan-kam farqlay olishdi.

en: To the east, however, the Carpathians, extending from the ൢ൩th to ൤ൡth degrees of east longitude, lay directly under their eyes and could be examined in all the peculiarities of their distribution.
uz: Biroq, sharqda Karpatlar, sharqiy uzunlikning -dan -darajlarigacha bo'lgan, ularning ko'zlari ostida joylashgan va ularning tarqalishining barcha o'ziga xos xususiyatlarini o'rganish mumkin edi.

en: Barbican proposed a hypothesis regarding the formation of those mountains, which his companions thought at least as good as any other.
uz: Barbican o'sha tog'larning paydo bo'lishiga oid g'oyani taklif qildi, uning hamkorlari hech bo'lmaganda boshqa tog'lar kabi yaxshi deb o'yladilar.

en: Looking carefully over the Carpathians and catching occasional glimpses of semi-circular formations and half domes, he concluded that the chain must have formerly been a succession of vast craters.
uz: Karpatlarni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqib, yarim to'plamli formaatsiyalar va yarim kupollarni ko'rib, u zanjir ilgari yirik kraterlarning ketma-ketligi bo'lishi kerak degan xulosaga keldi.

en: Then had come some mighty internal discharge, or rather the subsidence to which Mare Imbrium is due, for it immediately broke off or swallowed up one half of those mountains, leaving the other half steep as a wall on one side and sloping gently on the other to the level of the surrounding plains.
uz: Keyin kuchli ichki oqim paydo bo'ldi yoki, aniqrog'i, Mare Imbriumning tushishi sabab bo'ldi, chunki u darhol bu tog'larning bir yarmini buzdi yoki yutib yubordi, qolgan yarmini bir tomondan devor kabi baland qoldirdi va boshqa tomondan atrofdagi tekisliklar darajasigacha sekin o'tdi.

en: The Carpathians were therefore pretty nearly in the same condition as the crater mountains Ptolemy, Alpetragius and Arzachel would find themselves in, if some terrible cataclysm, by tearing away their eastern ramparts, had turned them into a chain of mountains whose towering cliffs would nod threateningly over the western shores of Mare Nubium.
uz: Shuning uchun Karpatlar to'g'ri, deyarli xuddi Ptolemey, Alpetragiy va Arzachel tog'lari kabi holatda edi, agar sharqiy devorlarini parchalab, ularni qo'rqinchli bir dahshatli fojialar bo'lib, tog'lar zanjirlariga aylantirgan bo'lsa edi, ularning baland qirg'oqlari Mare Nubiumning g'arbiy sohillari ustidan dahshatli tarzda bosh ko'targan bo'lardi.

en: The mean height of the Carpathians is about ൧,ൡൡൡ feet, the altitude of certain points in the Pyrenees such as the Port of Pineda, or Roland's Breach, in the shadow of Mont Perdu.
uz: Karpatlarning o'rtacha balandligi taxminan , fut, Pirineyalarning Pineda portlari yoki Mont Perdu soyasida joylashgan Roland bo'linishi kabi ba'zi nuqtalarining balandligi.

en: The northern slopes of the Carpathians sink rapidly towards the shores of the vast Mare Imbrium.
uz: Karpatlarning shimoliy tomirlari ulkan Mare Imbrium qirg'og'iga tezda qulab tushadi.

en: Towards two o'clock in the morning, Barbican calculated the Projectile to be on the ൣൡth northern parallel, and therefore almost immediately over the little ring mountain called Pytheas, about ൥൧ൡൡ feet in height.
uz: Ertalab soat ikkiga yaqin, Barbican o'ylaganicha, o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlancha o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlancha o'g'irlangan.

en: The distance of the travellers from the Moon at this
uz: Sayohatchilarning oydan uzoqligi bu vaqtda

en: point could not be more than about ൨൦ൡ miles, reduced to about ൨ by means of their excellent telescopes.
uz: Ularning ajoyib teleskoplari yordamida nuqtasi taxminan  mildan ortiq bo'lmasligi mumkin edi.

en: Mare Imbrium, the Sea of Rains here revealed itself in all its vastness to the eyes of the travellers, though it must be acknowledged that the immense depression so called, did not afford them a very clear idea regarding its exact boundaries.
uz: Mare Imbrium, bu yerda yomg'ir dengizlari sayohatchilarning ko'zlariga o'zining kengligi bilan ko'rindi, ammo shuni tan olish kerakki, shunday nomlangan ulkan depressiya ularga uning aniq chegaralari haqida aniq tasavvurga ega bo'lmagan.

en: Right ahead of them rose Lambert about a mile in height; and further on, more to the left, in the direction of Oceanus Procellarum, Euler revealed itself by its glittering radiations.
uz: Ularning oldidan Lambert bir mil balandlikda ko'tarildi; keyinroq, chap tomonga, Oceanus Procellarum yo'nalishida, Euler o'zini o'zining shalqin radiatsiyalari bilan oshkor qildi.

en: This mountain, of about the same height as Lambert, had been the object of very interesting calculations on the part of Schroeter of Erfurt.
uz: Lambertning balandligi bilan bir xil bo'lgan bu tog' Erfurtlik Schroeter tomonidan juda qiziqarli hisob-kitoblarga loyiq bo'lgan.

en: This keen observer, desirous of inquiring into the probable origin of the lunar mountains, had proposed to himself the following question: Does the volume of the crater appear to be equal to that of the surrounding ramparts?
uz: Bu g'ayratli kuzatuvchi, oy tog'larining ehtimoldan yiroq emasligini bilmoqchi bo'lib, o'ziga quyidagi savolni berdi: Kraterning hajmi atrofdagi devorlar hajmiga teng bo'ladimi?

en: His calculations showing him that this was generally the case, he naturally concluded that these ramparts must therefore have been the product of a single eruption, for successive eruptions of volcanic matter would have disturbed this correlation.
uz: Uning hisob-kitoblari unga bu odatda shunday bo'lganini ko'rsatganida, u tabiiy ravishda ushbu devorlar bitta portlash natijasida paydo bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak degan xulosaga keldi, chunki vulkanik moddalarning bo'linadigan portlashlari ushbu bog'liqlikni buzgan bo'lardi.

en: Euler alone, he found, to be an exception to this general law, as the volume of its crater appeared to be twice as great as that of the mass surrounding it.
uz: Uning fikricha, faqat Euler ushbu umumiy qonunning istisno bo'lishi mumkin, chunki uning kraterining hajmi atrofidagi massadan ikki baravar katta bo'lgan.

en: It must therefore have been formed by several eruptions in succession, but in that case what had become of the ejected matter?
uz: Demak, u bir necha marta uchib ketgan edi, lekin u holda chiqarib yuborilgan moddaga nima bo'lgan?

en: Theories of this nature and all manner of scientific questions were, of course, perfectly permissible to terrestrial astronomers laboring under the disadvantage of imperfect instruments.
uz: Bu turdagi nazariyalar va har qanday ilmiy savollar, albatta, nomukammal asboblarning kamchiliklari ostida ishlaydigan yer yuzidagi astronomlarga to'liq yo'l qo'yilgan.

en: But Barbican could not think of wasting his time in any speculation of the kind, and now, seeing that his Projectile perceptibly approached the lunar disc, though he despaired of ever reaching it, he was more sanguine than ever of being soon able to discover positively and unquestionably some of the secrets of its formation.
uz: Ammo Barbican o'z vaqtini shu kabi gumonlarga sarflash haqida o'ylamagan va hozir, uning "Projektil" oy diskini sezilarli darajada yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib, u yerga yetib borishga umidsizlikka tushgan bo'lsa-da, u o'z vaqtida uning shakllanishining sirlarini aniq va shubhasiz kashf etishga qodir bo'lishidan hech qachon ko'ra ko'proq umidga ega edi.

en: LUNAR LANDSCAPES At half past two in the morning of December ൧th, the travellers crossed the ൤ൡth northern parallel, at a distance from the lunar surface of ൧ൣ൦ miles, reduced to about ൧ by their spy-glasses.
uz: DECMBER kuni ertalab soat ikki yarimlarda sayohatchilar oy yuzasidan o'tadigan masofadan o'n mil masofada, o'zlarining kuzatuv ko'zgulari tufayli taxminan o'n milgacha bo'lgan shimoliy parallelni kesib o'tishdi.

en: Barbican could not yet see the least probability of their landing at any point of the disc.
uz: Barbican diskning har qanday nuqtasiga tushish ehtimoli eng kamligini hali ko'ra olmagan.

en: The velocity of the Projectile was decidedly slow, but for that reason extremely puzzling.
uz: Projektilning tezligi qat'iy sekin edi, ammo shu sababli juda g'alati edi.

en: Barbican could not account for it.
uz: Barbican buni tushuntira olmagan.

en: At such a proximity to the Moon, the velocity, one would think, should be very great indeed to be able to counteract the lunar attraction.
uz: Ayga shunday yaqin bo'lganda, tezlik, deb o'ylash mumkin, oyga jalb qilinishiga qarshi kurashish uchun juda katta bo'lishi kerak.

en: Why did it not fall?
uz: Nima uchun u tushib qolmadi?

en: Barbican could not tell; his companions were equally in the dark.
uz: Barbican buni bilmadi; uning hamrohlari ham qorong'ilikda edi.

en: Ardan said he gave it up.
uz: Ardan uni tashlab ketgani haqida aytdi.

en: Besides they had no time to spend in investigating it.
uz: Bundan tashqari, ular uni tekshirish uchun vaqt sarflamadilar.

en: The lunar panorama was unrolling all its splendors beneath them, and they could not bear to lose one of its slightest details.
uz: Ular ostida oy panoramalari o'zining barcha hashamatlarini ko'targan va ular hatto eng kichik tafsilotlarini ham yo'qotishga chiday olmagan.

en: The lunar disc being brought within a distance of about six miles by the spy-glasses, it is a fair question to ask, what could an aeronaut at such an elevation from our Earth discover on its surface?
uz: Oy diskini kuzatuv ko'zgulari bilan taxminan olti mil masofada olib borilgani sababli, o'zimizdan shunday balandlikda yer yuzi bo'lgan samolyot uning yuzida nimalarni topishi mumkinligi to'g'risida so'rash oqilona.

en: At present that question can hardly be answered, the most remarkable balloon ascensions never having passed an altitude of five miles under circumstances favorable for observers.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda bu savolga javob topish qiyin, chunki eng diqqatga sazovor ballon ko'tarilishlari kuzatuvchilar uchun qulay sharoitlarda hech qachon besh mil balandlikdan o'tmagan.

en: Here, however, is an account, carefully transcribed from notes taken on the spot, of what Barbican and his companions did see from their peculiar post of observation.
uz: Biroq, bu erda Barbican va uning hamkorlari o'zlarining o'ziga xos kuzatish joylaridan ko'rgan narsalari haqida aniq yozildi.

en: Varieties of color, in the first place, appeared here and there upon the disc.
uz: Diska ustida birinchi navbatda turli xil ranglar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Selenographers are not quite agreed as to the nature of these colors.
uz: Selenograflar bu ranglarning xususiyati haqida to'liq rozi emaslar.

en: Not that such colors are without variety or too faint to be easily distinguished.
uz: Bunday ranglar turlicha bo'lmasligi yoki osonlikcha ajralib turish uchun juda chiroyli emas.

en: Schmidt of Athens even says that if our oceans on earth were all evaporated, an observer in the Moon would hardly find the seas and continents of our globe even so well outlined as those of the Moon are to the eye of a terrestrial observer.
uz: Atinalik Shmit hatto, agar yer yuzidagi okeanlarimiz butunlay buzib ketsa, oyni kuzatuvchining oyni kuzatuvchisi sayyoramizdagi dengizlar va qit'alarni yer yuzidagi kuzatuvchining ko'zi uchun oyning dengizlari kabi yaxshi tasvirlangan holda topishi mumkin emasligini aytadi.

en: According to him, the shade of color distinguishing those vast plains known as "seas" is a dark gray dashed with green and brown,—a color presented also by a few of the great craters.
uz: Uning aytishicha, "dengizlar" deb nomlangan keng o'lchovlarni ajratib turadigan rang shodi yashil va qalin rangli, bir nechta katta kraterlarda ham mavjud bo'lgan rang.

en: This opinion of Schmidt's, shared by Beer and Maedler, Barbican's observations now convinced him to be far better founded than that of certain astronomers who admit of no color at all being visible on the Moon's surface but gray.
uz: Bir va Maedler tomonidan qo'shilgan Shmitning bu fikri, Barbicanning kuzatishlari uni hozirda oy yuzida hech qanday rang ko'rinmasligini tan oluvchi ayrim astronomlardan ancha yaxshiroq asoslanganligiga ishontirdi.

en: In certain spots the greenish tint was quite decided, particularly in Mare Serenitatis and Mare Humorum, the very localities where Schmidt had most noticed it.
uz: Ba'zi joylarda yashil rang juda aniq edi, ayniqsa Mare Serenitatis va Mare Humorumda, shmidt uni ko'proq sezgan joylarda.

en: Barbican also remarked that several large craters, of the class that had no interior cones, reflected a kind of bluish tinge, somewhat like that given forth by a freshly polished steel plate.
uz: Barbican, shuningdek, ichki konlari bo'lmagan bir nechta katta kraterlarning bir xil ko'k rangni aks ettirganini, bu yangi polizlangan po'lat plakatidan paydo bo'lgan o'ziga o'xshaydi.

en: These tints, he now saw enough to convince him, proceeded really from the lunar surface, and were not due, as certain astronomers asserted, either to the imperfections of the spy-glasses, or to the interference of the terrestrial atmosphere.
uz: Endi u uni ishontiradigan darajada ko'rgan bu nuqtalar haqiqatan ham oy yuzasidan kelib chiqqan va ba'zi astronomlar aytishicha, ular kashshoflik ko'zgularining kamchiliklari yoki yer atrofidagi atmosfera aralashuviga bog'liq emas edi.

en: His singular opportunity for correct observation allowed him to entertain no doubt whatever on the subject.
uz: To'g'ri kuzatuv uchun uning o'ziga xos imkoniyati unga shubhasiz, mavzuga oid har qanday narsani o'tkazishga imkon berdi.

en: Hampered by no atmosphere, he was free from all liability to optical illusion.
uz: Hech qanday atmosfera unga to'sqinlik qilmaganda, u optik illüziya uchun javobgarlikdan ozod bo'lgan.

en: Satisfied therefore as to the reality of these tints, he considered such knowledge a positive gain to science.
uz: Shuning uchun u ushbu nuqtalarning haqiqiyligi bilan qoniqarli bo'lib, bunday bilimlarni ilm-fan uchun ijobiy foyda deb hisoblagan.

en: But that greenish tint—to what was it due?
uz: Ammo o'sha yashil rang nimaga bog'liq edi?

en: To a dense tropical vegetation maintained by a low atmosphere, a mile or so in thickness?
uz: Kichik atmosfera, bir mil yoki undan ko'proq qalloqlikda saqlanadigan zich tropik o'simliklarga?

en: But this was another question that could not be answered at present.
uz: Ammo bu hozircha javob topolmaydigan yana bir savol edi.

en: Further on he could detect here and there traces of a decidedly ruddy tint.
uz: Keyinchalik u bu erda va u erda aniq qizil rang izlarini aniqlay olgan.

en: Such a shade he knew had been already detected in the Palus Somnii, near Mare Crisium, and in the circular area of Lichtenberg, near the Hercynian Mountains, on the eastern edge of the Moon.
uz: U bilganidek, bunday soya endi Mare Crisium yaqinidagi Palus Somnii va oyning sharqiy chegaraidagi Hercynian tog'lari yaqinidagi Lichtenbergning aylanma hududida aniqlangan.

en: To what cause was this tint to be attributed?
uz: Ushbu rang qaysi sababga asoslangan?

en: To the actual color of the surface itself?
uz: Yer yuzasining asl rangini ko'rib chiqaylikmi?

en: Or to that of the lava covering it here and there?
uz: Yoki bu yerda va u yerda qoplagan lavadanmi?

en: Or to the color resulting from the mixture of other colors seen
uz: Yoki ko'rgan boshqa ranglarning aralashmasidan kelib chiqqan rangga

en: at a distance too great to allow of their being distinguished separately?
uz: Ular alohida ajralib turish uchun juda katta masofada?

en: Barbican and his companions succeeded no better at a new problem that soon engaged their undivided attention.
uz: Barbican va uning hamkorlari tez orada ularning e'tiborini jalb qilgan yangi muammoni hal qilishda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishdi.

en: It deserves some detail.
uz: Bu ba'zi tafsilotlarga loyiq.

en: Having passed Lambert, being just over Timocharis, all were attentively gazing at the magnificent crater of Archimedes with a diameter of ൦ൣ miles across and ramparts more than ൦ൡൡൡ feet in height, when Ardan startled his companions by suddenly exclaiming: "Hello!
uz: Lambertni o'tib o'tib, Timoxarisning yonida bo'lib, hamma diqqat bilan Arximedning ko'p qirrali, deyarli 3 km bo'lib, balandligi 3 metrdan ortiq bo'lgan qirg'oqlariga qarab turgan edi, Ardan o'z hamrohlariga to'satdan: "Hallo!

en: Cultivated fields as I am a living man!" "What do you mean by your cultivated fields?" asked M'Nicholl sourly, wiping his glasses and shrugging his shoulders.
uz: Men tirik odam bo'lganim uchun ekinzorlar!" - deb so'radi M'Nicholl, ko'z ko'zgularini silklab, yelkalarini yumib. "Siz o'zingizning ekinzorlaringiz deb nimani nazarda tutyapsiz?" deb so'radi.

en: "Certainly cultivated fields!" replied Ardan.
uz: Ardan javob berdi: "Agar bo'lmasa, ekinzorlar!"

en: "Don't you see the furrows?
uz: "Qo'zg'orlarni ko'rmayapsanmi?

en: They're certainly plain enough.
uz: Ular, albatta, yetarlicha sodda.

en: They are white too from glistening in the sun, but they are quite different from the radiating streaks of Copernicus.
uz: Ular quyoshda parlashdan oq bo'ladi, lekin ular Kopernikning radiatsiyaviy ranglaridan ancha farq qiladi.

en: Why, their sides are perfectly parallel!" "Where are those furrows?" asked M'Nicholl, putting his glasses to his eye and adjusting the focus.
uz: Ularning yonlari to'liq parallel!" - deb so'radi M'Nicholl, ko'z ko'zlariga ko'zoynaklarini qo'yib, diqqatni o'zgartirib.

en: "You can see them in all directions," answered Ardan; "but two are particularly visible: one running north from Archimedes, the other south towards the Apennines." M'Nicholl's face, as he gazed, gradually assumed a grin which soon developed into a snicker, if not a positive laugh, as he observed to Ardan: "Your Selenites must be Brobdignagians, their oxen Leviathans, and their ploughs bigger than Marston's famous cannon, if these are furrows!" "How's that, Barbican?" asked Ardan doubtfully, but unwilling to submit to M'Nicholl.
uz: "Ularni har xil yo'nalishlarda ko'rish mumkin", - deb javob berdi Ardan; "lekin ikkitalari ayniqsa ko'rinadi: biri Archimeddan shimoliga, ikkinchisi esa janubga Apenninalar tomon o'tadi". M'Nicholning yuzi ko'z o'ngida turib, asta-sekin tabassumni qabul qildi va bu tezda g'alati, agar ijobiy kulgi bo'lmasa ham, Ardanga ta'kidlab berdi: "Sizning selenlaringiz Brobdignagians, ularning bo'ylari Leviathanlar va ularning sho'rlari Marstonning mashhur to'qinga qaraganda kattaroq bo'lsa kerak!" - deb so'radi Ardan shubhali, ammo M'Nicholga bo'ysunish uchun tayyor emas.

en: "They're not furrows, dear friend," said Barbican, "and can't be, either, simply on account of their immense size.
uz: "Ular burchak emas, aziz do'stim, - dedi Barbican, - va ular ham bo'lishi mumkin emas, shunchaki ularning ulkanligi tufayli.

en: They are what the German astronomers called Rillen; the French, rainures, and the English, grooves, canals, clefts, cracks, chasms, or fissures." "You have a good stock of names for them anyhow," observed Ardan, "if that does any good." "The number of names given them," answered Barbican, "shows how little is really known about them.
uz: Ular nemis astronomlari Rillen deb atagan narsa; frantsuzlar, yomg'irlar va inglizlar, solinish, kanallar, bo'g'riliklar, yoriqlar, chuqurliklar yoki bo'g'riliklar. " "Sizda ular uchun qandaydir yaxshi nomlar mavjud", dedi Ardan, "agar bu biron bir foyda keltirsa". "Ularga berilgan nomlar soni", deb javob berdi Barbican, "ular haqida qanchalik oz ma'lum bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

en: They have been observed in all
uz: Ular hamma joyda kuzatilgan.

en: the level portion of the Moon's surface.
uz: Oʻz navbatida, oʻsha oy yuzasining tekis qismi.

en: Small as they appear to us, a little calculation must convince you that they are in some places hundreds of miles in length, a mile in width and probably in many points several miles in depth.
uz: Ular bizga kichkina ko'rinsa-da, bir oz hisob-kitoblar ularni ba'zi joylarda yuzlab kilometr uzunlik, bir kilometr kenglik va ehtimol ko'p joylarda bir necha kilometr chuqurlikda bo'lishlariga ishontirishi kerak.

en: Their width and depth, however, vary, though their sides, so far as observed, are always rigorously parallel.
uz: Biroq, ularning kengligi va chuqurligi farq qiladi, garchi ularning tomonlari, kuzatilgan bo'lsa-da, har doim qat'iy ravishda parallel bo'lsa-da.

en: Let us take a good look at them." Putting the glass to his eye, Barbican examined the clefts for some time with close attention.
uz: Keling, ularni yaxshilab ko'rib chiqaylik".Barbican shishani ko'ziga ko'targan holda, bir muncha vaqt davomida teshiklarni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

en: He saw that their banks were sharp edged and extremely steep.
uz: Uning ko'zicha, ularning qirg'oqlari keskin bo'lakli va juda baland edi.

en: In many places they were of such geometrical regularity that he readily excused Gruithuysen's idea of deeming them to be gigantic earthworks thrown up by the Selenite engineers.
uz: Ko'p joylarda ular o'ta geometrik jihatdan muntazam bo'lganligi sababli Gruithuysen ularni selenit muhandislari tomonidan qo'yilgan ulkan yer ishlari deb hisoblash g'oyalarini oqlagan.

en: Some of them were as straight as if laid out with a line, others were curved a little here and there, though still maintaining the strict parallelism of their sides.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari chiziq bilan to'g'ri, ba'zilari esa biroz buzib, biroz buzib, biroz buzib turardi, ammo o'z tomonlarining qat'iy parallelligini saqlab turardi.

en: These crossed each other; those entered craters and came out at the other side.
uz: Bular bir-biriga kesib o'tishdi; bular kraterlarga kirib, boshqa tomondan chiqib ketishdi.

en: Here, they furrowed annular plateaus, such as Posidonius or Petavius.
uz: Bu yerda ular Posidoniy yoki Petaviy kabi anular platolarni o'rab olishdi.

en: There, they wrinkled whole seas, for instance, Mare Serenitatis.
uz: U erda ular butun dengizlarni, masalan, Mare Serenitatisni burqlab qo'yishgan.

en: These curious peculiarities of the lunar surface had interested the astronomic mind to a very high degree at their first discovery, and have proved to be very perplexing problems ever since.
uz: Ay yuzasining bu g'ayritabiiy xususiyatlari astronomiya ongini birinchi kashfiyotida juda katta darajada qiziqtirgan edi va o'sha paytdan beri juda murakkab muammolar bo'lib chiqdi.

en: The first observers do not seem to have noticed them.
uz: Birinchi kuzatuvchilar ularni payqashmagan ko'rinadi.

en: Neither Hevelius, nor Cassini, nor La Hire, nor Herschel, makes a single remark regarding their nature.
uz: Hevelius ham, Cassini ham, La Hire ham, Herschel ham ularning tabiati to'g'risida hech qanday fikr bildirmaydi.

en: It was Schroeter, in ൢ൨൩൪, who called the attention of scientists to them for the first time.
uz: Shroeter,  yilda ilk bor olimlarning e'tiborini ularga qaratgan.

en: He had only ൢൢ to show, but Lohrmann soon recorded ൨൦ more.
uz: U faqat  ko'rsatishi kerak edi, lekin Lohrmann tez orada  ko'proq yozdi.

en: Pastorff, Gruithuysen, and particularly Beer and Maedler were still more successful, but Julius Schmidt, the famous astronomer of Athens, has raised their number up to ൥ൣ൦, and has even published their names in a catalogue.
uz: Pastorff, Gruithuysen va ayniqsa Beer va Maedler hali ham muvaffaqiyatli edilar, ammo Atinalik mashhur astronom Julius Schmidt ularning sonini  gacha ko'tardi va hatto ularning ismlarini katalogda e'lon qildi.

en: But counting them is one thing, determining their nature is another.
uz: Ammo ularni sanish bir narsa, ularning tabiatini aniqlash esa boshqacha.

en: They are not fortifications, certainly: and cannot be ancient beds of dried up rivers, for two very good and sufficient reasons: first, water, even under the most favorable circumstances on the Moon's surface, could have never ploughed up such vast channels; secondly, these chasms often traverse lofty craters through and through, like an immense railroad cutting.
uz: Bular, albatta, mustahkamlanishlar emas va ikkita juda yaxshi va yetarli sababga ko'ra, an'anaviy qurigan daryolar bo'lishi mumkin emas: birinchidan, suv, hatto oy yuzasidagi eng qulay sharoitlarda ham, bunday keng kanallarni hech qachon o'rab ololmaydi; ikkinchidan, bu chuqurliklar ko'pincha katta kraterlarni o'tkazib, katta temir yo'l kesish kabi o'tadi.

en: At these details, Ardan's imagination became unusually excited and of course it was not without some result.
uz: Ushbu tafsilotlarni ko'rib, Ardanning tasavvurlari o'zgacha hayajonga to'ldi va, albatta, bu natijasiz bo'lmagan.

en: It even happened that he hit on an idea that had already suggested itself to Schmidt of Athens.
uz: Hatto Afinalik Schmidtga o'zini taklif qilgan g'oyaga ham qo'shilibdi.

en: "Why not consider them," he asked, "to be the simple phenomena of vegetation?" "What do you mean?" asked Barbican.
uz: "Nima uchun ularni oddiy o'simlik hodisalari deb hisoblamaysiz?" - deb so'radi u. - Nima demoqchisiz? - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: "Rows of sugar cane?" suggested M'Nicholl with a snicker.
uz: "Sakar qanoqining qatorlari?" - deb taklif qildi M'Nicholl.

en: "Not exactly, my worthy Captain," answered Ardan quietly, "though you were perhaps nearer to the mark than you expected.
uz: "To'g'ri emas, aziz kapitanim", - dedi Ardan xotirjamlik bilan, "agar siz, ehtimol, o'zingiz kutganingizdan ko'ra maqsadga yaqinroq bo'lgan bo'lsangiz ham.

en: I don't mean exactly rows of sugar cane, but I do mean vast avenues of trees—poplars, for instance—planted regularly on each side of a great high road." "Still harping on vegetation!" said the Captain.
uz: Men to'g'ri shakar qalamining qatorlarini nazarda tutmayman, lekin katta daraxtlar, masalan, katta yo'lning har bir tomoniga muntazam o'tkaziladigan poplarlarni nazarda tutyapman.

en: "Ardan, what a splendid historian was spoiled in you!
uz: "Ardan, sizda qanday ajoyib tarixchi o'g'irlangan!

en: The less you know about your facts, the readier you are to account for them." "Ma foi," said Ardan simply, "I do only what the greatest of your scientific men do—that is, guess.
uz: O'zingizning faktlaringiz haqida qancha kam bilsangiz, shuncha ko'proq javob berishga tayyor bo'lasiz". - dedi Ardan oddiy so'z bilan: "Men faqat sizning eng buyuk olimlaringiz nima qilayotganini qilaman, ya'ni, taxmin qiling.

en: There is this difference however between us—I call my guesses, guesses, mere conjecture;—they dignify theirs as profound theories or as astounding discoveries!" "Often the case, friend Ardan, too often the case," said Barbican.
uz: Biroq, biz o'rtasida bu farq bor.Men o'z taxminlarimni, taxminlarimni shunchaki taxminlar deb atayman; ular o'zlarining asosli nazariyalar yoki hayratlanarli kashfiyotlar deb e'tirof qiladilar!" - dedi Barbican.

en: "In the question under consideration, however," continued the Frenchman, "my conjecture has this advantage over some others: it explains why these rills appear and seem to disappear at regular intervals." "Let us hear the explanation," said the Captain.
uz: Fransiyalovchi davom etdi: "Hamma savolga ko'ra, mening taxminim boshqalarga qaraganda afzallik bor: u nega bu shov-shuvlar muntazam ravishda paydo bo'lib, yo'q bo'lib ketayotganini tushuntiradi.

en: "They become invisible when the trees lose their leaves, and they reappear when they resume them." "His explanation is not without ingenuity," observed Barbican to M'Nicholl, "but, my dear friend," turning to Ardan, "it is hardly admissible." "Probably not," said Ardan, "but why not?" "Because as the Sun is nearly always vertical to the lunar equator, the Moon can have no change of seasons worth mentioning; therefore her vegetation can present none of the phenomena that you speak of."
uz: "Aragonlar barglarini yo'qotganda ko'rinmas bo'ladilar va ularni qayta tiklaganda yana paydo bo'ladilar". - deb aytdi Barbican M'Nichollga: "Uning tushuntirishi aqlsiz emas, lekin, aziz do'stim, Ardanga qarab, "bu hech qachon qabul qilinmaydi". - dedi Ardan. - Ehtimol yo'q, lekin nima uchun yo'q?" - deb aytdi Ardan. - Quyosh deyarli har doim oy ekvatoriga vertikal bo'lgani sababli, oyning mavsumlari o'zgarmasligi mumkin emas; shuning uchun uning o'simligi siz aytib o'tgan hodisalardan hech birini ko'rsatolmaydi".

en: This was perfectly true.
uz: Bu to'liq haq edi.

en: The slight obliquity of the Moon's axis, only ൢ-ൢ/ൣ°, keeps the Sun in the same altitude the whole year around.
uz: Oy o'qiining kichik bo'g'inligi, faqat -/°, Quyoshni butun yil davomida bir xil balandlikda saqlaydi.

en: In the equatorial regions he is always vertical, and in the polar he is never higher than the horizon.
uz: Ekvatoriya mintaqalari uchun u har doim vertikal, qutbda esa hech qachon horizontdan yuqori bo'lmaydi.

en: Therefore, there can be no change of seasons; according to the latitude, it is a perpetual winter, spring, summer, or autumn the whole year round.
uz: Shuning uchun mavsumlar o'zgarishi mumkin emas; tezlikka qarab, bu yil davomida doimiy qish, bahor, yozgi yoki kuz.

en: This state of things is almost precisely similar to that which prevails in Jupiter, who also stands nearly upright in his orbit, the inclination of his axis being only about ൤°.
uz: Bu holat Jupiterda hukmronlik qiladigan holatga deyarli to'g'ri o'xshaydi, u ham orbitalarida deyarli to'g'ri turadi, uning o'qi faqat taxminan ° bo'lib o'tadi.

en: But how to account for the grooves?
uz: Ammo bu yo'nalishlarni qanday hisoblab chiqamiz?

en: A very hard nut to crack.
uz: Chekish uchun juda qiyin tuxum.

en: They must certainly be a later formation than the craters and the rings, for they are often found breaking right through the circular ramparts.
uz: Ular, albatta, kraterlar va do'zaxlardan keyinroq paydo bo'lishi kerak, chunki ular ko'pincha to'plamli devorlarni buzgan holda topilmoqda.

en: Probably the latest of all lunar features, the results of the last geological epochs, they are due altogether to expansion or shrinkage acting on a large scale and brought about by the great forces of nature, operating after a manner altogether unknown on our earth.
uz: Ehtimol, oyning eng so'nggi xususiyatlari, so'nggi geologik davrlarning natijasi, ular butunlay katta miqyosda va tabiiy kuchlar tufayli sodir bo'lgan kengayish yoki qisqartirish tufayli sodir bo'ladi, ular bizning yer yuzimizda umuman noma'lum tarzda faoliyat ko'rsatadi.

en: Such at least was Barbican's idea.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda Barbicanning g'oyasi shunday edi.

en: "My friends," he quietly observed, "without meaning to put forward any pretentious claims to originality, but by simply turning to account some advantages that have never before befallen contemplative mortal eye, why not construct a little hypothesis of our own regarding the nature of these grooves and the causes that gave them birth?
uz: "Do'stlarim", - dedi u xotirjamlik bilan, "o'zgachalik haqida hech qanday o'ylamaslik, lekin shunchaki o'z vaqtida ko'z o'ngida bo'lmagan ba'zi afzalliklarni hisobga olish orqali, nima uchun bu qo'llanmalarning xususiyati va ularni tug'dirgan sabablarga nisbatan o'zimizning kichik g'oyalarimizni tuzmaymiz?

en: Look at that great chasm just below us, somewhat to the right.
uz: O'zimizdan biroz pastda, o'ng tomonda, o'sha katta chuqurlikka qarang.

en: It is at least fifty or sixty miles long and runs along the base of the Apennines in a line almost perfectly straight.
uz: U kamida ellik yoki oltmish mil uzunlikdagi va Apenninlarning poyoni bo'ylab to'g'ri chizig'i bo'lib, deyarli to'g'ri chizig'i bo'lib o'tadi.

en: Does not its parallelism with the mountain chain suggest a causative relation?
uz: Tog'lar zanjiri bilan o'xshashligi sababli munosabatni ko'rsatmaydimi?

en: See that other mighty rill, at least a hundred and fifty miles long, starting directly north of it and pursuing so true a course that it cleaves Archimedes almost cleanly into two.
uz: Qaranglar, bu boshqa qudratli, kamida 150 mil uzoq bo'lgan, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning shimolidan boshlanib, o'sha qadar to'g'ri yo'lni davom ettirib, Arximedni deyarli ikkiga bo'g'ib qo'yadi.

en: The nearer it lies to the mountain, as you perceive, the greater its width; as it recedes in either direction it grows narrower.
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, tog'ga qanchalik yaqin bo'lsa, kengligi shunchalik katta bo'ladi; ikkala yo'nalishda ham orqaga qaytgani sayin, torroq bo'ladi.

en: Does not everything point out to one great cause of their origin?
uz: Hamma narsa ularning kelib chiqishi uchun bitta katta sababga ishora qilmaydimi?

en: They are simple crevasses, like those so often noticed on Alpine glaciers, only that these tremendous cracks in the surface are produced by the shrinkage of the crust consequent on cooling.
uz: Bular alpin muzlayanda ko'pincha ko'rinadigan oddiy bo'g'imlardir, faqatgina yuzidagi bu yirik bo'g'imlar sovuqlanish natijasida kerakning qisqarishi natijasida hosil bo'ladi.

en: Can we point out some analogies to this on the Earth?
uz: Yer yuzida bu bilan qandaydir o'xshashliklarni ko'rsatishimiz mumkinmi?

en: The defile of the Jordan, terminating in the awful depression of the Dead Sea, no doubt occurs to you on the moment.
uz: O'lik dengizning dahshatli tushishi bilan yakunlanadigan Iordan daryosining ifloslanishi shubhasiz, o'sha paytda sizda paydo bo'ladi.

en: Valley, as I saw it ten years ago, is an apter comparison.
uz: O'n yil oldin ko'rganimdek, "Valley" - bu eng yaxshi taqqoslashdir.

en: There I stood on the brink of a tremendous chasm with perpendicular walls, a mile in width, a mile in depth and eight miles in length.
uz: U yerda men bir mil keng, bir mil chuqur va sakkiz mil uzun bo'lgan, chekkasi bo'ylab devorlari bo'lgan dahshatli chuqurlik chegaralarida turardim.

en: Judge if I was astounded!
uz: Agar men hayron bo'lsam, hukm qilinglar!

en: But how should we feel it, when travelling on the lunar surface, we should suddenly find ourselves on the brink of a yawning chasm two miles wide, fifty miles long, and so fathomless in sheer vertical depth as to leave its black profundities absolutely invisible in spite of the dazzling sunlight!" "I feel my flesh already crawling even in the anticipation!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ammo biz buni qanday his qilishimiz kerak, oy yuzasida sayohat qilganimizda, birdan o'zimizni ikki mil keng, ellik mil uzun va o'ta vertikal chuqurlikda o'ta chuqur bo'lgan, qora chuqurliklarni quyoshning chiroqlariga qaramay mutlaqo ko'rinmas qilib qoldiradigan bo'lakning chegaralarida topamiz! "Men o'zimni hatto kutib o'tirishda ham tanamni o'z ichiga olgan tuproqni his qilaman!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "I shan't regret it much if we never get to the Moon," growled M'Nicholl; "I never hankered after it anyhow!" By this time the Projectile had reached the fortieth degree of lunar latitude, and could hardly be further than five hundred miles from the surface, a distance reduced to about ൦ miles by the travellers' glasses.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Agar hech qachon oyga yetib bormasak, bundan afsuslanmayman", - deb qichqirdi. "Men hech qachon uni orzu qilmaganman!" - deb aytdi. "Bu vaqtga kelib, Proyektil o'n to'rtinchi darajaga yetib kelgan edi va u yer yuzidan besh yuz mildan ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin edi, bu esa sayohatchilar ko'zgulari tufayli taxminan 5 milga qisqartirilgan.

en: Away to their left appeared Helicon, a ring mountain about ൢ൧ൡൡ feet high; and still further to the left the eye could catch a glimpse of the cliffs enclosing a semi-elliptical portion of Mare Imbrium, called the Sinus Iridium, or Bay of the Rainbows.
uz: O'z chap tomonida, taxminan 1 metr balandlikda joylashgan bir bog'liq tog' bo'lgan Helicon paydo bo'ldi; va hali chap tomonida ko'z, Mare Imbriumning yarim eliptik qismini o'rab olgan qayalarni ko'rish mumkin edi, ular Sinus Iridium yoki yomg'irboqlar ko'chagi deb nomlanadi.

en: In order to allow astronomers to make complete observations on the lunar surface, the terrestrial atmosphere should possess a transparency seventy times greater than its present power of transmission.
uz: Astronomlarga oy yuzasida to'liq kuzatishlarni amalga oshirish uchun yerdagi atmosfera hozirgi uzatish quvvatidan yetmish baravar ko'proq shaffoflikka ega bo'lishi kerak.

en: But in the void through which the Projectile was now floating, no fluid whatever interposed between the eye of the observer and the object observed.
uz: Ammo o'sha bo'sh joyda, o'sha paytda proyektil suzib borayotgan edi, kuzatuvchi ko'zi bilan kuzatuvchi ob'ekt o'rtasida hech qanday suyuqlik bo'lmagan.

en: Besides, the travellers now found themselves at a distance that had never before been reached by the most powerful telescopes, including even Lord Rosse's and the great instrument on the Rocky Mountains.
uz: Bundan tashqari, sayohatchilar o'zlarini ilgari hech qachon eng qudratli teleskoplar, shu jumladan hatto Lord Rosse va Rocky tog'laridagi buyuk asbob-uskunalar tomonidan yetib bo'lmagan masofada topdilar.

en: Barbican was therefore in a condition singularly favorable to resolve the great question concerning the Moon's inhabitableness.
uz: Shuning uchun Barbican oyning yashashi mumkinligi to'g'risidagi buyuk muammoni hal qilish uchun o'ziga xos qulay sharoitda edi.

en: Nevertheless, the solution still escaped him.
uz: Shunga qaramasdan, u hali ham yechimni topolmadi.

en: He could discover nothing around him but a dreary waste of immense plains, and towards the north, beneath him, bare mountains of the aridest character.
uz: U atrofida o'ta katta o'tlar va shimoliga qarab, uning pastida eng quruq tog'lar bo'lib qolganidan boshqa hech narsa topolmadi.

en: Not the slightest vestige of man's work could be detected over the vast expanse.
uz: O'ta keng maydonda inson ishlarining eng kichik qoldiqlari ham aniqlanmagan.

en: Not the slightest sign of a ruin spoke of his ever having been there.
uz: Hech qanday vayronlik belgisi ham uning u erda bo'lgani haqida gapirmagan.

en: Nothing betrayed the slightest trace of the development of animal life, even in an inferior degree.
uz: Hayvonlar hayotining rivojlanishining eng kichik izini hech narsa ko'rsatmadi, hatto kamroq darajada ham.

en: Not the least glimpse of vegetation.
uz: O'simliklarni ko'rishning eng kamdan-kam usti.

en: Of the three great kingdoms that hold dominion on the surface of the globe, the mineral, the vegetable and the animal, one alone was represented on the lunar sphere: the mineral, the whole mineral, and nothing but the mineral.
uz: Dunyo yuzi ustidan hukmronlik qiladigan uchta buyuk shohlik - mineral, o'simlik va hayvonotdan faqat bittasi oy sferasida tasvirlangan: mineral, butun mineral va faqat mineral.

en: "Why!" exclaimed Ardan, with a disconcerted look, after a long and searching examination, "I can't find anybody.
uz: "Nima uchun!" - dedi Ardan uzoq va izlanishdan so'ng, xafa bo'lgan ko'z bilan: "Men hech kimni topolmayman.

en: Everything is as motionless as a street in Pompeii at ൥ o'clock in the morning!"
uz: Hamma narsa ertalab soat 7 da Pompeyda ko'cha kabi harakatsiz!"

en: THE SOLUTION STILL ESCAPED HIM.
uz: THE Solution hali ham undan qochib ketgan.

en: "Good comparison, friend Ardan;" observed M'Nicholl.
uz: "Yaxshi taqqoslash, do'stim Ardan", - dedi M'Nicholl.

en: "Lava, slag, volcanic eminences, vitreous matter glistening like ice, piles of scoria, pitch black shadows, dazzling streaks, like rivers of light breaking over jagged rocks—these are now beneath my eye—these alone I can detect—not a man—not an animal—not a tree.
uz: "Lava, qirg'oq, volkanik ko'rinishlar, muz kabi shishlangan shishalar, shkorya to'plamlari, qora soyalar, yorug'lik anhorlari, yorug'lik daryolari kabi ko'tarilgan toshlar ustida bular endi ko'zim ostida, bular yolg'iz men insonni, hayvonni yoki daraxtni aniqlay olmayman.

en: The great American Desert is a land of milk and honey in comparison with the joyless orb over which we are now moving.
uz: Buyuk Amerika sahrolari sut va asal yurti, biz hozir harakatlanayotgan quvonchsiz ko'rinish bilan taqqoslaganda.

en: However, even yet we can predicate nothing positive.
uz: Biroq, hali ham biz ijobiy hech narsa oldindan aytib bera olmaymiz.

en: The atmosphere may have taken refuge in the depths of the chasms, in the interior of the craters, or even on the opposite side of the Moon, for all we know!"
uz: Atmosfera, ehtimol, chuqurliklarning chuqurliklarida, kraterlarning ichki qismida yoki hatto oyning qarama-qarshi tomonida panoh topgan bo'lishi mumkin, biz bilgan hamma narsa uchun!"

en: "Still we must remember," observed Barbican, "that even the sharpest eye cannot detect a man at a distance greater than four miles and a-half, and our glasses have not yet brought us nearer than five." "Which means to say," observed Ardan, "that though we can't see the Selenites, they can see our Projectile!" But matters had not improved much when, towards four o'clock in the morning, the travellers found themselves on the ൦ൡth parallel, and at a distance of only about ൤൨൦ miles from the lunar surface.
uz: "Hamma shuni yodda tutishimiz kerak", - dedi Barbican, "hatto eng keskin ko'z insonni to'rt yarim mildan ortiq masofada ko'ra olmaydi va ko'z ko'zlari bizni hali besh mildan ko'proq yaqinlashtirgani yo'q". "Bu shuni anglatadiki, biz Selenitlarni ko'ra olmasak ham, ular bizning o'qimizni ko'rishadi!" - dedi Ardan. - Ammo sayohatchilar o'zlarini ertalab soat to'rtga yaqin o'tirganida va oy yuzasidan faqat taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan taxminan

en: Still no trace of the least movement, or even of the lowest form of life.
uz: Hattoki eng kam harakatlanish yoki hatto eng past hayot shakli izlari yo'q.

en: "What peaked mountain is that which we have just passed on our right?" asked Ardan.
uz: Ardan so'radi: "Biz o'ng tomonimizdan o'tib o'tgan toqqa qanday to'siq bor?"

en: "It is quite remarkable, standing as it does in almost solitary grandeur in the barren plain." "That is Pico," answered Barbican.
uz: "U juda diqqatga sazovor, u quruq dengizda deyarli yolg'iz ulkanlikda turibdi". - Bu Piko, - deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "It is at least ൩ൡൡൡ feet high and is well known to terrestrial astronomers as well by its peculiar shadow as on account of its comparative isolation.
uz: "U kamida  fut balandlikda va yer yuzidagi astronomlar uchun o'zining o'ziga xos soyasi va o'zidan tashqari, o'zidan ajratilganligi sababli tanilgan.

en: See the collection of perfectly formed little craters nestling around its base." "Barbican," asked M'Nicholl suddenly, "what peak is that which lies almost directly south of Pico?
uz: "Barbican", - deb so'radi M'Nicholl to'satdan, "Pico shahriga yaqin deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri joylashgan to'siq nima?

en: I see it plainly, but I can't find it on my map." "I have remarked that pyramidal peak myself," replied Barbican; "but I can assure you that so far it has received no name as yet, although it is likely enough to have been distinguished by the terrestrial astronomers.
uz: Men uni aniq ko'raman, lekin xaritimda topolmayman. "Men o'zim piramida to'g'ini qayd qildim, - deb javob berdi Barbican; - lekin sizga shuni ta'kidlay olamanki, hozircha u hech qanday nomga ega emas, garchi u yerdagi astronomlar tomonidan ajralib turgani ehtimoldan yiroq emas.

en: It can't be less than ൥ൡൡൡ feet in height." "I propose we called it Barbican!" cried Ardan enthusiastically.
uz: U o'n metrdan kam bo'lishi mumkin emas". - Men buni "Barbican" deb atashimizni taklif qilaman! - deb o'yladi Ardan hayajon bilan.

en: "Agreed!" answered M'Nicholl, "unless we can find a higher one." "We must be before-hand with Schmidt of Athens!" exclaimed Ardan.
uz: M'Nicholl javob berdi: "Boshqarish, agar biz yuqori bo'lgan birini topmasak", - dedi. "Atinadagi Shmidt bilan yuzma-yuz bo'lishimiz kerak!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "He will leave nothing unnamed that his telescope can catch a glimpse of." "Passed unanimously!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: "U o'z teleskopining nazarini solishi mumkin bo'lgan hech qanday nomsiz narsani qoldirmaydi. " "Bir ovozdan o'tdi!" - deb baqirdi M'Nicholl.

en: "And officially recorded!" added the Frenchman, making the proper entry on his map.
uz: "Rosmiy ravishda qayd etilgan!" - deb qo'shimcha qildi frantsuz, xaritasiga tegishli yozuvni kiritdi.

en: Barbican!" then cried both gentlemen, rising and taking off their hats respectfully to the distant peak.
uz: "Barbican!" - deb baqira boshladi ikkala rafiqani ham, baland turib, hurmat ila cho'qqisini olib tashladilar.

en: "Look to the west!" interrupted Barbican, watching, as usual, while his companions were talking, and probably perfectly unconscious of
uz: "G'arbga qarang!" - dedi Barbican, odatdagidek, uning hamkorlari gapirayotgan paytda ko'z o'ngida turib.

en: what they were saying; "directly to the west!
uz: Ular nima deyishayotganini; "to'g'ridan-to'g'ri g'arbga!

en: Now tell me what you see!" "I see a vast valley!" answered M'Nicholl.
uz: Endi nima ko'ryapsan, ayting!" - deb javob berdi M'Nicholl. - Men ulkan vodiyni ko'ryapman.

en: "Straight as an arrow!" added Ardan.
uz: "Oʻq kabi toʻgʻri!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "Running through lofty mountains!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Uzoq tog'lar orqali yuguryapman!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "Cut through with a pair of saws and scooped out with a chisel!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Bir juft pichoq bilan kesib tashlang va chizil bilan chiqaring!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "See the shadows of those peaks!" cried M'Nicholl catching fire at the sight.
uz: M'Nicholl ko'rinishda olovga tushib: "O'sha tepaliklarning soyasini ko'ring!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "Black, long, and sharp as if cast by cathedral spires!" "Oh!
uz: "Qara, uzun va o'tkir, xuddi katedra burchaklari tomonidan o'ralgandek!"

en: ye crags and peaks!" burst forth Ardan; "how I should like to catch even a faint echo of the chorus you could chant, if a wild storm roared over your beetling summits!
uz: Sizlar tog'lar va cho'qqizlar! - dedi Ardan; - agar sizning cho'g'lar to'plaringizda yovvoyi qasr surg'asi bo'lsa, siz kuylashingiz mumkin bo'lgan chorusning hatto kamroq o'zso'zini ham ko'rishni juda xohlayman!

en: The pine forests of Norwegian mountains howling in midwinter would not be an accordeon in comparison!" "Wonderful instance of subsidence on a grand scale!" exclaimed the Captain, hastily relapsing into science.
uz: Norvegiya tog'larining qish o'rtalarida qichqiriq qiladigan borog'li o'rmonlari bilan taqqoslaganda, u bir xilma-xillik bo'lmaydi!" - deb hayqirdi kapitan, shoshilinch ravishda ilm-fanga qaytdi.

en: "Not at all!" cried the Frenchman, still true to his colors; "no subsidence there!
uz: "Agar yo'q!" - deb baqirdi fransuz, hali ham o'z ranglariga sodiq bo'lib, "bu yerda hech qanday o'simlik yo'q!

en: A comet simply came too close and left its mark as it flew past." "Fanciful exclamations, dear friends," observed Barbican; "but I'm not surprised at your excitement.
uz: Kometa shunchaki juda yaqinlashdi va o'tgach o'z izini qoldirdi. "Qizil do'stlarim, ajoyib qo'rqinchlar", dedi Barbican; "lekin sizning hayajoningizga hayron emasman.

en: Yonder is the famous Valley of the Alps, a standing enigma to all selenographers.
uz: Yonder Alplar vodiysi bo'lib, barcha selenograflar uchun o'rinli ravshanlikdir.

en: How it could have been formed, no one can tell.
uz: Qanday qilib u paydo bo'lganini hech kim aytolmaydi.

en: Even wilder guesses than yours, Ardan, have been hazarded on the subject.
uz: Bu borada sizning o'zingizdan ham dahshatli taxminlar, Ardan, xavf ostida qolmoqda.

en: All we can state positively at present regarding this wonderful formation, is what I have just recorded in my note-book: the Valley of the Alps is about ൦ mile wide and ൨ൡ or ൩ൡ long: it is remarkably flat and free from debris, though the mountains on each side rise like walls to the height of at least ൢൡ,ൡൡൡ feet.—Over the whole surface of our Earth I know of no natural phenomenon that can be at all compared with it." "Another wonder almost in front of us!" cried Ardan.
uz: Hozirgi kunda ushbu ajoyib tuzilishga nisbatan faqatgina men o'zimning yozuv daftarimda qayd etgan narsalarga e'tibor qaratishimiz mumkin: Alplar vodiysi deyarli 1 km keng va 2 km uzun: u juda tekis va buzoqsiz, garchi har bir tomondan tog'lar devorlar kabi balandlikda kamida 1 metr balandlikkacha ko'tariladi. Yer yuzi bo'ylab men hech qanday tabiiy hodisa haqida hech qanday ma'lumotga ega emasman. "Birta mo'jiza deyarli bizning oldimizda!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "I see a vast lake black as pitch and round as a crater; it is surrounded by such lofty mountains that their shadows reach clear across, rendering the interior quite invisible!" "That's Plato;" said M'Nicholl; "I know it well; it's the darkest spot on the Moon: many a night I gazed at it from my little observatory in Broad Street, Philadelphia."
uz: "Men katta qora ko'lni ko'ryapman, u krater kabi baland va yuzli; u shunchalik baland tog'lar bilan o'rab olinganki, ularning soyasi o'z ichiga o'tadi va ichki qismini ko'rinmas qilib qo'yadi!" - dedi M'Nicholl; "Men uni yaxshi bilaman; u oyning eng qorong'i nuqtasi: ko'p kechalar men uni Filadelfiyaning Broad Streetdagi kichkina observatoriyamdan ko'rdim".

en: "Right, Captain," said Barbican; "the crater Plato, is, indeed, generally considered the blackest spot on the Moon, but I am inclined to consider the spots Grimaldi and Riccioli on the extreme eastern edge to be somewhat darker.
uz: "To'g'ri, kapitan", dedi Barbican; "Platon kraterini, albatta, odatda oydagi eng qora nuqta deb hisoblashadi, lekin men o'zimning o'ylaymanki, cheksiz sharqiy chekkadagi Grimaldi va Riccioli nuqtalari biroz qorong'iroq.

en: If you take my glass, Ardan, which is of somewhat greater power than yours, you will distinctly see the bottom of the crater.
uz: Agar siz mening shishaimni, Ardanni olsangiz, u sizdan biroz ko'proq kuchga ega bo'lib, kraterning pastki qismini aniq ko'rasiz.

en: The reflective power of its plateau probably proceeds from the exceedingly great number of small craters that you can detect there." "I think I see something like them now," said Ardan.
uz: Uning platolarining aks ettiruvchi kuchi, ehtimol, u erda aniqlanadigan juda katta miqdordagi kichik kraterlardan kelib chiqadi". "Men hozir ularga o'xshash narsani ko'ryapman, deb o'ylayman", dedi Ardan.

en: "But I am sorry the Projectile's course will not give us a vertical view." "Can't be helped!" said Barbican; "we must go where it takes us.
uz: "Ammo men o'ylaymanki, Projectile yo'nalishi bizga vertikal ko'rinishni bermaydi. " "Yordam berolmaydi!" dedi Barbican; "biz bizni olib boradigan joyga borishimiz kerak.

en: The day may come when man can steer the projectile or the balloon in which he is shut up, in any way he pleases, but that day has not come yet!" Towards five in the morning, the northern limit of Mare Imbrium was finally passed, and Mare Frigoris spread its frost-colored plains far to the right and left.
uz: Inson o'zi xohlagan tarzda o'zini qamashtirgan raketani yoki ballonni boshqarishi mumkin bo'lgan kun kelishi mumkin, ammo bu kun hali kelmagan!" - deb so'zlagan.Tunlab soat beshda Mare Imbriumning shimoliy chegarasi nihoyat o'tib ketdi va Mare Frigoris sovuq rangli maydonlarini o'ng va chap tomonga tarqatdi.

en: On the east the travellers could easily see the ring-mountain Condamine, about ൥ൡൡൡ feet high, while a little ahead on the right they could plainly distinguish Fontenelle with an altitude nearly twice as great.
uz: Sharqda sayohatchilar o'zlarining balandligi taxminan 3 metr bo'lgan Condamine tog'ini osonlikcha ko'rishlari mumkin edi, o'ng tomonda esa Fontenelle tog'ining deyarli ikki baravar balandligi bilan aniq farq qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: Mare Frigoris was soon passed, and the whole lunar surface beneath the travellers, as far as they could see in all directions, now bristled with mountains, crags, and peaks.
uz: Tez orada Mare Frigorisdan o'tib ketdi va sayohatchilar har tomonlama ko'rishlari mumkin bo'lgancha, uning pastidagi butun oy yuzi endi tog'lar, toshlar va tepaliklar bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: Indeed, at the ൨ൡth parallel the "Seas" or plains seem to have come to an end.
uz: Darhaqiqat, th parallelda "dengizlar" yoki tekisliklar tugadi.

en: The spy-glasses now brought the surface to within about three miles, a distance less than that between the hotel at Chamouni and the summit of Mont Blanc.
uz: Kasb-qoriq ko'zguvlari endi yuzani taxminan uch mil ichida, Chamouni mehmonxonasi va Mont Blankning tepaligidan kamroq masofada ko'rsatdi.

en: To the left, they had no difficulty in distinguishing the ramparts of Philolaus, about ൢൣ,ൡൡൡ feet high, but though the crater had a diameter of nearly thirty miles, the black shadows prevented the slightest sign of its interior from being seen.
uz: Chap tomonida Philolausning devorlarini farq qilishda hech qanday qiyinchilik yo'q edi, ular taxminan 3 metr balandlikda edilar, lekin krater deyarli 30 mil diametrga ega bo'lsa-da, qora soyalar uning ichki qismining eng kam belgisini ko'rishga to'sqinlik qilardi.

en: The Sun was now sinking very low, and the illuminated surface of the Moon was reduced to a narrow rim.
uz: Quyosh endi juda past bo'lib o'tib ketayotgan edi va oyning yorug'langan yuzi tor bo'lakga kamaygan edi.

en: By this time, too, the bird's eye view to which the observations had so far principally confined, decidedly altered its character.
uz: Shu paytgacha kuzatuvlar asosan cheklangan qush ko'rinishi ham uning xarakterini o'zgartirgan.

en: They could now look back at the lunar mountains that they had been just sailing over—a view somewhat like that enjoyed by a tourist standing on the summit of Mt.
uz: Endi ular o'zlari sayohat qilib kelayotgan oy tog'lariga nazar solib ko'rishlari mumkin edi.

en: Gothard as he sees the sun setting behind the peaks of the Bernese Oberland.
uz: Gothard Bernning Oberlandiya tepaliklari orqasida quyosh botayotganini ko'rib turibdi.

en: The lunar landscapes however,
uz: Biroq, oy manzaralari,

en: though seen under these new and ever varying conditions, "hardly gained much by the change," according to Ardan's expression.
uz: Ushbu yangi va har doim o'zgarib turadigan sharoitlarda ko'rilgan bo'lsa-da, Ardanning so'zlariga ko'ra, "o'zgarish tufayli juda oz foyda ko'rishdi".

en: On the contrary, they looked, if possible, more dreary and inhospitable than before.
uz: Aksincha, ular iloji bo'lsa, avvalgidek chiroyli va mehmondo'stliksiz ko'rinardi.

en: The Moon having no atmosphere, the benefit of this gaseous envelope in softening off and nicely shading the approaches of light and darkness, heat and cold, is never felt on her surface.
uz: O'sha oyda atmosfera yo'qligi sababli, bu gazli qoplama nur va qorong'ilik, issiq va sovuqning yaqinlashishini yumshatadi va chiroyli soyalaydi.

en: There, no twilight ever softly ushers in the brilliant sun, or sweetly heralds the near approach of night's dark shadow.
uz: U yerda hech qanday qorong'i quyoshni sekin-sakin ko'tarmaydi yoki kechaning qorong'i soyasi yaqinlashib kelishini xushxabar qilib beradi.

en: Night follows day, and day night, with the startling suddenness of a match struck or a lamp extinguished in a cavern.
uz: Kechasi kunduzdan keyin, kecha esa kunduzdan keyin bo'lib o'tadi, u yerda to'qnashuvning o'tishi yoki ko'rvaxonada chiroq o'chirib ketishidan qo'rqinchli bir tasavvur bilan sodir bo'ladi.

en: Nor can it present any gradual transition from either extreme of temperature.
uz: Shuningdek, u har qanday har qanday harorat cheksizligidan bosqichma-bosqich o'tishni ko'rsatolmaydi.

en: Hot jumps to cold, and cold jumps to hot.
uz: Issiqlik sovuqqa, sovuqlik esa issiqlikka o'tadi.

en: A moment after a glacial midnight, it is a roasting noon.
uz: Qizil kechadan bir daqiqa o'tgach, bu qovurilgan tush.

en: Without an instant's warning the temperature falls from ൣൢൣ° Fahrenheit to the icy winter of interstellar space.
uz: Bir lahzalik ogohlantirishsiz, harorat ° Fahrenheitdan interyulduzlararo kosmosning muzli qishlarigacha pasayadi.

en: The surface is all dazzling glare, or pitchy gloom.
uz: Yer yuzi butunlay chiroyli yorug'lik, yoki chiroyli zulmatga to'lib-toshgan.

en: Wherever the direct rays of the sun do not fall, darkness reigns supreme.
uz: Quyoshning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nurlari tushmagan joylarda zulmat hukmronlik qiladi.

en: What we call diffused light on Earth, the grateful result of refraction, the luminous matter held in suspension by the air, the mother of our dawns and our dusks, of our blushing mornings and our dewy eyes, of our shades, our penumbras, our tints and all the other magical effects of chiaro- oscuro—this diffused light has absolutely no existence on the surface of the Moon.
uz: Yer yuzida tarqalgan nur deb atalgan narsa, ta'sirning minnatdor natijasi, havo tomonidan susaytirilgan yorug'lik, tong va tunning onasi, qizillab borayotgan tonglarimiz va ko'zlarimiz, soyalarimiz, yarim ko'rinishlarimiz, nuqtalarimiz va chiaro- oscuroning boshqa barcha sehrli ta'sirlari bu tarqalgan nurning oy yuzasida hech qanday mavjudligi yo'q.

en: Nothing is there to break the inexorable contrast between intense white and intense black.
uz: Kuchli oq va kuchli qora o'rtasidagi o'zgarmas kontrastni buzadigan hech narsa yo'q.

en: At mid-day, let a Selenite shade his eyes and look at the sky: it will appear to him as black as pitch, while the stars still sparkle before him as vividly as they do to us on the coldest and darkest night in winter.
uz: Tush paytida Selenitning ko'zlarini ko'rsin va osmonga nazar solsin: u unga chiroq kabi qora ko'rinadi, yulduzlar esa hali ham qishning eng sovuq va qorong'i kechasida bizga qilganidek, uning oldiga yorqincha parvarish qiladi.

en: From this you can judge of the impression made on our travellers by those strange lunar landscapes.
uz: Bundan kelib chiqqan holda, ushbu g'alati oy manzaralari sayyohlarimizga qanday taassurot qoldirganini ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: Even their decided novelty and very strange character produced any thing but a pleasing effect on the organs of sight.

en: The Projectile had been lately approaching the Moon's surface so rapidly that it at last seemed actually impossible not to finally touch it somewhere in the neighborhood of the north pole, whose dazzling ridges now presented themselves in sharp and strong relief against the black sky.
uz: O'sha paytdan beri Layla O'shaning yuziga shunchalik tez yaqinlashib kelayotgan ediki, nihoyat, uni shimoliy qutb yaqinidagi biron bir joyga qo'ymay qolish imkonsiz tuyulgan edi, chunki uning chiroyli shoxlari hozirda qora osmonga qarshi keskin va kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatgan edi.

en: Therefore he kept silent, but quietly bided his time.
uz: Shuning uchun u sukut saqladi, lekin xotirjamlik bilan o'z vaqtini talab qildi.

uz: O'z navbatida Projectile o'z faoliyatini davom ettirib, oy yuziga yanada yaqinlashdi.

uz: Endi oy sayohatchilarga o'z ikkinchi chorak boshlanishida bizga ko'rinishi kabi, o'z ko'rinishida ko'rinadi, ya'ni o'rniga yorqin yarim oy sifatida ko'rinadi.

en: On one side, glaring dazzling light; on the other, cavernous pitchy darkness.
uz: Bir tomondan yorug'lik, boshqa tomondan qo'rqinchli qorong'ilik.

en: separating both was broken into a thousand bits of protuberances and concavities, dented, notched, and jagged.
