en: At six o'clock the travellers found themselves exactly over the north pole.
uz: Soat oltilarda sayohatchilar o'zlarini aynan shimoliy qutbning ustida topdilar.

en: They were quietly gazing at the rapidly shifting features of the wondrous view unrolling itself beneath them, and were silently wondering what was to come next, when, suddenly, the Projectile passed the dividing line.
uz: Ular xotirjamlik bilan ularning ostidan ko'rinayotgan ajoyib ko'rinishning tez o'zgarib borayotgan xususiyatlariga qarab, keyin nima bo'lishini so'zsiz o'ylashar edilar, lekin birdan, "Projektil" bo'linma chizig'ini o'tkazib yubordi.

en: The Sun and Moon instantly vanished from view.
uz: Quyosh va oy darhol ko'rinishdan yo'qoldi.

en: The next moment, without the slightest warning the travellers found themselves plunged in an ocean of the most appalling darkness!
uz: Keyingi daqiqada, sayohatchilar hech qanday ogohlantirishsiz, o'zlarini eng dahshatli qorong'ilikdagi okeanga tushib qolgan holda topdilar!

en: A NIGHT OF FIFTEEN DAYS.
uz: O'n besh kunlik kechasi.

en: The Projectile being not quite ൤ൡ miles from the Moon's north pole when the startling phenomenon, recorded in our last chapter, took place, a few seconds were quite sufficient to launch it at once from the brightest day into the unknown realms of night.
uz: O'tgan bobimizda qayd etilgan dahshatli hodisa sodir bo'lganda, Layla oyning shimoliy qutbidan bir necha kilometr uzoqlikda bo'lmaganligi sababli, uni eng yorqin kunning eng yorqin kunidan to'g'ri yo'lga qo'yish uchun bir necha soniya yetarli edi.

en: The transition was so abrupt, so unexpected, without the slightest shading off, from dazzling effulgence to Cimmerian gloom, that the Moon seemed to have been suddenly extinguished like a lamp when the gas is turned off.
uz: O'tish shunchalik to'satdan, shunchalik kutilmaganda, kamroq soya-sanoqsiz bo'lib o'tdi, o'tishning o'zi o'z-o'zidan chiroyli chiroyli nurdan Cimmeriya zulmiga o'tdiki, gaz o'chirilganda oy bir lampa kabi to'satdan o'chirib ketganga o'xshaydi.

en: "Where's the Moon?" cried Ardan in amazement.
uz: "Oy qayerda?" - dedi Ardan hayratda.

en: "It appears as if she had been wiped out of creation!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "U yaratilishdan yo'q qilingan bo'lib ko'rinadi!" - deb baqirdi.

en: Barbican said nothing, but observed carefully.
uz: Barbican hech narsa aytmadi, lekin diqqat bilan kuzatdi.

en: Not a particle, however, could he see of the disc that had glittered so resplendently before his eyes a few moments ago.
uz: Biroq, u bir necha daqiqa oldin ko'z o'ngida shunday yorqin shishlagan diskdan bir tishakni ham ko'rmagan.

en: Not a shadow, not a gleam, not the slightest vestige could he trace of its existence.
uz: Hech bir soya, hech bir yorug'lik, hech bir belgi ham uning mavjudligini aniqlay olmagan.

en: The darkness being profound, the dazzling splendor of the stars only gave a deeper blackness to the pitchy sky.
uz: Qorong'ilik chuqur bo'lgani uchun, yulduzlarning yorqin shodligi nurli osmonga faqat chuqurroq qorong'ulik berdi.

en: The travellers found themselves now in a night that had plenty of time not only to become black itself, but to steep everything connected with it in palpable blackness.
uz: Sayohatchilar o'zlarini nafaqat qoralash uchun, balki u bilan bog'liq bo'lgan hamma narsani aniq qoralash uchun yetarlicha vaqtga ega bo'lgan kechada topdilar.

en: This was the night ൤൦൥-ൢ/൥ hours long, during which the invisible face of the Moon is turned away from the Sun.
uz: Bu kechasi -/ soat davom etgan, oyning ko'rinmas yuzi Quyoshdan yuz o'giradigan kecha edi.

en: In this black darkness the Projectile now fully participated.
uz: Ushbu qora qorong'ilikda "Projektil" endi to'liq ishtirok etdi.

en: the Moon's shadow, it was as effectually cut off from the action of the solar rays as was every point on the invisible lunar surface itself.
uz: Oyning soyasi, u ko'rinmas oy yuzasidagi har bir nuqta kabi quyosh nurlarining ta'siridan samarali kesilgan edi.

en: The travellers being no longer able to see each other, it was proposed to light the gas, though such an unexpected demand on a commodity at once so scarce and so valuable was certainly disquieting.
uz: Sayohatchilar bir-birlarini ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmagani uchun, gazni yoqish taklif qilindi, garchi bir vaqtning o'zida kam va qimmatli bo'lgan tovarga nisbatan bunday kutilmagan talab, albatta, xavotirga soluvchi bo'lgan.

en: The gas, it will be remembered, had been intended for heating alone, not illumination, of which both Sun and Moon had promised a never ending supply.
uz: Shuni yodda tutish kerakki, gaz faqat issiqlik uchun ishlatilgan edi, yorug'lik uchun emas, quyosh va oy har ikkalasi ham oxirigacha etkazib berishni va'da qilgan edi.

en: But here both Sun and Moon, in a single instant vanished from before their eyes and left them in Stygian darkness.
uz: Ammo shu yerda quyosh va oy bir lahzada ularning ko'zlari oldida yo'qolgan va ularni Stigiya zulmatida qoldirgan.

en: "It's all the Sun's fault!" cried Ardan, angrily trying to throw the blame on something, and, like every angry man in such circumstances, bound to be rather nonsensical.
uz: Ardan g'azablanib, biror narsaga ayb qo'ymoqchi bo'lib, shunday vaziyatlarda g'azabga tushadigan har bir kishi kabi o'ta aqlsiz bo'lishi kerak.

en: "Put the saddle on the right horse, Ardan," said M'Nicholl patronizingly, always delighted at an opportunity of counting a point off the Frenchman.
uz: M'Nicholl: "O'ng qo'lga oting, Ardan", - dedi.M'Nicholl frantsuzchiga bir nuqtani hisoblab chiqish imkoniyatidan har doim mamnun bo'lib, mehribonlik ila gapirdi.

en: "You mean it's all the Moon's fault, don't you, in setting herself like a screen between us and the Sun?" "No, I don't!" cried Ardan, not at all soothed by his friend's patronizing tone, and sticking like a man to his first assertion right or wrong.
uz: "Sizning aytgandek, o'zini biz bilan Quyosh o'rtasida ekran kabi o'rnatganida oyning hammasi aybdor, shunday emasmi?" - deb aytmoqchisiz, "Yo'q, men bunday qilmayman!" - dedi Ardan, do'stining mehribon tonidan umuman xotirjam bo'lmay, o'zining birinchi so'zlariga, to'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri bo'lganini bir odamdek qo'yib.

en: It will be all the Sun's fault if we use up our gas!" "Nonsense!" said M'Nicholl.
uz: Biz gazni to'kkanimizda, butunlay quyoshning aybi bo'ladi!" - dedi M'Nicholl.

en: "It's the Moon, who by her interposition has cut off the Sun's light." "The Sun had no business to allow it to be cut off," said Ardan, still angry and therefore decidedly loose in his assertions.
uz: "O'z o'rnagi bilan Quyoshning nurini kesib qo'ygan oy", - dedi Ardan hali ham g'azabda va shu sababli o'z e'tirozlarida qat'iy bo'shashgan holda.

en: Before M'Nicholl could reply, Barbican interposed, and his even voice was soon heard pouring balm on the troubled waters.
uz: M'Nicholl javob bera olmaguncha, Barbican o'z so'zini qo'zg'atdi va uning hatto ovozi tez orada qayg'uli suvlarga balsam to'kganini eshitildi.

en: "Dear friends," he observed, "a little reflection on either side would convince you that our present situation is neither the Moon's fault nor the Sun's fault.
uz: "Dor do'stlar", - deb ta'kidladi u, "har ikki tomondan bir oz mulohaza sizlarni hozirgi ahvolimizning Ne oyning, Ne Quyoshning aybi emasligiga ishontiradi.

en: If anything is to be blamed for it, it is our Projectile which, instead of rigidly following its allotted course, has awkwardly contrived to deviate from it.
uz: Agar bunga biron narsa aybdor bo'lsa, bu bizning o'z yo'nalishidan qat'iy o'tmay, o'z yo'nalishidan adashish uchun o'ziga yarasha o'yin qilgan o'g'limizdir.

en: However, strict justice must acquit even the Projectile.
uz: Biroq, qat'iy adolat hatto Projectile-ni oqlashi kerak.

en: It only obeyed a great law of nature in shifting its course as soon as it came within the sphere of that inopportune bolide's influence." "All right!" said Ardan, as usual in the best of humor after Barbican had laid down the law.
uz: "To'g'ri!" - dedi Ardan, Barbican qonunni belgilaganidan so'ng, odatdagidek, humorning eng yaxshi tomoniga qarab. "To'g'ri!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "I have no doubt it is exactly as you say; and,
uz: "Men shubhalanmaymanki, bu sizning so'zingizdek; va,

en: now that all is settled, suppose we take breakfast.
uz: Endi hamma narsa tuzilgan ekan, keling, biz kechki ovqatni iste'mol qilaylik.

en: After such a hard night spent in work, a little refreshment would not be out of place!" Such a proposition being too reasonable even for M'Nicholl to oppose, Ardan turned on the gas, and had everything ready for the meal in a few minutes.
uz: Ishda o'tkazgan bunday qiyin kechadan so'ng, bir oz ichimlik o'rinsiz bo'lmaydi!" - degan taklif M'Nichollning ham qarshilik ko'rsatishi uchun juda oqilona bo'lgani uchun, Ardan gazni yoqib, ovqat uchun bir necha daqiqada hamma narsa tayyor bo'ldi.

en: But, this time, breakfast was consumed in absolute silence.
uz: Ammo, bu safar, ertalabki ovqatni mutlaqo hushyorlikda iste'mol qilishdi.

en: No toasts were offered, no hurrahs were uttered.
uz: Hech qanday toastlar taklif etilmagan, hech qanday hurralar aytilmagan.

en: A painful uneasiness had seized the hearts of the daring travellers.
uz: Jasoratli sayohatchilarning yuragida og'ir xavotir paydo bo'ldi.

en: The darkness into which they were so suddenly plunged, told decidedly on their spirits.
uz: Ular o'sha paytdagi qorong'ilikka to'satdan tushishdi va bu ularning ruhlariga qattiq ta'sir qildi.

en: They felt almost as if they had been suddenly deprived of their sight.
uz: Ular o'zlarini to'satdan ko'zlari yo'qotib qo'yilgandek his qilishdi.

en: That thick, dismal savage blackness, which Victor Hugo's pen is so fond of occasionally revelling in, surrounded them on all sides and crushed them like an iron shroud.
uz: Victor Hugoning qalamini vaqti-vaqti bilan o'ziga xos bo'lgan qalin, shafqatsiz yovvoyi qorong'ilik ularni har tomondan o'rab oldi va temir qopqoq kabi ularni ezib yubordi.

en: It was felt worse than ever when, breakfast being over, Ardan carefully turned off the gas, and everything within the Projectile was as dark as without.
uz: Ertalabki ovqat tugaganida, Ardan gazni ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'chirib qo'yganida, o'zimni har qachongidan ham yomon his qilardim.

en: However, though they could not see each other's faces, they could hear each other's voices, and therefore they soon began to talk.
uz: Biroq, ular bir-birlarining yuzlarini ko'rmagan bo'lsa-da, bir-birlarining ovozlarini eshitishardi va shu sababli tez orada ular gapira boshlashdi.

en: The most natural subject of conversation was this terrible night ൤൦൥ hours long, which the laws of nature have imposed on the Lunar inhabitants.
uz: Suhbatning eng tabiiy mavzusi bu qo'rqinchli kecha edi, u soatlar davomida davom etgan, tabiat qonunlari oy aholisiga qo'yib bergan.

en: Barbican undertook to give his friends some explanation regarding the cause of the startling phenomenon, and the consequences resulting from it.
uz: Barbican o'z do'stlariga bu dahshatli hodisaning sababini va oqibatlarini tushuntirishni taklif qildi.

en: "Yes, startling is the word for it," observed Barbican, replying to a remark of Ardan's; "and still more so when we reflect that not only are both lunar hemispheres deprived, by turns, of sun light for nearly ൢ൦ days, but that also the particular hemisphere over which we are at this moment floating is all that long night completely deprived of earth-light.
uz: "Ha, bu so'z qo'rqinchli", - dedi Barbican Ardanning so'zlariga javob berib, "va ayniqsa, ikki oy yarim qirrasining ham bir-biriga qarab deyarli  kun quyosh nuridan mahrum bo'lgani haqida mulohaza yuritganda, balki biz hozirgi paytda suzayotgan o'ziga xos yarim qirrasining ham yer yorug'ligidan butunlay mahrum bo'lgani haqida mulohaza yuritib ko'raylik.

en: In other words, it is only one side of the Moon's disc that ever receives any light from the Earth.
uz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, Ay diskining faqat bir tomoni Yerdan biron bir yorug'lik oladi.

en: From nearly every portion of one side of the Moon, the Earth is always as completely absent as the Sun is from us at midnight.
uz: Ayning deyarli har bir qismidan Yer doimo kechqurun Quyosh bizdan uzoq bo'lgani kabi butunlay yo'q.

en: Suppose an analogous case existed on the Earth; suppose, for instance, that neither in Europe, Asia or North America was the Moon ever visible—that, in fact, it was to be seen only at our antipodes.
uz: Ayol Yer yuzida mavjud bo'lganini tasavvur qiling; masalan, Evropada, Osiyoda yoki Shimoliy Amerikada hech qachon oy ko'rinmasligini tasavvur qiling, aslida u faqat bizning antipodlarimizdan ko'rinadi.

en: With what astonishment should we contemplate her for the first time on our arrival in Australia or New Zealand!"
uz: Avstraliya yoki Yangi Zelandiyaga kelganimizda uni birinchi marta ko'rib hayron bo'lishimiz kerak!"

en: "Every man of us would pack off to Australia to see her!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "Har bir kishi uni ko'rish uchun Avstraliyaga borardi!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "Yes," said M'Nicholl sententiously; "for a visit to the South Sea a Turk would willingly forego Mecca; and a Bostonian would prefer Sidney even to Paris." "Well," resumed Barbican, "this interesting marvel is reserved for the Selenite that inhabits the side of the Moon which is always turned away from our globe." "And which," added the Captain, "we should have had the unspeakable satisfaction of contemplating if we had only arrived at the period when the Sun and the Earth are not at the same side of the Moon—that is, ൢ൦ days sooner or later than now." uz: U chiroyli ko'rinishning  darajasini, sharqda  darajasini va g'arbda  darajasini ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun uning  darajasiga nisbatan, ya'ni butun yuzani bir oz ko'proq, atrofida / darajasiga teng bo'lgan, inson ko'zi uchun ko'rinadi.

en: Consequently a Selenite could catch an occasional glimpse of our Earth, without altogether quitting the dark side." "No matter for that!" cried Ardan; "if we ever become Selenites we must inhabit the visible side.
uz: Natijada, Selenit Yerimizni vaqti-vaqti bilan ko'rib turishi mumkin edi, ammo butunlay qorong'i tomondan ketmas edi". "Bu hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas!" - deb baqirdi Ardan; "agar biz Selenit bo'lsak, ko'rinadigan tomondan yashashi kerak.

en: My weak point is light, and that I must have when it can be got." "Unless, as perhaps in this case, you might be paying too dear for it," observed M'Nicholl.
uz: Mening zaif tomonim yengillikdir va men uni olishim mumkin bo'lganda olishim kerak". - deb ta'kidladi M'Nicholl. - Ehtimol, bu holatda bo'lgani kabi, siz uchun juda qimmat pul to'layotgandirsiz.

en: "How would you like to pay for your light by the loss of the atmosphere, which, according to some philosophers, is piled away on the dark side?" "Ah!
uz: "Ba'zi falsafachilarga ko'ra, qorong'i tomonda to'plangan atmosfera yo'qolishi bilan nuringiz uchun pul to'lashni xohlaysizmi?"

en: In that case I should consider a little before committing myself," replied Ardan, "I should like to hear your opinion regarding such a notion, Barbican.
uz: O'zimni qo'llab-quvvatlashdan oldin biroz o'ylab ko'rishim kerak, - dedi Ardan. - Bunday fikrga nisbatan sizning fikringizni eshitishni xohlayman, Barbican.

en: Have astronomers any valid reasons for supposing the atmosphere to have fled to the dark side of the Moon?" "Defer that question till some other time, Ardan," whispered M'Nicholl; "Barbican is just now thinking out something that interests him far more deeply than any empty speculation of astronomers.
uz: Astronomlar atmosferaning Oʻzlarining oyning qorongʻi tomoniga qochib ketganini taxmin qilish uchun asosli sabablarga ega?" - deb soʻradi M'Nicholl. - Bu savolni boshqa bir vaqtga qoldiring, Ardan, - dedi M'Nicholl. - Barbican hozirda astronomlarning hech qanday boʻsh taxminlaridan ham chuqurroq qiziqqan narsani oʻylab topmoqda.

en: If you are near the window, look out through it towards the Moon.
uz: Agar darcha yaqinida bo'lsangiz, u orqali oyga qarab ko'ring.

en: Can you see anything?" "I can feel the window with my hand; but for all I can see, I might as well be over head and ears in a hogshead of ink." The two friends kept up a desultory conversation, but Barbican did not hear them.
uz: Siz biror narsa ko'rasizmi?" - "Men o'zimning qo'lim bilan oynani sezaman; lekin ko'rib turganim uchun, boshim va quloqlarimning o'rtasida qora qora qorachog'ida bo'lishim mumkin". Ikki do'st o'z suhbatini davom ettirdi, lekin Barbican ularni eshitmadi.

en: One fact, in particular, troubled him, and he sought in vain to account for it.
uz: Bir fakt uni ayniqsa xavotirga solgan va u buning sababini befoyda tushuntirishga harakat qilgan.

en: Having come so near the Moon—about ൤ൡ miles—why had not the Projectile gone all the way?
uz: O'sha qadar yaqinlashib kelgan oyga, nima uchun o'sha o'g'il o'g'li butunlay o'tib ketmadi?

en: Had its velocity been very great, the tendency to fall could certainly be counteracted.
uz: Agar uning tezligi juda katta bo'lganida, pastga tushish tendensiyasi albatta bartaraf etilishi mumkin edi.

en: But the velocity being undeniably very moderate, how explain such a decided resistance to Lunar attraction?
uz: Ammo tezlik, shubhasiz, juda o'rtacha bo'lgani uchun, oyga nisbatan bunday qat'iy qarshilikni qanday tushuntirish mumkin?

en: Had the Projectile come within the sphere of some strange unknown influence?
uz: O'g'li qandaydir g'alati, noma'lum ta'sirga ega bo'lganmi?

en: Did the neighborhood of some mysterious body retain it firmly imbedded in ether?
uz: Biror sirli jismning atrofida u eterga qattiq bog'langan bo'lganmi?

en: That it would never reach the Moon, was now beyond all doubt; but where was it going?
uz: O'shanda u hech qachon Oyga yetib bormaydi deb shubha yo'q edi; lekin u qayerga ketayotgan edi?

en: Nearer to her or further off?
uz: Unga yaqinroqmi yoki uzoqroqmi?

en: Or was it rushing resistlessly into infinity on the wings of that pitchy night?
uz: Yoki u o'sha chiroyli tunning qanotlari ustida chidamsiz cheksizlikka shovqin qilyaptimi?

en: Who could tell, know, calculate—who could even guess, amid the horror of this gloomy blackness?
uz: Bu qorong'i qorong'ilik dahshatida kim bilishi, bilishi, hisoblashi mumkin?

en: Questions, like these, left Barbican no rest; in vain he tried to grapple with them; he felt like a child before them, baffled and almost despairing.
uz: Shu kabi savollar Barbicanni tinch qoldirmasdi; bekorga u bilan kurashishga harakat qilardi; o'zini ularning oldida o'smirday his qilardi, g'alati va deyarli umidsiz edi.

en: In fact, what could be more tantalizing?
uz: Aslida, bundan ko'proq qiziqarli narsa nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Just outside their windows, only a few leagues off, perhaps only a few miles, lay the radiant planet of the night, but in every respect as far off from the eyes of himself and his companions as if she was hiding at the other side of Jupiter!
uz: Darvozalari tashqarisida, bir necha kilometr, ehtimol bir necha kilometr uzoqlikda, nurli tun sayyorasi joylashgan, ammo har jihatdan u va uning hamkorlari ko'zidan juda uzoqda, xuddi u Yupiterning boshqa tomoniga yashiringan bo'lsa kerak!

en: And to their ears she was no nearer.
uz: Ularning quloqlariga u hech qachon yaqin emas edi.

en: Earthquakes of the old Titanic type might at that very moment be upheaving her surface with resistless force, crashing mountain against mountain as fiercely as wave meets wave around the storm-lashed cliffs of Cape Horn.
uz: Eski Titaniq turidagi zilzilalar o'sha paytda uning yuzasini qarshiliksiz kuch bilan ko'tarib, toqqa to'qnashgan tog'ni to'lqin to'qnashgandek, to'lqin to'qnashgan to'lqinni to'lqin to'qnashgandek qattiq urib yuborishi mumkin.

en: But not the faintest far off murmur even of such a mighty tumult could break the dead brooding silence that surrounded the travellers.
uz: Ammo shunchalik kuchli g'alayonning hatto eng kichik shovqinlari ham sayohatchilarni o'rab olgan o'lik va g'ayratli nutqni buzishi mumkin emas.

en: Nay, the Moon, realizing the weird fancy of the Arabian poet, who calls her a "giant stiffening into granite, but struggling madly against his doom," might shriek, in a spasm of agony, loudly enough to be heard in Sirius.
uz: Yo'q, Ay, uni "granitga o'zgargan, ammo o'z halokatini g'alati bilan o'tkazayotgan" ulkan arab shoirning g'ayrioddiy xayolini anglab, azob-uqubat chekib, Siriusda eshitiladigan darajada baland ovoz bilan qichqirishi mumkin.

en: But our travellers could not hear it.
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarimiz uni eshitolmadi.

en: Their ears no sound could now reach.
uz: Ularning quloqlari endi hech qanday tovushga yetib kelmaydi.

en: They could no more detect the rending of a continent than the falling of a feather.
uz: Ular bir qit'aning parchalanishini, tovuqning tushib ketishini ko'proq aniqlay olishmagan.

en: Air, the propagator and transmitter of sound, was absent from her surface.
uz: Tovushning targ'ibotchisi va uzatgichisi bo'lgan havo uning yuzasidan yo'q edi.

en: Her cries, her struggles, her groans, were all smothered beneath the impenetrable tomb of eternal silence!
uz: Uning yig'i-sig'i, kurashlari, qayg'u-shubhalari abadiy xotirjamlikning o'tmas qabri ostida tug'ildi!

en: These were some of the fanciful ideas by which Ardan tried to amuse his companions in the present unsatisfactory state of affairs.
uz: Bular Ardanning hozirgi qoniqarsiz vaziyatda hamrohlarini o'yin-kulgi qilishga urinayotgan o'ylashchan fikrlaridan biri edi.

en: His efforts, however well meant, were not successful.
uz: Uning harakatlari, qanchalik yaxshi niyatda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, muvaffaqiyatli bo'lmadi.

en: M'Nicholl's growls were more savage than usual, and even Barbican's patience was decidedly giving way.
uz: M'Nichollning qichqiriqlari odatdagidan ham dahshatli edi va hatto Barbicanning sabr-toqatlari ham o'z yo'lidan ketayotgan edi.

en: The loss of the other face they could have easily borne—with most of its details they had been already familiar.
uz: Boshqa yuzning yo'qolishini ular osonlikcha ko'pgina tafsilotlari bilan ko'ra ko'pchilik bilgan edilar.

en: But, no, it must be the dark face that now escaped their observation!
uz: Ammo, yo'q, hozir ularning nazaridan o'tgan qorong'i yuz o'zi bo'lishi kerak!

en: The very one that for numberless reasons they were actually dying to see!
uz: Aynan o'sha o'rinni ko'rish uchun ko'pgina sabablarga ko'ra o'tirgan edi!

en: They looked out of the windows once more at the black Moon beneath them.
uz: Ular darchalardan yana bir bor ularning pastidagi qora oyga qarashdi.

en: There it lay below them, a round black spot, hiding the sweet faces of the stars, but otherwise no more distinguishable by the travellers than if they were lying in the depths of the Mammoth Cave of Kentucky.
uz: U yerda ular pastida, yulduzlarning shirin yuzlarini yashirgan to'plam qora nuqta joylashgan edi, ammo sayohatchilar uchun ular Kentuckydagi Mammut g'orining chuqurliklarida yotgan bo'lishidan ko'ra ko'proq farqlanmagan edi.

en: Only fifteen days before, that dark face had been splendidly illuminated by the solar beams, every crater lustrous, every peak sparkling, every streak glistening under the vertical ray.
uz: Faqatgina o'n besh kun oldin, o'sha qorong'i yuz quyosh nurlari, har bir krater yorqin, har bir tepalik parcha-parcha, har bir chiziq vertikal nur ostida parcha-parcha bo'lgan quyosh nurlari bilan chiroyli yoritilgan edi.

en: In fifteen days later, a day light the most brilliant would have replaced a midnight the most Cimmerian.
uz: O'n besh kun o'tgach, eng yorqin kunduz yorug'ligi yarim tunning eng yorug'ini o'rniga Cimmeriya yorug'ligini almashtirardi.

en: But in fifteen days later, where would the Projectile be?
uz: Ammo o'n besh kundan keyin "Projektil" qayerda bo'ladi?

en: In what direction would it have been drawn by the forces innumerable of attractions incalculable?
uz: Ko'pgina ko'rinishlarning ko'payib borayotgan kuchlari uni qaysi yo'nalishda jalb qilgan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: To such a question as this, even Ardan would reply only by an ominous shake of the head.
uz: Hatto Ardan ham bunday savolga faqat boshini qo'zg'atish bilan javob beradi.

en: We know already that our travellers, as well as astronomers generally, judging from that portion of the dark side occasionally revealed by the Moon's librations, were pretty certain that there is no great difference between her two sides, as far as regards their physical constitutions.
uz: Bizning sayohatchilarimiz va, umuman olganda, astronomlar, oy libratsiyalari tomonidan vaqti-vaqti bilan oshkor etiladigan qorong'i tomonning o'sha qismidan xulosa qilib, o'zlarining jismoniy tuzilishi bo'yicha ikki tomon o'rtasida katta farq yo'qligiga amin bo'lishganini bilamiz.

en: This portion, about the seventh part, shows plains and mountains, circles and craters, all of precisely the same nature as those already laid down on the chart.
uz: Bu qismda taxminan yettinchi qismda o'lchamlar va tog'lar, doiralar va kraterlar ko'rsatilgan, ularning barchasi chartda ko'rsatilganlarga o'xshaydi.

en: Judging therefore from analogy, the other three-sevenths are, in all probability a world in every respect exactly like the visible face—that is, arid, desert, dead.
uz: Shunday qilib, analogiyadan xulosa qilib, qolgan uch yettinchi qismi, ehtimol, har jihatdan ko'rinadigan yuzaga o'xshash dunyo, ya'ni quruq, sahro, o'lik.

en: But our travellers also knew that pretty certain is far from quite certain, and that arguing merely from analogy may enable you to give a good guess, but can never lead you to an undoubted conclusion.
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarimiz, juda aniq narsa to'liq aniq emasligini va faqat analogiyadan asoslanib dalillar berish sizga yaxshi taxmin qilish imkonini berishi mumkinligini, ammo hech qachon shubha ostiga solmaydigan xulosaga olib kelmasligini ham bilar edilar.

en: What if the atmosphere had really withdrawn to this dark face?
uz: Agar atmosfera chindan ham bu qorong'i yuzaga chiqsa nima bo'lardi?

en: And if air, why not water?
uz: Agar havo bo'lsa, nega suv bo'lmaydi?

en: Would not this be enough to infuse life into the whole continent?
uz: Bu butun qit'aga hayotni to'ldirish uchun etarli emasmi?

en: Why should not vegetation flourish on its plains, fish in its seas, animals in its forests, and man in every one of its zones that were capable of sustaining life?
uz: Nima uchun o'z o'lchovlarida o'simlik, dengizlarida baliqlar, o'rmonlarida hayvonlar va hayotni qo'llab-quvvatlashga qodir bo'lgan barcha hududlarda insonlar rivojlanmasligi kerak?

en: To these interesting questions, what a satisfaction it would be to be able to answer positively one way or another!
uz: Ushbu qiziqarli savollarga shu yoki shu yo'l bilan ijobiy javob berishga qodir bo'lish naqadar qoniqarli bo'lardi!

en: For thousands of difficult problems a mere glimpse at this hemisphere would be enough to furnish a satisfactory reply.
uz: Minglab qiyin muammolarga qoniqarli javob berish uchun bu yarim jahonning bir ko'rinishi kifoya qiladi.

en: How glorious it would be to contemplate a realm on which the eye of man has never yet rested!
uz: Inson ko'zi hali hech qachon tiklanmagan bir dunyoni ko'rish naqadar ulug'vor bo'lardi!

en: Great, therefore, as you may readily conceive, was the depression of our travellers' spirits, as they pursued their way, enveloped in a veil of darkness the most profound.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz tasavvur qilganingizdek, sayohatchilarimiz o'z yo'llarini davom ettirganida, qorong'ilik qopqog'i bilan o'rab olgan holda, ruhlarining tushkunligi katta edi.

en: Still even then Ardan, as usual, formed somewhat of an exception.
uz: Hattoki o'shanda ham Ardan, odatdagidek, biroz istisnoga aylandi.

en: Finding it impossible to see a particle of the Lunar surface, he gave it up for good, and tried to console himself by gazing at the stars, which now fairly blazed in the spangled heavens.
uz: O'zi uchun oy yuzasidagi bir qismni ko'rish imkonsiz deb topib, u buni butunlayin tashlab, o'zini yulduzlarga qarab tasalli berishga harakat qildi, ular endi chiroyli osmonlarda yonib turgan edi.

en: And certainly never before had astronomer enjoyed an opportunity for gazing at the heavenly bodies under such peculiar advantages.
uz: Bundan oldin hech bir astronom osmon jismlarini bunday o'ziga xos afzalliklar bilan ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmagan.

en: How Fraye of Paris, Chacornac of Lyons, and Father Secchi of Rome would have envied him!
uz: Parijlik Fraye, Lyonslik Chacornac va Rimlik Secchi otasi unga qanchalik hasad qilishgan bo'lsa kerak!

en: For, candidly and truly speaking, never before had mortal eye revelled on such a scene of starry splendor.
uz: Chindan ham, rostgo'y va rostgo'y aytganda, hech qachon o'likning ko'zi bunday yulduzli chiroyli ko'rinishga ko'z tikmagan edi.

en: The black sky sparkled with lustrous fires, like the ceiling of a vast hall of ebony encrusted with flashing diamonds.
uz: Qora osmon parcha-parcha o'tlar bilan parcha-parcha bo'lgan, xuddi yorqin olmoslar bilan o'ralgan keng eboniy zalning ustini o'rab olgan.

en: Ardan's eye could take in the whole extent in an easy sweep from the Southern Cross to the Little Bear, thus embracing within one glance not only the two polar stars of the present day, but also Campus and Vega, which, by reason of the precession of the Equinoxes, are to be our polar stars ൢൣ,ൡൡൡ years hence.
uz: Ardanning ko'zi butun ko'rinishni Janubiy Xochdan kichkina g'olibgacha osonlikcha ko'tarib, hozirgi ikki qutb yulduzini emas, balki Campus va Vega yulduzlarini bir qarashda o'z ichiga oladi, ular tengdoshliklarning oldingiligi tufayli bizning qutb yulduzlarimiz bo'lishi kerak., yillar o'tib.

en: His imagination, as if intoxicated, reeled wildly through these sublime infinitudes and got lost in them.
uz: Uning tasavvurlari xuddi mast bo'lib, bu yuksak cheksizliklarni o'rab-o'rab, o'z-o'zidan adashdi.

en: He forgot all about himself and all about his companions.
uz: U o'zi va do'stlari haqida hamma narsani unutib qo'ydi.

en: He forgot even the strangeness of the fate that had sent them wandering through these forbidden regions, like a bewildered comet that had lost its way.
uz: Hatto ularni bu taqiqlangan hududlarda, yo'ldan adashgan g'alati kometa singari aylanib yurgan taqdirning g'ayrioddiyligini ham unutdi.

en: With what a soft sweet light every star glowed!
uz: Har bir yulduz qanday yumshoq, shirin yorug'lik bilan yorug' edi!

en: No matter what its magnitude, the stream that flowed from it looked calm and holy.
uz: Bu oqim qanchalik katta bo'lmasin, undan oqib o'tgan oqim tinch va muqaddas ko'rinardi.

en: No twinkling, no scintillation, no nictitation, disturbed their pure and lambent gleam.
uz: Hech qanday qimirlash, chiroqlashish yoki chiroqlashish ularning sof va chiroyli yorug'ligini buzmagan.

en: No atmosphere here interposed its layers of humidity or of unequal density to interrupt the stately majesty of their effulgence.
uz: Bu yerda hech qanday atmosfera o'zining namlik qatlamlarini yoki tengsiz zichlikni buzish uchun ularning qudratli ulug'vorligini to'xtatmadi.

en: The longer he gazed upon them, the more absorbing became their attraction.
uz: U ularga qancha ko'proq qarasa, shuncha ko'proq qiziqish ko'rsatardi.

en: He felt that they were great kindly eyes looking down even yet with benevolence and protection on himself and his companions now driving wildly through space, and lost in the pathless depths of the black ocean of infinity!
uz: U o'zini va o'z sheriklarini o'ziga va cheksizlikning qora okeanining yo'lsiz chuqurliklarida yo'qolgan va o'zlariga va do'stlariga mehr-shafqat va himoya bilan qarab turgan juda mehribon ko'zlar deb hisoblardi!

en: He soon became aware that his friends, following his example, had interested themselves in gazing at the stars, and were now just as absorbed as himself in the contemplation of the transcendent spectacle.
uz: U tez orada uning do'stlari uning o'rnagiga ergashib, yulduzlarga qarashga qiziqish ko'rsatganini va hozir ular ham o'zi kabi transcendent spektaklni ko'rib chiqayotganini tushundi.

en: For a long time all three continued to feast their eyes on
uz: Uchtasi ham uzoq vaqt davomida ko'zlarini ko'rishlarini davom ettirgan.

en: all the glories of the starry firmament; but, strange to say, the part that seemed to possess the strangest and weirdest fascination for their wandering glances was the spot where the vast disc of the Moon showed like an enormous round hole, black and soundless, and apparently deep enough to permit a glance into the darkest mysteries of the infinite.
uz: Yulduzli osmondagi barcha shon-shuhratlar; lekin, g'alati aytish joizki, ularning ko'z o'ngida yurganlari uchun eng g'alati va g'alati taassurotga ega bo'lgan qism, oyning keng diskini katta, qora va tovushsiz yuza kabi ko'rsatadigan va cheksizning eng qorong'i sirlariga nazar solishga imkon beradigan darajada chuqur bo'lgan joy edi.

en: A disagreeable sensation, however, against which they had been for some time struggling, at last put an end to their contemplations, and compelled them to think of themselves.
uz: Biroq, ular bir muncha vaqt davomida kurashayotgan nojo'ya hissiyot, nihoyat ularning mulohazalariga chek qo'ydi va ularni o'zlari haqida o'ylashga majbur qildi.

en: This was nothing less than a pretty sharp cold, at first somewhat endurable, but which soon covered the inside surface of the window panes with a thick coating of ice.
uz: Bu juda qattiq sovuqdan boshqa narsa emas edi, dastlab biroz chidamli edi, ammo tez orada derazalar ichidagi yuzini qalin muz qoplami bilan qoplagan.

en: The fact was that, the Sun's direct rays having no longer an opportunity of warming up the Projectile, the latter began to lose rapidly by radiation whatever heat it had stored away within its walls.
uz: Darhaqiqat, quyoshning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nurlari o'z ichiga o'rnatilgan har qanday issiqlikni tezda yo'qotishni boshladi.

en: The consequence was a very decided falling of the thermometer, and so thick a condensation of the internal moisture on the window glasses as to soon render all external observations extremely difficult, if not actually impossible.
uz: Natijada termometrning juda qat'iy tushib ketishi va derazalaridagi ichki namlikning shunchalik to'liq kondensatsiyasi bo'ldiki, tez orada barcha tashqi kuzatishlarni juda qiyin, hatto imkonsiz qilib qo'ydi.

en: The Captain, as the oldest man in the party, claimed the privilege of saying he could stand it no longer.
uz: Kapten, partiyadagi eng keksa odam sifatida, o'zini ko'proq ko'tarolmasligini aytish sharafiga ega bo'ldi.

en: Striking a light, he consulted the thermometer and cried out: "Seventeen degrees below zero, centigrade!
uz: Yorug'likni yoqib, u termometrni ko'rib chiqib: "O'n yettita daraja noldan past, sentrij!

en: that is certainly low enough to make an old fellow like me feel rather chilly!" "Just one degree and a half above zero, Fahrenheit!" observed Barbican; "I really had no idea that it was so cold." His teeth actually chattered so much that he could hardly articulate; still he, as well as the others, disliked to entrench on their short supply of gas.
uz: Bu, albatta, men kabi keksa odam o'zini juda sovuq his qilishi uchun etarlicha past!" - deb aytdi Barbican; "Men bu qadar sovuq bo'lganini bilmasdim". - Uning tishlari shunchalik qichqirdiki, u o'zini so'z bilan ifodalay olmagan; lekin u ham, boshqalar ham gazning kamligi tufayli o'zlarini mustahkam tutishni yoqtirmasdi.

en: "One feature of our journey that I particularly admire," said Ardan, trying to laugh with freezing lips, "is that we can't complain of monotony.
uz: "Bizning sayohatimizning ayniqsa hayratda qoldirgan xususiyatlaridan biri, - dedi Ardan, sovuq og'izlar bilan kulishga harakat qilib, - biz monotonlikdan shikoyat qila olmaymiz.

en: At one time we are frying with the heat and blinded with the light, like Indians caught on a burning prairie; at another, we are freezing in the pitchy darkness of a hyperborean winter, like Sir John Franklin's merry men in the Bay of Boothia.
uz: Bir vaqtlar biz issiqlik va yorug'lik bilan ko'rilganmiz, xuddi yonayotgan preriyaga tutilgan hindistonlar kabi; boshqa paytlarda esa, biz hiperboreya qishning qorong'i qorong'iligida muzlaymiz, xuddi Sir John Franklinning Boothiya ko'chmasidagi quvonchli odamlari kabi.

en: Madame La Nature, you don't forget your devotees; on the contrary, you overwhelm us with your attentions!"
uz: Madame La Nature, siz o'z muxlislaringizni unutmaysiz, aksincha, bizni diqqat bilan ko'rib turibsiz!"

en: "Our external temperature may be reckoned at how much?" asked the Captain, making a desperate effort to keep up the conversation.
uz: "Bizning tashqi haroratimiz qancha bo'lishi mumkin?" - deb so'radi kapitan, suhbatni davom ettirish uchun juda ko'p harakat qildi.

en: "The temperature outside our Projectile must be precisely the same as that of interstellar space in general," answered Barbican.
uz: "Projectilimiz tashqarisidagi harorat yulduzlararo kosmosdagi harorat bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak", - deb javob berdi Barbican.

en: "Is not this precisely the moment then," interposed Ardan, quickly, "for making an experiment which we could never have made as long as we were in the sunshine?" "That's so!" exclaimed Barbican; "now or never!
uz: "O'sha paytda biz quyosh nurida bo'lganimizcha hech qachon qila olmagan tajribani amalga oshirish uchun aynan shu vaqt kelmadimi?" - dedi Ardan tezda.

en: I'm glad you thought of it, Ardan.
uz: Buni o'ylaganiga xursandman, Ardan.

en: We are just now in the position to find out the temperature of space by actual experiment, and so see whose calculations are right, Fourier's or Pouillet's." "Let's see," asked Ardan, "who was Fourier, and who was Pouillet?" "Baron Fourier, of the French Academy, wrote a famous treatise on Heat, which I remember reading twenty years ago in Penington's book store," promptly responded the Captain; "Pouillet was an eminent professor of Physics at the Sorbonne, where he died, last year, I think." "Thank you, Captain," said Ardan; "the cold does not injure your memory, though it is decidedly on the advance.
uz: Biz hozirgina kosmos haroratini haqiqiy tajriba orqali aniqlashga qodirmiz va kimning hisob-kitoblari to'g'ri, Fourierning yoki Pouilletning hisob-kitoblarini ko'rib chiqamiz". - deb so'radi Ardan. - Keling, ko'rib chiqaylik, Fourier kim edi va Pouillet kim edi? - deb so'radi Ardan. - Frantsiya akademiyasining Baron Fourier issiqlik to'g'risida mashhur maqolani yozgan edi, uni yigirma yil oldin Penington kitob do'konida o'qiganimni eslayman, - deb javob berdi kapitan. - Pouillet o'tgan yili o'lgan Sorbonna fizikasi professori edi.

en: See how thick the ice is already on the window panes!
uz: Qani endi oynalar panellariga muzning qalinligini ko'ring!

en: Let it only keep on and we shall soon have our breaths falling around us in flakes of snow." "Let us prepare a thermometer," said Barbican, who had already set himself to work in a business-like manner.
uz: Faqat shunday davom eting va biz tez orada o'zimizni qor shkaflari bilan o'rab olishimiz mumkin". "Termometr tayyorlaylik", dedi Barbican, u allaqachon biznesga o'xshash tarzda ishlashga qaror qilgan edi.

en: A thermometer of the usual kind, as may be readily supposed, would be of no use whatever in the experiment that was now about to be made.
uz: Odatdagidek, odatdagi termometr hozirda amalga oshirilayotgan tajribada hech qanday foydasi yo'q deb taxmin qilish mumkin.

en: In an ordinary thermometer Mercury freezes hard when exposed to a temperature of ൥ൡ° below zero.
uz: Oddiy termometrda Merkuri noldan past ° haroratga duchor bo'lganda qattiq muzlaydi.

en: But Barbican had provided himself with a Minimum, self-recording thermometer, of a peculiar nature, invented by Wolferdin, a friend of Arago's, which could correctly register exceedingly low degrees of temperature.
uz: Ammo Barbican o'ziga o'zi uchun o'ziga xos xususiyatga ega bo'lgan Minimumni, o'z-o'zini qayd etadigan termometrni taqdim etgan edi, uni Aragoning do'sti Wolferdin ixtiro qilgan va u juda past harorat darajasini aniq qayd etishi mumkin edi.

en: Before beginning the experiment, this instrument was tested by comparison with one of the usual kind, and then Barbican hesitated a few moments regarding the best means of employing it.
uz: Tajriba boshlanishidan oldin, ushbu asbobni odatdagi asbob bilan solishtirish orqali sinab ko'rishdi, keyin esa Barbican uni ishlatishning eng yaxshi usuli haqida bir necha daqiqa shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: "How shall we start this experiment?" asked the Captain.
uz: "Bu tajribani qanday boshlashimiz kerak?" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "Nothing simpler," answered Ardan, always ready to reply; "you just open your windows, and fling out your thermometer.
uz: "Odamroq hech narsa yo'q", - deb javob berdi Ardan, har doim javob berishga tayyor; "Siz shunchaki derazalaringizni ochib, termometringizni tashlang.

en: your Projectile, as a calf follows her mother.
uz: Sizning proyektilingiz, buzoqni onasiga ergashganidek.

uz: 25 daqiqadan keyin qo'lingni ko'tarib qo'ying" - dedi Barbican.

en: "Put out your hand—" continued Ardan, quietly.
uz: Ardan: "Qo'lingni ko'tarib ko'ring", - deb davom etdi.

en: "You do nothing of the kind," again interrupted Barbican; "that is, unless you prefer, instead of a hand, to pull back a frozen stump, shapeless, colorless and lifeless!" "I prefer a hand," said Ardan, surprised and interested.
uz: "Siz hech narsa qilmaysiz, - dedi Barbican yana bir bor, - ya'ni qo'lning o'rniga muzlatilgan, shaklsiz, rangsiz va hayotsiz bo'g'ini orqaga tortib olishni afzal ko'rmasangiz!" - Men qo'lni afzal ko'raman, - dedi Ardan hayron va qiziqib.

en: "Yes," continued Barbican, "the instant your hand left the Projectile, it would experience the same terrible sensations as is produced by cauterizing it with an iron bar white hot.
uz: "Ha, - deb davom etdi Barbican, - qo'lingiz Projectile-ni tashlab ketgandan so'ng, uni temir barda oq issiq bilan kauterizatsiya qilish natijasida hosil bo'lgan xuddi shunday dahshatli his-tuyg'ularni boshdan kechiradi.

en: For heat, whether rushing rapidly out of our bodies or rapidly entering them, is identically the same force and does the same amount of damage.
uz: Chunki issiqlik, tanamizdan tez chiqib ketsa ham, tez kirib ketsa ham, bir xil kuchga ega va bir xil miqdorda zarar yetkazadi.

en: Besides I am by no means certain that we are still followed by the objects that we flung out of the Projectile." "Why not?" asked M'Nicholl; "we saw them all outside not long ago." "But we can't see them outside now," answered Barbican; "that may be accounted for, I know, by the darkness, but it may be also by the fact of their not being there at all.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bizni hali ham Projectile-dan tashlagan narsalar kuzatib borishiga amin emasman". - "Nega yo'q?" deb so'radi M'Nicholl; "biz hammasini yaqinda tashqarida ko'rdik. - Lekin biz ularni hozir tashqarida ko'rmaymiz, - deb javob berdi Barbican; - bu, bilsam, qorong'ilik tufayli sodir bo'lishi mumkin, ammo ularning umuman yo'q bo'lgani tufayli ham sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

en: In a case like this, we can't rely on uncertainties.
uz: Bunday holatda biz noaniqlikka tayanishimiz mumkin emas.

en: Therefore, to make sure of not losing our thermometer, we shall fasten it with a string and easily pull it in whenever we like." This advice being adopted, the window was opened quickly, and the instrument was thrown out at once by M'Nicholl, who held it fastened by a short stout cord so that it could be pulled in immediately.
uz: Shuning uchun termometrimizni yo'qotmaslik uchun uni ip bilan bog'lab, xohlaganimizda osonlikcha olib kiramiz". Ushbu maslahat qabul qilinganda, darcha tez ochildi va asbobni M'Nicholl darhol tashladi, u uni darhol olib kirishi uchun qisqa, qattiq ip bilan bog'lab qo'ydi.

en: The window had hardly been open for longer than a second, yet that second had been enough to admit a terrible icy chill into the interior of the Projectile.
uz: Oyna bir soniyadan ko'proq vaqt davomida ochiq bo'lmagan, ammo bu soniya qorong'i sovuqlikni o'z ichiga olish uchun etarli edi.

en: "Ten thousand ice-bergs!" cried Ardan, shivering all over; "it's cold enough to freeze a white bear!" Barbican waited quietly for half an hour; that time he considered quite long enough to enable the instrument to acquire the temperature of the interstellar space.
uz: "O'n mingta muz tog'i!" - deb qichqirdi Ardan, hamma joyda titraydi; "bu juda sovuq bo'lib, oq g'azdani to'xtab qo'yishga qodir!" - deb aytdi Barbican yarim soat tinchlik bilan kutdi; bu vaqt u asbobning yulduzlararo kosmosning haroratini o'zlashtirishiga imkon beradigan darajada uzoq vaqt deb hisobladi.

en: Then he gave the signal, and it was instantly pulled in.
uz: So'ngra u signalni berdi va u o'sha zahoti ishga tushirildi.

en: It took him a few moments to calculate the quantity of mercury that had escaped into the little diaphragm attached to the lower part of
uz: U bir necha daqiqa vaqt o'tib, o'zining pastki qismiga biriktirilgan kichkina diafragmga o'tib ketgan quvur miqdorini hisoblab chiqdi.

en: the instrument; then he said: "A hundred and forty degrees, centigrade, below zero!"
uz: asbobni; so'ngra u: "Yuz qirq daraja, sentisgrad, noldan past!" - dedi.

en: IT'S COLD ENOUGH TO FREEZE A WHITE BEAR.
uz: Oq qushni buzish uchun juda sovuq.

en: "Two hundred and twenty degrees, Fahrenheit, below zero!" cried M'Nicholl; "no wonder that we should feel a little chilly!" "Pouillet is right, then," said Barbican, "and Fourier wrong." "Another victory for Sorbonne over the Academy!" cried Ardan.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Yikki yuz ikki daraja Fahrenheit, noldan past!" - deb baqirdi; "o'zimizni biroz sovuq his qilishimiz ajablanarli emas!" - dedi Barbican. - Shunday ekan, Pouillet to'g'ri, Fourier esa noto'g'ri. - Sorbonning akademiyaga qarshi yana bir g'olibi bor!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: Not that I'm a bit proud of finding myself in the midst of a temperature so very distingué—though it is more than three times colder than Hayes ever felt it at Humboldt Glacier or Nevenoff at Yakoutsk.
uz: Men o'zimni shunchalik ajoyib haroratda topganimdan biroz faxrlanaman, lekin bu Hayesning Humboldt muzladagidan yoki Yakoutskdagi Nevenoffdan uch barobar sovuqroq bo'lishiga qaramay.

en: If Madame the Moon becomes as cold as this every time that her surface is withdrawn from the sunlight for
uz: Agar Ay Xonim har safar uning yuzi quyosh nuridan uzoqlashsa, u shu qadar sovuq bo'ladi.

en: fourteen days, I don't think, boys, that her hospitality is much to hanker after!"
uz: O'n to'rt kun davomida, yigitlar, uning mehmondo'stligini ko'p sog'inib ko'rmayapman!"

en: GLIMPSES AT THE INVISIBLE.
uz: Ko'rinmas odamga ko'rinadi.

en: In spite of the dreadful condition in which the three friends now found themselves, and the still more dreadful future that awaited them, it must be acknowledged that Ardan bravely kept up his spirits.
uz: Uchta do'st o'zlarini hozirning o'zida qo'rqinchli holatda va ularni kutgan yanada qo'rqinchli kelajakka qaramay, Ardan jasorat bilan ruhini saqlab qolganini tan olish kerak.

en: And his companions were just as cheerful.
uz: U bilan birga bo'lganlar ham xuddi shunday quvonchli edilar.

en: Their philosophy was quite simple and perfectly intelligible.
uz: Ularning falsafasi juda sodda va to'liq tushunarli edi.

en: What they could bear, they bore without murmuring.
uz: Ular nimaga chidashsa, shovqin qilmasdan chidashardi.

en: When it became unbearable, they only complained, if complaining would do any good.
uz: Qachonki, bu yengil bo'lmaganda, ular faqat shikoyat qilishning foydasi borligini ko'rishardi.

en: Imprisoned in an iron shroud, flying through profound darkness into the infinite abysses of space, nearly a quarter million of miles distant from all human aid, freezing with the icy cold, their little stock not only of gas but of air rapidly running lower and lower, a near future of the most impenetrable obscurity looming up before them, they never once thought of wasting time in asking such useless questions as where they were going, or what fate was about to befall them.
uz: Temir qopqoqda qamoqda bo'lgan, cheksiz zulmat orqali kosmning cheksiz tublariga, insonlar yordamidan qariyb 250 ming mil uzoqlikda, muzli sovuqdan to'sib, ularning gaz bilan bog'liq kichik zaxiralari emas, balki havo tez-tez pastga tushadi, yaqin kelajakda ular uchun eng o'zidan-o'zini pastga tushadigan qorong'ilik paydo bo'ladi, ular qayerga ketayotganlari yoki ularga nima yuz berayotganini o'ylab, vaqtni sarflash haqida hech qachon o'ylamagan.

en: Knowing that no good could possibly result from inaction or despair, they carefully kept their wits about them, making their experiments and recording their observations as calmly and as deliberately as if they were working at home in the quiet retirement of their own cabinets.
uz: Hech qanday yaxshilik harakatsizlik yoki umidsizlikdan kelib chiqishi mumkin emasligini bilgan holda, ular o'zlarining aql-idroklarini diqqat bilan saqlab, o'zlarining tajribalarini o'tkazdilar va kuzatishlarini xuddi o'z kabinetlarining xotirjamlik bilan o'z xonadonlarida ishlamoqchi bo'lganidek, tinchlik va niyat bilan yozib olishdi.

en: Any other course of action, however, would have been perfectly absurd on their part, and this no one knew better than themselves.
uz: Biroq, ularning boshqa harakati mutlaqo absurd bo'lgan bo'lardi va buni hech kim o'zlaridan yaxshiroq bilmasdi.

en: Even if desirous to act otherwise, what could they have done?
uz: Agar ular boshqacha yo'l tutishni istasalar ham, nima qilishlari mumkin edi?

en: As powerless over the Projectile as a baby over a locomotive, they
uz: Ular Lokomotiv ustidan chaqaloq bo'lgani kabi, Projectile ustidan ham kuchsiz.

en: could neither clap brakes to its movement nor switch off its direction.
uz: Uning harakatini to'xtatish ham, yo'nalishini o'chirib qo'yish ham mumkin emas edi.

en: A sailor can turn his ship's head at pleasure; an aeronaut has little trouble, by means of his ballast and his throttle-valve, in giving a vertical movement to his balloon.
uz: Donochi kemasining boshini zavq bilan aylantirishi mumkin; havo kemasi aviatorining ballast va gazli valvuvi yordamida balonini vertikal harakatga qo'yishda kam muammo tug'diradi.

en: But nothing of this kind could our travellers attempt.
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarimiz bunday harakatlarni qilolmadi.

en: No helm, or ballast, or throttle-valve could avail them now.
uz: Hech qanday qo'riqchi, ballast yoki gaz quvurlari ularni hozirda ishlatolmaydi.

en: Nothing in the world could be done to prevent things from following their own course to the bitter end.
uz: Dunyoda hech narsa qilinib bo'lmaydigan bo'lib, narsalar o'z yo'llarini o'zlariga o'xshatishlariga to'sqinlik qiladi.

en: If these three men would permit themselves to hazard an expression at all on the subject, which they didn't, each could have done it by his own favorite motto, so admirably expressive of his individual nature.
uz: Agar bu uchta kishi o'zlariga bu mavzuda biron-bir ibora qilish imkoniyatini bersalar edi, lekin ular buni qilmagan edilar, har biri o'z sevimli shiorasi bilan buni qila olgan bo'lardi, bu esa o'zining shaxsiy tabiatini ajoyib tarzda ifodalaydi.

en: "Donnez tête baissée!" (Go it baldheaded!) showed Ardan's uncalculating impetuosity and his Celtic blood.
uz: "Donnez tête baissée!" (Go it baldheaded!) Ardanning o'ziga xos harakat va kelt qonini ko'rsatdi.

en: "Fata quocunque vocant!" (To its logical consequence!) revealed Barbican's imperturbable stoicism, culture hardening rather than loosening the original British phlegm.
uz: "Fata quocunque vocant!" (o'zining mantiqiy oqibatlariga ko'ra!) Barbicanning buzib bo'lmaydigan stoikizmini oshkor qildi, madaniyat asl ingliz phlegmini yumshatishning o'rniga qattiqlashtiradi.

en: Whilst M'Nicholl's "Screw down the valve and let her rip!" betrayed at once his unconquerable Yankee coolness and his old experiences as a Western steamboat captain.
uz: M'Nichollning "Valvonni buz va uni yirtishga ruxsat bering!" so'zlari bir vaqtning o'zida uning yengilmas yankiy sovuqligini va G'arbiy bug' kemasi kapitanining eski tajribalarini oshkor qildi.

en: Where were they now, at eight o'clock in the morning of the day called in America the sixth of December?
uz: Endi ular Amerikada 6-dekabr deb atalgan kunning sahar sakkizida qayerda edilar?

en: Near the Moon, very certainly; near enough, in fact, for them to perceive easily in the dark the great round screen which she formed between themselves and the Projectile on one side, and the Earth, Sun, and stars on the other.
uz: Ayga yaqin, albatta; haqiqatan ham, ular qorong'ilikda o'zlari va bir tomondan Projectile o'rtasida, boshqa tomondan Yer, Quyosh va yulduzlar o'rtasida shakllangan katta davra ekranini osonlikcha ko'rishlari uchun etarlicha yaqin.

en: But as to the exact distance at which she lay from them—they had no possible means of calculating it.
uz: Ammo u ulardan qancha uzoqlikda yotganini aniq bilmasliklari uchun ular buni hisoblash imkoniga ega bo'lishmagan.

en: The Projectile, impelled and maintained by forces inexplicable and even incomprehensible, had come within less than thirty miles from the Moon's north pole.
uz: O'z kuchini tushuntirib bo'lmaydigan va hatto tushunarli bo'lmagan kuchlar tomonidan harakatlanayotgan va saqlanayotgan raketa o'n kilometrdan kam bo'lgan masofada O'shaning shimoliy qutbidan kelgan edi.

en: But during those two hours of immersion in the dark shadow, had this distance been increased or diminished?
uz: Ammo o'sha ikki soatlik qorong'i soyasida bo'lgan vaqt davomida bu masofani ko'paytirganmi yoki kamaytirganmi?

en: There was evidently no stand-point whereby to estimate either the Projectile's direction or its velocity.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, Projectilning yo'nalishini yoki tezligini baholash uchun nuqtai nazar yo'q edi.

en: Perhaps, moving rapidly away from the Moon, it would be soon out of her shadow altogether.
uz: Ehtimol, oy tezda o'zidan uzoqlashib ketayotgan bo'lsa, u tez orada o'z soyasidan butunlay chiqib ketadi.

en: Perhaps, on the contrary, gradually approaching her surface, it might come into contact at any moment with some sharp invisible peak of the Lunar mountains—a catastrophe sure to put a sudden end to the trip, and the travellers too.
uz: Ehtimol, aksincha, uning yuziga asta-sekin yaqinlashganda, u har qanday vaqtda oy tog'larining ko'rinmas, keskin cho'qqisi bilan uchrashishi mumkin - bu safarni va sayohatchilarni o'z navbatida to'xtatadigan halokatdir.

en: An excited discussion on this subject soon sprang up, in which all naturally took part.
uz: Tez orada bu mavzuga oid hayajonli suhbat boshlandi, unda hammaning o'zi ishtirok etdi.

en: Ardan's imagination as usual getting the better of his reason, he maintained very warmly that the Projectile, caught and retained by the Moon's attraction, could not help falling on her surface, just as an aerolite cannot help falling on our Earth.
uz: Ardanning tasavvurlari odatdagidek aql-idrokidan ustun bo'lib, u oyning jozibadorligi tufayli ushlab qolingan va ushlab turilgan "Projektil" uning yuziga tushib ketishdan bosh tortmasligi mumkinligini juda samimiylik bilan ta'kidlagan, xuddi aerolita Yerga tushib ketishdan bosh tortmaganidek.

en: "Softly, dear boy, softly," replied Barbican; "aerolites can help falling on the Earth, and the proof is, that few of them do fall—most of them don't.
uz: - Yaxshi, aziz o'g'lim, yaxshi, - deb javob berdi Barbican; - aerolitslar yerga tushishga yordam berishlari mumkin va buning isboti shundaki, ulardan bir nechtasi tushadi, aksariyatlari tushmaydi.

en: Therefore, even granting that we had already assumed the nature of an aerolite, it does not necessarily follow that we should fall on the Moon." "But," objected Ardan, "if we approach only near enough, I don't see how we can help—" "You don't see, it may be," said Barbican, "but you can see, if you only reflect a moment.
uz: Shuning uchun, biz allaqachon aerolitning xususiyatini qabul qilgan bo'lsak-da, biz o'zimizni oyga tushirishimiz kerakligini anglatmaydi", - deb aytdi Ardan. "Agar biz faqat etarlicha yaqinlashsak, qanday yordam berishni ko'rmayapman", dedi Barbican. "Siz ko'rmaysiz, ehtimol shunday bo'ladi, lekin bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'rsangiz, ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: Have you not often seen the November meteors, for instance, streaking the skies, thousands at a time?" "Yes; on several occasions I was so fortunate." "Well, did you ever see any of them strike the Earth's surface?" asked Barbican.
uz: Masalan, noyabr oyidagi meteorlarni ko'pincha ko'rmaganmisizmi, ular bir vaqtning o'zida minglab ko'klarni ko'tarib turadi?" - "Ha, bir necha marta men juda omadli bo'ldim". - "Hmm, ulardan hech birini Yer yuziga urganini ko'rganmisiz?" - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: "I can't say I ever did," was the candid reply, "but—" "Well, these shooting stars," continued Barbican, "or rather these wandering particles of matter, shine only from being inflamed by the friction of the atmosphere.
uz: "Men hech qachon shunday qilganimni aytolmayman", deb javob berdi u, "lekin" - deb davom etdi Barbican. - "Bu o'tadigan yulduzlar yoki, aniqrog'i, bu aylanuvchi modda zarbalari faqat atmosfera aralashuvidan ildiz otadi.

en: Therefore they can never be at a greater distance from the Earth than ൤ൡ or ൥ൡ miles at furthest, and yet they seldom fall on it.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular hech qachon Yerdan eng uzoqlikda  yoki  mildan ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin emas, ammo ular kamdan-kam unga tushib ketishadi.

en: So with our Projectile.
uz: Shunday qilib, bizning Projectile bilan.

en: It may go very close to the Moon without falling into it." "But our roving Projectile must pull up somewhere in the long run," replied Ardan, "and I should like to know where that somewhere can be, if not in the Moon." "Softly again, dear boy," said Barbican; "how do you know that our Projectile must pull up somewhere?" "It's self-evident," replied Ardan; "it can't keep moving for ever." "Whether it can or it can't depends altogether on which one of two mathematical curves it has followed in describing its course.
uz: "Ammo o'zboshimchalik bilan oyga yaqinlashib, unga tushib qolmasligi mumkin". - deb javob berdi Ardan, - "Ammo bizning yo'lovchi proyektilimiz uzoq vaqt davomida qayerda bo'lishi kerak va men buni qayerda bo'lishi mumkinligini bilmoqchiman, agar oyda bo'lmasa. - Yana bir bor yumshoq, aziz o'g'lim, - dedi Barbican; - qanday qilib bilasan, bizning proyektilimiz qayerda bo'lishi kerakligini?" - dedi Ardan, - bu o'z-o'zidan aniq; - u doimiy ravishda harakatlanishda davom eta olmaydi.

en: According to the velocity with which it was endowed at a certain moment, it must follow either the one or the other; but this velocity I do not consider myself just now able to calculate."
uz: Ma'lum bir paytda u qanday tezlikda paydo bo'lganidan qat'iy nazar, u bir yoki boshqa tezlikni kuzatishi kerak; lekin men o'zimni bu tezlikni hozirda hisoblab chiqishga qodir emasman".

en: "Exactly so," chimed in M'Nicholl; "it must describe and keep on describing either a parabola or a hyperbola." "Precisely," said Barbican; "at a certain velocity it would take a parabolic curve; with a velocity considerably greater it should describe a hyperbolic curve." "I always did like nice corpulent words," said Ardan, trying to laugh; "bloated and unwieldy, they express in a neat handy way exactly what you mean.
uz: "Haqiqatan ham shunday", - dedi M'Nicholl; "u yoki parabola yoki hiperbolani tasvirlashi kerak va davom ettirish kerak." "To'g'ri, - dedi Barbican; "ma'lum bir tezlikda u parabolik egri chiziqni oladi; sezilarli darajada yuqori tezlikda u hiperbolik egri chiziqni tasvirlashi kerak. " "Men har doim yaxshi va jasoratli so'zlarni yoqtirardim", dedi Ardan, kulishga harakat qilib; "ko'ngil va o'z-o'zidan qo'pol, ular siz nimani nazarda tutganingizni yaxshi va qulay tarzda ifodalaydi.

en: Of course, I know all about the high—high— those high curves, and those low curves.
uz: Albatta, men o'sha yuqori va past bo'g'inlar to'g'risida hamma narsani bilaman.

en: Explain them to me all the same.
uz: Menga hammasini bir xil tushuntiring.

en: Consider me most deplorably ignorant on the nature of these curves." "Well," said the Captain, a little bumptiously, "a parabola is a curve of the second order, formed by the intersection of a cone by a plane parallel to one of its sides." "You don't say so!" cried Ardan, with mouth agape.
uz: Meni bu egriliklarning xususiyatiga nisbatan juda bexabar deb hisoblang". - dedi kapitan biroz g'alati, - parabola - bu ikkinchi darajali egrilik bo'lib, koni o'rtasida yonma-yon bo'lib o'tishi natijasida shakllanadi. - Siz buni aytmaysiz! - dedi Ardan og'zini agape bilan.

en: "Do tell!" "It is pretty nearly the path taken by a shell shot from a mortar." "Well now!" observed Ardan, apparently much surprised; "who'd have thought it?
uz: - Ayting-chi! - dedi Ardan, ko'rinib turganidek, juda hayron bo'lib: - Buni kim o'ylagan bo'lsa kerak?

en: Now for the high—high—bully old curve!" "The hyperbola," continued the Captain, not minding Ardan's antics, "the hyperbola is a curve of the second order, formed from the intersection of a cone by a plane parallel to its axis, or rather parallel to its two generatrices, constituting two separate branches, extending indefinitely in both directions." "Oh, what an accomplished scientist I'm going to turn out, if only left long enough at your feet, illustrious maestro!" cried Ardan, with effusion.
uz: "Hyperbola, - dedi kapitan Ardanning g'alati so'zlariga e'tibor bermay, - "hyperbola ikkinchi darajali bo'g'ildirak bo'lib, koni o'ziga teng bo'lgan, yoki ikki generatorining teng bo'lgan rejasi bo'yicha bo'lib o'tadi va ikki bo'g'ini tashkil etadi, ular har ikki yo'nalishda cheksiz davom etadi". - "Oh, men qanday ham muvaffaqiyatli olim bo'laman, agar sizning oyoqlaringizda yetarlicha uzoq qoldirsam, ulug'vor maestro!" - deb baqirdi Ardan.

en: "Only figure it to yourselves, boys; before the Captain's lucid explanations, I fully expected to hear something about the high curves and the low curves in the back of an Ancient Thomas!
uz: "O'zingiz o'ylab ko'ringlar, yigitlar; kapitanning aniq tushuntirishlaridan oldin, men qadimgi Tomasning orqasidagi yuqori va past bo'g'inlar haqida eshitishni kutgan edim!

en: Oh, Michael, Michael, why didn't you know the Captain earlier?" But the Captain was now too deeply interested in a hot discussion with Barbican to notice that the Frenchman was only funning him.
uz: Oh, Maykl, Maykl, nega siz kapitanni ilgari bilmagan edingiz?" - deb so'rashdi, lekin kapitan endi Barbican bilan qizg'in suhbatga juda qiziqib, fransuzning uni faqat o'yin-kulg'iga solganiga e'tibor bermadi.

en: Which of the two curves had been the one most probably taken by the Projectile?
uz: Ikkala egrilikning qaysi biri Projectile tomonidan eng ko'pincha o'tkazilgan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Barbican maintained it was the parabolic; M'Nicholl insisted that it was the hyperbolic.
uz: Barbican bu parabolik deb aytdi, M'Nicholl esa bu hiperbolik deb aytdi.

en: Their tempers were not improved by the severe cold, and both became rather excited in the dispute.
uz: Ular qattiq sovuqdan ko'ngillari yaxshilanib qolmadi va ikkovi ham bahsda juda hayajonlanishdi.

en: They drew so many lines on the table, and crossed them so often with others, that nothing was left at last but a great blot.
uz: Ular stol ustida shunchalik ko'p chiziqlarni chizdilar va ularni boshqalar bilan shunchalik tez-tez kesib o'tdilarki, nihoyat, katta bir burchakdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi.

en: covered bits of paper with x's and y's, which they read out like so many classic passages, shouting them, declaiming them, drawing attention to the strong points by gesticulation so forcible and voice so loud that neither of the disputants could hear a word that the other said.
uz: X va y belgilari bilan qoplangan qog'oz qismlarini o'qib chiqishlari juda ko'p klassik oyatlar kabi, ularni baqirib, o'zlariga e'tirof etishlari, kuchli nuqtalarga e'tiborni jalb qilishlari kerak bo'lgan harakatlar va ovozlar shunchalik baland bo'lganki, bahsda ishtirok etuvchilarning hech biri o'z so'zini eshitolmadi.

en: Possibly the very great difference in temperature between the external air in contact with their skin and the blood coursing through their veins, had given rise to magnetic currents as potential in their effects as a superabundant supply of oxygen.
uz: Ehtimol, ularning terisi bilan ta'sirda bo'lgan tashqi havo va damarlari orqali oqib kelayotgan qon o'rtasidagi juda katta harorat farqi magnit quvurlarini og'ir kislorod ta'minoti sifatida ta'sir qilishlari mumkin bo'lganligi sababli paydo bo'lgan.

en: At all events, the language they soon began to employ in the enforcement of their arguments fairly made the Frenchman's hair stand on end.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, tez orada ular o'z dalillarini qo'llab-quvvatlashga qo'llaniladigan til fransuzning sochlarini o'ziga xos qilib qo'ydi.

en: "You probably forget the important difference between a directrix and an axis," hotly observed Barbican.
uz: "Siz, ehtimol, direktoriya va o'sha o'rtasidagi muhim farqni unutasiz", - dedi Barbican.

en: "I know what an abscissa is, any how!" cried the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Men absitsaning nima ekanligini bilaman, qanday bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "Can you say as much?" "Did you ever understand what is meant by a double ordinate?" asked Barbican, trying to keep cool.
uz: "Siz ham shunday ko'p gapirishingiz mumkinmi?" - deb so'radi Barbican.

en: "More than you ever did about a transverse and a conjugate!" replied the Captain, with much asperity.
uz: Kapten: "Sizdan ko'ra ko'proq transversal va konjugat haqida!" - deb javob berdi.

en: "Any one not convinced at a glance that this eccentricity is equal to unity, must be blind as a bat!" exclaimed Barbican, fast losing his ordinary urbanity.
uz: "Bu g'ayrat birlikga teng ekanligiga bir qarashda amin bo'lmaganlar, urbaqcha kabi ko'r bo'lishlari kerak!" - deb hayqirdi Barbican, odatdagidek shaharchilikni tezda yo'qotdi.

en: "Less than unity, you mean!
uz: "Birligdan kam, deysan!

en: If you want spectacles, here are mine!" shouted the Captain, angrily tearing them off and offering them to his adversary.
uz: Agar ko'zoynaklar kerak bo'lsa, bu mening o'zimniki!" - deb baqirib yubordi kapitan, ularni g'azab bilan yirtib olib, dushmaniga taklif qildi.

en: "Dear boys!" interposed Ardan— —"The eccentricity is equal to unity!" cried Barbican.
uz: "Dor yigitlar!" - dedi Ardan"Eksentriklik birlikga teng!" - deb baqirdi Barbican.

en: —"The eccentricity is less than unity!" screamed M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Eksentriklik birligidan kamroq!" - deb baqirib yubordi.

en: "Talking of eccentricity—" put in Ardan.
uz: Ardanda qo'yilgan "Xoʻrsiz gapirish" soʻzi.

en: —"Therefore it's a parabola, and must be!" cried Barbican, triumphantly.
uz: "Shuning uchun bu masal va bo'lishi kerak!" - deb baqirib yubordi Barbican.

en: —"Therefore it's hyperbola and nothing shorter!" was the Captain's quite as confident reply.
uz: Kaptenning o'ziga ishongan javobida: "Shuning uchun bu hiperbola va undan qisqacha hech narsa emas!" degan edi.

en: "For gracious sake!—" resumed Ardan.
uz: Ardan davom etib: "Xayrli ish uchun!" dedi.

en: "Then produce your asymptote!" exclaimed Barbican, with an angry sneer.
uz: "O'shanda asymptotiingizni ishlab chiqaring!" - dedi Barbican g'azablangan g'azab bilan.

en: "Let us see the symmetrical point!" roared the Captain, quite savagely.
uz: "Simetrik nuqtani ko'raylik!" - deb qichqirdi kapitan, juda yovvoyilik bilan.

en: old fellows!—" cried Ardan, as loud as his lungs would let him.
uz: Qariyalar!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, o'z samollari unga imkon qadar baland ovoz bilan.

en: "It's useless to argue with a Mississippi steamboat Captain," ejaculated Barbican; "he never gives in till he blows up!" "Never try to convince a Yankee schoolmaster," replied M'Nicholl; "he has one book by heart and don't believe in any other!" "Here, friend Michael, get me a cord, won't you?
uz: "Missisipi bug' kemasi kapitanidan bahslashish befoyda", - dedi Barbican; "o'zi portlab ketmaguncha hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi!" - dedi M'Nicholl. "Yank maktab o'qituvchisini hech qachon ishontirishga urinmang, - dedi M'Nicholl. - U bir kitobni yoddan o'zi biladi va boshqa hech bir kitobga ishonmaydi!" - deb javob berdi M'Nichol.

en: It's the only way to convince him!" cried Barbican, hastily turning to the Frenchman.
uz: Bu uni ishontirishning yagona usuli!" - deb baqirdi Barbican, shoshilinch ravishda fransuz odamga murojaat qildi.

en: "Hand me over that ruler, Ardan!" yelled the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "O'sha qo'riqchini menga qo'llagin, Ardan!" - deb baqirdi.

en: It's the only way now left to bring him to reason!" "Look here, Barbican and M'Nicholl!" cried Ardan, at last making himself heard, and keeping a tight hold both on the cord and the ruler.
uz: Endi uni aqlga keltirishning yagona usuli shuki!" - dedi Ardan, so'ng o'zini eshitib, qo'lga ham, qo'lga ham qattiq ushlab turdi.

en: "This thing has gone far enough!
uz: "Bu narsa yetarlicha uzoqga bordi!

en: Stop your talk, and answer me a few questions.
uz: So'zlaringizni to'xtatib, bir necha savollarga javob bering.

en: What do you want of this cord, Barbican?" "To describe a parabolic curve!" "And what are you going to do with the ruler, M'Nicholl!" "To help draw a true hyperbola!" "Promise me, Barbican, that you're not going to lasso the Captain!" "Lasso the Captain!
uz: "Ustiga-boshda parabolik egri chiziqni tasvirlash uchun", "Va siz qo'riqchi bilan nima qilasiz, M'Nicholl!" "Haqiqiy hiperbola chizishga yordam berish uchun!" "Menga va'da bering, Barbican, siz kapitanni lasso qilmaysiz!" "Lasso kapitan!

en: ha!" "You promise, M'Nicholl, that you're not going to brain the President!" "I brain the President!
uz: "Ha!" "Sen prezidentni o'ylamaslikka va'da berasan, M'Nicholl!" "Men prezidentni o'ylayman!

en: ho!" "I want merely to convince him that it is a parabola!" "I only want to make it clear as day that it is hyperbola!" "Does it make any real difference whether it is one or the other?" yelled Ardan.
uz: "Men uni shunchaki bu masal ekanligiga ishontirishni xohlayman!" - dedi Ardan. "Bu juda ko'p bo'lgan ma'lumotni aniq ko'rsatmoqchiman", - dedi Ardan.

en: "The greatest possible difference—in the Eye of Science." "A radical and incontrovertible difference—in the Eye of Science!" "Oh!
uz: "Ilmning ko'zidagi eng katta iloji bo'lgan farq". "Ilmning ko'zidagi radikal va tanqissiz farq!" "Oh!

en: Hang the Eye of Science—will either curve take us to the Moon?" "No!" "Will either take us back to the Earth?" "No!" "Will either take us anywhere that you know of?" "No!" "Why not?"
uz: Ilmning ko'zi o'g'irlab qo'yilgan bo'lsa, bu bizni oyga olib boradimi? - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Yo'q! - Nega yo'q!

en: "Because they are both open curves, and therefore can never end!" "Is it of the slightest possible importance which of the two curves controls the Projectile?" "Not the slightest—except in the Eye of Science!" "Then let the Eye of Science and her parabolas and hyperbolas, and conjugates, and asymptotes, and the rest of the confounded nonsensical farrago, all go to pot!
uz: "Hammalari ochiq egriliqlar bo'lgani uchun hech qachon tugashi mumkin emas!" - deb so'rashdi. - Ikki egrilikning qaysi biri Projectilni boshqarishi mumkin bo'lgan eng kichik ahamiyatga egami? - "Olamning ko'zidan tashqari hech narsa emas!" - deb so'rashdi. - So'ngra ilmning ko'zi va uning parabolalari va hiperbolalari, konjugatlari, asimptotlari va qolgan g'alati behuda farragosining barchasini to'g'ri yo'lga qo'yishsin!

en: What's the use of bothering your heads about them here!
uz: Bu yerda ular haqida o'ylashingizning foydasi nimada!

en: Have you not enough to trouble you otherwise?
uz: Sizni boshqa holatda bezovta qilish uchun yetarlicha ko'p narsa yo'qmi?

en: A nice pair of scientists you are?
uz: Sizlar yaxshi olimlar juftligingizmi?

en: 'Stanislow' scientists, probably.
uz: "Stanislow" olimlari, ehtimol.

en: Do real scientists lose their tempers for a trifle?
uz: Haqiqiy olimlar kichkina narsa uchun g'azablanib ketadimi?

en: Am I ever to see my ideal of a true scientific man in the flesh?
uz: Haqiqiy olimning o'z idealimni jismonan ko'rishim mumkinmi?

en: Barbican came very near realizing my idea perfectly; but I see that Science just has as little effect as Culture in driving the Old Adam out of us!
uz: Barbican mening g'oyamni mukammal darajada amalga oshirishga juda yaqin keldi; lekin men shuni ko'ryapmanki, eski Odamni bizdan haydab chiqarishda Fan madaniyat kabi kam ta'sir ko'rsatadi!

en: The idea of the only simpleton in the lot having to lecture the others on propriety of deportment!
uz: Toʻplamdagi yagona begona odamning boshqalarga deportmentning munosibligi toʻgʻrisida dars berish kerakligi haqidagi gʻoya!

en: I thought they were going to tear each other's eyes out!
uz: O'zim ularning bir-birlarining ko'zlarini chiqarib yuborishlarini his qilardim!

en: Give me that cord, Michael!
uz: Menga u ipni bering, Maykl!

en: Hand me the heavy ruler, Ardan!
uz: Menga og'ir hukmdorni uzat, Ardan!

en: It's the only way to bring him to reason!
uz: Bu uni aqlga keltirishning yagona usuli!

en: I shall never get over it!" and he laughed till his sides ached and his cheeks streamed.
uz: Men hech qachon buni yenga olmayman!" - dedi va qo'shiqlarini ko'tarib, yonlarida og'riq paydo bo'ldi.

en: His laughter was so contagious, and his merriment so genuine, that there was really no resisting it, and the next few minutes witnessed nothing but laughing, and handshaking and rib-punching in the Projectile—though Heaven knows there was very little for the poor fellows to be merry about.
uz: Uning kulishi shunchalik yuqumli edi va uning shodligi shunchalik samimiy ediki, unga qarshi turish mumkin emas edi va keyingi bir necha daqiqada faqat kulish, qo'l-qo'shish va qo'l urish va qo'l-qo'l urishdan boshqa hech narsa ko'rinmadi.

en: As they could neither reach the Moon nor return to the Earth, what was to befall them?
uz: Ayga yetib borolmagani va Yerga qaytib borolmagani uchun ularga nima bo'lishi kerak edi?

en: The immediate outlook was the very reverse of exhilarating.
uz: O'sha zahotiyoq ko'rinish hayajonlantiruvchi bo'lganning aksariyati edi.

en: If they did not die of hunger, if they did not die of thirst, the reason would simply be that, in a few days, as soon as their gas was exhausted, they would die for want of air, unless indeed the icy cold had killed them beforehand!
uz: Agar ular ochlikdan, chanqlikdan o'lishmasa, sababi shunchaki bir necha kun ichida, gaz to'liq bo'lganida, ular havo yetishmasligi uchun o'lishadi, agar muzli sovuq ularni o'ldirmagan bo'lmasa!

en: By this time, in fact, the temperature had become so exceedingly cold that a further encroachment on their little stock of gas could be put off no longer.
uz: Aslida, o'sha paytda harorat shunchalik sovuq bo'lganki, ularning gaz ehtiyojiga qo'shimcha tajovuz qilish vaqtini kechiktirolmadi.

en: The light, of course, they could manage to do without; but a little heat was absolutely necessary to prevent them from freezing to death.
uz: Tabiiyki, ular yorug'likdan xalos bo'lishlari mumkin edi; lekin ularni muzlatib o'lishlariga to'sqinlik qilish uchun bir oz issiqlik mutlaqo zarur edi.

en: Fortunately, however, the caloric developed by the Reiset and Regnault process for purifying the air, raised the
uz: Yaxshiyamki, havoni tozalash uchun Reiset va Regnault jarayonlari tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan kaloriya miqdori havo narxini oshirdi.

en: internal temperature of the Projectile a little, so that, with an expenditure of gas much less than they had expected, our travellers were able to maintain it at a degree capable of sustaining human life.
uz: Projektilning ichki harorati biroz ozgina bo'ldi, shuning uchun sayohatchilarimiz o'ylagandan ko'ra kamroq gaz sarflash bilan uni inson hayotini saqlab qolishga qodir darajada saqlay olishdi.

en: By this time, also, all observations through the windows had become exceedingly difficult.
uz: Shu paytgacha barcha oynalar orqali kuzatish juda qiyin bo'lgan.

en: The internal moisture condensed so thick and congealed so hard on the glass that nothing short of continued friction could keep up its transparency.
uz: Ichki namlik shu qadar qalloqli bo'lib, shisha ustiga shunchalik qattiq tugaydiki, uning shaffofligini davomli chiziqdan tashqari hech narsa saqlab qololmadi.

en: But this friction, however laborious they might regard it at other times, they thought very little of just now, when observation had become far more interesting and important than ever.
uz: Ammo bu chiziqlar, boshqa paytlarda qanchalik zahmatli bo'lmasin, ular kuzatish har qachongidan ham qiziqarli va muhimroq bo'lganida, hozircha bu haqda juda kam o'ylashgan.

en: If the Moon had any atmosphere, our travellers were near enough now to strike any meteor that might be rushing through it.
uz: Agar oyda atmosfera bo'lsa, sayohatchilarimiz endi u orqali o'tib ketayotgan meteoritlarga urish uchun yetarlicha yaqin bo'lishgan.

en: If the Projectile itself were floating in it, as was possible, would not such a good conductor of sound convey to their ears the reflexion of some lunar echo, the roar of some storm raging among the mountains, the rattling of some plunging avalanche, or the detonations of some eructating volcano?
uz: Agar raketa o'z ichiga o'tirsa, ehtimol, bunday yaxshi tovush conductorlari ularning quloqlariga oy egasi o'z aksini, tog'lar o'rtasida g'azablanayotgan bo'ronning shovqinini, qulab tushayotgan lavinganing shovqinini yoki erektatsiya qiluvchi vulqonning portlashlarini yetkazmaydilarmi?

en: And suppose some lunar Etna or Vesuvius was flashing out its fires, was it not even possible that their eye could catch a glimpse of the lurid gleam?
uz: Va ayning Etna yoki Vesuviy o'tlarini o'chirib yuborganini tasavvur qiling, ularning ko'zlari bu yorug' parvarishning chiroqini ko'rishlari mumkin emasmidi?

en: One or two facts of this kind, well attested, would singularly elucidate the vexatious question of a lunar atmosphere, which is still so far from being decided.
uz: Bunday bir yoki ikki fakt, yaxshi tasdiqlangan bo'lsa-da, hali hal qilinmagan oy atmosferasi haqidagi g'alati savolni alohida tushuntiradi.

en: Full of such thoughts and intensely interested in them, Barbican, M'Nicholl and Ardan, patient as astronomers at a transit of Venus, watched steadily at their windows, and allowed nothing worth noticing to escape their searching gaze.
uz: Bunday fikrlar bilan to'lib-toshgan va ularga qattiq qiziqish ko'rsatgan Barbican, M'Nicholl va Ardan, Venura tranzitida astronomlar sifatida sabr-toqatli bo'lib, o'z derazalaridan doimiy ravishda kuzatib turishgan va diqqatga sazovor bo'lgan hech narsa ularning izlanish ko'zlaridan qochib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymagan.

en: Ardan's patience first gave out.
uz: Ardanning sabr-toqatidan oldin o'zimni tashlab ketdim.

en: He showed it by an observation natural enough, for that matter, to a mind unaccustomed to long stretches of careful thought: "This darkness is absolutely killing!
uz: U buni tabiiy ravishda kuzatish orqali ko'rsatdi: "Bu qorong'ilik mutlaqo o'ldiradi!

en: If we ever take this trip again, it must be about the time of the New Moon!" "There I agree with you, Ardan," observed the Captain.
