uz: Agar biz bu safarda yana bir bor bo'lsak, bu yangi oy vaqti bo'lishi kerak!" - deb aytdi kapitan.

en: "That would be just the time to start.
uz: "O'sha paytda boshlashning ayni vaqti bo'ladi.

en: The Moon herself, I grant, would be lost in the solar rays and therefore invisible all the time of our trip, but in compensation, we should have the Full Earth in full view.
uz: Ayning o'zi quyosh nurlarida yo'qolishi va shuning uchun sayohatimiz davomida ko'rinmas bo'lishi mumkin, deb tan olaman, ammo buning o'rniga biz to'liq Yerni to'liq ko'rishimiz kerak.

en: Besides —and this is your chief point, no doubt, Ardan—if we should happen to be drawn round the Moon, just as we are at the present moment,
uz: Bundan tashqari, bu sizning asosiy fikringizdir, hech shubhasiz, Ardan, agar hozirgi paytda bo'lganimizdek, biz o'zimizni oy atrofida ko'rsatsak,

en: we should enjoy the inestimable advantage of beholding her invisible side magnificently illuminated!" "My idea exactly, Captain," said Ardan.
uz: Biz uning ko'rinmas tomonini ajoyib tarzda yoritilgan holda ko'rishning beqiyos afzalligidan bahramand bo'lishimiz kerak!" - Aynan mening fikrim, kapitan, - dedi Ardan.

en: "What is your opinion on this point, Barbican?" "My opinion is as follows:" answered Barbican, gravely.
uz: "Bu masalada sizning fikringiz qanday, Barbican?" - deb javob berdi Barbican, jiddiy.

en: "If we ever repeat this journey, we shall start precisely at the same time and under precisely the same circumstances.
uz: "Agar biz bu sayohatni takrorlasak, aynan shu vaqtda va aynan shu sharoitlarda boshlaymiz.

en: You forget that our only object is to reach the Moon.
uz: Bizning yagona maqsadimiz - oyga yetib borish ekanini unutasiz.

en: Now suppose we had really landed there, as we expected to do yesterday, would it not have been much more agreeable to behold the lunar continents enjoying the full light of day than to find them plunged in the dismal obscurity of night?
uz: Endi, agar biz o'sha yerga tushgan bo'lsak, kecha biz buni kutganimizdek, oy qit'alariga to'liq kunduz yorug'ligida ko'rinishni ko'proq yoqimli qilib ko'rmagan bo'larmidik?

en: Would not our first installation of discovery have been under circumstances decidedly extremely favorable?
uz: Bizning birinchi kashfiyot o'rnatish sharoitida juda qulay bo'lmagan bo'lmasmidi?

en: Your silence shows that you agree with me.
uz: Sizning sukut saqlashingiz mening fikrimga qo'shilayotganingizni ko'rsatadi.

en: As to the invisible side, once landed, we should have the power to visit it when we pleased, and therefore we could always choose whatever time would best suit our purpose.
uz: Ko'rinmas tomonga kelsak, biz uni xohlaganimizda ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishimiz kerak va shuning uchun biz har doim maqsadimizga mos keladigan vaqtni tanlashimiz mumkin.

en: Therefore, if we wanted to land in the Moon, the period of the Full Moon was the best period to select.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar biz oyga tushishni istasak, to'liq oy davrini tanlash eng yaxshi davr edi.

en: The period was well chosen, the time was well calculated, the force was well applied, the Projectile was well aimed, but missing our way spoiled everything." "That's sound logic, no doubt," said Ardan; "still I can't help thinking that all for want of a little light we are losing, probably forever, a splendid opportunity of seeing the Moon's invisible side.
uz: Vaqti yaxshi tanlangan, vaqt yaxshi hisoblangan, kuch yaxshi qo'llanilib, proyektil yaxshi maqsadga qo'yilgan edi, ammo yo'limizni yo'qotish hamma narsani buzdi". - dedi Ardan; - "Bu, shubhasiz, mantiqiy fikr", - dedi Ardan; "haqiqatan ham, bir oz yorug'lik yetishmasligi tufayli biz oyning ko'rinmas tomonini ko'rishning ajoyib imkoniyatini, ehtimol abadiy yo'qotyapmiz, deb o'ylashdan bosh tortmayapman.

en: How about the other planets, Barbican?
uz: Boshqa sayyoralar haqida nima deyish mumkin, Barbican?

en: Do you think that their inhabitants are as ignorant regarding their satellites as we are regarding ours?" "On that subject," observed M'Nicholl, "I could venture an answer myself, though, of course, without pretending to speak dogmatically on any such open question.
uz: Sizningcha, ularning aholisi o'z satelitlari haqida biz kabi jaholatli deb o'ylaysizmi?" - dedi M'Nicholl. - Bu mavzuda men o'zim javob berishga jur'at qilardim, ammo, albatta, bunday ochiq savolga dogmatik ravishda gapirmoqchi bo'lganimdek ko'rinmayapman.

en: The satellites of the other planets, by their comparative proximity, must be much easier to study than our Moon.
uz: Boshqa sayyoralarning satelitlari o'zlarining nisbatan yaqinligi tufayli oyimizdan ko'ra ko'proq o'rganish osonroq bo'lishi kerak.

en: The Saturnians, the Uranians, the Jovians, cannot have had very serious difficulty in effecting some communication with their satellites.
uz: Saturn, Uran, Jovianlar o'z satelitlari bilan muloqot qilishda jiddiy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishlari mumkin emas.

en: Jupiter's four moons, for instance, though on an average actually ൣ-ൢ/ൣ times farther from their planet's centre than the Moon is from us, are comparatively four times nearer to him on account of his radius being eleven times greater than the Earth's.
uz: Misol uchun, Jupiterning to'rtta oylari, agar ular o'rtacha o'rtacha o'z sayyorasining markazidan Ay bizdan uzoqroq bo'lsa-da, uning radiusi Yer radiusidan o'n bir baravar katta bo'lgani uchun unga nisbatan to'rt baravar yaqinroq.

en: With Saturn's eight moons, the case is almost precisely similar.
uz: Saturnning sakkiz oyida vaziyat deyarli o'xshash.

en: distance is nearly three times greater than that of our Moon; but as Saturn's diameter is about ൪ times greater than the Earth's, his bodyguards are really between ൤ and ൥ times nearer to their principal than ours is to us.
uz: Ayimizdan deyarli uch baravar katta; ammo Saturnning diametrini Yerdan deyarli  baravar katta qilib ko'rishgani sababli, uning qo'riqchilari aslida o'zlarining asosiy yo'nalishlariga bizning yo'nalishimizga qaraganda  va  baravar yaqinroq bo'lishadi.

en: As to Uranus, his first satellite, Ariel, half as far from him as our Moon is from the Earth, is comparatively, though not actually, eight times nearer." "Therefore," said Barbican, now taking up the subject, "an experiment analogous to ours, starting from either of these three planets, would have encountered fewer difficulties.
uz: Uranning birinchi uydosi Ariel uning yerdan o'z oyimizdan yarim uzoqroq bo'lsa-da, deyarli sakkiz barobar yaqinroq. "Shuning uchun, - dedi Barbican, endi mavzuni muhokama qilib, - bizning sayyoramizga o'xshash tajriba, uchta sayyoradan boshlansa, kamroq qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishi mumkin edi.

en: But the whole question resolves itself into this.
uz: Ammo butun savol o'zini shu bilan yakunlaydi.

en: If the Jovians and the rest have been able to quit their planets, they have probably succeeded in discovering the invisible sides of their satellites.
uz: Agar Jovians va boshqalar o'z sayyoralaridan chiqib ketishga muvaffaq bo'lishsa, ular, ehtimol, o'z uydirmalarining ko'rinmas tomonlarini kashf etishda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishgan.

en: But if they have not been able to do so, why, they're not a bit wiser than ourselves—But what's the matter with the Projectile?
uz: Ammo agar ular buni qila olmagan bo'lsalar, nega, ular bizdan biroz ham aqlli emaslar?

en: It's certainly shifting!" Shifting it certainly was.
uz: Bu, albatta, o'zgarib bormoqda!" - degan edi.

en: While the path it described as it swung blindly through the darkness, could not be laid down by any chart for want of a starting point, Barbican and his companions soon became aware of a decided modification of its relative position with regard to the Moon's surface.
uz: Qorong'ilikda ko'r bo'lib o'tgan yo'lning boshlang'ich nuqtasi yo'qligi sababli hech qanday jadval tomonidan belgilab bo'lmasa-da, Barbican va uning hamkorlari tez orada o'zlarining oy yuziga nisbatan nisbatan o'z o'rnagi qat'iy ravishda o'zgartirilganini bilib olishdi.

en: Instead of its side, as heretofore, it now presented its base to the Moon's disc, and its axis had become rigidly vertical to the lunar horizon.
uz: Oldingi kabi o'z tomonining o'rniga, u endi o'z asosini oy diskini taqdim etdi va uning o'qi o'rnida oy ufqida qattiq vertikal bo'ldi.

en: Of this new feature in their journey, Barbican had assured himself by the most undoubted proof towards four o'clock in the morning.
uz: Ular sayohatidagi ushbu yangi xususiyat haqida Barbican o'zini ertalab soat to'rtga yaqin eng shubhali dalil bilan ishontirgan edi.

en: The heavier portion of the Projectile gravitated towards the Moon's centre exactly as if they were falling towards her surface.
uz: Laylakning og'ir qismi o'z kuchini oy markazida o'tkazganida, xuddi o'sha oyning yuziga tushib ketgandek bo'ldi.

en: But were they falling?
uz: Ammo ular tushib ketayotganmidi?

en: Were they at last, contrary to all expectations, about to reach the goal that they had been so ardently wishing for?
uz: Xo'sh, ular nihoyat, barcha kutilganlarga qaraganda, o'zlari shunchalik orzu qilgan maqsadga erishishga tayyor bo'lishganmi?

en: A sight-point, just discovered by M'Nicholl, very soon convinced Barbican that the Projectile was as far as ever from approaching the Moon, but was moving around it in a curve pretty near concentric.
uz: M'Nicholl tomonidan yaqinda kashf etilgan bir ko'rish nuqtasi tez orada Barbicanni Projektil o'zidan hech qachon Ayga yaqin bo'lmaganligiga ishontirdi, ammo u atrofida juda yaqin konsentrik bo'lgan egrilikda harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: M'Nicholl's discovery, a luminous gleam flickering on the distant verge of the black disc, at once engrossed the complete attention of our travellers and set them to divining its course.
uz: M'Nichollning kashfiyoti, qora diskning uzoq bo'yiga parcha-parcha bo'lgan yorug' yorug'lik, sayohatchilarimizning butun e'tiborini o'ziga jalb qilib, uning yo'l-yo'riqini aniqlashga undadi.

en: It could not possibly be confounded with a star.
uz: U yulduz bilan qarama-qarshi qarama-qarshi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Its glare was reddish, like that of a distant furnace on a dark night; it kept steadily increasing in size and brightness, thus showing beyond a doubt how the Projectile was
uz: Uning yorug'ligi qizil rangli edi, xuddi qorong'i tundagi uzoq pech kabi; u o'lcham va yorug'lik ko'payib borardi va shu yo'sin, o'z ichiga o'tgan o'g'il-qizlarni ko'rsatadi.

en: moving—in the direction of the luminous point, and not vertically falling towards the Moon's surface.
uz: Yorug'lik nuqtasi yo'nalishida harakatlanayotgan va oy yuziga vertikal ravishda tushib ketmagan.

en: "It's a volcano!" cried the Captain, in great excitement; "a volcano in full blast!
uz: "Bu volkan!" - deb hayqirib yubordi kapitan, katta hayajon bilan: "bu volkan to'liq portlashda!

en: An outlet of the Moon's internal fires!
uz: Oyning ichki o'tlaridan chiqindi!

en: Therefore she can't be a burnt out cinder!" "It certainly looks like a volcano," replied Barbican, carefully investigating this new and puzzling phenomenon with his night-glass.
uz: Shuning uchun u yonib ketgan kulga bo'lishi mumkin emas!" - deb javob berdi Barbican, bu yangi va g'alati hodisani kechasi ko'rinishi bilan sinchiklab o'rganayotganda.

en: "If it is not one, in fact, what can it be?" "To maintain combustion," commenced Ardan syllogistically and sententiously, "air is necessary.
uz: "Agar u bitta bo'lmasa, aslida nima bo'lishi mumkin?" - dedi Ardan silogistik va so'z bilan boshlandi. - Yolg'onlikni saqlash uchun havo kerak.

en: An undoubted case of combustion lies before us.
uz: Shubhasiz, yonishning aniq holatini ko'rib chiqamiz.

en: Therefore, this part of the Moon must have an atmosphere!" "Perhaps so," observed Barbican, "but not necessarily so.
uz: Shuning uchun, oyning ushbu qismida atmosfera bo'lishi kerak! - deb ta'kidladi Barbican. - Ehtimol, shunday bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu shart emas.

en: The volcano, by decomposing certain substances, gunpowder for instance, may be able to furnish its own oxygen, and thus explode in a vacuum.
uz: Volkan muayyan moddalarni, masalan, changni parchalab, o'z kislorodini yetkazib berishi va shu bilan birga vakumda portlashi mumkin.

en: That blaze, in fact, seems to me to possess the intensity and the blinding glare of objects burning in pure oxygen.
uz: Darhaqiqat, o'sha olov menga sof kislorodda yonayotgan ob'ektlarning kuchliligi va ko'rgizadigan yorug'ligiga ega bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: Let us therefore be not over hasty in jumping at the conclusion of the existence of a lunar atmosphere." This fire mountain was situated, according to the most plausible conjecture, somewhere in the neighborhood of the ൥൦th degree, south latitude, of the Moon's invisible side.
uz: Shuning uchun, o'zimizni o'zgartirmay, oy atrofining mavjudligi to'g'risida xulosa chiqaraylik". Ushbu olov tog'i eng ishonchli taxminlarga ko'ra, oyning ko'rinmas tomonining janubiy kenglikdagi th darajasi yaqinida joylashgan edi.

en: For a little while the travellers indulged the fond hope that they were directly approaching it, but, to their great disappointment, the path described by the Projectile lay in a different direction.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida sayohatchilar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri unga yaqinlashayotganini umid qilishdi, ammo katta umidsizlikka to'lib-toshganlari uchun, o'sha o'g'il tomonidan tasvirlangan yo'l boshqacha yo'nalishda joylashgan edi.

en: Its nature therefore they had no opportunity of ascertaining.
uz: Shuning uchun uning mohiyatini aniqlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmadilar.

en: It began to disappear behind the dark horizon within less than half an hour after the time that M'Nicholl had signalled it.
uz: M'Nicholl xabar bergan vaqtdan yarim soat o'tgach, u qorong'i horizont orqasida yo'qolishni boshladi.

en: Still, the fact of the uncontested existence of such a phenomenon was a grand one, and of considerable importance in selenographic investigations.
uz: Shunga qaramay, bunday hodisaning tanqid qilinmagan mavjudligi katta va selenografik tadqiqotlarda muhim ahamiyatga ega edi.

en: It proved that heat had not altogether disappeared from the lunar world; and the existence of heat once settled, who can say positively that the vegetable kingdom and even the animal kingdom have not likewise resisted so far every influence tending to destroy them?
uz: Bu issiqlikning oy dunyosidan butunlay yo'qolmaganligini isbotladi; issiqlikning mavjudligi bir marta o'rnatilganidan so'ng, o'simlik va hatto hayvonot dunyosi ham ularni yo'q qilishga moyil bo'lgan har qanday ta'sirga hozirgacha qarshi turmaganini kim shubhasiz aytishi mumkin?

en: If terrestrial astronomers could only be convinced, by undoubted evidence, of the existence of this active volcano on the Moon's surface, they would certainly admit of very
uz: Agar yer yuzidagi astronomlar faqat shubhasiz dalillar orqali o'sha faol vulqonning oy yuzasida mavjudligiga ishontira olsalar, albatta, ular juda ko'p holatda bo'lishlarini tan olishadi.

en: considerable modifications in the present doubts regarding her inhabitability.
uz: Uning yashashga yaroqliligi haqida hozirgi shubhalarda sezilarli o'zgarishlar yuz berdi.

en: Thoughts of this kind continued to occupy the minds of our travellers even for some time after the little spark of light had been extinguished in the black gloom.
uz: Bunday fikrlar sayohatchilarimizning ongini bir muncha vaqt davomida, hatto qora zulmatda yoritilgan kichik chiroq o'chirib ketgandan keyin ham egallab turardi.

en: But they said very little; even Ardan was silent, and continued to look out of the window.
uz: Ammo ular juda kam gapirishdi; hatto Ardan ham sukut saqlab, darchaga qarab turardi.

en: Barbican surrendered himself up to a reverie regarding the mysterious destinies of the lunar world.
uz: Barbican o'zini oy dunyosining sirli taqdirlari to'g'risida o'ziga bag'ishlagan.

en: Was its present condition a foreshadowing of what our Earth is to become?
uz: Uning hozirgi holati bizning Yer sayyoramizning qanday bo'lishini oldindan ko'rsatganmi?

en: M'Nicholl, too, was lost in speculation.
uz: M'Nicholl ham spekulyatsiyalarda yo'qolgan.

en: Was the Moon older or younger than the Earth in the order of Creation?
uz: Yaratuv tartibida oy Yerdan kattaroq yoki yoshroq bo'lganmi?

en: Had she ever been a beautiful world of life, and color, and magnificent variety?
uz: U hayotning, rang-barang va ajoyib turdagi go'zal dunyosi bo'lganmidi?

en: If so, had her inhabitants— Great Mercy, what a cry from Ardan!
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, uning aholisi uchun "Yaxshi marhamat", Ardandanning qayg'usi edi!

en: It sounded human, so seldom do we hear a shriek so expressive at once of surprise and horror and even terror!
uz: Bu inson ovoziga o'xshardi, shuning uchun biz kamdan-kam bir vaqtning o'zida hayronlik va dahshat va hatto dahshatdan shu qadar kuchli qichqiriqni eshitamiz!

en: It brought back his startled companions to their senses in a second.
uz: Bu uning qo'rqinchli hamrohlariga bir soniyada aqlni tikladi.

en: Nor did they ask him for the cause of his alarm.
uz: Shuningdek, ular undan uning ogohlantirishining sababini ham so'ramadi.

en: It was only too clear.
uz: Faqat juda aniq edi.

en: Right in their very path, a blazing ball of fire had suddenly risen up before their eyes, the pitchy darkness all round it rendering its glare still more blinding.
uz: Ular o'z yo'llarida turganida, ularning ko'zlari oldida birdan olov to'plami ko'tarildi, atrofidagi qorong'ilik uni yanada ko'p ko'rishga majbur qildi.

en: Its phosphoric coruscation filled the Projectile with white streams of lurid light, tinging the contents with a pallor indescribably ghastly.
uz: Uning fosforli koruskasi Projectilni oq yorug'lik oqimlari bilan to'ldirdi va uning tarkibini tasvirlab bo'lmaydigan darajada dahshatli bo'lak bilan to'ldirdi.

en: The travellers' faces in particular, gleamed with that peculiar livid and cadaverous tinge, blue and yellow, which magicians so readily produce by burning table salt in alcohol.
uz: Ayniqsa, sayohatchilarning yuzlari o'zgacha qizil va jasadli, ko'k va sariq ranglar bilan chiroqlashardi, bular sehrgarlar o'zlarining iste'dodlari bilan spirtli ichimliklarda dasturxon tuzini yonib chiqargan.

en: "Sacré!" cried Ardan who always spoke his own language when much excited.
uz: "Sakré!" - deb baqirdi Ardan, u juda hayajonlangan paytda har doim o'z tilida gapirgan.

en: "What a pair of beauties you are!
uz: "Sizlar naqadar chiroyli juftsiz!

en: What thundering thing is coming at us now?" "Another bolide," answered Barbican, his eye as calm as ever, though a faint tremor was quite perceptible in his voice.
uz: Hozir bizga nima g'iybat qilyapti?" - deb javob berdi Barbican, uning ko'zi har doimgidek tinch edi, ammo ovozidagi chiroyli titrash juda sezilarli edi.

en: You are joking!" "I was never more in earnest," was the President's quiet reply, as he looked through his closed fingers.
uz: Sen hazil qilyapsan!" - deb prezidentning tinch javobini eshitib, o'z barmoqlarini yopib ko'rdi.

en: He knew exactly what he was saying.
uz: U nima deyayotganini aniq bilardi.

en: The dazzling glitter did not deceive him.
uz: Qizillab turgan shisha uni aldamagan.

en: Such a meteor seen from the Earth could not appear much brighter than the Full Moon, but here in the midst of the black ether and unsoftened by the veil of the atmosphere, it was absolutely blinding.
uz: Yerdan ko'rilgan bunday meteorit to'liq oydan ko'ra ko'proq yorqin ko'rinishi mumkin emas edi, lekin bu yerda qora eterning o'rtasida va atmosfera pardalari tomonidan yumshatilmagan holda, u mutlaqo ko'r bo'lgan.

en: These wandering bodies carry in themselves the principle
uz: Ushbu ko'chma-ko'chma badanlar o'zlarida prinsipni o'z ichiga oladilar.

en: of their incandescence.
uz: Ular o'z ishtiyoqlarini ko'rishadi.

en: Oxygen is by no means necessary for their combustion.
uz: Ular yonishi uchun hech qachon kislorod kerak emas.

en: Some of them indeed often take fire as they rush through the layers of our atmosphere, and generally burn out before they strike the Earth.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari atmosfera qatlamlarini bosib o'tganda tez-tez olovga tushib, asosan Yerga urishdan oldin yonib ketadi.

en: But others, on the contrary, and the greater number too, follow a track through space far more distant from the Earth than the fifty miles supposed to limit our atmosphere.
uz: Ammo boshqalar, aksincha, ko'pchiligi ham, atmosferaimizni cheklaydigan ellik mildan ko'ra Yerdan ancha uzoqroq bo'lgan kosmik yo'lni izlashadi.

en: In October, ൢ൩൥൥, one of these meteors had appeared in the sky at an altitude calculated to be at least ൤ൣൡ miles; and in August, ൢ൩൥ൢ, another had vanished when it had reached the height of ൥൦ൡ miles.
uz: Oktyabr oyida bu meteorlardan biri osmonda kamida  mil balandlikda paydo bo'lgan va avgust oyida yana bir meteor o'z o'rnida  mil balandligiga yetib borganida yo'qolgan.

en: A few even of those seen from the Earth must have been several miles in diameter.
uz: Hatto Yerdan ko'rinadigan bir necha kishilar bir necha kilometr diametrli bo'lishi kerak.

en: The velocity with which some of them have been calculated to move, from east to west, in a direction contrary to that of the Earth, is astounding enough to exceed belief—about fifty miles in a second.
uz: Ularning ba'zilarining sharqdan g'arbga, Yerga qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda harakatlanishlari hisoblangan tezlik juda ajablanarli darajada, chunki ular bir soniyada taxminan ellik milga ketadi.

en: Our Earth does not move quite ൣൡ miles in a second, though it goes a thousand times quicker than the fastest locomotive.
uz: Bizning Yer sayyoramiz sekunda juda oz mil harakatlanmaydi, ammo eng tez harakatlanadigan lokomotivdan ming barobar tezroq harakatlanadi.

en: THEY COULD UTTER NO WORD.
uz: Ular hech qanday so'z aytolmaydilar.

en: Barbican calculated like lightning that the present object of their alarm was only about ൣ൦ൡ miles distant from them, and could not be less than a mile and a quarter in diameter.
uz: Barbican chaqmoq kabi hisob-kitob qildiki, ularning ogohlantirishining hozirgi ob'ekti ulardan faqat taxminan  mil uzoqlikda va deyarli bir mil va to'rtdan kam bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: It was coming on at the rate of more than a mile a second or about ൨൦ miles a minute.
uz: U bir soniyaga bir mil yoki daqiqada taxminan 1 km tezlikda harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: It lay right in the path of the Projectile, and in a very few seconds indeed a terrible collision was inevitable.
uz: U bir necha soniya o'tgach, qorong'ilik yo'lida joylashgan edi va juda ham dahshatli to'qnashishning oldini olish mumkin edi.

en: The enormous rate at which it grew in size, showed the terrible velocity at which it was approaching.
uz: Uning o'sish sur'ati juda tez bo'lganligi uning yaqinlashayotgan dahshatli tezligini ko'rsatdi.

en: You can hardly imagine the situation of our poor travellers at the sight of this frightful apparition.
uz: Bu dahshatli fohishaga ko'z tikgan kambag'al sayohatchilarimizning ahvolini tasavvur qilish qiyin.

en: I shall certainly not attempt to describe it.
uz: Albatta, uni tasvirlashga harakat qilmayman.

en: In spite of their singular courage, wonderful coolness,
uz: Ularning o'zgacha jasorati, ajoyib sovuqligiga qaramay,

en: extraordinary fortitude, they were now breathless, motionless, almost helpless; their muscles were tightened to their utmost tension; their eyes stared out of their sockets; their faces were petrified with horror.
uz: O'zgacha kuch-quvvatga ega bo'lganlar, endi nafassiz, harakatsiz, deyarli yordamsiz edilar; mushaklari o'zlarining kuch-qudratlariga qadar siqilgan edi; ko'zlari o'z sochiqlaridan qaragan edi; yuzlari dahshatga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: Their Projectile, whose course they were powerless as children to guide, was making straight for this fiery mass, whose glare in a few seconds had become more blinding than the open vent of a reverberating furnace.
uz: Bolalar kabi yo'l ko'rsatishga ojiz bo'lgan o'zlarining o'q-quruqlari o'sha olovli to'plamga to'g'ri borayotgan edi, uning yorqinligi bir necha soniya ichida o't qo'zg'aygan pechning ochiq ventilatsiyasiga qaraganda ko'proq ko'r bo'lib ketgan edi.

en: Their own Projectile was carrying them headlong into a bottomless abyss of fire!
uz: Ularning o'z o'qlari ularni tubsiz olov tubosiga olib ketayotgan edi!

en: Still, even in this moment of horror, their presence of mind, or at least their consciousness, never abandoned them.
uz: Biroq, hatto bu dahshatli daqiqalarda ham ularning ongli yoki hech bo'lmaganda ongli mavjudligi ularni hech qachon tashlab ketmadi.

en: Barbican had grasped each of his friends by the hand, and all three tried as well as they could to watch through half-closed eyelids the white-hot asteroid's rapid approach.
uz: Barbican do'stlarining har birini qo'lidan ushlab olgan edi va ularning barchasi yarim yopilgan ko'z qo'llari bilan oq issiq asteroidning tezda yaqinlashishini kuzatishga harakat qilishgan.

en: They could utter no word, they could breathe no prayer.
uz: Ular hech qanday so'z aytolmadilar, hech qanday ibodatni nafas ololmadilar.

en: They gave themselves up for lost—in the agony of terror that partially interrupted the ordinary functions of their brains, this was absolutely all they could do!
uz: Ular o'zlarini terror azobida yo'qotib qo'yishlariga to'sqinlik qilishdi, bu ularning miyasining odatiy funktsiyalarini qisman kesib qo'ydi, bu ularning qilishlari mumkin bo'lgan yagona narsa edi!

en: Hardly three minutes had elapsed since Ardan had caught the first glimpse of it—three ages of agony!
uz: Ardan o'zining uch yillik azob-uqubatini birinchi marta ko'rganidan beri uch daqiqa o'tibdi!

en: In a second—in less than a second, the terrible fireball had burst like a shell!
uz: Bir soniyadan kam vaqt ichida dahshatli yong'in to'plami shell kabi portlab ketdi!

en: Thousands of glittering fragments were flying around them in all directions—but with no more noise than is made by so many light flakes of thistle- down floating about some warm afternoon in summer.
uz: Ularning atrofida har tomonlama minglab parcha-parcha parchalar uchib borardi, lekin yozda bir issiq kechqurun atrofida suzayotgan ko'pgina yumshoq bo'laklardan ko'ra ko'proq shov-shuvsiz edi.

en: The blinding, blasting steely white glare of the explosion almost bereft the travellers of the use of their eyesight forever, but no more report reached their ears than if it had taken place at the bottom of the Gulf of Mexico.
uz: Shov-shuvning ko'rgichli, qirg'oqsiz oq ko'rinishi sayohatchilarni ko'zlarini abadiy ishlatishdan mahrum qildi, ammo ular quloqlariga hech qanday xabar yetmadi, aksincha, u Meksika ko'rgazmasi tubida sodir bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: In an atmosphere like ours, such a crash would have burst the ear-membranes of ten thousand elephants!
uz: Bizning kabi muhitda bunday to'qnashish o'n mingta filning quloq membranasini buzgan bo'lardi!

en: In the middle of the commotion another loud cry was suddenly heard.
uz: To'satdan shov-shuvning o'rtasida yana bir baland qichqiriq eshitildi.

en: It was the Captain who called this time.
uz: Bu safar qo'ng'iroq qilgan kapitan edi.

en: His companions rushed to his window and all looked out together in the same direction.
uz: U bilan birga bo'lganlar uning oyna tomoniga yugurib borishdi va hammalari bir xil yo'nalishda ko'z ochdilar.

en: What a sight met their eyes!
uz: Ularning ko'zlariga qanday ko'rinish tushdi!

en: What pen can describe it?
uz: Uni qanday qalam tasvirlashi mumkin?

en: What pencil can reproduce the magnificence of its coloring?
uz: Qaysi qalam o'zining rang-barangligini ko'paytirishi mumkin?

en: It was a Vesuvius at his best and wildest, at the moment just after the old cone has fallen in.
uz: Bu Vesuviyning eng yaxshi va g'ayritabiiy holatida edi, hozirgi paytda eski kon tushgandan so'ng.

en: Millions of luminous fragments streaked the sky with their blazing fires.
uz: Milyonlab yorug' parchalar osmonni o'zlarining olovli olovlari bilan yoritdi.

en: All sizes and shapes of light, all colors and shades of colors, were inextricably mingled together.
uz: Barcha o'lchamlar va nur shakllari, barcha ranglar va rang rang ranglari bir-biri bilan bo'lgan.

en: gold, scintillations in crimson, splendors in emerald, lucidities in ultramarine—a dazzling girandola of every tint and of every hue.
uz: Qizil qizil rangdagi oltin, zamir rangdagi chiroyli, ultramarin rangdagi yorqinlik, har bir rang va har bir nuqtadagi chiroyli girandola.

en: Of the enormous fireball, an instant ago such an object of dread, nothing now remained but these glittering pieces, shooting about in all directions, each one an asteroid in its turn.
uz: O't o'g'irligi, bir daqiqa oldin bunday dahshatli ob'ekt bo'lgan, endi bu parcha-parcha bo'lib, har xil yo'nalishlarda o'tadi, har biri o'z navbatida asteroid bo'ladi.

en: Some flew out straight and gleaming like a steel sword; others rushed here and there irregularly like chips struck off a red-hot rock; and others left long trails of glittering cosmical dust behind them like the nebulous tail of Donati's comet.
uz: Ba'zilari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va po'latli qilich kabi parcha-parcha chiqib ketishdi; ba'zilari bu yerga-bu yerga to'g'ri-to'g'ri shovqinlar qizil toshga tushib ketgan kabi shovqin qildilar; ba'zilari esa Donati kometasining bulutli quyruq singari orqalarida parcha-bulut bo'lgan kosmik tuproqning uzun izlarini qoldirdilar.

en: These incandescent blocks crossed each other, struck each other, crushed each other into still smaller fragments, one of which, grazing the Projectile, jarred it so violently that the very window at which the travellers were standing, was cracked by the shock.
uz: Ushbu yonib turgan bloklar bir-biriga kesib o'tishdi, bir-birlariga urishdi, bir-birlarini yana kichikroq bo'lak-bo'laklarga aylantirib yubordilar, ulardan biri, o'z ichiga "Projektil"ni o'rab olib, uni shunchalik qattiq urdiki, sayohatchilar turgan oyna hayratda qoldi.

en: Our friends felt, in fact, as if they were the objective point at which endless volleys of blazing shells were aimed, any of them powerful enough, if it only hit them fair, to make as short work of the Projectile as you could of an egg-shell.
uz: Do'stlarimiz, aslida, o'zlarini o'zlarining o'zlariga o'xshatishgan, chunki ular o'zlarining o'zlariga o'xshaydigan shelllarning cheksiz to'plamlari qaratilgan ob'ektiv nuqta edilar, ularning har biri, agar ular adolatli bo'lsa, bir tuxum shell bilan mumkin bo'lganidek, Projectile bilan qisqa ish qilish uchun etarlicha kuchli bo'lgan.

en: They had many hairbreadth escapes, but fortunately the cracking of the glass proved to be the only serious damage of which they could complain.
uz: Ular ko'p sochlar kengligi bo'lgan, ammo baxtga ko'ra, shishalarning parchalanishi ular shikoyat qila oladigan yagona jiddiy zarar bo'lgan.

en: This extraordinary illumination lasted altogether only a few seconds; every one of its details was of a most singular and exciting nature—but one of its greatest wonders was yet to come.
uz: Ushbu ajoyib yorug'lik jami bir necha soniya davom etdi; uning har bir tafsilotlari juda o'ziga xos va hayajonli bo'lgan, ammo eng buyuk mo'jizalaridan biri hali kelmagan edi.

en: The ether, saturated with luminous matter, developed an intensity of blazing brightness unequalled by the lime light, the magnesium light, the electric light, or any other dazzling source of illumination with which we are acquainted on earth.
uz: Yorug'likli modda bilan to'ldirilgan eter, yonayotgan yorug'lik intensivligini rivojlantiradi, bu yorug'lik maydon, magnezium yorug'ligi, elektr yorug'ligi yoki yer yuzida bizga tanish bo'lgan boshqa yorug'lik manbai bilan teng emas.

en: It flashed out of these asteroids in all directions, and downwards, of course, as well as elsewhere.
uz: Bu asteroidlar orasidan barcha yo'nalishlarda, albatta, pastga ham, boshqa joylarda ham parcha-parcha paydo bo'ldi.

en: At one particular instant, it was so very vivid that Ardan, who happened to be looking downwards, cried out, as if in transport: "Oh!!
uz: O'sha paytlarda bu voqea shunchalik jonli bo'lganki, Ardan tushka qarab turgan bo'lib, transportda bo'lgani kabi: "Oh!!!" - deb baqirdi.

en: Visible at last!" And the three companions, thrilling with indescribable emotion, shot a hasty glance through the openings of the coruscating field beneath them.
uz: Oxir-oqibat ko'rinadi!" - deb so'zlab o'tgan edi.Uchta hamkorlari esa so'zlab bo'lmaydigan tuyg'u bilan hayratda bo'lib, ularning ostidan yugurib turgan maydonning ochilishlaridan darrov ko'z ochishdi.

en: Did they really catch a glimpse of the mysterious invisible disc that the eye of man had never before lit upon?
uz: Ular haqiqatan ham inson ko'zi hech qachon yoritmagan sirli ko'rinmas diskni ko'rishganmi?

en: For a second or so they gazed with enraptured fascination at all they could see.
uz: Ular bir soniya yoki undan ko'ra ko'rishlari mumkin bo'lgan narsalarga g'ayrat bilan qarab turishdi.

en: What did they see, what could they see at a distance so uncertain that Barbican has never been able even to guess at it?
uz: Ular nima ko'rishgan, nima ko'rishlari mumkin edi, uzoqlikda Barbican hech qachon hatto tasavvur ham qila olmagan darajada ishonchsiz?

en: Ardan was reminded of the night he had stood on the battlements of Dover Castle, a few years before, when the fitful flashes of a thunder storm gave him occasional and very uncertain glimpses of the French coast at the opposite side of the strait.
uz: Ardan bir necha yil oldin Dovr qalʼasining qoʻrqinchlarida turgan kechasini esladi, u yerda oltin-oʻtin boʻronning shov-shuvlari unga Fransiya qirgʻogʻining oʻzga tomonidagi koʻrinishini vaqti-vaqti bilan va juda noaniq koʻrinishlarga ega boʻlgan.

en: Misty strips long and narrow, extending over one portion of the disc— probably cloud-scuds sustained by a highly rarefied atmosphere— permitted only a very dreamy idea of lofty mountains stretching beneath them in shapeless proportions, of smaller reliefs, circuses, yawning craters, and the other capricious, sponge-like formations so common on the visible side.
uz: Diskning bir qismini bosib o'tgan uzoq va tor bo'laklar, ehtimol, juda kam tarqalgan atmosfera tufayli saqlanib qolgan bulutlar ular ostidan shakllisiz o'lchamlarda uzilgan baland tog'lar, kichikroq reliefflar, sirklar, qirg'oqlar va boshqa ko'rinadigan tomonlarda keng tarqalgan g'alati, ko'krakga o'xshash formaatsiyalar haqida juda hayajonli tasavvurga ega bo'lishlariga imkon berdi.

en: Elsewhere the watchers became aware for an instant of immense spaces, certainly not arid plains, but seas, real oceans, vast and calm, reflecting from their placid depths the dazzling fireworks of the weird and wildly flashing meteors.
uz: Boshqa joylarda kuzatuvchilar bir zum uchun ulkan joylarni, albatta quruq o'tlar emas, balki dengizlarni, haqiqiy okeanlarni, keng va xotirjam bo'lgan, o'zlarining xotirjam chuqurliklaridan g'ayritabiiy va yovvoyi yorqin meteorlarning o'ziga xos o'yin-kulgilarini aks ettirgan katta va katta o'rinlarni ko'rishdi.

en: Farther on, but very darkly as if behind a screen, shadowy continents revealed themselves, their surfaces flecked with black cloudy masses, probably great forests, with here and there a— Nothing more!
uz: Uzoqroq, lekin juda qorong'i, xuddi ekran ortida bo'lgani kabi, soyasidagi qit'alar o'zlarini ko'rsatdi, ularning yuzalari qora bulutli to'plamlar bilan butlangan, ehtimol katta o'rmonlar bilan, shu va shu yerda hech narsa!

en: In less than a second the illumination had come to an end, involving everything in the Moon's direction once more in pitchy darkness.
uz: Bir soniyadan kam vaqt ichida yorug'lik tugadi, oyga qarab boradigan hamma narsani yana bir bor qorong'ilik bilan qamrab oladi.

en: But had the impression made on the travellers' eyes been a mere vision or the result of a reality?
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarning ko'zlariga tushirilgan taassurot shunchaki tasavvurmi yoki haqiqat natijasi bo'lganmi?

en: an optical delusion or the shadow of a solid fact?
uz: Optik aldamlikmi yoki mustahkam faktning soyasimi?

en: Could an observation so rapid, so fleeting, so superficial, be really regarded as a genuine scientific affirmation?
uz: Bunday tezkor, o'tkinchi va yuzxotirchilik bilan kuzatilgan narsa, haqiqatan ham haqiqiy ilmiy dalil deb hisoblanishi mumkinmi?

en: Could such a feeble glimmer of the invisible disc justify them in pronouncing a decided opinion on the inhabitability of the Moon?
uz: Ko'rinmas diskning bunday kam tarqalishi ularni oyda yashashi mumkinligi to'g'risida qat'iy fikr bildirishga asoslantirishi mumkinmi?

en: To such questions as these, rising spontaneously and simultaneously in the minds of our travellers, they could not reply at the moment; they could not reply to them long afterwards; even to this day they can give them no satisfactory answer.
uz: Sayohatchilarimizning onglarida o'z-o'zidan va bir vaqtning o'zida paydo bo'lgan bunday savollarga ular hozirda javob bera olishmadi; ular keyinchalik ham javob bera olishmadi; hatto bugungi kunga qadar ularga qoniqarli javob bera olishmaydi.

en: All they could do at the moment, they did.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda ular qila oladigan barcha narsani bajarishdi.

en: To every sight and sound they kept their eyes and ears open, and, by observing the most perfect silence, they sought to render their impressions too vivid to admit of deception.
uz: Ular har bir ko'rinishga va tovushga ko'zlari va quloqlarini ochiq saqlab, eng mukammal xotirjamlikni kuzatish orqali o'z taassurotlarini aldashni tan olish uchun juda jonli qilishga harakat qilishardi.

en: There was now, however, nothing to be heard, and very little more to be seen.
uz: Biroq, endi eshitish uchun hech narsa yo'q edi va ko'rish uchun juda oz narsa bor edi.

en: The few coruscations that flashed over the sky, gradually became fewer and dimmer; the asteroids sought paths further and further apart, and finally disappeared altogether.
uz: Osmondan parcha-parcha ko'rinadigan bir nechta shovqinlar asta-sekin kamroq va kamroq bo'ldi; asteroidlar o'zaro yo'lni izlab, nihoyat butunlay yo'qolishdi.

en: The ether resumed its original blackness.
uz: Eter o'zining asl qoraligini tikladi.

en: The stars, eclipsed for a moment, blazed out
uz: Yulduzlar bir zum uchun qoplanganidan so'ng, yorug'lik bilan parlashdi.

en: again on the firmament, and the invisible disc, that had flashed into view for an instant, once more relapsed forever into the impenetrable depths of night.
uz: Osmondagi ko'rinmas disk bir zumda ko'rinishga tushib qolgan bo'lsa-da, yana bir bor kechaning o'tmas chuqurliklariga abadiy qaytdi.

en: THE SOUTHERN HEMISPHERE.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahon.

en: Exceedingly narrow and exceedingly fortunate had been the escape of the Projectile.
uz: O'ta tor va o'ta omadli bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, o'ta g'alati bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, o'ta g'alati bo'lgan bo'ldi.

en: And from a danger too the most unlikely and the most unexpected.
uz: Shuningdek, eng ehtimoldan yiroq va eng kutilmagan xavfdan ham.

en: Who would have ever dreamed of even the possibility of such an encounter?
uz: Kim bunday uchrashuvning ehtimolini ham tasavvur qilgan bo'lar edi?

en: And was all danger over?
uz: Va barcha xavf-xatar o'tib ketganmi?

en: The sight of one of these erratic bolides certainly justified the gravest apprehensions of our travellers regarding the existence of others.
uz: Ushbu noaniq bolidlardan birini ko'rish, albatta, sayohatchilarimizning boshqalarning mavjudligi to'g'risida qo'rquvlarini oqlaydi.

en: Worse than the sunken reefs of the Southern Seas or the snags of the Mississippi, how could the Projectile be expected to avoid them?
uz: Janubiy dengizlarning qulab ketgan resiflaridan yoki Missisipi daryolarining to'siqlaridan ham yomonroq bo'lgan holda, qanday qilib Projectile ulardan qochishi mumkin edi?

en: Drifting along blindly through the boundless ethereal ocean, her inmates, even if they saw the danger, were totally powerless to turn her aside.
uz: Ko'r bo'lib, cheksiz etyer okeanidan o'tib ketayotgan uning mahbuslari xavf-xatarni ko'rsalar ham, uni chetga qaytarishga hech qanday kuchlari yo'q edi.

en: Like a ship without a rudder, like a runaway horse, like a collapsed balloon, like an iceberg in an Atlantic storm, like a boat in the Niagara rapids, she moved on sullenly, recklessly, mechanically, mayhap into the very jaws of the most frightful danger, the bright intelligences within no more able to modify her motions even by a finger's breadth than they were able to affect Mercury's movements around the Sun.
uz: G'ildiraksiz kema kabi, qochib ketayotgan ot kabi, qulagan ballon kabi, Atlantika bo'ronida muz tog'i kabi, Niagara tezkorligida kemaning o'rnagi kabi, u o'z harakatini beparvo, beparvo, mexanik tarzda, eng dahshatli xavfning o'ziga o'xshab o'tkazib yuboradi, uning ichida yashirin aqlli insonlar uning harakatlarini hatto bir barmoq kengligi bilan ham o'zgartira olmaydilar, chunki ular Merkuriyaning Quyosh atrofidagi harakatlariga ta'sir qila olmaydilar.

en: But did our friends complain of the new perils now looming up before them?
uz: Ammo do'stlarimiz hozir ular oldida turgan yangi xavf-xatarlardan shikoyat qilishganmi?

en: They never thought of such a thing.
uz: Ular hech qachon bunday narsa haqida o'ylamagan.

en: On the contrary, they only considered themselves (after the lapse of a few minutes to calm their nerves) extremely lucky in having witnessed this fresh glory of exuberant nature, this transcendent display of fireworks
uz: Aksincha, ular o'zlarini (bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, g'azabini xotirjam qilish uchun) o'zlarini juda baxtli deb hisoblashgan, chunki ular bu chiroyli tabiatning yangi shon-shuhratini, o'tkir o'yinlarni ko'rishgan.

en: which not only cast into absolute insignificance anything of the kind they had ever seen on Earth, but had actually enabled them by its dazzling illumination to gaze for a second or two at the Moon's mysterious invisible disc.
uz: Bu nafaqat ular Yer yuzida ko'rgan har qanday narsani mutlaqo ahamiyatsiz deb hisoblaydi, balki o'z yorug'ligi bilan bir-ikki soniya davomida oyning sirli ko'rinmas diskini ko'rishlariga imkon beradi.

en: This glorious momentary glance, worth a whole lifetime of ordinary existence, had revealed to mortal ken her continents, her oceans, her forests.
uz: Bu ulug'vor bir vaqtning o'zida ko'rinish, butun umr oddiy hayotga ega bo'lgan, o'z qit'alariga, okeanlariga, o'rmonlariga o'xshash narsalarni o'lik kishiga oshkor etgan edi.

en: But did it also convince them of the existence of an atmosphere on her surface whose vivifying molecules would render life possible?
uz: Ammo bu ularni uning yuzasida atmosferaning mavjudligiga ishontirganmi, uning hayotga ta'sir qiladigan molekulalari hayotga imkon yaratadi?

en: This question they had again to leave unanswered—it will hardly ever be answered in a way quite satisfactory to human curiosity.
uz: Bu savolni ular yana javobsiz qoldirishlari kerak edi, ammo inson qiziqishlarini qondiruvchi tarzda javob berish qiyin.

en: Still, infinite was their satisfaction at having hovered even for an instant on the very verge of such a great problem's solution.
uz: Biroq, bunday katta muammoning yechimining chegarasida bir daqiqaga ham bo'lgan quvonchlari cheksiz edi.

en: It was now half-past three in the afternoon.
uz: Endi soat uch yarim edi.

en: The Projectile still pursued its curving but otherwise unknown path over the Moon's invisible face.
uz: Projektil o'zining egri, ammo boshqa ma'lum bo'lmagan yo'lini Oydinning ko'rinmas yuzi ustida davom ettirgan.

en: Had this path been disturbed by that dangerous meteor?
uz: Ushbu yo'l xavfli meteorit tomonidan buzilganmi?

en: There was every reason to fear so—though, disturbance or no disturbance, the curve it described should still be one strictly in accordance with the laws of Mechanical Philosophy.
uz: Qo'rqishning barcha sabablari bor edi, ammo, tashvishlar bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi, u tasvirlagan bo'g'in har doim mexanik falsafaning qonunlariga qat'iy mos bo'lishi kerak.

en: Whether it was a parabola or a hyperbola, however, or whether it was disturbed or not, made very little difference as, in any case, the Projectile was bound to quit pretty soon the cone of the shadow, at a point directly opposite to where it had entered it.
uz: Biroq, bu parabola yoki hiperbola bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, bu o'zgarish juda kam ahamiyatga ega edi, chunki, hech bo'lmaganda, proyektil o'z ichiga kirgan joyidan to'g'ri qarama-qarshi bo'lgan joyda ko'rinishda ko'rinishda ko'rinishda ko'rinishda ko'rinishni tez orada tark etishi kerak edi.

en: This cone could not possibly be of very great extent, considering the very slight ratio borne by the Moon's diameter when compared with the Sun's.
uz: Ayning quyoshli diametri bilan taqqoslaganda, u juda kam bo'lgan nisbatni e'tiborga olib, bu shisha juda katta bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Still, to all appearances, the Projectile seemed to be quite as deeply immersed in the shadow as ever, and there was apparently not the slightest sign of such a state of things coming soon to an end.
uz: Biroq, ko'rinishicha, "Projektil" har doimgidek soyasida chuqur o'tirib qolgan edi va bu holat yaqin orada tugagani haqida hech qanday belgi yo'q edi.

en: At what rate was the Projectile now moving?
uz: O'sha paytda Projectile qanday tezlikda harakatlanayotgan edi?

en: Hard to say, but certainly not slowly, certainly rapidly enough to be out of the shadow by this time, if describing a curve rigidly parabolic.
uz: Aytish qiyin, lekin, albatta, sekin emas, balki shu vaqtgacha soyasidan chiqib ketish uchun etarlicha tez, agar qattiq parabolik egri chiziqni tasvirlayotgan bo'lsangiz.

en: Was the curve therefore not parabolic?
uz: Shunday qilib, bu egrilik parabolik emasmidi?

en: Another puzzling problem and sadly bewildering to poor Barbican, who had now almost lost his reason by attempting to clear up questions that were proving altogether too profound for his overworked brains.
uz: Boshqa bir g'alati muammo va qashshoq Barbican uchun g'alati g'alati, chunki u endi o'zlarining ortiqcha ishlagan miyasi uchun juda chuqur bo'lgan savollarni aniqlashga harakat qilib, aqlini yo'qotib qo'ygan edi.

en: Not that he ever thought of taking rest.
uz: Hech qachon dam olish haqida o'ylamagan.

en: Not that his companions thought of taking rest.
uz: Yo'q, uning hamkorlari dam olishni o'ylashmagan.

en: With senses as high-strung as ever, they still watched carefully for every new fact, every
uz: Ular har qachongidan ko'proq his-tuyg'ular bilan har bir yangi faktni diqqat bilan kuzatib turishgan.

en: unexpected incident that might throw some light on the sidereal investigations.
uz: O'ylanmagan hodisa, bu sidereal tekshiruvlarga yorug'lik ko'rsatishi mumkin.

en: Even their dinner, or what was called so, consisted of only a few bits of bread and meat, distributed by Ardan at five o'clock, and swallowed mechanically.
uz: Hatto ularning kechki ovqatlari ham, ya'ni shunday deb nomlangan narsalari ham, Ardan tomonidan soat beshda tarqatilgan va mexanik ravishda yutib yuborilgan bir necha dona non va go'shtdan iborat edi.

en: They did not even turn on the gas full head to see what they were eating; each man stood solidly at his window, the glass of which they had enough to do in keeping free from the rapidly condensing moisture.
uz: Ular nima yeyishayotganini ko'rish uchun hatto gazni to'ldirib qo'yishmadi; har bir kishi o'z darcha oldida qattiq turardi, shunda shishalar tezda kondensatsiyalovchi namlikdan xalos bo'lish uchun etarlicha harakat qilishardi.

en: At about half-past five, however, M'Nicholl, who had been gazing for some time with his telescope in a particular direction, called the attention of his companions to some bright specks of light barely discernible in that part of the horizon towards which the Projectile was evidently moving.
uz: Biroq, soat 5:30 atrofida M'Nicholl, ko'p vaqt davomida teleskop bilan muayyan yo'nalishdagi ko'rinishni ko'rgan bo'lsa-da, o'z yo'lovchilarining e'tiborini bir nechta yorug' parchalarga qaratdi, ular ko'rinishning shunga o'xshash qismida sezilarli darajada ko'rinmas edi.

en: His words were hardly uttered when his companions announced the same discovery.
uz: Uning hamkorlari xuddi shu kashfiyotni e'lon qilishganda, so'zlari kamdan-kam so'zlangan.

en: They could soon all see the glittering specks not only becoming more and more numerous, but also gradually assuming the shape of an extremely slender, but extremely brilliant crescent.
uz: Tez orada hammalari shishqoq teshiklarni nafaqat ko'payib borayotganini, balki asta-sekin nihoyatda chiroyli, ammo nihoyatda yorqin yarim oy shaklini olganini ko'rishlari mumkin edi.

en: Rapidly more brilliant and more decided in shape the profile gradually grew, till it soon resembled the first faint sketch of the New Moon that we catch of evenings in the western sky, or rather the first glimpse we get of her limb as it slowly moves out of eclipse.
uz: Tez orada profil o'sib borardi, tezda biz g'arbiy osmondagi kechki paytlarni ko'rib turgan yangi oyning birinchi samarasiz eskiziga o'xshardi yoki, to'g'ri, uning tusini ko'rib, u kechqurun tutulishdan sekin-sakin chiqib ketadi.

en: But it was inconceivably brighter than either, and was furthermore strangely relieved by the pitchy blackness both of sky and Moon.
uz: Ammo u ikkisidan ham ko'ra ko'proq yorqin edi va osmon va oyning qora qoraligi bilan ajablanarli darajada yengillashdi.

en: In fact, it soon became so brilliant as to dispel in a moment all doubt as to its particular nature.
uz: Darhaqiqat, u tezda shunchalik ajoyib bo'ldiki, uning o'ziga xos xususiyatiga bo'lgan barcha shubhalarni bir daqiqa ichida yo'q qildi.

en: No meteor could present such a perfect shape; no volcano, such dazzling splendor.
uz: Hech qanday meteor bunday mukammal shaklni taqdim eta olmaydi; hech qanday vulqon bunday ajoyib parvarish qila olmaydi.

en: "The Sun!" cried Barbican.
uz: "Kosh!" - deb baqirdi Barbican.

en: "The Sun?" asked M'Nicholl and Ardan in some astonishment.
uz: - Quyoshmi? - deb M'Nicholl va Ardan o'zlarini hayratda qoldirib so'radilar.

en: "Yes, dear friends; it is the Sun himself that you now see; these summits that you behold him gilding are the mountains that lie on the Moon's southern rim.
uz: "Ha, aziz do'stlarim, siz hozir quyoshning o'zini ko'ryapsiz; uni oltinlab ko'rgan ushbu tepaliklar - oyning janubiy sohilidagi tog'lardir.

en: We are rapidly nearing her south pole." "After doubling her north pole!" cried Ardan; "why, we must be circumnavigating her!" "Exactly; sailing all around her." "Hurrah!
uz: Biz uning janubiy qutbga tezda yaqinlashamiz". - "Uning shimoliy qutbini ikki baravar ko'paytirganimizdan so'ng!" - deb baqirdi Ardan; "Nega, biz uni aylanib o'tishimiz kerak!" - "To'g'ri, uning atrofida yelka yuribmiz". - "Hurrah!"

en: Then we're all right at last!
uz: Shunday qilib, nihoyat biz yaxshi bo'ldik!

en: There's nothing more to fear from your hyperbolas or parabolas or any other of your open curves!" "Nothing more, certainly, from an open curve, but every thing from a closed one."
uz: Sizning hiperbolalaringiz yoki parabolalaringiz yoki boshqa ochiq egri yozuvlaringizdan qo'rqish uchun boshqa hech narsa yo'q! " "Aybda emas, ochiq egri yozuvdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q, lekin hamma narsa yopilgan egri yozuvdan".

en: And what is the trouble?" "An eclipse it is called; and the trouble is that, instead of flying off into the boundless regions of space, our Projectile will probably describe an elliptical orbit around the Moon—" —"What!" cried M'Nicholl, in amazement, "and be her satellite for ever!" "All right and proper," said Ardan; "why shouldn't she have one of her own?" "Only, my dear friend," said Barbican to Ardan, "this change of curve involves no change in the doom of the Projectile.
uz: Va nima muammosi bor?" - dedi Ardan; "Nima uchun uning o'zidan biri bo'lmasligi kerak?" - dedi Ardan. - Faqatgina, aziz do'stim, - dedi Barbican Ardanga, - bu aylanma o'zgarishi bironta o'zgarishni o'z ichiga olmaydi.

uz: Men bu mavzuni chuqur o'rganib chiqdim va shuning uchun bu haqda hamma narsani bilaman".

uz: Sizni kun bo'yi zavq bilan tinglay olardim!" - deb o'yladi Ardan, g'ayrat bilan, ammo ba'zi bir noqulaylik bilan, chunki u sevimli do'stiga nisbatan bunday yolg'on gapirganida vijdonining charchag'ini his qildi.

en: "The fact is," he went on, "such a rational conversation as the present, on such an absorbing subject, with such a perfect master—" "The Sun!" cried M'Nicholl starting up and cheering.
uz: U davom etdi: "Aqiqat shundaki, hozirgi kabi oqilona suhbat, shu kabi chiroyli mavzuda, shu kabi mukammal ustasi bilan" "Kosh!" - deb hayqirdi M'Nicholl boshlanadi va xursand bo'ladi.

en: "He's cleared the disc completely, and he's now himself again!
uz: "U diskni to'liq tozaladi va endi u o'zi qaytadi!

en: Hurrah!" "Hurrah!" cried the others quite as enthusiastically (Ardan did not seem a bit desirous to finish his sentence).
uz: Hurrah!" - deb baqirib yubordilar (Ardan o'z jumlasini tugatishga umuman tayyor emas edi).

en: They tossed their maps aside and hastened to the window.

uz: Soat to'g'ri soat olti edi.

uz: Quyosh, oy disklari bilan to'liq bog'lanishdan to'liq xalos bo'lib, butun Projectile-ni oltin nurlariga to'kib soldi.

uz: Sayohatchilar, oyning janubiy qutbining ustunida to'g'ri yo'lga tushib, o'zlaridan taxminan  mil uzoqlikda bo'lishganini Barbican tezda aniqladi, bu esa ular shimoliy qutbdan to'g'ri uzoqlikda bo'lganligini isbotlaydi.

en: For some time, the travellers' whole attention was concentrated on the glorious Sun.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida sayohatchilarning butun e'tiborlari ulug'vor Quyoshga qaratilgan edi.

en: His light was inexpressibly cheering; and his heat, soon penetrating the walls of the Projectile, infused a new and sweet life into their chilled and exhausted frames.
uz: Uning yorug'ligi so'zsiz quvonchli edi va uning issiqligi tez orada Projectile devorlariga kirib, ularning sovuq va charchagan ramkalariga yangi va shirin hayot ato etdi.

en: The ice rapidly disappeared, and the windows soon resumed their former perfect transparency.
uz: Buz tezda yo'qoldi va darchalar tez orada o'zlarining mukammal shaffofligini tikladi.

uz: Quyoshning yoqimli nurlari qanchalik yaxshi! - deb hayqirib yubordi kapitan.

uz: "Men Ardanning kambag'al do'stlari Selenitlarga o'sha uzoq va sovuq kechasi davomida qanchalik achinaman!

en: How impatient they must be to see the Sun back again!" "Yes," said Ardan, also sitting down the better to bask in the vivifying rays, "his light no doubt brings them to life and keeps them alive.
uz: Ular quyoshni yana ko'rish uchun qanchalik sabrsizlik bilan kutishmoqda! - dedi Ardan, yana hayotga aylantiruvchi nurlarni ko'rish uchun o'tirgan holda, "Ha, uning nuri ularni hayotga qaytaradi va tirik qoldiradi.

en: Without light or heat during all that dreary winter, they must freeze stiff like the frogs or become torpid like the bears.
uz: O'sha qorong'i qish davomida yorug'lik yoki issiqlik bo'lmagan holda, ular qurtlar kabi qattiq muzlatilishi yoki g'ayratli bo'lishi kerak.

en: I can't imagine how they could get through it otherwise."
uz: Boshqa yo'l bilan ular qanday o'tishlari mumkinligini tasavvur ham qila olmayman".

en: "I'm glad we're through it anyhow," observed M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl shunday deb aytdi: "Hamma nima bo'lganda ham, biz buni o'tkazganimizdan xursandman.

en: "I may at once acknowledge that I felt perfectly miserable as long as it lasted.
uz: "Men o'zimni o'zimni o'zimni butunlay baxtsiz his qilganimni darhol tan olsam bo'ladi.

en: I can now easily understand how the combined cold and darkness killed Doctor Kane's Esquimaux dogs.
uz: Endi men sovuq va qorong'ilik bilan birga Doktor Kaynning Eskimux itlarini qanday qilib o'ldirganini osonlikcha tushunib yetaman.

uz: Bu meni o'ldirmoqchi edi.

en: I was so miserable that at last I could neither talk myself nor bear to hear others talk." "My own case exactly," said Barbican—"that is," he added hastily, correcting himself, "I tried to talk because I found Ardan so interested, but in spite of all we said, and saw, and had to think of, Byron's terrible dream would continually rise up before me:
uz: O'zimni ham, boshqalarni ham gapirishni ham ko'rmay qo'ydim", - dedi Barbican. - "O'zimning o'zimning holatim to'g'ri", - deb aytdi u tezda o'zini to'g'rilab, qo'shimcha qilib: "Men gapirishga harakat qildim, chunki Ardanni juda qiziqtirgan edim, lekin biz aytgan, ko'rgan va o'ylashimiz kerak bo'lgan hamma narsalarga qaramay, Byronning dahshatli orzu menga doimiy ravishda ko'tarildi:

uz: Ertalab keldi va ketdi, keldi va hech qanday kun keltirmadi!

en: And men forgot their passions in the dread Of this their desolation, and all hearts Were chilled into a selfish prayer for light!" As he pronounced these words in accents at once monotonous and melancholy, Ardan, fully appreciative, quietly gesticulated in perfect cadence with the rhythm.
uz: Odamlar o'z ishtiyoqlarini qo'rquvda unutdilar, bu ularning halok bo'lishidan qo'rqib, hamma yuraklar nur so'rab, xudbin ibodatga aylandilar!" - dedi Ardan.

en: Then the three men remained completely silent for several minutes.
uz: So'ngra uch kishi bir necha daqiqa davomida butunlay sukut saqlashdi.

en: Buried in recollection, or lost in thought, or magnetized by the bright Sun, they seemed to be half asleep while steeping their limbs in his vitalizing beams.
uz: Xotiralar ichida ko'milgan, fikrlarda yo'qolgan yoki yorqin Quyosh tomonidan magnitlashtirilgan bo'lib, ular o'z a'zolarini uning jonlantiruvchi nurlariga cho'kib qo'ygan holda yarim uxlab yotgan bo'lishdi.

en: Barbican was the first to dissolve the reverie by jumping up.
uz: Barbican birinchi bo'lib o'z ko'nglini ko'targan.

en: His sharp eye had noticed that the base of the Projectile, instead of keeping rigidly perpendicular to the lunar surface, turned away a little, so as to render the elliptical orbit somewhat elongated.
uz: Uning keskin ko'zi Projektilning poydevori oy yuziga qat'iy tegishqoq bo'lishning o'rniga, biroz o'zgarib, elliptik orbita biroz uzaytirilishini payqadi.

en: This he made his companions immediately observe, and also called their attention to the fact that from this point they could easily have seen the Earth had it been Full, but that now, drowned in the Sun's beams, it was quite invisible.
uz: U o'z hamrohlariga buni darhol kuzatishga undadi va ularning e'tiborini shu paytdan boshlab ular Yerni to'liq bo'lganida osonlikcha ko'rishlari mumkinligini, ammo hozir quyosh nurlarida cho'kib ketganidan so'ng u butunlay ko'rinmasligini ham fosh qildi.

en: A more attractive spectacle, however, soon engaged their undivided attention—that of the Moon's southern regions, now brought within about the third of a mile by their telescopes.
uz: Biroq, ko'proq jozibador ko'rinish tez orada ularning e'tiborini jalb qildi - oyning janubiy mintaqalari, endi ularning teleskoplari tomonidan bir milning uchdan bir qismiga yaqinlashtirildi.

en: Immediately resuming their posts by the windows, they carefully noted every feature presented by the fantastic panorama that stretched itself out in endless lengths beneath their wondering eyes.
uz: Darhol o'z postlarini oynada davom ettirib, ular o'zlarining hayratlanarli ko'zlari ostida cheksiz uzunliklarda o'z-o'zini kengaytirgan ajoyib panorama tomonidan taqdim etilgan har bir xususiyatga diqqat bilan e'tibor qaratishdi.

uz: Leibnitz va Doerfel tog'lari juda janubiy hududlarda rivojlangan ikkita alohida guruhni tashkil etadi.

en: "They're beds of snow," he said at last in a decided tone.
uz: "Ular qar yotoqlari", dedi u nihoyat qat'iy so'z bilan.

uz: M'Nicholl: "Qov!" - deb hayqirdi.

uz: "Ha, qor, yoki, to'g'ri, g'alatilar g'ayratli muz bilan qoplangan.

en: See how vividly they reflect the Sun's rays.
uz: Ko'ring, ular quyosh nurlarini qanchalik aniq aks ettirishadi.

uz: Lava to'plamlari hech qachon bunday ajoyib bir xilma-xillik bilan parlay olmaydi.

en: Therefore there must be both water and air on the Moon's surface.
uz: Shuning uchun oy yuzida suv ham, havo ham bo'lishi kerak.

en: Not much— perhaps very little if you insist on it—but the fact that there is some can now no longer be questioned." This assertion of Barbican's, made so positively by a man who never decided unless when thoroughly convinced, was a great triumph for Ardan, who, as the gracious reader doubtless remembers, had had a famous dispute with M'Nicholl on that very subject at Tampa.[D] His eyes brightened and a smile of pleasure played around his lips, but, with a great effort at self-restraint, he kept perfectly silent and would not permit himself even to look in the direction of the Captain.
uz: Agar siz buni istayotgan bo'lsangiz, ko'p emas, balki juda kam, lekin ba'zilari borligi endi shubha ostiga qo'yilmaydi".Barbicanning bu so'zlari, to'liq ishonch hosil qilmaganidan boshqa hech qachon qaror chiqarmagan kishi tomonidan juda ijobiy tarzda aytilgan edi, Ardan uchun katta g'alaba edi, chunki mehribon o'quvchi shubhasiz eslaydi, u M'Nicholl bilan Tampadagi shu mavzuda mashhur bahsga duch kelgan edi.[D] Uning ko'zlari yorqinlashdi va uning og'izlari atrofida zavq tabassumlari o'ynadi, ammo u o'zini tuta bilish uchun katta harakat qilgan holda, to'liq sukut saqladi va hatto kapitanning yo'liga qarashga ham ruxsat bermadi.

uz: M'Nichollga kelsak, u boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylash uchun Doerfel va Leibnitz bilan juda ko'p shug'ullanardi.

en: These mountains rose from plains of moderate extent, bounded by an indefinite succession of walled hollows and ring ramparts.
uz: Ushbu tog'lar o'rtacha darajada bo'lgan o'tmalardan ko'tarilgan, devorli hollar va o'zaroqlar bilan chegaralangan.

en: They are the only chains met in this region of ridge-brimmed craters and circles; distinguished by no particular feature, they project a few pointed peaks here and there, some of which exceed four miles and a half in height.
uz: Ular bu hududda uchraydigan yagona zanjirlardir; ular hech qanday o'ziga xos xususiyat bilan ajralib turmaydi, chunki ular bir nechta o'tkir cho'qqizlarni shu va shu joyda namoyish etadilar, ularning ba'zilari balandligi to'rt yarim mildan oshadi.

en: This altitude, however, foreshortened as it was by the vertical position of the Projectile, could not be noticed just then, even if correct observation had been permitted by the dazzling surface.
uz: Biroq, bu balandlik, bu balandlik Projectilning vertikal pozitsiyasi bilan qisqartirilgan bo'lgani uchun, hatto yorqin yuzaga qarab aniq kuzatish mumkin bo'lsa ham, o'sha paytda aniq ko'rinishga ega bo'lmadi.

en: Once more again before the travellers' eyes the Moon's disc revealed itself in all the old familiar features so characteristic of lunar landscapes—no blending of tones, no softening of colors, no graduation of shadows, every line glaring in white or black by reason of the total absence of refracted light.
uz: Sayohatchilarning ko'z o'ngida yana bir bor oy diskining o'zi o'zini oy manzaralariga o'xshaydigan barcha eski tanish xususiyatlarda ko'rsatdi.Tonlarning aralashmasligi, ranglarning yumshatmasligi, soyalarning o'zgarishi, har bir chiziq o'zlarining to'liq ifloslanmaganligi sababli oq yoki qora rangda ko'rinadi.

en: And yet the wonderfully peculiar character of this desolate world imparted to it a weird attraction as strangely fascinating as ever.
uz: Shunga qaramay, bu chiroyli dunyoning ajoyib xususiyati unga har qachongidan ham g'ayrioddiy bir jozibadorlik ato etdi.

en: Over this chaotic region the travellers were now sweeping, as if borne on the wings of a storm; the peaks defiled beneath them; the yawning chasms revealed their ruin-strewn floors; the fissured cracks untwisted themselves; the ramparts showed all their sides; the mysterious holes presented their impenetrable depths; the
uz: Ushbu xavfsiz hududni sayohatchilar endi shamolning qanotlari bilan ko'tarilgan kabi ko'tarishdi; ularning pastidagi tepaliklar iflos bo'ldi; bo'g'ib ketgan chuqurliklar buzilib ketgan qavatlarini oshkor qildi; bo'g'ib ketgan bo'g'riliklar o'z-o'zidan o'zlarini o'zgartirdi; devorlar o'z tomonlarini ko'rsatdi; sirli toshlar o'zlarining kirib kelmaydigan chuqurliklarini ko'rsatdi;

en: clustered mountain summits and rings rapidly decomposed themselves: but in a moment again all had become more inextricably entangled than ever.
uz: To'plangan tog'lar sammitlari va bog'lari tezda o'z-o'zidan buzib ketishdi: lekin bir daqiqada hamma narsa har qachongidan ham qat'iyroq bog'langan edi.

en: Everything appeared to be the finished handiwork of volcanic agency, in the utmost purity and highest perfection.
uz: Hamma narsa volkanik agentlikning bitik qo'llanmasi bo'lib, eng pok va eng mukammal darajada ko'rinardi.

en: None of the mollifying effects of air or water could here be noticed.
uz: Bu erda havo yoki suvning yumshatadigan ta'sirlaridan hech biri payqamaydi.

en: No smooth-capped mountains, no gently winding river channels, no vast prairie-lands of deposited sediment, no traces of vegetation, no signs of agriculture, no vestiges of a great city.
uz: Yo'q, tekis tog'lar yo'q, suv kanallari ham yo'q, ko'p o'tkir ko'chatlar, o'simlik izlari yo'q, qishloq xo'jaligi ko'rinishi yo'q, buyuk shahar qoldiqlari yo'q.

en: Nothing but vast beds of glistering lava, now rough like immense piles of scoriae and clinker, now smooth like crystal mirrors, and reflecting the Sun's rays with the same intolerable glare.
uz: O'ta ulkan g'ayratli lava to'plamlaridan boshqa hech narsa yo'q, endi shkaflar va klinkerlarning ulkan to'plamlariga o'xshaydi, endi kristall ko'rinishlariga o'xshaydi va quyosh nurlarini xuddi shu chidamsiz yorqinlik bilan aks ettiradi.

en: Not the faintest speck of life.
uz: Hayotning eng zaif qismi ham emas.

en: A world absolutely and completely dead, fixed, still, motionless—save when a gigantic land-slide, breaking off the vertical wall of a crater, plunged down into the soundless depths, with all the fury too of a crashing avalanche, with all the speed of a Niagara, but, in the total absence of atmosphere, noiseless as a feather, as a snow flake, as a grain of impalpable dust.
uz: To'liq va butunlay o'lik, to'xtatilgan, to'xtatilgan, harakatsiz dunyoBoshqa katta yer shishqoqining kraterning vertikal devorini buzganida, ovozsiz chuqurlikka tushdi, butun g'azabga to'lib-toshgan lavinga ham, Niagara tezligiga ham, lekin atmosfera to'liq yo'qligida, parcha kabi, qor to'g'riligi kabi, o'zidan-o'zi ko'tarilmaydigan tuproq donaga o'xshaydi.

en: Careful observations, taken by Barbican and repeated by his companions, soon satisfied them that the ridgy outline of the mountains on the Moon's border, though perhaps due to different forces from those acting in the centre, still presented a character generally uniform.
uz: Barbican tomonidan o'tkazilgan va uning hamkorlari tomonidan takrorlangan ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatishlar, tez orada ularni oy chegarasidagi tog'larning qirg'oq bo'lib ko'rinishi, ehtimol uning markazida faoliyat ko'rsatayotganlardan farq qiladigan kuchlar tufayli bo'lsa-da, hali ham odatda bir xil xarakterga ega ekanligini qondirdi.

en: The same bulwark-surrounded hollows, the same abrupt projections of surface.
uz: Xuddi shu qo'rqinch bilan o'ralgan hollar, xuddi shu sur'atning shoshilinch ko'rinishlari.

en: Yet a different arrangement, as Barbican pointed out to his companions, might be naturally expected.
uz: Biroq, Barbican o'z hamrohlariga ta'kidlaganidek, boshqacha tartib tabiiy ravishda kutilishi mumkin.

en: In the central portion of the disc, the Moon's crust, before solidification, must have been subjected to two attractions—that of the Moon herself and that of the Earth—acting, however, in contrary directions and therefore, in a certain sense, serving to neutralize each other.
uz: Diskning markaziy qismida, oy qornasi mustahkamlanishidan oldin ikki ta'sirga duchor bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak: oyning o'zi va Yerning, ammo ular qarama-qarshi yo'nalishlarda harakat qilishadi va shu sababli, muayyan ma'noda, bir-birini mustasno qilish uchun xizmat qiladi.

en: Towards the border of her disc, on the contrary, the terrestrial attraction, having acted in a direction perpendicular to that of the lunar, should have exerted greater power, and therefore given a different shape to the general contour.
uz: Ay diskining chegarasiga qaraganda, yerdagi jozibadorlik oyning jozibadorligiga tegishqoq bo'lib harakat qilgan bo'lsa, katta kuchga ega bo'lishi kerak edi va shuning uchun umumiy konturga boshqacha shakl bergan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: But no remarkable difference had so far been perceived by terrestrial observers; and none could now be detected by our travellers.
uz: Ammo yer yuzidagi kuzatuvchilar tomonidan hech qanday sezilarli farq sezilmagan edi va hozirda sayohatchilar tomonidan hech qanday farq sezilmagan edi.

en: Therefore the Moon must have found in herself alone the principle of her shape and of her superficial development—that is, she owed nothing to external influences.
uz: Shuning uchun oy o'z shakli va yuzaki rivojlanishining printsipini faqat o'z ichidan topgan bo'lishi kerak, ya'ni u tashqi ta'sirlarga hech narsa qarzdor emas edi.

en: "Arago was perfectly right, therefore," concluded
uz: "Oragoning so'zlari to'liq to'g'ri edi, shuning uchun", - deb xulosa qildi u.

en: Barbican, "in the remarkable opinion to which he gave expression thirty years ago: 'No external action whatever has contributed to the formation of the Moon's diversified surface.'" "But don't you think, Barbican," asked the Captain, "that every force, internal or external, that might modify the Moon's shape, has ceased long ago?" "I am rather inclined to that opinion," said Barbican; "it is not, however, a new one.
uz: "Barbican, o'ttiz yil oldin o'z ifodasini bergani kabi, hech qanday tashqi harakat o'z hissasini o'z ichiga olmagan", - deb aytdi kapitan. "Ammo sen o'ylamaysanmi, Barbican, o'sha o'lchamni o'zgartiradigan har qanday ichki yoki tashqi kuch uzoq vaqt oldin to'xtadi?" - dedi Barbican. "Men o'sha fikrga ko'proq moyilman, - dedi Barbican; "shunga qaramay, bu yangi kuch emas.

en: Descartes maintained that as the Earth is an extinct Sun, so is the Moon an extinct Earth.
uz: Dekartning fikricha, Yer o'lik Quyosh bo'lgani kabi, Oy ham o'lik Yer bo'lib qolgan.

en: My own opinion at present is that the Moon is now the image of death, but I can't say if she has ever been the abode of life." "The abode of life!" cried Ardan, who had great repugnance in accepting the idea that the Moon was no better than a heap of cinders and ashes; "why, look there!
uz: Hozirgi kunda mening fikrim shundaki, oy hozirgi vaqtda o'limning tasviri, lekin u hayotning manbai bo'lganmi yoki yo'qmi, demayman". - Hayotning manbai bo'lgan!" - deb hayqirib yubordi Ardan, o'zidan o'zini ko'ngilsizlik bilan o'ylab, o'sha oy ko'p cho'g' va kuldan yaxshiroq emas degan fikrni qabul qildi.

en: If those are not as neat a set of the ruins of an abandoned city as ever I saw, I should like to know what they are!"
uz: Agar bular men ko'rgan kabi tashlab ketilgan shaharning vayronlari to'plami bo'lmasa, men nima ekanligini bilishni xohlayman!"

en: ONCE MORE THE PIPES OF AN AQUEDUCT.
uz: Bir marta suv quvurining quvurlari ko'proq.

en: He pointed to some very remarkable rocky formations in the neighborhood of Short, a ring mountain rising to an altitude considerably higher than that of Mont Blanc.
uz: U Short yaqinidagi ba'zi diqqatga sazovor toshli tuzilishlarni ko'rsatdi, bu toshlar Mont Blankdan ancha yuqori balandlikka ko'tarilgan do'zax tog'dir.

en: Even Barbican and M'Nicholl could detect some regularity and semblance of order in the arrangement of these rocks, but this, of course, they looked on as a mere freak of nature, like the Lurlei Rock, the Giant's Causeway, or the Old Man of the Franconia Mountains.
uz: Hatto Barbican va M'Nicholl ham bu toshlarning joylashuvidagi tartibga va tartibga o'xshashlikni aniqlay olishgan, ammo ular buni, albatta, Lurlei tosh, Giant's Causeway yoki Franconia tog'larining keksa kishilari kabi tabiatning oddiy begonaligi deb ko'rishgan.

en: Ardan, however, would not accept such an easy mode of getting rid of a difficulty.
uz: Biroq, Ardan qiyinchiliklardan xalos bo'lishning bunday oson usulini qabul qilmaydi.

en: "See the ruins on that bluff," he exclaimed; "those steep sides must have been washed by a great river in the prehistoric times.
uz: U shunday dedi: "O'sha bluffdagi xarobalarga e'tibor bering; o'sha tepa tomonlar tarixiy davrlarda buyuk daryo tomonidan yuvilib ketgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: That was the fortress.
uz: Bu qalʼa edi.

en: Farther down lay the city.
uz: Shaharni yanada pastroq joylashtirgan.

en: There are the dismantled ramparts; why, there's the very coping of a portico still intact!
uz: Bu yerda vayron qilingan devorlar bor; nima bo'lganda ham, bu yerda hali ham saqlanib qolgan portikning o'ziga xos o'zgarishi bor!

en: Don't you see three broken pillars lying beside their pedestals?
uz: Uchta buzilgan ustunlarning piyodalari yonida yotganini ko'rmayapsizmi?

en: a little to the left of those arches that evidently once bore the pipes of an aqueduct!
uz: Bir vaqtlar akvedekt quvurlari bor bo'lgan o'sha archalarning chap tomonida biroz!

en: Well, look a little to the right, and there is something that you can see!
uz: O'ng tomonga biroz qarab ko'ringlar, siz ko'ra oladigan bir narsa bor!

en: As I'm a living man I have no difficulty in discerning the gigantic butments of a great bridge that formerly spanned that immense river!" Did he really see all this?
uz: Men tirik odam bo'lganim uchun, ilgari o'sha ulkan daryo bo'ylab o'tgan buyuk ko'prikning ulkan bo'laklarini ko'rishda hech qanday qiyinchilik tug'olmaydi!" - dedi u.

en: To this day he affirms stoutly that he did, and even greater wonders besides.
uz: Bugungi kunga qadar u buni qatʼiylik bilan tasdiqlaydi va bundan tashqari yana koʻproq moʻʼjizalar yaratadi.

en: His companions, however, without denying that he had good grounds for his assertion on this subject or questioning the general accuracy of his observations, content themselves with saying that the reason why they had failed to discover the wonderful city, was that Ardan's telescope was of a strange and peculiar construction.
uz: Biroq, uning yo'lboshchilari bu borada uning e'tiqodining asosliligini inkor qilmasdan yoki uning kuzatishlarining umumiy aniqligini shubha ostiga qo'ymagan holda, ular ajoyib shaharni kashf etishda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganining sababi Ardan teleskopining g'ayrioddiy va o'ziga xos qurilishi bo'lganiga to'g'ri keladi, deb aytishga rozi bo'lishdi.

en: Being somewhat short-sighted, he had had it manufactured expressly for his own use, but it was of such singular power that his companions could not use it without hurting their eyes.
uz: U biroz qisqa ko'rinadigan bo'lgani uchun, uni o'z foydasi uchun ishlab chiqargan edi, ammo u shunchalik ajoyib qudratga ega ediki, uning hamkorlari uni ko'zlarini og'ritmasdan ishlatolmadilar.

en: But, whether the ruins were real or not, the moments were evidently too precious to be lost in idle discussion.
uz: Ammo bu vayronliklar haqiqiy bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, bu vaqtlar behuda bahs-munozaralarda yo'qolish uchun juda qimmatli edi.

en: The great city of the Selenites soon disappeared on the remote horizon, and, what was of far greater importance, the distance of the Projectile from the Moon's disc began to increase so sensibly that the smaller details of the surface were soon lost in a confused mass, and it was only the lofty heights, the wide craters, the great ring mountains, and the vast plains that still continued to give sharp, distinctive outlines.
uz: Selenitlarning buyuk shahri tez orada uzoq horizontda yo'q bo'lib ketadi va bundan ham muhimroq bo'lgan narsa shundaki, Proyektilning oy diskidan uzoqligi shunchalik sezilarli darajada oshdiki, uning yuzidagi kichik tafsilotlar tez orada chalg'itadigan massada yo'qoldi va faqat baland balandliklar, keng kraterlar, katta do'zax tog'lari va keng o'tlar hali ham keskin, o'ziga xos konturlar berishda davom etdi.

en: A little to their left, the travellers could now plainly distinguish one of the most remarkable of the Moon's craters, Newton, so well known to all lunar astronomers.
uz: Biroz chap tomonida sayohatchilar endi oyning eng diqqatga sazovor kraterlaridan birini, Newtonni, barcha oy astronomiyalari uchun tanigan holda aniq ajrata olishdi.

en: Its ramparts, forming a perfect circle, rise to such a height, at least ൣൣ,ൡൡൡ feet, as to seem insurmountable.
uz: Uning devorlari mukammal to'plamni tashkil etib, hech bo'lmaganda 1 metr balandlikka ko'tarilgan, bu esa yengilmasdek tuyuladi.

en: "You can, no doubt, notice for yourselves," said Barbican, "that the external height of this mountain is far from being equal to the depth of its crater.
uz: "Sizlar, shubhasiz, ushbu tog'ning tashqi balandligi uning kraterining chuqurligiga teng emasligini o'zingiz ko'rishingiz mumkin", dedi Barbican.

en: The enormous pit, in fact, seems to be a soundless sea of pitchy black, the bottom of which the Sun's rays have never reached.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, ulkan chuqurlik, quyosh nurlari hech qachon quyosh quyosh nurlarining quyigacha yetmagan, qalin qora dengiz kabi ko'rinadi.

en: There, as Humboldt says, reigns eternal darkness, so absolute that Earth-shine or even Sunlight is never able to dispel it.
uz: U yerda, Humboldt aytganidek, abadiy zulmat hukmronlik qiladi, u shunchalik mutlaqo bo'ladiki, Yer yorug'ligi yoki hatto Quyosh nuri uni hech qachon yo'q qila olmaydi.

en: Had Michael's friends the old mythologists ever known anything about it, they would doubtless have made it the entrance to the infernal regions.
uz: Agar Mayklning do'stlari, eski mitologlar bu haqda hech narsa bilgan bo'lsa, shubhasiz, ular uni jahannam hududlariga kirish yo'li qilib qo'yishgan bo'lardi.

en: On the whole surface of our Earth, there is no mountain even remotely resembling it.
uz: Yer yuzi yuzida hech bir tog' unga o'xshamaydi.

en: It is a perfect type of the lunar crater.
uz: Bu oy kraterining mukammal turi.

en: Like most of them, it shows that the peculiar formation of the Moon's surface is due, first, to the cooling of the lunar crust; secondly, to the cracking from internal pressure; and, thirdly, to the violent volcanic action in consequence.
uz: Ularning aksariyati singari, u o'z-o'zidan ko'rinib turibdiki, oy yuzasining o'ziga xos shakllanishi, birinchidan, oy qornining sovuqlanishi; ikkinchidan, ichki bosim tufayli parchalanishi; uchinchidan, natijada kuchli volkanik harakatlar tufayli sodir bo'ladi.

en: This must have been of a far fiercer nature than it has ever been with us.
uz: Bu biz bilan sodir bo'lgan voqealardan ancha qattiqroq bo'lishi kerak.

en: The matter was ejected to a vast height till great mountains were formed; and still the action went on, until at last the floor of the crater sank to a depth far lower than the level of the external plain." "You may be right," said Ardan by way of reply; "as for me, I'm looking out for another city.
uz: Bu hodisa ulkan togʻlar paydo boʻlguncha balandlikka chiqarib tashlandi va harakat davom etdi, nihoyat kraterning tuprogʻi tashqi tekislik darajasiga qaraganda ancha pastroq chuqurlikka tushib ketdi". "Siz haqli boʻlishingiz mumkin", dedi Ardan javob tariqasida; "men boshqa shaharni kutyapman.

en: But I'm sorry to say that our Projectile is increasing its distance so fast that, even if one lay at my feet at this moment, I doubt very much if I could see it a bit better than either you or the Captain." Newton was soon passed, and the Projectile followed a course that took it directly over the ring mountain Moretus.
