uz: Ammo men o'ylaymanki, bizning o'rnatilgan raketamiz o'z masofasini shunchalik tez uzaytirmoqdaki, hatto hozirgi paytda bir kishi oyoqlarimda yotgan bo'lsa ham, men uni siz yoki kapitandan biroz yaxshiroq ko'rishimga juda shubha qilaman".Nyuton tez orada o'tdi va raketamiz uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Moretus tog'i ustida olib ketgan yo'lni bosib o'tdi.

en: A little to the west the travellers could easily distinguish the summits of Blancanus, ൨,ൡൡൡ feet high, and, towards seven o'clock in the evening, they were approaching the neighborhood of Clavius.
uz: Biroz g'arbga ketib, sayohatchilar Blankanusning balandligi 2 metr bo'lgan tepaliklarini osonlikcha ko'rishardi va kechqurun yetti soat atrofida Clavius yaqinlashdilar.

en: This walled-plain, one of the most remarkable on the Moon, lies ൦൦° S.
uz: Ayning eng diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri bo'lgan bu devorli tekislik ° S-da joylashgan.

en: Its height is estimated at ൢ൧,ൡൡൡ feet, but it is considered to be about a hundred and fifty miles in diameter.
uz: Uning balandligi , fut bo'lib taxmin qilinadi, ammo deyarli 150 mil diametrli deb hisoblanadi.

en: Of this vast crater, the travellers now at a distance of ൣ൦ൡ miles, reduced to ൣ-ൢ/ൣ by their telescopes, had a magnificent bird's-eye view.
uz: Ushbu yirik kraterdan sayohatchilar, endi  mil masofada, teleskoplari orqali -/ ga kamaytirilgan holda, ajoyib qush ko'rinishiga ega edilar.

en: "Our terrestrial volcanoes," said Barbican, "as you can now readily judge for yourselves, are no more than molehills when compared with those of the Moon.
uz: "Bizning yer yuzidagi vulqonlarimiz, endi siz o'zingizdan o'ylashingiz mumkin bo'lganidek, oydagi vulqonlar bilan taqqoslaganda, ko'tarilgan tog'lardan ko'ra ko'proq emas.

en: Measure the old craters formed by the early eruptions of Vesuvius and Ætna, and you will find them little more than three miles in diameter.
uz: Vesuviy va Etna vulqonlarining erta portlashlari natijasida hosil bo'lgan eski kraterlarni o'lchashga harakat qiling va ularni deyarli uch mil diametrdan ozroq topasiz.

en: The crater of Cantal in central France is only about six miles in width; the famous valley in Ceylon, called the Crater, though not at all due to volcanic action, is ൥൥ miles across and is considered to be the greatest in the world.
uz: Fransiyaning markaziy qismidagi Kantal kraterining eni atigi olti milga yaqin bo'lib, Ceylondagi mashhur vodiy, volkanik harakatlar tufayli emas bo'lsa-da,  milga teng bo'lib, dunyodagi eng katta vodiy hisoblanadi.

en: But even this is very little in comparison to the diameter of Clavius lying beneath us at the present moment."
uz: Ammo hatto bu ham hozirgi paytda bizdan pastda joylashgan Claviusning diametrini taqqoslaganda juda kamdir".

en: "How much is its diameter?" asked the Captain.
uz: "Uning diametri qancha?" - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "At least one hundred and forty-two miles," replied Barbican; "it is probably the greatest in the Moon, but many others measure more than a hundred miles across." "Dear boys," said Ardan, half to himself, half to the others, "only imagine the delicious state of things on the surface of the gentle Moon when these craters, brimming over with hissing lava, were vomiting forth, all at the same time, showers of melted stones, clouds of blinding smoke, and sheets of blasting flame!
uz: "Yog'i yuz qirq ikki mil", - deb javob berdi Barbican; "u, ehtimol, oydagi eng katta, ammo ko'plari yuz mildan ortiq bo'lib o'tadi". - Ardan o'ziga yarim, boshqalarga yarim, - dedi Ardan, - bu go'zal oy yuzidagi narsalarning mazali holatini tasavvur qiling, bu kraterlar, shishish-shishlab ketgan lavadan to'lib-toshgan, bir vaqtning o'zida, erib ketgan toshlarning sho'rlari, ko'rdiruvchi tut bulutlari va o'simlik olovining laqablari bilan qovurib ketganida!

en: What an intensely overpowering spectacle was here presented once, but now, how are the mighty fallen!
uz: Bu yerda bir vaqtlar naqadar qudratli ko'rgazma namoyish etilgan edi, ammo endi qudratlilar qanday qulab ketgan!

en: Our Moon, as at present beheld, seems to be nothing more than the skinny spectre left after a brilliant display of fireworks, when the spluttering crackers, the glittering wheels, the hissing serpents, the revolving suns, and the dazzling stars, are all 'played out', and nothing remains to tell of the gorgeous spectacle but a few blackened sticks and half a dozen half burned bits of pasteboard.
uz: Ayimiz hozirgi ko'rinishida, o'zidan-o'zidan chiroyli o'yin-kulgilar ko'rsatilganidan so'ng qolgan kamolga o'xshaydi, bu yerda to'qnashgan krakerlar, chiroyli velosipedlar, g'iybatli ilonlar, aylanayotgan quyoshlar va chiroyli yulduzlar "o'ynaydi", va ajoyib ko'rinish haqida bir necha qora bo'lgan tayoq va yarim dozayn o'rta yondirilgan pastavratdan boshqa hech narsa aytilmaydi.

en: I should like to hear one of you trying to explain the cause, the reason, the principle, the philosophy of such tremendous cataclysms!" Barbican's only reply was a series of nods, for in truth he had not heard a single word of Ardan's philosophic explosion.
uz: Sizlardan biri bunday dahshatli halokatlarning sababini, sababini, tamoyilini va falsafasini tushuntirishga harakat qilayotganini eshitishni xohlayman!" - dedi Barbicanning yagona javobi bir qator bosh ko'tarish edi, chunki aslida u Ardanning falsafiy portlashi haqida bir so'z ham eshitmagan edi.

en: His ears were with his eyes, and these were obstinately bent on the gigantic ramparts of Clavius, formed of concentric mountain ridges, which were actually leagues in depth.
uz: Uning quloqlari ko'zlar bilan bog'liq edi va ular o'zlarining chuqurligi bilan teng bo'lgan konsentrik tog' shoxlaridan tashkil topgan Claviusning ulkan devorlariga qat'iy tikilgan edi.

en: On the floor of the vast cavity, could be seen hundreds of smaller craters, mottling it like a skimming dish, and pierced here and there by sharp peaks, one of which could hardly be less than ൢ൦,ൡൡൡ feet high.
uz: Katta cho'g'ning tuprog'ida yuzlab kichikroq kraterlar ko'rinardi, ular o'tkir-o'tkir idish kabi bo'g'ib-bo'g'ib, bu yerda-bu yerda keskin cho'qqizlar bilan o'rab-o'rab bo'lgan, ulardan biri balandligi 2 metrdan kam bo'lishi mumkin emas edi.

en: All around, the plain was desolate in the extreme.
uz: Butun atrofda o'lchov juda charchagan edi.

en: You could not conceive how anything could be barrener than these serrated outlines, or gloomier than these shattered mountains—until you looked at the plain that encircled them.
uz: Siz hech qanday narsa bu keskin ko'rinishlardan yoki bu parchalangan tog'lardan ko'ra ko'proq qorong'i bo'lishi mumkinligini tasavvur ham qila olmas edingiz, chunki siz ularni o'rab olgan tekislikka nazar solmas edingiz.

en: Ardan hardly exaggerated when he called it the scene of a battle fought thousands of years ago but still white with the hideous bones of overthrown peaks, slaughtered mountains and mutilated precipices!
uz: Ardan uni minglab yillar oldin o'tkazilgan, ammo hali ham oq bo'lgan jang maydoni deb ataganida, bu o'ta katta bo'lmagan edi, chunki u yerda quvib ketgan tepaliklar, qirg'inlangan tog'lar va shikastlangan cho'llarning qo'rqinchli suyaklari bor edi!

en: "Hills amid the air encountered hills, Hurled to and fro in jaculation dire,"
uz: "Hikmatdagi tog'lar tog'lar bilan uchraydi, g'azabga to'lib-toshgan tog'lar bilan to'xtab-toshgan edi"

en: murmured M'Nicholl, who could quote you Milton quite as readily as the Bible.
uz: M'Nicholl sizdan Miltonning so'zlarini Muqaddas Kitobga o'xshatsa bo'ladi.

en: "This must have been the spot," muttered Barbican to himself, "where the brittle shell of the cooling sphere, being thicker than usual, offered greater resistance to an eruption of the red-hot nucleus.
uz: "Bu o'ziga xos joy bo'lishi kerak edi", - dedi Barbican o'ziga-o'zi, - "suyuqlanish sferasining buzg'unchi shellining odatdagidan tikanroq bo'lgani, qizil qizil yadrolarning portlashi uchun katta qarshilik ko'rsatgan joy edi.

en: Hence these piled up buttresses, and these orderless heaps of consolidated lava and ejected scoriæ." The Projectile advanced, but the scene of desolation seemed to remain unchanged.
uz: Shuning uchun bular to'plamlarga to'lib-toshgan, bular esa mustahkamlangan lavadan iborat tartibsiz to'plamlar bo'lib, qo'zg'olonlarni chiqarib yuborgan edi".

en: Craters, ring mountains, pitted plateaus dotted with shapeless wrecks, succeeded each other without interruption.
uz: Kraterlar, do'zax tog'lari, shaklsiz xarobalarga to'lib-toshgan pitted platolar bir-biriga uzluksiz davom etdi.

en: For level plain, for dark "sea," for smooth plateau, the eye here sought in vain.
uz: Tekis joy uchun, qorong'u "dengiz" uchun, tekis joy uchun, bu yerda ko'z behuda izladi.

en: It was a Swiss Greenland, an Icelandic Norway, a Sahara of shattered crust studded with countless hills of glassy lava.
uz: Bu Shveytsariya Grinlandiyasi, Islandiya Norvegiyasi, ko'plab shishali lav tog'lari bilan to'lib-toshgan parchalangan qurt Sahara edi.

en: At last, in the very centre of this blistered region, right too at its very culmination, the travellers came on the brightest and most remarkable mountain of the Moon.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, ushbu bulutli hududning o'zida, ayniqsa uning eng yuqori darajasida sayohatchilar Oyning eng yorqin va eng diqqatga sazovor tog'iga yetib kelishdi.

en: In the dazzling Tycho they found it an easy matter to recognize the famous lunar point, which the world will for ever designate by the name of the distinguished astronomer of Denmark.
uz: Qizillatadigan Tychoda ular mashhur oy nuqtasini tan olishni oson deb topdilar, bu nuqta butun dunyo Danimarkning taniqli astronomining ismi bilan abadiy tanlanadi.

en: This brilliant luminosity of the southern hemisphere, no one that ever gazes at the Full Moon in a cloudless sky, can help noticing.
uz: Janubiy yarim jahonning bu yorqin yorug'ligi, bulutsiz osmonda to'liq oyga qaragan hech kim buni payqamaydi.

en: Ardan, who had always particularly admired it, now hailed it as an old friend, and almost exhausted breath, imagination and vocabulary in the epithets with which he greeted this cynosure of the lunar mountains.
uz: Har doim uni juda qadrlagan Ardan uni qadimgi do'stim deb maqtagan va o'sha oy tog'larining bu sinosurasiga salom bergan epitetlaridagi nafas, tasavvur va so'zbuzarlik deyarli to'xtab qolgan.

en: "Hail!" he cried, "thou blazing focus of glittering streaks, thou coruscating nucleus of irradiation, thou starting point of rays divergent, thou egress of meteoric flashes!
uz: U: "Yaxshi damlar, yorqin yorug'lik, nurlanishning yorug'ligi, farqlovchi nurlarning boshlang'ich nuqtasi, meteorik chaqmoqlarning chiqishi!

en: Hub of the silver wheel that ever rolls in silent majesty over the starry plains of Night!
uz: Kechagi yulduzli o'rmonlar ustida hech qachon so'zsiz ulug'vorlikda aylanib yuradigan kumush g'ildirakning markazidir!

en: Paragon of jewels enchased in a carcanet of dazzling brilliants!
uz: Paragon g'ayritabiiy asboblar karkanetida o'rnatilgan g'ayritabiiy asboblar!

en: Eye of the universe, beaming with heavenly resplendescence!
uz: Koinotning ko'zi, osmon parvarishi bilan nurlanmoqda!

en: "Who shall say what thou art?
uz: "Sen nima ekaningni kim aytadi?

en: The golden clasp of her floating robes?
uz: Uning uchib borayotgan liboslarining oltin to'plami?

en: The blazing head of the great bolt that rivets the lunar hemispheres in union inseverable?
uz: Oʻz navbatida, oy yarim qirrali qismlarini birlashtiradigan katta boltning olovli boshi birlashtirilishi mumkin emasmi?

en: Or cans't thou have been some errant bolide, which missing its way, butted blindly against the lunar face, and there stuck fast, like a Minie ball mashed against a cast-iron target?
uz: Yoki yo'ldan adashgan, o'z yo'lidan adashgan, ko'r bo'lib, oy yuziga to'g'ri kelgan va o'sha yerda mini ballga o'xshab, bir temirdan o'ralgan maqsadga to'g'ri tushmagan bo'lsang bo'lmasmidi?

en: Not even Barbican is
uz: Hatto Barbican ham yo'q

en: able to penetrate thy mystery.
uz: Sizning siringizni o'rganishga qodir.

en: But one thing I know.
uz: Lekin bir narsani bilaman.

en: Thy dazzling glare so sore my eyes hath made that longer on thy light to gaze I do not dare.
uz: Sening ko'zlarimdagi chiroyli yorug'lik, ko'zlarimdagi yorug'likni ko'rishga shuncha vaqt qo'shganki, men bunga jur'at qilmayman.

en: Captain, have you any smoked glass?" In spite of this anti-climax, Ardan's companions could hardly consider his utterings either as ridiculous or over enthusiastic.
uz: Kapitan, sizda tutatilgan shisha bormi?" - degan savolga javob berdi Ardanning do'stlari, bu g'alabaga qaramay, uning so'zlashlarini na kulgili, na juda hayajonli deb bilmasdi.

en: They could easily excuse his excitement on the subject.
uz: Ular uning bu mavzuda bo'lgan hayajonini osonlikcha uzrlashlari mumkin edi.

en: And so could we, if we only remember that Tycho, though nearly a quarter of a million miles distant, is such a luminous point on the lunar disc, that almost any moonlit night it can be easily perceived by the unaided terrestrial eye.
uz: Biz ham shunday bo'lishimiz mumkin edi, agar faqatgina Tycho, deyarli million kilometr uzoqlikda bo'lsa-da, oy diskidagi shunday yorqin nuqta ekanligini eslasak, deyarli har qanday oy yorug'li kecha uni yer yuzidagi ko'z yordamisiz osonlikcha ko'rish mumkin.

en: What then must have been its splendor in the eyes of our travellers whose telescopes brought it actually four thousand times nearer!
uz: O'sha paytda, uni teleskoplari bilan to'rt ming baravar yaqinlashtirgan sayohatchilarimiz ko'z o'ngida bu naqadar ajoyib bo'lgan!

en: No wonder that with smoked glasses, they endeavored to soften off its effulgent glare!
uz: Shuning uchun, ular o'tkir ko'zoynaklar bilan uning chiroyli yorug'ligini yumshatishga harakat qilishgani ajablanarli emas!

en: Then in hushed silence, or at most uttering at intervals a few interjections expressive of their intense admiration, they remained for some time completely engrossed in the overwhelming spectacle.
uz: So'ngra xotirjamlik bilan, yoki, eng muhimi, vaqti-vaqti bilan o'zlarining katta hayratlanishini ifodalaydigan bir nechta interjeksiyalarni aytish bilan ular bir muncha vaqt davomida bu dahshatli spektaklga to'liq o'zlashtirildilar.

en: For the time being, every sentiment, impression, thought, feeling on their part, was concentrated in the eye, just as at other times under violent excitement every throb of our life is concentrated in the heart.
uz: Hozircha har qanday his-tuyg'u, taassurot, fikr va his-tuyg'u ko'zga to'g'ri keladi, xuddi o'zga paytlarda g'azabga to'lganimizda hayotimizning har bir urishi yurakga to'g'ri keladi.

en: Tycho belongs to the system of lunar craters that is called radiating, like Aristarchus or Copernicus, which had been already seen and highly admired by our travellers at their first approach to the Moon.
uz: Tycho Ayga birinchi marta yaqinlashganda sayohatchilarimiz tomonidan ko'rilgan va juda hayratda bo'lgan Aristarx yoki Kopernik kabi nurlanish deb nomlangan oy kraterlari tizimiga kiradi.

en: But it is decidedly the most remarkable and conspicuous of them all.
uz: Ammo bu, albatta, ularning hammasidan eng diqqatga sazovor va diqqatga sazovor.

en: It occupies the great focus of disruption, whence it sends out great streaks thousands of miles in length; and it gives the most unmistakable evidence of the terribly eruptive nature of those forces that once shattered the Moon's solidified shell in this portion of the lunar surface.
uz: U buzg'unchilikning katta markazini egallaydi va minglab millar uzunlikda katta bo'laklarni yuboradi; va u bir vaqtlar oy yuzasining ushbu qismida oyning mustahkamlangan shellini buzgan kuchlarning dahshatli portlash xususiyatining eng aniq dalillarini beradi.

en: Situated in the southern latitude of ൥൤° by an eastern longitude of ൢൣ°, Tycho's crater, somewhat elliptical in shape, is ൦൥ miles in diameter and upwards of ൢ൧,ൡൡൡ feet in depth.
uz: °ning janubiy eni bilan °ning sharqiy uzunligi bilan joylashgan Tycho kraterining shakli biroz elliptik bo'lib, diametri  mil va chuqurligi , fut bo'lgan.

en: Its lofty ramparts are buttressed by other mountains, Mont Blancs in size, all grouped around it, and all streaked with the great divergent fissures that radiate from it as a centre.
uz: Uning baland devorlari boshqa tog'lar, o'lchamli Mont Blank tomonidan mustahkamlanadi, ularning barchasi uning atrofida to'plangan va ularning barchasi markaz sifatida u yerdan oqib o'tadigan katta bo'g'riqlar bilan qoplangan.

en: Of what this incomparable mountain really is, with all these lines of projections converging towards it and with all these prominent points of relief protruding within its crater, photography has, so far, been
uz: Ushbu tengsiz tog'ning asl mohiyati, unga yaqinlashib borayotgan ko'rinadigan ko'rinishlar va uning kraterida ko'rinadigan barcha ko'plab ko'rinadigan relief nuqtalari bilan fotografiya hozircha o'z ichiga olgan.

en: able to give us only a very unsatisfactory idea.
uz: Bu bizga faqat juda qoniqarsiz g'oya berishga qodir.

en: The reason too is very simple: it is only at Full Moon that Tycho reveals himself in all his splendor.
uz: Buning sababi ham juda sodda: faqat to'liq oyda Tycho o'zini butun go'zalligi bilan oshkor qiladi.

en: The shadows therefore vanishing, the perspective foreshortenings disappear and the views become little better than a dead blank.
uz: Shuning uchun soyalar yo'q bo'lib ketadi, istiqbol qisqartmalari yo'qoladi va ko'rinishlar o'lik bo'sh joydan oz yaxshiroq bo'ladi.

en: This is the more to be regretted as this wonderful region is well worthy of being represented with the greatest possible photographic accuracy.
uz: Buning uchun bundan ko'proq afsuslanish kerak, chunki bu ajoyib hudud imkon qadar ko'proq fotosurat aniqligi bilan suratga olinishga arziydi.

en: It is a vast agglomeration of holes, craters, ring formations, a complicated intersection of crests—in short, a distracting volcanic network flung over the blistered soil.
uz: Bu toshlar, kraterlar, bog'lanishlar, murakkab cho'qqizlar, qisqa so'zlarda, burchaklarning murakkab kesishida joylashgan katta to'plamdir, bu to'plamli tuproq ustidan tashlangan chalg'itadigan volkanik tarmoq.

en: The ebullitions of the central eruption still evidently preserve their original form.
uz: Markaziy portlashning qizg'inligi hali ham asl shaklini saqlab qolmoqda.

en: As they first appeared, so they lie.
uz: Ular ilk bor paydo bo'lganida, yolg'on gapirishadi.

en: Crystallizing as they cooled, they have stereotyped in imperishable characters the aspect formerly presented by the whole Moon's surface under the influences of recent plutonic upheaval.
uz: Ular sovuq bo'lganida kristalllashtirib, o'tmishda butun oy yuzi tomonidan yaqinda sodir bo'lgan plutonik g'alati ta'siri ostida taqdim etilgan xususiyatni o'zlarining o'tmishda o'lmas belgilarida stereotiplashtirdilar.

en: Our travellers were far more fortunate than the photographers.
uz: Sayohatchilarimiz fotosuratchilarga qaraganda ancha baxtliroq bo'lishdi.

en: The distance separating them from the peaks of Tycho's concentric terraces was not so considerable as to conceal the principal details from a very satisfactory view.
uz: Ularni Tyxoning konsentrik terasalarining cho'qqislaridan ajratib turgan masofa asosiy tafsilotlarni juda qoniqarli ko'rinishdan yashirish uchun shunchalik katta emas edi.

en: They could easily distinguish the annular ramparts of the external circumvallation, the mountains buttressing the gigantic walls internally as well as externally, the vast esplanades descending irregularly and abruptly to the sunken plains all around.
uz: Ular tashqaridagi atrof-muhitning sarosimali devorlarini, katta devorlarni ichkari va tashqarida mustahkamlaydigan tog'larni, atrofdagi cho'kkan dengizlarga muntazam ravishda va keskin ravishda tushayotgan ulkan esplanadlarni osonlikcha aniqlay olishardi.

en: They could even detect a difference of a few hundred feet in altitude in favor of the western or right hand side over the eastern.
uz: Ular hatto bir necha yuz fut balandlikda g'arb yoki o'ng tomondan sharqiy tomondan farq qilishini aniqlashi mumkin edi.

en: They could also see that these dividing ridges were actually inaccessible and completely unsurmountable, at least by ordinary terrestrian efforts.
uz: Shuningdek, ular ushbu bo'linma chiziqlarining, hech bo'lmaganda, oddiy yerdagi harakatlar bilan, aslida yetib bo'lmaydigan va butunlay o'zgarmasligini ko'rishgan.

en: No system of castrametation ever devised by Polybius or Vauban could bear the slightest comparison with such vast fortifications, A city built on the floor of the circular cavity could be no more reached by the outside Lunarians than if it had been built in the planet Mars.
uz: Polybius yoki Vauban tomonidan yaratilgan hech qanday kastrametatsiya tizimi bunday keng qo'riqlarga nisbatan eng kam darajada chiday olmaydi, aylanma tuxumning qavatida qurilgan shahar Mars sayyorasida qurilganidan ko'ra, tashqi lunarlar tomonidan ko'proq yetib borolmaydi.

en: This idea set Ardan off again.
uz: Ushbu g'oya Ardanni yana qo'zg'atdi.

en: "Yes," said he, "such a city would be at once completely inaccessible, and still not inconveniently situated in a plateau full of aspects decidedly picturesque.
uz: "Ha, shunday shahar bir vaqtning o'zida to'liq yetib bo'lmaydi va hali ham o'ta chiroyli jihatlarga to'la platoda noqulay joylashtirilmaydi.

en: Even in the depths of this immense crater, Nature, as you can see, has left no flat and empty void.
uz: Hatto ushbu ulkan kraterning chuqurliklarida ham tabiat, siz ko'rib turganingizdek, hech qanday to'siq va bo'sh joy qoldirmagan.

en: You can easily trace its special oreography, its various mountain systems which turn it into a regular world on a small scale.
uz: Uning maxsus oreografiyasi, turli tog'lar tizimlari uni kichik miqyosda odatdagi dunyoga aylantiradi.

en: Notice its cones, its central hills, its valleys, its substructures already
uz: Uning shkaflarini, markazdagi tepaliklarini, vodiylarini, tarkibiy tuzilmalarini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: cut and dry and therefore quietly prepared to receive the masterpieces of Selenite architecture.
uz: O'chirish va quritish, shuning uchun Selenit arxitekturasining mustakroriy asarlarini qabul qilish uchun sukut tayyorlangan.

en: Down there to the left is a lovely spot for a Saint Peter's; to the right, a magnificent site for a Forum; here a Louvre could be built capable of entrancing Michael Angelo himself; there a citadel could be raised to which even Gibraltar would be a molehill!
uz: Sol tomonida - Sankt-Peterning go'zal joyi; o'ng tomonida - Forum uchun ajoyib joy; bu yerda Mixael Angeloni o'ziga jalb qilishga qodir Louvre bunyod etilishi mumkin; u erda hatto Gibraltar shahriga o'xshaydigan qal'on ko'tarilishi mumkin!

en: In the middle rises a sharp peak which can hardly be less than a mile in height—a grand pedestal for the statue of some Selenite Vincent de Paul or George Washington.
uz: O'rtada o'tkir cho'qqiz ko'tariladi, bu balandligi bir mildan kam bo'lishi mumkin emas.Selenitlardan bo'lgan Vinsent de Pol yoki Jorj Vashingtonga mo'ljallangan haykalning ulkan pedestasi.

en: And around them all is a mighty mountain-ring at least ൤ miles high, but which, to an eye looking from the centre of our vast city, could not appear to be more than five or six hundred feet.
uz: Va ularning hammasini o'rab olgan holda, hech bo'lmaganda millar balandlikda bo'lgan, ammo bizning ulkan shaharimizning markazidan ko'rinadigan ko'z uchun besh yoki olti yuz futdan ortiq bo'lmagan kuchli tog'lar bor.

en: Enormous circus, where mighty Rome herself in her palmiest days, though increased tenfold, would have no reason to complain for want of room!" He stopped for a few seconds, perhaps to take breath, and then resumed: "Oh what an abode of serene happiness could be constructed within this shadow-fringed ring of the mighty mountains!
uz: Ulkan sirk, bu erda qudratli Rim o'z kunlarida, o'n baravar ko'paygan bo'lsa-da, o'rinsiz qolish uchun shikoyat qilish uchun hech qanday sababga ega bo'lmaydi! "U bir necha soniya to'xtadi, ehtimol nafas olish uchun, so'ngra yana davom etdi: "Oh, bu kuchli tog'larning soya-barakli anjangida qanday tinch baxtning manzili qurilishi mumkin!

en: O blessed refuge, unassailable by aught of human ills!
uz: Ey muborak panoh, insoniyatning hech qanday zararidan himoyalanmaydigan panoh!

en: What a calm unruffled life could be enjoyed within thy hallowed precincts, even by those cynics, those haters of humanity, those disgusted reconstructors of society, those misanthropes and misogynists old and young, who are continually writing whining verses in odd corners of the newspapers!" "Right at last, Ardan, my boy!" cried M'Nicholl, quietly rubbing the glass of his spectacles; "I should like to see the whole lot of them carted in there without a moment's delay!" "It couldn't hold the half of them!" observed Barbican drily.
uz: Sizning muqaddas hududingizda qanday tinch va xotirjam hayot kechirish mumkin, hatto o'sha siniklar, insoniyatdan nafratlanganlar, jamiyatning jirkanch rekonstruktorlari, eski va yosh misantroplar va ayollarga qarshi o'zlarining ko'ngillari bilan gazetalarning g'alati burchaklarida doimo g'ayratli so'zlarni yozadigan ayollarning o'zi ham!" - dedi M'Nichol.

en: It was not until the Projectile had passed a little beyond Tycho's immense concavity that Barbican and his friends had a good opportunity for observing the brilliant streaks sent so wonderfully flying in all directions from this celebrated mountain as a common centre.
uz: Faqatgina "Projektil" Tyxoning ulkan g'ovuridan biroz pastga o'tgandan so'ng, Barbican va uning do'stlari ushbu mashhur tog'dan barcha yo'nalishlarda ajoyib tarzda uchib o'tgan shinam yo'nalishlarni umumiy markaz sifatida kuzatish uchun yaxshi imkoniyatga ega bo'lishdi.

en: They examined them for some time with the closest attention.
uz: Ular bir muncha vaqt davomida ularni diqqat bilan tekshirib ko'rishdi.

en: What could be the nature of this radiating aureola?
uz: Ushbu nurlangan aureolaning tabiati qanday bo'lishi mumkin?

en: By what geological phenomena could this blazing coma have been possibly produced?
uz: Qanday geologik hodisalar tufayli bu olovli koma paydo bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Such questions were the most natural things in the world for Barbican and his companions to propound to themselves, as indeed they have been to every astronomer from the beginning of time, and probably will be to the end.
uz: Bunday savollar Barbican va uning hamkorlari uchun o'zlariga savol berish uchun dunyodagi eng tabiiy narsa edi, chunki ular har bir astronomga vaqtning boshidan beri, ehtimol, oxirgi kungacha shunday bo'ladi.

en: What you can see, what anybody can see on a clear night when the Moon is full—only our friends had all the advantages of a closer view.
uz: Siz ko'rishingiz mumkin bo'lgan narsalarni, faqat bizning do'stlarimiz aniq ko'rishning barcha afzalliklariga ega edi.

en: From Tycho, as a focus, radiated in all directions, as from the head of a peeled orange, more than a hundred luminous streaks or channels, edges raised, middle depressed—or perhaps vice versa, owing to an optical illusion— some at least twelve miles wide, some fully thirty.
uz: Tychodan, diqqat markaz sifatida, har xil yo'nalishlarda, xuddi qovurilgan naranj boshidan, yuzdan ortiq yorqin chiziqlar yoki kanallar, yuqori bo'laklar, o'rta tushkunlik yoki, ehtimol, aksincha, optik illüziya tufayli nurlanishadi ba'zilari kamida o'n ikki mil keng, ba'zilari esa to'liq o'ttiz.

en: In certain directions they ran for a distance of at least six hundred miles, and seemed—especially towards the west, northwest, and north—to cover half the southern hemisphere.
uz: Ba'zi yo'nalishlarda ular kamida olti yuz mil masofani bosib o'tishdi va ayniqsa g'arbiy, shimoli-g'arbiy va shimoli yo'nalishida janubiy yarim yer yuzini qamrab olgan bo'lib ko'rinishdi.

en: One of these flashes extended as far as Neander on the ൥ൡth meridian; another, curving around so
uz: Ushbu chaqmoqlardan biri Neanderga qadar, th meridianida, o'z ichiga olgan; yana birida, bu erda o'z atrofini egib olgan.

en: as to furrow the Mare Nectaris, came to an end on the chain of the Pyrenees, after a course of perhaps a little more than seven hundred miles.
uz: Mare Nectarisni o'rab olish uchun Pyreneyalar zanjirida, ehtimol yetti yuz mildan ko'proq yo'l bosib o'tganidan so'ng, yakunlandi.

en: On the east, some of them barred with luminous network the Mare Nubium and even the Mare Humorum.
uz: Sharqda ulardan ba'zilari Mare Nubium va hatto Mare Humorumni yorug'lik tarmog'i bilan taqiqlashgan.

en: The most puzzling feature of these glittering streaks was that they ran their course directly onward, apparently neither obstructed by valley, crater, or mountain ridge however high.
uz: Ushbu shalqin yo'nalishlarning eng hayratlanarli xususiyati shundaki, ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'lni davom ettirishgan, ehtimol, vodiy, krater yoki tog'lar orqasidan hech qanday to'siq yo'q edi.

en: They all started, as said before, from one common focus, Tycho's crater.
uz: Ularning barchasi, avvaliga aytilganidek, bitta umumiy diqqat markazidan, Tycho krateridan boshlandi.

en: From this they certainly all seemed to emanate.
uz: Shubhasizki, ularning barchasi bulardan kelib chiqqan.

en: Could they be rivers of lava once vomited from that centre by resistless volcanic agency and afterwards crystallized into glassy rock?
uz: Ular o'sha markazdan o'tkazib yuborilgan va o'tmishga qarshilik ko'rsatmagan volkanik agentlik tomonidan keyinchalik shishali toshga aylangan lava daryolari bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: This idea of Herschel's, Barbican had no hesitation in qualifying as exceedingly absurd.
uz: Herschelin, Barbicanning bu g'oyasi juda absurd deb tan olinishda hech qanday shubha qilmagan.

en: Rivers running in perfectly straight lines, across plains, and up as well as down mountains!
uz: To'g'ri to'g'ri chiziqlarda, o'rmonlar bo'ylab, tog'lar ostiga va pastga o'tayotgan daryolar!

en: "Other astronomers," he continued, "have looked on these streaks as a peculiar kind of moraines, that is, long lines of erratic blocks belched forth with mighty power at the period of Tycho's own upheaval." "How do you like that theory, Barbican," asked the Captain.
uz: U davom etdi: "O'zga astronomlar ushbu chiziqlarni o'ziga xos morainalar kabi ko'rishgan, ya'ni Tycho o'z to'qnashuvi davrida kuchli kuch bilan paydo bo'lgan ko'p o'tkir bloklar qatorlari. " "Bu nazariya sizga yoqadi, Barbican", - deb so'radi kapitan.

en: "It's not a particle better than Herschel's," was the reply; "no volcanic action could project rocks to a distance of six or seven hundred miles, not to talk of laying them down so regularly that we can't detect a break in them." "Happy thought!" cried Ardan suddenly; "it seems to me that I can tell the cause of these radiating streaks!" "Let us hear it," said Barbican.
uz: "Bu Herschelinidan yaxshiroq bir zarracha emas", - deb javob berdi ular; "orolning hech qanday harakatlari toshlarni olti yoki yetti yuz mil masofada ko'tarishi mumkin emas, xolos, ularni shunday muntazam ravishda joylashtirib qo'yish haqida gap ketmasa ham, ularda buzilishni aniqlay olmaymiz". "Xursandchilik fikrini!" - dedi Ardan to'satdan. "Menga o'xshaydiki, men bu radiatsiyalar sababini ayta olaman!" - dedi Barbican.

en: "Certainly," was Ardan's reply; "these streaks are all only the parts of what we call a 'star,' as made by a stone striking ice; or by a ball, a pane of glass." "Not bad," smiled Barbican approvingly; "only where is the hand that flung the stone or threw the ball?" "The hand is hardly necessary," replied Ardan, by no means disconcerted; "but as for the ball, what do you say to a comet?" Here M'Nicholl laughed so loud that Ardan was seriously irritated.
uz: "Chindan ham", - deb javob berdi Ardan; "bu bo'laklar biz "yulduz" deb atagan narsalarning faqatgina qismlaridir, ular toshni buzgan muz yoki to'p bilan yasalgan bo'ladi". "Yomon emas", - deb tabassum bilan tabassum qildi Barbican; "to'p qo'l qayerda?" - deb javob berdi Ardan, hech qachon xavotirlanmay: "Qo'l kerak emas", deb javob berdi Ardan; "lekin to'p haqida gap ketganda, kometaga nima deysiz?" - dedi M'Nicholl bu yerda shunchalik baland ovoz bilan kulishdiki, Ardan juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: However, before he could say anything cutting enough to make the Captain mind his manners, Barbican had quickly resumed:
uz: Biroq, kapitanni o'z xulq-atvorini o'zgartirish uchun yetarlicha qat'iy so'zlarni aytishdan oldin, Barbican tezda yana boshlandi:

en: "Dear friend, let the comets alone, I beg of you; the old astronomers fled to them on all occasions and made them explain every difficulty—" —"The comets were all used up long ago—" interrupted M'Nicholl.
uz: "Dor do'stim, kometalarni qo'yib yubor, iltimos; eski astronomlar har safar ularga qochib, har qanday qiyinchilikni tushuntirib berishardi" M'Nicholl: "Kometalarning barchasi uzoq vaqtdan beri ishlagan edi", - deb to'xtatdi.

en: —"Yes," went on Barbican, as serenely as a judge, "comets, they said, had fallen on the surface in meteoric showers and crushed in the crater cavities; comets had dried up the water; comets had whisked off the atmosphere; comets had done everything.
uz: "Ha, - dedi Barbican, hakam kabi xotirjamlik bilan, - kometalar meteoritlar yogʻdirib, kraterlar toshlarida tushib ketgan, suvni quritgan, atmosferaga oʻtirgan, kometalar hamma narsani bajargan, deb aytishdi.

en: All pure assumption!
uz: Barcha to'g'ri tavakkal!

en: In your case, however, friend Michael, no comet whatever is necessary.
uz: Biroq, sizning holatingizda, do'stim Maykl, hech qanday kometa kerak emas.

en: The shock that gave rise to your great 'star' may have come from the interior rather than the exterior.
uz: Sizning buyuk "yulduzingiz" paydo bo'lgan shok tashqi emas, ichki holatdan kelib chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: A violent contraction of the lunar crust in the process of cooling may have given birth to your gigantic 'star' formation." "I accept the amendment," said Ardan, now in the best of humor and looking triumphantly at M'Nicholl.
uz: O'zgarish jarayonida oy qornining kuchli qisqarishi sizning ulkan yulduz to'plamingizga sabab bo'lishi mumkin. "Men o'zgartirishni qabul qilaman", dedi Ardan, endi humorning eng yaxshisi va M'Nichollga g'alaba bilan qaraydi.

en: "An English scientist," continued Barbican, "Nasmyth by name, is decidedly of your opinion, especially ever since a little experiment of his own has confirmed him in it.
uz: "Bir ingliz olim, - dedi Barbican davom etib, - nomidan Nasmyth sizning fikringizga qat'iy qo'shiladi, ayniqsa, uning o'zi o'tkazgan kichik tajribasi uni tasdiqlaganidan beri.

en: He filled a glass globe with water, hermetically sealed it, and then plunged it into a hot bath.
uz: U shishaga suv to'ldirdi, uni ermetik tarzda muhrladi, so'ngra uni issiq hammomga qo'ydi.

en: The enclosed water, expanding at a greater rate than the glass, burst the latter, but, in doing so, it made a vast number of cracks all diverging in every direction from the focus of disruption.
uz: Qatilgan suv, shishaga qaraganda tezroq kengayib, shishaga toshqindi, ammo shunda u ko'pgina bo'g'riliklarni yaratdi va bularning barchasi buzilib ketadigan nuqtalardan har tomonda farq qiladi.

en: Something like this he conceives to have taken place around Tycho.
uz: Uning fikricha, bunday voqealar Tixoning atrofida sodir bo'lgan.

en: As the crust cooled, it cracked.
uz: Quruq sovuq bo'lganida, u parchalanib ketdi.

en: The lava from the interior, oozing out, spread itself on both sides of the cracks.
uz: Ichki qismdan chiqqan lav, chiqarib, tikanlarning har ikki tomonida tarqaldi.

en: This certainly explains pretty satisfactorily why those flat glistening streaks are of much greater width than the fissures through which the lava had at first made its way to the surface." "Well done for an Englishman!" cried Ardan in great spirits.
uz: Bu, albatta, o'sha pishirgan maydonlar nima uchun lava birinchi marta yuzaga kelgan bo'laklardan ancha kengroq ekanini qoniqarli tarzda tushuntiradi". "Ingliz uchun yaxshi ish!" - deb o'yladi Ardan.

en: "He's no Englishman," said M'Nicholl, glad to have an opportunity of coming off with some credit.
uz: "U ingliz emas", - dedi M'Nicholl, ba'zi kredit bilan o'tish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganidan xursand.

en: "He is the famous Scotch engineer who invented the steam hammer, the steam ram, and discovered the 'willow leaves' in the Sun's disc." "Better and better," said Ardan—"but, powers of Vulcan!
uz: "U bug'dagi pichoqni, bug'li qo'yni ixtiro qilgan va Quyosh diskidagi "quruq barglarni" kashf etgan mashhur viskiy muhandisidir". "Yaxshi va yaxshiroq", dedi Ardan" lekin, Vulkan qudratlari!

en: What makes it so hot?
uz: Nima uchun u shunchalik issiq?

en: I'm actually roasting!" This observation was hardly necessary to make his companions conscious that by this time they felt extremely uncomfortable.
uz: Bu e'tibor uning hamrohlariga bu vaqtgacha o'zlarini juda noqulay his qilishlarini tushunish uchun zaruriy emas edi.

en: heat had become quite oppressive.
uz: Issiqlik juda bosimli bo'lib qoldi.

en: Between the natural caloric of the Sun and the reflected caloric of the Moon, the Projectile was fast turning into a regular bake oven.
uz: Quyoshning tabiiy kaloriyasi va oyning aks ettirilgan kaloriyasi o'rtasida, Projectile tezda odatdagi pishirish pechasiga aylanayotgan edi.

en: This transition from intense cold to intense heat was already about quite as much as they could bear.
uz: Kuchli sovuqdan kuchli issiqlikka o'tish ular ko'ra ko'proq narsani ko'targan edi.

en: "What shall we do, Barbican?" asked Ardan, seeing that for some time no one else appeared inclined to say a word.
uz: "Biz nima qilishimiz kerak, Barbican?" - deb so'radi Ardan, chunki bir muncha vaqt davomida boshqa hech kim so'z aytishga moyil bo'lmagan.

en: "Nothing, at least yet awhile, friend Ardan," replied Barbican, "I have been watching the thermometer carefully for the last few minutes, and, though we are at present at ൤൩° centigrade, or ൢൡൡ° Fahrenheit, I have noticed that the mercury is slowly falling.
uz: - Hech narsa, hech bo'lmaganda bir muncha vaqt, do'stim Ardan, - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Men termometrni so'nggi bir necha daqiqadan beri diqqat bilan kuzatib kelayotganman va hozirda biz ° centigrada yoki ° Fahrenheitda bo'lsak-da, qirg'oqning asta-sekin pasayishini payqadim.

en: You can also easily remark for yourself that the floor of the Projectile is turning away more and more from the lunar surface.
uz: Shuningdek, siz o'zingiz ham osonlikcha shuni ta'kidlay olasizki, Projectilning tuprog'i oy yuzasidan tobora ortib bormoqda.

en: From this I conclude quite confidently, and I see that the Captain agrees with me, that all danger of death from intense heat, though decidedly alarming ten minutes ago, is over for the present and, for some time at least, it may be dismissed from further consideration." "I'm not very sorry for it," said Ardan cheerfully; "neither to be baked like a pie in an oven nor roasted like a fat goose before a fire is the kind of death I should like to die of." "Yet from such a death you would suffer no more than your friends the Selenites are exposed to every day of their lives," said the Captain, evidently determined on getting up an argument.
uz: Shundan qat'iy xulosa chiqaram va kapitan mening fikrimga qo'shiladiki, o'n daqiqa oldin qattiq issiqdan o'lish xavfi hozirgi uchun o'z nihoyasiga yetadi va hech bo'lmaganda, bu holat ko'rib chiqilmaydi. "Men bundan juda afsuslanmayman", dedi Ardan xursand bo'lib; "birovda tort kabi pishirilmasligi yoki yong'ingacha yog' bo'g'ay kabi pishirilmasligi - o'limning o'ziga o'xshaydi". "Shunga qaramay, bunday o'limdan siz do'stlaringiz Selenitlarning har bir kunida duchor bo'lishidan ko'ra ko'proq azob chekmaysiz", - dedi kapitan, ehtimol bahslashish uchun qat'iy qaror qilgan.

en: "I understand the full bearing of your allusion, my dear Captain," replied Ardan quickly, but not at all in a tone showing that he was disposed to second M'Nicholl's expectations.
uz: Ardan tezda javob berdi: "Men sizning izohingizning to'liqligini tushunaman, aziz kapitanim", ammo u M'Nichollning umidlariga javob berishga tayyorligini ko'rsatadigan so'z bilan hech qachon javob bermadi.

en: He was, in fact, fast losing all his old habits of positivism.
uz: Aslida, u o'zining eski ijobiy odatlarini tezda yo'qotayotgan edi.

en: Latterly he had seen much, but he had reflected more.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda u ko'p narsalarni ko'rgan, ammo ko'proq fikr yuritgan.

en: The deeper he had reflected, the more inclined he had become to accept the conclusion that the less he knew.
uz: U qanchalik chuqur o'ylab ko'rgan bo'lsa, shunchalik kam bilimga ega bo'lgan xulosaga ko'ra boshlagan.

en: Hence he had decided that if M'Nicholl wanted an argument it should not be with him.
uz: Shuning uchun u M'Nicholning bahs-munozara qilmoqchi bo'lsa, bu uning o'zi bilan bo'lmasligi kerak, deb qaror qildi.

en: All speculative disputes he should henceforth avoid; he would listen with pleasure to all that could be urged on each side; he might even skirmish a little here and there as the spirit moved him; but a regular pitched battle on a subject purely speculative he was fully determined never again to enter into.
uz: Bundan buyon u barcha spekulativ nizolardan qochishi kerak edi; u har bir tarafdan qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan barcha narsalarni quvonch bilan tinglar edi; hatto ruh uni harakatga keltirib, biroz ko'tarishi mumkin edi; lekin u hech qachon o'z ichiga olmaslikka qat'iy qaror qilgan edi.

en: "Yes, dear Captain," he continued, "that pointed arrow of yours has by no means missed its mark, but I can't deny that my faith is
uz: U davom etdi: "Ha, aziz kapitan, sizning o'qingiz hech qachon o'z nishonidan mahrum bo'lmadi, lekin men o'zimning imonim borligini inkor qila olmayman.

en: beginning to be what you call a little 'shaky' in the existence of my friends the Selenites.
uz: Mening do'stlarim Selenitlar mavjudligida siz biroz 'shaky' deb atayotgan narsam bo'lishga boshlanmoqda.

en: However, I should like to have your square opinion on the matter.
uz: Biroq, bu masalada sizning to'g'ri fikringizni eshitishni xohlayman.

en: We have witnessed many strange lunar phenomena lately, closer and clearer than mortal eye ever rested on them before.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda biz ko'plab g'alati oy hodisalariga guvoh bo'ldik, bu hodisalar insoniyat ko'z o'ngida ko'rganidan ko'ra yaqinroq va aniqroq edi.

en: Has what we have seen confirmed any theory of yours or confounded any hypothesis?
uz: Bizning ko'rganlarimiz sizning biror nazariga asos solganmi yoki biron bir g'oyani buzib qo'yganmi?

en: Have you seen enough to induce you to adopt decided conclusions?
uz: Sizda qat'iy xulosalar chiqarishga undash uchun yetarlicha ko'rmadingizmi?

en: I will put the question formally.
uz: Men savolni rasmiy ravishda beraman.

en: Do you, or do you not, think that the Moon resembles the Earth in being the abode of animals and intelligent beings?
uz: Siz o'ylaysizmi yoki yo'qmi, oy hayvonlar va aqlli mavjudotlarning uyi bo'lgani uchun Yerga o'xshaydi?

en: Come, answer, messieurs.
uz: Kelinglar, javob beringlar, xonimlar.

en: Yes, or no?" "I think we can answer your question categorically," replied Barbican, "if you modify its form a little." "Put the question any way you please," said Ardan; "only you answer it!
uz: "Ha, yoki yo'q?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Men o'ylaymanki, biz sizning savolingizga qat'iy javob bera olamiz, agar siz uning shaklini biroz o'zgartirsangiz.

en: I'm not particular about the form." "Good," said Barbican; "the question, being a double one, demands a double answer.
uz: "Yaxshi", dedi Barbican; "so'rov ikki xil javobni talab qiladi.

en: First: Is the Moon inhabitable?
uz: Birinchidan: Oy yashashi mumkinmi?

en: Second: Has the Moon ever been inhabited?" "That's the way to go about it," said the Captain.
uz: Ikkinchidan, oyda hech qachon odamlar yashamaganmi?" - dedi kapitan.

en: "Now then, Ardan, what do you say to the first question?
uz: "Hndi, Ardan, birinchi savolga qanday javob berasan?

en: Yes, or no?" "I really can't say anything," replied Ardan.
uz: "Ha, yo'qmi?" - deb javob berdi Ardan. - Haqiqatan ham hech narsa aytolmayman.

en: "In the presence of such distinguished scientists, I'm only a listener, a 'mere looker on in Vienna' as the Divine Williams has it.
uz: "Bu kabi taniqli olimlar oldida men faqat tinglovchi, ilohiy Vilyamsning aytishicha, "Vyanada shunchaki ko'z o'nglovchi" bo'laman.

en: However, for the sake of argument, suppose I reply in the affirmative, and say that the Moon is inhabitable." "If you do, I shall most unhesitatingly contradict you," said Barbican, feeling just then in splendid humor for carrying on an argument, not, of course, for the sake of contradicting or conquering or crushing or showing off or for any other vulgar weakness of lower minds, but for the noble and indeed the only motive that should impel a philosopher—that of enlightening and convincing, "In taking the negative side, however, or saying that the Moon is not inhabitable, I shall not be satisfied with merely negative arguments.
uz: Biroq, bahslashish uchun, aytingki, men ijobiy javob berib, oy yashashi mumkinligini aytaman". "Agar shunday qilsangiz, men sizga eng qat'iy qarshilik ko'rsataman", - dedi Barbican, o'sha paytda bahslashishni davom ettirish uchun o'zini ajoyib his qilib, albatta, qarshilik ko'rsatish yoki g'alaba qozonish yoki ezib tashlash yoki o'zini ko'rsatish yoki pastki onglarning har qanday boshqa vulgar zaifligi uchun emas, balki falsafanni o'rgatish va ishontirish uchun rag'batlantirishi kerak bo'lgan noyob va yagona motiv uchun, "Hamma shu bilan birga, salbiy tomonni ko'rib, yoki oy yashashi mumkin emas, deb aytishda men faqat salbiy dalillar bilan qanoatlantirmayman.

en: Many words, however, are not required.
uz: Biroq, ko'p so'zlar talab qilinmaydi.

en: Look at her present condition: her atmosphere dwindled away to the lowest ebb; her 'seas' dried up or very nearly so; her waters reduced to next to nothing; her vegetation, if existing at all, existing only on the scantiest scale; her transitions from intense heat to intense cold, as we ourselves can testify,
uz: Uning hozirgi holatiga e'tibor bering: uning atmosfera eng past bo'lgan joyga kamaydi; uning "dengizlari" qurib qoldi yoki juda deyarli shunday bo'ldi; uning suvlari deyarli hech narsaga kamaydi; uning o'simliklari, agar mavjud bo'lsa, faqat eng kam miqyosda mavjud; biz o'zimiz guvoh bo'lganidek, kuchli issiqlikdan qattiq sovuqqa o'tishlari,

en: sudden in the extreme; her nights and her days each nearly ൤൧ൡ hours long.
uz: O'tmishda, uning kechalari va kunlari deyarli bir necha soat davom etadi.

en: With all this positively against her and nothing at all that we know of positively for her, I have very little hesitation in saying that the Moon appears to me to be absolutely uninhabitable.
uz: Unga qarshi bo'lgan barcha ijobiy holatlar bo'yicha va biz uchun ijobiy ma'lumotlar yo'qligi sababli, oy men uchun mutlaqo yashashi mumkin emas deb o'ylayman.

en: She seems to me not only unpropitious to the development of the animal kingdom but actually incapable of sustaining life at all—that is, in the sense that we usually attach to such a term." "That saving clause is well introduced, friend Barbican," said M'Nicholl, who, seeing no chance of demolishing Ardan, had not yet made up his mind as to having another little bout with the President.
uz: U menga nafaqat hayvonot dunyosining rivojlanishiga yaroqsiz, balki umuman hayotni qo'llab-quvvatlashga qodir emas, degani, biz odatda bunday atama bilan bog'liq bo'lgan ma'noda". "Bu qutqaruv to'g'risidagi qoida yaxshi joriy etilgan, do'stim Barbican", - dedi M'Nicholl, Ardanni buzib tashlash imkoniyati yo'qligini ko'rib, prezident bilan yana o'zaro jang qilishga qaror qilmagan.

en: "For surely you would not venture to assert that the Moon is uninhabitable by a race of beings having an organization different from ours?" "That question too, Captain," replied Barbican, "though a much more difficult one, I shall try to answer.
uz: "Agar siz o'zimizdan boshqacha tashkilotga ega bo'lgan mavjudotlar irqi tomonidan oy yashashi mumkin emasligini aytishga jur'at qilmasangiz?" - deb javob berdi Barbican. - Bu savolga ham, kapitan, javob berishga harakat qilaman, garchi u ancha qiyinroq bo'lsa-da.

en: First, however, let us see, Captain, if we agree on some fundamental points.
uz: Biroq, avvalambor, kapitan, bir nechta asosiy masalalarda kelishib olsak, ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: How do we detect the existence of life?
uz: Hayot mavjudligini qanday aniqlaymiz?

en: Is it not by movement?
uz: Bu harakat orqali emasmi?

en: Is not motion its result, no matter what may be its organization?" "Well," said the Captain in a drawling way, "I guess we may grant that." "Then, dear friends," resumed Barbican, "I must remind you that, though we have had the privilege of observing the lunar continents at a distance of not more than one-third of a mile, we have never yet caught sight of the first thing moving on her surface.
uz: Harakat uning natijasi emasmi, qaysi tashkilot bo'lishidan qat'i nazar?" - dedi kapitan qo'rqinchli tarzda, - "O'ylaymanki, biz bunga rozi bo'lishimiz mumkin. - Keyin, aziz do'stlar, - dedi Barbican yana, - Men sizga shuni eslatishim kerakki, biz oy qit'alariga bir mil uchdan ortiq masofadan kuzatish sharafiga ega bo'lsak-da, biz hali uning yuzasida harakatlanayotgan birinchi narsani ko'rmaganmiz.

en: The presence of humanity, even of the lowest type, would have revealed itself in some form or other, by boundaries, by buildings, even by ruins.
uz: Insoniyatning mavjudligi, hatto eng past turdagi mavjudligi ham, o'zini shu yoki bu shaklda, chegaralar, binolar, hatto vayronliklar orqali oshkor etgan bo'ladi.

en: Now what have we seen?
uz: Endi biz nima ko'rdik?

en: Everywhere and always, the geological works of nature; nowhere and never, the orderly labors of man.
uz: Har yerda va har doim tabiatning geologik ishlari; hech joyda va hech qachon insonning tartibli mehnatlari.

en: Therefore, if any representatives of animal life exist in the Moon, they must have taken refuge in those bottomless abysses where our eyes were unable to track them.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar oyda hayvonot hayotining biror vakili mavjud bo'lsa, ular bizning ko'zlarimiz ularni izlay olmaydigan, tubsiz tubsizlikka panoh topgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: And even this I can't admit.
uz: Hatto buni ham tan ololmayman.

en: They could not always remain in these cavities.
uz: Ular har doim ham bu teshiklarda qolishlari mumkin emas edi.

en: If there is any atmosphere at all in the Moon, it must be found in her immense low-lying plains.
uz: Agar oyda biron bir atmosfera bo'lsa, unda u uning ulkan past joylarda joylashgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Over those plains her inhabitants must have often passed, and on those plains they must in some way or other have left some mark, some trace, some vestige of their existence, were it even only a road.
uz: Uning aholisi tez-tez o'sha tekisliklardan o'tib o'tgan bo'lishi kerak va bu tekisliklarda ular bir yo'l bilan yoki boshqa yo'l bilan ba'zi izlar, izlar, ularning mavjudligi izlari qoldirgan bo'lishi kerak, hatto bu yo'l bo'lsa ham.

en: But you both know well that nowhere are any such traces visible:
uz: Ammo ikkovingiz ham yaxshi bilasizki, hech qayerda bunday izlar ko'rinmaydi:

en: therefore, they don't exist; therefore, no lunar inhabitants exist— except, of course, such a race of beings, if we can imagine any such, as could exist without revealing their existence by movement." "That is to say," broke in Ardan, to give what he conceived a sharper point to Barbican's cogent arguments, "such a race of beings as could exist without existing!" "Precisely," said Barbican: "Life without movement, and no life at all, are equivalent expressions." "Captain," said Ardan, with all the gravity he could assume, "have you anything more to say before the Moderator of our little Debating Society gives his opinion on the arguments regarding the question before the house?" "No more at present," said the Captain, biding his time.
uz: Shuning uchun ular mavjud emas; shuning uchun hech qanday oy aholisi mavjud emas, albatta, bunday mavjudotlar irqidan tashqari, agar biz buni tasavvur qilishimiz mumkin bo'lsa, ularning mavjudligini harakat orqali oshkor qilmasdan mavjud bo'lishi mumkin. " "Ya'ni", - dedi Ardan, "Barbicanning qat'iy dalillariga, "bo'lmasa mavjud bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan mavjudotlar irqidan" o'zini ko'targanini aniqroq ko'rsatish uchun.

en: "Then," resumed Ardan, rising with much dignity, "the Committee on Lunar Explorations, appointed by the Honorable Baltimore Gun Club, solemnly assembled in the Projectile belonging to the aforesaid learned and respectable Society, having carefully weighed all the arguments advanced on each side of the question, and having also carefully considered all the new facts bearing on the case that have lately come under the personal notice of said Committee, unanimously decides negatively on the question now before the chair for investigation—namely, 'Is the Moon inhabitable?' Barbican, as chairman of the Committee, I empower you to duly record our solemn decision—No, the Moon is not inhabitable." Barbican, opening his note-book, made the proper entry among the minutes of the meeting of December ൧th.
uz: "Shundan so'ng, - dedi Ardan, juda qadr-qimmat bilan ko'tarilgan holda, - Muharrim Baltimor Gun Club tomonidan tayinlangan, yuqorida aytib o'tilgan bilimdon va hurmatga sazovor jamiyatga tegishli bo'lgan Projektilda tantanali yig'ilgan, oyni tadqiq qilish bo'yicha qo'mita, savolning har bir tomonida taqdim etilgan barcha dalillarni diqqat bilan o'ylab, so'nggi paytlarda ushbu qo'mita tomonidan shaxsiy e'lon qilinadigan barcha yangi faktlarni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqib, endi tergov raisi oldida turgan savolga bir ovozdan salbiy qaror qabul qiladi, ya'ni: "Oy yashashi mumkinmi?" - Barbican, qo'mitaning raisi sifatida men sizlarni bizning tantanali qarorimizni qayd etish uchun vakolat beraman.No, oy yashashi mumkin emas".

en: "Now then, gentlemen," continued Ardan, "if you are ready for the second question, the necessary complement of the first, we may as well approach it at once.
uz: "Hndi, xonimlar", dedi Ardan davom etib, "agar siz ikkinchi savolga tayyor bo'lsangiz, birinchi savolning zarur qo'shimcha qismi bo'lsa, biz unga bir vaqtning o'zida murojaat qilishimiz mumkin.

en: I propound it for discussion in the following form: Has the Moon ever been inhabited?
uz: Men uni muhokama qilish uchun quyidagi shaklda taklif qilaman: Ayda hech qachon odamlar yashashib kelganmi?

en: Captain, the Committee would be delighted to hear your remarks on the subject." "Gentlemen," began the Captain in reply, "I had formed my opinion regarding the ancient inhabitability of our Satellite long before I ever dreamed of testing my theory by anything like our present journey.
uz: Kapitan, qo'mita bu borada sizning fikrlaringizni eshitishdan mamnun bo'ladi". - Hazratlar, - deb javob berdi Kapitan, - hozirgi sayohatimizga o'xshash narsa bilan nazrimni sinab ko'rishni orzu qilganimdan ancha oldin, bizning Satelimizning qadimgi yashashib qolishi haqida o'z fikrimni shakllantirgan edim.

en: I will now add that all our observations, so far made, have only served to confirm me in my opinion.
uz: Endi shuni qo'shamanki, hozirgacha qilingan barcha izohlarimiz mening fikrimni tasdiqlaydi.

en: I now venture to assert, not only with every kind of probability in my favor but also on what I consider most
uz: Endi men nafaqat o'zimning foydamga bo'lgan barcha ehtimolliklarni, balki eng ko'p deb o'ylagandek bo'lgan narsalarni ham tasdiqlashga jur'at qilaman.

en: excellent arguments, that the Moon was once inhabited by a race of beings possessing an organization similar to our own, that she once produced animals anatomically resembling our terrestrial animals, and that all these living organizations, human and animal, have had their day, that that day vanished ages and ages ago, and that, consequently, Life, extinguished forever, can never again reveal its existence there under any form." "Is the Chair," asked Ardan, "to infer from the honorable gentleman's observations that he considers the Moon to be a world much older than the Earth?" "Not exactly that," replied the Captain without hesitation; "I rather mean to say that the Moon is a world that grew old more rapidly than the Earth; that it came to maturity earlier; that it ripened quicker, and was stricken with old age sooner.
uz: Ayda bir vaqtlar bizning o'zimizga o'xshash tashkilotga ega bo'lgan mavjudotlar irqasi yashar ekanligi, u bir vaqtlar yerdagi hayvonlarimizga anatomiya bilan o'xshash hayvonlarni yaratganligi va barcha tirik tashkilotlar, insonlar va hayvonlar, o'z kunlari bo'lganligi, o'sha kun asrlar va asrlar ilgari yo'qolganligi va, natijada, abadiy o'chgan Hayot hech qachon o'z mavjudligini u yerda hech qanday shaklda ko'rsatolmaydiligi haqidagi dalillar juda yaxshi dalillardir. " "Sura, - deb so'radi Ardan, - hurmatli janobning kuzatishlaridan Ayni Yerdan ancha qadimroq dunyo deb hisoblaydi deb xulosa qilish mumkinmi?" - deb so'radi. "Agar emas, - deb javob berdi kapitan hech ikkilanmasdan; "Men Ayni o'z kunidan ham tezroq qarib borgan dunyodan aytmoqni afzal ko'raman; u o'z kunidan ham oldin qarib borgan; u o'z kunidan ham tezroq qirib borgan va o'z yoshini o'zgartirgan, deb aytmoqni xohlayman.

en: Owing to the difference of the volumes of the two worlds, the organizing forces of matter must have been comparatively much more violent in the interior of the Moon than in the interior of the Earth.
uz: Ikkala dunyoning hajmi farq qilishi sababli, materyani tashkil etuvchi kuchlar Yerdagi kuchlarga qaraganda oy ichkarisida ancha zo'ravon bo'lishi kerak.

en: The present condition of its surface, as we see it lying there beneath us at this moment, places this assertion beyond all possibility of doubt.
uz: Uning yuzasining hozirgi holati, biz uni hozirda bizdan pastda ko'rib turibmiz, bu fikrni hech qanday shubha tug'dirmaydigan joyga joylashtiradi.

en: Wrinkled, pitted, knotted, furrowed, scarred, nothing that we can show on Earth resembles it.
uz: Bu yerga o'xshash hech narsa yo'q, buzilmagan, bog'langan, to'g'rilashgan, chiroyli, jarohatlangan. Yer yuzida ko'rsatishimiz mumkin bo'lgan hech narsa unga o'xshamaydi.

en: Moon and Earth were called into existence by the Creator probably at the same period of time.
uz: Ay va Yer Yaratuvchimiz tomonidan, ehtimol, bir vaqtning o'zida paydo bo'lgan.

en: In the first stages of their existence, they do not seem to have been anything better than masses of gas.
uz: Ular mavjud bo'lishining dastlabki bosqichlarida gaz massasidan yaxshiroq bo'lgan ko'rinmaydi.

en: Acted upon by various forces and various influences, all of course directed by an omnipotent intelligence, these gases by degrees became liquid, and the liquids grew condensed into solids until solidity could retain its shape.
uz: Bu gazlar turli kuchlar va turli ta'sirlar bilan harakat qilib, albatta, hamma narsaga qodir bo'lgan aqli rasolik tomonidan boshqariladi, ular asta-sekin suyuqlikka aylandi va suyuqliklar qat'iyatni saqlab qolmaguncha qat'iy moddalarga aylandi.

en: But the two heavenly bodies, though starting at the same time, developed at a very different ratio.
uz: Biroq, ikkita osmon jismlari bir vaqtning o'zida boshlanishgan bo'lsa-da, juda farq qilgan nisbatda rivojlangan.

en: Most undoubtedly, our globe was still gaseous or at most only liquid, at the period when the Moon, already hardened by cooling, began to become inhabitable." "Most undoubtedly is good!" observed Ardan admiringly.
uz: Shubhasizki, bizning sayyoramiz hali ham gazli yoki eng ko'pida faqat suyuq edi, o'sha davrda oy, allaqachon sovuqdan qattiq bo'lib, yashashi mumkin bo'ldi".

en: "At this period," continued the learned Captain, "an atmosphere surrounded her.
uz: "Bu davrda", - deb davom ettirgan bilimdon kapitan, "ular atrofidagi muhit paydo bo'ldi.

en: The waters, shut in by this gaseous envelope, could no longer evaporate.
uz: Ushbu gazli qopqoq tomonidan yopilgan suvlar endi bug'lanib ketolmaydi.

en: Under the combined influences of air, water, light, and solar heat as well as internal heat, vegetation began to overspread the continents by this time ready to receive it, and most undoubtedly—I mean—a—incontestably—it was at this epoch that
uz: Havo, suv, yorug'lik va quyosh issiqligi hamda ichki issiqlikning qo'shilgan ta'sirlari ostida, o'simlik bu vaqtgacha uni qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lgan qit'alarni qamrab oldi va shubhasiz, bu davrda o'simlik o'sib bordi.

en: life manifested itself on the lunar surface.
uz: Hayot o'zini oy yuzida namoyon etgan.

en: I say incontestably advisedly, for Nature never exhausts herself in producing useless things, and therefore a world, so wonderfully inhabitable, must of necessity have had inhabitants." "I like of necessity too," said Ardan, who could never keep still; "I always did, when I felt my arguments to be what you call a little shaky." "But, my dear Captain," here observed Barbican, "have you taken into consideration some of the peculiarities of our Satellite which are decidedly opposed to the development of vegetable and animal existence?
uz: Men shubhasiz maslahat beraman, chunki tabiat hech qachon foydasiz narsalarni ishlab chiqarishda o'zini to'xtatmaydi va shuning uchun ajoyib yashashi mumkin bo'lgan dunyo albatta aholi bo'lishi kerak. "Men ham albatta odamlarga ega bo'lishni yaxshi ko'raman", dedi hech qachon to'xtamaydigan Ardan; "Men doim o'zimning dalillarimni siz biroz salqin deb bilganimda shunday qilardim.

en: Those nights and days, for instance, ൤൦൥ hours long?" "I have considered them all," answered the brave Captain.
uz: Misol uchun, bu kechalar va kunlar soatlab davom etadimi? - Men ularning barchasini ko'rib chiqdim, - deb javob berdi jasoratli kapitan.

en: "Days and nights of such an enormous length would at the present time, I grant, give rise to variations in temperature altogether intolerable to any ordinary organization.
uz: "O'sha qadar uzoq kun va kechalar hozirgi vaqtda har qanday oddiy tashkilot uchun qabul qilinmaydigan harorat o'zgarishlariga sabab bo'ladi.

en: But things were quite different in the era alluded to.
uz: Ammo bu davrda vaziyat ancha boshqacha edi.

en: At that time, the atmosphere enveloped the Moon in a gaseous mantle, and the vapors took the shape of clouds.
uz: O'sha paytda atmosferada oyni gazli qopqoq bilan o'rab olgan va bug'lar bulut shakliga kirgan.

en: By the screen thus formed by the hand of nature, the heat of the solar rays was tempered and the nocturnal radiation retarded.
uz: Tabiat qo'li bilan hosil bo'lgan ekran orqali quyosh nurlarining issiqligi susayib, tungi nurlanish susayib ketdi.
