uz: Bir-biri atrofida muntazam aylanayotgan har bir harakatlanuvchi jism elipsni tasvirlaydi.

en: Science has proved this incontestably.
uz: Ilm-fan buni shubhasiz isbotladi.

en: The satellites describe ellipses around the planets, the planets around the Sun, the Sun himself describes an ellipse around the unknown star that serves as
uz: Satelitlar sayyoralar atrofidagi elipsilarni tasvirlaydi, Quyosh atrofidagi planetalar, Quyosh o'zi noma'lum yulduz atrofidagi elipsiyani tasvirlaydi, bu esa sifatida xizmat qiladi.

en: a pivot for our whole solar system.
uz: Bu butun Quyosh tizimimiz uchun muhim ahamiyatga ega.

en: How can our Baltimore Gun Club Projectile then escape the universal law?
uz: O'sha paytda bizning Baltimor Gun Club Projectile-imiz qanday qilib universal qonunlardan qochishi mumkin?

en: "Now what is the consequence of this law?
uz: "Hndi bu qonunning oqibati nima?

en: If the orbit were a circle, the satellite would always preserve the same distance from its primary, and its velocity should therefore be constant.
uz: Agar orbita aylansa, u har doim o'zining asosiy orqasidan bir xil masofani saqlaydi va shuning uchun uning tezligi doimiy bo'lishi kerak.

en: But the orbit being an ellipse, and the attracting body always occupying one of the foci, the satellite must evidently lie nearer to this focus in one part of its orbit than in another.
uz: Ammo orbita elips bo'lgani va jalb qiluvchi jism har doim markazlardan birini egallab turganligi sababli, u orbitining bir qismida boshqa qismidan ko'ra ushbu markazga yaqinroq bo'lishi kerak.

en: The Earth when nearest to the Sun, is in her perihelion; when most distant, in her aphelion.
uz: Yer Quyoshga eng yaqin bo'lganida perihelionida, eng uzoqda bo'lganda afhelionida joylashgan.

en: The Moon, with regard to the Earth, is similarly in her perigee, and her apogee.
uz: Yerga nisbatan oy o'zining perigei va apogeida ham xuddi shunday.

en: Analogous expressions denoting the relations of the Projectile towards the Moon, would be periselene and aposelene.
uz: O'z navbatida, o'xshash ifodeler, ya'ni Projektilning oyga nisbatan munosabatlarini bildiruvchi ifodeler, periselene va aposelene bo'ladi.

en: At its aposelene the Projectile's velocity would have reached its minimum; at the periselene, its maximum.
uz: O'z aposeleneda Projectile tezligi o'z minimalligiga, periseleneda maksimalligiga yetgan bo'ladi.

en: As it is to the former point that we are now moving, clearly the velocity must keep on diminishing until that point is reached.
uz: Hozir biz oldingi nuqtaga harakatlanayotgan ekanmiz, aniqki, bu nuqtaga yetguncha tezlik pasayib borishi kerak.

en: Then, if it does not die out altogether, it must spring up again, and even accelerate as it reapproaches the Moon.
uz: Keyin, agar u butunlay o'lib ketmasa, u yana ko'tarilishi va hatto oyga yaqinlashganda tezlashishi kerak.

en: Now the great trouble is this: If the Aposelenetic point should coincide with the point of lunar attraction, our velocity must certainly become nil, and the Projectile must remain relatively motionless forever!" "What do you mean by 'relatively motionless'?" asked M'Nicholl, who was carefully studying the situation.
uz: Endi katta muammo shundaki: agar Aposelenetik nuqta oyning jozibadorligi nuqtasi bilan bir xil bo'lsa, bizning tezligimiz nolga aylanishi kerak va Projektil abadiy nisbatan harakatsiz qolishi kerak! "Nima degani "rasmiy harakatsiz" deb?" deb so'radi M'Nicholl, vaziyatni diqqat bilan o'rganayotgan edi.

en: "I mean, of course, not absolutely motionless," answered Barbican; "absolute immobility is, as you are well aware, altogether impossible, but motionless with regard to the Earth and the—" "By Mahomet's jackass!" interrupted Ardan hastily, "I must say we're a precious set of imbéciles!" "I don't deny it, dear friend," said Barbican quietly, notwithstanding the unceremonious interruption; "but why do you say so just now?" "Because though we are possessed of the power of retarding the velocity that takes us from the Moon, we have never thought of employing it!" "What do you mean?" "Do you forget the rockets?" "It's a fact!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: - Albatta, mutlaqo harakatsiz emas, - dedi Barbican; - mutlaqo harakatsizlik, siz yaxshi bilasiz, mutlaqo imkonsiz, lekin Yer va ga nisbatan harakatsiz, - dedi Ardan shoshilinchlik bilan: - Biz qimmatbaho ahmoqlar to'plami ekanimizni aytishim kerak! - dedi. - Men buni inkor etmayman, aziz do'stim, - dedi Barbican xotirjamliksiz to'sqinlikka qaramay; - lekin nega siz buni hozir aytyapsiz?

en: "How have we forgotten them?"
uz: "Ularni qanday unutib qo'ydik?"

en: "I'm sure I can't tell," answered Barbican, "unless, perhaps, because we had too many other things to think about.
uz: "Mening aytishim mumkin emas", deb javob berdi Barbican, "belki, ehtimol, bizda o'ylash uchun juda ko'p boshqa narsalar bo'lmagan bo'lsa.

en: Your thought, my dear friend, is a most happy one, and, of course, we shall utilize it." "When?
uz: Sizning fikringiz, aziz do'stim, juda baxtli va, albatta, biz undan foydalanamiz.

en: How soon?" "At the first favorable opportunity, not sooner.
uz: Qachongacha?" deb so'raganida, "Birinchi qulay fursatda, avval emas.

en: For you can see for yourselves, dear friends," he went on explaining, "that with the present obliquity of the Projectile with regard to the lunar disc, a discharge of our rockets would be more likely to send us away from the Moon than towards her.
uz: Chunki siz o'zingiz ko'rishingiz mumkin, aziz do'stlarim, - dedi u tushuntirib, - hozirgi vaqtda Ravoning oy diskini ko'rib chiqishi bilan raketalarimizning oqishi bizni oyga qaraganda undan uzoqlashtiradi.

en: Of course, you are both still desirous of reaching the Moon?" "Most emphatically so!" "Then by reserving our rockets for the last chance, we may possibly get there after all.
uz: Albatta, ikkovingiz ham hali ham oyga yetib borishni istaysizlarmi?" - "Agar shunday bo'lsa, albatta!" - "O'z raketalarimizni so'nggi marta qo'yib, biz u yerga yetib borishimiz mumkin.

en: In consequence of some force, to me utterly inexplicable, the Projectile still seems disposed to turn its base towards the Earth.
uz: Mening nazarimda toʻliq tushuntirilmaydigan bir kuch tufayli, proyektil hali ham oʻz asosini Yerga qaratishga moyil boʻlib tuyuladi.

en: In fact, it is likely enough that at the neutral point its cone will point vertically to the Moon.
uz: Darhaqiqat, neytral nuqtada uning konining oyga vertikal ravishda ko'rsatilishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas.

en: That being the moment when its velocity will most probably be nil, it will also be the moment for us to discharge our rockets, and the possibility is that we may force a direct fall on the lunar disc." "Good!" cried Ardan, clapping hands.
uz: Bu uning tezligi nol bo'lgan payt bo'lgani sababli, biz o'z raketalarimizni ishga tushirishimiz kerak bo'lgan vaqt bo'ladi va ehtimol biz oy diskini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qulab yubora olamiz". - "Yaxshi!" - dedi Ardan qo'l urib.

en: "Why didn't we execute this grand manoeuvre the first time we reached the neutral point?" asked M'Nicholl a little crustily.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Nega biz birinchi marta neytral nuqtaga yetib kelganimizda bu buyuk harakatni bajarmadik?" - deb so'radi.

en: "It would be useless," answered Barbican; "the Projectile's velocity at that time, as you no doubt remember, not only did not need rockets, but was actually too great to be affected by them." "True!" chimed in Ardan; "a wind of four miles an hour is very little use to a steamer going ten." "That assertion," cried M'Nicholl, "I am rather dis—" —"Dear friends," interposed Barbican, his pale face beaming and his clear voice ringing with the new excitement; "let us just now waste no time in mere words.
uz: "Bu foydasiz bo'ladi", - deb javob berdi Barbican; "o'sha paytda Projectile tezligi, siz hech shubhasiz eslaysiz, nafaqat raketalarga muhtoj emas edi, balki ular tomonidan ta'sir qilinish uchun juda katta edi. " "To'g'ri", - dedi Ardanda; "soatga to'rt millik shamol o'n marta ketayotgan parvoz kemasiga juda kam foyda keltiradi. "M'Nicholl: "Bu fikrni o'z so'zlari bilan aytishdan ko'ra ko'proq qiynayman", - deb baqirdi.

en: We have one more chance, perhaps a great one.
uz: Bizda yana bir imkoniyat bor, ehtimol buyuk imkoniyat.

en: Let us not throw it away!
uz: Uni tashlab ketmaylik!

en: We have been on the brink of despair—"
uz: Biz umidsizlik chegarasida edik".

en: —"Beyond it!" cried Ardan.
uz: Ardan: "O'tmishda!" - deb baqirdi.

en: —"But I now begin to see a possibility, nay, a very decided probability, of our being able to attain the great end at last!" "Bravo!" cried Ardan.
uz: "Ammo men endi buyuk oxiriga erishish imkoniyatini, xolos, juda aniq ehtimollikni ko'rishni boshladim!" - dedi Ardan.

en: "Hurrah!" cried M'Nicholl.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Hura!" - deb baqirdi.

en: my brave boys!" cried Barbican as enthusiastically as his companions; "all's not over yet by a long shot!" What had brought about this great revulsion in the spirits of our bold adventurers?
uz: Mening jasoratli yigitlarim! - deb Barbican hamrohlari kabi g'ayrat bilan baqirib yubordi; - bu hali uzoq vaqtdan o'tmagan! - Bizning jasoratli sarguzashtchilarimizning ruhida bu katta jirkanchlikni nima keltirib chiqargan edi?

en: Prince Esterhazy's Tokay?
uz: Prince Esterhazyning Tokay?

en: The latter, most probably.
uz: Ikkinchisi, ehtimol.

en: What had become of the resolutions they had discussed so ably and passed so decidedly a few hours before?
uz: Bir necha soat oldin ular o'zlari uchun juda puxta muhokama qilgan va qat'iy qabul qilgan qarorlar nima bo'ldi?

en: Was the Moon inhabited?
uz: Oʻshanda oyda odamlar yasharmidi?

en: Was the Moon habitable?
uz: Oy yashashi mumkinmi?

en: Yet in the face of all this—or rather as coolly as if such subjects had never been alluded to—here were the reckless scientists actually thinking of nothing but how to work heaven and earth in order to get there!
uz: Ammo bularning barchasi oldida, xuddi bunday mavzular hech qachon ma'lumotga ega bo'lmagan bo'lgani kabi, beparvo olimlar aslida osmon va yerni qanday ishlash kerakligini o'ylashdan boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylamaydilar!

en: One question more remained to be answered before they played their last trump, namely: "At what precise moment would the Projectile reach the neutral point?" To this Barbican had very little trouble in finding an answer.
uz: So'nggi qo'ng'iroqlaridan oldin yana bir savolga javob topishga to'g'ri keldi: "Projektil qaysi vaqtda neytral nuqtaga yetadi?"

en: The time spent in proceeding from the south pole to the dead point being evidently equal to the time previously spent in proceeding from the dead point to the north pole—to ascertain the former, he had only to calculate the latter.
uz: Janubiy qutbdan o'lim nuqtasiga o'tish uchun sarflangan vaqt, avvalgilarni aniqlash uchun o'lim nuqtasidan shimoliy qutbga o'tish uchun sarflangan vaqtga teng bo'lganligi sababli, u faqat oxirgilarni hisoblab chiqishi kerak edi.

en: This was easily done.
uz: Buni osonlikcha amalga oshirish mumkin edi.

en: To refer to his notes, to check off the different rates of velocity at which they had readied the different parallels, and to turn these rates into time, required only a very few minutes careful calculation.
uz: Uning yozuvlariga ishora qilish, ular turli parallelllarni tayyorlagan turli tezliklarni tekshirish va ushbu tezliklarni vaqtga aylantirish uchun faqat bir necha daqiqalik ehtiyotkorlik bilan hisoblash kerak edi.

en: The Projectile then was to reach the point of neutral attraction at one o'clock in the morning of December ൩th.
uz: O'shanda Proyektil dekabr oyining ertalabgi soat birida neytral jozibadorlik nuqtasiga yetishi kerak edi.

en: At the present time, it was five o'clock in the morning of the ൨th; therefore, if nothing unforeseen should occur in the meantime, their great and final effort was to be made about twenty hours later.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda soat besh edi, shuning uchun agar o'sha paytgacha hech narsa kutilmagan bo'lmasa, ularning katta va yakuniy sa'y-harakatlari taxminan yigirma soat o'tib amalga oshirilishi kerak edi.

en: The rockets, so often alluded to as an idea of Ardan's and already fully described, had been originally provided to break the violence of the Projectile's fall on the lunar surface; but now the dauntless travellers were about to employ them for a purpose precisely the reverse.
uz: Ko'pincha Ardanning g'oyasi deb atashgan va allaqachon to'liq tasvirlangan raketalar dastlab oy yuziga o'tishning zo'ravonligini buzish uchun taqdim etilgan edi; ammo endi jasoratli sayohatchilar ularni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri boshqacha maqsad uchun ishlatishga tayyor edilar.

en: In any case, having been put in proper order for immediate
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, ular o'z vaqtida to'g'ri tartibga qo'yilgan.

en: use, nothing more now remained to be done till the moment should come for firing them off.
uz: Ulardan foydalanish uchun vaqt kelmaguncha, endi boshqa hech narsa qilish kerak emas edi.

en: "Now then, friends," said M'Nicholl, rubbing his eyes but hardly able to keep them open, "I'm not over fond of talking, but this time I think I may offer a slight proposition." "We shall be most happy to entertain it, my dear Captain," said Barbican.
uz: "Hndi, do'stlar, - dedi M'Nicholl ko'zlarini ko'tarib, lekin ularni ochib qo'ymaslik bilan, - men gapirishni juda yaxshi ko'rmayman, lekin bu safar bir oz taklif qilishim mumkin deb o'ylayman.

en: ARDAN GAZED ON THE PAIR.
uz: ARDAN GAZED ON THE PAIR.

en: "I propose we lie down and take a good nap." "Good gracious!" protested Ardan; "What next?"
uz: "O'tirib, yaxshi uxlasak bo'ladi", deb taklif qilaman. "O'rinli", - dedi Ardan; "Bundan keyin nima bo'ladi?"

en: "We have not had a blessed wink for forty hours," continued the Captain; "a little sleep would recuperate us wonderfully." "No sleep now!" exclaimed Ardan.
uz: Kapten davom etib: "Qirq soatdan beri bir marta ham ko'z yummaganmiz; bir oz uxlash bizni ajoyib tarzda tiklaydi. " Ardan: "Hndi hech qanday uyqusizlik yo'q!" - dedi.

en: "Every man to his taste!" said M'Nicholl; "mine at present is certainly to turn in!" and suiting the action to the word, he coiled himself on the sofa, and in a few minutes his deep regular breathing showed his slumber to be as tranquil as an infant's.
uz: M'Nicholl: "Har bir kishi o'z ta'miga mos keladi!" - dedi; "haqiqatan mening ishim - bu o'z ishini o'zgartirish!" - dedi va so'zga mos ravishda, u o'zini sofa ustiga o'rab oldi va bir necha daqiqada uning chuqur, muntazam nafas olishi uning uxlash vaqtini chaqaloqning o'zi kabi xotirjam ko'rsatdi.

en: Barbican looked at him in a kindly way, but only for a very short time; his eyes grew so filmy that he could not keep them open any longer.
uz: Barbican unga mehribonlik ila qaradi, lekin faqat juda qisqa vaqtga; uning ko'zlari shunchalik ko'p bo'ldiki, ko'zlarini ko'proq ocholmadi.

en: "The Captain," he said, "may not be without his little faults, but for good practical sense he is worth a ship-load like you and me, Ardan.
uz: U shunday dedi: "Kapten o'zining kichik kamchiliklaridan holi bo'lmasligi mumkin, lekin u siz va men kabi kema yukini o'z ichiga oladi, Ardan.

en: By Jove, I'm going to imitate him, and, friend Michael, you might do worse!" In a short time he was as unconscious as the Captain.
uz: Jove, men uning o'rnagiga ergashaman va, do'stim Maykl, sen bundan ham yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin!" Qisqa vaqt ichida u kapitan singari befarq bo'ldi.

en: Ardan gazed on the pair for a few minutes, and then began to feel quite lonely.
uz: Ardan bir necha daqiqaga bu juftlikka qaradi va keyin o'zini juda yolg'iz his qila boshlaydi.

en: Even his animals were fast asleep.
uz: Hatto uning hayvonlari ham uxlab yotgan edi.

en: He tried to look out, but observing without having anybody to listen to your observations, is dull work.
uz: U diqqat bilan qarashga harakat qildi, lekin sizning e'tiboringizni eshitadigan odamsiz kuzatish - bu charchagan ish.

en: He looked again at the sleeping pair, and then he gave in.
uz: U yana uxlayotgan juftlikka qaradi va keyin taslim bo'ladi.

en: "It can't be denied," he muttered, slowly nodding his head, "that even your practical men sometimes stumble on a good idea." Then curling up his long legs, and folding his arms under his head, his restless brain was soon forming fantastic shapes for itself in the mysterious land of dreams.
uz: "Bu yolg'on bo'lmasligi mumkin", - dedi u, asta-sekin boshini bosib, "ha, hatto sizning amaliy odamlaringiz ba'zan yaxshi g'oyaga qochishadi". So'ngra o'z uzun oyoqlarini yig'ib, qo'llarini bosh ostidagi qo'llarini qo'zg'atib, uning bezovta miyasi tez orada ajoyib shakllarni o'zi uchun orzularning sirli mamlakatida yaratdi.

en: But his slumbers were too much disturbed to last long.
uz: Ammo uning uyqusizligi uzoq davom etishi uchun juda ko'p to'xtatilgan edi.

en: After an uneasy, restless, unrefreshing attempt at repose, he sat up at about half-past seven o'clock, and began stretching himself, when he found his companions already awake and discussing the situation in whispers.
uz: Xavfsiz, bezovta va charchatib yubormaydigan dam olishga urinishdan so'ng, u soat yetti yarimlarda o'rnidan turib, o'zini uzishni boshladi, chunki u o'z hamkorlarini endi uyg'onib, vaziyatni shoshib muhokama qilayotganini ko'rdi.

en: The Projectile, they were remarking, was still pursuing its way from the Moon, and turning its conical point more and more in her direction.
uz: Ular shuni ta'kidlashganki, "Projektil" hali ham oydan o'z yo'lini izlab borayotgan edi va konik nuqtasini o'z yo'liga ko'proq o'zgartirgan edi.

en: This latter phenomenon, though as puzzling as ever, Barbican regarded with decided pleasure: the more directly the conical summit pointed to the Moon at the exact moment, the more directly towards her surface would the rockets communicate their reactionary motion.
uz: Bu oxirgi hodisa har qachongidan ham g'alati bo'lsa-da, Barbican bunga qat'iy mamnunlik bilan qaradi: konik sammit aynan shu vaqtda oyga aniq ko'rsatilgan sari, raketalar o'zlarining reaktsiyaviy harakatlarini uning yuziga qanchalik to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'llagan bo'lsa, shunga o'xshab, raketalar o'z harakatlarini yanada to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bildiradi.

en: Nearly seventeen hours, however, were still to elapse before that moment, that all important moment, would arrive.
uz: Biroq, o'sha muhim vaqt kelishi uchun deyarli o'n yetti soat davom etishi kerak edi.

en: The time began to drag.
uz: Vaqt ortib borishni boshladi.

en: The excitement produced by the Moon's vicinity had died out.
uz: Oʻz navbatida, oy atrofida paydo boʻlgan hayajon oʻz oʻlimini kutdi.

en: Our travellers, though as daring and as confident as ever, could not help feeling a certain sinking of heart at the approach of the moment for deciding either alternative of their doom in this world—their fall to the Moon, or their eternal imprisonment in a changeless orbit.
uz: Bizning sayohatchilarimiz har qachongidan ham jasoratli va ishonchli bo'lishsa-da, bu dunyoda o'zlarining halokatining - oyga tushib qolishining yoki o'zgarmas orbitada abadiy qamoqqa tushishning - bir xil variantini tanlash uchun yaqinlashib kelayotgan paytida yuraklari biroz og'ib ketayotganini his qilishdan bosh tortmadilar.

en: Barbican and M'Nicholl tried to kill time by revising their calculations and putting their notes in order; Ardan, by feverishly walking back and forth from window to window, and stopping for a second or two to throw a nervous glance at the cold, silent and impassive Moon.
uz: Barbican va M'Nicholl o'z hisob-kitoblarini qayta ko'rib, yozuvlarini tartibga solib, vaqtni o'ldirishga harakat qilishdi; Ardan, o'zlarining ishtiyoqlari bilan darcha-daraxtdan oldinga-qayta yurib, sovuq, soqovsiz va o'zboshimsiz oyga g'alati ko'z tikish uchun bir-ikki soniya to'xtashdi.

en: Now and then reminiscences of our lower world would flit across their brains.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan bizning pastki dunyomiz xotiralari ularning miyasidan o'tib ketardi.

en: Visions of the famous Gun Club rose up before them the oftenest, with their dear friend Marston always the central figure.
uz: Ular uchun mashhur Gun Clubning ko'rinishlari ko'pincha paydo bo'lib, ularning aziz do'sti Marston har doim asosiy shaxs bo'lgan.

en: What was his bustling, honest, good-natured, impetuous heart at now?
uz: Hozir uning hayajonli, rostgo'y, xushmuomala va g'ayratli yuragi nimada edi?

en: Most probably he was standing bravely at his post on the Rocky Mountains, his eye glued to the great Telescope, his whole soul peering through its tube.
uz: Ehtimol, u Rocky tog'larida o'z postida jasorat bilan turgan edi, ko'zi ulkan teleskopga yopilgan, butun ruhi uning tubiga qarab turgan edi.

en: Had he seen the Projectile before it vanished behind the Moon's north pole?
uz: O'sha oyning shimoliy qutbidan keyin yo'qolganidan oldin u "Projectil"ni ko'rganmidi?

en: Could he have caught a glimpse of it at its reappearance?
uz: U uni yana paydo bo'lganida ko'rib bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: If so, could he have concluded it to be the satellite of a satellite!
uz: Agar shunday bo'lgan bo'lsa, u u yerdagi uyning uydoni deb xulosa chiqarishi mumkin edi!

en: Could Belfast have announced to the world such a startling piece of intelligence?
uz: Belfast dunyoga bunday dahshatli ma'lumotni e'lon qilishi mumkinmi?

en: Was that all the Earth was ever to know of their great enterprise?
uz: Ularning buyuk ishi haqida butun Yer yuzi bilishi kerak edi?

en: What were the speculations of the Scientific World upon the subject?
uz: Ilmiy dunyo bu borada qanday taxmin qilgan?

en: In listless questions and desultory conversation of this kind the day slowly wore away, without the occurrence of any incident whatever to relieve its weary monotony.
uz: Shu kabi ochko'zliksiz savollar va behuda suhbatlarda kun asta-sekin o'tib ketadi, hech qanday hodisa sodir bo'lmasdan, uning charchagan monotonligini yengillashtiradi.

en: Midnight arrived, December the seventh was dead.
uz: Tun yarimlari keldi, yettinchi dekabr o'lgan edi.

en: As Ardan said: "Le Sept Decembre est mort; vive le Huit!" In one hour more, the neutral point would be reached.
uz: Ardan aytganidek: "Sept dekabr o'ldi, o'n besh yil yashasin!" Bir soatdan keyin neytral nuqtaga yetib boradi.

en: At what velocity was the Projectile now moving?
uz: O'sha paytda Projectile qanday tezlikda harakatlanayotgan edi?

en: Barbican could not exactly tell, but he felt quite certain that no serious error had slipped into his calculations.
uz: Barbican to'g'ri aytolmadi, lekin u o'z hisob-kitoblarida jiddiy xato yo'qligiga amin edi.

en: At one o'clock that night, nil the velocity was to be, and nil it would be!
uz: O'sha kecha soat birda tezligi nol bo'lishi kerak edi va nol bo'lishi kerak edi!

en: Another phenomenon, in any case, was to mark the arrival of the exact moment.
uz: Boshqa bir hodisa esa, aniq vaqt kelishini belgilash edi.

en: At the dead point, the two attractions, terrestrial and lunar, would again exactly counterbalance each other.
uz: O'tkinchi nuqtada, ikkita yerdagi va oydagi diqqatga sazovor joy bir-biriga to'g'ri mos keladi.

en: seconds, objects would no longer possess the slightest weight.
uz: Bir necha soniya o'tgach, ob'ektlarning eng oz og'irligi yo'q bo'ladi.

en: This curious circumstance, which had so much surprised and amused the travellers at its first occurrence, was now to appear again as soon as the conditions should become identical.
uz: Birinchi marta sodir bo'lganida sayohatchilarni juda hayratda qoldirgan va zavqlantirgan bu g'alati holat, sharoitlar bir xil bo'lganida, yana paydo bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: During these few seconds then would come the moment for striking the decisive blow.
uz: O'sha bir necha soniya ichida hal qiluvchi urish vaqti keladi.

en: They could soon notice the gradual approach of this important instant.
uz: Tez orada ular ushbu muhim vaqtning asta-sekin yaqinlashishini payqashlari mumkin edi.

en: Objects began to weigh sensibly lighter.
uz: Buyumlar sezilarli darajada yengilroq vaznga ega bo'la boshladi.

en: The conical point of the Projectile had become almost directly under the centre of the lunar surface.
uz: Projektilning shkafli nuqtasi deyarli oy yuzasining markazidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pastga aylandi.

en: This gladdened the hearts of the bold adventurers.
uz: Bu jasoratli sayohatchilarning qalbini quvontirdi.

en: The recoil of the rockets losing none of its power by oblique action, the chances pronounced decidedly in their favor.
uz: Raketalarning o'z kuchini yo'qotish bilan bog'liq bo'lgan o'zgarishi, imkoniyatlari o'zlariga afzal bo'ldi.

en: Now, only supposing the Projectile's velocity to be absolutely annihilated at the dead point, the slightest force directing it towards the Moon would be certain to cause it finally to fall on her surface.
uz: Endi, faqatgina raketning tezligi o'lim nuqtasida mutlaqo yo'q qilinganini tasavvur qilsak, uni oyga yo'naltirayotgan eng kichik kuch uni oxir-oqibat uning yuziga tushishiga sabab bo'ladi.

en: Supposing!—but supposing the contrary!
uz: Tasavvur qilish! lekin aksincha tasavvur qilish!

en: —Even these brave adventurers had not the courage to suppose the contrary!
uz: Hatto bu jasoratli sarguzashtchilar ham buning aksi deb o'ylashga jasoratli bo'lishmagan!

en: "Five minutes to one o'clock," said M'Nicholl, his eyes never quitting his watch.
uz: M'Nichollning ko'zlari soatidan hech qachon to'xtamaydi.

en: "Ready?" asked Barbican of Ardan.
uz: "Hazirmisiz?" - deb so'radi Ardanlik Barbican.

en: "Ay, ay, sir!" was Ardan's reply, as he made sure that the electric apparatus to discharge the rockets was in perfect working order.
uz: "Ay, ay, xo'jayinim!" - deb javob berdi Ardan, chunki u raketalarni ishga tushirish uchun elektr vositasining mukammal holatda ishlashini ta'minladi.

en: "Wait till I give the word," said Barbican, pulling out his chronometer.
uz: "Men xabar bermagunimcha kuting", - dedi Barbican, xronometrini olib chiqib.

en: The moment was now evidently close at hand.
uz: O'sha paytda vaqt yaqinlashib qolgan edi.

uz: Atrofda yotgan narsalarning hech qanday og'irligi yo'q edi.

en: The travellers felt their bodies to be as buoyant as a hydrogen balloon.
uz: Sayohatchilar o'zlarining tanasini vodorod ballon singari ko'tarib turganini his qilishdi.

en: Barbican let go his chronometer, but it kept its place as firmly in empty space before his eyes as if it had been nailed to the wall!
uz: Barbican o'z xronometrini qo'yib yubordi, lekin u uning ko'z o'ngida bo'sh joyda o'z o'rinini xuddi devorga qulflab qo'yilganidek saqladi!

en: "One o'clock!" cried Barbican in a solemn tone.
uz: "Bir soat!" - dedi Barbican tantanali ovoz bilan.

uz: Ardan darhol kichik elektr batareyasining chiqarib tashlash kalitini qo'ydi.

en: But Ardan saw through the window a long thin flash, which vanished in a second.
uz: Ammo Ardan darcha orqali uzun va chiroyli bir chaqmoqni ko'rdi, u bir soniyada yo'qoldi.

en: At the same moment, the three friends became instantaneously conscious of a slight shock experienced by the Projectile.
uz: Shu paytning o'zida uchta do'st o'z-o'zidan Projectile tomonidan boshdan kechirilgan salqin shokning guvohi bo'ldi.

en: They looked at each other, speechless, breathless, for about as long as it would take you to count five: the silence so intense that they could easily hear the pulsation of their hearts.
uz: Ular bir-birlariga so'zsiz, nafassiz qarab turishdi, taxminan beshni sanash uchun kerak bo'lgan vaqtni: shunchalik kuchli sukut bo'lganki, ular o'z yuraklarining urishini osonlikcha eshitishgan.

uz: "Biz yo'q!" - deb javob berdi M'Nicholl, shuningdek, o'z nafasidan yuqori gapirishni ham qiyinlashtirdi.

uz: "O'zining birinchi taassurotlari doimo to'g'ri", - deb u falsafiy gapirdi.

en: "We are lost!" said M'Nicholl gloomily, his philosophy yielding to despair.
uz: "Biz yo'qolganmiz!" - dedi M'Nicholl, uning falsafasi umidsizlikka tushadi.

en: "One consolation, boys!" cried Ardan, genial to the last.
uz: "Bir tasalli, yigitlar!" - dedi Ardan, so'nggigacha ajoyib.

en: "We shall die together!" "If we die," said Barbican calmly, but with a kind of suppressed enthusiasm, "it will be only to remove to a more extended sphere of our investigations.
uz: "Biz birgalikda o'lamiz!" - dedi Barbican xotirjamlik bilan, ammo bir xil quvonch bilan, "agar o'lsak, bu faqat bizning tadqiqotlarimizning kengroq sferasiga olib ketilishi uchun bo'ladi.

en: In the other world, we can pursue our inquiries under far more favorable auspices.
uz: Boshqa dunyoda biz ko'proq qulay sharoitlarda so'rovlarimizni davom ettira olamiz.

en: There the wonders of our great Creator, clothed in brighter light, shall be brought within a shorter range.
uz: U yerda buyuk Yaratuvchimizning ajoyib ishlari yanada yorug'roq yorug'lik bilan qoplangan bo'lib, kamroq masofaga olib boriladi.

en: We shall require no machine, nor projectile, nor material contrivance of any kind to be enabled to contemplate them in all their grandeur and to appreciate them fully and intelligently.
uz: Biz hech qanday mashina, o'q-tuxum yoki biron-bir moddiy ustunlik talab qilmaymiz, toki ularni o'z ulug'vorligida ko'rib chiqish va ularni to'liq va aqlli ravishda qadrlashimiz mumkin.

en: Our souls, enlightened by the emanations of the Eternal Wisdom, shall revel forever in the blessed rays of Eternal Knowledge!" "A grand view to take of it, dear friend Barbican;" replied Ardan, "and a consoling one too.
uz: Abadiy donolikning nurlari bilan nurlangan jonlarimiz abadiy abadiy bilimning qutlug' nurlarida zavqlanadilar! - deb javob berdi Ardan. - Bu ajoyib va tasalli beruvchi ko'rinish, aziz do'stim Barbican.

en: The privilege of roaming at will through God's great universe should make ample amends for missing the Moon!"
uz: Xudoning buyuk koinotida o'z xohish-irodasidan yurish sharafiga ega bo'lish, oyni yo'qotib qo'yganimiz uchun to'lovni to'liq qoplashi kerak!"

en: M'Nicholl fixed his eyes on Barbican admiringly, feebly muttering with hardly moving lips: "Grit to the marrow!
uz: M'Nicholl Barbicanga qarab, o'z ko'zlarini hayratda qoldirib, og'zidan hech narsa ko'tarilmagan og'izlar bilan bir-biridan so'zlab: "Qo'nggi marraga quloq sol!

en: Grit to the marrow!" Barbican, head bowed in reverence, arms folded across his breast, meekly and uncomplainingly uttered with sublime resignation: "Thy will be done!" "Amen!" answered his companions, in a loud and fervent whisper.
uz: Grit to the marrow!" - deb qo'shib qo'ydi Barbican, boshini hurmat bilan egallagan, qo'llarini ko'krakidan to'kib olgan holda, kamtarlik va nohaqlik bilan oliy martabali bo'linish bilan: "Sening xohishing bajo kelsin!" - deb javob berdi.

en: They were soon falling through the boundless regions of space with inconceivable rapidity!
uz: Tez orada ular ko'rinmas darajada tezlik bilan kosmik hududlar bo'ylab tushib ketishdi!

en: OFF THE PACIFIC COAST.
uz: O'Shaning okean qirg'og'ida.

uz: - Xo'sh, leytenant, tovush qanday? - deb so'radi. - Juda hayajonli, kapitan, biz deyarli to'xtadik, - dedi leytenant.

en: "But it's a tremendous depth so near land.
uz: Ammo bu yerning deyarli deyarli deyarli chuqurligi.

en: "We have probably lit on a submarine valley channelled out by the Japanese Current." "The Japanese Current, Captain?" "Certainly; that branch of it which breaks on the western shores of North America and then flows southeast towards the Isthmus of Panama." "That may account for it, Captain," replied young Brownson; "at least, I hope it does, for then we may expect the valley to get shallower as we leave the land.
uz: "Biz, ehtimol, Yaponiya quyi tomonidan olib chiqilgan suv osti daryosini yoritganmiz", "Yapon quyi, kapitan?" "Agar bo'lmasa, uning shimoliy Amerikaning g'arbiy sohillarida bo'lib, so'ngra Panamaning Istmosiga qarab janubi-sharqiy tomonga oqadigan shoxasi.

en: So far, there's no sign of a Telegraphic Plateau in this quarter of the globe." "Probably not, Brownson.
uz: Shu paytgacha dunyoning bu choragida Telegrafik plato haqida hech qanday iz yo'q.

en: "I hope it's not the 'cup-lead' you are using, Brownson?" said the Captain, after a few minutes observation.
uz: Kapten bir necha daqiqa kuzatuvdan so'ng dedi: "Siz foydalanayotgan "ko'p-ko'rsatkich" emasligini umid qilaman, Brownson?"

en: "Oh no, Captain, certainly not," replied the Lieutenant.
uz: - Yo'q, kapitan, albatta yo'q, - dedi boshliq.

uz: "Bu kabi chuqurliklarda faqat Brukning qurilmalari foyda keltiradi. " - deb aytdi kapitan. - Brooke, Maury davrida u bilan birga xizmat qilgan aqlli yigit.

uz: Endi to'rtta qo'ng'iroq yaqinlashib qoldi va sizning izningiz bilan o'zimni o'tkazaman.

en: Good night!" "Goodnight, Captain!" replied Brownson, who spent the next two hours pacing backward and forward on the quarter deck, watching the hauling in of the sounding line, and occasionally casting a glance towards all quarters of the sky.
uz: "Yaxshi kecha, kapitan!" - deb javob berdi Brownson, keyingi ikki soat davomida to'rtta deckda orqaga va oldinga qadam qo'yib, ovoz chizig'ini ko'rib turardi va vaqti-vaqti bilan osmonning barcha tomonlariga nazar tashladi.

en: It was a glorious night.

uz: Siz o'zingizni tropik iqlimda his qilar edingiz, chunki hech qanday nafas oltingizda bo'lmasa-da, his-tuyg'ularingiz uzoqdagi shirin gullar bog'ining mazali hidini osonlikcha aniqlaydi.

uz: Bosh muhandis qo'shimcha qildi: "Menda hech qanday shubha yo'qki, bu narsa nihoyat shunchalik modaga aylanadiki, Yer aholisining yarmi oyga sayohat qiladi". "Men ushbu imtiyozni faqat Vashingtondagi do'stlarimizga cheklashim kerak", dedi keksa Frisbi, uning g'azabi, ehtimol, uzoq xizmatlarini e'tirof etishni unutib qo'ymaganligi tufayli yomon bo'lgan. "Ularning aksariyati uchun esa men hech bo'lmaganda oyga yuborishga qat'iy qaror qilishim kerak.

en: Every month I would ram a whole raft of them into the Columbiad, with a charge under them strong enough to blow them all to the—But— Hey!—what in creation's that?"
uz: Har oy men ularning to'liq to'plamini Kolumbiadga tushirardim, ularning ostidan to'g'ri bo'lgan to'siq bilan ularning barchasini toshga tushirishim mumkin edi.

en: FOR A SECOND ONLY DID THEY CATCH ITS FLASH.
uz: Faqat bir soniya davomida ular o'z sur'atlarini ushlab olishdi.

en: Whilst the officer was speaking, his companions had suddenly caught a sound in the air which reminded them immediately of the whistling scream of a Lancaster shell.
uz: Politsiya boshligʻi gapirganida, uning hamkorlari birdan havodagi tovushni koʻrishdi va u darhol ularni Lancaster shellining qichqirishini eslatdi.

en: At first they thought the steam was escaping somewhere, but, looking upwards, they saw that the strange noise proceeded from a ball of dazzling brightness, directly over their heads, and evidently falling towards them with tremendous velocity.
uz: Boshida ular bug'lar qayerda bo'lsa-da qochib ketayotganini o'ylashdi, lekin yuqoriga qarab, g'alati tovush ularning boshlari ustida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lgan, chiroyli yorug'lik to'plamidan kelib chiqqanini ko'rishdi va, ko'rinib turibdiki, ular tomon dahshatli tezlikda tushib borayotgan edi.

en: Too frightened to say a word, they could only see that in its light the whole ship blazed like fireworks, and the whole sea glittered like a silver lake.
uz: Bir so'z aytish uchun juda qo'rqishgan, ular faqat uning yorug'ligida butun kemaning yong'in o't qo'zg'ayganini va butun dengizning kumush ko'l kabi shinamligini ko'rishgan.

en: Quicker than tongue can utter, or mind can conceive, it flashed before their eyes for a second, an enormous
uz: Til so'zlashiga yoki ongini tasavvur qilishga moyil bo'lganidan tezroq, bir soniya davomida ularning ko'z o'ngida o'tadi.

en: bolide set on fire by friction with the atmosphere, and gleaming in its white heat like a stream of molten iron gushing straight from the furnace.
uz: Atmosfera bilan aralashish natijasida yong'in o'tadi va uning oq issiqligida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pechdan oqib kelayotgan eritilgan temir oqimi kabi shinam bo'ladi.

en: For a second only did they catch its flash before their eyes; then striking the bowsprit of the vessel, which it shivered into a thousand pieces, it vanished in the sea in an instant with a hiss, a scream, and a roar, all equally indescribable.
uz: Bir soniya davomida ular uning shovqinini ko'zlari oldida ko'rishdi; so'ngra kema mingta qismga bo'lib titragan bo'lsa-da, o'sha kemani o'sha paytning o'zida dengizda silkitish, qichqirish va qichqirish bilan yo'qoldi. Bularning hammasi ham bir xil qilib tasvirlab bo'lmaydi.

en: For some time the utmost confusion reigned on deck.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida deckda eng katta g'alati hukmronlik qildi.

en: With eyes too dazzled to see, ears still ringing with the frightful combination of unearthly sounds, faces splashed with floods of sea water, and noses stifled with clouds of scalding steam, the crew of the Susquehanna could hardly realize that their marvellous escape by a few feet from instant and certain destruction was an accomplished fact, not a frightful dream.
uz: Ko'rish uchun ko'zlari juda cho'kgan, quloqlari hali ham yerdan tashqari tovushlarning dahshatli kombinatsiyasi bilan qichqirgan, yuzlari dengiz suvining to'lqinlari bilan cho'kkan va burunlari qizg'in tutun bulutlari bilan cho'kgan, Susquehanna ekipajining ajoyib qochishi bir necha metrlik darhol va aniq yo'q bo'lib ketishidan qo'rqqanlari uchun, bu dahshatli orzu emas, balki amalga oshgan narsa ekanligini anglab yetib qolmadi.

en: They were still engaged in trying to open their eyes and to get the hot water out of their ears, when they suddenly heard the trumpet voice of Captain Bloomsbury crying, as he stood half dressed on the head of the cabin stairs: "What's up, gentlemen?
uz: Ular hali ham ko'zlarini ochishga va quloqlaridan issiq suvni olib chiqishga harakat qilishganida, kapitan Bloomsburyning yarim kiyimli bo'lib, qahramonlarning boshiga to'xtab turganini eshitib, qo'ng'iroq qildilar: "Nima bo'ldi, xonimlar?

en: In heaven's name, what's up?" The little Midshipman had been knocked flat by the concussion and stunned by the uproar.
uz: Osmon nomidan, nima bo'ldi?" - deb so'rashdi. Kichik Midshipman shovqin tufayli to'xtab qolib, g'alati shov-shuvdan hayron qolgan edi.

en: But before any body else could reply, his voice was heard, clear and sharp, piercing the din like an arrow: "It's THEY, Captain!
uz: Ammo boshqa hech kim javob bera olmaguncha, uning ovozi aniq va o'tkir bo'lib, o'q kabi: "Ular, kapitan!

en: Didn't I tell you so?"
uz: Men sizga aytmagan edimmi?"

en: In a few minutes, consciousness had restored order on board the Susquehanna, but the excitement was as great as ever.
uz: Bir necha daqiqada Susquehanna kemasida ong tartibni tikladi, ammo hayajon har qachongidan ham katta edi.

en: They had escaped by a hairsbreadth the terrible fate of being both burned and drowned without a moment's warning, without a single soul being left alive to tell the fatal tale; but on this neither officer nor man appeared to bestow the slightest thought.
uz: Ular o'zlarining qo'rqinchli taqdiridan bir soch cho'qqisidan qochib ketishgan edi: ular bir lahza ogohlantirishsiz yonib, cho'kib ketishgan edi, o'zlarining halokatli hikoyalarini aytib berishga hech bir jon qolmagan edi; lekin bu haqda hech bir xodim ham, odam ham hech qanday fikrni bermagan edi.

en: They were wholly engrossed with the terrible catastrophe that had befallen the famous adventurers.
uz: Ular mashhur sayohatchilarga yuz bergan dahshatli fojia bilan to'liq band edilar.

en: What was the loss of the Susquehanna and all it contained, in comparison to the loss experienced by the world at large in the terrible tragic dénouement just witnessed?
uz: Susquehanna va uning tarkibiga kirgan barcha narsalarning yo'qotilishi, hozir ko'rgan dahshatli fojia oqibatida butun dunyo boshdan kechirgan yo'qotish bilan taqqoslaganda, nima edi?

en: The worst had now come to the worst.
uz: Endi eng yomon narsa eng yomon narsaga aylandi.

en: At last the long agony was over forever.
uz: Oxir-oqibat uzoq azob-uqubatlar abadiy o'tdi.

en: Those three gallant men, who had not only conceived but had actually executed the grandest and most daring enterprise of ancient or modern times, had paid by the most fearful of deaths, for their sublime devotion to science and their unselfish desire to extend the bounds of human knowledge!
uz: O'sha uchta jasoratli odam, nafaqat qadimgi yoki zamonaviy zamonlarning eng buyuk va eng jasoratli ishini tasavvur qilgan, balki amalga oshirgan edilar, o'limdan qo'rqadiganlar tomonidan ilm-fanga bo'lgan yuksak sadoqatlari va inson bilimining chegaralarini kengaytirishga bo'lgan begʻaraz istaklari uchun pul to'lagan edilar!

en: Before such a reflection as this, all other considerations were at once reduced to proportions of the most absolute insignificance.
uz: Bunday fikrlashdan oldin, boshqa barcha e'tiborlar eng mutlaqo ahamiyatsiz bo'lgan proporsiyalarga kamaytirildi.

en: But was the death of the adventurers so very certain after all?
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarning o'limi shu qadar aniqmi edi?

en: Hope is hard to kill.
uz: Umidni o'ldirish qiyin.

en: Consciousness had brought reflection, reflection doubt, and doubt had resuscitated hope.
uz: O'y-o'yinning o'zi tafakkur, tafakkur shubha keltirdi va shubha umidni qayta tiriltirdi.

en: "It's they!" had exclaimed the little Midshipman, and the cry had thrilled every heart on board as with an electric shock.
uz: "Ular!" - deb hayqirdi kichkina Midshipman, va qichqiriq kemadagi har bir qalbini elektr shokiga o'xshatgan.

en: had instantly understood it.
uz: O'sha zahoti buni tushunib oldim.

en: Everybody had felt it to be true.
uz: Hammasi buni haqiqatdek his qilgan edi.

en: Nothing could be more certain than that the meteor which had just flashed before their eyes was the famous projectile of the Baltimore Gun Club.
uz: Ularning ko'z o'ngida to'qnashgan meteorit Baltimor quroli klubining mashhur raketi bo'lganidan ko'ra aniqroq narsa yo'q edi.

en: Nothing could be truer than that it contained the three world renowned men and that it now lay in the black depths of the Pacific Ocean.
uz: Unda uchta dunyo mashhur odam borligi va hozirda Tinch okeanning qora chuqurliklarida joylashganligi haqida aytishdan ko'ra haqiqatliroq narsa yo'q.

en: But here opinions began to diverge.
uz: Ammo bu yerda fikrlar farq qila boshladi.

en: Some courageous breasts soon refused to accept the prevalent idea.
uz: Ba'zi jasoratli ko'kraklar tez orada keng tarqalgan g'oyani qabul qilishni rad etishdi.

en: "They're killed by the shock!" cried the crowd.
uz: "Ular hayratdan o'ldirilgan!" - deb hayqirdi xaloyiq.

en: "Killed?" exclaimed the hopeful ones; "Not a bit of it!
uz: "Qo'ldirilganmi?" - deb hayqirdi umidvorlar; "Bir oz ham yo'q!

en: The water here is deep enough to break a fall twice as great." "They're smothered for want of air!" exclaimed the crowd.
uz: Bu yerdagi suv ikki barobar chuqurroq bo'lib, suv tushib ketishi mumkin". - Ular havo yetishmagani uchun g'arq bo'lib ketishdi! - deb hayqirdi xaloyiq.

en: "Their stock may not be run out yet!" was the ready reply.
uz: "Ularning zaxiralari hali to'xtab qolmagan bo'lishi mumkin!" - deb javob berishga tayyor edilar.

en: "Their air apparatus is still on hand." "They're burned to a cinder!" shrieked the crowd.
uz: "O'shalarning havo qurilmalari hali ham mavjud". "Ular yonib ketishdi!" - deb hayqirdi xaloyiq.

en: "They had not time to be burned!" answered the Band of Hope.
uz: "Ular yonishga vaqt yo'q edi!" - deb javob berdi umid guruhi.

en: "The Projectile did not get hot till it reached the atmosphere, through which it tore in a few seconds." "If they're neither burned nor smothered nor killed by the shock, they're sure to be drowned!" persisted the crowd, with redoubled lamentations.
uz: "Projektil atmosferaga yetgunga qadar issiq bo'lmadi, undan bir necha soniya ichida parchalanib ketdi". "Agar ular notanish yoki cho'ktirilmasa yoki o'ldirilmasa, shubhasiz, cho'kib ketishadi!" - deb ta'kidlab o'tgan xaloyiq ikki barobar ko'paygan.

en: "Fish 'em up first!" cried the Hopeful Band.
uz: Umidli guruh: "Birinchi ularni baliqlab qo'ying!" - deb baqirdi.

en: Let's fish 'em up at once!" The cries of Hope prevailed.
uz: Keling, ularni birdan tutib olaylik!" - degan umidning qichqiriqlari hukmronlik qildi.

en: The unanimous opinion of a council of the officers hastily summoned together by the Captain was to go to work and fish up the Projectile with the least possible delay.
uz: Kapitan tomonidan tezda yig'ilgan ofitserlar kengashi bir ovozda ishga borishga va eng kam kechiktirilgan holda "Projectil"ni olib chiqishga qaror qildi.

en: But was such an operation possible?
uz: Ammo bunday operatsiya amalga oshirilishi mumkinmi?

en: was the overwhelming reply; difficult, no doubt, but still quite possible.
uz: Bu javob katta bo'ldi; qiyin, shubhasiz, lekin hali ham mumkin.

en: Certainly, however, such an attempt was not immediately possible as the Susquehanna had no machinery strong enough or suitable enough for a piece of work involving such a nicety of detailed operations, not to speak of its exceeding difficulty.
uz: Ammo shubhasizki, bunday urinish darhol mumkin bo'lmagan, chunki Susquehanna mashinalari etarlicha kuchli yoki bunday batafsil operatsiyalarni o'z ichiga olgan ish uchun etarlicha mos keladigan mashinalarga ega bo'lmagan.

en: The next unanimous decision, therefore, was to start the vessel at once for the nearest port, whence they could instantly telegraph the Projectile's arrival to the Baltimore Gun Club.
uz: Shunday qilib, keyingi bir ovozli qaror kemani darhol eng yaqin portga boshlash edi, shu yerdan ular bir zumda Projectilening Baltimor Gun Clubga kelishini telegraflashlari mumkin edi.

en: But what was the nearest port?
uz: Ammo eng yaqin port nima edi?

en: A serious question, to answer which in a satisfactory manner the Captain had to carefully examine
uz: Bu jiddiy savolga javob berish uchun kapitan uni qoniqarli tarzda sinchkovlik bilan o'rganib chiqishi kerak edi.

en: The neighboring shores of the California Peninsula, low and sandy, were absolutely destitute of good harbors.
uz: Kaliforniya yarim oroli yaqinidagi past va qumli qirg'oqlarda yaxshi portlar yo'q edi.

en: San Diego, about a day's sail directly north, possessed an excellent harbor, but, not yet having telegraphic communication with the rest of the Union, it was of course not to be thought of.
uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri shimoliga bir kunlik yelka tashrifi bo'lgan San-Diyegoda ajoyib port bor edi, ammo u hali ham butun Ittifoq bilan telegrafik aloqaga ega bo'lmagani uchun, albatta, bu haqda o'ylamaslik kerak edi.

en: San Pedro Bay was too open to be approached in winter.
uz: Qishda San-Pedro ko'chasi juda ochiq edi.

en: The Santa Barbara Channel was liable to the same objection, not to mention the trouble often caused by kelp and wintry fogs.
uz: Santa-Barbara kanalida ham xuddi shunday e'tiroz bor edi, ayniqsa, kelp va qishdagi bulutlar tufayli ko'pincha paydo bo'ladigan muammolar haqida gap ketmasdi.

en: The bay of San Luis Obispo was still worse in every respect; having no islands to act as a breakwater, landing there in winter was often impossible.
uz: San Luis Obispo ko'chasi har jihatdan yanada yomonroq edi; suvni buzish uchun orollar bo'lmaganligi sababli, qishda u yerga tushish ko'pincha imkonsiz edi.

en: The harbor of the picturesque old town of Monterey was safe enough, but some uncertainty regarding sure telegraphic communications with San Francisco, decided the council not to venture it.
uz: Montereyning go'zal eski shaharchasining portlari xavfsiz edi, ammo San-Fransiisko bilan telegrafik aloqalar bo'yicha aniqlik yo'qligi sababli, Kengash bu ishga qo'l urmaslikka qaror qildi.

en: Half Moon Bay, a little to the north, would be just as risky, and in moments like the present when every minute was worth a day, no risk involving the slightest loss of time could be ventured.
uz: Yarim oy ko'chasi, biroz shimolga, xuddi shunday xavfli bo'ladi va har bir daqiqa bir kunga arziydigan hozirgi paytda hech qanday vaqtni yo'qotish xavfi yo'q.

en: Evidently, therefore, the most advisable plan was to sail directly for the bay of San Francisco, the Golden Gate, the finest harbor on the Pacific Coast and one of the safest in the world.
uz: Shu sababli, eng yaxshi reja San-Fransiisko ko'chasiga, Tinch okean qirg'og'idagi eng yaxshi port va dunyodagi eng xavfsiz portlardan biri bo'lgan Golden Gate shahriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sayohat qilish edi.

en: Here telegraphic communication with all parts of the Union was assured beyond a doubt.
uz: Bu yerda Ittifoqning barcha qismlari bilan telegrafik aloqa shubhasiz kafolatlangan edi.

en: San Francisco, about ൨൦ൡ miles distant, the Susquehanna could probably make in three days; with a little increased pressure, possibly in two days and a-half.
uz: San-Fransisko, taxminan  mil uzoqlikda, Susquehanna, ehtimol, uch kun ichida, balki ikki yarim kun ichida, biroz ko'paygan bosim bilan yetib borishi mumkin.

en: The sooner then she started, the better.
uz: U qanchalik tezroq boshlasa, shunchalik yaxshi bo'ladi.

en: The fires were soon in full blast.
uz: Tez orada yong'inlar to'liq portlashdi.

en: The vessel could get under weigh at once.
uz: Suv birdan og'irlashishi mumkin.

en: In fact, nothing delayed immediate departure but the consideration that two miles of sounding line were still to be hauled up from the ocean depths.
uz: Darhaqiqat, darhol jo'nab ketishni hech narsa kechiktirmagan, faqat ikki millik ovoz chizig'i dengiz chuqurligidan ko'tarib olinishi kerakligi haqida fikr yuritilibdi.

en: Rut the Captain, after a moment's thought, unwilling that any more time should be lost, determined to cut it.
uz: Kapten Rut bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'rganidan so'ng, vaqt yo'q bo'lib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymagan holda, uni kesishga qat'iy qaror qildi.

en: Then marking its position by fastening its end to a buoy, he could haul it up at his leisure on his return.
uz: So'ngra uning o'rniga belgi qo'yib, oxirini bo'yinga bog'lab qo'ydi va qaytib kelganida uni o'zi xohlagancha ko'tarib olishi mumkin edi.

en: "Besides," said he, "the buoy will show us the precise spot where the Projectile fell." "As for that, Captain," observed Brownson, "the exact spot has been carefully recorded already: ൣ൨° ൨' north latitude by ൥ൢ° ൤൨' west longitude, reckoning from the meridian of Washington." "All right, Lieutenant," said the Captain curtly.
uz: "O'shanda, - dedi u, - buoy bizga o'g'il quyilgan aniq joyni ko'rsatadi". "O'sha joyga kelsak, kapitan, - deb ta'kidladi Brownson, - aniq joy allaqachon diqqat bilan qayd etilgan: °' shimoliy uzunlik bilan °' g'arbiy uzunlik, Vaşington meridianidan hisoblab". "To'g'ri, leytenant", - dedi kapitan qisqa so'z bilan.

en: A large cone-shaped metal buoy, strengthened still further by a couple of stout spars to which it was securely lashed, was soon rigged up on deck, whence, being hoisted overboard, the whole apparatus was carefully lowered to the surface of the sea.
uz: Bir necha kuchli sparalar bilan yanada mustahkamlangan katta kon shaklidagi metall bo'y, tez orada kemaga o'rnatib qo'yildi, shundan keyin butun qurilma dengiz yuziga tashlandi.

en: By means of a ring in the small end of the buoy, the latter was then solidly attached to the part of the sounding line that still remained in the water, and all possible precautions were taken to diminish the danger of friction, caused by the contrary currents, tidal waves, and the ordinary heaving swells of ocean.
uz: Buyumning kichik yonida bo'lgan bog'ning yordamida buyum suvda qolgan ovoz chizig'ining qismini qattiq bog'lagan va akvariumning qarshi oqimlari, to'lqin to'lqinlari va oddiy o'simliklar tufayli yuzaga keladigan chiziqlar xavfini kamaytirish uchun barcha ehtiyotkorlik choralari ko'rilgan.

en: It was now a little after three o'clock in the morning.
uz: Hozir esa soat uchdan biroz past edi.

en: The Chief Engineer announced everything to be in perfect readiness for starting.
uz: Bosh muhandis hamma narsani ishga tushirish uchun mukammal tayyor bo'lishi uchun e'lon qildi.

en: The Captain gave the signal, directing the pilot to steer straight for San Francisco, north-north by west.
uz: Kapten signalni berib, uchuvchiga San-Fransiiskoga, shimoliy-shimoliy g'arbdan to'g'ri yo'l tutishni buyurdi.

en: The waters under the stern began to boil and foam; the ship very soon felt and yielded to the power that animated her; and in a few minutes she was making at least twelve knots an hour.
uz: G'ildirak ostidagi suvlar qaynay boshladi va changga aylandi; kemani tez orada o'z kuchini his etib, uni jonlantirgan kuchga bo'ysundirdi va bir necha daqiqada u soatga kamida o'n ikki nuqta harakatlanardi.

en: Her sailing powers were somewhat higher than this, but it was necessary to be careful in the neighborhood of such a dangerous coast as that of California.
uz: Uning yelka qobiliyati bundan ancha yuqori edi, ammo Kaliforniya kabi xavfli qirg'oqning atrofida ehtiyot bo'lish kerak edi.

en: Seven hundred and fifty miles of smooth waters presented no very difficult task to a fast traveller like the Susquehanna, yet it was not till two days and a-half afterwards that she sighted the Golden Gate.
uz: Yetti yuz ellik mil suyuq suvlar Susquehanna kabi tezkor sayohatchi uchun juda qiyin vazifa emas edi, ammo ikki yarim kun o'tgandan so'ng oltin darvozani ko'rgan.

en: As usual, the coast was foggy; neither Point Lobos nor Point Boneta could be seen.
uz: Odatdagidek, qirg'oq qorong'i bo'lib, Point Lobos ham, Point Boneta ham ko'rinmas edi.

en: But Captain Bloomsbury, well acquainted with every portion of this coast, ran as close along the southern shore as he dared, the fog-gun at Point Boneta safely directing his course.
uz: Ammo ushbu sohilning har bir qismini yaxshi bilgan kapitan Bloomsbury janubiy sohil bo'ylab imkon qadar yaqinroq yugurib, Point Bonetadagi qirg'o'l qurolini o'z yo'lini xavfsiz yo'naltirgan edi.

en: Here expecting to be able to gain a few hours time by signalling to the outer telegraph station on Point Lobos, he had caused to be painted on a sail in large black letters: "THE MOONMEN ARE BACK!" but the officers in attendance, though their fog-horn could be easily heard—the distance not being quite two miles—were unfortunately not able to see it.
uz: Bu yerda u Point Lobosdagi tashqi telegraf stantsiyasiga signal yuborib, bir necha soat vaqt topishni kutganida, katta qora harflar bilan: "HOL QO'ShIQLAR qaytib keldi!" deb yelka ustiga rasm chizgan edi, ammo hozir bo'lgan ofitserlar, hatto ularning bulut shoxlari ham osonlikcha eshitilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, uzoqlikda ikki kilometr yo'q bo'lsa-da, afsuski, uni ko'rish imkoniga ega bo'lmadilar.

en: Perhaps they did see it, but feared a hoax.
uz: Ehtimol, ular buni ko'rishgan, lekin bu yolg'on bo'lishidan qo'rqishgan.

en: Giving the Fort Point a good wide berth, the Susquehanna found the fog gradually clearing away, and by half-past three the passengers, looking under it, enjoyed the glorious view of the Contra Costa mountains east of San Francisco, which had obtained for this entrance the famous and well deserved appellation of the Golden Gate.
uz: Fort Poyntiga yaxshi keng joy berayotgan Susquehanna, bulutni asta-sekin yo'qotganini ko'rdi va soat uch yarim o'tgach, yo'lovchilar uning ostiga qarab, San-Fransiskoning sharqidagi Contra Costa tog'larining ajoyib manzarasidan bahramand bo'lishdi, bu kirish uchun oltin darvoza degan mashhur va munosib nomga ega bo'lgan.

en: In another half hour, they had doubled Black Point, and were
uz: Yana yarim soat ichida ular Qora nuqtani ikki baravar ko'paytirib, o'z joylarida bo'lishdi.

en: lying safely at anchor between the islands of Alcatraz and Yerba Buena.
uz: Alcatraz va Yerba Buena orollari o'rtasida xavfsizlikda qo'rg'oq bo'lib yotgan.

en: In less than five minutes afterwards the Captain was quickly lowered into his gig, and eight stout pairs of arms were pulling him rapidly to shore.
uz: Besh daqiqadan kam vaqt o'tgach, kapitan tezda o'z ishini boshlaydi va sakkiz kuchli qo'l uni qirg'oqqa tezlik bilan tortib borardi.

en: The usual crowd of idlers had collected that evening on the summit of Telegraph Hill to enjoy the magnificent view, which for variety, extent, beauty and grandeur, is probably unsurpassed on earth.
uz: O'sha kechqurun Telegram tog'ining tepalig'ida odatdagi to'sqinlik qiladigan odamlar to'planib, turli xil, keng, go'zal va buyuk ko'rinishlardan bahramand bo'lgan ajoyib manzaralardan bahramand bo'lishdi.

en: Of course, the inevitable reporter, hot after an item, was not absent.
uz: Shubhasizki, biron bir mavzuga ishtiyoq bilan qaraydigan mutasaddi yo'q edi.

en: The Susquehanna had hardly crossed the bar, when they caught sight of her.
uz: Susquehanna oilasi uni ko'rishganda, bardan oz o'tishgan edi.

en: A government vessel entering the bay at full speed, is something to look at even in San Francisco.
uz: To'liq tezlikda ko'chma qirg'og'iga kirib kelayotgan hukumat kemasi hatto San-Fransiskoda ham ko'rinishi mumkin.

en: Even during the war, it would be considered rather unusual.
uz: Hatto urush paytida ham bu odatiy hol deb hisoblanardi.

uz: Ammo tez orada uning bowsprit butunlay kesilganligini payqadilar.

uz: Biror narsa bo'lishi kerak va baland tog'dan tushish uchun hammalari oyoqlari bilan Megg's Wharfga yetib borishga imkon qadar tezroq shovqin qilishadi.

uz: Kapten zich to'plamni o'rab o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan, lekin u ularning g'alati qiziqishlarini qondirish uchun hech qanday harakat qilmadi.

uz: U jang ovozi tashqarida kamdan-kam eshitilgan ovoz bilan: "Tovush!" - deb baqirdi.

uz: O'n yettita qobiliyatli qo'riqchi bir lahzada uni qo'ldan-qo'l bo'g'ib ketishga uringan edi.

uz: "Telegrafga!

en: Like lightning!" were his stifled mutterings, as he struggled in the arms of the Irish giant who had at last succeeded in securing him.
uz: Yolg'izganday!" - deb qo'rqinchli qichqiriqlarini aytdi u, oxir-oqibat uni himoya qilishga muvaffaq bo'lgan irlandiyalik ulkanning qo'llarida kurashganida.

en: "To the telegraph office!" cried most of the crowd, running after him like fox hounds, but the more knowing ones immediately began questioning the boatmen in the Captain's gig.
uz: "Telegrafga!" - deb hayqirdi xaloyiqning ko'p qismi, uning orqasidan tovuq otlar kabi yugurib ketishdi, ammo ko'proq bilimdonlar darhol kapitanning ishida bo'lgan kemachilarni so'roq qila boshladilar.

en: These honest fellows, nothing loth to tell all that they knew and more that they invented, soon had the satisfaction of finding themselves the centrepoint of a wonder stricken audience, greedily swallowing up every item of the extraordinary news and still hungrily gaping for more.
uz: Bu halol odamlar, bilganlari va ixtiro qilganlari haqida hech narsa aytolmaydi, lekin tez orada o'zlarini hayratda qolgan tinglovchilarning markazida topish qoniqishlariga ega bo'lishdi, ular har bir ajoyib yangilikni ochko'zlik bilan yutib yuborishdi va hali ham ko'proq narsani xohlashdi.

en: By this time, however, an important dispatch was flying east, bearing four different addresses: To the Secretary of the U.S.

en: This dispatch read as follows: "In latitude twenty-seven degrees seven minutes north and longitude forty-one degrees thirty-seven minutes west shortly after one o'clock on the morning of twelfth instant Columbiad Projectile fell in Pacific— send instructions— BLOOMSBURY, Captain, SUSQUEHANNA." "Besh daqiqadan so'ng butun San-Fransiisko yangiliklarga ega bo'ldi.

en: An hour later, the newspaper boys were shrieking it through the great cities of the States.
uz: Bir soat o'tgach, gazeta o'g'illari AQShning katta shaharlarida buni baqirib yurishdi.

en: Before bed-time every man, woman, and child in the country had heard it and gone into ecstasies over it.
uz: Yotoqdan oldin, mamlakatdagi har bir erkak, ayol va bola uni eshitib, bu haqda hayajonga tushdi.

en: Owing to the difference in longitude, the people of Europe could not hear it till after midnight.
uz: Uzoqlikning farqlari sababli, Yevropa aholisi uni yarim tundan keyin tinglay olishmadi.

en: But next morning the astounding issue of the great American enterprise fell on them like a thunder clap.
uz: Ammo ertasi kuni ertalab, buyuk amerikalik biznesning hayratlanarli sonlari ular ustiga g'azabga to'lib tushdi.

en: We must, of course, decline all attempts at describing the effects of this most unexpected intelligence on the world at large.
uz: Albatta, biz ushbu kutilmagan ma'lumotlarning butun dunyoga ta'sirini tasvirlashga qaratilgan har qanday urinishlardan voz kechishimiz kerak.

en: The Secretary of the Navy immediately telegraphed directions to the Susquehanna to keep a full head of steam up night and day so as to be ready to give instant execution to orders received at any moment.
uz: Dengiz dengizlari kotibi darhol Susquehannaga kechayu kunduz to'liq parom boshini saqlab qolish uchun yo'l-yo'riqlarni telegraf orqali yuboradi, shunda u har qanday vaqtda qabul qilingan buyruqlarni darhol ijro etishga tayyor bo'ladi.

en: The Observatory authorities at Cambridge held a special meeting that very evening, where, with all the serene calmness so characteristic of learned societies, they discussed the scientific points of the question in all its bearings.
uz: Kembridj Observatoriyasi xodimlari o'sha kechqurun maxsus yig'ilish o'tkazdi, u yerda o'qituvchi jamiyatlarga xos tinchlik bilan savolning ilmiy jihatlarini muhokama qildilar.

en: But, before committing themselves to any decided opinion, they unanimously resolved to wait for the development of further details.
uz: Ammo ular qarorga kelishdan oldin, bir ovozdan qaror qildilarki, qo'shimcha tafsilotlarni kutib turish kerak.

en: At the rooms of the Gun Club in Baltimore there was a terrible time.
uz: Baltimordagi Gun Club xonadonlarida dahshatli vaqt o'tdi.

en: The kind reader no doubt remembers the nature of the dispatch sent one day previously by Professor Belfast from the Long's Peak observatory, announcing that the Projectile had been seen but that it had become the Moon's satellite, destined to revolve around her forever and ever till time should be no more.
uz: Yaxshi o'quvchi shubhasiz, bir kun oldin Long's Peak observatoriyasidan Belfast professori tomonidan yuborilgan xabarning mohiyatini eslaydi, u o'z ichiga Projektilning ko'rilganligini, ammo u o'z navbatida o'z atrofida doimo aylanish uchun mo'ljallangan oyga aylangani haqida xabar beradi. Vaqt o'tib ketadi.

en: The reader is also kindly aware by this time that such dispatch was not supported by
uz: Shuningdek, o'quvchi o'sha paytga qadar bunday jo'natma qo'llab-quvvatlanmaganligini yaxshi biladi.

en: the slightest foundations in fact.

en: The learned Professor, in a moment of temporary cerebral excitation, to which even the greatest scientist is just as liable as the rest of us, had taken some little meteor or, still more probably, some little fly-speck in the telescope for the Projectile.
uz: O'qituvchi, eng buyuk olim ham biz kabi o'z hissasiga ega bo'lgan vaqtincha miyaning hayajonlanish paytida, bir oz meteorit yoki, ehtimol, biroz ko'p mosaklar to'plamini teleskopda o'rab olgan.

en: The worst of it was that he had not only boldly proclaimed his alleged discovery to the world at large but he had even explained all about it with the well known easy pomposity that "Science" sometimes ventures to assume.
uz: Eng yomoni shundaki, u nafaqat o'zining gumon qilingan kashfiyotini butun dunyoga jasorat ila e'lon qilgan, balki u hatto bu haqda hamma narsani "Ilm" ba'zan qabul qilishga jur'at qiladigan mashhur oson pompozitsiya bilan tushuntirib bergan.

en: The consequences of all this may be readily guessed.
uz: Bularning barchasining oqibatlarini tezda tasavvur qilish mumkin.

en: The Baltimore Gun Club had split up immediately into two violently opposed parties.
uz: Baltimor qutuvchilar klubi darhol ikkiga bo'lindi.

en: Those gentlemen who regularly conned the scientific magazines, took every word of the learned Professor's dispatch for gospel—or rather for something of far higher value, and more strictly in accordance with the highly advanced scientific developments of the day.
uz: Ilmiy jurnallarni muntazam ravishda o'qib yurgan bu gentlemen o'sha davrdagi ilmiy yutuqlarga mos ravishda, bilimdon professor yuborgan har bir so'zni xushxabar yoki ancha yuqori qiymatga ega bo'lgan narsa deb qabul qilishgan.

en: But the others, who never read anything but the daily papers and who could not bear the idea of losing Barbican, laughed the whole thing to scorn.
uz: Ammo har kuni gazetalardan boshqa hech narsa o'qimagan va Barbicanni yo'qotish g'oyasiga chiday olmagan boshqalar esa butun ishdan kulishdi.

en: Belfast, they said, had seen as much of the Projectile as he had of the "Open Polar Sea," and the rest of the dispatch was mere twaddle, though asserted with all the sternness of a religious dogma and enveloped in the usual scientific slang.
uz: Ularning aytishicha, Belfast "Ochiq qutb dengizidan" ko'rganidek, "Projektil"dan ham ko'p narsani ko'rgan va qolgan qismlar diniy dogmalarning qat'iyligi bilan ta'kidlangan bo'lsa-da, odatdagidek ilmiy slang bilan o'ralgan edi.

en: The meeting held in the Club House, ൣ൥ Monument Square, Baltimore, on the evening of the ൢ൤th, had been therefore disorderly in the highest degree.
uz: Baltimor shahridagi Monument maydoni, Club uyida o'tkazilgan yig'ilish, shuning uchun o'tgan yilning 7 kunida kechqurun, eng yuqori darajada tartibsizlikka uchragan edi.

en: Long before the appointed hour, the great hall was densely packed and the greatest uproar prevailed.
uz: Belgilangan soatdan ancha oldin, katta zal zich to'planib, eng katta g'alayon hukmronlik qildi.

en: Vice- President Wilcox took the chair, and all was comparatively quiet until Colonel Bloomsbury, the Honorary Secretary in Marston's absence, commenced to read Belfast's dispatch.
uz: Vitse-prezident Wilcox o'rinni egalladi va Marstonning yo'qligida faxriy kotibi, polkovnik Bloomsbury Belfastning xabarini o'qishni boshlaguncha, hamma narsa o'rinsiz edi.

en: Then the scene, according to the account given in the next day's Sun, from whose columns we condense our report, actually "beggared description." Roars, yells, cheers, counter-cheers, clappings, hissings, stampings, squallings, whistlings, barkings, mewings, cock crowings, all of the most fearful and demoniacal character, turned the immense hall into a regular pandemonium.
uz: Keyin esa, keyingi kunning Sun-da keltirilgan hikoyalarga ko'ra, biz o'z hisobotimizni to'plamlaridan to'ldirib o'tamiz, aslida bu tasvir "qarshilik" edi. "Qo'rqishlar, qichqiriqlar, shovqinlar, qarshi shovqinlar, qo'l urish, shovqinlar, shovqinlar, shovqinlar, qichqiriqlar, qichqiriqlar, qichqiriqlar, qo'rqinchli va jinli xarakterlarning hammasi ulkan zalni odatdagi pandemoniyamga aylantirdi.

en: In vain did President Wilcox fire off his detonating bell, with a report on ordinary occasions as loud as the roar of a small piece of ordnance.
uz: Prezident Uilkoxning o'z qo'ng'iroqli qo'ng'iroqini puchga chiqarib, oddiy hodisalar haqida xabar bergani, kichik qurolning qichqiriqidir.

uz: O'shanda hukmron bo'lgan dahshatli shov-shuvda bu lucifer o'yinining shov-shuvidan ko'ra ko'proq eshitilmadi.

uz: Biroq ba'zi qichqiriqlar o'z-o'zidan ba'zan ovozning to'xtash vaqtida eshitilishi mumkin edi.

en: It was carried unanimously.
uz: Bu ovoz bir xilda qabul qilindi.

en: President Wilcox left the chair, the meeting broke up in the wildest disorder— the scientists rather crest fallen, but the Barbican men quite jubilant for having been so successful in preventing the reading of that detested dispatch.
uz: Prezident Uilkox o'rinni tark etdi, yig'ilish g'alati tartibsizlikka tushib ketdi olimlar o'zlarining ko'tarilishlariga qo'shilib ketdi, lekin barbikanlar o'sha nafratlanarli xabarni o'qishni to'xtatishda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganlari uchun juda xursand edilar.

en: Little sleeping was done that night in Baltimore, and less business next day.
uz: O'sha kecha Baltimordada kamroq uxlab, ertasi kuni ish bilan shug'ullanmagan.

en: Even in the public schools so little work was done by the children that S.T.
