uz: Wallace, Esq., Ta'lim kengashi raisi, odatdagi Rojdestvo ta'tilini bir hafta oldin kutishni maslahat berdi.

en: Every one talked of the Projectile; nothing was heard at the corners but discussions regarding its probable fate.
uz: Har bir kishi "Projectil" haqida gapirardi; uning ehtimolli taqdirini muhokama qilishdan boshqa hech narsa burchlarda eshitilmadi.

en: All Baltimore was immediately rent into two parties, the Belfasters and the Barbicanites.
uz: Barcha Baltimor darhol ikki partiyaga, Belfasters va Barbicanitesga aylantiriladi.

en: The latter was the most enthusiastic and noisy, the former decidedly the most numerous and influential.
uz: Ikkinchisi eng hayajonli va shov-shuvli edi, ikkinchisi eng ko'p va ta'sirli edi.

en: Science, or rather pseudo-science, always exerts a mysterious attraction of an exceedingly powerful nature over the generality—that is, the more ignorant portion of the human race.
uz: Ilm-fan, yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri soxta-ilm-fan, har doim odamzodning ko'proq jaholatli qismi bo'lgan umumiylikka nisbatan juda kuchli tabiatning sirli jozibadorligini namoyon etadi.

en: Assert the most absurd nonsense, call it a scientific truth, and back it up with strange words which, like potentiality, etc., sound as if they had a meaning but in reality have none, and nine out of every ten men who read your book will believe you.
uz: Eng g'alati gaplarni aytish, uni ilmiy haqiqat deb atash va bu gaplarni o'zgacha so'zlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash, ular potensial va hokazo kabi ma'noga ega bo'lib tuyuladi, ammo aslida hech qanday ma'noga ega emas va kitobingizni o'qigan o'n kishidan to'qqiz kishi sizga ishonadi.

en: Acquire a remarkable name in one branch of human knowledge, and presto!
uz: Inson bilimining bir bo'limi bo'yicha ajoyib nom toping va presto!

en: you are infallible in all.
uz: Siz hamma narsada xato qilmassiz.

en: Who can contradict you, if you only wrap up your assertions in specious phrases that not one man in a million attempts to ascertain the real meaning of?
uz: Agar siz o'zingizning so'zlaringizni million kishidan hech kim haqiqiy ma'nosini aniqlashga urinmagan g'alati iboralar bilan to'plashingiz mumkin bo'lsa, kim sizga qarshi chiqishi mumkin?

en: We like so much to be saved the trouble of thinking, that it is far easier and more comfortable to be led than to contradict, to fall in quietly with the great flock of sheep that jump blindly after their leader than to remain apart, making one's self ridiculous by foolishly attempting to argue.
uz: Biz o'zimizni o'ylashdan qutqarishni shunchalik yaxshi ko'ramizki, bu ziddiyatlarga qaramay, yo'naltirilish ancha osonroq va qulayroqdir, o'z yo'l-yo'riqlariga beparvo bo'lishdan ko'ra, o'z yo'lboshchisining orqasidan ko'r-ko'r qo'shib o'tadigan katta qo'ylar suruviga sekinlik bilan qo'shilib ketish, o'zimizni oqib qolishdan ko'ra, o'zimizni oqib qo'yib, bahslashishga nodonlik bilan harakat qilishdan ko'ra.

en: Real argument, in fact, is very difficult, for several reasons: first, you must understand your subject well, which is hardly likely; secondly, your opponent must also understand it well, which is even less likely; thirdly, you must listen patiently to his arguments, which is still less likely; and fourthly, he must listen to yours, the least likely of all.
uz: Aslida, haqiqiy dalillar bir necha sabablarga ko'ra juda qiyin: birinchisi, siz mavzuingizni yaxshi tushunishingiz kerak, bu esa ehtimoldan yiroq emas; ikkinchisi, raqibingiz ham buni yaxshi tushunishi kerak, bu esa ehtimoldan yiroq emas; uchinchisi, siz uning dalillarini sabr ila tinglashingiz kerak, bu esa ehtimoldan yiroq emas; va to'rtinchidan, u sizning fikringizni, eng kam ehtimoldan yiroq bo'lganini eshitishi kerak.

en: If a quack advertises a panacea for all human ills at a dollar a bottle, a hundred will buy the bottle, for one that will try how many are killed by it.
uz: Agar bir qaroqchi odamlarning barcha kasalliklari uchun bir dollarlik dori-darmonni bir shishaga taklif qilsa, yuz kishi shisha sotib oladi, bir kishi shishaga qancha odam o'lib ketishini sinab ko'radi.

en: What would the investigator gain by charging the quack with murder?
uz: Tergovchi qaroqchini o'ldirishda ayblab, nimaga erishadi?

en: Nobody would believe him, because nobody would take the trouble to follow his arguments.
uz: Hech kim unga ishonmasdi, chunki hech kim uning dalillariga amal qilishda zahmat chekmasdi.

en: His adversary, first in the field, had gained the popular ear, and remained the unassailable master of the situation.
uz: Uning dushmani, birinchi bo'lib maydonda bo'lib, xalqning e'tiborini egallab olgan va vaziyatning o'ziga xos egasi bo'lib qolgan.

en: Our love of "Science" rests upon our admiration of intellect, only unfortunately the intellect is too often that of other people, not our own.
uz: "Ilm"ga bo'lgan sevgimiz intellektaga bo'lgan hurmatimizga asoslangan, ammo afsuski, intellekt ko'pincha o'zimizga emas, boshqa odamlarga xosdir.

en: The very sound of Belfast's phrases, for instance, "satellite," "lunar attraction," "immutable path of its orbit," etc, convinced the greater part of the "intelligent" community that he who used them so flippantly must be an exceedingly great man.
uz: Belfastning "satelit", "oyning jozibadorligi", "orbitining o'zgarmas yo'li" va boshqa so'zlarining ovozi "aqlli" jamoaning aksariyat qismini ulardan befarqlik bilan foydalangan kishi juda buyuk inson bo'lishi kerakligiga ishontirdi.

en: Therefore, he had completely proved his case.
uz: Shuning uchun u o'z fikrini to'liq isbotlagan.

en: Therefore, the great majority of the ladies and gentlemen that regularly attend the scientific lectures of the Peabody Institute, pronounced Barbican's fate and that of his companions to be sealed.
uz: Shuning uchun, Peabody instituti ilmiy-ma'ruzalarida muntazam ishtirok etayotgan xonimlar va janoblar katta qismi, Barbican va uning hamrohlari taqdirini muhrlab qo'yishlarini e'lon qildilar.

en: Next morning's newspapers contained lengthy obituary notices of the Great Balloon-attics as the witty man of the New York Herald phrased it, some of which might be considered quite complimentary.
uz: Keyingi kuni ertalabgi gazetalarda Buyuk Balon-attiklar haqidagi uzun obituary notisalari bor edi, bu haqda Nyu-York Heraldning aqlli xodimi so'zlagan edi, ularning ba'zilarini esa juda maqtovga sazovor deb bilsa bo'ladi.

en: These, all industriously copied into the evening papers, the people were carefully reading over again, some with honest regret, some deriving a great moral lesson from an attempt exceedingly reprehensible in every point of view, but most, we are sorry to acknowledge, with a feeling of ill concealed pleasure.
uz: Bularning barchasi kechki gazetalarga g'ayrat bilan nusxa olingan edi, odamlar ularni qayta-qayta diqqat bilan o'qib o'tdilar, ba'zilari samimiy afsus bilan, ba'zilari har jihatdan juda tanqid qilinadigan harakatdan katta axloqiy saboq olishdi, ammo aksariyatlari, afsuski, tanqid qilishimiz kerak, yomonlik bilan yashirilgan zavq hissi bilan.

en: Had not they always said how it was to end?
uz: Ular har doim bu voqea qanday yakunlanishi haqida gapirmaganmidi?

en: Was there anything more absurd ever conceived?
uz: Bundan ham absurdroq narsa tug'ilganmi?

en: If you want a real scientific man, no wind bag, no sham, take Belfast!
uz: Agar siz haqiqiy ilmiy odam, sham yoki sham bo'lmasin, Belfastni xohlasangiz!

en: He knows what he's talking about!
uz: U nima haqida gapirayotganini biladi!

en: Didn't he by means of the Monster Telescope, see the Projectile, as large as life, whirling round and round the Moon?
uz: U "Monster Telescope" yordamida hayotni o'z ichiga oladigan ulkan bo'lib, oy atrofida aylanib borayotgan "Projektil"ni ko'rmaganmi?

en: Anyway, what else could have happened?
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, boshqa nima bo'lishi mumkin edi?

en: Wasn't it what anybody's common sense expected?
uz: Bu hech kimning oqilona nuqtai nazaridan kutgan narsa emasmi?

en: Don't you remember a conversation we had with you one day?
uz: Bir kuni siz bilan suhbatlashganimizni eslaysizmi?

en: The Barbicanites were very doleful, but they never though of giving in.
uz: Barbicanitlar juda majbur edilar, lekin ular hech qachon taslim bo'lish haqida o'ylamagan.

en: They would die sooner.
uz: Ular tezroq o'lishadi.

en: When pressed for a scientific reply to a scientific argument, they denied that there was any argument to reply to.
uz: Ilmiy dalillarga ilmiy javob berishni talab qilganda, ular javob berish uchun biron bir dalil borligini inkor etishdi.

en: Had not Belfast seen the Projectile?
uz: Belfast "Projektil"ni ko'rmaganmidi?

en: Was not the Great Telescope then good for anything?
uz: O'shanda Buyuk teleskop biron bir narsaga yordam bermaganmi?

en: Yes, but not for everything!
uz: Ha, lekin hamma narsa uchun emas!

en: Did not Belfast know his business?
uz: Belfast o'z ishini bilmasmidi?

en: Did they mean to say that he had seen nothing at all?
uz: Ular u hech narsa ko'rmaganini aytmoqchi bo'lishganmi?

en: Well, not exactly that, but those scientific gentlemen can seldom be trusted; in their rage for discovery, they make a mountain out of a molehill, or, what is worse, they start a theory and then distort facts to support it.
uz: Toʻgʻri, aynan shunday emas, lekin bu ilmiy gentlemanlarga kamdan-kam ishonish mumkin; ular kashfiyotga gʻazablanishganda, molehilldan togʻ yaratadilar yoki, bundan ham yomonroq narsa, ular nazariya boshlashadi va keyin faktlarni buzib, uni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydilar.

en: Answers of this kind either led directly to a fight, or the Belfasters moved away thoroughly disgusted with the ignorance of their opponents, who could not see a chain of reasoning as bright as the noonday sun.
uz: Bunday javoblar yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri jangga olib keldi yoki Belfastlar o'z dushmanlarining jaholatidan jirkanch bo'lib ketishdi, chunki ular tafakkurlar zanjirini tush kun quyosh singari yorqin ko'rishmadi.

en: Things were in this feverish state on the evening of the ൢ൥th, when, all at once, Bloomsbury's dispatch arrived in Baltimore.
uz: Bu holatda kun kechqurun Bloomsburyning jo'natilishi Baltimorga to'satdan yetib kelgan.

en: I need not say that it dropped like a spark in a keg of gun powder.
uz: Aytishimning hojati yo'q, u bir to'qima o'q-po'l pudrasida bo'lgan chiroq kabi tushib ketdi.

en: The first question all asked was: Is it genuine or bogus?
uz: Birinchi savol: bu haqiqiymi yoki yolg'onmi?

en: real or got up by the stockbrokers?
uz: Haqiqiymi yoki birja brokerlari tomonidan o'tkazilganmi?

en: But a few flashes backwards and forwards over the wires soon settled that point.
uz: Ammo bir necha teshiklar uzib o'tgan simlar ustida bu nuqta tezda hal bo'ldi.

en: The stunning effects of the new blow were hardly over when the Barbicanites began to perceive that the wonderful intelligence was decidedly in their favor.
uz: Barbicanliklar ajoyib intellektning o'z foydasiga ekanligini anglay boshlaganda, yangi hujumning ajoyib ta'siri tugamay qoldi.

en: Was it not a distinct contradiction of the whole story told by their opponents?
uz: Bu ularning dushmanlari aytib bergan butun hikoyaning aniq ziddiyati emasmi?

en: If Barbican and his friends were lying at the bottom of the Pacific, they were certainly not circumgyrating around the Moon.
uz: Agar Barbican va uning do'stlari Tinch okeanining tubida yotgan bo'lsalar, ular o'zlarining oy atrofida aylanayotganlari aniq emas.

en: If it was the Projectile that had broken off the bowsprit of the Susquehanna, it could not certainly be the Projectile that Belfast had seen only the day previous doing the duty of a satellite.
uz: Agar "Susquehanna" o'zining qo'zg'olonini kesib qo'ygan proyektil bo'lsa, unda u "Belfast"ning o'tgan kuni o'z navbatida satelit vazifasini bajargan projektil bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Did not the truth of one incident render the other an absolute impossibility?
uz: Bir hodisaning haqiqatligi boshqa hodisani mutlaqo imkonsiz qilmadimi?

en: If Bloomsbury was right, was not Belfast an ass?
uz: Agar Bloomsbury to'g'ri bo'lsa, unda Belfast g'ayritabiiy bo'lmaganmi?

en: The new revelation did not improve poor Barbican's fate a bit—no matter for that!
uz: Yangi vahiy kambag'al Barbicanning taqdirini bir oz ham yaxshilamagan!

en: Did not the party gain by it?
uz: Partiya bundan foyda ko'rmadi?

en: What would the Belfasters say now?
uz: Endi Belfasterlar nima deyishadi?

en: Would not they hold down their heads in confusion and disgrace?
uz: Ular g'alati va sharmandalikda boshlarini pastga olmaydilarmi?

en: The Belfasters, with a versatility highly creditable to human nature, did nothing of the kind.
uz: Belfastlar, inson tabiatiga e'tirof etilgan ko'p qirralilik bilan hech narsa qilmadi.

en: Rapidly adopting the very line of tactics they had just been so severely censuring, they simply denied the whole thing.
uz: Ular tezda o'zlari tanqid qilgan taktikani qabul qilishdi, ular shunchaki butun ishni inkor etishdi.

en: the truth of the Bloomsbury dispatch?
uz: Bloomsbury xabarining haqiqatini?

en: Yes, every word of it!
uz: Ha, har bir so'z!

en: Had not Bloomsbury seen the Projectile?
uz: Bloomsbury "Projektil"ni ko'rmaganmidi?

en: Were not his eyes good for anything?
uz: Uning ko'zlari hech narsaga yaroqsiz emasmidi?

en: Did not the Captain know his business?
uz: Kapten o'z ishini bilmasmidi?

en: Did they mean to say that the bowsprit of the Susquehanna had not been broken off?
uz: Ular "Susquehanna"ning quyi ruhi kesilmaganini aytmoqchi bo'lishganmi?

en: Well, not exactly that, but those naval gentlemen are not always to be trusted; after a pleasant little supper, they often see the wrong light-house, or, what is worse, in their desire to shield their negligence from censure, they dodge the blame by trying to show that the accident was unavoidable.
uz: Toʻgʻri, aynan shunday emas, lekin bu dengiz xoʻjayinilarga har doim ham ishonish mumkin emas; yaxshi kechki ovqatdan soʻng, ular koʻpincha notoʻgʻri nishoncha koʻrishadi yoki, bundan ham ogʻirroq boʻlsa-da, befarqlikni tanqid qilishdan himoya qilish istagida, ular hodisani oldini olishning iloji yoʻqligini koʻrsatishga harakat qilib, aybdan qochadilar.

en: The Susquehanna's bowsprit had been snapped off, in all probability, by some sudden squall, or, what was still more likely, some little aerolite had struck it and frightened the crew into fits.
uz: "Susquehanna"ning qo'rqinchli nishoni, ehtimol, to'satdan to'satdan to'satdan to'satdan o'chirib ketibdi yoki, bundan ham ko'proq ehtimol bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, unga kichik bir aerolita tushib, ekipajni qo'rqitib, sarosimaga tushirdi.

en: When answers of this kind did not lead to blows, the case was an exceptional one indeed.
uz: Bunday javoblar darhol darvozalarga olib kelmasa, bu holat, albatta, o'zgacha edi.

en: The contestants were so numerous and so excited that the police at last began to think of letting them fight it out without any interference.
uz: Tanlovchilar shunchalik ko'p va hayajonli bo'lganki, nihoyat politsiya ularga hech qanday aralashuvsiz kurashishga ruxsat berish haqida o'ylashga tushdi.

en: Marshal O'Kane, though ably assisted by his ൢൣ officers and ൦ൡൡ patrolmen, had a terrible time of it.
uz: O'Kane marshal o'z ofitserlari va patrulyerlari tomonidan qobiliyatli yordamga ega bo'lsa-da, o'z vaqtida yomon vaqt o'tkazgan.

en: The most respectable men in Baltimore, with eyes blackened, noses bleeding, and collars torn, saw the inside of a prison that night for the first time in all their lives.
uz: Baltimorning eng hurmatga sazovor kishilari, ko'zlari qora, burunlari qon ketib, bo'yinlari yorilib ketgan, o'sha kecha o'z hayotlarida birinchi marta bir qamoqxonaning ichki qismini ko'rishdi.

en: Men that even the Great War had left the warmest of friends, now abused each other like fishwomen.
uz: Hatto Buyuk Urushning eng yaxshi do'stlarini qoldirgan erkaklar endi baliq ayollari kabi bir-birlariga zo'ravonlik qilishgan.

en: The prison could not hold the half of those arrested.
uz: Qamoqxona hibsga olinganlarning yarmini ushlab tura ololmadi.

en: They were all, however, discharged next morning, for the simple reason that the Mayor and the aldermen had been themselves engaged in so many pugilistic combats during the night that they were altogether disabled from attending to their magisterial duties next day.
uz: Biroq, ularning barchasi ertasi kuni ertalab, shahar hokimi va a'zolari kechasi ko'p janglarda ishtirok etganligi sababli, o'zlarining magistratura vazifasini bajarishdan to'liq mahrum bo'lishganligi sababli, ko'chib ketishdi.

en: Our readers, however, may be quite assured that, even in the wildest whirl of the tremendous excitement around them, all the members of the Baltimore Gun Club did not lose their heads.
uz: Biroq, o'quvchilarimiz o'z atrofidagi hayajonning eng yovvoyi davrasida ham, Baltimor o'qchilar klubining barcha a'zolari boshini yo'qotmaganligiga amin bo'lishlari mumkin.

en: In spite of the determined opposition of the Belfasters who would not allow
uz: Belfasterlarning qat'iy qarshiligiga qaramay, ular bunga yo'l qo'ymaydilar.

en: the Bloomsbury dispatch to be read at the special meeting called that evening, a few succeeded in adjourning to a committee-room, where Joseph Wilcox, Esq., presiding, our old friends Colonel Bloomsbury, Major Elphinstone, Tom Hunter, Billsby the brave, General Morgan, Chief Engineer John Murphy, and about as many more as were sufficient to form a quorum, declared themselves to be in regular session, and proceeded quietly to debate on the nature of Captain Bloomsbury's dispatch.
uz: O'sha kecha o'tkazilgan maxsus yig'ilishda o'qiladigan Bloomsbury jo'natmasi, ba'zilar qo'mita xonasida bo'lib, Joseph Wilcox, Esq., rais bo'lib, eski do'stlarimiz polkovnik Bloomsbury, major Elfinston, Tom Hunter, jasoratli Billsby, general Morgan, bosh muhandis John Murphy va boshqa ko'p kishilar bilan birga quorumni tashkil etish uchun yetarlicha vaqt bo'lgan, o'zlarini muntazam majlisda deb e'lon qildilar va kapitan Bloomsbury jo'natishining mohiyati haqida xotirjamlik bilan bahslashdilar.

en: Was it of a nature to justify immediate action or not?
uz: Bu darhol harakat qilish uchun asos bo'lganmi yoki yo'qmi?

en: Decided unanimously in the affirmative.
uz: Bir ovozdan rozilik bilan qaror qabul qilindi.

en: Because, whether actually true or untrue, the incident it announced was not impossible.
uz: Chunki, haqiqat yoki yolg'on bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u e'lon qilgan hodisa imkonsiz bo'lmagan.

en: Had it indeed announced the Projectile to have fallen in California or in South America, there would have been good valid reasons to question its accuracy.
uz: Agar o'sha o'g'il, "Projektil"ni Kaliforniyada yoki Janubiy Amerikada tushib qolganini e'lon qilgan bo'lsa edi, uning aniqligiga shubha ostiga qo'yish uchun yaxshi asoslar bo'lgan bo'lardi.

en: But by taking into consideration the Moon's distance, and the time elapsed between the moment of the start and that of the presumed fall (about ൢൡ days), and also the Earth's revolution in the meantime, it was soon calculated that the point at which the Projectile should strike our globe, if it struck it at all, would be somewhere about ൣ൨° north latitude, and ൥ൣ° west longitude—the very identical spot given in the Captain's dispatch!
uz: Ammo oyning masofasini, boshlanish vaqti va taxmin qilingan tush vaqti o'rtasidagi vaqtni (taxminan  kun) va shu vaqt ichida Yerning inqirozini hisobga olgan holda, tez orada hisoblab chiqildiki, o'sha o'tkazilgan vaqtda o'tkazilgan o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazilgan o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazilgan o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchining o'tkazilgan o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkavchining o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkazuvchi o'tkavchining o'tkazilishi o'tkazilgan o'tkazilishi o'tkazilgan o'tkazilgan!

en: This certainly was a strong point in its favor, especially as there was positively nothing valid whatever to urge against it.
uz: Bu, albatta, uning foydasiga kuchli nuqtai nazar edi, ayniqsa, unga qarshi qo'zg'atish uchun hech qanday asosli narsa bo'lmaganligi sababli.

en: A decided resolution was therefore immediately taken.
uz: Shuning uchun darhol qaror qabul qilindi.

en: Everything that man could do was to be done at once, in order to fish up their brave associates from the depths of the Pacific.
uz: Insonning qo'lidan kelganicha, jasoratli sheriklarini Tinch okeanning chuqurligidan topib olish uchun bir marta qilish kerak edi.

en: That very night, in fact, whilst the streets of Baltimore were still resounding with the yells of contending Belfasters and Barbicanites, a committee of four, Morgan, Hunter, Murphy, and Elphinstone, were speeding over the Alleghanies in a special train, placed at their disposal by the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad Company, and fast enough to land them in Chicago pretty early on the following evening.
uz: Darhaqiqat, o'sha kecha, Baltimor ko'chalari hali ham bahsli Belfasters va Barbicanitlarning qichqiriqlari bilan to'qnashganida, to'rt nafardan iborat komissiya, Morgan, Hunter, Murphy va Elphinstone, Olleganilarni o'zlarining ixtiyorlariga qo'ygan maxsus poyezdda tezlikda bosib o'tishdi.

en: Here a fresh locomotive and a Pullman car taking charge of them, they were whirled off to Omaha, reaching that busy locality at about supper time on the evening of December ൢ൧th.
uz: Bu yerda yangi lokomotiv va Pullman mashinasi ularni boshqarganida, ular Omahaga aylantirib ketishdi va dekabr oyida kechki payt kechki ovqat paytida bu mashhur joyga yetib kelishdi.

en: The Pacific Train, as it was called though at that time running no further west than Julesburg, instead of waiting for the regular hour of starting, fired up that very night, and was soon pulling the famous Baltimore Club men
uz: O'sha paytda "Pacific Train" deb nomlansa-da, Julesburgdan g'arbga bormay, odatdagi start vaqtini kutishning o'rniga, o'sha kecha ishga tushdi va yaqinda mashhur Baltimor klubidagi erkaklarni jalb qildi.

en: up the slopes of the Nebraska at the rate of forty miles an hour.
uz: Nebraskaning tepaliklarida soatga qirq mil tezlikda ko'tariladi.

en: They were awakened before light next morning by the guard, who told them that Julesburg, which they were just entering, was the last point so far reached by the rails.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab ularni qo'riqchi quyoshdan oldin uyg'otib qo'ydi va u ularga Julesburg shahriga kirayotganlari haqida xabar berdi.

en: But their regret at this circumstance was most unexpectedly and joyfully interrupted by finding their hands warmly clasped and their names cheerily cried out by their old and beloved friend, J.T.
uz: Ammo bu holatdan afsuslanishlari kutilmagan va quvonch bilan ularning qo'llarini iliq qo'yib, ismlari eski va sevikli do'sti J.T. tomonidan quvonch bilan chaqirilgani bilan kesildi.

en: Marston, the illustrious Secretary of the Baltimore Gun Club.
uz: Marston, Baltimor quroli klubining nufuzli kotibi.

en: At the close of the first volume of our entertaining and veracious history, we left this most devoted friend and admirer of Barbican established firmly at his post on the summit of Long's Peak, beside the Great Telescope, watching the skies, night and day, for some traces of his departed friends.
uz: O'z qiziqarli va rostgo'y tariximizning birinchi jildining yakunida, biz Barbicanning eng sadoqatli do'sti va muxlisini Long's Peakning sammitida, Buyuk teleskopning yonida o'z postida mustahkam o'rnatgan holda qoldirdik, u kechasi va kunduzi osmonni kuzatib, o'tgan do'stlarining ba'zi izlarini qidirib topdi.

en: There, as the gracious Reader will also remember, he had come a little too late to catch that sight of the Projectile which Belfast had at first reported so confidently, but of which the Professor by degrees had begun to entertain the most serious doubts.
uz: O'sha yerda, mehribon o'quvchi ham eslab qolishi mumkin bo'lganidek, u dastlab Belfastda shu qadar ishonch bilan xabar bergan, ammo professor asta-sekin eng jiddiy shubhalarga duchor bo'lgan "Projektil"ni ko'rish uchun biroz kech kelgan edi.

en: In these doubts, however, Marston, strange to say, would not permit himself for one moment to share.
uz: Biroq, bu shubhalarda Marston o'ziga bir daqiqa ham ishtirok etishiga yo'l qo'ymagan.

en: Belfast might shake his head as much as he pleased; he, Marston, was no fickle reed to be shaken by every wind; he firmly believed the Projectile to be there before him, actually in sight, if he could only see it.
uz: Belfast o'zi xohlagancha boshini silkitishi mumkin edi; u, Marston, har bir shamol tomonidan silkitilishi mumkin bo'lgan o'zgaruvchan qalam emas edi; u o'zidan oldinda, agar uni ko'rsa, o'z ko'zi oldida, aslida ko'rilgan, deb qat'iy ishonardi.

en: All the long night of the ൢ൤th, and even for several hours of the ൢ൥th, he never quitted the telescope for a single instant.
uz: O'nlab soat davomida, hatto o'nlab soat davomida ham u teleskopdan bir daqiqa ham chiqib ketmadi.

en: The midnight sky was in magnificent order; not a speck dimmed its azure of an intensely dark tint.
uz: Tunning o'rta osmonida ajoyib tartib bor edi; bir tishak ham o'zining ko'k rangini qattiq qorong'i rangga o'zgartirmagan.

en: The stars blazed out like fires; the Moon refused none of her secrets to the scientists who were gazing at her so intently that night from the platform on the summit of Long's Peak.
uz: Yulduzlar olov kabi o'sib chiqdi; oy Long's Peakning tepaligidagi platformadan o'sha kecha uni juda diqqat bilan kuzatib turgan olimlarga hech qanday sirini aytmadi.

en: But no black spot crawling over her resplendent surface rewarded their eager gaze.
uz: Ammo uning chiroyli yuzasi ustida yurgan hech qanday qora nuqta ularning ehtirosli ko'zlarini mukofotlamagan.

en: Marston indeed would occasionally utter a joyful cry announcing some discovery, but in a moment after he was confessing with groans that it was all a false alarm.
uz: Darhaqiqat, Marston vaqti-vaqti bilan ba'zi kashfiyotlarni e'lon qilib, quvonch ila yig'lar edi, lekin bir zumda u hamma narsa yolg'on qo'rquv edi, deb g'azablanayotgan holda tan oldi.

en: Towards morning, Belfast gave up in despair and went to take a sleep; but no sleep for Marston.
uz: Ertalabga yaqin Belfast umidsizlikka tushdi va uxlashga ketdi; ammo Marston uchun uxlash imkoni yo'q edi.

en: Though he was now quite alone, the assistants having also retired, he kept on talking incessantly to himself, expressing the most unbounded confidence in the safety of his friends, and the absolute certainty of their return.
uz: Garchi u endi yolg'iz qolgan bo'lsa-da, yordamchilari ham pensiyaga ketishgan bo'lsa-da, u o'zi bilan to'xtamay gapiraverardi, do'stlarining xavfsizligiga cheksiz ishonch bildirardi va ularning qaytib kelishining mutlaqo ishonchini bildirardi.

en: It was not until some hours after the Sun had
uz: Quyosh o'tib bir necha soat o'tgandan so'ng, bu voqea sodir bo'ldi.

en: risen and the Moon had disappeared behind the snowy peaks of the west, that he at last withdrew his weary eye from the glass through which every image formed by the great reflector was to be viewed.
uz: O'shanda oy g'arbning qorli tepaliklari orqasidan ko'tarildi va u nihoyat charchagan ko'zini buyuk reflektor tomonidan hosil bo'lgan har bir tasvir ko'rinadigan shkafdan olib tashladi.

en: The countenance he turned on Belfast, who had now come back, was rueful in the extreme.
uz: Endi qaytib kelgan Belfastga qaragan ko'rinishi nihoyatda qayg'uli edi.

en: It was the image of grief and despair.
uz: Bu qayg'u va umidsizlikning tasviri edi.

en: "Did you see nothing whatever during the night, Professor?" he asked of Belfast, though he knew very well the answer he was to get.
uz: "Siz kechasi hech narsa ko'rmadingizmi, professor?" - deb so'radi u Belfast haqida, ammo javobni yaxshi bilgan edi.

en: "Nothing whatever." "But you saw them once, didn't you?" "Them!
uz: - Hech narsa. - Lekin siz ularni bir marta ko'rdingiz, shunday emasmi? - dedi. - Ular!

en: Who?" "Our friends." "Oh!
uz: Kim?" "Bizning do'stlarimiz". "Oh!

en: the Projectile—well—I think I must have made some oversight." "Don't say that!
uz: "Projektillar yaxshiligi"Mening o'ylagimcha, men ba'zi bir xatoga yo'l qo'ygan bo'laman.

en: M'Connell see it also?" "No.
uz: M'Connell ham buni ko'ryaptimi?" - "Yo'q.

en: He only wrote out what I dictated." "Why, you must have seen it!
uz: U faqat mening buyruqlarimni yozdi". "Agar shunday bo'lsa, siz uni ko'rgan bo'lar edingiz!

en: I have seen it myself!" "You shall never see it again!
uz: O'zim uni ko'rdim!" - "Siz uni boshqa hech qachon ko'rmaysiz!

en: It's shot off into space." "You're as wrong now as you thought you were right yesterday." "I'm sorry to say I was wrong yesterday; but I have every reason to believe I'm right to-day." "We shall see!
uz: Kosmosiga tushdi". "Siz o'tgan kun to'g'ri deb o'ylaganingizdek, hozir ham noto'g'ri. " "Kecha noto'g'ri bo'lganimni aytish uchun uzr so'rayman; lekin bugun to'g'ri ekanligimga ishonish uchun barcha sabablarim bor. " "Biz ko'ramiz!

en: Wait till to-night!" "To-night!
uz: Kechagacha kuting!" - "Kechagacha!

en: As far as the Projectile is concerned, night is now no better than day." The learned Professor was quite right, but in a way which he did not exactly expect.
uz: Projektilga kelsak, kechasi kunduzdan yaxshiroq emas". O'qituvchi to'g'ri fikrda edi, ammo u buni o'ylamagan.

en: That very evening, after a weary day, apparently a month long, during which Marston sought in vain for a few hours' repose, just as all hands, well wrapped up in warm furs, were getting ready to assume their posts once more near the mouth of the gigantic Telescope, Mr.
uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun, bir oy davom etayotgan charchagan kundan so'ng, Marston bir necha soatlik dam olishni bekorga izlaganida, hamma qo'llari issiq to'qimalarga o'rab, ulkan teleskopning og'ziga yaqin yana bir bor o'z lavozimlarini egallashga tayyorgarlik ko'rmoqda edi.

en: M'Connell hastily presented himself with a dispatch for Belfast.
uz: M'Konel darhol Belfast uchun yuborilgan xabarni taqdim etdi.

en: The Professor was listlessly breaking the envelope, when he uttered a sharp cry of surprise.
uz: Professor o'z xatti-harakatini o'ylamasdan buzganida, o'zi hayratda qolgan bir qichqiriq chiqardi.

en: "Hey!" cried Marston quickly.
uz: Marston tezda: "Hey!" - deb baqirdi.

en: "What's up now?" "Oh!!
uz: "Hndi nima bo'ldi?" "Oh!!"

en: The Pro—pro—projectile!!" "What of it?
uz: The Proproprojectile!!" "Nima uchun?

en: Speak!!" "IT'S BACK!!"
uz: So'zlang!!" "U qaytib keldi!!"

en: Marston uttered a wild yell of mingled horror, surprise, and joy, jumped a little into the air, and then fell flat and motionless on the platform.
uz: Marston qo'rquv, hayrat va quvonch bilan aralashgan yovvoyi qichqirishni so'zlab, biroz havoga sakrashdi va so'ngra platformada to'xtab, harakatsiz tushib qoldi.

en: Had Belfast shot him with a ten pound weight, right between the two eyes, he could not have knocked him flatter or stiffer.
uz: Agar Belfast unga o'n funt og'irlikdagi, ikki ko'z o'rtasida o'qlaganida edi, u uni ko'proq yoki qattiqroq urishi mumkin emas edi.

en: Having neither slept all night, nor eaten all day, the poor fellow's system had become so weak that such unexpected news was really more than he could bear.
uz: To'liq kecha uxlamagan va kun bo'yi ovqat yemagan kambag'alning tizimi shunchalik zaiflashib ketganki, bunday kutilmagan xabarlar uning ko'tarishi mumkin bo'lganidan ko'proq edi.

en: Besides, as one of the Cambridge men of the party, a young medical student, remarked: the thin, cold air of these high mountains was extremely enervating.
uz: Bundan tashqari, partiyaning Kembridž a'zolaridan biri bo'lgan yosh tibbiyot fani shunday fikr bildirdi: bu baland tog'larning qalin va yomg'ir havolari juda dahshatli edi.

en: The astronomers, all exceedingly alarmed, did what they could to recover their friend from his fit, but it was nearly ten minutes before they had the satisfaction of seeing his limbs moving with a slight quiver and his breast beginning to heave.
uz: Astronomlar juda xavotirga tushdilar va do'stlarini kasalligidan qutqarish uchun qo'llaridan kelganini qildilar, ammo uning a'zolari biroz charchagan holda harakatlanayotganini va ko'kraklari ko'tarilishidan taxminan o'n daqiqa oldin mamnuniyat topdilar.

en: At last the color came back to his face and his eyes opened.
uz: Nihoyat uning yuziga rang qaytdi va ko'zlari ochildi.

en: He stared around for a few seconds at his friends, evidently unconscious, but his senses were not long in returning.
uz: U bir necha soniya atrofida do'stlarini ko'rib turardi, ko'rinib turibdi, lekin his-tuyg'ulari tezda qaytadi.

en: "Say!" he uttered at last in a faint voice.
uz: - Ayt! - dedi u oxir-oqibat soʻzsiz ovoz bilan.

en: "Well!" replied Belfast.
uz: "To'g'ri!" deb javob berdi Belfast.

en: "Where is that infernal Pro—pro—jectile?" "In the Pacific Ocean." "What??" He was on his feet in an instant.
uz: "O'sha jahannamli Proproyektili qaerda?" "Tinch okeanida". "Nima?" "U bir daqiqada oyoqlari ustiga turdi.

en: "Say that again!" "In the Pacific Ocean." "Hurrah!
uz: "O'sha so'zni yana ayt!" "Tinch okeanida". "Hurrah!

en: Old Barbican's not made into mincemeat yet!
uz: Old Barbican hali go'shtga aylantirilmagan!

en: Let's start!" "Where for?" "San Francisco!" "When?" "This instant!" "In the dark?" "We shall soon have the light of the Moon!
uz: Keling, boshlasak!" "Qayerdan?" "San-Fransiisko!" "Qachon?" "Bu daqiqada!" "Qorong'ida?" "Qisqa vaqt ichida oy nuri paydo bo'ladi!

en: it's the least she can do after all the trouble she has given us!"
uz: Bizga bergan barcha qiyinchiliklardan so'ng, bu uning qila olishi mumkin bo'lgan eng kam narsa!"

en: ON THE WINGS OF THE WIND.
uz: shamolning qanotlarida.

en: Leaving M'Connell and a few other Cambridge men to take charge of the Great Telescope, Marston and Belfast in little more than an hour after the receipt of the exciting dispatch, were scudding down the slopes of Long's Peak by the only possible route—the inclined railroad.
uz: M'Konnell va bir necha boshqa Kembridž odamlarini Buyuk teleskopni boshqarishga qoldirib, Marston va Belfastning qiziqarli xabarni olgandan bir soatdan kam vaqt o'tgach, Long's Peak tepaligidan faqat mumkin bo'lgan yo'nalishda - burchakli temir yo'l yo'li bo'ylab yurishardi.

en: This mode of travelling, however, highly satisfactory as far as it went, ceased altogether at the mountain foot, at the point where the Dale River formed a junction with Cache la Poudre Creek.
uz: Biroq, bu yo'l-yo'lning juda mamnuniyatli usuli tog' oyoqida, Dayn daryosi Cache la Poudre Creek bilan bog'liq bo'lgan joyda to'xtadi.

en: But Marston, having already mapped out the whole journey with some care and forethought, was ready for almost every emergency.
uz: Ammo Marston butun sayohatni ba'zi bir ehtiyotkorlik va oldindan o'ylash bilan rejalashtirgan bo'lib, deyarli har qanday favqulodda vaziyatga tayyor edi.

en: Instinctively feeling that the first act of the Baltimore Gun Club would be to send a Committee to San Francisco to investigate matters, he had determined to meet this deputation on the route, and his only trouble now was to determine at what point he would be most likely to catch them.
uz: Baltimor o'q-quruq klubining dastlabki ishi San-Fransiiskoga komissiya yuborish bo'lishini istisno qilib, u yo'lda bu vakil bilan uchrashishga qaror qildi va endi uning yagona muammosi ularni qaysi vaqtda to'plash ehtimoli borligini aniqlash edi.

en: His great start, he knew perfectly well, could not put him more than a day in advance of them: they having the advantage of a railroad nearly all the way, whilst himself and Belfast could not help losing much time in struggling through ravines, canyons, mountain precipices, and densely tangled forests, not to mention the possibility of a brush or two with prowling Indians, before they could strike the line of the Pacific Railroad, along which he knew the Club men to be approaching.
uz: Uning ajoyib bosqichi, u yaxshi bilganidek, uni ulardan bir kundan ko'proq oldinga qo'yish mumkin emas edi: ular deyarli butun yo'lda temir yo'lning afzalligiga ega edilar, u va Belfast esa ko'p vaqtini yo'ldan ozdirishdan bosh tortmadilar, chunki ular o'zlari va o'zlarining jamoa a'zolari yaqinlashib kelayotganini bilgan Tinch okeani temir yo'li liniyasini bosib o'tishidan oldin, ular bilan bir yoki ikki marta ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega emas edilar.

en: After a few hours rest at La Porte, a little settlement lately started in the valley, early in the morning they took
uz: La Porte shahrida bir necha soatlik dam olishdan so'ng, yaqinda vodiyda kichik bir aholi yashash joylari tashkil etildi, ertalab ertalab ular o'z yurtlariga ko'chib o'tishdi.

en: the stage that passed through from Denver to Cheyenne, a town at that time hardly a year old but already flourishing, with a busy population of several thousand inhabitants.
uz: Denverdan Cheyennega o'tgan bosqich, o'sha paytda bir yoshga to'lmagan, lekin endi gullab-yashgan, bir necha ming aholi yashaydigan shahar edi.

en: Losing not a moment at Cheyenne, where they arrived much sooner than they had anticipated, they took places in Wells, Fargo and Co.'s Overland Stage Mail bound east, and were soon flying towards Julesburg at the rate of twelve miles an hour.
uz: Cheyenne shahriga yetib borganlarida, ular kutilganidan ham tezroq kelganlarida, sharqqa borayotgan Wells, Fargo va Co.ning Overland Stage Mail-da joy olishdi va tez orada soatga o'n ikki mil tezlikda Julesburg tomon uchib borishdi.

en: Here Marston was anxious to meet the Club men, as at this point the Pacific Railroad divided into two branches—one bearing north, the other south of the Great Salt Lake —and he feared they might take the wrong one.
uz: Bu yerda Marston Klub odamlari bilan uchrashishni istaydi, chunki hozirda Tinch okeani temir yo'li ikki bo'limga bo'lindi, biri shimoliga, ikkinchisi esa Buyuk Tuz ko'lning janubiga qaratilgan bo'lib, ular noto'g'ri bo'limni olishlaridan qo'rqardi.

en: But he arrived in Julesburg fully ൢൡ hours before the Committee, so that himself and Belfast had not only ample time to rest a little after their rapid flight from Long's Peak, but also to make every possible preparation for the terrible journey of more than fifteen hundred miles that still lay before them.
uz: Ammo u Julesburgga Komitetdan soatlar oldin yetib keldi, shuning uchun u va Belfastning Long's Peakdan tez uchuvchi parvozdan keyin biroz dam olish uchun yetarlicha vaqtlari bo'ldi, shuningdek, ular hali ham oldinda turgan 1500 mildan ziyod dahshatli sayohatga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun barcha tayyorgarlik ko'rishlari kerak edi.

en: This journey, undertaken at a most unseasonable period of the year, and over one of the most terrible deserts in the world, would require a volume for itself.
uz: Yilning eng mavsumsiz davrida va dunyodagi eng dahshatli sahrolardan biri bo'ylab amalga oshiriladigan ushbu sayohat o'zi uchun katta hajmni talab qiladi.

en: Constantly presenting the sharpest points of contrast between the most savage features of wild barbaric nature on the one hand, and the most touching traits of the sweetest humanity on the other, the story of our Club men's adventures, if only well told, could hardly fail to be highly interesting.
uz: Bir tomondan yovvoyi barbarlik tabiatining eng yovvoyi xususiyatlari va boshqa tomondan eng shirin insoniyatning eng yoqimli xususiyatlari o'rtasidagi keskin kontrastlarni doimiy ravishda taqdim etib, bizning klub erkaklarining sarguzashtlari haqidagi hikoya, agar yaxshi aytilsa, juda qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But instead of a volume, we can give it only a chapter, and that a short one.
uz: Ammo bir jild o'rniga, biz unga faqat bir bobni, va bu qisqa bir bobni berishimiz mumkin.

en: From Julesburg, the last station on the eastern end of the Pacific Railroad, to Cisco, the last station on its western end, the distance is probably about fifteen hundred miles, about as far as Constantinople is from London, or Moscow from Paris.
uz: Tinchiston temir yo'li sharqiy qismidagi so'nggi stantsiyasi bo'lgan Julesburgdan g'arbiy qismidagi so'nggi stantsiyasi bo'lgan Ciscogacha bo'lgan masofada, ehtimol, Konstantinopol Londondan yoki Moskva Parijdan qariyb o'n besh yuz mil uzoq bo'ladi.

en: This enormous stretch of country had to be travelled all the way by, at the best, a six horse stage tearing along night and day at a uniform rate, road or no road, of ten miles an hour.
uz: Ushbu ulkan hududni eng yaxshi holatda oltita otli bosqich orqali bosib o'tish kerak edi, u kechayu kunduz bir xil tezlikda, yo'l yoki yo'lsiz, soatga o'n milga tezlik bilan yorilib ketadi.

en: But this was the least of the trouble.
uz: Ammo bu eng kam muammo edi.

en: Bands of hostile Indians were a constant source of watchfulness and trouble, against which even a most liberal stock of rifles and revolvers were not always a reassurance.
uz: Do'stona hindistonliklar guruhlari doimiy ravishda hushyorlik va muammolar manbaidir edi, hatto eng erkin o'q va revolverlar ham har doim ham tasalli bermaydi.

en: Whirlwinds of dust often overwhelmed the travellers so completely that they could hardly tell day from night, whilst blasts of icy chill, sweeping down from the snowy peaks of the
uz: Ko'pincha changli shamollar sayohatchilarni shunchalik to'ldirib yuborardiki, ular kunni tunda qiynalib, qorli sovuqning shovqinlarini ko'tarib olishardi.

en: Rocky Mountains, often made them imagine themselves in the midst of the horrors of an Arctic winter.
uz: Rocky tog'lari, ko'pincha ularni Arktik qishning dahshatli davrida o'zlarini tasavvur qilishga undadi.

en: The predominant scenery gave no pleasure to the eye or exhilaration to the mind.
uz: Avvalo ko'rinadigan manzara ko'zga yoqimlilik bermadi yoki ongga quvonch bermadi.

en: It was of the dreariest description.
uz: Bu juda dahshatli tasvir edi.

en: Days and days passed with hardly a house to be seen, or a tree or a blade of grass.
uz: Kunlar va kunlar o'tib ketar edi, uydan, daraxtdan yoki o'tdan ko'rinmas edi.

en: I might even add, or a mountain or a river, for the one was too often a heap of agglomerated sand and clay cut into unsightly chasms by the rain, and the other generally degenerated into a mere stagnant swamp, its shallowness and dryness increasing regularly with its length.
uz: Hatto qo'shishim mumkin, ya'ni tog' yoki daryo, chunki biri juda ko'pincha yomg'ir va loy to'plami bo'lib, yomg'ir tomonidan noxush chuqurliklarga kesilgan, ikkinchisi esa odatda to'xtab qolgan maydonga aylanib, uning uzunligi bilan suyuqligi va quruqligi muntazam ravishda oshadi.

en: The only houses were log ranches, called Relays, hardly visible in their sandy surroundings, and separate from each other by a mean distance of ten miles.
uz: Faqatgina uylar yog'ochlar, Relay deb nomlangan, qumli atrofida kamdan-kam ko'rinadigan va o'rtacha o'n mil masofada bir-biridan ajralib turadigan xo'jaliklar edi.

en: The only trees were either stunted cedars, so far apart, as to be often denominated Lone Trees; and, besides wormwood, the only plant was the sage plant, about two feet high, gray, dry, crisp, and emitting a sharp pungent odor by no means pleasant.
uz: Faqatgina daraxtlar o'z-o'zidan juda uzoq bo'lgan, ko'pincha yolg'iz daraxtlar deb nomlangan, yoki o'tkir sedr daraxtlari edi; va qurtog'idan tashqari, yagona o'simlik, taxminan ikki fut baland, oq, quruq, chiroyli va hech qachon yoqimli bo'lmagan o'tkir, o'ta chiroyli hidni chiqaradigan sage o'simligi edi.

en: In fact, Barbican and his companions had seen nothing drearier or savager in the dreariest and savagest of lunar landscapes than the scenes occasionally presented to Marston and his friends in their headlong journey on the track of the great Pacific Railroad.
uz: Darhaqiqat, Barbican va uning hamkorlari oy ko'rinishlarining eng dahshatli va vahshiy qismida Marston va uning do'stlariga buyuk Tinch okeani temir yo'li yo'nalishidagi sayohatlarida vaqti-vaqti bilan taqdim etiladigan ko'rinishlardan ko'ra ko'proq dahshatli yoki yovvoyi narsa ko'rmagan edilar.

en: Here, bowlders, high, square, straight and plumb as an immense hotel, blocked up your way; there, lay an endless level, flat as the palm of your hand, over which your eye might roam in vain in search of something green like a meadow, yellow like a cornfield, or black like ploughed ground—a mere boundless waste of dirty white from the stunted wormwood, often rendered misty with the clouds of smarting alkali dust.
uz: Bu yerda, bowlders, baland, kvadrat, to'g'ri va ulkan mehmonxona kabi plumb, sizning yo'lingizni to'sib qo'ydi; u erda, cheksiz darajadagi, qo'lingizning qo'l qo'li kabi tekis, ko'zingiz behuda o'tqa kabi yashil, momaqov kabi sariq yoki pishirilgan yerga o'xshaydigan qora bir narsa izlab yurishi mumkin bo'lgan ko'z, ko'pincha bulutli alkali chang bulutlari bilan qoplangan cho'g'a bo'g'inidan chiqindilar.

en: Occasionally, however, this savage scenery decidedly changed its character.
uz: Ammo vaqti-vaqti bilan bu yovvoyi manzara o'z xarakterini o'zgartiradi.

en: Now, a lovely glen would smile before our travellers, traversed by tinkling streams, waving with sweet grasses, dotted with little groves, alive with hares, antelopes, and even elks, but apparently never yet trodden by the foot of man.
uz: Endi, bir go'zal glen bizning sayohatchilarimiz oldida tabassum qiladi, buzib o'tadigan daryolar orqali o'tadi, shirin o'tlar bilan o'ynaydi, kichkina o'tlar bilan to'planadi, qushlar, antiloplar va hatto elkalar bilan yashaydi, ammo, ko'rinib turibdiki, hech qachon inson oyoqlari bilan cho'zilmaydi.

en: Now, our Club men felt like travelling on clouds, as they careered along the great plateau west of the Black Hills, fully ൩,ൡൡൡ feet above the level of the sea, though even there the grass was as green and fresh as if it grew in some sequestered valley of Pennsylvania.
uz: Bizning klub odamlarimiz o'zlarini bulutlarda sayohat qilishni his qilishdi, chunki ular Black Hillsning g'arbiy qismida joylashgan katta plato bo'ylab, dengiz darajasiga to'liq 3 metr balandlikda sayohat qilishdi, garchi u erda ham o'tlar Pennsylvania shtatining biron bir vodiysida o'sgani kabi yashil va yangi bo'lgan bo'lsa-da.

en: "In this untravelled world whose margin fades For ever and for ever as they moved," they would find themselves in an immense, tawny, treeless plain, outlined by mountains so distant as to resemble fantastic cloud piles.
uz: "Bu sayohat qilinmagan dunyoda, ular harakatlanayotganda o'zlarining chegarasi butunlay o'zidan o'tadi", ular o'zlarini katta, qalin, daraxtsiz tekislikda topib olishadi, ular tog'lar tomonidan suratga olingan, ular ajoyib bulutlar to'plamiga o'xshaydigan uzoq tog'lar tomonidan suratga olingan.

en: Here for days they would have to skirt the coasts of a Lake, vast, unruffled, unrippled, apparently of metallic consistency, from whose sapphire depths rose pyramidal islands to a height of fully three thousand feet above the surface.
uz: Bu yerda ular kunlar davomida keng, ko'p bo'lmagan, to'lqinsiz, metallga to'g'ri keladigan ko'lning qirg'og'i bo'ylab sayohat qilishlari kerak edi, uning saffir chuqurligidan piramidali orollar yuzaga kelib, yuzi ustida to'liq uch ming fut balandlikka yetib keldi.

en: In a few days all would change.
uz: Bir necha kun ichida hamma narsa o'zgaradi.

en: No more sand wastes, salt water flats, or clouds of blinding alkali dust.
uz: Endi qum chiqindilari, tuzli suv maydonlari yoki ko'z yumshatadigan alkali chang bulutlari yo'q.

en: The travellers' road, at the foot of black precipitous cliffs, would wind along the brink of a roaring torrent, whose devious course would lead them into the heart of the Sierras, where misty peaks solemnly sentinelled the nestling vales still smiling in genial summer verdure.
uz: Sirtchilar yo'li, qora toshbo'ron qirg'oqlar oyoqlari ostida, qichqiriq torrent bo'yida o'tadi, uning bo'g'in-bo'g'in yo'li ularni Sierrasning qalbiga olib boradi, bu erda bulutli cho'qqizlar hali ham ajoyib yozgi o'simliklarda tabassumli bo'lgan g'alati vodiylarni tantanali nazorat qiladi.

en: Across these they were often whirled through immense forests of varied character, here dense enough to obscure the track, there swaying in the sweet sunlight and vocal with joyous birds of bright and gorgeous plumage.
uz: Ular ko'pincha turli xil xususiyatlarga ega ulkan o'rmonlar orqali aylanib borardilar, bu erda ular yo'lni ko'rishga yetarlicha zich edilar, u erda ular quyoshning salqin nurida va chiroyli ko'rinadigan quvonchli qushlar bilan ovoz chiqardilar.

en: Then tropical vegetation would completely hide the trail, crystal lakes would obstruct it, cascades shooting down from perpendicular rocks would obliterate it, mountain passes barricaded by basaltic columns would render it uncertain, and on one occasion it was completely covered up by a fall of snow to a depth of more than twenty feet.
uz: Keyin tropik o'simlik yo'lni to'liq yashirib qo'yadi, kristallli ko'llar uni to'sib qo'yadi, bo'g'in toshlardan tushadigan kaskadlar uni yo'q qiladi, bazalt ustunlari bilan barrikadlangan tog'lar uni noaniq qiladi va bir marta u yigirma futdan ortiq chuqurlikka tushadigan qor bilan to'liq qoplandi.

en: But nothing could oppose serious delay to our travellers.
uz: Ammo sayohatchilarimizga jiddiy kechiktirishga hech narsa to'sqinlik qila olmagan.

en: Their motto was ever "onward!" and what they lost in one hour by some mishap they endeavored to recover on the next by redoubled speed.
uz: Ularning mottolari har doim "kelib ketish!" edi va bir soat ichida biron bir baxtsiz hodisa tufayli yo'qolgan narsalarni ikki baravar tezlikda tiklashga harakat qilishdi.

en: They felt that they would be no friends of Barbican's if they were discouraged by impossibilities.
uz: Agar imkonsiz narsalar ularni tushkunlikka tushirsa, ular Barbicanning do'sti bo'lishmaydi, deb o'ylashgan.

en: Besides, what would have been real impossibilities at another time, several concurrent circumstances now rendered comparatively easy.
uz: Bundan tashqari, boshqa paytlarda haqiqiy imkonsiz bo'lgan narsalarni bir necha bir vaqtning o'zida sodir bo'lgan holatlar hozir nisbatan osonlashtirdi.

en: The surveys, the gradings, the cuttings, and the other preliminary labors in the great Pacific Railroad, gave them incalculable aid.
uz: O'tkazilgan o'rtoqlar, o'lchovlar, kesish va katta Tinch okeani temir yo'lidagi boshqa dastlabki ishlar ularga beqiyos yordam ko'rsatdi.

en: Horses, help, carriages, provisions were always in abundance.
uz: Otlar, yordam, aravalar, rizq-ro'z har doim mo'l-ko'l edi.

en: Their object being well known, they had the best wishes of every hand on the road.
uz: Ularning maqsadi yaxshi ma'lum bo'lgani uchun, ular yo'ldagi har bir qo'lingizning eng yaxshi tilaklariga ega edilar.

en: People remained up for them all hours of the night, no matter at what station they were expected.
uz: Odamlar ular uchun kecha bo'yi-boshida, qaysi stantsiyada bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, hushyor turishgan.

en: The warmest and most comfortable of meals were always ready for them, for which no charge would be taken on any account.
uz: Ular uchun eng issiq va eng qulay ovqatlar doimo tayyor edi, bu uchun hech qanday haq olinmaydi.

en: In Utah, a deputation of
uz: Utah shtatida deputatlik o'rinbosari

en: Mormons galloped alongside them for forty miles to help them over some points of the road that had been often found difficult.
uz: Mormonlar yo'lning ba'zi qismlarida ularga yordam berish uchun qirq mil uzoqlikda ularning yonida galoplashdi, bu yo'l ko'pincha qiyin deb topilgan edi.

en: The season was the finest known for many years.
uz: Bu mavsum ko'p yillar davomida eng yaxshi ma'lum bo'lgan mavsum edi.

en: In short, as an old Californian said as he saw them shooting over the rickety bridge that crossed the Bear River at Corinne: "they had everything in their favor —luck as well as pluck!" The rate at which they performed this terrible ride across the Continent and the progress they made each day, some readers may consider worthy of a few more items for the sake of future reference.
uz: Qisqacha aytganda, bir qadimgi kaliforniyalik kishi ularni Corinne shahridagi Bear daryosini kesib o'tgan ko'prikdan o'qishni ko'rganida aytganidek: "Ular o'z foydasiga hamma narsaga ega edilar! luck as well as pluck!" Ular qit'ani kesib o'tishlarining tezligi va har kuni erishgan yutuqlari, kelajakda ma'lumot uchun ba'zi o'quvchilar bir necha narsalarga loyiq deb hisoblashi mumkin.

en: Discarding the ordinary overland mail stage as altogether too slow for their purpose, they hired at Julesburg a strong, well built carriage, large enough to hold them all comfortably; but this they had to replace twice before they came to their journey's end.
uz: Oddiy quruqlik pochta tasmasini o'z maqsadlari uchun juda sekin deb tashlab, ular Julesburgda kuchli, yaxshi qurilgan vagonni ijaraga olishdi, ularning barchasini qulay ushlab turish uchun etarlicha katta edi; lekin ular sayohatning oxiriga yetib kelishdan oldin buni ikki marta almashtirishlari kerak edi.

en: Their team always consisted of the best six horses that could be found, and their driver was the famous Hank Monk of California, who, happening to be in Julesburg about that time, volunteered to see them safely landed in Cisco on the summit of the Sierra Nevada.
uz: Ularning jamoasi har doim eng yaxshi olti otdan iborat bo'lgan va ularning haydovchisi Kaliforniyalik mashhur Hank Monk edi, u o'sha paytda Julesburgda bo'lib, ularni Sierra Nevada tepalig'ida Cisco-da xavfsiz joylashtirganini ko'rish uchun o'z xohishini bildirdi.

en: They were enabled to change horses as near as possible every hour, by telegraphing ahead in the morning, during the day, and often far into the hours of night.
uz: Ular ertalab, kunduz va ko'pincha kechqurun telegraf orqali har soatda otlarni o'zgartirishga imkon berishdi.

en: Starting from Julesburg early in the morning of the ൢ൨th, their first resting place for a few hours at night was Granite Canyon, twenty miles west of Cheyenne, and just at the foot of the pass over the Black Hills.
uz: Julesburgdan boshlab, o'tgan yilning ertalabida ular kechasi bir necha soat davomida birinchi bo'lib Granit kanyoniga, Cheyenne shahridan yigirma kilometr g'arbda joylashgan va Qora tog'lar bo'ylab o'tadigan yo'lning oyoqida o'tirgan.

en: On the ൢ൩th, night-fall found them entering St.
uz: th kuni, kechasi ular St.

en: Mary's, at the further end of the pass between Rattle Snake Hills and Elk Mountain.
uz: Mary's, Rattle Snake Hills va Elk Mountain o'rtasidagi o'tishning eng oxirida.

en: It was after ൦ o'clock and already dark on the ൢ൪th, when the travellers, hurrying with all speed through the gloomy gorge of slate formation leading to the banks of the Green River, found the ford too deep to be ventured before morning.
uz: Soat o'tgandan so'ng edi va o'sha kuni qorong'u bo'lib qolgan edi, sayohatchilar Green daryosining qirg'og'iga olib boradigan qora qirg'oqaning qorong'i bo'g'ini bo'ylab tezlik bilan harakat qilib borayotganlarida, ertalabdan oldin ko'tarib bo'lmaydigan bo'shliqni juda chuqur deb topdilar.

en: The ൣൡth was a clear cold day very favorable for brisk locomotion, and the bright sun had not quite disappeared behind the Wahsatch Mountains when the Club men, having crossed the Bear River, began to leave the lofty plateau of the Rocky Mountains by the great inclined plane marked by the lines of the Echo and the Weber Rivers on their way to the valley of the Great American Desert.

en: At last, late in the evening of Christmas Day, amidst the most enthusiastic cheers of all the inhabitants of Cisco, who welcomed them with a splendid pine brand procession, Marston and his friends, thoroughly used up, feet swelled, limbs bruised, bones aching, stomachs seasick, eyes bleared, ears ringing, and brains on fire for want of rest, took their places in the State Car waiting for them, and started without a moment's delay for Sacramento, about a hundred miles distant.

en: They were all fast asleep when the train entered Sacramento, but the Mayor and the other city authorities who had waited up to receive them, had them carried carefully, so as not to disturb their slumbers, on board the Yo Semite, a fine steamer belonging to the California Navigation Company, which landed them safely at San Francisco about noon on the ൣ൧th, after accomplishing the extraordinary winter journey of ൢ൦ൡൡ miles over land in little more than nine days, only about ൣൡൡ miles being done by steam.

en: All these and many other portions of the submarine apparatus which had been employed that very year for clearing the channel, lifting the wrecks and recovering the treasure, lay now at San Francisco, unused fortunately on account of the season of the year, and therefore they could be readily obtained for the asking.
