en: Wouldn't it be glorious to fish them up alive and well?
uz: Ularni tirik va sog'lom tutish ulug'vor bo'lmasmidi?

en: What were they doing just now?
uz: Ular endi nima qilishgan?

en: Their bodies most probably were lying in a shapeless pile on the floor of the Projectile, like a heap of clothes, the uppermost man being the last smothered; or perhaps floating about in the water inside the Projectile, like dead gold fish in an aquarium; or perhaps burned to a cinder, like papers in a "champion" safe after a great fire; or, who knows?
uz: Ehtimol, ularning jasadlari "Projectil"ning yotoq ustida kiyim to'plami kabi, shaksiz to'plamda yotgan bo'lishi mumkin edi, eng yuqori darajadagi odam oxirgi bo'lib o'ldirilgan edi; yoki, ehtimol, "Projectil" ichidagi suvda o'lik oltin baliq kabi akvariumda ko'tarilib yurgan bo'lishi mumkin edi; yoki, ehtimol, katta olovdan keyin "chempion" kasbida qog'ozlar kabi ko'mirga yondirib yuborilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi; yoki kim biladi?

en: perhaps at that very moment the poor fellows were making their last and almost superhuman struggles to burst their watery prison and ascend once more into the cheerful regions of light and air!
uz: Ehtimol, o'sha paytda kambag'al odamlar suvli qamoqxonasini buzish va yorug'lik va havo quvonchli hududlariga yana ko'tarilish uchun so'nggi va deyarli insonparvar kurashlarini olib borayotgan bo'lishardi!

en: How vain must such puny efforts prove!
uz: Bunday g'alati harakatlar qanchalik befoyda bo'lishi kerak!

en: Plunged into ocean depths of three or four miles beneath the surface, subjected to an inconceivable pressure of millions and millions of tons of sea water, their metallic shroud was utterly unassailable from within, and utterly unapproachable from without!
uz: Dengizning yuzidan uch yoki to'rt mil pastdagi chuqurliklariga tushib, millionlab tonna dengiz suvining g'alati bosimi ostida, ularning metall qopqoqlari ichkaridan to'liq hujum qilinmas edi va tashqaridan to'liq yaqinlashish mumkin emas edi!

en: Early on the morning of December ൣ൪th, the Captain calculating from his log that they must now be very near the spot where they had witnessed the extraordinary phenomenon, the Susquehanna hove to.
uz: Dekabrning erta tongida kapitan o'z yozuvlaridan hisob-kitob qilib, ular hozir Susquehanna qo'rqinchli hodisani ko'rgan joyga juda yaqin bo'lishlari kerakligini aytdi.

en: Having to wait till noon to find his exact position, he ordered
uz: O'zining aniq manzilini topish uchun tushgacha kutish kerak bo'lgan u, amr qildi

en: the steamer to take a short circular course of a few hours' duration, in hope of sighting the buoy.
uz: Buzg'unchi kemada bir necha soat davom etayotgan qisqa davralik yo'lni bosib o'tish, buoyani ko'rish umidida.

en: But though at least a hundred telescopes scanned the calm ocean breast for many miles in all directions, it was nowhere to be seen.
uz: Garchi kamida yuz ta teleskoplar tinch okean ko'kraklarini turli yo'nalishlar bo'yicha ko'p kilometrlar uzoqlikda ko'rgan bo'lsa-da, uni hech qayerda ko'rmagan.

en: Precisely at noon, aided by his officers and in the presence of Marston, Belfast, and the Gun Club Committee, the Captain took his observations.
uz: To'g'ri tush paytida kapitan o'z ofitsyerlari yordamida va Marston, Belfast va Gun Club qo'mitasi ishtirokida o'z fikrlarini bildirdi.

en: After a moment or two of the most profound interest, it was a great gratification to all to learn that the Susquehanna was on the right parallel, and only about ൢ൦ miles west of the precise spot where the Projectile had disappeared beneath the waves.
uz: Bir yoki ikki daqiqa chuqur qiziqish ko'rsatib, Susquehanna o'ng parallelda va o'sha joydan faqat deyarli olti kilometr g'arbda joylashgan bo'lib, u to'lqinlar ostida yo'qolganini bilib, hammamiz katta mamnuniyat topdik.

en: The steamer started at once in the direction indicated, and a minute or two before one o'clock the Captain said they were "there." No sign of the buoy could yet be seen in any direction; it had probably been drifted southward by the Mexican coast current which slowly glides along these shores from December to April.
uz: Hattoki kema ko'rsatilgan yo'nalishda darhol boshladi va bir soatdan bir yoki ikki daqiqa oldin kapitan ular "u erda" ekanliklarini aytdi. "Buyon hech qanday yo'nalishda bo'lmagani ko'rinmadi; ehtimol, u dekabrdan aprelgacha bu sohillar bo'ylab sekin-sekin o'tadigan Meksikaning sohil oqimi tomonidan janubiy tomonga o'tkazib yuborilgan edi.

en: "At last!" cried Marston, with a sigh of great relief.
uz: "Nihoyat!" - dedi Marston, katta tasalli hissi bilan.

en: "Shall we commence at once?" asked the Captain.
uz: Kapten: "Birdan boshlaymizmi?" - deb so'radi.

en: "Without losing the twenty thousandth part of a second!" answered Marston; "life or death depends upon our dispatch!" The Susquehanna again hove to, and this time all possible precautions were taken to keep her in a state of perfect immobility— an operation easily accomplished in these pacific latitudes, where cloud and wind and water are often as motionless as if all life had died out of the world.
uz: Marston javob berdi: "Ikkinchidan yigirma mingdan bir qismini yo'qotmasdan!" "O'lim yoki hayot bizning yo'l-yo'riqimizga bog'liq!" Susquehanna yana o'zini qo'zg'atdi va bu safar uni mukammal harakatsiz holatda saqlash uchun barcha ehtiyotkorlik choralari ko'rilibdi bu okean o'latlarida osonlikcha amalga oshiriladigan operatsiya, unda bulutlar, shamol va suv ko'pincha xuddi butun hayot olamdan o'lganidek harakatsiz bo'ladi.

en: In fact, as the boats were quietly lowered, preparatory for beginning the operations, the mirror like calmness of sea, sky, and ship so impressed the Doctor, who was of a poetical turn of mind, that he could not help exclaiming to the little Midshipman, who was standing nearest: "Coleridge realized, with variations: The breeze drops down, the sail drops down, All's still as still can be; If we speak, it is only to break The silence of the sea.
uz: Darhaqiqat, qayiqlar operatsiyalarni boshlash uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun sekin tushirilganida, dengiz, osmon va kemaning tinchligi kabi ko'rinish Doktorni shu qadar taassurot qoldirdiki, u eng yaqin turgan kichkina Midshipmanga: "Koleridj o'zgaruvchanlik bilan shuni tushirdi: shamol tushadi, yelka tushadi, barchasi hali ham shunday bo'lishi mumkin; agar gapirsak, bu faqat dengizning sukutini buzish uchun.

en: Still are the clouds, still are the shrouds, No life, no breath, no motion; Idle are all as a painted ship Upon a painted ocean!"
uz: To'g'ri, bulutlar ham, qopqoqlar ham bor, hayot yo'q, nafas yo'q, harakat yo'q; befoydalik hammasi bo'yoqlangan dengizda bo'yilgan kema kabi bo'ladi!"

en: Chief Engineer Murphy now took command.
uz: Bosh muhandis Murfi endi qo'mondonlikni oldi.

en: Before letting down the buoys, the first thing evidently to be done was to find out, if possible, the precise point where the Projectile lay.
uz: Buylarni tushirishdan oldin, birinchi navbatda, iloji bo'lsa, o'sha o'g'ilning aniq joyini aniqlash kerak edi.

en: For this purpose, the Nautilus was clearly the only part of the machinery that could be employed with advantage.
uz: Shu maqsadda, Nautilus mashinaning faqatgina bir qismi edi, undan foydalangan holda foydalanish mumkin edi.

en: Its chambers were accordingly soon filled with water, its air reservoirs were also soon completely charged, and the Nautilus itself, suspended by chains from the end of a yard, lay quietly on the ocean surface, its manhole on the top remaining open for the reception of those who were willing to encounter the dangers that awaited it in the fearful depths of the Pacific.
uz: Shu sababli uning xonalari tez orada suv bilan to'lib-toshdi, havo omborlari ham tez orada to'liq to'ldirdi va Nautilusning o'zi, hovli oxiridan zanjirlar bilan o'tkazib, okean yuzida xotirjamlik bilan o'tirdi, uning yuqori qismidagi manhole tinchlik bilan ochiq edi. Tinch okeanning dahshatli chuqurliklarida uni kutgan xavf-xatarlarga duch kelishga tayyor bo'lganlarni qabul qilish uchun.

en: Every one looking on was well aware that, after a few hundred feet below the surface, the pressure would grow more and more enormous, until at last it became quite doubtful if any line could bear the tremendous strain.
uz: Har bir tomoshabin yuzdan bir necha yuz metr pastda bo'lganidan so'ng, bosim tobora ortib borishini yaxshi biladi, oxir-oqibat, hech qanday chiziq katta bosimni ko'tarishi mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi degan savol paydo bo'ldi.

en: It was even possible that at a certain depth the walls of the Nautilus might be crushed in like an eggshell, and the whole machine made as flat as two leaves of paper pasted together.
uz: Hatto Nautilusning devorlari muayyan chuqurlikda tuxum qo'rquvi kabi sindirib yuborilishi mumkin edi va butun mashina ikki varaq qog'oz kabi tekis bo'lib, bir-biriga yopilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Perfectly conscious of the nature of the tremendous risk they were about to run, Marston, Morgan, and Murphy quietly bade their friends a short farewell and were lowered into the manhole.
uz: Ular qo'lga olishlari kerak bo'lgan ulkan xavf-xatarning mohiyatini yaxshi tushunib, Marston, Morgan va Murfi do'stlariga xotirjamlik bilan salom berishdi va ularni manholega tushirishdi.

en: The Nautilus having room enough for four, Belfast had been expected to be of the party but, feeling a little sea sick, the Professor backed out at the last moment, to the great joy of Mr.
uz: Nautilusda to'rt kishi uchun joy bo'lsa-da, Belfast partiyaning ishtirokchisi bo'lishi kutilgan edi, ammo biroz dengiz kasalligiga chalingan professor so'nggi daqiqada orqaga chiqdi.

en: Watkins, the famous reporter of the N.Y.
uz: N.Y. jurnalining mashhur muxbiri Watkins

en: Herald, who was immediately allowed to take his place.
uz: Herald, uning o'rniga o'tirishga to'g'ri keldi.

en: Every provision against immediate danger had been made.
uz: Darhol xavf-xatarga qarshi barcha choralar ko'rildi.

en: By means of preconcerted signals, the inmates could have themselves drawn up, let down, or carried laterally in whatever direction they pleased.
uz: O'zidan oldingi signallar yordamida mahbuslar o'zlarini qandaydir yo'nalishda ko'tarib olishlari, tushirishlari yoki o'zlari xohlagan yo'nalishda yonma-yon olib ketishlari mumkin edi.

en: By barometers and other instruments they could readily ascertain the pressure of the air and water, also how far they had descended and at what rate they were moving.
uz: Barometrlar va boshqa asboblar yordamida ular havo va suv bosimini, shuningdek, qancha pastga tushganini va qanday tezlikda harakatlanayotganini aniqlay olishdi.

en: The Captain, from his bridge, carefully superintended every detail of the operation.
uz: Kapten o'z ko'pridan operatsiyaning har bir tafsilotini diqqat bilan kuzatib borardi.

en: All signals he insisted on attending to himself personally, transmitting them instantly by his bell to the engineer below.
uz: Barcha signallarni u shaxsan o'zi ko'rib chiqishga rag'batlantirgan va ularni darhol qo'ng'iroq orqali quyida keltirilgan muhandisga uzatgan.

en: The whole power of the steam engine had been brought to bear on the windlass; the chains could withstand an enormous strain.
uz: Bug' motori butun quvvatini shamolning shishaga qo'shgan edi; zanjirlar ulkan bosimga chidab borardi.

en: The wheels had been carefully oiled and tested beforehand; the signalling apparatus had been subjected to the rigidest examination; and every portion of the machinery had been proved to be in admirable working order.
uz: G'ildiraklar ehtiyotkorlik bilan moylangan va oldindan sinovdan o'tkazilgan edi; signal berish apparati eng qattiq tekshiruvdan o'tkazilgan edi; mashinaning har bir qismi ajoyib holatda ekanligi isbotlangan edi.

en: The chances of immediate and unforeseen danger, it is true, had been somewhat diminished by all these precautions.
uz: To'g'ri, ushbu ehtiyotkorlik choralarining barchasi darhol va kutilmagan xavf-xatar yuzaga kelish ehtimoli biroz kamaytirgan.

en: The risk, nevertheless, was fearful.
uz: Ammo bu xavf qo'rqinchli edi.

en: The slightest accident or even carelessness might easily lead to the most disastrous consequence.
uz: Eng kichik baxtsiz hodisa yoki hatto beparvolik eng ayanchli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

en: Five minutes after two o'clock, the manhole being closed, the lamps lit, and everything pronounced all right, the signal for the descent was given, and the Nautilus immediately disappeared beneath the waters.
uz: To'rt soatdan besh daqiqa o'tgach, manhole yopildi, chiroqlar yoqildi va hamma narsa yaxshi so'zlandi, tushish signalini berdi va Nautilus darhol suv ostida yo'qoldi.

en: A double anxiety now possessed all on board the Susquehanna: the prisoners in the Nautilus were in danger as well as the prisoners in the Projectile.
uz: Endi Susquehanna kemasida bo'lganlarning hammasini ikki xil tashvishlar bosgan: Nautilusdagi mahbuslar ham, Projectiledagi mahbuslar ham xavf ostida edilar.

en: Marston and his friends, however, were anything but disquieted on their own account, and, pencil in hand and noses flattened on the glass plates, they examined carefully everything they could see in the liquid masses through which they were descending.
uz: Ammo Marston va uning do'stlari o'zlari uchun tashvishlanishdan kamroq edilar va qo'llarida qalam va shisha plakatlariga burunlari tekis bo'lgan holda, ular tushayotgan suyuq to'plamlarda ko'rgan hamma narsani diqqat bilan tekshirib ko'rishardi.

en: For the first five hundred feet, the descent was accomplished with little trouble.
uz: Birinchi besh yuz fut davomida tushish osonlikcha amalga oshirildi.

en: The Nautilus sank rather slowly, at a uniform rate of a foot to the second.
uz: Nautilus bir metr ikkinchi darajaga teng tezlikda juda sekin qulab tushdi.

en: It had not been two minutes under water when the light of day completely disappeared.
uz: Kun yorug'ligi butunlay yo'qolganda, suv ostida ikki daqiqa o'tmagan edi.

en: But for this the occupants were fully prepared, having provided themselves with powerful lamps, whose brilliant light, radiating from polished reflectors, gave them an opportunity of seeing clearly around it for a distance of eight or ten feet in all directions.
uz: Ammo bu uchun yo'lovchilar o'zlariga kuchli chiroqlar bilan ta'minlangan holda to'liq tayyorgarlik ko'rishgan edi, ularning shiddatli yorug'ligi, sozlangan reflektorlardan sochib o'tgan bo'lib, ular atrofini har tomonlama sakkiz yoki o'n fut masofada aniq ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega edilar.

en: Owing to the superlatively excellent construction of the Nautilus, also on account of the scaphanders, or suits of diving armor, with which Marston and his friends had clothed themselves, the disagreeable sensations to which divers are ordinarily exposed, were hardly felt at all in the beginning of the descent.
uz: Nautilusning juda yaxshi qurilishi tufayli, shuningdek, Marston va uning do'stlari o'zlarini kiyib olgan qo'llanma kiyimlari tufayli, qo'llanmachilar odatda ko'ringan noqulay his-tuyg'ular tushish boshida kamdan-kam sezildi.

en: Marston was about to congratulate his companions on the favorable auspices inaugurating their trip, when Murphy, consulting the instrument, discovered to his great surprise that the Nautilus was not making its time.
uz: Marston o'z hamkorlarini sayohatni boshlash uchun qulay imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lganlari uchun tabriklashmoqchi bo'lganida, Murfi asbobni ko'rib chiqib, Nautilus o'z vaqtini o'tkazmayotganini o'zi ajablanib tushdi.

en: In reply to their signal "faster!" the downward movement increased a little, but it soon relaxed again.
uz: Ularning "tezroq!" degan signallariga javoban pastga ko'tarilgan harakat biroz ko'paydi, lekin tez orada yana sekinlashdi.

en: Instead of less than two minutes, as at the beginning, it now took twelve minutes to make a hundred feet.
uz: Avvalgidek, ikki daqiqadan kamroq vaqt o'tmay, endi o'n ikki daqiqa vaqt o'tdi.

en: They had gone only seven hundred feet in thirty-seven minutes.
uz: Ular o'ttiz yetti daqiqada atigi yetti yuz fut yurishgan.

en: In spite of repeated signalling, their progress during the next hour was even still more alarming, one hundred feet taking exactly ൦൪ minutes.
uz: Takrorlangan signallarga qaramay, keyingi soat davomida ularning taraqqiyoti yanada dahshatli bo'ldi, yuz metr vaqt to'g'ri vaqtni oladi.

en: To shorten detail, it required
uz: Xulosalarni qisqartirish uchun, bu kerak edi

en: two hours more to make another hundred feet; and then the Nautilus, after taking ten minutes to crawl an inch further, came to a perfect stand still.
uz: Yana ikki yuz futga yetaklash uchun yana ikki soat davom etadi; keyin Nautilus o'n daqiqa davom etib, bir dyuymga ko'proq yurib, mukammal holatga keladi.

en: The pressure of the water had evidently now become too enormous to allow further descent.
uz: Suvning bosimi endi yana pastga tushish uchun juda katta bo'lgan.

en: The Clubmen's distress was very great; Marston's, in particular, was indescribable.
uz: Klub a'zolarining qayg'usi juda katta edi; ayniqsa, Marstonning qayg'usi bejiz edi.

en: In vain, catching at straws, he signalled "eastwards!" "westwards!" "northwards!" or "southwards!" the Nautilus moved readily every way but downwards.
uz: Vafoda, cho'g'alarni ushlab, u "sharqiy tomonga", "g'arbiy tomonga", "shimoliy tomonga" yoki "shimoliy tomonga" signalini yuboradi.Nautilus har qanday yo'ldan, lekin pastga harakatlanadi.

en: what shall we do?" he cried in despair; "Barbican, must we really give you up though separated from us by the short distance of only a few miles?" At last, nothing better being to be done, the unwilling signal "heave upwards!" was given, and the hauling up commenced.
uz: Nima qilishimiz kerak?" - deb o'yladi u; "Barbican, bizdan bir necha kilometr uzoqlikda ajralib qolgan bo'lsak ham, biz sizni aslida topshirishimiz kerakmi?" Oxir-oqibat, hech narsa qilish kerak bo'lmaganda, istamagan signal "yuqoriga ko'taring!" berildi va ko'tarib olish boshlandi.

en: It was done very slowly, and with the greatest care.
uz: Bu juda sekin va juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan amalga oshirildi.

en: A sudden jerk might snap the chains; an incautious twist might put a kink on the air tube; besides, it was well known that the sudden removal of heavy pressure resulting from rapid ascent, is attended by very disagreeable sensations, which have sometimes even proved fatal.
uz: To'satdan shovqin ketiklarni buzishi mumkin; ehtiyotsiz tikish havo quvurini shovqin qilishi mumkin; bundan tashqari, tez chiqqandan kelib chiqqan og'ir bosimning to'satdan olib tashlanishi juda yoqimsiz his-tuyg'ular bilan birga bo'lib, ba'zan hatto halokatga olib kelishi yaxshi ma'lum.

en: It was near midnight when the Clubmen were lifted out of the manhole.
uz: Klub a'zolarini manholedan chiqarib tashlaganlarida tun yarimgacha edi.

en: Their faces were pale, their eyes bloodshot, their figures stooped.
uz: Ularning yuzlari oqib ketdi, ko'zlari qon bilan to'lib-toshdi, suratlari egri edi.

en: Even the Herald Reporter seemed to have got enough of exploring.
uz: Hatto "Herald Reporter" ham ko'proq izlanish olib borishga charchagan edi.

en: But Marston was as confident as ever, and tried to be as brisk.
uz: Ammo Marston har doimgidek o'z-o'zidan o'zidan o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta o'ta bo'ta bo'tadi.

en: He had hardly swallowed the refreshment so positively enjoined in the circumstances, when he abruptly addressed the Captain: "What's the weight of your heaviest cannon balls?" "Thirty pounds, Mr.
uz: O'sha holatda u o'sha qadar ijobiy tarzda buyurilgan ichimlikni ham yutib olmagan edi, lekin u to'satdan kapitanga: "Sizning eng og'ir to'qnashuvchi to'plamlaringizning og'irligi qancha?" - deb so'radi.

en: Marston." "Can't you attach thirty of them to the Nautilus and sink us again?" "Certainly, Mr.
uz: Marston. " "Ulardan o'ttizini Nautilusga bog'lab, bizni yana quvib yuborish mumkin emasmi?"

en: Marston, if you wish it.
uz: Marston, agar xohlasangiz.

en: It shall be the first thing done to-morrow." "To-night, Captain!
uz: Ertaga birinchi bo'lib bajarilishi kerak. "Tunchagacha, kapitan!

en: Barbican has not an instant to lose." "At once then be it, Mr.
uz: "Barbicanning yo'qotish uchun bir daqiqa ham yo'q.

en: Just as you say." The new sinkers were soon attached to the Nautilus, which disappeared once more with all its former occupants inside, except the Herald Reporter, who had fallen asleep over his notes, or at least seemed to be.
uz: Siz aytganingizdek". Yangi sinkerslar tez orada Nautilusga qo'shildi, u yana bir bor o'z ichkarisida bo'lgan barcha eski o'quvchilari bilan birga yo'qoldi, faqat "Herald Reporter"ni qo'yib, uning yozuvlari ustiga uxlab ketgan edi yoki hech bo'lmaganda shunday ko'rinardi.

en: He had probably made up his mind as to the likelihood of the Nautilus ever getting back again.
uz: Ehtimol, u Nautilusning yana qaytishi ehtimolligi haqida o'ylagandir.

en: The second descent was quicker than the first, but just as futile.
uz: Ikkinchi tushish birinchiga qaraganda tezroq edi, ammo xuddi shu darajada befoyda edi.

en: At ൢൢ൦ൣ feet, the Nautilus positively refused to go a single inch further.
uz: oyog'ida Nautilus bir santimetrgacha davom etishdan qat'iy voz kechdi.

en: Marston looked like a man in a stupor.
uz: Marston o'ziga o'xshaydigan odamga o'xshaydi.

en: He made no objection to the signal given by the others to return; he even helped to cut the ropes by which the cannon balls had been attached.
uz: U boshqalarning qaytib kelishga bergan signallariga qarshilik ko'rsatmadi; hatto qo'l to'plamlari bog'langan qo'llarni kesishga yordam berdi.

en: Not a single word was spoken by the party, as they slowly rose to the surface.
uz: Ular asta-sekin yuzaga chiqgani uchun partiya bir so'z ham aytmadi.

en: Marston seemed to be struggling against despair.
uz: Marston umidsizlikka qarshi kurashayotgan edi.

en: For the first time, the impossibility of the great enterprise seemed to dawn upon him.
uz: Birinchi marta katta ishning imkoni bo'lmagani unga ko'rindi.

en: He and his friends had undertaken a great fight with the mighty Ocean, which now played with them as a giant with a pigmy.
uz: U va uning do'stlari qudratli okean bilan katta jang olib borgan edilar, u endi ular bilan bir pigi bilan ulkan o'yin o'ynagan edi.

en: To reach the bottom was evidently completely out of their power; and what was infinitely worse, there was nothing to be gained by reaching it.
uz: Chindan ham, quyiqqa yetib borish ularning qo'lidan chiqdi va bundan ham yomonroq narsa - bu yerga yetib borish hech qanday foyda keltirmagan.

en: The Projectile was not on the bottom; it could not even have got to the bottom.
uz: O'g'irlanuvchi quyida yo'q edi; hatto quyida ham bo'lishi mumkin emas edi.

en: Marston said it all in a few words to the Captain, as the Clubmen stepped on deck a few hours later: "Barbican is floating midway in the depths of the Pacific, like Mahomet in his coffin!" Blindly yielding, however, to the melancholy hope that is born of despair, Marston and his friends renewed the search next day, the ൤ൡth, but they were all too worn out with watching and excitement to be able to continue it longer than a few hours.
uz: Marston bularning barchasini kapitanga bir necha so'z bilan aytdi, klub a'zolari bir necha soat o'tgandan so'ng qadoqqa qadam qo'yishganida: "Barbican Tinch okeanining chuqurliklariga o'rta yo'lni bosib o'tmoqda, Muhammad o'z ko'krakida bo'lgani kabi!" - deb aytdi. uz: Yer o'g'illari bu yer yuzini qo'rqmasdan tark etgan va g'ayritabiiy ajoyib sayohatni o'tkazgan holda qaytishga muvaffaq bo'lganlar, ular har bir kishi bilan qabul qilinishga loyiq edilar.

en: extremity of pride, pomp and glorious circumstance that the world is capable of displaying.
uz: Dunyo ko'rsatishga qodir bo'lgan mag'rurlik, pokizalik va ulug'vorlik cheksizligi.

en: To catch a glimpse of these demi-gods, to hear the sound of their voices, perhaps even to touch their hands—these were the only emotions with which the great heart of the country at large was now throbbing.
uz: Ushbu yarim xudolarni ko'rish, ularning ovozlarini eshitish, ehtimol hatto qo'llariga tegish - bu mamlakatning katta yuragi hozirda urib turgan yagona his-tuyg'ular edi.

en: To gratify this natural yearning of humanity, to afford not only to every foreigner but to every native in the land an opportunity of beholding the three heroes who had reflected such indelible glory on the American name, and to do it all in a manner eminently worthy of the great American Nation, instantly became the desire of the American People.
uz: Insoniyatning bu tabiiy istaklarini qondirish, nafaqat har bir chet ellik, balki mamlakatdagi har bir tug'ilgan kishiga amerikalik nomga o'tkinchi shon-shuhratni aks ettirgan uchta qahramonni ko'rish imkoniyatini berish va bularning barchasini buyuk Amerika millatiga munosib tarzda bajarish, amerika xalqining istaklariga aylandi.

en: To desire a thing, and to have it, are synonymous terms with the great people of the American Republic.
uz: Bir narsaga orzu qilish va unga ega bo'lish Amerika Respublikasining buyuk xalqlari bilan bir xil.

en: A little thinking simplified the matter considerably: as all the people could not go to the heroes, the heroes should go to all the people.
uz: Bir oz o'ylab ko'ring, bu masala ancha soddalashtirildi: barcha odamlar qahramonlarga borolmagani uchun, qahramonlar barcha odamlarga borishlari kerak.

en: So decided, so done.
uz: Shunday qilib qaror qildim, shunday qildim.

en: It was nearly two months before Barbican and his friends could get back to Baltimore.
uz: Barbican va uning do'stlari Baltimorga qaytib kelishidan deyarli ikki oy o'tdi.

en: The winter travelling over the Rocky Mountains had been very difficult on account of the heavy snows, and, even when they found themselves in the level country, though they tried to travel as privately as possible, and for the present positively declined all public receptions, they were compelled to spend some time in the houses of the warm friends near whom they passed in the course of their long journey.
uz: Qish Rocky tog'lari ustidan sayohat qilish og'ir qarlar tufayli juda qiyin bo'lgan va hatto o'zlarini tekis mamlakatda topganlarida ham, ular imkon qadar shaxsiy sayohat qilishga harakat qilishgan bo'lsa-da, hozircha barcha jamoatchilik qabullaridan voz kechishgan bo'lsa-da, uzoq safar davomida o'tgan mehribon do'stlarining uylarida vaqt o'tkazishlari kerak edi.

en: The rough notes of their Moon adventures—the only ones that they could furnish just then—circulating like wild fire and devoured with universal avidity, only imparted a keener whet to the public desire to feast their eyes on such men.
uz: Ular o'sha paytda o'zlarining oylik sarguzashtlari haqida o'qigan, yovvoyi olov kabi aylanib borayotgan va butun dunyodagi ochko'zlik bilan yutqazilgan yumshoq notalar faqatgina bunday odamlarga ko'z ochish istagi uchun jamoatchilikka kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: These notes were telegraphed free to every newspaper in the country, but the longest and best account of the "Journey to the Moon" appeared in the columns of the New York Herald, owing to the fact that Watkins the reporter had had the adventurers all to himself during the whole of the three days' trip of the Susquehanna back to San Francisco.
uz: Ushbu yozuvlar mamlakatdagi har bir gazetaga bepul telegrafik ravishda yuborilgan edi, ammo "Ayga sayohat"ning eng uzun va eng yaxshi hikoyasi Nyu-York Heraldning ustunlarida paydo bo'ldi, chunki jurnalist Watkins Susquehanna San-Fransiiskoga uch kunlik sayohatida barcha sarguzashtchilarni o'ziga olgan edi.

en: In a week after their return, every man, woman, and child in the United States knew by heart some of the main facts and incidents in the famous journey; but, of course, it is needless to say that they knew
uz: Ular qaytganidan bir hafta o'tgach, Qo'shma Shtatlardagi har bir erkak, ayol va bola mashhur sayohatning ba'zi asosiy faktlari va hodisalarini yoddan bilar edi; ammo, albatta, ular bilganini aytishning hojati yo'q

en: nothing at all about the finer points and the highly interesting minor details of the astounding story.
uz: Bu hayratlanarli hikoyaning eng yaxshi nuqtalari va juda qiziqarli kichik tafsilotlari haqida hech narsa yo'q.

en: These are now all laid before the highly favored reader for the first time.
uz: Bularning barchasi endi birinchi marta yuqori darajada tan olingan o'quvchi oldida qo'yilgan.

en: I presume it is unnecessary to add that they are worthy of his most implicit confidence, having been industriously and conscientiously compiled from the daily journals of the three travellers, revised, corrected, and digested very carefully by Barbican himself.
uz: Ular Barbicanning o'zi g'ayrat va vijdon bilan uchta sayohatchining kundalik jurnallaridan tayyorlab, qayta ko'rib chiqdi, tuzatdi va juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan sindirdi.

en: It was, of course, too early at this period for the critics to pass a decided opinion on the nature of the information furnished by our travellers.
uz: Albatta, bu davrda tanqidchilar sayohatchilarimiz tomonidan taqdim etilgan ma'lumotlarning xususiyati to'g'risida qat'iy fikr bildirishi uchun juda erta edi.

en: Besides, the Moon is an exceedingly difficult subject.
uz: Bundan tashqari, oy juda qiyin mavzu.

en: Very few newspaper men in the country are capable of offering a single opinion regarding her that is worth reading.
uz: Mamlakatda juda oz gazetachi ayol haqida o'qishga arziydigan bitta fikr bildirishga qodir.

en: This is probably also the reason why half-scientists talk so much dogmatic nonsense about her.
uz: Ehtimol, bu ham yarim olimlarning u haqida shuncha dogmatik g'alati gapirishining sababi.

en: Enough, however, had appeared in the notes to warrant the general opinion that Barbican's explorations had set at rest forever several pet theories lately started regarding the nature of our satellite.
uz: Biroq, notlarda Barbicanning izlanishlari oxirgi paytlarda saytotimizning tabiati to'g'risida boshlanadigan bir nechta uy hayvonlari nazariyasini abadiy to'xtatib qo'ygan deb e'lon qilinadigan umumiy fikrga asos bo'lishi uchun yetarlicha ko'rsatmalar paydo bo'lgan.

en: He and his friends had seen her with their own eyes, and under such favorable circumstances as to be altogether exceptional.
uz: U va uning do'stlari uni o'z ko'zlari bilan ko'rishgan edi va bu juda qulay sharoitlarda, umuman noyob bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Regarding her formation, her origin, her inhabitability, they could easily tell what system should be rejected and what might be admitted.
uz: Uning shakllanishi, kelib chiqishi, yashashi mumkinligi borasida ular qaysi tizim rad etilishi va qaysi tizim qabul qilinishi mumkinligini osonlikcha ayta olishardi.

en: Her past, her present, and her future, had been alike laid bare before their eyes.
uz: Uning o'tmish, hozirgi va kelajagi ularning ko'z o'ngida ko'rinardi.

en: How can you object to the positive assertion of a conscientious man who has passed within a few hundred miles of Tycho, the culminating point in the strangest of all the strange systems of lunar oreography?
uz: Qanday qilib Tycho shahridan bir necha yuz mil uzoqlikda o'tgan, oy oreografiyasining barcha g'ayrioddiy tizimlarida eng g'ayrioddiy nuqta bo'lgan vijdonli odamning ijobiy da'vosiga qarshi turishingiz mumkin?

en: What reply can you make to a man who has sounded the dark abysses of the Plato crater?
uz: Platon kraterining qorong'i chuqurliklarini o'qigan odamga qanday javob berishingiz mumkin?

en: How can you dare to contradict those men whom the vicissitudes of their daring journey had swept over the dark, Invisible Face of the Moon, never before revealed to human eye?
uz: Qanday qilib siz jasoratli sayohatlarining o'zgarishlari hech qachon inson ko'ziga ko'rinmagan, oyning qorong'i va ko'rinmas yuzini o'rab olgan odamlarga qarshi chiqishga jur'at qila olasiz?

en: It was now confessedly the privilege and the right of these men to set limits to that selenographic science which had till now been making itself so very busy in reconstructing the lunar world.
uz: Hozirda bu kishilar o'zlarining o'zlarini o'zlari uchun oy dunyosini rekonstruksiya qilishda juda mashg'ul bo'lgan selenografik ilm-fanga cheklovlar qo'yish sharafi va huquqini tan olishdi.

en: They could now say, authoritatively, like Cuvier lecturing over a fossil skeleton: "Once the Moon was this, a habitable world, and inhabitable long before our Earth!
uz: Ular endi Quvierning fosil skelet haqida ma'ruza berganidek, ishonchli ravishda shunday deyishlari mumkin edi: "Bir vaqtlar oy bu edi, yashashi mumkin bo'lgan dunyo va bizning Yerimizdan ancha oldin yashashi mumkin bo'lgan dunyo!

en: And now the Moon is that, an uninhabitable world, and uninhabitable ages and ages ago!"
uz: Va endi oy - bu, yashar bo'lmaydigan dunyo va asrlar avval yashar bo'lmaydigan dunyo!"

en: We must not even dream of undertaking a description of the grand fête by which the return of the illustrious members of the Gun Club was to be adequately celebrated, and the natural curiosity of their countrymen to see them was to be reasonably gratified.
uz: Biz hatto qurol klubining mashhur a'zolarining qaytib kelishini munosib tarzda nishonlash va ularning yurtdoshlarining ularni ko'rish uchun tabiiy qiziqishlarini to'g'ri ravishda qondirish uchun buyuk bayram haqida hikoya qilish haqida orzu qilmasligimiz kerak.

en: It was one worthy in every way of its recipients, worthy of the Gun Club, worthy of the Great Republic, and, best of all, every man, woman, and child in the United States could take part in it.
uz: Bu har jihatdan o'z oluvchilariga munosib, Gun Clubga munosib, Buyuk Respublikaga munosib va eng muhimi, AQShdagi har bir erkak, ayol va bola ishtirok etishi mumkin edi.

en: It required at least three months to prepare it: but this was not to be regretted as its leading idea could not be properly carried out during the severe colds of winter.
uz: Uni tayyorlash uchun kamida uch oy kerak bo'ldi: lekin buning uchun afsuslanmaslik kerak edi, chunki uning asosiy g'oyasi qishning qattiq sovuq davrida to'g'ri amalga oshirilmagan.

en: All the great railroads of the Union had been closely united by temporary rails, a uniform gauge had been everywhere adopted, and every other necessary arrangement had been made to enable a splendid palace car, expressly manufactured for the occasion by Pullman himself, to visit every chief point in the United States without ever breaking connection.
uz: Ittifoqning barcha buyuk temir yo'llari vaqtinchalik temir yo'llar bilan yaqin birlashtirilgan edi, hamma joyda bir xil o'lchami qabul qilingan edi va Pullmanning o'zi tomonidan maxsus ishlab chiqarilgan ajoyib saroy mashinasi Qo'shma Shtatlarning har bir asosiy nuqtasiga hech qachon bog'liqlikni buzmasdan tashrif buyurishi uchun barcha zarur choralar ko'rilgan edi.

en: Through the principal street in each city, or streets if one was not large enough, rails had been laid so as to admit the passage of the triumphal car.
uz: Har bir shaharning asosiy ko'chasi yoki ko'chalari, agar biri etarlicha katta bo'lmasa, g'alaba qozonadigan mashina o'tishi uchun yo'llar o'rnatilgan edi.

en: In many cities, as a precaution against unfavorable weather, these streets had been arched over with glass, thus becoming grand arcades, many of which have been allowed to remain so to the present day.
uz: Ko'plab shaharlarda, yomon havoga qarshi ehtiyotkorlik choralari sifatida, ushbu ko'chalar shisha bilan bog'langan edi va shu yo'sin buyuk arkadalarga aylandi, ularning ko'pchiligi bugungi kungacha shunday qolishiga ruxsat berildi.

en: The houses lining these streets, hung with tapestry, decorated with flowers, waving with banners, were all to be illuminated at night time in a style at once both the most brilliant and the most tasteful.
uz: Ushbu ko'chalarni o'rab olgan uylar, gobirlar bilan bog'langan, gullar bilan bezatilgan, bayroqlar bilan o'ynagan uylar, barchasi kechasi eng chiroyli va eng mazali uslubda bir vaqtning o'zida yoritilishi kerak edi.

en: On the sidewalks, tables had been laid, often miles and miles long, at the public expense; these were to be covered with every kind of eatables, exquisitely cooked, in the greatest profusion, and free to everyone for twelve hours before the arrival of the illustrious guests and also for twelve hours after their departure.
uz: Trotuardalar, ko'pincha kilometrlar uzoq bo'lgan stollar davlat xarajatlari evaziga o'rnatilgan edi; bular har qanday ovqatlanish uchun mo'ljallangan, chiroyli pishirilgan, eng ko'p miqdorda tayyorlangan va mashhur mehmonlar kelishidan oldin va chiqishlaridan keyin ham o'n ikki soat davomida har bir kishi uchun bepul bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: The idea mainly aimed at was that, at the grand national banquet about to take place, every inhabitant of the United States, without exception, could consider Barbican and his companions as his own particular guests for the time being, thus giving them a welcome the heartiest and most unanimous that the world has ever yet witnessed.
uz: Asosiy maqsad shundaki, yaqin orada bo'lib o'tadigan ulkan milliy ziyofatda Barbican va uning hamrohlari barchasi, istisno qilmasdan, hozircha o'z mehmonlari sifatida ko'rib chiqilishi mumkin edi va bu ularga dunyo hozirgacha ko'rgan eng samimiy va bir ovozli kutib olishni anglatadi.

en: Evergreens were to deck the lamp-posts; triumphal arches to span the streets; fountains, squirting eau de cologne, to perfume and cool the air; bands, stationed at proper intervals, to play the most
uz: Evergreenslar chiroq ustunlarini ko'tarishi kerak edi; ko'chalarni bo'ylab g'alaba qozonish uchun shoirlar; quduqlar, ko'k suvini cho'kish, parfüm qilish va havoni sovutish uchun; bandlar, kerakli oraliqlarda joylashtirilgan, eng ko'p o'ynash uchun

en: inspiring music; and boys and girls from public and private schools, dressed in picturesque attire, to sing songs of joy and glory.
uz: ilhomlantiruvchi musiqa; va davlat va xususiy maktablardan bo'lgan o'g'il-qizlar, go'zal kiyimlar kiygan holda, quvonch va shon-shuhrat qo'shiqlarini kuylashlari uchun.

en: The people, seated at the banquetting tables, were to rise and cheer and toast the heroes as they passed; the military companies, in splendid uniforms, were to salute them with presented arms; while the bells pealed from the church towers, the great guns roared from the armories, feux de joie resounded from the ships in the harbor, until the day's wildest whirl of excitement was continued far into the night by a general illumination and a surpassing display of fireworks.
uz: O'tirgan kishilar o'tib ketayotgan qahramonlarni ko'tarib, tasalli berishlari, toast berishlari kerak edi; harbiy kompaniyalar ajoyib kiyim kiygan bo'lib, ularga taqdim etilgan qurollar bilan salom berishlari kerak edi; cherkov burjlaridan qo'ng'iroqlar qo'ng'iroq qilinayotganda, qurol-yarog'lar arsenallardan qichqirib, quvonchli o'chirib ketayotgan firʼavonlar koʻchada joylashgan kemalardan tovushlar eshitib, kunning eng yovvoyi gʻayrati kechasigacha umumiy yorug'lik va oʻtkinchi oʻyin-kulgʻlar bilan davom etguniga qadar.

en: Right in the very heart of the city, the slowly moving triumphal car was always to halt long enough to allow the Club men to join the cheering citizens at their meal, which was to be breakfast, dinner or supper according to that part of the day at which the halt was made.
uz: Shaharning o'zida, sekin harakatlanayotgan g'alaba mashinasi har doim klub odamlariga ovqatlanish paytida xursandchilik qiladigan fuqarolarga qo'shilishlariga imkon beradigan darajada to'xtatadi, bu kechki ovqat, kechki ovqat yoki kechki ovqat bo'lishi kerak edi, kunning to'xtatilgan qismiga qarab.

en: The number of champagne bottles drunk on these occasions, or of the speeches made, or of the jokes told, or of the toasts offered, or of the hands shaken, of course, I cannot now weary my kind reader by detailing, though I have the whole account lying before me in black and white, written out day by day in Barbican's own bold hand.
uz: Ushbu marosimlarda ichilgan shampanish shishalarining soni, so'zlarning soni, aytib o'tilgan hazillar soni, taklif qilingan toastlar soni yoki qo'llarni silkitish soni, albatta, hozir mehribon o'quvchiimni tafsilotlar bilan to'xtata olmayman, garchi butun hisob-kitob qora va oq bo'lib, Barbicanning jasoratli qo'li bilan kundan-kunga yozilgan bo'lsa-da.

en: Yet I should like to give a few extracts from this wonderful journal.
uz: Lekin men bu ajoyib jurnaldan bir necha xatboshilarni aytib bermoqchiman.

en: It is a perfect model of accuracy and system.
uz: Bu aniqlik va tizimning mukammal modeli.

en: Whether detailing his own doings or those of the innumerable people he met, Caesar himself never wrote anything more lucid or more pointed.
uz: O'zining yoki ko'pgina odamlar bilan uchrashgan harakatlarini batafsil bayon etgan bo'lsa-da, Qaysarning o'zi hech qachon bu kabi aniq yoki aniq yozuvlarni yozmagan.

en: But nothing sets the extraordinary nature of this great man in a better light than the firm, commanding, masterly character of the handwriting in which these records are made.
uz: Ammo bu buyuk odamning noyob xususiyatini ushbu yozuvlar yozilgan qo'lda yozilgan qat'iy, buyuk va ustunlik bilan yozilgan yozuvlardan yaxshiroq ko'rsatadigan hech narsa yo'q.

en: The elegant penmanship all through might easily pass for copper plate engraving—except on one page, dated "Boston, after dinner," where, candor compels me to acknowledge, the "Solid Men" appear to have succeeded in rendering his iron nerves the least bit wabbly.
uz: Bu chiroyli qalamchilik bir sahifadagi "Boston, kechki ovqatdan keyin", deb nomlangan bir sahifadan tashqari, mis plakatlarini o'qishga osonlikcha o'tishi mumkin, bu yerda "Solid Men" o'zining temir g'azablarini kamdan-kam bo'shashtirishga muvaffaq bo'lganini tan olishim kerak.

en: The palace car had been so constructed that, by turning a few cranks and pulling out a few bolts, it was transformed at once into a highly decorated and extremely comfortable open barouche.
uz: Qirol mashinasi shunday qurilgan ediki, u bir necha burchakni aylanib, bir nechta boltlarni tortib, birdan yuqori bezatilgan va juda qulay ochiq barushga aylandi.

en: Marston took the seat usually occupied by the driver: Ardan and M'Nicholl sat immediately under him, face to face with Barbican, who, in order that everyone might be able to distinguish him, was to keep all the back seat for himself, the post of honor.
uz: Marston odatda haydovchining o'tirgan o'rinbosari bo'ldi: Ardan va M'Nicholl uning ostiga o'tirdi, barbican bilan yuzma-yuz o'tirdi, u hammani tanib-bilishi uchun orqa o'rinni o'zi uchun saqlashi kerak edi.

en: On Monday morning, the fifth of May, a month generally the pleasantest in the United States, the grand national banquet commenced in Baltimore, and lasted twenty-four hours.
uz: AQShda odatda eng yoqimli oy bo'lgan may oyining beshinchisi, dushanba kuni ertalab Baltimordada katta milliy ziyofat boshlandi va u yigirma to'rt soat davom etdi.

en: The Gun Club insisted on paying all the expenses of the day, and the city compromised by being allowed to celebrate in whatever way it pleased the reception of the Club men on their return.
uz: Gun Club kunning barcha xarajatlarini to'lashni istaydi va shaharga klub odamlarini qaytib kelishganida qandaydir tarzda nishonlashga ruxsat berish bilan zarar yetkazdi.

en: They started on their trip that same day in the midst of one of the grandest ovations possible to conceive.
uz: Ular o'sha kuni sayohatni eng katta ovatsiyalardan biri bilan boshlashdi.

en: They stopped for a little while at Wilmington, but they took dinner in Philadelphia, where the splendor of Broad Street (at present the finest boulevard in the world, being ൢൢ൤ feet wide and five miles long) can be more easily alluded to than even partially described.
uz: Ular Wilmingtonda bir muncha vaqt to'xtashdi, lekin ular Filadelfiyadagi kechki ovqatga borishdi, bu yerda Broad Streetning (hozirgi kunda dunyodagi eng yaxshi bulvard, kengligi 3 metr va uzunligi 5 mil bo'lgan) hashamatini qisman tasvirlashdan ko'ra ko'proq aytish mumkin.

en: The house fronts glittered with flowers, flags, pictures, tapestries, and other decorations; the chimneys and roofs swarmed with men and boys cheerfully risking their necks every moment to get one glance at the "Moon men"; every window was a brilliant bouquet of beautiful ladies waving their scented handkerchiefs and showering their sweetest smiles; the elevated tables on the sidewalks, groaning with an abundance of excellent and varied food, were lined with men, women, and children, who, however occupied in eating and drinking, never forgot to salute the heroes, cheering them lustily as they slowly moved along; the spacious street itself, just paved from end to end with smooth Belgian blocks, was a living moving panorama of soldiers, temperance men, free masons, and other societies, radiant in gorgeous uniforms, brilliant in flashing banners, and simply perfect in the rhythmic cadence
uz: Uyning old tomonlari gullar, bayroqlar, rasmlar, gobirlar va boshqa bezaklar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi; chodirlar va toshlar erkaklar va yigitlar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, ular "Oy erkaklari" ga bir qarash uchun har bir daqiqada o'z bo'yni xavf ostiga qo'yishgan edi; har bir deraza ularning xushbo'y to'pkalarini o'girib, eng shirin tabassumlarini yuvgan go'zal xonimlarning chiroyli buketi edi; trotuardagi baland stollar, ko'pgina ajoyib va turm-turm taom bilan yig'ib-ichib, erkaklar, ayollar va bolalar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, ular ovqatlanish va ichish bilan band bo'lishgan bo'lishsa-da, hech qachon g'ayratlarga salom aytishni unutmagan edilar, ular sekin-sekin harakatlanayotganda ularni salomlashardilar; keng ko'cha ko'cha o'rinli, chiroyli belgiya bloklari bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, shunchaki o'ziga xos bo'lgan askarlar, erkinlik va boshqa askarlar, erkaklar, erkaklar, erkaklar, erkaklar, ayollar va bolalar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: of their tread, wings of delicious music seeming to bear them onward in their proud and stately march.
uz: Ular o'z yo'nalishlarida, maqtanchli musiqa qanotlari ularni mag'rur va ulug'vor yurishlarida davom ettirmoqda.

en: A vast awning, spanning the street from ridge to ridge, had been so prepared and arranged that, in case of rain or too strong a glare from the summer sun, it could be opened out wholly or partially in the space of a very few minutes.
uz: Ko'cha bo'ylab ko'chadan-bo'yiga bo'lgan katta choriq shunday tayyorlangan va joylashtirilgan ediki, yomg'ir yog'sa yoki yozgi quyoshning kuchli porlashi bo'lsa, u bir necha daqiqada butunlay yoki qisman ochilishi mumkin edi.

en: There was not, however, the slightest occasion for using it, the weather being exceedingly fine, almost paradisiacal, as Marston loved to phrase it.
uz: Biroq, uni ishlatish uchun hech qanday qulaylik bo'lmagan, chunki ob-havo juda yaxshi, deyarli jannatga aylangan, chunki Marston uni so'zlashni yaxshi ko'rgan.

en: THEIR ARRIVAL WAS WELCOMED WITH EQUAL FURORE.
uz: Ularning yetib kelishi teng kelajak bilan kutib olindi.

en: The "Moon men" supped and spent the night in New York, where they were received with even greater enthusiasm than at Philadelphia.
uz: "Oy odamlari" Nyu-Yorkda ovqatlanib, kechqurun o'tirishdi, bu yerda ular Filadelfiyadekidan ham katta quvonch bilan kutib olindilar.

en: But no detailed description can be given of their majestic progress from city to city through all portions of the mighty Republic.
uz: Ammo ularning buyuk respublika bo'ylab shahar-shahardan shaharga o'tgan ulkan taraqqiyotini batafsil tasvirlab berolmaymiz.

en: It is enough to say that they visited every important town from Portland to San Francisco, from Salt Lake City to New Orleans, from Mobile to Charleston, and from Saint Louis to Baltimore; that, in every section of the great country, preparations for their reception were equally as enthusiastic, their arrival was welcomed with equal

en: The Reed used to like the rain, but that was merely her selﬁshness.” Then another drop fell.

en: “What is the use of a statue if it cannot keep the rain off?” he said; “I must look for a good chimney-pot,” and he determined to ﬂy away.
uz: Agar u yomg'ir yog'ishiga to'sqinlik qilmasa, haykalning foydasi nimada? - dedi u. - Men yaxshi cho'mirni qidirib topishim kerak, - dedi u va u o'sha yerga uchib ketishga qaror qildi.

en: But before he had opened his wings, a third drop fell, and he looked up, and saw—Ah!
uz: Ammo u qanotlarini ochmasdan oldin uchinchi tomir tushib qoldi va u ko'z o'ngida ko'rib, ah!

en: The eyes of the Happy Prince were ﬁlled with tears, and tears were run- ning down his golden cheeks.
uz: Baxtiyor shohning ko'zlari ko'z yoshlari bilan to'lib, uning oltin yig'inlariga ko'z yoshlari oqib ketdi.

en: His face was so beautiful in the moonlight that the little Swallow was ﬁlled with pity.
uz: Uning yuzi oy yorug'ligida shunchalik chiroyli ediki, kichkinagina Yovuzga achchiqlik ko'tarildi.

en: “Who are you?” he said.
uz: Siz kimsiz? - dedi u.

en: “I am the Happy Prince.” “Why are you weeping then?” asked the Swallow; “you have quite drenched me.”
uz: Men baxtli shohman.  Nima uchun yig'layapsan? - deb so'radi Yovuz;  siz meni to'liq suvga cho'mdirgansiz.

en: “When I was alive and had a human heart,” answered the statue, “I did not know what tears were, for I lived in the Palace of Sans-Souci, where sorrow is not allowed to enter.
uz: Men tirik bo'lganimda va inson yuragi bo'lganimda, - deb javob berdi haykal, - Men ko'z yoshlari nima ekanligini bilmasdim, chunki men Sans-Souci saroyida yashardim, unda qayg'u kirishiga ruxsat berilmaydi.

en: In the daytime I played with my companions in the garden, and in the evening I led the dance in the Great Hall.
uz: Künduz men do'stlarim bilan bog'da o'ynashdim, kechki payt esa Buyuk zalda raqsni boshqarardim.

en: Round the garden ran a very lofty wall, but I never cared to ask what lay beyond it, everything about me was so beautiful.
uz: Bog' atrofida juda baland devor bor edi, lekin men undan tashqarida nima borligini so'rashni istamasdim.

en: My courtiers called me the Happy Prince, and happy indeed I was, if pleasure be happiness.
uz: Donolarim meni baxtli shoh deb atashardi va men baxtli edim, agar zavq baxt bo'lsa.

en: So I lived, and so I died.
uz: Shunday qilib, men yashadim va o'ldim.

en: And now that I am dead they have set me up here so high that I can see all the ugliness and all the misery of my city, and though my heart is made of lead yet I cannot chose but weep.” “What!
uz: Endi esa o'lganimdan so'ng, ular meni bu yerda shunchalik yuqoriga ko'tardilarki, shaharimdagi barcha noxushlik va qashshoqlikni ko'rishim mumkin va yuragim toshdan yasalgan bo'lsa-da, yig'ishdan boshqa yo'l topa olmayman.!

en: is he not solid gold?” said the Swallow to himself.
uz: U qattiq oltin emasmi? - deb o'ziga o'zicha so'radi Yovuz.

en: He was too polite to make any personal remarks out loud.
uz: U juda xushmuomala bo'lib, ovoz chiqarib biron-bir shaxsiy fikr aytmadi.

en: “Far away,” continued the statue in a low musical voice, “far away in a little street there is a poor house.
uz: Uzoqdan, oyna past musiqiy ovoz bilan davom etdi, Uzoqdan, kichkina ko'chada kambag'al uy bor.

en: One of the windows is open, and through it I can see a woman seated at a table.
uz: Oynalardan biri ochilgan va u orqali men stolda o'tirgan bir ayolni ko'rishim mumkin.

en: Her face is thin and worn, and she has coarse, red hands, all pricked by the needle, for she is a seamstress.
uz: Uning yuzi chiroyli va eskirgan, qo'llari esa qizil va qo'pol, ularning barchasi igna bilan teshilgan, chunki u tikuvchi.

en: She is embroidering passion-ﬂowers on a satin gown for the loveliest of the Queen’s maids-of-honour to wear at the next Court-ball.
uz: Qiroliyning eng go'zal xizmatkorlari uchun keyingi sud-balda kiyish uchun u satin kiyimga ishtiyoq gullarini tikib qo'yadi.

en: In a bed in the corner of the room her little boy is lying ill.
uz: Xonaning burchagidagi yotoqda uning kichkina o'g'li kasal yotgan.

en: He has a fever, and is asking for oranges.
uz: Uning issiqligi bor va o'zidan portlakni so'rayapti.

en: His mother has nothing to give him but river water, so he is crying.
uz: Uning onasi unga daryo suvidan boshqa hech narsa berolmaydi, shuning uchun u yig'laydi.

en: Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, will you not bring her the ruby out of my sword-hilt?
uz: Yovuz, Yovuz, kichkina Yovuz, unga qilich-qilichdagi rubini olib kelmaysanmi?

en: My feet are fastened to this pedestal and I cannot move.” “I am waited for in Egypt,” said the Swallow.
uz: Oyoqlarim shu pedestalga bog'langan va men harakatlanolmayman.Menni Misrda kutishmoqda, dedi Yovuz.

en: “My friends are ﬂying up and down the Nile, and talking to the large lotus-ﬂowers.
uz: Dastalarim Nil daryosidan uchib-uchib, katta lotus gullari bilan suhbatlashmoqdalar.

en: Soon they will go to sleep in the tomb of the great King.
uz: Yaqinda ular buyuk Shohning qabrida uxlab ketishadi.

en: The King is there himself in his painted cofﬁn.
uz: Podshoh o'zi bo'yilgan qovusida o'sha yerda.

en: He is wrapped in yellow linen, and embalmed with spices.
uz: U sariq linoga o'ralgan va shivorlar bilan balsamlangan.

en: Round his neck is a chain of pale green jade, and his hands are like with- ered leaves.” “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “will you not stay with me for one night, and be my messenger?
uz: Uning bo'yni rang-barang yashil giyad zanjiridir, qo'llari esa barg-barg kabi.Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, dedi Prins,Siz men bilan bir kecha qolmaysizmi va mening elchim bo'lasizmi?

en: The boy is so thirsty, and the mother so sad.” “I don’t think I like boys,” answered the Swallow.
uz: Bola juda chanqoq, onasi esa juda xafa.

en: “Last summer, when I was staying on the river, there were two rude boys, the miller’s sons, who were always throwing stones at me.
uz: O'tgan yozda, men daryo bo'yida bo'lganimda, menga har doim tosh tashlaydigan ikki nojo'ya yigit, millerning o'g'illari bor edi.

en: They never hit me, of course; we swal- lows ﬂy far too well for that, and besides, I come of a family famous for its agility; but still, it was a mark of disrespect.”
uz: Albatta, ular meni hech qachon urmaydilar; biz maydonlar buning uchun juda yaxshi uchib ketamiz va, bundan tashqari, men oilasidan bo'lganman, u o'zining tezkorligi bilan mashhur; ammo bu hurmatsizlik belgisi edi.

en: But the Happy Prince looked so sad that the little Swallow was sorry.
uz: Ammo baxtli printz shunchalik xafa bo'lganki, kichkina Yovuz o'zi ham afsuslanardi.

en: “It is very cold here,” he said; “but I will stay with you for one night, and be your messenger.” “Thank you, little Swallow,” said the Prince.
uz: Bu erda juda sovuq, dedi u, lekin men bir kecha sizning yoningizda bo'lib, elchingiz bo'laman.

en: So the Swallow picked out the great ruby from the Prince’s sword, and ﬂew away with it in his beak over the roofs of the town.
uz: Shunday qilib, Yovuz shohning qilichidan buyuk rubini olib, o'z bo'g'ida bilan shaharning tomlariga uchib ketdi.

en: He passed by the cathedral tower, where the white marble angels were sculptured.
uz: U katedralning minorasidan o'tib ketdi, u yerda oq marmor farishtalari haykalga o'ralgan edi.

en: He passed by the palace and heard the sound of dancing.
uz: Qishlog'idan o'tib, raqslarning ovozini eshitdi.

en: A beautiful girl came out on the balcony with her lover.
uz: Bir go'zal qiz o'z sevgilisi bilan balkonga chiqdi.

en: “How wonderful the stars are,” he said to her, “and how wonderful is the power of love!” “I hope my dress will be ready in time for the State-ball,” she answered; “I have ordered passion-ﬂowers to be embroidered on it; but the seamstress- es are so lazy.” He passed over the river, and saw the lanterns hanging to the masts of the ships.
uz: U ayolga shunday dedi: "Yulduzlar qanchalik ajoyib va sevgi kuchi naqadar ajoyib! State-ball uchun kiyimim o'z vaqtida tayyor bo'lishini umid qilaman", - javob berdi u; "Men unga ishtiyoq gullari tikilganini buyurdim; lekin tikuvchilar o'zlarining ishtiyoqlari bilan chiroyli. U daryodan o'tib o'tib, kemaning mastlariga osilgan lanternlarni ko'rdi.

en: He passed over the Ghetto, and saw the old Jews bargaining with each other, and weighing out money in copper scales.
uz: U ghettodan o'tib, keksa yahudiylarni bir-biri bilan savdo-sotiq qilib, mis tarozida pulni tortishayotganini ko'rdi.

en: At last he came to the poor house and looked in.
uz: Nihoyat u kambag'al uyga kelib, ichkariga ko'rdi.

en: The boy was tossing feverishly on his bed, and the mother had fallen asleep, she was so tired.
uz: Bola o'z yotoqxonasida issiqlik bilan o'tiribdi va ona uxlab qoldi, u juda charchagan edi.

en: In he hopped, and laid the great ruby on the table beside the woman’s thimble.
uz: U o'tib o'tib, katta rubini ayolning barmoqchasiga qo'yib, stol ustiga qo'ydi.

en: Then he ﬂew gen- tly round the bed, fanning the boy’s forehead with his wings.
uz: So'ngra u o'g'ilning oyoqlarini qanotlari bilan o'rab, to'shakda o'tirib o'tiribdi.

en: “How cool I feel,” said the boy, “I must be getting better”; and he sank into a delicious slumber.
uz: O'zimni qanchalik yaxshi his qilyapman, - dedi o'g'il, - o'zimni yaxshi his qilyapman, - va o'sha paytda u ajoyib uyquga tushdi.

en: Then the Swallow ﬂew back to the Happy Prince, and told him what he had done.
uz: So'ngra Yovuz baxtli shohning oldiga qaytib borib, nima qilganini aytib berdi.

en: “It is curious,” he remarked, “but I feel quite warm now, al- though it is so cold.” “That is because you have done a good action,” said the Prince.
uz: Bu g'alati, dedi u, lekin men hozir juda iliq his qilaman, al- garchi juda sovuq bo'lsa ham.Bu sizning yaxshi harakatingiz tufayli, dedi printz.

en: And the little Swallow began to think, and then he fell asleep.
uz: Kichik bo'lak o'ylay boshladi va keyin uxladi.

en: Thinking always made him sleepy.
uz: Har doim o'ylash uni uxlatardi.

en: When day broke he ﬂew down to the river and had a bath.
uz: Kun yorug' bo'lganida, u daryoga o'tib, suvga cho'mdi.

en: “What a re- markable phenomenon,” said the Professor of Ornithology as he was pass- ing over the bridge.
uz: Qanday ajoyib hodisa, - dedi Ornitologiya professori ko'prikdan o'tib ketayotganda.

en: “A swallow in winter!”  And he wrote a long letter about it to the local newspaper.
uz: Qish oyida qovurish! Va u bu haqda mahalliy gazetaga uzoq maktub yozdi.

en: Every one quoted it, it was full of so many words that they could not understand.
uz: Har bir kishi uni tilga olgan, u shuncha so'zlarga to'lib-toshganki, ular uni tushunishmagandi.

en: “To-night I go to Egypt,” said the Swallow, and he was in high spirits at the prospect.
uz: Kechasi men Misrga boraman, - dedi Yovuz, va u bu istiqbolda juda hayajonli edi.

en: He visited all the public monuments, and sat a long time on top of the church steeple.
uz: U barcha ommaviy yodgorliklarni ko'rib chiqib, cherkovning cho'ri ustida uzoq vaqt o'tirdi.

en: Wherever he went the Sparrows chirruped, and
uz: U qayerga bormasin, qovoqlar qichqirib ketardi va

en: said to each other, “What a distinguished stranger!” so he enjoyed himself very much.
uz: Ular bir-biriga: "Bu qanday noyob begona odam!" - deyishdi, shuning uchun u juda zavqlandi.

en: When the moon rose he ﬂew back to the Happy Prince.
uz: Oy ko'tarilganda u baxtli shohga qaytib bordi.

en: “Have you any commissions for Egypt?” he cried; “I am just starting.” “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “will you not stay with me one night longer?” “I am waited for in Egypt,” answered the Swallow.
uz: Misr uchun biron bir vositachilik bormi? - deb baqirdi u. - Men hali boshlanyapman. - Qovur, qovur, kichik qovur, - dedi printz. - Bir kecha ham men bilan qolmaysanmi? - Qovur, - dedi Qovur. - Misrda meni kutishyapti.

en: “To-morrow my friends will ﬂy up to the Second Cataract.
uz: Ertaga do'stlarim Ikkinchi kataraktga uchib borishadi.

en: The river-horse couches there among the bulrushes, and on a great granite throne sits the God Memnon.
uz: Daryo otlari bu yerdagi bulrushlar orasida o'tiradi va buyuk granit taxtida Memnon xudo o'tiradi.

en: All night long he watches the stars, and when the morning star shines he ut- ters one cry of joy, and then he is silent.
uz: U butun kecha yulduzlarga qarab turadi va ertalab yulduzi yorug' bo'lganida, quvonchdan bir qichqiriq chiqarib, so'ngra o'zini tutadi.

en: At noon the yellow lions come down to the water’s edge to drink.
uz: Tush paytida sariq sherlar ichish uchun suv bo'yiga tushadi.

en: They have eyes like green beryls, and their roar is louder than the roar of the cataract.
uz: Ularning ko'zlari yashil beryllar kabi va ularning qichqiriqlari katarakt qichqiriqidan ham baland.

en: “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “far away across the city I see a young man in a garret.
uz: Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, dedi Prins, farq shaharning boshqa tomonida bir yigitni ko'rdim.

en: He is leaning over a desk covered with papers, and in a tumbler by his side there is a bunch of withered violets.
uz: U qog'ozlar bilan qoplangan ish stoli ustida yonboshlagan va yonida joylashgan bir qamalda bir to'plam o'chirib qolgan violetlar bor.

en: His hair is brown and crisp, and his lips are red as a pomegranate, and he has large and dreamy eyes.
uz: Uning sochlari rang-barang va chiroyli, og'izlari nar kabi qizil, ko'zlari katta va tushli.

en: He is trying to ﬁnish a play for the Director of the Theatre, but he is too cold to write any more.
uz: U Teatr direktori uchun o'yinni tugatishga harakat qilmoqda, ammo u yana yozish uchun juda sovuq.

en: There is no ﬁre in the grate, and hunger has made him faint.” “I will wait with you one night longer,” said the Swallow, who really had a good heart.
uz: Gretda olov yo'q va ochlik uni beparvo qildi.Men siz bilan bir kecha ko'proq kutaman, dedi Yovuz, chunki u haqiqatan ham yaxshi yurakga ega edi.

en: “Shall I take him another ruby?” “Alas!
uz: Unga yana bir rubini olib ketishim kerakmi?

en: I have no ruby now,” said the Prince; “my eyes are all that I have left.
uz: Hozirda mening rubiyam yo'q, - dedi printz. - Mening ko'zlarim qolgan.

en: They are made of rare sapphires, which were brought out of India a thousand years ago.
uz: Ular bir ming yil oldin Hindistondan olib chiqilgan noyob saffirlardan yasalgan.

en: Pluck out one of them and take it to him.
uz: Ulardan birini tanlab olib, unga olib boring.

en: He will sell it to the jeweller, and buy food and ﬁrewood, and ﬁnish his play.” “Dear Prince,” said the Swallow, “I cannot do that”; and he began to weep.
uz: U uni zargarga sotadi, oziq-ovqat va yog'och sotib oladi va o'yinni tugatadi.Sevg'im,- dedi Yovuz,Men buni qila olmayman; u yig'la boshladi.

en: “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “do as I command you.” So the Swallow plucked out the Prince’s eye, and ﬂew away to the stu- dent’s garret.
uz: Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, dedi Prince, shunday qiling, men sizga buyuraman. Shunday qilib Swallow Prince'ning ko'zini chiqarib olib, uzib ketdi.

en: It was easy enough to get in, as there was a hole in the roof.
uz: U yerga kirish juda oson edi, chunki tomda cho'l bor edi.

en: Through this he darted, and came into the room.
uz: Shu orqali u o'ynadi va xonaniga kirdi.

en: The young man had his head buried in his hands, so he did not hear the ﬂutter of the bird’s wings, and when he looked up he found the beautiful sapphire lying on the with- ered violets.
uz: Yosh yigitning boshi qo'llarida ko'milgan edi, shuning uchun u qushlarning qanotlari qichqirishini eshitmadi va ko'tarilganida, o'z ko'zlariga chiroyli safpirni ko'rgan.

en: “I am beginning to be appreciated,” he cried; “this is from some great ad- mirer.
uz: "Men qadrlanishni boshlayman", - deb hayqirib yubordi u. - Bu buyuk reklamachidan.

en: Now I can ﬁnish my play,” and he looked quite happy.
uz: Endi o'yinimni tugatishim mumkin, va u juda xursand ko'rinardi.

en: The next day the Swallow ﬂew down to the harbour.
uz: Ertasi kuni Swallow portga uchdi.

en: He sat on the mast of a large vessel and watched the sailors hauling big chests out of the hold with ropes.
uz: U katta kemaning mastida o'tirib, kemachilar ulkan qushlarni qo'lga qo'yib, qo'lga toshlar bilan quvib chiqarib olishganini kuzatardi.

en: “Heave a-hoy!” they shouted as each chest came up.
uz: Ular har bir quti ko'tarilganda baqirib: "Heave a-hoy!" deb baqirdilar.

en: “I am go- ing to Egypt”!
uz: Men Misrga ketyapman!

en: cried the Swallow, but nobody minded, and when the moon rose he ﬂew back to the Happy Prince.
uz: Yovuz qichqiriq qildi, lekin hech kim bunga e'tibor bermadi va oy ko'tarilganda u baxtli shohning oldiga qaytib ketdi.

en: “I am come to bid you good-bye,” he cried.
uz: Men senga salom aytishga keldim, - deb yig'ladi u.

en: “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “will you not stay with me one night longer?” “It is winter,” answered the Swallow, “and the chill snow will soon be here.
uz: Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, dedi Prince, Siz men bilan yana bir kecha qolmaysizmi?Bu qish,Swallow javob berdi, va sovuq qar tez orada keladi.

en: In Egypt the sun is warm on the green palm-trees, and the crocodiles lie in the mud and look lazily about them.
uz: Misrda yashil xurmo daraxtlarida quyosh issiq bo'lib, buzoqlar cho'g'da yotgan va ular atrofida kemsiz ko'rinadi.

en: My companions are building a nest in the Temple of Baalbec, and the pink and white doves are watching them, and cooing to each other.
uz: Mening hamrohlarim Baalbek ma'badiga o'z yuzini qurmoqdalar va ro'za va oq kaptarlar ularni kuzatib, bir-birlariga ko'z tikishmoqdalar.

en: Dear Prince, I must leave you, but I will never forget you, and next spring I will bring you back two beautiful jewels in place of those you have given away.
uz: Aziz shoh, men seni tashlab ketishim kerak, lekin men seni hech qachon unutmayman va kelgusi bahorda siz berganlar o'rniga sizga ikkita go'zal marvaridni qaytarib beraman.

en: The ruby shall be redder than a red rose, and the sapphire shall be as blue as the great sea.” “In the square below,” said the Happy Prince, “there stands a little match- girl.
uz: Rubi qizil rozalardan qizilroq, safpir esa dengiz kabi ko'k bo'ladi.Chindan pastki maydonda,- dedi baxtli shoh,o'sha yerda kichkina qizcha turadi.

en: She has let her matches fall in the gutter, and they are all spoiled.
uz: U o'z o'yinchoqlarini qo'lga tushirib qo'ydi va ularning barchasi buzilgan.

en: Her father will beat her if she does not bring home some money, and she is cry- ing.
uz: Agar u uyga pul olib kelmasa, otasi uni uradi va u yig'laydi.

en: She has no shoes or stockings, and her little head is bare.
uz: Uning oyoq kiyimlari va choriqlari yo'q va kichkina boshi yalang'och.

en: Pluck out my other eye, and give it to her, and her father will not beat her.” “I will stay with you one night longer,” said the Swallow, “but I cannot pluck out your eye.
uz: Boshqa ko'zimni chiqarib olib, unga bering, uning otasi uni urmaydi.Men siz bilan bir kecha ko'proq qolishim kerak, dedi Yovuz, lekin men sizning ko'zingizni chiqarib bo'lmaydi.

en: You would be quite blind then.” “Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “do as I command you.” So he plucked out the Prince’s other eye, and darted down with it.
uz: O'shanda siz ko'r bo'lasiz.Swallow, Swallow, little Swallow, dedi printz,Men sizga buyurganimni qiling.So'ngra u printzning boshqa ko'zini olib chiqib, u bilan o'tirib yubordi.

en: He swooped past the match-girl, and slipped the jewel into the palm of her hand.
uz: U qizning yonidan o'tib, marvaridni uning qo'liga qo'ydi.

en: “What a lovely bit of glass,” cried the little girl; and she ran home, laughing.
uz: "Qanday chiroyli shisha", - deb yig'ladi qizcha, u esa uyga qichqiriq bordi.

en: Then the Swallow came back to the Prince.
uz: So'ngra Yovuz shohning oldiga qaytib keldi.

en: “You are blind now,” he said, “so I will stay with you always.” “No, little Swallow,” said the poor Prince, “you must go away to Egypt.” “I will stay with you always,” said the Swallow, and he slept at the Prince’s feet.
uz: Siz endi ko'rsiz, - dedi u, - shuning uchun men siz bilan doimo bo'laman.  Yo'q, kichkinagina qovuz, - dedi kambag'al printz, - siz Misrga ketishingiz kerak. Men siz bilan doimo bo'laman, - dedi qovuz, - va u printz oyoqlarida uxladi.

en: All the next day he sat on the Prince’s shoulder, and told him stories of what he had seen in strange lands.
uz: Ertasi kuni u shohning yelkasiga o'tirib, unga o'zgacha mamlakatlarda ko'rgan hikoyalarini aytib berdi.

en: He told him of the red ibises, who stand in long rows on the banks of the Nile, and catch gold-ﬁsh in their beaks; of the Sphinx, who is as old as the world itself, and lives in the desert, and knows everything; of the merchants, who walk slowly by the side of their camels, and carry amber beads in their hands; of the King of the Mountains of the Moon, who is as black as ebony, and worships a large crystal; of the great green snake that sleeps in a palm-tree, and has twenty priests to feed it with honey-cakes; and of the pygmies who sail over a big lake on large ﬂat leaves, and are always at war with the butterﬂies.
uz: U unga Nil daryosida uzoq qatorda turadigan qizil ibislar haqida aytib berdi va o'z burchaklarida oltin baliqlarni tutadi; sahroda yashaydigan va hamma narsani biluvchi Sfinks haqida; tuyalari yonida sekin yuradigan va qo'llarida anbar marvaridlarni olib yuradigan savdogarlar haqida; eboni kabi qora va katta kristalga sig'inadigan oy tog'lari shohi haqida; xurmo daraxtida uxlaydigan va unga bal keklari bilan ovqat beradigan yigirma ruhoni bor katta yashil ilon haqida; katta tekis barg'alar ustida katta ko'l ustidan suzadigan va doimo polizlar bilan jangda bo'lgan pirmeyalar haqida.

en: “Dear little Swallow,” said the Prince, “you tell me of marvellous things, but more marvellous than anything is the suffering of men and of women.
uz: Aziz kichkinagina qovoq, - dedi printz, - menga ajoyib narsalar haqida aytib berasiz, lekin erkaklar va ayollarning azob-uqubatlari hamma narsadan ham ajoyib.

en: There is no Mystery so great as Misery.
uz: Misrdan buyukroq sir yo'q.

en: Fly over my city, little Swallow, and tell me what you see there.” So the Swallow ﬂew over the great city, and saw the rich making merry in their beautiful houses, while the beggars were sitting at the gates.
uz: Mening shahri ustidan uchib o't, kichik Yovuz, u yerda nima ko'rganingni ayt. Shunday qilib, Yovuz buyuk shahar ustidan uchib o'tdi va boylarning go'zal uylarida xursandchilik qilayotganini ko'rdi, begonalar esa darvozalarda o'tirgan edi.

en: He ﬂew into dark lanes, and saw the white faces of starving children looking out listlessly at the black streets.
uz: U qorong'i yo'llarga uchib, och qolgan bolalarning oq yuzlarini ko'rdi.

en: Under the archway of a bridge two little boys were lying in one another’s arms to try and keep themselves warm.
uz: Bir ko'prikning arvosida ikkita kichkina o'g'il o'zlarini issiq saqlash uchun bir-birining qo'llarida yotgan edi.

en: “How hungry we are!” they said.
uz: Biz qanchalik ochmiz! - deyishdi ular.

en: “You must not lie here,” shouted the Watchman, and they wandered out into the rain.
uz: "Sizlar bu yerda yotgan bo'lmasligingiz kerak", - deb baqirib yubordi Himoyachi va ular yomg'ir yog'ishiga yo'l qo'yib ketishdi.

en: Then he ﬂew back and told the Prince what he had seen.
uz: So'ngra u uchib qaytib kelib, ko'rganlarini Princega aytib berdi.

en: “I am covered with ﬁne gold,” said the Prince, “you must take it off, leaf by leaf, and give it to my poor; the living always think that gold can make them happy.” Leaf after leaf of the ﬁne gold the Swallow picked off, till the Happy Prince looked quite dull and grey.
uz: "Men sof oltin bilan qoplanganman", - dedi Qirozga, "Siz uni yarim-yarim olib, kambag'allarimga berishingiz kerak; tiriklar har doim oltin ularni baxtli qilishi mumkin deb o'ylashadi. Qiroz o'qigan sof oltinning yarmidan-yarmidan, baxtli Qirozgacha juda chiroyli va griz ko'rinadi.

en: Leaf after leaf of the ﬁne gold he brought to the poor, and the children’s faces grew rosier, and they laughed and played games in the street.
uz: U kambag'allarga olib kelgan go'zal oltinning bargidan-bargini ko'tardi va bolalarning yuzlari rosalashdi, ular ko'chada kulishadi va o'yin o'ynashadi.

en: “We have bread now!” they cried.
uz: Endi non bor! - deb baqirdilar.

en: Then the snow came, and after the snow came the frost.
uz: So'ngra qor keldi, qordan keyin esa sovuq keldi.

en: The streets looked as if they were made of silver, they were so bright and glistening; long icicles like crystal daggers hung down from the eaves of the houses, everybody went about in furs, and the little boys wore scarlet caps and skat- ed on the ice.
uz: Ko'chalar kumushdan yasalgan bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi, ular juda yorqin va shinam edi; uylarning cho'llarida kristall cho'g'iga o'xshash uzun muzlar oshib turardi, har bir kishi sochlarda yurardi va kichik o'g'illar qizil to'pkalar kiygan va muzda kaydashgan.

en: The poor little Swallow grew colder and colder, but he would not leave the Prince, he loved him too well.
uz: Zavqsiz kichkinagina qovoq sovuq va sovuq bo'lib borardi, lekin u Prince-ni tashlab ketishni istamadi, u uni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

en: He picked up crumbs outside the baker’s
uz: U pastkichning tashqarisida maydonlarni to'pladi.

en: door when the baker was not looking and tried to keep himself warm by ﬂapping his wings.
uz: Butun xonadoni ko'rmayotganida, nonni tayyorlab qo'yishga harakat qilib, qanotlarini teshishga harakat qilardi.

en: But at last he knew that he was going to die.
uz: Ammo oxir-oqibat u o'lishi kerakligini bilardi.

en: He had just strength to ﬂy up to the Prince’s shoulder once more.
uz: U yana bir bor Princening shoxlariga uchish uchun kuchga ega edi.

en: “Good-bye, dear Prince!” he mur- mured, “will you let me kiss your hand?” “I am glad that you are going to Egypt at last, little Swallow,” said the Prince, “you have stayed too long here; but you must kiss me on the lips, for I love you.” “It is not to Egypt that I am going,” said the Swallow.
uz: Xudojo'y, aziz printz! U: Siz menga qo'lingizni o'pishimga ruxsat berasizmi?  Men nihoyat Misrga ketayotganingizga xursandman, kichik Yovuz, dedi printz, Siz bu yerda juda uzoq vaqt qoldingiz; lekin siz meni og'zingizga o'pishingiz kerak, chunki men sizni yaxshi ko'raman. Men Misrga ketmayman, dedi Yovuz.

en: “I am going to the House of Death.
uz: Men o'lim uyiga boryapman.

en: Death is the brother of Sleep, is he not?” And he kissed the Happy Prince on the lips, and fell down dead at his feet.
uz: O'lim - uxlanishning ukasi, shunday emasmi? U baxtli shohni og'zidan o'pdi va uning oyoqlariga o'lib tushdi.

en: At that moment a curious crack sounded inside the statue, as if something had broken.
uz: O'sha paytda haykal ichida g'ayritabiiy bo'g'rilik tovushlandi, xuddi biror narsa buzilgan bo'lgandek.

en: The fact is that the leaden heart had snapped right in two.
uz: Darhaqiqat, oltin yuragi ikkiga bo'lindi.

en: It certainly was a dreadfully hard frost.
uz: Albatta, bu juda qattiq sovuq edi.

en: Early the next morning the Mayor was walking in the square below in company with the Town Councillors.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab shahar hokimi shahar a'zolari bilan birga pastki maydonda yuribdi.

en: As they passed the column he looked up at the statue: “Dear me!
uz: Ular ustunni o'tayotganda, u haykalga qarab: "Sevg'im!

en: how shabby the Happy Prince looks!” he said.
uz: Baxtiyor printz qanchalik yomon ko'rinadi! dedi u.

en: “How shabby indeed!” cried the Town Councillors, who always agreed with the Mayor; and they went up to look at it.
uz: "Haqiqatan ham yomon!" - deb baqirgan shahar a'zolari doimo shahar hokimi bilan rozi bo'lib, uni ko'rib chiqish uchun o'tishdi.

en: “The ruby has fallen out of his sword, his eyes are gone, and he is golden no longer,” said the Mayor in fact, “he is litttle beter than a beggar!” “Little better than a beggar,” said the Town Councillors.
uz: Rubini qilichidan tushdi, ko'zlari yo'qoldi va u endi oltin emas, - dedi shahar hokimi, aslida, u bir so'roqchidan biroz yaxshiroq!U so'roqchidan biroz yaxshiroq, - dedilar shahar Kengashchilari.

en: “And here is actually a dead bird at his feet!” continued the Mayor.
uz: Va bu uning oyoqlari oldida o'lgan qush! deb davom etdi shahar hokimi.

en: “We must really issue a proclamation that birds are not to be allowed to die here.”  And the Town Clerk made a note of the suggestion.
uz: Biz chindan ham qushlarning bu yerda o'lishlariga yo'l qo'ymaslik kerakligini e'lon qilishimiz kerak.Va shahar kotibi bu taklifni qayd etdi.

en: So they pulled down the statue of the Happy Prince.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular baxtli shohning haykalini tushirdilar.

en: “As he is no longer beautiful he is no longer useful,” said the Art Professor at the University.
uz: "U endi go'zal emas, shuning uchun u endi foydali emas", - dedi universitetning san'at professori.

en: Then they melted the statue in a furnace, and the Mayor held a meeting of the Corporation to decide what was to be done with the metal.
uz: So'ngra ular haykalni pechda eritdilar va shahar hokimi korporatsiyaning majlisini o'tkazdi va metall bilan nima qilish kerakligini hal qildi.

en: “We must have another statue, of course,” he said, “and it shall be a statue of myself.” “Of myself,” said each of the Town Councillors, and they quarrelled.
uz: Bizda boshqa bir haykal bo'lishi kerak, albatta,  dedi,  va u o'zimning haykal bo'lishi kerak.  O'zimning o'zim,  dedi har bir shahar kengashchisi, va ular bahslashdi.

en: When I last heard of them they were quarrelling still.
uz: So'nggi bor ular haqida eshitganimda, ular hali ham bahslashayotgan edilar.

en: “What a strange thing!” said the overseer of the workmen at the foundry.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, bu g'alati narsa! - dedi qo'shiqxonadagi ishchilarning nazoratchisi.

en: “This broken lead heart will not melt in the furnace.
uz: Bu buzilgan oltin yuragi pechda eritilmaydi.

en: We must throw it away.”  So they threw it on a dust-heap where the dead Swallow was also lying.
uz: Biz uni tashlashimiz kerak. Shunday qilib, o'lik Yovuzning ham yotgan joyidagi tuproq to'pasiga tashladilar.

en: “Bring me the two most precious things in the city,” said God to one of His Angels; and the Angel brought Him the leaden heart and the dead bird.
uz: Xudo O'z farishtalaridan biriga: "Shuning uchun shaharning eng qimmatbaho ikkita narsasini menga olib kelinglar", - dedi. Farishta esa Unga bo'g'im qalbini va o'lgan qushni olib keldi.

en: “You have rightly chosen,” said God, “for in my garden of Paradise this little bird shall sing for evermore, and in my city of gold the Happy Prince shall praise me.”
uz: Xudo dedi: "Siz to'g'ri tanlagansiz, chunki mening jannat bog'imda bu qush abadiy qo'shiq kuylaydi va oltin shaharimda baxtli shoh meni maqtadi".

en: THE NIGHTINGALE AND THE ROSE “She said that she would dance with me if I brought her red roses,” cried the young Student; “but in all my garden there is no red rose.” From her nest in the holm-oak tree the Nightingale heard him, and she looked out through the leaves, and wondered.
