uz: Ammo ikkinchi rap, so'ngra uchinchi rap keldi, u boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq ovoz chiqardi.

en: “‘It is some poor traveller,’ said little Hans to himself, and he ran to the door.
uz: "Bu kambag'al sayohatchi", - dedi kichkina Xans o'ziga, u esa eshik tomon yugurdi.

en: “There stood the Miller with a lantern in one hand and a big stick in the other.
uz: Bir qo'lida chiroq va boshqa qo'lida katta tayoq bilan Miller turgan edi.

en: “‘Dear little Hans,’ cried the Miller, ‘I am in great trouble.
uz: Aziz Hans, Millerning ovozi: "Men katta muammoga tushib qoldim.

en: My little boy has fallen off a ladder and hurt himself, and I am going for the Doctor.
uz: Mening kichkina o'g'lim daraxtdan tushib, o'zini jarohatlagan va men Doktorni olib ketmoqchiman.

en: But he lives so far away, and it is such a bad night, that it has just occurred to me that it would be much better if you went instead of me.
uz: Ammo u shunchalik uzoq yashaydi va kechasi shunchalik yomon, hatto men o'zimning o'rnimda siz ketayotganingizda yaxshiroq bo'lishini o'yladim.

en: You know I am going to give you my wheelbarrow, and so, it is only fair that you should do something for me in return.’ “‘Certainly,’ cried little Hans, ‘I take it quite as a compliment your com- ing to me, and I will start off at once.
uz: O'zingiz bilasiz, men sizga aravachani beraman, shuning uchun siz o'zingizga o'rnak qilib, men uchun biror narsa qilishingiz to'g'ri bo'ladi. Chindan ham,  kichkina Xans yig'ladi, Men buni menga iltijo qilganingiz uchun kompliment sifatida qabul qilaman va men darhol ishga tushaman.

en: But you must lend me your lantern, as the night is so dark that I am afraid I might fall into the ditch.’ “‘I am very sorry,’ answered the Miller, ‘but it is my new lantern, and it would be a great loss to me if anything happened to it.’ “‘Well, never mind, I will do without it,’ cried little Hans, and he took down his great fur coat, and his warm scarlet cap, and tied a mufﬂer round his throat, and started off.
uz: Ammo siz menga lampaingizni qarz olishingiz kerak, chunki kechasi shunchalik qorong'i bo'lib, qo'rqamanki, qo'lga tushib ketaman.Men juda afsusman, Miller javob berdi, lekin bu mening yangi lampaim, unga biror narsa yuz bersa, men uchun katta zarar bo'lardi.Albatta, hech narsa, men undan voz kechaman, kichkina Xans baqirdi va u o'zining ulkan to'yoshini va issiq qizil to'pini olib tashladi, bo'yni atrofida tovushni bog'ladi va boshladi.

en: “What a dreadful storm it was!
uz: Bu qanday dahshatli bo'ron edi!

en: The night was so black that little Hans could hardly see, and the wind was so strong that he could scarcely stand.
uz: Kechasi shunchalik qorong'i ediki, kichkina Xans ko'ra olmaydi, shamol esa shunchalik kuchli bo'lganki, u to'xtamaydi.

en: However, he was very courageous, and after he had been walking about three hours, he arrived at the Doctor’s house, and knocked at the door.
uz: Biroq u juda jasoratli bo'lgan va uch soatcha yurganidan so'ng shifokorning uyiga yetib kelib, eshikni taqillatdi.

en: “‘Who is there?’ cried the Doctor, putting his head out of his bedroom window.
uz: Kim bor? - deb qayg'urdi Doktor, boshini yotoqxonasining derazasidan chiqarib tashladi.

en: “‘Little Hans, Doctor.’ “’What do you want, little Hans?’ “‘The Miller’s son has fallen from a ladder, and has hurt himself, and the Miller wants you to come at once.’ “‘All right!’ said the Doctor; and he ordered his horse, and his big boots, and his lantern, and came downstairs, and rode off in the direction of the Miller’s house, little Hans trudging behind him.
uz: Little Hans, Doktor.  Siz nima istaysiz, kichik Hans?  Millerning o'g'li eskalar ustida tushib, o'ziga zarar yetkazdi va Miller sizni darhol kelishni xohlaydi.   Ha, - dedi Doktor; otini, katta botlarini va chiroqini buyurdi va pastga tushib, Millerning uyiga bordi, kichik Hans orqasidan yurdi.

en: “But the storm grew worse and worse, and the rain fell in torrents, and little Hans could not see where he was going, or keep up with the horse.
uz: Shundan so'ng bo'ron og'irlashib, yomg'ir oqib tushdi va kichkina Xans qayerga borayotganini ko'rmadi va otning orqasidan ketolmadi.

en: At last he lost his way, and wandered off on the moor, which was a very dan- gerous place, as it was full of deep holes, and there poor little Hans was drowned.
uz: Nihoyat, yo'lidan adashib, juda xavfli joy bo'lgan mo'l-ko'l bo'yiga ko'chib ketdi, chunki u chuqur toshlar bilan to'lgan edi va u yerda kambag'al kichkina Xans cho'kib ketgan edi.

en: His body was found the next day by some goatherds, ﬂoating in a great pool of water, and was brought back by them to the cottage.
uz: Uning jasadi ertasi kuni bir nechta cho'ponlar tomonidan katta suv hovuzida suzib turgan holda topilgan va ular tomonidan uyga qaytarib olib ketilgan.

en: “Everybody went to little Hans’ funeral, as he was so popular, and the Miller was the chief mourner.
uz: Hammasi kichkina Hansning dafn marosimiga borishgan, chunki u juda mashhur edi va Miller bosh qayg'uchi edi.

en: “‘As I was his best friend,’ said the Miller, ‘it is only fair that I should have the best place’; so he walked at the head of the procession in a long
uz: Men uning eng yaxshi do'sti bo'lganim uchun,  Miller dedi, Men eng yaxshi joyga ega bo'lishim adolatli; shuning uchun u uzoq vaqt davomida marosimning boshida yurdi

en: black cloak, and every now and then he wiped his eyes with a big pocket- handkerchief.
uz: Qora qopqog'i, vaqti-vaqti bilan esa katta kiyimli to'qima bilan ko'zlarini o'chirib turardi.

en: “‘Little Hans is certainly a great loss to every one,’ said the Blacksmith, when the funeral was over, and they were all seated comfortably in the inn, drinking spiced wine and eating sweet cakes.
uz: "Kiçik Xans, albatta, har bir kishi uchun katta ziyon", - deb aytdi Qirol, marosim tugagandan so'ng, ular hammasi mehmonxonada qulay o'tirgan edilar, ziravorli sharob ichib, shirin keklarni yeyishgan edilar.

en: “‘A great loss to me at any rate,’ answered the Miller; ‘why, I had as good as given him my wheelbarrow, and now I really don’t know what to do with it.
uz: - Men uchun katta ziyon, - deb javob berdi Miller; - nima uchun, men unga o'z vagonimni berishga ham tayyor edim va endi men bu bilan nima qilishim kerakligini bilmayman.

en: It is very much in my way at home, and it is in such bad repair that I could not get anything for it if I sold it.
uz: Uyga borganimda, u shunchalik yomon holatda bo'lib, uni sotsam, buning evaziga hech narsa topolmasdim.

en: I will certainly take care not to give away anything again.
uz: Shubhasiz, men yana hech narsa bermaslikka e'tibor beraman.

en: One always suffers for being generous.’” “Well?” said the Water-rat, after a long pause.
uz: Odam har doim saxiy bo'lgani uchun azob chekadi. dedi Suvli podshoh, uzoq to'xtatishdan so'ng.

en: “Well, that is the end,” said the Linnet.
uz: Eh, bu oxirat, dedi Linnet.

en: “But what became of the Miller?” asked the Water-rat.
uz: Lekin Millerga nima bo'ldi? deb so'radi suvli podshoh.

en: I really don’t know,” replied the Linnet; “and I am sure that I don’t care.” “It is quite evident then that you have no sympathy in your nature,” said the Water-rat.
uz: - Haqiqatan ham bilmayman, - deb javob berdi Linnet; - va shubhasiz, menga g'amxo'rlik qilmaydi. - Shunday qilib, sizda tabiatda hech qanday hamdardlik yo'qligi aniq ko'rinadi, - dedi suvli podshoh.

en: “I am afraid you don’t quite see the moral of the story,” remarked the Linnet.
uz: "Xotinim, siz hikoyaning axloqiy mazmunini ko'rmayapsiz", - dedi Linnet.

en: “The what?” screamed the Water-rat.
uz: The what? so'ng suvli podshoh qichqirdi.

en: “The moral.” “Do you mean to say that the story has a moral?” “Certainly,” said the Linnet.
uz: Axloqiy.  Siz hikoyaning axloqiyligi borligini aytmoqchimisiz?  Albatta, deb aytdi Linnet.

en: “Well, really,” said the Water-rat, in a very angry manner, “I think you should have told me that before you began.
uz: Ha, haqiqatan ham, - dedi suvli podshoh, juda g'azablanib, - o'ylaymanki, siz buni boshlashdan oldin menga aytishingiz kerak edi.

en: If you had done so, I certainly would not have listened to you; in fact, I should have said ‘Pooh,’ like the critic.
uz: Agar shunday qilgan bo'lsangiz, men sizni tinglamas edim; aslida, tanqidchi kabi "Puh", deb aytardim.

en: However, I can say it now”; so he shouted out “Pooh” at the top of his voice, gave a whisk with his tail, and went back into his hole.
uz: Biroq, men endi aytishim mumkin; shuning uchun u o'z ovozini baland so'z bilan qichqirib: "Puh!" - deb aytdi, quyruq bilan o'q qo'ydi va o'z cho'liga qaytib ketdi.

en: “And how do you like the Water-rat?” asked the Duck, who came pad- dling up some minutes afterwards.
uz: Va siz suvli tovuqni qanday yoqtirasiz? deb so'radi, keyin bir necha daqiqadan so'ng u yerga o'tirdi.

en: “He has a great many good points, but for my own part I have a mother’s feelings, and I can never look at a con- ﬁrmed bachelor without the tears coming into my eyes.” “I am rather afraid that I have annoyed him,” answered the Linnet.
uz: Uning ko'p yaxshi tomonlari bor, lekin o'zimda onamning his-tuyg'ulari bor va ko'zimga yoshlar tushmasdan, hech qachon mustahkam bolakayga qaramasam bo'ladi.

en: “The fact is, that I told him a story with a moral.” “Ah!
uz: Aslida, men unga axloqiy hikoyani aytib berdim.Ah!

en: that is always a very dangerous thing to do,” said the Duck.
uz: Bu har doim ham juda xavfli ish, - dedi Qo'zi. - Bu juda xavfli ish.

en: And I quite agree with her.
uz: Va men u bilan to'liq rozi bo'laman.

en: THE REMARKABLE ROCKET The King’s son was going to be married, so there were general rejoicings.
uz: Oʻsha paytda shohning oʻgʻli turmushga chiqishi kerak edi, shuning uchun katta xursandchiliklar boʻldi.

en: He had waited a whole year for his bride, and at last she had arrived.
uz: U kelini uchun to'liq yil kutgan edi va nihoyat u keldi.

en: She was a Russian Princess, and had driven all the way from Finland in a sledge drawn by six reindeer.
uz: U Rossiya princesasi bo'lib, oltita reyna tomonidan ko'rsatilgan choriq bilan Finlyandiyadan kelgan edi.

en: The sledge was shaped like a great golden swan, and between the swan’s wings lay the little Princess herself.
uz: Slayda katta oltin chovga o'xshardi va chovning qanotlari o'rtasida kichkina princesaning o'zi yotgan edi.

en: Her long ermine- cloak reached right down to her feet, on her head was a tiny cap of silver tissue, and she was as pale as the Snow Palace in which she had always lived.
uz: Uning uzun ermin qopqog'i oyoqlarigacha yetib borardi, boshida kumush teshikdan yasalgan kichkina qopqoq bor edi va u doim yashagan qar saroyi kabi oq edi.

en: So pale was she that as she drove through the streets all the people wondered.
uz: U shunchalik ko'p bo'lganki, ko'chalarda haydashganida, hamma hayron bo'ldi.

en: “She is like a white rose!” they cried, and they threw down ﬂowers on her from the balconies.
uz: U oq rozaga o'xshaydi! - deb baqirdilar va balkonlardan unga gullar tashladilar.

en: At the gate of the Castle the Prince was waiting to receive her.
uz: Qolning darvozasida shoh uni kutib turardi.

en: He had dreamy violet eyes, and his hair was like ﬁne gold.
uz: Uning orzu-qizil ko'zlari bor edi va sochlari sof oltin kabi edi.

en: When he saw her he sank upon one knee, and kissed her hand.
uz: Uni ko'rgach, tiz cho'kib, uning qo'lini o'pdi.

en: “Your picture was beautiful,” he murmured, “but you are more beautiful than your picture”; and the little Princess blushed.
uz: "Sening surating chiroyli edi", - deb g'ayratli so'zladi u, "lekin sen suratingdan ham chiroylisan", - deb aytdi u. Kichik printsesa qizargan edi.

en: “She was like a white rose before,” said a young Page to his neighbour, “but she is like a red rose now”; and the whole Court was delighted.
uz: "U ilgari oq roza kabi edi", - dedi yosh Page qo'shnisiga, "lekin hozir qizil roza kabi bo'ldi" va butun sud xursand bo'ldi.

en: For the next three days everybody went about saying, “White rose, Red rose, Red rose, White rose”; and the King gave orders that the Page’s salary was to be doubled.
uz: Keyingi uch kun davomida hamma: "Oq roza, qizil roza, qizil roza, oq roza" deb aytardi va shoh Page'ning ish haqi ikki baravar ko'paytirilishini buyurdi.

en: As he received no salary at all this was not of much use to him, but it was considered a great honour, and was duly published in the Court Gazette.
uz: U hech qanday ish haqi olmaganligi sababli, bu unga katta foyda bermadi, ammo bu katta sharaf deb hisoblandi va sud gazetalarida e'lon qilindi.

en: When the three days were over the marriage was celebrated.
uz: Uch kun o'tgach, nikoh nishonlandi.

en: It was a magniﬁcent ceremony, and the bride and bridegroom walked hand in hand under a canopy of purple velvet embroidered with little pearls.
uz: Bu ajoyib marosim edi va kelin va kelin o'z qo'llarini bir-biriga qo'yib, kichik marvaridlar bilan tikilgan bo'rkash paxma qo'l ostida yurishdi.

en: Then there was a State Banquet, which lasted for ﬁve hours.
uz: So'ngra besh soat davom etgan davlat banketi bo'lib o'tdi.

en: The Prince and Princess sat at the top of the Great Hall and drank out of a cup of clear crystal.
uz: Prince va Princess Buyuk zalning yuqori qismida o'tirib, bir qadah kristalldan ichdilar.

en: Only true lovers could drink out of this cup, for if false lips touched it, it grew grey and dull and cloudy.
uz: Faqatgina haqiqiy muhabbatkorlar ushbu kosalardan ichishlari mumkin edi, chunki agar soxta og'izlar unga qo'l tegizsa, u griz, chiroyli va bulutli bo'ladi.

en: “It’s quite clear that they love each other,” said the little Page, “as clear as crystal!” and the King doubled his salary a second time.
uz: Ular bir-birlarini yaxshi ko'rishlari aniq, - dedi kichik sahifa, - kristal kabi aniq! - va shoh ikkinchi marta ish haqini ikki baravar ko'paytirdi.

en: “What an hon- our!” cried all the courtiers.
uz: "Bu qanday sharaf! - deb baqirdi barcha hovliqlar.

en: After the banquet there was to be a Ball.
uz: Bayramdan keyin Bayl o'tkazilishi kerak edi.

en: The bride and bridegroom were to dance the Rose-dance together, and the King had promised to play the ﬂute.
uz: Kelin va kuyov birgalikda Roza raqsini o'ynashdi, shoh esa pilla o'ynashga va'da bergan edi.

en: He played very badly, but no one had ever dared to tell him so, be- cause he was the King.
uz: U juda yomon o'ynashgan, lekin hech kim unga buni aytishga jur'at etmagan, chunki u Podshoh edi.

en: Indeed, he knew only two airs, and was never quite certain which one he was playing; but it made no matter, for, whatever he did, everybody cried out, “Charming!
uz: Haqiqatan ham, u faqat ikkita havoni bilgan va qaysi birini o'ynashidan hech qachon amin bo'lmagan; lekin bu muhim emas edi, chunki u nimaiki qilmasin, hamma: "Chiroyli!" - deb baqirardi.

en: charming!” The last item on the programme was a grand display of ﬁreworks, to be let off exactly at midnight.
uz: dasturning so'nggi qismida yong'in-o't qo'zg'atish namoyishi bo'lib o'tdi, uni to'g'ri yarim kechada qo'yib yuborish kerak edi.

en: The little Princess had never seen a ﬁrework in her life, so the King had given orders that the Royal Pyrotechnist should be in attendance on the day of her marriage.
uz: Kichik printsessasi hayotida hech qachon o't o't o'tlarini ko'rmagan edi, shuning uchun shoh uning to'y kunida Royal Pyrotechnist ishtirok etishi kerakligini buyurgan edi.

en: “What are ﬁreworks like?” she had asked the Prince, one morning, as she was walking on the terrace.
uz: Foyverk qanday? deb so'raganida, bir kuni ertalab, u terasida yurganida, u shohdan so'radi.

en: “They are like the Aurora Borealis,” said the King, who always answered questions that were addressed to other people, “only much more natural.
uz: "Ular Aurora Borealisga o'xshaydi", - dedi shoh, u har doim boshqa odamlarga qaratilgan savollarga javob bergan, ammo bu juda tabiiy.

en: I prefer them to stars myself, as you always know when they are going to ap- pear, and they are as delightful as my own ﬂute-playing.
uz: Men ularni o'zim yulduzlashni afzal ko'raman, chunki ular qachon o'ynashini har doim bilasiz va ular mening o'zimning klaviat o'ynashim kabi yoqimli.

en: You must certain- ly see them.” So at the end of the King’s garden a great stand had been set up, and as soon as the Royal Pyrotechnist had put everything in its proper place, the ﬁreworks began to talk to each other.
uz: Siz ularni albatta ko'rishingiz kerak. Shunday qilib, shoh bog'ining oxirida katta stend o'rnatilgan edi va Royal Pyrotechnist hamma narsani o'z joyiga qo'yganidan so'ng, yong'inlar bir-biri bilan gaplashishni boshladilar.

en: “The world is certainly very beautiful,” cried a little Squib.
uz: Dunyo, albatta, juda chiroyli, deb baqirib yubordi biroz Squib.

en: “Just look at those yellow tulips.
uz: O'sha sariq tulplarga qarang.

en: if they were real crackers they could not be love- lier.
uz: Agar ular haqiqiy krekerlar bo'lganida, ular mehr-muhabbatli bo'lishlari mumkin emas edi.

en: I am very glad I have travelled.
uz: Men sayohat qilganimdan juda xursandman.

en: Travel improves the mind wonderful- ly, and does away with all one’s prejudices.” “The King’s garden is not the world, you foolish squib,” said a big Ro- man Candle; “the world is an enormous place, and it would take you three days to see it thoroughly.” “Any place you love is the world to you,” exclaimed a pensive Catherine Wheel, who had been attached to an old deal box in early life, and prided herself on her broken heart; “but love is not fashionable any more, the poets have killed it.
uz: Bu ongni ajoyib tarzda yaxshilaydi va barcha oldindan o'rganilgan o'y-tirozlarni bartaraf etadi.King bog'i dunyo emas, siz ahmoq pishiruvchingiz, deb aytdi katta Ro-man shamol;dunyo ulkan joydir va uni to'liq ko'rish uchun uch kun kerak bo'ladi.Har qanday joyni yaxshi ko'rasiz, bu siz uchun dunyo, deb e'tirof etdi yoshligida eski bir sandikga bog'langan va o'z yuragi buzilganligi bilan faxrlangan o'ylanuvchi Catherine Wheel; lekin sevgi endi moda emas, shoirlar uni o'ldirgan.

en: They wrote so much about it that nobody believed them, and I am not surprised.
uz: Ular bu haqda shunchalik ko'p yozishganki, hech kim ularga ishonmadi va bu meni hayratda qoldirmaydi.

en: True love suffers, and is silent.
uz: Haqiqiy sevgi azob chekadi va sukut saqlaydi.

en: I remember myself once—But it is no matter now.
uz: O'zimni bir marta eslayman, lekin bu endi ahamiyat bermaydi.

en: Romance is a thing of the past.”
uz: Romansiya o'tmishga aylandi.

en: “Nonsense!” said the Roman Candle, “Romance never dies.
uz: Rim shamli: "Romansiya hech qachon o'lmaydi.

en: It is like the moon, and lives for ever.
uz: U oyga o'xshaydi va abadiy yashaydi.

en: The bride and bridegroom, for instance, love each other very dearly.
uz: Misol uchun, kelin va kelin bir-birlarini juda yaxshi ko'rishadi.

en: I heard all about them this morning from a brown-paper cartridge, who happened to be staying in the same drawer as myself, and knew the latest Court news.” But the Catherine Wheel shook her head.
uz: Men bu ertalab ular to'g'risidagi xabarni ko'k qavatli qog'oz kartochkasidan eshitdim, u ham men bilan bitta qutida yashardi va so'nggi sud xabarlarini bilardi. Ammo Ketrin velosipedi boshini silkitdi.

en: “Romance is dead, Romance is dead, Romance is dead,” she murmured.
uz: Romance o'ldi, Romance o'ldi, Romance o'ldi, u g'iybat qildi.

en: She was one of those people who think that, if you say the same thing over and over a great many times, it becomes true in the end.
uz: U o'sha odamlardan biri edi, agar bir xil so'zlarni ko'p marta takrorlasangiz, oxir-oqibat haqiqatga aylanadi deb o'ylaydi.

en: Suddenly, a sharp, dry cough was heard, and they all looked round.
uz: Toʻsatdan oʻtkir, quruq kashs eshitildi va hamma atrofga qarab koʻrdi.

en: It came from a tall, supercilious-looking Rocket, who was tied to the end of a long stick.
uz: U baland, kibrli ko'rinishda bo'lgan raketa, uzoq tayoqning uctiga bog'langan edi.

en: He always coughed before he made any observation, so as to attract attention.
uz: U har doim e'tiborni jalb qilish uchun biron bir izoh berishdan oldin qo'shardi.

en: ahem!” he said, and everybody listened except the poor Cather- ine Wheel, who was still shaking her head, and murmuring, “Romance is dead.” “Order!
uz: U shunday dedi va hamma tinglagan edi, faqat kambag'al Kather-ine Wheel boshini silkitib, "Romansiya o'ldi" deb g'ayratli bo'lgan edi.

en: He was something of a politician, and had always taken a prominent part in the local elections, so he knew the proper Parliamentary expressions to use.
uz: U bir xil siyosatchi edi va mahalliy saylovlarda har doim muhim ishtirok etgan, shuning uchun u to'g'ri parlament so'zlarini ishlatishni bilgan.

en: “Quite dead,” whispered the Catherine Wheel, and she went off to sleep.
uz: To'liq o'lgan,  Catherine Wheel shov-shuv qildi va u uxlab ketdi.

en: He spoke with a very slow, distinct voice, as if he was dictating his memoirs, and always looked over the shoulder of the person to whom he was talking.
uz: U juda sekin, aniq ovoz bilan gapirgan, xuddi o'z xotiralarini yozgan kabi, har doim gapirgan odamning yelkasidan ko'z o'girgan.

en: In fact, he had a most distinguished manner.
uz: Darhaqiqat, u juda taniqli xatti-harakatlarga ega edi.

en: “How fortunate it is for the King’s son,” he remarked, “that he is to be married on the very day on which I am to be let off.
uz: "Qirolning o'g'li uchun qanday baxtli bo'ldi, - deb ta'kidladi u, - u meni ozod qilish kunida turmushga chiqishi kerak.

en: Really, if it had been arranged beforehand, it could not have turned out better for him; but, Princes are always lucky.” “Dear me!” said the little Squib, “I thought it was quite the other way, and that we were to be let off in the Prince’s honour.” “It may be so with you,” he answered; “indeed, I have no doubt that it is, but with me it is different.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, agar bu oldindan tuzilgan bo'lganida, u uchun bu yaxshiroq bo'lmasdi; lekin, printslar har doim omadli.Sevg'im! kichik Squib aytdi,Men o'yladimki, bu to'g'ri boshqacha yo'l bilan sodir bo'ldi va bizni printsning sharafiga qo'yib yuborish kerak edi.Siz bilan ham shunday bo'lishi mumkin,o'zi javob berdi;Haqiqatan ham, shunga shubha yo'q, lekin men bilan u boshqacha.

en: I am a very remarkable Rocket, and come of re- markable parents.
uz: Men juda diqqatga sazovor roketman va o'zgacha ota-onalardan tug'ilganman.

en: My mother was the most celebrated Catherine Wheel of her day, and was renowned for her graceful dancing.
uz: Onam o'z davridagi eng mashhur Catherine Wheel bo'lib, o'zining chiroyli raqslari bilan mashhur edi.

en: When she made her great public appearance she spun round nineteen times before she went out, and each time that she did so she threw into the air seven pink stars.
uz: O'zining ajoyib ommaviy ko'rinishini ko'rsatganida, u ketishdan oldin o'n to'qqiz marta aylanib chiqardi va har safar u yettita roza yulduzni havoga tashladi.

en: She was three feet and a half in diameter, and made of the very best gunpowder.
uz: U uch yarim fut diametrli va eng yaxshi qorovuldan yasalgan edi.

en: My father was a Rocket like myself, and of French extraction.
uz: Otam o'zim kabi roketachi va fransuz millati bo'lgan.

en: He ﬂew so high that the people were afraid that he would never come down again.
uz: U shunchalik yuqoriga uchdiki, odamlar u yana hech qachon tushmasligidan qo'rqishdi.

en: He did, though, for he was of a kindly disposition, and he made a most brilliant descent in a shower of golden rain.
uz: Ammo u shunday qildi, chunki u mehribon ruhda edi va oltin yomg'ir yog'ishi bilan juda ajoyib tushdi.

en: The newspapers wrote about his perfor- mance in very ﬂattering terms.
uz: Gazetalar uning ishlashi haqida juda yoqimli so'zlar bilan yozgan.

en: Indeed, the Court Gazette called him a tri- umph of Pylotechnic art.” “Pyrotechnic, Pyrotechnic, you mean,” said a Bengal Light; “I know it is Pyrotechnic, for I saw it written on my own canister.” “Well, I said Pylotechnic,” answered the Rocket, in a severe tone of voice, and the Bengal Light felt so crushed that he began at once to bully the little squibs, in order to show that he was still a person of some importance.
uz: Darhaqiqat, "Shu" gazetasi uni Pylotexnik san'atining uchta ustasi deb atagan. Pyrotechnic, Pyrotechnic, siz aytmoqchimisiz, dedi Bengal Light; Men bu Pyrotechnic ekanligini bilaman, chunki men uni o'z qo'llamda ko'rdim. Navoiy, men Pylotechnic deb aytdim, Rocketga qattiq ovoz bilan javob berdi va Bengal Light o'zini shunchalik ezilgan his qildiki, u o'zi hali ham muhim shaxs ekanini ko'rsatish uchun birdan-bir kichkinagina ko'piklarni zorlashni boshladi.

en: “I was saying,” continued the Rocket, “I was saying—What was I saying?” “You were talking about yourself,” replied the Roman Candle.
uz: Men aytyap edim,  Roketa davom etdi, Men aytyap edim, Men nima deb aytyapman?Siz o'zingiz haqida gapirgansiz,  Rim shamli javob berdi.

en: “Of course; I knew I was discussing some interesting subject when I was so rudely interrupted.
uz: Avsud, men o'zimni qiziq bir mavzuda muhokama qilayotganimni bilardim, lekin meni o'sha qadar qo'pol ravishda to'xtatishdi.

en: I hate rudeness and bad manners of every kind, for I am extremely sensitive.
uz: Men qo'pollik va har qanday yomon xulq-atvordan nafratlanaman, chunki men juda sezgirman.

en: No one in the whole world is so sensitive as I am, I am quite sure of that.” “What is a sensitive person?” said the Cracker to the Roman Candle.
uz: Dunyoda hech kim men kabi sezgir emas, bunga aminman.  Sezgir odam nima? - deb so'radi Romaniyaning chiroqidan so'ng.

en: “A person who, because he has corns himself, always treads on other people’s toes,” answered the Roman Candle in a low whisper; and the Cracker nearly exploded with laughter.
uz: O'zidan-o'zidan pishirganligi sababli har doim boshqalarning barmoqlariga qadam tashlaydigan kishi Rim shamolini past ovoz bilan javob berdi; Cracker esa deyarli g'azabga to'ldi.

en: “Pray, what are you laughing at?” inquired the Rocket; “I am not laughing.” “I am laughing because I am happy,” replied the Cracker.
uz: Pray, nimaga kulyapsan? Rocketdan so'radi; Men kulmayapman. Men quvonch topganim uchun kulyapman, deb javob berdi Cracker.

en: “That is a very selﬁsh reason,” said the Rocket angrily.
uz: "Bu juda xudbinlik sababidir", - dedi Raketa g'azabga to'lib.

en: “What right have you to be happy?
uz: Xo'sh, baxtli bo'lish uchun qanday huquqingiz bor?

en: You should be thinking about others.
uz: Boshqalar haqida o'ylashingiz kerak.

en: In fact, you should be thinking about me.
uz: Aslida, siz men haqimda o'ylashingiz kerak.

en: I am always thinking about myself, and I expect everybody else to do the same.
uz: Men doimo o'zim haqida o'ylayman va boshqalarning ham shunday qilishlarini kutaman.

en: That is what is called sympathy.
uz: Bu hamdardlik deb ataladi.

en: It is a beautiful virtue, and I possess it in a high degree.
uz: Bu go'zal fazilat va men uni yuqori darajada egallayapman.

en: Suppose, for instance, anything happened to me to-night, what a misfortune that would be for every one!
uz: Misol uchun, kecha menga biror narsa sodir bo'lganini tasavvur qiling, bu har bir kishi uchun qanday baxtsizlik bo'lishi mumkin!

en: The Prince and Princess would never be happy again, their whole married life would be spoiled; and as for the King, I know he would not get over it.
uz: Prince va princesslar hech qachon baxtli bo'lishmaydi, ularning butun turmush tarzi buzuq bo'ladi; va shohga kelsak, uning bu vaziyatdan hech qachon xalos bo'lmasligini bilaman.

en: Really, when I begin to reﬂect on the importance of my po- sition, I am almost moved to tears.”
uz: Haqiqatan ham, o'z nuqtai nazarim qanchalik muhim ekani haqida mulohaza yuritishni boshlaganimda, o'zimni ko'z yoshlarimga to'ldiraman.

en: “If you want to give pleasure to others,” cried the Roman Candle, “you had better keep yourself dry.” “Certainly,” exclaimed the Bengal Light, who was now in better spirits; “that is only common sense.” “Common sense, indeed!” said the Rocket indignantly; “you forget that I am very uncommon, and very remarkable.
uz: Agar siz boshqalarga zavq berishni istasangiz, Roma shamolini chaqirganingizda, Siz o'zingizni quruq saqlashingiz kerak edi.Agar yo'q, endi yaxshi ruhda bo'lgan Bengal Light so'zladi; bu faqatgina aqli raso.Aqli raso, albatta! Rocket g'azablanib dedi; siz men juda kamyob va juda diqqatga sazovor bo'lganimni unutasiz.

en: Why, anybody can have com- mon sense, provided that they have no imagination.
uz: Axir, har kim aql-idrokga ega bo'lishi mumkin, agar u tasavvurga ega bo'lmasa.

en: But I have imagina- tion, for I never think of things as they really are; I always think of them as being quite different.
uz: Ammo men tasavvurga egaman, chunki men hech qachon narsalarni ular bo'lganidek ko'rmayman; men ularni har doim boshqacha deb o'ylayman.

en: As for keeping myself dry, there is evidently no one here who can at all appreciate an emotional nature.
uz: O'zimni quruq saqlash haqida gap ketganda, bu yerda hissiy tabiatni qadrlaydigan hech kim yo'q.

en: Fortunately for myself, I don’t care.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, o'zim uchun bu menga qiziqmaydi.

en: The only thing that sustains one through life is the conscious- ness of the immense inferiority of everybody else, and this is a feeling that I have always cultivated.
uz: Hayot davomida odamni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yagona narsa - bu boshqalarning ulkan kamchiligini bilishdir va bu men har doim rivojlantirgan his-tuyg'u.

en: But none of you have any hearts.
uz: Ammo sizlarning hech kimning yuragi yo'q.

en: Here you are laughing and making merry just as if the Prince and Princess had not just been married.” “Well, really,” exclaimed a small Fire-balloon, “why not?
uz: Mana, sizlar o'zingizning kulishingiz va quvonishingiz bilan, xuddi prints va princesaning yangi turmush qurgani yo'qdek. Ha, haqiqatan ham,  kichkina olov balonini qichqirdi,  nima uchun yo'q?

en: It is a most joyful occasion, and when I soar up into the air I intend to tell the stars all about it.
uz: Bu juda quvonchli hodisa va havoga uchganimda, yulduzlarga bu haqda aytib berishni rejalashtiraman.

en: You will see them twinkle when I talk to them about the pretty bride.” “Ah!
uz: Men ularga go'zal kelin haqida gapirganimda, ularning chiroqlashishini ko'rasiz.  Ah!

en: what a trivial view of life!” said the Rocket; “but it is only what I expected.
uz: Hayotga nisbatan naqadar oddiy nuqtai nazar! - dedi Raketa; - lekin bu men kutgan narsa.

en: There is nothing in you; you are hollow and empty.
uz: Sizda hech narsa yo'q; siz quruq va bo'shsizsiz.

en: Why, per- haps the Prince and Princess may go to live in a country where there is a deep river, and perhaps they may have one only son, a little fair-haired boy with violet eyes like the Prince himself; and perhaps some day he may go out to walk with his nurse; and perhaps the nurse may go to sleep under a great elder-tree; and perhaps the little boy may fall into the deep river and be drowned.
uz: Ehtimol, prints va printsesa chuqur daryo bo'lgan mamlakatda yashash uchun borishadi va ehtimol ularning yagona o'g'li bo'lishi mumkin, balki printsning o'zi kabi rang-barang ko'zlar bilan kichkinagina sochli yigit bo'lishi mumkin; va ehtimol bir kun u o'z hamshiralari bilan yurishga ketishi mumkin; va ehtimol hamshira katta bir keksa daraxt ostida uxlashi mumkin; va ehtimol kichkinagina o'g'il chuqur daryoga tushib, cho'kib ketishi mumkin.

en: What a terrible misfortune!
uz: Bu naqadar dahshatli baxtsizlik!

en: Poor people, to lose their only son!
uz: Yolg'iz o'g'lini yo'qotgan kambag'al odamlar!

en: It is really too dreadful!
uz: Bu juda dahshatli!

en: I shall never get over it.” “But they have not lost their only son,” said the Roman Candle; “no mis- fortune has happened to them at all.” “I never said that they had,” replied the Rocket; “I said that they might.
uz: Men buni hech qachon yenga olmayman. Lekin ular yagona o'g'lini yo'qotgan emaslar, dedi Rim shamli; ularga hech qanday baxtsizlik yuz bermagan. Men hech qachon ular borligini aytmaganman, Rocket javob berdi; Men ular borligini aytdim.

en: If they had lost their only son there would be no use in saying anything more about the matter.
uz: Agar ular yagona o'g'lini yo'qotgan bo'lishganida, bu haqda boshqa hech narsa aytishning foydasi yo'q edi.

en: I hate people who cry over spilt milk.
uz: Men to'kilgan sut ustidan yig'layotgan odamlardan nafratlanaman.

en: But when I think that they might lose their only son, I certainly am very much affected.” “You certainly are!” cried the Bengal Light.
uz: Ammo ular yagona o'g'lini yo'qotishlari mumkinligini o'ylayotganimda, men juda ta'sirlanaman. "Sizlar albatta shundaysiz!" - deb baqirdi Bengal Light.

en: “In fact, you are the most affected person I ever met.”
uz: Aslida, siz men tanigan eng ko'p zarar ko'rgan odamsiz.

en: “You are the rudest person I ever met,” said the Rocket, “and you cannot understand my friendship for the Prince.” “Why, you don’t even know him,” growled the Roman Candle.
uz: Siz men uchratgan eng qo'pol odamsiz,  dedi Roketa,  va siz printzga bo'lgan do'stligimni tushunmayapsiz. Nima uchun, siz uni hatto tanimaysiz,  Rim shamolini qichqirdi.

en: “I never said I knew him,” answered the Rocket.
uz: "Men uni taniganimni hech qachon aytmaganman", - deb javob berdi Raketa.

en: “I dare say that if I knew him I should not be his friend at all.
uz: Agar uni bilsam, uning do'sti bo'lmasdim, deb aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: It is a very dangerous thing to know one’s friends.” “You had really better keep yourself dry,” said the Fire-balloon.
uz: Do'stlar bilan tanishish juda xavfli bo'ladi.Siz o'zingizni quruq saqlashingiz kerak edi, - dedi Yong'in ballon.

en: “That is the important thing.” “Very important for you, I have no doubt,” answered the Rocket, “but I shall weep if I choose”; and he actually burst into real tears, which ﬂowed down his stick like rain-drops, and nearly drowned two little beetles, who were just thinking of setting up house together, and were looking for a nice dry spot to live in.
uz: Bu eng muhim narsa. Siz uchun juda muhim, hech shubha yo'q, Rocket javob berdi,  lekin men xohlasam yig'layman; va u aslida o'z tayoqidan yog'ib, yomg'ir tomchilariga o'xshaydigan haqiqiy ko'z yoshlariga to'ldi va ikki kichkinagina qaroqchini o'ldirib yubordi, ular birga uy qurishni o'ylayotgan edilar va yashash uchun quruq joy qidirayotgan edilar.

en: “He must have a truly romantic nature,” said the Catherine Wheel, “for he weeps when there is nothing at all to weep about”; and she heaved a deep sigh, and thought about the deal box.
uz: U chindan ham romantik tabiatga ega bo'lishi kerak,  dedi Catherine Wheel, chunki u yig'laydi, chunki yig'lash uchun hech narsa yo'q ; va u chuqur nafas oldi va bitim qutisi haqida o'yladi.

en: But the Roman Candle and the Bengal Light were quite indignant, and kept saying, “Humbug!
uz: Ammo Rim shamli va Bengal yorug'ligi juda g'azabga to'lib, "Humbug!" deb aytishdi.

en: humbug!” at the top of their voices.
uz: Humbug! ularning ovozlari eng yuqoriida.

en: They were ex- tremely practical, and whenever they objected to anything they called it humbug.
uz: Ular juda amaliy edilar va har qachon biron bir narsaga qarshilik ko'rsatsalar, uni hambug deb atashardilar.

en: Then the moon rose like a wonderful silver shield; and the stars began to shine, and a sound of music came from the palace.
uz: Oʻshanda oy ajoyib kumush qalqon kabi koʻtarildi, yulduzlar parlay boshladi va saroydan musiqa ovozi chiqdi.

en: The Prince and Princess were leading the dance.
uz: Prince va Princess raqsga boshchilik qilishgan.

en: They danced so beauti- fully that the tall white lilies peeped in at the window and watched them, and the great red poppies nodded their heads and beat time.
uz: Ular shunchalik chiroyli raqsga tushdilarki, baland oq lilar darchaga qarab, ularni ko'rdilar, katta qizil qovoq esa boshlarini burib vaqtni urdilar.

en: Then ten o’clock struck, and then eleven, and then twelve, and at the last stroke of midnight every one came out on the terrace, and the King sent for the Royal Pyrotechnist.
uz: So'ngra o'n soat urildi, keyin o'n bir, keyin o'n ikki, va yarim tunning so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggi so'nggiga chiqdi va shoh podshoh pyrotehnikni chaqirib yubordi.

en: “Let the ﬁreworks begin,” said the King; and the Royal Pyrotechnist made a low bow, and marched down to the end of the garden.
uz: Foyerverk boshlansin, dedi shoh; va Royal Pyrotechnist pastga o'tirib, bog'ning oxirigacha yurdi.

en: He had six attendants with him, each of whom carried a lighted torch at the end of a long pole.
uz: U bilan birga olti nafar xizmatkor bor edi, ularning har biri uzoq ustunning so'ngida yonib turgan shamol ko'tarib turardi.

en: It was certainly a magniﬁcent display.
uz: Bu, albatta, ajoyib ko'rinish edi.

en: went the Catherine Wheel, as she spun round and round.
uz: Catherine G'ildiragi aylanib borar edi.

en: went the Roman Candle.
uz: Rim shamolini o'chirib yubordi.

en: Then the Squibs danced all over the place, and the Bengal Lights made everything look scarlet.
uz: Keyin Squiblar hamma joyda raqsga tushdilar va Bengal yorug'liklari hamma narsani qizil ko'rinishga qo'yishdi.

en: “Good- bye,” cried the Fire-balloon, as he soared away, dropping tiny blue sparks.
uz: Good-bye, o'zidan chiqib ketayotganda, olov ballonini qichqirib, kichkina ko'k chiroqlarni tashladi.

en: answered the Crackers, who were enjoying themselves im- mensely.
uz: Ular o'zlarining zavq-shafqatlarini ko'z yumib o'tkazgan "Krakkerlar" jamoasi javob berdi.

en: Every one was a great success except the Remarkable Rocket.
uz: Har biri ajoyib raketadan tashqari katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

en: He was so damp with crying that he could not go off at all.
uz: U yig'lab o'tirganidan o'ta nam bo'lib, umuman o'tib ketolmadi.

en: The best thing in him was the gunpowder, and that was so wet with tears that it was of no use.
uz: Udagi eng yaxshi narsa - to'qima edi va u juda ko'p ko'z yoshlariga to'lib-toshgan bo'lib, foydasi yo'q edi.

en: All his poor relations, to whom he would never speak, except with a sneer, shot up into the sky like wonderful golden ﬂowers with blossoms of ﬁre.
uz: U hech qachon masxara qilishdan tashqari gapirmaydigan barcha kambag'al qarindoshlari, oltin gullar kabi osmonga ko'tarildi.

en: cried the Court; and the little Princess laughed with pleasure.
uz: Qahrga yig'ladi va kichkinagina printsesa xursandchilik bilan kulishdi.

en: “I suppose they are reserving me for some grand occasion,” said the Rocket; “no doubt that is what it means,” and he looked more supercilious than ever.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, ular meni qandaydir ulug' marosim uchun qo'yib qo'yishmoqda, dedi Roketa; Shuni aytish kerakki, bu o'sha ma'noni anglatadi, va u har qachongidan ko'proq mag'rur ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: The next day the workmen came to put everything tidy.
uz: Ertasi kuni ishchilar hamma narsani tozalash uchun kelishdi.

en: “This is evident- ly a deputation,” said the Rocket; “I will receive them with becoming digni- ty” so he put his nose in the air, and began to frown severely as if he were thinking about some very important subject.
uz: "Bu, albatta, deputatlik", - dedi Roketa, "Men ularni munosiblik bilan qabul qilaman", - dedi u. Shu sababli u o'z nuzini ko'tardi va juda muhim mavzu haqida o'ylagandek, ko'z o'ngidan ko'z o'ngini ko'tardi.

en: But they took no notice of him at all till they were just going away.
uz: Ammo ular uni ketgunga qadar hech qachon e'tiborsiz qoldirishdi.

en: Then one of them caught sight of him.
uz: Keyin ulardan biri uni ko'rib qoldi.

en: “Hallo!” he cried, “what a bad rocket!” and he threw him over the wall into the ditch.
uz: U: "Halo!" - deb baqirdi va uni devor ustiga tashlab, chuqurlikka uloqtirdi.

en: BAD Rocket?” he said, as he whirled through the air; “impossible!
uz: "BAD Rocket?" - dedi u havoda aylanib yurganida; "Mümkin emas!

en: GRAND Rocket, that is what the man said.
uz: GRAND Rocket, bu kishi shunday degan.

en: BAD and GRAND sound very much the same, indeed they often are the same”; and he fell into the mud.
uz: "BAD" va "GRAND" o'xshash tovushlar bilan taqqoslanadi, aslida ular ko'pincha bir xil bo'ladi; u esa cho'lga tushibdi.

en: “It is not comfortable here,” he remarked, “but no doubt it is some fash- ionable watering-place, and they have sent me away to recruit my health.
uz: Bu yerda qulay emas, - dedi u, - lekin shubhasiz, bu biroz moddan o'zgaruvchan sug'orish joyidir va ular meni sog'lig'imni saqlash uchun jo'natishdi.

en: My nerves are certainly very much shattered, and I require rest.” Then a little Frog, with bright jewelled eyes, and a green mottled coat, swam up to him.
uz: Chindan ham, mening hissiy his-tuyg'ularim juda yomon va men dam olishga muhtojman. Keyin unga yoritilgan ko'z va yashil pishirilgan kiyimli kichkinagina kurakcha yaqinlashdi.

en: “A new arrival, I see!” said the Frog.
uz: Men yangi kelganlarni ko'ryapman! dedi Qoraq.

en: “Well, after all there is nothing like mud.
uz: Albatta, maydaning o'rniga hech narsa yo'q.

en: Give me rainy weather and a ditch, and I am quite happy.
uz: Menga yomg'ir yog'adigan ob-havo va maydon bering, shunda men juda baxtli bo'laman.

en: Do you think it will be a wet afternoon?
uz: Sizningcha, bu yomg'ir kunlari boshoq kun bo'ladimi?

en: I am sure I hope so, but the sky is quite blue and cloudless.
uz: Ishonchim komil, lekin osmon juda ko'k va bulutsiz.

en: What a pity!” “Ahem!
uz: Bu naqadar achinarli! Ahem!

en: ahem!” said the Rocket, and he began to cough.
uz: ahem! dedi Raketa, u ham qo'shishni boshladi.

en: “What a delightful voice you have!” cried the Frog.
uz: Qizig'ingiz naqadar chiroyli! - deb qichqirdi Qoraq.

en: “Really it is quite like a croak, and croaking is of course the most musical sound in the world.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, bu qo'ng'iroqga o'xshaydi va qo'ng'iroq, albatta, dunyodagi eng musiqiy tovushdir.

en: You will hear our glee-club this evening.
uz: Bugun kechqurun glee-klubimizni tinglaysiz.

en: We sit in the old duck pond close by the farmer’s house, and as soon as the moon rises we begin.
uz: Farmerning uyiga yaqin joylashgan eski qurtlar hovuzida o'tiribmiz va oy ko'tarilganda boshlaymiz.

en: It is so en- trancing that everybody lies awake to listen to us.
uz: Bu shunchalik chiroyliki, hamma bizni tinglash uchun uyg'onadi.

en: In fact, it was only yes-
uz: Aslida, bu faqat "ha" edi.

en: terday that I heard the farmer’s wife say to her mother that she could not get a wink of sleep at night on account of us.
uz: Uchinchi kuni fermerning xotini onasiga biz tufayli kechasi uxlay olmaganini aytganini eshitdim.

en: It is most gratifying to ﬁnd one- self so popular.” “Ahem!
uz: O'z-o'zini shu qadar mashhur topish juda mamnuniyat baxsh etadi. Ahem!

en: ahem!” said the Rocket angrily.
uz: ahem! dedi Raketa g'azabda.

en: He was very much annoyed that he could not get a word in.
uz: U bir so'z ham aytolmagani uchun juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: “A delightful voice, certainly,” continued the Frog; “I hope you will come over to the duck-pond.
uz: Ajoyib ovoz, albatta, - deb davom etdi Qoraq; Men umidimki, siz qurtlar hovuzidan o'tasiz.

en: I am off to look for my daughters.
uz: Men qizlarimni qidirishga ketyapman.

en: I have six beautiful daughters, and I am so afraid the Pike may meet them.
uz: Mening olti go'zal qizim bor va Pike ularni uchratishidan juda qo'rqaman.

en: He is a perfect monster, and would have no hesitation in breakfasting off them.
uz: U mukammal qo'rqinchdir va ulardan ovqatlanishdan hech ikkilanmaydi.

en: Well, good-bye: I have enjoyed our conversation very much, I assure you.” “Conversation, indeed!” said the Rocket.
uz: Xo'sh, salom: suhbatimizdan juda zavqlandim, sizga ishontiraman. Chindan ham suhbat! - dedi Roketa.

en: “You have talked the whole time yourself.
uz: Siz o'zingiz ham butun vaqt davomida gapirgansiz.

en: That is not conversation.” “Somebody must listen,” answered the Frog, “and I like to do all the talk- ing myself.
uz: Bu suhbat emas. Kimdir tinglashi kerak,- deb javob berdi Frog, va men barcha suhbatni o'zim qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: It saves time, and prevents arguments.” “But I like arguments,” said the Rocket.
uz: Bu vaqtni tejaydi va bahs-munozaralarni oldini oladi.  Lekin men bahs-munozaralarni yaxshi ko'raman, dedi Roketa.

en: “I hope not,” said the Frog complacently.
uz: Umid qilamanki, yo'q, - dedi Qoraq samimiylik bilan.

en: “Arguments are extremely vul- gar, for everybody in good society holds exactly the same opinions.
uz: Mulohazalar juda oddiy, chunki yaxshi jamiyatda hamma bir xil fikrlarga ega.

en: Good- bye a second time; I see my daughters in the distance and the little Frog swam away.
uz: Ikkinchi marta salomatlik bilan; men uzoqlikda qizlarimni ko'raman va kichkinagina Frog ko'chib o'tib ketadi.

en: “You are a very irritating person,” said the Rocket, “and very ill-bred.
uz: Siz juda g'azablantiruvchi odamsiz, - dedi Roketa, - va juda yomon ko'rinadi.

en: I hate people who talk about themselves, as you do, when one wants to talk about oneself, as I do.
uz: Men o'zlari haqida gapiradigan odamlardan nafratlanaman, chunki siz o'zingiz kabi o'zlari haqida gapirishni istasangiz, men kabi o'zlari haqida gapirishni xohlaysiz.

en: It is what I call selﬁshness, and selﬁshness is a most detestable thing, especially to any one of my temperament, for I am well known for my sympathetic nature.
uz: Men buni xudbinlik deb atayman va xudbinlik juda jirkanch narsa, ayniqsa, har qanday odam uchun, chunki men mehribonligim bilan tanilganman.

en: In fact, you should take example by me; you could not possibly have a better model.
uz: Darhaqiqat, siz mendan o'rnak olishingiz kerak; sizda undan yaxshi namuna bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Now that you have the chance you had better avail yourself of it, for I am going back to Court almost im- mediately.
uz: Endi fursatingiz bor ekan, undan foydalaning, chunki men deyarli darhol sudga qaytaman.

en: I am a great favourite at Court; in fact, the Prince and Princess were married yesterday in my honour.
uz: Men qahramonda katta sevimli odamman; aslida, prints va printsesa mening hurmatim uchun kecha turmushga chiqdilar.

en: Of course you know nothing of these matters, for you are a provincial.” “There is no good talking to him,” said a Dragon-ﬂy, who was sitting on the top of a large brown bulrush; “no good at all, for he has gone away.” “Well, that is his loss, not mine,” answered the Rocket.
uz: Albatta, siz bu mavzulardan hech narsa bilmaysiz, chunki siz viloyatliksiz. U bilan gaplashishning hech qanday foydasi yo'q, dedi ko'p qalin ko'chatning ustida o'tirgan Dragon-fly; hech qanday foydasi yo'q, chunki u ketib ketgan.Bu uning zararidir, mening emas, Rocket javob berdi.

en: “I am not going to stop talking to him merely because he pays no attention.
uz: Men unga shunchaki e'tibor bermagani uchun gapirishni to'xtatmayman.

en: I like hearing myself talk.
uz: O'zimni gapirishni eshitishni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: It is one of my greatest pleasures.
uz: Bu mening eng katta zavqlarimdan biridir.

en: I often have long conversa- tions all by myself, and I am so clever that sometimes I don’t understand a single word of what I am saying.”
uz: Ko'pincha men o'zim bilan uzoq suhbatlar o'tkazaman va men shunchalik aqllimanki, ba'zan aytganlarimning bir so'zini ham tushunmayapman.

en: “Then you should certainly lecture on Philosophy,” said the Dragon-ﬂy; and he spread a pair of lovely gauze wings and soared away into the sky.
uz: "Shuning uchun siz falsafa mavzusida dars o'tkazishingiz kerak", - dedi Drahmon-quruq. - Va u chiroyli gaz qanotlari juftini taratdi va osmonga ko'tarildi.

en: “How very silly of him not to stay here!” said the Rocket.
uz: U bu yerda qolmasligi naqadar ahmoqlikdir! - dedi Raketa.

en: “I am sure that he has not often got such a chance of improving his mind.
uz: Men shubhalanamanki, u ko'pincha fikrlash tarzini o'zgartirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmagan.

en: However, I don’t care a bit.
uz: Biroq, bu menga biroz ham ahamiyat bermaydi.

en: Genius like mine is sure to be appreciated some day”; and he sank down a little deeper into the mud.
uz: Mening kabi g'ayrioddiy inson bir kun kelib qadrlanadi va u ozgina chuqurroq cho'kib ketgan.

en: After some time a large White Duck swam up to him.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, uning yonida katta oq chorva ko'tarildi.

en: She had yellow legs, and webbed feet, and was considered a great beauty on account of her waddle.
uz: Uning sariq oyoqlari va to'qilgan oyoqlari bor edi va u o'z qo'llari bilan juda go'zal deb hisoblanardi.

en: “Quack, quack, quack,” she said.
uz: Quack, quack, quack, dedi u.

en: “What a curious shape you are!
uz: Siz qanday qiziqarli shaklsiz!

en: May I ask were you born like that, or is it the result of an accident?” “It is quite evident that you have always lived in the country,” answered the Rocket, “otherwise you would know who I am.
uz: Siz shunday tug'ilganmisiz, yoki bu baxtsiz hodisalar tufayli sodir bo'lganmi?Siz har doim qishloq joyda yashaganingiz aniq, Rocket javob berdi,Xullas, siz mening kim ekanimni bilasiz.

en: However, I excuse your ignorance.
uz: Biroq, sizning jaholatingiz uchun uzr so'rayman.

en: It would be unfair to expect other people to be as remarkable as oneself.
uz: Boshqalarning o'zimizdek diqqatga sazovor bo'lishini kutish adolatsiz bo'ladi.

en: You will no doubt be surprised to hear that I can ﬂy up into the sky, and come down in a shower of golden rain.” “I don’t think much of that,” said the Duck, “as I cannot see what use it is to any one.
uz: Men osmonga uchib, oltin yomg'ir yog'ishi bilan tushishim mumkinligini eshitganingizda ajablanasiz.Men bu haqda ko'p o'ylamayman, dedi Qurtak, chunki men hech kimga qanday foyda keltirishini ko'rmayman.

en: Now, if you could plough the ﬁelds like the ox, or draw a cart like the horse, or look after the sheep like the collie-dog, that would be something.” “My good creature,” cried the Rocket in a very haughty tone of voice, “I see that you belong to the lower orders.
uz: Endi, agar siz o'g'il kabi dalalarni terib olishingiz yoki ot kabi arava chizishingiz yoki qo'ylarni kolli-dog' kabi parvarishlashingiz mumkin bo'lsa, bu bir narsa bo'ladi.Yaxshi yaratim, Rocketni juda mag'rur ovoz bilan chaqirdi,Men sizning past darajalarga tegishli ekanligingizni ko'raman.

en: A person of my position is never useful.
uz: Mening o'rnimdagi odam hech qachon foydali emas.

en: We have certain accomplishments, and that is more than sufﬁcient.
uz: Bizda ba'zi yutuqlar bor va bu yetarli emas.

en: I have no sympathy myself with industry of any kind, least of all with such industries as you seem to recommend.
uz: Men o'zim hech qanday sanoat bilan aloqador emasman, ayniqsa siz tavsiya qilayotgan sohalar bilan.

en: Indeed, I have always been of opin- ion that hard work is simply the refuge of people who have nothing whatev- er to do.” “Well, well,” said the Duck, who was of a very peaceable disposition, and never quarrelled with any one, “everybody has different tastes.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men har doim ham qattiq mehnat qilish shunchaki hech narsa qilmaydigan odamlarning panohi deb o'ylardim. deb aytdi kamdan-kam tinchlikparvar va hech qachon hech kim bilan bahslashmagan Bo't.Har kimning o'ziga xos ta'siri bor.

en: I hope, at any rate, that you are going to take up your residence here.” “Oh!
uz: Umid qilamanki, hech bo'lmaganda, siz bu yerda o'z qarorgohingizni qabul qilasiz.!

en: dear no,” cried the Rocket.
uz: Yo'q, aziz, Rocket qichqirdi.

en: “I am merely a visitor, a distinguished visitor.
uz: Men shunchaki tashrif buyuruvchi, taniqli tashrif buyuruvchiman.

en: The fact is that I ﬁnd this place rather tedious.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men bu joyni juda charchatadigan joy deb bilaman.

en: There is neither so- ciety here, nor solitude.
uz: Bu yerda jamiyat ham, yolg'izlik ham yo'q.

en: In fact, it is essentially suburban.
uz: Aslida, u asosan shahar tashqarisidir.

en: I shall probably go back to Court, for I know that I am destined to make a sensation in the world.” “I had thoughts of entering public life once myself,” remarked the Duck; “there are so many things that need reforming.
uz: Ehtimol, men sudga qaytib boraman, chunki men dunyoga ta'sir ko'rsatishim kerakligini bilaman.Men ham bir marta jamoat hayotiga kirish haqida o'yladim,- dedi Do'k;bu ko'p narsalar o'zgartirishga muhtoj.

en: Indeed, I took the chair at a
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men o'rinni o'z zimmamga oldim.

en: meeting some time ago, and we passed resolutions condemning everything that we did not like.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt oldin uchrashganmiz va biz yoqtirmagan hamma narsani qoralagan qarorlar qabul qildik.

en: However, they did not seem to have much effect.
uz: Biroq, ular ko'p ta'sir ko'rsatmagan.

en: Now I go in for domesticity, and look after my family.”  “I am made for public life,” said the Rocket, “and so are all my relations, even the humblest of them.
uz: Endi men uyga boraman va oilamga g'amxo'rlik qilaman.Men jamoat hayoti uchun yaratilganman, Rocket aytdi, va barcha qarindoshlarim ham shunday, hatto eng kamtarinlari ham.

en: Whenever we appear we excite great attention.
uz: Har safar paydo bo'lganimizda katta e'tiborni jalb qilamiz.

en: I have not actually appeared myself, but when I do so it will be a magniﬁ- cent sight.
uz: Aslida, men o'zim ko'rinmadim, lekin shunday bo'lganimda, bu ajoyib ko'rinish bo'ladi.

en: As for domesticity, it ages one rapidly, and distracts one’s mind from higher things.” “Ah!
uz: Uy egaligiga kelsak, u odamni tezda yoshga to'ldiradi va ongini yuqori narsalardan chalg'itadi. Ah!

en: the higher things of life, how ﬁne they are!” said the Duck; “and that reminds me how hungry I feel”: and she swam away down the stream, saying, “Quack, quack, quack.” “Come back!
uz: Hayotning oliy narsalari, naqadar chiroyli! - dedi Do'st;  va bu menga o'zimning qanchalik och bo'lganimni eslatadi: va u daryo bo'ylab suzib ketib, "Quack, quack, quack. Qo'rgin!" deb aytdi.

en: come back!” screamed the Rocket, “I have a great deal to say to you”; but the Duck paid no attention to him.
uz: Qaytib kel! - deb qichqirdi Raketa, - Men sizga aytadigan ko'p narsalarim bor, lekin Katta unga e'tibor bermadi.

en: “I am glad that she has gone,” he said to himself, “she has a decidedly middle-class mind”; and he sank a little deeper still into the mud, and began to think about the loneli- ness of genius, when suddenly two little boys in white smocks came run- ning down the bank, with a kettle and some faggots.
uz: U o'ziga shunday dedi: "O'zining o'rta sinf aqli bor ekan, men uning ketganiga xursandman, u o'ziga shunday dedi: "O'zi o'rta sinfni o'zlashtirgan", - va u ozgina chuqurroq cho'kib, g'iyriyatning yolg'izligi haqida o'ylay boshladi.

en: “This must be the deputation,” said the Rocket, and he tried to look very digniﬁed.
uz: "Bu deputatlik bo'lishi kerak", - dedi Roketa va u o'zini juda munosib ko'rishga harakat qildi.

en: “Hallo!” cried one of the boys, “look at this old stick!
uz: Halo! Bir o'g'il yig'ladi, Bu eski tayoqqa qarang!

en: I wonder how it came here”; and he picked the rocket out of the ditch.
uz: Qanday qilib u bu yerga kelganini o'ylab ko'ryapman; u esa raketani quduqdan chiqarib oldi.

en: “OLD Stick!” said the Rocket, “impossible!
uz: OLD Stick! dedi Raketa, impossible!

en: GOLD Stick, that is what he said.
uz: "GOLD Stick", deb aytgan edi u.

en: Gold Stick is very complimentary.
uz: Gold Stick juda maqtovga sazovor.

en: In fact, he mistakes me for one of the Court dignitaries!” “Let us put it into the ﬁre!” said the other boy, “it will help to boil the kettle.” So they piled the faggots together, and put the Rocket on top, and lit the ﬁre.
uz: Aslida, u meni sud mansabdorlaridan biri deb o'ylaydi!  Keling, uni olovga qo'yamiz! Boshqa yigit dedi,  Bu qovurishni qaynatishga yordam beradi. Shunday qilib, ular qovurlarni to'pladilar, Roketi ustiga qo'ydilar va olovni yoqdilar.

en: “This is magniﬁcent,” cried the Rocket, “they are going to let me off in broad day-light, so that every one can see me.” “We will go to sleep now,” they said, “and when we wake up the kettle will be boiled”; and they lay down on the grass, and shut their eyes.
uz: Bu ajoyib,  Rocket xitob qildi, ular meni kunduz yorug'ligida qo'yib yuborishadi, toki hamma meni ko'rishi mumkin. Endi uxlashga ketamiz, deyishdi, va uyg'onganimizda qozon qaynatilgan bo'ladi; ular o'tlar ustiga yotishdi va ko'zlarini yopishdi.

en: The Rocket was very damp, so he took a long time to burn.
uz: Raketa juda nam edi, shuning uchun uni yoqish uchun uzoq vaqt kerak bo'ldi.

en: At last, how- ever, the ﬁre caught him.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, qandaydir holatda, olov uni tutdi.

en: “Now I am going off!” he cried, and he made himself very stiff and straight.
uz: Endi ketyapman! - deb baqirdi u va o'zini juda qattiq va to'g'ri tutdi.

en: “I know I shall go much higher than the stars, much higher than the moon, much higher than the sun.
uz: Men yulduzlardan, oydan, quyoshdan ancha yuqoriga ko'tarilishimni bilaman.

en: In fact, I shall go so high that—”
uz: Darhaqiqat, men shunchalik yuqoriga boramanki

en: and he went straight up into the air.
uz: U to'g'ri havoga chiqib ketdi.

en: “Delightful!” he cried, “I shall go on like this for ever.
uz: U: "Men abadiy shunday bo'lib yuraman", - deb baqirdi.

en: What a success I am!” But nobody saw him.
uz: Men qanchalik muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldim! Ammo uni hech kim ko'rmagan.

en: Then he began to feel a curious tingling sensation all over him.
uz: Keyin u atrofida qiziqarli qichqiriq tuyg'usini his qila boshladi.

en: “Now I am going to explode,” he cried.
uz: Endi men portlaydiraman, - deb baqirdi u.

en: “I shall set the whole world on ﬁre, and make such a noise that nobody will talk about anything else for a whole year.”  And he certainly did explode.
uz: Men butun dunyoni olovga to'ldirib, shunga o'xshash shovqinni chiqaramanki, bir yil davomida hech kim boshqa narsa haqida gapira olmaydi. Va u albatta portladi.

en: There was no doubt about it.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu borada hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: But nobody heard him, not even the two little boys, for they were sound asleep.
uz: Lekin hech kim uni eshitmadi, hatto ikkita o'g'il ham eshitmadi, chunki ular qattiq uxlab yotgan edilar.

en: Then all that was left of him was the stick, and this fell down on the back of a Goose who was taking a walk by the side of the ditch.
uz: So'ngra undan qolgan narsa - to'qnashi edi va bu qo'zg'onning yonida yurgan g'ozning orqasidan tushdi.

en: “Good heavens!” cried the Goose.
uz: "Yomon osmonlar!" - deb qichqirdi Gʻoz.

en: “It is going to rain sticks”; and she rushed into the water.
uz: Shovqin yog'adi; va u suvga shoshdi.

en: Introduction Folklore, legends, myths and fairy tales have followed childhood through the ages, for every healthy youngster has a wholesome and instinctive love for stories fantastic, marvelous and manifestly unreal.
uz: O'smirlik davrida folklor, afsonalar, afsonalar va hikoyalar bolalikni kuzatib bormoqda, chunki har bir sog'lom yoshda ajoyib, ajoyib va aniq haqiqatsiz hikoyalarga bo'lgan sog'lom va instinktli muhabbat bor.

en: The winged fairies of Grimm and Andersen have brought more happiness to childish hearts than all other human creations.
uz: Grimm va Andersenning qanotli janoblari bolalik yuraklariga boshqa insoniy ijodlardan ko'ra ko'proq baxt keltirdi.

en: Yet the old time fairy tale, having served for generations, may now be classed as "historical" in the children's library; for the time has come for a series of newer "wonder tales" in which the stereotyped genie, dwarf and fairy are eliminated, together with all the horrible and blood-curdling incidents devised by their authors to point a fearsome moral to each tale.
uz: Ammo qadimgi afsonalar nasllar davomida xizmat qilgan bo'lsa-da, endi bolalar kutubxonasida "tarixiy" deb tan olinishi mumkin; chunki har bir afsonaga qo'rqinchli axloqiy nuqtai nazarni ko'rsatish uchun mualliflari tomonidan yaratilgan barcha dahshatli va qon to'kkan hodisalar bilan birga stereotiplashtirilgan jin, qaroq va afsonalar yo'q qilinadigan yangi "mukofot hikoyalari" seriyasining vaqti keldi.

en: Modern education includes morality; therefore the modern child seeks only entertainment in its wonder tales and gladly dispenses with all disagreeable incident.
uz: Zamonaviy ta'limda axloqiy me'yorlar ham o'z ichiga oladi; shuning uchun zamonaviy bola o'zining ajoyib hikoyalarida faqat o'yin-kulgi izlaydi va har qanday noqulay hodisalardan xursandchilik bilan voz kechadi.

en: Having this thought in mind, the story of "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz" was written solely to please children of today.
uz: Buni yodda tutgan holda, "Ozning ajoyib sehragi" hikoyasi faqat bugungi bolalar uchun yozilgan.

en: It aspires to being a modernized fairy tale, in which the wonderment and joy are retained and the heartaches and nightmares are left out.
uz: U zamonaviy masal bo'lishga intiladi, unda hayrat va quvonch saqlanib qoladi, ammo qayg'u va orzular chetda qoldiriladi.

en: Frank Baum Chicago, April, 1900.
uz: Frank Baum Chikagoda, 1900-yilning aprel oyida.

en: Chapter I The Cyclone Dorothy lived in the midst of the great Kansas prairies, with Uncle Henry, who was a farmer, and Aunt Em, who was the farmer's wife.
uz: Birinchi bob "Dorothy" shamol katta Kansas preriyalarining o'rtasida yashardi, u yerda fermer bo'lgan Onkayi Xenri va fermerning rafiqasi bo'lgan onasi Em yashardi.

en: Their house was small, for the lumber to build it had to be carried by wagon many miles.
uz: Ularning uyi kichkina edi, chunki uni qurish uchun yog'ochni ko'p kilometrlar davomida vagon bilan olib ketish kerak edi.

en: There were four walls, a floor and a roof, which made one room; and this room contained a rusty looking cookstove, a cupboard for the dishes, a table, three or four chairs, and the beds.
uz: To'rtta devor, er va tom bir xonani tashkil etgan edi; va bu xonada rang-barang ko'rinadigan oshqozon, idishlar uchun ombor, stol, uch yoki to'rtta o'rindiq va to'shaklar mavjud edi.

en: Uncle Henry and Aunt Em had a big bed in one corner, and Dorothy a little bed in another corner.
uz: Onam Xenri va onasi Emning bir burchagida katta to'shasi, Dorothy esa boshqa burchagida kichkina to'shasi bor edi.

en: There was no garret at all, and no cellar—except a small hole dug in the ground, called a cyclone cellar, where the family could go in case one of those great whirlwinds arose, mighty enough to crush any building in its path.
uz: Hech qanday garret va bodrum yo'q edi, faqat bir kichkinagina tuproq qa'ridan o'tkazilgan cho'g'idan tashqari, to'g'ri to'g'ri bo'lmagan, bu erda oila o'z yo'lida bo'lgan har qanday binoni ezib tashlashga qodir bo'lgan bu kuchli to'rqinlardan biri paydo bo'lgan taqdirda ham o'sha yerga borishi mumkin edi.

en: It was reached by a trap door in the middle of the floor, from which a ladder led down into the small, dark hole.
uz: Unga erta yerdagi tuzoq eshigidan yetib borardi, undan bir narvon kichik, qorong'u toshga tushardi.

en: When Dorothy stood in the doorway and looked around, she could see nothing but the great gray prairie on every side.
uz: Dorothy eshik oldida turib, atrofini ko'rganida, har tomondan katta bo'lak-bo'lak preriyalaridan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmagan.

en: Not a tree nor a house broke the broad sweep of flat country that reached to the edge of the sky in all directions.
uz: Hech bir daraxt ham, hech bir uy ham har tomonlama osmon chegarasiga yetib borayotgan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'lni buzmagan.

en: The sun had baked the plowed land into a gray mass, with little cracks running through it.
uz: Quyosh o'tkir yerni o'g'illar bilan o'rab olib, o'z ichiga kichik bo'g'riqlar o'tkazib yubordi.

en: Even the grass was not green, for the sun had burned the tops of the long blades until they were the same gray color to be seen everywhere.
uz: Hatto o't ham yashil bo'lmagan, chunki quyosh uzun qilichlarning ustlarini har joyda ko'rinadigan o'sha oq rangga aylantirgan edi.

en: Once the house had been painted, but the sun blistered the paint and the
uz: Bir marta uy bo'yilgan edi, lekin quyosh bo'yilgan bo'y va ko'rinishlarni qoplab qo'ydi.

en: rains washed it away, and now the house was as dull and gray as everything else.
uz: Yomg'ir uni yo'q qildi va uy endi hamma narsa kabi chiroyli va griq edi.

en: When Aunt Em came there to live she was a young, pretty wife.
uz: Em xonim o'sha yerga kelganida, u yosh va chiroyli xotin edi.

en: The sun and wind had changed her, too.
uz: Quyosh va shamol uni ham o'zgartirgan edi.

en: They had taken the sparkle from her eyes and left them a sober gray; they had taken the red from her cheeks and lips, and they were gray also.
uz: Ular uning ko'zlaridan parlashni olib, o'zlariga o'rinli oq rangni qoldirishdi; qizil rangni uning yuz va og'izlaridan olib, ular ham o'rinli o'rinni egallab olishdi.

en: She was thin and gaunt, and never smiled now.
uz: U chiroyli va g'alati edi va endi hech qachon tabassum qilmadi.

en: In the middle of a cyclone the air is generally still, but the great pressure of the wind on every side of the house raised it up higher and higher, until it was at the very top of the cyclone; and there it remained and was carried miles and miles away as easily as you could carry a feather.
uz: Shiklonning o'rtasida havo odatda to'xtab turadi, lekin uyning har tomonidagi shamolning kuchli bosimi uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'tarib, shiklonning eng yuqori tomonida bo'lguncha ko'tarib turadi; u erda u qoladi va tovuq ko'tarib olgandek kilometrlar uzoqlikda ko'tariladi.

en: Hour after hour passed away, and slowly Dorothy got over her fright; but she felt quite lonely, and the wind shrieked so loudly all about her that she nearly became deaf.
uz: Soat-soat o'tib borardi va Dorotiya asta-sekin qo'rquvidan ozod bo'ldi; lekin u o'zini juda yolg'iz his qilardi va shamol atrofida shunchalik kuchli bo'lganki, u deyarli kar bo'lib qoldi.

en: At first she had wondered if she would be dashed to pieces when the house fell again; but as the hours passed and nothing terrible happened, she stopped worrying and resolved to wait calmly and see what the future would bring.
uz: Boshida u, uy yana qulab ketganda, u parchalanib ketadimi, deb o'ylagani bor edi; lekin soatlar o'tib, hech qanday dahshatli narsa sodir bo'lmagani sayin, u tashvishlanishni to'xtatdi va tinchlik bilan kutishga va kelajakda nima bo'lishini ko'rishga qaror qildi.

en: At last she crawled over the swaying floor to her bed, and lay down upon it; and Toto followed and lay down beside her.
