en: As they walked on, the green glow became brighter and brighter, and it seemed that at last they were nearing the end of their travels.
uz: Yo'l-yo'lakay, yashil yorug'lik yanada yorqinlashib borardi va oxir-oqibat ular sayohatlarining oxiriga yaqinlashganidek tuyuldi.

en: Yet it was afternoon before they came to the great wall that surrounded the City.
uz: Ammo shaharni o'rab olgan katta devorga yetib kelishidan oldin kechki payt edi.

en: It was high and thick and of a bright green color.
uz: U baland, qalin va yorqin yashil rangda edi.

en: In front of them, and at the end of the road of yellow brick, was a big gate, all studded with emeralds that glittered so in the sun that even the painted eyes of the Scarecrow were dazzled by their brilliancy.
uz: Ularning oldida, sariq g'ishtdan yasalgan yo'lning oxirida, quyoshda shunchalik yoritib turgan zamaraldlar bilan to'ldirilgan katta darvoza bor ediki, hatto qo'rqinchlilarning bo'yilgan ko'zlari ham ularning shinamligi bilan cho'kib ketgan edi.

en: There was a bell beside the gate, and Dorothy pushed the button and heard a silvery tinkle sound within.
uz: Darvoza yonida qo'ng'iroq bor edi va Doroti tugmani bosdi va ichkarisida kumushli qichqiriq eshitdi.

en: Then the big gate swung slowly open, and they all passed through and found themselves in a high arched room, the walls of which glistened with countless emeralds.
uz: Keyin buyuk darvoza sekin-sekin ochildi va ular o'sha joydan o'tishdi va o'zlarini baland bog'li xonada topishdi, devorlari son-sanoqsiz zamarglar bilan parlashardi.

en: Before them stood a little man about the same size as the Munchkins.
uz: Ularning oldida Munchkinlar bilan teng bo'lgan kichkina odam turgan edi.

en: He was clothed all in green, from his head to his feet, and even his skin was of a greenish tint.
uz: U boshidan oyoqlarigacha butunlay yashil kiyimda edi va hatto teri ham yashil rangga ega edi.

en: At his side was a large green box.
uz: Uning yonida katta yashil quti bor edi.

en: When he saw Dorothy and her companions the man asked, "What do you wish in the Emerald City?" "We came here to see the Great Oz," said Dorothy.
uz: U Doroti va uning do'stlarini ko'rganida: "Smerald shahrida nima istaysiz?" - deb so'radi.Doroti: "Biz Buyuk Ozni ko'rish uchun keldik", - dedi.

en: The man was so surprised at this answer that he sat down to think it over.
uz: Bu javobga odam shunchalik hayron bo'ldiki, o'tirib o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: "It has been many years since anyone asked me to see Oz," he said, shaking his head in perplexity.
uz: "Ozni ko'rishni hech kim so'ramaganidan ko'p yillar o'tdi", - dedi u hayajonda boshini silkitib.

en: "He is powerful and terrible, and
uz: "U kuchli va dahshatli, va

en: if you come on an idle or foolish errand to bother the wise reflections of the Great Wizard, he might be angry and destroy you all in an instant." "But it is not a foolish errand, nor an idle one," replied the Scarecrow; "it is important.
uz: Agar siz buyuk sehrgarning dono fikrlarini chalg'itish uchun bepul yoki ahmoqlik bilan harakat qilsangiz, u g'azablanib, sizni bir daqiqada yo'q qiladi". - Ammo bu bepul yoki bepul ish emas, - dedi qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli. - Bu muhim.

en: And we have been told that Oz is a good Wizard." "So he is," said the green man, "and he rules the Emerald City wisely and well.
uz: Bizga Ozning yaxshi sehrgar ekanligi aytilmoqda. "U shunday, - dedi yashil odam, - va u Emerald Cityni dono va yaxshi boshqaradi.

en: But to those who are not honest, or who approach him from curiosity, he is most terrible, and few have ever dared ask to see his face.
uz: Ammo rostgo'y bo'lmaganlar yoki qiziquvchanlik tufayli unga yaqinlashadiganlar uchun u juda dahshatli va kamchilik uning yuzini ko'rish uchun so'rashga jur'at qilgan.

en: I am the Guardian of the Gates, and since you demand to see the Great Oz I must take you to his Palace.
uz: Men eshiklarning himoyachisi bo'laman va siz Buyuk Ozni ko'rishni talab qilayotganingiz uchun men sizni uning saroyiga olib borishim kerak.

en: But first you must put on the spectacles." "Why?" asked Dorothy.
uz: Ammo avval ko'zguvchlarni kiyishingiz kerak". - "Nega?" deb so'radi Dorotsiya.

en: "Because if you did not wear spectacles the brightness and glory of the Emerald City would blind you.
uz: "Agar ko'zoynak kiymasangiz, Esmerald shahrining yorug'ligi va ulug'vorligi sizni ko'r qilib qo'yadi.

en: Even those who live in the City must wear spectacles night and day.
uz: Hatto Shaharda yashovchilar ham kechayu kunduz ko'z ko'zlarini kiyishlari kerak.

en: They are all locked on, for Oz so ordered it when the City was first built, and I have the only key that will unlock them." He opened the big box, and Dorothy saw that it was filled with spectacles of every size and shape.
uz: Ularning barchasi qulflab qo'yilgan, chunki O'z shahar qurilganida buni buyurgan edi va men ularning qulfini ochadigan yagona kalitim bor". U katta qutini ochdi va Doroti u har xil o'lcham va shaklda ko'z ko'zlar bilan to'lganini ko'rdi.

en: All of them had green glasses in them.
uz: Ularning barchasida yashil oynalar bor edi.

en: The Guardian of the Gates found a pair that would just fit Dorothy and put them over her eyes.
uz: The Guardian of the Gates Dorothyga mos keladigan juftlik topib, ularni uning ko'zlariga qo'ydi.

en: There were two golden bands fastened to them that passed around the back of her head, where they were locked together by a little key that was at the end of a chain the Guardian of the Gates wore around his neck.
uz: Uning boshining orqasidan o'tgan ikkita oltin to'plam ularga bog'langan edi va bu to'plamlar uning bo'yni atrofida bo'lgan eshiklarning himoyachisi bo'lgan zanjirning oxirida joylashgan kichkina kalit bilan bir-biriga qulflab qo'yilgan edi.

en: When they were on, Dorothy could not take them off had she wished, but of course she did not wish to be blinded by the glare of the Emerald City, so she said nothing.
uz: Ular o'rnatilganida, Doroti xohlaganida ularni olib tashlay olmasdi, lekin, albatta, u Emerald Cityning yorqinligi bilan ko'r bo'lishni istamasdi, shuning uchun u hech narsa aytmadi.

en: Then the green man fitted spectacles for the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman and the Lion, and even on little Toto; and all were locked fast with the key.
uz: So'ngra yashil odam Qo'rqinchli, Tin Woodman, Arslon va hatto kichik Toto uchun ko'zoynaklar o'rnatdi va ularning barchasi kalit bilan tezda qulflab qo'yildi.

en: Then the Guardian of the Gates put on his own glasses and told them he was ready to show them to the Palace.
uz: So'ngra eshiklar himoyachisi o'z ko'z ko'zlari bilan ko'zlarini kiyib, ularni Sarvari Olamga ko'rsatishga tayyor ekanini aytdi.

en: key from a peg on the wall, he opened another gate, and they all followed him through the portal into the streets of the Emerald City.
uz: U devordagi kalitdan boshqa darvoza ochdi va ular hammasi uning orqasidan Emerald City ko'chalariga o'tib ketishdi.

en: Chapter XI The Wonderful City of Oz Even with eyes protected by the green spectacles, Dorothy and her friends were at first dazzled by the brilliancy of the wonderful City.
uz: XI bob Ozning go'zal shahri Darhaqiqat, yashil ko'z ko'zlari bilan Dorothy va uning do'stlari birinchi navbatda go'zal shaharning chiroyli ko'rinishiga hayratda qolishdi.

en: The streets were lined with beautiful houses all built of green marble and studded everywhere with sparkling emeralds.
uz: Ko'chalar yashil marmordan qurilgan go'zal uylar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi va hamma joyda parcha-parcha esmeraldlar bilan qoplangan edi.

en: They walked over a pavement of the same green marble, and where the blocks were joined together were rows of emeralds, set closely, and glittering in the brightness of the sun.
uz: Ular bir xil yashil marmordan yasalgan piyoda bo'ylab o'tishdi va bloklar bir-biriga qo'shilgan joyda yaqin joyda joylashgan, quyoshning porlashiga qaraganda parcha-parcha bo'lgan zamaraldlar qatorlari bor edi.

en: The window panes were of green glass; even the sky above the City had a green tint, and the rays of the sun were green.
uz: Oynalar yashil shisha bilan qurilgan edi; hatto shaharning osmonlari yashil rangga ega edi va quyosh nurlari yashil rangga ega edi.

en: There were many people—men, women, and children—walking about, and these were all dressed in green clothes and had greenish skins.
uz: Bu yerda erkaklar, ayollar va bolalar ko'p bo'lib yurishgan va ularning barchasi yashil kiyim kiygan va ko'krakli teriga ega edilar.

en: They looked at Dorothy and her strangely assorted company with wondering eyes, and the children all ran away and hid behind their mothers when they saw the Lion; but no one spoke to them.
uz: Ular Dorothy va uning g'alati qo'shnilariga hayratda qolgan ko'zlar bilan qarab turishdi va bolalarning hammasi sherni ko'rganlarida, onalari orqasidan yashirinib qochib ketishdi, lekin hech kim ularga gapirmadi.

en: Many shops stood in the street, and Dorothy saw that everything in them was green.
uz: Ko'chada ko'plab do'konlar bor edi va Doroti ulardagi hamma narsa yashil ekanligini ko'rdi.

en: Green candy and green pop corn were offered for sale, as well as green shoes, green hats, and green clothes of all sorts.
uz: Yashil shirinlik va yashil pop-mashna, shuningdek, yashil poyabzallar, yashil to'pkalar va har qanday yashil kiyim-kechaklar sotildi.

en: At one place a man was selling green lemonade, and when the children bought it Dorothy could see that they paid for it with green pennies.
uz: Bir joyda bir kishi yashil limonad sotar edi va bolalar uni sotib olganda, Doroti ular uchun yashil pul to'laganini ko'rdi.

en: There seemed to be no horses nor animals of any kind; the men carried things around in little green carts, which they pushed before them.
uz: Hech qanday ot yoki hayvon yo'qdek ko'rinardi; erkaklar narsalarni kichik yashil aravalarda olib yurishgan va ularni o'zlarining oldinga itishgan.

en: Everyone seemed happy and contented and prosperous.
uz: Hamma baxtli, qoniqarli va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: The Guardian of the Gates led them through the streets until they came to a big building, exactly in the middle of the City, which was the Palace of Oz, the Great Wizard.
uz: Darvozalar himoyachisi ularni ko'chalar orqali olib bordi va shaharning o'rtasida joylashgan katta binoga yetib keldilar, bu esa Buyuk sehrgar Oz saroyi edi.

en: There was a soldier before the door, dressed in a green uniform and wearing a long green beard.
uz: Eshik oldida yashil uniform kiyib, uzun yashil soqol kiygan bir askar turgan edi.

en: "Here are strangers," said the Guardian of the Gates to him, "and they demand to see the Great Oz." "Step inside," answered the soldier, "and I will carry your message to him." So they passed through the Palace Gates and were led into a big room with a green carpet and lovely green furniture set with emeralds.
uz: "Boshqa odamlar bor", - dedi darvozalar qo'riqchisi unga, "va ular Buyuk Ozni ko'rishni talab qiladilar". - "Inga kiring", - dedi askar, "va men unga xabaringizni yetkazaman". - Shunday qilib, ular Sarvari darvozalaridan o'tib, yashil cho'tka va zamaraldlar bilan mo'ljallangan go'zal yashil mebelli katta xonaniga olib borildilar.

en: The soldier made them all wipe their feet upon a green mat before entering this room, and when they were seated he said politely: "Please make yourselves comfortable while I go to the door of the Throne Room and tell Oz you are here." They had to wait a long time before the soldier returned.
uz: Askar bu xonaga kirishdan oldin ularning barchasini yashil matda bilan yuvishtirdi va ular o'tirganida u xushmuomalalik bilan shunday dedi: "Ido'stlik xonasining eshiklariga borib, Ozga sizning kelishingiz haqida aytsam, o'zingizni qulay qilib ko'ringlar". Askar qaytib kelishidan oldin ular ko'p vaqt kutishlari kerak edi.

en: When, at last, he came back, Dorothy asked: "Have you seen Oz?" "Oh, no," returned the soldier; "I have never seen him.
uz: Nihoyat, u qaytib kelganida, Doroti: "Ozni ko'rganmisiz?" - deb so'radi. - Yo'q, yo'q, - dedi askar. - Men uni hech qachon ko'rmaganman.

en: But I spoke to him as he sat behind his screen and gave him your message.
uz: Lekin men u ekrani ortida o'tirganida unga gapirib, xabaringizni berdim.

en: He said he will grant you an audience, if you so desire; but each one of you must enter his presence alone, and he will admit but one each day.
uz: Agar siz xohlasangiz, u sizga tinglovchilar berishini aytdi, lekin har biringiz o'z huzuringizga yolg'iz kirishingiz kerak va u har kuni faqat bir kishini qabul qiladi.

en: Therefore, as you must remain in the Palace for several days, I will have you shown to rooms where you may rest in comfort after your journey." "Thank you," replied the girl; "that is very kind of Oz." The soldier now blew upon a green whistle, and at once a young girl, dressed in a pretty green silk gown, entered the room.
uz: Shuning uchun, siz bir necha kun saroyda qolishingiz kerak bo'lganligi sababli, men sayohatingizdan keyin qulay dam olishingiz mumkin bo'lgan xonalarni ko'rsataman". - "Rahmat", - dedi qiz; "bu juda yaxshi Oz. - "Soldat endi yashil pishirgan va birdan juda yashil ipak kiyim kiygan yosh qiz xonaga kirdi.

en: lovely green hair and green eyes, and she bowed low before Dorothy as she said, "Follow me and I will show you your room." So Dorothy said good-bye to all her friends except Toto, and taking the dog in her arms followed the green girl through seven passages and up three flights of stairs until they came to a room at the front of the Palace.
uz: U Dorothyga: "Mening orqamdan ergashing, senga o'z xonangni ko'rsataman", - deb aytdi. Shunday qilib, Dorothy To'todan tashqari barcha do'stlariga salom berdi va itni qo'liga olib, yashil qizni yetti yo'ldan va uch qavatdan uch qavatgacha kuzatib bordi.

en: It was the sweetest little room in the world, with a soft comfortable bed that had sheets of green silk and a green velvet counterpane.
uz: Bu dunyodagi eng sevimli kichik xona edi, u yumshoq, qulay yotoq bilan yashil ipak va yashil samutli konterpan bilan qoplangan edi.

en: There was a tiny fountain in the middle of the room, that shot a spray of green perfume into the air, to fall back into a beautifully carved green marble basin.
uz: Xonaning o'rtasida kichkina buloq bor edi, u yelkaga yashil parfümni shishtirib, go'zal o'ralgan yashil marmor hovuzga qaytadi.

en: Beautiful green flowers stood in the windows, and there was a shelf with a row of little green books.
uz: Oynalarda go'zal yashil gullar bor edi va shelfda kichik yashil kitoblar qatorida edi.

en: When Dorothy had time to open these books she found them full of queer green pictures that made her laugh, they were so funny.
uz: Doroti bu kitoblarni ochishga vaqt topganida, ularni o'zini kulishga undaydigan kichkinagina yashil rasmlar bilan to'ldirdi, ular juda qiziqarli edi.

en: In a wardrobe were many green dresses, made of silk and satin and velvet; and all of them fitted Dorothy exactly.
uz: Kiyim xonadonida ipak, satin va samutdan yasalgan ko'plab yashil kiyimlar bor edi va ularning barchasi Dorotiga to'g'ri mos kelardi.

en: "Make yourself perfectly at home," said the green girl, "and if you wish for anything ring the bell.
uz: "O'zingizni mukammal uyda ko'rsating", dedi yashil qiz, "agar biror narsa istasangiz, qo'ng'iroq qiling.

en: Oz will send for you tomorrow morning." She left Dorothy alone and went back to the others.
uz: Ertaga ertalab seni chaqirtirib yuboraman". - deb aytdi u, Dorothyni yolg'iz qoldirib, boshqalarga qaytdi.

en: These she also led to rooms, and each one of them found himself lodged in a very pleasant part of the Palace.
uz: Bularni ham xonalarga olib boradi va ularning har biri o'zini saroyning juda yoqimli bir qismida joylashtirgan.

en: Of course this politeness was wasted on the Scarecrow; for when he found himself alone in his room he stood stupidly in one spot, just within the doorway, to wait till morning.
uz: Albatta, bu xushmuomalalik Qo'rqinchli bilan behuda sarflandi; chunki u o'z xonasida yolg'iz bo'lganida, ertalabgacha kutish uchun bir joyda, darvoza yonida o'zini ahmoqona tutdi.

en: It would not rest him to lie down, and he could not close his eyes; so he remained all night staring at a little spider which was weaving its web in a corner of the room, just as if it were not one of the most wonderful rooms in the world.
uz: U o'tirishni istamaydi va ko'zlarini yopolmaydi; shuning uchun u butun kecha o'z to'pini xonaning bir burchagida to'sib yurgan kichkina o'rnakni ko'rib turardi, xuddi dunyodagi eng ajoyib xonalardan biri bo'lmaganidek.

en: The Tin Woodman lay down on his bed from force of habit, for he remembered when he was made of flesh; but not being able to sleep, he passed the night moving his joints up and down to make sure they kept in good working order.
uz: Tin Woodman odat kuchi bilan o'z yotoqxonasiga yotdi, chunki u o'zining go'shtdan yasalganini esladi; lekin uxlay olmaganligi uchun u o'z qo'shilmalarini yuqoriga va pastga ko'chirishni o'tkazdi, chunki ular yaxshi ishlashiga ishonch hosil qildi.

en: The Lion would have preferred a bed of dried leaves in the forest, and did not like being shut up in a room; but he had too much sense to let this worry him, so he
uz: Arslon o'rmondagi quritilgan barglardan iborat yotoqni afzal ko'rgan bo'lardi va xonaga qo'yilishni yoqtirmagan bo'lardi; lekin u bu haqda tashvishlanishiga yo'l qo'ymaydigan darajada aqlli edi, shuning uchun u o'zini tashvishlantirgan.

en: sprang upon the bed and rolled himself up like a cat and purred himself asleep in a minute.
uz: Yotoq ustiga tushib, mushuk kabi o'zini yig'ib, bir daqiqada uxlab ketdi.

en: The next morning, after breakfast, the green maiden came to fetch Dorothy, and she dressed her in one of the prettiest gowns, made of green brocaded satin.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, kechki ovqatdan so'ng, yashil qiz Dorothyni olib keldi va unga yashil brokatlangan satindan yasalgan eng chiroyli liboslardan birini kiydirdi.

en: Dorothy put on a green silk apron and tied a green ribbon around Toto's neck, and they started for the Throne Room of the Great Oz.
uz: Doroti yashil ipak shkaf kiygan va Toto bo'yniga yashil lenta bog'lagan va ular Buyuk Ozning taxti xonasiga borishdi.

en: First they came to a great hall in which were many ladies and gentlemen of the court, all dressed in rich costumes.
uz: Avval ular katta zalga keldilar, unda ko'plab xonimlar va hovli a'zolari bo'lib, barchasi boy kostyumlarda kiyinishgan.

en: These people had nothing to do but talk to each other, but they always came to wait outside the Throne Room every morning, although they were never permitted to see Oz.
uz: Bu odamlar bir-birlari bilan suhbatlashishdan boshqa hech qanday ish ko'rmagan, lekin har kuni ertalab ular har kuni Arshi A'loxonasi tashqarisida kutib turishardi, garchi ularga hech qachon Ozni ko'rish ruxsat etilmagan bo'lsa ham.

en: As Dorothy entered they looked at her curiously, and one of them whispered: "Are you really going to look upon the face of Oz the Terrible?" "Of course," answered the girl, "if he will see me." "Oh, he will see you," said the soldier who had taken her message to the Wizard, "although he does not like to have people ask to see him.
uz: Dorotsiya kirganida, ular qiziqarli tarzda unga qarab turishdi va ulardan biri: "Siz haqiqatan ham Oz dahshatli odamning yuzini ko'rasizmi?" - deb g'ayrat bilan aytdi. - Albatta, - dedi qizcha, - agar u meni ko'rsa. - Oh, u sizni ko'radi, - dedi sehrgarga xabarini olib ketgan askar, - ammo u odamlarning uni ko'rishni so'rashlarini yoqtirmaydi.

en: Indeed, at first he was angry and said I should send you back where you came from.
uz: Darhaqiqat, boshida u g'azablanib, seni qayerdan kelganingga qaytarib yuborishimni aytdi.

en: Then he asked me what you looked like, and when I mentioned your silver shoes he was very much interested.
uz: So'ngra u mendan qanday ko'rinishingizni so'radi va men sizning kumush poyabzallaringizni aytib berganimda, u juda qiziqdi.

en: At last I told him about the mark upon your forehead, and he decided he would admit you to his presence." Just then a bell rang, and the green girl said to Dorothy, "That is the signal.
uz: Nihoyat men unga oldingdagi belgi haqida aytib berdim va u seni o'z huzurida qabul qilishga qaror qildi". O'sha paytda qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroq qildi va yashil qiz Dorothyga: "Bu signal.

en: You must go into the Throne Room alone." She opened a little door and Dorothy walked boldly through and found herself in a wonderful place.
uz: Siz yolg'iz taxt xonasida kirishingiz kerak". U kichkina eshikni ochdi va Doroti jasorat bilan o'sha xonada o'zini ajoyib joyda topdi.

en: It was a big, round room with a high arched roof, and the walls and ceiling and floor were covered with large emeralds set closely together.
uz: Bu katta, davraliy xonadir, yuqori bo'g'li tom bilan, devorlar, ustun va pol katta zamirlar bilan qoplangan edi.

en: In the center of the roof was a great light, as bright as the sun, which made the emeralds sparkle in a wonderful manner.
uz: Uyning markazida quyosh singari kuchli nur paydo bo'lgan va bu zamaraldlar ajoyib tarzda parlashardi.

en: But what interested Dorothy most was the big throne of green marble that stood in the middle of the room.
uz: Ammo Dorotiyani eng ko'p qiziqtirgan narsa - xonaning o'rtasida turgan yirik yashil marmorli taxti edi.

en: It was shaped like a
uz: Bu birga o'xshash shaklda edi.

en: chair and sparkled with gems, as did everything else.
uz: O'rindiq va marvaridlar bilan parcha-parcha bo'lgan, boshqa hamma narsa kabi.

en: In the center of the chair was an enormous Head, without a body to support it or any arms or legs whatever.
uz: Arqonning markazida ulkan bosh bor edi, uni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan badan yoki qo'llar yoki oyoqlar yo'q edi.

en: There was no hair upon this head, but it had eyes and a nose and mouth, and was much bigger than the head of the biggest giant.
uz: Bu boshda sochlar yo'q edi, lekin u ko'zlar, burun va og'zi bor edi va eng yirik oltin boshidan ancha kattaroq edi.

en: As Dorothy gazed upon this in wonder and fear, the eyes turned slowly and looked at her sharply and steadily.
uz: Doroti bu voqeaga hayron va qo'rqqan holda qaraganida, uning ko'zlari sekin-sakin o'zgarib, uni keskin va qat'iy ko'rib turdi.

en: Then the mouth moved, and Dorothy heard a voice say: "I am Oz, the Great and Terrible.
uz: Keyin og'iz harakatlandi va Doroti ovozni eshitdi: "Men Oz, buyuk va dahshatli odamman.

en: Who are you, and why do you seek me?" It was not such an awful voice as she had expected to come from the big Head; so she took courage and answered: "I am Dorothy, the Small and Meek.
uz: Siz kimsiz va nima uchun meni qidiryapsiz?" - degan so'z u katta boshdan kelishini kutgandek dahshatli emas edi; shuning uchun u jasoratga to'lib, shunday javob berdi: "Men Dorothy, Kichik va Yumshoqman.

en: I have come to you for help." The eyes looked at her thoughtfully for a full minute.
uz: Men sening yordangga keldim". - deb, ko'zlari butun bir daqiqa davomida unga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: Then said the voice: "Where did you get the silver shoes?" "I got them from the Wicked Witch of the East, when my house fell on her and killed her," she replied.
uz: So'ngra ovoz: "Qumush poyabzallarni qayerdan olding?" - deb so'radi. - Men ularni Sharqning yovuz sehrgaridan oldim, chunki uyim uning ustiga tushib, uni o'ldirgan edi", - deb javob berdi u.

en: "Where did you get the mark upon your forehead?" continued the voice.
uz: "Qayerdan moyningdagi belgiga ega bo'lding?" - deb davom etdi ovoz.

en: "That is where the Good Witch of the North kissed me when she bade me good-bye and sent me to you," said the girl.

en: "I will go too," declared the Scarecrow; "but I shall not be of much help to you, I am such a fool." "I haven't the heart to harm even a Witch," remarked the Tin Woodman; "but if you go I certainly shall go with you." Therefore it was decided to start upon their journey the next morning, and the Woodman sharpened his axe on a green grindstone and had all his joints properly oiled.

Shuning uchun ertasi kuni ertalab ularning sayohatini boshlashga qaror qilindi, va Woodman o'z pichoqini yashil mo'ljallangan tosh ustiga o'tkazib, barcha qo'shmalarini to'g'ri moy bilan moylashdi.

en: The Scarecrow stuffed himself with fresh straw and Dorothy put new paint on his eyes that he might see better.
uz: Qo'rqinchli o'zini yangi soya bilan to'ldirdi va Doroti ko'zlariga ko'rinishi uchun yangi bo'yoq qo'ydi.

en: The green girl, who was very kind to them, filled Dorothy's basket with good things to eat, and fastened a little bell around Toto's neck with a green ribbon.
uz: Ular bilan juda mehribon bo'lgan yashil qiz Dorotining koshini yaxshi ovqat bilan to'ldirdi va Toto bo'yniga yashil qo'shiq bilan kichkina qo'ng'iroqni bog'ladi.

en: They went to bed quite early and slept soundly until daylight, when they were awakened by the crowing of a green cock that lived in the back yard of the Palace, and the cackling of a hen that had laid a green egg.
uz: Ular juda erta uxlab ketishdi va kun yorug' bo'lgunga qadar qattiq uxlashdi, so'ng ular Sarvarxonaning yotoq xonasida yashovchi yashil pichoqning qichqirishidan va yashil tuxum qo'ygan tovuqning qichqirishidan uyg'onishdi.

en: Chapter XII The Search for the Wicked Witch The soldier with the green whiskers led them through the streets of the Emerald City until they reached the room where the Guardian of the Gates lived.
uz: XII bob Yovuz sehrgarni qidirish Yashil pichoqlarni ko'chalar orqali olib borgan askar, ular Esmerald shahrining qo'riqchisi yashaydigan xonaniga yetguncha, ularni yo'naltirdi.

en: This officer unlocked their spectacles to put them back in his great box, and then he politely opened the gate for our friends.
uz: Bu ofitser ularning ko'zoynaklarini ochib, ularni katta qutisiga qo'ydi va keyin do'stlarimiz uchun darvozani xushmuomalalik bilan ochdi.

en: "Which road leads to the Wicked Witch of the West?" asked Dorothy.
uz: "Qayer yo'l G'arbning yovuz sehrgarisiga olib boradi?" - deb so'radi Dorotsiya.

en: "There is no road," answered the Guardian of the Gates.
uz: "Yo'l yo'q", deb javob berdi "Guardian of the Gates".

en: "No one ever wishes to go that way." "How, then, are we to find her?" inquired the girl.
uz: - Hech kim o'sha yo'ldan borishni istamaydi. - Unda uni qanday topamiz? - deb so'radi qiz.

en: "That will be easy," replied the man, "for when she knows you are in the country of the Winkies she will find you, and make you all her slaves." "Perhaps not," said the Scarecrow, "for we mean to destroy her." "Oh, that is different," said the Guardian of the Gates.
uz: - Bu oson bo'ladi, - deb javob berdi yigit, - chunki u sizning Winkies mamlakatida ekanligingizni bilganda sizni topib, sizni barcha qullariga aylantiradi. - Ehtimol, yo'q, - dedi qo'rqinchli, - chunki biz uni yo'q qilishni xohlaymiz.

en: "No one has ever destroyed her before, so I naturally thought she would make slaves of you, as she has of the rest.
uz: Hech kim uni ilgari yo'q qilib bo'lmagandi, shuning uchun men tabiiy ravishda o'zimni sizlarni, qolganlarni ham qul qilib oladi deb o'yladim.

en: But take care; for she is wicked and fierce, and may not allow you to destroy her.
uz: Ammo ehtiyot bo'ling; chunki u yovuz va shafqatsiz va uni yo'q qilishingizga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: Keep to the West, where the sun sets, and you cannot fail to find her."
uz: G'arbga, quyosh botgan joyga qarab turing va uni topishdan bosh tortmaysiz".

en: They thanked him and bade him good-bye, and turned toward the West, walking over fields of soft grass dotted here and there with daisies and buttercups.
uz: Ular unga minnatdorchilik bildirib, salom aytishdi va G'arbga qarab, bu yerda-bu yerda qizil va ko'kraklar bilan to'la bo'lgan yumshoq o'tlar maydonlari ustidan yurishdi.

en: Dorothy still wore the pretty silk dress she had put on in the palace, but now, to her surprise, she found it was no longer green, but pure white.
uz: Doroti hali ham saroyda kiygan go'zal ipak kiyimini kiygan edi, lekin endi u o'zini hayratda qoldirib, ko'rdiki, u endi yashil emas, balki sof oq.

en: The ribbon around Toto's neck had also lost its green color and was as white as Dorothy's dress.
uz: Toto bo'yni atrofidagi lent ham yashil rangini yo'qotgan edi va Dorothy kiyimidek oq edi.

en: The Emerald City was soon left far behind.
uz: "Emerald shahar" tez orada orqada qolgan.

en: As they advanced the ground became rougher and hillier, for there were no farms nor houses in this country of the West, and the ground was untilled.
uz: Ular qadam bosgan sayin, yer qattiqroq va balandroq bo'ldi, chunki G'arb mamlakatida ne fermalar, ne uylar bor edi va yer to'g'rilashdi.

en: In the afternoon the sun shone hot in their faces, for there were no trees to offer them shade; so that before night Dorothy and Toto and the Lion were tired, and lay down upon the grass and fell asleep, with the Woodman and the Scarecrow keeping watch.
uz: Tush paytida ularning yuzalarida quyosh issiqligi porlab turardi, chunki ularga soya beradigan daraxtlar yo'q edi; shuning uchun kechadan oldin Doroti, Toto va Arslon charchagan va o'tlar ustiga yotgan va uxlagan edilar.

en: Now the Wicked Witch of the West had but one eye, yet that was as powerful as a telescope, and could see everywhere.
uz: G'arbning yovuz sehrgarining bitta ko'zi bor edi, ammo u teleskop kabi kuchli va hamma joyni ko'ra oladi.

en: So, as she sat in the door of her castle, she happened to look around and saw Dorothy lying asleep, with her friends all about her.
uz: Qolining eshigida o'tirganida, atrofini ko'rib, Dorothyni do'stlari bilan birga uxlab yotganini ko'rdi.

en: They were a long distance off, but the Wicked Witch was angry to find them in her country; so she blew upon a silver whistle that hung around her neck.
uz: Ular uzoq yo'lda edilar, lekin Yovuz sehrgar ularni o'z yurtida topib, g'azabga to'ldi; shuning uchun o'z bo'yni atrofida osilgan kumush pishirgan.

en: At once there came running to her from all directions a pack of great wolves.
uz: Birdan unga har tarafdan katta bo'ri to'pasi yugurib keldi.

en: They had long legs and fierce eyes and sharp teeth.
uz: Ularning oyoqlari uzun, ko'zlari qattiq va tishlari o'tkir edi.

en: "Go to those people," said the Witch, "and tear them to pieces." "Are you not going to make them your slaves?" asked the leader of the wolves.
uz: "O'sha odamlarning oldiga borib, ularni parchalatib tashlanglar", - dedi sehrgar. "Ularni qul qilib o'tkazmaysanmi?" - deb so'radi bo'rilar boshlig'i.

en: "No," she answered, "one is of tin, and one of straw; one is a girl and another a Lion.
uz: - Yo'q, - deb javob berdi u, - biri qalin, biri cho'g'dan, biri qiz, boshqasi sher.

en: None of them is fit to work, so you may tear them into small pieces." "Very well," said the wolf, and he dashed away at full speed, followed by the others.
uz: Ularning hech biri ishlashga yaroqsiz emas, shuning uchun siz ularni kichik bo'lak-bo'lak qilib yirtib yuborishingiz mumkin". - "To'g'ri, - dedi bo'ri va u to'liq tezlikda yugurib ketdi, qolganlari esa uning orqasidan ergashdi.

en: It was lucky the Scarecrow and the Woodman were wide awake and heard the wolves coming.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, qo'rqinchli va o'simlik o'g'li uyg'onib, bo'rilarning kelishini eshitishdi.

en: "This is my fight," said the Woodman, "so get behind me and I will meet them as they come." He seized his axe, which he had made very sharp, and as the leader of the wolves came on the Tin Woodman swung his arm and chopped the wolf's head from its body, so that it immediately died.
uz: "Bu mening jangim", - dedi Vudman, "shuning uchun orqamdan ergashinglar, ular kelganda men ularni uchrataman". U o'zining o'tkir qilib qo'ygan o'g'lini ushlab oldi va bo'rilarning boshlig'i bo'g'iga yaqinlashganda, Tin Vudman qo'lini o'zgartirib, bo'ri boshini uning tanasi bilan kesib tashladi va u darhol o'ldi.

en: As soon as he could raise his axe another wolf came up, and he also fell under the sharp edge of the Tin Woodman's weapon.
uz: O'z o'rnini ko'targanida, yana bir qurt paydo bo'ldi va u ham Tin Woodman qurolining o'tkir o'qi ostida tushib qoldi.

en: There were forty wolves, and forty times a wolf was killed, so that at last they all lay dead in a heap before the Woodman.
uz: Oʻrtak boʻri bor edi va qirq marta boʻri oʻldirilgan edi, nihoyat, ular hammasi oʻlik boʻlib oʻtirgan edi.

en: Then he put down his axe and sat beside the Scarecrow, who said, "It was a good fight, friend." They waited until Dorothy awoke the next morning.
uz: So'ngra o'z baltini qo'yib, qo'rqinchli qo'ng'iroqning yonida o'tirdi va u: "Bu yaxshi jang edi, do'stim" dedi.

en: The little girl was quite frightened when she saw the great pile of shaggy wolves, but the Tin Woodman told her all.
uz: Qiz ulkan boʻri toʻplamini koʻrganida juda qoʻrqqan edi, lekin Tin Woodman unga hamma narsani aytib berdi.

en: She thanked him for saving them and sat down to breakfast, after which they started again upon their journey.
uz: U ularni qutqargani uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirdi va kechki ovqatga o'tirdi, so'ng esa ular sayohatni davom ettirishdi.

en: Now this same morning the Wicked Witch came to the door of her castle and looked out with her one eye that could see far off.
uz: Shu ertalab Yovuz sehrgar o'z qal'asi eshiklariga kelib, uzoqdan ko'ra oladigan bir ko'zi bilan tashqariga qaradi.

en: She saw all her wolves lying dead, and the strangers still traveling through her country.
uz: U o'z bo'rilarining o'lib ketayotganini va begonalarning o'z yurtida sayohat qilayotganini ko'rdi.

en: This made her angrier than before, and she blew her silver whistle twice.
uz: Bu uni avvalgidan ko'ra g'azablanishiga sabab bo'ldi va u ikki marta kumush pishirgan.

en: Straightway a great flock of wild crows came flying toward her, enough to darken the sky.
uz: To'g'ri yo'lda unga yaqinlashib, osmonni qorong'u qilish uchun etarlicha katta bo'lgan yovvoyi qahvalar to'plami uchib keldi.

en: And the Wicked Witch said to the King Crow, "Fly at once to the strangers; peck out their eyes and tear them to pieces." The wild crows flew in one great flock toward Dorothy and her companions.
uz: Yovuz sehrgar shoh qo'rg'oqqa: "Birdan begonalarga uchib ket, ularning ko'zlarini kesib, ularni parchalab tashla", - dedi.

en: When the little girl saw them coming she was afraid.
uz: Kichik qizcha ularni kelayotganini ko'rganida qo'rqqan.

en: But the Scarecrow said, "This is my battle, so lie down beside me and you will not be harmed." So they all lay upon the ground except the Scarecrow, and he stood up and stretched out his arms.
uz: Ammo qo'rqinchli: "Bu mening jangim, shuning uchun yonimda o'tiring va sizga hech qanday zarar yetmaydi", - dedi.Shunday qilib, qo'rqinchlidan tashqari hamma yerga yiqildi va u o'rnidan turib qo'llarini uzatdi.

en: And when the crows saw him
uz: Qurtlar uni ko'rganlarida,

en: they were frightened, as these birds always are by scarecrows, and did not dare to come any nearer.
uz: Ular qo'rqib qolar edilar, chunki bu qushlar doimo qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli.

en: But the King Crow said: "It is only a stuffed man.
uz: Ammo Qoraq shoh: "Bu faqat to'ldirilgan odam.

en: I will peck his eyes out." The King Crow flew at the Scarecrow, who caught it by the head and twisted its neck until it died.
uz: Men uning ko'zlarini o'chirib yuboraman". - deb so'zlagan shoh qo'rg'osi qo'rqinchli qo'rg'onning boshiga tushib, bo'yinini o'limgacha burib qo'ydi.

en: And then another crow flew at him, and the Scarecrow twisted its neck also.
uz: Keyin yana bir qo'rg'on unga uchdi va qo'rqinchli qo'rg'on ham bo'ynini burib yubordi.

en: There were forty crows, and forty times the Scarecrow twisted a neck, until at last all were lying dead beside him.
uz: U yerda qirq qo'rqoq bor edi va qo'rqinch qirq marta bo'yinni burib qo'ydi, nihoyat ularning barchasi uning yonida o'lik yotgan edi.

en: Then he called to his companions to rise, and again they went upon their journey.
uz: So'ngra u o'z hamrohlariga o'rnidan turishga chaqirdi va ular yana yo'lga chiqdilar.

en: When the Wicked Witch looked out again and saw all her crows lying in a heap, she got into a terrible rage, and blew three times upon her silver whistle.
uz: Yovuz sehrgar yana ko'rib, qo'rqoqlarining to'plamda yotganini ko'rganida, u dahshatli g'azabga tushdi va kumush pishirganida uch marta urdi.

en: Forthwith there was heard a great buzzing in the air, and a swarm of black bees came flying toward her.
uz: Shundan so'ng havoda katta bir shovqin eshitildi va qora onaklar to'plami unga o'xshaydigan bo'ldi.

en: "Go to the strangers and sting them to death!" commanded the Witch, and the bees turned and flew rapidly until they came to where Dorothy and her friends were walking.
uz: "Boshqalarga boringlar va ularni o'ldiringlar!" - deb buyurdi sehrgar, u esa Dorothy va uning do'stlari yurgan joyga yetguncha, orqaga burib, tez uzib ketdi.

en: But the Woodman had seen them coming, and the Scarecrow had decided what to do.
uz: Ammo Vudman ularni kelayotganini ko'rgan va qo'rqinchli qo'rqinch nima qilish kerakligini hal qilgan edi.

en: "Take out my straw and scatter it over the little girl and the dog and the Lion," he said to the Woodman, "and the bees cannot sting them." This the Woodman did, and as Dorothy lay close beside the Lion and held Toto in her arms, the straw covered them entirely.
uz: "O'sha cho'qqimni olib chiqib, kichkina qiz, it va Arslonga tarqating", - dedi u Vudmanga, "va asablar ularni urib bo'lmaydi". Vudman shunday qildi va Doroti Arslonga yaqin o'tirib, Totoni qo'llarida ushlab turganida, cho'qqiz ularni to'liq qopladi.

en: The bees came and found no one but the Woodman to sting, so they flew at him and broke off all their stings against the tin, without hurting the Woodman at all.
uz: Eshiklar kelib, o'simlikdan boshqa hech kimni urib bo'lmasligini ko'rishdi, shuning uchun ular unga uchib borib, o'simlikdagi o'simliklarning barchasini kesib tashladilar va o'simlikni hech qanday zarar etkazmadilar.

en: And as bees cannot live when their stings are broken that was the end of the black bees, and they lay scattered thick about the Woodman, like little heaps of fine coal.
uz: Va oylar o'z cho'g'lari buzilganida yashay olmaydigan bo'lgani uchun, qora oylarning oxiri bo'ldi va ular o'simlik atrofida, kichik ko'mir to'plamlari kabi to'qnashgan edi.

en: Then Dorothy and the Lion got up, and the girl helped the Tin Woodman put the straw back into the Scarecrow again, until he was as good as ever.
uz: Keyin Doroti va Arslon o'rnidan turib, qiz Tin Woodmanning qo'rqinchli odamni yana qo'zg'atishga yordam berdi va u har qachongidan ham yaxshi bo'lgunga qadar qo'rqinchli odamni yana qo'lga kiritdi.

en: So they started upon their journey once more.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular safarlariga yana qaytishdi.

en: The Wicked Witch was so angry when she saw her black bees in little heaps like fine coal that she stamped her foot and tore her hair
uz: Yovuz sehrgar o'zining qora arlarini ko'mir kabi kichik to'plamlarda ko'rganida shunchalik g'azablandiki, oyoq bosdi va sochlarini yirtib yubordi.

en: and gnashed her teeth.
uz: va o'z tishlarini teshiklab qo'ydi.

en: And then she called a dozen of her slaves, who were the Winkies, and gave them sharp spears, telling them to go to the strangers and destroy them.
uz: Keyin u o'nlab qullarini, Winkilarni chaqirib, ularga o'tkir nayzalar berib, begonalarga borib ularni yo'q qilishlarini aytdi.

en: The Winkies were not a brave people, but they had to do as they were told.
uz: Winkilar jasoratli odamlar emas edilar, lekin ularga buyurilgan ishni qilishlari kerak edi.

en: So they marched away until they came near to Dorothy.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular Dorothyga yaqinlashmagunlaricha yo'lga tushib ketishdi.

en: Then the Lion gave a great roar and sprang towards them, and the poor Winkies were so frightened that they ran back as fast as they could.
uz: Shundan so'ng Arslon qattiq qichqirdi va ularning yoniga chiqdi va kambag'al Winkies shunchalik qo'rqib ketishdiki, imkon qadar tezroq yugurib qaytib kelishdi.

en: When they returned to the castle the Wicked Witch beat them well with a strap, and sent them back to their work, after which she sat down to think what she should do next.
uz: Qalaga qaytib kelganlarida, Yovuz sehrgar ularni to'p bilan urib, ishga qaytardi, so'ng esa o'tirdi va nima qilishni o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: She could not understand how all her plans to destroy these strangers had failed; but she was a powerful Witch, as well as a wicked one, and she soon made up her mind how to act.
uz: U bu begonalarni yo'q qilishning barcha rejalari qanday muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini tushunmadi; lekin u kuchli sehrgar va yovuz bo'lgan va tez orada qanday harakat qilish kerakligini o'ylab topdi.

en: There was, in her cupboard, a Golden Cap, with a circle of diamonds and rubies running round it.
uz: Uning omborida oltin to'pka bor edi, uning atrofida olmoslar va ko'piklar to'plami yurardi.

en: This Golden Cap had a charm.
uz: Bu oltin toʻpka yoqimli edi.

en: Whoever owned it could call three times upon the Winged Monkeys, who would obey any order they were given.
uz: Uni kimda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u qanotli maymonga uch marta murojaat qilishi mumkin edi, ular ularga berilgan har qanday buyruqqa itoat qiladilar.

en: But no person could command these strange creatures more than three times.
uz: Ammo hech kim bu g'alati mavjudotlarga uch martadan ko'proq buyruq bera olmaydi.

en: Twice already the Wicked Witch had used the charm of the Cap.
uz: Yovuz sehrgar ikki marta Kapning go'zalligidan foydalangan.

en: Once was when she had made the Winkies her slaves, and set herself to rule over their country.
uz: Bir marta u Winkilarni qul qilib, o'z mamlakatini boshqarishga qaror qildi.

en: The Winged Monkeys had helped her do this.
uz: Unga Winged Monkeys bu ishni amalga oshirishda yordam bergan edi.

en: The second time was when she had fought against the Great Oz himself, and driven him out of the land of the West.
uz: Ikkinchi marta esa u Buyuk Ozga o'zi qarshi jang qilib, uni G'arb yurtidan haydab chiqarganida edi.

en: The Winged Monkeys had also helped her in doing this.
uz: Qayiq qayiqlari ham unga bu ishni amalga oshirishda yordam bergan edi.

en: Only once more could she use this Golden Cap, for which reason she did not like to do so until all her other powers were exhausted.
uz: U faqat bir bor o'sha oltin to'pkazni ishlatishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun u o'zining boshqa kuchlari to'liq bo'lgunga qadar buni qilishni xohlamagan.

en: But now that her fierce wolves and her wild crows and her stinging bees were gone, and her slaves had been scared away by the Cowardly Lion, she saw there was only one way left to destroy Dorothy and her friends.
uz: Ammo endi uning yovvoyi qurtlari, yovvoyi qo'rqinchlari va bo'g'ib ketgan asalari yo'qolganidan va qo'rqoq sherdan qullari qo'rqib ketishganidan so'ng, u Dorotani va uning do'stlarini yo'q qilishning yagona yo'li borligini tushungan.

en: So the Wicked Witch took the Golden Cap from her cupboard and placed it upon her head.
uz: Shunday qilib, Yovuz sehrgar o'z omboridan oltin to'pka olib, uning boshiga qo'ydi.

en: Then she stood upon her left foot and said slowly:
uz: So'ngra o'zining chap oyog'ida turib, sekin-sakin shunday dedi:

en: "Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke!" Next she stood upon her right foot and said: "Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo!" After this she stood upon both feet and cried in a loud voice: "Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik!" Now the charm began to work.
uz: "Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke!" So'ngra o'ng oyoqida turib: "Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo!" dedi.Shundan so'ng u ikkala oyoqida turib, baland ovoz bilan: "Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik!" deb baqirdi.

en: The sky was darkened, and a low rumbling sound was heard in the air.
uz: Osmon qorong'i bo'lib qoldi va havoda past ovoz eshitildi.

en: There was a rushing of many wings, a great chattering and laughing, and the sun came out of the dark sky to show the Wicked Witch surrounded by a crowd of monkeys, each with a pair of immense and powerful wings on his shoulders.
uz: Ko'p qanotlarning shovqinligi, katta gap-so'z va kulgilar bo'ldi, qoronchasi qorong'i osmondan chiqib, yovuz sehrgarni bir to'plam maymunlar bilan o'rab olganini ko'rsatdi, ularning har biri omonlarida ulkan va kuchli qanotlar juftligi bor edi.

en: One, much bigger than the others, seemed to be their leader.
uz: Boshqalaridan ancha kattaroq bo'lgan biri ularning yetakchisi bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: He flew close to the Witch and said, "You have called us for the third and last time.
uz: U sehrgarning oldiga uchib kelib: "Siz bizni uchinchi va oxirgi marta chaqirdingiz.

en: What do you command?" "Go to the strangers who are within my land and destroy them all except the Lion," said the Wicked Witch.
uz: Siz nima buyurasiz?" - dedi Yovuz sehrgar. - Mening yurtimda yashovchi musofirlarga boringlar va Arslondan boshqalarni hammasini yo'q qilinglar.

en: "Bring that beast to me, for I have a mind to harness him like a horse, and make him work." "Your commands shall be obeyed," said the leader.
uz: "O'sha hayvonni menga keltiringlar, chunki uni ot kabi ushlab turishga va ishlashga qaror qildim", - dedi boshliq. "Sizning buyruqlaringizga amal qilamiz", dedi u.

en: Then, with a great deal of chattering and noise, the Winged Monkeys flew away to the place where Dorothy and her friends were walking.
uz: So'ngra qahramon va shovqinli maymunlar Dorothy va uning do'stlari yurgan joyga uchib ketdilar.

en: Some of the Monkeys seized the Tin Woodman and carried him through the air until they were over a country thickly covered with sharp rocks.
uz: Ba'zi Maymunlar Tin Woodmanni ushlab, u havo bo'ylab ko'tarib o'tishdi va o'tkir toshlar bilan qoplangan yurtga yetib kelishdi.

en: Here they dropped the poor Woodman, who fell a great distance to the rocks, where he lay so battered and dented that he could neither move nor groan.
uz: Bu yerda kambag'al Vudmanni tashlab qo'yishdi, u toshlarga juda uzoqdan tushdi, u erda u shunchalik urib-ko'tarilgan ediki, harakatlanishga ham, g'azablanishga ham qodir emas edi.

en: Others of the Monkeys caught the Scarecrow, and with their long fingers pulled all of the straw out of his clothes and head.
uz: Maymondagilar qo'rquvchini ushlab, uzun barmoqlari bilan uning kiyim-kechakidan va boshidan to'siq chiqarib olishdi.

en: They made his hat and boots and clothes into a small bundle and threw it into the top branches of a tall tree.
uz: Uning to'pkasi, poyabzallari va kiyim-kechaklarini kichik bir to'plamga aylantirib, baland daraxtning yuqori shoxlariga tashladilar.

en: The remaining Monkeys threw pieces of stout rope around the Lion and wound many coils about his body and head and legs, until
uz: Qolgan Maymunlar sherning atrofida kuchli ip bo'laklarini tashlab, uning tanasi, boshi va oyoqlari atrofida ko'plab bobinlarni o'rab olishdi.

en: he was unable to bite or scratch or struggle in any way.
uz: U hech qanday usulda aralashish, urish yoki kurashish imkoniyatiga ega emas edi.

en: Then they lifted him up and flew away with him to the Witch's castle, where he was placed in a small yard with a high iron fence around it, so that he could not escape.
uz: So'ngra uni ko'tarib olib, u bilan birga sehrgarning qalʼasiga uchib ketishdi va uni yuqori temir toʻsiq bilan oʻrab olgan kichkina hovliga qoʻyishdi, shuning uchun u qochib ketolmadi.

en: But Dorothy they did not harm at all.
uz: Ammo ular Dorothyga hech qanday zarar yetkazmadi.

en: She stood, with Toto in her arms, watching the sad fate of her comrades and thinking it would soon be her turn.
uz: To'to qo'llarida turib, hamkasblarining qayg'uli taqdirini kuzatib turardi va tez orada o'z navbatida bo'ladi deb o'ylagan.

en: The leader of the Winged Monkeys flew up to her, his long, hairy arms stretched out and his ugly face grinning terribly; but he saw the mark of the Good Witch's kiss upon her forehead and stopped short, motioning the others not to touch her.
uz: Qo'ng'iroqli maymunlar boshlig'i uning oldiga uchdi, uning uzun, sochli qo'llari uzilgan va o'zining qo'rqinchli yuzi juda ko'p tabassum qildi; lekin u uning peshanasida Yaxshi Xudojonning o'pishi belgisini ko'rdi va o'z vaqtida to'xtadi va boshqalarga unga tegmaslikka ishora qildi.

en: "We dare not harm this little girl," he said to them, "for she is protected by the Power of Good, and that is greater than the Power of Evil.
uz: U ularga shunday dedi: "Biz bu kichkina qizchaga zarar yetkazishga jur'at etmaymiz, chunki u Yaxshilik qudrati bilan himoyalangan va bu yomonlik qudratiga qaraganda katta.

en: All we can do is to carry her to the castle of the Wicked Witch and leave her there." So, carefully and gently, they lifted Dorothy in their arms and carried her swiftly through the air until they came to the castle, where they set her down upon the front doorstep.
uz: Biz uni yomon sehrgarning qalʼasiga olib borib, u yerda qoldirishimiz mumkin". Shunday qilib, ular Dorothyni ehtiyotkorlik va muloyimlik bilan qoʻllarida olib, osmondan oshib ketishdi.

en: Then the leader said to the Witch: "We have obeyed you as far as we were able.
uz: Keyin boshliq sehrgarga shunday dedi: "Biz sizga imkonimiz boricha itoat qildik.

en: The Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow are destroyed, and the Lion is tied up in your yard.
uz: Tin Woodman va qo'rquvchisi yo'q qilinadi va Arslon sizning hovlisingizda bog'langan.

en: The little girl we dare not harm, nor the dog she carries in her arms.
uz: Biz yomon ko'rishga jur'at etmagan qizcha va uning qo'llarida turgan itga zarar yetkazishga jur'at etmaymiz.

en: Your power over our band is now ended, and you will never see us again." Then all the Winged Monkeys, with much laughing and chattering and noise, flew into the air and were soon out of sight.
uz: Bizning guruhimiz ustidan sizning hokimiyatingiz endi tugadi va siz bizni boshqa hech qachon ko'rmaysiz". Keyin barcha qanotli maymunlar ko'p kulish, gap-so'z va shov-shuv bilan havoga uchib ketdilar va tez orada ko'rinmas edilar.

en: The Wicked Witch was both surprised and worried when she saw the mark on Dorothy's forehead, for she knew well that neither the Winged Monkeys nor she, herself, dare hurt the girl in any way.
uz: Yovuz sehrgar Dorotining oldidagi belgini ko'rib hayron va xavotirga tushdi, chunki u qanotli maymunlar ham, o'zi ham qizga hech qanday zarar yetkazishga jur'at qilmasligini yaxshi bilardi.

en: She looked down at Dorothy's feet, and seeing the Silver Shoes, began to tremble with fear, for she knew what a powerful charm belonged to them.
uz: U Dorotiyaning oyoqlariga qarab, kumush poyabzallarni ko'rib, qo'rquvdan titra boshladi, chunki u ularning qanchalik kuchli ta'sirini bilardi.

en: At first the Witch was tempted to run away from Dorothy; but she happened to look into the child's eyes and saw how simple the soul behind them was, and that the little girl did not know of the
uz: Avval sehrgar Dorothydan qochib ketish vasvasasiga tushdi; lekin u bolaning ko'zlariga qaradi va ularning orqasidagi ruh qanchalik sodda ekanligini va kichkina qizchaning bu ruhdan xabardor emasligini ko'radi.

en: wonderful power the Silver Shoes gave her.
uz: Kumush poyabzallar unga bergan ajoyib kuch.

en: So the Wicked Witch laughed to herself, and thought, "I can still make her my slave, for she does not know how to use her power." Then she said to Dorothy, harshly and severely: "Come with me; and see that you mind everything I tell you, for if you do not I will make an end of you, as I did of the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow." Dorothy followed her through many of the beautiful rooms in her castle until they came to the kitchen, where the Witch bade her clean the pots and kettles and sweep the floor and keep the fire fed with wood.
uz: Yovuz sehrgar o'z-o'zidan kuldi va o'yladi: "Men uni hali ham qul qilaman, chunki u o'z kuchidan qanday foydalanishni bilmaydi". So'ngra u Dorotiga qattiq va qat'iylik bilan shunday dedi: "Men bilan kel; va senga aytganlarimga e'tibor berishga harakat qil, agar qilmasang, Men seni Tin Woodman va Scarecrow bilan sodir etganimdek o'ldiraman". Doroti uning qishlog'idagi ko'plab chiroyli xonalar orqali kuzatib bordi.

en: Dorothy went to work meekly, with her mind made up to work as hard as she could; for she was glad the Wicked Witch had decided not to kill her.
uz: Doroti kamtarinlik bilan ishga kirdi va iloji boricha ko'proq mehnat qilishga qaror qildi; chunki u yovuz sehrgarning uni o'ldirishni istamaganidan xursand edi.

en: With Dorothy hard at work, the Witch thought she would go into the courtyard and harness the Cowardly Lion like a horse; it would amuse her, she was sure, to make him draw her chariot whenever she wished to go to drive.
uz: Doroti qattiq ishlayotgan ekan, sehrgar ayol hovliga kirib, qo'rqoq sherni ot kabi qo'lga oladi deb o'yladi; bu unga zavq keltiradi, shubhasiz, u haydashga ketmoqchi bo'lganda uning aravachasini chizishga majburlaydi.

en: But as she opened the gate the Lion gave a loud roar and bounded at her so fiercely that the Witch was afraid, and ran out and shut the gate again.
uz: Ammo u darvozani ochganida, Arslon baland ovoz bilan qichqirib, uni shunchalik qattiq qo'rqitdiki, sehrgar qo'rqib chiqib, darvozani yana yopdi.

en: "If I cannot harness you," said the Witch to the Lion, speaking through the bars of the gate, "I can starve you.
uz: "Agar men sizni qo'llab-quvvatlay olmasam, - dedi o'g'lim Arslonga, darvozaning barlari orqali gapirgan holda, - Men sizni ochlikdan o'ldiraman.

en: You shall have nothing to eat until you do as I wish." So after that she took no food to the imprisoned Lion; but every day she came to the gate at noon and asked, "Are you ready to be harnessed like a horse?" And the Lion would answer, "No.
uz: Men xohlagan ishni qilmaguningizcha, siz hech narsa yeyangiz yo'q". Shunday qilib, bundan keyin u qamoqda bo'lgan Arslonga hech qanday ovqat olib bormadi; lekin har kuni tush paytida darvozaxga kelib, undan: "At kabi qo'lga tushishga tayyormisiz?" - deb so'radi.

en: If you come in this yard, I will bite you." The reason the Lion did not have to do as the Witch wished was that every night, while the woman was asleep, Dorothy carried him food from the cupboard.
uz: Agar siz bu hovliga kirsangiz, men sizni og'izaman". Arslon sehrgarning xohishi bo'yicha yo'l qo'ymasligining sababi shundaki, har kecha ayol uxlayotganda, Doroti unga ombordan oziq-ovqat olib borardi.

en: After he had eaten he would lie down on his bed of straw, and Dorothy would lie beside him and put her head
uz: Ovqatni yeganidan so'ng, u o'zining to'shakli to'shagida o'tirardi, Doroti esa uning yonida o'tirib, boshini qo'ydi.

en: on his soft, shaggy mane, while they talked of their troubles and tried to plan some way to escape.
uz: Ular o'z muammolari haqida gapirib, qandaydir qochish yo'lini rejalashtirishga harakat qilishganida, uning yumshoq, shov-shuvli maydonida o'tirdilar.

en: But they could find no way to get out of the castle, for it was constantly guarded by the yellow Winkies, who were the slaves of the Wicked Witch and too afraid of her not to do as she told them.
uz: Ammo ular qishlog'dan chiqib ketishning yo'lini topolmadilar, chunki qishloqda o'z qullari bo'lgan sariq Winkies doimiy ravishda qo'riqlanardi va ular yovuz sehrgaraning qullari edilar va u ularga buyurgan ishni qilmaslikdan qo'rqardilar.

en: The girl had to work hard during the day, and often the Witch threatened to beat her with the same old umbrella she always carried in her hand.
uz: Qiz kun davomida juda ko'p mehnat qilishi kerak edi va ko'pincha sehrgar uni har doim qo'lida olib yurgan eski chiroq bilan urish bilan tahdid qilardi.

en: But, in truth, she did not dare to strike Dorothy, because of the mark upon her forehead.
uz: Ammo haqiqat shundaki, u Dorothyga yuzaki belgi tufayli urishga jur'at etmadi.

en: The child did not know this, and was full of fear for herself and Toto.
uz: Bola buni bilmas edi va o'zi va Toto uchun qo'rqqan edi.

en: Once the Witch struck Toto a blow with her umbrella and the brave little dog flew at her and bit her leg in return.
uz: Bir marta sehrgar To'toga o'z omborchasini urganida, jasoratli it unga uchib kelib, uning oyoqidan urdi.

en: The Witch did not bleed where she was bitten, for she was so wicked that the blood in her had dried up many years before.
uz: Chiroyli qiz o'tqazilgan joyda qon ketmadi, chunki u shunchalik yovuz ediki, uning ichidagi qon ko'p yillar oldin qurigan edi.

en: Dorothy's life became very sad as she grew to understand that it would be harder than ever to get back to Kansas and Aunt Em again.
uz: Dorotining hayoti juda xafa bo'ldi, chunki u Kanzasga va Em onasi bilan yana qaytish har qachongidan ham qiyinroq bo'lishini tushunib yetdi.

en: Sometimes she would cry bitterly for hours, with Toto sitting at her feet and looking into her face, whining dismally to show how sorry he was for his little mistress.
uz: Ba'zan u soatlab qattiq yig'lar edi, Toto uning oyoqlarida o'tirib, yuziga qarab, o'z xotini uchun qanchalik achinganini ko'rsatish uchun qayg'urgan.

en: Toto did not really care whether he was in Kansas or the Land of Oz so long as Dorothy was with him; but he knew the little girl was unhappy, and that made him unhappy too.
uz: To'to, Dorothy u bilan birga bo'lganida, Kanzasda yoki O'z yurtida bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, muhim ahamiyatga ega emas edi; lekin u kichkina qizchaning baxtsiz ekanligini bilardi va bu uni ham baxtsiz qildi.

en: Now the Wicked Witch had a great longing to have for her own the Silver Shoes which the girl always wore.
uz: Endi Yovuz sehrgar qiz har doim kiygan kumush poyabzallarni o'zi uchun olishni juda xohlagan.

en: Her bees and her crows and her wolves were lying in heaps and drying up, and she had used up all the power of the Golden Cap; but if she could only get hold of the Silver Shoes, they would give her more power than all the other things she had lost.
uz: Uning arlari, qahvalari va bo'rilari to'plamlarda yotgan va qurib ketayotgan edilar va u oltin to'plamning butun kuchini sarflagan edi; lekin agar u faqat kumush poyabzallarni qo'lga kiritsa, ular unga yo'qolgan boshqa narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq kuch beradi.

en: She watched Dorothy carefully, to see if she ever took off her shoes, thinking she might steal them.
uz: U Dorotiyni diqqat bilan kuzatib turardi va uni o'g'irlab ketishi mumkinligini o'ylab, hech qachon poyabzallarini tushirmasligini ko'rdi.

en: But the child was so proud of her pretty shoes that she never took them off except at night and when she took her bath.
uz: Ammo bola o'zining chiroyli poyabzallari bilan shunchalik faxrlanardiki, uni kechasi va suvga cho'kgan paytlaridan tashqari hech qachon olib tashlamagan.

en: The Witch was too much afraid of the dark to dare go in Dorothy's room at night to take the shoes, and her dread of water was greater than her fear of the dark, so she never came near when Dorothy was bathing.
uz: Qo'riqchi qorong'ulikdan qo'rqqanidan, kechasi Dorothy xonasiga kirishga va poyabzallarini olishga jur'at qilmagan va uning suvdan qo'rquvi qorong'ulikdan katta edi, shuning uchun Dorothy suvga cho'mganida hech qachon yaqinlashmagan.

en: the old Witch never touched water, nor ever let water touch her in any way.
uz: Keksa sehrgar hech qachon suvga tegmagan va suv unga hech qanday ta'sir qilishiga yo'l qo'ymagan.

en: But the wicked creature was very cunning, and she finally thought of a trick that would give her what she wanted.
uz: Ammo bu yovuz mavjudot juda hiylasiz edi va nihoyat, unga istaganini beradigan hiyla haqida o'yladi.

en: She placed a bar of iron in the middle of the kitchen floor, and then by her magic arts made the iron invisible to human eyes.
uz: U oshxonadagi yotoqning o'rtasida temirni qo'ydi va o'z sehr-jodulari bilan temirni inson ko'zi uchun ko'rinmas qilib qo'ydi.

en: So that when Dorothy walked across the floor she stumbled over the bar, not being able to see it, and fell at full length.
uz: Shunday qilib, Doroti ertalab yugurganida, uni ko'rishga ojiz bo'lib, barni to'xtatib qolib, to'liq o'tib tushdi.

en: She was not much hurt, but in her fall one of the Silver Shoes came off; and before she could reach it, the Witch had snatched it away and put it on her own skinny foot.
uz: U juda ham jarohatlanmagan, lekin quyilganida kumush poyabzallardan biri tushdi va unga yetib kelishidan oldin, sehrgar uni olib ketib, o'z pichan oyoqlariga qo'ydi.

en: The wicked woman was greatly pleased with the success of her trick, for as long as she had one of the shoes she owned half the power of their charm, and Dorothy could not use it against her, even had she known how to do so.
uz: Yovuz ayol o'z hiylaining muvaffaqiyatidan juda mamnun edi, chunki uning poyabzallaridan biriga ega bo'lganida, u ularning go'zalligining yarmiga ega bo'lgan va Doroti buni unga qarshi ishlatishi mumkin emas edi, hatto u buni qanday qilishni bilsa ham.

en: The little girl, seeing she had lost one of her pretty shoes, grew angry, and said to the Witch, "Give me back my shoe!" "I will not," retorted the Witch, "for it is now my shoe, and not yours." "You are a wicked creature!" cried Dorothy.
uz: Kichik qizcha o'zining chiroyli poyabzallaridan birini yo'qotganini ko'rib, g'azabga to'ldi va sehrgarga dedi: "Menga poyabzalimni qaytarib ber!" - Men buni qilmayman, - deb javob berdi sehrgar, - chunki bu endi sizning poyabzalingiz emas, balki mening poyabzalim.

en: "You have no right to take my shoe from me." "I shall keep it, just the same," said the Witch, laughing at her, "and someday I shall get the other one from you, too." This made Dorothy so very angry that she picked up the bucket of water that stood near and dashed it over the Witch, wetting her from head to foot.
uz: "Sen mening poyabzalimni olish huquqiga ega emassan". - Men uni saqlab qolaman, xuddi shunday, - dedi sehrgar ayol unga kulishib, - va bir kuni o'sha poyabzalni sening o'zingdan ham olishim kerak. - Bu Dorothyni shunchalik g'azablantirdiki, u yonimda turgan suv qadoqini olib, sehrgarning ustiga urib, uni boshdan oyoqqacha bosadi.

en: Instantly the wicked woman gave a loud cry of fear, and then, as Dorothy looked at her in wonder, the Witch began to shrink and fall away.
uz: O'sha zahoti yovuz ayol qo'rquvdan baland ovoz bilan qichqirib yubordi va keyin, Doroti unga hayratda ko'rib turganida, sehrgar kamayib, yo'qolishni boshladi.

en: "See what you have done!" she screamed.
uz: - Qarang, nima qildingiz! - deb baqirdi u.

en: "In a minute I shall melt away."
uz: "Bir daqiqadan keyin men erib ketaman".

en: "I'm very sorry, indeed," said Dorothy, who was truly frightened to see the Witch actually melting away like brown sugar before her very eyes.
uz: "Haqiqatan ham, juda afsusdaman", - dedi Doroti, uning ko'z o'ngida sehrgarning qora shakar kabi erib ketayotganini ko'rib chindan ham qo'rqqan edi.

en: "Didn't you know water would be the end of me?" asked the Witch, in a wailing, despairing voice.
uz: - Suv men uchun oxirat bo'lishini bilmadingmi? - deb so'radi sehrgar, yig'lab, umidsizlikda qolgan ovoz bilan.

en: "Of course not," answered Dorothy.
uz: "Agar bo'lmasa", deb javob berdi Doroti.

en: "How should I?" "Well, in a few minutes I shall be all melted, and you will have the castle to yourself.
uz: - Qanday qilib qilsam bo'ladi? - deb so'radi. - Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng men butunlay erib ketaman va siz o'zingiz uchun qal'ani topasiz.

en: I have been wicked in my day, but I never thought a little girl like you would ever be able to melt me and end my wicked deeds.
uz: Men o'z kunlarimda yovuz bo'lganman, lekin siz kabi kichkina qizcha meni eritib, yovuz ishlarimni tugatadi, deb hech qachon o'ylamaganman.

en: Look out—here I go!" With these words the Witch fell down in a brown, melted, shapeless mass and began to spread over the clean boards of the kitchen floor.
uz: Bu so'zlar bilan sehrgar ko'k, erib ketgan, shaksiz bir massasiga tushib, oshxonadagi toza pillalarga tarqaladi.

en: Seeing that she had really melted away to nothing, Dorothy drew another bucket of water and threw it over the mess.
uz: Dorothy o'zining chindan ham erib ketganini ko'rib, yana bir idish suv olib, uni buzuqqa tashladi.

en: She then swept it all out the door.
uz: So'ngra u hamma narsani eshikdan olib chiqdi.

en: After picking out the silver shoe, which was all that was left of the old woman, she cleaned and dried it with a cloth, and put it on her foot again.
uz: Qariya ayolning qolgan kumush poyabzalini tanlab olganidan so'ng, uni kiyim bilan tozalab, quritib, yana oyoq boshiga qo'ydi.

en: Then, being at last free to do as she chose, she ran out to the courtyard to tell the Lion that the Wicked Witch of the West had come to an end, and that they were no longer prisoners in a strange land.
uz: So'ngra, nihoyat o'zi xohlagan ishni qilishga erkin bo'lib, u sherga sherga yovuz g'ayriodgorlikning o'z nihoyasiga yetganini va ular o'zga yurtda mahbus bo'lmaganini aytish uchun hovliga yugurdi.

en: Chapter XIII The Rescue The Cowardly Lion was much pleased to hear that the Wicked Witch had been melted by a bucket of water, and Dorothy at once unlocked the gate of his prison and set him free.
uz: XIII bob Qutqaruv Qo'rqoq sher, yovuz sehrgarning suvi qadoq bilan erib ketgani haqida eshitib, juda xursand bo'ldi va Doroti darhol o'z qamoqxonasining darvozalarini ochib, uni ozod qildi.

en: They went in together to the castle, where Dorothy's first act was to call all the Winkies together and tell them that they were no longer slaves.
uz: Ular birga shahardan o'tishdi va Dorotining birinchi ishi barcha Winkilarni yig'ib, ular endi qul emasligini aytish edi.

en: There was great rejoicing among the yellow Winkies, for they had been made to work hard during many years for the Wicked Witch, who had always treated them with great cruelty.
uz: Sariq Winkieslar orasida katta quvonch bor edi, chunki ular har doim ularga shafqatsiz munosabatda bo'lgan Yovuz sehrgar uchun ko'p yillar davomida qattiq mehnat qilishgan.

en: They kept this day as a holiday, then and ever after, and spent the time in feasting and dancing.
uz: Ular bu kunni bayram sifatida saqlab, o'sha paytdan boshlab va undan keyin ham bayram qilib, tantana qilishgan.

en: "If our friends, the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, were only with us," said the Lion, "I should be quite happy." "Don't you suppose we could rescue them?" asked the girl anxiously.
uz: "Agar bizning do'stlarimiz, qo'rqinchli va qalin o'simlik faqat biz bilan bo'lganida edi", dedi Arslon, "men juda xursand bo'lardim". "Biz ularni qutqarishimiz mumkin deb o'ylamayapsizmi?" - deb so'radi qiz qiz tashvish bilan.

en: "We can try," answered the Lion.
uz: "Biz sinab ko'rishimiz mumkin", deb javob berdi Arslon.

en: So they called the yellow Winkies and asked them if they would help to rescue their friends, and the Winkies said that they would be delighted to do all in their power for Dorothy, who had set them free from bondage.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular sariq Winkiesni chaqirib, do'stlarini qutqarishga yordam berishni so'radilar va Winkieslar ularni qullikdan ozod qilgan Dorothy uchun qo'llaridan kelganini qilishdan mamnun bo'lishlarini aytishdi.

en: So she chose a number of the Winkies who looked as if they knew the most, and they all started away.
uz: Shunday qilib, u Winkilarning bir nechtasini tanladi, ular eng ko'p bilimga ega bo'lib ko'rinishgan va ularning barchasi ketishdi.

en: day and part of the next until they came to the rocky plain where the Tin Woodman lay, all battered and bent.
uz: Keyingi kun va bir qismida ular Tin Woodman yotgan toshbo'ron o'rmonlariga kelib qolguncha, barchasi urib-ko'tarilgan va egri bo'lgan.

en: His axe was near him, but the blade was rusted and the handle broken off short.
uz: Uning oʻgʻli uning yonida edi, ammo oʻgʻli eskirgan va qoʻlni kesib tashlagan.

en: The Winkies lifted him tenderly in their arms, and carried him back to the Yellow Castle again, Dorothy shedding a few tears by the way at the sad plight of her old friend, and the Lion looking sober and sorry.
uz: Winkieslar uni o'z qo'llarida ko'tarib, yana sariq qal'aga olib borishdi, Dorothy esa eski do'stining qayg'uli ahvolini ko'rib, ko'z yoshlarini to'kib yubordi.

en: When they reached the castle Dorothy said to the Winkies: "Are any of your people tinsmiths?" "Oh, yes.
uz: Qalaga yetib kelganlarida, Doroti Vinskiylarga: "Sizlarning odamlaringizdan hech kim qanoqchi bo'ladimi?" - deb so'radi.

en: Some of us are very good tinsmiths," they told her.
uz: Ba'zilarimiz juda yaxshi qutilarmiz", - deyishdi unga.

en: "Then bring them to me," she said.
uz: - Keyin ularni menga keltiringlar, - dedi u.

en: And when the tinsmiths came, bringing with them all their tools in baskets, she inquired, "Can you straighten out those dents in the Tin Woodman, and bend him back into shape again, and solder him together where he is broken?" The tinsmiths looked the Woodman over carefully and then answered that they thought they could mend him so he would be as good as ever.
uz: Tinsmatlar o'zlarining barcha asbob-uskunalarini to'pkalarda olib kelganida, u: "Tins Woodmandagi buchanlarni to'g'rilashingiz mumkinmi, uni yana shaklga qo'yishingiz va buzilgan joyda to'ldirib qo'yishingiz mumkinmi?" - deb so'radi.Tinsmatlar Woodmanni diqqat bilan ko'rib, uni tuzatish mumkin deb o'ylashganini aytishdi.

en: So they set to work in one of the big yellow rooms of the castle and worked for three days and four nights, hammering and twisting and bending and soldering and polishing and pounding at the legs and body and head of the Tin Woodman, until at last he was straightened out into his old form, and his joints worked as well as ever.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular qalʼaning katta sariq xonalaridan birida ishlashni boshlashdi va uch kun va toʻrt kecha ishladi, oʻtkirlab-oʻtkirlab, bogʻlab-boʻgʻib, toʻldirib, oʻtkirlab, Tin Woodmanning oyoqlari, tanasi va boshi bilan toʻqnashdi, nihoyat u eski shakliga toʻgʻrilashdi va uning qoʻshmalari har doimgidek ishlaydi.

en: To be sure, there were several patches on him, but the tinsmiths did a good job, and as the Woodman was not a vain man he did not mind the patches at all.
uz: To'g'ri, uning boshiga bir necha takalar bor edi, lekin tangerlar yaxshi ish qildilar va Woodman behuda odam bo'lmaganligi sababli, o'sha takalarga hech qanday xalaqit bermadi.

en: When, at last, he walked into Dorothy's room and thanked her for rescuing him, he was so pleased that he wept tears of joy, and Dorothy had to wipe every tear carefully from his face with her apron, so his joints would not be rusted.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u Dorotining xonasiga kirib, uni qutqargani uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirganida, u shunchalik xursand bo'ldiki, quvonchdan ko'z yoshlarini to'kib yubordi va Dorotining qo'shiqlari rang-barang bo'lmasligi uchun o'z qopqog'i bilan uning yuzidagi har bir yoshni ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'chirib tashlashi kerak edi.

en: At the same time her own tears fell thick and fast at the joy of meeting her old friend again, and these tears did not need to be wiped away.
uz: Shu bilan birga, eski do'sti bilan yana uchrashish quvonchidan ko'z yoshlari to'lib-toshdi va bu ko'z yoshlarini o'chirib tashlashning hojati yo'q edi.

en: As for the Lion, he wiped his eyes so often with the tip of his tail that it became quite wet, and he was obliged to go out into the courtyard and hold it in the sun till it dried.
uz: Arslonning ko'zlarini quyruqning tomoniga shunchalik tez-tez silkitganki, u juda suyuq bo'lib qoldi va u hovliga chiqib, quyoshga cho'kguncha uni ushlab turishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: "If we only had the Scarecrow with us again," said the Tin Woodman, when Dorothy had finished telling him everything that had happened, "I should be quite happy." "We must try to find him," said the girl.
uz: "Agar qo'rqinchli yana o'zimizda bo'lganida edi", - dedi Tin Woodman, Doroti u bilan sodir bo'lganlarning barchasini aytib bo'lgandan so'ng, "men juda xursand bo'lar edim". "Biz uni topishga harakat qilishimiz kerak", dedi qiz.

en: So she called the Winkies to help her, and they walked all that day and part of the next until they came to the tall tree in the branches of which the Winged Monkeys had tossed the Scarecrow's clothes.
uz: Shunda u Winkies-larni yordamga chaqirdi va ular butun kun va keyingi bir qismida qo'rqinchli maymunlar Qo'rqinchli kiyimlarini tashlagan bo'laklaridagi baland daraxtga yetib kelishlaricha yurishdi.

en: It was a very tall tree, and the trunk was so smooth that no one could climb it; but the Woodman said at once, "I'll chop it down, and then we can get the Scarecrow's clothes." Now while the tinsmiths had been at work mending the Woodman himself, another of the Winkies, who was a goldsmith, had made an axe-handle of solid gold and fitted it to the Woodman's axe, instead of the old broken handle.
uz: Bu juda baland daraxt edi va trunk shunchalik mos ediki, uni hech kim ko'tarolmasdi; lekin Vudman birdan: "Men uni kesaman, keyin qo'rqinchli kiyimni olsak bo'ladi", - dedi.

en: Others polished the blade until all the rust was removed and it glistened like burnished silver.
uz: Boshqalar esa o'qlarni o'g'irlashardi, hatto barcha eskirish o'chirib, o'qilgan kumush kabi shinam bo'ldi.

en: As soon as he had spoken, the Tin Woodman began to chop, and in a short time the tree fell over with a crash, whereupon the Scarecrow's clothes fell out of the branches and rolled off on the ground.
uz: U gapirganidan so'ng, Tin Woodman chopishni boshladi va ko'p o'tmay daraxt tushib tushdi va qo'rqinchli odamning kiyimlari shoxlardan tushib, yerga yiqildi.

en: Dorothy picked them up and had the Winkies carry them back to the castle, where they were stuffed with nice, clean straw; and behold!
uz: Doroti ularni olib kelib, Winkilar bilan birga qalʼaga olib borishni buyurdi, u yerda ular yaxshi, toza choʻgʻ bilan toʻldirilgan edilar.

en: here was the Scarecrow, as good as ever, thanking them over and over again for saving him.
uz: Bu erda qo'rqinchli odam har qachongidan ham yaxshi edi va uni qutqarganlari uchun ularga takror-takror minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

en: Now that they were reunited, Dorothy and her friends spent a few happy days at the Yellow Castle, where they found everything they needed to make them comfortable.
uz: Endi ular qayta uchrashganidan so'ng, Doroti va uning do'stlari bir necha quvonchli kunlarni Sariq qal'ada o'tkazdilar, u erda ular o'zlarini qulay qilish uchun kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani topdilar.

en: But one day the girl thought of Aunt Em, and said, "We must go back to Oz, and claim his promise." "Yes," said the Woodman, "at last I shall get my heart." "And I shall get my brains," added the Scarecrow joyfully.
uz: Ammo bir kuni qiz Em onasi haqida o'ylab, "Biz Ozga qaytib borib, uning va'dasini qo'lga kiritishimiz kerak" dedi. "Ha, - dedi Vudman, - nihoyat yuragimni qo'lga kiritaman. - Va men ongimni qo'lga kiritaman", - deb qo'shib qo'ydi qo'rqinchli.

en: "And I shall get my courage," said the Lion thoughtfully.
uz: "Va men jasoratimni qo'lga kiritaman", - dedi Arslon o'ylab.

en: "And I shall get back to Kansas," cried Dorothy, clapping her hands.
uz: "Va men Kanzasga qaytaman", - dedi Doroti qo'l urib.

en: "Oh, let us start for the Emerald City tomorrow!" This they decided to do.
uz: "Oh, keling, ertaga Emerald Cityga boraylik!" - deb aytishdi.

en: The next day they called the Winkies together and bade them good-bye.
uz: Ertasi kuni ular Winkilarni chaqirib, ularga salom berishdi.

en: The Winkies were sorry to have them go, and they had grown so fond of the Tin Woodman that they begged him to stay and rule over them and the Yellow Land of the West.
uz: Winkilar ularni tark etishdan xafa bo'lishdi va ular Tin Woodmanni shunchalik yaxshi ko'rishdiki, uni qolish va ular va G'arbning Sarayli Yerini boshqarishini iltijo qilishdi.

en: Finding they were determined to go, the Winkies gave Toto and the Lion each a golden collar; and to Dorothy they presented a beautiful bracelet studded with diamonds; and to the Scarecrow they gave a gold-headed walking stick, to keep him from stumbling; and to the Tin Woodman they offered a silver oil-can, inlaid with gold and set with precious jewels.
uz: Ular ketishga qat'iy qaror qilishganini ko'rib, Winkieslar Toto va Arslonga har biriga oltin bo'yinturuq berishdi; Dorotiga esa oltin bilan o'ralgan chiroyli asbob-uskunalar taqdim etishdi; Qo'rqinchliga esa qo'ng'iroq qilishdan saqlanish uchun oltin boshli cho'pon berishdi; Tin Woodmanga esa oltin bilan o'ralgan va qimmatbaho zargarliklar bilan qoplangan kumush moy qadoqchasini taqdim etishdi.

en: Every one of the travelers made the Winkies a pretty speech in return, and all shook hands with them until their arms ached.
uz: Har bir sayohatchi Winkilarga yaxshi nutq so'zladi va hamma qo'llari og'rig'ig'ini ko'targuncha qo'llarini qo'shdi.

en: Dorothy went to the Witch's cupboard to fill her basket with food for the journey, and there she saw the Golden Cap.
uz: Doroti sayohat uchun oziq-ovqat bilan to'ldirish uchun sehrgarning omborga bordi va u yerda oltin to'pkazni ko'rdi.

en: She tried it on her own head and found that it fitted her exactly.
uz: U buni o'z boshida sinab ko'rdi va u o'ziga to'g'ri mos kelayotganini ko'rdi.

en: She did not know anything about the charm of the Golden Cap, but she saw that it was pretty, so she made up her mind to wear it and carry her sunbonnet in the basket.
uz: U oltin toʻpka charmi haqida hech narsa bilmagan edi, lekin uning chiroyli ekanligini koʻrib, uni kiyishga va quyoshni koʻkrak ichida olib yurishga qaror qildi.

en: Then, being prepared for the journey, they all started for the Emerald City; and the Winkies gave them three cheers and many good wishes to carry with them.
uz: Keyin, sayohatga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun, ular barchasi Emerald Cityga yo'naltirishdi; Winkies ularga uch marta salom berdi va ko'plab yaxshi tilaklarni o'zlari bilan olib borishga ruxsat berdi.

en: Chapter XIV The Winged Monkeys You will remember there was no road—not even a pathway— between the castle of the Wicked Witch and the Emerald City.
uz: O'zingiz eslaysizki, Yovuz sehrgarning shahri va Zulmat shahri o'rtasida yo'l yo'q edi, hatto yo'l ham yo'q edi.

en: When the four travelers went in search of the Witch she had seen them coming, and so sent the Winged Monkeys to bring them to her.
uz: To'rtta sayohatchi sehrgarni qidirishga ketganda, u ularni kelayotganini ko'rgan va u uchun qanotli maymunlarni yuborib, ularni unga olib kelgan.

en: It was much harder to find their way back through the big fields of buttercups and yellow daisies than it was being carried.
uz: O'z yo'llarini ko'p bo'lgan ko'kraklar va sariq marvaridlar maydonlaridan topib olish, uni olib ketishdan ancha qiyinroq edi.

en: They knew, of course, they must go straight east, toward the rising sun; and they started off in the right way.
uz: Ular, albatta, sharqqa to'g'ridan-to'g'ri borishlari kerakligini bilishardi va ular to'g'ri yo'ldan boshlashdi.

en: But at noon, when the sun was over their heads, they did not know which was east and which was west, and that was the reason they were lost in the great fields.
uz: Ammo tushda, quyosh boshlari ustida bo'lganida, ular qaysilari sharq va qaysilari g'arbda ekanligini bilmas edilar va shuning uchun ular katta dalalarda yo'qolishgan edi.
