en: They kept on walking, however, and at night the moon came out and shone brightly.
uz: Biroq ular yurishni davom ettirishdi va kechasi oy chiqib, yorqin yorqinlik bilan porladi.

en: So they lay down among the sweet smelling yellow flowers and slept soundly until morning—all but the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular go'zal, xushbo'y sariq gul gullar orasida yotishdi va ertalabgacha qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli va qalin o'simliklardan tashqari hamma yaxshi uxladilar.

en: The next morning the sun was behind a cloud, but they started on, as if they were quite sure which way they were going.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab quyosh bulut ortida edi, lekin ular qaysi yo'ldan borayotganlarini aniq bilgan bo'lib, yo'lga tushishdi.

en: "If we walk far enough," said Dorothy, "I am sure we shall sometime come to some place." But day by day passed away, and they still saw nothing before them but the scarlet fields.
uz: "Agar biz yetarlicha uzoq yursak, - dedi Doroti, - shubhasiz, bir kuni biron bir joyga yetamiz". Ammo kun o'tib ketadi va ular hali ham ko'z o'nglarida qizil maydonlardan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmadilar.

en: The Scarecrow began to grumble a bit.
uz: Qo'rqinchli odam biroz g'azablanishni boshladi.

en: "We have surely lost our way," he said, "and unless we find it again in time to reach the Emerald City, I shall never get my brains." "Nor I my heart," declared the Tin Woodman.
uz: U shunday dedi: "Biz yo'limizni yo'qotganmiz va agar biz Emerald Cityga yetib kelish uchun uni qaytarib topmasak, men hech qachon o'zimni aqldan ozdira olmayman".

en: "It seems to me I can scarcely wait till I get to Oz, and you must admit this is a very long journey." "You see," said the Cowardly Lion, with a whimper, "I haven't the courage to keep tramping forever, without getting anywhere at all." Then Dorothy lost heart.
uz: "Oz shahriga yetib borishni sabrsizlik bilan kutyapman deb o'ylayman va bu juda uzoq sayohat ekanligini tan olishingiz kerak". "Qarang, - dedi qo'rqinchli Arslon g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda, - hech qanday joyga bormasdan, abadiy g'ayratni davom ettirish uchun jasoratim yo'q". Keyin Dorotsiya yurag'ini yo'qotdi.

en: She sat down on the grass and looked at her companions, and they sat down and looked at her, and Toto found that for the first time in his life he was too tired to chase a butterfly that flew past his head.
uz: U o'tda o'tirib, o'z do'stlariga qaradi, ular esa o'tirib, unga qaraydilar va Toto hayotida birinchi marta u boshidan o'tgan ko'krakni quvish uchun juda charchaganini tushuna boshladi.

en: So he put out his tongue and panted and looked at Dorothy as if to ask what they should do next.
uz: Shunday qilib, u tilini ko'tarib, nafas oldi va Dorotisiga nima qilish kerakligini so'rash kabi qarab turdi.

en: "Suppose we call the field mice," she suggested.
uz: U: "Biz dala tuxumlarini chaqiramiz, deylik", - deb aytdi.

en: "They could probably tell us the way to the Emerald City." "To be sure they could," cried the Scarecrow.
uz: "Ular, ehtimol, bizga Emerald Cityga yo'l ko'rsatishlari mumkin", - dedi qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli.

en: "Why didn't we think of that before?" Dorothy blew the little whistle she had always carried about her neck since the Queen of the Mice had given it to her.
uz: "Nima uchun biz buni ilgari ham o'ylamagan edik?" - dedi Doroti, "Mushlar Qiroli" uni sovg'a qilganidan beri bo'yniga ushlab turgan kichkinagina pishirganini so'radi.

en: In a few minutes they heard the pattering of tiny feet, and many of the small gray mice came running up to her.
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng ular kichik oyog'lar qichqirishini eshitishdi va ko'plab kichkina oq toshlar uning yoniga yugurib kelishdi.

en: Among them was the Queen herself, who asked, in her squeaky little voice: "What can I do for my friends?" "We have lost our way," said Dorothy.
uz: Ularning orasida Qirolicha o'zi ham bo'lgan va u o'zining qichqiriqsiz ovozi bilan: "Do'stlarim uchun nima qilishim mumkin?" - deb so'ragan edi.

en: "Can you tell us where the Emerald City is?" "Certainly," answered the Queen; "but it is a great way off, for you have had it at your backs all this time." Then she noticed Dorothy's Golden Cap, and said, "Why don't you use the charm of the Cap, and call the Winged Monkeys to you?
uz: - Bizga Emerald City qaerdaligini aytsa bo'ladimi? - deb javob berdi Qirolicha. - Albatta, lekin bu juda katta yo'l, chunki siz uni shuncha vaqt orqa tomonda saqlab turdingiz.

en: They will carry you to the City of Oz in less than an hour." "I didn't know there was a charm," answered Dorothy, in surprise.
uz: Ular sizni bir soatdan kam vaqt ichida Oz shahriga olib ketishadi". - Men hech qanday mashhurlik borligini bilmasdim, - dedi Dorotsiya hayratda.

en: "It is written inside the Golden Cap," replied the Queen of the Mice.
uz: "Bu oltin to'pka ichida yozilgan", - deb javob berdi Tovuqlar Qiroli.

en: "But if you are going to call the Winged Monkeys we must run away, for they are full of mischief and think it great fun to plague us." "Won't they hurt me?" asked the girl anxiously.
uz: "Agar qanotli maymunlarni chaqirmoqchi bo'lsangiz, biz qochib ketishimiz kerak, chunki ular yomonlik bilan to'lib-toshgan va bizni azoblash juda qiziqarli deb o'ylashadi". - Ular menga zarar etkazmaydilarmi? - deb so'radi qiz tashvish bilan.

en: They must obey the wearer of the Cap.
uz: Ular Kapka kiyuvchiga itoat qilishlari kerak.

en: Good-bye!" And she scampered out of sight, with all the mice hurrying after her.
uz: Xo'sh, kelinglar!" - dedi va u ko'rinmasidan qochib ketdi, butun tovuqlar uning orqasidan shoshilmoqda.

en: Dorothy looked inside the Golden Cap and saw some words written upon the lining.
uz: Doroti oltin toʻpka ichkarisiga qaradi va qopqoqda yozilgan soʻzlarni koʻradi.

en: These, she thought, must be the charm, so she read the directions carefully and put the Cap upon her head.
uz: O'zicha, bularning hammasi mashhur bo'lishi kerak edi, shuning uchun u yo'l-yo'riqlarni diqqat bilan o'qib, boshida to'pka qo'ydi.

en: "Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke!" she said, standing on her left foot.
uz: "Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke!" - dedi u, chap oyoqida turib.

en: "What did you say?" asked the Scarecrow, who did not know what she was doing.
uz: "Siz nima deysiz?" - deb so'radi qo'rqitgich, u nima qilayotganini bilmagan edi.

en: "Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo!" Dorothy went on, standing this time on her right foot.
uz: "Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo!" - deb davom etdi Doroti, bu safar o'ng oyoqida turibdi.

en: "Hello!" replied the Tin Woodman calmly.
uz: "Salom!" - dedi Tin Woodman xotirjamlik bilan.

en: "Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik!" said Dorothy, who was now standing on both feet.
uz: "Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik!" - dedi Dorotsiya, endi ikkala oyoqida turibdi.

en: This ended the saying of the charm, and they heard a great chattering and flapping of wings, as the band of Winged Monkeys flew up to them.
uz: Shu tariqa mashhurlik so'zlari tugadi va ular Winged Monkeys guruhining o'zlariga yaqinlashayotganini eshitishdi.

en: The King bowed low before Dorothy, and asked, "What is your command?" "We wish to go to the Emerald City," said the child, "and we have lost our way." "We will carry you," replied the King, and no sooner had he spoken than two of the Monkeys caught Dorothy in their arms and flew away with her.
uz: Podshoh Doroti oldida tiz cho'kib: "Sizning buyruqingiz nima?" - deb so'radi. - Biz Emerald shahriga bormoqchimiz, - dedi bola, - va yo'limiz yo'qolgan. - Biz sizni ko'tarib boramiz, - deb javob berdi shoh, so'zlaganidan so'ng ikkita maymun Dorotiyning qo'liga olinib, u bilan uchib ketdi.

en: Others took the Scarecrow and the Woodman and the Lion, and one little Monkey seized Toto and flew after them, although the dog tried hard to bite him.
uz: Boshqalar Qo'rqinchli, O'simlik va Arsloni olib ketishdi va bitta maymun Totoga qo'l urib, ularning orqasidan uchdi, lekin it uni urishga harakat qildi.

en: The Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman were rather frightened at first, for they remembered how badly the Winged Monkeys had
uz: Qo'rqinchli va Tin Woodman dastlab juda qo'rqishgan, chunki ular qanotli maymunlar qanchalik yomon bo'lganini eslab qolgan edilar.

en: treated them before; but they saw that no harm was intended, so they rode through the air quite cheerfully, and had a fine time looking at the pretty gardens and woods far below them.
uz: Ular ilgari ularni davolashgan edilar, lekin ular hech qanday zarar ko'rmoqchi emasligini ko'rishdi, shuning uchun ular havo bo'ylab juda quvonch bilan sayohat qilishdi va ularning pastidagi go'zal bog'lar va o'rmonlarga qarab yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishdi.

en: Dorothy found herself riding easily between two of the biggest Monkeys, one of them the King himself.
uz: Doroti ikkita eng yirik maymun o'rtasida osonlikcha o'zini topib oldi, ulardan biri - shohning o'zi.

en: They had made a chair of their hands and were careful not to hurt her.
uz: Ular o'z qo'llari bilan o'rinni qurib, unga zarar yetkazmaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'lishdi.

en: "Why do you have to obey the charm of the Golden Cap?" she asked.
uz: U: "Nima uchun siz oltin toʻpka goʻzalligiga boʻysunishingiz kerak?" - deb soʻradi.

en: "That is a long story," answered the King, with a Winged laugh; "but as we have a long journey before us, I will pass the time by telling you about it, if you wish." "I shall be glad to hear it," she replied.
uz: - Bu uzoq hikoya, - deb javob berdi shoh qanotli tabassum bilan; - lekin oldimizda uzoq sayohat bo'lgani uchun, agar xohlasangiz, sizga bu haqda aytib beraman.

en: "Once," began the leader, "we were a free people, living happily in the great forest, flying from tree to tree, eating nuts and fruit, and doing just as we pleased without calling anybody master.
uz: "Bir vaqtlar biz erkin xalq edik, katta o'rmonda baxtli yashar edik, daraxtdan daraxtga uchib borardik, yong'oq va meva yeb, hech kimni xo'jayinim deb atamasdan xohlaganimizni qilamiz.

en: Perhaps some of us were rather too full of mischief at times, flying down to pull the tails of the animals that had no wings, chasing birds, and throwing nuts at the people who walked in the forest.
uz: Ehtimol, ba'zilarimiz ba'zan yomonlik bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lib, qanotlari bo'lmagan hayvonlarning quyruqlarini tortib olish uchun o'tib, qushlarni quvg'in qilib, o'rmonda yurgan odamlarga yong'oqlar tashlagan bo'lamiz.

en: But we were careless and happy and full of fun, and enjoyed every minute of the day.
uz: Ammo biz beparvo va baxtli va kulgili bo'lib, kunning har bir daqiqasi bilan zavqlanardik.

en: This was many years ago, long before Oz came out of the clouds to rule over this land.
uz: Bu ko'p yillar oldin, Oz bu yurt ustidan hukmronlik qilish uchun bulutlardan chiqib kelishidan ancha oldin sodir bo'lgan.

en: "There lived here then, away at the North, a beautiful princess, who was also a powerful sorceress.
uz: "O'sha paytda Shimoliy Koreyada bir go'zal princess yashardi, u ham kuchli sehrgar edi.

en: All her magic was used to help the people, and she was never known to hurt anyone who was good.
uz: Uning barcha sehr-jodlari odamlarga yordam berish uchun ishlatilgan va u hech qachon yaxshi odamlarga zarar yetkazmagan.

en: Her name was Gayelette, and she lived in a handsome palace built from great blocks of ruby.
uz: Uning ismi Gayelette edi va u rubi bloklaridan qurilgan chiroyli saroyda yashardi.

en: Everyone loved her, but her greatest sorrow was that she could find no one to love in return, since all the men were much too stupid and ugly to mate with one so beautiful and wise.
uz: Hamma uni yaxshi ko'rardi, lekin uning eng katta qayg'usi shundaki, u o'z o'rniga sevadigan hech kimni topolmadi, chunki barcha erkaklar shuncha chiroyli va aqlli kishi bilan juftlik qilish uchun juda ahmoq va o'tkir edi.

en: At last, however, she found a boy who was handsome and manly and wise beyond his years.
uz: Biroq, nihoyat, uning yoshidan ko'ra chiroyli, erkak va dono bo'lgan o'g'il topdi.

en: Gayelette made up her mind that when he grew to be a man she would make him her husband, so she took him to her ruby palace and used all her magic powers to make him as strong and good and lovely as any woman could wish.
uz: Gayeletta o'sha yigit katta bo'lganida uni er qilib olishi haqida qaror qildi, shuning uchun uni o'z rubin saroyiga olib bordi va barcha sehrli kuchlaridan foydalanib, uni har qanday ayol xohlagancha kuchli, yaxshi va chiroyli qilishdi.

en: When he grew to manhood, Quelala, as he was called, was said to be the best and wisest man in all the land, while his manly beauty was so great that Gayelette loved him dearly, and hastened to make everything ready for the wedding.
uz: O'shanda Quelala, uning ismi bilan atalgan bo'lsa-da, butun mamlakatdagi eng yaxshi va aqlli odam bo'lgan, ammo uning erkakcha go'zalligi shunchalik katta bo'lganki, Gayelet uni juda yaxshi ko'rgan va to'y uchun hamma narsani tayyorlashga shoshgan.

en: "My grandfather was at that time the King of the Winged Monkeys which lived in the forest near Gayelette's palace, and the old fellow loved a joke better than a good dinner.
uz: "Otam o'sha paytda Gayeletning saroyi yaqinidagi o'rmonda yashovchi qanotli maymunlar shohi edi va keksa yigit yaxshi ovqatdan ko'ra hazilni ko'proq yoqtirardi.

en: One day, just before the wedding, my grandfather was flying out with his band when he saw Quelala walking beside the river.
uz: Bir kuni, to'y tug'ilishidan oldin, buvim o'z guruhini qo'llab uzib ketayotganda, Quelalaning daryo bo'yida yurayotganini ko'rdi.

en: He was dressed in a rich costume of pink silk and purple velvet, and my grandfather thought he would see what he could do.
uz: U rosa ipka va bo'yoq paxtalardan iborat boy kostyum kiygan edi va buvim nima qila olishini ko'rishini o'ylagan edi.

en: At his word the band flew down and seized Quelala, carried him in their arms until they were over the middle of the river, and then dropped him into the water.
uz: Uning so'zlariga ko'ra, jangchilar Quelalaning qo'liga tushib, uni qo'llarida ko'tarib, daryo o'rtasida bo'lganlariga qadar suvga tashladilar.

en: "`Swim out, my fine fellow,' cried my grandfather, `and see if the water has spotted your clothes.' Quelala was much too wise not to swim, and he was not in the least spoiled by all his good fortune.
uz: Qolala ko'z o'ngida suzmaslikka juda aqlli edi va butun omadidan hech qanday zarar ko'rmadi.

en: He laughed, when he came to the top of the water, and swam in to shore.
uz: U suvning yuqori tomoniga yetib, qirg'oqqa suzdi.

en: But when Gayelette came running out to him she found his silks and velvet all ruined by the river.
uz: Ammo Gayelet uning oldiga yugurib kelganida, uning ipkalari va sumkalari daryo tomonidan vayron bo'lganini ko'rdi.

en: "The princess was angry, and she knew, of course, who did it.
uz: "Printsesa g'azabga to'ldi va, albatta, kim aybdor ekanini biladi.

en: She had all the Winged Monkeys brought before her, and she said at first that their wings should be tied and they should be treated as they had treated Quelala, and dropped in the river.
uz: U barcha qanotli maymunlarni o'ziga olib keldi va dastlab u ularning qanotlarini bog'lab, Quelalaga qanday munosabatda bo'lgan bo'lsa, ularga ham shunday munosabatda bo'lishlarini va daryoga tushishini aytdi.

en: But my grandfather pleaded hard, for he knew the Monkeys would drown in the river with their wings tied, and Quelala said a kind word for them also; so that Gayelette finally spared them, on condition that the Winged Monkeys should ever after do three times the bidding of the owner of the Golden Cap.
uz: Ammo buvim qattiq iltijo qildi, chunki u Maymunlar qanotlari bog'langan holda daryoga cho'kishini bilardi va Quelala ularga ham mehribon so'z aytdi; shuning uchun Gayeletta ularni oxir-oqibat qutqardi, shunda qanotli Maymunlar oltin to'pka egasining uch baravar buyruqini bajarishlari kerak edi.

en: This Cap had been made for a wedding present to Quelala, and it is said to have cost the princess half her kingdom.
uz: Bu toʻpka Quelalaga toʻy sovgʻasi sifatida tayyorlangan va bu printsessga uning shohligining yarmidan ziyod pul sarflaganligi aytilgan.

en: Of course my grandfather and all the other Monkeys at once agreed to the condition, and that is how it happens that we are three times the slaves of the owner of the Golden Cap, whosoever he may be." "And what became of them?" asked Dorothy, who had been greatly interested in the story.
uz: Albatta, bobom va boshqa Maymunlar birdan shartiga rozi bo'ldilar va bizlar, kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, oltin to'pka egasining uch baravar qullari bo'lishimiz mumkin. " - Va ularning nima bo'ldi? - deb so'radi hikoya bilan juda qiziqqan Doroti.

en: "Quelala being the first owner of the Golden Cap," replied the Monkey, "he was the first to lay his wishes upon us.
uz: "Qelala oltin to'pka birinchi egasi bo'lgani sababli, bizlarga o'z xohishini birinchi o'zi bergan", - deb javob berdi Maymun.

en: As his bride could not bear the sight of us, he called us all to him in the forest after he had married her and ordered us always to keep where she could never again set eyes on a Winged Monkey, which we were glad to do, for we were all afraid of her.
uz: Uning kelini bizni ko'rishga chiday olmagani uchun, uni turmushga chiqarganidan so'ng, bizni o'rmonda o'ziga chaqirib, qayerda bo'lmasin qo'yib qo'yishni buyurdi, chunki u yana bir marta qanotli maymunni ko'rmasdi.

en: "This was all we ever had to do until the Golden Cap fell into the hands of the Wicked Witch of the West, who made us enslave the Winkies, and afterward drive Oz himself out of the Land of the West.
uz: "Altin toʻpka Gʻarbning yovuz sehrgarining qoʻliga tushmaguncha, bu bizlarni Winkiesga qul qilib qoʻygan va keyinchalik Ozni Gʻarb yurtidan haydab chiqarganimizcha, bu bizning barcha ishimiz edi.

en: Now the Golden Cap is yours, and three times you have the right to lay your wishes upon us." As the Monkey King finished his story Dorothy looked down and saw the green, shining walls of the Emerald City before them.
uz: Endi oltin toʻpka siznikidir va uch marta siz bizdan xohishingizni soʻrash huquqiga egasiz". Maymun Podshohi hikoyasini tugatganida, Doroti pastga qarab koʻrdi va ular oldida Zamarald shahrining yashil, yorqin devorlarini koʻrdi.

en: She wondered at the rapid flight of the Monkeys, but was glad the journey was over.
uz: U Maymunlarning tez uchuvidan hayron edi, ammo sayohat tugashiga xursand edi.

en: The strange creatures set the travelers down carefully before the gate of the City, the King bowed low to Dorothy, and then flew swiftly away, followed by all his band.
uz: Qizig'i mavjudotlar sayohatchilarni shahar darvozalari oldida ehtiyotkorlik bilan joylashtirdi, shoh Dorotsiyaga sajda qildi va tezda uzib ketdi, uning orqasidan butun to'plami ergashib ketdi.

en: "That was a good ride," said the little girl.
uz: "Bu yaxshi sayohat edi", dedi kichkina qiz.

en: "Yes, and a quick way out of our troubles," replied the Lion.
uz: "Ha, va muammolarimizdan tezda xalos bo'lishimiz mumkin", - deb javob berdi Arslon.

en: "How lucky it was you brought away that wonderful Cap!"
uz: "Bu ajoyib kapani olib kelganingiz naqadar baxtli edi!"

en: Chapter XV The Discovery of Oz, the Terrible The four travelers walked up to the great gate of Emerald City and rang the bell.
uz: XV bob Ozning kashfiyoti, dahshatli To'rtta sayohatchi Emerald Cityning buyuk darvozalariga yetib kelib, qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: After ringing several times, it was opened by the same Guardian of the Gates they had met before.
uz: Bir necha marta qo'ng'iroq qilganidan so'ng, ular ilgari uchrashib kelgan darvoza qo'riqchisi tomonidan ochildi.

en: are you back again?" he asked, in surprise.
uz: Yana qaytib keldingmi?" - deb so'radi u hayratda.

en: "Do you not see us?" answered the Scarecrow.
uz: - Bizni ko'rmayapsanmi? - deb javob berdi qo'rqinchli.

en: "But I thought you had gone to visit the Wicked Witch of the West." "We did visit her," said the Scarecrow.
uz: - Lekin men siz G'arbning yovuz sehrgarisiga tashrif buyurganingizni o'ylardim. - Biz uni tashrif buyurdik, - dedi qo'rqinchli.

en: "And she let you go again?" asked the man, in wonder.
uz: "U seni yana qo'yib yubordi?" - deb hayron bo'lgan kishi so'radi.

en: "She could not help it, for she is melted," explained the Scarecrow.
uz: "U o'ziga yordam bera olmadi, chunki u erishib ketgan", - deb tushuntirdi qo'rqinchli.

en: Well, that is good news, indeed," said the man.
uz: Ha, bu, albatta, yaxshi xabar", - dedi yigit.

en: "Who melted her?" "It was Dorothy," said the Lion gravely.
uz: "Uni kim eritdi?" - dedi Arslon og'irlik bilan. - Bu Doroti edi.

en: "Good gracious!" exclaimed the man, and he bowed very low indeed before her.
uz: - Yaxshi, mehribon! - deb hayqirib, ayolning oldida juda past o'zini egalladi.

en: Then he led them into his little room and locked the spectacles from the great box on all their eyes, just as he had done before.
uz: So'ngra u ularni o'zining kichik xonasiga olib kirdi va avvalgidek, katta qutidagi ko'zgularni ularning ko'zlariga qulflab qo'ydi.

en: Afterward they passed on through the gate into the Emerald City.
uz: So'ng ular eshikdan Emerald shaharga o'tishdi.

en: When the people heard from the Guardian of the Gates that Dorothy had melted the Wicked Witch of the West, they all gathered around the travelers and followed them in a great crowd to the Palace of Oz.
uz: Darvozalar himoyachisidan Dorotining G'arbning yovuz sehrgarini eritganini eshitgan odamlar sayohatchilar atrofida to'planib, katta xaloyiqda Oz saroyiga yetib kelishdi.

en: The soldier with the green whiskers was still on guard before the door, but he let them in at once, and they were again met by the beautiful green girl, who showed each of them to their old rooms at once, so they might rest until the Great Oz was ready to receive them.
uz: Yashil mustakkalli askar eshik oldida hali ham qo'riqchi bo'lib turgan edi, lekin u ularni darhol kirishga ruxsat berdi va ularni yana go'zal yashil qiz uchratdi, u har biriga eski xonalarini bir marta ko'rsatdi, shunda ular Buyuk Oz ularni qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lgunga qadar dam olishlari mumkin edi.

en: The soldier had the news carried straight to Oz that Dorothy and the other travelers had come back again, after destroying the Wicked Witch; but Oz made no reply.
uz: Askar, Doroti va boshqa sayohatchilar yovuz sehrgarni yo'q qilib, yana qaytganligi haqidagi xabarni Ozga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetkazdi; lekin Oz hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: They thought the Great Wizard would send for them at once, but he did not.
uz: Ular buyuk sehrgar ularni darhol chaqiradi deb o'ylashgan, lekin u bunday qilmadi.

en: They had no word from him the next day, nor the next, nor the next.
uz: Ertasi kuni ham, ertasi kuni ham, ertasi kuni ham undan hech qanday xabar olishmadi.

en: The waiting was tiresome and wearing, and at last they grew vexed that Oz should treat them in so poor a fashion, after sending them to undergo hardships and slavery.
uz: Kutilish charchatadigan va ishlov bermaydigan edi va nihoyat, Oz ularni og'irlik va qullikka yuborganidan so'ng, ularga yomon munosabatda bo'lishidan xafa bo'lishdi.

en: So the Scarecrow at last asked the green girl to take another message to Oz, saying if he did not let them in to see him at once they would call the Winged Monkeys to help them, and find out whether he kept his promises or not.
uz: Shunday qilib, qo'rqinchli qiz nihoyat yashil qizdan Ozga boshqa xabarni olib borishni so'radi va agar u ularni uni ko'rish uchun darhol kirishiga yo'l qo'ymasa, u qanotli maymonga yordam berishini va va'dalariga rioya qilgan- qilmaganini bilib olishlarini aytdi.

en: When the Wizard was given this message he was so frightened that he sent word for them to come to the Throne Room at four minutes after nine o'clock the next morning.
uz: Bu xabar sehrgarga berilganida u shunchalik qo'rqqanki, ertasi kuni ertalab soat to'qqizdan keyin to'rt daqiqa o'tgach, ularni taxt xonasida bo'lishlari haqida xabar yubordi.

en: He had once met the Winged Monkeys in the Land of the West, and he did not wish to meet them again.
uz: U bir marta G'arb mamlakatida qanotli maymunlar bilan uchrashgan va ular bilan yana uchrashishni istamagan.

en: The four travelers passed a sleepless night, each thinking of the gift Oz had promised to bestow on him.
uz: To'rtta sayohatchi uyqusiz bir kecha o'tkazdi, har biri Oz unga berishni va'da qilgan sovg'ani o'ylaydi.

en: Dorothy fell asleep only once, and then she dreamed she was in Kansas, where Aunt Em was telling her how glad she was to have her little girl at home again.
uz: Dorotsiya faqat bir marta uxlab qoldi va keyin u Kanzasda bo'lganini tushirdi, u erda Em qoni qayerda bo'lganini aytadi.

en: Promptly at nine o'clock the next morning the green-whiskered soldier came to them, and four minutes later they all went into the Throne Room of the Great Oz.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab soat to'qqizlarda yashil chekili askar ularning oldiga keldi va to'rt daqiqa o'tgach, ular hammasi Buyuk Ozning taxti xonasiga kirishdi.

en: Of course each one of them expected to see the Wizard in the shape he had taken before, and all were greatly surprised when they looked about and saw no one at all in the room.
uz: Albatta, ularning har biri sehrgarni avvalgi shaklida ko'rishni kutardi va hamma atrofga qarab, xonada hech kimni ko'rmaganlarida juda hayron bo'ldilar.

en: the door and closer to one another, for the stillness of the empty room was more dreadful than any of the forms they had seen Oz take.
uz: Eshik va bir-biriga yaqinroq bo'lish, chunki bo'sh xonaning tinchligi ular Ozni ko'rgan har qanday shakllaridan ham dahshatli edi.

en: Presently they heard a solemn Voice, that seemed to come from somewhere near the top of the great dome, and it said: "I am Oz, the Great and Terrible.
uz: O'sha zahoti ular buyuk kupolning tomoniga yaqin bir joydan kelib chiqqanidek tuyulgan tantanali ovozning ovozini eshitishdi va u shunday dedi: "Men Oz, buyuk va dahshatli odamman.

en: Why do you seek me?" They looked again in every part of the room, and then, seeing no one, Dorothy asked, "Where are you?" "I am everywhere," answered the Voice, "but to the eyes of common mortals I am invisible.
uz: Nima uchun meni qidiryapsiz?" - deb so'radilar.Ular xonaning har bir qismini yana ko'rib, keyin hech kimni ko'rmay, Doroti: "Qayersiz?" - deb so'radi.Sov: "Men har yerda bo'laman, ammo oddiy insoniyat ko'zlariga ko'rinmasman.

en: I will now seat myself upon my throne, that you may converse with me." Indeed, the Voice seemed just then to come straight from the throne itself; so they walked toward it and stood in a row while Dorothy said: "We have come to claim our promise, O Oz." "What promise?" asked Oz.
uz: Endi men o'zimni taxtga o'tirtiraman, toki sen men bilan gaplashasan". Haqiqatan ham, ovoz o'sha paytda taxtning o'zidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelib turgandek tuyuldi; shuning uchun ular unga yaqinlashib, qatorda turishdi va Doroti shunday dedi: "Biz va'damizni talab qilishga keldik, ey Oz". "Qanday va'da?" - deb so'radi Oz.

en: "You promised to send me back to Kansas when the Wicked Witch was destroyed," said the girl.
uz: "Sen meni Kansanzga qaytarib yuborishga va'da bergan eding, chunki Yovuz sehrgar yo'q qilinganida", dedi qiz.

en: "And you promised to give me brains," said the Scarecrow.
uz: - Va menga miya berishga va'da berding, - dedi qo'rqinchli.

en: "And you promised to give me a heart," said the Tin Woodman.
uz: "Siz menga yurak berishga va'da bergan edingiz", dedi Tin Woodman.

en: "And you promised to give me courage," said the Cowardly Lion.
uz: - Va menga jasorat berishga va'da berding, - dedi qo'rqoq sher.

en: "Is the Wicked Witch really destroyed?" asked the Voice, and Dorothy thought it trembled a little.
uz: "Xudojo'y qiz haqiqatan ham yo'q qilinganmi?" - deb so'radi ovoz va Doroti uning biroz titraganini his qildi.

en: "Yes," she answered, "I melted her with a bucket of water." "Dear me," said the Voice, "how sudden!
uz: "Ha, - deb javob berdi u, - men uni bir qadoq suv bilan eritdim. - Aziz menga, - dedi ovoz, - naqadar to'satdan!

en: Well, come to me tomorrow, for I must have time to think it over." "You've had plenty of time already," said the Tin Woodman angrily.
uz: Ertaga mendan so'rasang, chunki bu haqda o'ylashga vaqtim bo'lishi kerak". - Sizda allaqachon ko'p vaqt bor edi, - dedi Tin Woodman g'azabga to'lib.

en: "We shan't wait a day longer," said the Scarecrow.
uz: "Biz bir kun ham kutmaymiz", - dedi qo'rqinchli.

en: "You must keep your promises to us!" exclaimed Dorothy.
uz: "Siz bizga bergan va'dalaringizni bajarishingiz kerak!" - dedi Doroti.

en: The Lion thought it might be as well to frighten the Wizard, so he gave a large, loud roar, which was so fierce and dreadful that Toto jumped away from him in alarm and tipped over the screen that stood in a corner.
uz: Arslon sehrgarni qo'rqitish ham yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin deb o'yladi, shuning uchun u juda kuchli va dahshatli qichqiriq qildi, hatto Toto qo'rqinchga to'lib, undan qochib ketdi va burchada turgan ekrani ko'tardi.

en: As it fell with a crash they looked that way, and the next moment all of them were filled with wonder.
uz: U to'xtab tushib ketganda, ular o'sha tomondan ko'rinishdi va keyingi daqiqada hammasi hayratga tushdi.

en: For they saw, standing in just the spot the screen had hidden, a little old man, with a bald head and a wrinkled face, who seemed to be as much surprised as they were.
uz: Chunki ular ko'rishardiki, ekranning yashirgan joyida kichkinagina oqsoqol, sochli bosh va burqlangan yuzi turgan edi va u ham o'zlari kabi hayron bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: The Tin Woodman, raising his axe, rushed toward the little man and cried out, "Who are you?" "I am Oz, the Great and Terrible," said the little man, in a trembling voice.
uz: Tin Woodman o'z baltini ko'tarib, kichkina odamning yoniga yugurib: "Sen kimsan?" - deb baqirdi.

en: "But don't strike me—please don't—and I'll do anything you want me to." Our friends looked at him in surprise and dismay.
uz: "Ammo menga urma, iltimos, qilma, men siz xohlagan har qanday ishni qilaman". Do'stlarimiz uni hayron va xavotirga to'lib ko'rdilar.

en: "I thought Oz was a great Head," said Dorothy.
uz: "Oz ajoyib boshchi deb o'ylardim", - dedi Doroti.

en: "And I thought Oz was a lovely Lady," said the Scarecrow.
uz: "Oz go'zal xonim deb o'yladim", - dedi qo'rqinchli.

en: "And I thought Oz was a terrible Beast," said the Tin Woodman.
uz: "Men Ozni dahshatli hayvon deb o'ylardim", - dedi Tin Woodman.

en: "And I thought Oz was a Ball of Fire," exclaimed the Lion.
uz: "Men Ozni olov toʻplami deb oʻylardim", - dedi sher.

en: "No, you are all wrong," said the little man meekly.
uz: "Yo'q, hammangiz noto'g'ri yo'ldan ozdirasizlar", - dedi kichkina odam kamtarinlik bilan.

en: "I have been making believe." "Making believe!" cried Dorothy.
uz: "Men ishonib topshirganman". - deb baqirdi Dorotsiya. "Men ishonib topshirganman!" - dedi Dorotsiya.

en: "Are you not a Great Wizard?" "Hush, my dear," he said.
uz: "Siz buyuk sehrgar emasmisiz?" - dedi u.

en: "Don't speak so loud, or you will be overheard—and I should be ruined.
uz: "Ushbu qadar baland ovozda gapirmang, yo'q bo'lsa sen eshitib ketasan va men ham vayron bo'laman.

en: I'm supposed to be a Great Wizard." "And aren't you?" she asked.
uz: Men buyuk sehrgar bo'lishim kerak". - "Siz ham shunday emasmisiz?" deb so'radi u.

en: "Not a bit of it, my dear; I'm just a common man." "You're more than that," said the Scarecrow, in a grieved tone; "you're a humbug." "Exactly so!" declared the little man, rubbing his hands together as if it pleased him.
uz: "Ozgina emas, azizim; men oddiy odamman". - Siz bundan ham ko'proqsiz, - dedi qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli so'zlar bilan, - siz bir qo'rqinchsiz. - To'g'ri shunday! - dedi kichkinagina odam, qo'llarini o'ziga yoqtirganidek aralashtirib.

en: "But this is terrible," said the Tin Woodman.
uz: "Ammo bu dahshatli", dedi Tin Woodman.

en: "How shall I ever get my heart?" "Or I my courage?" asked the Lion.
uz: "O'z yuragimni qayerdan topaman?" - deb so'radi Arslon.

en: "Or I my brains?" wailed the Scarecrow, wiping the tears from his eyes with his coat sleeve.
uz: "Yoki mening miyammi?" - deb qayg'urdi qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli, ko'zidagi yoshlarni ko'rinmas qo'rqinch bilan o'chirib tashladi.

en: "My dear friends," said Oz, "I pray you not to speak of these little things.
uz: "Dor do'stlarim", - dedi Oz, "bu kichik narsalar haqida gapirmasligingizni iltijo qilaman.

en: Think of me, and the terrible trouble I'm in at being found out." "Doesn't anyone else know you're a humbug?" asked Dorothy.
uz: Men va o'zimni aniqlashga tushayotgan dahshatli muammolar haqida o'ylab ko'ring". - Siz o'zingizning hambug ekanligingizni boshqa hech kim bilmaydimi? - deb so'radi Dorotsiya.

en: "No one knows it but you four—and myself," replied Oz.
uz: Oz javob berdi: "Sening va o'zimdan boshqa hech kim buni bilmaydi.

en: "I have fooled everyone so long that I thought I should never be found out.
uz: "Men hammani shunchalik uzoq vaqt aldadimki, hech qachon topilmasligi kerak deb o'yladim.

en: It was a great mistake my ever letting you into the Throne Room.
uz: Sizni Taxt Xonasiga kirishga ruxsat berish katta xato bo'ldi.

en: Usually I will not see even my subjects, and so they believe I am something terrible." "But, I don't understand," said Dorothy, in bewilderment.
uz: Odatda men hatto o'z sub'ektlarimni ham ko'rmayman va ular meni dahshatli bir narsa deb o'ylashadi". - Lekin men tushunmayapman, - dedi Dorotsiya hayronlik bilan.

en: "How was it that you appeared to me as a great Head?" "That was one of my tricks," answered Oz.
uz: "Nima uchun menga buyuk Bosh sifatida ko'rinarding?" - deb javob berdi Oz. - Bu mening hiylalarimdan biri edi.

en: "Step this way, please, and I will tell you all about it." He led the way to a small chamber in the rear of the Throne Room, and they all followed him.
uz: - Iltimos, shu yo'ldan yuringlar, men sizlarga hamma narsani aytib beraman. - dedi u. - Taxt Xonasining orqa qismidagi kichik xonaga yetaklab bordi va hamma uning orqasidan ergashdi.

en: He pointed to one corner, in which lay the great Head, made out of many thicknesses of paper, and with a carefully painted face.
uz: U bir burchada ko'p qalinlikdagi qog'ozdan yasalgan va diqqat bilan bo'yilgan yuziga ega bo'lgan ulkan Boshni ko'rsatdi.

en: "This I hung from the ceiling by a wire," said Oz.
uz: "Men buni simdan osganman", dedi Oz.

en: "I stood behind the screen and pulled a thread, to make the eyes move and the mouth open." "But how about the voice?" she inquired.
uz: "Men ekran orqasida turib, ko'zlar ko'rinishi va og'zim ochilishi uchun ip tortib oldim", - deb so'radi u.

en: "Oh, I am a ventriloquist," said the little man.
uz: "O, men ventrilokistman", dedi kichkina odam.

en: "I can throw the sound of my voice wherever I wish, so that you thought it was coming out of the Head.
uz: "O'zim xohlagan joyga ovozimni tashlab qo'yishim mumkin, shuning uchun siz uni boshdan chiqarayotgan deb o'ylar edingiz.

en: Here are the other things I used to deceive you." He showed the Scarecrow the dress and the mask he had worn when he seemed to be the lovely Lady.

uz: Buni qo'rqqan Arslonning oldiga qo'yib, u unga yoqmagan bo'lsa-da, sehrgar: "Ish. " - deb so'radi. - Bu nima?" - deb so'radi Arslon.

en: "Well," answered Oz, "if it were inside of you, it would be courage.
uz: Oz javob berdi: "Agar bu sizning ichingizda bo'lganida, bu jasorat bo'lardi.

en: You know, of course, that courage is always inside one; so that this really cannot be called courage until you have swallowed it.
uz: Albatta, shu jasorat har doim inson ichida, shuning uchun uni yutib yubormaguningizcha, uni jasorat deb atash mumkin emas.

en: Therefore I advise you to drink it as soon as possible." The Lion hesitated no longer, but drank till the dish was empty.
uz: Shuning uchun men sizga imkon qadar tezroq ichishni maslahat beraman".Sher endi tortinmay, pishirgancha ichdi.

en: "How do you feel now?" asked Oz.
uz: "O'zingizni endi qanday his qilyapsiz?" - deb so'radi Oz.

en: "Full of courage," replied the Lion, who went joyfully back to his friends to tell them of his good fortune.
uz: "Toʻla jasorat bilan", - deb javob berdi Arslon, xursand boʻlib, doʻstlariga omadini aytib berish uchun qaytib keldi.

en: Oz, left to himself, smiled to think of his success in giving the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman and the Lion exactly what they thought they wanted.
uz: Oz o'zi uchun qoldirilgan holda, qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli va Tin Woodman va Arslonga o'zlari xohlagan narsani berishdagi muvaffaqiyatini ko'rib, tabassum qildi.

en: "How can I help being a humbug," he said, "when all these people make me do things that everybody knows can't be done?
uz: U shunday dedi: "Boshqa odamlar meni hamma qila olmaydigan ishlarni qilishga majburlaganida, men qanday qilib o'zimni o'g'irlatishga yordam bersam bo'ladi?

en: It was easy to make the Scarecrow and the Lion and the Woodman happy, because they imagined I could do anything.
uz: Qo'rqinchli, Arslon va Vudmanni baxtli qilish oson edi, chunki ular mening hamma narsani qila olaman deb o'ylashgan.

en: But it will take more than imagination to carry Dorothy back to Kansas, and I'm sure I don't know how it can be done."
uz: Ammo Dorotiyani Kanzasga qaytarish uchun tasavvurdan ko'ra ko'proq narsa kerak bo'ladi va shubhasizki, buni qanday qilish mumkinligini bilmayman".

en: Chapter XVII How the Balloon Was Launched For three days Dorothy heard nothing from Oz.
uz: 17-bob Balon qanday ishga tushirilganligi Uch kun davomida Doroti Ozdan hech narsa eshitmagan.

en: These were sad days for the little girl, although her friends were all quite happy and contented.
uz: Bu qizcha uchun og'ir kunlar edi, ammo uning do'stlari hammasi juda baxtli va mamnun edi.

en: The Scarecrow told them there were wonderful thoughts in his head; but he would not say what they were because he knew no one could understand them but himself.
uz: Qo'rqinchli o'zlarining boshida ajoyib fikrlar borligini aytdi, lekin ular nima ekanligini aytmadi, chunki u ularni o'zidan boshqa hech kim tushunolmasligini bilardi.

en: When the Tin Woodman walked about he felt his heart rattling around in his breast; and he told Dorothy he had discovered it to be a kinder and more tender heart than the one he had owned when he was made of flesh.
uz: Tin Woodman yurganida, uning yuragi ko'kraklarida urib ketayotganini sezdi va u Dorothyga uning go'shtdan yasalganida ega bo'lgan yuragidan ko'ra mehribonroq va mehribonroq yuragini topganini aytdi.

en: The Lion declared he was afraid of nothing on earth, and would gladly face an army or a dozen of the fierce Kalidahs.
uz: Arslon yer yuzidagi hech narsadan qo'rqmasligini va o'nlab zo'ravon Kalidalar armiyasiga qarshi kurashishni xohlayotganini e'lon qildi.

en: Thus each of the little party was satisfied except Dorothy, who longed more than ever to get back to Kansas.
uz: Shunday qilib, kichik guruhning har bir a'zosi qoniqarli bo'ldi, faqat Doroti bundan mustasno edi, chunki u Kanzasga qaytishni har qachongidan ko'proq orzu qilardi.

en: On the fourth day, to her great joy, Oz sent for her, and when she entered the Throne Room he greeted her pleasantly: "Sit down, my dear; I think I have found the way to get you out of this country." "And back to Kansas?" she asked eagerly.
uz: To'rtinchi kuni, Oz uni chaqirtirib yubordi va u taxt xonasidan kirganida, u uni xushmuomalalik bilan kutib oldi: "O'tir, azizim; men seni bu mamlakatdan chiqarish yo'lini topdim, deb o'ylayman".

en: "Well, I'm not sure about Kansas," said Oz, "for I haven't the faintest notion which way it lies.
uz: "Kansas haqida amin emasman", - dedi Oz, "chunki uning qaysi yo'l bilan joylashganligi haqida hech qanday tasavvurim yo'q.

en: But the first thing to do is to cross the desert, and then it should be easy to find your way home."
uz: Ammo birinchi bo'lib sahro bo'ylab o'tish kerak, keyin esa uyga borish oson bo'lishi kerak".

en: "How can I cross the desert?" she inquired.
uz: U: "Men sahro orqali qanday o'tishim mumkin?" - deb so'radi.

en: "Well, I'll tell you what I think," said the little man.
uz: "Men sizga o'zimning fikrimni aytaman", dedi kichkina odam.

en: "You see, when I came to this country it was in a balloon.
uz: "Bilasizmi, men bu mamlakatga kelganimda, u balon ichida edi.

en: You also came through the air, being carried by a cyclone.
uz: Siz ham shamol tomonidan ko'tarilib, havo orqali kelgansiz.

en: So I believe the best way to get across the desert will be through the air.
uz: Shunday qilib, cho'ldan kesib o'tishning eng yaxshi usuli havo orqali bo'ladi deb o'ylayman.

en: Now, it is quite beyond my powers to make a cyclone; but I've been thinking the matter over, and I believe I can make a balloon." "How?" asked Dorothy.
uz: Shundan so'ng, to'fonni yaratish mening qo'limdan chiqib ketadi, lekin men bu haqda o'ylab ko'rdim va o'zimga o'ylaymanki, men ballon yarata olaman". - "Qanday?" - deb so'radi Dorotsiya.

en: "A balloon," said Oz, "is made of silk, which is coated with glue to keep the gas in it.
uz: Oz shunday dedi: "Balon ipakdan yasalgan bo'lib, unda gaz saqlanishi uchun uni yopishqoq bilan qoplaydilar.

en: I have plenty of silk in the Palace, so it will be no trouble to make the balloon.
uz: Qishlog'imda ko'pgina ipak bor, shuning uchun ballonni tayyorlashda hech qanday muammo bo'lmaydi.

en: But in all this country there is no gas to fill the balloon with, to make it float." "If it won't float," remarked Dorothy, "it will be of no use to us." "True," answered Oz.
uz: Ammo bu mamlakatda ballonni to'ldirish, uni suzish uchun gaz yo'q". "Agar u suzmasa", dedi Dorotsiya, "bu bizga hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi". "Haqiqatan ham", deb javob berdi Oz.

en: "But there is another way to make it float, which is to fill it with hot air.
uz: Ammo uni suzishning yana bir usuli bor: uni issiq havo bilan to'ldirish.

en: Hot air isn't as good as gas, for if the air should get cold the balloon would come down in the desert, and we should be lost." "We!" exclaimed the girl.
uz: Issiq havo gaz kabi yaxshi emas, chunki agar havo sovuq bo'lsa, ballon sahroda tushadi va biz yo'qolishimiz kerak".

en: "Are you going with me?" "Yes, of course," replied Oz.
uz: Oz: "Men bilan kelayapsizmi?" - deb javob berdi.

en: "I am tired of being such a humbug.
uz: "Men bunday g'alati bo'lishdan charchadim.

en: If I should go out of this Palace my people would soon discover I am not a Wizard, and then they would be vexed with me for having deceived them.
uz: Agar men bu saroydan chiqib ketsam, xalqim tez orada mening sehrgar emasligimni bilib oladi va ularni aldash uchun men bilan xafa bo'ladilar.

en: So I have to stay shut up in these rooms all day, and it gets tiresome.
uz: Shunday qilib, men butun kun bu xonalarda xalos bo'lishim kerak va bu charchatadigan bo'ladi.

en: I'd much rather go back to Kansas with you and be in a circus again." "I shall be glad to have your company," said Dorothy.
uz: Men siz bilan birga Kanzasga qaytib borib, yana sirkda ishtirok etishni afzal ko'raman". - Men sizning kompaniyangizdan mamnun bo'laman, - dedi Doroti.

en: "Thank you," he answered.
uz: "Rahmat", deb javob berdi u.

en: "Now, if you will help me sew the silk together, we will begin to work on our balloon." So Dorothy took a needle and thread, and as fast as Oz cut the strips of silk into proper shape the girl sewed them neatly together.
uz: "Agar siz menga ipakni tikishga yordam bersangiz, biz ballonimiz ustida ishlashni boshlaymiz".Dorothy igna va ipni oldi va Oz ipakni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ygani sayin qiz ularni yaxshi tikdi.

en: First there was a strip of light green silk, then a strip of dark green and then a strip of emerald green; for Oz had a fancy to make the
uz: Avval yorug' yashil ipak, so'ngra qorong'u yashil va keyin zamarald yashil bo'lak bor edi; chunki Ozning o'ylashicha, bu yumshoq ipkalar yaratilgan.

en: balloon in different shades of the color about them.
uz: Ular atrofida turli rangdagi ballon bor.

en: It took three days to sew all the strips together, but when it was finished they had a big bag of green silk more than twenty feet long.
uz: Barcha tirajlarni bir-biriga tikish uchun uch kun kerak bo'ldi, lekin bitgach, ular yigirma futdan ortiq uzun bo'lgan katta yashil ipak to'plamini topdilar.

en: Then Oz painted it on the inside with a coat of thin glue, to make it airtight, after which he announced that the balloon was ready.
uz: Keyin Oz uni havoga chidamli qilish uchun ichki qismini kamroq yopishqoq qopqoq bilan bo'yashtiribdi, so'ng esa balon tayyor ekanini e'lon qildi.

en: "But we must have a basket to ride in," he said.
uz: "Ammo bizda sayohat qilish uchun koska bo'lishi kerak", dedi u.

en: So he sent the soldier with the green whiskers for a big clothes basket, which he fastened with many ropes to the bottom of the balloon.
uz: Shuning uchun u yashil mustaxli askarni katta kiyim koshi uchun yubordi va uni ko'plab iplar bilan balonning pastki qismiga bog'ladi.

en: When it was all ready, Oz sent word to his people that he was going to make a visit to a great brother Wizard who lived in the clouds.
uz: Hamma narsa tayyor bo'lganida, Oz o'z odamlariga bulutlarda yashovchi buyuk bir birodarimiz sehrgarning oldiga borishini xabar qildi.

en: The news spread rapidly throughout the city and everyone came to see the wonderful sight.
uz: Xabar butun shaharga tez tarqaldi va hamma ajoyib manzarani ko'rishga keldi.

en: Oz ordered the balloon carried out in front of the Palace, and the people gazed upon it with much curiosity.
uz: Oz saroy oldidagi ballonni olib chiqishni buyurdi va odamlar uni qiziqarli ko'rishdi.

en: The Tin Woodman had chopped a big pile of wood, and now he made a fire of it, and Oz held the bottom of the balloon over the fire so that the hot air that arose from it would be caught in the silken bag.
uz: Tin Woodman katta daraxt to'plamini kesib qo'ygan edi va endi u undan olov yaratgan edi, Oz esa balonaning pastini olov ustida ushlab turardi, shunda undan paydo bo'lgan issiq havo ipak sumkasida to'planib ketardi.

en: Gradually the balloon swelled out and rose into the air, until finally the basket just touched the ground.
uz: Butunlab balon yuzaga chiqib, havoga ko'tarildi, nihoyat koska yerga tushib qoldi.

en: Then Oz got into the basket and said to all the people in a loud voice: "I am now going away to make a visit.
uz: Keyin O'z koskaga kirdi va baland ovoz bilan barchaga shunday dedi: "Men endi tashrif buyurish uchun ketyapman.

en: While I am gone the Scarecrow will rule over you.
uz: Men ketayotganimda, qo'rqinchli odam siz ustidan hukmronlik qiladi.

en: I command you to obey him as you would me." The balloon was by this time tugging hard at the rope that held it to the ground, for the air within it was hot, and this made it so much lighter in weight than the air without that it pulled hard to rise into the sky.
uz: Men sizlarga buyuraman, siz unga menga bo'ysunganingizdek itoat etinglar". Balon uni yerga ushlab turadigan ipni qattiq ushlab turardi, chunki uning ichidagi havo issiq edi va bu uni havoga qaraganda og'irroq qilib qo'ygan edi, shuning uchun u osmonga ko'tarilish uchun qattiq ushlab turardi.

en: "Come, Dorothy!" cried the Wizard.
uz: - Kel, Doroti! - deb baqirdi sehrgar.

en: "Hurry up, or the balloon will fly away." "I can't find Toto anywhere," replied Dorothy, who did not wish to leave her little dog behind.
uz: "Shoshil, yoki balon uchib ketadi. " - Men hech joyda Totoni topolmayman, - dedi Dorotsiya, o'z itini tashlab ketishni istamagan.

en: Toto had run into the crowd to bark at a
uz: To'to odamlarning ko'pligiga to'xtab, bir kishiga qichqirgan edi.

en: kitten, and Dorothy at last found him.
uz: Qizim, va Doroti nihoyat uni topdi.

en: She picked him up and ran towards the balloon.
uz: U uni ko'tarib, ballonga qarab yugurdi.

en: She was within a few steps of it, and Oz was holding out his hands to help her into the basket, when, crack!
uz: U undan bir necha qadam yaqinida edi va Oz qo'llarini uzatganida, uni koshiga olib kirishga yordam berardi.

en: went the ropes, and the balloon rose into the air without her.
uz: Xotiralar o'tib ketdi va balon usiz havoga ko'tarildi.

en: "Come back!" she screamed.
uz: "Qayta kel!" - deb baqirdi u.

en: "I want to go, too!" "I can't come back, my dear," called Oz from the basket.
uz: "Men ham bormoqchiman!" - deb so'radi Oz. - Men qaytib kelolmayman, azizim.

en: "Good- bye!" "Good-bye!" shouted everyone, and all eyes were turned upward to where the Wizard was riding in the basket, rising every moment farther and farther into the sky.
uz: "Xudojo'y!" - deb hayqirdi hamma, ko'zlari esa sehrgar kosida otlayotgan joyga ko'tarilib, har bir daqiqadan ko'proq osmonga ko'tarilib borardi.

en: And that was the last any of them ever saw of Oz, the Wonderful Wizard, though he may have reached Omaha safely, and be there now, for all we know.
uz: Va bu ularning hech biri Oz, ajoyib sehrgarni ko'rgan oxirgi edi, garchi u Omahaga omon-omon yetib borgan bo'lsa-da va hozir u yerda bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But the people remembered him lovingly, and said to one another: "Oz was always our friend.
uz: Lekin xalq uni sevgi ila esladi va bir-biriga: "Oz do'stimiz bo'lgan.

en: When he was here he built for us this beautiful Emerald City, and now he is gone he has left the Wise Scarecrow to rule over us." Still, for many days they grieved over the loss of the Wonderful Wizard, and would not be comforted.
uz: U bu yerda bo'lganida, bizga bu go'zal Emerald Shaharni qurdi va endi u yo'q bo'lib, dono qo'rqinchli qo'zg'olonni bizni hukmronlik qilish uchun tashlab ketdi". Shunday bo'lsa-da, ular ko'p kun davomida ajoyib sehrgarni yo'qotish uchun xafa bo'lishdi va tasalli topmadilar.

en: Chapter XVIII Away to the South Dorothy wept bitterly at the passing of her hope to get home to Kansas again; but when she thought it all over she was glad she had not gone up in a balloon.
uz: Janubiy tomonga sayohatda bo'lgan Doroti yana Kanzasga qaytish umidi yo'qolganida achchiq yig'ladi; lekin bu haqda o'ylab ko'rganida, u o'zini ballonda ko'tarmaganidan xursand bo'ldi.

en: And she also felt sorry at losing Oz, and so did her companions.
uz: Shuningdek, u Ozni yo'qotgani uchun ham, uning hamkorlari uchun ham achinar edi.

en: The Tin Woodman came to her and said: "Truly I should be ungrateful if I failed to mourn for the man who gave me my lovely heart.
uz: Tin Woodman uning oldiga kelib: "Agar menga sevimli yuragimni bergan odam uchun yig'lamagan bo'lsam, albatta, men minnatdorchilik bildirmayman.

en: I should like to cry a little because Oz is gone, if you will kindly wipe away my tears, so that I shall not rust." "With pleasure," she answered, and brought a towel at once.
uz: Oz yo'qolgani uchun biroz yig'lashni istardim, agar menga ro'za bo'lmasligi uchun ko'z yoshimni o'chirib tashlasangiz", - deb javob berdi u.

en: Then the Tin Woodman wept for several minutes, and she watched the tears carefully and wiped them away with the towel.
uz: Keyin Tin Woodman bir necha daqiqa davomida yig'ladi va ko'z yoshlarini diqqat bilan kuzatib, ularni charchoq bilan yuvdi.

en: When he had finished, he thanked her kindly and oiled himself thoroughly with his jeweled oil-can, to guard against mishap.
uz: Toʻgʻri, u ayolga minnatdorchilik bildirdi va oʻzini befarqlikdan himoya qilish uchun oʻzining marvarid yogʻli quroli bilan yaxshilab moyladi.

en: The Scarecrow was now the ruler of the Emerald City, and although he was not a Wizard the people were proud of him.
uz: Qo'rqinchli endi Zamarad shahri hokimi edi va u sehrgar bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da, odamlar u bilan faxrlanishardi.

en: "For," they said, "there is not another city in all the world that is ruled by a stuffed man." And, so far as they knew, they were quite right.
uz: Ular shunday deyishdi: "Dunyoda hech bir shaharga to'ldirilgan odam hukmronlik qilmaydi". Ular bilgancha, ular to'g'ri gapirishgan.

en: The morning after the balloon had gone up with Oz, the four travelers met in the Throne Room and talked matters over.
uz: Balon Oz bilan uchib ketganidan keyin ertalab to'rtta sayohatchi Taxt Xonasida uchrashdi va mavzularni muhokama qildilar.

en: Scarecrow sat in the big throne and the others stood respectfully before him.
uz: Qo'rqinchli ulkan taxtda o'tirdi va qolganlar uning oldida hurmat ila turdilar.

en: "We are not so unlucky," said the new ruler, "for this Palace and the Emerald City belong to us, and we can do just as we please.
uz: Yangi hukmdor shunday dedi: "Biz o'zimiz uchun baxtsiz emasmiz, chunki bu saroy va Emerald City bizga tegishli va biz o'zimiz xohlaganini qila olamiz.

en: When I remember that a short time ago I was up on a pole in a farmer's cornfield, and that now I am the ruler of this beautiful City, I am quite satisfied with my lot." "I also," said the Tin Woodman, "am well-pleased with my new heart; and, really, that was the only thing I wished in all the world." "For my part, I am content in knowing I am as brave as any beast that ever lived, if not braver," said the Lion modestly.
uz: Qisqa vaqt oldin bir fermerning donzorida ustun bo'lganimni va endi men bu go'zal shaharning hokimi ekanimni eslab, o'zimning taqdirimdan mamnunman". "Men ham, - dedi Tin Woodman, - yangi yuragimdan mamnunman; haqiqatan ham, bu butun dunyoda istagan yagona narsam edi". "Men o'zim uchun har qanday yirtqich hayvon kabi jasoratli, agar jasoratli bo'lmasam ham", - dedi Arslon kamtarlik bilan.

en: "If Dorothy would only be contented to live in the Emerald City," continued the Scarecrow, "we might all be happy together." "But I don't want to live here," cried Dorothy.
uz: "Agar Doroti Xamirturush shahrida yashashga rozi bo'lsa, biz hammamiz birga baxtli bo'lishimiz mumkin", - dedi qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchli. "Ammo men bu yerda yashashni istamayman", - deb baqirdi Doroti.

en: "I want to go to Kansas, and live with Aunt Em and Uncle Henry." "Well, then, what can be done?" inquired the Woodman.
uz: "Men Kanzasga borib, Em onasi va Xenri o'g'lim bilan yashashni xohlayman.

en: The Scarecrow decided to think, and he thought so hard that the pins and needles began to stick out of his brains.
uz: Qo'rqinchli o'ylab ko'rishga qaror qildi va u shunchalik qattiq o'yladiki, o'zining miyasidan ignalar chiqdi.

en: Finally he said: "Why not call the Winged Monkeys, and ask them to carry you over the desert?" "I never thought of that!" said Dorothy joyfully.
uz: Nihoyat u: "Nega Winged Monkeys-ni chaqirib, sizni sahroda ko'tarib ketishlarini so'rasangiz bo'ladi?" - deb so'radi.

en: "It's just the thing.
uz: "Bu shunchaki narsa.

en: I'll go at once for the Golden Cap." When she brought it into the Throne Room she spoke the magic words, and soon the band of Winged Monkeys flew in through the open window and stood beside her.
uz: Men darhol oltin toʻpka uchun boraman". Uni taxt xonasida olib kelganida u sehrli soʻzlarni aytdi va tez orada qanotli maymunlar guruhini ochilgan deraza orqali uchirib kirib, uning yonida turishdi.

en: "This is the second time you have called us," said the Monkey King, bowing before the little girl.
uz: "Siz bizni ikkinchi marta chaqirdingiz", - dedi Maymun Podshohi, qizchaga sajda qildi.

en: "What do you wish?" "I want you to fly with me to Kansas," said Dorothy.
uz: "Siz nima tilaysiz?" - dedi Doroti. - Men bilan birga Kanzasga uchishni xohlayman.

en: But the Monkey King shook his head.
uz: Ammo Maymun Podshohi boshini silkitdi.

en: "That cannot be done," he said.
uz: U: "Bu mumkin emas", dedi.

en: "We belong to this country alone, and cannot leave it.
uz: "Biz bu mamlakatga birgina tegishlimiz va uni tashlab ketolmaymiz.

en: There has never been a Winged Monkey in Kansas yet, and I suppose there never will be, for they don't belong there.
uz: Kanzasda hali qanotli maymun bo'lmagan va hech qachon bo'lmaydi, deb o'ylayman, chunki ular o'sha joyga tegishli emas.

en: We shall be glad to serve you in any way in our power, but we cannot cross the desert.
uz: Sizga imkonimiz boricha xizmat qilishdan mamnunmiz, ammo sahro orqali o'tishning imkoni yo'q.

en: Good-bye." And with another bow, the Monkey King spread his wings and flew away through the window, followed by all his band.
uz: Xullas. " Va yana bir qo'l bilan Maymun Podshohi qanotlarini tarqatdi va darcha orqali uchib ketdi, uning orqasidan butun guruh o'tib ketdi.

en: Dorothy was ready to cry with disappointment.
uz: Doroti ko'ngilsizlikdan yig'lashga tayyor edi.

en: "I have wasted the charm of the Golden Cap to no purpose," she said, "for the Winged Monkeys cannot help me." "It is certainly too bad!" said the tender-hearted Woodman.
uz: U shunday dedi: "Men oltin toʻpka goʻzalligini hech qanday maqsadga sarflamaganman, chunki qanotli maymunlar menga yordam bera olmaydilar".

en: The Scarecrow was thinking again, and his head bulged out so horribly that Dorothy feared it would burst.
uz: Qo'rqinchli yana o'ylay boshladi va uning boshi shunchalik ko'p bo'lib chiqdiki, Doroti u parchalanishini qo'rqib qo'ydi.

en: "Let us call in the soldier with the green whiskers," he said, "and ask his advice." So the soldier was summoned and entered the Throne Room timidly, for while Oz was alive he never was allowed to come farther than the door.
uz: "Yashil mo'yashli askarni chaqirib, uning maslahatini so'raylik", - dedi u. Shunday qilib, askar chaqirildi va u o'zidan ko'ra tirik bo'lgan Ozga hech qachon eshikdan uzoqroq kelishga ruxsat berilmaganidan u o'zidan qo'rqqan holda Taxt Xonasiga kirdi.

en: "This little girl," said the Scarecrow to the soldier, "wishes to cross the desert.
uz: "Bu kichkina qiz", - dedi qo'rqinchli askarga, "suvdan o'tishni istaydi.

en: How can she do so?" "I cannot tell," answered the soldier, "for nobody has ever crossed the desert, unless it is Oz himself." "Is there no one who can help me?" asked Dorothy earnestly.
uz: Qanday qilib u buni qila oladi?" - deb javob berdi askar, - "Men bilmayman, chunki hech kim hech qachon sahro orqali o'tmagan, faqat Oz o'zi o'tadi". - Menga yordam bera oladigan hech kim yo'qmi? - deb so'radi Dorotsiya samimiylik bilan.

en: "Glinda might," he suggested.
uz: "Glinda bo'lishi mumkin", - dedi u.

en: "Who is Glinda?" inquired the Scarecrow.
