en: Everywhere I could feel the tie which bound this youthful society in one, and everywhere, too, I could feel that it left me out.
uz: Har joyda yoshlar jamiyatini birlashtirgan bog'liqlikni his qila olaman va har yerda ham meni chetga qoldirganini his qila olaman.

en: Yet this impression lasted for a moment only, and was succeeded, together with the vexation which it had caused, by the idea that it was best that I should not belong to that society, but keep to my own circle of gentlemen; wherefore I proceeded to seat myself upon the third bench, with, as neighbours, Count B., Baron Z., the Prince R., Iwin, and some other young men of the same class with none of whom, however, was acquainted save with Iwin and Count B.
uz: Ammo bu taassurot faqat bir muncha davom etdi va uning oqibatida paydo bo'lgan xafalik bilan birga, men o'sha jamiyatga tegishli bo'lmasam, balki o'zimning xonadonimni saqlasam yaxshi bo'ladi degan fikrga qo'shildi; shuning uchun men o'zimni uchinchi stolga o'tirdim va qo'shni sifatida Count B., Baron Z., Prince R., Iwin va shu sinfdagi boshqa yoshlar bilan birga bo'ldim, ammo ularning hech biri Iwin va Count B-dan boshqa hech kim bilan tanish bo'lmagan.

en: Yet the look which these young gentlemen threw at me at once made me feel that I was not of their set, and I turned to observe what was going on around me.
uz: Biroq, bu yigitlarning menga birdan ko'rsatgan ko'zlari meni o'zlarining guruhidan bo'lmaganimdek his qildi va men atrofimda nimalar sodir bo'layotganini kuzatish uchun o'zimni burdim.

en: Semenoff, with grey, matted hair, white teeth, and tunic flying open, was seated a little distance off, and leaning forward on his elbows as he nibbled a pen, while the gymnasium student who had come out first in the examinations had established himself on the front bench, and, with a black stock coming half-way up his cheek, was toying with the silver watch-chain which adorned his satin waistcoat.
uz: Shira, matlangan sochlari, oq tishlari va ko'ylaklari ochiq bo'lgan Semenoff biroz uzoqlikda o'tirib, qalamni o'qib, qo'l qo'llaridan oldinga tiklanib o'tirgan edi, imtihonlarda birinchi bo'lib chiqqan gimnaziya o'quvchisi esa oldingi bankda o'zini o'rnatgan edi va qora stoqning yarim yo'lida bo'lib, shag'atiga o'tirgan kumush soat zanjir bilan o'ynab o'ynayotgan edi.

en: On a bench in a raised part of the hall I could descry Ikonin (evidently he had contrived to enter the University
uz: Zalning yuqori qismidagi bankda Ikoninni tasvirlab berardim (o'zi universitetga kirish uchun qurbonlik yaratganidan ko'rinib turibdi).

en: somehow!), and hear him fussily proclaiming, in all the glory of blue piped trousers which completely hid his boots, that he was now seated on Parnassus.
uz: !), va uni to'liq poyabzallarini yashirgan ko'k qutilar shon-shuhratida Parnassus ustida o'tirganini g'ayrat bilan e'lon qilayotganini eshitish.

en: Ilinka—who had surprised me by giving me a bow not only cold, but supercilious, as though to remind me that here we were all equals—was just in front of me, with his legs resting in free and easy style on another bench (a hit, somehow I thought, at myself), and conversing with a student as he threw occasional glances in my direction.
uz: Ilinka, meni nafaqat sovuq, balki o'zboshimchalik bilan quvonch bilan hayratda qoldirgan edi, xuddi bu yerda barchamiz teng ekanimizni eslatmoqchi bo'lib, o'zimning oldimda turgan edi, oyoqlari boshqa bankda erkin va oson tarzda o'tirgan edi (men o'zimga o'xshardim) va bir talaba bilan suhbatlashayotgan edi, u vaqti-vaqti bilan menga qarab turardi.

en: Iwin’s set by my side were talking in French, yet every word which I overheard of their conversation seemed to me both stupid and incorrect (“Ce n’est pas francais,” I thought to myself), while all the attitudes, utterances, and doings of Semenoff, Ilinka, and the rest struck me as uniformly coarse, ungentlemanly, and “comme il ne faut pas.” Thus, attached to no particular set, I felt isolated and unable to make friends, and so grew resentful.
uz: Mening yonimda o'tirgan kishilar frantsuz tilida gapirishardi, ammo ularning suhbatidan eshitgan har bir so'z menga ahmoq va noto'g'ri tuyulgan edi (Men o'zim o'zimga o'yladim), Semenoff, Ilinka va boshqalarning barcha munosabatlari, so'zlari va harakatlari menga bir xil darajada qo'pol, odamsiz va keraksiz deb tuyuldi.

en: One of the students on the bench in front of me kept biting his nails, which were raw to the quick already, and this so disgusted me that I edged away from him.
uz: Oldimda o'tirgan bankda o'tirgan talabalardan biri o'zining to'g'irlarini o'g'irlab yurgan edi, ular allaqachon tez-tez xamir edilar va bu meni shunchalik jirkanch qildiki, men undan uzoqlashdim.

en: In short, I remember finding my first day a most depressing affair.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, birinchi kunimni juda tushkunlik bilan o'tkazganimni eslayman.

en: When the professor entered, and there was a general stir and a cessation of chatter, I remember throwing a scornful glance at him, as also that he began his discourse with a sentence which I thought devoid of meaning.
uz: Professor kirganida, umumiy g'alayon va gap-so'zlarning to'xtashi sodir bo'lganida, men unga e'tiborsizlik bilan qaraganimni eslayman, shuningdek, u nutqini mening fikrimcha ma'noga ega bo'lmagan jumla bilan boshlaganini eslayman.

en: I had expected the lecture to be, from first to last, so clever that not a word ought to be taken from or added to it.
uz: O'yladimki, bu nutq boshidan oxirigacha shunchalik aqlli bo'ladiki, unga hech qanday so'z qo'shilmasligi kerak.

en: Disappointed in this, I at once proceeded to draw beneath the heading “First Lecture” with which I had adorned my beautifully- bound notebook no less than eighteen faces in profile, joined together in a sort of chaplet, and only occasionally moved my hand along the page in order to give the professor (who, I felt sure, must be greatly interested in me) the impression that I was writing something.
uz: Bu menga tushkunlikka tushdi va men darhol o'zimning chiroyli bog'langan yozuv daftarimni o'n sakkiz yuzdan kam bo'lmagan profildan bezatgan "First Lecture" nomli sarlavha ostida chizishga kirdim, uni o'zaro bog'lab qo'ydim va faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan o'zimning qo'limni sahifa bo'ylab ko'tarib, professorga (men shubhasiz, menga juda qiziqish ko'rsatgan) biror narsa yozayotganim haqidagi taassurot qoldirdim.

en: In fact, at this very first lecture I came to the decision which I maintained to the end of my course, namely, that it was unnecessary, and even stupid, to take down every word said by every professor.
uz: Darhaqiqat, ushbu birinchi nutqda men o'qishimning oxirigacha davom ettirgan qarorga keldim: har bir professor aytgan har bir so'zni yozib olish keraksiz va hatto ahmoqlikdir.

en: At subsequent lectures, however, I did not feel my isolation so strongly, since I made several acquaintances and got into the way of shaking hands and entering into conversation.
uz: Keyingi o'quvlarda esa men o'zimni yolg'iz his qilmay qo'ydim, chunki bir necha marta tanish bo'lib, qo'limni siqib suhbatga kirdim.

en: Yet for some reason or another no real intimacy ever sprang up between us, and I often
uz: Ammo bir sababga ko'ra, biz o'rtasida hech qachon haqiqiy yaqinlik paydo bo'lmagan va men ko'pincha o'zimni shunday his qilaman.

en: found myself depressed and only feigning cheerfulness.
uz: O'zimni tushkunlikka tushgan va faqat xursandchilikni ko'rsatgan holda ko'rdim.

en: With the set which comprised Iwin and “the aristocrats,” as they were generally known, I could not make any headway at all, for, as I now remember, I was always shy and churlish to them, and nodded to them only when they nodded to me; so that they had little inducement to desire my acquaintance.
uz: Iwin va aristokratlarni o'z ichiga olgan guruh bilan, ular umumiy ma'lumotlar bo'lgani kabi, hech qanday yutuqlarga erisholmadim, chunki hozir eslaymanki, men ular bilan doim uyalgan va qo'pol bo'lganman va ular menga qo'l urgandagina ularga bosh og'dirganman; shuning uchun ular mening tanishligimni istashlariga juda oz sabab bo'lgan.

en: With most of the other students, however, this arose from quite a different cause.
uz: Boshqa talabalarning aksariyati uchun esa bu umuman boshqacha sababdan kelib chiqqan.

en: As soon as ever I discerned friendliness on the part of a comrade, I at once gave him to understand that I went to luncheon with Prince Ivan Ivanovitch and kept my own drozhki.
uz: Bir tengdoshning do'stona munosabatini payqaganimda, unga darhol o'zim Prince Ivan Ivanovitch bilan tushlikka borganimni va o'zimning drozhkimni saqlaganimni tushunib berishimni aytdim.

en: All this I said merely to show myself in the most favourable light in his eyes, and to induce him to like me all the more; yet almost invariably the only result of my communicating to him the intelligence concerning the drozhki and my relationship to Prince Ivan Ivanovitch was that, to my astonishment, he at once adopted a cold and haughty bearing towards me.
uz: Men bularning barchasini faqat o'zimni uning ko'zlariga eng yoqimli tarzda ko'rsatib, uni menga yanada ko'proq yoqtirishga undash uchun aytdim; lekin, deyarli har doim ham, unga drozhkilar haqidagi ma'lumotlarni va princ Ivan Ivanovich bilan munosabatimni aytishning yagona natijasi shundaki, u menga nisbatan birdan sovuq va mag'rurlik bilan munosabatni o'rnatdi.

en: Among us we had a Crown student named Operoff—a very modest, industrious, and clever young fellow, who always offered one his hand like a slab of wood (that is to say, without closing his fingers or making the slightest movement with them); with the result that his comrades often did the same to him in jest, and called it the “deal board” way of shaking hands.
uz: O'zimiz orasida Operoff ismli korona o'quvchisi bor edi, u juda kamtarin, mehnatsevar va aqlli yigit edi, u har doim o'z qo'lini yog'och bo'lak kabi (ya'ni, barmoqlarini yopmasdan yoki ular bilan kichik harakat qilmasdan) taklif qilardi; natijada uning tengdoshlari ko'pincha unga xuddi shunday qilib kulishardilar va uni deal board deb atashardilar.

en: He and I nearly always sat next to one another, and discussed matters generally.
uz: U va men deyarli har doim bir-birimizning yonida o'tirib, umuman muhokama qilardik.

en: In particular he pleased me with the freedom with which he would criticise the professors as he pointed out to me with great clearness and acumen the merits or demerits of their respective ways of teaching and made occasional fun of them.
uz: Xususan, professorlarni tanqid qilish erkinligi menga yoqardi, chunki u menga o'zlarining ta'lim berish usullarining afzalliklari yoki kamchiliklarini aniq va aniq ko'rsatdi va vaqti-vaqti bilan ularni mazax qildi.

en: Such remarks I found exceedingly striking and diverting when uttered in his quiet, mincing voice.
uz: Bunday so'zlarni uning tinch, qichqiriq ovozi bilan aytganimda, juda diqqatga sazovor va chalg'itadigan bo'ldi.

en: Nevertheless he never let a lecture pass without taking careful notes of it in his fine handwriting, and eventually we decided to join forces, and to do our preparation together.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u hech qachon ma'ruza o'tishiga yo'l qo'ymagan, uni o'zining yaxshi qo'li yozuvi bilan diqqat bilan yozib olmagan va nihoyat, qo'limizni birlashtirishga va birgalikda tayyorgarlik ko'rishga qaror qildik.

en: Things had progressed to the point of his always looking pleased when I took my usual seat beside him when, unfortunately, I one day found it necessary to inform him that, before her death, my mother had besought my father never to allow us to enter for a government scholarship, as well as that I myself considered Crown students, no matter how clever, to be-“well, they are not GENTLEMEN,” I concluded, though beginning to flounder a little and grow red.
uz: Afsuski, bir kuni men uning yonida odatdagi o'rinni egallab olsam, u har doim xursand bo'lib ko'rinadi, lekin o'limidan oldin onam otamdan hech qachon hukumat stipendiyalari uchun kirishimizga ruxsat bermasligini so'raganini va men o'zim Crown talabalarini, qanchalik aqlli bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, yaxshi deb hisoblaganimni aytishim kerak edi.

en: At the moment Operoff said nothing, but at
uz: Operoff o'sha paytda hech narsa aytmadi, lekin o'sha paytda.

en: subsequent lectures he ceased to greet me or to offer me his board- like hand, and never attempted to talk to me, but, as soon as ever I sat down, he would lean his head upon his arm, and purport to be absorbed in his notebooks.
uz: Keyinchalik u menga salom berishni yoki o'z qo'lini berishni to'xtatdi va hech qachon men bilan gaplashishga urinmadi, lekin men o'tirganimdan so'ng, boshini qo'liga tikib, yozuvlar bilan o'ziga jalb bo'lishini aytadi.

en: I was surprised at this sudden coolness, but looked upon it as infra dig, “pour un jeune homme de bonne maison” to curry favour with a mere Crown student of an Operoff, and so left him severely alone—though I confess that his aloofness hurt my feelings.
uz: Men ushbu to'satdan sovuqlikka hayron qoldim, lekin uni o'zim uchun bir yaxshi uyda yashaydigan yigit uchun o'zimni yaxshi ko'rishim kerak deb o'ylardim, shuning uchun uni Operoffning oddiy korona o'quvchilari bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish uchun qattiq yolg'iz qoldirdim, garchi uning o'ziga xosligi his-tuyg'ularimni jarohatlaganini tan olsam ham.

en: On one occasion I arrived before him, and, since the lecture was to be delivered by a popular professor whom students came to hear who did not usually attend such functions, I found almost every seat occupied.
uz: Bir marta men uning oldiga yetib keldim va nutqni o'quvchilarning ko'pligi eshitadigan, odatda bunday tadbirlarga bormaydigan mashhur professor o'tkazishi kerak bo'lganligi sababli, deyarli har bir o'rinni egallagan holda topdim.

en: Accordingly I secured Operoff’s place for myself by spreading my notebooks on the desk before it; after which I left the room again for a moment.
uz: Shuning uchun men Operoffning o'rinini o'zim uchun Operoffning oldidagi ish stolida yozuvlarimni tarqatib, o'zim uchun o'rnatdim; shundan so'ng yana bir muncha vaqt davomida xonani tark etdim.

en: When I returned I perceived that my paraphernalia had been relegated to the bench behind, and the place taken by Operoff himself.
uz: Qaytib kelganimda, paraparnaliyalarim orqa quloqqa tashlanganini va Operoffning o'zi o'rnatgan joyni ko'rdim.

en: I remarked to him that I had already secured it by placing my notebooks there.
uz: Men unga yozuvlarimni o'sha joyga qo'yib, uni jamlaganimni aytdim.

en: “I know nothing about that,” he replied sharply, yet without looking up at me.
uz: - Men bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman, - dedi u keskin javob berib, lekin menga ko'z tikmay.

en: “I tell you I placed my notebooks there,” I repeated, purposely trying to bluster, in the hope of intimidating him.
uz: Men sizga aytamanki, men yozuvlarimni u yerga qo'ydim, Men uni qo'rqitish umidida qasddan o'zimni qo'zg'atishga harakat qilib, takrorladim.

en: “Every one saw me do it,” I added, including the students near me in my glance.
uz: Men qo'shimcha qilib aytdim: "Har kim meni buni qilayotganimni ko'rdi, shu jumladan yonimda turgan talabalar ham.

en: Several of them looked at me with curiosity, yet none of them spoke.
uz: Ularning bir nechtasi menga qiziqish bilan qarab turishdi, ammo hech kim gapirmadi.

en: “Seats cannot be booked here,” said Operoff.
uz: Operoff shunday dedi: "Bu yerda o'rindiqlarni joylashtirish mumkin emas.

en: “Whoever first sits down in a place keeps it,” and, settling himself angrily where he was, he flashed at me a glance of defiance.
uz: Kim birinchi o'tirsa, uni saqlab qoladi va o'zi turgan joyda g'azablanib o'zini o'tirib, menga qarshilik ko'rinishini ko'rsatdi.

en: “Well, that only means that you are a cad,” I said.
uz: Eh, bu shunchaki siz o'zingizning o'zingizdan o'tganingizning ma'nosini beradi, - dedim men.

en: I have an idea that he murmured something about my being “a stupid young idiot,” but I decided not to hear it.
uz: O'zimni ahmoq yosh axloqsiz yigit deb o'ylagani haqida bir narsa o'yladim, lekin men buni eshitmaslikka qaror qildim.

en: What would be the use, I asked myself, of my hearing it?
uz: Men o'zimdan so'radim: uni eshitish menga qanday foyda keltiradi?

en: That we should brawl like a couple of manants over less than nothing?
uz: Biz hech narsadan kamroq narsa uchun bir-birimiz bilan bahslashishimiz kerak deb?

en: (I was very fond of the word manants, and often used it for meeting awkward junctures.) Perhaps I should have said something more had not, at that moment, a door slammed and the professor (dressed in a blue frockcoat, and shuffling his feet as he walked) ascended the rostrum.
uz: (Men manants so'zini juda yaxshi ko'rardim va uni ko'pincha noqulay uchrashuvlar uchun ishlatardim.) Ehtimol, o'sha paytda eshik yopilmaganida va professor (ko'k kiyim kiygan va yurganida oyoqlarini aralashtirgan) marshrutga chiqib ketmaganida, men ko'proq gapirishim kerak edi.

en: Nevertheless, when the examination was about to come on, and I had need of some one’s notebooks, Operoff remembered his promise to lend me his, and we did our preparation together.
uz: Biroq, imtihon o'tmoqchi bo'lganida va men ba'zilarning yozuvlariga muhtoj bo'lganimda, Operoff menga o'zini berishni va'da qilganini esladi va biz birgalikda tayyorgarlik ko'rdik.

en: AFFAIRS OF THE HEART Affaires du coeur exercised me greatly that winter.
uz: Qalb ishlari o'sha qishda meni juda mashq qildi.

en: In fact, I fell in love three times.
uz: Aslida men uch marta muhabbatga tushdim.

en: The first time, I became passionately enamoured of a buxom lady whom I used to see riding at Freitag’s riding-school; with the result that every day when she was taking a lesson there (that is to say, every Tuesday and Friday) I used to go to gaze at her, but always in such a state of trepidation lest I should be seen that I stood a long way off, and bolted directly I thought her likely to approach the spot where I was standing.
uz: Birinchi marta men Freitagda haydash maktabida haydashni ko'rgan bo'g'im ayolga ishonganman; natijada, u o'sha yerda har kuni (ya'ni har sal va juma kunlari) dars o'qiganida, men unga qarab ketardim, lekin har doim men uzoqdan turganimni ko'rishdan qo'rqaman, deb qo'rqaman va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tirganimda, uning men turgan joyga yaqinlashishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas deb o'yladim.

en: Likewise, I used to turn round so precipitately whenever she appeared to be glancing in my direction that I never saw her face well, and to this day do not know whether she was really beautiful or not.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, u menga qarab turganiga o'xshab, men uning yuzini hech qachon yaxshi ko'rmadim va bugungi kunga qadar u chindan ham chiroyli yoki chiroyli emasligini bilmayman.

en: Dubkoff, who was acquainted with her, surprised me one day in the riding-school, where I was lurking concealed behind the lady’s grooms and the fur wraps which they were holding, and, having heard from Dimitri of my infatuation, frightened me so terribly by proposing to introduce me to the Amazon that I fled incontinently from the school, and was prevented by the mere thought that possibly he had told her about me from ever entering the place again, or even from hiding behind her grooms, lest I should encounter her.
uz: U bilan tanish Dubkoff meni bir kuni hayratda qoldirdi, chunki men ayollarning kuyovlari va ularning qo'lida turgan toʻngʻizlar orqasida yashiringan edim va Dimitridan oʻzimni yoqtirganligimni eshitib, meni shunchalik qoʻrqitdiki, meni Amazonga tanishtirishni taklif qildi, hatto maktabdan qochib ketdim va ehtimol u menga men haqda gapirgan boʻlishi mumkinligi haqida oʻylaganim uni yana oʻsha joyga kirishdan yoki hatto kuyovlarining orqasida yashirib qolishdan toʻsqinlik qildi.

en: Whenever I fell in love with ladies whom I did not know, and especially married women, I experienced a shyness a thousand times greater than I had ever felt with Sonetchka.
uz: Har safar tanimagan xotinga va ayniqsa turmushga chiqqan ayollarga muhabbat qo'yganimda, Sonetchka bilan o'zimni his qilganimdan ming barobar ko'proq o'ylayman.

en: I dreaded beyond measure that my divinity should learn of my passion, or even of my existence, since I felt sure that, once she had done so, she would be so terribly offended that I should never be forgiven for my presumption.
uz: O'zimning xudojo'yligim o'zimning ishtiyoqimni yoki hatto mavjudligimni bilishi mumkinligidan haddan tashqari qo'rqardim, chunki u bunday qilgandan so'ng, u shunchalik xafa bo'ladiki, men hech qachon o'zimning shubhasizligim uchun kechirilmayman deb o'yladim.

en: And indeed, if the Amazon referred to above had ever
uz: Haqiqatan ham, agar yuqorida aytib o'tilgan Amazoniya biror vaqtlarda

en: come to know how I used to stand behind the grooms and dream of seizing her and carrying her off to some country spot—if she had ever come to know how I should have lived with her there, and how I should have treated her, it is probable that she would have had very good cause for indignation!
uz: Qachonki, u o'sha yerda u bilan qanday yashashim kerakligini va unga qanday munosabatda bo'lishim kerakligini bilsa, ehtimol, uning g'azablanishiga juda yaxshi sabab bo'lgan bo'lardi!

en: But I always felt that, once I got to know her, she would straightway divine these thoughts, and consider herself insulted by my acquaintance.
uz: Ammo men har doim uni taniganimda, u shu zahoti bu fikrlarni bashorat qilib, tanishim tomonidan haqoratlangan deb o'ylaydi, deb o'yladim.

en: As my second affaire du coeur, I, (for the third time) fell in love with Sonetchka when I saw her at her sister’s.
uz: Men (uchinchi marta) Sonetchka bilan uchrashganimda, uni singillari bilan uchrashganimda sevdim.

en: My second passion for her had long since come to an end, but I became enamoured of her this third time through Lubotshka sending me a copy-book in which Sonetchka had copied some extracts from Lermontoff’s The Demon, with certain of the more subtly amorous passages underlined in red ink and marked with pressed flowers.
uz: U bilan bo'lgan ikkinchi ishtiyoqim uzoq vaqt o'tgach tugadi, lekin Lubotshka menga Sonetchka Lermontoffning "Jomon" kitobidan ba'zi bir chiziqlarni nusxa qilib olgan, ba'zilarini qizil momaza bilan belgilab qo'yilgan va qizil gullar bilan belgilangani bilan uchinchi marta u bilan muhabbatga tushdim.

en: Remembering how Woloda had been wont to kiss his inamorata’s purse last year, I essayed to do the same thing now; and really, when alone in my room in the evenings and engaged in dreaming as I looked at a flower or occasionally pressed it to my lips, I would feel a certain pleasantly lachrymose mood steal over me, and remain genuinely in love (or suppose myself to be so) for at least several days.
uz: O'tgan yili Voloda o'zining sevimli ayollarining qopqoqchasini o'pishganini eslab, men hozir ham xuddi shunday qilishga harakat qildim; haqiqatan ham, kechqurun xonamda yolg'iz bo'lib, gulga qarab orzu qilayotganimda yoki vaqti-vaqti bilan uni og'zimga surib qo'yganimda, men o'zimni bir necha kun davomida chin dildan sevgan (yoki o'zimni shunday deb hisoblayman) bo'lib qolishimni his qilardim.

en: Finally, my third affaire du coeur that winter was connected with the lady with whom Woloda was in love, and who used occasionally to visit at our house.
uz: Va nihoyat, o'sha qishdagi uchinchi muammom Woloda sevgan va vaqti-vaqti bilan uyimizga tashrif buyuradigan ayol bilan bog'liq edi.

en: Yet, in this damsel, as I now remember, there was not a single beautiful feature to be found—or, at all events, none of those which usually pleased me.
uz: Biroq, bu qizda, hozir eslaymanki, hech qanday chiroyli xususiyat yo'q edi yoki, hech bo'lmaganda, menga yoqadigan hech qanday xususiyat yo'q edi.

en: She was the daughter of a well- known Moscow lady of light and leading, and, petite and slender, wore long flaxen curls after the English fashion, and could boast of a transparent profile.
uz: U mashhur moskovlik ayolining qizi edi, u yorug' va yetakchi edi va kichik va chiroyli edi, u ingliz modasiga o'xshash uzun laynakli bo'laklar kiygan va shaffof profilga ega bo'lgan.

en: Every one said that she was even cleverer and more learned than her mother, but I was never in a position to judge of that, since, overcome with craven bashfulness at the mere thought of her intellect and accomplishments, I never spoke to her alone but once, and then with unaccountable trepidation.
uz: Har kim uning onasidan ham aqlli va bilimdonroq ekanligini aytdi, lekin men buni hech qachon hukm qila olmaganman, chunki uning aqli va yutuqlari haqida o'ylashdan qo'rqqanim uchun men hech qachon u bilan yolg'iz gaplashmaganman, faqat bir marta, keyin esa juda qo'rqqanim uchun.

en: Woloda’s enthusiasm, however (for the presence of an audience never prevented him from giving vent to his rapture), communicated itself to me so strongly that I also became enamoured of the lady.
uz: Biroq, Woloda'ning hayajonini (ko'pchilik ishtirok etgani uchun u o'z quvonchini ko'rsatishga hech qachon to'sqinlik qilmagan), u menga shunchalik kuchli ta'sir qildiki, men ham xotinimga muhabbat qo'ydim.

en: Yet, conscious that he would not be pleased to know that two brothers were in love with the same girl, I never told him of my condition.
uz: Biroq, ikki aka-uka bir xil qizga muhabbatda ekanini bilganda u xursand bo'lmasligini bilardim, shuning uchun men unga o'zimning holatimni hech qachon aytmadim.

en: the contrary, I took special delight in the thought that our mutual love for her was so pure that, though its object was, in both cases, the same charming being, we remained friends and ready, if ever the occasion should arise, to sacrifice ourselves for one another.
uz: Aksincha, o'zaro muhabbatimiz shunchalik sof bo'lganligi haqida o'ylash menga ayniqsa yoqardiki, uning maqsadi ikkala holatda ham bir xil chiroyli mavjudot bo'lishiga qaramay, biz do'st bo'lib qoldik va, agar biror fursat tug'ilsa, bir-birimiz uchun o'zimizni qurbon qilishga tayyor edik.

en: Yet I have an idea that, as regards self-sacrifice, he did not quite share my views, for he was so passionately in love with the lady that once he was for giving a member of the diplomatic corps, who was said to be going to marry her, a slap in the face and a challenge to a duel; but, for my part, I would gladly have sacrificed my feelings for his sake, seeing that the fact that the only remark I had ever addressed to her had been on the subject of the dignity of classical music, and that my passion, for all my efforts to keep it alive, expired the following week, would have rendered it the more easy for me to do so.
uz: Biroq, o'z-o'zini fido qilish masalasida u mening fikrlarim bilan to'liq bo'lishmaganini bilaman, chunki u ayolga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan muhabbat ko'rsatgan ediki, bir marta u bilan turmushga chiqmoqchi bo'lgan diplomatik korpus a'zosiga yuzma-yuz urib, duellashishga qarshilik ko'rsatgan edi; lekin men uning uchun o'z his-tuyg'ularimni qurbon qilgan bo'lardim, chunki men unga aytgan yagona so'zlarim klassik musiqaning qadr-qimmatini o'z ichiga olgan edi va uni tirik qoldirish uchun qilgan barcha harakatlarimga qaramay, ishtiyoqim keyingi haftada tugadi.

en: THE WORLD As regards those worldly delights to which I had intended, on entering the University, to surrender myself in imitation of my brother, I underwent a complete disillusionment that winter.
uz: DUNYAT O'sha dunyodagi zavqlarga ega bo'lganimda, universitetga kirganimda, akamga taqlid qilib, o'zimni topshirishni rejalashtirgan edim, lekin o'sha qishda men mutlaqo umidsizlikka tushdim.

en: Woloda danced a great deal, and Papa also went to balls with his young wife, but I appeared to be thought either too young or unfitted for such delights, and no one invited me to the houses where balls were being given.
uz: Woloda juda ko'p raqs qilardi va otam ham yosh xotini bilan balolarga borardi, lekin meni juda yosh yoki bunday zavqlarga mos kelmaydigan deb o'ylashardi va meni hech kim balolar o'tkaziladigan uylarga taklif qilmadi.

en: Yet, in spite of my vow of frankness with Dimitri, I never told him (nor any one else) how much I should have liked to go to those dances, and how I felt hurt at being forgotten and (apparently) taken for the philosopher that I pretended to be.
uz: Biroq, Dimitriy bilan rostgo'ylik va'damga qaramasdan, men unga (yoki boshqa hech kimga) o'sha raqslarga borishni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rganimni va o'zimni o'zimdek falsafachi deb bilganimdan va unutilganimdan o'zimni qanday ranjitganimni hech qachon aytmaganman.

en: Nevertheless, a reception was to be given that winter at the Princess Kornakoff’s, and to it she sent us personal invitations—to myself among the rest!
uz: Shunga qaramay, o'sha qishda Kornakoffs princesasida qabul bo'lib o'tadi va u bizga o'zimga o'zgalar orasida shaxsiy taklifnomalar yubordi!

en: Consequently, I was to attend my first ball.
uz: Natijada, men birinchi tantanaga borishim kerak edi.

en: Before starting, Woloda came into my room to see how I was dressing myself—an act on his part which greatly surprised me and took me aback.
uz: Boshlanishdan oldin, Woloda xonamga kirib, o'zimni qanday kiyganimni ko'rdi, bu meni hayratda qoldirib, hayratda qoldirdi.

en: In my opinion (it must be understood) solicitude about one’s dress was a shameful thing, and should be kept under, but he seemed to think it a thing so natural and necessary that he said outright that he was afraid I should be put out of countenance on that score.
uz: Mening fikrimcha (bu tushuniladi) kiyim-kechak haqida g'amxo'rlik qilish uyatli va yashirin narsa edi, lekin u buni o'ta tabiiy va zarur deb hisoblagan, shuning uchun u o'zidan qo'rqqanini aytdi.

en: Accordingly, he bid me don my patent leather boots, and was horrified to find that I wanted to put on gloves of peau de chamois.
uz: Shuning uchun u menga charmli charmli poyabzallarimni kiyishni taklif qildi va men shamoy teridan tayyorlangan qo'lqovutlar kiyishni istardim, deb qo'rqib qoldi.

en: Next, he adjusted my watch-chain in a particular manner, and carried me off to a hairdresser’s near the Kuznetski Bridge to have my locks coiffured.
uz: Keyin u soat zanjirimni muayyan tarzda sozladi va meni Kuznetski ko'prisi yaqinidagi salmoqxonaga olib bordi.

en: That done, he withdrew to a little distance and surveyed me.
uz: Buni qilgach, u biroz uzoqlashdi va meni ko'rib chiqdi.

en: “Yes, he looks right enough now” said he to the hairdresser.
uz: - Ha, hozir u yaxshi ko'rinadi, - dedi u cho'g'ir sochuvchisiga.

en: “Only —couldn’t you smooth those tufts of his in front a little?” Yet, for all that Monsieur Charles treated my forelocks with one essence and another, they persisted in rising up again when ever I put on my hat.
uz: Faqat Siz uning oldidagi tuftlarini biroz sozlay olasizmi? Biroq, monsyer Charlz bosh qo'llarimga bir-biri bilan muomala qilgan bo'lsa-da, ular har safar to'plamni kiyganimda yana ko'tarilishiga chidamli edi.

en: In fact, my curled and tonsured figure seemed to me to look far worse than it had done before.
uz: Darhaqiqat, o'zimning tupurgan va tonzorlangan suratim avvalgidek ancha yomon ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan.

en: My only hope of salvation lay in an affectation of untidiness.
uz: Qutqaruv uchun yagona umidim buzg'unchilikning ta'sirida edi.

en: Only in that guise would my exterior resemble anything at all.
uz: Faqat shu tarzda tashqi ko'rinishim hech narsaga o'xshaydi.

en: Woloda, apparently, was of the same opinion, for he begged me to undo the curls, and when I had done so and still looked unpresentable, he ceased to regard me at all, but throughout the drive to the Kornakoffs remained silent and depressed.
uz: Woloda ham xuddi shunday fikrda edi, chunki u menga buzuqlarni yo'q qilishimni iltimos qildi va men buni qilganimda va hali ham ko'rinmasdek ko'ringanda, u menga umuman nazar tashlab qo'ydi, lekin Kornakoffga borgan safar davomida u jim va tushkun bo'lib qoldi.

en: Nevertheless, I entered the Kornakoffs’ mansion boldly enough, and it was only when the Princess had invited me to dance, and I, for some reason or another (though I had driven there with no other thought in my head than to dance well), had replied that I never indulged in that pastime, that I began to blush, and, left solitary among a crowd of strangers, became plunged in my usual insuperable and ever-growing shyness.
uz: Shunga qaramay, men Kornakofflar saroyiga yetarlicha jasorat bilan kirdim va faqatgina princess meni raqsga taklif qilganida, men biron sababga ko'ra (agar men o'zimni raqsga o'tkazishdan boshqa hech qanday fikrim bo'lmagan holda u yerga haydashgan bo'lsam ham), o'sha vaqt o'tkazishga hech qachon rozi bo'lmasligimni, qizg'ayishni boshlaganimni va begonalar to'plami orasida yolg'iz qolganimni va odatdagidek g'alati va o'sib borayotgan soqovligimdan mahrum bo'lganimni aytdim.

en: In fact, I remained silent on that spot almost the whole evening!
uz: Darhaqiqat, men deyarli butun kecha o'sha joyda sukut saqladim!

en: Nevertheless, while a waltz was in progress, one of the young princesses came to me and asked me, with the sort of official kindness common to all her family, why I was not dancing.
uz: Biroq, vals o'yinlari o'tkazilayotganda, yosh printsesslardan biri menga yaqinlashib, butun oilasiga xos bo'lgan rasmiy mehribonlik bilan nega men raqs qilmayotganimni so'radi.

en: I can remember blushing hotly at the question, but at the same time feeling—for all my efforts to prevent it—a self-satisfied smile steal
uz: Men savolga qizg'inlab o'tirganimni eslayman, ammo shu bilan birga o'zimni qanoatlantirgan tabassumni o'g'irlashdan to'xtatish uchun qilgan barcha sa'y-harakatlarim uchun o'yladim.

en: over my face as I began talking, in the most inflated and long-winded French, such rubbish as even now, after dozens of years, it shames me to recall.
uz: O'zim gapira boshlaganimda, eng ko'p puchga chiqqan va uzoq o'tadigan frantsuz tilida yuzimni ko'tarib ko'rdim, hatto hozir ham, o'nlab yillar o'tgach, eslab qolishimdan uyalmayman.

en: It must have been the effect of the music, which, while exciting my nervous sensibility, drowned (as I supposed) the less intelligible portion of my utterances.
uz: Bu musiqa ta'siri bo'lishi kerak edi, u mening hissiy hissiyligimni hayajonlantirgan bo'lsa-da, so'zlarimning tushunarli bo'lmagan qismini (men tasavvur qilganimdek) o'ldirgan.

en: Anyhow, I went on speaking of the exalted company present, and of the futility of men and women, until I had got myself into such a tangle that I was forced to stop short in the middle of a word of a sentence which I found myself powerless to conclude.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men hozir bo'lgan ulug'vor odamlar va erkaklar va ayollarning befoydaligi haqida gapirishni davom ettirdim, hatto o'zimni shunchalik puchga tushirgan edimki, o'zimni so'zning o'rtasida to'xtatishga majbur qildim.

en: Even the worldly-minded young Princess was shocked by my conduct, and gazed at me in reproach; whereat I burst out laughing.
uz: Hatto dunyoning fikrlash tarzi bo'lgan yosh princess ham mening xatti-harakatimdan hayron bo'lib, menga haqorat bilan qaradi.

en: At this critical moment, Woloda, who had remarked that I was conversing with great animation, and probably was curious to know what excuses I was making for not dancing, approached us with Dubkoff.
uz: Ushbu muhim paytda, men ajoyib animatsiya bilan suhbatlashayotganimni va, ehtimol, men raqs qilmasligim uchun qanday uzrlar izlayotganimni bilmoqchi bo'lgan Woloda Dubkoff bilan bizga yaqinlashdi.

en: Seeing, however, my smiling face and the Princess’s frightened mien, as well as overhearing the appalling rubbish with which I concluded my speech, he turned red in the face, and wheeled round again.
uz: Biroq, mening tabassumli yuzimni ko'rib, Princessning qo'rqib ketayotgan ko'z o'ngini ko'rib va nutqimni yakunlagan dahshatli axlatni eshitib, u yuzida qizillashib, yana o'ziga burildi.

en: The Princess also rose and left me.
uz: Qizaloq ham o'rnidan turib meni tashlab ketdi.

en: I continued to smile, but in such a state of agony from the consciousness of my stupidity that I felt ready to sink into the floor.
uz: Men tabassumni davom ettirdim, lekin o'zimning ahmoqligim haqida o'ylagani uchun shunchalik azob chekdimki, o'zimni yerga cho'kishga tayyor his qildim.

en: Likewise I felt that, come what might, I must move about and say something, in order to effect a change in my position.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, o'zim ham, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, o'z nuqtai nazarimni o'zgartirish uchun harakat qilib, biror narsa aytishim kerakligini his qildim.

en: Accordingly I approached Dubkoff, and asked him if he had danced many waltzes with her that night.
uz: Shu sababli Dubkoffga yaqinlashib, u kechasi u bilan ko'p valitslarni raqsga tushganmi, yo'qmi deb so'radim.

en: This I feigned to say in a gay and jesting manner, yet in reality I was imploring help of the very Dubkoff to whom I had cried “Hold your tongue!” on the night of the matriculation dinner.
uz: Men buni gey va mazaxli tarzda aytmoqchi bo'lgan edim, ammo aslida men matrikulyatsion kechki ovqat kechasi "O'z tilingni tut!" deb baqirgan Dubkoffning yordamiga iltijo qilardim.

en: By way of answer, he made as though he had not heard me, and turned away.
uz: Javob sifatida u meni tinglamaganidek qildi va yuz o'girdi.

en: Next, I approached Woloda, and said with an effort and in a similar tone of assumed gaiety: “Hullo, Woloda!
uz: Keyin men Wolodaga yaqinlashdim va harakat va shunga o'xshash shodlik bilan: "Hullo, Woloda!

en: Are you played out yet?” He merely looked at me as much as to say, “You wouldn’t speak to me like that if we were alone,” and left me without a word, in the evident fear that I might continue to attach myself to his person.
uz: U menga shunchaki qarab: "Agar yolg'iz bo'lganimizda, menga shunday gapirmas edingiz", - deb aytdi va men uning shaxsiyatidan qo'rqqanim uchun so'zsiz qoldirdi.

en: Even my own brother deserts me!” I thought to myself.
uz: Hatto o'z akam ham meni tashlab ketadi! O'zim o'zim bilan o'yladim.

en: Yet somehow I had not the courage to depart, but remained standing where I was until the very end of the evening.
uz: Ammo bir yo'l bilan ketish uchun jasoratim bo'lmadi, balki kechqurungacha o'zim turgan joyda turdim.

en: At length, when every one was leaving the room and crowding into the hall,
uz: Oxir-oqibat, hamma xonadan chiqib, zalga to'planib ketganda,

en: and a footman slipped my greatcoat on to my shoulders in such a way as to tilt up my cap, I gave a dreary, half-lachrymose smile, and remarked to no one in particular: “Comme c’est gracieux!” XXXIX.
uz: Bir kishi katta kiyimimni yelkamga o'tkazib qo'ydi, shunda capimni ko'tarib qo'ydim, men chiroyli, yarim laxrimoz tabassumni ko'rsatdim va hech kimga: "Comme cest gracieux! XXXIX" deb aytmadim.

en: THE STUDENTS’ FEAST NOTWITHSTANDING that, as yet, Dimitri’s influence had kept me from indulging in those customary students’ festivities known as kutezhi or “wines,” that winter saw me participate in such a function, and carry away with me a not over-pleasant impression of it.
uz: Dimitriyning ta'siri tufayli o'sha odatdagi talabalar bayramlarida ishtirok etishdan qochganimni eslatib, qish o'tib bunday tadbirda ishtirok etishimni ko'rgan va bu haqda o'zimga yoqimli tasavvurni o'tkazganimni aytaman.

en: This is how it came about.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu sodir bo'ldi.

en: At a lecture soon after the New Year, Baron Z.—a tall, light-haired young fellow of very serious demeanour and regular features— invited us all to spend a sociable evening with him.
uz: Yangi yildan so'nggi bir nutqda baron Z.a, juda jiddiy xulq-atvor va muntazam ko'rinishlarga ega bo'lgan baland sochli yosh yigit, barchamizni u bilan birga bir kechani o'tkazishga taklif qildi.

en: By “us all”, I mean all the men more or less “comme il faut”, of our course, and exclusive of Grap, Semenoff, Operoff, and commoners of that sort.
uz: us all deganda, men, albatta, barcha erkaklarni ko'proq yoki kamroq o'z ichiga olyapman va Grap, Semenoff, Operoff va shunga o'xshash oddiy odamlardan tashqari.

en: Woloda smiled contemptuously when he heard that I was going to a “wine” of first course men, but I looked to derive great and unusual pleasure from this, to me, novel method of passing the time.
uz: Woloda men birinchi marta erkaklar o'yinlariga borayotganimni eshitganida kamsitib tabassum qildi, lekin men bu vaqtni o'tkazishning yangi usuli bo'lganidan katta va odatiy emas zavq o'tkazishga harakat qildim.

en: Accordingly, punctually at the appointed hour of eight I presented myself at the Baron’s.
uz: Shu bois, soat sakkizda belgilab qo'yilgan vaqtda o'zimni Baronlar huzurida ko'rdim.

en: Our host, in an open tunic and white waistcoat, received his guests in the brilliantly lighted salon and drawing-room of the small mansion where his parents lived—they having given up their reception rooms to him for the evening for purposes of this party.
uz: Uy egasi ochiq tunika va oq kiyimda mehmonlarini uning ota-onasi yashaydigan kichkina uyning chiroyli yoritilgan salonida va o'tirish xonasida kutib oldi.

en: In the corridor could be seen the heads and skirts of inquisitive domestics, while in the dining-room I caught a glimpse of a dress which I imagined to belong to the Baroness herself.
uz: Koridorda qiziqarli uy egalarining boshlari va kamonlari ko'rish mumkin edi, ovqatxonada esa men baronessning o'ziga tegishli deb o'ylagan kiyimni ko'rdim.

en: The guests numbered a score, and were all of them students except Herr Frost (in attendance upon Iwin) and a tall, red-faced gentleman who was
uz: Mehmonlar soniga ko'tarilgan edilar va ularning barchasi talabalar edilar, faqat Herr Frost (Iwinni ko'rib turgan) va baland, qizil yuzli bir gentleman bundan mustasno.

en: superintending the feast and who was introduced to every one as a relative of the Baron’s and a former student of the University of Dorpat.
uz: Bayramni nazorat qiluvchi va har bir kishiga baronlarning qarindoshi va Dorpat universiteti sobiq talaba sifatida tanishtirilgan.

en: At first, the excessive brilliancy and formal appointments of the reception-rooms had such a chilling effect upon this youthful company that every one involuntarily hugged the walls, except a few bolder spirits and the ex-Dorpat student, who, with his waistcoat already unbuttoned, seemed to be in every room, and in every corner of every room, at once, and filled the whole place with his resonant, agreeable, never-ceasing tenor voice.
uz: Boshida, qabulxonalarning ortiqcha chiroyliligi va rasmiy uchrashuvlari bu yoshlar jamoasiga shunchalik dahshatli ta'sir ko'rsatdiki, ba'zi bir jasoratli ruhlar va sobiq Dorpat talabalaridan tashqari, hamma o'z navbatida har bir xonada va har bir xonaning har bir burchagida bo'lib, butun joyni o'z shovqinli, yoqimli, to'xtamas tenor ovozi bilan to'ldirdi.

en: The remainder of the guests preferred either to remain silent or to talk in discreet tones of professors, faculties, examinations, and other serious and interesting matters.
uz: Qolgan mehmonlar sukut saqlashni yoki professorlar, fakultetlar, imtihonlar va boshqa jiddiy va qiziqarli masalalarni muhokama qilishni afzal ko'rishdi.

en: Yet every one, without exception, kept watching the door of the dining-room, and, while trying to conceal the fact, wearing an expression which said: “Come!
uz: Ammo har bir kishi, istisno qilmasdan, oshxona eshigini kuzatib turardi va buni yashirishga harakat qilib, " kel!!" degan ifodani kiygan edi.

en: It is time to begin.” I too felt that it was time to begin, and awaited the beginning with pleasurable impatience.
uz: Men ham boshlanish vaqti keldi deb o'yladim va boshlanishni yoqimli sabrsizlik bilan kutardim.

en: After footmen had handed round tea among the guests, the Dorpat student asked Frost in Russian: “Can you make punch, Frost?” “Oh ja!” replied Frost with a joyful flourish of his heels, and the other went on: “Then do you set about it” (they addressed each other in the second person singular, as former comrades at Dorpat).
uz: Sayohatchilar mehmonlar o'rtasida to'g'ri choy uzatganidan so'ng, Dorpat shogirdi Frostdan rus tilida so'radi: "Qozog'im, siz yumush tayyorlay olasizmi?"Oh, ha! Frost shodlik bilan to'pini ko'tardi va boshqa kishi davom etdi: "Shuning uchun o'zingizni o'ylab ko'ring (Ular Dorpatdagi sobiq tengdoshlar sifatida ikkinchi shaxsda bir-biriga singularda murojaat qilishgan).

en: Frost accordingly departed to the dining-room, with great strides of his bowed, muscular legs, and, after some walking backwards and forwards, deposited upon the drawing-room table a large punchbowl, accompanied by a ten-pound sugar loaf supported on three students’ swords placed crosswise.
uz: Frost o'z bog'langan, mushakli oyoqlari bilan oshxonasiga bordi va biroz orqa va oldinga yurib, o'tirganidan so'ng, o'tirish xonasi dasturxonida o'n kilogrammlik shakarli nonni o'rnatgan uchta o'quvchi qilichlariga qo'llab-quvvatlagan katta pishirgichni o'tirgan.

en: Meanwhile, the Baron had been going round among his guests as they sat regarding the punch-bowl, and addressing them, with a face of immutable gravity, in the formula: “I beg of you all to drink of this loving-cup in student fashion, that there may be good-fellowship among the members of our course.
uz: Shu bilan birga, baron o'z mehmonlari orasida o'tirganida, ular punch-bowl haqida o'tirganlarida, ularni o'zgaruvchanlik bilan murojaat qilib, quyidagi formula bilan murojaat qilgan edi: Sizlarning barchangizdan ushbu mehribon kosani talabalar uslubida ichinglar, shunda kursimiz a'zolari orasida yaxshi munosabatlar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Unbutton your waistcoats, or take them off altogether, as you please.” Already the Dorpat student had divested himself of his tunic and rolled up his white shirt-sleeves above his elbows, and now, planting his feet firmly apart, he proceeded to set fire to the rum in the punch-bowl.
uz: Kiyimlaringizni tugma, yoki xohlaganingizcha ularni butunlay olib qo'ying. Dorpat o'quvchisi o'z kiyimidan o'zini tashlab, oq kiyim qo'lqoplarini qo'lqoplari ustida o'rab olgan edi va endi oyoqlarini qat'iy ajratgan holda romga olov qo'yish uchun cho'nchoqda o'tiribdi.

en: “Gentlemen, put out the candles!” he cried with a sudden shout so loud and insistent that we seemed all of us to be shouting at once.
uz: Jentlemenlar, chiroqlarni o'chirib qo'yinglar! u birdan shunday baland va qattiq baqirib yubordiki, biz hammamiz bir vaqtning o'zida baqirib ketgandek tuyuldi.

en: However, we still went on silently regarding the punch-bowl and the white shirt of the Dorpat student, with a feeling that a moment of great solemnity was approaching.
uz: Biroq, biz Dorpat o'quvchilarining punch-bowl va oq ko'ylaklari to'g'risida so'zsiz davom ettirdik va katta tantanali vaqt yaqinlashayotganini his qildik.

en: “Put out the lights, Frost, I tell you!” the Dorpat student shouted again.
uz: Lightlarni o'chirib qo'ying, Frost, sizga aytaman! Dorpat shogirdi yana qichqirdi.

en: Evidently the punch was now sufficiently burnt.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, urish endi yetarlicha yondirilgan edi.

en: Accordingly every one helped to extinguish the candles, until the room was in total darkness save for a spot where the white shirts and hands of the three students supporting the sugarloaf on their crossed swords were lit up by the lurid flames from the bowl.
uz: Shunday qilib, har bir kishi chiroqlarni o'chirishga yordam berdi, faqat uchta o'quvchi o'z qilichlarida shakarni qo'llab-quvvatlagan oq ko'ylaklari va qo'llari qo'ldan kechirilgan idishdagi olovlar bilan yoqilg'i chiqqan joydan tashqari, xona butunlay qorong'ilikka to'lganidan keyin.

en: Yet the Dorpat student’s tenor voice was not the only one to be heard, for in different quarters of the room resounded chattering and laughter.
uz: Biroq, Dorpat talabalarining tenor ovozi faqatgina eshitilmagan, chunki xonaning turli qismlarida gap-so'z va kulgilar eshitilgan.

en: Many had taken off their tunics (especially students whose garments were of fine cloth and perfectly new), and I now did the same, with a consciousness that “IT” was “beginning.” There had been no great festivity as yet, but I felt assured that things would go splendidly when once we had begun drinking tumblers of the potion that was now in course of preparation.
uz: Ko'pchilik o'z kiyimlarini (ayniqsa, kiyimlari chiroyli to'qima va mukammal yangi bo'lgan talabalar) olib tashlagan edi, men ham xuddi shunday qildim, chunki IT  boshlanayotganini bilardim. Hozircha katta bayram bo'lmagan edi, ammo biz hozir tayyorlanayotgan potionning qoshiqlarini ichishni boshlaganimizda, ishlar ajoyib bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qildim.

en: At length, the punch was ready, and the Dorpat student, with much bespattering of the table as he did so, ladled the liquor into tumblers, and cried: “Now, gentlemen, please!” When we had each of us taken a sticky tumbler of the stuff into our hands, the Dorpat student and Frost sang a German song in which the word “Hoch!” kept occurring again and again, while we joined, in haphazard fashion, in the chorus.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, urish tayyor edi va Dorpat o'quvchisi o'sha paytda o'z so'zini ko'p ko'targan holda, sharobni to'plamlarga qo'ydi va: "Hndi, xonimlar, iltimos! Har birimiz qo'limizga buyumning yopishqoq to'plamini oldikda, Dorpat o'quvchisi va Frost nemis qo'shiqini kuylashdi, unda Hoch! so'zi qayta-qayta paydo bo'lib turardi, biz esa tasodifiy ravishda chorusga qo'shildik.

en: Next we clinked glasses together, shouted something in praise of punch, crossed hands, and took our first drink of the sweet, strong mixture.
uz: Keyingi safar biz bir-birimiz bilan shishalar tikdik, yumushni maqtash uchun biror narsa qichqirdik, qo'llarimizni o'girdik va birinchi marta shirin, kuchli aralashmani ichdik.

en: After that there was no further waiting; the “wine” was in full swing.
uz: Shundan keyin ko'proq kutish yo'q edi; wine to'liq harakatda edi.

en: The first glassful consumed, a second was poured out.
uz: Birinchi shishalik iste'mol qilindi, ikkinchisi quyildi.

en: Yet, for all that I began to feel a throbbing in my temples, and that the flames seemed to be turning purple, and that every one around me was laughing and shouting, things seemed lacking in real gaiety, and I somehow felt that, as a matter of fact, we were all of us finding the affair rather dull, and only PRETENDING to be enjoying it.
uz: Biroq, men o'z ibodatxonalarimda o'zimni titroq his qila boshlaganimda va olovlar rang-barang bo'lib, atrofimda hamma kulish va qichqirishayotganida ham, narsalar haqiqiy quvonchdan mahrum bo'lib ko'rinardi va men bir yo'l bilan, aslida, biz hammamiz bu ishni juda g'alati deb topayotganimizni va faqat undan zavqlanamiz deb o'ylayotganimizni his qilardim.

en: The Dorpat student may have been an exception, for he continued to grow more and more red in the face and more and more ubiquitous as he filled up empty glasses and stained the table with fresh spots
uz: Dorpat o'quvchisi bundan mustasno bo'lishi mumkin, chunki u bo'sh shishalarni to'ldirib, stolni yangi maydalar bilan moylagan holda, yuzida qizilroq va hamma joyda bo'lgan bo'ldi

en: of the sweet, sticky stuff.
uz: Bu shirin, yopishqoq narsalar.

en: The precise sequence of events I cannot remember, but I can recall feeling strongly attracted towards Frost and the Dorpat student that evening, learning their German song by heart, and kissing them each on their sticky-sweet lips; also that that same evening I conceived a violent hatred against the Dorpat student, and was for pushing him from his chair, but thought better of it; also that, besides feeling the same spirit of independence towards the rest of the company as I had felt on the night of the matriculation dinner, my head ached and swam so badly that I thought each moment would be my last; also that, for some reason or another, we all of us sat down on the floor and imitated the movements of rowers in a boat as we sang in chorus, “Down our mother stream the Volga;” also that I conceived this procedure on our part to be uncalled for; also that, as I lay prone upon the floor, I
uz: O'shanda men Frost va Dorpat o'quvchilariga qattiq jalb bo'lganimni eslay olaman, ularning nemis qo'shiqlarini yoddan o'rgandim va ularning har biriga o'z qo'pol-o'ng'izlari bilan o'pdim; shuningdek, o'sha kechada men Dorpat o'quchisiga nisbatan shafqatsiz nafratni o'ylab ko'rdim va uni o'rindiqidan itdim, ammo bundan yaxshiroq o'yladim; shuningdek, matrikul taomida o'tgan kechasi boshim og'rig'i va ko'z og'rig'im shunchalik og'ir ediki, har bir daqiqa so'zim bo'ladi deb o'yladim; shuningdek, bir sababdan yoki boshqa, barchamiz yerga o'tirdik va chorusda kuylaganimizda qayiqda kemachilarning harakatlarini taqlid qildik,  Volgawn,  Dogawn,  O'z onamizni qo'shib qo'yganimizda; shuningdek, men bu jarayonni o'z tomonim uchun ham o'zgartirganman; shuningdek, men o'zimni o'zgartirganimdek, o'zimni ham o'zgartirdim.

en: crossed my legs and began wriggling about like a tsigane; [Gipsy dancer.] also that I ricked some one’s neck, and came to the conclusion that I should never have done such a thing if I had not been drunk; also that we had some supper and another kind of liquor, and that I then went to the door to get some fresh air; also that my head seemed suddenly to grow chill, and that I noticed, as I drove away, that the scat of the vehicle was so sharply aslant and slippery that for me to retain my position behind Kuzma was impossible; also that he seemed to have turned all flabby, and to be waving about like a dish clout.
uz: oyoqlarimni o'chirib, bir qigan kabi aylanib yurishni boshladim; [Gipsy raqschi] shuningdek, kimningdir bo'yniga urib, mast bo'lmaganimda hech qachon bunday ish qilmagan bo'lar edim, degan xulosaga keldim; shuningdek, kechki ovqat va boshqa spirtli ichimliklarni ichgan edik va keyin toza havo olish uchun eshikga bordim; shuningdek, boshim birdan sovuq bo'lib ketayotgandek tuyuldi va men haydab ketayotganimda, mashinaning shovqinligi shunchalik keskin o'tgan va sekin bo'lganini payqadimki, Kuzma orqasida o'zimning pozitsiyamni saqlab qolish men uchun imkonsizdir; shuningdek, u butunlay chiroyli bo'lib ketgan va ko'ylakcha kabi o'girganini ko'rdim.

en: But what I remember best is that throughout the whole of that evening I never ceased to feel that I was acting with excessive stupidity in pretending to be enjoying myself, to like drinking a great deal, and to be in no way drunk, as well as that every one else present was acting with equal stupidity in pretending those same things.
uz: Ammo eng yaxshi eslaymanki, o'sha kecha davomida men o'zimni zavqlanib, ko'p ichishni yaxshi ko'raman va hech qachon mast bo'lmasam, deb o'ylashim uchun o'zimni haddan tashqari ahmoqona ish tutganimni his etishdan to'xtamasdim, shuningdek, boshqalarning hammasi xuddi shu ahmoqonalik bilan xuddi shu narsalarni o'ylashayotgani haqida o'ylashdim.

en: All the time I had a feeling that each one of my companions was finding the festivities as distasteful as I was myself; but, in the belief that he was the only one doing so, felt himself bound to pretend that he was very merry, in order not to mar the general hilarity.
uz: Men har safar o'zim kabi har bir do'stim bayramlarni yoqimsiz deb o'ylardim; lekin, faqat o'zi bunday qilishiga ishonib, o'zini juda quvonchli deb o'ylashga majbur bo'ldim, umuman hayratga tushmaslik uchun.

en: Also, strange to state, I felt that I ought to keep up this pretence for the sole reason that into a punch- bowl there had been poured three bottles of champagne at nine roubles the bottle and ten bottles of rum at four—making seventy roubles in all, exclusive of the supper.
uz: Bundan tashqari, o'zimni o'ylashim mumkinki, men bu so'zlarni faqatgina shunga ko'ra davom ettirishim kerak edi, chunki bir cho'pkachaga to'qqiz rubldan bir shishaga uchta shampaniya, to'qqiz shishaga o'n shisha rum quyilgan edi.

en: So convinced of my folly did I feel that, when, at next day’s lecture, those of my comrades who had
uz: O'z aqlsizlikimga shu qadar ishongan edimki, ertasi kungi nutqda, o'tgan yillar davomida o'tgan tengdoshlarimning o'zlarining nutqlarini eshitganimda, o'zimni shunday his qildim.

en: been at Baron Z.‘s party seemed not only in no way ashamed to remember what they had done, but even talked about it so that other students might hear of their doings, I felt greatly astonished.
uz: Baron Z.ning partiyasida bo'lganimda, nafaqat ular nima qilganini eslab yurishdan uyalgan, balki boshqa talabalar ularning qilgan ishlarini eshitishi uchun bu haqda gapirgan bo'lsam ham, o'zimni juda hayratda qoldirdim.

en: They all declared that it had been a splendid “wine,” that Dorpat students were just the fellows for that kind of thing, and that there had been consumed at it no less than forty bottles of rum among twenty guests, some of whom had dropped senseless under the table!
uz: Ularning barchasi bu ajoyib sharob ekanligini, Dorpat talabalari o'sha kabi ishlarga to'g'ri kelganini va yigirma mehmon orasida kamida qirq shisha rum iste'mol qilinganligini, ba'zilari esa o'zlaricha dasturxonga tushganini aytishdi!

en: That they should care to talk about such things seemed strange enough, but that they should care to lie about them seemed absolutely unintelligible.
uz: Bunday narsalar to'g'risida gapirishni istashlari ajablanarli tuyulgan, ammo ular haqida yolg'on gapirishni istashlari mutlaqo tushunarli emas.

en: MY FRIENDSHIP WITH THE NECHLUDOFFS That winter, too, I saw a great deal both of Dimitri who often looked us up, and of his family, with whom I was beginning to stand on intimate terms.
uz: O'sha qishda ham bizni tez-tez kuzatib turadigan Dimitri va men yaqin munosabatlarga ega bo'lgan oila a'zolarini ko'p ko'rdim.

en: The Nechludoffs (that is to say, mother, aunt, and daughter) always spent their evenings at home, at which time the Princess liked young men to visit her—at all events young men of the kind whom she described as able to spend an evening without playing cards or dancing.
uz: Nechludofflar (ya'ni ona, opa va qizi) har doim kechki paytlarini uyda o'tkazishgan, shu paytlarda princess yigitlar uni tashrif buyurishlarini yoqtirgan.

en: Yet such young fellows must have been few and far between, for, although I went to the Nechludoffs almost every evening, I seldom found other guests present.
uz: Ammo bunday yoshlar kam bo'lishi kerak edi, chunki men Nechludoffga deyarli har kuni kechqurun borardim, ammo boshqa mehmonlarni kam uchratardim.

en: Thus, I came to know the members of this family and their several dispositions well enough to be able to form clear ideas as to their mutual relations, and to be quite at home amid the rooms and furniture of their house.
uz: Shunday qilib, men ushbu oila a'zolarini va ularning turli xil xatti-harakatlarini o'zaro munosabatlari to'g'risida aniq tasavvurga ega bo'lish va uyidagi xonalar va mebellar orasida o'zimni o'zim bilan tanishtirishga qodir bo'lgan darajada yaxshi tanishdim.

en: Indeed, so long as no other guests were present, I felt entirely at my ease.
uz: Darhaqiqat, boshqa mehmonlar bo'lmaganida, men o'zimni butunlay qulay his qilardim.

en: True, at first I used to feel a little uncomfortable when left alone in the
uz: To'g'ri, boshida men o'zimni yolg'iz qo'yib qo'yganimda biroz noqulay his qilardim.

en: room with Varenika, for I could not rid myself of the idea that, though far from pretty, she wished me to fall in love with her; but in time this nervousness of mine began to lessen, since she always looked so natural, and talked to me so exactly as though she were conversing with her brother or Lubov Sergievna, that I came to look upon her simply as a person to whom it was in no way dangerous or wrong to show that I took pleasure in her company.
uz: Varenika bilan o'tirganim uchun, men o'zimni go'zallikdan uzoq bo'lsa-da, u menga u bilan muhabbat qilishimni xohlagan fikrdan xalos qila olmadim; lekin vaqt o'tib bu tashvishlarim kamaydi, chunki u har doim juda tabiiy ko'rinardi va men bilan xuddi ukasi yoki Lubov Sergiyevna bilan suhbatlashgandek gapirardi, shuning uchun men uni shunchaki uning do'stligidan zavq olganimni ko'rsatish uchun hech qanday xavfli yoki noto'g'ri bo'lmagan odam sifatida ko'rib chiqdim.

en: Throughout the whole of our acquaintance she appeared to me merely a plain, though not positively ugly, girl, concerning whom one would never ask oneself the question, “Am I, or am I not, in love with her?” Sometimes I would talk to her direct, but more often I did so through Dimitri or Lubov Sergievna; and it was the latter method which afforded me the most pleasure.
uz: O'z tanishligimiz davomida u menga oddiy, garchi chiroyli bo'lmasa ham, hech qachon o'zimizga: "Men unga muhabbat qozonamanmi yoki yo'qmi?" degan savolni bermaydigan oddiy qiz edi. Ba'zan men unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirardim, lekin ko'pincha Dimitri yoki Lubov Sergiyevna orqali gapirardim.

en: I derived considerable gratification from discoursing when she was there, from hearing her sing, and, in general, from knowing that she was in the same room as myself; but it was seldom now that any thoughts of what our future relations might ever be, or that any dreams of self-sacrifice for my friend if he should ever fall in love with my sister, came into my head.
uz: U o'sha yerda bo'lganida nutq so'zlashdan, uning kuylashini eshitishdan va, umuman olganda, u men bilan bir xonada ekanligini bilishdan katta mamnuniyat topdim; lekin hozirda bizning kelajakdagi munosabatlarimiz qanday bo'lishi mumkinligi yoki do'stim uchun agar u opamga muhabbat qilar ekan, deb o'ylash orzularim boshimga kamdan-kam keladi.

en: If any such ideas or fancies occurred to me, I felt satisfied with the present, and drove away all thoughts about the future.
uz: Agar men o'zimga bunday g'oyalar yoki xayol-mulohazalar tushsa, hozirgi paytda o'zimni mamnun his qilardim va kelajakka bo'lgan barcha fikrlarni yo'q qilardim.

en: Yet, in spite of this intimacy, I continued to look upon it as my bounden duty to keep the Nechludoffs in general, and Varenika in particular, in ignorance of my true feelings and tastes, and strove always to appear altogether another young man than what I really was—to appear, indeed, such a young man as could never possibly have existed.
uz: Biroq, bunday yaqinlikka qaramay, men Nechludofflarni umuman, ayniqsa Varenikaning haqiqiy his-tuyg'ularimni bilmaslikni o'z burchim deb bildim va men o'zimdan boshqa yosh odamga o'xshatishga harakat qildim.

en: I affected to be “soulful” and would go off into raptures and exclamations and impassioned gestures whenever I wished it to be thought that anything pleased me, while, on the other hand, I tried always to seem indifferent towards any unusual circumstance which I myself perceived or which I had had pointed out to me.
uz: O'zimni "ruhiyatli" bo'lishga ta'sir qilib, o'zim sezgan yoki menga ko'rsatgan har qanday noyob holatga nisbatan har doim befarq bo'lib ko'rinishga harakat qilardim.

en: I aimed always at figuring both as a sarcastic cynic divorced from every sacred tie and as a shrewd observer, as well as at being accounted logical in all my conduct, precise and methodical in all my ways of life, and at the same time contemptuous of all materiality.
uz: Men har doim har qanday muqaddas bog'likdan ajralgan sarkastikaviy sinik va aqlli kuzatuvchi sifatida, shuningdek, barcha xulq-atvorimda mantiqiy, barcha hayot tarzimda aniq va metodik bo'lib, bir vaqtning o'zida barcha moddiy narsalarga hurmatsizlik bilan qaragan bo'lishga harakat qilardim.

en: I may safely say that I was far better in reality than the strange being into whom I attempted to convert myself; yet, whatever I was or was not,
uz: Men o'zimni o'zimga aylantirmoqchi bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy mavjudotga qaraganda haqiqatda ancha yaxshiroq bo'lganimni aytishim mumkin; ammo men nima bo'lsam ham, nima bo'lmasam ham, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshatdim.

en: the Nechludoffs were unfailingly kind to me, and (happily for myself) took no notice (as it now appears) of my play-acting.
uz: Nechludofflar menga nisbatan beqiyos mehribon bo'lishdi va (o'zim uchun baxtli bo'lgan) mening o'yin-kulgimni hech qachon e'tiborga olmagan.

en: Only Lubov Sergievna, who, I believe, really believed me to be a great egoist, atheist, and cynic, had no love for me, but frequently disputed what I said, flew into tempers, and left me petrified with her disjointed, irrelevant utterances.
uz: Faqat Lubov Sergiyevna, men o'ylaymanki, meni katta xudbin, ateist va sinik deb hisoblagan, menga hech qanday sevgi ko'rsatmagan, lekin ko'pincha aytganlarimga qarshi chiqib, g'azabga tushdi va uning noaniq va ahamiyatsiz so'zlari meni dahshatga soldi.

en: Yet Dimitri held always to the same strange, something more than friendly, relations with her, and used to say not only that she was misunderstood by every one, but that she did him a world of good.
uz: Ammo Dimitriy doimo u bilan o'xshash g'alati, do'stona munosabatlarga ega bo'lgan va u nafaqat u har kim tomonidan noto'g'ri tushunilgan, balki unga yaxshilik qilganligini aytadi.

en: This, however, did not prevent the rest of his family from finding fault with his infatuation.
uz: Biroq, bu uning oila a'zolarining o'ziga xos ishtiyoqidan ayb topishiga to'sqinlik qilmadi.

en: Once, when talking to me about this incomprehensible attachment, Varenika explained the matter thus: “You see, Dimitri is a selfish person.
uz: Bir marta Varenika menga bu tushunarli bo'lmagan bog'liqlik haqida gapirganida, bu haqda shunday tushuntirdi: "Dimitri o'zboshimchalik bilan odam.

en: He is very proud, and, for all his intellect, very fond of praise, and of surprising people, and of always being FIRST, while little Auntie” (the general nickname for Lubov Sergievna) “is innocent enough to admire him, and at the same time devoid of the tact to conceal her admiration.
uz: U juda mag'rur va, butun aqli bo'lsa-da, maqtovga, hayratda qoldiradigan odamlarga va har doim birinchi bo'lishga juda yoqadi, kichik onasi (Lubov Sergiyevna uchun umumiy alif nomi) esa unga hayron bo'lish uchun yetarlicha aybsiz va shu bilan birga o'z hayronligini yashirish uchun maqtanchidan mahrum.

en: Consequently she flatters his vanity—not out of pretence, but sincerely.” This dictum I laid to heart, and, when thinking it over afterwards, could not but come to the conclusion that Varenika was very sensible; wherefore I was glad to award her promotion thenceforth in my regard.
uz: Shuning uchun u uning behudaligini so'zsiz emas, chin dildan maqtagan. Men bu so'zlarni o'z yuragimga qo'ydim va keyinchalik o'ylab ko'rganimda, Varenikaning juda aqlli ekanligiga amin bo'ldim; shuning uchun men bundan buyon unga o'z munosabatim bilan lavozimga ko'tarilishdan xursand bo'ldim.

en: Yet, though I was always glad enough to assign her any credit which might arise from my discovering in her character any signs of good sense or other moral qualities, I did so with strict moderation, and never ran to any extreme pitch of enthusiasm in the process.
uz: Biroq, agar men har doim uning shaxsiyatida aqli rasolik yoki boshqa axloqiy fazilatlarni ko'rganimdan kelib chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan biron bir kreditni unga berishdan mamnun bo'lsam-da, men buni qat'iyat bilan o'ylayman va bu jarayonda hech qachon nihoyatda g'ayratli bo'lmayman.

en: Thus, when Sophia Ivanovna (who was never weary of discussing her niece) related to me how, four years ago, Varenika had suddenly given away all her clothes to some peasant children without first asking permission to do so, so that the garments had subsequently to be recovered, I did not at once accept the fact as entitling Varenika to elevation in my opinion, but went on giving her good advice about the unpracticalness of such views on property.
uz: Shunday qilib, Sofiya Ivanovna (o'z singlisi haqida gapirishdan hech qachon charchamaydi) menga to'rt yil oldin Varenika bir necha qishloq farzandlariga to'satdan barcha kiyim-kechaklarini ruxsat so'ramagan holda qaytib berganini aytib berganda, keyinchalik bu kiyim-kechaklar qaytarib olinishi kerak edi, men bu faktni Varenikaga mening fikrimcha yuksaklikka ega bo'lish huquqiga ega bo'lganini darhol qabul qilmadim, balki unga mulkka nisbatan bunday nuqtai nazarlarning amaliy emasligi haqida yaxshi maslahat berishni davom ettirdim.

en: When other guests were present at the Nechludoffs (among them, sometimes, Woloda and Dubkoff) I used to withdraw myself to a remote plane, and, with the complacency and quiet consciousness of strength of an habitue of the house, listen to what others were saying without putting in a remark myself.
uz: Nechludoffda boshqa mehmonlar bo'lganida (ular orasida ba'zan Woloda va Dubkoff) men o'zimni uzoq samolyotga olib borardim va uyda ishlaydigan kishi kabi o'z-o'zimni o'ylash va kuch-qudrat bilan boshqalarning gaplarini o'zim aytmasdan tinglardim.

en: Yet everything that these others
uz: Biroq, bu boshqalarning hamma narsa bilan bog'liq.

en: said seemed to me so immeasurably stupid that I used to feel inwardly amazed that such a clever, logical woman as the Princess, with her equally logical family, could listen to and answer such rubbish.
uz: Oʻshanda men oʻzimni shunchalik ahmoq deb bilardimki, oʻzimni oʻzimda hayratda qoldirganmanki, shu kabi aqlli, mantiqiy ayol, shu kabi mantiqiy oilasi bilan Prinsesa kabi, bunday axloqsizlikni tinglab, javob bera oladi.

en: Had it, however, entered into my head to compare what, others said with what I myself said when there alone, I should probably have ceased to feel surprise.
uz: Biroq, agar boshqalarning aytishi bilan o'zimning o'zim yolg'iz bo'lganimda aytganim bilan solishtirishni o'ylagandim bo'lsa, ehtimol, men o'zimni ajablantirishni to'xtatardim.

en: Still less should I have continued to feel surprise had I not believed that the women of our own household—Avdotia, Lubotshka, and Katenka—were superior to the rest of their sex, for in that case I should have remembered the kind of things over which Avdotia and Katenka would laugh and jest with Dubkoff from one end of an evening to the other.
uz: Ayniqsa, agar Avdotia, Lubotshka va Katenka ayollarining o'z oiladagi ayollardan ustun ekaniga ishonmaganimda, o'zimni hayratda qoldirgan bo'lar edim, chunki o'sha holda Avdotia va Katenka Dubkoff bilan kechqurun bir chetidan boshqasiga kulishadigan narsalarni eslab qolishim kerak edi.

en: I should have remembered that seldom did an evening pass but Dubkoff would first have, an argument about something, and then read in a sententious voice either some verses beginning “Au banquet de la vie, infortune convive” or extracts from The Demon.
uz: Esda tutishim kerak ediki, kechki paytlar kamdan-kam kechki paytlar o'tadi, lekin Dubkoff avval bir narsa haqida bahslashib, so'ngra bir nechta oyatlarni o'qib o'tishi kerak edi.

en: In short, I should have remembered what nonsense they used to chatter for hours at a time.
uz: Bir so'z bilan aytganda, ular bir vaqtning o'zida soatlab nimalar haqida gapirishganini eslab qolishim kerak edi.

en: It need hardly be said that, when guests were present, Varenika paid less attention to me than when we were alone, as well as that I was deprived of the reading and music which I so greatly loved to hear.
uz: Qonaqlar borligida Varenika menga yolg'iz bo'lganimizda bo'lganidan kamroq e'tibor qaratganini, shuningdek, men eshitishni juda yaxshi ko'rgan o'qish va musiqadan mahrum bo'lganimni aytishning hojati yo'q.

en: When talking to guests, she lost, in my eyes, her principal charm—that of quiet seriousness and simplicity.
uz: Mehmonlar bilan suhbatlashayotib, u mening ko'zimga ko'ra, uning asosiy jozibasi - xotirjam jiddiylik va soddalik bo'lganini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: I remember how strange it used to seem to me to hear her discoursing on theatres and the weather to my brother Woloda!
uz: O'zimning akam Voloda bilan teatrlarda va ob-havo to'g'risida uning nutqlarini eshitish men uchun qanchalik g'alati tuyulganini eslayman!

en: I knew that of all things in the world he most despised and shunned banality, and that Varenika herself used to make fun of forced conversations on the weather and similar matters.
uz: Dunyodagi barcha narsalardan u eng ko'p nafratlanishini va oddiy hollikdan qochishini bilar edim va Varenika ham ob-havo va shunga o'xshash masalalar to'g'risida majburiy suhbatlarni masxara qilardi.

en: Why, then, when meeting in society, did they both of them talk such intolerable nothings, and, as it were, shame one another?
uz: Xo'sh, nima uchun ular jamiyatda uchrashganda, ikkalasi ham bu qadar qo'pol gaplarni gapirib, bir-birlarini sharmanda qilishgan?

en: After talks of this kind I used to feel silently resentful against Woloda, as well as next day to rally Varenika on her overnight guests.
uz: Bunday suhbatlardan so'ng men Wolodaga g'azablanardim, ertasi kuni esa Varenikaning kechqurun kelgan mehmonlarini yig'ib olishim kerak edi.

en: Yet one result of it was that I derived all the greater pleasure from being one of the Nechludoffs’ family circle.
uz: Ammo buning natijasi shundaki, men Nechludoff oila a'zolaridan biri bo'lishdan katta zavq oldim.

en: Also, for some reason or another I began to prefer meeting Dimitri in his mother’s drawing-room to being with him alone.
uz: Bundan tashqari, nima sababdan yoki boshqa sabablarga ko'ra, Dimitri bilan yolg'iz bo'lishdan ko'ra onasining oshxonasida uchrashishni afzal ko'rishni boshladim.

en: MY FRIENDSHIP WITH THE NECHLUDOFFS At this period, indeed, my friendship with Dimitri hung by a hair.
uz: Bu davrda Dimitri bilan do'stligim sochlar bilan bog'liq edi.

en: I had been criticising him too long not to have discovered faults in his character, for it is only in first youth that we love passionately and therefore love only perfect people.
uz: Men uning shaxsiyatida kamchiliklarni topmaganim uchun uzoq vaqtdan beri uni tanqid qilgandim, chunki biz faqat yoshlik paytida ishtiyoq bilan sevamiz va shuning uchun faqat mukammal odamlarni sevamiz.

en: As soon as the mists engendered by love of this kind begin to dissolve, and to be penetrated by the clear beams of reason, we see the object of our adoration in his true shape, and with all his virtues and failings exposed.
uz: Bunday muhabbat tufayli paydo bo'lgan bulutlar erishib, oqilona bo'lgan oqibati bilan o'ralishni boshlaganidan so'ng, biz maqtovimiz predmetini uning haqiqiy shaklida va barcha fazilatlari va kamchiliklari oshkor qilingan holda ko'ramiz.

en: Some of those failings strike us with the exaggerated force of the unexpected, and combine with the instinct for novelty and the hope that perfection may yet be found in a fellow-man to induce us not only to feel coldness, but even aversion, towards the late object of our adoration.
uz: Bunday kamchiliklarning ba'zilari bizni kutilmaganlarning haddan tashqari kuchi bilan urib, yangilik instinktlari va birovda mukammallik topilishiga umid bilan birlashtirib, nafaqat sovuqlikni, balki hatto o'zimiz sajda qilgan oxirgi ob'ektga nisbatan nafratni his etishga undaydi.

en: Consequently, desiring it no longer, we usually cast it from us, and pass onwards to seek fresh perfection.
uz: Natijada, biz uni boshqa istamaymiz, shuning uchun biz odatda uni o'zimizdan tashlab, yangi mukammallikka intilish uchun oldinga o'tamiz.

en: For the circumstance that that was not what occurred with respect to my own relation to Dimitri, I was indebted to his stubborn, punctilious, and more critical than impulsive attachment to myself—a tie which I felt ashamed to break.
uz: Dimitri bilan o'z munosabatlarimda shunday bo'lmaganligi sababli, men uning o'zimga bo'lgan o'ta qattiq, aniq va o'z-o'zimga bo'lgan munosabatidan juda ham minnatdor edim.

en: Moreover, our strange vow of frankness bound us together.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bizni o'zgacha ochiqlik qasamyodimiz birlashtirdi.

en: We were afraid that, if we parted, we should leave in one another’s power all the incriminatory moral secrets of which we had made mutual confession.
uz: Agar ajralib ketsak, o'zaro e'tirof etganimiz barcha aybdor axloqiy sirlarni bir-birimizga topshirib qo'yishdan qo'rqardik.

en: At the same time, our rule of frankness had long ceased to be faithfully observed, but, on the contrary, proved a frequent cause of constraint, and brought about strange relations between us.
uz: Shu bilan birga, bizning ochiqlik qoidamiz uzoq vaqtdan beri sadoqatli bo'lib qolmay qolgan edi, aksincha, u tez-tez cheklovlar keltirib chiqargan va o'zimiz bilan o'zgacha munosabatlarga olib kelgan.

en: Almost every time that winter that I went upstairs to Dimitri’s room, I used to find there a University friend of his named Bezobiedoff, with whom he appeared to be very much taken up.
uz: Demak, o'sha qishda men Dimitrining xonasiga borganimda, u yerda uning Bezobiedoff ismli universitet do'sti bor edi, u bilan u juda qiziq edi.

en: Bezobiedoff was a small, slight fellow, with a face pitted over with smallpox, freckled, effeminate hands, and a huge flaxen moustache much in need of the comb.
uz: Bezobiedoff kichkina va yengil yigit edi, uning yuzida cho'chqa kasalligi bor edi, qo'llari qizargan, ayol qo'llari ko'p bo'lgan va katta bo'g'i bor edi.

en: He was invariably dirty, shabby, uncouth, and uninteresting.
uz: U har doim nopok, xor, nopok va qiziqarli bo'lmagan.

en: To me, Dimitri’s relations with him were as unintelligible as his
uz: Dimitrining u bilan bo'lgan munosabati menga uning munosabati kabi tushunarli emas edi.

en: relations with Lubov Sergievna, and the only reason he could have had for choosing such a man for his associate was that in the whole University there was no worse-looking student than Bezobiedoff.
uz: Lubov Sergiyevna bilan munosabatlar bo'lgan va u bunday kishini o'z hamkori sifatida tanlaganining yagona sababi, butun universitetda Bezobiedoffdan yomon ko'rinadigan talaba yo'qligi edi.

en: Yet that alone would have been sufficient to make Dimitri extend him his friendship, and, as a matter of fact, in all his intercourse with this fellow he seemed to be saying proudly: “I care nothing who a man may be.
uz: Biroq, Dimitriy unga do'stlikni kengaytirishi uchun bu o'zi yetarli bo'lardi va aslida, bu yigit bilan o'tkazgan barcha suhbatlarida u faxrlanar bo'lib: "Men odam kim bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida umuman o'ylamayman.

en: In my eyes every one is equal.
uz: Mening ko'zimda hamma tengdir.

en: I like him, and therefore he is a desirable acquaintance.” Nevertheless I could not imagine how he could bring himself to do it, nor how the wretched Bezobiedoff ever contrived to maintain his awkward position.
uz: Men uni yoqtiraman va shuning uchun u yoqimli tanisdir. Shunga qaramay, u buni qanday qilib qila olishini va bezobiedoffning o'z vazifasini qanday saqlab qolishini tasavvur ham qila olmasdim.

en: To me the friendship seemed a most distasteful one.
uz: Men uchun do'stlik juda jirkanch tuyulgan.

en: One night, I went up to Dimitri’s room to try and get him to come down for an evening’s talk in his mother’s drawing-room, where we could also listen to Varenika’s reading and singing, but Bezobiedoff had forestalled me there, and Dimitri answered me curtly that he could not come down, since, as I could see for myself, he had a visitor with him.
uz: Bir kecha men Dimitriyning xonasiga borganimda, uni onasining o'tirish xonasida oqshom nutqlari uchun tushishga undadim, u yerda Varenikaning o'qishi va kuylashini ham tinglashimiz mumkin edi, lekin Bezobiedoff meni oldinga surib qo'ydi va Dimitri menga qisqacha javob berdiki, u tusholmaydi, chunki, o'zim ko'rganimcha, u bilan birga mehmon bor edi.

en: “Besides,” he added, “what is the fun of sitting there?
uz: Bundan tashqari, u qo'shimcha qildi: "O'sha yerda o'tirishning qiziqarli joyi nimada?
