en: Yes, yes, she is a lady of spirit, proud and determined.
uz: Ha, ha, u ruhli, mag'rur va qat'iy ayol.

en: She scrubs the floors herself and has nothing but black bread to eat, but won’t allow herself to be treated with disrespect.
uz: U o'zi yerni tozalaydi va ovqatlanish uchun qora nondan boshqa hech narsa yo'q, lekin o'ziga hurmatsizlik ko'rsatilishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: That’s why she would not overlook Mr.
uz: Shuning uchun u Mr.Xolibni e'tiborsiz qoldirmagan.

en: Lebeziatnikov’s rudeness to her, and so when he gave her a beating for it, she took to her bed more from the hurt to her feelings than from the blows.
uz: Lebeziatnikovning unga nisbatan shafqatsizligi, shuning uchun u uni urganida, u o'z yotoqxonasiga o'tirganidan ko'ra ko'proq o'z his-tuyg'ularidan azob chekkan.

en: She was a widow when I married her, with three children, one smaller than the other.
uz: Men u bilan turmush qurganimda, u beva edi va u uchta farzandga ega edi, biri ikkinchisidan kichikroq edi.

en: She married her first husband, an infantry officer, for love, and ran away with him from her father’s house.
uz: U birinchi eri, piyoda xodimi bo'lgan erini sevish uchun turmushga chiqdi va u bilan birga otasi uyidan qochib ketdi.

en: She was exceedingly fond of her husband; but he gave way to cards, got into trouble and with that he died.
uz: U erini juda yaxshi ko'rgan edi, lekin u kartadan voz kechib, muammolarga tushib, o'ldi.

en: He used to beat her at the end: and although she paid him back, of which I have authentic documentary evidence, to this day she speaks of him with tears and she throws him up to me; and I am glad, I am glad that, though only in imagination, she should think of herself as having once been happy.
uz: Oxirida u uni urardi va garchi u unga pul to'lagan bo'lsa-da, bu borada ishonchli hujjatlarga ega bo'lgan dalillar bor, lekin u shu kungacha u haqida ko'z yoshlari bilan gapiradi va uni menga ko'rsatadi; va men xursandman, xursandmanki, agar u faqat tasavvurda bo'lsa-da, o'zini bir vaqtlar baxtli bo'lgan deb o'ylashi kerak.

en: … And she was left at his death with three children in a wild and remote district where I happened to be at the time; and she was left in such hopeless poverty that, although I have seen many ups and downs of all sort, I don’t feel equal to describing it even.
uz: U o'limida uch nafar bolasi bilan o'sha paytda men o'zim turgan yovvoyi va chekka joyda qoldi va u shunchalik umidsiz kambag'allikda qoldiki, men ko'p o'zgarishlarni ko'rgan bo'lsam-da, uni hatto tasvirlashga ham teng emasman.

en: Her relations had all thrown her off.
uz: Uning qarindoshlari uni tashlab ketishdi.

en: And she was proud, too,
uz: Va u ham faxrlanardi,

en: … And then, honoured sir, and then, I, being at the time a widower, with a daughter of fourteen left me by my first wife, offered her my hand, for I could not bear the sight of such suffering.
uz: Keyin, aziz sir, o'sha paytda beva bo'lganim uchun, birinchi rafiqam menga o'n to'rt yoshli qizini qoldirib, unga qo'limni taklif qildim, chunki men bunday azob-uqubatlarni ko'rishni ko'ra olmadim.

en: You can judge the extremity of her calamities, that she, a woman of education and culture and distinguished family, should have consented to be my wife.
uz: Uning azob-uqubatlari qanchalik og'ir ekanini o'ylab ko'ring, ta'lim-tarbiya, madaniyat va obro'li oiladagi ayol mening xotinim bo'lishga rozi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Weeping and sobbing and wringing her hands, she married me!
uz: Oʻzi yigʻlab, yigʻlab, qoʻllarini burib, menga turmushga chiqdi!

en: For she had nowhere to turn!
uz: Chunki u qayerga borishi mumkin bo'lgan joyga ega emas edi!

en: Do you understand, sir, do you understand what it means when you have absolutely nowhere to turn?
uz: Siz tushunasizmi, xo'jayinim, siz hech qanday joyga bormayotganingizda nimani anglatishini tushunasizmi?

en: No, that you don’t understand yet.
uz: Yo'q, siz hali tushunmagan narsa.

en: … And for a whole year, I performed my duties conscientiously and faithfully, and did not touch this” (he tapped the jug with his finger), “for I have feelings.
uz: Bir yil davomida men o'z vazifamni vijdon va sadoqat bilan bajardim va bunga qo'l urmadim (o'zi barmog'i bilan qo'l urgan), chunki his-tuyg'ularim bor.

en: But even so, I could not please her; and then I lost my place too, and that through no fault of mine but through changes in the office; and then I did touch it!
uz: Ammo shunga qaramay, men unga yoqtirolmadim va keyin o'z joyimni ham yo'qotdim va bu mening aybim emas, balki ofisdagi o'zgarishlar tufayli bo'ldi.

en: … It will be a year and a half ago soon since we found ourselves at last after many wanderings and numerous calamities in this magnificent capital, adorned with innumerable monuments.
uz: ... Yaqinda bir yarim yil o'tgach, ko'plab sayohatlar va ko'plab ofatlar bo'lganidan so'ng, son-sanoqsiz yodgorliklar bilan bezatilgan bu ajoyib poytaxtda o'zimizni topdik.

en: Here I obtained a situation.
uz: Bu erda men vaziyatni topdim.

en: … I obtained it and I lost it again.
uz: ... Men uni topdim va yana yo'qotdim.

en: This time it was through my own fault I lost it: for my weakness had come out.
uz: Bu safar uni o'zimning xatoim tufayli yo'qotdim, chunki zaifligim oshkor bo'lgan edi.

en: … We have now part of a room at Amalia Fyodorovna Lippevechsel’s; and what we live upon and what we pay our rent with, I could not say.
uz: ... Endi bizda Amaliya Fyodorovna Lippevechsels-da xonaning bir qismi mavjud; va biz nima bilan yashashimiz va ijara pulini nima bilan to'lashimizni ayta olmayman.

en: There are a lot of people living there besides ourselves.
uz: U yerda bizdan tashqari ko'plab odamlar yashaydi.

en: Dirt and disorder, a perfect Bedlam … hm … yes … And meanwhile my daughter by my first wife has grown up; and what my daughter has had to put up with from her stepmother whilst she was growing up, I won’t speak of.
uz: Buzuqlik va tartibsizlik, mukammal Bedlam ... hm ... ha ... shu bilan birga, birinchi rafiqamdan bo'lgan qizim katta bo'ldi; va qizim o'sganida o'z qaynonasidan nimalarni boshdan kechirdi, men bu haqda gapirmayman.

en: For, though Katerina Ivanovna is full of generous feelings, she is a spirited lady, irritable and short-tempered.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna saxiy his-tuyg'ularga to'la bo'lsa-da, u ruhiyatli ayol, g'azablanuvchi va qisqa ruhiyatli.

en: But it’s no use going over that!
uz: Ammo bu haqda gapirishning foydasi yo'q!

en: Sonia, as you may well fancy, has had no education.
uz: Sonia, siz o'ylagandek, hech qanday ta'lim olmagan.

en: I did make an effort four years ago to give her a course of geography and universal history, but as I was not very well up in those subjects myself and we had no suitable books, and what books we had … hm, anyway we have not even those now, so all our instruction came to an end.
uz: To'rt yil oldin men unga geografiya va universal tarix kursini o'rgatishga harakat qildim, lekin men o'zim bu fanlarda juda yaxshi o'rnak ko'rmaganim va bizda mos kitoblar yo'q edi va qanday kitoblar bor edi ... um, hozirda bizda ular ham yo'q, shuning uchun barcha o'quvlarimiz tugadi.

en: We stopped at Cyrus of Persia.
uz: Biz Fors shohi Kuroda to'xtadik.

en: Since she has attained years of maturity, she has read other books of romantic tendency and of late she had read with great interest a book she got through Mr.
uz: O'shanda u o'zining yetukligi yillariga yetganidan buyon boshqa romantik kitoblarni ham o'qigan va so'nggi paytlarda u Mr. orqali olgan kitobni katta qiziqish bilan o'qigan.

en: Lebeziatnikov, Lewes’ Physiology —do you know it?
uz: Lebeziatnikov, Lewes Fisiologiyao'zingiz bilasizmi?

en: —and even recounted extracts from it to us: and that’s the
uz: va hatto undan o'qigan bitiklarni bizga aytib berdi: va bu

en: whole of her education.
uz: butun ta'limini o'tkazgan.

en: And now may I venture to address you, honoured sir, on my own account with a private question.
uz: Endi esa, hurmatli sir, sizga shaxsiy savol bilan murojaat qilishga jur'at qilsam bo'ladi.

en: Do you suppose that a respectable poor girl can earn much by honest work?
uz: Sizningcha, hurmatga sazovor kambag'al qiz halol ish bilan ko'p pul topishi mumkinmi?

en: Not fifteen farthings a day can she earn, if she is respectable and has no special talent and that without putting her work down for an instant!
uz: Agar u hurmatga sazovor bo'lsa va o'zgacha iste'dodga ega bo'lmasa, kuniga 15 fartinch pul ham topolmaydi va bu ishni bir zumga ham pastga solmasdan!

en: And what’s more, Ivan Ivanitch Klopstock the civil counsellor —have you heard of him?
uz: Bundan tashqari, fuqarolik maslahatchisi Ivan Ivanitch Klopstock haqida eshitganmisiz?

en: —has not to this day paid her for the half-dozen linen shirts she made him and drove her roughly away, stamping and reviling her, on the pretext that the shirt collars were not made like the pattern and were put in askew.
uz: bu kungacha u unga yarim o'nlab to'qimaq ko'ylaklari uchun pul to'lamagan va uni taxminan yo'qlab ketayotgan, uni bosqinchilik va haqorat qilib, ko'ylaklar namunaga o'xshamaydi, deb o'yinda ko'ylaklar qo'yilgan.

en: And there are the little ones hungry.
uz: Va kichiklar och.

en: … And Katerina Ivanovna walking up and down and wringing her hands, her cheeks flushed red, as they always are in that disease: ‘Here you live with us,’ says she, ‘you eat and drink and are kept warm and you do nothing to help.’ And much she gets to eat and drink when there is not a crust for the little ones for three days!
uz: Katerina Ivonovna esa o'z qo'llarini o'rab-o'rab yurardi, yig'ib-o'rab yurardi, yig'ib-o'tib, o'zlarining qizil chehralari o'sha kasallikda har doimgidek: "Bu yerda siz biz bilan yashayapsiz", - deydi u, "Siz ovqatlanasiz va ichasiz va issiq bo'lib qolasiz va hech narsa qilmaysiz.

en: I was lying at the time … well, what of it!
uz: O'shanda yolg'on gapirgan edim... nima bo'ldi!

en: I was lying drunk and I heard my Sonia speaking (she is a gentle creature with a soft little voice … fair hair and such a pale, thin little face).
uz: Men mast bo'lib yotgan edim va Sonia so'zlashiga quloq soldim (o'zi yumshak ovozi, chiroyli sochlari va o'ta oq va chiroyli yuzi bilan mehribon yaratilgan).

en: She said: ‘Katerina Ivanovna, am I really to do a thing like that?’ And Darya Frantsovna, a woman of evil character and very well known to the police, had two or three times tried to get at her through the landlady.
uz: U shunday dedi: "Katerina Ivanovna, men haqiqatan ham bunday ishni qilsam bo'ladimi?" Va Darya Frantsovna, yovuz xarakterga ega va politsiya uchun juda mashhur ayol, uy egasi orqali ikki-uch marta unga qarshi chiqishga harakat qildi.

en: ‘And why not?’ said Katerina Ivanovna with a jeer, ‘you are something mighty precious to be so careful of!’ But don’t blame her, don’t blame her, honoured sir, don’t blame her!
uz: Va nega yo'q? dedi Katerina Ivanovna bir marta, siz shunchalik ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak bo'lgan juda qimmatbaho narsasiz! Ammo uni ayblamang, uni ayblamang, hurmatli sir, uni ayblamang!

en: She was not herself when she spoke, but driven to distraction by her illness and the crying of the hungry children; and it was said more to wound her than anything else.
uz: U gapirganda o'zi emas edi, kasalligi va och bolalarning yig'lashlari uni chalg'itardi va bu ayolga boshqa narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq zarar yetkazadi.

en: … For that’s Katerina Ivanovna’s character, and when children cry, even from hunger, she falls to beating them at once.
uz: Chunki Katerina Ivanovna o'z xarakterini o'z ichiga oladi va bolalar ochlikdan yig'lagandan keyin ham ularni darhol urishga majbur bo'ladi.

en: At six o’clock I saw Sonia get up, put on her kerchief and her cape, and go out of the room and about nine o’clock she came back.
uz: Soat oltilarda Soniyani turib, o'z pichoqini va qopqog'ini kiyib, xonadan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rdim va soat to'qqizlarda u qaytib keldi.

en: She walked straight up to Katerina Ivanovna and she laid thirty roubles on the table before her in silence.
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Katerina Ivonovnaga yaqinlashdi va u o'ttiz rublni o'z oldiga so'zsiz o'rnatib qo'ydi.

en: She did not utter a word, she did not even look at her, she simply picked up our big green drap de dames shawl (we have a shawl, made of drap de dames), put it over her head and face and lay down on the bed with her face to the wall; only her little shoulders and her body kept shuddering.
uz: U bir so'z aytmadi, hatto unga nazar ham solmadi, shunchaki bizning katta yashil de dames shalimizni (bizda de dames shali bor), boshini va yuziga qo'ydi va o'z yuzini devorga tikib, to'shakda yotgan edi; faqat uning kichkina shohlari va tanasi titrab turardi.

en: … And I went on lying there, just as before.
uz: Va men o'sha yerda, avvalgidek, yotgan edim.

en: … And then I saw, young man, I saw Katerina Ivanovna, in
uz: Keyin men ko'rdim, yosh yigit, Katerina Ivanovna ko'rdim.

en: the same silence go up to Sonia’s little bed; she was on her knees all the evening kissing Sonia’s feet, and would not get up, and then they both fell asleep in each other’s arms … together, together … yes … and I … lay drunk.” Marmeladov stopped short, as though his voice had failed him.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, Sonia o'zining kichkina yotoqxonasiga ham shunday xotirjamlik ko'tariladi; u butun kecha tiz cho'kib, Sonia oyoqlarini o'qib turardi va turolmadi, so'ngra ikkalasi ham bir-birining qo'lida uxlab ketishdi ... birgalikda, birgalikda ... ha ... va men ... mast o'tirdim. Marmeladov o'z ovozini yo'qotganidek, o'zini to'xtatdi.

en: Then he hurriedly filled his glass, drank, and cleared his throat.
uz: Keyin u darhol shishalarini to'ldirdi, ichdi va qo'lini tozaladi.

en: “Since then, sir,” he went on after a brief pause —“Since then, owing to an unfortunate occurrence and through information given by evil-intentioned persons —in all which Darya Frantsovna took a leading part on the pretext that she had been treated with want of respect —since then my daughter Sofya Semyonovna has been forced to take a yellow ticket, and owing to that she is unable to go on living with us.
uz: O'shandan beri, xonim, u qisqa bir to'xtatishdan so'ng davom etdi O'shandan beri, baxtsiz hodisa tufayli va yomon niyatli odamlar tomonidan berilgan ma'lumot tufayli Darya Frantsovna o'z o'rniga hurmatsizlik bilan muomala qilgani dastidan yetakchi o'rinni egalladi.O'shandan beri qizim Sofiya Semyonovna sariq chipta olishga majbur bo'ldi va shu sababli u biz bilan yashashni davom ettira olmaydi.

en: For our landlady, Amalia Fyodorovna would not hear of it (though she had backed up Darya Frantsovna before) and Mr.
uz: Uy egasi Amaliya Fyodorovna buni eshitmaydi (agar u ilgari Dariya Frantsovna bilan hamkorlik qilgan bo'lsa-da) va Mr.

en: Lebeziatnikov too … hm.
uz: Lebeziatnikov ham ... hm.

en: … All the trouble between him and Katerina Ivanovna was on Sonia’s account.
uz: U bilan Katerina Ivanovna o'rtasidagi barcha muammolar Sonia hisobida edi.

en: At first he was for making up to Sonia himself and then all of a sudden he stood on his dignity: ‘how,’ said he, ‘can a highly educated man like me live in the same rooms with a girl like that?’ And Katerina Ivanovna would not let it pass, she stood up for her … and so that’s how it happened.
uz: Boshida u Sonia bilan o'zini yarashtirgan edi va keyin birdan o'z qadr-qimmatini mustahkamladi: "Men kabi oliy ma'lumotli odam o'sha qiz bilan bir xonada yashashi mumkinmi?" - dedi u. Katerina Ivanovna buni o'tkazib yubormadi, u uning tarafida turdi... va shunday bo'ldi.

en: And Sonia comes to us now, mostly after dark; she comforts Katerina Ivanovna and gives her all she can.
uz: Sonia esa hozir bizga keladi, asosan qorong'ilik chog'ida; Katerina Ivanovnaga tasalli berib, qo'lidan kelganicha yordam beradi.

en: … She has a room at the Kapernaumovs’ the tailors, she lodges with them; Kapernaumov is a lame man with a cleft palate and all of his numerous family have cleft palates too.
uz: ...Kapernaumovlar uyida o'tiradi, ular bilan uyda yashaydi; Kapernaumov cho'loq odam bo'lib, uning ko'plab oila a'zolari ham o'zlarining cho'loq qo'llari bor.

en: And his wife, too, has a cleft palate.
uz: Uning xotini ham buqaloq bo'lib qolgan.

en: They all live in one room, but Sonia has her own, partitioned off.
uz: Ularning barchasi bir xonada yashaydi, lekin Sonia o'zidan iborat bo'lgan bo'linmalarga ega.

en: … Hm … yes … very poor people and all with cleft palates … yes.
uz: Ha... ha... juda kambag'al odamlar va hammalari palatasi bo'g'ilib qolganlar... ha.

en: Then I got up in the morning, and put on my rags, lifted up my hands to heaven and set off to his excellency Ivan Afanasyvitch.
uz: Keyin ertalab uyg'onib, kiyimimni kiydirib, qo'llarimni osmonga ko'tarib, oliy ruhoniy Ivon Afanasivichning oldiga jo'nab ketdim.

en: His excellency Ivan Afanasyvitch, do you know him?
uz: Uning oliyligi Ivan Afanasyvitch, siz uni taniysizmi?

en: Well, then, it’s a man of God you don’t know.
uz: Xo'sh, u siz bilmagan Xudoyimizdir.

en: He is wax … wax before the face of the Lord; even as wax melteth!
uz: U Xudovandning huzurida balchiq ... balchiq bo'ladi; xuddi balchiq erib ketganidek!

uz: Biz ketaylik, xo'jayinim, dedi Marmeladov bir vaqtning o'zida, boshini ko'tarib, Raskolnikovga murojaat qildi Men bilan birga keling ... Kozelning uyi, hovliga qarab.

en: I’m going to Katerina Ivanovna —time I did.” Raskolnikov had for some time been wanting to go and he had meant to help him.
uz: Men Katerina Ivanovnaga boryapman. Raskolnikov bir muncha vaqtdan beri borishni xohlagan va unga yordam berishni xohlagan.

en: Marmeladov was much unsteadier on his legs than in his speech and leaned heavily on the young man.
uz: Marmeladov o'z nutqidan ko'ra oyoqlarida ko'proq o'zgargan va yigitga qattiq tayanayotgan edi.

en: They had two or three hundred paces to go.
uz: Ularga yetarlicha ikki yoki uch yuz qadam qolishi kerak edi.

en: The drunken man was more and more overcome by dismay and confusion as they drew nearer the house.
uz: Ular uyga yaqinlashayotganda, mast odamni qo'rquv va g'alati hissi kuchayib borardi.

en: “It’s not Katerina Ivanovna I am afraid of now,” he muttered in agitation —“and that she will begin pulling my hair.
uz: Men hozir Katerina Ivanovna emasligimdan qo'rqaman, - deb u g'ayrat bilan qichqirib yubordi. - U sochlarimni tortib olishni boshlaydi.

en: What does my hair matter!
uz: Mening sochlarimning ahamiyati nimada!

en: Indeed it will be better if she does begin pulling it, that’s not what I am afraid of … it’s her eyes I am afraid of … yes, her eyes … the red on her cheeks, too, frightens me … and her breathing too.
uz: Darhaqiqat, agar u uni tortib olishni boshlasa yaxshiroq bo'ladi, men bundan qo'rqmayman ... uning ko'zlaridan qo'rqaman ... ha, uning ko'zlari ... uning burchaklarida qizil rang ham meni qo'rqitadi ... va uning nafas olishidan ham qo'rqaman.

en: … Have you noticed how people in that disease breathe … when they are excited?
uz: ... Bu kasallikka chalingan odamlarning hayajonda bo'lganlarida qanday nafas olishlarini payqaganmisiz?

en: I am frightened of the children’s crying, too.
uz: Bolalarning yig'lashidan ham qo'rqaman.

en: … For if Sonia has not taken them food … I don’t know what’s happened!
uz: Chunki agar Sonia ularga ovqat bermagan bo'lsa, nima bo'lganini bilmayman!

en: But blows I am not afraid of.
uz: Ammo men qo'rqmayman.

en: … Know, sir, that such blows are not a pain to me, but even an enjoyment.
uz: ... Bilasiz, xo'jayinim, bunday urishlar men uchun og'riq emas, balki zavqdir.

en: In fact I can’t get on without it.
uz: Aslida, men bu yo'lsiz yashay olmayman.

en: Let her strike me, it relieves her heart … it’s better so … There is
uz: U meni urishiga yo'l qo'ying, bu uning qalbini yengillashtiradi ... bu yaxshiroqdir ...

en: The house of Kozel, the cabinetmaker … a German, well- to-do.
uz: Kozelning uyi, kabinet quruvchisi ... nemis, yaxshi ish qiladigan.

en: Lead the way!” They went in from the yard and up to the fourth storey.
uz: Yo'lni ko'rsating! Ular hovlidan tashqariga kirib, to'rtinchi qavatga ko'tarildilar.

en: The staircase got darker and darker as they went up.
uz: Ular ko'tarilganda, daraxt qorong'i bo'lib borardi.

en: It was nearly eleven o’clock and although in summer in Petersburg there is no real night, yet it was quite dark at the top of the stairs.
uz: Deyarli soat o'n bir edi va yozda Sankt-Peterburgda haqiqiy kechasi bo'lmasa-da, daraxtning yuqori qismida juda qorong'i edi.

en: A grimy little door at the very top of the stairs stood ajar.
uz: Turg'unning yuqori qismidagi kichkina, kirli eshik o'rtasida turgan edi.

en: A very poor-looking room about ten paces long was lighted up by a candle- end; the whole of it was visible from the entrance.
uz: O'n qadam uzunlikdagi juda kambag'al ko'rinadigan xona shisha bilan yoritilgan edi; butun xona kirish tomondan ko'rinardi.

en: It was all in disorder, littered up with rags of all sorts, especially children’s garments.
uz: Hamma narsa tartibsizlikda edi, har xil kiyimlar, ayniqsa bolalar kiyimlari bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: Across the furthest corner was stretched a ragged sheet.
uz: Eng uzoq burchadan bir teshik uzilgan edi.

en: Behind it probably was the bed.
uz: Ehtimol, uning orqasida yotoq bor edi.

en: There was nothing in the room except two chairs and a sofa covered with American leather, full of holes, before which stood an old deal kitchen-table, unpainted and uncovered.
uz: Xonada ikkita o'rindiq va qo'ldan to'lgan, toshlar bilan to'lgan amerikalik teridan qoplangan kanepadan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi, uning oldida eski kuchxona jadvali, bo'yoqlanmagan va qoplanmagan edi.

en: At the edge of the table stood a smoldering tallow-candle in an iron candlestick.
uz: O'sha dasturxonning chegaralarida temir chiroqlar o'rnatilgan chiroq turgan edi.

en: It appeared that the family had a room to themselves, not part of a room, but their room was practically a passage.
uz: Oila o'z xonasiga ega bo'lgan, xonaning bir qismi bo'lmagan, lekin ularning xonasi deyarli bir yo'l edi.

en: The door leading to the other rooms, or rather cupboards, into which Amalia Lippevechsel’s flat was divided stood half open, and there was shouting, uproar and laughter within.
uz: Amalia Lippevechselning xonasi bo'linadigan boshqa xonalarga, ya'ni omborlarga olib boradigan eshik yarim ochilgan edi va ichkarida qichqiriq, shov-shuv va kulgilar bor edi.

en: People seemed to be playing cards and drinking tea there.
uz: O'sha yerda odamlar karta o'ynash va choy ichish bilan shug'ullanayotgandek ko'rinardi.

en: Words of the most unceremonious kind flew out from time to time.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida, o'z navbatida o'z navbatida so'zlarni so'zlashardi.

en: Raskolnikov recognised Katerina Ivanovna at once.
uz: Raskolnikov Katerina Ivanovnani darhol tan oldi.

en: She was a rather tall, slim and graceful woman, terribly emaciated, with magnificent dark brown hair and with a hectic flush in her cheeks.
uz: U o'ta baland, chiroyli va chiroyli ayol edi, u juda kam bo'lgan, ajoyib qora qora qora sochlari va yig'in-yig'in bilan yig'ilgan.

en: She was pacing up and down in her little room, pressing her hands against her chest; her lips were parched and her breathing came in nervous broken gasps.
uz: U o'zining kichik xonasida yurib-turib, qo'llarini ko'krakga tatib, o'z ko'kraklarini qo'zg'atardi; og'izlari quruq edi va nafaslari g'azabga to'lib-toshdi.

en: Her eyes glittered as in fever and looked about with a harsh immovable stare.
uz: Uning ko'zlari qizg'inlab, o'ziga qarab turardi.

en: And that consumptive and excited face with the last flickering light of the candle-end playing upon it made a sickening impression.
uz: Va bu iste'molchi va hayajonli yuzi, shishalarning so'nggi chiroqlari o'ynash bilan, unga yomon taassurot qoldirdi.

en: She seemed to Raskolnikov about thirty years old and was certainly a strange wife for Marmeladov.
uz: Raskolnikov uchun u taxminan o'ttiz yoshga to'lgan va Marmeladov uchun o'zgacha xotin edi.

en: … She had not heard them and did not notice them coming in.
uz: ... U ularni eshitmagan edi va ular kirayotganini sezmagan edi.

en: She seemed to be lost in thought, hearing and seeing nothing.
uz: U fikrlarida adashib, eshitib-ko'rmay qolgan edi.

en: The room was close, but she had not opened the window; a stench rose from the staircase, but the door on to the stairs was not closed.
uz: Xona yaqin edi, lekin u oynani ochmagan edi; mertalardan buyum ko'tarildi, lekin eshik yopilmagan edi.

en: From the inner rooms clouds of tobacco smoke floated in,
uz: Ichki xonalardan tamaki tutunining bulutlari ko'tarildi.

en: she kept coughing, but did not close the door.
uz: U qo'shishni davom ettirgan, lekin eshikni yopmagan.

en: The youngest child, a girl of six, was asleep, sitting curled up on the floor with her head on the sofa.
uz: Eng kichik bola, olti yashar qiz, o'tirgan edi, sofa ustida boshini egallagan holda, yerga yopishib o'tirgan edi.

en: A boy a year older stood crying and shaking in the corner, probably he had just had a beating.
uz: Bir yil katta bolakay burchada yig'lab va titrab turardi, ehtimol u yaqinda urilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Beside him stood a girl of nine years old, tall and thin, wearing a thin and ragged chemise with an ancient cashmere pelisse flung over her bare shoulders, long outgrown and barely reaching her knees.
uz: Uning yonida to'qqiz yoshli qizcha, baland va chiroyli, chiroyli kiyim kiygan, qadimgi kasxmir pelissasi bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lgan, ko'p o'sib, tiz cho'kkan, ko'p o'smagan, ko'p o'smagan, o'z shoxlaridan ko'tarib o'tirgan.

en: Her arm, as thin as a stick, was round her brother’s neck.
uz: Uning qo'li cho'g'iday chiroyli bo'lib, ukasining bo'yni atrofida edi.

en: She was trying to comfort him, whispering something to him, and doing all she could to keep him from whimpering again.
uz: U uni tasalli berishga harakat qilardi, unga biror narsa shoshib, yana bir bor g'amginlik qilmasligini qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilardi.

en: At the same time her large dark eyes, which looked larger still from the thinness of her frightened face, were watching her mother with alarm.
uz: Shu bilan birga, uning katta qorong'i ko'zlari, qo'rqinchli yuzining chiroyliligi tufayli yanada kattaroq ko'rinardi, onasini qo'rqinch bilan kuzatardi.

en: Marmeladov did not enter the door, but dropped on his knees in the very doorway, pushing Raskolnikov in front of him.
uz: Marmeladov eshikdan kirmadi, balki eshikning o'zida tiz cho'kib, Raskolnikovni uning oldiga itdi.

en: The woman seeing a stranger stopped indifferently facing him, coming to herself for a moment and apparently wondering what he had come for.
uz: Begona odamni ko'rgan ayol befarqlik bilan unga qaray to'xtadi, bir daqiqa o'ziga kelib, uning nima uchun kelganini o'ylaydi.

en: But evidently she decided that he was going into the next room, as he had to pass through hers to get there.
uz: Ammo, ehtimol, u uning yonidagi xonadan o'tishi kerak bo'lganidan, uning yonidagi xonadan o'tmoqchi bo'lganini aytdi.

en: Taking no further notice of him, she walked towards the outer door to close it and uttered a sudden scream on seeing her husband on his knees in the doorway.
uz: U o'sha kishini ko'rmay, eshikni yopish uchun tashqi eshik tomon bordi va erini eshikda tiz cho'kkan holda ko'rib, to'satdan qichqirdi.

en: “Ah!” she cried out in a frenzy, “he has come back!
uz: U g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda: "U qaytib keldi!" - deb baqirdi.

en: … And where is the money?
uz: Va pul qayerda?

en: What’s in your pocket, show me!
uz: Jismangizda nima borligini menga ko'rsating!

en: And your clothes are all different!
uz: Va sizning kiyimlaringiz hammasi boshqacha!

en: Where are your clothes?
uz: Sizning kiyimlaringiz qayerda?

en: Speak!” And she fell to searching him.
uz: So'zlash! Va u uni qidirishga tushdi.

en: Marmeladov submissively and obediently held up both arms to facilitate the search.
uz: Marmeladov qidiruvni osonlashtirish uchun itoatkorlik va itoatkorlik bilan qo'llarini ko'tardi.

en: Not a farthing was there.
uz: U yerda hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: “Where is the money?” she cried —“Mercy on us, can he have drunk it all?
uz: Qayerda pul bor? - deb baqirdi u. - Bizlarga rahm qil, u hammasini ichgan bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: There were twelve silver roubles left in the chest!” and in a fury she seized him by the hair and dragged him into the room.
uz: Ko'krak ichida o'n ikki kumush rubl qolgan edi! Va g'azabda u uni sochidan ushlab, xonaniga sudrab kirdi.

en: Marmeladov seconded her efforts by meekly crawling along on his knees.
uz: Marmeladov uning harakatlarini qo'llab-quvvatlab, tiz cho'kkancha o'zini kamtarlik bilan orqaga surdi.

en: “And this is a consolation to me!
uz: Bu menga tasalli baxsh etadi!

en: This does not hurt me, but is a positive con-so-la-tion, ho-nou-red sir,” he called out, shaken to and fro by his hair and even once striking the ground with his forehead.
uz: Bu meni xafa qilmaydi, lekin ijobiy ta'sir qiladi, ho-nou-red sir, u sochlari bilan shovqinlanib, bir marta hatto oldidan yerga urib qo'ydi.

en: The child asleep on the floor woke up, and began to cry.
uz: Yotoqdagi bola uyg'onib, yig'lay boshladi.

en: The boy in the corner losing all control began trembling and screaming and
uz: Burchakdagi o'g'il butun nazoratni yo'qotgan holda titra boshladi va qichqirdi va

en: rushed to his sister in violent terror, almost in a fit.
uz: O'z singlisiga shovqinlik bilan qo'rqib, deyarli to'satdan kelib qoldi.

en: The eldest girl was shaking like a leaf.
uz: Yirik qiz barg kabi titrab turardi.

en: he’s drunk it all,” the poor woman screamed in despair —“and his clothes are gone!
uz: U hamma narsani ichgan, kambag'al ayol umidsizlikdan qichqirgan va uning kiyimlari yo'qolgan!

en: And they are hungry, hungry!” — and wringing her hands she pointed to the children.
uz: Va ular och, och!  va qo'llarini burib, bolalarga ishora qildi.

en: And you, are you not ashamed?” —she pounced all at once upon Raskolnikov —“from the tavern!
uz: Va siz, uyatga qolmayapsizmi? she Raskolnikovga birdan o'zini tashlab yubordi taverndan!

en: Have you been drinking with him?
uz: U bilan birga ichganmisiz?

en: You have been drinking with him, too!
uz: Siz ham u bilan birga ichgansiz!

en: Go away!” The young man was hastening away without uttering a word.
uz: Yo'qol! Yosh yigit bir so'z aytmasdan darrov yo'qoldi.

en: The inner door was thrown wide open and inquisitive faces were peering in at it.
uz: Ichki eshik keng ochildi va qiziquvchan yuzlar unga qarab turardi.

en: Coarse laughing faces with pipes and cigarettes and heads wearing caps thrust themselves in at the doorway.
uz: Tovushlar va sigaretlar bilan qichqiriq yuzlar va qo'rqinchli boshlar o'zlarini eshikga qo'yib kirishadi.

en: Further in could be seen figures in dressing gowns flung open, in costumes of unseemly scantiness, some of them with cards in their hands.
uz: Keyinroq ko'rinadigan kiyimlar, ko'rinmas kiyimlar, ba'zilari qo'lida kartalar bilan ko'rinadi.

en: They were particularly diverted, when Marmeladov, dragged about by his hair, shouted that it was a consolation to him.
uz: Ayniqsa, Marmeladov sochlari bilan yurib, uni tasalli berayotganini aytganda, ular o'zlarini chalg'itdilar.

en: They even began to come into the room; at last a sinister shrill outcry was heard: this came from Amalia Lippevechsel herself pushing her way amongst them and trying to restore order after her own fashion and for the hundredth time to frighten the poor woman by ordering her with coarse abuse to clear out of the room next day.
uz: Ular hatto xonadonga kirishni boshlashdi; nihoyat, yovvoyi qichqiriq eshitildi: bu Amaliya Lippevechselning o'zi ularning orasiga kirib, o'z uslubida tartibni tiklashga harakat qilgani va boshqa bir marta kambag'al ayolni qo'rqitish uchun keyingi kuni xonadan chiqib ketishni buyurganidan kelib chiqdi.

en: As he went out, Raskolnikov had time to put his hand into his pocket, to snatch up the coppers he had received in exchange for his rouble in the tavern and to lay them unnoticed on the window.
uz: Raskolnikov chiqib ketayotganda, o'z qo'lini qopqoqlariga qo'yib, taverndagi rubli evaziga olgan pullarni olib, ularni darchaga ko'rinmasdan qo'yib qo'ydi.

en: Afterwards on the stairs, he changed his mind and would have gone back.
uz: Keyingi marta merosmonda fikrini o'zgartirib, qaytib borgan bo'lardi.

en: “What a stupid thing I’ve done,” he thought to himself, “they have Sonia and I want it myself.” But reflecting that it would be impossible to take it back now and that in any case he would not have taken it, he dismissed it with a wave of his hand and went back to his lodging.
uz: Men qanday ahmoqona ish qildim, - deb o'yladi u o'zicha, - ular Soniaga egalar va men ham uni xohlayman. - Ammo uni endi qaytarib olishning imkoni yo'qligini va hech bo'lmaganda uni qaytarib olishning iloji yo'qligini o'ylab, u uni qo'li bilan urib tashladi va uyga qaytib ketdi.

en: “Sonia wants pomatum too,” he said as he walked along the street, and he laughed malignantly —“such smartness costs money.
uz: "Sonia ham pomatumni xohlaydi", - dedi u ko'cha bo'ylab yurganida va yomon ko'rinishda kulganida.

en: And maybe Sonia herself will be bankrupt today, for there is always a risk, hunting big game … digging for gold … then they would all be without a crust tomorrow except for my money.
uz: Ehtimol, Sonia bugun bankrot bo'ladi, chunki har doim katta o'g'il ovlash xavfi bor ... oltin qidirish ... keyin ertaga mening pulimdan tashqari ularning barchasi qalinliksiz bo'lishadi.

en: What a mine they’ve dug there!
uz: Ular u yerda qandaygina kon qazishgan!

en: And they’re making the most of it!
uz: Va ular undan maksimal darajada foydalanmoqdalar!

en: Yes, they are making the most of it!
uz: Ha, ular undan to'liq foydalanmoqdalar!

en: They’ve wept over it and grown used to it.
uz: Ular buni ko'rib yig'lashdi va odatlanib borishdi.

en: Man grows used to everything, the scoundrel!”
uz: Inson hamma narsaga odatlanib qoladi, xudojo'y!

en: He sank into thought.
uz: U fikrga tushdi.

en: “And what if I am wrong,” he cried suddenly after a moment’s thought.
uz: Va agar men xato qilsam nima bo'ladi, deb o'ylagandan so'ng u to'satdan yig'ladi.

en: “What if man is not really a scoundrel, man in general, I mean, the whole race of mankind —then all the rest is prejudice, simply artificial terrors and there are no barriers and it’s all as it should be.”
uz: Agar inson aslida begona emas, umuman inson, ya'ni butun insoniyat irqi bo'lsa, qolgan hamma narsa oldindan o'ylash, shunchaki sun'iy qo'rquv va hech qanday to'siq yo'q bo'lsa, hamma narsa bo'lishi kerak bo'lganidek bo'ladi.

en: III He waked up late next day after a broken sleep.
uz: U ertasi kuni uxlamaganidan keyin kech uyg'ondi.

en: But his sleep had not refreshed him; he waked up bilious, irritable, ill-tempered, and looked with hatred at his room.
uz: Ammo uning uyqusi unga tasalli bermagan edi; u o'zini ko'ngli, g'azab va g'azablangan holda uyg'onib, o'z xonasiga nafrat bilan qaradi.

en: It was a tiny cupboard of a room about six paces in length.
uz: Bu o'n qadam uzunlikdagi xonaning kichkina omboridir.

en: It had a poverty-stricken appearance with its dusty yellow paper peeling off the walls, and it was so low-pitched that a man of more than average height was ill at ease in it and felt every moment that he would knock his head against the ceiling.
uz: Bu qirg'oqning qirg'oqli sariq qog'ozlari devorlardan qovurilganida, u shunchalik kam bo'lganki, o'rtacha balandlikdan yuqori bo'lgan kishi u bilan bemalol bo'lib, o'z boshini plafonga urish hissi bilan har bir daqiqada o'zini erkin his qilardi.

en: The furniture was in keeping with the room: there were three old chairs, rather rickety; a painted table in the corner on which lay a few manuscripts and books; the dust that lay thick upon them showed that they had been long untouched.
uz: Mebellar xonaning o'ziga yarasha edi: uchta eski, biroz chiroyli o'rindiqlar; burchada bir nechta qo'lyozma va kitoblar yotgan bo'yilgan stol; ularning ustiga to'kib ketgan chang ular uzoq vaqtgacha qo'llanilmaganligini ko'rsatdi.

en: A big clumsy sofa occupied almost the whole of one wall and half the floor space of the room; it was once covered with chintz, but was now in rags and served Raskolnikov as a bed.
uz: Katta, ko'p bo'lmagan kanepa xona deyarli butun devor va xonaning yarmini egallab olgan edi; u bir vaqtlar chintz bilan qoplangan edi, ammo endi to'qimalarda edi va Raskolnikovga yotoq sifatida xizmat qilardi.

en: Often he went to sleep on it, as he was, without undressing, without sheets, wrapped in his old student’s overcoat, with his head on one little pillow, under which he heaped up all the linen he had, clean and dirty, by way of a bolster.
uz: Ko'pincha u o'z ustiga o'tirardi, chunki u bezovta emas, to'qimalarsiz, eski o'quvchilarining kiyimlariga o'rab olingan, boshini bitta kichkina yostiqqa qo'yib, uning ostida o'zi bor bo'lgan barcha toza va kirli kiyimlarni qo'llanma sifatida to'pladi.

en: A little table stood in front of the sofa.
uz: Sofa oldida kichkina stol turardi.

en: It would have been difficult to sink to a lower ebb of disorder, but to Raskolnikov in his present state of mind this was positively agreeable.
uz: To'g'ri yo'lni buzish qiyin bo'lardi, lekin Raskolnikov uchun hozirgi fikrlash tarzi bilan bu juda yoqimli edi.

en: He had got completely away from everyone, like a tortoise in its shell, and even the sight of a servant girl who had to wait upon him and looked sometimes into his room made him writhe with nervous irritation.
uz: U hamma odamlardan butunlay qochib ketibdi, xuddi qo'rg'asidagi qurtog'a kabi, hatto uni kutib turadigan va ba'zan xonasiga qarab turadigan xizmatkor qizni ko'rish uni g'alati g'azabdan qotib qo'ydi.

en: He was in the condition that overtakes some monomaniacs entirely concentrated upon one thing.
uz: U monomaniklarning ba'zilarini to'liq bitta narsaga e'tibor qaratadigan holatda edi.

en: His landlady had for the last fortnight given up sending him in meals, and he had not yet thought of expostulating with her, though he went without his
uz: Uy egasi uni ovqatlantirishdan to'xtadi va u o'zi bilan suhbatlashishni o'ylamagan edi, garchi u o'zidan voz kechgan bo'lsa ham.

en: Nastasya, the cook and only servant, was rather pleased at the lodger’s mood and had entirely given up sweeping and doing his room, only once a week or so she would stray into his room with a broom.
uz: Nastasya, oshpaz va yagona xizmatkor, uy egasining ruh-tuyg'usidan juda mamnun bo'lib, uning xonasini tozalash va tozalashdan butunlay voz kechgan edi, haftasiga bir marta yoki undan ko'proq vaqt davomida u uning xonasida ko'ylak bilan yurardi.

en: She waked him up that day.
uz: O'sha kuni u uni uyg'otdi.

en: “Get up, why are you asleep?” she called to him.
uz: O'rnidan tur, nega uxlayapsan? U unga chaqiribdi.

en: “It’s past nine, I have brought you some tea; will you have a cup?
uz: Soat to'qqizdan so'ng, men sizga choy olib keldim; bir qadah ichasizmi?

en: I should think you’re fairly starving?” Raskolnikov opened his eyes, started and recognised Nastasya.
uz: Raskolnikov ko'zlarini ochib, Nastasiyani tanib oldi.

en: “From the landlady, eh?” he asked, slowly and with a sickly face sitting up on the sofa.
uz: "Xonadon egasidan", - deb so'radi u, sekin-sekin va kasal yuz bilan kanepada o'tirgan.

en: “From the landlady, indeed!” She set before him her own cracked teapot full of weak and stale tea and laid two yellow lumps of sugar by the side of it.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, uy egasidan! U o'zining charchagan, zaif va eskirgan choy bilan to'lgan choy qabini uning oldiga qo'ydi va uning yonida ikkita sariq shakar to'plamini qo'ydi.

en: “Here, Nastasya, take it please,” he said, fumbling in his pocket (for he had slept in his clothes) and taking out a handful of coppers —“run and buy me a loaf.
uz: Mana, Nastasya, iltimos, uni oling, - dedi u, kiyimda yotganini ko'rib (ko'ylakda uxlaganini ko'rib) kiyimini o'rab, bir nechta mislarni olib chiqib, menga non sotib ol.

en: And get me a little sausage, the cheapest, at the pork-butcher’s.” “The loaf I’ll fetch you this very minute, but wouldn’t you rather have some cabbage soup instead of sausage?
uz: Va menga mayda go'sht butcherlaridagi eng arzon sovushni olib keling.Bu daqiqada sizga non olib kelaman, lekin sovush o'rniga ko'psab shovushini olishni afzal ko'rmaysizmi?

en: It’s capital soup, yesterday’s.
uz: Bu kechki kunlar uchun kapital shovqin.

en: I saved it for you yesterday, but you came in late.
uz: Kecha uni sen uchun saqlab qo'ydim, lekin kech kelding.

en: It’s fine soup.” When the soup had been brought, and he had begun upon it, Nastasya sat down beside him on the sofa and began chatting.
uz: Bu juda yaxshi shovpa. Shovpa olib kelgach, Nastasya uning yonida sofada o'tirib, suhbat boshladi.

en: She was a country peasant-woman and a very talkative one.
uz: U qishloq xo'jaligi ayol edi va juda gapiradigan ayol edi.

en: “Praskovya Pavlovna means to complain to the police about you,” she said.
uz: Praskovya Pavlovna siz haqingizda politsiyaga shikoyat qilishni nazarda tutadi, dedi u.

en: What does she want?” “You don’t pay her money and you won’t turn out of the room.
uz: U nima istaydi?  Siz unga pul to'lamasangiz va xonani tark etmaysiz.

en: That’s what she wants, to be sure.” “The devil, that’s the last straw,” he muttered, grinding his teeth, “no, that would not suit me … just now.
uz: U aynan shu narsani xohlaydi, shubhasiz. Shaytonga, bu so'nggi cho'g'dir, u g'iybat qilib, tishlarini qirib qo'ydi, yo'q, bu menga mos kelmaydi... hozir.

en: She is a fool,” he added aloud.
uz: U ahmoqona, - dedi u baland ovoz bilan qo'shimcha qilib.

en: “I’ll go and talk to her today.” “Fool she is and no mistake, just as I am.
uz: Bugun men u bilan gaplashaman.U o'zi ham xuddi men kabi aqlsiz va noto'g'ri.

en: But why, if you are so clever, do you lie here like a sack and have nothing to show for it?
uz: Ammo nima uchun, agar siz shunchalik aqlli bo'lsangiz, bu yerda o'tiribsiz va buning uchun hech narsa ko'rsatolmaysiz?

en: One time you used to go out, you say, to teach children.
uz: Bir marta siz bolalar uchun o'qitish uchun tashqariga chiqardingiz, deysiz.

en: But why is it you do nothing now?”
uz: Ammo nima uchun siz hozir hech narsa qilmaysiz?

en: “I am doing …” Raskolnikov began sullenly and reluctantly.
uz: I am doing ... Raskolnikov sullenly va istaksiz boshladi.

en: “What are you doing?” “Work …” “What sort of work?” “I am thinking,” he answered seriously after a pause.
uz: Siz nima qilyapsiz?  Ish ...  Qanday ish?  Men o'ylayman, u to'xtatishdan so'ng jiddiy javob berdi.

en: Nastasya was overcome with a fit of laughter.
uz: Nastasya ko'p kulish bilan o'ldirildi.

en: She was given to laughter and when anything amused her, she laughed inaudibly, quivering and shaking all over till she felt ill.
uz: U kulishga berilgan edi va biron narsa uni o'yin qilganda, u eshitilmaydigan tarzda kulishardi, u o'zini kasal his qilgunga qadar titrab va titrab turardi.

en: “And have you made much money by your thinking?” she managed to articulate at last.
uz: Va siz o'z fikrlash tarzingiz bilan ko'p pul topdingizmi? U nihoyat so'zlashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: “One can’t go out to give lessons without boots.
uz: Shuning o'rniga, hech kim botlarsiz dars berishga chiqolmaydi.

en: And I’m sick of it.” “Don’t quarrel with your bread and butter.” “They pay so little for lessons.
uz: Va men bundan charchadim.Sizlar non va yog'ingiz bilan bahslashmanglar.Ular darslar uchun juda kam pul to'laydilar.

en: What’s the use of a few coppers?” he answered, reluctantly, as though replying to his own thought.
uz: Bir necha kumushdan nima foyda? - deb javob berdi u, o'z fikriga javob berayotgandek, istamay.

en: “And you want to get a fortune all at once?” He looked at her strangely.
uz: Va siz bir vaqtning o'zida boylik orttirishni xohlaysizmi? U ayolga g'alati qarab ko'rdi.

en: “Yes, I want a fortune,” he answered firmly, after a brief pause.
uz: "Ha, men boylik orzu qilaman", - dedi u, biroz to'xtab, qat'iy javob berdi.

en: “Don’t be in such a hurry, you quite frighten me!
uz: Shoshilmang, siz meni qo'rqitasiz!

en: Shall I get you the loaf or not?” “As you please.” “Ah, I forgot!
uz: Sizga nonni olib kelsam bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi?Siz xohlaganidek.Ah, unutib qoldim!

en: A letter came for you yesterday when you were out.” “A letter?
uz: Kecha siz tashqarida bo'lganingizda sizga xat keldi.Xat?

en: from whom?” “I can’t say.
uz: Kimdan?   Men aytolmayman.

en: I gave three kopecks of my own to the postman for it.
uz: Men o'zimning uch kopekimni pochtachiga buning uchun berdim.

en: Will you pay me back?” “Then bring it to me, for God’s sake, bring it,” cried Raskolnikov greatly excited —“good God!” A minute later the letter was brought him.
uz: Menga qaytarib berasizmi?  Keyin uni menga olib keling, xudo uchun olib keling, - dedi Raskolnikov juda hayajonlanib.Xudoim! Bir daqiqadan so'ng unga xat olib keldi.

en: That was it: from his mother, from the province of R — —.
uz: Mana shu: R viloyatidan bo'lgan onasidan.

en: He turned pale when he took it.
uz: Uni olib ketgach, o'sha kishi o'z-o'zidan ko'ngli oqib ketdi.

en: It was a long while since he had received a letter, but another feeling also suddenly stabbed his heart.
uz: Uzoq vaqtdan beri xat olmagan edi, lekin birdan boshqa his-tuyg'u ham uning qalbiga tushib qoldi.

en: “Nastasya, leave me alone, for goodness’ sake; here are your three kopecks, but for goodness’ sake, make haste and go!” The letter was quivering in his hand; he did not want to open it in her presence; he wanted to be left alone with this letter.
uz: Nastasya, meni tinch qo'yib yubor, xudo uchun; mana uchta kopekingiz, lekin xudo uchun shoshiling va keting! Uning qo'lida maktub titrayotgan edi; u uni uning huzurida ochishni istamagan; u bu maktub bilan yolg'iz qolishni xohlagan.

en: When Nastasya had gone out, he lifted it quickly to his lips and kissed it; then he gazed intently at the address, the small, sloping handwriting, so dear and familiar, of the mother who had once taught him to read
uz: Nastasya chiqib ketgach, uni tezda og'ziga ko'tarib, o'pdi; so'ngra u bir marta unga o'qishni o'rgatgan onasining kichik, yonboshlagan, juda sevimli va tanish qo'lyozmasi bo'lgan manzilga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: He delayed; he seemed almost afraid of something.
uz: U kechikdi; deyarli bir narsadan qo'rqqan ko'rinardi.

en: At last he opened it; it was a thick heavy letter, weighing over two ounces, two large sheets of note paper were covered with very small handwriting.
uz: Nihoyat u uni ochdi; u ikki onsanadan ortiq og'ir bo'lgan qalin va og'ir xat edi, ikkita katta qog'oz qog'ozning katta varaqasi juda kichik qo'lda yozilgan edi.

en: “My dear Rodya,” wrote his mother —“it’s two months since I last had a talk with you by letter which has distressed me and even kept me awake at night, thinking.
uz: My dear Rodya, o'z onasiga yozdi its ikki oy o'tib men siz bilan oxirgi marta xat orqali suhbatlashganimdan beri, bu meni xafa qildi va hatto kechasi o'ylash uchun uyg'onib qo'ydi.

en: But I am sure you will not blame me for my inevitable silence.
uz: Ammo shubhalanamanki, meni o'zimning hushyorligim uchun ayblay olmaysiz.

en: You know how I love you; you are all we have to look to, Dounia and I, you are our all, our one hope, our one stay.
uz: Sizni qanchalik yaxshi ko'raman, buni bilasiz; biz faqat sizga, Dounia va men, e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak, siz bizning barchamizsiz, bizning yagona umidimiz, bizning yagona qolishimizsiz.

en: What a grief it was to me when I heard that you had given up the university some months ago, for want of means to keep yourself and that you had lost your lessons and your other work!
uz: Bir necha oy oldin o'zingizni ta'minlash uchun mablag' yo'qligi sababli universitetni tark etganingizni va darslaringizni va boshqa ishingizni yo'qotganingizni eshitganimda men qanchalik xafa bo'ldim!

en: How could I help you out of my hundred and twenty roubles a year pension?
uz: Yillik pensiyamdan yuz yigirma rubldan qanday qilib sizga yordam bersam bo'ladi?

en: The fifteen roubles I sent you four months ago I borrowed, as you know, on security of my pension, from Vassily Ivanovitch Vahrushin a merchant of this town.
uz: To'rt oy oldin sizga yuborgan o'n besh rubl pulni, bilganingizdek, pensiyamni himoya qilish uchun shaharlik savdogar Vassily Ivanovitch Vahrushindan qarz oldim.

en: He is a kindhearted man and was a friend of your father’s too.
uz: U mehribon odam va otangizning ham do'sti edi.

en: But having given him the right to receive the pension, I had to wait till the debt was paid off and that is only just done, so that I’ve been unable to send you anything all this time.
uz: Ammo unga pensiya olish huquqini berganimdan so'ng, men qarz to'langanicha kutishim kerak bo'ldi va bu faqat hozirgina amalga oshdi, shuning uchun men bu vaqt davomida sizga hech narsa yuborolmadim.

en: But now, thank God, I believe I shall be able to send you something more and in fact we may congratulate ourselves on our good fortune now, of which I hasten to inform you.
uz: Lekin endi, Xudoga shukr, sizga ko'proq narsani yuborishga muvaffaq bo'lishimga ishonaman va aslida, hozir o'zimizni omadimiz bilan tabriklashimiz mumkin, bu haqda sizga xabar berishga shoshilyapman.

en: In the first place, would you have guessed, dear Rodya, that your sister has been living with me for the last six weeks and we shall not be separated in the future.
uz: Avvalo, sen, aziz Rodya, singlingiz o'tgan olti haftadan beri men bilan birga yashayotganini va kelajakda bizni ajratib qo'ymasligini tasavvur qilgan bo'larmidingiz?

en: Thank God, her sufferings are over, but I will tell you everything in order, so that you may know just how everything has happened and all that we have hitherto concealed from you.
uz: Xudoga shukr, uning azob-uqubatlari tugadi, lekin men sizga hamma narsani tartib bilan aytib beraman, shunda hamma narsa qanday sodir bo'lganini va biz sizdan hozirgacha yashirgan barcha narsalarni bilib olasiz.

en: When you wrote to me two months ago that you had heard that Dounia had a great deal to put up with in the Svidrigraïlovs’ house, when you wrote that and asked me to tell you all about it —what could I write in answer to you?
uz: Ikki oy oldin menga yozganingizda, Svidrigrailovlar uyida Duniyaning juda ko'p muammolarga duch kelishini eshitganingizda, siz buni yozganingizda va bu haqda hamma narsani aytib berishni so'raganingizda, sizga javob sifatida nima yozishim mumkin?

en: If I had written the whole truth to you, I dare say you would have thrown up everything and have come to us, even if you had to walk all the way, for I know your character and your feelings, and you would not let your sister be insulted.
uz: Agar men sizga butun haqiqatni yozgan bo'lsam, siz hamma narsani tashlab, hatto butun yo'lni yurishingiz kerak bo'lgan taqdirda ham, bizga keldingiz, deb aytishga jur'at qilaman, chunki men sizning xarakteringizni va his-tuyg'ularingizni bilaman va siz singlingizni haqoratlashga yo'l qo'ymagansiz.

en: I was in despair myself, but what could I
uz: O'zim ham umidsizlikka tushdim, lekin nima qila olaman?

en: And, besides, I did not know the whole truth myself then.
uz: Bundan tashqari, o'shanda men o'zim ham butun haqiqatni bilmasdim.

en: What made it all so difficult was that Dounia received a hundred roubles in advance when she took the place as governess in their family, on condition of part of her salary being deducted every month, and so it was impossible to throw up the situation without repaying the debt.
uz: Bularning barchasini qiyinlashtirgan narsa shundaki, Dounia o'z oilasida muharrir sifatida o'rinni egallaganida yuz rubl oldindan olgan edi, shunda uning oylik ish haqi qisman kamaytirilishi shart edi va shuning uchun qarzini to'lamasdan vaziyatni to'xtatish mumkin emas edi.

en: This sum (now I can explain it all to you, my precious Rodya) she took chiefly in order to send you sixty roubles, which you needed so terribly then and which you received from us last year.
uz: Bu miqdorni (hozir men bularning barchasini sizga tushuntira olaman, aziz Rodya) u asosan sizga o'ttiz rubl yuborish uchun oldi, bu pul o'sha paytda juda kerak edi va siz o'tgan yili bizdan olgan edi.

en: We deceived you then, writing that this money came from Dounia’s savings, but that was not so, and now I tell you all about it, because, thank God, things have suddenly changed for the better, and that you may know how Dounia loves you and what a heart she has.
uz: O'shanda biz sizlarni aldatib, bu pul Dounia jamg'armasidan kelganini yozgan edik, lekin bu shunday emas edi va endi men sizga bu haqda hamma narsani aytib beraman, chunki, Xudoga shukr, voqealar birdan yaxshi tomonga o'zgardi va Dounia sizni qanchalik yaxshi ko'radi va uning qanday yuragi borligini bilishingiz uchun.

en: Svidrigaïlov treated her very rudely and used to make disrespectful and jeering remarks at table.
uz: Svidrigailov unga juda qo'pol munosabatda bo'lib, dasturxon atrofida hurmatsizlik va haqoratli so'zlarni aytgan.

en: … But I don’t want to go into all those painful details, so as not to worry you for nothing when it is now all over.
uz: Ammo men o'sha barcha og'ir tafsilotlarga kirishni istamayman, chunki bu endi butunlay tugaganida sizni behuda tashvishlantirmayman.

en: In short, in spite of the kind and generous behaviour of Marfa Petrovna, Mr.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, Marfa Petrovnaning mehribonligi va saxiyligiga qaramay, Mr.

en: Svidrigaïlov’s wife, and all the rest of the household, Dounia had a very hard time, especially when Mr.
uz: Svidrigailovning rafiqasi va butun oila a'zolari, Dounia, ayniqsa, Mr.

en: Svidrigaïlov, relapsing into his old regimental habits, was under the influence of Bacchus.
uz: Svidrigailov o'zining eski regimentlik odatlariga qaytganida, Bacchus ta'sirida edi.

en: And how do you think it was all explained later on?
uz: Sizningcha, bularning barchasi keyinchalik qanday tushuntirilgan?

en: Would you believe that the crazy fellow had conceived a passion for Dounia from the beginning, but had concealed it under a show of rudeness and contempt.
uz: Siz aqldan ozgan odam Douniaga nisbatan ishtiyoqni boshidan boshlab his qilganini, ammo buni qo'pollik va pastkashlik ko'rinmasida yashirganini ishonasizmi?

en: Possibly he was ashamed and horrified himself at his own flighty hopes, considering his years and his being the father of a family; and that made him angry with Dounia.
uz: Ehtimol, u o'z yoshini va oila a'zosini e'tiborga olib, o'z umidlari uchun o'zini uyalgan va qo'rqitgan bo'lishi mumkin va bu unga Duniyaga g'azablantirgan.

en: And possibly, too, he hoped by his rude and sneering behaviour to hide the truth from others.
uz: Ehtimol, u o'z qo'pol va masxara qiluvchi xulq-atvori bilan haqiqatni boshqalardan yashirishni umid qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But at last he lost all control and had the face to make Dounia an open and shameful proposal, promising her all sorts of inducements and offering, besides, to throw up everything and take her to another estate of his, or even abroad.
uz: Ammo nihoyat u butun nazoratni yo'qotdi va Douniaga ochiq va sharmanda taklifni berishga va'da berdi, unga har qanday rag'batlantirish va taklifni va'da qildi, shuningdek, hamma narsani tashlab, uni o'zining boshqa mulklariga yoki hatto chet elga olib ketishni taklif qildi.

en: You can imagine all she went through!
uz: U qanchalik azob chekganini tasavvur qila olasiz!

en: To leave her situation at once was impossible not only on account of the money debt, but also to spare the feelings of Marfa Petrovna, whose suspicions would have been aroused: and then Dounia would have been the cause of a rupture in the family.
uz: O'z vazifasini darhol tashlab ketish nafaqat pul qarzi tufayli, balki Marfa Petrovnaning his-tuyg'ularini saqlab qolish uchun imkonsiz edi, chunki uning shubhalari uyg'onadi va keyinchalik Dounia oilada bo'linishga sabab bo'ladi.

en: would have meant a terrible scandal for Dounia too; that would have been inevitable.
uz: Dounia uchun ham dahshatli hujum bo'lgan bo'lar edi; bu esa qochmas edi.

en: There were various other reasons owing to which Dounia could not hope to escape from that awful house for another six weeks.
uz: Dounia yana olti hafta davomida o'sha dahshatli uydan qochishga umid qila olmagan boshqa turli sabablar bor edi.

en: You know Dounia, of course; you know how clever she is and what a strong will she has.
uz: Siz, albatta, Douniyani bilasiz; uning qanchalik aqlli va kuchli irodasi borligini bilasiz.

en: Dounia can endure a great deal and even in the most difficult cases she has the fortitude to maintain her firmness.
uz: Dounia juda ko'p narsaga chidashga qodir va hatto eng qiyin holatlarda ham o'zining qat'iyligini saqlab qolish uchun jasoratga ega.

en: She did not even write to me about everything for fear of upsetting me, although we were constantly in communication.
uz: Hatto menga har bir narsa haqida yozmagan edi, chunki u meni xafa qilishidan qo'rqqan edi, garchi biz doimiy ravishda muloqotda bo'lgan bo'lsak ham.

en: It all ended very unexpectedly.
uz: Bularning barchasi juda kutilmagan tarzda tug'ildi.

en: Marfa Petrovna accidentally overheard her husband imploring Dounia in the garden, and, putting quite a wrong interpretation on the position, threw the blame upon her, believing her to be the cause of it all.
uz: Marfa Petrovna o'z erini bog'da Douniaga iltijo qilayotganini eshitib, vaziyatni noto'g'ri tushuntirib, aybni uning ustiga tashladi va bularning hammasi uning sababchisi bo'lishiga ishonadi.

en: An awful scene took place between them on the spot in the garden; Marfa Petrovna went so far as to strike Dounia, refused to hear anything and was shouting at her for a whole hour and then gave orders that Dounia should be packed off at once to me in a plain peasant’s cart, into which they flung all her things, her linen and her clothes, all pell-mell, without folding it up and packing it.
uz: Ular o'rtasida bog'da bo'lgan voqeada dahshatli bir voqea yuz berdi; Marfa Petrovna hatto Duniyani urib, eshitishni rad etdi va butun bir soat davomida unga baqirdi va keyin Duniyani darhol menga oddiy qishloq xo'jaligi aravachasida to'plashlarini buyurdi, unda hamma narsalarini, to'qimalarini va kiyimlarini to'plamagan holda tashladilar.

en: And a heavy shower of rain came on, too, and Dounia, insulted and put to shame, had to drive with a peasant in an open cart all the seventeen versts into town.
uz: Shundan so'ng qattiq yomg'ir yog'di va Dounia haqoratlanib, sharmanda bo'lib, shaharga o'n yettita verstni ochiq arava bilan qishloq xo'jaligi bilan olib borishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Only think now what answer could I have sent to the letter I received from you two months ago and what could I have written?
uz: Faqat bir o'ylab ko'ring, ikki oy oldin sizdan olgan maktubga qanday javob yuborishim mumkin edi va nima yozishim mumkin edi?

en: I was in despair; I dared not write to you the truth because you would have been very unhappy, mortified and indignant, and yet what could you do?
uz: Men tushkunlikka tushdim; sizga haqiqatni yozishga jur'at qilmadim, chunki siz juda baxtsiz, sharmanda va g'azablangan bo'lar edingiz, ammo nima qilishingiz mumkin edi?

en: You could only perhaps ruin yourself, and, besides, Dounia would not allow it; and fill up my letter with trifles when my heart was so full of sorrow, I could not.
uz: Ehtimol, siz o'zingizni halok qila olasiz va, bundan tashqari, Dounia bunga yo'l qo'ymaydi; yuragim qayg'u bilan to'lib-toshganida xatimni kichik narsalar bilan to'ldira olmayman.

en: For a whole month the town was full of gossip about this scandal, and it came to such a pass that Dounia and I dared not even go to church on account of the contemptuous looks, whispers, and even remarks made aloud about us.
uz: Shahar bir oy davomida shu skandal haqida mish-mishlarga to'lib-toshgan va bu shunchalik katta bo'ldiki, Dounia va men biz haqoratli ko'rinish, shoshib-shubha va hatto biz haqimizda baland ovoz bilan gapiradigan so'zlar tufayli hatto cherkovga borishga ham jur'at qilmadik.

en: All our acquaintances avoided us, nobody even bowed to us in the street, and I learnt that some shopmen and clerks were intending to insult us in a shameful way, smearing the gates of our house with pitch, so that the landlord began to tell us we must leave.
uz: Barcha tanishlarimiz bizdan qochishdi, hatto ko'chada hech kim bizga sajda qilmadi va men ba'zi do'konchilar va xizmatchilar bizni sharmanda tarzda haqoratlashga, uyimizning eshiklarini pichoq bilan moylashni rejalashtirganini bilib oldim, shuning uchun uy egasi bizga ketishimiz kerakligini aytishni boshladi.

en: All this was set going by Marfa Petrovna who
uz: Bularning barchasi Marfa Petrovna tomonidan amalga oshirildi.

en: managed to slander Dounia and throw dirt at her in every family.
uz: Douniaga tuhmat qilish va har bir oilada unga kulfat tashlashda muvaffaqiyat qozongan.

en: She knows everyone in the neighbourhood, and that month she was continually coming into the town, and as she is rather talkative and fond of gossiping about her family affairs and particularly of complaining to all and each of her husband — which is not at all right —so in a short time she had spread her story not only in the town, but over the whole surrounding district.
uz: U mahalladagi barcha odamlarni biladi va o'sha oyda u shaharga muntazam ravishda keladi va u o'z oilaviy ishlari haqida gapirishni yoqtiradi va ayniqsa erining har biriga shikoyat qiladi, bu umuman yaxshi emas, shuning uchun u qisqa vaqt ichida o'z hikoyasini nafaqat shaharda, balki butun atrofdagi tumanlarda tarqatdi.

en: It made me ill, but Dounia bore it better than I did, and if only you could have seen how she endured it all and tried to comfort me and cheer me up!
uz: Bu meni kasal qildi, lekin Dounia buni men o'zimdan yaxshiroq ko'rdi va agar u bularning barchasini qanday qilib yengib, meni tasalli berishga va ruhlantirishga harakat qilganini ko'rsangiz edi!

en: But by God’s mercy, our sufferings were cut short: Mr.
uz: Lekin Xudoning rahm-shafqati bilan azoblarimiz qisqartirildi:

en: Svidrigaïlov returned to his senses and repented and, probably feeling sorry for Dounia, he laid before Marfa Petrovna a complete and unmistakable proof of Dounia’s innocence, in the form of a letter Dounia had been forced to write and give to him, before Marfa Petrovna came upon them in the garden.
uz: Svidrigailov aqldan ozdi va tavba qildi va, ehtimol, Duniyani xafa qilib, Marfa Petrovna bog'da ularga duch kelishidan oldin, Duniyaning yozishga majbur bo'lgan maktubi shaklida, Duniyaning aybsizligini to'liq va aniq tasdiqlagan.

en: This letter, which remained in Mr.
uz: Bu maktub Mr.da saqlanib qolgan.

en: Svidrigaïlov’s hands after her departure, she had written to refuse personal explanations and secret interviews, for which he was entreating her.
uz: Svidrigaylov ketgandan so'ng, u shaxsiy tushuntirishlar va yashirin intervyulardan voz kechish uchun yozgan edi.

en: In that letter she reproached him with great heat and indignation for the baseness of his behaviour in regard to Marfa Petrovna, reminding him that he was the father and head of a family and telling him how infamous it was of him to torment and make unhappy a defenceless girl, unhappy enough already.
uz: O'sha maktubda u uni Marfa Petrovnaga nisbatan qilgan xatti-harakatining kamtarligi uchun juda qizg'in va g'azab bilan tanqid qildi, u o'zining ota va oila boshi ekanligini eslatdi va unga o'zidan juda yomon ekanligini aytdi, o'zidan himoyasi yo'q qizni azoblab, baxtsiz qilish.

en: Indeed, dear Rodya, the letter was so nobly and touchingly written that I sobbed when I read it and to this day I cannot read it without tears.
uz: Darhaqiqat, aziz Rodya, maktub shunchalik noyob va ta'sirchan yozildiki, uni o'qiganimda yig'lab yubordim va bugun ham uni ko'z yoshimsiz o'qiy olmayman.

en: Moreover, the evidence of the servants, too, cleared Dounia’s reputation; they had seen and known a great deal more than Mr.
uz: Bundan tashqari, xizmatkorlarning guvohliklari ham Dounianing obro'sini tozaladi; ular Mr.dan ko'proq narsani ko'rishgan va bilishgan.

en: Svidrigaïlov had himself supposed —as indeed is always the case with servants.
uz: Svidrigailov o'zi ham o'zi shunday deb o'ylagani kerak edi, albatta, xizmatkorlar bilan hamisha shunday bo'ladi.

en: Marfa Petrovna was completely taken aback, and ‘again crushed’ as she said herself to us, but she was completely convinced of Dounia’s innocence.
uz: Marfa Petrovna butunlay hayratga tushdi va o'zini bizlarga aytganda yana bir bor ko'nglini cho'zdi, lekin u Dounia aybsizligiga to'liq ishonardi.

en: The very next day, being Sunday, she went straight to the Cathedral, knelt down and prayed with tears to Our Lady to give her strength to bear this new trial and to do her duty.
uz: Ertasi kuni, yakshanba bo'lganida, u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri katedraliga bordi, tiz cho'kib, Xonimimizga ko'z yoshlari bilan ibodat qildi, bu yangi sinovga chidash va vazifasini bajarishga kuch berishini so'radi.

en: Then she came straight from the Cathedral to us, told us the whole story, wept bitterly and, fully penitent, she embraced Dounia and besought her to forgive her.
uz: Keyin u katedralidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelib, bizga butun hikoyani aytib berdi, achchiq-achchiq yig'ladi va butunlay tavba qilgan holda, Douniyani quchoqlab, uni kechirishini iltijo qildi.

en: without any delay, she went round to all the houses in the town and everywhere, shedding tears, she asserted in the most flattering terms Dounia’s innocence and the nobility of her feelings and her behavior.
uz: U darhol shaharning barcha uylariga va hamma joyga borib, ko'z yoshlarini to'kib, Dounianing aybsizligini, his-tuyg'ular va xulq-atvorining noyobligini eng yoqimli so'zlar bilan ta'kidladi.

en: What was more, she showed and read to everyone the letter in Dounia’s own handwriting to Mr.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u hammaga Dounianing o'z qo'li bilan yozilgan Mr.ga yozilgan maktubni ko'rsatdi va o'qib berdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov and even allowed them to take copies of it — which I must say I think was superfluous.
uz: Svidrigailov hatto ularga nusxalar olishlariga ruxsat berdi, bu men uchun ortiqcha deb o'ylayman, deb aytishim kerak.

en: In this way she was busy for several days in driving about the whole town, because some people had taken offence through precedence having been given to others.
uz: Shu yo'sin u bir necha kun davomida butun shaharni haydash bilan band edi, chunki ba'zi odamlar boshqalarga ustunlik berish orqali xafa bo'lishgan.

en: And therefore they had to take turns, so that in every house she was expected before she arrived, and everyone knew that on such and such a day Marfa Petrovna would be reading the letter in such and such a place and people assembled for every reading of it, even many who had heard it several times already both in their own houses and in other people’s.
uz: Shuning uchun ular o'z navbatlarida bo'lishlari kerak edi, shuning uchun har bir uyda uni kelishidan oldin kutishardi va har bir kishi Marfa Petrovnaning har bir kunida har bir joyda xat o'qiyotganini va har bir o'qishga yig'ilgan odamlarni biladi, hatto ko'pchilik uni bir necha marta o'z uylarida ham, boshqa odamlarda ham eshitgan edi.

en: In my opinion a great deal, a very great deal of all this was unnecessary; but that’s Marfa Petrovna’s character.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, bularning ko'pchiligi zaruriy emas edi, lekin bu Marfa Petrovnaning xarakteridir.

en: Anyway she succeeded in completely reestablishing Dounia’s reputation and the whole ignominy of this affair rested as an indelible disgrace upon her husband, as the only person to blame, so that I really began to feel sorry for him; it was really treating the crazy fellow too harshly.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u Dounia ismini to'liq tiklashga muvaffaq bo'ldi va bu ishning barcha sharmandaligi erining o'ziga o'chirib bo'lmaydigan sharmandaligi, aybdor yagona shaxs sifatida o'z ichiga olindi, shuning uchun men u uchun haqiqatan ham achinishni boshladim; bu haqiqatan ham aqldan ozgan odamga juda qattiq munosabatda bo'lgan.

en: Dounia was at once asked to give lessons in several families, but she refused.
uz: Dounia birdan bir nechta oilalarda dars berishni so'radi, lekin u rad etdi.

en: All of a sudden everyone began to treat her with marked respect and all this did much to bring about the event by which, one may say, our whole fortunes are now transformed.
uz: Toʻsatdan hamma unga hurmat bilan munosabatda boʻldi va bularning barchasi bizning butun taqdirimizni oʻzgartiradigan voqeaga katta hissa qoʻshdi.

en: You must know, dear Rodya, that Dounia has a suitor and that she has already consented to marry him.
uz: Siz bilishingiz kerakki, aziz Rodya, Douniaga bir yigit bor va u allaqachon u bilan turmush qurishga rozi bo'ldi.

en: I hasten to tell you all about the matter, and though it has been arranged without asking your consent, I think you will not be aggrieved with me or with your sister on that account, for you will see that we could not wait and put off our decision till we heard from you.
uz: Men bu haqda sizga hamma narsani aytishga shoshildim va bu sizning roziligingizni so'ramagan holda tuzilgan bo'lsa-da, bu haqda menga yoki singlingizga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaysiz, chunki siz ko'rasizki, biz sizdan xabar olishimizcha qarorimizni kechiktirishga va kechiktirishga harakat qila olmadik.

en: And you could not have judged all the facts without being on the spot.
uz: Va siz barcha faktlarni o'rinda bo'lmasdan hal qila olmas edingiz.

en: This was how it happened.
uz: Shunday qilib sodir bo'ldi.

en: He is already of the rank of a counsellor, Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin, and is distantly related to Marfa Petrovna, who has been very active in bringing the match about.
uz: U allaqachon Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin nomli maslahatchi darajasidan va o'yinni o'ynashda faol ishtirok etgan Marfa Petrovna bilan uzoq qarindosh.

en: It began with his expressing through her his desire to make our
uz: Bu uning o'zi orqali o'z xohishini bildirishi bilan boshlandi.

en: He was properly received, drank coffee with us and the very next day he sent us a letter in which he very courteously made an offer and begged for a speedy and decided answer.
uz: U munosib qabul qilindi, biz bilan birga kofe ichdi va ertasi kuni bizga maktub yubordi, unda u juda xushmuomalalik bilan taklif qildi va tezkor va qat'iy javob so'radi.

en: He is a very busy man and is in a great hurry to get to Petersburg, so that every moment is precious to him.
uz: U juda mashg'ul odam va Sankt-Peterburgga borishga juda shoshilmoqda, shuning uchun har bir daqiqa unga qimmatli.

en: At first, of course, we were greatly surprised, as it had all happened so quickly and unexpectedly.
uz: Albatta, dastlab biz juda hayratda qoldik, chunki bularning barchasi juda tez va kutilmagan tarzda sodir bo'lgan.

en: We thought and talked it over the whole day.
uz: Biz bu haqda kun bo'yi o'ylab, suhbatlashdik.

en: He is a well-to-do man, to be depended upon, he has two posts in the government and has already made his fortune.
uz: U boy odam, unga ishonish mumkin, u hukumatda ikkita lavozimga ega va allaqachon o'z mol-mulkini topgan.

en: It is true that he is forty-five years old, but he is of a fairly prepossessing appearance and might still be thought attractive by women, and he is altogether a very respectable and presentable man, only he seems a little morose and somewhat conceited.
uz: To'g'ri, u qirq besh yoshda, lekin u juda g'alati ko'rinish va hali ham ayollar tomonidan jozibador deb hisoblanishi mumkin, va u juda hurmatli va ko'rinadigan erkak, faqat u biroz g'alati va biroz mag'rur ko'rinadi.

en: But possibly that may only be the impression he makes at first sight.
uz: Ammo, ehtimol, bu uning birinchi ko'rinishdagi taassurotidir.

en: And beware, dear Rodya, when he comes to Petersburg, as he shortly will do, beware of judging him too hastily and severely, as your way is, if there is anything you do not like in him at first sight.
uz: Va ehtiyot bo'ling, aziz Rodya, u Sankt-Peterburgga kelganda, u yaqinda sodir bo'ladiganidek, agar u birinchi qarashda sizga yoqmaydigan biror narsa bo'lsa, siz o'zingizning yo'lingiz bo'yicha uni juda tez va qat'iy hukm qilishdan ehtiyot bo'ling.

en: I give you this warning, although I feel sure that he will make a favourable impression upon you.
uz: Bu ogohlantirishni sizga beraman, ammo u sizga ijobiy taassurot qoldirishiga aminman.

en: Moreover, in order to understand any man one must be deliberate and careful to avoid forming prejudices and mistaken ideas, which are very difficult to correct and get over afterwards.
uz: Bundan tashqari, har qanday odamni tushunish uchun inson o'y-ibratli va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak, chunki bu noto'g'ri fikrlar va oldindan o'tish juda qiyin.

en: And Pyotr Petrovitch, judging by many indications, is a thoroughly estimable man.
uz: Va Pyotr Petrovitch, ko'plab ko'rsatkichlarga ko'ra, juda qadrli odam.

en: At his first visit, indeed, he told us that he was a practical man, but still he shares, as he expressed it, many of the convictions ‘of our most rising generation’ and he is an opponent of all prejudices.
uz: Darhaqiqat, birinchi tashrifida u bizga o'zining amaliy inson ekanligini aytdi, ammo u o'zi aytganidek, ko'pchilik o'sib borayotgan avlodimizning e'tiqodlarini baham ko'radi va u barcha oldindan ko'ringanlarga qarshilik ko'rsatadi.

en: He said a good deal more, for he seems a little conceited and likes to be listened to, but this is scarcely a vice.
uz: U ko'proq gapirdi, chunki u biroz mag'rur va tinglanishni yaxshi ko'radi, ammo bu kamdan-kam yomonlikdir.

en: I, of course, understood very little of it, but Dounia explained to me that, though he is not a man of great education, he is clever and seems to be good-natured.
uz: Albatta, men bu haqda juda kam narsani tushunardim, lekin Duniy menga, u juda bilimdon emas, lekin aqlli va yaxshi xulq-atvorli bo'lib ko'rinishini tushuntirdi.

en: You know your sister’s character, Rodya.
uz: Siz singlingizning xarakterini bilasiz, Rodya.

en: She is a resolute, sensible, patient and generous girl, but she has a passionate heart, as I know very well.
uz: U qat'iy, aqlli, sabrli va saxiy qiz, lekin uning yuragi, men yaxshi bilganimdek, g'ayratli.

en: Of course, there is no great love either on his side, or on hers, but Dounia is a clever girl and has the heart of an angel, and will make it her duty to make her husband happy who on his side will make her
uz: To'g'ri, uning yoki uning tarafidan katta sevgi yo'q, lekin Dounia aqlli qiz va farishta yuragi bor va u erini baxtli qilish vazifasini bajaradi.

en: Of that we have no good reason to doubt, though it must be admitted the matter has been arranged in great haste.
uz: Shunga shubha ostiga qo'yish uchun hech qanday asosimiz yo'q, ammo e'tirof etish kerakki, bu masala juda tezda hal qilindi.

en: Besides he is a man of great prudence and he will see, to be sure, of himself, that his own happiness will be the more secure, the happier Dounia is with him.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u juda aqlli odam va u o'zidan shubhalanmasdan, o'z baxtining qanchalik xavfsiz bo'lsa, shunchalik baxtli Dounia u bilan birga bo'ladi.

en: And as for some defects of character, for some habits and even certain differences of opinion —which indeed are inevitable even in the happiest marriages —Dounia has said that, as regards all that, she relies on herself, that there is nothing to be uneasy about, and that she is ready to put up with a great deal, if only their future relationship can be an honourable and straightforward one.
uz: Va ba'zi kamchiliklarga, ba'zi odatlarga va hatto ba'zi bir fikr-mulohazalarning farqlariga kelsak, bular eng baxtli nikohlarda ham muqarrar bo'ladi.Dounia bularning barchasida o'ziga ishonishini, hech qanday xavotirga ega bo'lmasligini va agar ularning kelajakdagi munosabatlari hurmatli va bevosita bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa, juda ko'p narsani ko'tarishga tayyorligini aytdi.

en: He struck me, for instance, at first, as rather abrupt, but that may well come from his being an outspoken man, and that is no doubt how it is.
uz: Misol uchun, u menga birinchi bo'lib biroz g'alati tuyuldi, ammo bu uning ochiqchasiga gapirgan odamligidan kelib chiqishi mumkin va shubhasiz, shunday.

en: For instance, at his second visit, after he had received Dounia’s consent, in the course of conversation, he declared that before making Dounia’s acquaintance, he had made up his mind to marry a girl of good reputation, without dowry and, above all, one who had experienced poverty, because, as he explained, a man ought not to be indebted to his wife, but that it is better for a wife to look upon her husband as her benefactor.
uz: Misol uchun, ikkinchi tashrifida, Dounia roziligini olganidan so'ng, suhbat davomida u, Dounia bilan tanishishdan oldin, yaxshi nomli, marhamatsiz va eng asosiysi kambag'al bo'lgan qiz bilan turmush qurishga qaror qilganini aytdi, chunki, uning tushuntirishicha, erkak o'z xotiniga qarzdor bo'lmasligi kerak, aksincha, xotin o'z erini yaxshilik qiluvchi sifatida ko'rish yaxshiroqdir.

en: I must add that he expressed it more nicely and politely than I have done, for I have forgotten his actual phrases and only remember the meaning.
uz: Men qo'shishim kerakki, u bu so'zlarni men aytganimdan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi va xushmuomalalik bilan aytgan, chunki men uning so'zlarini unutganman va faqat ma'nosini eslayman.

en: And, besides, it was obviously not said of design, but slipped out in the heat of conversation, so that he tried afterwards to correct himself and smooth it over, but all the same it did strike me as somewhat rude, and I said so afterwards to Dounia.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u, albatta, dizayn haqida gapirmagan, balki suhbatning issiqligidan chiqib ketgan, shuning uchun u keyinchalik o'zini tuzatishga va uni sekinlashtirishga harakat qildi, ammo bu menga biroz qo'pol ko'rindi va men keyinchalik buni Douniaga aytdim.

en: But Dounia was vexed, and answered that ‘words are not deeds,’ and that, of course, is perfectly true.
uz: Ammo Dounia xafa bo'lib, so'zlar amal emas, degan javob berdi va bu, albatta, to'liq haq.

en: Dounia did not sleep all night before she made up her mind, and, thinking that I was asleep, she got out of bed and was walking up and down the room all night; at last she knelt down before the icon and prayed long and fervently and in the morning she told me that she had decided.
uz: Dounia o'z qarorini qabul qilishdan oldin butun kecha uxlamagan va men uxlaganimni o'ylab, o'z yotoqidan turib, butun kecha xonadan yurgan; oxir-oqibat, u ikoni oldida tiz cho'kib, uzoq va g'ayratli ibodat qildi va ertalab qarorini chiqarganini menga aytdi.

en: “I have mentioned already that Pyotr Petrovitch is just setting off for Petersburg, where he has a great deal of business, and he wants to open a legal bureau.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitchning Peterburgga ketayotganini aytib o'tgan edim, u yerda katta ish olib boradi va u yuridik idorani ochishni istaydi.

en: He has been occupied for many years in conducting civil and commercial litigation, and
uz: U ko'p yillar davomida fuqarolik va tijorat bo'yicha nizolarni olib borishda band bo'lgan va

en: only the other day he won an important case.
uz: Faqat bir kun oldin u muhim ishda g'alaba qozondi.
