en: He has to be in Petersburg because he has an important case before the Senate.
uz: U Sankt-Peterburgda bo'lishi kerak, chunki Senat oldida muhim ish bor.

en: So, Rodya dear, he may be of the greatest use to you, in every way indeed, and Dounia and I have agreed that from this very day you could definitely enter upon your career and might consider that your future is marked out and assured for you.
uz: Shunday qilib, aziz Rodya, u sizga har jihatdan juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin va Dounia va men shu kundan boshlab karyerangizga qat'iy kirishingiz mumkinligini va kelajagingiz siz uchun belgilab qo'yilgan va kafolatlangan deb o'ylashingizga rozi bo'ldik.

en: Oh, if only this comes to pass!
uz: Oh, agar mana shunday bo'lsa edi!

en: This would be such a benefit that we could only look upon it as a providential blessing.
uz: Bu shunchalik foydalidirki, biz uni faqatgina ilohiy baraka deb bilishimiz mumkin.

en: Dounia is dreaming of nothing else.
uz: Dounia boshqa hech narsa haqida orzu qilmayapti.

en: We have even ventured already to drop a few words on the subject to Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: Hatto Pyotr Petrovitch haqida bir necha so'z aytishga ham jur'at qildik.

en: He was cautious in his answer, and said that, of course, as he could not get on without a secretary, it would be better to be paying a salary to a relation than to a stranger, if only the former were fitted for the duties (as though there could be doubt of your being fitted!) but then he expressed doubts whether your studies at the university would leave you time for work at his office.
uz: U javobida ehtiyotkor bo'lib, albatta, kotibi bo'lmagan holda o'z ishini davom ettira olmaydigan bo'lgani uchun, qarindoshlariga qaraganda, begona kishiga ish haqi to'lash yaxshiroq bo'lishini aytdi, agar avvalgilar vazifasiga mos kelsa edi (sizning o'zingizga mos bo'lishingiz haqida shubha bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da!) lekin keyin universitetda o'qishingiz uning ofisida ishlash uchun vaqtingiz bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi degan shubhalarni bildirdi.

en: The matter dropped for the time, but Dounia is thinking of nothing else now.
uz: Vaqt o'tib bu masala halok bo'ldi, lekin Dounia endi boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylamaydi.

en: She has been in a sort of fever for the last few days, and has already made a regular plan for your becoming in the end an associate and even a partner in Pyotr Petrovitch’s business, which might well be, seeing that you are a student of law.
uz: U so'nggi bir necha kun davomida bir xil issiqlikka chalingan va siz oxir-oqibat Pyotr Petrovitchning ishida sherik va hatto sherik bo'lishingizni rejalashtirgan.

en: I am in complete agreement with her, Rodya, and share all her plans and hopes, and think there is every probability of realising them.
uz: Men Rodya bilan to'liq rozi bo'laman va uning barcha rejalari va umidlarini baham ko'raman va ularni amalga oshirishning barcha imkoniyatlari bor deb o'ylayman.

en: And in spite of Pyotr Petrovitch’s evasiveness, very natural at present (since he does not know you), Dounia is firmly persuaded that she will gain everything by her good influence over her future husband; this she is reckoning upon.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitchning chetga chiqish qobiliyatiga qaramay, hozirda bu tabiiy (chunki u sizni tanimaydi), Dounia o'zining bo'lajak eri ustidan yaxshi ta'sir ko'rsatishi bilan hamma narsaga erishadi, deb qat'iy ishonadi.

en: Of course we are careful not to talk of any of these more remote plans to Pyotr Petrovitch, especially of your becoming his partner.
uz: Albatta, biz Pyotr Petrovitchga ushbu uzoq rejalardan hech birini, ayniqsa, sizning uning sherik bo'lishingiz haqida gapirishdan ehtiyot bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: He is a practical man and might take this very coldly, it might all seem to him simply a daydream.
uz: U amaliy odam va bu haqda juda sovuq fikrda bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu unga shunchaki bir orzu kabi tuyulishi mumkin.

en: Nor has either Dounia or I breathed a word to him of the great hopes we have of his helping us to pay for your university studies; we have not spoken of it in the first place, because it will come to pass of itself, later on, and he will no doubt without wasting words offer to do it of himself, (as though he could refuse Dounia that) the more readily since you may by your own efforts become his right
uz: Dounia ham, men ham unga oliy ta'lim pulini to'lashga yordam berishiga umid qilayotganimiz haqida bir so'z ham aytmaganmiz; biz bu haqda birinchi navbatda gapirmaganmiz, chunki bu o'z-o'zidan keyin sodir bo'ladi va u, shubhasiz, so'zlarni sarflamasdan, buni o'zi qilish uchun taklif qiladi (douniaga buni rad etishi mumkin bo'lganidek), chunki siz o'zingizning harakatlaringiz bilan o'z huquqingizga aylanishingiz mumkin

en: hand in the office, and receive this assistance not as a charity, but as a salary earned by your own work.
uz: Ishxonada xizmat qiling va ushbu yordamni xayriya sifatida emas, balki o'zingizning ishingiz bilan to'langan ish haqi sifatida oling.

en: Dounia wants to arrange it all like this and I quite agree with her.
uz: Dounia buni shunday tartibga solishni istaydi va men u bilan to'liq rozi bo'laman.

en: And we have not spoken of our plans for another reason, that is, because I particularly wanted you to feel on an equal footing when you first meet him.
uz: Va biz boshqa sabablarga ko'ra rejalarimiz haqida gapirmadik, ya'ni men uni birinchi marta uchratganingizda o'zingizni teng his qilishingizni xohlagan edim.

en: When Dounia spoke to him with enthusiasm about you, he answered that one could never judge of a man without seeing him close, for oneself, and that he looked forward to forming his own opinion when he makes your acquaintance.
uz: Dounia siz haqingizda g'ayrat bilan gapirganida, u siz bilan tanishib bo'lganda o'z fikrini o'zgartirishni intizorlik bilan kutishini va siz bilan yaqinroq tanishib bo'lmaguncha, hech qachon odamni hukm qilolmasligingizni aytdi.

en: Do you know, my precious Rodya, I think that perhaps for some reasons (nothing to do with Pyotr Petrovitch though, simply for my own personal, perhaps old-womanish, fancies) I should do better to go on living by myself, apart, than with them, after the wedding.
uz: Bilasizmi, aziz Rodya, men o'ylaymanki, ehtimol ba'zi sabablarga ko'ra (Pyotr Petrovitch bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q, faqat shaxsiy, ehtimol qadimgi xotinning o'ylashlari uchun) to'ydan keyin ular bilan yashashdan ko'ra, yakka o'zim yashashni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: I am convinced that he will be generous and delicate enough to invite me and to urge me to remain with my daughter for the future, and if he has said nothing about it hitherto, it is simply because it has been taken for granted; but I shall refuse.
uz: U meni taklif qilib, kelajakda qizim bilan qolishimni iltimos qilish uchun saxiy va mehribon bo'lishiga ishonaman va agar u bu haqda hali hech narsa aytmagan bo'lsa, bu oddiy hol bo'lgani uchun; lekin men rad etaman.

en: I have noticed more than once in my life that husbands don’t quite get on with their mothers-in-law, and I don’t want to be the least bit in anyone’s way, and for my own sake, too, would rather be quite independent, so long as I have a crust of bread of my own, and such children as you and Dounia.
uz: Hayotimda bir necha bor erlar qaynonasi bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmasligini payqadim va hech kimning yo'lida kamroq bo'lishni istamayman va o'zim uchun ham mustaqil bo'lishni afzal ko'raman, agar men o'zimning ham, siz va Dounia singari bolalarimning ham rizq-ro'z qo'limda bo'lsa.

en: If possible, I would settle somewhere near you, for the most joyful piece of news, dear Rodya, I have kept for the end of my letter: know then, my dear boy, that we may, perhaps, be all together in a very short time and may embrace one another again after a separation of almost three years!
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, men sizga yaqin joyda joylashaman, eng quvonchli xabar uchun, aziz Rodya, men maktubim oxirida saqlaganman: biling, endi, aziz o'g'lim, ehtimol, biz hammamiz juda qisqa vaqt ichida birga bo'lishimiz mumkin va deyarli uch yil ajralganimizdan so'ng bir-birimizni yana quchoqlab olishimiz mumkin!

en: It is settled for certain that Dounia and I are to set off for Petersburg, exactly when I don’t know, but very, very soon, possibly in a week.
uz: To'g'ri, To'unia va men Sankt-Peterburg shahriga jo'nab ketishimizni aniq belgilab qo'yyapmiz, aniq bilmayman, lekin juda, juda tez, ehtimol bir hafta ichida.

en: It all depends on Pyotr Petrovitch who will let us know when he has had time to look round him in Petersburg.
uz: Bularning barchasi Pyotr Petrovitchga bog'liq bo'lib, u Peterburgda atrofini ko'rib chiqish uchun vaqt topganida bizga xabar beradi.

en: To suit his own arrangements he is anxious to have the ceremony as soon as possible, even before the fast of Our Lady, if it could be managed, or if that is too soon to be ready, immediately after.
uz: O'z tartiblariga mos ravishda, u marosimni iloji boricha tezroq o'tkazishni istaydi, hatto Xonimimizning ro'zidan oldin ham, agar uni amalga oshirish mumkin bo'lsa yoki tayyor bo'lish uchun juda tez bo'lsa, darhol keyinroq.

en: Oh, with what happiness I shall press you to my heart!
uz: Oh, men seni yuragimga qanday baxt bilan tatib ko'raman!

en: Dounia is all excitement at the joyful thought of seeing you, she said one day in joke that she would be ready to marry Pyotr Petrovitch for that alone.
uz: Dounia sizni ko'rishning quvonchli fikridan juda hayajonlanadi, u bir kuni Pyotr Petrovitch bilan turmush qurishga tayyor bo'lishi haqida maydalik bilan aytdi.

en: writing anything to you now, and has only told me to write that she has so much, so much to tell you that she is not going to take up her pen now, for a few lines would tell you nothing, and it would only mean upsetting herself; she bids me send you her love and innumerable kisses.
uz: Endi senga biror narsa yozishimni aytdi va menga faqat shunday yozishimni aytdiki, uning juda ko'p, sizga aytadigan juda ko'p narsa bor, u endi qalamini qo'ymaydi, chunki bir necha satr sizga hech narsa aytmaydi va bu faqat o'zini xafa qilishni anglatadi; u menga o'z sevgisini va son-sanoqsiz o'qishni yuborishimni taklif qiladi.

en: But although we shall be meeting so soon, perhaps I shall send you as much money as I can in a day or two.
uz: Ammo biz yaqinda uchrashamiz, lekin ehtimol bir yoki ikki kun ichida sizga imkon qadar ko'p pul yuboraman.

en: Now that everyone has heard that Dounia is to marry Pyotr Petrovitch, my credit has suddenly improved and I know that Afanasy Ivanovitch will trust me now even to seventy- five roubles on the security of my pension, so that perhaps I shall be able to send you twenty-five or even thirty roubles.
uz: Endi har kim Dounia Pyotr Petrovitch bilan turmushga chiqishi haqida eshitgan ekan, mening kreditim birdan yaxshilandi va Afanasy Ivanovitch mening pensiyamni himoya qilish uchun menga yetmish besh rublgacha ishonishini bilaman, shuning uchun ehtimol men sizga yigirma besh yoki hatto o'ttiz rubl yuborishim mumkin.

en: I would send you more, but I am uneasy about our travelling expenses; for though Pyotr Petrovitch has been so kind as to undertake part of the expenses of the journey, that is to say, he has taken upon himself the conveyance of our bags and big trunk (which will be conveyed through some acquaintances of his), we must reckon upon some expense on our arrival in Petersburg, where we can’t be left without a halfpenny, at least for the first few days.
uz: Sizlarga ko'proq jo'nataman, lekin sayohat xarajatlarimizdan xavotirlanaman; chunki Pyotr Petrovitch sayohat xarajatlarining bir qismini o'z zimmasiga olgan bo'lsa-da, ya'ni bizning sumkalarimiz va katta bagajimizni (ular uning ba'zi tanishlari orqali olib boriladi) o'z zimmasiga olgan bo'lsa-da, biz Petersburgga kelganimizda ba'zi xarajatlarni hisoblab chiqishimiz kerak, chunki biz yarim tangagacha, hech bo'lmaganda, birinchi kunlar uchun ham qolmay qolishimiz mumkin emas.

en: But we have calculated it all, Dounia and I, to the last penny, and we see that the journey will not cost very much.
uz: Ammo biz, Dounia va men hamma narsani so'nggi pentagacha hisoblab chiqdik va sayohatning qimmat bo'lmasligini ko'ramiz.

en: It is only ninety versts from us to the railway and we have come to an agreement with a driver we know, so as to be in readiness; and from there Dounia and I can travel quite comfortably third class.
uz: Bizdan temir yo'lga borish uchun atigi to'qqiz kilometr yo'l bor va biz o'zimiz bilgan haydovchi bilan tayyor turish uchun kelishuvga keldik; u yerdan Dounia va men uchinchi sinfda juda qulay sayohat qilishimiz mumkin.

en: So that I may very likely be able to send to you not twenty-five, but thirty roubles.
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga yigirma besh emas, balki o'ttiz rubl yuborishim mumkin.

en: But enough; I have covered two sheets already and there is no space left for more; our whole history, but so many events have happened!
uz: Lekin yetarli; men allaqachon ikkita varaqni o'chirib qo'ydim va boshqalarga joy qolmadi; butun tariximiz, lekin ko'pgina voqealar sodir bo'ldi!

en: And now, my precious Rodya, I embrace you and send you a mother’s blessing till we meet.
uz: Va endi, aziz Rodya, men seni quchoqlab, uchrashmagunimizcha onamning barakasi bilan yuboraman.

en: Love Dounia your sister, Rodya; love her as she loves you and understand that she loves you beyond everything, more than herself.
uz: Dounia singilingizni, Rodyani seving; uni u sizni sevgani kabi seving va u sizni hamma narsadan, o'zini o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevishini tushuning.

en: She is an angel and you, Rodya, you are everything to us —our one hope, our one consolation.
uz: U farishta, siz esa, Rodya, biz uchun hamma narsasiz, bizning yagona umidimiz va tasallimiz.

en: If only you are happy, we shall be happy.
uz: Agar siz baxtli bo'lsangiz, biz ham baxtli bo'lamiz.

en: Do you still say your prayers, Rodya, and believe in the mercy of our Creator and our Redeemer?
uz: Siz hali ham ibodatlaringizni aytyapsizmi, Rodya, Yaratuvchimiz va Qutqaruvchimizning rahmdilligiga ishonyapsizmi?

en: I am afraid in my heart that you may have been visited by the new spirit of infidelity that is abroad today; If it is so, I pray for you.
uz: Qalbimda qo'rqamanki, bugungi kunda keng tarqalgan yangi xudojo'ylik ruhi sizni tashrif buyurgan bo'lishi mumkin; agar shunday bo'lsa, men siz uchun ibodat qilaman.

en: how in your childhood, when your father was living, you used to lisp your prayers at my knee, and how happy we all were in those days.
uz: Bolaligingizda, otangiz tirik bo'lganida, siz ibodatlaringizni tiz cho'kkaningizda to'kib qo'yganingizni va o'sha kunlarda hammamiz qanchalik baxtli ekanimizni ko'rdingiz.

en: Goodbye, till we meet then —I embrace you warmly, warmly, with many kisses.
uz: Xo'sh, uchrashmagunimizcha, men sizni iliq, iliq, ko'pgina o'qishlar bilan quchoqlayman.

en: “Yours till death, Pulcheria Raskolnikov.” Almost from the first, while he read the letter, Raskolnikov’s face was wet with tears; but when he finished it, his face was pale and distorted and a bitter, wrathful and malignant smile was on his lips.
uz: Your till death, Pulcheria Raskolnikov. Raskolnikov maktubni o'qiganidan boshlab deyarli uning yuzi ko'z yoshlari bilan to'lib-toshgan edi; lekin uni tugatganida uning yuzi o'tkir va buzilgan edi va og'izlarida achchiq, g'azabli va yovuz tabassum bor edi.

en: He laid his head down on his threadbare dirty pillow and pondered, pondered a long time.
uz: U boshini o'zining nopok, kirli yostigiga qo'yib, ko'p vaqt o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: His heart was beating violently, and his brain was in a turmoil.
uz: Uning yuragi og'ir urib, miyasi g'alati bo'lgan.

en: At last he felt cramped and stifled in the little yellow room that was like a cupboard or a box.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u o'zini sovg'a yoki quti kabi bo'lgan kichkina sariq xonada siqilgan va cho'kgan his qildi.

en: His eyes and his mind craved for space.
uz: Uning ko'zlari va ongining ko'z-ko'zidan ko'rinish oromadi.

en: He took up his hat and went out, this time without dread of meeting anyone; he had forgotten his dread.
uz: U to'pini olib, tashqariga chiqdi, bu safar hech kim bilan uchrashishdan qo'rqmay, qo'rquvni unutib qo'ydi.

en: He turned in the direction of the Vassilyevsky Ostrov, walking along Vassilyevsky Prospect, as though hastening on some business, but he walked, as his habit was, without noticing his way, muttering and even speaking aloud to himself, to the astonishment of the passersby.
uz: U Vassilyevskiy Ostrov yo'nalishidagi yo'lni o'zgartirib, Vassilyevskiy prospekti bo'ylab yuribdi, xuddi biron bir ishda shoshilgani kabi, lekin u o'z odati bo'yicha, o'z yo'lini ko'rmasdan, o'zi o'zi bilan g'ayratli va hatto baland ovoz bilan gapirgan holda, o'tib ketayotganlarni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: Many of them took him to be drunk.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi uni mastlikka olib ketishdi.

en: IV His mother’s letter had been a torture to him, but as regards the chief fact in it, he had felt not one moment’s hesitation, even whilst he was reading the letter.
uz: Onasining maktubi unga azob keltirdi, lekin uning asosiy faktini ko'rib chiqayotganda, xatni o'qiganida ham, u bir daqiqa ham shubha ostiga qo'ymagan.

en: The essential question was settled, and irrevocably settled, in his mind: “Never such a marriage while I am alive and Mr.
uz: U o'z fikrida muhim savolni hal qildi va bu savol o'z vaqtida hal qilindi: "Men tirik bo'lganimcha bunday nikoh o'tkazilmagan va Mr.

en: Luzhin be damned!” “The thing is perfectly clear,” he muttered to himself, with a malignant smile anticipating the triumph of his decision.
uz: Luzhin halok bo'lsin! Bular to'liq aniq, o'zi o'ziga qarab, o'z qarorining g'alaba qozonishini kutib o'tirgan yovuz tabassum bilan gapirdi.

en: “No, mother, no, Dounia, you won’t deceive me!
uz: Yo'q, ona, yo'q, Dounia, meni aldamaysiz!

en: and then they apologise for not asking my advice and for taking the decision without me!
uz: Keyin mening maslahatimni so'ramaganliklari va qarorni mensiz qabul qilganliklari uchun uzr so'raydilar!

en: They imagine it is arranged now and can’t be broken off; but we will see whether it can or not!
uz: Ular buni hozirda tuzilgan deb o'ylashadi va uni buzish mumkin emas; lekin bu tuzilgan yoki yo'qligini ko'ramiz!

en: A magnificent excuse: ‘Pyotr Petrovitch is such a busy man that even his wedding has to be in post-haste, almost by express.’ No, Dounia, I see it all and I know what you want to say to me; and I know too what you were thinking about, when you walked up and down all night, and what your prayers were like before the Holy Mother of Kazan who stands in mother’s bedroom.
uz: Ajoyib uzr: Pyotr Petrovitch shunchalik mashg'ul odamki, hatto uning to'ylari ham shoshilinch, deyarli ekspres tarzda o'tishi kerak. Yo'q, Dounia, men hamma narsani ko'ryapman va menga nima deyishni xohlayotganingizni bilaman; va men ham nima haqida o'ylayotganingizni bilaman, siz butun kecha o'tib-o'tib yurganingizda, va oyingizning yotoqxonasida turgan Qozonning muqaddas onasi oldida ibodatlaringiz qanday edi.

en: Bitter is the ascent to Golgotha.
uz: Go'lgotadagi ko'tarilish og'ir bo'ladi.

en: … Hm … so it is finally settled; you have determined to marry a sensible business man, Avdotya Romanovna, one who has a fortune (has already made his fortune, that is so much more solid and impressive), a man who holds two government posts and who shares the ideas of our most rising generation, as mother writes, and who seems to be kind, as Dounia herself observes.
uz: Hm ... nihoyat hal bo'ldi; siz aqlli ishbilarmon Avdotya Romanovna bilan turmush qurishga qaror qildingiz, uning mol-mulki bor (u allaqachon mol-mulkiga ega bo'ldi, bu ancha mustahkam va ta'sirchan), ikki marta hukumat lavozimida bo'lgan va onam yozganidek, eng ko'tarilgan avlodimizning g'oyalarini baham ko'radigan va Dounia o'zi kuzatganidek mehribon bo'lib ko'rinadigan kishi.

en: That seems beats everything!
uz: Bu hamma narsani mag'lub qiladi!

en: And that very Dounia for that very ‘seems’ is marrying him!
uz: Va aynan shunga o'xshash Dounia unga turmushga chiqyapti!

en: “… But I should like to know why mother has written to me about ‘our most rising generation’?
uz: ... Ammo men bilmoqchi edim, nega onam menga eng ko'tarilgan avlodimiz haqida yozgan?

en: Simply as a descriptive touch, or with the idea of prepossessing me in favour of Mr.
uz: Oddiy ravishda tavsiflash to'plami sifatida yoki meni Mr.ning foydasiga qo'llab-quvvatlash g'oyasi bilan.

en: I should like to know one thing more: how far they were open with one another that day and night and all this time since?
uz: Yana bir narsani bilmoqchiman: ular o'sha kecha-kunduz va o'sha vaqtdan beri bir-biriga qanchalik ochiq edilar?

en: Was it all put into words, or did both understand that they had the same thing at heart and in their minds, so that there was no need to speak of it aloud, and better not to speak of it.
uz: Bularning barchasi so'zlarga aylandimi yoki ikkalasi ham o'zlarining yuraklarida va onglarida bir xil narsa borligini tushunishganmi, shuning uchun bu haqda ovoz chiqarib gapirishning hojati yo'q va gapirmaslik yaxshiroqmi?

en: Most likely it was partly like that, from mother’s letter it’s evident: he struck her as rude a little, and mother in her simplicity took her observations to Dounia.
uz: Ehtimol, bu qisman shunday edi, onasining maktubidan ko'rinib turibdiki, u unga biroz qo'pollik bilan qaragan va ona uning soddaligi bilan uning e'tiborini Douniaga olib borgan.

en: And she was sure to be vexed and ‘answered her angrily.’ I should think so!
uz: Va u xafa bo'lishi shubhasizdir va g'azab bilan javob berdi.Men shunday o'ylayman!

en: Who would not be angered when it was quite clear without any naive questions and when it was understood that it was useless to discuss it.
uz: Kim g'azablanib qolmaydi, agar bu savollar inoq savollarsiz aniq bo'lsa va muhokama qilishning foydasi yo'qligini tushunsa?

en: And why does she write to me, ‘love Dounia, Rodya, and she loves you more than herself’?
uz: Va nima uchun u menga yozadi, love Dounia, Rodya, va u sizni o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevadi?

en: Has she a secret conscience- prick at sacrificing her daughter to her son?
uz: Qizini o'g'li uchun qurbonlikka keltirishda uning vijdoni saqlanadimi?

en: ‘You are our one comfort, you are everything to us.’ Oh, mother!” His bitterness grew more and more intense, and if he had happened to meet Mr.
uz: Siz bizning yagona tasallimiz, siz biz uchun hamma narsamizsiz. Oh, ona! Uning achchiqligi kundan-kunga kuchayib borardi va agar u Mr.

en: Luzhin at the moment, he might have murdered him.
uz: Luzhin hozirgi paytda uni o'ldirgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: “Hm … yes, that’s true,” he continued, pursuing the whirling ideas that chased each other in his brain, “it is true that ‘it needs time and care to get to know a man,’ but there is no mistake about Mr.
uz: Hm ... ha, bu haqiqat, u davom etdi, o'z miyasida bir-birini quvg'in qilgan g'ayratli g'oyalarni izlab, bu haqiqatdir,bir kishi bilan tanishish uchun vaqt va g'amxo'rlik kerak, lekin Mr. haqida hech qanday xato yo'q.

en: The chief thing is he is ‘a man of business and seems kind,’ that was something, wasn’t it, to send the bags and big box for them!
uz: Asosiy narsa shundaki, u biznesmen va mehribon ko'rinadi, bu ularning uchun sumka va katta quti yuborish uchun bir narsa edi, shunday emasmi?

en: A kind man, no doubt after that!
uz: Yaxshi odam, shubhasiz, bundan keyin!

en: But his bride and her mother are to drive in a peasant’s cart covered with sacking (I know, I have been driven in it).
uz: Ammo uning kelinasi va onasi talonchilar aravachasida haydashga majbur bo'lishadi (bilsam, men u yerda haydashganman).

en: It is only ninety versts and then they can ‘travel very comfortably, third class,’ for a thousand versts!
uz: Bu atigi to'qqiz va ular juda qulay, uchinchi sinf, ming vachtada sayohat qilishlari mumkin!

en: One must cut one’s coat according to one’s cloth, but what about you, Mr.
uz: Birovning kiyimini kiyimga qarab kesishi kerak, lekin siz haqida nima deyish mumkin, Mr.

en: … And you must be aware that her mother has to raise money on her pension for the journey.
uz: Va siz uning onasi sayohat uchun pensiyasini yig'ishi kerakligini bilishingiz kerak.

en: To be sure it’s a matter of business, a partnership for mutual benefit, with equal shares and expenses; —food and drink provided, but pay for your tobacco.
uz: Bu biznes masalasi, o'zaro manfaatli sheriklik, teng ulush va xarajatlar bilan; oziq-ovqat va ichimlik taqdim etiladi, lekin tamaki uchun pul to'lash.

en: The business man has got the better of them, too.
uz: Ishbilarmon odam ham ulardan ustun bo'ldi.

en: The luggage will cost less than their fares and very likely go for nothing.
uz: Bagajlar ularning narxlaridan kamroq va hech narsa uchun bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: How is it that they don’t both see all that, or is it that they don’t want to see?
uz: Nima uchun ikkalasi ham bularning barchasini ko'rmaydilar yoki ko'rishni xohlamaydilar?

en: And they are pleased, pleased!
uz: Va ular mamnun, mamnun!

en: And to think that this is only the first blossoming, and that the real fruits are to come!
uz: Va bu faqat birinchi gullash va haqiqiy mevalar kelishi haqida o'ylash!

en: But what really matters is not the stinginess, is not the meanness, but the tone
uz: Ammo aslida muhim bo'lgan narsa o'tkirlik yoki yomonlik emas, balki tovushdir.

en: For that will be the tone after marriage, it’s a foretaste of it.
uz: Chunki bu nikohdan keyin o'z so'zini ifodalaydi, bu uning oldindan tanovul qilishidir.

en: And mother too, why should she be so lavish?
uz: Va ona ham, nega u shunchalik xafa bo'lishi kerak?

en: What will she have by the time she gets to Petersburg?
uz: Sankt-Peterburgga yetib borganda u nimaga ega bo'ladi?

en: Three silver roubles or two ‘paper ones’ as she says … that old woman … hm.
uz: U kishi aytganidek, uchta kumush rubl yoki ikkita qog'ozli rubl ... bu keksa ayol ... hm.

en: What does she expect to live upon in Petersburg afterwards?
uz: U keyinchalik Sankt-Peterburgda nima bilan yashashni kutadi?

en: She has her reasons already for guessing that she could not live with Dounia after the marriage, even for the first few months.
uz: U allaqachon uylanishidan keyin, hatto birinchi bir necha oy davomida, Dounia bilan yashashni istamaydi deb o'ylashga asoslari bor.

en: The good man has no doubt let slip something on that subject also, though mother would deny it: ‘I shall refuse,’ says she.
uz: Yaxshi odam shubhasiz, bu mavzuda ham biron bir narsani qoldirdi, ammo ona buni rad etadi: "Men rad qilaman", deydi u.

en: On whom is she reckoning then?
uz: Xo'sh, u kimga ishonadi?

en: Is she counting on what is left of her hundred and twenty roubles of pension when Afanasy Ivanovitch’s debt is paid?
uz: Afanasiy Ivanovitchning qarzi to'langanida, u pensiyasidan qolgan yuz yigirma rubl miqdorida pulni hisoblayaptimi?

en: She knits woollen shawls and embroiders cuffs, ruining her old eyes.
uz: U junli shaullar va tikish bilan bog'liq bo'lgan manftlarni tikadi va o'zining eski ko'zlarini buzib yuboradi.

en: And all her shawls don’t add more than twenty roubles a year to her hundred and twenty, I know that.
uz: Va uning barcha shallari uning yuz yigirma yilligiga yiliga yigirma rubldan ko'proq qo'shmaydi, buni bilaman.

en: So she is building all her hopes all the time on Mr.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'z umidlarini doimo Mr.ga bog'lab turadi.

en: Luzhin’s generosity; ‘he will offer it of himself, he will press it on me.’ You may wait a long time for that!
uz: Luzhinning saxiyligi; u uni o'z xohishi bilan taklif qiladi, menga bosim o'tkazadi. Buning uchun uzoq vaqt kutishingiz mumkin!

en: That’s how it always is with these Schilleresque noble hearts; till the last moment every goose is a swan with them, till the last moment, they hope for the best and will see nothing wrong, and although they have an inkling of the other side of the picture, yet they won’t face the truth till they are forced to; the very thought of it makes them shiver; they thrust the truth away with both hands, until the man they deck out in false colours puts a fool’s cap on them with his own hands.
uz: Bu Shillereskning buyuk yuraklari bilan hamisha shunday bo'ladi; oxirgi daqiqaga qadar har bir qo'zg'on ular bilan chiroyli bo'ladi, oxirgi daqiqaga qadar ular eng yaxshisiga umid bog'laydilar va hech narsa noto'g'ri ko'rmaydilar, va agar ular rasmning boshqa tomonini tushunsalar ham, haqiqatga duch kelmaydilar, lekin ular majbur bo'lmaguncha; bu haqda o'ylash ularni titraydi; ular haqiqatni ikkala qo'li bilan o'zgartiradilar, hatto ular soxta ranglar bilan bezashgan odam o'z qo'li bilan ularga o'ng qo'l qo'yib qo'yadi.

en: I should like to know whether Mr.
uz: Men Mr.ning o'zi bor-yo'qligini bilmoqchiman.

en: Luzhin has any orders of merit; I bet he has the Anna in his buttonhole and that he puts it on when he goes to dine with contractors or merchants.
uz: Luzhinning hech qanday qadr-qiymati yo'q; o'ylaymanki, uning tugma cho'g'ida Anna bor va u kontraktlar yoki savdogarlar bilan ovqatlanishga ketganda uni kiyib qo'yadi.

en: He will be sure to have it for his wedding, too!
uz: Shubhasizki, u ham to'y uchun uni oladi!

en: Enough of him, confound him!
uz: U yetarli, uni chalg'itib qo'ying!

en: “Well, … mother I don’t wonder at, it’s like her, God bless her, but how could Dounia?
uz: Xo'sh, ... onam haqida o'ylamayman, u o'zi kabi, Xudo unga baraka bersin, lekin qanday qilib Dounia bunga erishishi mumkin?

en: Dounia darling, as though I did not know you!
uz: Dounia, azizim, seni tanimaganim kabi!

en: You were nearly twenty when I saw you last: I understood you then.
uz: Seni oxirgi marta ko'rganimda deyarli yigirma yoshda eding: o'sha paytda men seni tushunardim.

en: Mother writes that ‘Dounia can put up with a great deal.’ I know that very well.
uz: Onam yozadiki, Dunyo ko'p narsaga chiday oladi.Men buni yaxshi bilaman.

en: I knew that two years and a half ago, and for the last two and a half years I have been thinking about it, thinking of just that, that ‘Dounia can put up with a great deal.’ If she could put up with Mr.
uz: Men buni ikki yarim yil oldin va so'nggi ikki yarim yil davomida o'yladim va o'yladim, bu haqda o'yladim, chunki "Dounia" juda ko'p narsalarni ko'tarishi mumkin.

en: Svidrigaïlov and all the rest of it, she certainly can put up with a great deal.
uz: Svidrigailov va boshqalarning barchasi, albatta, u juda ko'p narsaga chiday oladi.

en: And now mother and she have taken it into their heads that she can put up with Mr.
uz: Endi esa onasi bilan o'zlariga o'ylab ko'rishdiki, u Mr. bilan chidashi mumkin.

en: Luzhin, who propounds the theory of the
uz: Luzhin, o'zining teoriyasini taqdim etgan.

en: superiority of wives raised from destitution and owing everything to their husband’s bounty —who propounds it, too, almost at the first interview.
uz: Ayollarning kambag'allikdan o'sib-ulg'aygan va hamma narsani o'z erlari uchun minnatdor bo'lgan xotinning ustunligi, uni ham birinchi suhbatda deyarli ko'rsatadi.

en: Granted that he ‘let it slip,’ though he is a sensible man, (yet maybe it was not a slip at all, but he meant to make himself clear as soon as possible) but Dounia, Dounia?
uz: Garchi u oqilona odam bo'lsa-da, (agar bu xato bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da, lekin u imkon qadar tezroq o'zini ochiq-oydin ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsa-da), lekin Dounia, Dounia?

en: She understands the man, of course, but she will have to live with the man.
uz: Albatta, u erkakni tushunadi, lekin u bilan yashashga majbur bo'ladi.

en: she’d live on black bread and water, she would not sell her soul, she would not barter her moral freedom for comfort; she would not barter it for all Schleswig-Holstein, much less Mr.
uz: U qora non va suv bilan yashaydi, o'z jonini sotmaydi, axloqiy erkinligini tasalli uchun sotmaydi; butun Shlesvig-Holstein uchun sotmaydi, bundan ham kamroq Mr. Holstein uchun sotmaydi.

en: No, Dounia was not that sort when I knew her and … she is still the same, of course!
uz: Yo'q, Dounia men uni taniganimda bunday emas edi va... u hali ham xuddi shunday, albatta!

en: Yes, there’s no denying, the Svidrigaïlovs are a bitter pill!
uz: Ha, shubhasizki, Svidrigailovlar achchiq dorilardir!

en: It’s a bitter thing to spend one’s life a governess in the provinces for two hundred roubles, but I know she would rather be a nigger on a plantation or a Lett with a German master than degrade her soul, and her moral dignity, by binding herself forever to a man whom she does not respect and with whom she has nothing in common —for her own advantage.
uz: O'z hayotini ikki yuz rubl evaziga viloyatlarda o'qituvchi sifatida o'tkazish og'irdir, lekin uning o'z nafsiga va axloqiy qadr-qimmatini pastga surib, o'zini abadiy hurmat qilmaydigan va o'ziga foyda keltiradigan hech qanday umumiyligi yo'q kishiga bog'lab qo'yishdan ko'ra, o'z hayotini ikki yuz rubl evaziga viloyatlarda o'qituvchi sifatida o'tkazishni afzal ko'rishni afzal ko'raman.

en: Luzhin had been of unalloyed gold, or one huge diamond, she would never have consented to become his legal concubine.
uz: Luzhin oltin yoki bitta ulkan olmosdan yasalgan bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, u hech qachon uning qonuniy konkubina bo'lishga rozi bo'lmasdi.

en: Why is she consenting then?
uz: Xo'sh, nega u rozi bo'ladi?

en: What’s the point of it?
uz: Buning nima maqsadi bor?

en: It’s clear enough: for herself, for her comfort, to save her life she would not sell herself, but for someone else she is doing it!
uz: Toʻgʻri aniq: oʻzi uchun, oʻz taskinini, oʻz hayotini saqlab qolish uchun u oʻzini sotmaydi, balki oʻzini boshqa kishi uchun sotadi!

en: For one she loves, for one she adores, she will sell herself!
uz: Sevgan, sevadigan kishi uchun o'zini sotadi!

en: That’s what it all amounts to; for her brother, for her mother, she will sell herself!
uz: Bularning barchasi shu bilan bog'liq: ukasi uchun, onasi uchun u o'zini sotadi!

en: She will sell everything!
uz: U hamma narsani sotadi!

en: In such cases, ‘we overcome our moral feeling if necessary,’ freedom, peace, conscience even, all, all are brought into the market.
uz: Bunday holatlarda, agar kerak bo'lsa, biz o'z axloqiy his-tuyg'ularimizni yengamiz, erkinlik, tinchlik, hatto vijdon, barchasi bozorga chiqariladi.

en: Let my life go, if only my dear ones may be happy!
uz: Hayotimni yo'q qil, agar yaqinlarim baxtli bo'lsa!

en: More than that, we become casuists, we learn to be Jesuitical and for a time maybe we can soothe ourselves, we can persuade ourselves that it is one’s duty for a good object.
uz: Bundan tashqari, biz kasuzistlarga aylanamiz, jesuit bo'lishni o'rganamiz va ehtimol bir muncha vaqt o'zimizni xotirjam qila olamiz, yaxshi narsa uchun bu o'z burchimiz deb o'zimizni ishontira olamiz.

en: That’s just like us, it’s as clear as daylight.
uz: Bu xuddi biz kabi, kun yorug'ligi kabi aniq.

en: It’s clear that Rodion Romanovitch Raskolnikov is the central figure in the business, and no one else.
uz: Rodion Romanovitch Raskolnikov bu biznesning markaziy shaxsiyati ekanligi aniq, boshqa hech kim emas.

en: Oh, yes, she can ensure his happiness, keep him in the university, make him a partner in the office, make his whole future secure; perhaps he may even be a rich man later on, prosperous, respected, and may even end his life a famous man!
uz: Ha, u uning baxtini ta'minlashi mumkin, uni universitetda saqlashi mumkin, uni ofisda sherik qilishi mumkin, butun kelajagi xavfsiz bo'lishi mumkin; ehtimol, u keyinchalik boy, boy, hurmatga sazovor bo'lishi mumkin va hatto o'z hayotini mashhur kishi sifatida tugatishi mumkin!

en: It’s all Rodya, precious Rodya, her first born!
uz: Bularning barchasi Rodya, aziz Rodya, uning to'ng'ich tug'ilgan!

en: For such a son who would not sacrifice such a daughter!
uz: Bunday qizni qurbon qilmagan o'g'il uchun!

en: Oh, loving, over-partial hearts!
uz: Oh, mehribon, ortiqcha yuzxotirchilik qiladigan yuraklar!

en: his sake we would not shrink even from Sonia’s fate.
uz: U uchun biz hatto Sonia nasibasiga ham qochmaymiz.

en: Sonia, Sonia Marmeladov, the eternal victim so long as the world lasts.
uz: Sonia, Sonia Marmeladov, abadiy qurbon, dunyo bor ekan.

en: Have you taken the measure of your sacrifice, both of you?
uz: Ikkalaingiz ham qurbonligingizni o'lchab oldingizmi?

en: Is there sense in it?
uz: Buning ma'nosi bormi?

en: And let me tell you, Dounia, Sonia’s life is no worse than life with Mr.
uz: Va sizga aytaman, Dounia, Sonaning hayoti Mr. Sonaning hayotidan ham yomonroq emas.

en: ‘There can be no question of love,’ mother writes.
uz: Sevgidan hech qanday shubha yo'q,  deb yozadi ona.

en: And what if there can be no respect either, if on the contrary there is aversion, contempt, repulsion, what then?
uz: Agar hurmat ham bo'lmasa, aksincha nafrat, nafrat va nafrat bo'lsa, nima bo'ladi?

en: So you will have to ‘keep up your appearance,’ too.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz ham tashqi ko'rinishingizga e'tibor qaratishingiz kerak.

en: Do you understand what that smartness means?
uz: Bu aqllilik nimani anglatishini tushunyapsizmi?

en: Do you understand that the Luzhin smartness is just the same thing as Sonia’s and may be worse, viler, baser, because in your case, Dounia, it’s a bargain for luxuries, after all, but with Sonia it’s simply a question of starvation.
uz: Siz tushunasizmi, Luzhin aqlliligi Sonia bilan bir xil va yomonroq, yomonroq, kamroq bo'lishi mumkin, chunki sizning holatingizda, Dounia, bu, nihoyat, farovonlik uchun bir sovg'a, lekin Sonia bilan bu shunchaki ochlik masalasi.

en: It has to be paid for, it has to be paid for, Dounia, this smartness.
uz: Buning evaziga pul to'lash kerak, bu aqlsizlik uchun pul to'lash kerak, Dounia.

en: And what if it’s more than you can bear afterwards, if you regret it?
uz: Va agar keyinchalik afsuslanayotgan bo'lsangiz, bu siz ko'proq ko'targan bo'lsa-chi?

en: The bitterness, the misery, the curses, the tears hidden from all the world, for you are not a Marfa Petrovna.
uz: Qizig'i, qayg'u, la'natlar, ko'z yoshlari butun dunyo uchun yashirin, chunki siz Marfa Petrovna emassiz.

en: And how will your mother feel then?
uz: Shunda onangiz o'zini qanday his qiladi?

en: Even now she is uneasy, she is worried, but then, when she sees it all clearly?
uz: Hatto hozir u noqulay va tashvishlangan, ammo keyin hamma narsani aniq ko'rganida nima bo'ladi?

en: Yes, indeed, what have you taken me for?
uz: Ha, aslida, nima uchun meni o'ylab ko'rdingiz?

en: I won’t have your sacrifice, Dounia, I won’t have it, mother!
uz: Men sizning qurbonligingizni qabul qilmayman, Dounia, men uni qabul qilmayman, ona!

en: It shall not be, so long as I am alive, it shall not, it shall not!
uz: Men tirik bo'lganimcha, bunday bo'lmaydi, bunday bo'lmaydi!

en: I won’t accept it!” He suddenly paused in his reflection and stood still.
uz: Men bunga rozi bo'lmayman! U birdan o'z mulohazalarida to'xtadi va to'xtadi.

en: But what are you going to do to prevent it?
uz: Ammo buning oldini olish uchun nima qilishingiz kerak?

en: And what right have you?
uz: Va sizda qanday huquq bor?

en: What can you promise them on your side to give you such a right?
uz: Sizga bunday huquq berish uchun siz ularga o'zingizning tomoningizda nima va'da bera olasiz?

en: Your whole life, your whole future, you will devote to them when you have finished your studies and obtained a post?
uz: Siz o'qishni tugatganingizda va lavozimga ega bo'lganingizda butun hayotingizni, butun kelajagingizni ularga bag'ishlaysizmi?

en: Yes, we have heard all that before, and that’s all words, but now?
uz: Ha, biz bularning barchasini ilgari eshitganmiz va bu barcha so'zlar, ammo endi?

en: Now something must be done, now, do you understand that?
uz: Endi biror narsa qilish kerak, hozir, buni tushunyapsizmi?

en: And what are you doing now?
uz: Va endi nima qilyapsan?

en: You are living upon them.
uz: Siz ular ustida yashayapsiz.

en: They borrow on their hundred roubles pension.
uz: Ular o'zlarining yuz rubllik pensiyalari bilan qarz olishadi.

en: They borrow from the Svidrigaïlovs.
uz: Ular Svidrigailovlardan qarz olishadi.

en: How are you going to save them from Svidrigaïlovs, from Afanasy Ivanovitch Vahrushin, oh, future millionaire Zeus who would arrange their lives for them?
uz: Qanday qilib siz ularni Svidrigailovlardan, Afanasiy Ivanovitch Vahrushindan, ular uchun hayotlarini tartibga soluvchi bo'lajak millioner Zevsdan qutqarasiz?

en: In another ten years?
uz: Yana o'n yildan keyinmi?

en: In another ten years, mother will be blind with knitting shawls, maybe with weeping too.
uz: Yana o'n yil ichida onam ko'r bo'lib, mayda shoul tikib, hatto yig'lab ham ko'r bo'ladi.

en: She will be worn to a shadow with fasting; and my sister?
uz: U ro'za tutish bilan soyaga aylanadi; mening singlim hammi?

en: Imagine for a moment what may have
uz: Bir zum o'ylab ko'ring, nima bo'lishi mumkin.

en: become of your sister in ten years?
uz: O'n yil ichida singlingizning o'zi bo'ladimi?

en: What may happen to her during those ten years?
uz: O'sha o'n yil ichida unga nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Can you fancy?” So he tortured himself, fretting himself with such questions, and finding a kind of enjoyment in it.
uz: O'zingizni qiynalgan, o'zini bunday savollar bilan bezovta qilgan va bulardan zavqlanayotganini tasavvur qila olasizmi?

en: And yet all these questions were not new ones suddenly confronting him, they were old familiar aches.
uz: Shunga qaramay, bu barcha savollar unga to'satdan duch kelgan yangi savollar emas edi, balki qadimgi tanish dardlar edi.

en: It was long since they had first begun to grip and rend his heart.
uz: O'sha paytdan beri ular uning qalbini o'rab, parchalab ketishmagan.

en: Long, long ago his present anguish had its first beginnings; it had waxed and gathered strength, it had matured and concentrated, until it had taken the form of a fearful, frenzied and fantastic question, which tortured his heart and mind, clamouring insistently for an answer.
uz: Ko'p vaqtlar oldin uning hozirgi qayg'usi birinchi bosqichiga ega edi; u o'sib borgan va kuch topgan, o'sib borgan va zichlangan, hatto qo'rqinchli, g'alati va ajoyib savol shakliga kirgunga qadar, uning yuragi va ongini qiynagan va javob so'rash uchun qattiq qayg'urgan.

en: Now his mother’s letter had burst on him like a thunderclap.
uz: Endi onasining maktubi unga to'qnashganday burildi.

en: It was clear that he must not now suffer passively, worrying himself over unsolved questions, but that he must do something, do it at once, and do it quickly.
uz: Endi u hal qilinmagan savollar uchun tashvishlanib, passiv azob chekmasligi kerakligi aniq edi, aksincha, u tezda va darhol biror narsa qilishi kerakligi aniq edi.

en: Anyway he must decide on something, or else … “Or throw up life altogether!” he cried suddenly, in a frenzy —“accept one’s lot humbly as it is, once for all and stifle everything in oneself, giving up all claim to activity, life and love!” “Do you understand, sir, do you understand what it means when you have absolutely nowhere to turn?” Marmeladov’s question came suddenly into his mind, “for every man must have somewhere to turn.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u biror narsaga qaror qilishi kerak, yoki... Yoki butunlay hayotni tashlashi kerak! u to'satdan, g'azabda, birdan bir marta kamtarinlik bilan o'z taqdirini qabul qilib, o'z ichidagi hamma narsani o'zi bilan bog'lab, faoliyat, hayot va sevgiga bo'lgan barcha huquqlardan voz kechadi! Siz tushunasizmi, xonim, siz hech qanday joyga bormayotganingizda nimani anglatishini tushunasizmi? Marmeladovning so'rovi to'satdan uning ongiga keldi, chunki har bir odamning bir joyida bo'lishi kerak.

en: …” He gave a sudden start; another thought, that he had had yesterday, slipped back into his mind.
uz: ... U to'satdan boshladi; kecha o'tkazgan boshqa bir fikr uning ongiga qaytdi.

en: But he did not start at the thought recurring to him, for he knew, he had felt beforehand, that it must come back, he was expecting it; besides it was not only yesterday’s thought.
uz: Ammo u o'ziga takrorlanayotgan fikrdan boshlanmadi, chunki u bilgan, oldindan his qilgan, u qaytib kelishi kerakligini, uni kutganini bilgan; bundan tashqari, u faqat kechalik fikr emas edi.

en: The difference was that a month ago, yesterday even, the thought was a mere dream: but now … now it appeared not a dream at all, it had taken a new menacing and quite unfamiliar shape, and he suddenly became aware of this himself.
uz: Farqi shundaki, bir oy oldin, hatto kecha, bu fikr shunchaki orzu edi: lekin endi ... endi bu umuman orzu emas edi, u yangi qo'rqinchli va o'zgacha shaklga ega bo'ldi va u to'satdan buni o'zi tushundi.

en: … He felt a hammering in his head, and there was a darkness before his eyes.
uz: U boshida bir martalani his qildi va ko'zlari oldida qorong'ilik bor edi.

en: He looked round hurriedly, he was searching for something.
uz: U tezda atrofini ko'rib, biror narsani qidirib topdi.

en: He wanted to sit down and was looking for a seat; he was walking along the K — — Boulevard.
uz: U o'tirishni xohlagan va o'tirishni qidirayotgan edi; u K   Boulevard bo'ylab yurgan edi.

en: There was a seat about a hundred paces in front of him.
uz: Uning oldidagi o'rinni taxminan yuz qadam oldinda ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: He walked towards it as fast he could; but on the way he met with a little adventure which absorbed all his attention.
uz: U imkon qadar tezroq unga yaqinlashdi, lekin yo'lda u butun diqqatini jalb qilgan kichik bir sarguzashtga duch keldi.

en: Looking for the seat, he had noticed a woman walking some twenty paces in front of him, but at first he took no more notice of her than of other
uz: O'rinni qidirayotganda, u o'zidan yigirma qadam oldin bir ayol yurganini ko'rdi, lekin boshida u ayolga boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor bermadi

en: objects that crossed his path.
uz: Uning yo'lini kesib o'tgan narsalar.

en: It had happened to him many times going home not to notice the road by which he was going, and he was accustomed to walk like that.
uz: U ko'p marotaba uyga qaytib borganida, o'zi o'tayotgan yo'lni ko'rmay qolgan edi va u shunday yurishga odatlangan edi.

en: But there was at first sight something so strange about the woman in front of him, that gradually his attention was riveted upon her, at first reluctantly and, as it were, resentfully, and then more and more intently.
uz: Ammo birinchi qarashda uning oldidagi ayolda shunchalik g'alati narsa bor ediki, uning e'tiborini asta-sekin unga qaratdi, boshida xohlamasdan va, deganda, g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda, so'ngra yanada ko'proq diqqat bilan.

en: He felt a sudden desire to find out what it was that was so strange about the woman.
uz: Birdan u ayolda nima g'alati ekanini bilmoqchi bo'ldi.

en: In the first place, she appeared to be a girl quite young, and she was walking in the great heat bareheaded and with no parasol or gloves, waving her arms about in an absurd way.
uz: Birinchidan, u juda yosh qiz bo'lib ko'rinardi va u juda issiqlikda bosh ko'tarib, shamol yoki qo'lqopsiz yurardi, qo'llarini g'alati tarzda o'girib yurardi.

en: She had on a dress of some light silky material, but put on strangely awry, not properly hooked up, and torn open at the top of the skirt, close to the waist: a great piece was rent and hanging loose.
uz: Uning kiyimlari biroz yorug' ipak materialidan edi, ammo u g'alati qilib, to'g'ri bog'lanmagan, cho'qqisining yuqori qismida, belning yonida yirtilgan edi: katta bo'lak yirtilgan va bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lgan edi.

en: A little kerchief was flung about her bare throat, but lay slanting on one side.
uz: Uning bo'lak-bo'lak bo'ylab kichkina kirchiv tashlangan edi, ammo bir tomonda yonib turgan edi.

en: The girl was walking unsteadily, too, stumbling and staggering from side to side.
uz: Qiz ham o'z yo'l-yo'riqlarini o'zgartirmay yurib, yon-yurtdan to'sqinlik qilib, to'sqinlik qilardi.

en: She drew Raskolnikov’s whole attention at last.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u Raskolnikovning butun e'tiborini jalb qildi.

en: He overtook the girl at the seat, but, on reaching it, she dropped down on it, in the corner; she let her head sink on the back of the seat and closed her eyes, apparently in extreme exhaustion.
uz: U o'rindiqdagi qizni qo'lga oldi, lekin unga yetib borgach, u burchada uning ustiga tushib, boshini o'rindiqning orqasida quvib, ko'zlarini yumdi, ko'rinib turganidek, u nihoyatda charchagan edi.

en: Looking at her closely, he saw at once that she was completely drunk.
uz: U ayolga diqqat bilan qaraganida, u o'sha zahoti u butunlay mast ekanini ko'rdi.

en: It was a strange and shocking sight.
uz: Bu g'alati va dahshatli ko'rinish edi.

en: He could hardly believe that he was not mistaken.
uz: U noto'g'ri yo'l tutmaganligiga o'zini ishontira olmadi.

en: He saw before him the face of a quite young, fair-haired girl —sixteen, perhaps not more than fifteen, years old, pretty little face, but flushed and heavy looking and, as it were, swollen.
uz: U o'z oldida yosh, chiroyli sochli qizning yuzini ko'rdi, yoshi o'n olti, ehtimol o'n besh yoshdan oshmasligi kerak edi, juda kichik, lekin qizil va og'ir ko'rinadigan va, demak, yuvgan.

en: The girl seemed hardly to know what she was doing; she crossed one leg over the other, lifting it indecorously, and showed every sign of being unconscious that she was in the street.
uz: Qiz o'zi nima qilayotganini o'zi bilmaganidek tuyuladi; u bir oyoqni boshqa oyoqqa o'girib, uni beparvolik bilan ko'tarib, ko'chada bo'lganini ko'rsatib, befarq bo'lganining har qanday belgisini ko'rsatdi.

en: Raskolnikov did not sit down, but he felt unwilling to leave her, and stood facing her in perplexity.
uz: Raskolnikov o'tirmadi, lekin uni tashlab ketishni istamadi va uni hayronlik bilan ko'rib turardi.

en: This boulevard was never much frequented; and now, at two o’clock, in the stifling heat, it was quite deserted.
uz: Bu bulvard hech qachon ko'p odamlarga murojaat qilmagan va endi soat ikkilarda, issiqlik ostida u juda cho'zilgan edi.

en: And yet on the further side of the boulevard, about fifteen paces away, a gentleman was standing on the edge of the pavement.
uz: Ammo bulvardning boshqa tomoniga, taxminan o'n besh qadam uzoqlikda, bir gentleman piyoda bo'ylab turgan edi.

en: He, too, would apparently have liked to approach the girl with some object of his own.
uz: O'zi ham qizga o'zining biron bir ob'ekti bilan yaqinlashishni xohlagan bo'lsa kerak.

en: He, too, had probably seen her in the distance and had followed her, but found Raskolnikov in his way.
uz: U ham, ehtimol, qizni uzoqdan ko'rib, uning orqasidan ergashgan bo'lsa kerak, lekin Raskolnikovni o'z yo'lida topdi.

en: He looked angrily at him, though he tried to escape his notice, and stood impatiently biding his time, till the unwelcome man in rags should
uz: U unga g'azab bilan qaradi, ammo uning e'tiboridan qochib ketishga harakat qiladi va o'z vaqtini sabr-toqat bilan kutadi.

en: His intentions were unmistakable.
uz: Uning niyatlari aniq edi.

en: The gentleman was a plump, thickly-set man, about thirty, fashionably dressed, with a high colour, red lips and moustaches.
uz: Bu gentleman o'ttiz yoshda bo'lgan, ko'p ko'p bo'lgan, chiroyli kiyim kiygan, rangli, qizil og'iz va mustaklari bor yigit edi.

en: Raskolnikov felt furious; he had a sudden longing to insult this fat dandy in some way.
uz: Raskolnikov g'azabga to'ldi; u birdan bu yumshoq dandyni qandaydir tarzda haqoratlashni orzu qildi.

en: He left the girl for a moment and walked towards the gentleman.
uz: U qizni bir zumga qoldirib, janobning yoniga bordi.

en: What do you want here?” he shouted, clenching his fists and laughing, spluttering with rage.
uz: Bu yerda nima istaysiz? - deb baqirib, o'z yumruqlarini jamlab, g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda kulishdi.

en: “What do you mean?” the gentleman asked sternly, scowling in haughty astonishment.
uz: Siz nimani nazarda tutyapsiz? - deb so'ragan xonim qattiqqo'llik bilan, mag'rurlik bilan hayron bo'lib.

en: “Get away, that’s what I mean.” “How dare you, you low fellow!” He raised his cane.
uz: Ochib ket, shuni aytaman. Qanday jasoratga ega bo'lding, o'g'lim! U o'z tayoqini ko'tardi.

en: Raskolnikov rushed at him with his fists, without reflecting that the stout gentleman was a match for two men like himself.
uz: Raskolnikov o'zi kabi ikki kishiga mos keladigan o'g'il deb o'ylamagan holda, o'z yumushlari bilan unga shoshdi.

en: But at that instant someone seized him from behind, and a police constable stood between them.
uz: Ammo o'sha zahoti kimdir uni orqadan ushlab oldi va bir politsiya xodimi ularning orasida turdi.

en: “That’s enough, gentlemen, no fighting, please, in a public place.
uz: Bu yetarli, xonimlar, hech qanday jang qilmang, iltimos, ommaviy joyda.

en: Who are you?” he asked Raskolnikov sternly, noticing his rags.
uz: Siz kimsiz? - dedi u Raskolnikovdan qattiq so'radi va uning kiyim-kechaklarini ko'rdi.

en: Raskolnikov looked at him intently.
uz: Raskolnikov unga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: He had a straightforward, sensible, soldierly face, with grey moustaches and whiskers.
uz: U oddiy, aqlli, harbiy suratga ega bo'lib, griz mustaklari va mustaklari bor edi.

en: “You are just the man I want,” Raskolnikov cried, catching at his arm.
uz: Siz men istagan odamsiz, Raskolnikov yig'lab yubordi va qo'lidan ushlab qoldi.

en: “I am a student, Raskolnikov.
uz: Men talabaman, Raskolnikov.

en: … You may as well know that too,” he added, addressing the gentleman, “come along, I have something to show you.” And taking the policeman by the hand he drew him towards the seat.
uz: ... Siz ham buni bilishingiz mumkin, - dedi u, xudojo'y kishiga murojaat qilib, - keling, sizga ko'rsatadigan bir narsam bor. U politsionerning qo'lidan ushlab, uni o'tirishga olib keldi.

en: “Look here, hopelessly drunk, and she has just come down the boulevard.
uz: Mana ko'ringlar, u umidsizlikka mast va u bulvarddan o'tib keldi.

en: There is no telling who and what she is, she does not look like a professional.
uz: Kim va nima ekanligini aytish mumkin emas, u professional ko'rinishga ega emas.

en: It’s more likely she has been given drink and deceived somewhere … for the first time … you understand?
uz: Ehtimol, u biron bir joyda ichib, aldangan bo'lishi mumkin ... birinchi marta ... tushunasizmi?

en: and they’ve put her out into the street like that.
uz: Uni ko'chaga chiqarib qo'yishdi.

en: Look at the way her dress is torn, and the way it has been put on: she has been dressed by somebody, she has not dressed herself, and dressed by unpractised hands, by a man’s hands; that’s evident.
uz: Uning kiyimlari qanday yirtilgan va kiyinilganligiga e'tibor bering: u kimnidir kiyib olgan, o'zini kiyib olgan emas, balki mashq qilinmagan qo'llar, erkak qo'llari bilan kiyib olgan; bu aniq.

en: And now look there: I don’t know that dandy with whom I was going to fight, I see him for the first time, but he, too, has seen her on the road, just now, drunk, not knowing what she is doing, and now he is very eager to get hold of
uz: Endi esa qaranglar: men jangga borgan o'sha dandyni bilmayman, men uni birinchi marta ko'ryapman, lekin u ham uni yo'lda ko'rgan, hozirgina mast, nima qilayotganini bilmay, o'zi ham uni qo'lga olishni juda istaydi.

en: her, to get her away somewhere while she is in this state … that’s certain, believe me, I am not wrong.
uz: U shunday holatda bo'lganida, uni qayerga olib ketish uchun... shubhasiz, ishoning, men noto'g'ri yo'l tutmayman.

en: I saw him myself watching her and following her, but I prevented him, and he is just waiting for me to go away.
uz: O'zim uni kuzatib, uning orqasidan ergashayotganini ko'rdim, lekin men unga to'sqinlik qildim va u mening ketishimni kutmoqda.

en: Now he has walked away a little, and is standing still, pretending to make a cigarette.
uz: Endi u biroz ketib ketdi va to'xtab turadi va sigaret tayyorlab qo'yganini ko'rsatadi.

en: … Think how can we keep her out of his hands, and how are we to get her home?” The policeman saw it all in a flash.
uz: ... Qanday qilib uni qo'lidan olib qo'yishimiz mumkinligini va uni uyga qaytarib olishimiz mumkinligini o'ylab ko'ring? Politsiyachi hamma narsani bir lahzada ko'rdi.

en: The stout gentleman was easy to understand, he turned to consider the girl.
uz: Jigarbandni tushunish oson edi, u qizni ko'rib chiqish uchun o'zini yuvdi.

en: The policeman bent over to examine her more closely, and his face worked with genuine compassion.
uz: Politsiya xodimi qizni ko'proq ko'rib chiqish uchun egildi va uning yuzi samimiy rahm-shafqat bilan ishora qildi.

en: “Ah, what a pity!” he said, shaking his head —“why, she is quite a child!
uz: U boshini silkitib dedi: "Nega, u juda yosh bola!

en: She has been deceived, you can see that at once.
uz: U aldangan, siz buni darhol ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: Listen, lady,” he began addressing her, “where do you live?” The girl opened her weary and sleepy-looking eyes, gazed blankly at the speaker and waved her hand.
uz: Xonim, quloq soling, u unga murojaat qila boshladi, qayerda yashasangiz? Qiz charchagan va uxlab ko'rinadigan ko'zlarini ochdi, gapiruvchiga ko'z tikdi va qo'lini yumdi.

en: “Here,” said Raskolnikov feeling in his pocket and finding twenty kopecks, “here, call a cab and tell him to drive her to her address.
uz: Raskolnikovning aytishicha, bu yerda o'z joniga tushib, yigirma kopekni topib, bir taksiga chaqirib, uni uning manziliga olib borishini aytadi.

en: The only thing is to find out her address!” “Missy, missy!” the policeman began again, taking the money.
uz: Faqat uning manzilini topish kerak!Missy, missy! Politsiyachi yana pulni olib, boshini ochdi.

en: “I’ll fetch you a cab and take you home myself.
uz: Men o'zim taksi olib kelib, sizni uyingizga olib ketaman.

en: Where shall I take you, eh?
uz: Sizlarni qayerga olib borishim kerak?

en: Where do you live?” “Go away!
uz: Qayerda yashasangiz?Ochib ketinglar!

en: They won’t let me alone,” the girl muttered, and once more waved her hand.
uz: Ular meni yolg'iz qo'ymaydilar, - deb gapirgan qiz yana bir bor qo'lini ko'tardi.

en: “Ach, ach, how shocking!
uz: Ach, ach, naqadar dahshatli!

en: It’s shameful, missy, it’s a shame!” He shook his head again, shocked, sympathetic and indignant.
uz: Bu o'ta sharmandalikdir, xotinim, bu o'ta sharmandalikdir! U yana boshini silkitdi, hayron, hamdard va g'azabga to'ldi.

en: “It’s a difficult job,” the policeman said to Raskolnikov, and as he did so, he looked him up and down in a rapid glance.
uz: "Bu qiyin ish", - dedi politsiyachi Raskolnikovga, va u shunday qilganda, uni tezda ko'rib turdi.

en: He, too, must have seemed a strange figure to him: dressed in rags and handing him money!
uz: U ham unga g'ayritabiiy qiyofaga o'xshashi kerak edi: kiyim-kechak kiygan va unga pul uzatgan!

en: “Did you meet her far from here?” he asked him.
uz: Undan uzoqdan uchrashganmisiz? - deb so'radi.

en: “I tell you she was walking in front of me, staggering, just here, in the boulevard.
uz: Men sizga aytamanki, u oldimda yurgan edi, bu erda, bulvardda.

en: She only just reached the seat and sank down on it.” “Ah, the shameful things that are done in the world nowadays, God have mercy on us!
uz: U faqatgina o'rinishga yetib, uning ustiga qulab tushdi.Ah, bugun dunyoda sodir bo'layotgan sharmandaliklar, Xudo bizga rahm qilsin!

en: An innocent creature like that, drunk already!
uz: Bunday aybsiz mavjudot allaqachon mast bo'lgan!

en: She has been deceived, that’s a sure thing.
uz: U aldangan, shubhasiz.

en: See how her dress has been torn too.
uz: Uning kiyimi ham qanday yirtilganini ko'ring.

en: … Ah, the vice one sees nowadays!
uz: Ah, hozirgi paytda bir nafar vitse-prezident ko'radi!

en: And as likely as not she belongs to gentlefolk too, poor ones maybe.
uz: Va ehtimol, u ham gentlefolk, kambag'al kishilarga tegishli emas.

en: many like that nowadays.
uz: Bugungi kunda ko'pchilik shunday.

en: She looks refined, too, as though she were a lady,” and he bent over her once more.
uz: U ham rafiqat ko'rinadi, xuddi bir ayol kabi, va u yana bir bor uning ustidan egildi.

en: Perhaps he had daughters growing up like that, “looking like ladies and refined” with pretensions to gentility and smartness.
uz: Ehtimol, uning qizlari shunday o'sib-e'sgan, ayollarga o'xshaydigan va mehribonlik va aqllilikka o'xshaydigan qizlari bor edi.

en: … “The chief thing is,” Raskolnikov persisted, “to keep her out of this scoundrel’s hands!
uz: Asosiysi,  Raskolnikov davom etdi,  uni bu qotilning qo'lidan saqlab qolish uchun!

en: Why should he outrage her!
uz: Nima uchun u uni xafa qilishi kerak!

en: It’s as clear as day what he is after; ah, the brute, he is not moving off!” Raskolnikov spoke aloud and pointed to him.
uz: U nima orqasidan ketayotganini kunduzday aniq ko'rish mumkin; ah, vahshiy, u ketmayapti! Raskolnikov baland ovoz bilan gapirib, unga ishora qildi.

en: The gentleman heard him, and seemed about to fly into a rage again, but thought better of it, and confined himself to a contemptuous look.
uz: Jentelman uni eshitib, yana g'azabga uchib ketayotganga o'xshaydi, lekin o'ylab ko'radi va o'zini kamsitadigan ko'rinishga cheklaydi.

en: He then walked slowly another ten paces away and again halted.
uz: So'ngra yana o'n qadam uzoqlashdi va yana to'xtadi.

en: “Keep her out of his hands we can,” said the constable thoughtfully, “if only she’d tell us where to take her, but as it is.
uz: Uni qo'lidan olib ketmasligimiz mumkin, - dedi politsiya boshlig'i, - agar u bizga uni qayerga olib ketish kerakligini aytsa edi, lekin shunday bo'ladi.

en: … Missy, hey, missy!” he bent over her once more.
uz: ... Missy, hey, missy! u yana bir bor uning ustidan egildi.

en: She opened her eyes fully all of a sudden, looked at him intently, as though realising something, got up from the seat and walked away in the direction from which she had come.
uz: Birdan ko'zlarini to'liq ochdi, unga diqqat bilan qaradi, xuddi biror narsani anglab yetgandek, o'rindiqdan turib, qayerdan kelganini ko'rib ketdi.

en: “Oh shameful wretches, they won’t let me alone!” she said, waving her hand again.
uz: Ey, ayblangan kambag'allar, ular meni yolg'iz qo'ymaydilar! dedi u, yana qo'lini urib.

en: She walked quickly, though staggering as before.
uz: U tez yurdi, lekin avvalgidek hayratda qoldirgan.

en: The dandy followed her, but along another avenue, keeping his eye on her.
uz: Dandy ayolga ergashib, lekin boshqa yo'l bo'ylab, uning ko'z-ko'zidan o'tib ketmadi.

en: “Don’t be anxious, I won’t let him have her,” the policeman said resolutely, and he set off after them.
uz: "Xavotir olmanglar, men unga uni olishlariga yo'l qo'ymayman", - dedi politsiya boshlig'i qat'iy qaror qilib, ularning orqasidan ergashib ketdi.

en: “Ah, the vice one sees nowadays!” he repeated aloud, sighing.
uz: Ah, bugungi kunda bir nozir ko'radi! u baland ovoz bilan ta'kidlab o'tdi, nafratlanmoqda.

en: At that moment something seemed to sting Raskolnikov; in an instant a complete revulsion of feeling came over him.
uz: O'sha paytda Raskolnikovni biror narsa urib qo'yganiga o'xshardi; bir lahzada u o'ziga to'liq nafratlanib qoldi.

en: “Hey, here!” he shouted after the policeman.
uz: Hey, bu erda! u politsiyachining orqasidan qichqirdi.

en: The latter turned round.
uz: Keyinchalik u aylanib chiqdi.

en: What is it to do with you?
uz: Bu sizga qanday aloqasi bor?

en: Let him amuse himself.” He pointed at the dandy, “What is it to do with you?” The policeman was bewildered, and stared at him open-eyed.
uz: O'zini o'yin qilsin. U dandyga ishora qildi, Bu sizga nima bog'liq? Politsiya boshlig'i g'alati bo'lib, unga ko'z ochgan holda qaradi.

en: Raskolnikov laughed.
uz: Raskolnikov kuldi.

en: “Well!” ejaculated the policeman, with a gesture of contempt, and he walked after the dandy and the girl, probably taking Raskolnikov for a madman or something even worse.
uz: Ha! politsiyachini pastga surib tashladi va u Dandy va qizning orqasidan yurdi, ehtimol Raskolnikovni aqldan ozgan yoki bundan ham yomonroq deb o'ylagan.

en: “He has carried off my twenty kopecks,” Raskolnikov murmured angrily when he was left alone.
uz: U mening yigirma kopekimni olib ketdi, Raskolnikov o'zi yolg'iz qolganda g'azabda g'ayrat bilan gapirdi.

en: “Well, let him take as much from the other fellow to allow him to have the girl and so let it end.
uz: Ha, keling, u boshqa yigitdan qizga ega bo'lish uchun imkon qadar ko'proq narsani olsin va shu bilan yakunlansin.

en: did I want to interfere?
uz: Men aralashmoqchi bo'ldimmi?

en: Is it for me to help?
uz: Menga yordam berish kerakmi?

en: Have I any right to help?
uz: Men yordam berishga haqlimanmi?

en: Let them devour each other alive —what is to me?
uz: Ular bir-birlarini tirik yutib yuborsinlar.Men uchun nima kerak?

en: How did I dare to give him twenty kopecks?
uz: Qanday qilib unga yigirma kopek berishga jur'at qildim?

en: Were they mine?” In spite of those strange words he felt very wretched.
uz: Ular meningki edi? O'sha g'alati so'zlarga qaramay, u o'zini juda baxtsiz his qildi.

en: He sat down on the deserted seat.
uz: O'zi bo'sh o'rindiqga o'tirdi.

en: His thoughts strayed aimlessly.
uz: Uning fikrlari maqsadsiz yo'ldan ozdi.

en: … He found it hard to fix his mind on anything at that moment.
uz: U o'sha paytda biror narsa haqida fikr yuritishni qiyin deb topdi.

en: He longed to forget himself altogether, to forget everything, and then to wake up and begin life anew.
uz: U o'zini butunlay unutishni, hamma narsani unutishni va keyin uyg'onib, hayotni yangidan boshlashni orzu qilardi.

en: … “Poor girl!” he said, looking at the empty corner where she had sat —“She will come to herself and weep, and then her mother will find out.
uz: "Yomon qiz!" - dedi u, o'tirgan bo'sh burchasiga qarab. - U o'ziga kelib yig'laydi, keyin onasi buni bilib oladi.

en: … She will give her a beating, a horrible, shameful beating and then maybe, turn her out of doors.
uz: ... U unga urib, dahshatli, sharmanda urib, keyin, ehtimol, uni eshikdan haydab yuboradi.

en: … And even if she does not, the Darya Frantsovnas will get wind of it, and the girl will soon be slipping out on the sly here and there.
uz: Va hatto bunday qilmasa ham, Darya Frantsovnaslar buni bilib olishadi va qiz tez orada bu yerda-bu yerda g'ayritabiiy tarzda chiqib ketadi.

en: Then there will be the hospital directly (that’s always the luck of those girls with respectable mothers, who go wrong on the sly) and then … again the hospital … drink … the taverns … and more hospital, in two or three years —a wreck, and her life over at eighteen or nineteen.
uz: Keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kasalxona bo'ladi (bu har doim yaxshi onalarga ega bo'lgan qizlarning omadidir) va keyin ... yana kasalxona ... ichimlik ... tavernalar ... va yana kasalxona, ikki yoki uch yil ichida a qirg'in, va uning hayoti o'n sakkiz yoki o'n to'qqiz yoshda tugadi.

en: … Have not I seen cases like that?
uz: Men bunday holatlarni ko'rmadimmi?

en: And how have they been brought to it?
uz: Va ularga qanday erishildi?

en: Why, they’ve all come to it like that.
uz: Axir, ular hammasi shunday fikrga kelishgan-ku.

en: But what does it matter?
uz: Ammo bu qanday ahamiyatga ega?

en: That’s as it should be, they tell us.
uz: Ular bizga shunday bo'lishi kerakligini aytishadi.

en: A certain percentage, they tell us, must every year go … that way … to the devil, I suppose, so that the rest may remain chaste, and not be interfered with.
uz: Bizga aytilishicha, har yili muayyan foiz... shunga o'xshab... shaytonga ketishi kerak, deb o'ylayman, toki qolgan qismi pok qolsin va unga hech kim aralashmasin.

en: What splendid words they have; they are so scientific, so consolatory.
uz: Ularning so'zlari naqadar ajoyib; ular juda ilmiy va tasalli beruvchi.

en: … Once you’ve said ‘percentage’ there’s nothing more to worry about.
uz: ... Agar siz percentage degan bo'lsangiz, endi tashvishlanishingiz kerak bo'lgan hech narsa yo'q.

en: If we had any other word … maybe we might feel more uneasy.
uz: Agar boshqa so'z bo'lganida ... ehtimol biz o'zimizni yanada noqulay his qilishimiz mumkin.

en: … But what if Dounia were one of the percentage!
uz: Ammo agar Dounia bu foizlardan biri bo'lganida nima bo'lar edi?

en: Of another one if not that one?
uz: Boshqa biridan, agar bulardan bo'lmasa?

en: “But where am I going?” he thought suddenly.
uz: Ammo men qayerga ketyapman? deb o'yladi.

en: “Strange, I came out for something.
uz: O'zgacha, men biror narsa uchun chiqdim.

en: As soon as I had read the letter I came out.
uz: Men maktubni o'qib bo'lgandan so'ng, tashqariga chiqdim.

en: … I was going to Vassilyevsky Ostrov, to Razumihin.
uz: Men Vassilyevskiy Ostrovga, Razumihinga ketayotgan edim.

en: That’s what it was … now I remember.
uz: O'sha narsa edi... endi eslayman.

en: And what put the idea of going to Razumihin into my head just now?
uz: Va hozir Razumihinga borish g'oyasi boshimga nima tushdi?

en: That’s curious.” He wondered at himself.
uz: Bu g'alati.U o'z-o'ziga savol berdi.

en: Razumihin was one of his old comrades at the university.
uz: Razumihin universitetdagi eski hamkasblaridan biri edi.

en: It was remarkable that Raskolnikov had hardly any friends at the university; he kept aloof from everyone, went to see no one, and did not welcome anyone who came to see him, and indeed
uz: Raskolnikovning universitetda deyarli do'stlari yo'qligi diqqatga sazovor edi; u hamma odamlardan uzoqlashardi, hech kimni ko'rishga bormagan va uni ko'rishga kelganlarni qabul qilmagan.

en: everyone soon gave him up.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay hamma unga qarshi chiqdi.

en: He took no part in the students’ gatherings, amusements or conversations.
uz: U talabalar yig'ilishlarida, o'yin-kulgilarda yoki suhbatlarda ishtirok etmadi.

en: He worked with great intensity without sparing himself, and he was respected for this, but no one liked him.
uz: U o'zini o'zi xotirjam tutmasdan, katta kuch bilan mehnat qilardi va buning uchun hurmatga sazovor edi, ammo hech kim uni yoqtirmadi.

en: He was very poor, and there was a sort of haughty pride and reserve about him, as though he were keeping something to himself.
uz: U juda kambag'al edi va atrofida xuddi o'zi uchun biror narsa saqlab qolganidek, mag'rurlik va o'zidan qo'rqish paydo bo'lgan.

en: He seemed to some of his comrades to look down upon them all as children, as though he were superior in development, knowledge and convictions, as though their beliefs and interests were beneath him.
uz: U ba'zi tengdoshlariga ularning barchasini bola deb pastga surib, rivojlanish, bilim va e'tiqodlarida ustun bo'lib, e'tiqodlari va manfaatlari undan past bo'lganidek ko'rinardi.

en: With Razumihin he had got on, or, at least, he was more unreserved and communicative with him.
uz: Razumihin bilan u yaxshi munosabatda edi yoki hech bo'lmaganda, u u bilan ko'proq muloqot qila boshladi.

en: Indeed it was impossible to be on any other terms with Razumihin.
uz: Darhaqiqat, Razumihin bilan boshqa shart-sharoitlarda bo'lish imkonsiz edi.

en: He was an exceptionally good-humoured and candid youth, good-natured to the point of simplicity, though both depth and dignity lay concealed under that simplicity.
uz: U o'zgacha xushmuomala va ochiq yosh edi, soddalikkacha xushmuomala edi, garchi soddalik ostida chuqurlik ham, qadr-qimmat ham yashiringan bo'lsa-da.

en: The better of his comrades understood this, and all were fond of him.
uz: Uning eng yaxshi hamkasblari buni tushunib, hammaga yoqdi.

en: He was extremely intelligent, though he was certainly rather a simpleton at times.
uz: U juda aqlli edi, ammo ba'zan oddiy inson bo'lgan.

en: He was of striking appearance —tall, thin, black-haired and always badly shaved.
uz: U ko'rinishda ko'p bo'lgan, uzun, chiroyli, qora sochli va doim yomon shavqlangan.

en: He was sometimes uproarious and was reputed to be of great physical strength.
uz: U ba'zan g'alati bo'lib, kuchli jismoniy kuchga ega bo'lgan.

en: One night, when out in a festive company, he had with one blow laid a gigantic policeman on his back.
uz: Bir kecha, bayramga borganida, u bitta cho'qqiz bilan katta politsiyachini orqaga qo'ydi.

en: There was no limit to his drinking powers, but he could abstain from drink altogether; he sometimes went too far in his pranks; but he could do without pranks altogether.
uz: Uning ichimlik qobiliyati cheklangan emas edi, lekin u ichishdan umuman voz kechishi mumkin edi; ba'zan u o'z mashg'ulotlarida haddan tashqari ketardi; lekin u o'z mashg'ulotlaridan umuman voz kechishi mumkin edi.

en: Another thing striking about Razumihin, no failure distressed him, and it seemed as though no unfavourable circumstances could crush him.
uz: Razumihinning yana bir diqqatga sazovor joyi shundaki, u hech qanday muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan bezovta bo'lmagan va hech qanday yomon sharoit uni ezishga qodir bo'lmagan.

en: He could lodge anywhere, and bear the extremes of cold and hunger.
uz: U istalgan joyda yashashi mumkin edi va sovuq va ochlikdan azob chekishi mumkin edi.

en: He was very poor, and kept himself entirely on what he could earn by work of one sort or another.
uz: U juda kambag'al bo'lib, o'zini butunlay o'zi bir xil ish bilan topishi mumkin bo'lgan narsasiga bag'ishlagan.

en: He knew of no end of resources by which to earn money.
uz: U pul topish uchun cheksiz manbalarni bilgan.

en: He spent one whole winter without lighting his stove, and used to declare that he liked it better, because one slept more soundly in the cold.
uz: U butun qishni cho'g'ini yoqtirmasdan o'tkazgan va o'zini yaxshi ko'rganini aytadigan bo'lgan, chunki sovuqdan ko'proq uxlagan.

en: For the present he, too, had been obliged to give up the university, but it was only for a time, and he was working with all his might to save enough to return to his studies again.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda u ham universitetni tashlab ketishga majbur bo'lgan, lekin bu faqat bir muddatga bo'lgan va u o'z o'quvlariga qaytish uchun etarlicha mablag'ni tejash uchun butun kuchini sarflagan.

en: Raskolnikov had not been to see him for the last four months, and Razumihin did not even know his address.
uz: Raskolnikov uni to'rt oydan beri ko'rmagan edi va Razumihin uning manzilini ham bilmagan edi.

en: About two months before, they had met in the street, but Raskolnikov had turned away and even crossed to the other side that he might not be observed.
uz: Taxminan ikki oy oldin ular ko'chada uchrashgan edilar, lekin Raskolnikov uni ko'rmasliklari uchun yuz o'girib, hatto boshqa tomonga o'tib ketdi.

en: And though Razumihin noticed him, he passed him by, as he did not want to annoy him.
uz: Razumihin uni ko'rgan bo'lsa-da, uni xafa qilmoqchi bo'lmagan holda o'tib o'tdi.

en: V “Of course, I’ve been meaning lately to go to Razumihin’s to ask for work, to ask him to get me lessons or something …” Raskolnikov thought, “but what help can he be to me now?
uz: Albatta, men so'nggi paytlarda Razumihinning oldiga borib ish so'rashni, menga dars yoki boshqa narsa berishni so'rashni rejalashtirganman... Raskolnikov o'yladi, lekin u menga hozir qanday yordam berishi mumkin?

en: Suppose he gets me lessons, suppose he shares his last farthing with me, if he has any farthings, so that I could get some boots and make myself tidy enough to give lessons … hm … Well and what then?
uz: Ayting-chi, u menga darslar beradi, agar u bilan so'nggi farthingini baham ko'rsa, agar u bilan farthing bo'lsa, unda men bir nechta poyabzal sotib olib, darslar berishga tayyor bo'lishim uchun o'zimni to'g'ri tuzataman... hmm... Xo'sh, nima bo'ladi?

en: What shall I do with the few coppers I earn?
uz: O'zim kasb etayotgan bir necha pul pul bilan nima qilaman?

en: That’s not what I want now.
uz: Hozir men bunday qilishni xohlamayman.

en: It’s really absurd for me to go to Razumihin.
uz: Mening uchun Razumihin shahriga borish juda absurd.

en: …” The question why he was now going to Razumihin agitated him even more than he was himself aware; he kept uneasily seeking for some sinister significance in this apparently ordinary action.
uz: ... Nima uchun u endi Razumihinga borayotganini bilish uni o'zi bilmaganidan ham ko'proq xavotirga solgan; u bu oddiy ko'rinadigan harakatda qandaydir dahshatli ahamiyatga ega bo'lish uchun tashvish bilan izlanishni davom ettirgan.

en: “Could I have expected to set it all straight and to find a way out by means of Razumihin alone?” he asked himself in perplexity.
uz: Men hamma narsani to'g'rilash va yolg'iz Razumihin yordamida chiqish yo'lini topishimni kutardimmi? deb o'ziga savol berdi u hayajonda.

en: He pondered and rubbed his forehead, and, strange to say, after long musing, suddenly, as if it were spontaneously and by chance, a fantastic thought came into his head.
uz: U mulohaza yuritib, peshanasini aralashtirdi va, g'alati qilib aytganda, ko'p vaqt o'ylab ko'rganidan so'ng, to'satdan, xuddi o'z-o'zidan va tasodifan bo'lgani kabi, uning boshiga ajoyib bir fikr keldi.

en: “Hm … to Razumihin’s,” he said all at once, calmly, as though he had reached a final determination.
uz: Hm ... Razumihinsga, u hamma narsani bir lahzada, xotirjamlik bilan aytdi, xuddi oxirgi qarorga kelganidek.

en: “I shall go to Razumihin’s of course, but … not now.
uz: Albatta, Razumihinlarga boraman, lekin hozir emas.

en: I shall go to him … on the next day after It, when It will be over and everything will begin afresh.
uz: Men uning oldiga boraman ... ertasi kuni, U tugaganida va hamma narsa yangidan boshlanganida.

en: …” And suddenly he realised what he was thinking.
uz: ... Va to'satdan o'zi nima o'ylayotganini angladi.

en: “After It,” he shouted, jumping up from the seat, “but is It really going to happen?
uz: After It, u qichqirdi, o'rindiqdan sakrab o'tadi,  lekin bu haqiqatan ham sodir bo'ladimi?

en: Is it possible it really will happen?” He left the seat, and went off almost at a run; he meant to turn back, homewards, but the thought of going home suddenly filled him with intense loathing; in that hole, in that awful little cupboard of his, all this had for a month past been growing up in him; and he walked on at random.
uz: Haqiqatan ham bo'lishi mumkinmi? U o'rinni tark etib, deyarli yugurib ketdi; uyiga qaytib borishni xohlagan, lekin uyiga qaytish haqidagi fikr birdan uni qattiq nafratga to'ldirgan; o'sha cho'lda, uning qo'rqinchli kichik omborida, bularning barchasi o'tgan bir oy davomida uning ichida o'sib borgan edi; va u tasodifan davom etdi.

en: His nervous shudder had passed into a fever that made him feel shivering; in spite of the heat he felt cold.
uz: Uning g'azabli titrashuvi o'tib, o'zini titrayotgandek his qiladigan issiqlikka aylandi; issiqlikka qaramay, u sovuq his qildi.

en: With a kind of effort he began almost unconsciously, from some inner craving, to stare at all the objects before him, as though looking for something to distract his attention; but he did not succeed, and kept dropping every moment into brooding.
uz: O'zicha harakat qilib, u o'zidan-o'zi, ichki istakdan kelib, diqqatini chalg'itadigan narsani qidirib topayotgandek, oldidagi barcha narsalarga qaray boshladi; lekin u muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan va har bir daqiqani o'ylab ko'rishni davom ettirgan.

en: When with a start he lifted his head again and looked round, he forgot at once what he had just been thinking about and even where he was going.
uz: Boshlanishda yana boshini ko'tarib, atrofini ko'rganida, u o'zi o'ylayotgan narsani va hatto qayerga borayotganini darhol unutib qo'ydi.

en: In this way he walked right across Vassilyevsky Ostrov, came out on to the Lesser Neva, crossed the bridge and turned towards the islands.
