uz: Shu yo'l bilan u Vassilyevskiy Ostrovni to'g'ri bosib o'tdi, kichik Nevaga chiqdi, ko'prikni kesib o'tdi va orollarga qarab ketdi.

en: The greenness and freshness were at first restful to his weary eyes after the dust of the town and the huge houses that hemmed him in and weighed upon him.
uz: O'sha yashillik va yangilik dastlab uning charchagan ko'zlari uchun shaharning tuproqidan va uni o'rab olgan va uning ustiga og'irlik ko'rsatgan ulkan uylardan so'ng tinchlik keltirardi.

en: Here there were no taverns, no stifling closeness, no stench.
uz: Bu yerda hech qanday mehmonxonalar yo'q edi, o'tkir yaqinlik yo'q edi, hech qanday kir yo'q edi.

en: But soon these new pleasant sensations passed into morbid irritability.
uz: Ammo tez orada bu yangi yoqimli his-tuyg'ular kasallik bilan bezovta bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Sometimes he stood still before a brightly painted summer villa standing among green foliage, he gazed through the fence, he saw in the distance smartly dressed women on the verandahs and balconies, and children running in the gardens.
uz: Ba'zan u yashil yaproqlar o'rtasida turgan, yorqin bo'lgan yozgi villa oldida to'xtamay turgan, to'siqdan ko'z ochgan, uzoqdan verandalar va balkonlarda chiroyli kiyim kiygan ayollar va bog'larda yugurayotgan bolalar ko'rinardi.

en: The flowers especially caught his attention; he gazed at them longer than at anything.
uz: Ayniqsa, gullar uning e'tiborini jalb qildi; u ularga boshqa narsalarga qaraganda ko'proq qaradi.

en: He was met, too, by luxurious carriages and by men and women on horseback; he watched them with curious eyes and forgot about them before they had vanished from his sight.
uz: Shuningdek, uni hashamatli aravalar va otda yurgan erkak va ayollar kutib olishdi; u ularni qiziqarli ko'zlar bilan kuzatib, ular uning ko'zidan yo'qolishdan oldin unutib qo'ydi.

en: Once he stood still and counted his money; he found he had thirty kopecks.
uz: Bir marta u to'xtamay pulini hisoblab chiqdi va o'ttiz kopek pulini topdi.

en: “Twenty to the policeman, three to Nastasya for the letter, so I must have given forty-seven or fifty to the Marmeladovs yesterday,” he thought, reckoning it up for some unknown reason, but he soon forgot with what object he had taken the money out of his pocket.
uz: Polisga yigirma, xat uchun Nastasyaga uchta, shuning uchun men kecha Marmeladovlar oilasiga qirq yetti yoki ellik dollar bergan bo'lardim, deb o'yladi u, noma'lum sabablarga ko'ra hisob-kitob qilib, lekin tez orada qaysi asbob bilan pulni qopidan chiqarib olganini unutib qo'ydi.

en: He recalled it on passing an eating-house or tavern, and felt that he was hungry.
uz: U ovqatlanuvchi uy yoki mehmonxonadan o'tib ketayotganini esladi va o'zini och his qildi.

en: … Going into the tavern he drank a glass of vodka and ate a pie of some sort.
uz: ... Tavernga kirib, bir stakan vodka ichdi va bir turdagi tortni yedi.

en: He finished eating it as he walked away.
uz: U ketayotganda uni yeb-ichib yubordi.

en: It was a long while since he had taken vodka and it had an effect upon him at once, though he only drank a wineglassful.
uz: U vodka ichganidan ko'p vaqt o'tgan va u unga darhol ta'sir ko'rsatgan, garchi u faqatgina bir shisha sharob ichgan bo'lsa ham.

en: His legs felt suddenly heavy and a great drowsiness came upon him.
uz: Uning oyoqlari birdan og'ir bo'lib qoldi va u o'ziga katta uyquslikni boshdan kechirdi.

en: He turned homewards, but reaching Petrovsky Ostrov he stopped completely exhausted, turned off the road into the bushes, sank down upon the grass and instantly fell asleep.
uz: U uyga qaytib ketdi, lekin Petrovskiy Ostrovga yetib borgach, u butunlay charchagan holda to'xtadi, yo'lni butalarga o'tkazdi, o'tlar ustida cho'kib ketdi va darhol uxladi.

en: In a morbid condition of the brain, dreams often have a singular actuality, vividness, and extraordinary semblance of reality.
uz: Miyaning kasal bo'lgan holatida, tushlar ko'pincha o'ziga xos haqiqatga, jonlilikka va o'ziga xos haqiqatga o'xshaydi.

en: At times monstrous images are created, but the setting and the whole picture are so truth-like and filled with details so delicate, so unexpectedly, but so artistically consistent, that the dreamer, were he an artist like Pushkin or Turgenev even, could never have invented them in the waking state.
uz: Ba'zan dahshatli tasvirlar yaratilgan, ammo muhit va butun rasm juda haqiqatga o'xshaydi va tafsilotlar bilan to'lib-toshadi, shu qadar nozik, kutilmagan, ammo san'at jihatidan barqarorki, orzu qiluvchi, hatto Puşkin yoki Turgenev kabi rassom bo'lganda ham, ularni uyg'onishda hech qachon yaratolmagan.

en: Such sick dreams always remain long in the memory and make a powerful impression on the overwrought and deranged nervous system.
uz: Bunday kasal tushlar xotira ichida uzoq vaqt qoladi va ortiqcha bosim va aqldan ozgan asabiy tizimga kuchli taassurot qoldiradi.

en: Raskolnikov had a fearful dream.
uz: Raskolnikov dahshatli tush ko'rdi.

en: He dreamt he was back in his childhood in the little town of his birth.
uz: U tug'ilgan kichkina shaharchasida bolaligida qaytib kelganini orzu qilardi.

en: He was a child about seven years old, walking into the country with his father on the evening of a holiday.
uz: U taxminan yetti yoshli bola edi va bayram kuni kechqurun otasi bilan qishloqqa borar edi.

en: It was a grey and heavy day, the country was exactly as he remembered it; indeed he recalled it far more vividly in his dream than he had done in memory.
uz: Bu oq va og'ir kun edi, mamlakat xuddi u eslaganidek edi; haqiqatan ham, u tushida eslaganidan ko'ra ko'proq narsani esladi.

en: The little town stood on a level flat as bare as the hand, not even a willow near it; only in the far distance, a copse lay, a dark blur on the very edge of the horizon.
uz: Kichik shaharcha o'z qo'licha tekis bo'lgan, tekis bo'lgan, tekis bo'lmagan tekis joyda turardi; faqat uzoq masofalarda ko'rinishsiz, qorong'u ko'rinishsiz bo'lib, ko'rinishning chegarasida joylashgan edi.

en: A few paces beyond the last market garden stood a tavern, a big tavern, which had always aroused in him a feeling of aversion, even of fear, when he walked by it with his father.
uz: So'nggi bozor bog'idan bir necha qadam o'tib, u erda otasi bilan o'sha yerda o'tib ketganda, ularda har doim nafrat, hatto qo'rquv tuyg'usi uyg'otgan katta mehmonxona bor edi.

en: There was always a crowd there, always shouting, laughter and abuse, hideous hoarse singing and often fighting.
uz: U yerda doimo xaloyiq bor edi, har doim qichqirish, kulgi va zo'ravonlik, qo'rqinchli qo'shiq va ko'pincha janglar edi.

en: Drunken and horrible-looking figures were hanging about the tavern.
uz: Sarxo'r va dahshatli ko'rinishli kishilar mehmonxona atrofida osilgan edi.

en: He used to cling close to his father, trembling all over when he met them.
uz: U otasiga juda yaqin bo'lib, ular bilan uchrashganda qo'rqib ketardi.

en: Near the tavern the road became a dusty track, the dust of which was always black.
uz: Mehmonxona yaqinida yo'l tuproqli yo'l bo'lib, tuproq har doim qora bo'lgan.

en: It was a winding road, and about a hundred paces further on, it turned to the right to the graveyard.
uz: Bu tiklangan yo'l edi va bir yuz qadamdan o'tib, o'ng tomonga burchakga qarab borardi.

en: In the middle of the graveyard stood a stone church with a green cupola where he used to go to mass two or three times a year with his father and mother, when a service was held in memory of his grandmother, who had long been dead, and whom he had never seen.
uz: Qabristonning o'rtasida yashil kupolali toshli cherkov turardi, u yerda u o'z ota-onasini bir yilda ikki yoki uch marta masdaga taklif qilardi, bu yerda uzoq vaqtdan beri vafot etgan va hech qachon ko'rmagan buvisi xotirasiga marosim o'tkazilardi.

en: On these occasions they used to take on a white dish tied up in a table napkin a special sort of rice pudding with raisins stuck in it in the shape of a cross.
uz: Bunday paytlarda ular o'zlarining o'zlari bilan o'rnatilgan to'plamda o'rnatilgan oq taomni qabul qilishardi. Bu o'z navbatida, o'z ichiga xoch shaklidagi uzumlar o'rnatilgan maxsus turdagi riz puddingni o'z ichiga oladi.

en: He loved that church, the old- fashioned, unadorned icons and the old priest with the shaking head.
uz: U o'sha cherkovni, qadimgi, bezaksiz tasvirlarni va boshini titratgan keksa ruhoniyni yaxshi ko'rgan.

en: Near his grandmother’s grave, which was marked by a stone, was the little grave of his younger brother who had died at six months old.
uz: Uning buvisi qabri yonida, tosh bilan belgilab qo'yilgan, olti oyligida vafot etgan kichkina ukasi qabri bor edi.

en: He did not remember him at all, but he had been told about his little
uz: U uni umuman eslay olmasdi, lekin unga o'zining kichkina bolasi haqida aytib berishgan edi.

en: brother, and whenever he visited the graveyard he used religiously and reverently to cross himself and to bow down and kiss the little grave.
uz: va qachon qabrga borsa, diniy va hurmat ila o'zini xochga surib, o'z ukasini quvonch bilan o'qib, o'g'lini o'pishardi.

en: And now he dreamt that he was walking with his father past the tavern on the way to the graveyard; he was holding his father’s hand and looking with dread at the tavern.
uz: Endi u otasi bilan birga qabrga borayotganda, qabrdan o'tib ketayotganini tushirdi; otasining qo'lini ushlab, qo'rquv bilan qabrga qarab turardi.

en: A peculiar circumstance attracted his attention: there seemed to be some kind of festivity going on, there were crowds of gaily dressed townspeople, peasant women, their husbands, and riffraff of all sorts, all singing and all more or less drunk.
uz: Uning e'tiborini o'ziga xos holatga qaratdi: u yerda qandaydir bayram bo'lib o'tganiga o'xshaydi, shahar aholisi, qishloq ayollar, ularning erlari va har qanday odamlarning ko'pchiligi xursandchilik bilan kiyinadi, ularning barchasi kuylaydi va ko'proq-ko'proq ichkilikboz.

en: Near the entrance of the tavern stood a cart, but a strange cart.
uz: Mehmonxona eshikida bir arava turardi, ammo u o'zgacha edi.

en: It was one of those big carts usually drawn by heavy carthorses and laden with casks of wine or other heavy goods.
uz: Bu odatda og'ir kartorlar tomonidan chizilgan va sharob yoki boshqa og'ir tovarlar bilan to'ldirilgan katta vagonlardan biri edi.

en: He always liked looking at those great carthorses, with their long manes, thick legs, and slow even pace, drawing along a perfect mountain with no appearance of effort, as though it were easier going with a load than without it.
uz: U har doim o'sha katta kartorlarga, ularning uzun burchaklari, qalin oyoqlari va sekin va to'g'ri ritmlari bilan qaray boshlashni yaxshi ko'rgan edi, ular hech qanday harakat ko'rinmasidan iborat mukammal tog' bo'ylab ko'tarib, xuddi yuk bilan ketishdan ko'ra yo'lsiz yurish osonroq bo'lganidek.

en: But now, strange to say, in the shafts of such a cart he saw a thin little sorrel beast, one of those peasants’ nags which he had often seen straining their utmost under a heavy load of wood or hay, especially when the wheels were stuck in the mud or in a rut.
uz: Ammo endi, g'alati qilib aytganda, u bunday arava shaftlarida kamroq bo'lgan bir kichkina qo'rqinchli hayvonni ko'rdi, u ko'pincha yog'och yoki hayning og'ir yuk ostida o'z kuchini sarflagan qishloq xo'jalarining biri edi, ayniqsa, u velosipedlar loydan yoki ko'tarilgan joyda to'xtab qolganida.

en: And the peasants would beat them so cruelly, sometimes even about the nose and eyes, and he felt so sorry, so sorry for them that he almost cried, and his mother always used to take him away from the window.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi ularni juda shafqatsiz urardi, ba'zan hatto burun va ko'zlar haqida ham, u juda achinar edi, ular uchun juda achinar edi, deyarli yig'lar edi, onasi esa uni do'zaxdan olib ketardi.

en: All of a sudden there was a great uproar of shouting, singing and the balalaika, and from the tavern a number of big and very drunken peasants came out, wearing red and blue shirts and coats thrown over their shoulders.
uz: Toʻsatdan qichqiriq, qoʻshiq va balalaika gʻayratli boʻldi va mehmonxonadan koʻpgina katta va juda mast dehqonlar, qizil va koʻk kiyimlar va omborlari ustiga qoʻyilgan kiyimlar bilan chiqdi.

en: “Get in, get in!” shouted one of them, a young thick-necked peasant with a fleshy face red as a carrot.
uz: Kinga kir, kir! deb baqirib yubordi ulardan biri, go'sht kabi qizil, go'shtli yuzli, qalin bo'lakli yosh qishloq xo'jaligi.

en: “I’ll take you all, get in!” But at once there was an outbreak of laughter and exclamations in the crowd.
uz: Men hammangizni olib ketaman, kiringlar! Ammo birdan xaloyiq orasida kulgi va ovozlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Take us all with a beast like that!” “Why, Mikolka, are you crazy to put a nag like that in such a cart?” “And this mare is twenty if she is a day, mates!” “Get in, I’ll take you all,” Mikolka shouted again, leaping first into the cart, seizing the reins and standing straight up in front.
uz: Bizni hammamizni shunday hayvon bilan olib keting!Mikoolka, nima uchun siz shunday qurtoshni bunday aravaga qo'yishingiz uchun aqldan ozasiz?Va bu echki bir kunlik bo'lsa, yigirma yoshga to'ladi, do'stlar!Karib kiringlar, men hammangizni olib ketaman,Mikoolka yana baqirdi, avvaliga aravaga tushib, tiriklarni ushlab, to'g'ri oldinga turibdi.

en: “The bay has gone with Matvey,” he shouted from the cart —“and this brute, mates, is just breaking my heart, I feel as if I could kill her.
uz: Kofir Matvey bilan ketib ketdi, u aravachadan qichqirdi va bu vahshiy, do'stlar, yuragimni sindirib ketyapti, men uni o'ldirmoqchi bo'lganimdek his qilaman.

en: She’s just eating her head off.
uz: U shunchaki boshini yeydi.

en: I’ll make her gallop!
uz: Men uni galop qilishim kerak!

en: gallop!” and he picked up the whip, preparing himself with relish to flog the little mare.
uz: Gallop! va u qamchani olib, kichkinagini qamchilashga tayyorgarlik ko'rdi.

en: Come along!” The crowd laughed.
uz: Kelinglar! Xaloyiq kulishdi.

en: “D’you hear, she’ll gallop!” “Gallop indeed!
uz: siz eshitgan, shell galop!Gallop haqiqatan ham!

en: She has not had a gallop in her for the last ten years!” “She’ll jog along!” “Don’t you mind her, mates, bring a whip each of you, get ready!” “All right!
uz: U o'n yildan beri o'zida galop bo'lmagan!U yugurib ketadi!Undan xafa bo'lmanglar, do'stlar, har biringizga qamchilatib kelinglar, tayyorlaninglar!To'g'ri!

en: Give it to her!” They all clambered into Mikolka’s cart, laughing and making jokes.
uz: Uni unga bering! Ular hammasi Mikolka aravachasini o'rab, kulishadi va hazil qiladilar.

en: Six men got in and there was still room for more.
uz: Olti kishi kirdi va yana ko'proq odamlarga joy bo'ldi.

en: They hauled in a fat, rosy-cheeked woman.
uz: Ular yumshoq, gullab-yashirilgan ayolga qo'l urishdi.

en: She was dressed in red cotton, in a pointed, beaded headdress and thick leather shoes; she was cracking nuts and laughing.
uz: U qizil pamuk kiyimida, o'tkir, marvarid bo'lgan bosh kiyimida va qalin charmli poyabzallarda edi; u yong'oqlarni parchalab, kulishardi.

en: The crowd round them was laughing too and indeed, how could they help laughing?
uz: Ularning atrofidagi xaloyiq ham kulmoqda edi va haqiqatan ham, ular kulishga qanday yordam berishlari mumkin edi?

en: That wretched nag was to drag all the cartload of them at a gallop!
uz: O'sha qashshoq qush ularning to'plamini galop bilan tortib olib ketishi kerak edi!

en: Two young fellows in the cart were just getting whips ready to help Mikolka.
uz: Arabada turgan ikkita yosh yigit Mikolkaga yordam berish uchun qamchilab ketayotgan edi.

en: With the cry of “now,” the mare tugged with all her might, but far from galloping, could scarcely move forward; she struggled with her legs, gasping and shrinking from the blows of the three whips which were showered upon her like hail.
uz: Qichqiriq bilan qo'ldan kelganicha, qo'li bilan tortib olgan, lekin galoplab ketmay, oz-oz harakatlanardi; oyoqlari bilan kurashdi, uchta qamchiga qarshi hujum qilib, o'zlariga yog'ib tushgan sovuqga o'xshaydigan uchta qamchadan qo'rqib ketardi.

en: The laughter in the cart and in the crowd was redoubled, but Mikolka flew into a rage and furiously thrashed the mare, as though he supposed she really could gallop.
uz: Arabada va xaloyiqda kulgi ikki baravar ko'paydi, ammo Mikolka g'azabga to'lib, xuddi uning galop qila olishini his qilganidek, chiziqni g'azabga to'kib yubordi.

en: “Let me get in, too, mates,” shouted a young man in the crowd whose appetite was aroused.
uz: Men ham kirishimga ruxsat beringlar, do'stlar,  deb baqirgan xaloyiq orasida bir yigitning ochko'zi uyg'ongan.

en: “Get in, all get in,” cried Mikolka, “she will draw you all.
uz: Koshinglar, hammangiz kiringlar, Mikolka baqirib yubordi, U hammangizni jalb qiladi.

en: I’ll beat her to death!” And he thrashed and thrashed at the mare, beside himself with fury.
uz: Men uni o'limga uraman! Va u g'azabdan o'z o'zi yonida bo'lib, o'zini ko'tarib, qo'lga urdi.

en: “Father, father,” he cried, “father, what are they doing?
uz: Otam, otam, o'zi baqirdi, o'tam, ular nima qilmoqdalar?

en: Father, they are beating the poor horse!” “Come along, come along!” said his father.
uz: Ota, ular kambag'al otni urishyapti! Kel, kel, kel! dedi otasi.

en: “They are drunken and foolish, they are in fun; come away, don’t look!” and he tried to draw him away, but he tore himself away from his hand, and, beside himself with horror, ran to the horse.
uz: Ular mast va nodon, o'yin-kulg'ida o'ynaydilar, ketinglar, ko'rmanglar! - dedi u, uni olib ketishga harakat qildi, lekin u o'zini qo'lidan yirtib olib, qo'rqinchdan qochib, ot tomon yugurdi.

en: The poor beast was in a bad way.
uz: Zavqsiz hayvon yomon holatda edi.

en: She was gasping, standing still, then tugging again and almost falling.
uz: U nafas olishi, to'xtamasligi, keyin yana quvib ketishi va deyarli qulab ketishi mumkin edi.

en: “Beat her to death,” cried Mikolka, “it’s come to that.
uz: Ayolni o'limga urish, - deb baqirib yubordi Mikolka, - bu o'ziga yarasha bo'ldi.

en: “What are you about, are you a Christian, you devil?” shouted an old man in the crowd.
uz: - Nima qilyapsan, sen masihiymisiz, iblis? - deb hayqirdi xaloyiq orasida bir keksa kishi.

en: “Did anyone ever see the like?
uz: Agar hech kim shunga o'xshash narsalarni ko'rgan bo'lsa?

en: A wretched nag like that pulling such a cartload,” said another.
uz: O'sha kabi g'alati qo'zg'olon bunday yukni tortib olib ketayotgan, - dedi yana bir kishi. - O'sha kabi g'alati qo'zg'olon, - dedi yana bir kishi.

en: “You’ll kill her,” shouted the third.
uz: "Sen uni o'ldirasan", - deb baqirib yubordi uchinchi.

en: It’s my property, I’ll do what I choose.
uz: Bu mening mulkiman, men o'zim xohlaganimni qilaman.

en: Get in, more of you!
uz: Kiringlar, ko'proq bo'linglar!

en: I will have her go at a gallop!
uz: Men uni galopga olib boraman!

en: …” All at once laughter broke into a roar and covered everything: the mare, roused by the shower of blows, began feebly kicking.
uz: ... Birdan kulgi qichqiriq qilib, hamma narsani qopladi: urishlarning shohi bilan uyg'otilgan bo'lak zaiflik bilan urishni boshladi.

en: Even the old man could not help smiling.
uz: Hatto keksa kishi ham tabassum qilishdan bosh tortmadi.

en: To think of a wretched little beast like that trying to kick!
uz: O'sha bechora hayvonni urishga harakat qilayotganini tasavvur qiling!

en: Two lads in the crowd snatched up whips and ran to the mare to beat her about the ribs.
uz: Xaloyiqda bo'lgan ikki yigit qamchilaqlarni olib, uni qo'llari bilan urish uchun qo'lga chopishdi.

en: “Hit her in the face, in the eyes, in the eyes,” cried Mikolka.
uz: "Uning yuziga, ko'zlariga, ko'zlariga ur", - deb yig'ladi Mikolka.

en: “Give us a song, mates,” shouted someone in the cart and everyone in the cart joined in a riotous song, jingling a tambourine and whistling.
uz: Bizga bir qo'shiq beringlar, do'stlar, arava ichida kimnidir baqiribdi va aravadagi barcha odamlar davra qo'shiqlarida qo'shiq qo'shib qo'shildilar, davomiy qo'shiq qo'shib, pishirishdi.

en: The woman went on cracking nuts and laughing.
uz: Ayol g'ayratga to'lib, o'z ko'zlari bilan kulishni davom ettirdi.

en: … He ran beside the mare, ran in front of her, saw her being whipped across the eyes, right in the eyes!
uz: ... U qochqinning yonida yugurdi, uning oldidan yugurdi, uning ko'zlariga to'qilganini ko'rdi, to'g'ri ko'zlarga!

en: He was crying, he felt choking, his tears were streaming.
uz: U yig'layotgan edi, o'zini chekayotgan his qilardi, ko'z yoshlari oqib ketar edi.

en: One of the men gave him a cut with the whip across the face, he did not feel it.
uz: O'sha odamlardan biri unga yuzidagi qamchila bilan kesib qo'ydi, lekin u buni his qilmadi.

en: Wringing his hands and screaming, he rushed up to the grey-headed old man with the grey beard, who was shaking his head in disapproval.
uz: Qo'llarini qichqirib, qichqirib, boshini g'alati boshoqli oqsoqolning oldiga yugurdi.

en: One woman seized him by the hand and would have taken him away, but he tore himself from her and ran back to the mare.
uz: Bir ayol uni qo'lidan ushlab, olib ketmoqchi edi, lekin u undan ajralib, qoʻlga qaytib keldi.

en: She was almost at the last gasp, but began kicking once more.
uz: U deyarli oxirgi nafasini oladigan bo'lsa-da, yana bir bor urishni boshladi.

en: “I’ll teach you to kick,” Mikolka shouted ferociously.
uz: Men sizga urishni o'rgataman, - dedi Mikolka og'ir ovozda.

en: He threw down the whip, bent forward and picked up from the bottom of the cart a long, thick shaft, he took hold of one end with both hands and with an effort brandished it over the mare.
uz: U qamchani tashladi, oldinga burildi va arava pastidan uzun, qalin shaftni ko'tarib oldi, bir tomoni ikki qo'li bilan qo'lga oldi va uni harakat bilan maydon ustiga ko'tardi.

en: “He’ll crush her,” was shouted round him.
uz: U uni ezib tashlaydi, o'z atrofida qichqirildi.

en: “He’ll kill her!” “It’s my property,” shouted Mikolka and brought the shaft down with a swinging blow.
uz: U uni o'ldiradi! - deb baqirib yubordi Mikolka. - Bu mening mol-mulkim.

en: There was a sound of a heavy thud.
uz: U yerda og'ir toshqin tovushlari eshitildi.

en: “Thrash her, thrash her!
uz: Uni uring, uni uring!

en: Why have you stopped?” shouted voices in the crowd.
uz: Nima uchun to'xtatdingiz? xaloyiq orasida ba'zi ovozlar baqirib ketdi.

en: And Mikolka swung the shaft a second time and it fell a second time on the spine of the luckless mare.
uz: Mikolka esa o'g'lini ikkinchi marta o'zgartirdi va u ikkinchi marta omadsiz qo'zg'oloning cho'qqisiga tushdi.

en: She sank back on her
uz: U o'z ustiga qaytdi

en: haunches, but lurched forward and tugged forward with all her force, tugged first on one side and then on the other, trying to move the cart.
uz: O'z kuchini ishga solib, avvalo bir tomondan, keyin esa boshqa tomondan tortib, aravachani ko'tarishga harakat qildi.

en: But the six whips were attacking her in all directions, and the shaft was raised again and fell upon her a third time, then a fourth, with heavy measured blows.
uz: Ammo olti qamchi unga har tomonlama hujum qilib, o'shach yana ko'tarildi va uchinchi marta, keyin to'rtinchi marta qattiq urish bilan unga tushdi.

en: Mikolka was in a fury that he could not kill her at one blow.
uz: Mikolka uni bir marta o'ldira olmasligidan g'azabda edi.

en: “She’s a tough one,” was shouted in the crowd.
uz: "U qattiqqo'l", - deb hayqirdi xaloyiq.

en: “She’ll fall in a minute, mates, there will soon be an end of her,” said an admiring spectator in the crowd.
uz: "U bir daqiqada qulab ketadi, do'stlar, uning oxiri tez orada bo'ladi", - dedi xaloyiq orasidagi hayratlanuvchi tomoshabin.

en: “Fetch an axe to her!
uz: O'ziga o'g'ilni qo'yib bering!

en: Finish her off,” shouted a third.
uz: Uni tugating, - deb uchinchi marta qichqirdi.

en: Stand off,” Mikolka screamed frantically; he threw down the shaft, stooped down in the cart and picked up an iron crowbar.
uz: Turing, Mikolka g'azabdan qichqirdi; u o'shaftni pastga tashladi, aravachaga o'zini egib, temir qo'riqchini ko'tarib oldi.

en: “Look out,” he shouted, and with all his might he dealt a stunning blow at the poor mare.
uz: U qichqirdi va o'z kuchi bilan kambag'al echkiga ajoyib darvoza urdi.

en: The blow fell; the mare staggered, sank back, tried to pull, but the bar fell again with a swinging blow on her back and she fell on the ground like a log.
uz: Urug' tushdi; qo'zi cho'kib, orqaga qaytdi, tortib olishga harakat qildi, lekin qo'riqchi kemasi yana orqaga cho'kib tushdi va u o'simlik kabi yerga yiqildi.

en: “Finish her off,” shouted Mikolka and he leapt beside himself, out of the cart.
uz: Uni tugating,  deb baqirdi Mikolka va u o'z-o'ziga qochib, aravachadan chiqdi.

en: Several young men, also flushed with drink, seized anything they could come across —whips, sticks, poles, and ran to the dying mare.
uz: Bir necha yosh yigitlar ham ichimlik bilan to'lib-toshgan edilar va o'lib ketayotgan qo'lga qo'yilgan har qanday narsadan qo'lga olishdi.

en: Mikolka stood on one side and began dealing random blows with the crowbar.
uz: Mikolka bir tomondan turib, qo'ng'iroq barchasi bilan tasodifiy urishni boshladi.

en: The mare stretched out her head, drew a long breath and died.
uz: Qo'zi boshini uzatdi, uzoq nafas oldi va o'ldi.

en: “You butchered her,” someone shouted in the crowd.
uz: Siz uni qotib yubordingiz,  kimdir xaloyiq orasida qichqirdi.

en: “Why wouldn’t she gallop then?” “My property!” shouted Mikolka, with bloodshot eyes, brandishing the bar in his hands.
uz: Nima uchun u o'sha paytda galop qilmasdi?My property! deb baqirib yubordi Mikolka qonli ko'zlar bilan, qo'llarida barni o'chirib qo'ydi.

en: He stood as though regretting that he had nothing more to beat.
uz: O'zi ko'tarib turardi, xuddi o'zi uchun g'alaba qozonish uchun boshqa hech narsa yo'qligidan afsuslanayotgan bo'lsa-da.

en: “No mistake about it, you are not a Christian,” many voices were shouting in the crowd.
uz: Bu haqda hech qanday xato yo'q, siz masihiy emassiz,  ko'p ovozlar xaloyiq orasida qichqirishdi.

en: But the poor boy, beside himself, made his way, screaming, through the crowd to the sorrel nag, put his arms round her bleeding dead head and kissed it, kissed the eyes and kissed the lips.
uz: Ammo kambag'al yigit o'z-o'zidan chetda bo'lib, xaloyiq orqali qichqiriq qilib, qo'llarini uning qon to'kib ketgan o'lik boshiga qo'ydi va uni o'pdi, ko'zlarini o'pdi va og'zlarini o'pdi.

en: … Then he jumped up and flew in a frenzy with his little fists out at Mikolka.
uz: So'ngra u o'z qo'llarini ko'tarib, Mikolakada g'alati ko'rinishda uchib ketdi.

en: At that instant his father, who had been running after him, snatched him up and carried him out of the crowd.
uz: O'sha zahoti otasi, uning orqasidan yugurib borayotgan edi, uni ko'tarib, xaloyiq orasidan olib chiqdi.

en: Let us go home,” he said to him.
uz: Uyga boraylik, - dedi u unga.

en: Why did they … kill … the poor horse!” he sobbed, but his voice broke and the words came in shrieks from his panting chest.
uz: Nima uchun ular ... kambag'al otni o'ldirishdi! u yig'lab yubordi, lekin ovozi bo'g'ib ketdi va so'zlar qichqiriq bilan uning nafasini o'chirgan ko'krakidan keldi.

en: … They are brutal … it’s not our business!” said his father.
uz: Ular shafqatsiz... bu bizning ishimiz emas! - dedi otasi.

en: He put his arms round his father but he felt choked, choked.
uz: Otasining qo'llarini o'rab olgan bo'lsa-da, u o'zini charchagan, charchagan his qilgan.

en: He tried to draw a breath, to cry out —and woke up.
uz: U nafas olishga, qichqirishga harakat qildi va uyg'ondi.

en: He waked up, gasping for breath, his hair soaked with perspiration, and stood up in terror.
uz: U nafas olishni xohlagan holda uyg'onib, sochlarini ter bilan to'kib qo'ydi va qo'rquvdan turibdi.

en: “Thank God, that was only a dream,” he said, sitting down under a tree and drawing deep breaths.
uz: "Allohga shukr, bu faqat bir orzu edi", - dedi u, daraxt ostida o'tirib, chuqur nafas olib.

en: Is it some fever coming on?
uz: Issiq paydo bo'lyaptimi?

en: Such a hideous dream!” He felt utterly broken: darkness and confusion were in his soul.
uz: O'zini o'zi halok his qildi: uning ruhida qorong'ilik va chalkashlik bor edi.

en: He rested his elbows on his knees and leaned his head on his hands.
uz: U qo'lqoshlarini tiz cho'kib, boshini qo'llariga tikib qo'ydi.

en: “Good God!” he cried, “can it be, can it be, that I shall really take an axe, that I shall strike her on the head, split her skull open … that I shall tread in the sticky warm blood, break the lock, steal and tremble; hide, all spattered in the blood … with the axe.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo! deb baqirdi, Haqiqatan ham o'qim bo'lishi mumkinmi, bo'lishi mumkinmi, men o'qimni olib, uning boshiga uraman, kafanini parchalatib ochaman ... qo'pol issiq qonni bosaman, qulfni buzaman, o'g'irlayman va titrayman; qorong'i bo'lib yashirinaman, bularning barchasi qonga to'kilgan ... o'qim bilan.

en: … Good God, can it be?” He was shaking like a leaf as he said this.
uz: ... Yaxshi Xudo, shunday bo'ladimi? U buni aytganda, barg kabi titrab yurgan edi.

en: “But why am I going on like this?” he continued, sitting up again, as it were in profound amazement.
uz: Ammo nega men bunday davom etyapman? - dedi u, yana o'tirib, xuddi chuqur hayronlik bilan.

en: “I knew that I could never bring myself to it, so what have I been torturing myself for till now?
uz: Men o'zimni hech qachon bunga olib kelolmayman, deb bilardim, shuning uchun hozirgacha nima uchun o'zimni qiynalyapman?

en: Yesterday, yesterday, when I went to make that … experiment, yesterday I realised completely that I could never bear to do it.
uz: Kecha, kecha, men tajriba o'tkazishga borganimda, kecha men buni hech qachon ko'ra olmasligimni to'liq tushundim.

en: … Why am I going over it again, then?
uz: Xo'sh, nega men bu mavzuni yana ko'rib chiqaman?

en: Why am I hesitating?
uz: Nima uchun men shubha qilaman?

en: As I came down the stairs yesterday, I said myself that it was base, loathsome, vile, vile … the very thought of it made me feel sick and filled me with horror.
uz: Kecha merosidan tushayotganimda, o'zimga: "Bu begona, jirkanch, jirkanch, jirkanch... bu haqda o'ylash menga og'riqli va dahshatli bo'ldi.

en: “No, I couldn’t do it, I couldn’t do it!
uz: Yo'q, men buni qila olmasdim, qila olmasdim!

en: Granted, granted that there is no flaw in all that reasoning, that all that I have concluded this last month is clear as day, true as arithmetic.
uz: To'g'ri, bu fikrlash tarzida kamchilik yo'qligini, o'tgan oyda chiqargan xulosalarimning barchasi kun kabi aniq, aritmetik jihatdan ham haq ekanligini e'tirof etamiz.

en: Anyway I couldn’t bring myself to it!
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men o'zimni bunga olib kelolmadim!

en: I couldn’t do it, I couldn’t do it!
uz: Men buni qila olmasdim, qila olmasdim!

en: Why, why then am I still … ?” He rose to his feet, looked round in wonder as though surprised at finding himself in this place, and went towards the bridge.
uz: Nima uchun, nima uchun men hali ham ...? U o'z oyoqlaridan turib, o'ziga qarab qolibdi, xuddi o'zini bu joyda topganidan ajablanib, ko'prik tomon ketdi.

en: He was pale, his eyes glowed, he was exhausted in every limb, but he seemed suddenly to breathe more easily.
uz: Uning ko'zlari yorug' edi, ko'zlari yorug' edi, har bir a'zosi charchagan edi, lekin u birdan osonroq nafas olishni boshladi.

en: He felt he had cast off that fearful burden that had so long been weighing upon him, and all at
uz: U o'zi uchun uzoq vaqtdan beri o'z ustiga og'ir yuk bo'lgan dahshatli og'irlikni yo'qotganini his qildi va bu hammasi o'z-o'zidan chiqib ketdi.

en: once there was a sense of relief and peace in his soul.
uz: Bir marta uning ruhi taskin va tinchlikni his qildi.

en: “Lord,” he prayed, “show me my path —I renounce that accursed … dream of mine.” Crossing the bridge, he gazed quietly and calmly at the Neva, at the glowing red sun setting in the glowing sky.
uz: Rabbim, u ibodat qildi, menga yo'limni ko'rsating  Men bu la'natdan voz kechaman ... mening orzuim. Ko'prikni kesib o'tib, u tinchlik va xotirjamlik bilan Neva ko'rigini ko'rdi, shiddatli osmonda parcha-parcha qizil quyosh botayotganini ko'rdi.

en: In spite of his weakness he was not conscious of fatigue.
uz: O'zining zaifligiga qaramay, u charchaganidan xabardor emas edi.

en: It was as though an abscess that had been forming for a month past in his heart had suddenly broken.
uz: O'tgan bir oydan beri yuragida hosil bo'lib kelayotgan absces to'satdan buzilgani singari edi.

en: He was free from that spell, that sorcery, that obsession!
uz: U o'sha sehrdan, sehr-jodudan, g'ayratdan ozod edi!

en: Later on, when he recalled that time and all that happened to him during those days, minute by minute, point by point, he was superstitiously impressed by one circumstance, which, though in itself not very exceptional, always seemed to him afterwards the predestined turning-point of his fate.
uz: Keyinchalik, u o'sha vaqtni va o'sha kunlar davomida unga yuz bergan barcha voqealarni, daqiqalar va nuqtalar bilan eslatib o'tganda, o'zi uchun juda muhim bo'lmagan bir holat yuz berdi, ammo keyinchalik bu uning taqdirining oldindan belgilab qo'yilgan o'zgarishi bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: He could never understand and explain to himself why, when he was tired and worn out, when it would have been more convenient for him to go home by the shortest and most direct way, he had returned by the Hay Market where he had no need to go.
uz: U hech qachon o'zi uchun nima uchun, charchagan va charchoq bo'lganida, u uchun eng qisqa va eng to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'ldan uyga qaytish qulayroq bo'lganida, nima uchun u borishga hojat yo'q bo'lgan Hay bozori orqali qaytib kelganini tushunib, o'ziga tushuntira olmagan.

en: It was obviously and quite unnecessarily out of his way, though not much so.
uz: Bu uning yo'lidan chiqib ketgani aniq va zaruriy emas edi, ammo shunchalik emas edi.

en: It is true that it happened to him dozens of times to return home without noticing what streets he passed through.
uz: To'g'ri, u o'nlab marotaba uyga qaytib, qaysi ko'chalardan o'tganini payqamas edi.

en: But why, he was always asking himself, why had such an important, such a decisive and at the same time such an absolutely chance meeting happened in the Hay Market (where he had moreover no reason to go) at the very hour, the very minute of his life when he was just in the very mood and in the very circumstances in which that meeting was able to exert the gravest and most decisive influence on his whole destiny?
uz: Ammo u o'zidan nima uchun, nima uchun u o'zining hayotidagi o'ta muhim, o'ta muhim va shu bilan birga o'ta to'g'ri tasodifiy uchrashuvni o'tkazgan (u erda u borishga hech qanday sabab yo'q edi) o'sha vaqt, o'ta muhim daqiqada, o'ta muhim va o'ta muhim o'yin o'tkazgan va o'ta muhim o'yin o'tkazgan?

en: As though it had been lying in wait for him on purpose!
uz: O'zi bilgan holda uni kutib turgandek bo'ldi!

en: It was about nine o’clock when he crossed the Hay Market.
uz: Soat taxminan to'qqizlar edi, u Hay bozorini kesib o'tdi.

en: At the tables and the barrows, at the booths and the shops, all the market people were closing their establishments or clearing away and packing up their wares and, like their customers, were going home.
uz: Soxtaxonalar va do'konlarda, stollar va do'konlarda, barcha bozor egalari o'z korxonalarini yopib, yo'q qilib, mahsulotlarini to'plab, o'z mijozlari kabi uylariga qaytib ketishdi.

en: Rag pickers and costermongers of all kinds were crowding round the taverns in the dirty and stinking courtyards of the Hay Market.
uz: Hay bozorining kirli va kirli hovlidagi makmonlar atrofida har xil rag to'plovchi va kostermongerlar to'plangan edi.

en: Raskolnikov particularly liked this place and the neighbouring alleys, when he wandered aimlessly in the streets.
uz: Raskolnikov bu joyni va qo'shni ko'chalarni ayniqsa yoqtirgan, chunki u ko'chalarda maqsadsiz yurgan.

en: Here his rags did not attract contemptuous attention, and one could walk about in any
uz: Bu yerda uning kiyimlari kamsitilgan e'tiborni jalb qilmadi va odam istalgan kiyimda yurishi mumkin edi.

en: attire without scandalising people.
uz: Odamlarni hayratga solmasdan kiyinish.

en: At the corner of an alley a huckster and his wife had two tables set out with tapes, thread, cotton handkerchiefs, etc.
uz: Ko'cha burchagida bir huckster va uning rafiqasi ikkita stolni bandlar, iplar, pamuk to'qimalar va boshqalar bilan o'rnatishgan.

en: They, too, had got up to go home, but were lingering in conversation with a friend, who had just come up to them.
uz: Ular ham uyga qaytish uchun turishibdi, lekin bir do'stlari bilan suhbatlashayotganlarida, ular yaqinlashishgan edi.

en: This friend was Lizaveta Ivanovna, or, as everyone called her, Lizaveta, the younger sister of the old pawnbroker, Alyona Ivanovna, whom Raskolnikov had visited the previous day to pawn his watch and make his experiment.
uz: Bu do'st Lizaveta Ivanovna yoki, hamma uni nima deb atagan bo'lsa, Lizaveta, eski g'ayratli Alyona Ivanovna singlisi, Raskolnikov o'z soatini g'ayratga olish va tajribasini amalga oshirish uchun bir kun oldin tashrif buyurgan edi.

en: … He already knew all about Lizaveta and she knew him a little too.
uz: U Lizaveta haqida hamma narsani bilgan edi va u ham uni biroz taniydi.

en: She was a single woman of about thirty- five, tall, clumsy, timid, submissive and almost idiotic.
uz: U taxminan o'ttiz besh yoshli turmush qurmagan ayol edi, baland, behuda, uyalgan, itoatkor va deyarli ahmoq.

en: She was a complete slave and went in fear and trembling of her sister, who made her work day and night, and even beat her.
uz: U butunlayin qul bo'lib, o'z singlisidan qo'rqib va titrab yurardi, chunki u uni kechayu kunduz mehnat qilishga majbur qilardi va hatto urib yuborardi.

en: She was standing with a bundle before the huckster and his wife, listening earnestly and doubtfully.
uz: U huckster va uning xotini oldida bir to'plam bilan turib, diqqat bilan va shubha bilan tinglagan edi.

en: They were talking of something with special warmth.
uz: Ular o'zgacha iliqlik bilan gapira boshlashdi.

en: The moment Raskolnikov caught sight of her, he was overcome by a strange sensation as it were of intense astonishment, though there was nothing astonishing about this meeting.
uz: Raskolnikov uni ko'rgach, o'ziga xos hayronlik hissi paydo bo'ldi, ammo bu uchrashuvda hech qanday hayratlanarli narsa yo'q edi.

en: “You could make up your mind for yourself, Lizaveta Ivanovna,” the huckster was saying aloud.
uz: Siz o'zingiz qaror qabul qila olasiz, Lizaveta Ivanovna, huckster baland ovoz bilan aytdi.

en: “Come round tomorrow about seven.
uz: Ertaga soat yetti atrofida keling.

en: They will be here too.” “Tomorrow?” said Lizaveta slowly and thoughtfully, as though unable to make up her mind.
uz: Ular ham bu yerda bo'lishadi.Ertaga? Lizaveta o'z fikrini o'zgartirmay, asta-sekin va mulohaza bilan javob berdi.

en: “Upon my word, what a fright you are in of Alyona Ivanovna,” gabbled the huckster’s wife, a lively little woman.
uz: Men aytgan so'zlarimcha, siz Alyona Ivanovna-dan juda qo'rqasiz, - dedi hucksterning xotini, jonli kichik ayol.

en: “I look at you, you are like some little babe.
uz: Senga qarasam, siz kichkina bola kabi bo'lasiz.

en: And she is not your own sister either — nothing but a stepsister and what a hand she keeps over you!” “But this time don’t say a word to Alyona Ivanovna,” her husband interrupted; “that’s my advice, but come round to us without asking.
uz: Va u sizning singilingiz ham emas, o'g'il singilingizdir va u sizga qanday yordam beradi! Ammo bu safar Alyona Ivanovnaga bir so'z aytmang, uning eri uni uzatib qo'ydi; mening maslahatim shundaki, bizdan so'ramagan holda oldimizga keling.

en: It will be worth your while.
uz: Bu sizning vaqtingizga arziydi.

en: Later on your sister herself may have a notion.” “Am I to come?” “About seven o’clock tomorrow.
uz: Keyinchalik singlingizning o'zi ham fikrga ega bo'lishi mumkin.Men kelishim kerakmi?Ertaga soat yetti atrofida.

en: And they will be here.
uz: Ular ham bu yerda bo'ladi.

en: You will be able to decide for yourself.” “And we’ll have a cup of tea,” added his wife.
uz: Siz o'zingiz qaror qabul qila olasiz. Va biz bir qadah choy ichamiz, - dedi uning xotini.

en: “All right, I’ll come,” said Lizaveta, still pondering, and she began slowly moving away.
uz: "To'g'ri, men kelaman", - dedi Lizaveta, hali ham o'ylay boshladi va u sekin-sakin ketishni boshladi.

en: Raskolnikov had just passed and heard no more.
uz: Raskolnikov yaqinda o'tib ketib, boshqa hech narsa eshitmadi.

en: He passed softly, unnoticed, trying not to miss a word.
uz: U o'tib ketib, bir so'zni ham o'tkazib yubormaslikka harakat qildi.

en: His first amazement was followed by a thrill of horror, like a shiver running down his spine.
uz: Uning birinchi hayratlanishiga qo'rqinchli his-tuyg'u qo'shildi, xuddi uning cho'qqisidan cho'kib ketayotgan titroq kabi.

en: He had learnt, he had suddenly quite unexpectedly learnt, that the next day at seven o’clock Lizaveta, the old woman’s sister and only companion, would be away from home and that therefore at seven o’clock precisely the old woman would be left alone.
uz: U ertasi kuni soat yettilarda keksa ayolning singlisi va yagona yo'lboshchisi Lizaveta uyidan uzoqda bo'lishini va shuning uchun soat yettida keksa ayol yolg'iz qolishini bilib olgan.

en: He was only a few steps from his lodging.
uz: U o'z uyidan bir necha qadam uzoqlikda edi.

en: He went in like a man condemned to death.
uz: U o'limga mahkum bo'lgan odam kabi kirdi.

en: He thought of nothing and was incapable of thinking; but he felt suddenly in his whole being that he had no more freedom of thought, no will, and that everything was suddenly and irrevocably decided.
uz: U hech narsa haqida o'ylamagan va o'ylay olmaydigan edi; lekin birdan butun o'zida fikr erkinligi, xohishi yo'qligini va hamma narsa birdan va qaytarib olinmaydigan tarzda hal qilinganligini his qildi.

en: Certainly, if he had to wait whole years for a suitable opportunity, he could not reckon on a more certain step towards the success of the plan than that which had just presented itself.
uz: Albatta, agar u to'liq yillar davomida qulay imkoniyatni kutishi kerak bo'lsa, reja muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga erishish uchun o'zi hozircha taqdim etganidan ko'ra aniqroq qadam qo'yishini kutolmasdi.

en: In any case, it would have been difficult to find out beforehand and with certainty, with greater exactness and less risk, and without dangerous inquiries and investigations, that next day at a certain time an old woman, on whose life an attempt was contemplated, would be at home and entirely alone.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, ertasi kuni muayyan vaqtda, hayotga qasd qilish rejalashtirilgan bir keksa ayol uyda va butunlay yolg'iz bo'lishini oldindan va aniq, aniqroq, kamroq xavf va xavfli so'rovlarsiz aniqlash qiyin bo'lardi.

en: VI Later on Raskolnikov happened to find out why the huckster and his wife had invited Lizaveta.
uz: Keyin Raskolnikov VI nima uchun huckster va uning xotini Lizavetaga taklif qilishganini bilib oldi.

en: It was a very ordinary matter and there was nothing exceptional about it.
uz: Bu juda oddiy masala edi va ularda hech qanday istisno yo'q edi.

en: A family who had come to the town and been reduced to poverty were selling their household goods and clothes, all women’s things.
uz: Shaharga kelgan va qashshoqlikka aylangan bir oila o'z uy mahsulotlari va kiyim-kechaklarini, barcha ayollarga tegishli bo'lgan narsalarni sotardi.

en: As the things would have fetched little in the market, they were looking for a dealer.
uz: Bozorda bu narsalar kamroq pulga ega bo'lganligi sababli, ular dilerni qidirishardi.

en: This was Lizaveta’s business.
uz: Bu Lizaveta ishi edi.

en: She undertook such jobs and was frequently employed, as she was very honest and always fixed a fair price and stuck to it.
uz: U bunday ishlarni o'z zimmasiga olgan va tez-tez ish bilan ta'minlangan, chunki u juda halol va doimo adolatli narxni belgilab, unga sodiq bo'lgan.

en: She spoke as a rule little and, as we have said already, she was very submissive and timid.
uz: U odatda kam gapirardi va biz allaqachon aytib o'tganimizdek, u juda itoatkor va qo'rqinchli edi.

en: But Raskolnikov had become superstitious of late.
uz: Ammo Raskolnikov so'nggi paytlarda sehrgarlikka berilib ketgan edi.

en: The traces of superstition remained in him long after, and were almost ineradicable.
uz: U erda sehr-jodu izlari uzoq vaqt davom etdi va deyarli yo'q qilinmagan edi.

en: And in all this he was always afterwards disposed to see something strange and mysterious, as it were, the presence of some peculiar influences and coincidences.
uz: Va bularning barchasida u har doim keyinchalik g'alati va sirli bir narsani ko'rishga moyil edi, ya'ni ba'zi o'ziga xos ta'sir va tasodiflarning mavjudligini ko'rishga moyil edi.

en: In the previous winter a student he knew called Pokorev, who had left for Harkov, had chanced in conversation to give him the address of Alyona Ivanovna, the old pawnbroker, in case he might want to pawn anything.
uz: O'tgan qishda u bilgan Pokorev ismli o'quvchi Harkovga jo'nab ketibdi va agar u biron bir narsani qo'yib bermoqchi bo'lsa, avvalgi qarz beruvchi Alyona Ivanovna manzilini unga berish uchun suhbatda yuz bergan edi.

en: For a long while he did not go to her, for he had lessons and managed to get along somehow.
uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida u ayolning oldiga bormadi, chunki u darslar o'tkazgan va qandaydir tarzda yaxshi munosabatda bo'lgan.

en: Six weeks ago he had remembered the address; he had two articles that could be pawned: his father’s old silver watch and a little gold ring with three red stones, a present from his sister at parting.
uz: Olti hafta oldin u manzilni eslab qolgan edi; unga ikki narsa qo'shilgan edi: otasining eski kumush soatlari va uchta qizil toshli kichik oltin anjom, opasi tomonidan ajralish paytida sovg'a.

en: He decided to take the ring.
uz: U o'ziga bag'ishlashni qaror qildi.

en: When he found the old woman he had felt an insurmountable repulsion for her at the first glance, though he knew nothing special about her.
uz: U keksa ayolni topganida, u haqida hech narsa bilmagan bo'lsa-da, birinchi qarashda unga nisbatan g'azablantiradigan nafratni his qilgan edi.

en: He got two roubles from her and went into a miserable little tavern on his way home.
uz: U undan ikki rubl olib, uyga qaytayotganida bir kichkina va qashshoq mehmonxonaga kirdi.

en: He asked for tea, sat down and sank into deep thought.
uz: U choy so'radi, o'tirdi va chuqur o'ylashga tushdi.

en: strange idea was pecking at his brain like a chicken in the egg, and very, very much absorbed him.
uz: O'zgacha g'oya uning miyasiga tupurib, uni tuxumdagi tovuq kabi o'rab oldi.

en: Almost beside him at the next table there was sitting a student, whom he did not know and had never seen, and with him a young officer.
uz: Qo'shni stolda uning yonida deyarli hech qachon ko'rmagan va tanib-bilmagan bir talaba o'tirgan edi.

en: They had played a game of billiards and began drinking tea.
uz: Ular bilyard o'yinini o'ynashdi va choy ichishni boshlashdi.

en: All at once he heard the student mention to the officer the pawnbroker Alyona Ivanovna and give him her address.
uz: Birdan o'quvchi o'qituvchisiga pawnbroker Alyona Ivanovna haqida gapirib, unga uning manzilini berganini eshitdi.

en: This of itself seemed strange to Raskolnikov; he had just come from her and here at once he heard her name.
uz: Raskolnikov uchun bu o'ziga xos g'alati tuyulgan; u o'sha zahoti uning oldiga kelib, shu zahoti uning ismini eshitgan edi.

en: Of course it was a chance, but he could not shake off a very extraordinary impression, and here someone seemed to be speaking expressly for him; the student began telling his friend various details about Alyona Ivanovna.
uz: Albatta, bu imkoniyat edi, lekin u juda ajoyib taassurot qoldirgan va bu erda kimdir u uchun gapirgan bo'lib tuyuldi; o'quvchi o'z do'stiga Alyona Ivanovna haqida turli tafsilotlarni aytib berishni boshladi.

en: “She is first-rate,” he said.
uz: "U birinchi darajali", dedi u.

en: “You can always get money from her.
uz: Siz har doim undan pul olishingiz mumkin.

en: She is as rich as a Jew, she can give you five thousand roubles at a time and she is not above taking a pledge for a rouble.
uz: U yahudiy kabi boy, u sizga bir marta besh ming rubl berishga qodir va bir rubl uchun garov olishdan ustun emas.

en: Lots of our fellows have had dealings with her.
uz: Ko'pgina sheriklarimiz u bilan munosabatda bo'lishgan.

en: But she is an awful old harpy.
uz: Ammo u juda ham qo'pol keksa harpy.

en: …” And he began describing how spiteful and uncertain she was, how if you were only a day late with your interest the pledge was lost; how she gave a quarter of the value of an article and took five and even seven percent a month on it and so on.
uz: ... Va u uning qanchalik yomon va shubhasiz ekanligini, agar siz foizingiz bilan bir kun kech bo'lsangiz, garov yo'qolganini, qanday qilib u bir maqolaning qiymati to'rtdan bir qismini berib, oyiga besh va hatto yetti foizini olganini tushuntirib berishni boshladi.

en: The student chattered on, saying that she had a sister Lizaveta, whom the wretched little creature was continually beating, and kept in complete bondage like a small child, though Lizaveta was at least six feet high.
uz: O'quvchi o'zining singlisi Lizaveta borligini va uning ko'tarilganligi Lizaveta kamida olti metr bo'lsa-da, u bola kabi to'liq qullikda saqlanayotganini aytdi.

en: “There’s a phenomenon for you,” cried the student and he laughed.
uz: Siz uchun bir hodisa bor, - deb yig'ladi o'quvchi va u kuldi.

en: They began talking about Lizaveta.
uz: Ular Lizaveta haqida gapira boshlashdi.

en: The student spoke about her with a peculiar relish and was continually laughing and the officer listened with great interest and asked him to send Lizaveta to do some mending for him.
uz: O'quvchi u haqida o'ziga xos taom bilan gapirgan va doimiy ravishda kulishgan edi va ofitser katta qiziqish bilan tinglab, unga Lizavetani unga tuzatish uchun yuborishni so'radi.

en: Raskolnikov did not miss a word and learned everything about her.
uz: Raskolnikov hech bir so'z o'tkazib yubormadi va u haqida hamma narsani bilib oldi.

en: Lizaveta was younger than the old woman and was her half-sister, being the child of a different mother.
uz: Lizaveta keksa ayoldan kichikroq va uning o'rtog'i singlisi edi, chunki u boshqa ona bolasi edi.

en: She was thirty-five.
uz: U o'ttiz besh yoshda edi.

en: She worked day and night for her sister, and besides doing the cooking and the washing, she did sewing and worked as a charwoman and gave her sister all she earned.
uz: U singlisi uchun kechayu kunduz ishlagan va ovqat pishirish va yuvishdan tashqari, tikuv va charm ayol sifatida ishlagan va kasb qilgan hamma narsasini singlisiga bergan.

en: She did not dare to accept an order or job of any kind without her sister’s permission.
uz: U singillarining ruxsatisiz biron bir topshiriqni yoki ishni qabul qilishga jur'at qilmadi.

en: The old woman had already made her will, and Lizaveta knew of it, and by this will she would not get a farthing; nothing but the movables, chairs and so on; all the money was left to a monastery in
uz: Keksa ayol allaqachon vasiyatnoma bergan edi va Lizaveta buni bilgan edi va bu vasiyatnoma orqali u hech bir fartinchga ega bo'lmasdi; faqat ko'chma jihozlar, o'rindiqlar va hokazolar bor edi; barcha pulni Monastirda saqlab qolgan.

en: the province of N — —, that prayers might be said for her in perpetuity.
uz: N viloyatida uning uchun ibodatlar abadiy bo'lishi uchun.

en: Lizaveta was of lower rank than her sister, unmarried and awfully uncouth in appearance, remarkably tall with long feet that looked as if they were bent outwards.
uz: Lizaveta singlisiga qaraganda kamroq darajadagi, turmush qurmagan va ko'rinishi juda yomon, baland va uzun oyoqlari tashqi ko'rinishda egri ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: She always wore battered goatskin shoes, and was clean in her person.
uz: U har doim echki teridan bo'lgan poyabzallar kiygan va o'z shaxsiyatida pok edi.

en: What the student expressed most surprise and amusement about was the fact that Lizaveta was continually with child.
uz: O'quvchi eng katta hayronlik va zavqni Lizaveta doimiy ravishda homilador bo'lganligi haqida izhor etdi.

en: “But you say she is hideous?” observed the officer.
uz: Ammo siz uning dahshatli ekanligini aytasizmi? - dedi politsiya boshlig'i.

en: “Yes, she is so dark-skinned and looks like a soldier dressed up, but you know she is not at all hideous.
uz: Ha, u juda qorong'u terli va kiyingan askarga o'xshaydi, ammo siz uning hech qanday dahshatli emasligini bilasiz.

en: She has such a good-natured face and eyes.
uz: Uning yuz va ko'zlari juda mehribon.

en: And the proof of it is that lots of people are attracted by her.
uz: Buning isboti shundaki, ko'plab odamlar unga jalb bo'lishadi.

en: She is such a soft, gentle creature, ready to put up with anything, always willing, willing to do anything.
uz: U juda yumshoq va mehribon mavjudot, har qanday narsaga tayyor, har doim tayyor, har qanday ishni qilishga tayyor.

en: And her smile is really very sweet.” “You seem to find her attractive yourself,” laughed the officer.
uz: Uning tabassumlari juda yoqimli. Siz ham uni jozibali deb topdingiz, - dedi politsiya boshlig'i.

en: “From her queerness.
uz: O'zining quirligi tufayli.

en: No, I’ll tell you what.
uz: Yo'q, men sizga nima deyman.

en: I could kill that damned old woman and make off with her money, I assure you, without the faintest conscience-prick,” the student added with warmth.
uz: Men o'sha qariya xotinni o'ldirib, uning pulini olib ketishim mumkin edi, sizga shuni aytib qo'yay: vijdonning kamchiligi bo'lmaganda", - deb qo'shimcha qildi o'quvchi.

en: The officer laughed again while Raskolnikov shuddered.
uz: Sarkar yana kulishdi, Raskolnikov esa shovqin qildi.

en: “Listen, I want to ask you a serious question,” the student said hotly.
uz: Quloq solinglar, men sizga jiddiy savol bermoqchiman, dedi o'quvchi qizg'in.

en: “I was joking of course, but look here; on one side we have a stupid, senseless, worthless, spiteful, ailing, horrid old woman, not simply useless but doing actual mischief, who has not an idea what she is living for herself, and who will die in a day or two in any case.
uz: Men, albatta, hazil qilib yurgan edim, lekin bir tomondan, bizda bir ahmoq, behuda, behuda, nafratli, kasal, dahshatli keksa ayol bor, u shunchaki behuda emas, balki haqiqiy yomonlik qiladi, u o'zi uchun nima yashayotganini bilmaydi va bir yoki ikki kun ichida o'ladi.

en: You understand?” “Yes, yes, I understand,” answered the officer, watching his excited companion attentively.
uz: Siz tushunasizmi?  Ha, ha, men tushunaman, - deb javob berdi ofitser, hayajonli hamkorini diqqat bilan kuzatib turdi.

en: On the other side, fresh young lives thrown away for want of help and by thousands, on every side!
uz: Boshqa tomondan, yangi yosh hayotlar yordamsiz va har tarafdan minglab odamlar tomonidan tashlab yuborilgan!

en: A hundred thousand good deeds could be done and helped, on that old woman’s money which will be buried in a monastery!
uz: Bu qariya ayolning monastirda ko'milgan pulidan yuz mingta yaxshilik qilish va yordam berish mumkin!

en: Hundreds, thousands perhaps, might be set on the right path; dozens of families saved from destitution, from ruin, from vice, from the Lock hospitals —and all with her money.
uz: Yuzlab, minglab kishilar to'g'ri yo'lga qo'yilgan bo'lishi mumkin; o'nlab oilalar qashshoqlikdan, vayronlikdan, yomonlikdan, Lock kasalxonalaridan qutqarilgan va bularning barchasi uning pullari bilan sodir bo'lgan.

en: Kill her, take her money and with the help of it devote oneself to the service of humanity and the good of all.
uz: Uni o'ldiring, uning pulini oling va uning yordamida o'zingizni insoniyatga va barchaga xizmat qilishga bag'ishlang.

en: What do you think, would not one tiny crime be wiped out by
uz: Sizningcha, birgina kichik jinoyatchilikni o'chirib tashlamasmidingiz?

en: thousands of good deeds?
uz: Minglab yaxshi ishlar?

en: For one life thousands would be saved from corruption and decay.
uz: Bir umr uchun minglab odamlar buzuqlik va buzuqlikdan xalos bo'lishadi.

en: One death, and a hundred lives in exchange —it’s simple arithmetic!
uz: Bir o'lim va yuzta hayot o'rniga oddiy aritmetika!

en: Besides, what value has the life of that sickly, stupid, ill-natured old woman in the balance of existence!
uz: Bundan tashqari, bu kasal, ahmoq va yomon tabiatga ega bo'lgan keksa ayolning hayoti mavjudotning muvozanatida qanchalik qadrli!

en: No more than the life of a louse, of a black-beetle, less in fact because the old woman is doing harm.
uz: O'g'rilarning, qora ko'piklarning hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq emas, aksincha, qariya ayol zarar yetkazayotganidan kamroq.

en: She is wearing out the lives of others; the other day she bit Lizaveta’s finger out of spite; it almost had to be amputated.” “Of course she does not deserve to live,” remarked the officer, “but there it is, it’s nature.” “Oh, well, brother, but we have to correct and direct nature, and, but for that, we should drown in an ocean of prejudice.
uz: U boshqalarning hayotini to'sib bormoqda; bir kun o'tgach, Lizaveta ning barmog'ini g'azabdan o'g'ibdi; u deyarli kesib tashlanishi kerak edi. Albatta, u yashashga loyiq emas, xodimi aytdi, lekin u erda, bu tabiat. Oh, yaxshi, aka, lekin biz tabiatni tuzatishimiz va yo'naltirishimiz kerak va, lekin buning uchun, biz oldindan o'ylaydigan okeanga cho'kishimiz kerak.

en: But for that, there would never have been a single great man.
uz: Ammo buning uchun hech qachon bitta ham buyuk odam bo'lmagan.

en: They talk of duty, conscience —I don’t want to say anything against duty and conscience; —but the point is, what do we mean by them?
uz: Ular burch, vijdon haqida gapirishadi.Men burch va vijdonga qarshi hech narsa aytmoqchi emasman; lekin asosiy savol shundaki, biz bu so'zlar bilan nimani nazarda tutyapmiz?

en: Stay, I have another question to ask you.
uz: Qoling, senga yana bir savolim bor.

en: Listen!” “No, you stay, I’ll ask you a question.
uz: Quloq soling!  Yo'q, siz qoling, men sizga bir savol beraman.

en: Listen!” “Well?” “You are talking and speechifying away, but tell me, would you kill the old woman yourself?” “Of course not!
uz: Quloq soling! Xo'sh? Siz gapiryapsiz va gapirib yuryapsiz, lekin menga ayting, siz keksa ayolni o'zingiz o'ldirasizmi? Albatta, yo'q!

en: I was only arguing the justice of it.
uz: Men faqat uning adolatliligini ta'kidlab o'tgan edim.

en: … It’s nothing to do with me.
uz: Bu men bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q.

en: …” “But I think, if you would not do it yourself, there’s no justice about it.
uz: Ammo men o'ylaymanki, agar siz buni o'zingiz qilmasangiz, bunda adolat yo'q.

en: … Let us have another game.” Raskolnikov was violently agitated.
uz: ... Keling, yana bir o'yin o'ynaylik. Raskolnikov zo'ravonlik bilan g'ayratga tushdi.

en: Of course, it was all ordinary youthful talk and thought, such as he had often heard before in different forms and on different themes.
uz: Albatta, bularning hammasi oddiy yoshlarning gaplari va fikrlari edi, chunki u bundan oldin turli xil shakllarda va turli mavzularda ko'pincha eshitgan edi.

en: But why had he happened to hear such a discussion and such ideas at the very moment when his own brain was just conceiving … the very same ideas?
uz: Ammo nega u o'zining miyasi o'sha-o'sha fikrlarni tasavvur qilib yurgan paytda bunday bahs-munozara va g'oyalarni eshitgan?

en: And why, just at the moment when he had brought away the embryo of his idea from the old woman had he dropped at once upon a conversation about her?
uz: Va nima uchun, o'z g'oyasi embrionini keksa ayoldan olib kelgan paytda, u o'sha ayol haqida suhbatga to'xtab qo'ydi?

en: This coincidence always seemed strange to him.
uz: Bu hodisa unga har doim g'alati tuyulgan.

en: This trivial talk in a tavern had an immense influence on him in his later action; as though there had really been in it something preordained, some guiding hint.
uz: Shavondagi bu behuda nutq uning keyingi harakatlariga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi; xuddi o'sha nutqda o'zidan oldindan belgilab qo'yilgan narsa, yo'l-yo'riq beruvchi biron bir nuqta bo'lgani kabi.

en: On returning from the Hay Market he flung himself on the sofa and sat for a whole hour without stirring.
uz: Hay bozoridan qaytganida u o'zini sofaga tashladi va butun bir soat o'tirdi.

en: Meanwhile it got dark; he had no candle and, indeed, it did not occur to him to light up.
uz: Shu bilan birga, qorong'i bo'ldi; uning chiroqlari yo'q edi va chindan ham, u parvo qilmoqchi bo'lmagan.

en: He could never recollect whether he had been thinking about anything at that time.
uz: U o'sha paytda biror narsa haqida o'ylayotganini hech qachon eslay olmagan.

en: At last he was conscious of his former fever and shivering, and he realised with relief that he could lie down on the sofa.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u o'zining sobiq issiqligi va titrashidan xabardor bo'ldi va u o'zini sofa ustiga yotishi mumkinligini yengillik bilan angladi.

en: Soon heavy, leaden sleep came over him, as it were crushing him.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, uni qattiq uyqu ushlab qoldi.

en: He slept an extraordinarily long time and without dreaming.
uz: U juda uzoq vaqt uxladi va hech qanday orzu qilmadi.

en: Nastasya, coming into his room at ten o’clock the next morning, had difficulty in rousing him.
uz: Nastasya ertasi kuni ertalab soat o'nlarda o'z xonasiga kirib, uni uyg'otishda qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi.

en: She brought him in tea and bread.
uz: U unga choy va non keltirdi.

en: The tea was again the second brew and again in her own teapot.
uz: Choy yana ikkinchi marta, yana o'zining choy qabida bo'lgan.

en: “My goodness, how he sleeps!” she cried indignantly.
uz: "Xudoyim, qanday uxlaydi!" - deb g'azabda yig'ladi u.

en: “And he is always asleep.” He got up with an effort.
uz: Va u har doim uxlab turadi. U kuch bilan turdi.

en: His head ached, he stood up, took a turn in his garret and sank back on the sofa again.
uz: Bosh og'rig'i bo'lgani uchun u o'rnidan turdi, o'z garretida o'girilib, yana sofaga tushdi.

en: “Going to sleep again,” cried Nastasya.
uz: Yana uxlashga ketyapman, - deb qayg'urdi Nastasya.

en: “Are you ill, eh?” He made no reply.
uz: Siz kasalmisiz? U hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: “Do you want some tea?” “Afterwards,” he said with an effort, closing his eyes again and turning to the wall.
uz: Shundan so'ng,  o'z ko'zlarini yana yopib, devorga yuz o'girdi.

en: Nastasya stood over him.
uz: Nastasya uning ustida turdi.

en: “Perhaps he really is ill,” she said, turned and went out.
uz: Ehtimol, u haqiqatan ham bemor, dedi u, o'girilib tashqariga chiqdi.

en: She came in again at two o’clock with soup.
uz: U soat ikkilarda yana kelib, supani olib keldi.

en: He was lying as before.
uz: U avvalgidek yolg'on gapirgan.

en: The tea stood untouched.
uz: Choy hech kimga tegmagan edi.

en: Nastasya felt positively offended and began wrathfully rousing him.
uz: Nastasya o'zini qattiq xafa his qilib, uni g'azab bilan uyg'otishga tushdi.

en: “Why are you lying like a log?” she shouted, looking at him with repulsion.
uz: Nima uchun siz daraxt kabi yolg'on gapiryapsiz? - deb baqirdi u, unga nafrat bilan qarab.

en: He got up, and sat down again, but said nothing and stared at the floor.
uz: U o'rnidan turib yana o'tirdi, lekin hech narsa aytmadi va yerga tikilib qaradi.

en: “Are you ill or not?” asked Nastasya and again received no answer.
uz: Siz kasalmisiz yoki yo'qmi? deb so'radi Nastasya va yana hech qanday javob olmadi.

en: “You’d better go out and get a breath of air,” she said after a pause.
uz: "Siz tashqariga chiqib, bir oz nafas olsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi", - dedi u to'xtatishdan so'ng.

en: “Will you eat it or not?” “Afterwards,” he said weakly.
uz: Siz uni yeyapsizmi yoki yo'qmi? Keyinchalik, u zaiflik bilan dedi.

en: “You can go.” And he motioned her out.
uz: Siz ketishingiz mumkin. Va u ayolga ishora qildi.

en: She remained a little longer, looked at him with compassion and went out.
uz: U biroz ko'proq qoldi, unga achinadi va tashqariga chiqdi.

en: A few minutes afterwards, he raised his eyes and looked for a long while at the tea and the soup.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, u ko'zlarini ko'tarib, choy va shoppani ko'rib ko'rdi.

en: Then he took the bread, took up a spoon and began to eat.
uz: So'ngra nonni olib, qichqorni ko'tarib, ovqatlanishni boshladi.

en: He ate a little, three or four spoonfuls, without appetite, as it were mechanically.
uz: U ozgina, uch yoki to'rt qoshiq ovqat yeydi, bu mehkaniy ravishda, xohish-irodasini yo'q qildi.

en: His head ached less.
uz: Uning boshi kamroq og'riqli edi.

en: After his meal he stretched himself on the sofa again, but now he could not sleep; he lay without stirring, with his face in the pillow.
uz: Ovqatdan so'ng yana o'zini sofaga uzatib qo'ydi, ammo endi uxlay olmadi; u ko'tarilmasdan, yuzini yostiga tikib, yotgan edi.

en: He was haunted by daydreams and such strange daydreams; in one, that kept recurring, he fancied that he was in Africa, in Egypt, in some sort of oasis.
uz: U tushlar va g'ayritabiiy tushlar bilan ovora edi; birida u o'zini Afrikada, Misrda, biron bir oazda deb o'ylardi.

en: The caravan was resting, the camels were peacefully lying down; the palms stood all around in a complete circle; all the party were at dinner.
uz: Karavan dam olgan edi, tuyalar xotirjam o'tirgan edi; palmalar to'liq to'plamda to'xtab turishgan edi; butun jamoa kechki ovqatda o'tirgan edi.

en: But he was drinking water from a spring which flowed gurgling close by.
uz: Ammo u yaqin atrofda oqib turgan buloqdan suv ichgan.

en: And it was so cool, it was wonderful, wonderful, blue, cold water running among the particoloured stones and over the clean sand which glistened here and there like gold.
uz: Va u juda sovuq edi, ajoyib, ajoyib, ko'k, sovuq suv, toshlar va toza qumning ustiga oqib o'tadi, bu yerda-bu yerda oltin kabi shishalib turardi.

en: … Suddenly he heard a clock strike.
uz: Birdan u soat urishining ovozini eshitdi.

en: He started, roused himself, raised his head, looked out of the window, and seeing how late it was, suddenly jumped up wide awake as though someone had pulled him off the sofa.
uz: U boshladi, o'zini uyg'otdi, boshini ko'tarib, darvoza tomoniga qaradi va vaqt qanchalik kech bo'lganini ko'rib, to'satdan o'zidan turib ketdi, xuddi kimdir uni kanepadan ushlab qo'ygan bo'lsa kerak.

en: He crept on tiptoe to the door, stealthily opened it and began listening on the staircase.
uz: U eshikga oyoq boshiga kirdi, uni yashirincha ochdi va sinchkovlik bilan tinglay boshladi.

en: His heart beat terribly.
uz: Uning yuragi dahshatli urib ketdi.

en: But all was quiet on the stairs as if everyone was asleep.
uz: Lekin mertabanlarda hamma uxlab yotgan kabi tinchlik hukm surardi.

en: … It seemed to him strange and monstrous that he could have slept in such forgetfulness from the previous day and had done nothing, had prepared nothing yet.
uz: U o'ziga g'alati va dahshatli ko'rinardi, chunki u o'tgan kunning o'tmishini unutib, hech narsa qilmagan, hech narsa tayyorgarlik ko'rmagan edi.

en: … And meanwhile perhaps it had struck six.
uz: Shu bilan birga, ehtimol oltita bo'lgan.

en: And his drowsiness and stupefaction were followed by an extraordinary, feverish, as it were distracted haste.
uz: Uning uyqusizligi va befarqligi o'zgacha, qizg'in, chalg'itadigan shoshilinchlik bilan kuzatildi.

en: But the preparations to be made were few.
uz: Ammo tayyorgarlik ko'rish juda oz edi.

en: He concentrated all his energies on thinking of everything and forgetting nothing; and his heart kept beating and thumping so that he could hardly breathe.
uz: U butun kuchini hamma narsani o'ylashga va hech narsani unutishga qaratdi; yuragi esa og'ir urib, o'z jonini tiyib turardi, hatto nafas olishni ham qiyinlashtirardi.

en: First he had to make a noose and sew it into his overcoat —a work of a moment.
uz: Avval u bir to'plamni tayyorlab, uni kiyimga tikishi kerak edi.

en: He rummaged under his pillow and picked out amongst the linen stuffed away under it, a worn out, old unwashed shirt.
uz: U yastog'i ostida o'tirib, uning ostida to'ldirilgan to'qimalar orasidan eskirgan, eski yuvmagan ko'ylakni tanladi.

en: From its rags he tore a long strip, a couple of inches wide and about sixteen inches long.
uz: Uning to'qimalaridan u bir necha dyuym keng va taxminan o'n olti dyuym uzun bo'lgan uzun chiziqni yirtib yubordi.

en: He folded this strip in two, took off his wide, strong summer overcoat of some stout cotton material (his only outer garment) and began sewing the two ends of the rag on the inside, under the left armhole.
uz: U bu chiziqni ikkiga bo'lib qo'ydi, o'zining keng, kuchli yozgi kiyimini (o'zining yagona tashqi kiyimidan) olib tashladi va ichki kiyimning ikki tomini chap armog'i ostida tikishni boshladi.

en: His hands shook as he sewed, but he did it successfully so that nothing showed outside when he put the coat on
uz: Uning qo'llari tikuvchilik qilayotganda titraydi, lekin u buni muvaffaqiyatli qildi, shuning uchun kiyimni kiyganida hech narsa tashqarida ko'rinmasdi.

en: The needle and thread he had got ready long before and they lay on his table in a piece of paper.
uz: U ancha vaqt oldin tayyorlagan igna va iplar uning stolida qog'oz bo'ylab yotgan edi.

en: As for the noose, it was a very ingenious device of his own; the noose was intended for the axe.
uz: Qo'lni o'zi o'zi yaratgan juda daftonli qurilma edi; qo'lni o'g'irga o'rnatish uchun yaratilgan edi.

en: It was impossible for him to carry the axe through the street in his hands.
uz: Uning o'zi uchun o'g'irni ko'chadan ko'tarib o'tish imkonsiz edi.

en: And if hidden under his coat he would still have had to support it with his hand, which would have been noticeable.
uz: Agar kiyim ostida yashirilsa, uni qo'li bilan qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak edi, bu esa sezilarli bo'lardi.

en: Now he had only to put the head of the axe in the noose, and it would hang quietly under his arm on the inside.
uz: Endi u faqat o'g'irning boshini ipga qo'yish kerak edi va u ichki qismida uning qo'li ostida sekin oshib turardi.

en: Putting his hand in his coat pocket, he could hold the end of the handle all the way, so that it did not swing; and as the coat was very full, a regular sack in fact, it could not be seen from outside that he was holding something with the hand that was in the pocket.
uz: Qo'lini kiyimining qoshiqlariga qo'yib, u qo'lni to'liq ushlab turishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun u o'zganmasdi; va kiyim juda to'liq bo'lgani uchun, aslida, odatdagi sumka, tashqaridan ko'rinmas edi, chunki u kiyimdagi qo'li bilan biror narsani ushlab turganini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: This noose, too, he had designed a fortnight before.
uz: Bu ip ham o'n ikki hafta oldin loyihalashtirilgan edi.

en: When he had finished with this, he thrust his hand into a little opening between his sofa and the floor, fumbled in the left corner and drew out the pledge, which he had got ready long before and hidden there.
uz: Buni tugatganida, u qo'lini sofa va qavat o'rtasida kichik bo'shliqga qo'ydi, chap burchada o'tirib, uzoq vaqt oldin tayyorlab qo'ygan va o'sha yerda yashirib qo'ygan garovni olib chiqdi.

en: This pledge was, however, only a smoothly planed piece of wood the size and thickness of a silver cigarette case.
uz: Biroq, bu va'da faqat kumush sigareta qutisi o'lchamlari va qallig'i bo'lgan bir qism yog'ochdan iborat edi.

en: He picked up this piece of wood in one of his wanderings in a courtyard where there was some sort of a workshop.
uz: U o'zining hovlisidagi bir sayohatida o'sha daraxtni topib oldi, u yerda o'quv xonasi bo'lgan edi.

en: Afterwards he had added to the wood a thin smooth piece of iron, which he had also picked up at the same time in the street.
uz: Keyinchalik u yog'ochga bir oz lazzatli temir qo'shgan edi, uni ko'chada bir vaqtning o'zida olib kelgan edi.

en: Putting the iron which was a little the smaller on the piece of wood, he fastened them very firmly, crossing and re-crossing the thread round them; then wrapped them carefully and daintily in clean white paper and tied up the parcel so that it would be very difficult to untie it.
uz: U daraxt ustiga biroz kichikroq bo'lgan temirni qo'yib, ularni juda qattiq bog'ladi, ular atrofidagi ipni kesib o'tadi va qayta kesib o'tadi; so'ngra ularni toza oq qog'ozga ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'rab olib, paketni bog'lab qo'ydi, shuning uchun uni bo'shatish juda qiyin bo'ladi.

en: This was in order to divert the attention of the old woman for a time, while she was trying to undo the knot, and so to gain a moment.
uz: Bu esa keksa ayolning e'tiborini biroz chalg'itish maqsadida, u to'qnashuvni bekor qilishga harakat qilganda, biroz vaqtni o'tkazish uchun qilingan edi.

en: The iron strip was added to give weight, so that the woman might not guess the first minute that the “thing” was made of wood.
uz: Temir chiziq o'lchash uchun qo'shildi, shuning uchun ayol birinchi daqiqada thingning yog'ochdan qilinganligini bilmasligi mumkin edi.

en: All this had been stored by him beforehand under the sofa.
uz: Bularning barchasini o'zi sofa ostida oldindan saqlagan edi.

en: He had only just got the pledge out when he heard someone suddenly about in the yard.
uz: O'sha paytda u hovlida kimdir paydo bo'lganini eshitib, faqatgina va'da olgan edi.

en: “It struck six long ago.” “Long ago!
uz: Bu olti yil oldin sodir bo'ldi.   uzoq vaqt oldin!

en: My God!” He rushed to the door, listened, caught up his hat and began to descend his thirteen steps cautiously, noiselessly, like a cat.
uz: Hy Xudoyim! U eshik tomon shovqin qildi, tingladi, g'azabini ko'tarib, o'n uch qadamni ehtiyotkorlik bilan, shovqinsiz, mushuk kabi pastga tushdi.

en: He had still the most important thing to do —to steal the axe from the kitchen.
uz: U hali ham qilish uchun eng muhim ish bor edi - oshxonadan baltni o'g'irlash.

en: That the deed must be done with an axe he had decided long ago.
uz: Bu ish uzoq vaqt oldin o'zi qaror qilgan o'g'ir bilan amalga oshirilishi kerakligi haqida.

en: He had also a pocket pruning-knife, but he could not rely on the knife and still less on his own strength, and so resolved finally on the axe.
uz: Shuningdek, uning kiyimida kesish quroli ham bor edi, lekin u quroli va hatto o'z kuch-qudratiga tayanolmadi va nihoyat, o'z ixtiyorini o'rnatdi.

en: We may note in passing, one peculiarity in regard to all the final resolutions taken by him in the matter; they had one strange characteristic: the more final they were, the more hideous and the more absurd they at once became in his eyes.
uz: Bu borada uning qabul qilgan barcha qarorlari haqida bir xil xarakterli fikrga e'tibor qaratishimiz mumkin; ular bir xil g'alati xususiyatga ega edi: ular qanchalik nihoyasiga yetgan bo'lsa, uning nazarida shunchalik dahshatli va absurd bo'lgan.

en: In spite of all his agonising inward struggle, he never for a single instant all that time could believe in the carrying out of his plans.
uz: O'zining og'ir ichki kurashlariga qaramay, u o'z rejalarini amalga oshirishga hech bir daqiqa ham ishonolmadi.

en: And, indeed, if it had ever happened that everything to the least point could have been considered and finally settled, and no uncertainty of any kind had remained, he would, it seems, have renounced it all as something absurd, monstrous and impossible.
uz: Darhaqiqat, agar hamma narsa, eng kam darajada, ko'rib chiqilishi va nihoyat hal qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan va hech qanday noaniqlik qolmagan bo'lsa edi, u bularning barchasidan absurd, dahshatli va imkonsiz narsa deb voz kechgan bo'lardi.

en: But a whole mass of unsettled points and uncertainties remained.
uz: Ammo ko'p ko'plab nolish va noaniqliklar mavjud edi.

en: As for getting the axe, that trifling business cost him no anxiety, for nothing could be easier.
uz: O'sha g'alati ish unga hech qanday tashvish keltirmadi, chunki hech narsa osonroq bo'lmaydi.

en: Nastasya was continually out of the house, especially in the evenings; she would run in to the neighbours or to a shop, and always left the door ajar.
uz: Nastasya doimo uydan tashqariga chiqardi, ayniqsa kechqurun; u qo'shnilar yoki do'konga yugurib kirib, eshikni har doim ochiq qoldirdi.

en: It was the one thing the landlady was always scolding her about.
uz: Uy egasi uni har doim tanqid qilgan yagona narsa shu edi.

en: And so, when the time came, he would only have to go quietly into the kitchen and to take the axe, and an hour later (when everything was over) go in and put it back again.
uz: Shunday qilib, vaqt kelganda, u faqatgina oshxonada xotirjamlik bilan kirib, ishakni olib, bir soatdan so'ng (barcha narsa tugagandan so'ng) ichkariga kirib, uni yana qo'yish kerak edi.

en: But these were doubtful points.
uz: Ammo bu savollar shubhali edi.

en: Supposing he returned an hour later to put it back, and Nastasya had come back and was on the spot.
uz: Bir soat o'tgach qaytib kelib, uni qaytarib qo'yganini tasavvur qiling, Nastasya qaytib kelib, o'rinni topdi.

en: He would of course have to go by and wait till she went out again.
uz: Albatta, u o'sha ayol yana tashqariga chiqmaguncha o'tishi kerak bo'ladi.

en: But supposing she were in the meantime to miss the axe, look for it, make an outcry —that would mean suspicion or at least grounds for suspicion.
uz: Lekin agar u o'sha vaqt ichida o'g'lini yo'qotib qo'ygan bo'lsa, uni qidirib topib, g'alayon gapirib, shubhani yoki hech bo'lmaganda shubhani bildiradi.

en: But those were all trifles which he had not even begun to consider, and indeed he had no time.
uz: Ammo bularning hammasi u hatto o'ylashga ham kirmagan va vaqt ham bo'lmagan kichik ishlar edi.

en: He was thinking of the chief point, and put off trifling details, until he could believe in it all.
uz: U asosiy mavzu haqida o'ylayotgan edi va hamma narsaga ishonmaguncha, kichik tafsilotlarni qoldirgan.

en: But that seemed utterly unattainable.
uz: Ammo bu mutlaqo erishish mumkin emasdek tuyuldi.

en: So it seemed to himself at least.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda o'ziga shunday tuyuldi.

en: He could not imagine, for instance, that he would sometime leave off thinking, get up and simply go there.
uz: Misol uchun, u o'zi o'ylab ko'rishni to'xtatib, turib, shunchaki u yerga borishini tasavvur ham qila olmagan.

en: … Even his late experiment (i.e.
uz: Hatto uning oxirgi tajribasi (ya'ni) ham.

en: his visit with the object of a final survey of the place) was simply an attempt at an experiment, far from being the real thing, as though one should say “come, let us go and try it —why dream about it!” —and at once he had broken down and had run away cursing, in a frenzy with himself.
uz: Uning bu joyni so'nggi marta ko'rib chiqish maqsadi bilan tashrif buyurganligi) shunchaki tajriba qilishga urinish edi, bu haqiqiy narsa emas edi, deyarli shunday bo'lishi kerak edi: "Qo'ng, borib sinab ko'raylik, nima uchun bu haqda orzu qilyapman! va birdan u tushkunlikka tushib, o'z-o'zidan g'azablanib, la'natib ketib ketgan edi.

en: Meanwhile it would seem, as regards the moral question, that his analysis was complete; his casuistry had become keen as a razor, and he could not find rational objections in himself.
