uz: Shu bilan birga, axloqiy savolga nisbatan uning tahlillari to'liq bo'lganiga o'xshaydi; uning kasuzistligi o'g'irlanuvchi o'g'irlangan va u o'z-o'zidan oqilona e'tirozlar topa olmaydi.

en: But in the last resort he simply ceased to believe in himself, and doggedly, slavishly sought arguments in all directions, fumbling for them, as though someone were forcing and drawing him to it.
uz: Ammo oxir-oqibat u o'ziga ishonishni to'xtatdi va qat'iylik bilan, qullik bilan barcha yo'nalishlarda bahs-munozaralar izladi, xuddi kimdir uni majburlab, unga jalb qilgandek, ularni o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: At first —long before indeed —he had been much occupied with one question; why almost all crimes are so badly concealed and so easily detected, and why almost all criminals leave such obvious traces?
uz: Dastlab u bir savol bilan juda band edi; nega deyarli barcha jinoyatlar shunchalik yaxshi yashirilgan va osonlikcha aniqlangan va nega deyarli barcha jinoyatchilar bunday aniq iz qoldirishadi?

en: He had come gradually to many different and curious conclusions, and in his opinion the chief reason lay not so much in the material impossibility of concealing the crime, as in the criminal himself.
uz: U asta-sekin ko'plab turli xil va qiziqarli xulosalarga keldi va uning fikriga ko'ra, asosiy sabab jinoyatni yashirishning moddiy imkoni bo'lmaganda emas, balki jinoyatchining o'zida.

en: Almost every criminal is subject to a failure of will and reasoning power by a childish and phenomenal heedlessness, at the very instant when prudence and caution are most essential.
uz: Deyarli har bir jinoyatchi o'z irodasini va fikrlash qobiliyatini bolalik va fenomenal befarqlik bilan yo'qotib qo'yadi, ayniqsa ehtiyotkorlik va ehtiyotkorlik eng muhim bo'lgan paytda.

en: It was his conviction that this eclipse of reason and failure of will power attacked a man like a disease, developed gradually and reached its highest point just before the perpetration of the crime, continued with equal violence at the moment of the crime and for longer or shorter time after, according to the individual case, and then passed off like any other disease.
uz: Uning e'tiqodi shundaki, bu aql tutish va irodasini yo'qotish insonni kasallik kabi hujum qiladi, bu kasallik sodir etilishidan oldin asta-sekin rivojlanadi va eng yuqori nuqtaga yetadi, jinoyat sodir etilish paytida ham, keyinchalik ham, har bir kishining holatiga ko'ra, uzoq yoki qisqa vaqt davomida teng zo'ravonlik bilan davom etadi va keyin boshqa kasalliklar kabi o'tadi.

en: The question whether the disease gives rise to the crime, or whether the crime from its own peculiar nature is always accompanied by something of the nature of disease, he did not yet feel able to decide.
uz: Kasallik jinoyatni keltirib chiqaradimi yoki uning o'ziga xos xususiyatiga ko'ra jinoyat har doim kasallik xususiyatiga ega bo'lgan narsadan iboratmi, degan savolga u hali qaror chiqarishga qodir emas edi.

en: When he reached these conclusions, he decided that in his own case there could not be such a morbid reaction, that his reason and will would remain unimpaired at the time of carrying out his design, for the simple reason that his design was “not a crime.
uz: Ushbu xulosalarga kelganida, u o'z holatida bunday kasal reaktsiya bo'lishi mumkin emasligini, uning dizaynini amalga oshirish paytida uning sabab va irodasi o'zgarmasligi kerakligini tan oldi, chunki uning dizayni jinoyat bo'lmagan.

en: …” We will omit all the process by means of which he arrived at this last conclusion; we have run too far ahead already.
uz: ... Bu oxirgi xulosaga kelgan barcha jarayonlarni qoldiramiz; biz allaqachon juda uzoq davom ettirdik.

en: … We may add only that the practical, purely material difficulties of the affair occupied a secondary position in his mind.
uz: ... Faqatgina shuni qo'shishimiz mumkinki, ishning amaliy, sof moddiy qiyinchiliklari uning ongida ikkinchi darajali o'rinni egallagan.

en: “One has but to keep all one’s willpower and reason to deal with them, and they will all be overcome at the time when once one has familiarised oneself with the minutest details of the business.
uz: Boshqalari bilan shug'ullanish uchun barcha xohish-irodasini va aql-idrokini saqlab qolish kerak va bularning barchasi biznesning eng kichik tafsilotlari bilan tanishtirilganidan so'ng yengiladi.

en: …” But this preparation had never been begun.
uz: Ammo bu tayyorgarlik hech qachon boshlanmagan edi.

en: His final decisions were what he came to trust
uz: Uning oxirgi qarorlari u ishonadigan kishilar edi.

en: least, and when the hour struck, it all came to pass quite differently, as it were accidentally and unexpectedly.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, soat o'tgach, hamma narsa o'zgacha bo'lib, xuddi tasodifan va kutilmagan tarzda sodir bo'ldi.

en: One trifling circumstance upset his calculations, before he had even left the staircase.
uz: U hatto mertabanni tashlab ketishidan oldin, bitta kichik holat uning hisob-kitoblarini buzdi.

en: When he reached the landlady’s kitchen, the door of which was open as usual, he glanced cautiously in to see whether, in Nastasya’s absence, the landlady herself was there, or if not, whether the door to her own room was closed, so that she might not peep out when he went in for the axe.
uz: U odatdagidek eshik ochiq bo'lgan uy egasining oshxonasiga yetib kelganida, Nastasyaxning yo'qligida uy egasi o'sha yerda bo'lgan-bo'lmaganini yoki o'z xonasiga kiradigan eshik yopilgan-bo'lmaganini ko'rish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'z ochdi.

en: But what was his amazement when he suddenly saw that Nastasya was not only at home in the kitchen, but was occupied there, taking linen out of a basket and hanging it on a line.
uz: Ammo Nastasya nafaqat uyda, balki oshxonada ham bo'lganini ko'rib, hayron bo'lganidan so'ng, u bir koshdan to'qima olib, uni chiziqga osib qo'yganini ko'rib, hayron qoldi.

en: Seeing him, she left off hanging the clothes, turned to him and stared at him all the time he was passing.
uz: Uni ko'rib, kiyimlarini osib tashlashni to'xtatdi, o'ziga qarab, o'tib ketayotganda unga tikilib qaradi.

en: He turned away his eyes, and walked past as though he noticed nothing.
uz: U ko'zlarini o'zgartirib, hech narsa sezmayotgandek o'tib ketdi.

en: But it was the end of everything; he had not the axe!
uz: Ammo bu hammaning oxiri edi; u o'z ixtiyorida emas edi!

en: “What made me think,” he reflected, as he went under the gateway, “what made me think that she would be sure not to be at home at that moment!
uz: U darvoza ostida o'tirganida, o'ylab ko'rdimki, u o'sha paytda u uyda bo'lmasligiga amin bo'lishim kerak edi.

en: Why, why, why did I assume this so certainly?” He was crushed and even humiliated.
uz: Nima uchun, nima uchun, nega men buni shu qadar aniq ko'rdim? U tushkunlikka tushdi va hatto xorlikka tushdi.

en: He could have laughed at himself in his anger.
uz: U g'azabda o'ziga kulishi mumkin edi.

en: … A dull animal rage boiled within him.
uz: Uning ichida g'alati hayvon g'azabini ko'tardi.

en: He stood hesitating in the gateway.
uz: U darvoza oldida toʻxtamay turibdi.

en: To go into the street, to go a walk for appearance’ sake was revolting; to go back to his room, even more revolting.
uz: Ko'chaga chiqish, tashqi ko'rinish uchun yurish dahshatli edi; o'z xonasiga qaytish esa yanada dahshatli edi.

en: “And what a chance I have lost for ever!” he muttered, standing aimlessly in the gateway, just opposite the porter’s little dark room, which was also open.
uz: Va men abadiy yo'qotgan imkoniyatim qanday! - deb gapirdi u, eshikda, daryodagi kichik qorong'i xonaning qarshisida, u ham ochiq edi.

en: Suddenly he started.
uz: Toʻsatdan u boshladi.

en: From the porter’s room, two paces away from him, something shining under the bench to the right caught his eye.
uz: Undan ikki qadam uzoqlikda bo'lgan portier xonasidan o'ng tomondagi bank ostida shinam bir narsa uning ko'zini qamrab oldi.

en: … He looked about him —nobody.
uz: U atrofida hech kim ko'rmadi.

en: He approached the room on tiptoe, went down two steps into it and in a faint voice called the porter.
uz: U xonaga oyoq boshiga yaqinlashdi, ikki qadam pastga tushdi va o'z ovozini porter deb atadi.

en: Somewhere near though, in the yard, for the door is wide open.” He dashed to the axe (it was an axe) and pulled it out from under the bench, where it lay between two chunks of wood; at once, before going out, he made it fast in the noose, he thrust both hands into his pockets and went out of the room; no one had noticed him!
uz: Lekin u yerda, hovlida, chunki eshik keng ochilgan edi. U o'sha o'g'ilni (bu o'g'il bo'lgan) o'g'ilga yugurib, o'g'ilni bank ostidagi o'g'ilni ikki daraxt oralig'idan olib chiqdi; darhol, tashqariga chiqishdan oldin, o'g'il o'g'ilni o'g'ilga qo'yib, ikkala qo'lini ham o'z qoplariga qo'ydi va xonadan chiqib ketdi; uni hech kim ko'rmagan edi!

en: “When reason fails, the devil helps!” he thought with a strange grin.
uz: Agar aql yo'q bo'lsa, shayton yordam beradi! deb o'yladi u g'alati tabassum bilan.

en: This chance raised his spirits extraordinarily.
uz: Bu imkoniyat uning ruhini ajoyib tarzda ko'tardi.

en: He walked along quietly and sedately, without hurry, to avoid awakening suspicion.
uz: U shubha uyg'otmaslik uchun shoshilmasdan, tinch va xotirjamlik bilan yurdi.

en: He scarcely looked at the passersby, tried to escape looking at their faces at all, and to be as little noticeable as possible.
uz: U o'tib ketayotganlarga atigi qaramasdi, ularning yuzlariga qaramasdan qochib ketishga harakat qildi va iloji boricha kamroq ko'rinishga ega bo'ldi.

en: Suddenly he thought of his hat.
uz: Toʻsatdan u oʻzining toʻpkasi haqida oʻyladi.

en: I had the money the day before yesterday and did not get a cap to wear instead!” A curse rose from the bottom of his soul.
uz: Kecha pulim bor edi va uning o'rniga kiymak uchun to'pka olmaganman! Uning ruhi tubidan la'nati ko'tarildi.

en: Glancing out of the corner of his eye into a shop, he saw by a clock on the wall that it was ten minutes past seven.
uz: Ko'z burchagidan do'konga qarab, u devordagi soatdan o'n daqiqa yetti pastini ko'rdi.

en: He had to make haste and at the same time to go someway round, so as to approach the house from the other side.
uz: U darrov harakat qilib, bir yo'l bilan atrofga borishi kerak edi, shuning uchun u uyga boshqa tomondan yaqinlashishi kerak edi.

en: … When he had happened to imagine all this beforehand, he had sometimes thought that he would be very much afraid.
uz: ... Bularning barchasini oldindan tasavvur qilganida, u ba'zan juda qo'rqadi deb o'ylagan.

en: But he was not very much afraid now, was not afraid at all, indeed.
uz: Ammo u endi juda ham qo'rqmagan, umuman qo'rqmagan.

en: His mind was even occupied by irrelevant matters, but by nothing for long.
uz: Uning ongini hatto ahamiyati yo'q narsalar egallab olgan, lekin uzoq vaqt hech narsa bilan shug'ullanmagan.

en: As he passed the Yusupov garden, he was deeply absorbed in considering the building of great fountains, and of their refreshing effect on the atmosphere in all the squares.
uz: Yusupov bog'idan o'tib borganida, u buyuk quduqlarning qurilishini va ularning barcha maydonlardagi atmosferaga ta'sirini ko'rib, chuqur o'ziga jalb bo'ldi.

en: By degrees he passed to the conviction that if the summer garden were extended to the field of Mars, and perhaps joined to the garden of the Mihailovsky Palace, it would be a splendid thing and a great benefit to the town.
uz: Keyinchalik u yoz bog'i Mars maydonigacha kengaytirilsa va ehtimol Mihailovskiy saroy bog'iga qo'shilsa, bu shahar uchun ajoyib va katta foyda keltiradi degan fikrga o'tdi.

en: Then he was interested by the question why in all great towns men are not simply driven by necessity, but in some peculiar way inclined to live in those parts of the town where there are no gardens nor fountains; where there is most dirt and smell and all sorts of nastiness.
uz: Keyin esa, barcha buyuk shaharlarda odamlar nega shunchaki zarurat bilan emas, balki shaharning bog'lari va buloqlari bo'lmagan joylarida yashashga moyil bo'lishadi; bu yerda ko'proq tok-to'lqin, xushbo'ylik va har qanday yomonlik bor.

en: Then his own walks through the Hay Market came back to his mind, and for a moment he waked up to reality.
uz: Keyin o'zlarining Hay bozori orqali o'tishlarini esladi va bir zum davomida u haqiqatga uyg'ondi.

en: “What nonsense!” he thought, “better think of nothing at all!” “So probably men led to execution clutch mentally at every object that meets them on the way,” flashed through his mind, but simply flashed, like lightning; he made haste to dismiss this thought.
uz: Qanday axmoqlik! o'yladi,  hech narsa haqida o'ylamaslik yaxshiroq! Shunday qilib, ehtimol odamlar yo'lda uchrashadigan har bir ob'ektga g'amxo'rlik qilib, o'z fikrini o'zgartirgan, lekin shunchaki chaqmoq kabi o'zgartirgan; u bu fikrni rad etishga shoshildi.

en: … And by now he was near; here was the house, here was the gate.
uz: Va hozir u yaqinlashib qoldi; mana uyning, mana eshikning.

en: Suddenly a clock somewhere struck once.
uz: Toʻsatdan bir joyda bir marta soat urildi.

en: can it be half-past seven?
uz: Bu yetti yarim o'tishi mumkinmi?

en: Impossible, it must be fast!” Luckily for him, everything went well again at the gates.
uz: Bu imkonsiz, tez bo'lishi kerak! Yaxshiyamki, darvozalarda hammasi yaxshi o'tdi.

en: At that very moment, as though expressly for his benefit, a huge wagon of hay had just driven in at the gate, completely screening him as he passed under the gateway, and the wagon had scarcely had time to
uz: O'sha paytda, xuddi o'z foydasiga bo'lganidek, darvoza oldida katta o't aravachasi kirib, darvoza ostidan o'tib ketayotganda uni to'liq tekshirib ko'rdi.

en: drive through into the yard, before he had slipped in a flash to the right.
uz: U o'ng tomonga o'tib o'tib ketishdan oldin hovliga o'tib kirdi.

en: On the other side of the wagon he could hear shouting and quarrelling; but no one noticed him and no one met him.
uz: Qayiqning boshqa tomonasida u qichqiriq va bahs-munozaralarni eshitgan edi; lekin hech kim uni ko'rmadi va hech kim uni kutib olmagan.

en: Many windows looking into that huge quadrangular yard were open at that moment, but he did not raise his head —he had not the strength to.
uz: O'sha paytda katta to'rtburchakli hovliga qarashli ko'plab derazalar ochiq edi, ammo u boshini ko'tarmadi.

en: The staircase leading to the old woman’s room was close by, just on the right of the gateway.
uz: Keksa ayolning xonasiga olib boradigan mertar yaqin atrofda, darvozaning o'ng tomonida edi.

en: He was already on the stairs.
uz: U allaqachon mertabaning ustida edi.

en: … Drawing a breath, pressing his hand against his throbbing heart, and once more feeling for the axe and setting it straight, he began softly and cautiously ascending the stairs, listening every minute.
uz: ... O'ziga nafas olib, qo'lini urib yuragini bosgan, bir bor esa o'g'irini ko'tarib, uni to'g'ri yo'lga qo'ygan u, har daqiqani tinglab, sekin va ehtiyotkorlik bilan mertabanni ko'tarib borishni boshladi.

en: But the stairs, too, were quite deserted; all the doors were shut; he met no one.
uz: Lekin mertarlar ham chindan ham bo'sh edi; barcha eshiklar yopilgan edi; u hech kimni uchratmadi.

en: One flat indeed on the first floor was wide open and painters were at work in it, but they did not glance at him.
uz: Birinchi qavatdagi bir kvartira keng ochilgan edi va rasmchilar u yerda ishlayotgan edi, lekin ular unga nazar solmagan edilar.

en: He stood still, thought a minute and went on.
uz: U to'xtadi, bir daqiqa o'yladi va davom etdi.

en: “Of course it would be better if they had not been here, but … it’s two storeys above them.” And there was the fourth storey, here was the door, here was the flat opposite, the empty one.
uz: Agar ular bu yerda bo'lmaganida yaxshiroq bo'lardi, lekin... ularning ustida ikki qavat bor. Va to'rtinchi qavat bor edi, bu erda eshik bor edi, bu erda o'zga tomondagi kvartira, bo'sh edi.

en: The flat underneath the old woman’s was apparently empty also; the visiting card nailed on the door had been torn off —they had gone away!
uz: Keksa ayollarning pastki xonasi ham bo'sh edi; eshikga quvib qo'yilgan tashrif kartochkasi yirtilgan edi.

en: … He was out of breath.
uz: U nafasdan o'tdi.

en: For one instant the thought floated through his mind, “Shall I go back?” But he made no answer and began listening at the old woman’s door, a dead silence.
uz: Bir daqiqa davomida uning ongida: "Men qaytib borishim kerakmi?" degan fikr paydo bo'ldi, lekin u hech qanday javob bermadi va keksa ayolning eshigida o'lik xotirjamlik bilan tinglay boshladi.

en: Then he listened again on the staircase, listened long and intently … then looked about him for the last time, pulled himself together, drew himself up, and once more tried the axe in the noose.
uz: So'ngra u yana turar joyda tingladi, uzoq va diqqat bilan tingladi ... so'ngra o'z atrofini oxirgi marta ko'rib, o'zini yig'di, o'zini ko'tardi va yana bir bor to'qnashuvga urinib ko'rdi.

en: “Am I very pale?” he wondered.
uz: Men juda soya bo'lganmanmi? deb o'yladi.

en: “Am I not evidently agitated?
uz: Men g'ayratli emasmanmi?

en: … Had I better wait a little longer … till my heart leaves off thumping?” But his heart did not leave off.
uz: ... Qalbim urishni to'xtatguncha biroz ko'proq kutishim kerakmi? Ammo uning yuragi to'xtamaydi.

en: On the contrary, as though to spite him, it throbbed more and more violently.
uz: Aksincha, xuddi unga qarshi bo'lganidek, u o'z kuchini kuchaytirgancha urardi.

en: He could stand it no longer, he slowly put out his hand to the bell and rang.
uz: U ko'proq ko'tarib bo'lmadi, u asta-sekin qo'lini qo'lini qo'yib qo'ng'iroqga qo'ydi va qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: Half a minute later he rang again, more loudly.
uz: Yarim daqiqa o'tgach, u yana qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: To go on ringing was useless and out of place.
uz: Qo'ng'iroqni davom ettirish foydasiz va joyidan chetda edi.

en: The old woman was, of course, at home, but she was suspicious and alone.
uz: Qariya ayol, albatta, uyda edi, lekin u shubhali va yolg'iz edi.

en: He had some knowledge of her habits … and once more he put his ear to the door.
uz: U uning odatlari haqida ma'lumotga ega edi va yana bir bor quloqlarini eshikga qo'ydi.

en: Either his senses were peculiarly keen (which it is difficult to suppose), or the sound was really very distinct.
uz: Yoki uning his-tuyg'ulari o'zgacha o'ziga xos edi (bu haqda taxmin qilish qiyin), yoki tovush aslida juda aniq edi.

en: Anyway, he suddenly heard something like the cautious touch of a hand on
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u to'satdan qo'lning ehtiyotkorlik bilan tiklanishiga o'xshash narsani eshitdi.

en: the lock and the rustle of a skirt at the very door.
uz: Eshikdagi qulf va cho'chqiriq.

en: Someone was standing stealthily close to the lock and just as he was doing on the outside was secretly listening within, and seemed to have her ear to the door.
uz: Kimdir qulfning yaqinida yashirincha turibdi va u tashqi tomondan qilganidek, yashirincha ichkaridan tinglab turardi va uning qulog'i eshikga yaqin bo'lib turardi.

en: … He moved a little on purpose and muttered something aloud that he might not have the appearance of hiding, then rang a third time, but quietly, soberly, and without impatience, Recalling it afterwards, that moment stood out in his mind vividly, distinctly, forever; he could not make out how he had had such cunning, for his mind was as it were clouded at moments and he was almost unconscious of his body.
uz: ... U ozgina qasddan harakat qilib, yashirinish kabi ko'rinmaydigan narsani baland ovoz bilan gapirdi, so'ngra uchinchi marta qo'ng'iroq qildi, lekin xotirjamlik bilan, aqldan ozgan holda va sabr-toqatsiz, keyinroq eslab, o'sha payt uning ongida jonli, aniq, abadiy o'rin oldi; u qanday qilib bunday hiyla-nayrangga ega bo'lganini tushunolmadi, chunki uning ongi bir lahzada bulutga to'lib ketgandek edi va u deyarli o'z tanasi haqida o'ylamay qolgan edi.

en: … An instant later he heard the latch unfastened.
uz: Bir zum o'tgach, u qulfning bo'shatilganini eshitdi.

en: VII The door was as before opened a tiny crack, and again two sharp and suspicious eyes stared at him out of the darkness.
uz: VII eshik xuddi avvalgidek kichkina bo'lakni ochdi va yana ikkita o'tkir va shubhali ko'z qorong'ilikdan unga qaradi.

en: Then Raskolnikov lost his head and nearly made a great mistake.
uz: Keyin Raskolnikov aqlini yo'qotib, deyarli katta xatoga yo'l qo'ydi.

en: Fearing the old woman would be frightened by their being alone, and not hoping that the sight of him would disarm her suspicions, he took hold of the door and drew it towards him to prevent the old woman from attempting to shut it again.
uz: Qariya ayolning yolg'iz qolishidan qo'rqqanidan va uning ko'rinishi uning shubhalarini yengishiga umid qilmaganidan u eshikni ushlab, uni o'ziga jalb qildi va qariya ayol uni yana yopishga urinmasin deb uni ushlab qo'ydi.

en: Seeing this she did not pull the door back, but she did not let go the handle so that he almost dragged her out with it on to the stairs.
uz: Buni ko'rib, u eshikni orqaga tortib qo'ymadi, lekin qo'lni qo'yib yubormadi, shuning uchun u deyarli uni eshikdan tashqariga olib chiqdi.

en: Seeing that she was standing in the doorway not allowing him to pass, he advanced straight upon her.
uz: U ayolning eshik oldida turib, unga o'tishga ruxsat bermayotganini ko'rib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning ustiga yaqinlashdi.

en: She stepped back in alarm, tried to say something, but seemed unable to speak and stared with open eyes at him.
uz: U qo'rqinchga to'lib, bir narsa aytishga harakat qildi, lekin gapira olmaydigan bo'lib ko'rindi va ochiq ko'zlar bilan unga qaradi.

en: “Good evening, Alyona Ivanovna,” he began, trying to speak easily, but his voice would not obey him, it broke and shook.
uz: "Xayrli kechasi, Alyona Ivanovna", - deb boshladi u, osonlikcha gapirishga harakat qildi, ammo uning ovozi unga itoat qilmadi, u bo'lindi va titradi.

en: “I have come  … I have brought something … but we’d better come in … to the light.
uz: Men keldim ... men biror narsa olib keldim ... lekin biz yaxshiroq kirib kelsak ... yorug'likka.

en: …” And leaving her, he passed straight into the room uninvited.
uz: ... U ayolni qoldirib, taklif etilmagan holda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xonaga o'tdi.

en: The old woman ran after him; her tongue was unloosed.
uz: Keksa ayol uning orqasidan yugurib ketdi; tilini o'chirib qo'ydi.

en: What do you want?” “Why, Alyona Ivanovna, you know me … Raskolnikov … here, I brought you the pledge I promised the other day …” And he held out the pledge.
uz: Nima istaysiz?Alyona Ivanovna, siz meni taniysiz... Raskolnikov... mana, men sizga bir kun oldin bergan va'damni olib keldim... Va u va'damni bajardi.

en: The old woman glanced for a moment at the pledge, but at once stared in the eyes of her uninvited visitor.
uz: Keksa ayol bir zumga qaradi, lekin darhol taklif qilinmagan mehmonining ko'zlariga qaradi.

en: She looked intently, maliciously and mistrustfully.
uz: U diqqat bilan, yovuzlik va ishonchsizlik bilan ko'rinardi.

en: A minute passed; he even fancied something like a sneer in her eyes, as though she had already guessed everything.
uz: Bir daqiqa o'tdi; u hatto qizning ko'zlariga kulgi kabi bir narsani tasavvur qildi, xuddi u allaqachon hamma narsani tasavvur qilgan bo'lsa.

en: He felt that he was losing his head, that he was
uz: U o'zini aqldan ozdirayotganini his qilardi.

en: almost frightened, so frightened that if she were to look like that and not say a word for another half minute, he thought he would have run away from her.
uz: U deyarli qo'rqqan, shunchalik qo'rqqanki, agar u shunday ko'rinsa va yana yarim daqiqa so'z aytmasa, undan qochib ketishini o'ylagan.

en: “Why do you look at me as though you did not know me?” he said suddenly, also with malice.
uz: Nima uchun menga o'zingizni tanimagan kabi ko'rasiz? - dedi u to'satdan, shuningdek, yomon niyat bilan.

en: “Take it if you like, if not I’ll go elsewhere, I am in a hurry.” He had not even thought of saying this, but it was suddenly said of itself.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, uni oling, agar xohlamasangiz, boshqa joyga ketaman, shoshilinchman.U buni aytishni hatto o'ylamagan edi, lekin to'satdan u o'z-o'zidan aytildi.

en: The old woman recovered herself, and her visitor’s resolute tone evidently restored her confidence.
uz: Keksa ayol o'zini tikladi va uning tashrif buyuruvchilarining qat'iy so'zlari uning ishonchini tikladi.

en: “But why, my good sir, all of a minute.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, nega, mening yaxshi sirim, bir daqiqa.

en: … What is it?” she asked, looking at the pledge.
uz: ... nima? deb so'radi u, va'daga qarab.

en: “The silver cigarette case; I spoke of it last time, you know.” She held out her hand.
uz: Kumush sigaret qopqoqasi; men o'tgan safar bu haqda gapirgan edim, bilasiz. U qo'lini uzatdi.

en: “But how pale you are, to be sure … and your hands are trembling too?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa-da, o'zingizning qo'llaringiz ham titrayotgan bo'lsa-da, siz naqadar oq bo'lasiz?

en: Have you been bathing, or what?” “Fever,” he answered abruptly.
uz: Siz ham suvga cho'mganmisiz? Fever, u to'satdan javob berdi.

en: “You can’t help getting pale … if you’ve nothing to eat,” he added, with difficulty articulating the words.
uz: Agar ovqatlanmagan bo'lsangiz, so'zlarni so'zlashda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganda, o'zingizni oqlay olmaysiz.

en: His strength was failing him again.
uz: Uning kuch-quvvatlari yana uni yo'qotgan edi.

en: But his answer sounded like the truth; the old woman took the pledge.
uz: Ammo uning javobi haqiqatdek tuyuldi; keksa ayol vaʼda oldi.

en: “What is it?” she asked once more, scanning Raskolnikov intently, and weighing the pledge in her hand.
uz: Bu nima? - deb so'radi u Raskolnikovni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqib, qo'lida qo'lga olingan g'ayrni o'lchab.

en: “A thing … cigarette case.
uz: Bir narsa ... sigaret qopqoqasi.

en: … Look at it.” “It does not seem somehow like silver.
uz: ... Uni ko'ring. Bu kumushga o'xshamaydi.

en: … How he has wrapped it up!” Trying to untie the string and turning to the window, to the light (all her windows were shut, in spite of the stifling heat), she left him altogether for some seconds and stood with her back to him.
uz: Qanday qilib u uni o'rab oldi! U shamolni bo'shatib, darchaga, yorug'likka qarab turishga harakat qildi (o'sha issiqlikka qaramay, uning barcha darchalari yopilgan edi), u uni bir necha soniya uchun butunlay qoldirdi va orqasidan turib unga yaqinlashdi.

en: He unbuttoned his coat and freed the axe from the noose, but did not yet take it out altogether, simply holding it in his right hand under the coat.
uz: U kiyimini ochib, pichoqni qo'lga tushirgan, ammo hali uni butunlay olib tashlamagan, shunchaki kiyim ostida o'ng qo'lida ushlab turgan.

en: His hands were fearfully weak, he felt them every moment growing more numb and more wooden.
uz: Uning qo'llari dahshatli darajada zaif edi, u ularni har bir daqiqada ko'proq o'nglashayotgan va yog'ochdan bo'lganini his qilardi.

en: He was afraid he would let the axe slip and fall.
uz: U o'sha o'g'ilning o'g'illarini qo'yib ketishiga qo'rqardi.

en: … A sudden giddiness came over him.
uz: Birdan u o'ziga ko'z yumdi.

en: “But what has he tied it up like this for?” the old woman cried with vexation and moved towards him.
uz: Ammo uni nima uchun shunday bog'lab qo'ydi? - qariya ayol qayg'udan yig'lab, unga yaqinlashdi.

en: He had not a minute more to lose.
uz: Uning yo'qotish uchun bir daqiqa ham qolmadi.

en: He pulled the axe quite out, swung it with both arms, scarcely conscious of himself, and almost without effort, almost mechanically, brought the blunt side down on
uz: U o'zini o'zi bilmay, o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'zicha o'shacha o'chirdi.

en: He seemed not to use his own strength in this.
uz: U bu borada o'z kuch-quvvatidan foydalanmayotganga o'xshaydi.

en: But as soon as he had once brought the axe down, his strength returned to him.
uz: Ammo bir marta o'qni pastga tushirganida, u o'z kuchini qaytarib oldi.

en: The old woman was as always bareheaded.
uz: Qariya ayol har doimgidek bosh ko'p bo'lmagan edi.

en: Her thin, light hair, streaked with grey, thickly smeared with grease, was plaited in a rat’s tail and fastened by a broken horn comb which stood out on the nape of her neck.
uz: Uning chiroyli, yorug' sochlari griz rangda bo'lib, yog' bilan qoplangan edi, ular tovuq quyruqqa bog'lanib, bo'g'i bo'g'i ustida ko'rinadigan bo'g'im qirqasiga bog'langan edi.

en: As she was so short, the blow fell on the very top of her skull.
uz: U shunchalik qisqa bo'lganida, urish uning tengkachasining yuqori qismida tushib qoldi.

en: She cried out, but very faintly, and suddenly sank all of a heap on the floor, raising her hands to her head.
uz: U qichqiriq qildi, lekin juda zaiflik bilan, va to'satdan qo'llarini boshiga ko'tarib, yerga to'plam bo'lib qulab ketdi.

en: In one hand she still held “the pledge.” Then he dealt her another and another blow with the blunt side and on the same spot.
uz: Bir qo'lida u hali ham g'ayrni ushlab turardi. So'ngra u unga yana bir urib, yana bir urib qo'ydi.

en: The blood gushed as from an overturned glass, the body fell back.
uz: Qon to'kib, xuddi to'g'rilashuvchi shishaga o'xshab, jasad orqaga tushib ketdi.

en: He stepped back, let it fall, and at once bent over her face; she was dead.
uz: U orqaga qadam bosdi, uni qulab yubordi va darhol uning yuziga burildi; u o'lgan edi.

en: Her eyes seemed to be starting out of their sockets, the brow and the whole face were drawn and contorted convulsively.
uz: Uning ko'zlari o'z sochiqlaridan boshlangandek ko'rinardi, burun va butun yuzi bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lib, shovqinli bo'lib ketdi.

en: He laid the axe on the ground near the dead body and felt at once in her pocket (trying to avoid the streaming body) —the same right- hand pocket from which she had taken the key on his last visit.
uz: U o'g'li jasad yonidagi yerga pichoqni qo'ydi va shu zahoti uning qoshiqida (to'plamni to'ldirishdan qochmoqchi bo'lib) o'ng qo'li qoshiqidagi kalitni his qildi.

en: He was in full possession of his faculties, free from confusion or giddiness, but his hands were still trembling.
uz: U o'z kuch-qudratini to'liq egallagan, g'alati va burchsizlikdan xalos bo'lgan, ammo qo'llari hali ham titrab turardi.

en: He remembered afterwards that he had been particularly collected and careful, trying all the time not to get smeared with blood.
uz: Keyinchalik u o'zini alohida yig'ib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'tkazganini esladi va butun vaqt davomida qon bilan to'kmaslik uchun harakat qildi.

en: … He pulled out the keys at once, they were all, as before, in one bunch on a steel ring.
uz: ... U kalitlarni bir vaqtning o'zida olib chiqdi, ular hammasi, avvalgidek, po'latga o'rnatilgan bir to'plamda edi.

en: He ran at once into the bedroom with them.
uz: U darhol ular bilan birga yotoqxonasiga yugurdi.

en: It was a very small room with a whole shrine of holy images.
uz: Bu juda kichik xona edi, unda butun muqaddas tasvirlar xonasi bor edi.

en: Against the other wall stood a big bed, very clean and covered with a silk patchwork wadded quilt.
uz: Boshqa devorga qarshi katta, juda toza, ipak parchalar bilan qoplangan katta yotoq turardi.

en: Against a third wall was a chest of drawers.
uz: Uchinchi devorga qarshi quti-qurtasi bor edi.

en: Strange to say, so soon as he began to fit the keys into the chest, so soon as he heard their jingling, a convulsive shudder passed over him.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, u kalitlarni ko'krakga qo'yishni boshlaganidan so'ng, ularning qichqiriqlarini eshitganidan so'ng, u ustidan shovqinli titrishni boshdan kechirdi.

en: He suddenly felt tempted again to give it all up and go away.
uz: Birdan u yana o'zini tashlab ketish vasvasasiga tushdi.

en: But that was only for an instant; it was too late to go back.
uz: Ammo bu bir zum uchun edi; orqaga qaytish uchun juda kech edi.

en: He positively smiled at himself, when suddenly another terrifying idea occurred to his mind.
uz: U o'z-o'ziga tabassum bilan tabassum qildi, lekin to'satdan yana bir dahshatli fikr uning ongiga keldi.

en: He suddenly fancied that the old woman might be still alive and might recover her senses.
uz: U birdan keksa ayol hali ham tirik bo'lishi mumkinligini va aql-idrokini tiklashi mumkinligini o'yladi.

en: Leaving the keys in the chest, he ran back to the body, snatched up the axe and lifted it once more over the old woman, but did not bring it down.
uz: O'z kalitlarini ko'krak ichida qoldirib, u joniga qaytib bordi, o'g'irni olib, keksa ayolning ustiga yana ko'tardi, lekin uni tushirmadi.

en: There was no doubt that she was dead.
uz: U o'lganida hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: Bending down and examining her again more closely, he saw
uz: O'zini egib, uni yana ko'proq tekshirib ko'rganida, u ko'rganini ko'rdi.

en: clearly that the skull was broken and even battered in on one side.
uz: Koʻrinib turibdiki, kafan jarohatlangan va hatto bir tomondan urilgan.

en: He was about to feel it with his finger, but drew back his hand and indeed it was evident without that.
uz: U buni barmog'i bilan his qilmoqchi edi, ammo qo'lini orqaga surdi va bu o'zidan tashqari aniq edi.

en: Meanwhile there was a perfect pool of blood.
uz: Shu bilan birga, mukammal qon hovlisi ham bor edi.

en: All at once he noticed a string on her neck; he tugged at it, but the string was strong and did not snap and besides, it was soaked with blood.
uz: Birdan u ayolning bo'yniga bir ipni ko'rdi; uni tortib oldi, lekin ip kuchli va buzib bo'lmadi va qo'shimcha ravishda, u qon bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: He tried to pull it out from the front of the dress, but something held it and prevented its coming.
uz: U uni libosining old tomonidan olib chiqishga harakat qildi, ammo biror narsa uni ushlab qo'ydi va uni kelishidan to'sdi.

en: In his impatience he raised the axe again to cut the string from above on the body, but did not dare, and with difficulty, smearing his hand and the axe in the blood, after two minutes’ hurried effort, he cut the string and took it off without touching the body with the axe; he was not mistaken —it was a purse.
uz: Sabrsizlik bilan u tikanni yana ko'tarib, to'plamni tanadagi yuqori tomondan kesib tashladi, lekin u jur'at qilmadi va og'irlik bilan qo'lini va to'plamni qonga solib, ikki daqiqadan keyin tikanni kesib tashladi va to'plam bilan tanasiga tegmasdan olib tashladi; u noto'g'ri yo'l tutmadi.

en: On the string were two crosses, one of Cyprus wood and one of copper, and an image in silver filigree, and with them a small greasy chamois leather purse with a steel rim and ring.
uz: Uyning ustida ikkita xoch, biri Kipr yog'ochidan, biri esa misdan, kumush filigradan yasalgan tasvir va ular bilan birga o'ta yog'li shamoys charm qopqoqasi bor edi.

en: The purse was stuffed very full; Raskolnikov thrust it in his pocket without looking at it, flung the crosses on the old woman’s body and rushed back into the bedroom, this time taking the axe with him.
uz: Chetka juda to'liq edi; Raskolnikov uni ko'rmasdan, kiyimga tashladi, keksa ayolning tanasiga xochlarni tashladi va yotoqxonasiga qaytib bordi, bu safar o'z bilan qasni olib ketdi.

en: He was in terrible haste, he snatched the keys, and began trying them again.
uz: U juda shoshgan edi, kalitlarini olib, yana sinab ko'rishni boshladi.

en: But he was unsuccessful.
uz: Ammo u muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

en: They would not fit in the locks.
uz: Ular qulflarga mos kelmaydi.

en: It was not so much that his hands were shaking, but that he kept making mistakes; though he saw for instance that a key was not the right one and would not fit, still he tried to put it in.
uz: Uning qo'llari titraganligi uchun emas, balki u xatolar qilib yurganligi uchun; masalan, u kalitning to'g'ri emasligini va mos kelmasligini ko'rgan bo'lsa-da, uni o'rnatishga harakat qildi.

en: Suddenly he remembered and realised that the big key with the deep notches, which was hanging there with the small keys could not possibly belong to the chest of drawers (on his last visit this had struck him), but to some strong box, and that everything perhaps was hidden in that box.
uz: Toʻsatdan u eslab qoldi va chuqur oʻtlar bilan katta kalit, kichik kalitlar bilan oʻtirgan katta kalit, ehtimol sovutgichga tegishli boʻlmasligi mumkinligini angladi (oʻzining oxirgi tashrifida bu unga taʼsir qilgan edi), balki kuchli qutuqqa tegishliligini va u qutuqqa hamma narsa yashirilganligini angladi.

en: He left the chest of drawers, and at once felt under the bedstead, knowing that old women usually keep boxes under their beds.
uz: U sovutni tashlab ketib, o'zini to'shak ostida his qildi, chunki keksa ayollar odatda to'shaklar ostida qutilarni saqlab qolishini bilardi.

en: And so it was; there was a good-sized box under the bed, at least a yard in length, with an arched lid covered with red leather and studded with steel nails.
uz: Va shunday bo'ldi; yotoq ostida kamida bir metr uzunlikdagi yaxshi o'lchamli quti bor edi, uning egri qopqoqlari qizil teridan qoplangan va po'lat kiyimlari bilan qoplangan edi.

en: The notched key fitted at once and unlocked it.
uz: O'tkirlangan kalit darhol o'rnatildi va uni ochdi.

en: At the top, under a white sheet, was a coat of red brocade lined with hareskin; under it was a silk dress, then a shawl and it seemed as though there was nothing below but clothes.
uz: Yuqorida, oq varaq ostida, qo'ylak kiyimlari bilan qoplangan qizil brokat kiyim bor edi; uning ostida ipak kiyim, so'ngra shaul bor edi va pastda kiyimdan boshqa hech narsa yo'qdek ko'rinardi.

en: The first thing he did was to wipe his bloodstained hands on the red brocade.
uz: U birinchi bo'lib o'zining qonli qo'llarini qizil brokatga o'chirib tashladi.

en: “It’s red, and on red blood will be less noticeable,” the thought passed through his
uz: qizil, va qizil qonda ko'rinishi kamroq bo'ladi, o'ylab uning o'zi orqali o'tgan fikr

en: mind; then he suddenly came to himself.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan o'zi haqida o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: “Good God, am I going out of my senses?” he thought with terror.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo, aqldan ozyapmanmi? deb qo'rqib o'yladi u.

en: But no sooner did he touch the clothes than a gold watch slipped from under the fur coat.
uz: Ammo u kiyimga qo'l tegizmaganda, soch kiyimidan oltin soat chiqib ketdi.

en: He made haste to turn them all over.
uz: U ularni tezda burib yubordi.

en: There turned out to be various articles made of gold among the clothes — probably all pledges, unredeemed or waiting to be redeemed — bracelets, chains, earrings, pins and such things.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, kiyimlar orasida oltindan yasalgan turli xil buyumlar bor edi  ehtimol barcha va'dalar, to'lov qilinmagan yoki to'lov qilinishini kutayotgan  bid'atlar, zanjirlar, quloq o'qishlar, pinlar va shunga o'xshash narsalar.

en: Some were in cases, others simply wrapped in newspaper, carefully and exactly folded, and tied round with tape.
uz: Ba'zilari kassalarda, ba'zilari shunchaki gazetaga o'rab, diqqat bilan va aniq qatlamga olingan va kassa bilan bog'langan edi.

en: Without any delay, he began filling up the pockets of his trousers and overcoat without examining or undoing the parcels and cases; but he had not time to take many.
uz: Zudlik bilan, u parcellar va qoplamalarni tekshirmasdan yoki bekor qilmasdan, paltoslari va kiyimlarining to'plamlarini to'ldirib boshladi; lekin ko'p narsalarni olib ketishga vaqt bo'lmadi.

en: … He suddenly heard steps in the room where the old woman lay.
uz: Birdan keksa ayol yotgan xonada qadamlar eshitdi.

en: He stopped short and was still as death.
uz: U qisqa to'xtadi va hali ham o'lim kabi edi.

en: But all was quiet, so it must have been his fancy.
uz: Ammo hamma narsa xotirjam edi, shuning uchun bu uning o'ylash istagi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: All at once he heard distinctly a faint cry, as though someone had uttered a low broken moan.
uz: Toʻsatdan u biroz oʻzgarib, xuddi kimdir past boʻlgan bir yigʻinni aytgan boʻlsa kerak, deb oʻziga xos bir qichqiriqni eshitdi.

en: Then again dead silence for a minute or two.
uz: So'ngra yana bir yoki ikki daqiqalik o'lik xotirjamlik.

en: He sat squatting on his heels by the box and waited holding his breath.
uz: O'zi qutuq yonida bo'g'inlarida o'tirib, nafas olishni to'xtatib kutardi.

en: Suddenly he jumped up, seized the axe and ran out of the bedroom.
uz: Toʻsatdan u oʻrnidan oʻtib, oʻgʻlini ushlab, yotoqxonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: In the middle of the room stood Lizaveta with a big bundle in her arms.
uz: Xonaning o'rtasida Lizaveta qo'llarida katta to'plam bilan turgan edi.

en: She was gazing in stupefaction at her murdered sister, white as a sheet and seeming not to have the strength to cry out.
uz: U o'ldirilgan singlisiga qo'rqinch bilan qarayotgan edi, u to'qima kabi oq edi va baqirishga kuch-quvvatga ega bo'lmagandek ko'rinardi.

en: Seeing him run out of the bedroom, she began faintly quivering all over, like a leaf, a shudder ran down her face; she lifted her hand, opened her mouth, but still did not scream.
uz: Uni yotoqxonadan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rgach, u hamma joyda salqin titray boshladi, xuddi barg kabi, titroq yuzidan tushdi; qo'lini ko'tarib, og'zini ochdi, ammo qichqirishni istamadi.

en: She began slowly backing away from him into the corner, staring intently, persistently at him, but still uttered no sound, as though she could not get breath to scream.
uz: U undan asta-sekin burchakga qarab, diqqat bilan, qat'iylik bilan unga qaray boshladi, lekin hali ham hech qanday ovoz chiqarmadi, xuddi o'zi qichqirish uchun nafas ololmayotgandek.

en: He rushed at her with the axe; her mouth twitched piteously, as one sees babies’ mouths, when they begin to be frightened, stare intently at what frightens them and are on the point of screaming.
uz: U o'g'liga o'g'ir bilan shovqin qildi; uning og'zi achinarli tarzda titrab qoldi, chunki chaqaloqlarning og'zlari qo'rqib ketayotganini ko'rib, ularni qo'rqitadigan narsaga diqqat bilan qaraydilar va qichqirishni boshlaydilar.

en: And this hapless Lizaveta was so simple and had been so thoroughly crushed and scared that she did not even raise a hand to guard her face, though that was the most necessary and natural action at the moment, for the axe was raised over her face.
uz: Va bu baxtsiz Lizaveta shunchalik sodda edi va shunchalik qattiq cho'kgan va qo'rqib ketgan ediki, u hatto yuzini himoya qilish uchun qo'lini ko'tarmadi, garchi bu hozirgi paytda eng zarur va tabiiy harakat bo'lsa ham, chunki o'g'ilning yuzi ustidan o'g'il ko'tarildi.

en: She only put up her empty left hand, but not to her face, slowly holding it out before her as though motioning him away.
uz: U faqat o'zining bo'sh chap qo'lini ko'tarib, lekin yuziga qaramasdi, unga ko'z tikib, unga ishora qilganday bo'ldi.

en: The axe fell with the sharp edge just on the skull and split at one blow all the top of the head.
uz: O'tkir o'qi faqat kafaning o'ng tomoniga tushib, bir marta boshning yuqori qismini parchaladi.

en: Raskolnikov completely lost his head, snatching up her bundle, dropped it again and ran into the entry.
uz: Raskolnikov butunlay boshini yo'qotib, uning to'plamini olib, uni yana tashladi va kirishga yugurdi.

en: Fear gained more and more mastery over him, especially after this second, quite unexpected murder.
uz: Qo'rquv uni, ayniqsa, ushbu ikkinchi, umuman kutilmagan o'limdan keyin yanada ko'proq boshqardi.

en: He longed to run away from the place as fast as possible.
uz: U imkon qadar tezroq u yerdan qochib ketishni orzu qilardi.

en: And if at that moment he had been capable of seeing and reasoning more correctly, if he had been able to realise all the difficulties of his position, the hopelessness, the hideousness and the absurdity of it, if he could have understood how many obstacles and, perhaps, crimes he had still to overcome or to commit, to get out of that place and to make his way home, it is very possible that he would have flung up everything, and would have gone to give himself up, and not from fear, but from simple horror and loathing of what he had done.
uz: Va agar u o'sha paytda u o'z vazifasining barcha qiyinchiliklarini, umidsizlikni, dahshatliligini va absurdligini anglab yetgan bo'lsa, agar u o'sha joydan chiqib, uyga qaytish uchun hali ham ko'p to'siqlarni va, ehtimol, sodir etish kerak bo'lgan jinoyatlarni tushuna olgan bo'lsa, ehtimol u hamma narsani tashlab, qo'rqmasdan emas, balki qilgan ishidan qo'rqib va nafratlanib, o'zini berishga ketgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The feeling of loathing especially surged up within him and grew stronger every minute.
uz: Ayniqsa, uning ichida nafrat tuyg'usi paydo bo'ldi va har bir daqiqada kuchayib borardi.

en: He would not now have gone to the box or even into the room for anything in the world.
uz: U endi hech narsa uchun qutiqqa yoki hatto xonada ketmagan bo'lardi.

en: But a sort of blankness, even dreaminess, had begun by degrees to take possession of him; at moments he forgot himself, or rather, forgot what was of importance, and caught at trifles.
uz: Ammo bir xil bo'shlik, hatto orzular uning oldiga tushib ketishni boshlagan edi; ba'zida u o'zini unutgan, yoki to'g'ri aytganda, nima muhimligini unutgan va kichik ishlarga qo'l urgan.

en: Glancing, however, into the kitchen and seeing a bucket half full of water on a bench, he bethought him of washing his hands and the axe.
uz: Biroq, oshxonada ko'z tikib, stol ustida yarim suv to'lgan idishni ko'rib, u qo'llarini yuvishni va baltani yuvishni o'yladi.

en: His hands were sticky with blood.
uz: Uning qo'llari qon bilan yopilgan edi.

en: He dropped the axe with the blade in the water, snatched a piece of soap that lay in a broken saucer on the window, and began washing his hands in the bucket.
uz: U o'g'li bilan pichoqni suvga tashladi, oynadagi buzilgan pishirgan ichida turgan bir parcha sabondan tortib oldi va qo'llarini idishda yuvishni boshladi.

en: When they were clean, he took out the axe, washed the blade and spent a long time, about three minutes, washing the wood where there were spots of blood rubbing them with soap.
uz: Ular toza bo'lganda, u o'g'irni olib chiqib, o'g'irni yuvdi va uzoq vaqt, taxminan uch daqiqa davomida yog'ochni tozalab, qon maydonlari bo'lgan joyda sabun bilan yuvdi.

en: Then he wiped it all with some linen that was hanging to dry on a line in the kitchen and then he was a long while attentively examining the axe at the window.
uz: So'ngra u ovqatxonadagi qatorda quritish uchun osilgan bir nechta kiyim bilan barchasini yuvdi va keyin uzoq vaqt davomida darchadagi baltani diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

en: There was no trace left on it, only the wood was still damp.
uz: Uning ustiga hech qanday iz qolmadi, faqat yog'och hali ham nam edi.

en: He carefully hung the axe in the noose under his coat.
uz: O'z kiyimining pastki qismida esa o'g'irni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bog'lagan.

en: Then as far as was possible, in the dim light in the kitchen, he looked over his overcoat, his trousers and his boots.
uz: Keyin, imkon qadar, oshxonadagi kam yorug'likda, u kiyimini, shortslarini va poyabzallarini ko'rib chiqdi.

en: At the first glance there seemed to be nothing but stains on the boots.
uz: Birinchi qarashda poyabzallarda faqat lekadan boshqa narsa yo'qdek ko'rinardi.

en: He wetted the rag and rubbed the boots.
uz: U to'qimalarni bosdi va poyabzallarni aralashtirdi.

en: But he knew he was not looking thoroughly, that there might be something quite noticeable that he was overlooking.
uz: Ammo u yaxshi ko'rmayotganini bilardi, ehtimol, u ko'z o'ngida ko'rinadigan bir narsa borligini ko'rdi.

en: He stood in the middle of the room, lost in thought.
uz: U xonaning o'rtasida turib, fikrlarini yo'qotdi.

en: Dark agonising ideas rose in his mind —the
uz: Uning ongida qorong'i azob-uqubat keltiruvchi g'oyalar paydo bo'ldi.

en: idea that he was mad and that at that moment he was incapable of reasoning, of protecting himself, that he ought perhaps to be doing something utterly different from what he was now doing.
uz: U g'alati ekanligi va o'sha paytda fikr yuritishga, o'zini himoya qilishga qodir emasligi, ehtimol hozirgi ishidan umuman boshqacha harakat qilishi kerakligi haqidagi fikr.

en: “Good God!” he muttered, “I must fly, fly,” and he rushed into the entry.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo! deb g'iybat qildi, Men uchib ketishim kerak, uchib ketishim kerak, va u kirishga shoshildi.

en: But here a shock of terror awaited him such as he had never known before.
uz: Ammo bu yerda uni hech qachon ko'rmagan dahshatli shok kutardi.

en: He stood and gazed and could not believe his eyes: the door, the outer door from the stairs, at which he had not long before waited and rung, was standing unfastened and at least six inches open.
uz: U turgan va ko'z o'ngida turardi va ko'zlariga ishonolmadi: eshik, u uzoq vaqt kutmagan va qichqirgan mertalardan tashqari eshik, to'xtamas edi va kamida olti dyuym ochiq edi.

en: No lock, no bolt, all the time, all that time!
uz: Hech qanday qulf, hech qanday bolt, har doim, har doim!

en: The old woman had not shut it after him perhaps as a precaution.
uz: Keksa ayol uni undan keyin to'xtatib qo'ymagan edi, ehtimol ehtiyot chorasi sifatida.

en: Why, he had seen Lizaveta afterwards!
uz: Axir, u keyinchalik Lizaveta bilan uchrashgan edi!

en: And how could he, how could he have failed to reflect that she must have come in somehow!
uz: Va u qanday qilib, qanday qilib u ayolning qaysidir tarzda kirib kelgani haqida o'ylamasligi mumkin edi!

en: She could not have come through the wall!
uz: U devor orqali o'tishi mumkin emas edi!

en: He dashed to the door and fastened the latch.
uz: U eshikga yugurib, qulfni o'rnatdi.

en: “But no, the wrong thing again!
uz: Ammo yo'q, yana noto'g'ri narsa!

en: I must get away, get away.
uz: Men ketishim kerak, ketishim kerak.

en: …” He unfastened the latch, opened the door and began listening on the staircase.
uz: ... U qulfni ochib, eshikni ochdi va mertabaning ustida tinglay boshladi.

en: He listened a long time.
uz: U uzoq vaqt tingladi.

en: Somewhere far away, it might be in the gateway, two voices were loudly and shrilly shouting, quarrelling and scolding.
uz: Uzoq bir joyda, ehtimol, darvoza oldida, ikki ovoz baland ovoz bilan qichqiriq qilib, bahslashayotgan va tanqid qilayotgan edi.

en: “What are they about?” He waited patiently.
uz: Ular nima haqida? U sabr-toqat bilan kutdi.

en: At last all was still, as though suddenly cut off; they had separated.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, birdan kesilgan bo'lib qolgan edi; ular ajralib ketishdi.

en: He was meaning to go out, but suddenly, on the floor below, a door was noisily opened and someone began going downstairs humming a tune.
uz: U tashqariga chiqmoqchi edi, lekin to'satdan, pastdagi qavatda bir eshik shov-shuv bilan ochildi va kimdir bir musiqa qo'shib, pastga tushib ketishni boshladi.

en: “How is it they all make such a noise?” flashed through his mind.
uz: Qanday qilib ular hammasi shunday shovqinlik qilishadi? - deb o'ylab ko'rdi u.

en: Once more he closed the door and waited.
uz: U yana eshikni yopib, kutdi.

en: At last all was still, not a soul stirring.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, jon ham harakatlanmay, to'xtamay qoldi.

en: He was just taking a step towards the stairs when he heard fresh footsteps.
uz: U shunchaki mertaga qarab qadam bosayotgan edi, ammo yangi qadamlar so'zlarini eshitdi.

en: The steps sounded very far off, at the very bottom of the stairs, but he remembered quite clearly and distinctly that from the first sound he began for some reason to suspect that this was someone coming there, to the fourth floor, to the old woman.
uz: Burchaklar juda uzoqda, askarlarning pastida eshitilardi, ammo u birinchi ovozdan boshlab, nega bo'lsa ham, bu kishi to'rtinchi qavatga, keksa ayolga kelib ketayotganini gumon qilishga boshlaganini aniq va aniq esladi.

en: Were the sounds somehow peculiar, significant?
uz: Bu tovushlar g'alati, ahamiyatli edi?

en: The steps were heavy, even and unhurried.
uz: Boshlari og'ir, teng va shoshilmas edi.

en: Now he had passed the first floor, now he was mounting higher, it was growing more and more distinct!
uz: Endi u birinchi qavatdan o'tib ketdi, endi u yuqoriga ko'tarildi, u yanada aniqroq bo'ldi!

en: He could hear his heavy breathing.
uz: U o'zining og'ir nafas olishini eshitardi.

en: And now the third storey had been reached.
uz: Va endi uchinchi qavatga yetib kelgan edi.

en: And it seemed to him all at once that he was turned to
uz: Birdan unga o'ziga murojaat qilinganidek ko'rindi.

en: stone, that it was like a dream in which one is being pursued, nearly caught and will be killed, and is rooted to the spot and cannot even move one’s arms.
uz: Bu toshni orzu qilib ko'rganingizda, uni orqadan quvg'in qilishadi, deyarli ushlab qolishadi va o'ldirishadi, u o'z-o'zidan o'rnida o'rnagan va qo'llarini ham ko'chira olmaydi.

en: At last when the unknown was mounting to the fourth floor, he suddenly started, and succeeded in slipping neatly and quickly back into the flat and closing the door behind him.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, noma'lum odam to'rtinchi qavatga ko'tarilganida, u to'satdan boshladi va xonadonga yaxshi va tez qaytishga va orqasidan eshikni yopishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Then he took the hook and softly, noiselessly, fixed it in the catch.
uz: So'ngra o'g'irchoqni olib, asta-sekin, shov-shuvsiz qilib, o'g'irchoqqa o'rnatdi.

en: Instinct helped him.
uz: Unga instinkt yordam berdi.

en: When he had done this, he crouched holding his breath, by the door.
uz: Buni amalga oshirib bo'lgach, u eshik oldida o'z nafasini tutgan holda yonboshladi.

en: The unknown visitor was by now also at the door.
uz: Tanilmagan mehmon endi eshik oldida edi.

en: They were now standing opposite one another, as he had just before been standing with the old woman, when the door divided them and he was listening.
uz: Ular endi bir-biriga qarama-qarshi turgan edilar, xuddi u biroz oldin keksa ayol bilan turganidek, eshik ularni bo'lib ketganda, u tinglagan edi.

en: The visitor panted several times.
uz: Tashrifchi bir necha marta nafas oldi.

en: “He must be a big, fat man,” thought Raskolnikov, squeezing the axe in his hand.
uz: "U katta va katta bo'lishi kerak", - deb o'yladi Raskolnikov, qo'lida pichoqni siqib.

en: It seemed like a dream indeed.
uz: Haqiqatan ham bu bir orzuga o'xshardi.

en: The visitor took hold of the bell and rang it loudly.
uz: Mehmon qo'lga oldi va baland ovoz bilan qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: As soon as the tin bell tinkled, Raskolnikov seemed to be aware of something moving in the room.
uz: Qalin qo'ng'iroq qichqirish bilan Raskolnikov xonada biror narsa harakatlanayotganini sezdi.

en: For some seconds he listened quite seriously.
uz: Bir necha soniya davomida u juda jiddiy tingladi.

en: The unknown rang again, waited and suddenly tugged violently and impatiently at the handle of the door.
uz: Tanilmagan kishi yana qo'ng'iroq qildi, kutdi va birdan eshikning qo'lini qattiq va sabrsizlik bilan tortdi.

en: Raskolnikov gazed in horror at the hook shaking in its fastening, and in blank terror expected every minute that the fastening would be pulled out.
uz: Raskolnikov qo'rqinch bilan o'zining qo'riqnomasida sarsasht qilayotgan qo'rg'onni ko'rdi va qo'riqnomada qo'riqnomani olib tashlashni har daqiqada kutardi.

en: It certainly did seem possible, so violently was he shaking it.
uz: Albatta, bu mumkin bo'lganidek tuyulgan, chunki u uni juda qattiq shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: He was tempted to hold the fastening, but he might be aware of it.
uz: U qo'lga olish vasvasasiga tushdi, lekin u buni bilishi mumkin.

en: A giddiness came over him again.
uz: U yana bir bor g'alati holga tushdi.

en: “I shall fall down!” flashed through his mind, but the unknown began to speak and he recovered himself at once.
uz: "Men yiqilib ketaman!" - deb o'ylab ko'rdi, ammo noma'lum narsa gapira boshladi va u o'zini darhol sog'aytirdi.

en: Are they asleep or murdered?
uz: Ular uxlab ketyaptimi yoki o'ldirilganmi?

en: D-damn them!” he bawled in a thick voice, “Hey, Alyona Ivanovna, old witch!
uz: U qattiq ovoz bilan qichqirdi: "Ey, Alyona Ivanovna, keksa sehrgar!

en: Lizaveta Ivanovna, hey, my beauty!
uz: Lizaveta Ivanovna, ey, mening go'zalligim!

en: Are they asleep or what?” And again, enraged, he tugged with all his might a dozen times at the bell.
uz: Ular uxlayaptimi yoki yo'qmi? Va yana g'azablanib, u qo'lidan kelgancha bir doʻzayning qo'ng'iroqini qo'zg'atdi.

en: He must certainly be a man of authority and an intimate acquaintance.
uz: Albatta, u mansabdor shaxs va yaqin tanish bo'lishi kerak.

en: At this moment light hurried steps were heard not far off, on the stairs.
uz: O'sha paytda uzoq yo'ldan, poshqoqda yumshoq qadamlar eshitildi.

en: Someone else was approaching.
uz: Boshqa bir kishi yaqinlashayotgan edi.

en: Raskolnikov had not heard them at first.
uz: Raskolnikov ularni dastlab eshitmagan edi.

en: “You don’t say there’s no one at home,” the newcomer cried in a cheerful, ringing voice, addressing the first visitor, who still went on pulling the bell.
uz: Siz uyda hech kim yo'q deysiz,  yangi kelgan kishi birinchi tashrif buyuruvchiga murojaat qilib, xursand va qichqiriq ovozi bilan yig'ladi, u hali ham qo'ng'iroqni qo'zg'atdi.

en: “Good evening, Koch.” “From his voice he must be quite young,” thought Raskolnikov.
uz: Xayrli kechki payt, Koch. O'z ovoziga ko'ra, u juda yosh bo'lishi kerak, deb o'yladi Raskolnikov.

en: “Who the devil can tell?
uz: Kimga shayton aytishi mumkin?

en: I’ve almost broken the lock,” answered Koch.
uz: Men deyarli qulfni buzganman, - dedi Koch.

en: “But how do you come to know me?” “Why!
uz: Ammo siz meni qanday tanib oldingiz?

en: The day before yesterday I beat you three times running at billiards at Gambrinus’.” “Oh!” “So they are not at home?
uz: O'tgan kuni men Gambrinusda bilyarda o'ynashda seni uch marta mag'lub qildim.Oh! So'ngra ular uyda yo'q?

en: It’s awfully stupid though.
uz: Ammo bu juda ahmoqlikdir.

en: Where could the old woman have gone?
uz: Qariya ayol qayerga ketgan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: I’ve come on business.” “Yes; and I have business with her, too.” “Well, what can we do?
uz: Men biznesga keldim.  Ha, men ham u bilan ish yuritaman.  Xo'sh, nima qilishimiz mumkin?

en: Go back, I suppose, Aie —aie!
uz: O'ylaymanki, qaytib boring, Aie aie!

en: And I was hoping to get some money!” cried the young man.
uz: Va men pul olishni umid qilardim! yosh yigit yig'ladi.

en: “We must give it up, of course, but what did she fix this time for?
uz: Biz buni tashlab ketishimiz kerak, albatta, lekin u bu safar nima uchun tuzatdi?

en: The old witch fixed the time for me to come herself.
uz: Keksa sehrgar mening kelishimni o'zi belgilagan.

en: And where the devil she can have got to, I can’t make out.
uz: Va u qayerga borishi mumkin bo'lsa, men buni aniqlay olmayman.

en: She sits here from year’s end to year’s end, the old hag; her legs are bad and yet here all of a sudden she is out for a walk!” “Hadn’t we better ask the porter?” “What?” “Where she’s gone and when she’ll be back.” “Hm.
uz: U yil o'tishi bilan yil o'tishi bilan bu yerda o'tiradi, keksa qo'g'ri; oyoqlari yomon, ammo birdan bu yerda o'tishga ketadi! Hadnt yaxshi bo'lsa, porterdan so'ramiz? What?  U qayerda va qachon qaytib keladi.  Hm.

en: … But you know she never does go anywhere.” And he once more tugged at the door-handle.
uz: Ammo uning hech qachon hech qayerga ketmasligini bilasiz. Va u yana bir bor eshik qo'riqchini quvib qo'ydi.

en: There’s nothing to be done, we must go!” “Stay!” cried the young man suddenly.
uz: Hech narsa qilolmaydi, biz ketishimiz kerak!

en: “Do you see how the door shakes if you pull it?” “Well?” “That shows it’s not locked, but fastened with the hook!
uz: Do'rni tortib qo'ysangiz, u qanday titraydiganini ko'rasizmi?  Xo'sh?  Bu uni qulflab qo'ymaganligini, balki qo'riqchi bilan bog'langanligini ko'rsatadi!

en: Do you hear how the hook clanks?” “Well?” “Why, don’t you see?
uz: Qo'rg'oqlarning qichqiriqlarini eshityapsizmi?Ha? Nega, ko'rmayapsizmi?

en: That proves that one of them is at home.
uz: Bu ularning biri uyda ekanligini isbotlaydi.

en: If they were all out, they would have locked the door from the outside with the key and not with the hook from inside.
uz: Agar ular hammasi tashqarida bo'lganida, eshikni ichkaridan qulflab qo'yishlari mumkin edi.

en: There, do you hear how the hook is clanking?
uz: O'sha yerda, qo'ng'iroqning qichqirishini eshityapsizmi?

en: To fasten the hook on the inside they must
uz: Xokni ichkariga bog'lash uchun ular kerak

en: be at home, don’t you see.
uz: uyda bo'ling, ko'rmaysanmi.

en: So there they are sitting inside and don’t open the door!” “Well!
uz: Shunday qilib, ular ichkarida o'tirib, eshikni ochmaydilar!

en: And so they must be!” cried Koch, astonished.
uz: Va ular shunday bo'lishi kerak! - deb hayratda qo'shib yubordi Koch.

en: “What are they about in there?” And he began furiously shaking the door.
uz: Ular u yerda nima qilishyapti? Va u g'azab bilan eshikni shovqin qila boshladi.

en: “Stay!” cried the young man again.
uz: Stay! Yosh yigit yana yig'ladi.

en: There must be something wrong.
uz: Biror narsa noto'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.

en: … Here, you’ve been ringing and pulling at the door and still they don’t open!
uz: Mana, siz eshikni qichqirish va tortish bilan shug'ullanasiz, ammo ular ochilmaydi!

en: So either they’ve both fainted or …” “What?” “I tell you what.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular ikkalasi ham bayonotga tushdilar yoki ...  Nima?  Men sizga nima deyman.

en: Let’s go fetch the porter, let him wake them up.” “All right.” Both were going down.
uz: Keling, portiyerni olib keling, u ularni uyg'otsin. To'g'ri. Ikkalasi ham tushayotgan edi.

en: You stop here while I run down for the porter.” “What for?” “Well, you’d better.” “All right.” “I’m studying the law you see!
uz: Siz bu yerda to'xtab turing, men portierning oldiga yuguraman.  Nima uchun?  Xo'sh, siz yaxshiroq bo'lasiz.  Ha, yaxshi.  Men qonunni o'rganyapman!

en: It’s evident, e-vi-dent there’s something wrong here!” the young man cried hotly, and he ran downstairs.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, bu yerda biror narsa noto'g'ri bo'lib qoldi! Yosh yigit qizg'in yig'lab, pastga yugurdi.

en: Once more he softly touched the bell which gave one tinkle, then gently, as though reflecting and looking about him, began touching the door-handle pulling it and letting it go to make sure once more that it was only fastened by the hook.
uz: U yana bir marta bir marta bir marta qichqirgan qo'ng'iroqga muloyimlik bilan tegdi, so'ngra o'zini o'ylab ko'rgan va o'ziga o'xshaydigan holda eshikni qo'lga boshladi va uni yana bir bor qo'lga kiritdi.

en: Then puffing and panting he bent down and began looking at the keyhole: but the key was in the lock on the inside and so nothing could be seen.
uz: Keyin puflab, nafas olib, o'zini egib, kalitga qaray boshladi: lekin kalit ichkaridagi qulfda edi va shuning uchun hech narsa ko'rinmasdi.

en: Raskolnikov stood keeping tight hold of the axe.
uz: Raskolnikov o'rnida turib, o'g'lini qattiq ushlab turardi.

en: He was in a sort of delirium.
uz: U bir xil deliriumda edi.

en: He was even making ready to fight when they should come in.
uz: Hatto ular qachon kelishi kerak bo'lganida, u jangga tayyorgarlik ko'rmoqchi edi.

en: While they were knocking and talking together, the idea several times occurred to him to end it all at once and shout to them through the door.
uz: Ular taqillatib, bir-biri bilan suhbatlashayotganlarida, bir necha marta u o'ziga kelib, hamma narsani bir vaqtning o'zida tugatish va eshikdan ularga qichqirish g'oyasi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Now and then he was tempted to swear at them, to jeer at them, while they could not open the door!
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan u ularga qasam ichishga, ularni masxara qilishga moyil bo'ldi, lekin ular eshikni ocholmadilar!

en: “Only make haste!” was the thought that flashed through his mind.
uz: Bola turib shoshil! degan fikr uning ongidan o'tib ketdi.

en: “But what the devil is he about?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, u nima demoqchi?

en: …” Time was passing, one minute, and another —no one came.
uz: ... Vaqt o'tib bordi, bir daqiqa o'tibdi, yana bir daqiqa o'tibdi. Hech kim kelmadi.

en: Koch began to be restless.
uz: Koch tashvishlanishni boshladi.

en: “What the devil?” he cried suddenly and in impatience deserting his sentry duty, he, too, went down, hurrying and thumping with his heavy boots on the stairs.
uz: U darhol yig'lab yubordi va sabrsizlik bilan soqchilik vazifasidan voz kechib, u ham pastga tushdi, shoshilmay va og'ir poyabzallarini ushlab turdi.

en: The steps died away.
uz: Bosqi o'lib ketdi.

en: Raskolnikov unfastened the hook, opened the door —there was no sound.
uz: Raskolnikov qo'riqchini ochib, eshikni ochdi.

en: Abruptly, without any thought at all, he went out, closing the door as thoroughly as he could, and went downstairs.
uz: Toʻsatdan, hech qanday oʻylamasdan, u tashqariga chiqib, eshikni iloji boricha yaxshilab yopib, pastga tushdi.

en: He had gone down three flights when he suddenly heard a loud voice below —where could he go!
uz: U uch qavat pastga tushganida, to'satdan pastda baland ovozni eshitdi.

en: There was nowhere to hide.
uz: Hech joyda yashirinib bo'lmasdi.

en: He was just going back to the flat.
uz: U shunchaki xonasiga qaytib ketayotgan edi.

en: Catch the brute!” Somebody dashed out of a flat below, shouting, and rather fell than ran down the stairs, bawling at the top of his voice.
uz: Yovuzni tuting! Kimdir pastdagi kvartardan chiqqach, qichqiriq qilib, pastga tushib ketdi, balki sinchkovlardan pastga yugurib, ovozini ko'targancha qichqirdi.

en: Blast him!” The shout ended in a shriek; the last sounds came from the yard; all was still.
uz: Uni o'ldiringlar! Qichqiriq qichqiriq bilan yakunlandi; so'nggi tovushlar hovlisidan keldi; hamma narsa sukunat edi.

en: But at the same instant several men talking loud and fast began noisily mounting the stairs.
uz: Ammo shu zahoti bir necha kishi baland ovozda gapirib, baland ovozda turishni boshladilar.

en: There were three or four of them.
uz: Uchta yoki to'rt kishi bor edi.

en: He distinguished the ringing voice of the young man.
uz: U yigitning qichqiriq ovozini tanib oldi.

en: “Hey!” Filled with despair he went straight to meet them, feeling “come what must!” If they stopped him —all was lost; if they let him pass — all was lost too; they would remember him.
uz: Hey! U umidsizlikdan toʻlib-toshgan holda, ularni uchratishga bordi va nima boʻlishi kerakligini his qildi! Agar ular uni toʻxtatsalar, hamma narsa yoʻqolgan boʻladi; agar uni oʻtkazib yuborsalar, hamma narsa yoʻqolgan boʻladi; ular uni eslaydilar.

en: They were approaching; they were only a flight from him —and suddenly deliverance!
uz: Ular yaqinlashayotgan edilar; ular undan faqat qochib ketish edi va to'satdan xalos bo'lishdi!

en: A few steps from him on the right, there was an empty flat with the door wide open, the flat on the second floor where the painters had been at work, and which, as though for his benefit, they had just left.
uz: Undan bir necha qadam o'ng tomonida eshik keng ochilgan bo'sh xonadon bor edi, ikkinchi qavatda esa rassomlar ishlagan xonadon bor edi va u, xuddi uning foydasi uchun, hozirgina ketib ketgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: It was they, no doubt, who had just run down, shouting.
uz: Shubhasizki, ular o'zlarini qichqirish bilan qulab yuborgan edilar.

en: The floor had only just been painted, in the middle of the room stood a pail and a broken pot with paint and brushes.
uz: Yerni yangi bo'yashgan edi, xonaning o'rtasida bo'yash va teshiklangan idish bo'lib, bo'yash va burchaklar bor edi.

en: In one instant he had whisked in at the open door and hidden behind the wall and only in the nick of time; they had already reached the landing.
uz: Bir daqiqada u ochiq eshikdan kirib, devor ortida yashirinib qolgan edi va faqat vaqt o'tib qoldi; ular endi jo'natish joyiga yetib kelishgan edi.

en: Then they turned and went on up to the fourth floor, talking loudly.
uz: So'ngra aylanib, to'rtinchi qavatga chiqib, baland ovoz bilan gapirishdi.

en: He waited, went out on tiptoe and ran down the stairs.
uz: U kutdi, oyoq burchaklari bilan chiqib, daraxtdan pastga yugurdi.

en: No one was on the stairs, nor in the gateway.
uz: Sotuvlarda ham, darvozalarda ham hech kim yo'q edi.

en: He passed quickly through the gateway and turned to the left in the street.
uz: U tezda darvoza orqali o'tib, ko'chada chap tomonga burildi.

en: He knew, he knew perfectly well that at that moment they were at the flat, that they were greatly astonished at finding it unlocked, as the door had just been fastened, that by now they were looking at the bodies, that before another minute had passed they would guess and completely realise that the murderer had just been there, and had succeeded in hiding somewhere, slipping by them and escaping.
uz: U o'sha paytda ular xonadonda ekanliklarini, eshikni qulflab qo'yishganidan juda hayron qolishganini, hozirgi vaqtda jasadlarga qarayotganlarini, yana bir daqiqa o'tmay qotilning o'sha yerda bo'lgani va bir joyda yashirinib, ulardan o'tib ketib qochganini aniqlab olishlarini yaxshi bilardi.

en: They would guess most likely that he had been in the empty flat,
uz: Ehtimol, ular uning bo'sh xonada bo'lgani haqida o'ylashadi.

en: while they were going upstairs.
uz: Ular yuqoriga borayotganlarida.

en: And meanwhile he dared not quicken his pace much, though the next turning was still nearly a hundred yards away.
uz: Va shu bilan birga u o'z ritmini ko'p tezlashtirishga jur'at qilmadi, garchi keyingi burilish hali ham qariyb yuz metr uzoqlikda bo'lgan bo'lsa ham.

en: “Should he slip through some gateway and wait somewhere in an unknown street?
uz: U birorta darvoza orqali kirib, noma'lum bir ko'chada bir joyda kutishi kerakmi?

en: Should he fling away the axe?
uz: Baltachani tashlash kerakmi?

en: Should he take a cab?
uz: U taksiga borishi kerakmi?

en: Hopeless, hopeless!” At last he reached the turning.
uz: Umidsizlik, umidsizlik! Oxir-oqibat u burchakga yetdi.

en: He turned down it more dead than alive.
uz: U uni tirikdan ko'ra ko'proq o'lik deb rad etdi.

en: Here he was half way to safety, and he understood it; it was less risky because there was a great crowd of people, and he was lost in it like a grain of sand.
uz: Bu yerda u o'rta yo'lda xavfsizlikka borgan va buni tushunardi; bu kamroq xavfli edi, chunki katta xaloyiq bo'lgan va u yerda qum xanoyi kabi yo'qolgan.

en: But all he had suffered had so weakened him that he could scarcely move.
uz: Ammo azob-uqubat ko'targan barcha narsalar uni shunchalik zaiflashtirganki, o'zini hech qanday harakatlanishga qodir bo'lmadi.

en: Perspiration ran down him in drops, his neck was all wet.
uz: Tushkunlik unga tushdi, bo'yni issiq edi.

en: “My word, he has been going it!” someone shouted at him when he came out on the canal bank.
uz: Mening so'zimcha, u buni qilmoqda! Kanal qirg'og'idan chiqqanida kimdir unga qichqirdi.

en: He was only dimly conscious of himself now, and the farther he went the worse it was.
uz: Endi u faqat o'z-o'zidan kamdan-kam xabardor edi va qanchalik uzoqroq borsa, shunchalik yomon bo'ldi.

en: He remembered however, that on coming out on to the canal bank, he was alarmed at finding few people there and so being more conspicuous, and he had thought of turning back.
uz: Biroq, u kanal qirg'og'iga chiqib ketganda, u yerda bir necha kishi bo'lganini va shu sababli ko'proq ko'rinadigan bo'lganini esladi va orqaga qaytishni o'yladi.

en: Though he was almost falling from fatigue, he went a long way round so as to get home from quite a different direction.
uz: Garchi u deyarli charchagan bo'lsa-da, uyga boshqa yo'nalishdan qaytish uchun uzoq yo'l bosib o'tdi.

en: He was not fully conscious when he passed through the gateway of his house!
uz: U o'z uyining darvozasidan o'tib ketganda, u to'liq ongidan o'tmagan edi!

en: He was already on the staircase before he recollected the axe.
uz: U o'g'lini esga olishdan oldin, u allaqachon sinfda edi.

en: And yet he had a very grave problem before him, to put it back and to escape observation as far as possible in doing so.
uz: Ammo uning oldida juda jiddiy muammo bor edi: uni qaytarib qo'yish va bu borada iloji boricha ko'rinishdan qochish.

en: He was of course incapable of reflecting that it might perhaps be far better not to restore the axe at all, but to drop it later on in somebody’s yard.
uz: Albatta, u o'z fikrini o'tkazishga qodir emas edi, ehtimol, o'g'irni umuman tiklamasdan, keyinroq uni kimningdir hovlisida tashlash yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But it all happened fortunately, the door of the porter’s room was closed but not locked, so that it seemed most likely that the porter was at home.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, bularning barchasi sodir bo'ldi, portiyerning xonasi eshigini qulflab qo'yishgan, lekin qulflab qo'ymagan, shuning uchun portiyer uyda bo'lgani ehtimoldan yiroq emas edi.

en: But he had so completely lost all power of reflection that he walked straight to the door and opened it.
uz: Ammo u o'z fikrlash qobiliyatini shunchalik yo'qotgan ediki, to'g'ri eshikga borib eshikni ochdi.

en: If the porter had asked him, “What do you want?” he would perhaps have simply handed him the axe.
uz: Agar portiyer undan: "Siz nima istaysiz?" - deb so'rasak, ehtimol u shunchaki o'g'lini unga qo'yib bergan bo'lardi.

en: But again the porter was not at home, and he succeeded in putting the axe back under the bench, and even covering it with the chunk of wood as before.
uz: Lekin yana uyda bo'lmagan ko'tarib, o'g'irni yana bank ostida qo'yib, hatto avvalgidek yog'och bo'g'i bilan qopladi.

en: He met no one, not a soul, afterwards on the way to his room; the landlady’s door was shut.
uz: U o'z xonasiga borayotganda hech kimga, hatto jonga ham duch kelmadi; uy egasining eshiklari yopiq edi.

en: When he was in his room, he flung himself on the sofa just as he was —he did not sleep, but sank into blank forgetfulness.
uz: O'z xonasida bo'lganida, u o'zini xuddi shunday sofaga tashladi.U uxlamadi, aksincha, u o'z xonasiga tushadi.

en: If anyone had come into his room then, he would have jumped up at once and screamed.
uz: Agar o'sha paytda uning xonasiga kimdir kirgan bo'lsa, u darhol ko'tarilib, qichqirgan bo'lardi.

en: Scraps and shreds of thoughts
uz: Fikrlarning mayda-mayda qismlari va parchalari

en: were simply swarming in his brain, but he could not catch at one, he could not rest on one, in spite of all his efforts.
uz: Uning miyasida shunchaki to'planib turardi, lekin u hech qachon uni ushlab qololmadi, hech qachon uning harakatlariga qaramay, uning ustida turolmadi.

en: I So he lay a very long while.
uz: Shunday qilib, u juda uzoq vaqt uxladi.

en: Now and then he seemed to wake up, and at such moments he noticed that it was far into the night, but it did not occur to him to get up.
uz: Vaqt-vaqti bilan u uyg'onib turardi va o'sha paytlarda kechasi juda uzoq ekanini payqadi, lekin u uyg'onishni tasavvur ham qilmadi.

en: At last he noticed that it was beginning to get light.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u yorug'likka tushishni boshlaganini payqadi.

en: He was lying on his back, still dazed from his recent oblivion.
uz: U o'z orqasida yotgan edi, hali ham o'zining yaqindagi unutib ketishidan befarq emas edi.

en: Fearful, despairing cries rose shrilly from the street, sounds which he heard every night, indeed, under his window after two o’clock.
uz: Qo'rqqan, umidsiz qichqiriqlar ko'chadan ko'tarildi, har kecha, haqiqatan ham, ikki soatdan so'ng o'z derazasining ostida eshitadigan tovushlar.

en: They woke him up now.
uz: Ular uni endi uyg'otdilar.

en: the drunken men are coming out of the taverns,” he thought, “it’s past two o’clock,” and at once he leaped up, as though someone had pulled him from the sofa.
uz: U o'ylaganidek, ichkilikboz kishilar mehmonxonalardan chiqib ketmoqda, soat ikki o'tibdi va u darhol o'zini ko'tardi, xuddi kimdir uni kanepadan tortib olgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: Past two o’clock!” He sat down on the sofa —and instantly recollected everything!
uz: Ikki soat o'tibdi! Sofaga o'tirdi va darhol hamma narsani esladi!

en: All at once, in one flash, he recollected everything.
uz: Bir lahzada, bir chaqmoq ichida, u hamma narsani esladi.

en: For the first moment he thought he was going mad.
uz: Birinchisi, u aqldan ozayib ketayotganini his qildi.

en: A dreadful chill came over him; but the chill was from the fever that had begun long before in his sleep.
uz: U juda sovuq bo'ldi, lekin bu sovuq uzoq vaqt oldin uyqusida boshlangan issiqdan kelib chiqqan edi.

en: Now he was suddenly taken with violent shivering, so that his teeth chattered and all his limbs were shaking.
uz: Endi u to'satdan kuchli titrash bilan olib ketildi, shuning uchun uning tishlari qichqirib, barcha a'zolari titraydi.

en: He opened the door and began listening —everything in the house was asleep.
uz: U eshikni ochib, tinglashga tushdi va uydagilarning hammasi uxlab ketishdi.

en: With amazement he gazed at himself and everything in the room around him, wondering how he could have come in the night before without fastening the door, and have flung himself on the sofa without undressing, without even taking his hat off.
uz: U o'ziga va atrofidagi hamma narsaga hayronlik bilan qaradi va o'zini o'ylab, qanday qilib o'tgan kecha eshikni yopmasdan kelib, o'zini sovg'a ustiga qo'yib, hatto kiyimini yo'qotib, to'plamini ham olib tashlamasdan o'zini pastga tashlab qo'yishi mumkinligini o'ylaydi.

en: It had fallen off and was lying on the floor near his pillow.
uz: U yerga tushib, uning yostigi yonida yotgan edi.

en: “If anyone had come in, what would he have thought?
uz: Agar biror kishi kirgan bo'lsa, nima deb o'ylaydi?

en: That I’m drunk but …” He rushed to the window.
uz: Men mast bo'lganimni, lekin... U darchaga yugurib bordi.

en: There was light enough, and he began hurriedly looking himself all over from head to foot, all his clothes;
uz: Yorug'lik yetarli edi va u o'zini boshdan oyoqgacha, butun kiyim-kechaklarini ko'rib, shoshilmay o'ziga qarab turardi.

en: were there no traces?
uz: Uning izlari yo'qmidi?

en: But there was no doing it like that; shivering with cold, he began taking off everything and looking over again.
uz: Ammo bunday qilishning iloji yo'q edi; sovuqdan titrab, u hamma narsani olib tashlay boshladi va yana ko'z o'ngga qarab ketdi.

en: He turned everything over to the last threads and rags, and mistrusting himself, went through his search three times.
uz: U hamma narsani so'nggi iplar va to'qimalarga topshirib, o'ziga ishonchsizlik qilib, uch marta qidiruvni o'tkazdi.

en: But there seemed to be nothing, no trace, except in one place, where some thick drops of congealed blood were clinging to the frayed edge of his trousers.
uz: Ammo hech narsa, hech qanday iz bo'lmagandek ko'rindi, faqat bitta joyda, qondirilgan qonning qalin tomchilari uning paltaroshlarining bo'sh bo'lib qolgan chekkasiga yopishib qolgan edi.

en: He picked up a big claspknife and cut off the frayed threads.
uz: U katta o't qo'yib, bo'g'ilgan iplarni kesib tashladi.

en: There seemed to be nothing more.
uz: Bundan tashqari hech narsa yo'qdek ko'rinardi.

en: Suddenly he remembered that the purse and the things he had taken out of the old woman’s box were still in his pockets!
