uz: Toʻsatdan u, qariya ayolning qutisidan olib chiqqan qopqoq va narsalar hali ham uning toʻplarida ekanligini esladi!

en: He had not thought till then of taking them out and hiding them!
uz: O'sha paytgacha ularni olib chiqib, yashirish haqida o'ylamagan edi!

en: He had not even thought of them while he was examining his clothes!
uz: U hatto kiyimlarini ko'rib chiqayotib, ular haqida o'ylamagan edi!

en: Instantly he rushed to take them out and fling them on the table.
uz: U darhol ularni olib chiqib, stol ustiga tashladi.

en: When he had pulled out everything, and turned the pocket inside out to be sure there was nothing left, he carried the whole heap to the corner.
uz: U hamma narsani olib chiqib, hech narsa qolmaganligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun kiyimni ichkariga burib yuborganida, butun to'plamni burchakka olib keldi.

en: The paper had come off the bottom of the wall and hung there in tatters.
uz: Qogʻoz devorning pastligidan chiqib, u erda boʻlak-boʻlak boʻlib oʻtirgan edi.

en: He began stuffing all the things into the hole under the paper: “They’re in!
uz: U qog'oz ostidagi tuchoqqa barcha narsalarni to'ldirishni boshladi: "Ular kirdi!

en: All out of sight, and the purse too!” he thought gleefully, getting up and gazing blankly at the hole which bulged out more than ever.
uz: Hamma ko'rinmas edi, va hammom! deb o'yladi u xursand bo'lib, turib, hech qachon ko'rmaganidan ko'ra ko'proq ko'tarilgan toshga ko'z tikdi.

en: Suddenly he shuddered all over with horror; “My God!” he whispered in despair: “what’s the matter with me?
uz: Toʻsatdan u qoʻrquvdan titrab ketdi; My God! u umidsizlikka tushib: what's the matter with me?

en: Is that the way to hide things?” He had not reckoned on having trinkets to hide.
uz: Bu narsalarni yashirishning usulimi? U yashirish uchun go'zal narsalarni o'rnatishni kutmagan edi.

en: He had only thought of money, and so had not prepared a hiding-place.
uz: U faqat pul haqida o'ylagan edi, shuning uchun u yashirinib qolish joyini tayyorlamagan edi.

en: “But now, now, what am I glad of?” he thought, “Is that hiding things?
uz: Ammo endi nimaga quvonaman? - deb o'yladi u, - bu yashirgan narsalarmi?

en: My reason’s deserting me —simply!” He sat down on the sofa in exhaustion and was at once shaken by another unbearable fit of shivering.
uz: Mening sabablarim meni tashlab ketmoqda, shunchaki! U charchagan holda sofaga o'tirdi va darhol yana bir chidamsiz titrishga tushdi.

en: Mechanically he drew from a chair beside him his old student’s winter coat, which was still warm though almost in rags, covered himself up with it and once more sank into drowsiness and delirium.
uz: Mexanik jihatdan u o'zining yonidagi o'rindiqdan eski o'quvchisining qishki kiyimini olib chiqdi, u hali ham issiq bo'lsa-da, deyarli to'qimalarda edi, o'zini u bilan qopladi va yana uyquslikka va deliriumga tushdi.

en: He lost consciousness.
uz: U ongini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: Not more than five minutes had passed when he jumped up a second time, and at once pounced in a frenzy on his clothes again.
uz: Ikkinchi marta ko'tarilganida besh daqiqadan ko'p vaqt o'tmagan edi va u darhol o'z kiyimlarini qayta o'rab oldi.

en: “How could I go to sleep again with nothing done?
uz: Qanday qilib hech narsa qilmagan holda yana uxlay olaman?

en: Yes, yes; I have not taken the loop off the armhole!
uz: Ha, ha, men buzni qo'l cho'g'idan olib tashlamaganman!

en: I forgot it, forgot a thing like that!
uz: Men unutib qoldim, bunday narsani unutib qoldim!

en: Such a piece of evidence!”
uz: Bunday dalillar bor!

en: He pulled off the noose, hurriedly cut it to pieces and threw the bits among his linen under the pillow.
uz: U qo'lga qo'yilgan ipni olib tashladi, darhol uni bo'g'im-bo'g'im qilib tashladi va bo'g'im-bo'g'imlarini to'pkalar o'rtasida yostiq ostida tashladi.

en: “Pieces of torn linen couldn’t rouse suspicion, whatever happened; I think not, I think not, anyway!” he repeated, standing in the middle of the room, and with painful concentration he fell to gazing about him again, at the floor and everywhere, trying to make sure he had not forgotten anything.
uz: Tirtirilib ketgan len maydonlari nima bo'lganidan qat'i nazar, hech qanday shubha uyg'otolmadi; men o'ylamayman, o'ylamayman, hech bo'lmasa! U o'rtada turib, takrorladi va og'riqli konsentratsiya bilan o'zini yana atrofida ko'rishga tushdi, yerga va hamma joyga, hech narsa unutmaganligiga ishonch hosil qilishga harakat qildi.

en: The conviction that all his faculties, even memory, and the simplest power of reflection were failing him, began to be an insufferable torture.
uz: Uning barcha qobiliyatlari, hatto xotira va eng oddiy fikrlash qobiliyati uni yo'qotib qo'yishiga ishonish, chidamsiz azobga aylanishni boshladi.

en: “Surely it isn’t beginning already!
uz: Shubhasizki, bu hali boshlanmagan!

en: Surely it isn’t my punishment coming upon me?
uz: Bu mening jazomim emasmi?

en: It is!” The frayed rags he had cut off his trousers were actually lying on the floor in the middle of the room, where anyone coming in would see them!
uz: Ha, shunday! O'z shortslarini kesib tashlagan bo'lak-bo'laklar, aslida, xonaning o'rtasida, yer ustida yotgan edi, u yerga kirgan har bir kishi ularni ko'rishi mumkin edi!

en: “What is the matter with me!” he cried again, like one distraught.
uz: Men bilan nima bo'ldi? - deb yana yig'ladi u, xuddi g'amgin odam kabi.

en: Then a strange idea entered his head; that, perhaps, all his clothes were covered with blood, that, perhaps, there were a great many stains, but that he did not see them, did not notice them because his perceptions were failing, were going to pieces … his reason was clouded.
uz: Keyin uning ongiga g'alati bir fikr kirdi; ehtimol, uning barcha kiyimlari qon bilan qoplangan, ehtimol, ko'pcha leklar bor edi, lekin u ularni ko'rmagan, ularni sezmagan, chunki his-tuyg'ular puchga chiqardi, parchalanib ketardi ... uning aql-idroklari bulutli edi.

en: … Suddenly he remembered that there had been blood on the purse too.
uz: Birdan u ham qopqoqda qon borligini esladi.

en: Then there must be blood on the pocket too, for I put the wet purse in my pocket!” In a flash he had turned the pocket inside out and, yes!
uz: O'shanda pochkumda ham qon bo'lishi kerak, chunki men suvli sumkani pochkumga qo'ydim! Bir lahzada u pochkani ichkariga burib yubordi va ha!

en: —there were traces, stains on the lining of the pocket!
uz: Jobning qopqoqida izlar, leklar bor edi!

en: “So my reason has not quite deserted me, so I still have some sense and memory, since I guessed it of myself,” he thought triumphantly, with a deep sigh of relief; “it’s simply the weakness of fever, a moment’s delirium,” and he tore the whole lining out of the left pocket of his trousers.
uz: Demak, aql-idrokim meni butunlay tashlab ketmagan, shuning uchun o'zim o'zim o'ylagandan keyin ham ba'zi his-tuyg'ularim va xotiram bor, deb o'yladi u g'alaba bilan, chuqur tasalli his-tuyg'usi bilan; bu shunchaki issiqning zaifligi, bir daqiqalik delirium, va u butun bo'yoqni o'z shortslarining chap pochkasidan yirtib tashladi.

en: At that instant the sunlight fell on his left boot; on the sock which poked out from the boot, he fancied there were traces!
uz: O'sha zahoti quyosh nurlari uning chap cho'nkashiga tushib qoldi; cho'nkasidan chiqadigan cho'nkasida izlar bor deb o'yladi!

en: He flung off his boots; “traces indeed!
uz: U botlarini tashladi; traces haqiqatan ham!

en: The tip of the sock was soaked with blood;” he must have unwarily stepped into that pool.
uz: Soqogʻining soʻngi qon bilan toʻlib-toshgan edi; u ehtiyotsizlik bilan hovuzga qadam qoʻygan boʻlishi kerak.

en: … “But what am I to do with this now?
uz: Ammo men endi bu bilan nima qilishim kerak?

en: Where am I to put the sock and rags and pocket?” He gathered them all up in his hands and stood in the middle of the room.
uz: Qayerga cho'nqa, to'qima va qop qo'yishim kerak? U hamma narsani qo'llarida to'pladi va xonaning o'rtasida turdi.

en: But they would ransack the stove first of all.
uz: Ammo ular avvalo pechni talon-toroj qilishardi.

en: But what can I burn them with?
uz: Ammo ularni nima bilan yondira olaman?

en: There are no matches even.
uz: Hatto o'yinlar ham yo'q.

en: No, better go out and throw it all away somewhere.
uz: Yo'q, tashqariga chiqib, hamma narsani qaysidir joyga tashlash yaxshiroqdir.

en: Yes, better throw it away,” he repeated, sitting down on the sofa again, “and at once, this minute, without lingering …” But his head sank on the pillow instead.
uz: Ha, uni tashlab yuborish yaxshiroqdir, - deb takrorladi u, yana sofa ustida o'tirib, - va birdan, shu daqiqada, ko'p vaqt o'tkazmasdan ... Ammo boshini yostiqqa tashlab qo'ydi.

en: Again the unbearable icy shivering came over him; again he drew his coat over him.
uz: Yana uning ustiga yengilmas sovuq titrishlar tushdi; yana kiyimini o'ziga surdi.

en: And for a long while, for some hours, he was haunted by the impulse to “go off somewhere at once, this moment, and fling it all away, so that it may be out of sight and done with, at once, at once!” Several times he tried to rise from the sofa, but could not.
uz: Va uzoq vaqt davomida, bir necha soat davomida, uni bir vaqtning o'zida biron bir joyga chiqib ketish va hamma narsani tashlab ketish istagi kuzatib turardi, shuning uchun u ko'rinmas edi va bir vaqtning o'zida to'xtadi! Bir necha marta u kanepadan turishga harakat qildi, lekin u qila olmadi.

en: He was thoroughly waked up at last by a violent knocking at his door.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, uning eshigini qattiqqo'l taqillatib, u uyg'ondi.

en: “Open, do, are you dead or alive?
uz: Ochiq, qil, o'lganmisiz yoki tirikmisiz?

en: He keeps sleeping here!” shouted Nastasya, banging with her fist on the door.
uz: U shu yerda uxlaydi! - dedi Nastasya, eshikga qo'shiq qo'yib.

en: “For whole days together he’s snoring here like a dog!
uz: Butun kunlar davomida u bu yerda it kabi qichqirib turadi!

en: It’s past ten.” “Maybe he’s not at home,” said a man’s voice.
uz: O'n soat o'tibdi.U uyda bo'lmasligi mumkin, - dedi bir kishi ovozi.

en: that’s the porter’s voice.
uz: Bu porterning ovozi.

en: … What does he want?” He jumped up and sat on the sofa.
uz: ... U nima istaydi? U o'tib o'tirdi va sofaga o'tirdi.

en: The beating of his heart was a positive pain.
uz: Qalb urishlari ijobiy og'riq edi.

en: “Then who can have latched the door?” retorted Nastasya.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa, eshikni kim qulflab qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin? - dedi Nastasya.

en: “He’s taken to bolting himself in!
uz: U o'zini o'zi qo'lga kiritishga majbur qildi!

en: As if he were worth stealing!
uz: O'g'rilik qilishga arziydigan bo'lsa kerak!

en: Open, you stupid, wake up!” “What do they want?
uz: Oching, ahmoq, uyg'oning!Ular nima istaydilar?

en: …” He half rose, stooped forward and unlatched the door.
uz: ... U yarim ko'tarildi, o'zini egib, eshikni ochdi.

en: His room was so small that he could undo the latch without leaving the bed.
uz: Uning xonasi shunchalik kichkina bo'lganki, u o'z yotoqidan chiqib ketmasdan qulfni buzishi mumkin edi.

en: Yes; the porter and Nastasya were standing there.
uz: Ha, u yerda portiyer va Nastasya turgan edi.

en: Nastasya stared at him in a strange way.
uz: Nastasya unga g'alati tarzda qaradi.

en: He glanced with a defiant and desperate air at the porter, who without a word held out a grey folded paper sealed with bottle-wax.
uz: U bir so'z aytmay, shisha-shax bilan muhrlangan griy qatlamli qog'ozni ko'tarib o'tirgan portiyerga qarshilik va umidsizlik bilan qaradi.

en: “A notice from the office,” he announced, as he gave him the paper.
uz: Xizmatdan xabardorlik, uni qog'ozni berganida, u xabar berdi.

en: “From what office?” “A summons to the police office, of course.
uz: Qaysi ofisdan?A politsiyaga chaqiriq, albatta.

en: You know which office.” “To the police?
uz: Qaysi idora haqida bilasizmi?Polisga?

en: You’re sent for, so you go.” The man looked at him attentively, looked round the room and turned to go away.
uz: Sizni chaqirish uchun yuborilgan, shuning uchun keting. U kishi unga diqqat bilan qaradi, xonani ko'rib, ketish uchun o'girilibdi.

en: “He’s downright ill!” observed Nastasya, not taking her eyes off him.
uz: "U bemor!" - deb o'yladi Nastasya, ko'zlarini undan olib ketmay.

en: The porter turned his head for a moment.
uz: Porter bir zum boshini burdi.

en: “He’s been in a fever since yesterday,” she added.
uz: U o'tgan kundan beri issiqlikda edi, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u.

en: Raskolnikov made no response and held the paper in his hands, without opening it.
uz: Raskolnikov hech qanday javob bermadi va qog'ozni qo'lida olib, uni ochmasdan qo'ydi.

en: “Don’t you get up then,” Nastasya went on compassionately, seeing that he was letting his feet down from the sofa.
uz: Don't get up then, Nastasya rahm-shafqat bilan davom etdi, chunki u oyoqlarini kanepadan tushirganini ko'rdi.

en: “You’re ill, and so don’t go; there’s no such hurry.
uz: Siz kasalsiz, shuning uchun ketmang; bunday terishish kerak emas.

en: What have you got there?” He looked; in his right hand he held the shreds he had cut from his trousers, the sock, and the rags of the pocket.
uz: Sizda nima bor? U ko'z ochdi; o'ng qo'lida o'z piyozlaridan kesib olgan bo'lak-bo'laklarini, shokalarini va qopqog'ini ushlab turardi.

en: So he had been asleep with them in his hand.
uz: Demak, u ularni qo'lida ushlab yotgan edi.

en: Afterwards reflecting upon it, he remembered that half waking up in his fever, he had grasped all this tightly in his hand and so fallen asleep again.
uz: Keyinchalik bu haqda mulohaza yuritib, o'sha paytning o'zida o'z og'rig'ida uyg'onib, hamma narsani qo'lida qattiq ushlab, yana uxlaganini esladi.

en: “Look at the rags he’s collected and sleeps with them, as though he has got hold of a treasure …” And Nastasya went off into her hysterical giggle.
uz: O'zining to'plamlariga nazar solinglar va xuddi xazinaga ega bo'lganidek, ular bilan uxlaydilar ... Nastasya esa histerik tabassumga tushib ketdi.

en: Instantly he thrust them all under his great coat and fixed his eyes intently upon her.
uz: Oʻsha zahoti u hammalarini katta kiyimining ostiga qoʻyib, qizga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: Far as he was from being capable of rational reflection at that moment, he felt that no one would behave like that with a person who was going to be arrested.
uz: U o'sha paytda oqilona mulohaza yuritishga qodir bo'lmagani uchun, hech kim hibsga olinadigan odamga bunday munosabatda bo'lmasligini his qilgan.

en: “But … the police?” “You’d better have some tea!
uz: Lekin... politsiya?Siz biroz choy ichsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi!

en: I’ll bring it, there’s some left.” “No … I’m going; I’ll go at once,” he muttered, getting on to his feet.
uz: Men uni olib kelaman, yana bir nechta qolmoqda.   Yo'q ... Men ketyapman; men darhol ketyapman, - dedi u, oyoqlariga turib.

en: “Why, you’ll never get downstairs!” “Yes, I’ll go.” “As you please.” She followed the porter out.
uz: Nega, sen hech qachon pastga tushmaysan!  Ha, men ketaman.  Siz xohlagancha. U portiyerni tashqariga ergashib chiqdi.

en: At once he rushed to the light to examine the sock and the rags.
uz: Oʻsha zahoti u choʻtka va kiyimlarni koʻrib chiqish uchun yorugʻlikka yugurdi.

en: “There are stains, but not very noticeable; all covered with dirt, and rubbed and already discoloured.
uz: Bularning ko'rinishi ko'p bo'lmasa-da, ko'rinadi; ularning barchasi bulut bilan qoplangan, silkitilgan va allaqachon rangsiz bo'lgan.

en: No one who had no suspicion could distinguish anything.
uz: Hech kimda hech qanday shubha yo'q bo'lsa ham, hech narsani farqlay olmaydi.

en: Nastasya from a distance could not have noticed, thank God!” Then with a tremor he broke the seal of the notice and began reading; he was a long while reading, before he understood.
uz: Nastasya uzoqdan ko'rmagan bo'lsa kerak, Xudoga shukr! So'ngra titrash bilan u xabarning muhrini buzdi va o'qishni boshladi; u uzoq vaqt o'qishni boshladi, lekin tushunmadi.

en: It was an ordinary summons from the district police-
uz: Bu tuman politsiyasi tomonidan oddiy chaqiriq edi.

en: station to appear that day at half-past nine at the office of the district superintendent.
uz: O'sha kuni soat to'qqiz yarimlarda tuman nazorati boshlig'ining ofisida paydo bo'lish uchun.

en: “But when has such a thing happened?
uz: Ammo bunday voqea qachon sodir bo'ldi?

en: I never have anything to do with the police!
uz: Men hech qachon politsiya bilan hech qanday aloqam yo'q!

en: And why just today?” he thought in agonising bewilderment.
uz: Va nega bugun? deb o'yladi u og'ir hayronlik bilan.

en: “Good God, only get it over soon!” He was flinging himself on his knees to pray, but broke into laughter —not at the idea of prayer, but at himself.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo, buni tezda tuzating! U ibodat qilish uchun tiz cho'kkan edi, ammo o'ziga kulish bilan bosh tortdi Nima uchun ibodat qilish kerakligi haqida emas, balki o'ziga.

en: He began, hurriedly dressing.
uz: U tezda kiyinishni boshladi.

en: “If I’m lost, I am lost, I don’t care!
uz: Agar men yo'qolsam, yo'qolganman, menga g'amxo'rlik qilmayman!

en: Shall I put the sock on?” he suddenly wondered, “it will get dustier still and the traces will be gone.” But no sooner had he put it on than he pulled it off again in loathing and horror.
uz: Cho'nqa kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi? deb o'yladi u, o'zidan-o'zi, o'sha tuproq bo'lib, izlar yo'q bo'ladi. Ammo uni kiyib olganidan so'ng, u nafrat va dahshatga to'lib, uni yana tushirib yubordi.

en: He pulled it off, but reflecting that he had no other socks, he picked it up and put it on again —and again he laughed.
uz: U uni olib chiqdi, lekin boshqa chorsaklari yo'qligini ko'rib, uni olib, yana kiyib qo'ydi va yana kuldi.

en: “That’s all conventional, that’s all relative, merely a way of looking at it,” he thought in a flash, but only on the top surface of his mind, while he was shuddering all over, “there, I’ve got it on!
uz: Bu hamma narsa an'anaviy, bu hamma narsa o'zaro bog'liq, shunchaki unga qarashning o'zi, o'zi o'yladi, lekin faqat ongining eng yuqori yuzasida, u hamma joyda titrab turganida, u erda, men uni o'zimga oldim!

en: I have finished by getting it on!” But his laughter was quickly followed by despair.
uz: Men uni kiyganimdan so'ng bo'ldim! Ammo uning kulgi tezda umidsizlikka uchradi.

en: “No, it’s too much for me …” he thought.
uz: Yo'q, bu men uchun juda ko'p... deb o'yladi.

en: “From fear,” he muttered.
uz: U qo'rqqanidan g'iybat qildi.

en: His head swam and ached with fever.
uz: Uning boshi suzib, issiqdan azob chekdi.

en: They want to decoy me there and confound me over everything,” he mused, as he went out on to the stairs —“the worst of it is I’m almost lightheaded … I may blurt out something stupid …” On the stairs he remembered that he was leaving all the things just as they were in the hole in the wall, “and very likely, it’s on purpose to search when I’m out,” he thought, and stopped short.
uz: Ular meni o'sha yerda o'rab olishadi va meni hamma narsa bilan chalg'itmoqchi, - deb o'yladi u, - u mertalarga chiqib ketayotganda eng og'ir narsa shundaki, men deyarli g'alati bo'laman ... men biron bir ahmoqona narsani so'zlab yuborishim mumkin ... - Mertalarda u barcha narsalarni deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli deyarli tashlab ketayotganini esladi, - deb o'yladi u va o'zini to'xtatdi.

en: But he was possessed by such despair, such cynicism of misery, if one may so call it, that with a wave of his hand he went on.
uz: Ammo u shunchalik umidsizlikka, qashshoqlikning shunchalik sinikligiga ega edi, agar buni shunday deb aytsa bo'ladi, u qo'lini o'chirib davom etdi.

en: “Only to get it over!” In the street the heat was insufferable again; not a drop of rain had fallen all those days.
uz: Yeganim uchun! Ko'chada issiqlik yana ko'tarilmadi; o'sha kunlar davomida bir tomchi ham yomg'ir yog'magan edi.

en: Again dust, bricks and mortar, again the stench from the shops and pothouses, again the drunken men, the Finnish pedlars and half-broken-down cabs.
uz: Yana chang, tosh va mortar, yana do'konlar va uylarning kiridan, yana ichkilikbozlar, finlar va yarim parchalangan taksilar.

en: The sun shone straight in his eyes, so that it hurt him to look out of them, and he felt his head going round —as a man in a fever is apt to feel when he comes out into the street on a bright sunny day.
uz: Quyosh uning ko'zlariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shashardi, shuning uchun ularni ko'rish unga og'riqli edi va u o'z boshini aylanib borayotganini his qilardi, chunki issiq bo'lgan odam ko'chaga chiqqanida yorqin quyoshli kunlarda o'zini shunday his qiladi.

en: When he reached the turning into the street, in an agony of trepidation he looked down it … at the house … and at once averted his eyes.
uz: U ko'chaga o'tadigan joyga yetib borgach, qo'rquvdan azob chekib, uyiga qarab, ko'zlarini darhol chalg'itdi.

en: “If they question me, perhaps I’ll simply tell,” he thought, as he drew near the police-station.
uz: Agar meni so'roq qilsalar, ehtimol men shunchaki aytaman, deb o'yladi u, politsiya stansiyasiga yaqinlashganda.

en: The police-station was about a quarter of a mile off.
uz: Politsiya stansiyasi bir mildan bir chorak uzoqlikda edi.

en: It had lately been moved to new rooms on the fourth floor of a new house.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda u yangi uyning to'rtinchi qavatidagi yangi xonalarga ko'chirildi.

en: He had been once for a moment in the old office but long ago.
uz: O'sha paytlari u eski ofisda bir marta bo'lgan edi, ammo ancha vaqt oldin.

en: Turning in at the gateway, he saw on the right a flight of stairs which a peasant was mounting with a book in his hand.
uz: Darvoza tomon o'girib, o'ng tomonida bir qishloq egasi o'z qo'lida kitob olib o'tirgan poygachalarni ko'rdi.

en: “A house-porter, no doubt; so then, the office is here,” and he began ascending the stairs on the chance.
uz: Shubhasiz, uyning ustiga kiruvchi, biroq ofis ham bu yerda, va u fursatdan foydalanib, daraxtga ko'tarilishni boshladi.

en: He did not want to ask questions of anyone.
uz: U hech kimga savol berishni istamagan.

en: “I’ll go in, fall on my knees, and confess everything …” he thought, as he reached the fourth floor.
uz: Men kiraman, tiz cho'kib, hamma narsani tan olib ketaman, - deb o'yladi u, to'rtinchi qavatga yetib kelganida.

en: The staircase was steep, narrow and all sloppy with dirty water.
uz: Turg'alar tepa, siqilgan va barcha kirli suv bilan bevafo edi.

en: The kitchens of the flats opened on to the stairs and stood open almost the whole day.
uz: Uy-joylarning oshxonalari mertagacha ochildi va deyarli kun bo'yi ochiq turdi.

en: So there was a fearful smell and heat.
uz: Shunday qilib, qo'rqinchli hid va issiqlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: The staircase was crowded with porters going up and down with their books under their arms, policemen, and persons of all sorts and both sexes.
uz: Turg'alar o'z kitoblarini qo'l ostida olib, ko'tarib-ko'tarib borayotgan portiyerlar, politsiya xodimlari va har xil jinsdagi odamlar bilan to'la edi.

en: The door of the office, too, stood wide open.
uz: Ofis eshigini ham keng ochib turardim.

en: Peasants stood waiting within.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi ichkarida kutib turardi.

en: There, too, the heat was stifling and there was a sickening smell of fresh paint and stale oil from the newly decorated rooms.
uz: U yerda ham issiqlik og'ir edi va yangi bezatilgan xonalardan yangi bo'yoq va eskirgan moyning achchiq hidini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: After waiting a little, he decided to move forward into the next room.
uz: Biroz kutgandan so'ng, u qo'shni xonaga o'tishga qaror qildi.

en: All the rooms were small and low-pitched.
uz: Barcha xonalar kichik va past bo'lgan edi.

en: A fearful impatience drew him on and on.
uz: Qo'rqinchli sabrsizlik uni ko'p marta jalb qildi.

en: No one paid attention to him.
uz: Hech kim unga e'tibor bermadi.

en: In the second room some clerks sat writing, dressed hardly better than he was, and rather a queer-looking set.
uz: Ikkinchi xonada ba'zi xizmatkorlar o'tirib yozishardi, u undan yaxshi kiyinmagan edi, aksincha, o'ziga xos ko'rinadigan set.

en: He went up to one of them.
uz: U ulardan biriga bordi.

en: “What is it?” He showed the notice he had received.
uz: Bu nima? U olgan xabarni ko'rsatdi.

en: “You are a student?” the man asked, glancing at the notice.
uz: Siz o'quvchimisiz? - deb so'radi yigit, yozuvlarga nazar solib.

en: “Yes, formerly a student.” The clerk looked at him, but without the slightest interest.
uz: Ha, ilgari talaba edi. Xodim unga qaradi, lekin hech qanday qiziqish ko'rsatmaydi.

en: He was a particularly unkempt person with the look of a fixed idea in his eye.
uz: U o'zining ko'zidagi fikrni o'zgartirgan, ayniqsa beparvo odam edi.

en: “There would be no getting anything out of him, because he has no interest in anything,” thought Raskolnikov.
uz: "Undan hech narsa olinmaydi, chunki u hech narsaga qiziqmaydi", - deb o'yladi Raskolnikov.

en: “Go in there to the head clerk,” said the clerk, pointing towards the furthest room.
uz: O'sha yerga borib, bosh xodimni ko'ring, - dedi xodim, uzoqroq xonaga ishora qilib.

en: He went into that room —the fourth in order; it was a small room and packed full of people, rather better dressed than in the outer rooms.
uz: U o'sha xonada to'rtinchi marta o'tirdi; u kichik xonada bo'lib, tashqi xonalarga qaraganda ko'proq kiyim kiygan odamlar bilan to'la edi.

en: Among them were two ladies.
uz: Ular orasida ikkita ayol bor edi.

en: One, poorly dressed in mourning, sat at the table opposite the chief clerk, writing something at his dictation.
uz: Bir kishi, qayg'u kiyimida yomon kiyim kiygan bo'lsa-da, bosh amaldorning qarshisidagi dasturxonda o'tirib, uning buyruqlariga binoan biror narsa yozadi.

en: The other, a very stout, buxom woman with a purplish-red, blotchy face, excessively smartly dressed with a brooch on her bosom as big as a saucer, was standing on one side, apparently waiting for something.
uz: Ikkinchisi, juda kuchli, chiroyli qizil, burchakli yuzli, ko'nglida chiroyli kiyim kiygan, sirtdek katta bo'lgan ko'krakli ayol, bir tomonda turib, bir narsani kutayotgan edi.

en: Raskolnikov thrust his notice upon the head clerk.
uz: Raskolnikov o'z e'lonini bosh xodimiga qo'yib berdi.

en: The latter glanced at it, said: “Wait a minute,” and went on attending to the lady in mourning.
uz: Keyinchalik bu ayol uni ko'rib,: "Bir daqiqa turing", - dedi va qayg'urgan ayolga yordam berishga davom etdi.

en: He breathed more freely.
uz: U ko'proq erkin nafas oldi.

en: “It can’t be that!” By degrees he began to regain confidence, he kept urging himself to have courage and be calm.
uz: Bu mumkin emas! Butunlay ishonchni tiklay boshladi, u jasoratli va xotirjam bo'lishga o'zini rag'batlantirgan.

en: “Some foolishness, some trifling carelessness, and I may betray myself!
uz: Ba'zi ahmoqlik, ba'zi beparvolik va o'zimga xiyonat qilishim mumkin!

en: Hm … it’s a pity there’s no air here,” he added, “it’s stifling.
uz: Hm... bu yerda havo yo'qligi afsus, - dedi u qo'shimcha qilib, - bu og'ir.

en: … It makes one’s head dizzier than ever … and one’s mind too …” He was conscious of a terrible inner turmoil.
uz: ... Bu odamning boshini har qachongidan ko'proq bo'shashtiradi ... va uning ongini ham ... U dahshatli ichki g'alayonni sezgan.

en: He was afraid of losing his self-control; he tried to catch at something and fix his mind on it, something quite irrelevant, but he could not succeed in this at all.
uz: U o'zini nazorat qilishni yo'qotishdan qo'rqardi; u biron bir narsani ushlab, unga e'tibor qaratishga harakat qilardi, bu juda ahamiyatsiz narsa edi, ammo u bunda umuman muvaffaqiyat qozona olmadi.

en: Yet the head clerk greatly interested him, he kept hoping to see through him and guess something from his face.
uz: Ammo bosh kotibi uni juda qiziqtirgan, u o'z ko'zidan ko'rishni va yuzidan bir narsani tasavvur qilishni umid qilgan.

en: He was a very young man, about two and twenty, with a dark mobile face that looked older than his years.
uz: U juda yosh yigit edi, taxminan yigirma ikki yoshda edi, qorong'i ko'rinadigan yuzi bor edi va o'z yoshidan katta ko'rinardi.

en: He was fashionably dressed and foppish, with his hair parted in the middle, well combed and pomaded, and wore a number of rings on his well-scrubbed fingers and a gold chain on his waistcoat.
uz: U zamonaviy kiyim-kechak va chiroyli kiyimda edi, sochlari o'rtacha bo'lib, yaxshi pishirilgan va moylangan edi va yaxshi pishirilgan barmoqlarida bir qator halqalar va kiyimida oltin zanjir bor edi.

en: He said a couple of words in French to a foreigner who was in the room, and said them fairly correctly.
uz: U xonada bo'lgan chet ellik kishiga fransuz tilida bir necha so'z aytdi va ularni juda to'g'ri aytdi.

en: “Luise Ivanovna, you can sit down,” he said casually to the gaily- dressed, purple-faced lady, who was still standing as though not venturing to sit down, though there was a chair beside her.
uz: Luisa Ivanovna, o'tirishingiz mumkin, dedi u xursandchilik bilan kiyingan, bo'yoq suratli ayolga, u hali ham o'tirgan bo'lsa-da, o'tirishga jur'at qilmayotganga o'xshaydi, ammo uning yonida o'rindiq bor edi.

en: “Ich danke,” said the latter, and softly, with a rustle of silk she sank into the chair.
uz: "Ich danke", - deb javob berdi u, xotirjamlik bilan o'rinbosarga tushib ketdi.

en: Her light blue dress trimmed with white lace floated about the table like an air-balloon and filled almost half the room.
uz: Ochiq-oqshiroq ko'ylak kiyimlari oq dantzal bilan bezatilgan edi va stol atrofida havo balonlari kabi uchib, xonaning deyarli yarmini to'ldirdi.

en: But she was obviously embarrassed at filling half
uz: Ammo u yarmini to'ldirishdan uyalgan edi.

en: the room and smelling so strongly of scent; and though her smile was impudent as well as cringing, it betrayed evident uneasiness.
uz: Xonadon va bu kabi kuchli xushbo'y tutatqi; va uning tabassumini qo'rqinchli va qo'rqinchli bo'lsa-da, u ochiq-oydin xavotirni ko'rsatdi.

en: The lady in mourning had done at last, and got up.
uz: Ayol oxir-oqibat yig'lab chiqdi va o'rnidan turdi.

en: All at once, with some noise, an officer walked in very jauntily, with a peculiar swing of his shoulders at each step.
uz: Birdan, biroz shov-shuv bilan, bir ofitser juda sariqlik bilan kirib keldi, har qadamda o'z shoxlarining o'ziga xos o'zgarishi bilan.

en: He tossed his cockaded cap on the table and sat down in an easy-chair.
uz: U o'zining qo'pol qo'rqinchli to'pini stol ustiga tashlab, o'tirgan joyga o'tirdi.

en: The small lady positively skipped from her seat on seeing him, and fell to curtsying in a sort of ecstasy; but the officer took not the smallest notice of her, and she did not venture to sit down again in his presence.
uz: Xotincha uni ko'rganida o'rindiqidan pastga o'tdi va o'ziga xos ekstaziya hissi bilan o'tirdi; biroq ofitser unga hech qanday e'tibor bermadi va u yana uning huzurida o'tirishga jur'at etmadi.

en: He was the assistant superintendent.
uz: U boshliqning yordamchisi bo'lgan.

en: He had a reddish moustache that stood out horizontally on each side of his face, and extremely small features, expressive of nothing much except a certain insolence.
uz: Uning yuzining har bir tomonida gorizontal tarzda ko'rinadigan qizil burchaklari va juda kichik belgilari bor edi, ular faqatgina biroz g'azablantirishdan boshqa hech narsani ifodalamaydigan edi.

en: He looked askance and rather indignantly at Raskolnikov; he was so very badly dressed, and in spite of his humiliating position, his bearing was by no means in keeping with his clothes.
uz: U Raskolnikovga g'azablangan va g'azablangan ko'z bilan qaradi; u juda yomon kiyimda edi va o'z kamsitadigan mavqega qaramay, uning munosabati kiyimlariga mos kelmadi.

en: Raskolnikov had unwarily fixed a very long and direct look on him, so that he felt positively affronted.
uz: Raskolnikov ehtiyotkorlik bilan unga juda uzoq va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarashni ko'rsatdi va u o'zini ijobiy tarzda haqoratlangan his qildi.

en: “What do you want?” he shouted, apparently astonished that such a ragged fellow was not annihilated by the majesty of his glance.
uz: - Nima istaysiz? - deb baqirdi u, ko'rinib turibdiki, bunday chiroyli yigitning ko'z ko'zlarining ulug'vorligi bilan yo'q qilinmagani uchun hayron edi.

en: “I was summoned … by a notice …” Raskolnikov faltered.
uz: Men chaqirilgan edim ... xabardorlik bilan ... Raskolnikov puchga chiqdi.

en: “For the recovery of money due, from the student,” the head clerk interfered hurriedly, tearing himself from his papers.
uz: O'quvchi tomonidan to'liq to'lanadigan pulni qaytarish uchun bosh kotibi darhol aralashdi va o'z hujjati qog'ozlaridan o'zini yirtib oldi.

en: “Here!” and he flung Raskolnikov a document and pointed out the place.
uz: Mana! va u Raskolnikovga hujjat tashlab, joyni ko'rsatdi.

en: “Read that!” “Money?
uz: Shuni o'qing!  Pul?

en: What money?” thought Raskolnikov, “but … then … it’s certainly not that.” And he trembled with joy.
uz: Qaysi pul? - deb o'yladi Raskolnikov, - lekin... keyin... bu albatta o'sha emas. U xursandchilikdan titrab ketdi.

en: He felt sudden intense indescribable relief.
uz: U to'satdan o'zidan-o'zidan so'zlab bo'lmaydigan darajada yengillikni his qildi.

en: A load was lifted from his back.
uz: Uning orqasidan yuk ko'tarildi.

en: “And pray, what time were you directed to appear, sir?” shouted the assistant superintendent, seeming for some unknown reason more and more aggrieved.
uz: Va ibodat qiling, sizga qaysi soatda ko'rinishga yo'l qo'yilgan, xonim? - deb baqirdi yordamchi nazoratchi, noma'lum sabablarga ko'ra, ko'proq xafa bo'lib qoldi.

en: “You are told to come at nine, and now it’s twelve!” “The notice was only brought me a quarter of an hour ago,” Raskolnikov answered loudly over his shoulder.
uz: Sizga to'qqizlarda kelishni aytishdi, endi esa o'n ikki!  Menga bu xabarni faqat bir chorak soat oldin olib kelishdi, Raskolnikov baland ovoz bilan yelkasiga qarab javob berdi.

en: To his own surprise he, too, grew suddenly angry and found a certain pleasure in it.
uz: O'zi ham hayron bo'lib, to'satdan g'azablanib, bu ishdan mamnun bo'ldi.

en: “And it’s enough that I have come here ill with fever.” “Kindly refrain from shouting!”
uz: Va men bu yerga sovuqdan azob chekib kelganim yetarli. Xavf qilib, qichqirishdan voz kechinglar!

en: “I’m not shouting, I’m speaking very quietly, it’s you who are shouting at me.
uz: Men qichqirmayapman, juda sekin gapiryapman, menga qichqirayotganlar sizsiz.

en: I’m a student, and allow no one to shout at me.” The assistant superintendent was so furious that for the first minute he could only splutter inarticulately.
uz: Men o'quvchiman va hech kim menga qichqirishlariga yo'l qo'ymayman. Superintendentning yordamchisi shunchalik g'azabga to'lganki, birinchi daqiqada u faqat so'zsiz so'zlashdi.

en: He leaped up from his seat.
uz: U o'tirgan joyidan ko'tarildi.

en: You are in a government office.
uz: Siz hukumat idorasida bo'lasiz.

en: Don’t be impudent, sir!” “You’re in a government office, too,” cried Raskolnikov, “and you’re smoking a cigarette as well as shouting, so you are showing disrespect to all of us.” He felt an indescribable satisfaction at having said this.
uz: O'zingizni qo'pol his qilmang, xo'jayin! Siz ham hukumat idorasidasiz, - deb baqirdi Raskolnikov, - siz sigaret chekib, qichqirishni ham davom ettirasiz, shuning uchun hammamizga hurmatsizlik ko'rsatyapsiz. - U buni aytishdan beqiyos mamnuniyat his qildi.

en: The head clerk looked at him with a smile.
uz: Bosh xodimi unga tabassum bilan qaradi.

en: The angry assistant superintendent was obviously disconcerted.
uz: G'azablangan yordamchi nazoratchi, shubhasiz, xavotirga tushdi.

en: “That’s not your business!” he shouted at last with unnatural loudness.
uz: - Bu sizning ishingiz emas! - dedi u, nihoyat, tabiiy emas.

en: “Kindly make the declaration demanded of you.
uz: Sizdan talab qilingan deklaratsiyani bajaring.

en: Alexandr Grigorievitch.
uz: Aleksandr Grigorievitch.

en: There is a complaint against you!
uz: Sizga qarshi shikoyat bor!

en: You don’t pay your debts!
uz: Sizlar qarzlaringizni to'lamaysizlar!

en: You’re a fine bird!” But Raskolnikov was not listening now; he had eagerly clutched at the paper, in haste to find an explanation.
uz: Siz chiroyli qushsiz! Ammo Raskolnikov endi tinglamagan edi; u g'ayrat bilan qog'ozni ushlab, tushuntirish izlab yurgan edi.

en: He read it once, and a second time, and still did not understand.
uz: U uni bir marta va ikkinchi marta o'qib, hali ham tushunmadi.

en: “What is this?” he asked the head clerk.
uz: Bu nima? - deb so'radi u bosh xizmatkoridan.

en: “It is for the recovery of money on an I.O.U., a writ.
uz: Bu I.O.U.da pulni yig'ish uchun, yozish uchun.

en: You must either pay it, with all expenses, costs and so on, or give a written declaration when you can pay it, and at the same time an undertaking not to leave the capital without payment, and nor to sell or conceal your property.
uz: Siz uni barcha xarajatlar, xarajatlar va hokazolar bilan to'lashingiz kerak yoki uni to'lashingiz mumkin bo'lganda yozma deklaratsiya berishingiz kerak va shu bilan birga kapitalni to'lamasdan ketmaslik va mol-mulkingizni sotish yoki yashirmaslik majburiyatini olishingiz kerak.

en: The creditor is at liberty to sell your property, and proceed against you according to the law.” “But I … am not in debt to anyone!” “That’s not our business.
uz: Qarz beruvchi sizning mol-mulkingizni sotishga va sizga qarshi qonun bo'yicha ish yuritishga haqli.Ammo men ... hech kimga qarzdor emasman!Bu bizning ishimiz emas.

en: for a hundred and fifteen roubles, legally attested, and due for payment, has been brought us for recovery, given by you to the widow of the assessor Zarnitsyn, nine months ago, and paid over by the widow Zarnitsyn to one Mr.
uz: To'qqiz oy oldin siz tomonidan baholovchi Zarnitsynning beva ayolga berilgan va beva ayol Zarnitsyn tomonidan bir Mr.ga to'langan to'lov uchun bizga to'lov uchun qonuniy tasdiqlangan va to'lov uchun yetkazilgan yuz besh rubl pul uchun olib kelingan.

en: We therefore summon you, hereupon.” “But she is my landlady!” “And what if she is your landlady?” The head clerk looked at him with a condescending smile of compassion, and at the same time with a certain triumph, as at a novice under fire for the first time —as though he would say: “Well,
uz: Shuning uchun biz sizni chaqiramiz. Lekin u mening uy egasi! Va agar u sizning uy egasi bo'lsa? Bosh xodimi unga rahmdillik bilan tabassum bilan, shu bilan birga, o'ziga xos g'alaba bilan qaradi, xuddi birinchi marta olov ostida turgan yangilikdek. O'shanda u shunday deydi:Buy,

en: how do you feel now?” But what did he care now for an I.O.U., for a writ of recovery!
uz: Endi qanday his qilyapsiz? Ammo u endi I.O.U. yoki tiklanish xatini nimaga tashvishlanardi?

en: Was that worth worrying about now, was it worth attention even!
uz: Endi bu tashvishlanishga arziydiganmi yoki hatto e'tiborga loyiqmi?

en: He stood, he read, he listened, he answered, he even asked questions himself, but all mechanically.
uz: U to'xtadi, o'qidi, tingladi, javob berdi, hatto o'zi savollar berdi, ammo bularning hammasi mexanik ravishda.

en: The triumphant sense of security, of deliverance from overwhelming danger, that was what filled his whole soul that moment without thought for the future, without analysis, without suppositions or surmises, without doubts and without questioning.
uz: Xavfsizlikning g'alaba qozonadigan hissi, katta xavf-xatardan xalos bo'lish uning butun ruhini o'sha paytda kelajak haqida o'ylamagan, tahlil qilmagan, taxmin va taxmin qilmagan, shubha qilmagan va shubha qilmagan holda to'ldirgan edi.

en: It was an instant of full, direct, purely instinctive joy.
uz: Bu to'liq, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, chindan ham instinktli quvonchning bir daqiqa edi.

en: But at that very moment something like a thunderstorm took place in the office.
uz: Ammo o'sha paytda ofisda momaqaldiroqga o'xshash narsa sodir bo'ldi.

en: The assistant superintendent, still shaken by Raskolnikov’s disrespect, still fuming and obviously anxious to keep up his wounded dignity, pounced on the unfortunate smart lady, who had been gazing at him ever since he came in with an exceedingly silly smile.
uz: Raskolnikovning hurmatsizlikidan hali ham dahshatga tushgan, hali ham o'zining jarohatlangan qadr-qimmatini saqlab qolish uchun g'ayratli va g'ayratli bo'lgan yordamchi nazoratchi o'sha zaif aqlli xonimga hujum qildi, u unga kirganidan beri juda ahmoqona tabassum bilan qarab turardi.

en: “You shameful hussy!” he shouted suddenly at the top of his voice.
uz: "Ey uyalgan hussy!" - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u to'satdan.

en: (The lady in mourning had left the office.) “What was going on at your house last night?
uz: (Qasosli ayol ofisdan chiqib ketgan edi.) Kecha sizning uyingizda nimalar bo'lgan?

en: A disgrace again, you’re a scandal to the whole street.
uz: Yana bir marta sharmandalik, siz butun ko'cha uchun shovqin.

en: Fighting and drinking again.
uz: Yana jang va ichimlik.

en: Do you want the house of correction?
uz: Tuzatish uyini xohlaysizmi?

en: Why, I have warned you ten times over that I would not let you off the eleventh!
uz: Men sizlarni o'n marta ogohlantirganmanki, o'n birinchi kuni sizni qo'yib yubormayman!

en: And here you are again, again, you … you  … !” The paper fell out of Raskolnikov’s hands, and he looked wildly at the smart lady who was so unceremoniously treated.
uz: Mana, yana siz, yana siz... siz... ! Raskolnikovning qo'lidan qog'oz tushib qoldi va u o'sha aqlli xotinni vahshiy ko'rib qoldi.

en: But he soon saw what it meant, and at once began to find positive amusement in the scandal.
uz: Ammo u tezda bu nimani anglatishini tushungan va shu zahoti shu skandaldan ijobiy zavq topishni boshladi.

en: He listened with pleasure, so that he longed to laugh and laugh … all his nerves were on edge.
uz: U zavq bilan tinglagan, shuning uchun u kulish va kulish istagi bilan ... barcha g'azablari keskin edi.

en: “Ilya Petrovitch!” the head clerk was beginning anxiously, but stopped short, for he knew from experience that the enraged assistant could not be stopped except by force.
uz: Ilya Petrovitch! Bosh kotibi tashvish bilan boshlanayotgan edi, lekin u o'z tajribasiga ko'ra, g'azablangan yordamchisini kuchdan tashqari to'xtata olmasligini bilardi.

en: As for the smart lady, at first she positively trembled before the storm.
uz: Aqlli xonim esa, boshida bo'ron oldida qo'rqib ketdi.

en: But, strange to say, the more numerous and violent the terms of abuse became, the more amiable she looked, and the more seductive the smiles she lavished on the terrible assistant.
uz: Ammo, g'alati aytish joizki, jinsiy zo'ravonlik to'g'risidagi gaplar qanchalik ko'p va zo'ravon bo'lganida, u qanchalik mehribon ko'rinardi va o'sha dahshatli yordamchisiga qancha ko'p tabassumlar ko'rsatsa, shunchalik jozibali edi.

en: She moved uneasily, and curtsied incessantly, waiting impatiently for a chance of putting in her word: and at last she found it.
uz: O'zini tashvish bilan harakatlantirib, to'xtamasdan qo'rqib, so'zini aytish uchun imkoniyatni intizorlik bilan kutdi va nihoyat uni topdi.

en: “There was no sort of noise or fighting in my house, Mr.
uz: Uyimda hech qanday shovqin yoki bahs-munozara bo'lmagan, Hazrat.

en: Captain,” she pattered all at once, like peas dropping, speaking Russian
uz: Kapitan, u bir vaqtning o'zida o'z ko'zlariga ko'z tikdi, xuddi ertaklar tushishi kabi, rus tilida gapirgan.

en: confidently, though with a strong German accent, “and no sort of scandal, and his honour came drunk, and it’s the whole truth I am telling, Mr.
uz: Ishonch bilan, ammo kuchli nemis aksenti bilan, hech qanday skandalsiz, uning sharafi mast bo'ldi va bu mening butun haqiqatimni aytyapman, birodar.

en: Captain, and I am not to blame.
uz: Kapitan, bu mening aybim emas.

en: … Mine is an honourable house, Mr.
uz: ... Mening uyim sharafli uy, Mr..

en: Captain, and honourable behaviour, Mr.
uz: Kapitan, va hurmatli xulq-atvor, Mr.

en: Captain, and I always, always dislike any scandal myself.
uz: Kapitan, va men ham har doim, har doim hech qanday hujumdan nafratlanaman.

en: But he came quite tipsy, and asked for three bottles again, and then he lifted up one leg, and began playing the pianoforte with one foot, and that is not at all right in an honourable house, and he ganz broke the piano, and it was very bad manners indeed and I said so.
uz: Ammo u juda ichib qoldi va yana uchta shisha so'radi, so'ngra bir oyoqini ko'tarib, bir oyoq bilan klaviaturada o'ynashni boshladi va bu hurmatli uyda umuman yaxshi emas, u klaviaturani buzdi va bu juda yomon xulq-atvor edi va men shunday deb aytdim.

en: And he took up a bottle and began hitting everyone with it.
uz: U bir shisha olib, hamma bilan urishni boshladi.

en: And then I called the porter, and Karl came, and he took Karl and hit him in the eye; and he hit Henriette in the eye, too, and gave me five slaps on the cheek.
uz: So'ngra porterni chaqirdim va Karl keldi, u Karlni oldi va uning ko'ziga urdi; u ham Henriettega ko'ziga urdi va menga besh marta shapka qo'ydi.

en: And it was so ungentlemanly in an honourable house, Mr.
uz: Shu bois, hurmatga sazovor uyda bu juda xushmuomala emas edi, xonim.

en: Captain, and I screamed.
uz: Kapitan, men esa qichqirdim.

en: And he opened the window over the canal, and stood in the window, squealing like a little pig; it was a disgrace.
uz: U kanalning o'ng tomonidagi derazani ochib, daraxtning o'ng tomonida turib, kichkina to'ng'iz kabi qichqiriq qildi; bu sharmandalik edi.

en: The idea of squealing like a little pig at the window into the street!
uz: Ko'chaga o'tadigan deraza oldida kichkinagina cho'chqa kabi qichqirish g'oyasi!

en: And Karl pulled him away from the window by his coat, and it is true, Mr.
uz: Karl uni kiyimidan qo'yib, darcha tomondan olib ketdi va bu haqiqat, Mr..

en: Captain, he tore sein rock.
uz: Kapitan, u o'z qo'llarini yirtdi.

en: And then he shouted that man muss pay him fifteen roubles damages.
uz: Keyin u odam unga o'n besh rubl miqdorida zararni to'lash kerakligini baqirib yubordi.

en: And I did pay him, Mr.
uz: Va men unga pul to'ldim, Mr..

en: Captain, five roubles for sein rock.
uz: Kapitan, uning toshidan besh rubl.

en: And he is an ungentlemanly visitor and caused all the scandal.
uz: Va u odamsiz mehmon bo'lib, butun bu isrofga sababchi bo'ldi.

en: ‘I will show you up,’ he said, ‘for I can write to all the papers about you.’ ” “Then he was an author?” “Yes, Mr.
uz: Men sizga ko'rsataman,  dedi, chunki men siz to'g'risidagi barcha gazetalarga yozishim mumkin.  Shunday qilib u muallif bo'lganmi? Ha, Hazrat,

en: Captain, and what an ungentlemanly visitor in an honourable house.
uz: Kapitan, va qanday ham xayrli uyga mehmon bo'lgan.

en: I have told you already …” “Ilya Petrovitch!” the head clerk repeated significantly.
uz: Men sizga allaqachon aytdim ...  Ilya Petrovitch! bosh kotibi sezilarli darajada takrorladi.

en: The assistant glanced rapidly at him; the head clerk slightly shook his head.
uz: Xizmatchi unga tezda nazar tashladi; bosh xodimi boshini biroz shovqirdi.

en: “… So I tell you this, most respectable Luise Ivanovna, and I tell it you for the last time,” the assistant went on.
uz: ... Shunday qilib, men sizga shu narsani aytaman, eng hurmatli Luisa Ivanovna, va men sizga oxirgi marta aytaman,  yordamchisi davom etdi.

en: “If there is a scandal in your honourable house once again, I will put you yourself in the lockup, as it is called in polite society.
uz: Agar sizning hurmatli uyingizda yana bir marta shubha paydo bo'lsa, sizni xushmuomala jamiyatda nima deb ataladigan zindonga qo'yaman.

en: So a literary man, an author took five roubles for his coattail in an ‘honourable house’?
uz: Demak, adabiyotchi, muallif bir honourable houseda o'zining qo'shqinligi uchun besh rubl pul oldi?

en: A nice set, these authors!” And he cast a contemptuous glance at Raskolnikov.
uz: Bu mualliflar chiroyli o'rinni egalladi! Va u Raskolnikovga nohaq ko'z tikdi.

en: “There was a scandal the other day in a restaurant, too.
uz: O'tgan kun restoranda ham shov-shuv bo'lib o'tdi.

en: An author had eaten his
uz: Muallif o'z taomini yeydi.

en: dinner and would not pay; ‘I’ll write a satire on you,’ says he.
uz: Va kechki ovqatni to'lamaydi; Men siz haqingizda bir satira yozaman, deydi u.

en: And there was another of them on a steamer last week used the most disgraceful language to the respectable family of a civil councillor, his wife and daughter.
uz: O'tgan hafta uchuvchi kemada bo'lgan yana bir kishi bir fuqarolik kengashining hurmatga sazovor oilasiga, uning xotini va qizi uchun eng sharmanda so'zlarni aytgan edi.

en: And there was one of them turned out of a confectioner’s shop the other day.
uz: Va ulardan biri bir kun oldin sutkachilik do'konidan chiqib ketgan edi.

en: They are like that, authors, literary men, students, town-criers.
uz: Ular shunday: mualliflar, adabiylar, talabalar, shaharchalar.

en: I shall look in upon you myself one day.
uz: O'zim ham bir kun seni ko'rib ko'raman.

en: Then you had better be careful!
uz: O'shanda ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak!

en: Do you hear?” With hurried deference, Luise Ivanovna fell to curtsying in all directions, and so curtsied herself to the door.
uz: Eshityapsizmi? Luiz Ivonovna shoshilinch hurmat bilan har tomonga o'zini qo'zg'atishga tushdi va o'zini eshik tomon qo'zg'atdi.

en: But at the door, she stumbled backwards against a good-looking officer with a fresh, open face and splendid thick fair whiskers.
uz: Ammo eshikda u yangi, ochiq yuz va chiroyli qalin chiroyli mustakkalli chiroyli ofitserga orqa tomondan to'xtab qoldi.

en: This was the superintendent of the district himself, Nikodim Fomitch.
uz: Bu tuman noziri Nikodim Fomitch edi.

en: Luise Ivanovna made haste to curtsy almost to the ground, and with mincing little steps, she fluttered out of the office.
uz: Luisa Ivanovna deyarli yerga yetib ketishga shoshildi va kichik qadamlar bilan ofisdan chiqib ketdi.

en: “Again thunder and lightning —a hurricane!” said Nikodim Fomitch to Ilya Petrovitch in a civil and friendly tone.
uz: Yekin momaqaldiroq va chaqmoq hurrikani! dedi Nikodim Fomitch Ilya Petrovitchga xushmuomala va do'stona so'z bilan.

en: “You are aroused again, you are fuming again!
uz: Siz yana uyg'onasiz, yana tutasiz!

en: I heard it on the stairs!” “Well, what then!” Ilya Petrovitch drawled with gentlemanly nonchalance; and he walked with some papers to another table, with a jaunty swing of his shoulders at each step.
uz: Men uni mertalarda eshitdim! Xo'sh, nima bo'ladi! Ilya Petrovitch gentlemanly nonchalance bilan chizdi; va u bir necha qog'ozlar bilan boshqa stolga yurdi, har bir qadamda omborlarini jaunty aylanib.

en: “Here, if you will kindly look: an author, or a student, has been one at least, does not pay his debts, has given an I.O.U., won’t clear out of his room, and complaints are constantly being lodged against him, and here he has been pleased to make a protest against my smoking in his presence!
uz: Bu erda, agar siz mehribonlik bilan ko'rsangiz: muallif yoki talaba hech bo'lmaganda bitta bo'lgan, qarzlarini to'lamaydi, I.O.U. bergan, xonasidan chiqishni xohlamaydi, unga qarshi doimiy ravishda shikoyatlar ko'rsatiladi va bu erda u mening chekishimga qarshi o'z huzurida norozilik bildirishdan xursand bo'ldi!

en: He behaves like a cad himself, and just look at him, please.
uz: U o'zi kabi o'zini yo'qotib qo'yadi va unga bir nazar soling, iltimos.

en: Here’s the gentleman, and very attractive he is!” “Poverty is not a vice, my friend, but we know you go off like powder, you can’t bear a slight, I daresay you took offence at something and went too far yourself,” continued Nikodim Fomitch, turning affably to Raskolnikov.
uz: Mana, yigit, va u juda jozibali! "Karchaklik yomonlik emas, do'stim, lekin biz bilamizki, siz to'lat kabi ketasiz, bir oz ham ko'tarolmaysiz, men bir narsaga jahl qilib, o'zingiz ham o'zingizni haddan tashqari pastga ketganingizni aytaman", - dedi Nikodim Fomitch, Raskolnikovga mehribonlik bilan murojaat qilib.

en: “But you were wrong there; he is a capital fellow, I assure you, but explosive, explosive!
uz: Ammo siz xato qildingiz; u kapital odam, sizga ishontiraman, lekin portlovchi, portlovchi!

en: He gets hot, fires up, boils over, and no stopping him!
uz: U issiq bo'lib, otadi, qaynatadi va hech kim uni to'xtatmaydi!

en: And then it’s all over!
uz: Va nihoyat, hamma narsa tugadi!

en: And at the bottom he’s a heart of gold!
uz: Va uning quyida oltin yurak bor!

en: His nickname in the regiment was the ‘Explosive Lieutenant.’ …” “And what a regiment it was, too,” cried Ilya Petrovitch, much gratified at this agreeable banter, though still sulky.
uz: Uning qo'shindagi alif nomi "Explosive Lieutenant" edi. ...  Va u qanday qo'shin edi, deb baqirgan Ilya Petrovitch, bu yoqimli, ammo hali ham g'alati gaplarga ko'p mamnun bo'lgan.

en: Raskolnikov had a sudden desire to say something exceptionally pleasant to them all.
uz: Raskolnikovning birdan hammaga juda yoqimli bir narsa aytish istagi paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Excuse me, Captain,” he began easily, suddenly addressing Nikodim Fomitch, “will you enter into my position?
uz: Kechirasiz, kapitan, u osonlikcha boshladi, to'satdan Nikodim Fomitchga murojaat qilib, siz mening lavozimimga kirasizmi?

en: … I am ready to ask pardon, if I have been ill-mannered.
uz: Agar men yomon xulq-atvorni ko'rsatgan bo'lsam, kechirim so'rashga tayyorman.

en: I am a poor student, sick and shattered” (“shattered” was the word he used) “by poverty.
uz: Men kambag'al talabaman, kasalman va kambag'allik tufayli vayron bo'ldim.

en: I am not studying, because I cannot keep myself now, but I shall get money.
uz: Men o'qimayapman, chunki hozir o'zimni saqlay olmayman, lekin pul topaman.

en: … I have a mother and sister in the province of X — —.
uz: Mening X viloyatida onam va singlim bor.

en: They will send it to me, and I will pay.
uz: Ular uni menga yuboradilar va men to'layman.

en: My landlady is a good-hearted woman, but she is so exasperated at my having lost my lessons, and not paying her for the last four months, that she does not even send up my dinner … and I don’t understand this I.O.U.
uz: Uy egam yaxshi yurakli ayol, lekin men darslarimni yo'qotganimdan va so'nggi to'rt oy davomida unga pul bermaganimdan shunchalik g'azablanadiki, hatto kechki ovqatimni ham taklif qilmaydi ... va men bu I.O.U.ni tushunmayman.

en: She is asking me to pay her on this I.O.U.
uz: U mendan ushbu I.O.U. uchun pul to'lashimni so'rayapti.

en: How am I to pay her?
uz: Unga qanday pul to'lashim kerak?

en: Judge for yourselves!
uz: O'zingiz hukm qilinglar!

en: …” “But that is not our business, you know,” the head clerk was observing.
uz: ... Ammo bu bizning ishimiz emas, bilasiz, bosh kotibi kuzatgan.

en: I perfectly agree with you.
uz: Men siz bilan to'liq rozi bo'laman.

en: But allow me to explain …” Raskolnikov put in again, still addressing Nikodim Fomitch, but trying his best to address Ilya Petrovitch also, though the latter persistently appeared to be rummaging among his papers and to be contemptuously oblivious of him.
uz: Lekin tushuntirishga ruxsat bering ... Raskolnikov yana qo'shildi, hali ham Nikodim Fomitchga murojaat qildi, lekin Ilya Petrovitchga ham murojaat qilish uchun qo'lidan kelgancha harakat qildi, garchi Ilya Petrovitch o'z gazetalarida qat'iy harakat qilib, uni kamsitib e'tiborsiz qoldirgan bo'lsa-da.

en: “Allow me to explain that I have been living with her for nearly three years and at first … at first … for why should I not confess it, at the very beginning I promised to marry her daughter, it was a verbal promise, freely given … she was a girl  … indeed, I liked her, though I was not in love with her … a youthful affair in fact … that is, I mean to say, that my landlady gave me credit freely in those days, and I led a life of … I was very heedless …” “Nobody asks you for these personal details, sir, we’ve no time to waste,” Ilya Petrovitch interposed roughly and with a note of triumph; but Raskolnikov stopped him hotly, though he suddenly found it exceedingly difficult to speak.
uz: Mening u bilan uch yilga yaqin yashayotganimni tushuntirishga ruxsat bering va dastlab ... dastlab ... nima uchun tan olmasam kerak edi, boshida men uning qizi bilan turmush qurishga va'da berdim, bu og'zaki va'da edi, bepul berilgan ... u qiz edi ... haqiqatan ham, men uni yoqtirardim, garchi men unga muhabbat qilmagan bo'lsam ham ... yoshlik muammosi aslida ... ya'ni, uy egam menga o'sha kunlarda bepul kredit berganini aytmoqchiman, va men juda befarq hayot kechirgan edim ...  Hech kim sizdan bu shaxsiy tafsilotlarni so'ramaydi, sir, bizda vaqt yo'q, Ilya Petrovitch taxmin bilan va g'alaba notasi bilan aralashib oldi; lekin Raskolnikov uni birdan-biriga qattiq to'xtatdi, garchi u gapirishni juda qiyin deb topdi.

en: “But excuse me, excuse me.
uz: Ammo meni kechiringlar, meni kechiringlar.

en: It is for me to explain … how it all happened … In my turn … though I agree with you … it is unnecessary.
uz: Hammasi qanday sodir bo'lganini tushuntirish mening vazifamdir, ammo men siz bilan rozi bo'lsam-da, bu keraksiz.

en: But a year ago, the girl died of typhus.
uz: Ammo bir yil oldin qizcha tifusdan vafot etdi.

en: I remained lodging there as before, and when my landlady moved into her present quarters, she said to me … and in a friendly way … that she had complete trust in me, but still, would I not give her an I.O.U.
uz: Men o'sha yerda avvalgidek yashardim va uy egam hozirgi xonalariga ko'chib o'tganida, u menga ... va do'stona tarzda ... menga to'liq ishonishini aytdi, ammo hali ham unga I.O.U. bermasam bo'ladimi?

en: for one hundred and fifteen roubles, all the debt I owed her.
uz: Bir yuz besh rubl evaziga, unga qarzdor bo'lgan barcha qarzlarimni sotib oldim.

en: only I gave her that, she would trust me again, as much as I liked, and that she would never, never —those were her own words —make use of that I.O.U.
uz: Men unga faqat shuni berdimki, u menga yana ishonadi, men xohlagancha, va hech qachon, hech qachon o'z so'zlari edi, bu I.O.U.dan foydalanmaydi.

en: till I could pay of myself … and now, when I have lost my lessons and have nothing to eat, she takes action against me.
uz: O'zim haqimni to'lashim mumkin bo'lgunga qadar ... va endi, darslarimni yo'qotganimdan va ovqatlanishga hech narsa yo'qligimdan so'ng, u menga qarshi chora ko'radi.

en: What am I to say to that?” “All these affecting details are no business of ours.” Ilya Petrovitch interrupted rudely.
uz: Bunga nima deyishim kerak?Bu barcha tafsilotlarga ta'sir ko'rsatadigan tafsilotlar bizning ishimiz emas. Ilya Petrovitch beparvolik bilan to'xtatdi.

en: “You must give a written undertaking but as for your love affairs and all these tragic events, we have nothing to do with that.” “Come now … you are harsh,” muttered Nikodim Fomitch, sitting down at the table and also beginning to write.
uz: Siz yozma majburiyatni qabul qilishingiz kerak, lekin sizning ishqiy munosabatlaringiz va barcha bu ayanchli hodisalar haqida gap ketganda, biz bunga hech qanday aloqamiz yo'q.  Keling, endi ... siz qattiqqo'lsiz, Nikodim Fomitch g'azablandi, stolga o'tirib, yozishni boshladi.

en: He looked a little ashamed.
uz: U biroz uyalgan ko'rinardi.

en: “Write!” said the head clerk to Raskolnikov.
uz: Yozib qo'ying! - dedi bosh xodimi Raskolnikovga.

en: “Write what?” the latter asked, gruffly.
uz: Qanday yozib qo'yish kerak? so'radilar.

en: “I will dictate to you.” Raskolnikov fancied that the head clerk treated him more casually and contemptuously after his speech, but strange to say he suddenly felt completely indifferent to anyone’s opinion, and this revulsion took place in a flash, in one instant.
uz: Raskolnikov so'zidan so'ng bosh kotibi unga ko'proq beparvolik va kamsitish bilan munosabatda bo'lishini o'ylagan, ammo o'zini kimningdir fikriga befarq his qilganini aytish g'alati, va bu jirkanchlik bir daqiqada sodir bo'ldi.

en: If he had cared to think a little, he would have been amazed indeed that he could have talked to them like that a minute before, forcing his feelings upon them.
uz: Agar u biroz mulohaza yuritishga harakat qilgan bo'lsa, bir daqiqa oldin u bilan shunday gaplashganiga va o'z his-tuyg'ularini ularga o'tkazganiga juda hayron bo'lgan bo'lardi.

en: And where had those feelings come from?
uz: Va bu his-tuyg'ular qayerdan paydo bo'ldi?

en: Now if the whole room had been filled, not with police officers, but with those nearest and dearest to him, he would not have found one human word for them, so empty was his heart.
uz: Agar butun xonadon politsiya xodimlari bilan emas, balki unga eng yaqin va yaqin bo'lgan odamlar bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lsa edi, u uchun birgina inson so'zi ham bo'lmasdi, chunki uning yuragi shunchalik bo'sh edi.

en: A gloomy sensation of agonising, everlasting solitude and remoteness, took conscious form in his soul.
uz: Og'ir azob chekkan, abadiy yolg'izlik va uzoqlikning qorong'i hissi uning ruhida o'zini his qildi.

en: It was not the meanness of his sentimental effusions before Ilya Petrovitch, nor the meanness of the latter’s triumph over him that had caused this sudden revulsion in his heart.
uz: Ilya Petrovitch oldida o'zining hissiy tuyg'ularining va uning ustidan g'alaba qozonishining kamtarligi uning yuragida to'satdan g'azabni keltirib chiqarmagan.

en: Oh, what had he to do now with his own baseness, with all these petty vanities, officers, German women, debts, police-offices?
uz: Oh, u endi o'z kamtarligi bilan, barcha bu kichik bekorchiliklar, ofitserlar, nemis ayollar, qarzlar, politsiya ofislari bilan nima qilishi kerak edi?

en: If he had been sentenced to be burnt at that moment, he would not have stirred, would hardly have heard the sentence to the end.
uz: Agar u o'sha paytda o'z jazosini o'tkazishga hukm qilinganida edi, u hech qanday harakat qilmagan bo'lar edi, jazo so'zini oxirigacha eshitmagan bo'lar edi.

en: Something was happening to him entirely new, sudden and unknown.
uz: U bilan yangi, to'satdan va noma'lum bir narsa sodir bo'ldi.

en: It was not that he understood, but he felt clearly with all the intensity of sensation that he could never more appeal to these people in the police-office with sentimental effusions like his recent outburst, or with anything whatever; and that if they
uz: U buni tushunmagan edi, lekin u o'zi uchun bunday kuchli his-tuyg'ularni his qilgan ediki, u hech qachon o'zining so'nggi shovqin kabi his-tuyg'ular bilan politsiyaga murojaat qila olmaydi.

en: had been his own brothers and sisters and not police-officers, it would have been utterly out of the question to appeal to them in any circumstance of life.
uz: Agar ular politsiya xodimlari emas, balki o'z aka-ukalari bo'lganida edi, har qanday vaziyatda ularga murojaat qilish mumkin emas edi.

en: He had never experienced such a strange and awful sensation.
uz: U hech qachon bunday g'alati va dahshatli hissiyotni boshdan kechirmagan edi.

en: And what was most agonising —it was more a sensation than a conception or idea, a direct sensation, the most agonising of all the sensations he had known in his life.
uz: Va eng og'ir bo'lgan narsa - bu tasavvur yoki g'oya emas, balki hissiyot edi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri hissiyot edi, u hayotida boshdan kechirgan barcha hissiyotlarning eng og'iridir.

en: The head clerk began dictating to him the usual form of declaration, that he could not pay, that he undertook to do so at a future date, that he would not leave the town, nor sell his property, and so on.
uz: Bosh kotibi unga odatdagi deklaratsiya shaklini dikta qila boshladi, u pul to'lay olmaydi, kelgusida buni amalga oshirishni va shaharni tark etmaydi, mol-mulkini sotmaydi va hokazo.

en: “But you can’t write, you can hardly hold the pen,” observed the head clerk, looking with curiosity at Raskolnikov.
uz: Ammo siz yozolmaysiz, qalamni qo'yib ham ko'rmaysiz, - dedi bosh xodimi, Raskolnikovga qiziquvchanlik bilan qarab.

en: “Are you ill?” “Yes, I am giddy.
uz: Siz kasalmisiz?Ha, men giddyman.

en: Go on!” “That’s all.
uz: Boringlar!  Bu hammasi.

en: Sign it.” The head clerk took the paper, and turned to attend to others.
uz: Uni imzolash. Bosh kotibi qog'ozni olib, boshqalarga murojaat qildi.

en: Raskolnikov gave back the pen; but instead of getting up and going away, he put his elbows on the table and pressed his head in his hands.
uz: Raskolnikov qalamni qaytarib berdi; lekin turish va ketish o'rniga, u qo'lqoplarini stol ustiga qo'yib, boshini qo'llariga bosdi.

en: He felt as if a nail were being driven into his skull.
uz: O'ziga xuddi bosh ko'krakidagi pichoqni o'g'irlab ketayotgandek tuyg'ular paydo bo'ldi.

en: A strange idea suddenly occurred to him, to get up at once, to go up to Nikodim Fomitch, and tell him everything that had happened yesterday, and then to go with him to his lodgings and to show him the things in the hole in the corner.
uz: U darhol turib, Nikodim Fomitchning oldiga borib, o'tgan kun sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealarni aytib berishni, keyin u bilan uning uylariga borib, burchakdagi cho'lda bo'lgan narsalarni ko'rsatishni o'ylagan.

en: The impulse was so strong that he got up from his seat to carry it out.
uz: Impulsi shunchalik kuchli bo'lganki, u o'rindiqidan turib uni amalga oshirish uchun o'tirdi.

en: “Hadn’t I better think a minute?” flashed through his mind.
uz: Bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'rsam yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: “No, better cast off the burden without thinking.” But all at once he stood still, rooted to the spot.
uz: Yo'q, bu og'irlikni o'ylab ko'rmasdan tashlash yaxshiroqdir. Ammo u birdan to'xtadi va o'z o'rniga o'rnagan.

en: Nikodim Fomitch was talking eagerly with Ilya Petrovitch, and the words reached him: “It’s impossible, they’ll both be released.
uz: Nikodim Fomitch Ilya Petrovitch bilan suhbatlashayotgan edi va unga quyidagi so'zlar yetib keldi: "Bu imkonsiz, ikkalasi ham ozod qilinadi.

en: To begin with, the whole story contradicts itself.
uz: Avvalo, butun hikoya o'ziga ziddir.

en: Why should they have called the porter, if it had been their doing?
uz: Agar bu ularning ishi bo'lgan bo'lsa, nima uchun ular portiyerni chaqirishlari kerak edi?

en: To inform against themselves?
uz: O'zlariga qarshi axborot berish uchunmi?

en: No, that would be too cunning!
uz: Yo'q, bu juda hiyla-nayrang bo'ladi!

en: Besides, Pestryakov, the student, was seen at the gate by both the porters and a woman as he went in.
uz: Bundan tashqari, Pestryakov, o'quvchi, kirganida darvozabonlar va bir ayol tomonidan darvoza oldida ko'rishgan.

en: He was walking with three friends, who left him only at the gate, and he asked the porters to direct him, in the presence of the friends.
uz: U uchta do'sti bilan sayohat qilib borayotgan edi, ular uni faqat darvoza oldida qoldirib ketishdi va u do'stlari oldida uni yo'naltirishlarini eshikchilardan so'radi.

en: Now, would he have asked his way if he had been going with such an object?
uz: Endi, agar u bunday ob'ekt bilan borayotgan bo'lsa, u o'z yo'lidan so'rarmidi?

en: As for Koch, he spent half an hour at the silversmith’s
uz: Kochning o'zi esa o'n yarim soatlik vaqtini kumushchilikda o'tkazdi.

en: below, before he went up to the old woman and he left him at exactly a quarter to eight.
uz: Quyida esa u keksa ayolning oldiga chiqib, uni soat to'rtdan sakkizgacha qoldirdi.

en: Now just consider …” “But excuse me, how do you explain this contradiction?
uz: Endi faqat o'ylab ko'ring ...  Ammo kechirim so'raysiz, bu ziddiyatni qanday tushuntirishingiz mumkin?

en: They state themselves that they knocked and the door was locked; yet three minutes later when they went up with the porter, it turned out the door was unfastened.” “That’s just it; the murderer must have been there and bolted himself in; and they’d have caught him for a certainty if Koch had not been an ass and gone to look for the porter too.
uz: Ular o'zlariga taqillatdilar va eshik qulflab qo'yildi, deb aytishdi; lekin uch daqiqa o'tgach, eshikni eshikchilar bilan olib chiqib ketishganida, eshiklar ochilmagan edi.Haqiqatan ham shunday; qotil u yerda bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak va o'zini o'zi qamab qo'ygan bo'lishi kerak edi; agar Koch o'g'il bo'lmagan va eshikchiga ham qaragan bo'lmaganida, uni aniq tutishgan bo'lar edi.

en: He must have seized the interval to get downstairs and slip by them somehow.
uz: U pastga tushib, bir yo'l bilan ularning yonidan o'tib ketish uchun oralig'idan foydalangan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Koch keeps crossing himself and saying: ‘If I had been there, he would have jumped out and killed me with his axe.’ He is going to have a thanksgiving service —ha, ha!” “And no one saw the murderer?” “They might well not see him; the house is a regular Noah’s Ark,” said the head clerk, who was listening.
uz: Koch o'zini o'zi o'ylab, shunday deydi: "Agar men u yerda bo'lganimda, u o'z cho'g'i bilan meni o'ldirgan bo'lar edi. U shukronalar yig'ilishini o'tkazadi ha, ha!  Va hech kim qotilni ko'rmaganmi?  Ular uni ko'rmasliklari mumkin; uy Nuhning odatiy kemasi", - dedi tinglovchi bosh kotibi.

en: “It’s clear, quite clear,” Nikodim Fomitch repeated warmly.
uz: It's clear, quite clear, Nikodim Fomitch soʻzlarni samimiylik bilan takrorladi.

en: “No, it is anything but clear,” Ilya Petrovitch maintained.
uz: Yo'q, bu hamma narsa aniq emas, Ilya Petrovitch davom etdi.

en: Raskolnikov picked up his hat and walked towards the door, but he did not reach it.
uz: Raskolnikov toʻpini koʻtarib, eshik tomon yurdi, lekin u eshikga yetmadi.

en: … When he recovered consciousness, he found himself sitting in a chair, supported by someone on the right side, while someone else was standing on the left, holding a yellowish glass filled with yellow water, and Nikodim Fomitch standing before him, looking intently at him.
uz: O'z ongini tiklaganida, o'zining o'ng tomonidagi birov tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlangan o'rindiqda o'tirganini va chap tomonidagi boshqa birov sariq rangli, sariq suv bilan to'ldirilgan shishaga ega bo'lganini va uning oldida Nikodim Fomitch turib, unga diqqat bilan qarayotganini ko'rdi.

en: He got up from the chair.
uz: U o'rindiqdan turibdi.

en: Are you ill?” Nikodim Fomitch asked, rather sharply.
uz: Siz kasalmisiz? Nikodim Fomitch juda qattiq so'radi.

en: “He could hardly hold his pen when he was signing,” said the head clerk, settling back in his place, and taking up his work again.
uz: "U imzolash paytida qalamini qo'yib o'tirolmasdi", - dedi bosh kotibi, o'z joyida o'tirib, yana ishini boshladi.

en: “Have you been ill long?” cried Ilya Petrovitch from his place, where he, too, was looking through papers.
uz: Ilya Petrovitch ham qog'ozlarni ko'rib turgan joyidan yig'lab yubordi.

en: He had, of course, come to look at the sick man when he fainted, but retired at once when he recovered.
uz: Albatta, u baytilganida bemor odamga qarash uchun kelgan edi, lekin sog'ayganida o'zidan keyin o'z ishini o'tkazdi.

en: “Since yesterday,” muttered Raskolnikov in reply.
uz: Kechadan boshlab, Raskolnikov javobda g'alati gapirdi.

en: “Did you go out yesterday?” “Yes.” “Though you were ill?” “Yes.”
uz: Kecha tashqariga chiqdingizmi?Ha.Xasta bo'lgan bo'lsangiz ham?Ha.

en: “At what time?” “About seven.” “And where did you go, may I ask?” “Along the street.” “Short and clear.” Raskolnikov, white as a handkerchief, had answered sharply, jerkily, without dropping his black feverish eyes before Ilya Petrovitch’s stare.
uz: Qanday vaqtda?  7 atrofida.  Qayerga borganingni so'rasam bo'ladimi?  Ko'cha bo'ylab.  Qisqa va aniq. Qisqa va aniq. Qatlamcha oq Raskolnikov sharp javob bergan edi.

en: “He can scarcely stand upright.
uz: U barvaqt to'g'ri tura olmaydi.

en: And you …” Nikodim Fomitch was beginning.
uz: Va siz ... Nikodim Fomitch boshlanayotgan edi.

en: “No matter,” Ilya Petrovitch pronounced rather peculiarly.
uz: No matter, Ilya Petrovitch o'ziga xos tarzda so'zladi.

en: Nikodim Fomitch would have made some further protest, but glancing at the head clerk who was looking very hard at him, he did not speak.
uz: Nikodim Fomitch yana bir bor norozilik bildirgan bo'lar edi, lekin unga qattiq qaragan bosh kotibiga qarab, u gapirmadi.

en: There was a sudden silence.
uz: Toʻsatdan xotirjamlik paydo boʻldi.

en: “Very well, then,” concluded Ilya Petrovitch, “we will not detain you.” Raskolnikov went out.
uz: O'sha paytda juda yaxshi, Ilya Petrovitch yakunladi, biz sizni ushlab qo'ymaymiz. Raskolnikov tashqariga chiqdi.

en: He caught the sound of eager conversation on his departure, and above the rest rose the questioning voice of Nikodim Fomitch.
uz: U ketayotganda g'ayratli suhbatning ovozini ushlab oldi va qolganlarning ustiga Nikodim Fomitchning savol berayotgan ovozi ko'tarildi.

en: In the street, his faintness passed off completely.
uz: Ko'chada uning bo'shashi butunlay o'tib ketdi.

en: “A search —there will be a search at once,” he repeated to himself, hurrying home.
uz: Qidiruv Bir vaqtning o'zida qidiruv bo'ladi, o'zi o'ziga takrorladi, uyga shoshilmoqda.

en: they suspect.” His former terror mastered him completely again.
uz: Ular gumon qilmoqdalar. Uning sobiq dahshatlari uni yana to'liq o'zlashtirdi.

en: II “And what if there has been a search already?
uz: II Va agar allaqachon qidiruv bo'lgan bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?

en: What if I find them in my room?” But here was his room.
uz: Agar ularni o'z xonamda topsam nima bo'ladi? Ammo bu uning xonasi edi.

en: Nothing and no one in it.
uz: Unda hech narsa va hech kim yo'q.

en: No one had peeped in.
uz: Hech kim ko'z ochib ko'rmagan edi.

en: Even Nastasya had not touched it.
uz: Hatto Nastasya ham unga tegmagan edi.

en: how could he have left all those things in the hole?
uz: Qanday qilib u o'sha barcha narsalarni cho'lda qoldirgan?

en: He rushed to the corner, slipped his hand under the paper, pulled the things out and lined his pockets with them.
uz: U burchakga yugurib, qo'lini qog'oz ostida o'tkazdi, narsalarni olib chiqib, kiyimlarini qopladi.

en: There were eight articles in all: two little boxes with earrings or something of the sort, he hardly looked to see; then four small leather cases.
uz: Umuman sakkiz ta buyum bor edi: ikkita qutichoq quloqlari yoki shunga o'xshash narsa bilan; keyin to'rtta kichkina teridan yasalgan maydon.

en: There was a chain, too, merely wrapped in newspaper and something else in newspaper, that looked like a decoration.
uz: Shuningdek, gazetaga o'ralgan zanjir ham bor edi va gazetaga o'xshaydigan boshqa narsa ham bor edi.

en: … He put them all in the different pockets of his overcoat, and the remaining pocket of his trousers, trying to conceal them as much as possible.
uz: ... U hamma narsalarini kiyimining va pantalonlarining turli qoplariga qo'ydi va ularni iloji boricha ko'proq yashirishga harakat qildi.

en: He took the purse, too.
uz: U ham qopqoqni olib ketdi.

en: Then he went out of his room, leaving the door open.
uz: Keyin u o'z xonasidan chiqib, eshikni ochiq qoldirdi.

en: He walked quickly and resolutely, and though he felt shattered, he had his senses about him.
uz: U tez va qat'iy yurdi va o'zini tushkun his qilgan bo'lsa-da, uning atrofida his-tuyg'ulari bor edi.

en: He was afraid of pursuit, he was afraid that in another half-hour, another quarter of an hour perhaps, instructions would be issued for his pursuit, and so at all costs, he must hide all traces before then.
uz: U quvg'in qilishdan qo'rqardi, ehtimol yana yarim soat, yana bir chorak soat ichida uning quvg'inlari uchun yo'l-yo'riqlar berilib ketishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardi, shuning uchun har qanday xarajatdan oldin barcha izlarini yashirib qo'yish kerak edi.

en: He must clear everything up while he still had some strength, some reasoning power left him.
uz: O'zidan ba'zi kuch, fikrlash qobiliyati qolganida, u hamma narsani aniqlashtirishi kerak.

en: … Where was he to go?
uz: U qayerga borishi kerak edi?

en: That had long been settled: “Fling them into the canal, and all traces hidden in the water, the thing would be at an end.” So he had decided in the night of his delirium when several times he had had the impulse to get up and go away, to make haste, and get rid of it all.
uz: Bu uzoq vaqtdan beri hal qilingan edi: Ularni kanalga tashlash va suvda yashirilgan barcha izlar, bu narsa tugadi. Shunday qilib, u bir necha marta turib ketishga, shoshilishga va hamma narsadan qutulishga harakat qilgan delirium kechasida qaror qildi.

en: But to get rid of it, turned out to be a very difficult task.
uz: Ammo undan xalos bo'lish juda qiyin bo'ldi.

en: He wandered along the bank of the Ekaterininsky Canal for half an hour
uz: U Ekaterininskiy kanalining qirg'og'i bo'ylab yarim soat yurdi.

en: or more and looked several times at the steps running down to the water, but he could not think of carrying out his plan; either rafts stood at the steps’ edge, and women were washing clothes on them, or boats were moored there, and people were swarming everywhere.
uz: Yoki undan ko'proq vaqt davomida suvga tushadigan qadamlarga bir necha bor qarab turardi, lekin rejalarini amalga oshirish haqida o'ylay olmagan; yoki to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri, to'g'ri.

en: Moreover he could be seen and noticed from the banks on all sides; it would look suspicious for a man to go down on purpose, stop, and throw something into the water.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u har tomondan qirg'oqlardan ko'rilishi va e'tiborga olinishi mumkin edi; bir kishi bila turib pastga tushib, to'xtab, suvga biror narsa tashlasa, shubhasiz ko'rinadi.

en: And what if the boxes were to float instead of sinking?
uz: Va agar qutilar g'arq bo'lishning o'rniga ko'tarilib tursa nima bo'ladi?

en: And of course they would.
uz: Albatta, ular buni qilishadi.

en: Even as it was, everyone he met seemed to stare and look round, as if they had nothing to do but to watch him.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, u uchratgan har bir kishi atrofini ko'rib, uni kuzatib turishdan boshqa hech qanday ishi yo'qdek ko'rinardi.

en: “Why is it, or can it be my fancy?” he thought.
uz: Nima uchun, yoki bu mening fikrim bo'lishi mumkinmi? - deb o'yladi u.

en: At last the thought struck him that it might be better to go to the Neva.
uz: Oxiri unga Nevaga borish yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin degan fikr keldi.

en: There were not so many people there, he would be less observed, and it would be more convenient in every way, above all it was further off.
uz: U yerda shunchalik ko'p odam yo'q edi, uni kamroq kuzatishardi va har jihatdan qulayroq bo'lardi, eng muhimi, u uzoqroq edi.

en: He wondered how he could have been wandering for a good half-hour, worried and anxious in this dangerous past without thinking of it before.
uz: U o'ziga qanday qilib bu xavfli o'tmishda qayg'urgan va tashvishlangan holda yarim soat davomida bu haqda o'ylamagan bo'lishi mumkinligini o'yladi.

en: And that half-hour he had lost over an irrational plan, simply because he had thought of it in delirium!
uz: Va o'sha yarim soatni bir irasional reja tufayli yo'qotgan edi, chunki u bu haqda deliriumda o'ylagan edi!

en: He had become extremely absent and forgetful and he was aware of it.
uz: U juda chetda va unutgan bo'lib qoldi va u buni bilar edi.

en: He certainly must make haste.
uz: Albatta, u shoshilishi kerak.

en: He walked towards the Neva along V — — Prospect, but on the way another idea struck him.
uz: U V   Prospect bo'ylab Neva tomon yurdi, ammo yo'lda unga boshqa bir g'oya keldi.
