uz: Ular uni olib ketishdi, - deb qichqirdi Katerina Ivanovna, u uning qichqiriqlariga quloq soldi va soʻzsiz qoldi.

en: With sad and timid eyes he looked for her; she returned and stood by his pillow.
uz: U qayg'urgan va qo'rqinchli ko'zlar bilan uni qidirdi; u qaytib kelib, uning yostigi yonida turdi.

en: He seemed a little easier but not for long.
uz: U biroz osonroq ko'rinardi, lekin uzoq vaqt qolmadi.

en: Soon his eyes rested on little Lida, his favourite, who was shaking in the corner, as though she were in a fit, and staring at him with her wondering childish eyes.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay uning ko'zlari kichkina Lidaga, uning eng sevimli qizini ko'rdi, u burchada titraydi, xuddi o'zi kasal bo'lib qolgan bo'lsa-da, unga o'ziga o'xshaydigan bolalik ko'zlari bilan qaradi.

en: “A-ah,” he signed towards her uneasily.
uz: A-ah, u uning yo'liga osonlikcha imzo qo'ydi.

en: He wanted to say something.
uz: U biror narsa aytmoqchi edi.

en: “What now?” cried Katerina Ivanovna.
uz: What now? Katerina Ivanovna yig'ladi.

en: “Barefoot, barefoot!” he muttered, indicating with frenzied eyes the child’s bare feet.
uz: "Barsfoot, barefoot!" - deb o'ylashdi u, g'ayritabiiy ko'zlar bilan chaqaloqning boshi to'q bo'lganini ko'rsatdi.

en: “Be silent,” Katerina Ivanovna cried irritably, “you know why she is barefooted.” “Thank God, the doctor,” exclaimed Raskolnikov, relieved.
uz: Shut bo'ling, Katerina Ivanovna g'azablanib yig'ladi, siz nima uchun yalang'och bo'lganini bilasiz. Xudoga shukr, shifokor, Raskolnikov tasalli topdi.

en: The doctor came in, a precise little old man, a German, looking about him mistrustfully; he went up to the sick man, took his pulse, carefully felt his head and with the help of Katerina Ivanovna he unbuttoned the bloodstained shirt, and bared the injured man’s chest.
uz: Shifokor kirdi, aniq bir keksa nemis, uning atrofini ishonchsizlik bilan ko'rib turardi; u bemorning oldiga borib, pulsini oldi, boshini diqqat bilan sezdi va Katerina Ivanovnaning yordami bilan qonli ko'ylakni ochib, jarohatlangan odamning ko'krakini ochdi.

en: It was gashed, crushed and fractured, several ribs on the right side were broken.
uz: U cho'kgan, cho'kkan va parchalangan, o'ng tomondagi bir nechta qirg'oqlari sindirilgan.

en: On the left side, just over the heart, was a large, sinister-looking yellowish-black bruise —a cruel kick from the horse’s hoof.
uz: Chap tomonda, qalbning o'zida katta, yovuz ko'rinishdagi sariq rangli qora ko'rinishdagi zarba bor edi.

en: The policeman told him that he was caught in the wheel and turned round with it for thirty yards on the road.
uz: Politsiyachi u haydovchining haydovchisiga tushib qolganini va u bilan o'ttiz metr yo'l yurganini aytdi.

en: “It’s wonderful that he has recovered consciousness,” the doctor whispered softly to Raskolnikov.
uz: U ongga qaytgani ajablanarli, shifokor Raskolnikovga iliq so'zlab berdi.

en: “What do you think of him?” he asked.
uz: Undan nima deb o'ylaysiz? - deb so'radi u.

en: “He will die immediately.” “Is there really no hope?” “Not the faintest!
uz: U darhol o'lib ketadi.  Haqiqatan ham umid yo'qmi?  Hech qanday umid yo'q!

en: He is at the last gasp.
uz: U o'zining oxirgi nafasini oladi.

en: … His head is badly injured, too … Hm … I could bleed him if you like, but … it would be useless.
uz: Uning boshi ham og'ir jarohatlangan, agar xohlasangiz, uni qon bilan sug'orishim mumkin, ammo bu foydasiz bo'ladi.

en: He is bound to die within the next five or ten minutes.” “Better bleed him then.” “If you like.
uz: U keyingi besh-o'n daqiqada o'lib ketishi aniq. Shuning o'zi uchun uni qon tashlash yaxshiroqdir.  Agar xohlasangiz.

en: … But I warn you it will be perfectly useless.” At that moment other steps were heard; the crowd in the passage parted, and the priest, a little, grey old man, appeared in the doorway bearing the sacrament.
uz: Ammo sizlarni ogohlantiramanki, bu mutlaqo befoyda bo'ladi. O'sha paytda boshqa qadamlar eshitilib, yo'ldagi xaloyiq bo'lindi va ruhoniy, kichkina, qarib qolgan keksa kishi, eshikda sakramentni ko'tarib keldi.

en: A policeman had gone for him at the time of the accident.
uz: Voqea sodir bo'lgan paytda uni politsiya xodimi kutib olgan edi.

en: The doctor changed places with him, exchanging glances with him.
uz: Shifokor u bilan joy o'zgarib, ko'z o'zgartirdi.

en: Raskolnikov begged the doctor to remain a little while.
uz: Raskolnikov shifokorga bir muncha vaqt qolishni iltijo qildi.

en: He shrugged his shoulders and remained.
uz: U yelkalarini ko'tarib, qoldi.

en: The confession was soon over.
uz: Qayta tanbeh bo'ldi.

en: The dying man probably understood little; he could only utter indistinct broken sounds.
uz: O'tib ketayotgan odam, ehtimol, juda oz narsani anglab yetardi; u faqat aniq bo'lmagan tovushlarni aytishi mumkin edi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna took little Lida, lifted the boy from the chair, knelt down in the corner by the stove and made the children kneel in front of her.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna Lida singlini olib, bolani o'rindiqdan ko'tardi, cho'nqa yonida tiz cho'kdi va bolalarni uning oldida tiz cho'ktirdi.

en: The little girl was still trembling; but the boy, kneeling on his little bare knees, lifted his hand rhythmically, crossing
uz: Kichkina qiz hali ham titrab turardi; lekin o'g'il o'zining kichkina yalang'och tiz cho'kib, qo'lini ritmik ravishda ko'tardi va kesib o'tdi.

en: himself with precision and bowed down, touching the floor with his forehead, which seemed to afford him especial satisfaction.
uz: O'zini aniqlik bilan egib, oyoq boshi bilan yerga teggan, bu unga alohida mamnuniyat baxsh etardi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna bit her lips and held back her tears; she prayed, too, now and then pulling straight the boy’s shirt, and managed to cover the girl’s bare shoulders with a kerchief, which she took from the chest without rising from her knees or ceasing to pray.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna o'z og'izlarini o'g'irlab, ko'z yoshlarini to'xtatdi; u ham vaqti-vaqti bilan o'g'ilning ko'ylakini to'g'ri tortib ibodat qildi va qizning yalang'och shoxlarini o'g'irchoq bilan qoplab, uni ko'krakdan ko'tardi, ammo tiz cho'kmasdan yoki ibodat qilishni to'xtatmasdan.

en: Meanwhile the door from the inner rooms was opened inquisitively again.
uz: Shu bilan birga, ichki xonalar eshigini yana qiziqarli tarzda ochishdi.

en: In the passage the crowd of spectators from all the flats on the staircase grew denser and denser, but they did not venture beyond the threshold.
uz: O'tish jarayonida mertabaning barcha kvartiralaridan kelgan tomoshabinlar to'plami zichroq va zichroq bo'lib borardi, ammo ular daraxt ustunidan o'tishga jur'at qilmadilar.

en: A single candle-end lighted up the scene.
uz: Birgina chiroqning o'rniga ko'rinish yorug' qildi.

en: At that moment Polenka forced her way through the crowd at the door.
uz: O'sha paytda Polenka eshikdagi xaloyiq orqali o'zini o'tkazdi.

en: She came in panting from running so fast, took off her kerchief, looked for her mother, went up to her and said, “She’s coming, I met her in the street.” Her mother made her kneel beside her.
uz: U shuncha tez yugurib ketib, o'z ko'ylakini olib, onasini qidirib, uning oldiga bordi va: "U kelayotgan, men uni ko'chada uchratdim", - dedi.O'z onasi uni yonida tiz cho'ktirdi.

en: Timidly and noiselessly a young girl made her way through the crowd, and strange was her appearance in that room, in the midst of want, rags, death and despair.
uz: Ustoz va shovqinsiz bo'lgan bir qiz xaloyiq orasidan o'zini ochdi va bu xonada, muhtojlik, ko'ylak, o'lim va umidsizlik orasida, uning ko'rinishi g'alati edi.

en: She, too, was in rags, her attire was all of the cheapest, but decked out in gutter finery of a special stamp, unmistakably betraying its shameful purpose.
uz: Uning kiyimlari eng arzon edi, lekin maxsus pochta pochta markasi bilan bezatilgan bo'lsa-da, u o'zining sharmanda maqsadini aniq ko'rsatadi.

en: Sonia stopped short in the doorway and looked about her bewildered, unconscious of everything.
uz: Sonia eshikda to'xtadi va o'ziga qaradi, u hayron bo'lib, hamma narsadan bexabar.

en: She forgot her fourth-hand, gaudy silk dress, so unseemly here with its ridiculous long train, and her immense crinoline that filled up the whole doorway, and her light-coloured shoes, and the parasol she brought with her, though it was no use at night, and the absurd round straw hat with its flaring flame-coloured feather.
uz: U o'zining to'rtinchi qo'ldagi, chiroyli ipak kiyimini unutdi, bu erda u o'zining g'alati uzun poyezdlari bilan juda bejiz edi, va butun eshikni to'ldiradigan ulkan krinolinini, yorug' rangli poyabzallarini, kechasi foydasiz bo'lsa-da, o'zi bilan olib kelgan chiroqni va o'zining olov rangli to'rqinli absurd to'g'riroq cho'pkalarini unutdi.

en: Under this rakishly-tilted hat was a pale, frightened little face with lips parted and eyes staring in terror.
uz: Bu qo'rqinchli to'pka ostida qo'rqqan, ko'ngli cho'kgan, og'izlari ochilgan, ko'zlari dahshatga to'lib-toshgan kichkina yuz bor edi.

en: Sonia was a small thin girl of eighteen with fair hair, rather pretty, with wonderful blue eyes.
uz: Sonia o'n sakkiz yoshli, sochlari oq, ko'p chiroyli, ko'k ko'zlar bilan chiroyli qiz edi.

en: She looked intently at the bed and the priest; she too was out of breath with running.
uz: U to'shagini va ruhoniyni diqqat bilan ko'rdi; u ham yugurib ketib, nafasini ketkazdi.

en: At last whispers, some words in the crowd probably, reached her.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, xaloyiq orasida ba'zi bir so'zlar, ehtimol, shov-shuvlar unga yetib keldi.

en: She looked down and took a step forward into the room, still keeping close to the door.
uz: U pastga qarab, bir qadam oldinga kirib, xonani eshik oldida qoldirdi.

en: The service was over.
uz: Xizmat tugadi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna went up to her husband again.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna yana erining huzuriga bordi.

en: The priest stepped back and turned to say a few words of admonition and consolation to Katerina Ivanovna on leaving.
uz: Ruhoniy orqaga qaytib, ketayotganda Katerina Ivanovnaga bir necha so'z nasihat va tasalli berishni so'radi.

en: “What am I to do with these?” she interrupted sharply and irritably, pointing to the little ones.
uz: - Men bularga nima qilishim kerak? - dedi u keskin va g'azabga to'lib, kichiklarga ishora qildi.

en: “God is merciful; look to the Most High for succour,” the priest began.
uz: "Xudo rahmlidir, yordam uchun Eng oliyga murojaat qiling", - deb boshladi ruhoniy.

en: He is merciful, but not to us.” “That’s a sin, a sin, madam,” observed the priest, shaking his head.
uz: U rahmdil, lekin bizlarga emas.Bu gunoh, gunoh, xonim,- dedi ruhoniy, boshini silkitib.

en: “And isn’t that a sin?” cried Katerina Ivanovna, pointing to the dying man.
uz: Bu gunoh emasmi? - dedi Katerina Ivanovna, o'lib ketayotgan odamga ishora qilib.

en: “Perhaps those who have involuntarily caused the accident will agree to compensate you, at least for the loss of his earnings.” “You don’t understand!” cried Katerina Ivanovna angrily waving her hand.
uz: Ehtimol, o'z qasosini yo'qotib qo'yganlar sizni, hech bo'lmaganda, uning ish haqi yo'qotish uchun to'lov qilishga rozi bo'lishadi.Siz tushunmayapsiz! - dedi Katerina Ivanovna jahl bilan qo'lini cho'kib.

en: “And why should they compensate me?
uz: Ular nega menga kompensatsiya qilishlari kerak?

en: Why, he was drunk and threw himself under the horses!
uz: Axir, u mast bo'lib, otlar ostida o'zini tashladi-ku!

en: He brought us in nothing but misery.
uz: U bizni faqatgina qashshoqlikdan mahrum qildi.

en: He drank everything away, the drunkard!
uz: U hamma narsani ichib yubordi, ichkilikboz!

en: He robbed us to get drink, he wasted their lives and mine for drink!
uz: U bizni ichish uchun talon-toroj qildi, ularning va mening hayotimni ichish uchun sarfladi!

en: And thank God he’s dying!
uz: Xudoga shukr, u o'lib ketyapti!

en: One less to keep!” “You must forgive in the hour of death, that’s a sin, madam, such feelings are a great sin.” Katerina Ivanovna was busy with the dying man; she was giving him water, wiping the blood and sweat from his head, setting his pillow straight, and had only turned now and then for a moment to address the priest.
uz: O'lim paytida kechirishingiz kerak, bu gunoh, xonim, bunday his-tuyg'ular katta gunohdir.Katerina Ivanovna o'lib ketayotgan odam bilan band edi; unga suv berib, boshidan qon va terni silkib, yostiqini to'g'ri o'rnatib, vaqti-vaqti bilan ruhoniyga murojaat qilish uchun o'girilib turardi.

en: Now she flew at him almost in a frenzy.
uz: Endi u deyarli g'azabga to'lib-toshdi.

en: That’s words and only words!
uz: Bu so'zlar va faqatgina so'zlar!

en: If he’d not been run over, he’d have come home today drunk and his only shirt dirty and in rags and he’d have fallen asleep like a log, and I should have been sousing and rinsing till daybreak, washing his rags and the children’s and then drying them by the window and as soon as it was daylight I should have been darning them.
uz: Agar uni o'g'irlamaganida, u bugun ichkilikboz va uning yagona ko'ylaklari kir va to'qima bilan uyga kelgan bo'lardi va u yog'och kabi uxlagan bo'lar edi, men esa tonggacha suzish va to'ldirishim kerak edi, uning to'qimalarini va bolalarini yuvish va keyin ularni deraza tomonda quritish. Kun yorug' bo'lganida men ularni to'ldirishim kerak edi.

en: That’s how I spend my nights!
uz: Kechalarimni shunday o'tkazaman!

en: … What’s the use of talking of forgiveness!
uz: Kechirim haqida gapirishning foydasi nimada?

en: I have forgiven as it is!” A terrible hollow cough interrupted her words.
uz: Men uni shunday kechirdim! Qo'rqinchli qo'l qo'shishi uning so'zlarini kesib qo'ydi.

en: She put her handkerchief to her lips and showed it to the priest, pressing her other hand to her aching chest.
uz: O'zining to'plamini og'ziga qo'yib, ruhoniyga ko'rsatdi va boshqa qo'lini og'riqli ko'kraklariga bosdi.

en: The handkerchief was covered with blood.
uz: Qo'lqop qon bilan qoplangan edi.

en: The priest bowed his head and said nothing.
uz: Ruhoniy boshini egib, hech narsa aytmadi.

en: Marmeladov was in the last agony; he did not take his eyes off the face of Katerina Ivanovna, who was bending over him again.
uz: Marmeladov so'nggi azobda edi; u Katerina Ivanovna yuzidan ko'zlarini olib qo'ymagan, chunki u yana uning ustiga o'zini egallagan edi.

en: He kept trying to say something to her; he began moving his tongue with difficulty and articulating indistinctly, but Katerina Ivanovna,
uz: U unga biror narsa aytishga harakat qilardi; tilini qiyinchilik bilan harakatga keltirib, so'zlarni aniq aytmay boshladi, lekin Katerina Ivanovna:

en: understanding that he wanted to ask her forgiveness, called peremptorily to him: “Be silent!
uz: U ayoldan kechirim so'rashni xohlayotganini tushunib, unga qattiq chaqirib: "Shuning gapingni aytma!

en: I know what you want to say!” And the sick man was silent, but at the same instant his wandering eyes strayed to the doorway and he saw Sonia.
uz: Men nima demoqchi ekanligingizni bilaman! Bemor o'zini tutdi, lekin shu paytning o'zida uning ko'zlari eshikga qaradi va u Soniaga ko'rinadi.

en: Till then he had not noticed her: she was standing in the shadow in a corner.
uz: O'shanda u uni ko'rmagan edi: u bir burchada soyasida turgan edi.

en: Who’s that?” he said suddenly in a thick gasping voice, in agitation, turning his eyes in horror towards the door where his daughter was standing, and trying to sit up.
uz: Bu kim? - deb so'radi u birdan, g'ayratli va g'ayratli ovoz bilan, qo'rqinchli ko'zlarini qizining turgan eshikga qaratdi va o'tirishga harakat qildi.

en: Lie do-own!” cried Katerina Ivanovna.
uz: Yolg'onlik qilish! - deb baqirib yubordi Katerina Ivanovna.

en: With unnatural strength he had succeeded in propping himself on his elbow.
uz: U tabiiy kuchga ega bo'lmagan kuch bilan o'zini qo'lqoshida tiklashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: He looked wildly and fixedly for some time on his daughter, as though not recognising her.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt qizini tanimayotgandek vahshiy va qat'iy nazar bilan ko'rdi.

en: He had never seen her before in such attire.
uz: U ayolni ilgari hech qachon bunday kiyimda ko'rmagan edi.

en: Suddenly he recognised her, crushed and ashamed in her humiliation and gaudy finery, meekly awaiting her turn to say goodbye to her dying father.
uz: Birdan u qizni tanib oldi, uning kamsitilishi va go'zal ta'mirlashidan xor bo'lib, o'tib ketayotgan otasi bilan xayrlashish uchun uning navbatini muloyimlik bilan kutdi.

en: His face showed intense suffering.
uz: Uning yuzi qattiq azob chekayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: Forgive!” he cried, and he tried to hold out his hand to her, but losing his balance, he fell off the sofa, face downwards on the floor.
uz: Kechirasiz! u yig'lab yubordi va qo'lini unga uzatishga harakat qildi, lekin muvozanatini yo'qotgach, u sofasidan yuz o'girib, yerga yiqildi.

en: They rushed to pick him up, they put him on the sofa; but he was dying.
uz: Ular uni ko'tarib olish uchun shoshilib, sofa ustiga qo'ydilar; lekin u o'lib ketayotgan edi.

en: Sonia with a faint cry ran up, embraced him and remained so without moving.
uz: Sonia kamroq qichqiriq bilan yugurib kelib, uni quchoqladi va harakatlanmasdan shunday qoldi.

en: He died in her arms.
uz: U uning qo'llarida o'ldi.

en: “He’s got what he wanted,” Katerina Ivanovna cried, seeing her husband’s dead body.
uz: U xohlaganini topdi, - dedi Katerina Ivanovna, erining jasadini ko'rib yig'ladi.

en: “Well, what’s to be done now?
uz: Xo'sh, endi nima qilish kerak?

en: How am I to bury him!
uz: Qanday qilib uni ko'mishim kerak!

en: What can I give them tomorrow to eat?” Raskolnikov went up to Katerina Ivanovna.
uz: Ertaga ularga nima ovqat bersam bo'ladi? Raskolnikov Katerina Ivanovnaga bordi.

en: “Katerina Ivanovna,” he began, “last week your husband told me all his life and circumstances.
uz: "Katerina Ivanovna", - deb boshladi u, "o'tgan hafta eringiz menga o'z hayoti va ahvolini aytib berdi.

en: … Believe me, he spoke of you with passionate reverence.
uz: ... Menga ishoning, u siz haqingizda o'ziga xos hurmat bilan gapirgan.

en: From that evening, when I learnt how devoted he was to you all and how he loved and respected you especially, Katerina Ivanovna, in spite of his unfortunate weakness, from that evening we became friends.
uz: O'sha kechqurun, u hammangizga qanchalik bag'ishlanganligini va ayniqsa sizni, Katerina Ivanovna, sevishini va hurmatini joyiga qo'yganini bilib olgach, o'sha kechqurun biz do'st bo'ldik.

en: … Allow me now … to do something … to repay my debt to my dead friend.
uz: ... Endi menga ruxsat bering... o'lgan do'stimga qarzimni to'lash uchun biror narsa qilishim kerak.

en: Here are twenty roubles, I think —and if that can be of any assistance to you, then … I … in short, I will come again, I will be sure to come again … I shall, perhaps, come again tomorrow.
uz: Mana yigirma rubl, deb o'ylayman va agar bu sizga yordam berishi mumkin bo'lsa, unda men ... qisqacha aytganda, yana kelaman, albatta qaytaman ... ehtimol, ertaga yana kelaman.

en: And he went quickly out of the room, squeezing his way through the crowd to the stairs.
uz: U tezda xonadan chiqib, xaloyiq orasida o'z yo'lini bosib, mertalarga chiqdi.

en: But in the crowd he suddenly jostled against Nikodim Fomitch, who had heard of the accident and had come to give instructions in person.
uz: Ammo u to'satdan xaloyiq orasida hodisani eshitgan va shaxsan yo'l-yo'riq berishga kelgan Nikodim Fomitchga qo'shildi.

en: They had not met since the scene at the police station, but Nikodim Fomitch knew him instantly.
uz: Ular o'sha voqeadan beri politsiya bo'limida uchrashmagan edilar, ammo Nikodim Fomitch uni darhol taniydi.

en: “Ah, is that you?” he asked him.
uz: Ah, senmi? deb so'radi u.

en: “He’s dead,” answered Raskolnikov.
uz: "U o'lgan", - deb javob berdi Raskolnikov.

en: “The doctor and the priest have been, all as it should have been.
uz: Doktor va ruhoniy o'zlarini shunday his qilishdi, hamma narsa bo'lishi kerak bo'lganidek bo'ldi.

en: Don’t worry the poor woman too much, she is in consumption as it is.
uz: Yomon ayol haqida ortiq tashvishlanmang, u hozirda iste'molda.

en: Try and cheer her up, if possible … you are a kindhearted man, I know …” he added with a smile, looking straight in his face.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, uni xursand qilishga harakat qiling ... siz yaxshi odamsiz, bilaman ... U tabassum bilan qo'shimcha qildi va yuzlariga to'g'ri qarab qo'ydi.

en: “But you are spattered with blood,” observed Nikodim Fomitch, noticing in the lamplight some fresh stains on Raskolnikov’s waistcoat.
uz: Ammo siz qon bilan to'ldirilgansiz, - dedi Nikodim Fomitch, yorug'lik nurida Raskolnikovning kiyimida yangi lekani ko'rib.

en: “Yes … I’m covered with blood,” Raskolnikov said with a peculiar air; then he smiled, nodded and went downstairs.
uz: Ha... Men qon bilan qoplanganman, Raskolnikov g'alati havo bilan aytdi; so'ngra tabassum qildi, boshini tiydi va pastga tushdi.

en: He walked down slowly and deliberately, feverish but not conscious of it, entirely absorbed in a new overwhelming sensation of life and strength that surged up suddenly within him.
uz: U sekin-sekin va bila turib, issiq bo'lib, ammo buni bilmay, butunlay o'z ichiga yangi hayot va kuch hissi bilan o'rab olgan.

en: This sensation might be compared to that of a man condemned to death who has suddenly been pardoned.
uz: Bu his-tuyg'u o'limga mahkum bo'lgan odamning his-tuyg'usi bilan taqqoslanishi mumkin, ammo u to'satdan afv etildi.

en: Halfway down the staircase he was overtaken by the priest on his way home; Raskolnikov let him pass, exchanging a silent greeting with him.
uz: Hatto o'rtada turganda, u uyga qaytayotganda ruhoniy tomonidan uchrashdi; Raskolnikov uni o'tib ketishiga yo'l qo'yib, u bilan xotirjamlik bilan salomlashdi.

en: He was just descending the last steps when he heard rapid footsteps behind him.
uz: U faqat so'nggi qadamlarni tushayotganida, orqasidan tez qadamlar so'nggi so'zlarni eshitdi.

en: Someone overtook him; it was Polenka.
uz: Kimdir uni yutib yubordi; Polenka edi.

en: She was running after him, calling “Wait!
uz: U uning orqasidan yugurib, Wait! deb chaqirardi.

en: wait!” He turned round.
uz: To'xtating! U o'girilib ketdi.

en: She was at the bottom of the staircase and stopped short a step above him.
uz: U mertabanning pastida bo'lib, uning ustida bir qadam turib to'xtadi.

en: A dim light came in from the yard.
uz: Xonadan kam yorug'lik keldi.

en: Raskolnikov could distinguish the child’s thin but pretty little face, looking at him with a bright childish smile.
uz: Raskolnikov bolaning chiroyli, lekin chiroyli yuzidan ajralib turishini, unga qizg'in bolalik tabassumini ko'rib turishini ko'rdi.

en: She had run after him with a message which she was evidently glad to give.
uz: U uning orqasidan shodlik bilan xabar olib borgan edi.

en: “Tell me, what is your name?
uz: Menga ayting, ismingiz qanday?

en: … and where do you live?” she said hurriedly in a breathless voice.
uz: ... va siz qayerda yashayapsiz? dedi u shoshib, nafassiz ovoz bilan.

en: He laid both hands on her shoulders and looked at her with a sort of rapture.
uz: Ikkala qo'lini ham ayolning shoxlariga qo'yib, unga o'ziga xos ko'z o'rnagi bilan qaradi.

en: It was such a joy to him to look at her, he could not have said why.
uz: Uning ko'z o'ngidan ko'rib quvonchga to'lganidan, nima sababini aytolmasdi.

en: “Sister Sonia sent me,” answered the girl, smiling still more brightly.
uz: "Sor Sonia meni yubordi, qiz javob berdi va yana ko'proq tabassum bilan javob berdi.

en: “I knew it was sister Sonia sent you.” “Mamma sent me, too … when sister Sonia was sending me, mamma came up, too, and said ‘Run fast, Polenka.’ ” “Do you love sister Sonia?” “I love her more than anyone,” Polenka answered with a peculiar earnestness, and her smile became graver.
uz: Soniya singlisi seni yuborganini bilar edim.Mamma meni ham yuborgan... Soniya singlimiz meni yuborganida, ona ham kelib, unga: Shoshil, Polenka, Soniyani sevasanmi?Men uni har kimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevaman, Polenka o'zgacha samimiylik bilan javob berdi va uning tabassumini ko'tardi.

en: “And will you love me?” By way of answer he saw the little girl’s face approaching him, her full lips naively held out to kiss him.
uz: U meni sevasizmi? Javob sifatida u qizchaning yuzini o'ziga yaqinlashayotganini ko'rdi, uning to'liq og'izlari naiflik bilan uni o'pmoqchi edi.

en: Suddenly her arms as thin as sticks held him tightly, her head rested on his shoulder and the little girl wept softly, pressing her face against him.
uz: Toʻsatdan uning choʻqqina qoʻllari uni qattiq ushlab turardi, boshini uning shoxli ustiga qoʻydi va kichkina qizcha unga yuz oʻgirib, salomatlik bilan yigʻladi.

en: “I am sorry for father,” she said a moment later, raising her tear- stained face and brushing away the tears with her hands.
uz: "Otam uchun xafa bo'laman", - dedi u bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, ko'z yoshlari ko'tarib, ko'z yoshlarini qo'llari bilan yuvdi.

en: “It’s nothing but misfortunes now,” she added suddenly with that peculiarly sedate air which children try hard to assume when they want to speak like grownup people.
uz: Bu hozir baxtsizliklardan boshqa narsa emas, u to'satdan o'zgacha tinchlantiruvchi havo bilan qo'shdi, bolalar kattalarga o'xshab gapirishni istasalar, buni qabul qilishga harakat qilishadi.

en: “Did your father love you?” “He loved Lida most,” she went on very seriously without a smile, exactly like grownup people, “he loved her because she is little and because she is ill, too.
uz: Otam seni yaxshi ko'rganmi?Lidaga eng ko'p sevgan, u kattalar kabi tabassumsiz jiddiy munosabatda bo'ldi,U uni kichikligi va kasalligi sababli yaxshi ko'rgan.

en: And he always used to bring her presents.
uz: Va u har doim unga sovg'alar olib kelardi.

en: But he taught us to read and me grammar and scripture, too,” she added with dignity.
uz: Ammo u bizga o'qishni o'rgatdi va menga grammatika va oyatlarni ham o'rgatdi, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u hurmat bilan.

en: “And mother never used to say anything, but we knew that she liked it and father knew it, too.
uz: Otam hech qachon gapirmasdi, lekin biz buni yaxshi ko'rganini bilardik va otam ham buni bilardi.

en: And mother wants to teach me French, for it’s time my education began.” “And do you know your prayers?” “Of course, we do!
uz: Onam esa menga frantsuz tilini o'rgatishni istaydi, chunki mening ta'lim olishimning vaqti keldi. Va siz ibodatlaringizni bilasizmi? Albatta, bilamiz!

en: We knew them long ago.
uz: Biz ularni ancha vaqt oldin bilardik.

en: I say my prayers to myself as I am a big girl now, but Kolya and Lida say them aloud with mother.
uz: Endi katta bo'lganim uchun o'zimga ibodat qilaman, ammo Kolya va Lida ularni onam bilan birga baland ovoz bilan aytishadi.

en: First they repeat the ‘Ave Maria’ and then another prayer: ‘Lord, forgive and bless sister Sonia,’ and then another, ‘Lord, forgive and bless our second father.’ For our elder father is dead and this is another one, but we do pray for the other as well.” “Polenka, my name is Rodion.
uz: Avvaliga ular Ave Maria va keyin yana bir ibodatni takrorlaydilar: Rabbim, singlimiz Soniyani kechiring va duo qiling, so'ngra yana bir, Rabbim, ikkinchi otamizni kechiring va duo qiling. Chunki katta otamiz vafot etgan va bu yana bir kishi, lekin biz boshqa uchun ham ibodat qilamiz.Polenka, ismim Rodion.

en: Pray sometimes for me, too.
uz: Men uchun ham ba'zan ibodat qiling.

en: ‘And Thy servant Rodion,’ nothing more.” “I’ll pray for you all the rest of my life,” the little girl declared hotly, and suddenly smiling again she rushed at him and hugged him
uz: Va xizmatkoring Rodion, boshqa hech narsa emas.Men butun hayotim davomida sen uchun ibodat qilaman, kichik qiz qizcha qizg'inlik bilan e'lon qildi va to'satdan yana tabassum qilib, unga yugurdi va uni quchoqladi

en: Raskolnikov told her his name and address and promised to be sure to come next day.
uz: Raskolnikov unga o'z ismi va manzilini aytib, ertasi kuni albatta kelishini va'da qildi.

en: The child went away quite enchanted with him.
uz: Bola u bilan juda hayajonlanib ketdi.

en: It was past ten when he came out into the street.
uz: U ko'chaga chiqqanida soat o'ndan past edi.

en: In five minutes he was standing on the bridge at the spot where the woman had jumped in.
uz: Besh daqiqadan so'ng, u o'sha ayol qusib o'tgan joyda ko'prikda turibdi.

en: “Enough,” he pronounced resolutely and triumphantly.
uz: Yog'i, u qat'iy va g'alaba qozonib so'zladi.

en: “I’ve done with fancies, imaginary terrors and phantoms!
uz: Men xayollar, tasavvurli dahshatlar va sehr-jodular bilan to'xtadim!

en: haven’t I lived just now?
uz: Men hozircha yashamaganmanmi?

en: My life has not yet died with that old woman!
uz: O'sha keksa ayol bilan hayotim hali o'limga yetmagan!

en: The Kingdom of Heaven to her —and now enough, madam, leave me in peace!
uz: Osmon Shohligi unga yetarli va endi, xonim, meni tinchlikda qoldiring!

en: Now for the reign of reason and light … and of will, and of strength … and now we will see!
uz: Endi aql-idrok va yorug'lik hukmronligi uchun ... irodas va kuch ... va endi ko'ramiz!

en: We will try our strength!” he added defiantly, as though challenging some power of darkness.
uz: Biz kuchimizni sinab ko'ramiz! deb qo'shimcha qildi u, xuddi qorong'ilik kuchlariga qarshi chiqqan bo'lib.

en: “And I was ready to consent to live in a square of space!
uz: Va men o'zimni maydonda yashash uchun rozi bo'lishga tayyor edim!

en: “I am very weak at this moment, but … I believe my illness is all over.
uz: Men hozir juda zaifman, lekin ... men kasalligim o'tganligiga ishonaman.

en: I knew it would be over when I went out.
uz: Men chiqib ketgach, bularning hammasi tugaganini bilardim.

en: By the way, Potchinkov’s house is only a few steps away.
uz: Aytgancha, Potchinkovning uyi bir necha qadamdan uzoq.

en: I certainly must go to Razumihin even if it were not close by … let him win his bet!
uz: Men, albatta, Razumihinga borishim kerak, hatto u yaqin emas bo'lsa ham ... uning o'yinini g'alaba qozonishiga yo'l qo'ying!

en: Let us give him some satisfaction, too —no matter!
uz: Keling, unga ham qoniqish baxsh etamiz!

en: Strength, strength is what one wants, you can get nothing without it, and strength must be won by strength —that’s what they don’t know,” he added proudly and self-confidently and he walked with flagging footsteps from the bridge.
uz: Kuch, kuch - bu inson xohlagan narsadir, usiz hech narsa topolmaysiz va kuchni kuch bilan qo'lga kiritish kerak, bu ular bilmaydigan narsa, - deb qo'shimcha qildi u faxrli va ishonch bilan va ko'prikdan ko'rinadigan qadamlar bilan yurdi.

en: Pride and self-confidence grew continually stronger in him; he was becoming a different man every moment.
uz: Uning mag'rurligi va o'zidan o'zidan o'zidan o'ta ishonch hosil qilishi, har bir daqiqada o'zgacha inson bo'lib borishi uchun o'sib borardi.

en: What was it had happened to work this revolution in him?
uz: Unda bu inqilobni amalga oshirish uchun nima sodir bo'lgan?

en: He did not know himself; like a man catching at a straw, he suddenly felt that he, too, “could live, that there was still life for him, that his life had not died with the old woman.” Perhaps he was in too great a hurry with his conclusions, but he did not think of that.
uz: U o'zini tanimagan; cho'g'a tutgan odam kabi, u ham o'zini tirik his qilgan, o'zi uchun hali ham hayot borligini, keksa ayol bilan o'lgan hayotining yo'qligini sezgan. Ehtimol, u xulosalar chiqarishga juda shoshgan edi, ammo bu haqda o'ylamagan.

en: “But I did ask her to remember ‘Thy servant Rodion’ in her prayers,” the idea struck him.
uz: Lekin men unga ibodatlarida xonadoningiz Rodionni eslatishni so'radim, bu g'oya unga tushdi.

en: “Well, that was … in case of emergency,” he added and laughed himself at his boyish sally.
uz: Eh, bu ... shoshilinch holatda, qo'shimcha qilib, o'zining o'g'illik salliga o'zini kuldi.

en: He was in the best of spirits.
uz: U eng yaxshi ruhda edi.

en: He easily found Razumihin; the new lodger was already known at Potchinkov’s and the porter at once showed him the way.
uz: U Razumihinni osonlikcha topdi; Potchinkovlarda yangi uy egasi allaqachon tanilgan edi va portiyer unga darhol yo'l ko'rsatdi.

en: Halfway upstairs he could hear the noise and animated conversation of a big gathering of people.
uz: Yuqorida o'rtada odamlarning katta yig'ilishining shov-shuvini eshitadi.

en: The door was wide open on the stairs; he could
uz: Eshik narvonlar ustida keng ochilgan edi; u o'zini o'zi tutishi mumkin edi.

en: hear exclamations and discussion.
uz: Eshitish va muhokama qilish.

en: Razumihin’s room was fairly large; the company consisted of fifteen people.
uz: Razumichinning xonasi juda katta edi; kompaniya o'n besh kishidan iborat edi.

en: Raskolnikov stopped in the entry, where two of the landlady’s servants were busy behind a screen with two samovars, bottles, plates and dishes of pie and savouries, brought up from the landlady’s kitchen.
uz: Raskolnikov kirish joyida to'xtadi, u yerda uy egasining xizmatkorlaridan ikkisi ekranda o'tirganida, uy egasining oshxonasidan keltirilgan ikkita samovar, shishalar, plakatlar va pishirishlar bilan band edilar.

en: Raskolnikov sent in for Razumihin.
uz: Raskolnikov Razumihin uchun jo'natildi.

en: He ran out delighted.
uz: U quvonch bilan yugurib ketdi.

en: At the first glance it was apparent that he had had a great deal to drink and, though no amount of liquor made Razumihin quite drunk, this time he was perceptibly affected by it.
uz: Birinchi qarashda u juda ko'p ichganligi aniq edi va garchi hech qanday miqdorda spirtli ichimlik Razumihinni o'ta mast qilmagan bo'lsa-da, bu safar u unga sezilarli darajada ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: “Listen,” Raskolnikov hastened to say, “I’ve only just come to tell you you’ve won your bet and that no one really knows what may not happen to him.
uz: Raskolnikov shunday dedi: "Men sizga faqat shuni aytishga keldimki, siz o'zingizning tikishingizni qo'lga kiritgansiz va hech kim unga nima bo'lmasligini bilmaydi.

en: I can’t come in; I am so weak that I shall fall down directly.
uz: Men kirolmayman; men shunchalik zaifmanki, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yiqilib ketaman.

en: And so good evening and goodbye!
uz: Shu sababli, yaxshi kecha va salom!

en: Come and see me tomorrow.” “Do you know what?
uz: Ertaga menga tashrif buyuring.Bilasizmi nima?

en: If you say you’re weak yourself, you must …” “And your visitors?
uz: Agar siz o'zingiz ham zaif ekanligingizni aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, unda siz ... Va tashrif buyuruvchilaringiz haqida nima deyish kerak?

en: Who is the curly-headed one who has just peeped out?” “He?
uz: O'sha tupurgan boshli kishi kim?U?

en: Goodness only knows!
uz: Faqatgina Xudo biladi!

en: Some friend of uncle’s, I expect, or perhaps he has come without being invited … I’ll leave uncle with them, he is an invaluable person, pity I can’t introduce you to him now.
uz: Oʻgʻlimning doʻsti boʻlishi kerak, deb oʻylayman, yoki ehtimol u taklif etilmasdan kelgan boʻlishi mumkin... Oʻgʻlimni ular bilan qoldiraman, u bebaho inson, afsuski, men sizni hozir unga tanishtirolmayman.

en: But confound them all now!
uz: Ammo hozir hammasini chalg'itib qo'ying!

en: They won’t notice me, and I need a little fresh air, for you’ve come just in the nick of time —another two minutes and I should have come to blows!
uz: Ular meni ko'rmaydilar va men bir oz toza havoga muhtojman, chunki siz o'z vaqtida keldingiz yana ikki daqiqa va men o'zimni qo'lga olishim kerak edi!

en: They are talking such a lot of wild stuff … you simply can’t imagine what men will say!
uz: Ular juda ko'p yovvoyi gaplarni aytmoqdalar ... erkaklar nima deyishini tasavvur ham qila olmaysiz!

en: Though why shouldn’t you imagine?
uz: Ammo nega tasavvur qilmasligingiz kerak?

en: Don’t we talk nonsense ourselves?
uz: Biz o'zimiz behuda gapirmayapmizmi?

en: And let them … that’s the way to learn not to!
uz: Va ularni qo'yib yuboringlar... bu o'rganishning o'rni!

en: … Wait a minute, I’ll fetch Zossimov.” Zossimov pounced upon Raskolnikov almost greedily; he showed a special interest in him; soon his face brightened.
uz: Zossimov Raskolnikovni deyarli ochko'zlik bilan urdi; u unga alohida qiziqish ko'rsatdi; tez orada uning yuzi yorqinlashdi.

en: “You must go to bed at once,” he pronounced, examining the patient as far as he could, “and take something for the night.
uz: "Siz darhol yotoqga borishingiz kerak", - dedi u, bemorni iloji boricha ko'proq tekshirib, "va kecha uchun biror narsa olib keting.

en: I got it ready some time ago … a powder.” “Two, if you like,” answered Raskolnikov.
uz: Men buni bir necha vaqt oldin tayyorladim ... bir toʻqima.  Ikki, agar xohlasangiz, Raskolnikov javob berdi.

en: The powder was taken at once.
uz: Quruq darhol qabul qilindi.

en: “It’s a good thing you are taking him home,” observed Zossimov to Razumihin —“we shall see how he is tomorrow, today he’s not at all
uz: Yaxshiyamki, siz uni uyga olib ketasiz, - dedi Zossimov Razumihinga. - Ertaga qanday bo'lishini ko'ramiz, bugun u umuman yo'q.

en: amiss —a considerable change since the afternoon.
uz: Kechqurundan beri sezilarli o'zgarishlar yuz berdi.

en: Live and learn  …” “Do you know what Zossimov whispered to me when we were coming out?” Razumihin blurted out, as soon as they were in the street.
uz: Turing va o'rganing...Zossimov men bilan suhbatlashayotganda menga nimalarni shoshib aytganini bilasizmi? Razumihin ko'chada bo'lganidan so'ng, o'z ko'zidan chiqdi.

en: “I won’t tell you everything, brother, because they are such fools.
uz: Men senga hamma narsani aytmayman, aka, chunki ular o'ta ahmoqlardir.

en: Zossimov told me to talk freely to you on the way and get you to talk freely to me, and afterwards I am to tell him about it, for he’s got a notion in his head that you are … mad or close on it.
uz: Zossimov menga yo'lda siz bilan erkin gaplashishni va siz menga erkin gapirishingizni aytdi, keyin esa men unga bu haqda aytib beraman, chunki uning ongida siz ... g'azablanasiz yoki yaqin ekanligingiz haqida tasavvur bor.

en: In the first place, you’ve three times the brains he has; in the second, if you are not mad, you needn’t care a hang that he has got such a wild idea; and thirdly, that piece of beef whose specialty is surgery has gone mad on mental diseases, and what’s brought him to this conclusion about you was your conversation today with Zametov.” “Zametov told you all about it?” “Yes, and he did well.
uz: Birinchidan, sizda uning ongidan uch baravar ko'proq ong bor; ikkinchidan, agar siz g'alati bo'lmasangiz, uning g'alati g'oyaga ega bo'lishidan umuman xavotirlanmasligingiz kerak; uchinchidan, jarrohlik shifosi bo'lgan bu go'shtning ruhiy kasalliklarga bo'lgan jahlini ko'targansiz va uni siz haqingizda shunday xulosaga keltirib qo'ygan narsa bugun Zametov bilan o'tgan suhbatingiz edi.Zametov bu haqda sizga hamma narsani aytib berdi?Ha, va u yaxshi ish qildi.

en: Now I understand what it all means and so does Zametov.
uz: Endi men bularning barchasining ma'nosini tushundim va Zametov ham.

en: … Well, the fact is, Rodya … the point is … I am a little drunk now.
uz: Haqiqat shundaki, Rodya, men hozir biroz mastman.

en: … But that’s … no matter … the point is that this idea … you understand?
uz: Ammo bu ... muhim emas ... muhim narsa shundaki, ushbu g'oya ... tushunasizmi?

en: was just being hatched in their brains … you understand?
uz: Ularning miyasida o'sib borayotgan edi... tushunyapsizmi?

en: That is, no one ventured to say it aloud, because the idea is too absurd and especially since the arrest of that painter, that bubble’s burst and gone for ever.
uz: Demak, hech kim buni baland ovoz bilan aytishga jur'at qilmadi, chunki bu juda absurd fikr va ayniqsa, bu rassomning hibsga olinishidan so'ng, bulutlar to'kib ketib, abadiy yo'qolgan.

en: But why are they such fools?
uz: Ammo nima uchun ular shunchalik ahmoqlar?

en: I gave Zametov a bit of a thrashing at the time —that’s between ourselves, brother; please don’t let out a hint that you know of it; I’ve noticed he is a ticklish subject; it was at Luise Ivanovna’s.
uz: Zametovga o'sha paytda o'z-o'zimiz bilan bog'liq bo'lgan biroz g'alati so'zlarni aytdim, birodarim; iltimos, bu haqda bilganingizni ko'rsatma bermang; men uning charchag'i bir mavzu ekanligini payqadim; bu Luisa Ivanovna bilan bo'lgan.

en: But today, today it’s all cleared up.
uz: Ammo bugun, bugun hamma narsa aniqlandi.

en: That Ilya Petrovitch is at the bottom of it!
uz: Ilya Petrovitchning bu ishning pastida ekanligi!

en: He took advantage of your fainting at the police station, but he is ashamed of it himself now; I know that …” Raskolnikov listened greedily.
uz: U politsiya bo'limida sening baytilog'ingdan foydalangan, lekin hozir u o'zi uchun o'zi ham uyat chekmoqda; men bilamanki ... Raskolnikov ochko'zlik bilan tingladi.

en: Razumihin was drunk enough to talk too freely.
uz: Razumihin juda erkin gapirish uchun yetarlicha mast edi.

en: “I fainted then because it was so close and the smell of paint,” said Raskolnikov.
uz: O'shanda men o'zimni chalg'itdim, chunki u juda yaqin edi va bo'yoqning hidini ko'rdi, - dedi Raskolnikov.

en: “No need to explain that!
uz: Buni tushuntirishning hojati yo'q!

en: And it wasn’t the paint only: the fever had been coming on for a month; Zossimov testifies to that!
uz: Va bu faqat bo'yoq bilan bog'liq emas edi: bir oy davomida issiqlik paydo bo'lgan edi; Zossimov bunga guvohlik beradi!

en: But how crushed that boy is now, you wouldn’t believe!
uz: Ammo o'sha o'g'il hozir qanchalik tushkunlikka tushganini tasavvur qila olmaysiz!

en: ‘I am not worth his little finger,’ he says.
uz: Men uning kichik barmog'iga arzimaydi, deydi u.

en: He has good feelings at times, brother.
uz: U ba'zan yaxshi his-tuyg'ularga ega, aka.

en: But the lesson, the lesson you gave him today in the
uz: Ammo siz unga bugun o'rgatgan saboq, dars, o'qigan saboq.

en: Palais de Cristal, that was too good for anything!
uz: Palais de Cristal, bu hech narsa uchun juda yaxshi edi!

en: You frightened him at first, you know, he nearly went into convulsions!
uz: Boshida siz uni qo'rqitgansiz, bilasizmi, u deyarli sarosimaga tushdi!

en: You almost convinced him again of the truth of all that hideous nonsense, and then you suddenly —put out your tongue at him: ‘There now, what do you make of it?’ It was perfect!
uz: Siz uni yana bir bor bu dahshatli axloqsizlikning haqiqatini ishontirmoqchi bo'ldingiz, keyin birdan unga tilingizni chiqarib: "Shu yerda nima deysiz?

en: He is crushed, annihilated now!
uz: Hozir u ezib yuborilgan, yo'q qilingan!

en: It was masterly, by Jove, it’s what they deserve!
uz: Bu Jove tomonidan ustunlik bilan bajarilgan, ular bunga loyiqdir!

en: Ah, that I wasn’t there!
uz: Ah, men u yerda bo'lmaganim uchun!

en: He was hoping to see you awfully.
uz: U sizni juda ko'p kutardi.

en: Porfiry, too, wants to make your acquaintance …” “Ah!
uz: Porfiry ham siz bilan tanishishni istaydi ...Ah!

en: … he too … but why did they put me down as mad?” “Oh, not mad.
uz: ... u ham ... lekin nega meni g'alati deb hisoblashgan?Oh, g'alati emas.

en: I must have said too much, brother.
uz: Men juda ko'p gapirgan bo'laman, aka.

en: … What struck him, you see, was that only that subject seemed to interest you; now it’s clear why it did interest you; knowing all the circumstances … and how that irritated you and worked in with your illness … I am a little drunk, brother, only, confound him, he has some idea of his own … I tell you, he’s mad on mental diseases.
uz: ... Uni hayratda qoldirgan narsa shundaki, faqatgina bu mavzu sizni qiziqtirgan edi; endi nima uchun sizni qiziqtirganligi aniq; barcha holatlarni bilgan holda ... va bu sizni qanday g'azablantirgan va kasalligingizga qanday yordam berganini bilgan holda ... Men biroz mastman, aka, faqat, uni chalg'itdim, u o'z fikrini o'zi biladi ... sizga aytaman, u ruhiy kasalliklarga g'azab.

en: But don’t you mind him …” For half a minute both were silent.
uz: Ammo siz unga qarshi emassiz ... Yarim daqiqa davomida ikkalasi ham sukut saqlashdi.

en: “Listen, Razumihin,” began Raskolnikov, “I want to tell you plainly: I’ve just been at a deathbed, a clerk who died … I gave them all my money … and besides I’ve just been kissed by someone who, if I had killed anyone, would just the same … in fact I saw someone else there … with a flame-coloured feather … but I am talking nonsense; I am very weak, support me … we shall be at the stairs directly …” “What’s the matter?
uz: Raskolnikov boshladi: "Men sizga aniq aytmoqchiman: men o'lim to'shagida edim, o'lgan xodim ... men ularga butun pulimni berdim ... va bundan tashqari men kimnidir o'ldirganimda, xuddi shunday bo'lardi ... aslida men u yerda boshqa birovni ko'rdim ... olov rangli piyoda ... lekin men behuda gapiryapman; men juda zaifman, meni qo'llab-quvvatlang ... biz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri poyga boramiz ...

en: What’s the matter with you?” Razumihin asked anxiously.
uz: Sizga nima bo'ldi? - deb so'radi Razumihin tashvishlanib.

en: “I am a little giddy, but that’s not the point, I am so sad, so sad … like a woman.
uz: Men biroz ko'nglim o'zgarib ketganman, lekin bu mening fikrim emas, men juda qayg'uraman, juda qayg'uraman ... bir ayol kabi.

en: Look, look!” “What is it?” “Don’t you see?
uz: Qaranglar, qaranglar!  Bu nima?  Qaranglar, ko'rmayapsizlarmi?

en: A light in my room, you see?
uz: Xonamdagi chiroqni ko'ryapsizmi?

en: Through the crack  …” They were already at the foot of the last flight of stairs, at the level of the landlady’s door, and they could, as a fact, see from below that there was a light in Raskolnikov’s garret.
uz: ... Ular allaqachon uy egasining eshik darajasida, so'nggi bosqichdagi mertarlarning oyoq ostida edilar va, aslida, pastdan Raskolnikovning garretida yorug'lik borligini ko'rishardi.

en: Nastasya, perhaps,” observed Razumihin.
uz: Nastasya, ehtimol, Razumihinni kuzatdi.

en: “She is never in my room at this time and she must be in bed long ago, but … I don’t care!
uz: O'sha paytda u hech qachon xonamda emas va u ancha vaqt oldin yotoqda bo'lishi kerak, lekin... bu menga qiziqmaydi!

en: Goodbye!” “What do you mean?
uz: Xo'sh, salom! Siz nimani nazarda tutyapsiz?

en: I am coming with you, we’ll come in together!”
uz: Men siz bilan birga kelaman, biz birgalikda kiramiz!

en: “I know we are going in together, but I want to shake hands here and say goodbye to you here.
uz: Men bilamanki, biz birgalikda kiramiz, lekin men bu yerda qo'l urib, siz bilan xayrlashmoqchiman.

en: So give me your hand, goodbye!” “What’s the matter with you, Rodya?” “Nothing … come along … you shall be witness.” They began mounting the stairs, and the idea struck Razumihin that perhaps Zossimov might be right after all.
uz: Shunday qilib, menga qo'lingizni bering, salom!Siz bilan nima sodir bo'ldi, Rodya? Hech narsa ... keling ... siz shohid bo'lasiz. Ular mertaga ko'tarilishni boshlashdi, va razumihinning g'oyasi Zossimovning so'zlari to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida edi.

en: “Ah, I’ve upset him with my chatter!” he muttered to himself.
uz: Ah, men uni gaplarim bilan xafa qildim! deb o'z-o'ziga qichqirdi.

en: When they reached the door they heard voices in the room.
uz: Ular eshikga yetganlarida xonada ovozlarni eshitishdi.

en: “What is it?” cried Razumihin.
uz: Nima bu? deb baqirdi Razumihin.

en: Raskolnikov was the first to open the door; he flung it wide and stood still in the doorway, dumbfoundered.
uz: Raskolnikov birinchi bo'lib eshikni ochdi; uni keng tashladi va o'zini ko'rmagan holda eshikda to'xtadi.

en: His mother and sister were sitting on his sofa and had been waiting an hour and a half for him.
uz: Uning onasi va singlisi uning sofasida o'tirib, uni bir yarim soat kutishgan edi.

en: Why had he never expected, never thought of them, though the news that they had started, were on their way and would arrive immediately, had been repeated to him only that day?
uz: Nima uchun u hech qachon ularni kutmagan, ular haqida hech o'ylamagan edi, ammo ular boshlagan va darhol kelib qoladigan yangiliklar u kunda unga takrorlangan edi?

en: They had spent that hour and a half plying Nastasya with questions.
uz: Ular o'sha bir yarim soat davomida Nastasyaga savollar berib kelishgan edi.

en: She was standing before them and had told them everything by now.
uz: U ularning oldida turgan edi va hozirga qadar hamma narsani ularga aytib bergan edi.

en: They were beside themselves with alarm when they heard of his “running away” today, ill and, as they understood from her story, delirious!
uz: Uning bugun kasal va, uning hikoyasidan tushunib yetganidek, deliriyalangan holda qochib ketayotganini eshitganlarida, ular qo'rqinchga to'lgan edilar!

en: “Good Heavens, what had become of him?” Both had been weeping, both had been in anguish for that hour and a half.
uz: Yomon osmonlar, u nima bo'ldi? Ikkalasi ham o'sha yarim soat davomida yig'lab, qayg'uda edilar.

en: A cry of joy, of ecstasy, greeted Raskolnikov’s entrance.
uz: Raskolnikovning kirishiga quvonch va shodlik ovozi keldi.

en: But he stood like one dead; a sudden intolerable sensation struck him like a thunderbolt.
uz: Ammo u o'lik kabi turdi; to'satdan unga g'alati tuyg'u chaqmoqday tushib qoldi.

en: He did not lift his arms to embrace them, he could not.
uz: U qo'llarini ko'tarib, ularni quchoqlab olmagan.

en: His mother and sister clasped him in their arms, kissed him, laughed and cried.
uz: Uning onasi va singlisi uni quchoqlab, o'pdilar, kulishdi va yig'ladilar.

en: He took a step, tottered and fell to the ground, fainting.
uz: U bir qadam qo'ydi, teshiklab, yerga yiqildi va baytildi.

en: Anxiety, cries of horror, moans … Razumihin who was standing in the doorway flew into the room, seized the sick man in his strong arms and in a moment had him on the sofa.
uz: Tashvish, qo'rqinchli qichqiriq, qayg'u... Eshikda turgan Razumihin xonaga uchib kirdi, kasalni kuchli qo'llarida ushlab, bir daqiqada uni sofa ustiga qo'ydi.

en: “It’s nothing, nothing!” he cried to the mother and sister —“it’s only a faint, a mere trifle!
uz: "Bu hech narsa emas, hech narsa emas!" - deb qayg'urdi u onasi va singlisiga. - Bu faqat bir kamchilik, bir kamchilik!

en: Only just now the doctor said he was much better, that he is perfectly well!
uz: Faqatgina hozir shifokor uning juda yaxshi ekanligini, mukammal sog'lomligini aytdi!

en: See, he is coming to himself, he is all right again!” And seizing Dounia by the arm so that he almost dislocated it, he made her bend down to see that “he is all right again.” The mother
uz: Mana, u o'z-o'ziga qaytib kelyapti, u yana yaxshi! Dounia qo'lidan tutgan holda, uni deyarli ajratib qo'ydi, uni yana yaxshi ekanligini ko'rish uchun egib qo'ydi. Onasi

en: and sister looked on him with emotion and gratitude, as their Providence.
uz: Opamiz va singlisi uni o'zlarining Parvardigorlari sifatida hissiyot va minnatdorchilik bilan ko'rib turishgan.

en: They had heard already from Nastasya all that had been done for their Rodya during his illness, by this “very competent young man,” as Pulcheria Alexandrovna Raskolnikov called him that evening in conversation with Dounia.
uz: Ular Nastasiyadan kasalligida Rodya uchun pulcheria Aleksandrovna Raskolnikov bilan suhbatlashayotgan kuni kechqurun unga aytganidek, bu "chiroyli" yosh yigit tomonidan qilingan barcha ishlarni eshitishgan edi.

en: I Raskolnikov got up, and sat down on the sofa.
uz: Raskolnikov o'rnidan turib, sofaga o'tirdi.

en: He waved his hand weakly to Razumihin to cut short the flow of warm and incoherent consolations he was addressing to his mother and sister, took them both by the hand and for a minute or two gazed from one to the other without speaking.
uz: Razumihinga qo'lini cho'k qo'yib, onasi va singlisiga aytgan samimiy va noaniq tasallilarni kesib tashlash uchun, ularni qo'lidan ushlab, bir-ikki daqiqa davomida gapirmasdan bir-birlariga qarab turdi.

en: His mother was alarmed by his expression.
uz: Uning onasi uning ifodasidan xavotirga tushdi.

en: It revealed an emotion agonisingly poignant, and at the same time something immovable, almost insane.
uz: Bu og'irlik bilan o'ziga xos tuyg'ularni va bir vaqtning o'zida harakatsiz, deyarli aqldan ozgan narsani oshkor qildi.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna began to cry.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna yig'lab yubordi.

en: Avdotya Romanovna was pale; her hand trembled in her brother’s.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna soya edi; uning qo'li aka-ukalaridan titragan edi.

en: “Go home … with him,” he said in a broken voice, pointing to Razumihin, “goodbye till tomorrow; tomorrow everything … Is it long since you arrived?” “This evening, Rodya,” answered Pulcheria Alexandrovna, “the train was awfully late.
uz: Ushbu kechqurun Rodya Pulcheria Aleksandrovnaga javob berdi: Tochqin juda kech qoldi.

en: But, Rodya, nothing would induce me to leave you now!
uz: Ammo Rodya, hech narsa meni seni tashlab ketishga undamaydi!

en: I will spend the night here, near you …” “Don’t torture me!” he said with a gesture of irritation.
uz: Men tunni bu yerda, sizning yoningizda o'tkazaman ... Meni qiynamang! dedi u g'azablanish imo-ishora bilan.

en: “I will stay with him,” cried Razumihin, “I won’t leave him for a moment.
uz: "Men u bilan birga bo'laman", - deb baqirdi Razumihin, "men uni bir daqiqa ham tark etmayman.

en: Bother all my visitors!
uz: Barcha tashrif buyuruvchilarni bezovta qiling!

en: Let them rage to their hearts’ content!
uz: Ular ko'ngillari qondirgancha g'azablansinlar!

en: My uncle is presiding there.” “How, how can I thank you!” Pulcheria Alexandrovna was beginning, once more pressing Razumihin’s hands, but Raskolnikov interrupted her again.
uz: Otam shu yerda raislik qiladi. Qanday qilib, sizga qanday rahmat aytsam bo'ladi! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna boshlanayotgan edi, yana Razumihinning qo'llarini bosdi, lekin Raskolnikov uni yana to'xtatdi.

en: I can’t have it!” he repeated irritably, “don’t worry me!
uz: Men buni qabul qila olmayman! - deb qayg'urib takrorladi u, - meni tashvishlantirmanglar!

en: Enough, go away … I can’t stand it!” “Come, mamma, come out of the room at least for a minute,” Dounia whispered in dismay; “we are distressing him, that’s evident.”
uz: Toʻgʻri, ket... Men buni koʻtarolmayman!

en: “Mayn’t I look at him after three years?” wept Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Uch yildan so'ng unga qanday qarayman? - deb yig'ladi Pulcheria Aleksandrovna.

en: “Stay,” he stopped them again, “you keep interrupting me, and my ideas get muddled.
uz: U yana ularni to'xtatdi, siz meni to'xtatishni davom ettirasiz va mening g'oyalarim chalg'ib ketadi.

en: … Have you seen Luzhin?” “No, Rodya, but he knows already of our arrival.
uz: Siz Luzhinni ko'rganmisiz? Yo'q, Rodya, lekin u bizning kelishimizni allaqachon biladi.

en: We have heard, Rodya, that Pyotr Petrovitch was so kind as to visit you today,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna added somewhat timidly.
uz: Biz eshitdik, Rodya, Pyotr Petrovitch bugun sizni ko'rish uchun juda mehribon bo'lganini, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna biroz uyalgan holda qo'shdi.

en: “Yes … he was so kind … Dounia, I promised Luzhin I’d throw him downstairs and told him to go to hell.
uz: Ha... u juda mehribon edi... Dounia, men Luzhinga uni pastga tashlashga va jahannamga ketishga va'da berdim.

en: …” “Rodya, what are you saying!
uz: ... Rodya, nima deyapsan!

en: Surely, you don’t mean to tell us …” Pulcheria Alexandrovna began in alarm, but she stopped, looking at Dounia.
uz: Shubhasiz, siz bizga aytmoqchi emassiz ... Pulcheria Aleksandrovna xavotirga tushib boshladi, lekin u Douniaga qarab to'xtadi.

en: Avdotya Romanovna was looking attentively at her brother, waiting for what would come next.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna o'z ukasiga diqqat bilan qarab, bundan keyin nima bo'lishini kutardi.

en: Both of them had heard of the quarrel from Nastasya, so far as she had succeeded in understanding and reporting it, and were in painful perplexity and suspense.
uz: Ikkalasi ham bahs haqida Nastasiyadan eshitgan edilar, chunki u buni tushunishga va xabar berishga muvaffaq bo'ldi va ular og'ir darajada g'alati va g'alati edilar.

en: “Dounia,” Raskolnikov continued with an effort, “I don’t want that marriage, so at the first opportunity tomorrow you must refuse Luzhin, so that we may never hear his name again.” “Good Heavens!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Dounia, Raskolnikov harakat bilan davom etdi, Men bu nikohni xohlamayman, shuning uchun ertaga birinchi imkoniyatda siz Luzhinni rad etishingiz kerak, toki biz uning ismini boshqa hech qachon eshitmasligimiz kerak.Good Heaven! Pulcheria Alexandrovna xitob qildi.

en: “Brother, think what you are saying!” Avdotya Romanovna began impetuously, but immediately checked herself.
uz: Xudo, nima deyayotganingni o'ylab ko'ring! Avdotya Romanovna g'ayrat bilan boshladi, lekin darhol o'zini tekshirdi.

en: “You are not fit to talk now, perhaps; you are tired,” she added gently.
uz: Siz hozir gapirishga yaroqsiz, ehtimol; siz charchagansiz, u muloyimlik bilan qo'shimcha qildi.

en: “You think I am delirious?
uz: Siz meni deliriumli deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: No … You are marrying Luzhin for my sake.
uz: Yo'q, siz mening nomim uchun Luzhin bilan turmush qurasiz.

en: But I won’t accept the sacrifice.
uz: Ammo men qurbonlikni qabul qilmayman.

en: And so write a letter before tomorrow, to refuse him … Let me read it in the morning and that will be the end of it!” “That I can’t do!” the girl cried, offended, “what right have you …” “Dounia, you are hasty, too, be quiet, tomorrow … Don’t you see  …” the mother interposed in dismay.
uz: Shunday qilib, ertagacha uni rad etish uchun maktub yozing... Ertalab uni o'qib bersam, bu uning oxiri bo'ladi!Bu men qila olmayman! Qiz yig'ladi, xafa bo'ldi,siz nima haqingiz bor...Dounia, siz ham shoshilyapsiz, ertaga sukut saqlang...

en: “Better come away!” “He is raving,” Razumihin cried tipsily, “or how would he dare!
uz: Yog'iroq qiling!  U g'azablangan, Razumihin o'z-o'zidan yig'lab yubordi,  Yoki qanday qilib u jur'at qiladi!

en: Tomorrow all this nonsense will be over … today he certainly did drive him away.
uz: Ertaga bu axloqsizliklarning hammasi tugadi ... bugun u albatta uni haydab yubordi.

en: And Luzhin got angry, too.
uz: Va Luzhin ham g'azablandi.

en: … He made speeches here, wanted to show off his learning and he went out crestfallen.
uz: U bu yerda nutqlar so'zladi, o'z bilimini ko'rsatmoqchi bo'ldi va o'zini pastga tushirdi.

en: …” “Then it’s true?” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: ... Shuning o'zi rostmi? Pulcheria Aleksandrovna baqirib yubordi.

en: “Goodbye till tomorrow, brother,” said Dounia compassionately —“let us go, mother … Goodbye, Rodya.” “Do you hear, sister,” he repeated after them, making a last effort, “I am not delirious; this marriage is —an infamy.
uz: Bugunga qadar saqlanib qoling, aka, dedi Dounia rahmdillik bilan bizdan ketamiz, ona ... Xayr, Rodya. Siz eshityapsizmi, singil, u oxirgi harakat qilib, ularning orqasidan takrorladi,Men delirium emasman; bu nikoh an fahshdir.

en: Let me act like a scoundrel, but you mustn’t … one is enough … and though I am a scoundrel, I wouldn’t own such a sister.
uz: Men bir qaroqchi kabi harakat qilaman, lekin siz buni qilmasligingiz kerak ... bir qaroqchi yetarli ... va men qaroqchi bo'lsam ham, bunday singlimga ega bo'lmasdim.

en: …” “But you’re out of your mind!
uz: Ammo siz aqldan ozgansiz!

en: Despot!” roared Razumihin; but Raskolnikov did not and perhaps could not answer.
uz: Despot! Razumihinni qichqirdi; lekin Raskolnikov javob bermadi va ehtimol javob bera olmagan.

en: He lay down on the sofa, and turned to the wall, utterly exhausted.
uz: Sofa ustiga yotdi va butunlay charchagan holda devor tomon burildi.

en: Avdotya Romanovna looked with interest at Razumihin; her black eyes flashed; Razumihin positively started at her glance.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna Razumihinga qiziqish bilan qaradi; uning qora ko'zlari o'zlashdi; Razumihin uning ko'zlariga ijobiy tarzda boshlandi.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna stood overwhelmed.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna g'alaba qozonib turdi.

en: “Nothing would induce me to go,” she whispered in despair to Razumihin.
uz: Hech narsa meni ketishga undamaydi, - deb o'ylamasdan Razumihinga shovqin qildi u.

en: “I will stay somewhere here … escort Dounia home.” “You’ll spoil everything,” Razumihin answered in the same whisper, losing patience —“come out on to the stairs, anyway.
uz: Men bu yerda bir joyda qolaman ... Douniani uyga eskort qilaman.Siz hamma narsani buzib yuborasiz, Razumihin xuddi shu shovqin bilan javob berdi, sabr-toqatini yo'qotdi Hasta bo'lsa, mertaga chiqing.

en: Nastasya, show a light!
uz: Nastasya, yorug'likni ko'rsating!

en: I assure you,” he went on in a half whisper on the stairs —“that he was almost beating the doctor and me this afternoon!
uz: Sizlarni ishontiraman, u o'rtacha shovqincha mertalarda davom etdiki,u bugun kechqurun shifokor va meni deyarli urmoqchi edi!

en: Even he gave way and left him, so as not to irritate him.
uz: Hatto u ham uni g'azablantirish uchun taslim bo'lib, tashlab ketdi.

en: I remained downstairs on guard, but he dressed at once and slipped off.
uz: Men quchoq ostida qolib, qo'riqchi bo'ldim, lekin u darhol kiyimlarini kiyib, qochib ketdi.

en: And he will slip off again if you irritate him, at this time of night, and will do himself some mischief.
uz: Agar siz uni kechasi shu vaqtda xafa qilsangiz, u yana qochib ketadi va o'ziga zarar yetkazadi.

en: …” “What are you saying?” “And Avdotya Romanovna can’t possibly be left in those lodgings without you.
uz: ... Siz nima deyyapsiz?  Avdotya Romanovna sizsiz o'sha uylarda qoldirilishi mumkin emas.

en: Just think where you are staying!
uz: Qayerda yashayotganingizni o'ylab ko'ring!

en: That blackguard Pyotr Petrovitch couldn’t find you better lodgings … But you know I’ve had a little to drink, and that’s what makes me … swear; don’t mind it.
uz: O'sha qora qo'riqchi Pyotr Petrovitch sizga yaxshiroq joy topa olmagan edi ... Ammo bilamanki, men biroz ichganman va bu meni qasam ichishga undaydi; bu sizga xalaqit bermaydi.

en: …” “But I’ll go to the landlady here,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna insisted, “I’ll beseech her to find some corner for Dounia and me for the night.
uz: Lekin men bu yerdagi uy egasi oldiga boraman, - deya rag'batlantirgan Pulcheria Aleksandrovna, - Men unga Dounia va men uchun kecha uchun burchadan joy topishini iltijo qilaman.

en: I can’t leave him like that, I cannot!” This conversation took place on the landing just before the landlady’s door.
uz: Men uni shunday qoldirolmayman, men bunday qilolmayman! Bu suhbat uy egasining eshigidan biroz oldinda, devorga tushib turgan joyda bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Nastasya lighted them from a step below.
uz: Nastasya ularni pastdagi qadamdan yoritdi.

en: Razumihin was in extraordinary excitement.
uz: Razumihin nihoyatda hayajonli edi.

en: Half an hour earlier, while he was bringing Raskolnikov home, he had indeed talked too freely, but he was aware of it himself, and his head was clear in spite of the vast quantities he had imbibed.
uz: Yarim soat oldin, Raskolnikovni uyga olib kelganida, u juda erkin gapirgan edi, ammo o'zi buni bilar edi va uning g'oyasi katta miqdorda ichganiga qaramay, aniq edi.

en: Now he was in a state bordering on
uz: Endi u o'sha davlatga chegara qiluvchi shtatda edi.

en: ecstasy, and all that he had drunk seemed to fly to his head with redoubled effect.
uz: Ekstasy va ichgan barcha narsalari uning boshiga o'tkazib yuborilganidek tuyuldi.

en: He stood with the two ladies, seizing both by their hands, persuading them, and giving them reasons with astonishing plainness of speech, and at almost every word he uttered, probably to emphasise his arguments, he squeezed their hands painfully as in a vise.
uz: U ikki xonimning qo'lidan ushlab, ularni ishontirib, gapini soddalik bilan tushuntirdi va deyarli har bir so'zidan so'ng, ehtimol o'z dalillarini ta'kidlash uchun, ularning qo'llarini og'riqli tarzda shishirdi.

en: He stared at Avdotya Romanovna without the least regard for good manners.
uz: U Avdotya Romanovnaga yaxshi xulq-atvorga hech qanday e'tibor bermasdan qarab turardi.

en: They sometimes pulled their hands out of his huge bony paws, but far from noticing what was the matter, he drew them all the closer to him.
uz: Ba'zan ular qo'llarini uning ulkan suyak bo'laklaridan chiqarib olishardi, lekin u nima bo'lganini ko'rmay, ularni o'ziga yanada yaqinlashtirdi.

en: If they’d told him to jump head foremost from the staircase, he would have done it without thought or hesitation in their service.
uz: Agar ular unga boshini ustdan pastga ko'tarishni aytishganida, u o'z xizmatida o'ylamasdan va shubha qilmasdan buni qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Though Pulcheria Alexandrovna felt that the young man was really too eccentric and pinched her hand too much, in her anxiety over her Rodya she looked on his presence as providential, and was unwilling to notice all his peculiarities.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna yosh yigitning o'zini juda g'ayritabiiy va qo'lini juda ko'p bosganini his qilgan bo'lsa-da, uning Rodya haqida tashvishlanib, uning hozir bo'lishiga qarab, uning barcha o'ziga xos xususiyatlariga e'tibor berishni istamagan.

en: But though Avdotya Romanovna shared her anxiety, and was not of timorous disposition, she could not see the glowing light in his eyes without wonder and almost alarm.
uz: Ammo Avdotya Romanovna o'z tashvishini baham ko'rsa-da, qo'rqoq emas edi, lekin u uning ko'zidagi nurni hayronlik va deyarli qo'rqinchsiz ko'ra olmadi.

en: It was only the unbounded confidence inspired by Nastasya’s account of her brother’s queer friend, which prevented her from trying to run away from him, and to persuade her mother to do the same.
uz: O'g'lining gayri do'sti haqida Nastasyaning hikoyasidan ilhomlangan cheksiz ishonch uni undan qochishga va onasini ham xuddi shunday qilishga undashdan to'xtatdi.

en: She realised, too, that even running away was perhaps impossible now.
uz: U, hatto qochib ketish ham hozir imkonsiz ekanini tushundi.

en: Ten minutes later, however, she was considerably reassured; it was characteristic of Razumihin that he showed his true nature at once, whatever mood he might be in, so that people quickly saw the sort of man they had to deal with.
uz: Biroq, o'n daqiqadan so'ng u juda tasalli topdi; Razumihinning o'ziga xos xususiyati shundaki, u o'zining haqiqiy tabiatini birdan ko'rsatdi, u qanday holatda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, odamlar qanday odam bilan shug'ullanayotganini tezda ko'rishlari mumkin edi.

en: “You can’t go to the landlady, that’s perfect nonsense!” he cried.
uz: "Sen uy egasiga borolmaysan, bu to'liq g'alati gap!" - deb baqirdi u.

en: “If you stay, though you are his mother, you’ll drive him to a frenzy, and then goodness knows what will happen!
uz: Agar siz uning onasi bo'lsangiz-da, agar qolsangiz, uni g'alatilikka solishingiz mumkin va keyin nima bo'lishini Xudo biladi!

en: Listen, I’ll tell you what I’ll do: Nastasya will stay with him now, and I’ll conduct you both home, you can’t be in the streets alone; Petersburg is an awful place in that way.
uz: Quloq solinglar, Men sizga nima qilishimni aytaman: Nastasya hozir u bilan qoladi va men ikkovingizni uyingizga olib boraman, siz yolg'iz ko'chalarda bo'lishingiz mumkin emas; Sankt-Peterburg o'sha jihatdan dahshatli joy.

en: Then I’ll run straight back here and a quarter of an hour later, on my word of honour, I’ll bring you news how he is, whether he is asleep, and all that.
uz: Keyin men to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bu yerga qaytib boraman va bir chorak soat o'tgach, o'zimning hurmat so'zimga binoan, u qanday ekanligi, uxlayotgan-turmaganligi va hokazo yangiliklarni keltirib beraman.

en: Then I’ll run home in a twinkling —I’ve a lot of friends there, all drunk —I’ll fetch Zossimov —that’s the doctor who is looking after him, he is there, too, but he is not drunk; he is not drunk, he is never drunk!
uz: Keyin men o'zimning uyimga shovqincha yugurib boraman, u yerda ko'plab do'stlarim bor, ularning hammasi ichkilikboz, men Zossimovni olib kelaman, bu unga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan shifokor, u ham bor, lekin u mast emas; u mast emas, u hech qachon mast emas!

en: I’ll drag him to Rodya, and then to you, so that you’ll get two reports in the hour —from the doctor, you understand, from the doctor himself,
uz: Men uni Rodyaga, so'ngra sizga olib boraman, shunda siz bir soat ichida shifokorning, siz tushunasiz, shifokorning o'zidan ikkita hisobot olishingiz mumkin.

en: that’s a very different thing from my account of him!
uz: Bu mening u haqda aytgan so'zlarimdan juda farq qiladi!

en: If there’s anything wrong, I swear I’ll bring you here myself, but, if it’s all right, you go to bed.
uz: Agar biror narsa yomon bo'lsa, qasamki, men sizni shaxsan bu yerga olib kelaman, lekin agar bu yaxshi bo'lsa, siz uxlashga keting.

en: And I’ll spend the night here, in the passage, he won’t hear me, and I’ll tell Zossimov to sleep at the landlady’s, to be at hand.
uz: Kechasi men bu yerda, yo'lda o'tiraman, u meni eshitmaydi va Zossimovga uy egasi uyida uxlashini aytaman.

en: Which is better for him: you or the doctor?
uz: U uchun qaysi narsa yaxshiroq: sizmi yoki shifokormi?

en: But the landlady is out of the question; it’s all right for me, but it’s out of the question for you: she wouldn’t take you, for she’s … for she’s a fool … She’d be jealous on my account of Avdotya Romanovna and of you, too, if you want to know … of Avdotya Romanovna certainly.
uz: Lekin uy egasi bu haqda gapirmaydi; men uchun ham, siz uchun ham: u sizni qabul qilmaydi, chunki u ... o'zi ahmoq... Avdotya Romanovna haqida mening va siz haqingizda ham, agar bilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, Avdotya Romanovna haqida g'ururlanadi.

en: She is an absolutely, absolutely unaccountable character!
uz: U mutlaqo, mutlaqo javobsiz shaxs!

en: But I am a fool, too!
uz: Ammo men ham ahmoqman!

en: Come, do you trust me or not?” “Let us go, mother,” said Avdotya Romanovna, “he will certainly do what he has promised.
uz: Keling, menga ishonasizmi yoki yo'qmi?Biz ketaylik, onam, dedi Avdotya Romanovna,u albatta va'dasini bajaradi.

en: He has saved Rodya already, and if the doctor really will consent to spend the night here, what could be better?” “You see, you … you … understand me, because you are an angel!” Razumihin cried in ecstasy, “let us go!
uz: U allaqachon Rodyani qutqardi va agar shifokor bu yerda kechani o'tkazishga rozi bo'lsa, bundan yaxshiroq nima bo'lishi mumkin?Qaranglar, siz... siz... meni tushunasiz, chunki siz farishtasiz! Razumihin ekstaziy qichqiriq qildi, bizni ketishga ruxsat bering!

en: Fly upstairs and sit with him with a light; I’ll come in a quarter of an hour.” Though Pulcheria Alexandrovna was not perfectly convinced, she made no further resistance.
uz: Yuqoriga uchib, u bilan chiroq bilan o'tiring; men bir chorak soat ichida kelaman. Pulcheria Aleksandrovna to'liq ishontirmagan bo'lsa-da, u boshqa qarshilik ko'rsatmadi.

en: Razumihin gave an arm to each and drew them down the stairs.
uz: Razumihin har bir kishiga qo'l berib, ularni burchakdan tushirdi.

en: He still made her uneasy, as though he was competent and good-natured, was he capable of carrying out his promise?
uz: U hali ham uni noqulay qilib qo'ydi, xuddi o'zi mahoratli va mehribon bo'lgani kabi, va'dasini bajarishga qodirmi?

en: He seemed in such a condition.
uz: U shunday holatda ko'rinardi.

en: … “Ah, I see you think I am in such a condition!” Razumihin broke in upon her thoughts, guessing them, as he strolled along the pavement with huge steps, so that the two ladies could hardly keep up with him, a fact he did not observe, however.
uz: Ah, siz mening bunday holatda ekanligimni o'ylayotganingizni ko'raman! Razumihin yo'l-yo'riqlarini o'ylab, katta qadamlar bilan yo'l-yo'riq bo'ylab yurganida, ikki xonim ham unga sekinlik bilan ergashishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi, lekin u buni kuzatmadi.

en: That is  … I am drunk like a fool, but that’s not it; I am not drunk from wine.
uz: Demak, men ahmoqday mastman, ammo bu o'zi emas; men sharobdan mast emasman.

en: It’s seeing you has turned my head … But don’t mind me!
uz: Sizni ko'rib boshimni burib yubordim... lekin menga hech qanday xalaqit bermang!

en: Don’t take any notice: I am talking nonsense, I am not worthy of you.
uz: Hech qanday e'tibor bermang: men behuda gapiryapman, men sizga munosib emasman.

en: … I am utterly unworthy of you!
uz: ... Men sizdan mutlaqo noloyiqman!

en: The minute I’ve taken you home, I’ll pour a couple of pailfuls of water over my head in the gutter here, and then I shall be all right.
uz: Sizni uyga olib ketganimdan so'ng, men bir necha qadoq suvni boshimga quyaman, keyin men yaxshi bo'laman.

en: … If only you knew how I love you both!
uz: ... Agar siz ham men ikkovingizni qanchalik yaxshi ko'ramanligini bilsangiz edi!

en: Don’t laugh, and don’t be angry!
uz: Qichqirishni ham, g'azablanishni ham istamaysiz!

en: You may be angry with anyone, but not with me!
uz: Siz har kimga g'azablanishingiz mumkin, lekin menga emas!

en: I am his friend, and therefore I am your friend, too, I want to be … I had a presentiment … Last year there was a moment …
uz: Men uning do'stiman va shuning uchun men ham sizning do'stingizman, men ham bo'lishni xohlayman... O'tgan yili o'zimni his qildim...

en: though it wasn’t a presentiment really, for you seem to have fallen from heaven.
uz: Garchi bu aslida his-tuyg'u bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da, chunki siz osmondan tushib qolganingiz ko'rinadi.

en: And I expect I shan’t sleep all night … Zossimov was afraid a little time ago that he would go mad … that’s why he mustn’t be irritated.” “What do you say?” cried the mother.
uz: Va men butun kecha uxlamayman deb o'ylayman ... Zossimov bir muncha vaqt oldin g'alati bo'lishidan qo'rqqan edi ... shuning uchun u g'azablanmasligi kerak.   Nima deysiz? ona yig'ladi.

en: “Did the doctor really say that?” asked Avdotya Romanovna, alarmed.
uz: Doctor haqiqatan ham shunday deganmi? deb so'radi Avdotya Romanovna xavotirlanib.

en: “Yes, but it’s not so, not a bit of it.
uz: Ha, lekin u shunday emas, biroz ham emas.

en: He gave him some medicine, a powder, I saw it, and then your coming here.
uz: U unga dori-darmon, pudrat berdi, men uni ko'rdim va keyin sizning bu yerga kelishingiz.

en: It would have been better if you had come tomorrow.
uz: Agar ertaga kelganingizda yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

en: It’s a good thing we went away.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, ketdik.

en: And in an hour Zossimov himself will report to you about everything.
uz: Va bir soat ichida Zossimovning o'zi sizga hamma narsa haqida xabar beradi.

en: And I shan’t be drunk.
uz: Va men mast bo'lmayman.

en: … And what made me get so tight?
uz: Va nima meni shunchalik qattiq qo'zg'atib qo'ydi?

en: Because they got me into an argument, damn them!
uz: Chunki ular meni bahslashishga majbur qildilar!

en: I’ve sworn never to argue!
uz: Men hech qachon bahslashmaslikka qasam ichganman!

en: They talk such trash!
uz: Ular bunday axloqsiz gaplarni aytishadi!

en: I almost came to blows!
uz: Men deyarli to'qnashdim!

en: I’ve left my uncle to preside.
uz: Men o'g'limni prezidentlikka qoldirdim.

en: Would you believe, they insist on complete absence of individualism and that’s just what they relish!
uz: Ishonasizmi, ular individualistlikning to'liq yo'qlig'ini istaydilar va aynan shundan zavqlanishadi!

en: Not to be themselves, to be as unlike themselves as they can.
uz: Ular o'zlarini emas, o'zlarini iloji boricha boshqacha ko'rishadi.

en: That’s what they regard as the highest point of progress.
uz: Ular buni rivojlanishning eng yuqori nuqtasi deb hisoblashadi.

en: If only their nonsense were their own, but as it is …” “Listen!” Pulcheria Alexandrovna interrupted timidly, but it only added fuel to the flames.
uz: Agar ularning g'alati gaplari o'zlarining g'alati bo'lganida edi, lekin shunday bo'lsa ...  Tinglang! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna qo'rqmasdan to'xtatdi, lekin bu olovga faqat yoqilg'i qo'shdi.

en: “What do you think?” shouted Razumihin, louder than ever, “you think I am attacking them for talking nonsense?
uz: Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz? - deb baqirdi Razumihin, har qachongidan ham baland ovoz bilan. - Sizlar o'ylaysizlarmi, men ularni behuda gapirganlari uchun hujum qilyapman?

en: I like them to talk nonsense.
uz: Men ularning behuda gapirishlarini yaxshi ko'raman.

en: That’s man’s one privilege over all creation.
uz: Bu insoniyatning butun yaratilishdan ustun bo'lgan yagona imtiyozi.

en: Through error you come to the truth!
uz: To'g'ri yo'ldan ozdirish orqali haqiqatga erishasiz!

en: I am a man because I err!
uz: Men erkakman, chunki xato qilaman!

en: You never reach any truth without making fourteen mistakes and very likely a hundred and fourteen.
uz: Siz hech qachon haqiqatga yetib bormaysiz, lekin o'n to'rtta xatoga yo'l qo'ymaysiz va ehtimol yuz o'n to'rtta xatoga yo'l qo'ymaysiz.

en: And a fine thing, too, in its way; but we can’t even make mistakes on our own account!
uz: Va bu o'z yo'lida ham chiroyli narsa; lekin biz o'zimiz uchun xatolar ham qila olmaymiz!

en: Talk nonsense, but talk your own nonsense, and I’ll kiss you for it.
uz: Behuda gapir, lekin o'z behuda gapingni ayt va men seni o'zing uchun o'paman.

en: To go wrong in one’s own way is better than to go right in someone else’s.
uz: O'z yo'lida xato qilish boshqa odamning yo'lida to'g'ri yo'ldan o'tishdan yaxshiroqdir.

en: In the first case you are a man, in the second you’re no better than a bird.
uz: Birinchi holatda siz erkaksiz, ikkinchisida esa qushdan yaxshiroq emassiz.

en: Truth won’t escape you, but life can be cramped.
uz: Haqiqat sizdan qochmaydi, ammo hayot siqilishi mumkin.

en: There have been examples.
uz: Misollar bor.

en: And what are we doing now?
uz: Va biz endi nima qilamiz?

en: In science, development, thought, invention, ideals, aims, liberalism, judgment, experience and everything, everything, everything, we are still in the preparatory class at school.
uz: Ilm-fan, rivojlanish, fikrlash, ixtiro, ideallar, maqsadlar, liberalizm, hukm, tajriba va hamma narsa, hamma narsa, hamma narsa, biz hali ham maktabda tayyorgarlik sinfidamiz.

en: We prefer to live on other people’s ideas, it’s what
uz: Biz boshqa odamlarning g'oyalari asosida yashashni afzal ko'ramiz, shuning uchun bu bizga yoqadi.

en: Am I right, am I right?” cried Razumihin, pressing and shaking the two ladies’ hands.
uz: Men to'g'rimi, to'g'rimi? - deb baqirdi Razumihin, ikkala xonimning qo'llarini siqib, silkitdi.

en: “Oh, mercy, I do not know,” cried poor Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Oh, marhamat, bilmayman, - deb baqirdi kambag'al Pulcheria Aleksandrovna.

en: “Yes, yes … though I don’t agree with you in everything,” added Avdotya Romanovna earnestly and at once uttered a cry, for he squeezed her hand so painfully.
uz: "Ha, ha... men siz bilan hamma narsada rozi bo'lmasam ham", - deb qo'shimcha qildi Avdotya Romanovna. - Avdotya qo'lini og'ir bosganidan keyin u darhol yig'lab yubordi.

en: “Yes, you say yes … well after that you … you …” he cried in a transport, “you are a fount of goodness, purity, sense … and perfection.
uz: Ha, siz "ha" deyasiz ... bundan keyin siz ... siz ... u transportda yig'ladi, siz yaxshilik, soflik, aql-idrok ... va mukammallikning manbai.

en: Give me your hand … you give me yours, too!
uz: Menga qo'lingni ber... menga qo'lingni ham ber!

en: I want to kiss your hands here at once, on my knees …” and he fell on his knees on the pavement, fortunately at that time deserted.
uz: Men sizning qo'lingizni shu zahoti bu yerda, tiz cho'kkanimda o'pishimni istayman ... va u yo'lda tiz cho'kkanida, omad uchun, o'sha paytda tashqarida edi.
