en: Besides, he could not endure uncertainty, and he wanted an explanation: if his request had been so openly disobeyed, there was something behind it, and in that case it was better to find it out beforehand; it rested with him to punish them and there would always be time for that.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u noaniqlikka chidashmagan va tushuntirishni xohlagan: agar uning iltimosi shu qadar ochiq bo'lmagan bo'lsa, uning orqasida biror narsa bor edi va u holda buni oldindan aniqlash yaxshiroq edi; ularni jazolash uning zimmasidadir va buning uchun har doim vaqt bo'ladi.

en: “I trust you had a favourable journey,” he inquired officially of Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Men umid qilamanki, sizda qulay sayohat bo'ldi, deb Pulcheria Aleksandrovnadan rasmiy so'rov oldi.

en: “Oh, very, Pyotr Petrovitch.” “I am gratified to hear it.
uz: Oh, juda, Pyotr Petrovitch.  Men buni eshitishdan mamnunman.

en: And Avdotya Romanovna is not overfatigued either?” “I am young and strong, I don’t get tired, but it was a great strain for mother,” answered Dounia.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna ham charchagan emasmi? "Men yosh va kuchliman, charchamayapman, lekin bu onam uchun juda qiyin edi", - deb javob berdi Dounia.

en: “That’s unavoidable!
uz: Thats inevitable!

en: our national railways are of terrible length.
uz: Milliy temir yo'llarimiz juda uzun.

en: ‘Mother Russia,’ as they say, is a vast country.
uz: Rossiya ona, deyishlariga ko'ra, ulkan mamlakat.

en: … In spite of all my desire to do so, I was unable to meet you yesterday.
uz: ... Bu borada ko'p istaklarimga qaramay, kecha siz bilan uchrashishga muvaffaq bo'lmadim.

en: But I trust all passed off without inconvenience?” “Oh, no, Pyotr Petrovitch, it was all terribly disheartening,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna hastened to declare with peculiar intonation, “and if Dmitri Prokofitch had not been sent us, I really believe by God
uz: Ammo men hamma narsa noqulayliksiz o'tdi deb ishonaman?O, yo'q, Pyotr Petrovitch, bu juda dahshatli edi, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna o'ziga xos intonatsiya bilan e'lon qilishga shoshildi, va agar Dmitriy Prokofitch bizga yuborilmagan bo'lsa edi, men chin dildan Xudoga ishonaman

en: Himself, we should have been utterly lost.
uz: O'zi, biz butunlay yo'qolgan bo'lishimiz kerak edi.

en: Dmitri Prokofitch Razumihin,” she added, introducing him to Luzhin.
uz: Dmitri Prokofitch Razumihin, u qo'shimcha qilib, uni Luzhin bilan tanishtirdi.

en: “I had the pleasure … yesterday,” muttered Pyotr Petrovitch with a hostile glance sidelong at Razumihin; then he scowled and was silent.
uz: Kecha Pyotr Petroviç Razumining yonida dushmanlik bilan ko'z tikib gapirdi, so'ngra o'zini ko'tardi va so'zsiz qoldi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch belonged to that class of persons, on the surface very polite in society, who make a great point of punctiliousness, but who, directly they are crossed in anything, are completely disconcerted, and become more like sacks of flour than elegant and lively men of society.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch o'sha odamlar sinfasiga tegishli edi, ular jamiyatda juda xushmuomala bo'lishadi, ular aniqlik bilan gapirishadi, lekin ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri hech narsa bilan o'zaro bog'liq bo'lib, butunlay g'alati bo'lib, jamiyatning chiroyli va jonli odamlaridan ko'ra ustunlaricha bo'lib qolishadi.

en: Again all was silent; Raskolnikov was obstinately mute, Avdotya Romanovna was unwilling to open the conversation too soon.
uz: Yana hammasi xotirjam edi; Raskolnikov qat'iy so'zsiz edi, Avdotya Romanovna suhbatni juda tez boshlashni xohlamagan edi.

en: Razumihin had nothing to say, so Pulcheria Alexandrovna was anxious again.
uz: Razumihinning aytadigan so'zlari yo'q edi, shuning uchun Pulcheria Aleksandrovna yana tashvishlandi.

en: “Marfa Petrovna is dead, have you heard?” she began having recourse to her leading item of conversation.
uz: Marfa Petrovna vafot etdi, eshitganmisiz? u o'zining asosiy mavzuga murojaat qilishni boshladi.

en: “To be sure, I heard so.
uz: To be sure, I heard so.

en: I was immediately informed, and I have come to make you acquainted with the fact that Arkady Ivanovitch Svidrigaïlov set off in haste for Petersburg immediately after his wife’s funeral.
uz: Men darhol xabardor bo'ldim va sizni Arkadiy Ivanovich Svidrigailov xotini dafn qilinganidan so'ng darhol shoshilinchlik bilan Sankt-Peterburgga jo'nab ketgani haqida xabardor qilish uchun keldim.

en: So at least I have excellent authority for believing.” “To Petersburg?
uz: Shunday qilib, hech bo'lmaganda men ishonish uchun ajoyib vakolatga egaman.Peterburgga?

en: here?” Dounia asked in alarm and looked at her mother.
uz: Bu yerda? Dounia qo'rqinchli so'radi va onasiga qaradi.

en: “Yes, indeed, and doubtless not without some design, having in view the rapidity of his departure, and all the circumstances preceding it.” “Good heavens!
uz: Ha, albatta, va, albatta, uning ketish tezligini va undan oldingi barcha sharoitlarni inobatga olgan holda, ba'zi bir rejalarsiz emas.Yaxshi kunlar!

en: won’t he leave Dounia in peace even here?” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: U hatto bu yerda ham Duniyani tinchlik bilan tark etmaydi-ku? - deb baqirdi Pulcheria Aleksandrovna.

en: “I imagine that neither you nor Avdotya Romanovna have any grounds for uneasiness, unless, of course, you are yourselves desirous of getting into communication with him.
uz: Mening tasavvurimcha, siz ham, Avdotya Romanovna ham u bilan muloqot qilishni xohlamagan bo'lsangiz, u bilan xavotirlanish uchun hech qanday sababingiz yo'q.

en: For my part I am on my guard, and am now discovering where he is lodging.” “Oh, Pyotr Petrovitch, you would not believe what a fright you have given me,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna went on: “I’ve only seen him twice, but I thought him terrible, terrible!
uz: O'z navbatida, men ehtiyot bo'lib turibman va hozir u qaerda yashayotganini aniqlayapman.

en: I am convinced that he was the cause of Marfa Petrovna’s death.” “It’s impossible to be certain about that.
uz: Men Marfa Petrovnovaning o'limiga u sababchi bo'lganligiga aminman.Bu haqda aniq aytish mumkin emas.

en: I have precise information.
uz: Mening aniq ma'lumotlarim bor.

en: I do not dispute that he may have contributed to accelerate the course of events by the moral influence, so to say, of the affront; but
uz: Men uning axloqiy ta'siridan, ya'ni haqoratdan, voqealar jarayonini jadallashtirishga hissa qo'shganini shubha ostiga qo'ymayman; lekin

en: as to the general conduct and moral characteristics of that personage, I am in agreement with you.
uz: Ushbu xarakterning umumiy xulq-atvori va axloqiy xususiyatlari haqida gap ketganda, men siz bilan rozi bo'laman.

en: I do not know whether he is well off now, and precisely what Marfa Petrovna left him; this will be known to me within a very short period; but no doubt here in Petersburg, if he has any pecuniary resources, he will relapse at once into his old ways.
uz: Endi uning farovonligi bor-yo'qligini va Marfa Petrovna unga nima qoldirganini bilmayman; bu haqda men tezda bilib olaman; lekin shubhasiz, bu yerda, Sankt-Peterburgda, agar u pul mablag'lariga ega bo'lsa, u o'zining eski uslublariga qaytadi.

en: He is the most depraved, and abjectly vicious specimen of that class of men.
uz: U o'sha inson sinfining eng fosiq va shafqatsiz namunasidir.

en: I have considerable reason to believe that Marfa Petrovna, who was so unfortunate as to fall in love with him and to pay his debts eight years ago, was of service to him also in another way.
uz: Men sakkiz yil oldin unga muhabbat qilib, qarzini to'lash uchun baxtsiz bo'lgan Marfa Petrovna unga boshqa bir yo'l bilan ham xizmat qilganligiga ishonish uchun jiddiy sabablarga egaman.

en: Solely by her exertions and sacrifices, a criminal charge, involving an element of fantastic and homicidal brutality for which he might well have been sentenced to Siberia, was hushed up.
uz: Faqatgina uning harakatlari va qurbonliklari tufayli, u Sibirga jazolanishi mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib va qotil shafqatsizlik elementini o'z ichiga olgan jinoiy ayblov soʻnib qoldi.

en: That’s the sort of man he is, if you care to know.” “Good heavens!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Agar bilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, u shunday odam.Yomon osmon! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna baqirib yubordi.

en: “Are you speaking the truth when you say that you have good evidence of this?” Dounia asked sternly and emphatically.
uz: Sizda bu borada yaxshi dalillar borligini aytganda rost gapiryapsizmi? Dounia qattiq va qat'iy so'radi.

en: “I only repeat what I was told in secret by Marfa Petrovna.
uz: Men faqat Marfa Petrovna tomonidan sirda aytilgan narsalarni takrorlayman.

en: I must observe that from the legal point of view the case was far from clear.
uz: Shuni ta'kidlashim kerakki, qonuniy nuqtai nazardan bu holat aniq emas edi.

en: There was, and I believe still is, living here a woman called Resslich, a foreigner, who lent small sums of money at interest, and did other commissions, and with this woman Svidrigaïlov had for a long while close and mysterious relations.
uz: Bu yerda Resslich ismli ayol yashardi va hozir ham yashaydi deb o'ylayman, u chet ellik edi, u kichik miqdordagi pulni foizdan qarz olgan va boshqa vositachiliklarni bajargan va Svidrigailov bilan uzoq vaqt davomida yaqin va sirli munosabatlar bo'lgan.

en: She had a relation, a niece I believe, living with her, a deaf and dumb girl of fifteen, or perhaps not more than fourteen.
uz: Uning qarindoshi bor edi, mening fikrimcha, u bilan birga yashaydigan bir singlimiz bor edi, u o'n besh yoshli soqov va o'n to'rt yoshdan ortiq bo'lmagan qiz edi.

en: Resslich hated this girl, and grudged her every crust; she used to beat her mercilessly.
uz: Resslich bu qizdan nafratlangan va uning har bir qornidan nafratlangan; u uni shafqatsiz urgan.

en: One day the girl was found hanging in the garret.
uz: Bir kuni qizni garretda o'g'irlab topishdi.

en: At the inquest the verdict was suicide.
uz: So'rovda hukm o'z joniga qasd qilgan.

en: After the usual proceedings the matter ended, but, later on, information was given that the child had been … cruelly outraged by Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Odatdagi ish jarayonidan so'ng, masala tugadi, ammo keyinchalik bola Svidrigailov tomonidan ... shafqatsiz ravishda g'azablanganligi haqida ma'lumot berildi.

en: It is true, this was not clearly established, the information was given by another German woman of loose character whose word could not be trusted; no statement was actually made to the police, thanks to Marfa Petrovna’s money and exertions; it did not get beyond gossip.
uz: To'g'ri, bu aniq tasdiqlanmagan, ma'lumot boshqa bir nemis ayol tomonidan berilgan edi, uning so'ziga ishonib bo'lmaydi; hech qanday ma'lumotlar politsiyaga chiqarilmagan edi, chunki Marfa Petrovnaning pul va sa'y-harakatlari tufayli; bu g'iybatlardan tashqariga chiqmagan.

en: And yet the story is a very significant one.
uz: Shunga qaramay, hikoya juda muhimdir.

en: You heard, no doubt, Avdotya Romanovna, when you were with them the story of the servant Philip who died of ill treatment he received six years ago, before the abolition of serfdom.”
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, siz ular bilan bo'lganingizda, olti yil oldin, qullikni bekor qilishdan oldin, unga yomon munosabatdan o'tgan xizmatkor Filip haqidagi hikoyani eshitgansiz.

en: “I heard, on the contrary, that this Philip hanged himself.” “Quite so, but what drove him, or rather perhaps disposed him, to suicide was the systematic persecution and severity of Mr.
uz: Aksincha, bu Filip o'zini o'g'irlaganini eshitganman.To'g'ri, lekin uni o'z joniga qasd qilishga undovchi yoki, ehtimol, uni o'z joniga qasd qilishga chorlagan narsa - bu Mr. Filipning muntazam quvg'inlari va qattiqqo'lligi edi.

en: Svidrigaïlov.” “I don’t know that,” answered Dounia, dryly.
uz: Svidrigailov. "Men buni bilmayman", deb javob berdi Dounia, quruq.

en: “I only heard a queer story that Philip was a sort of hypochondriac, a sort of domestic philosopher, the servants used to say, ‘he read himself silly,’ and that he hanged himself partly on account of Mr.
uz: Men faqatgina Filipning o'ziga xos hikoyani eshitdim, u bir xil ipokondriya, bir xil uy falsafasi edi, xodimlar o'zlarini o'qiganini, o'zini axmoqona o'qiganini va o'zini Mr. tufayli qisman asraganini aytishgan.

en: Svidrigaïlov’s mockery of him and not his blows.
uz: Svidrigailovning o'zi uni masxara qiladi, uning urishi emas.

en: When I was there he behaved well to the servants, and they were actually fond of him, though they certainly did blame him for Philip’s death.” “I perceive, Avdotya Romanovna, that you seem disposed to undertake his defence all of a sudden,” Luzhin observed, twisting his lips into an ambiguous smile, “there’s no doubt that he is an astute man, and insinuating where ladies are concerned, of which Marfa Petrovna, who has died so strangely, is a terrible instance.
uz: Men u erda bo'lganimda u xizmatkorlariga yaxshi munosabatda edi va ular unga yoqishgan, ammo Filipning o'limi uchun uni ayblashgan. Avdotya Romanovna, siz uning himoya qilish uchun birdan tayyor bo'lib ko'rinayotganingizni tushunaman, Luzhin e'tibor berdi, dudaklarini ikki xil tabassumga aylantirib, bu erda uning aql-idrokli odam ekanligiga shubha yo'q, va ayollarga nisbatan ishora qilish, bu juda g'alati holatda vafot etgan Marfa Petrovna uchun dahshatli misol.

en: My only desire has been to be of service to you and your mother with my advice, in view of the renewed efforts which may certainly be anticipated from him.
uz: Mening yagona xohishim, u o'z navbatida o'zidan kutiladigan yangiliklarni ko'rib chiqib, sizga va onangizga maslahatlarim bilan xizmat qilish edi.

en: For my part it’s my firm conviction, that he will end in a debtor’s prison again.
uz: Men uchun esa, u yana qarzdorlar qamoqxonasiga o'tirib ketishiga qat'iy ishonaman.

en: Marfa Petrovna had not the slightest intention of settling anything substantial on him, having regard for his children’s interests, and, if she left him anything, it would only be the merest sufficiency, something insignificant and ephemeral, which would not last a year for a man of his habits.” “Pyotr Petrovitch, I beg you,” said Dounia, “say no more of Mr.
uz: Marfa Petrovna bolalarining manfaatlarini ko'zlab, u bilan hech qanday jiddiy masala hal qilmoqchi bo'lmagan va agar u unga biror narsa qoldirsa, bu shunchaki yetarli, ahamiyatsiz va vaqtinchalik narsa bo'ladi, bu uning odatlari bo'lgan odam uchun bir yil ham davom etmaydi.Pyotr Petrovitch, iltimos, dedi Dounia,Mustam Mr. haqida boshqa aytmang.

en: It makes me miserable.” “He has just been to see me,” said Raskolnikov, breaking his silence for the first time.
uz: Bu meni xafa qiladi.U meni ko'rish uchun kelgan, dedi Raskolnikov, birinchi marta ovozini buzdi.

en: There were exclamations from all, and they all turned to him.
uz: Hammasi baland ovoz bilan hayqirdi va hammalari unga yuz o'girdi.

en: Even Pyotr Petrovitch was roused.
uz: Hatto Pyotr Petrovitch ham uyg'onildi.

en: “An hour and a half ago, he came in when I was asleep, waked me, and introduced himself,” Raskolnikov continued.
uz: Bir yarim soat oldin men uxlab yotganimda u kelib, meni uyg'otib, o'zini tanishtirdi, Raskolnikov davom etdi.

en: “He was fairly cheerful and at ease, and quite hopes that we shall become friends.
uz: U juda quvonchli va xotirjam edi va biz do'st bo'lishimizni juda umid qiladi.

en: He is particularly anxious, by the way, Dounia, for an interview with you, at which he asked me to assist.
uz: Ayniqsa, Dounia, u siz bilan intervyu o'tkazishni juda istaydi va menga yordam berishni so'radi.

en: He has a proposition to make to you, and he told me about it.
uz: U sizga taklif qiladi va menga buni aytib berdi.

en: He told me, too, that a week before her
uz: U menga ham buni bir hafta oldin aytdi.

en: death Marfa Petrovna left you three thousand roubles in her will, Dounia, and that you can receive the money very shortly.” “Thank God!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna, crossing herself.
uz: Marfa Petrovna sizga o'lim vasiyatida uch ming rubl qoldirdi, Dounia, va siz pulni juda tezda olishingiz mumkin. Xudoga shukr! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna o'zini o'zi ko'targan holda baqirdi.

en: “Pray for her soul, Dounia!” “It’s a fact!” broke from Luzhin.
uz: Dunia, uning ruhi uchun ibodat qiling!Bu fakt!Luzhindan chiqqan.

en: “Tell us, what more?” Dounia urged Raskolnikov.
uz: Bizga ayt, yana nima? Dounia Raskolnikovni rag'batlantirdi.

en: “Then he said that he wasn’t rich and all the estate was left to his children who are now with an aunt, then that he was staying somewhere not far from me, but where, I don’t know, I didn’t ask.
uz: Keyin u boy emasligini va butun mol-mulkini endi onasi bilan birga bo'lgan farzandlariga qoldirganini, keyin mendan uzoq bo'lmagan joyda yashayotganini, lekin qayerda, bilmayman, so'ramaganimni aytdi.

en: …” “But what, what does he want to propose to Dounia?” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna in a fright.
uz: ... Lekin nima, u Duniyaga nima taklif qilishni xohlaydi? Pulcheria Aleksandrovna qo'rqqan holda baqirdi.

en: “Did he tell you?” “Yes.” “What was it?” “I’ll tell you afterwards.” Raskolnikov ceased speaking and turned his attention to his tea.
uz: U sizga aytganmi?  Ha.  Bu nima edi?  Keyinroq aytib beraman. Raskolnikov gapirishni to'xtatdi va diqqatini choyiga qaratdi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch looked at his watch.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch o'z soatini ko'rdi.

en: “I am compelled to keep a business engagement, and so I shall not be in your way,” he added with an air of some pique and he began getting up.
uz: Men ish bilan band bo'lishga majburman, shuning uchun men sizning yo'lingizda bo'lmasman, dedi u biroz o'z-o'zidan so'ng qo'shimcha qilib, o'rnidan turishni boshladi.

en: “Don’t go, Pyotr Petrovitch,” said Dounia, “you intended to spend the evening.
uz: Don't go, Pyotr Petrovitch, dedi Dounia,siz kechqurun o'tkazishni rejalashtirgan.

en: Besides, you wrote yourself that you wanted to have an explanation with mother.” “Precisely so, Avdotya Romanovna,” Pyotr Petrovitch answered impressively, sitting down again, but still holding his hat.
uz: Bundan tashqari, siz o'zingizga o'zingizning onangiz bilan tushuntirishni xohlayotganingizni yozgansiz. Aynan shunday javob berdi Avdotya Romanovna, Pyotr Petrovitch yana o'tirib, ammo hali ham to'pkasi bilan javob berdi.

en: “I certainly desired an explanation with you and your honoured mother upon a very important point indeed.
uz: Men siz va hurmatli onangiz bilan juda muhim bir masalada tushuntirishni xohladim.

en: But as your brother cannot speak openly in my presence of some proposals of Mr.
uz: Ammo birodaringiz mening huzurimda ochiqchasiga gapira olmaydigan bo'lgani uchun, Mr.ning ba'zi takliflari haqida ochiqchasiga gapira olmaydi.

en: Svidrigaïlov, I, too, do not desire and am not able to speak openly … in the presence of others … of certain matters of the greatest gravity.
uz: Svidrigailov, men ham boshqalarning huzurida eng jiddiy masalalarni ochiqchasiga muhokama qilishni istamayman va qila olmayman.

en: Moreover, my most weighty and urgent request has been disregarded.
uz: Bundan tashqari, eng og'ir va shoshilinch so'rovim e'tiborsiz qoldirildi.

en: …” Assuming an aggrieved air, Luzhin relapsed into dignified silence.
uz: ... Luzhin xafa bo'lgan havoga ega bo'lganini tasavvur qilib, munosib xotirjamlikka tushdi.

en: “Your request that my brother should not be present at our meeting was disregarded solely at my insistance,” said Dounia.
uz: O'g'lim yig'ilishimizga bormasligi haqidagi sizning iltimosingiz faqat mening talabim tufayli rad etildi,  dedi Dounia.

en: “You wrote that you had been insulted by my brother; I think that this must be explained at once, and you must be reconciled.
uz: Siz birodarim tomonidan haqoratlanganingizni yozgan edingiz; men buni darhol tushuntirib berishingiz kerak deb o'ylayman va siz bilan yarashish kerak.

en: And if Rodya really has insulted you, then he should and will apologise.” Pyotr Petrovitch took a stronger line.
uz: Agar Rodya sizni haqoratlagan bo'lsa, u kechirim so'rash kerak va so'radi. Pyotr Petrovitch qat'iy qaror chiqardi.

en: “There are insults, Avdotya Romanovna, which no goodwill can make us forget.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, hech qanday yaxshi niyat bizni unutib qo'yishi mumkin bo'lgan haqoratlar bor.

en: There is a line in everything which it is dangerous to overstep; and when it has been overstepped, there is no return.” “That wasn’t what I was speaking of exactly, Pyotr Petrovitch,” Dounia interrupted with some impatience.
uz: Har bir narsada o'tish xavfli bo'lgan chegara bor; va o'tgach, qaytib ketish yo'q.Men aynan shu haqda gapirmagan edim, Pyotr Petrovitch, Dounia biroz sabrsizlik bilan to'xtatdi.

en: “Please understand that our whole future depends now on whether all this is explained and set right as soon as possible.
uz: Iltimos, keling, butun kelajagimiz hozirning o'zida bularning barchasini tushuntirib, tezroq tuzatishimizga bog'liqligini tushuning.

en: I tell you frankly at the start that I cannot look at it in any other light, and if you have the least regard for me, all this business must be ended today, however hard that may be.
uz: Avvaliga sizlarga ochiqchasiga aytamanki, bu borada boshqa nuqtai nazarga ega bo'lishim mumkin emas va agar siz meni kamroq hurmat qilsangiz, bu ishning barchasi bugun yakunlanishi kerak, qanchalik qiyin bo'lmasin.

en: I repeat that if my brother is to blame he will ask your forgiveness.” “I am surprised at your putting the question like that,” said Luzhin, getting more and more irritated.
uz: Agar akam aybdor bo'lsa, u sizdan kechirim so'raydi, deb takrorlayman.Men savolni shunday so'rashingizga hayronman, dedi Luzhin, ko'proq g'azablanib.

en: “Esteeming, and so to say, adoring you, I may at the same time, very well indeed, be able to dislike some member of your family.
uz: Sizni hurmat qilib, shunday deyish mumkin, sizni sevadigan bo'lsam, shu bilan birga, juda yaxshi, sizning oila a'zolaringizdan ba'zilarini yoqtirmay qolaman.

en: Though I lay claim to the happiness of your hand, I cannot accept duties incompatible with …” “Ah, don’t be so ready to take offence, Pyotr Petrovitch,” Dounia interrupted with feeling, “and be the sensible and generous man I have always considered, and wish to consider, you to be.
uz: Garchi men sizning qo'lingizning baxtiyorligiga e'tirof etsam-da, men ...  Ah, tanqid qilishga shunchalik tayyor bo'lmang, Pyotr Petrovitch, Dounia his-tuyg'ular bilan kesib qo'yildi, va har doim o'ylagandim va o'ylashni xohlagan bo'lgan aqlli va saxiy odam bo'ling.

en: I’ve given you a great promise, I am your betrothed.
uz: Men sizga buyuk va'da berdim, men sizning keliningizman.

en: Trust me in this matter and, believe me, I shall be capable of judging impartially.
uz: Bu masalada menga ishoning va menga ishoning, men yuzxotirchilik qilmasdan hukm qila olaman.

en: My assuming the part of judge is as much a surprise for my brother as for you.
uz: Sudya rolini o'ynashim ukam uchun ham, siz uchun ham ajablanarli emas.

en: When I insisted on his coming to our interview today after your letter, I told him nothing of what I meant to do.
uz: Men sizning maktubingizdan so'ng, uning bugun intervyuga kelishini istayotganimda, nima qilishni rejalashtirganimni unga hech narsa aytmadim.

en: Understand that, if you are not reconciled, I must choose between you —it must be either you or he.
uz: Shuni tushuningki, agar siz yarashmasangiz, men o'zingiz o'rtasida tanlov qilishim kerak, bu siz yoki u bo'lishi kerak.

en: That is how the question rests on your side and on his.
uz: Shunday qilib, savol sizning va uning tomonida turibdi.

en: I don’t want to be mistaken in my choice, and I must not be.
uz: Men o'zimni tanlaganimda xato qilmoqchi emasman va bunday bo'lmasim kerak.

en: For your sake I must break off with my brother, for my brother’s sake I must break off with you.
uz: Sizlar uchun birodarim bilan ajrashishim kerak, birodarim uchun siz bilan ajrashishim kerak.

en: I can find out for certain now whether he is a brother to me, and I want to know it; and of you, whether I am dear to you, whether you esteem me, whether you are the husband for me.” “Avdotya Romanovna,” Luzhin declared huffily, “your words are of too much consequence to me; I will say more, they are offensive in view of the position I have the honour to occupy in relation to you.
uz: Endi u mening akammi yoki xotinimmi, buni bilmoqchiman va sizdan ham, men siz uchun azizmanmi, meni hurmat qilyapsizmi, siz mening erimmi. Avdotya Romanovna, Luzhin shubhasiz,  Sizning so'zlaringiz men uchun juda katta ahamiyatga ega, deb e'lon qildi; yana aytamanki, ular men siz bilan munosabatda bo'lgan sharafni ko'rib, qo'polroqdir.

en: To say nothing of your strange and offensive setting me on a level with an impertinent boy, you admit the possibility of breaking your
uz: O'zingizning g'ayrioddiy va qo'pol munosabatlaringiz bilan meni bir yigit bilan tenglashtirganingizdan tashqari, siz o'zingizning xatti-harakatingizni buzish ehtimoli borligini tan olyapsiz.

en: You say ‘you or he,’ showing thereby of how little consequence I am in your eyes … I cannot let this pass considering the relationship and … the obligations existing between us.” “What!” cried Dounia, flushing.
uz: Siz "siz yoki u", deb aytasiz, shunda men sizning ko'zingizda qanchalik kam ahamiyatga ega ekanligimni ko'rsata olasiz... Bu munosabat va ... biz o'rtasida mavjud bo'lgan majburiyatlarni inobatga olgan holda o'tib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymayman.What! deb qayg'urgan Dounia, ko'tarilgan.

en: “I set your interest beside all that has hitherto been most precious in my life, what has made up the whole of my life, and here you are offended at my making too little account of you.” Raskolnikov smiled sarcastically, Razumihin fidgeted, but Pyotr Petrovitch did not accept the reproof; on the contrary, at every word he became more persistent and irritable, as though he relished it.
uz: Men sizning qiziqishingizni hayotimdagi eng qimmatbaho narsalardan, butun hayotimni tashkil etgan narsalardan tashqarida qo'ydim va bu erda siz men siz haqingizda juda kam gapirganimdan xafa bo'lasiz. Raskolnikov sarkastika bilan tabassum qildi, Razumihin g'ayratga to'ldi, lekin Pyotr Petrovitch tanbehni qabul qilmadi; aksincha, har bir so'z bilan u yanada chidamli va g'azablanarli bo'ldi, xuddi undan zavqlanayotgandek.

en: “Love for the future partner of your life, for your husband, ought to outweigh your love for your brother,” he pronounced sententiously, “and in any case I cannot be put on the same level.
uz: O'g'lingizga bo'ladigan sevgini, eringizga bo'lgan sevgingizni o'zingizning birodaringizga bo'lgan sevgingizdan ustun qo'yishingiz kerak, - dedi u so'zlar bilan, - va hech bo'lmaganda men ham xuddi shunday darajada bo'lmasam kerak.

en: … Although I said so emphatically that I would not speak openly in your brother’s presence, nevertheless, I intend now to ask your honoured mother for a necessary explanation on a point of great importance closely affecting my dignity.
uz: ... Garchi men sizlarning birodaringiz oldida ochiqchasiga gapirmasligimni aytmagan bo'lsam-da, hozir sizlarning hurmatli onangizdan mening qadr-qimmatimga jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan muhim bir masalada kerakli tushuntirish so'rashni xohlayman.

en: Your son,” he turned to Pulcheria Alexandrovna, “yesterday in the presence of Mr.
uz: Sizning o'g'lingiz Pulcheria Aleksandrovnaga murojaat qildi, o'tgan kuni Mr. Alexandrovna huzurida.

en: Razsudkin (or … I think that’s it?
uz: Razsudkin (yoki... shuni o'ylaymanmi?

en: excuse me I have forgotten your surname)” (he bowed politely to Razumihin) “insulted me by misrepresenting the idea I expressed to you in a private conversation, drinking coffee, that is, that marriage with a poor girl who has had experience of trouble is more advantageous from the conjugal point of view than with one who has lived in luxury, since it is more profitable for the moral character.
uz: Kechirasiz, familiyangizni unutib qo'ydim) (u xushmuomalalik bilan Razumihinga sajda qildi) Siz bilan shaxsiy suhbatda, kofe ichib, sizga bildirgan fikrimni noto'g'ri ifoda etib, meni haqoratladi, ya'ni muammolarni boshdan kechirgan kambag'al qiz bilan turmush qurish turmush nuqtai nazaridan arziydiganidan ko'proq foydalidir, chunki bu axloqiy xarakter uchun foydaliroq.

en: Your son intentionally exaggerated the significance of my words and made them ridiculous, accusing me of malicious intentions, and, as far as I could see, relied upon your correspondence with him.
uz: O'g'lingiz mening so'zlarim ma'nosini qasddan o'lchab, ularni masxara qilib, meni yomon niyatlar bilan aybladi va, ko'rib turganimcha, u bilan yozishma munosabatlaringizga tayanadi.

en: I shall consider myself happy, Pulcheria Alexandrovna, if it is possible for you to convince me of an opposite conclusion, and thereby considerately reassure me.
uz: O'zimni baxtli deb hisoblayman, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna, agar siz menga qarama-qarshi xulosaga kelishingizga ishonch hosil qilishingiz mumkin bo'lsa, va shu yo'sin meni muloyimlik bilan xotirjam qilishingiz mumkin.

en: Kindly let me know in what terms precisely you repeated my words in your letter to Rodion Romanovitch.” “I don’t remember,” faltered Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Rodion Romanovitchga yozgan maktubingizda aytgan so'zlarimni nimaga to'g'ri ta'riflaganingizni menga bildiring.Men eslay olmayman, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna g'ayratga tushdi.

en: “I repeated them as I understood them.
uz: Men ularni tushunishimcha takrorladim.

en: I don’t know how Rodya repeated them to you, perhaps he exaggerated.” “He could not have exaggerated them, except at your instigation.”
uz: Rodya ularni sizga qanday takrorlaganini bilmayman, ehtimol u haddan oshgan.Sizning qo'zg'atishingizdan tashqari, u ularni haddan oshirib bo'lmaydi.

en: “Pyotr Petrovitch,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna declared with dignity, “the proof that Dounia and I did not take your words in a very bad sense is the fact that we are here.” “Good, mother,” said Dounia approvingly.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch,Pulcheria Aleksandrovna munosib ravishda: Dunia va men sizning so'zlaringizni yomon ma'noda qabul qilmaganligimizni isbotlovchi dalil - bu bizning hozir bo'lishimizdir.Yaxshi, onam, dedi Dounia rozilik bilan.

en: “Then this is my fault again,” said Luzhin, aggrieved.
uz: Shuning o'rniga bu yana mening aybim, dedi Luzhin, xafa bo'lib.

en: “Well, Pyotr Petrovitch, you keep blaming Rodion, but you yourself have just written what was false about him,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna added, gaining courage.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, siz Rodionni ayblashni davom ettiryapsiz, lekin siz o'zingiz u haqida yolg'on gaplarni yozgansiz, - dedi Pulcheria Aleksandrovna va jasoratni qo'lga kiritdi.

en: “I don’t remember writing anything false.” “You wrote,” Raskolnikov said sharply, not turning to Luzhin, “that I gave money yesterday not to the widow of the man who was killed, as was the fact, but to his daughter (whom I had never seen till yesterday).
uz: Men hech qanday yolg'on yozishni eslay olmayman.Siz yozgansiz, Raskolnikov Luzhinga murojaat qilmay, keskinlik bilan aytdi,ki men kecha pulni o'ldirilgan kishining bechoriga emas, balki uning qiziga bergan edim (men uni kechaga qadar ko'rmagan edim).

en: You wrote this to make dissension between me and my family, and for that object added coarse expressions about the conduct of a girl whom you don’t know.
uz: Siz buni men va oilam o'rtasida kelishmovchiliklarni keltirish uchun yozgansiz va shu maqsadda tanimagan qizning xulq-atvori haqida qo'pol so'zlar qo'shgansiz.

en: All that is mean slander.” “Excuse me, sir,” said Luzhin, quivering with fury.
uz: Bu faqat haqoratdir. Xullas, xo'jayinim, dedi Luzhin, g'azabdan titrab.

en: “I enlarged upon your qualities and conduct in my letter solely in response to your sister’s and mother’s inquiries, how I found you, and what impression you made on me.
uz: Men sizning fazilatlaringiz va xulq-atvoringizni maktubimda faqatgina singillaringiz va onangizning so'rovlariga javob sifatida kengaytirdim, sizni qanday topdim va menga qanday taassurot qoldirdingiz.

en: As for what you’ve alluded to in my letter, be so good as to point out one word of falsehood, show, that is, that you didn’t throw away your money, and that there are not worthless persons in that family, however unfortunate.” “To my thinking, you, with all your virtues, are not worth the little finger of that unfortunate girl at whom you throw stones.” “Would you go so far then as to let her associate with your mother and sister?” “I have done so already, if you care to know.
uz: Men maktubimda aytganingiz uchun bir so'z yolg'on ekanini ko'rsatishga harakat qiling, ya'ni pulingizni tashlamaganingizni ko'rsating va bu oilada hech qanday behuda odamlar yo'qligini ko'rsating.Men o'ylaymanki, siz barcha fazilatlaringiz bilan birga, tosh tashlagan behuda qizning kichkina barmog'iga ham arzimaydigansiz.Siz uni onangiz va singillaringiz bilan bog'lashga ruxsat berishingiz mumkinmi? Agar bilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, men buni allaqachon qildim.

en: I made her sit down today with mother and Dounia.” “Rodya!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Men uni bugun onasi va Dounia bilan o'tirtirtirishga majbur qildim.Rodya! Pulcheria Alexandrovna o'zicha baqirdi.

en: Dounia crimsoned, Razumihin knitted his brows.
uz: Dounia qizargan, Razumihin ko'z burchaklarini tikgan.

en: Luzhin smiled with lofty sarcasm.
uz: Luzhin baland sarkasm bilan tabassum qildi.

en: “You may see for yourself, Avdotya Romanovna,” he said, “whether it is possible for us to agree.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, siz o'zingiz ko'rishingiz mumkin, - dedi u, - biz bu haqda kelishuvga erishish mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi.

en: I hope now that this question is at an end, once and for all.
uz: Umid qilamanki, endi bu savol birdan-boshqa tugagandir.

en: I will withdraw, that I may not hinder the pleasures of family intimacy, and the discussion of secrets.” He got up from his chair and took his hat.
uz: Oilaviy yaqinlik va sirlar to'g'risida suhbatning zavq-shafqatlariga xalaqit bermasligim uchun orqaga chiqaman. U o'rindiqidan turib, to'pini olib ketdi.

en: “But in withdrawing, I venture to request that for the future I may be spared similar meetings, and, so to say, compromises.
uz: Ammo o'zimni chetlatib ketayotganimda, kelajakda o'xshash uchrashuvlar va, demak, kompromislar bo'lmasligi uchun iltimos qilishga jur'at qilaman.

en: I appeal particularly to you, honoured
uz: Xususan, sizlarga murojaat qilaman, hurmatli kishilar

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna, on this subject, the more as my letter was addressed to you and to no one else.” Pulcheria Alexandrovna was a little offended.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna, bu mavzuda maktubim sizga va boshqa hech kimga yozilmaganidan ko'ra ko'proq. Pulcheria Aleksandrovna biroz xafa bo'ldi.

en: “You seem to think we are completely under your authority, Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: Siz bizni butunlay sizning hokimiyatingiz ostida deb o'ylaysiz, Pyotr Petrovitch.

en: Dounia has told you the reason your desire was disregarded, she had the best intentions.
uz: Dounia sizning xohishingizni e'tiborsiz qoldirishining sababini aytib berdi, chunki u eng yaxshi niyatlar ila qilgan edi.

en: And indeed you write as though you were laying commands upon me.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, siz menga amrlar berganingiz kabi yozasiz.

en: Are we to consider every desire of yours as a command?
uz: Sizning har bir istakingizni buyruq sifatida ko'rib chiqamizmi?

en: Let me tell you on the contrary that you ought to show particular delicacy and consideration for us now, because we have thrown up everything, and have come here relying on you, and so we are in any case in a sense in your hands.” “That is not quite true, Pulcheria Alexandrovna, especially at the present moment, when the news has come of Marfa Petrovna’s legacy, which seems indeed very apropos, judging from the new tone you take to me,” he added sarcastically.
uz: Aksincha, sizga aytamanki, siz hozir biz uchun alohida muloyimlik va e'tibor ko'rsatishingiz kerak, chunki biz hamma narsani tashlab yubordik va bu yerga sizga tayanib keldik va shuning uchun biz har qanday ma'noda sizning qo'lingizdamiz.Bu to'liq haqiqat emas, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna, ayniqsa hozirgi paytda, Marfa Petrovnaning merosi haqida xabarlar kelganida, bu, albatta, menga qabul qilayotgan yangi so'zingizga qarab juda mos tuyuladi. U sarkastika bilan qo'shib qo'ydi.

en: “Judging from that remark, we may certainly presume that you were reckoning on our helplessness,” Dounia observed irritably.
uz: Bu so'zlardan kelib chiqqan holda, siz bizning kuchsizligimizni hisobga olganingizni taxmin qilishimiz mumkin, - dedi Dounia g'azabga to'lib.

en: “But now in any case I cannot reckon on it, and I particularly desire not to hinder your discussion of the secret proposals of Arkady Ivanovitch Svidrigaïlov, which he has entrusted to your brother and which have, I perceive, a great and possibly a very agreeable interest for you.” “Good heavens!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Ammo endi hech qanday holatda bunga umid bog'lay olmayman va ayniqsa Arkadiy Ivanovich Svidrigailovning birodaringizga ishonib topshirgan va siz uchun katta va ehtimol juda yoqimli qiziqish ko'rsatgan sirli takliflari haqida suhbatingizga to'sqinlik qilmaslikni xohlayman.Yaxshi osmonlar! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna xitob qildi.

en: Razumihin could not sit still on his chair.
uz: Razumihin o'z kursi ustida to'xtab o'tirolmadi.

en: “Aren’t you ashamed now, sister?” asked Raskolnikov.
uz: - Endi uyatga qolmadingmi, singlim? - deb so'radi Raskolnikov.

en: “I am ashamed, Rodya,” said Dounia.
uz: Men uyatdaman, Rodya, dedi Dounia.

en: “Pyotr Petrovitch, go away,” she turned to him, white with anger.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, ket, u g'azabdan oqib, unga qarab ketdi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch had apparently not at all expected such a conclusion.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, ehtimol, bunday xulosaga kelishni kutmagan.

en: He had too much confidence in himself, in his power and in the helplessness of his victims.
uz: U o'ziga, o'z qudratiga va o'z qurbonlarining yordamsizligiga juda ko'p ishonardi.

en: He could not believe it even now.
uz: Hatto hozir ham unga ishonolmadi.

en: He turned pale, and his lips quivered.
uz: U o'zgarib ketdi va tili titraydi.

en: “Avdotya Romanovna, if I go out of this door now, after such a dismissal, then, you may reckon on it, I will never come back.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, agar men bunday ishdan bo'shatilganimdan keyin hozir bu eshikdan chiqib ketsam, o'sha paytga hech qachon qaytib kelmayman, deb o'ylaysiz.

en: Consider what you are doing.
uz: Nima qilayotganingizni o'ylab ko'ring.

en: My word is not to be shaken.” “What insolence!” cried Dounia, springing up from her seat.
uz: Mening so'zim silkitilmasligi kerak.Bu qanday ahmoqlik! - dedi Dounia o'rindiqidan chiqqach.

en: “I don’t want you to come back again.”
uz: Men sizning yana qaytishingizni xohlamayman.

en: So that’s how it stands!” cried Luzhin, utterly unable to the last moment to believe in the rupture and so completely thrown out of his reckoning now.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu shunday! - deb baqirdi Luzhin, bu parchaga ishonib, so'nggi kungacha ishonib bo'lmadi va hozir esa o'z hisobidan butunlay tashlab ketildi.

en: “So that’s how it stands!
uz: Shuning uchun bu holat shunday!

en: But do you know, Avdotya Romanovna, that I might protest?” “What right have you to speak to her like that?” Pulcheria Alexandrovna intervened hotly.
uz: Ammo bilmaysizmi, Avdotya Romanovna, men bunga qarshilik ko'rsatishim mumkin?Sizda unga shunday gapirish huquqi bormi? Pulcheria Aleksandrovna qizg'in aralashib oldi.

en: “And what can you protest about?
uz: Va siz nimaga qarshi protest qila olasiz?

en: What rights have you?
uz: Sizda qanday huquqlar bor?

en: Am I to give my Dounia to a man like you?
uz: Men douniaimni sen kabi odamga beramanmi?

en: Go away, leave us altogether!
uz: Yo'qolinglar, bizni butunlay qoldiringlar!

en: We are to blame for having agreed to a wrong action, and I above all.
uz: Biz noto'g'ri harakatga rozi bo'lganimiz uchun aybdormiz va eng asosiysi men.

en: …” “But you have bound me, Pulcheria Alexandrovna,” Luzhin stormed in a frenzy, “by your promise, and now you deny it and … besides … I have been led on account of that into expenses.
uz: Ammo siz meni bog'lab qo'ydingiz, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna, Luzhin sizning va'dangiz bilan g'azabga tushdi va endi siz buni inkor qilyapsiz va ... bundan tashqari ... men bu tufayli xarajatlarga tushdim.

en: …” This last complaint was so characteristic of Pyotr Petrovitch, that Raskolnikov, pale with anger and with the effort of restraining it, could not help breaking into laughter.
uz: ... Ushbu oxirgi shikoyat Pyotr Petrovitchning o'ziga xos xususiyati bo'lgan, Raskolnikov g'azabdan o'zidan-o'zidan puchga chiqib, uni to'xtatishga harakat qilib, kulgiga tushdi.

en: But Pulcheria Alexandrovna was furious.
uz: Ammo Pulcheria Aleksandrovna g'azabga to'ldi.

en: Are you speaking of our trunk?
uz: Siz bizning quti haqida gapiryapsizmi?

en: But the conductor brought it for nothing for you.
uz: Ammo konduktor uni sizga bepul olib keldi.

en: Mercy on us, we have bound you!
uz: Bizga rahm qil, biz seni bog'lab qo'ydik!

en: What are you thinking about, Pyotr Petrovitch, it was you bound us, hand and foot, not we!” “Enough, mother, no more please,” Avdotya Romanovna implored.
uz: Nima haqida o'ylayapsan, Pyotr Petrovitch, bizni sen bog'lading, biz emas, qo'l va oyoq!Yetiq, ona, endi hech narsa yo'q, Avdotya Romanovna iltijo qildi.

en: “Pyotr Petrovitch, do be kind and go!” “I am going, but one last word,” he said, quite unable to control himself.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, mehribon bo'lib keting!Men ketyapman, lekin so'nggi bir so'z, dedi, o'zini tuta olmay.

en: “Your mamma seems to have entirely forgotten that I made up my mind to take you, so to speak, after the gossip of the town had spread all over the district in regard to your reputation.
uz: Omang sizni olib ketishga qaror qilganimni butunlay unutib qo'ygan ko'rinadi, chunki sizning obro'ingiz haqida shaharning mish-mishlari butun tuman bo'ylab tarqalgan edi.

en: Disregarding public opinion for your sake and reinstating your reputation, I certainly might very well reckon on a fitting return, and might indeed look for gratitude on your part.
uz: Sizning foydangiz uchun jamoatchilik fikrini e'tiborsiz qoldirib, sizning obro'ingizni tiklash uchun, albatta, men o'zingizga munosib javobni kutishim mumkin va sizdan minnatdorchilik izlashim mumkin.

en: And my eyes have only now been opened!
uz: Va ko'zlarim faqat endi ochildi!

en: I see myself that I may have acted very, very recklessly in disregarding the universal verdict.
uz: O'zimni shunday ko'ramanki, men jahon hukmini e'tiborsiz qoldirib, juda, juda befarqlik bilan harakat qilgan bo'lishim mumkin.

en: …” “Does the fellow want his head smashed?” cried Razumihin, jumping up.
uz: ... Shunaqa odam boshini sindirishni istaymi? - deb baqirdi Razumihin, ko'tarib o'tadi.

en: “You are a mean and spiteful man!” cried Dounia.
uz: "Sen yomon va yomon odamsan!" - deb qayg'urdi Dounia.

en: Not a movement!” cried Raskolnikov, holding Razumihin back; then going close up to Luzhin, “Kindly leave the room!” he said quietly and distinctly, “and not a word more or …”
uz: Hech qanday harakat yo'q! - deb baqirdi Raskolnikov, Razumihinni orqaga ushlab, keyin Luzhinga yaqinlashib, xonadan chiqib ketish uchun harakat qildi. - U xotirjam va aniq so'zladi: - Va bir so'z ham ko'proq yo'q...

en: Pyotr Petrovitch gazed at him for some seconds with a pale face that worked with anger, then he turned, went out, and rarely has any man carried away in his heart such vindictive hatred as he felt against Raskolnikov.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch bir necha soniya davomida g'azabga to'lib-toshgan, ko'rinmas yuz bilan unga qaradi, so'ngra o'girilib, tashqariga chiqadi va kamdan-kamda hech bir kishi o'z yuragida Raskolnikovga nisbatan his qilgan o'zini shunday qasosga botgan nafratni ko'tarib yuradi.

en: Him, and him alone, he blamed for everything.
uz: U hamma narsada faqat o'zini aybladi.

en: It is noteworthy that as he went downstairs he still imagined that his case was perhaps not utterly lost, and that, so far as the ladies were concerned, all might “very well indeed” be set right again.
uz: Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, u pastga tushib ketganda hali ham o'z da'vosi to'liq yo'q bo'lganini va ayollar uchun hamma narsa o'zgarishi mumkinligini tasavvur qilgan.

en: III The fact was that up to the last moment he had never expected such an ending; he had been overbearing to the last degree, never dreaming that two destitute and defenceless women could escape from his control.
uz: III Aslida, u oxirgi kungacha bunday yakunni kutmagan edi; u o'zining eng katta darajada hukmronlik qilgan edi, hech qachon ikki qashshoq va himoyasiz ayol uning nazoratidan qochib ketishi mumkinligini orzu qilmagan edi.

en: This conviction was strengthened by his vanity and conceit, a conceit to the point of fatuity.
uz: Bu e'tiqod uning behudaligi va mag'rurligi bilan mustahkamlandi, bu mag'rurligi o'ta g'alati bo'ldi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch, who had made his way up from insignificance, was morbidly given to self- admiration, had the highest opinion of his intelligence and capacities, and sometimes even gloated in solitude over his image in the glass.
uz: Bitta ahamiyatsizlikdan o'z yo'lini topgan Pyotr Petrovitch o'ziga befarq emasdi, o'ziga hurmat ko'rsatardi, o'zining aqli va qobiliyati haqida eng yuqori fikrda edi va ba'zan hatto o'zicha ko'rinishda bo'lgan tasvirini ko'rib yolg'izlikda xursand bo'lgan.

en: But what he loved and valued above all was the money he had amassed by his labour, and by all sorts of devices: that money made him the equal of all who had been his superiors.
uz: Ammo u eng ko'p narsani yaxshi ko'rgan va qadrlagan narsa - o'z mehnatidan va turli usullar bilan to'plangan pul edi: bu pul uni o'z boshlig'i bo'lgan barchaga tenglashtirgan.

en: When he had bitterly reminded Dounia that he had decided to take her in spite of evil report, Pyotr Petrovitch had spoken with perfect sincerity and had, indeed, felt genuinely indignant at such “black ingratitude.” And yet, when he made Dounia his offer, he was fully aware of the groundlessness of all the gossip.
uz: U yomon xabarga qaramay, uni olib ketishga qaror qilganini Douniaga qattiq eslatganida, Pyotr Petrovitch mukammal samimiylik bilan gapirgan va bunday "qizil noqulaylik"ga chindan ham g'azablangan edi. Biroq, Douniaga taklif qilganida, u barcha g'iybatlarning asossizligini to'liq tushunib yetgan.

en: The story had been everywhere contradicted by Marfa Petrovna, and was by then disbelieved by all the townspeople, who were warm in Dounia’a defence.
uz: Bu hikoya har joyda Marfa Petrovna tomonidan tanqid qilingan edi va o'sha paytga kelib butun shahar aholisi tomonidan ishonilmagan edi, chunki ular Dounia himoyasida iliq edilar.

en: And he would not have denied that he knew all that at the time.
uz: Va u o'sha paytda bularning barchasini bilishini inkor qilmagan.

en: Yet he still thought highly of his own resolution in lifting Dounia to his level and regarded it as something heroic.
uz: Ammo u hali ham Duniyani o'z darajasiga ko'tarishda o'z qarorini yuqori baholadi va uni qahramonlik deb hisobladi.

en: In speaking of it to Dounia, he had let out the secret feeling he cherished and admired, and he could not understand that others should fail to admire it too.
uz: Douniaga bu haqda gapirganida, u o'zi qadrlagan va hayratda qoldirgan sirli tuyg'ularni oshkor etgan va boshqalarning ham bu tuyg'ularni hayratda qoldirishlari kerakligini tushunmagan.

en: He had called on Raskolnikov with the feelings of a benefactor who is about to reap the fruits of his good deeds and to hear agreeable flattery.
uz: U Raskolnikovni yaxshilik qilgan kishi kabi his-tuyg'ular bilan chaqirgan edi, u yaxshiliklarining mevalarini o'rib, yoqimli maqtanishlarni eshitishga tayyor.

en: And as he went downstairs now, he considered himself most undeservedly injured and unrecognised.
uz: Endi pastga tushib ketayotganda, u o'zini eng o'ziga yaralgan va tanilmagan deb hisoblagan.

en: Dounia was simply essential to him; to do without her was unthinkable.
uz: Dounia u uchun juda muhim edi; usiz yashash ham mumkin emas edi.

en: For many years he had had voluptuous dreams of marriage, but he had gone on waiting and amassing money.
uz: Ko'p yillar davomida u turmush qurishni orzu qilib yurgan edi, lekin u kutishni davom ettirib, pul yig'ib olgan edi.

en: He brooded with relish, in profound secret, over the image of a girl — virtuous, poor (she must be poor), very young, very pretty, of good birth and education, very timid, one who had suffered much, and was completely humbled before him, one who would all her life look on him as her saviour, worship him, admire him and only him.
uz: O'zi o'ziga xos fazilatli, kambag'al, juda yosh, juda chiroyli, yaxshi tug'ilgan va ta'lim olgan, juda qo'rqinchli, ko'p azob chekkan va uning oldida mutlaqo kamtarin bo'lgan, butun hayoti davomida uni qutqaruvchisi sifatida ko'rib, Unga sajda qiladigan, Unga va faqat Unga e'zoz bildiradigan bir qizning tasvirini chuqur sirda o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: How many scenes, how many amorous episodes he had imagined on this seductive and playful theme, when his work was over!
uz: Uning ishi tugaganidan so'ng, u bu jozibador va o'yinli mavzuda ko'pgina sahnalar, ko'pgina ishqiy hodisalarni tasavvur qilgan edi!

en: And, behold, the dream of so many years was all but realised; the beauty and education of Avdotya Romanovna had impressed him; her helpless position had been a great allurement; in her he had found even more than he dreamed of.
uz: Mana, shuncha yillar orzu amalga oshdi; Avdotya Romanovnaning go'zalligi va ta'limi unga ta'sir qildi; uning yordamsiz o'rnagi juda yoqimli edi; u ayolda u orzu qilganidan ham ko'proq narsani topdi.

en: Here was a girl of pride, character, virtue, of education and breeding superior to his own (he felt that), and this creature would be slavishly grateful all her life for his heroic condescension, and would humble herself in the dust before him, and he would have absolute, unbounded power over her!
uz: Bu yerda mag'rur, xarakterli, fazilatli, o'zidan ustun bo'lgan ta'lim va tarbiyaga ega bo'lgan qiz bor edi (u shunday his qilgan), va bu yaratilish o'z hayoti davomida uning g'ayratli kamtarligi uchun qullik bilan minnatdor bo'lib, uning oldida tuproqda o'zini past olib, uning ustidan mutlaq, cheksiz kuchga ega bo'ladi!

en: … Not long before, he had, too, after long reflection and hesitation, made an important change in his career and was now entering on a wider circle of business.
uz: ... Bundan ko'p vaqt o'tmay, u ham uzoq mulohaza va shubha ostidan karyerasida muhim o'zgarish kiritdi va endi keng biznes doirasini boshlagan.

en: With this change his cherished dreams of rising into a higher class of society seemed likely to be realised.
uz: Ushbu o'zgarish bilan uning yuqori darajadagi jamiyatga o'tish haqidagi orzulari amalga oshdi.

en: … He was, in fact, determined to try his fortune in Petersburg.
uz: Aslida, u Sankt-Peterburgda omadini sinab ko'rishga qat'iy qaror qildi.

en: He knew that women could do a very great deal.
uz: U ayollarning juda ko'p narsani qila olishini bilardi.

en: The fascination of a charming, virtuous, highly educated woman might make his way easier, might do wonders in attracting people to him, throwing an aureole round him, and now everything was in ruins!
uz: Chiroyli, fazilatli, oliy ma'lumotli ayolning mashhurligi uning yo'lini osonlashtirishi mumkin, odamlarni jalb qilishda mo'ʼjizalar yaratishi mumkin, uning atrofida auroraol tashlashi mumkin va endi hamma narsa vayron bo'lgan!

en: This sudden horrible rupture affected him like a clap of thunder; it was like a hideous joke, an absurdity.
uz: Bu dahshatli, qo'rqinchli o'zgarish uni momaqaldiroq kabi ta'sir qildi; bu dahshatli hazil, absurdlik kabi edi.

en: He had only been a tiny bit masterful, had not even time to speak out, had simply made a joke, been carried away —and it had ended so seriously.
uz: U biroz ustunlik ko'rsatdi, hatto gapirishga ham vaqt bo'lmadi, shunchaki kulgi qildi, o'ziga ergashib ketdi va bu juda jiddiy yakunlandi.

en: And, of course, too, he did love Dounia in his own way; he already possessed her in his dreams —and all at once!
uz: Va, albatta, u ham Douniyani o'z yo'lida sevgan; u allaqachon uni tushlarida ega bo'lgan va bir vaqtning o'zida!

en: The next day, the very next day, it must all be set right, smoothed over, settled.
uz: Ertasi kuni, ertasi kuni, hamma narsa to'g'rilash, tekislash, tuzatish kerak.

en: Above all he must crush that conceited milksop who was the cause of it all.
uz: Eng asosiysi, bularning barchasining sababchisi bo'lgan o'zboshimchalik bilan ko'ngilxush bo'lgan sutni cho'kishi kerak.

en: With a sick feeling he could not help recalling Razumihin too, but, he soon reassured himself on that score; as though a fellow like that could be put on a level with him!
uz: U kasal hissi bilan Razumihinni ham eslay olmagan edi, lekin u tez orada o'zini o'zi bilan o'sha holatda tasalli topgan; xuddi o'sha kabi odam unga teng bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidek!

en: The man he really dreaded in earnest was Svidrigaïlov.
uz: U chindan ham qo'rqqan odam Svidrigailov edi.

en: … He had, in short, a great deal to attend to.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, u ko'p ishlarni bajarishi kerak edi.

en: … “No, I, I am more to blame than anyone!” said Dounia, kissing and embracing her mother.
uz: "Yo'q, men, hech kimdan ko'ra men aybdorman!" - dedi Dounia, onasini o'pib quchoqlab.

en: “I was tempted by his money, but on my honour, brother, I had no idea he was such a base man.
uz: Uning pullari meni vasvasaga solgan edi, lekin men uchun sharaf, aka, uning bunday yomon odam ekani haqida hech o'ylamagan edim.

en: If I had seen through him before, nothing would have tempted me!
uz: Agar men undan oldin ko'rgan bo'lsam, hech narsa meni vasvasaga solmasdi!

en: Don’t blame me, brother!” “God has delivered us!
uz: Meni ayblamang, aka! Xudo bizni qutqardi!

en: God has delivered us!” Pulcheria Alexandrovna muttered, but half consciously, as though scarcely able to realise what had happened.
uz: Xudo bizni qutqardi! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna g'iybat qildi, lekin yarim bilmasdan, nima sodir bo'lganini anglab yetmayotgandek.

en: They were all relieved, and in five minutes they were laughing.
uz: Hammasi tasalli topdi va besh daqiqadan so'ng ular kulishdi.

en: Only now and then Dounia turned white and frowned, remembering what had passed.
uz: Faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan Dounia o'tmishdagi voqealarni eslab, oq va ko'z o'g'rilib ketdi.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna was surprised to find that she, too, was glad: she had only that morning thought rupture with Luzhin a terrible misfortune.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna o'zi ham xursand bo'lganini bilib, hayron qoldi: faqat o'sha kuni ertalab Luzhin bilan bo'lgan ajralish o'ziga yomon baxtsizlik deb o'yladi.

en: Razumihin was delighted.
uz: Razumihin juda xursand edi.

en: He did not yet dare to express his joy fully, but he was in a fever of excitement as though a ton-weight had fallen off his heart.
uz: U hali quvonchini to'liq ifodalashga jur'at etmagan edi, lekin u juda hayajonli edi, xuddi yuragidan ton og'irligi tushgandek.

en: Now he had the right to devote his life to them, to serve them.
uz: Endi u o'z hayotini ularga bag'ishlab, ularga xizmat qilishga haqli edi.

en: … Anything might happen now!
uz: Endi har qanday narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin!

en: But he felt afraid to think of further possibilities and dared not let his imagination range.
uz: Ammo u qo'rqqan edi, boshqa imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqishga va tasavvurining cheklanishiga yo'l qo'ymishga jur'at qilmadi.

en: But Raskolnikov sat still in the same place, almost sullen and indifferent.
uz: Ammo Raskolnikov hali ham o'sha joyda o'tirgan, deyarli g'alati va befarq edi.

en: Though he had been the most insistent on getting rid of Luzhin, he seemed now the least concerned at what had happened.
uz: Garchi u Luzhinni yo'q qilishda eng qat'iy harakat qilgan bo'lsa-da, u sodir bo'lgan hodisalar uchun endi eng kam tashvishlangan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: Dounia could not help thinking that he was still angry with her, and Pulcheria Alexandrovna watched him timidly.
uz: Dounia hali ham unga g'azablanayotganini o'ylay olmay, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna uni qo'rqmasdan kuzatib turardi.

en: “What did Svidrigaïlov say to you?” said Dounia, approaching him.
uz: "Svidrigailov sizga nima dedi?" - dedi Dounia unga yaqinlashib.

en: “Yes, yes!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Ha, ha! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna baqirib yubordi.

en: Raskolnikov raised his head.
uz: Raskolnikov boshini ko'tardi.

en: “He wants to make you a present of ten thousand roubles and he desires to see you once in my presence.” “See her!
uz: U sizga o'n ming rubllik sovg'a berishni va sizni bir marta mening huzurimda ko'rishni istaydi. Uni ko'ring!

en: On no account!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Hech qanday hisobda! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna baqirib yubordi.

en: “And how dare he offer her money!” Then Raskolnikov repeated (rather dryly) his conversation with Svidrigaïlov, omitting his account of the ghostly visitations of Marfa Petrovna, wishing to avoid all unnecessary talk.
uz: Keyin Raskolnikov Svidrigailov bilan o'z suhbatini takrorladi (o'ziga yarasha quruqlik bilan), Marfa Petrovnaga duch kelgan tashriflar haqidagi hikoyasini qoldirib, barcha zaruriy gap-so'zlardan qochmoqchi bo'ldi.

en: “What answer did you give him?” asked Dounia.
uz: Unga qanday javob bergansiz? - deb so'radi Dounia.

en: “At first I said I would not take any message to you.
uz: Boshida sizga hech qanday xabarni qabul qilmayman, deb aytdim.

en: Then he said that he would do his utmost to obtain an interview with you without my help.
uz: So'ngra u siz bilan intervyu olish uchun qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilishini aytdi.

en: He assured me that his passion for you was a passing infatuation, now he has no feeling for you.
uz: U menga sen uchun o'z ishtiyoqining o'tmishda o'tgan bir ishtiyoq ekanligini va endi senga nisbatan his-tuyg'usi yo'qligini ishontirdi.

en: He doesn’t want you to marry Luzhin.
uz: U sizdan Luzhin bilan turmush qurishni istamaydi.

en: … His talk was altogether rather muddled.” “How do you explain him to yourself, Rodya?
uz: ... Uning nutqi umuman chalkash edi.  Qanday qilib uni o'zingizga tushuntirib bera olasiz, Rodya?

en: How did he strike you?” “I must confess I don’t quite understand him.
uz: U sizni qanday urgan? Men tan olsam kerakki, men uni to'liq tushunmayapman.

en: He offers you ten thousand, and yet says he is not well off.
uz: U sizga o'n mingni taklif qiladi, ammo o'zi yaxshi emasligini aytadi.

en: He says he is going away, and in ten minutes he forgets he has said it.
uz: U ketayotganini aytadi va o'n daqiqadan so'ng aytganini unutadi.

en: Then he says he is going to be married and has already fixed on the girl.
uz: Keyin u turmushga chiqishini aytadi va qizni o'ziga jalb qilgan.

en: … No doubt he has a motive, and probably a bad one.
uz: Shubhasiz, uning niyatlari bor va ehtimol yomon.

en: But it’s odd that he should be so clumsy about it if he had any designs against you.
uz: Ammo agar sizga qarshi biron-bir niyatlari bo'lsa, u bu haqda shunchalik qahramon bo'lishi ajablanarli emas.

en: … Of course, I refused this money on your account, once for all.
uz: Albatta, men bu pulni sening hisobingda bir martalik rad etdim.

en: Altogether, I thought him very strange.
uz: Umuman olganda, men uni juda g'alati deb o'ylardim.

en: … One might almost think he was mad.
uz: ... Biror kishi deyarli uning aqldan ozganini o'ylashi mumkin.

en: But I may be mistaken; that may only be the part he assumes.
uz: Ammo men xato qilishim mumkin; bu uning o'yin-kulgi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The death of Marfa Petrovna seems to have made a great impression on him.” “God rest her soul,” exclaimed Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: Marfa Petrovna o'limi unga katta ta'sir ko'rsatgan bo'lishi mumkin. Xudo uning ruhini tinchlantirsin, deb e'tirof etdi Pulcheria Alexandrovna.

en: “I shall always, always pray for her!
uz: Men har doim, har doim u uchun ibodat qilaman!

en: Where should we be now, Dounia, without this three thousand!
uz: Bu uch ming kishi bo'lmasa, endi qayerda bo'lishimiz kerak edi, Dounia!

en: It’s as though it had fallen from heaven!
uz: Xuddi osmondan tushib tushganidek bo'ladi!

en: Why, Rodya, this morning we had only three roubles in our pocket and Dounia and I were just planning to pawn her watch, so as to avoid borrowing from that man until he offered help.” Dounia seemed strangely impressed by Svidrigaïlov’s offer.
uz: Rodya, bu kuni ertalab bizning cibimizda faqat uch rubl bor edi va Dounia va men o'sha odamdan yordam taklif qilmaguncha qarz olishdan qochish uchun uning soatini qo'yib berishni rejalashtirgan edik. Dounia Svidrigailovning taklifidan g'alati darajada ta'sirlangan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: She still stood meditating.
uz: U hali ham meditatsiya qilishda turardi.

en: “He has got some terrible plan,” she said in a half whisper to herself, almost shuddering.
uz: Uning dahshatli rejasi bor, dedi u o'ziga yarim shvashda, deyarli titrab.

en: Raskolnikov noticed this disproportionate terror.
uz: Raskolnikov bu o'z navbatida qo'rqinchli holatni payqadi.

en: “I fancy I shall have to see him more than once again,” he said to Dounia.
uz: "Men uni bir necha marta ko'rishim kerak bo'lishini o'ylayman", - dedi u Douniaga.

en: I will track him out!” cried Razumihin, vigorously.
uz: Men uni izlab chiqaman! - dedi Razumihin kuch bilan.

en: “I won’t lose sight of him.
uz: Men uni ko'rishni yo'qotmayman.

en: Rodya has given me leave.
uz: Rodya menga ruxsat berdi.

en: He said to me himself just now.
uz: O'zi menga o'zi aytdi.

en: ‘Take care of my sister.’ Will you give me leave, too, Avdotya Romanovna?”
uz: Xonimga g'amxo'rlik qiling. Menga ham ruxsat berasizmi, Avdotya Romanovna?

en: Dounia smiled and held out her hand, but the look of anxiety did not leave her face.
uz: Dounia tabassum qilib qo'lini ko'tarib qo'ydi, ammo tashvishlanish ko'rinishi uning yuzidan ketmadi.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna gazed at her timidly, but the three thousand roubles had obviously a soothing effect on her.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna u ayolga qo'rqqancha qarab turdi, lekin uch ming rubl unga tinchlantiruvchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: A quarter of an hour later, they were all engaged in a lively conversation.
uz: Taxminan chorak soat o'tgach, ularning hammasi hayajonli suhbatga kirishdi.

en: Even Raskolnikov listened attentively for some time, though he did not talk.
uz: Hatto Raskolnikov ham bir muncha vaqt diqqat bilan tingladi, lekin gapirmadi.

en: Razumihin was the speaker.
uz: Razumihin nutq so'zlovchi bo'ldi.

en: “And why, why should you go away?” he flowed on ecstatically.
uz: Va nima uchun, nima uchun siz ketishingiz kerak? - dedi u hayajon bilan.

en: “And what are you to do in a little town?
uz: Va siz kichkina shaharda nima qilishingiz kerak?

en: The great thing is, you are all here together and you need one another —you do need one another, believe me.
uz: Eng muhimi shundaki, sizlar hammamiz bir joyda bo'lib, bir-biringizga muhtojsizlar, ishoninglar.

en: … Take me into partnership, and I assure you we’ll plan a capital enterprise.
uz: ... Meni sheriklikka oling va sizga shuni ta'kidlaymanki, biz kapital korxona tuzishni rejalashtiramiz.

en: I’ll explain it all in detail to you, the whole project!
uz: Men sizga hamma narsani batafsil tushuntirib beraman, butun loyihani!

en: It all flashed into my head this morning, before anything had happened … I tell you what; I have an uncle, I must introduce him to you (a most accommodating and respectable old man).
uz: Bugun ertalab hamma narsa sodir bo'lishidan oldin, bularning barchasi boshimga tushdi ... Men sizga nima deyman; mening bir o'g'lim bor, uni sizga tanishtirishim kerak (eng mehribon va hurmatli keksa kishi).

en: This uncle has got a capital of a thousand roubles, and he lives on his pension and has no need of that money.
uz: Bu o'g'limning ming rubllik kapitallari bor va u pensiya bilan yashaydi va bu pulga muhtoj emas.

en: For the last two years he has been bothering me to borrow it from him and pay him six percent interest.
uz: So'nggi ikki yildan beri u menga uni undan qarz olib, olti foizli foizni to'lashim uchun bosim o'tkazmoqda.

en: I know what that means; he simply wants to help me.
uz: Bu nimani anglatishini bilaman; u menga yordam berishni xohlaydi.

en: Last year I had no need of it, but this year I resolved to borrow it as soon as he arrived.
uz: O'tgan yili unga ehtiyoj yo'q edi, lekin bu yil uni u kelgandan so'ng qarz olishga qaror qildim.

en: Then you lend me another thousand of your three and we have enough for a start, so we’ll go into partnership, and what are we going to do?” Then Razumihin began to unfold his project, and he explained at length that almost all our publishers and booksellers know nothing at all of what they are selling, and for that reason they are usually bad publishers, and that any decent publications pay as a rule and give a profit, sometimes a considerable one.
uz: So'ngra siz menga o'zingizning uchingizdan ming nafardan boshqa qarz bersangiz, bizda boshlanishga etarlicha narsa bor, shuning uchun biz hamkorlik qilamiz va nima qilamiz? Keyin Razumihin o'z loyihasini ochishni boshladi va u bizning deyarli barcha nashriyot va kitob sotuvchilarimiz nima sotayotganlarini hech narsa bilmasligini, shuning uchun ular odatda yomon nashriyotchilar ekanliklarini va har qanday munosib nashrlar odatda pul to'layotgani va foyda keltirishi, ba'zan katta foyda keltirishi haqida batafsil tushuntirdi.

en: Razumihin had, indeed, been dreaming of setting up as a publisher.
uz: Darhaqiqat, Razumihin nashriyot bo'lish haqida orzu qilgan edi.

en: For the last two years he had been working in publishers’ offices, and knew three European languages well, though he had told Raskolnikov six days before that he was “schwach” in German with an object of persuading him to take half his translation and half the payment for it.
uz: So'nggi ikki yil davomida u nashriyot ofislarida ishlagan va uchta Evropa tilini yaxshi bilgan, garchi olti kun oldin Raskolnikovga o'zini nemis tilida "schwach" deb aytgan bo'lsa-da, uni tarjimasining yarmini va uning uchun to'lovning yarmini qabul qilishga undash maqsadida.

en: He had told a lie then, and Raskolnikov knew he was lying.
uz: O'shanda u yolg'on gapirgan va Raskolnikov yolg'on gapirayotganini bilardi.

en: “Why, why should we let our chance slip when we have one of the chief means of success —money of our own!” cried Razumihin warmly.
uz: Nima uchun muvaffaqiyatning asosiy vositalaridan biri - o'z pulimiz bo'lganda, bu imkoniyatdan voz kechishimiz kerak! - deb qayg'urdi Razumihin.

en: “Of course there will be a lot of work, but we will work, you, Avdotya Romanovna, I, Rodion.
uz: Albatta, ko'p ish bo'ladi, lekin biz ishlaymiz, siz, Avdotya Romanovna, Men, Rodion.

en: … You get a splendid profit on some
uz: ...Ba'zilar uchun ajoyib foyda olishingiz mumkin.

en: And the great point of the business is that we shall know just what wants translating, and we shall be translating, publishing, learning all at once.
uz: Bu ishning asosiy maqsadi shundaki, biz tarjima qilishni istagan narsani bilib, bir vaqtning o'zida tarjima, nashr va o'rganish bilan shug'ullanamiz.

en: I can be of use because I have experience.
uz: Men tajribaga ega bo'lganim uchun foydali bo'lishim mumkin.

en: For nearly two years I’ve been scuttling about among the publishers, and now I know every detail of their business.
uz: Deyarli ikki yil davomida nashriyotchilar orasida ko'p o'ylab yurganman va endi ularning biznesining har bir tafsilotini bilaman.

en: You need not be a saint to make pots, believe me!
uz: Quruqlarni tayyorlash uchun aziz bo'lish shart emas, ishoning!

en: And why, why should we let our chance slip!
uz: Va nega, nega biz imkoniyatimizdan mahrum bo'lishimiz kerak!

en: Why, I know —and I kept the secret —two or three books which one might get a hundred roubles simply for thinking of translating and publishing.
uz: Men bilaman va sirimni saqlab qoldim ikki yoki uchta kitob, uni tarjima qilish va nashr etish haqida o'ylagani uchun yuz rubl pul topishim mumkin.

en: Indeed, and I would not take five hundred for the very idea of one of them.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, ulardan birining g'oyasi uchun men besh yuzni qabul qilmayman.

en: And what do you think?
uz: Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?

en: If I were to tell a publisher, I dare say he’d hesitate —they are such blockheads!
uz: Agar men bu haqda bir nashriyotga aytsam, u ikkilanishini aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: And as for the business side, printing, paper, selling, you trust to me, I know my way about.
uz: Va biznes, bosma, qog'oz, sotish jihatlariga kelsak, menga ishoning, men o'z yo'limni bilaman.

en: We’ll begin in a small way and go on to a large.
uz: Biz kichikdan boshlaymiz va kattaga o'tamiz.

en: In any case it will get us our living and we shall get back our capital.” Dounia’s eyes shone.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu bizga hayotdan ko'z yumishga yordam beradi va biz o'z kapitalimizni qaytarib olamiz. Dunyoning ko'zlari yorqin bo'ldi.

en: “I like what you are saying, Dmitri Prokofitch!” she said.
uz: Menga aytgan gapingiz yoqadi, Dmitri Prokofitch! dedi u.

en: “I know nothing about it, of course,” put in Pulcheria Alexandrovna, “it may be a good idea, but again God knows.
uz: Men bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman, albatta,  Pulcheria Alexandrovna-da qo'yilgan, bu yaxshi fikr bo'lishi mumkin, lekin yana Xudo biladi.

en: It’s new and untried.
uz: Bu yangi va sinovdan o'tmagan.

en: Of course, we must remain here at least for a time.” She looked at Rodya.
uz: Albatta, biz kamida bir muncha vaqt bu yerda qolishimiz kerak. U Rodyaga qaradi.

en: “What do you think, brother?” said Dounia.
uz: Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz, aka? dedi Dounia.

en: “I think he’s got a very good idea,” he answered.
uz: "Men o'ylaymanki, u juda yaxshi g'oyaga ega", - deb javob berdi u.

en: “Of course, it’s too soon to dream of a publishing firm, but we certainly might bring out five or six books and be sure of success.
uz: Albatta, nashriyot kompaniyasi haqida orzu qilish juda erta, ammo biz besh yoki olti kitob chiqarib, muvaffaqiyatga erishamiz.

en: I know of one book myself which would be sure to go well.
uz: O'zim ham yaxshi o'tadigan bitta kitobni bilaman.

en: And as for his being able to manage it, there’s no doubt about that either.
uz: Va uning buni boshqarishga qodir bo'lishiga kelsak, bu borada ham shubha yo'q.

en: He knows the business.
uz: U biznesni yaxshi biladi.

en: … But we can talk it over later.
uz: Ammo biz bu haqda keyinroq gaplashamiz.

en: …” “Hurrah!” cried Razumihin.
uz: ... Hurrah! deb baqirdi Razumihin.

en: “Now, stay, there’s a flat here in this house, belonging to the same owner.
uz: Xullas, qoling, bu uyda bir xil egasiga tegishli bo'lgan kvartira bor.

en: It’s a special flat apart, not communicating with these lodgings.
uz: Bu alohida maxsus kvartira, bu uylar bilan aloqa qilmayapti.

en: It’s furnished, rent moderate, three rooms.
uz: Bu jihozlangan, o'rtacha ijara, uch xonali xona.

en: Suppose you take them to begin with.
uz: Aytaylik, siz ularni boshlash uchun olib ketasiz.

en: I’ll pawn your watch tomorrow and bring you the money, and everything can be arranged then.
uz: Ertaga soatingizni bahona qilib, pul keltirib beraman va keyin hamma narsa tuzilgan bo'ladi.

en: You can all three live together, and Rodya will be with you.
uz: Siz uchingiz ham birga yashay olasiz va Rodya siz bilan birga bo'ladi.

en: But where are you off to, Rodya?” “What, Rodya, you are going already?” Pulcheria Alexandrovna asked in dismay.
uz: Ammo qayerga ketyapsan, Rodya?Nima, Rodya, allaqachon ketyapsan? Pulcheria Aleksandrovna dahshatga tushib so'radi.

en: “At such a minute?” cried Razumihin.
uz: "Bu kabi daqiqada?" - deb baqirdi Razumihin.

en: Dounia looked at her brother with incredulous wonder.
uz: Dounia o'z ukasiga g'ayrat bilan qarab qo'ydi.

en: He held his cap in his hand, he was preparing to leave them.
uz: U qo'lida to'pkasi bor edi, ularni tark etish uchun tayyorlanayotgan edi.

en: “One would think you were burying me or saying goodbye forever,” he said somewhat oddly.
uz: "Siz meni ko'mib tashlayotganingizni yoki abadiy salom aytayotganingizni o'ylar edingiz", - dedi u biroz g'alati.

en: He attempted to smile, but it did not turn out a smile.
uz: U tabassum qilishga harakat qildi, lekin tabassum bo'lmadi.

en: “But who knows, perhaps it is the last time we shall see each other …” he let slip accidentally.
uz: Ammo kim biladi, ehtimol bu biz bir-birimizni oxirgi marta ko'rishimizdir ... u tasodifan qochib ketadi.

en: It was what he was thinking, and it somehow was uttered aloud.
uz: Bu uning o'ylashi edi va u qandaydir tarzda baland ovoz bilan aytildi.

en: “What is the matter with you?” cried his mother.
uz: Senga nima bo'ldi? Uning onasi yig'lab yubordi.

en: “Where are you going, Rodya?” asked Dounia rather strangely.
uz: Qayerga ketyapsan, Rodya? - deb savol berdi Dounia o'ta g'alati tarzda.

en: “Oh, I’m quite obliged to …” he answered vaguely, as though hesitating what he would say.
uz: Oh, men juda majburman ... u o'z so'zlariga shubha ostiga qo'ygan kabi noaniq javob berdi.

en: But there was a look of sharp determination in his white face.
uz: Ammo uning oq yuzida qat'iy qaror paydo bo'ldi.

en: “I meant to say … as I was coming here … I meant to tell you, mother, and you, Dounia, that it would be better for us to part for a time.
uz: Men aytmoqchiman... bu yerga kelganimda... senga, ona, va senga, Dounia, biroz ajralish yaxshiroq bo'lishini aytmoqchiman.

en: I feel ill, I am not at peace.
uz: O'zimni kasal his qilyapman, tinchlikda emasman.

en: … I will come afterwards, I will come of myself … when it’s possible.
uz: Keyin kelaman, o'zimdan kelaman, iloji bo'lganda.

en: I remember you and love you.
uz: Men sizlarni eslayman va sevaman.

en: … Leave me, leave me alone.
uz: Meni tashlab ketinglar, meni tinch qo'yinglar.

en: I decided this even before … I’m absolutely resolved on it.
uz: Men bu qarorni bundan oldin ham qabul qildim... Men bu qarorga qat'iy qaror qildim.

en: Whatever may come to me, whether I come to ruin or not, I want to be alone.
uz: Menga nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, yo'q bo'lishim yoki yo'q bo'lishim kerak, men yolg'iz qolishni xohlayman.

en: Forget me altogether, it’s better.
uz: Meni butunlay unut, bu yaxshiroqdir.

en: Don’t inquire about me.
uz: Men haqimda so'roq qilmang.

en: When I can, I’ll come of myself or … I’ll send for you.
uz: Mulohazakor bo'lganimda, o'z xohishimdan kelib, yoki sizlarni chaqirib yuboraman.

en: Perhaps it will all come back, but now if you love me, give me up … else I shall begin to hate you, I feel it.
uz: Ehtimol, hamma narsa qaytib keladi, lekin agar siz meni yaxshi ko'rsangiz, meni tashlab qo'ying ... aks holda men sizdan nafratlanishni boshlayman, buni his qilaman.

en: … Goodbye!” “Good God!” cried Pulcheria Alexandrovna.
uz: ... Xo'sh!Good God! Pulcheria Aleksandrovna baqirib yubordi.

en: Both his mother and his sister were terribly alarmed.
uz: Uning onasi ham, singlisi ham juda xavotirda edilar.

en: “Rodya, Rodya, be reconciled with us!
uz: Rodya, Rodya, biz bilan yarashing!

en: Let us be as before!” cried his poor mother.
uz: Keling, avvalgidek bo'laylik! - deb qayg'urgan kambag'al onasi.

en: He turned slowly to the door and slowly went out of the room.
uz: U sekin-sekin eshik tomon burildi va sekin-sekin xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: Dounia overtook him.
uz: Dounia uni yutib yubordi.

en: “Brother, what are you doing to mother?” she whispered, her eyes flashing with indignation.
uz: "Kakaim, onamga nima qilyapsan?" - deb shov-shuv qildi u, ko'zlari g'azablangan holda.

en: He looked dully at her.
uz: U ayolga xushmuomalalik bilan qaradi.

en: “No matter, I shall come.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men kelaman.

en: … I’m coming,” he muttered in an undertone, as though not fully conscious of what he was saying, and he went out of the room.
uz: ... Men kelayotganman, - deb o'zini past tutdi u, o'zi nima deyayotganini to'liq tushunmayotgandek, xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: “Wicked, heartless egoist!” cried Dounia.
uz: Qahramon, yuraksiz xudbin! Dounia baqirdi.

en: “He is insane, but not heartless.
uz: U aqldan ozgan, lekin yuraksiz emas.

en: You’re heartless after that!” Razumihin whispered in her ear, squeezing her hand tightly.
uz: Bundan keyin siz yuraksizsiz! Razumihin uning quloqlariga shoshib, qo'lini qattiq siqdi.

en: “I shall be back directly,” he shouted to the horror-stricken mother, and he ran out of the room.
uz: "Men to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaytib kelaman", - deb qo'rqitdi u dahshatga to'lgan onasiga va u xonadan yugurib chiqdi.

en: Raskolnikov was waiting for him at the end of the passage.
uz: Raskolnikov uni yo'lning oxirida kutib turgan edi.

en: “I knew you would run after me,” he said.
uz: "Siz mening ortimdan quvg'in qilasiz, deb bilardim", - dedi u.

en: “Go back to them —be with them … be with them tomorrow and always.
uz: O'zingizga qaytinglar Ular bilan birga bo'linglar ... ertaga va har doim ular bilan birga bo'linglar.

en: … I … perhaps I shall come … if I can.
uz: Ehtimol men ham kelishim mumkin bo'lsa.

en: Goodbye.” And without holding out his hand he walked away.
uz: Xo'sh. Qo'lini ko'tarmasdan u ketib ketdi.

en: “But where are you going?
uz: Ammo qayerga ketyapsiz?

en: What’s the matter with you?
uz: Senga nima bo'ldi?

en: How can you go on like this?” Razumihin muttered, at his wits’ end.
uz: Qanday qilib siz bunday davom ettira olasiz? - deb g'azablandi Razumihin.

en: Raskolnikov stopped once more.
uz: Raskolnikov yana bir bor to'xtadi.

en: “Once for all, never ask me about anything.
uz: Bir marta, hech qachon mendan hech narsa haqida so'ramang.

en: I have nothing to tell you.
uz: Sizga aytadigan hech narsaim yo'q.

en: Don’t come to see me.
uz: Meni ko'rishga kelma.

en: Maybe I’ll come here.
uz: Ehtimol, men bu yerga kelishim mumkin.

en: … Leave me, but don’t leave them.
uz: ... Meni tark eting, lekin ularni tark etmang.

en: Do you understand me?” It was dark in the corridor, they were standing near the lamp.
uz: Meni tushunyapsizmi? Koridorda qorong'ilik edi, ular chiroq yonida turishgan edi.

en: For a minute they were looking at one another in silence.
uz: Ular bir daqiqa davomida bir-birlariga sukutdan qarab turishdi.

en: Razumihin remembered that minute all his life.
uz: Razumihin o'z hayoti davomida o'sha daqiqani eslab turardi.

en: Raskolnikov’s burning and intent eyes grew more penetrating every moment, piercing into his soul, into his consciousness.
uz: Raskolnikovning qizg'in va niyatli ko'zlari har bir daqiqaga ko'proq kirib, uning ruhiga, ongiga kirib borardi.

en: Suddenly Razumihin started.
uz: Toʻsatdan Razumihin boshlandi.

en: Something strange, as it were, passed between them.
uz: Ularning o'rtasida g'alati bir narsa o'tdi.

en: … Some idea, some hint, as it were, slipped, something awful, hideous, and suddenly understood on both sides.
uz: ... Ba'zi bir g'oya, ba'zi bir ilhom, shunday qilib aytish kerak, o'tib ketdi, dahshatli, dahshatli va birdan ikki tomondan ham tushuniladigan narsa.

en: … Razumihin turned pale.
uz: ... Razumihin o'g'ilga aylandi.

en: “Do you understand now?” said Raskolnikov, his face twitching nervously.
uz: "Hndi tushunyapsizmi?" - dedi Raskolnikov, yuzi g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda.

en: “Go back, go to them,” he said suddenly, and turning quickly, he went out of the house.
