en: Yes, yes, don’t be uneasy, it’s all right,” Porfiry Petrovitch said as though in haste, and after he had said it he took the paper and looked at it.
uz: Ha, ha, bezovta bo'lmang, bu yaxshi, - dedi Porfiry Petrovitch shoshilinchlik bilan, so'zlaridan so'ng esa qog'ozni olib, uni ko'rib chiqdi.

en: “Yes, it’s all right.
uz: Ha, bu yaxshi.

en: needed,” he declared with the same rapidity and he laid the paper on the table.
uz: kerak deb e'lon qildi va qog'ozni stol ustiga qo'ydi.

en: A minute later when he was talking of something else he took it from the table and put it on his bureau.
uz: Bir daqiqa o'tgach, u boshqa narsa haqida gapirganida, uni stoldan olib, ish stoliga qo'ydi.

en: “I believe you said yesterday you would like to question me … formally … about my acquaintance with the murdered woman?” Raskolnikov was beginning again.
uz: Menimcha, siz o'tgan kun meni ... rasmiy ravishda ... o'ldirilgan ayol bilan tanishligim haqida so'roq qilishni xohlaysiz deb aytdingiz? Raskolnikov yana boshlanayotgan edi.

en: “Why did I put in ‘I believe’ ” passed through his mind in a flash.
uz: Nima uchun men o'zimni qo'ydim, ishonaman, deb o'yladim, bir lahzada uning ongidan o'tdi.

en: “Why am I so uneasy at having put in that ‘I believe’?” came in a second flash.
uz: Nima uchun men o'zimni shunday noqulay his qilyapmanki, o'sha "I believe" so'zini qo'yib qo'yganimda?

en: And he suddenly felt that his uneasiness at the mere contact with Porfiry, at the first words, at the first looks, had grown in an instant to monstrous proportions, and that this was fearfully dangerous.
uz: Birdan u Porfir bilan muloqot qilishdan, birinchi so'zlar aytishdan, birinchi ko'rinishdan ko'p tashvishlanganini va bu juda xavfli ekanini his qildi.

en: His nerves were quivering, his emotion was increasing.
uz: Uning hissiyotlari titrab, his-tuyg'ularini ko'paytirgan.

en: “It’s bad, it’s bad!
uz: Bu yomon, bu yomon!

en: I shall say too much again.” “Yes, yes, yes!
uz: Men yana bir bor ko'p gapiraman.Ha, ha, ha, ha!

en: There’s no hurry, there’s no hurry,” muttered Porfiry Petrovitch, moving to and fro about the table without any apparent aim, as it were making dashes towards the window, the bureau and the table, at one moment avoiding Raskolnikov’s suspicious glance, then again standing still and looking him straight in the face.
uz: Hech qanday shoshilinchlik yo'q, hech qanday shoshilinchlik yo'q, - dedi Porfiry Petrovitch, hech qanday aniq maqsadsiz dasturxon atrofida o'z ko'rinishini ko'rsatdi, xuddi darcha, ofis va dasturxon tomon chiziqlar chizdi, bir lahzada Raskolnikovning shubhali ko'zidan qochdi, keyin yana to'xtadi va unga to'g'ri qaradi.

en: His fat round little figure looked very strange, like a ball rolling from one side to the other and rebounding back.
uz: Uning yog'ir, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lgan kichkina shakli juda g'ayrioddiy ko'rinardi, xuddi bir tomondan boshqa tomonga aylanib, orqaga qaytib kelayotgan to'pga o'xshar edi.

en: “We’ve plenty of time.
uz: Bizda yetarlicha vaqt bor.

en: Here, a cigarette!” he went on, offering his visitor a cigarette.
uz: Mana, sigareta! u davom etdi va tashrif buyurgan kishiga sigareta taklif qildi.

en: “You know I am receiving you here, but my own quarters are through there, you know, my government quarters.
uz: Sizlar bilasizlarki, men sizni bu yerda qabul qilyapman, lekin mening o'zimning uylarim o'sha yerda, bilasiz, mening hukumat uylarimda.

en: But I am living outside for the time, I had to have some repairs done here.
uz: Ammo hozirda men tashqarida yashayman, bu yerda ba'zi bir ta'mirlash ishlari olib borilishi kerak edi.

en: It’s almost finished now.
uz: Endi deyarli bitib qoldi.

en: … Government quarters, you know, are a capital thing.
uz: ... Hukumat xonalari, bilasizmi, kapital narsa.

en: Eh, what do you think?” “Yes, a capital thing,” answered Raskolnikov, looking at him almost ironically.
uz: Xo'sh, nima deb o'ylaysiz?Ha, kapital narsa, Raskolnikov javob berdi va unga deyarli ironik tarzda qaradi.

en: “A capital thing, a capital thing,” repeated Porfiry Petrovitch, as though he had just thought of something quite different.
uz: A capital thing, a capital thing, Porfiry Petrovitch takrorladi, xuddi u shunchaki boshqacha narsa haqida o'ylagandek.

en: “Yes, a capital thing,” he almost shouted at last, suddenly staring at Raskolnikov and stopping short two steps from him.
uz: "Ha, katta narsa", - deb so'ng deyarli qichqirdi u, birdan Raskolnikovga tikilib, undan ikki qadam uzoqlikda to'xtadi.

en: This stupid repetition was too incongruous in its ineptitude with the serious, brooding and enigmatic glance he turned upon his visitor.
uz: Bu ahmoqona takrorlash o'z qobiliyatsizligi bilan mehmonning jiddiy, g'ayratli va sirsiz ko'zlariga mos kelmagan.

en: But this stirred Raskolnikov’s spleen more than ever and he could not resist an ironical and rather incautious challenge.
uz: Ammo bu Raskolnikovning ko'krakini har qachongidan ko'proq harakatga keltirdi va u ironik va kamsitilmas qiyinchilikka qarshi tura olmadi.

en: “Tell me, please,” he asked suddenly, looking almost insolently at him and taking a kind of pleasure in his own insolence.
uz: Menga ayting, iltimos,  deb so'radi u to'satdan, unga deyarli g'azablangancha qarab, o'z g'azablog'idan zavqlanib.

en: “I believe it’s a sort of legal rule, a sort of legal tradition —for all investigating lawyers —to begin their attack from afar, with a trivial, or at least an irrelevant subject, so as to encourage, or rather, to divert the man they are cross-examining, to disarm his caution and then all at once to give him an unexpected knockdown blow with some fatal question.
uz: Menimcha, bu bir xil qonuniy qoida, bir xil qonuniy an'ana  barcha tergov qiluvchi advokatlar uchun ularni uzoqdan, oddiy, yoki hech bo'lmaganda ahamiyatsiz mavzu bilan hujum qilishni boshlash, o'zaro tekshiruv o'tkazuvchi kishini jalb qilish, ehtiyotkorlikni yo'q qilish va birdan unga o'limga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan savol bilan kutilmagan darvozani berish uchun.

en: It’s a sacred tradition, mentioned, I fancy, in all the manuals of the art?” “Yes, yes.
uz: Bu muqaddas an'ana, men o'ylaymanki, barcha san'at qo'llanmalarida qayd etilgan?Ha, ha.

en: … Why, do you imagine that was why I spoke about government quarters … eh?” And as he said this Porfiry Petrovitch screwed up his eyes and winked; a good-humoured, crafty look passed over his face.
uz: Nima uchun, siz tasavvur qila olasizmi, shu sababli men hukumat qarorgohlari haqida gapirgan edim... eh? Va u gapirganida, bu Porfiry Petrovitch ko'zlarini buzdi va ko'z o'ngidan ko'z yumdi; uning yuziga xushmuomala, hiylasiz ko'rinish o'tdi.

en: The wrinkles on his forehead were smoothed out, his eyes contracted, his features broadened and he suddenly went off into a nervous prolonged laugh, shaking all over and looking Raskolnikov straight in the face.
uz: Uning oldidagi burchaklar tekislashdi, ko'zlari qisqardi, ko'zlari kenglashdi va u birdan ravshan, uzoq vaqt davomida kulishdi, butunlay sarsadi va Raskolnikovning yuziga to'g'ri qaradi.

en: The latter forced himself to laugh, too, but when Porfiry, seeing that he was laughing, broke into such a guffaw that he turned almost crimson, Raskolnikov’s repulsion overcame all precaution; he left off laughing, scowled and stared with hatred at Porfiry, keeping his eyes fixed on him while his intentionally prolonged laughter lasted.
uz: Bu kishi o'zini ham kulishga majbur qildi, lekin Porfiry o'zining kulishayotganini ko'rib, o'zi deyarli qizil bo'lib ketganini ko'rganida, Raskolnikovning nafratlanishi har qanday ehtiyotkorlikni yengdi; u kulishni to'xtatdi, Porfiryga nafrat bilan qaradi va ko'zlarini unga tikib, uning qasddan uzoq davom etayotgan kulishi davom etadi.

en: There was lack of precaution on both sides, however, for Porfiry Petrovitch seemed to be laughing in his visitor’s face and to be very little disturbed at the annoyance with which the visitor received it.
uz: Biroq, har ikki tomonda ham ehtiyotkorlik yo'q edi, chunki Porfiry Petrovitch mehmonning yuzida kulganday ko'rinardi va mehmon uni qabul qilgan g'azabdan juda kam xavotirlanardi.

en: The latter fact was very significant in Raskolnikov’s eyes: he saw that Porfiry Petrovitch had not been embarrassed just before either, but that he, Raskolnikov, had perhaps fallen into a trap; that there must be something, some motive here unknown to him; that, perhaps, everything was in readiness and in another moment would break upon him … He went straight to the point at once, rose from his seat and took his cap.
uz: Raskolnikovning ko'zida bu oxirgi fakt juda ahamiyatli edi: u Porfiry Petrovitch ham bundan oldin o'zini noqulay his qilmaganini, balki Raskolnikovning tuzoqqa tushib qolganini, bu yerda biror narsa, unga noma'lum sabab bo'lishi kerakligini, ehtimol hamma narsa tayyor bo'lganini va boshqa bir daqiqada uni bosib o'tishini ko'rdi.

en: “Porfiry Petrovitch,” he began resolutely, though with considerable irritation, “yesterday you expressed a desire that I should come to you for some inquiries” (he laid special stress on the word
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch, u qat'iylik bilan, garchi sezilarli g'azab bilan boshlandi, Kecha siz menga bir nechta so'rovlar uchun oldingizga kelishimni xohlashingizni bildirgansiz (u alohida e'tiborni so'ziga qaratdi

en: “I have come and if you have anything to ask me, ask it, and if not, allow me to withdraw.
uz: Men kelganman va agar mendan biror narsa so'rashingiz bo'lsa, so'rang, agar yo'q bo'lsa, menga ruxsat bering.

en: I have no time to spare.
uz: Mening vaqtim yo'q.

en: … I have to be at the funeral of that man who was run over, of whom you … know also,” he added, feeling angry at once at having made this addition and more irritated at his anger.
uz: ... Men o'sha odamning o'g'illarini ko'p o'ldirganidan keyin uning dafnida bo'lishim kerak, siz ham ... bilaman, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u. - Men bu qo'shimchalarni qo'shganimdan darhol g'azablanaman va g'azabidan ko'proq g'azablanaman.

en: “I am sick of it all, do you hear?
uz: Men bularning barchasidan charchadim, eshityapsizmi?

en: It’s partly what made me ill.
uz: Bu menga kasal bo'lishimga sabab bo'ldi.

en: In short,” he shouted, feeling that the phrase about his illness was still more out of place, “in short, kindly examine me or let me go, at once.
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, u o'z kasalligi haqida gapirishning o'rniga o'zgarib qolganini his etib, qichqirdi. Qisqa qilib aytganda, meni birdan tekshirib ko'ring yoki qo'yib yuboring.

en: And if you must examine me, do so in the proper form!
uz: Agar meni tekshirishingiz kerak bo'lsa, buni to'g'ri shaklda qiling!

en: I will not allow you to do so otherwise, and so meanwhile, goodbye, as we have evidently nothing to keep us now.” “Good heavens!
uz: Aks holda sizga ruxsat bermayman va shu bilan birga, salom ayting, chunki hozirda bizni to'xtatadigan hech narsa yo'q.Yaxshi osmonlar!

en: What shall I question you about?” cackled Porfiry Petrovitch with a change of tone, instantly leaving off laughing.
uz: Nima haqida so'rasam bo'ladi? Porfiry Petrovitch o'zgartirilgan so'z o'zgarib, o'z ko'zidan kulishni to'xtatdi.

en: “Please don’t disturb yourself,” he began fidgeting from place to place and fussily making Raskolnikov sit down.
uz: Iltimos, o'zingizni bezovta qilmang, u joy-joydan-joyga ko'chib o'tishni boshladi va Raskolnikovni o'tirishga majbur qildi.

en: “There’s no hurry, there’s no hurry, it’s all nonsense.
uz: Hech qanday shoshilinchlik yo'q, hech qanday shoshilinchlik yo'q, bularning barchasi g'alati gap.

en: Oh, no, I’m very glad you’ve come to see me at last … I look upon you simply as a visitor.
uz: Yo'q, meni ko'rish uchun nihoyat kelganingizga quvonaman... Men sizlarni shunchaki mehmon sifatida ko'rib chiqaman.

en: And as for my confounded laughter, please excuse it, Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Mening g'alati kulishimga kelsak, kechirim so'raysiz, Rodion Romanovitch.

en: … It’s my nerves, you tickled me so with your witty observation; I assure you, sometimes I shake with laughter like an india-rubber ball for half an hour at a time.
uz: ... Bu mening g'azablarim, siz o'zingizning aqlli kuzatishingiz bilan meni juda yoqtirasiz; sizga shuni aytamanki, ba'zan men yarim soat davomida bir marta bir marta hind-gumumi to'pasi kabi kulgi bilan titrayman.

en: … I’m often afraid of an attack of paralysis.
uz: Ko'pincha shollik hujumidan qo'rqaman.

en: Please do, or I shall think you are angry …” Raskolnikov did not speak; he listened, watching him, still frowning angrily.
uz: Iltimos, qil, yoki men sizni g'azablangan deb o'ylayman ... Raskolnikov gapirmadi; u tinglagan, uni kuzatib turgan, hali ham g'azablangan ko'z o'ngida.

en: He did sit down, but still held his cap.
uz: U o'tirdi, lekin hali ham to'pini ushlab turdi.

en: “I must tell you one thing about myself, my dear Rodion Romanovitch,” Porfiry Petrovitch continued, moving about the room and again avoiding his visitor’s eyes.
uz: Men sizga o'zim haqida bir narsani aytishim kerak, aziz Rodion Romanovitch, Porfiry Petrovitch davom etdi, xonada harakatlanadi va yana tashrif buyuruvchilarning ko'zlarini chetlab o'tadi.

en: “You see, I’m a bachelor, a man of no consequence and not used to society; besides, I have nothing before me, I’m set, I’m running to seed and … and have you noticed, Rodion Romanovitch, that in our Petersburg circles, if two clever men meet who are not intimate, but respect each other, like you and me, it takes them half an hour before they can find a subject for conversation —they are dumb, they sit opposite each other and feel awkward.
uz: Qaranglar, men beva, ahamiyatsiz va jamiyatga moyil bo'lmagan odamman; bundan tashqari, men oldimda hech narsa yo'q, men o'zimni o'rnatdim, urug' orasiga chopyapman va ... va siz, Rodion Romanovitch, e'tibor berdingizmi, Petersburgda bizning doiralarimizda ikki aqlli odam uchrashsa, ular bir-biriga yaqin emas, lekin siz va men kabi bir-birimizni hurmat qiladilar, suhbat uchun mavzu topishga yarim soat vaqt ketadi.

en: Everyone has subjects of conversation, ladies for instance … people in high society always have their subjects of conversation, c’est de rigueur, but people of the middle sort like us,
uz: Har kimning suhbat mavzulari bor, masalan, ayollar ... yuqori jamiyatdagi odamlar har doim o'zlarining suhbat mavzulariga ega, xolos, lekin o'rta darajadagi odamlar biz kabi,

en: thinking people that is, are always tongue-tied and awkward.
uz: Ya'ni, o'ylaydigan odamlar har doim til bilan bog'liq va noqulay bo'ladi.

en: What is the reason of it?
uz: Buning sababi nima?

en: Whether it is the lack of public interest, or whether it is we are so honest we don’t want to deceive one another, I don’t know.
uz: Umumiy qiziqishning yo'qligi yoki biz bir-birimizni aldashni xohlamaydigan darajada halol bo'lishimiz sabab bo'ladimi, bilmayman.

en: Do put down your cap, it looks as if you were just going, it makes me uncomfortable … I am so delighted …” Raskolnikov put down his cap and continued listening in silence with a serious frowning face to the vague and empty chatter of Porfiry Petrovitch.
uz: Kapkani pastga qo'ying, ko'rinishicha, siz ketayotgansiz, bu meni noqulay qiladi ... Men juda xursandman ... Raskolnikov kapkani pastga qo'ydi va Porfiry Petrovitchning noaniq va bo'sh gaplariga jiddiy burchak yuzi bilan jimlik bilan quloq solishni davom ettirdi.

en: “Does he really want to distract my attention with his silly babble?” “I can’t offer you coffee here; but why not spend five minutes with a friend?” Porfiry pattered on, “and you know all these official duties  … please don’t mind my running up and down, excuse it, my dear fellow, I am very much afraid of offending you, but exercise is absolutely indispensable for me.
uz: Haqiqatan ham u o'zining ahmoqona gaplari bilan e'tiborimni chalg'itishni istaymi?Men sizga bu yerda kofe taklif qila olmayman; lekin nima uchun do'stingiz bilan besh daqiqa vaqt o'tkazmaysiz? Porfiry o'qilgan,va siz ushbu barcha rasmiy vazifalarni bilasiz ... iltimos, mening yuqoriga va pastga yugurishimga xalaqit bermang, kechirim so'raysiz, aziz do'stim, men sizni xafa qilishdan juda qo'rqaman, lekin jismoniy mashqlar men uchun mutlaqo zarur.

en: I’m always sitting and so glad to be moving about for five minutes … I suffer from my sedentary life … I always intend to join a gymnasium; they say that officials of all ranks, even Privy Councillors, may be seen skipping gaily there; there you have it, modern science … yes, yes.
uz: Men har doim o'tirib, besh daqiqa harakatlanayotganimdan xursandman ... Men o'tirmas hayotimdan azob chekaman ... Men har doim sport zavodida ishtirok etishni rejalashtiraman; ular har qanday darajalardagi mansabdor shaxslarni, hatto Xususiy Kengash a'zolarini ham u yerda quvonch bilan o'tkazib ketayotganini ko'rish mumkin, deyishadi; u erda sizda bu bor, zamonaviy ilm-fan ... ha, ha.

en: … But as for my duties here, inquiries and all such formalities … you mentioned inquiries yourself just now … I assure you these interrogations are sometimes more embarrassing for the interrogator than for the interrogated.
uz: Ammo mening bu erda bo'lgan vazifama, so'rovlar va barcha shunga o'xshash formaliyatlarga kelsak, siz hali so'rovlarni o'zingiz aytib o'tgansiz, sizga shuni aytamanki, bu so'rovlar ba'zan so'rovchilar uchun so'rovlarga qaraganda, so'rovchilar uchun ko'proq noqulay bo'ladi.

en: … You made the observation yourself just now very aptly and wittily.” (Raskolnikov had made no observation of the kind.) “One gets into a muddle!
uz: Siz o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingizning fikringizni o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'zingiz ham o'ylab ko'rdingiz. (Raskolnikov bunday fikrniga ega bo'lmagan edi) Bir kishi o'z-o'zidan chalg'ib ketadi!

en: One keeps harping on the same note, like a drum!
uz: Bir kishi bir xil notada, bir davra kabi, harflashda davom etadi!

en: There is to be a reform and we shall be called by a different name, at least, he-he-he!
uz: O'zgarish bo'lishi kerak va bizni hech bo'lmaganda boshqacha nom bilan chaqirishlari kerak, hech bo'lmaganda, u-u-u-u!

en: And as for our legal tradition, as you so wittily called it, I thoroughly agree with you.
uz: Va bizning huquqiy an'analarimizga kelsak, siz buni juda aqlli deb atagan bo'lsangiz, men siz bilan to'liq rozi bo'laman.

en: Every prisoner on trial, even the rudest peasant, knows that they begin by disarming him with irrelevant questions (as you so happily put it) and then deal him a knockdown blow, he-he-he!
uz: Har bir mahbus, hatto eng qo'pol qishloq xo'jaligi ham, uni birinchi navbatda ahamiyatsiz savollar bilan qurolsizlashtirib (Siz buni xursandchilik bilan aytganingizdek) o'tkazganini biladi va so'ngra unga to'g'ri urib, u-u-u!

en: —your felicitous comparison, he-he!
uz: your felicitous taqqoslash, he-he!

en: So you really imagined that I meant by ‘government quarters’ … he-he!
uz: Demak, siz mening davlat qarorgohlari deganimni tasavvur qildingiz... u-u!

en: You are an ironical person.
uz: Siz ironik insonsiz.

en: Ah, by the way, yes!
uz: Ah, shu bilan birga, ha!

en: One word leads to another.
uz: Bir so'z boshqa so'zga olib keladi.

en: You spoke of formality just now, apropos of the inquiry, you know.
uz: Siz hozirgina rasmiylik haqida gapirgansiz, ammo bu so'rov haqida gapirgansiz.

en: But what’s the use of formality?
uz: Ammo rasmiylikning qanday foydasi bor?

en: In many cases it’s nonsense.
uz: Ko'p hollarda bu g'alati gap.

en: Sometimes one has a friendly chat and gets a good deal more out of it.
uz: Ba'zan do'stona suhbatlar bo'lib, undan ko'proq foyda olishadi.

en: One can always fall back on formality, allow me to assure you.
uz: Biror kishi har doim rasmiylikka qaytishi mumkin, sizga ishontirishga ruxsat bering.

en: And after all, what does it amount to?
uz: Axir, bu nimaga teng keladi?

en: examining lawyer cannot be bounded by formality at every step.
uz: Advokatni tekshirib ko'rish har bir qadamda rasmiylikka bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: The work of investigation is, so to speak, a free art in its own way, he-he- he!” Porfiry Petrovitch took breath a moment.
uz: Tergov ishi o'z-o'zidan erkin san'atdir, shunday deylik, u-u-u! Porfiry Petrovitch bir zum nafas oldi.

en: He had simply babbled on uttering empty phrases, letting slip a few enigmatic words and again reverting to incoherence.
uz: U shunchaki bo'sh iboralarni gapirib, bir necha g'ayritabiiy so'zlarni qo'yib yuborib, yana bir bor ko'rinmaslikka qaytgan edi.

en: He was almost running about the room, moving his fat little legs quicker and quicker, looking at the ground, with his right hand behind his back, while with his left making gesticulations that were extraordinarily incongruous with his words.
uz: U deyarli xonadon atrofida yugurib borardi, o'zining qalin oyoqlarini tezroq va tezroq harakat qilardi, o'ng qo'lini orqaga qo'yib yerga qarab, chap qo'lini qo'yib, so'zlariga zid bo'lgan harakatlarni qilardi.

en: Raskolnikov suddenly noticed that as he ran about the room he seemed twice to stop for a moment near the door, as though he were listening.
uz: Raskolnikov birdan xonadon atrofida yugurib borayotganda, u ikki marta eshik oldida bir zumga to'xtab turishga o'xshaydiganini payqadi.

en: “Is he expecting anything?” “You are certainly quite right about it,” Porfiry began gaily, looking with extraordinary simplicity at Raskolnikov (which startled him and instantly put him on his guard); “certainly quite right in laughing so wittily at our legal forms, he-he!
uz: U biror narsani kutyaptimi?  Siz, albatta, to'g'ri aytasiz, Porfiry Raskolnikovga (u uni qo'rqitib, darhol ehtiyot bo'lishiga sabab bo'lgan) ajoyib soddalik bilan qaray boshladi,   Haqiqatan ham, bizning huquqiy shakllarimizga o'yin-kulgi bilan kulishida to'g'ri aytasiz, u-u!

en: Some of these elaborate psychological methods are exceedingly ridiculous and perhaps useless, if one adheres too closely to the forms.
uz: Ushbu murakkab psixologik usullarning ba'zilari juda g'alati va ehtimol foydasiz, agar shakllarga juda qattiq rioya qilsak.

en: Yes … I am talking of forms again.
uz: Ha... yana shakllar haqida gapiryapman.

en: Well, if I recognise, or more strictly speaking, if I suspect someone or other to be a criminal in any case entrusted to me … you’re reading for the law, of course, Rodion Romanovitch?” “Yes, I was …” “Well, then it is a precedent for you for the future —though don’t suppose I should venture to instruct you after the articles you publish about crime!
uz: Xo'sh, agar men kimnidir yoki kimnidir menga ishonib topshirilgan har qanday holatda jinoyatchi deb tan olsam yoki aniqroq aytsam, albatta, siz qonun uchun o'qiysiz, Rodion Romanovitch?Ha, men shunday edim...Xullas, bu kelajakda siz uchun precedentdir, lekin siz jinoyatchilik to'g'risida nashr etgan maqolalaringizdan keyin sizga yo'l-yo'riq berishga jur'at qilsam bo'lmaydi, deb o'ylamang!

en: No, I simply make bold to state it by way of fact, if I took this man or that for a criminal, why, I ask, should I worry him prematurely, even though I had evidence against him?
uz: Yo'q, men shunchaki aytishga jur'at qilamanki, agar men bu yoki bu odamni jinoyatchi deb bilsam, nima uchun, deb so'rayman, unga qarshi dalillar bo'lsa-da, uni o'z vaqtida tashvishlantirishim kerak?

en: In one case I may be bound, for instance, to arrest a man at once, but another may be in quite a different position, you know, so why shouldn’t I let him walk about the town a bit?
uz: Misol uchun, bir holatda men bir odamni bir vaqtning o'zida hibsga olishim kerak bo'lishi mumkin, ammo boshqa holat juda boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun uni biroz shahar atrofida yurishiga ruxsat bersam bo'ladimi?

en: But I see you don’t quite understand, so I’ll give you a clearer example.
uz: Ammo siz buni tushunmayotganingizni ko'rib turibman, shuning uchun men sizga aniqroq misol beraman.

en: If I put him in prison too soon, I may very likely give him, so to speak, moral support, he- he!
uz: Agar men uni juda tez qamoqqa tashlasam, ehtimol, unga axloqiy jihatdan yordam beraman.

en: You’re laughing?” Raskolnikov had no idea of laughing.
uz: Siz kulyapsizmi? Raskolnikov kulish haqida hech qanday tasavvurga ega emas edi.

en: He was sitting with compressed lips, his feverish eyes fixed on Porfiry Petrovitch’s.
uz: U og'izlari siqilgan holda o'tirgan edi, og'ir ko'zlari Porfiry Petrovitchlarga qaragan edi.

en: “Yet that is the case, with some types especially, for men are so different.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa-da, ba'zi turlarda ayniqsa, erkaklar juda farq qiladi.

en: You say ‘evidence.’ Well, there may be evidence.
uz: Siz "eslatma" deb aytasiz. Ha, dalillar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But evidence, you know, can generally be taken two ways.
uz: Ammo dalillar, bilasizmi, odatda ikki yo'l bilan ko'rib chiqilishi mumkin.

en: I am an examining lawyer and a weak man, I confess it.
uz: Men tanqid qiluvchi advokat va zaif odamman, buni tanqid qilaman.

en: I should like to make a proof, so to say, mathematically clear.
uz: Men matematik jihatdan aniq bir dalilni taqdim etishni xohlayman.

en: I should like to make a chain of evidence such as twice two are four, it ought to be a direct, irrefutable proof!
uz: Ikki baravar ikki baravar to'rt bo'ladi, deb dalillar zanjirini yaratmoqchiman, bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, tanqid qilinmaydigan dalil bo'lishi kerak!

en: And if I shut him up too soon —even though I might be convinced he was the man, I should very likely be depriving myself of the means of getting further evidence against him.
uz: Va agar men uni juda tez og'iz tutsam, hatto u odam ekaniga amin bo'lishim mumkin bo'lsa-da, ehtimol o'zimga qarshi qo'shimcha dalillar olish imkoniyatidan mahrum bo'lishim kerak.

en: By giving him, so to speak, a definite position, I shall put him out of suspense and set his mind at rest, so that he will retreat into his shell.
uz: Unga aniq joy berish orqali, demak, uni tashvishdan ozod qilib, ongini tinchlantiraman, shunda u o'z shell-ga qaytadi.

en: They say that at Sevastopol, soon after Alma, the clever people were in a terrible fright that the enemy would attack openly and take Sevastopol at once.
uz: Aytishlaricha, Alma shahridan ko'p o'tmay, Sevastopolda, aqlli odamlar dushman ochiqchasiga hujum qilib, Sevastopolni darhol egallab olishi haqida dahshatli qo'rquvda edilar.

en: But when they saw that the enemy preferred a regular siege, they were delighted, I am told and reassured, for the thing would drag on for two months at least.
uz: Ammo ular dushman doimiy qamal qilishni afzal ko'rganida, ular xursand bo'lishdi, deb aytishadi va meni xotirjam qilishadi, chunki bu holat kamida ikki oy davom etadi.

en: You’re laughing, you don’t believe me again?
uz: Qani, yana menga ishonmayapsanmi?

en: Of course, you’re right, too.
uz: Albatta, siz ham haqsiz.

en: You’re right, you’re right.
uz: Siz haqsiz, siz haqsiz.

en: These are special cases, I admit.
uz: Bular maxsus holatlar, men tan oldim.

en: But you must observe this, my dear Rodion Romanovitch, the general case, the case for which all legal forms and rules are intended, for which they are calculated and laid down in books, does not exist at all, for the reason that every case, every crime, for instance, so soon as it actually occurs, at once becomes a thoroughly special case and sometimes a case unlike any that’s gone before.
uz: Ammo siz buni e'tiborga olishingiz kerak, aziz Rodion Romanovitch, umumiy holat, barcha huquqiy shakl va qoidalar nazarda tutilgan, hisoblab chiqilgan va kitoblarda bayon etilgan holat, umuman mavjud emas, chunki har bir holat, har bir jinoyat, masalan, u sodir bo'lganda, darhol butunlay maxsus holatga aylanadi va ba'zan avvalgilardan farqli o'laroq boshqa holatga aylanadi.

en: Very comic cases of that sort sometimes occur.
uz: Ba'zan o'sha kabi juda hazil holatlar sodir bo'ladi.

en: If I leave one man quite alone, if I don’t touch him and don’t worry him, but let him know or at least suspect every moment that I know all about it and am watching him day and night, and if he is in continual suspicion and terror, he’ll be bound to lose his head.
uz: Agar men bir kishini yolg'iz qoldirsam, unga tegmasam va tashvishlanmasam, lekin har bir daqiqada uning hamma narsani bilishini yoki hech bo'lmaganda uni kuzatayotganimni bilishini yoki shubhalanishini aytsam, agar u doimiy ravishda shubha va qo'rquvda bo'lsa, u aqlini yo'qotib qo'yadi.

en: He’ll come of himself, or maybe do something which will make it as plain as twice two are four —it’s delightful.
uz: U o'z-o'zidan keladi, yoki, ehtimol, ikki marta ikki marta to'rt marta yoqimli bo'lgani kabi aniq bo'ladigan biror narsa qiladi.

en: It may be so with a simple peasant, but with one of our sort, an intelligent man cultivated on a certain side, it’s a dead certainty.
uz: Oddiy dehqon bilan ham shunday bo'lishi mumkin, ammo bizdan biri, ma'lum bir tomonda o'tqazilgan aqlli odam bilan, bu o'lik ishonchdir.

en: For, my dear fellow, it’s a very important matter to know on what side a man is cultivated.
uz: Chunki, aziz do'stim, odamning qaysi tarafda tarbiyalanishini bilish juda muhimdir.

en: And then there are nerves, there are nerves, you have overlooked them!
uz: Va yana g'azablar bor, g'azablar bor, siz ularni e'tiborsiz qoldirdingiz!

en: Why, they are all sick, nervous and irritable!
uz: Axir, ularning barchasi kasal, g'alati va g'azablangan!

en: … And then how they all suffer from spleen!
uz: Keyin esa, ularning barchasi ko'krak kasalligiga chalinganini ko'rdim!

en: That I assure you is a regular goldmine for us.
uz: Bu biz uchun odatdagi oltin mayda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

en: And it’s no anxiety to me, his running about the town free!
uz: Va men uchun uning shahar atrofida erkin yurishi tashvishlanmaydi!

en: him, let him walk about for a bit!
uz: Uni biroz yurishiga ruxsat bering!

en: I know well enough that I’ve caught him and that he won’t escape me.
uz: Men uni ushlab qo'yganimni va u mendan qochib ketolmayotganini yaxshi bilaman.

en: Where could he escape to, he-he?
uz: Qayerga qochib ketishi mumkin edi?

en: A Pole will escape abroad, but not here, especially as I am watching and have taken measures.
uz: A polyak chet elga qochib ketadi, lekin bu yerda emas, ayniqsa men kuzatib turaman va choralar ko'rdim.

en: Will he escape into the depths of the country perhaps?
uz: Ehtimol, u mamlakatning chuqurligiga qochib ketadimi?

en: But you know, peasants live there, real rude Russian peasants.
uz: Ammo, bilasizmi, u erda qishloqlar yashaydi, haqiqiy rus qishloqlari.

en: A modern cultivated man would prefer prison to living with such strangers as our peasants.
uz: Zamonaviy madaniyatli odam, qishloqchalarimiz kabi begona odamlar bilan yashashdan ko'ra, qamoqxonaga borishni afzal ko'radi.

en: But that’s all nonsense, and on the surface.
uz: Ammo bularning hammasi behuda va yuzaki.

en: It’s not merely that he has nowhere to run to, he is psychologically unable to escape me, he-he!
uz: U shunchaki qochishga joy yo'qligi bilan bog'liq emas, balki psixologik jihatdan mendan qochib qutula olmaydi.

en: Through a law of nature he can’t escape me if he had anywhere to go.
uz: Tabiat qonuni tufayli u qaerga borishi kerak bo'lsa ham, mendan qochib ketolmaydi.

en: Have you seen a butterfly round a candle?
uz: Shisha atrofida papillon ko'rganmisiz?

en: That’s how he will keep circling and circling round me.
uz: Shunday qilib, u menga doimo aylanib boradi.

en: Freedom will lose its attractions.
uz: Erkinlik o'z nufuzini yo'qotadi.

en: He’ll begin to brood, he’ll weave a tangle round himself, he’ll worry himself to death!
uz: O'zini o'ziga bog'laydi, o'zini o'ziga bog'laydi, o'zini o'limgacha bezovta qiladi!

en: What’s more he will provide me with a mathematical proof —if I only give him long enough interval.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u menga matematik dalilni taqdim etadi, agar men unga yetarlicha uzoq intervalni bersam.

en: … And he’ll keep circling round me, getting nearer and nearer and then —flop!
uz: Va u atrofimda aylanib boradi, yaqinlashib, yaqinlashib ketadi va so'ngra g'alaba qozonadi!

en: He’ll fly straight into my mouth and I’ll swallow him, and that will be very amusing, he-he-he!
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri og'zimga uchib ketadi va men uni yutib yuboraman, bu juda qiziqarli bo'ladi, u-u-u!

en: You don’t believe me?” Raskolnikov made no reply; he sat pale and motionless, still gazing with the same intensity into Porfiry’s face.
uz: Raskolnikov hech qanday javob bermadi; u o'tirgan sari soya va harakatsiz bo'lib, hali ham Porfirining yuziga xuddi shu kuch bilan qaradi.

en: “It’s a lesson,” he thought, turning cold.
uz: "Bu saboq", - deb o'yladi u, sovuqlashib ketadi.

en: “This is beyond the cat playing with a mouse, like yesterday.
uz: Bu kechki paytgidek, mushuk bilan o'ynagan mushukdan tashqari.

en: He can’t be showing off his power with no motive … prompting me; he is far too clever for that … he must have another object.
uz: U o'z kuchini hech qanday sababsiz namoyish eta olmaydi ... meni rag'batlantiradi; u buning uchun juda aqlli ... u boshqa bir ob'ektga ega bo'lishi kerak.

en: It’s all nonsense, my friend, you are pretending, to scare me!
uz: Bularning hammasi behuda, do'stim, meni qo'rqitish uchun o'zingizni o'zingizdek ko'rsata olasiz!

en: You’ve no proofs and the man I saw had no real existence.
uz: Sizda hech qanday dalillar yo'q va men ko'rgan odamning haqiqiy mavjudligi yo'q edi.

en: You simply want to make me lose my head, to work me up beforehand and so to crush me.
uz: Siz shunchaki mening boshimni yo'qotib, oldindan meni o'zgartirmoqchisan va shuning uchun meni ezib tashlamoqchisan.

en: But you are wrong, you won’t do it!
uz: Ammo siz xato qilyapsiz, buni qilmaysiz!

en: But why give me such a hint?
uz: Ammo nega menga bunday g'oya berish kerak?

en: Is he reckoning on my shattered nerves?
uz: U mening buzilgan g'azablarimdan hisob-kitob qilyaptimi?

en: No, my friend, you are wrong, you won’t do it even though you have some trap for me … let us see what you have in store for me.” And he braced himself to face a terrible and unknown ordeal.
uz: Yo'q, do'stim, sen noto'g'ri yo'l tutasan, menga biror tuzoq qo'ygan bo'lsang ham, buni qilmaysan... menga nima tayyorlaganingni ko'ramiz. Va u o'zini dahshatli va noma'lum sinovga tayyorlagan.

en: At times he longed to fall on Porfiry and strangle him.
uz: Ba'zan u Porfirga tushib, uni g'arq qilishni orzu qilardi.

en: This anger was what he dreaded from the beginning.
uz: Shu g'azabdan u boshidan beri qo'rqardi.

en: He felt that his parched lips were flecked with foam, his heart was throbbing.
uz: O'zining quruq og'izlari cho'g'ga to'lib qolganini, yuragi urib ketganini sezdi.

en: But he was still determined not to speak till the right moment.
uz: Ammo u hali ham to'g'ri vaqtgacha gapirmaslikka qat'iy qaror qildi.

en: He realised that this
uz: U shuni tushunganki, bu

en: was the best policy in his position, because instead of saying too much he would be irritating his enemy by his silence and provoking him into speaking too freely.
uz: Bu uning o'rnida eng yaxshi siyosat edi, chunki u haddan tashqari ko'p gapirishning o'rniga, o'z so'zsizligi bilan dushmanini g'azablantirib, uni haddan tashqari erkin gapirishga undaydi.

en: Anyhow, this was what he hoped for.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu uning umidi edi.

en: “No, I see you don’t believe me, you think I am playing a harmless joke on you,” Porfiry began again, getting more and more lively, chuckling at every instant and again pacing round the room.
uz: Yo'q, siz menga ishonmayotganingizni ko'ryapman, siz mening sizga salbiy hazil qilyapman deb o'ylaysiz, Porfiry yana boshlandi, yanada jonli bo'ldi, har bir daqiqada kulishadi va xonadon atrofida qayta-qayta yuradi.

en: “And to be sure you’re right: God has given me a figure that can awaken none but comic ideas in other people; a buffoon; but let me tell you, and I repeat it, excuse an old man, my dear Rodion Romanovitch, you are a man still young, so to say, in your first youth and so you put intellect above everything, like all young people.
uz: Va siz haqli ekanligingizga amin bo'lish uchun: Xudo menga boshqa odamlarda faqat komik fikrlarni uyg'otadigan shaxsni berdi; bufona; lekin sizga aytaman, va yana aytaman, bir keksa odamni kechiring, aziz Rodion Romanovitch, siz hali yosh, degani, yoshligingizda va shuning uchun siz barcha yoshlar kabi aql-idrokni hamma narsadan ustun qo'yasiz.

en: Playful wit and abstract arguments fascinate you and that’s for all the world like the old Austrian Hof-kriegsrath, as far as I can judge of military matters, that is: on paper they’d beaten Napoleon and taken him prisoner, and there in their study they worked it all out in the cleverest fashion, but look you, General Mack surrendered with all his army, he-he-he!
uz: O'yinchanlik va ma'lum dalillar sizni hayratda qoldiradi va bu butun dunyo uchun eski Avstriyalik Hof-kriegsrath kabi, men harbiy masalalarni hal qila olsam, ya'ni qog'ozda ular Napoleonni mag'lub qilib, asir qilib olishgan, va u erda o'z studiyasida hamma narsani eng aqlli tarzda hal qilishgan, ammo siz ko'ring, general Mak butun armiyasi bilan taslim bo'ldi, u-u-u!

en: I see, I see, Rodion Romanovitch, you are laughing at a civilian like me, taking examples out of military history!
uz: Ko'rib turibman, ko'rib turibman, Rodion Romanovitch, siz menga o'xshab fuqarolarga kulyapsiz, harbiy tarixdan misollar olib yuryapsiz!

en: But I can’t help it, it’s my weakness.
uz: Ammo men buni qila olmayman, bu mening zaifligimdir.

en: I am fond of military science.
uz: Men harbiy fanni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: And I’m ever so fond of reading all military histories.
uz: Va men har qanday harbiy tarixni o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

en: I’ve certainly missed my proper career.
uz: Shubhasiz, o'z karyeramni sog'inib qoldim.

en: I ought to have been in the army, upon my word I ought.
uz: Men armiyada bo'lishim kerak edi, so'zimga muvofiq bo'lishim kerak edi.

en: I shouldn’t have been a Napoleon, but I might have been a major, he-he!
uz: Men Napoleon bo'lmasdim, lekin major bo'lishim mumkin edi.

en: Well, I’ll tell you the whole truth, my dear fellow, about this special case, I mean: actual fact and a man’s temperament, my dear sir, are weighty matters and it’s astonishing how they sometimes deceive the sharpest calculation!
uz: Xo'sh, men sizga butun haqiqatni aytaman, aziz do'stim, ushbu maxsus holat haqida, men aytaman: haqiqiy faktlar va insonning temperamenti, aziz sir, og'ir narsalar va ular ba'zan eng keskin hisob-kitoblarni qanday aldashlari ajablanarli!

en: I —listen to an old man —am speaking seriously, Rodion Romanovitch” (as he said this Porfiry Petrovitch, who was scarcely five-and-thirty, actually seemed to have grown old; even his voice changed and he seemed to shrink together) “Moreover, I’m a candid man … am I a candid man or not?
uz: Men bir keksa odamni eshitib, jiddiy gapirganman, Rodion Romanovitch (u o'zi aytganidek, besh o'ttiz yoshga to'lgan Porfiry Petrovitch, aslida qarib qolgan edi; hatto uning ovozi ham o'zgargan va u bir-biriga qisqartirilgandek ko'rinardi)

en: I fancy I really am: I tell you these things for nothing and don’t even expect a reward for it, he-he!
uz: Men o'zimni chindan ham shunday deb bilaman: men sizga bu narsalarni bepul aytib beraman va buning uchun mukofotni kutmayman!

en: Well, to proceed, wit in my opinion is a splendid thing, it is, so to say, an adornment of nature and a consolation of life, and what tricks it can play!
uz: O'shanda, mening fikrimcha, aql - idrok ajoyib narsa, u, shunday deylik, tabiatning bezaklanishi va hayotning tasalliidir va u qanday hiylalarni o'ynashini biladi!

en: So that it sometimes is hard for a poor examining lawyer to know where he is, especially when he’s liable to be carried away by his own fancy, too, for you know he is a man after all!
uz: Shunday qilib, ba'zan kambag'al advokatga o'zini qayerda ko'rish qiyin bo'ladi, ayniqsa, u o'z xayollari bilan o'ziga jalb bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganda, chunki siz bilganingizdek, u odam!

en: But the poor fellow is saved by the
uz: Ammo kambag'al odamning najot topishi uchun o'z jonini sarflaydi.

en: criminal’s temperament, worse luck for him!
uz: Jinoyatchilarning temperamenti yomonroq bo'lsa, u uchun omad ham yomon bo'ladi!

en: But young people carried away by their own wit don’t think of that ‘when they overstep all obstacles,’ as you wittily and cleverly expressed it yesterday.
uz: Ammo o'z aql-idroklari bilan ovul bo'lgan yoshlar, siz o'tgan kun aql-idrok va aqllilik bilan aytganingizdek, barcha to'siqlarni o'tkazib ketganda, bu haqda o'ylamaydilar.

en: He will lie —that is, the man who is a special case, the incognito, and he will lie well, in the cleverest fashion; you might think he would triumph and enjoy the fruits of his wit, but at the most interesting, the most flagrant moment he will faint.
uz: U yolg'on gapiradi, ya'ni incognito bo'lgan kishi va u eng aqlli tarzda yaxshi yolg'on gapiradi; siz uning g'alaba qozonishini va o'z aql-idrokidan bahramand bo'lishini o'ylashingiz mumkin, ammo eng qiziqarli, eng oshkora daqiqada u baytilanib ketadi.

en: Of course there may be illness and a stuffy room as well, but anyway!
uz: Albatta, kasallik va to'siq xonasi ham bo'lishi mumkin, lekin har holda!

en: Anyway he’s given us the idea!
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u bizga g'oyani berdi!

en: He lied incomparably, but he didn’t reckon on his temperament.
uz: U o'ziga yarasha yolg'on gapirgan, ammo o'z temperamentiga e'tibor bermagan.

en: That’s what betrays him!
uz: Bu uni aldovchi narsa!

en: Another time he will be carried away by his playful wit into making fun of the man who suspects him, he will turn pale as it were on purpose to mislead, but his paleness will be too natural, too much like the real thing, again he has given us an idea!
uz: Boshqa safar u o'zining o'yinchan hiyla-nayrangidan foydalanib, uni shubha ostiga qo'ygan odamdan masxara qiladi, uni yo'ldan ozdirish uchun qasd qilganidek, o'zidan-o'zidan o'zgarib qoladi, ammo o'zining o'zgaruvchanligi juda tabiiy bo'ladi, juda haqiqiy narsaga o'xshaydi, yana bizga g'oya berdi!

en: Though his questioner may be deceived at first, he will think differently next day if he is not a fool, and, of course, it is like that at every step!
uz: Garchi savol beruvchisi boshida aldanib qolsa-da, erta kuni axmoq bo'lmasa boshqacha fikrda bo'ladi va, albatta, har qadamda shunday bo'ladi!

en: He puts himself forward where he is not wanted, speaks continually when he ought to keep silent, brings in all sorts of allegorical allusions, he-he!
uz: U o'zini xohlamaydigan joyga ko'taradi, sukut saqlash kerak bo'lganda doimiy ravishda gapiradi, turli xil allegorik izohlarni keltirib chiqaradi.

en: Comes and asks why didn’t you take me long ago?
uz: U kelib, nega meni uzoq vaqt oldin olib ketmadingiz, deb so'radi.

en: And that can happen, you know, with the cleverest man, the psychologist, the literary man.
uz: Va bu eng aqlli odam, psixolog, adabiy odam bilan sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The temperament reflects everything like a mirror!
uz: Temperament hamma narsani ko'zgu kabi aks ettiradi!

en: Gaze into it and admire what you see!
uz: Unga nazar tashlang va ko'rgan narsangizga hayron bo'ling!

en: But why are you so pale, Rodion Romanovitch?
uz: Ammo nega siz shunchalik oqib ketasiz, Rodion Romanovitch?

en: Shall I open the window?” “Oh, don’t trouble, please,” cried Raskolnikov and he suddenly broke into a laugh.
uz: Oyna ochsam bo'ladimi?Oh, xafa bo'lmang, iltimos, Raskolnikov yig'ladi va u to'satdan kulishga tushdi.

en: “Please don’t trouble.” Porfiry stood facing him, paused a moment and suddenly he too laughed.
uz: Xullas, bezovta qilmang. Porfiry unga qaragan holda to'xtadi, bir zum to'xtadi va to'satdan u ham kuldi.

en: Raskolnikov got up from the sofa, abruptly checking his hysterical laughter.
uz: Raskolnikov sofadan turib, histerik tabassumini tekshirib ko'rdi.

en: “Porfiry Petrovitch,” he began, speaking loudly and distinctly, though his legs trembled and he could scarcely stand.
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch, u baland ovozda va aniq gapirib boshladi, garchi oyoqlari titrab tursa-da, toʻxtamaydi.

en: “I see clearly at last that you actually suspect me of murdering that old woman and her sister Lizaveta.
uz: Nihoyat, siz meni o'sha keksa ayol va uning singlisi Lizavetani o'ldirganimda gumon qilayotganingizni aniq ko'rdim.

en: Let me tell you for my part that I am sick of this.
uz: Mening o'zim uchun aytamanki, men bundan charchadim.

en: If you find that you have a right to prosecute me legally, to arrest me, then prosecute me, arrest me.
uz: Agar siz meni qonuniy ravishda ayblashga, hibsga olishga haqli ekanligingizni bilsangiz, menga qarshi ayblov qo'yib, meni hibsga oling.

en: But I will not let myself be jeered at to my face and worried …” His lips trembled, his eyes glowed with fury and he could not restrain his voice.
uz: Lekin men o'zimni ko'zimga qarab masxara va tashvishlanishga yo'l qo'ymayman ... Uning og'izlari titragan, ko'zlari g'azabga to'lib-toshgan va ovozini to'xtata olmagan.

en: “I won’t allow it!” he shouted, bringing his fist down on the table.
uz: Men bunga yo'l qo'ymayman! - deb baqirib, o'z yumushini stol ustiga tashladi.

en: “Do you hear that, Porfiry Petrovitch?
uz: Shuni eshityapsizmi, Porfiry Petrovitch?

en: I won’t allow it.” “Good heavens!
uz: Men bunga yo'l qo'ymayman.Yomon osmonlar!

en: What does it mean?” cried Porfiry Petrovitch, apparently quite frightened.
uz: Bu nimani anglatadi? Porfiry Petrovitch, ko'rinib turganidek, juda qo'rqqan holda, baqirib yubordi.

en: “Rodion Romanovitch, my dear fellow, what is the matter with you?” “I won’t allow it,” Raskolnikov shouted again.
uz: Rodion Romanovitch, azizim, senga nima bo'ldi?Men bunga yo'l qo'ymayman, Raskolnikov yana baqirdi.

en: They’ll hear and come in.
uz: Ular eshitib, kirib kelishadi.

en: Just think, what could we say to them?” Porfiry Petrovitch whispered in horror, bringing his face close to Raskolnikov’s.
uz: Bir o'ylab ko'ring, ularga nima deyishimiz mumkin? Porfiry Petrovitch qo'rqinchli so'zlab, Raskolnikovlarga yuzini yaqinlashtirdi.

en: “I won’t allow it, I won’t allow it,” Raskolnikov repeated mechanically, but he too spoke in a sudden whisper.
uz: Men bunga yo'l qo'ymayman, yo'l qo'ymayman, Raskolnikov mexanik tarzda takrorladi, lekin u ham birdan shoshib gapirdi.

en: Porfiry turned quickly and ran to open the window.
uz: Porfiry tez o'girilib, darvozani ochish uchun yugurdi.

en: And you must have some water, my dear fellow.
uz: Va sizda suv bo'lishi kerak, aziz do'stim.

en: You’re ill!” and he was running to the door to call for some when he found a decanter of water in the corner.
uz: Siz kasalsiz! va u bir nechta chaqirib olish uchun eshikga yugurib borar edi, ammo burchada suv dekanterini topdi.

en: “Come, drink a little,” he whispered, rushing up to him with the decanter.
uz: Kelib, bir oz iching, deb shov-shuv qildi u, o'ziga yaqinlashib, o'z o'ziga o'tkirlik bilan to'g'ri keldi.

en: “It will be sure to do you good.” Porfiry Petrovitch’s alarm and sympathy were so natural that Raskolnikov was silent and began looking at him with wild curiosity.
uz: Bu sizga foyda keltiradi. Porfiry Petrovitchning tashvishlari va hamdardligi shu qadar tabiiy ediki, Raskolnikov o'zini tutdi va g'ayritabiiy qiziqish bilan unga qaray boshladi.

en: He did not take the water, however.
uz: Biroq, u suvni ichmadi.

en: “Rodion Romanovitch, my dear fellow, you’ll drive yourself out of your mind, I assure you, ach, ach!
uz: Rodion Romanovitch, aziz do'stim, o'zingizni aqldan ozdirib yuborasiz, sizga ishontiraman, ach, ach!

en: Have some water, do drink a little.” He forced him to take the glass.
uz: Bir oz suv iching, bir oz iching. U uni shishaga olib ketishga majbur qildi.

en: Raskolnikov raised it mechanically to his lips, but set it on the table again with disgust.
uz: Raskolnikov uni mexanik ravishda og'ziga ko'tardi, ammo uni yana stol ustiga qo'ydi.

en: “Yes, you’ve had a little attack!
uz: Ha, sizda kichik hujum bo'ldi!

en: You’ll bring back your illness again, my dear fellow,” Porfiry Petrovitch cackled with friendly sympathy, though he still looked rather disconcerted.
uz: Siz kasalligingizni yana qaytarasiz, aziz do'stim, Porfiry Petrovitch do'stona hamdardlik bilan qichqirgan edi, garchi u hali ham juda xavotirlangan ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: “Good heavens, you must take more care of yourself!
uz: Albatta, o'zingizga ko'proq g'amxo'rlik qilishingiz kerak!

en: Dmitri Prokofitch was here, came to see me yesterday —I know, I know, I’ve a nasty, ironical temper, but what they made of it!
uz: Dmitri Prokofitch kecha menga tashrif buyurgan edi, men bilaman, bilaman, men yomon, ironik tuyg'ularim bor, lekin ular buni qanday qilishdi!

en: … Good heavens, he came yesterday after you’d been.
uz: ...Ibrohim, siz ketgandan so'ng, u kecha keldi.

en: We dined and he talked and talked away, and I could only throw up my hands in despair!
uz: Biz ovqatlanardik, u gapirib, gapirib ketardi, men esa umidsizlikka tushib qo'llarimni tiklab yubora olmadim!

en: Did he come from you?
uz: U sizdan kelib chiqqanmi?

en: But do sit down, for mercy’s sake, sit down!” “No, not from me, but I knew he went to you and why he went,” Raskolnikov answered sharply.
uz: Lekin o'tiring, rahm-shafqat uchun o'tiring!Yo'q, men emas, lekin u sizning oldingizga borayotganini va nima uchun borayotganini bilardim, Raskolnikov keskin javob berdi.

en: “You knew?” “I knew.
uz: You knew? I knew.

en: “Why this, Rodion Romanovitch, that I know more than that about you; I know about everything.
uz: Nima uchun, Rodion Romanovitch, men siz haqingizda bundan ko'ra ko'proq narsani bilaman; men hamma narsani bilaman.

en: I know how you went to take a flat at night when it was dark and how you rang the bell and asked about the blood, so that the workmen and the porter did not know what to make of it.
uz: Kechasi qorong'i bo'lganda, qanday qilib uyni olib ketishingizni va qo'ng'iroqni chaqirib, qon haqida so'rashingizni bilaman, shunda ishchilar va portiyer bu haqda nima deyishlarini bilmas edi.

en: Yes, I understand your state of mind at that time … but you’ll drive yourself mad like that, upon my word!
uz: Ha, men o'sha paytda sizning fikrlash tarzingizni tushunaman ... lekin siz mening so'zimga ko'ra o'zingizni shunday g'alati qilasiz!

en: You’ll lose your head!
uz: Siz boshingizni yo'qotasiz!

en: You’re full of generous indignation at the wrongs you’ve received, first from destiny, and then from the police officers, and so you rush from one thing to another to force them to speak out and make an end of it all, because you are sick of all this suspicion and foolishness.
uz: Siz avval taqdirdan, so'ngra politsiya xodimlaridan o'zingiz uchun sodir etilgan nohaqliklarga nisbatan saxiy g'azabga to'lib-toshgansiz, shuning uchun ularni ovoz chiqarib, bularning barchasini tugatishga majburlash uchun bir narsadan boshqasiga shoshilyapsiz, chunki siz bu barcha shubha va aqlsizlikdan bezovta bo'libsiz.

en: That’s so, isn’t it?
uz: Shunday ekan, shunday emasmi?

en: I have guessed how you feel, haven’t I?
uz: O'zingizning his-tuyg'ularingizni bilaman, shunday emasmi?

en: Only in that way you’ll lose your head and Razumihin’s, too; he’s too good a man for such a position, you must know that.
uz: Faqat shu yo'l bilan boshingizni va razumihinlaringizni ham yo'qotasiz; u bunday lavozimga ega bo'lish uchun juda yaxshi odam, buni bilishingiz kerak.

en: You are ill and he is good and your illness is infectious for him … I’ll tell you about it when you are more yourself.
uz: Siz kasalsiz va u yaxshi va sizning kasalligingiz unga yuqadigan ... Men sizga bu haqda o'zingizdan ko'proq bo'lganingizda aytib beraman.

en: … But do sit down, for goodness’ sake.
uz: Lekin o'tirib ko'ring, xudolar uchun.

en: Please rest, you look shocking, do sit down.” Raskolnikov sat down; he no longer shivered, he was hot all over.
uz: Iltimos, dam oling, siz hayratlanarli ko'rinasiz, o'tiring. Raskolnikov o'tirdi; u endi titragan emas edi, u hamma joyda issiq edi.

en: In amazement he listened with strained attention to Porfiry Petrovitch who still seemed frightened as he looked after him with friendly solicitude.
uz: U hayron bo'lib, Porfiry Petrovitchni diqqat bilan tinglagan va u hali ham qo'rqqanidek ko'rinardi, chunki u unga do'stlik bilan g'amxo'rlik qilardi.

en: But he did not believe a word he said, though he felt a strange inclination to believe.
uz: Ammo u aytgan so'zlariga ishonmadi, ammo o'ziga ishonish uchun o'ziga xos moyillikni his qildi.

en: Porfiry’s unexpected words about the flat had utterly overwhelmed him.
uz: Porfirining xonadonga nisbatan kutilmagan so'zlari uni nihoyatda hayratda qoldirdi.

en: “How can it be, he knows about the flat then,” he thought suddenly, “and he tells it me himself!” “Yes, in our legal practice there was a case almost exactly similar, a case of morbid psychology,” Porfiry went on quickly.
uz: Qanday qilib bo'lishi mumkin, u o'sha paytda xonadon haqida biladi, u to'satdan o'yladi va o'zi menga aytadi! Ha, bizning huquqiy amaliyotimizda deyarli o'xshash holat, kasallik psixologiyasi bo'lgan holat bor edi.

en: “A man confessed to murder and how he kept it up!
uz: Bir kishi qotillikni tan oldi va uni qanday davom ettirdi!

en: It was a regular hallucination; he brought forward facts, he imposed upon everyone and why?
uz: Bu odatdagi hallucinatsiya edi; u faktlarni keltirib chiqardi, u har bir kishiga o'zini majburladi va nima uchun?

en: He had been partly, but only partly, unintentionally the cause of a murder and when he knew that he had given the murderers the opportunity, he sank into dejection, it got on his mind and turned his brain, he began imagining things and he persuaded himself that he was the murderer.
uz: U qisman, lekin qisman, qasddan qotillikning sababchisi bo'lgan va qotillarga imkoniyat berganini bilganida, tushkunlikka tushib qolgan, bu uning ongiga tushdi va ongini o'zgartirdi, u narsalarni tasavvur qila boshladi va o'zini o'zi qotil deb ishontirdi.

en: But at last the High Court of Appeal went into it and the poor fellow was acquitted and put under proper care.
uz: Ammo nihoyat, Oliy Apellatsiya sudi bunga kirdi va kambag'al odam oqlandi va kerakli parvarishlarga joylashtirildi.

en: Thanks to the Court of Appeal!
uz: Apellyatsiya sudi uchun rahmat!

en: Why, my dear fellow, you may drive yourself into delirium if you have the impulse to work upon your nerves, to go ringing bells at night and asking about blood!
uz: Axir, azizim, agar sizda g'azabga to'lish, kechasi quloq qo'yib, qon so'rash istagi bo'lsa, o'zingizni deliriumga olib ketishingiz mumkin!

en: I’ve studied all this morbid psychology in my practice.
uz: O'z amaliyotimda bu kasallik psixologiyasini o'rganganman.

en: is sometimes tempted to jump out of a window or from a belfry.
uz: Ba'zan o'z ko'rinishidan yoki qo'ng'iroq to'plamidan sakrash vasvasasiga duchor bo'ladi.

en: Just the same with bell-ringing.
uz: To'qnashuv bilan ham xuddi shunday.

en: … It’s all illness, Rodion Romanovitch!
uz: Bularning hammasi kasallik, Rodion Romanovitch!

en: You have begun to neglect your illness.
uz: Siz kasalligingizga beparvo bo'la boshladingiz.

en: You should consult an experienced doctor, what’s the good of that fat fellow?
uz: Siz tajribali shifokorga murojaat qilishingiz kerak, shunda bu semiz odamning foydasi nimada?

en: You are lightheaded!
uz: Sen aqlsizsan!

en: You were delirious when you did all this!” For a moment Raskolnikov felt everything going round.
uz: Bularning barchasini bajarganingizda siz deliriyaga tushdingiz! Raskolnikov bir zumda hamma narsa aylanib borayotganini his qildi.

en: “Is it possible, is it possible,” flashed through his mind, “that he is still lying?
uz: Menga mumkinmi, mumkinmi,  o'z ongidan o'tib, u hali ham yolg'on gapirayotganini?

en: He can’t be, he can’t be.” He rejected that idea, feeling to what a degree of fury it might drive him, feeling that that fury might drive him mad.
uz: U bo'lishi mumkin emas, bo'lishi mumkin emas. U bu g'oyani rad etdi, chunki u uni qay darajada g'azablanishiga olib kelishi mumkinligini va bu g'azab uni aqldan ozdirishi mumkinligini his qildi.

en: “I was not delirious.
uz: Men delirli emasdim.

en: I knew what I was doing,” he cried, straining every faculty to penetrate Porfiry’s game, “I was quite myself, do you hear?” “Yes, I hear and understand.
uz: Men nima qilayotganimni bilardim, - deb yig'ladi u, - Porfirining o'yinini o'ynash uchun har bir fakultetni kuchga solib, o'zimni o'zim deb bildim, eshityapsanmi? - Ha, eshitib, tushunaman.

en: You said yesterday you were not delirious, you were particularly emphatic about it!
uz: Kecha siz deliriumli emasligingizni aytdingiz, ayniqsa, bu borada qat'iy e'tirof qildingiz!

en: I understand all you can tell me!
uz: Menga aytadigan hamma narsangizni tushunaman!

en: … Listen, Rodion Romanovitch, my dear fellow.
uz: ... Tinglang, Rodion Romanovitch, aziz do'stim.

en: If you were actually a criminal, or were somehow mixed up in this damnable business, would you insist that you were not delirious but in full possession of your faculties?
uz: Agar siz aslida jinoyatchi bo'lganingizda yoki bu halokatli ishda aralashgan bo'lganingizda, deliryo qilmasligingizni, balki o'z qobiliyatingizni to'liq egallaganligingizni istaysizmi?

en: And so emphatically and persistently?
uz: Va shu qadar qat'iy va qat'iylik bilan?

en: Would it be possible?
uz: Bu mumkinmi?

en: Quite impossible, to my thinking.
uz: O'ylashimcha, to'liq imkonsiz.

en: If you had anything on your conscience, you certainly ought to insist that you were delirious.
uz: Agar vijdoningizda biron narsa bo'lsa, unda siz deliryoda ekanligingizni aytishingiz kerak.

en: That’s so, isn’t it?” There was a note of slyness in this inquiry.
uz: Shunday ekan, shunday emasmi? Ushbu so'rovda kamtarlik belgisi bor edi.

en: Raskolnikov drew back on the sofa as Porfiry bent over him and stared in silent perplexity at him.
uz: Raskolnikov Porfiry uning ustiga o'girilib, unga beparvolik bilan qaraganida, sofaga o'tirdi.

en: “Another thing about Razumihin —you certainly ought to have said that he came of his own accord, to have concealed your part in it!
uz: Razumihin haqida yana bir narsa Siz, albatta, uning o'z xohishi bilan kelganini aytishingiz kerak edi, bu ishda o'zingizning hissangizni yashirish uchun!

en: But you don’t conceal it!
uz: Ammo siz buni yashirmaysiz!

en: You lay stress on his coming at your instigation.” Raskolnikov had not done so.
uz: Siz uning sizning qo'zg'atishingiz bilan kelishiga e'tibor qaratasiz. Raskolnikov buni qilmagan edi.

en: A chill went down his back.
uz: Uning orqasidan sovuq tushdi.

en: “You keep telling lies,” he said slowly and weakly, twisting his lips into a sickly smile, “you are trying again to show that you know all my game, that you know all I shall say beforehand,” he said, conscious himself that he was not weighing his words as he ought.
uz: "Siz yolg'on gapirishni davom ettiryapsiz", - dedi u sekin-sekin, og'izlarini og'ir tabassumga aylantirib, "Siz yana o'zimning o'yinimni bilganingizni, oldindan aytganlarimning barchasini bilganingizni ko'rsatishga harakat qilyapsiz", - dedi u, so'zlariga to'g'ri baho bermayotganini anglab.

en: “You want to frighten me … or you are simply laughing at me …” He still stared at him as he said this and again there was a light of intense hatred in his eyes.
uz: Siz meni qo'rqitmoqchi bo'lasiz ... yoki siz shunchaki menga kulyapsiz ... U hali ham unga shunday gapirganida qarab turardi va yana ko'zlarida kuchli nafrat nurlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: “You keep lying,” he said.
uz: Siz yolg'on gapirishni davom ettirasiz, dedi u.

en: “You know perfectly well that the best policy for the criminal is to tell the truth as nearly as possible … to conceal as little as possible.
uz: Siz yaxshi bilasizki, jinoyatchi uchun eng yaxshi siyosat - haqiqatni imkon qadar yaqin aytish ... imkon qadar kamroq yashirishdir.

en: I don’t believe you!” “What a wily person you are!” Porfiry tittered, “there’s no catching you; you’ve a perfect monomania.
uz: Men sizga ishonmayman!Qanday hiylasiz inson ekansiz! Porfiry tittered,theres no catching you; youve a perfect monomania.

en: So you don’t believe me?
uz: Shunday qilib, menga ishonmayapsizmi?

en: But still you do believe me, you believe a quarter; I’ll soon make you believe the whole, because I have a sincere liking for you and genuinely wish you good.” Raskolnikov’s lips trembled.
uz: Ammo siz hali ham menga ishonasiz, siz to'rtdan bir qismiga ishonasiz; men tez orada sizni butunlay ishonishga majbur qilaman, chunki men sizga chin dildan yoqaman va sizga chin dildan yaxshilik tilayman. Raskolnikov og'izlari titrab ketdi.

en: “Yes, I do,” went on Porfiry, touching Raskolnikov’s arm genially, “you must take care of your illness.
uz: Ha, shunday, men borman, Porfirida ketdim, Raskolnikovning qo'liga aql bilan tegdim, siz kasalligingizga g'amxo'rlik qilishingiz kerak.

en: Besides, your mother and sister are here now; you must think of them.
uz: Bundan tashqari, sizning onangiz va singilingiz hozir bu yerda; siz ular haqida o'ylashingiz kerak.

en: You must soothe and comfort them and you do nothing but frighten them …” “What has that to do with you?
uz: Siz ularni tinchlantirishingiz va tasalli berishingiz kerak va siz ularni qo'rqitishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmaysiz ...  Bu sizga qanday aloqasi bor?

en: What concern is it of yours?
uz: Bu sizni nimaga qiziqtiradi?

en: You are keeping watch on me and want to let me know it?” “Good heavens!
uz: Siz meni kuzatib turyapsiz va buni menga aytmoqchimisiz?Yaxshi osmonlar!

en: Why, I learnt it all from you yourself!
uz: Men hammasini o'zingizdan o'rgandim!

en: You don’t notice that in your excitement you tell me and others everything.
uz: O'zingizning hayajoningiz bilan menga va boshqalarga hamma narsani aytib berayotganingizni sezmaysiz.

en: From Razumihin, too, I learnt a number of interesting details yesterday.
uz: Kecha Razumihindan ham bir qator qiziqarli tafsilotlarni bilib oldim.

en: No, you interrupted me, but I must tell you that, for all your wit, your suspiciousness makes you lose the commonsense view of things.
uz: Yo'q, siz meni to'xtatgansiz, lekin sizga aytishim kerakki, sizning aql-idrokingiz bo'lsa-da, sizning shubhalaringiz sizni hamma narsaga aqlli nuqtai nazaringizni yo'qotishga undaydi.

en: To return to bell-ringing, for instance.
uz: Misol uchun, qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroqlariga qaytish.

en: I, an examining lawyer, have betrayed a precious thing like that, a real fact (for it is a fact worth having), and you see nothing in it!
uz: Men, advokat, bunday qimmatbaho narsani, haqiqiy faktni (chunki bu haqiqatga ega bo'lishga arziydi) so'zlab berdim va siz bunda hech narsa ko'rmaysiz!

en: Why, if I had the slightest suspicion of you, should I have acted like that?
uz: Agar men siz haqingizda hech qanday shubha qilmagan bo'lsam, nega men shunday yo'l tutishim kerak edi?

en: No, I should first have disarmed your suspicions and not let you see I knew of that fact, should have diverted your attention and suddenly have dealt you a knockdown blow (your expression) saying: ‘And what were you doing, sir, pray, at ten or nearly eleven at the murdered woman’s flat and why did you ring the bell and why did you ask about blood?
uz: Yo'q, men avval sizning shubhalaringizni yo'q qilib, bu haqiqatni bilganimni ko'rmasligingiz kerak edi, e'tiboringizni chalg'itib, sizga to'satdan: "U nima qilib yurgansiz, xonim, ibodat qiling, o'n yoki deyarli o'n birlarda o'ldirilgan ayolning xonadonida va nega qo'ng'iroq qildingiz va nega qon haqida so'radingiz?

en: And why did you invite the porters to go with you to the police station, to the lieutenant?’ That’s how I ought to have acted if I had a grain of suspicion of you.
uz: Va nega siz portiyerlarni siz bilan politsiya bo'linmasiga, leytenantga borishga taklif qildingiz? Agar sizdan hech qanday shubha bo'lmasa, men shunday yo'l tutishim kerak edi.

en: I ought to have taken your evidence in due form, searched your lodging and perhaps have arrested you, too … so I have no suspicion of you, since I have not done that!
uz: Men sizning dalillaringizni to'g'ri shaklda olishim kerak edi, uyingizni tekshirib ko'rishim kerak edi va ehtimol sizni ham hibsga olishim kerak edi ... shuning uchun men sizdan hech qanday shubha yo'q, chunki men bunday qilmaganman!

en: But you can’t look at it normally and you see nothing, I say again.”
uz: Ammo siz uni odatda ko'ra olmaysiz va hech narsa ko'rmaysiz, yana aytaman.

en: Raskolnikov started so that Porfiry Petrovitch could not fail to perceive it.
uz: Raskolnikov buni Porfiry Petrovitch tushunib olishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun boshladi.

en: “You are lying all the while,” he cried, “I don’t know your object, but you are lying.
uz: "Siz doimo yolg'on gapiryapsiz", - deb hayqirib yubordi u, "Men sizning maqsadingizni bilmayman, lekin siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz.

en: You did not speak like that just now and I cannot be mistaken!” “I am lying?” Porfiry repeated, apparently incensed, but preserving a good-humoured and ironical face, as though he were not in the least concerned at Raskolnikov’s opinion of him.
uz: Siz hali shunday gapirmadingiz va men xato qilolmayman!  Men yolg'on gapiryapman? Porfiry takrorladi, ko'rinishicha g'azablangan, ammo xushmuomala va ironik yuzini saqlab qolgan, xuddi Raskolnikovning o'zi haqida qanday fikrda bo'lishidan hech qanday tashvishlanmaganidek.

en: “I am lying … but how did I treat you just now, I, the examining lawyer?
uz: Men yolg'on gapiryapman... lekin men, imtihon qiluvchi advokat, sizga qanday munosabatda bo'ldim?

en: Prompting you and giving you every means for your defence; illness, I said, delirium, injury, melancholy and the police officers and all the rest of it?
uz: Sizni rag'batlantirish va sizni himoya qilish uchun barcha vositalarni berish; kasallik, dedim, delirium, jarohat, melanxoniya va politsiya xodimlari va boshqalarning barchasi?

en: Though, indeed, all those psychological means of defence are not very reliable and cut both ways: illness, delirium, I don’t remember —that’s all right, but why, my good sir, in your illness and in your delirium were you haunted by just those delusions and not by any others?
uz: Garchi, haqiqatan ham, bu psixologik himoya vositalarining barchasi juda ishonchli emas va ikki tomondan kesilgan: kasallik, delirium, men eslay olmayman, bu yaxshi, lekin nega, mening yaxshi sirim, sizning kasalligingizda va deliriumingizda faqatgina bu aldamliklar sizni hech kim tomonidan emas, balki o'sha aldamliklar tomonidan qiynalgan?

en: There may have been others, eh?
uz: Boshqalar ham bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin, shundaymi?

en: He-he-he!” Raskolnikov looked haughtily and contemptuously at him.
uz: Raskolnikov unga mag'rur va nohaq ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: “Briefly,” he said loudly and imperiously, rising to his feet and in so doing pushing Porfiry back a little, “briefly, I want to know, do you acknowledge me perfectly free from suspicion or not?
uz: Kincha, u baland ovozda va g'ayrat bilan so'radi, oyoqlariga turib, Porfirni biroz orqaga surib, Kincha, bilmoqchiman, meni shubha ostiga qo'ymaysizmi yoki yo'qmi?

en: Tell me, Porfiry Petrovitch, tell me once for all and make haste!” “What a business I’m having with you!” cried Porfiry with a perfectly good-humoured, sly and composed face.
uz: Menga ayting, Porfiry Petrovitch, menga bir bor va shoshil!Men siz bilan qanday ish olib boryapman! Porfiry juda yaxshi ruhiy tuyg'u, hiyla-nayrang va muloyim yuz bilan baqirdi.

en: “And why do you want to know, why do you want to know so much, since they haven’t begun to worry you?
uz: Va nima uchun siz bilishni xohlaysiz, nima uchun shunchalik ko'p bilishni xohlaysiz, chunki ular sizni xavotirga solmayapti?

en: Why, you are like a child asking for matches!
uz: Axir, siz o'g'il bolaga o'xshash bo'lib, o'yinchoqlar so'raysiz!

en: And why are you so uneasy?
uz: Va nima uchun siz o'zingizni bunday noqulay his qilyapsiz?

en: Why do you force yourself upon us, eh?
uz: Nima uchun bizga o'zingizni majburlaysiz?

en: He-he-he!” “I repeat,” Raskolnikov cried furiously, “that I can’t put up with it!” “With what?
uz: U-u-u!  Men takrorlayman, Raskolnikov g'azabdan yig'ladi, men bunga chiday olmayman!   Nima bilan?

en: Uncertainty?” interrupted Porfiry.
uz: Xavfsizlik Porfiryni to'xtatdi.

en: I tell you I won’t have it.
uz: Men sizga aytamanki, men uni qabul qilmayman.

en: I can’t and I won’t, do you hear, do you hear?” he shouted, bringing his fist down on the table again.
uz: Men qila olmayman va qila olmayman, eshitasizmi, eshitasizmi? - deb baqirib, o'z yumushini yana stol ustiga tashladi.

en: I warn you seriously, take care of yourself.
uz: Sizni jiddiy ogohlantiryapman, o'zingizni ehtiyot qiling.

en: I am not joking,” Porfiry whispered, but this time there was not the look of old womanish good nature and alarm in his face.
uz: Men hazil qilmayapman, - deb shoshirdi Porfiry, - lekin bu safar uning yuziga qadimgi ayollik va qo'rqinchli ko'rinish ko'rinmadi.

en: Now he was peremptory, stern, frowning and for once laying aside all mystification.
uz: Endi u qattiqqo'l, qattiqqo'l, burun egib, bir marta ham barcha xudojo'ylikni chetga qo'ydi.

en: But this was only for an instant.
uz: Ammo bu faqat bir daqiqalik edi.

en: Raskolnikov, bewildered, suddenly fell into actual frenzy, but, strange to say, he again obeyed the command to speak quietly, though he was in a perfect paroxysm of fury.
uz: Raskolnikov hayron bo'lib, to'satdan g'azabga tushdi, ammo g'alati aytish joizki, o'zi qattiq g'azabga to'lgan bo'lsa-da, yana xotirjamlik bilan gapirish buyruqlariga bo'ysundi.

en: “I will not allow myself to be tortured,” he whispered, instantly recognising with hatred that he could not help obeying the command and driven to even greater fury by the thought.
uz: "Men o'zimga azob chekishga yo'l qo'ymayman", - deb shov-shuv qildi u, o'zidan-o'zi buyrug'ga bo'ysunishdan bosh tortolmasligini va bu fikr uni yanada g'azablanishga undadi.

en: “Arrest me, search me, but kindly act in due form and don’t play with me!
uz: Meni hibsga olinglar, qidiringlar, lekin menga o'yin qilmanglar va menga o'yin qilmanglar!

en: Don’t dare!” “Don’t worry about the form,” Porfiry interrupted with the same sly smile, as it were, gloating with enjoyment over Raskolnikov.
uz: form haqida tashvishlanmang, Porfiry Raskolnikovning o'zi bilan o'sha-o'sha g'alati tabassum bilan to'xtatdi.

en: “I invited you to see me quite in a friendly way.” “I don’t want your friendship and I spit on it!
uz: Men sizni do'stona munosabatda bo'lishingizga taklif qildim.Men sizning do'stligingizni xohlamayman va unga tishlayman!

en: And, here, I take my cap and go.
uz: Mana, men kaptamni olib ketaman.

en: What will you say now if you mean to arrest me?” He took up his cap and went to the door.
uz: Agar meni hibsga olishni istasangiz, endi nima deysiz? U qo'lboshini ko'tarib, eshikga bordi.

en: “And won’t you see my little surprise?” chuckled Porfiry, again taking him by the arm and stopping him at the door.
uz: Va siz mening kichik ajablanishimni ko'rmayapsizmi? Porfiry tabassum qilib, yana bir bor uni qo'lidan ushlab, eshik oldida to'xtatdi.

en: He seemed to become more playful and good-humoured, which maddened Raskolnikov.
uz: U ko'proq o'yin-kulgi va humorli bo'lib qoldi, bu esa Raskolnikovni g'azablantirdi.

en: “What surprise?” he asked, standing still and looking at Porfiry in alarm.
uz: Nima ajablanarli? - deb so'radi u, to'xtab turib, Porfiryga qo'rqinchli ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: “My little surprise, it’s sitting there behind the door, he-he-he!” (He pointed to the locked door.) “I locked him in that he should not escape.” “What is it?
uz: Mening kichkina taajjubim, u eshik ortida o'tirgan, he-he-he! (U qulflangan eshikni ko'rsatdi.) Men uni qochmasligi uchun qulflab qo'ydim.  Bu nima?

en: …” Raskolnikov walked to the door and would have opened it, but it was locked.
uz: ... Raskolnikov eshikga yaqinlashib, uni ochgan bo'lar edi, lekin u qulflab qo'yilgan edi.

en: “It’s locked, here is the key!” And he brought a key out of his pocket.
uz: Bu qulflab qo'yilgan, bu yerda kalit bor! Va u o'z qopidan bir kalitni olib chiqdi.

en: “You are lying,” roared Raskolnikov without restraint, “you lie, you damned punchinello!” and he rushed at Porfiry who retreated to the other door, not at all alarmed.
uz: Siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz, Raskolnikov o'zini tuta olmagan holda qichqirib yubordi, siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz, siz la'natlangan punchinello! va u boshqa eshikga qaytgan Porfirga shoshildi, hech qanday tashvishlanmagan.

en: “I understand it all!
uz: Men hamma narsani tushunaman!

en: You are lying and mocking so that I may betray myself to you …” “Why, you could not betray yourself any further, my dear Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Siz yolg'on gapirib, masxara qilyapsiz, shunda men sizga o'zimni topshirishim mumkin ... Nima uchun, siz o'zingizni bundan keyin ham topshirishingiz mumkin emas, aziz Rodion Romanovitch.

en: You are in a passion.
uz: Siz ishtiyoq bilan shug'ullanasiz.

en: Don’t shout, I shall call the clerks.”
uz: Qichqirishni to'xtatmang, men xizmatchilarni chaqiraman.

en: You knew I was ill and tried to work me into a frenzy to make me betray myself, that was your object!
uz: Sen mening kasalligimni bilar eding va o'zimga xiyonat qilishim uchun meni g'alati ishga solishga harakat qilar eding, bu sening maqsading edi!

en: I understand it all.
uz: Men hammasini tushunaman.

en: You’ve no evidence, you have only wretched rubbishly suspicions like Zametov’s!
uz: Sizda hech qanday dalillar yo'q, faqat Zametov kabi g'alati shubhalar bor!

en: You knew my character, you wanted to drive me to fury and then to knock me down with priests and deputies.
uz: Siz mening xarakterimni bilar edingiz, meni g'azablantirib, keyin ruhoniylar va deputatlar bilan o'ldirmoqchi edingiz.

en: … Are you waiting for them?
uz: Siz ularni kutyapsizmi?

en: What are you waiting for?
uz: Nima uchun kutyapsiz?

en: Produce them?” “Why deputies, my good man?
uz: Ularni ishlab chiqarish? Nima uchun deputatlar, yaxshi odam?

en: What things people will imagine!
uz: Odamlar o'zlari tasavvur qiladigan qanday narsalar!

en: And to do so would not be acting in form as you say, you don’t know the business, my dear fellow.
uz: Va buni qilish siz aytganidek, siz biznesni bilmaysiz, aziz do'stim, shaklda harakat qilish emas.

en: … And there’s no escaping form, as you see,” Porfiry muttered, listening at the door through which a noise could be heard.
uz: Va hech qanday qochish shakli yo'q, siz ko'rib turganingizdek, Porfiry gapni eshitib, eshikdan ovoz eshitildi.

en: “Ah, they’re coming,” cried Raskolnikov.
uz: Ah, ular kelayotgan,  deya baqirdi Raskolnikov.

en: “You’ve sent for them!
uz: Siz ularni chaqirtirib yubordingiz!

en: Well, produce them all: your deputies, your witnesses, what you like!
uz: Ularning barchasini ishlab chiqaring: o'rinbosarlaringiz, guvohlaringiz, xohlaganingizcha!

en: … I am ready!” But at this moment a strange incident occurred, something so unexpected that neither Raskolnikov nor Porfiry Petrovitch could have looked for such a conclusion to their interview.
uz: ... Men tayyorman! Ammo o'sha paytda g'alati hodisa sodir bo'ldi, Raskolnikov ham, Porfiry Petrovitch ham intervyularida bunday xulosaga intilmagan darajada kutilmagan narsa.

en: VI When he remembered the scene afterwards, this is how Raskolnikov saw it.
uz: Raskolnikov o'sha voqeani keyinroq eslab qolganida, uni shunday ko'rgan.

en: The noise behind the door increased, and suddenly the door was opened a little.
uz: Eshik orqasidagi shovqin kuchayib bordi va darhol eshik biroz ochildi.

en: “What is it?” cried Porfiry Petrovitch, annoyed.
uz: Nima bu? Porfiry Petrovitch, xafa bo'lib, baqirib yubordi.

en: “Why, I gave orders  …” For an instant there was no answer, but it was evident that there were several persons at the door, and that they were apparently pushing somebody back.
uz: Men buyrug'larimni berdim ... Bir zumda hech qanday javob berilmadi, lekin eshik oldida bir nechta odam turganligi aniq edi va ular, ehtimol, kimnidir orqaga qaytarayotganini ko'rishdi.

en: “What is it?” Porfiry Petrovitch repeated, uneasily.
uz: Nima bu? Porfiry Petrovitch yana bir bor gapni aytdi.

en: “The prisoner Nikolay has been brought,” someone answered.
uz: Qamoqchisi Nikolay olib kelingan, kimdir javob berdi.

en: What’s he doing here?
uz: U bu yerda nima qilyapti?

en: How irregular!” cried Porfiry, rushing to the door.
uz: Qanday ham noaniq! Porfiry qichqirib, eshikga shoshdi.

en: “But he …” began the same voice, and suddenly ceased.
uz: Ammo u o'sha o'sha ovoz bilan boshladi va to'xtadi.

en: Two seconds, not more, were spent in actual struggle, then someone gave a violent shove, and then a man, very pale, strode into the room.
uz: Ikki soniyadan ko'proq vaqt haqiqiy kurashda o'tkazildi, so'ngra kimdir zo'ravonlik bilan shovqin qildi va nihoyat, juda oq bir kishi xonada kirdi.

en: This man’s appearance was at first sight very strange.
uz: Bu odamning tashqi ko'rinishi birinchi qarashda juda g'alati edi.

en: He stared straight before him, as though seeing nothing.
uz: U xuddi hech narsa ko'rmayotgandek, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning oldiga qaradi.

en: There was a determined gleam in his eyes; at the same time there was a deathly pallor in his face, as though he were being led to the scaffold.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida aniq bir yorug'lik bor edi; bir vaqtning o'zida uning yuziga o'limga olib borilayotgandek o'limga sabab bo'lgan bir qora ko'rinish paydo bo'ldi.

en: His white lips were faintly twitching.
uz: Uning oq og'izlari kamdan-kam tiklanayotgan edi.

en: He was dressed like a workman and was of medium height, very young, slim, his hair cut in round crop, with thin spare features.
uz: U ishchi kabi kiyinadi va o'rta balandlikda, juda yosh, chiroyli, sochlarini yuzma-yuz o'lchamda kesib, chiroyli ehtiyot xususiyatlariga ega edi.

en: The man whom he had thrust back followed him into the room and succeeded in seizing him by the shoulder; he was a warder; but Nikolay pulled his arm away.
uz: O'zi orqaga surib yuborgan odam uni xonaga ergashib kirdi va uni yelkasiga qo'yib oldi; u soqchi edi; lekin Nikolay qo'lini olib ketdi.

en: Several persons crowded inquisitively into the doorway.
uz: Bir nechta kishilar eshikga qiziqish bilan kirib kelishdi.

en: Some of them tried to get in.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari kirishga harakat qilishdi.

en: All this took place almost instantaneously.
uz: Bularning barchasi deyarli darhol sodir bo'ldi.

en: “Go away, it’s too soon!
uz: Ochib ketinglar, juda erta!

en: Wait till you are sent for!
uz: Sizni chaqirtirishni kuting!

en: … Why have you brought him so soon?” Porfiry Petrovitch muttered, extremely annoyed, and as it were thrown out of his reckoning.
uz: ... Nega siz uni shuncha tez olib keldingiz? Porfiry Petrovitch g'azablanib, g'azablanib, o'z hisobidan chiqarib yuboribdi.

en: But Nikolay suddenly knelt down.
uz: Ammo Nikolay toʻsatdan tiz choʻkdi.

en: “What’s the matter?” cried Porfiry, surprised.
uz: nima bo'ldi? Porfiry hayron bo'lib, baqirib yubordi.

en: I am the murderer,” Nikolay articulated suddenly, rather breathless, but speaking fairly loudly.
uz: Men qotilman, - dedi Nikolay to'satdan, umuman nafassiz, ammo juda baland ovoz bilan gapirib.
