uz: Katerina Ivanovna o'z o'rinbosari bo'lmagan. Katerina Ivanovna o'z o'rinbosaridan turib, qattiq va ko'rinib turgan tinch ovoz bilan (har holda o'zi oq va ko'kraklari ko'tarilgan bo'lsa-da) Agar u bir daqiqaga o'z dadasi bilan teng bo'lishga jur'at qilsa, Katerina Ivanovna boshini yopib, uni oyoqlari bilan cho'zib qo'yadi. Amaliya Ivanovna xonadan to'shab, u uy egasi ekanligi va Katerina Ivanovna o'sha daqiqa uylardan chiqib ketishi kerakligi haqida qichqiriq qildi. Keyin u bir sababga ko'ra stoldan kumush qoshiqlarni yig'ib olishga shoshildi.

en: There was a great outcry and uproar, the children began crying.
uz: Buyuk qichqiriq va g'alayon bo'ldi, bolalar yig'la boshladilar.

en: Sonia ran to restrain Katerina Ivanovna, but when Amalia Ivanovna shouted something about “the yellow ticket,” Katerina Ivanovna pushed Sonia away, and rushed at the landlady to carry out her threat.
uz: Soniya Katerina Ivanovnaga toʻxtatish uchun yugurib ketdi, lekin Amaliya Ivanovna sariq chipta haqida bir narsa baqirganda, Katerina Ivanovna Soniyani orqaga surib, uy egasiga uyincha qoʻzgʻatdi.

en: At that minute the door opened, and Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin appeared on the threshold.
uz: O'sha daqiqada eshik ochildi va Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin chegara oldida paydo bo'ldi.

en: He stood scanning the party with severe and vigilant eyes.
uz: U qattiq va hushyor ko'zlar bilan partiyani ko'rib turardi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna rushed to him.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna unga yugurib bordi.

en: III “Pyotr Petrovitch,” she cried, “protect me … you at least!
uz: III.Pyotr Petrovitch, u yig'lab yubordi, meni himoya qil... hech bo'lmaganda sen!

en: Make this foolish woman understand that she can’t behave like this to a lady in misfortune … that there is a law for such things.
uz: Bu ahmoq ayolga baxtsiz ayolga bunday munosabatda bo'lish mumkin emasligini tushunishga yordam bering ... bunday narsalar uchun qonun borligini tushuning.

en: … I’ll go to the governor-general himself.
uz: ...Men bosh gubernatorning oldiga o'zim boraman.

en: … She shall answer for it.
uz: ...U buning uchun javob beradi.

en: … Remembering my father’s hospitality protect these orphans.” “Allow me, madam.
uz: Otamning mehmondo'stligini eslab, bu yetimlarni himoya qilaman.

en: … Allow me.” Pyotr Petrovitch waved her off.
uz: ... Menga ruxsat bering. Pyotr Petrovitch uni qo'lga oldi.

en: “Your papa as you are well aware I had not the honour of knowing” (someone laughed aloud) “and I do not intend to take part in your everlasting squabbles with Amalia Ivanovna.
uz: Sizning otangiz yaxshi biladiganidek, men bilishim sharafiga ega emasman (kimdir baland ovoz bilan kuldi)  va men Amaliya Ivanovna bilan doimo bahslashayotganingizda ishtirok etishni xohlamayman.

en: … I have come here to speak of my own affairs … and I want to have a word with your stepdaughter, Sofya … Ivanovna, I think it is?
uz: Men bu yerga o'z ishlarim haqida gapirish uchun keldim va o'g'il qizingiz Sofiya bilan suhbatlashmoqchiman.

en: Allow me to pass.” Pyotr Petrovitch, edging by her, went to the opposite corner where Sonia was.
uz: Men o'tishimga ruxsat bering. Pyotr Petrovitch uning yonidan o'tib, Sonia turgan o'zga burchakga ketdi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna remained standing where she was, as though thunderstruck.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna o'zi turgan joyda turib, xuddi g'alati bo'lib qolgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: She could not understand how Pyotr Petrovitch could deny having enjoyed her father’s hospitality.
uz: U Pyotr Petrovitchning otasining mehmondo'stligidan zavqlanishini inkor etishini tushunmagan.

en: Though she had invented it herself, she believed in it firmly by this time.
uz: Garchi uni o'zi ixtiro qilgan bo'lsa-da, u o'sha paytgacha unga qattiq ishonardi.

en: She was struck too by the businesslike, dry and even contemptuous menacing tone of Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: U ham Pyotr Petroviçning biznesga o'xshash, quruq va hatto haqoratli qo'rqinchli so'zlaridan hayratda qoldi.

en: All the clamour gradually died away at his entrance.
uz: O'zining kirish yo'lida butun shov-shuv bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Not only was this “serious business man” strikingly incongruous with the rest of the party, but it was evident, too, that he had come upon some matter of consequence, that some exceptional cause must have brought him and that therefore something was going to happen.
uz: Ushbu "jizgi biznesmen" nafaqat partiyaning qolgan qismi bilan keskin zid edi, balki u qandaydir muhim masala bilan shug'ullanayotganini ham ko'rsatdi, uni biron bir noyob sabab olib kelgan bo'lishi kerak edi va shuning uchun biror narsa sodir bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Raskolnikov, standing beside Sonia, moved aside to let him pass; Pyotr Petrovitch did not seem to notice him.
uz: Raskolnikov, Sonia yonida turib, uni o'tkazib yuborish uchun bir chetga o'tdi; Pyotr Petrovitch uni ko'rmagan ko'rinardi.

en: A minute later Lebeziatnikov, too, appeared in the
uz: Bir daqiqa o'tgach, Lebeziatnikov ham qo'lga kiritildi.

en: doorway; he did not come in, but stood still, listening with marked interest, almost wonder, and seemed for a time perplexed.
uz: U eshikdan o'tib kirmadi, lekin o'rnida turib, qiziqish bilan tingladi, deyarli hayron bo'ldi va biroz g'alati ko'rindi.

en: “Excuse me for possibly interrupting you, but it’s a matter of some importance,” Pyotr Petrovitch observed, addressing the company generally.
uz: Mening sizni to'xtatishim uchun uzr so'raysiz, lekin bu muhim masala", - dedi Pyotr Petrovitch, kompaniyani umuman murojaat qilib.

en: “I am glad indeed to find other persons present.
uz: Haqiqatan ham boshqa odamlarni ko'rishdan xursandman.

en: Amalia Ivanovna, I humbly beg you as mistress of the house to pay careful attention to what I have to say to Sofya Ivanovna.
uz: Amaliya Ivanovna, uy egasi sifatida sizdan kamtarlik ila so'raymanki, Sofiya Ivanovnaga aytadigan so'zlarimga diqqatli bo'ling.

en: Sofya Ivanovna,” he went on, addressing Sonia, who was very much surprised and already alarmed, “immediately after your visit I found that a hundred- rouble note was missing from my table, in the room of my friend Mr.
uz: Sofiya Ivanovna, u davom etdi, Soniaga murojaat qildi, u juda hayratda va endi xavotirda edi,Sizning tashrifingizdan so'ng men yuz rubllik qog'ozning stolimdan yo'qolganini ko'rdim, do'stimning xonadoni Mr.ning xonadoni.

en: If in any way whatever you know and will tell us where it is now, I assure you on my word of honour and call all present to witness that the matter shall end there.
uz: Agar siz biron bir narsani bilsangiz va hozir u qaerda ekanligini bizga aytsangiz, men sizlarni o'z shodligim bilan ishontiraman va barcha ishtirokchilarni bu masalaga guvoh bo'lishga chaqiraman.

en: In the opposite case I shall be compelled to have recourse to very serious measures and then … you must blame yourself.” Complete silence reigned in the room.
uz: Aks holda men jiddiy choralar ko'rishga majbur bo'laman va keyin ... o'zingizni ayblashingiz kerak. Xonada to'liq sukut hukmronlik qildi.

en: Even the crying children were still.
uz: Hatto yig'layotgan bolalar ham jim edilar.

en: Sonia stood deadly pale, staring at Luzhin and unable to say a word.
uz: Sonia o'limdan ko'z yumgan holda, Luzhinga qaragan va so'z aytolmagan edi.

en: She seemed not to understand.
uz: U buni tushunmayotgandek ko'rinardi.

en: Some seconds passed.
uz: Bir necha soniya o'tdi.

en: “Well, how is it to be then?” asked Luzhin, looking intently at her.
uz: Xo'sh, o'shanda qanday bo'ladi? - deb so'radi Lujin, unga diqqat bilan qarab.

en: … I know nothing about it,” Sonia articulated faintly at last.
uz: ... Men bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman, - Sonia oxir-oqibat so'zlab berdi.

en: “No, you know nothing?” Luzhin repeated and again he paused for some seconds.
uz: Yo'q, sen hech narsa bilmaysanmi? Luzhin bir necha marta takrorladi va bir necha soniya to'xtadi.

en: “Think a moment, mademoiselle,” he began severely, but still, as it were, admonishing her.
uz: Bir daqiqa o'ylab ko'ring, mademoiselle, u qattiq boshlandi, ammo hali ham, shunday qilib aytganda, unga maslahat berishni boshladi.

en: “Reflect, I am prepared to give you time for consideration.
uz: Refleks, men sizga o'ylash uchun vaqt berishga tayyorman.

en: Kindly observe this: if I were not so entirely convinced I should not, you may be sure, with my experience venture to accuse you so directly.
uz: Iltimos, buni e'tiborga oling: agar men o'zimni shu qadar qat'iy ishontirmagan bo'lsam, o'z tajribam bilan sizni shu qadar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ayblashga jur'at qilmasdim.

en: Seeing that for such direct accusation before witnesses, if false or even mistaken, I should myself in a certain sense be made responsible, I am aware of that.
uz: Agar guvohlar oldida bunday to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ayblov yolg'on bo'lsa yoki hatto noto'g'ri bo'lsa, bu uchun men o'zim ham muayyan ma'noda javobgar bo'lishim kerakligini ko'rib, shundan xabardorman.

en: This morning I changed for my own purposes several five-percent securities for the sum of approximately three thousand roubles.
uz: Bugun ertalab men taxminan uch ming rubl miqdorida bir nechta besh foizlik qimmatli qog'ozlarni o'z maqsadlarim uchun almashtirdim.

en: The account is noted down in my pocketbook.
uz: Hisobnomani mening pokemda qayd etganman.

en: On my return home I proceeded to count the money —as Mr.
uz: Uyga qaytganimda pulni Mr.

en: Lebeziatnikov will bear witness —and after counting two thousand three hundred roubles I put the rest in my pocketbook in my coat pocket.
uz: Lebeziatnikov guvohlik beradi va ikki ming uch yuz rublni hisoblab chiqqanimdan so'ng qoldiqni ham kiyim kiyimimga qo'ydim.

en: About five hundred roubles remained on the table and among them three notes of a hundred roubles each.
uz: O'sha yerda taxminan besh yuz rubl va ularning orasida har biri yuz rubllik uchta qog'oz qoldi.

en: At that moment you entered (at my
uz: O'sha paytda siz kirganingizda (o'zimning uyimga) kirgansiz.

en: invitation) —and all the time you were present you were exceedingly embarrassed; so that three times you jumped up in the middle of the conversation and tried to make off.
uz: taklif)  va siz hozir bo'lgan vaqt davomida juda uyalgan edingiz; shuning uchun uch marta suhbatning o'rtasida o'tib ketib, qochishga harakat qildingiz.

en: Lebeziatnikov can bear witness to this.
uz: Lebeziatnikov bunga guvoh bo'lishi mumkin.

en: You yourself, mademoiselle, probably will not refuse to confirm my statement that I invited you through Mr.
uz: Siz ham, mademoiselle, ehtimol, sizni Mr. orqali taklif qilganimni tasdiqlashni rad etmaysiz.

en: Lebeziatnikov, solely in order to discuss with you the hopeless and destitute position of your relative, Katerina Ivanovna (whose dinner I was unable to attend), and the advisability of getting up something of the nature of a subscription, lottery or the like, for her benefit.
uz: Lebeziatnikov, faqat sizning qarindoshingiz Katerina Ivanovna (men uning kechki ovqatida qatnasholmadim) ning umidsiz va qashshoq holatini va uning foydasiga obuna, lotereya yoki shunga o'xshash narsalardan foydalanishni maslahatlashishni siz bilan muhokama qilish uchun.

en: You thanked me and even shed tears.
uz: Siz menga minnatdorchilik bildirgansiz va hatto ko'zlaringizga yosh oqib ketdi.

en: I describe all this as it took place, primarily to recall it to your mind and secondly to show you that not the slightest detail has escaped my recollection.
uz: Men bularning barchasini sodir bo'lganidek tasvirlayman, birinchi navbatda, buni ongingizga eslatish va ikkinchi navbatda, eng kichik tafsilot ham xotiramdan chetda qolmaganini ko'rsatish uchun.

en: Then I took a ten- rouble note from the table and handed it to you by way of first instalment on my part for the benefit of your relative.
uz: So'ngra men stoldan o'n rubllik qog'ozni olib, qarindoshingiz foydasiga o'zim tomonidan birinchi qism sifatida sizga topshirdim.

en: Lebeziatnikov saw all this.
uz: Lebeziatnikov bularning barchasini ko'rdi.

en: Then I accompanied you to the door — you being still in the same state of embarrassment —after which, being left alone with Mr.
uz: Keyin men sizni eshikgacha kuzatib bordim  siz hali ham o'sha o'sha o'yinda o'zingizni noqulay his qilyapsiz Sundan so'ng, Mr. bilan yolg'iz qolish.

en: Lebeziatnikov I talked to him for ten minutes —then Mr.
uz: Lebeziatnikov Men u bilan o'n daqiqa suhbatlashdim.

en: Lebeziatnikov went out and I returned to the table with the money lying on it, intending to count it and to put it aside, as I proposed doing before.
uz: Lebeziatnikov tashqariga chiqib, men pulni o'rnatgan holda stolga qaytib keldim va oldindan taklif qilganimdek, uni hisoblab qo'yib qo'yib qo'yishni rejalashtirdim.

en: To my surprise one hundred-rouble note had disappeared.
uz: Men hayron bo'lganimcha, yuz rubllik qog'oz yo'qoldi.

en: Kindly consider the position.
uz: Iltimos, pozitsiyani ko'rib chiqing.

en: Lebeziatnikov I cannot suspect.
uz: Lebeziatnikov Men shubhalanolmayman.

en: I am ashamed to allude to such a supposition.
uz: Bunday taxminni aytishdan uyalmayman.

en: I cannot have made a mistake in my reckoning, for the minute before your entrance I had finished my accounts and found the total correct.
uz: Hisob-kitobimda xato qilolmasdim, chunki sizning kirishingizdan bir daqiqa oldin hisob-kitoblarimni tugatdim va to'liq to'g'ri topdim.

en: You will admit that recollecting your embarrassment, your eagerness to get away and the fact that you kept your hands for some time on the table, and taking into consideration your social position and the habits associated with it, I was, so to say, with horror and positively against my will, compelled to entertain a suspicion —a cruel, but justifiable suspicion!
uz: Siz shuni tan olishingiz kerakki, o'zingizning o'zingizni qo'rqitganingizni, qochib ketishga intilayotganingizni va qo'llaringizni bir muncha vaqt davomida stol ustida saqlaganingizni eslab, ijtimoiy mavqeyangizni va bu bilan bog'liq odatlarni hisobga olgan holda, men qo'rqinch bilan va xohishimga qarshi, shafqatsiz, ammo asosli shubha bilan shubha ostiga qo'yishga majbur bo'ldim!

en: I will add further and repeat that in spite of my positive conviction, I realise that I run a certain risk in making this accusation, but as you see, I could not let it pass.
uz: Keyinroq qo'shaman va yana aytamanki, ijobiy e'tiqodimga qaramay, bu ayblovni qo'yib berish bilan biroz xavf tug'dirayotganimni anglayman, ammo ko'rib turganingizdek, men buni o'tkazib yuborolmasdim.

en: I have taken action and I will tell you why: solely, madam, solely, owing to your black ingratitude!
uz: Men chora ko'rdim va nima uchun: faqat, xonim, faqat sizning qora minnatdorchiliksizligingiz tufayli!

en: I invite you for the benefit of your destitute relative, I present you with my donation of ten roubles and you, on the spot, repay me for all that with such an action.
uz: Sizni kambag'al qarindoshingiz foydasiga taklif qilaman, sizga o'n rubllik ehsonimni taqdim etaman va siz o'sha joyda menga bunday harakat bilan barcha narsani qaytarasiz.

en: Moreover, like a true friend I beg you —and you
uz: Bundan tashqari, chin do'st sifatida senga va senga iltijo qilaman.

en: could have no better friend at this moment —think what you are doing, otherwise I shall be immovable!
uz: Hozirgi paytda mendan yaxshiroq do'stim bo'lmas edi, nima qilayotganingizni o'ylab ko'ring, aks holda men ko'tarilmayman!

en: Well, what do you say?” “I have taken nothing,” Sonia whispered in terror, “you gave me ten roubles, here it is, take it.” Sonia pulled her handkerchief out of her pocket, untied a corner of it, took out the ten-rouble note and gave it to Luzhin.
uz: Xo'sh, nima deysiz? Men hech narsa olmaganman, Sonia qo'rquvdan shovqin qildi, siz menga o'n rubl berdi, bu erda, uni oling. Sonia to'fonini qopqoqidan chiqarib, uning burchasiga bog'liq bo'lmagan, o'n rubllik notani olib chiqib, Lushinga berdi.

en: “And the hundred roubles you do not confess to taking?” he insisted reproachfully, not taking the note.
uz: "Siz qabul qilmagan yuz rubllar haqida nima deyish mumkin?" - dedi u tanqid qilib, notani qabul qilmay.

en: Sonia looked about her.
uz: Sonia uning atrofini ko'rdi.

en: All were looking at her with such awful, stern, ironical, hostile eyes.
uz: Hammasi unga dahshatli, qattiq, ironik va dushman ko'zlar bilan qarayotgan edi.

en: She looked at Raskolnikov … he stood against the wall, with his arms crossed, looking at her with glowing eyes.
uz: U Raskolnikovga qaradi... u qo'llarini o'girib, devorga qarshi turib, qizg'in ko'zlar bilan unga qaradi.

en: “Good God!” broke from Sonia.
uz: Good God! Sonia-dan ajraldi.

en: “Amalia Ivanovna, we shall have to send word to the police and therefore I humbly beg you meanwhile to send for the house porter,” Luzhin said softly and even kindly.
uz: Amaliya Ivanovna, biz politsiyaga xabar yuborishimiz kerak bo'ladi va shuning uchun men sizdan kamtarinlik bilan iltimos qilamanki, shu vaqt ichida uyning portieriga xabar yuboring, Luzhin muloyimlik va hatto mehribonlik bilan aytdi.

en: “Gott der Barmherzige!
uz: Rahmdillik Xudosi!

en: I knew she was the thief,” cried Amalia Ivanovna, throwing up her hands.
uz: U o'g'ri ekanligini bilardim, - deb yig'ladi Amaliya Ivanovna qo'llarini ko'tarib.

en: “You knew it?” Luzhin caught her up, “then I suppose you had some reason before this for thinking so.
uz: Siz buni bilar edingizmi?Luzhin uni ushlab qoldi, Shundan oldin sizda shunday fikr yuritishga sabab bo'lgan deb o'ylayman.

en: I beg you, worthy Amalia Ivanovna, to remember your words which have been uttered before witnesses.” There was a buzz of loud conversation on all sides.
uz: Sizdan, munosib Amaliya Ivanovna, guvohlar oldida aytgan so'zlaringizni eslab qolishingizni iltimos qilaman. Har tarafdan baland ovozda suhbatlar bo'lgan.

en: All were in movement.
uz: Hammasi harakatda edi.

en: “What!” cried Katerina Ivanovna, suddenly realising the position, and she rushed at Luzhin.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna qichqirib: "Nima!!" - dedi va to'satdan o'z vazifasini tushunib, Luzhinga yugurdi.

en: You accuse her of stealing?
uz: Siz uni o'g'irlikda ayblaysizmi?

en: Ah, the wretches, the wretches!” And running to Sonia she flung her wasted arms round her and held her as in a vise.
uz: Ah, kambag'allar, kambag'allar! Soniaga yugurib borib, o'z qo'llarini o'ziga tashladi va uni o'ziga o'xshatdi.

en: how dared you take ten roubles from him?
uz: Qanday qilib undan o'n rublni olib ketishga jur'at qildingiz?

en: Give me the ten roubles at once —here!” And snatching the note from Sonia, Katerina Ivanovna crumpled it up and flung it straight into Luzhin’s face.
uz: O'nta rublni bir vaqtning o'zida menga bering here! Katerina Ivanovna Sonia-dan notani olib ketib, uni bo'g'ib tashladi va Luzhinning yuziga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tashladi.

en: It hit him in the eye and fell on the ground.
uz: U uning ko'ziga urib, yerga yiqildi.

en: Amalia Ivanovna hastened to pick it up.
uz: Amaliya Ivanovna uni ko'tarib olishga shoshildi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch lost his temper.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch o'z g'azabini yo'qotdi.

en: “Hold that mad woman!” he shouted.
uz: O'sha aqldan ozgan ayolni ushlab turing! - deb baqirdi u.

en: At that moment several other persons, besides Lebeziatnikov, appeared in the doorway, among them the two ladies.
uz: O'sha paytda Lebeziatnikovdan tashqari boshqa bir necha kishi eshikda paydo bo'ldi, ularning orasida ikkita ayol ham bor edi.

en: Idiot!” shrieked Katerina Ivanovna.
uz: Aqlsiz! - deb qichqirdi Katerina Ivanovna.

en: “You are an idiot yourself, pettifogging lawyer, base man!
uz: Siz o'zingiz ham ahmoqsiz, pettifogging advokat, begona odam!

en: Sonia, Sonia take his money!
uz: Sonia, Sonia uning pulini ol!

en: Why, she’d give away her last penny!” and Katerina Ivanovna broke into hysterical laughter.
uz: Axir, u o'zining so'nggi pulini berardi-ku! va Katerina Ivanovna histerik tabassumga tushdi.

en: “Did you ever see such an idiot?” she turned from side to side.
uz: Siz hech qachon bunday axloqsizni ko'rganmisiz? U yonma-yon o'girilib ketdi.

en: “And you too?” she suddenly saw the landlady, “and you too, sausage eater, you declare that she is a thief, you trashy Prussian hen’s leg in a crinoline!
uz: Siz ham? u birdan uy egasini ko'rdi, Siz ham, sovut yegan, u o'g'ri deb e'lon qilasiz, siz piyodalik prussiyalik qo'zilar!

en: She hasn’t been out of this room: she came straight from you, you wretch, and sat down beside me, everyone saw her.
uz: U bu xonadan chiqmagan: u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sizdan kelib keldi, betakror, va men yonimga o'tiribdi, hamma uni ko'rdi.

en: She sat here, by Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: U Rodion Romanovitch tomonidan shu yerda o'tirgan.

en: Since she’s not left the room, the money would have to be on her!
uz: U xonadan chiqib ketmagan ekan, pul uning zimmasida bo'lishi kerak!

en: Search her, search her!
uz: Uni qidiring, uni qidiring!

en: But if you don’t find it, then excuse me, my dear fellow, you’ll answer for it!
uz: Ammo agar topmasangiz, kechirim so'raysiz, aziz do'stim, siz javob berasiz!

en: I’ll go to our Sovereign, to our Sovereign, to our gracious Tsar himself, and throw myself at his feet, today, this minute!
uz: Men hukmdorimizga, hukmdorimizga, mehribon shohimizning o'ziga borib, bugun, shu daqiqada uning oyoqlariga o'zimni tashlayman!

en: I am alone in the world!
uz: Dunyoda yolg'izman!

en: They would let me in!
uz: Ular meni kirishga ruxsat berishardi!

en: Do you think they wouldn’t?
uz: Sizningcha, ular bunday qilmasmidi?

en: You’re wrong, I will get in!
uz: Siz xato qilyapsiz, men kiraman!

en: You reckoned on her meekness!
uz: Uning muloyimligiga ishonasiz!

en: You relied upon that!
uz: Siz bunga tayanardingiz!

en: But I am not so submissive, let me tell you!
uz: Ammo men o'sha qadar itoatkor emasman, sizga aytaman!

en: You’ve gone too far yourself.
uz: Siz o'zingiz ham juda uzoqga borgansiz.

en: Search her, search her!” And Katerina Ivanovna in a frenzy shook Luzhin and dragged him towards Sonia.
uz: Uni qidiring, uni qidiring! Katerina Ivanovna g'azabda Luzhinni silkitdi va uni Sonia tomon quvib olib ketdi.

en: “I am ready, I’ll be responsible … but calm yourself, madam, calm yourself.
uz: Men tayyorman, men mas'ul bo'laman... lekin o'zingizni tinch tuting, xonim, o'zingizni tinch tuting.

en: I see that you are not so submissive!
uz: Ko'rib turibmanki, siz o'ta itoatkor emassiz!

en: … Well, well, but as to that …” Luzhin muttered, “that ought to be before the police … though indeed there are witnesses enough as it is.
uz: Xo'sh, yaxshi, lekin bu haqda ... Luzhin gapirib berdi, bu politsiya oldida bo'lishi kerak edi ... garchi, aslida ko'pgina guvohlar mavjud bo'lsa ham.

en: … But in any case it’s difficult for a man … on account of her sex.
uz: Ammo erkak kishi uchun jinsiy nuqtai nazaridan qiyin bo'ladi.

en: … But with the help of Amalia Ivanovna … though, of course, it’s not the way to do things.
uz: Ammo Amaliya Ivanovnaning yordami bilan, albatta, bu yo'l yo'q.

en: … How is it to be done?” “As you will!
uz: ... Qanday qilib amalga oshirilishi kerak?Siz xohlaganidek!

en: Let anyone who likes search her!” cried Katerina Ivanovna.
uz: Kimni xohlasa, uni qidirsin! dedi Katerina Ivanovna.

en: “Sonia, turn out your pockets!
uz: Sonia, o'zingizning to'plaringizni ochinglar!

en: Look, monster, the pocket is empty, here was her handkerchief!
uz: Qarang, qudratli haykal, bu yerda uning to'pkasi bor edi!

en: Here is the other pocket, look!
uz: Mana, yana bir qoshiq, ko'ring!

en: D’you see, d’you see?” And Katerina Ivanovna turned —or rather snatched —both pockets inside out.
uz: Ko'ryapsanmi, ko'ryapsanmi? Katerina Ivanovna o'girilib ketdi yoki ikkitasining ham qadoqlarini o'rab oldi.

en: But from the right pocket a piece of paper flew out and describing a parabola in the air fell at Luzhin’s feet.
uz: Ammo o'ng kiyimdan qog'oz parvoz qilib chiqib, havoda parabola tasvirlangan qog'oz Luzhinning oyoqlariga tushib qoldi.

en: Everyone saw it, several cried out.
uz: Buni hamma ko'rdi, ba'zilari esa baqirib yubordilar.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch stooped down, picked up the
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch yerga yiqilib, qo'llarini ko'tarib oldi.

en: paper in two fingers, lifted it where all could see it and opened it.
uz: qog'ozni ikki barmog'i bilan qo'yib, uni hamma ko'rish uchun ko'tarib, ochib qo'ydi.

en: It was a hundred-rouble note folded in eight.
uz: Bu yuz rubllik qog'oz, sakkiz ga to'g'rilangan.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch held up the note showing it to everyone.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch notani ko'tarib, hammaga ko'rsatdi.

en: Police, police!” yelled Amalia Ivanovna.
uz: Politsiya, politsiya! - deb baqirib yubordi Amaliya Ivanovna.

en: “They must to Siberia be sent!
uz: Ular Sibirga jo'natilishi kerak!

en: Away!” Exclamations arose on all sides.
uz: Har tarafdan g'alaba qozongandi.

en: Raskolnikov was silent, keeping his eyes fixed on Sonia, except for an occasional rapid glance at Luzhin.
uz: Raskolnikov sukut saqlab, Soniaga ko'z tikdi, faqat Luzhinga tez-tez nazar tashladi.

en: Sonia stood still, as though unconscious.
uz: Sonia o'zini befarq deb o'ylab, to'xtadi.

en: She was hardly able to feel surprise.
uz: U o'zini ajablantiruvchi his qila olmadi.

en: Suddenly the colour rushed to her cheeks; she uttered a cry and hid her face in her hands.
uz: Toʻsatdan rang uning yigʻinlariga tushib ketdi; u yigʻlab yubordi va yuzini qoʻllarida yashirdi.

en: I know nothing about it,” she cried with a heartrending wail, and she ran to Katerina Ivanovna, who clasped her tightly in her arms, as though she would shelter her from all the world.
uz: Men bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman, u yurakni og'irlab yig'lab, Katerina Ivanovna tomon yugurdi va u uni butun dunyodan himoya qiladi deb, uni qo'llariga qattiq bog'ladi.

en: You see, I don’t believe it!” she cried in the face of the obvious fact, swaying her to and fro in her arms like a baby, kissing her face continually, then snatching at her hands and kissing them, too, “you took it!
uz: Ko'ryapsizmi, men ishonmayman! u aniq faktga qaraganda yig'ladi, uni chaqaloq kabi qo'llarida o'rab, yuzini uzluksiz o'padi, keyin qo'llarini o'rab, ularni ham o'padi, siz uni olding!

en: How stupid these people are!
uz: Bu odamlar qanchalik ahmoqlar!

en: You are fools, fools,” she cried, addressing the whole room, “you don’t know, you don’t know what a heart she has, what a girl she is!
uz: Sizlar ahmoqlarsiz, ahmoqlarsiz, u yig'lab, butun xonada gapirmoqda, siz bilmaysiz, uning qanday yuragi borligini, qanday qiz ekanligini bilmaysiz!

en: She’d sell her last rag, she’d go barefoot to help you if you needed it, that’s what she is!
uz: U o'zining so'nggi to'plamini sotadi, agar sizga kerak bo'lsa, sizga yordam berish uchun yalang'och bo'lib ketadi, bu uning o'zi!

en: She has the yellow passport because my children were starving, she sold herself for us!
uz: Uning sariq pasporti bor, chunki mening bolalarim ochlikdan o'lishgan, o'zini biz uchun sotgan!

en: Ah, husband, husband!
uz: Ah, er, er!

en: What a memorial dinner for you!
uz: Bu siz uchun qanday xotira kechki ovqatidir!

en: Defend her, why are you all standing still?
uz: Uni himoya qiling, nima uchun hammangiz to'xtamay turibsiz?

en: Rodion Romanovitch, why don’t you stand up for her?
uz: Rodion Romanovitch, nima uchun siz uning tarafida turibsiz?

en: Do you believe it, too?
uz: Siz ham bunga ishonasizmi?

en: You are not worth her little finger, all of you together!
uz: Sizlar uning kichkina barmog'iga arziydigan emassiz, hammangiz birga!

en: Defend her now, at least!” The wail of the poor, consumptive, helpless woman seemed to produce a great effect on her audience.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda uni hozir himoya qiling! kambag'al, iste'molchi va yordamsiz ayolning yig'i-sig'i tinglovchilariga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: The agonised, wasted, consumptive face, the parched bloodstained lips, the hoarse voice, the tears unrestrained as a child’s, the trustful, childish and yet despairing prayer for help were so piteous that everyone seemed to feel for her.
uz: Og'riq chekkan, sarf-xarajatli, iste'molchi yuz, qon bilan to'ldirilgan tilaklar, qo'rqinchli ovoz, bolalikdagi o'z ko'z yoshlari, ishonchli, bolalik kabi va ammo yordam so'rab umidsiz ibodatlar shunchalik achinarli ediki, hamma unga nisbatan hissa qo'shgan edi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch at any rate was at once moved to compassion.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, albatta, darhol rahmdillikka tushdi.

en: “Madam, madam, this incident does not reflect upon you!” he cried impressively, “no one would take upon himself to accuse you of
uz: "Xonim, xonim, bu hodisa sizda aks etmaydi!" - deb hayqirdi u, hech kim sizni ayblashga tayyor emas.

en: being an instigator or even an accomplice in it, especially as you have proved her guilt by turning out her pockets, showing that you had no previous idea of it.
uz: Bu ishda qo'zg'atuvchi yoki hatto sherik bo'lish, ayniqsa, siz uning jabrini to'kib, uning aybdorligini isbotlaganingiz uchun, bu sizning bu haqda oldindan hech qanday tasavvuringiz bo'lmaganligini ko'rsatadi.

en: I am most ready, most ready to show compassion, if poverty, so to speak, drove Sofya Semyonovna to it, but why did you refuse to confess, mademoiselle?
uz: Agar kambag'allik Sofya Semyonovnaga bunday yo'l tutishga sabab bo'lsa, men juda ham tayyorman, juda hamdardman, lekin nega siz tan olishdan bosh tortdingiz, mademoiselle?

en: Were you afraid of the disgrace?
uz: Siz sharmandalikdan qo'rqardingizmi?

en: You lost your head, perhaps?
uz: Ehtimol, boshingizni yo'qotib qo'ydingiz?

en: One can quite understand it.
uz: Buni yaxshi tushunish mumkin.

en: … But how could you have lowered yourself to such an action?
uz: Ammo qanday qilib siz o'zingizni bunday harakatga tushirgan bo'la olasiz?

en: Gentlemen,” he addressed the whole company, “gentlemen!
uz: Hazratlar, u butun kompaniyaga murojaat qildi, hazratlar!

en: Compassionate and, so to say, commiserating these people, I am ready to overlook it even now in spite of the personal insult lavished upon me!
uz: Ushbu odamlarga rahmdillik ko'rsatib, shunday deyish mumkinki, ularga rahmdillik ko'rsatib, men o'zimga qilingan shaxsiy haqoratga qaramay, hozir ham buni e'tiborsiz qoldirishga tayyorman!

en: And may this disgrace be a lesson to you for the future,” he said, addressing Sonia, “and I will carry the matter no further.
uz: Va bu sharmandalik kelajak uchun sizga saboq bo'lsin, - dedi u, Soniaga murojaat qilib, - va men bu mavzuni bundan keyin ham davom ettirmayman.

en: Enough!” Pyotr Petrovitch stole a glance at Raskolnikov.
uz: Yetarli! Pyotr Petrovitch Raskolnikovga bir nazar tashladi.

en: Their eyes met, and the fire in Raskolnikov’s seemed ready to reduce him to ashes.
uz: Ularning ko'zlari uchrashdi va Raskolnikovning otashi uni kulga aylantirishga tayyor bo'lib ko'rindi.

en: Meanwhile Katerina Ivanovna apparently heard nothing.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Katerina Ivanovna hech narsa eshitmadi.

en: She was kissing and hugging Sonia like a madwoman.
uz: U Soniaga o'ziga o'xshaydigan, aqldan ozgan ayol kabi o'zini o'g'ib, quchoqlab yurardi.

en: The children, too, were embracing Sonia on all sides, and Polenka —though she did not fully understand what was wrong —was drowned in tears and shaking with sobs, as she hid her pretty little face, swollen with weeping, on Sonia’s shoulder.
uz: Bolalar ham Soniaga qo'l urishardi, Polenka nima yomonligini to'liq tushunmagan bo'lsa-da, ko'z yoshlari bilan cho'kib, yig'lab-ichib, o'zining go'zal, yig'lab-ichib ketgan yuzini Sonia yelkasiga yashirib qo'ydi.

en: “How vile!” a loud voice cried suddenly in the doorway.
uz: Qachonki, eshikdan birdan baland bir ovoz qichqirib yubordi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch looked round quickly.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch tezda atrofini ko'rdi.

en: “What vileness!” Lebeziatnikov repeated, staring him straight in the face.
uz: Qanday yomonlik! Lebeziatnikov yana aytdi va unga to'g'ri qaradi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch gave a positive start —all noticed it and recalled it afterwards.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch ijobiy boshlangan. Hamma buni payqadi va keyinchalik eslab qo'ydi.

en: Lebeziatnikov strode into the room.
uz: Lebeziatnikov xonadonga kirib keldi.

en: “And you dared to call me as witness?” he said, going up to Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: "Va siz meni guvoh sifatida chaqirishga jur'at qildingizmi?" - dedi u, Pyotr Petrovitchning oldiga chiqib.

en: What are you talking about?” muttered Luzhin.
uz: Nima haqida gapiryapsan? - deb o'yladi Luzhin.

en: “I mean that you … are a slanderer, that’s what my words mean!” Lebeziatnikov said hotly, looking sternly at him with his shortsighted eyes.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, siz ... tuhmatchi, bu mening so'zlarimning ma'nosi! Lebeziatnikov qizg'in javob berdi va uning qisqa ko'zlari bilan unga qattiq qaradi.

en: He was extremely angry.
uz: U nihoyatda g'azablangan edi.

en: Raskolnikov gazed intently at him, as though seizing and weighing each word.
uz: Raskolnikov unga diqqat bilan qaradi, xuddi har bir so'zni o'z ichiga olgan va o'lchab o'tirgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: Again there was a silence.
uz: Yana bir bor xotirjamlik bo'ldi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch indeed seemed almost dumbfounded for the first moment.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch, aslida, dastlabki paytlarda deyarli g'alati ko'rinardi.

en: “If you mean that for me, …” he began, stammering.
uz: Agar men uchun buni aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, ... u gapni gapirib boshladi.

en: “But what’s the matter with you?
uz: Ammo senga nima bo'ldi?

en: Are you out of your mind?” “I’m in my mind, but you are a scoundrel!
uz: Sen aqldan ozganingmi?Men o'zimni o'ylayman, lekin sen bir qotilsan!

en: I have heard everything.
uz: Men hamma narsani eshitganman.

en: I kept waiting on purpose to understand it, for I must own even now it is not quite logical.
uz: Men uni tushunish uchun qasddan kutganman, chunki hozir ham bu mantiqiy emasligini bilishim kerak.

en: … What you have done it all for I can’t understand.” “Why, what have I done then?
uz: ... Bularning barchasini nima uchun qilganingizni tushunolmayman. Nima uchun, nima qildim?

en: Give over talking in your nonsensical riddles!
uz: O'zingizning behuda g'ayratlaringiz bilan gapirishni to'xtating!

en: Or maybe you are drunk!” “You may be a drunkard, perhaps, vile man, but I am not!
uz: Yoki siz mast bo'lishingiz mumkin!Siz ichkilikboz bo'lishingiz mumkin, ehtimol, yomon odam, lekin men emasman!

en: I never touch vodka, for it’s against my convictions.
uz: Men hech qachon vodkaga qo'ymayman, chunki bu mening e'tiqodlarimga ziddir.

en: Would you believe it, he, he himself, with his own hands gave Sofya Semyonovna that hundred-rouble note —I saw it, I was a witness, I’ll take my oath!
uz: Ishonasizmi, u o'z qo'li bilan Sofiya Semyonovnaga yuz rubllik yozuvni berdi.

en: He did it, he!” repeated Lebeziatnikov, addressing all.
uz: U buni qildi, u! deb takrorladi Lebeziatnikov, hammaga murojaat qildi.

en: “Are you crazy, milksop?” squealed Luzhin.
uz: Siz aqldan ozganmisiz, Sovuq? - deb o'yladi Luzhin.

en: “She is herself before you —she herself here declared just now before everyone that I gave her only ten roubles.
uz: U sening oldingda o'zi ekanligini aytdi U o'zi bu yerda hozir hamma oldida men unga faqat o'n rubl berganimni e'lon qildi.

en: How could I have given it to her?” “I saw it, I saw it,” Lebeziatnikov repeated, “and though it is against my principles, I am ready this very minute to take any oath you like before the court, for I saw how you slipped it in her pocket.
uz: Qanday qilib unga bergan bo'lardim?Men uni ko'rdim, ko'rdim, - deb takrorladi Lebeziatnikov, - va bu mening prinsiplarimga zid bo'lsa-da, men hozir siz xohlagan qasamni sud oldida aytishga tayyorman, chunki siz uni uning qoshiga tushirganingizni ko'rdim.

en: Only like a fool I thought you did it out of kindness!
uz: Faqatgina ahmoq kabi buni mehribonlik ila qilganingizni o'yladim!

en: When you were saying goodbye to her at the door, while you held her hand in one hand, with the other, the left, you slipped the note into her pocket.
uz: Siz eshik oldida unga salom aytayotganingizda, bir qo'lingizdan, boshqa qo'lingizdan chap qo'lingiz bilan uni ushlab turganingizda, notani uning qoshiga qo'yib qo'ydingiz.

en: I saw it, I saw it!” Luzhin turned pale.
uz: Men uni ko'rdim, ko'rdim! Luzhin o'g'ilga aylandi.

en: “What lies!” he cried impudently, “why, how could you, standing by the window, see the note?
uz: U qo'pollik bilan: "Nima uchun, qanday qilib siz darcha oldida turib, yozuvni ko'rasiz?" - deb baqirdi.

en: You fancied it with your shortsighted eyes.
uz: Siz buni qisqa ko'zlaringiz bilan tasavvur qildingiz.

en: You are raving!” “No, I didn’t fancy it.
uz: Siz g'azablanyapsiz!  Yo'q, men buni yoqtirmadim.

en: And though I was standing some way off, I saw it all.
uz: Garchi men uzoqlikda turgan bo'lsam-da, hammasini ko'rdim.

en: And though it certainly would be hard to distinguish a note from the window —that’s true —I knew for certain that it was a hundred-rouble note, because, when you were going to give Sofya Semyonovna ten roubles, you took up from the table a hundred- rouble note (I saw it because I was standing near then, and an idea struck me at once, so that I did not forget you had it in your hand).
uz: Garchi noto'g'rilikni darchadan ajratish qiyin bo'lsa-da, men uning yuz rubllik noto'g'ri ekanligini aniq bilardim, chunki Sofiya Semyonovnaga o'n rubl bermoqchi bo'lganingizda, stoldan yuz rubllik noto'g'ri olib qo'ydingiz (men uni ko'rdim, chunki men u vaqtda yaqin turgan edim va birdan bir fikr paydo bo'ldi, shuning uchun uni qo'lingda olganingizni unutmadim).

en: You folded it and kept it in your hand all the time.
uz: Siz uni qo'lingizda saqlab turardingiz.

en: I didn’t think of it
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylamaganman.

en: again until, when you were getting up, you changed it from your right hand to your left and nearly dropped it!
uz: Yana bir bor turib, uni o'ng qo'lingdan chap qo'lingga o'zgartirib, deyarli tushirib yubording!

en: I noticed it because the same idea struck me again, that you meant to do her a kindness without my seeing.
uz: Men buni payqadim, chunki o'sha fikr menga yana o'tdi, siz unga men ko'rmasdan yaxshilik qilishni xohlayotganingizni aytasiz.

en: You can fancy how I watched you and I saw how you succeeded in slipping it into her pocket.
uz: Sizni ko'rib, uni uning qoshiga qo'yib qo'yganingizni ko'rdim.

en: I saw it, I saw it, I’ll take my oath.” Lebeziatnikov was almost breathless.
uz: Men uni ko'rdim, ko'rdim, qasam ichaman. Lebeziatnikov deyarli nafassiz edi.

en: Exclamations arose on all hands chiefly expressive of wonder, but some were menacing in tone.
uz: Hamma qo'llaridan hayratga tushadigan ovozlar paydo bo'ldi, ammo ba'zilari qo'rqinchli tonda.

en: They all crowded round Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: Ular hammasi Pyotr Petrovitch atrofida to'plangan edi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna flew to Lebeziatnikov.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna Lebeziatnikovga uchdi.

en: “I was mistaken in you!
uz: Men sizda xatoga yo'l qo'ydim!

en: You are the only one to take her part!
uz: Uning ishtirokida ishtirok etadigan yagona sizsiz!

en: God has sent you!” Katerina Ivanovna, hardly knowing what she was doing, sank on her knees before him.
uz: Xudo seni yubordi! Katerina Ivanovna nima qilayotganini bilmay, uning oldida tiz cho'kdi.

en: “A pack of nonsense!” yelled Luzhin, roused to fury, “it’s all nonsense you’ve been talking!
uz: A pack of nonsense!  qichqirdi Luzhin, g'azabga to'lgan,      s barcha nonsense siz    been gapirish!

en: ‘An idea struck you, you didn’t think, you noticed’ —what does it amount to?
uz: Sizga bir g'oya keldi, o'ylab ko'rmadingiz, o'ylab ko'rdingiz  nimaga teng keladi?

en: So I gave it to her on the sly on purpose?
uz: Demak, men uni bilmasdan unga berganman?

en: What have I to do with this  … ?” “What for?
uz: Bu bilan men nima aloqam bor ... ?  Nima uchun?

en: That’s what I can’t understand, but that what I am telling you is the fact, that’s certain!
uz: Men buni tushunmayapman, lekin men sizga aytayotgan narsa haqiqat ekanligi shubhasiz!

en: So far from my being mistaken, you infamous criminal man, I remember how, on account of it, a question occurred to me at once, just when I was thanking you and pressing your hand.
uz: O'zimni adashtirmayapman, ey mashhur jinoyatchi, lekin shunga qaramay, men sizga minnatdorchilik bildirgan va qo'lingizni tatib turganimda, birdan menga savol kelib qolganini eslayman.

en: What made you put it secretly in her pocket?
uz: Nima uchun uni yashirincha uning qoshiga qo'ydingiz?

en: Why you did it secretly, I mean?
uz: Nima uchun buni yashirincha qildingiz?

en: Could it be simply to conceal it from me, knowing that my convictions are opposed to yours and that I do not approve of private benevolence, which effects no radical cure?
uz: Bu shunchaki mening e'tiqodlarim sizning e'tiqodingizga zid ekanligini va shaxsiy mehribonlikni yoqtirmasligimni bilib, undan yashirishim mumkinmi?

en: Well, I decided that you really were ashamed of giving such a large sum before me.
uz: Xo'sh, men o'zimdan oldin bunday ulkan summani berishdan juda uyalganingni tushundim.

en: Perhaps, too, I thought, he wants to give her a surprise, when she finds a whole hundred-rouble note in her pocket.
uz: Ehtimol, u ham unga yuz rubllik pulni pokasida topganida, uni hayratda qoldirmoqchi bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'yladim.

en: (For I know, some benevolent people are very fond of decking out their charitable actions in that way.) Then the idea struck me, too, that you wanted to test her, to see whether, when she found it, she would come to thank you.
uz: (Ushbu yo'l bilan xayrixohlik qilayotganlarning ba'zilari yaxshi ko'rishadi, deb bilaman.) Keyin menga ham siz uni sinab ko'rmoqchi bo'lganingiz, uni topganida sizga minnatdorchilik bildiradimi, deb o'ylab ko'rmoqchi bo'lganingiz haqida g'oya keldi.

en: Then, too, that you wanted to avoid thanks and that, as the saying is, your right hand should not know … something of that sort, in fact.
uz: Bundan tashqari, siz minnatdorchilik bildirishdan qochmoqchi ekanligingizni va o'ng qo'lingiz bunday narsani bilmasligi kerakligini aytishadi.

en: I thought of so many possibilities that I put off considering it, but still thought it indelicate to show you that I
uz: Men ko'p imkoniyatlar haqida o'yladim va ularni ko'rib chiqishni kechiktirdim, lekin sizga ko'rsatishimni ko'rsatish men uchun o'ylamaslik deb o'ylardim.

en: But another idea struck me again that Sofya Semyonovna might easily lose the money before she noticed it, that was why I decided to come in here to call her out of the room and to tell her that you put a hundred roubles in her pocket.
uz: Ammo Sofiya Semyonovna buni payqamasdan pulni yo'qotishi mumkinligi haqidagi fikr menga yana bir bor keldi, shuning uchun men uni xonadan chaqirib, uning qoshiga yuz rubl qo'yganingizni aytishga qaror qildim.

en: But on my way I went first to Madame Kobilatnikov’s to take them the General Treatise on the Positive Method and especially to recommend Piderit’s article (and also Wagner’s); then I come on here and what a state of things I find!
uz: Ammo yo'limda men avvalambor Xonim Kobilatnikovlarning oldiga borib, ularga "Yaxshi usul to'g'risidagi umumiy muomala"ni olib bordim va ayniqsa Pideritning maqolalarini (va shuningdek, Wagnerlarni) tavsiya qildim; so'ngra men bu yerga keldim va qanday holatni ko'rdim!

en: Now could I, could I, have all these ideas and reflections if I had not seen you put the hundred-rouble note in her pocket?” When Lebeziatnikov finished his long-winded harangue with the logical deduction at the end, he was quite tired, and the perspiration streamed from his face.
uz: Endi men, agar siz yuz rubllik notani uning qopqoqida qo'yganingizni ko'rmaganimda, bu barcha fikrlar va mulohazalarga ega bo'larmidim? Lebeziatnikov uzoq bo'lgan haranguni so'ngida mantiqiy xulosa bilan yakunlaganida, u juda charchagan edi va yuzidan ter oqib ketdi.

en: He could not, alas, even express himself correctly in Russian, though he knew no other language, so that he was quite exhausted, almost emaciated after this heroic exploit.
uz: Afsuski, u boshqa tilni bilmasa-da, o'zini rus tilida to'g'ri ifoda eta olmagan, shuning uchun u juda charchagan va shu qahramonlik bilan harakat qilganidan keyin deyarli bo'shashgan edi.

en: But his speech produced a powerful effect.
uz: Ammo uning nutqi kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: He had spoken with such vehemence, with such conviction that everyone obviously believed him.
uz: Uning so'zlari shunchalik kuchli edi, hamma unga ishonardi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch felt that things were going badly with him.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch o'zi bilan yomon munosabatda bo'lganini his qildi.

en: “What is it to do with me if silly ideas did occur to you?” he shouted, “that’s no evidence.
uz: Agar sizda o'yinsiz g'oyalar paydo bo'lsa, bu men bilan nima bog'liq? deb baqirdi u, bu hech qanday dalil emas.

en: You may have dreamt it, that’s all!
uz: Ehtimol, siz uni orzu qilgan bo'larsiz, shu qadar!

en: And I tell you, you are lying, sir.
uz: Va sizga aytamanki, siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz, sir.

en: You are lying and slandering from some spite against me, simply from pique, because I did not agree with your freethinking, godless, social propositions!” But this retort did not benefit Pyotr Petrovitch.
uz: Siz menga qarshi yolg'on gapiryapsiz va haqorat qilasiz, faqatgina o'zimga qarshi gapiryapsiz, chunki men sizning erkin fikrlaydigan, xudotars va ijtimoiy takliflaringiz bilan rozi emasman! Ammo bu javob Pyotr Petrovitchga foyda keltirmadi.

en: Murmurs of disapproval were heard on all sides.
uz: Har tarafdan norozilik g'iybatlari eshitildi.

en: “Ah, that’s your line now, is it!” cried Lebeziatnikov, “that’s nonsense!
uz: Ah, bu sizning so'zlaringiz endi, shundaymi? deb baqirdi Lebeziatnikov, bu g'alati gaplar!

en: Call the police and I’ll take my oath!
uz: Politsiyaga xabar bering va men qasamimni qabul qilaman!

en: There’s only one thing I can’t understand: what made him risk such a contemptible action.
uz: Faqat bir narsani tushunmayapman: nima uni bunday kamtarlik bilan harakat qilishga undagan.

en: Oh, pitiful, despicable man!” “I can explain why he risked such an action, and if necessary, I, too, will swear to it,” Raskolnikov said at last in a firm voice, and he stepped forward.
uz: Oh, achinarli, nafratlanarli odam! Men nima uchun u bunday xatti-harakatni xavf ostiga qo'yganini tushuntira olaman va kerak bo'lsa, men ham qasam ichaman, Raskolnikov nihoyat qat'iy ovoz bilan dedi va o'zi oldinga qadam qo'ydi.

en: He appeared to be firm and composed.
uz: U qat'iy va xotirjam bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: Everyone felt clearly, from the very look of him that he really knew about it and that the mystery would be solved.
uz: Hamma uning ko'rinishidan aniq ko'rinib turibdiki, u bu haqda haqiqatan ham bilgan va sir hal qilinadi.

en: “Now I can explain it all to myself,” said Raskolnikov, addressing Lebeziatnikov.
uz: "Hndi men bularning barchasini o'zimga tushuntira olaman", - dedi Raskolnikov Lebeziatnikovga murojaat qilib.

en: “From the very beginning of the business, I suspected
uz: Biznesning boshidan boshlab men shubhalanardim

en: that there was some scoundrelly intrigue at the bottom of it.
uz: Uning negizida biron bir g'alati intrigasi borligi haqida.

en: I began to suspect it from some special circumstances known to me only, which I will explain at once to everyone: they account for everything.
uz: Men buni faqatgina o'zim bilgan maxsus holatlardan kelib chiqqan holda shubha ostiga qo'yishni boshladim, bu holatni hammaga darhol tushuntirib beraman: ular hamma narsani tushuntirishadi.

en: Your valuable evidence has finally made everything clear to me.
uz: Sizning qimmatbaho dalillaringiz nihoyat menga hamma narsani aniqlashtirdi.

en: I beg all, all to listen.
uz: Hammalaringiz tinglanglar, deb iltijo qilaman.

en: This gentleman (he pointed to Luzhin) was recently engaged to be married to a young lady —my sister, Avdotya Romanovna Raskolnikov.
uz: Bu xonim (u Luzhinni ko'rsatdi) yaqinda yosh xonim Avdotya Romanovna Raskolnikov ismli singlim bilan turmushga chiqishi haqida so'z yuritgan edi.

en: But coming to Petersburg he quarrelled with me, the day before yesterday, at our first meeting and I drove him out of my room —I have two witnesses to prove it.
uz: Ammo Sankt-Peterburgga kelganimda, bir kun oldin, birinchi uchrashuvimizda u men bilan bahslashdi va men uni o'z xonamdan haydab yubordim.

en: He is a very spiteful man.
uz: U juda yomon odam.

en: … The day before yesterday I did not know that he was staying here, in your room, and that consequently on the very day we quarrelled —the day before yesterday —he saw me give Katerina Ivanovna some money for the funeral, as a friend of the late Mr.
uz: Kechqurun men uning bu yerda, sizning xonangizda yashayotganini bilmasdim va shuning uchun biz bahslashgan kunning o'zida u meni Katerina Ivanovnaga marhum M. Ivanovnaning do'sti sifatida dafn uchun pul berayotganini ko'rdi.

en: He at once wrote a note to my mother and informed her that I had given away all my money, not to Katerina Ivanovna but to Sofya Semyonovna, and referred in a most contemptible way to the … character of Sofya Semyonovna, that is, hinted at the character of my attitude to Sofya Semyonovna.
uz: U darhol onamga xat yozdi va men butun pulimni Katerina Ivanovnaga emas, Sofya Semyonovnaga berganimni aytdi va sofiya Semyonovnaga nisbatan munosabatimning xususiyatini ko'rsatdi.

en: All this you understand was with the object of dividing me from my mother and sister, by insinuating that I was squandering on unworthy objects the money which they had sent me and which was all they had.
uz: Siz buni faqatgina onam va singlimdan ajralib turish maqsadida, ular menga yuborgan pulni va ular ega bo'lgan yagona pulni men noloyiq narsalarga sarflayotganimni aytmoqchisiz.

en: Yesterday evening, before my mother and sister and in his presence, I declared that I had given the money to Katerina Ivanovna for the funeral and not to Sofya Semyonovna and that I had no acquaintance with Sofya Semyonovna and had never seen her before, indeed.
uz: Kecha kechqurun onam va singlim oldida va uning huzurida men pulni Sofiya Semyonovnaga emas, Katerina Ivanovnaga o'lim uchun berganimni, Sofiya Semyonovna bilan hech qanday tanishim yo'qligini va uni hech qachon ko'rmaganimni e'lon qildim.

en: At the same time I added that he, Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin, with all his virtues, was not worth Sofya Semyonovna’s little finger, though he spoke so ill of her.
uz: Shu bilan birga, u, Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin, o'zining barcha fazilatlari bilan Sofiya Semyonovna ning kichkina barmog'iga arziydigan emasligini qo'shdim, garchi u uning haqida yomon gapirgan bo'lsa ham.

en: To his question —would I let Sofya Semyonovna sit down beside my sister, I answered that I had already done so that day.
uz: Sofiya Semyonovna singlimning yonida o'tirishiga ruxsat bersam bo'ladimi, degan savolga men o'sha kuni o'tirganimni aytdim.

en: Irritated that my mother and sister were unwilling to quarrel with me at his insinuations, he gradually began being unpardonably rude to them.
uz: Onam va singlim uning g'oyalari bilan men bilan bahslashishga rozi emasligidan g'azablanib, u asta-sekin ularga nisbatan kechirilmas darajada qo'pol bo'la boshladi.

en: A final rupture took place and he was turned out of the house.
uz: So'nggi bo'linish sodir bo'ldi va u uydan chiqarib yuborildi.

en: All this happened yesterday evening.
uz: Bularning barchasi o'tgan kechqurun sodir bo'ldi.

en: Now I beg your special attention: consider: if he had now succeeded in proving that Sofya Semyonovna was a thief, he would have shown to my mother and sister that he was almost right in his suspicions, that he had reason to be angry at my putting my sister on a level with
uz: Endi sizning alohida e'tiboringizni iltimos qilaman: e'tibor bering: agar u Sofiya Semyonovna o'g'ri ekanligini isbotlashga muvaffaq bo'lganida edi, onam va singlimga u shubhalarida deyarli to'g'ri ekanligini, singlimni o'g'ri bilan tenglashtirganimdan g'azablanish uchun sabablari borligini ko'rsatgan bo'lardi.

en: Sofya Semyonovna, that, in attacking me, he was protecting and preserving the honour of my sister, his betrothed.
uz: Sofiya Semyonovna, menga hujum qilib, singlimning, uning kelin-qizining sharafini himoya qilib, saqlab qolganini aytadi.

en: In fact he might even, through all this, have been able to estrange me from my family, and no doubt he hoped to be restored to favour with them; to say nothing of revenging himself on me personally, for he has grounds for supposing that the honour and happiness of Sofya Semyonovna are very precious to me.
uz: Darhaqiqat, u hatto bularning barchasi tufayli meni oilamdan uzoqlashtirib qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin edi va, shubhasiz, ular bilan do'stlashishga qaytishini umid qilardi; shaxsan menga qasos olish haqida hech narsa aytmaslik uchun, chunki u Sofiya Semyonovnaning sharafi va baxt-saodatini men uchun juda qadrli deb taxmin qilish uchun asoslarga ega.

en: That was what he was working for!
uz: U shu maqsadda ishlagan!

en: That’s how I understand it.
uz: Men buni shunday tushunaman.

en: That’s the whole reason for it and there can be no other!” It was like this, or somewhat like this, that Raskolnikov wound up his speech which was followed very attentively, though often interrupted by exclamations from his audience.
uz: Buning butun sababi shundan iborat va boshqa sabab bo'lmasligi mumkin! Raskolnikov nutqini shu tarzda yoki biroz shu tarzda yakunladi, lekin ko'pincha tinglovchilarining ovozi bilan to'xtalgan bo'lsa-da, uni juda diqqat bilan kuzatib borishdi.

en: But in spite of interruptions he spoke clearly, calmly, exactly, firmly.
uz: Ammo u, uzilishlarga qaramay, aniq, xotirjam, aniq va qat'iy tarzda gapirdi.

en: His decisive voice, his tone of conviction and his stern face made a great impression on everyone.
uz: Uning qatʼiy ovozi, ishonch tonlari va qattiqqoʻlligi hammaga katta taassurot qoldirdi.

en: “Yes, yes, that’s it,” Lebeziatnikov assented gleefully, “that must be it, for he asked me, as soon as Sofya Semyonovna came into our room, whether you were here, whether I had seen you among Katerina Ivanovna’s guests.
uz: Ha, ha, shu qadar,  Lebeziatnikov xursandchilik bilan rozi bo'ldi, u shunday bo'lishi kerak, chunki u so'radi Sofya Semyonovna xonamizga kirganidan so'ng, siz bu yerda bo'lganmisiz, sizni Katerina Ivanovna mehmonlari orasida ko'rganmisiz.

en: He called me aside to the window and asked me in secret.
uz: U meni tom ma'noda oynasiga chaqirib, yashirincha so'radi.

en: It was essential for him that you should be here!
uz: U uchun sizning bu yerda bo'lishingiz juda muhim edi!

en: That’s it, that’s it!” Luzhin smiled contemptuously and did not speak.
uz: Mana shu, mana shu! Luzhin kamsitish bilan tabassum qilib, gapirmadi.

en: But he was very pale.
uz: Ammo u juda soya edi.

en: He seemed to be deliberating on some means of escape.
uz: U qandaydir qochish yo'llarini o'ylayotgan ko'rinardi.

en: Perhaps he would have been glad to give up everything and get away, but at the moment this was scarcely possible.
uz: Ehtimol, u hamma narsadan voz kechib, qochib ketishga tayyor bo'lgan bo'lar edi, lekin hozirgi paytda bu kamdan-kam mumkin edi.

en: It would have implied admitting the truth of the accusations brought against him.
uz: Bu unga qarshi qo'yilgan ayblovlarning haqiqatini tan olishni anglatardi.

en: Moreover, the company, which had already been excited by drink, was now too much stirred to allow it.
uz: Bundan tashqari, ichimlik bilan allaqachon hayajonlangan kompaniya endi bunga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: The commissariat clerk, though indeed he had not grasped the whole position, was shouting louder than anyone and was making some suggestions very unpleasant to Luzhin.
uz: Komissariatning kotibi, butun vazifani tushunmagan bo'lsa-da, kimgadir ko'ra baland ovoz bilan baqirib, Luzhinga juda yoqimsiz takliflarni berardi.

en: But not all those present were drunk; lodgers came in from all the rooms.
uz: Lekin barcha ishtirokchilar mast emas edilar; ijaraga oluvchilar barcha xonalardan kirib kelishdi.

en: The three Poles were tremendously excited and were continually shouting at him: “The pan is a łajdak!” and muttering threats in Polish.
uz: Uch nafar polyak juda hayajonlanib, unga doimiy ravishda: "Pann - lajdak!" - deb baqirib, polsha tilida qo'rqitishlarni qichqirib turardi.

en: Sonia had been listening with strained attention, though she too seemed unable to grasp it all; she seemed as though she had just returned to consciousness.
uz: Sonia ham hamma narsani anglay olmaganidek tuyulsa-da, diqqat bilan tinglagan edi; xuddi ongga qaytganidek ko'rinardi.

en: She did not take her eyes off Raskolnikov, feeling that all her safety lay in him.
uz: U Raskolnikovni ko'rib, o'zining butun xavfsizligi uning o'zida ekanligini his qildi.

en: Ivanovna breathed hard and painfully and seemed fearfully exhausted.
uz: Ivanovna qattiq va og'riqli nafas oldi va qo'rqinchli darajada charchagan ko'rinardi.

en: Amalia Ivanovna stood looking more stupid than anyone, with her mouth wide open, unable to make out what had happened.
uz: Amaliya Ivanovna hech kimdan ahmoqroq ko'rinib, og'zini keng ochib, nima sodir bo'lganini aniqlay olmagan edi.

en: She only saw that Pyotr Petrovitch had somehow come to grief.
uz: U faqat Pyotr Petroviçning qaysidir tarzda qayg'uga tushganini ko'rdi.

en: Raskolnikov was attempting to speak again, but they did not let him.
uz: Raskolnikov yana gapirishga harakat qildi, lekin unga ruxsat berilmadi.

en: Everyone was crowding round Luzhin with threats and shouts of abuse.
uz: Hamma Luzhin atrofida qo'rquvlar va zo'ravonlik ovozlari bilan to'plandi.

en: But Pyotr Petrovitch was not intimidated.
uz: Ammo Pyotr Petrovitch qo'rqitilmadi.

en: Seeing that his accusation of Sonia had completely failed, he had recourse to insolence: “Allow me, gentlemen, allow me!
uz: Soniaga nisbatan qilgan ayblovining to'liq puchga chiqqanini ko'rib, u: "Menga ruxsat bering, xonimlar, menga ruxsat bering!

en: Don’t squeeze, let me pass!” he said, making his way through the crowd.
uz: Shartlamanglar, menga o'tishga ruxsat beringlar! - dedi u, xaloyiq orasidan o'tib o'tadi.

en: “And no threats, if you please!
uz: Va hech qanday tahdidlar yo'q, iltimos!

en: I assure you it will be useless, you will gain nothing by it.
uz: Sizlarni ishontiramanki, bu foydasiz bo'ladi, siz undan hech qanday foyda ko'rmaysiz.

en: On the contrary, you’ll have to answer, gentlemen, for violently obstructing the course of justice.
uz: Aksincha, siz, xonimlar, adolat yo'nalishida zo'ravonlik bilan to'sqinlik qilganingiz uchun javobgar bo'lishingiz kerak.

en: The thief has been more than unmasked, and I shall prosecute.
uz: O'g'ri ko'proq ko'rsatilgan, shuning uchun men uni ayblayman.

en: Our judges are not so blind and … not so drunk, and will not believe the testimony of two notorious infidels, agitators, and atheists, who accuse me from motives of personal revenge which they are foolish enough to admit.
uz: Bizning hakamlarimiz shunchalik ko'r va ... shunchalik mast emaslar va meni shaxsiy qasos olish niyatida ayblovchi ikki notoriyalangan kofir, g'alayonchi va ateistning guvohligiga ishonmaydilar.

en: … Yes, allow me to pass!” “Don’t let me find a trace of you in my room!
uz: Ha, menga o'tishga ruxsat bering!Sizning izingizni xonamda topishga ruxsat bermang!

en: Kindly leave at once, and everything is at an end between us!
uz: Iltimos, darhol ketinglar va o'zimiz bilan hamma narsa tugab ketadi!

en: When I think of the trouble I’ve been taking, the way I’ve been expounding … all this fortnight!” “I told you myself today that I was going, when you tried to keep me; now I will simply add that you are a fool.
uz: Men o'zimni qanday qiynalganimni, bu ikki kun davomida qanday qilib tushuntirib berayotganimni o'ylagandan so'ng, bugun men o'zimga aytdimki, men ketyapman, siz meni ushlab turishga harakat qilganingizda; endi men shunchaki siz axmoq ekanligingizni qo'shaman.

en: I advise you to see a doctor for your brains and your short sight.
uz: O'z miyangiz va ko'zlaringiz qisqa bo'lishi uchun shifokorga murojaat qilishingizni maslahat beraman.

en: Let me pass, gentlemen!” He forced his way through.
uz: Men o'tib ketishimga ruxsat bering, xonimlar! U o'tishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: But the commissariat clerk was unwilling to let him off so easily: he picked up a glass from the table, brandished it in the air and flung it at Pyotr Petrovitch; but the glass flew straight at Amalia Ivanovna.
uz: Ammo komisariat xodimi uni shunchalik osonlikcha qo'yib yuborishga rozi bo'lmadi: u stoldan bir shisha olib, uni havoga ko'tardi va Pyotr Petrovitchga tashladi; lekin shisha Amaliya Ivanovnaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uchdi.

en: She screamed, and the clerk, overbalancing, fell heavily under the table.
uz: U qichqirdi va xizmatkor esa ortiqcha muvozanatga ega bo'lib, stol ostida og'irlab yiqildi.

en: Pyotr Petrovitch made his way to his room and half an hour later had left the house.
uz: Pyotr Petrovitch o'z xonasiga bordi va yarim soat o'tgach uydan chiqib ketdi.

en: Sonia, timid by nature, had felt before that day that she could be ill-treated more easily than anyone, and that she could be wronged with impunity.
uz: Sonia, tabiatidan qo'rqinchli bo'lgani uchun, o'sha kundan oldin o'zini har kimdan ko'ra osonroq yomon munosabatda bo'lishi mumkinligini va unga jazo berilmasligi mumkinligini his qilgan edi.

en: Yet till that moment she had fancied that she might escape misfortune by care, gentleness and submissiveness before everyone.
uz: Ammo o'sha paytgacha u qayg'urish, muloyimlik va itoatkorlik bilan hamma oldida baxtsizlikdan qochishi mumkinligini his qilgan edi.

en: Her disappointment was too great.
uz: Uning tushkunligi juda katta edi.

en: She could, of course, bear with patience and almost without murmur anything, even this.
uz: Albatta, u sabr-toqat bilan va deyarli hech narsa haqida g'iybat qilmasdan, hatto bu haqda ham g'ayrat ila javob bera olardi.

en: But for the first minute she felt it too bitter.
uz: Ammo birinchi daqiqada u o'zini juda achchiq his qildi.

en: In spite of her triumph and her justification —when her first terror and stupefaction had passed and she could understand it all clearly —the feeling of her helplessness and of the wrong done to her made her heart throb with anguish and she was overcome with hysterical weeping.
uz: O'zining g'alaba qozonishiga va oqlanishiga qaramay, ilk dahshat va qo'rquv o'tib ketganda va u hamma narsani aniq tushunib yetganda, o'zining yordamsizlik hissi va unga qilingan adolatsizlik uning qalbini azob-uqubatdan urib, histerik yig'lash bilan o'ldirgan.

en: At last, unable to bear any more, she rushed out of the room and ran home, almost immediately after Luzhin’s departure.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, bu ayol ko'proq ko'tarib o'tirolmadi, shuning uchun u xonadan chiqib, uyiga qochib ketdi, deyarli Luzhin ketgandan so'ng.

en: When amidst loud laughter the glass flew at Amalia Ivanovna, it was more than the landlady could endure.
uz: Qahramonlarning ko'ngli ko'tarilgan qichqiriqlari orasida shisha Amaliya Ivanovnaga o'tib ketganda, uy egasi ko'tarishi mumkin bo'lgan narsadan ko'proq edi.

en: With a shriek she rushed like a fury at Katerina Ivanovna, considering her to blame for everything.
uz: Qichqiriq bilan u Katerina Ivanovnaga g'azabga to'lib, hamma narsada uni aybdor deb hisobladi.

en: “Out of my lodgings!
uz: Mening uylarimdan chiqib ketinglar!

en: Quick march!” And with these words she began snatching up everything she could lay her hands on that belonged to Katerina Ivanovna, and throwing it on the floor.
uz: Tez marsh! Va bu so'zlar bilan u Katerina Ivanovnaga tegishli bo'lgan hamma narsani olib, yerga tashlashni boshladi.

en: Katerina Ivanovna, pale, almost fainting, and gasping for breath, jumped up from the bed where she had sunk in exhaustion and darted at Amalia Ivanovna.
uz: Katerina Ivanovna, soyalib, deyarli eshikdan o'tib, nafas olishni istamay, to'sqinlik bilan to'xtatgan yotoqidan ko'tarildi va Amaliya Ivanovnaga toshbo'ron qildi.

en: But the battle was too unequal: the landlady waved her away like a feather.
uz: Ammo jang juda teng bo'lmagan edi: uy egasi uni tovuq kabi o'girib yubordi.

en: As though that godless calumny was not enough —this vile creature attacks me!
uz: O'sha xudotars tuhmatlar yetarli emas deb o'ylayman, bu yovuz jonzot menga hujum qiladi!

en: On the day of my husband’s funeral I am turned out of my lodging!
uz: Erimning dafn kuni men yashaydigan joydan chiqarib tashlanadi!

en: After eating my bread and salt she turns me into the street, with my orphans!
uz: Non va tuzimni yeganidan so'ng, u meni yetimlarim bilan ko'chaga aylantiradi!

en: Where am I to go?” wailed the poor woman, sobbing and gasping.
uz: Qayerga borishim kerak? - deb qayg'urdi kambag'al ayol, yig'lab, ko'ngli ko'tardi.

en: “Good God!” she cried with flashing eyes, “is there no justice upon earth?
uz: Yaxshi Xudo! U chaqmoqli ko'zlar bilan baqirib: Bu dunyoda adolat yo'qmi?

en: Whom should you protect if not us orphans?
uz: Siz kimni himoya qilishingiz kerak, agar yetim bo'lmagan bo'lsak?

en: There is law and justice on earth, there is, I will find it!
uz: Yer yuzida qonun va adolat bor, bor, men uni topaman!

en: Wait a bit, godless creature!
uz: Bir oz kuting, ey xudotars maxluqot!

en: Polenka, stay with the children, I’ll come back.
uz: Polenka, bolalar bilan qol, men qaytib kelaman.

en: Wait for me, if you have to wait in the street.
uz: Agar ko'chada kutishga to'g'ri kelsa, meni kuting.

en: We will see whether there is justice on earth!” And throwing over her head that green shawl which Marmeladov had mentioned to Raskolnikov, Katerina Ivanovna squeezed her way through the disorderly and drunken crowd of lodgers who still filled the room, and, wailing and tearful, she ran into the street —with a vague intention of going at once somewhere to find justice.
uz: Yer yuzida adolat bor-yo'qligini ko'ramiz! Marmeladov Raskolnikovga aytib o'tgan yashil shali o'z boshiga tashlab ketib, Katerina Ivanovna xonani to'ldirib turgan tartibsiz va mast bo'lgan uy egalarining ko'pligidan o'zini pastga surdi va yig'lab-ichib, ko'chaga yugurdi.

en: Polenka with the two little ones in her arms crouched, terrified, on the trunk in the corner of the room, where she waited trembling for her mother to come back.
uz: Polenka qo'llarida ikkita kichkina bo'lib, qo'rqib, xonaning burchagidagi bagajga o'tirib, onasi qaytib kelishini titrab kutardi.

en: Amalia Ivanovna raged about the room, shrieking, lamenting and throwing everything she came across on the floor.
uz: Amaliya Ivanovna xonadon atrofida qichqirib, qayg'urib, to'qnashgan har bir narsani yerga tashlab ketardi.

en: The lodgers talked incoherently, some commented to the best of
uz: Uy egalari noto'g'ri so'zlarni aytishgan, ba'zilari eng yaxshilarga sharh berishgan.

en: their ability on what had happened, others quarrelled and swore at one another, while others struck up a song.
uz: O'tgan hodisalar haqida o'z qobiliyatlari bilan gaplashib, ba'zilari bir-biriga qasam ichishgan, ba'zilari esa qo'shiq qo'shib qo'yishgan.

en: … “Now it’s time for me to go,” thought Raskolnikov.
uz: ... Endi mening ketishimning vaqti keldi, deb o'yladi Raskolnikov.

en: “Well, Sofya Semyonovna, we shall see what you’ll say now!” And he set off in the direction of Sonia’s lodgings.
uz: Xo'sh, Sofiya Semyonovna, endi nima deyishingizni ko'ramiz! Va u Sonia uylariga qarab yo'lga chiqdi.

en: IV Raskolnikov had been a vigorous and active champion of Sonia against Luzhin, although he had such a load of horror and anguish in his own heart.
uz: Raskolnikov IV Luzhinga qarshi Sonia uchun kuchli va faol himoyachi bo'lgan edi, garchi u o'z yuragida dahshat va qayg'u bilan to'lgan bo'lsa ham.

en: But having gone through so much in the morning, he found a sort of relief in a change of sensations, apart from the strong personal feeling which impelled him to defend Sonia.
uz: Ammo ertalab shuncha narsani boshdan kechirganidan so'ng, uni Sonia uchun himoya qilishga undaydigan kuchli shaxsiy his-tuyg'ulardan tashqari, his-tuyg'ular o'zgarishida bir xil yengillik topdi.

en: He was agitated too, especially at some moments, by the thought of his approaching interview with Sonia: he had to tell her who had killed Lizaveta.
uz: U ham, ayniqsa ba'zi paytlarda, Sonia bilan suhbatlashish haqida o'ylashdan xavotirga tushdi: u unga Lizavetani kim o'ldirganini aytishi kerak edi.

en: He knew the terrible suffering it would be to him and, as it were, brushed away the thought of it.
uz: U o'zining azob chekishini bilar edi va bu haqda o'ylashdan voz kechdi.

en: So when he cried as he left Katerina Ivanovna’s, “Well, Sofya Semyonovna, we shall see what you’ll say now!” he was still superficially excited, still vigorous and defiant from his triumph over Luzhin.
uz: Shunday qilib, u Katerina Ivanovna'dan ketayotganda yig'lab yuborganida, Sofiya Semyonovna, endi nima deyishingizni ko'ramiz!

en: But, strange to say, by the time he reached Sonia’s lodging, he felt a sudden impotence and fear.
uz: Ammo g'alati, u Sonaning xonasiga yetib kelganida, u to'satdan kuchsizlik va qo'rquvni his qildi.

en: He stood still in hesitation at the door, asking himself the strange question: “Must he tell her who killed Lizaveta?” It was a strange question because he felt at the very time not only that he could not help telling her, but also that he could not put off the telling.
uz: U darvoza oldida shubha ostiga turib, o'ziga o'ziga o'xshash savol berardi: "Lizavetani kim o'ldirganini aytishi kerakmi?" Bu g'alati savol edi, chunki u o'sha paytda nafaqat unga aytishdan bosh tortmay, balki gapni kechiktirolmasligini his qilgan.

en: He did not yet know why it must be so, he only felt it, and the agonising sense of his impotence before the inevitable almost crushed him.
uz: U hali nima uchun bunday bo'lishi kerakligini bilmas edi, faqat uni his qilgan edi, va muqarrar bo'lishdan oldin uning kuchsizligini his etishning og'ir hissi uni deyarli ezib tashlagan.

en: To cut short his hesitation and suffering, he quickly opened the door and looked at Sonia from the doorway.
uz: U o'z shubha va azob-uqubatini qisqartirish uchun darrov eshikni ochib, Soniaga eshikdan qarab qo'ydi.

en: She was sitting with her elbows on the table and her face in her hands, but seeing Raskolnikov she got up at once and came to meet him as though she were expecting him.
uz: U o'z qo'lqoplari bilan stol ustida o'tirgan va yuzini qo'llarida ko'rgan edi, lekin Raskolnikovni ko'rganida u darhol turdi va uni kutib turganidek uchratdi.

en: “What would have become of me but for you?” she said quickly, meeting him in the middle of the room.
uz: Sizdan boshqa men nima bo'lar edim? - deb so'radi u tezda, xonaning o'rtasida uchrashdi.

en: Evidently she was in haste to say this to him.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u bu haqda unga aytishga shoshgan edi.

en: It was what she had been waiting for.
uz: Bu uning kutgan narsasi edi.

en: Raskolnikov went to the table and sat down on the chair from which she had only just risen.
uz: Raskolnikov dasturxonga borib, o'sha o'rindiqga o'tirdi, undan u yaqinda turibdi.

en: She stood facing him, two steps away, just as she had done the day before.
uz: O'sha kuni qilganidek, u ikki qadam uzoqlikda uning qarshisida turibdi.

en: “Well, Sonia?” he said, and felt that his voice was trembling, “it was all due to ‘your social position and the habits associated with it.’ Did you understand that just now?” Her face showed her distress.
uz: Eh, Sonia? dedi u va o'z ovozini titrayotganini sezdi, bularning hammasi sizning ijtimoiy mavqeingiz va u bilan bog'liq odatlaringiz tufayli sodir bo'ldi. Buni hozir tushunib oldingizmi? Uning yuzi qayg'uga to'lganini ko'rsatdi.

en: “Only don’t talk to me as you did yesterday,” she interrupted him.
uz: Faqat menga kecha qilganingizdek gapirmang, - dedi u unga aralashib.

en: “Please don’t begin it.
uz: Iltimos, uni boshlashdan bosh tortmang.

en: There is misery enough without that.” She made haste to smile, afraid that he might not like the reproach.
uz: Bu yo'ldan ketsa ham, yetarlicha azob-uqubatlar bor. O'sha ayol, ehtimol, uning tanqid qilishidan qo'rqib, shoshilib tabassum qildi.

en: “I was silly to come away from there.
uz: Men o'sha yerdan chiqib ketish uchun ahmoqlik qildim.

en: What is happening there now?
uz: Hozir u yerda nima bo'lyapti?

en: I wanted to go back directly, but I kept thinking that … you would come.” He told her that Amalia Ivanovna was turning them out of their lodging and that Katerina Ivanovna had run off somewhere “to seek justice.” “My God!” cried Sonia, “let’s go at once.
uz: Men to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tmoqchi edim, lekin o'ylaymanki, siz ham kelarsiz. U unga Amaliya Ivanovna ularni uylaridan haydab ketayotganini va Katerina Ivanovna adolatni izlash uchun qayerda bo'lishini aytdi.My God! so'radi Sonia, lets go away at once.

en: …” And she snatched up her cape.
uz: ... Va o'z ko'ylagini o'rab oldi.

en: “It’s everlastingly the same thing!” said Raskolnikov, irritably.
uz: Bu abadiy bir xil narsa! - dedi Raskolnikov g'azabga to'lib.

en: “You’ve no thought except for them!
uz: Siz ular haqida o'ylamagansiz!

en: Stay a little with me.” “But … Katerina Ivanovna?” “You won’t lose Katerina Ivanovna, you may be sure, she’ll come to you herself since she has run out,” he added peevishly.
uz: Men bilan biroz qoling. Lekin ... Katerina Ivanovna? Katerina Ivanovna sizni yo'qotmaydi, shubhasiz, u o'zi sizga keladi, chunki u to'xtadi, dedi u o'ziga xos qo'shimcha qildi.

en: “If she doesn’t find you here, you’ll be blamed for it.
uz: Agar u sizni bu yerda topmasa, siz aybdor bo'lasiz.

en: …” Sonia sat down in painful suspense.
uz: ... Sonia og'riqli suspense bilan o'tirdi.

en: Raskolnikov was silent, gazing at the floor and deliberating.
uz: Raskolnikov sukut saqlab, yerga tikilib, mulohaza yuritdi.

en: “This time Luzhin did not want to prosecute you,” he began, not looking at Sonia, “but if he had wanted to, if it had suited his plans, he would have sent you to prison if it had not been for Lebeziatnikov and me.
uz: Bu safar Luzhin sizni ayblashni istamadi,  u Soniaga qaramasdan boshladi,  lekin u xohlaganida, rejalariga muvofiq bo'lganida, sizni jazonga yuborardi, agar Lebeziatnikov va men uchun bo'lmaganida.

en: Ah?” “Yes,” she assented in a faint voice.
uz: Ah? Ha, u zaif ovoz bilan rozi bo'ldi.

en: “Yes,” she repeated, preoccupied and distressed.
uz: - Ha, - deb takrorladi u, tashvishlanib va xafa bo'lib.

en: “But I might easily not have been there.
uz: Ammo men u erda bo'lmagan bo'lardim.

en: And it was quite an accident Lebeziatnikov’s turning up.”
uz: Va bu to'g'ri tasodifan bo'ldi, Lebeziatnikovlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: “And if you’d gone to prison, what then?
uz: Agar siz qamoqqa o'tirgan bo'lsangiz, nima bo'lar edi?

en: Do you remember what I said yesterday?” Again she did not answer.
uz: Kecha nima deb aytganimni eslaysizmi? U yana javob bermadi.

en: “I thought you would cry out again ‘don’t speak of it, leave off.’ ” Raskolnikov gave a laugh, but rather a forced one.
uz: Men o'yladimki, siz yana qichqirasiz  bu haqda gapirmang, to'xtating.  Raskolnikov kulishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: “What, silence again?” he asked a minute later.
uz: Nima, yana sessizlikmi? deb so'radi u bir daqiqa o'tib.

en: “We must talk about something, you know.
uz: Biz bir narsa haqida gapirishimiz kerak, bilasizmi.

en: It would be interesting for me to know how you would decide a certain ‘problem’ as Lebeziatnikov would say.” (He was beginning to lose the thread.) “No, really, I am serious.
uz: Men uchun qanday qilib muayyan problemni hal qilishingizni bilish qiziqarli bo'lardi, chunki Lebeziatnikov aytganidek. (U nuqta yo'qotishni boshlagan edi.) Yo'q, men buni jiddiy aytyapman.

en: Imagine, Sonia, that you had known all Luzhin’s intentions beforehand.
uz: O'ylab ko'ring, Sonia, Luzhinning barcha niyatlarini oldindan bilgan bo'lar eding.

en: Known, that is, for a fact, that they would be the ruin of Katerina Ivanovna and the children and yourself thrown in —since you don’t count yourself for anything —Polenka too … for she’ll go the same way.
uz: Ma'lumki, ular Katerina Ivanovna, bolalar va o'zingizning halokatingiz bo'lishi mumkin, chunki siz o'zingizni hech narsa deb hisoblamaysiz Polenka ham ... chunki u ham xuddi shunday yo'ldan boradi.

en: Well, if suddenly it all depended on your decision whether he or they should go on living, that is whether Luzhin should go on living and doing wicked things, or Katerina Ivanovna should die?
uz: Toʻgʻri, agar toʻsatdan bularning barchasi sizning qaroringizga bogʻliq boʻlsa, u yoki ular tirik qolishlari kerakmi, yaʼni Luzhin tirik qolishi va yovuz ishlar qilishi kerakmi yoki Katerina Ivanovna oʻlishi kerakmi?

en: How would you decide which of them was to die?
uz: Ularning qaysi biri o'lishi kerakligini qanday hal qilasiz?

en: I ask you?” Sonia looked uneasily at him.
uz: Sendan so'raymanmi? Sonia unga xavotir bilan qaradi.

en: There was something peculiar in this hesitating question, which seemed approaching something in a roundabout way.
uz: Ushbu shubha ostiga qo'ygan savolda o'ziga xos bir narsa bor edi, u bir narsaga aylanarli tarzda yaqinlashayotgan edi.

en: “I felt that you were going to ask some question like that,” she said, looking inquisitively at him.
uz: "Men siz shunday savol berasiz deb o'yladim", - dedi u, unga qiziqish bilan qarab.

en: “I dare say you did.
uz: Men aytganimni aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: But how is it to be answered?” “Why do you ask about what could not happen?” said Sonia reluctantly.
uz: Ammo bunga qanday javob berish kerak? Nima uchun nima bo'lmasligi haqida so'raysiz? - dedi Sonia istamagan holda.

en: “Then it would be better for Luzhin to go on living and doing wicked things?
uz: Shunday bo'lsa, Lushin uchun yomon ishlar qilib, tirik qolish yaxshiroqmi?

en: You haven’t dared to decide even that!” “But I can’t know the Divine Providence.
uz: Hatto shu qarorni qabul qilishga jur'at etmadingiz! Ammo men ilohiy ta'minotni bilmayman.

en: … And why do you ask what can’t be answered?
uz: Va nega siz javob bera olmaydigan savolni berasiz?

en: What’s the use of such foolish questions?
uz: Bunday ahmoqona savollarning foydasi nimada?

en: How could it happen that it should depend on my decision —who has made me a judge to decide who is to live and who is not to live?” “Oh, if the Divine Providence is to be mixed up in it, there is no doing anything,” Raskolnikov grumbled morosely.
uz: Qanday qilib bu mening qarorimga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin?Kim meni hakam qilib tayinlagan bo'lsa, kim yashashi va kim yashamasligi haqida qaror chiqaradi?Oh, agar bunga ilohiy ta'minot aralashtirilishi kerak bo'lsa, unda hech narsa qilishning hojati yo'q, Raskolnikov o'ziga yarasha g'azablandi.

en: “You’d better say straight out what you want!” Sonia cried in distress.
uz: Siz o'zingiz xohlagan narsani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi!Sonya xafa bo'lib yig'ladi.

en: “You are leading up to something again.
uz: Siz yana bir narsaga yetaklab boryapsiz.

en: … Can you have come simply to torture me?”
uz: ... Siz shunchaki meni qiynash uchun keldingizmi?

en: She could not control herself and began crying bitterly.
uz: U o'zini tuta olmay, achchiq-achchiq yig'la boshladi.

en: He looked at her in gloomy misery.
uz: U qizga qayg'uli va qayg'uli ko'rinishda qaradi.

en: “Of course you’re right, Sonia,” he said softly at last.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, Sonia, so'ng u sekinlik bilan javob berdi.

en: He was suddenly changed.
uz: U to'satdan o'zgardi.

en: His tone of assumed arrogance and helpless defiance was gone.
