uz: Uning o'ylagandek kibrli va yordamsiz qarshilik ko'rsatgan so'zi yo'q edi.

en: Even his voice was suddenly weak.
uz: Hatto uning ovozi ham birdan zaiflashib ketdi.

en: “I told you yesterday that I was not coming to ask forgiveness and almost the first thing I’ve said is to ask forgiveness.
uz: Kecha sizga kechirim so'rash uchun kelmasligimni aytdim va deyarli birinchi bo'lib kechirim so'rashni aytdim.

en: … I said that about Luzhin and Providence for my own sake.
uz: Luzhin va Providence haqida o'zim uchun shunday aytdim.

en: I was asking forgiveness, Sonia.
uz: Men kechirim so'ragan edim, Sonia.

en: …” He tried to smile, but there was something helpless and incomplete in his pale smile.
uz: ... U tabassum qilishga harakat qildi, lekin uning soʻlib oʻtgan tabassumida yordamsiz va toʻliq boʻlmagan bir narsa bor edi.

en: He bowed his head and hid his face in his hands.
uz: U boshini egib, yuzini qo'llarida yashirdi.

en: And suddenly a strange, surprising sensation of a sort of bitter hatred for Sonia passed through his heart.
uz: Toʻsatdan uning yuragida Soniaga boʻlgan oʻtkir nafratning gʻayrioddiy, hayratda qoldiradigan hissiyot paydo boʻldi.

en: As it were wondering and frightened of this sensation, he raised his head and looked intently at her; but he met her uneasy and painfully anxious eyes fixed on him; there was love in them; his hatred vanished like a phantom.
uz: Bu his-tuyg'udan hayron va qo'rqib, u boshini ko'tarib, qizga diqqat bilan qaradi, lekin uning qayg'uli va og'riqli ko'zlari unga qaraganini ko'rdi; ularda sevgi bor edi; uning nafratlari hayajon kabi yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: It was not the real feeling; he had taken the one feeling for the other.
uz: Bu haqiqiy tuyg'u emas edi; u bir tuyg'u uchun boshqa tuyg'ularni qabul qilgan edi.

en: It only meant that that minute had come.
uz: Bu faqat o'sha daqiqa kelganini anglatardi.

en: He hid his face in his hands again and bowed his head.
uz: U yana yuzini qo'llariga saqlab, boshini egib qo'ydi.

en: Suddenly he turned pale, got up from his chair, looked at Sonia, and without uttering a word sat down mechanically on her bed.
uz: Toʻsatdan u oʻz koʻrinishidan turib, Soniaga qaradi va bir soʻz ham aytmasdan uning yotoq ustiga oʻtiradi.

en: His sensations that moment were terribly like the moment when he had stood over the old woman with the axe in his hand and felt that “he must not lose another minute.” “What’s the matter?” asked Sonia, dreadfully frightened.
uz: Uning o'sha paytdagi his-tuyg'ulari, qo'lida pichoq bilan keksa ayolning ustida turib, yana bir daqiqa o'tkazib yubormasligi kerakligini his qilgan paytga o'xshaydi. Nima bo'ldi? - so'radi qo'rqinchli Sonia.

en: He could not utter a word.
uz: U bir so'z ham aytolmadi.

en: This was not at all, not at all the way he had intended to “tell” and he did not understand what was happening to him now.
uz: Bu hech qachon, hech qachon u aytmoqchi bo'lgan yo'l emas edi va u o'zi bilan nima sodir bo'layotganini tushunmadi.

en: She went up to him, softly, sat down on the bed beside him and waited, not taking her eyes off him.
uz: U uning yoniga yaqinlashdi, xotirjamlik bilan uning yonida yotgan to'shagida o'tirib, ko'zlarini undan olib ketmasdan kutdi.

en: Her heart throbbed and sank.
uz: Uning yuragi urib, qulab ketdi.

en: It was unendurable; he turned his deadly pale face to her.
uz: Bu ko'ngilsizlik edi; u o'z o'limga olib ketadigan o'tkir yuzini unga qaratdi.

en: His lips worked, helplessly struggling to utter something.
uz: Uning og'izlari ishlaydi, biron narsa aytishga yordamsiz kurashdi.

en: A pang of terror passed through Sonia’s heart.
uz: Sonia yuragidan qo'rqinch parcha o'tdi.

en: “What’s the matter?” she repeated, drawing a little away from him.
uz: Qiziq, nima bo'ldi? - deb takrorladi u, biroz undan uzoqlashdi.

en: “Nothing, Sonia, don’t be frightened.
uz: Hech narsa, Sonia, qo'rqma.

en: It really is nonsense, if you think of it,” he muttered, like a man in delirium.
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham behuda, agar o'ylasangiz, u delirdagi odam kabi qichqirdi.

en: have I come to torture you?” he added suddenly, looking at her.
uz: Men sizni qiynash uchun keldimmi? u to'satdan unga qarab qo'shimcha qildi.

en: I keep asking myself that question, Sonia.
uz: Men o'zimga o'zimdan shu savolni berishni davom ettiryapman, Sonia.

en: …” He had perhaps been asking himself that question a quarter of an hour before, but now he spoke helplessly, hardly knowing what he said and feeling a continual tremor all over.
uz: ... Ehtimol, o'ziga bu savolni bir chorak soat oldin ham bergan bo'lsa kerak, lekin endi u yordamsiz gapirgan, nima deyishini bilmay, atrofida doimiy titrishni his qilgan.

en: “Oh, how you are suffering!” she muttered in distress, looking intently at him.
uz: "Oh, qanday azob chekyapsan!" - deb qayg'uga tushib, unga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: … Listen, Sonia.” He suddenly smiled, a pale helpless smile for two seconds.
uz: Eshiting, Sonia. U birdan tabassum qildi, ikki soniya davomida qo'rqinchli va yordamsiz tabassum qildi.

en: “You remember what I meant to tell you yesterday?” Sonia waited uneasily.
uz: Sizni eslaysizmi, kecha men sizga nima aytmoqchi edim? Sonia bezovta kutib qoldi.

en: “I said as I went away that perhaps I was saying goodbye forever, but that if I came today I would tell you who … who killed Lizaveta.” She began trembling all over.
uz: Men ketayotganimda, ehtimol abadiy salom aytayotganimni aytdim, lekin agar bugun kelsam, sizga kim ... kim Lizavetani o'ldirganini aytib beraman. U hamma joyda titra boshladi.

en: “Well, here I’ve come to tell you.” “Then you really meant it yesterday?” she whispered with difficulty.
uz: Ha, men sizga aytishga keldim.   Xo'sh, siz o'tmishda buni chinakamiga aytganmisiz? U qiyinchilik bilan shoshib yubordi.

en: “How do you know?” she asked quickly, as though suddenly regaining her reason.
uz: Qanday qilib bilasan? - deb so'radi u tezda, xuddi to'satdan aql-idrokini tiklagandek.

en: Sonia’s face grew paler and paler, and she breathed painfully.
uz: Sonia yuzidan ko'rinishi ko'payib borardi va u og'riqli nafas oldi.

en: “I know.” She paused a minute.
uz: I know. U bir daqiqa to'xtadi.

en: “Have they found him?” she asked timidly.
uz: Uni topdilarmi? - deb so'radi u qo'rqinchli so'zlar bilan.

en: “No.” “Then how do you know about it?” she asked again, hardly audibly and again after a minute’s pause.
uz: Yo'q  Unda siz buni qayerdan bilasan? deb so'radi u yana, bir daqiqalik to'xtab o'tgach, bir necha marta.

en: He turned to her and looked very intently at her.
uz: U ayolga yuz o'girib, unga juda diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: “Guess,” he said, with the same distorted helpless smile.
uz: Guess, dedi u, o'sha o'sha buzilgan yordamsiz tabassum bilan.

en: A shudder passed over her.
uz: Uning ustiga shudring o'tdi.

en: “But you … why do you frighten me like this?” she said, smiling like a child.
uz: Ammo siz... nega meni shunday qo'rqitasiz? - dedi u, bola kabi tabassum qilib.

en: “I must be a great friend of his … since I know,” Raskolnikov went on, still gazing into her face, as though he could not turn his eyes away.
uz: Men uning yaxshi do'sti bo'lishim kerak ... chunki men buni bilaman,  Raskolnikov davom etdi, hali ham uning yuziga qaradi, xuddi ko'zlarini o'zgartirolmagandek.

en: “He … did not mean to kill that Lizaveta … he … killed her accidentally.
uz: U... bu Lizavetani o'ldirishni istamagan edi... u... uni o'zi o'ldirgan.

en: … He meant to kill the old woman when she was alone and he went there … and then Lizaveta came in … he killed her too.” Another awful moment passed.
uz: U keksa ayolni yolg'iz bo'lganida o'ldirishni xohlagan va u o'sha yerga bordi va keyin Lizaveta kirdi-yu uni ham o'ldirdi. Yana bir dahshatli daqiqa o'tdi.

en: Both still gazed at one another.
uz: Ikkalasi ham hali ham bir-birlariga tikilib qarab turardi.

en: “You can’t guess, then?” he asked suddenly, feeling as though he were flinging himself down from a steeple.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, tasavvur qila olmaysizmi? deb so'radi u birdan, o'zini to'padan tushayotganini his etib.

en: “N-no …” whispered Sonia.
uz: N-yo'q ... Sonia g'aflatli so'zlarni aytdi.

en: “Take a good look.” As soon as he had said this again, the same familiar sensation froze his heart.
uz: Yaxshi tomosha qiling. Buni yana aytgandan so'ng, uning yuragi xuddi shu tanish hissiyot bilan to'xtab qoldi.

en: He looked at her and all at once seemed to see in her face the face of Lizaveta.
uz: U unga qaradi va birdan uning yuzida Lizavetaning yuzini ko'rishga o'xshaydi.

en: He remembered clearly the expression in Lizaveta’s face, when he approached her with the axe and she stepped back to the wall, putting out her hand, with childish terror in her face, looking as little children do when they begin to be frightened of something, looking intently and uneasily at what frightens them, shrinking back and holding out their little hands on the point of crying.
uz: U Lizaveta yuzidagi ifodani aniq esladi, u o'g'li bilan unga yaqinlashganda va u devorga qaytganida, qo'lini ko'tarib, yuzida bolalik dahshatini ko'tarib, kichkina bolalar kabi ko'rinadi, ular biror narsadan qo'rqishni boshlashganida, ularni qo'rqitadigan narsaga diqqat bilan va noqulay qarab, orqaga surib, o'z qo'llarini yig'lashga tayyorlab qo'ydi.

en: Almost the same thing happened now to Sonia.
uz: Sofiya bilan deyarli xuddi shunday voqea sodir bo'ldi.

en: With the same helplessness and the same terror, she looked at him for a while and, suddenly putting out her left hand, pressed her fingers faintly against his breast and slowly began to get up from the bed, moving further from him and keeping her eyes fixed even more immovably on him.
uz: O'sha xil qo'rquv va qo'rquv bilan u biroz unga qaradi va to'satdan chap qo'lini ko'tarib, o'z barmoqlarini uning ko'kraklariga salqinlik bilan bosadi va sekin-sakin o'rnidan turib, undan uzoqroq ketadi va ko'zlarini unga yanada qat'iy tiklaydi.

en: Her terror infected him.
uz: Uning qo'rquvi uni yuqtirdi.

en: The same fear showed itself on his face.
uz: Uning yuzida ham xuddi shunday qo'rquv paydo bo'ldi.

en: In the same way he stared at her and almost with the same childish smile.
uz: U unga xuddi shunday qaradi va deyarli xuddi shunday bolalik tabassum bilan.

en: “Have you guessed?” he whispered at last.
uz: Shubhang qildingizmi? u nihoyat shovqin qildi.

en: “Good God!” broke in an awful wail from her bosom.
uz: Good God! Uning ko'krakidan qo'rqinchli bir yig'i chiqdi.

en: She sank helplessly on the bed with her face in the pillows, but a moment later she got up, moved quickly to him, seized both his hands and, gripping them tight in her thin fingers, began looking into his face again with the same intent stare.
uz: U o'z yuzini yostiqlarda ko'tarib, yordamsiz o'tirgan edi, lekin bir zum o'tib u turib, uning yoniga tez o'tdi, ikkala qo'lini ham ushlab, o'zining chiroyli barmoqlari bilan ularni qattiq ushlab, yana o'sha niyat bilan uning yuziga qaray boshladi.

en: In this last desperate look she tried to look into him and catch some last hope.
uz: O'sha so'nggi ko'z o'zidan kechganida, u unga yaqinroq qarab, so'nggi umidni topishga harakat qildi.

en: But there was no hope; there was no doubt remaining; it was all true!
uz: Ammo umid yo'q edi, hech shubha yo'q edi, hamma narsa haqiqat edi!

en: Later on, indeed, when she recalled that moment, she thought it strange and wondered why she had seen at once that there was no doubt.
uz: Keyinchalik, o'sha paytni eslab, u o'zini g'alati his qilib, nega shubhasizligini birdan ko'rganini o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: She could not have said, for instance, that she had foreseen something of the sort —and yet now, as soon as he told her, she suddenly fancied that she had really foreseen this very thing.
uz: Misol uchun, u bunday narsani oldindan ko'rganini aytolmasdi, lekin u aytgandan so'ng, u to'satdan o'zi aynan shu narsani oldindan ko'rganini his qildi.

en: “Stop, Sonia, enough!
uz: Stop, Sonia, yetarlicha!

en: don’t torture me,” he begged her miserably.
uz: Meni qiynamang, - deb unga achinarli ravishda yolvordi u.

en: It was not at all, not at all like this he had thought of telling her, but this is how it happened.
uz: Bu ayolga aytishni o'ylagani kabi emas edi, lekin shunday bo'ldi.

en: She jumped up, seeming not to know what she was doing, and, wringing her hands, walked into the middle of the room; but quickly went back and sat down again beside him, her shoulder almost touching his.
uz: O'zi nima qilayotganini bilmay turib, o'tib o'tadi va qo'llarini burib, xonaning o'rtasiga kirdi; lekin tezda qaytib kelib, yana uning yonida o'tirdi va uning yelkasi deyarli uningki bilan bog'liq edi.

en: All of a sudden she started as though she had been stabbed, uttered a cry and fell on her knees before him, she did not know why.
uz: Toʻsatdan u oʻzini toshboʻron qilgan boʻlsa-da, yigʻlab yubordi va uning oldida tiz choʻkdi, nima sababini bilmay.

en: “What have you done —what have you done to yourself?” she said in despair, and, jumping up, she flung herself on his neck, threw her arms round him, and held him tightly.
uz: Siz nima qildingiz?Siz o'zingizga nima qildingiz? deb so'radi u umidsizlikka tushib, o'zini uning bo'yniga tashladi, qo'llarini uning atrofida tashladi va uni qattiq ushlab oldi.

en: Raskolnikov drew back and looked at her with a mournful smile.
uz: Raskolnikov orqaga qarab, qayg'uli tabassum bilan unga qaradi.

en: “You are a strange girl, Sonia —you kiss me and hug me when I tell you about that.
uz: Siz g'alati qizsiz, Sonia Soniyam, men sizga bu haqda aytib bersam, siz meni o'pasiz va quchoqlaysiz.

en: … You don’t think what you are doing.” “There is no one —no one in the whole world now so unhappy as you!” she cried in a frenzy, not hearing what he said, and she suddenly broke into violent hysterical weeping.
uz: Siz nima qilayotganingizni o'ylab ko'rmaysiz. Dunyoda siz kabi baxtsiz hech kim yo'q! Uning so'zlarini eshitmay, g'alati yig'lab yubordi va to'satdan qattiq histerik yig'lashga tushdi.

en: A feeling long unfamiliar to him flooded his heart and softened it at once.
uz: U uchun uzoq vaqtdan beri noma'lum bo'lgan his-tuyg'u uning qalbini suvga cho'mdirdi va uni darhol yumshatdi.

en: He did not struggle against it.
uz: U bunga qarshi kurashmagan.

en: Two tears started into his eyes and hung on his eyelashes.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida ikkita ko'z yoshlari paydo bo'lib, ko'z burchaklariga osib qo'ydi.

en: “Then you won’t leave me, Sonia?” he said, looking at her almost with hope.
uz: Keyin meni tashlab ketmaysanmi, Sonia? - dedi u, unga umid bilan qarab.

en: “No, no, never, nowhere!” cried Sonia.
uz: "Yo'q, yo'q, hech qachon, hech qaerda!" - deb qayg'urdi Sonia.

en: “I will follow you, I will follow you everywhere.
uz: Men senga ergashaman, har yerda senga ergashaman.

en: Oh, how miserable I am!
uz: Oh, men qanchalik qashshoqman!

en: … Why, why didn’t I know you before!
uz: Nega men sizni ilgari bilmagan edim?

en: Why didn’t you come before?
uz: Nima uchun ilgari kelmadingiz?

en: Oh, dear!” “Here I have come.” “Yes, now!
uz: Oh, aziz!  Mana keldim.   Ha, hozir!

en: What’s to be done now?
uz: Endi nima qilish kerak?

en: … Together, together!” she repeated as it were unconsciously, and she hugged him again.
uz: ... Birga, birga! u o'ylamasdan takrorladi va uni yana quchoqladi.

en: “I’ll follow you to Siberia!” He recoiled at this, and the same hostile, almost haughty smile came to his lips.
uz: Sizni Sibirga kuzatib boraman! U bu gapdan qaytdi va o'sha dushman, deyarli mag'rur tabassum uning og'zidan chiqdi.

en: “Perhaps I don’t want to go to Siberia yet, Sonia,” he said.
uz: Balki men hali Sibirga borishni istamayman, Sonia, - dedi u.

en: Sonia looked at him quickly.
uz: Sonia unga tezda nazar tashladi.

en: Again after her first passionate, agonising sympathy for the unhappy man the terrible idea of the murder overwhelmed her.
uz: O'sha baxtsiz odamga nisbatan birinchi marta g'ayratli va azobli his-tuyg'ularini ko'rganidan so'ng, uni o'lim haqidagi dahshatli tasavvur hayratda qoldirdi.

en: In his changed tone she seemed to hear the murderer speaking.
uz: Uning o'zgartirilgan ovozi bilan u qotilning gapirganini eshitgan ko'rinardi.

en: She looked at him bewildered.
uz: U unga g'alati ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: She knew nothing as yet, why, how, with what object it had been.
uz: Hozircha u nima uchun, qanday qilib, qaysi asbob bilan bo'lganini hech narsa bilmagan.

en: Now all these questions rushed at once into
uz: Endi bu barcha savollar bir vaqtning o'zida ga kirib keldi.

en: And again she could not believe it: “He, he is a murderer!
uz: Yana bir bor unga ishonmadi: "U qotil!

en: Could it be true?” “What’s the meaning of it?
uz: Bu haqiqat bo'lishi mumkinmi?   Buning ma'nosi nima?

en: Where am I?” she said in complete bewilderment, as though still unable to recover herself.
uz: Qayerda ekanman? - deb so'radi u butunlay g'ayratda, xuddi hali ham o'zini tiklay olmaydigan bo'lib.

en: “How could you, you, a man like you.
uz: Qanday qilib siz o'zingiz kabi odamni qo'lga olishingiz mumkin?

en: … How could you bring yourself to it?
uz: Qanday qilib siz o'zingizni bunga jalb qila olasiz?

en: … What does it mean?” “Oh, well —to plunder.
uz: ... Bu nimani anglatadi? Oh, yaxshi to plunder.

en: Leave off, Sonia,” he answered wearily, almost with vexation.
uz: Qo'yib ket, Sonia, - dedi u charchagancha, deyarli xafa bo'lib.

en: Sonia stood as though struck dumb, but suddenly she cried: “You were hungry!
uz: Soniya soqovga tushib qolganidek turdi, lekin to'satdan: "Siz och edingiz!

en: It was … to help your mother?
uz: Bu ... onangizga yordam berish uchunmi?

en: Yes?” “No, Sonia, no,” he muttered, turning away and hanging his head.
uz: Ha?Yo'q, Sonia, yo'q, u g'iybat qilib, yuz o'girib, boshini asadi.

en: “I was not so hungry.
uz: Men shunchalik och emas edim.

en: … I certainly did want to help my mother, but … that’s not the real thing either.
uz: Men, shubhasiz, onamga yordam berishni xohlaganman, lekin... bu ham haqiqiy narsa emas.

en: … Don’t torture me, Sonia.” Sonia clasped her hands.
uz: ... Meni qiynamang, Sonia. Sonia qo'llarini qo'lga oldi.

en: “Could it, could it all be true?
uz: Bu mumkinmi, bularning barchasi haqiqat bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: Good God, what a truth!
uz: Yaxshi Xudoyim, bu qanday haqiqat!

en: Who could believe it?
uz: Kim bunga ishonishi mumkin?

en: And how could you give away your last farthing and yet rob and murder!
uz: Va qanday qilib siz so'nggi fartingizni berasiz va o'g'irlash va qotillik qila olasiz!

en: Ah,” she cried suddenly, “that money you gave Katerina Ivanovna … that money.
uz: Ah, u to'satdan yig'ladi, o'sha pulni Katerina Ivanovnaga berganing... o'sha pulni.

en: … Can that money …” “No, Sonia,” he broke in hurriedly, “that money was not it.
uz: ...Bu pul bormi ...  Yo'q, Sonia, u terishqoqlik bilan kirdi, bu pul emas edi.

en: Don’t worry yourself!
uz: O'zingizni tashvishlantirmang!

en: That money my mother sent me and it came when I was ill, the day I gave it to you.
uz: Bu pulni onam menga yubordi va men kasal bo'lganimda, sizga bergan kunimda keldi.

en: … Razumihin saw it … he received it for me.
uz: ... Razumihin uni ko'rganida... u men uchun olgan edi.

en: … That money was mine —my own.” Sonia listened to him in bewilderment and did her utmost to comprehend.
uz: ... Bu pul mening pulim edi.Soniya uni hayronlik bilan tingladi va uni tushunishga harakat qildi.

en: … I don’t even know really whether there was any money,” he added softly, as though reflecting.
uz: - Pul bor-yo'qligini ham bilmayman, - deb o'ylaydi u, o'ylab ko'rgandek, sekin qo'shimcha qildi.

en: “I took a purse off her neck, made of chamois leather … a purse stuffed full of something … but I didn’t look in it; I suppose I hadn’t time.
uz: Men uning bo'yniga shamoys teridan yasalgan qopchani olib qo'ydim ... biroz to'ldirilgan qopchani ... lekin ichimga nazar solmadim; ehtimol vaqtim yo'q edi.

en: … And the things —chains and trinkets —I buried under a stone with the purse next morning in a yard off the V — — Prospect.
uz: ... Va men keyingi kuni ertalab V    prospekti yonidagi hovlida sumka bilan tosh ostida ko'mgan zanjirlar va arzonliklar.

en: They are all there now.
uz: Ular endi barchasi bor.

en: …” Sonia strained every nerve to listen.
uz: ... Sonia tinglash uchun har qanday g'ayratga ega bo'ldi.

en: “Then why … why, you said you did it to rob, but you took nothing?” she asked quickly, catching at a straw.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa, nima uchun... nima uchun, uni talon-toroj qilish uchun qilganingizni aytdingiz, ammo hech narsa olib ketmadingiz? - deb so'radi u tezda, cho'g'a ustiga tushib.

en: … I haven’t yet decided whether to take that money or not,” he said, musing again; and, seeming to wake up with a start, he gave a brief ironical smile.
uz: ... Men hali pulni qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida qaror qilmaganman, - dedi u yana o'ylab, o'z o'rnida o'ylaydi. - Va boshlanish bilan uyg'onib, u qisqacha ironik tabassum bilan tabassum qildi.

en: “Ach, what silly stuff I am talking, eh?”
uz: Ach, men qanday ahmoqona narsalar haqida gapiryapman, eh?

en: The thought flashed through Sonia’s mind, wasn’t he mad?
uz: Soʻniyaning fikri uning ongida paydo boʻldi, shunday emasmi?

en: But she dismissed it at once.
uz: Ammo u darhol uni rad etdi.

en: “No, it was something else.” She could make nothing of it, nothing.
uz: Yo'q, bu boshqa narsa edi. U hech narsa qila olmagan, hech narsa.

en: “Do you know, Sonia,” he said suddenly with conviction, “let me tell you: if I’d simply killed because I was hungry,” laying stress on every word and looking enigmatically but sincerely at her, “I should be happy now.
uz: Bilasizmi, Sonia, u birdan ishonch bilan dedi, ey, sizga aytaman: agar men shunchaki och bo'lganim uchun o'ldirgan bo'lsam, har bir so'zimga e'tibor qaratgan va unga sirsiz, lekin samimiy qarashganimda,Men hozir baxtli bo'lishim kerak.

en: You must believe that!
uz: Siz bunga ishonishingiz kerak!

en: What would it matter to you,” he cried a moment later with a sort of despair, “what would it matter to you if I were to confess that I did wrong?
uz: Siz uchun nima ahamiyatga ega, u bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, bir xil umidsizlik bilan yig'ladi,Siz uchun nima ahamiyatga ega, agar men xato qilganimni tan olsam?

en: What do you gain by such a stupid triumph over me?
uz: Men ustidan bunday ahmoqona g'alaba qozonish bilan nimaga erishasiz?

en: Ah, Sonia, was it for that I’ve come to you today?” Again Sonia tried to say something, but did not speak.
uz: Ah, Sonia, bugun men sening oldiga kelganim uchunmi? Yana Sonia biror narsa aytishga harakat qildi, lekin gapirmadi.

en: “I asked you to go with me yesterday because you are all I have left.” “Go where?” asked Sonia timidly.
uz: Kecha men bilan birga borishni so'radim, chunki siz mening qolganimsiz.Soniya qo'rqmasdan so'radi: "Qayerga borasan?"

en: “Not to steal and not to murder, don’t be anxious,” he smiled bitterly.
uz: "O'g'irlik qilmaslik, qotillik qilmaslik, tashvishlanmaslik", - dedi u og'ir tabassum bilan.

en: “We are so different.
uz: Biz juda farq qilamiz.

en: … And you know, Sonia, it’s only now, only this moment that I understand where I asked you to go with me yesterday!
uz: ... Va bilasiz, Sonia, faqatgina hozir, faqatgina o'sha paytda men kecha men bilan birga borishni so'raganimni tushunib yetdim!

en: Yesterday when I said it I did not know where.
uz: Kecha buni aytganimda, qayerdaligini bilmasdim.

en: I asked you for one thing, I came to you for one thing —not to leave me.
uz: Men Sendan bir narsani so'radim, bir narsani so'rab keldim, meni tashlab ketmasligingni so'radim.

en: You won’t leave me, Sonia?” She squeezed his hand.
uz: Siz meni tashlab ketmaysizmi, Sonia? U uning qo'lini siqdi.

en: “And why, why did I tell her?
uz: Va nega, nega men unga aytdim?

en: Why did I let her know?” he cried a minute later in despair, looking with infinite anguish at her.
uz: Nima uchun men unga xabar berdim? U bir daqiqa o'tib umidsizlikka tushib yig'ladi va unga cheksiz qayg'u bilan qaradi.

en: “Here you expect an explanation from me, Sonia; you are sitting and waiting for it, I see that.
uz: Mana siz mendan tushuntirishni kutyapsiz, Sonia; siz o'tirib, uni kutyapsiz, men buni ko'ryapman.

en: But what can I tell you?
uz: Ammo sizga nima deyishim mumkin?

en: You won’t understand and will only suffer misery … on my account!
uz: Siz buni tushunmaysiz va faqat mening nomim tufayli azob chekasiz!

en: Well, you are crying and embracing me again.
uz: Oʻshanda yana yigʻlayotgansan va meni quchoqlayotgansan.

en: Because I couldn’t bear my burden and have come to throw it on another: you suffer too, and I shall feel better!
uz: Chunki men o'z og'irligimni ko'tarolmay, uni boshqa birovga tashlashga keldim: siz ham azob chekasiz, men esa o'zimni yaxshiroq his qilaman!

en: And can you love such a mean wretch?” “But aren’t you suffering, too?” cried Sonia.
uz: Va siz bunday yovuz kambag'alni sevishingiz mumkinmi? Ammo siz ham azob chekmayapsizmi? - deb qayg'urdi Sonia.

en: Again a wave of the same feeling surged into his heart, and again for an instant softened it.
uz: Yana o'sha his-tuyg'ularning to'lqinlari uning qalbiga kirib, bir zum uchun uni yana yumshatdi.

en: “Sonia, I have a bad heart, take note of that.
uz: Sonia, yuragim yomon, buni eslang.

en: It may explain a great deal.
uz: Bu ko'p narsalarni tushuntirib berishi mumkin.

en: I have come because I am bad.
uz: Men yomon odam bo'lganim uchun keldim.

en: There are men who wouldn’t have come.
uz: Kelmagan kishilar ham bor.

en: But I am a coward and … a mean wretch.
uz: Lekin men qo'rqinchli va ... yovuz kambag'alman.

en: That’s not the point.
uz: Bu mavzu o'zi emas.

en: I must speak now, but I don’t know how to begin.” He paused and sank into thought.
uz: Hozir gapirishim kerak, lekin qanday boshlashni bilmayman. U to'xtadi va o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: “Ach, we are so different,” he cried again, “we are not alike.
uz: "A, biz juda farq qilamiz", - deb yana baqirib yubordi u, "biz bir xil emasmiz.

en: And why, why did I come?
uz: Va nima uchun, nima uchun keldim?

en: I shall never forgive myself that.” “No, no, it was a good thing you came,” cried Sonia.
uz: O'zimni hech qachon kechira olmayman. Yo'q, yo'q, kelishingiz yaxshi edi, - deb qayg'urdi Sonia.

en: “It’s better I should know, far better!” He looked at her with anguish.
uz: Men bilishim kerak, ancha yaxshiroq! U qayg'u bilan unga qaradi.

en: “What if it were really that?” he said, as though reaching a conclusion.
uz: Haqiqatan ham shunday bo'lsa nima bo'ladi? dedi u, xuddi xulosaga kelayotgan bo'lib.

en: “Yes, that’s what it was!
uz: Ha, aynan shu narsa edi!

en: I wanted to become a Napoleon, that is why I killed her.
uz: Men Napoleon bo'lishni istardim, shuning uchun uni o'ldirdim.

en: … Do you understand now?” “N-no,” Sonia whispered naively and timidly.
uz: Endi tushunyapsizmi? N-yo'q, Sonia naif va qo'rqinchli so'zlab berdi.

en: “Only speak, speak, I shall understand, I shall understand in myself!” she kept begging him.
uz: Faqat gapiring, gapiring, men tushunaman, o'zimda tushunaman! - deb iltijo qildi u.

en: Very well, we shall see!” He paused and was for some time lost in meditation.
uz: Juda yaxshi, biz ko'ramiz! U to'xtadi va bir muncha vaqt davomida o'ylashda o'zlarini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: “It was like this: I asked myself one day this question —what if Napoleon, for instance, had happened to be in my place, and if he had not had Toulon nor Egypt nor the passage of Mont Blanc to begin his career with, but instead of all those picturesque and monumental things, there had simply been some ridiculous old hag, a pawnbroker, who had to be murdered too to get money from her trunk (for his career, you understand).
uz: Bu shunday edi: bir kuni o'zimdan shunday savol so'radim ¿Menga o'xshab, Napolyon mening o'rnimda bo'lib, Toulon, Misr yoki Mont Blank yo'lboshchisi bilan karyerasini boshlash imkoniyati bo'lmaganida edi, lekin bu hayratlanarli va monumental narsalar o'rniga (karyerasi uchun, tushunasiz) uning bagajidan pul olish uchun o'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan ba'zi bir kulfatli keksa qoqaroq, qarzdor bo'lgan kishi bor edi.

en: Well, would he have brought himself to that if there had been no other means?
uz: Agar boshqa yo'llar bo'lmaganida, u o'zini shunday qilishga taklif qilgan bo'larmidi?

en: Wouldn’t he have felt a pang at its being so far from monumental and … and sinful, too?
uz: U monumental va gunohkorlikdan shunchalik uzoq bo'lganidan xafa bo'lmasmidi?

en: Well, I must tell you that I worried myself fearfully over that ‘question’ so that I was awfully ashamed when I guessed at last (all of a sudden, somehow) that it would not have given him the least pang, that it would not even have struck him that it was not monumental … that he would not have seen that there was anything in it to pause over, and that, if he had had no other way, he would have strangled her in a minute without thinking about it!
uz: Men sizga aytishim kerakki, men o'zimni o'sha savoldan juda xavotirlandim va nihoyat (birdan, bir yo'l bilan) bu unga hech qanday azob bermasligini, bu unga hatto ta'sir qilmasligini, bu monumental emasligini... bu erda to'xtash uchun biron narsa borligini ko'rmasligini va agar boshqa yo'l bo'lmaganida, uni bir daqiqa ichida o'ylab ko'rmasdan tug'ib yubormasligini bilganimda juda uyalganman!

en: Well, I too … left off thinking about it … murdered her, following his example.
uz: Men ham ... bu haqda o'ylashni to'xtatdim ... uni o'ldirib, uning o'rnagiga ergashdim.

en: And that’s exactly how it was!
uz: Va aynan shunday bo'ldi!

en: Do you think it funny?
uz: Siz buni qiziqarli deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: Yes, Sonia, the funniest thing of all is that perhaps that’s just how it was.” Sonia did not think it at all funny.
uz: Ha, Sonia, eng hayajonli narsa shundaki, ehtimol, bu o'sha tarzda bo'lgan. Sonia bu haqda umuman o'ylamagan.

en: “You had better tell me straight out … without examples,” she begged, still more timidly and scarcely audibly.
uz: Siz menga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytib berishingiz kerak edi ... misollarsiz, u iltijo qildi, ammo yanada qo'rqinchli va kamdan-kam eshitilishi mumkin.

en: He turned to her, looked sadly at her and took her hands.
uz: U ayolga yuz o'girib, qayg'uli ko'z bilan unga qaradi va qo'llarini ushlab turadi.

en: “You are right again, Sonia.
uz: Siz yana haqsiz, Sonia.

en: Of course that’s all nonsense, it’s almost all talk!
uz: Albatta, bularning hammasi behuda, deyarli hamma gap-so'z bilan bog'liq!

en: You see, you know of course that my mother has scarcely anything, my sister happened to have a good education and was condemned to drudge as a governess.
uz: Bilasizmi, albatta, onamning hech narsa yo'qligini bilasiz, singlim yaxshi ta'lim olgan va o'qituvchi sifatida mehnat qilishga hukm qilingan.

en: All their hopes were centered on me.
uz: Ularning barcha umidlari menga bog'liq edi.

en: I was a student, but I couldn’t keep myself at the university and was forced for a time to leave it.
uz: O'zim talaba edim, lekin universitetda o'zimni saqlab qololmadim va bir muncha vaqt uni tark etishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: Even if I had lingered on like that, in ten or twelve years I might (with luck) hope to be some sort of teacher or clerk with a salary of a thousand roubles” (he repeated it as though it were a lesson) “and by that time my mother would be worn out with grief and anxiety and I could not succeed in keeping her in comfort while my sister … well, my sister might well have fared worse!
uz: Hatto men o'n-o'n ikki yildan keyin o'qituvchi yoki ishbilarmon bo'lishga umid qilaman va ming rubllik ish haqiga ega bo'laman (o'sha paytgacha u dars kabi takrorladi) va o'sha paytgacha onam qayg'u va tashvishlardan bezovta bo'lib, opamni tasallida saqlay olmayman, opam esa ... yaxshi, opam bundan ham yomon bo'lishi mumkin edi!

en: And it’s a hard thing to pass everything by all one’s life, to turn one’s back upon everything, to forget one’s mother and decorously accept the insults inflicted on one’s sister.
uz: Va hamma narsani o'z hayotidan o'tkazib yuborish, hamma narsaga qaytish, onasini unutish va singlisiga qilingan haqoratlarni munosib ravishda qabul qilish qiyin.

en: When one has buried them to burden oneself with others —wife and children —and to leave them again without a farthing?
uz: O'zini boshqalarga - xotini va bolalariga - og'ir tutish va ularni yana bir bor pulsiz qoldirish uchun ularni ko'mib qo'ygan bo'lsak, nima bo'ladi?

en: So I resolved to gain possession of the old woman’s money and to use it for my first years without worrying my mother, to keep myself at the university and for a little while after leaving it —and to do this all on a broad, thorough scale, so as to build up a completely new career and enter upon a new life of independence.
uz: Shunday qilib, men keksa ayolning pullariga ega bo'lishga va uni onamni tashvishlantirmasdan birinchi yillar davomida ishlatishga qaror qildim, universitetda o'zimni saqlab qolishga va uni tark etganimdan keyin biroz vaqt uchun hammasini keng, chuqur miqyosda amalga oshirishga qaror qildim, shunda men butunlay yangi karyerani qurib, mustaqillik bilan yangi hayotga kirishdim.

en: … Well … that’s all.
uz: Xo'sh... shu qadar.

en: … Well, of course in killing the old woman I did wrong.
uz: - Albatta, bu qariya ayolni o'ldirishda men xato qildim.

en: … Well, that’s enough.” He struggled to the end of his speech in exhaustion and let his head sink.
uz: ... Xo'sh, bu yetarli. U nutqining oxirigacha charchagan holda kurashdi va boshini og'irlashtirdi.

en: “Oh, that’s not it, that’s not it,” Sonia cried in distress.
uz: Oh, shu emas, shu emas, Sonia qayg'udan yig'ladi.

en: “How could one … no, that’s not right, not right.” “You see yourself that it’s not right.
uz: Qanday qilib... yo'q, bu noto'g'ri emas, to'g'ri emas.

en: But I’ve spoken truly, it’s the truth.” “As though that could be the truth!
uz: Lekin men haqiqatni gapirdim, bu haqiqatdir. Xuddi shunday bo'lishi mumkin!

en: Good God!” “I’ve only killed a louse, Sonia, a useless, loathsome, harmful creature.” “A human being —a louse!”
uz: Yaxshi Xudo!  Men faqat bir tovuqni o'ldirdim, Sonia, foydasiz, jirkanch, zararli mavjudot.  Inson mavjudoti  tovuq!

en: “I too know it wasn’t a louse,” he answered, looking strangely at her.
uz: "Men ham bu tuxum emasligini bilaman", - deb javob berdi u, unga g'alati ko'z bilan qaray boshladi.

en: “But I am talking nonsense, Sonia,” he added.
uz: Lekin men g'alati gaplarni aytyapman, Sonia, - dedi u qo'shimcha qilib.

en: “I’ve been talking nonsense a long time.
uz: Ive been talking nonsense for a long time.  Men uzoq vaqtdan beri behuda gapiryapman.

en: … That’s not it, you are right there.
uz: ...Ushbu emas, siz o'sha yerda turibsiz.

en: There were quite, quite other causes for it!
uz: Buning boshqa sabablari ham bor edi!

en: I haven’t talked to anyone for so long, Sonia.
uz: Men shuncha vaqtdan beri hech kim bilan gaplashmaganman, Sonia.

en: … My head aches dreadfully now.” His eyes shone with feverish brilliance.
uz: Mening boshim endi dahshatli og'rig'i bilan og'riydi. Uning ko'zlari qizg'in chiroq bilan parlashardi.

en: He was almost delirious; an uneasy smile strayed on his lips.
uz: U deyarli deliriyalangan edi; uning og'zakiga noqulay tabassum yo'q edi.

en: His terrible exhaustion could be seen through his excitement.
uz: Uning dahshatli charchaganligi uning hayajonidan ko'rinib turardi.

en: Sonia saw how he was suffering.
uz: Sonia uning azob chekayotganini ko'rdi.

en: She too was growing dizzy.
uz: U ham qahramon bo'lib borayotgan edi.

en: And he talked so strangely; it seemed somehow comprehensible, but yet … “But how, how!
uz: Va u juda g'alati tarzda gapirdi; bu tushunarli tuyulgan, ammo...  Ammo qanday, qanday!

en: Good God!” And she wrung her hands in despair.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo! Va u umidsizlikka tushib qo'llarini teshirdi.

en: “No, Sonia, that’s not it,” he began again suddenly, raising his head, as though a new and sudden train of thought had struck and as it were roused him —“that’s not it!
uz: - Yo'q, Sonia, u shunday emas, - dedi u, boshini ko'tarib, boshini ko'tardi, xuddi yangi va to'satdan bir fikr paydo bo'lib, uni uyg'otgandek. - U shunday emas!

en: Better … imagine —yes, it’s certainly better —imagine that I am vain, envious, malicious, base, vindictive and … well, perhaps with a tendency to insanity.
uz: Yaxshi ... tasavvur qiling, ha, albatta yaxshiroq ... tasavvur qiling, men behuda, hasadli, yovuz, nopok, qasosli va ... yaxshi, ehtimol aqlsizlikka moyilman.

en: (Let’s have it all out at once!
uz: (Buni bir vaqtning o'zida chiqarib tashlaymiz!

en: They’ve talked of madness already, I noticed.) I told you just now I could not keep myself at the university.
uz: Ular allaqachon aqlsizlik haqida gapirgan edilar, men buni payqadim.) Men sizga endi universitetda o'zimni saqlay olmayotganimni aytdim.

en: But do you know that perhaps I might have done?
uz: Ammo, ehtimol men buni qilgan bo'lardim, deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: My mother would have sent me what I needed for the fees and I could have earned enough for clothes, boots and food, no doubt.
uz: Onam menga to'lovlar uchun kerak bo'lgan narsalarni yuborardi va men kiyim, poyabzal va oziq-ovqat uchun etarlicha pul topardim, shubhasiz.

en: Lessons had turned up at half a rouble.
uz: Darslar yarim rubldan tushdi.

en: But I turned sulky and wouldn’t.
uz: Ammo men o'zimni ko'nglimdan kechirdim va o'zimni ko'nglimdan kechirdim.

en: (Yes, sulkiness, that’s the right word for it!) I sat in my room like a spider.
uz: (Ha, qayg'urish, bu so'z uchun to'g'ri so'z!) Men o'z xonamda o'tirib, o'simlik kabi o'tirdim.

en: You’ve been in my den, you’ve seen it.
uz: Siz mening g'orimda bo'lgansiz, uni ko'rgansiz.

en: … And do you know, Sonia, that low ceilings and tiny rooms cramp the soul and the mind?
uz: Va sen, Sonia, past plafonlar va kichik xonalar ruh va ongni siqib qo'yganini bilasanmi?

en: Ah, how I hated that garret!
uz: Ah, men o'sha garretdan naqadar nafratlanardim!

en: And yet I wouldn’t go out of it!
uz: Ammo men bundan voz kechmayman!

en: I wouldn’t on purpose!
uz: Men buni niyat bilan qilmagan bo'lardim!

en: I didn’t go out for days together, and I wouldn’t work, I wouldn’t even eat, I just lay there doing nothing.
uz: Kunlar davomida birga chiqib ketmasdim, ishlamasdim, hatto ovqatlanmasdim, shunchaki yonimda yonib, hech narsa qilmasdim.

en: If Nastasya brought me anything, I ate it, if she didn’t, I went all day without; I wouldn’t ask, on purpose, from sulkiness!
uz: Agar Nastasya menga biron narsa olib kelsa, men uni yezdim, agar u olib kelmasa, men kun bo'yi u yerdan ketardim; qasddan qayg'udan so'ramagan bo'lardim!

en: At night I had no light, I lay in the dark and I wouldn’t earn money for candles.
uz: Kechasi yorug'lik yo'q edi, qorong'ilikda yotgan edim va chiroqlar uchun pul topolmasdim.

en: I ought to have studied, but I sold my books; and the dust lies an inch thick on the notebooks on my table.
uz: O'qigan bo'lardim, lekin kitoblarimni sotdim va stoldagi yozuvlar ustida bir santim qalinlikdagi tuproq joylashgan.

en: I preferred lying still and thinking.
uz: Men o'zimni to'xtatib, fikr yuritishni afzal ko'rdim.

en: And I kept thinking.
uz: Va men o'ylashni davom ettirdim.

en: … And I had dreams all the time, strange dreams of all sorts, no need to describe!
uz: Va men doimo orzular qilib turardim, turli xil g'alati orzular, ularni tasvirlashning hojati yo'q!

en: Only then I began to fancy that … No, that’s not it!
uz: Faqat o'shanda men o'zimni shunday his qila boshladimki... yo'q, bunday emas!

en: Again I am telling you wrong!
uz: Yana bir bor sizga noto'g'ri aytyapman!

en: You see I kept asking myself then: why am I so stupid that if others are stupid —and I know they are —yet I won’t
uz: Oʻshanda oʻzimdan: nega men shunchalik ahmoqmanki, agar boshqalar ahmoq boʻlsalar va men ularning ahmoq ekanliklarini bilaman, men buni qilmayman? - deb soʻraganman.

en: Then I saw, Sonia, that if one waits for everyone to get wiser it will take too long.
uz: Keyin shuni ko'rdim, Sonia, agar hamma dono bo'lishini kutsa, bu juda uzoq vaqtni oladi.

en: … Afterwards I understood that that would never come to pass, that men won’t change and that nobody can alter it and that it’s not worth wasting effort over it.
uz: Keyinchalik shuni tushundimki, bu hech qachon sodir bo'lmaydi, odamlar o'zgarmaydi va hech kim uni o'zgartira olmaydi va buning uchun hech qanday harakatni ziyoda qilmaslik kerak.

en: That’s the law of their nature, Sonia, … that’s so!
uz: Bu ularning tabiat qonuni, Sonia, ... shunday!

en: … And I know now, Sonia, that whoever is strong in mind and spirit will have power over them.
uz: Endi shuni bilamanki, Sonia, aqli va ruhi kuchli bo'lgan kishi ularning ustidan hukmronlik qiladi.

en: Anyone who is greatly daring is right in their eyes.
uz: Kimda-kim juda jasoratli bo'lsa, ularning nazarida o'rinli.

en: He who despises most things will be a lawgiver among them and he who dares most of all will be most in the right!
uz: Ko'p narsalarni kamsitgan kishi ular orasida qonun chiqaruvchi bo'ladi va eng ko'p harakat qilgan kishi eng ko'p haqli bo'ladi!

en: So it has been till now and so it will always be.
uz: Hozirgacha shunday bo'lgan va har doim shunday bo'ladi.

en: A man must be blind not to see it!” Though Raskolnikov looked at Sonia as he said this, he no longer cared whether she understood or not.
uz: Odam uni ko'rmasligi uchun ko'r bo'lishi kerak! Raskolnikov buni aytganda Soniaga qaragan bo'lsa-da, uning tushunishi yoki tushunmasligi unga umuman ahamiyat bermasdi.

en: The fever had complete hold of him; he was in a sort of gloomy ecstasy (he certainly had been too long without talking to anyone).
uz: Issiq uni to'liq qamrab oldi; u bir xil qorong'i ekstaziyada edi (u, albatta, uzoq vaqtdan beri hech kim bilan gaplashmagan edi).

en: Sonia felt that his gloomy creed had become his faith and code.
uz: Sonia o'zidan ko'rinib turibdiki, uning qayg'uli e'tiqodi uning e'tiqodi va kodiga aylandi.

en: “I divined then, Sonia,” he went on eagerly, “that power is only vouchsafed to the man who dares to stoop and pick it up.
uz: Men o'sha paytda, Sonia, o'ylab ko'rdim, u g'ayrat bilan davom etdi, qudrat faqat quvonchga to'lib, uni ko'tarib olishga jur'at etgan kishiga beriladi.

en: There is only one thing, one thing needful: one has only to dare!
uz: Faqat bitta narsa, bitta narsa kerak: faqat birovga jasorat qilish kerak!

en: Then for the first time in my life an idea took shape in my mind which no one had ever thought of before me, no one!
uz: O'shanda hayotimda birinchi marta ongimda hech kim o'ylamagan g'oya paydo bo'ldi!

en: I saw clear as daylight how strange it is that not a single person living in this mad world has had the daring to go straight for it all and send it flying to the devil!
uz: Kun yorug'ligicha aniq ko'rdimki, bu g'alati dunyoda yashovchi hech bir odam ham to'g'ridan-to'g'ri harakat qilib, uni shaytonning oldiga yuborishga jur'at qilmagan.

en: I … I wanted to have the daring … and I killed her.
uz: Men ... jasoratli bo'lishni xohladim ... va men uni o'ldirdim.

en: I only wanted to have the daring, Sonia!
uz: Men faqat jasoratli bo'lishni istardim, Sonia!

en: That was the whole cause of it!” “Oh hush, hush,” cried Sonia, clasping her hands.
uz: Buning sababi ham shu edi!Oh hush, hush, Sonia qo'llarini qo'shgan holda yig'ladi.

en: “You turned away from God and God has smitten you, has given you over to the devil!” “Then Sonia, when I used to lie there in the dark and all this became clear to me, was it a temptation of the devil, eh?” “Hush, don’t laugh, blasphemer!
uz: Siz Xudodan yuz o'girib, Xudo sizni urib, shaytonning qo'liga topshirdi!Soniya, men qorong'ilikda yotganimda va bularning barchasi menga aniq bo'lganida, bu shaytonning vasvasaga tushganimi?Hush, kulma, kufr keltiruvchi!

en: You don’t understand, you don’t understand!
uz: Sizlar tushunmayapsizlar, tushunmayapsizlar!

en: He won’t understand!” “Hush, Sonia!
uz: U tushunmaydi!  Hush, Sonia!

en: I know myself that it was the devil leading me.
uz: O'zim ham shuni bilamanki, meni shayton boshqargan.

en: Hush, Sonia, hush!” he repeated with gloomy insistence.
uz: Xush, Sonia, hush! u qayg'uli bosim bilan takrorladi.

en: “I know it all, I have thought it all over and over and whispered it all over to myself, lying there in the dark.
uz: Men hamma narsani bilaman, men buni qayta-qayta o'ylab, qorong'ilikda o'zimga shoshib qoldim.

en: … I’ve argued it all over with myself, every point of it, and I know it all, all!
uz: ... Men o'zim bilan hamma narsani bahslashdim, uning har bir nuqtasi, va men hamma narsani bilaman, hamma narsani!

en: And how sick, how sick I was then of going over it all!
uz: Va men o'sha paytda bularning barchasini ko'rib chiqishdan qanchalik kasal bo'lganman!

en: I have kept wanting to forget it and
uz: Men buni unutib yuborishni istardim va

en: make a new beginning, Sonia, and leave off thinking.
uz: Yangi boshlan, Sonia, va o'ylashni to'xtat.

en: And you don’t suppose that I went into it headlong like a fool?
uz: Va men bu ishga o'zimni aqlsiz deb o'ylamayman, deb o'ylamayapsizmi?

en: I went into it like a wise man, and that was just my destruction.
uz: Men dono odam kabi unga kirdim va bu mening halokatim edi.

en: And you mustn’t suppose that I didn’t know, for instance, that if I began to question myself whether I had the right to gain power —I certainly hadn’t the right —or that if I asked myself whether a human being is a louse it proved that it wasn’t so for me, though it might be for a man who would go straight to his goal without asking questions.
uz: Misol uchun, agar men o'zimdan hokimiyatni qo'lga kiritish huquqiga ega ekanligimni shubha ostiga qo'ysam, shubhasiz, men haqli emasman yoki agar inson o'zimdan bug'doy bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi deb so'rasam, bu men uchun shunday emasligini isbotlaydi, garchi bu savol bermasdan o'z maqsadiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri boradigan kishi uchun bo'lishi mumkin.

en: … If I worried myself all those days, wondering whether Napoleon would have done it or not, I felt clearly of course that I wasn’t Napoleon.
uz: O'zimni o'sha kunlar davomida tashvishlantirganimda, Napoleon buni qilganmi, yo'qmi, deb o'ylasam, o'zim Napoleon emasligimni aniq his qilardim.

en: I had to endure all the agony of that battle of ideas, Sonia, and I longed to throw it off: I wanted to murder without casuistry, to murder for my own sake, for myself alone!
uz: Fikrlar urushi azob-uqubatini ko'tarishim kerak edi, Sonia, va uni tashlab yuborishni orzu qilardim: kasusistrikasiz o'ldirmoqchi edim, faqat o'zim uchun o'ldirmoqchi edim, faqat o'zim uchun o'ldirmoqchi edim!

en: I didn’t want to lie about it even to myself.
uz: Men bu haqda o'zimga ham yolg'on gapirishni istamaganman.

en: It wasn’t to help my mother I did the murder —that’s nonsense —I didn’t do the murder to gain wealth and power and to become a benefactor of mankind.
uz: Men bu qotillikni onamga yordam berish uchun qilmaganman, bu g'alati gaplardir, men bu qotillikni boylik va hokimiyat orttirish va insoniyatga yaxshilik qilish uchun qilmaganman.

en: I simply did it; I did the murder for myself, for myself alone, and whether I became a benefactor to others, or spent my life like a spider catching men in my web and sucking the life out of men, I couldn’t have cared at that moment.
uz: Men buni shunchaki qildim; o'zim uchun, faqat o'zim uchun o'ldirdim va boshqalarga yaxshilik qiluvchi bo'lishim yoki o'z hayotimni o'z to'plamda odamlarni ushlab, odamlarni sug'orib o'tirgan o'g'irmoqqa o'xshatib o'tkazishim haqida o'ylamasdim.

en: … And it was not the money I wanted, Sonia, when I did it.
uz: Va men buni qilganimda, Sonia, men xohlagan pul emas edi.

en: It was not so much the money I wanted, but something else.
uz: Men pulni emas, balki boshqa narsani xohlardim.

en: … I know it all now.
uz: Endi hamma narsani bilaman.

en: Perhaps I should never have committed a murder again.
uz: Ehtimol, men boshqa hech qachon qotillik qilmasam kerak edi.

en: I wanted to find out something else; it was something else led me on.
uz: Men boshqa bir narsani bilmoqchi edim; bu menga boshqa bir narsa olib keldi.

en: I wanted to find out then and quickly whether I was a louse like everybody else or a man.
uz: O'shanda va tezda, men ham boshqalarning o'zi kabi bo'g'im yoki odam ekanligimni bilmoqchi edim.

en: Whether I can step over barriers or not, whether I dare stoop to pick up or not, whether I am a trembling creature or whether I have the right …” “To kill?
uz: Men to'siqlardan o'tishim mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi, ko'tarib olish uchun egri bo'lishim mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi, qo'rqinchli mavjudotmanmi yoki o'ldirish huquqiga egamanmi?

en: Have the right to kill?” Sonia clasped her hands.
uz: O'ldirishga haqingiz bormi? Sonia qo'llarini qo'shdi.

en: “Ach, Sonia!” he cried irritably and seemed about to make some retort, but was contemptuously silent.
uz: - Ach, Sonia! - deb g'azablanib yig'ladi u, biroz javob bermoqchi bo'lib ko'rindi, lekin kamsitish bilan sukut saqladi.

en: “Don’t interrupt me, Sonia.
uz: Meni to'xtatmang, Sonia.

en: I want to prove one thing only, that the devil led me on then and he has shown me since that I had not the right to take that path, because I am just such a louse as all the rest.
uz: Faqat bir narsani isbotlamoqchiman, shunda iblis meni o'sha paytga olib keldi va u menga o'sha paytdan beri o'sha yo'ldan o'tishga haqqim yo'qligini ko'rsatdi, chunki men boshqalarning hammasi kabi bo'g'izman.

en: He was mocking me and here I’ve come to you now!
uz: U meni masxara qilardi va men endi sening oldiga keldim!

en: If I were not a louse, should I have come to you?
uz: Agar men tovuq bo'lmaganimda, sizlarning oldingizga kelishim kerakmidi?

en: Listen: when I went then to the old woman’s I only went to try.
uz: Tinglang: men keksa ayollarga borganimda, faqat sinab ko'rishga borganman.

en: … You may be sure of that!” “And you murdered her!”
uz: Siz bunga amin bo'lishingiz mumkin! Va siz uni o'ldirgansiz!

en: “But how did I murder her?
uz: Ammo men uni qanday qilib o'ldirdim?

en: Is that how men do murders?
uz: Erkaklar o'ldirishni shunday qilishadimi?

en: Do men go to commit a murder as I went then?
uz: Men kabi erkaklar ham o'ldirilgan bo'lishganmi?

en: I will tell you some day how I went!
uz: Bir kuni men sizga qanday bo'lganimni aytib beraman!

en: Did I murder the old woman?
uz: Men keksa ayolni o'ldirganmanmi?

en: I murdered myself, not her!
uz: Men o'zimni o'ldirdim, uni emas!

en: I crushed myself once for all, forever.
uz: O'zimni bir marta, abadiy cho'kib yubordim.

en: … But it was the devil that killed that old woman, not I.
uz: Ammo bu qariya ayolni o'ldirgan iblis edi, men emas.

en: Enough, enough, Sonia, enough!
uz: Yetarli, yetarli, Sonia, yetarli!

en: Let me be!” he cried in a sudden spasm of agony, “let me be!” He leaned his elbows on his knees and squeezed his head in his hands as in a vise.
uz: O'zimni yo'q qil! u o'zimni yo'q qil! o'zimni yo'q qil! o'zimni yo'q qil! o'zimni yo'q qil! U o'z qo'lqoplarini tiz cho'kib, boshini qo'llarida bir to'pka kabi siqib qo'ydi.

en: “What suffering!” A wail of anguish broke from Sonia.
uz: Qanday azob-uqubat! Soniyadan qayg'u g'azabini eshitdi.

en: “Well, what am I to do now?” he asked, suddenly raising his head and looking at her with a face hideously distorted by despair.
uz: Endi nima qilishim kerak? - deb so'radi u, boshini ko'tarib, umidsizlikdan dahshatli ravishda buzilgan yuzini ko'rib.

en: “What are you to do?” she cried, jumping up, and her eyes that had been full of tears suddenly began to shine.
uz: Siz nima qilmoqchisiz? U yig'lab, ko'zidan ko'z yoshlari to'lib-toshgan ko'zlarida to'satdan yorqinlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Stand up!” (She seized him by the shoulder, he got up, looking at her almost bewildered.) “Go at once, this very minute, stand at the crossroads, bow down, first kiss the earth which you have defiled and then bow down to all the world and say to all men aloud, ‘I am a murderer!’ Then God will send you life again.
uz: Toʻxtang! (Oʻsha ayol uni yelkasiga qoʻyib oldi, u oʻrnidan turib, unga deyarli gʻalati qarab turdi.) Bu daqiqada oʻzing bor, yoʻl chekkasida tur, tiz choʻk, avvaliga siz ifloslagan yerni oʻpish, soʻngra butun dunyoga tiz choʻk va barcha odamlarga baland ovoz bilan ayt, Men qotilman! Soʻngra Xudo seni yana tiriltiradi.

en: Will you go, will you go?” she asked him, trembling all over, snatching his two hands, squeezing them tight in hers and gazing at him with eyes full of fire.
uz: Siz ketasizmi, ketasizmi? - deb so'radi u, qo'rqqan holda, uning qo'llarini o'rab olib, o'zining qo'liga qattiq siqib, olovga to'lgan ko'z bilan unga qaradi.

en: He was amazed at her sudden ecstasy.
uz: U uning to'satdan o'ziga xos tuyg'usini ko'rib hayron qoldi.

en: “You mean Siberia, Sonia?
uz: Siberiya haqida gapiryapsizmi, Sonia?

en: I must give myself up?” he asked gloomily.
uz: O'zimni topshirishim kerakmi? - deb so'radi u tushkunlik bilan.

en: “Suffer and expiate your sin by it, that’s what you must do.” “No!
uz: Bunday azob cheking va gunohingni o'zing o'zing o'zingdan kechiring, shundoq qilishing kerak.  Yo'q!

en: I am not going to them, Sonia!” “But how will you go on living?
uz: Men ularga bormayman, Sonia! Ammo siz qanday qilib yashashni davom ettira olasiz?

en: What will you live for?” cried Sonia, “how is it possible now?
uz: Nima uchun yashaysiz? - deya qayg'urdi Sonia, - hozir qanday qilib bu mumkin?

en: Why, how can you talk to your mother?
uz: Nima uchun, onangiz bilan qanday gaplashasiz?

en: (Oh, what will become of them now?) But what am I saying?
uz: (Oh, endi ularga nima bo'ladi?) Lekin men nima demoqchiman?

en: You have abandoned your mother and your sister already.
uz: Siz allaqachon onangiz va singillaringizni tashlab qo'ydingiz.

en: He has abandoned them already!
uz: U allaqachon ularni tashlab ketgan!

en: Oh, God!” she cried, “why, he knows it all himself.
uz: Oh, Xudoyim! - deb baqirdi u, - nima uchun, u hammasini o'zi biladi.

en: How, how can he live by himself!
uz: Qanday qilib u o'zi yashashi mumkin!

en: What will become of you now?” “Don’t be a child, Sonia,” he said softly.
uz: Endi sen bilan nima bo'ladi? Bola bo'lma, Sonia, - dedi u sekin.

en: “What wrong have I done them?
uz: Men ularga nima yomonlik qildim?

en: Why should I go to them?
uz: Nima uchun men ularga borishim kerak?

en: What should I say to them?
uz: Men ularga nima deb aytishim kerak?

en: That’s only a phantom.
uz: Bu faqat hayajon.

en: … They destroy men by millions themselves and look on it as a virtue.
uz: Ular o'zlari millionlab odamlarni yo'q qiladilar va buni bir fazilat sifatida ko'radilar.

en: They are knaves and scoundrels, Sonia!
uz: Ular o'g'illar va g'alatilar, Sonia!

en: I am not going to them.
uz: Men ularga bormayman.

en: And what should I say to them —that I murdered her, but did not dare to take the money and hid it under a stone?” he
uz: Men uni o'ldirganman, lekin pulni olib, tosh ostiga yashirganimga jur'at etmaganman, deb ularga nima deyishim kerak?

en: added with a bitter smile.
uz: Qizil tabassum bilan qo'shildi.

en: “Why, they would laugh at me, and would call me a fool for not getting it.
uz: Nima uchun, ular men bilan kulishadi va uni olmaganim uchun meni axmoq deb ataydilar.

en: A coward and a fool!
uz: Qo'rqoq va ahmoq!

en: They wouldn’t understand and they don’t deserve to understand.
uz: Ular buni tushunmaydilar va tushunishga loyiq emaslar.

en: Don’t be a child, Sonia.
uz: Bola bo'lma, Sonia.

en: …” “It will be too much for you to bear, too much!” she repeated, holding out her hands in despairing supplication.
uz: ... Siz uchun ko'p bo'ladi, juda ko'p! U yana aytdi, qo'llarini ko'tarib, umidsiz iltijo qildi.

en: “Perhaps I’ve been unfair to myself,” he observed gloomily, pondering, “perhaps after all I am a man and not a louse and I’ve been in too great a hurry to condemn myself.
uz: Balki men o'zimga nisbatan adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lgan bo'lsam kerak, deb o'ylaydi u, ehtimol men o'zimni hukm qilish uchun juda shoshilinch edim.

en: I’ll make another fight for it.” A haughty smile appeared on his lips.
uz: U uchun yana bir jang qilaman.Uning og'zidan mag'rur tabassum paydo bo'ldi.

en: “What a burden to bear!
uz: Qaysi og'irlikni ko'tarish kerak!

en: And your whole life, your whole life!” “I shall get used to it,” he said grimly and thoughtfully.
uz: Va butun hayotingiz, butun hayotingiz! Men bunga odatlanib ketaman, dedi u o'ylamasdan.

en: “Listen,” he began a minute later, “stop crying, it’s time to talk of the facts: I’ve come to tell you that the police are after me, on my track.
uz: Quloq solinglar, u bir daqiqa o'tgach, yig'lashni to'xtatdi, bu haqiqat haqida gapirishning vaqti keldi: men sizga politsiya mening orqamda, izimdan ketayotganini aytishga keldim.

en: …” “Ach!” Sonia cried in terror.
uz: ... Ach! Sonia dahshatdan yig'ladi.

en: “Well, why do you cry out?
uz: Xo'sh, nega qichqiryapsan?

en: You want me to go to Siberia and now you are frightened?
uz: Siz mening Sibirga borishimni xohlaysiz va endi qo'rqasiz?

en: But let me tell you: I shall not give myself up.
uz: Lekin sizga aytaman: men o'zimni tashlab ketmayman.

en: I shall make a struggle for it and they won’t do anything to me.
uz: Men buning uchun kurashaman va ular menga hech narsa qilmaydilar.

en: They’ve no real evidence.
uz: Ular uchun haqiqiy dalillar yo'q.

en: Yesterday I was in great danger and believed I was lost; but today things are going better.
uz: Kecha men katta xavf ostida edim va yo'qolganimga ishonardim; lekin bugun vaziyat yaxshilanmoqda.

en: All the facts they know can be explained two ways, that’s to say I can turn their accusations to my credit, do you understand?
uz: Ular bilgan barcha faktlarni ikki yo'l bilan tushuntirish mumkin, ya'ni men ularning ayblovlarini o'zimga ishonib topishim mumkin, tushunasizmi?

en: And I shall, for I’ve learnt my lesson.
uz: Men ham shunday qilaman, chunki darsni o'rgandim.

en: But they will certainly arrest me.
uz: Ammo ular meni albatta hibsga olishadi.

en: If it had not been for something that happened, they would have done so today for certain; perhaps even now they will arrest me today.
uz: Agar biror narsa sodir bo'lmaganida, ular bugun albatta shunday qilishgan bo'lur edi; ehtimol hozir ham meni bugun hibsga olishadi.

en: … But that’s no matter, Sonia; they’ll let me out again … for there isn’t any real proof against me, and there won’t be, I give you my word for it.
uz: Ammo bu muhim emas, Sonia; ular meni yana chiqarib yuborishadi ... chunki men uchun hech qanday haqiqiy dalil yo'q va bo'lmaydi, men sizga bu haqda so'z beraman.

en: And they can’t convict a man on what they have against me.
uz: Va ular menga qarshi nimalar borligiga asoslanib hech kimni ayblay olmaydilar.

en: … I only tell you that you may know.
uz: Men sizga faqat bilishingiz mumkinligini aytyapman.

en: … I will try to manage somehow to put it to my mother and sister so that they won’t be frightened.
uz: Men buni onam va singlimga aytishga harakat qilaman, shunda ular qo'rqmaydilar.

en: … My sister’s future is secure, however, now, I believe … and my mother’s must be too.
uz: Biroq, mening opamning kelajagi xavfsizlikda bo'lib, hozir, men ishonaman ... va onam ham shunday bo'lishi kerak.

en: Will you come and see me in prison when I am there?” “Oh, I will, I will.” They sat side by side, both mournful and dejected, as though they had been cast up by the tempest alone on some deserted shore.
uz: O'sha yerda bo'lganimda, siz meni qamoqda ko'rishga kelarmisiz?Oh, qilaman, qilaman. Ular bir-biriga qo'shilib, qayg'u va tushkunlikka tushib, xuddi bir quruq qirg'oqda bo'lgan shamol tomonidan yolg'iz tashlab ketilganlardek o'tirdilar.

en: looked at Sonia and felt how great was her love for him, and strange to say he felt it suddenly burdensome and painful to be so loved.
uz: Soniaga qarab, uning unga bo'lgan sevgisi qanchalik katta ekanini sezdi va u o'zini shunchalik sevadigan va og'riqli his qilganini aytish qiyin.

en: Yes, it was a strange and awful sensation!
uz: Ha, bu g'alati va dahshatli his-tuyg'u edi!

en: On his way to see Sonia he had felt that all his hopes rested on her; he expected to be rid of at least part of his suffering, and now, when all her heart turned towards him, he suddenly felt that he was immeasurably unhappier than before.
uz: Sonia bilan uchrashish yo'lida u barcha umidlari uning ustida bo'lganini his qilgan edi; u azob-uqubatlarining hech bo'lmaganda bir qismidan xalos bo'lishini kutgan edi va endi uning butun qalbi unga qaratilganida, u birdan o'zini avvalgidan ham ko'proq baxtsiz his qilgan.

en: “Sonia,” he said, “you’d better not come and see me when I am in prison.” Sonia did not answer, she was crying.
uz: "Sonya", - dedi u, "men qamoqda bo'lganimda, meni ko'rmasangiz yaxshi bo'lardi".Sonya javob bermadi, u yig'lab yurgan edi.

en: Several minutes passed.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tdi.

en: “Have you a cross on you?” she asked, as though suddenly thinking of it.
uz: "Sizda xoch bormi?" - deb so'radi u, xuddi to'satdan bu haqda o'ylagandek.

en: He did not at first understand the question.
uz: Boshida u savolni tushunmadi.

en: Here, take this one, of cypress wood.
uz: Mana, bu birini olib boring, kipr yog'ochidan.

en: I have another, a copper one that belonged to Lizaveta.
uz: Mening yana bir kumush qo'lim bor, u Lizavetaga tegishli edi.

en: I changed with Lizaveta: she gave me her cross and I gave her my little icon.
uz: Lizaveta bilan o'zgardim: u menga o'z xochini berdi va men unga o'z kichkina simlimni berdim.

en: I will wear Lizaveta’s now and give you this.
uz: Men hozir Lizavetas kiyib, sizga buni beraman.

en: Take it … it’s mine!
uz: O'zing olib ket... bu mening!

en: It’s mine, you know,” she begged him.
uz: Bu mening, bilasizmi, u unga iltijo qildi.

en: “We will go to suffer together, and together we will bear our cross!” “Give it me,” said Raskolnikov.
uz: Biz birgalikda azob chekamiz va birgalikda xochimizni ko'taramiz! Menga bering, dedi Raskolnikov.

en: He did not want to hurt her feelings.
uz: U ayolning his-tuyg'ularini o'zgartirishni istamagan.

en: But immediately he drew back the hand he held out for the cross.
uz: Ammo u darhol xoch uchun uzatgan qo'lini qaytarib oldi.

en: Better later,” he added to comfort her.
uz: Keyinroq yaxshiroq, u uni tasalli berish uchun qo'shdi.

en: “Yes, yes, better,” she repeated with conviction, “when you go to meet your suffering, then put it on.
uz: Ha, ha, yaxshiroq, u ishonch bilan takrorladi, Siz azob-uqubatingizga duch kelganingizda, uni kiying.

en: You will come to me, I’ll put it on you, we will pray and go together.” At that moment someone knocked three times at the door.
uz: Siz mendan oldinga kelasiz, men uni o'zingizga kiyayman, ibodat qilamiz va birgalikda ketamiz. O'sha paytda kimdir eshikni uch marta taqillatdi.

en: “Sofya Semyonovna, may I come in?” they heard in a very familiar and polite voice.
uz: "Sofya Semyonovna, ichkariga kirsam bo'ladimi? Ular juda tanish va xushmuomala ovoz bilan eshitishdi.

en: Sonia rushed to the door in a fright.
uz: Sonia qo'rqib eshikga yugurdi.

en: The flaxen head of Mr.
uz: Mr.ning laxt boshligi.

en: Lebeziatnikov appeared at the door.
uz: Lebeziatnikov eshik oldida paydo bo'ldi.

en: V Lebeziatnikov looked perturbed.
uz: V. Lebeziatnikov xavotirga tushdi.

en: “I’ve come to you, Sofya Semyonovna,” he began.
uz: "Senga keldim, Sofiya Semyonovna", - deb boshladi u.

en: “Excuse me … I thought I should find you,” he said, addressing Raskolnikov suddenly, “that is, I didn’t mean anything … of that sort … But I just thought … Katerina Ivanovna has gone out of her mind,” he blurted out suddenly, turning from Raskolnikov to Sonia.
uz: Kechirasiz... Men sizni topishim kerak deb o'yladim, - dedi u, Raskolnikovga to'satdan murojaat qilib, - ya'ni, men hech narsani o'ylamagan edim... lekin men o'yladim... Katerina Ivanovna aqldan ozdirgan, - u Raskolnikovdan Soniaga o'zgarib, to'satdan chiqib ketdi.

en: “At least it seems so.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda shunday ko'rinadi.

en: But … we don’t know what to do, you see!
uz: Ammo biz nima qilishni bilmaymiz!

en: She came back —she seems to have been turned out somewhere, perhaps beaten.
uz: U qaytib keldi u bir joyga o'tkazib yuborilgan, ehtimol urilgan bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: … So it seems at least, … She had run to your father’s former chief, she didn’t find him at home: he was dining at some other general’s.
uz: Shunday qilib, hech bo'lmaganda, u otangizning sobiq boshlig'iga yugurib borgan bo'lsa-da, uni uyda topmagan: u boshqa generallarda ovqatlanayotgan edi.

en: … Only fancy, she rushed off there, to the other general’s, and, imagine, she was so persistent that she managed to get the chief to see her, had him fetched out from dinner, it seems.
uz: Faqat o'ziga xos, u boshqa generallarga shoshilib bordi va, tasavvur qiling, u shunchalik qattiq ediki, u boshliqni uni ko'rish uchun chaqirdi va uni kechki ovqatdan olib chiqdi.

en: You can imagine what happened.
uz: Nima bo'lganini tasavvur qila olasiz.

en: She was turned out, of course; but, according to her own story, she abused him and threw something at him.
uz: Albatta, u o'zini o'zgartirgan, lekin o'z hikoyasiga ko'ra, u uni zo'ravonlik qilib, unga biror narsa tashlagan.

en: One may well believe it.
uz: Buni bir kishi ishonishi mumkin.

en: … How it is she wasn’t taken up, I can’t understand!
uz: U qanday qilib o'zi bilan birga bo'lmaganini tushunolmayman!

en: Now she is telling everyone, including Amalia Ivanovna; but it’s difficult to understand her, she is screaming and flinging herself about.
uz: Endi u hammaga, shu jumladan, Amaliya Ivanovnaga gapirib bermoqda, ammo uni tushunish qiyin, u qichqiriq va o'zini o'zi o'ylab o'tkazmoqda.

en: … Oh yes, she shouts that since everyone has abandoned her, she will take the children and go into the street with a barrel-organ, and the children will sing and dance, and she too, and collect money, and will go every day under the general’s window … ‘to let everyone see wellborn children, whose father was an official, begging in the street.’ She keeps beating the children and they are all crying.
uz: ... Ha, u hamma uni tashlab ketgani sababli, bolalarni olib ko'chaga qo'yib ketadi, bolalar ham qo'shiq kuylab raqsga tushadi, o'zi ham, pul yig'ib, har kuni generalning oynasi ostida ketadi... Otalari rasmiy bo'lgan yaxshi tug'ilgan bolalarni ko'rish uchun ko'chada yolvorib yuradi.U bolalarni urib, hamma yig'ib yuradi.

en: She is teaching Lida to sing ‘My Village,’ the boy to dance, Polenka the same.
uz: U Lidaga "My Village"ni kuylashni, "My Village"ni raqsga o'rgatmoqda, Polenka ham shunday.

en: up all the clothes, and making them little caps like actors; she means to carry a tin basin and make it tinkle, instead of music.
uz: Barcha kiyim-kechaklarni tayyorlab, ularni aktyorlar kabi kichkina to'pkalar qilib, musiqa o'rniga, qalin idishlarni olib yurishni va ularni qichqirib qo'yishni nazarda tutadi.

en: … She won’t listen to anything.
uz: U hech narsaga quloq solmaydi.

en: … Imagine the state of things!
uz: ... Bu holatni tasavvur qiling!

en: It’s beyond anything!” Lebeziatnikov would have gone on, but Sonia, who had heard him almost breathless, snatched up her cloak and hat, and ran out of the room, putting on her things as she went.
uz: Bu hech narsaga o'xshamaydi! Lebeziatnikov davom etgan bo'lar edi, lekin Sonia, uning deyarli nafassizligini eshitib, ko'ylagini va to'pqini olib chiqib, xonadan yugurib chiqib, o'z narsalarini kiydi.

en: Raskolnikov followed her and Lebeziatnikov came after him.
uz: Raskolnikov uning orqasidan ergashib, Lebeziatnikov ham uning orqasidan ergashib keldi.

en: “She has certainly gone mad!” he said to Raskolnikov, as they went out into the street.
uz: "U aqldan ozdi!" - dedi u Raskolnikovga, ular ko'chaga chiqib ketayotganlarida.

en: “I didn’t want to frighten Sofya Semyonovna, so I said ‘it seemed like it,’ but there isn’t a doubt of it.
uz: Men Sofiya Semyonovnaga qo'rqitmoqchi emasdim, shuning uchun shunday tuyuladi, deb aytdim, ammo shubhasiz.

en: They say that in consumption the tubercles sometimes occur in the brain; it’s a pity I know nothing of medicine.
uz: Ular iste'mol qilish paytida tuberkullar ba'zan miyada paydo bo'ladi, deb aytishadi; afsuski, men tibbiyot haqida hech narsa bilmayman.

en: I did try to persuade her, but she wouldn’t listen.” “Did you talk to her about the tubercles?” “Not precisely of the tubercles.
uz: Men uni ishontirishga harakat qildim, lekin u quloq solmadi.  Siz u bilan tuberkullar haqida gapirganmisiz?  To'g'ri tuberkullar haqida emas.

en: Besides, she wouldn’t have understood!
uz: Bundan tashqari, u buni tushunmagan bo'lardi!

en: But what I say is, that if you convince a person logically that he has nothing to cry about, he’ll stop crying.
uz: Lekin men aytyapmanki, agar siz odamni hech narsa uchun yig'lashning hojati yo'qligiga mantiqiy ravishda ishontirsangiz, u yig'lashni to'xtatadi.

en: Is it your conviction that he won’t?” “Life would be too easy if it were so,” answered Raskolnikov.
uz: Uning bunday qilmasligiga ishonasizmi? Agar shunday bo'lsa, hayot juda oson bo'lardi, Raskolnikov javob berdi.

en: “Excuse me, excuse me; of course it would be rather difficult for Katerina Ivanovna to understand, but do you know that in Paris they have been conducting serious experiments as to the possibility of curing the insane, simply by logical argument?
uz: Kechirasizlar, kechiringlar; albatta, Katerina Ivanovna uchun buni tushunish juda qiyin bo'ladi, lekin Parijda shunchaki mantiqiy dalillar yordamida aqldan ozganlarni davolash imkoniyati borasida jiddiy tajribalar o'tkazilganini bilasizmi?

en: One professor there, a scientific man of standing, lately dead, believed in the possibility of such treatment.
uz: U yerda o'lgan bir professor, yaqinda vafot etgan obro'li olim bunday davolanish imkoniyatiga ishonardi.

en: His idea was that there’s nothing really wrong with the physical organism of the insane, and that insanity is, so to say, a logical mistake, an error of judgment, an incorrect view of things.
uz: Uning fikri shundaki, aqldan ozgan odamning jismoniy organizmida hech qanday muammo yo'q va aqldan ozgan odam mantiqiy xato, noto'g'ri xulosa, noto'g'ri nuqtai nazardir.

en: He gradually showed the madman his error and, would you believe it, they say he was successful?
uz: U asta-sekin aqldan ozgan odamga o'z xatolarini ko'rsatdi va, ishonasizmi, ular uning muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganini aytishadi?

en: But as he made use of douches too, how far success was due to that treatment remains uncertain.
uz: Ammo u ham dushlardan foydalanganligi sababli, bu davolanish qanchalik muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganligi noma'lum.

en: … So it seems at least.” Raskolnikov had long ceased to listen.
uz: Shunday qilib, hech bo'lmaganda ko'rinadi. Raskolnikov uzoq vaqtdan beri tinglashni to'xtatgan.

en: Reaching the house where he lived, he nodded to Lebeziatnikov and went in at the gate.
uz: U yashaydigan uyga yetib borgach, u Lebeziatnikovga bosh ko'tardi va darvoza tomon kirdi.

en: Lebeziatnikov woke up with a start, looked about him and hurried on.
uz: Lebeziatnikov o'z o'rnidan turib, atrofini ko'rib, shoshilmay davom etdi.

en: Raskolnikov went into his little room and stood still in the middle of it.
uz: Raskolnikov o'zining kichik xonasiga kirib, uning o'rtasida to'xtab turdi.

en: Why had he come back here?
uz: Nima uchun u bu yerga qaytib keldi?

en: He looked at the yellow and
uz: U sariq rangga qaradi va

en: tattered paper, at the dust, at his sofa.
uz: Uning sofasidagi changga to'lgan qog'oz.

en: … From the yard came a loud continuous knocking; someone seemed to be hammering … He went to the window, rose on tiptoe and looked out into the yard for a long time with an air of absorbed attention.
uz: ... hovlisidan baland ovoz bilan to'liq taqillatish keldi; kimdir toshqin qilganday ko'rinardi ... U darchaga bordi, oyoq boshiga ko'tarildi va uzoq vaqt davomida hovlisga e'tibor bilan qaradi.

en: But the yard was empty and he could not see who was hammering.
uz: Ammo hovli bo'sh edi va u kim tortishayotganini ko'rmadi.

en: In the house on the left he saw some open windows; on the windowsills were pots of sickly- looking geraniums.
uz: Chapdagi uyda u ochiq oynalarni ko'rdi; oynalar ustida kasal ko'rinadigan geraniumlar qadoqlari bor edi.

en: Linen was hung out of the windows … He knew it all by heart.
uz: To'qimalar o'tkir edi, u buni yoddan bilar edi.

en: He turned away and sat down on the sofa.
uz: U yuz o'girib, sofaga o'tirdi.

en: Never, never had he felt himself so fearfully alone!
uz: Hech qachon, hech qachon o'zini shunchalik yolg'iz his qilmagan edi!

en: Yes, he felt once more that he would perhaps come to hate Sonia, now that he had made her more miserable.
uz: Ha, u yana bir bor Soniaga nafratlanishini his qildi, chunki u uni yanada baxtsiz qildi.

en: “Why had he gone to her to beg for her tears?
uz: Nega u ayolning ko'z yoshlari uchun iltijo qilish uchun uning oldiga borgan edi?

en: What need had he to poison her life?
uz: Uning hayotini zaharlash uchun unga nima kerak edi?

en: Oh, the meanness of it!” “I will remain alone,” he said resolutely, “and she shall not come to the prison!” Five minutes later he raised his head with a strange smile.
uz: Oh, naqadar behuda!  Men yolg'iz qolaman, dedi qat'iy qaror qilib, va u qamoqqa kelmaydi! Besh daqiqadan so'ng u boshini g'ayrioddiy tabassum bilan ko'tardi.

en: That was a strange thought.
uz: Bu g'alati fikr edi.

en: “Perhaps it really would be better in Siberia,” he thought suddenly.
uz: Ehtimol, Sibirda bu yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'yladi u birdan.

en: He could not have said how long he sat there with vague thoughts surging through his mind.
uz: U qancha vaqt o'sha yerda o'tirganini aytolmasdi va uning ongida g'alati fikrlar paydo bo'lgan.

en: All at once the door opened and Dounia came in.
uz: Darhol eshik ochildi va Dounia kirdi.

en: At first she stood still and looked at him from the doorway, just as he had done at Sonia; then she came in and sat down in the same place as yesterday, on the chair facing him.
uz: Boshida u to'xtab, Sonia bilan qilganidek, eshikdan unga qaradi, keyin u kirib, o'sha yerda o'tirib, uning oldida o'tiradi.

en: He looked silently and almost vacantly at her.
uz: U xotirjamlik bilan va deyarli bo'sh tomondan unga qaradi.

en: “Don’t be angry, brother; I’ve only come for one minute,” said Dounia.
uz: gun bo'lma, aka, men faqat bir daqiqaga keldim, dedi Dounia.

en: Her face looked thoughtful but not stern.
uz: Uning yuzi mulohaza yuritadigan, lekin qattiqqo'l bo'lmagan ko'rinardi.

en: Her eyes were bright and soft.
uz: Uning ko'zlari yorqin va yumshoq edi.

en: He saw that she too had come to him with love.
uz: U uning ham unga sevgi ila kelganini ko'rdi.

en: “Brother, now I know all, all.
uz: Xudo, endi men hamma narsani bilaman, hamma narsani.

en: Dmitri Prokofitch has explained and told me everything.
uz: Dmitri Prokofitch menga hamma narsani tushuntirib berdi.

en: They are worrying and persecuting you through a stupid and contemptible suspicion.
uz: Ular sizni ahmoqona va nafratlanarli shubha bilan tashvishlantirmoqdalar va quvg'in qilmoqdalar.

en: … Dmitri Prokofitch told me that there is no danger, and that you are wrong in looking upon it with such horror.
uz: Dmitriy Prokofitch menga hech qanday xavf yo'qligini va siz unga shunchalik dahshatli qarayotganingizda xato qilganingizni aytdi.

en: I don’t think so, and I fully understand how indignant you must be, and that that indignation may have a permanent effect on you.
uz: Men buni o'ylamayman va siz qanchalik g'azablangan bo'lishingiz mumkinligini va bu g'azablanganlikning sizga doimiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligini to'liq tushunaman.

en: That’s what I am afraid of.
uz: Men bundan qo'rqaman.

en: As for your cutting yourself off from us, I don’t judge you, I don’t venture to judge you, and forgive me for having blamed you for it.
uz: O'zingizni bizdan ajratishingizga kelsak, men sizni hukm qilmayman, sizni hukm qilishga jur'at etmayman va sizni ayblaganim uchun meni kechiring.

en: I feel that I too, if I had so great a trouble,
uz: O'zim ham shunday o'ylaymanki, agar men ham shunday katta muammolarga duch kelsam,

en: should keep away from everyone.
uz: Hammadan uzoqroq turish kerak.

en: I shall tell mother nothing of this, but I shall talk about you continually and shall tell her from you that you will come very soon.
uz: Bu haqda onamga hech narsa aytmayman, lekin siz haqingizda doimo gapirib, tez orada kelishingiz haqida aytaman.

en: Don’t worry about her; I will set her mind at rest; but don’t you try her too much —come once at least; remember that she is your mother.
uz: U haqida tashvishlanmang, men uning ongini tinchlantiraman, lekin uni juda ko'p harakat qilmang, hech bo'lmaganda bir marta keling, u sizning onangiz ekanligini yodda tuting.

en: And now I have come simply to say” (Dounia began to get up) “that if you should need me or should need … all my life or anything … call me, and I’ll come.
uz: Va endi men shunchaki aytishga keldim (Dounia o'rnidan turishga boshladi)ki, agar sizga men kerak bo'lsam yoki kerak bo'lsa ... butun hayotim yoki nima bo'lsa ham ... menga qo'ng'iroq qiling va men kelaman.

en: Goodbye!” She turned abruptly and went towards the door.
uz: Xotinim birdan o'girilib, eshik tomon bordi.

en: “Dounia!” Raskolnikov stopped her and went towards her.
uz: Dounia! Raskolnikov uni to'xtatdi va uning yoniga bordi.

en: “That Razumihin, Dmitri Prokofitch, is a very good fellow.” Dounia flushed slightly.
uz: That Razumihin, Dmitri Prokofitch, juda yaxshi odam. Dounia biroz o'tkazib yubordi.

en: “Well?” she asked, waiting a moment.
uz: Xo'sh? deb so'radi u, bir daqiqa kutgan holda.

en: “He is competent, hardworking, honest and capable of real love.
uz: U mahoratli, mehnatsevar, halol va haqiqiy sevishga qodir.

en: … Goodbye, Dounia.” Dounia flushed crimson, then suddenly she took alarm.
uz: ... Xo'sh, Dounia. Dounia qizil ko'rinishni ko'tardi, keyin birdan u ogohlantirishni qo'zg'atdi.

en: “But what does it mean, brother?
uz: Ammo bu nimani anglatadi, aka?

en: Are we really parting forever that you … give me such a parting message?” “Never mind.
uz: Siz menga bunday xayrli xabarni berishingiz uchun biz chindan ham abadiy ajrashyapmizmi?

en: … Goodbye.” He turned away, and walked to the window.
uz: ... Xo'sh. U yuz o'girib, darchaga bordi.

en: She stood a moment, looked at him uneasily, and went out troubled.
uz: U bir muncha vaqt turdi, unga tashvishlanib qaradi va tashvishlanib chiqib ketadi.

en: No, he was not cold to her.
uz: Yo'q, u ayolga sovuq emas edi.

en: There was an instant (the very last one) when he had longed to take her in his arms and say goodbye to her, and even to tell her, but he had not dared even to touch her hand.
uz: Bir daqiqa (o'zining oxirgi daqiqa) u qizni quchoqlab, salom aytishni va hatto aytishni orzu qilgan edi, lekin u hatto uning qo'liga tegishga ham jur'at etmagan edi.

en: “Afterwards she may shudder when she remembers that I embraced her, and will feel that I stole her kiss.” “And would she stand that test?” he went on a few minutes later to himself.
uz: Shundan so'ng men uni quchoqlaganimni eslab qolganda, u titraydi va men uning o'g'lini o'g'irlaganimni his qiladi. Va u ushbu sinovdan o'tishi mumkinmi? U bir necha daqiqadan so'ng o'zi bilan davom etdi.

en: “No, she wouldn’t; girls like that can’t stand things!
uz: Yo'q, u buni qilmaydi; bunday qizlar bu narsaga chiday olmaydi!

en: They never do.” And he thought of Sonia.
