en: It had been too stifling, too cramping, the burden had been too agonising.
uz: Bu juda og'ir edi, juda og'ir edi, juda og'ir edi.

en: A lethargy had come upon him at times.
uz: Ba'zan u o'ziga kamtarlik hissi bilan qaragan edi.

en: From the moment of the scene with Nikolay at Porfiry’s he had been suffocating, penned in without hope of escape.
uz: Nikolay bilan Porfirda yuz bergan voqeadan boshlab u qochib ketish umidiga ega bo'lmay, o'zini qo'zg'atib, o'zini tosh qilib qo'ygan edi.

en: After Nikolay’s confession, on that very day had come the scene with Sonia; his behaviour and his last words had been utterly unlike anything he could have imagined beforehand; he had grown feebler, instantly and fundamentally!
uz: Nikolayning tanbehidan so'ng, o'sha kuni Sonia bilan sodir bo'lgan voqea sodir bo'ldi; uning xulq-atvori va so'nggi so'zlari u oldindan tasavvur qilgan narsalarga o'xshamaydi; u darhol va tubdan zaiflashdi!

en: And he had agreed at the time with Sonia, he had agreed in his heart he could not go on living alone with such a thing on his mind!
uz: O'shanda u Sonia bilan rozi bo'lgan edi, o'z yuragida shunday fikr bilan yolg'iz yashashni davom ettira olmaydigan bo'lishiga rozi bo'lgan edi!

en: “And Svidrigaïlov was a riddle … He worried him, that was true, but somehow not on the same point.
uz: Svidrigailov esa g'alati edi... U uni tashvishlantirdi, bu haqiqat edi, lekin qaysidir jihatdan bir xil nuqtai nazarga ega emas edi.

en: He might still have a struggle to come with Svidrigaïlov.
uz: U hali ham Svidrigaylov bilan birga kelish uchun kurashishi mumkin.

en: Svidrigaïlov, too, might be a means of escape; but Porfiry was a different matter.
uz: Svidrigailov ham qochish usuli bo'lishi mumkin edi; lekin Porfiry esa boshqacha narsa edi.

en: “And so Porfiry himself had explained it to Razumihin, had explained it psychologically.
uz: Va shuning uchun Porfirining o'zi buni Razumihinga tushuntirib, psixologik jihatdan tushuntirib bergan edi.

en: He had begun bringing in his damned psychology again!
uz: U yana o'zining yomon psixologiyasini keltirib chiqarishni boshladi!

en: But to think that Porfiry should for one moment believe that Nikolay was guilty, after what had passed between them before Nikolay’s appearance, after that tête-à-tête interview, which could have only one explanation?
uz: Ammo, Nikolay paydo bo'lishidan oldin ular o'rtasida nimalar o'tganidan keyin, faqat bitta tushuntirish bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan o'sha intervyudan keyin, Porfiry bir daqiqagacha Nikolay aybdorligiga ishonishi kerak deb o'ylash mumkinmi?

en: (During those days Raskolnikov had often recalled passages in that scene with Porfiry; he could not bear to let his mind rest on it.) Such words, such gestures had passed between them, they had exchanged such glances, things had been said in such a tone and had reached such a pass, that Nikolay, whom Porfiry had seen through at the first word, at the first gesture, could not have shaken his conviction.
uz: (O'sha kunlarda Raskolnikov ko'pincha Porfir bilan bo'lgan voqeada o'tgan voqealarni eslab turardi; u o'z fikrini unga qaratishga chiday olmagan edi.) Bunday so'zlar, bunday harakatlar o'rtasida o'tgan edi, ular o'zaro o'xshash ko'z o'rnidan o'tgan edi, narsalar shunday rangda aytilgan edi va shunday o'tishga erishgan ediki, Porfirning birinchi so'zida ko'rgan Nikolay, birinchi harakatda uning ishonchini silkitib qo'ymas edi.

en: “And to think that even Razumihin had begun to suspect!
uz: Va hatto Razumihin ham shubhalanishni boshlaganini o'ylash!

en: The scene in the corridor under the lamp had produced its effect then.
uz: O'sha paytda chiroq ostida joylashgan koridordagi voqea o'z ta'sirini o'tkazgan edi.

en: He had rushed to Porfiry.
uz: U Porfirga shoshgan edi.

en: … But what had induced the latter to receive him like that?
uz: Ammo uni bunday qabul qilishga nima undagan?

en: What had been his object in putting Razumihin off with Nikolay?
uz: Nikolay bilan Razumixinni qo'yib yuborishning maqsadi nimada edi?

en: He must have some plan; there was some design, but what was it?
uz: U biron bir rejaga ega bo'lishi kerak edi; u erda biron bir dizayn bor edi, ammo u nima edi?

en: It was true that a long time had passed since that morning — too long a time —and no sight nor sound of Porfiry.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, o'sha ertalabdan ko'p vaqt o'tgan va Porfirni ko'rish va eshitishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: Well, that was a bad sign.
uz: Xo'sh, bu yomon belgi edi.

en: …” Raskolnikov took his cap and went out of the room, still pondering.
uz: ... Raskolnikov to'pini olib, xonadan chiqib ketdi va hali ham o'ylab ko'rdi.

en: It was the first time for a long while that he had felt clear in his mind, at least.
uz: Ko'p vaqt o'tgach, u birinchi marta, hech bo'lmaganda, o'zini aniq his qilgan.

en: “I must settle Svidrigaïlov,” he thought, “and as soon as
uz: Svidrigailov bilan kelishuvga erishishim kerak, deb o'yladi u, va imkon qadar tezroq.

en: possible; he, too, seems to be waiting for me to come to him of my own accord.” And at that moment there was such a rush of hate in his weary heart that he might have killed either of those two —Porfiry or Svidrigaïlov.
uz: U ham mening o'zimni o'z xohishim bilan uning oldiga borishimni kutganday tuyuladi. Va o'sha paytda uning charchagan qalbida nafrat shunchalik ko'payganki, u bu ikki kishidan birini o'ldirishi mumkin edi Porfiry yoki Svidrigailov.

en: At least he felt that he would be capable of doing it later, if not now.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, agar hozir bo'lmasa, keyinchalik buni qila oladi deb o'yladi.

en: “We shall see, we shall see,” he repeated to himself.
uz: Biz ko'ramiz, ko'ramiz, o'zi o'ziga takrorladi.

en: But no sooner had he opened the door than he stumbled upon Porfiry himself in the passage.
uz: Ammo u eshikni ochganidan so'ng, yo'lda Porfirining o'zi bilan uchrashdi.

en: He was coming in to see him.
uz: U uni ko'rish uchun kirib kelgan edi.

en: Raskolnikov was dumbfounded for a minute, but only for one minute.
uz: Raskolnikov bir daqiqaga g'alati bo'ldi, lekin faqat bir daqiqaga.

en: Strange to say, he was not very much astonished at seeing Porfiry and scarcely afraid of him.
uz: Ajablanarlisi shundaki, u Porfirni ko'rib hayron bo'lmagan va undan qo'rqmagan.

en: He was simply startled, but was quickly, instantly, on his guard.
uz: U shunchaki qo'rqib ketgan edi, lekin tezda, darhol, o'z hushyorligida edi.

en: “Perhaps this will mean the end?
uz: Ehtimol, bu oxiratni anglatadi?

en: But how could Porfiry have approached so quietly, like a cat, so that he had heard nothing?
uz: Ammo qanday qilib Porfiry shunday xotirjamlik bilan, mushuk kabi, unga hech narsa eshitmagan bo'lishi mumkin edi?

en: Could he have been listening at the door?” “You didn’t expect a visitor, Rodion Romanovitch,” Porfiry explained, laughing.
uz: U eshik oldida tinglab turarmidi?Siz mehmonni kutmagan edingiz, - dedi Rodion Romanovitch, Porfiry kulish bilan tushuntirdi.

en: “I’ve been meaning to look in a long time; I was passing by and thought why not go in for five minutes.
uz: Men uzoq vaqtdan beri ko'rishni xohladim; men o'sha joydan o'tib ketayotgan edim va nega besh daqiqa ichida ichkariga kirmasam bo'ladi deb o'yladim.

en: I won’t keep you long.
uz: Men sizni uzoq vaqt qoldirmayman.

en: Just let me have one cigarette.” “Sit down, Porfiry Petrovitch, sit down.” Raskolnikov gave his visitor a seat with so pleased and friendly an expression that he would have marvelled at himself, if he could have seen it.
uz: Menga bitta sigaretni qo'yib bering. O'tiring, Porfiry Petrovitch, o'tiring. Raskolnikov mehmonini o'tirishga taklif qildi, u shunday xursand va do'stona ifodani ko'rdiki, uni ko'rganida o'ziga hayron bo'lardi.

en: The last moment had come, the last drops had to be drained!
uz: So'nggi damlar to'kib ketishi kerak edi!

en: So a man will sometimes go through half an hour of mortal terror with a brigand, yet when the knife is at his throat at last, he feels no fear.
uz: Shunday qilib, ba'zan bir odam o'g'ri bilan yarim soatlik dahshatli hayot kechiradi, ammo nihoyat pichoq uning bo'yniga tushib qolsa, u hech qanday qo'rquv his qilmaydi.

en: Raskolnikov seated himself directly facing Porfiry, and looked at him without flinching.
uz: Raskolnikov Porfiryga qarata o'tirib, unga ko'z tikmasdan qaradi.

en: Porfiry screwed up his eyes and began lighting a cigarette.
uz: Porfiry ko'zlarini to'g'rilab, sigaret yoqishni boshladi.

en: “Speak, speak,” seemed as though it would burst from Raskolnikov’s heart.
uz: Speak, speak, Raskolnikovning yuragidan burishayotganidek tuyuldi.

en: “Come, why don’t you speak?”
uz: Kosh, nega gapirmayapsan?

en: II “Ah these cigarettes!” Porfiry Petrovitch ejaculated at last, having lighted one.
uz: II Ah, bu sigaretalar! Porfiry Petrovitch nihoyat ejakulyatda, birini yoqib yubordi.

en: “They are pernicious, positively pernicious, and yet I can’t give them up!
uz: Ular zararli, ijobiy zararli, ammo men ularni tashlab ketolmayman!

en: I cough, I begin to have tickling in my throat and a difficulty in breathing.
uz: Qo'shaman, qo'limda qichqiriq va nafas olishda qiyinchilik paydo bo'ladi.

en: You know I am a coward, I went lately to Dr.
uz: Bilasizmi, men qo'rqoqman, men yaqinda doktorning oldiga bordim.

en: B — — n; he always gives at least half an hour to each patient.
uz: B  n; u har doim har bir bemorga kamida yarim soat vaqt beradi.

en: He positively laughed looking at me; he sounded me: ‘Tobacco’s bad for you,’ he said, ‘your lungs are affected.’ But how am I to give it up?
uz: U menga ko'z o'ngida ko'z tikib kulishdi, menga shunday so'zlarni aytdi: "Tobaqa sizga yomon ta'sir qiladi", "tuyuqlaringiz zararlanadi", - dedi. Ammo men qanday qilib to'xtatishim kerak?

en: What is there to take its place?
uz: Uning o'rniga nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: I don’t drink, that’s the mischief, he- he-he, that I don’t.
uz: Men ichmayman, bu mening yomonligimdir, men ichmayman.

en: Everything is relative, Rodion Romanovitch, everything is relative!” “Why, he’s playing his professional tricks again,” Raskolnikov thought with disgust.
uz: Hamma narsa nisbiy, Rodion Romanovitch, hamma narsa nisbiy! Nega, u yana o'z professional hiylalarini o'ynaydi, Raskolnikov jirkanch fikr bildirdi.

en: All the circumstances of their last interview suddenly came back to him, and he felt a rush of the feeling that had come upon him then.
uz: Ularning so'nggi intervyusining barcha holatlari birdan unga eslatib keldi va u o'sha paytda his-tuyg'ularga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: “I came to see you the day before yesterday, in the evening; you didn’t know?” Porfiry Petrovitch went on, looking round the room.
uz: Men siz bilan bir kun oldin, kechqurun uchrashishga keldim; siz buni bilmas edingizmi? Porfiry Petrovitch davom etdi va xonani ko'rib chiqdi.

en: “I came into this very room.
uz: Men aynan shu xonaga kirdim.

en: I was passing by, just as I did today, and I thought I’d return your call.
uz: Men bugun o'tib ketayotgan edim va sizning qo'ng'iroqingizga javob beraman deb o'yladim.

en: I walked in as your door was wide open, I looked round, waited and went out without leaving my name with your servant.
uz: Men sizning eshikingiz ochiq bo'lganida kirdim, atrofimga qarab, kutdim va ismimni xizmatkoringizga qoldirmasdan tashqariga chiqdim.

en: Don’t you lock your door?” Raskolnikov’s face grew more and more gloomy.
uz: Eshikni qulflamaydingizmi? Raskolnikovning yuzi kundan-kunga qorong'i bo'lib borardi.

en: Porfiry seemed to guess his state of mind.
uz: Porfiry uning fikrlash tarzini tasavvur qilgan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: “I’ve come to have it out with you, Rodion Romanovitch, my dear fellow!
uz: Men siz bilan suhbatlashishga keldim, Rodion Romanovitch, aziz do'stim!

en: I owe you an explanation and must give it to you,” he continued with a slight smile, just patting Raskolnikov’s knee.
uz: Men sizga tushuntirish berishga qarzdorman va sizga beraman", - deb davom etdi u kichkina tabassum bilan, Raskolnikovning oyoqlarini tikib.

en: But almost at the same instant a serious and careworn look came into his face; to his surprise Raskolnikov saw a touch of sadness in
uz: Ammo deyarli shu zahoti uning yuziga jiddiy va g'amxo'rlik ko'rinishi tushib qoldi; Raskolnikovning g'amginligini ko'rib, Raskolnikov hayratda qoldi.

en: He had never seen and never suspected such an expression in his face.
uz: U hech qachon yuzidagi bunday ifodani ko'rmagan va hech qachon gumon ham qilmagan.

en: “A strange scene passed between us last time we met, Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Biz oxirgi marta uchrashganimizda, o'zimiz o'rtasida g'alati bir voqea sodir bo'ldi, Rodion Romanovitch.

en: Our first interview, too, was a strange one; but then … and one thing after another!
uz: Birinchi suhbatimiz ham g'alati edi, lekin keyin... bir narsa ortidan boshqa!

en: This is the point: I have perhaps acted unfairly to you; I feel it.
uz: Muhim narsa shuki, men sizga adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lgan bo'lsam kerak, men buni his qilaman.

en: Do you remember how we parted?
uz: Biz qanday ajralganimizni eslaysizmi?

en: Your nerves were unhinged and your knees were shaking and so were mine.
uz: Sening g'azab-g'azabing va tizlaring titrab turardi, mening ham.

en: And, you know, our behaviour was unseemly, even ungentlemanly.
uz: Va, bilasizmi, bizning xulq-atvorimiz munosib emas edi, hatto erkaklarcha emas edi.

en: And yet we are gentlemen, above all, in any case, gentlemen; that must be understood.
uz: Ammo biz - eng asosiysi, eng asosiysi, erkaklarmiz; buni tushunish kerak.

en: Do you remember what we came to?
uz: Biz nimaga erishganimizni eslaysizmi?

en: … and it was quite indecorous.” “What is he up to, what does he take me for?” Raskolnikov asked himself in amazement, raising his head and looking with open eyes on Porfiry.
uz: ... va bu juda beparvo edi. U nima qilyapti, meni nimaga o'ylaydi? Raskolnikov o'ziga hayronlik bilan so'radi, boshini ko'tarib, Porfiryga ochiq ko'zlar bilan qaradi.

en: “I’ve decided openness is better between us,” Porfiry Petrovitch went on, turning his head away and dropping his eyes, as though unwilling to disconcert his former victim and as though disdaining his former wiles.
“Yes, such suspicions and such scenes cannot continue for long.
uz: Ha, bunday shubhalar va ko'rinishlar uzoq davom etishi mumkin emas.

en: Nikolay put a stop to it, or I don’t know what we might not have come to.
uz: Nikolay buni to'xtatdi yoki biz nimaga yetib kelmaganimizni bilmayman.

en: That damned workman was sitting at the time in the next room —can you realise that?
uz: O'sha la'natli ishchi o'sha paytda yonma-yon xonada o'tirgan edi.

en: You know that, of course; and I am aware that he came to you afterwards.
uz: Albatta, siz buni bilasiz va men uning keyinchalik sizdan so'raganidan xabardorman.

en: But what you supposed then was not true: I had not sent for anyone, I had made no kind of arrangements.
uz: Ammo siz o'sha paytda tasavvur qilganingiz noto'g'ri edi: men hech kimni chaqirmaganman, hech qanday tadbirlar qilmaganman.

en: You ask why I hadn’t?
uz: Nima uchun qilmadim deb so'rasan?

en: What shall I say to you?
uz: Sizga nima deyishim kerak?

en: it had all come upon me so suddenly.
uz: Bularning barchasi menga to'satdan tushdi.

en: I had scarcely sent for the porters (you noticed them as you went out, I dare say).
uz: Men bor-yo'g'i portiyerlarni chaqirtirib yuborgan edim (man aytamanki, siz ularni chiqib ketayotganingizda ko'rdingiz).

en: An idea flashed upon me; I was firmly convinced at the time, you see, Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: O'shanda menga bir g'oya paydo bo'ldi; men o'sha paytda qattiq ishongan edim, Rodion Romanovitch.

en: Come, I thought —even if I let one thing slip for a time, I shall get hold of something else —I shan’t lose what I want, anyway.
uz: Keling, men o'yladimki, agar bir narsa bir vaqtga o'tib ketsa ham, boshqa bir narsaga ega bo'laman, men xohlagan narsamni yo'qotmayman.

en: You are nervously irritable, Rodion Romanovitch, by temperament; it’s out of proportion with other qualities of your heart and character, which I flatter myself I have to some extent divined.
uz: Siz, Rodion Romanovitch, o'zingizning temperamentingiz tufayli g'azablanasiz; bu sizning yuragingiz va shaxsiyatingizning boshqa fazilatlari bilan mutanosib emas, men o'zimni maqtanaman.

en: Of course I did reflect even then that it does not always happen that a man gets up and blurts out his whole story.
uz: Albatta, o'shanda ham men o'yladimki, erkak kishi har doim ham o'rnidan turib, butun hikoyasini aytib bermaydi.

en: It does happen sometimes, if you make a man lose all patience, though even then it’s rare.
uz: Ba'zan sodir bo'ladi, agar siz erkak kishining sabr-toqatini yo'qotib qo'ysangiz, lekin hatto u holda ham bu kamdan-kam sodir bo'ladi.

en: I was capable of realising that.
uz: Men buni tushunishga qodir edim.

en: If I only had a fact, I thought, the least little fact to go upon, something I could lay hold of,
uz: O'yladimki, agar men bir faktga ega bo'lsam, hatto unga amal qilish uchun eng kam narsa bo'lsa, uni o'zimga qo'yib olishim mumkin bo'lgan narsa,

en: something tangible, not merely psychological.
uz: Bu shunchaki psixologik emas, balki aniq narsa.

en: For if a man is guilty, you must be able to get something substantial out of him; one may reckon upon most surprising results indeed.
uz: Chunki agar odam aybdor bo'lsa, undan biron-bir muhim narsani olishingiz kerak; albatta, eng hayratlanarli natijalarga umid bog'lash mumkin.

en: I was reckoning on your temperament, Rodion Romanovitch, on your temperament above all things!
uz: Men sizning temperamentingizni, Rodion Romanovitch, har bir narsadan ustun qo'ygan edim!

en: I had great hopes of you at that time.” “But what are you driving at now?” Raskolnikov muttered at last, asking the question without thinking.
uz: O'shanda sizdan katta umidlar orttirgan edim. Ammo hozir nimaga otyapsiz? Raskolnikov nihoyat g'iybat qilib, o'ylab ko'rmasdan savol berdi.

en: “What is he talking about?” he wondered distractedly, “does he really take me to be innocent?” “What am I driving at?
uz: U nima haqida gapirayotgan? - deb o'ylaydi u, - "Haqiqatan ham meni aybsiz deb biladimi?" - deb hayron bo'ldi.

en: I’ve come to explain myself, I consider it my duty, so to speak.
uz: Men o'zimni tushuntirishga keldim, men buni o'z burchim deb bilaman.

en: I want to make clear to you how the whole business, the whole misunderstanding arose.
uz: Men sizga qanday qilib butun ish, barcha noto'g'ri tushunchalar paydo bo'lganini aniq tushuntirishni xohlayman.

en: I’ve caused you a great deal of suffering, Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Sizga ko'p azob-uqubatlar yetkazganman, Rodion Romanovitch.

en: I understand what it must mean for a man who has been unfortunate, but who is proud, imperious and above all, impatient, to have to bear such treatment!
uz: O'shanda baxtsiz bo'lgan, ammo mag'rur, g'ururli va eng muhimi, sabrsizlik bilan muomala qilayotgan kishi uchun bunday muomalaga duch kelish nimani anglatishini tushunaman!

en: I regard you in any case as a man of noble character and not without elements of magnanimity, though I don’t agree with all your convictions.
uz: Sizni har qanday holatda buyuk xarakterga ega bo'lgan odam deb bilaman va mag'rurlik elementlaridan mahrum emasman, garchi men sizning barcha e'tiqodlaringiz bilan rozi bo'lmasam ham.

en: I wanted to tell you this first, frankly and quite sincerely, for above all I don’t want to deceive you.
uz: Avval men sizga bu haqda ochiq va samimiylik bilan aytmoqchi edim, chunki eng avvalo men sizni aldashni istamayman.

en: When I made your acquaintance, I felt attracted by you.
uz: Siz bilan tanishib olsam, siz menga yoqib qoldingiz.

en: Perhaps you will laugh at my saying so.
uz: Ehtimol, siz mening shunday deyishimdan kulmaysiz.

en: You have a right to.
uz: Siz bunga haqingiz bor.

en: I know you disliked me from the first and indeed you’ve no reason to like me.
uz: Men bilamanki, siz meni birinchi marta yoqtirmas edingiz va, albatta, meni yoqtirishga hech qanday sababingiz yo'q.

en: You may think what you like, but I desire now to do all I can to efface that impression and to show that I am a man of heart and conscience.
uz: Sizlar xohlaganingizni o'ylay olasiz, lekin men hozir bu taassurotni o'chirib tashlash va yurak va vijdonli odam ekanimni ko'rsatish uchun qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qilishni xohlayman.

en: I speak sincerely.” Porfiry Petrovitch made a dignified pause.
uz: Men chin dildan gapiryapman. Porfiry Petrovitch munosib to'xtatish qildi.

en: Raskolnikov felt a rush of renewed alarm.
uz: Raskolnikov yangi ogohlantirishni his qildi.

en: The thought that Porfiry believed him to be innocent began to make him uneasy.
uz: Porfirining aybsiz deb o'ylashi uni xavotirga solishni boshladi.

en: “It’s scarcely necessary to go over everything in detail,” Porfiry Petrovitch went on.
uz: "Har narsani batafsil ko'rib chiqish arziydi", - dedi Porfiry Petrovitch.

en: “Indeed, I could scarcely attempt it.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men buni sinab ko'rishim mumkin emas edi.

en: To begin with there were rumours.
uz: Avvaliga mish-mishlar bor edi.

en: Through whom, how, and when those rumours came to me … and how they affected you, I need not go into.
uz: Kim orqali, qanday qilib va qachon bu mish-mishlar menga yetib keldi ... va ular sizga qanday ta'sir qildi, men bunga kirishim shart emas.

en: My suspicions were aroused by a complete accident, which might just as easily not have happened.
uz: Mening shubhalarim to'liq baxtsiz hodisa tufayli paydo bo'ldi, bu sodir bo'lmasligi mumkin edi.

en: I believe there is no need to go into that either.
uz: Menimcha, bu haqda ham gapirishning hojati yo'q.

en: Those rumours and that accident led to one idea in my mind.
uz: O'sha mish-mishlar va voqeadan so'ng mening ongimda bitta fikr paydo bo'ldi.

en: I admit it openly —for one may as well make a clean breast of it —I was the first to pitch on you.
uz: Men buni ochiqchasiga tan olaman, chunki siz ham bundan toza ko'krak topishingiz mumkin. Men birinchi bo'lib sizga qarshi chiqdim.

en: The old woman’s notes on the pledges and the rest of it —that all came to nothing.
uz: Keksa ayolning va'dalar va boshqa narsalar haqida yozgan yozuvlari bularning barchasi puchga chiqqanini ko'rsatdi.

en: Yours was one of a hundred.
uz: Seningki yuz kishidan biri edi.

en: I happened, too, to hear of the scene at the office, from a man who described it capitally, unconsciously reproducing the scene with great vividness.
uz: Men ham ishxonada sodir bo'lgan voqeani katta ma'noda tasvirlagan bir odamdan eshitgan edim, u o'z-o'zidan bexabar voqeani katta jonlilik bilan takrorlagan edi.

en: It was just one thing after another, Rodion Romanovitch, my dear fellow!
uz: Bu faqat bir-biridan keyin sodir bo'ldi, Rodion Romanovitch, aziz do'stim!

en: How could I avoid being brought to certain ideas?
uz: Qanday qilib ba'zi fikrlarga berilib ketishdan qochishim mumkin?

en: From a hundred rabbits you can’t make a horse, a hundred suspicions don’t make a proof, as the English proverb says, but that’s only from the rational point of view — you can’t help being partial, for after all a lawyer is only human.
uz: Yuzta tovuqdan ot yaratib bo'lmaydi, yuzlab shubhalar ingliz ma'nosi kabi dalil yaratmaydi, lekin bu faqat oqilona nuqtai nazar bilan sodir bo'ladi.

en: I thought, too, of your article in that journal, do you remember, on your first visit we talked of it?
uz: Men ham jurnaldagi maqolangiz haqida o'yladim, eslaysizmi, birinchi tashrifingizda biz bu haqda gapirgan edik?

en: I jeered at you at the time, but that was only to lead you on.
uz: O'shanda men seni masxara qildim, lekin bu faqat seni yo'ldan ozdirish uchun edi.

en: I repeat, Rodion Romanovitch, you are ill and impatient.
uz: Yana aytaman, Rodion Romanovitch, siz kasal va sabrsizlik bilan kurashyapsiz.

en: That you were bold, headstrong, in earnest and … had felt a great deal I recognised long before.
uz: Siz jasoratli, qat'iy va jiddiy ekanligingizni va ... men ancha oldin tan olganimdek, juda ko'p narsani his qilganingizni.

en: I, too, have felt the same, so that your article seemed familiar to me.
uz: Men ham xuddi shunday his qildim, shuning uchun maqolangiz menga tanish tuyuldi.

en: It was conceived on sleepless nights, with a throbbing heart, in ecstasy and suppressed enthusiasm.
uz: Bu uyqusiz kechalarda, yurak urishida, ekstazda va g'ayratni yo'q qilishda tug'ilgan.

en: And that proud suppressed enthusiasm in young people is dangerous!
uz: Va yoshlarning g'ururli va g'ururli bo'lgan hayajonlari xavfli!

en: I jeered at you then, but let me tell you that, as a literary amateur, I am awfully fond of such first essays, full of the heat of youth.
uz: O'shanda men sizga kulgan edim, lekin sizga aytamanki, bir adabiyyat ishbilarmonligi sifatida yoshlik issiqligi bilan to'lgan bunday birinchi esaylarni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

en: There is a mistiness and a chord vibrating in the mist.
uz: Bulut ichida bir so'z va bir chord larzaga keladi.

en: Your article is absurd and fantastic, but there’s a transparent sincerity, a youthful incorruptible pride and the daring of despair in it.
uz: Maqolangiz g'alati va ajoyib, lekin ularda shaffof samimiylik, yoshlikdagi ifloslik va umidsizlikning jasorati bor.

en: It’s a gloomy article, but that’s what’s fine in it.
uz: Bu qora maqola, ammo bu erda yaxshi narsa bor.

en: I read your article and put it aside, thinking as I did so ‘that man won’t go the common way.’ Well, I ask you, after that as a preliminary, how could I help being carried away by what followed?
uz: Men maqolangizni o'qib qo'ydim va uni chetga qo'ydim, o'zim ham shunday deb o'yladim: "Bu odam odatdagi yo'ldan yurmaydi.

en: Oh, dear, I am not saying anything, I am not making any statement now.
uz: Oh, azizim, men hech narsa aytmayapman, hozir hech qanday deklaratsiya qilmayapman.

en: I simply noted it at the time.
uz: O'sha paytda men shunchaki yozib qoldim.

en: What is there in it?
uz: Unda nima bor?

en: There’s nothing in it, that is really nothing and perhaps absolutely nothing.
uz: Unda hech narsa yo'q, bu aslida hech narsa va ehtimol mutlaqo hech narsa emas.

en: And it’s not at all the thing for the prosecutor to let himself be carried away by notions: here I have Nikolay on my hands with actual evidence against him —you may think what you like of it, but it’s evidence.
uz: Prokuror o'zini tushunchalarga jalb qilishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi: bu erda men Nikolayni qo'limga oldim va unga qarshi haqiqiy dalillar bor.

en: He brings in his psychology, too; one has to consider him, too, for it’s a matter of life and death.
uz: U o'z psixologiyasini ham o'z ichiga oladi; uni ham inobatga olish kerak, chunki bu hayot va o'lim masalasi.

en: Why am I explaining this to you?
uz: Nega men sizga buni tushuntirib beryapman?

en: That you may understand, and not blame my malicious behaviour on that occasion.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz tushunishingiz va o'sha paytdagi yomon xulq-atvorim uchun aybdor bo'lmasligingiz uchun.

en: It was not malicious, I assure you, he-he!
uz: Bu yovuzlik emas edi, sizga ishontiraman, u-u!

en: Do you suppose I didn’t come to search your room at the time?
uz: O'sha paytda xonangizni qidirib topishga kelmadimmi?

en: I did, I did, he-he!
uz: Men shunday qildim, shunday qildim, shunday qildim!

en: I was here when you were lying ill in bed, not officially, not in my own person,
uz: Sen kasal holda yotoqda yotganingda men bu yerda edim, rasman emas, shaxsan ham emas.

en: Your room was searched to the last thread at the first suspicion; but umsonst!
uz: Sizning xonangiz birinchi gumon bilan oxirgi nuqtagacha qidirildi; lekin umsonst!

en: I thought to myself, now that man will come, will come of himself and quickly, too; if he’s guilty, he’s sure to come.
uz: O'zimga shunday o'yladim: "Bu odam o'z-o'zidan keladi va tezda keladi; agar u aybdor bo'lsa, albatta keladi".

en: Another man wouldn’t, but he will.
uz: Boshqa kishi buni qilmaydi, lekin qiladi.

en: And you remember how Mr.
uz: Va siz o'zingiz eslaysiz, qanday qilib Mr.

en: Razumihin began discussing the subject with you?
uz: Razumihin bu mavzuda siz bilan suhbatlashishni boshladimi?

en: We arranged that to excite you, so we purposely spread rumours, that he might discuss the case with you, and Razumihin is not a man to restrain his indignation.
uz: Biz buni sizni hayajonlantirish uchun qildik, shuning uchun biz qasddan mish-mishlarni tarqatdik, shuning uchun u siz bilan bu ishni muhokama qilishi mumkin, va Razumihin o'z g'azabini to'xtatadigan odam emas.

en: Zametov was tremendously struck by your anger and your open daring.
uz: Zametov sizning g'azabingiz va ochiq jasoratingizdan juda hayratda qoldi.

en: Think of blurting out in a restaurant ‘I killed her.’ It was too daring, too reckless.
uz: Mehmonxonada o'tirganimni o'ylab ko'ring, men uni o'ldirib yubordim.Bu juda jasoratli, juda beparvolik edi.

en: I thought so myself, if he is guilty he will be a formidable opponent.
uz: O'zim ham shunday deb o'yladim, agar u aybdor bo'lsa, u kuchli raqib bo'ladi.

en: That was what I thought at the time.
uz: O'shanda men ham shunday deb o'yladim.

en: I was expecting you.
uz: Men sizni kutgan edim.

en: But you simply bowled Zametov over and  … well, you see, it all lies in this —that this damnable psychology can be taken two ways!
uz: Ammo siz shunchaki Zametovni o'tkazgansiz va... ko'rib turganingizdek, hamma narsa shunda turibdi - bu yomon psixologiya ikki yo'l bilan tushunilishi mumkin!

en: Well, I kept expecting you, and so it was, you came!
uz: Men sizni kutgan edim va shunday bo'ldi, siz keldingiz!

en: My heart was fairly throbbing.
uz: Qalbim o'ta tez urardi.

en: “Now, why need you have come?
uz: Hndi nima uchun kelishingiz kerak?

en: Your laughter, too, as you came in, do you remember?
uz: Siz kirganingizda sizning kulishingiz ham, eslaysizmi?

en: I saw it all plain as daylight, but if I hadn’t expected you so specially, I should not have noticed anything in your laughter.
uz: Men hamma narsani kunduz yorug'ligicha ko'rdim, lekin agar sizdan bunday xotirjamlikni kutmaganimda, sizning kulishingizda hech narsa ko'rmagan bo'lar edim.

en: You see what influence a mood has!
uz: Mana, ruhning ta'siri qanchalik kuchli ekanligini ko'rasiz!

en: Razumihin then — ah, that stone, that stone under which the things were hidden!
uz: Razumihin keyin  ah, bu tosh, bu narsalar yashirilgan tosh!

en: I seem to see it somewhere in a kitchen garden.
uz: Men buni oshxonada bir joyda ko'ryapman.

en: It was in a kitchen garden, you told Zametov and afterwards you repeated that in my office?
uz: Bu oshxonada bo'lgan, siz Zametovga aytdingiz va keyin esa ofisimda takrorladingiz?

en: And when we began picking your article to pieces, how you explained it!
uz: Va biz maqolangizni parchalashni boshlaganimizda, siz uni qanday tushuntirdingiz!

en: One could take every word of yours in two senses, as though there were another meaning hidden.
uz: Sizning har bir so'zingizni ikki ma'noda qabul qilish mumkin, xuddi boshqa ma'nolar yashirin bo'lgani kabi.

en: “So in this way, Rodion Romanovitch, I reached the furthest limit, and knocking my head against a post, I pulled myself up, asking myself what I was about.
uz: Shunday qilib, Rodion Romanovitch, men eng uzoq chegaraga yetib keldim va boshimni ustunga urib, o'zimni ko'tarib, nima qilayotganimni o'zimdan so'radim.

en: After all, I said, you can take it all in another sense if you like, and it’s more natural so, indeed.
uz: Axir, men aytdim, agar xohlasangiz, hamma narsani boshqa ma'noda ko'rishingiz mumkin va bu tabiiyroq.

en: I couldn’t help admitting it was more natural.
uz: Bu tabiiyroq ekanini tan oldim.

en: ‘No, I’d better get hold of some little fact’ I said.
uz: Yo'q, men aytgan ba'zi kichik faktlarni o'zlashtirib olishim kerak.

en: So when I heard of the bell-ringing, I held my breath and was all in a tremor.
uz: Shunda qo'ng'iroq tovushini eshitganimda, nafasimni ushlab qoldim va butunlay titrab qoldim.

en: ‘Here is my little fact,’ thought I, and I didn’t think it over, I simply wouldn’t.
uz: Mana mening kichkina faktim, deb o'yladim, lekin o'ylab ko'rmadim, shunchaki o'ylamasdim.

en: I would have given a thousand roubles at that minute to have seen you with my own eyes, when you walked a hundred paces beside that workman, after he had called you murderer to your face, and you did not dare to ask
uz: O'sha daqiqada sizni o'z ko'zim bilan ko'rish uchun ming rubl berardim, o'sha ishchining yonida yuz qadam yurganingizda, u sizni qotil deb ataganidan so'ng va siz so'rashga jur'at etmaganingizda.

en: him a question all the way.
uz: Unga butunlay savol berish kerak edi.

en: And then what about your trembling, what about your bell-ringing in your illness, in semi-delirium?
uz: Va keyin titrashingiz, kasalligingizda, yarim deliriumda qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz haqida nima deyish mumkin?

en: “And so, Rodion Romanovitch, can you wonder that I played such pranks on you?
uz: Shunday qilib, Rodion Romanovitch, men siz bilan shunday mashg'ulotlar o'tkazganimdan hayron bo'la olasizmi?

en: And what made you come at that very minute?
uz: Va nima sizni o'sha daqiqaga keltirdi?

en: Someone seemed to have sent you, by Jove!
uz: Kimdir sizni jo'natgan ko'rinardi, Jove!

en: And if Nikolay had not parted us … and do you remember Nikolay at the time?
uz: Agar Nikolay bizni ajratmagan bo'lsa-chi... o'sha paytda Nikolayni eslaysizmi?

en: Do you remember him clearly?
uz: Uni aniq eslay olasizmi?

en: It was a thunderbolt, a regular thunderbolt!
uz: Bu chaqmoq, odatdagi chaqmoq edi!

en: I didn’t believe in the thunderbolt, not for a minute.
uz: Men bir daqiqa ham chaqmoqga ishonmadim.

en: You could see it for yourself; and how could I?
uz: Siz buni o'zingiz ko'rishingiz mumkin edi va men qanday qilib ko'rishim mumkin?

en: Even afterwards, when you had gone and he began making very, very plausible answers on certain points, so that I was surprised at him myself, even then I didn’t believe his story!
uz: Hatto keyinchalik, siz ketib ketgandan so'ng ham, u ba'zi savollarga juda, juda ishonchli javob berishni boshlaganida, hatto men ham unga hayratda qoldim, hatto o'shanda ham uning hikoyasiga ishonmadim!

en: You see what it is to be as firm as a rock!
uz: Tosh kabi qat'iy bo'lish nimani anglatishini bilasiz!

en: No, thought I, Morgenfrüh.
uz: Yo'q, men o'yladim, Ertalab.

en: What has Nikolay got to do with it!” “Razumihin told me just now that you think Nikolay guilty and had yourself assured him of it.
uz: Nikolay bunga qanday aloqasi bor?Razumihin menga hali-haqiqatan Nikolay aybdor deb o'ylayotganingizni aytdi va o'zingiz unga bu haqda ishontirgansiz.

en: …” His voice failed him, and he broke off.
uz: ... Uning ovozi uni yo'qotib qo'ydi va u bo'shatildi.

en: He had been listening in indescribable agitation, as this man who had seen through and through him, went back upon himself.
uz: U so'zlab bo'lmaydigan g'ayrat bilan tinglagan edi, chunki bu odam uni ko'rgan va ko'rgan bo'lib, o'ziga qaytdi.

en: He was afraid of believing it and did not believe it.
uz: U bunga ishonishdan qo'rqardi va ishonmadi.

en: In those still ambiguous words he kept eagerly looking for something more definite and conclusive.
uz: O'sha hali ham noaniq so'zlar bilan u yanada aniqroq va aniqroq narsani izlab yurgan.

en: Razumihin!” cried Porfiry Petrovitch, seeming glad of a question from Raskolnikov, who had till then been silent.
uz: Razumihin! Porfiry Petrovitch, Raskolnikovning savolidan xursand bo'lib, o'sha paytgacha sukut saqlagan.

en: But I had to put Mr.
uz: Ammo men Mr.ni qo'yishim kerak edi.

en: Razumihin off; two is company, three is none.
uz: Razumihin yo'q; ikkitasi kompaniyadir, uchasi hech narsa emas.

en: Razumihin is not the right man, besides he is an outsider.
uz: Razumihin to'g'ri odam emas, xolos, u chet ellik.

en: He came running to me with a pale face.
uz: U o'z ko'z o'ngida bo'lib, yonimga yugurib keldi.

en: … But never mind him, why bring him in?
uz: Ammo uni tashlab qo'ying, uni nima uchun olib kelish kerak?

en: To return to Nikolay, would you like to know what sort of a type he is, how I understand him, that is?
uz: Nikolayga qaytib kelsak, u qanday inson, men uni qanday tushunaman, deb bilishni xohlaysizmi?

en: To begin with, he is still a child and not exactly a coward, but something by way of an artist.
uz: Avvalo, u hali ham bola va to'g'ri qo'rqoq emas, balki san'atkor.

en: Really, don’t laugh at my describing him so.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, uni shunday tasvirlaganimdan kulmang.

en: He is innocent and responsive to influence.
uz: U aybsiz va ta'sirga javobgardir.

en: He has a heart, and is a fantastic fellow.
uz: Uning yuragi bor va u ajoyib odam.

en: He sings and dances, he tells stories, they say, so that people come from other villages to hear him.
uz: U kuylaydi va raqs qiladi, hikoyalar aytib beradi, deyishadi, shuning uchun boshqa qishloqlardan odamlar uni tinglash uchun kelishadi.

en: He attends school too, and laughs till he cries if you hold up a finger to him; he will drink himself senseless —not as a regular vice, but at times, when people treat him, like a child.
uz: U ham maktabga boradi va agar unga barmog'ingizni ko'tarsangiz, yig'lab o'tiradi; u o'zini aqlsiz ichadi - odat tusiga kirmay, balki ba'zida odamlar unga bola kabi munosabatda bo'lganda.

en: And he stole, too, then, without knowing it himself, for ‘How can it be stealing, if one picks it up?’ And do you know he is
uz: Keyin u ham o'zi bilmasdan o'g'irlab ketgan, chunki uni olib ketayotgan kishi o'g'irlab ketgan bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: an Old Believer, or rather a dissenter?
uz: Eski imonli, yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, ko'pchilikni norozi qilgan kishi?

en: There have been Wanderersൣ in his family, and he was for two years in his village under the spiritual guidance of a certain elder.
uz: Oilasida ko'chmas sayohatchilar bor edi va u ikki yil davomida o'z qishlog'ida bir oqsoqolning ma'naviy yo'l-yo'rig'i ostida edi.

en: I learnt all this from Nikolay and from his fellow villagers.
uz: Men bularning barchasini Nikolay va uning qishlog'idan o'rgandim.

en: And what’s more, he wanted to run into the wilderness!
uz: Bundan tashqari, u sahroga qochmoqchi edi!

en: He was full of fervour, prayed at night, read the old books, ‘the true’ ones, and read himself crazy.
uz: U juda g'ayratli bo'lib, kechasi ibodat qilib, eski kitoblarni o'qib, o'zini aqldan o'tkazgan.

en: “Petersburg had a great effect upon him, especially the women and the wine.
uz: Peterburg unga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi, ayniqsa xotin-qizlar va sharob.

en: He responds to everything and he forgot the elder and all that.
uz: U hamma narsaga javob beradi va oqsoqol va boshqa narsalarni unutib qo'yadi.

en: I learnt that an artist here took a fancy to him, and used to go and see him, and now this business came upon him.
uz: Men bu yerda bir san'atkor unga yoqqanini va uni ko'rishga borganini bilib oldim, endi esa bu ish uning ustiga tushdi.

en: “Well, he was frightened, he tried to hang himself!
uz: U qo'rqib, o'zini asrashga harakat qildi!

en: How can one get over the idea the people have of Russian legal proceedings?
uz: Qanday qilib odamlar Rossiya bo'yicha sud jarayonlari haqida o'ylashlari mumkin?

en: The very word ‘trial’ frightens some of them.
uz: Ba'zilarni trial so'zi qo'rqitadi.

en: We shall see what the new juries will do.
uz: Yangi hay'at a'zolari nima qilishini ko'ramiz.

en: God grant they do good!
uz: Xudo ularga yaxshilik qilsin!

en: Well, in prison, it seems, he remembered the venerable elder; the Bible, too, made its appearance again.
uz: Ehtimol, qamoqda u aziz oqsoqolni esladi; Muqaddas Kitob ham yana paydo bo'ldi.

en: Do you know, Rodion Romanovitch, the force of the word ‘suffering’ among some of these people!
uz: Bilasizmi, Rodion Romanovitch, ba'zi odamlar orasida azob chekish so'zining kuchi!

en: It’s not a question of suffering for someone’s benefit, but simply, ‘one must suffer.’ If they suffer at the hands of the authorities, so much the better.
uz: Bu odamning foydasi uchun azob chekishi emas, balki shunchaki, azob chekishi kerak.Agar ular hokimiyat tomonidan azob chekishsa, shunchalik yaxshiroqdir.

en: In my time there was a very meek and mild prisoner who spent a whole year in prison always reading his Bible on the stove at night and he read himself crazy, and so crazy, do you know, that one day, apropos of nothing, he seized a brick and flung it at the governor; though he had done him no harm.
uz: Mening davrimda juda kamtar va muloyim bir mahbus bor edi, u butun yil davomida qamoqda bo'lib, kechasi do'zaxda Muqaddas Kitobni o'qib o'tirardi va o'zini aqldan ozgan deb o'ylardi, va shunchalik aqldan ozganki, bir kuni, hech narsa bo'lmagan holda, bir tikanni olib, gubernatorga tashladi; garchi u unga zarar yetkazmagan bo'lsa ham.

en: And the way he threw it too: aimed it a yard on one side on purpose, for fear of hurting him.
uz: Va uni tashlash usuli ham shunday: uni bir tomonga qasddan bir yarda ushlab, unga zarar yetkazishdan qo'rqqan.

en: Well, we know what happens to a prisoner who assaults an officer with a weapon.
uz: Biz bir ofitserga qurol bilan hujum qilgan mahbusga nima bo'lishini bilamiz.

en: So ‘he took his suffering.’ “So I suspect now that Nikolay wants to take his suffering or something of the sort.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'z azob-uqubatini o'z zimmasiga olgan. Shunday qilib, endi men Nikolay o'z azob-uqubatini o'z zimmasiga olishni xohlayotganini shubha qilaman.

en: I know it for certain from facts, indeed.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, haqiqatdan ham shubhalanaman.

en: Only he doesn’t know that I know.
uz: Lekin u mening bilishimni bilmaydi.

en: What, you don’t admit that there are such fantastic people among the peasants?
uz: Xo'sh, siz fermerlar orasida bunday ajoyib odamlar borligini tan olmayapsizmi?

en: The elder now has begun influencing him, especially since he tried to hang himself.
uz: Endi oqsoqol unga ta'sir ko'rsatishni boshladi, ayniqsa, u o'zini asrashga uringanidan beri.

en: But he’ll come and tell me all himself.
uz: Lekin u kelib, menga o'zi hammasini aytib beradi.

en: You think he’ll hold out?
uz: Siz o'ylaysizmi, u sabr-toqat qiladi?

en: Wait a bit, he’ll take his words back.
uz: Bir oz vaqt turing, o'z so'zlarini qaytarib oladi.

en: I am waiting from hour to hour for him to come and abjure his evidence.
uz: Men uning kelishini va dalillarini rad etishini soatdan-soat kutyapman.

en: I have come to like that Nikolay and am studying him in detail.
uz: O'sha Nikolay menga yoqdi va uni batafsil o'rganyapman.

en: He answered me very plausibly on some points, he obviously had
uz: U menga ba'zi masalalarda juda ishonchli javob berdi, aniqki, u shunday javob bergan edi.

en: collected some evidence and prepared himself cleverly.
uz: ba'zi dalillarni to'pladi va o'zini aqlli tayyorladi.

en: But on other points he is simply at sea, knows nothing and doesn’t even suspect that he doesn’t know!
uz: Ammo boshqa nuqtalarda u shunchaki dengizda bo'lib, hech narsa bilmaydi va hatto bilmasligini gumon ham qilmaydi!

en: “No, Rodion Romanovitch, Nikolay doesn’t come in!
uz: Yo'q, Rodion Romanovitch, Nikolay kelmaydi!

en: This is a fantastic, gloomy business, a modern case, an incident of today when the heart of man is troubled, when the phrase is quoted that blood ‘renews,’ when comfort is preached as the aim of life.
uz: Bu ajoyib, nozik ish, zamonaviy holat, insonning yuragi xavotirda bo'lgan, qon yangilanayotgan, tasalli hayotning maqsadi deb targ'ib etiladigan so'zlar keltirilgan bugungi hodisa.

en: Here we have bookish dreams, a heart unhinged by theories.
uz: Bu erda bizda kitobcha orzular, nazariyalar bilan bog'liq bo'lmagan yurak bor.

en: Here we see resolution in the first stage, but resolution of a special kind: he resolved to do it like jumping over a precipice or from a bell tower and his legs shook as he went to the crime.
uz: Bu erda biz birinchi bosqichda qarorni ko'ramiz, lekin bu alohida qaror: u buni toshbo'ron yoki qo'ng'iroq to'rkasidan sakrash kabi qilishga qaror qildi va jinoyat sodir etilishiga borganida oyoqlari titrab ketdi.

en: He forgot to shut the door after him, and murdered two people for a theory.
uz: U eshikni yopishni unutib, nazariya uchun ikki kishini o'ldirgan.

en: He committed the murder and couldn’t take the money, and what he did manage to snatch up he hid under a stone.
uz: U qotillikni sodir etgan va pulni ololmagan, ammo uni olib ketishga muvaffaq bo'lgan narsalarni esa tosh ostida yashirgan.

en: It wasn’t enough for him to suffer agony behind the door while they battered at the door and rung the bell, no, he had to go to the empty lodging, half delirious, to recall the bell-ringing, he wanted to feel the cold shiver over again.
uz: Eshik orqasida tortinish va qo'ng'iroqni chaqirish uchun azob chekish yetarli emas edi, yo'q, u o'sha bo'sh uyga borishi kerak edi, yarim deliryoda, qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroqini eslab qolishi uchun, u yana sovuq titrishni his etishni xohlagan.

en: … Well, that we grant, was through illness, but consider this: he is a murderer, but looks upon himself as an honest man, despises others, poses as injured innocence.
uz: ... Biz buni kasallik tufayli qildik, lekin buni ko'rib chiqaylik: u qotil, ammo o'zini halol inson deb biladi, boshqalarni kamsitadi, o'zini aybsiz deb o'ylaydi.

en: No, that’s not the work of a Nikolay, my dear Rodion Romanovitch!” All that had been said before had sounded so like a recantation that these words were too great a shock.
uz: Yo'q, bu Nikolayning ishi emas, aziz Rodion Romanovitch! Oldin aytilganlarning hammasi o'ziga o'xshaydi, hatto bu so'zlar juda dahshatli bo'ldi.

en: Raskolnikov shuddered as though he had been stabbed.
uz: Raskolnikov xuddi o'zi bo'g'ib ketgan bo'lsa, shiddatli titradi.

en: “Then … who then … is the murderer?” he asked in a breathless voice, unable to restrain himself.
uz: Keyin ... kim ... qotil? deb so'radi u nafassiz ovoz bilan, o'zini tuta olmay.

en: Porfiry Petrovitch sank back in his chair, as though he were amazed at the question.
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch savolga hayron bo'lib, o'z kursiga qaytdi.

en: “Who is the murderer?” he repeated, as though unable to believe his ears.
uz: Qilal kim? - dedi u, xuddi o'z quloqlariga ishonib bo'lmagandek.

en: “Why, you, Rodion Romanovitch!
uz: Nima uchun, siz, Rodion Romanovitch!

en: You are the murderer,” he added, almost in a whisper, in a voice of genuine conviction.
uz: Siz qotilsiz, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u, deyarli shoshib, chin ishonch bilan.

en: Raskolnikov leapt from the sofa, stood up for a few seconds and sat down again without uttering a word.
uz: Raskolnikov sofadan ko'tarildi, bir necha soniya turdi va so'z aytmasdan yana o'tirdi.

en: His face twitched convulsively.
uz: Uning yuzi shovqinli bo'ldi.

en: “Your lip is twitching just as it did before,” Porfiry Petrovitch observed almost sympathetically.
uz: Sizning og'zingiz avvalgidek teshiklab ketmoqda, Porfiry Petrovitch deyarli hamdardlik bilan kuzatdi.

en: “You’ve been misunderstanding me, I think, Rodion Romanovitch,” he added after a brief pause,
uz: Siz meni noto'g'ri tushunib yetgansiz, deb o'ylayman, Rodion Romanovitch, u qisqa to'xtatishdan so'ng qo'shimcha qildi:

en: “that’s why you are so surprised.
uz: Shuning uchun siz juda hayratda qoldingiz.

en: I came on purpose to tell you everything and deal openly with you.” “It was not I murdered her,” Raskolnikov whispered like a frightened child caught in the act.
uz: Men senga hamma narsani aytishga va ochiq-oydin munosabatda bo'lish uchun qasddan keldim. Men uni o'ldirganim yo'q, Raskolnikov qo'rqib ketgan bola kabi shov-shuv qildi.

en: “No, it was you, you Rodion Romanovitch, and no one else,” Porfiry whispered sternly, with conviction.
uz: - Yo'q, bu siz, siz Rodion Romanovitch va boshqa hech kim emas edi, - deb xotirjamlik bilan va ishonch bilan shovqin qildi Porfiry.

en: They were both silent and the silence lasted strangely long, about ten minutes.
uz: Ikkalasi ham sukut saqlashdi va sukut juda uzoq davom etdi, taxminan o'n daqiqa.

en: Raskolnikov put his elbow on the table and passed his fingers through his hair.
uz: Raskolnikov qo'lqovusini stol ustiga qo'yib, barmoqlarini sochlariga o'tkazdi.

en: Porfiry Petrovitch sat quietly waiting.
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch xotirjamlik bilan kutgan.

en: Suddenly Raskolnikov looked scornfully at Porfiry.
uz: Toʻsatdan Raskolnikov Porfiryga gʻazablangancha qarab qoʻydi.

en: “You are at your old tricks again, Porfiry Petrovitch!
uz: Siz yana o'zingizning eski hiylalaringiz bilan shug'ullanasiz, Porfiry Petrovitch!

en: Your old method again.
uz: Yana eski usulingiz.

en: I wonder you don’t get sick of it!” “Oh, stop that, what does that matter now?
uz: O'zimga hayronmanki, siz bundan bezovta emassiz!Oh, to'xtating, bu endi nimaga bog'liq?

en: It would be a different matter if there were witnesses present, but we are whispering alone.
uz: Agar guvohlar bo'lganida, bu boshqa narsa bo'lardi, lekin biz yolg'iz shovqin qilyapmiz.

en: You see yourself that I have not come to chase and capture you like a hare.
uz: O'zingizni ko'rib turibsizki, men sizlarni qush kabi orqadan quvishga va ushlab olish uchun kelmadim.

en: Whether you confess it or not is nothing to me now; for myself, I am convinced without it.” “If so, what did you come for?” Raskolnikov asked irritably.
uz: Siz buni tan olyapsizmi yoki yo'qmi, bu hozir men uchun ahamiyatsiz; o'zim uchun u yo'q ekanman. Agar shunday bo'lsa, nima uchun keldingiz? Raskolnikov xafa bo'lib so'radi.

en: “I ask you the same question again: if you consider me guilty, why don’t you take me to prison?” “Oh, that’s your question!
uz: Men sizga yana bir bor xuddi shu savolni beraman: agar siz meni aybdor deb bilsangiz, nega meni qamoqqa tashlamaysiz?Oh, bu sizning savolingiz!

en: I will answer you, point for point.
uz: Men sizga javob beraman, nuqta-nuqta.

en: In the first place, to arrest you so directly is not to my interest.” “How so?
uz: Birinchidan, sizni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri hibsga olish mening manfaatim yo'q.  Qanday qilib?

en: If you are convinced you ought.
uz: Agar ishonchingiz komil bo'lsa, shunday bo'lishi kerak.

en: …” “Ach, what if I am convinced?
uz: ... Ach, agar men shubhalansam nima bo'ladi?

en: That’s only my dream for the time.
uz: Hozircha bu mening orzuim.

en: Why should I put you in safety?
uz: Nima uchun sizni xavfsiz joyga qo'yishim kerak?

en: You know that’s it, since you ask me to do it.
uz: Siz buni o'zingiz aytgandan so'ng, bu o'zi ekanligini bilasiz.

en: If I confront you with that workman for instance and you say to him ‘were you drunk or not?
uz: Misol uchun, agar men sizga ishchi bilan duch kelsam va siz unga: "Siz mast bo'lganmisiz yoki yo'q?" - deysangiz, men sizga: "Siz mast bo'lganmisiz yoki yo'q?" - deb aytaman.

en: Who saw me with you?
uz: Meni sen bilan birga kim ko'rgan?

en: I simply took you to be drunk, and you were drunk, too.’ Well, what could I answer, especially as your story is a more likely one than his?
uz: Men sizni shunchaki mast bo'lishga olib keldim va siz ham mast edingiz. Xo'sh, nimaga javob bera olaman, ayniqsa sizning hikoyangiz uning hikoyasidan ko'ra ko'proq ehtimol bo'lganligi sababli?

en: for there’s nothing but psychology to support his evidence —that’s almost unseemly with his ugly mug, while you hit the mark exactly, for the rascal is an inveterate drunkard and notoriously so.
uz: Chunki uning dalillarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan psixologiyadan boshqa hech narsa yo'q, chunki uning qo'rqinchli mugasi bilan deyarli to'g'ri kelmaydi, ammo siz aniq maqsadga erishasiz.

en: And I have myself admitted candidly several times already that that psychology can be taken in two ways and that the second way is stronger and looks far more probable, and that apart from that I have as yet nothing against you.
uz: Men o'zim ham bir necha bor tan oldimki, bu psixologiya ikki yo'l bilan tushunilishi mumkin va ikkinchi yo'l kuchli va ehtimoldan yiroq ko'rinadi va bundan tashqari, hozircha sizga qarshi hech narsa yo'q.

en: And though I shall put you in prison and indeed have come —quite contrary to etiquette —to inform you of it
uz: Garchi men sizni qamoqqa tashlasam-da, sizlarni xabardor qilish uchun o'zimning odobga zid bo'lgan yo'l tutgan bo'lsam ham.

en: beforehand, yet I tell you frankly, also contrary to etiquette, that it won’t be to my advantage.
uz: Oldindan aytaman, lekin men sizlarga ochiqchasiga aytaman, bu ham odobga zid bo'lib, bu menga foyda keltirmaydi.

en: Well, secondly, I’ve come to you because  …” “Yes, yes, secondly?” Raskolnikov was listening breathless.
uz: Ikkinchidan, men sizning oldingizga keldim, chunki ...  Ha, ha, ikkinchidan? Raskolnikov nafassiz tinglayotgan edi.

en: “Because, as I told you just now, I consider I owe you an explanation.
uz: Chunki men sizga hozir aytganimdek, sizga tushuntirish berishim kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: I don’t want you to look upon me as a monster, as I have a genuine liking for you, you may believe me or not.
uz: Men sizdan g'ayratli bo'lganim uchun, meni qo'rqinch deb bilmasligingizni istayman, ishoning yoki ishonmang.

en: And in the third place I’ve come to you with a direct and open proposition —that you should surrender and confess.
uz: Uchinchidan, men sizga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va ochiq taklif bilan keldim, siz taslim bo'lib, tanbeh berishingiz kerak.

en: It will be infinitely more to your advantage and to my advantage too, for my task will be done.
uz: Bu sizga va menga ham foyda keltiradi, chunki mening vazifam bajarildi.

en: Well, is this open on my part or not?” Raskolnikov thought a minute.
uz: Xo'sh, bu men uchun ochiqmi yoki yo'qmi? Raskolnikov bir daqiqa o'yladi.

en: “Listen, Porfiry Petrovitch.
uz: Quloq soling, Porfiry Petrovitch.

en: You said just now you have nothing but psychology to go on, yet now you’ve gone on mathematics.
uz: Siz hali-haqiqatan ham psixologiyadan boshqa hech narsa yo'qligini aytdingiz, ammo endi matematikaga o'tdingiz.

en: Well, what if you are mistaken yourself, now?” “No, Rodion Romanovitch, I am not mistaken.
uz: Xo'sh, agar siz o'zingizni noto'g'ri ko'rsangiz nima bo'ladi?Yo'q, Rodion Romanovitch, men noto'g'ri yo'l tutmayman.

en: I have a little fact even then, Providence sent it me.” “What little fact?” “I won’t tell you what, Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Hatto o'sha paytlarda ham bir oz haqiqatim bor, bu haqda menga Providence xabar berdi.Qanday haqiqat?Men sizga nima deymayman, Rodion Romanovitch.

en: And in any case, I haven’t the right to put it off any longer, I must arrest you.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu ishni endi kechiktirishga haqim yo'q, men sizni hibsga olishim kerak.

en: So think it over: it makes no difference to me now and so I speak only for your sake.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu haqda o'ylab ko'ring: hozir bu menga hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas va shuning uchun men faqat sizning manfaatingiz uchun gapiryapman.

en: Believe me, it will be better, Rodion Romanovitch.” Raskolnikov smiled malignantly.
uz: Ishoning, bu yaxshiroq bo'ladi, Rodion Romanovitch. Raskolnikov yomon ko'rinishda tabassum qildi.

en: “That’s not simply ridiculous, it’s positively shameless.
uz: Bu shunchaki g'alati emas, balki uyatsiz.

en: Why, even if I were guilty, which I don’t admit, what reason should I have to confess, when you tell me yourself that I shall be in greater safety in prison?” “Ah, Rodion Romanovitch, don’t put too much faith in words, perhaps prison will not be altogether a restful place.
uz: Nima uchun, hatto men aybdor bo'lsam ham, buni tan olmayman, nima sababdan meni qamoqda yanada xavfsizroq bo'lishimni o'zingiz aytasiz?Ah, Rodion Romanovitch, so'zlarga ishonmang, ehtimol qamoqxona umuman tinch joy bo'lmaydi.

en: That’s only theory and my theory, and what authority am I for you?
uz: Bu faqat nazariya va mening nazrimdir va men siz uchun qanday vakolatga egaman?

en: Perhaps, too, even now I am hiding something from you?
uz: Ehtimol, hozir ham men sizdan biror narsani yashiryapman?

en: I can’t lay bare everything, he-he!
uz: Men hamma narsani ochib bo'lmayman!

en: And how can you ask what advantage?
uz: Va qanday qilib siz qanday afzallikni so'rashingiz mumkin?

en: Don’t you know how it would lessen your sentence?
uz: O'zingiz bilmayapsizmi, bu sizning jazangizni qanday kamaytiradi?

en: You would be confessing at a moment when another man has taken the crime on himself and so has muddled the whole case.
uz: Siz boshqa odam o'z zimmasiga jinoyatni o'z zimmasiga olgan va butun ishni buzib qo'ygan paytda tan olishni xohlaysiz.

en: I swear before God that I will so arrange that your confession shall come as a complete surprise.
uz: Xudo oldida qasam ichamanki, sizning tanbehingiz to'liq ajablanarli bo'lishi uchun, men bu ishni amalga oshiraman.

en: We will make a clean sweep of all these psychological
uz: Biz ushbu psixologik holatlarni tozalab chiqamiz

en: points, of a suspicion against you, so that your crime will appear to have been something like an aberration, for in truth it was an aberration.
uz: Sizga qarshi gumon qilish uchun, jinoyatingiz biroz o'zgaruvchan bo'lgan deb ko'rinadi, chunki haqiqatda bu o'zgaruvchan bo'lgan.

en: I am an honest man, Rodion Romanovitch, and will keep my word.” Raskolnikov maintained a mournful silence and let his head sink dejectedly.
uz: Men rostgo'y odamman, Rodion Romanovitch, va so'zimni bajaraman. Raskolnikov qayg'uli so'zsizlikni saqlab, boshini tushkunlikka tushirib qo'ydi.

en: He pondered a long while and at last smiled again, but his smile was sad and gentle.
uz: U ancha vaqt o'ylab ko'rdi va nihoyat yana tabassum qildi, ammo tabassumini xafa va muloyim ko'rsatdi.

en: “No!” he said, apparently abandoning all attempt to keep up appearances with Porfiry, “it’s not worth it, I don’t care about lessening the sentence!” “That’s just what I was afraid of!” Porfiry cried warmly and, as it seemed, involuntarily.
uz: Yo'q! dedi, ko'rinib turibdiki, Porfir bilan ko'rinishni saqlab qolish uchun barcha urinishlarni tashlab qo'ydi, itga loyiq emas, jazoni kamaytirish menga g'amxo'rlik qilmaydi!   Aynan shu narsadan qo'rqardim! Porfiry iliq va, ko'rinishicha, ixtiyoriy ravishda yig'ladi.

en: “That’s just what I feared, that you wouldn’t care about the mitigation of sentence.” Raskolnikov looked sadly and expressively at him.
uz: Men qo'rqqanim shundaki, siz hukmni yengillashtirishga qiziqmaysiz. Raskolnikov unga qayg'uli va ifodalangan ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: “Ah, don’t disdain life!” Porfiry went on.
uz: Ah, hayotni kamsitmang! Porfiry davom etdi.

en: “You have a great deal of it still before you.
uz: Sizda hali ko'p narsalar bor.

en: How can you say you don’t want a mitigation of sentence?
uz: Qanday qilib siz o'zingizning jazangizni kamaytirishni istamaysiz deb ayta olasiz?

en: You are an impatient fellow!” “A great deal of what lies before me?” “Of life.
uz: Siz sabrsizlik bilan harakat qilyapsiz! Mening oldimda ko'p narsalar bor? Hayotning.

en: What sort of prophet are you, do you know much about it?
uz: Siz qanday payg'ambarsiz, bu haqda ko'p narsani bilasizmi?

en: Seek and ye shall find.
uz: Izlanglar, topasizlar.

en: This may be God’s means for bringing you to Him.
uz: Ehtimol, bu Xudo sizni O'ziga jalb qilish uchun taqdim etgan vosita bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And it’s not forever, the bondage.
uz: Va qullik abadiy emas.

en: …” “The time will be shortened,” laughed Raskolnikov.
uz: ... Vaqti qisqartirilgan bo'ladi, - deb kuldi Raskolnikov.

en: “Why, is it the bourgeois disgrace you are afraid of?
uz: Nima uchun, siz burjua sharmandaligidan qo'rqasizmi?

en: It may be that you are afraid of it without knowing it, because you are young!
uz: Ehtimol, siz buni bilmasdan qo'rqishingiz mumkin, chunki siz yoshsiz!

en: But anyway you shouldn’t be afraid of giving yourself up and confessing.” “Ach, hang it!” Raskolnikov whispered with loathing and contempt, as though he did not want to speak aloud.
uz: Ammo har holda, o'zingizni topib, tan olishdan qo'rqmasligingiz kerak.A, to'xtab qo'ying! Raskolnikov g'azab va pastkashlik bilan shovqin qildi, xuddi baland ovoz bilan gapirishni istamaganidek.

en: He got up again as though he meant to go away, but sat down again in evident despair.
uz: O'tib ketmoqchi bo'lganidek yana turdi, ammo yana umidsizlikka tushib o'tirdi.

en: “Hang it, if you like!
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, uni osib qo'yinglar!

en: You’ve lost faith and you think that I am grossly flattering you; but how long has your life been?
uz: Siz imoningizni yo'qotdingiz va men sizni juda yaxshi ko'raman deb o'ylaysiz; ammo hayotingiz qancha vaqtdan beri davom etmoqda?

en: How much do you understand?
uz: Siz qancha tushunasiz?

en: You made up a theory and then were ashamed that it broke down and turned out to be not at all original!
uz: Siz bir nazariyani uydirib, uni buzganidan uyalgansiz va asl nazariyasi bo'lmaganini ko'rsatgansiz!

en: It turned out something base, that’s true, but you are not hopelessly base.
uz: Bu juda past narsa bo'ldi, bu haqiqat, lekin siz umidsiz darajada past emassiz.

en: By no means so base!
uz: Hech qachon bu qadar oddiy emas!

en: At least you didn’t deceive yourself for long, you went straight to the furthest point at one bound.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda siz uzoq vaqt o'zingizni aldamang, bir chegaraga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri eng uzoq nuqtaga borgansiz.

en: How do I regard you?
uz: Sizni qanday ko'rib chiqaman?

en: I regard you as one of those men who would stand and smile at
uz: Sizni o'sha kishilardan biri deb bilaman, ular oldida turib tabassum qiladilar.

en: their torturer while he cuts their entrails out, if only they have found faith or God.
uz: Ular imon topgan bo'lsa yoki Xudo topgan bo'lsa, u ularning ichlarini kesib tashlar ekan, ularni azoblaydi.

en: Find it and you will live.
uz: Uni toping va yashang.

en: You have long needed a change of air.
uz: Siz uzoq vaqtdan beri havo o'zgarishiga muhtojsiz.

en: Suffering, too, is a good thing.
uz: Azob chekish ham yaxshi narsa.

en: Maybe Nikolay is right in wanting to suffer.
uz: Ehtimol, Nikolay azob chekishni istashida to'g'ri gapirgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I know you don’t believe in it —but don’t be over-wise; fling yourself straight into life, without deliberation; don’t be afraid —the flood will bear you to the bank and set you safe on your feet again.
uz: Men bilamanki, siz bunga ishonmaysiz, lekin ortiqcha donolik qilmang; o'zingizni hayotga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tashlang, o'ylamasdan; qo'rqmang - to'fon sizni qirg'og'iga olib ketadi va sizni yana to'g'ri tura oladi.

en: I only believe that you have long life before you.
uz: Men faqat sizning oldingizda uzoq umr borligiga ishonaman.

en: I know that you take all my words now for a set speech prepared beforehand, but maybe you will remember them after.
uz: Men bilamanki, siz mening so'zlarimni oldindan tayyorlangan nutq sifatida qabul qilyapsiz, lekin ehtimol siz ularni keyinroq eslaysiz.

en: They may be of use some time.
uz: Ular bir muncha vaqtdan beri foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It’s as well that you only killed the old woman.
uz: Shuningdek, siz faqat keksa ayolni o'ldirganingiz yaxshi.

en: If you’d invented another theory you might perhaps have done something a thousand times more hideous.
uz: Agar siz boshqa nazariyani yaratgan bo'lsangiz, ehtimol ming barobar dahshatli bo'lgan narsani qilgan bo'lar edingiz.

en: You ought to thank God, perhaps.
uz: Ehtimol, Xudoga shukr qilishingiz kerak.

en: Perhaps God is saving you for something.
uz: Ehtimol, Xudo sizni biron bir maqsad uchun qutqarmoqda.

en: But keep a good heart and have less fear!
uz: Ammo yaxshi yurak va kamroq qo'rquvga ega bo'ling!

en: Are you afraid of the great expiation before you?
uz: Siz oldingizdagi buyuk qurbonlikdan qo'rqyapsizmi?

en: No, it would be shameful to be afraid of it.
uz: Yo'q, undan qo'rqish uyat bo'lardi.

en: Since you have taken such a step, you must harden your heart.
uz: Bunday qadam qo'yganingizdan so'ng, yuragingizni qattiq qilishingiz kerak.

en: There is justice in it.
uz: Unda adolat bor.

en: You must fulfil the demands of justice.
uz: Siz adolat talablarini bajarishingiz kerak.

en: I know that you don’t believe it, but indeed, life will bring you through.
uz: Siz bunga ishonmayotganingizni bilaman, lekin hayot sizni o'z ichiga oladi.

en: You will live it down in time.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, uni o'zingizda his qilasiz.

en: What you need now is fresh air, fresh air, fresh air!” Raskolnikov positively started.
uz: Hozir sizga toza havo, toza havo, toza havo kerak! Raskolnikov ijobiy boshladi.

en: what prophet are you?
uz: Siz qanday payg'ambarsiz?

en: From the height of what majestic calm do you proclaim these words of wisdom?” “Who am I?
uz: Qaysi ulug'vor xotirjamlikning balandligidan siz ushbu donolik so'zlarini e'lon qilasiz?Men kimman?

en: I am a man with nothing to hope for, that’s all.
uz: Men umidi yo'q odamman, shu o'zi.

en: A man perhaps of feeling and sympathy, maybe of some knowledge too, but my day is over.
uz: Ehtimol, his-tuyg'u va hamdardlik ko'rsatadigan, ehtimol bilimli odam, lekin kunim tugadi.

en: But you are a different matter, there is life waiting for you.
uz: Ammo siz boshqa narsasiz, hayot sizni kutmoqda.

en: maybe your life, too, will pass off in smoke and come to nothing.
uz: Ehtimol, sizning ham hayotingiz tutun ichida o'tib ketadi va hech narsa bo'lmaydi.

en: Come, what does it matter, that you will pass into another class of men?
uz: Qani, boshqa odamlarga o'tishingiz nimaga ahamiyatga ega?

en: It’s not comfort you regret, with your heart!
uz: Bu sizning yuragingiz bilan afsuslanishingiz uchun tasalli emas!

en: What of it that perhaps no one will see you for so long?
uz: Ehtimol, sizni hech kim uzoq vaqt ko'rmaydi?

en: It’s not time, but yourself that will decide that.
uz: Bu vaqt emas, balki o'zingiz hal qilasiz.

en: Be the sun and all will see you.
uz: Quyosh bo'ling va hamma sizni ko'radi.

en: The sun has before all to be the sun.
uz: Quyosh birinchi navbatda quyosh bo'lishi kerak.

en: Why are you smiling again?
uz: Nega yana tabassum qilyapsan?

en: At my being such a Schiller?
uz: Men bunday Schiller bo'lganimda?

en: I bet you’re imagining that I am trying to get round you by flattery.
uz: Shuni aytamanki, siz mening sizlarni maqtanish orqali o'ylashga harakat qilayotganimni tasavvur qilyapsiz.

en: Well, perhaps I am, he-he-he!
uz: Ehtimol, men, u-u-u-u!

en: Perhaps you’d better not believe my word, perhaps you’d better never believe it altogether —I’m made that way, I confess it.
uz: Ehtimol, siz mening so'zimga ishonmasligingiz yaxshiroqdir, ehtimol siz hech qachon ishonmasligingiz yaxshiroqdir.

en: me add, you can judge for yourself, I think, how far I am a base sort of man and how far I am honest.” “When do you mean to arrest me?” “Well, I can let you walk about another day or two.
uz: Menga qo'shing, o'zing o'zing hukm qila olasan, men o'ylaymanki, men qanchalik oddiy odamman va qanchalik halolman.Siz meni qachon hibsga olishni rejalashtiryapsiz?Ha, men sizni bir yoki ikki kun davomida qo'yib yuborishim mumkin.

en: Think it over, my dear fellow, and pray to God.
uz: Buni o'ylab ko'ring, azizim, Xudoga ibodat qiling.

en: It’s more in your interest, believe me.” “And what if I run away?” asked Raskolnikov with a strange smile.
uz: Bu sizning manfaatingizga ko'proq, ishoning.  Va men qochib ketsam nima bo'ladi? Raskolnikov g'alati tabassum bilan so'radi.

en: “No, you won’t run away.
uz: Yo'q, siz qochmaysiz.

en: A peasant would run away, a fashionable dissenter would run away, the flunkey of another man’s thought, for you’ve only to show him the end of your little finger and he’ll be ready to believe in anything for the rest of his life.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi qochib ketadi, moddiy muxolifatchi qochib ketadi, boshqa odamning fikrini o'ylaydi, chunki siz unga faqat o'z kichik barmog'ingizning so'ngini ko'rsatishingiz kerak va u butun hayoti davomida har narsaga ishonishga tayyor bo'ladi.

en: But you’ve ceased to believe in your theory already, what will you run away with?
uz: Ammo siz o'zingizning nazariga ishonishni to'xtatgansiz, nima bilan qochib ketasiz?

en: And what would you do in hiding?
uz: Va siz yashirinib nima qilasiz?

en: It would be hateful and difficult for you, and what you need more than anything in life is a definite position, an atmosphere to suit you.
uz: Bu siz uchun nafrat va qiyin bo'ladi va hayotda siz uchun eng muhim narsa aniq joy, sizga mos keladigan muhitdir.

en: And what sort of atmosphere would you have?
uz: Va siz qanday muhitga ega bo'lasiz?

en: If you ran away, you’d come back to yourself.
uz: Agar qochgan bo'lsangiz, o'zingizga qaytasiz.

en: You can’t get on without us.
uz: Siz bizsiz yursangiz bo'lmaydi.

en: And if I put you in prison —say you’ve been there a month, or two, or three —remember my word, you’ll confess of yourself and perhaps to your own surprise.
uz: Agar sizni bir oy yoki ikki yoki uch oy davomida qamoqqa tashlasam, so'zimni eslang, siz o'zingizni tan olsangiz va ehtimol o'zingizning ajablanib qolishingiz mumkin.

en: You won’t know an hour beforehand that you are coming with a confession.
uz: Siz bir soat oldin tanbeh bilan kelayotganingizni bilmaysiz.

en: I am convinced that you will decide, ‘to take your suffering.’ You don’t believe my words now, but you’ll come to it of yourself.
uz: Ishonamanki, siz o'zingizning azob-uqubatingizni qabul qilishga qaror qilasiz.Siz hozir mening so'zlarimga ishonmaysiz, lekin o'zingiz bunga erishasiz.

en: For suffering, Rodion Romanovitch, is a great thing.
uz: Rodion Romanovitch, azob-uqubat uchun bu juda yaxshi narsa.

en: Never mind my having grown fat, I know all the same.
uz: Men ham shunga qaramay, shoshilib ketdim, men ham shunga o'xshash narsani bilaman.

en: Don’t laugh at it, there’s an idea in suffering, Nikolay is right.
uz: Unga kulmang, azob-uqubatda bir fikr bor, Nikolay haqli.

en: No, you won’t run away, Rodion Romanovitch.” Raskolnikov got up and took his cap.
uz: Yo'q, siz qochib ketmaysiz, Rodion Romanovitch. Raskolnikov o'rnidan turib, to'pqini olib ketdi.

en: Porfiry Petrovitch also rose.
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch ham ko'tarildi.

en: “Are you going for a walk?
uz: Siz yurishga ketyapsizmi?

en: The evening will be fine, if only we don’t have a storm.
uz: Kechasi yaxshi bo'ladi, agar shamol bo'lmasin.

en: Though it would be a good thing to freshen the air.” He, too, took his cap.
uz: Garchi havo tozalash yaxshi bo'lsa-da. U ham to'pini olib ketdi.

en: “Porfiry Petrovitch, please don’t take up the notion that I have confessed to you today,” Raskolnikov pronounced with sullen insistence.
uz: Porfiry Petrovitch, men bugun sizga e'tirof etgan fikrni qabul qilmang, - dedi Raskolnikov shiddat bilan.

en: “You’re a strange man and I have listened to you from simple curiosity.
uz: Siz g'ayritabiiy odamsiz va men sizni shunchaki qiziqish bilan tingladim.

en: But I have admitted nothing, remember that!” “Oh, I know that, I’ll remember.
uz: Ammo men hech narsa tan olmaganman, buni eslang!Oh, men buni bilaman, eslayman.

en: Look at him, he’s trembling!
uz: Unga qarang, u titrab yuribdi!

en: Don’t be uneasy, my dear fellow, have it your own way.
uz: O'zingizni xavotirga solmang, aziz do'stim, o'z yo'lingizda qiling.

en: Walk about a bit, you won’t be able to walk too far.
uz: Bir oz yurganingizda, juda uzoq yurishga qodir bo'lmaysiz.

en: If anything happens, I have one request to make of you,” he added, dropping his voice.
uz: Agar biror narsa bo'lsa, men sizdan bir iltimos qilaman, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u, ovozini tushirib.

en: awkward one, but important.
uz: Bu qiyin, lekin muhim.

en: If anything were to happen (though indeed I don’t believe in it and think you quite incapable of it), yet in case you were taken during these forty or fifty hours with the notion of putting an end to the business in some other way, in some fantastic fashion —laying hands on yourself —(it’s an absurd proposition, but you must forgive me for it) do leave a brief but precise note, only two lines, and mention the stone.
uz: Agar biror narsa bo'lsa (haqiqatan ham, men bunga ishonmayman va siz buni qila olmaysiz deb o'ylayman), lekin agar siz ushbu qirq yoki ellik soat davomida biznesni boshqa tarzda tugatish fikrini o'zingizga qo'yib olgan bo'lsangiz, ajoyib tarzda o'zingizning qo'lingizni qo'yib o'zingizni qo'yib olishingiz mumkin bo'lsa (bu absurd taklif, lekin siz meni kechirishingiz kerak) qisqa, ammo aniq yozuv qoldiring, faqat ikkita satr va toshni eslang.

en: It will be more generous.
uz: Bu yanada saxiy bo'ladi.

en: Good thoughts and sound decisions to you!” Porfiry went out, stooping and avoiding looking at Raskolnikov.
uz: Sizlarga yaxshi fikrlar va oqilona qarorlar! Porfiry yugurib, Raskolnikovga qaramasdan tashqariga chiqdi.

en: The latter went to the window and waited with irritable impatience till he calculated that Porfiry had reached the street and moved away.
uz: Keyinchalik u darchaga borib, Porfiry ko'chaga yetib ketganini hisoblab chiqmaguncha sabrsizlik bilan kutdi.

en: Then he too went hurriedly out of the room.
uz: Keyin u ham xonadan shoshilinch chiqib ketdi.

en: III He hurried to Svidrigaïlov’s.
uz: U Svidrigailovlar tomon shoshildi.

en: What he had to hope from that man he did not know.
uz: U o'sha odamdan nimani kutishi kerakligini bilmagan.

en: But that man had some hidden power over him.
uz: Ammo bu odamning uning ustidan yashirin bir qudrati bor edi.

en: Having once recognised this, he could not rest, and now the time had come.
uz: Bir marta buni tan olib, u dam ololmadi va endi vaqt keldi.

en: On the way, one question particularly worried him: had Svidrigaïlov been to Porfiry’s?
uz: Yo'lda, uni ayniqsa bir savol tashvishlantirdi: Svidrigailov Porfirylarga borganmi?

en: As far as he could judge, he would swear to it, that he had not.
uz: O'zi hukm qila olganicha, u bunday qilmaganligiga qasam ichardi.

en: He pondered again and again, went over Porfiry’s visit; no, he hadn’t been, of course he hadn’t.
uz: U takror-takror o'ylab, Porfirining tashrifini eslab o'tdi; yo'q, bo'lmagan, albatta, bo'lmagan.

en: But if he had not been yet, would he go?
uz: Ammo u hali bormagan bo'lsa, borarmidi?

en: Meanwhile, for the present he fancied he couldn’t.
uz: Shu bilan birga, hozirgi vaqtda u qila olmaydi deb o'ylagan.

en: He could not have explained, but if he could, he would not have wasted much thought over it at the moment.
uz: U buni tushuntira olmagan, lekin u qila olsa, hozirda bu haqda ko'p o'ylamagan bo'lardi.

en: It all worried him and at the same time he could not attend to it.
uz: Bularning barchasi uni tashvishlantirib, bir vaqtning o'zida uni kuzatib bo'lmaydi.

en: Strange to say, none would have believed it perhaps, but he only felt a faint vague anxiety about his immediate future.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, hech kim bunga ishonmagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u faqat yaqin kelajak haqida kamdan-kam xavotirda edi.

en: Another, much more important anxiety tormented him —it concerned himself, but in a different, more vital way.
uz: Boshqa, ancha muhimroq tashvishlar uni qiynagan, lekin o'zini boshqacha, muhimroq tarzda o'ziga tashvishlantirgan.

en: Moreover, he was conscious of immense moral fatigue, though his mind was working better that morning than it had done of late.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u juda katta axloqiy charchag'idan xabardor edi, garchi uning fikri o'sha kuni ertalab kechki paytga qaraganda yaxshiroq ishlamoqchi bo'lsa-da.

en: And was it worth while, after all that had happened, to contend with these new trivial difficulties?
uz: Va sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealardan so'ng, ushbu yangi oddiy qiyinchiliklar bilan kurashishga vaqt kerakmi?

en: Was it worth while, for instance, to manoeuvre that Svidrigaïlov should not go to Porfiry’s?
uz: Misol uchun, Svidrigailov Porfirylarga bormasligi kerakligini aytish o'ziga yarasha bo'lganmi?

en: Was it worth while to investigate, to ascertain the facts, to waste time over anyone like Svidrigaïlov?
uz: Svidrigaylov kabi odamga vaqt sarflash, dalillarni tekshirish va vaqtni sarflash arziydiganmi?

en: Oh, how sick he was of it all!
uz: O'zi bularning barchasidan qanchalik bezovta edi!

en: And yet he was hastening to Svidrigaïlov; could he be expecting something new from him, information, or means of escape?
uz: Shunga qaramay, u Svidrigaylovga shoshilmoqda edi; u undan biron yangi narsani, ma'lumotni yoki qochishni kutishi mumkinmi?

en: Men will catch at straws!
uz: Erkaklar cho'g'ga tushib qolishadi!

en: Was it destiny or some instinct bringing them
uz: Qizig'i yoki qandaydir instinkt ularni olib kelganmi?

en: Perhaps it was only fatigue, despair; perhaps it was not Svidrigaïlov but some other whom he needed, and Svidrigaïlov had simply presented himself by chance.
uz: Ehtimol, bu faqatgina charchash, umidsizlik edi; ehtimol, Svidrigailov emas, balki unga kerak bo'lgan boshqa bir kishi edi va Svidrigailov shunchaki tasodifan o'zini taqdim etgan edi.

en: But what should he go to Sonia for now?
uz: Lekin hozir u Soniaga nima uchun borishi kerak?

en: To beg her tears again?
uz: Yana ko'z yoshlariga iltijo qilish uchun?

en: He was afraid of Sonia, too.
uz: U ham Soniyadan qo'rqardi.

en: Sonia stood before him as an irrevocable sentence.
uz: Sonia uning oldida o'zgartirilmaydigan hukm sifatida turdi.

en: He must go his own way or hers.
uz: U o'z yo'lidan yoki uning yo'lidan borishi kerak.

en: At that moment especially he did not feel equal to seeing her.
uz: Ayniqsa, o'sha paytda u o'zini uni ko'rish bilan teng his qilmadi.

en: No, would it not be better to try Svidrigaïlov?
uz: Yo'q, Svidrigailovni sinab ko'rish yaxshiroq emasmi?

en: And he could not help inwardly owning that he had long felt that he must see him for some reason.
uz: Va u uzoq vaqtdan beri uni ko'rish kerakligini his qilganini o'z ichiga olishi mumkin emas edi.

en: But what could they have in common?
uz: Ammo ularning umumiyligi nimada bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Their very evildoing could not be of the same kind.
uz: Ularning yomon ishlari bir xil bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: The man, moreover, was very unpleasant, evidently depraved, undoubtedly cunning and deceitful, possibly malignant.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bu odam juda yoqimsiz, ko'rinishicha iflos, hech shubhasiz hiylasiz va aldamchi, ehtimol yovuz.

en: Such stories were told about him.
uz: U haqda shunday hikoyalar aytilgan.

en: It is true he was befriending Katerina Ivanovna’s children, but who could tell with what motive and what it meant?
uz: To'g'ri, u Katerina Ivanovna bolalari bilan do'stlashgan, lekin kim nima sababdan va nimani anglatishini ayta oladi?

en: The man always had some design, some project.
uz: Bu kishi har doim ham ba'zi dizayn, ba'zi loyihalarga ega bo'lgan.

en: There was another thought which had been continually hovering of late about Raskolnikov’s mind, and causing him great uneasiness.
uz: Raskolnikovning ongida oxirgi kunlarda doimiy ravishda o'tirgan boshqa bir fikr bor edi va unga katta xavotir tug'dirgan edi.

en: It was so painful that he made distinct efforts to get rid of it.
uz: U shunchalik og'riqli ediki, uni yo'q qilish uchun alohida harakat qildi.

en: He sometimes thought that Svidrigaïlov was dogging his footsteps.
uz: Ba'zan u Svidrigailov uning izidan yurayotganini his qilardi.

en: Svidrigaïlov had found out his secret and had had designs on Dounia.
uz: Svidrigailov uning sirini bilib, Duniyada dizaynlar yaratgan.

en: What if he had them still?
uz: Agar ularni hali ham saqlab qolsa nima bo'ladi?

en: Wasn’t it practically certain that he had?
uz: Uning bunday qilgani aniq emasmidi?

en: And what if, having learnt his secret and so having gained power over him, he were to use it as a weapon against Dounia?
