uz: Men sizga bir xil qiziqarli misolni aytib berishim mumkin.

en: The first day I came here I visited various haunts, after seven years I simply rushed at them.
uz: Bu yerga birinchi kun kelib, turli qahramonlarni ko'rdim, yetti yildan keyin esa ularga shoshildim.

en: You probably notice that I am not in a hurry to renew acquaintance with my old friends.
uz: Ehtimol, oldingi do'stlarim bilan tanishishni qayta boshlash uchun shoshilmasligimni sezasiz.

en: I shall do without them as long as I can.
uz: Men iloji boricha ularsiz yashayman.

en: Do you know, when I was with Marfa Petrovna in the country, I was haunted by the thought of these places where anyone who knows his way about can find a great deal.
uz: Bilasizmi, Marfa Petrovna bilan qishloqda bo'lganimda, o'z yo'lini bilgan har bir kishi ko'p narsalarni topishi mumkin bo'lgan bu joylar haqida o'ylash meni qiynagan.

en: The peasants have vodka, the educated young people, shut out from activity, waste themselves in impossible dreams and visions and are crippled by theories; Jews have sprung up and are amassing money, and all the rest give themselves up to debauchery.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi vodka, o'qigan yoshlar faoliyatdan mahrum bo'lib, o'zlarini imkonsiz orzu va tasavvurlarga sarflaydilar va nazariyalar ularni chalg'itadi; yahudiylar paydo bo'lib, pul yig'ib olishmoqda, qolganlar esa o'zlarini axloqsizlikka bermoqdalar.

en: From the first hour the town reeked of its familiar odours.
uz: Shahar birinchi soatdan boshlab o'zining tanish hidlari bilan xushbo'y bo'ldi.

en: I chanced to be in a frightful den —I like my dens dirty —it was a dance, so called, and there was a cancan such as I never saw in my day.
uz: Men qo'rqinchli g'orda o'tirgan bo'ldim. G'alati g'ordalar menga yoqdi. Bu bir raqs edi, deb atalgan edi va o'z kunlarimda hech qachon ko'rmagan o'rnakli kankan bor edi.

en: All of a sudden I saw a little girl of thirteen, nicely dressed, dancing with a specialist in that line, with another one vis-à- vis.
uz: Toʻsatdan men oʻn uch yoshli qizchani koʻrdim, juda chiroyli kiyim kiygan, oʻsha yoʻnalishdagi mutaxassis bilan, boshqa bir kishi bilan bir-biriga qarshi raqs oʻtkazgan.

en: Her mother was sitting on a chair by the wall.
uz: Onasi devorning yonida o'tirgan o'rindiqda o'tirgan edi.

en: You can’t fancy what a cancan that was!
uz: O'zingiz tasavvur qila olmaysizki, bu qanchadan-qancha kankan bo'lgan!

en: The girl was ashamed, blushed, at last felt insulted, and began to cry.
uz: Qiz o'zidan o'zini noloyiq va qizg'in his qilib, o'zini haqoratlangan his qildi va yig'la boshladi.

en: Her partner seized her and began whirling her round and performing before her; everyone laughed and —I like your public, even the cancan public —they laughed and shouted, ‘Serves her right —serves her right!
uz: Uning hamkori uni ushlab, uning atrofini aylanib, uning oldida o'ynashni boshladi; hamma kulishdi va sizning auditoriyangizni yoqtirdim, hatto kankan jamoatchiligini ham yoqtirdim, ular kulishdi va baqirib: "O'z huquqini bajaradi, o'z huquqini bajaradi!" - dedilar.

en: Shouldn’t bring children!’ Well, it’s not my business whether that consoling reflection was logical or not.
uz: Bola olib kelmasligingiz kerak! Xo'sh, bu tasalli beruvchi mulohaza mantiqiymi yoki yo'qmi, bu mening ishim emas.

en: I at once fixed on my plan, sat down by the mother, and began by saying that I too was a stranger and that people here were ill-bred and that they couldn’t distinguish decent folks and treat them with respect, gave her to understand that I had plenty of money, offered to take them home in my carriage.
uz: Men darhol rejaimni belgilab, onamning yonida o'tirib, o'zim ham begona odam ekanimni va bu yerda odamlar yomon tarbiyalangan va ular munosib odamlarni farqlab, ularga hurmat bilan muomala qila olmaydiganligini aytishdan boshladim.

en: I took them home and got to know them.
uz: Men ularni uyga olib ketdim va ularni tanib-bildim.

en: They were lodging in a miserable little hole and had only just arrived from the country.
uz: Ular kichkina va ayanchli cho'lda yashar edilar va yaqinda qishloqdan kelgan edilar.

en: She told me that she and her daughter could only regard my acquaintance as an honour.
uz: U menga o'zi va uning qizi mening tanishimni sharaf deb bilishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: I found out that they had nothing of their own and had come to town upon some legal business.
uz: Men ularning o'zlarining hech narsalari yo'qligini va shaharga qonuniy ish bilan kelishganligini bilib oldim.

en: I proffered my services and money.
uz: Men o'z xizmatlarim va pulimni taklif qildim.

en: I learnt that they had gone to the dancing saloon by mistake, believing that it was a genuine dancing class.
uz: Ular o'zlaricha haqiqiy raqs sinfida o'tirgan deb o'ylab, xatolik bilan raqs salooniga borishganini bilib oldim.

en: I offered to assist in the young girl’s education in French and dancing.
uz: Men qizning frantsuz tilida va raqsda ta'lim olishida yordam berishni taklif qildim.

en: My offer was accepted with enthusiasm as an honour —and we are still friendly.
uz: Mening taklifim katta sharaf deb qabul qilindi va biz hali ham do'stmiz.

en: … If you like, we’ll go and see them, only not just now.” “Stop!
uz: ... Agar xohlasangiz, biz ularni ko'rishga boramiz, lekin hozir emas. Stop!

en: Enough of your vile, nasty anecdotes, depraved vile, sensual man!” “Schiller, you are a regular Schiller!
uz: Sening yomon, yomon anekdotlar, axloqsiz yomon, jinsiy odamlardan yetarlicha ko'p!Schiller, sen odatdagi Schillersan!

en: O la vertu va-t-elle se nicher?
uz: Yoki bu fazilat o'ziga xosmi?

en: But you know I shall tell you these things on purpose, for the pleasure of hearing your outcries!” “I dare say.
uz: Ammo siz bilamanki, men bularni bilgan holda aytaman, chunki sizning qichqirishlaringizni eshitish zavq keltiradi!Men aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: I can see I am ridiculous myself,” muttered Raskolnikov angrily.
uz: O'zimning o'zim g'alati ekanligimni ko'ryapman, - deya g'azabda Raskolnikov qichqirdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov laughed heartily; finally he called Philip, paid his bill, and began getting up.
uz: Svidrigailov ko'ngli bilan kuldi; nihoyat u Filipga qo'ng'iroq qildi, hisob-kitobini to'ladi va turishga kirdi.

en: “I say, but I am drunk, assez causé,” he said.
uz: Men aytaman, lekin men mastman, assez causé, dedi u.

en: “It’s been a pleasure.” “I should rather think it must be a pleasure!” cried Raskolnikov, getting up.
uz: Its been a pleasure.I o'ylashim kerakki, bu zavq-shavq bo'lishi kerak! Raskolnikov o'rnidan turib, baqirdi.

en: “No doubt it is a pleasure for a worn-out profligate to describe such adventures with a monstrous project of the same sort
uz: Shubhasizki, charchagan bo'g'iz bunday mashg'ulotlarni o'xshash dahshatli loyiha bilan tasvirlashdan zavqlanadi.

en: in his mind —especially under such circumstances and to such a man as me.
uz: Xususan, bunday sharoitlarda va men kabi odam uchun.

en: … It’s stimulating!” “Well, if you come to that,” Svidrigaïlov answered, scrutinising Raskolnikov with some surprise, “if you come to that, you are a thorough cynic yourself.
uz: Bu hayratlanarli!Ha, agar shunday fikrga kelgan bo'lsangiz, Svidrigailov Raskolnikovni biroz hayratda qoldirib, javob berdi,agar shunday fikrga kelgan bo'lsangiz, o'zingiz mutlaqo siniksiz.

en: You’ve plenty to make you so, anyway.
uz: Sizni shunday qilish uchun juda ko'p narsangiz bor.

en: You can understand a great deal … and you can do a great deal too.
uz: Siz ko'p narsani tushunishingiz mumkin ... va siz ham ko'p narsani qila olasiz.

en: I sincerely regret not having had more talk with you, but I shan’t lose sight of you.
uz: Siz bilan ko'proq suhbatlashmaganimga chin dildan afsuslanaman, lekin sizni ko'zimdan yo'qotmayman.

en: … Only wait a bit.” Svidrigaïlov walked out of the restaurant.
uz: Faqat biroz kuting. Svidrigailov restorandan chiqib ketdi.

en: Raskolnikov walked out after him.
uz: Raskolnikov uning orqasidan chiqib ketdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov was not however very drunk, the wine had affected him for a moment, but it was passing off every minute.
uz: Svidrigailov shunga qaramay, juda mast emas edi, sharob uni bir muncha vaqt davomida ta'sir qilgan edi, ammo u har daqiqada o'tib ketayotgan edi.

en: He was preoccupied with something of importance and was frowning.
uz: U muhim bir ish bilan band edi va o'z ko'zlarini toshgan edi.

en: He was apparently excited and uneasy in anticipation of something.
uz: O'shanda u bir narsaga umid qilib, hayajon va xavotirda edi.

en: His manner to Raskolnikov had changed during the last few minutes, and he was ruder and more sneering every moment.
uz: Raskolnikovga nisbatan so'nggi bir necha daqiqada uning munosabati o'zgardi va u har bir daqiqada o'zidan-o'zidan zo'rroq va ko'proq masxara qilardi.

en: Raskolnikov noticed all this, and he too was uneasy.
uz: Raskolnikov bularning barchasini payqadi va u ham xavotirda edi.

en: He became very suspicious of Svidrigaïlov and resolved to follow him.
uz: U Svidrigaylovga nisbatan juda shubha ostiga oldi va uning orqasidan ergashishga qaror qildi.

en: They came out on to the pavement.
uz: Ular piyoda chiqdilar.

en: “You go to the right, and I to the left, or if you like, the other way.
uz: Siz o'ng tomonga, men esa chap tomonga, yoki agar xohlasangiz, o'zga tomonga boring.

en: Only adieu, mon plaisir, may we meet again.” And he walked to the right towards the Hay Market.
uz: Faqat salom, mon plaisir, yana uchrashishimiz mumkin. Va u Hay bozori tomon o'ng tomonga yurdi.

en: V Raskolnikov walked after him.
uz: V. Raskolnikov uning orqasidan ergashdi.

en: “What’s this?” cried Svidrigaïlov turning round, “I thought I said …” “It means that I am not going to lose sight of you now.” “What?” Both stood still and gazed at one another, as though measuring their strength.
uz: Bu nima?  Svidrigailov o'zini o'zgartirgan holda baqirdi,  O'zim aytdim...  Bu men seni endi ko'zdan chiqarmasligimni anglatadi.   Nima? Ikkalasi ham to'xtamay, bir-birlariga qaray boshladilar, xuddi o'z kuchlarini o'lchayotgandek.

en: “From all your half tipsy stories,” Raskolnikov observed harshly, “I am positive that you have not given up your designs on my sister, but are pursuing them more actively than ever.
uz: Sizning yarim-yarim gaplaringizdan, Raskolnikov qat'iylik bilan aytdi, Men o'zimning singlimga bo'lgan dizayningizdan voz kechmaganligingizga aminman, lekin siz ularni har qachongidan ham faolroq izlayapsiz.

en: I have learnt that my sister received a letter this morning.
uz: O'zimning singlim bu ertalab xat olganini bilib oldim.

en: You have hardly been able to sit still all this time.
uz: Bu vaqtning o'zida o'tirib o'tirolmadingiz.

en: … You may have unearthed a wife on the way, but that means nothing.
uz: Siz yo'lda xotinningni topgan bo'lsangiz ham, bu hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas.

en: I should like to make certain myself.” Raskolnikov could hardly have said himself what he wanted and of what he wished to make certain.
uz: O'zim ishonch hosil qilishni xohlayman. Raskolnikov o'zi nima xohlaganini va nimaga ishonch hosil qilishni xohlaganini aytishi mumkin emas edi.

en: I’ll call the police!” “Call away!” Again they stood for a minute facing each other.
uz: Men politsiyaga xabar beraman!Call away! Yana ular bir daqiqaga bir-biriga qaragan holda turishdi.

en: At last Svidrigaïlov’s face changed.
uz: Oxir-oqibat Svidrigailovning yuzi o'zgardi.

en: Having satisfied himself that Raskolnikov was not frightened at his threat, he assumed a mirthful and friendly air.
uz: Raskolnikov uning tahdididan qo'rqmaganini o'zini ishontirganidan so'ng, u quvonchli va do'stona tuyg'ularni qabul qildi.

en: I purposely refrained from referring to your affair, though I am devoured by curiosity.
uz: Men bilganimcha, sizning ishingiz haqida gapirishdan bosh tortdim, ammo men qiziqish bilan o'zimni yo'q qilib qo'ydim.

en: It’s a fantastic affair.
uz: Bu ajoyib afveradir.

en: I’ve put it off till another time, but you’re enough to rouse the dead.
uz: Men uni boshqa bir vaqtga qoldirdim, lekin siz o'liklarni uyg'otishga etarlicha qodirsiz.

en: … Well, let us go, only I warn you beforehand I am only going home for a moment, to get some money; then I shall lock up the flat, take a cab and go to spend the evening at the Islands.
uz: Xo'sh, ketaylik, faqat oldindan ogohlantiramanki, men faqat bir muncha vaqt uchun uyga qaytib, pul yig'ib olmoqchiman; so'ngra xonadonimni qulflab, taksiga o'tirib, kechki payt orollarda o'tkazaman.

en: Now, now are you going to follow me?”
uz: Endi, siz menga ergashasizmi?

en: “I’m coming to your lodgings, not to see you but Sofya Semyonovna, to say I’m sorry not to have been at the funeral.” “That’s as you like, but Sofya Semyonovna is not at home.
uz: Men sizlarni ko'rish uchun emas, balki Sofiya Semyonovna bilan suhbatlashish uchun sizning uyingizga kelyapman, marosimga bormaganim uchun uzr so'rayman.

en: She has taken the three children to an old lady of high rank, the patroness of some orphan asylums, whom I used to know years ago.
uz: U uchta bolani yuqori darajadagi bir keksa ayolga olib bordi, u yillar oldin men bilgan ba'zi yetimlar uylarining do'sti edi.

en: I charmed the old lady by depositing a sum of money with her to provide for the three children of Katerina Ivanovna and subscribing to the institution as well.
uz: Katerina Ivanovnaning uchta farzandini ta'minlash uchun uning oldiga pul to'plash va ushbu muassasada xizmat ko'rsatish orqali keksa xonimni hayratda qoldirdim.

en: I told her too the story of Sofya Semyonovna in full detail, suppressing nothing.
uz: Men unga Sofya Semyonovna haqidagi hikoyani ham batafsil aytib berdim, hech narsani kamaytirmadim.

en: It produced an indescribable effect on her.
uz: Bu unga bejiz ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: That’s why Sofya Semyonovna has been invited to call today at the X — — Hotel where the lady is staying for the time.” “No matter, I’ll come all the same.” “As you like, it’s nothing to me, but I won’t come with you; here we are at home.
uz: Shuning uchun Sofiya Semyonovna xonim hozirgi vaqtda yashaydigan X X   Hotelga tashrif buyurishga taklif etilgan. Qanday bo'lmasin, men ham kelaman. Siz xohlaganingizdek, men uchun hech narsa emas, lekin men siz bilan kelmayman; mana biz uydamiz.

en: By the way, I am convinced that you regard me with suspicion just because I have shown such delicacy and have not so far troubled you with questions … you understand?
uz: Aytgancha, men o'zimni shubhalanaman, chunki men juda mehribon bo'ldim va sizni savollar bilan bezovta qilmadim... tushunasizmi?

en: It struck you as extraordinary; I don’t mind betting it’s that.
uz: Bu sizga ajoyib tuyuldi; men bu borada baholanishga xalaqit bermayman.

en: Well, it teaches one to show delicacy!” “And to listen at doors!” “Ah, that’s it, is it?” laughed Svidrigaïlov.
uz: To'g'ri, bu insonni go'zallikni namoyon etishga o'rgatadi! Va eshiklarda tinglashga o'rgatadi!Ah, shundaymi? Svidrigailov kuldi.

en: “Yes, I should have been surprised if you had let that pass after all that has happened.
uz: Ha, agar siz bularning barchasidan so'ng buni o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lsangiz, men hayron bo'lishim kerak edi.

en: Though I did understand something of the pranks you had been up to and were telling Sofya Semyonovna about, what was the meaning of it?
uz: Siz Sofiya Semyonovnaga o'tgan va aytib berayotgan mashg'ulotlarning bir qismini tushundim, ammo ularning ma'nosi nimada edi?

en: Perhaps I am quite behind the times and can’t understand.
uz: Ehtimol, men zamon orqasidan ketib, tushunmayapman.

en: For goodness’ sake, explain it, my dear boy.
uz: Xudo uchun, tushuntiring, aziz o'g'lim.

en: Expound the latest theories!” “You couldn’t have heard anything.
uz: Eng so'nggi nazariyalarni ko'rsating!Siz hech narsa eshitmagan bo'lar edingiz.

en: You’re making it all up!” “But I’m not talking about that (though I did hear something).
uz: Siz bularning barchasini o'zingiz uydiringlar! Ammo men bu haqda gapirmayapman (agar men biror narsa eshitgan bo'lsam ham).

en: No, I’m talking of the way you keep sighing and groaning now.
uz: Yo'q, men siz hozir g'ayrat va qayg'urishni davom ettirishingiz haqida gapiryapman.

en: The Schiller in you is in revolt every moment, and now you tell me not to listen at doors.
uz: Sizdagi Schiller har bir daqiqada isyon ko'tarib turadi va endi siz menga eshiklarda tinglamaslikni aytasiz.

en: If that’s how you feel, go and inform the police that you had this mischance: you made a little mistake in your theory.
uz: Agar o'zingizni shunday his qilsangiz, borib politsiyaga xabar beringki, sizda bunday baxtsizlik yuz berdi: siz nazariy jihatdan kichik xatoga yo'l qo'ydingiz.

en: But if you are convinced that one mustn’t listen at doors, but one may murder old women at one’s pleasure, you’d better be off to America and make haste.
uz: Ammo agar siz uyda tinglash kerak emasligiga ishongan bo'lsangiz, lekin siz o'zingiz xohlagancha keksa ayollarni o'ldirishingiz mumkinligiga ishongan bo'lsangiz, Amerikaga borib, shoshiling.

en: There may still be time.
uz: Ehtimol, hali ham vaqt bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I’m speaking sincerely.
uz: Men chin dildan gapiryapman.

en: Haven’t you the money?
uz: Pulingiz yo'qmi?

en: I’ll give you the fare.”
uz: Men sizga sayohat narxini beraman.

en: “I’m not thinking of that at all,” Raskolnikov interrupted with disgust.
uz: "Men bu haqda umuman o'ylamayman", - dedi Raskolnikov jirkanchlik bilan.

en: “I understand (but don’t put yourself out, don’t discuss it if you don’t want to).
uz: Men tushunaman (lekin o'zingizni tashlab qo'ymang, xohlamasangiz muhokama qilmang).

en: I understand the questions you are worrying over — moral ones, aren’t they?
uz: Siz tashvishlanayotgan axloqiy savollarni tushunaman, shunday emasmi?

en: Duties of citizen and man?
uz: Fuqaro va insonning vazifasi?

en: They are nothing to you now, ha-ha!
uz: Ular endi siz uchun hech narsa emas, ha-ha!

en: You’ll say you are still a man and a citizen.
uz: Siz hali ham erkak va fuqaro ekanligingizni aytasiz.

en: If so you ought not to have got into this coil.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, siz bu bobkaga kirmasligingiz kerak edi.

en: It’s no use taking up a job you are not fit for.
uz: Siz yaroqsiz bo'lgan ishda ishtirok etishning foydasi yo'q.

en: Well, you’d better shoot yourself, or don’t you want to?” “You seem trying to enrage me, to make me leave you.” “What a queer fellow!
uz: Xo'sh, o'zingni o'ldirasanmi yoki xohlamasanmi?Siz meni g'azablantirmoqchi bo'lib ko'rinyapsiz, sizni tark etishim uchun.Qanday g'ayritabiiy odam!

en: Welcome to the staircase.
uz: Sotuvga xush kelibsiz.

en: You see, that’s the way to Sofya Semyonovna.
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, Sofiya Semyonovnaga borish yo'li shu.

en: Look, there is no one at home.
uz: Qarang, uyda hech kim yo'q.

en: Don’t you believe me?
uz: Menga ishonmayapsizmi?

en: She leaves the key with him.
uz: U o'zining kalitini unga qoldirdi.

en: Here is Madame de Kapernaumov herself.
uz: Bu yerda Madame de Kapernaumovning o'zi bor.

en: She is not in and won’t be till late in the evening probably.
uz: Ehtimol, u kechqurun kelib qolmaydi va kelmaydi.

en: Well, come to my room; you wanted to come and see me, didn’t you?
uz: Mening xonamga keling, siz meni ko'rmoqchi bo'ldingiz, shunday emasmi?

en: Madame Resslich’s not at home.
uz: Resslich xonim uyda yo'q.

en: She is a woman who is always busy, an excellent woman I assure you.
uz: U har doim mashg'ul bo'lgan ayol, men sizga ishontiraman, bu ajoyib ayol.

en: … She might have been of use to you if you had been a little more sensible.
uz: Agar siz biroz aqlli bo'lganingizda, u sizga foydali bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: I take this five-percent bond out of the bureau —see what a lot I’ve got of them still —this one will be turned into cash today.
uz: Men bu besh foizlik obligatsiyani ofisdan olib tashlayman va ko'rib chiqaman, ulardan qanchalar ko'p bo'lganini hali ham ko'rib chiqaman.

en: I mustn’t waste any more time.
uz: Endi vaqtni ziyoda qilmasligim kerak.

en: The bureau is locked, the flat is locked, and here we are again on the stairs.
uz: Ishxona qulflab qo'yilgan, xonadon qulflab qo'yilgan va mana biz yana mertabaning ustidamiz.

en: Shall we take a cab?
uz: Taksiga boramizmi?

en: I’m going to the Islands.
uz: Men orollarga ketyapman.

en: Would you like a lift?
uz: Sizni ko'tarib olishni xohlaysizmi?

en: I’ll take this carriage.
uz: Men bu aravazni olib ketaman.

en: You are tired of it!
uz: Siz bundan charchagansiz!

en: I believe it will come on to rain.
uz: Shuni yodda tutamanki, yomg'ir yog'adi.

en: Never mind, we’ll put down the hood.
uz: Asosiysi, biz qo'lni pastga qo'yamiz.

en: …” Svidrigaïlov was already in the carriage.
uz: ... Svidrigailov allaqachon arava ichida edi.

en: Raskolnikov decided that his suspicions were at least for that moment unjust.
uz: Raskolnikov o'zining shubhalari, hech bo'lmaganda, o'sha paytda adolatsiz bo'lganligiga qaror qildi.

en: Without answering a word he turned and walked back towards the Hay Market.
uz: U bir so'z javob bermasdan o'girilib, Hay bozori tomon qaytib ketdi.

en: If he had only turned round on his way he might have seen Svidrigaïlov get out not a hundred paces off, dismiss the cab and walk along the pavement.
uz: Agar u o'z yo'lida o'girilib ketsa, Svidrigaylovni yuz qadam ham ketmay chiqib, taksiga chiqib, yo'l bo'ylab yurganini ko'rgan bo'lar edi.

en: But he had turned the corner and could see nothing.
uz: Ammo u burchadan burib, hech narsa ko'rmadi.

en: Intense disgust drew him away from Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Kuchli nafrat uni Svidrigailovdan uzoqlashtirdi.

en: “To think that I could for one instant have looked for help from that coarse brute, that depraved sensualist and blackguard!” he cried.
uz: Men bir daqiqa uchun ham o'sha qo'rqinchli vahshiy odamdan yordam izlagan bo'lardim, deb o'ylashim mumkin edi! deb baqirdi u.

en: Raskolnikov’s judgment was uttered too lightly and hastily: there was something about Svidrigaïlov which gave him a certain original,
uz: Raskolnikovning hukmi juda yengil va shoshilinch tarzda aytilgan: Svidrigailovning o'zi haqida bir narsa bor edi va bu unga asl nusxa berdi.

en: even a mysterious character.
uz: Hatto sirli xarakter ham.

en: As concerned his sister, Raskolnikov was convinced that Svidrigaïlov would not leave her in peace.
uz: Oʻz singlisi haqida gap ketganda, Raskolnikov Svidrigailov uni tinch qoldirmasligiga amin edi.

en: But it was too tiresome and unbearable to go on thinking and thinking about this.
uz: Ammo bu haqda o'ylash va o'ylashni davom ettirish uchun bu juda charchatadigan va ko'tarilmaydigan edi.

en: When he was alone, he had not gone twenty paces before he sank, as usual, into deep thought.
uz: U yolg'iz bo'lganida, odatdagidek, chuqur fikrga tushishdan oldin yigirma qadam ham ketmagan edi.

en: On the bridge he stood by the railing and began gazing at the water.
uz: U ko'prikning yonida to'xtadi va suvga qaray boshladi.

en: And his sister was standing close by him.
uz: Uning singlisi ham uning yonida turardi.

en: He met her at the entrance to the bridge, but passed by without seeing her.
uz: U uni ko'prikning eshigida uchratdi, lekin uni ko'rmasdan o'tib o'tdi.

en: Dounia had never met him like this in the street before and was struck with dismay.
uz: Dounia uni ko'chada hech qachon bunday ko'rmagan va juda xavotirlangan edi.

en: She stood still and did not know whether to call to him or not.
uz: U to'xtamay turib, unga qo'ng'iroq qilish kerakmi yoki yo'qligini bilmadi.

en: Suddenly she saw Svidrigaïlov coming quickly from the direction of the Hay Market.
uz: Toʻsatdan u Svidrigailovni Hay bozori yoʻnalishidan tezda kelayotganini koʻrdi.

en: He seemed to be approaching cautiously.
uz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan yaqinlashayotganini ko'rardim.

en: He did not go on to the bridge, but stood aside on the pavement, doing all he could to avoid Raskolnikov’s seeing him.
uz: U ko'prikga o'tirmay, yo'lda yonma-yon turib, Raskolnikovlar uni ko'rmasliklari uchun qo'lidan kelganini qildi.

en: He had observed Dounia for some time and had been making signs to her.
uz: U bir muncha vaqtdan buyon Duniyani kuzatib turardi va unga imo-ishoralar qilib yurardi.

en: She fancied he was signalling to beg her not to speak to her brother, but to come to him.
uz: U uning ukasi bilan gaplashmaslikni, uning oldiga kelishini iltijo qilishini isbotlamoqda deb o'ylagan.

en: That was what Dounia did.
uz: Dounia aynan shunday qildi.

en: She stole by her brother and went up to Svidrigaïlov.
uz: O'g'li tomonidan o'g'irlab, Svidrigailovning oldiga bordi.

en: “Let us make haste away,” Svidrigaïlov whispered to her, “I don’t want Rodion Romanovitch to know of our meeting.
uz: Let's hurry away, Svidrigaïlov unga shoshib, I don't want Rodion Romanovitch to know of our meeting.

en: I must tell you I’ve been sitting with him in the restaurant close by, where he looked me up and I had great difficulty in getting rid of him.
uz: Shuni aytishim kerakki, men u bilan yaqin atrofdagi restoranda o'tirgan edim, u meni ko'rib chiqdi va men undan qutulishimda katta qiyinchiliklarga duch keldim.

en: He has somehow heard of my letter to you and suspects something.
uz: U sizga yozgan maktubim haqida eshitgan va bir narsaga shubha ostiga qo'ygan.

en: It wasn’t you who told him, of course, but if not you, who then?” “Well, we’ve turned the corner now,” Dounia interrupted, “and my brother won’t see us.
uz: Albatta, unga siz aytmagan edingiz, lekin siz aytmagan bo'lsangiz, unda kim bo'ladi?Ha, biz endi burchada bo'ldik, Dounia o'zini uzdi, va akam bizni ko'rmaydi.

en: I have to tell you that I am going no further with you.
uz: Sizlarga aytishim kerakki, men siz bilan hech qachon ketmayman.

en: You can tell it all in the street.” “In the first place, I can’t say it in the street; secondly, you must hear Sofya Semyonovna too; and, thirdly, I will show you some papers.
uz: Hamma narsani ko'chada aytishingiz mumkin. Birinchidan, men ko'chada aytolmayman; ikkinchidan, siz Sofiya Semyonovna-ni ham eshitishingiz kerak; uchinchidan, sizga ba'zi hujjatlarni ko'rsataman.

en: … Oh well, if you won’t agree to come with me, I shall refuse to give any explanation and go away at once.
uz: Agar siz men bilan kelishni istamasangiz, men hech qanday tushuntirish berishni rad etib, darhol ketaman.

en: But I beg you not to forget that a very curious secret of your beloved brother’s is entirely in my keeping.” Dounia stood still, hesitating, and looked at Svidrigaïlov with searching eyes.
uz: Lekin sizlardan iltimos qilamanki, sevimli aka-ukalaringizning qiziqarli sirini to'liq o'zim saqlab qolaman. Dounia to'xtamay, shubha ostiga qolib, Svidrigailovga o'z ko'zlari bilan qarab turdi.

en: “What are you afraid of?” he observed quietly.
uz: Siz nimaga qo'rqasiz? - dedi u xotirjamlik bilan.

en: “The town is not the country.
uz: shahar qishloq emas.

en: And even in the country you did me more harm than I did you.” “Have you prepared Sofya Semyonovna?” “No, I have not said a word to her and am not quite certain whether she is at home now.
uz: Hatto qishloq joylarda ham siz menga o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq zarar yetkazgansiz.Sofiya Semyonovnaga tayyorgarlik ko'rdingizmi?Yo'q, men unga bir so'z ham aytmaganman va hozir u uyda ekanligiga amin emasman.

en: But most likely she is.
uz: Ammo, ehtimol, shunday.

en: She has buried her stepmother today: she is not likely to go visiting on such a day.
uz: U bugun o'g'il onasini ko'mib tashladi: u bunday kunlarda tashrif buyurish uchun ketishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas.

en: For the time I don’t want to speak to anyone about it and I half regret having spoken to you.
uz: Men bu haqda hech kim bilan gaplashmoqchi emasman va siz bilan gapirganimdan yarim afsuslanaman.

en: The slightest indiscretion is as bad as betrayal in a thing like this.
uz: Hech qanday kamsitilmaslik bunday ishda xiyonat kabi yomon.

en: I live there in that house, we are coming to it.
uz: Men o'sha uyda yashayman, biz bu uyga yaqinlashamiz.

en: That’s the porter of our house —he knows me very well; you see, he’s bowing; he sees I’m coming with a lady and no doubt he has noticed your face already and you will be glad of that if you are afraid of me and suspicious.
uz: Bu bizning uyimizning portieri, u meni juda yaxshi biladi; ko'ryapsizmi, u quvonchga to'lib, meni bir ayol bilan birga kelayotganimni ko'radi va shubhasiz, u sizning oldingizga ko'z ochgan va agar siz mendan qo'rqsangiz va shubha ostiga qo'ysangiz, bundan xursand bo'lasiz.

en: Excuse my putting things so coarsely.
uz: Bularni o'z-o'zidan kechiring.

en: I haven’t a flat to myself; Sofya Semyonovna’s room is next to mine — she lodges in the next flat.
uz: O'zim uchun kvartira yo'q; Sofiya Semyonovna xonasi mening o'zimning yonimda joylashgan.

en: The whole floor is let out in lodgings.
uz: Butun qavat uy-joylarga aylanadi.

en: Why are you frightened like a child?
uz: Nima uchun bola kabi qo'rqasiz?

en: Am I really so terrible?” Svidrigaïlov’s lips were twisted in a condescending smile; but he was in no smiling mood.
uz: Men haqiqatan ham shunday dahshatlimanmi? Svidrigailovning dudasi kamtarlik bilan tabassum bilan burildi; lekin u tabassum ruhida emas edi.

en: His heart was throbbing and he could scarcely breathe.
uz: Uning yuragi urib ketardi va u hatto nafas ham ololmasdi.

en: He spoke rather loud to cover his growing excitement.
uz: U o'sib borayotgan hayajonini qoplash uchun juda baland ovoz bilan gapirgan.

en: But Dounia did not notice this peculiar excitement, she was so irritated by his remark that she was frightened of him like a child and that he was so terrible to her.
uz: Ammo Dounia bu g'alati hayajonni sezmadi, uning so'zlaridan shunchalik xafa bo'ldiki, u undan bola kabi qo'rqardi va u unga juda dahshatli munosabatda edi.

en: “Though I know that you are not a man … of honour, I am not in the least afraid of you.
uz: Garchi siz ... sharafli odam emasligingizni bilsam ham, men sizdan hech qanday qo'rqmayman.

en: Lead the way,” she said with apparent composure, but her face was very pale.
uz: Yo'lni ko'rsating, - dedi u ko'rinadigan xotirjamlik bilan, lekin yuzida juda soya edi.

en: Svidrigaïlov stopped at Sonia’s room.
uz: Svidrigailov Sonia xonasida to'xtadi.

en: “Allow me to inquire whether she is at home.
uz: U uyda bormi, yo'qmi, deb so'rashim mumkin.

en: But I know she may come quite soon.
uz: Lekin men uning yaqinda kelishini bilaman.

en: If she’s gone out, it can only be to see a lady about the orphans.
uz: Agar u tashqariga chiqqan bo'lsa, bu faqat yetimlar haqida bir xonimni ko'rish bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Their mother is dead.
uz: Ularning onasi vafot etgan.

en: … I’ve been meddling and making arrangements for them.
uz: ... Men ularga aralashib, tadbirlar o'tkazganman.

en: If Sofya Semyonovna does not come back in ten minutes, I will send her to you, today if you like.
uz: Agar Sofiya Semyonovna o'n daqiqada qaytib kelmasa, agar xohlasangiz, uni bugun sizga yuboraman.

en: These are my two rooms.
uz: Bu mening ikkita xonam.

en: Madame Resslich, my landlady, has the next room.
uz: Uy egasi Resslich xonimning yonidagi xonasi bor.

en: I will show you my chief piece of evidence: this door from my bedroom leads into two perfectly empty rooms, which are to let.
uz: Sizga asosiy dalilimni ko'rsataman: yotoqxonamdan bu eshik ikkita mukammal bo'sh xonani olib kiradi.

en: Here they are … You must look into them with some attention.”
uz: Mana ular... Siz ularni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqishingiz kerak.

en: Svidrigaïlov occupied two fairly large furnished rooms.
uz: Svidrigailov ikki katta mebelli xonani egallagan.

en: Dounia was looking about her mistrustfully, but saw nothing special in the furniture or position of the rooms.
uz: Dounia o'ziga ishonchsizlik bilan qarab turardi, lekin xonalarning mebellarida yoki joylarida hech qanday o'ziga xos narsani ko'rmadi.

en: Yet there was something to observe, for instance, that Svidrigaïlov’s flat was exactly between two sets of almost uninhabited apartments.
uz: Masalan, Svidrigailovning xonadoni deyarli yashamaydigan ikki xonadon o'rtasida joylashganligini kuzatish mumkin edi.

en: His rooms were not entered directly from the passage, but through the landlady’s two almost empty rooms.
uz: Uning xonalariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'ldan emas, balki uy egasining ikki deyarli bo'sh xonasi orqali kirishgan.

en: Unlocking a door leading out of his bedroom, Svidrigaïlov showed Dounia the two empty rooms that were to let.
uz: Svidrigailov o'z yotoqxonasidan chiqib ketadigan eshikni ochib, Douniaga ijaraga olish uchun ikkita bo'sh xonani ko'rsatdi.

en: Dounia stopped in the doorway, not knowing what she was called to look upon, but Svidrigaïlov hastened to explain.
uz: Dounia nimaga qarash kerakligini bilmay, eshikda to'xtadi, lekin Svidrigailov shoshilmay tushuntirdi.

en: “Look here, at this second large room.
uz: Mana bu ikkinchi katta xonani ko'ring.

en: Notice that door, it’s locked.
uz: O'sha eshikga e'tibor bering, u qulflab qo'yilgan.

en: By the door stands a chair, the only one in the two rooms.
uz: Eshik oldida bitta o'rindiq turibdi, u ikkala xonada yagona o'rindiq.

en: I brought it from my rooms so as to listen more conveniently.
uz: Men uni o'zimning xonamdan olib keldim, shuning uchun uni yanada qulayroq tinglashim mumkin.

en: Just the other side of the door is Sofya Semyonovna’s table; she sat there talking to Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Eshikning o'zi yonida Sofya Semyonovna stolini o'rnatadi; u o'sha yerda Rodion Romanovitch bilan suhbatlashardi.

en: And I sat here listening on two successive evenings, for two hours each time —and of course I was able to learn something, what do you think?” “You listened?” “Yes, I did.
uz: Va men bu yerda ketma-ket ikki kecha, har safar ikki soat davomida tinglab o'tirdim va, albatta, men biror narsani o'rganishga muvaffaq bo'ldim, siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?Siz tinglaganmisiz?Ha, men eshitganman.

en: Now come back to my room; we can’t sit down here.” He brought Avdotya Romanovna back into his sitting-room and offered her a chair.
uz: Endi mening xonamga qayting; bu yerda o'tirolmaymiz. Avdotya Romanovnaga o'z xonasiga qaytadi va unga o'rinni taklif qiladi.

en: He sat down at the opposite side of the table, at least seven feet from her, but probably there was the same glow in his eyes which had once frightened Dounia so much.
uz: U o'sha stolning qarshisida, undan kamida yetti metr uzoqlikda o'tirdi, ammo ehtimol uning ko'zlarida bir vaqtlar Douniaga shunchalik qo'rqitgan shovqin bor edi.

en: She shuddered and once more looked about her distrustfully.
uz: U dahshatga tushdi va yana bir bor ishonchsizlik bilan atrofga qaradi.

en: It was an involuntary gesture; she evidently did not wish to betray her uneasiness.
uz: Bu o'z ixtiyori bilan sodir bo'lgan harakat edi; u, ko'rinib turibdiki, o'z xavotirini oshkor qilishni istamagan.

en: But the secluded position of Svidrigaïlov’s lodging had suddenly struck her.
uz: Ammo Svidrigailovning uyidagi chekka joy unga to'satdan ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: She wanted to ask whether his landlady at least were at home, but pride kept her from asking.
uz: U uning uy egasi hech bo'lmaganda uyda bo'lgan-bo'lmaganini so'rashni xohlagan, ammo mag'rurlik uni so'rashdan to'xtatgan.

en: Moreover, she had another trouble in her heart incomparably greater than fear for herself.
uz: Bundan tashqari, uning yuragida o'zi uchun qo'rqishdan ko'ra ko'proq muammo bor edi.

en: She was in great distress.
uz: U juda qayg'uda edi.

en: “Here is your letter,” she said, laying it on the table.
uz: Mana sizning maktubingiz, dedi u, uni stol ustiga qo'yib.

en: “Can it be true what you write?
uz: Siz yozgan narsa haqiqat bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: You hint at a crime committed, you say, by my brother.
uz: Siz mening akam tomonidan sodir etilgan jinoyatni nazarda tutyapsiz.

en: You hint at it too clearly; you daren’t deny it now.
uz: Siz buni juda aniq ko'rsatyapsiz; endi uni inkor etishga jur'at qilmaysiz.

en: I must tell you that I’d heard of this stupid story before you wrote and don’t believe a word of it.
uz: Sizga aytishim kerakki, siz yozishdan oldin men bu ahmoqona hikoyani eshitgan edim va bir so'zingizga ham ishonmayman.

en: It’s a disgusting and ridiculous suspicion.
uz: Bu jirkanch va g'alati shubha.

en: I know the story and why and how it was invented.
uz: Men hikoyani bilaman va nega va qanday qilib u ixtiro qilinganini bilaman.

en: You can have no proofs.
uz: Sizda hech qanday dalil bo'lmaydi.

en: You promised to prove it.
uz: Siz buni isbotlashga va'da berdingiz.

en: But let me warn you that I don’t believe you!
uz: Lekin sizga ogohlantiramanki, men sizga ishonmayman!

en: I don’t believe you!” Dounia said this, speaking hurriedly, and for an instant the colour rushed to her face.
uz: Men sizga ishonmayman! Dounia buni aytdi, shoshilinch gapirdi va bir zumda uning yuziga rang tushdi.

en: “If you didn’t believe it, how could you risk coming alone to my rooms?
uz: Agar ishonmasangiz, nega mening xonamga yolg'iz kelishga jur'at qila olasiz?

en: Simply from curiosity?” “Don’t torment me.
uz: Faqatgina qiziquvchanlik tufayli? Dont tortinish meni.

en: Speak, speak!” “There’s no denying that you are a brave girl.
uz: Gapiring, gapiring!Siz jasoratli qiz ekanligingizni inkor qilish mumkin emas.

en: Upon my word, I thought you would have asked Mr.
uz: Mening so'zimga binoan, siz Mr.-dan so'rashingizni o'yladim.

en: Razumihin to escort you here.
uz: Razumihin sizni bu yerga eskort qilish uchun.

en: But he was not with you nor anywhere near.
uz: Ammo u siz bilan birga ham, yaqin joyda ham bo'lmagan.

en: I was on the lookout.
uz: Men kuzatuvda edim.

en: It’s spirited of you, it proves you wanted to spare Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Bu sizning ruhingiz bilan sodir bo'ldi, bu sizning Rodion Romanovitchni qutqarmoqchi ekanligingizni isbotlaydi.

en: But everything is divine in you.
uz: Ammo sizda hamma narsa ilohiy.

en: … About your brother, what am I to say to you?
uz: ...O'g'ling haqida senga nima deyishim kerak?

en: You’ve just seen him yourself.
uz: Siz uni o'zingiz ko'rgansiz.

en: What did you think of him?” “Surely that’s not the only thing you are building on?” “No, not on that, but on his own words.
uz: U haqida nima deb o'yladingiz?Shuni aytish joizki, siz faqat shu narsaga asoslanyapsiz?Yo'q, bu haqda emas, balki uning o'z so'zlariga asoslanyapsiz.

en: He came here on two successive evenings to see Sofya Semyonovna.
uz: U Sofya Semyonovna bilan uchrashish uchun ikki kechada bir-biridan keyin bu yerga keldi.

en: I’ve shown you where they sat.
uz: Men sizlarga ular qayerda o'tirganini ko'rsatdim.

en: He made a full confession to her.
uz: U ayolga to'liq tanbeh berdi.

en: He killed an old woman, a pawnbroker, with whom he had pawned things himself.
uz: U bir keksa ayolni, o'zi o'zi pul berishga g'amxo'rlik qilgan qarzdorni o'ldirgan.

en: He killed her sister too, a pedlar woman called Lizaveta, who happened to come in while he was murdering her sister.
uz: U uning singlisi, Lizaveta ismli ayolni ham o'ldirdi, u singlisi o'ldirilayotganda kelib qoldi.

en: He killed them with an axe he brought with him.
uz: U o'zi bilan olib kelgan o'g'ir bilan ularni o'ldirgan.

en: He murdered them to rob them and he did rob them.
uz: U ularni talon-toroj qilish uchun o'ldirgan va talon-toroj qilgan.

en: He took money and various things.
uz: U pul va turli narsalarni olib ketdi.

en: … He told all this, word for word, to Sofya Semyonovna, the only person who knows his secret.
uz: U bularning barchasini Sofiya Semyonovnaga so'z-so'z aytib berdi, uning sirini bilgan yagona kishi.

en: But she has had no share by word or deed in the murder; she was as horrified at it as you are now.
uz: Ammo u o'limda so'z yoki ish bilan ishtirok etmagan; u hozirgi siz kabi qo'rqib ketgan edi.

en: Don’t be anxious, she won’t betray him.” “It cannot be,” muttered Dounia, with white lips.
uz: Xavotir olmang, u unga xiyonat qilmaydi. Bu bo'lmaydi, deb gapirgan Dounia oq og'izlar bilan.

en: She gasped for breath.
uz: U nafas olish uchun nafas oldi.

en: There was not the slightest cause, no sort of ground.
uz: Hech qanday sabab, hech qanday asos yo'q edi.

en: … It’s a lie, a lie!” “He robbed her, that was the cause, he took money and things.
uz: ... Bu yolg'on, yolg'on! U uni talon-toroj qildi, bu sabab edi, u pul va boshqa narsalarni oldi.

en: It’s true that by his own admission he made no use of the money or things, but hid them under a stone, where they are now.
uz: To'g'ri, o'z tanqidida u pul yoki boshqa narsalardan foydalanmadi, balki ularni hozirgi joydagi tosh ostiga yashirdi.

en: But that was because he dared not make use of them.” “But how could he steal, rob?
uz: Ammo bu uning ulardan foydalanishga jur'at etmagani uchun edi. Ammo u qanday qilib o'g'irlashishi mumkin edi, o'g'irlashishi mumkin edi?

en: How could he dream of it?” cried Dounia, and she jumped up from the chair.
uz: Qanday qilib u bu haqda orzu qila oladi? - deb baqirdi Dounia va u o'rindiqdan o'tardi.

en: “Why, you know him, and you’ve seen him, can he be a thief?”
uz: Nima uchun siz uni tanasiz va ko'rgansiz, u o'g'ri bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: She seemed to be imploring Svidrigaïlov; she had entirely forgotten her fear.
uz: U Svidrigailovga iltijo qilayotgan ko'rinardi; u qo'rquvni butunlay unutgan edi.

en: “There are thousands and millions of combinations and possibilities, Avdotya Romanovna.
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, minglab va millionlab kombinatsiyalar va imkoniyatlar mavjud.

en: A thief steals and knows he is a scoundrel, but I’ve heard of a gentleman who broke open the mail.
uz: O'g'ri o'g'irlaydi va u o'zining begona ekanligini biladi, lekin men pochta xabarini buzgan bir gentleman haqida eshitganman.

en: Who knows, very likely he thought he was doing a gentlemanly thing!
uz: Kim biladi, ehtimol, u gentlemanlik qilayotganini o'ylagan bo'lishi mumkin!

en: Of course I should not have believed it myself if I’d been told of it as you have, but I believe my own ears.
uz: Albatta, agar siz kabi menga bu haqda gapirsalar, o'zim ham ishonmas edim, lekin o'z quloqlarimga ishonaman.

en: He explained all the causes of it to Sofya Semyonovna too, but she did not believe her ears at first, yet she believed her own eyes at last.” “What … were the causes?” “It’s a long story, Avdotya Romanovna.
uz: U Sofiya Semyonovnaga ham buning barcha sabablarini tushuntirdi, lekin u boshida o'z quloqlariga ishonmadi, ammo oxir-oqibat o'z ko'zlariga ishondi. Nima sabablari?Bu uzoq hikoya, Avdotya Romanovna.

en: Here’s … how shall I tell you?
uz: Mana... qanday qilib aytishim kerak?

en: —A theory of a sort, the same one by which I for instance consider that a single misdeed is permissible if the principal aim is right, a solitary wrongdoing and hundreds of good deeds!
uz: Bir xil nazariya, men, masalan, agar asosiy maqsad to'g'ri bo'lsa, bitta noto'g'ri ish yo'l qo'yilgan deb o'ylayman, bir xil noto'g'ri ish va yuzlab yaxshi ishlar!

en: It’s galling too, of course, for a young man of gifts and overweening pride to know that if he had, for instance, a paltry three thousand, his whole career, his whole future would be differently shaped and yet not to have that three thousand.
uz: Albatta, iqtidorli va mag'rur bo'lgan yosh kishi uchun, masalan, uch ming pulga ega bo'lganida, butun hayoti, butun kelajagi boshqacha bo'lib, uch ming pulga ega bo'lmasligini bilishi juda achinarli.

en: Add to that, nervous irritability from hunger, from lodging in a hole, from rags, from a vivid sense of the charm of his social position and his sister’s and mother’s position too.
uz: Buning ustiga ochlikdan, cho'g'da yashaganidan, to'qimalardan, uning ijtimoiy mavqei va singil-singillari va onasi mavqeyidagi go'zallik haqida aniq his-tuyg'u qilishdan paydo bo'lgan g'alati xafalik ham qo'shilsin.

en: Above all, vanity, pride and vanity, though goodness knows he may have good qualities too.
uz: Eng asosiysi, u bekorchilik, mag'rurlik va bekorchilikka ega, ammo Xudo uning yaxshi fazilatlarga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini biladi.

en: … I am not blaming him, please don’t think it; besides, it’s not my business.
uz: ... Men uni ayblamayman, iltimos, o'ylamang; bundan tashqari, bu mening ishim emas.

en: A special little theory came in too —a theory of a sort —dividing mankind, you see, into material and superior persons, that is persons to whom the law does not apply owing to their superiority, who make laws for the rest of mankind, the material, that is.
uz: O'zgacha nazariya ham paydo bo'ldi, bu nazariya insoniyatni moddiy va yuqori shaxslarga bo'lib, ya'ni o'z ustunligi tufayli qonun qo'llanilmaydigan, qolgan insoniyat uchun qonunlar tuzadigan shaxslar, ya'ni moddiy shaxslarga bo'linadi.

en: It’s all right as a theory, une théorie comme une autre.
uz: Bu nazariya sifatida yaxshi, nazariya boshqa nazariya sifatida yaxshi.

en: Napoleon attracted him tremendously, that is, what affected him was that a great many men of genius have not hesitated at wrongdoing, but have overstepped the law without thinking about it.
uz: Napoleon uni juda jalb qildi, ya'ni uni ta'sir qilgan narsa shundaki, juda ko'p iste'dodli odamlar noto'g'ri ish qilishda ikkilanmagan, balki o'ylamasdan qonunni buzgan.

en: He seems to have fancied that he was a genius too —that is, he was convinced of it for a time.
uz: U o'zini o'zi ham dahshatli deb o'ylagan bo'lib tuyuladi, ya'ni u bir muncha vaqt shu fikrda bo'lgan.

en: He has suffered a great deal and is still suffering from the idea that he could make a theory, but was incapable of boldly overstepping the law, and so he is not a man of genius.
uz: U juda ko'p azob chekdi va hali ham nazariya tuzishi mumkin degan fikrdan azob chekmoqda, ammo qonunni jasorat bilan buzishga qodir emas, shuning uchun u dahshatli odam emas.

en: And that’s humiliating for a young man of any pride, in our day especially.
uz: Va bu har qanday g'ururli yigit uchun kamtarlikdir, ayniqsa bizning kunlarimizda.

en: You deny him any moral feeling then?
uz: Shunday qilib, siz unga biron bir axloqiy hissiyotni rad etasizmi?

en: Is he like that?” “Ah, Avdotya Romanovna, everything is in a muddle now; not that it was ever in very good order.
uz: U shundaymi?Aha, Avdotya Romanovna, hozir hamma narsa g'alati holatda; hech qachon juda yaxshi tartibda bo'lmagan.

en: Russians in general are broad in their ideas, Avdotya Romanovna, broad like their land and exceedingly disposed to the fantastic, the chaotic.
uz: Umuman olganda, ruslar o'zlarining g'oyalari keng, Avdotya Romanovna, o'z yerlari kabi keng va ajoyib, xaroyib narsaga juda moyil.

en: But it’s a misfortune to be broad without a special genius.
uz: Ammo o'zgacha da'vosiz keng bo'lish baxtsizlikdir.

en: Do you remember what a lot of talk we had together on this subject, sitting in the evenings on the terrace after supper?
uz: Kechalari kechki ovqatdan so'ng terassada o'tirib, bu mavzuda birga qancha suhbatlashganimizni eslaysizmi?

en: Why, you used to reproach me with breadth!
uz: Axir, siz meni kenglik bilan tanqid qilar edingiz-ku!

en: Who knows, perhaps we were talking at the very time when he was lying here thinking over his plan.
uz: Kim biladi, ehtimol biz u erda o'z rejasi haqida o'ylayotganida gapirgan bo'lardik.

en: There are no sacred traditions amongst us, especially in the educated class, Avdotya Romanovna.
uz: Bizda hech qanday muqaddas an'analar yo'q, ayniqsa bilimdonlar orasida Avdotya Romanovna.

en: At the best someone will make them up somehow for himself out of books or from some old chronicle.
uz: Eng yaxshi holatda, kimdir ularni o'zi uchun kitoblardan yoki eski xronikalardan yaratadi.

en: But those are for the most part the learned and all old fogeys, so that it would be almost ill-bred in a man of society.
uz: Ammo bularning aksariyati bilimdonlar va barcha eski fogeylardir, shuning uchun u jamiyat odamida deyarli yomon tarbiyaga ega bo'ladi.

en: You know my opinions in general, though.
uz: Ammo siz mening umumiy fikrlarimni bilasiz.

en: I never blame anyone.
uz: Men hech qachon hech kimni ayblamayman.

en: I do nothing at all, I persevere in that.
uz: Men umuman hech narsa qilmayman, bu borada qat'iy harakat qilaman.

en: But we’ve talked of this more than once before.
uz: Ammo biz bu haqda bir necha marta gapirganmiz.

en: I was so happy indeed as to interest you in my opinions.
uz: Sizni mening fikrlarim bilan qiziqtirganimdan juda xursand bo'ldim.

en: … You are very pale, Avdotya Romanovna.” “I know his theory.
uz: ... Siz juda soyaverasiz, Avdotya Romanovna.Men uning nazariyasini bilaman.

en: I read that article of his about men to whom all is permitted.
uz: Men uning barcha narsalarga ruxsat berilgan erkaklar haqida yozgan maqolasini o'qib chiqdim.

en: Razumihin brought it to me.” “Mr.
uz: Razumihin uni menga keltirdi. Mr.

en: Your brother’s article?
uz: Birodaringizning maqolasi?

en: Is there such an article?
uz: Bunday maqola bormi?

en: It must be interesting.
uz: Bu qiziqarli bo'lishi kerak.

en: But where are you going, Avdotya Romanovna?” “I want to see Sofya Semyonovna,” Dounia articulated faintly.
uz: Ammo qayerga ketyapsiz, Avdotya Romanovna?Sofya Semyonovna bilan uchrashishni xohlayman, Dounia so'zlashda so'zlashda so'zlashuvchan.

en: “How do I go to her?
uz: Men unga qanday borishim kerak?

en: She has come in, perhaps.
uz: Ehtimol, u kirib kelgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: I must see her at once.
uz: Men uni darhol ko'rishim kerak.

en: Perhaps she …” Avdotya Romanovna could not finish.
uz: Ehtimol u Avdotya Romanovna bitira olmagan.

en: Her breath literally failed her.
uz: Uning nafas olish usuli, chindan ham, uni yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: “Sofya Semyonovna will not be back till night, at least I believe not.
uz: Sofya Semyonovna kechgacha qaytib kelmaydi, hech bo'lmaganda men ishonmayman.

en: She was to have been back at once, but if not, then she will not be in till quite late.” “Ah, then you are lying!
uz: U darhol qaytib kelishi kerak edi, lekin agar qaytib kelmasa, u juda kechgacha qaytib kelmaydi.Ah, demak, siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz!

en: I see … you were lying … lying all the time.
uz: Ko'rib turibmanki, siz doim yolg'on gapirgansiz.

en: … I don’t believe you!
uz: Men sizga ishonmayman!

en: I don’t believe you!” cried Dounia, completely losing her head.
uz: Men sizga ishonmayman! - deb yig'ladi Dounia, boshini butunlay yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: Almost fainting, she sank on to a chair which Svidrigaïlov made haste to give her.
uz: U deyarli eshikdan o'tib, Svidrigailov shoshilinchlik bilan unga berish uchun o'tirgan o'rinbosari ustiga tushib ketdi.

en: “Avdotya Romanovna, what is it?
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, bu nima?

en: …” He sprinkled some water over her.
uz: ... U ayol ustiga suv cho'kdi.

en: Dounia shuddered and came to herself.
uz: Dounia dahshatga tushdi va o'ziga keldi.

en: “It has acted violently,” Svidrigaïlov muttered to himself, frowning.
uz: U zo'ravonlik bilan harakat qildi,  Svidrigailov o'zicha gapirib, o'ziga burchak qo'ydi.

en: “Avdotya Romanovna, calm yourself!
uz: Avdotya Romanovna, tinchlaning!

en: Believe me, he has friends.
uz: Ishoning, uning do'stlari bor.

en: Would you like me to take him abroad?
uz: Uni chet elga olib ketishimni xohlaysizmi?

en: I have money, I can get a ticket in three days.
uz: Pulim bor, uch kun ichida chipta olsam bo'ladi.

en: And as for the murder, he will do all sorts of good deeds yet, to atone for it.
uz: Oʻlimga kelganda esa, uni toʻlov qilish uchun u yana har xil yaxshiliklarni qiladi.

en: He may become a great man yet.
uz: U hali ham buyuk inson bo'lishi mumkin.

en: How do you feel?” “Cruel man!
uz: O'zingizni qanday his qilyapsiz? Qahrli odam!

en: To be able to jeer at it!
uz: Bu haqda o'ylashim kerak!

en: Let me go …” “Where are you going?” “To him.
uz: Men ketaman ...  Qayerga ketyapsan?  Unga.

en: Why is this door locked?
uz: Nima uchun bu eshik qulflab qo'yilgan?

en: We came in at that door and now it is locked.
uz: Biz o'sha eshikdan kirdik va endi u qulflab qo'yilgan.

en: When did you manage to lock it?” “We couldn’t be shouting all over the flat on such a subject.
uz: Qachon uni qulflab qo'ygan edingiz?Biz bunday mavzuda butun xonadon bo'ylab qichqirishni istamaymiz.

en: I am far from jeering; it’s simply that I’m sick of talking like this.
uz: Men masxara qilishdan uzoqman; shunchaki men bunday gapirishdan charchadim.

en: But how can you go in such a state?
uz: Ammo qanday qilib bunday holatda o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz mumkin?

en: Do you want to betray him?
uz: Unga xiyonat qilishni xohlaysizmi?

en: You will drive him to fury, and he will give himself up.
uz: Siz uni g'azablantirasiz va u o'zini topshiradi.

en: Let me tell you, he is already being watched; they are already on his track.
uz: Sizga aytamanki, uni allaqachon kuzatib bormoqdalar; ular allaqachon uning izidan bormoqdalar.

en: You will simply be giving him away.
uz: Siz shunchaki uni tashlab ketasiz.

en: Wait a little: I saw him and was talking to him just now.
uz: Bir oz vaqt: men uni ko'rdim va u bilan gaplashayotgan edim.

en: He can still be saved.
uz: U hali ham qutqariladi.

en: Wait a bit, sit down; let us think it over together.
uz: Biroz kuting, o'tirib ko'rib chiqing; keling, bu haqda birgalikda o'ylab ko'raylik.

en: I asked you to come in order to discuss it alone with you and to consider it thoroughly.
uz: Men sizdan uni shaxsan siz bilan muhokama qilish va chuqur o'rganish uchun kelishni so'radim.

en: But do sit down!” “How can you save him?
uz: Ammo o'tiring! Qanday qilib uni qutqarishingiz mumkin?

en: Can he really be saved?” Dounia sat down.
uz: U haqiqatan ham qutqarila oladimi? Dounia o'tiribdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov sat down beside her.
uz: Svidrigailov uning yonida o'tirdi.

en: “It all depends on you, on you, on you alone,” he began with glowing eyes, almost in a whisper and hardly able to utter the words for emotion.
uz: Buning barchasi sizdan, sizdan, faqat sizdan kelib chiqadi, u o'z ko'zlarini yorqin qilib boshladi, deyarli shoshib va his-tuyg'ularni ifodalash uchun so'zlarni aytishga ojiz edi.

en: Dounia drew back from him in alarm.
uz: Dounia u bilan bo'lgan xavotirda orqaga chiqdi.

en: He too was trembling all over.
uz: U ham hamma joyda titragan edi.

en: “You … one word from you, and he is saved.
uz: Siz... sizdan bir so'z so'z, va u qutqariladi.

en: I have money and friends.
uz: Pul va do'stlarim bor.

en: I’ll send him away at once.
uz: Men uni darhol jo'nataman.

en: I’ll get a passport, two passports, one for him and one for me.
uz: Men pasport, ikki pasport, birini u uchun, birini o'zim uchun olsam bo'ladi.

en: I have friends  … capable people.
uz: Mening do'stlarim bor... qobiliyatli odamlar.

en: … If you like, I’ll take a passport for you … for your mother.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, men siz uchun ... onangiz uchun pasport olib ketaman.

en: … What do you want with Razumihin?
uz: Siz Razumihindan nima istaysiz?

en: … I love you beyond everything.
uz: ...Men seni har narsadan ustun sevaman.

en: … Let me kiss the hem of your dress,
uz: ... Kambag'angning chekiga o'pishimga ruxsat bering,

en: … The very rustle of it is too much for me.
uz: ...Uning shovqinligi men uchun juda ko'p.

en: Tell me, ‘do that,’ and I’ll do it.
uz: Menga ayting, shuni qil, shuni qilaman.

en: I will do the impossible.
uz: Men imkonsiz narsani qilaman.

en: What you believe, I will believe.
uz: Sen nimaga ishonasan, men ham shunday ishonaman.

en: I’ll do anything —anything!
uz: Men har qanday narsani qilaman!

en: Don’t, don’t look at me like that.
uz: Menga shunday qaramang.

en: Do you know that you are killing me?
uz: Siz meni o'ldirayotganingizni bilasizmi?

en: …” He was almost beginning to rave.
uz: ... U deyarli ravingni boshlagan edi.

en: … Something seemed suddenly to go to his head.
uz: Birdan uning boshiga biror narsa tushdi.

en: Dounia jumped up and rushed to the door.
uz: Dounia ko'tarildi va eshikga yugurdi.

en: Open it!” she called, shaking the door.
uz: Eshikni oching! U qo'ng'iroq qildi va eshikni silkitdi.

en: Is there no one there?” Svidrigaïlov got up and came to himself.
uz: U yerda hech kim yo'qmi? Svidrigailov o'rnidan turib, o'ziga keldi.

en: His still trembling lips slowly broke into an angry mocking smile.
uz: Uning hali ham titrab turgan og'izlari asta-sekin g'azablangan masxarali tabassumga aylandi.

en: “There is no one at home,” he said quietly and emphatically.
uz: "Uyda hech kim yo'q", - dedi u xotirjamlik va qat'iylik bilan.

en: “The landlady has gone out, and it’s waste of time to shout like that.
uz: Uy egasi tashqariga chiqdi va bunday qichqirish vaqtni yo'qotishdir.

en: You are only exciting yourself uselessly.” “Where is the key?
uz: Siz faqat o'zingizni foydasiz hayajonlantiryapsiz. Keychasi qayerda?

en: Open the door at once, at once, base man!” “I have lost the key and cannot find it.” “This is an outrage,” cried Dounia, turning pale as death.
uz: Darhol eshikni oching, darhol, o'g'lim!Men kalitni yo'qotib yubordim va topolmadim.Bu g'azablangan narsa, - deb baqirdi Dounia, o'limga o'xshaydi.

en: She rushed to the furthest corner, where she made haste to barricade herself with a little table.
uz: U eng uzoq burchakga yugurdi va o'zini kichik bir stol bilan barrikada qilishga shoshildi.

en: She did not scream, but she fixed her eyes on her tormentor and watched every movement he made.
uz: U qichqiriq qilmadi, lekin o'z ko'zlarini o'zining azoblovchisiga qaratdi va uning har bir harakatini kuzatdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov remained standing at the other end of the room facing her.
uz: Svidrigailov xonaning boshqa tomoniga qarab turdi.

en: He was positively composed, at least in appearance, but his face was pale as before.
uz: U, hech bo'lmaganda, tashqi ko'rinishda ijobiy tarkibga ega edi, ammo yuzida avvalgidek soya edi.

en: The mocking smile did not leave his face.
uz: Masxara qiluvchi tabassum yuzidan chiqmadi.

en: “You spoke of outrage just now, Avdotya Romanovna.
uz: Siz hozirgina g'azab haqida gapirgansiz, Avdotya Romanovna.

en: In that case you may be sure I’ve taken measures.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, siz o'zingiz uchun choralar ko'rganingizga amin bo'lishingiz mumkin.

en: Sofya Semyonovna is not at home.
uz: Sofya Semyonovna uyda yo'q.

en: The Kapernaumovs are far away —there are five locked rooms between.
uz: Kapernaumovlar juda uzoqda. ~ ~ ~ Ularning o'rtasida besh ta qulfli xonalar mavjud. ~ ~ ~

en: I am at least twice as strong as you are and I have nothing to fear, besides.
uz: Men sizlardan ikki baravar kuchliroqman va qo'rqishim kerak bo'lmagan.

en: For you could not complain afterwards.
uz: Chunki keyinchalik shikoyat qila olmas edingiz.

en: You surely would not be willing actually to betray your brother?
uz: Siz o'z birodaringizga xiyonat qilishga tayyor emasmidingiz?

en: Besides, no one would believe you.
uz: Bundan tashqari, hech kim sizga ishonmaydi.

en: How should a girl have come alone to visit a solitary man in his lodgings?
uz: Qanday qilib bir qiz yolg'iz odamning uylariga yolg'iz kelgan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: So that even if you do sacrifice your brother, you could prove nothing.
uz: Shunday qilib, hatto birodaringizni qurbon qilsangiz ham, hech narsa isbotlay olmaysiz.

en: It is very difficult to prove an assault, Avdotya Romanovna.” “Scoundrel!” whispered Dounia indignantly.
uz: Hujumni isbotlash juda qiyin, Avdotya Romanovna. Scoundrel! Dounia g'azabga to'lib-toshdi.

en: “As you like, but observe I was only speaking by way of a general proposition.
uz: Siz xohlaganingizdek, lekin e'tibor bering, men faqat umumiy taklif orqali gapirgan edim.

en: It’s my personal conviction that you are perfectly right — violence is hateful.
uz: Shaxsiy e'tiqodim shuki, siz mutlaqo haqsiz, zo'ravonlik nafratlidir.

en: I only spoke to show you that you need have no
uz: Men sizga faqat sizga hech narsa kerak emasligini ko'rsatish uchun gapirdim.

en: remorse even if … you were willing to save your brother of your own accord, as I suggest to you.
uz: Afsuski, agar siz o'zingizning birodaringizni qutqarishga tayyor bo'lgan bo'lsangiz ham, men sizga maslahat beraman.

en: You would be simply submitting to circumstances, to violence, in fact, if we must use that word.
uz: Agar bu so'zni qo'llashimiz kerak bo'lsa, siz shunchaki vaziyatlarga, zo'ravonlikka bo'ysunasiz.

en: Your brother’s and your mother’s fate are in your hands.
uz: Birodaru opa-singillaringiz va onangizning taqdirlari sizning qo'lingizda.

en: I will be your slave … all my life … I will wait here.” Svidrigaïlov sat down on the sofa about eight steps from Dounia.
uz: Men sizning qulingiz bo'laman ... butun hayotim davomida ... men bu yerda kutaman. Svidrigailov Dounia shahriga sakkiz qadam yaqin bo'lgan sofaga o'tirdi.

en: She had not the slightest doubt now of his unbending determination.
uz: Endi uning qat'iy qaroridan hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: Besides, she knew him.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u uni taniydi.

en: Suddenly she pulled out of her pocket a revolver, cocked it and laid it in her hand on the table.
uz: Toʻsatdan u kiyimidan revolver olib chiqib, uni qovurib, qoʻlida dasturxon ustiga qoʻydi.

en: Svidrigaïlov jumped up.
uz: Svidrigailov ko'tarildi.

en: So that’s it, is it?” he cried, surprised but smiling maliciously.
uz: Shunday qilib, shu qadar, shundaymi? - deb yig'ladi u, hayron bo'lib, lekin yomon ko'ngil bilan tabassum qildi.

en: “Well, that completely alters the aspect of affairs.
uz: Ha, bu vaziyatning ko'rinishini butunlay o'zgartiradi.

en: You’ve made things wonderfully easier for me, Avdotya Romanovna.
uz: Sizlar men uchun ishlarni juda osonlashtirdingiz, Avdotya Romanovna.

en: But where did you get the revolver?
uz: Ammo siz bu qurolni qayerdan olgansiz?

en: Why, it’s my revolver, an old friend!
uz: Bu mening qurol-yarog'im, eski do'stim!

en: And how I’ve hunted for it!
uz: Va men uni qanday ham orqasiga qo'yganman!

en: The shooting lessons I’ve given you in the country have not been thrown away.” “It’s not your revolver, it belonged to Marfa Petrovna, whom you killed, wretch!
uz: Men sizga qishloqdagi o'qishni o'rgatganim uchun o'qishni tashlab yubormaganman.Bu sizning revolveringiz emas, siz o'ldirgan Marfa Petrovnaga tegishli edi!

en: There was nothing of yours in her house.
uz: Uning uyida sening hech narsaing yo'q edi.

en: I took it when I began to suspect what you were capable of.
uz: Siz nimaga qodir ekanligingizni shubha ostiga qo'yganimda, uni qabul qildim.

en: If you dare to advance one step, I swear I’ll kill you.” She was frantic.
uz: Agar siz bir qadam ham orqaga qadam bossangiz, qasam ichaman, sizni o'ldiraman.

en: I ask from curiosity,” said Svidrigaïlov, still standing where he was.
uz: Men qiziquvchanlikdan so'rayman, - dedi Svidrigailov, hali ham o'zi turgan joyda turib.

en: “Inform, if you want to!
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, xabar bering!

en: You poisoned your wife, I know; you are a murderer yourself!” She held the revolver ready.
uz: Men bilaman, siz xotiningizni zaharlagansiz; siz o'zingiz ham qotilsiz! U o'z revolverini tayyorlab qo'ygan edi.

en: “Are you so positive I poisoned Marfa Petrovna?” “You did!
uz: Men Marfa Petrovnoni zaharlaganimdan shu qadar ishonchingiz komilmi?Siz shunday qildingiz!

en: You hinted it yourself; you talked to me of poison.
uz: Siz o'zingiz ishora qildingiz; menga zahar haqida gapirgansiz.

en: … I know you went to get it … you had it in readiness.
uz: ... Men bilamanki, siz uni olish uchun borgansiz... siz uni tayyor holda ko'rgansiz.

en: … It was your doing.
uz: ...Bu sizning ishingiz edi.

en: … It must have been your doing.
uz: ... Bu sizning ishingiz bo'lishi kerak.

en: … Scoundrel!” “Even if that were true, it would have been for your sake … you would have been the cause.” “You are lying!
uz: ...Inoq! Agar bu haqiqat bo'lganida ham, bu o'zingiz uchun bo'lgan bo'lardi... siz sabab bo'lgan bo'lardingiz.  Siz yolg'on gapiryapsiz!

en: I hated you always, always.
uz: Men seni har doim, har doim nafratlaganman.

en: …” “Oho, Avdotya Romanovna!
uz: ...Oh, Avdotya Romanovna!

en: You seem to have forgotten how you softened to me in the heat of propaganda.
uz: O'zingizning o'ylagandek, propaganda issiqligida menga qanday yumshoqlik qilganingizni unutgansiz.

en: I saw it in your eyes.
uz: Men buni sizning ko'zlaringizda ko'rdim.

en: Do you remember that moonlight night, when the nightingale was singing?”
uz: O'sha oy yorug'u kechasi, kechqurun qo'shiq kuylagan kechani eslaysizmi?

en: “That’s a lie,” there was a flash of fury in Dounia’s eyes, “that’s a lie and a libel!” “A lie?
uz: Bu yolg'on, Duniyaning ko'zlarida g'azabni ko'tarish edi, bu yolg'on va haqorat!

en: Well, if you like, it’s a lie.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, bu yolg'on.

en: Women ought not to be reminded of such things,” he smiled.
uz: Ayollar bunday narsalar haqida eslatib bo'lmasliklari kerak, - dedi u tabassum bilan.

en: “I know you will shoot, you pretty wild creature.
uz: Men bilsam, siz o'qishni davom ettirasiz, ey chiroyli yovvoyi mavjudot.

en: Well, shoot away!” Dounia raised the revolver, and deadly pale, gazed at him, measuring the distance and awaiting the first movement on his part.
uz: Dounia revolverni ko'tardi va o'limga to'lib-toshdi, unga qaradi, masofani o'lchab, uning birinchi harakatini kutadi.

en: Her lower lip was white and quivering and her big black eyes flashed like fire.
uz: Uning pastki og'zi oq va titraydigan, katta qora ko'zlari esa olov kabi parlashardi.

en: He had never seen her so handsome.
uz: U hech qachon uni shu qadar chiroyli ko'rmagan edi.

en: The fire glowing in her eyes at the moment she raised the revolver seemed to kindle him and there was a pang of anguish in his heart.
uz: O'sha paytda uning ko'zidagi olov uni o'chirib qo'ydi va uning yuragida biroz og'irlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: He took a step forward and a shot rang out.
uz: U bir qadam oldinga ko'tardi va o'q eshitildi.

en: The bullet grazed his hair and flew into the wall behind.
uz: O'q uning sochlarini o'rab olib, orqasidagi devorga uchdi.

en: He stood still and laughed softly.
uz: U toʻxtamay, salqincha kulishdi.

en: “The wasp has stung me.
uz: Tovuz meni uribdi.

en: She aimed straight at my head.
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri boshimga qaratilgan edi.

en: Blood?” he pulled out his handkerchief to wipe the blood, which flowed in a thin stream down his right temple.
uz: Qon? o'ng tomoniga o'tib, o'ng tomoniga oqib o'tgan qonni tozalash uchun o'zining to'qimachasini chiqardi.

en: The bullet seemed to have just grazed the skin.
uz: O'qning terini o'rab olganini ko'rardim.

en: Dounia lowered the revolver and looked at Svidrigaïlov not so much in terror as in a sort of wild amazement.
uz: Dounia revolverni pastga tushirdi va Svidrigailovga qo'rquvdan emas, balki vahshiy hayratda ko'z tikdi.

en: She seemed not to understand what she was doing and what was going on.
uz: U nima qilayotganini va nima sodir bo'layotganini tushunmayotganday tuyuldi.

en: Fire again, I’ll wait,” said Svidrigaïlov softly, still smiling, but gloomily.
uz: Yana o't, men kutaman, - dedi Svidrigailov sekinlik bilan, hali ham tabassum bilan, lekin ko'ngilsizlik bilan.

en: “If you go on like that, I shall have time to seize you before you cock again.” Dounia started, quickly cocked the pistol and again raised it.
uz: Agar shunday davom etsangiz, siz yana pichoq qilishingizdan oldin sizni ushlab turishga vaqtim bo'ladi. Dounia boshladi, tezda pichoqni ushlab, uni yana ko'tarib oldi.

en: “Let me be,” she cried in despair.
uz: Let me be, u umidsizlikka tushib yig'ladi.

en: “I swear I’ll shoot again.
uz: Shunga qasamki, yana bir marta o'q ko'taraman.

en: I … I’ll kill you.” “Well … at three paces you can hardly help it.
uz: Men seni o'ldiraman.Ushbu... uch qadamda o'zingga hech qanday yordam berolmaysan.

en: But if you don’t … then.” His eyes flashed and he took two steps forward.
uz: Ammo agar yo'q bo'lsa... o'shanda. Uning ko'zlari bir-birini ko'rib, ikki qadam oldinga qadam qo'ydi.

en: Dounia shot again: it missed fire.
uz: Dounia yana o'q oldi: u o'qdan o'tdi.

en: “You haven’t loaded it properly.
uz: Siz uni to'g'ri yuklamagansiz.

en: Never mind, you have another charge there.
uz: Aslo ahamiyat yo'q, sizda yana bir to'lov bor.

en: Get it ready, I’ll wait.” He stood facing her, two paces away, waiting and gazing at her with wild determination, with feverishly passionate, stubborn, set eyes.
uz: Tayyorlaning, men kutaman. U ikki qadam uzoqlikda, qizga qaragan holda, qizg'in ishtiyoq bilan, qizg'in ishtiyoq bilan, o'zboshimchalik bilan, ko'z o'ngida turardi.

en: Dounia saw that he would sooner die than let her go.
uz: Dounia uning ketishiga ruxsat berishdan ko'ra o'lib ketishni afzal ko'rganini tushungan.

en: “And … now, of course she would kill him, at two paces!” Suddenly she flung away the revolver.
uz: Va... albatta, u uni ikki qadamda o'ldiradi! Birdan u o'z revolverini tashlab yubordi.

en: “She’s dropped it!” said Svidrigaïlov with surprise, and he drew a deep breath.
uz: "U tushdi!" - dedi Svidrigailov hayron bo'lib, chuqur nafas oldi.

en: A weight seemed to have rolled from his heart — perhaps not only the fear of death; indeed he may scarcely have felt it at that moment.
uz: Uning yuragidan og'irlik ko'tarilib ketdi, ehtimol, nafaqat o'lim qo'rquvi, balki u o'sha paytda uni his qilmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It was the deliverance from another feeling, darker and more bitter, which he could not himself have defined.
uz: Bu uning o'zi belgilab bera olmagan boshqa, qorong'u va achchiqroq his-tuyg'ulardan xalos bo'lish edi.

en: He went to Dounia and gently put his arm round her waist.
uz: U Douniaga borib, qo'lini uning belini o'rab oldi.

en: She did not resist, but, trembling like a leaf, looked at him with suppliant eyes.
uz: U qarshilik ko'rsatmadi, lekin barg kabi titrab, unga iltijo qilayotgan ko'zlar bilan qaradi.

en: He tried to say something, but his lips moved without being able to utter a sound.
uz: U biror narsa aytishga harakat qildi, ammo og'zaki bir ovozni ham aytolmay harakatlandi.

en: “Let me go,” Dounia implored.
uz: Let me go, Dounia iltijo qildi.

en: Svidrigaïlov shuddered.
uz: Svidrigailov dahshatga tushdi.

en: Her voice now was quite different.
uz: Uning ovozi endi ancha boshqacha edi.

en: “Then you don’t love me?” he asked softly.
uz: Seni sevmayapmanmi? deb so'radi u sekin.

en: Dounia shook her head.
uz: Dounia boshini silkitdi.

en: “And … and you can’t?
uz: Va ... va siz qila olmaysizmi?

en: Never?” he whispered in despair.
uz: Hech qachon? u umidsizlikka tushib shovqin qildi.

en: “Never!” There followed a moment of terrible, dumb struggle in the heart of Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Svidrigailovning qalbida dahshatli, soqov kurashning bir daqiqaligi davom etdi.

en: He looked at her with an indescribable gaze.
uz: U ayolga so'zlab bo'lmaydigan ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: Suddenly he withdrew his arm, turned quickly to the window and stood facing it.
uz: Toʻsatdan u qoʻlini olib, darhol darchaga qarab turdi va unga qaragan holda turdi.

en: Another moment passed.
uz: Yana bir daqiqa o'tdi.

en: “Here’s the key.” He took it out of the left pocket of his coat and laid it on the table behind him, without turning or looking at Dounia.
uz: Mana kalit. U uni kiyimining chap qopqoqidan olib chiqib, orqasidagi stolga qo'ydi, hech qachon Douniaga qaramasdan.

en: Make haste!” He looked stubbornly out of the window.
uz: Shoshil! U darvoza tomondan o'ziga tik qaradi.

en: Dounia went up to the table to take the key.
uz: Dounia kalitni olish uchun stolga bordi.

en: Make haste!” repeated Svidrigaïlov, still without turning or moving.
uz: Shoshil! Svidrigailov takrorladi, hali ham o'zgarib yoki harakatlanmasdan.

en: But there seemed a terrible significance in the tone of that “make haste.” Dounia understood it, snatched up the key, flew to the door, unlocked it quickly and rushed out of the room.
uz: Ammo shunga o'xshab, make hurry so'zlarining o'zida dahshatli ma'no paydo bo'ldi. Dounia buni tushunib, kalitni olib, eshik tomon uchdi, uni tezda ochdi va xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: A minute later, beside herself, she ran out on to the canal bank in the direction of X — — Bridge.
uz: Bir daqiqadan so'ng, u o'zidan tashqari, X   ko'prik yo'nalishidagi kanal qirg'og'iga chopdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov remained three minutes standing at the window.
uz: Svidrigailov uch daqiqa davomida deraza oldida turdi.

en: At last he slowly turned, looked about him and passed his hand over his forehead.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u asta-sekin o'girilib, atrofini ko'rib, qo'lini oldinga o'tkazdi.

en: A strange smile contorted his face, a pitiful, sad, weak smile, a smile of despair.
uz: Uning yuzida g'alati tabassum, achinarli, xafa, zaif tabassum, umidsizlik tabassum paydo bo'ldi.

en: The blood, which was already getting dry, smeared his hand.
uz: Qon endi qurib ketayotgan edi, uni qo'lidan solib qo'ydi.

en: He looked angrily at it, then wetted a towel and
uz: U g'azab bilan unga qaradi, so'ngra bir charchoqni bosadi va

en: The revolver which Dounia had flung away lay near the door and suddenly caught his eye.
uz: Dounia tashlagan revolver eshik yaqinida yotgan edi va to'satdan uning ko'zini qamrab oldi.

en: He picked it up and examined it.
uz: U uni olib, tekshirib ko'rdi.

en: It was a little pocket three-barrel revolver of old- fashioned construction.
uz: Bu qadimgi uslubda ishlab chiqilgan kichik keskin uch barrelli revolver edi.

en: There were still two charges and one capsule left in it.
uz: U yerda yana ikkita to'lov va bitta kapsula qolgan edi.

en: It could be fired again.
uz: U yana o'chirilishi mumkin.

en: He thought a little, put the revolver in his pocket, took his hat and went out.
uz: U biroz o'ylab ko'rdi, revolverni qopqoqlariga qo'yib, to'pini olib, tashqariga chiqdi.

en: VI He spent that evening till ten o’clock going from one low haunt to another.
uz: U o'sha kecha soat o'n gacha bir past joydan boshqasiga o'tib o'tdi.

en: Katia too turned up and sang another gutter song, how a certain “villain and tyrant,  began kissing Katia.” Svidrigaïlov treated Katia and the organ-grinder and some singers and the waiters and two little clerks.
uz: Katia ham paydo bo'lib, yana bir qo'shiq kuyladi, qanday qilib bir "qaroqchi va tiran" Katia bilan o'qishni boshladi. Svidrigailov Katia va organ-moyishi, ba'zi qo'shiqchilar, xizmatkorlar va ikkita kichkina xizmatkor bilan muomala qildi.

en: He was particularly drawn to these clerks by the fact that they both had crooked noses, one bent to the left and the other to the right.
uz: U ayniqsa bu ishchilar bilan tanishib qoldi, chunki ularning ikkalasi ham burunlari egri, biri chap, ikkinchisi esa o'ng tomon egri bo'lgan.

en: They took him finally to a pleasure garden, where he paid for their entrance.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, ular uni zavq bog'iga olib ketishdi, u yerda u kirish uchun pul to'ladi.

en: There was one lanky three-year-old pine-tree and three bushes in the garden, besides a “Vauxhall,” which was in reality a drinking-bar where tea too was served, and there were a few green tables and chairs standing round it.
uz: Bog'da bir uch yoshli borak daraxti va uchta buta bor edi, bundan tashqari Vauxhall, aslida choy ham xizmat qiladigan ichimlik bara edi va uning atrofida bir nechta yashil stollar va o'rindiqlar turgan edi.

en: A chorus of wretched singers and a drunken but exceedingly depressed German clown from Munich with a red nose entertained the public.
uz: Qizil qo'shiqchilar qo'shigi va Munich shahridagi pichoq, ammo juda tushkunlikka tushgan, qizil burunli nemis palovni tinglovchilarga zavq keltirdi.

en: The clerks quarrelled with some other clerks and a fight seemed imminent.
uz: Ishchilar boshqa ishchilar bilan bahslashishdi va jang yaqinlashib qolgan bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: Svidrigaïlov was chosen to decide the dispute.
uz: Svidrigailov nizoni hal qilish uchun tanlandi.

en: He listened to them for a quarter of an hour, but they shouted so loud that there was no possibility of understanding them.
uz: U ularni qirq soat davomida tinglagan, ammo ular shunchalik baland ovoz bilan baqirganki, ularni tushunish imkoni yo'q edi.

en: The only fact that seemed certain was that one of them had stolen something and had even succeeded in selling it on the spot to a Jew, but would not share the spoil with his companion.
uz: Faqatgina aniq ko'rinadigan narsa shundaki, ulardan biri biror narsani o'g'irlagan va hatto uni o'z vaqtida yahudiy kishiga sotishga muvaffaq bo'lgan, ammo bu olovni o'z hamkori bilan bo'lishmagan.

en: Finally it appeared that the stolen object was a teaspoon belonging to the Vauxhall.
uz: Nihoyat, o'g'irlangan buyum Vauxhallga tegishli bir choy qoshiq ekanligi aniqlandi.

en: It was missed and the affair began to seem troublesome.
uz: Bu o'zidan chetda qoldirilgan va munosabatlar muammoli ko'rinishga ega bo'ldi.

en: Svidrigaïlov paid for the spoon, got up, and walked out of the garden.
uz: Svidrigailov qoshiq uchun pul to'ladi, o'rnidan turib, bog'dan chiqib ketdi.

en: He had not drunk a drop of wine all this time and had ordered tea more for the sake of appearances than anything.
uz: U bu vaqt davomida bir tomchi ham sharob ichmagan va tashqi ko'rinish uchun ko'proq choy buyurtma qilgan.

en: It was a dark and stifling evening.
uz: Bu qorong'u va og'ir kecha edi.

en: Threatening storm-clouds came over the sky about ten o’clock.
uz: Taxminan soat o'nlar atrofida osmon ustidan dahshatli bo'ron bulutlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: There was a clap of thunder, and the rain came down like a waterfall.
uz: U yerda momaqaldiroq ovoz chiqdi va yomg'ir kasal kabi tushdi.

en: The water fell not in drops, but beat on the earth in streams.
uz: Suv tomchilatib tushmadi, balki yer yuziga oqimlarcha tushib tushdi.

en: There were flashes of lightning every minute and each flash lasted while one could count five.
uz: Har bir daqiqada chaqmoq chaqmoqlari paydo bo'lgan va har bir chaqmoq besh marta sanab bo'lguncha davom etgan.

en: Drenched to the skin, he went home, locked himself in, opened the bureau, took out all his money and tore up two or three papers.
uz: O'ziga qaytib, o'zini qulflab, ofisni ochib, pulini olib chiqib, ikki-uchta qog'ozni parchaladi.

en: Then, putting the money in his pocket, he was about to change his clothes, but, looking out of the window and listening to the thunder and the rain, he gave up the idea, took up his hat and went out of the room without locking the door.
uz: Keyin pulni kiyimini o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lib, qopqoqlariga qo'ydi, lekin darchaga qarab, momaqaldiroq va yomg'irni tinglab, fikrdan voz kechdi, kaptasini ko'tarib, eshikni qulflamagan holda xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: He went straight to Sonia.
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Soniaga bordi.

en: She was not alone: the four Kapernaumov children were with her.
uz: U yolg'iz emas edi: u bilan birga to'rtta Kafarnahum o'g'li ham bor edi.

en: She was giving them tea.
uz: U ularga choy berayotgan edi.

en: She received Svidrigaïlov in respectful silence, looking wonderingly at his soaking clothes.
uz: U Svidrigaylovni hurmat ila hushyorlik bilan kutib oldi va uning kiyim-kechaklarini hayronlik bilan ko'rdi.

en: The children all ran away at once in indescribable terror.
uz: Bolalarning hammasi bir vaqtning o'zida tilga olinmaydigan dahshatga tushib qochib ketishdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov sat down at the table and asked Sonia to sit beside him.
uz: Svidrigailov stolga o'tirib, Soniaga o'z yonida o'tirishni taklif qildi.

en: She timidly prepared to listen.
uz: U qo'rqmasdan tinglashga tayyorlandi.

en: “I may be going to America, Sofya Semyonovna,” said Svidrigaïlov, “and as I am probably seeing you for the last time, I have come to make some arrangements.
