uz: Men Amerikaga ketyapman, Sofya Semyonovna, dedi Svidrigailov, va men sizni oxirgi marta ko'rishim mumkin bo'lganligi sababli, men ba'zi kelishuvlarni amalga oshirish uchun keldim.

en: Well, did you see the lady today?
uz: Xo'sh, siz bugun xonimni ko'rdingizmi?

en: I know what she said to you, you need not tell me.” (Sonia made a movement and blushed.) “Those people have their own way of doing things.
uz: U sizga nima dedi, men bilmayman. (Sonia harakat qildi va qizg'inladi.) Bu odamlar o'zlarining o'z yo'llari bilan harakat qilishadi.

en: As to your sisters and your brother, they are really provided for and the money assigned to them I’ve put into safe keeping and have received acknowledgments.
uz: Singillaringiz va aka-ukalaringiz haqli ravishda ta'minlanmoqda va ularga tayinlangan pulni xavfsiz saqlash uchun qo'ydim va ularga minnatdorchilik bildirdim.

en: You had better take charge of the receipts, in case anything happens.
uz: Biror narsa sodir bo'lsa, rasvolarni o'zingiz nazorat qiling.

en: Well now, that’s settled.
uz: Endi esa bu hal qilindi.

en: Here are three five-percent bonds to the value of three thousand roubles.
uz: Mana, uch ming rubl qiymatidagi uchta besh foizlik obligatsiya.

en: Take those for yourself, entirely for yourself, and let that be strictly between ourselves, so that no one knows of it, whatever you hear.
uz: Bularni o'zingiz uchun, butunlay o'zingiz uchun olib boring va buni o'zimiz o'rtasida saqlashingiz kerak, shuning uchun hech kim buni bilmasligi kerak, nima eshitsangiz ham.

en: You will need the money, for to go on living in the old way, Sofya Semyonovna, is bad, and besides there is no need for it now.” “I am so much indebted to you, and so are the children and my stepmother,” said Sonia hurriedly, “and if I’ve said so little … please
uz: Sizga pul kerak bo'ladi, chunki eski yo'l bilan yashash yomon, Sofiya Semyonovna, va bundan tashqari, hozir bu kerak emas. Men sizga juda ko'p qarzdorman, bolalar va o'g'lim ham shunday, - dedi Sonia shoshilinch, - va agar men juda kam gapirgan bo'lsam ... iltimos.

en: don’t consider …” “That’s enough!
uz: ko'rmang ...   Bu yetarli!

en: that’s enough!” “But as for the money, Arkady Ivanovitch, I am very grateful to you, but I don’t need it now.
uz: Ammo pulga kelsak, Arkady Ivanovitch, men sizga juda minnatdorman, lekin hozir unga muhtoj emasman.

en: I can always earn my own living.
uz: Men har doim o'zim uchun umr ko'rishim mumkin.

en: Don’t think me ungrateful.
uz: Meni minnatdorchiliksiz deb o'ylamang.

en: If you are so charitable, that money.
uz: Agar siz bunday mehribon bo'lsangiz, bu pul.

en: …” “It’s for you, for you, Sofya Semyonovna, and please don’t waste words over it.
uz: ... Bu sen uchun, Soniya Semyonovna, va iltimos, bu haqda so'zlarni isrof qilmang.

en: I haven’t time for it.
uz: Men uchun vaqt yo'q.

en: Rodion Romanovitch has two alternatives: a bullet in the brain or Siberia.” (Sonia looked wildly at him, and started.) “Don’t be uneasy, I know all about it from himself and I am not a gossip; I won’t tell anyone.
uz: Rodion Romanovitchning ikkita variantlari bor: miyaga o'q yoki Sibirga. (Sonia unga vahimaga qarab boshladi.) Xavotir olmang, men bu haqda o'zimdan bilaman va men g'iybatchi emasman; men hech kimga aytmayman.

en: It was good advice when you told him to give himself up and confess.
uz: Siz unga o'zini topshirish va tan olishni aytganingizda yaxshi maslahat bo'lgan.

en: It would be much better for him.
uz: U uchun bu ancha yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

en: Well, if it turns out to be Siberia, he will go and you will follow him.
uz: Agar Sibir bo'lsa, u ketadi va siz unga ergashasiz.

en: And if so, you’ll need money.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, sizga pul kerak bo'ladi.

en: You’ll need it for him, do you understand?
uz: Unga kerak bo'ladi, tushunasizmi?

en: Giving it to you is the same as my giving it to him.
uz: Sizga berish, unga berayotganim bilan bir xil.

en: Besides, you promised Amalia Ivanovna to pay what’s owing.
uz: Bundan tashqari, siz Amaliya Ivanovnaga qarzdor bo'lganini to'lashga va'da bergansiz.

en: How can you undertake such obligations so heedlessly, Sofya Semyonovna?
uz: Qanday qilib siz bunday majburiyatlarni shunchalik beparvolik bilan o'z zimmasiga olyapsiz, Sofiya Semyonovna?

en: It was Katerina Ivanovna’s debt and not yours, so you ought not to have taken any notice of the German woman.
uz: Bu sizning emas, Katerina Ivanovnaning qarzi edi, shuning uchun nemis ayolga hech qanday e'tibor bermasligingiz kerak edi.

en: You can’t get through the world like that.
uz: Dunyoda bunday yo'l tutish mumkin emas.

en: If you are ever questioned about me —tomorrow or the day after you will be asked —don’t say anything about my coming to see you now and don’t show the money to anyone or say a word about it.
uz: Agar sizni ertaga yoki ertangi kuni men haqimda so'ragan bo'lsalar, hozir sizni ko'rish uchun kelganim haqida hech narsa aytmang va pulni hech kimga ko'rsatmang yoki bu haqda bir so'z aytmang.

en: Well, now goodbye.” (He got up.) “My greetings to Rodion Romanovitch.
uz: Xo'sh, endi salom. (U turdi.) Rodion Romanovitchga salomlarimni aytaman.

en: By the way, you’d better put the money for the present in Mr.
uz: Aytgancha, hozirgi vaqt uchun pulni Mr.ga qo'yish yaxshiroqdir.

en: Razumihin’s keeping.
uz: Razumihins saqlab qolmoqda.

en: He’s not a bad fellow.
uz: U yomon odam emas.

en: Take it to him tomorrow or … when the time comes.
uz: Uni ertaga yoki ... vaqti kelganda unga olib boring.

en: And till then, hide it carefully.” Sonia too jumped up from her chair and looked in dismay at Svidrigaïlov.
uz: O'sha paytgacha buni ehtiyotkorlik bilan yashiring. Sonia ham o'z o'rindiqidan chiqib, Svidrigailovga dahshatli ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: She longed to speak, to ask a question, but for the first moments she did not dare and did not know how to begin.
uz: U gapirishni, savol berishni orzu qilardi, lekin birinchi paytlarda unga jasorat va qanday boshlash kerakligini bilmasdi.

en: “How can you … how can you be going now, in such rain?” “Why, be starting for America, and be stopped by rain!
uz: Siz qanday qilib ... qanday qilib hozir bunday yomg'ir ostida yurishingiz mumkin?  Nima uchun, Amerikaga boshlash va yomg'ir tomonidan to'xtatish mumkin!

en: Goodbye, Sofya Semyonovna, my dear!
uz: Xo'sh, Sofya Semyonovna, aziz!

en: Live and live long, you will be of use to others.
uz: Hayotga ega bo'lib, uzoq umr ko'rsating, boshqalarga foydali bo'lasiz.

en: By the way … tell Mr.
uz: Ayting-chi, ... bu haqda Mr.ga ayting.

en: Razumihin I send my greetings to him.
uz: Razumihin men unga salomlarimni yuboraman.

en: Tell him Arkady Ivanovitch Svidrigaïlov sends his greetings.
uz: Unga Arkady Ivanovitch Svidrigailovning salomlarini ayting.

en: He went out, leaving Sonia in a state of wondering anxiety and vague apprehension.
uz: U tashqariga chiqdi va Soniyani tashvishlanib, tashvishlanib, noaniq qo'rquvda qoldirdi.

en: It appeared afterwards that on the same evening, at twenty past eleven, he made another very eccentric and unexpected visit.
uz: Keyinchalik, o'sha kechqurun, soat yigirma birda, u yana bir ajoyib va kutilmagan tashrif buyurdi.

en: The rain still persisted.
uz: Yomg'ir hali ham davom etdi.

en: Drenched to the skin, he walked into the little flat where the parents of his betrothed lived, in Third Street in Vassilyevsky Island.
uz: O'z joniga cho'kkan u, Vassilyevskiy orolining uchinchi ko'chasidagi uchinchi ko'cha bo'ylab, uning kelinining ota-onasi yashaydigan kichkina xonadonga kirdi.

en: He knocked some time before he was admitted, and his visit at first caused great perturbation; but Svidrigaïlov could be very fascinating when he liked, so that the first, and indeed very intelligent surmise of the sensible parents that Svidrigaïlov had probably had so much to drink that he did not know what he was doing vanished immediately.
uz: U qabul qilinishidan oldin bir muncha vaqt taqillatibdi va uning tashrifi boshida katta tashvishga sabab bo'ldi; lekin Svidrigailov xohlagan vaqtda juda qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun Svidrigailovning o'zi nima qilayotganini bilmaydigan darajada ko'p ichganligi haqidagi aqlli ota-onasining birinchi, haqiqatan ham juda aqlli taxminlari darhol yo'qoldi.

en: The decrepit father was wheeled in to see Svidrigaïlov by the tender and sensible mother, who as usual began the conversation with various irrelevant questions.
uz: Oʻtmishdagi ota Svidrigailovni koʻrish uchun mehribon va aqlli ona tomonidan olib borildi, u, odatdagidek, suhbatni turli xil ahamiyatsiz savollar bilan boshladi.

en: She never asked a direct question, but began by smiling and rubbing her hands and then, if she were obliged to ascertain something —for instance, when Svidrigaïlov would like to have the wedding —she would begin by interested and almost eager questions about Paris and the court life there, and only by degrees brought the conversation round to Third Street.
uz: U hech qachon to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol bermagan, lekin boshida tabassum qilib, qo'llarini aralashtirgan va keyin, agar u biror narsa bilishga majbur bo'lsa, masalan, Svidrigailov to'y o'tkazishni xohlaganida, Parij va u yerdagi hovli hayot haqida qiziqarli va deyarli qiziqarli savollar bilan boshlanadi va faqat asta-sekin suhbatni uchinchi ko'chaga olib keladi.

en: On other occasions this had of course been very impressive, but this time Arkady Ivanovitch seemed particularly impatient, and insisted on seeing his betrothed at once, though he had been informed, to begin with, that she had already gone to bed.
uz: Boshqa paytlarda bu, albatta, juda ta'sirli edi, ammo bu safar Arkady Ivanovitch ayniqsa sabrsizlikda ko'rindi va u qizning allaqachon uxlab ketgani haqida xabardor qilingan bo'lsa-da, u qizni darhol ko'rishni istaydi.

en: The girl of course appeared.
uz: Shubhasiz, qiz paydo bo'ldi.

en: Svidrigaïlov informed her at once that he was obliged by very important affairs to leave Petersburg for a time, and therefore brought her fifteen thousand roubles and begged her accept them as a present from him, as he had long been intending to make her this trifling present before their wedding.
uz: Svidrigailov unga darhol muhim ishlarga ko'ra bir muddatga Sankt-Peterburgdan ketishga majbur bo'lganini aytdi va shuning uchun u ayolga o'n besh ming rubl olib keldi va undan ularni sovg'a sifatida qabul qilishni iltimos qildi, chunki u uzoq vaqtdan beri ular to'yidan oldin unga bu kichik sovg'ani berishni rejalashtirgan edi.

en: The logical connection of the present with his immediate departure and the absolute necessity of visiting them for that purpose in pouring rain at midnight was not made clear.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtning o'zidan-o'zidan ketishi bilan mantiqiy aloqasi va kechqurun tushayotgan yomg'ir paytida ularni bu maqsad uchun tashrif buyurishning mutlaqo zarurligi aniq ko'rsatilmagan.

en: But it all went off very well; even the inevitable ejaculations of wonder and regret, the inevitable questions were extraordinarily few and restrained.
uz: Ammo hamma narsa juda yaxshi o'tdi; hatto hayronlik va afsusning oldini olish mumkin bo'lgan echimlari ham, oldini olish mumkin bo'lmagan savollar ham juda kam va cheklangan edi.

en: On the other hand, the gratitude expressed was most glowing and was reinforced by tears from the most sensible of mothers.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, minnatdorchilik izhorlari eng yorqin edi va eng aqlli onalarning ko'z yoshlari uni mustahkamladi.

en: Svidrigaïlov got up, laughed, kissed his betrothed, patted her cheek, declared he would soon come back,
uz: Svidrigailov o'rnidan turib, kulishdi, qizini o'pdilar, uning tungiga taqillatdilar va tez orada qaytib kelishini e'lon qildilar.

en: and noticing in her eyes, together with childish curiosity, a sort of earnest dumb inquiry, reflected and kissed her again, though he felt sincere anger inwardly at the thought that his present would be immediately locked up in the keeping of the most sensible of mothers.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida bolalik qiziqishi bilan birga, samimiy va soqov so'rovlar ko'rinishini ko'rib, u yana o'zini o'ylab, o'pdi, ammo u o'z hozirgi sovg'asini eng aqlli onalar qaramog'ida tutib qo'yishi haqida o'ylaganida ichidan g'azabni his qildi.

en: He went away, leaving them all in a state of extraordinary excitement, but the tender mamma, speaking quietly in a half whisper, settled some of the most important of their doubts, concluding that Svidrigaïlov was a great man, a man of great affairs and connections and of great wealth —there was no knowing what he had in his mind.
uz: U ketib, ularning barchasini g'ayratli holatda qoldirdi, lekin mehribon onasi o'rta bir shvashda xotirjamlik bilan gapirib, Svidrigailovning buyuk inson, katta ishlar va aloqalar bilan shug'ullanadigan va boylik bilan shug'ullanadigan kishi ekanligini tushunib, ularning eng muhim shubhalaridan ba'zilarini hal qildi.

en: He would start off on a journey and give away money just as the fancy took him, so that there was nothing surprising about it.
uz: U sayohatni boshlaydi va o'ziga o'xshaydigan pulni o'ziga qaytarib berardi, shuning uchun bu erda hech qanday ajablanarli narsa yo'q edi.

en: Of course it was strange that he was wet through, but Englishmen, for instance, are even more eccentric, and all these people of high society didn’t think of what was said of them and didn’t stand on ceremony.
uz: Albatta, uning ishlanganligi g'alati edi, ammo inglizlar, masalan, yanada eksentrikroq bo'lishadi va barcha yuqori darajadagi odamlar ular haqida nima deyilganini o'ylamaydilar va marosimlarda turmaydilar.

en: Possibly, indeed, he came like that on purpose to show that he was not afraid of anyone.
uz: Ehtimol, u hech kimdan qo'rqmasligini ko'rsatish uchun qasddan shunday keldi.

en: Above all, not a word should be said about it, for God knows what might come of it, and the money must be locked up, and it was most fortunate that Fedosya, the cook, had not left the kitchen.
uz: Eng asosiysi, bu haqda hech narsa aytish kerak emas, chunki Xudo nima bo'lishini biladi va pulni qulflab qo'yish kerak va mehribon oshpaz Fedosya oshxonadan chiqib ketmagan.

en: And above all not a word must be said to that old cat, Madame Resslich, and so on and so on.
uz: Eng asosiysi esa, bu keksa mushukga hech qanday so'z aytish kerak emas, xonim Resslich va hokazo.

en: They sat up whispering till two o’clock, but the girl went to bed much earlier, amazed and rather sorrowful.
uz: Ular soat ikkigacha shoshib o'tirdilar, lekin qiz ancha oldin, hayron va juda qayg'urgan holda uxlab ketdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov meanwhile, exactly at midnight, crossed the bridge on the way back to the mainland.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Svidrigailov, to'g'ri yarim kechada, qirg'oqqa qaytib borayotganda ko'prikni kesib o'tdi.

en: The rain had ceased and there was a roaring wind.
uz: Yomg'ir to'xtadi va kuchli shamol bor edi.

en: He began shivering, and for one moment he gazed at the black waters of the Little Neva with a look of special interest, even inquiry.
uz: U titra boshladi va bir daqiqa davomida kichik Nevaning qora suvlariga alohida qiziqish bilan qaradi, hatto so'rov qiladi.

en: But he soon felt it very cold, standing by the water; he turned and went towards Y — — Prospect.
uz: Ammo u tez orada suv yonida turganida juda sovuq bo'lganini his qildi; o'girilib, Y istiqbolga bordi.

en: He walked along that endless street for a long time, almost half an hour, more than once stumbling in the dark on the wooden pavement, but continually looking for something on the right side of the street.
uz: U uzoq vaqt davomida, deyarli yarim soat davomida, o'tkir yo'l bo'ylab yurgan, bir necha marta qorong'ilikda yog'och piyoda to'xtab qolgan, ammo doimo yo'lning o'ng tomonida biror narsani izlagan.

en: He had noticed passing through this street lately that there was a hotel somewhere towards the end, built of wood, but fairly large, and its name he remembered was something like Adrianople.
uz: U so'nggi paytlarda bu ko'cha orqali o'tib ketayotganida, uning oxirida o'tdan qurilgan, ammo juda katta bir mehmonxona borligini va uning nomi Adrianopl kabi ekanligini payqadi.

en: He was not mistaken: the hotel was so conspicuous in that Godforsaken place that he could not fail to see it even in the dark.
uz: U noto'g'ri fikrda edi: mehmonxona o'sha Xudo tomonidan tark etilgan joyda shunchalik ko'rinardiki, hatto qorong'ilikda ham uni ko'rishga qodir edi.

en: It was a long, blackened wooden building, and in spite of the late hour there were lights in the
uz: Bu uzun, qora bo'lgan yog'och bino edi va kechki soatga qaramay, u yerda yorug'lik bor edi.

en: windows and signs of life within.
uz: Oynalar va ichkaridagi hayot belgilari.

en: He went in and asked a ragged fellow who met him in the corridor for a room.
uz: U kirdi va koridorda uchrashgan bir yigitdan xonani so'radi.

en: The latter, scanning Svidrigaïlov, pulled himself together and led him at once to a close and tiny room in the distance, at the end of the corridor, under the stairs.
uz: Shundan keyin Svidrigailovni skanerlab, o'zini yig'ib oldi va uni darhol yo'lga olib, yo'lning oxirida, narvonchalar ostiga, uzoqlikda joylashgan yopilgan va kichik xonaga yetakladi.

en: There was no other, all were occupied.
uz: Boshqa hech kim yo'q edi, hammasi mashg'ul bo'lgan.

en: The ragged fellow looked inquiringly.
uz: Yovuz yigit savol-javob bilan qaradi.

en: “Is there tea?” asked Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Is there tea? so'radi Svidrigailov.

en: “Yes, sir.” “What else is there?” “Veal, vodka, savouries.” “Bring me tea and veal.” “And you want nothing else?” he asked with apparent surprise.
uz: Ha, xo'jayinim.  Boshqa nima bor?   Idish, vodka, go'shtlar.  Menga choy va idish olib keling.  Va siz boshqa hech narsa xohlamaysiz? deb so'radi u ko'rinadigan hayratda.

en: “Nothing, nothing.” The ragged man went away, completely disillusioned.
uz: Hech narsa, hech narsa emas. Yovuz odam butunlay tushkunlikka tushib, ketib ketdi.

en: “It must be a nice place,” thought Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Bu chiroyli joy bo'lishi kerak, deb o'yladi Svidrigailov.

en: “How was it I didn’t know it?
uz: Qanday qilib men buni bilmasdim?

en: I expect I look as if I came from a café chantant and have had some adventure on the way.
uz: O'ylaymanki, men kafedraning qahramonidan kelib, yo'lda biroz mashg'ul bo'lganim kabi ko'rinaman.

en: It would be interesting to know who stayed here?” He lighted the candle and looked at the room more carefully.
uz: Bu yerda kim qolishini bilish qiziqarli bo'ladi? U shamolni yoqib, xonani ko'proq diqqat bilan ko'rdi.

en: It was a room so low-pitched that Svidrigaïlov could only just stand up in it; it had one window; the bed, which was very dirty, and the plain- stained chair and table almost filled it up.
uz: Bu o'rin shunchalik kam bo'lganki, Svidrigailov o'sha xonada o'rnidan turib o'tirishi mumkin edi; u bitta derazaga ega edi; yotoq juda kirli edi va oddiy rangli o'rindiq va stol deyarli uni to'ldirardi.

en: The walls looked as though they were made of planks, covered with shabby paper, so torn and dusty that the pattern was indistinguishable, though the general colour —yellow —could still be made out.
uz: Devorlar taxtalardan yasalgan bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi, bu qog'ozlar o'z-o'zidan qoplangan, shunchalik charchagan va changli bo'lganki, namuna aniqlanmagan edi, ammo umumiy rang sarg'u o'rinadi.

en: One of the walls was cut short by the sloping ceiling, though the room was not an attic but just under the stairs.
uz: Devorlarning biri baland sotuv bilan qisqartirilgan bo'lsa-da, xonadon chekkasi emas edi, balki qadamlar ostida edi.

en: Svidrigaïlov set down the candle, sat down on the bed and sank into thought.
uz: Svidrigailov shamolni yoqib, to'shagida o'tirib, fikrga tushib ketdi.

en: But a strange persistent murmur which sometimes rose to a shout in the next room attracted his attention.
uz: Ammo ba'zan yonidagi xonada qichqiriqga aylangan g'alati, doimiy g'iybat uning e'tiborini jalb qildi.

en: The murmur had not ceased from the moment he entered the room.
uz: U xonadonga kirgan paytdan boshlab g'iybatlar to'xtamaydi.

en: He listened: someone was upbraiding and almost tearfully scolding, but he heard only one voice.
uz: U tinglagan: kimdir uni tanqid qilib, deyarli ko'z yoshlari bilan tanqid qilmoqda, lekin u faqat bitta ovozni eshitadi.

en: Svidrigaïlov got up, shaded the light with his hand and at once he saw light through a crack in the wall; he went up and peeped through.
uz: Svidrigailov o'rnidan turib, qo'li bilan nurni soyaladi va darhol devordagi bo'g'rilik orqali yorug'likni ko'rdi.

en: The room, which was somewhat larger than his, had two occupants.
uz: Xonasi undan biroz kattaroq bo'lgan xonada ikki kishi bo'lgan.

en: One of them, a very curly-headed man with a red
uz: Ulardan biri, qizil kiyimli, juda qalin boshli kishi edi.

en: inflamed face, was standing in the pose of an orator, without his coat, with his legs wide apart to preserve his balance, and smiting himself on the breast.
uz: O'z yuzini puflagan, orator kabi ko'rinishda, kiyimsiz, oyoqlari muvozanatni saqlab qolish uchun keng bo'lgan holda turib, ko'krakga urib o'zini urgan edi.

en: He reproached the other with being a beggar, with having no standing whatever.
uz: U o'g'lini so'rab, so'zsiz, so'zsiz deb tanqid qildi.

en: He declared that he had taken the other out of the gutter and he could turn him out when he liked, and that only the finger of Providence sees it all.
uz: U o'sha odamni qo'lga olib, xohlagan vaqtda uni tashlab ketishi mumkinligini va faqatgina Parvardigorning barmog'i hamma narsani ko'rayotganini aytdi.

en: The object of his reproaches was sitting in a chair, and had the air of a man who wants dreadfully to sneeze, but can’t.
uz: Uning tanqid qilinayotgan narsasi o'rindiqda o'tirgan edi va bu odamning o'ziga o'xshaydi, lekin o'tirolmaydi.

en: He sometimes turned sheepish and befogged eyes on the speaker, but obviously had not the slightest idea what he was talking about and scarcely heard it.
uz: U ba'zan qo'ylak bo'lib, ko'zlarini so'zlovchiga tikardi, ammo u nima haqida gapirayotganini anglamay, uni kamdan-kam eshitgan edi.

en: A candle was burning down on the table; there were wineglasses, a nearly empty bottle of vodka, bread and cucumber, and glasses with the dregs of stale tea.
uz: Ishxonada shamol yonayotgan edi; sharob shishalari, vodka, non va timisoqning deyarli bo'sh shisha shishalari va eski choyning cho'g'lari bo'lgan shishalar bor edi.

en: After gazing attentively at this, Svidrigaïlov turned away indifferently and sat down on the bed.
uz: Bu holatga diqqat bilan qaragan Svidrigailov befarqlik bilan yuz o'girib, yotoqqa o'tirdi.

en: The ragged attendant, returning with the tea, could not resist asking him again whether he didn’t want anything more, and again receiving a negative reply, finally withdrew.
uz: Chay bilan qaytib kelayotgan g'azabga to'lgan xizmatkor yana bir bor undan yana biron narsa istamasligini so'rashdan bosh tortolmadi va yana salbiy javob olganidan so'ng, nihoyat, orqaga chiqdi.

en: Svidrigaïlov made haste to drink a glass of tea to warm himself, but could not eat anything.
uz: Svidrigailov o'zini isitish uchun bir stakan choy ichishga shoshdi, ammo hech narsa yemadi.

en: He began to feel feverish.
uz: U o'zini issiq his qila boshladi.

en: He took off his coat and, wrapping himself in the blanket, lay down on the bed.
uz: U kiyimini olib, qopqonga o'zini o'rab, yotoq ustiga yotdi.

en: “It would have been better to be well for the occasion,” he thought with a smile.
uz: Bu hodisa uchun yaxshi bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak edi, deb o'yladi u tabassum bilan.

en: The room was close, the candle burnt dimly, the wind was roaring outside, he heard a mouse scratching in the corner and the room smelt of mice and of leather.
uz: Xona yaqin edi, shamol chiroyli yonardi, shamol tashqariga shov-shuv qilar edi, u burchada egri qichqirganini eshitdi va xonadon egri va charm hidini his qilar edi.

en: He lay in a sort of reverie: one thought followed another.
uz: U o'ziga o'xshaydigan bir holatda o'tirgan: bir fikr boshqa fikrdan ketadi.

en: He felt a longing to fix his imagination on something.
uz: U o'z tasavvurini biror narsaga qaratish istagini uyg'otdi.

en: “It must be a garden under the window,” he thought.
uz: U o'ylaganidek, o'sha do'zax ostida bog' bo'lishi kerak.

en: “There’s a sound of trees.
uz: Daraxtlarning ovozi eshitilmoqda.

en: How I dislike the sound of trees on a stormy night, in the dark!
uz: To'fonli kechada qorong'ilikda daraxtlarning tovushidan nafratlanaman!

en: They give one a horrid feeling.” He remembered how he had disliked it when he passed Petrovsky Park just now.
uz: Ular odamga dahshatli his-tuyg'u beradi. U Petrovskiy bog'idan o'tib ketayotganida, unga yoqmaganini esladi.

en: This reminded him of the bridge over the Little Neva and he felt cold again as he had when standing there.
uz: Bu unga Kichik Neva ko'prining eslatishini eslatdi va u erda turganida o'zini sovuq his qilganidek, yana sovuq his qildi.

en: “I never have liked water,” he thought, “even in a landscape,” and he suddenly smiled again at a strange idea: “Surely now all these questions of taste and comfort ought not to matter, but I’ve become more particular, like an animal that picks out a special place … for such an occasion.
uz: "Men hech qachon suvni yoqtirmaganman", - deb o'yladi u, hatto landshaftda ham, - va birdan o'zgacha fikrga yana tabassum qildi: "Haqiqatan ham, hozir bu barcha ta'minot va qulaylik masalalari ahamiyatsiz bo'lishi kerak, lekin men o'zimni yanada aniqroq his qildim, xuddi bunday vaziyatga alohida joy tanlagan hayvon kabi.

en: I ought to have gone into the Petrovsky Park!
uz: Men Petrovskiy bog'iga borishim kerak edi!

en: I suppose it seemed dark, cold, ha-ha!
uz: O'ylaymanki, u qorong'u, sovuq, ha-ha kabi ko'rinardi!

en: As though I were seeking pleasant sensations!
uz: Men yoqimli his-tuyg'ularni izlayotganimdek bo'ldim!

en: way, why haven’t I put out the candle?” he blew it out.
uz: Yo'q, nega men shamolni o'chirib qo'ymaganman?

en: “They’ve gone to bed next door,” he thought, not seeing the light at the crack.
uz: Ular qo'shni uyga ketishdi, deb o'yladi u, bu yerda yorug'likni ko'rmay.

en: “Well, now, Marfa Petrovna, now is the time for you to turn up; it’s dark, and the very time and place for you.
uz: Xo'sh, Marfa Petrovna, hozir sen ko'tarilishing vaqti keldi; qorong'ilik bor va bu sen uchun o'ta qulay vaqt va joy.

en: But now you won’t come!” He suddenly recalled how, an hour before carrying out his design on Dounia, he had recommended Raskolnikov to trust her to Razumihin’s keeping.
uz: Ammo endi kelmaysan! U to'satdan Duniyada loyihasini amalga oshirishdan bir soat oldin Raskolnikovga uni Razumihinning ustiga qo'yishni tavsiya qilganini esladi.

en: “I suppose I really did say it, as Raskolnikov guessed, to tease myself.
uz: Raskolnikov o'ylagandek, men buni o'zimni masxara qilish uchun aytdim.

en: But what a rogue that Raskolnikov is!
uz: Ammo Raskolnikov naqadar yovuz odam!

en: He’s gone through a good deal.
uz: U juda yaxshi ishlardan o'tgan.

en: He may be a successful rogue in time when he’s got over his nonsense.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, u o'z g'alati gaplarini o'ylab topganida, muvaffaqiyatli qotil bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But now he’s too eager for life.
uz: Ammo hozir u hayotga juda tayyor.

en: These young men are contemptible on that point.
uz: Bu yigitlar bu nuqtai nazardan nafratlanarli.

en: But, hang the fellow!
uz: Ammo, u kishini o'tkirlab qo'yinglar!

en: Let him please himself, it’s nothing to do with me.” He could not get to sleep.
uz: O'zini mamnun qilsin, bu men bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q.U uxlay olmagan.

en: By degrees Dounia’s image rose before him, and a shudder ran over him.
uz: Dounia tasavvurining ko'tarilishi uning oldidan o'sib bordi va u titrash bilan o'zini o'rab oldi.

en: “No, I must give up all that now,” he thought, rousing himself.
uz: "Yo'q, men hozir bularning barchasidan voz kechishim kerak", - deb o'yladi u o'zini uyg'otib.

en: “I must think of something else.
uz: Men boshqa narsani o'ylashim kerak.

en: It’s queer and funny.
uz: Bu g'alati va qiziqarli.

en: I never had a great hatred for anyone, I never particularly desired to avenge myself even, and that’s a bad sign, a bad sign, a bad sign.
uz: Men hech qachon hech kimdan nafratlanmaganman, hatto o'zimdan qasos olishni ham xohlamaganman va bu yomon belgi, yomon belgi, yomon belgi.

en: I never liked quarrelling either, and never lost my temper — that’s a bad sign too.
uz: Men ham bahslashishni yoqtirmaganman va hech qachon g'azabimni yo'qotmaganman.

en: And the promises I made her just now, too — Damnation!
uz: Va men hozir unga bergan va'dalar ham shunday!

en: —perhaps she would have made a new man of me somehow.
uz: boshqacha u meni yangi odamga aylantirishi mumkin edi.

en: …” He ground his teeth and sank into silence again.
uz: ... U tishlarini teshirdi va yana xotirjamlikka tushdi.

en: Again Dounia’s image rose before him, just as she was when, after shooting the first time, she had lowered the revolver in terror and gazed blankly at him, so that he might have seized her twice over and she would not have lifted a hand to defend herself if he had not reminded her.
uz: Dounia'ning tasviri uning oldida o'sib turardi, xuddi birinchi marta o'qiganidan so'ng, u qorong'ilik bilan pulimizni pastga tushirib, unga ko'z tikib qaraganida edi, ehtimol u uni ikki marta qo'lga olgan bo'lishi mumkin edi va agar u unga eslatmagan bo'lsa, u o'zini himoya qilish uchun qo'lini ko'tarmagan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: He recalled how at that instant he felt almost sorry for her, how he had felt a pang at his heart … “Aïe!
uz: U o'sha daqiqada u uchun deyarli xafa bo'lganini, yuragidagi og'riqlarni eslab qoldi.

en: Damnation, these thoughts again!
uz: Chindan ham, yana o'sha fikrlar!

en: I must put it away!” He was dozing off; the feverish shiver had ceased, when suddenly something seemed to run over his arm and leg under the bedclothes.
uz: Uni qo'yib qo'yishim kerak! U uxlab yotgan edi; og'ir dard o'tib ketgan edi, to'satdan uning qo'li va oyoqlari ostida bir narsa o'tib ketayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: I believe it’s a mouse,” he thought, “that’s the veal I left on the table.” He felt fearfully disinclined to pull off the blanket, get up, get cold, but all at once something unpleasant ran over his leg again.
uz: O'zi o'ylaganidek, bu tovuq, bu men stol ustida qoldirgan buzoq.U qo'rqqancha qopqog'ini olib tashlashga, turishga, sovuqga tushishga moyil emas edi, lekin birdan yana uning oyoqidan yoqimsiz narsa o'tdi.

en: He pulled off the blanket and lighted the candle.
uz: U qopqog'ini olib, chiroqni yoqdi.

en: Shaking with feverish chill he bent down to examine the bed: there was nothing.
uz: Issiqdan titrab, o'z yotoqini tekshirib ko'rish uchun egildi: hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: He shook the blanket and suddenly a mouse jumped
uz: U qopqog'ini silkitdi va to'satdan tovuq ko'tarildi.

en: He tried to catch it, but the mouse ran to and fro in zigzags without leaving the bed, slipped between his fingers, ran over his hand and suddenly darted under the pillow.
uz: U uni ushlab turishga harakat qildi, lekin tovuq to'shagidan chiqib ketmasdan zigzaglar bilan bir-biriga yugurdi, barmoqlari orasidan o'tib ketdi, qo'lini o'tib ketdi va birdan yostiq ostiga tushdi.

en: He threw down the pillow, but in one instant felt something leap on his chest and dart over his body and down his back under his shirt.
uz: U yostiqni tashladi, lekin bir lahzada ko'krakidan bir narsa o'tgani va uning tanasi ustiga o'tgani va ko'ylak ostida orqaga tushgani his qilindi.

en: He trembled nervously and woke up.
uz: U g'azabdan titrab uyg'ondi.

en: He was lying on the bed and wrapped up in the blanket as before.
uz: U o'z yotoqida, avvalgidek, qopqonga o'girib yotgan edi.

en: The wind was howling under the window.
uz: Oyna ostida shamol qichqirib turardi.

en: “How disgusting,” he thought with annoyance.
uz: Qanday jirkanch, - deb o'yladi u xafa bo'lib.

en: He got up and sat on the edge of the bedstead with his back to the window.
uz: U o'rnidan turib, o'z orqasini oynasiga qaratib, yotoq yonida o'tirdi.

en: “It’s better not to sleep at all,” he decided.
uz: U o'zi qaror qildi: "O'z uyquda bo'lmaslik yaxshiroqdir.

en: There was a cold damp draught from the window, however; without getting up he drew the blanket over him and wrapped himself in it.
uz: Biroq, darcha ustida sovuq suyuq suv ko'tarib turardi; u turmasdan, o'ziga yopiq kiyimni ko'tarib, unga o'zini o'rab olgan.

en: He was not thinking of anything and did not want to think.
uz: U hech narsa haqida o'ylamagan va o'ylashni xohlamagan.

en: But one image rose after another, incoherent scraps of thought without beginning or end passed through his mind.
uz: Ammo bir tasavvurning ortidan boshqa tasavvur ko'tarildi, uning ongidan boshlanish va oxiratsiz fikrlar o'tib ketdi.

en: He sank into drowsiness.
uz: U uyqusizlikka tushdi.

en: Perhaps the cold, or the dampness, or the dark, or the wind that howled under the window and tossed the trees roused a sort of persistent craving for the fantastic.
uz: Ehtimol, sovuq, namlik, qorong'ilik yoki oyna ostidan qichqiriq va daraxtlarni tashlab ketayotgan shamol ajoyib narsalarga bo'lgan doimiy istakni uyg'otgandir.

en: He kept dwelling on images of flowers, he fancied a charming flower garden, a bright, warm, almost hot day, a holiday — Trinity day.
uz: U gullarning tasvirlari bilan mulohaza yuritib, chiroyli gul bog'ini, yorqin, iliq, deyarli issiq kun, ta'til - uchlik kunini tasavvur qildi.

en: A fine, sumptuous country cottage in the English taste overgrown with fragrant flowers, with flower beds going round the house; the porch, wreathed in climbers, was surrounded with beds of roses.
uz: Inglizcha rangli, chiroyli qishloq uyasi, xushbo'y gullar bilan to'lib-toshgan, uy atrofida gullar to'plari bor edi; tog'lar bilan to'plangan chekkasi gullar to'plari bilan o'rab-o'rab olingan.

en: A light, cool staircase, carpeted with rich rugs, was decorated with rare plants in china pots.
uz: Yengil, sovuq, boy cho'g'lar bilan cho'tkalab qo'yilgan poygacha chiroyli o'simliklar bilan chiroyli qurilgan.

en: He noticed particularly in the windows nosegays of tender, white, heavily fragrant narcissus bending over their bright, green, thick long stalks.
uz: Ayniqsa, u oynalarda o'zlarining yorqin, yashil, qalin uzun bo'g'inlari ustida egri, oq, qattiq xushbo'y narkisslarning burchaklarini ko'rdi.

en: He was reluctant to move away from them, but he went up the stairs and came into a large, high drawing-room and again everywhere —at the windows, the doors on to the balcony, and on the balcony itself —were flowers.
uz: U ulardan uzoqlashishga xohlamagan edi, lekin ustiga ko'tarildi va katta, baland bir turar joyga va yana hamma joyga kirdi oynaklarda, balkonga eshiklarda va balkonning o'zida gullar bor edi.

en: The floors were strewn with freshly-cut fragrant hay, the windows were open, a fresh, cool, light air came into the room.
uz: Yotoqlar yangi kesilgan xushbo'y hay bilan to'ldirilgan edi, derazalar ochiq edi, yangi, sovuq, yorug' havo xonadonga kirib keldi.

en: The birds were chirruping under the window, and in the middle of the room, on a table covered with a white satin shroud, stood a coffin.
uz: Qushlar darcha ostida qichqirishardi va xonaning o'rtasida oq satin qopqoq bilan qoplangan stol ustida quti turgan edi.

en: The coffin was covered with white silk and edged with a thick white frill; wreaths of flowers surrounded it on all sides.
uz: Qovush oq ipak bilan qoplangan va qo'llari bo'g'im oq bo'lak bilan qoplangan edi; uni har tomondan gullar bag'ridanlar o'rab olgan edi.

en: Among the flowers lay a girl in a white muslin dress, with her arms crossed and pressed on her bosom, as
uz: Gullar o'rtasida oq muslin kiyim kiygan, qo'llarini o'girgan va ko'kraklariga bosgan qiz o'tirgan edi.

en: though carved out of marble.
uz: Garchi marmordan o'ralgan bo'lsa-da.

en: But her loose fair hair was wet; there was a wreath of roses on her head.
uz: Ammo uning bo'sh sochlari suyuq edi; boshida gullar to'rkasi bor edi.

en: The stern and already rigid profile of her face looked as though chiselled of marble too, and the smile on her pale lips was full of an immense unchildish misery and sorrowful appeal.
uz: Uning qattiq va qatʼiy yuzi ham marmordan yasalgan boʻlgani kabi koʻrinardi va uning sochiq dudaklarida boʻlgan tabassum katta bolasiz qaygʻu va qaygʻuli ilhom bilan toʻlib-toshgan edi.

en: Svidrigaïlov knew that girl; there was no holy image, no burning candle beside the coffin; no sound of prayers: the girl had drowned herself.
uz: Svidrigailov o'sha qizni tanardi; muqaddas tasvir yo'q edi, ko'krak yonayotgan chiroq ham yo'q edi; ibodatlar ham yo'q edi: qiz o'zini g'arq qilgan edi.

en: She was only fourteen, but her heart was broken.
uz: U atigi o'n to'rt yoshda edi, ammo yuragi buzilgan edi.

en: And she had destroyed herself, crushed by an insult that had appalled and amazed that childish soul, had smirched that angel purity with unmerited disgrace and torn from her a last scream of despair, unheeded and brutally disregarded, on a dark night in the cold and wet while the wind howled.
uz: Va u o'zini yo'q qildi, bolalik ruhini dahshatga solgan va hayratda qoldirgan haqoratga tushdi, o'sha farishta pokligini noloyiq sharmandalik bilan o'chirdi va shamol qayg'urgan sovuq va boshoqli bir qorong'u tunda unga e'tibor berilmagan va shafqatsiz ravishda e'tiborsiz qolgan umidsizlikning so'nggi qichqiriqini o'chirdi.

en: … Svidrigaïlov came to himself, got up from the bed and went to the window.
uz: ... Svidrigailov o'ziga kelib, to'shagidan turib, derazaga bordi.

en: He felt for the latch and opened it.
uz: U qulfini sezdi va uni ochdi.

en: The wind lashed furiously into the little room and stung his face and his chest, only covered with his shirt, as though with frost.
uz: Shamol kichkina xonani g'azabga to'kib, uning yuzini va ko'krakini, xuddi muz bilan qoplangan bo'lsa-da, faqat kiyim bilan qoplab qo'ygan edi.

en: Under the window there must have been something like a garden, and apparently a pleasure garden.
uz: Oyna ostida bog'ga o'xshash narsa bo'lishi kerak edi va, ehtimol, zavq bog'i.

en: There, too, probably there were tea-tables and singing in the daytime.
uz: U yerda ham, ehtimol, kunduzda choy stollari va qo'shiq kuylanardi.

en: Now drops of rain flew in at the window from the trees and bushes; it was dark as in a cellar, so that he could only just make out some dark blurs of objects.
uz: Hozir esa daraxtlar va butalardan yogʻoch tomchilari darvoza tomonga uchib kiribdi; quduqday qorongʻi edi, shuning uchun u faqatgina biron-bir narsalarning qorongʻi koʻrinmasligini koʻra olardi.

en: Svidrigaïlov, bending down with elbows on the windowsill, gazed for five minutes into the darkness; the boom of a cannon, followed by a second one, resounded in the darkness of the night.
uz: Svidrigailov, deraza ustunida qo'lqoplari bilan egrilib, besh daqiqa davomida qorong'ilikka qarab turdi; tunning shovqinini, keyin ikkinchi qo'shinini kecha qorong'iligida eshitdi.

en: The river is overflowing,” he thought.
uz: O'zi o'ylaganidek, daryo to'lib-toshmoqda.

en: “By morning it will be swirling down the street in the lower parts, flooding the basements and cellars.
uz: Ertalab ertalab yo'lning quyi qismlarida buzg'unchilik qilib, sotuvxonalar va hovlilarni suv bilan to'ldiradi.

en: The cellar rats will swim out, and men will curse in the rain and wind as they drag their rubbish to their upper storeys.
uz: Sotuvli podshohlar ichkariga suzishadi va odamlar o'zlarining chiqindilarini yuqori qavatlariga olib ketayotganda yomg'ir va shamolda la'natlaydilar.

en: What time is it now?” And he had hardly thought it when, somewhere near, a clock on the wall, ticking away hurriedly, struck three.
uz: Hozir soat necha? Va u buni o'ylab ko'rmaganda, yaqin joyda devordagi soat shoshilinch o'tib ketib, uchta urdi.

en: It will be light in an hour!
uz: Bir soat ichida yorug'lik bo'ladi!

en: I’ll go out at once straight to the park.
uz: Men darhol to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'ga chiqaman.

en: I’ll choose a great bush there drenched with rain, so that as soon as one’s shoulder touches it, millions of drops drip on one’s head.” He moved away from the window, shut it, lighted the candle, put on his waistcoat, his overcoat and his hat and went out, carrying the candle, into the passage to look for the ragged attendant who would
uz: Men u yerda yomg'ir bilan to'lib-toshgan katta butalarni tanlayman, shunda uning yelkasida millionlab tomirlar boshiga tushib ketadi.U darvozdan uzoqlashdi, uni yopdi, shamolni yondirdi, kiyimini, kiyimini va to'pini kiydirdi va shamolni olib chiqib ketdi.

en: be asleep somewhere in the midst of candle-ends and all sorts of rubbish, to pay him for the room and leave the hotel.
uz: u yerda chiroqlar va har qanday axlatlar orasida uxlab, xonadon uchun pul to'lash va mehmonxonadan chiqib ketish uchun.

en: “It’s the best minute; I couldn’t choose a better.” He walked for some time through a long narrow corridor without finding anyone and was just going to call out, when suddenly in a dark corner between an old cupboard and the door he caught sight of a strange object which seemed to be alive.
uz: Bu eng yaxshi daqiqa; men yaxshiroqni tanlashim mumkin emas. U bir muncha vaqt davomida hech kimni topmay, uzoq tor chodir orqali yurib, shunchaki qo'rqqan edi, lekin to'satdan eski ombor va eshik o'rtasidagi qorong'i burchakda u hayotni ko'rgan g'ayritabiiy narsani ko'rdi.

en: He bent down with the candle and saw a little girl, not more than five years old, shivering and crying, with her clothes as wet as a soaking house-flannel.
uz: U shamol bilan yonib, besh yoshga to'lmagan kichkina qizchani ko'rdi, u titrab yig'lab, kiyimlari suvga cho'kkan uy flaneli kabi suyuq edi.

en: She did not seem afraid of Svidrigaïlov, but looked at him with blank amazement out of her big black eyes.
uz: U Svidrigaylovdan qo'rqmagan, lekin katta qora ko'zlaridan uni bepul hayronlik bilan ko'rgan.

en: Now and then she sobbed as children do when they have been crying a long time, but are beginning to be comforted.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti o'tib, bolalar uzoq vaqt yig'lab yurgan, ammo tasalli topishni boshlaganida, xuddi shunday yig'lab yubordi.

en: The child’s face was pale and tired, she was numb with cold.
uz: Bolaning yuzi yorqin va charchagan bo'lib, sovuqdan befarq edi.

en: “How can she have come here?
uz: Qanday qilib u bu yerga kelgan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: She must have hidden here and not slept all night.” He began questioning her.
uz: U shu yerda yashirinib, butun kecha uxlamagan bo'lishi mumkin. U uni so'roq qilishga boshladi.

en: The child suddenly becoming animated, chattered away in her baby language, something about “mammy” and that “mammy would beat her,” and about some cup that she had “bwoken.” The child chattered on without stopping.
uz: Bola to'satdan jonli bo'lib, chaqaloq tilida gapirgan, mamma va mamma uni urishi haqida gapirgan, mamma va u bwoken qilgan bir kos haqida gapirgan. Bola to'xtamasdan gapirgan.

en: He could only guess from what she said that she was a neglected child, whose mother, probably a drunken cook, in the service of the hotel, whipped and frightened her; that the child had broken a cup of her mother’s and was so frightened that she had run away the evening before, had hidden for a long while somewhere outside in the rain, at last had made her way in here, hidden behind the cupboard and spent the night there, crying and trembling from the damp, the darkness and the fear that she would be badly beaten for it.
uz: Uning so'zlariga ko'ra, u beparvo bo'lgan bola edi, ehtimol uning onasi mehmonxonada mast oshpaz bo'lganida, uni qamchilab qo'yardi; bola onalarining bir kosasini buzgan edi va u shunchalik qo'rqqan ediki, u o'tgan kuni kechqurun qochib ketgan edi, yomg'ir ostida uzoq vaqt yashirinib, nihoyat bu yerga kirib, ombor orqasidan yashirinib, kechasi u yerda o'tkazgan edi, bug'doy, qorong'ilik va u uchun og'ir urib yuborishidan qo'rqqan holda yig'lab-tiribdi.

en: He took her in his arms, went back to his room, sat her on the bed, and began undressing her.
uz: U qizni qo'liga olib, o'z xonasiga qaytdi, uni to'shagida o'tirib qo'ydi va uni kiyimidan chiqarib yuborishni boshladi.

en: The torn shoes which she had on her stockingless feet were as wet as if they had been standing in a puddle all night.
uz: O'zining choriqsiz oyoqlarida bo'lgan yirtilgan poyabzallari butun kecha pudda ichida turgan kabi suyuq edi.

en: When he had undressed her, he put her on the bed, covered her up and wrapped her in the blanket from her head downwards.
uz: Uni kiyimidan chiqarib tashlaganidan so'ng, uni yotoqqa qo'ydi, o'zini qopladi va boshidan pastga qopqoqqa o'rab oldi.

en: She fell asleep at once.
uz: U darhol uxlab ketdi.

en: Then he sank into dreary musing again.
uz: Keyin u yana bir bor g'alati mulohazalarga berilib ketdi.

en: “What folly to trouble myself,” he decided suddenly with an oppressive feeling of annoyance.
uz: O'zimni bezovta qilish qanday ahmoqlik edi, - deb o'yladi u, to'satdan g'azablangan hissiyot bilan.

en: “What idiocy!” In vexation he took up the candle to go and look for the ragged attendant again and make haste to go away.
uz: Qanday axmoqlik! U xafa bo'lib, shamolni olib, yana bir bor bo'lak-bo'lak xizmatkorni izlab, darhol ketishga shoshdi.

en: “Damn the child!” he thought as he opened
uz: Xotin o'g'liga yomonlik bo'lsin! deb o'yladi u ochib o'tirganida

en: the door, but he turned again to see whether the child was asleep.
uz: Eshikdan chiqib, bola uxlayotgan-turmaganini ko'rish uchun yana bir bor o'girilibdi.

en: He raised the blanket carefully.
uz: U yopiqni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tardi.

en: The child was sleeping soundly, she had got warm under the blanket, and her pale cheeks were flushed.
uz: Bola yaxshi uxlagan, cho'tka ostida issiq bo'lgan va uning bo'lak-bo'laklari qizg'in bo'lgan.

en: But strange to say that flush seemed brighter and coarser than the rosy cheeks of childhood.
uz: Ammo shu flush bolalikdagi gullab-yashnagan yig'ilishga qaraganda ko'proq yorqin va qo'pol ko'rinardi.

en: “It’s a flush of fever,” thought Svidrigaïlov.
uz: "Bu issiqning o'tishi", - deb o'yladi Svidrigailov.

en: It was like the flush from drinking, as though she had been given a full glass to drink.
uz: U ichib o'tirgan suvga o'xshardi, xuddi unga to'liq shisha berilgan bo'lsa-da.

en: Her crimson lips were hot and glowing; but what was this?
uz: Uning qizil og'izlari issiq va yorqin edi; lekin bu nima edi?

en: He suddenly fancied that her long black eyelashes were quivering, as though the lids were opening and a sly crafty eye peeped out with an unchildlike wink, as though the little girl were not asleep, but pretending.
uz: Birdan u uning uzun qora ko'z burchaklari titrab, qopqog'i ochilgan kabi, kichkina qizcha uxlamagan, balki o'ylayotgan bo'lsa kerak, deb o'ylaydi.

en: Her lips parted in a smile.
uz: Uning og'izlari tabassum bilan ajralib ketdi.

en: The corners of her mouth quivered, as though she were trying to control them.
uz: Uning og'iz burchaklari titrab, xuddi ularni nazorat qilishga harakat qilgandek bo'ldi.

en: But now she quite gave up all effort, now it was a grin, a broad grin; there was something shameless, provocative in that quite unchildish face; it was depravity, it was the face of a harlot, the shameless face of a French harlot.
uz: Ammo hozir u barcha sa'y-harakatlardan voz kechdi, endi bu tabassum, keng tabassum edi; bu juda bolasiz yuzida uyatsiz, provokativ narsa bor edi; bu bu axloqsizlik edi, bu bir fohisha yuzasi edi, bu frantsuz fohisha yuzasi.

en: Now both eyes opened wide; they turned a glowing, shameless glance upon him; they laughed, invited him.
uz: Endi ularning ikkala ko'zi ham keng ochildi; ular unga shinam, o'z-o'zidan xor ko'rinish bilan qarishdi; ular kulishdi va uni taklif qilishdi.

en: … There was something infinitely hideous and shocking in that laugh, in those eyes, in such nastiness in the face of a child.
uz: O'sha kulgi, ko'zlar, bola yuzidagi bunday yomonlik ichida cheksiz dahshatli va dahshatli narsa bor edi.

en: “What, at five years old?” Svidrigaïlov muttered in genuine horror.
uz: Svidrigailov haqiqatan ham dahshatga tushdi.

en: “What does it mean?” And now she turned to him, her little face all aglow, holding out her arms.
uz: Bu nimani anglatadi? Va endi u o'z ko'zidan qizg'in yuzlanib, qo'llarini ko'tarib unga qarab ketdi.

en: … “Accursed child!” Svidrigaïlov cried, raising his hand to strike her, but at that moment he woke up.
uz: La'natlangan bola! Svidrigailov yig'lab, uni urish uchun qo'lini ko'tardi, lekin o'sha paytda u uyg'ondi.

en: He was in the same bed, still wrapped in the blanket.
uz: U bir xil yotoqda edi, hali ham qopqoqqa o'girilgan edi.

en: The candle had not been lighted, and daylight was streaming in at the windows.
uz: Shamol yoqilmagan edi va derazalarda kunduz yorug'ligi oqib turardi.

en: “I’ve had nightmare all night!” He got up angrily, feeling utterly shattered; his bones ached.
uz: Men butun kecha tush ko'rdim! U g'azabga to'lib, o'zini tubdan buzilgan his etib turdi; suyaklari og'riydi.

en: There was a thick mist outside and he could see nothing.
uz: Chindan ham, tashqarida to'siq bulut bor edi va u hech narsa ko'rmasdi.

en: He had overslept himself!
uz: U o'zini sovirib yubordi!

en: He got up, put on his still damp jacket and overcoat.
uz: U o'rnidan turib, hali ham nam kiyimini va kiyimini kiydirdi.

en: Feeling the revolver in his pocket, he took it out and then he sat down, took a notebook out of his pocket and in the most conspicuous place on the title page wrote a few lines in large letters.
uz: O'z pochkasidagi revolverni his etib, uni olib chiqdi va keyin o'tirib, pochkasidan yozuv daftarini olib chiqib, bosh sahifasidagi eng ko'rinadigan joyda katta harflar bilan bir necha satr yozdi.

en: Reading them over, he sank into thought with his elbows on the table.
uz: Ularni o'qib o'tib, o'ylashga tushdi va o'z qo'lqovushlari stol ustida edi.

en: The revolver and the notebook lay beside him.
uz: O'z yonida revolver va yozuvxona yotgan edi.

en: Some flies woke up and settled on the untouched veal, which was still on the table.
uz: Ba'zi cho'g'lar uyg'onib, dasturxon ustida hali ham bo'lgan to'qnashmagan buzoqqa o'tirishdi.

en: He stared at them and at last with his free right hand began trying to catch one.
uz: U ularga tikilib qaradi va nihoyat o'ng qo'li bilan bittasini ushlab olishga harakat qiladi.

en: He tried till he was tired, but could not catch it.
uz: U charchagancha harakat qildi, lekin uni ushlab qololmadi.

en: At last, realising that he was engaged in
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u o'zi bilan shug'ullanayotganini anglab yetdi.

en: this interesting pursuit, he started, got up and walked resolutely out of the room.
uz: Bu qiziqarli mashg'ulot boshlandi, u o'rnidan turib, xonadan qat'iy chiqib ketdi.

en: A thick milky mist hung over the town.
uz: Shaharning ustida katta sutli bulut oshib turardi.

en: Svidrigaïlov walked along the slippery dirty wooden pavement towards the Little Neva.
uz: Svidrigailov o'tkir, kirli yog'och piyoda bo'ylab kichik Neva tomon yurdi.

en: He was picturing the waters of the Little Neva swollen in the night, Petrovsky Island, the wet paths, the wet grass, the wet trees and bushes and at last the bush.
uz: U kechasi puchgan Kichik Nevaning suvlarini, Petrovskiy orollarini, boshoqli yo'llarni, boshoqli o'tlarni, boshoqli daraxtlar va butalarni va nihoyat butalarni tasavvur qilardi.

en: … He began ill-humouredly staring at the houses, trying to think of something else.
uz: ... U o'zgacha fikrlarni o'ylashga harakat qilib, o'sha uylarga g'alati ko'z tikib qaray boshladi.

en: There was not a cabman or a passerby in the street.
uz: Ko'chada taksi haydovchisi ham, yo'lovchi ham yo'q edi.

en: The bright yellow, wooden, little houses looked dirty and dejected with their closed shutters.
uz: Yolg'iz sariq, yog'och, kichkina uylar yopiq shterlari bilan kirli va tushkun ko'rinardi.

en: The cold and damp penetrated his whole body and he began to shiver.
uz: Soyuqlik va namlik uning butun tanasini qamrab oldi va u titra boshladi.

en: From time to time he came across shop signs and read each carefully.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan u do'kon belgilariga duch kelib, har birini diqqat bilan o'qigan.

en: At last he reached the end of the wooden pavement and came to a big stone house.
uz: Nihoyat, u yog'och piyodalarning oxiriga yetib, katta toshli uyga keldi.

en: A dirty, shivering dog crossed his path with its tail between its legs.
uz: Yuzlari o'rtasida quyruq bo'lgan kirli, titragan it uning yo'lini kesib o'tdi.

en: A man in a greatcoat lay face downwards; dead drunk, across the pavement.
uz: Ko'ylak kiyimli bir kishi yuzma-yuz uzilgan edi; o'lik mast, yo'lning o'rtasida.

en: He looked at him and went on.
uz: U unga qaradi va davom etadi.

en: A high tower stood up on the left.
uz: O'ng tomonda baland bir minora ko'tarildi.

en: “Bah!” he shouted, “here is a place.
uz: Bah! u baqirib dedi, bu yerda joy bor.

en: Why should it be Petrovsky?
uz: Nima uchun u Petrovskiy bo'lishi kerak?

en: It will be in the presence of an official witness anyway.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu rasmiy guvohning huzurida bo'ladi.

en: …” He almost smiled at this new thought and turned into the street where there was the big house with the tower.
uz: ... U bu yangi fikrga qariyb tabassum qilib, katta uy va minora joylashgan ko'chaga aylandi.

en: At the great closed gates of the house, a little man stood with his shoulder leaning against them, wrapped in a grey soldier’s coat, with a copper Achilles helmet on his head.
uz: Uyning katta yopiq eshiklarida bir kichkina odam omon qolgani bilan, o'ziga o'xshash bo'lgan, griz askar libosida o'rab olgan va boshida misdan yasalgan Achilles kaskasi bor edi.

en: He cast a drowsy and indifferent glance at Svidrigaïlov.
uz: U Svidrigaylovga uyqu va befarqlik bilan qarashdi.

en: His face wore that perpetual look of peevish dejection, which is so sourly printed on all faces of Jewish race without exception.
uz: Uning yuzida juda qattiq tushkunlik ko'rinishi bor edi, bu juda qizg'incha yahudiylarning barcha yuzlarida hech qanday istisno qilmasdan bosib o'tilgan.

en: They both, Svidrigaïlov and Achilles, stared at each other for a few minutes without speaking.
uz: Ikkalasi ham, Svidrigailov va Axil bir-birlariga bir necha daqiqacha so'zsiz qarab turishdi.

en: At last it struck Achilles as irregular for a man not drunk to be standing three steps from him, staring and not saying a word.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, Achilles mast bo'lmagan kishi uch qadamdan uzoq turgan va bir so'z ham aytmagan holda ko'z o'ngida turgani uchun noaniq bo'lganini ko'rdi.

en: “What do you want here?” he said, without moving or changing his position.
uz: Bu yerda nima istaysiz? - dedi u, ko'chmasdan yoki o'z pozitsiyasini o'zgartirmasdan.

en: “Nothing, brother, good morning,” answered Svidrigaïlov.
uz: Hech narsa, birodarim, salom, Svidrigailov javob berdi.

en: “This isn’t the place.” “I am going to foreign parts, brother.” “To foreign parts?” “To America.”
uz: Bu o'rin emas.  Men chet elga ketyapman, aka.  chet elga?  Amerikaga.

en: “America.” Svidrigaïlov took out the revolver and cocked it.
uz: Amerika. Svidrigailov revolverni olib chiqib, uni o'g'irlab qo'ydi.

en: Achilles raised his eyebrows.
uz: Akil ko'z burchaklarini ko'tardi.

en: “I say, this is not the place for such jokes!” “Why shouldn’t it be the place?” “Because it isn’t.” “Well, brother, I don’t mind that.
uz: Men aytamanki, bu joy bunday kulgilar uchun joy emas! Nega bu joy bo'lmasligi kerak? Chunki u joy emas. Xo'sh, birodar, men bunga qiynalmayman.

en: When you are asked, you just say he was going, he said, to America.” He put the revolver to his right temple.
uz: Sizdan so'rashganda, u Amerikaga ketayotganini aytasiz. U o'ng tomoniga qurol qo'ydi.

en: “You can’t do it here, it’s not the place,” cried Achilles, rousing himself, his eyes growing bigger and bigger.
uz: Siz buni bu yerda qila olmaysiz, bu joy emas, - deb baqirdi Axil, o'zini uyg'otdi va ko'zlari ko'proq va ko'proq ulg'ayib borardi.

en: Svidrigaïlov pulled the trigger.
uz: Svidrigailov o'g'irchoqni chaqirdi.

en: VII The same day, about seven o’clock in the evening, Raskolnikov was on his way to his mother’s and sister’s lodging —the lodging in Bakaleyev’s house which Razumihin had found for them.
uz: O'sha kuni, kechqurun soat yetti atrofida, Raskolnikov onalari va singillari bilan birga bo'lgan Bakaleyevning uyiga borayotgan edi, bu uyda Razumihin ular uchun topgan edi.

en: The stairs went up from the street.
uz: Ko'chadan ustiga qadam bosgan.

en: Raskolnikov walked with lagging steps, as though still hesitating whether to go or not.
uz: Raskolnikov ketish yoki ketmaslik borasida hali ham shubha ostiga qo'ygan bo'lib, orqaga qadam qo'yib yurdi.

en: But nothing would have turned him back: his decision was taken.
uz: Ammo hech narsa uni qaytarib ololmasdi: uning qarori qabul qilingan edi.

en: “Besides, it doesn’t matter, they still know nothing,” he thought, “and they are used to thinking of me as eccentric.” He was appallingly dressed: his clothes torn and dirty, soaked with a night’s rain.
uz: Bundan tashqari, ular hali ham hech narsani bilmaydilar, deb o'yladi u, va ular meni eksentrik deb o'ylashga odatlanib qolishgan.U dahshatli kiyimda edi: kiyimlari yirtilgan va kirli, kechasi yomg'ir yog'gan edi.

en: His face was almost distorted from fatigue, exposure, the inward conflict that had lasted for twenty-four hours.
uz: Uning yuzi deyarli to'qson soat davom etgan charchatish, ifloslanish va ichki jangdan deyarli buzilgan edi.

en: He had spent all the previous night alone, God knows where.
uz: U o'tgan kechani yolg'iz o'tkazgan edi, Xudo biladi qayerda.

en: But anyway he had reached a decision.
uz: Ammo u qandaydir qarorga keldi.

en: He knocked at the door which was opened by his mother.
uz: U onasi tomonidan ochilgan eshikni taqillatdi.

en: Dounia was not at home.
uz: Dounia uyda yo'q edi.

en: Even the servant happened to be out.
uz: Hatto xizmatkor ham tashqariga chiqdi.

en: At first Pulcheria Alexandrovna was speechless with joy and surprise; then she took him by the hand and drew him into the room.
uz: Boshida Pulcheria Aleksandrovna quvonch va hayratdan so'zsiz qoldi; so'ngra uni qo'lidan ushlab, xonani olib kirdi.

en: “Here you are!” she began, faltering with joy.
uz: Mana sen! - deb boshladi u, quvonchdan g'ayratlanib.

en: “Don’t be angry with me, Rodya, for welcoming you so foolishly with tears: I am laughing not crying.
uz: Rodya, men sizni o'sha ahmoqona tarzda ko'z yoshlari bilan kutib olganim uchun menga g'azablanma: men kulyapman, yig'lamayman.

en: Did you think I was crying?
uz: Men yig'layotganimni o'ylaganmisiz?

en: No, I am delighted, but I’ve got into such a stupid habit of shedding tears.
uz: Yo'q, men juda xursandman, lekin men o'zimni o'zimga o'g'irlab, ko'z yoshlarini to'kib yuborish odatimga kirdim.

en: I’ve been like that ever since your father’s death.
uz: Otamning o'limidan beri men shundayman.

en: Sit down, dear boy, you must be tired; I see you are.
uz: O'tirib ko'ring, aziz o'g'lim, sen charchagan bo'lasan, ko'rib turibman.

en: Ah, how muddy you are.” “I was in the rain yesterday, mother.
uz: Ah, siz juda maydonsiz.  Men kecha yomg'ir ostida edim, ona.

en: …” Raskolnikov began.
uz: ... Raskolnikov boshlandi.

en: “No, no,” Pulcheria Alexandrovna hurriedly interrupted, “you thought I was going to cross-question you in the womanish way I used to; don’t be anxious, I understand, I understand it all: now I’ve
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna darrov to'xtadi,siz meni avvalgi ayollik yo'lida sizdan so'rashimni o'ylagan edingiz; tashvishlanmang, men buni tushunaman, men hammasini tushunaman: endi men o'zimni o'ldirganman.

en: learned the ways here and truly I see for myself that they are better.
uz: Bu yerda o'rgangan yo'llarimni o'zim ko'rdim va ular yaxshiroq ekanligini o'zim ko'rdim.

en: I’ve made up my mind once for all: how could I understand your plans and expect you to give an account of them?
uz: Men bir marta va butunlayin qaror qildim: qanday qilib rejalaringizni tushunib, ulardan hisobot berishni kutsam bo'ladi?

en: God knows what concerns and plans you may have, or what ideas you are hatching; so it’s not for me to keep nudging your elbow, asking you what you are thinking about?
uz: Xudo sizning qanday tashvishlaringiz va rejalaringiz yoki qanday g'oyalaringiz borligini biladi, shuning uchun men sizdan nima haqida o'ylayotganingizni so'rab, qo'lqovog'ingizni qo'zg'atishim kerak emasmi?

en: why am I running to and fro as though I were crazy … ?
uz: Nima uchun men aqldan ozganim kabi bu yerga-bu yerga yugurib ketyapman ... ?

en: I am reading your article in the magazine for the third time, Rodya.
uz: Men sizning maqolangizni uchinchi marta o'qiyotganman, Rodya.

en: Dmitri Prokofitch brought it to me.
uz: Dmitri Prokofitch uni menga keltirdi.

en: Directly I saw it I cried out to myself: ‘There, foolish one,’ I thought, ‘that’s what he is busy about; that’s the solution of the mystery!
uz: Men uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rdim va o'zimga shunday deb baqirdi: "U erda, ahmoq, men o'yladim: "U shu bilan mashg'ul; bu sirning yechimi!

en: Learned people are always like that.
uz: O'rgangan odamlar har doim shunday bo'ladi.

en: He may have some new ideas in his head just now; he is thinking them over and I worry him and upset him.’ I read it, my dear, and of course there was a great deal I did not understand; but that’s only natural —how should I?” “Show me, mother.” Raskolnikov took the magazine and glanced at his article.
uz: Ehtimol, hozirda uning boshida yangi g'oyalar bor, u ularni o'ylab ko'rib turibdi va men uni tashvishlantiraman va xafa qilaman. Men uni o'qib chiqdim, azizim, va albatta men tushunmagan ko'p narsalar bor edi; lekin bu tabiiy. Qanday qilib?  Menga ko'rsating, ona. Raskolnikov jurnalni olib, maqolaga nazar tashladi.

en: Incongruous as it was with his mood and his circumstances, he felt that strange and bitter sweet sensation that every author experiences the first time he sees himself in print; besides, he was only twenty-three.
uz: Havo va sharoitlariga mos kelmagan bo'lsa-da, u har bir muallif o'zini birinchi marta chop etilgan kitobda ko'rganida his qiladigan o'sha g'alati va qaynoq shirin hissiyotni his qilardi; bundan tashqari, u atigi yigirma uch yoshda edi.

en: It lasted only a moment.
uz: Bu faqat bir daqiqa davom etdi.

en: After reading a few lines he frowned and his heart throbbed with anguish.
uz: Bir necha satrni o'qiganidan so'ng, u ko'z o'ngidan ko'tardi va yuragi qayg'udan urdi.

en: He recalled all the inward conflict of the preceding months.
uz: U o'tgan oylarning barcha ichki ziddiyatlarini esladi.

en: He flung the article on the table with disgust and anger.
uz: U maqolani jirkanch va g'azabga to'lib-toshgan holda stol ustiga tashladi.

en: “But, however foolish I may be, Rodya, I can see for myself that you will very soon be one of the leading —if not the leading man —in the world of Russian thought.
uz: Ammo men qanchalik axmoq bo'lsam ham, Rodya, tez orada rus fikrlash tarzida eng mashhur odamlardan biri bo'lishingizni o'zim ko'rib turibman.

en: And they dared to think you were mad!
uz: Va ular sizni aqldan ozgan deb o'ylashga jur'at qilishdi!

en: You don’t know, but they really thought that.
uz: Bilmaysiz, lekin ular buni o'ylashgan.

en: Ah, the despicable creatures, how could they understand genius!
uz: Ah, begunoh mavjudotlar, qanday qilib ular g'ayrioddiylikni tushunishlari mumkin!

en: And Dounia, Dounia was all but believing it —what do you say to that?
uz: Va Dounia, Dounia bunga ishonishdan boshqa narsa yo'q edi.

en: Your father sent twice to magazines —the first time poems (I’ve got the manuscript and will show you) and the second time a whole novel (I begged him to let me copy it out) and how we prayed that they should be taken — they weren’t!
uz: Otangiz jurnallarga ikki marta poemlarni (man manxatni oldim va sizga ko'rsataman) va ikkinchi marta butun romani (men uni nusxa olishimga ruxsat berishini iltijo qildim) va biz ularni olib ketish uchun qanday ibodat qilganimizni ko'rdim.

en: I was breaking my heart, Rodya, six or seven days ago over your food and your clothes and the way you are living.
uz: Olti yoki yetti kun oldin, Rodya, ovqatingiz, kiyimingiz va turmush tarzingiz tufayli yuragimni sindirib yubordim.

en: But now I see again how foolish I was, for you can attain any position you like by your intellect and talent.
uz: Ammo endi men o'zim qanchalik ahmoq bo'lganimni yana ko'rdim, chunki siz o'zingizning intellekt va iste'dodingiz bilan xohlagan lavozimga erishishingiz mumkin.

en: No doubt you don’t care about that for
uz: Shubhasizki, siz bu haqda g'amxo'rlik qilmaysiz.

en: the present and you are occupied with much more important matters.
uz: Hozirgi paytda siz ancha muhimroq ishlar bilan bandsiz.

en: …” “Dounia’s not at home, mother?” “No, Rodya.
uz: Dunyo uyda emasmi, onam?

en: I often don’t see her; she leaves me alone.
uz: Ko'pincha uni ko'rmayapman; u meni yolg'iz qoldiradi.

en: Dmitri Prokofitch comes to see me, it’s so good of him, and he always talks about you.
uz: Dmitri Prokofitch menga tashrif buyuradi, bu uning juda mehribonligi va u har doim siz haqingizda gapiradi.

en: He loves you and respects you, my dear.
uz: U sizni sevadi va hurmat qiladi, azizim.

en: I don’t say that Dounia is very wanting in consideration.
uz: Men Duniyaning e'tiborga loyiqligini aytmayman.

en: I am not complaining.
uz: Men shikoyat qilmayapman.

en: She has her ways and I have mine; she seems to have got some secrets of late and I never have any secrets from you two.
uz: Uning o'z yo'llari bor, men ham o'zimning yo'llarim bor; u oxirgi paytlarda bir nechta sirlarga ega bo'lgan va men siz ikkovingizdan hech qachon hech qanday sirlarga ega emasman.

en: Of course, I am sure that Dounia has far too much sense, and besides she loves you and me … but I don’t know what it will all lead to.
uz: To'g'ri, Duniyaning aql-idrokli ekanligiga aminman, bundan tashqari u siz va meni sevadi... lekin bularning barchasi nimaga olib kelishini bilmayman.

en: You’ve made me so happy by coming now, Rodya, but she has missed you by going out; when she comes in I’ll tell her: ‘Your brother came in while you were out.
uz: Siz hozir kelib meni juda baxtli qildingiz, Rodya, lekin u sizni tashqarida qoldirdi; u kirib kelganda men unga aytaman: Siz tashqarida bo'lganingizda ukangiz keldi.

en: Where have you been all this time?’ You mustn’t spoil me, Rodya, you know; come when you can, but if you can’t, it doesn’t matter, I can wait.
uz: Bu vaqt davomida qayerda bo'lgan edingiz? Menga yomonlik qilmasligingiz kerak, Rodya, bilasizmi; imkoningiz bo'lganda keling, lekin agar qila olmasangiz, bu muhim emas, men kutishim mumkin.

en: I shall know, anyway, that you are fond of me, that will be enough for me.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, siz meni yaxshi ko'rganingizni bilaman, bu men uchun yetarli bo'ladi.

en: I shall read what you write, I shall hear about you from everyone, and sometimes you’ll come yourself to see me.
uz: Men sizning yozganlaringizni o'qib, siz haqingizda hammalardan eshitaman va ba'zan siz o'zingiz menga tashrif buyurasiz.

en: What could be better?
uz: Bundan yaxshiroq nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Here you’ve come now to comfort your mother, I see that.” Here Pulcheria Alexandrovna began to cry.
uz: Mana endi onangizni tasalli berishga keldingiz, men buni ko'ryapman. Pulcheria Aleksandrovna yig'lashga tushdi.

en: Don’t mind my foolishness.
uz: Mening ahmoqligimga xalaqit bermang.

en: My goodness, why am I sitting here?” she cried, jumping up.
uz: Hy Xudoyim, nega men bu yerda o'tiryapman? - deb yig'ladi u, ko'tarib turibdi.

en: “There is coffee and I don’t offer you any.
uz: Qahva bor va men sizga hech qanday taklif qilmayman.

en: Ah, that’s the selfishness of old age.
uz: Ah, bu keksalikning xudbinligi.

en: I’ll get it at once!” “Mother, don’t trouble, I am going at once.
uz: Men uni darhol oldim!Otam, tashvishlanma, men darhol ketyapman.

en: I haven’t come for that.
uz: Men buning uchun kelmadim.

en: Please listen to me.” Pulcheria Alexandrovna went up to him timidly.
uz: Iltimos, meni tinglang. Pulcheria Aleksandrovna uning oldiga qo'rqinchli ravishda keldi.

en: “Mother, whatever happens, whatever you hear about me, whatever you are told about me, will you always love me as you do now?” he asked suddenly from the fullness of his heart, as though not thinking of his words and not weighing them.
uz: "Otam, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, men to'g'rimda nima bo'lmasin, nima bo'lmasin, men to'g'rimda nima bo'lmasin, nima bo'lmasin, nima bo'lmasin, men to'g'rimda nima bo'lmasin, meni hozirgi kabi sevasizmi?" deb so'radi u, xuddi so'zlari haqida o'ylamagan va ularni o'ylamagan bo'lib.

en: “Rodya, Rodya, what is the matter?
uz: Rodya, Rodya, nima bo'ldi?

en: How can you ask me such a question?
uz: Qanday qilib menga bunday savol bera olasiz?

en: Why, who will tell me anything about you?
uz: Nima uchun, kim menga siz haqingizda biror narsa aytadi?

en: Besides, I shouldn’t believe anyone, I should refuse to listen.” “I’ve come to assure you that I’ve always loved you and I am glad that we are alone, even glad Dounia is out,” he went on with the same impulse.
uz: Bundan tashqari, men hech kimga ishonmasligim kerak, tinglashni rad etishim kerak. Men sizni har doim sevganimni va yolg'iz bo'lganimizdan xursand bo'lganimni sizga ishontirishga keldim, hatto Dounia chiqib ketgani uchun ham xursandman, u ham xuddi shunday impuls bilan davom etdi.

en: “I have come to tell you that though you will be
uz: Men sizga aytishga keldimki, siz shunday bo'lishingiz mumkin, ammo siz shunday bo'lasiz

en: unhappy, you must believe that your son loves you now more than himself, and that all you thought about me, that I was cruel and didn’t care about you, was all a mistake.
uz: Yaxshi emas, siz o'g'lingiz sizni endi o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevishiga ishonishingiz kerak, va siz men haqimda o'ylagan barcha narsalar, men shafqatsiz va sizga g'amxo'rlik qilmagan edim, bularning barchasi xato edi.

en: I shall never cease to love you.
uz: Men seni sevishni hech qachon to'xtatmayman.

en: … Well, that’s enough: I thought I must do this and begin with this.
uz: ... Xo'sh, bu yetarli: men buni qilishim va shu bilan boshlashim kerak deb o'yladim.

en: …” Pulcheria Alexandrovna embraced him in silence, pressing him to her bosom and weeping gently.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna uni o'z ko'nglida quchoqlab, xotirjamlik bilan yig'ladi.

en: “I don’t know what is wrong with you, Rodya,” she said at last.
uz: "Senda nima borligini bilmayman, Rodya", - dedi u nihoyat.

en: “I’ve been thinking all this time that we were simply boring you and now I see that there is a great sorrow in store for you, and that’s why you are miserable.
uz: Bu vaqt davomida biz sizni shunchaki charchatib qo'yganmiz deb o'yladim va endi siz uchun katta qayg'u kutilayotganini va shuning uchun siz baxtsiz ekaningizni ko'rdim.

en: I’ve foreseen it a long time, Rodya.
uz: Men buni uzoq vaqtdan beri kutib o'tganman, Rodya.

en: Forgive me for speaking about it.
uz: Bu haqda gapirganim uchun kechirim so'raysiz.

en: I keep thinking about it and lie awake at nights.
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylayman va kechasi uyg'onib yotaman.

en: Your sister lay talking in her sleep all last night, talking of nothing but you.
uz: Qizingiz o'tgan kechasi uyqusida yolg'iz sizdan boshqa hech narsa haqida gapirmay yotgan edi.

en: I caught something, but I couldn’t make it out.
uz: Bir narsani ushlab qoldim, lekin uni aniqlay olmadim.

en: I felt all the morning as though I were going to be hanged, waiting for something, expecting something, and now it has come!
uz: Men butun ertalab o'zimni asrashga tayyor bo'lganimdek his qildim, bir narsani kutdim, bir narsani kutdim va endi u keldi!

en: Rodya, Rodya, where are you going?
uz: Rodya, Rodya, qayerga ketyapsiz?

en: You are going away somewhere?” “Yes.” “That’s what I thought!
uz: Siz bir joyga ketyapsizmi? Yes.    Mana men o'yladim!

en: I can come with you, you know, if you need me.
uz: Agar menga muhtoj bo'lsangiz, men siz bilan birga borishim mumkin.

en: And Dounia, too; she loves you, she loves you dearly —and Sofya Semyonovna may come with us if you like.
uz: Dounia ham seni yaxshi ko'radi, juda yaxshi ko'radi va Sofiya Semyonovna ham biz bilan birga kelishi mumkin, agar xohlasangiz.

en: You see, I am glad to look upon her as a daughter even … Dmitri Prokofitch will help us to go together.
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, men uni hatto qiz sifatida ko'rib quvonaman ... Dmitri Prokofitch bizga birgalikda borishga yordam beradi.

en: But … where … are you going?” “Goodbye, mother.” “What, today?” she cried, as though losing him forever.
uz: Ammo... qayerga ketyapsan?Xudojo'y, ona.Bugun nima?U o'zini abadiy yo'qotgandek yig'ladi.

en: “I can’t stay, I must go now.
uz: Men qololmayman, endi ketishim kerak.

en: …” “And can’t I come with you?” “No, but kneel down and pray to God for me.
uz: Men ham sizlar bilan borolmaymanmi? - Yo'q, tiz cho'kib, men uchun Xudoga ibodat qiling.

en: Your prayer perhaps will reach Him.” “Let me bless you and sign you with the cross.
uz: Balki ibodatingiz Unga yetib boradi.  Men sizni duo qilib, xoch bilan imzolayman.

en: That’s right, that’s right.
uz: To'g'ri, to'g'ri.

en: Oh, God, what are we doing?” Yes, he was glad, he was very glad that there was no one there, that he was alone with his mother.
uz: Oh, Xudoyim, biz nima qilyapmiz? Ha, u xursand edi, u yerda hech kim yo'qligi uchun juda xursand edi, u o'z onasi bilan yolg'iz edi.

en: For the first time after all those awful months his heart was softened.
uz: O'sha dahshatli oylardan so'ng birinchi marta uning yuragi yumshatildi.

en: He fell down before her, he kissed her feet and both wept, embracing.
uz: U ayolning oldiga yiqilib, oyoqlarini o'pdi va ikkalasi ham yig'lab, o'zlarini qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: And she was not surprised and did not question him this time.
uz: Bu safar u hayron bo'lmadi va uni so'roq qilmadi.

en: For some days she had realised that something awful was happening to her son and that now some terrible minute had come for him.
uz: Bir necha kun davomida u o'g'li bilan dahshatli voqealar sodir bo'layotganini va u uchun dahshatli bir daqiqa kelganini anglab yetdi.

en: “Rodya, my darling, my first born,” she said sobbing, “now you are just as when you were little.
uz: "Rodya, azizim, birinchi tug'ilganim", - dedi u yig'lab, "hozir siz kichkinaligingizda bo'lganingizdeksiz.

en: You would run like this to me and hug me and kiss me.
uz: Sen shunday yugurib menga qo'shilib, o'nglab, o'parding.

en: When your father was living and we were poor, you comforted us simply by being with us and when I buried your father, how often we wept together at his grave and embraced, as now.
uz: Otang tirik bo'lganida, biz kambag'al bo'lganimizda, sen shunchaki biz bilan bo'lib, bizga tasalli berarding va men otangni ko'mganimda, biz uning qabrida tez-tez yig'lab, o'zimizni qo'llab-quvvatlagan edik.

en: And if I’ve been crying lately, it’s that my mother’s heart had a foreboding of trouble.
uz: Va agar men so'nggi paytlarda yig'lab yurgan bo'lsam, bu onamning yuragida muammolar paydo bo'lganligi sababli.

en: The first time I saw you, that evening, you remember, as soon as we arrived here, I guessed simply from your eyes.
uz: Sizni birinchi marta ko'rganimda, o'sha kechqurun, eslaysiz, biz bu yerga yetib kelganimizdan so'ng, men shunchaki ko'zlaringizdan o'yladim.

en: My heart sank at once, and today when I opened the door and looked at you, I thought the fatal hour had come.
uz: Darhol yuragim tushdi va bugun eshikni ochib, sizga qaraganimda, o'zimni o'yladimki, bu dahshatli soat keldi.

en: Rodya, Rodya, you are not going away today?” “No!” “You’ll come again?” “Yes … I’ll come.” “Rodya, don’t be angry, I don’t dare to question you.
uz: Rodya, Rodya, siz bugun ketmayapsizmi?Yo'q!Siz yana kelarmisiz?Ha... Men kelaman.Rodya, g'azablanmang, men sizni so'rashga jur'at etmayman.

en: Only say two words to me —is it far where you are going?” “Very far.” “What is awaiting you there?
uz: Menga faqat ikki so'z ayting, siz borayotgan joy uzoqmi?

en: Some post or career for you?” “What God sends … only pray for me.” Raskolnikov went to the door, but she clutched him and gazed despairingly into his eyes.
uz: Siz uchun biron bir lavozim yoki kasb bormi? Xudo yuboradigan narsa ... faqat men uchun ibodat qiling. Raskolnikov eshikga bordi, lekin u uni qo'lga oldi va umidsizlik bilan uning ko'zlariga qaradi.

en: Her face worked with terror.
uz: Uning yuzi dahshatga to'lib-toshdi.

en: “Enough, mother,” said Raskolnikov, deeply regretting that he had come.
uz: Etarli, ona, dedi Raskolnikov, u kelganidan juda afsuslanib.

en: “Not forever, it’s not yet forever?
uz: Abadiy emasmi, abadiy emasmi?

en: You’ll come, you’ll come tomorrow?” “I will, I will, goodbye.” He tore himself away at last.
uz: Siz kelasizmi, ertaga kelasizmi?I will, I will, goodbye. U nihoyat o'zini yo'q qildi.

en: It was a warm, fresh, bright evening; it had cleared up in the morning.
uz: Bu issiq, yangi, yorqin kechasi edi; ertalab yorug' bo'ldi.

en: Raskolnikov went to his lodgings; he made haste.
uz: Raskolnikov o'z uylariga bordi; u shoshildi.

en: He wanted to finish all before sunset.
uz: U quyosh botishidan oldin hamma narsani tugatmoqchi edi.

en: He did not want to meet anyone till then.
uz: U o'sha paytgacha hech kim bilan uchrashishni istamagan.

en: Going up the stairs he noticed that Nastasya rushed from the samovar to watch him intently.
uz: Sotuvlarni ko'targanida, Nastasya samovardan chiqib, uni diqqat bilan kuzatib borayotganini ko'rdi.

en: “Can anyone have come to see me?” he wondered.
uz: Meni ko'rishga kim kelgan bo'lishi mumkinmi? deb o'yladi.

en: He had a disgusted vision of Porfiry.
uz: U Porfiry haqida jirkanch tasavvurga ega edi.

en: But opening his door he saw Dounia.
uz: Ammo eshikni ochib, u Duniyani ko'rdi.

en: She was sitting alone, plunged in deep thought, and looked as though she had been waiting a long time.
uz: U yolg'iz o'tirgan, chuqur o'ylashga tushgan va uzoq vaqt kutgan kabi ko'rinardi.

en: He stopped short in the doorway.
uz: U eshikda to'xtadi.

en: She rose from the sofa in dismay and stood up facing him.
uz: U dahshatga tushgan holda sofanadan turib, unga qaragan holda turdi.

en: Her eyes, fixed upon him, betrayed horror and infinite grief.
uz: Uning ko'zlari unga qaraganida, dahshat va cheksiz qayg'u paydo bo'ldi.

en: And from those eyes alone he saw at once that she knew.
uz: Va faqat o'sha ko'zlar bilan u qizni taniydiganini birdan ko'rdi.

en: “Am I to come in or go away?” he asked uncertainly.
uz: Men kirishim kerakmi yoki ketishim kerakmi? deb so'radi u ishonchsiz.

en: “I’ve been all day with Sofya Semyonovna.
uz: Men Sofiya Semyonovna bilan kun bo'yi birga bo'ldim.

en: We were both waiting for you.
uz: Ikkalasi ham sizni kutgan edik.

en: We thought that you would be sure to come there.” Raskolnikov went into the room and sank exhausted on a chair.
uz: Biz siz albatta u yerga borasiz deb o'yladik. Raskolnikov xonasiga kirib, charchagan holda o'rindiq ustida cho'kdi.

en: “I feel weak, Dounia, I am very tired; and I should have liked at this moment to be able to control myself.” He glanced at her mistrustfully.
