en: It happened once or twice, however, that Pulcheria Alexandrovna gave such a turn to the conversation that it was impossible to answer her without mentioning where Rodya was, and on receiving unsatisfactory and suspicious answers she became at once gloomy and silent, and this mood lasted for a long time.
uz: Biroq bir-ikki marta Pulcheria Aleksandrovna suhbatni o'zgartirganida, Rodyaning qayerda ekanligini aytmasdan javob berish imkonsiz bo'lgan va u qoniqarli va shubhali javoblarni olganda u bir vaqtning o'zida qorong'i va sukut bo'lib qoldi va bu his-tuyg'u uzoq davom etdi.

en: Dounia saw at last that it was hard to deceive her and came to the conclusion that it was better to be absolutely silent on certain points; but it became more and more evident that the poor mother suspected something terrible.
uz: Dounia oxir-oqibat uni aldashning qiyinligini ko'rib, ba'zi masalalarda mutlaqo sukut saqlash yaxshiroq degan xulosaga keldi; ammo kambag'al ona dahshatli bir narsani shubha ostiga qo'yganini ko'proq ko'rinib turdi.

en: Dounia remembered her brother’s telling her that her mother had overheard her talking in her sleep on the night after her interview
uz: Dounia o'z akasi unga intervyudan keyingi kechada onasi uni uxlab gapirganini eshitganini aytgani haqida esladi.

en: with Svidrigaïlov and before the fatal day of the confession: had not she made out something from that?
uz: Svidrigailov bilan va tanbehning ayanchli kuni oldidan: u bundan biror narsani aniqlamaganmidi?

en: Sometimes days and even weeks of gloomy silence and tears would be succeeded by a period of hysterical animation, and the invalid would begin to talk almost incessantly of her son, of her hopes of his future.
uz: Ba'zan kunlar va hatto haftalar davomida ko'ngilsizlik va ko'z yoshlari histerik hayratlanish davridan keyin boshlanadi va nogiron o'g'li haqida, uning kelajakka bo'lgan umidlari haqida deyarli to'xtamas gapira boshlaydi.

en: … Her fancies were sometimes very strange.
uz: Uning xayollari ba'zan juda g'alati bo'lgan.

en: They humoured her, pretended to agree with her (she saw perhaps that they were pretending), but she still went on talking.
uz: Ular unga xijolat ko'rsatishdi, u bilan rozi bo'lib qolishlarini ko'rsatishdi (u, ehtimol, ular o'zlarini shunday ko'rsatayotganini ko'rdi), lekin u hali ham gapiraverardi.

en: Five months after Raskolnikov’s confession, he was sentenced.
uz: Raskolnikovning tanbehidan besh oy o'tgach, uni hukm qilishdi.

en: Razumihin and Sonia saw him in prison as often as it was possible.
uz: Razumihin va Sonia uni qamoqda imkon qadar ko'p ko'rishardi.

en: At last the moment of separation came.
uz: Nihoyat, ajralish payti keldi.

en: Dounia swore to her brother that the separation should not be for ever, Razumihin did the same.
uz: Dounia ukasiga ajralish abadiy bo'lmasligi haqida qasam ichibdi, Razumihin ham shunday qildi.

en: Razumihin, in his youthful ardour, had firmly resolved to lay the foundations at least of a secure livelihood during the next three or four years, and saving up a certain sum, to emigrate to Siberia, a country rich in every natural resource and in need of workers, active men and capital.
uz: Razumihin yoshlik g'ayrati bilan keyingi uch yoki to'rt yil ichida hech bo'lmaganda xavfsiz yashash uchun asoslar qo'yishga va muayyan miqdorni tejashga qat'iy qaror qilgan edi va barcha tabiiy resurslarga boy va ishchilar, faol kishilar va kapitalga muhtoj bo'lgan Sibirga ko'chib o'tishga qaror qilgan edi.

en: There they would settle in the town where Rodya was and all together would begin a new life.
uz: U yerda ular Rodya joylashgan shaharchaga joylashib, birgalikda yangi hayot boshlashardi.

en: They all wept at parting.
uz: Ular barchasi ayrilish paytida yig'lab yubordilar.

en: Raskolnikov had been very dreamy for a few days before.
uz: Raskolnikov bundan bir necha kun oldin juda orzu qilgandir.

en: He asked a great deal about his mother and was constantly anxious about her.
uz: U onasi haqida juda ko'p savollar berardi va u uchun doimo tashvishlanardi.

en: He worried so much about her that it alarmed Dounia.
uz: U qiz haqida shunchalik tashvishlanganki, bu Duniyani xavotirga solgan.

en: When he heard about his mother’s illness he became very gloomy.
uz: Onasining kasalligi haqida eshitgach, u juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: With Sonia he was particularly reserved all the time.
uz: Soniaga nisbatan u har doim o'ziga xos xotirjamlik ko'rsatgan.

en: With the help of the money left to her by Svidrigaïlov, Sonia had long ago made her preparations to follow the party of convicts in which he was despatched to Siberia.
uz: Svidrigailov tomonidan unga qoldirilgan pul yordamida Sonia uzoq vaqt oldin o'zini Sibirga jo'natilgan mahkumlar guruhini kuzatib borish uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rgan edi.

en: Not a word passed between Raskolnikov and her on the subject, but both knew it would be so.
uz: Raskolnikov va uning o'rtasida bu borada hech qanday gap yo'q edi, ammo ikkalasi ham bu haqda bilishgan.

en: At the final leave- taking he smiled strangely at his sister’s and Razumihin’s fervent anticipations of their happy future together when he should come out of prison.
uz: Oxirgi ta'tilda u singillari va Razumihining birga baxtli kelajagi haqida g'ayratli his-tuyg'ularini ko'rib, o'zini qamoqdan ozod qilganida g'alati tabassum bilan tabassum qildi.

en: He predicted that their mother’s illness would soon have a fatal ending.
uz: U onasining kasalligi yaqin orada halokatli yakun topishini bashorat qilgan.

en: Sonia and he at last set off.
uz: U va Sonia nihoyat yo'lga chiqdi.

en: Two months later Dounia was married to Razumihin.
uz: Ikki oydan so'ng Dounia Razumihin bilan turmushga chiqdi.

en: It was a quiet and sorrowful wedding; Porfiry Petrovitch and Zossimov were invited however.
uz: Bu tinch va qayg'uli to'y edi; ammo Porfiry Petrovitch va Zossimov taklif etilgan edi.

en: During all this period Razumihin wore an air of resolute determination.
uz: Ushbu davr davomida Razumihin qat'iy qarorni namoyon etgan.

en: Dounia put implicit faith in his carrying out his plans and indeed she could not but believe in him.
uz: Dounia uning rejalarini amalga oshirishiga ishonadi va u unga ishonishdan boshqa narsa qila olmaydi.

en: He displayed a rare strength of will.
uz: U kamdan-kam kuchli xohish-irodasini namoyon etgan.

en: Among other things he began attending university
uz: Boshqa narsalar orasida u universitetga borishni boshladi

en: lectures again in order to take his degree.
uz: O'zining diplomini olish uchun yana bir bor o'qishga kiradi.

en: They were continually making plans for the future; both counted on settling in Siberia within five years at least.
uz: Ular doimo kelajakka rejalar tuzishardi; ikkalasi ham kamida besh yil ichida Sibirga joylashishga umid qilishardi.

en: Till then they rested their hopes on Sonia.
uz: O'shanda ular Soniaga umid bog'lashgan.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna was delighted to give her blessing to Dounia’s marriage with Razumihin; but after the marriage she became even more melancholy and anxious.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna Dounianing Razumihin bilan nikohiga baraka berishga rozi boʻldi; lekin u erga teggach, oʻzini yanada tushkun va tashvishlanarli his qildi.

en: To give her pleasure Razumihin told her how Raskolnikov had looked after the poor student and his decrepit father and how a year ago he had been burnt and injured in rescuing two little children from a fire.
uz: Razumihin qizga zavq berish uchun, Raskolnikovning kambag'al o'quvchi va uning o'z otasiga qanday g'amxo'rlik qilganini va bir yil oldin u ikkita kichkina bolani yong'indan qutqarishda qanday yondirib, jarohatlanganini aytib berdi.

en: These two pieces of news excited Pulcheria Alexandrovna’s disordered imagination almost to ecstasy.
uz: Ushbu ikkita yangilik Pulcheria Alexandrovnaning taxminiy tasavvurini deyarli ecstasyga aylantirdi.

en: She was continually talking about them, even entering into conversation with strangers in the street, though Dounia always accompanied her.
uz: U ular haqida doimo gapirib turardi, hatto ko'chada g'ayritabiiy odamlar bilan suhbatlashardi, ammo Dounia doimo unga ergashardi.

en: In public conveyances and shops, wherever she could capture a listener, she would begin the discourse about her son, his article, how he had helped the student, how he had been burnt at the fire, and so on!
uz: Ommaviy transport vositalari va do'konlarda, istalgan joyda tinglovchilarni o'ziga jalb qilsa, u o'g'li, uning maqolasi, uning o'quvchiga qanday yordam berganligi, olovda qanday yondirilganligi va hokazolar to'g'risida nutq boshlaydi!

en: Dounia did not know how to restrain her.
uz: Dounia uni qanday to'xtatishni bilmadi.

en: Apart from the danger of her morbid excitement, there was the risk of someone’s recalling Raskolnikov’s name and speaking of the recent trial.
uz: Uning dardli hayajonidan tashqari, kimdir Raskolnikov ismini eslab, so'nggi sud jarayoni haqida gapirish xavfi ham bor edi.

en: Pulcheria Alexandrovna found out the address of the mother of the two children her son had saved and insisted on going to see her.
uz: Pulcheria Aleksandrovna o'g'li qutqargan ikki bolaning onasining manzilini bilib, uni ko'rishga borishga qat'iy qaror qildi.

en: At last her restlessness reached an extreme point.
uz: Nihoyat uning bezovtaligi nihoyasiga yetdi.

en: She would sometimes begin to cry suddenly and was often ill and feverishly delirious.
uz: Ba'zan u to'satdan yig'la boshlaydi va ko'pincha kasal va issiqlik bilan deliriumga tushadi.

en: One morning she declared that by her reckoning Rodya ought soon to be home, that she remembered when he said goodbye to her he said that they must expect him back in nine months.
uz: Bir kuni ertalab u Rodya yaqin orada uyga qaytishi kerakligini, u undan salom so'raganida to'qqiz oy ichida qaytishini kutish kerakligini eslab qolganini e'lon qildi.

en: She began to prepare for his coming, began to do up her room for him, to clean the furniture, to wash and put up new hangings and so on.
uz: U uning kelishi uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rishni boshladi, o'z xonasini uning uchun quritishni, mebellarni tozalashni, yuvishni va yangi asboblarni o'rnatishni boshladi va hokazo.

en: Dounia was anxious, but said nothing and helped her to arrange the room.
uz: Dounia xavotirda edi, lekin hech narsa aytmadi va xonani yig'ishga yordam berdi.

en: After a fatiguing day spent in continual fancies, in joyful daydreams and tears, Pulcheria Alexandrovna was taken ill in the night and by morning she was feverish and delirious.
uz: To'xtatmas xayollarda, quvonchli tushlarda va ko'z yoshlarida o'tkazgan charchagan kunidan so'ng, Pulcheria Aleksandrovna kechasi kasal bo'lib qoldi va ertalab u issiq va deliriumga chalingan edi.

en: She died within a fortnight.
uz: U ikki hafta ichida vafot etdi.

en: In her delirium she dropped words which showed that she knew a great deal more about her son’s terrible fate than they had supposed.
uz: O'zining deliriyasida u o'g'lining dahshatli taqdirini ular o'ylagandan ko'ra ko'proq bilishini ko'rsatadigan so'zlarni aytdi.

en: For a long time Raskolnikov did not know of his mother’s death, though a regular correspondence had been maintained from the time he reached Siberia.
uz: Raskolnikov uzoq vaqt davomida onasining o'limi haqida bilmagan, ammo u Sibirga yetib kelganidan beri muntazam ravishda yozishmalar olib borilgan.

en: It was carried on by means of Sonia, who wrote every month to the Razumihins and received an answer with unfailing regularity.
uz: U har oy Razumihins oilasiga xat yozgan va muntazam ravishda javob olgan Sonia orqali amalga oshirilgan.

en: At first they found Sonia’s letters dry and unsatisfactory, but later on they came to the conclusion that the letters could not be better, for from these letters they received a complete picture of their unfortunate brother’s life.
uz: Boshida ular Sonaning xatlarini quruq va qoniqarli deb topdilar, ammo keyinchalik ular xatlar bundan yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin emas degan xulosaga kelishdi, chunki ushbu xatlardan ular o'z birodarlarining baxtsiz hayoti haqida to'liq tasavvurga ega bo'lishdi.

en: Sonia’s letters were full of the most matter-of-fact detail, the simplest and clearest description of all Raskolnikov’s surroundings as a convict.
uz: Sonia xatlari eng aniq tafsilotlarga to'la edi, Raskolnikovning mahbus sifatida atrofidagi barcha holatlarni eng sodda va aniq tasvirlagan edi.

en: There was no word of her own hopes, no conjecture as to the future, no description of her feelings.
uz: Uning o'z umidlari haqida hech qanday so'z yo'q edi, kelajak haqida hech qanday taxmin yo'q edi, uning his-tuyg'ularini tasvirlab bermagan.

en: Instead of any attempt to interpret his state of mind and inner life, she gave the simple facts —that is, his own words, an exact account of his health, what he asked for at their interviews, what commission he gave her and so on.
uz: Uning fikrlash tarzi va ichki hayotini tushuntirishga urinishning o'rniga, u oddiy faktlarni, ya'ni o'z so'zlarini, sog'lig'ini, suhbatlarida nima so'raganini, unga qanday topshiriq berganini va hokazolarni aytib berdi.

en: All these facts she gave with extraordinary minuteness.
uz: Bu barcha faktlarni u o'zgacha xolislik bilan bergan.

en: The picture of their unhappy brother stood out at last with great clearness and precision.
uz: Ularning baxtsiz ukasi haqidagi rasm nihoyat katta aniqlik va aniqlik bilan ko'rindi.

en: There could be no mistake, because nothing was given but facts.
uz: Hech qanday xato bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, chunki haqiqatdan boshqa hech narsa berilmagan.

en: But Dounia and her husband could get little comfort out of the news, especially at first.
uz: Ammo Dounia va uning eri, ayniqsa boshida, yangiliklardan kamdan-kam tasalli olishardi.

en: Sonia wrote that he was constantly sullen and not ready to talk, that he scarcely seemed interested in the news she gave him from their letters, that he sometimes asked after his mother and that when, seeing that he had guessed the truth, she told him at last of her death, she was surprised to find that he did not seem greatly affected by it, not externally at any rate.
uz: Sonia uning har doim g'azablanishini va gapirishga tayyor emasligini, maktublaridan olgan xabarlar unga qiziqqanini, ba'zan onasining nomini so'raganini va uning haqiqatni bilganini ko'rib, uning o'limini aytganda, u o'ziga katta ta'sir ko'rsatmaganini ko'rganida hayron qoldi.

en: She told them that, although he seemed so wrapped up in himself and, as it were, shut himself off from everyone —he took a very direct and simple view of his new life; that he understood his position, expected nothing better for the time, had no ill-founded hopes (as is so common in his position) and scarcely seemed surprised at anything in his surroundings, so unlike anything he had known before.
uz: U ularga aytdiki, Garchi u o'ziga juda o'xshasa-da va hammalardan chetda qolgan bo'lsa-da, u o'zining yangi hayotiga juda bevosita va sodda nuqtai nazar bilan qaraydi; u o'z vazifasini tushunadi, o'sha vaqt uchun hech narsani yaxshiroq kutmaydi, hech qanday asossiz umidlarga ega emas (u o'z vazifasida juda keng tarqalgan) va atrofidagi hech narsa unga o'xshamaydi.

en: She wrote that his health was satisfactory; he did his work without shirking or seeking to do more; he was almost indifferent about food, but except on Sundays and holidays the food was so bad that at last he had been glad to accept some money from her, Sonia, to have his own tea every day.
uz: U uning sog'ligi yaxshi ekanligini yozdi; u o'z ishini qochib o'tmasdan yoki ko'proq ishlashni xohlamagan holda bajarardi; u oziq-ovqatga nisbatan deyarli befarq edi, lekin yakshanba va bayramlardan tashqari, ovqat shunchalik yomon ediki, nihoyat u undan, Soniadan, har kuni o'z choyini ichish uchun pulni qabul qilishdan mamnun edi.

en: He begged her not to trouble about anything else, declaring that all this fuss about him only annoyed him.
uz: U ayoldan boshqa hech narsa bilan band bo'lmasin deb iltijo qilib, uning atrofidagi bu g'alayon uni faqat g'azabga soladi.

en: wrote further that in prison he shared the same room with the rest, that she had not seen the inside of their barracks, but concluded that they were crowded, miserable and unhealthy; that he slept on a plank bed with a rug under him and was unwilling to make any other arrangement.
uz: Keyinchalik u qamoqda u boshqalar bilan bir xonada bo'lganini, u ularning barakasi ichki qismini ko'rmaganini, lekin ular juda ko'p, baxtsiz va sog'lom bo'lishganini, u yonida cho'tka bo'lib yotganini va boshqa hech qanday tadbir o'tkazishni istamaganini yozdi.

en: But that he lived so poorly and roughly, not from any plan or design, but simply from inattention and indifference.
uz: Ammo u hech qanday reja yoki dizayndan emas, balki shunchaki befarqlik va befarqlikdan juda kam va taxminsiz hayot kechirdi.

en: Sonia wrote simply that he had at first shown no interest in her visits, had almost been vexed with her indeed for coming, unwilling to talk and rude to her.
uz: Sonia shunchaki, u birinchi navbatda uning tashriflariga qiziqish ko'rsatmaganini, u kelganligi uchun deyarli g'azablanganini, gapirishga xohlamaganini va unga befarq bo'lganini yozdi.

en: But that in the end these visits had become a habit and almost a necessity for him, so that he was positively distressed when she was ill for some days and could not visit him.
uz: Ammo oxir-oqibat bu tashriflar u uchun odatga va deyarli zarurlikka aylandi, shuning uchun u bir necha kun kasal bo'lganida va uni ko'rishga qodir bo'lmaganida, u juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: She used to see him on holidays at the prison gates or in the guardroom, to which he was brought for a few minutes to see her.
uz: U uni ta'tilda qamoq darvozalarida yoki qo'riqxonada ko'rishardi, u yerda uni bir necha daqiqaga ko'rish uchun olib borardi.

en: On working days she would go to see him at work either at the workshops or at the brick kilns, or at the sheds on the banks of the Irtish.
uz: Ish kunlarida u uni ishxonada yoki tikanlar idishida yoki Irtish daryosining qirg'og'ida joylashgan maydonlarda ko'rish uchun borardi.

en: About herself, Sonia wrote that she had succeeded in making some acquaintances in the town, that she did sewing, and, as there was scarcely a dressmaker in the town, she was looked upon as an indispensable person in many houses.
uz: Sonia o'zi haqida yozganida, u shaharda ba'zi odamlar bilan tanishishga muvaffaq bo'lgan, tikuvchilik qilgan va shaharda kamdan-kam kiyim usuli bo'lgani uchun, ko'plab uylarda u juda muhim shaxs deb hisoblangan.

en: But she did not mention that the authorities were, through her, interested in Raskolnikov; that his task was lightened and so on.
uz: Ammo u Raskolnikovga o'zi orqali hukumatning qiziqish ko'rsatganini, uning vazifasi yengillashtirilganini va hokazolarni aytmadi.

en: At last the news came (Dounia had indeed noticed signs of alarm and uneasiness in the preceding letters) that he held aloof from everyone, that his fellow prisoners did not like him, that he kept silent for days at a time and was becoming very pale.
uz: Nihoyat xabar keldi (Dounia o'tgan xatlarda xavotir va xavotirning belgilarini ko'rgan edi) u har kimdan uzoqlashdi, uning qamoqdoshlari uni yoqtirmadi, u bir necha kun davomida sukut saqlab qoldi va juda yorqin bo'ldi.

en: In the last letter Sonia wrote that he had been taken very seriously ill and was in the convict ward of the hospital.
uz: So'nggi maktubida Soniya u kasal bo'lib, kasalxonadagi mahkumlar bo'linmasida bo'lganini yozgan.

en: He was ill a long time.
uz: U uzoq vaqtdan beri kasal edi.

en: But it was not the horrors of prison life, not the hard labour, the bad food, the shaven head, or the patched clothes that crushed him.
uz: Ammo uni qamoqdagi hayotning dahshatlari, mehnat, yomon ovqat, soch sochlari yoki kiyim-kechaklari ezmagan.

en: What did he care for all those trials and hardships!
uz: O'sha sinov va qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u nimaga g'amxo'rlik qilgan!

en: he was even glad of the hard work.
uz: U hatto mehnatidan xursand edi.

en: Physically exhausted, he could at least reckon on a few hours of quiet sleep.
uz: Jismoniy jihatdan charchagan bo'lsa-da, u hech bo'lmaganda bir necha soat tinch uyquga umid bog'lashi mumkin edi.

en: And what was the food to him —the thin cabbage soup with beetles floating in it?
uz: Va unga nima taom bo'lgan? Uda bug'doylar suzib borayotgan cho'qqizli cho'g' cho'g'i?

en: In the past as a student he had often not had even that.
uz: O'tmishda u talaba sifatida ko'pincha bu haqda bilmagan edi.

en: His clothes were warm and suited to his manner of life.
uz: Uning kiyimlari issiq va uning turmush tarziga mos edi.

en: He did not even feel the fetters.
uz: U hatto bog'larni his qilmadi.

en: Was he ashamed of his shaven head and particoloured coat?
uz: U o'z sochlarini qirqib, partikel rangli kiyimidan uyalganmi?

en: Sonia was afraid of him, how could he be ashamed before her?
uz: Sonia undan qo'rqardi, qanday qilib u undan uyalishi mumkin edi?

en: And yet he was ashamed even before Sonia, whom he tortured because of it with his contemptuous rough manner.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u hatto Sonia oldida ham uyat chekardi, chunki u shu sababdan o'z qo'pol xatti-harakatlari bilan azob chekardi.

en: But it was not his shaven head and his fetters he was ashamed of: his pride had been stung to the quick.
uz: Ammo u o'zining sochlarini va zanjirlarini o'zidan or qilmadi: uning mag'rurligi tezda kesilgan edi.

en: It was wounded pride that made him ill.
uz: U kasal bo'lganini jarohatlangan mag'rurlik qildi.

en: Oh, how happy he would have been if he could have blamed himself!
uz: Agar o'zini ayblash imkoniga ega bo'lganida, u qanchalik xursand bo'lgan bo'lardi!

en: He could have borne anything then, even shame and disgrace.
uz: O'shanda u har qanday narsani boshdan kechirishi mumkin edi, hatto sharmandalik va sharmandalikni ham.

en: But he judged himself severely, and his exasperated conscience found no particularly terrible fault in his past, except a simple blunder which might happen to anyone.
uz: Ammo u o'zini qat'iy hukm qildi va o'z vijdonining g'azablantirilishi uning o'tmishda hech qanday yomonlik topmadi, faqat oddiy xatoga yo'l qo'yib, u har kimga ham sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He was ashamed just because he, Raskolnikov, had so hopelessly, stupidly come to grief through some decree of blind fate, and must humble himself and submit to “the idiocy” of a sentence, if he were anyhow to be at peace.
uz: O'zi Raskolnikovning o'zi shu qadar umidsiz, ahmoqona qilib, ko'r taqdir qarori tufayli qayg'uga tushgani uchun uyalgan edi va agar tinch bo'lishi uchun o'zini kamtar qilib, hukmning axloqsizligiga bo'ysunishi kerak edi.

en: Vague and objectless anxiety in the present, and in the future a continual sacrifice leading to nothing —that was all that lay before him.
uz: Hozirgi paytda ko'rinmas va ahamiyatsiz tashvishlar, kelajakda esa doimiy qurbonlik bo'lib, uning oldidagi hamma narsa yo'q bo'lib qolishiga olib keladi.

en: And what comfort was it to him that at the end of eight years he would only be thirty-two and able to begin a new life!
uz: Va sakkiz yil o'tgach, u atigi o'ttiz ikki yoshda bo'lib, yangi hayotni boshlashga qodir bo'lishi unga naqadar tasalli baxsh etardi!

en: What had he to live for?
uz: U nima uchun yashashi kerak edi?

en: What had he to look forward to?
uz: U nimani kutishi mumkin edi?

en: Why should he strive?
uz: Nima uchun u kurashishi kerak?

en: To live in order to exist?
uz: mavjud bo'lish uchun yashash uchunmi?

en: Why, he had been ready a thousand times before to give up existence for the sake of an idea, for a hope, even for a fancy.
uz: Axir, u bir g'oya, umid va hatto o'ziga xos narsa uchun mavjudotdan voz kechishga ming marta tayyor edi.

en: Mere existence had always been too little for him; he had always wanted more.
uz: Faqatgina mavjudot u uchun har doim ham kam edi; u har doim ko'proq narsani xohlagan.

en: Perhaps it was just because of the strength of his desires that he had thought himself a man to whom more was permissible than to others.
uz: Ehtimol, o'zining kuchli istaklari tufayli u o'zini boshqalarga qaraganda ko'proq narsalarga ega bo'lgan kishi deb hisoblagan.

en: And if only fate would have sent him repentance —burning repentance that would have torn his heart and robbed him of sleep, that repentance, the awful agony of which brings visions of hanging
uz: Qasamki, taqdir unga tavba yuborib, yuragini yirtib, uni uxlatishga undaydigan yonayotgan tavbalarni yuborgan bo'lsa edi, bu tavba, uning dahshatli azob-uqubatlari oshib ketish haqidagi tasavvurlarni keltirib chiqargan bo'lsa edi.

en: Oh, he would have been glad of it!
uz: Oh, u bunga quvonar edi!

en: Tears and agonies would at least have been life.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, ko'z yoshlari va azob-uqubatlar hech bo'lmaganda hayot bo'lgan bo'lardi.

en: But he did not repent of his crime.
uz: Ammo u o'z jinoyatidan tavba qilmadi.

en: At least he might have found relief in raging at his stupidity, as he had raged at the grotesque blunders that had brought him to prison.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda u o'z ahmoqligidan g'azablanishda yengillik topishi mumkin edi, chunki u uni qamoqqa tashlagan grotesk xatolarga g'azablanardi.

en: But now in prison, in freedom, he thought over and criticised all his actions again and by no means found them so blundering and so grotesque as they had seemed at the fatal time.
uz: Ammo endi u qamoqda, erkinlikda, o'z harakatlarini qayta o'ylab, tanqid qildi va hech qachon ularni o'z vaqtida o'ylagandek g'alati va g'alati ko'rmadi.

en: “In what way,” he asked himself, “was my theory stupider than others that have swarmed and clashed from the beginning of the world?
uz: U o'zidan shunday so'radi: "Mening nazariyam dunyo yaratilgandan beri to'planib, to'qnashgan boshqa nazariyalardan ahmoqroqmi?"

en: One has only to look at the thing quite independently, broadly, and uninfluenced by commonplace ideas, and my idea will by no means seem so … strange.
uz: Faqat bu narsaga mustaqil, keng va oddiy fikrlar ta'siri ostida qarash kerak va mening fikrim hech qachon o'ta ... g'alati ko'rinmaydi.

en: Oh, sceptics and halfpenny philosophers, why do you halt halfway!
uz: Oh, sceptiklar va yarim pullik falsafachilar, nega yarim yo'lda to'xtashingiz kerak!

en: “Why does my action strike them as so horrible?” he said to himself.
uz: Nima uchun mening harakatim ularga shunchalik dahshatli tuyuladi? - deb o'yladi u o'z-o'ziga.

en: “Is it because it was a crime?
uz: Bu jinoyat bo'lgani uchunmi?

en: What is meant by crime?
uz: Jinoyatchilik nimani anglatadi?

en: My conscience is at rest.
uz: Vijdonim xotirjam.

en: Of course, it was a legal crime, of course, the letter of the law was broken and blood was shed.
uz: Albatta, bu qonuniy jinoyat edi, albatta, qonunning harfi buzilgan va qon to'kilgan.

en: Well, punish me for the letter of the law … and that’s enough.
uz: Xo'sh, meni qonunning harfi uchun jazolashingiz kerak... va shu yetarli.

en: Of course, in that case many of the benefactors of mankind who snatched power for themselves instead of inheriting it ought to have been punished at their first steps.
uz: Albatta, o'sha paytda hokimiyatni meros qilib olishning o'rniga o'zlariga o'g'irlab olgan ko'pgina insoniyatga yaxshilik qiluvchi kishilar birinchi qadamlarida jazolanishi kerak edi.

en: But those men succeeded and so they were right, and I didn’t, and so I had no right to have taken that step.” It was only in that that he recognised his criminality, only in the fact that he had been unsuccessful and had confessed it.
uz: Ammo bu odamlar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishdi va ular haqli edilar, men esa bunday qilmadim va shuning uchun men bu qadamni qo'yish huquqiga ega emasdim. U o'z jinoyatchiligini tan olishi, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganligi va buni tan olganligi bilan.

en: He suffered too from the question: why had he not killed himself?
uz: U ham: nega o'zini o'ldirmagan? degan savoldan azob chekdi.

en: Why had he stood looking at the river and preferred to confess?
uz: Nima uchun u daryoga qarab turardi va tan olishni afzal ko'rdi?

en: Was the desire to live so strong and was it so hard to overcome it?
uz: Hayot istagi shunchalik kuchli edi va uni yengish shunchalik qiyinmi edi?

en: Had not Svidrigaïlov overcome it, although he was afraid of death?
uz: Svidrigailov o'limdan qo'rqqan bo'lsa-da, uni yengmaganmidi?

en: In misery he asked himself this question, and could not understand that, at the very time he had been standing looking into the river, he had perhaps been dimly conscious of the fundamental falsity in himself and his convictions.
uz: U o'ziga bu savolni qiynalgan holda berardi va o'sha paytda o'zi ko'z o'ngida turib, daryoga qarab turganida, o'zi va o'z e'tiqodlarining asosiy yolg'onligini bilmaganini tushunmadi.

en: He didn’t understand that that consciousness might be the promise of a future crisis, of a new view of life and of his future resurrection.
uz: U bunday ong kelajakdagi inqiroz, hayotga yangi qarash va kelajakda tirilishining va'dasi bo'lishi mumkinligini tushunmagan.

en: He preferred to attribute it to the dead weight of instinct which he could not step over, again through weakness and meanness.
uz: U uni o'z kuchini yo'qotolmaydigan, yana bir bor zaiflik va kamtarlik orqali o'z instinktining o'lim og'irligiga bog'lashni afzal ko'rdi.

en: He looked at his fellow prisoners and was amazed to see how they all
uz: U o'z mahbuslariga qaradi va ularning barchasining munosabatiga hayron bo'ladi.

en: loved life and prized it.
uz: Hayotni sevgan va qadrlagan.

en: It seemed to him that they loved and valued life more in prison than in freedom.
uz: Uning fikricha, ular qamoqda yashashni erkinlikdan ko'ra ko'proq sevib, hayotga katta e'tibor qaratishgan.

en: What terrible agonies and privations some of them, the tramps for instance, had endured!
uz: Ulardan ba'zilari, masalan, ko'ngillilar, qanday dahshatli azob-uqubat va kamchiliklarga duch kelishgan!

en: Could they care so much for a ray of sunshine, for the primeval forest, the cold spring hidden away in some unseen spot, which the tramp had marked three years before, and longed to see again, as he might to see his sweetheart, dreaming of the green grass round it and the bird singing in the bush?
uz: Ular quyosh nurini, qadimgi o'rmonni, sovuq cho'qqini, uch yil oldin o'zlarining ko'rinmas joylarida yashirin bo'lib qolgan va o'z sevgilisini ko'rish uchun orzu qilgan, atrofida yashil o't va butalarda qo'shiq kuylayotgan qushni ko'rish uchun uch yil oldin belgilagan bir joyni ko'rish uchun shunchalik qayg'urishi mumkinmi?

en: As he went on he saw still more inexplicable examples.
uz: U davom etib, yana ham ko'proq tushuntirilmaydigan misollarni ko'rdi.

en: In prison, of course, there was a great deal he did not see and did not want to see; he lived as it were with downcast eyes.
uz: Zindonda, albatta, ko'rmagan va ko'rishni istamagan ko'p narsalar bor edi; u ko'z yumgan ko'zlar bilan yashardi.

en: It was loathsome and unbearable for him to look.
uz: Uning ko'z o'ngida ko'rinish dahshatli va ko'rinmas edi.

en: But in the end there was much that surprised him and he began, as it were involuntarily, to notice much that he had not suspected before.
uz: Ammo oxir-oqibat uni hayratda qoldirgan ko'p narsa bor edi va u, o'z xohishi bilan bo'lmaganidek, ilgari bilmagan ko'p narsalarni ko'rishni boshladi.

en: What surprised him most of all was the terrible impossible gulf that lay between him and all the rest.
uz: Uni eng hayratda qoldirgan narsa - u bilan boshqalarning o'rtasida turgan dahshatli imkonsiz bo'shliq edi.

en: They seemed to be a different species, and he looked at them and they at him with distrust and hostility.
uz: Ular boshqa turga o'xshardi va u ularga qaradi, ular esa unga ishonchsizlik va dushmanlik bilan qaraydilar.

en: He felt and knew the reasons of his isolation, but he would never have admitted till then that those reasons were so deep and strong.
uz: U o'zini yolg'iz qolib qolishining sabablarini sezgan va bilgan edi, ammo u vaqtgacha bu sabablar shunchalik chuqur va kuchli ekanligini hech qachon tan olmagan.

en: There were some Polish exiles, political prisoners, among them.
uz: Ular orasida ba'zi polyaklar, siyosiy mahbuslar ham bor edi.

en: They simply looked down upon all the rest as ignorant churls; but Raskolnikov could not look upon them like that.
uz: Ular boshqalarning barchasini jaholatli g'alatilar deb pastga ko'rishardi; lekin Raskolnikov ularga shunday qarashni istamagan.

en: He saw that these ignorant men were in many respects far wiser than the Poles.
uz: U ushbu jaholatli odamlarning ko'p jihatdan polyaklardan ancha aqlliroq ekanini ko'rdi.

en: There were some Russians who were just as contemptuous, a former officer and two seminarists.
uz: O'sha paytda ruslar ham shu qadar haqoratli bo'lishgan, bir sobiq ofitser va ikki seminarist bor edi.

en: Raskolnikov saw their mistake as clearly.
uz: Raskolnikov o'z xatolarini ham aniq ko'rdi.

en: He was disliked and avoided by everyone; they even began to hate him at last —why, he could not tell.
uz: Hamma uni yoqtirmasdi va undan qochardi; hatto oxir-oqibat undan nafratlanishni boshlashdi.

en: Men who had been far more guilty despised and laughed at his crime.
uz: O'sha paytgacha ko'proq aybdor bo'lgan kishilar uning jinoyatidan nafratlanib, masxara qilishgan.

en: “You’re a gentleman,” they used to say.
uz: "Siz gentlemansiz", deyishardi.

en: “You shouldn’t hack about with an axe; that’s not a gentleman’s work.” The second week in Lent, his turn came to take the sacrament with his gang.
uz: Siz o'zingizni o'g'irlatishingiz kerak emas; bu xudojo'ylarning ishi emas. Lentning ikkinchi haftasida uning navbatida o'z bandasi bilan diniy marosimga boradi.

en: He went to church and prayed with the others.
uz: U cherkovga borib, boshqalar bilan birga ibodat qilardi.

en: A quarrel broke out one day, he did not know how.
uz: Bir kuni bahs-munozara yuz berdi, u qanday qilishni bilmadi.

en: All fell on him at once in a fury.
uz: Hamma g'azabga to'lib, birdan uning ustiga tushdi.

en: You don’t believe in God,” they shouted.
uz: Siz Xudoga ishonmayapsiz, - deb baqirishdi ular.

en: “You ought to be killed.”
uz: Siz o'ldirilishingiz kerak.

en: He had never talked to them about God nor his belief, but they wanted to kill him as an infidel.
uz: U hech qachon ularga Alloh haqida yoki o'z e'tiqodi haqida gapirmagan edi, lekin ular uni kofir sifatida o'ldirishni xohlashgan.

en: One of the prisoners rushed at him in a perfect frenzy.
uz: Mahbuslardan biri mukammal g'ayritabiiy holatda unga shoshildi.

en: Raskolnikov awaited him calmly and silently; his eyebrows did not quiver, his face did not flinch.
uz: Raskolnikov uni xotirjamlik va xotirjamlik bilan kutib turdi; uning ko'z burchaklari titrmagan, yuzi qoqintirmagan.

en: The guard succeeded in intervening between him and his assailant, or there would have been bloodshed.
uz: Qo'riqchi u bilan uning hujumchisi o'rtasida aralashishga muvaffaq bo'ldi, aks holda qon to'kilishi mumkin edi.

en: There was another question he could not decide: why were they all so fond of Sonia?
uz: U hal qila olmagan yana bir savol bor edi: nima uchun ular hammasi Soniaga shunchalik muhabbat ko'rsatishgan?

en: She did not try to win their favour; she rarely met them, sometimes only she came to see him at work for a moment.
uz: U ularning roziligini olishga urinmadi; ular bilan kam uchrashardi, ba'zan faqat uni bir muncha vaqt ishxonada ko'rish uchun kelgan edi.

en: And yet everybody knew her, they knew that she had come out to follow him, knew how and where she lived.
uz: Lekin hamma uni taniydi, uning unga ergashish uchun chiqqanini, qanday va qayerda yashayotganini bilgan.

en: She never gave them money, did them no particular services.
uz: U ularga hech qachon pul bermagan, ularga hech qanday xizmat ko'rsatmagan.

en: Only once at Christmas she sent them all presents of pies and rolls.
uz: Faqatgina bir marta, Rojdestvo kuni, u barchaga tort va rullar sovg'alarini yubordi.

en: But by degrees closer relations sprang up between them and Sonia.
uz: Ammo ular va Sonia o'rtasida asta-sekin yaqin munosabatlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: She would write and post letters for them to their relations.
uz: U ular uchun qarindoshlariga xatlar yozadi va jo'natadi.

en: Relations of the prisoners who visited the town, at their instructions, left with Sonia presents and money for them.
uz: Shaharga tashrif buyurgan mahbuslarning qarindoshlari ularning ko'rsatmalariga ko'ra, Sonia bilan birga sovg'alar va ularga pul olib ketishdi.

en: Their wives and sweethearts knew her and used to visit her.
uz: Ularning xotinlari va sevgilisi uni tanib-bilishgan va uni ko'rishgan.

en: And when she visited Raskolnikov at work, or met a party of the prisoners on the road, they all took off their hats to her.
uz: U Raskolnikovga ishxonada tashrif buyurganida yoki yo'lda bir guruh mahbuslar bilan uchrashganida, ularning barchasi unga qarshi g'azabini yo'q qilishardi.

en: “Little mother Sofya Semyonovna, you are our dear, good little mother,” coarse branded criminals said to that frail little creature.
uz: Kichik ona Sofya Semyonovna, siz bizning sevimli, yaxshi kichik onamizsiz,  qalin tanilgan jinoyatchilar o'sha zaif kichkina yaratilishga aytishdi.

en: She would smile and bow to them and everyone was delighted when she smiled.
uz: U tabassum qilib, ularga sajda qilardi va hamma uning tabassumidan xursand edi.

en: They even admired her gait and turned round to watch her walking; they admired her too for being so little, and, in fact, did not know what to admire her most for.
uz: Ular hatto uning yurish-turishi va yurish-turishi bilan hayratda bo'lishgan; ular ham unga juda kichikligi uchun hayratda bo'lishgan va, aslida, unga eng ko'p nima uchun hayratda bo'lishlarini bilmas edilar.

en: They even came to her for help in their illnesses.
uz: Ular hatto kasalliklarida yordam so'rab, uning yoniga kelishardi.

en: He was in the hospital from the middle of Lent till after Easter.
uz: U Hosil bayramidan keyin ham kasalxonada bo'lgan.

en: When he was better, he remembered the dreams he had had while he was feverish and delirious.
uz: U sog'lom bo'lganida, o'zining issiq va deliriumli davrida ko'rgan orzularini esladi.

en: He dreamt that the whole world was condemned to a terrible new strange plague that had come to Europe from the depths of Asia.
uz: Uning tushida butun dunyo Asiyaning chuqurligidan Evropaga yetib kelgan dahshatli yangi g'alati ofatga mahkum etilgan edi.

en: All were to be destroyed except a very few chosen.
uz: Barcha, tanlanganlardan tashqari, butunlay yo'q qilinadi.

en: Some new sorts of microbes were attacking the bodies of men, but these microbes were endowed with intelligence and will.
uz: Ba'zi yangi mikroblar inson tanasiga hujum qilib yurgan, ammo bu mikroblar aqlli va irodasini ko'rsatgan.

en: Men attacked by them became at once mad and furious.
uz: Ular tomonidan hujum qilingan odamlar darhol g'azabga tushishdi va g'azabga tushdilar.

en: But never had men considered themselves so intellectual and so completely in possession of the truth as these sufferers, never had they considered their decisions, their scientific conclusions, their
uz: Ammo hech qachon odamlar o'zlarini bu azob chekayotganlar kabi aqlli va haqiqatga to'liq ega deb hisoblamagan, o'z qarorlarini, ilmiy xulosalarini, o'z fikrlarini o'ylab ko'rmagan.

en: moral convictions so infallible.
uz: Oddiy axloqiy e'tiqodlar o'ta to'g'ri.

en: Whole villages, whole towns and peoples went mad from the infection.
uz: To'liq qishloqlar, shaharlar va xalqlar yuqumli kasallikdan g'alati bo'ldi.

en: All were excited and did not understand one another.
uz: Hammasi hayajonlanib, bir-birini tushunishmagandi.

en: Each thought that he alone had the truth and was wretched looking at the others, beat himself on the breast, wept, and wrung his hands.
uz: Har biri haqiqatni faqat o'zi biladi deb o'yladi va boshqalarga qarab, o'zini ko'krakga urib, yig'lab, qo'llarini qovurib, o'zini baxtsiz his qildi.

en: They did not know how to judge and could not agree what to consider evil and what good; they did not know whom to blame, whom to justify.
uz: Ular qanday hukm qilishni bilmas edilar va nima yomon va nima yaxshi deb o'ylashlari bilan kelishib ololmas edilar; kimni ayblash va kimni oqlashlarini bilmas edilar.

en: Men killed each other in a sort of senseless spite.
uz: Erkaklar bir-birlarini o'ldirishganida, bu bir xil behuda ish emas edi.

en: They gathered together in armies against one another, but even on the march the armies would begin attacking each other, the ranks would be broken and the soldiers would fall on each other, stabbing and cutting, biting and devouring each other.
uz: Ular bir-biriga qarshi qo'shinlar bo'lib yig'ilishardi, lekin hatto marshda ham qo'shinlar bir-birlariga hujum qilishni boshlashardi, saflar buzilgan va askarlar bir-birlariga yiqilib, bir-birlarini bo'g'ib-bo'g'ib, kesib-qovurib, bir-birlarini o'g'ib-o'g'ib ketishardi.

en: The alarm bell was ringing all day long in the towns; men rushed together, but why they were summoned and who was summoning them no one knew.
uz: Shaharlarda kun bo'yi qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroqlari qo'ng'iroq qilib turardi; odamlar yig'ilib borishdi, lekin nima uchun ularni chaqirishganini va kim ularni chaqirayotganini hech kim bilmasdi.

en: The most ordinary trades were abandoned, because everyone proposed his own ideas, his own improvements, and they could not agree.
uz: Eng oddiy savdosi tashlandi, chunki har kim o'z g'oyalarini, o'z yaxshilanishlarini taklif qildi va ular rozi bo'lmadi.

en: The land too was abandoned.
uz: Yer ham tashlab ketilgan.

en: Men met in groups, agreed on something, swore to keep together, but at once began on something quite different from what they had proposed.
uz: Erkaklar guruhlar bo'lib yig'ilishdi, bir narsaga kelishib oldilar, birga qolishga qasam ichdilar, lekin darhol ular taklif qilgan narsadan umuman boshqacha narsa bilan shug'ullanishdi.

en: They accused one another, fought and killed each other.
uz: Ular bir-birlarini ayblab, bir-birlari bilan jang qilib, bir-birlarini o'ldirishgan.

en: There were conflagrations and famine.
uz: Yong'inlar va ocharchilik yuz berdi.

en: All men and all things were involved in destruction.
uz: Barcha insonlar va barcha mavjudotlar yo'q qilinish bilan shug'ullanishgan.

en: The plague spread and moved further and further.
uz: O'tkirlik tarqaldi va yanada kengaydi.

en: Only a few men could be saved in the whole world.
uz: Dunyo bo'ylab faqat bir necha kishi najot topishi mumkin edi.

en: They were a pure chosen people, destined to found a new race and a new life, to renew and purify the earth, but no one had seen these men, no one had heard their words and their voices.
uz: Ular pok tanlangan xalq edilar, ular yangi irq va yangi hayotni tashkil etish, yer yuzini yangilash va tozalash uchun tayinlangan edilar, ammo hech kim bu odamlarni ko'rmagan, ularning so'zlarini va ovozlarini eshitmagan edi.

en: Raskolnikov was worried that this senseless dream haunted his memory so miserably, the impression of this feverish delirium persisted so long.
uz: Raskolnikov bu behuda orzu uning xotirasini shunchalik dahshatga solganidan xavotirda ediki, bu qizg'in deliriumning taassurotlari shunchalik uzoq davom etdi.

en: The second week after Easter had come.
uz: Ista bayramidan keyingi ikkinchi hafta keldi.

en: There were warm bright spring days; in the prison ward the grating windows under which the sentinel paced were opened.
uz: Issiq, yorqin bahor kunlari bor edi; qamoqxonada soqchilar o'tadigan chiroqlar ochilgan.

en: Sonia had only been able to visit him twice during his illness; each time she had to obtain permission, and it was difficult.
uz: Sonia kasal bo'lganida uni ikki marta ko'rishgan edi; har safar ruxsat olish kerak edi va bu qiyin edi.

en: But she often used to come to the hospital yard, especially in the evening, sometimes only to stand a minute and look up at the windows of the ward.
uz: Ammo u ko'pincha kasalxona hovliga, ayniqsa kechqurun kelardi, ba'zan bir daqiqa turib, xonadonning derazalariga qarab turardi.

en: One evening, when he was almost well again, Raskolnikov fell asleep.
uz: Bir kuni kechqurun Raskolnikov deyarli sog'ayib ketibdi.

en: On waking up he chanced to go to the window, and at once saw Sonia in the distance at the hospital gate.
uz: U uyg'onganida u darvoza tomoniga bordi va shu zahoti kasalxona darvozasida uzoqdan Soniyani ko'rdi.

en: waiting for someone.
uz: Kimnidir kutmoqda.

en: Something stabbed him to the heart at that minute.
uz: O'sha daqiqada bir narsa uning yuragini o'g'irlab qo'ydi.

en: He shuddered and moved away from the window.
uz: U dahshatga tushib, darvoza tomondan uzoqlashdi.

en: Next day Sonia did not come, nor the day after; he noticed that he was expecting her uneasily.
uz: Ertasi kuni Sonia kelmadi, ertasi kuni ham kelmadi; u uni xavotirda kutib turganini payqadi.

en: At last he was discharged.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u quvib chiqildi.

en: On reaching the prison he learnt from the convicts that Sofya Semyonovna was lying ill at home and was unable to go out.
uz: Zindonga yetib borgach, Sofiya Semyonovna uyda kasal yotganini va tashqariga chiqolmayotganini mahkumlardan bilib oldi.

en: He was very uneasy and sent to inquire after her; he soon learnt that her illness was not dangerous.
uz: U juda xavotirda edi va uning orqasidan so'rash uchun yuborilgan edi; u tez orada uning kasalligi xavfli emasligini bilib oldi.

en: Hearing that he was anxious about her, Sonia sent him a pencilled note, telling him that she was much better, that she had a slight cold and that she would soon, very soon come and see him at his work.
uz: Sonia u uchun tashvishlanayotganini eshitib, unga qalam bilan yozilgan notani yuborib, u ancha yaxshi ekanligi, biroz sovuq bo'lganligi va tez orada, juda tez orada uni ishxonada ko'rishga kelishi haqida aytdi.

en: His heart throbbed painfully as he read it.
uz: Uni o'qiganida uning yuragi og'riqli urdi.

en: Again it was a warm bright day.
uz: Yana issiq, yorqin kun edi.

en: Early in the morning, at six o’clock, he went off to work on the river bank, where they used to pound alabaster and where there was a kiln for baking it in a shed.
uz: Ertalab soat oltilarda u daryo bo'yida ishlash uchun jo'nab ketdi, u yerda alabast qovurishardi va bir cho'pka ichida uni pishirish uchun pech bor edi.

en: There were only three of them sent.
uz: Ulardan faqat uchta kishi yuborilgan edi.

en: One of the convicts went with the guard to the fortress to fetch a tool; the other began getting the wood ready and laying it in the kiln.
uz: Bir mahbus qo'riqchi bilan birga qalaga asbob olish uchun bordi; ikkinchisi esa o'g'ilni tayyorlab, pechga qo'yishni boshladi.

en: Raskolnikov came out of the shed on to the river bank, sat down on a heap of logs by the shed and began gazing at the wide deserted river.
uz: Raskolnikov sheddan chiqib, daryo qirg'og'iga chiqdi, shedning yonida joylashgan daraxtga o'tirdi va keng cho'loq daryoga qaray boshladi.

en: From the high bank a broad landscape opened before him, the sound of singing floated faintly audible from the other bank.
uz: Yuqori qirg'og'idan uning oldida keng manzara ochildi, qo'shiqlarning ovozi boshqa qirg'og'idan kamdan-kam eshitilishi mumkin edi.

en: In the vast steppe, bathed in sunshine, he could just see, like black specks, the nomads’ tents.
uz: Quyosh nurida suvga cho'mgan keng cho'llarda u nomadlar chodirlarini qora to'qimalar kabi ko'rishardi.

en: There there was freedom, there other men were living, utterly unlike those here; there time itself seemed to stand still, as though the age of Abraham and his flocks had not passed.
uz: Bo'lgan erkinlik bor edi, bu yerda boshqa odamlar yashayotgan edi, bu yerda bo'lganlardan umuman farq qiladi; o'sha yerda vaqt o'zi to'xtab turgandek tuyuldi, xuddi Ibrohim va uning qo'ylarining yoshi o'tgan bo'lmaganidek.

en: Raskolnikov sat gazing, his thoughts passed into daydreams, into contemplation; he thought of nothing, but a vague restlessness excited and troubled him.
uz: Raskolnikov o'tirib ko'z o'ngida turardi, uning fikrlari tushlarga, mulohazalarga o'tdi; u hech narsa haqida o'ylamagan, faqat bir noaniq bezovta uni hayajonlantirib, xavotirga solgan.

en: Suddenly he found Sonia beside him; she had come up noiselessly and sat down at his side.
uz: Toʻsatdan Sonia uning yonida boʻlganini koʻrdi; u ovozsiz chiqib, uning yonida oʻtirgan edi.

en: It was still quite early; the morning chill was still keen.
uz: Hali ham juda erta edi; ertalabgi sovuq hali ham kuchli edi.

en: She wore her poor old burnous and the green shawl; her face still showed signs of illness, it was thinner and paler.
uz: U o'zining kambag'al eski burnous va yashil shali kiygan edi; uning yuzi hali ham kasallik belgilarini ko'rsatgan, u kamroq va palroq edi.

en: She gave him a joyful smile of welcome, but held out her hand with her usual timidity.
uz: U unga quvonchli tabassum bilan javob berdi, ammo odatdagidek uyalgan holda qo'lini uzatdi.

en: She was always timid of holding out her hand to him and sometimes did not offer it at all, as though afraid he would repel it.
uz: U har doim unga qo'lini uzatishdan qo'rqardi va ba'zan uni rad etishidan qo'rqqan holda, hech qachon taklif qilmasdi.

en: He always took her hand as though with repugnance, always seemed vexed to meet her and was sometimes obstinately silent throughout her visit.
uz: U har doim uning qo'lidan qo'l urib, xuddi jirkanchlik bilan bo'lgani kabi, uni uchratish uchun har doim g'azabga to'lib, ba'zan uning tashrif davomida qat'iy so'zsiz bo'lgan.

en: Sometimes she trembled before him and went away deeply grieved.
uz: Ba'zan u uning oldida titrab, chuqur qayg'urib ketardi.

en: But now their hands did not part.
uz: Ammo endi ularning qo'llari ajralmadi.

en: He stole a rapid glance at her and dropped his eyes on the ground without speaking.
uz: U qizga tezroq qarab, gapirmasdan yerga ko'zini tashladi.

en: They were alone, no one had seen them.
uz: Ular yolg'iz edilar, hech kim ularni ko'rmagan edi.

en: The guard had turned away for the time.
uz: Qo'riqchi o'sha vaqt uchun yuz o'girdi.

en: How it happened he did not know.
uz: Qanday qilib sodir bo'lganini u bilmagan.

en: But all at once something seemed to seize him and fling him at her feet.
uz: Ammo birdan bir narsa uni ushlab, uning oyoqlariga tashlab ketayotganga o'xshaydi.

en: He wept and threw his arms round her knees.
uz: U yig'lab, qo'llarini ayolning tiz cho'kib qo'ydi.

en: For the first instant she was terribly frightened and she turned pale.
uz: Birinchi daqiqada u juda qo'rqqan va o'zidan oqib ketdi.

en: She jumped up and looked at him trembling.
uz: U o'rnidan o'tib, uni titrab ko'rib qoldi.

en: But at the same moment she understood, and a light of infinite happiness came into her eyes.
uz: Ammo shu zahoti u tushundi va uning ko'zlariga cheksiz baxtning nurlari tushdi.

en: She knew and had no doubt that he loved her beyond everything and that at last the moment had come.
uz: U uni hamma narsadan ustunroq sevishini va nihoyat vaqt kelganini bilardi va shubhalanmagan edi.

en: … They wanted to speak, but could not; tears stood in their eyes.
uz: Ular gapirishni istashardi, lekin qila olmadilar; ko'zlarida yoshlar turardi.

en: They were both pale and thin; but those sick pale faces were bright with the dawn of a new future, of a full resurrection into a new life.
uz: Ular bo'lak va chiroyli edilar; lekin kasal bo'lak yuzlari yangi kelajak, yangi hayotga to'liq tirilishning yorqin yorug'ligi bilan yorqin edi.

en: They were renewed by love; the heart of each held infinite sources of life for the heart of the other.
uz: Ular sevgi bilan yangilandilar; ularning har birining yuragi o'zaro yurak uchun cheksiz hayot manbalarini saqlab qolgan.

en: They resolved to wait and be patient.
uz: Ular sabr-toqat va sabr-toqat bilan kutishga qaror qilishdi.

en: They had another seven years to wait, and what terrible suffering and what infinite happiness before them!
uz: Ularga yana yetti yil kutish kerak edi va ularning oldida naqadar dahshatli azob-uqubat va cheksiz baxt bor edi!

en: But he had risen again and he knew it and felt it in all his being, while she —she only lived in his life.
uz: Ammo u yana o'lib chiqdi va u buni bilgan va butun mavjudotida his qilgan, ammo u faqat uning hayotida yashaydi.

en: On the evening of the same day, when the barracks were locked, Raskolnikov lay on his plank bed and thought of her.
uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun, kasarnalar qulflab qo'yilganida, Raskolnikov o'zining lavha yotoqida yotgan edi va u haqida o'yladi.

en: He had even fancied that day that all the convicts who had been his enemies looked at him differently; he had even entered into talk with them and they answered him in a friendly way.
uz: U hatto o'sha kuni dushman bo'lgan barcha mahbuslar unga boshqacha qarashlarini tasavvur qilgan edi; u hatto ular bilan suhbatga kirgan edi va ular unga do'stona javob berishgan.

en: He remembered that now, and thought it was bound to be so.
uz: U buni endi esladi va bu albatta shunday bo'lishi kerak deb o'yladi.

en: Wasn’t everything now bound to be changed?
uz: Endi hamma narsa o'zgarishi kerak emasmi?

en: He remembered how continually he had tormented her and wounded her heart.
uz: U o'zining qizni har doim azoblab, yuragini og'ritganini esladi.

en: He remembered her pale and thin little face.
uz: U uning bo'lak-bo'lak va chiroyli yuzini esladi.

en: But these recollections scarcely troubled him now; he knew with what infinite love he would now repay all her sufferings.
uz: Ammo bu xotiralar uni endi tashvishga soladi; u endi uning azob-uqubatlarini qanday cheksiz sevgi bilan qoplay olishini bilardi.

en: And what were all, all the agonies of the past!
uz: Va o'tmishdagi azoblarning barchasi nima edi!

en: Everything, even his crime, his sentence and imprisonment, seemed to him now in the first rush of feeling an external, strange fact with which he had no concern.
uz: Hamma narsa, hatto uning jinoyatlari, hukmlari va qamoq jazosi, unga hozirda tashqi, g'ayrioddiy faktni his qilishning birinchi shoshqati bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: But he could not think for long together of anything that evening, and he could not have analysed anything consciously; he
uz: Ammo u kechqurun hech narsa haqida uzoq vaqt birga o'ylay olmagan va u hech narsani ongli ravishda tahlil qila olmagan.

en: Life had stepped into the place of theory and something quite different would work itself out in his mind.
uz: Hayot nazariya o'rnini egallagan va uning ongida o'ziga xos boshqacha narsa paydo bo'lgan.

en: Under his pillow lay the New Testament.
uz: Uning yastog'i ostida Yangi Ahd yozilgan edi.

en: He took it up mechanically.
uz: U buni mexanik ravishda o'zlashtirdi.

en: The book belonged to Sonia; it was the one from which she had read the raising of Lazarus to him.
uz: Bu kitob Soniaga tegishli edi; u o'sha kitobdan Lazarning tirilishi haqida unga o'qib bergan edi.

en: At first he was afraid that she would worry him about religion, would talk about the gospel and pester him with books.
uz: Boshida u ayol uni din haqida tashvishlantirib, Injil haqida gapirib, kitoblar bilan ta'qib qilishidan qo'rqardi.

en: But to his great surprise she had not once approached the subject and had not even offered him the Testament.
uz: Ammo u juda hayron edi, chunki u bu mavzuga bir marta ham murojaat qilmagan va hatto vasiyatni ham taklif qilmagan edi.

en: He had asked her for it himself not long before his illness and she brought him the book without a word.
uz: Kasalligidan oldin u o'zi undan kitobni so'ragan edi va u so'zsiz unga kitobni olib keldi.

en: Till now he had not opened it.
uz: Hozirgacha u uni ochmagan edi.

en: He did not open it now, but one thought passed through his mind: “Can her convictions not be mine now?
uz: U endi uni ochmadi, lekin bir fikr uning ongidan o'tdi: "Uning e'tiqodlari endi mening o'zimga tegishli bo'lmasmidi?

en: Her feelings, her aspirations at least.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda uning his-tuyg'ulari, orzu-istaklari.

en: …” She too had been greatly agitated that day, and at night she was taken ill again.
uz: O'sha kuni u ham juda xavotirda edi va kechasi yana kasal bo'ldi.

en: But she was so happy —and so unexpectedly happy —that she was almost frightened of her happiness.
uz: Ammo u shunchalik baxtli va kutilmagan darajada baxtli ediki, o'z baxtidan deyarli qo'rqardi.

en: Seven years, only seven years!
uz: Yetti yil, faqat yetti yil!

en: At the beginning of their happiness at some moments they were both ready to look on those seven years as though they were seven days.
uz: Ba'zi bir paytlarda ular baxtli bo'lishning boshida, o'sha yetti yilni yetti kun kabi ko'rishga tayyor edilar.

en: He did not know that the new life would not be given him for nothing, that he would have to pay dearly for it, that it would cost him great striving, great suffering.
uz: U yangi hayotga bepul ega bo'lmasligini, buning evaziga qimmatga tushishi kerakligini, katta mehnat va og'ir azob chekishi kerakligini bilmagan.

en: But that is the beginning of a new story —the story of the gradual renewal of a man, the story of his gradual regeneration, of his passing from one world into another, of his initiation into a new unknown life.
uz: Ammo bu yangi hikoyaning boshlanishi - insonning asta-sekin yangilanishi, uning asta-sekin qayta tiklanishi, bir dunyodan boshqasiga o'tishi, yangi noma'lum hayotga kirishi haqidagi hikoya.

en: That might be the subject of a new story, but our present story is ended.
uz: Bu yangi hikoyaning mavzusi bo'lishi mumkin, ammo hozirgi hikoyamiz tugadi.

en: A cou- ple of hundred years ago men possessed the history of little more than the last three thousand years.
uz: Yuz yil oldingi odamlar oxirgi uch ming yildagidan ko'p bo'lmagan tarixga ega edilar.

en: What happened before that time was a matter of legend and speculation.
uz: O'sha vaqtdan oldin sodir bo'lgan voqea afsona va taxmin masalasi edi.

en: Over a large part of the civilized world it was be- lieved and taught that the world had been created suddenly in 4004 B.C., though authorities differed as to whether this had occurred in the spring or autumn of that year.
uz: Madaniyatli dunyoning katta qismida dunyo miloddan avvalgi 4004-yilda to'satdan yaratilgan deb yolg'on gapirildi va o'rgatildi, garchi bu voqea o'sha yilning bahorida yoki kuzida sodir bo'lganmi, degan savolda rasmiylar bir-biridan farq qilishgan.

en: This fantastically precise misconception was based upon a too literal interpretation of the Hebrew Bible, and upon rather arbi- trary theological assumptions connected therewith.
uz: Bu ajoyib aniq noto'g'ri tushuncha Ibroniy Injilning juda so'zma-so'z talqiniga va u bilan bog'liq arbi-trary teologik taxminlarga asoslangan edi.

en: Such ideas have long since been abandoned by religious teachers, and it is universally recognized that the universe in which we live has to all appearances existed for an enormous period of time and possibly for endless time.
uz: Bunday g'oyalar diniy o'qituvchilar tomonidan allaqachon voz kechilgan va biz yashayotgan olam barcha ko'rinishlarga ko'ra ulkan vaqt va ehtimol cheksiz vaqt davomida mavjud bo'lganligi universally tan olingan.

en: Of course there may be deception in these appearances, as a room may be made to seem endless by putting mirrors facing each other at either end.
uz: Albatta, bu ko'rinishlarda aldov bo'lishi mumkin, chunki xona har ikki uchida bir-biriga qaragan oynalarni qo'yish orqali cheksiz ko'rinishi mumkin.

en: But that the universe in which we live has existed only for six or seven thousand years may be re- garded as an altogether exploded idea.
uz: Ammo biz yashayotgan olamning faqat olti-yetti ming yil mavjud bo'lgani butunlay portlagan g'oya sifatida qayta saqlanishi mumkin.

en: The earth, as everybody knows nowadays, is a spheroid, a sphere slightly compressed, orange fashion, with a diameter of nearly 8,000 miles.
uz: Yer, hozirgi kunda hamma biladiganidek, sferoddir, biroz siqilgan, to'q sariq rangli sharikdir, diametri deyarli 8 000 mil.

en: Its spherical shape has been known at least to a limited number of intelligent people for nearly 2,500 years, but before that time it was supposed to be ﬂat, and various ideas which now seem fantastic were entertained about its relations to the sky and the stars and planets.
uz: Uning sferik shakli deyarli 2500 yildan beri aqlli odamlarning cheklangan soniga ma'lum bo'lgan, lekin o'sha vaqtgacha u tekis bo'lishi kerak edi va hozir fantastik ko'rinadigan turli xil g'oyalar uning osmon, yulduzlar va sayyoralar bilan aloqalari haqida qiziqtirilgan edi.

en: We know now that it rotates upon its axis (which is about 24 miles shorter than its equatorial diameter) every twenty-four hours, and that this is the cause of the alternations of day and night, that it circles about the sun in a slightly distorted and slowly vari-
uz: Biz endi bilamizki, u har yigirma to'rt soatda o'z o'qida aylanadi (bu uning ekvatorial diametriga qaraganda taxminan 24 mil qisqa), va bu kun va tun o'zgarishlarining sababi, u quyosh atrofida biroz buzilgan va sekin-asta aylanadi.

en: able oval path in a year.
uz: Bir yilda qodir bo'lgan oval yo'l.

en: Its distance from the sun varies between ninety-one and a half millions at its nearest and ninety-four and a half million miles.
uz: Uning quyoshdan masofasi eng yaqinida to'qson bir yarim million va to'qson to'rt yarim million mil oralig'ida o'zgaradi.

en: “LUMINOUS SPIRAL CLOUDS OF MATTER”  (Nebula photographed 1910)  Photo: G.
uz: MASIYATNING YORIG'LI SPIRAL SOCHLARI (Nebulosa 1910-yilda suratga olingan) Foto: G.

en: Ritchey About the earth circles a smaller sphere, the moon, at an average distance of 239,000 miles.
uz: Ritchey Yer atrofida o'rtacha 239,000 mil masofada kichikroq sferasi, Oy aylanadi.

en: Earth and moon are not the only bodies to travel round the sun.
uz: Yer va oy quyosh atrofida aylanadigan yagona jismlar emas.

en: There are also the planets, Mercury and Venus, at distances of thir- ty-six and sixty-seven millions of miles; and beyond the circle of the earth
uz: Shuningdek, uch-olti-yetti va oltmish-yetti million mil masofada joylashgan sayyoralar, Merkuriy va Venera bor; va Yer aylanasidan tashqarida.

en: and disregarding a belt of numerous smaller bodies, the planetoids, there are Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune at mean distances of 141, 483, 886, 1,782, and 1,793 millions of miles respectively.
uz: Va ko'plab kichikroq jismlar, sayyoralar kamarini hisobga olmaganda, Mars, Yupiter, Saturn, Uran va Neptun o'rtacha masofada mos ravishda 141, 483, 886, 1,782 va 1,793 million mil masofada mavjud.

en: These ﬁgures in mil- lions of miles are very difﬁcult for the mind to grasp.
uz: Bu minglab millardagi raqamlarni ong tushunishi juda qiyin.

en: It may help the read- er’s imagination if we reduce the sun and planets to a smaller, more con- ceivable scale.
uz: Agar quyosh va sayyoralarni kichikroq, osonroq masshtabga tushirsak, o'quvchi tasavvurlariga yordam berishi mumkin.

en: THE NEBULA SEEN EDGE-ON  Note the central core which, through millions of years, is cooling to solidity
uz: NEBULA KO'RILGAN QISMI Million yillar davomida sovib, mustahkamlikka erishayotgan markaziy yadroga e'tibor bering.

en: Ritchey If, then, we represent our earth as a little ball of one inch diameter, the sun would be a big globe nine feet across and 323 yards away, that is about a ﬁfth of a mile, four or ﬁve minutes’ walking.
uz: Agar biz Yer yuzini bir dyuym diametrli kichik shar sifatida tasavvur qilsak, quyosh kengligi to'qqiz fut va 323 yard bo'lgan katta globus bo'lardi, bu bir milning beshdan bir qismi, to'rt yoki besh daqiqa piyoda yurish demakdir.

en: The moon would be a small pea two feet and a half from the world.
uz: Oy dunyodan ikki yarim fut uzoqlikda kichik bir no'xat bo'lardi.

en: Between earth and sun there would be the two inner planets, Mercury and Venus, at distances of one hundred and twenty-ﬁve and two hundred and ﬁfty yards from the sun.
uz: Yer va quyosh o'rtasida quyoshdan bir yuz yigirma besh va ikki yuz ellik yard masofada joylashgan ikkita ichki sayyora, Merkuriy va Venera bo'lardi.

en: All round and about these bodies there would be emptiness until you came to Mars, a hundred and seventy-ﬁve feet beyond the earth; Jupiter nearly a mile away, a foot in diameter; Saturn, a little smaller, two miles off; Uranus four miles off and Neptune six miles off.
uz: Butun atrofda va bu jismlar atrofida bo'shliq bo'ladi, toki siz Marsga yetib bormaguningizcha, yerdan yuz yetmish besh fut uzoqlikda; Yupiter deyarli bir mil uzoqlikda, diametri bir fut; Saturn, biroz kichikroq, ikki mil uzoqlikda; Uran to'rt mil uzoqlikda va Neptun olti mil uzoqlikda.

en: Then nothingness and nothingness except for small particles and drifting scraps of attenuated vapour for thousands of miles.
uz: Keyin hech narsalik va hech narsalik, faqat mayda zarrachalar va minglab millar davomida suzuvchi susaygan bug' qoldiqlaridan tashqari.

en: The nearest star to earth on this scale would be 40,000 miles away.
uz: Bu shkala boʻyicha Yerga eng yaqin yulduz 40 000 mil uzoqlikda boʻladi.

en: These ﬁgures will serve perhaps to give one some conception of the im- mense emptiness of space in which the drama of life goes on.
uz: Bu raqamlar, ehtimol, hayot dramasi davom etayotgan fazoning insonlar uchun bo'shlig'i haqida biroz tasavvurga ega bo'lishga yordam beradi.

en: For in all this enormous vacancy of space we know certainly of life only upon the surface of our earth.
uz: Chunki butun bu ulkan fazo bo'shlig'ida biz faqat yer yuzida hayot haqida aniq bilamiz.

en: It does not penetrate much more than three miles down into the 4,000 miles that separate us from the centre of our globe, and it does not reach more than ﬁve miles above its surface.
uz: U bizni globus markazidan ajratib turuvchi 4000 milga uch mildan ko'p pastga tushmaydi va uning yuzasi ustida besh mildan ko'pga yetmaydi.

en: Appar- ently all the limitlessness of space is otherwise empty and dead.
uz: Ko'rinishidan, butun fazoning cheksizligi bo'sh va o'likdir.

en: The deepest ocean dredgings go down to ﬁve miles.
uz: Eng chuqur okean dredjlari besh milgacha tushadi.

en: The highest recorded ﬂight of an aeroplane is little more than four miles.
uz: Samolyotning eng yuqori qayd etilgan parvozi to'rt mildan sal ko'proq emas.

en: Men have reached to seven miles up in balloons, but at a cost of great suffering.
uz: Erkaklar sharlarda yetti mil balandlikka yetib kelishdi, lekin katta azob evaziga.

en: No bird can ﬂy so high as ﬁve miles, and small birds and insects which have been carried up by aeroplanes drop off insensible far below that level.
uz: Hech bir qush besh mil balandlikda uchib ketolmaydi va samolyotlar tomonidan ko'tarib ketilgan kichik qushlar va hasharotlar bu darajadan ancha pastda sezilmasdan tushadi.

en: II THE WORLD IN TIME In the last ﬁfty years there has been much very ﬁne and interesting specula- tion on the part of scientiﬁc men upon the age and origin of our earth.
uz: II ZAMONDAGI DUNYO So'nggi ellik yil ichida olimlar tomonidan Yerimizning yoshi va kelib chiqishi bo'yicha juda yaxshi va qiziqarli taxminlar bo'ldi.

en: Here we cannot pretend to give even a summary of such speculations because they involve the most subtle mathematical and physical considerations.
uz: Bu yerda biz bunday taxminlarning hatto qisqacha ma'lumot berishga ham o'xshamaymiz, chunki ular eng nozik matematik va fizik mulohazalarni o'z ichiga oladi.

en: The truth is that the physical and astronomical sciences are still too undeveloped as yet to make anything of the sort more than an illustrative guesswork.
uz: Haqiqat shuki, fizikaviy va astronomik fanlar hali ham illyustrativ taxminlardan ko'ra ko'proq narsa yasash uchun juda rivojlanmagan.

en: The gener- al tendency has been to make the estimated age of our globe longer and longer.
uz: Umumiy tendensiya shundan iboratki, bizning globusimizning taxminiy yoshi tobora uzayib bormoqda.

en: It now seems probable that the earth has had an independent exis- tence as a spinning planet ﬂying round and round the sun for a longer period than 2,000,000,000 years.
uz: Hozirgi kunda Yer quyosh atrofida aylanib yurgan aylanuvchi sayyorada 2,000,000,000 yildan ko'proq vaqt davomida mustaqil mavjudlikka ega bo'lgani ehtimoliy ko'rinadi.

en: It may have been much longer than that.
uz: Balki bundan ham uzoqroq bo'lgandir.

en: This is a length of time that absolutely overpowers the imagination.
uz: Bu tasavvurni mutlaqo yengib o'tuvchi vaqt.

en: Before that vast period of separate existence, the sun and earth and the other planets that circulate round the sun may have been a great swirl of dif- fused matter in space.
uz: O'sha ulkan alohida mavjudlik davridan oldin, quyosh va Yer hamda Quyosh atrofida aylanadigan boshqa sayyoralar fazoda diffuzatsiyalangan materiyaning katta aylanishi bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The telescope reveals to us in various parts of the heavens luminous spiral clouds of matter, the spiral nebulæ, which appear to be in rotation about a centre.
uz: Teleskop bizga osmonning turli qismlarida materiyaning yorqin spiral bulutlarini, markaz atrofida aylanayotgandek ko'rinadigan spiral tumanlarni ko'rsatadi.

en: It is supposed by many astronomers that the sun and its planets were once such a spiral, and that their matter has under- gone concentration into its present form.
uz: Ko'pgina astronomlar quyosh va uning sayyoralari bir vaqtlar shunday spiral bo'lgan va ularning materiyasi hozirgi shakliga to'planmay qolgan deb taxmin qilishadi.

en: Through majestic æons that con- centration went on until in that vast remoteness of the past for which we have given ﬁgures, the world and its moon were distinguishable.
uz: O'sha ulug'vor davrlar davomida markazlash o'tmishning ulkan olisligigacha davom etdi, biz uning uchun shakllarni bergan edik, dunyo va uning oyi ajralib turardi.

en: They were spinning then much faster than they are spinning now; they were at a lesser distance from the sun; they travelled round it very much faster, and they were probably incandescent or molten at the surface.
uz: Ular o'shanda hozirgi aylanishidan ancha tez aylanayotgan edi; ular quyoshdan kamroq masofada edilar; ular uning atrofida ancha tezroq harakat qilishardi va ular, ehtimol, sirtda yonib turgan yoki erigan edi.

en: The sun itself was a much greater blaze in the heavens.
uz: Quyoshning o'zi osmonda ancha katta olov edi.

en: THE GREAT SPIRAL NEBULA  Photo: G.
uz: BUYUK SPIRAL NEBULA Foto: G.

en: Ritchey If we could go back through that inﬁnitude of time and see the earth in this earlier stage of its history, we should behold a scene more like the interi- or of a blast furnace or the surface of a lava ﬂow before it cools and cakes over than any other contemporary scene.
uz: Agar biz o'sha cheksiz vaqtdan orqaga qaytib, Yerni o'z tarixining bu erta bosqichida ko'ra olsak, biz boshqa har qanday zamonaviy sahnaga qaraganda, sovuqlashdan oldin lava oqimi yoki portlash pechining ichki qismiga yoki yuziga ko'proq o'xshash sahnani ko'rishimiz kerak edi.

en: No water would be visible because all the water there was would still be superheated steam in a stormy at- mosphere of sulphurous and metallic vapours.
uz: Hech qanday suv ko'rinmas edi, chunki u yerda bo'lgan barcha suv hali ham oltingugurtli va metall bug'larning bo'ronli ko'rinishida haddan tashqari issiq bug' bo'lardi.

en: Beneath this would swirl and boil an ocean of molten rock substance.
uz: Buning ostida erigan tosh moddasining okeani aylanib qaynashi mumkin edi.

en: Across a sky of ﬁery clouds the glare of the hurrying sun and moon would sweep swiftly like hot breaths of ﬂame.
uz: Olovli bulutlar osmonida shoshilinch quyosh va oyning nuri olovning issiq nafaslari kabi tez surildi.

en: A DARK NEBULA Taken in 1920 with the aid of the largest telescope in the world.
uz: Qorong'u NEBULA 1920-yilda dunyodagi eng katta teleskop yordamida olingan.

en: One of the ﬁrst photographs taken by the Mount Wilson telescope.
uz: Mount Wilson teleskopi tomonidan olingan birinchi fotosuratlardan biri.

en: There are dark nebulæ and bright nebulæ.
uz: Qorong'u tumanlar va yorqin tumanlar bor.

en: Henry Norris Russell,
uz: Genri Norris Rassel,

en: against the British theory, holds that the dark nebulæ preceded the bright nebulæ.
uz: Britaniya nazariyasiga zid ravishda, qorong'u tuman yorqin tumanlardan oldin kelgan deb hisoblanadi.

en: Hale Slowly by degrees as one million of years followed another, this ﬁery scene would lose its eruptive incandescence.
uz: Hale asta-sekin bir million yil o'tgach, bu olovli sahna o'zining otilish nurini yo'qotardi.

en: The vapours in the sky would rain down and become less dense overhead; great slaggy cakes of solidifying rock would appear upon the surface of the molten sea, and sink under it, to be replaced by other ﬂoating masses.
uz: Osmondagi bug'lar yog'ib, tepada kamroq zich bo'lardi; erigan dengiz yuzasida qattiqlashadigan toshdan yasalgan katta shlakli tortlar paydo bo'lardi va uning ostida cho'kib, boshqa suzuvchi massalar bilan almashtirilishi kerak edi.

en: The sun and moon growing now each more distant and each smaller, would rush with diminishing swiftness across the heavens.
uz: Quyosh va oy endi tobora uzoqlashib, tobora kichrayib borar ekan, osmon bo'ylab sekin-asta tezlik bilan shoshilardi.

en: The moon now, because of its smaller size, would be already cooled far below incandescence, and would be alternately obstructing and reﬂecting the sunlight in a series of eclipses and full moons.
uz: Oy endi, o'zining kichikroq o'lchami tufayli, allaqachon quyosh nuridan ancha pastda sovutilardi va bir qator tutilishlar va to'lin oylarda vaqti-vaqti bilan quyosh nurini to'sib, aks ettirardi.

en: ANOTHER SPIRAL NEBULA  Photo: G.
uz: BOSHQA SPIRAL NEBULA Foto: G.

en: Ritchey And so with a tremendous slowness through the vastness of time, the earth would grow more and more like the earth on which we live, until at last an age would come when, in the cooling air, steam would begin to condense
uz: Shunday qilib, vaqt kengligi davomida ulkan sekinlik bilan yer biz yashayotgan yer kabi tobora o'sib borardi, toki nihoyat sovutish havoda bug' kondensatsiya qila boshlaydigan bir davr kelguncha.

en: into clouds, and the ﬁrst rain would fall hissing upon the ﬁrst rocks below.
uz: bulutlarga tushardi va birinchi yomg'ir pastdagi birinchi toshlarga shivirlab tushardi.

en: For endless millenia the greater part of the earth’s water would still be va- porized in the atmosphere, but there would now be hot streams running over the crystallizing rocks below and pools and lakes into which these streams would be carrying detritus and depositing sediment.
uz: Cheksiz ming yillar davomida Yer suvining katta qismi atmosferaga kirib borardi, lekin hozirda pastdagi kristalllashgan toshlar, havzalar va ko'llar ustidan issiq oqimlar oqib o'tadi, bu oqimlar ularga detritus olib kirardi va cho'kindi tashlardi.

en: LANDSCAPE BEFORE LIFE “Great lava-like masses of rock without traces of soil” At last a condition of things must have been attained in which a man might have stood up on earth and looked about him and lived.
uz: HAYOTDAN OLDINGI LANDSKOP Tosh izsiz lavaga o'xshash ulkan to'plamlar Nihoyat, odam yer yuzida turib, atrofga qarab yashashi mumkin bo'lgan bir holatga erishilgan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: If we could have visited the earth at that time we should have stood on great lava-like masses of rock without a trace of soil or touch of living vegetation, under a storm-rent sky.
uz: Agar o'sha paytda Yerga tashrif buyurishimiz mumkin bo'lganida, biz to'fonli osmon ostida, tuproq izsiz yoki tirik o'simliklar teginishisiz, katta lavaga o'xshash tosh massalarida turardik.

en: Hot and violent winds, exceeding the ﬁercest tornado that ever blows, and downpours of rain such as our milder, slower earth to-day knows nothing of, might have assailed us.
uz: Issiq va shiddatli shamollar, har qachongidan ham kuchli bo'lgan tornado va bizning yengilroq, sekinroq yerimiz kabi yomg'ir to'lqinlari bugungi kunda hech narsa bilmasligimiz sababli, bizga hujum qilishi mumkin edi.

en: The water of the downpour would have rushed by us, muddy with the spoils of the rocks, coming together into torrents, cutting deep gorges and canyons as they hurried past to deposit their sediment in the earliest seas.
uz: Yomg'ir suvi biz tomondan shoshilgan bo'lardi, loyqa toshlar bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, daryolarga birlashib, chuqur daryolar va kanyonlarni kesib o'tardi, ular eng erta dengizlarga cho'kindilarini tashlash uchun shoshilishardi.

en: Through the clouds we should have
uz: Bulutlar orqali bizda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan

en: glimpsed a great sun moving visibly across the sky, and in its wake and in the wake of the moon would have come a diurnal tide of earthquake and up- heaval.
uz: Osmon bo'ylab ko'rinib turgan ulkan quyoshni ko'rdim va uning orqasidan va oy orqasidan zilzila va ko'tarilishning kunlik to'lqini kelardi.

en: And the moon, which nowadays keeps one constant face to earth, would then have been rotating visibly and showing the side it now hides so inexorably.
uz: Va hozirgi kunda doimiy ravishda yer yuzida bo'lgan oy, o'shanda ko'rinadigan aylanib, hozir yashiringan tomonini shunchalik tinimsiz ko'rsatardi.

en: One million years followed another, and the day length- ened, the sun grew more distant and milder, the moon’s pace in the sky slackened; the intensity of rain and storm diminished and the water in the ﬁrst seas increased and ran together into the ocean garment our planet hence- forth wore.
uz: Bir million yil o'tgach, kun uzunligi kengayib, quyosh yanada uzoqlashdi va yumshoqlashdi, oy osmonida sekinlashdi; yomg'ir va bo'ronning intensivligi kamaydi va birinchi dengizlardagi suv ko'paydi va birgalikda okean libosiga yugurdi, sayyoramiz bundan buyon eskirdi.

en: But there was no life as yet upon the earth; the seas were lifeless, and the rocks were barren.
uz: Ammo yer yuzida hali hayot yo'q edi; dengizlar jonsiz edi va toshlar bepusht edi.

en: III THE BEGINNINGS OF LIFE As everybody knows nowadays, the knowledge we possess of life before the beginnings of human memory and tradition is derived from the markings and fossils of living things in the stratiﬁed rocks.
uz: III HAYOT BOSHLARI Hozirgi kunda hamma biladiganidek, inson xotirasi va an'anasining boshlanishidan oldingi hayot haqidagi bilimimiz qatlamlashtirilgan toshlardagi tirik mavjudotlarning belgilari va qoldiqlaridan kelib chiqqan.

en: We ﬁnd preserved in shale and slate, limestone, and sandstone, bones, shells, ﬁbres, stems, fruits, footmarks, scratchings and the like, side by side with the ripple marks of the earliest tides and the pittings of the earliest rain-falls.
uz: Biz shag'al va shifer, ohaktosh va qum toshlarida, suyaklarda, qobiqlarda, tolalarda, poyalarda, mevalarda, oyoq izlarida, tirnalishlarda va shunga o'xshash holatlarda, eng erta to'lqinlarning to'lqin izlari va eng erta yomg'irlarning teshiklari bilan yonma-yon saqlanib qolganini topamiz.

en: It is by the sedulous examina- tion of this Record of the Rocks that the past history of the earth’s life has been pieced together.
uz: Aynan shu Toshlar yozuvining chuqur o'rganilishi natijasida Yer hayotining o'tmish tarixi bir-biriga bog'langan.

en: That much nearly everybody knows to-day.
uz: Bugungi kunda deyarli hamma biladigan narsa shu.
