en: The sedi- mentary rocks do not lie neatly stratum above stratum; they have been crum- pled, bent, thrust about, distorted and mixed together like the leaves of a li- brary that has been repeatedly looted and burnt, and it is only as a result of many devoted lifetimes of work that the record has been put into order and read.
uz: Sedi-mentar toshlar qatlam ustida bir tekis yotmaydi; ular bir-biriga qayta-qayta talon-toroj qilingan va yoqilgan libriy barglari kabi maydalangan, bukilgan, ag'darilgan, buzilgan va aralashtirilgan, va faqat ko'plab bag'ishlangan mehnatlar natijasida yozuv tartibga solingan va o'qilgan.

en: The whole compass of time represented by the record of the rocks is now estimated as 1,600,000,000 years.
uz: Toshlarning yozuvi bilan ifodalangan butun vaqt kompasini hozirda 1,600,000,000 yil deb baholash mumkin.

en: The earliest rocks in the record are called by geologists the Azoic rocks, because they show no traces of life.
uz: Yozuvdagi eng qadimgi toshlar geologlar tomonidan azoik toshlar deb ataladi, chunki ular hayot izlarini ko'rsatmaydi.

en: Great areas of these Azoic rocks lie un- covered in North America, and they are of such a thickness that geologists consider that they represent a period of at least half of the 1,600,000,000 which they assign to the whole geological record.
uz: Ushbu azoik qoyalarning katta maydonlari Shimoliy Amerikada qoplanmagan holda joylashgan va ular shunchalik qalinki, geologlar ular butun geologik yozuvga tayinlagan 1,600,000,000 dan kamida yarmini tashkil etadi deb hisoblashadi.

en: Let me repeat this pro- foundly signiﬁcant fact.
uz: Keling, bu juda muhim faktni takrorlay.

en: Half the great interval of time since land and sea were ﬁrst distinguishable on earth has left us no traces of life.
uz: Yer va dengiz yer yuzida birinchi marta ajralib turgandan beri katta vaqtning yarmi bizga hayot izlarini qoldirmadi.

en: There are rip- plings and rain marks still to be found in these rocks, but no marks nor ves- tiges of any living thing.
uz: Bu toshlarda hali ham yoriqlar va yomg'ir izlari topilishi mumkin, lekin hech qanday tirik mavjudotning izlari ham, yo'lbarslari ham yo'q.

en: MARINE LIFE IN THE CAMBRIAN PERIOD 1 and 8, Jellyﬁshes; 2, Hyolithes (swimming snail); 3, Humenocaris; 4, Pro- tospongia; 5, Lampshells (Obolella); 6, Orthoceras; 7, Trilobite (Paradox- ides) — see fossil on page 13; 9, Coral (Archæocyathus); 10, Bryograptus; 11, Trilobite (Olenellus); 12, Palesterina
uz: KAMBRIYA DAVRIDA 1 va 8-DAVOLARDA Meduzalar; 2, Hyolitlar (suzuvchi salyangoz); 3, Humenocaris; 4, Pro-tospongia; 5, Lampa qobig'i (Obolella); 6, Orthoceras; 7, Trilobit (Paradox- ides)  13-betda fosiliga qarang; 9, Archæocyathus; 10, Bryograptus; 11, Trilobit (Olenellus); 12, Palesterina

en: Then, as we come up the record, signs of past life appear and increase.
uz: Keyin, yozuvni ko'rib chiqayotganda, o'tmish hayoti alomatlari paydo bo'ladi va kuchayadi.

en: The age of the world’s history in which we ﬁnd these past traces is called by geologists the Lower Palæozoic age.
uz: Dunyo tarixining biz bu o'tmish izlarini topgan davri geologlar tomonidan Quyi Paleozoik davr deb ataladi.

en: The ﬁrst indications that life was astir are vestiges of comparatively simple and lowly things: the shells of small shellﬁsh, the stems and ﬂowerlike heads of zoophytes, seaweeds and the tracks and remains of sea worms and crustacea.
uz: Hayot o'tkir bo'lganligining dastlabki belgilari nisbatan oddiy va oddiy narsalarning qoldiqlari: mayda suvoqlarning qobig'i, zoofitlarning poyalari va gulsimon boshlari, dengiz o'tlari hamda dengiz qurtlari va qisqichbaqasimonlarning izlari va qoldiqlari.

en: Very early appear certain creatures rather like plant-lice, crawling creatures which could roll them- selves up into balls as the plant-lice do, the trilobites.
uz: Juda erta paydo bo'ladigan ba'zi mavjudotlar ko'proq o'simlik bo'lagiga o'xshaydi, ularni o'rab oladigan sudralib yuruvchi mavjudotlar - o'zini o'simlik bo'lagi kabi sharlarga aylantiradi, trilobitlar.

en: Later by a few million years or so come certain sea scorpions, more mobile and powerful creatures than the world had ever seen before.
uz: Keyinroq, bir necha million yillar o'tgach, dunyo ilgari ko'rganidan ko'ra ko'proq harakatchan va qudratli bo'lgan ayrim dengiz sharpionlari paydo bo'ladi.

en: FOSSIL TRILOBITE (SLIGHTLY MAGNIFIED)  Photo: John J.
uz: FOSSIL TRILOBIT (YORIG'I KATTA) Foto: Jon J.

en: None of these creatures were of very great size.
uz: Bu mavjudotlarning hech biri juda katta o'lchamga ega emas edi.

en: Among the largest were certain of the sea scorpions, which measured nine feet in length.
uz: Eng kattalari orasida dengiz chayonlari ham bor edi, ularning uzunligi to'qqiz fut edi.

en: There are no signs whatever of land life of any sort, plant or animal; there are no ﬁshes nor any vertebrated creatures in this part of the record.
uz: Yer yuzidagi hayotning hech qanday belgilari yo'q, hech qanday o'simlik yoki hayvon yo'q; bu yozuv qismida na baliqlar, na umurtqali mavjudotlar mavjud emas.

en: Essentially all the plants and creatures which have left us their traces from this period of the earth’s history are shallow-water and intertidal beings.
uz: Aslida, yer tarixining shu davridan bizga o'z izlarini qoldirgan barcha o'simliklar va mavjudotlar sayoz suvli va to'lqinlararo mavjudotlardir.

en: If we wished to paral- lel the ﬂora and fauna of the Lower Palæozoic rocks on the earth to-day, we
uz: Agar biz bugungi kunda yer yuzidagi quyi paloezoik toshlarning flora va fauna olamini o'rganmoqchi bo'lsak, biz...

en: should do it best, except in the matter of size, by taking a drop of water from a rock pool or scummy ditch and examining it under a microscope.
uz: Yaxshisi, lekin o'lchami masalasida bo'lmasa, tosh havzasi yoki axlatli ariqdan bir tomchi suv olib, mikroskop ostida tekshirib ko'rish kerak.

en: The little crustacea, the small shellﬁsh, the zoophytes and algæ we should ﬁnd there would display a quite striking resemblance to these clumsier, larger proto- types that once were the crown of life upon our planet.
uz: Kichik qisqichbaqalar, kichik qobiqlar, zoofitlar va algaelar, biz u yerda topishimiz kerak bo'lganlar, bir vaqtlar sayyoramiz hayoti toji bo'lgan bu qo'polroq, kattaroq prototiplarga juda sezilarli o'xshashlik ko'rsatadi.

en: EARLY PALÆOLITHIC FOSSILS OF VARIOUS SPECIES OF LINGU- LA  Species of this most ancient genus of shellﬁsh still live to-day  (In Natural History Museum, London)
uz: LINGU-LA ning turli xil turlarining erta palyeolitik qazilmalari. Ushbu eng qadimgi qobiq turkumining turlari bugungi kunda ham tirik (Tabiiy tarix muzeyida, London).

en: It is well, however, to bear in mind that the Lower Palæozoic rocks proba- bly do not give us anything at all representative of the ﬁrst beginnings of life on our planet.
uz: Lekin shuni yodda tutish yaxshiki, quyi paleoziy tog'liklari bizga sayyoramizdagi hayotning birinchi boshlanishlaridan umuman hech narsa bermaydi.

en: Unless a creature has bones or other hard parts, unless it wears a shell or is big enough and heavy enough to make characteristic footprints and trails in mud, it is unlikely to leave any fossilized traces of its existence behind.
uz: Agar mavjudot suyak yoki boshqa qattiq qismlarga ega bo'lmasa, agar u qobiq taqmasa yoki loyga xos oyoq izlari va izlar qoldiradigan darajada katta va og'ir bo'lmasa, u o'z mavjudligining qazilma izlarini qoldirishi dargumon.

en: To-day there are hundreds of thousands of species of small soft-bod- ied creatures in our world which it is inconceivable can ever leave any mark for future geologists to discover.
uz: Bugungi kunda dunyoda yuz minglab mayda yumshoq tanali mavjudotlar mavjud bo'lib, ularni kelajakdagi geologlar kashf etishi mumkinligi tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydi.

en: In the world’s past, millions of millions of species of such creatures may have lived and multiplied and ﬂourished and passed away without a trace remaining.
uz: Dunyo o'tmishda millionlab bunday mavjudotlarning millionlab turlari yashab, ko'payib, gullab-yashnab, hech qanday iz qoldirmasdan vafot etgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The waters of the warm and shallow lakes and seas of the so-called Azoic period may have teemed with an inﬁ- nite variety of lowly, jelly-like, shell-less and boneless creatures, and a mul- titude of green scummy plants may have spread over the sunlit intertidal rocks and beaches.
uz: Azoiy davri deb ataladigan iliq va sayoz ko'llar va dengizlarning suvlari quyi, jellyga o'xshash, qobig'isiz va suyaksiz mavjudotlarning infusimon xilma-xilligi bilan to'ldirilgan bo'lishi mumkin, shuningdek, quyosh nurida yoritilgan to'lqinlararo toshlar va plyajlar ustida ko'p miqdordagi yashil axlatli o'simliklar tarqalgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The Record of the Rocks is no more a complete record of life in the past than the books of a bank are a record of the existence of everybody in the neighbourhood.
uz: Toshlar yozuvi o'tmishdagi hayotning to'liq yozuvi emas, xuddi bank kitoblari ham qo'shnilikda har bir kishining mavjudligi haqida yozuv bo'lgani kabi.

en: It is only when a species begins to secrete a shell or a spicule or a carapace or a lime-supported stem, and so put by something for the future, that it goes upon the Record.
uz: Faqatgina bir tur qobiq, tikan, g'ovak yoki ohaktosh poyani ajrata boshlagandagina va kelajak uchun nimadir qo'yilgandagina, u Yozuvga kiradi.

en: But in rocks of an age prior to those which bear any fossil traces, graphite, a form of uncombined carbon, is sometimes found, and some authorities consider that it may have been separated out from combination through the vital activities of unknown living things.
uz: Lekin qazilma izlari bor bo'lganlardan oldingi davr toshlarida ba'zan aralashmagan uglerod shaklidagi grafit topiladi va ba'zi ma'lumotlar uni noma'lum tirik mavjudotlarning hayotiy faoliyati orqali aralashmaslikdan ajratib yuborilgan bo'lishi mumkin deb hisoblaydi.

en: FOSSILIZED FOOTPRINTS OF A LABYRINTHODONT CHEIROTHERIUM  (In Natural History Museum, London)
uz: LABYRINTHODONT SHEIROTHERIUM (Tabiiy Tarix Muzeyi, London)ning Fossilizatsiyalangan Oyoq Izlari

en: IV THE AGE OF FISHES In the days when the world was supposed to have endured for only a few thousand years, it was supposed that the different species of plants and ani- mals were ﬁxed and ﬁnal; they had all been created exactly as they are to- day, each species by itself.
uz: IV Baliqlar davri Dunyo atigi bir necha ming yil yashashi kerak bo'lgan kunlarda, turli xil o'simliklar va ani-moslar qat'iy va yakuniy deb hisoblangan edi; ularning barchasi bugungi kunda qanday bo'lsa, xuddi shunday yaratilgan edi, har bir tur o'zi.

en: But as men began to discover and study the Record of the Rocks this belief gave place to the suspicion that many species had changed and developed slowly through the course of ages, and this again expanded into a belief in what is called Organic Evolution, a be- lief that all species of life upon earth, animal and vegetable alike, are de- scended by slow continuous processes of change from some very simple ancestral form of life, some almost structureless living substance, far back in the so-called Azoic seas.
uz: Ammo odamlar Toshlar yozuvini kashf eta boshlaganlarida va o'rganayotganlarida, bu e'tiqod ko'plab turlar asrlar davomida asta-sekin o'zgarib, rivojlanib ketgan degan gumonga o'rnak berdi va bu yana organik evolyutsiya deb ataladigan narsa, yer yuzidagi barcha turlar, hayvonlar va o'simliklar kabi, juda oddiy ajdodlik hayot shaklidan, deyarli tuzilmagan tirik moddan tortib, uzoqroq bo'lgan Azoik dengizlarda sekin davom etayotgan o'zgarish jarayonlari bilan parchalanadi degan e'tiqodga aylandi.

en: This question of Organic Evolution, like the question of the age of the earth, has in the past been the subject of much bitter controversy.
uz: Organik evolyutsiya masalasi, xuddi Yer davri masalasi kabi, o'tmishda ko'p achchiq bahslar mavzusi bo'lgan.

en: There was a time when a belief in organic evolution was for rather obscure reasons supposed to be incompatible with sound Christian, Jewish and Moslem doc- trine.
uz: Shunday bir zamonlar bo'lgan ediki, organik evolyutsiyaga bo'lgan ishonch ancha noaniq sabablarga ko'ra sog'lom xristian, yahudiy va musulmon doktrinasiga mos kelmas edi.

en: That time has passed, and the men of the most orthodox Catholic, Protestant, Jewish and Mohammedan belief are now free to accept this new- er and broader view of a common origin of all living things.
uz: O'sha vaqt o'tib ketdi va eng ortodoksal katolik, protestant, yahudiy va muhammed e'tiqodidagi odamlar endi barcha tirik mavjudotlarning umumiy kelib chiqishiga oid bu yangi va kengroq qarashni qabul qilishga erkin.

en: No life seems to have happened suddenly upon earth.
uz: Yer yuzida hech qanday hayot to'satdan sodir bo'lganga o'xshamaydi.

en: Life grew and grows.
uz: Hayot o'sdi va o'sadi.

en: Age by age through gulfs of time at which imagination reels, life has been growing from a mere stirring in the intertidal slime towards freedom, power and consciousness.
uz: Avloddan-avlodga, tasavvur aylanadigan vaqt qoyalari orqali hayot to'lqinlararo slimanda erkinlik, kuch va ongga qarab shunchaki harakatlanishdan o'sib bormoqda.

en: Life consists of individuals.
uz: Hayot shaxslardan iborat.

en: These individuals are deﬁnite things, they are not like the lumps and masses, nor even the limitless and motionless
uz: Bu shaxslar aniq narsalardir, ular guruhlar va massalarga o'xshamaydi, hatto cheksiz va harakatsiz ham emas.

en: crystals, of non-living matter, and they have two characteristics no dead matter possesses.
uz: Kristallar, tirik bo'lmagan moddaning, va ularda hech qanday o'lik moddaning ega bo'lmagan ikki xususiyati bor.

en: They can assimilate other matter into themselves and make it part of themselves, and they can reproduce themselves.
uz: Ular boshqa moddalarni o'zlariga singdirib, uni o'zlarining bir qismiga aylantirishi va o'zlarini ko'paytirishi mumkin.

en: They eat and they breed.
uz: Ular yeyishadi va ko'payishadi.

en: They can give rise to other individuals, for the most part like themselves, but always also a little different from themselves.
uz: Ular o'zlariga o'xshagan boshqa shaxslarni ham tug'dirishi mumkin, lekin har doim o'zlaridan biroz farq qiladi.

en: There is a speciﬁc and family resemblance between an individual and its offspring, and there is an individual difference between every parent and every off- spring it produces, and this is true in every species and at every stage of life.
uz: Individual va uning avlodlari o'rtasida o'ziga xos va oilaviy o'xshashlik mavjud, har bir ota-ona va har bir o'tkinchi bahor o'rtasida individual farq bor va bu har bir turda va hayotning har bir bosqichida to'g'ri keladi.

en: SPECIMEN OF THE PTERICHTHYS MILLERI OR SEA SCORPION SHOWING BODY ARMOUR Now scientiﬁc men are not able to explain to us either why offspring should resemble nor why they should differ from their parents.
uz: PTERICHTHYS MILLERI yoki SEA SCORPION TANASINI KO'RSATGAN QUROLNING NAMUNALARI Endi olimlar bizga na nasl nima uchun o'xshashligi kerakligini, na ota-onalaridan nima uchun farq qilishi kerakligini tushuntira olishmaydi.

en: But seeing that offspring do at once resemble and differ, it is a matter rather of com- mon sense than of scientiﬁc knowledge that, if the conditions under which a species live are changed, the species should undergo some correlated changes.
uz: Lekin avlodlar bir vaqtning o'zida o'xshash va farq qilishini ko'rib, agar bir tur yashaydigan sharoitlar o'zgarsa, tur biroz bog'liq o'zgarishlarga duch kelishi ilmiy bilimdan ko'ra ko'proq umumiy ma'no masalasidir.

en: Because in any generation of the species there must be a number of individuals whose individual differences make them better adapted to the new conditions under which the species has to live, and a number whose individuals whose individual differences make it rather harder for them to live.
uz: Chunki har qanday tur avlodida shunday bir qator shaxslar bo'lishi kerakki, ularning individual farqi ularni tur yashashga majbur bo'lgan yangi sharoitlarga yaxshiroq moslashtiradi va ularning individual farqi ularning yashashini ancha qiyinlashtiradi.

en: And on the whole the former sort will live longer, bear more offspring, and reproduce themselves more abundantly than the latter, and so genera- tion by generation the average of the species will change in the favourable direction.
uz: Va umuman olganda, avvalgi tur uzoqroq umr ko'radi, ko'proq avlod ko'radi va ikkinchisiga qaraganda ko'proq ko'payadi, shuning uchun avloddan avlodga turning o'rtacha ko'rsatkichi ijobiy yo'nalishda o'zgaradi.

en: This process, which is called Natural Selection, is not so much a scientiﬁc theory as a necessary deduction from the facts of reproduction and individual difference.
uz: Bu jarayon, tabiiy tanlanish deb ataladi, ilmiy nazariya emas, balki ko'payish faktlari va individual farqdan zarur xulosa hisoblanadi.

en: There may be many forces at work varying, destroy- ing and preserving species, about which science may still be unaware or un- decided, but the man who can deny the operation of this process of natural selection upon life since its beginning must be either ignorant of the ele- mentary facts of life or incapable of ordinary thought.
uz: Turlarni yo'q qilish va saqlab qolish uchun ko'plab kuchlar ishlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin, ular haqida fan hali ham bexabar yoki qaror qabul qilmagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin hayot boshidan beri bu tabiiy tanlanish jarayonining ta'sirini inkor eta oladigan inson hayotning saylov faktlaridan bexabar yoki oddiy fikrlashga qodir bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: Many scientiﬁc men have speculated about the ﬁrst beginning of life and their speculations are often of great interest, but there is absolutely no deﬁ- nite knowledge and no convincing guess yet of the way in which life began.
uz: Ko'plab olimlar hayotning birinchi boshi haqida taxmin qilishgan va ularning taxminlari ko'pincha katta qiziqish uyg'otadi, lekin hayot qanday boshlanganligi haqida mutlaqo aniq bilim va ishonchli taxmin yo'q.

en: But nearly all authorities are agreed that it probably began upon mud or sand in warm sunlit shallow brackish water, and that it spread up the beach- es to the intertidal lines and out to the open waters.
uz: Lekin deyarli barcha rasmiylar u, ehtimol, iliq quyosh nurida yoritilgan sayoz sho'r suvdagi loy yoki qum ustida boshlangan va u plyaj bo'ylab tarqalgan - to'lqinlararo chiziqlargacha va ochiq suvlargacha.

en: FOSSIL OF THE CLADOSELACHE, A DEVONIAN SHARK  Nat.
uz: FOSSIL OF THE CLADOSELACHE, A DEVONIAN SHARK Nat.

en: That early world was a world of strong tides and currents.
uz: O'sha erta dunyo kuchli to'lqinlar va oqimlar dunyosi edi.

en: An incessant destruction of individuals must have been going on through their being swept up the beaches and dried, or by their being swept out to sea and sink- ing down out of reach of air and sun.
uz: Shaxslarning tinimsiz yo'q qilinishi ularning plyajlarga supurilishi va quritilishi, yoki dengizga supurilishi va havo va quyosh yetib bormaydigan darajada cho'kib ketishi natijasida sodir bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Early conditions favoured the devel- opment of every tendency to root and hold on, every tendency to form an outer skin and casing to protect the stranded individual from immediate des- iccation.
uz: Dastlabki sharoitlar har bir ildiz otish va ushlab turish tendentsiyasining rivojlanishiga, har bir tashqi terini shakllantirish tendensiyasiga va qolib ketgan shaxsni darhol suvdan himoya qilish uchun korpusga ega edi.

en: From the very earliest any tendency to sensitiveness to taste would turn the individual in the direction of food, and any sensitiveness to light would assist it to struggle back out of the darkness of the sea deeps and cav- erns or to wriggle back out of the excessive glare of the dangerous shallows.
uz: Eng erta paytlardan ta'mga sezgirlikka bo'lgan har qanday moyillik shaxsni oziq-ovqatga yo'naltirardi va yorug'likka bo'lgan har qanday sezgirlik unga dengiz chuqurliklari va g'orlari zulmatidan qayta kurashishga yoki xavfli sayozliklarning haddan tashqari ko'rinishidan qutulishga yordam berardi.

en: Probably the ﬁrst shells and body armour of living things were protec- tions against drying rather than against active enemies.
uz: Ehtimol, tirik mavjudotlarning birinchi snaryadlari va tanasi zirhi faol dushmanlarga qarshi emas, balki qurishdan himoya edi.

en: But tooth and claw come early into our earthly history.
uz: Lekin tish va tirnoq bizning yer yuzidagi tariximizga erta kirib keladi.

en: We have already noted the size of the earlier water scorpions.
uz: Biz avvalgi suv chayonlarining o'lchamini allaqachon qayd etganmiz.

en: For long ages such creatures were the supreme lords of life.
uz: Uzoq asrlar davomida bunday mavjudotlar hayotning oliy hukmdorlari edi.

en: Then in a division of these Palæozoic rocks called the Silurian division, which many geologists now suppose to be as old as ﬁve hundred million years, there appears a new type of being, equipped with eyes and teeth and swimming powers of an altogether more powerful kind.
uz: Keyin, ko'plab geologlar hozirda taxmin qilayotgan Siluriya bo'linmasi deb nomlangan ushbu Paleozoik toshlarning bo'linmasida, ko'pchilik besh yuz million yil oldingi deb hisoblaydi, ko'zlar, tishlar va umuman kuchli suzish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lgan yangi turdagi mavjudot paydo bo'ladi.

en: These were the ﬁrst known backboned ani- mals, the earliest ﬁshes, the ﬁrst known Vertebrata.
uz: Bular birinchi ma'lum umurtqali ani- mals baliqlar, eng qadimgi baliqlar, birinchi ma'lum Umurtqavorlar edi.

en: SHARKS AND GANOIDS OF THE DEVONIAN PERIOD  By Alice Woodward These ﬁshes increase greatly in the next division of rocks, the rocks known as the Devonian system.
uz: ALIS VUDVARD tomonidan Shayton davrining AKUS va GANOIDLARI Bu baliqlar keyingi toshlar bo'limida, Devoniya tizimi deb nomlanuvchi toshlarda sezilarli darajada ko'payadi.

en: They are so prevalent that this period of the
uz: Ular shunchalik keng tarqalganki, bu davr...

en: Record of the Rocks has been called the Age of Fishes.
uz: Toshlar yozuvi Baliqlar davri deb atalgan.

en: Fishes of a pattern now gone from the earth, and ﬁshes allied to the sharks and sturgeons of to- day, rushed through the waters, leapt in the air, browsed among the sea- weeds, pursued and preyed upon one another, and gave a new liveliness to the waters of the world.
uz: Yer yuzidan ketgan naqshli baliqlar va bugungi kundagi akulalar va boyo'g'lilarga aloqador baliqlar suvlar bo'ylab shoshilishdi, havoda sakrashdi, dengiz o'tlari orasida sayr qilishdi, bir-birini quvlashdi va o'lja qilishdi va dunyo suvlariga yangi jon berdi.

en: None of these were excessively big by our present standards.
uz: Bularning hech biri hozirgi standartlarimizga ko'ra haddan tashqari katta emas edi.

en: Few of them were more than two or three feet long, but there were exceptional forms which were as long as twenty feet.
uz: Ularning bir nechtasi ikki yoki uch futdan uzunroq edi, lekin yigirma futgacha bo'lgan ajoyib shakllari bor edi.

en: We know nothing from geology of the ancestors of these ﬁshes.
uz: Biz bu baliqlarning ajdodlarining geologiyasidan hech narsa bilmaymiz.

en: They do not appear to be related to any of the forms that preceded them.
uz: Ular ulardan oldingi shakllarga aloqador ko'rinmaydi.

en: Zoologists have the most interesting views of their ancestry, but these they derive from the study of the development of the eggs of their still living relations, and from other sources.
uz: Zoologlar o'zlarining ajdodlari haqida eng qiziqarli qarashlarga ega, lekin bular ularning hali tirik bo'lgan munosabatlarining tuxumlarining rivojlanishini o'rganishdan va boshqa manbalardan kelib chiqadi.

en: Apparently the ancestors of the vertebrata were soft- bodied and perhaps quite small swimming creatures who began ﬁrst to de- velop hard parts as teeth round and about their mouths.
uz: Aftidan, umurtqa hayvonlarining ajdodlari yumshoq tanli va ehtimol juda kichik suzuvchi mavjudotlar bo'lgan, ular avval qattiq qismlarni tishlari bo'ylab va og'izlari atrofida de- Velop qila boshlagan.

en: The teeth of a skate or dogﬁsh cover the roof and ﬂoor of its mouth and pass at the lip into the ﬂattened toothlike scales that encase most of its body.
uz: Skate yoki it baliqining tishlari uning og'zining tomi va polini qoplaydi va labida uning tanasining ko'p qismini o'rab turuvchi tekis tishli tarozilarga o'tadi.

en: As the ﬁshes develop these teeth scales in the geological record, they swim out of the hidden darkness of the past into the light, the ﬁrst vertebrated animals visible in the record.
uz: Baliqlar geologik yozuvda bu tish shkalalarini rivojlantirar ekan, ular o'tmishning yashirin zulmatidan yorug'likka suzadilar, bu yozuvda ko'rinadigan birinchi umurtqali hayvonlardir.

en: V THE AGE OF THE COAL SWAMPS The land during this Age of Fishes was apparently quite lifeless.
uz: KO'MIR HAMIRLARI ASRIDA Bu Baliqlar Asri davrida yer ancha jonsiz bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: Crags and uplands of barren rock lay under the sun and rain.
uz: Qoyalar va bepusht toshli tepaliklar quyosh va yomg'ir ostida yotardi.

en: There was no real soil— for as yet there were no earthworms which help to make a soil, and no plants to break up the rock particles into mould; there was no trace of moss or lichen.
uz: Haqiqiy tuproq yo'q edi  chunki hali tuproq yasashga yordam beradigan tuproq qurtlari ham, tosh zarralarini mog'orga ajratadigan o'simliklar ham yo'q edi; mox yoki lichinka izlari ham yo'q edi.

en: Life was still only in the sea.
uz: Hayot hali faqat dengizda edi.

en: Over this world of barren rock played great changes of climate.
uz: Ushbu bepusht toshlar dunyosi ustida iqlimning katta o'zgarishlari sodir bo'ldi.

en: The caus- es of these changes of climate were very complex and they have still to be properly estimated.
uz: Bu iqlim o'zgarishlarining sabablari juda murakkab edi va ularni hali ham to'g'ri baholash kerak.

en: The changing shape of the earth’s orbit, the gradual shifting of the poles of rotation, changes in the shapes of the continents, probably even ﬂuctuations in the warmth of the sun, now conspired to plunge great areas of the earth’s surface into long periods of cold and ice and now again for millions of years spread a warm or equable climate over this planet.
uz: Yer orbitasining o'zgaruvchan shakli, aylanish qutblarining asta-sekin siljishi, qit'alarning shakllaridagi o'zgarishlar, ehtimol hatto quyoshning issig'idagi tebranishlar, hozirda Yer yuzasining katta hududlarini uzoq sovuq va muz davrlariga botirish va yana millionlab yillar davomida bu sayyoraga iliq yoki teng iqlim tarqatish uchun fitna uyushtirmoqda.

en: There seem to have been phases of great internal activity in the world’s history, when in the course of a few million years accumulated up- thrusts would break out in lines of volcanic eruption and upheaval and re- arrange the mountain and continental outlines of the globe, increasing the depth of the sea and the height of the mountains and exaggerating the ex- tremes of climate.
uz: Dunyo tarixida shunday katta ichki faollik davrlari bo'lganga o'xshaydi, unda bir necha million yil davomida to'plangan ko'tarilish harakatlari vulqon otilishi va to'ntarish chiziqlarida paydo bo'lib, globusning tog' va qit'a konturlarini qayta tartibga soladi, dengiz chuqurligini va tog'larning balandligini oshiradi va iqlimning o'zgaruvchan harakatlarini haddan tashqari oshiradi.

en: And these would be followed by vast ages of comparative quiescence, when frost, rain and river would wear down the mountain heights and carry great masses of silt to ﬁll and raise the sea bottoms and spread the seas, ever shallower and wider, over more and more of the land.
uz: Va bulardan so'ng, sovuq, yomg'ir va daryo tog' balandliklarini yemirib, dengiz tubini to'ldirish va ko'tarish uchun ulkan loy massalarini olib ketganda, ulkan davrlar davomida nisbatan sokinlik kuzatiladi va dengizlar tobora sayozlashib, kengroq, tobora ko'proq quruqlik bo'ylab tarqaladi.

en: There have been “high and deep” ages in the world’s history and “low and level” ages.
uz: Dunyo tarixida yuqori va chuqur davrlar, past va tekis davrlar bo'lgan.

en: The reader must dismiss from his mind any idea that the surface of the earth has been growing steadily cooler since its crust grew solid.
uz: O'quvchi o'z ongidan Yer yuzasi qobig'i qattiq bo'lganidan beri barqaror ravishda salqinlashib borayotgani haqidagi har qanday fikrni chiqarib tashlashi kerak.

en: After that much cooling had been achieved, the internal temperature ceased to af-
uz: Shundan so'ng, ko'p sovutishlarga erishilgandan so'ng, ichki harorat af- gacha to'xtadi.

en: fect surface conditions.
uz: Haqiqiy sirt sharoitlari.

en: There are traces of periods of superabundant ice and snow, of “Glacial Ages,” that is, even in the Azoic period.
uz: Muzlik davrlarining, ya'ni hatto Azoik davrida ham juda ko'p muz va qor davrlarining izlari bor.

en: It was only towards the close of the Age of Fishes, in a period of extensive shallow seas and lagoons, that life spread itself out in any effectual way from the waters on to the land.
uz: Faqatgina Baliqlar davri oxirida, keng sayoz dengizlar va lagunyalar davrida hayot suvlardan quruqlikkacha samarali yo'l bilan tarqaldi.

en: No doubt the earlier types of the forms that now begin to appear in great abundance had already been developing in a rare and obscure manner for many scores of millions of years.
uz: Shubhasiz, hozirda juda ko'p namoyon bo'la boshlagan shakllarning dastlabki turlari allaqachon ko'p millionlab yillar davomida kam uchraydigan va noaniq tarzda rivojlanib kelgan edi.

en: But now came their opportunity.
uz: Ammo endi ularning imkoniyati keldi.

en: A CARBONIFEROUS SWAMP  A Coal Seam in the Making
uz: Uglerodli tozalagich Ko'mir chokini yasashda

en: Plants no doubt preceded animal forms in this invasion of the land, but the animals probably followed up the plant emigration very closely.
uz: O'simliklar shubhasiz, bu yerga bostirib kirishda hayvon shakllaridan oldingi edi, lekin hayvonlar, ehtimol, o'simliklarning ko'chishini juda yaqindan kuzatib borgan.

en: The ﬁrst problem that the plant had to solve was the problem of some sustaining stiff support to hold up its fronds to the sunlight when the buoyant water was withdrawn; the second was the problem of getting water from the swampy ground below to the tissues of the plant, now that it was no longer close at hand.
uz: O'simlik yechishi kerak bo'lgan birinchi muammo, gullab-yashnayotgan suv tortib olinayotganda, barglarini quyosh nurida ushlab turish uchun qattiq tayanchni ushlab turish muammosi edi; ikkinchisi, botqoq yerdan o'simlik to'qimalariga suv olish muammosi edi, endi u yaqin emas edi.

en: The two problems were solved by the development of woody tissue which both sustained the plant and acted as water carrier to the leaves.
uz: Ikki muammo o'simlikni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan va barglarga suv tashuvchi vazifasini bajaradigan yog'och to'qimalarning rivojlanishi orqali hal qilindi.

en: The Record of the Rocks is suddenly crowded by a vast variety of woody swamp plants, many of them of great size, big tree mosses, tree ferns, gigantic horsetails and the like.
uz: Toshlar yozuvi to'satdan turli xil yog'och botqoq o'simliklar bilan to'lib ketadi, ularning ko'pchiligi katta o'lchamdagi, katta daraxt moxlari, daraxt ko'rshapalaklari, ulkan ot poyalari va shunga o'xshashlardir.

en: And with these, age by age, there crawled out of the water a great variety of animal forms.
uz: Va bular bilan, yoshdan yoshga ko'ra, suvdan juda ko'p hayvon shakllari sudrab chiqdi.

en: There were centipedes and millipedes; there were the ﬁrst primitive insects; there were creatures related to the an- cient king crabs and sea scorpions which became the earliest spiders and land scorpions, and presently there were vertebrated animals.
uz: U yerda yuz oyoqlilar va millipedlar bor edi; birinchi ibtidoiy hasharotlar bor edi; an-sient qirol qisqichbaqalari va dengiz sharpalari bilan bog'liq mavjudotlar bor edi, ular eng erta o'rgimchaklar va quruqlik sharpalariga aylandi, va hozirda umurtqali hayvonlar bor edi.

en: SKULL OF A LABYRINTHODONT, CAPITOSAURUS  Nat.
uz: LABYRINTHODONTning SKULI, CAPITOSAURUS Nat.

en: Some of the earlier insects were very large.
uz: Avvalgi hasharotlarning ba'zilari juda katta edi.

en: There were dragon ﬂies in this period with wings that spread out to twenty-nine inches.
uz: Bu davrda yigirma to'qqiz dyuymgacha cho'zilgan qanotli ajdar pashshalari bor edi.

en: In various ways these new orders and genera had adapted themselves to breathing air.
uz: Bu yangi tartiblar va turkumlar turli yo'llar bilan nafas oluvchi havoga moslashgan edi.

en: Hitherto all animals had breathed air dissolved in water, and that indeed is what all animals still have to do.
uz: Hozirgacha barcha hayvonlar suvda erigan havoni nafas olgan edi va bu haqiqatan ham barcha hayvonlarning hali ham qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishidir.

en: But now in divers fashions the animal kingdom was acquiring the power of supplying its own moisture where it was needed.
uz: Ammo endi turli xil modalarda hayvonot dunyosi o'ziga kerak bo'lgan joyda namlikni ta'minlash kuchini qo'lga kiritayotgan edi.

en: A man with a perfectly dry lung would suffocate to-
uz: O'pkasi butunlay quruq odam bo'g'ilib qoladi...

en: day; his lung surfaces must be moist in order that air may pass through them into his blood.
uz: kun; uning o'pka yuzalari nam bo'lishi kerak, shunda havo ulardan uning qoniga o'tishi mumkin.

en: The adaptation to air breathing consists in all cases either in the development of a cover to the old-fashioned gills to stop evaporation, or in the development of tubes or other new breathing organs lying deep inside the body and moistened by a watery secretion.
uz: Havo nafas olishga moslashish barcha holatlarda evaporatsiyani to'xtatish uchun eski uslubdagi g'izillarga qopqoq yasashdan yoki tananing ichida chuqur joylashgan va suvli sekretsiya orqali namlangan trubkalar yoki boshqa yangi nafas olish organlarining rivojlanishidan iborat.

en: The old gills with which the ancestral ﬁsh of the vertebrated line had breathed were inadaptable to breath- ing upon land, and in the case of this division of the animal kingdom it is the swimming bladder of the ﬁsh which becomes a new, deep-seated breathing organ, the lung.
uz: Umurtqali zotning ajdod baliqlari nafas olgan eski qovurg'alari quruqlikda nafas olishga mos kelmas edi va hayvonot olamining bu bo'linishida baliqning suzish pufag'i yangi, chuqur joylashgan nafas oluvchi organga, o'pkaga aylanadi.

en: The kind of animals known as amphibia, the frogs and newts of to-day, begin their lives in the water and breathe by gills; and subsequent- ly the lung, developing in the same way as the swimming bladder of many ﬁshes do, as a baglike outgrowth from the throat, takes over the business of breathing, the animal comes out on land, and the gills dwindle and the gill slits disappear.
uz: Amfibiyalar deb nomlanuvchi hayvonlar, bugungi kunda qurbaqalar va yangilar suvda hayotlarini boshlaydilar va g'ovaklar orqali nafas oladilar; keyin esa, ko'plab baliqlarning suzish pufagidek rivojlanuvchi o'pka, tomoqdan chiqqan xalta kabi o'sib, nafas olish ishini o'z zimmasiga oladi, hayvon quruqlikka chiqadi, g'ovaklar kamayadi va g'ovak yoriqlar yo'qoladi.

en: (All except an outgrowth of one gill slit, which becomes the passage of the ear and ear-drum.) The animal can now live only in the air, but it must return at least to the edge of the water to lay its eggs and repro- duce its kind.
uz: (Hammasi bitta teshik bo'lagi o'sib chiqishi bundan mustasno, u quloq va quloq barabanining o'tishiga aylanadi.) Hayvon endi faqat havoda yashashi mumkin, lekin u hech bo'lmaganda tuxum qo'yish va o'z turini qaytarish uchun suv chetiga qaytishi kerak.

en: SKELETON OF A LABYRINTHODONT: THE ERYOPS  Nat.
uz: LABORINTHODONT SKELETON: ERYOPS Nat.

en: All the air-breathing vertebrata of this age of swamps and plants belonged to the class amphibia.
uz: Bu botqoqlik va o'simlik davridagi barcha havo esuvchi umurtqa hayvonlari amfibiyalar sinfiga tegishli edi.

en: They were nearly all of them forms related to the newts of to-day, and some of them attained a considerable size.
uz: Ularning deyarli barchasi hozirgi yangiliklarga tegishli shakl edi va ularning ba'zilari sezilarli o'lchamga ega bo'ldi.

en: They were land animals, it is true, but they were land animals needing to live in and near moist and swampy places, and all the great trees of this period were equally amphibious in their habits.
uz: Ular quruqlik hayvonlari edi, bu rost, lekin ular nam va botqoq joylarda va ularning yaqinida yashashga muhtoj quruqlik hayvonlari edi va bu davrning barcha buyuk daraxtlari o'z odatlarida bir xilda amfibiya edi.

en: None of them had yet developed fruits and seeds of a kind that could fall on land and develop with the help only of
uz: Ularning hech biri hali tuproqqa tushib, faqatgina yordamida rivojlana oladigan mevalar va urug'larni ishlab chiqmagan edi.

en: such moisture as dew and rain could bring.
uz: shudring va yomg'ir kabi namlik olib kelishi mumkin.

en: They all had to shed their spores in water, it would seem, if they were to germinate.
uz: Ularning barchasi o'z sporlarini suvga to'kishga majbur bo'lishdi, go'yo, agar ular unib chiqsa.

en: It is one of the most beautiful interests of that beautiful science, compara- tive anatomy, to trace the complex and wonderful adaptations of living things to the necessities of existence in air.
uz: O'sha go'zal fanning eng go'zal qiziqishlaridan biri, solishtirma anatomiyasi, tirik mavjudotlarning murakkab va ajoyib moslashuvlarini havoda mavjud bo'lish zaruratlariga izlashdir.

en: All living things, plants and ani- mals alike, are primarily water things.
uz: Barcha tirik mavjudotlar, o'simliklar va xuddi shunday hayvonlar, asosan suvga tegishli narsalardir.

en: For example all the higher vertebrated animals above the ﬁshes, up to and including man, pass through a stage in their development in the egg or before birth in which they have gill slits which are obliterated before the young emerge.
uz: Misol uchun, baliqlardan yuqori umurtqali hayvonlarning barchasi, shu jumladan inson ham, tuxumda yoki tug'ilishidan oldin rivojlanish bosqichidan o'tadi, unda ularning tishli bo'laklari paydo bo'lishidan oldin yo'q qilinadi.

en: The bare, water-washed eye of the ﬁsh is protected in the higher forms from drying up by eyelids and glands which secrete moisture.
uz: Baliqning yalang'och, suvda yuvilgan ko'zi yuqori shakllarda namlikni ajratib chiqaruvchi qovoqlar va bezlar orqali qurishdan himoyalangan.

en: The weaker sound vibrations of air necessi- tate an ear-drum.
uz: Havoning zaifroq tovush tebranishlari quloq barabanini talab qiladi.

en: In nearly every organ of the body similar modiﬁcations and adaptations are to be detected, similar patchings-up to meet aerial conditions.
uz: Deyarli har bir tana organida shunga o'xshash o'zgarishlar va moslashuvlar aniqlanadi, havo sharoitlariga mos keladigan shunga o'xshash yamoqlar.

en: This Carboniferous age, this age of the amphibia, was an age of life in the swamps and lagoons and on the low banks among these waters.
uz: Bu Karboniy davri, amfibiyalar davri botqoqlik va lagunlarda hamda bu suvlar orasidagi past qirg'oqlarda hayot davri edi.

en: Thus far life had now extended.
uz: Hozirgacha hayot endi cho'zilgan edi.

en: The hills and high lands were still quite barren and life- less.
uz: Tepaliklar va baland yerlar hali ham ancha bepusht va hayotiy edi.

en: Life had learnt to breathe air indeed, but it still had its roots in its native water; it still had to return to the water to reproduce its kind.
uz: Hayot haqiqatan ham havoni nafas olishga o'rgangan edi, lekin u hali ham o'z ona suvida ildiz otgan edi; u hali ham o'z turini ko'paytirish uchun suvga qaytishi kerak edi.

en: VI THE AGE OF REPTILES The abundant life of the Carboniferous period was succeeded by a vast cycle of dry and bitter ages.
uz: VI Yirtqichbaqasimonlar davri Karboniy davrining serhosil hayoti quruq va achchiq davrlarning ulkan aylanishi bilan davom etdi.

en: They are represented in the Record of the Rocks by thick deposits of sandstones and the like, in which fossils are comparatively few.
uz: Ular Toshlar yozuvida qalin qum toshlari va shunga o'xshash konlar bilan ifodalanadi, bunda qazilmalar nisbatan kam.

en: The temperature of the world ﬂuctuated widely, and there were long pe- riods of glacial cold.
uz: Dunyo harorati keng o'zgarib turdi va muzlik sovuqlikning uzoq davri bo'ldi.

en: Over great areas the former profusion of swamp vege- tation ceased, and, overlaid by these newer deposits, it began that process of compression and mineralization that gave the world most of the coal de- posits of to-day.
uz: Katta hududlarda botqoqlikdagi sabzavotlarning avvalgi ko'pligi to'xtadi va bu yangi konlar bilan qoplangan holda, dunyoga bugungi kunda ko'mirning ko'p qismini bergan siqish va minerallashtirish jarayoni boshlandi.

en: But it is during periods of change that life undergoes its most rapid modi- ﬁcations, and under hardship that it learns its hardest lessons.
uz: Ammo aynan o'zgarishlar davrida hayot o'zining eng tezkor o'zgarishlariga duch keladi va qiyinchiliklar ostida eng og'ir saboqlarni oladi.

en: As conditions revert towards warmth and moisture again we ﬁnd a new series of animal and plant forms established, We ﬁnd in the record the remains of vertebrated animals that laid eggs which, instead of hatching out tadpoles which needed to live for a time in water, carried on their development before hatching to a stage so nearly like the adult form that the young could live in air from the ﬁrst moment of independent existence.
uz: Sharoitlar yana issiqlik va namlikka qaytishi bilan biz hayvonot va o'simlik shakllarining yangi turkumini topamiz. Yozuvlarda shunday umurtqali hayvonlarning qoldiqlarini topamizki, ular tuxum qo'yishgan, suvda bir muddat yashash kerak bo'lgan tovuqlarni chiqarib tashlash o'rniga, mustaqil hayotining birinchi daqiqasidan boshlab yoshlar havoda yashashi mumkin bo'lgan kattalar shakliga yaqin bosqichga ko'tarilishidan oldin o'z rivojlanishini davom ettirgan.

en: Gills had been cut out altogether, and the gill slits only appeared as an embryonic phase.
uz: G'ildiraklar butunlay kesib tashlangan edi va g'ildirak yoriqlari faqat embrion faza sifatida paydo bo'lgan edi.

en: These new creatures without a tadpole stage were the Reptiles.
uz: Bu yangi yaratilmalar, kapalak bosqichisiz, sudralib yuruvchilar edi.

en: Concur- rently there had been a development of seed-bearing trees, which could spread their seed, independently of swamp or lakes.
uz: Bir vaqtning o'zida urug' chiqaruvchi daraxtlar rivojlangan edi, ular botqoqlik yoki ko'llardan qat'i nazar o'z urug'larini tarqatishi mumkin edi.

en: There were now palm- like cycads and many tropical conifers, though as yet there were no ﬂower- ing plants and no grasses.
uz: Hozirda palma kabi sikadlar va ko'plab tropik ignabarglilar bor edi, garchi hali gullaydigan o'simliklar va o'tlar yo'q edi.

en: There was a great number of ferns.
uz: U yerda juda ko'p ko'rshapalaklar bor edi.

en: And there was now also an increased variety of insects.
uz: Va endi hasharotlarning xilma-xilligi ham ortdi.

en: There were beetles, though bees and butterﬂies had yet to come.
uz: Qo'ng'izlar bor edi, garchi asalarilar va kapalaklar hali kelmagan bo'lsa ham.

en: But all the fundamental forms of a new real land fauna and ﬂora had been laid down during these vast ages of severity.
uz: Lekin yangi haqiqiy yer fauna va florasining barcha fundamental shakllari ushbu ulkan og'irlik davrida yaratilgan edi.

en: This new land life needed only the opportunity of favourable conditions to ﬂourish and prevail.
uz: Bu yangi quruqlik hayoti faqat gullab-yashnash va g'alaba qozonish uchun qulay sharoitlar imkoniyatiga muhtoj edi.

en: A FOSSIL ICHTHYOSAURUS, A MESOZOIC FISH-LIZARD  Found in the Lower Lias in Somersetshire  Nat.
uz: FOSSIL ICHTHYOSAURUS, Somersetshire Nat.dagi quyi liaslarda topilgan MESOZOIK Baliq-LIZARD.

en: Age by age and with abundant ﬂuctuations that mitigation came.
uz: Yoshdan yoshga va ko'p tebranishlar bilan yengillashtirish keldi.

en: The still incalculable movements of the earth’s crust, the changes in its orbit, the in- crease and diminution of the mutual inclination of orbit and pole, worked together to produce a great spell of widely diffused warm conditions.
uz: Yer qobig'ining hali ham hisoblab bo'lmaydigan harakatlari, uning orbitasidagi o'zgarishlar, orbita va qutbning o'zaro og'ishining kuchayishi va kamayishi keng tarqalgan issiq sharoitlarning ulkan sehrini yaratish uchun birgalikda ishladi.

en: The period lasted altogether, it is now supposed, upwards of two hundred million years.
uz: Davri umuman olganda, hozir taxmin qilinishicha, ikki yuz million yildan yuqori davom etdi.

en: It is called the Mesozoic period, to distinguish it from the altogether vaster Palæozoic and Azoic periods (together fourteen hundred millions) that preceded it, and from the Cainozoic or new life period that intervened be- tween its close and the present time, and it is also called the Age of Reptiles because of the astonishing predominance and variety of this form of life.
uz: U Mesozoy davri deb ataladi, uni undan oldingi kengroq Paleozoy va Azoy davrlaridan (barchasida o'n to'rt yuz million) va uning yaqinlashishi va hozirgi zamon oralig'ida bo'lgan Kaynozoy yoki yangi hayot davridan ajratib turish uchun, shuningdek, bu hayot shaklining hayratlanarli ustunligi va xilma-xilligi tufayli sudralib yuruvchilarning davri deb ham ataladi.

en: It came to an end some eighty million years ago.
uz: U taxminan sakson million yil oldin yakunlandi.

en: In the world to-day the genera of Reptiles are comparatively few and their distribution is very limited.
uz: Hozirgi kunda dunyoda sudralib yuruvchilarning turlari nisbatan kam va ularning tarqalishi juda cheklangan.

en: They are more various, it is true, than are the few surviving members of the order of the amphibia which once in the Carbonif- erous period ruled the world.
uz: Ular, rostini aytsam, bir vaqtlar Karbon davrida dunyoni boshqargan amfibiyalar turkumining qolgan oz sonli a'zolaridan ko'ra xilma-xilroqdir.

en: We still have the snakes, the turtles and tortois- es (the Chelonia), the alligators and crocodiles, and the lizards.
uz: Bizda hali ham ilonlar, toshbaqalar va toshbaqalar (Chelonia), aligatorlar va timsohlar, va kaltakesaklar bor.

en: ception they are creatures requiring warmth all the year round; they cannot stand exposure to cold, and it is probable that all the reptilian beings of the Mesozoic suffered under the same limitation.
uz: Ular yil davomida issiqlik talab qiladigan mavjudotlardir; ular sovuqqa chiday olmaydilar va ehtimol, Mezozoydagi barcha sudralib yuruvchi mavjudotlar bir xil cheklov ostida azob chekishgan.

en: It was a hothouse fauna, living amidst a hothouse ﬂora.
uz: Bu issiqxona faunasi edi, issiqxona flora o'rtasida yashar edi.

en: It endured no frosts.
uz: U hech qanday sovuqqa bardosh bermadi.

en: But the world had at least at- tained a real dry land fauna and ﬂora as distinguished from the mud and swamp fauna and ﬂora of the previous heyday of life upon earth.
uz: Lekin dunyo hech bo'lmaganda, yer yuzidagi hayotning avvalgi gullab-yashnagan davridagi loy va botqoqlik fauna va floralaridan farqli o'laroq, haqiqiy quruq yer fauna va floraga ega edi.

en: All the sorts of reptile we know now were much more abundantly repre- sented then, great turtles and tortoises, big crocodiles and many lizards and snakes, but in addition there was a number of series of wonderful creatures that have now vanished altogether from the earth.
uz: Hozir biz bilgan barcha sudralib yuruvchi hayvonlar o'sha paytlarda ancha mo'l-ko'l bo'lgan, katta toshbaqalar va toshbaqalar, katta timsohlar va ko'plab kaltakesaklar va ilonlar, lekin bundan tashqari, hozir yer yuzidan butunlay yo'qolgan bir qator ajoyib mavjudotlar ham bor edi.

en: There was a vast variety of beings called the Dinosaurs.
uz: Dinozavrlar deb ataladigan mavjudotlarning juda xilma-xilligi bor edi.

en: Vegetation was now spreading over the lower levels of the world, reeds, brakes of fern and the like; and browsing upon this abundance came a multitude of herbivorous reptiles, which increased in size as the Mesozoic period rose to its climax.
uz: Sabzavotlar endi dunyoning quyi qatlamlari, qamishlar, ko'rshapalak tormozlari va shunga o'xshash joylarda tarqalgan edi; va bu mo'l-ko'llikda ko'plab o'txo'r sudralib yuruvchilar paydo bo'ldi, ular Mezozoy davri o'zining eng yuqori cho'qqisiga ko'tarilishi bilan o'lchamiga ko'paydi.

en: Some of these beasts exceed- ed in size any other land animals that have ever lived; they were as large as whales.
uz: Bu hayvonlarning ba'zilari o'lchami bo'yicha boshqa quruqlik hayvonlaridan kattaroq edi; ular kitlar kabi katta edi.

en: The Diplodocus Carnegii for example measured eighty-four feet from snout to tail; the Gigantosaurus was even greater; it measured a hun- dred feet.
uz: Masalan, Diplodocus Carnegii burunidan dumgacha sakson to'rt fut o'lchangan; Gigantosaurus undan ham kattaroq edi; u hun-dried oyoqlarni o'lchagan.

en: Living upon these monsters was a swarm of carnivorous Dinosaurs of a corresponding size.
uz: Bu maxluqlar ustida yashovchi, o'lchamlari mos keladigan go'shtxo'r dinozavrlar to'dasi edi.

en: One of these, the Tyrannosaurus, is ﬁgured and de- scribed in many books as the last word in reptilian frightfulness.
uz: Bulardan biri, Tyrannosaurus, ko'plab kitoblarda sudralib yuruvchi qo'rquvchanlikning so'nggi so'zi sifatida tasvirlangan va yozib qoldirilgan.

en: A BIG SWAMP-INHABITING DINOSAUR, THE DIPLODOCUS, OVER EIGHTY FEET FROM SNOUT TO TAIL-TIP  Nat.
uz: Katta suzish-nafratuvchi dinozavr, DIPLODOKUS, qordan orqaga qarab sakson futdan ortiq.

en: While these great creatures pastured and pursued amidst the fronds and evergreens of the Mesozoic jungles, another now vanished tribe of reptiles, with a bat-like development of the fore limbs, pursued insects and one an- other, ﬁrst leapt and parachuted and presently ﬂew amidst the fronds and branches of the forest trees.
uz: Ushbu buyuk mavjudotlar Mezozoy o'rmonlarining barglari va doimiy yashillari orasida boqilgan va quvlab yurgan bir paytda, endi yo'qolib ketgan sudralib yuruvchilarning yana bir qabilasi old oyoqlarining ko'rshapalak shakliga ega bo'lib, hasharotlarni va bir-birini quvlab yurgan, avval sakrab, paraşutda uchib, keyinroq o'rmon barglari va shoxlari orasida uchib ketdi.

en: These were the Pterodactyls.
uz: Bular Pterodactyllar edi.

en: These were the ﬁrst ﬂying creatures with backbones; they mark a new achievement in the grow- ing powers of vertebrated life.
uz: Bular umurtqa suyagli birinchi uchuvchi mavjudotlar edi; ular umurtqali hayotning o'sish qobiliyatlarida yangi yutuqni belgilaydi.

en: Moreover some of the reptiles were returning to the sea waters.
uz: Qolaversa, sudralib yuruvchilarning ba'zilari dengiz suvlariga qaytishayotgan edi.

en: Three groups of big swimming beings had invaded the sea from which their ances- tors had come: the Mososaurs, the Plesiosaurs, and Ichthyosaurs.
uz: Katta suzuvchi mavjudotlarning uchta guruhi ularning ajdodlari kelgan dengizga bostirib kirgan edi: Mososavrlar, Plesiosavrlar va Ichtyozavrlar.

en: Some of these again approached the proportions of our present whales.
uz: Bularning ba'zilari yana hozirgi kitlarimizning proporsiyalariga yaqinlashdi.

en: The Ichthyosaurs seem to have been quite seagoing creatures, but the Plesiosaurs were a type of animal that has no cognate form to-day.
uz: Ichtiosavrlar ancha dengiz hayvonlari bo'lgan ko'rinadi, lekin Plesiosavrlar bugungi kunda qarindosh shakliga ega bo'lmagan hayvon turidir.

en: The body was stout and big with paddles, adapted either for swimming or crawling through marshes, or along the bottom of shallow waters.
uz: Tana mustahkam va katta edi, eshkaklari bilan, suzish yoki botqoqliklar orqali, yoki sayoz suvlar tubida emaklab yurish uchun mos edi.

en: The comparatively small
uz: Nisbatan kichik

en: head was poised on a vast snake of neck, altogether outdoing the neck of the swan.
uz: Bosh katta bo'yinli ilonga tikildi, umuman olganda oqqushning bo'ynidan ustun edi.

en: Either the Plesiosaur swam and searched for food under the water and fed as the swan will do, or it lurked under water and snatched at passing ﬁsh or beast.
uz: Yoki Plesiosavr suzib, suv ostida oziq-ovqat qidirdi va oqqush kabi oziqlantirildi, yoki u suv ostida yashirinib, o'tib ketayotgan baliq yoki hayvonni tortib oldi.

en: Such was the predominant land life throughout the Mesozoic age.
uz: Mesozoy davri davomida yer hayoti shunday hukmron edi.

en: It was by our human standards an advance upon anything that had preceded it.
uz: Bu bizning insoniy mezonlarimizga ko'ra, undan oldingi hamma narsadan oldinga siljish edi.

en: It had produced land animals greater in size, range, power and activity, more “vital” as people say, than anything the world had seen before.
uz: U yer yuzidagi hayvonlarni katta o'lcham, diapazon, quvvat va faollik bo'yicha, odamlar aytganidek, dunyo ko'rgan hamma narsadan ko'ra ko'proq  hayotiy yaratgan edi.

en: In the seas there had been no such advance but a great proliferation of new forms of life.
uz: Dengizlarda bunday taraqqiyot bo'lmagan, lekin yangi hayot shakllarining katta ko'payishi kuzatilgan edi.

en: An enormous variety of squid-like creatures with chambered shells, for the most part coiled, had appeared in the shallow seas, the Ammonites.
uz: Sayoz dengizlarda, ammoniylarda kameral qobiqlarga ega bo'lgan, ko'p qismi o'ralgan katta xilma-xil qovoqsimon mavjudotlar paydo bo'lgan edi.

en: They had had predecessors in the Palæozoic seas, but now was their age of glory.
uz: Ularda Paleozoik dengizlarda o'tmishdoshlari bor edi, lekin endi ularning shon-sharaf davri edi.

en: To-day they have left no survivors at all; their nearest relation is the pearly Nautilus, an inhabitant of tropical waters.
uz: Bugungi kunda ular hech qanday omon qolganlarni qoldirmadi; ularning eng yaqin qarindoshi tropik suvlarda yashovchi marvarid Nautilusdir.

en: And a new and more proliﬁc type of ﬁsh with lighter, ﬁner scales than the plate-like and tooth-like coverings that had hitherto prevailed, became and has since remained predominant in the seas and rivers.
uz: Va yangi va unumliroq baliq turi, shu paytgacha hukmron bo'lgan plastinka va tishsimon qoplamalarga qaraganda yengilroq, nozikroq tarozilarga ega bo'lib, dengizlar va daryolarda ustun bo'lib qoldi va shu vaqtdan beri hukmron bo'lib kelmoqda.

en: VII THE FIRST BIRDS AND THE FIRST MAMMALS In a few paragraphs a picture of the lush vegetation and swarming reptiles of that ﬁrst great summer of life, the Mesozoic period, has been sketched.
uz: VII BIRINCHI QUSHLAR VA BIRINCHI SO'RSHUVCHILAR Bir necha paragraflarda hayotning birinchi buyuk yozi, Mezozozo davridagi serhosil o'simliklar va to'planuvchi sudralib yuruvchilarning surati chizilgan.

en: But while the Dinosaurs lorded it over the hot selvas and marshy plains and the Pterodactyls ﬁlled the forests with their ﬂutterings and possibly with shrieks and croakings as they pursued the humming insect life of the still ﬂowerless shrubs and trees, some less conspicuous and less abundant forms upon the margins of this abounding life were acquiring certain powers and learning certain lessons of endurance, that were to be of the utmost value to their race when at last the smiling generosity of sun and earth began to fade.
uz: Lekin dinozavrlar issiq selvalar va botqoq tekisliklar ustidan hukmronlik qilgan bir paytda, Pterodactylar o'rmonlarni o'zlarining hilpirashlari va ehtimol shriklari va qichqiriqlari bilan to'ldirib, hali gulsiz butalar va daraxtlarning gumburlagan hasharot hayotini ta'qib qilishar ekan, bu mo'l-ko'l hayot chekkalarida kamroq ko'zga tashlanadigan va kamroq mo'l shakllar ma'lum kuchlarga ega bo'lishardi va bardoshlilik saboqlarini o'rganishardi, bu esa oxir-oqibat quyosh va yerning tabassumli saxiyligi so'nay boshlaganida ularning irqi uchun eng yuqori qiymatga ega bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: A group of tribes and genera of hopping reptiles, small creatures of the dinosaur type, seem to have been pushed by competition and the pursuit of their enemies towards the alternatives of extinction or adaptation to colder conditions in the higher hills or by the sea.
uz: Bir guruh qabilalar va sudralib yuruvchi sudralib yuruvchi hayvonlar, dinozavr turidagi kichik mavjudotlar, raqobat va dushmanlarining yuqoriroq tepaliklarda yoki dengiz bo'yidagi sovuqroq sharoitlarga yo'qolib ketish yoki moslashish alternativlariga intilishi natijasida itarilgan ko'rinadi.

en: Among these distressed tribes there was developed a new type of scale—scales that were elongated into quill-like forms and that presently branched into the crude beginnings of feathers.
uz: Bu azob chekkan qabilalar orasida yangi turdagi tarozi ishlab chiqildi  qiya shaklga cho'zilgan va hozirda patlarning qo'pol boshlanishlariga shoxlangan tarozilar.

en: These quill-like scales layover one another and formed a heat-re- taining covering more efﬁcient than any reptilian covering that had hitherto existed.
uz: Bu qiya shaklidagi tarozilar bir-birini yotqizadi va shu paytgacha mavjud bo'lgan har qanday sudralib yuruvchi qoplamadan ko'ra samaraliroq issiqlikni qayta tiklovchi qoplamani hosil qiladi.

en: So they permitted an invasion of colder regions that were otherwise uninhabited.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular boshqa hollarda aholi yashamaydigan sovuqroq hududlarga bostirib kirishga ruxsat berishdi.

en: Perhaps simultaneously with these changes there arose in these creatures a greater solicitude for their eggs.
uz: Ehtimol, bu o'zgarishlar bilan bir vaqtning o'zida bu mavjudotlarda ularning tuxumlariga bo'lgan katta e'tibor paydo bo'lgandir.

en: Most reptiles are apparently quite careless about their eggs, which are left for sun and season to hatch.
uz: Ko'pchilik sudralib yuruvchilar quyosh va mavsumda unib chiqishi uchun qoldirilgan tuxumlariga nisbatan ancha beparvo bo'lishar ekan.

en: But some of the varieties upon this new branch of the tree of life were ac-
uz: Ammo hayot daraxtining ushbu yangi shoxidagi ba'zi navlar...

en: quiring a habit of guarding their eggs and keeping them warm with the warmth of their bodies.
uz: Tuxumlarini qo'riqlash va ularni tana iliqligi bilan isitish odatini tark etish.

en: With these adaptations to cold other internal modiﬁcations were going on that made these creatures, the primitive birds, warm-blooded and indepen- dent of basking.
uz: Bu sovuqqa moslashuvlar bilan bu mavjudotlarni, ibtidoiy qushlarni, iliq qonli va o'z-o'zidan qondiradigan ichki o'zgarishlar bo'layotgan edi.

en: The very earliest birds seem to have been seabirds living upon ﬁsh, and their fore limbs were not wings but paddles rather after the penguin type.
uz: Eng qadimgi qushlar baliq ustida yashovchi dengiz qushlari bo'lgan ko'rinadi va ularning old oyoqlari qanot emas, balki pingvin tipidagi eshkaklar edi.

en: That peculiarly primitive bird, the New Zealand Ki-Wi, has feathers of a very simple sort, and neither ﬂies nor appears to be descended from ﬂying ancestors.
uz: O'sha o'ziga xos ibtidoiy qush, Yangi Zelandiya Ki-Wi, juda oddiy turdagi patlarga ega va na uchuvchi ajdodlardan kelib chiqqan ko'rinmaydi.

en: In the development of the birds, feathers came before wings.
uz: Qushlarning rivojlanishida patlar qanotlardan oldin paydo bo'lgan.

en: But once the feather was developed the possibility of making a light spread of feathers led inevitably to the wing.
uz: Lekin pat rivojlanganidan so'ng, patlarning yengil tarqalishi muqarrar ravishda qanotga olib borishi mumkin edi.

en: We know of the fossil remains of one bird at least which had reptilian teeth in its jaw and a long reptilian tail, but which also had a true bird’s wing and which certainly ﬂew and held its own among the pterodactyls of the Mesozoic time.
uz: Biz kamida bitta qushning qoldiqlari haqida bilamiz, uning jag'ida sudralib yuruvchi tishlari va uzun sudralib yuruvchi dumi bor edi, lekin u haqiqiy qush qanotini ham ega edi va u, albatta, Mezozozo davridagi pterodactyllar orasida o'zini ushlab turardi.

en: Nevertheless birds were neither varied nor abundant in Mesozoic times.
uz: Shunga qaramay, mezozoy davrida qushlar na xilma-xil edi, na mo'l-ko'l edi.

en: If a man could go back to typical Mesozoic country, he might walk for days and never see or hear such a thing as a bird, though he would see a great abundance of ptero- dactyls and insects among the fronds and reeds.
uz: Agar odam odatdagi Mezozoy davriga qaytib bora olsa, u bir necha kun yurib, qush kabi narsani hech qachon ko'rmasligi yoki eshitmasligi mumkin edi, garchi barglar va qamishlar orasida ptero-daktillar va hasharotlarning juda ko'pligini ko'rsa ham.

en: FOSSIL OF THE ARCHEOPTERYX; ONE OF THE EARLIEST BIRDS  Nat.
uz: ARXEOPTERIK QISMI; ENG DAVRLI QUSHLARNI BIRI Nat.

en: And another thing he would probably never see, and that would be any sign of a mammal.
uz: Va yana bir narsani u hech qachon ko'rmasligi mumkin edi, va bu sutemizuvchi hayvonning har qanday belgisi bo'lardi.

en: Probably the ﬁrst mammals were in existence millions of
uz: Ehtimol, birinchi sutemizuvchilar millionlab mavjud bo'lgan.

en: years before the ﬁrst thing one could call a bird, but they were altogether too small and obscure and remote for attention.
uz: Birinchi narsani qush deb atash mumkin bo'lganidan yillar oldin, lekin ular butunlay juda kichik, noaniq va e'tibor uchun uzoq edi.

en: HESPERORNIS IN ITS NATIVE SEAS
uz: HESPERORNIS O'zining O'ZINGIZDEK DENGIZLARIDA

en: The earliest mammals, like the earliest birds, were creatures driven by competition and pursuit into a life of hardship and adaptation to cold.
uz: Eng qadimgi sutemizuvchilar, xuddi eng qadimgi qushlar kabi, raqobat va qiyinchiliklar hamda sovuqqa moslashuvchan hayotga intilish natijasida haydalgan mavjudotlar edi.

en: With them also the scale became quill-like, and was developed into a heat-retain- ing covering; and they too underwent modiﬁcations, similar in kind though different in detail, to become warm-blooded and independent of basking.
uz: Ular bilan tarozi ham quillga o'xshab qoldi va issiqlikni ushlab turuvchi qopqoqga aylandi; va ular ham issiq qonli va o'rashdan mustaqil bo'lish uchun o'xshash, ammo batafsil farq qiladigan o'zgarishlarga duch kelishdi.

en: Instead of feathers they developed hairs, and instead of guarding and incu- bating their eggs they kept them warm and safe by retaining them inside their bodies until they were almost mature.
uz: Ular patlar o'rniga tuklar o'stirishdi va tuxumlarini qo'riqlash va yopishtirish o'rniga, ularni deyarli yetuk bo'lguncha tanasida saqlab, issiq va xavfsiz saqlashdi.

en: Most of them became altogether vivaparous and brought their young into the world alive.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi butunlay hayotga aylandi va bolalarini dunyoga tirik holda olib keldi.

en: And even after their young were born they tended to maintain a protective and nutritive as- sociation with them.
uz: Va hatto yosh bolalari tug'ilgandan keyin ham, ular ular bilan himoya va oziqlantiruvchi jamiyatni saqlab qolishga moyil edilar.

en: Most but not all mammals to-day have mammæ and suckle their young.
uz: Bugungi kunda ko'pchilik sutemizuvchilar emas, balki ularning ko'pchiligi emizadi va bolalarini emizadi.

en: Two mammals still live which lay eggs and which have not proper mammæ, though they nourish their young by a nutritive secre- tion of the under skin; these are the duck-billed platypus and the echidna.
uz: Ikki sutemizuvchi hali ham yashaydi, ular tuxum qo'yadi va to'g'ri emizishga ega emas, garchi ular o'z bolalarini teri ostidan oziqlantiruvchi sekretsiya bilan oziqlantirsa ham; bular o'rdak tishli platypus va echidna.

en: The echidna lays leathery eggs and then puts them into a pouch under its belly, and so carries them about warm and safe until they hatch.
uz: Echidna charm tuxumlarni qo'yadi va keyin qorniga qutichaga soladi, shu tariqa ularni iliq va xavfsiz holda ko'tarib, unib chiqguncha olib yuradi.

en: But just as a visitor to the Mesozoic world might have searched for days and weeks before ﬁnding a bird, so, unless he knew exactly where to go and look, he might have searched in vain for any traces of a mammal.
uz: Ammo xuddi Mezozoy dunyosiga tashrif buyuruvchi qushni topishdan oldin kunlar va haftalar qidirganidek, agar u aniq qayerga borishni va qidirishni bilmasa, u behuda sutemizuvchi izlarini qidirgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Both birds and mammals would have seemed very eccentric and secondary and unimportant creatures in Mesozoic times.
uz: Qushlar ham, sutemizuvchilar ham Mezozoy davrida juda g'alati va ikkinchi darajali va ahamiyatsiz mavjudotlardek tuyulgan bo'lardi.

en: THE KI-WI, APTERYX, STILL FOUND IN NEW ZEALAND Photo: Autotype Fine Art Co.
uz: KI-WI, APTERYX, YANGI ZELANDDA HAMON topiladi. Surat: Autotype Fine Art Co.

en: SLAB OF LOWER PLIOCENE MARL Discovered in Greece; it is rich in fossilized bones of early mammals
uz: Gretsiyada topilgan quyi PLIOCENE MARL SLAB; u erta sutemizuvchilarning qazilma suyaklariga boy.

en: The Age of Reptiles lasted, it is now guessed, eighty million years.
uz: Sudralib yuruvchilar davri davom etdi, hozir taxmin qilinmoqda, sakson million yil.

en: Had any quasi-human intelligence been watching the world through that incon- ceivable length of time, how safe and eternal the sunshine and abundance must have seemed, how assured the wallowing prosperity of the dinosaurs and the ﬂapping abundance of the ﬂying lizards!
uz: Agar biron bir deyarli insoniy aql dunyoni o'sha iloji yo'q vaqt davomida kuzatib turganida edi, quyosh nuri va mo'l-ko'llik qanchalik xavfsiz va abadiy ko'rinishi kerak edi, dinozavrlarning yutib yuruvchi farovonligi va uchayotgan kaltakesaklarning qanotli mo'l-ko'lligini qanchalik ta'minlagan bo'lardi!

en: And then the mysterious rhythms and accumulating forces of the universe began to turn against that quasi-eternal stability.
uz: Va keyin olamning sirli ritmlari va to'planib borayotgan kuchlari o'sha deyarli abadiy barqarorlikka qarshi burilishni boshladi.

en: That run of luck for life was running out.
uz: Hayot uchun omadning shu davri tugab borayotgan edi.

en: Age by age, myriad of years after myriad of years, with halts no doubt and retro- gressions, came a change towards hardship and extreme conditions, came great alterations of level and great redistributions of mountain and sea.
uz: Yoshdan yoshga, ko'p yillar o'tib, ko'p yillar o'tgach, hech qanday shubha yo'q to'xtashlar va orqaga qadamlar bilan, qiyinchilik va haddan tashqari sharoitlarga o'zgarish keldi, darajaning katta o'zgarishlari va tog' va dengizning katta qayta taqsimlanishi keldi.

en: We ﬁnd one thing in the Record of the Rocks during the decadence of the long Mesozoic age of prosperity that is very signiﬁcant of steadily sustained changes of condition, and that is a violent ﬂuctuation of living forms and the appearance of new and strange species.
uz: Toshlar yozuvidan uzoq Mezozoy davridagi farovonlik tanazzuli davrida holatning barqaror o'zgarishlaridan juda muhim bo'lgan bir narsani topamiz, ya'ni tirik shakllarning shiddatli tebranishi va yangi va g'alati turlarning paydo bo'lishi.

en: Under the gathering threat of extinction the older orders and genera are displaying their utmost capacity for variation and adaptation.
uz: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida eski tartiblar va turkumlar o'zgarish va moslashuvchanlik uchun o'zining maksimal salohiyatini namoyish etmoqda.

en: The Ammonites for example in these last pages of the Mesozoic chapter exhibit a multitude of fantastic forms.
uz: Masalan, Mezozoy bobining so'nggi sahifalaridagi ammoniylar ko'plab fantastik shakllarni namoyon etadi.

en: Under settled conditions there is no encouragement for novelties; they do not de- velop, they are suppressed; what is best adapted is already there.
uz: Muayyan sharoitlarda yangiliklarga undash yo'q; ular de-velop emas, ular bostiriladi; eng yaxshi moslashtirilgan narsa allaqachon mavjud.

en: Under novel conditions it is the ordinary type that suffers, and the novelty that may have a better chance to survive and establish itself....
uz: Yangi sharoitlarda aynan oddiy tur azob chekadi, yangilik esa omon qolish va o'zini o'rnatish uchun yaxshiroq imkoniyatga ega bo'lishi mumkin....

en: There comes a break in the Record of the Rocks that may represent sev- eral million years.
uz: Toshlar yozuvida bir uzilish paydo bo'ladi, bu esa yetti million yilni ifodalashi mumkin.

en: There is a veil here still, over even the outline of the his- tory of life.
uz: Bu yerda hali ham hayotning o'z-o'zidan ko'ra parda bor.

en: When it lifts again, the Age of Reptiles is at an end; the Di- nosaurs, the Plesiosaurs and Ichthyosaurs, the Pterodactyls, the innumerable genera and species of Ammonite have all gone absolutely.
uz: Qachonki u yana ko'tarilsa, sudralib yuruvchilarning davri tugaydi; Di-nosorlar, pleziosavrlar va ixtiosavrlar, Pterodactyllar, Ammonitlarning son-sanoqsiz urug'lari va turlari butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: In all their stu- pendous variety they have died out and left no descendants.
uz: Ularning barcha ulkan xilma-xilliklarida ular yo'q bo'lib ketishdi va hech qanday avlod qoldirmadilar.

en: The cold has killed them.
uz: Sovuq ularni o'ldirdi.

en: All their ﬁnal variations were insufﬁcient; they had never hit upon survival conditions.
uz: Ularning barcha yakuniy variantlari yetarli emas edi; ular hech qachon omon qolish shartlariga duch kelmagan edilar.

en: The world had passed through a phase of extreme conditions beyond their powers of endurance, a slow and complete mas- sacre of Mesozoic life has occurred, and we ﬁnd now a new scene, a new and hardier ﬂora, and a new and hardier fauna in possession of the world.
uz: Dunyo o'z chidamlilik qobiliyatidan tashqari haddan tashqari sharoitlar bosqichidan o'tdi, Mezozoy hayotining sekin va to'liq mas-muqaddasligi sodir bo'ldi va biz hozirda dunyoga ega bo'lgan yangi sahna, yangi va bardoshli flora va yangi va bardoshli faunaga duch keldik.

en: It is still a bleak and impoverished scene with which this new volume of the book of life begins.
uz: Hayot kitobining bu yangi jildi hali ham qorong'u va kambag'al sahna bilan boshlanadi.

en: The cycads and tropical conifers have given place very largely to trees that shed their leaves to avoid destruction by the snows of winter and to ﬂowering plants and shrubs, and where there was formerly
uz: Sikadlar va tropik ignabargli daraxtlar qishning qorlari tufayli vayron bo'lishidan qochish uchun barglarini to'kadigan daraxtlarga, shuningdek, gullaydigan o'simliklar va butalarga juda katta o'rin bergan va ilgari mavjud bo'lgan joylarga.

en: a profusion of reptiles, an increasing variety of birds and mammals is enter- ing into their inheritance.
uz: sudralib yuruvchilarning ko'pligi, qushlar va sutemizuvchilarning tobora ko'payib borayotgan xilma-xilligi ularning merosiga kirmoqda.

en: VIII THE AGE OF MAMMALS The opening of the next great period in the life of the earth, the Cainozoic period, was a period of upheaval and extreme volcanic activity.
uz: VIII SUSHKAVLAR DAVRI Yer hayotidagi keyingi buyuk davrning, Kaynozo davrining ochilishi, to'ntarish va haddan tashqari vulqon faolligi davri edi.

en: Now it was that the vast masses of the Alps and Himalayas and the mountain backbone of the Rockies and Andes were thrust up, and that the rude outlines of our present oceans and continents appeared.
uz: Endi Alp tog'lari va Himalay tog'larining ulkan massasi, Rokki tog'lari va And tog'larning orqa tayanchi ag'darildi va hozirgi okeanlarimiz va qit'alarimizning qo'pol konturlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: The map of the world begins to dis- play a ﬁrst dim resemblance to the map of to-day.
uz: Dunyo xaritasi bugungi kunga birinchi xira o'xshashlikni namoyon eta boshlaydi.

en: It is estimated now that between forty and eighty million years have elapsed from the beginnings of the Cainozoic period to the present time.
uz: Taxminlarga ko'ra, Kaynozo davrining boshidan hozirgi kungacha qirqdan sakson million yilgacha vaqt o'tgan.

en: At the outset of the Cainozoic period the climate of the world was austere.
uz: Kaynozo davrining boshida dunyo iqlimi qattiqroq edi.

en: It grew generally warmer until a fresh phase of great abundance was reached, after which conditions grew hard again and the earth passed into a series of extremely cold cycles, the Glacial Ages, from which apparently it is now slowly emerging.
uz: U odatda issiqroq bo'lib, yangi, ulkan mo'l-ko'l fazaga erishilgunga qadar o'sdi, shundan so'ng sharoitlar yana qattiqlashdi va Yer o'ta sovuq davrlar, Muz davrlariga o'tdi, ulardan endi asta-sekin chiqib kelmoqda.

en: But we do not know sufﬁcient of the causes of climatic change at present to forecast the possible ﬂuctuations of climatic conditions that lie before us.
uz: Lekin biz hozirgi vaqtda iqlim o'zgarishining sabablarini oldimizda turgan iqlim sharoitlarining ehtimoliy tebranishlarini bashorat qilish uchun yetarli darajada bilmaymiz.

en: We may be moving towards increasing sunshine or lapsing towards another glacial age; volcanic activity and the upheaval of mountain masses may be increasing or diminishing; we do not know; we lack sufﬁcient science.
uz: Biz quyosh nurini kuchaytirishga yoki yana bir muzlik davriga qarab ketayotgan bo'lishimiz mumkin; vulqon faolligi va tog' massalarining buzilishi kuchayib yoki kamayib borayotgan bo'lishi mumkin; bilmaymiz; yetarli bilimga ega emasmiz.

en: With the opening of this period the grasses appear; for the ﬁrst time there is pasture in the world; and with the full development of the once obscure mammalian type, appear a number of interesting grazing animals and of car- nivorous types which prey upon these.
uz: Ushbu davrning ochilishi bilan o'tlar paydo bo'ladi; dunyoda birinchi marta yaylov bor; va bir vaqtlar noma'lum bo'lgan sutemizuvchi turning to'liq rivojlanishi bilan, ularga o'lja bo'ladigan bir qator qiziqarli o'tloq hayvonlari va mashina-xo'r turlari paydo bo'ladi.

en: At ﬁrst these early mammals seem to differ only in a few characters from the great herbivorous and carnivorous reptiles that ages before had ﬂourished
uz: Dastlab, bu erta sutemizuvchilar qadim zamonlarda gullab-yashnagan ulkan o'txo'r va go'shtxo'r sudralib yuruvchilardan faqat bir necha xarakter jihatidan farq qiladi.

en: and then vanished from the earth.
uz: so'ngra yer yuzidan g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: A careless observer might suppose that in this second long age of warmth and plenty that was now beginning, nature was merely repeating the ﬁrst, with herbivorous and carnivorous mammals to parallel the herbivorous and carnivorous dinosaurs, with birds replacing pterodactyls and so on.
uz: Ehtiyotsiz kuzatuvchi, endi boshlanayotgan issiqlik va mo'l-ko'llikning ikkinchi uzoq davrida tabiat faqat birinchisini takrorlayotganini, o'txo'r va go'shtxo'r sutemizuvchilar o'txo'r va go'shtxo'r dinozavrlar bilan parallel ravishda, qushlar pterodaktillarni o'rnini bosganini va hokazo deb taxmin qilishi mumkin.

en: But this would be an altogether superﬁcial compari- son.
uz: Lekin bu shunchaki yuzaki taqqoslash bo'lardi.

en: The variety of the universe is inﬁnite and incessant; it progresses eter- nally; history never repeats itself and no parallels are precisely true.
uz: Koinotning xilma-xilligi cheksiz va tinimsiz; u doimiy ravishda rivojlanadi; tarix hech qachon takrorlanmaydi va hech qanday parallellar aniq haqiqatga ega emas.

en: The dif- ferences between the life of the Cainozoic and Mesozoic periods are far pro- founder than the resemblances.
uz: Kaynozoy va Mezozoy davrlarining hayoti o'rtasidagi farqlar o'xshashliklardan ancha ustun turadi.

en: A MAMMAL OF THE EARLY CAINOZOIC PERIOD  The Titanotherum (Brontops) Robustum The most fundamental of all these differences lies in the mental life of the two periods.
uz: ERTA KAINOZOIY MAVSUMNING O'G'RI Titanoterm (Brontops) Robustum Bu barcha farqlarning eng asosiysi ikki davrning ruhiy hayotida joylashgan.

en: It arises essentially out of the continuing contact of parent and offspring which distinguishes mammalian and in a lesser degree bird life, from the life of the reptile.
uz: U asosan ota-ona va avlodning doimiy aloqasi natijasida kelib chiqadi, bu sutemizuvchilarning va kamroq darajada qushlarning hayotini sudralib yuruvchilarning hayotidan ajratib turadi.

en: With very few exceptions the reptile abandons its egg to hatch alone.
uz: Juda kam istisnolar bilan sudralib yuruvchi o'z tuxumini tashlab, yolg'iz ko'payadi.

en: The young reptile has no knowledge whatever of its par- ent; its mental life, such as it is, begins and ends with its own experiences.
uz: Yosh sudralib yuruvchi o'z hayoti haqida hech qanday bilimga ega emas; uning aqliy hayoti, qanday bo'lsa, o'z tajribalari bilan boshlanadi va tugaydi.

en: It may tolerate the existence of its fellows but it has no communication with them; it never imitates, never learns from them, is incapable of concerted ac- tion with them.
uz: U o'z sheriklarining mavjudligiga toqat qilishi mumkin, lekin ular bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q; u hech qachon taqlid qilmaydi, ulardan hech qachon o'rganmaydi, ular bilan birgalikda harakat qilishga qodir emas.

en: Its life is that of an isolated individual.
uz: Uning hayoti alohida shaxsning hayotidir.

en: But with the suckling and cherishing of young which was distinctive of the new mammalian and avian strains arose the possibility of learning by imitation, of communica- tion, by warning cries and other concerted action, of mutual control and in- struction.
uz: Ammo yangi sutemizuvchi va qush shtammlariga xos bo'lgan yoshlarni emizish va parvarishlash bilan taqlid, aloqa, ogohlantirish faryodlari va boshqa muvofiqlashtirilgan harakatlar orqali o'rganish, o'zaro nazorat va ta'sir o'tkazish imkoniyati paydo bo'ldi.

en: A teachable type of life had come into the world.
uz: O'rgatiladigan hayot turi dunyoga keldi.

en: The earliest mammals of the Cainozoic period are but little superior in brain size to the more active carnivorous dinosaurs, but as we read on through the record towards modern times we ﬁnd, in every tribe and race of the mammalian animals, a steady universal increase in brain capacity.
uz: Kaynozo davridagi eng qadimgi sutemizuvchilar miya hajmi bo'yicha faolroq go'shtxo'r dinozavrlardan unchalik ustun emas, lekin zamonaviy davrga oid yozuvlarni o'qiganimiz sari, sutemizuvchi hayvonlarning har bir qabilasi va irqida miya sig'imining barqaror universal o'sishini aniqlaymiz.

en: For instance we ﬁnd at a comparatively early stage that rhinoceros-like beasts appear.
uz: Misol uchun, biz rhinocerosga o'xshash maxluqlarning nisbatan erta bosqichda paydo bo'lishini topamiz.

en: There is a creature, the Titanotherium, which lived in the earliest di- vision of this period.
uz: Bir maxluq bor, Titanotherium, u ushbu davrning eng erta ko'rinishida yashagan.

en: It was probably very like a modern rhinoceros in its habits and needs.
uz: U o'z odatlari va ehtiyojlari bo'yicha zamonaviy burgutga juda o'xshardi, ehtimol.

en: But its brain capacity was not one tenth that of its living successor.
uz: Lekin uning miya sig'imi tirik vorisidan o'ndan bir qismini tashkil etmas edi.
