en: The earlier mammals probably parted from their offspring as soon as suckling was over, but, once the capacity for mutual understanding has arisen, the advantages of continuing the association are very great; and we presently ﬁnd a number of mammalian species displaying the beginnings of a true social life and keeping together in herds, packs and ﬂocks, watching each other, imitating each other, taking warning from each other’s acts and cries.
uz: Ilk sutemizuvchilar emizish tugagandan so'ng o'z avlodlaridan ajralgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin o'zaro tushunish qobiliyati paydo bo'lgandan so'ng, aloqani davom ettirishning afzalliklari juda katta; va hozirda bir qator sutemizuvchi turlari haqiqiy ijtimoiy hayotning boshlanishini namoyish etayotganini va suruvlar, to'dalar va suruvlarda bir-birini kuzatayotganini, bir-birlariga taqlid qilayotganini, bir-birining harakatlari va faryodlaridan ogohlantirayotganini topamiz.

en: This is something that the world had not seen before among vertebrat- ed animals.
uz: Bu umurtqali hayvonlar orasida dunyo ilgari ko'rmagan narsa.

en: Reptiles and ﬁsh may no doubt be found in swarms and shoals; they have been hatched in quantities and similar conditions have kept them together, but in the case of the social and gregarious mammals the associa- tion arises not simply from a community of external forces, it is sustained by an inner impulse.
uz: Sudralib yuruvchi hayvonlar va baliqlar shubhasiz, to'dalar va o'rmonlarda uchraydi; ular miqdorda ko'paygan va shunga o'xshash sharoitlar ularni birga ushlab turgan, lekin ijtimoiy va umumiy sutemizuvchilar holatida assotsiatsiya shunchaki tashqi kuchlar jamoasidan kelib chiqmaydi, balki ichki impuls tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

en: They are not merely like one another and so found in the same places at the same times; they like one another and so they keep to- gether.
uz: Ular shunchaki bir-biriga o'xshash emas va bir vaqtning o'zida bir xil joylarda uchraydi; ular bir-birlariga yoqadi va shuning uchun birga qoladilar.

en: STENOMYLUS HITCHCOCKI—A GIRAFFE-CAMEL  Nat.
uz: STENOMYLUS HITCHCOCKIA GIRAFFE-CAMEL Nat.

en: SKELETON OF PROTOHIPPUS VENTICOLUS--EARLY HORSE  Nat.
uz: PROTOHIPPUS VENTICOLUS SKELETONI  EARLY HORSE Nat.

en: This difference between the reptile world and the world of our human minds is one our sympathies seem unable to pass.
uz: Bu sudralib yuruvchi olam va inson ongimiz olami o'rtasidagi farq bizning hamdardligimiz o'tib ketmaydigan tuyuladigan narsadir.

en: We cannot conceive in ourselves the swift uncomplicated urgency of a reptile’s instinctive motives, its appetites, fears and hates.
uz: Biz o'zimizda sudralib yuruvchining instinkt motivlari, ishtahalari, qo'rquvlari va nafratlarining tezkor, murakkab bo'lmagan shoshilinchligini tasavvur qila olmaymiz.

en: We cannot understand them in their simplicity because all our motives are complicated; our’s are balances and resultants and not simple urgencies.
uz: Biz ularni soddaligida tushunolmaymiz, chunki barcha motivlarimiz murakkab; bizning motivlarimiz muvozanatlar va natijalar, oddiy favqulodda vaziyatlar emas.

en: But the mammals and birds have self-restraint and consideration for other individuals, a social appeal, a self- control that is, at its lower level, after our own fashion.
uz: Lekin sutemizuvchilar va qushlarda o'zini tiyish va boshqa shaxslarga e'tibor, ijtimoiy joziba, o'zini nazorat qilish bor, bu esa o'z uslubimizga ko'ra pastroq darajada.

en: We can in consequence establish rela- tions with almost all sorts of them.
uz: Biz ularning deyarli har xil turlari bilan munosabatlar o'rnatishimiz mumkin.

en: When they suffer they utter cries and make movements that rouse our feelings.
uz: Ular azob chekayotganda, faryodlar chiqarishadi va his-tuyg'ularimizni uyg'otadigan harakatlar qilishadi.

en: We can make understanding pets of them with a mutual recognition.
uz: Biz ularni o'zaro tan olish orqali tushunarli uy hayvonlari qila olamiz.

en: They can be tamed to self-restraint to- wards us, domesticated and taught.
uz: Ularni o'z-o'zini tiyishga o'rgatish mumkin - bizni qamrab olish, uylashtirish va o'rgatish.

en: COMPARATIVE SIZES OF BRAINS OF RHINOCEROS AND DINOCERAS  Nat.
uz: RINOSEROS VA DINOSERAS NATONALARINING TASBIQLASH O'LCHAMLARI.

en: That unusual growth of brain which is the central fact of Cainozoic times marks a new communication and interdependence of individuals.
uz: Cainozoy davrining markaziy fakt bo'lgan aqlning o'sha g'ayrioddiy o'sishi shaxslarning yangi muloqot va o'zaro bog'liqligini belgilaydi.

en: It fore- shadows the development of human societies of which we shall soon be telling.
uz: U inson jamiyatlarining rivojlanishiga soya soladi, bu haqda tez orada aytib o'tamiz.

en: As the Cainozoic period unrolled, the resemblance of its ﬂora and fauna to the plants and animals that inhabit the world to-day increased.
uz: Kaynozo davrining ochilishi bilan uning flora va fauna a'zolarining bugungi kunda dunyoda yashovchi o'simliklar va hayvonlarga o'xshashligi ortdi.

en: The big clum- sy Uintatheres and Titanotheres, the Entelodonts and Hyracodons, big clum- sy brutes like nothing living, disappeared.
uz: Katta to'dalar - Uintaterlar va Titanoterlar, Entelodonlar va Girakodonlar, hech qanday tirik narsa kabi katta to'dalar - yirtqichlar yo'qoldi.

en: On the other hand a series of forms led up by steady degrees from grotesque and clumsy predecessors to the giraffes, camels, horses, elephants, deer, dogs and lions and tigers of the existing world.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, g'alati va bema'ni o'tmishdagilardan tortib, mavjud dunyoning jirafalari, tuyalari, otlari, fillari, bug'ulari, itlari va sherlari hamda yo'lbarslarigacha barqaror darajalarda yetakchilik qiluvchi shakllar seriyasi.

en: The evolution of the horse is particularly legible upon the ge- ological record.
uz: Otning evolyutsiyasi, ayniqsa, geologik yozuvlarda o'qilishi mumkin.

en: We have a fairly complete series of forms from a small tapir-like ancestor in the early Cainozoic.
uz: Bizda erta Kaynozoy davridagi kichik tapirga o'xshash ajdoddan olingan shakllarning ancha to'liq seriyasi mavjud.

en: Another line of development that has now been pieced together with some precision is that of the llamas and camels.
uz: Yana bir rivojlanish yo'nalishi, hozirda ba'zi bir aniqlik bilan birlashtirilgan, lamaslar va tuyalardir.

en: IX MONKEYS, APES AND SUB-MEN Naturalists divide the class Mammalia into a number of orders.
uz: IX MONKEY, APES VA SUB-MEN Tabiatshunoslar sutemizuvchilar sinfini bir qator tartiblarga bo'lishadi.

en: At the head of these is the order Primates, which includes the lemurs, the monkeys, apes and man.
uz: Bularning boshida Lemurlar, maymunlar, maymunlar va insonni o'z ichiga olgan Primatlar ordeni turibdi.

en: Their classiﬁcation was based originally upon anatomical re- semblances and took no account of any mental qualities.
uz: Ularning tasnifi dastlab anatomik qayta o'xshashliklarga asoslangan va hech qanday aqliy xususiyatlarni hisobga olmagan.

en: Now the past history of the Primates is one very difﬁcult to decipher in the geological record.
uz: Endi primatlar o'tmish tarixi geologik yozuvlarda juda qiyin tushuniladigan tarixdir.

en: They are for the most part animals which live in forests like the lemurs and monkeys or in bare rocky places like the ba- boons.
uz: Ular asosan lemurlar va maymunlar kabi o'rmonlarda yoki ba-boon kabi yalang'och toshli joylarda yashovchi hayvonlardir.

en: They are rarely drowned and covered up by sediment, nor are most of them very numerous species, and so they do not ﬁgure so largely among the fossils as the ancestors of the horses, camels and so forth do.
uz: Ular kamdan-kam hollarda cho'kib ketadi va cho'kindi bilan qoplanadi, ularning aksariyati juda ko'p tur emas, shuning uchun ular otlar, tuyalar va hokazolarning ajdodlari kabi ko'p qazilmalar orasida turmaydi.

en: But we know that quite early in the Cainozoic period, that is to say some forty mil- lion years ago or so, primitive monkeys and lemuroid creatures had ap- peared, poorer in brain and not so specialized as their later successors.
uz: Lekin biz bilamizki, Kaynozo davrining ancha erta davrida, ya'ni taxminan qirq million yil oldin, ibtidoiy maymunlar va lemuroid mavjudotlar o'zlarining keyingi vorislariga o'xshab, miyada kambag'alroq va unchalik ixtisoslashgan emas edi.

en: The great world summer of the middle Cainozoic period drew at last to an end.
uz: O'rta Kaynozo davridagi buyuk jahon yozi nihoyat yakunlandi.

en: It was to follow those other two great summers in the history of life, the summer of the Coal Swamps and the vast summer of the Age of Rep- tiles.
uz: Bu hayot tarixidagi o'sha boshqa ikki buyuk yozni, Ko'mir botqoqliklari yozini va Repliklar davrining ulkan yozini kuzatib borishi kerak edi.

en: Once more the earth spun towards an ice age.
uz: Yer yana bir bor muz davriga qarab aylandi.

en: The world chilled, grew milder for a time and chilled again.
uz: Dunyo sovidi, bir muddat yumshoqlashdi va yana sovidi.

en: In the warm past hippopotami had wal- lowed through a lush sub-tropical vegetation, and a tremendous tiger with fangs like sabres, the sabre-toothed tiger, had hunted its prey where now the journalists of Fleet Street go to and fro.
uz: Issiq o'tmishda begemotlar serhosil subtropik o'simliklardan o'tib ketgan edi va qilichdek tishli ulkan yo'lbars, qilich tishli yo'lbars o'z o'ljasini ovlagan edi, hozir Fleet Street jurnalistlari u yerga va bu yerga boradi.

en: Now came a bleaker age and still bleaker ages.
uz: Endi xiraroq davr keldi va hali ham xiraroq davrlar.

en: A great weeding and extinction of species occurred.
uz: Katta begona oʻtlar va turlarning yoʻq boʻlib ketishi sodir boʻldi.

en: A woolly rhinoceros, adapted to a cold climate, and the mammoth, a big woolly cousin of the elephants, the Arctic musk ox and the reindeer passed across
uz: Sovuq iqlimga moslashgan junli karkidon va fillarning katta junli amakivachchasi bo'lgan mammoth, Arktika mushak ho'kizi va bug'u o'tib ketdi.

en: Then century by century the Arctic ice cap, the wintry death of the great Ice Age, crept southward.
uz: Keyin asrma-asr Arktika muz qopqog'i, buyuk Muz Davrining qishki o'limi janubga sirg'alib bordi.

en: In England it came almost down to the Thames, in America it reached Ohio.
uz: Angliyada deyarli Temza daryosiga tushdi, Amerikada esa Ogayoga yetdi.

en: There would be warmer spells of a few thousand years and relapses towards a bitterer cold.
uz: Bir necha ming yillik iliqroq sehrlar va achchiq sovuqqa qaytishlar bo'lardi.

en: Geologists talk of these wintry phases as the First, Second, Third and Fourth Glacial Ages, and of the interludes as Interglacial periods.
uz: Geologlar bu qishki fazalarni Birinchi, Ikkinchi, Uchinchi va To'rtinchi Muzlik davrlari, oraliq davrlarni esa Muzliklararo davrlar deb atashadi.

en: We live to-day in a world that is still impoverished and scarred by that terrible win- ter.
uz: Biz bugungi kunda o'sha dahshatli g'alabadan hanuzgacha kambag'allashgan va jarohatlangan dunyoda yashayapmiz.

en: The First Glacial Age was coming on 600,000 years ago; the Fourth Glacial Age reached its bitterest some ﬁfty thousand years ago.
uz: Birinchi muzlik davri 600 000 yil oldin yaqinlashayotgan edi; to'rtinchi muzlik davri o'zining eng achchiq davriga ellik ming yil oldin yetgan edi.

en: And it was amidst the snows of this long universal winter that the ﬁrst man-like beings lived upon our planet.
uz: Va aynan shu uzun universal qishning qorlari orasida sayyoramizda birinchi insonga o'xshash mavjudotlar yashadi.

en: A MAMMOTH By the middle Cainozoic period there have appeared various apes with many quasi-human attributes of the jaws and leg bones, but it is only as we approach these Glacial Ages that we ﬁnd traces of creatures that we can speak of as “almost human.” These traces are not bones but implements.
uz: MAMMOTH O'rta Kaynozo davrida jag' va oyoq suyaklarining ko'plab deyarli insoniy xususiyatlariga ega bo'lgan turli xil maymunlar paydo bo'ldi, lekin aynan shu Muz davrlariga yaqinlashsak, biz deyarli inson deb ayta oladigan mavjudotlarning izlarini topamiz. Bu izlar suyaklar emas, balki asboblardir.

en: In Europe, in deposits of this period, between half a million and a million
uz: Yevropada, shu davrdagi depozitlarda, yarim milliondan bir milliongacha.

en: years old, we ﬁnd ﬂints and stones that have evidently been chipped inten- tionally by some handy creature desirous of hammering, scraping or ﬁght- ing with the sharpened edge.
uz: Ko'p yillar oldin, biz o'tkir qirra bilan bolg'a urish, qirib tashlash yoki kurashishni istagan ba'zi qo'lbars mavjudot tomonidan ataylab maydalangan flanetslar va toshlarni topamiz.

en: These things have been called “Eoliths” (dawn stones).
uz: Bu narsalar Eoliths deb nomlangan.

en: In Europe there are no bones nor other remains of the creature which made these objects, simply the objects themselves.
uz: Yevropada bu narsalarni yasagan mavjudotning suyaklari ham, boshqa qoldiqlari ham yo'q, shunchaki buyumlarning o'zi.

en: For all the cer- tainty we have it may have been some entirely un-human but intelligent monkey.
uz: Bizda bor ishonchga ko'ra, u butunlay insoniy bo'lmagan, lekin aqlli maymun bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: But at Trinil in Java, in accumulations of this age, a piece of a skull and various teeth and bones have been found of a sort of ape man, with a brain case bigger than that of any living apes, which seems to have walked erect.
uz: Ammo Yavadagi Trinilda, shu davrdagi to'plamlarda, bosh suyagining bir qismi va turli xil tishlar va suyaklar topilgan, unda har qanday tirik maymunlardagidan kattaroq bo'lgan, tik yurgan ko'rinadigan maymun odamning miyasi bor.

en: This creature is now called Pithecanthropus erectus, the walk- ing ape man, and the little trayful of its bones is the only help our imagina- tions have as yet in ﬁguring to, ourselves the makers of the Eoliths.
uz: Bu mavjudot hozirda Pithecanthropus erectus deb ataladi, yuradigan maymun odam, va uning suyaklarining kichkina bo'lagi bizning tasavvurimizdagi yagona yordam bo'lib, biz Eolithlar yaratuvchilari ekanligimizni aniqlashga hali bor kuchimiz yetadi.

en: FLINT IMPLEMENTS FOUND IN PILTDOWN REGION  Nat.
uz: FLINT IMPLEMENTLARI PILTDOWN REGION Nat.da topildi.

en: It is not until we come to sands that are almost a quarter of a million years old that we ﬁnd any other particle of a sub- human being.
uz: Faqatgina deyarli chorak million yillik qumlarga yetib borgunimizcha, biz sub-insonning boshqa zarralarini topamiz.

en: are plenty of implements, and they are steadily improving in quality as we read on through the record.
uz: U yerda juda ko'p asboblar bor va ular sifatini doimiy ravishda yaxshilab bormoqda, chunki biz bu haqda yozuv orqali o'qiymiz.

en: They are no longer clumsy Eoliths; they are now shapely instruments made with considerable skill.
uz: Ular endi beparvo Eolithlar emas; ular endi sezilarli mahorat bilan yasalgan shakldagi asboblardir.

en: And they are much bigger than the similar implements afterwards made by true man.
uz: Va ular haqiqiy odam tomonidan keyinchalik yasalgan shunga o'xshash asboblardan ancha kattaroqdir.

en: Then, in a sandpit at Heidelberg, appears a single quasi-human jaw-bone, a clumsy jaw-bone, absolutely chinless, far heavier than a true human jaw-bone and narrower, so that it is improbable the creature’s tongue could have moved about for articulate speech.
uz: Keyin, Heidelbergdagi qumxonada bitta deyarli insoniy jag' suyag'i paydo bo'ladi, g'adir-budur jag' suyag'i, mutlaqo chinsiz, haqiqiy insoniy jag' suyagidan ancha og'irroq va torroq, shuning uchun maxluqning tili aniq nutq uchun harakatlanishi mumkin emas.

en: On the strength of this jaw-bone, scientiﬁc men suppose this creature to have been a heavy, almost human monster, possibly with huge limbs and hands, possibly with a thick felt of hair, and they call it the Heidelberg Man.
uz: Ushbu jag' suyagining kuchiga ko'ra, olimlar bu maxluq og'ir, deyarli insoniy maxluq bo'lgan deb taxmin qilishadi, ehtimol ulkan oyoq-qo'llari va qo'llari bor, ehtimol qalin sochli, va uni Heidelberg odami deb atashadi.

en: A THEORETICAL RESTORATION OF THE PITHECANTHROPUS ERECTUS BY PROF.
uz: PROFESSOR tomonidan PITHECANTHROPUS ERECTUSning nazariy restavratsiyasi.

en: RUTOT This jaw-bone is, I think, one of the most tormenting objects in the world to our human curiosity.
uz: RUTOT Bu jag' suyagi, menimcha, insoniy qiziqishimiz uchun dunyodagi eng azobli ob'ektlardan biridir.

en: To see it is like looking through a defective glass into the past and catching just one blurred and tantalizing glimpse of this Thing, shambling through the bleak wilderness, clambering to avoid the sabre- toothed tiger, watching the woolly rhinoceros in the woods.
uz: Buni ko'rish xuddi o'tmishga nuqsonli oyna orqali qarashga va bu Narsaning faqat bir xira va hayratlanarli ko'rinishini ushlashga o'xshaydi, qorong'u cho'l bo'ylab g'adir-budur yurib, qilich tishli yo'lbarsdan qochish uchun o'rmondagi junli karkidonlarni tomosha qilgandek.

en: fore we can scrutinize the monster, he vanishes.
uz: Biz maxluqni tekshirib ko'rishimizdan oldin, u g'oyib bo'ladi.

en: Yet the soil is littered abun- dantly with the indestructible implements he chipped out for his uses.
uz: Lekin tuproq axlatga to'la - u o'z foydalanishlari uchun yaratgan buzilmas asboblar bilan bezatilgan.

en: THE HEIDELBERG MAN  The Heidelberg Man, as modelled under the supervision of Prof.
uz: HEIDELBERG ERKAKI Prof. rahbarligida modellashtirilgan Heidelberg Erka.

en: Rutot Still more fascinatingly enigmatical are the remains of a creature found at Piltdown in Sussex in a deposit that may indicate an age between a hundred and a hundred and ﬁfty thousand years ago, though some authorities would put these particular remains back in time to before the Heidelberg jaw- bone.
uz: Rutotning yana ham qiziqarliroq va sirli jihatlari Sussexdagi Piltdaunda yuzaga kelgan maxluqning qoldiqlari bo'lib, ular yuzdan bir yuz ellik ming yilgacha bo'lgan davrni ko'rsatishi mumkin, garchi ba'zi rasmiylar bu qoldiqlarni o'z vaqtida Heidelberg jag' suyagidan oldinroq joylashtirgan bo'lsalar ham.

en: Here there are the remains of a thick sub-human skull much larger than any existing ape’s, and a chimpanzee-like jaw-bone which may or may not belong to it, and, in addition, a bat-shaped piece of elephant bone evi- dently carefully manufactured, through which a hole had apparently been bored.
uz: Bu yerda mavjud bo'lgan har qanday maymundan ancha katta bo'lgan qalin subinsoniy bosh suyagining qoldiqlari, unga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin yoki bo'lmasligi mumkin bo'lgan shimpansga o'xshash jag' suyagining qoldiqlari va, bundan tashqari, tish bilan ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlab chiqarilgan fil suyagining ko'rshapalak shaklidagi bo'lagi mavjud bo'lib, u orqali teshik bor edi.

en: There is also the thigh-bone of a deer with cuts upon it like a tally.
uz: Shuningdek, bug'uning son suyagi ham bor, ustida terish kabi kesmalar bor.

en: THE PILTDOWN SKULL, AS RECONSTRUCTED FROM ORIGI- NAL FRAGMENT  Nat.
uz: PILTDOWN SKULL, ORIGI-NAL FRAGMENT Nat. dan qayta qurilganidek.

en: What sort of beast was this creature which sat and bored holes in bones?
uz: Bu suyaklarda teshiklarni zeriktirib o'tirgan maxluq qanday hayvon edi?

en: Scientiﬁc men have named him Eoanthropus, the Dawn Man.
uz: Olimlar uni Eoanthropus deb atashdi, Tong odami.

en: He stands apart from his kindred; a very different being either from the Heidelberg creature or from any living ape.
uz: U o'z qarindoshlari orasidan ajralib turadi; u Haydelberg maxluqidan yoki har qanday tirik maymundan juda farq qiladi.

en: No other vestige like him is known.
uz: Unga o'xshash boshqa hech qanday qoldiq ma'lum emas.

en: But the gravels and deposits of from one hundred thousand years onward are in- creasingly rich in implements of ﬂint and similar stone.
uz: Lekin yuz ming yildan keyingi shag'al va konlar tosh va shunga o'xshash tosh asboblariga tobora boy bo'lib bormoqda.

en: And these imple- ments are no longer rude “Eoliths.” The archæologists are presently able to distinguish scrapers, borers, knives, darts, throwing stones and hand axes ....
uz: Va bu usullar endi qo'pol emas Eolithlar. Arxeologlar hozirda qirg'ichlar, teshiklar, pichoqlar, dartslar, tosh otish va qo'l boltalarini ajrata olishmoqda ....

en: We are drawing very near to man.
uz: Biz odamga juda yaqinlashyapmiz.

en: In our next section we shall have to describe the strangest of all these precursors of humanity, the Nean- derthalers, the men who were almost, but not quite, true men.
uz: Keyingi bo'limimizda insoniyatning barcha oldingilaridan g'alatirog'ini, deyarli, lekin to'liq emas, chinakam inson bo'lgan nean-dertalerlarni tasvirlashimiz kerak bo'ladi.

en: But it may be well perhaps to state quite clearly here that no scientiﬁc man supposes either of these creatures, the Heidelberg Man or Eoanthropus, to be direct ancestors of the men of to-day.
uz: Lekin bu yerda aniq aytish mumkinki, hech bir olim bu mavjudotlardan, Heidelberg odami yoki Eoantropusdan, bugungi odamlarning bevosita ajdodlari deb hisoblamaydi.

en: These are, at the closest, related forms.
uz: Bular, eng yaqin, bog'liq shakllardir.

en: X THE NEANDERTHALER AND THE RHODESIAN MAN About ﬁfty or sixty thousand years ago, before the climax of the Fourth Glacial Age, there lived a creature on earth so like a man that until a few years ago its remains were considered to be altogether human.
uz: X NEANDERTHAL VA RODESIY INSON Taxminan ellik-olti ming yil oldin, to'rtinchi muzlik davri kulminatsiyasiga qadar, yer yuzida shunday bir mavjudot yashagan ediki, bir necha yil oldin uning qoldiqlari butunlay insoniy deb hisoblanardi.

en: We have skulls and bones of it and a great accumulation of the large implements it made and used.
uz: Bizda uning bosh suyaklari va suyaklari bor va u yasagan va ishlatgan katta asboblarning katta to'plami bor.

en: It sheltered in caves from the cold.
uz: U g'orlarda sovuqdan panoh topdi.

en: It probably dressed skins roughly and wore them.
uz: Ehtimol, u qo'pol qilib terisini kiydirib, ularni kiygan bo'lardi.

en: It was right-handed as men are.
uz: Bu erkaklar kabi o'ng qo'lli edi.

en: Yet now the ethnologists tell us these creatures were not true men.
uz: Ammo hozir etnologlar bizga bu mavjudotlar haqiqiy odamlar emasligini aytishmoqda.

en: They were of a different species of the same genus.
uz: Ular bir xil turdagi boshqa turga mansub edilar.

en: They had heavy protruding jaws and great brow ridges above the eyes and very low foreheads.
uz: Ularning og'ir ko'tarilib chiquvchi jag'lari, ko'zlarining tepasida katta qosh qoyalari va juda past peshonalari bor edi.

en: Their thumbs were not opposable to the ﬁngers as men’s are; their necks were so poised that they could not turn back their heads and look up to the sky.
uz: Ularning bosh barmoqlari erkaklarnikidek barmoqlarga qarshi turmas edi; ularning bo'yni shunchalik tik ediki, boshlarini orqaga qaytarib osmonga qarab tura olmasdi.

en: They probably slouched along, head down and forward.
uz: Ular, ehtimol, pastga va oldinga qarab, yonboshlab turishgan.

en: Their chinless jaw- bones resemble the Heidelberg jaw-bone and are markedly unlike human jaw-bones.
uz: Ularning jag'siz suyaklari Heidelberg jag' suyagini eslatadi va inson jag' suyaklariga sezilarli darajada o'xshamaydi.

en: And there were great differences from the human pattern in their teeth.
uz: Va ularning tishlarida inson naqshidan katta farq bor edi.

en: Their cheek teeth were more complicated in structure than ours, more complicated and not less so; they had not the long fangs of our cheek teeth; and also these quasi-men had not the marked canines (dog teeth) of an ordi- nary human being.
uz: Ularning yonoq tishlari bizning tishlarimizdan ko'ra murakkabroq tuzilishga ega edi, murakkabroq va undan kam emas; ularning yonoq tishlarimizning uzun tishlari yo'q edi; shuningdek, bu kvazi-erkaklarda oddiy insonning belgilangan it tishlari yo'q edi.

en: The capacity of their skulls was quite human, but the brain was bigger behind and lower in front than the human brain.
uz: Ularning bosh suyaglarining sig'imi juda insoniy edi, lekin miyasi orqa tomondan inson miyasidan kattaroq va old tomondan pastroq edi.

en: Their in- tellectual faculties were differently arranged.
uz: Ularning intellektual qobiliyatlari har xil joylashtirilgan edi.

en: They were not ancestral to the human line.
uz: Ular insoniyat nasliga ajdod emas edilar.

en: Mentally and physically they were upon a different line from the human line.
uz: Ruhiy va jismoniy jihatdan ular insoniy qatlamdan farqli chiziqda edilar.

en: Skulls and bones of this extinct species of man were found at Nean- derthal among other places, and from that place these strange proto-men have been christened Neanderthal Men, or Neanderthalers.
uz: Bu qirilib ketgan inson turining bosh suyaglari va suyaklari Nean-dertalda, boshqa joylarda topilgan va o'sha yerdan bu g'alati proto-odamlar Neandertal Erkaklari yoki Neandertallar deb nomlangan.

en: They must have endured in Europe for many hundreds or even thousands of years.
uz: Ular Yevropada yuzlab yoki hatto minglab yillar davomida bardosh bergan bo'lishi kerak.

en: THE NEANDERTHALER, ACCORDING TO PROF.
uz: NEANDERTHALER, PROFESSORGA KO'RA.

en: RUTOT At that time the climate and geography of our world was very different from what they are at the present time.
uz: O'sha paytda dunyo iqlimi va geografiyasi hozirgi zamondagidan juda farq qilardi.

en: Europe for example was covered with ice reaching as far south as the Thames and into Central Germany and Russia; there was no Channel separating Britain from France; the Mediter- ranean and the Red Sea were great valleys, with perhaps a chain of lakes in their deeper portions, and a great inland sea spread from the present Black Sea across South Russia and far into Central Asia.
uz: Misol uchun, Yevropa Temza daryosining janubgacha, Markaziy Germaniya va Rossiyaga qadar muz bilan qoplangan edi; Britaniyani Fransiyadan ajratib turuvchi kanal yo'q edi; Mediterranean-ranean va Qizil dengiz katta vodiylar edi, ehtimol chuqurroq qismlarida ko'llar zanjiri bor edi va hozirgi Qora dengizdan Janubiy Rossiya bo'ylab va Markaziy Osiyoga tarqalgan katta ichki dengiz.

en: Spain and all of Europe not actually under ice consisted of bleak uplands under a harder climate than that of Labrador, and it was only when North Africa was reached that one would have found a temperate climate.
uz: Ispaniya va butun Yevropa aslida muz ostida bo'lmagan, Labrador iqlimidan ko'ra qiyinroq bo'lgan xira tepaliklardan iborat edi va faqat Shimoliy Afrikaga yetib borilgandagina, o'rtacha iqlimni topish mumkin edi.

en: Across the cold steppes of Southern Europe with its sparse arctic vegetation, drifted such hardy crea-
uz: Janubiy Yevropaning sovuq dashtlari bo'ylab, o'zining kamyob Arktika o'simliklari bilan, shunday bardoshli yaratilgan...

en: tures as the woolly mammoth, and woolly rhinoceros, great oxen and rein- deer, no doubt following the vegetation northward in spring and southward in autumn.
uz: junli mammoth va junli karkidonlar, katta ho'kizlar va rein- bug'ular kabi aylanadi, shubhasiz, bahorda shimolga va kuzda janubga vegetatsiyani kuzatib boradi.

en: Such was the scene through which the Neanderthaler wandered, gather- ing such subsistence as he could from small game or fruits and berries and roots.
uz: Neandertallik sayohat qilgan sahna shunday edi, u kichik o'yin yoki mevalar, rezavorlar va ildizlardan imkon qadar ko'proq tirikchilik yig'ardi.

en: Possibly he was mainly a vegetarian, chewing twigs and roots.
uz: Ehtimol, u asosan vegetarian bo'lgan, shox va ildizlarni chaynab yurgan.

en: His level elaborate teeth suggest a largely vegetarian dietary.
uz: Uning murakkab tishlari asosan vegetarian ovqatlanishni ko'rsatadi.

en: But we also ﬁnd the long marrow bones of great animals in his caves, cracked to extract the marrow.
uz: Lekin biz uning g'orlarida yirik hayvonlarning uzun mag'iz suyaklarini ham topamiz, mag'izni ajratib olish uchun yorilgan.

en: His weapons could not have been of much avail in open conﬂict with great beasts, but it is supposed that he attacked them with spears at dif- ﬁcult river crossings and even constructed pitfalls for them.
uz: Uning qurollari katta maxluqlar bilan ochiq janglarda unchalik foyda bermagan bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin u turli xil daryo kesishmalarida nayzalar bilan ularga hujum qilgan va hatto ular uchun tuzoqlar qurgan deb taxmin qilinadi.

en: Possibly he fol- lowed the herds and preyed upon any dead that were killed in ﬁghts, and perhaps he played the part of jackal to the sabre-toothed tiger which still survived in his day.
uz: Ehtimol, u chorvalarni kuzatgan va janglarda o'ldirilgan har qanday o'likni o'lja qilgan, va ehtimol u o'z davrida hanuzgacha omon qolgan qilich tishli yo'lbarsga shakal rolini o'ynagan.

en: Possibly in the bitter hardships of the Glacial Ages this creature had taken to attacking animals after long ages of vegetarian adaptation.
uz: Ehtimol, muzlik davrlarining achchiq azoblarida bu maxluq uzoq yillik vegetarian moslashuvdan so'ng hayvonlarga hujum qilishga o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: We cannot guess what this Neanderthal man looked like.
uz: Biz bu neandertal odam qanday ko'rinishga ega ekanligini taxmin qila olmaymiz.

en: He may have been very hairy and very unhuman-looking indeed.
uz: U juda tukli va juda insoniy ko'rinishga ega bo'lmagan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: It is even doubtful if he went erect.
uz: U tik turgan bo'lsa ham, shubhalanarli.

en: He may have used his knuckles as well as his feet to hold him- self up.
uz: U o'zini ushlab turish uchun bo'g'imlaridan ham, oyoqlaridan ham foydalangan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Probably he went about alone or in small family groups.
uz: Ehtimol, u yolg'iz yoki kichik oilaviy guruhlarda aylanib yurardi.

en: It is in- ferred from the structure of his jaw that he was incapable of speech as we understand it.
uz: Uning jag'ining tuzilishidan kelib chiqadiki, biz tushunadiganidek, u gapirishga qodir emas edi.

en: For thousands of years these Neanderthalers were the highest animals that the European area had ever seen; and then some thirty or thirty-ﬁve thousand years ago as the climate grew warmer a race of kindred beings, more intelligent, knowing more, talking and co-operating together, came drifting into the Neanderthaler’s world from the south.
uz: Minglab yillar davomida bu neandertallar Yevropa hududi ko'rgan eng baland hayvonlar edi; va keyin taxminan o'ttiz yoki o'ttiz besh ming yil oldin iqlim isishi bilan, yanada aqlli, ko'proq biladigan, gaplashadigan va hamkorlik qiladigan, janubdan Neandertal dunyosiga suzib kiradigan o'xshash mavjudotlar irqi paydo bo'ldi.

en: They ousted the Ne- anderthalers from their caves and squatting places; they hunted the same food; they probably made war upon their grisly predecessors and killed them off.
uz: Ular Ne-o'g'illarni g'orlaridan va o'zlarining joylaridan haydab chiqarishdi; ular xuddi shu ovqatni ovlashardi; ehtimol, ular o'zlarining qo'rqinchli ajdodlariga qarshi urush qilishdi va ularni o'ldirishdi.

en: These newcomers from the south or the east—for at present we do not know their region of origin—who at last drove the Neanderthalers out of existence altogether, were beings of our own blood and kin, the ﬁrst True Men.
uz: Janubdan yoki sharqdan kelgan bu yangi kelganlar  hozircha ularning kelib chiqish hududini bilmaymiz  oxir-oqibat Neandertallarni butunlay mavjudotdan haydab chiqarganlar, o'z qonimiz va qarindoshlarimiz, birinchi Haqiqiy Erkaklar edi.

en: Their brain-cases and thumbs and necks and teeth were anatomically the same as our own.
uz: Ularning miyasi, bosh barmoqlari, bo'yni va tishlari anatomik jihatdan biznikiga o'xshash edi.

en: In a cave at Cro-Magnon and in another at Grimaldi, a number of skeletons have been found, the earliest truly human remains that are so far known.
uz: Cro-Magnondagi g'orda va Grimaldidagi boshqa g'orda bir qator skeletlar topilgan, ular hozirgacha ma'lum bo'lgan eng qadimgi haqiqiy insoniy qoldiqlardir.

en: So it is our race comes into the Record of the Rocks, and the story of mankind begins.
uz: Shunday qilib, bizning irqimiz Toshlar yozuviga kiradi va insoniyat tarixi boshlanadi.

en: COMPARISON OF (1) MODERN SKULL AND (2) RHODESIAN SKULL  Nat.
uz: Zamonaviy SKULLning taqqoslashi (1) va Rodesyan SKULLning taqqoslashi Nat.

en: The world was growing liker our own in those days though the climate was still austere.
uz: O'sha kunlarda dunyo o'zimizga o'xshab o'sib borayotgan edi, garchi iqlim hali ham qattiqroq bo'lsa ham.

en: The glaciers of the Ice Age were receding in Europe; the reindeer of France and Spain presently gave way to great herds of horses as grass increased upon the steppes, and the mammoth became more and more rare in southern Europe and ﬁnally receded northward altogether ....
uz: Yevropada Muz Davridagi muzliklar chekinayotgan edi; Fransiya va Ispaniya bug'ulari hozirda dashtlarda o't ko'paygan sari katta otlar suruviga yo'l ochdi va mamont Janubiy Yevropada tobora kam uchray boshladi va nihoyat butunlay shimolga chekindi....

en: We do not know where the True Men ﬁrst originated.
uz: Haqiqiy Erkaklar qayerdan paydo bo'lganini bilmaymiz.

en: But in the summer of 1921, an extremely interesting skull was found together with pieces of a skeleton at Broken Hill in South Africa, which seems to be a relic of a third sort of man, intermediate in its characteristics between the Neanderthaler and the human being.
uz: Lekin 1921-yilning yozida Janubiy Afrikadagi Broken Hillda nihoyatda qiziqarli bosh suyagini, neandertallik va inson o'rtasidagi xususiyatlari bo'yicha oraliq bo'lgan uchinchi turdagi odamning qoldig'i bo'lib ko'ringan skelet qismlari bilan birga topildi.

en: The brain-case indicates a brain bigger in front and smaller behind than the Neanderthaler’s, and the skull was poised erect upon the backbone in a quite human way.
uz: Bosh miya g'ilofi old tomondan neandertal odamnikidan kattaroq va orqa tomondan kichikroq bo'lgan miyani ko'rsatadi va bosh suyagini umurtqa pog'onasiga juda insoniy tarzda tik qo'yilgan.

en: The teeth also and the bones are quite human.
uz: Tishlar ham, suyaklar ham juda insoniy.

en: But the face must have been ape-like with enormous brow ridges and a ridge along the middle of the skull.
uz: Lekin yuz maymunga o'xshashi kerak edi, peshonalarining ulkan qirralari va bosh suyagining o'rtasida qirra bor edi.

en: The creature was indeed a true man, so to speak, with an ape- like, Neanderthaler face.
uz: Bu maxluq haqiqatan ham haqiqiy inson edi, shunday deyish mumkinki, maymunsimon, neandertal yuzli edi.

en: This Rhodesian Man is evidently still closer to real men than the Neanderthal Man.
uz: Bu Rodos odami, aniqki, neandertal odamidan ko'ra haqiqiy odamlarga yaqinroqdir.

en: This Rhodesian skull is probably only the second of what in the end may prove to be a long list of ﬁnds of sub-human species which lived on the earth in the vast interval of time between the beginnings of the Ice Age and the appearance of their common heir, and perhaps their common extermina- tor, the True Man.
uz: Bu Rodesian bosh suyagi, ehtimol, oxir-oqibatda Yer yuzida Muz Davrining boshlanishi va ularning umumiy vorisining paydo bo'lishi va ehtimol, ularning umumiy externina-tor, Haqiqiy Inson paydo bo'lishi orasidagi keng vaqt oralig'ida yashagan sub-inson turlarining uzun topilmalari ro'yxati bo'lib chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan narsaning ikkinchisidir.

en: The Rhodesian skull itself may not be very ancient.
uz: Rodesian bosh suyagining o'zi unchalik qadimiy bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: Up to the time of publishing this book there has been no exact determination of its probable age.
uz: Ushbu kitob nashr etilgan paytgacha uning ehtimoliy yoshi aniq aniqlanmagan.

en: It may be that this sub-human creature survived in South Africa until quite recent times.
uz: Ehtimol, bu subinsoniy maxluq Janubiy Afrikada juda yaqin vaqtlargacha omon qolgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: XI THE FIRST TRUE MEN The earliest signs and traces at present known to science, of a humanity which is indisputably kindred with ourselves, have been found in western Europe and particularly in France and Spain.
uz: XI BIRINCHI HAQIQIQATLI ERKAKLAR Bugungi kunda fanga ma'lum bo'lgan insoniyatning eng qadimgi belgilari va izlari, o'zimizga shubhasiz o'xshash bo'lgan, G'arbiy Yevropada, ayniqsa Fransiya va Ispaniyada topilgan.

en: Bones, weapons, scratchings upon bone and rock, carved fragments of bone, and paintings in caves and upon rock surfaces dating.
uz: Suyaklar, qurollar, suyak va tosh ustidagi tirnalishlar, suyakning o'yilgan parchalari, g'orlardagi va tosh yuzalaridagi rasmlar.

en: from 30,000 years ago or more, have been discovered in both these countries.
uz: 30 000 yil yoki undan ko'proq vaqt oldin, bu ikki mamlakatda ham topilgan.

en: Spain is at present the richest country in the world in these ﬁrst relics of our real human ancestors.
uz: Ispaniya hozirda haqiqiy insoniy ajdodlarimizning ushbu birinchi yodgorliklarida dunyodagi eng boy davlat hisoblanadi.

en: Of course our present collections of these things are the merest begin- nings of the accumulations we may hope for in the future, when there are searchers enough to make a thorough examination of all possible sources and when other countries in the world, now inaccessible to archæologists, have been explored in some detail.
uz: Albatta, bu narsalarning hozirgi to'plamlarimiz kelajakda umid qilishimiz mumkin bo'lgan to'plamlarning eng boshlanishi bo'ladi, qachonki barcha mumkin bo'lgan manbalarni chuqur o'rganish uchun yetarli qidiruvchilar bo'lsa va endi arxeologlar uchun mavjud bo'lmagan dunyoning boshqa mamlakatlari ba'zi tafsilotlar bilan o'rganilgan bo'lsa.

en: The greater part of Africa and Asia has never even been traversed yet by a trained observer interested in these mat- ters and free to explore, and we must be very careful therefore not to con- clude that the early true men were distinctively inhabitants of western Eu- rope or that they ﬁrst appeared in that region.
uz: Afrika va Osiyoning katta qismi hali hech qachon ushbu gilamchalarga qiziqqan va o'rganishga erkin bo'lgan o'qitilgan kuzatuvchi tomonidan bosib o'tilmagan va shuning uchun biz erta haqiqiy odamlar g'arbiy Yevropaning o'ziga xos aholisi bo'lgan yoki ular birinchi marta shu hududda paydo bo'lgan deb xulosa qilmaslikka juda ehtiyot bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: In Asia or Africa or submerged beneath the sea of to-day there may be richer and much earlier deposits of real human remains than anything that has yet come to light.
uz: Osiyo yoki Afrikada yoki hozirgi dengiz ostida cho'kib ketgan joylarda hali ma'lum bo'lgan har qanday narsadan ko'ra ko'proq boy va ancha qadimgi haqiqiy insoniy qoldiqlar topilishi mumkin.

en: I write in Asia or Africa, and I do not mention Ameri- ca because so far there have been no ﬁnds at all of any of the higher Pri- mates, either of great apes, sub-men, Neanderthalers nor early true men.
uz: Men Osiyo yoki Afrikada yozaman va Amerikani tilga olmayman, chunki hozirgacha hech qanday yuqori Pri-toshlar, na buyuk maymunlar, na sub-odamlar, na neandertalliklar, na erta haqiqiy odamlarning topilmalari topilmadi.

en: This development of life seems to have been an exclusively old world de- velopment, and it was only apparently at the end of the Old Stone Age that
uz: Hayotning bu rivojlanishi faqat eski dunyo rivojlanishi bo'lgan ko'rinadi va faqatgina Eski tosh davri oxirida bo'lgani ko'rinadi.

en: human beings ﬁrst made their way across the land connexion that is now cut by Behring Straits, into the American continent.
uz: Inson avvalo Behring bo'g'ozlari orqali kesib o'tiladigan quruqlik orqali Amerika qit'asiga yo'l topdi.

en: ONE OF THE MARVELLOUS CAVE PAINTINGS OF ALTAMIRA, NORTH SPAIN  The Walls of the Caves are covered in these representations of Bulls, etc., painted in the soft tones of red shaded to black.
uz: ALTAMIRA, SHIMOLIY ISPANIYADAGI MARVELLOV G'OR RASMLARIDAN BIRI G'or devorlari buqalarning va hokazo tasvirlari bilan qoplangan bo'lib, qizildan qoraga o'ralgan yumshoq tuslarda chizilgan.

en: They may be ﬁfteen or twenty thousand years old These ﬁrst real human beings we know of in Europe appear already to have belonged to one or other of at least two very distinct races.
uz: Ular o'n besh yoki yigirma ming yoshda bo'lishi mumkin. Yevropada biz bilgan birinchi haqiqiy insonlar allaqachon kamida ikkita juda alohida irqdan biriga tegishli bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: One of these races was of a very high type indeed; it was tall and big brained.
uz: Bu poygalardan biri haqiqatan ham juda yuqori turdagi edi; u baland va katta miyaga ega edi.

en: One of the women’s skulls found exceeds in capacity that of the average man of to-day.
uz: Ayollarning topilgan bosh suyaglaridan biri bugungi kunda o'rtacha erkakning sig'idan oshib ketadi.

en: One of the men’s skeletons is over six feet in height.
uz: Erkaklarning bir skeleti olti futdan baland.

en: The physical type resembled that of the North American Indian.
uz: Jismoniy turi Shimoliy Amerikalik hinduning o'ziga o'xshardi.

en: From the Cro-Magnon cave in which the ﬁrst skeletons were found these people have been called Cro-Magnards.
uz: Cro-Magnon g'oridan, unda birinchi skeletlar topilgan, bu odamlar Cro-Magnardlar deb atalgan.

en: They were savages, but savages of a high order.
uz: Ular vahshiylar edi, lekin yuqori darajadagi vahshiylar edi.

en: The second race, the race of the Grimaldi cave remains, was distinctly negroid in its characters.
uz: Ikkinchi irq, Grimaldi g'ori qoldiqlari irqi, o'z xarakterida aniq begroid edi.

en: Its nearest living afﬁnities are the Bushmen and Hottentots of South Africa.
uz: Uning eng yaqin tirik yaqinliklari Janubiy Afrikadagi Bushmenlar va Hottentotlardir.

en: It is interesting to ﬁnd at the very outset of the known human story, that mankind was already racially divided into at least two main vari- eties; and one is tempted to such unwarrantable guesses as that the former race was probably brownish rather than black and that it came from the East
uz: Ma'lum insoniyat tarixining eng boshidayoq insoniyat irqiy jihatdan kamida ikki asosiy xilma-xillikka bo'linganini aniqlash qiziqarli; va ulardan biri avvalgi irq qora emas, balki jigarrang bo'lgan va u Sharqdan kelgan degan asossiz taxminlarga vasvasaga solinadi.

en: or North, and that the latter was blackish rather than brown and came from the equatorial south.
uz: yoki Shimol, va oxirgisining jigarrang emas, balki qora rangda ekanligi va ekvatorial janubdan kelganligi.

en: BONE CARVINGS OF THE PALÆOLITHIC PERIOD  (1 and 2) Mammoth tusk carved to shape of Reindeer, (3) Dagger Handle representing Mammoth,
uz: PALEOLITIK MAVZUDNING SO'NGI O'YMA MAHSULOTLARI (1 va 2) Bug'u shaklida o'yilgan mammoth tushi, 3) mammothni ifodalovchi xanjar tutqichi.

en: and (4) Bone engraved with Horses’ Heads  Brit.
uz: va Suyak 4) Otlar  Brit boshlari bilan o'yilgan.

en: And these savages of perhaps forty thousand years ago were so human that they pierced shells to make necklaces, painted themselves, carved im- ages of bone and stone, scratched ﬁgures on rocks and bones, and painted rude but often very able sketches of beasts and the like upon the smooth walls of caves and upon inviting rock surfaces.
uz: Va bu qirq ming yil oldingi vahshiylar shunchalik insoniy ediki, ular marjonlar yasash uchun qobiqlarni teshib, o'zlarini bo'yashardi, suyak va toshdan asrlar davomida o'yib, tosh va suyaklarda tirnalgan shakllarni chizishardi, va g'orlarning silliq devorlariga va jozibali tosh yuzalariga qo'pol, ammo ko'pincha juda mohir hayvonlar va shunga o'xshash eskizlarni chizishardi.

en: They made a great variety of implements, much smaller in scale and ﬁner than those of the Nean- derthal men.
uz: Ular Nean-dertal odamlaridan ko'ra ancha kichik va nozikroq bo'lgan juda ko'p xil asboblar yasashdi.

en: We have now in our museums great quantities of their imple- ments, their statuettes, their rock drawings and the like.
uz: Bizning muzeylarimizda ularning asbob-uskunalari, haykallari, tosh rasmlari va shunga o'xshash ko'plab narsalar mavjud.

en: The earliest of them were hunters.
uz: Ularning eng ertalari ovchilar edi.

en: Their chief pursuit was the wild horse, the little bearded pony of that time.
uz: Ularning asosiy quvvati o'sha davrdagi kichkina soqolli pony bo'lgan yovvoyi ot edi.

en: They followed it as it moved after pas- ture.
uz: Ular unga pas-turdan keyin harakatlanayotganda ergashdilar.

en: And also they followed the bison.
uz: Va ular bisonni ham kuzatib borishdi.

en: They knew the mammoth, because they have left us strikingly effective pictures of that creature.
uz: Ular mammotni bilishardi, chunki ular bizga o'sha maxluqning hayratlanarli darajada samarali tasvirlarini qoldirishgan.

en: To judge by one rather ambiguous drawing they trapped and killed it.
uz: Birgina noaniq chizma bo'yicha baho berish uchun uni tutib, o'ldirishdi.

en: They hunted with spears and throwing stones.
uz: Ular nayzalar va tosh otish bilan ov qilishardi.

en: They do not seem to have had the bow, and it is doubtful if they had yet learnt to tame any animals.
uz: Ularning kamonlari bo'lmagan ko'rinadi va ular hali hech qanday hayvonni jilovlashni o'rgangan bo'lishlari dargumon.

en: There is one carving of a horse’s head and one or two drawings that suggest a bridled horse, with a twisted skin or tendon round it.
uz: Otning boshining bitta o'ymasi va bir-ikki chizmasi bor, ular jilvirlangan otni ko'rsatadi, uning atrofida egri teri yoki pay bo'ladi.

en: But the little horses of that age and region could not have carried a man, and if the horse was domesticated it was used as a led horse.
uz: Lekin o'sha davr va hududdagi kichkina otlar odamni ko'tara olmas edi, va agar ot uylashtirilgan bo'lsa, u yetakchi ot sifatida ishlatilgan.

en: It is doubtful and improbable that they had yet learnt the rather unnatural use of animal’s milk as food.
uz: Ularning hayvon sutidan oziq-ovqat sifatida nisbatan g'ayritabiiy foydalanishini hali o'rganmaganlari shubhali va ehtimoldan yiroq.

en: They do not seem to have erected any buildings though they may have had tents of skins, and though they made clay ﬁgures they never rose to the making of pottery.
uz: Ular hech qanday bino qurmagan ko'rinadi, garchi teri chodirlari bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, va loy haykallar yasagan bo'lsalar ham, kulolchilik qilishga hech qachon ko'tarilmagan.

en: Since they had no cooking implements their cookery must have been rudimentary or nonexistent.
uz: Ularning pishirish anjomlari bo'lmagani uchun, ularning pishirish uslublari oddiy yoki mavjud bo'lmagan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: They knew nothing of cultiva- tion and nothing of any sort of basket work or woven cloth.
uz: Ular kultivatsiya haqida hech narsa bilishmasdi va hech qanday savat ishi yoki to'qilgan mato haqida hech narsa bilishmasdi.

en: Except for their robes of skin or fur they were naked painted savages.
uz: Teri yoki mo'yna liboslaridan tashqari, ular yalang'och bo'yalgan yovvoyilar edi.

en: These earliest known men hunted the open steppes of Europe for a hun- dred centuries perhaps, and then slowly drifted and changed before a change of climate.
uz: Bu eng qadimgi ma'lum erkaklar Yevropaning ochiq dashtlarini bir necha asr davomida ovlab yurgan, keyin esa sekin-asta suzib yurib, iqlim o'zgarishidan oldin o'zgargan.

en: Europe, century by century, was growing milder and damper.
uz: Yevropa, asrdan asrga, yumshoqroq va damperroq bo'lib borardi.

en: Reindeer receded northward and eastward, and bison and horse fol- lowed.
uz: Bug'ular shimolga va sharqqa chekindi, bison va ot esa orqaga tushdi.

en: The steppes gave way to forests, and red deer took the place of horse and bison.
uz: Qirg'oqlar o'rmonlarga yo'l berdi va qizil bug'ular ot va bizon o'rnini egalladi.

en: There is a change in the character of the implements with this
uz: Ushbu bilan asboblarning xarakterida o'zgarish yuz berdi.

en: change in their application.
uz: Ularning arizasida o'zgarishlar.

en: River and lake ﬁshing becomes of great impor- tance to men, and ﬁne implements of bone increased.
uz: Daryo va ko'l baliq ovlash odamlar uchun katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lib, suyaklarning nozik asboblari ko'paydi.

en: “The bone needles of this age,” says de Mortillet, “are much superior to those of later, even his- torical times, down to the Renaissance.
uz: Bu davrning suyak ignalari,  deydi de Mortillet,  keyinroq, hatto uning  torik davrlaridan, Uyg'onish davrigacha bo'lganlaridan ancha ustundir.

en: The Romans, for example, never had needles comparable to those of this epoch.” THE RUTOT BUST OF A CRO-MAGNON MAN Almost ﬁfteen or twelve thousand years ago a fresh people drifted into the south of Spain, and left very remarkable drawings of themselves upon exposed rock faces there.
uz: Rimliklar, masalan, hech qachon shu davrdagidek ignalarga ega bo'lmaganlar.  KRO-MAGNON ODAMNING RUTOT BUSTI Taxminan o'n besh yoki o'n ikki ming yil oldin Ispaniya janubida yangi xalq suzib keldi va u yerda ochiq tosh yuzalarida o'zlarining juda ajoyib chizmalarini qoldirdi.

en: These were the Azilians (named from the Mas d’Azil cave).
uz: Bular Mas dAzil g'oridan olingan Azililar edi.

en: They had the bow; they seem to have worn feather headdress- es; they drew vividly; but also they had reduced their drawings to a sort of symbolism—a man for instance would be represented by a vertical dab with two or three horizontal dabs—that suggest the dawn of the writing idea.
uz: Ularning kamonlari bor edi; ular patli bosh kiyim kiygan ko'rinadi; ular yorqin chizishardi; lekin ular o'z chizmalarini bir xil ramziylikka ham aylantirib qo'yishardi  masalan, odam ikki yoki uchta gorizontal qo'l bilan vertikal qo'l bilan ifodalanardi  bu esa yozish g'oyasining paydo bo'lishini ko'rsatadi.

en: Against hunting sketches there are often marks like tallies.
uz: Ovchilik eskizlariga ko'pincha talliya kabi belgilar qo'yiladi.

en: One drawing shows two men smoking out a bees’ nest.
uz: Bir rasmda ikki erkak asalari uyasini tutatganini ko'rsatadi.

en: Among the most recent discoveries of Palæolithic Art are these speci- mens found in 1920 in Spain.
uz: Paleolit san'atining eng so'nggi kashfiyotlari orasida 1920-yilda Ispaniyada topilgan ushbu turlar bor.

en: They are probably ten or twelve thousand years old
uz: Ularning yoshi ehtimol o'n yoki o'n ikki ming yil.

en: These are the latest of the men that we call Palæolithic (Old Stone Age) because they had only chipped implements.
uz: Bular Paleolit deb ataydigan odamlarning eng so'nggilari, chunki ularda faqat maydalangan asboblar bor edi.

en: By ten or twelve thousand years a new sort of life has dawned in Europe, men have learnt not only to chip but to polish and grind stone implements, and they have begun cultiva- tion.
uz: O'n-o'n ikki ming yil ichida Yevropada yangi hayot paydo bo'ldi, odamlar nafaqat tosh asboblarini maydalashni, balki silliqlashni ham o'rgandilar va ularni yetishtirishni boshladilar.

en: The Neolithic Age (New Stone Age) was beginning.
uz: Yangi tosh davri boshlanayotgan edi.

en: It is interesting to note that less than a century ago there still survived in a remote part of the world, in Tasmania, a race of human beings at a lower level of physical and intellectual development than any of these earliest races of mankind who have left traces in Europe.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, bir asrdan kamroq vaqt oldin dunyoning olis bir qismida, Tasmaniyada, Yevropada iz qoldirgan insoniyatning eng qadimgi irqlaridan birortasidan kamroq jismoniy va intellektual rivojlanish darajasidagi insoniy irq hali ham mavjud edi.

en: These people had long ago been cut off by geographical changes from the rest of the species, and from stimulation and improvement.
uz: Bu odamlar allaqachon boshqa turlardan geografik o'zgarishlar, rag'batlantirish va yaxshilanishdan uzoq vaqt oldin ajralgan edi.

en: They seem to have degenerated rather than developed.
uz: Ular rivojlanish o'rniga degeneratsiyalashgan ko'rinadi.

en: They lived a base life subsisting upon shellﬁsh and small game.
uz: Ular oddiy hayot kechirib, kanalar va mayda o'yinchoqlardan foydalanib yashashardi.

en: They had no habitations but only squatting places.
uz: Ularning hech qanday turar joyi yo'q edi, faqat o'tirib yurish joylari bor edi.

en: They were real men of our species, but they had neither the manual dexterity nor the artistic powers of the ﬁrst true men.
uz: Ular bizning turimizdagi haqiqiy odamlar edi, lekin ularda na qo'l mahorati, na birinchi haqiqiy odamlarning badiiy qobiliyati yo'q edi.

en: XII PRIMITIVE THOUGHT And now let us indulge in a very interesting speculation; how did it feel to be a man in those early days of the human adventure?
uz: XII BIRINCHI O'YLIK Va endi juda qiziqarli taxminga beraylik; insoniy sarguzashtning o'sha dastlabki kunlarida odam bo'lish qanday his edi?

en: How did men think and what did they think in those remote days of hunting and wandering four hundred centuries ago before seed time and harvest began.
uz: Odamlar urug' va hosil boshlanishidan to'rt yuz yil oldin ov va sayohatning o'sha olis kunlarida qanday o'ylardilar va nimani o'ylardilar?

en: Those were days long before the written record of any human impressions, and we are left almost entirely to inference and guesswork in our answers to these questions.
uz: O'sha kunlar har qanday insoniy taassurotlarning yozma yozuvidan ancha oldin edi va biz bu savollarga javob berishda deyarli butunlay xulosalar va taxminlarga qoldik.

en: The sources to which scientiﬁc men have gone in their attempts to recon- struct that primitive mentality are very various.
uz: Ilmiy odamlar ibtidoiy mentalitetni qayta tuzishga urinishlarida murojaat qilgan manbalar juda xilma-xil.

en: Recently the science of psy- cho-analysis, which analyzes the way in which the egotistic and passionate impulses of the child are restrained, suppressed, modiﬁed or overlaid, to adapt them to the needs of social life, seems to have thrown a considerable amount of light upon the history of primitive society; and another fruitful source of suggestion has been the study of the ideas and customs of such contemporary savages as still survive.
uz: Yaqinda psixo-analiz ilmi, bolalarning egogistik va ehtirosli impulslari ijtimoiy hayot ehtiyojlariga moslashish uchun qanday cheklanishi, bostirilishi, o'zgartirilishi yoki ustma-ust bo'lishini tahlil qiladigan bo'lib, ibtidoiy jamiyat tarixiga sezilarli darajada yorug'lik ochib bergan ko'rinadi; va yana bir samarali taklif manbai hozirgi zamon yovvoyilarining g'oyalari va urf-odatlarini o'rganish bo'lib kelgan.

en: Again there is a sort of mental fos- silization which we ﬁnd in folk-lore and the deep-lying irrational supersti- tions and prejudices that still survive among modern civilized people.
uz: Yana bir xil aqliy fosillashuv bor, uni xalq rivoyatlarida va zamonaviy madaniyatli odamlar orasida hanuzgacha saqlanib qolgan chuqur irratsional xurofotlar va xurofotlarda uchratamiz.

en: And ﬁnally we have in the increasingly numerous pictures, statues, carvings, symbols and the like, as we draw near to our own time, clearer and clearer indications of what man found interesting and worthy of record and representation.
uz: Va nihoyat, o'z vaqtimizga yaqinlashar ekanmiz, tobora ko'proq rasmlar, haykallar, o'ymalar, ramzlar va shunga o'xshash narsalarda inson nimani qiziqarli va yozuvga va ifodalashga arziydiganini aniqroq va tiniqroq ko'rsatuvlarga egamiz.

en: Primitive man probably thought very much as a child thinks, that is to say in a series of imaginative pictures.
uz: Ibtidoiy inson, ehtimol, bola o'ylagandek, ya'ni bir qator xayoliy rasmlarda juda ko'p fikrlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He conjured up images or images presented themselves to his mind, and he acted in accordance with the emo-
uz: U o'z ongiga kelgan tasvirlarni yoki tasvirlarni o'ylab topdi va u emo-ga muvofiq harakat qildi.

en: So a child or an uneducated person does to-day.
uz: Shunday qilib, bola yoki o'qimagan odam bugun shunday qiladi.

en: System- atic thinking is apparently a comparatively late development in human ex- perience; it has not played any great part in human life until within the last three thousand years.
uz: Tizimli-axloqiy fikrlash, ko'rinishidan, insoniyat tarixida nisbatan kech rivojlanishdir; u inson hayotida oxirgi uch ming yilgacha katta rol o'ynamagan.

en: And even to-day those who really control and order their thoughts are but a small minority of mankind.
uz: Va hatto bugungi kunda o'z fikrlarini haqiqatan ham nazorat qiladigan va tartibga soladiganlar insoniyatning kichik bir ozchiligidir.

en: Most of the world still lives by imagination and passion.
uz: Dunyoning aksariyati hali ham xayol va ehtiros bilan yashaydi.

en: Probably the earliest human societies, in the opening stages of the true human story, were small family groups.
uz: Ehtimol, haqiqiy insoniyat hikoyasining dastlabki bosqichlarida bo'lgan eng qadimgi insoniy jamiyatlar kichik oilaviy guruhlar edi.

en: Just as the ﬂocks and herds of the earlier mammals arose out of families which remained together and multi- plied, so probably did the earliest tribes.
uz: Xuddi avvalgi sutemizuvchilarning suruvlari va suruvlari birga qolgan va ko'p qatlamli oilalardan paydo bo'lganidek, ehtimol, eng qadimgi qabilalar ham shunday qilishgan.

en: But before this could happen a cer- tain restraint upon the primitive egotisms of the individual had to be estab- lished.
uz: Lekin bu sodir bo'lishidan oldin, shaxsning ibtidoiy egoizmlariga muayyan cheklov o'rnatilishi kerak edi.

en: The fear of the father and respect for the mother had to be extended into adult life, and the natural jealousy of the old man of the group for the younger males as they grew up had to be mitigated.
uz: Ota qo'rquvi va onaga hurmatni voyaga yetgan hayotga tatbiq etish kerak edi va guruhning keksa odamlarining yoshroq erkaklarga bo'lgan tabiiy rashki katta bo'lgan sari yumshatilishi kerak edi.

en: The mother on the other hand was the natural adviser and protector of the young.
uz: Ona esa yoshlarning tabiiy maslahatchisi va himoyachisi edi.

en: Human social life grew up out of the reaction between the crude instinct of the young to go off and pair by themselves as they grew up, on the one hand, and the dangers and disadvantages of separation on the other.
uz: Inson ijtimoiy hayoti yoshlarning o'sgan sari o'z-o'zidan ketish va juftlashish kabi qo'pol instinktlari, bir tomondan, va ajralishning xavflari va kamchiliklari o'rtasidagi reaksiyadan kelib chiqqan.

en: An anthropological writer of great genius, J.
uz: Buyuk daho antropologik yozuvchi J.

en: Atkinson, in his Primal Law, has shown how much of the customary law of savages, the Tabus, that are so remarkable a fact in tribal life, can be ascribed to such a mental adjustment of the needs of the primi- tive human animal to a developing social life, and the later work of the psy- cho- analysts has done much to conﬁrm his interpretation of these possibilities.
uz: Atkinson o'zining Boshlang'ich Qonunida yovvoyilarning odatiy qonuni, qabila hayotida shunchalik ajoyib fakt bo'lgan Tabusning ko'p qismini inson hayoti rivojlanayotgan ijtimoiy hayotga bo'lgan birinchi darajali hayvonning ehtiyojlarini shunday aqliy moslashuviga bog'lash mumkinligini ko'rsatdi va psixo-cho-tahlilchilarning keyingi ishlari uning bu imkoniyatlarni talqin qilishini tasdiqlash uchun ko'p ish qildi.

en: Some speculative writers would have us believe that respect and fear of the Old Man and the emotional reaction of the primitive savage to older protective women, exaggerated in dreams and enriched by fanciful mental play, played a large part in the beginnings of primitive religion and in the conception of gods and goddesses.
uz: Ba'zi taxminiy yozuvchilar bizni Eski Odamga hurmat va qo'rquv, shuningdek, qadimgi vahshiyning keksa himoyachi ayollarga bo'lgan hissiy reaksiyasi, tushlarda bo'rttirilgan va xayolparast aqliy o'yinlar bilan boyitilgan, ibtidoiy dinning boshlanishida va xudolar va xudoyalar tushunchasida katta rol o'ynagan deb ishonishga majbur qiladi.

en: Associated with this respect for power- ful or helpful personalities was a dread and exaltation of such personages after their deaths, due to their reappearance in dreams.
uz: Ushbu qudratli yoki foydali shaxslarga hurmat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan narsa, bunday shaxslarning o'limidan keyin orzularda qayta paydo bo'lishi tufayli ularning dahshati va ulug'lanishi edi.

en: It was easy to be- lieve they were not truly dead but only fantastically transferred to a remote- ness of greater power.
uz: Ular haqiqatan ham o'lik emas edi, balki faqat ajoyib tarzda uzoqdagi kuchga o'tkazilgan edi, deb aytish oson edi.

en: The dreams, imaginations and fears of a child are far more vivid and real than those of a modern adult, and primitive man was always something of a child.
uz: Bolaning orzulari, tasavvurlari va qo'rquvlari zamonaviy kattalarnikidan ancha jonliroq va realroqdir, va ibtidoiy inson doimo bolaning bir narsasi edi.

en: He was nearer to the animals also, and he could suppose them to have
uz: U hayvonlarga ham yaqinroq edi va u ularni shunday deb o'ylashi mumkin edi.

en: motives and reactions like his own.
uz: o'ziniki kabi motivlar va reaksiyalar.

en: He could imagine animal helpers, ani- mal enemies, animal gods.
uz: U hayvoniy yordamchilar, yovuz dushmanlar, hayvonlar xudolarini tasavvur qila olardi.

en: One needs to have been an imaginative child oneself to realize again how important, signiﬁcant, portentous or friendly, strangely shaped rocks, lumps of wood, exceptional trees or the like may have appeared to the men of the Old Stone Age, and how dream and fancy would create stories and legends about such things that would become cred- ible as they told them.
uz: Qadimgi tosh davridagi odamlarga g'alati shakldagi toshlar, yog'och bo'laklari, ajoyib daraxtlar yoki shunga o'xshash narsalar qanchalik muhim, ahamiyatli, ko'zga ko'ringan yoki do'stona bo'lganini va ular aytganidek ishonib bo'ladigan narsalar haqida orzu va xayol qanday hikoyalar va afsonalar yaratishini yana bir bor anglash uchun o'zi ham xayolparast bola bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Some of these stories would be good enough to re- member and tell again.
uz: Bu hikoyalarning ba'zilari qayta a'zo bo'lish va yana aytib berish uchun yetarli bo'lardi.

en: The women would tell them to the children and so establish a tradition.
uz: Ayollar ularga bolalarga aytishardi va shu tariqa bir an'anani o'rnatishardi.

en: To this day most imaginative children invent long sto- ries in which some favourite doll or animal or some fantastic semi-human being ﬁgures as the hero, and primitive man probably did the same—with a much stronger disposition to believe his hero real.
uz: Bugungi kunga kelib, ko'pgina tasavvurga boy bolalar qahramon sifatida sevimli qo'g'irchoq yoki hayvon yoki fantastik yarim insoniyat qahramon sifatida uzun st-rilarni ixtiro qilishadi va ibtidoiy inson ham xuddi shunday qilgan bo'lishi mumkin  o'z qahramoniga haqiqiy deb ishonish uchun ancha kuchli moyillik bilan.

en: RELICS OF THE STONE AGE  Chert implements from Somaliland.
uz: SOMALILANDDAN TOSH VAQTIDAGI RELICS Chert asboblari.

en: In general form they are similar to those found in Western and Northern Europe  Brit.
uz: Umuman olganda, ular G'arbiy va Shimoliy Yevropa Britaniyalarida uchraydiganlarga o'xshaydi.

en: For the very earliest of the true men that we know of were probably quite talkative beings.
uz: Biz biladigan eng qadimgi haqiqiy erkaklar, ehtimol, ancha gapiradigan mavjudotlar bo'lgan.

en: In that way they have differed from the Neanderthalers and had an advantage over them.
uz: Shu yo'l bilan ular neandertallardan farq qilishdi va ulardan ustunlikka ega bo'lishdi.

en: The Neanderthaler may have been a dumb ani- mal.
uz: Neandertalchi ahmoq ani-mal bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Of course the primitive human speech was probably a very scanty col- lection of names, and may have been eked out with gestures and signs.
uz: Albatta, ibtidoiy inson nutqi, ehtimol, juda kam nomlar to'plami bo'lgan va imo-ishoralar va belgilar bilan ajralib chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: There is no sort of savage so low as not to have a kind of science of cause and effect.
uz: Hech qanday vahshiylik yo'qki, sabab va oqibat fanidan mahrum bo'lmasin.

en: But primitive man was not very critical in his associations of cause with effect; he very easily connected an effect with something quite wrong as its cause.
uz: Ammo ibtidoiy inson sabab va oqibat bilan bog'lashda unchalik tanqidiy emas edi; u effektni uning sababi sifatida butunlay noto'g'ri narsa bilan juda oson bog'lardi.

en: “You do so and so,” he said, “and so and so happens.” You give a child a poisonous berry and it dies.
uz: Sen shunday qilasan va shunday qilasan, dedi u, va shunday va shunday sodir bo'ladi. Bolaga zaharli rezavor berasan va u o'ladi.

en: You eat the heart of a valiant enemy and you become strong.
uz: Siz jasur dushmanning yuragini yeyasiz va kuchli bo'lasiz.

en: There we have two bits of cause and effect association, one true one false.
uz: U yerda bizda ikkita sabab va oqibat aloqasi bor, bittasi haqiqiy va bittasi noto'g'ri.

en: We call the system of cause and effect in the mind of a savage, Fetish; but Fetish is simply savage science.
uz: Biz vahshiy ongdagi sabab va oqibat tizimini Fetish deb ataymiz; lekin Fetish shunchaki vahshiy fan.

en: It differs from modern science in that it is totally unsystematic and uncritical and so more frequently wrong.
uz: U zamonaviy fanlardan butunlay tizimsiz va tanqidiy emasligi bilan farq qiladi, shuning uchun ko'pincha noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

en: WIDESPREAD SIMILARITY OF MEN OF THE STONE AGE  On the left is a ﬂint implement excavated in Gray’s Inn Lane, London; on the right one of similar form chipped by primitive men of Somaliland  Brit.
uz: Tosh asr erkaklarining keng tarqalgan o'xshashligi. Chap tomonda Londondagi Gray's Inn Lane'da qazilgan tishli asbob bor; o'ng tomonda Somaliland Britaniyalik ibtidoiy erkaklar tomonidan maydalangan shunga o'xshash shakldagi asbob bor.

en: In many cases it is not difﬁcult to link cause and effect, in many others erroneous ideas were soon corrected by experience; but there was a large series of issues of very great importance to primitive man, where he sought
uz: Ko'p hollarda sabab va oqibatni bog'lash qiyin emas, ko'p hollarda xato g'oyalar tez orada tajriba orqali tuzatildi; lekin ibtidoiy inson uchun juda katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan katta bir qator masalalar mavjud edi, u yerda...

en: persistently for causes and found explanations that were wrong but not suf- ﬁciently wrong nor so obviously wrong as to be detected.
uz: Noto'g'ri bo'lgan sabablar va topilgan izohlar uchun qat'iy turib, lekin yetarlicha noto'g'ri yoki aniq aniq noto'g'ri bo'lmagan.

en: It was a matter of great importance to him that game should be abundant or ﬁsh plentiful and easily caught, and no doubt he tried and believed in a thousand charms, in- cantations and omens to determine these desirable results.
uz: U uchun o'yin mo'l-ko'l bo'lishi yoki baliqlar mo'l-ko'l bo'lishi va oson tutilishi juda muhim edi va shubhasiz, u bu istalgan natijalarni aniqlash uchun mingta joziba, qo'shiq va bashoratlarga harakat qildi va ishondi.

en: Another great concern of his was illness and death.
uz: Uning yana bir katta tashvishi kasallik va o'lim edi.

en: Occasionally infections crept through the land and men died of them.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan infeksiyalar yer bo'ylab tarqaldi va ulardan odamlar o'ldi.

en: Occasionally men were stricken by illness and died or were enfeebled without any manifest cause.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan odamlar kasallikka chalinib, hech qanday aniq sababsiz vafot etishardi yoki zaiflashardi.

en: This too must have given the hasty, emotional mind of primitive man much feverish exercise.
uz: Bu ham ibtidoiy insonning shoshilinch, hissiy ongiga ko'p isitma bergan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Dreams and fantastic guesses made him blame this, or appeal for help to that man or beast or thing.
uz: Tushlar va xayolparast taxminlar uni bunga ayblashga, yoki o'sha odamga, hayvonga yoki narsaga yordam so'rashga majbur qildi.

en: He had the child’s aptitude for fear and panic.
uz: U bolaning qo'rquv va vahimaga bo'lgan qobiliyatiga ega edi.

en: Quite early in the little human tribe, older, steadier minds sharing the fears, sharing the imaginations, but a little more forceful than the others, must have asserted themselves, to advise, to prescribe, to command.
uz: Kichkina insoniyat qabilasidan ancha erta, keksa, barqarorroq onglar qo'rquvlarni baham ko'rishgan, tasavvurlarni baham ko'rishgan, lekin boshqalardan biroz kuchliroq bo'lgan, o'zlarini ta'kidlagan bo'lishi kerak, maslahat berish, buyurish, buyurish.

en: This they declared unpropitious and that imperative, this an omen of good and that an omen of evil.
uz: Buni ular noqulay va zarur deb e'lon qilishdi, bu yaxshilik va bu yomonlik alomati edi.

en: The expert in Fetish, the Medicine Man, was the ﬁrst priest.
uz: Fetish boʻyicha mutaxassis, Tibbiyot odami, birinchi ruhoniy edi.

en: He exhorted, he interpreted dreams, he warned, he performed the complicated hocus pocus that brought luck or averted calamity.
uz: U maslahat berdi, tushlarni talqin qildi, ogohlantirdi, omad olib keladigan yoki falokatni oldini oladigan murakkab hocus pocusni amalga oshirdi.

en: Primitive religion was not so much what we now call religion as practice and obser- vance, and the early priest dictated what was indeed an arbitrary primitive practical science.
uz: Ibtidoiy din hozir din deb ataydigan narsa amaliyot va kuzatish emas edi, va erta ruhoniy haqiqatan ham ixtiyoriy ibtidoiy amaliy fan bo'lgan narsani buyurdi.

en: XIII THE BEGINNINGS OF CULTIVATION We are still very ignorant about the beginnings of cultivation and settlement in the world although a vast amount of research and speculation has been given to these matters in the last ﬁfty years.
uz: XIII KULTIVATSIYA BOSHLARI Biz dunyoda yetishtirish va aholi punktlarining boshlanishi haqida hali ham juda bexabarmiz, garchi so'nggi ellik yil ichida bu masalalarga juda ko'p tadqiqot va taxminlar berilgan bo'lsa ham.

en: All that we can say with any conﬁdence at present is that somewhen about 15,000 and 12,000 B.C.
uz: Hozirgi kunda ishonch bilan ayta oladigan yagona narsa shuki, qachonlardir miloddan avvalgi 15,000 va 12,000 atrofida bo'lgan.

en: while the Azilian people were in the south of Spain and while the remnants of the earlier hunters were drifting northward and eastward, somewhere in North Africa or Western Asia or in that great Mediterranean valley that is now submerged under the waters of the Mediterranean sea, there were people who, age by age, were working out two vitally important things; they were beginning cultivation and they were domesticating animals.
uz: Osiyo xalqi Ispaniyaning janubida bo'lganida va avvalgi ovchilarning qoldiqlari shimolga va sharqqa qarab suzib yurganida, Shimoliy Afrika yoki G'arbiy Osiyoda yoki hozirda O'rta yer dengizi suvlari ostida qolib ketgan ulkan O'rta yer dengizi vodiysida, yosh o'tishi bilan ikki muhim narsani ishlab chiqayotgan odamlar bor edi; ular dehqonchilikni boshlashardi va hayvonlarni uylashtirishardi.

en: They were also beginning to make, in addition to the chipped implements of their hunter forebears, implements of polished stone.
uz: Ular o'z ovchi ajdodlarining maydalangan asboblaridan tashqari, sayqallangan toshdan ham asboblar yasay boshlashardi.

en: They had discovered the possibili- ty of basketwork and roughly woven textiles of plant ﬁbre, and they were beginning to make a rudely modelled pottery.
uz: Ular o'simlik tolalaridan savatchilik va taxminan to'qilgan to'qimachilik imkoniyatlarini topdilar va qo'pol tarzda modellashtirilgan kulolchilik yasashni boshlashdi.

en: They were entering upon a new phase in human culture, the Neolithic phase (New Stone Age) as distinguished from the Palæolithic (Old Stone) phase of the Cro-Magnards, the Grimaldi people, the Azilians and their like.
uz: Ular insoniyat madaniyatining yangi bosqichiga kirayotgan edilar, bu Cro-Magnardlar, Grimaldi xalqi, Azililar va ularning kabilarning palæolitik (Eski tosh) bosqichi edi.

en: [1] Slowly these Neolithic people spread over the warmer parts of the world; and the arts they had mastered, the plants and animals they had learnt to use, spread by imitation and acquisition even more widely than they did.
uz: Sekin-asta bu Neolit xalqlari dunyoning issiqroq qismlariga tarqaldi; va ular o'zlashtirgan san'atlar, ishlatishni o'rgangan o'simliklar va hayvonlar taqlid va o'zlashtirish orqali ulardan ham kengroq tarqaldi.

en: By 10,000 B.C., most of mankind was at the Neolithic level.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 10 000 yilga kelib, insoniyatning aksariyati Neolit darajasida edi.

en: Now the ploughing of land, the sowing of seed, the reaping of harvest, threshing and grinding, may seem the most obviously reasonable steps to a modern mind just as to a modern mind it is a commonplace that the world is
uz: Endi yer haydash, urug' ekish, hosilni yig'ishtirish, maydalash va silliqlash zamonaviy aql uchun eng aniq oqilona qadamlardek tuyulishi mumkin, xuddi zamonaviy aql uchun dunyo odatiy hol bo'lgani kabi.

en: What else could you do?
uz: Siz yana nima qila olar edingiz?

en: What else can it be?
uz: Yana nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: But to the primitive man of twenty thousand years ago neither of the systems of action and reasoning that seem so sure and manifest to us to-day were at all obvious.
uz: Ammo yigirma ming yil oldingi ibtidoiy inson uchun bugungi kunda bizga shu qadar ishonchli va namoyon bo'lib tuyulgan harakat va mulohaza tizimlarining hech biri umuman aniq emas edi.

en: He felt his way to effectual practice through a multitude of trials and misconceptions, with fantastic and unnecessary elaborations and false interpretations at every turn.
uz: U ko'plab sinovlar va noto'g'ri tushunchalar orqali samarali amaliyotga yo'lni his qildi, har bir qadamda fantastik va keraksiz izlanishlar va noto'g'ri talqinlar bilan.

en: Somewhere in the Mediterranean region, wheat grew wild; and man may have learnt to pound and then grind up its seeds for food long before he learnt to sow.
uz: O'rta yer dengizi mintaqasining qayerdadirida bug'doy yovvoyi o'sgan; va odam urug'ini ekishni o'rganmasidan ancha oldin uni maydalab, keyin oziq-ovqat uchun maydalab tashlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He reaped before he sowed.
uz: U ekishdan oldin hosil yig'di.

en: And it is a very remarkable thing that throughout the world wherever there is sowing and harvesting there is still traceable the vestiges of a strong primitive association of the idea of sowing with the idea of a blood sacri- ﬁce, and primarily of the sacriﬁce of a human being.
uz: Va juda ajoyib narsa shuki, butun dunyo bo'ylab, qayerda ekish va hosil yig'ish bo'lsa, u yerda hali ham qon qurbonligi g'oyasi bilan ekish g'oyasining kuchli ibtidoiy aloqasi, va asosan inson qurbonligi izlari kuzatilmoqda.

en: The study of the origi- nal entanglement of these two things is a profoundly attractive one to the curious mind; the interested reader will ﬁnd it very fully developed in that monumental work, Sir J.
uz: Bu ikki narsaning asl qarama-qarshiligini o'rganish qiziquvchan ong uchun chuqur jozibali narsa; qiziquvchi o'quvchi uni o'sha monumental asarda juda to'liq rivojlangan deb topadi, janob J.

en: Frazer’s Golden Bough.
uz: Frazerning Oltin Qovog'i.

en: It was an entangle- ment, we must remember, in the childish, dreaming, myth-making primitive mind; no reasoned process will explain it.
uz: Bu bolalarcha, tush ko'rish, afsona yaratadigan ibtidoiy ongda chalkashlik edi, eslashimiz kerak; hech qanday asoslangan jarayon buni tushuntirmaydi.

en: But in that world of 12,000 to 20,000 years ago, it would seem that whenever seed time came round to the Neolithic peoples there was a human sacriﬁce.
uz: Ammo o'sha 12 000 dan 20 000 yilgacha bo'lgan dunyoda, Neolit xalqlariga urug' vaqti kelgan har safar inson qurbonligi bo'lgandek tuyuldi.

en: And it was not the sacriﬁce of any mean or outcast person; it was the sacriﬁce usually of a chosen youth or maiden, a youth more often who was treated with profound deference and even worship up to the moment of his immolation.
uz: Va bu hech qanday oddiy yoki chetlatilgan odamning qurbonligi emas edi; bu odatda tanlangan yosh yoki qizning qurbonligi edi, ko'pincha chuqur hurmat bilan qaralgan va hatto qurbonlik paytigacha sig'ingan yosh.

en: He was a sort of sacriﬁcial god-king, and all the details of his killing had become a ritual di- rected by the old, knowing men and sanctioned by the accumulated usage of ages.
uz: U o'ziga xos qurbonlik xudo-shohi edi va uning o'ldirilishining barcha tafsilotlari qadimgi, odamlarni biladigan va asrlar davomida to'plangan foydalanish orqali ruxsat etilgan marosimga aylangan edi.

en: NEOLITHIC FLINT IMPLEMENTS  Brit.
uz: NEOLITIC FLINT IMPLEMENTLARI Britaniyalik.

en: At ﬁrst primitive men, with only a very rough idea of the seasons, must have found great difﬁculty in determining when was the propitious moment for the seed-time sacriﬁce and the sowing.
uz: Dastlab ibtidoiy odamlar, fasllar haqida juda qo'pol tasavvurga ega bo'lgan holda, urug' vaqtini qurbon qilish va ekish uchun qulay vaqtni aniqlashda katta qiyinchilikka duch kelishgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: There is some reason for suppos- ing that there was an early stage in human experience when men had no idea of a year.
uz: Inson tajribasining erta bosqichi bo'lgan, odamlar bir yil haqida tasavvurga ega bo'lmagan davrda bo'lgan deb taxmin qilish uchun qandaydir sabab bor.

en: The ﬁrst chronology was in lunar months; it is supposed that the years of the Biblical patriarchs are really moons, and the Babylonian calendar shows distinct traces of an attempt to reckon seed time by taking thirteen lunar months to see it round.
uz: Birinchi xronologiya oy oylarida bo'lgan; Muqaddas Kitobdagi patriarxlarning yillari haqiqatan ham oylar deb taxmin qilinadi va Bobil taqvimi urug' vaqtini o'n uch oy aylanib ko'rish orqali hisoblashga urinishning aniq izlarini ko'rsatadi.

en: This lunar inﬂuence upon the calendar reaches down to our own days.
uz: Bu oy taqvimiga ta'siri bizning kunlarimizgacha yetib boradi.

en: If usage did not dull our sense of its strange-
uz: Agar foydalanish bizning g'alati hisimizni xiralashtirmagan bo'lsa-

en: ness we should think it a very remarkable thing indeed that the Christian Church does not commemorate the Cruciﬁxion and Resurrection of Christ on the proper anniversaries but on dates that vary year by year with the phases of the moon.
uz: Shunday ekan, xristian cherkovi Masihning Xochga mixlanishi va tirilishini to'g'ri yubileylarda emas, balki yil sayin oyning bosqichlari bilan o'zgarib turadigan sanalarda xotirlashi juda ajoyib narsa deb hisoblashimiz kerak.

en: It may be doubted whether the ﬁrst agriculturalists made any observation of the stars.
uz: Birinchi dehqonlar yulduzlarni kuzatganmi yoki yo'qmi, shubhalanish mumkin.

en: It is more likely that stars were ﬁrst observed by migratory herdsmen, who found them a convenient mark of direction.
uz: Ko'proq ehtimol bilan yulduzlarni birinchi bo'lib ko'chmanchi chorvadorlar kuzatgan bo'lishi mumkin, ular ularga qulay yo'nalish belgisini topdilar.

en: But once their use in determining seasons was realized, their importance to agriculture be- came very great.
