uz: Lekin ularning fasllarni belgilashda qo'llanilishi anglangandan so'ng, ularning qishloq xo'jaligi uchun ahamiyati juda katta bo'ldi.

en: The seed-time sacriﬁce was linked up with the southing or northing of some prominent star.
uz: Urug' vaqtini qurbonlik qilish, qandaydir taniqli yulduzning janubga chiqish yoki shimolga tushishi bilan bog'liq edi.

en: A myth and worship of that star was for primitive man an almost inevitable consequence.
uz: O'sha yulduz haqidagi afsona va sig'inish ibtidoiy inson uchun deyarli muqarrar oqibat edi.

en: NEOLITHICISM OF TO-DAY  Spearheads, exactly as in the true Neolithic days, but made recently by Australian Natives,  (1) Made from a telegraph insulator;  (2) from a piece of broken bottle glass.
uz: Bugungi nayza boshlarining NEOLITISMI, xuddi haqiqiy Neolit davridagidek, lekin yaqinda Avstraliyalik mahalliy aholi tomonidan yaratilgan, telegraf izolyatoridan tayyorlangan; sindirilgan shisha bo'lagi.

en: It is easy to see how important the man of knowledge and experience, the man who knew about the blood sacriﬁce and the stars, became in this early Neolithic world.
uz: Ilm va tajriba egalari, qon qurbonligi va yulduzlar haqida bilgan inson, ushbu erta Neolit dunyosida qanchalik muhim bo'lganini ko'rish oson.

en: The fear of uncleanness and pollution, and the methods of cleansing that were advisable, constituted another source of power for the knowledgeable men and women.
uz: Najaslik va ifloslanishdan qo'rqish, hamda tozalash usullari maqsadga muvofiq bo'lgani bilimdon erkaklar va ayollar uchun yana bir kuch manbasini tashkil etdi.

en: For there have always been witches as well as wizards, and priestesses as well as priests.
uz: Chunki doimo jodugarlar ham, sehrgarlar ham, ruhoniylar ham, ruhoniylar ham bo'lgan.

en: The early priest was really not so much a religious man as a man of applied science.
uz: Dastlabki ruhoniy aslida diniy odam emas, balki amaliy fanlar odami edi.

en: His science was generally empir- ical and often bad; he kept it secret from the generality of men very jealous- ly; but that does not alter the fact that his primary function was knowledge and that his primary use was a practical use.
uz: Uning fani odatda empirik edi va ko'pincha yomon edi; u buni odamlarning umumiy ko'rinishidan juda rashk bilan yashirdi; lekin bu uning asosiy vazifasi bilim ekanligi va asosiy foydalanishi amaliy foydalanish ekanligi faktini o'zgartirmaydi.

en: SPECIMEN OF NEOLITHIC POTTERY  Dug up at Mortlake from the Thames Bed  Brit.
uz: NEOLITIK POTERIYASINING NAMUNALARI Mortlake'da Temza o'lkasidan Britdan qazilgan.

en: Twelve or ﬁfteen thousand years ago, in all the warm and fairly well-wa- tered parts of the Old World these Neolithic human communities, with their class and tradition of priests and priestesses and their cultivated ﬁelds and their development of villages and little walled cities, were spreading.
uz: O'n ikki yoki o'n besh ming yil oldin, Eski Dunyoning barcha iliq va ancha yaxshi obodonlashgan qismlarida, Neolit insoniy jamoalari, ularning ruhoniylar va ruhoniy qizlarning sinfi va an'analari, dehqonchilik maydonlari hamda qishloqlari va kichik devorli shaharlarining rivojlanishi bilan tarqalgan edi.

en: Age by age a drift and exchange of ideas went on between these communities.
uz: Bu jamiyatlar o'rtasida yosh o'tishi va g'oyalar almashinuvi avj oldi.

en: Eliot Smith and Rivers have used the term “Heliolithic culture” for the cul- ture of these ﬁrst agricultural peoples.
uz: Eliot Smit va Rivers ushbu birinchi qishloq xo'jaligi xalqlarining madaniyati uchun Geliolitik madaniyat atamasini ishlatishgan.

en: “Heliolithic” (Sun and Stone) is not perhaps the best possible word to use for this, but until scientiﬁc men give us a better one we shall have to use it.
uz: Geliolitik (Quyosh va Tosh) bu uchun eng yaxshi so'z bo'lmasligi mumkin, lekin olimlar bizga undan yaxshiroq so'z bermaguncha, uni ishlatishimiz kerak bo'ladi.

en: Originating somewhere in the Mediterranean and western Asiatic area, it spread age by age eastward and from island to island across the Paciﬁc until it may even have reached America and mingled with the more primitive ways of living of the Mon- goloid immigrants coming down from the North.
uz: O'rta yer dengizi va G'arbiy Osiyo hududida kelib chiqqan holda, u yoshdan yoshga qarab sharqqa va Tinch okeanidan orolga orolga tarqaldi, hatto Amerikaga yetib borgan bo'lishi mumkin va shimoldan kelayotgan Mon- goloid muhojirlarining yanada ibtidoiy turmush tarzi bilan aralashgan.

en: Wherever the brownish people with the Heliolithic culture went they took with them all or most of a certain group of curious ideas and practices.
uz: Heliolit madaniyatiga ega bo'lgan jigarrang odamlar qayerga bormasin, ular o'zlari bilan ma'lum bir guruh qiziqarli g'oyalar va amaliyotlarning barchasini yoki ko'p qismini olib ketishdi.

en: Some of them are such queer ideas that they call for the explanation of the mental expert.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari shunchalik g'alati g'oyalarki, ular ruhiy mutaxassisning izohini talab qiladi.

en: They made pyramids and great mounds, and set up great cir- cles of big stones, perhaps to facilitate the astronomical observation of the priests; they made mummies of some or all of their dead; they tattooed and circumcized; they had the old custom, known as the couvade, of sending the father to bed and rest when a child was born, and they had as a luck symbol the well-known Swastika.
uz: Ular piramidalar va ulkan tepaliklar yasashdi, shuningdek, ruhoniylarning astronomik kuzatuvini osonlashtirish uchun katta tosh doiralarini o'rnatishdi; ularning ba'zi yoki barcha o'liklaridan mumiyalar yasashdi; tatuirovka qilishdi va sunnat qilishdi; ular otalarni bola tug'ilganda uxlatish va dam olish uchun yuborishning eski odatiga ega edilar va ularning omad ramzi sifatida mashhur svastika bor edi.

en: If we were to make a map of the world with dots to show how far these group practices have left their traces, we should make a belt along the tem- perate and sub-tropical coasts of the world from Stonehenge and Spain across the world to Mexico and Peru.
uz: Agar biz bu guruh amaliyotlari qanchalik uzoq iz qoldirganini ko'rsatish uchun nuqtalar bilan dunyo xaritasini yasashimiz kerak bo'lsa, Stonehenge va Ispaniya bo'ylab dunyo bo'ylab Meksika va Perugacha bo'lgan dunyoning tematik va subtropik qirg'oqlari bo'ylab tasma yasashimiz kerak.

en: But Africa below the equator, north central Europe, and north Asia would show none of these dottings; there lived races who were developing along practically independent lines.
uz: Ammo ekvatordan pastroq Afrika, shimoliy markaziy Yevropa va shimoliy Osiyo bu nuqtalarni ko'rsatmas edi; amalda mustaqil chiziqlar bo'ylab rivojlanayotgan irqlar yashardi.

en: [1] The term Palæolithic we may note is also used to cover the Nean- derthaler and even the Eolithic implements.
uz: [1] Paleolit atamasi Nean-derthaler va hatto Eolit asboblarini ham qamrab olish uchun ishlatiladi.

en: The pre-human age is called the “Older Palæolithic;” the age of true men using unpolished stones in the “Newer Palæolithic.”
uz: Odamzoddan oldingi davr Eski Paleolit davr deb ataladi; haqiqiy erkaklarning Yangi Paleolit davrda sayqallangan toshlardan foydalangan davri.

en: XIV PRIMITIVE NEOLITHIC CIVILIZATIONS About 10,000 B.C.
uz: XIV BIRINCHI NEOLIT SIVILIZATSIYALARI Taxminan miloddan avvalgi 10 000 yil.

en: the geography of the world was very similar in its general outline to that of the world to-day.
uz: Dunyo geografiyasi umumiy ko'rinishida bugungi dunyoga juda o'xshash edi.

en: It is probable that by that time the great barrier across the Straits of Gibraltar that had hitherto banked back the ocean waters from the Mediterranean valley had been eaten through, and that the Mediterranean was a sea following much the same coastlines as it does now.
uz: Ehtimol, o'sha vaqtga kelib, Gibraltar bo'g'ozlari orqali o'tgan, shu paytgacha O'rta yer dengizi vodiysidan okean suvlarini qaytargan katta to'siq yutib yuborilgan va O'rta yer dengizi hozirgidek xuddi shunday qirg'oq chiziqlariga ergashgan dengiz edi.

en: The Caspian Sea was probably still far more extensive than it is at present, and it may have been continuous with the Black Sea to the north of the Caucasus Mountains.
uz: Kaspiy dengizi hozirgidan ancha kengroq bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin va u Qora dengiz bilan birga Kavkaz tog'larining shimolida davom etgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: About this great Central Asian sea lands that are now steppes and deserts were fertile and habitable.
uz: Ushbu buyuk Markaziy Osiyo dengiz yerlari haqida, hozirda dasht va cho'l bo'lgan, unumdor va yashash uchun qulay edi.

en: Generally it was a moister and more fertile world.
uz: Odatda u namroq va unumliroq dunyo edi.

en: European Russia was much more a land of swamp and lake than it is now, and there may still have been a land connex- ion between Asia and America at Behring Straits.
uz: Yevropa Rossiyasi hozirgidan ko'ra ancha botqoqlik va ko'l zaminida edi va Behring bo'g'ozlarida Osiyo va Amerika o'rtasida hali ham quruqlik aloqasi bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It would have been already possible at that time to have distinguished the main racial divisions of mankind as we know them to-day.
uz: O'sha paytda insoniyatning asosiy irqiy bo'linmalarini bugungi kunda biz bilganimizdek ajratib ko'rish allaqachon mumkin bo'lar edi.

en: Across the warm temperate regions of this rather warmer and better-wooded world, and along the coasts, stretched the brownish peoples of the Heliolithic culture, the an- cestors of the bulk of the living inhabitants of the Mediterranean world, of the Berbers, the Egyptians and of much of the population of South and Eastern Asia.
uz: Ushbu ancha iliq va yaxshi yog'ochli dunyoning iliq o'rtacha mintaqalarida, shuningdek, sohillar bo'ylab, Heliolit madaniyatining jigarrang xalqlari, O'rta yer dengizi dunyosining tirik aholisining asosiy qismi, Berberlar, Misrliklar va Janubiy va Sharqiy Osiyo aholisining katta qismining yo'lchilari cho'zilgan.

en: This great race had of course a number of varieties.
uz: Bu buyuk poyga, albatta, bir qator navlarga ega edi.

en: The Iber- ian or Mediterranean or “dark-white” race of the Atlantic and Mediter- ranean coast, the “Hamitic” peoples which include the Berbers and Egyp- tians, the Dravidians; the darker people of India, a multitude of East Indian people, many Polynesian races and the Maoris are all divisions of various
uz: Atlantika va O'rta yer dengizi qirg'oqlarining Iber-Iyan yoki O'rta yer dengizi yoki qora-oq irqi, Berberlar va Misrliklar, Dravidlarni o'z ichiga olgan Hamitiy xalqlari; Hindistonning qora xalqlari, Sharqiy Hindiston xalqlarining ko'pligi, ko'plab Polineziya irqlari va Maorilarning barchasi turli bo'linishidir.

en: value of this great main mass of humanity.
uz: insoniyatning ushbu buyuk asosiy massasining qiymati.

en: Its western varieties are whiter than its eastern.
uz: Uning g'arbiy navlari sharqidan oqroq.

en: In the forests of central and northern Europe a more blonde variety of men with blue eyes was becoming distinguishable, branching off from the main mass of brownish people, a variety which many people now speak of as the Nordic race.
uz: Markaziy va shimoliy Yevropaning o'rmonlarida ko'k ko'zli erkaklarning ko'proq sarg'ish navlari ajralib turardi, ular jigarrang odamlarning asosiy massasidan ajralib chiqardi, bu navni ko'pchilik hozirda Skandinaviya irqi deb ataydi.

en: In the more open regions of northeastern Asia was an- other differentiation of this brownish humanity in the direction of a type with more oblique eyes, high cheek-bones, a yellowish skin, and very straight black hair, the Mongolian peoples.
uz: Shimoliy-sharqiy Osiyoning ochiqroq hududlarida bu jigarrang insoniyatning boshqa bir farqlanishi ko'proq egri ko'zli, uzun yonoq suyaklari, sarg'ish teri va juda to'g'ri qora sochli, mo'g'ul xalqlari yo'nalishida edi.

en: In South Africa, Australia, in many tropical islands in the south of Asia were remains of the early negroid peoples.
uz: Janubiy Afrikada, Avstraliyada, Osiyo janubidagi ko'plab tropik orollarda erta qora tanli xalqlarning qoldiqlari bor edi.

en: The central parts of Africa were already a region of racial inter- mixture.
uz: Afrikaning markaziy qismlari allaqachon irqiy aralashuv mintaqasi edi.

en: Nearly all the coloured races of Africa to-day seem to be blends of the brownish peoples of the north with a negroid substratum.
uz: Bugungi kunda Afrikaning deyarli barcha rangli irqlari shimoldagi jigarrang xalqlarning negroid substrat bilan aralashmasidek tuyuladi.

en: We have to remember that human races can all interbreed freely and that they separate, mingle and reunite as clouds do.
uz: Biz shuni yodda tutishimiz kerakki, insoniyat irqlari erkin ravishda o'zaro ko'payishi mumkin va ular bulutlar kabi ajralib, aralashib va qayta birlashadi.

en: Human races do not branch out like trees with branches that never come together again.
uz: Insoniyat irqlari hech qachon birga kelmaydigan shoxlari bor daraxtlar kabi tarqalmaydi.

en: It is a thing we need to bear constantly in mind, this remingling of races at any opportunity.
uz: Bu biz doimiy ravishda yodda tutishimiz kerak bo'lgan narsa, har qanday imkoniyatda irqlarni eslash.

en: It will save us from many cruel delusions and prejudices if we do so.
uz: Agar shunday qilsak, bizni ko'plab shafqatsiz xayoliy fikrlar va xurofotlardan qutqaradi.

en: will use such a word as race in the loosest manner, and base the most pre- posterous generalizations upon it.
uz: Irq degan so'zni eng erkin tarzda ishlatadi va unga eng oldingi umumiylashtiruvlarni asoslaydi.

en: They will speak of a “British” race or of a “European” race.
uz: Ular Britaniya irqi yoki Yevropa irqi haqida gapirishadi.

en: But nearly all the European nations are confused mixtures of brownish, dark-white, white and Mongolian elements.
uz: Lekin deyarli barcha Yevropa millatlari jigarrang, to'q-oq, oq va mo'g'ul elementlarining chalkash aralashmalarida joylashgan.

en: A MAYA STELE  Showing a worshipper and a Serpent God.
uz: MAYA STELE ibodat qiluvchi va Ilon Xudosini ko'rsatmoqda.

en: Note the grotesque faces in the writing  Brit.
uz: Brit yozuvidagi g'alati yuzlarga e'tibor bering.

en: It was at the Neolithic phase of human development that peoples of the Mongolian breed ﬁrst made their way into America.
uz: Aynan inson rivojlanishining Neolit davrida moʻgʻul zotli xalqlar birinchi marta Amerikaga yoʻl olishdi.

en: Apparently they came by way of Behring Straits and spread southward.
uz: Ko'rinishidan, ular Behring bo'g'ozlari orqali kelishgan va janubga tarqalgan.

en: They found caribou, the American reindeer, in the north and great herds of bison in the south.
uz: Ular shimolda Amerika bug'usi bo'lgan karibu va janubda katta bison suruvlarini topdilar.

en: When they reached South America there were still living the Glyptodon, a gigan- tic armadillo, and the Megatherium, a monstrous clumsy sloth as high as an elephant.
uz: Ular Janubiy Amerikaga yetib borgach, u yerda hali ham Glyptodon, gigant-tik armadillo va Megatherium, fil kabi baland bo'lgan dahshatli, g'alati dangasa odam yashardi.

en: They probably exterminated the latter beast, which was as help- less as it was big.
uz: Ehtimol, ular oxirgi hayvonni yo'q qilishgan, u katta bo'lgani kabi yordam bermagan.

en: The greater portion of these American tribes never rose above a hunting nomadic Neolithic life.
uz: Bu amerika qabilalarining aksariyati hech qachon ovchi ko'chmanchi neolitika hayotidan yuqoriga ko'tarilmagan.

en: They never discovered the use of iron, and their chief metal possessions were native gold and copper.
uz: Ular hech qachon temirdan foydalanishni kashf etmaganlar va ularning asosiy metall boyliklari mahalliy oltin va mis edi.

en: But in Mexico, Yu- catan and Peru conditions existed favourable to settled cultivation, and here about 1000 B.C.
uz: Lekin Meksikada, Yu-katan va Peruda o'rnashgan ekinlar uchun qulay sharoitlar mavjud edi va bu yerda taxminan miloddan avvalgi 1000-yillarda.

en: or so arose very interesting civilizations of a parallel but different type from the old-world civilization.
uz: yoki shunday qilib, qadimgi dunyo sivilizatsiyasidan parallel, lekin boshqacha turdagi juda qiziqarli sivilizatsiyalar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Like the much earlier primi- tive civilizations of the old world these communities displayed a great de- velopment of human sacriﬁce about the processes of seed time and harvest; but while in the old world, as we shall see, these primary ideas were ulti- mately mitigated, complicated and overlaid by others, in America they de- veloped and were elaborated, to a very high degree of intensity.
uz: Xuddi eski dunyoning ancha erta boshlang'ich sivilizatsiyalari kabi, bu jamoalar urug'chilik va hosil olish jarayonlari haqida insoniy qurbonlikning katta tajribasini namoyish etishdi; lekin eski dunyoda, ko'rib turganimizdek, bu asosiy g'oyalar oxir-oqibat yumshatilgan, murakkablashtirilgan va boshqalar tomonidan ustma-ust qoplangan bo'lsa, Amerikada ular juda yuqori darajadagi intensivlik bilan ishlab chiqilgan va ishlab chiqilgan edi.

en: These American civilized countries were essentially priest-ruled countries; their war chiefs and rulers were under a rigorous rule of law and omen.
uz: Bu Amerika madaniy davlatlari asosan ruhoniylar tomonidan boshqariladigan davlatlar edi; ularning harbiy boshliqlari va hukmdorlari qat'iy qonun ustuvorligi va obro'si ostida edi.

en: These priests carried astronomical science to a high level of accuracy.
uz: Bu ruhoniylar astronomiya fanini yuqori darajadagi aniqlikka olib bordilar.

en: They knew their year better than the Babylonians of whom we shall pres- ently tell.
uz: Ular o'z yillarini biz oldindan aytib beradigan bobilliklarga qaraganda yaxshiroq bilishgan.

en: In Yucatan they had a kind of writing, the Maya writing, of the most curious and elaborate character.
uz: Yucatan shahrida eng qiziqarli va murakkab xarakterga ega bo'lgan Maya yozuvi bor edi.

en: So far as we have been able to deci- pher it, it was used mainly for keeping the exact and complicated calendars upon which the priests expended their intelligence.
uz: Uni aniqlay olganimizcha, u asosan ruhoniylar o'z aqllarini sarflagan aniq va murakkab taqvimlarni saqlash uchun ishlatilgan.

en: The art of the Maya civ- ilization came to a climax about 700 or 800 A.D.
uz: Maya sivilizatsiyasi san'ati taxminan milodiy 700 yoki 800-yillarda eng yuqori cho'qqisiga yetdi.

en: The sculptured work of these people amazes the modern observer by its great plastic power and its frequent beauty, and perplexes him by a grotesqueness and by a sort of in- sane conventionality and intricacy outside the circle of his ideas.
uz: Bu odamlarning haykaltaroshlik asari zamonaviy kuzatuvchini o'zining ulkan plastik qudrati va tez-tez uchraydigan go'zalligi bilan hayratga soladi, uni g'alatilik va o'z g'oyalari doirasidan tashqaridagi aql bovar qilmas an'anaviylik va murakkablik bilan hayratga soladi.

en: There is nothing quite like it in the old world.
uz: Eski dunyoda unga o'xshash hech narsa yo'q.

en: The nearest approach, and that is a re- mote one, is found in archaic Indian carvings.
uz: Eng yaqin yondashuv, ya'ni qayta moslashtirilgan yondashuv, arxaik hind o'ymakorliklarida uchraydi.

en: Everywhere there are woven feathers and serpents twine in and out.
uz: Har yerda to'qilgan patlar va ilonlar ichkariga va tashqariga o'raladi.

en: Many Maya inscriptions resemble a certain sort of elaborate drawing made by lunatics in European asylums, more than any other old-world work.
uz: Ko'pgina Maya yozuvlari Yevropa boshpanalarida aqldan ozganlar tomonidan yaratilgan ma'lum bir murakkab chizmaga o'xshaydi, boshqa eski dunyo asarlaridan ko'ra ko'proq.

en: It is as if the Maya mind had devel-
uz: Go'yo Mayya aqli rivojlangan go'yo...

en: oped upon a different line from the old-world mind, had a different twist to its ideas, was not, by old-world standards, a rational mind at all.
uz: Eski dunyo fikridan boshqacha chiziqni topdi, o'z g'oyalariga boshqacha burilishga ega edi, eski dunyo standartlariga ko'ra umuman oqilona fikr emas edi.

en: This linking of these aberrant American civilizations to the idea of a gen- eral mental aberration ﬁnds support in their extraordinary obsession by the shedding of human blood.
uz: Ushbu g'ayrioddiy Amerika sivilizatsiyalarining umumiy aqliy g'ayrioddiylik g'oyasiga bog'lanishi ularning inson qonini to'kishga bo'lgan g'ayrioddiy ishtiyoqida qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

en: The Mexican civilization in particular ran blood; it offered thousands of human victims yearly.
uz: Meksika sivilizatsiyasi, ayniqsa, qon oqizdi; u har yili minglab inson qurbonlarini taqdim etdi.

en: The cutting open of living victims, the tearing out of the still beating heart, was an act that dominated the minds and lives of these strange priesthoods.
uz: Tirik qurbonlarning kesilishi, hali ham urayotgan yurakni yirtish, bu g'alati ruhoniyliklarning ongini va hayotini hukmronlik qilgan harakat edi.

en: The public life, the nation- al festivities all turned on this fantastically horrible act.
uz: Jamoat hayoti, millat bayramlari hammasi bu ajoyib dahshatli harakatga qaratildi.

en: NEOLITHIC WARRIOR  Modelled from drawing by Prof.
uz: NEOLIT HARBIY Prof. chizmasidan modellashtirilgan.

en: Rutot The ordinary existence of the common people in these communities was very like the ordinary existence of any other barbaric peasantry.
uz: Rutot Bu jamiyatlardagi oddiy odamlarning oddiy mavjudligi har qanday boshqa vahshiy dehqonchilikning oddiy mavjudligiga juda o'xshardi.

en: Their pot- tery, weaving and dyeing was very good.
uz: Ularning idishlari, to'qish va bo'yash ishlari juda yaxshi edi.

en: The Maya writing was not only carven on stone but written and painted upon skins and the like.
uz: Maya yozuvi nafaqat toshga o'yib ishlangan, balki terisiga yozilgan va bo'yalgan va shunga o'xshash narsalar edi.

en: ropean and American museums contain many enigmatical Maya manu- scripts of which at present little has been deciphered except the dates.
uz: Ropean va Amerika muzeylarida ko'plab sirli Maya qo'lyozmalari mavjud bo'lib, ularning hozirgi kunda sanalaridan tashqari hech narsa shifrlanmagan.

en: In Peru there were beginnings of a similar writing but they were superseded by a method of keeping records by knotting cords.
uz: Peruda shunga o'xshash yozuvlarning boshlanishi bo'lgan, ammo ular arqonlar bilan bog'lash orqali yozuvlarni saqlash usuli bilan almashtirilgan.

en: A similar method of mnemonics was in use in China thousands of years ago.
uz: Xuddi shunday mnemonika usuli Xitoyda ming yillar oldin ishlatilgan.

en: In the old world before 4000 or 5000 B.C., that is to say three or four thousand years earlier, there were primitive civilizations not unlike these American civilizations; civilizations based upon a temple, having a vast quantity of blood sacriﬁces and with an intensely astronomical priesthood.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 4000 yoki 5000 yil oldingi dunyoda, ya'ni uch yoki to'rt ming yil oldin, bu Amerika sivilizatsiyalaridan farqli o'laroq bo'lmagan ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalar mavjud edi; ibodatxonaga asoslangan, qon qurbonliklari juda ko'p bo'lgan va astronomik ruhoniylik bilan mashhur sivilizatsiyalar.

en: But in the old world the primitive civilizations reacted upon one another and developed towards the conditions of our own world.
uz: Lekin eski dunyoda ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalar bir-biriga qarshi reaksiyaga kirishdi va o'z dunyomiz sharoitlariga qarab rivojlanishdi.

en: In America these primitive civilizations never progressed beyond this primitive stage.
uz: Amerikada bu ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalar hech qachon bu ibtidoiy bosqichdan o'tib ketmadi.

en: Each of them was in a little world of its own.
uz: Ularning har biri o'zining kichik olamida edi.

en: Mexico it seems knew little or noth- ing of Peru, until the Europeans came to America.
uz: Meksika Yevropaliklar Amerikaga kelmaguncha, Peruni deyarli bilmagan ko'rinadi.

en: The potato, which was the principal food stuff in Peru, was unknown in Mexico.
uz: Kartoshka, Peruda asosiy oziq-ovqat bo'lgan kartoshka, Meksikada noma'lum edi.

en: Age by age these peoples lived and marvelled at their gods and made their sacriﬁces and died.
uz: Avloddan-avlodga bu xalqlar o'z xudolariga hayrat bilan yashardilar, qurbonlik qildilar va vafot etdilar.

en: Maya art rose to high levels of decorative beauty.
uz: Maya san'ati dekorativ go'zallikning yuqori darajalariga ko'tarildi.

en: Men made love and tribes made war.
uz: Erkaklar sevgi qilishdi, qabilalar esa urush qilishdi.

en: Drought and plenty, pestilence and health, followed one another.
uz: Qurg'oqchilik va mo'l-ko'lchilik, o'lat va sog'liq bir-birining ortidan ketib ketdi.

en: The priests elaborated their calendar and their sacriﬁcial ritual through long centuries, but made little progress in other directions.
uz: Ruhoniylar o'z taqvimlarini va qurbonlik marosimlarini uzoq asrlar davomida ishlab chiqdilar, lekin boshqa yo'nalishlarda kam yutuqlarga erishdilar.

en: XV SUMERIA, EARLY EGYPT AND WRITING The old world is a wider, more varied stage than the new.
uz: XV SUMERIYA, ERTA MISR VA YoZISH Eski dunyo yangi dunyoga qaraganda kengroq, xilma-xilroq sahna.
Miloddan avvalgi 6000 yoki 7000 yilga kelib.

en: there were already quasi-civilized communities almost at the Peruvian level, appearing in various fertile regions of Asia and in the Nile valley.
uz: Osiyo va Nil vodiysining turli unumdor mintaqalarida paydo bo'lgan, deyarli Peruv darajasidagi deyarli madaniy jamiyatlar allaqachon mavjud edi.

en: At that time north Persia and western Turkestan and south Arabia were all more fertile than they are now, and there are traces of very early communi- ties in these regions.
uz: O'sha paytda shimoliy Fors, g'arbiy Turkiston va janubiy Arabiston hozirgidan ko'ra unumliroq edi va bu hududlarda juda erta aloqa izlari bor.

en: It is in lower Mesopotamia however and in Egypt that there ﬁrst appear cities, temples, systematic irrigation, and evidences of a social organization rising above the level of a mere barbaric village-town.
uz: Ammo quyi Mesopotamiyada va Misrda birinchi marta shaharlar, ibodatxonalar, tizimli sug'orish va oddiy vahshiy qishloq-shahar darajasidan yuqoriga ko'tarilgan ijtimoiy tashkilot dalillari paydo bo'ladi.

en: In those days the Euphrates and Tigris ﬂowed by separate mouths into the Persian Gulf, and it was in the country between them that the Sumerians built their ﬁrst cities.
uz: O'sha kunlarda Furot va Tigris daryolari alohida og'izlardan Fors ko'rfaziga oqib kirardi va shumerlar o'rtasidagi mamlakatda o'zlarining birinchi shaharlarini qurgan edilar.

en: About the same time, for chronology is still vague, the great history of Egypt was beginning.
uz: Taxminan shu vaqtning o'zida, xronologiya hali ham noaniq bo'lgani uchun, Misrning buyuk tarixi boshlanayotgan edi.

en: These Sumerians appear to have been a brownish people with prominent noses.
uz: Bu shumerlar ko'zga ko'ringan burunlari bor jigarrang xalq bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: They employed a sort of writing that has been deciphered, and their language is now known.
uz: Ular shifrlangan bir turdagi yozuvni qo'lladilar va ularning tili hozir ma'lum.

en: They had discovered the use of bronze and they built great tower-like temples of sun-dried brick.
uz: Ular bronza ishlatilishini aniqladilar va quyoshdan quritilgan g'ishtdan ulkan minoraga o'xshash ibodatxonalar qurdilar.

en: The clay of this country is very ﬁne; they used it to write upon, and so it is that their inscriptions have been preserved to us.
uz: Bu mamlakatning loyligi juda nozik; ular uni yozish uchun ishlatishgan, shuning uchun ham ularning yozuvlari bizga saqlanib qolgan.

en: They had cattle, sheep, goats and asses, but no horses.
uz: Ularning mollari, qo'ylari, echkilari va eshaklari bor edi, lekin otlari yo'q edi.

en: They fought on foot, in close formation, carrying spears and shields of skin.
uz: Ular piyoda, yaqin tuzilishda, nayzalar va teridan yasalgan qalqonlarni olib yurib jang qilishdi.

en: Their clothing was of wool and they shaved their heads.
uz: Ularning kiyimlari jun edi va ular sochlarini qirqishdi.

en: Each of the Sumerian cities seems generally to have been an independent state with a god of its own and priests of its own.
uz: Shumer shaharlarining har biri odatda o'z xudosi va ruhoniylari bo'lgan mustaqil davlat bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: But sometimes one city
uz: Lekin ba'zan bitta shahar

en: would establish an ascendancy over others and exact tribute from their pop- ulation.
uz: boshqalardan ustunlikni o'rnatadi va ularning xalqidan aniq hurmat ko'rsatadi.

en: A very ancient inscription at Nippur records the “empire,” the ﬁrst recorded empire, of the Sumerian city of Erech.
uz: Nippurdagi juda qadimgi yozuv Shumer shahri Erexning imperiyasi, birinchi qayd etilgan imperiyasini qayd etadi.

en: Its god and its priest-king claimed an authority from the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea.
uz: Uning xudosi va ruhoniy-shohi Fors qo'ltig'idan Qizil dengizgacha bo'lgan hokimiyatga da'vo qilishdi.

en: BRICK OF HAMMURABI, KING OF BABYLON ABOUT 2200 B.C.
uz: HAMMURABI BRICK, BABILON QIROLI, taxminan miloddan avvalgi 2200 yil.

en: Note the cuneiform characters of the inscription, which records the building of a temple to a Sun God At ﬁrst writing was merely an abbreviated method of pictorial record.
uz: Yozuvning ignabargli belgilariga e'tibor bering, unda Quyosh Xudosiga ibodatxona qurilishi qayd etilgan. Dastlab yozish faqat tasvir yozuvining qisqartirilgan usuli edi.

en: Even before Neolithic times men were beginning to write.
uz: Neolit davridan ham oldin odamlar yozishni boshlagan edi.

en: The Azilian rock pictures to which we have already referred show the beginning of the process.
uz: Biz allaqachon havola qilgan aziliyalik tosh rasmlari jarayonning boshlanishini ko'rsatadi.

en: Many of them record hunts and expeditions, and in most of these the human ﬁgures are plainly drawn.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi ov va ekspeditsiyani qayd etadi va ularning aksariyatida inson qiyofalari ochiqchasiga chizilgan.

en: But in some the painter would not bother with head and limbs; he just indicated men by a vertical and one or two transverse strokes.
uz: Lekin ba'zilarida rassom bosh va oyoqlar bilan shug'ullanmasdi; u shunchaki erkaklarni vertikal va bir-ikki ko'ndalang chiziqlar bilan ko'rsatdi.

en: From this to a conventional condensed picture writ- ing was an easy transition.
uz: Bundan an'anaviy condensatsion rasm yozishga o'tish oson edi.

en: In Sumeria, where the writing was done on clay with a stick, the dabs of the characters soon became unrecognizably unlike the things they stood for, but in Egypt where men painted on walls and on
uz: Sumeriyada, yozuvlar tayoq bilan loyga ishlangan joyda, qahramonlarning qo'llari tez orada o'z ifodasiga zid ravishda tanib bo'lmaydigan bo'lib qoldi, Misrda esa odamlar devorlarga va...

en: strips of the papyrus reed (the ﬁrst paper) the likeness to the thing imitated remained.
uz: Papirus qamish (birinchi qog'oz) chiziqlari taqlid qilingan narsaga o'xshashligi qoldi.

en: From the fact that the wooden styles used in Sumeria made wedge-shaped marks, the Sumerian writing is called cuneiform (= wedge- shaped).
uz: Sumeriyada ishlatilgan yog'och uslublar g'altak shaklidagi belgilarni yaratganligi sababli, Sumer yozuvi ignabargli (g'altak shaklidagi) deb ataladi.

en: EBONY CYLINDER SEALS OF FIRST EGYPTIAN DYNASTY  Recovered from the Tombs at Abydos in 1921 by the British School of Archæology.
uz: EBONY CYLINDER ICHINCHI MISR sulolasi muhrlari 1921-yilda Britaniya Arxeologiya maktabi tomonidan Abydosdagi qabrlardan topilgan.

en: They give evi- dence of early form of block printing An important step towards writing was made when pictures were used to indicate not the thing represented but some similar thing.
uz: Ular blok bosib chiqarishning dastlabki shakliga ega. Rasmlar tasvirlangan narsani emas, balki shunga o'xshash narsani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatilganda, yozishga muhim qadam tashlandi.

en: In the rebus dear to children of a suitable age, this is still done to-day.
uz: Qulay yoshdagi bolalarga qadrli bo'lgan rebusda bu hali ham bugungi kunda amalga oshiriladi.

en: We draw a camp with tents and a bell, and the child is delighted to guess that this is the Scotch name Campbell.
uz: Biz chodirlar va qo'ng'iroqli lager chizamiz va bola bu Campbellning shotlandcha ismini taxmin qilishdan xursand bo'ladi.

en: The Sumerian language was a language made up of accu- mulated syllables rather like some contemporary Amerindian languages,
uz: Shumer tili ba'zi zamonaviy Amerindi tillariga o'xshab, akku-mulated bo'g'inlardan tashkil topgan til edi.

en: and it lent itself very readily to this syllabic method of writing words ex- pressing ideas that could not be conveyed by pictures directly.
uz: va u so'zlarni yozishning bu bo'g'in usuliga juda osonlik bilan o'zini bag'ishladi - tasvirlar orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetkazilishi mumkin bo'lmagan g'oyalarni bosuvchi.

en: Egyptian writing underwent parallel developments.
uz: Misr yozuvi parallel rivojlanishlardan o'tdi.

en: Later on, when foreign peoples with less distinctly syllabled methods of speech were to learn and use these picture scripts they were to make those further modiﬁcations and simpliﬁca- tions that developed at last into alphabetical writing.
uz: Keyinroq, nutq usullari kamroq bo'laklangan xorijiy xalqlar ushbu tasvir yozuvlarini o'rganib, ulardan foydalanishi kerak bo'lganda, ular nihoyat alifbo yozuviga aylangan o'sha qo'shimcha o'zgartirishlar va soddalashtirishlarni amalga oshirishlari kerak edi.

en: All the true alphabets of the later world derived from a mixture of the Sumerian cuneiform and the Egyptian hieroglyphic (priest writing).
uz: Keyingi dunyoning barcha haqiqiy alifbolari Shumer kunjut yozuvi va Misr ierogliflari ( ruhoniy yozuvi) aralashmasidan kelib chiqqan.

en: Later in China there was to de- velop a conventionalized picture writing, but in China it never got to the al- phabetical stage.
uz: Keyinroq Xitoyda an'anaviy rasm yozuvini de-velop qilish kerak edi, lekin Xitoyda u hech qachon al-fabetik bosqichga chiqmadi.

en: The invention of writing was of very great importance in the develop- ment of human societies.
uz: Yozuv ixtirosi insoniyat jamiyatlarining rivojlanishida juda katta ahamiyatga ega edi.

en: It put agreements, laws, commandments on record.
uz: U kelishuvlar, qonunlar, amrlarni yozib qoldiradi.

en: It made the growth of states larger than the old city states possible.
uz: Bu eski shahar shtatlaridan kattaroq shtatlarning o'sishini imkon berdi.

en: It made a continuous historical consciousness possible.
uz: Bu uzluksiz tarixiy ongni ta'minlash imkonini berdi.

en: The command of the priest or king and his seal could go far beyond his sight and voice and could survive his death.
uz: Ruhoniy yoki shohning buyrug'i va uning muhri uning ko'zi va ovozidan ancha uzoqqa ketishi va o'limidan omon qolishi mumkin edi.

en: It is interesting to note that in ancient Sumeria seals were greatly used.
uz: Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, qadimgi Sumeriyada muhrlar juda ko'p ishlatilgan.

en: A king or a nobleman or a merchant would have his seal often very artistically carved, and would impress it on any clay document he wished to authorize.
uz: Shoh, zodagon yoki savdogar o'z muhrini ko'pincha juda badiiy tarzda o'yib qo'yardi va u ruxsat bermoqchi bo'lgan har qanday loy hujjatga muhrlardi.

en: So close had civilization got to printing six thou- sand years ago.
uz: Shunday yaqinlashganki, sivilizatsiya olti ming yil oldin chop etishga ulgurgan edi.

en: Then the clay was dried hard and became permanent.
uz: Keyin lo qattiq quritilib, doimiy bo'lib qoldi.

en: For the reader must remember that in the land of Mesopotamia for countless years, letters, records and accounts were all written on comparatively inde- structible tiles.
uz: O'quvchi esda tutishi kerakki, Mesopotamiya zaminida son-sanoqsiz yillar davomida maktublar, yozuvlar va hisoblar nisbatan tuzilmaydigan plitkalarda yozilgan.

en: To that fact we owe a great wealth of recovered knowledge.
uz: Shu faktga biz tiklangan bilimlarning katta boyligi qarzdormiz.

en: THE SAKHARA PYRAMIDS  The Pyramid to the right, the step Pyramid, is the oldest stone building in the world  Photo: F.
uz: SAHARA PYARAMIDLARI O'ng tomondagi piramida, zinapoya piramidi, dunyodagi eng qadimgi tosh binodir. Surat: F.

en: Boyer Bronze, copper, gold, silver and, as a precious rarity, meteoric iron were known in both Sumeria and Egypt at a very early stage.
uz: Boyer bronza, mis, oltin, kumush va qimmatbaho noyob narsa sifatida meteorik temir Shumer va Misrda juda erta bosqichda ma'lum edi.

en: VIEW FROM THE SUMMIT OF THE GREAT PYRAMID OF CHEOPS
uz: Buyuk Choplar Piramidasining Cho'qqisidan Ko'rinish

en: Showing how these great monuments dominate the plain  Photo: D.
uz: Ushbu buyuk yodgorliklar oddiy joyda qanday hukmronligini ko'rsatuvchi Surat: D.

en: THE TEMPLE OF HATHOR AT DENDEREH  Photo: D.
uz: HATHOR DENDEREH MABONASI Foto: D.

en: McLeish Daily life in those ﬁrst city lands of the old world must have been very similar in both Egypt and Sumeria.
uz: McLeish Eski dunyoning o'sha birinchi shahar yerlarida kunlik hayot Misr va Shumeristonda juda o'xshash bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: And except for the asses and cattle in the streets it must have been not unlike the life in the Maya cities of Ameri- ca three or four thousand years later.
uz: Va ko'chalardagi eshaklar va qoramollardan tashqari, Amerikadagi Maya shaharlaridagi hayotdan uch yoki to'rt ming yil o'tgach farq qilmagan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Most of the people in peace time were busy with irrigation and cultivation—except on days of religious festivity.
uz: Tinch davrdagi odamlarning aksariyati diniy bayram kunlaridan tashqari sug'orish va dehqonchilik bilan band edi.

en: They had no money and no need for it.
uz: Ularning puli yo'q edi va bunga hojati ham yo'q edi.

en: They managed their small occasion- al trades by barter.
uz: Ular o'zlarining kichik tadbirlarini barter orqali amalga oshirishdi.

en: The princes and rulers who alone had more than a few possessions used gold and silver bars and precious stones for any incidental act of trade.
uz: Shahzodalar va hukmdorlar, faqat o'zlari bir nechta mol-mulkga ega bo'lganlar, har qanday tasodifiy savdo uchun oltin, kumush tangalar va qimmatbaho toshlardan foydalanishardi.

en: The temple dominated life; in Sumeria it was a great towering temple that went up to a roof from which the stars were observed; in Egypt it was a massive building with only a ground ﬂoor.
uz: Ma'bad hayotda hukmron edi; Sumeriyada u yulduzlarni kuzatadigan tomga ko'tarilgan ulkan baland ibodatxona edi; Misrda u faqat birinchi qavatli ulkan bino edi.

en: In Sumeria the priest ruler was the greatest, most splendid of beings.
uz: Sumeriyada ruhoniy hukmdor eng buyuk, eng ajoyib mavjudot edi.

en: In Egypt however there was one who was raised above the priests; he was the living incarnation of the chief god of the land, the Pharaoh, the god king.
uz: Misrda ruhoniylardan yuqori ko'tarilgan bir kishi bor edi; u yerning bosh xudosi, Fir'avn, xudo-qiroli tirik timsoli edi.

en: There were few changes in the world in those days; men’s days were sun- ny, toilsome and conventional.
uz: O'sha kunlarda dunyoda o'zgarishlar kam edi; odamlarning kunlari quyoshli, mehnatsevar va oddiy edi.

en: Few strangers came into the land and such as did fared uncomfortably.
uz: Yerga kamdan-kam begona odamlar kirdi va ular noqulay ahvolda edilar.

en: The priest directed life according to immemori- al rules and watched the stars for seed time and marked the omens of the sacriﬁces and interpreted the warnings of dreams.
uz: Ruhoniy hayotni xotira qoidalariga muvofiq boshqardi va urug' vaqtini ko'rish uchun yulduzlarni kuzatdi, qurbonliklarning bashoratlarini belgiladi va tushlarning ogohlantirishlarini talqin qildi.

en: Men worked and loved and died, not unhappily, forgetful of the savage past of their race and heed- less of its future.
uz: Erkaklar ishladilar, sevdilar va va vafot etishdi, baxtsiz emas, o'z irqlarining vahshiy o'tmishi va kelajagiga e'tibor bermasdan.

en: Sometimes the ruler was benign.
uz: Ba'zan hukmdor mehribon bo'lardi.

en: Such was Pepi II, who reigned in Egypt for ninety years.
uz: Shunday edi Pepi II, Misrda to'qson yil hukmronlik qilgan.

en: Sometimes he was ambitious and took men’s sons to be soldiers and sent them against neighbouring city states to war and plunder, or he made them toil to build great buildings.
uz: Ba'zan u ambitsiyali edi va odamlarning o'g'illarini askar qilib olib, ularni qo'shni shahar davlatlariga urush va talon-toroj qilishga yuborardi, yoki ularni katta binolar qurishga majbur qilardi.

en: Such were Cheops and Chephren and Mycerinus, who built those vast sepulchral piles, the pyramids at Gizeh.
uz: Shundaylar Cheops, Chephren va Mycerinus edi, ular Gizehdagi piramidalar bo'lgan ulkan qabr ustunlarini qurdilar.

en: The largest of these is 450 feet high and the weight of stone in it is 4,883,000 tons.
uz: Ularning eng kattasi 450 fut balandlikda va undagi toshning og'irligi 4,883,000 tonnani tashkil etadi.

en: All this was brought down the Nile in boats and lugged into place chieﬂy by human muscle.
uz: Bularning barchasi Naylidan qayiqlarda olib tushirilgan va asosan inson mushaklari yordamida joylashtirilgan.

en: Its erection must have ex- hausted Egypt more than a great war would have done.
uz: Uning qurilishi Misrni buyuk urush qilganidan ko'ra ko'proq qiynagan bo'lishi kerak.

en: XVI PRIMITIVE NOMADIC PEOPLES It was not only in Mesopotamia and the Nile Valley that men were settling down to agriculture and the formation of city states in the centuries between 6000 and 8000 B.C.
uz: XVI BIRINCHI NOMAD XALQLARI Nafaqat Mesopotamiya va Nil vodiysida odamlar miloddan avvalgi 6000 va 8000 yillar oralig'ida qishloq xo'jaligi va shahar davlatlari shakllanishiga joylashdilar.

en: Wherever there were possibilities of irrigation and a steady all-the-year-round food supply men were exchanging the uncertain- ties and hardships of hunting and wandering for the routines of settlement.
uz: Sug'orish imkoniyati va yil davomida barqaror oziq-ovqat ta'minoti mavjud bo'lgan har qanday joyda odamlar ov va sayohatning noaniq bog'lari va qiyinchiliklarini aholi yashash tartiblari uchun almashishardi.

en: On the upper Tigris a people called the Assyrians were founding cities; in the valleys of Asia Minor and on the Mediterranean shores and islands, there were small communities growing up to civilization.
uz: Yuqori Tigrisda ossuriyaliklar deb ataladigan xalq shaharlar qurayotgan edi; Kichik Osiyo vodiylarida va O'rta yer dengizi qirg'oqlari va orollarida kichik jamoalar sivilizatsiyaga erishayotgan edi.

en: Possibly parallel developments of human life were already going on in favourable regions of India, and China.
uz: Ehtimol, inson hayotining parallel rivojlanishi Hindiston va Xitoyning qulay hududlarida allaqachon davom etayotgandir.

en: In many parts of Europe where there were lakes well stocked with ﬁsh, little communities of men had long settled in dwellings built on piles over the water, and were eking out agriculture by ﬁshing and hunting.
uz: Yevropaning ko'p qismlarida, baliq bilan to'la ko'llar bo'lgan joylarda, odamlar kichik jamoalari allaqachon suv ustidagi uylarga qurilgan va baliq ovlash va ov qilish orqali qishloq xo'jaligini ta'minlayotgan edi.

en: But over much larger areas of the old world no such settlement was possible.
uz: Lekin eski dunyoning ancha katta hududlarida bunday aholi punktlari mavjud emas edi.

en: The land was too harsh, too thickly wooded or too arid, or the sea- sons too uncertain for mankind, with only the implements and science of that age to take root.
uz: Yer juda qo'pol, juda qalin o'rmonli yoki juda quruq edi, yoki dengiz o'g'illari insoniyat uchun juda noaniq edi, faqat o'sha davrning asbob-uskunalari va ilmi ildiz otishi kerak edi.

en: For settlement under the conditions of the primitive civilizations men needed a constant water supply and warmth and sunshine.
uz: Ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalar sharoitida aholi yashash uchun odamlarga doimiy suv ta'minoti, iliqlik va quyosh nuri kerak edi.

en: Where these needs were not satisﬁed, man could live as a transient, as a hunter following his game, as a herdsman following the seasonal grass, but he could not set- tle.
uz: Bu ehtiyojlar qondirilmagan joylarda inson o'tkinchi, o'z o'yinini kuzatuvchi ovchi, mavsumiy o'tlarni kuzatuvchi cho'pon kabi yashashi mumkin edi, lekin u o'rnata olmasdi.

en: The transition from the hunting to the herding life may have been very gradual.
uz: Ovchilikdan chorvachilik hayotiga o'tish juda asta-sekin bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: From following herds of wild cattle or (in Asia) wild horses, men may have come to an idea of property in them, have learnt to pen them into valleys, have fought for them against wolves, wild dogs and other predatory beasts.
uz: Yovvoyi chorva mollari yoki (Osiyoda) yovvoyi otlarni kuzatib borishdan so'ng, odamlar ularda mulk haqida tasavvurga ega bo'lishgan, ularni vodiylarga joylashtirishni o'rgangan, ular uchun bo'rilar, yovvoyi itlar va boshqa yirtqich hayvonlarga qarshi kurashgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: POTTERY AND IMPLEMENTS OF THE LAKE DWELLERS  Brit.
uz: POTERY AND IMPLEMENTS OF THE LAKE DWELLERS Brit.

en: A CONTEMPORARY LAKE VILLAGE  These Borneo dwellings are practically counterparts of the homes of European neolithic communities 6000 B.C.
uz: Zamonaviy ko'l qishlog'i Borneodagi bu turar joylar miloddan avvalgi 6000-yilda Yevropa neolitik jamiyatlarining uylariga amalda o'xshashdir.

en: So while the primitive civilizations of the cultivators were growing up chieﬂy in the great river valleys, a different way of living, the nomadic life, a life in constant movement to and fro from winter pasture to summer pas- ture, was also growing up.
uz: Shunday qilib, kultivatorlarning ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalari asosan ulkan daryo vodiylarida o'sib kelayotgan bir paytda, boshqa turmush tarzi, ko'chmanchi hayot, qishki yaylovdan yozgi pas-turgacha doimiy ravishda harakatlanuvchi hayot ham o'sib kelayotgan edi.

en: The nomadic peoples were on the whole hardier than the agriculturalists; they were less proliﬁc and numerous, they had no permanent temples and no highly organized priesthood; they had less gear; but the reader must not suppose that theirs was necessarily a less highly de- veloped way of living on that account.
uz: Ko'chmanchi xalqlar dehqonlardan ko'ra butunlay qattiqqo'l edilar; ular unumdor va ko'p sonli emas edilar, ularning doimiy ibodatxonalari ham, yuqori darajada tashkil etilgan ruhoniylari ham yo'q edi; ularning jihozlari kamroq edi; lekin o'quvchi ularning hayot tarzi shu sababli unchalik rivojlanmagan deb o'ylamasligi kerak.

en: In many ways this free life was a fuller life than that of the tillers of the soil.
uz: Ko'p jihatdan bu erkin hayot tuproq teruvchilarining hayotidan ko'ra to'liqroq hayot edi.

en: The individual was more self- reliant; less of a unit in a crowd.
uz: Shaxs ko'proq o'ziga tayanardi; olomon ichida bir birlikdan kamroq edi.

en: The leader was more important; the medi- cine man perhaps less so.
uz: Rahbar muhimroq edi; medi-kino odami, ehtimol, undan ham kamroq.

en: NOMADS IN EGYPT  Egyptian wall painting in a tomb near ancient Beni Hassan, middle Egypt.
uz: Misrda nomadlar Misr devor rasmi qadimgi Beni Hassan yaqinidagi qabrda, o'rta Misr.

en: It depicts the arrival of a tribe of Semitic Nomads in Egypt about the year of 1895 B.C.
uz: Unda Misrga semit ko'chmanchi qabilasi taxminan miloddan avvalgi 1895 yilda kelganligi tasvirlangan.

en: Moving over large stretches of country the nomad took a wider view of life.
uz: Ko'chmanchi katta hududlar bo'ylab harakatlanib, hayotga kengroq qaradi.

en: He touched on the conﬁnes of this settled land and that.
uz: U bu o'rnashib qolgan yerning chegaralariga tegdi va shunga.

en: He was used to the sight of strange faces.
uz: U g'alati yuzlarni ko'rishga odatlangan edi.

en: He had to scheme and treat for pasture with com- peting tribes.
uz: U g'alaba qozongan qabilalar bilan o'tloq tuzishi va muomala qilishi kerak edi.

en: He knew more of minerals than the folk upon the plough lands because he went over mountain passes and into rocky places.
uz: U minerallar haqida plug yerlaridagi odamlardan ko'ra ko'proq bilardi, chunki u tog' o'tish joylaridan o'tib, toshli joylarga kirardi.

en: He may have been a better metallurgist.
uz: U yaxshiroq metallurg bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Possibly bronze and much more probably iron smelting were nomadic discoveries.
uz: Ehtimol, bronza va undan ham ko'proq temir erishi ko'chmanchi kashfiyotlar edi.

en: Some of the earliest implements of iron reduced from its ores have been found in Central Europe far away from the early civilizations.
uz: Temirning rudasidan yasalgan eng qadimgi asboblarining ba'zilari Markaziy Yevropada, erta sivilizatsiyalardan ancha uzoqda topilgan.

en: FLINT KNIVES OF 4500 B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 4500 yildagi FLINT KNIVES.

en: Excavated 1922 by the British School of Archæology in Egypt from First Dynasty Tombs On the other hand the settled folk had their textiles and their pottery and made many desirable things.
uz: 1922-yilda Misrdagi Britaniya Arxeologiya maktabi tomonidan Birinchi sulola qabrlaridan qazilgan. Boshqa tomondan, o'rnashgan xalq o'z to'qimachilik va kulolchiliklariga ega edi va ko'plab istalgan narsalarni yasadi.

en: It was inevitable that as the two sorts of life, the agricultural and the nomadic differentiated, a certain amount of looting and trading should develop between the two.
uz: Ikki turdagi hayot, qishloq xo'jaligi va ko'chmanchilar farqlanishi bilan, ularning o'rtasida ma'lum miqdorda talonchilik va savdo rivojlanishi muqarrar edi.

en: In Sumeria particularly which had deserts and seasonal country on either hand it must have been usual to have the nomads camping close to the cultivated ﬁelds, trading and stealing and perhaps tinkering, as gipsies do to this day.
uz: Sumeriyada, ayniqsa, ikki tomonda cho'llar va mavsumiy mamlakatlar bo'lganida, ko'chmanchilarning dehqonchilik dalalariga yaqin joylashgan, savdo va o'g'irlik qilish, ehtimol, tuzatish odatiy hol bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak, xuddi bugun ham gitarlar kabi.

en: (But hens they would not steal, because the domestic fowl—an Indian jungle fowl originally was not domesticated by man until about 1000 B.C.) They would bring precious stones and things of metal and leather.
uz: Lekin tovuqlar o'g'irlanmasdi, chunki mahalliy parranda  Hindiston o'rmon parisi dastlab miloddan avvalgi 1000 yilgacha odam tomonidan uylashtirilgan emas edi. Ular qimmatbaho toshlar, metall va charm buyumlarni olib kelishardi.

en: If they were hunters they would bring skins.
uz: Agar ular ovchi bo'lishganida, terilar olib kelishardi.

en: They would get in exchange pottery and beads and glass, gar- ments and suchlike manufactured things.
uz: Ular kulolchilik va munchoqlar, shisha, kiyim-kechak va shunga o'xshash ishlab chiqarilgan narsalarni almashtirib olishardi.

en: EGYPT PEASANTS GOING TO WORK  From an ancient and curiously painted model in the British Museum Three main regions and three main kinds of wandering and imperfectly settled people there were in those remote days of the ﬁrst civilizations in Sumeria and early Egypt.
uz: Misrlik bemorlar ishlashga ketmoqda. Britaniya muzeyidagi qadimiy va qiziqarli rasmdagi modeldan. Uchta asosiy hudud va uchta asosiy turdagi sayohatchi va nomukammal o'rnashgan odamlar Shumer va Misrning dastlabki birinchi tsivilizatsiyalarining olis kunlarida mavjud edi.

en: Away in the forests of Europe were the blonde Nordic peoples, hunters and herdsmen, a lowly race.
uz: Yevropaning o'rmonlarida sarg'ish shimoliy xalqlar, ovchilar va qo'ychilar, past irq bor edi.

en: The primitive civiliza- tions saw very little of this race before 1500 B.C.
uz: Ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalar miloddan avvalgi 1500-yilgacha bu poyga haqida juda kam ko'rishgan.

en: Away on the steppes of eastern Asia various Mongolian tribes, the Hunnish peoples, were domesti- cating the horse and developing a very wide sweeping habit of seasonal movement between their summer and winter camping places.
uz: Sharqiy Osiyoning dashtlarida turli xil moʻgʻul qabilalari, Hun xalqlari otni boqish va yozgi va qishki lager joylari oʻrtasida mavsumiy harakatlanishning juda keng koʻlamli odatini rivojlantirgan.

en: Possibly the Nordic and Hunnish peoples were still separated from one another by the swamps of Russia and the greater Caspian Sea of that time.
uz: Ehtimol, Skandinaviya va Gunn xalqlari o'sha davrdagi Rossiya botqoqliklari va Katta Kaspiy dengizi bilan hali ham bir-biridan ajralib turgandir.

en: For very much of Russia there was swamp and lake.
uz: Rossiyaning katta qismi botqoqlik va ko'l bo'lgan.

en: In the deserts, which were growing more arid now, of Syria and Arabia, tribes of a dark white or brownish peo- ple, the Semitic tribes, were driving ﬂocks of sheep and goats and asses from pasture to pasture.
uz: Suriyo va Arabistonning hozir quruqroq bo'lib borayotgan cho'llarida, qora oq yoki jigarrang pono-ple qabilalari, semit qabilalari qo'y, echki va eshaklar suruvini yaylovdan yaylovga haydab o'tishardi.

en: It was these Semitic shepherds and certain more negroid people from southern Persia, the Elamites, who were the ﬁrst no- mads to come into close contact with the early civilizations.
uz: Aynan shu semit cho'ponlari va Janubiy Forsdan kelgan ba'zi bir ko'proq qora tanli odamlar, Elamliklar, erta sivilizatsiyalar bilan yaqin aloqada bo'lgan birinchi aqldan ozgan odamlar edi.

en: They came as traders and as raiders.
uz: Ular savdogarlar va talonchilar sifatida kelishdi.

en: Finally there arose leaders among them with bolder imaginations, and they became conquerors.
uz: Nihoyat, ularning orasida jasurroq tasavvurga ega bo'lgan yetakchilar paydo bo'ldi va ular zabtchilarga aylandilar.

en: STELE GLORIFYING KING NARAM SIN, OF AKKAD  This monarch, son of Sargon I, was a great architecht as well as a famous conqueror.
uz: AKKAD QIROLI NARAM SINNING ISTIYOTLARI. Sargon I ning o'g'li bo'lgan bu monarx buyuk me'mor, shuningdek, mashhur bosqinchi edi.

en: Discovered in 1898 among the ruins of Susa, Persia
uz: 1898-yilda Susa, Fors xarobalari orasida topilgan.

en: a great Semitic leader, Sargon, had conquered the whole Sumerian land and was master of all the world from the Persian Gulf to the Mediterranean Sea.
uz: Buyuk semitlar yetakchisi Sargon butun Shumer yerlarini zabt etgan va Fors qo'ltig'idan O'rta yer dengizigacha bo'lgan butun dunyoning xo'jayini edi.

en: He was an illiterate barbarian and his people, the Akka- dians, learnt the Sumerian writing and adopted the Sumerian language as the speech of the ofﬁcials and the learned.
uz: U savodsiz varvar edi va uning xalqi, Akka-dians, shumer yozuvini o'rganib, shumer tilini amaldorlar va olimlarning nutqi sifatida qabul qildi.

en: The empire he founded decayed after two centuries, and after one inundation of Elamites a fresh Semitic people, the Amorites, by degrees established their rule over Sumeria.
uz: U asos solgan imperiya ikki asrdan so'ng parchalanib ketdi va Elamliklarning bir bosqinidan so'ng yangi semit xalqi, amorliklar, asta-sekin Shumer ustidan o'z hukmronligini o'rnatdi.

en: They made their capital in what had hitherto been a small up-river town, Baby- lon, and their empire is called the ﬁrst Babylonian Empire.
uz: Ular o'z poytaxtlarini shu paytgacha daryo bo'yidagi kichik shaharcha Baby-londa qurishgan va ularning imperiyasi birinchi Bobil imperiyasi deb ataladi.

en: It was consoli- dated by a great king called Hammurabi (circa 2100 B.C.) who made the ear- liest code of laws yet known to history.
uz: U Hammurabi deb nomlangan buyuk shoh tomonidan taxminan miloddan avvalgi 2100 yillarda tarixga ma'lum bo'lgan eng qisqa qonunlar kodeksini yaratgan.

en: The narrow valley of the Nile lies less open to nomadic invasion than Mesopotamia, but about the time of Hammurabi occurred a successful Sem- itic invasion of Egypt and a line of Pharaohs was set up, the Hyksos or “shepherd kings,” which lasted for several centuries.
uz: Nilning tor vodiysi Mesopotamiyadan ko'ra ko'chmanchi bosqinlarga kamroq ochiq, ammo Hammurabi davrida Misrga muvaffaqiyatli Sem-it bosqini sodir bo'ldi va bir necha asr davom etgan fir'avnlar, Xiksoslar yoki cho'pon shohlari liniyasi tashkil etildi.

en: These Semitic con- querors never assimilated themselves with the Egyptians; they were always regarded with hostility as foreigners and barbarians; and they were at last expelled by a popular uprising about 1600 B.C.
uz: Bu semit qo'zg'atuvchilari hech qachon misrliklar bilan bir xillashmagan; ular doimo begona va vahshiylar sifatida dushmanlik bilan qaralgan; va ular oxir-oqibat miloddan avvalgi 1600 yil atrofida bo'lib o'tgan xalq qo'zg'oloni natijasida quvib chiqarilgan.

en: But the Semites had come into Sumeria for good and all, the two races assimilated and the Babylonian Empire became Semitic in its language and character.
uz: Ammo semitlar Shumeristonga butunlay kelishdi, ikki irq birlashib ketdi va Bobil imperiyasi o'z tili va xarakterida semit bo'lib qoldi.

en: XVII THE FIRST SEAGOING PEOPLES The earliest boats and ships must have come into use some twenty-ﬁve or thirty thousand years ago.
uz: XVII BIRINCHI DENGIZCHI XALQLAR Eng qadimgi qayiqlar va kemalar taxminan yigirma besh yoki o'ttiz ming yil oldin foydalanishga kirgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Man was probably paddling about on the water with a log of wood or an inﬂated skin to assist him, at latest in the begin- nings of the Neolithic period.
uz: Odam, ehtimol, Neolit davri boshlarida, suvda yog'och g'o'la yoki shishirilgan teri bilan sayohat qilib, unga yordam bergan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: A basketwork boat covered with skin and caulked was used in Egypt and Sumeria from the beginnings of our knowl- edge.
uz: Misr va Shumerda terisi va kalkani qoplagan savatli qayiq bizning bilimlarimizning boshidanoq ishlatilgan.

en: Such boats are still used there.
uz: Bunday qayiqlar u yerda hanuzgacha ishlatiladi.

en: They are used to this day in Ireland and Wales and in Alaska; sealskin boats still make the crossing of Behring Straits.
uz: Ular bugungi kungacha Irlandiya va Uelsda va Alyaskada ishlatiladi; dengiz terisidan yasalgan qayiqlar hali ham Behring bo'g'ozlarini kesib o'tadi.

en: The hollow log followed as tools improved.
uz: Teshik yog'och asboblar yaxshilanishi bilan davom etdi.

en: The building of boats and then ships came in a natural succession.
uz: Qayiqlar va keyin kemalar qurilishi tabiiy ketma-ketlik bilan sodir bo'ldi.

en: Perhaps the legend of Noah’s Ark preserves the memory of some early exploit in shipbuilding, just as the story of the Flood, so widely distributed among the peoples of the world, may be the tradition of the ﬂooding of the Mediterranean basin.
uz: Ehtimol, Nuh kemasi afsonasi kemasozlikdagi dastlabki yutuqlarning xotirasini saqlab qoladi, xuddi dunyo xalqlari orasida keng tarqalgan To'fon hikoyasi O'rta yer dengizi havzasining suv toshqini an'anasi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: There were ships upon the Red Sea long before the pyramids were built, and there were ships on the Mediterranean and Persian Gulf by 7000 B.C.
uz: Qizil dengizda piramidalar qurilishidan ancha oldin kemalar bor edi, va miloddan avvalgi 7000 yilga kelib O'rta yer dengizi va Fors ko'rfazida kemalar bor edi.

en: Mostly these were the ships of ﬁshermen, but some were already trading and pirate ships—for knowing what we do of mankind we may guess pretty safely that the ﬁrst sailors plundered where they could and traded where they had to do so.
uz: Ko'pincha bular baliqchilar kemalari edi, lekin ba'zilari allaqachon savdo va qaroqchi kemalar edi  chunki insoniyat bilan nima qilishimizni bilganimiz uchun, birinchi dengizchilar imkon qadar talon-toroj qilishgan va kerak bo'lgan joyda savdo qilishgan deb taxmin qilishimiz mumkin.

en: The seas on which these ﬁrst ships adventured were inland seas on which the wind blew ﬁtfully and which were often at a dead calm for days togeth- er, so that sailing did not develop beyond an accessory use.
uz: Bu birinchi kemalar sarguzashtga uchragan dengizlar ichki dengizlar edi, unda shamol o'z o'rnida esardi va ular ko'pincha bir necha kun davomida o'lik sokinlikda edi, shuning uchun suzish aksessuarlardan tashqari rivojlanmas edi.

en: It is only in the last four hundred years that the well-rigged, ocean-going, sailing ship has developed.
uz: Faqatgina so'nggi to'rt yuz yil ichida yaxshi yo'naltirilgan, okeanga yo'naltirilgan, yelkanli kema rivojlandi.

en: The ships of the ancient world were essentially rowing ships
uz: Qadimgi dunyoning kemalari asosan eshkak eshituvchi kemalar edi.

en: which hugged the shore and went into harbour at the ﬁrst sign of rough weather.
uz: Qirg'oqni quchoqlab, og'ir ob-havoning birinchi belgisi bilan portga kirdi.

en: As ships grew into big galleys they caused a demand for war cap- tives as galley slaves.
uz: Kemalar katta galereyalarga aylangani sari, ular galereya qullari kabi urush kepkalariga talab uyg'otdi.

en: We have already noted the appearance of the Semitic people as wander- ers and nomads in the region of Syria and Arabia, and how they conquered Sumeria and set up ﬁrst the Akkadian and then the ﬁrst Babylonian Empire.
uz: Biz allaqachon Semit xalqining Suriya va Arabiston mintaqasida ko'chmanchilar va muhojirlar sifatida paydo bo'lganini, shuningdek, ular Shumeryani qanday zabt etganini va avval Akkadlar, keyin esa birinchi Bobil imperiyasini qanday tashkil etganini qayd etganmiz.

en: In the west these same Semitic peoples were taking to the sea.
uz: G'arbda xuddi shu semit xalqlari dengizga o'tib ketayotgan edi.

en: They set up a string of harbour towns along the Eastern coast of the Mediterranean, of which Tyre and Sidon were the chief; and by the time of Hammurabi in Babylon, they had spread as traders, wanderers and colonizers over the whole Mediterranean basin.
uz: Ular O'rta yer dengizining sharqiy sohili bo'ylab port shaharlari qatorini tashkil etishdi, ularning boshliqlari Tir va Sidon edi; va Bobildagi Hammurabi davrida ular butun O'rta yer dengizi havzasi bo'ylab savdogarlar, g'ariblar va mustamlakachilar sifatida tarqalgan edi.

en: These sea Semites were called the Phœnicians, They settled largely in Spain, pushing back the old Iberian Basque popula- tion and sending coasting expeditions through the straits of Gibraltar; and they set up colonies upon the north coast of Africa.
uz: Bu dengiz semitlari Fenitslar deb atalgan. Ular asosan Ispaniyada joylashdilar, eski Iberiya bask aholisini orqaga itarib, Gibraltar bo'g'ozlari orqali qirg'oqchilik ekspeditsiyalarini jo'natdilar; va ular Afrikaning shimoliy sohilida mustamlakalar o'rnatdilar.

en: Of Carthage, one of these Phœnician cities, we shall have much more to tell later.
uz: Karthag' haqida, bu Finikiya shaharlaridan biri haqida, keyinroq aytadigan ko'p narsalarimiz bor.

en: But the Phœnicians were not the ﬁrst people to have galleys in the Mediterranean waters.
uz: Lekin Finikiylar O'rta yer dengizi suvlarida galereyalari bo'lgan birinchi odamlar emas edi.

en: There was already a series of towns and cities among the islands and coasts of that sea belonging to a race or races apparently connected by blood and language with the Basques to the west and the Berbers and Egyptians to the south, the Ægean peoples.
uz: O'sha dengiz orollari va qirg'oqlari orasida g'arbda basklar, janubda esa berberlar va misrliklar, egyo xalqlari bilan qon va til bilan bog'langan deb taxmin qilinadigan irq yoki irqlarga tegishli bir qator shaharlar va shaharlar allaqachon mavjud edi.

en: These peoples must not be confused with the Greeks, who come much later into our story; they were pre-Greek, but they had cities in Greece and Asia Minor; Mycenæ and Troy for example, and they had a great and prosperous establishment at Cnossos in Crete.
uz: Bu xalqlarni bizning hikoyamizga ancha keyinroq kelgan yunonlar bilan adashtirmaslik kerak; ular yunonlardan oldingi davr edi, lekin ularning Gretsiya va Kichik Osiyoda shaharlari bor edi; Misenæ va Troyada, masalan, va ular Kritdagi Knososda buyuk va farovon maskanlarga ega edilar.

en: It is only in the last half century that the industry of excavating archæolo- gists has brought the extent and civilization of the Ægean peoples to our knowledge.
uz: Faqatgina so'nggi yarim asrda arxeologik qazish sanoati Aegean xalqlarining ko'lami va tsivilizatsiyasini bizning bilimlarimizga olib keldi.

en: Cnossos has been most thoroughly explored; it was happily not succeeded by any city big enough to destroy its ruins, and so it is our chief source of information about this once almost forgotten civilization.
uz: Knossos eng chuqur o'rganilgan; baxtga ko'ra, uning xarobalarini yo'q qilishga yetarlicha katta bo'lgan hech bir shahar unga erisha olmadi va shuning uchun u bir vaqtlar deyarli unutilgan bu tsivilizatsiya haqida asosiy ma'lumotlar manbamizdir.

en: The history of Cnossos goes back as far as the history of Egypt; the two countries were trading actively across the sea by 4000 B.C.
uz: Knossos tarixi Misr tarixiga borib taqaladi; ikki davlat miloddan avvalgi 4000 yilga kelib dengiz orqali faol savdo qilishgan.

en: By 2500 B.C., that is between the time of Sargon I and Hammurabi, Cretan civilization was at its zenith.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 2500 yilga kelib, ya'ni Sargon I va Hammurabi davrlari oralig'ida, Krit sivilizatsiyasi o'zining eng yuqori cho'qqisida edi.

en: Cnossos was not so much a town as a great palace for the Cretan monarch and his people.
uz: Knossos Krit monarxi va uning xalqi uchun unchalik shahar emas, balki buyuk saroy edi.

en: It was not even fortiﬁed.
uz: U hatto mustahkamlanmagan ham edi.

en: It was only fortiﬁed later
uz: U faqat keyinroq mustahkamlandi.

en: as the Phœnicians grew strong, and as a new and more terrible breed of pi- rates, the Greeks, came upon the sea from the north.
uz: Finikiylar kuchayib, yangi va dahshatliroq pi- stavkalar zoti sifatida shimoldan yunonlar dengizga kelishdi.

en: THE TREASURE HOUSE AT MYCENÆ  Photo: Fred Boissonnas The monarch was called Minos, as the Egyptian monarch was called Pharaoh; and he kept his state in a palace ﬁtted with running water, with
uz: MYCENÆDAGI Xazina Uyi Surat: Fred Boissonas Monarx Misr monarxi Fir'avn deb atalganidek, Minos deb atalgan; va u o'z davlatini oqim suv bilan jihozlangan saroyda saqlagan,

en: bathrooms and the like conveniences such as we know of in no other an- cient remains.
uz: hammomlar va biz bilgan boshqa hech qanday an-cient qoldiqlari kabi qulayliklar.

en: There he held great festivals and shows.
uz: U yerda u buyuk festivallar va shoular o'tkazdi.

en: There was bull- ﬁghting, singularly like the bull-ﬁghting that still survives in Spain; there was resemblance even in the costumes of the bull-ﬁghters; and there were gymnastic displays.
uz: Buqa janglari bor edi, xuddi Ispaniyada hanuzgacha saqlanib qolgan buqa janglariga o'xshab; buqa jangchilarining liboslarida ham o'xshashlik bor edi; va gimnastika namoyishlari ham bor edi.

en: The women’s clothes were remarkably modern in spir- it; they wore corsets and ﬂounced dresses.
uz: Ayollarning kiyimlari juda zamonaviy edi; ular korsetlar va gullab-yashnayotgan ko'ylaklar kiyishardi.

en: The pottery, the textile manufac- tures, the sculpture, painting, jewellery, ivory, metal and inlay work of these Cretans was often astonishingly beautiful.
uz: Bu Kritliklarning kulolchilik, to'qimachilik buyumlari, haykaltaroshligi, rassomligi, zargarlik buyumlari, fil suyagi, metall va ichki ishlar ko'pincha hayratlanarli darajada go'zal edi.

en: And they had a system of writ- ing, but that still remains to be deciphered.
uz: Va ularda yozish tizimi bor edi, lekin uni hali ham yechish kerak.

en: This happy and sunny and civilized life lasted for some score of cen- turies.
uz: Bu baxtli, quyoshli va madaniy hayot bir necha asrlar davom etdi.

en: Cnossos and Babylon abounded in comfortable and cultivated people who probably led very pleasant lives.
uz: Knossos va Bobil qulay va madaniyatli odamlar bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lib, ular, ehtimol, juda yoqimli hayot kechirgan.

en: They had shows and they had religious festivals, they had domestic slaves to look after them and industrial slaves to make a proﬁt for them.
uz: Ularning shoulari bor edi va diniy bayramlari bor edi, ularga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan uy qullari va foyda olish uchun sanoat qullari bor edi.

en: Life must have seemed very se- cure in Cnossos for such people, sunlit and girdled by the blue sea.
uz: Knossosda hayot quyosh nurida va ko'k dengiz bilan o'ralgan bunday odamlar uchun juda o'zgacha tuyulgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Egypt of course must have appeared rather a declining country in those days under the rule of her half-barbaric shepherd kings, and if one took an interest in politics one must have noticed how the Semitic people seemed to be getting everywhere, ruling Egypt, ruling distant Babylon, building Nineveh on the upper Tigris, sailing west to the Pillars of Hercules (the straits of Gibraltar) and setting up their colonies on those distant coasts.
uz: Misr, albatta, o'sha davrlarda yarim vahshiy cho'pon shohlari hukmronligi ostida ancha pasayib borayotgan davlat bo'lib ko'ringan bo'lishi kerak edi. Agar siyosatga qiziqish uyg'ongan bo'lsa, semit xalqi Misrni hukmronlik qilib, uzoq Bobilni hukmronlik qilib, yuqori Tigrisda Ninevani qurib, G'arbda Gerakl ustunlariga (Gibraltar bo'g'ozlari) suzib, o'sha uzoq qirg'oqlarda o'z mustamlakalarini o'rnatayotgandek tuyulganini payqagan bo'lish kerak edi.

en: There were some active arid curious minds in Cnossos, because later on the Greeks told legends of a certain skilful Cretan artiﬁcer, Dædalus, who attempted to make some sort of ﬂying machine, perhaps a glider, which col- lapsed and fell into the sea.
uz: Knossosda ba'zi faol quruq qiziquvchan onglar bor edi, chunki keyinroq yunonlar ma'lum bir mohir Krit artifikeri Dædalus haqida afsonalar tarqatishgan edi. U qandaydir uchish mashinasini, ehtimol, uchuvchi samolyotni yasashga uringan edi, u yiqilib tushdi va dengizga quladi.

en: It is interesting to note some of the differences as well as the resem- blances between the life of Cnossos and our own.
uz: Knossos hayoti va o'z hayotimiz o'rtasidagi ba'zi farqlar, shuningdek, o'zaro farqlarni qayd etish qiziqarli.

en: To a Cretan gentleman of 2500 B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 2500-yildagi Krit janoblariga.

en: iron was a rare metal which fell out of the sky and was curious rather than useful—for as yet only meteoric iron was known, iron had not been obtained from its ores.
uz: Temir osmondan tushgan noyob metall edi va foydali emas, balki qiziqarli edi  chunki hali faqat meteorik temir ma'lum edi, uning rudalaridan temir olinmagan edi.

en: Compare that with our modern state of affairs pervaded by iron everywhere.
uz: Buni hamma joyda temir bilan to'lib-toshgan zamonaviy ahvolimiz bilan solishtiring.

en: The horse again would be a quite legendary creature to our Cretan, a sort of super-ass which lived in the bleak northern lands far away beyond the Black Sea.
uz: Ot yana bizning Krit xalqi uchun ancha afsonaviy mavjudot bo'lardi, Qora dengizdan tashqaridagi xira shimoliy yerlarda yashagan super-eshak turidir.

en: Civilization for him dwelt chieﬂy in Ægean Greece and Asia Minor, where Lydians and Carians and Trojans lived a life and probably spoke languages like his own.
uz: U uchun tsivilizatsiya asosan Agey Yunonistonida va Kichik Osiyoda yashardi, u yerda Lidiylar, Kariylar va Troyanlar hayot kechirgan va ehtimol o'z tillarida gapirgan.

en: There were Phœni- cians and Ægeans settled in Spain and North Africa, but those were very
uz: Ispaniya va Shimoliy Afrikada Fin va Egenlar joylashgan edi, lekin ular juda...

en: remote regions to his imagination.
uz: Uzoq hududlar uning xayoliga.

en: Italy was still a desolate land covered with dense forests; the brown-skinned Etruscans had not yet gone there from Asia Minor.
uz: Italiya hali ham zich o'rmonlar bilan qoplangan cho'l zamin edi; jigarrang tanli etrusklar hali Kichik Osiyodan u yerga bormagan edi.

en: And one day perhaps this Cretan gentleman went down to the harbour and saw a captive who attracted his attention because he was very fair-complexioned and had blue eyes.
uz: Va bir kuni, ehtimol, bu Krit janob portiga tushdi va uning e'tiborini tortgan bir asirni ko'rdi, chunki u juda chiroyli va ko'k ko'zlarga ega edi.

en: Perhaps our Cretan tried to talk to him and was answered in an unintelligible gibberish.
uz: Ehtimol, bizning kreysimiz u bilan gaplashmoqchi bo'lgandir va tushunarsiz g'alati javob qaytarilgandir.

en: This creature came from somewhere beyond the Black Sea and seemed to be an altogether be- nighted savage.
uz: Bu maxluq Qora dengizdan narigi tomondan kelgan va umuman yovvoyi yovvoyi odamga o'xshardi.

en: But indeed he was an Aryan tribesman, of a race and cul- ture of which we shall soon have much to tell, and the strange gibberish he spoke was to differentiate some day into Sanskrit, Persian, Greek, Latin, German, English and most of the chief languages of the world.
uz: Lekin haqiqatan ham u ariy qabilasi a'zosi edi, uning irqi va madaniyati haqida tez orada ko'p gapirishimiz mumkin bo'ladi va u aytgan g'alati bema'ni gaplar bir kun kelib sanskrit, fors, yunon, lotin, nemis, ingliz va dunyoning asosiy tillarining aksariyatini farqlash edi.

en: THE PALACE AT CNOSSOS  The painted walls of the Throne Room  Photo: Fred Boissonnas Such was Cnossos at its zenith, intelligent, enterprising, bright and hap- py.
uz: CNOSOSDAGI SHAHR Taxt Xonasining bo'yalgan devorlari Surat: Fred Boissonnas. Knosos o'zining eng yuqori cho'qqisida, aqlli, tashabbuskor, yorqin va baxtli edi.

en: disaster came perhaps very suddenly upon its pros- perity.
uz: Falokat, ehtimol, o'zining farovonligi bilan juda to'satdan keldi.

en: The palace of Minos was destroyed, and its ruins have never been
uz: Minos saroyi vayron bo'ldi va uning xarobalari hech qachon...

en: rebuilt or inhabited from that day to this.
uz: o'sha kundan bu kungacha qayta qurilgan yoki yashalgan.

en: We do not know how this disaster occurred.
uz: Biz bu falokat qanday sodir bo'lganini bilmaymiz.

en: The excavators note what appears to be scattered plunder and the marks of the ﬁre.
uz: Ekskavatorlar tarqalgan talon-taroj va yong'in izlarini qayd etadi.

en: But the traces of a very destructive earthquake have also been found.
uz: Lekin juda vayronkor zilzila izlari ham topilgan.

en: Nature alone may have destroyed Cnossos, or the Greeks may have ﬁnished what the earthquake began.
uz: Tabiatning o'zi Knossosni yo'q qilgan bo'lishi mumkin, yoki yunonlar zilzila boshlangan narsani tugatgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: XVIII EGYPT, BABYLON AND ASSYRIA The Egyptians had never submitted very willingly to the rule of their Sem- itic shepherd kings and about 1600 A.D.
uz: XVIII Misr, BABIL VA ASSURIYA Misrliklar hech qachon o'zlarining Semit cho'pon shohlari hukmronligiga juda xohish bilan bo'ysunmagan va taxminan milodiy 1600 yillarda.

en: a vigorous patriotic movement ex- pelled these foreigners.
uz: Kuchli vatanparvarlik harakati bu chet elliklarni quvib chiqardi.

en: Followed a new phase or revival for Egypt, a period known to Egyptologists as the New Empire.
uz: Misr uchun yangi bosqich yoki tiklanish davom etdi, bu davr egiptologlar uchun Yangi Imperiya sifatida tanilgan.

en: Egypt, which had not been closely consolidated before the Hyksos invasion, was now a united country; and the phase of subjugation and insurrection left her full of military spirit.
uz: Misr, Hyksos bosqinidan oldin yaqindan mustahkamlanmagan edi, endi birlashgan davlat edi; va bo'ysundirish va isyon bosqichi uni harbiy ruhga to'la qoldirdi.

en: The Pharaohs became aggressive conquerors.
uz: Fir'avnlar tajovuzkor bosqinchilarga aylandilar.

en: They had now acquired the war horse and the war chariot, which the Hyksos had brought to them.
uz: Ular endi Hyksoslar olib kelgan urush otini va urush aravachasini sotib olishdi.

en: Un- der Thothmes III and Amenophis III Egypt had extended her rule into Asia as far as the Euphrates.
uz: Un- der Thothmes III va Amenophis III Misr o'z hukmronligini Osiyoga, hatto Furot daryosigacha cho'zgan edi.

en: We are entering now upon a thousand years of warfare between the once quite separated civilizations of Mesopotamia and the Nile.
uz: Biz hozir Mesopotamiya va Nilning bir vaqtlar butunlay ajralgan sivilizatsiyalari o'rtasidagi ming yillik urushga qadam qo'ymoqdamiz.

en: At ﬁrst Egypt was ascendant.
uz: Avvaliga Misr yuksalgan edi.

en: The great dynasties, the Seventeenth Dynasty, which includ- ed Thothmes III and Amenophis III and IV and a great queen Hatasu, and the Nineteenth, when Rameses II, supposed by some to have been the Pharaoh of Moses, reigned for sixty-seven years, raised Egypt to high levels of prosperity.
uz: Buyuk sulolalar, Thothmes III va Amenophis III va IV va buyuk malika Hatasu kabi o'n yettinchi sulolalar, va o'n to'qqizinchi sulolalar, ba'zilar Muso fir'avni deb hisoblagan Rameses II oltmish yetti yil hukmronlik qilganida, Misrni yuqori darajadagi farovonlikka olib keldi.

en: In between there were phases of depression for Egypt, con- quest by the Syrians and later conquest by the Ethiopians from the South.
uz: O'rtada Misr uchun depressiya bosqichlari, suriyaliklar tomonidan bosib olinishi va keyinchalik janubdan Efiopiyaliklar tomonidan bosib olinishi bo'lgan.

en: In Mesopotamia Babylon ruled, then the Hittites and the Syrians of Damascus rose to a transitory predominance; at one time the Syrians conquered Egypt; the fortunes of the Assyrians of Nineveh ebbed and ﬂowed; sometimes the city was a conquered city; sometimes the Assyrians ruled in Babylon and assailed Egypt.
uz: Mesopotamiyada Bobil hukmronlik qildi, keyin Damashqdagi xetlar va suriyaliklar vaqtinchalik ustunlikka erishdilar; bir vaqtlar suriyaliklar Misrni zabt etishdi; Ninevehdagi ossuriyaliklarning boyligi pasayib, oqib ketdi; ba'zan shahar zabt etilgan shahar edi; ba'zan ossuriyaliklar Bobilda hukmronlik qilishdi va Misrga hujum qilishdi.

en: Our space is too limited here to tell of the comings and go- ings of the armies of the Egyptians and of the various Semitic powers of Asia Minor, Syria and Mesopotamia.
uz: Bizning hududimiz bu yerda Misr qo'shinlarining kelishi va ketishi, shuningdek, Kichik Osiyo, Suriya va Mesopotamiyaning turli semit davlatlarining kelishi va ketishi haqida gapirishga juda cheklangan.

en: They were armies now provided with
uz: Ular endi ta'minlangan armiyalar edi.

en: vast droves of war chariots, for the horse—still used only for war and glory —had spread by this time into the old civilizations from Central Asia.
uz: Urush aravalarining ulkan to'dalari, chunki ot  hanuzgacha faqat urush va shon-sharaf uchun ishlatilgan  shu vaqtga kelib Markaziy Osiyodan kelgan eski tsivilizatsiyalarga tarqalgan edi.

en: TEMPLE AT ABU SIMBEL  Showing the statues of Rameses II at entrance Great conquerors appear in the dim light of that distant time and pass, Tushratta, King of Mitanni, who captured Nineveh, Tiglath Pileser I of As- syria who conquered Babylon.
uz: ABU SIMBELDAGI ibodatxona Kirish joyida Ramesses II haykallarini ko'rsatmoqda. Uzoq vaqtning xira nurida buyuk zabtgorlar paydo bo'ladi va o'tadi, Tushratta, Mitanni shohi, Ninevani zabt etgan, As-suriyalik Tiglath Pileser I, Bobilni zabt etgan.
