en: At last the Assyrians became the greatest military power of the time.
uz: Nihoyat, ossuriyaliklar o'sha davrning eng buyuk harbiy qudratiga aylandi.

en: Tiglath Pileser III conquered Babylon in 745 B.C.
uz: Tiglat Pileser III miloddan avvalgi 745-yilda Bobilni zabt etdi.

en: and founded what historians call the New Assyrian Empire.
uz: va tarixchilar Yangi Ossuriya imperiyasini deb ataydigan narsaga asos soldi.

en: Iron had also come now into civilization out of the north; the Hittites, the precursors of the Armenians, had it ﬁrst and communicated its use to the Assyrians, and an Assyrian usurper, Sargon II, armed his troops with it.
uz: Temir ham shimoldan sivilizatsiyaga kirib kelgan edi; armanlarning ajdodlari bo'lgan xetlar uni birinchi bo'lib ega bo'lishgan va uning qo'llanilishini ossuriyaliklarga yetkazishgan, shuningdek, ossuriyalik usurper Sargon II o'z qo'shinlarini u bilan qurollantirgan edi.

en: Assyria became the ﬁrst power to expound the doctrine of blood and iron.
uz: Ossuriya qon va temir ta'limotini tushuntirgan birinchi davlat bo'ldi.

en: Sargon’s son Sen- nacherib led an army to the borders of Egypt, and was defeated not by mili- tary strength but by the plague.
uz: Sargonning o'g'li Sen-nacherib Misr chegaralariga qo'shinni olib keldi va harbiy kuch bilan emas, balki vabo bilan mag'lub bo'ldi.

en: Sennacherib’s grandson Assurbanipal (who is also known in history by his Greek name of Sardanapalus) did actually conquer Egypt in 670 B.C.
uz: Sennacheribning nabirasi Assurbanipal (uning yunoncha nomi Sardanapalus bilan ham tanilgan) miloddan avvalgi 670-yilda Misrni zabt etgan.

en: But Egypt was already a conquered country then
uz: Ammo Misr o'sha paytda allaqachon zabt etilgan davlat edi.

en: under an Ethiopian dynasty.
uz: Efiopiya sulolasi ostida.

en: Sardanapalus simply replaced one conqueror by another.
uz: Sardanapalus shunchaki bir zabtchini boshqasiga almashtirdi.

en: AVENUE OF SPHINXES  Leading from the Nile to the great Temple of Karnak  Photo: D.
uz: SFINXES AVENUYASI Nil daryosidan Karnakning buyuk ibodatxonasiga olib boradi. Surat: D.

en: McLeish If one had a series of political maps of this long period of history, this in- terval of ten centuries, we should have Egypt expanding and contracting like an amœba under a microscope, and we should see these various Semitic states of the Babylonians, the Assyrians, the Hittites and the Syrians coming and going, eating each other up and disgorging each other again.
uz: MakLeish Agar odamda bu uzoq tarix davrining, o'n asr ichidagi siyosiy xaritalar seriyasi bo'lganida, Misr mikroskop ostida amoeba kabi kengayib va qisqargan bo'lishi kerak edi va biz Bobilliklar, ossuriyaliklar, xettlar va suriyaliklarning kelib-ketayotgan, bir-birini yeb, yana bir-birini so'rib tashlayotgan turli semit davlatlarini ko'rishimiz kerak edi.

en: To the west of Asia Minor there would be little Ægean states like Lydia, whose capital was Sardis, and Caria.
uz: Kichik Osiyo g'arbida Lidiya kabi kichik Ege davlatlari bo'lardi, uning poytaxti Sardis va Kariya edi.

en: But after about 1200 B.C.
uz: Ammo taxminan miloddan avvalgi 1200 yildan keyin.

en: and perhaps earlier, a new set of names would come into the map of the ancient world from the north-east and from the north- west.
uz: va ehtimol undan oldinroq, qadimgi dunyo xaritasiga shimoli-sharqdan va shimoli-g'arbdan yangi nomlar to'plami kirib kelardi.

en: These would be the names of certain barbaric tribes, armed with iron weapons and using horse-chariots, who were becoming a great afﬂiction to the Ægean and Semitic civilizations on
uz: Bular temir qurollari bilan qurollangan va ot-aravalardan foydalangan ayrim vahshiy qabilalarning ismlari bo'lardi, ular Egean va Semit sivilizatsiyalari uchun katta azobga aylanayotgan edi.

en: the northern borders.
uz: Shimoliy chegaralar.

en: They all spoke variants of what once must have been the same language, Aryan.
uz: Ularning barchasi bir vaqtlar bir xil til bo'lgan Aryan tilining variantlarini gapirishardi.

en: THE GREAT HYPOSTYLE HALL AT KARNAK  Photo: D.
uz: KARNAKDAGI BUYUK GYPOSTYLE ZALL Surat: D.

en: McLeish Round the north-east of the Black and Caspian Seas were coming the Medes and Persians.
uz: Qora va Kaspiy dengizlarining shimoli-sharq tomonida Med va Forslar kelayotgan edi.

en: Confused with these in the records of the time were Scythians and Samatians.
uz: O'sha davr yozuvlarida bular bilan skiflar va samatiylar adashgan edi.

en: From north-east or north-west came the Armeni- ans, from the north- west of the sea-barrier through the Balkan peninsula came Cimmerians, Phrygians and the Hellenic tribes whom now we call the Greeks.
uz: Shimoliy-sharq yoki shimoli-g'arbdan arman-anslar keldi, dengiz to'sig'ining shimoli-g'arbidan Bolqon yarim oroli orqali esa hozir biz yunonlar deb ataydigan simmeriylar, frijilar va helin qabilalari keldi.

en: They were raiders and robbers and plunderers of cities, these Ayrans, east and west alike.
uz: Ular sharqdan ham, g'arbdan ham shaharlarni talonchilar, o'g'rilar va talonchilar edi.

en: They were all kindred and similar peoples, hardy herdsmen who had taken to plunder.
uz: Ularning hammasi qarindosh va o'xshash xalqlar edi, o'ljaga tushgan qattiqqo'l cho'ponlar edi.

en: In the east they were still only borderers and raiders, but in the west they were taking cities and driving out the civilized Ægean populations.
uz: Sharqda ular hali faqat chegarachilar va tajovuzkorlar edi, lekin g'arbda ular shaharlarni egallab, madaniy Ægean aholini quvib chiqarishardi.

en: The Ægean peoples were so pressed that they were seeking new homes in lands beyond the Aryan range.
uz: Ægey xalqlari shunchalik bosim ostida ediki, ular Aryan hududidan tashqaridagi yerlarda yangi uy qidirayotgan edilar.

en: Some were seeking a settlement in the delta of the Nile and being repulsed by the Egyptians; some, the Etruscans, seem to have sailed from Asia Minor to found a state in the forest wildernesses of middle Italy; some built them- selves cities upon the south- east coasts of the Mediterranean and became later that people known in history as the Philistines.
uz: Ba'zilar Nil deltasida joylashuv izlayotgan va misrliklar tomonidan qaytarilgan edi; ba'zilar, etrusklar, O'rta Italiyaning o'rmon cho'llarida davlat tashkil etish uchun Kichik Osiyodan suzib kelgan ko'rinadi; ba'zilar O'rta yer dengizi janubi-sharqiy sohillarida o'z shaharlarini qurgan va keyinchalik tarixda filistimliklar deb tanilgan odamlar bo'lishdi.

en: Of these Aryans who came thus rudely upon the scene of the ancient civi- lizations we will tell more fully in a later section.
uz: Qadimgi sivilizatsiyalar joyiga shunday qo'pol tarzda kelgan bu oriylar haqida keyingi bo'limda batafsilroq aytib beramiz.

en: Here we note simply all this stir and emigration amidst the area of the ancient civilizations, that was set up by the swirl of the gradual and continuous advance of these Aryan barbarians out of the northern forests and wildernesses between 1600 and 600 B.C.
uz: Bu yerda biz shunchaki qadimgi tsivilizatsiyalar hududida bo'lgan barcha shov-shuv va ko'chishni qayd etamiz, bu miloddan avvalgi 1600 va 600 yillar oralig'ida ushbu ariy vahshiylarining shimoliy o'rmonlar va cho'llardan asta-sekin va uzluksiz chiqib ketish girdobi bilan tashkil etilgan edi.

en: And in a section to follow we must tell also of a little Semitic people, the Hebrews, in the hills behind the Phœnician and Philistine coasts, who began to be of signiﬁcance in the world towards the end of this period.
uz: Va keyingi bo'limda biz Finikiy va Filistim qirg'oqlari ortidagi tepaliklarda ozgina semit xalqi, ibroniylar haqida ham aytib berishimiz kerak, ular bu davrning oxiriga kelib dunyoda muhim ahamiyat kasb eta boshladilar.

en: They pro- duced a literature of very great importance in subsequent history, a collec- tion of books, histories, poems, books of wisdom and prophetic works, the Hebrew Bible.
uz: Ular keyingi tarixda juda katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan adabiyotni, kitoblar, tarixlar, she'rlar, donolik kitoblari va bashorat asarlari to'plamini, Ibroniy Injilni ishlab chiqarishdi.

en: In Mesopotamia and Egypt the coming of the Aryans did not cause fun- damental changes until after 600 B.C.
uz: Mesopotamiya va Misrdaoriylarning kelishi miloddan avvalgi 600 yildan keyin qiziqarli o'zgarishlarga olib kelmadi.

en: The ﬂight of the Ægeans before the Greeks and even the destruction of Cnossos must have seemed a very re- mote disturbance to both the citizens of Egypt and of Babylon.
uz: Agenlarning yunonlardan oldingi qochishi va hatto Knossosning vayron bo'lishi ham Misr va Bobil fuqarolari uchun juda katta bezovtalik bo'lib tuyulgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Dynasties came and went in these cradle states of civilization, but the main tenor of
uz: Dinastiyalar kelib-ketdi va bu sivilizatsiya beshigi holatlarida ketdi, lekin asosiy tenor...

en: human life went on, with a slow increase in reﬁnement and complexity age by age.
uz: Inson hayoti yil sayin takomillashuv va murakkablikning sekin o'sishi bilan davom etdi.

en: In Egypt the accumulated monuments of more ancient times—the pyramids were already in their third thousand of years and a show for visi- tors just as they are to- day—were supplemented by fresh and splendid buildings, more particularly in the time of the seventeenth and nineteenth dynasties.
uz: Misrda qadim zamonlarning to'plangan yodgorliklari  piramidalar allaqachon uch ming yillikda edi va hozirgidek ko'rguvchilar uchun tomosha edi  yangi va ajoyib binolar bilan to'ldirildi, ayniqsa o'n yettinchi va o'n to'qqizinchi sulolalar davrida.

en: The great temples at Karnak and Luxor date from this time.
uz: Karnak va Luxordagi buyuk ibodatxonalar shu davrga tegishli.

en: All the chief monuments of Nineveh, the great temples, the winged bulls with human heads, the reliefs of kings and chariots and lion hunts, were done in these centuries between 1600 and 600 B.C., and this period also covers most of the splendours of Babylon.
uz: Nineve shahrining barcha asosiy yodgorliklari, buyuk ibodatxonalar, inson boshli qanotli buqalar, shohlar va aravalar relyeflari hamda arslon ovlari miloddan avvalgi 1600 va 600 yillar oralig'ida amalga oshirilgan va bu davr Bobilning aksariyat hashamatlarini ham qamrab oladi.

en: FRIEZE SHOWING EGYPTIAN FEMALE SLAVES CARRYING LUXURIOUS FOODS  Photo: Jacques Boyer Both from Mesopotamia and Egypt we now have abundant public records, business accounts, stories, poetry and private correspondence.
uz: FRIEZE SHOWING EGYPT XUZUMONLARINING ICHIRUVCHI NAFXUR TAOMLARNI KO'RSATISH Photo: Jacques Boyer Mesopotamiyadan va Misrdan bo'lgan bizda hozirda keng jamoatchilik yozuvlari, biznes hisoblari, hikoyalar, she'riyat va shaxsiy yozishmalar mavjud.

en: We know that life, for prosperous and inﬂuential people in such cities as Baby- lon and the Egyptian Thebes, was already almost as reﬁned and as luxurious as that of comfortable and prosperous people to-day.
uz: Biz bilamizki, Baby-lon va Misr Tebasi kabi shaharlardagi farovon va nufuzli odamlar uchun hayot allaqachon bugungi kunda qulay va farovon odamlarning hayoti kabi nafis va hashamatli edi.

en: Such people lived an orderly and ceremonious life in beautiful and beautifully furnished and dec- orated houses, wore richly decorated clothing and lovely jewels; they had feasts and festivals, entertained one another with music and dancing, were waited upon by highly trained servants, were cared for by doctors and den- tists.
uz: Bunday odamlar go'zal va chiroyli jihozlangan va bezatilgan uylarda tartibli va marosimli hayot kechirardilar, boy bezatilgan kiyimlar va yoqimli taqinchoqlar kiyishardi; ular ziyofatlar va bayramlar o'tkazishardi, bir-birlarini musiqa va raqs bilan xursand qilishardi, yuqori malakali xizmatchilar kutib turardi, shifokorlar va den-tishlar g'amxo'rlik qilardi.

en: They did not travel very much or very far, but boating excursions were a common summer pleasure both on the Nile and on the Euphrates.
uz: Ular uncha ko'p yoki uncha uzoqqa sayohat qilmas edilar, lekin Nilda ham, Furotda ham qayiqda sayohat qilish umumiy yozgi zavq edi.

en: The beast of burthen was the ass; the horse was still used only in chariots for war and upon occasions of state.
uz: Burten hayvoni eshak edi; ot hali ham faqat urush va davlat imkoniyatlarida aravalarda ishlatilgan.

en: The mule was still novel and the camel, though it was known in Mesopotamia, had not been brought into Egypt.
uz: Mol hali ham yangi edi va tuya, garchi Mesopotamiyada ma'lum bo'lsa ham, Misrga olib kelinmagan edi.

en: And there were few utensils of iron; copper and bronze remained the pre- vailing metals.
uz: Va temir idishlar kam edi; mis va bronza oldindan o'ralgan metallar bo'lib qoldi.

en: Fine linen and cotton fabrics were known as well as wool.
uz: Mayda zig'ir va paxta matolari jun kabi mashhur edi.

en: But there was no silk yet.
uz: Lekin ipak hali yo'q edi.

en: Glass was known and beautifully coloured, but glass things were usually small.
uz: Shisha mashhur va chiroyli rangga ega edi, lekin shisha narsalar odatda kichik edi.

en: There was no clear glass and no optical use of glass.
uz: Shaffof shisha yo'q edi va shishaning optik qo'llanilishi ham yo'q edi.

en: People had gold stoppings in their teeth but no spectacles on their noses.
uz: Odamlarning tishlarida oltin to'siq bor edi, burunlarida esa ko'zoynak yo'q edi.

en: One odd contrast between the life of old Thebes or Babylon and modern life was the absence of coined money.
uz: Qadimgi Tebba yoki Bobil hayoti va zamonaviy hayot o'rtasidagi g'alati kontrastlardan biri bu tilga olingan pulning yo'qligi edi.

en: Most trade was still done by barter.
uz: Ko'p savdo baribir almashinuv orqali amalga oshirilgan.

en: Babylon was ﬁnancially far ahead of Egypt.
uz: Bobil moliyaviy jihatdan Misrdan ancha oldinda edi.

en: Gold and silver were used for exchange and kept in ingots; and there were bankers, before coinage, who stamped their names and the weight on these lumps of precious metal.
uz: Oltin va kumush ayirboshlash uchun ishlatilgan va quymalarda saqlangan; va tangalar yasashdan oldin, qimmatbaho metall bo'laklariga o'z nomlarini va og'irligini muhrlagan bankirlar bor edi.

en: A merchant or traveller would carry precious stones to sell to pay for his ne- cessities.
uz: Savdogar yoki sayohatchi o'z boyliklarini to'lash uchun sotish uchun qimmatbaho toshlarni olib yurardi.

en: Most servants and workers were slaves who were paid not money but in kind.
uz: Aksariyat xizmatkorlar va ishchilar pul bilan emas, balki natura bilan to'lanadigan qullar edi.

en: As money came in slavery declined.
uz: Pul qullikda kelgani sari kamayib ketdi.

en: A modern visitor to these crowning cities of the ancient world would have missed two very important articles of diet; there were no hens and no eggs.
uz: Qadimgi dunyoning bu tojlashuvchi shaharlariga zamonaviy tashrif buyuruvchi ovqatlanishning ikki juda muhim qismini o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lardi; na tovuqlar bor edi, na tuxumlar.

en: A French cook would have found small joy in Babylon.
uz: Fransuz oshpazi Bobilda ozgina quvonch topgan bo'lardi.

en: These things came from the East somewhere about the time of the last Assyrian empire.
uz: Bu narsalar Sharqdan qayerdandir, oxirgi Ossuriya imperiyasi davrida kelgan.

en: Religion like everything else had undergone great reﬁnement.
uz: Din hammasi kabi katta takomillashuvga uchragan edi.

en: Human sacriﬁce for instance had long since disappeared; animals or bread dummies had been substituted for the victim.
uz: Masalan, inson qurbonligi allaqachon yo'qolgan edi; qurbon o'rniga hayvonlar yoki non qo'g'irchoqlari almashtirilgan edi.

en: (But the Phœnicians and especially the citizens of Carthage, their greatest settlement in Africa, were accused, later of immolating human beings.) When a great chief had died in the ancient days it had been customary to sacriﬁce his wives and slaves and break spear and bow at his tomb so that he should not go unattended and unarmed in the spirit world.
uz: Ammo Finikiylar va ayniqsa ularning Afrikadagi eng katta maskani bo'lgan Karfagen fuqarolari keyinchalik odamlarni yoqib yuborishda ayblangan edilar. Qadim zamonda buyuk boshliq vafot etganida, u ruh olamiga qarovsiz va qurolsiz ketmasligi uchun xotini va qullarini qurbon qilish, nayzalarini sindirish va uning qabrida egilib yurish odatiy hol edi.

en: In Egypt there survived of this dark tradition the pleasant cus- tom of burying small models of house and shop and servants and cattle with the dead, models that give us to-day the liveliest realization of the safe and cultivated life of these ancient people, three thousand years and more ago.
uz: Misrda bu qorong'u an'anadan uy va do'kon, xizmatkorlar va chorva mollarining mayda modellarini o'liklar bilan ko'mishning yoqimli maskani saqlanib qoldi, bu modellar bizga bugungi kunda uch ming va undan ko'proq yillar oldingi ushbu qadimgi odamlarning xavfsiz va madaniy hayotini eng jonli anglash imkonini beradi.

en: THE TEMPLE OF HORUS AT EDFU Such was the ancient world before the coming of the Aryans out of the northern forests and plains.
uz: EDFUDAGI HORUS ibodatxonasi. Shimoliy o'rmonlar va tekisliklardan ariylar kelmasidan oldingi qadimgi dunyo shunday edi.

en: In India and China there were parallel develop- ments.
uz: Hindiston va Xitoyda parallel rivojlanishlar bo'lib o'tdi.

en: In the great valleys of both these regions agricultural city states of brownish peoples were growing up, but in India they do not seem to have advanced or coalesced so rapidly as the city states of Mesopotamia or Egypt.
uz: Bu ikki mintaqaning katta vodiylarida jigarrang xalqlarning qishloq xo'jaligi shaharlari rivojlanayotgan edi, lekin Hindistonda ular Mesopotamiya yoki Misr shaharlari kabi tez rivojlangan yoki birlashgan ko'rinmaydi.

en: They were nearer the level of the ancient Sumerians or of the Maya civilization of America.
uz: Ular qadimgi Shumerlar yoki Amerikaning Maya sivilizatsiyasi darajasiga yaqinroq edilar.

en: Chinese history has still to be modernized by Chi- nese scholars and cleared of much legendary matter.
uz: Xitoy tarixi hali Chi-nos olimlari tomonidan modernizatsiya qilinishi va ko'p afsonaviy masalalardan tozalanishi kerak.

en: Probably China at this time was in advance of India.
uz: Ehtimol, bu paytda Xitoy Hindistondan oldinda edi.

en: Contemporary with the seventeenth dynasty in Egypt, there was a dynasty of emperors in China, the Shang dynasty, priest emperors over a loose-knit empire of subordinate kings.
uz: Misrda o'n yettinchi sulola davrida Xitoyda imperatorlar sulolasi, Shang sulolasi, quyi podshohlarning bo'sh to'qilgan imperiyasi ustidan ruhoniy imperatorlar hukm surgan.

en: The chief duty of these early emperors was to perform the seasonal sacriﬁces.
uz: Bu erta imperatorlarning asosiy vazifasi mavsumiy qurbonliklarni bajarish edi.

en: Beauti- ful bronze vessels from the time of the Shang dynasty still exist, and their beauty and workmanship compel us to recognize that many centuries of civ- ilization must have preceded their manufacture.
uz: Shang sulolasi davridagi go'zal bronza idishlar hanuzgacha mavjud va ularning go'zalligi va ishlov berilishi bizni ularning ishlab chiqarilishidan ko'p asrlar oldin sivilizatsiya bo'lganini tan olishga majbur qiladi.

en: XIX THE PRIMITIVE ARYANS Four thousand years ago, that is to say about 2000 B.C., central and south- eastern Europe and central Asia were probably warmer, moister and better wooded than they are now.
uz: XIX ASOSIY ARYANLAR To'rt ming yil oldin, ya'ni miloddan avvalgi taxminan 2000 yillarda, Markaziy va janubi-sharqiy Yevropa hamda Markaziy Osiyo hozirgidan ko'ra iliqroq, namroq va yaxshiroq o'rmonli bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: In these regions of the earth wandered a group of tribes mainly of the fair and blue-eyed Nordic race, sufﬁciently in touch with one another to speak merely variations of one common language from the Rhine to the Caspian Sea.
uz: Yerning bu hududlarida asosan oq va ko'k ko'zli skandinavi irqidan bo'lgan bir guruh qabilalar kezib yurgan, ular bir-biri bilan yetarli darajada aloqaga ega bo'lib, Reyn daryosidan Kaspiy dengizigacha bo'lgan yagona umumiy tilning o'zgaruvchanliklarini gapirishardi.

en: At that time they may not have been a very numerous people, and their existence was unsuspected by the Babylonians to whom Hammurabi was giving laws, or by the already ancient and culti- vated land of Egypt which was tasting in those days for the ﬁrst time the bitterness of foreign conquest.
uz: O'sha paytda ular juda ko'p sonli xalq bo'lmasligi mumkin edi va ularning mavjudligi Hammurabi qonunlar bergan Bobilliklar yoki o'sha kunlarda birinchi marta xorijiy bosqin achchiqligini his qilayotgan allaqachon qadimiy va madaniy bo'lgan Misr zaminlari tomonidan gumon qilinmagan edi.

en: These Nordic people were destined to play a very important part indeed in the world’s history.
uz: Bu Skandinaviya xalqi dunyo tarixida juda muhim rol o'ynashga taqdirlangan edi.

en: They were a people of the parklands and the forest clearings; they had no horses at ﬁrst but they had cattle; when they wan- dered they put their tents and other gear on rough ox waggons; when they settled for a time they may have made huts of wattle and mud.
uz: Ular bog'lar va o'rmonzorlar aholisi edilar; ularning dastlab otlari yo'q edi, lekin chorva mollari bor edi; ular qo'pol buqa aravalariga chodirlarini va boshqa jihozlarini qo'yishardi; bir muddat o'rnashganlarida, ehtimol, loy va loydan kulbalar yasashgan bo'lishardi.

en: They burnt their important dead; they did not bury them ceremoniously as the brunette peoples did.
uz: Ular o'zlarining muhim o'liklarini yoqib yuborishdi; ularni brunet xalqlar qilganidek tantanali ravishda dafn qilishmadi.

en: They put the ashes of their greater leaders in urns and then made a great circular mound about them.
uz: Ular o'zlarining buyuk yetakchilarining kulini idishlarga soldilar va keyin ular atrofida katta dumaloq tepalik yasashdi.

en: These mounds are the “round bar- rows” that occur all over north Europe.
uz: Bu tepaliklar butun Shimoliy Yevropada uchraydigan yumaloq bar- qatorlardir.

en: The brunette people, their predeces- sors, did not burn their dead but buried them in a sitting position in elongat- ed mounds; the “long barrows.” The Aryans raised crops of wheat, ploughing with oxen, but they did not settle down by their crops; they would reap and move on.
uz: Qora sochli odamlar, ularning o'tmishdoshlari - sochlar, o'zlarining o'liklarini yoqishmadi, balki ularni uzun tepaliklarda o'tirgan holatda ko'mib qo'yishdi; uzoq qamishlar. Ariylar bug'doy ekinlarini ko'tarishardi, ho'kizlar bilan haydashardi, lekin ular o'z ekinlari bilan joylashmasdilar; ular yig'ishtirib, ketishardi.

en: They had bronze, and somewhen about 1500 B.C.
uz: Ularda bronza bor edi, ba'zilarida esa taxminan miloddan avvalgi 1500-yillarda.

en: They may have been the
uz: Ular bo'lishi mumkin edi...

en: discoverers of iron smelting.
uz: Temir erituvchi kashfiyotchilar.

en: And somewhen vaguely about that time they also got the horse—which to begin with they used only for draught purpos- es.
uz: Va ba'zilar o'sha vaqt haqida noaniq tarzda otga ham ega bo'lishdi  uni boshida faqat tortish maqsadlarida ishlatishardi.

en: Their social life did not centre upon a temple like that of the more set- tled people round the Mediterranean, and their chief men were leaders rather than priests.
uz: Ularning ijtimoiy hayoti O'rta yer dengizi atrofidagi ko'proq tartibsiz odamlarning ibodatxonasiga o'xshamasdi va ularning boshliqlari ruhoniylar emas, balki yetakchilar edi.

en: They had an aristocratic social order rather than a divine and regal order; from a very early stage they distinguished certain families as leaderly and noble.
uz: Ularning ilohiy va qirollik tartibidan ko'ra aristokratik ijtimoiy tartibi bor edi; ular juda erta bosqichdan boshlab ayrim oilalarni yetakchi va olijanob deb ajratib turishardi.

en: A BEAUTIFUL ARCHAIC AMPHORA  Compare the horses and other animals with the Altamira drawing on p.
uz: GO'ZALLIK ARXIY AMPHORA Otlar va boshqa hayvonlarni Altamira chizig'i bilan solishtiring, p.

en: 54, and also with the Greek frieze, p.
uz: 54, shuningdek, yunon frizi bilan, b.

en: 140 They were a very vocal people.
uz: Ular juda ovoz chiqaradigan xalq edilar.

en: They enlivened their wanderings by feasts, at which there was much drunkenness and at which a special sort of man, the bards, would sing and recite.
uz: Ular o'z sayohatlarini ziyofatlar bilan jonlantirishdi, unda ko'p mastlik bo'lardi va unda maxsus bir turdagi odam, bardlar qo'shiq aytib, tilovat qilishardi.

en: They had no writing until they had come into contact with civilization, and the memories of these bards were their living literature.
uz: Ularda sivilizatsiya bilan aloqaga kirmaguncha yozuv yo'q edi va bu bardlarning xotiralari ularning tirik adabiyoti edi.

en: This use of recited language as an entertainment did much to make it a ﬁne and beautiful instrument of expression, and to that no doubt the subsequent predominance of the languages derived from Aryan is, in part, to be ascribed.
uz: O'qilgan tilni ko'ngilochar vosita sifatida ishlatish uni nozik va go'zal ifoda vositasiga aylantirishga katta hissa qo'shdi va shubhasiz, Aryan tilidan kelib chiqqan tillarning keyingi ustunligi qisman shubhalanadi.

en: Every Aryan people had its legendary history crys- tallized in bardic recitations, epics, sagas and vedas, as they were variously called.
uz: Har bir ariy xalqining afsonaviy tarixi bordic rivoyatlar, dostonlar, hikoyalar va Vedada turli xil nomlar bilan tilga olingan edi.

en: The social life of these people centred about the households of their lead- ing men.
uz: Bu odamlarning ijtimoiy hayoti ularning yetakchi odamlarining uy xo'jaliklari haqida markazlashgan edi.

en: The hall of the chief where they settled for a time was often a very capacious timber building.
uz: Boshliqning bir muddatga joylashgan zali ko'pincha juda qudratli yog'och bino edi.

en: There were no doubt huts for herds and outlying farm buildings; but with most of the Aryan peoples this hall was the general centre, everyone went there to feast and hear the bards and take part in games and discussions.
uz: Shubhasiz, chorvalar uchun kulbalar va chekka fermer xo'jaliklari mavjud edi; lekin Aryan xalqlarining aksariyati uchun bu zal umumiy markaz edi, hamma u yerga ziyofat qilish, bardlarni tinglash va o'yinlar va munozaralarda ishtirok etish uchun borardi.

en: Cowsheds and stabling surrounded it.
uz: Uni sigirxonalar va o'rmonlar o'rab oldi.

en: The chief and his wife and so forth would sleep on a dais or in an upper gallery; the com- moner sort slept about anywhere, as people still do in Indian households.
uz: Boshliq va uning rafiqasi va hokazolar daisda yoki yuqori galereyada uxlashardi; kom-moner turlari istalgan joyda uxlashardi, xuddi hind uylarida bo'lgani kabi.

en: Except for weapons, ornaments, tools and suchlike personal possessions there was a sort of patriarchal communism in the tribe.
uz: Qurollar, bezaklar, asboblar va shunga o'xshash shaxsiy mulklardan tashqari, qabilada patriarxal kommunizmning bir turi bor edi.

en: The chief owned the cattle and grazing lands in the common interest; forest and rivers were the wild.
uz: Boshliq chorva mollari va o'tloq yerlariga umumiy manfaat uchun egalik qilardi; o'rmon va daryolar yovvoyi edi.

en: This was the fashion of the people who were increasing and multiplying over the great spaces of central Europe and west central Asia during the growth of the great civilization of Mesopotamia and the Nile, and whom we ﬁnd pressing upon the heliolithic peoples everywhere in the second millen- nium before Christ.
uz: Bu Mesopotamiya va Nil buyuk sivilizatsiyasining o'sishi davrida Markaziy Yevropa va G'arbiy Markaziy Osiyoning katta hududlarida ko'payib, ko'payib borayotgan va biz Masihdan oldingi ikkinchi mingyillikda hamma joyda gelyolitik xalqlarga bosim o'tkazayotgan odamlarning uslubi edi.

en: They were coming into France and Britain and into Spain.
uz: Ular Fransiya va Britaniyaga, shuningdek, Ispaniyaga kelayotgan edi.

en: They pushed westward in two waves.
uz: Ular g'arbga qarab ikki to'lqinda itarildilar.

en: The ﬁrst of these people who reached Britain and Ireland were armed with bronze weapons.
uz: Britaniya va Irlandiyaga yetib kelgan bu odamlarning birinchisi bronza qurollar bilan qurollangan edi.

en: They exter- minated or subjugated the people who had made the great stone monuments of Carnac in Brittany and Stonehenge and Avebury in England.
uz: Ular Brittanydagi Carnac va Angliyadagi Stonehenge va Avebury kabi buyuk tosh yodgorliklarini yasagan odamlarni o'ldirishdi yoki bo'ysundirishdi.

en: They reached Ireland.
uz: Ular Irlandiyaga yetib kelishdi.

en: They are called the Goidelic Celts.
uz: Ular Goidelik keltlar deb ataladi.

en: The second wave of a closely kindred people, perhaps intermixed with other racial elements,
uz: Yaqindan qarindosh xalqning ikkinchi to'lqini, ehtimol boshqa irqiy unsurlar bilan aralashgan.

en: brought iron with it into Great Britain, and is known as the wave of Bry- thonic Celts.
uz: Buyuk Britaniyaga temir olib kirdi va Bry-tonik keltlar to'lqini sifatida tanilgan.

en: From them the Welsh derive their language.
uz: Uelslar o'z tilini ulardan oladi.

en: THE MOUND OF NIPPUR  The site of a city which recent excavations have proved to date from at least as early as 5000 B.C., and probably 1000 years earlier  Photo: Underwood & Underwood Kindred Celtic peoples were pressing southward into Spain and coming into contact not only with the heliolithic Basque people who still occupied
uz: NIPPUR TO'G'ONI Yaqinda o'tkazilgan qazishmalar miloddan avvalgi kamida 5000 yil va ehtimol 1000 yil oldingi davrga borib taqaladigan shahar joyi. Surat: Underwood & Underwood O'xshash kelt xalqlari Janubiy tomonga Ispaniyaga bostirib kirib, nafaqat hali ham bosib o'tayotgan heliolitik bask xalqi bilan aloqaga kirishgan.

en: the country but with the Semitic Phœnician colonies of the sea coast.
uz: Mamlakat, lekin dengiz sohilidagi semit fenitsik mustamlakalari bilan.

en: A closely allied series of tribes, the Italians, were making their way down the still wild and wooded Italian peninsula.
uz: Yaqindan ittifoqchi qabilalar, italyanlar, hali yovvoyi va o'rmonli italyan yarim oroliga yo'l olishayotgan edi.

en: They did not always conquer.
uz: Ular har doim ham g'alaba qozonishmagan.

en: In the eighth century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi sakkizinchi asrda.

en: Rome appears in history, a trading town on the Tiber, in- habited by Aryan Latins but under the rule of Etruscan nobles and kings.
uz: Rim tarixda paydo bo'ladi, Tiber daryosidagi savdo shahri bo'lib, unda ariy lotinlari yashaydi, ammo etruska zodagonlari va shohlari hukmronligi ostida edi.

en: At the other extremity of the Aryan range there was a similar progress southward of similar tribes.
uz: Aryo tizmasining narigi uchida shunga o'xshash qabilalarning janubga tomon ham shunga o'xshash taraqqiyot kuzatildi.

en: Aryan peoples, speaking Sanskrit, had come down through the western passes into North India long before 1000 B.C.
uz: Aryan xalqlari, sanskrit tilida gapiradiganlar, miloddan avvalgi 1000 yillardan ancha oldin g'arbiy o'tish joylaridan Shimoliy Hindistonga tushishgan edi.

en: There they came into contact with a primordial brunette civilization, the Dravidian civilization, and learnt much from it.
uz: U yerda ular birlamchi qora tanli sivilizatsiya, Dravid sivilizatsiyasi bilan aloqaga kirishdi va undan ko'p narsa o'rganishdi.

en: Other Aryan tribes seem to have spread over the mountain masses of Central Asia far to the east of the present range of such peoples.
uz: Boshqa ariy qabilalari Markaziy Osiyoning tog' massalari bo'ylab tarqalgan ko'rinadi, hozirgi xalqlar orasidan sharqda uzoqroq.

en: In Eastern Turkestan there are still fair, blue- eyed Nordic tribes, but now they speak Mongolian tongues.
uz: Sharqiy Turkistonda hali ham ochiq, ko'k ko'zli skandinaviya qabilalari bor, lekin hozir ular mo'g'ul tillarida gaplashadi.

en: Between the Black and Caspian Seas the ancient Hittites had been sub- merged and “Aryanized” by the Armenians before 1000 B.C., and the Assyr- ians and Babylonians were already aware of a new and formidable ﬁghting barbarism on the north-eastern frontiers, a group of tribes amidst which the Scythians, the Medes and the Persians remain as outstanding names.
uz: Qora va Kaspiy dengizlari o'rtasida qadimgi xettlar miloddan avval 1000 yilgacha armanlar tomonidan qo'shib yuborilgan va ariylashtirilgan edi, ossuriyaliklar va bobilliklar esa shimoli-sharqiy chegaralarda yangi va dahshatli jangovar vahshiylikdan allaqachon xabardor edilar, ular orasida skiflar, medlar va forslar taniqli nomlar sifatida qoladigan qabilalar guruhi.

en: But it was through the Balkan peninsula that Aryan tribes made their ﬁrst heavy thrust into the heart of the old-world civilization.
uz: Ammo aynan Bolqon yarim oroli orqali ari qabilalari o'zlarining birinchi og'ir zarbalarini eski dunyo sivilizatsiyasining yuragiga kiritdilar.

en: They were already coming southward and crossing into Asia Minor many centuries before 1000 B.C.
uz: Ular allaqachon janubga kelib, miloddan avval 1000 yilgacha bo'lgan ko'p asrlar ichida Kichik Osiyoga o'tib ketayotgan edilar.

en: First came a group of tribes of whom the Phrygians were the most conspicuous, and then in succession the Æolic, the Ionic and the Dorian Greeks.
uz: Avval bir guruh qabilalar paydo bo'ldi, ularning orasida eng ko'zga ko'ringanlarifrigiyaliklar edi, keyin ketma-ket efirliklar, ionlar vaorianlar yunonlar edi.

en: they had wiped out the ancient Ægean civilization both in the mainland of Greece and in most of the Greek islands; the cities of Mycenæ and Tiryns were obliterated and Cnossos was nearly forgotten.
uz: Ular yunon materikida ham, yunon orollarining ko'p qismida ham qadimgi Egey sivilizatsiyasini yo'q qilishdi; Mycenæ va Tiryn shaharlari yo'q qilindi va Knossos deyarli unutildi.

en: The Greeks had taken to the sea before 1000 A.D., they had settled in Crete and Rhodes, and they were founding colonies in Sicily and the south of Italy after the fashion of the Phœnician trading cities that were dotted along the Mediterranean coasts.
uz: Greklar miloddan avval 1000 yilgacha dengizga chiqishgan, ular Krit va Rodosga joylashishgan va ular Sitsiliyada va Italiyaning janubida O'rta yer dengizi sohillarida tarqalgan Fenisiyadagi savdo shaharlari uslubida mustamlakalar tashkil etishayotgan edi.

en: So it was, while Tiglath Pileser III and Sargon II and Sardanapalus were ruling in Assyria and ﬁghting with Babylonia and Syria and Egypt, the Aryan peoples were learning the methods of civilization and making it over for their own purposes in Italy and Greece and north Persia.
uz: Shunday bo'ldi, Tiglat Pileser III va Sargon II va Sardanapalus Ossuriyada hukmronlik qilib, Bobil, Suriya va Misr bilan jang qilayotgan paytda, ariy xalqlari sivilizatsiya usullarini o'rganishardi va uni Italiya, Gretsiya va Shimoliy Forsda o'z maqsadlari uchun o'ylab topishdi.

en: The theme of history from the ninth century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi to'qqizinchi asrdagi tarix mavzusi.

en: onward for six centuries is the story
uz: Olti asr davom etar ekan, bu hikoyadir.

en: of how these Aryan peoples grew to power and enterprise and how at last they subjugated the whole Ancient World, Semitic, Ægean and Egyptian alike.
uz: Bu ariy xalqlari qanday qilib hokimiyat va tadbirkorlikka erishgani va oxir-oqibat butun Qadimgi Dunyo, Semitlar, Egeylar va Misrlarni qanday bo'ysundirgani haqida.

en: In form the Aryan peoples were altogether victorious; but the struggle of Aryan, Semitic and Egyptian ideas and methods was continued long after the sceptre was in Aryan hands.
uz: Shaklda ariy xalqlari butunlay g'alaba qozongan edi; lekin ariy, semit va misrlik g'oyalar va usullarning kurashi aryanlar qo'lida bo'lgandan keyin ham uzoq davom etdi.

en: It is indeed a struggle that goes on through all the rest of history and still in a manner continues to this day.
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham butun tarix davomida davom etayotgan va bugungi kungacha shunday tarzda davom etayotgan kurashdir.

en: XX THE LAST BABYLONIAN EMPIRE AND THE EMPIRE OF DARIUS I We have already mentioned how Assyria became a great military power un- der Tiglath Pileser III and under the usurper Sargon II.
uz: XX SO'NGGI BABIL imperiyasi VA DORIY imperiyasi I Ossuriya Tiglath Pileser III va usurper Sargon II ostida qanday qilib buyuk harbiy qudratga aylanganini allaqachon aytib o'tdik.

en: Sargon was not this man’s original name; he adopted it to ﬂatter the conquered Babylonians by reminding them of that ancient founder of the Akkadian Empire, Sargon I, two thousand years before his time.
uz: Sargon bu odamning asl ismi emas edi; u uni bosib olingan Bobilliklarga o'z davridan ikki ming yil oldin bo'lgan Akkad imperiyasining qadimgi asoschisini, Sargon I ni eslatib, maqtash uchun qabul qilgan.

en: Babylon, for all that it was a conquered city, was of greater population and importance than Nineveh, and its great god Bel Marduk and its traders and priests had to be treated politely.
uz: Bobil, o'zi bosib olingan shahar bo'lgani uchun, Ninevaga qaraganda ko'proq aholi va ahamiyatga ega edi, uning buyuk xudosi Bel Marduk va uning savdogarlari va ruhoniylariga xushmuomalalik bilan munosabatda bo'lish kerak edi.

en: In Mesopotamia in the eighth century B.C.
uz: Mesopotamiyada miloddan avvalgi VIII asrda.

en: we are already far beyond the barbaric days when the capture of a town meant loot and massacre.
uz: Biz allaqachon shaharni egallash o'lja va qirg'in degani bo'lgan vahshiy kunlardan ancha o'tib ketdik.

en: Con- querors sought to propitiate and win the conquered.
uz: Konquerlar zabt etilganlarni o'ziga jalb qilish va yutishga intildilar.

en: For a century and a half after Sargon the new Assyrian empire endured and, as we have noted, As- surbanipal (Sardanapalus) held at least lower Egypt.
uz: Sargondan keyin bir yarim asr davomida yangi Ossuriya imperiyasi bardosh berdi va, biz ta'kidlaganimizdek, As- surbanipal (Sardanapalus) kamida quyi Misrni egallab turdi.

en: But the power and solidarity of Assyria waned rapidly.
uz: Ammo Ossuriyaning qudrati va birdamligi tez sur'atlar bilan pasaydi.

en: Egypt by an effort threw off the foreigner under a Pharoah Psammetichus I, and under Necho II attempted a war of conquest in Syria.
uz: Misr bir urinish bilan chet ellikni Fir'avn Psammetichus I qo'l ostida haydab tashladi va Nexo II qo'l ostida Suriyada bosqinchilik urushiga urindi.

en: By that time Assyria was grappling with foes nearer at hand, and could make but a poor resistance.
uz: O'sha paytga kelib, Ossuriya yaqinroq dushmanlar bilan kurashayotgan edi va faqat past qarshilik ko'rsata olardi.

en: A Semitic people from south-east Mesopotamia, the Chaldeans, combined with Aryan Medes and Persians from the north-east against Nineveh, and in 606 B.C.— for now we are coming down to exact chronology—took that city.
uz: Mesopotamiyaning janubi-sharqidan kelgan semit xalqi, xaldeylar, shimoli-sharqdan kelgan ariy medlar va forslar bilan birga Ninevaga qarshi, va miloddan avvalgi 606-yilda  hozircha aniq xronologiyaga kelamiz  bu shaharni egalladi.

en: There was a division of the spoils of Assyria.
uz: Ossuriyaning o'ljalarini bo'lish edi.

en: A Median Empire was set up in the north under Cyaxares.
uz: Shimoliyda Cyaxares boshchiligida Mediya imperiyasi tashkil etildi.

en: It included Nineveh, and its capital was Ec- batana.
uz: Unga Nineva ham kirardi va uning poytaxti Ek-batana edi.

en: Eastward it reached to the borders of India.
uz: Sharqqa qarab u Hindiston chegaralariga yetib bordi.

en: To the south of this in a
uz: Buning janubida a

en: great crescent was a new Chaldean Empire, the Second Babylonian Empire, which rose to a very great degree of wealth and power under the rule of Nebuchadnezzar the Great (the Nebuchadnezzar of the Bible).
uz: Buyuk yarim oy Xaldiylar imperiyasi, Ikkinchi Bobil imperiyasi bo'lib, u Nabukadnezzar Buyuk hukmronligi ostida juda katta boylik va qudratga erishdi ( bibliyadagi Nabukadnezzar).

en: The last great days, the greatest days of all, for Babylon began.
uz: Oxirgi buyuk kunlar, Bobil uchun eng buyuk kunlar boshlandi.

en: For a time the two Empires remained at peace, and the daughter of Nebuchadnezzar was mar- ried to Cyaxares.
uz: Bir muddatga ikki imperiya tinch qoldi va Navuxodnezarning qizi Kyaksharsga turmushga chiqdi.

en: Meanwhile Necho II was pursuing his easy conquests in Syria.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Nexo II Suriyada oson bosib olishlarini davom ettirardi.

en: He had defeated and slain King Josiah of Judah, a small country of which there is more to tell presently, at the battle of Megiddo in 608 B.C., and he pushed on to the Euphrates to encounter not a decadent Assyria but a renascent Baby- lonia.
uz: U miloddan avvalgi 608-yilda Megido jangida Yahudo shohi Yoshiyoni maglub etgan va oldirgan edi. Bu kichik davlat haqida hozirda koproq malumot bor. Va u vayron bolgan Ossuriyaga emas, balki qayta tugilgan Baby-loniaga duch kelish uchun Furot daryosiga bordi.

en: The Chaldeans dealt very vigorously with the Egyptians.
uz: Xaldeylar misrliklar bilan juda shiddatli munosabatda bo'lishdi.

en: Necho was routed and driven back to Egypt, and the Babylonian frontier pushed down to the ancient Egyptian boundaries.
uz: Nexo mag'lub etilib, Misrga qaytarildi va Bobil chegarasi qadimgi Misr chegaralarigacha itarildi.

en: From 606 until 589 B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 606 yildan 589 yilgacha.

en: the Second Babylonian Empire ﬂourished inse- curely.
uz: Ikkinchi Bobil imperiyasi juda gullab-yashnadi.

en: It ﬂourished so long as it kept the peace with the stronger, hardier
uz: U kuchliroq, qat'iyatli bilan tinchlikni saqlagan sari gullab-yashnadi.

en: Median Empire to the north.
uz: Shimoliy tomondagi O'rtacha Imperiya.

en: And during these sixty-seven years not only life but learning ﬂourished in the ancient city.
uz: Va bu oltmish yetti yil davomida nafaqat hayot, balki ta'lim ham qadimiy shaharda gullab-yashnadi.

en: Even under the Assyrian monarchs and especially under Sardanapalus, Babylon had been a scene of great intellectual activity.
uz: Hatto Ossuriya monarxlari davrida ham, ayniqsa Sardanapalus davrida ham Bobil buyuk intellektual faoliyat sahnasi bo'lgan.

en: Sardanapalus, though an Assyrian, had been quite Babylon-ized.
uz: Sardanapalus, garchi ossuriyalik bo'lsa ham, ancha Bobilga aylangan edi.

en: He made a library, a li- brary not of paper but of the clay tablets that were used for writing in Mesopotamia since early Sumerian days.
uz: U kitobxona yaratdi, qog'ozdan emas, balki Mesopotamiyada Shumer davrining boshidan beri yozish uchun ishlatilgan loydan yasalgan lavhalardan.

en: His collection has been unearthed and is perhaps the most precious store of historical material in the world.
uz: Uning to'plami topildi va ehtimol dunyodagi eng qimmatli tarixiy materiallar ombori hisoblanadi.

en: The last of the Chaldean line of Babylonian monarchs, Nabonidus, had even keener literary tastes.
uz: Bobil monarxlarining Xaldey silsilasining oxirgisi Nabonid yanada g'ayrioddiy adabiy didga ega edi.

en: He patronized antiquarian researches, and when a date was worked out by his investigators for the accession of Sargon I he commemorated the fact by inscriptions.
uz: U antikvar tadqiqotlarga homiylik qildi va o'z tergovchilari tomonidan Sargon I'ning qo'shilishi uchun sana ishlab chiqilganda, u bu faktni yozuvlar bilan xotirladi.

en: But there were many signs of dis- union in his empire, and he sought to centralize it by bringing a number of the various local gods to Babylon and setting up temples to them there.
uz: Ammo uning imperiyasida birlashuv alomatlari ko'p edi va u Bobilga bir qator mahalliy xudolarni olib kelib, ularga u yerda ibodatxonalar o'rnatish orqali uni markazlashtirishga harakat qildi.

en: This device was to be practised quite successfully by the Romans in later times, but in Babylon it roused the jealousy of the powerful priesthood of Bel Marduk, the dominant god of the Babylonians.
uz: Bu qurilma keyinchalik rimliklar tomonidan ancha muvaffaqiyatli qo'llanilishi kerak edi, lekin Bobilda u Bobilliklarning hukmron xudosi bo'lgan Bel Mardukning qudratli ruhoniylarining rashqini uyg'otdi.

en: They cast about for a possi- ble alternative to Nabonidus and found it in Cyrus the Persian, the ruler of
uz: Ular Nabonidga ehtimoliy muqobil izlashdi va uni Forslik Kirda, hukmdorda topdilar.

en: the adjacent Median Empire.
uz: Qo'shni Mediya imperiyasi.

en: Cyrus had already distinguished himself by conquering Croesus, the rich king of Lydia in Eastern Asia Minor.
uz: Kir allaqachon Sharqiy Kichik Osiyoda Lidiyaning boy shohi Xreysni zabt etish orqali o'zini ajratib ko'rsatgan edi.

en: He came up against Babylon, there was a battle outside the walls, and the gates of the city were opened to him (538 B.C.).
uz: U Bobilga qarshi chiqdi, devorlar tashqarisida jang bo'ldi va shahar darvozalari unga ochildi (miloddan avvalgi 538-yil).

en: His soldiers entered the city without ﬁghting.
uz: Uning askarlari jang qilmasdan shaharga kirishdi.

en: The crown prince Belshazzar, the son of Nabonidus, was feasting, the Bible relates, when a hand appeared and wrote in letters of ﬁre upon the wall these mystical words: “Mene, Mene, Tekel, Upharsin,” which was in- terpreted by the prophet Daniel, whom he summoned to read the riddle, as “God has numbered thy kingdom and ﬁnished it; thou art weighed in the balance and found wanting and thy kingdom is given to the Medes and Per- sians.” Possibly the priests of Bel Marduk knew something about that writ- ing on the wall.
uz: Nabonidning o'g'li valiahd shahzoda Belshazzar ziyofat qilayotgan edi, Injilda aytilishicha, bir qo'l paydo bo'lib, devorga olovli harflar bilan quyidagi mistik so'zlarni yozdi: Mene, Mene, Tekel, Ufarsin, bu so'zlarni payg'ambar Daniel talqin qilgan edi, uni u topishmani o'qishga chaqirgan edi, ya'ni: Xudo sening shohligingni sanadi va uni tugatdi; sen tarozida tortib, yetishmayotganingni topding va shohliging Medlar va Per-siyanlarga berilgan. Ehtimol, Bel Marduk ruhoniylari bu yozuv haqida nimadir bilishardi.

en: Belshazzar was killed that night, says the Bible.
uz: Muqaddas Kitobda aytilishicha, Belshashar o'sha kechada o'ldirilgan.

en: Nabonidus was taken prisoner, and the occupation of the city was so peaceful that the services of Bel Marduk continued without intermission.
uz: Nabonid asirga olindi va shaharni bosib olish shunchalik tinch ediki, Bel Mardukning xizmatlari tinimsiz davom etdi.

en: PERSIAN MONARCH  From the ruins of Persepolis  Photo: Miss F.
uz: PERSONA MONARCH Persepolis xarobalaridan Foto: Miss F.

en: Biggs Thus it was the Babylonian and Median empires were united.
uz: Kattaliklar Shunday qilib, Bobil va Med imperiyalari birlashgan edi.

en: Cambyses, the son of Cyrus, subjugated Egypt.
uz: Komis, Kirning o'g'li Misrni bo'ysundirdi.

en: Cambyses went mad and was acciden- tally killed, and was presently succeeded by Darius the Mede, Darius I, the son of Hystaspes, one of the chief councillors of Cyrus.
uz: Kambis aqldan ozdi va tasodifan o'ldirildi va uning o'rnini hozirda Kur'ning bosh maslahatchilaridan biri bo'lgan Hystaspesning o'g'li Darius I, Med davlati egalladi.

en: THE RUINS OF PERSEPOLIS  The capital city of the Persian Empire; burnt by Alexander the Great  Photo: Major W.
uz: PERSEPOLIS XALQARI Fors imperiyasining poytaxti shahri; Aleksandr Buyuk tomonidan yoqib yuborilgan. Surat: Mayor W.

en: THE GREAT PORCH OF XERXES, AT PERSEPOLIS  Photo: Major W.
uz: KERXESNING BUYUK GURUHI, PERSEPOLISDA Foto: Mayor W.

en: Rodd The Persian Empire of Darius I, the ﬁrst of the new Aryan empires in the seat of the old civilizations, was the greatest empire the world had hitherto seen.
uz: Rodd: Daryo I ning Fors imperiyasi, eski sivilizatsiyalar o'rnidagi yangi Aryo imperiyalarining birinchisi, dunyo shu paytgacha ko'rgan eng buyuk imperiya edi.

en: It included all Asia Minor and Syria, all the old Assyrian and Baby- lonian empires, Egypt, the Caucasus and Caspian regions, Media, Persia, and it extended into India as far as the Indus.
uz: Unga butun Kichik Osiyo va Suriya, barcha eski Ossuriya va Baby-lon imperiyalari, Misr, Kavkaz va Kaspiy mintaqalari, Osiyo, Fors kirgan va u Hindistongacha, Ind daryosigacha cho'zilgan.

en: Such an empire was possible because the horse and rider and the chariot and the made-road had now been brought into the world.
uz: Bunday imperiya shunday bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki ot va chavandoz, arava va yasama yo'l endi dunyoga keltirilgan edi.

en: Hitherto the ass and ox and the camel for desert use had afforded the swiftest method of transport.
uz: Hozirgacha cho'lda foydalanish uchun eshak, ho'kiz va tuyaning eng tezkor transport usulini ta'minlagan edi.

en: Great arterial roads were made by the Persian rulers to hold their new empire, and post horses were always in waiting for the imperial messenger or the traveller with an ofﬁcial permit.
uz: Fors hukmdorlari tomonidan o'zlarining yangi imperiyasini ushlab turish uchun katta arterial yo'llar qurilgan va pochta otlari doimo imperator elchisini yoki rasmiy ruxsat bilan sayohatchiga kutishardi.

en: Moreover the world was now beginning to use coined mon- ey, which greatly facilitated trade and intercourse.
uz: Qolaversa, dunyo endi savdo va jinsiy aloqani sezilarli darajada osonlashtiradigan ixtiro qilingan mon-ey'dan foydalanishni boshlagan edi.

en: But the capital of this vast empire was no longer Babylon.
uz: Ammo bu ulkan imperiyaning poytaxti endi Bobil emas edi.

en: In the long run the priesthood of Bel Marduk gained nothing by their treason.
uz: Uzoq muddatda Bel Marduk ruhoniyligi ularning xiyonatidan hech narsa ololmadi.

en: Babylon though still important was
uz: Bobil baribir muhim edi.

en: now a declining city, and the great cities of the new empire were Persepolis and Susa and Ecbatana.
uz: Hozirda tanazzulga uchrayotgan shahar edi va yangi imperiyaning buyuk shaharlari Persepolis, Susa va Ekbatana edi.

en: The capital was Susa.
uz: Poytaxt Susa edi.

en: Nineveh was already aban- doned and sinking into ruins.
uz: Nineve allaqachon vayron bo'lib, vayronaga aylanib ketgan edi.

en: XXI THE EARLY HISTORY OF THE JEWS And now we can tell of the Hebrews, a Semitic people, not so important in their own time as in their inﬂuence upon the later history of the world.
uz: XXI YAHUDIYLARNING DAVRGI TARIXI Va endi biz ibroniylar haqida, semit xalqidan, o'z davrida dunyoning keyingi tarixiga ta'sirida unchalik muhim emasligini ayta olamiz.

en: They were settled in Judea long before 1000 B.C., and their capital city after that time was Jerusalem.
uz: Ular Yahudiyada miloddan avval 1000 yilgacha joylashgan edilar va o'sha vaqtdan keyin ularning poytaxti Quddus edi.

en: Their story is interwoven with that of the great empires on either side of them, Egypt to the south and the changing empires of Syr- ia, Assyria and Babylon to the north.
uz: Ularning hikoyasi ularning ikki tomonidagi buyuk imperiyalar, janubda Misr va shimolda Suriya, Ossuriya va Bobilning o'zgaruvchan imperiyalari bilan chambarchas bog'langan.

en: Their country was an inevitable high road between these latter powers and Egypt.
uz: Ularning mamlakati bu oxirgi davlatlar va Misr o'rtasidagi muqarrar yo'l edi.

en: Their importance in the world is due to the fact that they produced a writ- ten literature, a world history, a collection of laws, chronicles, psalms, books of wisdom, poetry and ﬁction and political utterances which became at last what Christians know as the Old Testament, the Hebrew Bible.
uz: Ularning dunyodagi ahamiyati shundan kelib chiqadi, chunki ular o'n yillik adabiyot, jahon tarixi, qonunlar, solnomalar, zabtlar, donolik kitoblari, she'riyat va badiiy adabiyot hamda siyosiy nutqlarni yaratdilar, ular oxir-oqibatda xristianlar Eski Ahd deb biladigan narsalarga, Ibroniy Injilga aylandilar.

en: This literature appears in history in the fourth or ﬁfth century B.C.
uz: Bu adabiyot miloddan avvalgi to'rtinchi yoki beshinchi asrda tarixda paydo bo'lgan.

en: Probably this literature was ﬁrst put together in Babylon.
uz: Ehtimol, bu adabiyot birinchi marta Bobilda yig'ilgan.

en: We have al- ready told how the Pharaoh, Necho II, invaded the Assyrian Empire while Assyria was ﬁghting for life against Medes, Persians and Chaldeans.
uz: Biz Fir'avn Nexo II ning Ossuriya imperiyasiga qanday hujum qilganini, Ossuriya Med, Fors va Xaldeylarga qarshi hayot uchun kurashayotganida, allaqachon aytib berganmiz.

en: Josiah King of Judah opposed him, and was defeated and slain at Megiddo (608 B.C.).
uz: Yahudo shohi Yoʻshiyo unga qarshi chiqdi va Megidoda magʻlub boʻldi va qirib tashlandi (miloddan avvalgi 608-yil).

en: Judah became a tributary to Egypt, and when Nebuchadnezzar the Great, the new Chaldean king in Babylon, rolled back Necho into Egypt, he attempted to manage Judah by setting up puppet kings in Jerusalem.
uz: Yahudo Misr daryosiga aylandi va Bobildagi yangi xaldey shohi Nabukadnezzar Nexoni Misrga qaytarganida, u Yahudoga qo'g'irchoq shohlarni Quddusda o'rnatish orqali rahbarlik qilishga urindi.

en: The experiment failed, the people massacred his Babylonian ofﬁcials, and he then determined to break up this little state altogether, which had long been playing off Egypt against the northern empire.
uz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, xalq uning Bobil amaldorlarini qirib tashladi va keyin u uzoq vaqtdan beri Misrni shimoliy imperiyaga qarshi o'ynatib kelayotgan bu kichik davlatni butunlay parchalashga qaror qildi.

en: Jerusalem was sacked and burnt, and the remnant of the people was carried off captive to Babylon.
uz: Quddus talon-toroj qilindi va yoqildi, qolgan xalq esa Bobilga asirga olib ketildi.

en: There they remained until Cyrus took Babylon (538 B.C.).
uz: Ular u yerda Kir Bobilni bosib olguncha (miloddan avvalgi 538-yil).

en: He then col- lected them together and sent them back to resettle their country and rebuild the walls and temple of Jerusalem.
uz: Keyin u ularni birga yig'di va o'z yurtlarini qayta joylashtirish va Quddus devorlari va ibodatxonasini qayta qurish uchun ularni qaytarib yubordi.

en: Before that time the Jews do not seem to have been a very civilized or united people.
uz: O'sha vaqtgacha yahudiylar juda madaniyatli yoki birlashgan xalq bo'lmagan ko'rinadi.

en: Probably only a very few of them could read or write.
uz: Ehtimol, ularning faqat ozchiligi o'qiy yoki yozishi mumkin edi.

en: In their own history one never hears of the early books of the Bible being read; the ﬁrst mention of a book is in the time of Josiah.
uz: Ularning o'z tarixida Injilning dastlabki kitoblari o'qilganini hech qachon eshitish mumkin emas; kitob haqida birinchi marta Yo'shiyo davrida tilga olinadi.

en: The Babylonian captivity civilized them and consolidated them.
uz: Bobil asirligi ularni madaniylashtirdi va mustahkamladi.

en: They returned aware of their own lit- erature, an acutely self-conscious and political people.
uz: Ular o'z adabiyotiga, o'ta o'z-o'zini anglaydigan va siyosiy xalqqa e'tibor berishdi.

en: Their Bible at that time seems to have consisted only of the Pentateuch, that is to say the ﬁrst ﬁve books of the Old Testament as we know it.
uz: Ularning o'sha paytdagi Bibliyasi faqat Pentateukdan iborat bo'lganga o'xshardi, ya'ni biz bilgan Eski Ahdning dastlabki besh kitobidan iborat edi.

en: In ad- dition, as separate books they already had many of the other books that have since been incorporated with the Pentateuch into the present Hebrew Bible, Chronicles, the Psalms and Proverbs for example.
uz: Qoʻshimcha ravishda, alohida kitoblar sifatida ularning allaqachon koʻplab boshqa kitoblari bor edi, ular oʻshandan beri Pentateuch bilan birga hozirgi Ibroniy Injil, Solnomalar, Zabur va Hikmatlarga qoʻshilgan, masalan.

en: The accounts of the Creation of the World, of Adam and Eve and of the Flood, with which the Bible begins, run closely parallel with similar Baby- lonian legends; they seem to have been part of the common beliefs of all the Semitic peoples.
uz: Dunyo yaratilishi, Odam Ato va Momo Havo va To'fon haqidagi rivoyatlar, Injil bilan boshlanishi, xuddi shunday bolalar-yolg'iz afsonalar bilan yaqin parallelga kiradi; ular barcha semit xalqlarining umumiy e'tiqodlarining bir qismi bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: So too the stories of Moses and of Samson have Sumerian and Babylonian parallels.
uz: Xuddi shunday, Muso va Shimson haqidagi hikoyalarda Shumer va Bobil o'xshashliklari ham bor.

en: But with the story of Abraham and onward begins something more special to the Jewish race.
uz: Ammo Ibrohimning hikoyasi bilan yahudiy irqi uchun yanada o'zgacha narsa boshlanadi.

en: Abraham may have lived as early as the days of Hammurabi in Babylon.
uz: Ibrohim Bobilda Hammurabi davridayoq yashagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He was a patriarchal Semitic nomad.
uz: U patriarxal semit ko'chmanchisi edi.

en: To the book of Genesis the reader must go for the story of his wanderings and for the stories of his sons and grandchildren and how they became captive in the Land of Egypt.
uz: Ibtido kitobiga o'quvchi o'zining sarguzashtlari, o'g'illari va nevaralarining Misr zaminida qanday asirga aylanganliklari haqidagi hikoyalarini topishi kerak.

en: He trav- elled through Canaan, and the God of Abraham, says the Bible story, promised this smiling land of prosperous cities to him and to his children.
uz: U Kan'on bo'ylab sayohat qildi va Injil hikoyasida aytilishicha, Ibrohimning Xudosi unga va uning bolalariga bu tabassumli, farovon shaharlar yerini va'da qildi.

en: And after a long sojourn in Egypt and after ﬁfty years of wandering in the wilderness under the leadership of Moses, the children of Abraham, grown now to a host of twelve tribes, invaded the land of Canaan from the Arabian deserts to the East.
uz: Misrda uzoq vaqt qolgach va Muso boshchiligida sahroda ellik yil sarguzasht qilganidan so'ng, Ibrohimning o'g'illari, hozirda o'n ikki qabiladan iborat qo'lga aylanib, Arabiston cho'llaridan sharqqacha bo'lgan Kan'on yurtiga bostirib kirdilar.

en: They may have done this somewhen between 1600 B.C.
uz: Ular buni miloddan avvalgi 1600 yillar oralig'ida qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: and 1300 B.C.; there are no Egyptian records of Moses nor of Canaan at this time to help out the story.
uz: va miloddan avvalgi 1300 yil; bu davrda Muso haqida yoki Kan'on haqida misrlik yozuvlar yo'q bo'lib, bu hikoyani to'ldirishga yordam beradi.

en: But at any rate they did not suc- ceed in conquering any more than the hilly backgrounds of the promised land.
uz: Lekin har qanday holatda ham ular va'da qilingan yurtning tepalik hududlaridan ko'ra ko'proq narsani zabt etishga muvaffaq bo'lishmadi.

en: The coast was now in the hands, not of the Canaanites but of newcom- ers, those Ægean peoples, the Philistines; and their cities, Gaza, Gath, Ash-
uz: Sohil endi kan'onliklarning emas, balki yangi kelganlarning, filistimliklarning qo'lida edi; va ularning shaharlari, G'azo, G'ath, Ash.

en: dod, Ascalon and Joppa successfully withstood the Hebrew attack.
uz: dod, Askalon va Yofa ibroniy hujumga muvaffaqiyatli bardosh berishdi.

en: For many generations the children of Abraham remained an obscure people of the hilly back country engaged in incessant bickerings with the Philistines and with the kindred tribes about them, the Moabites, the Midianites and so forth.
uz: Ko'p avlodlar davomida Ibrohimning o'g'illari tog'li orqa yurtning noma'lum xalqi bo'lib qoldilar, Filistimliklar va ularning atrofidagi qarindosh qabilalar, Moabliklar, Midyonliklar va hokazolar bilan tinimsiz bahslashdilar.

en: The reader will ﬁnd in the book of Judges a record of their struggles and disasters during this period.
uz: O'quvchi Hakamlar kitobida bu davrdagi kurashlari va falokatlari haqida yozuv topadi.

en: For very largely it is a record of disasters and failures frankly told.
uz: Ko'p jihatdan bu ochiqchasiga aytilgan falokatlar va muvaffaqiyatsizliklar yozuvidir.

en: For most of this period the Hebrews were ruled, so far as there was any rule among them, by priestly judges selected by the elders of the people, but
uz: Ushbu davrning ko'p qismida ibroniylar xalq oqsoqollari tomonidan tanlangan ruhoniy sudyalar tomonidan boshqarilardi, agar ular orasida qandaydir qoida bo'lsa, lekin...

en: at last somewhen towards 1000 B.C.
uz: Nihoyat, miloddan avvalgi 1000 yilga yaqin.

en: they chose themselves a king, Saul, to lead them in battle.
uz: Ular o'zlariga jangda boshchilik qilish uchun shoh, Shoulni tanladilar.

en: But Saul’s leading was no great improvement upon the leading of the Judges; he perished under the hail of Philistine arrows at the battle of Mount Gilboa, his armour went into the temple of the Philistine Venus, and his body was nailed to the walls of Beth-shan.
uz: Ammo Shoulning yetakchiligi hakamlarning yetakchiligiga nisbatan katta yaxshilanish bo'lmadi; u Gilbo'a tog'idagi jangda filistimlik o'qlarning yomg'iri ostida halok bo'ldi, uning zirhi filistimlik Venera ibodatxonasiga kirdi va uning tanasi Bet-shan devorlariga mixlandi.

en: THE MOUND AT BABYLON  Beneath which are the remains of a great palace of Nebuchadnezzar  Photo: Underwood & Underwood
uz: BABILDAGI TO'G'O. Quyida Navuxodnezarning buyuk saroyining qoldiqlari bor. Surat: Underwood & Underwood

en: His successor David was more successful and more politic.
uz: Uning vorisi Devid muvaffaqiyatliroq va siyosiyroq edi.

en: With David dawned the only period of prosperity the Hebrew peoples were ever to know.
uz: Dovud bilan ibroniy xalqlari bilgan yagona farovonlik davri paydo bo'ldi.

en: It was based on a close alliance with the Phœnician city of Tyre, whose King Hiram seems to have been a man of very great intelligence and enterprise.
uz: U Finikiyalik Tir shahri bilan yaqin ittifoqqa asoslangan edi, uning qiroli Xiram juda buyuk aql va ishbilarmon inson bo'lgan ko'rinadi.

en: He wished to secure a trade route to the Red Sea through the He- brew hill country.
uz: U He-brew tepaligi orqali Qizil dengizga savdo yo'lini ta'minlamoqchi edi.

en: Normally Phœnician trade went to the Red Sea by Egypt, but Egypt was in a state of profound disorder at this time; there may have been other obstructions to Phœnician trade along this line, and at any rate Hiram established the very closest relations both with David and with his son and successor Solomon.
uz: Odatda Finikiy savdosi Misr orqali Qizil dengizga borardi, lekin Misr o'sha paytda chuqur tartibsizlik holatida edi; bu yo'nalishda Finikiy savdosiga boshqa to'siqlar bo'lishi mumkin edi va hech qanday holatda Xiram Dovud bilan ham, o'g'li va vorisi Sulaymon bilan ham eng yaqin munosabatlarni o'rnatgan.

en: Under Hiram’s auspices the walls, palace and temple of Jerusalem arose, and in return Hiram built and launched his ships on the Red Sea.
uz: Hirom homiyligida Quddus devorlari, saroyi va ma'badi paydo bo'ldi va buning evaziga Hirom Qizil dengizda o'z kemalarini qurdi va ishga tushirdi.

en: A very considerable trade passed northward and southward through Jerusalem.
uz: Quddus orqali shimolga va janubga juda katta savdo o'tdi.

en: And Solomon achieved a prosperity and magniﬁcence unprecedented in the experience of his people.
uz: Va Sulaymon o'z xalqining tajribasida misli ko'rilmagan farovonlik va ulug'vorlikka erishdi.

en: He was even given a daugh- ter of Pharaoh in marriage.
uz: Unga hatto Fir'avnning qizini ham turmushga berishdi.

en: But it is well to keep the proportion of things in mind.
uz: Lekin narsalar nisbatini yodda tutgan ma'qul.

en: At the climax of his glories Solomon was only a little subordinate king in a little city.
uz: Shon-shuhratining eng yuqori cho'qqisida Sulaymon kichik bir shaharda ozgina bo'ysunuvchi shoh edi.

en: His power was so transitory that within a few years of his death, Shishak the ﬁrst Pharaoh of the twenty-second dynasty, had taken Jerusalem and looted most of its splendours.
uz: Uning hokimiyati shunchalik o'tkinch ediki, o'limidan bir necha yil o'tmay, yigirma ikkinchi sulola birinchi fir'avni Shishak Quddusni egallab, uning aksariyat hashamatini talon-toroj qildi.

en: The account of Solomon’s magniﬁcence given in the books of Kings and Chronicles is questioned by many critics.
uz: Sulaymonning shohlar va Solnoma kitoblarida keltirilgan ulug'vorligi haqidagi hikoya ko'plab tanqidchilar tomonidan shubha ostiga qo'yiladi.

en: They say that it was added to and exaggerated by the patriotic pride of later writers.
uz: Aytishlaricha, u keyingi yozuvchilarning vatanparvarlik g'ururi bilan qo'shilgan va haddan tashqari oshirilgan.

en: But the Bible account read carefully is not so overwhelming as it appears at the ﬁrst reading.
uz: Lekin diqqat bilan o'qilgan Injil rivoyati birinchi o'qishda ko'ringandek juda ham hayratlanarli emas.

en: Solomon’s temple, if one works out the measurements, would go inside a small suburban church, and his fourteen hundred chariots cease to impress us when we learn from an Assyrian monument that his successor Ahab sent a contingent of two thousand to the Assyrian army.
uz: Sulaymonning ma'badi, agar o'lchovlarni tuzib chiqilsa, kichik shahar chekkasidagi cherkov ichiga kirardi va uning o'n to'rt yuz aravalari bizni Ossuriya yodgorligidan uning vorisi Axabning Ossuriya armiyasiga ikki ming kishilik tarkib yuborganini o'rganganimizda hayratda qoldirishdan to'xtaydi.

en: It is also plainly manifest from the Bible narrative that Solomon spent himself in dis- play and overtaxed and overworked his people.
uz: Muqaddas Kitob rivoyatidan ham yaqqol ko'rinib turibdiki, Sulaymon o'zini beparvolik bilan o'ynagan, xalqini ortiqcha soliqlar bilan to'ldirgan va ishdan chiqarib yuborgan.

en: At his death the northern part of his kingdom broke off from Jerusalem and became the independent kingdom of Israel.
uz: Uning vafotida uning shohligining shimoliy qismi Quddusdan ajralib chiqib, Isroil mustaqil shohligiga aylandi.

en: Jerusalem remained the capital city of Judah.
uz: Quddus Yahudo poytaxti bo'lib qoldi.

en: THE ISHTAR GATEWAY, BABYLON  The bulls are in richly coloured enamel on baked brick  Photo: Underwood & Underwood The prosperity of the Hebrew people was short-lived.
uz: ISHTAR GATEWEY, BABILON Buqalar pishirilgan g'isht ustida boy rangli emalda. Surat: Underwood & Underwood Ibroniy xalqining farovonligi qisqa umr ko'rdi.

en: Hiram died, and the help of Tyre ceased to strengthen Jerusalem.
uz: Xiram vafot etdi va Tirning yordami Quddusni mustahkamlashdan to'xtadi.

en: Egypt grew strong again.
uz: Misr yana kuchaydi.

en: The history of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah becomes a history of two little states ground between, ﬁrst, Syria, then Assyria and then Baby-
uz: Isroil va Yahudo shohlarining tarixi, avvalo, Suriya, keyin Ossuriya va keyin Baby o'rtasida joylashgan ikkita kichik davlat tarixiga aylanadi.

en: lon to the north and Egypt to the south.
uz: Shimolga lon, janubga Misr.

en: It is a tale of disasters and of deliv- erances that only delayed disaster.
uz: Bu falokatlarni kechiktirgan falokatlar va qutqaruv ertaklaridir.

en: It is a tale of barbaric kings ruling a bar- baric people.
uz: Bu barbar xalqni hukmronlik qilayotgan vahshiy podshohlar haqidagi ertak.

en: the kingdom of Israel was swept away into captivi- ty by the Assyrians and its people utterly lost to history.
uz: Isroil shohligi ossuriyaliklar tomonidan asirga olib ketildi va uning xalqi butunlay tarixga yo'qoldi.

en: Judah struggled on until in 604 B.C., as we have told, it shared the fate of Israel.
uz: Yahudiy miloddan avvalgi 604-yilgacha kurashdi, aytganimizdek, u Isroil taqdiriga sherik edi.

en: There may be details open to criticism in the Bible story of Hebrew history from the days of the Judges onward, but on the whole it is evidently a true story which squares with all that has been learnt in the excavation of Egypt and Assyria and Babylon during the past century.
uz: Bibliyada yahudiy tarixining Hakamlar davridan boshlab tanqidga ochiq tafsilotlar bo'lishi mumkin, lekin umuman olganda, bu Misr, Ossuriya va Bobilning o'tgan asrdagi qazishlarida o'rganilgan barcha narsalar bilan bir xil bo'lgan haqiqiy hikoya ekanligi aniq.

en: It was in Babylon that the Hebrew people got their history together and evolved their tradition.
uz: Ibroniy xalqi o'z tarixini aynan Bobilda birlashtirib, o'z an'analarini rivojlantirdi.

en: The people who came back to Jerusalem at the com- mand of Cyrus were a very different people in spirit and knowledge from those who had gone into captivity.
uz: Kirning buyrug'i bilan Quddusga qaytgan odamlar asirlikda bo'lganlardan ruh va bilim jihatidan juda farq qilgan xalq edi.

en: They had learnt civilization.
uz: Ular sivilizatsiyani o'rganishgan edi.

en: In the de- velopment of their peculiar character a very great part was played by certain men, a new sort of men, the Prophets, to whom we must now direct our at- tention.
uz: Ularning o'ziga xos xarakterini rivojlantirishda muayyan odamlar, yangi turdagi odamlar, Payg'ambarlar juda katta rol o'ynadi, ularga hozir e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.

en: These Prophets mark the appearance of new and remarkable forces in the steady development of human society.
uz: Bu Payg'ambarlar insoniyat jamiyatining barqaror rivojlanishida yangi va ajoyib kuchlarning paydo bo'lishini belgilaydi.

en: XXII PRIESTS AND PROPHETS IN JUDEA The fall of Assyria and Babylon were only the ﬁrst of a series of disasters that were to happen to the Semitic peoples.
uz: Yahudiyadagi XXII RAHIMLAR VA PROFETLAR Ossuriya va Bobilning qulashi semit xalqlariga yetkazilishi kerak bo'lgan bir qator falokatlarning birinchisidir.

en: In the seventh century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi yettinchi asrda.

en: it would have seemed as though the whole civilized world was to be dominat- ed by Semitic rulers.
uz: Go'yo butun madaniy dunyo semit hukmdorlari tomonidan hukmronlik qilinayotgandek tuyulgan bo'lardi.

en: They ruled the great Assyrian empire and they had conquered Egypt; Assyria, Babylon, Syria were all Semitic, speaking lan- guages that were mutually intelligible.
uz: Ular buyuk Ossuriya imperiyasini boshqardilar va Misrni zabt etishdi; Ossuriya, Bobil, Suriya hammasi semit, o'zaro tushunarli tillarda gapirardi.

en: The trade of the world was in Sem- itic hands.
uz: Dunyo savdosi Sem-it qo'llarida edi.

en: Tyre, Sidon, the great mother cities of the Phœnician coast, had thrown out colonies that grew at last to even greater proportion in Spain, Sicily and Africa.
uz: Tir, Sidon, Fenisiy qirg'og'ining buyuk ona shaharlari, Ispaniyada, Sitsiliyada va Afrikada nihoyat yanada katta ulushga ega bo'lgan mustamlakalarni haydab chiqargan edi.

en: Carthage, founded before 800 B.C., had risen to a popula- tion of more than a million.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 800 yilgacha asos solingan Karfagen aholisi milliondan oshgan edi.

en: It was for a time the greatest city on earth.
uz: Bir vaqtlar u yer yuzidagi eng buyuk shahar edi.

en: Its ships went to Britain and out into the Atlantic.
uz: Uning kemalari Britaniyaga bordi va Atlantika okeaniga chiqdi.

en: They may have reached Madeira.
uz: Ular Madeiraga yetib borgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: We have already noted how Hiram co-operated with Solomon to build ships on the Red Sea for the Arabian and perhaps for the Indian trade.
uz: Biz allaqachon Hiram Sulaymon bilan Qizil dengizda Arab va ehtimol Hindiston savdosi uchun kemalar qurishda qanday hamkorlik qilganini qayd etganmiz.

en: In the time of the Pharaoh Necho, a Phœnician expedition sailed completely round Africa.
uz: Fir'avn Necho davrida Finoniyalik ekspeditsiya butun Afrikani aylanib chiqdi.

en: At that time the Aryan peoples were still barbarians.
uz: O'sha paytda ariy xalqlari hali ham vahshiylar edi.

en: Only the Greeks were reconstructing a new civilization of the ruins of the one they had de- stroyed, and the Medes were becoming “formidable,” as an Assyrian in- scription calls them, in central Asia.
uz: Faqatgina yunonlar o'zlari qurib tashlagan xarobalardan yangi tsivilizatsiyani qayta tiklayotgan edi va medlar Osiyo markaziy qismida, ossuriyalik yozuvda aytilishicha, asror bo'ladigan bo'lib borayotgan edi.

en: no one could have prophe- sied that before the third century B.C.
uz: Hech kim miloddan avvalgi uchinchi asrdan oldin bashorat qila olmas edi.

en: every trace of Semitic dominion would be wiped out by Aryan-speaking conquerors, and that everywhere the Sem- itic peoples would be subjects or tributaries or scattered altogether.
uz: Semit hukmronligining har bir izi ariy tilli bosqinchilar tomonidan yo'q qilinadi va hamma joyda semit xalqlari sub'ekt yoki irmoq bo'ladi yoki butunlay tarqalgan bo'ladi.

en: Every- where except in the northern deserts of Arabia, where the Bedouin adhered steadily to the nomadic way of life, the ancient way of life of the Semites
uz: Arabistonning shimoliy cho'llaridan tashqari hamma joyda, u yerda badaviylar ko'chmanchi hayot tarziga, semitlarning qadimiy hayot tarziga qat'iy amal qilishardi.

en: before Sargon I and his Akkadians went down to conquer Sumeria.
uz: Sargon I va uning akkadlari Shumeryani zabt etish uchun tushishdan oldin.

en: But the Arab Bedouin were never conquered by Aryan masters.
uz: Ammo arab badaviylari hech qachon ariy ustalari tomonidan zabt etilmagan.

en: Now of all these civilized Semites who were beaten and overrun in these ﬁve eventful centuries one people only held together and clung to its an- cient traditions and that was this little people, the Jews, who were sent back to build their city of Jerusalem by Cyrus the Persian.
uz: Endi, ushbu beshta voqea-hodisalarga boy asrda mag'lub etilgan va bosib olingan barcha madaniy semitlardan faqat bitta odam birdam bo'lib, o'zining an-cient an'analariga sodiq qoldi va bu kichik xalq edi, yahudiylar, ular Quddus shahri qurilishi uchun Fors Kir tomonidan qaytarib yuborilgan edi.

en: And they were able to do this, because they had got together this literature of theirs, their Bible, in Babylon.
uz: Va ular buni qila olishdi, chunki ular o'zlarining adabiyotlarini, Injillarini Bobilda yig'ishgan edi.

en: It is not so much the Jews who made the Bible as the Bible which made the Jews.
uz: Muqaddas Kitobni yahudiylar emas, balki Injil yahudiylarni yaratgan.

en: Running through this Bible were certain ideas, different from the ideas of the people about them, very stimulating and sustaining ideas, to which they were destined to cling through ﬁve and twenty cen- turies of hardship, adventure and oppression.
uz: Ushbu Injilni o'rganish odamlarning o'z haqidagi fikrlaridan farq qiladigan, juda rag'batlantiruvchi va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi fikrlar edi, ularga qiyinchilik, sarguzasht va zulmning yigirma besh asridan o'tishga mahkum edilar.

en: Foremost of these Jewish ideas was this, that their God was invisible and remote, an invisible God in a temple not made with hands, a Lord of Right- eousness throughout the earth.
uz: Yahudiylarning bu g'oyalarining eng asosiysi shunda ediki, ularning Xudosi ko'rinmas va uzoq edi, qo'lda qurilmagan ibodatxonada ko'rinmas Xudo, butun yer yuzida Haq-huquq egasi edi.

en: All other peoples had national gods embod- ied in images that lived in temples.
uz: Boshqa barcha xalqlarda milliy xudolar mujassam bo'lgan - har biri ibodatxonalarda yashagan tasvirlarda.

en: If the image was smashed and the tem- ple razed, presently that god died out.
uz: Agar tasvir sindirilgan va mavzu yo'q qilingan bo'lsa, hozirda o'sha xudo yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: But this was a new idea, this God of the Jews, in the heavens, high above priests and sacriﬁces.
uz: Lekin bu yangi g'oya edi, yahudiylarning bu Xudosi, osmonlarda, ruhoniylar va qurbonlardan yuqori.

en: And this God of Abraham, the Jews believed, had chosen them to be his peculiar people, to restore Jerusalem and make it the capital of Righteousness in the World.
uz: Yahudiylar Ishonishgan Ibrohimning bu Xudosi ularni O'zining o'ziga xos xalqi bo'lish uchun, Quddusni tiklash va uni Dunyodagi Adolat poytaxti qilish uchun tanlagan edi.

en: They were a people exalted by their sense of a common destiny.
uz: Ular umumiy taqdir hissi bilan ulug'langan xalq edilar.

en: This belief saturated them all when they returned to Jerusalem after the captivity in Babylon.
uz: Bu e'tiqod ularning barchasini Bobil asirligidan keyin Quddusga qaytganlarida to'yintirdi.

en: Is it any miracle that in their days of overthrow and subjugation many Babylonians and Syrians and so forth and later on many Phœnicians, speak- ing practically the same language and having endless customs, habits, tastes and traditions in common, should be attracted by this inspiring cult and should seek to share in its fellowship and its promise?
uz: O'zlarining ag'darilish va bo'ysundirish davrlarida ko'plab Bobilliklar va suriyaliklar va hokazo va keyinchalik ko'plab finikiylar, amalda bir xil tilda gapiradigan va cheksiz urf-odatlar, odatlar, didlar va an'analarga ega bo'lganlar, ushbu ilhomlantiruvchi kultga jalb qilinishi va uning do'stligi va va'dasida ishtirok etishga intilishi mo'jiza bo'ladimi?

en: After the fall of Tyre, Sidon, Carthage and the Spanish Phœnician cities, the Phœnicians suddenly vanish from history; and as suddenly we ﬁnd, not simply in Jerusalem but in Spain, Africa, Egypt, Arabia, the East, wherever the Phœnicians had set their feet, communities of Jews.
uz: Tir, Sidon, Karfagen va Ispaniyalik Fenikiy shaharlari qulagandan so'ng, Fenikiylar to'satdan tarixdan g'oyib bo'lishdi; va to'satdan, faqat Quddusda emas, balki Ispaniya, Afrika, Misr, Arabiston, Sharqda, Fenikiylar oyoq qo'ygan har qanday joyda yahudiylar jamoalarini topamiz.

en: And they were all held together by the Bible and by the reading of the Bible.
uz: Va ularning hammasi Injil va Injil o'qilishi bilan birga edi.

en: Jerusalem was from the ﬁrst only their nominal capital; their real city was this book of books.
uz: Quddus dastlab faqatgina ularning nominal poytaxti edi; ularning haqiqiy shahri bu kitoblar kitobi edi.

en: This is a new sort of thing in history.
uz: Bu tarixga yangi turdagi narsa.

en: It is something of which the seeds were sown long before, when the Sumerians and Egyptians began to turn their hieroglyphics
uz: Bu urug'lari ancha oldin, Shumerlar va Misrliklar o'z ierogliflarini o'zgartira boshlagan paytlarda ekiladigan narsadir.

en: The Jews were a new thing, a people without a king and pres- ently without a temple (for as we shall tell Jerusalem itself was broken up in 70 A.D.), held together and consolidated out of heterogeneous elements by nothing but the power of the written word.
uz: Yahudiylar yangi narsa edilar, shohsiz va asosan ibodatxonasi yo'q xalq edilar (chunki biz Quddusning o'zi milodiy 70-yilda parchalanib ketganini aytamiz), bir-biriga bog'langan va heterogen elementlardan faqatgina yozma so'z kuchi bilan mustahkamlangan edilar.

en: And this mental welding of the Jews was neither planned nor foreseen nor done by either priests or statesmen.
uz: Yahudiylarning bu aqliy payvandlanishi na rejalashtirilgan, na oldindan ko'rilmagan va na ruhoniylar yoki davlat arboblari tomonidan amalga oshirilgan edi.

en: Not only a new kind of community but a new kind of man comes into history with the development of the Jews.
uz: Nafaqat yangi turdagi jamiyat, balki yahudiylarning rivojlanishi bilan yangi turdagi odam ham tarixda kiradi.
