en: In the days of Solomon the Hebrews looked like becoming a little people just like any other little people of that time clustering around court and tem- ple, ruled by the wisdom of the priest and led by the ambition of the king.
uz: Sulaymon davrida ibroniylar o'sha davrdagi har qanday kichik xalq singari kichik xalq bo'lib qolishga o'xshardi, ular saroy va tem-ple atrofida to'planib, ruhoniyning donoligi bilan boshqarilardi va shohning ambitsiyalari bilan boshqarilardi.

en: But already, the reader may learn from the Bible, this new sort of man of which we speak, the Prophet, was in evidence.
uz: Lekin allaqachon o'quvchi Injildan bilib olishi mumkinki, biz gapirayotgan bu yangi turdagi inson, Payg'ambar, dalillar bilan namoyon bo'lgan.

en: As troubles thicken round the divided Hebrews the importance of these Prophets increases.
uz: Bo'linma ibroniylar atrofida muammolar kuchaygan sari, bu Payg'ambarlarning ahamiyati ortadi.

en: THE BLACK OBELISK OF SHALMANESER II  This obelisk (in the British Museum) of the King of Assyria mentions, in cuneiform, “Jehu the son of Omri.” Panel showing Jewish captives bringing tribute What were these Prophets?
uz: SHALMANESER II ning QORA OBELISKASI. Ossuriya qirolining ushbu obeliskasida (Britaniya muzeyida) ignabargli yozuvlarda Ommri o'g'li Yahyo yozilgan. Yahudiy asirlari hurmat keltirayotgan panel bu Payg'ambarlar kim edi?

en: They were men of the most diverse origins.
uz: Ular turli xil kelib chiqishga ega odamlar edilar.

en: The Prophet Ezekiel was of the priestly caste and the Prophet Amos wore the goatskin mantle of a shepherd, but all had this in common, that they gave allegiance to no one but to the God of Righteousness and that they spoke directly to the people.
uz: Payg'ambar Hizqiyo ruhoniylar kastasidan edi va Payg'ambar Amos cho'ponning echki terisidan kiyinardi, lekin ularning barchasida umumiy narsa bor edi: ular Adolat Xudosidan boshqa hech kimga sadoqat ko'rsatmasdilar va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xalqqa murojaat qilishardi.

en: They came without licence or consecration.
uz: Ular litsenziyasiz yoki bag'ishlanmasdan kelishdi.

en: “Now the word of the Lord came unto me;” that was the formula.
uz: Endi menga Egamizning so'zi keldi;  bu formula edi.

en: They were intensely political.
uz: Ular juda siyosiy edilar.

en: They exhorted the people against Egypt, “that bro- ken reed,” or against Assyria or Babylon; they denounced the indolence of the priestly order or the ﬂagrant sins of the King.
uz: Ular xalqni Misrga, osha birodarlikka yoki Ossuriya yoki Bobilga qarshi ogohlantirdilar; ular ruhoniylar tartibining beparvoligini yoki Shohning ochiq gunohlarini qoralashdi.

en: Some of them turned their attention to what we should now call “social reform.” The rich were “grind- ing the faces of the poor,” the luxurious were consuming the children’s bread; wealthy people made friends with and imitated the splendours and vices of foreigners; and this was hateful to Jehovah, the God of Abraham, who would certainly punish this land.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari diqqatini hozir ijtimoiy islohot deb atashimiz kerak bo'lgan narsaga qaratdilar. Boylar faqirlarning yuzini o'g'irlashardi, dabdabalilar bolalarning nonini yeyishardi; boylar begonalarning shon-shuhratlari va yomonliklariga do'stlashib, taqlid qilishardi; va bu Yahova, Ibrohim Xudosi uchun jirkanch edi, u bu yurtni albatta jazolardi.

en: ANOTHER PANEL OF THE BLACK OBELISK  Captive Princes making obeisance to Shalmaneser II These fulminations were written down and preserved and studied.
uz: QORA OBELISKning yana bir paneli. Shalmaneser II ga taslim bo'lgan asir shahzodalar. Bu to'liqliklar yozib olingan, saqlanib qolgan va o'rganilgan.

en: They went wherever the Jews went, and wherever they went they spread a new religious spirit.
uz: Ular yahudiylar borgan joyga bordilar va ular borgan joyga yangi diniy ruh tarqatdilar.

en: They carried the common man past priest and temple, past court and king and brought him face to face with the Rule of Righteousness.
uz: Ular oddiy odamni ruhoniy va ibodatxona, saroy va shoh oldidan olib o'tishdi va uni Adolat Qoidasi bilan yuzma-yuz olib kelishdi.

en: That is their supreme importance in the history of mankind.
uz: Bu ularning insoniyat tarixidagi eng yuqori ahamiyatidir.

en: In the great ut- terances of Isaiah the prophetic voice rises to a pitch of splendid anticipa- tion and foreshadows the whole earth united and at peace under one God.
uz: Ishayo payg'ambarning buyuk so'zlarida bashoratli ovoz ajoyib kutib olish nuqtasiga ko'tariladi va butun yer yuzini bir Xudo ostida birlashgan va tinchlikda bashorat qiladi.

en: Therein the Jewish prophecies culminate.
uz: U yerda yahudiy bashoratlari avj oladi.

en: All the Prophets did not speak in this fashion, and the intelligent reader of the prophetic books will ﬁnd much hate in them, much prejudice, and much that will remind him of the propaganda pamphlets of the present time.
uz: Barcha Payg'ambarlar bu tarzda gapirmagan va payg'ambarlik kitoblarining aqlli o'quvchisi ularda ko'p nafrat, ko'p xurofot va hozirgi zamonning targ'ibot broshyuralarini eslatuvchi ko'p narsalarni topadi.

en: Nevertheless it is the Hebrew Prophets of the period round and about the Babylonian captivity who mark the appearance of a new power in the
uz: Shunga qaramay, aynan o'sha davrdagi va Bobil asirligi haqidagi ibroniy payg'ambarlar yangi kuchning paydo bo'lishini belgilaydilar.

en: world, the power of individual moral appeal, of an appeal to the free con- science of mankind against the fetish sacriﬁces and slavish loyalties that had hitherto bridled and harnessed our race.
uz: Dunyo, individual axloqiy murojaatning kuchi, insoniyatning erkin ilmiy-tadqiqotga murojaatining fetish qurbonliklari va shu paytgacha irqimizni to'sib qo'ygan qullik sadoqatlariga qarshi.

en: XXIII THE GREEKS Now while after Solomon (whose reign was probably about 960 B.C.) the divided kingdoms of Israel and Judah were suffering destruction and depor- tation, and while the Jewish people were developing their tradition in cap- tivity in Babylon, another great power over the human mind, the Greek tra- dition, was also arising.
uz: XXIII GREYLAR Salomondan keyin (uning hukmronligi taxminan miloddan avvalgi 960-yilda bo'lgan) Isroil va Yahudo bo'lingan shohliklari vayronagarchilik va surgunlardan aziyat chekayotgan edi va yahudiylar Bobilda asirlikda o'z an'analarini rivojlantirayotgan paytda, inson ongiga nisbatan yana bir buyuk kuch, yunon an'anasi ham paydo bo'layotgan edi.

en: While the Hebrew prophets were working out a new sense of direct moral responsibility between the people and an eternal and universal God of Right, the Greek philosophers were training the hu- man mind in a new method and spirit of intellectual adventure.
uz: Ibroniy payg'ambarlar xalq va abadiy va universal Haq Xudosi o'rtasida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri axloqiy mas'uliyatning yangi tuyg'usini ishlab chiqayotgan bir paytda, yunon faylasuflari inson ongini yangi usul va intellektual sarguzasht ruhiga o'rgatishardi.

en: The Greek tribes as we have told were a branch of the Aryan- speaking stem.
uz: Biz aytganimizdek, yunon qabilalari ariy tilli zotning bir shoxi edi.

en: They had come down among the Ægean cities and islands some cen- turies before 1000 B.C.
uz: Ular miloddan avvalgi 1000 yilgacha bo'lgan davrda Ageya shaharlari va orollari orasida tushishgan.

en: They were probably already in southward movement before the Pharaoh Thothmes hunted his ﬁrst elephants beyond the con- quered Euphrates.
uz: Ular, ehtimol, Fir'avn Tothmes o'zlarining birinchi fillarini zabt etilgan Furot daryosidan o'tib ovlashidan oldin janubga qarab harakatlanayotgan bo'lishardi.

en: For in those days there were elephants in Mesopotamia and lions in Greece.
uz: O'sha kunlarda Mesopotamiyada fillar, Gretsiyada esa sherlar bor edi.

en: It is possible that it was a Greek raid that burnt Cnossos, but there are no Greek legends of such a victory though there are stories of Minos and his palace (the Labyrinth) and of the skill of the Cretan artiﬁcers.
uz: Ehtimol, Knossosni yoqib yuborgan yunon reyd bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bunday g'alaba haqida yunon afsonalari yo'q, garchi Minos va uning saroyi (Labirint) hamda Krit artifikatorlarining mahorati haqida hikoyalar mavjud bo'lsa ham.

en: STATUE OF MELEAGER  Note the progress in plastic power from the earlier wooden statue on left  Photo: Sebah & Foaillier
uz: MELEAGER haykali Chap tomondagi avvalgi yog'och haykaldan plastik quvvatdagi taraqqiyotga e'tibor bering Foto: Sebah & Foaillier

en: Like most of the Aryans these Greeks had singers and reciters whose per- formances were an important social link, and these handed down from the barbaric beginnings of their people two great epics, the Iliad, telling how a league of Greek tribes besieged and took and sacked the town of Troy in Asia Minor, and the Odyssey, being a long adventure story of the return of the sage captain, Odysseus, from Troy to his own island.
uz: Ko'pchilik oriylar singari, bu yunonlarda ham qo'shiqchilar va qo'shiqchilar bor edi, ularning ijodi muhim ijtimoiy bog'liq edi va bular o'z xalqlarining vahshiy boshlanishlaridan ikki buyuk dostonni, Iliadani o'z ichiga olgan bo'lib, unda yunon qabilalari bir guruhining Kichik Osiyodagi Troya shahri va Odisseyani qanday qamal qilib, o'g'irlaganini va talon-toroj qilganini hikoya qiladi. Bu dono kapitan Odisseyning Troyadan o'z oroliga qaytishining uzoq sarguzasht hikoyasidir.

en: These epics were written down somewhen in the eighth or seventh century B.C., when the Greeks had acquired the use of an alphabet from their more civilized neigh- bours, but they are supposed to have been in existence very much earlier.
uz: Bu dostonlar miloddan avvalgi sakkizinchi yoki yettinchi asrda yozilgan, o'shanda yunonlar o'zlarining yanada madaniyatli qo'shnilaridan alifbo ishlatishni o'zlashtirgan edi, ammo ular ancha avval mavjud bo'lgan deb taxmin qilinadi.

en: Formerly they were ascribed to a particular blind bard, Homer, who was supposed to have sat down and composed them as Milton composed Par- adise Lost.
uz: Ilgari ular ma'lum bir ko'r bardga, Gomerga tegishli edi, u ularni Milton Par-adise Lostni yozganidek, o'tirib yozishi kerak edi.

en: Whether there really was such a poet, whether he composed or only wrote down and polished these epics and so forth, is a favourite quar- relling ground for the erudite.
uz: Bunday shoir haqiqatan ham mavjud bo'lganmi, u bu dostonlarni yozganmi yoki faqatgina yozib, sayqallashganmi va hokazo, bu olimlar uchun sevimli asos hisoblanadi.

en: We need not concern ourselves with such bickerings here.
uz: Biz bu yerda bunday bahs-munozaralar bilan o'zimizni tashvishlantirishimizga hojat yo'q.

en: The thing that matters from our point of view is that the Greeks were in possession of their epics in the eighth century B.C., and that they were a common possession and a link between their various tribes, giv- ing them a sense of fellowship as against the outer barbarians.
uz: Bizning nuqtai nazarimizdan muhim bo'lgan narsa shundaki, yunonlar miloddan avvalgi VIII asrda o'z dostonlariga egalik qilishgan va ular turli qabilalari o'rtasida umumiy mulk va bog'lanish bo'lgan, ularga tashqi vahshiylarga nisbatan do'stlik tuyg'usini bergan.

en: They were a group of kindred peoples linked by the spoken and afterwards by the writ- ten word, and sharing common ideals of courage and behaviour.
uz: Ular og'zaki va keyinchalik yozma so'zlar orqali bog'langan, hamda jasorat va xulq-atvorning umumiy ideallarini baham ko'ruvchi qarindosh xalqlar guruhi edilar.

en: The epics showed the Greeks a barbaric people without iron, without writing, and still not living in cities.
uz: Eposlar yunonlarga temirsiz, yozuvsiz va baribir shaharlarda yashamaydigan vahshiy xalqni ko'rsatdi.

en: They seem to have lived at ﬁrst in open villages of huts around the halls of their chiefs outside the ruins of the Ægean cities they had destroyed.
uz: Ular dastlab o'z boshliqlarining zallari atrofidagi ochiq kulba qishloqlarida, ular vayron qilgan Egeya shaharlarining xarobalaridan tashqarida yashagan ko'rinadi.

en: Then they began to wall their cities and to adopt the idea of temples from the people they had conquered.
uz: Keyin ular o'z shaharlarini devorlashdi va zabt etgan odamlardan ibodatxonalar g'oyasini qabul qila boshladilar.

en: It has been said that the cities of the primitive civilizations grew up about the altar of some tribal god, and that the wall was added; in the cities of the Greeks the wall preceded the temple.
uz: Aytishlaricha, ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalarning shaharlari qandaydir qabila xudosi qurbongohining atrofida o'sgan va devor qo'shilgan; yunonlarning shaharlarida devor ibodatxonadan oldingi edi.

en: They began to trade and send out colonies.
uz: Ular savdo qila boshlashdi va mustamlakalarni jo'natishardi.

en: By the seventh century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi yettinchi asrga kelib.

en: a new series of cities had grown up in the valleys and islands of Greece, forgetful of the Ægean cities and civilization that had preceded them; Athens, Sparta, Corinth, Thebes, Samos, Miletus among the chief.
uz: Gretsiyaning vodiylari va orollarida yangi bir qator shaharlar o'sib chiqqan edi, ulardan oldingi Egeya shaharlari va tsivilizatsiyasini unutib; Afina, Sparta, Korinf, Tebes, Samos, Miletus boshliqlar qatorida.

en: There were already Greek settlements along the coast of the Black Sea and in Italy and Sicily.
uz: Qora dengiz sohili bo'ylab, shuningdek, Italiya va Sitsiliyada allaqachon yunon aholi punktlari mavjud edi.

en: The heel and toe of Italy was called Magna Græcia.
uz: Italiyaning poshnali poshnali qismi Magna Græcia deb atalgan.

en: Marseilles was a Greek town established on the site of an earlier Phœnician colony.
uz: Marsel avvalgi Fenisiy mustamlakasi joyida tashkil etilgan yunon shahri edi.

en: Now countries which are great plains or which have as a chief means of transport some great river like the Euphrates or Nile tend to become united under some common rule.
uz: Hozirda katta tekisliklar bo'lgan yoki asosiy transport vositasi sifatida Furot yoki Nil kabi katta daryoga ega bo'lgan davlatlar umumiy qoida ostida birlashadi.

en: The cities of Egypt and the cities of Sumeria, for example, ran together under one system of government.
uz: Misr va Shumer shaharlari, masalan, bir hukumat tizimi ostida birga ishlagan.

en: But the Greek peo- ples were cut up among islands and mountain valleys; both Greece and Magna Græcia are very mountainous; and the tendency was all the other way.
uz: Lekin yunon pop-peslari orollar va tog' vodiylari orasida kesilgan edi; Gretsiya ham, Magna Græcia ham juda tog'li edi; va tendensiya butunlay boshqacha edi.

en: When the Greeks come into history they are divided up into a number of little states which showed no signs of coalescence.
uz: Yunonlar tarixda paydo bo'lganda, ular koalekslik alomatlarini ko'rsatmagan bir qator kichik davlatlarga bo'linadi.

en: They are different even in race.
uz: Ular hatto irq bo'yicha ham farq qiladi.

en: Some consist chieﬂy of citizens of this or that Greek tribe, Ionic, Æolian or Doric; some have a mingled population of Greeks and de- scendants of the pre-Greek “Mediterranean” folk; some have an unmixed free citizenship of Greeks lording it over an enslaved conquered population like the “Helots” in Sparta.
uz: Ba'zilar asosan shu yoki bu yunon qabilasi, ion, eyol yoki dor fuqarolaridan iborat; ba'zilar yunonlardan oldingi O'rta yer dengizi xalqining aralash aholisi va avlodlaridan iborat; ba'zilar esa Spartadagi Helotlar kabi qullar ustidan zabt etilgan ozod fuqarolikka ega bo'lgan yunonlarning aralashmagan erkin fuqaroligiga ega.

en: In some the old leaderly Aryan families have become a close aristocracy; in some there is a democracy of all the Aryan citizens; in some there are elected or even hereditary kings, in some usurpers or tyrants.
uz: Ba'zilarida eski yetakchi ariy oilalari yaqin aristokratiyaga aylandi; ba'zilarida barcha ariy fuqarolarining demokratiyasi bor; ba'zilarida saylangan yoki hatto merosxo'r qirollar, ba'zilarida esa o'zlashtiruvchilar yoki zolimlar bor.

en: RUINS OF THE GREAT TEMPLE OF ZEUS AT OLYMPIA  Photo: Fred Boissonnas
uz: OLIMPIADADA ZEUSNING BUYUK MABONASINING XALQASI Foto: Fred Boissonnas

en: And the same geographical conditions that kept the Greek states divided and various, kept them small.
uz: Yunon davlatlarini bo'linib va xilma-xil qilib turadigan geografik sharoitlar ularni kichik qilib ham saqlardi.

en: The largest states were smaller than many English counties, and it is doubtful if the population of any of their cities ever exceeded a third of a million.
uz: Eng katta shtatlar ko'plab ingliz okruglariga qaraganda kichikroq edi va ularning birortasining aholisi millionning uchdan bir qismidan oshishi dargumon.

en: Few came up even to 50,000.
uz: Kamdan-kam odamlar hatto 50 000 ga ham yetdi.

en: There were unions of interest and sympathy but no coalescences.
uz: Qiziqish va hamdardlik uyg'unliklari bor edi, lekin hech qanday birlashuv yo'q edi.

en: Cities made leagues and alliances as trade increased, and small cities put themselves under the protection of great ones.
uz: Shaharlar savdo hajmi oshishi bilan ligalar va ittifoqlarni tuzdi, kichik shaharlar esa o'zlarini buyuk shaharlarning himoyasiga qo'ydi.

en: Yet all Greece was held together in a certain com- munity of feeling by two things, by the epics and by the custom of taking part every fourth year in the athletic contests at Olympia.
uz: Shunga qaramay, butun Gretsiya ikki narsa, dostonlar va har to'rtinchi yilda Olimpiya sport musobaqalarida ishtirok etish odati bilan ma'lum bir his-tuyg'ular hamjamiyatida birga edi.

en: This did not pre- vent wars and feuds, but it mitigated something of the savagery of war be- tween them, and a truce protected all travellers to and from the games.
uz: Bu urushlar va janjallarni oldindan keltirib chiqarmadi, lekin urushning vahshiyligini yumshatdi va sulh o'yinlarga boruvchi va undan keladigan barcha sayohatchilarni himoya qildi.

en: As time went on the sentiment of a common heritage grew and the number of states participating in the Olympic games increased until at last not only Greeks but competitors from the closely kindred countries of Epirus and Macedonia to the north were admitted.
uz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan umumiy meros tuyg'usi o'sib bordi va Olimpiya o'yinlarida ishtirok etayotgan davlatlar soni nihoyat nafaqat yunonlar, balki shimoliy qardosh Epir va Makedoniya davlatlaridan kelgan raqobatchilar ham qabul qilindi.

en: The Greek cities grew in trade and importance, and the quality of their civilization rose steadily in the seventh and sixth centuries B.C.
uz: Yunon shaharlari savdo va ahamiyatda o'sdi, miloddan avvalgi yettinchi va oltinchi asrlarda ularning sivilizatsiyasi sifati barqaror o'sdi.

en: Their social life differed in many interesting points from the social life of the Ægean and river valley civilizations.
uz: Ularning ijtimoiy hayoti Ageya va daryo vodiysi sivilizatsiyalarining ijtimoiy hayotidan ko'plab qiziqarli jihatlarda farq qilardi.

en: They had splendid temples but the priesthood was not the great traditional body it was in the cities of the older world, the- repository of all knowledge, the storehouse of ideas.
uz: Ularning ajoyib ibodatxonalari bor edi, lekin ruhoniylik qadimgi dunyo shaharlarida bo'lgan ulkan an'anaviy jism emas edi, barcha bilimlar ombori, g'oyalar ombori edi.

en: They had leaders and noble families, but no quasi- divine monarch surrounded by an elaborately organized court.
uz: Ularning yetakchilari va zodagon oilalari bor edi, lekin murakkab tashkil etilgan sud bilan o'ralgan deyarli ilohiy monarx yo'q edi.

en: Rather their organization was aristocratic, with leading families which kept each other in order.
uz: Ularning tashkiloti aristokratik edi, yetakchi oilalar bir-birini tartibli ushlab turardi.

en: Even their so- called “democracies” were aristocratic; every citizen had a share in public affairs and came to the assembly in a democracy, but everybody was not a citizen.
uz: Hatto ularning demokratiyalari aristokratik edi; har bir fuqaroning davlat ishlarida ishtiroki bor edi va demokratiyada yig'ilishga kelgan, lekin hamma ham fuqaro emas edi.

en: The Greek democracies were not like our modern “democracies” in which everyone has a vote.
uz: Yunon demokratiyalari bizning zamonaviy demokratiyalarimizga o'xshamasdi, unda har kimning ovozi bor edi.

en: Many of the Greek democracies had a few hundred or a few thousand citizens and then many thousands of slaves, freedmen and so forth, with no share in public affairs.
uz: Ko'pgina yunon demokratiyalarida bir necha yuz yoki bir necha ming fuqarolar, keyin esa ko'plab minglab qullar, ozod odamlar va hokazolar bo'lgan, ular davlat ishlarida hech qanday ishtirok etmas edi.

en: Generally in Greece affairs were in the hands of a community of substantial men.
uz: Odatda Gretsiyada ishlar katta miqdordagi erkaklar jamoasining qo'lida edi.

en: Their kings and their tyrants alike were just men set in front of other men or usurping a leadership; they were not quasi-divine overmen like Pharaoh or Minos or the monarchs of Mesopotamia.
uz: Ularning podshohlari ham, zolimlari ham boshqa odamlarning oldiga qo'yilgan yoki rahbarlikni o'zlashtirayotgan oddiy odamlar edi; ular Fir'avn, Minos yoki Mesopotamiya monarxlari kabi deyarli ilohiy ustun emas edilar.

en: Both thought and government therefore had a freedom under Greek conditions such as they had known in none of the older civilizations.
uz: Shunday qilib, fikr ham, hukumat ham yunon sharoitida hech qaysi qadimgi tsivilizatsiyada bilmagan erkinlikka ega edi.

en: The Greeks had brought down into cities the individualism, the personal
uz: Yunonlar shaharlarga individualizmni, shaxsiylikni olib kelishgan edi.

en: initiative of the wandering life of the northern parklands.
uz: Shimoliy bog'dorchilik hududlarining sayohat hayoti tashabbusi.

en: They were the ﬁrst republicans of importance in history.
uz: Ular tarixda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan birinchi respublikachilar edi.

en: THE TEMPLE OF NEPTUNE (POSEIDON), PÆSTUM, SICILY  Photo: Alinari And we ﬁnd that as they emerge from a condition of barbaric warfare a new thing becomes apparent in their intellectual life.
uz: NEPTUN MABADANI, PÆSTUM, SISIliya Surat: Alinari Va biz ularning vahshiy urush sharoitidan chiqqach, ularning intellektual hayotida yangi narsa paydo bo'lishini aniqlaymiz.

en: We ﬁnd men who are not priests seeking and recording knowledge and enquiring into the myster- ies of life and being, in a way that has hitherto been the sublime privilege of priesthood or the presumptuous amusement of kings.
uz: Biz ruhoniy bo'lmagan odamlarni topamiz, ular hayot va mavjudot sirlarini izlashmoqda va yozib olishmoqda, shu paytgacha ruhoniylikning ulug'vor imtiyozi yoki shohlarning mag'rur ko'ngilochi bo'lgan tarzda.

en: We ﬁnd already in the sixth century B.C.—perhaps while Isaiah was still prophesying in Babylon— such men as Thales and Anaximander of Miletus and Heraclitus of Eph- esus, who were what we should now call independent gentlemen, giving their minds to shrewd questionings of the world in which we live, asking what its real nature was, whence it came and what its destiny might be, and refusing all ready-made or evasive answers.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda  ehtimol, Ishayo Bobilda bashorat qilayotgan paytda  Miletolik Tales, Anaximander va Efeslik Geraklit kabi erkaklarni topamiz. Ular hozir mustaqil janoblar deb atashimiz kerak bo'lgan, biz yashayotgan dunyo haqida aql bovar qilmas savollarga berilib, uning haqiqiy tabiati nima edi, u qayerdan kelgan va taqdiri qanday bo'lishi mumkin edi, va tayyor yoki yashirin javoblardan voz kechishardi.

en: Of these questionings of the universe by the Greek mind, we shall have more to say a little later in this
uz: Yunon ongining olamga oid savollaridan keyinroq yana biroz ko'proq gapirishimiz kerak bo'ladi.

en: These Greek enquirers who begin to be remarkable in the sixth cen- tury B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda e'tiborga loyiq bo'la boshlagan bu yunon so'rovchilari.

en: are the ﬁrst philosophers, the ﬁrst “wisdom-lovers,” in the world.
uz: dunyodagi birinchi faylasuflar, birinchi hikmatsevarlardir.

en: And it may be noted here how important a century this sixth century B.C.
uz: Va bu yerda miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asr qanchalik muhim ekanligini ta'kidlash mumkin.

en: was in the history of humanity.
uz: insoniyat tarixida bo'lgan.

en: For not only were these Greek philosophers beginning the research for clear ideas about this universe and man’s place in it and Isaiah carrying Jewish prophecy to its sublimest levels, but as we shall tell later Gautama Buddha was then teaching in India and Confucius and Lao Tse in China.
uz: Chunki nafaqat bu yunon faylasuflari bu olam va unda inson o'rni haqidagi aniq g'oyalar bo'yicha tadqiqotni boshlashgan va Ishayo yahudiy bashoratini eng oliy darajalarga olib chiqqan, balki keyinroq aytadiganimizdek, Gautama Budda o'sha paytda Hindistonda va Konfutsiy va Lao Tese Xitoyda dars bergan edi.

en: From Athens to the Paciﬁc the human mind was astir.
uz: Afina shahridan Tinch okeanigacha inson ongi sayoz edi.

en: XXIV THE WARS OF THE GREEKS AND PERSIANS While the Greeks in the cities in Greece, South Italy and Asia Minor were embarking upon free intellectual enquiry and while in Babylon and Jerusalem the last of the Hebrew prophets were creating a free conscience for mankind, two adventurous Aryan peoples, the Medes and the Persians, were in possession of the civilization of the ancient world and were making a great empire, the Persian empire, which was far larger in extent than any empire the world had seen hitherto.
uz: XXIV GREYKA VA PERSONLARNING urushlari Gretsiya, Janubiy Italiya va Kichik Osiyo shaharlaridagi yunonlar erkin intellektual izlanishga otlangan paytda va Bobil va Quddusda Ibroniy payg'ambarlarning oxirgisi insoniyat uchun erkin vijdon yaratayotgan paytda, ikki sarguzashtga boy ariy xalqlari, Medlar va Forslar qadimgi dunyo tsivilizatsiyasiga ega edilar va buyuk imperiya, dunyo ko'rgan har qanday imperiyaga qaraganda ancha katta bo'lgan Fors imperiyasini yaratayotgan edilar.

en: Under Cyrus, Babylon and the rich and ancient civilization of Lydia had been added to the Persian rule; the Phœni- cian cities of the Levant and all the Greek cities in Asia Minor had been made tributary, Cambyses had subjected Egypt, and Darius I, the Mede, the third of the Persian rulers (521 B.C.), found himself monarch as it seemed of all the world.
uz: Kir davrida Lidiyaning boy va qadimiy tsivilizatsiyasi Fors hukmronligiga qo'shildi; Levantning Fen-sian shaharlari va Kichik Osiyodagi barcha yunon shaharlari qo'shilib ketdi, Kambis Misrni bo'ysundirdi va Doriy I, Med, Fors hukmdorlarining uchinchisi (521-yil miloddan avval), o'zini butun dunyoga o'xshab monarx deb topdi.

en: His couriers rode with his decrees from the Dardanelles to the Indus and from Upper Egypt to Central Asia.
uz: Uning kuryerlari uning farmonlari bilan Dardaneldan Indusga va Yuqori Misrdan Markaziy Osiyoga bordi.

en: The Greeks in Europe, it is true, Italy, Carthage, Sicily and the Spanish Phœnician settlements, were not under the Persian Peace; but they treated it with respect and the only people who gave any serious trouble were the old parent hordes of Nordic people in South Russia and Central Asia, the Scythians, who raided the northern and north-eastern borders.
uz: Yevropadagi yunonlar, rostini aytsam, Italiya, Karthag, Sitsiliya va Ispaniya Fenitsik aholi punktlari Fors tinchligi ostida emas edi; lekin ular unga hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'lishdi va jiddiy muammo tug'dirgan yagona odamlar Janubiy Rossiya va Markaziy Osiyodagi Skitiylarning eski ota-ona to'dalari bo'ldi, ular shimoliy va shimoli-sharqiy chegaralarga bostirib kirishdi.

en: Of course the population of this great Persian empire was not a popula- tion of Persians, The Persians were only the small conquering minority of this enormous realm.
uz: Albatta, bu buyuk Fors imperiyasining aholisi forslar aholisi emas edi, forslar bu ulkan saltanatning faqat kichik zabt etuvchi ozchiligi edi.

en: The rest of the population was what it had been before the Persians came from time immemorial, only that Persian was the admin-
uz: Aholining qolgan qismi qadim zamonlardan beri forslar kelmasidan oldin bo'lgan narsa edi, faqat forslar admin edi.

en: Trade and ﬁnance were still largely Semitic, Tyre and Sidon as of old were the great Mediterranean ports and Semitic shipping plied upon the seas.
uz: Savdo va moliya hali ham asosan semitlar edi, Tir va Sidon qadim zamonlarda buyuk O'rta yer dengizi portlari va semit kemasozlik dengizlar ustida joylashgan edi.

en: But many of these Semitic merchants and business peo- ple as they went from place to place already found a sympathetic and con- venient common history in the Hebrew tradition and the Hebrew scriptures.
uz: Lekin bu semit savdogarlari va bizneschilarining ko'pchiligi joylardan joyga borar ekan, allaqachon ibroniy an'analari va ibroniy kitoblarida hamdardlik va tushunarli umumiy tarixni topdilar.

en: A new element which was increasing rapidly in this empire was the Greek element.
uz: Bu imperiyada tez sur'atlar bilan o'sib borayotgan yangi element yunon elementi edi.

en: The Greeks were becoming serious rivals to the Semites upon the sea, and their detached and vigorous intelligence made them useful and, un- prejudiced ofﬁcials.
uz: Yunonlar dengizdagi semitlarga jiddiy raqib bo'lishayotgan edi va ularning ajratilgan va kuchli aql-idroklari ularni foydali va xolis amaldorlarga aylantirgan edi.

en: FINE PIECE OF ATHENIAN POTTERY  Showing Greek merchant vesselswith sails and oars statue on left  Brit.
uz: AFIYAN POTERIYASINING YAXSHI QISMI chap tomonda Britaniyaliklarning yelkanli va eshkakli grek savdo kemalari haykalini ko'rsatmoqda.

en: It was on account of the Scythians that Darius I invaded Europe.
uz: Dariy I Yevropaga skiflar tufayli bostirib kirgan edi.

en: He wanted to reach South Russia, the homeland of the Scythian horsemen.
uz: U skif otliqlarining vatani bo'lgan Janubiy Rossiyaga yetib bormoqchi edi.

en: He crossed the Bosphorus with a great army and marched through Bulgaria to the Danube, crossed this by a bridge of boats and pushed far northward.
uz: U katta qo'shin bilan Bosforni kesib o'tdi va Bolgariya orqali Dunay daryosiga yurdi, uni qayiqlar ko'prigi orqali kesib o'tdi va shimolga uzoqroqqa itarildi.

en: His army suffered terribly.
uz: Uning armiyasi dahshatli azob chekdi.

en: It was largely an infantry force and the mounted Scythians rode all round it, cut off its supplies, destroyed any stragglers and never came to a pitched battle.
uz: U asosan piyoda kuchlari edi va otliq skiflar uning atrofida minishdi, ta'minotini uzishdi, hech qanday ortda qolganlarni yo'q qilishdi va hech qachon jangga kelmadilar.

en: Darius was forced into an inglorious retreat.
uz: Dariy behayo chekinishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: He returned himself to Susa but he left an army in Thrace and Macedo- nia, and Macedonia submitted to Darius.
uz: U o'zi Susaga qaytib keldi, lekin u Trakiya va Makedoniyada qo'shin qoldirdi va Makedoniya Daryoga bo'ysundirdi.

en: Insurrections of the Greek cities in Asia followed this failure, and the European Greeks were drawn into the contest.
uz: Osiyodagi yunon shaharlarining qo'zg'olonlari shu muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi va Yevropa yunonlari musobaqaga jalb qilindi.

en: Darius resolved upon the subjugation of the Greeks in Europe.
uz: Dariy Yevropadagi yunonlarning bo'ysundirilishiga qaror qildi.

en: With the Phœnician ﬂeet at his disposal he was able to subdue one island after another, and ﬁnally in 490 B.C.
uz: Fenisiylar floti uning ixtiyorida bo'lgan holda, u birin-ketin orolni bo'ysundira oldi va nihoyat miloddan avvalgi 490-yilda.

en: he made his main attack upon Athens.
uz: U asosiy hujumini Afinaga amalga oshirdi.

en: A considerable Armada sailed from the ports of Asia Minor and the eastern
uz: Kichik Osiyo va sharqiy portlardan sezilarli Armada suzib chiqdi.

en: Mediterranean, and the expedition landed its troops at Marathon to the north of Athens.
uz: O'rta yer dengizi, ekspeditsiya esa o'z qo'shinlarini Marathonga, Afinaning shimoliga qo'ydi.

en: There they were met and signally defeated by the Athenians.
uz: U yerda ular kutib olindi va Afinaliklar tomonidan sezilarli tarzda mag'lub etildi.

en: An extraordinary thing happened at this time.
uz: Bu vaqtda g'ayrioddiy narsa sodir bo'ldi.

en: The bitterest rival of Athens in Greece was Sparta, but now Athens appealed to Sparta, sending a herald, a swift runner, imploring the Spartans not to let Greeks become slaves to barbarians.
uz: Gretsiyadagi Afinalarning eng achchiq raqibi Sparta edi, lekin endi Afina Spartaga murojaat qilib, Spartaliklardan yunonlarni vahshiylarga qul bo'lishlariga yo'l qo'ymasliklarini so'rab, xushxabarchi, tezkor yuguruvchini yubordi.

en: This runner (the prototype of all “Marathon” runners) did over a hundred miles of broken country in less than two days.
uz: Bu yuguruvchi (barcha Marathon yuguruvchilarining prototipi) ikki kundan kamroq vaqt ichida yuz mildan ortiq buzilgan yurtni bosib o'tdi.

en: The Spar- tans responded promptly and generously; but when, in three days, the Spar- tan force reached Athens, there was nothing for it to do but to view the bat- tleﬁeld and the bodies of the defeated Persian soldiers.
uz: Spar-tanlar tezkor va saxiy javob berishdi; lekin, uch kundan so'ng, Spar-tan kuchlari Afinaga yetib borgach, ular uchun bat- tle maydoniga va mag'lub bo'lgan fors askarlarining jasadlarini ko'rishdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi.

en: The Persian ﬂeet had returned to Asia.
uz: Fors floti Osiyoga qaytdi.

en: So ended the ﬁrst Persian attack on Greece.
uz: Shunday qilib, Gretsiyaga birinchi Fors hujumi yakunlandi.

en: The next was much more impressive.
uz: Keyingi qismi ancha ta'sirliroq edi.

en: Darius died soon after the news of his defeat at Marathon reached him, and for four years his son and succes- sor, Xerxes, prepared a host to crush the Greeks.
uz: Dariy Marathondagi mag'lubiyat haqidagi xabar unga yetib kelganidan ko'p o'tmay vafot etdi, va to'rt yil davomida uning o'g'li va vorisi Kserks yunonlarni mag'lub etish uchun qo'shin tayyorladi.

en: For a time terror united all the Greeks.
uz: Bir vaqtlar dahshat barcha yunonlarni birlashtirdi.

en: The army of Xerxes was certainly the greatest that had hitherto been assembled in the world.
uz: Gerks armiyasi, shubhasiz, dunyo bo'ylab shu paytgacha yig'ilgan eng buyuk armiya edi.

en: It was a huge assembly of discordant ele- ments.
uz: Bu kelishmovchilik hukmronlarining ulkan yig'ilishi edi.

en: It crossed the Dardanelles, 480 B.C., by a bridge of boats; and along the coast as it advanced moved an equally miscellaneous ﬂeet carrying sup- plies.
uz: U Dardanel orollarini, miloddan avvalgi 480-yilda, qayiqlar ko'prigi orqali kesib o'tdi; va qirg'oq bo'ylab o'tib borar ekan, xuddi shunday xilma-xil flot yordamchi kemalarni olib yurdi.

en: At the narrow pass of Thermopylæ a small force of 1400 men under the Spartan Leonidas resisted this multitude, and after a ﬁght of unsur- passed heroism was completely destroyed.
uz: Termopilening tor o'tish joyida spartalik Leonidas boshchiligidagi 1400 kishilik kichik kuch bu olomonga qarshilik ko'rsatdi va unsurlarsiz o'tgan qahramonlik jangidan so'ng butunlay yo'q qilindi.

en: Every man was killed.
uz: Har bir odam o'ldirildi.

en: But the losses they inﬂicted upon the Persians were enormous, and the army of Xerxes pushed on to Thebes and Athens in a chastened mood.
uz: Ammo ular forslarga yetkazgan yo'qotishlar juda katta edi va Gerks armiyasi jazolangan kayfiyatda Tebba va Afina tomon surildi.

en: Thebes sur- rendered and made terms.
uz: Thebes so'zlarni tarjima qildi va shartlar yaratdi.

en: The Athenians abandoned their city and it was burnt.
uz: Afinaliklar o'z shaharlarini tashlab ketishdi va u yoqib yuborildi.

en: Greece seemed in the hands of the conqueror, but again came victory against the odds and all expectations.
uz: Gretsiya bosqinchi qo'lidadek tuyuldi, lekin yana barcha umidlarga qarshi g'alaba keldi.

en: The Greek ﬂeet, though not a third the size of the Persian, assailed it in the bay of Salamis and destroyed it.
uz: Gretsiya floti, garchi Forsning uchdan bir qismiga teng bo'lmasa-da, Salamis qo'ltig'ida hujum qilib, uni yo'q qildi.

en: Xerxes found himself and his immense army cut off from supplies and his heart failed him.
uz: Kserks o'zini va uning ulkan qo'shinini ta'minotdan uzdi va uning yuragi uni xafa qildi.

en: He retreated to Asia with one half of his army, leaving the rest to be defeated at Platea (479 B.C.) what time the remnants of the Persian ﬂeet were hunted down by the Greeks and destroyed at Mycalæ in Asia Minor.
uz: U o'z qo'shinining yarmi bilan Osiyoga chekindi va qolganlarini Pletada (479 miloddan avvalgi) mag'lub etilishga qoldirdi, o'shanda Fors flotining qoldiqlari yunonlar tomonidan quvib chiqarildi va Kichik Osiyodagi Mikalyada yo'q qilindi.

en: ALL THAT REMAINS OF THE GREAT TEMPLE OF CORINTH  Photo: Fred Boissonnas The Persian danger was at an end.
uz: KORINTLAR BUYUK MAHIBINASINING BARCHA QOLG'I Surat: Fred Boissonas Fors xavfi oxirida edi.

en: Most of the Greek cities in Asia be- came free.
uz: Osiyodagi yunon shaharlarining aksariyati bepul bo'ldi.

en: All this is told in great detail and with much picturesqueness in the ﬁrst of written histories, the History of Herodotus.
uz: Bularning barchasi juda batafsil va ko'p go'zallik bilan yozilgan tarixlarning birinchisida, Gerodotning tarixida aytiladi.

en: This Herodotus was born about 484 B.C.
uz: Bu Gerodot miloddan avvalgi taxminan 484-yilda tug'ilgan.

en: in the Ionian city of Halicarnassus in Asia Minor, and he visited Babylon and Egypt in his search for exact particulars.
uz: Kichik Osiyodagi Ion shahridagi Halikarnass shahrida va u aniq ma'lumotlarni izlash uchun Bobil va Misrga tashrif buyurdi.

en: From My- calæ onward Persia sank into a confusion of dynastic troubles.
uz: Micaldan boshlab Fors sulolaviy tashvishlarning chalkashligiga botdi.

en: Xerxes was murdered in 465 B.C.
uz: Kserks miloddan avvalgi 465-yilda o'ldirilgan.

en: and rebellions in Egypt, Syria and Media broke up the brief order of that mighty realm.
uz: Misr, Suriya va Medyadagi isyonlar o'sha qudratli saltanatning qisqa tartibini buzdi.

en: The history of Herodotus lays stress on the weakness of Persia.
uz: Herodotning tarixi Forsning zaifligiga urg'u beradi.

en: This history is indeed what we should now call propa- ganda—propaganda for Greece to unite and conquer Persia.
uz: Bu tarix haqiqatan ham hozir propa- ganda deb atashimiz kerak bo'lgan narsa  Gretsiyaning birlashish va Forsni zabt etish uchun targ'ibot.

en: Herodotus makes one character, Aristagoras, go to the Spartans with a map of the known world and say to them: “These Barbarians are not valiant in ﬁght.
uz: Gerodot bir personajni, Aristagorani Spartanga ma'lum dunyoning xaritasi bilan borishga va ularga: Bu varvarlar jangda jasur emas, - deyishga majbur qildi.

en: You on the other hand have now attained the utmost skill in war ....
uz: Siz esa hozir urushda eng yuqori mahoratga erishdingiz...

en: No oth- er nations in the world have what they possess: gold, silver, bronze, embroi- dered garments, beasts and slaves.
uz: Dunyodagi boshqa xalqlarda hech kimda bor narsa yo'q: oltin, kumush, bronza, bezatilgan kiyimlar, hayvonlar va qullar.

en: All this you might have for yourselves, if you so desired.”
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, bularning hammasi o'zingiz uchun bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: THE TEMPLE OF NEPTUNE (POSEIDON) AT CAPE SUNIUM  Photo: Fred Boissonnas
uz: NEPTUNIY MABONASI KAPE SUNIUMDA Foto: Fred Boissonnas

en: XXV THE SPLENDOUR OF GREECE The century and a half that followed the defeat of Persia was one of very great splendour for the Greek civilization.
uz: XXV Gretsiyaning ulug'vorligi. Fors mag'lubiyatidan keyingi yarim asr yunon sivilizatsiyasi uchun juda katta ulug'vorliklardan biri edi.

en: True that Greece was torn by a desperate struggle for ascendancy between Athens, Sparta and other states (the Peloponnesian War 431 to 404 B.C.) and that in 338 B.C.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, Gretsiya Afina, Sparta va boshqa davlatlar o'rtasida ustunlik uchun umidsiz kurash tufayli yirtilgan edi ( Peloponnes urushi 431 dan 404 yilgacha) va 338 yilda.

en: the Macedo- nians became virtually masters of Greece; nevertheless during this period the thought and the creative and artistic impulse of the Greeks rose to levels that made their achievement a lamp to mankind for all the rest of history.
uz: Makedoniyaliklar Gretsiyaning deyarli ustasi bo'lishdi; shunga qaramay, bu davrda yunonlarning fikri va ijodiy va badiiy intilishi shunday darajalarga ko'tarildi, bu ularning yutuqlarini butun tarix davomida insoniyat uchun chiroqga aylantirdi.

en: The head and centre of this mental activity was Athens.
uz: Bu ruhiy faoliyatning boshi va markazi Afina edi.

en: For over thirty years (466 to 428 B.C.) Athens was dominated by a man of great vigour and liberality of mind, Pericles, who set himself to rebuild the city from the ash- es to which the Persians had reduced it.
uz: O'ttiz yildan ortiq vaqt davomida (miloddan avvalgi 466 dan 428 yilgacha) Afina katta kuch va erkin fikrga ega bo'lgan Perikles tomonidan hukmronlik qilingan bo'lib, u shaharni forslar uni pastga tushirgan kuldan qayta qurishga qaror qildi.

en: The beautiful ruins that still glorify Athens to-day are chieﬂy the remains of this great effort.
uz: Bugungi kunda Afina shahrini ulug'laydigan go'zal xarobalar asosan ushbu buyuk sa'y-harakatning qoldiqlaridir.

en: And he did not simply rebuild a material Athens.
uz: Va u shunchaki Afinani qayta qurmadi.

en: He rebuilt Athens intellectually.
uz: U Afinani intellektual jihatdan qayta qurdi.

en: He gath- ered about him not only architects and sculptors but poets, dramatists, philosophers and teachers.
uz: U atrofida nafaqat arxitektorlar va haykaltaroshlar, balki shoirlar, dramaturglar, faylasuflar va o'qituvchilar ham yig'ilgan edi.

en: Herodotus came to Athens to recite his history (438 B.C.).
uz: Gerodot Afinaga o'z tarixini o'qish uchun keldi (miloddan avvalgi 438-yil).

en: Anaxagoras came with the beginnings of a scientiﬁc description of the sun and stars.
uz: Anaxagora quyosh va yulduzlarni ilmiy ta'riflashning boshlanishi bilan keldi.

en: Æschylus, Sophocles and Euripides one after the other carried the Greek drama to its highest levels or beauty and nobility.
uz: Æskylus, Sofokl va Euripides birin-ketin yunon dramasiga o'zining eng yuqori darajalariga, go'zalligiga va olijanobligiga olib bordi.

en: The impetus Pericles gave to the intellectual life of Athens lived on after his death, and in spite of the fact that the peace of Greece was now broken by the Peloponnesian War and a long and wasteful struggle for “ascendan- cy” was beginning.
uz: Periklesning Afina intellektual hayotiga bergan turtki, uning vafotidan keyin ham davom etdi va garchi Gretsiyaning tinchligi Pelopones urushi tufayli buzilgani va ascendan-cy uchun uzoq va behuda kurash boshlanayotgan bo'lsa ham.

en: Indeed the darkling of the political horizon seems for a time to have quickened rather than discouraged men’s minds.
uz: Darhaqiqat, siyosiy ufqning qorong'ilashishi bir vaqtlar odamlarning ongini tushkunlikka solish o'rniga tezlashtirgandek tuyuladi.

en: Already long before the time of Pericles the peculiar freedom of Greek institutions had given great importance to skill in discussion.
uz: Perikles davridan ancha oldinroq yunon institutlarining o'ziga xos erkinligi muhokamada mahoratga katta ahamiyat bergan edi.

en: Decision rest- ed neither with king nor with priest but in the assemblies of the people or of leading men.
uz: Qaror na shoh bilan, na ruhoniy bilan, balki xalq yig'ilishlarida yoki yetakchi odamlarda hal qilindi.

en: Eloquence and able argument became very desirable accom- plishments therefore, and a class of teachers arose, the Sophists, who under- took to strengthen young men in these arts.
uz: Muhtaramlik va qobiliyatli bahs-munozara juda ham maqbul moslashuvga aylandi, shuning uchun o'qituvchilar sinfi paydo bo'ldi, Sofistlar, ular yoshlarni bu san'atlarda kuchaytirish uchun o'z zimmasiga olishdi.

en: But one cannot reason without matter, and knowledge followed in the wake of speech.
uz: Lekin moddanasiz fikr yuritib bo'lmaydi, va nutq ortidan bilim keladi.

en: The activities and rivalries of these Sophists led very naturally to an acute examination of style, of methods of thought and of the validity of arguments.
uz: Bu Sofistlarning faoliyati va raqobatlari juda tabiiy ravishda uslub, fikrlash usullari va dalillarning haqiqiyligini o'tkir tekshiruvga olib keldi.

en: When Peri- cles died a certain Socrates was becoming prominent as an able and de- structive critic of bad argument—and much of the teaching of the Sophists was bad argument.
uz: Peri-klles vafot etganida, ma'lum bir Sokrat yomon bahslarni qobiliyatli va de-struktsiv tanqidchi sifatida mashhur bo'lib borardi  va Sofistlarning ko'p ta'limoti yomon bahs edi.

en: A group of brilliant young men gathered about Socrates.
uz: Bir guruh daho yigitlar Suqrot haqida yig'ilishdi.

en: In the end Socrates was executed for disturbing people’s minds (399 B.C.), he was condemned after the digniﬁed fashion of the Athens of those days to drink in his own house and among his own friends a poisonous draught made from hemlock, but the disturbance of people’s minds went on in spite of his condemnation.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, Sokrat odamlarning ongini bezovta qilgani uchun qatl etildi (miloddan avvalgi 399 yil), u o'sha davrdagi Afinaliklarning o'z uyida va o'z do'stlari orasida hemlockdan zaharli ichimlik ichish odatidan keyin hukm qilindi, ammo odamlarning ongini bezovta qilish uning hukm qilinishiga qaramay davom etdi.

en: His young men carried on his teaching.
uz: Uning yigitlari uning ta'limotini davom ettirishdi.

en: PART OF THE FAMOUS FRIEZE OF THE PARTHENON, ATHENS  A specimen of Grecian sculpture in its ﬁnest expression.
uz: PARTENONning mashhur muzlatishining bir qismi, Afinada yunon haykaltaroshligining eng yaxshi ifodasidagi namunasi.

en: Compare the advance of art with that seen in the animals shown on p.
uz: San'at taraqqiyotini sahifada ko'rsatilgan hayvonlarda ko'ringan narsa bilan solishtiring.

en: 105  Photo: Fred Boissonnas
uz: 105 ta surat: Fred Boissonnalar

en: THE ACROPOLIS, ATHENS  The marvellous group of Temples and monuments built under the inspriration of Pericles  Photo: Fred Boissonnas
uz: AKROPOLIS, ATEN Ajoyib ibodatxonalar va yodgorliklar guruhi, Perikles ta'siri ostida qurilgan. Surat: Fred Boissonnas.

en: THE THEATRE AT EPIDAUROS, GREECE  A wonderfully preserved specimen showing the vast auditorium  Photo: Fred Boissonnas Chief among these young men was Plato (427 to 347 B.C.) who presently began to teach philosophy in the grove of the Academy.
uz: EPIDAUROSDAGI TEATR, GREEYA Katta auditoriyani ko'rsatuvchi ajoyib saqlanib qolgan namuna Surat: Fred Boissonnas Bu yigitlar orasida Aflotun (miloddan avvalgi 427 dan 347 gacha) bosh edi, u hozirda Akademiyaning o'rmonida falsafa dars berishni boshlagan.

en: His teaching fell into two main divisions, an examination of the foundations and methods of human thinking and an examination of political institutions.
uz: Uning ta'limoti ikki asosiy bo'linishga bo'lindi: inson tafakkurining asoslari va usullarini tekshirish va siyosiy institutlarni tekshirish.

en: He was the ﬁrst man to write a Utopia, that is to say the plan of a community different from and better than any existing community.
uz: U Utopiya yozgan birinchi odam edi, ya'ni mavjud jamiyatdan farqli va undan yaxshiroq bo'lgan jamiyatning rejasi.

en: This shows an altogether unprece- dented boldness in the human mind which had hitherto accepted social tra- ditions and usages with scarcely a question.
uz: Bu inson ongida shu paytgacha ijtimoiy an'analar va amaliyotlarni deyarli hech qanday savolsiz qabul qilgan misli ko'rilmagan jasoratni ko'rsatadi.

en: Plato said plainly to mankind: “Most of the social and political ills from which you suffer are under your control, given only the will and courage to change them.
uz: Platon insoniyatga aniq aytdi: Siz azob chekayotgan ijtimoiy va siyosiy kasalliklarning aksariyati sizning nazoratingiz ostida, faqat ularni o'zgartirishga bo'lgan iroda va jasorat berilgan.

en: You can live in an- other and a wiser fashion if you choose to think it out and work it out.
uz: Agar o'ylab topib, uni ishlab chiqishni tanlasangiz, boshqacha va aqlliroq tarzda yashashingiz mumkin.

en: You are not awake to your own power.” That is a high adventurous teaching that has still to soak in to the common intelligence of our race.
uz: Siz o'z kuchingizga uyg'oq emassiz. Bu bizning irqimizning umumiy aqliga hali singib ketishi kerak bo'lgan yuqori sarguzashtli ta'limotdir.

en: One of his earli- est works was the Republic, a dream of a communist aristocracy; his last unﬁnished work was the Laws, a scheme of regulation for another such Utopian state.
uz: Uning dastlabki asarlaridan biri Kommunistik aristokratiyaning orzusi bo'lgan Respublika edi; uning oxirgi tugallanmagan asari esa Qonunlar edi, yana bir shunday Utopik davlat uchun tartibga solish sxemasi.

en: THE CARYATIDES OF THE ERECHTHEUM  The ancient sanctuary on the Acropolis at Athens  Photo: Fred Boissonnas
uz: EREKTHEUM KARYATLARI Afina Akropolisidagi qadimiy ibodatxona Surat: Fred Boissonnas

en: ATHENE OF THE PARTHENON  Photo: Alinart The criticism of methods of thinking and methods of government was carried on after Plato’s death by Aristotle, who had been his pupil and who taught in the Lyceum.
uz: ATENALAR O'RTAKASINING Surat: Alinart Fikrlash usullari va boshqaruv usullarini tanqid qilish Platonning o'limidan keyin uning shogirdi bo'lgan va litseyda dars bergan Arastotel tomonidan davom ettirildi.

en: Aristotle came from the city of Stagira in Macedonia, and his father was court physician to the Macedonian king.
uz: Aristotel Makedoniyaning Stagira shahridan kelgan, otasi esa Makedoniya qirolining saroy shifokori edi.

en: For a time Aris- totle was tutor to Alexander, the king’s son, who was destined to achieve very great things of which we shall soon be telling.
uz: Bir vaqtlar Aris-totle shohning o'g'li Aleksandrga murabbiy bo'lgan, u juda buyuk narsalarga erishishga taqdirlangan edi, bu haqda tez orada aytib o'tamiz.

en: Aristotle’s work upon methods of thinking carried the science of Logic to a level at which it re- mained for ﬁfteen hundred years or more, until the mediæval schoolmen took up the ancient questions again.
uz: Aristotelning fikrlash usullari ustidagi ishlari Mantiq fanini shunday darajaga olib chiqdiki, u o'n besh yuz yil yoki undan ko'proq vaqt davomida qayta asoslangan, toki o'rta asr maktab o'quvchilari qadimiy savollarni qayta ko'rib chiqmaguncha.

en: Before man could really control his destiny as Plato taught, Aristotle perceived that he needed far more knowledge and far more accurate knowledge than he possessed.
uz: Odam o'z taqdirini Aflotun ta'lim berganidek chinakam nazorat qila olguncha, Arastotel o'ziga tegishli bo'lganidan ancha ko'proq bilim va aniq bilim kerakligini angladi.

en: And so Aristotle began that systematic collection of knowledge which nowadays we call Science.
uz: Shunday qilib, Arastu bugungi kunda biz Fan deb ataydigan bilimlarning tizimli to'plamini boshladi.

en: He sent out explorers to collect facts.
uz: U faktlarni yig'ish uchun tadqiqotchilarni yubordi.

en: father of natural history.
uz: Tabiiy tarix otasi.

en: He was the founder of political science.
uz: U siyosiy fan asoschisi edi.

en: His stu- dents at the Lyceum examined and compared the constitutions of 158 differ- ent states ....
uz: Uning litseydagi talabalari 158 ta turli shtatlarning konstitutsiyalarini tekshirib, solishtirdilar...

en: Here in the fourth century B.C.
uz: Bu yerda miloddan avvalgi to'rtinchi asrda.

en: we ﬁnd men who are practically “modern thinkers.” The child-like, dream-like methods of primitive thought had giv- en way to a disciplined and critical attack upon the problems of life.
uz: Biz amalda zamonaviy mutafakkirlar bo'lgan odamlarni topamiz. Ibtidoiy tafakkurning bolalarcha, orzuga o'xshash usullari hayot muammolariga intizomli va tanqidiy hujumga yo'l ochgan edi.

en: The weird and monstrous symbolism and imagery of the gods and god monsters, and all the taboos and awes and restraints that have hitherto encumbered thinking are here completely set aside.
uz: Xudolar va xudo maxluqlarining g'alati va dahshatli ramziyligi va tasvirlari, shu paytgacha tafakkurni to'sib kelgan barcha taqiqlar, qo'rqinchlar va cheklovlar bu yerda butunlay chetga surilgan.

en: Free, exact and systematic thinking has begun.
uz: Bepul, aniq va tizimli fikrlash boshlandi.

en: The fresh and unencumbered mind of these newcomers out of the northern forests has thrust itself into the mysteries of the temple and let the daylight in.
uz: Shimoliy o'rmonlardan chiqqan bu yangi kelganlarning yangi va to'siqlarsiz ongi ibodatxonaning sirlariga kirib, kunduzgi yorug'likka yo'l qo'ydi.

en: XXVI THE EMPIRE OF ALEXANDER THE GREAT From 431 to 404 B.C.
uz: XXVI ALIKSANDAR ULUG'NING imperiyasi Miloddan avvalgi 431 dan 404 gacha.

en: the Peloponnesian War wasted Greece.
uz: Peloponnes urushi Gretsiyani behudaga chiqardi.

en: Meanwhile to the north of Greece, the kindred country of Macedonia was rising slowly to power and civilization.
uz: Ayni paytda Gretsiya shimolida Makedoniya qarindosh davlati asta-sekin hokimiyat va tsivilizatsiyaga ko'tarilayotgan edi.

en: The Macedonians spoke a language closely akin to Greek, and on several occasions Macedonian competitors had taken part in the Olympic games.
uz: Makedoniyaliklar yunon tiliga yaqin tilda gaplashgan va bir necha bor Makedoniyalik musobaqachilar Olimpiya o'yinlarida ishtirok etgan.

en: a man of very great abilities and ambition became king of this little country—Philip.
uz: Juda katta qobiliyat va ambitsiyaga ega bo'lgan odam bu kichik mamlakatning shohi bo'ldi  Filipp.

en: Philip had previously been a hostage in Greece; he had had a thoroughly Greek education and he was probably aware of the ideas of Herodotus—which had also been developed by the philosopher Isocrates—of a possible conquest of Asia by a consoli- dated Greece.
uz: Filip avvalroq Gretsiyada garovga olingan edi; u toliq yunoncha talim olgan va u, ehtimol, Herodotning falsafachisi Izokrat tomonidan ham ishlab chiqilgan  Osiyoni konsollashgan Gretsiya tomonidan bosib olish mumkinligi haqidagi goyalaridan xabardor edi.

en: He set himself ﬁrst to extend and organize his own realm and to remodel his army.
uz: U avval o'z saltanatini kengaytirishga va tartibga solishga, shuningdek, o'z armiyasini qayta shakllantirishga qaror qildi.

en: For a thousand years now the charging horse-chariot had been the decisive factor in battles, that and the close-ﬁghting infantry.
uz: Ming yillardan beri ot-aravalar janglarda hal qiluvchi omil bo'lib kelgan edi, bu va yaqin jangovar piyoda askarlar.

en: Mounted horsemen had also fought, but as a cloud of skirmishers, individually and without discipline.
uz: Otliq chavandozlar ham jang qilishgan edi, lekin skirmishchilar buluti kabi, alohida va intizomsiz.

en: Philip made his infantry ﬁght in a closely packed mass, the Macedonian phalanx, and he trained his mounted gentlemen, the knights or companions, to ﬁght in formation and so invented cavalry.
uz: Filip o'z piyoda jangini zich to'plangan massivda, Makedoniya falankasida olib bordi va u o'zining otliq janoblarini, ritsarlar yoki hamrohlarini formationda jang qilishga o'rgatdi va shu tariqa otliq askarlarni ixtiro qildi.

en: The master move in most of his battles and in the battles of his son Alexander was a cavalry charge.
uz: Ustoz o'z janglarining ko'p qismida harakat qildi va o'g'li Aleksandrning janglarida otliq qo'shin edi.

en: The phalanx held the enemy infantry in front while the cav- alry swept away the enemy horse on his wings and poured in on the ﬂank and rear of his infantry.
uz: Falans dushman piyodasini oldinda ushlab turardi, g'orchilar esa dushman otini qanotlarida supurib, piyodasining yon va orqa tomonlariga kirib borardi.

en: Chariots were disabled by bowmen, who shot the horses.
uz: Aravani kamonchilar o'chirdi, ular otlarni otib tashladilar.

en: With this new army Philip extended his frontiers through Thessaly to Greece; and the battle of Chæronia (338 B.C.), fought against Athens and her allies, put all Greece at his feet.
uz: Ushbu yangi armiya bilan Filipp o'z chegaralarini Tasaliya orqali Gretsiyaga yo'naltirdi; va Afin va uning ittifoqchilariga qarshi kurashgan Xaron jangi (miloddan avvalgi 338 yil) butun Gretsiyani uning oyoqlari ostiga qo'ydi.

en: At last the dream of Herodotus was bearing fruit.
uz: Nihoyat, Herodotning orzusi o'z mevasini berdi.

en: A congress of all the Greek states appointed Philip captain-general of the Græco- Macedonian confederacy against Persia, and in 336 B.C.
uz: Barcha yunon davlatlarining qurultoyati Filipni Grek-Makedoniya konfederatsiyasining Forsga qarshi general-kapitan etib tayinladi va miloddan avvalgi 336-yilda.

en: his ad- vanced guard crossed into Asia upon this long premeditated adventure.
uz: Uning gvardiyasi uzoq muddat oldindan rejalashtirilgan sarguzashtga ko'ra Osiyoga o'tdi.

en: But he never followed it.
uz: Lekin u hech qachon bunga amal qilmadi.

en: He was assassinated; it is believed at the instigation of his queen Olympias, Alexander’s mother.
uz: U o'ldirildi; bu uning qirolichasi Olimpiya, Aleksandrning onasining undovi deb ishoniladi.

en: She was jealous because Philip had married a second wife.
uz: U Philipning ikkinchi xotiniga uylanganidan rashk qildi.

en: BUST OF ALEXANDER THE GREAT  (As in the British Museum) But Philip had taken unusual pains with his son’s education.
uz: ALEXANDR BUYUKNING BUSTI (Britaniya muzeyida bo'lgani kabi) Lekin Filip o'g'lining ta'limiga g'ayrioddiy tashvishlarni ko'targan edi.

en: He had not only secured Aristotle, the greatest philosopher in the world, as this boy’s
uz: U nafaqat dunyodagi eng buyuk faylasuf bo'lgan Arastotni, balki bu bola...

en: tutor, but he had shared his ideas with him and thrust military experience upon him.
uz: o'qituvchi, lekin u o'z g'oyalarini u bilan baham ko'rgan va unga harbiy tajriba o'rgatgan edi.

en: At Chæronia Alexander, who was then only eighteen years old, had been in command of the cavalry.
uz: Chæroniyada o'sha paytda atigi o'n sakkiz yoshda bo'lgan Aleksandr otliq askarlar qo'mondoni edi.

en: And so it was possible for this young man, who was still only twenty years old at the time of his accession, to take up his father’s task at once and to proceed successfully with the Per- sian adventure.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'z o'rniga kelgan paytda hali yigirma yoshda bo'lgan bu yigitga otasining vazifasini darhol bajarish va Per-sian sarguzashtlarini muvaffaqiyatli davom ettirish imkoni bo'ldi.

en: In 334 B.C.—for two years were needed to establish and conﬁrm his posi- tion in Macedonia and Greece—he crossed into Asia, defeated a not very much bigger Persian army at the battle of the Granicus and captured a num- ber of cities in Asia Minor.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 334-yilda  Makedoniya va Gretsiyada o'z pozitsiyasini o'rnatish va tasdiqlash uchun ikki yil kerak bo'ldi  u Osiyoga o'tdi, Granik jangida unchalik katta bo'lmagan Fors armiyasini mag'lub etdi va Kichik Osiyodagi bir qator shaharlarni egalladi.

en: He kept along the sea-coast.
uz: U dengiz sohili bo'ylab davom etdi.

en: It was necessary for him to reduce and garrison all the coast towns as he advanced because the Persians had control of the ﬂeets of Tyre and Sidon and so had command of the sea.
uz: U oldinga siljigan sari barcha qirg'oq shaharlarini qisqartirish va garnizonlash zarur edi, chunki forslar Sur va Sidon flotlarini nazorat qilishardi va shu bilan birga dengizga ham hukmronlik qilishardi.

en: Had he left a hostile port in his rear the Persians might have landed forces to raid his communications and cut him off.
uz: Agar u orqa tomonda dushman portini tark etganida, forslar uning aloqalariga hujum qilish va uni kesib tashlash uchun qo'shinlarni joylashtirishi mumkin edi.

en: At Issus (333 B.C.) he met and smashed a vast conglomerate host under Darius III.
uz: Isusda (miloddan avvalgi 333 yil) u Dariy III boshchiligidagi ulkan konglomerat qo'shiniga duch keldi va uni mag'lub etdi.

en: Like the host of Xerxes that had crossed the Dardanelles a century and a half before, it was an incoherent accumulation of contingents and it was encumbered with a multitude of court ofﬁcials, the harem of Darius and many camp follow- ers.
uz: Xuddi bir yarim asr oldin Dardanelni kesib o'tgan Gerks qo'shini kabi, bu ham notekis kontingent to'planishi edi va u saroy amaldorlarining ko'pligi, Daryo haremi va ko'plab qo'shnilar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: Sidon surrendered to Alexander but Tyre resisted obstinately.
uz: Sidon Aleksandrga taslim bo'ldi, lekin Tir qat'iyat bilan qarshilik ko'rsatdi.

en: Finally that great city was stormed and plundered and destroyed.
uz: Nihoyat, o'sha buyuk shahar hujumga uchradi, talon-toroj qilindi va vayron qilindi.

en: Gaza also was stormed, and towards the end of 332 B.C.
uz: G'azo ham hujumga uchradi va miloddan avvalgi 332 yil oxiriga kelib.

en: the conqueror entered Egypt and took over its rule from the Persians.
uz: Bosqinchi Misrga kirib, uning hukmronligini forslardan oldi.

en: ALEXANDER’S VICTORY OVER THE PERSIANS AT ISSUS  (From the Pompeian Mosaic)  Alexander charges in on the left, Darius is in the chariot to the right At Alexandretta and at Alexandria in Egypt he built great cities, accessi- ble from the land and so incapable of revolt.
uz: ALEXANDRANING ISSUSDAGI PERSONLAR UCHUN G'ALABASI (Pompemiya mozaikasidan) Aleksandr chap tomonda yuradi, Dariy o'ng tomondagi aravachada Aleksandretada va Misrdagi Iskandariyada u yerdan kirib kelgan va isyon ko'tarishga qodir bo'lmagan buyuk shaharlarni qurdi.

en: To these the trade of the Phœnician cities was diverted.
uz: Foniya shaharlarining savdosi shularga yo'naltirildi.

en: The Phœnicians of the western Mediter- ranean suddenly disappear from history—and as immediately the Jews of Alexandria and the other new trading cities created by Alexander appear.
uz: Gʻarbiy Oʻrta yer dengizi finikiylari birdaniga tarixdan yoʻqoladi  va shu zahoti Iskandariya yahudiylari va Aleksandr yaratgan boshqa yangi savdo shaharlari paydo boʻladi.

en: Alexander marched out of Egypt upon Babylon as Thothmes and Rameses and Necho had done before him.
uz: Aleksandr Misrdan Bobilga tomon bordi, xuddi Tothmes, Ramzes va Nexo o'zidan oldin qilganidek.

en: But he marched by way of Tyre.
uz: Ammo u Tir yo'li bilan yurdi.

en: At Arbela near the ruins of Nineveh, which was already a forgotten city, he met Darius and fought the decisive battle of the war.
uz: Arbelada, Nineva xarobalari yaqinida, allaqachon unutilgan shaharda, u Daryo bilan uchrashdi va urushning hal qiluvchi jangini olib bordi.

en: The Persian chariot charge failed, a Macedonian cavalry charge broke up the great com- posite host and the phalanx completed the victory.
uz: Fors aravalari hujumi muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, Makedoniya otliqlari hujumi buyuk kom-pozit qo'shinni parchalab tashladi va falang g'alabani yakunladi.

en: Darius led the retreat.
uz: Dariy chekinishga boshchilik qildi.

en: He made no further attempt to resist the invader but ﬂed northward into the country of the Medes.
uz: U bosqinchiga qarshi turishga boshqa urinmadi, balki shimolga qarab Medlar mamlakatiga qochdi.

en: Alexander marched on to Babylon, still prosperous and important, and then to Susa and Persepolis.
uz: Aleksandr hali ham farovon va muhim bo'lgan Bobilga, so'ngra Susa va Persepolisga yo'l oldi.

en: There after a drunken festi- val he burnt down the palace of Darius, the king of kings.
uz: U yerda mast bayramdan so'ng, u shohlar shohi Daryo saroyini yoqib yubordi.

en: THE APOLLO BELVEDERE  (In the Vatican Museum) Thence Alexander presently made a military parade of central Asia, go- ing to the utmost bounds of the Persian empire.
uz: APOLLO BELVEDERE (Vatikandagi muzeyda) U yerdan Aleksandr yaqinda Markaziy Osiyo harbiy paradini o'tkazdi va Fors imperiyasining eng chekka hududlariga bordi.

en: At ﬁrst he turned north- ward.
uz: Avvaliga u shimolga burildi.

en: Darius was pursued; and he was overtaken at dawn dying in his chari- ot, having been murdered by his own people.
uz: Dariy ta'qib qilindi; va u o'z xalqi tomonidan o'ldirilgan holda, o'z aravachasida erta tongda o'ldirib ketildi.

en: He was still living when the foremost Greeks reached him.
uz: U hali ham tirik edi, o'sha paytda eng ilg'or yunonlar unga yetib kelishdi.

en: Alexander came up to ﬁnd him dead.
uz: Aleksandr uni o'lik holda topdi.

en: Alexander skirted the Caspian Sea, he went up into the mountains of west- ern Turkestan, he came down by Herat (which he founded) and Cabul and the Khyber Pass into India.
uz: Aleksandr Kaspiy dengizini chetlab o'tib, G'arbiy Turkiston tog'lariga ko'tarildi, u Herat (uning asos solgan) va Kabul hamda Xayber dovoni orqali Hindistonga tushdi.

en: He fought a great battle on the Indus with an Indian king, Porus, and here the Macedonian troops met elephants for the
uz: U Hindiston shohi Porus bilan Indusda buyuk jang qildi va bu yerda Makedoniya qo'shinlari fillar bilan uchrashdi.

en: ﬁrst time and defeated them.
uz: birinchi marta va ularni mag'lub etdi.

en: Finally he built himself ships, sailed down to the mouth of the Indus, and marched back by the coast of Beluchistan, reaching Susa again in 324 B.C.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'ziga kemalar qurdi, Ind daryosi og'ziga tushdi va Belujiston qirg'og'i bo'ylab qaytdi, miloddan avvalgi 324-yilda yana Susaga yetib keldi.

en: after an absence of six years.
uz: Olti yillik yo'qlikdan keyin.

en: He then pre- pared to consolidate and organize this vast empire he had won.
uz: Keyin u g'alaba qozongan ulkan imperiyani mustahkamlash va tashkil etishga tayyor edi.

en: He sought to win over his new subjects.
uz: U o'zining yangi sub'ektlarini yutishga harakat qildi.

en: He assumed the robes and tiara of a Persian monarch, and this roused the jealousy of his Macedonian commanders.
uz: U Fors monarxining liboslari va tiarasini o'z zimmasiga oldi va bu uning Makedoniya qo'mondonlarining rashqini keltirib chiqardi.

en: He had much trouble with them.
uz: U ular bilan juda ko'p muammolarga duch keldi.

en: He arranged a number of marriages between these Macedonian ofﬁcers and Persian and Babylonian women: the “Mar- riage of the East and West.” He never lived to effect the consolidation he had planned.
uz: U bu makedoniyalik ofitserlar va fors va bobillik ayollar o'rtasida bir qator nikohlarni tashkil qildi: Sharq va G'arb marsiyalari. U hech qachon o'zi rejalashtirgan konsolidatsiyani amalga oshirish uchun yashamadi.

en: A fever seized him after a drinking bout in Babylon and he died in 323 B.C.
uz: Bobilda ichib yurganidan keyin uni isitma tutdi va miloddan avvalgi 323-yilda vafot etdi.

en: Immediately this vast dominion fell to pieces.
uz: Darhol bu ulkan hukmronlik parchalanib ketdi.

en: One of his generals, Seleu- cus, retained most of the old Persian empire from the Indus to Ephesus; an- other, Ptolemy, seized Egypt, and Antigonus secured Macedonia.
uz: Uning generallaridan biri, Seleu-kush, Hinddan Efesgacha bo'lgan eski Fors imperiyasining ko'p qismini saqlab qoldi; boshqasi, Ptolemey Misrni egalladi va Antigon Makedoniyani himoya qildi.

en: The rest of the empire remained unstable, passing under the control of a succession of local adventurers.
uz: Imperiyaning qolgan qismi beqaror bo'lib qoldi va mahalliy sarguzashtchilarning ketma-ketligi nazoratiga o'tdi.

en: Barbarian raids began from the north and grew in scope and intensity.
uz: Barbar reydlari shimoldan boshlanib, ko'lami va intensivligi oshdi.

en: Until at last, as we shall tell, a new power, the power of the Roman republic, came out of the west to subjugate one fragment after another and weld them together into a new and more enduring empire.
uz: Nihoyat, biz aytib o'tadiganimizdek, g'arbdan yangi kuch, Rim respublikasi kuchi kelib, bir parchani ketma-ket bo'ysundirib, ularni yangi va yanada bardavom imperiyaga bog'ladi.

en: XXVII THE MUSEUM AND LIBRARY AT ALEXANDRIA Before the time of Alexander Greeks had already been spreading as mer- chants, artists, ofﬁcials, mercenary soldiers, over most of the Persian do- minions.
uz: XXVII ALEKSANDRIyadagi muzey va kutubxona Aleksandr davridan oldin yunonlar allaqachon fors do-minionlarining aksariyati ustida mer-sants, rassomlar, amaldorlar, yollanma askarlar sifatida tarqalgan edi.

en: In the dynastic disputes that followed the death of Xerxes, a band of ten thousand Greek mercenaries played a part under the leadership of Xenophon.
uz: Kserksning o'limidan keyingi sulolaviy bahslarda, Ksenofon boshchiligida o'n minglik yunon yollanma askarlari ishtirok etdi.

en: Their return to Asiatic Greece from Babylon is described in his Retreat of the Ten Thousand, one of the ﬁrst war stories that was ever writ- ten by a general in command.
uz: Ularning Bobildan Osiyo Gretsiyasiga qaytishi uning O'n Minglik Chekinishi kitobida tasvirlangan bo'lib, bu general qo'mondon tomonidan yozilgan birinchi urush hikoyalaridan biridir.

en: But the conquests of Alexander and the divi- sion of his brief empire among his subordinate generals, greatly stimulated this permeation of the ancient world by the Greeks and their language and fashions and culture.
uz: Lekin Aleksandrning fathlari va uning qisqa imperiyasining o'z qo'l ostidagi generallar orasida bo'linishi yunonlar va ularning tili, modalari va madaniyati tomonidan qadimgi dunyoga kirib borishni sezilarli darajada rag'batlantirdi.

en: Traces of this Greek dissemination are to be found far away in central Asia and in north-west India.
uz: Bu yunon tarqalishining izlari Markaziy Osiyoda va Hindistonning shimoli-g'arbiy qismida uzoq joylarda uchraydi.

en: Their inﬂuence upon the de- velopment of Indian art was profound.
uz: Ularning Hindiston san'atining rivojlanishiga ta'siri chuqur edi.

en: For many centuries Athens retained her prestige as a centre of art and culture; her schools went on indeed to 529 A.D., that is to say for nearly a thousand years; but the leadership in the intellectual activity of the world passed presently across the Mediterranean to Alexandria, the new trading city that Alexander had founded.
uz: Ko'p asrlar davomida Afina san'at va madaniyat markazi sifatida o'z obro'sini saqlab qoldi; uning maktablari haqiqatan ham milodiy 529 yilga, ya'ni deyarli ming yilga borib taqaladi; ammo dunyoning intellektual faoliyatidagi yetakchilik hozirda O'rta yer dengizi orqali Aleksandriyaga, Aleksandr asos solgan yangi savdo shahriga o'tdi.

en: Here the Macedonian general Ptolemy had become Pharaoh, with a court that spoke Greek.
uz: Bu yerda Makedoniyalik general Ptolemey fir'avnga aylandi, uning saroyi yunon tilida gapirardi.

en: He had become an intimate of Alexander before he became king, and he was deeply saturated with the ideas of Aristotle.
uz: U Aleksandrning qirol bo'lishidan oldin yaqin do'stiga aylangan edi va u Aristotelning g'oyalariga chuqur to'yingan edi.

en: He set himself, with great energy and capacity, to orga- nize knowledge and investigation.
uz: U o'zini katta energiya va salohiyat bilan bilim va tadqiqot o'tkazishga qaratdi.

en: He also wrote a history of Alexander’s campaigns which, unhappily, is lost to the world.
uz: U shuningdek, Aleksandrning yurishlari tarixi ham yozgan, afsuski, u dunyoga yo'qolgan.

en: Alexander had already devoted considerable sums to ﬁnance the en- quiries of Aristotle, but Ptolemy I was the ﬁrst person to make a permanent endowment of science.
uz: Aleksandr allaqachon Aristotelning izlanishlarini moliyalashtirish uchun sezilarli miqdorda mablag' sarflagan edi, lekin Ptolemey I fan uchun doimiy mablag' yaratgan birinchi shaxs edi.

en: He set up a foundation in Alexandria which was for- merly dedicated to the Muses, the Museum of Alexandria.
uz: U Iskandariyada faqatgina Musolarga, Iskandariya muzeyiga bag'ishlangan poydevor tashkil etdi.

en: For two or three generations the scientiﬁc work done at Alexandria was extraordinarily good.
uz: Ikki-uch avlod davomida Iskandariyada qilingan ilmiy ishlar favqulodda darajada yaxshi edi.

en: Euclid, Eratosthenes who measured the size of the earth and came within ﬁfty miles of its true diameter, Apollonius who wrote on conic sec- tions, Hipparchus who made the ﬁrst star map and catalogue, and Hero who devised the ﬁrst steam engine are among the greater stars of an ex- traordinary constellation of scientiﬁc pioneers.
uz: Evklid, Eratosten, Yerning o'lchamini o'lchagan va uning haqiqiy diametriga ellik milya yaqin bo'lgan, Apolloniy konik seksiyalarda yozgan, Hipparx birinchi yulduz xaritasi va katalogini yaratgan va birinchi bug' dvigatelini o'ylab topgan Qahramonlar sobiq favqulodda yulduz turkumining yirik yulduzlaridan biridir.

en: Archimedes came from Syracuse to Alexandria to study, and was a frequent correspondent of the Museum.
uz: Arximed Sirakuzadan Iskandariyaga o'qish uchun keldi va muzeyning tez-tez muxbiri edi.

en: Herophilus was one of the greatest of Greek anatomists, and is said to have practised vivisection.
uz: Herofil yunon anatomlarining eng buyuklaridan biri bo'lgan va Vivisection bilan shug'ullanganligi aytiladi.

en: For a generation or so during the reigns of Ptolemy I and Ptolemy II there was such a blaze of knowledge and discovery at Alexandria as the world was not to see again until the sixteenth century A.D.
uz: Ptolemey I va Ptolemey II hukmronligi davrida taxminan bir avlod davomida Iskandariyada shunday bilim va kashfiyot alangasi bo'lganki, dunyo uni milodiy o'n oltinchi asrgacha qayta ko'rmagan.

en: But it did not continue.
uz: Lekin bu davom etmadi.

en: There may have been several causes of this decline.
uz: Bu pasayishning bir nechta sabablari bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Chief among them, the late Professor Mahaffy suggested, was the fact that the Museum was a “roy- al” college and all its professors and fellows were appointed and paid by Pharaoh.
uz: Ularning eng asosiysi, marhum professor Mahaffy ta'kidlaganidek, muzey roy-al kollej ekanligi va uning barcha professorlari va hamkasblari Fir'avn tomonidan tayinlangan va to'langanligi edi.

en: This was all very well when Pharaoh was Ptolemy I, the pupil and friend of Aristotle.
uz: Bularning barchasi juda yaxshi edi, Fir'avn Arastuning shogirdi va do'sti Ptolemey I bo'lgan paytda.

en: But as the dynasty of the Ptolemies went on they became Egyptianized, they fell under the sway of Egyptian priests and Egyptian re- ligious developments, they ceased to follow the work that was done, and their control stiﬂed the spirit of enquiry altogether.
uz: Ammo Ptolemey sulolasi Misrga aylanib borar ekan, ular Misr ruhoniylari va Misrning qonuniy rivojlanishlari ta'siriga tushib, qilingan ishlarga amal qilishni to'xtatdilar va ularning nazorati butunlay so'rov ruhini bo'g'ib qo'ydi.

en: The Museum produced little good work after its ﬁrst century of activity.
uz: Muzey faoliyatining birinchi asridan keyin unchalik yaxshi ish ko'rsatmadi.

en: Ptolemy I not only sought in the most modern spirit to organize the ﬁnd- ing of fresh knowledge.
uz: Ptolemey I nafaqat eng zamonaviy ruhda yangi bilimlarni topishni tashkil etishga intildi.

en: He tried also to set up an encyclopædic storehouse of wisdom in the Library of Alexandria.
uz: U shuningdek, Iskandariya kutubxonasida hikmatning ensiklopedik omborini tashkil etishga harakat qildi.

en: It was not simply a storehouse, it was also a book-copying and book-selling organization.
uz: Bu shunchaki ombor emas edi, balki kitob nusxalash va kitob sotish tashkiloti ham edi.

en: A great army of copyists was set to work perpetually multiplying copies of books.
uz: Kitoblarning nusxalarini doimiy ravishda ko'paytirish uchun katta nusxa ko'chirish armiyasi ishga tushdi.

en: Here then we have the deﬁnite ﬁrst opening up of the intellectual process in which we live to-day; here we have the systematic gathering and distrib- ution of knowledge.
uz: Bu yerda biz bugungi kunda yashayotgan intellektual jarayonning aniq birinchi ochilishi bor; bu yerda bilimlarni tizimli yig'ish va tarqatish bor.

en: The foundation of this Museum and Library marks one of the great epochs in the history of mankind.
uz: Ushbu Muzey va Kutubxonaning tashkil topishi insoniyat tarixidagi buyuk davrlardan birini belgilaydi.

en: It is the true beginning of Modern History.
uz: Bu zamonaviy tarixning haqiqiy boshlanishi.

en: ARISTOTLE  From Herculaneum, probably Fourth Century B.C.
uz: ARISTOTOL Gerkulanumdan, ehtimol miloddan avvalgi to'rtinchi asr.

en: Singer Both the work of research and the work of dissemination went on under serious handicaps.
uz: Qo'shiqchi Ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlari ham, tarqatish ishlari ham jiddiy qiyinchiliklar ostida davom etdi.

en: One of these was the great social gap that separated the philosopher, who was a gentleman, from the trader and the artisan.
uz: Shulardan biri, janob bo'lgan faylasufni savdogar va hunarmanddan ajratib turuvchi ulkan ijtimoiy bo'shliq edi.

en: There were glass workers and metal workers in abundance in those days, but they were not in mental contact with the thinkers.
uz: O'sha kunlarda shisha ishchilari va metall ishchilari mo'l-ko'l edi, lekin ular mutafakkirlar bilan ruhiy aloqada emas edilar.

en: The glass worker was making the most beautifully coloured beads and phials and so forth, but he never made a Florentine ﬂask or a lens.
uz: Shisha ishchisi eng chiroyli rangli boncuklar, piyolalar va hokazolarni yasayotgan edi, lekin u hech qachon Florensiya kolbasini yoki linzasini yasamagan.

en: Clear glass does not seem to have interest- ed him.
uz: Shaffof shisha uni qiziqtirmaydiganga o'xshaydi.

en: The metal worker made weapons and jewellery but he never made a chemical balance.
uz: Metall ishchisi qurol-yarog' va zargarlik buyumlarini yasagan, lekin hech qachon kimyoviy muvozanat yaratmagan.

en: The philosopher speculated loftily about atoms and the nature of things, but he had no practical experience of enamels and pig-
uz: Faylasuf atomlar va narsalarning tabiati haqida balandparvozlik bilan taxmin qildi, lekin u emal va cho'chqa haqida amaliy tajribaga ega emas edi.

en: ments and philters and so forth.
uz: ments va filtrlar va hokazo.

en: He was not interested in substances.
uz: Unga moddalar qiziq emas edi.

en: So Alexandria in its brief day of opportunity produced no microscopes and no chemistry.
uz: Shunday qilib, Iskandariya o'zining qisqa imkoniyat kunida hech qanday mikroskop va kimyo yaratmadi.

en: And though Hero invented a steam engine it was never set either to pump or drive a boat or do any useful thing.
uz: Garchi Hero bug' dvigatelini ixtiro qilsa ham, u hech qachon na nasoslash, na qayiqni haydash, na hech qanday foydali ish qilish uchun mo'ljallanmagan.

en: There were few practical ap- plications of science except in the realm of medicine, and the progress of science was not stimulated and sustained by the interest and excitement of practical applications.
uz: Tibbiyot sohasida fanning amaliy qo'llanilishi kam edi va fan taraqqiyoti amaliy qo'llashning qiziqarliligi va hayajoni bilan rag'batlantirilmagan va qo'llab-quvvatlanmagan edi.
