en: There was nothing to keep the work going therefore when the intellectual curiosity of Ptolemy I and Ptolemy II was withdrawn.
uz: Shunday qilib, Ptolomey I va Ptolomey II ning intellektual qiziquvchanligi bekor qilinganda, ishni davom ettiradigan hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: The discoveries of the Museum went on record in obscure manuscripts and never, until the revival of scientiﬁc curiosity at the Renascence, reached out to the mass of mankind.
uz: Muzeyning kashfiyotlari qorong'u qo'lyozmalarda yozib qoldirilgan va hech qachon, Renesansda ilmiy qiziqish uyg'onmaguncha, insoniyat ommasiga yetib bormagan.

en: Nor did the Library produce any improvements in book making.
uz: Kutubxona kitob yasashda hech qanday yaxshilanish olib kelmadi.

en: That an- cient world had no paper made in deﬁnite sizes from rag pulp.
uz: O'sha ilmiy dunyoda zig'ir pulpasidan aniq o'lchamdagi qog'oz yasalmagan edi.

en: Paper was a Chinese invention and it did not reach the western world until the ninth cen- tury A.D.
uz: Qog'oz Xitoy ixtirosi bo'lgan va u milodiy to'qqizinchi asrgacha g'arb olamiga yetib bormagan.

en: The only book materials were parchment and strips of the papyrus reed joined edge to edge.
uz: Yagona kitob materiallari pergament va qirra-qirra yopishtirilgan papirus qamish qatlamlari edi.

en: These strips were kept on rolls which were very unwieldy to wind to and fro and read, and very inconvenient for reference.
uz: Bu chiziqlar juda qiyin bo'lgan va o'qish uchun juda noqulay bo'lgan va ma'lumot uchun juda noqulay bo'lgan rulonlarda saqlangan.

en: It was these things that prevented the development of paged and printed books.
uz: Aynan shu narsalar sahifalashtirilgan va bosma kitoblarning rivojlanishiga to'sqinlik qildi.

en: Printing itself was known in the world it would seem as early as the Old Stone Age; there were seals in ancient Sumeria; but without abundant paper there was little advantage in printing books, an improvement that may further have been resisted by trades unionism on the part of the copyists employed.
uz: Bosmaxona o'zi dunyoda qadimgi tosh davridagidek ma'lum edi; qadimgi Sumeriyada muhrlar bor edi; lekin mo'l qog'ozsiz kitoblarni chop etishda kam afzallik bor edi, bu yaxshilanish nusxa ko'chirishchilar tomonidan qo'llaniladigan savdo ittifoqchiligi tomonidan yanada qarshilik ko'rsatilishi mumkin edi.

en: Alexandria produced abundant books but not cheap books, and it never spread knowledge into the population of the ancient world below the level of a wealthy and inﬂuential class.
uz: Iskandariya mo'l kitoblar ishlab chiqardi, lekin arzon kitoblar emas, va u hech qachon boy va nufuzli sinf darajasidan past bo'lgan qadimgi dunyo aholisiga bilim tarqatmadi.

en: STATUETTE OF MAITREYA: THE BUDDHA TO COME  A Græco-Buddhist sculpture of the Third Century A.D.
uz: MAITREYA haykali: BUDDHA Milodiy III asrning yunon-buddaviy haykaliga aylanadi.

en: Province, now in the India Museum) So it was that this blaze of intellectual enterprise never reached beyond a small circle of people in touch with the group of philosophers collected by the ﬁrst two Ptolemies.
uz: Viloyat, hozir Hindiston muzeyida) Shunday qilib, intellektual tadbirkorlikning bu alangasi birinchi ikki Ptolemey tomonidan to'plangan faylasuflar guruhi bilan aloqada bo'lgan kichik bir guruh odamlardan tashqariga chiqmagan edi.

en: It was like the light in a dark lantern which is shut off from the world at large.
uz: Bu xuddi butun dunyodan o'chirilgan qorong'u chiroqdagi nurga o'xshardi.

en: Within the blaze may be blindingly bright, but nevertheless it is unseen.
uz: Olov ichida ko'zni qamashtiruvchi darajada yorqin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin shunga qaramay u ko'rinmas.

en: The rest of the world went on its old ways un- aware that the seed of scientiﬁc knowledge that was one day to revolution- ize it altogether had been sown.
uz: Dunyoning qolgan qismi o'zining eski uslubida davom etdi - bir kun inqilobga olib boradigan ilmiy bilim urug'i butunlay ekilganini bilmasdan.

en: Presently a darkness of bigotry fell even upon Alexandria.
uz: Hozirda Iskandariyaga ham bigotinlik zulmati tushdi.

en: Thereafter for a thousand years of darkness the seed that Aristotle had sown lay hidden.
uz: Shundan so'ng, ming yil davomida zulmatda Arastotel ekkan urug' yashirinib yotdi.

en: Then it stirred and began to germinate.
uz: Keyin u aralashdi va unib chiqishni boshladi.

en: In a few centuries it had become that widespread growth of knowledge and clear ideas that is now changing the whole of human life.
uz: Bir necha asr ichida bilim va aniq g'oyalarning keng tarqalgan o'sishi hozirda butun insoniyat hayotini o'zgartirmoqda edi.

en: THE DEATH OF BUDDHA  Græco-Buddhist carving from Sivat Valley, N.
uz: BUDDA O'LIMI Sivat vodiysidan Græco-Buddhist o'ymakorligi, N.

en: Province, probably A.D.
uz: Viloyat, ehtimol milodiy.

en: Alexandria was not the only centre of Greek intellectual activity in the third century B.C.
uz: Aleksandriya miloddan avvalgi uchinchi asrda yunon intellektual faoliyatining yagona markazi emas edi.

en: There were many other cities that displayed a brilliant in- tellectual life amidst the disintegrating fragments of the brief empire of Alexander.
uz: Aleksandrning qisqa imperiyasining parchalanayotgan qismlari orasida ajoyib hikoyaviy hayotni namoyish etgan ko'plab boshqa shaharlar ham bor edi.

en: There was, for example, the Greek city of Syracuse in Sicily, where thought and science ﬂourished for two centuries; there was Perga- mum in Asia Minor, which also had a great library.
uz: Masalan, Sitsiliyadagi Sirakuza yunon shahri bor edi, u yerda fikr va fan ikki asr davomida gullab-yashnadi; Kichik Osiyoda Perga-mumi bor edi, u yerda ham katta kutubxona bor edi.

en: But this brilliant Hel- lenic world was now stricken by invasion from the north.
uz: Ammo bu ajoyib Hel- lenik dunyosi endi shimoldan bosqin natijasida vayron bo'ldi.

en: New Nordic bar- barians, the Gauls, were striking down along the tracks that had once been followed by the ancestors of the Greeks and Phrygians and Macedonians.
uz: Yangi Skandinaviya barlari, gallar, bir vaqtlar yunonlar, frigiyaliklar va makedoniyaliklarning ajdodlari tomonidan kuzatilgan izlar bo'ylab hujum qilmoqda edi.

en: They raided, shattered and destroyed.
uz: Ular hujum qildilar, sindirdilar va yo'q qildilar.

en: And in the wake of the Gauls came a new conquering people out of Italy, the Romans, who gradually subjugated all the western half of the vast realm of Darius and Alexander.
uz: Va gallarning ortidan Italiyadan yangi zabt etuvchi xalq, rimliklar keldi, ular asta-sekin Daryo va Aleksandrning ulkan saltanatining butun g'arbiy yarmini bo'ysundirdilar.

en: They were an able but unimaginative people, preferring law and proﬁt to either science or art.
uz: Ular qobiliyatli, ammo tasavvurga ega bo'lmagan xalq edilar, qonun va foydani fan yoki san'atdan afzal ko'rishardi.

en: New invaders were also coming down out of central Asia to shatter and subdue the Seleucid empire and to cut off the western world again from India.
uz: Yangi bosqinchilar ham Markaziy Osiyodan Seleviklar imperiyasini parchalash va bo'ysundirish hamda G'arbiy dunyoni Hindistondan yana kesib tashlash uchun tushayotgan edi.

en: These were the Parthians, hosts of mounted bowmen, who treated the Græco-Persian empire of Persepolis and Susa in the third century B.C.
uz: Bular partiylar edi, otliq kamonchilarning qo'shini bo'lib, miloddan avvalgi uchinchi asrda Persepolis va Susa yunon- fors imperiyasiga qarshi kurashgan.

en: in much the same fashion that the Medes and Persians had treated it in the sev- enth and sixth.
uz: Xuddi Medlar va Forslar yettinchi va oltinchi asrlarda unga qanday munosabatda bo'lishgan bo'lsa, xuddi shunday tarzda.

en: And there were now other nomadic peoples also coming out of the northeast, peoples who were not fair and Nordic and Aryan- speaking
uz: Va endi shimoli-sharqdan boshqa ko'chmanchi xalqlar ham chiqdi, adolatli bo'lmagan va skandinaviyalik va ariy tillarida gapiradigan xalqlar.

en: but yellow-skinned and black-haired and with a Mongolian speech.
uz: Lekin sariq tanli va qora sochli va moʻgʻul tili bilan.

en: But of these latter people we shall tell more in a subsequent chapter.
uz: Ammo bu oxirgi odamlar haqida keyingi bobda ko'proq aytib o'tamiz.

en: XXVIII THE LIFE OF GAUTAMA BUDDHA But now we must go back three centuries in our story to tell of a great teacher who came near to revolutionizing the religious thought and feeling of all Asia.
uz: XXVIII GAUTAMA BUDDHANING HAYOTI Ammo endi biz butun Osiyo diniy tafakkuri va hissiyotini inqilob qilishga yaqinlashgan buyuk ustoz haqida hikoya qilish uchun o'z hikoyamizga uch asr orqaga qaytishimiz kerak.

en: This was Gautama Buddha, who taught his disciples at Benares in India about the same time that Isaiah was prophesying among the Jews in Babylon and Heraclitus was carrying on his speculative enquiries into the nature of things at Ephesus.
uz: Bu Gautama Budda edi, u Hindistondagi Benaresda o'z shogirdlariga Ishayo Bobildagi yahudiylar orasida bashorat qilayotgan va Geraklit Efesda narsalarning tabiatiga oid taxminiy so'rovlarini olib borayotgan bir paytda o'rgatgan.

en: All these men were in the world at the same time, in the sixth century B.C.—unaware of one another.
uz: Bularning barchasi miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda bir vaqtning o'zida dunyoda edilar  bir-biridan bexabar edilar.

en: This sixth century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asr.

en: was indeed one of the most remarkable in all his- tory.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, u o'zining barcha sohalarida eng diqqatga sazovorlaridan biri edi.

en: Everywhere—for as we shall tell it was also the case in China—men’s minds were displaying a new boldness.
uz: Hamma joyda  aytganimizdek, Xitoyda ham shunday bo'lgan edi  odamlarning ongiga yangi jur'at kelayotgan edi.

en: Everywhere they were waking up out of the traditions of kingships and priests and blood sacriﬁces and asking the most penetrating questions.
uz: Hamma joyda ular qirollik va ruhoniylik an'analaridan, qon qurbonliklaridan uyg'onib, eng chuqur savollarni berishardi.

en: It is as if the race had reached a stage of adolescence—after a childhood of twenty thousand years.
uz: Xuddi poyga o'smirlik bosqichiga yetgandek  yigirma ming yillik bolalikdan keyin.

en: The early history of India is still very obscure.
uz: Hindistonning dastlabki tarixi hali ham juda noaniq.

en: Somewhen perhaps about 2000 B.C., an Aryan- speaking people came down from the north-west into India either in one invasion or in a series of invasions; and was able to spread its language and traditions over most of north India.
uz: Taxminan miloddan avvalgi 2000-yillarda, shimoli-g'arbdan ariy tilida so'zlashuvchi xalq bir bosqin yoki bir qator bosqinlar natijasida Hindistonga tushdi va o'z tilini va an'analarini shimoliy Hindistonning ko'p qismiga tarqatishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Its peculiar vari- ety of Aryan speech was the Sanskrit.
uz: Aryan nutqining o'ziga xos xilma-xilligi sanskrit edi.

en: They found a brunette people with a more elaborate civilization and less vigour of will, in possession of the country of the Indus and Ganges.
uz: Ular Indus va Ganga o'lkasini egallagan, murakkabroq tsivilizatsiya va kamroq irodali, qora sochli xalqni topdilar.

en: But they do not seem to have mingled with their predecessors as freely as did the Greeks and Persians.
uz: Lekin ular o'zidan oldingilar bilan yunonlar va forslar kabi erkin aralashmagan ko'rinadi.

en: They re- mained aloof.
uz: Ular qayta aloqada bo'lishdi.

en: When the past of India becomes dimly visible to the histori- an, Indian society is already stratiﬁed into several layers, with a variable number of sub-divisions, which do not eat together nor intermarry nor as-
uz: Hindiston o'tmishi tarixga xira ko'rinadigan bo'lganda, Hindiston jamiyati allaqachon bir nechta qatlamlarga bo'linadi, o'zgaruvchan qismlarga ega bo'lib, ular birga ovqatlanmaydi, na turmush qurishmaydi, na...

en: And throughout history this stratiﬁcation into castes contin- ues.
uz: Va butun tarix davomida kastalarga bo'linish davom etdi.

en: This makes the Indian population something different from the simple, freely inter-breeding European or Mongolian communities.
uz: Bu Hindiston aholisini oddiy, erkin o'zaro ko'payib boruvchi Yevropa yoki Mo'g'ul jamoalaridan biroz farq qiladi.

en: It is really a community of communities.
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham jamiyatlarning jamiyati.

en: Siddhattha Gautama was the son of an aristocratic family which ruled a small district on the Himalayan slopes.
uz: Siddhattha Gautama aristokratik oilaning o'g'li bo'lib, ular Himolay tog'lari yonbag'rida kichik bir tumanni boshqargan.

en: He was married at nineteen to a beautiful cousin.
uz: U o'n to'qqiz yoshida chiroyli amakivachchchasiga turmushga chiqdi.

en: He hunted and played and went about in his sunny world of gardens and groves and irrigated rice-ﬁelds.
uz: U ov qilardi, o'ynardi va o'zining quyoshli bog'lari, bog'lari va sug'orilgan guruchzorlari olamida aylanib yurardi.

en: And it was amidst this life that a great discontent fell upon him.
uz: Va aynan shu hayotning o'rtasida unga katta norozilik tushdi.

en: It was the unhappiness of a ﬁne brain that seeks employment.
uz: Bu ish qidirayotgan nozik miyaning baxtsizligi edi.

en: He felt that the existence he was leading was not the reality of life, but a holiday—a holiday that had gone on too long.
uz: U o'zi olib borayotgan mavjudlik hayotning haqiqati emas, balki juda uzoq davom etgan bayram ekanligini his qildi.

en: The sense of disease and mortality, the insecurity and the un-satisfactori- ness of all happiness, descended upon the mind of Gautama.
uz: Gautama ongiga kasallik va o'lim tuyg'usi, barcha baxtning beqarorligi va qoniqmasligi tushdi.

en: While he was in this mood he met one of those wandering ascetics who already existed in great numbers in India.
uz: U shu kayfiyatda bo'lganida, Hindistonda allaqachon ko'p sonda mavjud bo'lgan o'sha bema'ni zohidlardan biri bilan uchrashdi.

en: These men lived under severe rules, spending much time in meditation and in religious discussion.
uz: Bu odamlar qattiq qoidalar ostida yashagan, meditatsiya va diniy munozaralarda ko'p vaqt o'tkazgan.

en: They were supposed to be seeking some deeper reality in life, and a passionate desire to do likewise took possession of Gautama.
uz: Ular hayotdagi chuqurroq haqiqatni izlashlari kerak edi va xuddi shunday qilish istagini Gautamaga qo'shib olishdi.

en: He was meditating upon this project, says the story, when the news was brought to him that his wife had been delivered of his ﬁrst-born son.
uz: U bu loyihani o'ylab yurgan edi, deydi hikoya, qachonki unga xotini to'ng'ich o'g'lini dunyoga keltirganligi haqida xabar yetkazildi.

en: “This is another tie to break,” said Gautama.
uz: Bu yana bir uzilishi kerak bo'lgan bog'lam, dedi Gautama.

en: He returned to the village amidst the rejoicings of his fellow clansmen.
uz: U qishloqqa o'z qabiladoshlari quvonchi orasida qaytib keldi.

en: There was a great feast and a Nautch dance to celebrate the birth of this new tie, and in the night Gautama awoke in a great agony of spirit, “like a man who is told that his house is on ﬁre.” He resolved to leave his happy aimless life forthwith.
uz: Bu yangi galstukning tug'ilishini nishonlash uchun katta ziyofat va Nautch raqsi bo'lib o'tdi va kechasi Gautama katta azobda uyg'onib ketdi, uy o'tda ekanligini aytgan odam kabi. U o'zining baxtli maqsadsiz hayotini zudlik bilan tark etishga qaror qildi.

en: He went softly to the threshold of his wife’s chamber, and saw her by the light of a little oil lamp, sleeping sweetly, surrounded by ﬂowers, with his infant son in her arms.
uz: U xotini xonasining ostonasiga sekin bordi va uni kichkina moy chiroq nuri yonida ko'rdi, gullar bilan o'ralgan holda, go'zal uxlayotgan, uning qo'lida chaqaloq o'g'li bor edi.

en: He felt a great craving to take up the child in one ﬁrst and last embrace before he departed, but the fear of waking his wife prevented him, and at last he turned away and went out into the bright Indian moonshine and mounted his horse and rode off into the world.
uz: U ketishidan oldin bolani birinchi va oxirgi quchoqlashda ko'tarib olishga katta ishtiyoq bildirdi, lekin xotini uyg'onishidan qo'rqish unga to'sqinlik qildi va nihoyat o'girilib, yorqin hind oy nuriga chiqdi va otga minib, dunyoga otlandi.

en: TIBETAN BUDDHA  Gilt Brass Casting in India Museum, showing Gautama Buddha in the “earth witness” attitude  India Mus.
uz: TIBET BUDDASI Hindiston muzeyida Gilt Brass Casting, Gautama Buddani yer shohid munosabati bilan ko'rsatmoqda Hindiston Mus.

en: Very far he rode that night, and in the morning he stopped outside the lands of his clan, and dismounted beside a sandy river.
uz: U o'sha kechasi juda uzoqqa mindi va ertalab o'z urug'ining yerlaridan tashqarida to'xtadi va qumli daryo bo'yida tushdi.

en: There he cut off his ﬂowing locks with his sword, removed all his ornaments and sent them and his horse and sword back to his house.
uz: U yerda u qilichi bilan oqayotgan qulflarini kesib tashladi, barcha taqinchoqlarini olib tashladi va ularni, otini va qilichini uyga qaytarib yubordi.

en: Going on he presently met a ragged man and exchanged clothes with him, and so having divested himself of all worldly entanglements he was free to pursue his search after wisdom.
uz: U yo'lda ketayotib, u tez orada bir to'qilgan odam bilan uchrashdi va u bilan kiyim almashdi. Shunday qilib, barcha dunyoviy to'siqlardan xalos bo'lganidan so'ng, u donolikni izlashga erkin edi.

en: He made his way southward to a resort of hermits and teachers in a hilly spur of the Vindhya Mountains.
uz: U janubiy tomonga, Vindhyu tog'larining tepalikdagi cho'qqisidagi ermitlar va o'qituvchilarning kurortiga yo'l oldi.

en: There lived a number of wise men in a warren of caves, going into the town for their simple supplies and imparting their knowledge by word of mouth to such as cared to come to them.
uz: Bir qator dono odamlar g'orlar to'dasida yashar edilar, shaharga oddiy ta'minotlari uchun kirib, ularga kelishga g'amxo'rlik qilayotganlarga o'z bilimlarini og'izma-og'iz yetkazardilar.

en: Gautama became versed in all the metaphysics of his age.
uz: Gautama o'z davridagi barcha metafizikaga mohir bo'lib ketdi.

en: But his acute intelligence was dissatisﬁed with the solutions offered him.
uz: Lekin uning o'tkir aqli unga taklif etilgan yechimlardan norozi edi.

en: A BURMESE BUDDHA  Marble Figure from Mandalay, eighteenth century work, now in the India Museum The Indian mind has always been disposed to believe that power and knowledge may be obtained by extreme asceticism, by fasting, sleepless- ness, and self-torment, and these ideas Gautama now put to the test.
uz: Burma Buddhasining Mandalay shahridan yasalgan marmar figurasi, XVIII asr asari, hozirda Hindiston muzeyida. Hind ongi har doim kuch va bilimni haddan tashqari zohidlik, ro'za tutish, uyqusizlik va o'z-o'zini qiynash orqali olish mumkinligiga ishonishga moyil bo'lgan va bu g'oyalar Gautama tomonidan sinovdan o'tkazilgan.

en: He be- took himself with ﬁve disciple companions to the jungle and there he gave himself up to fasting and terrible penances.
uz: U o'zini beshta shogirdlari bilan o'rmonga olib bordi va u yerda ro'za tutish va dahshatli tavbalarga berilib ketdi.

en: His fame spread, “like the sound of a great bell hung in the canopy of the skies.” But it brought him no sense of truth achieved.
uz: Uning shuhrati tarqaldi, osmon soyasida osilib turgan ulkan qo'ng'iroq sadosi kabi. Ammo bu unga erishilgan haqiqat tuyg'usini bermadi.

en: One day he was walking up and down, trying to think in spite of his enfeebled state.
uz: Bir kuni u yuqoriga va pastga qarab yurardi, zaif holatiga qaramay o'ylashga harakat qilardi.

en: Suddenly he fell unconscious.
uz: To'satdan u hushidan ketib qoldi.

en: When he recovered, the preposterousness of these semi-magical ways to wisdom was plain to him.
uz: U tuzalganida, bu yarim sehrli donolik yo'llarining bema'niligi unga aniq edi.

en: THE DHAMÊKH TOWER  In the Deer Park at Sarnath.
uz: DHAMÊKH TOWER Sarnathdagi Kiyik Bog'ida.

en: (From a Painting in the India Museum)
uz: Hindiston muzeyidagi rasmdan

en: He horriﬁed his companions by demanding ordinary food and refusing to continue his mortiﬁcations.
uz: U o'z hamrohlarini oddiy ovqat talab qilib va o'z azoblarini davom ettirishdan bosh tortgan holda dahshatga soldi.

en: He had realized that whatever truth a man may reach is reached best by a nourished brain in a healthy body.
uz: U anglagan edi, inson erishishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday haqiqatga sog'lom tanadagi to'yingan miya orqali eng yaxshi erishiladi.

en: Such a concep- tion was absolutely foreign to the ideas of the land and age.
uz: Bunday tushuncha yer va davr g'oyalariga mutlaqo begona edi.

en: His disciples deserted him, and went off in a melancholy state to Benares.
uz: Shogirdlari uni tashlab ketishdi va qayg'uli holatda Benaresga yo'l olishdi.

en: Gautama wan- dered alone.
uz: Gautama van dered yolg'iz edi.

en: When the mind grapples with a great and intricate problem, it makes its advances step by step, with but little realization of the gains it has made, until suddenly, with an effect of abrupt illumination, it realizes its victory.
uz: Aql ulkan va murakkab muammoga duch kelganda, u qadam-baqadam o'z yutuqlarini amalga oshiradi, erishgan yutuqlarini unchalik anglamaydi, toki to'satdan, to'satdan yorug'lik ta'siri bilan o'z g'alabasini anglab yetmaguncha.

en: So it happened to Gautama.
uz: Shunday qilib, Gautama bilan ham shunday bo'ldi.

en: He had seated himself under a great tree by the side of a river to eat, when this sense of clear vision came to him.
uz: U daryo bo'yida katta daraxt ostida ovqatlanish uchun o'tirgan edi, shunda unga bu tiniq ko'rish hissi keldi.

en: It seemed to him that he saw life plain.
uz: Unga hayotni oddiy ko'rayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: He is said to have sat all day and all night in profound thought, and then he rose up to impart his vision to the world.
uz: Uning butun kun va butun tun chuqur o'y ichida o'tirgani aytiladi, so'ngra dunyoga o'z ko'rinishini yetkazish uchun turdi.

en: He went on to Benares and there he sought out and won back his lost dis- ciples to his new teaching.
uz: U Benaresga bordi va u yerda yo'qolgan dis-chipllarini yangi ta'limotiga qaytarib oldi.

en: In the King’s Deer Park at Benares they built themselves huts and set up a sort of school to which came many who were seeking after wisdom.
uz: Benaresdagi Qirol Bug'u Bog'ida ular o'zlari uchun kulbalar qurishdi va donolik izlayotgan ko'pchilik keladigan maktabni tashkil etishdi.

en: The starting point of his teaching was his own question as a fortunate young man, “Why am I not completely happy?” It was an introspective question.
uz: Uning ta'lim berishining boshlang'ich nuqtasi omadli yigit sifatida o'zining Nega men butunlay baxtli emasman? degan savoli edi. Bu introspektiv savol edi.

en: It was a question very different in quality from the frank and self- forgetful externalized curiosity with which Thales and Heraclitus were at- tacking the problems of the universe, or the equally self-forgetful burthen of moral obligation that the culminating prophets were imposing upon the He- brew mind.
uz: Bu Sales va Geraklit olam muammolarini hal qiluvchi ochiq va o'z-o'zini unutadigan tashqilashtirilgan qiziquvchanlikdan yoki eng yuqori cho'qqisi bo'lgan payg'ambarlar U-ning aqliga yuklayotgan axloqiy majburiyatning o'z-o'zini unutadigan yukidan sifat jihatidan juda farq qiladigan savol edi.

en: The Indian teacher did not forget self, he concentrated upon self and sought to destroy it.
uz: Hind o'qituvchisi o'zini unutmadi, o'ziga e'tibor qaratdi va uni yo'q qilishga harakat qildi.

en: All suffering, he taught, was due to the greedy de- sires of the individual.
uz: Barcha azoblar, u o'rgatdi, shaxsning ochko'z de-sirlariga bog'liq edi.

en: Until man has conquered his personal cravings his life is trouble and his end sorrow.
uz: Inson o'z shaxsiy istaklarini yengmaguncha, uning hayoti tashvish va oxirgi qayg'usi bo'ladi.

en: There were three principal forms that the craving for life took and they were all evil.
uz: Hayotga intilishning uchta asosiy shakli bor edi va ularning barchasi yovuz edi.

en: The ﬁrst was the desire of the appetites, greed and all forms of sensuousness, the second was the desire for a personal and egotistic immortality, the third was the craving for per- sonal success, worldliness, avarice and the like.
uz: Birinchisi ishtahalar, ochko'zlik va barcha shakldagi hissiyotsizlik istagi edi, ikkinchisi shaxsiy va egoistik o'lmaslikka intilish, uchinchisi esa shaxsiy muvaffaqiyat, dunyoviylik, ochko'zlik va shunga o'xshashlarga intilish edi.

en: All these forms of desire had to be overcome to escape from the distresses and chagrins of life.
uz: Bu istaklarning barcha shakllarini hayot azob-uqubatlari va qayg'ularidan qochish uchun yengib o'tish kerak edi.

en: When they were overcome, when self had vanished altogether, then serenity of soul, Nirvana, the highest good was attained.
uz: Ular yengilganda, o'zlik butunlay yo'qolganida, ruh halovati, Nirvana, eng oliy yaxshilikka erishildi.

en: This was the gist of his teaching, a very subtle and metaphysical teaching indeed, not nearly so easy to understand as the Greek injunction to see and know fearlessly and rightly and the Hebrew command to fear God and ac- complish righteousness.
uz: Bu uning ta'limotining mohiyati edi, juda nozik va metafizik ta'limot, aslida tushunish oson emas, chunki yunonlarning qo'rqmasdan va to'g'ri ko'rish va bilish buyrug'i, shuningdek, ibroniylarning Xudodan qo'rqish va adolatga amal qilish buyrug'i kabi.

en: It was a teaching much beyond the understanding of even Gautama’s immediate disciples, and it is no wonder that so soon as his personal inﬂuence was withdrawn it became corrupted and coarsened.
uz: Bu hatto Gautama'ning bevosita shogirdlari ham tushunmaydigan ta'limot edi va uning shaxsiy ta'siri cheklangan zahoti buzilgan va qo'pollashganidan ajablanarli emas.

en: There was a widespread belief in India at that time that at long intervals Wisdom came to earth and was incarnate in some chosen person who was known as the Buddha.
uz: O'sha davrda Hindistonda uzoq vaqt oralig'ida Donishmandlik yerga kelib, Budda deb nomlanuvchi tanlangan shaxsda mujassam bo'lishi haqidagi keng tarqalgan ishonch bor edi.

en: Gautama’s disciples declared that he was a Buddha, the latest of the Buddhas, though there is no evidence that he himself ever accepted the title.
uz: Gautama'ning shogirdlari u Budda ekanligini, Buddalarning eng so'nggisi ekanligini e'lon qilishdi, garchi u o'zi bu unvonni qabul qilganligiga hech qanday dalil yo'q.

en: Before he was well dead, a cycle of fantastic legends be- gan to be woven about him.
uz: U o'lmasdan oldin, u haqida ajoyib afsonalar to'qilishi kerak edi.

en: The human heart has always preferred a won- der story to a moral effort, and Gautama Buddha became very wonderful.
uz: Inson qalbi doimo ma'naviy harakatdan ko'ra g'alaba hikoyasini afzal ko'rgan va Gautama Budda juda ajoyib bo'lgan.

en: Yet there remained a substantial gain in the world.
uz: Shunga qaramay, dunyoda sezilarli yutuq saqlanib qoldi.

en: If Nirvana was too high and subtle for most men’s imaginations, if the myth-making impulse in the race was too strong for the simple facts of Gautama’s life, they could at least grasp something of the intention of what Gautama called the Eight- fold way, the Aryan or Noble Path in life.
uz: Agar Nirvana ko'pchilik insonlarning tasavvuri uchun juda yuqori va nozik bo'lganida, agar poygadagi afsona yaratishga bo'lgan intilish Gautama hayotidagi oddiy faktlar uchun juda kuchli bo'lganida, ular hech bo'lmaganda Gautama sakkizta yo'l, hayotdagi Aryan yoki Oliy Yo'l deb atagan narsa niyatidan biror narsa anglashlari mumkin edi.

en: In this there was an insistence upon mental uprightness, upon right aims and speech, right conduct and honest livelihood.
uz: Bu yerda aqliy to'g'rilikka, to'g'ri maqsadlar va nutqqa, to'g'ri xulq-atvorga va halol tirikchilikka urg'u berilgan edi.

en: There was a quickening of the conscience and an appeal to generous and self-forgetful ends.
uz: Vijdon tezlashdi va saxiy va o'zini unutadigan maqsadlarga murojaat qilindi.

en: XXIX KING ASOKA For some generations after the death of Gautama, these high and noble Bud- dhist teachings, this ﬁrst plain teaching that the highest good for man is the subjugation of self, made comparatively little headway in the world.
uz: XXIX QIROL ASOKA Gautama vafotidan keyin ba'zi avlodlar uchun bu oliy va olijanob Buddist ta'limotlari, inson uchun eng oliy yaxshilik o'zlikni bo'ysundirish ekanligi haqidagi birinchi oddiy ta'limot dunyoda nisbatan kam yutuqlarga erishdi.

en: Then they conquered the imagination of one of the greatest monarchs the world has ever seen.
uz: Keyin ular dunyo ko'rgan eng buyuk monarxlardan birining tasavvurini zabt etishdi.

en: We have already mentioned how Alexander the Great came down into India and fought with Porus upon the Indus.
uz: Biz allaqachon Aleksandr Buyukning Hindistonga qanday tushgani va Indus daryosida Porus bilan jang qilganini aytib o'tdik.

en: It is related by the Greek histo- rians that a certain Chandragupta Maurya came into Alexander’s camp and tried to persuade him to go on to the Ganges and conquer all India.
uz: Yunon tarixchilari ma'lum bir Chandragupta Maurya Aleksandrning lageriga kirib, uni Gangga o'tib, butun Hindistonni zabt etishga ko'ndirishga uringanini rivoyat qilishadi.

en: Alexan- der could not do this because of the refusal of his Macedonians to go further into what was for them an unknown world, and later on (303 B.C.) Chan- dragupta was able to secure the help or various hill tribes and realize his dream without Greek help.
uz: Aleksan-der buni o'z Makedoniyaliklarining ular uchun noma'lum dunyoga uzoqroqqa borishdan bosh tortgani sababli qila olmadi va keyinroq (miloddan avvalgi 303 yil) Chan-dragupta turli tepalik qabilalarining yordamini ta'minlay oldi va o'z orzusini yunonlarsiz amalga oshira oldi.

en: He built up an empire in North India and was presently (303 B.C.) able to attack Seleucus I in the Punjab and drive the last vestige of Greek power out of India.
uz: U Shimoliy Hindistonda imperiya qurdi va hozirda (miloddan avvalgi 303 yil) Panjobda Seleuk I ga hujum qilib, yunon kuchining oxirgi qoldiqini Hindistondan haydab chiqarishga qodir edi.

en: His son extended this new empire.
uz: Uning o'g'li bu yangi imperiyani kengaytirdi.

en: His grandson, Asoka, the monarch of whom we now have to tell, found himself in 264 B.C.
uz: Uning nabirasi, hozir aytib berishimiz kerak bo'lgan monarx Asoka miloddan avvalgi 264-yilda o'zini topgan.

en: ruling from Afghanistan to Madras.
uz: Afg'onistondan Madrasaga hukmronlik qilish.

en: Asoka was at ﬁrst disposed to follow the example of his father and grand- father and complete the conquest of the Indian peninsula.
uz: Asoka dastlab otasi va bobosining namunasiga ergashib, Hindiston yarim orolini zabt etishni yakunlashga tayyor edi.

en: He invaded Kalinga (255 B.C.), a country on the east coast of Madras, he was successful in his military operations and—alone among conquerors—he was so dis- gusted by the cruelty and horror of war that he renounced it.
uz: U Madrasning sharqiy qirg'og'idagi Kalinga (255 miloddan avvalgi)ga bostirib kirdi, u o'z harbiy harakatlarida muvaffaqiyatli edi va bosqinchilar orasida yolg'iz  urushning shafqatsizligi va dahshatiga shunchalik chidamli ediki, undan voz kechdi.

en: He would have no more of it.
uz: Unga bundan ortiq hech narsa kerak bo'lmas edi.

en: He adopted the peaceful doctrines of Buddhism and declared that henceforth his conquests should be the conquests of religion.
uz: U Buddizmning tinch ta'limotlarini qabul qildi va bundan buyon uning zabt etishlari dinning zabt etishlari bo'lishi kerakligini e'lon qildi.

en: A LOHAN OR BUDDHIST APOSTLE (Tang Dynasty)  (From the statue in the British Museum) His reign for eight-and-twenty years was one of the brightest interludes in the troubled history of mankind.
uz: LOHAN YOKI BUDDHIST APOSTOLI (Tang sulolasi) (Britaniya muzeyidagi haykaldan) Uning yigirma sakkiz yillik hukmronligi insoniyatning notinch tarixidagi eng yorqin davrlardan biri edi.

en: He organized a great digging of wells in India and the planting of trees for shade.
uz: U Hindistonda katta quduqlar qazishni va soya uchun daraxtlar ekishni tashkil qildi.

en: He founded hospitals and public gardens and gardens for the growing of medicinal herbs.
uz: U shifoxonalar, jamoat bog'lari va dorivor o'tlarni yetishtirish uchun bog'larga asos soldi.

en: He created a min- istry for the care of the aborigines and subject races of India.
uz: U aborigenlar va Hindistonning sub'ekt irqlariga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun minimal g'oya yaratdi.

en: He made pro- vision for the education of women.
uz: U ayollarning ta'limi uchun pro-vizion yaratdi.

en: He made vast benefactions to the Bud- dhist teaching orders, and tried to stimulate them to a better and more ener- getic criticism of their own accumulated literature.
uz: U Buddist ta'limotlariga ulkan xayriyalar qildi va ularni o'zlarining to'plangan adabiyotlarini yaxshiroq va kuchliroq getik tanqid qilishga undashga harakat qildi.

en: For corruptions and su-
uz: Korrupsiya va su- uchun.

en: perstitious accretions had accumulated very speedily upon the pure and simple teaching of the great Indian master.
uz: Buyuk hind ustozining sof va sodda ta'limotida betakror qo'shimchalar juda tez yig'ildi.

en: Missionaries went from Asoka to Kashmir, to Persia, to Ceylon and Alexandria.
uz: Missionerlar Asokadan Kashmirga, Forsga, Seylonga va Iskandariyaga borishdi.

en: TRANSOME SHOWING THE COURT OF ASOKA  India Mus.
uz: ASOKA INDIYA SUDINI KO'RSATGAN TRANSMER MUS.

en: ASOKA PANEL FROM BHARHUT  India Mus.
uz: ASOKA PANEL BHARHUT India Mus. dan

en: Such was Asoka, greatest of kings.
uz: Shunday edi Asoka, podshohlarning eng buyugi.

en: He was far in advance of his age.
uz: U o'z yoshidan ancha oldinda edi.

en: He left no prince and no organization of men to carry on his work, and within a century of his death the great days of his reign had become a glorious mem- ory in a shattered and decaying India.
uz: U o'z ishini davom ettirish uchun hech qanday shahzoda va odamlarning tashkilotini qoldirmadi va o'limidan bir asr o'tmay, uning hukmronligining buyuk kunlari vayron va chirigan Hindistonda shonli xotiraga aylandi.

en: The priestly caste of the Brahmins, the highest and most privileged caste in the Indian social body, has always been opposed to the frank and open teaching of Buddha.
uz: Brahminlarning ruhoniy kastasi, Hindiston ijtimoiy jismidagi eng yuqori va imtiyozli kasta, doimo Buddaning ochiq va ochiq ta'limotiga qarshi kelgan.

en: Gradually they un- dermined the Buddhist inﬂuence in the land.
uz: asta-sekin ular mamlakatdagi buddaviy ta'sirni yo'q qildilar.

en: The old monstrous gods, the
uz: Eski maxluq xudolar,

en: innumerable cults of Hinduism, resumed their sway.
uz: Hinduizmning son-sanoqsiz kultlari o'z ta'sirini qayta tikladi.

en: Caste became more rigorous and complicated.
uz: Kast qat'iyroq va murakkabroq bo'lib qoldi.

en: For long centuries Buddhism and Brahminism ﬂourished side by side, and then slowly Buddhism decayed and Brahmin- ism in a multitude of forms replaced it.
uz: Uzoq asrlar davomida Buddizm va Brahmizm yonma-yon gullab-yashnadi, keyin asta-sekin Buddizm parchalanib ketdi va Brahmizm-ismi uni ko'plab shakllarda almashtirdi.

en: But beyond the conﬁnes of India and the realms of caste Buddhism spread—until it had won China and Siam and Burma and Japan, countries in which it is predominant to this day.
uz: Lekin Hindiston va kasta buddizm olamlaridan tashqari tarqaldi  u Xitoy va Siam, Birma va Yaponiyani zabt etmaguncha, ular bugungi kungacha hukmron bo'lgan mamlakatlardir.

en: THE PILLAR OF LIONS  Capital of the Pillar (column lying on side) erected in Deer Park in the time of Asoka, where Buddha preached his ﬁrst sermon  (From a print in the India Museum)
uz: ASOKA davrida Bug'u bog'ida qurilgan, Budda o'zining birinchi va'zini aytgan ustun poydevori (Hindiston muzeyidagi chop etilganidan).

en: XXX CONFUCIUS AND LAO TSE We have still to tell of two other great men, Confucius and Lao Tse, who lived in that wonderful century which began the adolescence of mankind, the sixth century B.C.
uz: XXX CONFUKSIUS VA LAO TSE Biz hali insoniyatning o'smirligi boshlangan ajoyib asrda, miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda yashagan yana ikki buyuk odam haqida gapirishimiz kerak, Konfutsiy va Lao Tse.

en: In this history thus far we have told very little of the early story of China.
uz: Bu tarixda biz Xitoyning erta tarixi haqida shu paytgacha juda kam gapirdik.

en: At present that early history is still very obscure, and we look to Chinese explorers and archæolologists in the new China that is now arising to work out their past as thoroughly as the European past has been worked out during the last century.
uz: Hozirgi kunda o'sha erta tarix hali ham juda noaniq, va biz Xitoy tadqiqotchilari va arxeologlariga yangi Xitoyda qarashdamiz, u endi o'z o'tmishini Yevropa o'tmishi o'tgan asrda ishlab chiqilganidek chuqur o'rganish uchun paydo bo'lmoqda.

en: Very long ago the ﬁrst primitive Chinese civilizations arose in the great river valleys out of the primordial heliolithic culture.
uz: Ancha vaqtlar oldin Xitoyning birinchi ibtidoiy sivilizatsiyalari buyuk daryo vodiylarida ibtidoiy heliolitik madaniyatdan paydo bo'lgan.

en: They had, like Egypt and Sumeria, the general character- istics of that culture, and they centred upon temples in which priests and priest kings offered the seasonal blood sacriﬁces.
uz: Ularning Misr va Shumer kabi umumiy xarakteri bor edi - o'sha madaniyatning istiklari, va ular ruhoniylar va ruhoniy shohlar mavsumiy qon qurbonliklarini taqdim etadigan ibodatxonalarga e'tibor qaratishardi.

en: The life in those cities must have been very like the Egyptian and Sumerian life of six or seven thousand years ago and very like the Maya life of Central America a thou- sand years ago.
uz: O'sha shaharlardagi hayot olti-yetti ming yil oldingi Misr va Shumer hayotiga juda o'xshash bo'lishi kerak va ming-ming yil oldingi Markaziy Amerikaning Maya hayotiga juda o'xshash bo'lishi kerak.

en: If there were human sacriﬁces they had long given way to animal sacri- ﬁces before the dawn of history.
uz: Agar insoniy qurbonliklar bo'lganida, ular tarixning boshlanishidan ancha oldin hayvon qurbonliklariga yo'l qo'yishgan bo'lardi.

en: And a form of picture writing was growing up long before a thousand years B.C.
uz: Va rasm yozuvining bir shakli miloddan avvalgi ming yillardan ancha oldin rivojlanayotgan edi.

en: And just as the primitive civilizations of Europe and western Asia were in conﬂict with the nomads of the desert and the nomads of the north, so the primitive Chinese civilizations had a great cloud of nomadic peoples on their northern borders.
uz: Xuddi Yevropa va G'arbiy Osiyodagi ibtidoiy tsivilizatsiyalar sahro ko'chmanchilari va shimol ko'chmanchilari bilan ziddiyatga tushganidek, ibtidoiy Xitoy sivilizatsiyalari ham o'zlarining shimoliy chegaralarida ko'chmanchi xalqlarning katta bulutiga ega edi.

en: There was a number of tribes akin in language and ways of living, who are spoken of in history in succession as the Huns, the Mongols, the Turks and Tartars.
uz: Til va turmush tarzi bo'yicha bir qator urug'lar bo'lgan, ular tarixda ketma-ket xunnlar, mo'g'ullar, turklar va tatarlar sifatida tilga olinadi.

en: They changed and divided and combined and re-combined, just as the Nordic peoples in north Europe and central
uz: Ular o'zgarib, bo'lindi, birlashtirildi va qayta birlashtirildi, xuddi Shimoliy Yevropadagi va markaziydagi Skandinaviya xalqlari kabi.

en: Asia changed and varied in name rather than in nature.
uz: Osiyo tabiatda emas, balki nomi bilan o'zgarib, xilma-xil bo'lgan.

en: These Mongolian nomads had horses earlier than the Nordic peoples, and it may be that in the region of the Altai Mountains they made an independent discovery of iron somewhen after 1000 B.C.
uz: Bu moʻgʻul koʻchmanchilarining otlari Skandinaviya xalqlaridan oldinroq boʻlgan va ehtimol, Altay togʻlari hududida ular miloddan avvalgi 1000 yildan keyin temirning mustaqil kashfiyotini qilishgan.

en: And just as in the western case so ever and again these eastern nomads would achieve a sort of political unity, and become the conquerors and masters and revivers of this or that settled and civilized region.
uz: Xuddi g'arbiy holatda bo'lgani kabi, sharqiy ko'chmanchilar doimiy ravishda siyosiy birlikka erishib, bu yoki bu o'rnashib qolgan va madaniy mintaqaning zabtchilari, xo'jayinlari va tirikchilariga aylanishardi.

en: It is quite possible that the earliest civilization of China was not Mongo- lian at all any more than the earliest civilization of Europe and western Asia was Nordic or Semitic.
uz: Ehtimol, Xitoyning eng qadimgi tsivilizatsiyasi Yevropa va G'arbiy Osiyodagi eng qadimgi tsivilizatsiya Skandinaviya yoki Semit bo'lganidan ko'ra umuman Mongo-Lian bo'lmagan.

en: It is quite possible that the earliest civilization of China was a brunette civilization and of a piece with the earliest Egyptian, Sumerian and Dravidian civilizations, and that when the ﬁrst recorded his- tory of China began there had already been conquests and intermixture.
uz: Xitoyning eng qadimgi tsivilizatsiyasi brunet sivilizatsiya va Misr, Shumer va Dravidlarning eng qadimgi tsivilizatsiyalari bilan bir qism bo'lganligi va Xitoyning birinchi qayd etilgan tarixiy tarixi boshlanganida allaqachon bosqinlar va aralashuvlar bo'lganligi mumkin.

en: At any rate we ﬁnd that by 1750 B.C.
uz: Har qanday holatda ham, miloddan avvalgi 1750-yilga kelib...

en: China was already a vast system of little kingdoms and city states, all acknowledging a loose allegiance and paying more or less regularly, more or less deﬁnite feudal dues to one great priest emperor, the “Son of Heaven.” The “Shang” dynasty came to an end in 1125 B.C.
uz: Xitoy allaqachon kichik qirolliklar va shahar davlatlarining ulkan tizimi edi, ularning barchasi bo'sh sodiqlikni tan olardi va bir buyuk ruhoniy imperatorga, Osmondagi O'g'ilga ko'proq yoki kamroq aniq feodal to'lovlarni muntazam ravishda to'lardilar. Shang sulolasi miloddan avvalgi 1125 yilda yakunlandi.

en: A “Chow” dynasty succeeded “Shang,” and maintained China in a relaxing unity until the days of Asoka in India and of the Ptolemies in Egypt.
uz: Shangdan keyin Chow sulolasi o'tib ketdi va Xitoyni Hindistondagi Asoka va Misrdagi Ptolemey davrlarigacha xotirjam birlikda saqlab qoldi.

en: Gradually China went to pieces during that long “Chow” period.
uz: asta-sekin Xitoy o'sha uzun Chow davrida bo'laklarga bo'linib ketdi.

en: Hunnish peoples came down and set up principalities; local rulers discon- tinued their tribute and became independent.
uz: Gunn xalqlari kelib, knyazliklar o'rnatdilar; mahalliy hukmdorlar o'z hurmatlarini rad etishdi va mustaqil bo'lishdi.

en: There was in the sixth century B.C., says one Chinese authority, ﬁve or six thousand practically independent states in China.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda, bir xitoylik hokimiyatchi aytishicha, Xitoyda amalda mustaqil besh yoki olti mingta davlat bor edi.

en: It was what the Chinese call in their records an “Age of Confusion.” But this Age of Confusion was compatible with much intellectual activity and with the existence of many local centres of art and civilized living.
uz: Bu xitoyliklar o'z yozuvlarida Bezovtalik Davri deb atagan narsa edi. Ammo bu Bezovtalik Davri ko'plab intellektual faoliyat va ko'plab mahalliy san'at markazlari hamda madaniy hayotning mavjudligi bilan mos edi.

en: When we know more of Chinese history we shall ﬁnd that China also had her Miletus and her Athens, her Pergamum and her Macedonia.
uz: Xitoy tarixi haqida ko'proq bilganimizda, Xitoyning Miletu va Afina, Pergam va Makedoniya ham borligini aniqlaymiz.

en: At present we must be vague and brief about this period of Chinese division simply because our knowledge is not sufﬁcient for us to frame a coherent and con- secutive story.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda biz Xitoy bo'linishining ushbu davri haqida noaniq va qisqacha bo'lishimiz kerak, chunki bizning bilimlarimiz biz uchun tushunarli va izchil hikoyani yaratish uchun yetarli emas.

en: CONFUCIUS  Copy of stone carving in the Temple of Confucius at K’iu Fu  (From the records of the Archæological Mission to North China (Chavannes)) And just as in divided Greece there were philosophers and in shattered and captive Jewry prophets, so in disordered China there were philosophers
uz: Kiu Fu shahridagi Konfutsiy ibodatxonasida tosh o'ymakorligining nusxasi (Shimoliy Xitoyga arxeologik missiyaning (Chavannes) yozuvlaridan). Va xuddi bo'lingan Gretsiyada faylasuflar, vayron bo'lgan va asirga olingan yahudiy payg'ambarlari bo'lgani kabi, tartibsiz Xitoyda ham faylasuflar bor edi.

en: and teachers at this time.
uz: va ayni paytda o'qituvchilar.

en: In all these cases insecurity and uncertainty seemed to have quickened the better sort of mind.
uz: Bu holatlarning barchasida ishonchsizlik va noaniqlik aqlning yaxshiroq turini tezlashtirgandek tuyuldi.

en: Confucius was a man of aristocratic origin and some ofﬁcial importance in a small state called Lu.
uz: Konfutsiy aristokratik kelib chiqishga ega bo'lgan va Lu deb nomlanuvchi kichik davlatda rasmiy ahamiyatga ega odam edi.

en: Here in a very parallel mood to the Greek impulse he set up a sort of Acad- emy for discovering and teaching Wisdom.
uz: Bu yerda u yunoncha turtkiga juda parallel kayfiyatda Hikmatni kashf etish va o'rgatish uchun o'ziga xos Akademiya tashkil etdi.

en: The lawlessness and disorder of China distressed him profoundly.
uz: Xitoyning qonunbuzarligi va tartibsizliklari uni chuqur tashvishga soldi.

en: He conceived an ideal of a better govern- ment and a better life, and travelled from state to state seeking a prince who would carry out his legislative and educational ideas.
uz: U yaxshiroq hukumat va yaxshiroq hayot g'oyasini o'ylab topdi va o'zining qonun chiqaruvchi va ta'limiy g'oyalarini amalga oshiradigan shahzoda izlab shtatdan shtatga sayohat qildi.

en: He never found his prince; he found a prince, but court intrigues undermined the inﬂuence of the teacher and ﬁnally defeated his reforming proposals.
uz: U hech qachon o'z shahzodasini topmadi; u shahzodani topdi, lekin saroy fitnalari o'qituvchining ta'sirini susaytirdi va nihoyat uning islohot takliflarini mag'lub etdi.

en: It is interesting to note that a century and a half later the Greek philosopher Plato also sought a prince, and was for a time adviser to the tyrant Dionysius who ruled Syra- cuse in Sicily.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, bir yarim asr o'tgach yunon faylasufi Aflotun ham shahzoda izladi va bir vaqtlar Sitsiliyada Syra-cuse ustidan hukmronlik qilgan zolim Dionysiusga maslahatchi bo'ldi.

en: Confucius died a disappointed man.
uz: Konfutsiy xafa bo'lib vafot etdi.

en: “No intelligent ruler arises to take me as his master,” he said, “and my time has come to die.” But his teaching had more vitality than he imagined in his declining and hopeless years, and it became a great formative inﬂuence with the Chinese people.
uz: Meni o'z xo'jayini deb qabul qilish uchun hech qanday aqlli hukmdor ko'tarilmaydi, dedi u, va mening o'lish vaqtim keldi. Ammo uning ta'limoti o'zining pasayib borayotgan va umidsiz yillarida tasavvur qilganidan ko'ra ko'proq hayotiy edi va u xitoy xalqi bilan katta shakllantirish ta'siriga aylandi.

en: It became one of what the Chinese call the Three Teachings, the other two being those of Buddha and of Lao Tse.
uz: U xitoyliklar Uch Ta'limot deb ataydigan narsalardan biriga aylandi, qolgan ikkitasi esa Budda va Lao Tseniki edi.

en: The gist of the teaching of Confucius was the way of the noble or aristo- cratic man.
uz: Konfutsiy ta'limotining mohiyati oliyjanob yoki aristokrat odamning yo'li edi.

en: He was concerned with personal conduct as much as Gautama was concerned with the peace of self-forgetfulness and the Greek with ex- ternal knowledge and the Jew with righteousness.
uz: U Gautama o'zini unutib qo'yish tinchligi, yunonlar esa tashqi bilimlar bilan, yahudiylar esa adolat bilan kabi shaxsiy xulq-atvor bilan shug'ullangan edi.

en: He was the most public- minded of all great teachers.
uz: U barcha buyuk ustozlar orasida eng ommaviy fikrli edi.

en: He was supremely concerned by the confusion and miseries of the world, and he wanted to make men noble in order to bring about a noble world.
uz: U dunyoning chalkashligi va azob-uqubatlari bilan oliy darajada tashvishlanardi va u olijanob dunyoni yaratish uchun odamlarni olijanob qilmoqchi edi.

en: He sought to regulate conduct to an ex- traordinary extent; to provide sound rules for every occasion in life.
uz: U xulq-atvorni g'ayrioddiy darajada tartibga solishga, hayotdagi har bir holat uchun asosli qoidalarni ta'minlashga harakat qildi.

en: A po- lite, public- spirited gentleman, rather sternly self-disciplined, was the ideal he found already developing in the northern Chinese world and one to which he gave a permanent form.
uz: O'zini qattiq intizomli, kamtarin, ommaviy ruhli janob, u Shimoliy Xitoy olamida allaqachon rivojlanib borayotgan ideal edi va unga doimiy shakl bergan ideal edi.

en: THE GREAT WALL OF CHINA  As it crosses the mountains in Manchuria
uz: Xitoyning Buyuk devori Manxuriyadagi tog'larni kesib o'tayotganda

en: Photo: Underwood & Underwood The teaching of Lao Tse, who was for a long time in charge of the imper- ial library of the Chow dynasty, was much more mystical and vague and elusive than that of Confucius.
uz: Foto: Underwood & Underwood Chow sulolasining imperatorlik kutubxonasini uzoq vaqt boshqargan Lao Tsening ta'limoti Konfutsiydan ko'ra ancha sirli, noaniq va tushunarsiz edi.

en: He seems to have preached a stoical indiffer- ence to the pleasures and powers of the world and a return to an imaginary simple life of the past.
uz: U dunyo lazzatlari va qudratlariga befarqlik va o'tmishning xayoliy oddiy hayotiga qaytish haqida va'z qilgan ko'rinadi.

en: He left writings very contracted in style and very ob- scure.
uz: U yozuvlarni juda murakkab uslubda va juda noaniq qoldirdi.

en: He wrote in riddles.
uz: U topishmoqlar bilan yozdi.

en: After his death his teachings, like the teachings of Gautama Buddha, were corrupted and overlaid by legends and had the most complex and extraordinary observances and superstitious ideas grafted upon them.
uz: Uning vafotidan so'ng, uning ta'limotlari, xuddi Gautama Buddaning ta'limotlari kabi, afsonalar bilan buzilgan va qoplangan edi va ularga eng murakkab va g'ayrioddiy rioyalar va xurofot g'oyalari singdirilgan edi.

en: In China just as in India primordial ideas of magic and mon- strous legends out of the childish past of our race struggled against the new thinking in the world and succeeded in plastering it over with grotesque, ir- rational and antiquated observances.
uz: Xitoyda ham Hindistondagidek, irqimizning bolalarcha o'tmishidan chiqqan sehr va monstros afsonalarning ibtidoiy g'oyalari dunyodagi yangi fikrlashga qarshi kurashdi va uni g'alati, ratsional va qadimiy rioyalar bilan qoplashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Both Buddhism and Taoism (which ascribes itself largely to Lao Tse) as one ﬁnds them in China now, are reli- gions of monk, temple, priest and offering of a type as ancient in form, if not in thought, as the sacriﬁcial religions of ancient Sumeria and Egypt.
uz: Hozirgi Xitoyda uchraydigan buddizm ham, Taoizm ham (o'zini asosan Lao Tsega tegishli deb hisoblaydi) qadimgi Sumeriya va Misrning qurbonlik dinlari kabi shaklda, hatto fikrlashda ham qadimiy bo'lgan rohiblar, ibodatxonalar, ruhoniylar va qurbonlik ibodatlaridir.

en: But the teaching of Confucius was not so overlaid because it was limited and plain and straightforward and lent itself to no such distortions.
uz: Ammo Konfutsiy ta'limoti unchalik ustma-ust emas edi, chunki u cheklangan, aniq va sodda edi va bunday buzilishlarga yo'l qo'ymagan edi.

en: EARLY CHINESE BRONZE BELL  Inscribed in archaic characters: “made for use by the elder of Hing village in Ting district;” latter half of the Chou Dynasty, Sixth Century B.C.
uz: ERTA XITOY BRONZA QO'NG'IRG'ISI Arxaik belgilarda yozilgan: Ting tumanidagi Hing qishlog'ining oqsoqoli tomonidan foydalanish uchun tayyorlangan; Chou sulolasining oxirgi yarmi, Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asr.

en: (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) North China, the China of the Hwang-ho River, became Confucian in thought and spirit; south China, Yang-tse-Kiang China, became Taoist.
uz: (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) Shimoliy Xitoy, Hwang-ho daryosining Xitoy, fikrlash va ruhda Konfutsiyga aylandi; Janubiy Xitoy, Yang-tse-Kiang Xitoy, Taoistga aylandi.

en: Since those days a conﬂict has always been traceable in Chinese affairs be- tween these two spirits, the spirit of the north and the spirit of the south, be- tween (in latter times) Pekin and Nankin, between the ofﬁcial- minded, up- right and conservative north, and the sceptical, artistic, lax and experimental south.
uz: O'sha kunlardan beri Xitoy ishlarida doimo mojaro kuzatib borilmoqda: bu ikki ruh o'rtasida, shimol ruhi va janub ruhi o'rtasida, Pekin va Nankin o'rtasida (so'nggi paytlarda), rasmiy fikrli, yuqori o'ng va konservativ shimol o'rtasida va shubhali, badiiy, beparvo va eksperimental janub o'rtasida.

en: The divisions of China of the Age of Confusion reached their worst stage in the sixth century B.C.
uz: Xitoyning chalkashlik davri bo'linishlari miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda eng yomon bosqichga yetdi.

en: The Chow dynasty was so enfeebled and so discred- ited that Lao Tse left the unhappy court and retired into private life.
uz: Chow sulolasi shunchalik zaif va kamsitilgan ediki, Lao Tse baxtsiz saroydan chiqib, shaxsiy hayotga chekindi.

en: Three nominally subordinate powers dominated the situation in those days, Ts’i and Ts’in, both northern powers, and Ch’u, which was an aggres- sive military power in the Yangtse valley.
uz: O'sha kunlarda vaziyatda nominal ravishda bo'ysunuvchi uchta davlat hukmronlik qilardi: Tsi va Tsin, ikkala shimoliy davlat ham, va Chu, Yangtsé vodiysida tajovuzkor harbiy kuch edi.

en: At last Ts’i and Ts’in formed an alliance, subdued Ch’u and imposed a general treaty of disarmament and peace in China.
uz: Nihoyat, Tsi va Tsin ittifoq tuzdi, Chuni boysundirdi va Xitoyda qurolsizlanish va tinchlik togrisidagi umumiy shartnomani joriy qildi.

en: The power of Ts’in became predominant.
uz: Tsinning kuchi ustunlik qildi.

en: Finally about the time of Asoka in India the Ts’in monarch seized upon the sacriﬁcial vessels of the Chow emperor and took over his sacriﬁcial duties.
uz: Nihoyat, Hindistonda Asoka davrida Tsin monarxi Chow imperatorining qurbonlik idishlarini egallab oldi va uning qurbonlik vazifalarini o'z zimmasiga oldi.

en: His son, Shi- Hwang-ti (king in 246 B.C., emperor in 220 B.C.), is called in the Chinese Chronicles “the First Universal Emperor.” More fortunate than Alexander, Shi-Hwang-ti reigned for thirty-six years as king and emperor.
uz: Uning o'g'li Shi- Hwang-ti (miloddan avvalgi 246-yilda shoh, miloddan avvalgi 220-yilda imperator), Xitoy yilnomalarida Birinchi Universal Imperator deb ataladi. Aleksandrdan ko'ra omadliroq bo'lgan Shi- Hwang-ti qirol va imperator sifatida o'ttiz olti yil hukmronlik qildi.

en: His energetic reign marks the beginning of a new era of unity and prosperity for the Chinese people.
uz: Uning energiyali hukmronligi Xitoy xalqi uchun birlik va farovonlikning yangi davrining boshlanishini anglatadi.

en: He fought vigorously against the Hunnish invaders from the northern deserts, and he began that immense work, the Great Wall of China, to set a limit to their incursions.
uz: U shimoliy cho'llardan kelgan gunn bosqinchilariga qarshi shiddat bilan kurashdi va ularning bosqinlariga chek qo'yish uchun ulkan ishni, Xitoy Buyuk devorini boshladi.

en: XXXI ROME COMES INTO HISTORY The reader will note a general similarity in the history of all these civiliza- tions in spite of the effectual separation caused by the great barriers of the Indian north-west frontier and of the mountain masses of Central Asia and further India.
uz: XXXI RIM TARIXGA KELADI O'quvchi Hindiston shimoli-g'arbiy chegarasining katta to'siqlari va Markaziy Osiyo va undan keyingi Hindiston tog' massasi natijasida kelib chiqqan samarali ajralishga qaramay, bu barcha sivilizatsiyalar tarixida umumiy o'xshashlikni qayd etadi.

en: First for thousands of years the heliolithic culture spread over all the warm and fertile river valleys of the old world and developed a tem- ple system and priest rulers about its sacriﬁcial traditions.
uz: Avval ming yillar davomida gelyolitik madaniyat eski dunyoning barcha iliq va unumdor daryo vodiylariga tarqaldi va qurbonlik an'analari haqida tematik tizim va ruhoniy hukmdorlarini rivojlantirdi.

en: Apparently its ﬁrst makers were always those brunette peoples we have spoken of as the central race of mankind.
uz: Ko'rinishidan, uning birinchi yaratuvchilari doimo insoniyatning markaziy irqi sifatida tilga olgan qora sochli xalqlar bo'lgan.

en: Then the nomads came in from the regions of sea- sonal grass and seasonal migrations and superposed their own characteris- tics and often their own language on the primitive civilization.
uz: Keyin ko'chmanchilar dengiz-sonal o'tlari va mavsumiy migratsiyalar hududlaridan kelib, o'z xarakteristikalarini va ko'pincha o'z tilini ibtidoiy tsivilizatsiyaga qo'shdilar.

en: They subju- gated and stimulated it, and were stimulated to fresh developments and made it here one thing and here another.
uz: Ular uni qo'llab-quvvatladilar va rag'batlantirdilar, yangi ishlanmalar uchun rag'batlantirdilar va bu yerda bir narsa, bu yerda boshqa narsa qildilar.

en: In Mesopotamia it was the Elamite and then the Semite, and at last the Nordic Medes and Persians and the Greeks who supplied the ferment; over the region of the Ægean peoples it was the Greeks; in India it was the Aryan-speakers; in Egypt there was a thinner infusion of conquerors into a more intensely saturated priestly civi- lization; in China, the Hun conquered and was absorbed and was followed by fresh Huns.
uz: Mesopotamiyada olimlar, keyin semitlar, va nihoyat fermentni ta'minlagan Shimoliy Medlar, Forslar va Yunonlar edi; Agey xalqlari hududida bu yunonlar edi; Hindistonda bu ariy tillilar edi; Misrda g'oliblarning yanada zich to'yingan ruhoniy sivilizatsiyasiga ingichka aralashmasi bor edi; Xitoyda xunnlar zabt etdi va o'zlashtirildi va undan keyin yangi xunnlar keldi.

en: China was Mongolized just as Greece and North India were Aryanized and Mesopotamia Semitized and Aryanized.
uz: Xitoy xuddi Gretsiya va Shimoliy Hindiston ariylashgan va Mesopotamiyada semitizatsiya va ariylashtirilgan kabi mo'g'ullashdi.

en: Everywhere the no- mads destroyed much, but everywhere they brought in a new spirit of free enquiry and moral innovation.
uz: Hamma joyda aqldan ozganlar ko'p narsalarni yo'q qildilar, lekin hamma joyda ular erkin so'rov va axloqiy innovatsiyalarning yangi ruhini olib kelishdi.

en: They questioned the beliefs of immemorial ages.
uz: Ular qadim zamonlarning e'tiqodlariga shubha bilan qaradilar.

en: They let daylight into the temples.
uz: Ular kunduzgi yorug'likni ibodatxonalarga kiritdilar.

en: They set up kings who were neither priests nor gods but mere leaders among their captains and companions.
uz: Ular ruhoniylar ham, xudolar ham bo'lmagan, balki o'z sardorlari va hamrohlari orasida oddiy rahbarlar bo'lgan shohlarni tayinlashdi.

en: THE DYING GAUL  The statue in the National Museum, Rome, depicting a Gaul stabbing himself, after killing his wife,
uz: O'LGAN GOL Rimdagi Milliy muzeydagi gollning xotini o'ldirganidan so'ng o'zini pichoqlagan haykali.

en: in the presence of his enemies  Photo: Anderson In the centuries following the sixth century B.C.
uz: Dushmanlarining huzurida Foto: Anderson Miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrdan keyingi asrlarda.

en: we ﬁnd everywhere a great breaking down of ancient traditions and a new spirit of moral and in- tellectual enquiry awake, a spirit never more to be altogether stilled in the great progressive movement of mankind.
uz: Biz hamma joyda qadimgi an'analarning katta buzilishini va axloqiy va intellektual so'rovning yangi ruhini uyg'otishni topamiz, insoniyatning buyuk progressiv harakatida hech qachon butunlay to'xtab qolmaydigan ruh.

en: We ﬁnd reading and writing be- coming common and accessible accomplishments among the ruling and prosperous minority; they were no longer the jealously guarded secret of the priests.
uz: Biz o'qish va yozishni hukmron va farovon ozchilik orasida keng tarqalgan va qo'l yetadigan yutuqlarga duch kelamiz; ular endi ruhoniylarning rashk bilan qo'riqlanadigan siri emas edi.

en: Travel is increasing and transport growing easier by reason of hors- es and roads.
uz: Sayohatlar ortib bormoqda va transport otlar va yo'llar tufayli osonlashib bormoqda.

en: A new and easy device to facilitate trade has been found in coined money.
uz: Savdoni osonlashtirish uchun yangi va oson qurilma tanga pulda topildi.

en: Let us now transfer our attention back from China in the extreme east of the old world to the western half of the Mediterranean.
uz: Keling, endi diqqatimizni Xitoydan, eski dunyoning chekka sharqida, O'rta yer dengizining g'arbiy yarmiga qaytarib o'taylik.

en: Here we have to note the appearance of a city which was destined to play at last a very great part indeed in human affairs, Rome.
uz: Bu yerda inson ishlarida nihoyatda katta rol o'ynashi kerak bo'lgan shaharning paydo bo'lishini, Rimni qayd etishimiz kerak.

en: Hitherto we have told very little about Italy in our story.
uz: Hozirgacha hikoyamizda Italiya haqida juda kam gapirdik.

en: It was before 1000 B.C.
uz: Bu miloddan avvalgi 1000-yildan oldin edi.

en: a land of mountain and forest and thinly populated.
uz: Tog' va o'rmonli va kam aholi yashaydigan yurt.

en: Aryan-speak- ing tribes had pressed down this peninsula and formed little towns and cities, and the southern extremity was studded with Greek settlements.
uz: Aryan tilida so'zlashuvchi qabilalar bu yarim orolni bosib o'tib, kichik shaharchalar va shaharchalar tashkil etishdi, janubiy chegarasi esa yunon aholi punktlari bilan qoplangan edi.

en: The noble ruins of Pæstum preserve for us to this day something of the dignity and splendour of these early Greek establishments.
uz: Pæstumning olijanob xarobalari bugungi kungacha biz uchun ushbu qadimgi yunon muassasalarining qadr-qimmatini va ulug'vorligini saqlab qoladi.

en: A non-Aryan people, probably akin to the Ægean peoples, the Etruscans, had established them- selves in the central part of the peninsula.
uz: Ariy bo'lmagan xalq, ehtimol Agey xalqlariga, etruskalarga o'xshash bo'lgan, ularni yarim orolning markaziy qismida o'zlashtirgan edi.

en: They had reversed the usual process by subjugating various Aryan tribes.
uz: Ular odatdagi jarayonni o'zgartirib, turli ariy qabilalarini bo'ysundirishdi.

en: Rome, when it comes into the light of history, is a little trading city at a ford on the Tiber, with a Latin- speaking population ruled over by Etruscan kings.
uz: Rim, tarix nuriga kelganda, Tiber daryosidagi daryo bo'yida joylashgan kichik savdo shahri bo'lib, lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi aholi etruska qirollari tomonidan hukmronlik qiladi.

en: The old chronologies gave 753 B.C.
uz: Qadimgi xronologiyalar miloddan avvalgi 753-yilni beradi.

en: as the date of the founding of Rome, half a century later than the founding of the great Phœnician city of Carthage and twenty-three years after the ﬁrst Olympiad.
uz: Rimning tashkil topgan sanasi sifatida, buyuk Fenakiya shahri Karfagen tashkil topganidan yarim asr va birinchi Olimpiya o'yinidan yigirma uch yil o'tib.

en: Etruscan tombs of a much earlier date than 753 B.C.
uz: Etruskan qabrlari miloddan avvalgi 753-yildan ancha oldinroq.

en: have, however, been excavated in the Roman Forum.
uz: Biroq, Rim Forumida qazilgan.

en: In that red-letter century, the sixth century B.C., the Etruscan kings were expelled (510 B.C.) and Rome became an aristocratic republic with a lordly class of “patrician” families dominating a commonalty of “plebeians.” Ex- cept that it spoke Latin it was not unlike many aristocratic Greek republics.
uz: O'sha qizil harf asrida, miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda, etruska qirollari quvg'in qilindi (miloddan avvalgi 510.) va Rim aristokratik respublikaga aylandi, unda patrik oilalarining xo'jayinlar sinfi hukmronlik qildi va plebeylar umumiyligini hukmronlik qildi.

en: For some centuries the internal history of Rome was the story of a long and obstinate struggle for freedom and a share in the government on the part of the plebeians.
uz: Ba'zi asrlar davomida Rimning ichki tarixi ozodlik uchun uzoq va qat'iy kurash va plebeylarning hukumatdagi ulushi haqidagi hikoya edi.

en: It would not be difﬁcult to ﬁnd Greek parallels to this conﬂict, which the Greeks would have called a conﬂict of aristocracy with democracy.
uz: Bu mojaroga yunoncha parallellarni topish qiyin bo'lmas edi, buni yunonlar demokratiya bilan aristokratiya to'qnashuvi deb atashgan bo'lardi.

en: In the end the plebeians broke down most of the exclusive bar- riers of the old families and established a working equality with them.
uz: Oxir-oqibat plebeylar eski oilalarning eksklyuziv bar-riyerlarining aksariyatini yo'q qildilar va ular bilan ish tengligini o'rnatdilar.

en: They destroyed the old exclusiveness, and made it possible and acceptable for Rome to extend her citizenship by the inclusion of more and more “out- siders.” For while she still struggled at home, she was extending her power abroad.
uz: Ular eski eksklyuzivlikni yo'q qilishdi va Rimga o'z fuqaroligini tobora ko'proq tashqilarni qo'shish orqali kengaytirishni imkoni va maqbul qilishdi. Chunki u uyda qiynalgan paytda, o'z kuchini chet elga ham yo'naltirardi.

en: REMAINS OF THE ANCIENT ROMAN CISTERNS AT CARTHAGE  Photo: Underwood & Underwood The extension of Roman power began in the ﬁfth century B.C.
uz: ANCIY RIM SHAHIDLARINING KARTHAJDAGI QOLG'IQLARI Foto: Yog'och va Yog'och Rim hokimiyatining kengayishi miloddan avvalgi beshinchi asrda boshlangan.

en: Until that time they had waged war, and generally unsuccessful war, with the Etr- uscans.
uz: O'sha vaqtgacha ular Etr-usqonlar bilan urush olib borishgan edi, va odatda muvaffaqiyatsiz urush.

en: There was an Etruscan fort, Veii, only a few miles from Rome
uz: Rimdan bir necha milya uzoqlikda joylashgan Etruskan qal'asi bor edi, Veii.

en: which the Romans had never been able to capture.
uz: Rimliklar hech qachon zabt eta olmagan.

en: In 474 B.C., however, a great misfortune came to the Etruscans.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 474-yilda esa etruskaliklarga katta musibat keldi.

en: Their ﬂeet was destroyed by the Greeks of Syracuse in Sicily.
uz: Ularning floti Sitsiliyadagi Sirakuzalik yunonlar tomonidan yo'q qilindi.

en: At the same time a wave of Nordic invaders came down upon them from the north, the Gauls.
uz: Shu bilan birga shimoldan ularga, galliyaliklarga shimoliy bosqinchilarning to'lqini tushdi.

en: Caught between Roman and Gaul, the Etruscans fell—and disappear from history.
uz: Rim va Goll o'rtasida qolib ketgan etrusklar quladi va tarixdan yo'qoladi.

en: Veii was captured by the Romans, The Gauls came through to Rome and sacked the city (390 B.C.A.D.) but could not capture the Capitol.
uz: Veii Rimliklar tomonidan asirga olindi, galliyaliklar Rimga kirib, shaharni talon-toroj qilishdi (miloddan avvalgi 390-yil), lekin Kapitoliyni egallay olmadilar.

en: An attempted night surprise was betrayed by the cackling of some geese, and ﬁnally the invaders were bought off and retired to the north of Italy again.
uz: Kechki syurprizga urinish ba'zi g'ozlarning g'ijirlashi bilan aldanib ketdi va nihoyat bosqinchilar sotib olinib, yana Italiyaning shimoliga chekindi.

en: The Gaulish raid seems to have invigorated rather than weakened Rome.
uz: Galliya hujumi Rimni zaiflashtirgandan ko'ra, yanada jonlantirganga o'xshaydi.

en: The Romans conquered and assimilated the Etruscans, and extended their power over all central Italy from the Arno to Naples.
uz: Rimliklar etrusklarni zabt etishdi va o'zlashtirishdi hamda o'z kuchlarini Arno daryosidan Neapolgacha bo'lgan butun markaziy Italiya ustidan cho'zishdi.

en: To this they had reached within a few years of 300 B.C.
uz: Bunga ular miloddan avvalgi 300-yildan bir necha yil ichida erishgan edilar.

en: Their conquests in Italy were going on simultaneously with the growth of Philip’s power in Macedonia and Greece, and the tremendous raid of Alexander to Egypt and the Indus.
uz: Ularning Italiyadagi fathlari Filippning Makedoniya va Gretsiyadagi qudratining o'sishi, shuningdek, Aleksandrning Misrga va Ind daryosiga ulkan hujumi bilan bir vaqtda davom etardi.

en: The Romans had become notable people in the civilized world to the east of them by the break-up of Alexander’s empire.
uz: Rimliklar Aleksandr imperiyasining parchalanishi natijasida ularning sharqidagi madaniy dunyoda taniqli odamlarga aylangan edi.

en: To the north of the Roman power were the Gauls; to the south of them were the Greek settlements of Magna Græcia, that is to say of Sicily and of the toe and heel of Italy.
uz: Rim qudratining shimolida gallar bor edi; ularning janubida esa Magna Græcia, ya'ni Sitsiliya va Italiyaning oyoq va poshnali joylari joylashgan.

en: The Gauls were a hardy, warlike people and the Romans held that boundary by a line of forts and fortiﬁed settlements.
uz: Gallar qattiqqo'l, urushqoq xalq edi va rimliklar bu chegarani qal'alar va mustahkam aholi punktlari chizig'i bilan ushlab turishardi.

en: The Greek cities in the south headed by Tarentum (now Taranto) and by Syra- cuse in Sicily, did not so much threaten as fear the Romans.
uz: Janubdagi yunon shaharlari, Tarentum (hozirgi Taranto) va Sitsiliyadagi Suriya orqali boshchiligida, rimliklarga nisbatan qo'rquvchalik xavfli emas edi.

en: They looked about for some help against these new conquerors.
uz: Ular bu yangi bosqinchilarga qarshi yordam so'rab atrofga qarashdi.

en: We have already told how the empire of Alexander fell to pieces and was divided among his generals and companions.
uz: Biz allaqachon Aleksandr imperiyasining qanday qilib parchalanib ketganini va uning generallari va hamrohlari orasida bo'linganini aytib o'tdik.

en: Among these adventurers was a kinsman of Alexander’s named Pyrrhus, who established himself in Epirus, which is across the Adriatic Sea over against the heel of Italy.
uz: Bu sarguzashtchilar orasida Aleksandrning qarindoshi Pirr ham bor edi, u Italiyaning poshnali qismiga qaraganda Adriatik dengizidan o'tib, Epirda o'rnashib olgan.

en: It was his ambition to play the part of Philip of Macedonia to Magna Græcia, and to become protector and master-general of Tarentum, Syracuse and the rest of that part of the world.
uz: Uning ambitsiyasi Makedoniyalik Filipning rolini Magna Græciaga o'ynash, hamda Tarentum, Sirakuza va dunyoning qolgan qismining himoyachisi va bosh xo'jayini bo'lish edi.

en: He had what was then it very efﬁcient modern army; he had an infantry phalanx, cavalry from Thessaly—which was now quite as good as the original Macedonian cavalry—and twenty ﬁghting ele- phants; he invaded Italy and routed the Romans in two considerable battles, Heraclea (280 B.C.) and Ausculum (279 B.C.), and having driven them north, he turned his attention to the subjugation of Sicily.
uz: U o'sha paytdagi juda samarali zamonaviy armiyaga ega edi; u yerda piyoda falanga, Salliyadan otliq askarlar bor edi  hozirda asl Makedoniya otliqlari kabi yaxshi  va yigirmata jangchi elefant bor edi; u Italiyaga bostirib kirdi va Rimliklarni ikki sezilarli jangda, Geraklea (280 miloddan avvalgi) va Auskulum (279 miloddan avvalgi) mag'lub etdi va ularni shimolga haydab, diqqatini Sitsiliya bo'ysundirilishiga qaratdi.

en: But this brought against him a more formidable enemy than were the Ro- mans at that time, the Phœnician trading city of Carthage, which was proba- bly then the greatest city in the world.
uz: Ammo bu unga o'sha paytdagi Rimliklardan ko'ra dahshatliroq dushmanni, o'sha paytda dunyodagi eng buyuk shahar bo'lgan Kartagen degan Fenisiyadagi savdo shahrini olib keldi.

en: Sicily was too near Carthage for a new Alexander to be welcome there, and Carthage was mindful of the fate that had befallen her mother city Tyre half a century before.
uz: Sitsiliya Kartagaga yangi Aleksandrning u yerda kutib olinishi uchun juda yaqin edi va Kartafa ona shahri Tirga yarim asr oldin tushgan taqdirni esda tutgan edi.

en: So she sent a ﬂeet to encourage or compel Rome to continue the struggle, and she cut the overseas communications of Pyrrhus.
uz: Shunday qilib, u Rimni kurashni davom ettirishga undash yoki majburlash uchun flot yubordi va Pirrning xorijiy aloqalarini to'xtatdi.

en: Pyrrhus found himself freshly as- sailed by the Romans, and suffered a disastrous repulse in an attack he had made upon their camp at Beneventum between Naples and Rome.
uz: Pirrrus o'zini rimliklar tomonidan yangi sayr qilingan holda topdi va Neapol va Rim o'rtasidagi Beneventumdagi ularning lageriga qilgan hujumida dahshatli jirkanchlikka uchradi.

en: And suddenly came news that recalled him to Epirus.
uz: Va to'satdan uni Epirga eslatuvchi xabar keldi.

en: The Gauls were raiding south.
uz: Gallar janubga hujum qilmoqda edi.

en: But this time they were not raiding down into Italy; the Ro- man frontier, fortiﬁed and guarded, had become too formidable for them.
uz: Ammo bu safar ular Italiyaga bostirib kirmayotgan edilar; Rim chegarasi, mustahkamlangan va qo'riqlangan, ular uchun juda dahshatli bo'lib qolgan edi.

en: They were raiding down through Illyria (which is now Serbia and Albania) to Macedonia and Epirus.
uz: Ular Illyriya (hozirgi Serbiya va Albaniya) orqali Makedoniya va Epirga hujum qilishayotgan edi.

en: Repulsed by the Romans, endangered at sea by the Carthaginians, and threatened at home by the Gauls, Pyrrhus abandoned his dream of conquest and went home (275 B.C.), and the power of Rome was extended to the Straits of Messina.
uz: Rimliklar tomonidan rad etilgan, Karfagenliklar tomonidan dengizda yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida va uyida gallar tomonidan tahdid solingan Pirr o'z fath orzusidan voz kechib, miloddan avvalgi 275 yilda uyga qaytdi va Rim qudrati Messina bo'g'ozlarigacha cho'zilgan edi.

en: On the Sicilian side of the Straits was the Greek city of Messina, and this presently fell into the hands of a gang of pirates.
uz: Siciliya bo'g'ozlarining yonida Messina yunon shahri joylashgan edi va bu yaqin orada qaroqchilar guruhi qo'liga tushdi.

en: The Carthaginians, who were already practically overlords of Sicily and allies of Syracuse, sup- pressed these pirates (270 B.C.) and put in a Carthaginian garrison there.
uz: Karthaginliklar, ular allaqachon Sitsiliya hukmdorlari va Sirakuza ittifoqchilari bo'lganlari sababli, bu qaroqchilarni (miloddan avvalgi 270-yilda) qo'llab-quvvatladilar va u yerga Karthagin garnizonini joylashtirdilar.

en: The pirates appealed to Rome and Rome listened to their complaint.
uz: Qaroqchilar Rimga murojaat qilishdi va Rim ularning shikoyatini eshitdi.

en: And so across the Straits of Messina the great trading power of Carthage and this new conquering people, the Romans, found themselves in antagonism, face to face.
uz: Shunday qilib, Messina bo'g'ozlaridan o'tib, Karfagenning buyuk savdo qudrati va bu yangi zabt etuvchi xalq, Rimliklar yuzma-yuz qarama-qarshilikka duch kelishdi.

en: XXXII ROME AND CARTHAGE It was in 264 B.C.
uz: XXXII RIM VA KARTEG. Bu miloddan avvalgi 264-yilda sodir bo'lgan.

en: that the great struggle between Rome and Carthage, the Punic Wars, began.
uz: Rim va Kartafe o'rtasidagi buyuk kurash, Pun urushlari boshlangan edi.

en: In that year Asoka was beginning his reign in Behar and Shi- Hwang-ti was a little child, the Museum in Alexandria was still doing good scientiﬁc work, and the barbaric Gauls were now in Asia Minor and exacting a tribute from Pergamum.
uz: O'sha yili Asoka Behorda hukmronligini boshlagan edi va Shi- Hwang-ti kichkina bola edi, Iskandariyadagi muzey hali ham yaxshi ilmiy ishlar qilmoqda edi va vahshiy gallar hozir Kichik Osiyoda edi va Pergamdan hurmat so'rayotgan edi.

en: The different regions of the world were still separated by insurmountable distances, and probably the rest of mankind heard only vague and remote rumours of the mortal ﬁght that went on for a century and a half in Spain, Italy, North Africa and the western Mediterranean, between the last stronghold of Semitic power and Rome, this newcomer among Aryan-speaking peoples.
uz: Dunyoning turli mintaqalari hali ham yengib bo'lmas masofalar bilan ajralib turardi va ehtimol insoniyatning qolgan qismi Ispaniya, Italiya, Shimoliy Afrika va G'arbiy O'rta yer dengizida Semit kuchining oxirgi qo'rg'onchasi va Aryan tilida so'zlashuvchi xalqlar o'rtasida bir yarim asr davom etgan o'lim jangining faqat noaniq va uzoq mish-mishlarini eshitgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: That war has left its traces upon issues that still stir the world.
uz: O'sha urush dunyoni hanuzgacha tashvishga solayotgan masalalarda o'z izlarini qoldirdi.

en: Rome tri- umphed over Carthage, but the rivalry of Aryan and Semite was to merge itself later on in the conﬂict of Gentile and Jew.
uz: Rim Karthageni uch tomonlama himoya qildi, lekin Aryan va Semitlarning raqibi keyinchalik butparastlar va yahudiylar mojarosida birlashib ketishi kerak edi.

en: Our history now is coming to events whose consequences and distorted traditions still maintain a lin- gering and expiring vitality in, and exercise a complicating and confusing inﬂuence upon, the conﬂicts and controversies of to-day.
uz: Bizning tariximiz hozirda shunday hodisalarga kelmoqda, ularning oqibatlari va buzilgan an'analari bugungi kundagi mojarolar va bahslarga hali ham ozgina va o'chadigan hayotiylikni saqlab qoladi, murakkab va chalkash ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

en: The First Punic War began in 264 B.C.
uz: Birinchi Pun urushi miloddan avvalgi 264-yilda boshlangan.

en: about the pirates of Messina.
uz: Messina qaroqchilari haqida.

en: It de- veloped into a struggle for the possession of all Sicily except the dominions of the Greek king of Syracuse.
uz: U butun Sitsiliyani egallash uchun kurashga aylandi, faqatgina yunon shohi Sirakuza hukmronligi bundan mustasno.

en: The advantage of the sea was at ﬁrst with the Carthaginians.
uz: Dengizning afzalligi dastlab Karfagenliklar bilan edi.

en: They had great ﬁghting ships of what was hitherto an un- heard-of size, quinqueremes, galleys with ﬁve banks of oars and a huge ram.
uz: Ularda shu paytgacha hech kim eshitmagan o'lchamdagi buyuk jangovar kemalar, besh qirrali, beshta eshkak qirg'og'i va ulkan qo'chqorli galerelar bor edi.

en: At the battle of Salamis, two centuries before, the leading battleships had only been triremes with three banks.
uz: Salamis jangida, bundan ikki asr oldin, yetakchi jangovar kemalar faqat uchta qirg'oqli triremlar edi.

en: But the Romans, with ex- traordinary energy and in spite of the fact that they had little naval experi-
uz: Ammo rimliklar, g'ayrioddiy energiya bilan va ularning dengiz tajribasi kam bo'lishiga qaramay...

en: ence, set themselves to outbuild the Carthaginians.
