uz: Ence, o'zlarini Karfagenliklardan ustun qo'yishga majbur qildilar.

en: They manned the new navy they created chieﬂy with Greek seamen, and they invented grappling and boarding to make up for the superior seamanship of the enemy.
uz: Ular asosan yunon dengizchilari bilan yaratgan yangi flotni boshqardilar va dushmanning yuqori dengizchiligini qoplash uchun kurash va bortni ixtiro qilishdi.

en: When the Carthaginian came up to ram or shear the oars of the Roman, huge grap- pling irons seized him and the Roman soldiers swarmed aboard him.
uz: Karfagiy Rimlikning eshkaklarini qo'ylash yoki kesish uchun kelganida, ulkan tok temirlari uni ushladi va Rim askarlari unga hujum qildi.

en: At Mylæ (260 B.C.) and at Ecnomus (256 B.C.) the Carthaginians were disas- trously beaten.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 260-yilda va Eknomda (miloddan avvalgi 256-yilda) Karfagenliklar juda qattiq kaltaklandi.

en: They repulsed a Roman landing near Carthage but were bad- ly beaten at Palermo, losing one hundred and four elephants there—to grace such a triumphal procession through the Forum as Rome had never seen be- fore.
uz: Ular Rimning Kartfega yaqinidagi qo'nishini rad etishdi, lekin ular Palermoda yomon mag'lub bo'lishdi va u yerda yuz to'rtta filni yo'qotishdi  Forum orqali Rim hech qachon ko'rmagan bunday g'alaba marosimini nishonlash uchun.

en: But after that came two Roman defeats and then a Roman recovery.
uz: Ammo shundan so'ng Rimning ikkita mag'lubiyati va keyin Rimning tiklanishi keldi.

en: The last naval forces of Carthage were defeated by it last Roman effort at the battle of the Ægatian Isles (241 B.C.) and Carthage sued for peace.
uz: Kartagenning so'nggi dengiz kuchlari Aegatiya orollari jangida (miloddan avvalgi 211-yilda) uning so'nggi Rim urinishi natijasida mag'lub etildi va Kartagen tinchlik uchun da'vo qildi.

en: All Sicily except the dominions of Hiero, king of Syracuse, was ceded to the Romans.
uz: Sirakuza shohi Hiero hukmronligidan tashqari butun Sitsiliya Rimliklarga topshirildi.

en: HANNIBAL  Bust in the National Museum at Naples  Photo: Mansell For twenty-two years Rome and Carthage kept the peace.
uz: HANNIBALning Neapoldagi Milliy muzeyidagi to'plami. Surat: Mansell. Yigirma ikki yil davomida Rim va Karfagen tinchlikni saqlab qoldi.

en: Both had trou- ble enough at home.
uz: Ikkalasi ham uyda yetarli muammolarga duch kelishdi.

en: In Italy the Gauls came south again, threatened Rome —which in a state of panic offered human sacriﬁces to the Gods!—and were routed at Telamon.
uz: Italiyada gallar yana janubga kelishdi, Rimga tahdid soladilar  u vahima holatida xudolarga insoniy qurbonliklarni taklif qilardi!  va Telamonda mag'lub etildi.

en: Rome pushed forward to the Alps, and even ex- tended her dominions down the Adriatic coast to Illyria.
uz: Rim Alp tog'lariga tomon oldinga siljidi va hatto o'z hukmronliklarini Adriatik sohilidan Illyriyagacha cho'zdi.

en: Carthage suffered from domestic insurrections and from revolts in Corsica and Sardinia, and
uz: Karfagen mahalliy qo'zg'olonlar va Korsika va Sardiniyadagi qo'zg'olonlardan aziyat chekdi, va

en: displayed far less recuperative power.
uz: ancha kam tiklash quvvati namoyish etdi.

en: Finally, an act of intolerable aggres- sion, Rome seized and annexed the two revolting islands.
uz: Nihoyat, chidab bo'lmas tajovuzkorlik harakati bilan Rim ikki isyonkor orolni egallab oldi va qo'shib oldi.

en: Spain at that time was Carthaginian as far north as the river Ebro.
uz: O'sha paytda Ispaniya Kartagina davlati bo'lib, Ebro daryosigacha shimolda joylashgan edi.

en: To that boundary the Romans restricted them.
uz: Rimliklar ularni shu chegarada cheklashdi.

en: Any crossing of the Ebro by the Carthaginians was to be considered an act of war against the Romans.
uz: Karthaginliklar tomonidan Ebro o'tishi Rimliklarga qarshi urush harakati deb hisoblanishi kerak edi.

en: the Carthaginians, provoked by new Roman aggressions, did cross this river under a young general named Hannibal, one of the most brilliant commanders in the whole of history.
uz: Karfagenliklar, yangi Rim tajovuzlari tufayli qo'zg'atilgan holda, bu daryoni butun tarixdagi eng ajoyib sarkardalardan biri bo'lgan Hannibal ismli yosh general boshchiligida kesib o'tishdi.

en: He marched his army from Spain over the Alps into Italy, raised the Gauls against the Romans, and car- ried on the Second Punic War in Italy itself for ﬁfteen years.
uz: U o'z armiyasini Ispaniyadan Italiyaga Alp tog'lari ustidan olib kirdi, gallarni rimliklarga qarshi ko'tardi va Italiyaning o'zida o'n besh yil davomida Ikkinchi Pun urushida qatnashdi.

en: He inﬂicted tremendous defeats upon the Romans at Lake Trasimere and at Cannæ, and throughout all his Italian campaigns no Roman army stood against him and escaped disaster.
uz: U Rimliklarga Trasimere ko'lida va Cannæda ulkan mag'lubiyatlar yetkazdi va butun Italiya yurishlari davomida unga qarshi turgan va falokatdan qutulgan hech bir Rim armiyasi yo'q edi.

en: But a Roman army had landed at Marseilles and cut his communications with Spain; he had no siege train, and he could never cap- ture Rome.
uz: Ammo Rim armiyasi Marselga qo'ndi va uning Ispaniya bilan aloqasini to'xtatdi; uning qamal poyezdi yo'q edi va u hech qachon Rimni zabt eta olmadi.

en: Finally the Carthaginians, threatened by the revolt of the Nu- midians at home, were forced back upon the defence of their own city in Africa, a Roman army crossed into Africa, and Hannibal experienced his ﬁrst defeat under its walls at the battle of Zama (202 B.C.
uz: Nihoyat, Karfagenliklar, o'z uylarida Nu-midilarning isyoni bilan tahdid ostida, Afrikadagi o'z shaharlarini himoya qilishga majbur bo'lishdi, Rim armiyasi Afrikaga o'tdi va Hannibal uning devorlari ostida Zama jangida (miloddan avvalgi 202-yilda) birinchi mag'lubiyatini boshdan kechirdi.

en: at the hands of Sci- pio Africanus the Elder.
uz: Sci-pio Africanus the Elder qo'lida.

en: The battle of Zama ended this Second Punic War.
uz: Zama jangi bu Ikkinchi Pun urushini yakunladi.

en: Carthage capitulated; she surrendered Spain and her war ﬂeet; she paid an enormous indemnity and agreed to give up Hannibal to the vengeance of the Romans.
uz: Karfagen taslim bo'ldi; u Ispaniya va uning harbiy flotini taslim qildi; u ulkan tovon to'ladi va Hannibalni rimliklarning qasosiga berishga rozi bo'ldi.

en: But Hannibal escaped and ﬂed to Asia where later, being in danger of falling into the hands of his relentless enemies, he took poison and died.
uz: Ammo Gannibal qochib, Osiyoga qochdi, u yerda keyinchalik tinimsiz dushmanlarining qo'liga tushish xavfi ostida zahar olib, vafot etdi.

en: For ﬁfty-six years Rome and the shorn city of Carthage were at peace.
uz: Qirq olti yil davomida Rim va kesilgan Karfagen shahri tinchlikda edi.

en: And meanwhile Rome spread her empire over confused and divided Greece, invaded Asia Minor, and defeated Antiochus III, the Seleucid monarch, at Magnesia in Lydia.
uz: Va shu bilan birga Rim o'z imperiyasini chalkash va bo'linadigan Yunonistonga yoydi, Kichik Osiyoga bostirib kirdi va Lidiyadagi Magneziyada Selevik monarxi Antiox III ni mag'lub etdi.

en: She made Egypt, still under the Ptolemies, and Pergamum and most of the small states of Asia Minor into “Allies,” or, as we should call them now, “protected states.” Meanwhile Carthage, subjugated and enfeebled, had been slowly regain- ing something of her former prosperity.
uz: U Misrni, hali Ptolemeylar ostida bo'lgan Misrni, Pergamni va Kichik Osiyoning ko'p kichik davlatlarini ittifoqchilar yoki, hozir ularni qanday atashimiz kerak bo'lsa, himoyalangan davlatlarga aylantirdi. Ayni paytda, bo'ysundirilib va zaiflashgan Karfagen asta-sekin o'zining avvalgi farovonligidan qaytib kelgan edi.

en: Her recovery revived the hate and suspicion of the Romans.
uz: Uning sog'ayishi Rimliklarning nafratini va gumonini jonlantirdi.

en: She was attacked upon the most shallow and arti- ﬁcial of quarrels (149 B.C.), she made an obstinate and bitter resistance, stood a long siege and was stormed (146 B.C.).
uz: U eng sayoz va sun'iy janjallarga hujumga uchradi (miloddan avvalgi 149-yil), u qat'iyatli va achchiq qarshilik ko'rsatdi, uzoq qamalga bardosh berdi va bostirib kirildi (146-yil).

en: The street ﬁghting, or mas- sacre, lasted six days; it was extraordinarily bloody, and when the citadel
uz: Ko'cha janglari, yoki muqaddas janglar, olti kun davom etdi; u favqulodda qonli edi va qachonki qal'a...

en: capitulated only about ﬁfty thousand of the Carthaginian population re- mained alive out of a quarter of a million.
uz: Karfagiya aholisining atigi ellik mingga yaqini to'rtdan bir millionga tirik qolib ketdi.

en: They were sold into slavery, and the city was burnt and elaborately destroyed.
uz: Ular qullikka sotildi va shahar yoqib yuborildi va puxta vayron qilindi.

en: The blackened ruins were ploughed and sown as a sort of ceremonial effacement.
uz: Qoralashgan xarobalar bir turdagi tantanali o'chirish sifatida haydaldi va ekildi.

en: So ended the Third Punic War.
uz: Shunday qilib, Uchinchi Pun urush tugadi.

en: Of all the Semitic states and cities that had ﬂourished in the world ﬁve centuries before only one little country re- mained free under native rulers.
uz: Dunyoda besh asr oldin gullab-yashnagan barcha semit davlatlari va shaharlaridan faqat bitta kichkina davlat mahalliy hukmdorlar ostida ozod bo'lib qayta qo'lga kiritilgan edi.

en: This was Judea, which had liberated itself from the Seleucids and was under the rule of the native Maccabean princes.
uz: Bu Yahudiya edi, u Seleviklardan ozod bo'lgan va mahalliy Makabiy shahzodalarning hukmronligi ostida edi.

en: By this time it had its Bible almost complete, and was developing the dis- tinctive traditions of the Jewish world as we know it now.
uz: O'sha vaqtga kelib, u o'z Injilini deyarli to'liqga ega edi va hozirgi kunda biz bilgan yahudiy dunyosining tanqidiy an'analarini rivojlantirardi.

en: It was natural that the Carthaginians, Phoenicians and kindred peoples dispersed about the world should ﬁnd a common link in their practically identical language and in this literature of hope and courage.
uz: Dunyo bo'ylab tarqalgan Karfagiylar, Finikiylar va qarindosh xalqlar o'zlarining amalda bir xil tillarida va bu umid va jasorat adabiyotida umumiy bog'lanishni topishlari tabiiy edi.

en: To a large extent they were still the traders and bankers of the world.
uz: Ko'p jihatdan ular hali ham dunyoning savdogarlari va bankirlari edilar.

en: The Semitic world had been submerged rather than replaced.
uz: Semit dunyosi almashtirish o'rniga suvga botirilgan edi.

en: Jerusalem, which has always been rather the symbol than the centre of Judaism, was taken by the Romans in 65 B.C.; and after various vicissitudes of quasi- independence and revolt was besieged by them in 70 A.D.
uz: Quddus, doimo yahudiylikning markazi emas, balki ramzi bo'lib kelgan, miloddan avvalgi 65-yilda rimliklar tomonidan egallab olindi; va deyarli mustaqillik va isyonning turli o'zgarishlaridan so'ng, milodiy 70-yilda ular tomonidan qamalga olindi.

en: and cap- tured after a stubborn struggle.
uz: va o'jar kurashdan keyin qopqoqlandi.

en: The Temple was destroyed.
uz: Ma'bad vayron bo'ldi.

en: A later rebellion in 132 A.D.
uz: Keyinchalik milodiy 132 yilda isyon bo'lib o'tdi.

en: completed its destruction, and the Jerusalem we know to-day was rebuilt later under Roman auspices.
uz: vayron bo'lishini yakunladi va bugungi kunda biz biladigan Quddus keyinchalik Rim homiyligida qayta qurildi.

en: A temple to the Roman god,
uz: Rim xudosiga ibodatxona,

en: Jupiter Capitolinus, stood in the place of the Temple, and Jews were forbid- den to inhabit the city.
uz: Jupiter Capitolinus ibodatxona joyida turardi va yahudiylarga shaharda yashash taqiqlangan edi.

en: XXXIII THE GROWTH OF THE ROMAN EMPIRE Now this new Roman power which arose to dominate the western world in the second and ﬁrst centuries B.C.
uz: XXXIII RIM imperiyasining o'sishi Hozir miloddan avvalgi ikkinchi va birinchi asrlarda g'arb dunyosi ustidan hukmronlik qilish uchun paydo bo'lgan ushbu yangi Rim hokimiyati.

en: was in several respects a different thing from any of the great empires that had hitherto prevailed in the civilized world.
uz: bir necha jihatdan madaniy dunyoda shu paytgacha hukmronlik qilgan buyuk imperiyalardan farq qilardi.

en: It was not at ﬁrst a monarchy, and it was not the creation of any one great conqueror.
uz: U dastlab monarxiya emas edi va u hech qanday buyuk bosqinchining yaratilishi ham emas edi.

en: It was not indeed the ﬁrst of republican empires; Athens had dominated a group of Allies and dependents in the time of Pericles, and Carthage when she entered upon her fatal struggle with Rome was mistress of Sardinia and Corsica, Morocco, Algiers, Tunis, and most of Spain and Sicily.
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham respublika imperiyalarining birinchisi emas edi; Afina Perikles davrida ittifoqchilar va qaramog'idagi bir guruhga hukmronlik qilgan edi, va Karfagen Rim bilan halokatli kurashga kirganida Sardiniya va Korsika, Marokash, Jazoir, Tunis va Ispaniyaning ko'p qismi va Sitsiliyaning bekasi edi.

en: But it was the ﬁrst republican empire that escaped extinction and went on to fresh developments.
uz: Lekin bu yo'q bo'lib ketishdan qochib, yangi rivojlanishlarga o'tgan birinchi respublika imperiyasi edi.

en: The centre of this new system lay far to the west of the more ancient cen- tres of empire, which had hitherto been the river valleys of Mesopotamia and Egypt.
uz: Ushbu yangi tizimning markazi qadimgi imperiyaning g'arbida, shu paytgacha Mesopotamiya va Misr daryo vodiylari bo'lgan uzoqroq markazda joylashgan edi.

en: This westward position enabled Rome to bring in to civilization quite fresh regions and peoples.
uz: G'arbga qarab joylashgan bu joylashuv Rimga ancha yangi hududlar va xalqlarni sivilizatsiyaga olib kirish imkonini berdi.

en: The Roman power extended to Morocco and Spain, and was presently able to thrust north-westward over what is now France and Belgium to Britain and north-eastward into Hungary and South Russia.
uz: Rim qudrati Marokash va Ispaniyaga cho'zilgan va hozirda Fransiya va Belgiya bo'lgan hududlar ustidan shimoli-g'arbga, Britaniyaga va shimoli-sharqqa Vengriya va Janubiy Rossiyaga surishga qodir edi.

en: But on the other hand it was never able to maintain itself in Central Asia or Persia because they were too far from its administrative centres.
uz: Lekin boshqa tomondan, u hech qachon Markaziy Osiyo yoki Forsda o'zini saqlab qola olmadi, chunki ular uning ma'muriy markazlaridan juda uzoqda edi.

en: It included therefore great masses of fresh Nordic Aryan- speaking peoples, it presently incorporated nearly all the Greek people in the world, and its population was less strongly Hamitic and Semitic than that of any preceding empire.
uz: Shuning uchun u yangi Shimoliy Aryan tilida so'zlashuvchi xalqlarning katta ommasini o'z ichiga olgan, hozirda u dunyodagi deyarli barcha yunon xalqini o'z ichiga olgan va uning aholisi avvalgi imperiyalarga qaraganda kamroq Hamit va Semit edi.

en: For some centuries this Roman Empire did not fall into the grooves of precedent that had so speedily swallowed up Persian and Greek, and all that time it developed.
uz: Ba'zi asrlar davomida bu Rim imperiyasi fors va yunon tillarini shunchalik tez yutib yuborgan precedent yo'llariga tushmadi va shu vaqt davomida rivojlandi.

en: The rulers of the Medes and Persians became entirely Babylonized in a generation or so; they took over the tiara of the king of kings and the temples and priesthoods of his gods; Alexander and his suc- cessors followed in the same easy path of assimilation; the Seleucid mon- archs had much the same court and administrative methods as Nebuchad- nezzar; the Ptolemies became Pharaohs and altogether Egyptian.
uz: Med va Fors hukmdorlari bir necha avlod ichida butunlay Bobilga aylandilar; ular qirollarning tiarasini va uning xudolarining ibodatxonalari va ruhoniyliklarini o'z zimmasiga olishdi; Aleksandr va uning vorislari xuddi shu oson assimilyatsiya yo'lidan borishdi; Selevkid mon-arklari Nabukad-nezzar bilan deyarli bir xil saroy va ma'muriy usullarga ega edi; Ptolemeylar fir'avnlarga va umuman Misrga aylandi.

en: They were assimilated just as before them the Semitic conquerors of the Sumerians had been assimilated.
uz: Ular xuddi ulardan oldin shumerlarning semit bosqinchilari singari assimilyatsiya qilindi.

en: But the Romans ruled in their own city, and for some cen- turies kept to the laws of their own nature.
uz: Ammo rimliklar o'z shaharlarida hukmronlik qilishardi va ba'zi sen-turlar o'z tabiat qonunlariga amal qilishardi.

en: The only people who exercised any great mental inﬂuence upon them before the second or third century A.D.
uz: Miloddan keyingi ikkinchi yoki uchinchi asrgacha ularga katta ruhiy ta'sir ko'rsatgan yagona odamlar.

en: were the kindred and similar Greeks.
uz: qarindoshlar va shunga o'xshash yunonlar edi.

en: So that the Roman Empire was essentially a ﬁrst attempt to rule a great dominion upon mainly Aryan lines.
uz: Shunday qilib, Rim imperiyasi asosan Aryo liniyalari bo'yicha buyuk hukmronlikni boshqarish uchun birinchi urinish edi.

en: It was so far a new pattern in history, it was an expanded Aryan republic.
uz: Bu shu paytgacha tarixda yangi naqsh edi, bu kengaygan Aryan respublikasi edi.

en: The old pattern of a personal conqueror ruling over a capital city that had grown up round the temple of a harvest god did not apply to it.
uz: O'rim-yig'im xudosi ibodatxonasi atrofida o'sgan poytaxt shahri ustidan shaxsiy bosqinchining hukmronlik qilishining eski namunasi unga tegishli emas edi.

en: The Romans had gods and temples, but like the gods of the Greeks their gods were quasi- human immortals, divine patricians.
uz: Rimliklarning xudolari va ibodatxonalari bor edi, lekin yunonlarning xudolari singari ularning xudolari deyarli insoniy o'lmaslar, ilohiy vatanparvarlar edi.

en: The Romans also had blood sacriﬁces and even made human ones in times of stress, things they may have learnt to do from their dusky Etruscan teachers; but until Rome was long past its zenith neither priest nor temple played a large part in Roman history.
uz: Rimliklar ham qon qurbonliklari qilishgan va hatto stress davrlarida inson qurbonliklarini ham qilishgan, bu ishlarni ular o'zlarining qorong'u etruska ustozlaridan o'rgangan bo'lishi mumkin; lekin Rim o'z zenaitidan ancha o'tmaguncha, ruhoniy ham, ibodatxona ham Rim tarixida katta rol o'ynamagan.

en: The Roman Empire was a growth, an unplanned novel growth; the Ro- man people found themselves engaged almost unawares in a vast adminis- trative experiment.
uz: Rim imperiyasi o'sish edi, rejalashtirilmagan yangi o'sish edi; rus xalqi o'zini deyarli bexabar ulkan ma'muriy tajriba bilan shug'ullangan holda topdi.

en: It cannot be called a successful experiment.
uz: Buni muvaffaqiyatli tajriba deb atash mumkin emas.

en: In the end their empire collapsed altogether.
uz: Oxir-oqibat ularning imperiyasi butunlay quladi.

en: And it changed enormously in form and method from century to century.
uz: Va u asrdan asrga shakl va usulda juda katta o'zgardi.

en: It changed more in a hundred years than Bengal or Mesopotamia or Egypt changed in a thousand.
uz: U yuz yil ichida Bengal yoki Mesopotamiya yoki Misr ming yil ichida o'zgarganidan ko'ra ko'proq o'zgardi.

en: It was always changing.
uz: U doim o'zgarib turardi.

en: It never attained to any ﬁxity.
uz: U hech qachon hech qanday mahkamlikka erisha olmadi.

en: In a sense the experiment failed.
uz: Ma'lum ma'noda tajriba muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

en: In a sense the experiment remains unﬁn- ished, and Europe and America to-day are still working out the riddles of world-wide statescraft ﬁrst confronted by the Roman people.
uz: Ma'lum ma'noda tajriba tugallanmaganligicha qolmoqda va bugungi kunda Yevropa va Amerika Rim xalqi tomonidan birinchi bo'lib duch kelingan butun dunyo bo'ylab davlat yo'llari topishmoqlarini hal qilmoqda.

en: It is well for the student of history to bear in mind the very great changes not only in political but in social and moral matters that went on throughout the period of Roman dominion.
uz: Tarix o'quvchisi Rim hukmronligi davrida nafaqat siyosiy, balki ijtimoiy va axloqiy masalalarda sodir bo'lgan juda katta o'zgarishlarni yodda tutishi yaxshi.

en: There is much too strong a tendency in peo- ple’s minds to think of the Roman rule as something ﬁnished and stable,
uz: Rim hukmronligi haqida to'liq va barqaror narsa deb o'ylashga moyillik juda kuchli.

en: ﬁrm, rounded, noble and decisive.
uz: qat'iy, yumaloq, olijanob va qat'iy.

en: Macaulay’s Lays of Ancient Rome, S.P.Q.R.
uz: Makaulayning Qadimgi Rim yo'nalishlari, S.P.Q.R.

en: the elder Cato, the Scipios, Julius Cæsar, Diocletian, Constantine the Great, triumphs, orations, gladiatorial combats and Christian martyrs are all mixed up together in a picture of something high and cruel and digniﬁed.
uz: Katta Katon, Skiloslar, Yuliy Sezar, Diokletian, Konstantin Buyuk, g'alabalar, nutqlar, gladiatorlik janglari va xristian shahidlar barchasi baland va shafqatsiz va qadrli bir narsaning tasvirida aralashdir.

en: The items of that picture have to be disentangled.
uz: O'sha rasmdagi narsalarni ajratib olish kerak.

en: They are collected at dif- ferent points from a process of change profounder than that which separates the London of William the Conqueror from the London of to-day.
uz: Ular Buyuk Britaniyalik Londonni bugungi Londondan ajratib turuvchi o'zgarish jarayonidan ko'ra chuqurroq bo'lgan turli nuqtalarda yig'iladi.

en: We may very conveniently divide the expansion of Rome into four stages.
uz: Rimning kengayishini juda qulay tarzda to'rt bosqichga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: The ﬁrst stage began after the sack of Rome by the Goths in 390 B.C.
uz: Birinchi bosqich miloddan avvalgi 390-yilda gotikalar tomonidan Rimning talon-torojidan keyin boshlangan.

en: and went on until the end of the First Punic War (240 B.C,).
uz: va Birinchi Pun urushining oxirigacha davom etdi (miloddan avvalgi 240-yil).

en: We may call this stage the stage of the Assimilative Republic.
uz: Biz bu bosqichni assimilativ Respublikaning bosqichi deb atashimiz mumkin.

en: It was perhaps the ﬁnest, most characteristic stage in Roman history.
uz: Bu, ehtimol, Rim tarixidagi eng yaxshi, eng xarakterli sahna edi.

en: The age-long dissensions of pa- trician and plebeian were drawing to it close, the Etruscan threat had come to an end, no one was very rich yet nor very poor, and most men were pub- lic-spirited.
uz: Qadim zamonlar davomida patris va plebeynlar o'rtasidagi kelishmovchiliklar yaqinlashayotgan edi, etrus tahdidi tugab borgan edi, hech kim hali juda boy ham, juda kambag'al ham emas edi va ko'pchilik odamlar pub-lik ruhida edi.

en: It was a republic like the republic of the South African Boers before 1900 or like the northern states of the American union between 1800 and 1850; a free- farmers republic.
uz: U 1900-yilgacha Janubiy Afrika Burlari respublikasiga o'xshash yoki 1800 va 1850 yillar oralig'ida Amerika Ittifoqining shimoliy shtatlariga o'xshash respublika edi; erkin dehqonlar respublikasi.

en: At the outset of this stage Rome was a little state scarcely twenty miles square.
uz: Bu bosqichning boshida Rim kichik davlat edi, deyarli yigirma kvadrat milya.

en: She fought the sturdy but kindred states about her, and sought not their destruction but coalescence.
uz: U o'ziga xos bo'lgan mustahkam, ammo o'ziga o'xshash davlatlarga qarshi kurashdi va ularning yo'q qilinishini emas, balki birlashuvini izladi.

en: Her cen- turies of civil dissension had trained her people in compromise and conces- sions.
uz: Uning fuqarolik e'tirozining asrlari o'z xalqini murosaga va yon berishga o'rgatgan edi.

en: Some of the defeated cities became altogether Roman with a voting share in the government, some became self-governing with the right to trade and marry in Rome; garrisons full of citizens were set up at strategic points and colonies of varied privileges founded among the freshly con- quered people.
uz: Mag'lub bo'lgan shaharlarning ba'zilari hukumatdagi ovoz berish ulushi bilan butunlay Rimga aylandi, ba'zilari Rimda savdo qilish va turmush qurish huquqiga ega bo'lgan o'zini-o'zi boshqarish huquqiga ega bo'ldi; fuqarolarga to'la garnizonlar strategik nuqtalarda va yangi so'ralgan odamlar orasida tashkil etilgan turli imtiyozlarga ega koloniyalar tashkil etildi.

en: Great roads were made.
uz: Ajoyib yo'llar qurildi.

en: The rapid Latinization of all Italy was the inevitable consequence of such a policy.
uz: Butun Italiyaning tez sur'atlar bilan lotinlashishi bunday siyosatning muqarrar oqibati edi.

en: all the free in- habitants of Italy became citizens of the city of Rome.
uz: Italiyaning barcha bepul aholisi Rim shahri fuqarolariga aylandi.

en: Formally the whole Roman Empire became at last an extended city.
uz: Rasman butun Rim imperiyasi nihoyat kengaytirilgan shaharga aylandi.

en: every free man in the entire extent of the empire was given citizenship; the right, if he could get there, to vote in the town meeting in Rome.
uz: Imperiyaning butun hududidagi har bir erkin odamga fuqarolik berildi; agar u yerga yetib olsa, Rimdagi shahar yig'ilishida ovoz berish huquqi.

en: This extension of citizenship to tractable cities and to whole countries was the distinctive device of Roman expansion.
uz: Fuqarolikning muomala qilinadigan shaharlarga va butun mamlakatlarga tarqalishi Rim kengayishining o'ziga xos usuli edi.

en: It reversed the old process of conquest and assimilation altogether.
uz: U eski bosqin va assimilyatsiya jarayonini butunlay teskari qildi.

en: By the Roman method the con- querors assimilated the conquered.
uz: Rim usuli bilan konquerlar zabt etilganlarni o'zlashtirgan.

en: THE FORUM AT ROME AS IT IS TO-DAY But after the First Punic War and the annexation of Sicily, though the old process of assimilation still went on, another process arose by its side.
uz: ROMDAGI FORUM, HOZIGI KUNDAgidek. Ammo Birinchi Pun urushidan va Sitsiliya anneksiyasidan keyin, eski assimilyatsiya jarayoni davom etayotgan bo'lsa-da, uning yonida yana bir jarayon paydo bo'ldi.

en: Sici- ly for instance was treated as a conquered prey.
uz: Sici-ly, masalan, zabt etilgan o'lja sifatida qaralgan.

en: It was declared an “estate” of the Roman people.
uz: U Rim xalqining mulki deb e'lon qilindi.

en: Its rich soil and industrious population was exploited to make Rome rich.
uz: Uning boy tuprog'i va ishbilarmon aholisi Rimni boy qilish uchun ekspluatatsiya qilindi.

en: The patricians and the more inﬂuential among the ple- beians secured the major share of that wealth.
uz: Patritsiyaliklar va plebeylar orasida eng nufuzli bo'lganlar o'sha boylikning asosiy qismini ta'minladilar.

en: And the war also brought in a large supply of slaves.
uz: Va urush ham katta miqdorda qullarni olib keldi.

en: Before the First Punic War the population of the re- public had been largely a population of citizen farmers.
uz: Birinchi Pun urushidan oldin qayta xalq aholisi asosan fuqaro dehqonlar aholisi edi.

en: Military service was their privilege and liability.
uz: Harbiy xizmat ularning imtiyozi va mas'uliyati edi.

en: While they were on active service their farms fell into debt and a new large-scale slave agriculture grew up; when they returned they found their produce in competition with slave-grown produce from Sicily and from the new estates at home.
uz: Ular faol xizmatda bo'lganlarida, ularning fermer xo'jaliklari qarzga botdi va yangi yirik qul dehqonchiligi paydo bo'ldi; qaytib kelganlarida, ular o'z mahsulotlarini Sitsiliyadan va o'zlarining yangi mulklaridan qullar tomonidan yetishtirilgan mahsulotlar bilan raqobatlashayotganini topdilar.

en: The re- public had altered its character.
uz: Jamoatchilik o'z xarakterini o'zgartirdi.

en: Not only was Sicily in the hands of Rome, the common man was in the hands of the rich creditor and the rich competi- tor.
uz: Nafaqat Sitsiliya Rim qo'lida edi, oddiy odam boy kreditorlar va boy raqobatchilar qo'lida edi.

en: Rome had entered upon its second stage, the Republic of Adventurous Rich Men.
uz: Rim o'zining ikkinchi bosqichiga, Sarguzashtparast Boy Erkaklar Respublikasiga kirdi.

en: For two hundred years the Roman soldier farmers had struggled for free- dom and a share in the government of their state; for a hundred years they had enjoyed their privileges.
uz: Ikki yuz yil davomida Rim askar dehqonlari ozodlik va o'z davlat hukumatida ulush olish uchun kurashdilar; yuz yil davomida ular o'z imtiyozlaridan bahramand bo'lishdi.

en: The First Punic War wasted them and robbed them of all they had won.
uz: Birinchi Pun urushi ularni behudaga sarfladi va yutgan barcha narsalaridan mahrum qildi.

en: RELICS OF ROMAN RULE  Ruins of Coliseum in Tunis  Photo: Jacques Boyer The value of their electoral privileges had also evaporated.
uz: RIM HUKMATI RELICS Tunisdagi muzey xarobalari Surat: Jak Boyer Ularning saylov imtiyozlari qiymati ham bug'lanib ketgan edi.

en: The govern- ing bodies of the Roman republic were two in number.
uz: Rim respublikasining boshqaruv organlari soni ikki kishi edi.

en: The ﬁrst and more important was the Senate.
uz: Birinchi va eng muhimi Senat edi.

en: This was a body originally of patricians and then of prominent men of all sorts, who were summoned to it ﬁrst by certain powerful ofﬁcials, the consuls and censors.
uz: Bu dastlab vatanparvarlar, keyin esa har xil nufuzli odamlardan iborat guruh edi, ular avval ba'zi qudratli amaldorlar, konsullar va senzorlar tomonidan chaqirilgan edi.

en: Like the British House of Lords it became a gathering of great landowners, prominent politicians, big busi- ness men and the like.
uz: Britaniya Lordlar palatasi kabi, u ham buyuk yer egalari, taniqli siyosatchilar, yirik biznesmenlar va shunga o'xshashlarning yig'ilishiga aylandi.

en: It was much more like the British House of Lords than it was like the American Senate.
uz: Bu Britaniya Lordlar palatasiga Amerika Senatiga o'xshab ketgandan ko'ra ancha ko'proq o'xshardi.

en: For three centuries, from the Punic Wars onward, it was the centre of Roman political thought and purpose.
uz: Uch asr davomida, Pun urushlaridan boshlab, u Rim siyosiy tafakkuri va maqsadi markazi edi.

en: The second body was the Popular Assembly.
uz: Ikkinchi organ Xalq Assambleyasi edi.

en: This was supposed to be an assem-
uz: Bu assem- bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: bly of all the citizens of Rome.
uz: Rimning barcha fuqarolaridan xursandman.

en: When Rome was a little state twenty miles square this was a possible gathering.
uz: Rim kichik davlat bo'lganida, yigirma kvadrat milya maydonga ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan yig'ilish edi.

en: When the citizenship of Rome had spread beyond the conﬁnes in Italy, it was an altogether impossible one.
uz: Rim fuqaroligi Italiyadagi hududlardan tashqariga tarqalganida, bu mutlaqo imkonsiz edi.

en: Its meetings, proclaimed by horn-blowing from the Capitol and the city walls, became more and more a gathering of political hacks and city riff-raff.
uz: Uning uchrashuvlari, Kapitoliy va shahar devorlaridan karnay chalish orqali e'lon qilingan, tobora ko'proq siyosiy xakerlar va shahar rifflarining yig'ilishiga aylandi.

en: In the fourth century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi to'rtinchi asrda.

en: the Popular Assembly was a considerable check upon the Senate, a competent representation of the claims and rights of the com- mon man.
uz: Xalq Assambleyasi Senat ustidan sezilarli nazorat o'tkazdi, u kom-manning da'volari va huquqlarini vakolatli vakillik qilardi.

en: By the end of the Punic Wars it was an impotent relic of a van- quished popular control.
uz: Pun urushlarining oxiriga kelib, u vayron qilingan xalq boshqaruvining ojiz qoldig'i edi.

en: No effectual legal check remained upon the big men.
uz: Katta odamlarga hech qanday samarali qonuniy nazorat qolmadi.

en: THE GREAT ROMAN ARCH AT CTESIPHON NEAR BAGDAD Nothing of the nature of representative government was ever introduced into the Roman republic.
uz: BUYUK RIM ARCHASI BAGDAD YaQINIDAGI CTESIPHONDA Vakolatli hukumat tabiatiga ega hech narsa Rim respublikasiga hech qachon kiritilmagan.

en: No one thought of electing delegates to represent the will of the citizens.
uz: Hech kim fuqarolarning irodasini ifoda etish uchun delegatlarni saylash haqida o'ylamadi.

en: This is a very important point for the student to grasp.
uz: Bu o'quvchi tushunishi uchun juda muhim nuqta.

en: The Popular Assembly never became the equivalent of the American House of Representatives or the British House of Commons.
uz: Xalq Assambleyasi hech qachon Amerika Vakillar Palatasi yoki Britaniya Umumiy Palatasiga teng kelmadi.

en: In theory it was all the citizens; in practice it ceased to be anything at all worth consideration.
uz: Nazariy jihatdan bu barcha fuqarolar edi; amalda bu umuman e'tiborga arziydigan narsa bo'lishdan to'xtadi.

en: The common citizen of the Roman Empire was therefore in a very poor case after the Second Punic War; he was impoverished, he had often lost his farm, he was ousted from proﬁtable production by slaves, and he had no po- litical power left to him to remedy these things.
uz: Rim imperiyasining oddiy fuqarosi Ikkinchi Pun urushidan keyin juda yomon ahvolda edi; u qashshoq edi, u ko'pincha fermasini yo'qotgan edi, qullar tomonidan foydali ishlab chiqarishdan haydalgan edi va bu narsalarni bartaraf etish uchun unga siyosiy kuch qolmagan edi.

en: The only methods of popu- lar expression left to a people without any form of political expression are the strike and the revolt.
uz: Siyosiy ifodasiz xalqqa qoldirilgan yagona xalq ifodasi usullari - ish tashlash va isyon.

en: The story of the second and ﬁrst centuries B.C., so far as internal politics go, is a story of futile revolutionary upheaval.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi ikkinchi va birinchi asrlar haqidagi hikoya, ichki siyosatga kelsak, behuda inqilobiy to'ntarish haqidagi hikoyadir.

en: The scale of this history will not permit us to tell of the intricate struggles of that time, of the attempts to break up estates and restore the land to the free farmer, of proposals to abolish debts in whole or in part.
uz: Bu tarixning ko'lami o'sha davrdagi murakkab kurashlar, mulklarni bo'lish va yerni erkin dehqonga qaytarishga urinishlar, qarzlarni butunlay yoki qisman bekor qilish takliflari haqida gapirishga imkon bermaydi.

en: There was revolt and civil war.
uz: Isyon va fuqarolar urushi bo'ldi.

en: In 73 B.C., the distresses of Italy were enhanced by a great in- surrection, of the slaves under Spartacus.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 73-yilda Italiyaning azob-uqubatlari Spartak boshchiligidagi qullarning katta surrexiyasi bilan kuchaytirildi.

en: The slaves of Italy revolted with some effect, for among them were the trained ﬁghters of the gladiatorial shows.
uz: Italiya qullari ma'lum bir ta'sir bilan isyon ko'tardilar, chunki ularning orasida gladiatorlik shoularidagi tayyorgarlik ko'rgan jangchilar ham bor edi.

en: For two years Spartacus held out in the crater of Vesuvius, which seemed at that time to be an extinct volcano.
uz: Ikki yil davomida Spartak Vesuviy kraterida saqlandi, u o'sha paytda yo'q bo'lib ketgan vulqon kabi tuyulgan edi.

en: This insurrection was defeated at last and suppressed with frantic cruelty.
uz: Bu qo'zg'olon oxir-oqibat mag'lub etildi va g'azablangan shafqatsizlik bilan bostirildi.

en: Six thousand captured Spartacists were cruciﬁed along the Appian Way, the great highway that runs south- ward out of Rome (71 B.C.).
uz: Olti ming asirga olingan Spartaxist Appiyo yo'li bo'ylab xochga mixlandi, bu Rimdan janubiy qismida joylashgan buyuk avtomagistral bo'lib, miloddan avvalgi 71 yilda xochga mixlandi.

en: The common man never made head against the forces that were subjugat- ing and degrading him.
uz: Oddiy odam hech qachon uni bo'ysundirayotgan va qadrsizlantiruvchi kuchlarga qarshi turmagan.

en: But the big rich men who were overcoming him were even in his defeat preparing a new power in the Roman world over themselves and him, the power of the army.
uz: Ammo uni yengayotgan katta boylar hatto uning mag'lubiyatida ham Rim olamida o'zlari va unga qarshi yangi kuch, armiya kuchini tayyorlayotgan edilar.

en: Before the Second Punic War the army of Rome was a levy of free farm- ers, who, according to their quality, rode or marched afoot to battle.
uz: Ikkinchi Poniy urushigacha Rim armiyasi erkin dehqonlardan iborat bo'lib, ular o'z sifatlariga ko'ra jangga otda yoki yurishardi.

en: This was a very good force for wars close at hand, but not the sort of army that will go abroad and bear long campaigns with patience.
uz: Bu yaqinlashib kelayotgan urushlar uchun juda yaxshi kuch edi, lekin chet elga chiqib, uzoq kampaniyalarni sabr bilan o'tkazadigan armiya emas edi.

en: And moreover as the slaves multiplied and the estates grew, the supply of free- spirited ﬁghting farmers declined.
uz: Qolaversa, qullar ko'payib, mulklar o'sib borar ekan, erkin ruhdagi jangchi dehqonlarning ta'minoti kamaydi.

en: It was a popular leader named Marius who introduced a new factor.
uz: Marius ismli mashhur yetakchi yangi omilni joriy etgan edi.

en: North Africa after the overthrow of the Carthaginian civilization had become a semi-barbaric kingdom, the kingdom of Numidia.
uz: Karfagiy sivilizatsiyasi ag'darilganidan so'ng Shimoliy Afrika yarim vahshiy qirollikka, Numidiya qirolligiga aylandi.

en: The Ro- man power fell into conﬂict with Jugurtha, king of this state, and experi- enced enormous difﬁculties in subduing him.
uz: Ro-man hokimiyati ushbu davlatning shohi Yugurta bilan ziddiyatga tushdi va uni bo'ysundirishda ulkan qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi.

en: Marius was made consul, in a phase of public indignation, to end this discreditable war.
uz: Marius jamoatchilikning noroziligi davrida bu obro'siz urushni tugatish uchun konsul etib tayinlandi.

en: This he did by raising paid troops and drilling them hard.
uz: U buni pullik askarlarni yig'ish va ularni qattiq burg'ulash orqali qildi.

en: Jugurtha was brought in chains to Rome (106 B.C.) and Marius, when his time of ofﬁce had expired, held on
uz: Jugurtha Rimga zanjirlar bilan olib kelingan (miloddan avvalgi 106 yil), Marius esa uning lavozim muddati tugagandan so'ng, ushlab turildi.

en: to his consulship illegally with his newly created legions.
uz: o'zining yangi yaratilgan legionlari bilan noqonuniy ravishda konsullik qilish uchun.

en: There was no power in Rome to restrain him.
uz: Rimda uni ushlab turadigan kuch yo'q edi.

en: With Marius began the third phase in the development of the Roman power, the Republic of the Military Commanders.
uz: Marius bilan Rim qudratining rivojlanishidagi uchinchi bosqich, Harbiy Qo'mondonlar Respublikasi boshlandi.

en: For now began a period in which the leaders of the paid legions fought for the mastery of the Ro- man world.
uz: Hozircha pullik legionlar rahbarlari Rim dunyosini egallash uchun kurashadigan davr boshlandi.

en: Against Marius was pitted the aristocratic Sulla who had served under him in Africa.
uz: Mariusga qarshi Afrikada uning qo'l ostida xizmat qilgan aristokrat Sulla turardi.

en: Each in turn made a great massacre of his political op- ponents.
uz: Har biri o'z siyosiy raqiblariga katta qirg'in qildi.

en: Men were proscribed and executed by the thousand, and their es- tates were sold.
uz: Erkaklar minglab tomonidan taqiqlandi va qatl etildi, ularning es-tatolari esa sotildi.

en: After the bloody rivalry of these two and the horror of the revolt of Spartacus, came a phase in which Lucullus and Pompey the Great and Crassus and Julius Cæsar were the masters of armies and dominated affairs.
uz: Bu ikki kishining qonli raqibligidan va Spartak isyonining dahshatidan so'ng, Lyukullus va Pompey Buyuk, Krass va Yulius Cæsar armiyalarning xo'jayinlari va ishlarda hukmronlik qiladigan bosqich keldi.

en: It was Crassus who defeated Spartacus.
uz: Spartakni aynan Krass mag'lub etdi.

en: Lucullus conquered Asia Minor and penetrated to Armenia, and retired with great wealth into private life.
uz: Lyukul Kichik Osiyoni zabt etdi va Armanistonga kirib keldi va katta boylik bilan shaxsiy hayotga nafaqaga chiqdi.

en: Crassus thrusting further invaded Persia and was defeated and slain by the Parthians.
uz: Krass Forsga yanada hujum qildi va partiyaliklar tomonidan mag'lub etildi va o'ldirildi.

en: After a long rivalry Pompey was defeated by Julius Cæsar (48 B.C.) and murdered in Egypt, leaving Julius Cæsar sole master of the Roman world.
uz: Uzoq raqobatdan so'ng Pompey Yuliy Sezar tomonidan (48 miloddan avvalgi) mag'lub etildi va Misrda o'ldirildi, bu Yuliy Sezarni Rim olamining yagona xo'jayiniga aylantirdi.

en: The ﬁgure of Julius Cæsar is one that has stirred the human imagination out of all proportion to its merit or true importance.
uz: Yuliy Cæsar siymosi inson tasavvurini uning merosi yoki haqiqiy ahamiyatiga mutanosiblikdan chetga chiqarib yuborgan siymodir.

en: He has become a legend and a symbol.
uz: U afsonaga va ramzga aylandi.

en: For us he is chieﬂy important as marking the transition from the phase of military adventurers to the beginning of the fourth stage in Ro- man expansion, the Early Empire.
uz: U biz uchun asosan harbiy sarguzashtchilarning bosqichidan to'rtinchi bosqichning boshiga, Ro-man kengayishining, Erta Imperiyaning o'tishini belgilash kabi muhimdir.

en: For in spite of the profoundest economic and political convulsions, in spite of civil war and social degeneration, throughout all this time the boundaries of the Roman state crept outward and continued to creep outward to their maximum about 100 A.D.
uz: Chunki eng chuqur iqtisodiy va siyosiy to'lqinlarga qaramay, fuqarolar urushi va ijtimoiy parchalanishga qaramay, butun shu vaqt davomida Rim davlati chegaralari tashqariga kirib bordi va taxminan milodiy 100 yilgacha maksimal darajagacha tashqariga kirib borishda davom etdi.

en: There had been something like an ebb during the doubtful phases of the Second Punic War, and again a manifest loss of vigour before the reconstruction of the army by Marius.
uz: Ikkinchi Pun urushining shubhali bosqichlarida biroz pasayish va yana Marius tomonidan armiyani qayta tiklashdan oldin kuchning ochiq yo'qolishi bo'lgan edi.

en: The revolt of Spartacus marked a third phase.
uz: Spartakning isyoni uchinchi bosqichni belgiladi.

en: Julius Cæsar made his reputation as a military leader in Gaul, which is now France and Belgium.
uz: Yuliy Sezar hozirgi Fransiya va Belgiya bo'lgan Gollistonda harbiy yetakchi sifatida obro' qozongan.

en: (The chief tribes inhabiting this country belonged to the same Celtic people as the Gauls who had occupied north Italy for a time, and who had afterwards raided into Asia Minor and settled down as the Galatians.) Cæsar drove back a German invasion of Gaul and added all that country to the empire, and he twice crossed the Straits of Dover into Britain (55 and 54 B.C.), where however he made no permanent conquest.
uz: Bu mamlakatda yashovchi bosh qabilalar bir vaqtlar shimoliy Italiyani bosib olgan va keyinchalik Kichik Osiyoga bostirib kirib, Galatiyaliklar kabi joylashgan gallar kabi kelt xalqlariga tegishli edi. Kesar Gaulga Germaniyaning bostirib kirishini qaytardi va butun mamlakatni imperiyaga qo'shdi va u ikki marta Dovr bo'g'ozlaridan Britaniyaga (miloddan avvalgi 55 va 54 yillarda) o'tdi, ammo u yerda doimiy bosib olishni amalga oshirmadi.

en: the Great was consolidating Roman conquests that reached in the east to the Caspian Sea.
uz: Buyuk Rim Sharqda Kaspiy dengizigacha yetib borgan bosqinlarni mustahkamlamoqda edi.

en: THE COLUMN OF TRAJAN AT ROME  Representing his conquests at Dacia and elsewhere At this time, the middle of the ﬁrst century B.C., the Roman Senate was still the nominal centre of the Roman government, appointing consuls and other ofﬁcials, granting powers and the like; and a number of politicians, among whom Cicero was an outstanding ﬁgure, were struggling to preserve the great traditions of republican Rome and to maintain respect for its laws.
uz: Rimdagi TRAJAN ustuni Dakiyada va boshqa joylarda o'z zabtlarini ifodalab, Miloddan avvalgi birinchi asrning o'rtalarida Rim Senati Rim hukumatining nominal markazi bo'lib, konsullar va boshqa amaldorlarni tayinlardi, vakolatlar berardi va shunga o'xshashlarni; va bir qator siyosatchilar, jumladan Sitseron ham taniqli shaxs edi, respublikachi Rimning buyuk an'analarini saqlab qolish va uning qonunlariga hurmatni saqlab qolish uchun kurashardi.

en: But the spirit of citizenship had gone from Italy with the wasting away of the free farmers; it was a land now of slaves and impoverished men with neither the understanding nor the desire for freedom.
uz: Lekin fuqarolik ruhi Italiyadan erkin dehqonlarning isrof bo'lishi bilan ketgan edi; u endi qullar va kambag'al odamlarning zamini edi, na tushunchaga ega, na ozodlikka intilishga ega edi.

en: There was nothing whatever behind these republican leaders in the Senate, while behind the great adventurers they feared and desired to control were the legions.
uz: Senatda bu respublikachi rahbarlarning ortida hech narsa yo'q edi, ular qo'rqqan va nazorat qilishni istagan buyuk sarguzashtchilar ortida esa legionlar bor edi.

en: Over the heads of the Senate Crassus and Pompey and Cæsar divided the rule of the Empire between them (The First Triumvirate).
uz: Senat boshliqlari Krass, Pomfey va Sezar o'rtasida Imperiyaning hukmronligini (Birinchi Uchlik) bo'lishdi.

en: When presently Crassus
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda Krass

en: was killed at distant Carrhæ by the Parthians, Pompey and Cæsar fell out.
uz: Uzoq Carrhæda Parfiyaliklar tomonidan o'ldirilgan, Pompey va Sezar qulab tushdi.

en: Pompey took up the republican side, and laws were passed to bring Cæsar to trial for his breaches of law and his disobedience to the decrees of the Senate.
uz: Pompey respublikachi tomonni oldi va Sezarni qonunbuzarliklari va Senat qarorlariga itoatsizligi uchun sudga berish uchun qonunlar qabul qilindi.

en: It was illegal for a general to bring his troops out of the boundary of his command, and the boundary between Cæsar’s command and Italy was the Rubicon.
uz: General uchun o'z qo'shinlarini qo'mondonligi hududidan tashqariga olib chiqish noqonuniy edi va Cæsar qo'mondonligi va Italiya o'rtasidagi chegara Rubikondir.

en: he crossed the Rubicon, saying “The die is cast” and marched upon Pompey and Rome.
uz: U Rubikonni kesib o'tib, O'yin tashlandi dedi va Pompey va Rimga yurdi.

en: It had been the custom in Rome in the past, in periods of military extrem- ity, to elect a “dictator” with practically unlimited powers to rule through the crisis.
uz: Rimda o'tmishda, harbiy ekstremizm davrlarida, inqirozdan o'tish uchun deyarli cheksiz vakolatlarga ega bo'lgan diktatorni saylash odatiy holdir edi.

en: After his overthrow of Pompey, Cæsar was made dictator ﬁrst for ten years and then (in 45 B.C.) for life.
uz: Pompeyni ag'dargandan so'ng, Sezar avval o'n yilga, keyin esa (miloddan avvalgi 45-yilda) umrbod diktator etib tayinlandi.

en: In effect he was made monarch of the empire for life.
uz: Aslida u butun umrga imperiyaning monarxi etib tayinlandi.

en: There was talk of a king, a word abhorrent to Rome since the expulsion of the Etruscans ﬁve centuries before.
uz: Rim uchun besh asr oldin etrusklarning quvilishidan beri jirkanch so'z bo'lgan bir shoh haqida gapirardi.

en: Cæsar refused to be king, but adopted throne and sceptre.
uz: Sezar shoh bo'lishdan bosh tortdi, lekin taxt va tojni qabul qildi.

en: After his defeat of Pompey, Cæsar had gone on into Egypt and had made love to Cleopatra, the last of the Ptolemies, the goddess queen of Egypt.
uz: Sezar Pompeydan mag'lub bo'lgandan so'ng Misrga bordi va Ptolemeylarning oxirgisi, Misr ma'budasi Kleopatra bilan sevib qoldi.

en: She seems to have turned his head very completely.
uz: U uning boshini juda butunlay burib yuborgan ko'rinadi.

en: He had brought back to Rome the Egyptian idea of a god- king.
uz: U Rimga xudo-qirol haqidagi Misr g'oyasini qaytarib olib kelgan edi.

en: His statue was set up in a temple with an inscription “To the Uncon- querable God.” The expiring republicanism of Rome ﬂared up in a last protest, and Cæsar was stabbed to death in the Senate at the foot of the stat- ue of his murdered rival, Pompey the Great.
uz: Uning haykali Tanilmas Xudoga yozuvi tushirilgan ibodatxonada o'rnatildi. Rimning o'chayotgan respublikachiligi oxirgi norozilikda alanga oldi va Cæsar o'ldirilgan raqibi Pompey Buyukning poydevori ostida Senatda pichoqlab o'ldirildi.

en: Thirteen years more of this conﬂict of ambitious personalities followed.
uz: Bundan keyin ambitsiyali shaxslar to'qnashuvining o'n uch yilligi davom etdi.

en: There was a second Triumvirate of Lepidus, Mark Antony and Octavian Cæsar, the latter the nephew of Julius Cæsar.
uz: Lepidning ikkinchi Triumvirati bor edi, Mark Antoniy va Oktavian Cæsar, ikkinchisi Yuliy Cæsarning jiyani edi.

en: Octavian like his uncle took the poorer, hardier western provinces where the best legions were recruited.
uz: Oktavian, amakisi kabi, eng yaxshi legionlar jalb qilinadigan kambag'alroq, dadilroq g'arbiy viloyatlarni oldi.

en: In 31 B.C., he defeated Mark Antony, his only serious rival, at the naval bat- tle of Actium, and made himself sole master of the Roman world.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi 31 yilda u Aktium dengiz jangida o'zining yagona jiddiy raqibi Mark Antoniyni mag'lub etdi va o'zini Rim olamining yagona xo'jayini qildi.

en: But Octa- vian was a man of different quality altogether from Julius Cæsar.
uz: Lekin Octa-viyan Yuliy Cæsardan butunlay boshqa sifatga ega odam edi.

en: He had no foolish craving to be God or King.
uz: Uning Xudo yoki Shoh bo'lishga bo'lgan ahmoqona ishtiyoqi yo'q edi.

en: He had no queen-lover that he wished to dazzle.
uz: Uning ko'zini qamashtirmoqchi bo'lgan hech qanday malika-seviklisi yo'q edi.

en: He restored freedom to the Senate and people of Rome.
uz: U Rim Senatiga va xalqiga ozodlikni tikladi.

en: He declined to be dictator.
uz: U diktator bo'lishdan bosh tortdi.

en: The grateful Senate in return gave him the reality instead of the forms of power.
uz: Shukrli Senat evaziga unga hokimiyat shakllari o'rniga haqiqatni berdi.

en: He was to be called not King indeed, but “Princeps” and “Augustus.” He became Augustus Cæsar, the ﬁrst of the Roman emper- ors (27 B.C.
uz: U haqiqatan ham Qirol deb atalmasligi kerak edi, balki Princeps va Augustus deb atalishi kerak edi. U Avgust Cæsarga aylandi, Rim imperatorining birinchisi (27 miloddan avvalgi).

en: He was followed by Tiberius Cæsar (14 to 37 A.D.) and he by others, Caligula, Claudius, Nero and so on up to Trajan (98 A.D.), Hadrian (117 A.D.), Antonius Pius (138 A.D.) and Marcus Aurelius (161- 180 A.D.).
uz: Undan keyin Tiberius Cæsar (milodiy 14 dan 37 yilgacha) va undan keyin boshqalar, Kaligula, Klaudiy, Nero va shunga o'xshashlar Trajan (milodiy 98), Hadrian (117 yil), Antonius Pius (138 yil) va Mark Aurelius (161 - 180 yil)gacha davom etdi.

en: All these emperors were emperors of the legions.
uz: Bu imperatorlarning barchasi legion imperatorlari edi.

en: The soldiers made them, and some the soldiers destroyed.
uz: Askarlar ularni yasashdi va ba'zi askarlar ularni yo'q qilishdi.

en: Gradually the Senate fades out of Roman-his- tory, and the emperor and his administrative ofﬁcials replace it.
uz: Sekin-asta Senat Rim hukmronligidan yo'qoladi va imperator va uning ma'muriy amaldorlari uni almashtiradi.

en: The bound- aries of the empire crept forward now to their utmost limits.
uz: Imperiyaning chegaralari endi o'zlarining eng chekka chegaralariga qadar sudralib bordi.

en: Most of Britain was added to the empire, Transylvania was brought in as a new province, Dacia; Trajan crossed the Euphrates.
uz: Britaniya imperiyasining ko'p qismi qo'shildi, Transilvaniya yangi viloyat, Dakiya sifatida olib kirildi; Trajan Furot daryosini kesib o'tdi.

en: Hadrian had an idea that reminds us at once of what had happened at the other end of the old world.
uz: Hadrianning bir g'oyasi bor edi, u bizga eski dunyoning narigi chekkasida nima bo'lganini darhol eslatib turadi.

en: Like Shi- Hwang-ti he built walls against the northern barbarians; one across Britain and a palisade between the Rhine and the Danube.
uz: Shi- Hwang-ti kabi u shimoliy varvarlarga qarshi devorlar qurdi; biri Buyuk Britaniya orqali va Reyn va Dunay o'rtasidagi palisada.

en: He abandoned some of the acquisitions of Trajan.
uz: U Trajanning ba'zi sotib olishlaridan voz kechdi.

en: The expansion of the Roman Empire was at an end.
uz: Rim imperiyasining kengayishi nihoyasiga yetdi.

en: XXXIV BETWEEN ROME AND CHINA The second and ﬁrst centuries B.C.
uz: XXXIV RIM VA XITOY O'rtasida Miloddan avvalgi ikkinchi va birinchi asrlar.

en: mark a new phase in the history of mankind.
uz: Insoniyat tarixida yangi bosqichni belgilaydi.

en: Mesopotamia and the eastern Mediterranean are no longer the centre of interest.
uz: Mesopotamiya va Sharqiy O'rta yer dengizi endi qiziqish markazida emas.

en: Both Mesopotamia and Egypt were still fertile, populous and fairly prosperous, but they were no longer the dominant regions of the world.
uz: Mesopotamiya ham, Misr ham hali unumdor, gavjum va ancha farovon edi, lekin ular dunyoning hukmron hududlari emas edi.

en: Power had drifted to the west and to the east.
uz: Quvvat g'arbga va sharqqa qarab siljigan edi.

en: Two great empires now dominated the world, this new Roman Empire and the renascent Empire of China.
uz: Hozirda dunyoda ikkita buyuk imperiya hukmronlik qildi: bu yangi Rim imperiyasi va qayta tiklangan Xitoy imperiyasi.

en: Rome extended its power to the Euphrates, but it was never able to get beyond that boundary.
uz: Rim o'z qudratini Furot daryosigacha cho'zdi, lekin hech qachon bu chegaradan o'ta olmadi.

en: Beyond the Euphrates the for- mer Persian and Indian dominions of the Seleucids fell under a number of new masters.
uz: Furot daryosidan narida Seleviklarning Fors va Hind hukmdorliklari bir qator yangi ustozlar qo'liga o'tdi.

en: China, now under the Han dynasty, which had replaced the Ts’in dynasty at the death of Shi-Hwang-ti, had extended its power across Tibet and over the high mountain passes of the Pamirs into western Turkestan.
uz: Xitoy, hozirda Xan sulolasi ostida bo'lib, Shi-Hwang-ti vafotidan keyin Tsin sulolasini almashtirgan Xitoy, o'z kuchini Tibet bo'ylab va Pamir tog'larining baland o'tish joylari bo'ylab G'arbiy Turkistongacha cho'zgan edi.

en: But there, too, it reached its extremes.
uz: Ammo u yerda ham o'z chekkalariga yetdi.

en: China at this time was the greatest, best organized and most civilized po- litical system in the world.
uz: O'sha paytda Xitoy dunyodagi eng buyuk, eng yaxshi tashkil etilgan va eng madaniy siyosiy tizim edi.

en: It was superior in area and population to the Ro- man Empire at its zenith.
uz: U o'zining eng yuqori cho'qqisida Roman imperiyasidan maydoni va aholisi jihatidan ustun edi.

en: It was possible then for these two vast systems to ﬂourish in the same world at the same time in almost complete ignorance of each other.
uz: O'shanda bu ikki ulkan tizim bir vaqtning o'zida bir-birini deyarli to'liq bilmaslikda bir dunyoda gullab-yashnashi mumkin edi.

en: The means of communication both by sea and land was not yet sufﬁciently developed and organized for them to come to a direct clash.
uz: Dengiz orqali ham, quruqlik orqali ham aloqa vositalari yetarli darajada rivojlanmagan va ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'qnashuvga olib kelishi uchun tashkil etilgan emas edi.

en: Yet they reacted upon each other in a very remarkable way, and their in- ﬂuence upon the fate of the regions that lay between them, upon central Asia and India, was profound.
uz: Shunga qaramay, ular bir-biriga juda ajoyib tarzda munosabatda bo'lishdi va ularning o'rtasida joylashgan mintaqalar, markaziy Osiyo va Hindiston taqdiriga ta'siri chuqur edi.

en: A certain amount of trade trickled through, by camel caravans across Persia, for example, and by coasting ships by way of India and the Red Sea.
uz: Ma'lum miqdordagi savdo, masalan, Persiya bo'ylab tuya karvonlari orqali va Hindiston va Qizil dengiz orqali qirg'oq kemalari orqali oqib o'tdi.

en: Roman troops under Pompey followed
uz: Rim qo'shinlari Pompeyning qo'l ostida ketishdi.

en: in the footsteps of Alexander the Great, and marched up the eastern shores of the Caspian Sea.
uz: Aleksandr Buyukning izidan yurib, Kaspiy dengizining sharqiy qirg'oqlariga yurdi.

en: a Chinese expeditionary force under Pan Chau reached the Caspian, and sent emissaries to report upon the power of Rome.
uz: Pan Chauning boshchiligidagi Xitoy ekspeditsion kuchlari Kaspiy dengiziga yetib bordi va Rim qudrati haqida xabar berish uchun elchilar yubordi.

en: But many centuries were still to pass before deﬁnite knowledge and direct intercourse were to link the great parallel worlds of Europe and East- ern Asia.
uz: Lekin aniq bilim va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aloqa Yevropa va Sharqiy Osiyodagi buyuk parallel olamlarni bog'lashidan oldin hali ko'p asrlar o'tishi kerak edi.

en: To the north of both these great empires were barbaric wildernesses.
uz: Bu ikki buyuk imperiyaning shimolida vahshiy cho'llar bor edi.

en: What is now Germany was largely forest lands; the forests extended far into Russia and made a home for the gigantic aurochs, a bull of almost elephan- tine size.
uz: Hozirgi Germaniya asosan o'rmon yerlari edi; o'rmonlar Rossiyaga qadar cho'zilgan va deyarli fil o'lchamidagi ulkan avroxlar uchun uy yaratgan.

en: Then to the north of the great mountain masses of Asia stretched a band of deserts, steppes and then forests and frozen lands.
uz: Osiyodagi ulkan tog' massalarining shimoliga cho'llar, dashtlar, so'ngra o'rmonlar va muzlagan yerlar tarqaldi.

en: In the eastward lap of the elevated part of Asia was the great triangle of Manchuria.
uz: Osiyoning baland qismining sharqiy burchagida Manjuriya buyuk uchburchagi bor edi.

en: Large parts of these regions, stretching between South Russia and Turkestan into Manchuria, were and are regions of exceptional climatic insecurity.
uz: Ushbu mintaqalarning katta qismlari, Janubiy Rossiya va Turkiston o'rtasida Manchuriyaga cho'zilgan, favqulodda iqlimsizlikka duchor bo'lgan hududlar edi va bo'lib qolmoqda.

en: Their rainfall has varied greatly in the course of a few centuries They are lands treacherous to man.
uz: Ularning yog'ingarchiligi bir necha asr davomida sezilarli darajada o'zgargan. Ular insoniyat uchun xavfli yerlardir.

en: For years they will carry pasture and sustain cultiva- tion, and then will come an age of decline in humidity and a cycle of killing droughts.
uz: Yillar davomida ular yaylov olib yurishadi va dehqonchilikni ta'minlaydilar, keyin namlikning pasayishi davri va qurg'oqchilikning o'lim davri keladi.

en: A CHINESE COVERED JAR OF GREEN-GLAZED EARTHENWARE Han Dynasty (contemporary with the late Roman republic and early Empire)  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) The western part of this barbaric north from the German forests to South Russia and Turkestan and from Gothland to the Alps was the region of ori- gin of the Nordic peoples and of the Aryan speech.
uz: Xitoyning Yashil shisha bilan qoplangan Yer qoplamasi (Xan sulolasi) (keyinki Rim respublikasi va erta imperiyasi bilan hammuvofiq) (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) Ushbu vahshiy shimolning g'arbiy qismi, Germaniya o'rmonlaridan Janubiy Rossiya va Turkistongacha va Gotlanddan Alp tog'larigacha, Shimoliy xalqlarining ori-gin hududi va Aryan nutqi edi.

en: The eastern steppes and
uz: Sharqiy dashtlar va

en: deserts of Mongolia was the region of origin of the Hunnish or Mongolian or Tartar or Turkish peoples—for all these several peoples were akin in lan- guage, race, and way of life.
uz: Moʻgʻuliston choʻllari Gʻunlar yoki moʻgʻullar yoki Tartarlar yoki turk xalqlarining kelib chiqish hududi edi  chunki bu bir nechta xalqlarning barchasi lan-guage, irq va turmush tarzi boʻyicha oʻxshash edi.

en: And as the Nordic peoples seem to have been continually overﬂowing their own borders and pressing south upon the de- veloping civilizations of Mesopotamia and the Mediterranean coast, so the Hunnish tribes sent their surplus as wanderers, raiders and conquerors into the settled regions of China.
uz: Shimoliy xalqlar o'z chegaralarini doimiy ravishda to'kib, Mesopotamiya va O'rta yer dengizi sohilidagi de-veloping sivilizatsiyalariga janubga bosim o'tkazayotgandek tuyulsa, gunn qabilalari ham o'zlarining ortiqcha qismlarini Xitoyning o'troq hududlariga ko'chmanchilar, tajovuzchilar va bosqinchilar sifatida jo'natishdi.

en: Periods of plenty in the north would mean an increase in population there; a shortage of grass, a spell of cattle disease, would drive the hungry warlike tribesmen south.
uz: Shimolda mo'l-ko'l davrlar u yerda aholi sonining ko'payishini anglatadi; o't yetishmasligi, chorva mollari kasalligining sehridir, och urushqoq qabilalarni janubga haydab chiqaradi.

en: For a time there were simultaneously two fairly effective Empires in the world capable of holding back the barbarians and even forcing forward the frontiers of the imperial peace.
uz: Bir vaqtlar dunyoda bir vaqtning o'zida vahshiylarni ushlab turishga va hatto imperatorlik tinchligining chegaralarini oldinga siljitishga qodir bo'lgan ikki ancha samarali imperiya mavjud edi.

en: The thrust of the Han empire from north China into Mongolia was strong and continuous.
uz: Xitoy shimolidan Moʻgʻulistonga Xan imperiyasining surishi kuchli va uzluksiz edi.

en: The Chinese population welled up over the barrier of the Great Wall.
uz: Xitoy aholisi Buyuk Devor to'sig'idan o'tib ketdi.

en: Behind the imperial frontier guards came the Chinese farmer with horse and plough, ploughing up the grass lands and enclosing the winter pasture.
uz: Imperatorlik chegara qo'riqchilari orqasidan ot va plug bilan kelgan xitoylik fermer o'tloq yerlarni haydab, qishki yaylovni o'rab oldi.

en: The Hunnish peoples raided and murdered the settlers, but the Chinese punitive expeditions were too much for them.
uz: Gunn xalqlari ko'chmanchilarga hujum qilib, ularni o'ldirdilar, lekin Xitoy jazo ekspeditsiyalari ular uchun juda ko'p edi.

en: The nomads were faced with the choice of settling down to the plough and becoming Chinese tax-payers or shifting in search of fresh summer pastures.
uz: Ko'chmanchilar plugga joylashib, xitoylik soliq to'lovchilarga aylanish yoki yangi yozgi yaylovlarni qidirib ko'chish tanlovini ko'rishdi.

en: Some took the former course and were absorbed.
uz: Ba'zilar avvalgi yo'nalishni qabul qilib, o'zlariga singib ketishdi.

en: Some drifted north-eastward and eastward over the mountain passes down into western Turkestan.
uz: Ba'zilar shimoli-sharqqa va sharqqa qarab tog' oqimlari orqali g'arbiy Turkistonga tushdi.

en: VASE OF BRONZE FORM, UNGLAZED STONEWARE  Han Dynasty (B.C.
uz: BRONZA FORMA VASI, O'RQATILMAGAN TOSHLIK XAN sulolasi (miloddan avvalgi.

en: 220)  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) This westward drive of the Mongolian horsemen was going on from 200 B.C.
uz: 220) (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) Mongoliya otliqlarining g'arbga yurishi miloddan avvalgi 200-yildan boshlab davom etayotgan edi.

en: It was producing a westward pressure upon the Aryan tribes, and these again were pressing upon the Roman frontiers ready to break through directly there was any weakness apparent.
uz: U ariy qabilalariga g'arbga bosim o'tkazayotgan edi va ular yana Rim chegaralariga bosim o'tkazayotgan edi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yorib o'tishga tayyor edi, har qanday zaiflik aniq edi.

en: The Parthians, who were apparently a Scythian people with some Mongolian admixture, came down to the Euphrates by the ﬁrst century B.C.
uz: Parfiyaliklar, go'yoki Mo'g'ul aralashmasiga ega bo'lgan skif xalqi bo'lganlar, miloddan avvalgi birinchi asrga kelib, Furot daryosiga kelishgan.

en: They fought against Pompey the Great in his eastern raid.
uz: Ular Sharqiy hujumida Buyuk Pompeyga qarshi kurashdilar.

en: They defeated and killed Crassus.
uz: Ular Krassni mag'lub etishdi va o'ldirishdi.

en: They replaced the Seleucid monarchy in Persia by a dynasty of Parthian kings, the Arsacid dynasty.
uz: Ular Forsdagi Selevkidlar monarxiyasini Part shohlarining sulolasi, Arsakidlar sulolasi bilan almashtirdilar.

en: CHINESE VESSEL IN BRONZE, IN FORM OF A GOOSE  Dating from before the time of Shi-Hwang-ti.
uz: Xitoy kemasi BRONZA, GO'S shaklida, Shi-Hwang-ti zamonidan oldingi davrga borib taqaladi.

en: Such a piece of work indicates a high level of comfort and humour  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) But for a time the line of least resistance for hungry nomads lay neither to the west nor the east but through central Asia and then south-eastward through the Khyber Pass into India.
uz: Bunday asar yuqori darajadagi qulaylik va hazilni ko'rsatadi (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida). Ammo bir vaqtlar och ko'chmanchilar uchun eng kam qarshilik chizig'i na g'arbda, na sharqda, balki Markaziy Osiyo orqali va keyin Xayber dovonidan Janubi-sharqda Hindistonga kirib borardi.

en: It was India which received the Mongo- lian drive in these centuries of Roman and Chinese strength.
uz: Aynan Hindiston Rim va Xitoy kuchining bu asrlarida Mo'g'ul-Lyan kuchini qabul qildi.

en: A series of raiding conquerors poured down through the Punjab into the great plains to loot and destroy.
uz: Bir qator bosqinchi bosqinchilar Punjab bo'ylab katta tekisliklarga kelib, talon-toroj qilish va yo'q qilish uchun quyiladi.

en: The empire of Asoka was broken up, and for a time the history of India passes into darkness.
uz: Asoka imperiyasi parchalanib ketdi va bir muddat Hindiston tarixi zulmatga aylandi.

en: A certain Kushan dynasty founded by the “Indo- Scythians”—one of the raiding peoples—ruled for a time over North India and maintained a certain order.
uz: Shimoliy Hindiston ustidan bir muddat hukmronlik qilib, ma'lum bir tartibni saqlab qolgan, Indo-skiflar bosqinchi xalqlardan biri tomonidan asos solingan ma'lum bir Kushan sulolasi.

en: These invasions went on for several centuries.
uz: Bu bosqinlar bir necha asr davom etdi.

en: For a large part of the ﬁfth century A.D.
uz: Milodiy beshinchi asrning katta qismi uchun.

en: India was afﬂicted by the Ephthalites or White Huns, who levied tribute on the small Indian princes and held India in terror.
uz: Hindiston eftaliylar yoki oq xunlar tomonidan azoblangan edi, ular kichik hind shahzodalariga soliq solishgan va Hindistonni dahshatga solishgan.

en: Every summer these Ephthalites pastured in western Turkestan, every autumn they came down through the passes to ter- rorize India.
uz: Har yozda bu eftaliylar G'arbiy Turkistonda o'tlar, har kuzda ular Hindistonni ter-roiz qilish uchun o'tloqlardan pastga tushishardi.

en: In the second century A.D.
uz: Milodiy ikkinchi asrda.

en: a great misfortune came upon the Roman and Chinese empires that probably weakened the resistance of both to barbarian pressure.
uz: Rim va Xitoy imperiyalari ustiga katta baxtsizlik keldi, bu esa ularning barbar bosimga qarshiligini zaiflashtirgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: This was a pestilence of unexampled virulence.
uz: Bu mislsiz virulentlik balosi edi.

en: years in China and disorganized the social framework profoundly.
uz: Xitoyda yillar davomida ijtimoiy muhitni tubdan buzib tashladi.

en: The Han dynasty fell, and a new age of division and confusion began from which China did not fairly recover until the seventh century A.D.
uz: Xan sulolasi quladi va yangi bo'linish va chalkashlik davri boshlandi, undan Xitoy milodiy yettinchi asrgacha ancha tiklanmadi.

en: with the coming of the great Tang dynasty.
uz: Buyuk Tang sulolasining kelishi bilan.

en: The infection spread through Asia to Europe.
uz: Infeksiya Osiyo bo'ylab Yevropaga tarqaldi.

en: It raged throughout the Ro- man Empire from 164 to 180 A.D.
uz: U butun Rim imperiyasi bo'ylab milodiy 164 yildan 180 yilgacha hukmronlik qildi.

en: It evidently weakened the Roman imperi- al fabric very seriously.
uz: Bu Rim imperiyasini juda jiddiy zaiflashtirgan ko'rinadi.

en: We begin to hear of depopulation in the Roman provinces after this, and there was a marked deterioration in the vigour and efﬁciency of government.
uz: Shundan so'ng Rim viloyatlarida odamlarni ko'chirish haqida eshitishni boshlaymiz va hukumatning kuch-quvvat va samaradorligida sezilarli pasayish kuzatildi.

en: At any rate we presently ﬁnd the frontier no longer invulnerable, but giving way ﬁrst in this place and then in that.
uz: Har qanday holatda ham, hozirda chegarani zaif emas deb topamiz, lekin avval bu joyda, keyin esa u yerda yo'l ochamiz.

en: A new Nordic people, the Goths, coming originally from Gothland in Sweden, had migrated across Russia to the Volga region and the shores of the Black Sea and taken to the sea and piracy.
uz: Yangi Skandinaviya xalqi, Gotlar, aslida Shvetsiyadagi Gotlanddan kelib chiqqan holda, Rossiya bo'ylab Volga hududiga va Qora dengiz sohillariga ko'chib o'tib, dengizga va qaroqchilikka olib borilgan edi.

en: By the end of the second century they may have begun to feel the westward thrust of the Huns.
uz: Ikkinchi asr oxiriga kelib, ular g'arbga tomon xunnlarning surilishini his qila boshlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: In 247 they crossed the Danube in a great land raid, and defeated and killed the Emper- or Decius in a battle in what is now Serbia.
uz: 247-yilda ular Dunyo daryosini katta quruqlik hujumi bilan kesib o'tdilar va hozirgi Serbiya bo'lgan jangda imperator yoki Deciusni mag'lub etib, o'ldirdilar.

en: In 236 another Germanic peo- ple, the Franks, had broken bounds upon the lower Rhine, and the Alemanni had poured into Alsace.
uz: 236-yilda yana bir germanistonlik posho-pley, Franklar quyi Reyn bo'ylab chegaralarni buzib tashladilar va Alemannilar Alzasga oqib kirishdi.

en: The legions in Gaul beat back their invaders, but the Goths in the Balkan peninsula raided again and again.
uz: Galliyadagi legionlar o'z bosqinchilarini qaytardi, lekin Bolqon yarim orolidagi Gotlar qayta-qayta hujum qildi.

en: The province of Dacia vanished from Roman history.
uz: Dakiya viloyati Rim tarixidan g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: A chill had come to the pride and conﬁdence of Rome.
uz: Rimning g'ururi va ishonchiga salqinlik keldi.

en: In 270-275 Rome, which had been an open and secure city for three centuries, was fortiﬁed by the Emperor Aurelian.
uz: 270-275 yillarda uch asr davomida ochiq va xavfsiz shahar bo'lgan Rim imperator Aurelian tomonidan mustahkamlandi.

en: XXXV THE COMMON MAN’S LIFE UNDER THE EARLY ROMAN EMPIRE Before we tell of how this Roman empire which was built up in the two centuries B.C., and which ﬂourished in peace and security from the days of Augustus Cæsar onward for two centuries, fell into disorder and was broken up, it may be as well to devote some attention to the life of the ordinary people throughout this great realm.
uz: XXXV ODAMLIK INSONING HAYOTI ERTA Rim imperiyasi ostida Miloddan avvalgi ikki asrda qurilgan va Avgust Sezar davridan boshlab ikki asr davomida tinchlik va xavfsizlikda gullab-yashnagan bu Rim imperiyasi qanday tartibsizlikka tushib, parchalanib ketganini aytib berishdan oldin, bu buyuk saltanat bo'ylab oddiy odamlarning hayotiga biroz e'tibor qaratish ham mumkin.

en: Our history has come down now to within 2000 years of our own time; and the life of the civilized people, both under the Peace of Rome and the Peace of the Han dynasty, was beginning to resemble more and more clearly the life of their civilized successors to- day.
uz: Bizning tariximiz hozirgi zamonimizning 2000 yilligiga kelib tushdi; va Rim Tinchligi va Xan sulolasi Tinchligi davridagi madaniy xalqning hayoti bugungi kunda ularning madaniy vorislarining hayotiga tobora yaqqolroq o'xshab borayotgan edi.

en: In the western world coined money was now in common use; outside the priestly world there were many people of independent means who were nei- ther ofﬁcials of the government nor priests; people travelled about more freely than they had ever done before, and there were high roads and inns for them.
uz: G'arb dunyosida tanga pullar endi keng tarqalgan edi; ruhoniylar dunyosidan tashqarida hukumat amaldorlari ham, ruhoniylar ham bo'lmagan ko'plab mustaqil odamlar bor edi; odamlar avvalgidek erkinroq sayohat qilishardi va ular uchun katta yo'llar va mehmonxonalar bor edi.

en: Compared with the past, with the time before 500 B.C., life had be- come much more loose.
uz: O'tmishga nisbatan, miloddan avvalgi 500 yil oldingi davrga nisbatan, hayot ancha erkinroq bo'lgan edi.

en: Before that date civilized men had been bound to a district or country, had been bound to a tradition and lived within a very limited horizon; only the nomads traded and travelled.
uz: O'sha sanagacha madaniyatli odamlar bir tuman yoki mamlakatga bog'langan, an'anaga bog'langan va juda cheklangan ufq ichida yashagan edi; faqat ko'chmanchilar savdo qilishgan va sayohat qilishgan.

en: But neither the Roman Peace nor the Peace of the Han dynasty meant a uniform civilization over the large areas they controlled.
uz: Ammo na Rim Tinchligi, na Xan sulolasi Tinchligi ularning nazoratidagi katta hududlar ustidan bir xil tsivilizatsiyani anglatmadi.

en: There were very great local differences and great contrasts and inequalities of culture be- tween one district and another, just as there are to-day under the British Peace in India.
uz: Hindistonda hozirgi Britaniya tinchligi davrida bo'lgani kabi, bir tuman va boshqa hududlar o'rtasida juda katta mahalliy farqlar, katta kontrastlar va madaniy tengsizliklar mavjud edi.

en: The Roman garrisons and colonies were dotted here and
uz: Rim garnizonlari va mustamlakalari bu yerda tarqalgan edi va

en: there over this great space, worshipping Roman gods and speaking the Latin language; but where there had been towns and cities before the com- ing of the Romans, they went on, subordinated indeed but managing their own affairs, and, for a time at least, worshipping their own gods in their own fashion.
uz: Bu katta maydonda Rim xudolariga sig'inish va lotin tilida gapirish; lekin Rim hukmronligidan oldin shaharlar va shaharlar bo'lgan joyda, ular o'z ishlarini boshqarishga, hech bo'lmaganda, o'z xudolariga o'z uslubida sig'inish bilan davom etishdi.

en: Over Greece, Asia Minor, Egypt and the Hellenized East gen- erally, the Latin language never prevailed.
uz: Gretsiya, Kichik Osiyo, Misr va umuman olganda, yunonlashgan Sharq bo'ylab lotin tili hech qachon ustun kelmagan.

en: Greek ruled there invincibly.
uz: Yunon u yerda yengilmas tarzda hukmronlik qildi.

en: Saul of Tarsus, who became the apostle Paul, was a Jew and a Roman citi- zen; but he spoke and wrote Greek and not Hebrew.
uz: Saul Tarsulik, havoriy Pavlus bo'lgan, yahudiy va Rim fuqarosi edi; lekin u yunon tilida gapirardi va yozardi, ibroniy tilida emas.

en: Even at the court of the Parthian dynasty, which had overthrown the Greek Seleucids in Persia, and was quite outside the Roman imperial boundaries, Greek was the fashion- able language.
uz: Hatto Parfiya sulolasining saroyida ham, u Forsda yunon Seleviklarini ag'dargan va Rim imperiyasi chegaralaridan ancha tashqarida bo'lganida ham, yunon tili modaga qodir til edi.

en: In some parts of Spain and in North Africa, the Carthaginian language also held on for a long time in spite of the destruction of Carthage.
uz: Ispaniyaning ba'zi qismlarida va Shimoliy Afrikada Karfagiy tili ham Karfagen vayron bo'lishiga qaramay uzoq vaqt saqlanib qoldi.

en: Such a town as Seville, which had been a prosperous city long before the Roman name had been heard of, kept its Semitic goddess and preserved its Semitic speech for generations, in spite of a colony of Roman veterans at Italica a few miles away.
uz: Sevilya kabi shahar, Rim nomi eshitilmasidan ancha oldin farovon shahar bo'lgan, o'zining semit ma'budasini saqlab qolgan va bir necha mil uzoqlikda joylashgan Italica shahrida Rim faxriylari koloniyasiga qaramay, o'zining semit nutqini avlodlar davomida saqlab kelgan.

en: Septimius Severus, who was emperor from 193 to 211 A.D., spoke Carthaginian as his mother speech.
uz: Septimius Severus, 193 yildan 211 yilgacha imperator bo'lgan, karthaginaliklarni o'zining ona nutqi sifatida gapirdi.

en: He learnt Latin later as a foreign tongue; and it is recorded that his sister never learnt Latin and con- ducted her Roman household in the Punic language.
uz: U keyinchalik lotin tilini chet til sifatida o'rgandi; va qayd etilishicha, singlisi hech qachon lotin tilini o'rganmagan va Rim xonadonini pun tillarida o'rgangan.

en: In such countries as Gaul and Britain and in provinces like Dacia (now roughly Roumania) and Pannonia (Hungary south of the Danube), where there were no pre-existing great cities and temples and cultures, the Roman empire did however “Latinize.” It civilized these countries for the ﬁrst time.
uz: Galliya va Britaniya kabi mamlakatlarda, shuningdek, Dacia (hozirgi taxminan Ruminiya) va Pannoniya (Dunay daryosining janubidagi Vengriya) kabi viloyatlarda, allaqachon mavjud bo'lmagan buyuk shaharlar, ibodatxonalar va madaniyatlar bo'lmagan joylarda, Rim imperiyasi latinizatsiya qildi. U bu mamlakatlarni birinchi marta sivilizatsiya qildi.

en: It created cities and towns where Latin was from the ﬁrst the dominant speech, and where Roman gods were served and Roman customs and fash- ions followed.
uz: U birinchi bo'lib lotin tili hukmron bo'lgan, Rim xudolariga sig'inilgan va Rim urf-odatlari va fasodlari ergashgan shaharlar va shaharchalarni yaratdi.

en: The Roumanian, Italian, French and Spanish languages, all variations and modiﬁcations of Latin, remain to remind us of this extension of Latin speech and customs.
uz: Ruminiya, italyan, fransuz va ispan tillari, lotin tilining barcha o'zgarishlari va o'zgartirilishlari bizga lotin nutqi va urf-odatlarining ushbu kengayishini eslatib turadi.

en: North-west Africa also became at last largely Latin-speaking.
uz: Shimoliy-g'arbiy Afrika ham nihoyat asosan lotin tilida so'zlashuvchiga aylandi.

en: Egypt, Greece and the rest of the empire to the east were never Latinized.
uz: Misr, Gretsiya va sharqdagi qolgan imperiya hech qachon lotinlashtirilmagan.

en: They remained Egyptian and Greek in culture and spirit.
uz: Ular madaniyat va ruhda misrlik va yunon bo'lib qolishdi.

en: And even in Rome, among educated men, Greek was learnt as the language of a gentleman and Greek literature and learning were very, properly pre- ferred to Latin.
uz: Hatto Rimda ham, o'qimishli odamlar orasida, yunon tili janob tili sifatida o'rganilardi va yunon adabiyoti va ta'limi lotin tiliga juda, to'g'ri oldindan o'rgangan edi.

en: In this miscellaneous empire the ways of doing work and business were naturally also very miscellaneous.
uz: Bu xilma-xil imperiyada ish va biznes yuritish uslublari tabiiyki juda xilma-xil edi.

en: The chief industry of the settled world
uz: O'rnashgan dunyoning asosiy sanoati

en: was still largely agriculture.
uz: hali asosan qishloq xo'jaligi edi.

en: We have told how in Italy the sturdy free farm- ers who were the backbone of the early Roman republic were replaced by estates worked by slave labour after the Punic wars.
uz: Biz Italiyada erta Rim respublikasining tayanchi bo'lgan mustahkam erkin dehqon xo'jaliklari Pun urushlaridan so'ng qullar mehnati bilan ishlaydigan mulklar bilan qanday almashtirilganini aytib o'tdik.
