en: The Greek world had had very various methods of cultivation, from the Arcadian plan, wherein every free citizen toiled with his own hands, to Sparta, wherein it was a dis- honour to work and where agricultural work was done by a special slave class, the Helots.
uz: Yunon dunyosida juda xilma-xil kultivatsiya usullari bo'lgan edi, Arkad rejasidan boshlab, unda har bir erkin fuqaro o'z qo'li bilan mehnat qilardi, Spartagacha, u yerda ishlash sharafsizlik edi va qishloq xo'jaligi ishlarini maxsus qullar sinfi, helotlar amalga oshirdi.

en: But that was ancient history now, and over most of the Hellenized world the estate system and slave-gangs had spread.
uz: Ammo bu endi qadimgi tarix edi va yunonlashgan dunyoning ko'p qismida mulk tizimi va qul-gang tarqalgan edi.

en: The agri- cultural slaves were captives who spoke many different languages so that they could not understand each other, or they were born slaves; they had no solidarity to resist oppression, no tradition of rights, no knowledge, for they could not read nor write.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi va madaniyati qullari bir-birini tushunmaydigan, yoki qul bo'lib tug'ilgan ko'plab turli tillarda gapiradigan asirlar edi; ularning zulmga qarshi birdamligi, huquqlar an'anasi, bilimi yo'q edi, chunki ular na o'qishni, na yozishni bilmas edilar.

en: Although they came to form a majority of the country population they never made a successful insurrection.
uz: Garchi ular mamlakat aholisining ko'pchiligini tashkil etishga kelgan bo'lsalar ham, hech qachon muvaffaqiyatli isyon ko'tarmaganlar.

en: The insurrec- tion of Spartacus in the ﬁrst century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi birinchi asrda Spartakning qo'zg'oloni.

en: was an insurrection of the special slaves who were trained for the gladiatorial combats.
uz: gladiatorlik janglariga tayyorlangan maxsus qullarning qo'zg'oloni edi.

en: The agricultural work- ers in Italy in the latter days of the Republic and the early Empire suffered frightful indignities; they would be chained at night to prevent escape or have half the head shaved to make it difﬁcult.
uz: Italiyadagi qishloq xo'jaligi ishchilari Respublika va ilk imperiyaning so'nggi kunlarida dahshatli haqoratlarga duch kelishdi; ular qochishning oldini olish uchun kechasi zanjirband bo'lishardi yoki boshlarining yarmini qiyinlashtirish uchun qirqishardi.

en: They had no wives of their own; they could be outraged, mutilated and killed by their masters.
uz: Ularning o'z xotinlari yo'q edi; ular xo'jayinlari tomonidan g'azablanishlari, jarohatlanishi va o'ldirilishi mumkin edi.

en: A mas- ter could sell his slave to ﬁght beasts in the arena.
uz: Ustoz o'z qulini maydonda maxluqlarga qarshi kurashish uchun sotishi mumkin edi.

en: If a slave slew his master, all the slaves in his household and not merely the murderer were cruciﬁed.
uz: Agar qul o'z xo'jayinini o'ldirgan bo'lsa, faqat qotil emas, balki uning xonadonidagi barcha qullar xochga mixlangan bo'lardi.

en: In some parts of Greece, in Athens notably, the lot of the slave was never quite so frightful as this, but it was still detestable.
uz: Yunonistonning ba'zi qismlarida, ayniqsa Afinada, qulning taqdiri hech qachon bunchalik dahshatli bo'lmagan, lekin u hali ham jirkanch edi.

en: To such a population the barbarian invaders who presently broke through the defensive line of the legions, came not as enemies but as liberators.
uz: Bunday aholiga hozirda legionlarning mudofaa chizig'ini yorib o'tgan vahshiy bosqinchilar dushman sifatida emas, balki ozod qiluvchi sifatida kelishdi.

en: POMPEII  “Note the ruts in roadway worn by chariot wheels.” The slave system had spread to most industries and to every sort of work that could be done by gangs.
uz: POMPEII Aravaklar g'ildiraklari kiygan yo'llardagi buzilishlarga e'tibor bering. Qullik tizimi ko'pgina sohalarga va to'dalar tomonidan amalga oshirilishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday ishga tarqalgan edi.

en: Mines and metallurgical operations, the row- ing of galleys, road-making and big building operations were all largely slave occupations.
uz: Konchilik va metallurgiya operatsiyalari, galereyalarni taxlash, yo'lsozlik va katta qurilish operatsiyalari asosan qullar mashg'ulotlari edi.

en: And almost all domestic service was performed by slaves.
uz: Va deyarli barcha uy xizmatini qullar bajarardi.

en: There were poor free-men and there were freed-men in the cities and upon the country side, working for themselves or even working for wages.
uz: Shaharlarda ham, qishloqlarda ham kambag'al erkin odamlar bor edi, ular o'zlari uchun ishlayotgan yoki hatto maosh uchun ishlayotgan edi.

en: They were artizans, supervisors and so forth, workers of a new money- paid class working in competition with slave workers; but we do not know what proportion they made of the general population.
uz: Ular hunarmandlar, nazoratchilar va hokazo, qul ishchilari bilan raqobatlashayotgan yangi pullik to'lanadigan sinf ishchilari edi; lekin ularning umumiy aholiga nisbatan qancha ulushga ega bo'lganini bilmaymiz.

en: It probably varied widely
uz: Ehtimol, u juda ko'p o'zgargan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: in different places and at different periods.
uz: turli joylarda va turli davrlarda.

en: And there were also many modi- ﬁcations of slavery, from the slavery that was chained at night and driven with whips to the farm or quarry, to the slave whose master found it advan- tageous to leave him to cultivate his patch or work his craft and own his wife like a free-man, provided he paid in a satisfactory quittance to his owner.
uz: Shuningdek, qullikning ko'plab o'zgarishlari ham bor edi, kechasi zanjirband qilingan va qamchi bilan fermaga yoki karerga haydalgan qullikdan tortib, xo'jayin uni o'z patchini yetishtirishga yoki hunarini qilishga va xotiniga ozod odam kabi egalik qilishga qo'yib yuborishni afzal ko'rgan qulgacha, agar u egasiga qoniqarli to'lov to'lagan bo'lsa.

en: There were armed slaves.
uz: Qurollangan qullar bor edi.

en: At the opening of the period of the Punic wars, in 264 B.C., the Etruscan sport of setting slaves to ﬁght for their lives was revived in Rome.
uz: Poniy urushlari davrining boshida, miloddan avvalgi 264-yilda Rimda qullarni o'z hayotlari uchun kurashishga majbur qilishning etruska sporti qayta tiklandi.

en: It grew rapidly fashionable; and soon every great Roman rich man kept a retinue of gladiators, who sometimes fought in the arena but whose real business it was to act as his bodyguard of bullies.
uz: U tezda urfga kirdi; va tez orada har bir buyuk Rimlik boy o'zining gladiatorlari safini saqlardi, ular ba'zan arenada jang qilishardi, lekin ularning haqiqiy ishi zo'ravonlardan qo'riqchisi bo'lish edi.

en: And also there were learned slaves.
uz: Shuningdek, o'qimishli qullar ham bor edi.

en: The conquests of the later Republic were among the highly civilized cities of Greece, North Africa and Asia Minor; and they brought in many highly educated captives.
uz: Keyingi Respublikaning zabt etishlari Gretsiya, Shimoliy Afrika va Kichik Osiyo kabi yuqori madaniy shaharlar orasida edi; va ular ko'plab yuqori ma'lumotli asirlarni olib kelishdi.

en: The tutor of a young Roman of good family was usually a slave.
uz: Yaxshi oilali yosh rimlikning repetitori odatda qul edi.

en: A rich man would have a Greek slave as librarian, and slave secretaries and learned men.
uz: Boy odamga kutubxonachi sifatida yunon qul, qul kotiblari va olimlar kerak bo'lardi.

en: He would keep his poet as he would keep a performing dog.
uz: U o'z shoirini xuddi ijrochi itni qanday saqlagan bo'lsa, shunday saqlardi.

en: In this atmosphere of slavery the tradi- tions of modern literary criticism were evolved.
uz: Bu qullik muhitida zamonaviy adabiy tanqid an'analari rivojlandi.

en: The slaves still boast and quarrel in our reviews.
uz: Qullar bizning sharhlarimizda hali ham maqtanadi va janjallashadi.

en: There were enterprising people who bought intelli- gent boy slaves and had them educated for sale.
uz: U yerda aql-idrokli va muloyim bola qullarini sotib olgan va ularni sotuvga o'qitgan tadbirkor odamlar bor edi.

en: Slaves were trained as book copyists, as jewellers, and for endless skilled callings.
uz: Qullar kitob nusxalash, zargarlik buyumlari yasash va cheksiz mohir chaqiruvlar uchun o'qitilgan.

uz: COLISEUM, RIM Foto: Underwood & Underwood

en: INTERIOR OF THE COLISEUM AT IT APPEARS TO-DAY But there were very considerable changes in the position of a slave dur- ing the four hundred years between the opening days of conquest under the republic of rich men and the days of disintegration that followed the great pestilence.
uz: COLLISUMINING ichki qismi bugun paydo bo'ladi. Ammo boy odamlar respublikasi ostidagi bosqinning ochilish kunlari va buyuk vabo ortidan kelib chiqqan parchalanish kunlari orasida to'rt yuz yil davomida qulning holatida juda sezilarli o'zgarishlar bo'ldi.

en: In the second century B.C.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi ikkinchi asrda.

en: war-captives were abundant, manners gross and brutal; the slave had no rights and there was scarcely an outrage the reader can imagine that was not practised upon slaves in those days.
uz: Urush asirlari mo'l-ko'l, odoblari qo'pol va shafqatsiz edi; qulning hech qanday huquqi yo'q edi va o'quvchi o'sha davrda qullarga nisbatan qo'llanilmagan g'azabni tasavvur qila olmaydi.

en: But already in the ﬁrst century A.D.
uz: Ammo allaqachon milodiy birinchi asrda.

en: there was a perceptible improvement in the attitude of the Roman civilization towards slavery.
uz: Rim sivilizatsiyasining qullikka bo'lgan munosabatida sezilarli yaxshilanish kuzatildi.

en: Captives were not so abundant for one thing, and slaves were dearer.
uz: Asirlar bir jihatdan unchalik ko'p emas edi, qullar esa qimmatroq edi.

en: And slave- owners began to realize that the proﬁt and comfort they got from their slaves increased with the self-respect of these unfortunates.
uz: Va qul egalari o'z qullaridan olgan foyda va qulaylik, bu baxtsizlarning o'ziga bo'lgan hurmati bilan ortib borayotganini anglay boshladilar.

en: But also the moral tone of the com- munity was rising, and a sense of justice was becoming effective.
uz: Lekin jamiyatning axloqiy ohangi ham ko'tarilib, adolat tuyg'usi samarali bo'lib borayotgan edi.

en: The high- er mentality of Greece was qualifying the old Roman harshness.
uz: Yunonistonning yuqori mentaliteti eski Rim shafqatsizligini oqlardi.

en: Restric- tions upon cruelty were made, a master might no longer sell his slave to ﬁght beasts, a slave was given property rights in what was called his peculi- um, slaves were paid wages as an encouragement and stimulus, a form of
uz: Zolimlikka cheklovlar qo'yildi, xo'jayin endi qulini hayvonlarga qarshi kurashish uchun sotmasligi mumkin edi, qulga o'ziga xos deb atalgan mulk huquqi berildi - um, qullarga rag'batlantirish va rag'batlantirish sifatida ish haqi to'landi, bir shakl.

en: slave marriage was recognized.
uz: Qul nikohi tan olindi.

en: Very many forms of agriculture do not lend themselves to gang working, or require gang workers only at certain sea- sons.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligining juda ko'p shakllari o'zini guruhiy ish bilan shug'ullanishga bermaydi yoki faqat ayrim dengiz o'g'illarida guruhiy ishchilarni talab qiladi.

en: In regions where such conditions prevailed the slave presently became a serf, paying his owner part of his produce or working for him at certain seasons.
uz: Bunday sharoitlar hukmron bo'lgan hududlarda qul hozirda qulga aylandi, egasiga o'z mahsulotidan bir qismini to'lardi yoki ma'lum fasllarda u uchun ishlaydi.

en: When we begin to realize how essentially this great Latin and Greek- speaking Roman Empire of the ﬁrst two centuries A.D.
uz: Miloddan keyingi birinchi ikki asrdagi bu buyuk lotin va yunon tilli Rim imperiyasining mohiyatini anglay boshlaganimizda.

en: was a slave state and how small was the minority who had any pride or freedom in their lives, we lay our hands on the clues to its decay and collapse.
uz: qul davlati edi va hayotida g'urur yoki erkinlikka ega bo'lgan ozchilik qanchalik kichik bo'lsa, biz uning parchalanishi va qulashiga ishoralarni qo'lga kiritdik.

en: There was little of what we should call family life, few homes of temperate living and active thought and study; schools and colleges were few and far between.
uz: Oilaviy hayot deb ataladigan narsa kam edi, o'rtacha hayot va faol fikrlash va o'qish uylari kam edi; maktablar va kollejlar juda kam edi.

en: The free will and the free mind were nowhere to be found.
uz: Erkin iroda va erkin aql hech qayerda topilmas edi.

en: The great roads, the ruins of splendid buildings, the tradition of law and power it left for the astonish- ment of succeeding generations must not conceal from us that all its outer splendour was built upon thwarted wills, stiﬂed intelligence, and crippled and perverted desires.
uz: Ulkan yo'llar, hashamatli binolarning xarobalari, keyingi avlodlarning hayratlanishiga qoldirgan qonun va hokimiyat an'anasi bizdan yashirmasligi kerakki, uning barcha tashqi ulug'vorligi buzilgan irodalar, bo'g'ilgan aql va nog'or va buzilgan istaklar ustiga qurilgan.

en: And even the minority who lorded it over that wide realm of subjugation and of restraint and forced labour were uneasy and un- happy in their souls; art and literature, science and philosophy, which are the fruits of free and happy minds, waned in that atmosphere.
uz: Hatto uni o'sha keng bo'ysundirish, cheklash va majburiy mehnat olamida hukmronlik qilgan ozchilik ham o'z ruhlarida noqulay va baxtsiz edi; san'at va adabiyot, fan va falsafa, erkin va baxtli onglarning mevasidir, o'sha muhitda so'nadi.

en: There was much copying and imitation, an abundance of artistic artiﬁcers, much slav- ish pedantry among the servile men of learning, but the whole Roman em- pire in four centuries produced nothing to set beside the bold and noble in- tellectual activities of the comparatively little city of Athens during its one century of greatness.
uz: Ko'p nusxa ko'chirish va taqlid qilish, badiiy hunarmandlar ko'pligi, qullik-bo'ydoqlik o'qituvchilari orasida ko'p edi, lekin butun Rim imperiyasi to'rt asrda Afina shahrining nisbatan kichik bir asr buyukligi davridagi dadil va olijanob intellektual faoliyatidan tashqari hech narsa ishlab chiqarmadi.

en: Athens decayed under the Roman sceptre.
uz: Afina Rim tantanasi ostida chiridi.

en: The science of Alexandria decayed.
uz: Iskandariya ilmi chiridi.

en: The spirit of man, it seemed, was decaying in those days.
uz: O'sha kunlarda inson ruhi chirib borayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: XXXVI RELIGIOUS DEVELOPMENTS UNDER THE ROMAN EMPIRE The soul of man under that Latin and Greek empire of the ﬁrst two cen- turies of the Christian era was a worried and frustrated soul.
uz: Rim imperiyasi ostidagi XXXVI DINIY Taraqqiyotlar. Xristian davrining birinchi ikki asr davri Lotin va Yunon imperiyasi ostidagi inson ruhi xavotirli va umidsiz ruh edi.

en: Compulsion and cruelty reigned; there were pride and display but little honour; little serenity or steadfast happiness.
uz: Majburiyat va shafqatsizlik hukmron edi; g'urur va nafosat bor edi, lekin kam sharaf bor edi; kam xotirjamlik yoki barqaror baxt bor edi.

en: The unfortunate were despised and wretch- ed; the fortunate were insecure and feverishly eager for gratiﬁcations.
uz: Baxtsizlar nafratlanardi va bechora edilar; omadlilar esa ishonchsiz va xushchaqchaq edilar.

en: In a great number of cities life centred on the red excitement of the arena, where men and beasts fought and were tormented and slain.
uz: Ko'pgina shaharlarda hayot maydondagi qizil hayajonga qaratilgan edi, u yerda odamlar va hayvonlar jang qilishdi, azoblanishdi va o'ldirishdi.

en: Amphitheatres are the most characteristic of Roman ruins.
uz: Amfiteatrlar Rim xarobalarining eng xarakterli qismidir.

en: Life went on in that key.
uz: Hayot shu kalitda davom etdi.

en: The uneasi- ness of men’s hearts manifested itself in profound religious unrest.
uz: Erkaklarning qalbi beqarorligi chuqur diniy notinchlikda namoyon bo'ldi.

en: From the days when the Aryan hordes ﬁrst broke in upon the ancient civ- ilizations, it was inevitable that the old gods of the temples and priesthoods should suffer great adaptations or disappear.
uz: Aryan qo'shinlari qadimgi sivilizatsiyalarga birinchi marta bostirib kirgan kunlardan boshlab, ibodatxonalar va ruhoniylarning eski xudolari katta moslashuvlarga duch kelishi yoki yo'q bo'lib ketishi muqarrar edi.

en: In the course of hundreds of generations the agricultural peoples of the brunette civilizations had shaped their lives and thoughts to the temple-centred life.
uz: Yuzlab avlodlar davomida brunet sivilizatsiyalarning qishloq xo'jaligi xalqlari o'z hayotlari va fikrlarini ibodatxonaga yo'naltirilgan hayotga moslashtirgan edi.

en: Observances and the fear of disturbed routines, sacriﬁces and mysteries, dominated their minds.
uz: Ularning ongiga rioyalar va buzilgan odatlardan qo'rquv, qurbonliklar va sirlar hukmronlik qildi.

en: Their gods seem monstrous and illogical to our modern minds because we belong to an Aryanized world, but to these older peoples these deities had the im- mediate conviction and vividness of things seen in an intense dream.
uz: Ularning xudolari bizning zamonaviy ongimizga dahshatli va mantiqsiz ko'rinadi, chunki biz ariylashgan dunyoga mansubmiz, lekin bu qadimgi xalqlar uchun bu xudolar kuchli tushda ko'rilgan narsalarning bevosita ishonchi va jonliligiga ega edilar.

en: The conquest of one city state by another in Sumeria or early Egypt meant a change or a renaming of gods or goddesses, but left the shape and spirit of the worship intact.
uz: Shumer yoki erta Misrda bir shahar davlatining boshqasi tomonidan zabt etilishi xudolar yoki xudolarning o'zgarishi yoki nomini o'zgartirishni anglatardi, lekin ibodatning shakli va ruhini saqlab qoldi.

en: There was no change in its general character.
uz: Uning umumiy xarakterida hech qanday o'zgarish bo'lmadi.

en: The ﬁgures in the dream changed, but the dream went on and it was the same sort of dream.
uz: Tushdagi shaxslar o'zgardi, lekin tush davom etdi va u xuddi shu turdagi tush edi.

en: And the early Semitic conquerors were sufﬁciently akin in spirit to
uz: Va erta semit bosqinchilari ruhiy jihatdan yetarlicha yaqin edilar.

en: the Sumerians to take over the religion of the Mesopotamian civilization they subjugated without any profound alteration.
uz: Shumerlar Mesopotamiya sivilizatsiyasining dinini hech qanday chuqur o'zgarishsiz o'z zimmasiga olish uchun bo'ysundirishdi.

en: Egypt was never indeed subjugated to the extent of a religious revolution.
uz: Misr hech qachon diniy inqilob darajasigacha bo'ysundirilmagan.

en: Under the Ptolemies and under the Cæsars, her temples and altars and priesthoods remained essen- tially Egyptian.
uz: Ptolemeylar davrida va Sezarlar davrida uning ibodatxonalari, qurbongohlari va ruhoniyliklari asosan misrlik bo'lib qoldi.

en: So long as conquests went on between people of similar social and reli- gious habits it was possible to get over the clash between the god of this temple and region and the god of that by a process of grouping or assimila- tion.
uz: Xuddi shunday ijtimoiy va diniy odatlarga ega odamlar o'rtasida bosqinlar davom etar ekan, bu ibodatxona va mintaqaning xudosi va uning xudosi o'rtasidagi to'qnashuvni guruhlash yoki assimilyatsiya jarayoni orqali yengib o'tish mumkin edi.

en: If the two gods were alike in character they were identiﬁed.
uz: Agar ikki xudo xarakter jihatidan bir xil bo'lsa, ular aniqlandi.

en: It was re- ally the same god under another name, said the priests and the people.
uz: Ruhoniylar va xalq aytishicha, u boshqa ism bilan bir xil xudoga ittifoqchi edi.

en: This fusion of gods is called theocrasia; and the age of the great conquests of the thousand years B.C.
uz: Bu xudolarning birlashuvi teokratiya deb ataladi; va miloddan avvalgi ming yillik buyuk zabt etishlar davri.

en: was an age of theocrasia.
uz: Teokratiya davri edi.

en: Over wide areas the local gods were displaced by, or rather they were swallowed up in, a general god.
uz: Keng hududlarda mahalliy xudolar umumiy xudo tomonidan ko'chirildi, yoki to'g'rirog'i, yutib yuborildi.

en: So that when at last Hebrew prophets in Babylon proclaimed one God of Righteousness in all the earth men’s minds were fully prepared for that idea.
uz: Shunday qilib, nihoyat Bobildagi ibroniy payg'ambarlar butun yer yuzida yagona Adolat Xudosini e'lon qilganlarida, odamlarning onglari shu fikrga to'liq tayyor edi.

en: But often the gods were too dissimilar for such an assimilation, and then they were grouped together in some plausible relationship.
uz: Lekin ko'pincha xudolar bunday assimilyatsiya uchun juda o'xshash bo'lishardi va keyin ular qandaydir ishonchli munosabatda birga guruhlangan edilar.

en: A female god - and the Ægean world before the coming of the Greek was much addicted to Mother Gods—would be married to a male god, and an animal god or a star god would be humanized and the animal or astronomical aspect, the serpent or the sun or the star, made into an ornament or a symbol.
uz: Ayol xudo  va yunonlar kelmasidan oldin Egey dunyosi Ona Xudolarga juda bog'langan edi  erkak xudoga turmushga chiqardi, hayvon xudo yoki yulduz xudo insoniylashtirildi va hayvon yoki astronomik jihat, ilon yoki quyosh yoki yulduz, bezak yoki ramzga aylantiriladi.

en: Or the god of a defeated people would become a malignant antagonist to the brighter gods.
uz: Yoki mag'lub xalqning xudosi yorqinroq xudolarga yovuz dushman bo'lib qoladi.

en: The history of theology is full of such adaptations, compromises and ratio- nalizations of once local gods.
uz: Teologiya tarixi bir vaqtlar mahalliy xudolarning shunday moslashuvlari, murosalari va nisbatlari bilan to'la.

en: As Egypt developed from city states into one united kingdom there was much of this theocrasia.
uz: Misr shahar davlatlaridan birlashgan shohlikka aylanib borar ekan, bu teokratiyaning ko'p qismi mavjud edi.

en: The chief god so to speak was Osiris, a sacriﬁcial harvest god of whom Pharaoh was supposed to be the earthly incarnation.
uz: Bosh xudo, shunday deyish mumkinki, qurbonlik hosili xudosi bo'lgan Osiris edi, uning yer yuzidagi timsoli Fir'avn bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Osiris was represented as repeatedly dying and rising again; he was not only the seed and the harvest but also by a natural extension of thought the means of human immortality.
uz: Osiris qayta-qayta o'lish va qayta tirilish bilan ifodalangan; u nafaqat urug' va hosil edi, balki fikrlashning tabiiy davomiyligi orqali insoniy o'lmaslikning vositasi ham edi.

en: Among his symbols was the wide-winged scarabeus beetle which buries its eggs to rise again, and also the effulgent sun which sets to rise.
uz: Uning ramzlari orasida yana ko'tarilish uchun tuxumlarini ko'mib qo'yadigan keng qanotli qurt bor edi, shuningdek, ko'tarilishga botadigan yorqin quyosh ham bor edi.

en: Later on he was to be identiﬁed with Apis, the sacred bull.
uz: Keyinroq u Apis bilan, muqaddas buqa bilan tanishtirilishi kerak edi.

en: Associated with him was the goddess Isis.
uz: U bilan birga Isis ma'buda ham bor edi.

en: Isis was also Hathor, a cow- goddess, and the crescent moon and the Star of the sea.
uz: Isis, shuningdek, sigir ma'budasi Hathor, yarim oy va dengiz yulduzi edi.

en: Osiris dies and she bears a child, Horus, who is also a hawk-god and the dawn, and who grows to become Osiris again.
uz: Osiris vafot etadi va u Horus ismli bolani tug'adi, u ham tulki-xudo va tong bo'lib, yana Osiris bo'lib ulg'ayadi.

en: The efﬁgies of Isis represent her as bearing the in-
uz: Isisning ko'rinishlari uni ko'tarib yurgan holda ifodalaydi.

en: fant Horus in her arms and standing on the crescent moon.
uz: Horusni quchog'ida va yarim oy ustida turardi.

en: These are not logical relationships, but they were devised by the human mind before the development of hard and systematic thinking and they have a dream-like coherence.
uz: Bular mantiqiy munosabatlar emas, lekin ular qattiq va tizimli fikrlash rivojlanishidan oldin inson ongi tomonidan o'ylab topilgan va ular tushga o'xshash muvofiqlikka ega.

en: Beneath this triple group there are other and darker Egyptian gods, bad gods, the dog-headed Anubis, black night and the like, devourers, tempters, enemies of god and man.
uz: Bu uch kishilik guruh ostida Misrning boshqa va qorong'uroq xudolari, yomon xudolar, it boshli Anublar, qora tun va shunga o'xshashlar, yutgichlar, vasvasaga soladiganlar, xudo va inson dushmanlari bor.

en: MITHRAS SACRIFICING A BULL, ROMAN  (In the British Museum) Every religious system does in the course of time ﬁt itself to the shape of the human soul, and there can be no doubt that out of these illogical and even uncouth symbols, Egyptian people were able to fashion for themselves ways of genuine devotion and consolation.
uz: MITHRAS BULNI Qurbon QILISH, RIM (Buyuk Muzeyda) Har bir diniy tizim vaqt o'tishi bilan inson ruhining shakliga moslashadi va shubhasizki, ushbu mantiqsiz va hatto shafqatsiz ramzlardan Misr xalqi o'zlari uchun chinakam sadoqat va tasalli yo'llarini yaratishga qodir edilar.

en: The desire for immortality was very strong in the Egyptian mind, and the religious life of Egypt turned on that desire.
uz: Misr ongida o'lmaslikka bo'lgan istak juda kuchli edi va Misr diniy hayoti shu istakni qo'zg'atdi.

en: The Egyptian religion was an immortality religion as no other religion had ever been.
uz: Misr dini boshqa hech qaysi dindagidek o'lmaslik dini edi.

en: As Egypt went down under foreign conquerors and
uz: Misr xorijiy bosqinchilar qo'liga tushganida va

en: the Egyptian gods ceased to have any satisfactory political signiﬁcance, this craving for a life of compensations here-after, intensiﬁed.
uz: Misr xudolari hech qanday qoniqarli siyosiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lishni to'xtatdi, bu keyingi hayot uchun tovon talablari kuchaydi.

en: ISIS AND HORUS After the Greek conquest, the new city of Alexandria became the centre of Egyptian religious life, and indeed of the religious life of the whole Hel- lenic world.
uz: IShID VA HORUS Greklar bosib olgandan so'ng, yangi Iskandariya shahri Misr diniy hayotining, va aslida butun Hel-Lenin dunyosining diniy hayotining markaziga aylandi.

en: A great temple, the Serapeum, was set up by Ptolemy I at which a sort of trinity of gods was worshipped.
uz: Katta ibodatxona, Serapeum, Ptolemey I tomonidan tashkil etilgan bo'lib, u yerda xudolarning bir turdagi uchligi sig'inardi.

en: These were Serapis (who was Osiris-Apis rechristened), Isis and Horus.
uz: Bular Serapis edi (U Osiris-Apis deb qayta suvga cho'mdirilgan), Isis va Horus.

en: These were not regarded as separate gods but as three aspects of one god, and Serapis was identiﬁed with the Greek Zeus, the Roman Jupiter and the Persian sun-god.
uz: Bular alohida xudolar sifatida emas, balki bitta xudoning uchta jihati sifatida qaralgan va Serapis yunon Zevs, Rim Yupiter va Fors quyosh xudosi bilan identifikatsiya qilingan.

en: This wor- ship spread wherever the Hellenic inﬂuence extended, even into North India and Western China.
uz: Bu dunyoviy kema Gellin ta'siri cho'zilgan har qanday joyga, hatto Shimoliy Hindiston va G'arbiy Xitoyga ham tarqaldi.

en: The idea of immortality, an immortality of compensa- tions and consolation, was eagerly received by a world in which the com- mon life was hopelessly wretched.
uz: O'lmaslik g'oyasi, kompensatsiya va tasalli o'lmasligi, jamiyat hayoti umidsiz darajada qashshoq bo'lgan dunyo tomonidan ishtiyoq bilan qabul qilindi.

en: Serapis was called “the saviour of souls.” “After death,” said the hymns of that time, “we are still in the care of his providence.” Isis attracted many devotees.
uz: Serapis ruhiy najotkor deb atalgan. O'limdan keyin, deyishgan o'sha davrdagi madhiyalar, biz hali ham uning ta'minoti ostida. Isis ko'plab sadoqatlilarni jalb qildi.

en: Her images stood in her temples, as Queen of Heaven, bearing the infant Horus in her arms.
uz: Uning tasvirlari osmon malikasi sifatida uning ibodatxonalarida turardi, qo'lida go'dak Horusni ko'tarib.

en: Candles were burnt before her, votive offerings were made to her, shaven priests consecrated to celibacy waited on her altar.
uz: Uning oldida shamlar yoqildi, unga qasamyodlar qilindi, soqolli bo'ydoqlikka bag'ishlangan ruhoniylar uning qurbongohida kutishdi.

en: The rise of the Roman empire opened the western European world to this growing cult.
uz: Rim imperiyasining yuksalishi G'arbiy Yevropa olamini ushbu o'sib borayotgan kultga ochdi.

en: The temples of Serapis-Isis, the chanting of the priests and the hope of immortal life, followed the Roman standards to Scotland and Hol- land.
uz: Serapis-Isis ibodatxonalari, ruhoniylarning qo'shiqlari va o'lmas hayot umidi Shotlandiya va Hol- yerlariga Rim standartlariga amal qildi.

en: But there were many rivals to the Serapis-Isis religion.
uz: Lekin Serapis-Isis dinining ko'plab raqiblari bor edi.

en: Prominent among these was Mithraism.
uz: Bular orasida Mithraizm mashhur edi.

en: This was a religion of Persian origin, and it centred upon some now forgotten mysteries about Mithras sacriﬁcing a sa-
uz: Bu Fors kelib chiqishiga ega din edi va u Mithra qurbonligi haqidagi hozirda unutilgan ba'zi sirlarga asoslangan edi.

en: cred and benevolent bull.
uz: Ishonchli va xayriya qiluvchi buqa.

en: Here we seem to have something more primordial than the complicated and sophisticated Serapis-Isis beliefs.
uz: Bu yerda murakkab va murakkab Serapis-Isis e'tiqodlaridan ko'ra ibtidoiyroq narsa borga o'xshaydi.

en: We are carried back directly to the blood sacriﬁces of the heliolithic stage in human cul- ture.
uz: Biz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri insoniyat madaniyatining heliolitik bosqichidagi qon qurbonlariga olib boriladi.

en: The bull upon the Mithraic monuments always bleeds copiously from a wound in its side, and from this blood springs new life.
uz: Mithra yodgorliklarining ustidagi buqa har doim yonidagi jarohatdan ko'p qon oqizadi va bu qondan yangi hayot kechiradi.

en: The votary to Mithraism actually bathed in the blood of the sacriﬁcial bull.
uz: Mithraizmga sodiq qolganlar aslida qurbonlik buqasining qoni bilan cho'milgan.

en: At his initia- tion he went beneath a scaffolding upon which a bull was killed so that the blood could actually run down on him.
uz: U o'z tashabbusida, qon aslida uning ustiga oqib tushishi uchun, buqa o'ldiriladigan scaffolding ostiga kirdi.

en: Both these religions, and the same is true of many other of the numerous parallel cults that sought the allegiance of the slaves and citizens under the earlier Roman emperors, are personal religions.
uz: Bu dinlar ham, avvalgi Rim imperatorlari davrida qullar va fuqarolarning sadoqatini izlagan ko'plab parallel kultlarning ko'pchiligi ham shaxsiy dinlardir.

en: They aim at personal salva- tion and personal immortality.
uz: Ular shaxsiy najotga va shaxsiy o'lmaslikka qaratilgan.

en: The older religions were not personal like that; they were social.
uz: Qadimgi dinlar bunday shaxsiy emas edi; ular ijtimoiy edi.

en: The older fashion of divinity was god or goddess of the city ﬁrst or of the state, and only secondarily of the individual.
uz: Qadimgi ilohiylik uslubi birinchi navbatda shaharning yoki davlatning xudo yoki ma'budasi edi va faqat shaxsning ikkinchi darajali usuli edi.

en: The sac- riﬁces were a public and not a private function.
uz: Sak-rifiklar xususiy emas, balki jamoat funksiyasi edi.

en: They concerned collective practical needs in this world in which we live.
uz: Ular biz yashayotgan dunyoda umumiy amaliy ehtiyojlar haqida edi.

en: But the Greeks ﬁrst and now the Romans had pushed religion out of politics.
uz: Ammo yunonlar avval va hozir Rimliklar dinni siyosatdan chiqarib yuborgan edi.

en: Guided by the Egyptian tra- dition religion had retreated to the other world.
uz: Misr an'anaviy dini tomonidan boshqarilib, boshqa dunyoga chekingan edi.

en: BUST OF THE EMPEROR COMMODUS, A.D.
uz: EMPEROR KOMMUDNING BUSTI, A.D.

en: 180-192  Represented as the God Mithras, Roman, Circa A.D.
uz: 180-192 Miloddan avvalgi taxminan Miloddan avvalgi Rim, Mithra Xudosi sifatida namoyon etilgan.

en: 190  (In the British Museum) These new private immortality religions took all the heart and emotion out of the old state religions, but they did not actually replace them.
uz: 190 (Britaniya muzeyida) Bu yangi xususiy abadiylik dinlari eski davlat dinlaridan butun yurak va his-tuyg'uni olib tashladi, lekin ular ularni aslida almashtirmadi.

en: A typi- cal city under the earlier Roman emperors would have a number of temples to all sorts of gods.
uz: Qadimgi Rim imperatorlari davridagi tipik shaharda har xil xudolarga sig'adigan bir qator ibodatxonalar bo'lardi.

en: There might be a temple to Jupiter of the Capitol, the great god of Rome, and there would probably be one to the reigning Cæsar.
uz: Rimning buyuk xudosi bo'lgan Kapitoliy Yupiterga ibodatxona bo'lishi mumkin edi va hukmron Sezarga ham shunday ibodatxona bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: For the Cæsars had learnt from the Pharaohs the possibility of being gods.
uz: Chunki Sezarlar fir'avnlardan xudo bo'lish imkoniyatini o'rganishgan edi.

en: In such temples a cold and stately political worship went on; one would go and make an offering and burn a pinch of incense to show one’s loyalty.
uz: Bunday ibodatxonalarda sovuq va ulug'vor siyosiy ibodat davom etardi; odam borib, qurbonlik qilardi va sadoqatini ko'rsatish uchun bir chimdim tutatqi yoqardi.

en: But it would be to the temple of Isis, the dear Queen of Heaven, one would go with the burthen of one’s private troubles for advice and relief.
uz: Lekin bu Isis ma'badiga, Osmon malikasi aziziga, maslahat va yengillik olish uchun shaxsiy muammolar yukini olib borardi.

en: There might be local and eccentric gods.
uz: Mahalliy va g'alati xudolar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Seville, for example, long affected the worship of the old Carthaginian Venus.
uz: Sevilya, masalan, qadimgi Karfagiya Venerasiga sig'inishga uzoq ta'sir ko'rsatgan.

en: In a cave or an underground temple there would certainly be an altar to Mithras, attended by legionaries and slaves.
uz: G'orda yoki yer osti ibodatxonasida, albatta, Mitraga qurbongoh bo'lardi, unda legionerlar va qullar qatnashardi.

en: And probably also there would be a synagogue where the Jews gathered to read their Bible and uphold their faith in the unseen God of all the Earth.
uz: Va ehtimol, shuningdek, yahudiylar o'z Muqaddas Kitoblarini o'qish va butun Yer yuzidagi ko'rinmas Xudoga bo'lgan e'tiqodlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun yig'iladigan sinagoga ham bo'lar edi.

en: Sometimes there would be trouble with the Jews about the political side of the state religion.
uz: Ba'zan yahudiylar bilan davlat dinining siyosiy tomoni bo'yicha muammolar bo'lardi.

en: They held that their God was a jealous God intolerant of idolatry, and they would refuse to take part in the public sacriﬁces to Cæsar.
uz: Ular o'zlarining Xudosi butparastlikka toqat qilmaydigan rashkchi Xudodir deb hisoblashgan va ular Sezarga qilinadigan ommaviy qurbonliklarda ishtirok etishdan bosh tortishardi.

en: They would not even salute the Roman standards for fear of idolatry.
uz: Ular hatto butparastlikdan qo'rqib, Rim standartlariga ham salom bermas edilar.

en: In the East long before the time of Buddha there had been ascetics, men and women who gave up most of the delights of life, who repudiated mar- riage and property and sought spiritual powers and an escape from the stresses and mortiﬁcations of the world in abstinence, pain and solitude.
uz: Sharqda Buddaning zamonidan ancha oldin hayot lazzatlarining ko'p qismidan voz kechgan zohidlar, erkaklar va ayollar bo'lgan, ular turmush qurish va mulkni rad etishgan va ruhiy kuchlarni hamda dunyoni stress va xafa qilishdan qochishni tiyilish, og'riq va yolg'izlikda izlashgan.

en: Buddha himself set his face against ascetic extravagances, but many of his disciples followed a monkish life of great severity.
uz: Buddaning o'zi zohidlik dabdabalariga qarshi o'zini ko'rsatdi, lekin uning ko'plab shogirdlari juda qattiq rohiblik hayotini davom ettirdilar.

en: Obscure Greek cults practised similar disciplines even to the extent of self-mutilation.
uz: G'alati yunon kultlari hatto o'z-o'zini shikastlash darajasida ham shunga o'xshash fanlarni mashq qilishgan.

en: Asceti- cism appeared in the Jewish communities of Judea and Alexandria also in the ﬁrst century B.C.
uz: Yahudiya va Iskandariya yahudiy jamiyatlarida ascetizm miloddan avvalgi birinchi asrda ham paydo bo'lgan.

en: Communities of men abandoned the world and gave themselves to austerities and mystical contemplation.
uz: Odamlar jamoalari dunyoni tashlab, o'zlarini kamchiliklar va mistik mulohazalarga berdilar.

en: Such was the sect of the Essenes.
uz: Esenlar mazhabining mazhablari shunday edi.

en: Throughout the ﬁrst and second centuries A.D.
uz: Milodiy birinchi va ikkinchi asrlar davomida.

en: there was an al- most world-wide resort to such repudiations of life, a universal search for “salvation” from the distresses of the time.
uz: Hayotning bunday rad etishlariga eng ko'p jahon miqyosida murojaat qilish imkoniyati bor edi, o'sha davr azoblaridan  Najotni universal qidirish.

en: The old sense of an established order, the old conﬁdence in priest and temple and law and custom, had gone.
uz: O'rnatilgan tartibning eski tuyg'usi, ruhoniy va ibodatxonaga, qonun va urf-odatga bo'lgan eski ishonch yo'qolgan edi.

en: Amidst the prevailing slavery, cruelty, fear, anxiety, waste, display and hectic self-indulgence, went this epidemic of self- disgust and mental insecurity, this agonized search for peace even at the price of renunciation and voluntary suffering.
uz: Quldorlik, shafqatsizlik, qo'rquv, xavotir, isrofgarchilik, namoyish va shiddatli o'z-o'ziga bo'ysunish hukm surgan joyda, o'z-o'zini jirkanch va ruhiy ishonchsizlik epidemiyasi, hatto voz kechish va ixtiyoriy azob-uqubat evaziga ham tinchlik izlash azobida davom etdi.

en: This it was that ﬁlled the Serapeum with weeping penitents and brought the converts into the gloom and gore of the Mithraic cave.
uz: Aynan shu Serapeumni yig'lovchi tavba qiluvchilar bilan to'ldirgan va musulmonlarni Mitra g'orining zulmat va g'azabga olib kirgan edi.

en: XXXVII THE TEACHING OF JESUS It was while Augustus Cæsar, the ﬁrst of the Emperors, was reigning in Rome that Jesus who is the Christ of Christianity was born in Judea.
uz: XXXVII ISHONING TA'LIMOTLARI Avgust Kaysar, imperatorlarning birinchisi Rimda hukmronlik qilayotgan paytda, Iso Masih, xristianlik Masih bo'lgan Iso Yahudiyada tug'ilgan edi.

en: In his name a religion was to arise which was destined to become the ofﬁcial reli- gion of the entire Roman Empire.
uz: Uning nomidan butun Rim imperiyasining rasmiy diniga aylanishi uchun mo'ljallangan din paydo bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Now it is on the whole more convenient to keep history and theology apart.
uz: Endi tarix va teologiyani alohida saqlash umuman olganda yanada qulayroq.

en: A large proportion of the Christian world believes that Jesus was an incarnation of that God of all the Earth whom the Jews ﬁrst recognized.
uz: Xristian olamining katta qismi Iso Masih yahudiylar birinchi marta tan olgan butun Yer yuzidagi Xudoning mujassamligiga ishonadi.

en: The historian, if he is to remain historian, can neither accept nor deny that inter- pretation.
uz: Tarixchi, agar u tarixchi bo'lib qolmoqchi bo'lsa, bu aralashuvni na qabul qila oladi, na inkor eta oladi.

en: Materially Jesus appeared in the likeness of a man, and it is as a man that the historian must deal with him.
uz: Moddiy jihatdan Iso inson qiyofasida paydo bo'ldi va tarixchi u bilan inson qiyofasida muomala qilishi kerak.

en: He appeared in Judea in the reign of Tiberius Cæsar.
uz: U Yahudiyada Tiberius Sezar hukmronligi davrida paydo bo'ldi.

en: He preached after the fashion of the preceding Jewish prophets.
uz: U oldingi yahudiy payg'ambarlarining uslubida va'z qildi.

en: He was a man of about thirty, and we are in the profoundest ignorance of his manner of life before his preaching began.
uz: U taxminan o'ttiz yoshli odam edi va biz uning va'zidan oldin hayot tarzi haqida eng chuqur bilimga ega emasmiz.

en: Our only direct sources of information about the life and teaching of Je- sus are the four Gospels.
uz: Je-susning hayoti va ta'limoti haqida bevosita ma'lumot olishning yagona manbalarimiz to'rt Injildir.

en: All four agree in giving us a picture of a very deﬁ- nite personality.
uz: To'rtovlon ham bizga juda murakkab shaxsiyat tasvirini berishga rozi.

en: One is obliged to say, “Here was a man.
uz: Bir kishi aytishga majbur bo'ladi: Mana bir odam bor edi.

en: This could not have been invented.” But just as the personality of Gautama Buddha has been distorted and ob- scured by the stiff squatting ﬁgure, the gilded idol of later Buddhism, so one feels that the lean and strenuous personality of Jesus is much wronged by the unreality and conventionality that a mistaken reverence has imposed upon his ﬁgure in modern Christian art.
uz: Buni o'ylab topib bo'lmas edi. Ammo xuddi Gautama Buddaning shaxsiyati keyinchalik Buddizmning oltin butlari bo'lgan qattiq egilgan qiyofasi tomonidan buzilgan va obro'sizlantirilganidek, xuddi shunday qilib, Isoning ingichka va qattiqqo'l shaxsiyati zamonaviy xristian san'atida uning qiyofasiga noto'g'ri hurmat qo'ygan noaniqlik va odatiylikdan juda zarar ko'rganini his qilish mumkin.

en: Jesus was a penniless teacher, who
uz: Iso bepul ustoz edi, u...

en: wandered about the dusty sun-bit country of Judea, living upon casual gifts of food; yet he is always represented clean, combed and sleek, in spotless raiment, erect and with something motionless about him as though he was gliding through the air.
uz: Yahudiyaning changga to'la quyoshdan o'tadigan yurtida kezib yurgan, oddiy oziq-ovqat sovg'alarida yashayotgan; ammo u doimo toza, taralgan va nafis, beg'ubor kiyimda, tik turgan va atrofida xuddi havoda sirg'alib yugurgandek harakatsiz nimadir bilan tasvirlangan.

en: This alone has made him unreal and incredible to many people who cannot distinguish the core of the story from the orna- mental and unwise additions of the unintelligently devout.
uz: Bu uning yolg'iz o'zi uni voqeliksiz va aql bovar qilmas dindorlarning aqliy va bema'ni qo'shimchalaridan hikoyaning mohiyatini ajrata olmaydigan ko'pchilik uchun aql bovar qilmas va aql bovar qilmas qilib qo'ydi.

en: We are left, if we do strip this record of these difﬁcult accessories, with the ﬁgure of a being, very human, very earnest and passionate, capable of swift anger, and teaching a new and simple and profound doctrine—namely, the universal loving Fatherhood of God and the coming of the Kingdom of Heaven.
uz: Agar biz bu qiyin aksessuarlardan ushbu yozuvni yechsak, juda insoniy, juda jiddiy va ehtirosli, tez g'azablanishga qodir bo'lgan va yangi va oddiy va chuqur ta'limotni o'rgatadigan mavjudot qiyofasida qoldik  ya'ni, Xudoning umumjahon mehribon Otaligi va Osmon Shohligining kelishi.

en: He was clearly a person—to use a common phrase—of intense personal magnetism.
uz: U aniqki, keng tarqalgan ibora bilan aytganda, kuchli shaxsiy magnitizmga ega odam edi.

en: He attracted followers and ﬁlled them with love and courage.
uz: U izdoshlarini jalb qildi va ularni sevgi va jasorat bilan to'ldirdi.

en: Weak and ailing people were heartened and healed by his pres- ence.
uz: Zaif va kasal odamlar uning huzurida ruhlanishdi va shifo topishdi.

en: Yet he was probably of a delicate physique, because of the swiftness with which he died under the pains of cruciﬁxion.
uz: Lekin u, ehtimol, nozik tanasi bo'lgan, xochga mixlash azoblari ostida tez o'lganligi sababli.

en: There is a tradition that he fainted when, according to the custom, he was made to bear his cross to the place of execution.
uz: An'anaga ko'ra, u odatga ko'ra, xochini qatl joyiga olib borishga majbur qilinganda hushidan ketgan.

en: He went about the country for three years spreading his doctrine and then he came to Jerusalem and was accused of trying to set up a strange kingdom in Judea; he was tried upon this charge, and cruciﬁed together with two thieves.
uz: U uch yil davomida yurt bo'ylab o'z ta'limotlarini tarqatdi, so'ngra Quddusga keldi va Yahudiyada g'alati shohlik o'rnatishga urinayotganlikda ayblanib, shu ayblovga ko'ra sud qilindi va ikki o'g'ri bilan birga xochga mixlandi.

en: Long before these two were dead his sufferings were over.
uz: Bu ikkalasi ham o'lishidan ancha oldin uning azoblari tugadi.

en: The doctrine of the Kingdom of Heaven, which was the main teaching of Jesus, is certainly one of the most revolutionary doctrines that ever stirred and changed human thought.
uz: Iso Masihning asosiy ta'limoti bo'lgan Osmon Shohligi ta'limoti, shubhasiz, insoniyat fikrini qo'zg'atgan va o'zgartirgan eng inqilobiy ta'limotlardan biridir.

en: It is small wonder if the world of that time failed to grasp its full signiﬁcance, and recoiled in dismay from even a half apprehension of its tremendous challenges to the established habits and in- stitutions of mankind.
uz: O'sha davrdagi dunyo o'zining to'liq ahamiyatini anglab yetmagan bo'lsa, va insoniyatning o'rnatilgan odatlari va institutsiyalariga qarshi ulkan muammolarini yarim his qilishdan xavotirda orqaga chekingan bo'lsa, bu kichik ajabdir.

en: For the doctrine of the Kingdom of Heaven, as Jesus seems to have preached it, was no less than a bold and uncompromising de- mand for a complete change and cleansing of the life of our struggling race, an utter cleansing, without and within.
uz: Chunki Iso Masih va'z qilganidek, Osmon Shohligi ta'limoti, kurashayotgan irqimiz hayotini butunlay o'zgartirish va tozalash uchun jasur va murosasiz topshiriqdan kam emas edi, butunlay tozalash, tashqaridan ham, ichkaridan ham.

en: To the gospels the reader must go for all that is preserved of this tremendous teaching; here we are only con- cerned with the jar of its impact upon established ideas.
uz: Injillarga o'quvchi ushbu ulkan ta'limotdan saqlanib qolgan hamma narsa uchun borishi kerak; bu yerda biz faqat uning o'rnatilgan g'oyalarga ta'sirining jarligi bilan shug'ullanamiz.

en: The Jews were persuaded that God, the one God of the whole world, was a righteous god, but they also thought of him as a trading god who had made a bargain with their Father Abraham about them, a very good bargain indeed for them, to bring them at last to predominance in the earth.
uz: Yahudiylar butun dunyoning yagona Xudosi bo'lgan Xudo adolatli xudo ekanligiga ishongan edilar, lekin uni otasi Ibrohim bilan ular haqida kelishuv tuzgan savdo xudosi sifatida ham o'ylashardi, bu ularga nihoyatda yer yuzida ustunlikka olib kelish uchun juda yaxshi kelishuv edi.

en: dismay and anger they heard Jesus sweeping away their dear securities.
uz: Hayrat va g'azabda ular Iso Masihning qimmatli qog'ozlarini olib ketayotganini eshitishdi.

en: God, he taught, was no bargainer; there were no chosen people and no favourites in the Kingdom of Heaven.
uz: Xudo, u o'rgatdi, savdochi emas edi; Osmon Shohligida tanlangan odamlar ham, sevimlilar ham yo'q edi.

en: God was the loving father of all life, as incapable of showing favour as the universal sun.
uz: Xudo barcha hayotning mehribon otasi edi, universal quyosh kabi mehr ko'rsatishga qodir emas edi.

en: And all men were brothers—sinners alike and beloved sons alike—of this divine father.
uz: Va barcha odamlar bu ilohiy otaning aka-ukalari edi  gunohkorlar ham, sevikli o'g'illar ham.

en: In the parable of the Good Samaritan Jesus cast scorn upon that natural tendency we all obey, to glorify our own people and to minimize the righteousness of other creeds and other races.
uz: Yaxshi samariyalik Iso haqidagi masalda biz hammamiz o'z xalqimizni ulug'lash va boshqa e'tiqodlar va irqlarning solihligini kamaytirish uchun itoat qiladigan tabiiy moyillikka haqorat bilan qaralgan.

en: In the parable of the labourers he thrust aside the obstinate claim of the Jews to have a special claim upon God.
uz: Mehnatkashlar haqidagi masalda u yahudiylarning Xudoga alohida da'vo qilish haqidagi qat'iy da'vosini chetga surdi.

en: All whom God takes into the kingdom, he taught, God serves alike; there is no distinc- tion in his treatment, because there is no measure to his bounty.
uz: Xudo kimni shohlikka qabul qilsa, Xudo bir xil xizmat qiladi, deb o'rgatdi u; Uning muomalasida hech qanday farq yo'q, chunki Uning marhamatiga hech qanday o'lchov yo'q.

en: From all moreover, as the parable of the buried talent witnesses, and as the incident of the widow’s mite enforces, he demands the utmost.
uz: Bundan tashqari, dafn etilgan iste'dodlar haqidagi masal guvohlaridek va bevaning o'limi voqeasi kuchga kirganidek, u eng yuqori talabni qo'yadi.

en: There are no privi- leges, no rebates and no excuses in the Kingdom of Heaven.
uz: Osmon Shohligida hech qanday imtiyozlar, chegirmalar va bahonalar yo'q.

en: EARLY IDEAL PORTRAIT, IN GILDED GLASS, OF JESUS CHRIST IN WHICH THE TRADITIONAL BEARD IS NOT SHOWN
uz: ENG YAXSHI IDEAL PORTRAY, TILLAY ShISHADA, Iso Masihning an'anaviy soqol ko'rsatilmagan joyida.

en: But it is not only the intense tribal patriotism of the Jews that Jesus out- raged.
uz: Lekin Iso faqat yahudiylarning kuchli qabilaviy vatanparvarligini g'azablantirgani yo'q.

en: They were a people of intense family loyalty, and he would have swept away all the narrow and restrictive family affections in the great ﬂood of the love of God.
uz: Ular kuchli oilaviy sadoqatli xalq edilar va u Xudoning buyuk muhabbat to'fonida barcha tor va cheklovchi oilaviy mehr-muhabbatni yo'q qilgan bo'lardi.

en: The whole kingdom of Heaven was to be the family of his followers.
uz: Butun Osmon saltanati uning izdoshlarining oilasi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: We are told that, “While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
uz: Bizga aytilishicha, U hali xalq bilan gaplashayotganida, mana, onasi va aka-ukalari tashqarida turib, u bilan gaplashmoqchi edilar.

en: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, de- siring to speak with thee.
uz: Shunda bir kishi unga dedi: Mana, onang va akalaring tashqarida turibdi, sen bilan gaplashishni xohlashyapti.

en: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother?
uz: Ammo u javob berib, unga aytgan odamga dedi: Onam kim?

en: and who are my brethren?
uz: Va mening birodarlarim kimlar?

en: And he stretched forth his hands towards his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
uz: Va u shogirdlariga qo'llarini cho'zdi va dedi: Mana onam va akalarim!

en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.?
uz: Kimki osmondagi Otamning irodasini qilsa, u mening akam, singlim va onamdir.

en: [1] THE ROAD FROM NAZARETH TO TIBERIAS  Photo: Fannaway And not only did Jesus strike at patriotism and the bonds of family loyal- ty in the name of God’s universal fatherhood and brotherhood of all mankind, but it is clear that his teaching condemned all the gradations of the economic system, all private wealth, and personal advantages.
uz: [1] NAZARETDAN TIBERIYAGA YO'L Surat: Fannaway Va nafaqat Iso Masih vatanparvarlikka va Xudoning nomidan butun insoniyatning universal otaligi va birodarligiga sodiq oilaviy aloqalarga zarba berdi, balki uning ta'limoti iqtisodiy tizimning barcha darajalarini, barcha shaxsiy boyliklarni va shaxsiy afzalliklarni qoralaganligi aniq.

en: All men belonged to the kingdom; all their possessions belonged to the kingdom; the
uz: Barcha odamlar qirollikka tegishli edi; ularning barcha mol-mulklari qirollikka tegishli edi;

en: righteous life for all men, the only righteous life, was the service of God’s will with all that we had, with all that we were.
uz: Barcha odamlar uchun adolatli hayot, yagona adolatli hayot, bizda bor bo'lgan hamma narsa bilan Xudoning irodasiga xizmat qilish edi.

en: Again and again he de- nounced private riches and the reservation of any private life.
uz: U qayta-qayta shaxsiy boyliklarni va har qanday shaxsiy hayotni himoya qilishni bekor qildi.

en: DAVID’S TOWER AND WALL OF JERUSALEM  Photo: Fannaway “And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may in- herit eternal life?
uz: Dovudning QIRUSHOLIM TOWARI VA DEVORI Surat: Fannaway Va u yolga chiqqach, bir kishi yugurib kelib, unga tiz chokdi va soradi: Yaxshi Ustoz, abadiy hayotga merosxor bolish uchun nima qilsam boladi?

en: And Jesus said to him, Why callest thou me good?
uz: Iso unga dedi: Nega meni yaxshi deb atayapsan?

en: there is none good but one, that is God.
uz: Yaxshilik faqat bitta, ya'ni Xudodan boshqa hech kimda yo'q.

en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, De- fraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
uz: Sen amrlarni bilasan: Zinokorlik qilma, O'ldirma, O'g'irlik qilma, Yolg'on guvohlik berma, Aldov qilma, Ota-onangni hurmat qil.

en: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these things have I observed from my youth.
uz: Va u javob berib unga dedi: Ustoz, bularning hammasini yoshligimdan saqlab kelaman.

en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest; go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven; and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
uz: Shunda Iso uni sevib ko'rib, unga dedi: Senga bir narsa yetishmayapti; bor, bor narsangni sot va kambag'allarga ber, shunda osmonda xazinang bo'ladi; keyin kelib xochni ol va menga ergashing.

en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved; for he had great possessions.
uz: U bu gapdan xafa bo'ldi va xafa bo'lib ketdi, chunki uning boyligi juda katta edi.

en: A STREET IN JERUSALEM  Along such a thoroughfare Christ carried his cross to the place of execution
uz: Quddusdagi ko'cha Shunday yo'l bo'ylab Iso Masih o'z xochini qatl joyiga olib bordi.

en: Photo: Fannaway “And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the Kingdom of God!
uz: Surat: Fannaway Va Iso atrofga qaradi va shogirdlariga dedi: Qanday qiyinki, boylar Xudoning Shohligiga kiradilar!

en: And the disciples were astonished at his words.
uz: Shogirdlar uning so'zlaridan hayratda qoldilar.

en: But Jesus answered again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!
uz: Ammo Iso yana javob berib, ularga dedi: Ey bolalar, boylikka ishonadiganlar uchun Xudoning Shohligiga kirish naqadar qiyin!

en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.” [2] Moreover, in his tremendous prophecy of this kingdom which was to make all men one together in God, Jesus had small patience for the bargain- ing righteousness of formal religion.
uz: Tuyaning igna teshigidan o'tishi boy odamning Xudoning Shohligiga kirishiga qaraganda osonroqdir. Bundan tashqari, Iso Masih barcha odamlarni Xudo ichida birlashtiradigan bu shohlik haqidagi ulkan bashoratida rasmiy dinning adolatli kelishuviga nisbatan ozgina sabr qildi.

en: Another large part of his recorded ut- terances is aimed against the meticulous observance of the rules of the pi- ous career.
uz: Uning qayd etilgan amaliyotlarining yana bir katta qismi pi-ous karerasi qoidalariga ehtiyotkorlik bilan rioya qilishga qaratilgan.

en: “Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with un- washen hands?
uz: Shunda farziylar va ulamolar undan so'radilar: Nega shogirdlaring oqsoqollarning urf-odatlariga muvofiq yurishmaydi, balki yuvilmagan qo'llar bilan non yeyishadi?

en: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Isaiah prophe- sied of you hypocrites, as it is written, “This people honoureth me with their lips, “But their heart is far from me.
uz: U javob berib ularga dedi: Shunday qilib, Ishayo siz munofiqlar haqida payg'ambarlik qildi, chunki shunday yozilgan: 'Bu xalq meni lablari bilan hurmat qiladi, lekin ularning qalbi mendan uzoq.'

en: “Howbeit in vain do they worship me, “Teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
uz: Garchi behuda menga sig'inishsa ham, Inson amrlarini ta'limot sifatida o'rgatishmoqda.

en: “For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such things ye do.
uz: Chunki Xudoning amrini chetga surib, odamlarning urf-odatlarini idish va kosalarni yuvishga o'xshab tutasizlar va shunga o'xshash ko'p narsalarni ham qilasizlar.

en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.” [3] It was not merely a moral and a social revolution that Jesus proclaimed; it is clear from a score of indications that his teaching had a political bent of the plainest sort.
uz: U ularga dedi: Xudoning amrini rad etinglar, o'z an'analaringizni saqlanglar. [3] Iso faqat axloqiy va ijtimoiy inqilob e'lon qilgan emas edi; ko'plab ko'rsatmalardan ko'rinib turibdiki, uning ta'limoti eng ochiq siyosiy moyillikka ega edi.

en: It is true that he said his kingdom was not of this world, that it was in the hearts of men and not upon a throne; but it is equally clear that wherever and in what measure his kingdom was set up in the hearts of men, the outer world would be in that measure revolutionized and made new.
uz: U o'zining shohligi bu dunyodan emasligini, u odamlarning yuragida va taxtda emasligini aytgani rost; lekin uning shohligi odamlarning yuragida qayerda va qanday darajada o'rnatilsa, tashqi dunyo shu darajada inqilob qilingan va yangilashtirilgan bo'lishi ham aniq.

en: Whatever else the deafness and blindness of his hearers may have missed in his utterances, it is plain they did not miss his resolve to revolutionize the world.
uz: Uning nutqlarida tinglovchilarining karligi va ko'rligi nimani o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lsa, ular dunyoni inqilob qilishdagi qat'iyatini o'tkazib yubormaganlari aniq.

en: The whole tenor of the opposition to him and the circumstances of
uz: Unga qarshi bo'lgan muxolifatning butun tenderi va vaziyatlari.

en: his trial and execution show clearly that to his contemporaries he seemed to propose plainly, and did propose plainly, to change and fuse and enlarge all human life.
uz: Uning sudlanishi va qatl etilishi shuni aniq ko'rsatadiki, u o'z zamondoshlariga butun insoniy hayotni o'zgartirish, birlashtirish va kengaytirishni aniq taklif qilgan va qilgan.

en: In view of what he plainly said, is it any wonder that all who were rich and prosperous felt a horror of strange things, a swimming of their world at his teaching?
uz: Uning aniq aytganlariga ko'ra, boy va farovon bo'lganlarning barchasi g'alati narsalarning dahshatini his qilishlari, uning ta'limotida o'z dunyosining suzishi ajablanarli emasmi?

en: He was dragging out all the little private reservations they had made from social service into the light of a universal religious life.
uz: U ijtimoiy xizmatdan qilgan barcha kichik shaxsiy bandlarini umuminsoniy diniy hayotga olib kirayotgan edi.

en: He was like some terrible moral huntsman digging mankind out of the snug burrows in which they had lived hitherto.
uz: U xuddi dahshatli axloqiy ovchi kabi insoniyatni shu paytgacha yashagan o'tkir chuqurlardan chiqarib tashlagan edi.

en: In the white blaze of this kingdom of his there was to be no property, no privilege, no pride and precedence; no mo- tive indeed and no reward but love.
uz: Uning bu saltanatining oq alangasida hech qanday mulk, imtiyoz, g'urur va ustunlik bo'lmas edi; haqiqatan ham, hech qanday motivatsiya va faqat sevgi mukofot bo'lmas edi.

en: Is it any wonder that men were dazzled and blinded and cried out against him?
uz: Odamlarning ko'zlarini qamashtirib, ko'r bo'lib, unga qarshi qichqirishlari ajablanarli emasmi?

en: Even his disciples cried out when he would not spare them the light.
uz: Hatto shogirdlari ham u ularga nurni ayamasdan faryod qilishdi.

en: Is it any wonder that the priests realized that between this man and themselves there was no choice but that he or priest- craft should perish?
uz: Nahotki ruhoniylar bu odam bilan o'zlari o'rtasida o'zi yoki ruhoniylik kasbi halok bo'lishidan boshqa iloj yo'qligini anglab yetgan bo'lsalar?

en: Is it any wonder that the Roman soldiers, confronted and amazed by something soaring over their comprehension and threatening all their disciplines, should take refuge in wild laughter, and crown him with thorns and robe him in purple and make a mock Cæsar of him?
uz: Rim askarlari, o'zlarining tushunishlaridan oshib ketayotgan va barcha fanlariga tahdid solayotgan nimadirga duch kelib hayratda qolishsa, yovvoyi kulgiga qochishlari, uni tikanlar bilan tojlashlari, binafsha rangda kiydirishlari va undan masxara qilishlari ajablanarli emasmi?

en: For to take him seriously was to enter upon a strange and alarming life, to abandon habits, to control instincts and impulses, to essay an incredible happiness.
uz: Uni jiddiy qabul qilish g'alati va xavotirli hayotga kirish, odatlardan voz kechish, instinktlar va impulslarni nazorat qilish, aql bovar qilmas baxtni sinab ko'rish edi.

en: XXXVIII THE DEVELOPMENT OF DOCTRINAL CHRISTIANITY In the four gospels we ﬁnd the personality and teachings of Jesus but very little of the dogmas of the Christian church.
uz: XXXVIII DOKTRINAL XRISTIANLIK TANLOVSI To'rtta Injilda Iso Masihning shaxsiyati va ta'limotlarini topamiz, lekin xristian cherkovining dogmalarini juda kam topamiz.

en: It is in the epistles, a series of writings by the immediate followers of Jesus, that the broad lines of Christ- ian belief are laid down.
uz: Aynan Iso Masihning bevosita izdoshlari tomonidan yozilgan maktublarda Iso Masihning keng e'tiqodlari bayon etilgan.

en: Chief among the makers of Christian doctrine was St.
uz: Xristian ta'limoti yaratuvchilari orasida boshliq avliyo edi.

en: He had never seen Jesus nor heard him preach.
uz: U Iso Masihni hech qachon ko'rmagan va uning va'z qilganini eshitmagan edi.

en: Paul’s name was originally Saul, and he was conspicuous at ﬁrst as an active persecutor of the little band of disciples after the cruciﬁxion.
uz: Pavlusning ismi asl nusxada Shoul edi va u xochga mixlangandan keyin shogirdlarning kichik guruhini faol ta'qib qiluvchi sifatida dastlab ko'zga tashlandi.

en: Then he was suddenly converted to Christianity, and he changed his name to Paul.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan xristianlikka o'tdi va o'z ismini Pavlus deb o'zgartirdi.

en: He was a man of great intellectual vigour and deeply and passionately interested in the religious movements of the time.
uz: U buyuk intellektual g'ayratga ega va o'sha davr diniy harakatlariga chuqur va ehtirosli qiziqqan odam edi.

en: He was well versed in Judaism and in the Mithraism and Alexandrian reli- gion of the day.
uz: U yahudiylik va o'sha davrdagi Mitraizm va Iskandariya diniga yaxshi ega edi.

en: He carried over many of their ideas and terms of expression into Christianity.
uz: U ularning ko'plab g'oyalari va ifoda atamalarini xristianlikka olib kirdi.

en: He did very little to enlarge or develop the original teach- ing of Jesus, the teaching of the Kingdom of Heaven.
uz: U Iso Masihning asl ta'limotini, Osmon Shohligi ta'limotini kengaytirish yoki rivojlantirish uchun juda oz ish qildi.

en: But he taught that Je- sus was not only the promised Christ, the promised leader of the Jews, but also that his death was a sacriﬁce, like the deaths of the ancient sacriﬁcial victims of the primordial civilizations, for the redemption of mankind.
uz: Lekin u Je-sus nafaqat va'da qilingan Masih, yahudiylarning va'da qilingan yetakchisi ekanligini, balki uning o'limi ham, qadimgi sivilizatsiyalarning qadimgi qurbonlik qurbonlarining o'limlari kabi, insoniyatni qutqarish uchun qurbonlik ekanligini o'rgatdi.

en: When religions ﬂourish side by side they tend to pick up each other’s cer- emonial and other outward peculiarities.
uz: Dinlar yonma-yon gullab-yashnaganida, ular bir-birlarining ma'naviy va boshqa tashqi o'ziga xosliklarini qabul qilishga moyil bo'lishadi.

en: Buddhism, for example, in China has now almost the same sort of temples and priests and uses as Taoism, which follows in the teachings of Lao Tse.
uz: Masalan, Xitoyda buddizm hozirda Lao Tse ta'limotlariga amal qiladigan Taoizm kabi deyarli bir xil turdagi ibodatxonalar va ruhoniylarga ega.

en: Yet the original teachings of Buddhism and Taoism were almost ﬂatly opposed.
uz: Shunga qaramay, buddizm va taoizmning asl ta'limotlari deyarli butunlay qarama-qarshi edi.

en: And it reﬂects no doubt
uz: Va bu hech qanday shubha bilan aks etmaydi.

en: or discredit upon the essentials of Christian teaching that it took over not merely such formal things as the shaven priest, the votive offering, the al- tars, candles, chanting and images of the Alexandrian and Mithraic faiths, but adopted even their devotional phrases and their theological ideas.
uz: yoki xristian ta'limotining mohiyatiga shubha keltirib, u nafaqat qirilgan ruhoniy, qasamyod, al-tars, shamlar, Aleksandriya va Mitriy e'tiqodlarining qo'shiq aytish va tasvirlari kabi rasmiy narsalarni o'z zimmasiga oldi, balki hatto ularning ibodat iboralari va teologik g'oyalarini ham qabul qildi.

en: All these religions were ﬂourishing side by side with many less prominent cults.
uz: Bu dinlarning barchasi ko'plab kamroq mashhur kultlar bilan birga gullab-yashnadi.

en: Each was seeking adherents, and there must have been a constant go- ing and coming of converts between them.
uz: Har biri izdosh izlayotgan edi va ular o'rtasida doimiy ravishda mo'minlar kirib kelayotgan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Sometimes one or other would be in favour with the government.
uz: Ba'zan bir yoki ikkinchisi hukumatga yoqadi.

en: But Christianity was regarded with more suspicion than its rivals because, like the Jews, its adherents would not per- form acts of worship to the God Cæsar.
uz: Ammo xristianlik o'z raqiblaridan ko'ra ko'proq shubha bilan qaralgan, chunki yahudiylar singari uning tarafdorlari Sezar Xudosiga sig'inish harakatlarini amalga oshirmas edilar.

en: This made it a seditious religion, quite apart from the revolutionary spirit of the teachings of Jesus himself.
uz: Bu uni Iso Masihning o'zining ta'limotlarining inqilobiy ruhidan butunlay farq qilib, fitnachi dinga aylantirdi.

en: PETER AND PAUL POINTING TO A THRONE, ON GOLD BACKGROUND  From the Ninth Century original, in the Church of Sta.
uz: Pyotr va Pavlus taxtiga ishora qilish, oltin fonda To'qqizinchi asrdagi asl nusxadan, St cherkovida.

en: Prassede, Rome  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) St.
uz: Prassede, Rim (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) Ko'chada.

en: Paul familiarized his disciples with the idea that Jesus, like Osiris, was a god who died to rise again and give men immortality.
uz: Pavlus shogirdlariga Iso Masih, Osiris kabi, tirilish va odamlarga o'lmaslik berish uchun o'lgan xudo degan fikrni tanishtirdi.

en: And presently the spreading Christian community was greatly torn by complicated theo- logical disputes about the relationship of this God Jesus to God the Father of Mankind.
uz: Va hozirgi vaqtda tarqalgan xristian jamiyati bu Xudoning Iso Masihning insoniyat Otasi Xudoga bo'lgan munosabati haqidagi murakkab mantiqiy bahslar tufayli sezilarli darajada parchalanib ketdi.

en: The Arians taught that Jesus was divine, but distant from and inferior to the Father.
uz: Ariylar Iso Masih ilohiy, lekin Otadan uzoqda va undan past ekanligini o'rgatishardi.

en: The Sabellians taught that Jesus was merely an aspect of the Father, and that God was Jesus and Father at the same time just as a man may be a father and an artiﬁcer at the same time; and the Trinitarians taught a more subtle doctrine that God was both one and three, Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
uz: Sabelliylar Iso Masihning faqatgina Otaning bir jihati ekanligini va Xudo bir vaqtning o'zida Iso va Ota bo'lganini, xuddi inson bir vaqtning o'zida ota va sun'iy yaratgan odam bo'lishi mumkinligini o'rgatdilar; va Trinitiylar Xudo bir va uch, Ota, O'g'il va Muqaddas Ruh ekanligi haqida yanada nozik ta'limot o'rgatdilar.

en: For a time it seemed that Arianism would prevail over its rivals, and then after disputes, violence and wars, the Trinitarian formula became the accepted formula of all Christendom.
uz: Bir vaqtlar arianlik o'z raqiblaridan ustun keladi deb tuyuldi, keyin bahslar, zo'ravonlik va urushlardan so'ng, Trinitian formula butun xristianlikning qabul qilingan formulasiga aylandi.

en: It may be found in its completest expression in the Athanasian Creed.
uz: Uni o'zining eng to'liq ifodasida Afinaz e'tiqodida topish mumkin.

en: We offer no comment on these controversies here.
uz: Biz bu bahslarga hech qanday izoh bermaymiz.

en: They do not sway his- tory as the personal teaching of Jesus sways history.
uz: Ular Iso Masihning shaxsiy ta'limoti tarixni tebratganidek, uning o'zini ham tebratmaydilar.

en: The personal teaching of Jesus does seem to mark a new phase in the moral and spiritual life of our race.
uz: Isoning shaxsiy ta'limoti irqimizning axloqiy va ma'naviy hayotida yangi bosqichni belgilaganga o'xshaydi.

en: Its insistence upon the universal Fatherhood of God and the im- plicit brotherhood of all men, its insistence upon the sacredness of every hu- man personality as a living temple of God, was to have the profoundest ef- fect upon all the subsequent social and political life of mankind.
uz: Uning Xudoning universal Otaligiga va barcha insonlarning bevosita birodarligiga, har bir inson shaxsiyatining Xudoning tirik ibodatxonasi sifatida muqaddasligiga bo'lgan qat'iy ta'siri insoniyatning keyingi ijtimoiy va siyosiy hayotiga eng chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatishi kerak edi.

en: With Christianity, with the spreading teachings of Jesus, a new respect appears in the world for man as man.
uz: Xristianlik bilan, Iso Masihning tarqalgan ta'limotlari bilan dunyoda inson uchun inson sifatida yangi hurmat paydo bo'ldi.

en: It may be true, as hostile critics of Christianity have urged, that St..
uz: Xristianlikning dushman tanqidchilari ta'kidlaganidek, Muqaddas...

en: Paul preached obedience to slaves, but it is equally true that the whole spirit of the teachings of Jesus preserved in the gospels was against the subjugation of man by man.
uz: Pavlus qullarga itoatkorlikni va'z qilgan, ammo Injillarda saqlanib qolgan Iso Masihning ta'limotlarining butun ruhi insonning inson tomonidan bo'ysundirilishiga qarshi ekanligi ham xuddi shunday to'g'ri.

en: And still more distinctly was Chris- tianity opposed to such outrages upon human dignity as the gladiatorial combats in the arena.
uz: Va yanada aniqrog'i, Chris- Tianity maydondagi gladiatorlik janglari kabi insoniy qadr-qimmatga nisbatan bunday haqoratlarga qarshi edi.

en: THE BAPTISM OF CHRIST  (Sixth Century Ivory Panel in the British Museum) Throughout the ﬁrst two centuries after Christ, the Christian religion spread throughout the Roman Empire, weaving together an ever-growing multitude of converts into a new community of ideas and will.
uz: XRISTMANING BOTMTIZMASI (Britaniya muzeyining oltinchi asrdagi fil suyagi paneli) Masihdan keyingi birinchi ikki asrda xristian dini Rim imperiyasi bo'ylab tarqaldi va doimiy ravishda o'sib borayotgan ko'p sonli konvertatsiyachilarni yangi g'oyalar va iroda jamiyatiga birlashtirdi.

en: The attitude of the emperors varied between hostility and toleration.
uz: Imperatorlarning munosabatlari dushmanlik va bag'rikenglik o'rtasida har xil edi.

en: There were at- tempts to suppress this new faith in both the second and third centuries; and ﬁnally in 303 and the following years a great persecution under the Emper- or Diocletian.
uz: Ikkinchi va uchinchi asrlarda bu yangi e'tiqodni bostirishga vasvasalar bo'ldi; va nihoyat 303 va undan keyingi yillarda imperator yoki Diokletian ostida katta ta'qib bo'ldi.

en: The considerable accumulations of Church property were seized, all bibles and religious writings were conﬁscated and destroyed, Christians were put out of the protection of the law and many executed.
uz: Cherkov mulklarining sezilarli miqdorlari musodara qilindi, barcha Injillar va diniy yozuvlar musodara qilindi va yo'q qilindi, xristianlar qonun himoyasidan chetlashtirildi va ko'pchilik qatl etildi.

en: destruction of the books is particularly notable.
uz: Kitoblarning yo'q qilinishi ayniqsa diqqatga sazovor.

en: It shows how the power of the written word in holding together the new faith was appreciated by the authorities.
uz: Bu yangi e'tiqodni ushlab turishda yozma so'zning kuchi hokimiyatlar tomonidan qanday qadrlanganini ko'rsatadi.

en: These “book religions,” Christianity and Judaism, were reli- gions that educated.
uz: Bu kitob dinlari, Xristianlik va Yahudiylik, talim beruvchi dinlar edi.

en: Their continued existence depended very largely on people being able to read and understand their doctrinal ideas.
uz: Ularning davomiyligi asosan odamlarning o'z ta'limot g'oyalarini o'qiy olishiga va tushunishiga bog'liq edi.

en: The older re- ligions had made no such appeal to the personal intelligence.
uz: Qadimgi qayta legionlar shaxsiy razvedkaga bunday murojaat qilmagan edi.

en: In the ages of barbaric confusion that were now at hand in western Europe it was the Christian church that was mainly instrumental in preserving the tradition of learning.
uz: G'arbiy Yevropada hozirgi barbarik chalkashlik davrida asosan ta'lim an'anasini saqlab qolishda xristian cherkovi muhim rol o'ynadi.

en: The persecution of Diocletian failed completely to suppress the growing Christian community.
uz: Diokletianning ta'qiblari o'sib borayotgan xristian jamiyatini to'liq bostirishga muvaffaq bo'lmadi.

en: In many provinces it was ineffective because the bulk of the population and many of the ofﬁcials were Christian.
uz: Ko'pgina viloyatlarda bu samarasiz edi, chunki aholining katta qismi va ko'p amaldorlar xristian edi.

en: In 317 an edict of toleration was issued by the associated Emperor Galerius, and in 324 Constantine the Great, a friend and on his deathbed a baptized convert to Christianity, became sole ruler of the Roman world.
uz: 317-yilda hamkorlikdagi imperator Galeriy tomonidan bag'rikenglik hukmi chiqarildi va 324-yilda do'sti va o'lim to'shagida suvga cho'mgan nasroniy bo'lgan Buyuk Konstantin Rim olamining yagona hukmdori bo'ldi.

en: He abandoned all di- vine pretensions and put Christian symbols on the shields and banners of his troops.
uz: U barcha aldovlardan voz kechdi va qo'shinlarining qalqonlari va bayroqlariga xristian ramzlarini qo'ydi.

en: In a few years Christianity was securely established as the ofﬁcial reli- gion of the empire.
uz: Bir necha yil ichida xristianlik imperiyaning rasmiy dini sifatida mustahkam o'rnatildi.

en: The competing religions disappeared or were absorbed with extraordinary celerity, and in 300 Theodosius the Great caused the great statue of Jupiter Serapis at Alexandria to be destroyed.
uz: Raqobatchi dinlar g'oyib bo'ldi yoki g'ayrioddiy tezkorlik bilan o'zlashtirildi va 300-yilda Buyuk Teodosiy Iskandariyadagi Yupiter Serapisning buyuk haykalini yo'q qilishga majbur qildi.

en: From the out- set of the ﬁfth century onward the only priests or temples in the Roman Em- pire were Christian priests and temples.
uz: Beshinchi asrning oxiridan boshlab Rim imperiyasida yagona ruhoniylar yoki ibodatxonalar xristian ruhoniylar va ibodatxonalar edi.

en: XXXIX THE BARBARIANS BREAK THE EMPIRE INTO EAST AND WEST Throughout the third century the Roman Empire, decaying socially and dis- integrating morally, faced the barbarians.
uz: XXXIX BARBARLAR SHARQ VA G'ARBGA IMPERIYANI YO'QOTADI. Uchinchi asr davomida Rim imperiyasi ijtimoiy jihatdan parchalanib, axloqiy jihatdan integratsiya bo'lmay, varvarlarga duch keldi.

en: The emperors of this period were ﬁghting military autocrats, and the capital of the empire shifted with the ne- cessities of their military policy.
uz: Bu davr imperatorlari harbiy avtokratlarga qarshi kurashayotgan edi va imperiyaning poytaxti ularning harbiy siyosatining keskinligi bilan siljigan edi.

en: Now the imperial headquarters would be at Milan in north Italy, now in what is now Serbia at Sirmium or Nish, now in Nicomedia in Asia Minor.
uz: Endi imperatorlik shtab-kvartirasi Italiyaning shimoliy qismidagi Milanda bo'lardi, hozir hozirgi Serbiya, hozirgi Sirmium yoki Nishda, hozirgi Kichik Osiyodagi Nikomedyada.

en: Rome halfway down Italy was too far from the centre of interest to be a convenient imperial seat.
uz: Rim Italiyaning yarmigacha bo'lgan yo'lda, diqqat markazidan ancha uzoqda edi, hatto qulay imperatorlik o'rniga ham.

en: It was a declining city.
uz: Bu tanazzulga uchrayotgan shahar edi.

en: Over most of the empire peace still prevailed and men went about without arms.
uz: Imperiyaning ko'p qismida tinchlik hukm surardi va odamlar qurolsiz yurardi.

en: The armies continued to be the sole repositories of power; the emper- ors, dependent on their legions, became more and more autocratic to the rest of the empire and their state more and more like that of the Persian and other oriental monarchs.
uz: Armiyalar hokimiyatning yagona omborlari bo'lib qolishda davom etdi; o'z legionlariga bog'liq bo'lgan imperator, imperiyaning qolgan qismiga va ularning davlatiga tobora ko'proq avtokratik bo'lib, Fors va boshqa sharq monarxlariga o'xshab bordi.

en: Diocletian assumed a royal diadem and oriental robes.
uz: Diokletian qirollik diametri va sharqona liboslarni qabul qildi.

en: All along the imperial frontier, which ran roughly along the Rhine and Danube, enemies were now pressing.
uz: Rim va Dunay daryolari bo'ylab taxminan o'tgan imperiya chegarasi bo'ylab dushmanlar endi bosim o'tkazayotgan edi.

en: The Franks and other German tribes had come up to the Rhine.
uz: Franklar va boshqa nemis qabilalari Reyn daryosiga yetib kelgan edi.

en: In north Hungary were the Vandals; in what was once Dacia and is now Roumania, the Visigoths or West Goths.
uz: Vengriyaning shimolida vandallar bor edi; bir vaqtlar Dacia bo'lgan va hozirda Ruminiya bo'lgan hududda Visigotlar yoki G'arbiy Goatlar bor edi.

en: Behind these in south Russia were the East Goths or Ostrogoths, and beyond these again in the Volga region the Alans.
uz: Rossiyaning janubida bularning ortida Sharqiy Gotlar yoki Ostrogotlar bor edi, bundan tashqari Volga mintaqasida yana Alanslar bor edi.

en: But now Mongolian peoples were forc- ing their way towards Europe.
uz: Ammo endi moʻgʻul xalqlari Yevropaga tomon yoʻl olishni majburlashardi.

en: The Huns were already exacting tribute from the Alans and Ostrogoths and pushing them to the west.
uz: Hunlar allaqachon Alonlar va Ostrogotlardan soliq talab qilib, ularni g'arbga itarib yuborishardi.

en: In Asia the Roman frontiers were crumpling back under the push of a re- nascent Persia.
uz: Osiyoda Rim chegaralari qayta tug'ilgan Forsning bosimi ostida qaytib tushayotgan edi.

en: This new Persia, the Persia of the Sassenid kings, was to be a vigorous and on the whole a successful rival of the Roman Empire in Asia for the next three centuries.
uz: Bu yangi Fors, Sassinid shohlari Persiyasi, keyingi uch asr davomida Osiyodagi Rim imperiyasining kuchli va umuman olganda muvaffaqiyatli raqibi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: A glance at the map of Europe will show the reader the peculiar weak- ness of the empire.
uz: Yevropa xaritasiga bir nazar tashlash o'quvchiga imperiyaning o'ziga xos zaifligini ko'rsatadi.
