en: The river Danube comes down to within a couple of hundred miles of the Adriatic Sea in the region of what is now Bosnia and Serbia.
uz: Dunay daryosi Adriatik dengizidan bir necha yuz milya radiusga, hozirgi Bosniya va Serbiya hududida tushadi.

en: It makes a square re-entrant angle there.
uz: U yerda qayta kiruvchi kvadrat burchak hosil qiladi.

en: The Romans never kept their sea communications in good order, and this two hundred mile strip of land was their line of communication between the western Latin-speaking part of the empire and the eastern Greek-speaking portion.
uz: Rimliklar hech qachon dengiz aloqalarini yaxshi holatda saqlamagan va bu ikki yuz millik quruqlik chizig'i ularning imperiyaning g'arbiy lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi qismi va sharqiy yunon tilida so'zlashuvchi qismi o'rtasidagi aloqa liniyasi edi.

en: Against this square angle of the Danube the barbarian pressure was greatest.
uz: Dunay daryosining shu kvadrat burchagiga nisbatan vahshiy bosim eng katta edi.

en: When they broke through there it was inevitable that the empire should fall into two parts.
uz: Ular u yerdan o'tib ketgach, imperiya ikki qismga bo'linishi muqarrar edi.

en: A more vigorous empire might have thrust forward and reconquered Da- cia, but the Roman Empire lacked any such vigour.
uz: Kuchliroq imperiya oldinga siljib, Da-ciyani qaytarib olishi mumkin edi, lekin Rim imperiyasi bunday kuchga ega emas edi.

en: Constantine the Great was certainly a monarch of great devotion and intelligence.
uz: Konstantin Buyuk, albatta, buyuk sadoqat va aql-idrokga ega monarx edi.

en: He beat back a raid of the Goths from just these vital Balkan regions, but he had no force to carry the frontier across the Danube.
uz: U Gotlarning bu muhim Bolqon hududlaridan bo'lgan hujumini qaytardi, lekin uning Dunay daryosidan o'tish uchun kuchi yo'q edi.

en: He was too pre-occupied with the in- ternal weaknesses of the empire.
uz: U imperiyaning ichki zaif tomonlari bilan juda oldindan band edi.

en: He brought the solidarity and moral force of Christianity to revive the spirit of the declining empire, and he decided to
uz: U xristianlikning birdamligi va axloqiy kuchini zaiflashuvchi imperiyaning ruhini jonlantirishga olib keldi va u qaror qildi:

en: create a new permanent capital at Byzantium upon the Hellespont.
uz: Vizantiyada, Hellespont ustida yangi doimiy poytaxt yaratish.

en: This new-made Byzantium, which was re-christened Constantinople in his hon- our, was still building when he died.
uz: Yangi yaratilgan Vizantiya, u o'z sharafiga Qustantiniyo deb qayta nomlangan edi, u vafot etganida ham qurilgan edi.

en: Towards the end of his reign occurred a remarkable transaction.
uz: Uning hukmronligi oxirida ajoyib bir voqea sodir bo'ldi.

en: The Vandals, being pressed by the Goths, asked to be received into the Roman Empire.
uz: Gotikalar tomonidan bosim o'tkazilgan vandallar Rim imperiyasiga qabul qilinishni so'rashdi.

en: They were assigned lands in Pannonia, which is now that part of Hungary west of the Danube, and their ﬁghting men became nominally legionaries.
uz: Ularga Pannoniyada yerlar tayinlandi, u hozirda Vengriyaning Dunay daryosidan g'arbda joylashgan qismi edi va ularning jangchi erkaklari nomiga ko'ra legionerlar bo'lishdi.

en: But these new legionaries remained un- der their own chiefs.
uz: Lekin bu yangi legionerlar o'z boshliqlaridan voz kechib qolishdi.

en: Rome failed to digest them.
uz: Rim ularni hazm qila olmadi.

en: Constantine died working to reorganize his great realm, and soon the frontiers were ruptured again and the Visigoths came almost to Constan- tinople.
uz: Konstantin o'zining buyuk saltanatini qayta tashkil etish uchun ishlayotganda vafot etdi, va tez orada chegaralar yana yorildi va Vizigotlar deyarli Konstan-Tinoplega kelishdi.

en: They defeated the Emperor Valens at Adrianople and made a settle- ment in what is now Bulgaria, similar to the settlement of the Vandals in Pannonia.
uz: Ular Adrianopolda imperator Valensni mag'lub etishdi va hozirgi Bolgariya hududidavandallarning Pannoniyadagi joylashuviga o'xshash kelishuvga erishdilar.

en: Nominally they were subjects of the emperor, practically they were conquerors.
uz: Nominal jihatdan ular imperatorning fuqarolari edi, amalda esa ular bosqinchilar edi.

en: CONSTANTINE’S PILLAR, CONSTANTINOPLE  Photo: Sebah & Foaillier From 379 to 395 A.D.
uz: KONSTANTINNING PILLARASI, KONSTANTINOPLE Surat: Sebah & Foaillier 379 dan 395 yilgacha.

en: reigned the Emperor Theodosius the Great, and while he reigned the empire was still formally intact.
uz: imperator Teodosiy Buyuk hukmronlik qilgan va u hukmronlik qilgan davrda imperiya rasman butun edi.

en: Over the armies of Italy and Pannonia presided Stilicho, a Vandal, over the armies in the Balkan peninsula, Alaric, a Goth.
uz: Italiya va Pannoniya armiyalariga Stilicho, vandali, Bolqon yarim orolidagi armiyalarga Alaric, got boshchilik qildi.

en: When Theodosius died at the close of the fourth century he left two sons.
uz: Teodosiy to'rtinchi asr oxirida vafot etganida, u ikki o'g'lini qoldirdi.

en: Alaric supported one of these, Arcadius, in Constantinople, and Stilicho the other, Honorius, in Italy.
uz: Alaric ulardan birini, Arkadiyni Konstantinopolda, Stilicho ikkinchisini, Honoriusni esa Italiyada qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: In other words Alaric and Stilicho fought for the empire with the princes as puppets.
uz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, Alaric va Stilicho imperatorlik uchun shahzodalar bilan qo'g'irchoq sifatida kurashdilar.

en: In the course of their struggle Alaric marched into Italy and after a short siege took Rome (410 A.D.).
uz: Ularning kurashi davomida Alaric Italiyaga hujum qildi va qisqa qamaldan so'ng Rimni egalladi (milodiy 410).

en: The opening half of the ﬁfth century saw the whole of the Roman Empire in Europe the prey of robber armies of barbarians.
uz: Beshinchi asrning birinchi yarmi butun Rim imperiyasini Yevropada varvarlarning qaroqchi armiyalarining o'ljasiga aylantirdi.

en: It is difﬁcult to visualize the state of affairs in the world at that time.
uz: O'sha davrdagi dunyo ahvolini tasavvur qilish qiyin.

en: Over France, Spain, Italy and the Balkan peninsula, the great cities that had ﬂourished under the early em- pire still stood, impoverished, partly depopulated and falling into decay.
uz: Fransiya, Ispaniya, Italiya va Bolqon yarim orolida erta zamonlarda gullab-yashnagan buyuk shaharlar hali ham qashshoq, qisman odamsizlantirilgan va parchalanishga aylanib borardi.

en: Life in them must have been shallow, mean and full of uncertainty.
uz: Ulardagi hayot sayoz, badjahl va noaniqlikka to'la bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Local ofﬁcials asserted their authority and went on with their work with such con- science as they had, no doubt in the name of a now remote and inaccessible emperor.
uz: Mahalliy amaldorlar o'z vakolatlarini tasdiqladilar va o'z ishlarini o'zlari bilgan bilim bilan davom ettirdilar, shubhasiz, endi uzoq va inaccessible imperator nomi bilan.

en: The churches went on, but usually with illiterate priests.
uz: Cherkovlar davom etdi, lekin odatda savodsiz ruhoniylar bilan.

en: There was little reading and much superstition and fear.
uz: O'qish kam edi, xurofot va qo'rquv ko'p edi.

en: But everywhere except where looters had destroyed them, books and pictures and statuary and such-like works of art were still to be found.
uz: Lekin talonchilar ularni yo'q qilgan joylardan tashqari, kitoblar, rasmlar, haykallar va shunga o'xshash san'at asarlari hali ham topilmas edi.

en: The life of the countryside had also degenerated.
uz: Qishloq hayoti ham buzilib ketgan edi.

en: Everywhere this Roman world was much more weedy and untidy than it had been.
uz: Bu Rim dunyosi hamma joyda avvalgisidan ko'ra ancha begona va tartibsiz edi.

en: In some regions war and pestilence had brought the land down to the level of a waste.
uz: Ba'zi hududlarda urush va o'lat yerlarni cho'l darajasiga olib keldi.

en: Roads and forests were infested with robbers.
uz: Yo'llar va o'rmonlar qaroqchilar bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

en: Into such regions the barbarians marched, with little or no opposition, and set up their chiefs as rulers, often with Roman ofﬁcial titles.
uz: Bunday hududlarga varvarlar kam yoki hech qanday qarshilik bilan yurishardi va o'z boshliqlarini ko'pincha Rim rasmiy unvonlari bilan hukmdor qilib tayinlashardi.

en: If they were half civilized barbarians they would give the conquered districts tolerable terms, they would take possession of the towns, associate and intermarry, and acquire (with an accent) the Latin speech; but the Jutes, the Angles and Saxons who submerged the Roman province of Britain were agriculturalists and had no use for towns, they seem to have swept south Britain clear of the Romanized population and they replaced the language by their own Teutonic dialects, which became at last English.
uz: Agar ular yarim madaniyatli vahshiylar bo'lishganida, bosib olingan tumanlarga chidab bo'lmaydigan shartlar berishardi, shaharlarni egallab olishardi, sherikchilik qilishardi va turmush qurishardi, lotin tilini (aksenti bilan) o'zlashtirishardi; lekin Britaniya Rim viloyatini suvga botirganjutlar, angllar va saksonlar qishloq xo'jaligichilar edi va shaharlar uchun hech qanday foyda yo'q edi, ular Britaniya janubini romanlashtirilgan aholidan tozalaganga o'xshaydi va tilni o'zlarining tektonik shevalari bilan almashtirdilar, ular nihoyat ingliz tiliga aylandi.

en: BASE OF THE “OBELISK OF THEODOSIUS,” CONSTANTINOPLE  The obelisk of Thothmes, taken from Egypt to Constantinople by Theodosius and placed upon the pedestal her shown; an interesting example of early Byzantine art.
uz: TEODOSIY OBELISKASINING ASOSI,  KONSTANTINOPOL. Teodosiy tomonidan Misrdan Konstantinopolga olib ketilgan va ko'rsatilgan poydevorga qo'yilgan Tothmes obeliskasi; erta Vizantiya san'atining qiziqarli namunasi.

en: The complete obelisk is seen on
uz: Toʻliq obelisk koʻrinadi:

en: Photo: Sebah & Foaillier It is impossible in the space at our disposal to trace the movements of all the various German and Slavonic tribes as they went to and fro in the disor- ganized empire in search of plunder and a pleasant home.
uz: Foto: Sebah & Foaillier Bizning ixtiyorimizdagi fazoda turli nemis va slavyan qabilalarining talon-toroj va yoqimli uy izlab, buzilgan imperiyada qayerga va qayerga borganini kuzatishning iloji yo'q.

en: But let the Van- dals serve as an example.
uz: Lekin Van-dallar namuna bo'lsin.

en: They came into history in east Germany.
uz: Ular Sharqiy Germaniyada tarixga kirishdi.

en: They settled as we have told in Pannonia.
uz: Ular Pannoniyada aytganimizdek joylashdilar.

en: Thence they moved somewhen about 425 A.D.
uz: U yerdan ular taxminan milodiy 425-yilda ko'chib o'tishdi.

en: through the intervening provinces to Spain.
uz: Ispaniyaga o'tadigan oraliq viloyatlar orqali.

en: There they found Visigoths from South Russia and other German tribes setting up dukes and kings.
uz: U yerda ular Janubiy Rossiyadan kelgan Vizigotlar va boshqa nemis qabilalari gersoglar va shohlar o'rnatayotganini topdilar.

en: From Spain the Vandals under Genseric sailed for North Africa (429), captured Carthage (439), and built a ﬂeet.
uz: Ispaniyadan Genserik boshchiligidagi vandallar Shimoliy Afrikaga suzib borishdi (429), Karfagenni egalladilar (439), va flot qurdilar.

en: They secured the mastery of the sea and captured and pillaged Rome (455), which had recovered very imperfectly from her capture and looting by Alaric half a century earlier.
uz: Ular dengizni egallashni ta'minladilar va Rimni (455-yil) qo'lga kiritdilar va talon-toroj qildilar, bu shahar yarim asr oldin Alaric tomonidan qo'lga kiritilgan va talon-toroj qilinganidan juda mukammal emas edi.

en: Then the Vandals made themselves masters of Sicily, Corsica, Sardinia and most of the other islands of the western Mediterranean.
uz: Keyin vandallar o'zlarini Sitsiliya, Korsika, Sardiniya va G'arbiy O'rta yer dengizining boshqa ko'p orollarining xo'jayinlariga aylantirdilar.

en: They made, in fact, a sea empire very similar in its extent to the sea empire of Carthage seven hundred odd years before.
uz: Ular aslida yetti yuz yil avvalgi Karfagen dengiz imperiyasiga o'z ko'lami bilan juda o'xshash dengiz imperiyasini yaratdilar.

en: They were at the climax of their power about 477.
uz: Ular taxminan 477-yillarda o'z kuchlarining eng yuqori cho'qqisida edilar.

en: They were a mere handful of conquerors holding all this country.
uz: Ular butun bu mamlakatni egallab turgan bir hovuch bosqinchilar edi.

en: In the next century almost all their territory had been reconquered for the em- pire of Constantinople during a transitory blaze of energy under Justinian I.
uz: Keyingi asrda ularning deyarli barcha hududlari Yustinian I davridagi vaqtinchalik energiya alangasi davrida Konstantinopolning em- pire uchun qayta zabt etildi.

en: The story of the Vandals is but one sample of a host of similar adven- tures.
uz: Vandalilar haqidagi hikoya shunga o'xshash hodisalarning bir namunasi xolos.

en: But now there was coming into the European world the least kindred and most redoubtable of all these devastators, the Mongolian Huns or Tar- tars, a yellow people active and able, such as the western world had never before encountered.
uz: Ammo endi Yevropa dunyosiga bu vayron qiluvchilarning eng kamsimon va eng qo'rqinchli biri, mo'g'ul xunlari yoki tar-tarslari, g'arb dunyosi hech qachon uchratmagan faol va qodir sariq xalq kelayotgan edi.

en: XL THE HUNS AND THE END OF THE WESTERN EMPIRE This appearance of a conquering Mongolian people in Europe may be taken to mark a new stage in human history.
uz: XL THE HUNS AND THE END OF THE WESTERN EMPIRE. Yevropada zabt etayotgan moʻgʻul xalqining ushbu koʻrinishi insoniyat tarixida yangi bosqichni belgilash uchun qabul qilinishi mumkin.

en: Until the last century or so before the Christian era, the Mongol and the Nordic peoples had not been in close touch.
uz: Xristian davridan oldingi o'tgan asrgacha mo'g'ullar va Skandinaviya xalqlari yaqin aloqada bo'lmagan.

en: Far away in the frozen lands beyond the northern forests the Lapps, a Mongolian people, had drifted westward as far as Lapland, but they played no part in the main current of history.
uz: Uzoqdagi muzlagan yerlarda, shimoliy o'rmonlardan narida, Lappalar, mo'g'ul xalqi g'arbga qarab, Laplandiyagacha suzib ketgan edi, lekin ular tarixning asosiy oqimida hech qanday rol o'ynamagan edi.

en: For thousands of years the western world carried on the dramatic interplay of the Aryan, Semitic and funda- mental brunette peoples with very little interference (except for an Ethiopi- an invasion of Egypt or so) either from the black peoples to the south or from the Mongolian world in the far East.
uz: Ming yillar davomida g'arb dunyosi ariylar, semitlar va funda-aqliy brunet xalqlarining dramatik o'zaro ta'sirini juda kam aralashuv bilan ( Efiopiyadan tashqari - Misrga bostirib kirish yoki shunga o'xshash) janubdagi qora xalqlardan yoki Uzoq Sharqdagi mo'g'ul dunyosidan olib bordi.

en: It is probable that there were two chief causes for the new westward drift of the nomadic Mongolians.
uz: Koʻchmanchi moʻgʻullarning yangi gʻarbga siljishining ikkita asosiy sababi boʻlishi mumkin.

en: One was the consolidation of the great empire of China, its extension northward and the increase of its population during the prosperous period of the Han dynasty.
uz: Biri Xitoyning buyuk imperiyasining mustahkamlanishi, uning shimolga kengayishi va Xan sulolasining farovon davrida uning aholisining ko'payishi edi.

en: The other was some process of climatic change; a lesser rainfall that abolished swamps and forests perhaps, or a greater rainfall that extended grazing over desert steppes, or even per- haps both these processes going on in different regions but which anyhow facilitated a westward migration.
uz: Boshqasi esa iqlim o'zgarishining bir jarayoni edi; botqoqliklar va o'rmonlarni yo'q qilgan kamroq yog'ingarchilik, yoki cho'l dashtlariga cho'zilgan kattaroq yog'ingarchilik, yoki hatto har ikki jarayon turli hududlarda sodir bo'layotgan, ammo qandaydir tarzda g'arbga migratsiyani osonlashtirgan.

en: A third contributary cause was the eco- nomic wretchedness, internal decay and falling population of the Roman Empire.
uz: Uchinchi sabab Rim imperiyasining eko-nomik qashshoqligi, ichki parchalanishi va aholisining pasayishi edi.

en: The rich men of the later Roman Republic, and then the tax-gather- ers of the military emperors had utterly consumed its vitality.
uz: Keyinchalik Rim Respublikasining boy odamlari va keyin harbiy imperatorlarning soliq yig'uvchilari uning hayotiyligini butunlay yo'q qilib yuborishgan edi.

en: So we have the factors of thrust, means and opportunity.
uz: Demak, bizda turtki, vositalar va imkoniyat omillari bor.

en: There was pressure from the east, rot in the west and an open road.
uz: Sharqdan bosim, g'arbda chirish va ochiq yo'l bor edi.

en: The Hun had reached the eastern boundaries of European Russia by the ﬁrst century A.D., but it was not until the fourth and ﬁfth centuries A.D.
uz: Xunlar milodiy birinchi asrga kelib Yevropa Rossiyasining sharqiy chegaralariga yetib borgan edi, lekin bu milodiy to'rtinchi va beshinchi asrlargacha emas edi.

en: that these horsemen rose to predominance upon the steppes.
uz: Bu chavandozlar dashtlarda ustunlikka ko'tarildi.

en: The ﬁfth century was the Hun’s century.
uz: Beshinchi asr Xun asri edi.

en: The ﬁrst Huns to come into Italy were mercenary bands in the pay of Stilicho the Vandal, the master of Honorius.
uz: Italiyaga kelgan birinchi gunnlar Stilicho the Vandal, Honoriusning xo'jayiniga tegishli bo'lgan yollanma guruhlar edi.

en: Presently they were in possession of Pannonia, the empty nest of the Vandals.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda ular Pannoniyani, vandalarning bo'sh uyasini egallab olishardi.

en: By the second quarter of the ﬁfth century a great war chief had arisen among the Huns, Attila.
uz: Beshinchi asrning ikkinchi choragiga kelib, gunnlar orasida buyuk urush boshlig'i Attila paydo bo'ldi.

en: We have only vague and tantalizing glimpses of his power.
uz: Bizda uning qudratining faqat noaniq va hayratlanarli ko'rinishlari bor.

en: He ruled not only over the Huns but over a conglomerate of tribu- tary Germanic tribes; his empire extended from the Rhine cross the plains into Central Asia.
uz: U nafaqat gunnlar ustidan hukmronlik qildi, balki tribu german qabilalarining konglomerati ustidan ham hukmronlik qildi; uning imperiyasi Reyn daryosidan tekisliklarni kesib o'tib, Markaziy Osiyoga cho'zilgan edi.

en: He exchanged ambassadors with China.
uz: U Xitoy bilan elchilar almashdi.

en: His head camp was in the plain of Hungary east of the Danube.
uz: Uning bosh lageri Vengriyaning tekisligida, Dunay daryosidan sharqda joylashgan edi.

en: There he was visited by an envoy from Constantinople, Priscus, who has left us an account of his state.
uz: U yerda unga Konstantinopol elchisi Prisk tashrif buyurdi, u bizga o'z holati haqida ma'lumot qoldirdi.

en: The way of living of these Mongols was very like the way of living of the primitive Aryans they had replaced.
uz: Bu moʻgʻullarning turmush tarzi ular almashtirgan ibtidoiyoriylarning turmush tarziga juda oʻxshash edi.

en: The common folk were in huts and tents; the chiefs lived in great stockaded timber halls.
uz: Oddiy xalq kulbalarda va chodirlarda edi; boshliqlar katta taxtali yog'och zallarda yashashardi.

en: There were feasts and drinking and singing by the bards.
uz: Bardalar tomonidan ziyofatlar, ichimliklar va qo'shiqlar bo'lib o'tdi.

en: The Homeric heroes and even the Mace- donian companions of Alexander would probably have felt more at home in the camp-capital of Attila than they would have done in the cultivated and decadent court of Theodosius II, the son of Arcadius, who was then reign- ing in Constantinople.
uz: Gomer qahramonlari va hatto Aleksandrning Mace-daniyalik hamrohlari Attila lager-poytaxtida o'zlarini Konstantinopolda hukmronlik qilayotgan Arkadiy o'g'li Teodosiy II ning madaniy va buzuq saroyida his qilganlaridan ko'ra ko'proq o'z uylarida his qilgan bo'lishlari mumkin edi.

en: For a time it seemed as though the nomads under the leadership of the Huns and Attila would play the same part towards the Græco-Roman civi- lization of the Mediterranean countries that the barbaric Greeks had played long ago to the Ægean civilization.
uz: Bir muddatga go'yo gunnlar va Attila boshchiligidagi ko'chmanchilar O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlarining yunon-rum sivilizatsiyasiga nisbatan xuddi shunga o'xshash rol o'ynagandek tuyuldi, xuddi vahshiy yunonlar ilgari Egeya sivilizatsiyasiga o'ynaganidek.

en: It looked like history repeating itself upon a larger stage.
uz: Tarix kattaroq sahnada takrorlanayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: But the Huns were much more wedded to the nomadic life than the early Greeks, who were rather migratory cattle farmers than true nomads.
uz: Ammo gunnlar qadimgi yunonlardan ko'ra ko'chmanchi hayotga ko'proq moslashgan, ular haqiqiy ko'chmanchilardan ko'ra ko'proq ko'chmanchi chorvachilik dehqonlari edi.

en: The Huns raided and plundered but did not settle.
uz: Gunnlar hujum qildi va talon-toroj qildi, lekin joylashmadi.

en: For some years Attila bullied Theodosius as he chose.
uz: Bir necha yillar davomida Attila Teodosiyni o'zi tanlaganidek bezovta qildi.

en: His armies devas- tated and looted right down to the walls of Constantinople, Gibbon says that he totally destroyed no less than seventy cities in the Balkan peninsula, and Theodosius bought him off by payments of tribute and tried to get rid of him for good by sending secret agents to assassinate him.
uz: Gibbonning aytishicha, uning qo'shinlari Qustantiniyaning devorlarigacha vayron qilingan va talon-toroj qilingan, u Bolqon yarim orolida yetmishdan kam bo'lmagan shaharni butunlay vayron qilgan va Teodosiy uni soliq to'lovlari bilan sotib olgan va uni o'ldirish uchun maxfiy agentlarni yuborish orqali butunlay qutulishga harakat qilgan.

en: In 451 Attila turned his attention to the remains of the Latin- speaking half of the empire and invaded Gaul.
uz: 451-yilda Attila lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi imperiya yarmining qoldiqlariga e'tiborini qaratdi va Gollyaga bostirib kirdi.

en: Nearly every town in northern Gaul was sacked.
uz: Gollning shimoliy qismidagi deyarli har bir shahar talon-toroj qilindi.

en: Franks, Visigoths and the imperial forces united against him and he was defeated at
uz: Franklar, Vizigotlar va imperator kuchlari unga qarshi birlashdilar va u mag'lub bo'ldi.

en: Troyes in a vast dispersed battle in which a multitude of men, variously es- timated as between 150,000 and 300,000, were killed.
uz: Katta tarqalgan jangda Troyelar, unda turli xil taxminlarga ko'ra 150 000 dan 300 000 gacha bo'lgan ko'plab odamlar halok bo'ldi.

en: This checked him in Gaul, but it did not exhaust his enormous military resources.
uz: Bu uni Galliyada tekshirib ko'rdi, lekin bu uning ulkan harbiy resurslarini tugatmadi.

en: Next year he came into Italy by way of Venetia, burnt Aquileia and Padua and looted Milan.
uz: Keyingi yili u Venetiya orqali Italiyaga keldi, Akveliyani va Padovani yoqib yubordi va Milanni talon-toroj qildi.

en: HEAD OF BARBARIAN CHIEF  (In the British Museum) Numbers of fugitives from these north Italian towns and particularly from Padua ﬂed to islands in the lagoons at the head of the Adriatic and laid
uz: BARBIAN CHIEF (Britaniya muzeyida) Shimoliy Italiya shaharlaridan va ayniqsa Padua shahridan qochqinlar Adriatik dengizi boshidagi lagunelari orollariga qochib ketishdi va...

en: there the foundations of the city state of Venice, which was to become one of the greatest or the trading centres in the middle ages.
uz: U yerda Venetsiya shahri davlatining poydevori joylashgan bo'lib, u o'rta asrlarda eng buyuk yoki savdo markazlaridan biriga aylanishi kerak edi.

en: In 453 Attila died suddenly after a great feast to celebrate his marriage to a young woman, and at his death this plunder confederation of his fell to pieces.
uz: 453-yilda Attila katta ziyofatdan so'ng to'satdan vafot etdi, o'zining yosh ayolga uylanganini nishonlash uchun, vafotidan so'ng uning bu talon-toroj ittifoqi parchalanib ketdi.

en: The actual Huns disappear from history, mixed into the surrounding more numerous Aryan-speaking populations.
uz: Haqiqiy gunnlar tarixdan yo'qoladi, atrofdagi ko'proq ariy tilida so'zlashuvchi aholiga aralashib ketadi.

en: But these great Hun raids practically consummated the end of the Latin Roman Empire.
uz: Lekin bu buyuk Hun reydlari Lotin Rim imperiyasining oxirini amalda yakunladi.

en: After his death ten different emperors ruled in Rome in twenty years, set up by Van- dal and other mercenary troops.
uz: Uning vafotidan so'ng, Rimda yigirma yil ichida o'nta xil imperator hukmronlik qildi, ularni Van-dal va boshqa yollanma askarlar tashkil etdi.

en: The Vandals from Carthage took and sacked Rome in 455.
uz: Karfagenlik vandallar 455-yilda Rimni bosib olib, talon-toroj qilishdi.

en: Finally in 476 Odoacer, the chief of the barbarian troops, suppressed a Pannonian who was ﬁguring as emperor under the im- pressive name of Romulus Augustulus, and informed the Court of Constan- tinople that there was no longer an emperor in the west.
uz: Nihoyat, 476-yilda varvar qoʻshinlari boshligʻi Odekatser Romulus Augustulusning im-pressiv nomi ostida imperator sifatida oʻzini koʻrsatayotgan Pannonianni bostirdi va Konstanople saroyiga gʻarbda endi imperator yoʻqligini xabar qildi.

en: So ingloriously the Latin Roman Empire came to an end.
uz: Shunday g'alati tarzda Lotin Rim imperiyasi tugadi.

en: In 493 Theodoric the Goth became King of Rome.
uz: 493-yilda Got Teodorik Rim qiroli bo'ldi.

en: All over western and central Europe now barbarian chiefs were reigning as kings, dukes and the like, practically independent but for the most part professing some sort of shadowy allegiance to the emperor.
uz: Butun g'arbiy va markaziy Yevropada hozirda vahshiy boshliqlar qirollar, gersoglar va shunga o'xshashlar sifatida hukmronlik qilishardi, amalda mustaqil, lekin ko'p qismi imperatorga qandaydir soyali sadoqatni e'tirof etishardi.

en: There were hundreds and perhaps thousands of such practically independent brigand rulers.
uz: Bunday amalda mustaqil brigand hukmdorlar yuzlab va ehtimol minglab edi.

en: In Gaul, Spain and Italy and in Dacia the Latin speech still prevailed in locally distorted forms, but in Britain and east of the Rhine languages of the German group (or in Bohemia a Slavonic language, Czech) were the common speech.
uz: Galliyada, Ispaniya va Italiyada va Dakiyada lotin nutqi hali ham mahalliy buzilgan shakllarda ustun edi, lekin Britaniyada va Reynning sharqida nemis guruhining tillari (yoki Bohemiyada slavyan tili, chex) umumiy nutq edi.

en: The superior clergy and a small remnant of other educated men read and wrote Latin.
uz: Yuqori ruhoniylar va boshqa o'qimishli odamlarning kichik bir qismi lotin tilini o'qidi va yozdi.

en: Everywhere life was insecure and property was held by the strong arm.
uz: Hamma joyda hayot bexatar edi va mulk kuchli qo'l bilan ushlab turildi.

en: Castles multiplied and roads fell into decay.
uz: Qal'alar ko'paydi va yo'llar parchalanib ketdi.

en: The dawn of the sixth century was an age of division and of intellectual dark- ness throughout the western world.
uz: Oltinchi asrning tongi butun g'arbiy dunyo bo'ylab bo'linish va intellektual qorong'ulik davri edi.

en: Had it not been for the monks and Christian missionaries Latin learning might have perished altogether.
uz: Agar rohiblar va nasroniy missionerlar bo'lmaganida, lotin tili ta'limi butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketishi mumkin edi.

en: Why had the Roman Empire grown and why had it so completely de- cayed?
uz: Nima uchun Rim imperiyasi o'sdi va nega u bunchalik butunlay yo'q qilindi?

en: It grew because at ﬁrst the idea of citizenship held it together.
uz: U o'sdi, chunki dastlab fuqarolik g'oyasi uni birlashtirib turardi.

en: Throughout the days of the expanding republic, and even into the days of the early empire there remained a great number of men conscious of Roman citizenship, feeling it a privilege and an obligation to be a Roman citizen, conﬁdent of their rights under the Roman law and willing to make sacriﬁces in the name of Rome.
uz: Respublikaning kengayib borayotgan davrida va hatto dastlabki imperiyaning davrida ham Rim fuqaroligini anglagan, Rim fuqarosi bo'lishni imtiyoz va majburiyat deb hisoblagan, Rim qonunchiligi ostida o'z huquqlariga ishonchi komil va Rim nomidan qurbonlik qilishga tayyor bo'lgan ko'plab odamlar qoldi.

en: The prestige of Rome as of something just and great and law- upholding spread far beyond the Roman boundaries.
uz: Rimning adolatli, buyuk va qonunga rioya qiluvchi narsa sifatida obro'si Rim chegaralaridan ancha uzoqqa tarqaldi.

en: early as the Punic wars the sense of citizenship was being undermined by the growth of wealth and slavery.
uz: Pun urushlarining boshidanoq fuqarolik tuyg'usi boylik va qullikning o'sishi bilan susayib borayotgan edi.

en: Citizenship spread indeed but not the idea of citizenship.
uz: Fuqarolik tarqaldi, lekin fuqarolik g'oyasi emas.

en: The Roman Empire was after all a very primitive organization; it did not educate, did not explain itself to its increasing multitudes of citizens, did not invite their co-operation in its decisions.
uz: Rim imperiyasi baribir juda ibtidoiy tashkilot edi; u o'qitmagan, o'zining tobora ko'payib borayotgan fuqarolari soniga o'zini tushuntirmagan, o'z qarorlarida ularning hamkorligini taklif qilmagan.

en: There was no network of schools to ensure a common understanding, no distribution of news to sus- tain collective activity.
uz: Umumiy tushunishni ta'minlash uchun maktablar tarmog'i yo'q edi, jamoaviy faoliyatni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun yangiliklarni tarqatish yo'q edi.

en: The adventurers who struggled for power from the days of Marius and Sulla onward had no idea of creating and calling in pub- lic opinion upon the imperial affairs.
uz: Marius va Sulla davridan boshlab hokimiyat uchun kurashgan sarguzashtchilar imperatorlik ishlari bo'yicha ommaviy fikrda yaratishga va chaqirishga hech qanday tasavvurga ega emas edilar.

en: The spirit of citizenship died of starva- tion and no one observed it die.
uz: Fuqarolik ruhi ochlikdan o'ldi va hech kim uning o'lishini kuzatmadi.

en: All empires, all states, all organizations of human society are, in the ultimate, things of understanding and will.
uz: Barcha imperiyalar, barcha davlatlar, insoniyat jamiyatining barcha tashkilotlari, oxir-oqibatda, tushunish va iroda narsalaridir.

en: There remained no will for the Roman Empire in the World and so it came to an end.
uz: Dunyoda Rim imperiyasi uchun iroda qolmadi va shuning uchun u tugab ketdi.

en: But though the Latin-speaking Roman Empire died in the ﬁfth century, something else had been born within it that was to avail itself enormously of its prestige and tradition, and that was the Latin-speaking half of the Catholic Church.
uz: Lekin lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi Rim imperiyasi beshinchi asrda vafot etgan bo'lsa-da, u ichida o'zining obro'si va an'analaridan juda ko'p foydalanadigan boshqa narsa tug'ilgan edi va bu katolik cherkovining lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi yarmi edi.

en: This lived while the empire died because it appealed to the minds and wills of men, because it had books and a great system of teachers and missionaries to hold it together, things stronger than any law or legions.
uz: Bu imperiya o'lgan paytda yashadi, chunki u odamlarning ongiga va irodasini tortardi, chunki unda kitoblar va uni ushlab turadigan ajoyib o'qituvchilar va missionerlar tizimi bor edi, har qanday qonun yoki legionlardan kuchliroq narsalar bor edi.

en: Throughout the fourth and ﬁfth centuries A.D.
uz: Milodiy to'rtinchi va beshinchi asrlar davomida.

en: while the empire was decaying, Christianity was spreading to a universal dominion in Europe.
uz: Imperiya parchalanayotgan paytda, xristianlik Yevropada universal hukmronlikka tarqalgan edi.

en: It conquered its conquerors, the barbarians.
uz: U o'z bosqinchilarini, vahshiylarni zabt etdi.

en: When Attila seemed disposed to march on Rome, the patriarch of Rome intercepted him and did what no armies could do, turning him back by sheer moral force.
uz: Attila Rimga yurishga tayyordek tuyulganda, Rim patriarxi uni to'xtatib, hech qanday armiya qila olmaydigan ishni qildi va uni o'ta axloqiy kuch bilan orqaga qaytardi.

en: The Patriarch or Pope of Rome claimed to be the head of the entire Christian church.
uz: Rim patriarxi yoki papasi butun xristian cherkovi boshlig'i ekanligini da'vo qildi.

en: Now that there were no more emperors, he began to an- nex imperial titles and claims.
uz: Endi imperatorlar yo'q bo'lganidan so'ng, u keyingi imperatorlik unvonlari va da'volarini qabul qila boshladi.

en: He took the title of pontifex maximus, head sacriﬁcial priest of the Roman dominion, the most ancient of all the titles that the emperors had enjoyed.
uz: U Rim hukmronligining bosh qurbon ruhoniysi bo'lgan pontifex maximus unvonini oldi, bu imperatorlar ega bo'lgan barcha unvonlarning eng qadimgi unvoni edi.

en: XLI THE BYZANTINE AND SASSANID EMPIRES The Greek-speaking eastern half of the Roman Empire showed much more political tenacity than the western half.
uz: XLI BIZANTIYAN VA SASSANIY EMPIRLARI Rim imperiyasining yunon tilida so'zlashuvchi sharqiy yarmi g'arbiy yarmiga qaraganda ancha ko'proq siyosiy qat'iyat ko'rsatdi.

en: It weathered the disasters of the ﬁfth century A.D., which saw a complete and ﬁnal breaking up of the original Latin Roman power.
uz: U milodiy beshinchi asr falokatlariga bardosh berdi, bu esa asl Lotin Rim qudratining to'liq va yakuniy parchalanishini ko'rdi.

en: Attila bullied the Emperor Theodosius II and sacked and raided almost to the walls of Constantinople, but that city remained in- tact.
uz: Attila imperator Teodosiy II ni haqorat qildi va Konstantinopol devorlarigacha talon-toroj qilib, hujum qildi, ammo bu shahar xotirjam qoldi.

en: The Nubians came down the Nile and looted Upper Egypt, but Lower Egypt and Alexandria were left still fairly prosperous.
uz: Nubiyaliklar Nil daryosidan tushishdi va Yuqori Misrni talon-toroj qilishdi, ammo Quyi Misr va Iskandariya hali ham ancha farovon qolgan edi.

en: Most of Asia Minor was held against the Sassanid Persians.
uz: Kichik Osiyoning ko'p qismi Sassanid forslariga qarshi ushlab turildi.

en: The sixth century, which was an age of complete darkness for the West, saw indeed a considerable revival of the Greek power.
uz: G'arb uchun to'liq zulmat davri bo'lgan oltinchi asr, haqiqatan ham yunon kuchining sezilarli tiklanishini ko'rdi.

en: Justinian I (527-565) was a ruler of very great ambition and energy, and he was married to the Empress Theodora, a woman of quite equal capacity who had begun life as an actress.
uz: Yustinian I (527-565) juda katta ambitsiya va energiyaga ega hukmdor edi va u aktrisa sifatida hayotini boshlagan ancha teng imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lgan imperator Teodoraga turmushga chiqqan edi.

en: Justinian reconquered North Africa from the Vandals and most of Italy from the Goths.
uz: Yustinian Shimoliy Afrikani vandallar va Italiyaning ko'p qismini Gotlardan qaytarib oldi.

en: He even regained the south of Spain.
uz: U hatto Ispaniyaning janubini ham qaytarib oldi.

en: He did not limit his energies to naval and military enterprises.
uz: U o'z energiyasini dengiz va harbiy korxonalar bilan cheklamadi.

en: He founded a university, built the great church of Sta.
uz: U universitetga asos soldi, Staning buyuk cherkovini qurdi.

en: Sophia in Constantinople and codiﬁed the Ro- man law.
uz: Sofiya Konstantinopolda va Rim qonunini kodifikatsiya qildi.

en: But in order to destroy a rival to his university foundation he closed the schools of philosophy in Athens, which had been going on in un- broken continuity from the days of Plato, that is to say for nearly a thousand years.
uz: Lekin o'zining universitet fondiga raqibni yo'q qilish uchun u Afina shahridagi falsafa maktablarini yopdi, ular Platon davridan beri, ya'ni deyarli ming yildan beri uzluksiz davom etib kelayotgan edi.

en: From the third century onwards the Persian Empire had been the stead- fast rival of the Byzantine.
uz: Uchinchi asrdan boshlab Fors imperiyasi Vizantiyaning doimiy raqibi edi.

en: The two empires kept Asia Minor, Syria and
uz: Ikki imperiya Kichik Osiyo, Suriya va

en: Egypt in a state of perpetual unrest and waste.
uz: Misr doimiy tartibsizlik va vayronalik holatida.

en: In the ﬁrst century A.D., these lands were still at a high level of civilization, wealthy and with an abundant population, but the continual coming and going of armies, massacres, loot- ing and war taxation wore them down steadily until only shattered and ru- inous cities remained upon a countryside of scattered peasants.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi birinchi asrda bu yerlar hali ham yuqori darajadagi tsivilizatsiya, boy va ko'p aholisiga ega edi, lekin armiyalarning tinimsiz kelishi va ketishi, qirg'inlar, talon-toroj va urush soliqlari ularni barqaror ravishda yo'q qildi, toki faqat vayron bo'lgan va vayron bo'lgan shaharlar tarqalgan dehqonlar qishlog'ida qolmaguncha.

en: In this melancholy process of impoverishment and disorder lower Egypt fared per- haps less badly than the rest of the world.
uz: Ushbu qashshoqlik va tartibsizlikning qayg'uli jarayonida quyi Misr dunyoga qaraganda har bir kishiga kamroq zarar yetkazdi.

en: Alexandria, like Constantinople, continued a dwindling trade between the east and the west.
uz: Iskandariya, Konstantinopol kabi, sharq va g'arb o'rtasida kamayib borayotgan savdoni davom ettirdi.

en: THE CHURCH (NOW A MOSQUE) OF S.
uz: S.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.N.

en: SOPHIA, CONSTANTINO- PLE  The obelisk of Theodosius in in the foreground statue on left  Photo: Sebah & Foaillier Science and political philosophy seemed dead now in both these warring and decaying empires.
uz: SOFIYA, CONSTANTINO- ILTIMOS, Oldingi fonda, chap tomondagi haykalda Teodosiy obeliski. Surat: Sebah & Foaillier Fan va siyosiy falsafa hozirda urushayotgan va parchalanayotgan imperiyalarda o'likdek tuyuldi.

en: The last philosophers of Athens, until their suppres- sion, preserved the texts of the great literature of the past with an inﬁnite reverence and want of understanding.
uz: Afinalik so'nggi faylasuflar, o'zlarining bostirilgunga qadar, o'tmishdagi buyuk adabiyot matnlarini cheksiz hurmat va tushunish yetishmasligi bilan saqlab qoldilar.

en: But there remained no class of men in the world, no free gentlemen with bold and independent habits of thought, to carry on the tradition of frank statement and enquiry embodied in these writings.
uz: Ammo dunyoda hech qanday erkaklar sinfi qolmadi, jasur va mustaqil fikrlash odatlariga ega bo'lgan erkin janoblar ham, bu yozuvlarda mujassam bo'lgan ochiq bayonot va so'rov an'anasini davom ettirish uchun.

en: The social and political chaos accounts largely for the disappear-
uz: Ijtimoiy va siyosiy tartibsizlik asosan yo'qolib ketishga sabab bo'ladi.

en: ance of this class, but there was also another reason why the human intelli- gence was sterile and feverish during this age.
uz: Bu sinfdan biri, lekin bu yoshda inson aqli steril va isitma bo'lishining yana bir sababi ham bor edi.

en: In both Persia and Byzan- tium it was all age of intolerance.
uz: Forsda ham, Vizantiyada ham bu butun davr murosasizlik davri edi.

en: Both empires were religious empires in a new way, in a way that greatly hampered the free activities of the human mind.
uz: Ikkala imperiya ham yangi usulda diniy imperiya edi, bu esa inson ongining erkin faoliyatlariga katta to'sqinlik qilgan.

en: THE MAGNIFICENT ROOF-WORK IN S.
uz: KATTA tom usti ishi S. da.

en: SOPHIA  Photo: Sebah & Foaillier Of course the oldest empires in the world were religious empires, cen- tring upon the worship of a god or of a god-king.
uz: SOFIYA Foto: Sebah & Foaillier Albatta, dunyodagi eng qadimgi imperiyalar diniy imperiyalar edi, ular xudoga yoki xudo-qirolga sig'inishga asoslangan edi.

en: Alexander was treated as
uz: Aleksandrga shunday munosabatda bo'lishdi:

en: a divinity and the Cæsars were gods in so much as they had altars and tem- ples devoted to them and the offering of incense was made a test of loyalty to the Roman state.
uz: Xudolik va Sezarlar xudolar edi, chunki ularda qurbongohlar va ularga bag'ishlangan ibodatxonalar bor edi va tutatqi tutatqi Rim davlatiga sadoqat sinovi edi.

en: But these older religions were essentially religions of act and fact.
uz: Lekin bu qadimgi dinlar asosan amal va haqiqat dinlari edi.

en: They did not invade the mind.
uz: Ular ongga bostirib kirmadilar.

en: If a man offered his sacriﬁce and bowed to the god, he was left not only to think but to say practically whatever he liked about the affair.
uz: Agar bir kishi qurbonlik qilib, xudoga ta'zim qilsa, u nafaqat o'ylash, balki ish haqida o'ziga yoqqan narsani amalda aytish uchun qoldirardi.

en: But the new sort of religions that had come into the world, and particularly Christianity, turned inward.
uz: Ammo dunyoga kelgan yangi turdagi dinlar, ayniqsa xristianlik, ichkariga burildi.

en: These new faiths demanded not simply conformity but understanding belief.
uz: Bu yangi e'tiqodlar shunchaki muvofiqlikni emas, balki e'tiqodni tushunishni talab qilardi.

en: Natu- rally ﬁerce controversy ensued upon the exact meaning of the things be- lieved.
uz: Natu- rally shiddatli bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'ldi, chunki bu narsalarning aniq ma'nosi bor edi.

en: These new religions were creed religions.
uz: Bu yangi dinlar e'tiqod dinlari edi.

en: The world was confronted with a new word, Orthodoxy, and with a stern resolve to keep not only acts but speech and private thought within the limits of a set teaching.
uz: Dunyo yangi so'z, Pravoslavlik bilan yuzma-yuz keldi va nafaqat amallarni, balki nutq va shaxsiy fikrlashni qat'iy ta'limot doirasida saqlashga qat'iy qaror qildi.

en: For to hold a wrong opinion, much more to convey it to other people, was no longer regarded as an intellectual defect but a moral fault that might con- demn a soul to everlasting destruction.
uz: Noto'g'ri fikrga ega bo'lish, uni boshqa odamlarga yetkazish uchun, endi intellektual nuqson emas, balki ruhni abadiy halokatga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan axloqiy xato sifatida qaraldi.

en: THE RAVENNA PANEL, DEPICTING JUSTINIAN AND HIS COURT Photo: Alinari
uz: RAVENNA PANEL, JUSTINIAN VA UNING SUDINI BOSHQARISH Photo: Alinari

en: THE ROCK HEWN TEMPLE AT PETRA  Photo: Underwood & Underwood
uz: PETRADAGI QALQON HEWN MABONASI Foto: Yog'och va Yog'och

en: Both Ardashir I who founded the Sassanid dynasty in the third century A.D., and Constantine the Great who reconstructed the Roman Empire in the fourth, turned to religious organizations for help, because in these organiza- tions they saw a new means of using and controlling the wills of men.
uz: Miloddan avvalgi uchinchi asrda Sassanidlar sulolasiga asos solgan Ardashir I ham, to'rtinchi yilda Rim imperiyasini qayta qurgan Buyuk Konstantin ham yordam so'rab diniy tashkilotlarga murojaat qilishdi, chunki bu tashkilotlarda ular odamlarning irodasidan foydalanish va nazorat qilishning yangi usulini ko'rishdi.

en: And already before the end of the fourth century both empires were persecuting free talk and religious innovation.
uz: Va allaqachon to'rtinchi asr oxirigacha ikkala imperiya ham erkin so'zlashuv va diniy innovatsiyalarni ta'qib qilmoqda edi.

en: In Persia Ardashir found the ancient Per- sian religion of Zoroaster (or Zarathushtra) with its priests and temples and a sacred ﬁre that burnt upon its altars, ready for his purpose as a state reli- gion.
uz: Forsda Ardashir Zoroasterning qadimgi Per-sian dinini (yoki Zarathushtra) ruhoniylari va ibodatxonalari hamda uning qurbongohlarida yonib turgan muqaddas olov bilan topdi, u davlat dini sifatida o'z maqsadiga tayyor edi.

en: Before the end of the third century Zoroastrianism was persecuting Christianity, and in 277 A.D.
uz: Uchinchi asr oxirigacha Zoroasterlik xristianlikni ta'qib qilayotgan edi va milodiy 277-yilda.

en: Mani, the founder of a new faith, the Manichæans, was cruciﬁed and his body ﬂayed.
uz: Mani, yangi e'tiqodning asoschisi, Manixeylar xochga mixlandi va uning tanasi pardozlandi.

en: Constantinople, on its side, was busy hunting out Christian heresies.
uz: Konstantinopol o'z tomoni bilan xristian bid'atlarini ovlash bilan band edi.

en: Manichæan ideas infected Chris- tianity and had to be fought with the ﬁercest methods; in return ideas from Christianity affected the purity of the Zoroastrian doctrine.
uz: Manixoya g'oyalari Kris-Tianlikka zarar yetkazdi va eng shiddatli usullar bilan kurashishga to'g'ri keldi; buning evaziga xristianlikdan kelib chiqqan g'oyalar Zoroastriya ta'limotining sofligiga ta'sir qildi.

en: All ideas be- came suspect.
uz: Barcha g'oyalar shubhali bo'lib keldi.

en: Science, which demands before all things the free action of an untroubled mind, suffered a complete eclipse throughout this phase of intolerance.
uz: Ilm-fan, barcha narsadan oldin bezovta bo'lmagan aqlning erkin harakatini talab qiladigan, bu to'liq toqatsizlik bosqichida to'liq tutilishga duch keldi.

en: War, the bitterest theology, and the usual vices of mankind constituted Byzantine life of those days.
uz: Urush, eng achchiq teologiya va insoniyatning odatiy illatlari o'sha davrdagi Vizantiya hayotini tashkil etdi.

en: It was picturesque, it was romantic; it had little sweetness or light.
uz: U go'zal edi, romantik edi; unda hech qanday shirinlik yoki yorug'lik yo'q edi.

en: When Byzantium and Persia were not ﬁghting the bar- barians from the north, they wasted Asia Minor and Syria in dreary and de- structive hostilities.
uz: Vizantiya va Fors shimoldan kelgan bar-barlarga qarshi kurashmayotgan paytda, ular Kichik Osiyo va Suriyani zerikarli va de-strukturaviy janglarda vayron qilishdi.

en: Even in close alliance these two empires would have found it a hard task to turn back the barbarians and recover their prosperity.
uz: Hatto yaqin ittifoqda bo'lganda ham, bu ikki imperiya vahshiylarni qaytarish va ularning farovonligini tiklash uchun qiyin vazifa topgan bo'lardi.

en: The Turks or Tartars ﬁrst come into history as the allies ﬁrst of one power and then of another.
uz: Turklar yoki tatarlar avval bir davlatning ittifoqchilari, keyin esa boshqa davlatning ittifoqchilari sifatida tarixda paydo bo'lishadi.

en: In the sixth century the two chief antagonists were Jus- tinian and Chosroes I; in the opening of the seventh the Emperor Heraclius was pitted against Chosroes II (580).
uz: Oltinchi asrda ikki asosiy dushman Jus-tinian va Xosroes I edi; yettinchi asrning boshida imperator Gerakliy Xosroes II ga qarshi kurashdi (580).

en: At ﬁrst and until after Heraclius had become Emperor (610) Chosroes II carried all before him.
uz: Dastlab va Gerakliy imperator bo'lgandan keyin (610 yil) Xosroes II hamma narsani uning oldida ko'tardi.

en: He took Antioch, Damascus and Jerusalem and his armies reached Chalcedon, which is in Asia Minor over against Constan- tinople.
uz: U Antioxia, Damashq va Quddusni egalladi va uning qo'shinlari Kichik Osiyoda joylashgan Xalcedonga, Konstan-tinoplega qarshi yetib bordi.

en: In 619 he conquered Egypt.
uz: 619-yilda u Misrni zabt etdi.

en: Then Heraclius pressed a counter at- tack home and routed a Persian army at Nineveh (627), although at that time there were still Persian troops at Chalcedon.
uz: Keyin Gerakliy uyga qarshi to'siq qo'ydi va Nineva shahrida (627) Fors armiyasini mag'lub etdi, garchi o'sha paytda Xalcedonda hali ham Fors qo'shinlari bor edi.

en: In 628 Chosroes II was deposed and murdered by his son, Kavadh, and an inconclusive peace was made between the two exhausted empires.
uz: 628-yilda Chosroes II o'g'li Kavadh tomonidan ag'darildi va o'ldirildi va ikki charchagan imperiya o'rtasida xulosa bo'lmaydigan tinchlik o'rnatildi.

en: Byzantium and Persia had fought their last war.
uz: Vizantiya va Fors o'zlarining oxirgi urushini olib borgan edi.

en: But few people as yet dreamt of the storm that was even then gathering in the deserts to put an end for ever to this aimless, chronic struggle.
uz: Lekin hali kam odam o'sha paytda ham sahrolarda to'planib, bu maqsadsiz, surunkali kurashga abadiy chek qo'yayotgan bo'ron haqida orzu qilardi.

en: While Heraclius was restoring order in Syria a message reached him.
uz: Gerakliy Suriyada tartibni tiklayotgan paytda unga xabar yetib keldi.

en: It had been brought in to the imperial outpost at Bostra south of Damascus; it was in Arabic, an obscure Semitic desert language, and it was read to the Emperor, if it reached him at all, by an interpreter.
uz: U Damashqning janubidagi Bostra shahridagi imperatorlik ustunxonasiga olib kelingan edi; u arab tilida, noma'lum semit cho'l tilida edi va imperatorga, agar unga yetib borsa, tarjimon tomonidan o'qilgan edi.

en: It was from someone who called himself “Muhammad the Prophet of God.” It called upon the Emperor to acknowledge the One True God and to serve him.
uz: Bu o'zini Xudoning Payg'ambari Muhammad deb atagan odamdan edi. U imperatorni Yagona Haqiqiy Xudoni tan olishga va Unga xizmat qilishga chaqirardi.

en: What the Em- peror said is not recorded.
uz: Em-perorning aytganlari qayd etilmagan.

en: A similar message came to Kavadh at Ctesiphon.
uz: Xuddi shunday xabar Ctesiphondagi Kavadhga keldi.

en: He was annoyed, tore up the letter, and bade the messenger begone.
uz: U g'azablanib, xatni yirtib tashladi va xabarchi boshladi.

en: This Muhammad, it appeared, was a Bedouin leader whose headquarters were in the mean little desert town of Medina.
uz: Bu Muhammad, ko'rinishicha, Madina degan oddiy kichik cho'l shahrida joylashgan badaviylar yetakchisi edi.

en: He was preaching a new reli- gion of faith in the One True God.
uz: U Yagona Haqiqiy Xudoga bo'lgan imonning yangi dinini va'z qilayotgan edi.

en: “Even so, O Lord!” he said; “rend thou his Kingdom from Kavadh.”
uz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, ey Rabbim!  dedi u; uning shohligini Kavadhdan qaytarib ber.

en: XLII THE DYNASTIES OF SUY AND TANG IN CHINA Throughout the ﬁfth, sixth, seventh and eighth centuries, there was a steady drift of Mongolian peoples westward.
uz: Xitoyda SUY VA TANG sulolalari. Beshinchi, oltinchi, yettinchi va sakkizinchi asrlar davomida moʻgʻul xalqlarining gʻarbga doimiy siljishi kuzatildi.

en: The Huns of Attila were merely pre- cursors of this advance, which led at last to the establishment of Mongolian peoples in Finland, Esthonia, Hungary and Bulgaria, where their descen- dants, speaking languages akin to Turkish, survive to this day.
uz: Attila xunlari bu oldinga siljishning faqat oldingi ko'rsatkichlari edi, bu oxir-oqibatda Finlandiya, Estoniya, Vengriya va Bolgariyada mo'g'ul xalqlarining paydo bo'lishiga olib keldi, u yerda ularning avlodlari, turkchaga o'xshash tillarda gapiradiganlar, bugungi kungacha saqlanib qolmoqda.

en: The Mongo- lian nomads were, in fact, playing a role towards the Aryanized civilizations of Europe and Persia and India that the Aryans had played to the Ægean and Semitic civilizations ten or ﬁfteen centuries before.
uz: Mongo-Lian ko'chmanchilari, aslida, Yevropa, Fors va Hindistonning ariylashgan sivilizatsiyalariga nisbatan o'sha rolni o'ynagan edi, o'n-o'n besh asr oldin ariylar esa Ægean va Semit sivilizatsiyalariga o'ynagan edi.

en: In Central Asia the Turkish peoples had taken root in what is now West- ern Turkestan, and Persia already employed many Turkish ofﬁcials and Turkish mercenaries.
uz: Markaziy Osiyoda turk xalqlari hozirgi G'arbiy Turkistonda ildiz otgan edi va Forslar allaqachon ko'plab turk amaldorlari va turk yollanma askarlarini ish bilan ta'minlagan edi.

en: The Parthians had gone out of history, absorbed into the general population of Persia.
uz: Parfiyaliklar tarixdan chiqib ketgan, Forsning umumiy aholisiga singib ketgan edi.

en: There were no more Aryan nomads in the history of Central Asia; Mongolian people had replaced them.
uz: Markaziy Osiyo tarixida endi ariy ko'chmanchilari yo'q edi; ularni mo'g'ul xalqi almashtirgan edi.

en: The Turks became masters of Asia from China to the Caspian.
uz: Turklar Xitoydan Kaspiygacha bo'lgan Osiyoga xo'jayin bo'lishdi.

en: The same great pestilence at the end of the second century A.D.
uz: Xuddi shu buyuk vabo milodiy ikkinchi asr oxirida.

en: that had shattered the Roman Empire had overthrown the Han dynasty in China.
uz: Rim imperiyasini sindirgan, Xitoydagi Xan sulolasini ag'dargan.

en: Then came a period of division and of Hunnish conquests from which Chi- na arose refreshed, more rapidly and more completely than Europe was des- tined to do.
uz: Keyin bo'linish davri va Gunn bosqinlari keldi, ulardan Chi-na yangilanib, Yevropa qilishga qaror qilganidan tezroq va to'liqroq paydo bo'ldi.

en: Before the end of the sixth century China was reunited under the Suy dynasty, and this by the time of Heraclius gave place to the Tang dynasty, whose reign marks another great period of prosperity for China.
uz: Oltinchi asr oxirigacha Xitoy Suy sulolasi ostida qayta birlashtirildi va bu Gerakliy davriga kelib Tang sulolasiga o'rnini berdi, uning hukmronligi Xitoy uchun yana bir buyuk farovonlik davrini belgilaydi.

en: CHINESE EARTHENWARE ART OF THE TANG DYNASTY, 616-906 Specimens in glazed earthenware, in brown, green and buff, discovered in tombs in China  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum)
uz: Xitoy Yer ustidagi TANG sulolasi san'ati, 616-906 Xitoydagi qabrlarda (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) ochilgan, jigarrang, yashil va bo'rtma rangdagi oynali tuproqdan yasalgan namunalar.

en: Throughout the seventh, eighth and ninth centuries China was the most secure and civilized country in the world.
uz: Yettinchi, sakkizinchi va to'qqizinchi asrlar davomida Xitoy dunyodagi eng xavfsiz va madaniy davlat edi.

en: The Han dynasty had extended her boundaries in the north; the Suy and Tang dynasties now spread her civ- ilization to the south, and China began to assume the proportions she has to- day.
uz: Xan sulolasi o'z chegaralarini shimolda cho'zgan edi; Suy va Tang sulolalari endi o'z sivilizatsiyasini janubga yoya boshladi va Xitoy bugungi kunda o'z proporsiyalarini o'z zimmasiga ola boshladi.

en: In Central Asia indeed she reached much further, extending at last, through tributary Turkish tribes, to Persia and the Caspian Sea.
uz: Markaziy Osiyoda u haqiqatan ham ancha uzoqroqqa yetib bordi, nihoyat, turk qabilalari orqali, Fors va Kaspiy dengizigacha cho'zilib bordi.

en: The new China that had arisen was a very different land from the old China of the Hans.
uz: Yangi paydo bo'lgan Xitoy Xansning eski Xitoydan juda farq qiladigan yer edi.

en: A new and more vigorous literary school appeared, there was a great poetic revival; Buddhism had revolutionized philosophical and religious thought.
uz: Yangi va kuchliroq adabiyot maktabi paydo bo'ldi, katta she'riy uyg'onish bo'ldi; Buddizm falsafiy va diniy tafakkurni inqilob qildi.

en: There were great advances in artistic work, in technical skill and in all the amenities of life.
uz: Badiiy ishda, texnik mahoratda va hayotning barcha qulayliklarida katta yutuqlar bo'ldi.

en: Tea was ﬁrst used, paper manufactured and wood-block printing began.
uz: Choy birinchi marta ishlatilgan, qog'oz ishlab chiqarilgan va yog'och blokli bosma bosma boshlangan.

en: Millions of people indeed were leading or- derly, graceful and kindly lives in China during these centuries when the attenuated populations of Europe and Western Asia were living either in hovels, small walled cities or grim robber fortresses.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, millionlab odamlar Xitoyda shu asrlarda, Yevropa va G'arbiy Osiyoning zaif aholisi hovlilarda, kichik devorli shaharlarda yoki jirkanch qaroqchilar qal'alarida yashagan davrda beparvo, nafis va mehribon hayot kechirardilar.

en: While the mind of the west was black with theological obsessions, the mind of China was open and tolerant and enquiring.
uz: G'arb ongi ilohiy ehtiroslar bilan qora bo'lgan bir paytda, Xitoy ongi ochiq, bag'rikeng va izlanuvchan edi.

en: One of the earliest monarchs of the Tang dynasty was Tai- tsung, who be- gan to reign in 627, the year of the victory of Heraclius at Nineveh.
uz: Tang sulolasining eng erta monarxlaridan biri Tai-tsung bo'lib, u 627-yilda, Nerakliyning Ninevehdagi g'alabasi yilida hukmronlik qilgan.

en: He re- ceived an embassy from Heraclius, who was probably seeking an ally in the rear of Persia.
uz: U Gerakliydan elchixona qabul qildi, u ehtimol Fors orqasida ittifoqchi qidirayotgan edi.

en: From Persia itself came a party of Christian missionaries (635).
uz: Forsning o'zidan xristian missionerlar guruhi kelib chiqdi (635).

en: They were allowed to explain their creed to Tai-tsung and he exam- ined a Chinese translation of their Scriptures.
uz: Ularga o'z e'tiqodlarini Tai-tsunga tushuntirishga ruxsat berildi va u ularning Muqaddas Kitoblarining xitoycha tarjimasini tekshirib ko'rdi.

en: He pronounced this strange religion acceptable, and gave permission for the foundation of a church and monastery.
uz: U bu g'alati dinni maqbul deb e'lon qildi va cherkov va monastirga asos solishga ruxsat berdi.

en: To this monarch also (in 628) came messengers from Muhammad.
uz: Bu monarxga ham (628-yilda) Muhammaddan elchilar kelishdi.

en: They came to Canton on a trading ship.
uz: Ular Kanton shahriga savdo kemasida kelishdi.

en: They had sailed the whole way from Ara- bia along the Indian coasts.
uz: Ular Ara-bia'dan butun yo'lni Hindiston qirg'oqlari bo'ylab suzib o'tishdi.

en: Unlike Heraclius and Kavadh, Tai-Tsung gave these envoys a courteous hearing.
uz: Gerakliy va Kavadhdan farqli o'laroq, Tai-Tsung bu elchilarga xushmuomalalik bilan tingladi.

en: He expressed his interest in their theolog- ical ideas and assisted them to build a mosque in Canton, a mosque which survives, it is said, to this day, the oldest mosque in the world.
uz: U ularning teologik g'oyalariga qiziqishini bildirdi va ularga Kantonda masjid qurishga yordam berdi, bu masjid bugungi kungacha dunyodagi eng qadimgi masjid deb aytiladi.

en: XLIII MUHAMMAD AND ISLAM A prophetic amateur of history surveying the world in the opening of the seventh century might have concluded very reasonably that it was only a question of a few centuries before the whole of Europe and Asia fell under Mongolian domination.
uz: XLIII MUHAMMAD VA ISLOM Yettinchi asr boshida dunyoni o'rganayotgan bashoratkor tarix havaskori, butun Yevropa va Osiyo Mo'g'ullar hukmronligiga tushib qolishidan bir necha asr oldin bo'lgan masala edi, degan xulosaga kelishlari mumkin edi.

en: There were no signs of order or union in Western Europe, and the Byzantine and Persian Empires were manifestly bent upon a mutual destruction.
uz: G'arbiy Yevropada tartib yoki ittifoq alomatlari yo'q edi va Vizantiya va Fors imperiyalari o'zaro vayronagarchilikka ochiqchasiga moyil edi.

en: India also was divided and wasted.
uz: Hindiston ham bo'lindi va isrof bo'ldi.

en: On the other hand China was a steadily expanding empire which probably at that time exceed- ed all Europe in population, and the Turkish people who were growing to power in Central Asia were disposed to work in accord with China.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, Xitoy doimiy ravishda kengayib borayotgan imperiya edi, u o'sha paytda aholi soni bo'yicha butun Yevropadan oshib ketgandir va Markaziy Osiyoda hokimiyatga o'sib borayotgan turk xalqi Xitoy bilan kelishgan holda ishlashga tayyor edi.

en: And such a prophecy would not have been an altogether vain one.
uz: Va bunday bashorat umuman bekorga bo'lmas edi.

en: A time was to come in the thirteenth century when a Mongolian overlord would rule from the Danube to the Paciﬁc, and Turkish dynasties were destined to reign over the entire Byzantine and Persian Empires, over Egypt and most of India.
uz: O'n uchinchi asrda Mo'g'ul hukmdorining Dunay daryosidan Tinch okeanigacha hukmronlik qiladigan vaqti kelardi va turk sulolalari butun Vizantiya va Fors imperiyalari, Misr va Hindistonning ko'p qismi ustidan hukmronlik qilishga mahkum edi.

en: Where our prophet would have been most likely to have erred would have been in under-estimating the recuperative power of the Latin end of Europe and in ignoring the latent forces of the Arabian desert.
uz: Payg'ambarimiz eng ko'p xato qilgan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa, Yevropaning Lotin chekkasidagi tiklanish kuchini past baholash va Arabiston cho'lining yashirin kuchlariga e'tibor berishda bo'lardi.

en: Arabia would have seemed what it had been for times immemorial, the refuge of small and bickering nomadic tribes.
uz: Arabiston qadim zamonlardan beri bo'lganidek, kichik va janjalkash ko'chmanchi qabilalarning panohi bo'lgandek tuyulgan bo'lardi.

en: No Semitic people had founded an empire now for more than a thousand years.
uz: Hech qanday semit xalqi ming yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri imperiyaga asos solmagan edi.

en: Then suddenly the Bedouin ﬂared out for a brief century of splendour.
uz: Keyin to'satdan badaviy qisqa bir asr hashamat uchun yonib chiqdi.

en: They spread their rule and language from Spain to the boundaries of China.
uz: Ular o'z hukmronligi va tilini Ispaniyadan Xitoy chegaralarigacha yoyishdi.

en: They gave the world a new culture.
uz: Ular dunyoga yangi madaniyat berdilar.

en: They created a religion that is still to this day one of the most vital forces in the world.
uz: Ular dunyodagi eng muhim kuchlardan biri bo'lgan dinni yaratdilar, u bugungi kungacha ham shundaydir.

en: The man who ﬁred this Arab ﬂame appears ﬁrst in history as the young husband of the widow of a rich merchant of the town of Mecca, named Muhammad.
uz: Bu arab olovini yoqqan odam birinchi marta tarixga Makka shahridagi boy savdogarning bevasining yosh eri, Muhammad nomi bilan kiradi.

en: Until he was forty he did very little to distinguish himself in the world.
uz: U qirq yoshga to'lguncha dunyoda ajralib turish uchun juda oz ish qildi.

en: He seems to have taken considerable interest in religious discus- sion.
uz: U diniy munozaralarga katta qiziqish qo'ygan ko'rinadi.

en: Mecca was a pagan city at that time worshipping in particular a black stone, the Kaaba, of great repute throughout all Arabia and a centre of pil- grimages; but there were great numbers of Jews in the country—indeed all the southern portion of Arabia professed the Jewish faith—and there were Christian churches in Syria.
uz: Makka o'sha paytda butparast shahar edi, ayniqsa butun Arabiston bo'ylab katta obro'ga ega bo'lgan qora toshga, Ka'baga sig'inardi va pil-makiyaj markazi edi; lekin mamlakatda yahudiylar soni juda ko'p edi  haqiqatan ham, Arabistonning butun janubiy qismi yahudiy e'tiqodini e'tiqod qilardi  va Suriyada xristian cherkovlari bor edi.

en: About forty Muhammad began to develop prophetic characteristics like those of the Hebrew prophets twelve hundred years before him.
uz: Taxminan qirq Muhammad o'zidan o'n ikki yuz yil oldin bo'lgan ibroniy payg'ambarlar kabi payg'ambarlik xususiyatlarini rivojlantira boshladi.

en: He talked ﬁrst to his wife of the One True God, and of the rewards and punishments of virtue and wickedness.
uz: U avval xotiniga Yagona Haqiqiy Xudo haqida, hamda fazilat va yovuzlikning mukofotlari va jazolari haqida gapirdi.

en: There can be no doubt that his thoughts were very strongly inﬂuenced by Jewish and Christian ideas.
uz: Uning fikrlari yahudiy va xristian g'oyalari tomonidan juda kuchli ta'sirlanganligiga shubha yo'q.

en: He gathered about him a small circle of believers and presently began to preach in the town against the prevalent idolatry.
uz: U o'ziga ozgina mo'minlar to'plamini to'pladi va tez orada shaharda keng tarqalgan butparastlikka qarshi va'z qila boshladi.

en: This made him extremely unpopular with his fellow townsmen because the pilgrimages to the Kaaba were the chief source of such prosperity as Mecca enjoyed.
uz: Bu uni o'z hamshaharlari orasida juda mashhur qilmadi, chunki Ka'baga ziyorat qilish Makka kabi farovonlikning asosiy manbai edi.

en: He became bolder and more deﬁnite in his teaching, declaring himself to be the last chosen prophet of God entrust- ed with a mission to perfect religion.
uz: U o'z ta'limotida yanada jasurroq va qat'iyroq bo'lib, o'zini Xudoning eng so'nggi tanlangan payg'ambari deb e'lon qildi va dinni mukammal qilish missiyasini topshirdi.

en: Abraham, he declared, and Jesus Christ were his forerunners.
uz: Ibrohim, u e'lon qildi va Iso Masih uning oldingi o'tmishdoshlari edi.

en: He had been chosen to complete and perfect the revelation of God’s will.
uz: U Xudoning irodasining vahiyasini yakunlash va mukammal qilish uchun tanlangan edi.

en: He produced verses which he said had been communicated to him by an angel, and he had a strange vision in which he was taken up through the Heavens to God and instructed in his mission.
uz: U o'ziga farishta tomonidan yetkazilgan misralarni keltirdi va u osmonda Xudoga ko'tarilib, o'z missiyasida ko'rsatilgan g'alati bir vahiyga ega edi.

en: AT PRAYER IN THE DESERT  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock As his teaching increased in force the hostility of his fellow townsmen increased also.
uz: SAHARXANDAGI DUO Surat: Lehnert & Landrock Uning ta'limoti kuchga to'lgan sari, shahar aholisining dushmanligi ham kuchayib borardi.

en: At last a plot was made to kill him; but he escaped with his faithful friend and disciple, Abu Bekr, to the friendly town of Medina which adopted his doctrine.
uz: Nihoyat, uni o'ldirish uchun fitna uyushtirildi; lekin u sadoqatli do'sti va shogirdi Abu Bekr bilan uning ta'limoti qabul qilingan do'stona Madina shahriga qochib ketdi.

en: Hostilities followed between Mecca and Medina which ended at last in a treaty.
uz: Makka va Madina oʻrtasida dushmanlik davom etdi, bu esa nihoyat shartnoma bilan yakunlandi.

en: Mecca was to adopt the worship of the One True God and accept Muhammad as his prophet, but the adherents of the new faith were still to make the pilgrimage to Mecca just as they had done when they were pagans.
uz: Makka Yagona Haqiqiy Xudoga sig'inishni qabul qilishi va Muhammadni o'z payg'ambari sifatida qabul qilishi kerak edi, lekin yangi e'tiqod tarafdorlari baribir Makkaga butparast bo'lganlarida qilganidek ziyorat qilishlari kerak edi.

en: So Muhammad established the One True God in
uz: Shunday qilib, Muhammad Yagona Haqiqiy Xudoni o'rnatdi.

en: Mecca without injuring its pilgrim trafﬁc.
uz: Makka ziyoratchilarning harakatlariga zarar yetkazmasdan.

en: In 629 Muhammad returned to Mecca as its master, a year after he had sent out these envoys of his to Hera- clius, Tai-tsung, Kavadh and all the rulers of the earth.
uz: 629-yilda Muhammad Makkaga xo'jayin sifatida qaytdi, bu xabarlarini Hera-klyus, Tai-tsung, Kavadh va yer yuzidagi barcha hukmdorlarga yuborganidan bir yil o'tib.

en: LOOKING ACROSS THE SEA OF SAND  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock Then for four years more until his death in 632, Muhammad spread his power over the rest of Arabia.
uz: QUM DENGIZINI SO'RISH Photo: Lehnert & Landrock Keyin 632-yilda vafotiga qadar yana to'rt yil davomida Muhammad o'z hokimiyatini Arabistonning qolgan qismiga yoydi.

en: He married a number of wives in his declin- ing years, and his life on the whole was by modern standards unedifying.
uz: U o'zining pasayib borayotgan yillarida bir nechta xotinlarga turmushga chiqdi va umuman olganda, uning hayoti zamonaviy standartlar bo'yicha quruq emas edi.

en: He seems to have been a man compounded of very considerable vanity, greed, cunning, self-deception and quite sincere religious passion.
uz: U juda katta bema'nilik, ochko'zlik, hiyla-nayrang, o'zini aldash va juda samimiy diniy ishtiyoq bilan to'ldirilgan odamga o'xshardi.

en: He dic- tated a book of injunctions and expositions, the Koran, which he declared was communicated to him from God.
uz: U buyruqlar va tushuntirishlar kitobini, Qur'onni yozdi, uni Xudo tomonidan unga yetkazilgan deb e'lon qildi.

en: Regarded as literature or philosophy the Koran is certainly unworthy of its alleged Divine authorship.
uz: Qur'on adabiyot yoki falsafa sifatida ko'rilsa, u, albatta, o'zining Xudolik muallifligiga loyiq emas.

en: Yet when the manifest defects of Muhammad’s life and writings have been allowed for, there remains in Islam, this faith he imposed upon the Arabs, much power and inspiration.
uz: Ammo Muhammadning hayoti va yozgan asarlarining ochiq nuqsonlariga ruxsat berilganda ham, Islomda u arablarga yuklagan bu imon, ko'p kuch va ilhom qoladi.

en: One is its uncompromising monothe- ism; its simple enthusiastic faith in the rule and fatherhood of God and its freedom from theological complications.
uz: Biri uning murosasiz monoteizmidir; Xudoning hukmronligi va otasiligiga hamda teologik murakkabliklardan ozodligiga bo'lgan oddiy ishtiyoqli ishonchi.

en: Another is its complete detach- ment from the sacriﬁcial priest and the temple.
uz: Yana biri - qurbonlik ruhoniysi va ibodatxonadan butunlay ajralishidir.

en: It is an entirely prophetic religion, proof against any possibility of relapse towards blood sacriﬁces.
uz: Bu butunlay bashorat dinidir, qon qurbonliklariga qaytish ehtimoliga qarshi dalil.

en: In the Koran the limited and ceremonial nature of the pilgrimage to Mecca is stated beyond the possibility of dispute, and every precaution was taken by
uz: Qur'onda Makkaga ziyoratning cheklangan va marosimli mohiyati bahsli ehtimoldan tashqari bayon etilgan va har bir ehtiyot chorasi qo'llanilgan.

en: Muhammad to prevent the deiﬁcation of himself after his death.
uz: Muhammad o'limidan keyin o'zining ilohiylashining oldini olish uchun.

en: And a third element of strength lay in the insistence of Islam upon the perfect brother- hood and equality before God of all believers, whatever their colour, origin or status.
uz: Va kuchning uchinchi elementi Islomning mukammal birodarlikka bo'lgan qat'iyatida yotardi - barcha mo'minlarning rangi, kelib chiqishi yoki maqomi qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, Xudo oldida tenglik va tenglik.

en: These are the things that made Islam a power in human affairs.
uz: Bular Islomni insoniy ishlarda qudratga aylantirgan narsalardir.

en: It has been said that the true founder of the Empire of Islam was not so much Muhammad as his friend and helper, Abu Bekr.
uz: Islom imperiyasining haqiqiy asoschisi Muhammad emas, balki uning do'sti va yordamchisi Abu Bekr bo'lgani aytilgan.

en: If Muhammad, with his shifty character, was the mind and imagination of primitive Islam, Abu Bekr was its conscience and its will.
uz: Agar Muhammad o'zining nozik xarakteri bilan ibtidoiy Islomning aqli va tasavvuri bo'lsa, Abu Bekr uning vijdoni va irodasi edi.

en: Whenever Muhammad wavered Abu Bekr sustained him.
uz: Muhammad har safar ikkilanib qolsa, Abu Bekr uni qo'llab-quvvatlardi.

en: And when Muhammad died, Abu Bekr became Caliph (= successor), and with that faith that moves mountains, he set himself sim- ply and sanely to organize the subjugation of the whole world to Allah— with little armies of 3,000 or 4,000 Arabs—according to those letters the prophet had written from Medina in 628 to all the monarchs of the world.
uz: Muhammad vafot etganidan so'ng, Abu Bekr xalifa bo'ldi (= voris), va o'sha tog'larni harakatga keltiradigan imon bilan, u butun dunyoning Allohga bo'ysunishini tashkil etishga o'zini aql-idrok bilan qo'ydi  3000 yoki 4000 arabdan iborat kichik qo'shin bilan  Payg'ambar 628-yilda Madinadan butun dunyo monarxlariga yozgan maktublariga ko'ra.

en: XLIV THE GREAT DAYS OF THE ARABS There follows the most amazing story of conquest in the whole history of our race.
uz: XLIV ARABLARNING BUYUK KUNLARI Irqimiz tarixidagi eng ajoyib fath tarixi davom etadi.

en: The Byzantine army was smashed at the battle of the Yarmuk (a tributary of the Jordan) in 634; and the Emperor Heraclius, his energy sapped by dropsy and his resources exhausted by the Persian war, saw his new conquests in Syria, Damascus, Palmyra, Antioch, Jerusalem and the rest fall almost without resistance to the Moslim.
uz: Vizantiya armiyasi 634-yilda Iordaniya daryosi boʻlgan Yarmuq jangida magʻlub etildi. Imperator Gerakliy esa, uning energiyasi tomchilatib, resurslari Fors urushi natijasida charchagan holda, Suriyada, Damashqda, Palmirada, Antioxada, Quddusda va qolgan joylarda oʻzining yangi zabt etishlarini deyarli qarshiliksiz koʻrdi.

en: Large elements in the pop- ulation went over to Islam.
uz: Populyatsiyadagi katta elementlar Islomga o'tdi.

en: Then the Moslim turned east.
uz: Keyin musulmonlar sharqqa burildilar.

en: The Persians had found an able general in Rustam; they had a great host with a force of ele- phants; and for three days they fought the Arabs at Kadessia (637) and broke at last in headlong rout.
uz: Forslar Rustamda qobiliyatli general topdilar; ularda katta armiya, filonlar kuchi bor edi; va uch kun davomida ular Kadessiyada arablar bilan (637) jang qilishdi va oxir-oqibat jangda mag'lub bo'lishdi.

en: The conquest of all Persia followed, and the Moslem Empire pushed far into Western Turkestan and eastward until it met the Chinese.
uz: Butun Fors zabt etilishi davom etdi va musulmon imperiyasi Xitoylarga duch kelguncha G'arbiy Turkiston va sharqqa uzoqroqqa surildi.

en: Egypt fell al- most without resistance to the new conquerors, who full of a fanatical belief in the sufﬁciency of the Koran, wiped out the vestiges of the book-copying industry of the Alexandria Library.
uz: Misr yangi bosqinchilarga qarshilik ko'rsatmasdan quladi, ular Qur'onning yetarliligiga fanatik ishonch bilan to'lib, Iskandariya kutubxonasining kitob nusxalash sanoatining qoldiqlarini yo'q qildilar.

en: The tide of conquest poured along the north coast of Africa to the Straits of Gibraltar and Spain.
uz: Afrika shimoliy sohili bo'ylab Gibraltar va Ispaniya bo'g'ozlarigacha bosqin to'lqini oqib keldi.

en: Spain was invad- ed in 710 and the Pyrenees Mountains were reached in 720.
uz: Ispaniya 710-yilda bostirib kirildi va Piriney tog'lariga 720-yilda yetib borildi.

en: In 732 the Arab advance had reached the centre of France, but here it was stopped for good at the battle of Poitiers and thrust back as far as the Pyrenees again.
uz: 732-yilda arablarning yurishi Fransiya markaziga yetib bordi, ammo bu yerda u Poitier jangida butunlay to'xtadi va yana Piriney tog'larigacha orqaga itariladi.

en: The conquest of Egypt had given the Moslim a ﬂeet, and for a time it looked as though they would take Constantinople.
uz: Misrning zabt etilishi musulmonlarga flot bergan edi va bir muddatga ular Konstantinopolni egallagandek ko'rindi.

en: They made repeated sea attacks be- tween 672 and 718 but the great city held out against them.
uz: Ular 672 va 718-yillarda qayta-qayta dengiz hujumlarini amalga oshirdilar, lekin buyuk shahar ularga qarshi tura olmadi.

en: The Arabs had little political aptitude and no political experience, and this great empire with its capital now at Damascus, which stretched from Spain to China, was destined to break up very speedily.
uz: Arablar siyosiy qobiliyati kam va siyosiy tajribasi yo'q edi, va bu buyuk imperiya, hozirda poytaxti Damashqda bo'lgan va Ispaniya dan Xitoygacha cho'zilgan, juda tez parchalanishga mahkum edi.

en: From the very be- ginning doctrinal differences undermined its unity.
uz: Eng ko'p dogmatik farqlar uning birlikka putur yetkazdi.

en: But our interest here lies not with the story of its political disintegration but with its effect upon the human mind and upon the general destinies of our race.
uz: Lekin bizning bu yerda qiziqishimiz uning siyosiy parchalanishi haqidagi hikoyada emas, balki uning inson ongiga va irqimizning umumiy taqdirlariga ta'siri bilan bog'liq.

en: The Arab intelli- gence had been ﬂung across the world even more swiftly and dramatically than had the Greek a thousand years before.
uz: Arab aqli yunonlarga qaraganda ming yil oldin dunyoga yanada tez va dramatik tarzda tashlandi.

en: The intellectual stimulation of
uz: Intellektual rag'batlantirish

en: the whole world west of China, the break-up of old ideas and development of new ones, was enormous.
uz: Xitoyning butun g'arbiy dunyosi, eski g'oyalarning parchalanishi va yangi g'oyalarning rivojlanishi juda katta edi.

en: In Persia this fresh excited Arabic mind came into contact not only with Manichæan, Zoroastrian and Christian doctrine, but with the scientiﬁc Greek literature, preserved not only in Greek but in Syrian translations.
uz: Forsda bu yangi hayajonlangan arab ongi nafaqat Manixëan, Zoroaster va xristian ta'limoti bilan, balki nafaqat yunon tilida, balki suriya tarjimalarida saqlanib qolgan ilmiy yunon adabiyoti bilan ham aloqada bo'ldi.

en: It found Greek learning in Egypt also.
uz: Misrda ham yunon ta'limini topdi.

en: Every-where, and particularly in Spain, it discovered an active Jewish tradition of speculation and discussion.
uz: Hamma joyda, ayniqsa Ispaniyada, u faol yahudiy an'anasining taxmin va munozara qilishini aniqladi.

en: In Central Asia it met Buddhism and the material achievements of Chinese civilization.
uz: Markaziy Osiyoda u buddizm va Xitoy sivilizatsiyasining moddiy yutuqlariga duch keldi.

en: It learnt the manufacture of paper—which made printed books possible—from the Chinese.
uz: U qog'oz ishlab chiqarishni  bosma kitoblarni imkoniyatga aylantirgan narsani  xitoyliklardan o'rgangan.

en: And ﬁnally it came into touch with Indian mathematics and philosophy.
uz: Va nihoyat u hind matematika va falsafasi bilan aloqada bo'ldi.

en: JERUSALEM, SHOWING THE MOSQUE OF OMAR  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock Very speedily the intolerant self-sufﬁciency of the early days of faith, which made the Koran seem the only possible book, was dropped.
uz: YERUSHOLIM, OMAR MASJIDINI KO'RSATISH Surat: Lehnert & Landrock Juda tezda imonning dastlabki kunlarining chidamsiz o'zini-o'zi ta'minlashi, Qur'onni yagona mumkin bo'lgan kitobga o'xshatishi tushdi.

en: sprang up everywhere in the footsteps of the Arab conquerors.
uz: Arab bosqinchilarining izidan hamma joyda sakrab chiqdi.

en: By the eighth century there was an educational organization throughout the whole “Arabized” world.
uz: Sakkizinchi asrga kelib butun Arablashgan dunyo boʻylab taʼlim tashkiloti paydo boʻldi.

en: In the ninth learned men in the schools of Cordoba in Spain were corresponding with learned men in Cairo, Bagdad, Bokhara and Samarkand.
uz: Toʻqqizinchi yillarda Ispaniyadagi Kordubaning maktablaridagi olimlar Qohira, Bagʻdod, Buxoro va Samarqanddagi olimlar bilan yozishmalar olib borardi.

en: The Jewish mind assimilated very readily with the Arab, and for a time the two Semitic races worked together through the medium of Arabic.
uz: Yahudiy ongi arablar bilan juda oson assimilyatsiya bo'ldi va bir vaqtlar ikki semit irqi arab tili orqali birgalikda ishladi.

en: Long after the political break-up and enfeeblement of the Arabs, this intellectual community of the Arab-speaking world endured.
uz: Arablarning siyosiy parchalanishi va zaiflashuvidan ko'p vaqt o'tgach, arab tilida so'zlashuvchi dunyoning bu intellektual jamiyati bardosh berdi.

en: It was still producing very considerable results in the thirteenth century.
uz: U o'n uchinchi asrda ham juda sezilarli natijalar berayotgan edi.
