en: VIEW OF CAIRO MOSQUES  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock So it was that the systematic accumulation and criticism of facts which was ﬁrst begun by the Greeks was resumed in this astonishing renascence of the Semitic world.
uz: QAYRO MOSKELARIGA KO'RINISH Foto: Lehnert & Landrock Shunday qilib, yunonlar tomonidan boshlangan faktlarning tizimli to'planishi va tanqidi Semit olamining bu hayratlanarli qayta tirilishi bilan qayta tiklandi.

en: The seed of Aristotle and the museum of Alexandria that had lain so long inactive and neglected now germinated and began to
uz: Aristotel urug'i va Iskandariya muzeyi, uzoq vaqt davomida faoliyatsiz va e'tiborsiz qolgan edi, endi unib chiqdi va boshladi.

en: grow towards fruition.
uz: Meva sari o'sish.

en: Very great advances were made in mathematical, medical and physical science.
uz: Matematika, tibbiyot va fizika fanlarida juda katta yutuqlar erishildi.

en: The clumsy Roman numerals were ousted by the Arabic ﬁgures we use to this day and the zero sign was ﬁrst employed.
uz: Qo'pol Rim raqamlari bugungi kungacha ishlatiladigan arab raqamlari tomonidan yo'q qilindi va nol belgisi birinchi marta qo'llanildi.

en: The very name algebra is Arabic.
uz: Algebra nomining o'zi arabcha.

en: So is the word chemistry.
uz: Xuddi shunday, kimyo so'zi ham shunday.

en: The names of such stars as Algol, Aldebaran and Boötes preserve the traces of Arab con- quests in the sky.
uz: Algol, Aldebaran va Boötes kabi yulduzlarning nomlari osmondagi arab musobaqalari izlarini saqlab qolgan.

en: Their philosophy was destined to reanimate the medieval philosophy of France and Italy and the whole Christian world.
uz: Ularning falsafasi Fransiya va Italiyaning hamda butun xristian olamining o'rta asr falsafasini jonlantirishga mo'ljallangan edi.

en: The Arab experimental chemists were called alchemists, and they were still sufﬁciently barbaric in spirit to keep their methods and results secret as far as possible.
uz: Arab eksperimental kimyogarlari alkimyogarlar deb atalgan va ular hali ham o'z usullari va natijalarini imkon qadar maxfiy saqlash uchun yetarlicha vahshiy ruhda edilar.

en: They realized from the very beginning what enormous ad- vantages their possible discoveries might give them, and what far-reaching consequences they might have on human life.
uz: Ular o'zlarining mumkin bo'lgan kashfiyotlari ularga qanday ulkan reklama afzalliklarini berishi va inson hayotiga qanday uzoq muddatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkinligini boshidanoq angladilar.

en: They came upon many metal- lurgical and technical devices of the utmost value, alloys and dyes, distill- ing, tinctures and essences, optical glass; but the two chief ends they sought, they sought in vain.
uz: Ular juda yuqori qiymatdagi metall-logik va texnik qurilmalar, qotishmalar va bo'yoqlar, destillash, bo'yoqlar va mohiyatlar, optik shishaga duch kelishdi; lekin ular izlagan ikki asosiy nuqta, ular behuda izlashdi.

en: One was “the philosopher’s stone”—a means of changing the metallic elements one into another and so getting a control of artiﬁcial gold, and the other was the elixir vitœ, a stimulant that would re- vivify age and prolong life indeﬁnitely.
uz: Biri falsafa toshi metall elementlarni bir-biriga o'zgartirish va shu orqali sun'iy oltinni nazorat qilish vositasi edi, ikkinchisi esa elixir vitœ edi, bu yoshni qayta jonlantiradigan va hayotni cheksiz uzaytiradigan stimulyator edi.

en: The crabbed patient experimenting of these Arab alchemists spread into the Christian world.
uz: Bu arab alkimyogarlarining keksa bemorlarning tajribalari xristian olamiga tarqaldi.

en: The fascination of their enquiries spread.
uz: Ularning so'rovlariga bo'lgan qiziqish tarqaldi.

en: Very gradually the activities of these alchemists be- came more social and co-operative.
uz: Juda asta-sekin bu alkimyogarlarning faoliyati yanada ijtimoiy va kooperativ bo'lib bordi.

en: They found it proﬁtable to exchange and compare ideas.
uz: Ular g'oyalarni almashish va solishtirish foydali deb topishdi.

en: By insensible gradations the last of the alchemists be- came the ﬁrst of the experimental philosophers.
uz: Sezilmas gradatsiyalar orqali alkimyogarlarning oxirgisi tajriba faylasuflarining birinchisi bo'ldi.

en: The old alchemists sought the philosopher’s stone which was to trans- mute base metals to gold, and an elixir of immortality; they found the meth- ods of modern experimental science which promise in the end to give man illimitable power over the world and over his own destiny.
uz: Qadimgi alkimyogarlar falsafachi toshini qidirdilar, u asosiy metallarni oltinga aylantirish va o'lmaslik elixirini; ular zamonaviy eksperimental fanning met-moduslarini topdilar, ular oxir-oqibatda insonga dunyo va o'z taqdirlari ustidan cheksiz hokimiyat berishga va'da beradilar.

en: XLV THE DEVELOPMENT OF LATIN CHRISTENDOM It is worth while to note the extremely shrunken dimensions of the share of the world remaining under Aryan control in the seventh and eighth cen- turies.
uz: XLV LOTIN XRISTIANLIGINING TANVILISHI Yettinchi va sakkizinchi asrlarda dunyoni Aryanlar nazorati ostida qoldirgan ulushning juda qisqargan o'lchamlarini ta'kidlashga arziydi.

en: A thousand years before, the Aryan-speaking races were triumphant over all the civilized world west of China.
uz: Ming yil oldin, Aryan tilida so'zlashuvchi irqlar Xitoyning g'arbidagi butun madaniy dunyo ustidan g'alaba qozonishgan.

en: Now the Mongol had thrust as far as Hungary, nothing of Asia remained under Aryan rule except the Byzantine dominions in Asia Minor, and all Africa was lost and nearly all Spain.
uz: Endi moʻgʻullar Vengriyagacha choʻkishdi, Osiyoda Aryo hukmronligi ostida Kichik Osiyodagi Vizantiya hukmronliklaridan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi va butun Afrika va deyarli butun Ispaniya yoʻqoldi.

en: The great Hellenic world had shrunken to a few possessions round the nucleus of the trading city of Constantinople, and the memory of the Roman world was kept alive by the Latin of the western Christian priests.
uz: Buyuk yunon dunyosi Konstantinopol savdo shahrining yadrosi atrofidagi bir nechta mulkka qisqargan edi va Rim dunyosining xotirasini g'arbiy xristian ruhoniylarining lotin tili bilan saqlab qolgan edi.

en: In vivid contrast to this tale of retrogression, the Semitic tradition had risen again from subjugation and obscurity after a thousand years of darkness.
uz: Bu orqaga qaytish haqidagi ertakning yorqin ziddiyatida, semit an'anasi ming yillik zulmatdan so'ng yana bo'ysundirish va qorong'ulikdan ko'tarildi.

en: Yet the vitality of the Nordic peoples was not exhausted.
uz: Shunga qaramay, Shimoliy xalqlarning hayotiyligi tugamadi.

en: Conﬁned now to Central and North-Western Europe and terribly muddled in their social and political ideas, they were nevertheless building up gradually and steadily a new social order and preparing unconsciously for the recovery of a power even more extensive than that they had previously enjoyed.
uz: Hozirda Markaziy va Shimoliy-G'arbiy Yevropaga cheklangan va o'zlarining ijtimoiy va siyosiy g'oyalarida dahshatli darajada chalkash bo'lgan holda, ular shunga qaramay asta-sekin va barqaror ravishda yangi ijtimoiy tartibni yaratayotgan va ilgari rohatlanganidan ham kengroq hokimiyatning tiklanishiga ongsiz ravishda tayyorgarlik ko'rayotgan edilar.

en: We have told how at the beginning of the sixth century there remained no central government in Western Europe at all.
uz: Biz oltinchi asr boshlarida G'arbiy Yevropada umuman markaziy hukumat qolmaganini aytib berdik.

en: That world was divided up among numbers of local rulers holding their own as they could.
uz: O'sha dunyo mahalliy hukmdorlarning imkon qadar o'zinikini ushlab turganlari orasida bo'lingan edi.

en: This was too insecure a state of affairs to last; a system of co-operation and associa- tion grew up in this disorder, the feudal system, which has left its traces upon European life up to the present time.
uz: Bu uzoq davom etadigan darajada noaniq holat edi; bu tartibsizlikda hamkorlik va assotsiatsiya tizimi, feodal tizim o'sib chiqdi, u hozirgi kungacha Yevropa hayotida o'z izlarini qoldirdi.

en: This feudal system was a sort of
uz: Bu feodal tizim bir turdagi edi.

en: crystallization of society about power.
uz: Jamiyatning hokimiyat haqidagi kristalllashuvi.

en: Everywhere the lone man felt inse- cure and was prepared to barter a certain amount of his liberty for help and protection.
uz: Har qayerda yolg'iz odam o'zini davolanmas his qildi va yordam va himoya uchun ma'lum miqdordagi erkinligini almashtirishga tayyor edi.

en: He sought a stronger man as his lord and protector; he gave him military services and paid him dues, and in return he was conﬁrmed in his possession of what was his.
uz: U o'zining xo'jayin va himoyachisi sifatida kuchliroq odamni izladi; u unga harbiy xizmatlar ko'rsatdi va unga to'lovlar to'ladi, buning evaziga esa o'ziniki bo'lgan narsa uning egaligida tasdiqlandi.

en: His lord again found safety in vassalage to a still greater lord.
uz: Uning xo'jayini yana kattaroq xo'jayinga vassajda xavfsizlik topdi.

en: Cities also found it convenient to have feudal protectors, and monasteries and church estates bound themselves by similar ties.
uz: Shaharlar ham feodal himoyachilarga ega bo'lishni qulay deb topdilar, monastirlar va cherkov mulklari esa o'zlarini shunga o'xshash aloqalar bilan bog'lashdi.

en: No doubt in many cases allegiance was claimed before it was offered; the sys- tem grew downward as well as upward.
uz: Shubhasiz, ko'p hollarda sadoqat taklif qilinishidan oldin da'vo qilingan edi; tizim pastga ham, yuqoriga ham o'sdi.

en: So a sort of pyramidal system grew up, varying widely in different localities, permitting at ﬁrst a considerable play of violence and private warfare but making steadily for order and a new reign of law.
uz: Shunday qilib, turli joylarda keng o'zgarib turadigan, dastlab zo'ravonlik va shaxsiy urush o'yinlariga ruxsat beradigan, ammo tartib va yangi qonun hukmronligini barqaror ravishda ta'minlaydigan bir turdagi piramidaviy tizim paydo bo'ldi.

en: The pyramids grew up until some became recognizable as kingdoms.
uz: Piramidalar ba'zilari qirollik sifatida tanilguncha o'sdi.

en: Already by the early sixth century a Frankish kingdom existed under its founder Clovis in what is now France and the Netherlands, and presently Visigothic and Lombard and Gothic kingdoms were in existence.
uz: Oltinchi asrning boshiga kelib, Franka qirolligi o'zining asoschisi Klovis ostida hozirgi Fransiya va Niderlandiyada mavjud edi, hozirda esa Visigot va Lombard va Gotika qirolliklari mavjud edi.

en: The Moslim when they crossed the Pyrenees in 720 found this Frankish kingdom under the practical rule of Charles Martel, the Mayor of the Palace of a degenerate descendant of Clovis, and experienced the decisive defeat of Poitiers (732) at his hands.
uz: Musulmonlar 720-yilda Piriney togʻlarini kesib oʻtganda, bu Frank qirolligini Klovisning degenerativ avlodidan boʻlgan saroy meri Sharl Martelning amaliy hukmronligi ostida topdilar va uning qoʻlida Poitierlarning hal qiluvchi magʻlubiyatini (732) boshdan kechirdilar.

en: This Charles Martel was practically overlord of Europe north of the Alps from the Pyrenees to Hungary.
uz: Bu Charlz Martel amalda Alp tog'lari shimolidagi Yevropani, Piriney tog'laridan Vengriyagacha hukmronlik qilgan.

en: He ruled over a multitude of subordinate lords speaking French- Latin, and High and Low German languages.
uz: U fransuz-latin, yuqori va quyi nemis tillarida gapiradigan ko'plab quyi lordlar ustidan hukmronlik qilardi.

en: His son Pepin extinguished the last descendants of Clo- vis and took the kingly state and title.
uz: Uning o'g'li Pepin Clo-visning oxirgi avlodlarini yo'q qildi va qirollik maqomini va unvonini oldi.

en: His grandson Charlemagne, who be- gan to reign in 768, found himself lord of a realm so large that he could think of reviving the title of Latin Emperor.
uz: 768-yilda hukmronlik qiladigan uning nabirasi Charlz Buyuk, o'zini shunday katta saltanat egasi deb topdiki, u lotin imperatori unvonini qayta tiklashni o'ylay olardi.

en: He conquered North Italy and made himself master of Rome.
uz: U Shimoliy Italiyani zabt etdi va o'zini Rimning xo'jayini qildi.

en: Approaching the story of Europe as we do from the wider horizons of a world history we can see much more distinctly than the mere nationalist historian how cramping and disastrous this tradition of the Latin Roman Empire was.
uz: Yevropa tarixiga jahon tarixining kengroq ufqlaridan yondashganimizdek, biz Lotin Rim imperiyasining bu an'anasi qanchalik siqilish va halokatli ekanligini oddiy millatchi tarixchidan ko'ra ancha aniqroq ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: A narrow intense struggle for this phantom predominance was to consume European energy for more than a thousand years.
uz: Ushbu fantastik ustunlik uchun tor va shiddatli kurash ming yildan ortiq vaqt davomida Yevropa energiyasini iste'mol qilish edi.

en: Through all that period it is possible to trace certain unquenchable antagonisms; they run through the wits of Europe like the obsessions of a demented mind.
uz: O'sha davr davomida ba'zi so'nmas antagonizmlarni kuzatish mumkin; ular Yevropaning aqldan ozgan aqlning ehtiroslari kabi yuradi.

en: One driving force was this ambition of successful rulers, which Charlemagne (Charles the Great) embodied, to become Cæsar.
uz: Bir harakatlantiruvchi kuch muvaffaqiyatli hukmdorlarning Charlz Buyuk (Charlz Buyuk) timsoli bo'lgan, Sezar bo'lish ambitsiyasidir.

en: The realm of Charlemagne consisted of a complex of feudal German states at various stages of bar- barism.
uz: Charlz Buyuk saltanati bar-barizmning turli bosqichlarida feodal nemis davlatlari majmuasidan iborat edi.

en: West of the Rhine, most of these German peoples had learnt to speak various Latinized dialects which fused at last to form French.
uz: Reyn g'arbida, bu nemis xalqlarining aksariyati turli lotinlashgan shevalarda gapirishni o'rgangan edi, ular nihoyat fransuz tilini hosil qilish uchun birlashgan edi.

en: East of the Rhine, the racially similar German peoples did not lose their German speech.
uz: Reyn daryosining sharqida irqiy jihatdan o'xshash nemis xalqlari nemis tilidan voz kechmadilar.

en: On account of this, communication was difﬁcult between these two groups of barbarian conquerors and a split easily brought about.
uz: Shu sababli, bu ikki guruh varvar bosqinchilari o'rtasida aloqa qiyin edi va osonlikcha bo'linish keltirib chiqardi.

en: was made the more easy by the fact that the Frankish usage made it seem natural to divide the empire of Charlemagne among his sons at his death.
uz: Franklarning qo'llanilishi Charlz Buyuk imperiyasini o'g'illari orasida bo'lish uning vafotidan keyin tabiiy ko'rinishi sababli yanada osonlashtirildi.

en: So one aspect of the history of Europe from the days of Charlemagne onwards is a history of ﬁrst this monarch and his family and then that, struggling to a precarious headship of the kings, princes, dukes, bishops and cities of Eu- rope, while a steadily deepening antagonism between the French and Ger- man speaking elements develops in the medley.
uz: Shunday qilib, Charlz Buyuk davridan boshlab Yevropa tarixining bir jihati, avvalo bu monarx va uning oilasining, keyin esa Yevropaning shohlari, shahzodalari, gersoglari, yepiskoplari va shaharlarining beqaror boshchiligiga intilishi, fransuz va nemis tilli elementlar o'rtasida doimiy ravishda chuqurlashib borayotgan qarama-qarshilik rivojlanishidir.

en: There was a formality of election for each emperor; and the climax of his ambition was to struggle to the possession of that worn-out, misplaced capital Rome and to a corona- tion there.
uz: Har bir imperator uchun saylov rasmiyati bor edi; va uning ambitsiyalarining eng yuqori cho'qqisi o'sha eskirgan, yo'qolgan poytaxt Rimga egalik qilish va u yerda toj kiyish uchun kurash edi.

en: The next factor in the European political disorder was the resolve of the Church at Rome to make no temporal prince but the Pope of Rome himself emperor in effect.
uz: Yevropa siyosiy tartibsizliklarining keyingi omili Rim cherkovining Rim Rim Papasining o'zini haqiqiy imperator qilishdan boshqa vaqtinchalik shahzoda qilmaslikka qaror qilishi edi.

en: He was already pontifex maximus; for all practical pur- poses he held the decaying city; if he had no armies he had at least a vast propaganda organization in his priests throughout the whole Latin world; if he had little power over men’s bodies he held the keys of heaven and hell in their imaginations and could exercise much inﬂuence upon their souls.
uz: U allaqachon pontifex maximus edi; barcha amaliy maqsadlar uchun u chirigan shaharni ushlab turardi; agar u armiyasi bo'lmasa, butun Lotin dunyosi bo'ylab ruhoniylarida hech bo'lmaganda ulkan targ'ibot tashkiloti bo'lardi; agar u odamlarning tanasi ustidan kam kuchga ega bo'lsa, u ularning xayolida jannat va do'zax kalitlarini ushlab turardi va ularning ruhlariga katta ta'sir ko'rsata olardi.

en: So throughout the middle ages while one prince manœuvred against another ﬁrst for equality, then for ascendancy, and at last for the supreme prize, the Pope of Rome, sometimes boldly, sometimes craftily, sometimes feebly— for the Popes were a succession of oldish men and the average reign of a Pope was not more than two years—manœuvred for the submission of all the princes to himself as the ultimate overlord of Christendom.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'rta asrlar davomida bir shahzoda birinchi navbatda tenglik, keyin ustunlik va nihoyat oliy mukofot uchun boshqa shahzodaga qarshi ishlaganida, Rim Papasi ba'zan dadil, ba'zan mohirona, ba'zan zaif edi  chunki Papalar qadimgi odamlarning vorisi edi va Papa o'rtacha hukmronligi ikki yildan oshmas edi  barcha shahzodalarni xristian olamining eng yuqori hukmdorsi sifatida o'ziga bo'ysundirish uchun ishladi.

en: But these antagonisms of prince against prince and of Emperor against Pope do not by any means exhaust the factors of the European confusion.
uz: Lekin shahzoda shahzodaga qarshi va imperator Papaga qarshi bo'lgan bu qarama-qarshiliklar Yevropa chalkashligining omillarini hech qanday tarzda tugatmaydi.

en: There was still an Emperor in Constantinople speaking Greek and claiming the allegiance of all Europe.
uz: Konstantinopolda yunon tilida gapiradigan va butun Yevropaning sodiqligini da'vo qiladigan imperator hali ham bor edi.

en: When Charlemagne sought to revive the em- pire, it was merely the Latin end of the empire he revived.
uz: Charlz Buyuk Em-Pire'ni qayta tiklashga uringanida, u faqatgina imperiyaning lotin uchini qayta tikladi.

en: It was natural that a sense of rivalry between Latin Empire and Greek Empire should de- velop very readily.
uz: Lotin imperiyasi va Yunon imperiyasi o'rtasidagi raqobat tuyg'usi juda tez paydo bo'lishi tabiiy edi.

en: And still more readily did the rivalry of Greek-speaking Christianity and the newer Latin-speaking version develop.
uz: Va yunon tilida so'zlashuvchi xristianlik va yangi lotin tilida so'zlashuvchi versiya o'rtasidagi raqobat yanada osonroq rivojlandi.

en: The Pope of Rome claimed to be the successor of St.
uz: Rim Papasi o'zini Avliyo...ning vorisi deb da'vo qildi.

en: Peter, the chief of the apostles of Christ, and the head of the Christian community everywhere.
uz: Butrus, Masihning havoriylarining boshlig'i va hamma joydagi xristian jamoatining boshi.

en: Neither the emperor nor the patriarch in Constantinople were disposed to acknowledge this claim.
uz: Konstantinopoldagi na imperator, na patriarx bu da'voni tan olishga tayyor emas edi.

en: A dispute about a ﬁne point in the doctrine of the Holy Trinity consummated a long series of dissensions in a ﬁnal rupture in 1054.
uz: Muqaddas Uch Birlik ta'limotidagi nozik nuqta haqidagi bahs 1054-yilda yakuniy uzilish bilan uzoq davom etgan kelishmovchiliklarni yakunladi.

en: Latin Church and the Greek Church became and remained thereafter dis- tinct and frankly antagonistic.
uz: Lotin cherkovi va Yunon cherkovi shundan so'ng qat'iy va ochiqchasiga dushmanona bo'lib qoldi va qoldi.

en: This antagonism must be added to the others in our estimate of the conﬂicts that wasted Latin Christendom in the middle ages.
uz: Bu qarama-qarshilikni o'rta asrlarda Lotin xristianligini behudaga sarflagan mojarolar haqidagi bahonamizda boshqalarga ham qo'shish kerak.

en: STATUE OF CHARLEMAGNE IN FRONT OF NOTRE DAME, PARIS The ﬁgure is entirely imaginary and romantic.
uz: CHARLEMAGNE haykali NATRE DAME, PARIS oldida. Shakl butunlay xayoliy va romantik.

en: There is no contemporary portrait of Charlemagne  Photo: Rischgitz Upon this divided world of Christendom rained the blows of three sets of antagonists.
uz: Charlz Buyukning zamonaviy portreti yo'q. Foto: Rishgitz Xristianlikning bu bo'lingan dunyosiga uchta dushman to'plamining zarbalari yog'di.

en: About the Baltic and North Seas remained a series of Nordic tribes who were only very slowly and reluctantly Christianized; these were the Northmen.
uz: Boltiq dengizi va Shimoliy dengiz atrofida faqat juda sekin va istaksizlik bilan xristianlashtirilgan bir qator Skandinaviya qabilalari qoldi; bular Shimoliy xalq edi.

en: They had taken to the sea and piracy, and were raiding all the Christian coasts down to Spain.
uz: Ular dengizga va qaroqchilikka qo'l urishdi va Ispaniyagacha bo'lgan barcha xristian sohillarini bosib o'tishardi.

en: They had pushed up the Russian rivers to the desolate central lands and brought their shipping over into the south- ﬂowing rivers.
uz: Ular rus daryolarini vayron bo'lgan markaziy yerlarga ko'tarib, o'z kemasozliklarini janubiy oqimdagi daryolarga olib kirishdi.

en: They had come out upon the Caspian and Black Seas as pi- rates also.
uz: Ular Kaspiy va Qora dengizlariga pi- stavkalari sifatida ham chiqishgan edi.

en: They set up principalities in Russia; they were the ﬁrst people to be called Russians.
uz: Ular Rossiyada knyazliklar o'rnatdilar; ular ruslar deb atalgan birinchi odamlar edi.

en: These Northmen Russians came near to taking Constan- tinople.
uz: Bu shimoliy ruslar Konstan-Tinopolni egallashga yaqinlashdilar.

en: England in the early ninth century was a Christianized Low Ger- man country under a king, Egbert, a protégé and pupil of Charlemagne.
uz: Toʻqqizinchi asr boshlarida Angliya Xristianlashtirilgan quyi Germaniya davlati boʻlib, Buyuk Charlzning himoyachisi va shogirdlari boʻlgan Egbert podshoh ostida edi.

en: The Northmen wrested half the kingdom from his successor Alfred the Great (886), and ﬁnally under Canute (1016) made themselves masters of the whole land.
uz: Shimoliylar o'z vorisi Alfred Buyukdan qirollikning yarmini olib qo'yishdi (886), va nihoyat Kanut ostida (1016) o'zlarini butun yerning xo'jayinlari qilib olishdi.

en: Under Rolph the Ganger (912) another band of Northmen con- quered the north of France, which became Normandy.
uz: Rolf Ganger ostida (912) Shimoliy odamlarning yana bir guruhi Fransiyaning shimoliy qismini bosib oldi, u Normandiyaga aylandi.

en: Canute ruled not only over England but over Norway and Denmark, but his brief empire fell to pieces at his death through that political weakness of the barbaric peoples—division among a ruler’s sons.
uz: Kanut nafaqat Angliya ustidan hukmronlik qildi, balki Norvegiya va Daniyani ham, balki uning qisqa imperiyasi uning o'limida vahshiy xalqlarning siyosiy zaifligi  hukmdor o'g'illarining bo'linishi tufayli parchalanib ketdi.

en: It is interesting to speculate what might have happened if this temporary union of the North- men had endured.
uz: Agar Shimoliy odamlarning bu vaqtinchalik ittifoqi bardosh berganida nima bo'lishi mumkin edi, deb taxmin qilish qiziqarli.

en: They were a race of astonishing boldness and energy.
uz: Ular hayratlanarli jasorat va energiya poygasi edi.

en: They sailed in their galleys even to Iceland and Greenland.
uz: Ular o'z galereyalarida hatto Islandiya va Grenlandiyagacha suzib borishdi.

en: They were the ﬁrst Europeans to land on American soil.
uz: Ular Amerika tuprog'iga qo'ngan birinchi yevropaliklar edi.

en: Later on Norman adventurers were to recover Sicily from the Saracens and sack Rome.
uz: Keyinchalik normand sarguzashtchilari Sitsiliyani saracenlardan qaytarib olishlari va Rimni talon-toroj qilishlari kerak edi.

en: It is a fascinating thing to imagine what a great northern sea-faring power might have grown out of Canute’s kingdom, reaching from America to Russia.
uz: Kanut qirolligidan qanday buyuk shimoliy dengizchi davlat kelib chiqib, Amerikadan Rossiyagacha yetib borganini tasavvur qilish juda qiziqarli narsa.

en: To the east of the Germans and Latinized Europeans was a medley of Slav tribes and Turkish peoples.
uz: Germaniyaliklar va lotinlashgan yevropaliklarning sharqida slavyan qabilalari va turk xalqlarining bir to'plami joylashgan edi.

en: Prominent among these were the Magyars or Hungarians who were coming westward throughout the eighth and ninth centuries.
uz: Bular orasida mashhur bo'lganlar VIII va IX asrlarda g'arbga kelayotgan magariyalar yoki vengerlar edi.

en: Charlemagne held them for a time, but after his death they estab- lished themselves in what is now Hungary; and after the fashion of their kindred predecessors, the Huns, raided every summer into the settled parts of Europe.
uz: Charlz Buyuk ularni bir muddat ushlab turdi, lekin o'limidan so'ng ular hozirgi Vengriyada o'rnashdilar; va o'zlarining qarindosh ajdodlari, Hunlar uslubida, har yozda Yevropaning o'troq qismlariga bostirib kirishdi.

en: In 938 they went through Germany into France, crossed the Alps into North Italy, and so came home, burning, robbing and destroying.
uz: 938-yilda ular Germaniya orqali Fransiyaga o'tdilar, Alp tog'larini kesib o'tib, Shimoliy Italiyaga kirdilar va shunday qilib uyga qaytib, yoqib yuborishdi, o'g'irlashdi va yo'q qilishdi.

en: Finally pounding away from the south at the vestiges of the Roman Em- pire were the Saracens.
uz: Nihoyat, janubdan Rim Em- pire qoldiqlariga Saracenlar hujum qildi.

en: They had made themselves largely masters of the sea; their only formidable adversaries upon the water were the Northmen, the Russian Northmen out of the Black Sea and the Northmen of the west.
uz: Ular o'zlarini asosan dengiz xo'jayinlari qilib olgan edilar; ularning suvda yagona dahshatli raqiblari Shimoliylar, Qora dengizdan chiqqan rus Shimoliylari va g'arbdan kelgan Shimoliylar edi.

en: Hemmed in by these more vigorous and aggressive peoples, amidst forces they did not understand and dangers they could not estimate, Charle- magne and after him a series of other ambitious spirits took up the futile drama of restoring the Western Empire under the name of the Holy Roman Empire.
uz: Ushbu kuchliroq va tajovuzkor xalqlar tomonidan qamrab olingan, ular tushunmaydigan kuchlar va baholay olmaydigan xavflar orasida Charle-magne va undan keyin boshqa bir qator ambitsiyali ruhlar Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi nomi ostida G'arb imperiyasini tiklashning behuda dramasiga qo'l urishdi.

en: From the time of Charlemagne onward this idea obsessed the polit- ical life of Western Europe, while in the East the Greek half of the Roman power decayed and dwindled until at last nothing remained of it at all but the corrupt trading city of Constantinople and a few miles of territory about it.
uz: Charlz Buyuk davridan boshlab bu g'oya G'arbiy Yevropaning siyosiy hayotiga ta'sir qildi, Sharqda esa Rim kuchining yunon yarmi parchalanib, kamayib ketdi, nihoyat undan faqatgina korruptsiyalashgan savdo shahri Konstantinopol va uning atrofidagi bir necha millik hududdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi.

en: Politically the continent of Europe remained traditional and uncreative from the time of Charlemagne onward for a thousand years.
uz: Siyosiy jihatdan Yevropa qit'asi Charlz Buyuk davridan boshlab ming yil davomida an'anaviy va ijodsiz bo'lib qoldi.

en: The name of Charlemagne looms large in European history but his per- sonality is but indistinctly seen.
uz: Charlz Buyukning ismi Yevropa tarixida katta ahamiyatga ega, ammo uning shaxsiyati faqat noaniq ko'rinadi.

en: He could not read nor write, but he had a considerable respect for learning; he liked to be read aloud to at meals and he had a weakness for theological discussion.
uz: U na o'qiy olardi, na yoza olardi, lekin u o'qishga nisbatan ancha hurmatga ega edi; uni ovqatda baland ovozda o'qishni yoqtirardi va u teologik muhokama uchun zaif edi.

en: At his winter quarters at Aix- la- Chapelle or Mayence he gathered about him a number of learned men and picked up much from their conversation.
uz: Ayks-la-Chapelle yoki Mayensdagi qishki turar joyida u atrofida bir qator olimlarni to'pladi va ularning suhbatidan ko'p narsa oldi.

en: In the summer he made war, against the Spanish Saracens, against the Slavs and Magyars, against the Saxons, and other still heathen German tribes.
uz: Yozda u ispan saratsinlariga, slavyanlar va magariyalarga, saksonlarga va boshqa butparast nemis qabilalariga qarshi urush qildi.

en: It is doubtful whether the idea of becoming Cæsar in succession to Romulus Augustulus occurred to him before his acquisition of North Italy, or whether it was suggested to him by Pope Leo III, who was anxious to make the Latin Church indepen- dent of Constantinople.
uz: Romulus Augustulga vorislik qilib Cæsar bo'lish g'oyasi unga Shimoliy Italiyani qo'lga kiritishdan oldin kelganmi yoki Rim Papasi Leo III tomonidan unga bu g'oya taklif qilinganmi, u Lotin cherkovini Konstantinopol mustaqilligiga erishishga intilganmi, shubhasiz.

en: There were the most extraordinary manœuvres at Rome between the Pope and the prospective emperor in order to make it appear or not appear as if the Pope gave him the imperial crown.
uz: Rimda Rim Papasi va bo'lajak imperator o'rtasida Rim Papasi unga imperator tojini berganidek ko'rinishi yoki ko'rinmasligi uchun eng g'ayrioddiy manevrlar bo'lib o'tdi.

en: The Pope succeeded in crown- ing his visitor and conqueror by surprise in St.
uz: Rim Papasi o'z mehmonini va zabtchisini St.da ajablantirib tojlashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Peter’s on Christmas Day 800 A.D.
uz: Pyotr Rojdestvo kuni milodiy 800-yilda.

en: He produced a crown, put it on the head of Charlemagne and hailed him Cæsar and Augustus.
uz: U toj ishlab chiqardi, uni Charlz Buyukning boshiga qo'ydi va unga Sezar va Avgust deb tabrikladi.

en: There was great applause among the people.
uz: Odamlar orasida katta olqishlar bo'ldi.

en: Charlemagne was by no means pleased at the way in which the thing was done, it rankled in his mind as a defeat; and he left the most careful instruc- tions to his son that he was not to let the Pope crown him emperor; he was to seize the crown into his own hands and put it on his own head himself.
uz: Charlz Buyuk bu ishning qanday amalga oshirilishidan hech qanday mamnun emas edi, bu uning xayolida mag'lubiyatdek raqsga tushdi; va u o'g'liga eng ehtiyotkorona ko'rsatmalarni qoldirdi: Papa uni imperator qilib tayinlamasligi kerak edi; u tojni o'z qo'liga olib, o'z boshiga qo'yishi kerak edi.

en: So at the very outset of this imperial revival we see beginning the age-long dispute of Pope and Emperor for priority.
uz: Shunday qilib, ushbu imperatorlik uyg'onishining boshidayoq, biz Papa va Imperatorning ustuvorlik uchun asrlar davomida davom etgan bahsining boshlanishini ko'ramiz.

en: But Louis the Pious, the son of Charlemagne, disregarded his father’s instructions and was entirely submis- sive to the Pope.
uz: Ammo Buyuk Karlovning o'g'li Luidfik Avliyo otasining ko'rsatmalariga e'tibor bermadi va Rim Papasiga butunlay bo'ysundirdi.

en: The empire of Charlemagne fell apart at the death of Louis the Pious and the split between the French-speaking Franks and the German-speaking Franks widened.
uz: Buyuk Karl imperiyasi Lui Piozning o'limida parchalanib ketdi va fransuz tilida so'zlashuvchi franklar va nemis tilida so'zlashuvchi franklar o'rtasida bo'linish kengaydi.

en: The next emperor to arise was Otto, the son of a certain Henry the Fowler, a Saxon, who had been elected King of Germany by an assembly of German princes and prelates in 919.
uz: Keyingi paydo bo'lgan imperator Otto bo'ldi, u Saksonlardan bo'lgan, 919-yilda nemis shahzodalari va prelatlari yig'ilishi tomonidan Germaniya qiroli etib saylangan ma'lum bir Genrix Fowlerning o'g'li edi.

en: Otto descended upon Rome and was crowned emperor there in 962.
uz: Otto Rimga tushdi va 962-yilda u yerda imperator etib tojlandi.

en: This Saxon line came to an end early in the eleventh century and gave place to other German rulers.
uz: Bu Saksonlar liniyasi o'n birinchi asrning boshlarida yakunlandi va boshqa nemis hukmdorlariga o'rnini berdi.

en: The feudal princes and nobles to the west who spoke various French di- alects did not fall under the sway of these German emperors after the Carlovingian line, the line that is descended from Charlemagne, had come
uz: G'arbdagi turli xil fransuz tilidagi amaldorlar va zodagonlar Karlovingiy liniyasi, Buyuk Charlidan kelib chiqqan liniyadan keyin bu nemis imperatorlarining hukmronligiga tushmadilar.

en: to an end, and no part of Britain ever came into the Holy Roman Empire.
uz: oxirigacha, va Britaniyaning hech bir qismi Muqaddas Rim imperiyasiga kirmadi.

en: The Duke of Normandy, the King of France and a number of lesser feudal rulers remained outside.
uz: Normandiya gersogi, Fransiya qiroli va bir qator kichik feodal hukmdorlar tashqarida qoldi.

en: In 987 the Kingdom of France passed out of the possession of the Carlovingian line into the hands of Hugh Capet, whose descendants were still reigning in the eighteenth century.
uz: 987-yilda Fransiya Qirolligi Karlovingiya liniyasining egaligidan Xyu Kapetning qo'liga o'tdi, uning avlodlari XVIII asrda ham hukmronlik qilayotgan edi.

en: At the time of Hugh Capet the King of France ruled only a comparatively small territory round Paris.
uz: Hugh Capet davrida Fransiya qiroli Parij atrofidagi nisbatan kichik hududni boshqargan.

en: In 1066 England was attacked almost simultaneously by an invasion of the Norwegian Northmen under King Harold Hardrada and by the Latinized Northmen under the Duke of Normandy.
uz: 1066-yilda Angliya deyarli bir vaqtning o'zida Norvegiyalik Shimoliy odamlarning qirol Harold Hardrada boshchiligidagi va Normandiyalik gersog boshchiligidagi Lotinlashtirilgan Shimoliy odamlarning hujumiga uchradi.

en: Harold King of England defeated the former at the battle of Stamford Bridge, and was defeated by the latter at Hastings.
uz: Angliyalik Harold King Stamford Bridge jangida birinchisini mag'lub etdi va Hastings jangida ikkinchisidan mag'lub bo'ldi.

en: England was conquered by the Normans, and so cut off from Scandinavian, Teutonic and Russian affairs, and brought into the most inti- mate relations and conﬂicts with the French.
uz: Angliya normandlar tomonidan zabt etildi va shu tariqa Skandinaviya, Tevton va Rus ishlaridan uzildi hamda fransuzlar bilan eng yaqin munosabatlarga va mojarolarga olib keldi.

en: For the next four centuries the English were entangled in the conﬂicts of the French feudal princes and wasted upon the ﬁelds of France.
uz: Keyingi to'rt asr davomida inglizlar fransuz feodal shahzodalarining mojarolariga aralashib, Fransiya dalalarida isrof bo'lishdi.

en: XLVI THE CRUSADES AND THE AGE OF PAPAL DOMINION It is interesting to note that Charlemagne corresponded with the Caliph Haroun-al-Raschid, the Haroun-al-Raschid of the Arabian Nights.
uz: XLVI XUSUSLAR VA PAPA hukmronligining asri. Shuni ta'kidlash qiziqki, Buyuk Charlz Arab tunlari xalifasi Horun-al-Rashid, Horun-al-Rashid bilan yozishgan.

en: It is recorded that Haroun-al-Raschid sent ambassadors from Bagdad—which had now replaced Damascus as the Moslem capital—with a splendid tent, a water clock, an elephant and the keys of the Holy Sepulchre.
uz: Qayd etilishicha, Horun-al-Rashid Bag'doddan elchilar yuborgan edi  bu shahar endi Damashqni musulmon poytaxti sifatida almashtirgan edi  ajoyib chodir, suv soati, fil va Muqaddas Qabr kalitlari bilan.

en: This latter present was admirably calculated to set the Byzantine Empire and this new Holy Roman Empire by the ears as to which was the proper protector of the Christians in Jerusalem.
uz: Bu so'nggi sovg'a Vizantiya imperiyasini va bu yangi Muqaddas Rim imperiyasini Quddusdagi xristianlarning haqiqiy himoyachisi bo'lganligi haqida quloqlari bilan o'rnatish uchun hayratlanarli tarzda hisoblangan edi.

en: These presents remind us that while Europe in the ninth century was still a weltering disorder of war and pillage, there ﬂourished a great Arab Em- pire in Egypt and Mesopotamia, far more civilized than anything Europe could show.
uz: Bu sovg'alar bizga eslatib turadi, to'qqizinchi asrda Yevropa urush va talon-torojning hayajonli tartibsizliklari bo'lgan bir paytda, Misr va Mesopotamiyada Buyuk Arab Em- pire gullab-yashnadi, u Yevropa ko'rsata oladigan hamma narsadan ancha madaniyatli edi.

en: Here literature and science still lived; the arts ﬂourished, and the mind of man could move without fear or superstition.
uz: Bu yerda adabiyot va fan hali ham yashardi; san'at gullab-yashnadi va inson ongi qo'rquv yoki xurofotsiz harakatlana olardi.

en: And even in Spain and North Africa where the Saracenic dominions were falling into political confusion there was a vigorous intellectual life.
uz: Hatto Ispaniya va Shimoliy Afrikada ham, saracen hukmronliklari siyosiy chalkashlikka tushib ketayotgan joylarda ham, kuchli intellektual hayot hukm surardi.

en: Aristotle was read and discussed by these Jews and Arabs during these centuries of European darkness.
uz: Aristotel Yevropa zulmatining bu asrlarida yahudiylar va arablar tomonidan o'qilgan va muhokama qilingan.

en: They guarded the neglected seeds of science and philosophy.
uz: Ular fan va falsafaning beparvo urug'larini qo'riqlashardi.

en: North-east of the Caliph’s dominions was a number of Turkish tribes.
uz: Xalifaning shimoli-sharqiy hukmronliklarida bir qator turk qabilalari mavjud edi.

en: They had been converted to Islam, and they held the faith much more sim- ply and ﬁercely than the actively intellectual Arabs and Persians to the south.
uz: Ular Islomga o'tishgan edi va ular dinni janubdagi faol intellektual arablar va forslardan ko'ra ancha sodda va shiddatli ushlab turishardi.

en: In the tenth century the Turks were growing strong and vigorous while the Arab power was divided and decaying.
uz: O'ninchi asrda turklar kuchayib, kuchliroq bo'lib borayotgan edi, arab hokimiyati esa bo'linib, chirib borayotgan edi.

en: The relations of the Turks
uz: Turklarning munosabatlari

en: to the Empire of the Caliphate became very similar to the relations of the Medes to the last Babylonian Empire fourteen centuries before.
uz: Xalifalik imperiyasi Medlarning o'n to'rt asr oldingi oxirgi Bobil imperiyasi bilan munosabatlariga juda o'xshash bo'ldi.

en: In the eleventh century a group of Turkish tribes, the Seljuk Turks, came down into Mesopotamia and made the Caliph their nominal ruler but really their captive and tool.
uz: O'n birinchi asrda bir guruh turk qabilalari, Saljuqiy turklar Mesopotamiyaga kelib, xalifani o'zlarining nominal hukmdorlari, lekin aslida asirlari va asboblari qilib qo'yishdi.

en: They conquered Armenia.
uz: Ular Armanistonni zabt etishdi.

en: Then they struck at the rem- nants of the Byzantine power in Asia Minor.
uz: Keyin ular Kichik Osiyodagi Vizantiya kuchining qoldiqlariga zarba berishdi.

en: In 1071 the Byzantine army was utterly smashed at the battle of Melasgird, and the Turks swept forward until not a trace of Byzantine rule remained in Asia.
uz: 1071-yilda Vizantiya armiyasi Melasgird jangida butunlay vayron bo'ldi va turklar Osiyoda Vizantiya hukmronligining hech qanday izi qolmaguncha oldinga siljishdi.

en: They took the fortress of Nicæa over against Constantinople, and prepared to attempt that city.
uz: Ular Nikia qalasini Konstantinopolga qarshi olib, osha shaharga urinishga tayyorgarlik korishdi.

en: The Byzantine emperor, Michael VII, was overcome with terror.
uz: Vizantiya imperatori Mixail VII dahshatga tushdi.

en: He was already heavily engaged in warfare with a band of Norman adventurers who had seized Durazzo, and with a ﬁerce Turkish people, the Petschenegs, who were raiding over the Danube.
uz: U allaqachon Durazzoni egallagan normand sarguzashtchilari guruhi va Dunay daryosini bosib o'tayotgan shafqatsiz turk xalqi, Petcheneglar bilan urushda qattiq ishtirok etgan edi.

en: In his extremity he sought help where he could, and it is notable that he did not appeal to the western emperor but to the Pope of Rome as the head of Latin Christendom.
uz: U o'z nihoyatida iloji boricha yordam izladi va shuni ta'kidlash joizki, u g'arb imperatoriga emas, balki Rim Papasiga lotin xristianligining rahbari sifatida murojaat qildi.

en: He wrote to Pope Gre- gory VII, and his successor Alexius Comnenus wrote still more urgently to Urban II.
uz: U Rim Papasi Grigoriy VII ga xat yozdi, uning vorisi Aleksiy Komnen esa Urban II ga yanada shoshilinchroq xat yozdi.

en: CRUSADER TOMBS IN EXETER CATHEDRAL  Photo: Mansell This was not a quarter of a century from the rupture of the Latin and Greek churches.
uz: EXETER KATEDRALIDA Xoch Qabrlari Foto: Mansell Bu lotin va yunon cherkovlarining yirtilishidan chorak asr o'tmay qoldi.

en: That controversy was still vividly alive in men’s minds, and this disaster to Byzantium must have presented itself to the Pope as a supreme opportunity for reasserting the supremacy of the Latin Church over the dissentient Greeks.
uz: O'sha bahs odamlar ongida hali ham jonli edi va Vizantiyaga bo'lgan bu falokat Rim Papasiga Lotin cherkovining norozi yunonlar ustidan ustunligini qayta tasdiqlash uchun oliy imkoniyat sifatida taqdim etilgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Moreover this occasion gave the Pope a chance to deal with two other matters that troubled western Christendom very greatly.
uz: Qolaversa, bu voqea Rim Papasiga g'arbiy xristianlikni juda tashvishga solayotgan yana ikkita masala bilan shug'ullanish imkoniyatini berdi.

en: One was the custom of “private war” which disordered social life, and the other was the superabundant ﬁghting energy of the Low Germans and
uz: Biri ijtimoiy hayotni tartibsizlantiruvchi xususiy urush odati edi, ikkinchisi esa quyi nemislarning juda ko'p jangovar energiyasi edi va...

en: Christianized Northmen and particularly of the Franks and Normans.
uz: Xristianlashtirilgan shimoliy xalqlar, ayniqsa Franklar va Normanlarning.

en: A reli- gious war, the Crusade, the War of the Cross, was preached against the Turkish captors of Jerusalem, and a truce to all warfare amongst Christians (1095).
uz: Quddusning turk bosqinchilariga qarshi diniy urush, Xoch yurishi, Xoch urushi va xristianlar o'rtasidagi barcha urushlarga sulh 1095-yilda va'z qilindi.

en: The declared object of this war was the recovery of the Holy Sepul- chre from the unbelievers.
uz: Bu urushning e'lon qilingan maqsadi Muqaddas Qabr - Xronni kofirlardan tiklash edi.

en: A man called Peter the Hermit carried on a popu- lar propaganda throughout France and Germany on broadly democratic lines.
uz: Pyotr Ermet deb nomlangan odam Fransiya va Germaniya bo'ylab keng demokratik yo'nalishlarda ommaviy tashviqot olib bordi.

en: He went clad in a coarse garment, barefooted on an ass, he carried a huge cross and harangued the crowd in street or market-place or church.
uz: U qo'pol kiyimga kiyindi, eshakda yalang'och oyoq bilan yurdi, ulkan xochni ko'tarib, ko'cha, bozor yoki cherkovda olomonni ta'qib qildi.

en: He denounced the cruelties practised upon the Christian pilgrims by the Turks, and the shame of the Holy Sepulchre being in any but Christian hands.
uz: U turklar tomonidan xristian ziyoratchilariga nisbatan qo'llanilgan shafqatsizliklar va Muqaddas Qabrning xristianlardan boshqa qo'llarda bo'lishidan sharmanda edi.

en: The fruits of centuries of Christian teaching became apparent in the response.
uz: Xristian ta'limotining asrlar davomidagi mevalari javobda namoyon bo'ldi.

en: A great wave of enthusiasm swept the western world, and popular Christen- dom discovered itself.
uz: G'arb dunyosini katta ishtiyoq to'lqini qamrab oldi va mashhur Christen-dom o'zini topdi.

en: VIEW OF CAIRO  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock Such a widespread uprising of the common people in relation to a single idea as now occurred was a new thing in the history of our race.
uz: QAYROGA KO'RINISH Foto: Lehnert & Landrock Oddiy xalqning yagona g'oyaga nisbatan hozir sodir bo'lgan bunday keng ko'lamli qo'zg'oloni bizning irq tarixida yangi narsa edi.

en: There is nothing to parallel it in the previous history of the Roman Empire or of In- dia or China.
uz: Rim imperiyasining oldingi tarixida, In-dia yoki Xitoy tarixida unga o'xshash hech narsa yo'q.

en: On a smaller scale, however, there had been similar move- ments among the Jewish people after their liberation from the Babylonian captivity, and later on Islam was to display a parallel susceptibility to col- lective feeling.
uz: Kichikroq miqyosda esa, yahudiy xalqi Bobil asirligidan ozod bo'lgandan so'ng o'xshash harakatlar bo'lgan va keyinchalik Islom jamoaviy tuyg'uga parallel moyillikni namoyon etishi kerak edi.

en: Such movements were certainly connected with the new spirit that had come into life with the development of the missionary- teach-
uz: Bunday harakatlar, albatta, missionerlik ta'limoti rivojlanishi bilan hayotga kelgan yangi ruh bilan bog'liq edi.

en: The Hebrew prophets, Jesus and his disciples, Mani, Muham- mad, were all exhorters of men’s individual souls.
uz: Ibroniy payg'ambarlar, Iso va uning shogirdlari, Mani, Muhammad - aqldan ozgan, ularning barchasi insonlarning individual ruhlarini ogohlantiruvchi edilar.

en: They brought the person- al conscience face to face with God.
uz: Ular insonni - vijdonni Xudo bilan yuzma-yuz olib kelishdi.

en: Before that time religion had been much more a business of fetish, of pseudoscience, than of conscience.
uz: O'sha vaqtgacha din vijdon ishidan ko'ra ko'proq fetish, soxta fan biznesi edi.

en: The old kind of religion turned upon temple, initiated priest and mystical sacri- ﬁce, and ruled the common man like a slave by fear.
uz: Qadimgi din ibodatxonaga o'girildi, ruhoniy va mistik qurbonlikni boshladi va oddiy odamni qo'rquvdan qul kabi boshqardi.

en: The new kind of reli- gion made a man of him.
uz: Yangi turdagi dindorlik uni odamga aylantirdi.

en: The preaching of the First Crusade was the ﬁrst stirring of the common people in European history.
uz: Birinchi Xoch yurishining voizligi Yevropa tarixidagi oddiy xalqning birinchi qo'zg'alishi edi.

en: It may be too much to call it the birth of mod- ern democracy, but certainly at that time modern democracy stirred.
uz: Buni zamonaviy demokratiyaning tug'ilishi deb atash juda ko'p bo'lishi mumkin, lekin o'sha paytda zamonaviy demokratiya qo'zg'algan edi.

en: Before very long we shall ﬁnd it stirring again, and raising the most disturbing so- cial and religious questions.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay uni yana qo'zg'alganini va eng bezovta qiluvchi ijtimoiy va diniy savollarni ko'tarayotganini ko'ramiz.

en: Certainly this ﬁrst stirring of democracy ended very pitifully and lamen- tably.
uz: Albatta, demokratiyaning bu birinchi qo'zg'alishi juda achinarli va achinarli yakunlandi.

en: Considerable bodies of common people, crowds rather than armies, set out eastward from France and the Rhineland and Central Europe without waiting for leaders or proper equipment to rescue the Holy Sepulchre.
uz: Fransiya va Reynlandiya hamda Markaziy Yevropadan sharqqa qarab, Muqaddas Qabrni qutqarish uchun yetakchilar yoki tegishli jihozlarni kutmasdan, oddiy odamlarning sezilarli guruhlari, armiyalar emas, olomon jo'nab ketdi.

en: This was the “people’s crusade.” Two great mobs blundered into Hungary, mis- took the recently converted Magyars for pagans, committed atrocities and were massacred.
uz: Bu odamlarning xoch yurishi edi. Ikki buyuk olomon Vengriyaga adashib kirdi, yaqinda diniga kirgan mag'arlarni butparast deb qabul qildi, vahshiylar qildi va qirib tashlandi.

en: A third multitude with a similarly confused mind, after a great pogrom of the Jews in the Rhineland, marched eastward, and was also destroyed in Hungary.
uz: Xuddi shunday chalkash fikrga ega bo'lgan uchinchi olomon, Reynistondagi yahudiylarning katta pogromidan so'ng, sharqqa yurib ketdi va Vengriyada ham yo'q qilindi.

en: Two other huge crowds, under the leadership of Peter the Hermit himself, reached Constantinople, crossed the Bosphorus, and were massacred rather than defeated by the Seljuk Turks.
uz: Ikkita boshqa ulkan olomon, Pyotr Ermitning o'zi boshchiligida, Konstantinopolga yetib keldi, Bosforni kesib o'tdi va Saljuqiy turklari tomonidan mag'lub etilishdan ko'ra qirg'in qilindi.

en: So began and ended this ﬁrst movement of the European people, as people.
uz: Shunday qilib, Yevropa xalqining bu birinchi harakati boshlandi va yakunlandi, odamlar sifatida.

en: Next year (1097) the real ﬁghting forces crossed the Bosphorus.
uz: Keyingi yili (1097) haqiqiy jangovar kuchlar Bosforni kesib o'tdi.

en: Essen- tially they were Norman in leadership and spirit.
uz: Aslida ular yetakchilik va ruhda normand edilar.

en: They stormed Nicæa, marched by much the same route as Alexander had followed fourteen cen- turies before, to Antioch.
uz: Ular Nikayiyaga bostirib kirishdi, Aleksandr avval o'n to'rt asrdan o'tgan yo'nalish bo'ylab Antioxyaga borgan edi.

en: The siege of Antioch kept them a year, and in June 1099 they invested Jerusalem.
uz: Antioxyaning qamal qilinishi ularni bir yilga ushlab turdi va 1099-yil iyun oyida ular Quddusga sarmoya kiritdilar.

en: It was stormed after a month’s siege.
uz: Bir oylik qamaldan so'ng hujumga uchradi.

en: The slaughter was terrible.
uz: Qirg'in dahshatli edi.

en: Men riding on horseback were splashed by the blood in the streets.
uz: Otda uchayotgan erkaklar ko'chalarda qon bilan sachradi.

en: At nightfall on July 15th the Crusaders had fought their way into the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and overcome all opposition there: blood-stained, weary and “sobbing from excess of joy” they knelt down in prayer.
uz: 15-iyul kuni kechga yaqin Xochchilar Muqaddas Qabr cherkoviga kirib, u yerdagi barcha qarshiliklarni yengib o'tishdi: qon dog'lari, charchoq va ko'p quvonchdan yig'lab ibodat qilishdi.

en: MARK, VENICE  Originally on the arch of Trajan at Constantinople, the Doge Dandalo V took them after the Fourth Crusade, to Venice, whence Napoleon I removed them to Paris, but in 1815 they were returned to Venice.
uz: MARK, VENICE Asli Konstantinopoldagi Trajan archasida, Doge Dandalo V ularni To'rtinchi Xoch yurishidan so'ng Venetsiyaga olib bordi, u yerdan Napoleon I ularni Parijga olib ketdi, lekin 1815 yilda ular Venetsiyaga qaytarildi.

en: During the Great War of 1914-18 they were hidden away for fear of air raids.
uz: 1914-18 yillardagi Buyuk Urush davrida ular havo hujumlaridan qo'rqib yashiringan edilar.

en: McLeish Immediately the hostility of Latin and Greek broke out again.
uz: McLeish Darhol lotin va yunon tillarining dushmanligi yana avj oldi.

en: The Cru- saders were the servants of the Latin Church, and the Greek patriarch of Jerusalem found himself in a far worse case under the triumphant Latins than under the Turks.
uz: Kru-saderlar Lotin cherkovi xizmatkorlari edi va Quddusning yunon patriarxi o'zini turklardan ko'ra g'alaba qozongan lotinlar ostida ancha yomon ahvolda topdi.

en: The Crusaders discovered themselves between Byzantine and Turk and ﬁghting both.
uz: Salibchilar o'zlarini Vizantiya va Turk o'rtasida topdilar va ikkalasi bilan ham jang qilishdi.

en: Much of Asia Minor was recovered by the Byzantine Empire, and the Latin princes were left, a buffer between Turk and Greek, with Jerusalem and a few small principalities, of which Edessa was one of the chief, in Syria.
uz: Kichik Osiyoning ko'p qismi Vizantiya imperiyasi tomonidan qaytarib olindi va lotin shahzodalari Turklar va yunonlar o'rtasidagi bufer bo'lib qoldi, Quddus va bir nechta kichik knyazliklar bilan birga edi, ulardan biri Edessa, Suriyadagi boshliqlardan biri edi.

en: Their grip even on these possessions was precarious, and in 1144 Edessa fell to the Moslim, leading to an inef- fective Second Crusade, which failed to recover Edessa but saved Antioch from a similar fate.
uz: Ularning hatto bu mulklar ustidan ham qo'lga kiritishi beqaror edi va 1144-yilda Edessa musulmonlar qo'liga tushdi, natijada samarali bo'lmagan Ikkinchi Xoch yurishiga olib keldi, u Edessani qaytarib ololmadi, lekin Antioxani shunga o'xshash taqdirdan saqlab qoldi.

en: In 1169 the forces of Islam were rallied under a Kurdish adventurer named Saladin who had made himself master of Egypt.
uz: 1169-yilda Islom kuchlari o'zini Misrga xo'jayin qilgan Saladin ismli kurd sarguzashtchisiga qo'l ostida birlashdi.

en: He preached a Holy War against the Christians, recaptured Jerusalem in 1187, and so provoked the Third Crusade.
uz: U xristianlarga qarshi Muqaddas Urush haqida va'z qildi, 1187-yilda Quddusni qaytarib oldi va shu tariqa Uchinchi Xoch yurishini qo'zg'atdi.

en: This failed to recover Jerusalem.
uz: Bu Quddusni tiklay olmadi.

en: In the Fourth Crusade (1202-4) the Latin Church turned frankly upon the Greek Empire, and there was not even a pretence of ﬁghting the Turks.
uz: To'rtinchi Xoch yurishida (1202-4) lotin cherkovi yunon imperiyasiga ochiqchasiga yuzlandi va hatto turklarga qarshi kurashish uchun hech qanday da'vo yo'q edi.

en: It started from Venice and in 1204 it stormed Constantinople.
uz: U Venetsiyadan boshlandi va 1204-yilda Konstantinopolni bosib oldi.

en: The great rising trading city of Venice was the leader in this adventure, and most of the coasts and islands of the Byzantine Empire were annexed by the Venetians.
uz: Buyuk rivojlanayotgan savdo shahri Venetsiya bu sarguzashtda yetakchi edi va Vizantiya imperiyasining ko'p sohillari va orollari venetsiyaliklar tomonidan anneksiya qilindi.

en: A “Latin” emperor (Baldwin of Flanders) was set up in Constantinople and the Latin and Greek Church were declared to be reunited.
uz: Konstantinopolda Lotin imperatori (Flandriyalik Baldvin) tashkil etildi va Lotin va Yunon cherkovlari qayta birlashgan deb e'lon qilindi.

en: The Latin emperors ruled in Constan- tinople from 1204 to 1261 when the Greek world shook itself free again from Roman predominance.
uz: Lotin imperatorlari 1204-yildan 1261-yilgacha Konstan-Tinamopolda hukmronlik qilishdi, o'shanda yunon dunyosi yana Rim hukmronligidan ozod bo'ldi.

en: The twelfth century then and the opening of the thirteenth was the age of papal ascendancy just as the eleventh was the age of the ascendancy of the Seljuk Turks and the tenth the age of the Northmen.
uz: O'n ikkinchi asr o'shanda va o'n uchinchi asrning ochilishi xuddi o'n birinchi asr Saljuqiy turklarining va o'ninchi asrning shimolliklarning hukmronlik davri bo'lgani kabi, papal hukmronlik davri edi.

en: A united Christendom under the rule of the Pope came nearer to being a working reality than it ever was before or after that time.
uz: Rim Papasi hukmronligi ostidagi birlashgan xristianlik o'sha vaqtdan oldin yoki keyin bo'lganidan ko'ra amaliy haqiqatga yaqinroq keldi.

en: A COURTYARD IN THE ALHAMBRA  Photo: Lehnert & Landrock In those centuries a simple Christian faith was real and widespread over great areas of Europe.
uz: ALHAMBRADAgi hovli. Surat: Lehnert & Landrock O'sha asrlarda oddiy xristian dini haqiqiy va Yevropaning katta hududlarida keng tarqalgan edi.

en: Rome itself had passed through some dark and dis-
uz: Rimning o'zi qandaydir qorong'u va...

en: creditable phases; few writers can be found to excuse the lives of Popes John XI and John XII in the tenth century; they were abominable creatures; but the heart and body of Latin Christendom had remained earnest and sim- ple; the generality of the common priests and monks and nuns had lived ex- emplary and faithful lives.
uz: Ishonchli fazalar; o'ninchi asrda Rim Papasi Ioann XI va Ioann XII hayotini oqlaydigan yozuvchilar kam topiladi; ular jirkanch maxluqlar edi; lekin Lotin Xristianligining yuragi va tanasi jiddiy va samimiy bo'lib qolgan edi; oddiy ruhoniylar, rohiblar va rohibalarning umumiy aholisi ishchi va sadoqatli hayot kechirgan edi.

en: Upon the wealth of conﬁdence such lives created rested the power of the church.
uz: Bunday yaratilgan hayotlar ishonch boyligiga cherkovning qudrati asos bo'ldi.

en: Among the great Popes of the past had been Gregory the Great, Gregory I (590-604) and Leo III (795-816) who invited Charlemagne to be Cæsar and crowned him in spite of himself.
uz: O'tmishdagi buyuk Papalar orasida Buyuk Grigoriy, I Grigoriy (590-604) va Leo III (795-816) ham bor edi. Ular Charlemagneni Sezar bo'lishga taklif qilishdi va o'ziga qaramay uni tojlashdi.

en: Towards the close of the eleventh century there arose a great clerical statesman, Hilde- brand, who ended his life as Pope Gregory VII (1073- 1085).
uz: O'n birinchi asrning oxiriga kelib, buyuk ruhoniy davlat arbobi, Hilde- brend paydo bo'ldi va u Rim Papasi Gregori VII (1073- 1085) sifatida hayotiga chek qo'ydi.

en: Next but one after him came Urban II (1087-1099), the Pope of the First Crusade.
uz: Keyin undan keyin Urban II (1087-1099), Birinchi Xoch yurishining papasi keldi.

en: These two were the founders of this period of papal greatness during which the Popes lorded it over the Emperors.
uz: Bu ikkalasi ham Rim Papasi ulug'vorligi davrining asoschilari edi, shu davrda Rim Poplari uni imperatorlar ustidan hukmronlik qilgan edi.

en: From Bulgaria to Ireland and from Nor- way to Sicily and Jerusalem the Pope was supreme.
uz: Bolgariyadan Irlandiyagacha va Shimoliy yo'ldan Sitsiliya va Quddusgacha Rim Papasi hukmron edi.

en: Gregory VII obliged the Emperor Henry IV to come in penitence to him at Canossa and to await forgiveness for three days and nights in the courtyard of the castle, clad in sackcloth and barefooted to the snow.
uz: Gregoriy VII imperator Genrix IV ni Kanossada tavba qilish uchun uning oldiga kelishga va uch kun va tun qasr hovlisida, qop kiyimda va qorga yalangoyoq qarab kechirim kutishga majbur qildi.

en: In 1176 at Venice the Emperor Fred- erick (Frederick Barbarossa), knelt to Pope Alexander III and swore fealty to him.
uz: 1176-yilda Venetsiyada imperator Fred-erik (Frederick Barbarossa) Papa Aleksandr III oldida tiz cho'kdi va unga sodiqlik qasamyod qildi.

en: The great power of the church in the beginning of the eleventh century lay in the wills and consciences of men.
uz: O'n birinchi asr boshidagi cherkovning buyuk qudrati insonlarning irodasi va vijdonida edi.

en: It failed to retain the moral prestige on which its power was based.
uz: U o'z hokimiyatiga asoslangan axloqiy obro'ni saqlab qola olmadi.

en: In the opening decades of the fourteenth century it was discovered that the power of the Pope had evaporated.
uz: XIV asrning dastlabki o'nlab yillarida Rim Papasining kuchi bug'lanib ketganligi aniqlandi.

en: What was it that destroyed the naive conﬁdence of the common people of Chris- tendom in the church so that they would no longer rally to its appeal and serve its purposes?
uz: Xrisning cherkovga bo'lgan oddiy odamlarning sodda ishonchini shunday yo'q qildi-ki, ular endi uning jozibasiga qo'shilmay, uning maqsadlariga xizmat qilmay qolishsin?

en: The ﬁrst trouble was certainly the accumulation of wealth by the church.
uz: Birinchi muammo, albatta, cherkov tomonidan boylik to'planishi edi.

en: The church never died, and there was a frequent disposition on the part of dying childless people to leave lands to the church.
uz: Cherkov hech qachon o'lmadi va o'layotgan befarzand odamlar cherkovga yerlarni tashlab ketishga tez-tez moyil bo'lishardi.

en: Penitent sinners were exhorted to do so.
uz: Tavba qiluvchi gunohkorlarga shunday qilishga undalgan edi.

en: Accordingly in many European countries as much as a fourth of the land became church property.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ko'plab Yevropa mamlakatlarida yerning to'rtdan bir qismi cherkov mulkiga aylandi.

en: The appetite for property grows with what it feeds upon.
uz: Mulkga bo'lgan ishtaha u oziqlantirgan narsa bilan birga o'sadi.

en: Already in the thirteenth century it was being said everywhere that the priests were not good men, that they were always hunt- ing for money and legacies.
uz: O'n uchinchi asrda ham ruhoniylar yaxshi odamlar emasligi, ular doimo pul va meros uchun ov qilishlari haqida hamma joyda aytildi.

en: The kings and princes disliked this alienation of property very greatly.
uz: Shohlar va shahzodalar mulkning bu begonalashuvini juda yomon ko'rishardi.

en: In the place of feudal lords capable of military support, they found their land
uz: Harbiy yordamga qodir bo'lgan feodallar o'rniga, ular o'z yerlarini topdilar.

en: supporting abbeys and monks and nuns.
uz: Abbeylar va rohiblar va rohibalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

en: And these lands were really under foreign dominion.
uz: Va bu yerlar haqiqatan ham begona hukmronlik ostida edi.

en: Even before the time of Pope Gregory VII there had been a struggle between the princes and the papacy over the question of “investi- tures,” the question that is of who should appoint the bishops.
uz: Hatto Rim Papasi Gregoriy VII davridan oldin ham shahzodalar va papalik o'rtasida yepiskoplarni kim tayinlashi kerakligi haqidagi savol bo'yicha tekshiruvlar masalasida kurash bo'lgan edi.

en: If that power rested with the Pope and not the King, then the latter lost control not only of the consciences of his subjects but of a considerable part of his dominions.
uz: Agar bu hokimiyat Rim Papasiga tegishli bo'lsa va qirolga tegishli bo'lmasa, unda u nafaqat o'z fuqarolarining vijdonini, balki o'z hukmronliklarining sezilarli qismini nazoratdan chiqarib yuborgan bo'lardi.

en: For also the clergy claimed exemption from taxation.
uz: Shuningdek, ruhoniylar soliqdan ozod etilishni talab qilishdi.

en: They paid their taxes to Rome.
uz: Ular soliqlarini Rimga to'lashdi.

en: And not only that, but the church also claimed the right to levy a tax of one-tenth upon the property of the layman in addition to the taxes he paid his prince.
uz: Nafaqat bu, balki cherkov ham oddiy odamning mulkidan shahzodasi to'lagan soliqlardan tashqari o'ndan bir qism soliq olish huquqini talab qildi.

en: The history of nearly every country in Latin Christendom tells of the same phase in the eleventh century, a phase of struggle between monarch and Pope on the issue of investitures and generally it tells of a victory for the Pope.
uz: Lotin nasroniy dinidagi deyarli har bir davlatning tarixi o'n birinchi asrdagi bir xil bosqichdan, investitsiyalar masalasida monarx va Papa o'rtasidagi kurash bosqichidan va odatda Papa uchun g'alaba haqida hikoya qiladi.

en: He claimed to be able to excommunicate the prince, to absolve his subjects from their allegiance to him, to recognize a successor.
uz: U shahzodani chiqarib yuborishga, o'z fuqarolarini unga sodiqlikdan ozod qilishga, vorisni tan olishga qodir ekanligini da'vo qildi.

en: He claimed to be able to put a nation under an interdict, and then nearly all priestly functions ceased except the sacraments of baptism, conﬁrmation and penance; the priests could neither hold the ordinary services, marry people, nor bury the dead.
uz: U millatni ta'qiq ostiga qo'yishga qodir ekanligini da'vo qildi va keyin deyarli barcha ruhoniy vazifalari, faqatgina suvga cho'mish, tasdiq va tavba qilish sakramentlaridan tashqari, to'xtadi; ruhoniylar oddiy xizmatlarni bajara olmasdi, odamlarga uylanmasdi va o'liklarni ko'mmasdi.

en: With these two weapons it was possible for the twelfth century Popes to curb the most recalcitrant princes and overawe the most restive peoples.
uz: Ushbu ikki qurol bilan XII asr Papalari eng qaysar shahzodalarni cheklash va eng betartiblikli xalqlarni ovora qilish imkoniga ega edi.

en: These were enormous powers, and enormous powers are only to be used on extraordinary occasions.
uz: Bular ulkan qudratlar edi va ulkan qudratlar faqat favqulodda vaziyatlarda ishlatilishi kerak.

en: The Popes used them at last with a frequency that staled their effect.
uz: Rim Papasi ularni nihoyat o'z ta'sirini to'xtatib qo'ygan chastota bilan ishlatdi.

en: Within thirty years at the end of the twelfth century we ﬁnd Scotland, France and England in turn under an in- terdict.
uz: O'n ikkinchi asr oxirida o'ttiz yil ichida Shotlandiya, Fransiya va Angliyani o'z navbatida terdikt ostida topamiz.

en: And also the Popes could not resist the temptation to preach cru- sades against offending princes—until the crusading spirit was extinct.
uz: Shuningdek, Papalar xafa bo'lgan shahzodalarga qarshi shafqatsiz va'zlarni targ'ib qilish vasvasasiga qarshi tura olmadilar  toki xochparastlik ruhi yo'q bo'lib ketmaguncha.

en: It is possible that if the Church of Rome had struggled simply against the princes and had had a care to keep its hold upon the general mind, it might have achieved a permanent dominion over all Christendom.
uz: Ehtimol, agar Rim cherkovi oddiy shahzodalarga qarshi kurashganida va umumiy ongga o'z ta'sirini saqlab qolishga e'tibor berganida, u butun xristianlar ustidan doimiy hukmronlikka erishgan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: But the high claims of the Pope were reﬂected as arrogance in the conduct of the clergy.
uz: Ammo Rim Papasining yuqori da'volari ruhoniylarning xatti-harakatlarida takabburlik sifatida aks etdi.

en: Before the eleventh century the Roman priests could marry; they had close ties with the people among whom they lived; they were indeed a part of the people.
uz: O'n birinchi asrgacha Rim ruhoniylari turmush qurishlari mumkin edi; ular yashaydigan odamlar bilan yaqin aloqada edilar; ular haqiqatan ham xalqning bir qismi edilar.

en: Gregory VII made them celibates; he cut the priests off from too great an intimacy with the laymen in order to bind them more closely to Rome, but indeed he opened a ﬁssure between the church and the common- alty.
uz: Gregoriy VII ularni celibatga aylantirdi; u ruhoniylarni Rimga yaqinroq bog'lash uchun oddiy odamlar bilan haddan tashqari yaqin aloqadan uzdi, lekin aslida u cherkov va oddiy odamlar o'rtasida bo'linish ochdi.

en: The church had its own law courts.
uz: Cherkovning o'z qonuniy sudlari bor edi.

en: Cases involving not merely priests
uz: Faqat ruhoniylar bilan bog'liq bo'lmagan ishlar

en: but monks, students, crusaders, widows, orphans and the helpless were re- served for the clerical courts, and so were all matters relating to wills, mar- riages and oaths and all cases of sorcery, heresy and blasphemy.
uz: Ammo rohiblar, talabalar, xochparastlar, bevalar, yetim bolalar va ojizlar ruhoniy sudlar uchun qayta xizmat qilishdi, shuningdek, vasiyatlar, nikoh va qasamlar hamda sehrgarlik, bid'at va kufrga oid barcha masalalar ham.

en: Whenever the layman found himself in conﬂict with the priest he had to go to a cleri- cal court.
uz: Qachonki oddiy odam ruhoniy bilan ziddiyatga duch kelsa, u ruhoniylar sudiga borishi kerak edi.

en: The obligations of peace and war fell upon his shoulders alone and left the priest free.
uz: Tinchlik va urush majburiyatlari uning yelkasiga tushdi va ruhoniyni ozod qildi.

en: It is no great wonder that jealousy and hatred of the priests grew up in the Christian world.
uz: Xristian dunyosida ruhoniylarga nisbatan rashk va nafrat paydo bo'lgani katta ajablanarli emas.

en: Never did Rome seem to realize that its power was in the consciences of common men.
uz: Rim hech qachon o'z qudrati oddiy odamlarning vijdonida ekanligini anglaganday tuyulmagan.

en: It fought against religious enthusiasm, which should have been its ally, and it forced doctrinal orthodoxy upon honest doubt and aber- rant opinion.
uz: U diniy ishtiyoqqa qarshi kurashdi, bu uning ittifoqchisi bo'lishi kerak edi va u dogmatik ortodoksani halol shubha va haqoratli fikrga majbur qildi.

en: When the church interfered in matters of morality it had the common man with it, but not when it interfered in matters of doctrine.
uz: Cherkov axloq masalalariga aralashganda, u bilan oddiy odam bor edi, lekin ta'limot masalalariga aralashganda emas.

en: When in the south of France Waldo taught a return to the simplicity of Jesus in faith and life, Innocent III preached a crusade against the Waldenses, Waldo’s followers, and permitted them to be suppressed with ﬁre, sword, rape and the most abominable cruelties.
uz: Fransiyaning janubida Valdo Iso Masihning imon va hayotdagi soddaligiga qaytishni o'rgatganida, Innocent III valdenlarga, Valdo izdoshlariga qarshi xoch yurishini va ularni olov, qilich, zo'rlash va eng jirkanch shafqatsizlar bilan bostirishga ruxsat bergan edi.

en: Francis of Assisi (1181-1226) taught the imitation of Christ and a life of poverty and service, his followers, the Franciscans, were persecuted, scourged, imprisoned and dispersed.
uz: Fransisk Assisilik (1181-1226) Masihga taqlid qilishni va kambag'allik va xizmat hayotini o'rgatdi, uning izdoshlari, fransiskaliklar ta'qib qilindi, kaltaklandi, qamoqqa tashlandi va tarqaldi.

en: In 1318 four of them were burnt alive at Marseilles.
uz: 1318-yilda ulardan to'rttasi Marselda tiriklayin yoqib yuborildi.

en: On the other hand the ﬁercely orthodox order of the Dominicans, founded by St.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, Dominikanlarning shiddatli pravoslav tartibi, avliyo.

en: Do- minic (1170-1221) was strongly supported by Innocent III, who with its as- sistance set up an organization, the Inquisition, for the hunting of heresy and the afﬂiction of free thought.
uz: Do- minic (1170-1221) Innocent III tomonidan kuchli qo'llab-quvvatlandi, u o'z homiyligi bilan bid'atga va erkin fikrga zarar yetkazishga qaratilgan inkvizitsiya tashkilotiga asos soldi.

en: So it was that the church by excessive claims, by unrighteous privileges, and by an irrational intolerance destroyed that free faith of the common man which was the ﬁnal source of all its power.
uz: Shunday qilib, cherkov haddan tashqari da'volar, adolatsiz imtiyozlar va irratsional intolerantlik bilan o'zining butun kuchining yakuniy manbai bo'lgan oddiy odamning o'sha erkin e'tiqodini yo'q qildi.

en: The story of its decline tells of no adequate foemen from without but continually of decay from within.
uz: Uning tanazzul tarixi tashqi tomondan yetarli dushmanlar yo'qligi, balki ichki tomondan doimiy ravishda chirib borayotgani haqida hikoya qiladi.

en: XLVII RECALCITRANT PRINCES AND THE GREAT SCHISM One very great weakness of the Roman Church in its struggle to secure the headship of all Christendom was the manner in which the Pope was chosen.
uz: XLVII RECALCITRANT PRINCES VA BUYUK SCHIMIZM Rim cherkovining butun xristianlik boshchiligini ta'minlash uchun kurashidagi eng katta zaifligi Rim Papasining tanlangan usuli edi.

en: If indeed the papacy was to achieve its manifest ambition and establish one rule and one peace throughout Christendom, then it was vitally neces- sary that it should have a strong, steady and continuous direction.
uz: Agar rostdan ham Papalik o'zining yaqqol ambitsiyalariga erishishi va butun xristianlik bo'ylab yagona qoida va bir tinchlik o'rnatishi kerak bo'lsa, unda uning kuchli, barqaror va uzluksiz yo'nalishiga ega bo'lishi juda zarur edi.

en: In those great days of its opportunity it needed before all things that the Popes when they took ofﬁce should be able men in the prime of life, that each should have his successor-designate with whom he could discuss the policy of the church, and that the forms and processes of election should be clear, deﬁ- nite, unalterable and unassailable.
uz: O'sha buyuk imkoniyat kunlarida, barcha narsalardan oldin, ular lavozimga kelgan Papalar hayotning eng zo'r davrida qobiliyatli erkak bo'lishi, har birining o'z vorisi bo'lishi kerak edi, u bilan cherkov siyosatini muhokama qilishi mumkin edi va saylov shakllari va jarayonlari aniq, qat'iy, o'zgartirilmas va hujumga solmas bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Unhappily none of these things obtained.
uz: Afsuski, bu narsalarning hech biriga erishib bo'lmadi.

en: It was not even clear who could vote in the election of a Pope, nor whether the Byzantine or Holy Roman Emperor had a voice in the matter.
uz: Hatto Rim Papasini saylashda kim ovoz berishi mumkinligi ham aniq emas edi, shuningdek, Vizantiya yoki Muqaddas Rim imperatorining bu masalada ovozi bor-yo'qligi ham aniq emas edi.

en: That very great papal statesman Hildebrand (Pope Gregory VII, 1073-1085) did much to regularize the election.
uz: O'sha juda buyuk papalik davlat arbobi Hildebrand (Pope Gregory VII, 1073-1085) saylovni tartibga solish uchun ko'p ish qildi.

en: He conﬁned the votes to the Roman cardinals and he reduced the Emperor’s share to a formula of assent conceded to him by the church, but he made no provision for a successor-designate and he left it possible for the disputes of the cardinals to keep the See vacant, as in some cases it was kept vacant, for a year or more.
uz: U ovozlarni Rim kardinallariga chekladi va imperatorning ulushini cherkov tomonidan unga berilgan rozilik formusigacha kamaytirdi, lekin voris-tanlovga hech qanday qoida qo'ymadi va kardinallarning nizolari uchun Taxtni bir yil yoki undan ko'proq vaqtga bo'sh qoldirdi, chunki ba'zi hollarda u bir yil yoki undan ko'proq vaqtga bo'sh turardi.

en: MILAN CATHEDRALA COURTYARD IN THE ALHAMBRA  View showing the exquisite carvings characteristic of the 98 spires of the ediﬁce
uz: ALHAMBRA shahridagi MILAN KATEDRALASI hovlisi Binodagi 98 ta minorasiga xos bo'lgan nafis o'ymalarni ko'rsatuvchi ko'rinish.

en: The consequences of this want of ﬁrm deﬁnition are to be seen in the whole history of the papacy up to the sixteenth century.
uz: Ushbu qat'iy ta'rifning yetishmasligi oqibatlari papalikning butun tarixida XVI asrgacha ko'rinadi.

en: From quite early times onward there were disputed elections and two or more men each claiming to be Pope.
uz: Qadim zamonlardan boshlab bahsli saylovlar bo'lib, har biri Papa ekanligini da'vo qilayotgan ikki yoki undan ortiq odam bo'lgan.

en: The church would then be subjected to the indignity of going to the Emperor or some other outside arbiter to settle the dispute.
uz: Keyin cherkov nizoni hal qilish uchun imperatorga yoki boshqa tashqi hakamga borish sharafiga duchor bo'ladi.

en: And the career of everyone of the great Popes ended in a note of interrogation.
uz: Va buyuk Papalarning har birining karerasi so'roq xati bilan yakunlandi.

en: At his death the church might be left headless and as ineffective as a decapi- tated body.
uz: Uning o'limida cherkov boshsiz va sochlari bo'yalgan tana kabi samarasiz qolishi mumkin edi.

en: Or he might be replaced by some old rival eager only to discred- it and undo his work.
uz: Yoki uni faqat obro'sizlantirish va o'z ishini bekor qilishga intiluvchi eski raqib almashtirishi mumkin.

en: Or some enfeebled old man tottering on the brink of the grave might succeed him.
uz: Yoki uning o'rniga qabr qirg'og'ida titrayotgan bir zaif chol kelishi mumkin.

en: It was inevitable that this peculiar weakness of the papal organization should attract the interference of the various German princes, the French King, and the Norman and French Kings who ruled in England; that they should all try to inﬂuence the elections, and have a Pope in their own inter- est established in the Lateran Palace at Rome.
uz: Rim Papasi tashkilotining bu o'ziga xos zaifligi turli nemis shahzodalari, fransuz qirollari va Angliyada hukmronlik qilgan normman va fransuz qirollarining aralashuvini o'ziga tortishi muqarrar edi; ularning barchasi saylovlarga ta'sir o'tkazishga harakat qilishi va Rimdagi Lateran saroyida o'z ichida Rim Papasini o'rnatishi kerak edi.

en: And the more powerful and important the Pope became in European affairs, the more urgent did these interventions become.
uz: Va Rim Papasi Yevropa ishlarida qanchalik qudratli va muhim bo'lsa, bu aralashuvlar shunchalik dolzarb bo'lib borardi.

en: Under the circumstances it is no great wonder that many of the Popes were weak and futile.
uz: Bunday sharoitda, ko'plab Papalarning zaif va befoyda bo'lgani ajablanarli emas.

en: The astonishing thing is that many of them were able and courageous men.
uz: Ajablanarlisi shundaki, ularning ko'pchiligi qobiliyatli va jasur erkaklar edi.

en: One of the most vigorous and interesting of the Popes of this great period was Innocent III (1198-1216) who was so fortunate as to become Pope be- fore he was thirty-eight.
uz: Bu buyuk davrning eng faol va qiziqarli Papalaridan biri Innocent III (1198-1216) edi. U o'ttiz sakkiz yoshida Papa bo'lish baxtiga muyassar bo'lgan edi.

en: He and his successors were pitted against an even more interesting personality, the Emperor Frederick II; Stupor mundi he was called, the Wonder of the world.
uz: U va uning vorislari yanada qiziqarliroq shaxsga, imperator Frederik II ga qarshi turishdi; u Stupor mundi deb atalgan, dunyoning mo'jizasi edi.

en: The struggle of this monarch against Rome is a turning place in history.
uz: Bu monarxning Rimga qarshi kurashi tarixdagi burilish joyi hisoblanadi.

en: In the end Rome defeated him and de- stroyed his dynasty, but he left the prestige of the church and Pope so badly wounded that its wounds festered and led to its decay.
uz: Oxir-oqibat Rim uni mag'lub etdi va uning sulolasini yo'q qildi, lekin u cherkovning obro'sini va Rim Papasini shunchalik qattiq jarohatladi, uning yaralari achchiqlandi va uning parchalanishiga olib keldi.

en: Frederick was the son of the Emperor Henry VI and his mother was the daughter of Roger I, the Norman King of Sicily.
uz: Frederik imperator Genrix VI ning o'g'li edi va onasi Sitsiliya normand shohi Rodjer I ning qizi edi.

en: He inherited this kingdom in 1198 when he was a child of four years.
uz: U 1198-yilda, to'rt yoshli bo'lganida bu qirollikni meros qilib oldi.

en: Innocent III had been made his guardian.
uz: Innocent III uning vasiysiga aylantirilgan edi.

en: Sicily in those days had been but recently conquered by the Nor- mans; the Court was half oriental and full of highly educated Arabs; and some of these were associated in the education of the young king.
uz: O'sha davrda Sitsiliya nor-manlar tomonidan yaqinda zabt etilgan edi; saroy yarim sharqona va yuqori ma'lumotli arablarga to'la edi; va bularning ba'zilari yosh qirolning ta'limiga aloqador edi.

en: No doubt they were at some pains to make their point of view clear to him.
uz: Shubhasiz, ular unga o'z nuqtai nazarlarini aniq tushuntirishga harakat qilishgan.

en: He got a Moslem view of Christianity as well as a Christian view of Islam, and the unhappy result of this double system of instruction was a view, exceptional
uz: U xristianlikka musulmoncha qarashni ham, islomga xristiancha qarashni ham oldi va bu ikki tomonlama ta'lim tizimining baxtsiz natijasi g'ayrioddiy qarash bo'ldi.

en: in that age of faith, that all religions were impostures.
uz: o'sha imon davrida, barcha dinlar soxta edi.

en: He talked freely on the subject; his heresies and blasphemies are on record.
uz: U bu mavzuda bemalol gapirdi; uning bid'atlari va kufrlari qayd etilgan.

en: As the young man grew up he found himself in conﬂict with his guardian.
uz: Yigit ulg'aygach, o'z vasiysi bilan ziddiyatga tushib qoldi.

en: Innocent III wanted altogether too much from his ward.
uz: Innocent III o'z saroyidan juda ko'p narsa xohlardi.

en: When the opportunity came for Frederick to succeed as Emperor, the Pope intervened with conditions.
uz: Frederikning imperator sifatida muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati kelganda, Rim Papasi shartlar bilan aralashdi.

en: Frederick must promise to put down heresy in Germany with a strong hand.
