uz: Frederik Germaniyada bid'atchilikni kuchli qo'l bilan yo'q qilishga va'da berishi kerak.

en: Moreover he must relinquish his crown in Sicily and South Italy, because otherwise he would be too strong for the Pope.
uz: Qolaversa, u Sitsiliya va Janubiy Italiyadagi tojidan voz kechishi kerak, aks holda u Papa uchun juda kuchli bo'lardi.

en: And the German clergy were to be freed from all taxation.
uz: Va nemis ruhoniylari barcha soliqlardan ozod qilinishi kerak edi.

en: Frederick agreed but with no intention of keeping his word.
uz: Frederik rozi bo'ldi, lekin o'z so'zida turish niyati yo'q edi.

en: The Pope had already induced the French King to make war upon his own subjects in France, the cruel and bloody crusade against the Waldenses; he wanted Frederick to do the same thing in Germany.
uz: Rim Papasi allaqachon Fransuz qirolini Fransiyadagi o'z fuqarolariga qarshi urushga, valdenlarga qarshi shafqatsiz va qonli salib yurishiga undadi; u Frederikning Germaniyada ham xuddi shunday qilishini xohlardi.

en: But Frederick being far more of a heretic than any of the simple pietists who had incurred the Pope’s animosity, lacked the crusading im- pulse.
uz: Ammo Frederik Papaga dushmanlik qilgan oddiy pietistlardan ko'ra ancha ko'proq bid'atchi bo'lgani uchun, unda xudojo'y impuls yetishmas edi.

en: And when Innocent urged him to crusade against the Moslim and re- cover Jerusalem he was equally ready to promise and equally slack in his performance.
uz: Innocent uni musulmonlarga qarshi salib yurishga va Quddusni qayta bosib olishga undaganida, u xuddi shunday va'da berishga tayyor edi va o'z ijrosida ham xuddi shunday beparvo edi.

en: A TYPICAL CRUSADER: DON RODRIGO DE CARDENAS  From the Church of S.
uz: ANIQ XURSIYATCHI: Don RODRIGO DE CARDENAS, S. cherkovidan.

en: Pedro at Ocana, Spain  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum)
uz: Pedro Ocanada, Ispaniya (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida)

en: Having secured the imperial crown Frederick II stayed in Sicily, which he greatly preferred to Germany as a residence, and did nothing to redeem any of his promises to Innocent III, who died bafﬂed in 1216.
uz: Imperatorlik tojini qo'lga kiritgandan so'ng, Frederik II Sitsiliyada qoldi, uni Germaniyaga yashash joyi sifatida juda afzal ko'rdi va 1216-yilda hayratda o'lgan Innocent III ga bergan va'dalaridan hech narsani bekor qilmadi.

en: Honorius III, who succeeded Innocent, could do no better with Frederick, and Gregory IX (1227) came to the papal throne evidently resolved to settle accounts with this young man at any cost.
uz: Honorius III, Innocentning o'rniga kelgan, Frederik bilan bundan yaxshiroq uddalay olmadi va Gregoriy IX (1227) Rim papasi taxtiga kelganida, bu yigit bilan har qanday xarajat bilan hisob-kitob qilishga qaror qilgan edi.

en: He excommunicated him.
uz: U uni ishdan bo'shatdi.

en: Freder- ick II was denied all the comforts of religion.
uz: Freder- ick II dinning barcha qulayliklaridan mahrum bo'ldi.

en: In the half-Arab Court of Sici- ly this produced singularly little discomfort.
uz: Yarim arab saroyida bu juda kam noqulaylik tug'dirdi.

en: And also the Pope addressed a public letter to the Emperor reciting his vices (which were indisputable), his heresies, and his general misconduct.
uz: Shuningdek, Rim Papasi imperatorga o'zining noto'g'ri xulq-atvorlari (bular bahssiz edi), bid'atlari va umumiy noto'g'ri xulq-atvorini tilga olgan holda ommaviy xat yozdi.

en: To this Frederick replied in a docu- ment of diabolical ability.
uz: Bunga Frederik iblis qobiliyati haqidagi hujjatda javob berdi.

en: It was addressed to all the princes of Europe, and it made the ﬁrst clear statement of the issue between the Pope and the princes.
uz: U Yevropaning barcha shahzodalariga qaratilgan edi va u Rim Papasi va shahzodalar o'rtasidagi masala haqida birinchi aniq bayonot berdi.

en: He made a shattering attack upon the manifest ambition of the Pope to become the absolute ruler of all Europe.
uz: U Rim Papasining butun Yevropaning mutlaq hukmdori bo'lishga bo'lgan ochiq intilishiga qattiq hujum qildi.

en: He suggested a union of princes against this usurpation.
uz: U bu o'zlashtirishga qarshi shahzodalar ittifoqini taklif qildi.

en: He directed the attention of the princes speciﬁcally to the wealth of the church.
uz: U shahzodalarning e'tiborini aynan cherkov boyligiga qaratdi.

en: Having ﬁred off this deadly missile Frederick resolved to perform his twelve-year-old promise and go upon a crusade.
uz: Ushbu o'ldiruvchi raketni otgandan so'ng, Frederik o'zining o'n ikki yillik va'dasini bajarishga va xoch yurishiga qaror qildi.

en: This was the Sixth Crusade (1228).
uz: Bu Oltinchi Salib yurishi edi (1228).

en: It was as a crusade, farcical.
uz: Bu xuddi xoch yurishi kabi, hazilkash edi.

en: Frederick II went to Egypt and met and discussed affairs with the Sultan.
uz: Frederik II Misrga bordi va Sulton bilan uchrashib, masalalarni muhokama qildi.

en: These two gentlemen, both of sceptical opinions, exchanged congenial views, made a commercial convention to their mutual advantage, and agreed to transfer Jerusalem to Frederick.
uz: Bu ikki janob, ikkalasi ham shubhali fikrda bo'lgan, o'zaro kelishgan fikrlarni almashdilar, o'zaro manfaatdorlik uchun tijorat shartnomasini tuzdilar va Quddusni Frederikga topshirishga rozi bo'lishdi.

en: This indeed was a new sort of crusade, a crusade by private treaty.
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham yangi turdagi salib yurishi edi, xususiy shartnoma orqali salib yurishi.

en: Here was no blood splashing the conqueror, no “weeping with excess of joy.” As this as- tonishing crusader was an excommunicated man, he had to be content with a purely secular coronation as King of Jerusalem, taking the crown from the altar with his own hand—for all the clergy were bound to shun him.
uz: Bu yerda hech qanday qon sachramayotgan emas edi, hech qanday shodlikdan haddan tashqari yig'layotgan emas edi. Bu tozalash xochboz haydalgan odam bo'lgani uchun, u Quddus qiroli sifatida sof dunyoviy toj kiyish bilan kifoyalanishi kerak edi, qurbongohdan tojni o'z qo'li bilan olib  chunki barcha ruhoniylar uni rad etishlari kerak edi.

en: He then returned to Italy, chased the papal armies which had invaded his do- minions back to their own territories, and obliged the Pope to grant him ab- solution from his excommunication.
uz: Keyin u Italiyaga qaytib keldi, o'z hududlariga bostirib kirgan Papa qo'shinlarini quvib chiqardi va Rim Papasiga uni chetlatilishidan qutqarishga majbur qildi.

en: So a prince might treat the Pope in the thirteenth century, and there was now no storm of popular indignation to avenge him.
uz: Shunday qilib, shahzoda o'n uchinchi asrda Rim Papasiga munosabatda bo'lishi mumkin edi va endi uni qasos olish uchun xalq g'azabining bo'roni yo'q edi.

en: Those days were past.
uz: O'sha kunlar o'tib ketdi.

en: In 1239 Gregory IX resumed his struggle with Frederick, excommunicat- ed him for a second time, and renewed that warfare of public abuse in which the papacy had already suffered severely.
uz: 1239-yilda Gregoriy IX Frederik bilan kurashni davom ettirdi, uni ikkinchi marta ishdan bo'shatdi va paplik allaqachon qattiq azob chekkan ommaviy haqoratlar urushini yangiladi.

en: The controversy was re- vived after Gregory IX was dead, when Innocent IV was Pope; and again a
uz: Nizo Grigoriy IX vafotidan so'ng, Innocent IV Rim Papasi bo'lgan paytda qayta jonlandi; va yana...

en: devastating letter, which men were bound to remember, was written by Frederick against the church.
uz: Odamlar eslab qolishi kerak bo'lgan vayron qiluvchi xat, Frederik tomonidan cherkovga qarshi yozilgan edi.

en: He denounced the pride and irreligion of the clergy, and ascribed all the corruptions of the time to their pride and wealth.
uz: U ruhoniylarning mag'rurligi va dinsizligini qoraladi va o'sha davrdagi barcha buzilishlarni ularning mag'rurligi va boyligiga bog'ladi.

en: He proposed to his fellow princes a general conﬁscation of church property —for the good of the church.
uz: U o'zining hamkasb shahzodalariga cherkov mulkini umumiy musodara qilishni taklif qildi  cherkov manfaati uchun.

en: It was a suggestion that never afterwards left the imagination of the European princes.
uz: Bu Yevropa shahzodalarining tasavvuridan hech qachon uzoqlashmagan taklif edi.

en: We will not go on to tell of his last years.
uz: Biz uning oxirgi yillari haqida gapirishga bormaymiz.

en: The particular events of his life are far less signiﬁcant than its general atmosphere.
uz: Uning hayotidagi muayyan voqealar uning umumiy muhitidan ancha kam ahamiyatga ega.

en: It is possible to piece to- gether something of his court life in Sicily.
uz: Sitsiliyadagi saroy hayotidan bir narsa yig'ishtirish mumkin.

en: He was luxurious in his way of living, and fond of beautiful things.
uz: U hashamatli hayot tarzida edi va go'zal narsalarga oshiq edi.

en: He is described as licentious.
uz: U shahvatparast deb ta'riflanadi.

en: But it is clear that he was a man of very effectual curiosity and inquiry.
uz: Lekin aniqki, u juda samarali qiziquvchanlik va so'rovchan inson edi.

en: He gathered Jewish and Moslem as well as Christian philosophers at his court, and he did much to irrigate the Italian mind with Saracenic inﬂuences.
uz: U o'z saroyiga yahudiy va musulmon, shuningdek, xristian faylasuflarni yig'di va italyan ongini saracen ta'sirlari bilan sug'orish uchun ko'p ish qildi.

en: Through him the Arabic numerals and algebra were introduced to Christian students, and among other philosophers at his court was Michael Scott, who translat- ed portions of Aristotle and the commentaries thereon of the great Arab philosopher Averroes (of Cordoba).
uz: U orqali arab raqamlari va algebra xristian talabalariga tanishtirildi, uning saroyidagi boshqa faylasuflar qatorida esa, Arastuning qismlari va buyuk arab faylasufi Averroesning (Kordubaning) sharhlarini tarjima qilgan Maykl Skott ham bor edi.

en: In 1224 Frederick founded the Univer- sity of Naples, and he enlarged and enriched the great medical school at Salerno University.
uz: 1224-yilda Frederik Neapol universitetiga asos soldi va u Salerno universitetidagi buyuk tibbiyot maktabini kengaytirdi va boyitdi.

en: He also founded a zoological garden.
uz: U shuningdek, zoologik bog'ga asos soldi.

en: He left a book on hawking, which shows him to have been an acute observer of the habits of birds, and he was one of the ﬁrst Italians to write Italian verse.
uz: U qushlarning odatlariga o'tkir kuzatuvchi bo'lganini ko'rsatuvchi, italyan she'rlarini yozgan birinchi italyanlardan biri bo'lgan hakking haqida kitob qoldirdi.

en: Italian poet- ry was indeed born at his court.
uz: Italiyalik shoir haqiqatan ham uning saroyida tug'ilgan.

en: He has been called by an able writer, “the ﬁrst of the moderns,” and the phrase expresses aptly the unprejudiced de- tachment of his intellectual side.
uz: Uni qobiliyatli yozuvchi deb atashgan, zamonaviylarning birinchisi, va bu ibora uning intellektual tomonining xolis de-tachementini togri ifodalaydi.

en: A still more striking intimation of the decay of the living and sustaining forces of the papacy appeared when presently the Popes came into conﬂict with the growing power of the French King.
uz: Papalikning tirik va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi kuchlarining parchalanishining yanada yaqqolroq tasdig'i, hozirda Papalar Fransiya qirolining kuchayib borayotgan qudrati bilan ziddiyatga kirganda paydo bo'ldi.

en: During the lifetime of the Em- peror Frederick II, Germany fell into disunion, and the French King began to play the rôle of guard, supporter and rival to the Pope that had hitherto fallen to the Hohenstaufen Emperors.
uz: Imperator Frederik II davrida Germaniya bir-biriga zid bo'ldi va Fransiya qiroli shu paytgacha Hohenstaufen imperatorlariga tegishli bo'lgan Papaga qo'llab-quvvatlovchi, raqib va qo'riqchi rolini o'ynashni boshladi.

en: A series of Popes pursued the policy of supporting the French monarchs.
uz: Bir qator Papalar Fransiya monarxlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash siyosatini olib bordilar.

en: French princes were established in the kingdom of Sicily and Naples, with the support and approval of Rome, and the French Kings saw before them the possibility of restoring and ruling the Empire of Charlemagne.
uz: Fransuz knyazlari Rimning qo'llab-quvvatlashi va roziligi bilan Sitsiliya va Neapol qirolligida o'rnashdi va Fransiya qirollari Charlz Buyuk imperiyasini tiklash va hukmronlik qilish imkoniyatini ko'rishdi.

en: When, however, the German interregnum after the death of Frederick II, the last of the Hohenstaufens, came to all end and Rudolf of Habsburg was elected ﬁrst Habsburg Emperor (1273), the policy
uz: Biroq, Hohenstaufening oxirgi vakili Frederik II vafotidan keyin Germaniya hukumatlararo hukmronligi tugadi va Habsburglik Rudolf birinchi Habsburg imperatori etib saylandi (1273).

en: of Rome began to ﬂuctuate between France and Germany, veering about with the sympathies of each successive Pope.
uz: Rimning Fransiya va Germaniya o'rtasida o'zgara boshladi, har bir ketma-ket Papalarning hamdardligi bilan o'zgarib turardi.

en: In the East in 1261 the Greeks recaptured Constantinople from the Latin emperors, and the founder of the new Greek dynasty, Michael Palæologus, Michael VIII, after some unreal tentatives of reconciliation with the Pope, broke away from the Roman communion altogether, and with that, and the fall of the Latin kingdoms in Asia, the eastward ascendancy of the Popes came to an end.
uz: Sharqda 1261 yilda yunonlar Konstantinopolni lotin imperatorlaridan qaytarib olishdi va yangi yunon sulolasi asoschisi Maykl Palæologus, Maykl VIII, Papa bilan yarashuvga bir necha noaniq urinishlardan so'ng, Rim ittifoqidan butunlay ajralib chiqdi va shu bilan Osiyoda lotin qirolliklarining qulashi bilan Papalarning sharqiy ustunligi yakunlandi.

en: COSTUMES OF THE BURGUNDIAN NOBILITY: FLEMISH WORK OF THE FIFTEENTH CENTURY In 1294 Boniface VIII became Pope.
uz: BURGUNDIYA NOBILITASINING MOSLAMALARI: XV ASRNING FLEMISH ISHLARI 1294-YILDA BONIFATSIY VIII Papa bo'ldi.

en: He was an Italian, hostile to the French, and full of a sense of the great traditions and mission of Rome.
uz: U italyan, fransuzlarga dushman va Rimning buyuk an'analari va missiyasiga to'la edi.

en: For a time he carried things with a high hand.
uz: Bir vaqtlar u narsalarni baland qo'l bilan ko'tarib yurardi.

en: In 1300 he held a jubilee, and a vast multitude of pilgrims assembled in Rome.
uz: 1300 yilda u yubiley o'tkazdi va Rimda ziyoratchilarning ulkan olomon yig'ildi.

en: “So great was the inﬂux of money into the papal treasury, that two assistants were kept busy with the rakes collecting the offerings that were deposited at the tomb of St.
uz: Rim papasining xazinasiga pul oqimi shunchalik katta ediki, ikki yordamchi Sankt-Peterning qabriga qo'yilgan qurbonliklarni yig'ish bilan band edi.

en: Peter.” [1] But this festival was a delusive triumph.
uz: Peter. [1] Lekin bu festival aldamchi g'alaba edi.

en: Boniface came into conﬂict with the French King in 1302, and in 1303, as he was about to pronounce sentence of excommunication against that monarch, he was surprised and
uz: Bonifatiy 1302-yilda Fransiya qiroli bilan ziddiyatga tushdi va 1303-yilda, u o'sha monarxga qarshi ekzomulyatsiya hukmini e'lon qilmoqchi bo'lganida, hayron bo'ldi va...

en: arrested in his own ancestral palace at Anagni, by Guillaume de Nogaret.
uz: Anagni shahridagi o'z ajdod saroyida, Guillaume de Nogaret tomonidan hibsga olingan.

en: This agent from the French King forced an entrance into the palace, made his way into the bedroom of the frightened Pope—he was lying in bed with a cross in his hands—and heaped threats and insults upon him.
uz: Fransuz qirolining bu agenti saroyga zo'rlab kirdi, qo'rqib ketgan Papa yotoqxonasiga kirdi  u qo'lida xoch bilan karavotda yotgan edi  va unga tahdidlar va haqoratlar yog'dirdi.

en: The Pope was liberated a day or so later by the townspeople, and returned to Rome; but there he was seized upon and again made prisoner by the Orsini family, and in a few weeks’ time the shocked and disillusioned old man died a pris- oner in their hands.
uz: Rim Papasi bir kun yoki undan keyin shahar aholisi tomonidan ozod qilindi va Rimga qaytdi; lekin u yerda uni Orsinilar oilasi tomonidan yana asirga olishdi va bir necha hafta o'tgach, hayratga tushgan va umidsiz qolgan chol ularning qo'lida asir bo'lib vafot etdi.

en: COSTUMES OF THE BURGUNDIAN NOBILITY: FLEMISH WORK OF THE FIFTEENTH CENTURY  This series is from casts in the Victoria and Albert Museum of the original brass statuettes in the Rijks Museum, Amsterdam The people of Anagni did resent the ﬁrst outrage, and rose against Noga- ret to liberate Boniface, but then Anagni was the Pope’s native town.
uz: BURGUNDIYA NOBILITYASINING MOSLAMLARI: XV ASRNING FLM ISHLARI Bu turkum Viktoriya va Albert muzeyidagi kastlardan olingan, Rijks muzeyidagi, Amsterdamdagi asl mis haykalchalar. Anagni xalqi birinchi g'azabdan nafratlandi va Bonifatiyni ozod qilish uchun Noga qarshi ko'tarildi, ammo keyin Anagni Rim Papasining tug'ilgan shahri edi.

en: The important point to note is that the French King in this rough treatment of the head of Christendom was acting with the full approval of his people; he had summoned a council of the Three Estates of France (lords, church and com-
uz: Shuni ta'kidlash muhimki, Fransiya qiroli xristianlar rahbarining bu qo'pol munosabatida o'z xalqining to'liq roziligi bilan harakat qilmoqda edi; u Fransiyaning Uch Davlatlari (lordlar, cherkov va...

en: mons) and gained their consent before proceeding to extremities.
uz: Mon) va ularning roziligini qo'lga kiritdi, so'ngra o'ta zo'ravonlikka o'tdi.

en: Neither in Italy, Germany nor England was there the slightest general manifestation of disapproval at this free handling of the sovereign pontiff.
uz: Na Italiyada, na Germaniyada, na Angliyada suveren pontifning bu erkin muomalasiga nisbatan eng kichik umumiy norozilik namoyishi bo'lmadi.

en: The idea of Chris- tendom had decayed until its power over the minds of men had gone.
uz: Kris-tendom g'oyasi odamlar ongiga bo'lgan qudrati yo'qolguncha chirigan edi.

en: Throughout the fourteenth century the papacy did nothing to recover its moral sway.
uz: O'n to'rtinchi asr davomida papalik o'zining axloqiy hukmronligini tiklash uchun hech narsa qilmadi.

en: The next Pope elected, Clement V, was a Frenchman, the choice of King Philip of France.
uz: Keyingi saylangan Papa, Klement V, fransuz edi, Fransiya qiroli Filippning tanlovi edi.

en: He never came to Rome.
uz: U hech qachon Rimga kelmagan.

en: He set up his court in the town of Avignon, which then belonged not to France but to the papal See, though embedded in French territory, and there his successors remained until 1377, when Pope Gregory XI returned to the Vatican palace in Rome.
uz: U o'z saroyini Fransiyaga emas, balki Rim Papasi taxtiga tegishli bo'lgan, ammo Fransiya hududida joylashgan Avignon shahrida o'rnatdi va uning vorislari 1377 yilgacha u yerda qoldi, shundan so'ng Rim Papasi Gregoriy XI Rimdagi Vatikan saroyiga qaytdi.

en: But Gregory XI did not take the sympathies of the whole church with him.
uz: Lekin Gregoriy XI butun cherkovning hamdardligini o'zi bilan olib ketmadi.

en: Many of the cardinals were of French origin and their habits and associations were rooted deep at Avignon.
uz: Kardinallarning ko'pchiligi fransuz kelib chiqishiga ega edi va ularning odatlari va assotsiatsiyalari Avignonda chuqur ildiz otgan edi.

en: When in 1378 Gregory XI died, and an Italian, Urban VI, was elected, these dissentient cardinals declared the election invalid, and elected another Pope, the anti-Pope, Clement VII.
uz: 1378-yilda Gregoriy XI vafot etib, italyan Urban VI saylanganda, bu norozi kardinallar saylovni haqiqiy emas deb e'lon qilishdi va yana bir Papa, antipap Klement VII ni saylashdi.

en: This split is called the Great Schism.
uz: Bu bo'linish Buyuk Shisma deb ataladi.

en: The Popes remained in Rome, and all the anti-French powers, the Emperor, the King of England, Hungary, Poland and the North of Europe were loyal to them.
uz: Rim Papalari Rimda qoldi va barcha fransuzlarga qarshi davlatlar, imperator, Angliya qiroli, Vengriya, Polsha va Yevropaning shimoli ularga sodiq edi.

en: The anti-Popes, on the other hand, continued in Avignon, and were supported by the King of France, his ally the King of Scotland, Spain, Portugal and various German princes.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, anti-paplar Avignonda davom etdi va Fransiya qiroli, uning ittifoqchisi Shotlandiya, Ispaniya, Portugaliya qiroli va turli nemis shahzodalari tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlandi.

en: Each Pope excommunicated and cursed the adherents of his rival (1378- 1417).
uz: Har bir Papa o'z raqibining tarafdorlarini (1378-1417) qat'iyatdan chiqarib, la'natladi.

en: Is it any wonder that presently all over Europe people began to think for themselves in matters of religion?
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda butun Yevropada odamlar din masalalarida o'zlari uchun o'ylay boshlagani ajablanarli emasmi?

en: The beginnings of the Franciscans and the Dominicans, which we have noted in the preceding chapters, were but two among many of the new forces that were arising in Christendom, either to hold or shatter the church as its own wisdom might decide.
uz: Fransiskanlar va Dominikanlarning boshlanishi, biz oldingi boblarda qayd etganimizdek, xristianlikda paydo bo'layotgan ko'plab yangi kuchlar orasida faqat ikkitasi edi, ya'ni cherkovni o'z donoligi hal qilishi mumkin bo'lganidek ushlab turish yoki parchalash uchun.

en: Those two orders the church did assimilate and use, though with a little violence in the case of the former.
uz: O'sha ikki buyruq cherkov tomonidan o'zlashtirildi va ishlatildi, garchi birinchisi holatida biroz zo'ravonlik bilan.

en: But other forces were more frankly disobedient and critical.
uz: Lekin boshqa kuchlar ochiqchasiga itoatsizroq va tanqidiyroq edi.

en: A century and a half later came Wycliffe (1320-1384).
uz: Bir yarim asr o'tgach, Uiklif paydo bo'ldi (1320-1384).

en: He was a learned Doctor at Oxford.
uz: U Oksfordda o'qimishli doktor edi.

en: Quite late in his life he began a series of outspoken criticisms of the corruption of the clergy and the unwisdom of the church.
uz: U hayoti davomida ruhoniylarning buzilishiga va cherkovning dono emasligiga nisbatan bir qator ochiq tanqidlarni boshladi.

en: He organized a number of poor priests, the Wyclifﬁtes, to spread his ideas throughout England; and in order that people should judge between the church and himself, he translated the Bible into English.
uz: U bir qator kambag'al ruhoniylarni, Uiklifilarni Angliya bo'ylab o'z g'oyalarini tarqatish uchun tashkillashtirdi; va odamlar cherkov va o'zi o'rtasida hukm qilishlari uchun u Injilni ingliz tiliga tarjima qildi.

en: He was a more learned and far abler man than either St.
uz: U avliyolardan ko'ra ko'proq bilimdon va ancha mohir inson edi.

en: He had supporters in high places and a great follow- ing among the people; and though Rome raged against him, and ordered his imprisonment, he died a free man.
uz: Uning yuqori lavozimlarda tarafdorlari bor edi va xalq orasida katta obro'ga ega edi; va garchi Rim unga qarshi g'azablanib, uni qamoqqa tashlashga buyurgan bo'lsa ham, u ozod odam sifatida o'ldi.

en: But the black and ancient spirit that was leading the Catholic Church to its destruction would not let his bones rest in the grave.
uz: Ammo katolik cherkovini uning vayron bo'lishiga olib borayotgan qora va qadimiy ruh uning suyaklarini qabrda qoldirmasdi.

en: By a decree of the Council of Constance in 1415, his remains were ordered to be dug up and burnt, an order which was carried out at the command of Pope Martin V by Bishop Fleming in 1428.
uz: Konstans Kengashining 1415-yildagi farmoni bilan uning qoldiqlari qazib olinishi va yoqib yuborilishi buyurildi, bu buyruq 1428-yilda Yepiskop Fleming tomonidan Rim Papasi Martin V qo'mondonligida amalga oshirildi.

en: This desecration was not the act of some isolated fanatic; it was the ofﬁcial act of the church.
uz: Bu tahqirlash birorta alohida fanatikning ishi emas edi; bu cherkovning rasmiy ishi edi.

en: XLVIII THE MONGOL CONQUESTS But in the thirteenth century, while this strange and ﬁnally ineffectual strug- gle to unify Christendom under the rule of the Pope was going on in Eu- rope, far more momentous events were afoot upon the larger stage of Asia.
uz: XLVIII MONGOL ISTIROKLARI Ammo o'n uchinchi asrda, Yevropada Rim Papasi hukmronligi ostida xristianlikni birlashtirish uchun g'alati va nihoyat samarasiz kurash ketayotgan paytda, Osiyoning kattaroq sahnasida ancha muhim voqealar sodir bo'lgan edi.

en: A Turkish people from the country to the north of China rose suddenly to prominence in the world’s affairs, and achieved such a series of conquests as has no parallel in history.
uz: Xitoyning shimolidagi mamlakatdan kelgan turk xalqi to'satdan dunyo ishlarida mashhurlikka erishdi va tarixda misli ko'rilmagan bir qator fathlarga erishdi.

en: These were the Mongols.
uz: Bular mo'g'ullar edi.

en: At the opening of the thirteenth century they were a horde of nomadic horsemen, living very much as their predecessors, the Huns, had done, subsisting chieﬂy upon meat and mare’s milk and living in tents of skin.
uz: O'n uchinchi asrning boshlarida ular ko'chmanchi chavandozlar to'dasi bo'lib, o'zlaridan oldingi xunnlar kabi yashashardi, asosan go'sht va ot sutidan oziqlanib, teri chodirlarda yashashardi.

en: They had shaken them- selves free from Chinese dominion, and brought a number of other Turkish tribes into a military confederacy.
uz: Ular ularni silkitib tashlashdi - Xitoy hukmronligidan ozod bo'lishdi va bir qator boshqa turk qabilalarini harbiy konfederatsiyaga olib kelishdi.

en: Their central camp was at Karakorum in Mongolia.
uz: Ularning markaziy lageri Moʻgʻulistondagi Karakorumda edi.

en: At this time China was in a state of division.
uz: Ayni paytda Xitoy bo'linish holatida edi.

en: The great dynasty of Tang had passed into decay by the tenth century, and after a phase of division into warring states, three main empires, that of Kin in the north with Pekin as its capital and that of Sung in the south with a capital at Nankin, and Hsia in the centre, remain.
uz: Tangning buyuk sulolasi o'ninchi asrga kelib parchalanishga uchradi va urushayotgan davlatlarga bo'linish bosqichidan so'ng, uchta asosiy imperiya qoldi: shimolda Pekin poytaxti bilan Kin, janubda esa Nankin poytaxti bilan Sung va markazda Hsia.

en: In 1214 Jengis Khan, the leader of the Mongol confeder- ates, made war on the Kin Empire and captured Pekin (1214).
uz: 1214-yilda Moʻgʻul ittifoqchilarining yetakchisi Jengis Xon Kin imperiyasiga qarshi urush qildi va Pekinni egalladi (1214).

en: He then turned westward and conquered Western Turkestan, Persia, Armenia, India down to Lahore, and South Russia as far as Kieff.
uz: Keyin u g'arbga burilib, G'arbiy Turkiston, Fors, Armaniston, Hindistonni Lahorgacha va Kiyevgacha bo'lgan Janubiy Rossiyani zabt etdi.

en: He died master of a vast empire that reached from the Paciﬁc to the Dnieper.
uz: U Tinch okeanidan Dneprgacha cho'zilgan ulkan imperiyaning xo'jayini edi.

en: His successor, Ogdai Khan, continued this astonishing career of con- quest.
uz: Uning vorisi Og'day Xon bu ajoyib zabt etish karerasini davom ettirdi.

en: His armies were organized to a very high level of efﬁciency; and they had with them a new Chinese invention, gunpowder, which they used in
uz: Uning armiyalari juda yuqori darajada samarali tashkil etilgan edi; va ular o'zlari bilan birga Xitoyning yangi ixtirosi, poroxni ham bor edilar, undan foydalanishardi.

en: He completed the conquest of the Kin Empire and then swept his hosts right across Asia to Russia (1235), an altogether amazing march.
uz: U Kin imperiyasini zabt etishni yakunladi va keyin o'z qo'shinlarini Osiyo bo'ylab Rossiyaga (1235) olib chiqdi, bu butunlay ajoyib yurish edi.

en: Kieff was destroyed in 1240, and nearly all Russia became tributary to the Mongols.
uz: Kiyev 1240-yilda yo'q qilindi va deyarli butun Rossiya mo'g'ullarga qo'shilib ketdi.

en: Poland was ravaged, and a mixed army of Poles and Ger- mans was annihilated at the battle of Liegnitz in Lower Silesia in 1241.
uz: Polsha vayron qilindi va 1241 yilda Quyi Sileziyadagi Liegnits jangida polshaliklar va nemislarning aralash armiyasi yo'q qilindi.

en: The Emperor Frederick II does not seem to have made any great efforts to stay the advancing tide.
uz: Imperator Frederik II oldinga siljishni to'xtatish uchun katta kuch sarflaganga o'xshamaydi.

en: “It is only recently,” says Bury in his notes to Gibbon’s Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire, “that European history has begun to understand that the successes of the Mongol army which overran Poland and occupied Hun- gary in the spring of A.D.
uz: Faqat yaqinda, deydi Bury Gibbonning Rim imperiyasining tanazzuli va qulashi haqidagi eslatmalarida, Yevropa tarixi milodiy bahorda Polshani bosib olgan va Hun-gariyani bosib olgan mo'g'ul armiyasining muvaffaqiyatlarini tushunishni boshladi.

en: 1241 were won by consummate strategy and were not due to a mere overwhelming superiority of numbers.
uz: 1241 ta yutuq mukammal strategiya bilan qozonildi va shunchaki sonlar ustunligi tufayli emas edi.

en: But this fact has not yet become a matter of common knowledge; the vulgar opinion which represents the Tartars as a wild horde carrying all before them solely by their multitude, and galloping through Eastern Europe without a strategic plan, rushing at all obstacles and overcoming them by mere weight, still prevails.
uz: Lekin bu fakt hali keng tarqalgan ma'lumot masalasiga aylanmagan; tatarlar o'zlarining ko'pchiligi bilan oldinda hamma narsani olib yuradigan va strategik rejalarsiz Sharqiy Yevropani aylanib o'tadigan, barcha to'siqlarga shoshilmaydigan va ularni shunchaki og'irlik bilan yengib o'tadigan yovvoyi suruv sifatida ifodalangan vulgar fikr hali ham hukmron.

en: “It was wonderful how punctually and effectually the arrangements were carried out in operations extending from the Lower Vistula to Transylvania.
uz: Quyi Vistuladan Transilvaniyagacha bo'lgan operatsiyalarda kelishuvlarning naqadar o'z vaqtida va samarali amalga oshirilgani ajoyib edi.

en: Such a campaign was quite beyond the power of any European army of the time, and it was beyond the vision of any European commander.
uz: Bunday kampaniya o'sha davrdagi har qanday Yevropa armiyasining qudratiga sig'mas edi va u har qanday Yevropa qo'mondonining tasavvuriga ham sig'mas edi.

en: There was no general in Europe, from Frederick II downward, who was not a tyro in strategy compared to Subutai.
uz: Yevropada, Fridrix II dan boshlab, Subutayga nisbatan strategiyada tiro bo'lmagan general yo'q edi.

en: It should also be noticed that the Mongols embarked upon the enterprise with full knowledge of the political situation of Hungary and the condition of Poland—they had taken care to inform themselves by a well-organized system of spies; on the other hand, the Hun- garians and the Christian powers, like childish barbarians, knew hardly any- thing about their enemies.” But though the Mongols were victorious at Liegnitz, they did not contin- ue their drive westward.
uz: Shuni ham e'tiborga olish kerakki, mo'g'ullar Vengriyaning siyosiy ahvoli va Polshaning ahvoli haqida to'liq bilgan holda ushbu korxonaga kirishdi  ular o'zlarini yaxshi tashkil etilgan josuslar tizimi orqali xabardor qilishga e'tibor berishdi; boshqa tomondan, xunn-gariylar va xristian davlatlari, bolalarcha vahshiylar kabi, o'z dushmanlari haqida deyarli hech narsa bilishmasdi.

en: They were getting into woodlands and hilly coun- try, which did not suit their tactics; and so they turned southward and pre- pared to settle in Hungary, massacring or assimilating the kindred Magyar, even as these had previously massacred and assimilated the mixed Scythi- ans and Avars and Huns before them.
uz: Ular o'rmonzorlarga va tepalik qishloqlarga kirib borayotgan edilar, bu ularning taktikalariga mos kelmas edi; shuning uchun ular janubga burilib, Vengriyada joylashishga tayyor bo'lishdi, qarindoshlar bo'lgan mag'arilarni qirib tashlashdi yoki o'zlashtirishdi, xuddi ular ilgari aralash skiflar, avarlar va hunlarni qirib, o'zlashtirishganidek.

en: From the Hungarian plain they would probably have made raids west and south as the Hungarians had done in the
uz: Vengriya tekisligidan ular, ehtimol, vengerlar qilganidek, g'arb va janubga hujumlar qilgan bo'lar edilar.

en: ninth century, the Avars in the seventh and eighth and the Huns in the ﬁfth.
uz: To'qqizinchi asrda, Avarlar yettinchi va sakkizinchi asrda va Xunlar beshinchi asrda.

en: But Ogdai died suddenly, and in 1242 there was trouble about the succes- sion, and recalled by this, the undefeated hosts of Mongols began to pour back across Hungary and Roumania towards the east.
uz: Ammo Og'day to'satdan vafot etdi va 1242-yilda vorislik haqida muammo yuzaga keldi va bu eslatib o'tilganda, mag'lub bo'lmagan mo'g'ul qo'shinlari Vengriya va Ruminiya bo'ylab sharqqa qaytib oqib kela boshladi.

en: Thereafter the Mongols concentrated their attention upon their Asiatic conquests.
uz: Shundan so'ng mo'g'ullar o'z e'tiborlarini Osiyo bosib olishlariga qaratdilar.

en: By the middle of the thirteenth century they had conquered the Sung Empire.
uz: O'n uchinchi asr o'rtalariga kelib, ular Sung imperiyasini zabt etishdi.

en: Mangu Khan succeeded Ogdai Khan as Great Khan in 1251, and made his brother Kublai Khan governor of China.
uz: Mangu Xon 1251-yilda Og'day Xonning o'rnini Buyuk Xon qilib egalladi va akasi Kublai Xonni Xitoyga gubernator qildi.

en: In 1280 Kublai Khan had been formally recognized Emperor of China, and so founded the Yuan dynasty which lasted until 1368.
uz: 1280-yilda Kublai Xon rasman Xitoy imperatori deb tan olindi va shu tariqa 1368-yilgacha davom etgan Yuan sulolasiga asos soldi.

en: While the last ruins of the Sung rule were going down in China, another brother of Mangu, Hulagu, was conquering Persia and Syria.
uz: Sung hukmronligining oxirgi xarobalari Xitoyda qulayotgan bir paytda, Mangu'ning yana bir akasi Hulagu Fors va Suriyani zabt etayotgan edi.

en: The Mongols displayed a bitter animosity to Islam at this time, and not only massacred the population of Bagdad when they captured that city, but set to work to destroy the immemorial irrigation system which had kept Mesopotamia incessantly prosperous and populous from the early days of Sumeria.
uz: Moʻgʻullar oʻsha paytda Islomga achchiq adovat koʻrsatishdi va nafaqat Bagʻdod aholisini oʻsha shaharni egallaganlarida qirib tashlashdi, balki Mesopotamiyani Shumerning ilk kunlaridan beri tinimsiz farovon va gavjum saqlab kelgan qadimiy sugʻorish tizimini yoʻq qilish uchun ishga tushishdi.

en: From that time until our own Mesopotamia has been a desert of ruins, sustaining only a scanty population.
uz: O'sha vaqtdan boshlab o'z Mesopotamiyamiz xarobalar cho'li bo'lib, faqat kam sonli aholi yashaydi.

en: Into Egypt the Mongols never penetrated; the Sultan of Egypt completely defeated an army of Hu- lagu’s in Palestine in 1260.
uz: Misrga moʻgʻullar hech qachon kirmagan; Misr sultoni 1260-yilda Falastindagi Hu-LAgularning armiyasini butunlay magʻlub etgan.

en: After that disaster the tide of Mongol victory ebbed.
uz: O'sha falokatdan so'ng mo'g'ul g'alabasining oqimi pasaydi.

en: The dominions of the Great Khan fell into a number of separate states.
uz: Buyuk Xon hukmronliklari bir qator alohida davlatlarga bo'lindi.

en: The eastern Mongols became Buddhists, like the Chinese; the western became Moslim.
uz: Sharqiy mo'g'ullar xitoyliklar kabi buddist bo'lishdi; g'arbiylar musulmon bo'lishdi.

en: The Chi- nese threw off the rule of the Yuan dynasty in 1368, and set up the native Ming dynasty which ﬂourished from 1368 to 1644.
uz: Chi-nos 1368-yilda Yuan sulolasining hukmronligini bekor qildi va 1368-yildan 1644-yilgacha gullab-yashnagan mahalliy Ming sulolasini tashkil etdi.

en: The Russians remained tributary to the Tartar hordes upon the south-east steppes until 1480, when the Grand Duke of Moscow repudiated his allegiance and laid the founda- tion of modern Russia.
uz: Ruslar 1480-yilgacha janubi-sharqiy dashtlardagi Tartar qo'shinlariga qarama-qarshi bo'lib qoldilar, shundan so'ng Moskva buyuk gersogi o'z sadoqatidan voz kechdi va zamonaviy Rossiyaning asosini qo'ydi.

en: TARTAR HORSEMEN  (From a Chinese Print in the British Museum) In the fourteenth century there was a brief revival of Mongol vigour un- der Timurlane, a descendant of Jengis Khan.
uz: TARTAR HORSEMEN (Britaniya muzeyidagi Xitoy nashridan) O'n to'rtinchi asrda Jengisxon avlodidan bo'lgan Temurlaning mo'g'ul kuchini qisqacha tiklash bo'lib o'tdi.

en: He established himself in Western Turkestan, assumed the title of Grand Khan in 1369, and con- quered from Syria to Delhi.
uz: U G'arbiy Turkistonda o'zini o'rnatdi, 1369-yilda Buyuk Xon unvonini o'z zimmasiga oldi va Suriyadan Dehliga sayohat qildi.

en: He was the most savage and destructive of all the Mongol conquerors.
uz: U barcha moʻgʻul bosqinchilarining eng vahshiysi va vayronkorisi edi.

en: He established an empire of desolation that did not survive his death.
uz: U o'limidan omon qolmagan vayronagarchilik imperiyasini yaratdi.

en: In 1505, however, a descendant of this Timur, an adven-
uz: 1505-yilda esa, bu Temurning avlodi, bir adven-

en: turer named Baber, got together an army with guns and swept down upon the plains of India.
uz: Baber ismli turer qurol-yarog'li armiyani to'pladi va Hindiston tekisliklariga bostirib kirdi.

en: His grandson Akbar (1556-1605) completed his con- quests, and this Mongol (or “Mogul” as the Arabs called it) dynasty ruled in Delhi over the greater part of India until the eighteenth century.
uz: Uning nabirasi Akbar (1556-1605) o'z izlanishlarini yakunladi va bu mo'g'ullar sulolasi (arablar uni mo'g'ullar deb atashgan) Dehlida Hindistonning katta qismi ustidan XVIII asrgacha hukmronlik qildi.

en: One of the consequences of the ﬁrst great sweep of Mongol conquest in the thirteenth century was to drive a certain tribe of Turks, the Ottoman Turks, out of Turkestan into Asia Minor.
uz: O'n uchinchi asrda mo'g'ullarning bosqinlarining birinchi katta siljishidan kelib chiqadigan oqibatlardan biri Turkistondan Turklar qabilasi bo'lgan Usmonli turklarni Kichik Osiyoga haydash edi.

en: They extended and consolidated their power in Asia Minor, crossed the Dardanelles and conquered Macedo- nia, Serbia and Bulgaria, until at last Constantinople remained like an island amongst the Ottoman dominions.
uz: Ular Kichik Osiyoda o'z kuchlarini kengaytirdilar va mustahkamladilar, Dardanel orollarini kesib o'tdilar va Makedoniya, Serbiya va Bolgariyani zabt etishdi, oxiri Konstantinopol Usmonli hukmronliklari orasida orol kabi qoldi.

en: In 1453 the Ottoman Sultan, Muhammad II, took Constantinople, attacking it from the European side with a great number of guns.
uz: 1453-yilda Usmonli Sultoni Muhammad II Konstantinopolni egalladi va Yevropa tomondan unga ko'plab qurollar bilan hujum qildi.

en: This event caused intense excitement in Europe and there was talk of a crusade, but the day of the crusades was past.
uz: Bu voqea Yevropada shiddatli hayajon uyg'otdi va xoch yurishi haqida gaplar bor edi, ammo xoch yurishlari kuni o'tib ketdi.

en: In the course of the sixteenth century the Ottoman Sultans conquered Bagdad, Hungary, Egypt and most of North Africa, and their ﬂeet made them masters of the Mediterranean.
uz: O'n oltinchi asr davomida Usmonli sultonlari Bag'dod, Vengriya, Misr va Shimoliy Afrikaning ko'p qismini zabt etishdi va ularning floti ularni O'rta yer dengizi xo'jayinlariga aylantirdi.

en: They very nearly took Vienna, and they exacted it tribute from the Emperor.
uz: Ular Vena deyarli egallab oldilar va imperatordan unga tribute talab qilishdi.

en: There were but two items to offset the general ebb of Christian dominion in the ﬁfteenth century.
uz: XV asrda xristian hukmronligining umumiy pasayishini qoplash uchun faqat ikkita narsa bor edi.

en: restoration of the independence of Moscow (1480); the other was the grad- ual reconquest of Spain by the Christians.
uz: Moskva mustaqilligini tiklash (1480); ikkinchisi Ispaniya xristianlar tomonidan bosqichma-bosqich qayta zabt etilishi edi.

en: In 1492, Granada, the last Moslem state in the peninsula, fell to King Ferdinand of Aragon and his Queen Isabella of Castile.
uz: 1492-yilda Granada, yarim oroldagi oxirgi musulmon davlati, Aragon qiroli Ferdinand va uning qirolichasi Izabella Kastiliyaga o'tdi.

en: But it was not until as late as 1571 that the naval battle of Lepanto broke the prick of the Ottomans, and restored the Mediterranean waters to Christ- ian ascendancy.
uz: Ammo Lepanto dengiz jangi Usmoniylarning tikanini sindirib, O'rta yer dengizi suvlarini Masih-Iyon ustunligiga qaytarishi 1571 yilgacha emas edi.

en: XLIX THE INTELLECTUAL REVIVAL OF THE EUROPEANS Throughout the twelfth century there were many signs that the European intelligence was recovering courage and leisure, and preparing to take up again the intellectual enterprises of the ﬁrst Greek scientiﬁc enquiries and such speculations as those of the Italian Lucretius.
uz: XLIX EUROPEYLARNING INTELLEKT UYG'ONLASHI O'n ikkinchi asr davomida Yevropa razvedkasi jasorat va dam olgani, shuningdek, birinchi yunon ilmiy tadqiqotlarining intellektual korxonalarini va italyan Lucretius kabi taxminlarni qayta qabul qilishga tayyorgarlik ko'rayotgani haqida ko'plab alomatlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: The causes of this re- vival were many and complex.
uz: Bu qayta tiklanishning sabablari ko'p va murakkab edi.

en: The suppression of private war, the higher standards of comfort and security that followed the crusades, and the stimu- lation of men’s minds by the experiences of these expeditions were no doubt necessary preliminary conditions.
uz: Xususiy urushning bostirilishi, sahna yurishlari ortidan kelgan qulaylik va xavfsizlikning yuqori standartlari va odamlarning ongini ushbu ekspeditsiyalar tajribalari bilan rag'batlantirish shubhasiz zaruriy dastlabki shartlar edi.

en: Trade was reviving; cities were re- covering ease and safety; the standard of education was arising in the church and spreading among laymen.
uz: Savdo jonlanayotgan edi; shaharlar qulaylik va xavfsizlikni qayta qoplayotgan edi; cherkovda ta'lim standarti paydo bo'lib, oddiy odamlar orasida tarqalayotgan edi.

en: The thirteenth and fourteenth cen- turies were a period of growing, independent or quasi-independent cities; Venice, Florence, Genoa, Lisbon, Paris, Bruges, London, Antwerp, Ham- burg, Nuremberg, Novgorod, Wisby and Bergen for example.
uz: O'n uchinchi va o'n to'rtinchi asrlar o'sish davri bo'lgan, mustaqil yoki deyarli mustaqil shaharlar; masalan, Venetsiya, Florensiya, Genuya, Lissabon, Parij, Brugge, London, Antverpen, Ham-burg, Nyurnberg, Novgorod, Visbi va Bergen.

en: They were all trading cities with many travellers, and where men trade and travel they talk and think.
uz: Ularning barchasi ko'plab sayohatchilarga ega savdo shaharlari edi va odamlar savdo qiladigan va sayohat qiladigan joyda gaplashadi va o'ylashadi.

en: The polemics of the Popes and princes, the conspicuous savagery and wickedness of the persecution of heretics, were exciting men to doubt the authority of the church and question and discuss fundamental things.
uz: Papalar va shahzodalarning bahslari, bid'atchilarning ta'qibining ko'zga tashlanadigan vahshiyligi va yovuzligi odamlarni cherkovning hokimiyatiga shubha ostiga qo'yishga, fundamental narsalarni shubha ostiga olishga va muhokama qilishga undardi.

en: We have seen how the Arabs were the means of restoring Aristotle to Eu- rope, and how such a prince as Frederick II acted as a channel through which Arabic philosophy and science played upon the renascent European mind.
uz: Biz arablar Aristotelni Yevropaga qaytarish vositasi bo'lganini va Frederik II kabi shahzoda qayta tiklanayotgan Yevropa ongiga arab falsafasi va fani o'ynaydigan kanal sifatida qanday ta'sir qilganini ko'rdik.

en: Still more inﬂuential in the stirring up of men’s ideas were the Jews.
uz: Odamlarning g'oyalarini qo'zg'atishda yahudiylar yanada nufuzli edi.

en: Their very existence was a note of interrogation to the claims of the church.
uz: Ularning mavjudligining o'zi cherkovning da'volariga nisbatan so'roq xabari edi.

en: And ﬁnally the secret, fascinating enquiries of the alchemists were spread-
uz: Va nihoyat, alkimyogarlarning sirli, qiziqarli surishtiruvlari tarqaldi.

en: ing far and wide and setting men to the petty, furtive and yet fruitful re- sumption of experimental science.
uz: Uzoq va keng va odamlarni eksperimental fanning mayda, yashirin va ammo samarali qayta qabul qilinishiga olib keladi.

en: And the stir in men’s minds was by no means conﬁned now to the inde- pendent and well educated.
uz: Va odamlarning ongidagi hayajon hozir hech qanday tarzda mustaqil va yaxshi o'qitilgan narsalar bilan cheklanmagan edi.

en: The mind of the common man was awake in the world as it had never been before in all the experience of mankind.
uz: Oddiy odamning ongi dunyoda insoniyat tajribasida hech qachon bo'lmaganidek uyg'oq edi.

en: In spite of priest and persecution, Christianity does seem to have carried a mental ferment wherever its teaching reached.
uz: Ruhoniylar va ta'qiblarga qaramay, xristianlik o'z ta'limoti qayerga yetib borsa, o'sha yerda aqliy fermentni olib yurgan ko'rinadi.

en: It established a direct relation be- tween the conscience of the individual man and the God of Righteousness, so that now if need arose he had the courage to form his own judgment upon prince or prelate or creed.
uz: Bu shaxsning vijdoni va Adolat Xudosi o'rtasida bevosita aloqa o'rnatdi, shunda endi zarurat tug'ilsa, u shahzoda yoki voliy yoki e'tiqodga nisbatan o'z hukmini shakllantirishga jur'at topgan.

en: As early as the eleventh century philosophical discussion had begun again in Europe, and there were great and growing universities at Paris, Ox- ford, Bologna and other centres.
uz: Yevropada falsafiy munozaralar o'n birinchi asrning o'zida yana boshlandi va Parij, Oks-Ford, Bolonya va boshqa markazlarda buyuk va o'sib borayotgan universitetlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: There medieval “schoolmen” took up again and thrashed out a series of questions upon the value and meaning of words that were a necessary preliminary to clear thinking in the scientiﬁc age that was to follow.
uz: U yerda o'rta asr maktab o'quvchilari yana bir bor so'zlarning qiymati va ma'nosi bo'yicha bir qator savollarni ilgari surdilar, bu savollar kelgusi ilmiy davrda aniq fikrlash uchun zarur bo'lgan dastlabki qadam edi.

en: And standing by himself because of his distinctive genius was Roger Bacon (circa 1210 to circa 1293), a Franciscan of Oxford, the father of modern experimental science.
uz: Va o'zining o'ziga xos daholigi tufayli o'zicha turgan Roger Bacon (taxminan 1210 dan taxminan 1293) edi, Oksford frantsikanasi, zamonaviy eksperimental fanning otasi.

en: His name deserves a prominence in our history second only to that of Aristotle.
uz: Uning ismi tariximizda faqat Aristoteldan keyingi o'ziga xoslikka loyiq.

en: His writings are one long tirade against ignorance.
uz: Uning asarlari jaholatga qarshi uzoq davom etgan bir tiradadir.

en: He told his age it was ignorant, an incredibly bold thing to do.
uz: U o'z yoshiga bu johillik ekanligini, juda jur'atli ish ekanligini aytdi.

en: Nowadays a man may tell the world it is as silly as it is solemn, that all its methods are still infantile and clumsy and its dogmas childish assumptions, without much physical dan- ger; but these peoples of the middle ages when they were not actually being massacred or starving or dying of pestilence, were passionately convinced of the wisdom, the completeness and ﬁnality of their beliefs, and disposed to resent any reﬂections upon them very bitterly.
uz: Hozirgi kunda odam dunyoga aytishi mumkinki, u qanchalik tantanali bo'lsa ham, bu ahmoqlikdir, uning barcha usullari hali ham bachkana va bema'ni, dogmalari esa bolalarcha taxminlar, ko'p jismoniy zararsiz; lekin o'rta asr xalqlari aslida qirg'in qilinmagan, och qolmagan yoki vabo bilan o'lmagan paytda, o'z e'tiqodlarining donoligi, to'liqligi va yakuniyligiga ishtiyoq bilan ishongan va ularga nisbatan har qanday mulohazalarni juda achchiq qabul qilishga moyil edilar.

en: Roger Bacon’s writings were like a ﬂash of light in a profound darkness.
uz: Rojer Bekonning asarlari chuqur zulmatdagi yorug'lik chaqnashiga o'xshardi.

en: He combined his attack upon the ignorance of his times with a wealth of suggestion for the increase of knowledge.
uz: U o'z davrining jaholatga qarshi hujumini bilimni oshirish uchun ko'plab takliflar bilan birlashtirdi.

en: In his passionate insistence upon the need of experiment and of collecting knowledge, the spirit of Aristotle lives again in him.
uz: Uning tajriba o'tkazish va bilim yig'ish zarurligiga bo'lgan ehtirosida, Arastuning ruhi yana u ichida yashaydi.

en: “Experi- ment, experiment,” that is the burthen of Roger Bacon.
uz: Tadqiqot, tajriba, tajriba, - bu Roger Bekonning og'irligi.

en: Yet of Aristotle himself Roger Bacon fell foul.
uz: Ammo Arastuning o'zi Rojer Bekon axloqsizlikka uchradi.

en: He fell foul of him be- cause men, instead of facing facts boldly, sat in rooms and pored over the bad Latin translations which were then all that was available of the master.
uz: U undan g'azablandi, chunki odamlar faktlarga jasorat bilan duch kelish o'rniga, xonalarda o'tirishdi va o'sha paytda ustozning hamma narsasi bo'lgan yomon lotincha tarjimalar ustidan o'tirishardi.

en: “If I had my way,” he wrote, in his intemperate fashion, “I should burn all the books of Aristotle, for the study of them can only lead to a loss of time, produce error, and increase ignorance,” a sentiment that Aristotle would probably have echoed could he have returned to a world in which his works were not so much read as worshipped—and that, as Roger Bacon showed, in these most abominable translations.
uz: Agar menda o'z yo'lim bo'lganida edi, deb yozdi u o'zining g'ayrioddiy uslubida, Men Aristotelning barcha kitoblarini yoqib yuborishim kerak edi, chunki ularni o'rganish faqat vaqt yo'qotishga, xatolarga olib kelishga va bilimsizlikni oshirishga olib keladi, bu fikrni Aristotel, ehtimol, u o'z asarlari unchalik o'qilmagan va sig'inilgan dunyoga qaytganida aks ettirgan bo'lardi va Roger Bacon ko'rsatganidek, bu eng jirkanch tarjimalarda.

en: AN EARLY PRINTING PRESS  (From an old print) Throughout his books, a little disguised by the necessity of seeming to square it all with orthodoxy for fear of the prison and worse, Roger Bacon shouted to mankind, “Cease to be ruled by dogmas and authorities; look at the world!” Four chief sources of ignorance he denounced; respect for au- thority, custom, the sense of the ignorant crowd, and the vain, proud un-
uz: DAVRLI BOSMALASH (Eski bosmadan) O'z kitoblari davomida, qamoqdan qo'rqib, ortodoksallik bilan to'g'rilash zaruriyati bilan biroz niqoblangan holda, Rojer Bekon insoniyatga Dogma va hokimiyat tomonidan hukmronlik qilishni to'xtating; dunyoga qarang! deb baqirdi. U jaholatning to'rtta asosiy manbasini qoraladi: aniqlikka hurmat, odat, bilimsiz olomonning tuyg'usi va behuda, mag'rur...

en: teachableness of our dispositions.
uz: Bizning moslashuvlarimizning o'rgatiladiganligi.

en: Overcome but these, and a world of pow- er would open to men: — “Machines for navigating are possible without rowers, so that great ships suited to river or ocean, guided by one man, may be borne with greater speed than if they were full of men.
uz: Faqatgina shularni yengib o'ting, va odamlarga qudrat dunyosi ochiladi:   Navigatsiya mashinalari g'ildiraksiz bo'lishi mumkin, shunda daryo yoki okeanga mos keladigan, bitta odam boshqaradigan katta kemalar, agar ular odamlarga to'la bo'lsa, undan ko'ra tezroq yuklanishi mumkin.

en: Likewise cars may be made so that without a draught animal they may be moved cum impetu inœstimable, as we deem the scythed chariots to have been from which antiquity fought.
uz: Xuddi shunday, mashinalar shunday yasalishi mumkinki, ular hayvondan tashqari harakatlanishi mumkin, chunki bu harakatni sezish mumkin emas, chunki biz o'tkir aravalarni qadimgi zamonlar jang qilgan deb hisoblaymiz.

en: And ﬂying machines are possible, so that a man may sit in the middle turn- ing some device by which artiﬁcial wings may beat the air in the manner of a ﬂying bird.” So Roger Bacon wrote, but three more centuries were to elapse before men began any systematic attempts to explore the hidden stores of power and interest he realized so clearly existed beneath the dull surface of human affairs.
uz: Uchuvchi mashinalar ham mumkin, shunda odam o'rtada o'tirishi mumkin  sun'iy qanotlar orqali uchuvchi qush kabi havoni urishi mumkin bo'lgan qandaydir qurilmada. Shunday qilib, Rojer Bekon yozgan edi, lekin odamlar inson ishlarining xira yuzasida mavjudligini aniq anglaganidan oldin, kuch va qiziqishning yashirin do'konlarini o'rganishga qaratilgan har qanday tizimli urinishlarni boshlashdan yana uch asr o'tib ketadi.

en: But the Saracenic world not only gave Christendom the stimulus of its philosophers and alchemists; it also gave it paper.
uz: Lekin Saracen dunyosi nafaqat xristianlikka o'z faylasuflari va alkimyogarlarining rag'batini berdi, balki unga qog'oz ham berdi.

en: It is scarcely too much to say that paper made the intellectual revival of Europe possible.
uz: Qog'oz Yevropaning intellektual uyg'onishini imkon berdi, deyish deyarli haddan tashqari ko'p emas.

en: Paper origi- nated in China, where its use probably goes back to the second century B.C.
uz: Qog'oz Xitoyda paydo bo'lgan, u yerda uning ishlatilishi miloddan avvalgi ikkinchi asrga borib taqaladi.

en: In 751 the Chinese made an attack upon the Arab Moslems in Samarkand; they were repulsed, and among the prisoners taken from them were some skilled papermakers, from whom the art was learnt.
uz: 751-yilda xitoyliklar Samarqandda arab musulmonlariga hujum qilishdi; ular qaytarildi va ulardan olib ketilgan asirlar orasida ba'zi mohir qog'oz yasovchilar bor edi, ulardan san'at o'rganildi.

en: Arabic paper manu- scripts from the ninth century onward still exist.
uz: To'qqizinchi asrdan boshlab arab qog'ozi qo'lyozmalari hanuzgacha mavjud.

en: The manufacture entered Christendom either through Greece or by the capture of Moorish paper- mills during the Christian reconquest of Spain.
uz: Ishlab chiqarish Xristianlikka Gretsiya orqali yoki Ispaniya xristianlar tomonidan qayta zabt etilgan davrda moʻri qogʻoz tegirmonlarini egallash orqali kirdi.

en: But under the Christian Spanish the product deteriorated sadly.
uz: Ammo xristian ispanlar davrida mahsulot achinarli darajada yomonlashdi.

en: Good paper was not made in Christ- ian Europe until the end of the thirteenth century, and then it was Italy which led the world.
uz: Yaxshi qog'oz Iso Masihning Yevropasida o'n uchinchi asr oxirigacha yaratilmadi va keyin aynan Italiya dunyoga boshchilik qildi.

en: Only by the fourteenth century did the manufacture reach Germany, and not until the end of that century was it abundant and cheap enough for the printing of books to be a practicable business proposi- tion.
uz: Faqatgina o'n to'rtinchi asrga kelib ishlab chiqarish Germaniyaga yetib bordi va o'sha asr oxirigacha kitoblarni chop etish amaliy biznes taklif bo'lishi uchun mo'l va arzon edi.

en: Thereupon printing followed naturally and necessarily, for printing is the most obvious of inventions, and the intellectual life of the world entered upon a new and far more vigorous phase.
uz: Shundan so'ng bosma nashr tabiiy va zaruratli ravishda davom etdi, chunki bosma nashr ixtirolarning eng yaqqolidir va dunyoning intellektual hayoti yangi va ancha kuchliroq bosqichga kirdi.

en: It ceased to be a little trickle from mind to mind; it became a broad ﬂood, in which thousands and presently scores and hundreds of thousands of minds participated.
uz: U ongdan ongga biroz oqishni to'xtatdi; u keng suv toshqiniga aylandi, unda minglab va hozirda o'nlab va yuz minglab onglar ishtirok etdi.

en: One immediate result of this achievement of printing was the appearance of an abundance of Bibles in the world.
uz: Ushbu chop etish yutuqlarining birdan-bir natijalaridan biri dunyoga Injillarning mo'l-ko'l paydo bo'lishi edi.

en: Another was a cheapening of school-books.
uz: Yana biri maktab kitoblarining arzonlashtirilishi edi.

en: The knowledge of reading spread swiftly.
uz: O'qish bilimlari tez tarqaldi.

en: There was not only a great increase of books in the world, but the books that were now made were plainer to read and so easier to understand.
uz: Dunyoda kitoblar nafaqat katta ko'paydi, balki hozir tayyorlangan kitoblar ham o'qish uchun osonroq va tushunish osonroq edi.

en: Instead of toiling at a crabbed text arid then thinking over its signiﬁcance, readers now could think unimpeded as they read.
uz: Qisqichbaqasimon quruq matnga mehnat qilish o'rniga, uning ahamiyati haqida o'ylash o'rniga, o'quvchilar endi o'qiyotganda to'siqsiz fikrlashlari mumkin edi.

en: With this increase in the facility of reading, the reading public grew.
uz: O'qish qulayligining oshishi bilan o'quvchilarning soni o'sdi.

en: The book ceased to be a highly decorated toy or a scholar’s mystery.
uz: Kitob yuqori darajada bezatilgan o'yinchoq yoki olim sir bo'lishdan to'xtadi.

en: People began to write books to be read as well as looked at by ordinary people.
uz: Odamlar oddiy odamlar tomonidan o'qilishi va ko'rilishi uchun kitoblar yozishni boshladilar.

en: They wrote in the ordinary language and not in Latin.
uz: Ular oddiy tilda yozishardi, lotin tilida emas.

en: With the fourteenth century the real history of the European literature begins.
uz: O'n to'rtinchi asr bilan Yevropa adabiyotining haqiqiy tarixi boshlanadi.

en: So far we have been dealing only with the Saracenic share in the Eu- ropean revival.
uz: Hozirgacha biz faqatgina Saratseniylarning Yevropa tiklanishidagi ulushi bilan shug'ullanib kelmoqdamiz.

en: Let us turn now to the inﬂuence of the Mongol conquests.
uz: Keling, endi mo'g'ul bosqinlarining ta'siriga murojaat qilaylik.

en: They stimulated the geographical imagination of Europe enormously.
uz: Ular Yevropaning geografik tasavvurini juda katta darajada rag'batlantirdilar.

en: For a time under the Great Khan, all Asia and Western Europe enjoyed an open intercourse; all the roads were temporarily open, and representatives of every nation appeared at the court of Karakorum.
uz: Buyuk Xon davrida butun Osiyo va G'arbiy Yevropa ochiq muloqotdan bahramand bo'ldi; barcha yo'llar vaqtincha ochiq edi va Karakorum saroyida har bir millat vakillari paydo bo'ldi.

en: The barriers between Eu- rope and Asia set up by the religious feud of Christianity and Islam were lowered.
uz: Yevropa va Osiyo o'rtasidagi to'siqlar xristianlik va Islom diniy ziddiyatlari natijasida kamaytirildi.

en: Great hopes were entertained by the papacy for the conversion of the Mongols to Christianity.
uz: Papalik tomonidan moʻgʻullarning xristianlikka oʻtishiga katta umidlar uygʻonilgan edi.

en: Their only religion so far had been Shuman- ism, a primitive paganism.
uz: Ularning yagona dini shu paytgacha Shuman ismidan iborat edi, bu ibtidoiy butparastlik edi.

en: Envoys of the Pope, Buddhist priests from India, Parisian and Italian and Chinese artiﬁcers, Byzantine and Armenian mer- chants, mingled with Arab ofﬁcials and Persian and Indian astronomers and mathematicians at the Mongol court.
uz: Rim Papasining elchilari, Hindistondan kelgan buddist ruhoniylar, Parijlik va italyan va xitoylik hunarmandlar, Vizantiya va arman qo'shiqlari, arab rasmiylari, mo'g'ul saroyida fors va hind astronomlari va matematiklari bilan aralashgan.

en: We hear too much in history of the campaigns and massacres of the Mongols, and not enough of their curiosity and desire for learning.
uz: Moʻgʻullarning yurishlari va qirgʻinlari haqida tarixda juda koʻp eshitamiz, ularning qiziquvchanligi va oʻrganishga boʻlgan ishtiyoqi yetarli emas.

en: Not perhaps as an originative people, but as trans- mitters of knowledge and method their inﬂuence upon the world’s history has been very great.
uz: Balki kelib chiqishli xalq sifatida emas, balki bilim va usullarning o'tish vositalari sifatida ularning dunyo tarixiga ta'siri juda katta bo'lgan.

en: And everything one can learn of the vague and roman- tic personalities of Jengis or Kublai tends to conﬁrm the impression that these men were at least as understanding and creative monarchs as either that ﬂamboyant but egotistical ﬁgure Alexander the Great or that raiser of political ghosts, that energetic but illiterate theologian Charlemagne.
uz: Va Jengis yoki Kublayning noaniq va roman-tik shaxsiyatlari haqida bilib olish mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsa, bu odamlar hech bo'lmaganda o'sha dabdabali, ammo xudbin shaxs Aleksandr Buyuk yoki siyosiy arvohlarni tarbiyalovchi, faol, ammo savodsiz teolog Karl kabi tushunarli va ijodkor monarxlar degan taassurotni tasdiqlashga moyil.

en: One of the most interesting of these visitors to the Mongol Court was a certain Venetian, Marco Polo, who afterwards set down his story in a book.
uz: Moʻgʻul saroyiga tashrif buyuruvchilarning eng qiziqarlilaridan biri Venetsiyalik Marco Polo edi, u keyinchalik oʻz hikoyasini kitobga yozgan.

en: He went to China about 1272 with his father and uncle, who had already
uz: U taxminan 1272 yilda otasi va amakisi bilan Xitoyga bordi, ular allaqachon...

en: once made the journey.
uz: Bir safar sayohat qildi.

en: The Great Khan had been deeply impressed by the elder Polos; they were the ﬁrst men of the “Latin” peoples he had seen; and he sent them back with enquiries for teachers and learned men who could explain Christianity to him, and for various other European things that had aroused his curiosity.
uz: Buyuk Xon katta Polosdan chuqur ta'sirlangan edi; ular u ko'rgan Lotin xalqlarining birinchi odamlari edi; va u ularni xristianlikni unga tushuntira oladigan o'qituvchilar va olimlar, shuningdek, uning qiziqishini uyg'otgan boshqa turli Yevropa narsalari haqida so'rovlar bilan qaytarib yuborgan edi.

en: Their visit with Marco was their second visit.
uz: Ularning Marco bilan bo'lgan tashrifi ularning ikkinchi tashrifi edi.

en: ANCIENT BRONZE FIGURE FROM BENIN, W.
uz: BENIN, V. dan kelgan qadimgi bronzadan yasalgan siymo.

en: AFRICA  Note evidence in attire of knowledge of early European explorers  (In the British Museum) The three Polos started by way of Palestine and not by the Crimea, as in their previous expedition.
uz: Afrika Ilk Yevropalik tadqiqotchilarning (Britaniya muzeyida) bilimlariga oid dalillarni eslang. Uchta Polos avvalgi ekspeditsiyadagidek Qrimdan emas, balki Falastin yo'li bilan boshlangan.

en: They had with them a gold tablet and other indi- cations from the Great Khan that must have greatly facilitated their journey.
uz: Ularning yonida Oltin lavha va Buyuk Xonning boshqa ma'lumotlari bor edi, bu ularning sayohatini sezilarli darajada osonlashtirgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: The Great Khan had asked for some oil from the lamp that burns in the Holy Sepulchre at Jerusalem; and so thither they ﬁrst went, and then by way of Cilicia into Armenia.
uz: Buyuk Xon Quddusdagi Muqaddas Qabrda yonadigan chiroqdan yog' so'ragan edi; va shuning uchun ular avval u yerga borishdi, keyin Kilikziya orqali Armanistonga.

en: They went thus far north because the Sultan of Egypt was raiding the Mongol domains at this time.
uz: Ular shu paytgacha shimolga ketishdi, chunki Misr sultoni Mo'g'ullar hududlariga bostirib kirayotgan edi.

en: Thence they came by way of Mesopotamia to Ormuz on the Persian Gulf, as if they contemplated a sea voyage.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular Mesopotamiyadan Fors qo'ltig'idagi Ormuzga kelishdi, go'yo dengiz safarini o'ylagandek.

en: At Ormuz they met merchants from India.
uz: Ormuzda ular Hindistondan kelgan savdogarlar bilan uchrashdilar.

en: For some reason they did not take ship, but instead turned northward through the Persian deserts, and so by way of Balkh over the Pamir to Kashgar, and by way of
uz: Qandaydir sababga ko'ra ular kemaga o'tirmadilar, aksincha, Fors cho'llaridan shimolga burilib, Balx orqali Pamir orqali Qashqarga va...

en: Kotan and the Lob Nor into the Hwang-ho valley and on to Pekin.
uz: Kotan va Lob Nor Hwang-ho vodiysiga va keyin Pekin tomon.

en: At Pekin was the Great Khan, and they were hospitably entertained.
uz: Pekinda Buyuk Xon bor edi va ular mehmondo'stona qabul qilingan edi.

en: ANOTHER ANCIENT NEGRO BRONZE OF A EUROPEAN  (In the British Museum) Marco particularly pleased Kublai; he was young and clever, and it is clear he had mastered the Tartar language very thoroughly.
uz: BRITANIYA MUZYASIDAGI YEROPOYANING BOSHQA QADIMIY NEGRO BRONZASI Marco Kublaiga ayniqsa yoqdi; u yosh va aqlli edi va u Tartar tilini juda yaxshi o'zlashtirgani aniq edi.

en: He was given an ofﬁcial position and sent on several missions, chieﬂy in south-west China.
uz: Unga rasmiy lavozim berildi va bir nechta missiyalarga, asosan, Xitoyning janubi-g'arbiy qismida yuborildi.

en: The tale he had to tell of vast stretches of smiling and prosperous country, “all the way excellent hostelries for travellers,” and “ﬁne vineyards, ﬁelds, and gardens,” of “many abbeys” of Buddhist monks, of manufactures of “cloth of silk and gold and many ﬁne taffetas,” a “constant succession of cities and boroughs,” and so on, ﬁrst roused the incredulity and then ﬁred the imagination of all Europe.
uz: U keng masxaraboz va farovon yurtlar, hammasi sayohatchilar uchun ajoyib xostellar, yaxshi tokzorlar, dalalar va boglar, buddist rohiblarining koplab abbatlari,  ipak va oltin va koplab nozik tafetalari ishlab chiqarish, shaharlar va tumanlarning doimiy ketma-ketligi va hokazo haqidagi ertakni aytib berishi kerak edi, avval ishonchsizlikni uygotdi va keyin butun Yevropaning xayolini ochirdi.

en: He told of Burmah, and of its great armies with hundreds of elephants, and how these animals were defeated by the Mongol bowmen, and also of the Mongol conquest of Pegu.
uz: U Burma haqida, uning yuzlab fillar bilan ulkan qo'shinlari haqida va bu hayvonlar qanday qilib mo'g'ul kamonchilari tomonidan mag'lub etilganini, shuningdek, Pegu shahrini mo'g'ullar bosib olgani haqida gapirdi.

en: He told of Japan, and greatly exaggerated the amount of gold in that country.
uz: U Yaponiya haqida gapirdi va o'sha mamlakatdagi oltin miqdorini juda katta darajada oshirib ko'rsatdi.

en: For three years Marco ruled the city of Yang-chow as governor, and he probably im- pressed the Chinese inhabitants as being little more of a foreigner than any Tartar would have been.
uz: Uch yil davomida Marko Yang-chow shahrini gubernator sifatida boshqardi va u, ehtimol, Xitoy aholisini har qanday Tartardan ko'ra kamroq begona deb bosim o'tkazdi.

en: He may also have been sent on a mission to India.
uz: U Hindistonga missiyaga yuborilgan bo'lishi ham mumkin.

en: Chinese records mention a certain Polo attached to the imperial council in 1277, a very valuable conﬁrmation of the general truth of the Polo story.
uz: Xitoy yozuvlarida 1277-yilda imperatorlar kengashiga biriktirilgan ma'lum bir Polo haqida so'z boradi, bu Polo hikoyasining umumiy haqiqatini juda qimmatli tasdiqlaydi.

en: The publication of Marco Polo’s travels produced a profound effect upon the European imagination.
uz: Marko Polo sayohatlarining nashr etilishi Yevropa tasavvuriga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: The European literature, and especially the Eu- ropean romance of the ﬁfteenth century, echoes with the names in Marco Polo’s story, with Cathay (North China) and Cambulac (Pekin) and the like.
uz: Yevropa adabiyoti, ayniqsa XV asrning Yevropa romantikasi, Marko Polo hikoyasidagi nomlar, Katay (Shimoliy Xitoy) va Kambulak (Bekin) va shunga o'xshashlar bilan uyg'unlashadi.

en: EARLY ITALIAN ENGRAVING OF A SAILING SHIP  (In the British Museum) Two centuries later, among the readers of the Travels of Marco Polo was a certain Genoese mariner, Christopher Columbus, who conceived the bril- liant idea of sailing westward round the world to China.
uz: BRITANIYA MUSEUMIDA SAYOHLAR KEMISHINING DAVRIY ITALIYALIK QURILISHI Ikki asr o'tgach, Marko Polo Sayohatlari o'quvchilari orasida Genuyalik dengizchi Xristofor Kolumb bor edi, u dunyo bo'ylab G'arb bo'ylab Xitoyga suzib borish haqidagi yorqin g'oyani o'ylab topgan edi.

en: In Seville there is a copy of the Travels with marginal notes by Columbus.
uz: Sevilyada Kolumbning marginal qaydlari bilan Sayohatlar nusxasi bor.

en: There were many reasons why the thought of a Genoese should be turned in this direction.
uz: Genualik fikrini shu tomonga burish kerakligining ko'plab sabablari bor edi.

en: Until its capture by the Turks in 1453 Constantinople had been an impartial trading mart between the Western world and the East, and the Genoese had traded there freely.
uz: 1453-yilda Konstantinopol turklar tomonidan qo'lga kiritilgunga qadar G'arbiy dunyo va Sharq o'rtasida xolis savdo maydoni bo'lgan va Genualiklar u yerda erkin savdo qilgan.

en: But the “Latin” Venetians, the bitter rivals of the Ge- noese, had been the allies and helpers of the Turks against the Greeks, and with the coming of the Turks Constantinople turned an unfriendly face upon Genoese trade.
uz: Lekin Lotin venetsiyaliklar, Ge-noyeslarning achchiq raqiblari, turklarning yunonlarga qarshi ittifoqchilari va yordamchilari bo'lgan va turklar kelishi bilan Konstantinopol Genua savdosiga dushmanona yuz soldi.

en: The long forgotten discovery that the world was round had gradually resumed its sway over men’s minds.
uz: Dunyo dumaloq ekanligi haqidagi uzoq vaqtdan beri unutilgan kashfiyot asta-sekin odamlarning ongida o'z hukmronligini tikladi.

en: The idea of going westward to China was therefore a fairly obvious one.
uz: G'arbga, Xitoyga borish g'oyasi shuning uchun ham ancha ravshan edi.

en: It was encouraged by two things.
uz: Uni ikki narsa rag'batlantirdi.

en: The mariner’s compass had now been invented and men were no longer left to the mercy of a ﬁne night and the stars to determine the direc- tion in which they were sailing, and the Normans, Catalonians and Genoese and Portuguese had already pushed out into the Atlantic as far as the Canary Isles, Madeira and the Azores.
uz: Dengizchining kompassi endi o'ylab topilgan edi va odamlar endi mayin tun va yulduzlarning yo'nalishini aniqlash uchun qo'l ostida qolishmadi, normanlar, kataloniyaliklar, genovaliklar va portugallar allaqachon Kanar orollari, Madeira va Azor orollarigacha Atlantikaga itarib yuborishgan edi.

en: Yet Columbus found many difﬁculties before he could get ships to put his idea to the test.
uz: Ammo Kolumb o'z g'oyasini sinovdan o'tkazish uchun kemalarga ega bo'lishidan oldin ko'plab qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi.

en: He went from one European Court to another.
uz: U bir Yevropa sudidan boshqasiga o'tdi.

en: Finally at Granada, just won from the Moors, he secured the patronage of Ferdinand and Isabella, and was able to set out across the unknown ocean in three small ships.
uz: Nihoyat, Granadada, hozirgina Moorlardan g'alaba qozongan holda, u Ferdinand va Izabelaning homiyligini ta'minladi va uchta kichik kemada noma'lum okeandan o'tib ketishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: After a voyage of two months and nine days he came to a land which he believed to be India, but which was really a new continent, whose distinct existence the old world had never hitherto suspected.
uz: Ikki oylik va to'qqiz kunlik sayohatdan so'ng u Hindiston deb hisoblagan, ammo aslida yangi qit'a bo'lgan, qadimgi dunyo hech qachon shubhalanmagan o'ziga xos mavjudligiga keldi.

en: He returned to Spain with gold, cotton, strange beasts and birds, and two wild- eyed paint- ed Indians to be baptized.
uz: U Ispaniyaga oltin, paxta, g'alati hayvonlar va qushlar, shuningdek, suvga cho'mdirish uchun ikki yovvoyi ko'zli bo'yalgan hind bilan qaytdi.

en: They were called Indians because, to the end of his days, he believed that this land he had found was India.
uz: Ularni hindlar deb atashardi, chunki u o'z hayotining oxirigacha topgan bu yer Hindiston deb hisoblardi.

en: Only in the course of several years did men begin to realize that the whole new conti- nent of America was added to the world’s resources.
uz: Faqat bir necha yil o'tgach, odamlar butun Amerika yangi kontinenti dunyo resurslariga qo'shilganini anglay boshladilar.

en: The success of Columbus stimulated overseas enterprise enormously.
uz: Kolumbning muvaffaqiyati xorijiy korxonalarni juda ham rag'batlantirdi.

en: In 1497 the Portuguese sailed round Africa to India, and in 1515 there were Portuguese ships in Java.
uz: 1497-yilda portugallar Afrika bo'ylab Hindistonga suzib borishdi, 1515-yilda esa Javada portugal kemalari bor edi.

en: In 1519 Magellan, a Portuguese sailor in Spanish employment, sailed out of Seville westward with ﬁve ships, of which one, the Vittoria, came back up the river to Seville in 1522, the ﬁrst ship that had ever circumnavigated the world.
uz: 1519-yilda Ispaniyalik ish bilan shug'ullanuvchi portugallik dengizchi Magellan Sevilyadan besh kemasi bilan g'arbga suzib chiqdi, ulardan biri, Vittoria, 1522-yilda Sevilyaga qaytib keldi, bu dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilgan birinchi kema edi.

en: Thirty-one men were aboard her, survivors of two-hundred-and- eighty who had started.
uz: Uning bortida o'ttiz bir kishi bor edi, boshlagan ikki yuz sakson kishining omon qolganlari.

en: Magellan himself had been killed in the Philippine Isles.
uz: Magellanning o'zi Filippin orollarida o'ldirilgan edi.

en: Printed paper books, a new realization of the round world as a thing alto- gether attainable, a new vision of strange lands, strange animals and plants, strange manners and customs, discoveries overseas and in the skies and in the ways and materials of life burst upon the European mind.
uz: Bosma qog'oz kitoblar, dumaloq dunyoni yuqori darajadagi narsa sifatida yangi anglash, g'alati yerlar, g'alati hayvonlar va o'simliklar, g'alati odoblar va urf-odatlar, chet el va osmonlardagi kashfiyotlar va hayot yo'llari va materiallari Yevropa ongiga portladi.

en: The Greek classics, buried and forgotten for so long, were speedily being printed and studied, and were colouring men’s thoughts with the dreams of Plato and the traditions of an age of republican freedom and dignity.
uz: Yunon klassikasi, shunchalik uzoq vaqt davomida ko'milgan va unutilgan, tezda chop etilib, o'rganilib borardi va odamlarning fikrlarini Aflotun orzulari va respublika erkinligi va qadr-qimmatining an'analari bilan bo'yashardi.

en: The Roman do- minion had ﬁrst brought law and order to Western Europe, and the Latin Church had restored it; but under both Pagan and Catholic Rome curiosity and innovation were subordinate to and restrained by organization.
uz: Rim do-minioni birinchi navbatda G'arbiy Yevropaga qonun va tartibni olib kelgan edi, lotin cherkovi esa uni tiklagan edi; lekin butparast va katolik Rim ostida qiziquvchanlik va innovatsiya tashkilotga bo'ysunardi va cheklangan edi.

en: The reign of the Latin mind was now drawing to an end.
uz: Lotin ongining hukmronligi endi yakunlanayotgan edi.

en: Between the thirteenth and the sixteenth century the European Aryans, thanks to the stimulating inﬂuence of Semite and Mongol and the rediscovery of the Greek classics, broke away from the Latin tradition and rose again to the intellectual and material leadership of mankind.
uz: O'n uchinchi va o'n oltinchi asrlar oralig'ida Yevropaoriylari Semit va Mo'g'ullarning rag'batlantiruvchi ta'siri va yunon klassikasining qayta kashf etilishi tufayli lotin an'anasidan ajralib chiqib, insoniyatning intellektual va moddiy yetakchiligiga qayta ko'tarildi.

en: L THE REFORMATION OF THE LATIN CHURCH The Latin Church itself was enormously affected by this mental rebirth.
uz: LOTIN CHIRCHASINING ISLOHLANISHI Lotin cherkovining o'zi bu aqliy qayta tug'ilishdan juda katta ta'sir ko'rdi.

en: It was dismembered; and even the portion that survived was extensively renewed.
uz: U bo'laklarga bo'lingan edi; va hatto omon qolgan qismi ham keng ko'lamli ravishda yangilandi.

en: We have told how nearly the church came to the autocratic leadership of all Christendom in the eleventh and twelfth centuries, and how in the four- teenth and ﬁfteenth its power over men’s minds and affairs declined.
uz: Biz cherkovning o'n birinchi va o'n ikkinchi asrlarda butun xristianlikning avtokratik yetakchiligiga yaqinlashgani, to'rtinchi va o'n beshinchi asrlarda uning odamlarning aqli va ishlari ustidan hokimiyati qanday pasayganini aytib berdik.

en: We have described how popular religious enthusiasm which had in earlier ages been its support and power was turned against it by its pride, persecutions and centralization, and how the insidious scepticism of Frederick II bore fruit in a growing insubordination of the princes.
uz: Biz avvalgi davrlarda uning tayanchi va hokimiyati bo'lgan ommaviy diniy ishtiyoqning o'z mag'rurligi, ta'qiblari va markazlashuvi bilan unga qanday qarama-qarshi yo'naltirilganini, shuningdek, Frederik II ning yashirin skeptisizmining shahzodalarning tobora kuchayib borayotgan itoatsizligiga qanday meva berishini tasvirladik.

en: The Great Schism had re- duced its religious and political prestige to negligible proportions.
uz: Buyuk Shisma o'zining diniy va siyosiy obro'sini ahamiyatsiz o'lchamlarga qaytargan edi.

en: The forces of insurrection struck it now from both sides.
uz: Qo'zg'olon kuchlari endi unga ikki tomondan zarba berdi.

en: The teachings of the Englishman Wycliffe spread widely throughout Eu- rope.
uz: Ingliz Uiklifning ta'limotlari butun Yevropa bo'ylab keng tarqaldi.

en: In 1398 a learned Czech, John Huss, delivered a series of lectures upon Wycliffe’s teachings in the university of Prague.
uz: 1398-yilda bilimdon chex janoblari Jon Huss Pragadagi universitetda Uiklifning ta'limotlari bo'yicha bir qator ma'ruzalar o'qidi.

en: This teaching spread rapidly beyond the educated class and aroused great popular enthusiasm.
uz: Bu ta'limot o'qimishli sinfdan tashqari tez sur'atlar bilan tarqaldi va katta xalq ishtiyoqini uyg'otdi.

en: In 1414-18 a Council of the whole church was held at Constance to settle the Great Schism.
uz: 1414-18 yillarda Konsantanda Buyuk Shismani hal qilish uchun butun cherkov Kengashi bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Huss was invited to this Council under promise of a safe conduct from the emperor, seized, put on trial for heresy and burnt alive (1415).
uz: Huss imperator tomonidan xavfsiz xulq-atvor va'dasi ostida ushbu Kengashga taklif qilindi, hibsga olindi, bid'at uchun sudga berildi va tiriklayin yoqib yuborildi (1415).

en: So far from tranquillizing the Bohemian people, this led to an insur- rection of the Hussites in that country, the ﬁrst of a series of religious wars that inaugurated the break-up of Latin Christendom.
uz: Bu Boheya xalqini tinchlantirishdan yiroq bo'lsa-da, bu o'sha mamlakatda husitlarning sug'urtasiga olib keldi, bu Lotin xristianligining parchalanishiga sabab bo'lgan bir qator diniy urushlarning birinchisidir.

en: Against this insurrec-
uz: Bu qo'zg'olishga qarshi...

en: tion Pope Martin V, the Pope specially elected at Constance as the head of a reunited Christendom, preached a Crusade.
uz: Rim Papasi Martin V, Konstantda qayta birlashgan xristianlikning rahbari sifatida maxsus saylangan Papa, Xoch yurishini va'z qildi.

en: Five Crusades in all were launched upon this sturdy little people and all of them failed.
