uz: Ushbu mustahkam kichik odamlarga qarshi jami beshta Xoch yurishi boshlandi va ularning barchasi muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

en: All the unemployed rufﬁanism of Europe was turned upon Bohemia in the ﬁfteenth century, just as in the thirteenth it had been turned upon the Waldenses.
uz: Yevropaning barcha ishsiz rufianligi XV asrda Boheyaga qaratilgan edi, xuddi o'n uchinchi asrda valdenlarga qaratilganidek.

en: But the Bohemian Czechs, unlike the Waldenses, be- lieved in armed resistance.
uz: Lekin Boheya chexlari, valdenlardan farqli o'laroq, qurolli qarshilik ko'rsatishga tayyor edilar.

en: The Bohemian Crusade dissolved and streamed away from the battleﬁeld at the sound of the Hussites’ waggons and the dis- tant chanting of their troops; it did not even wait to ﬁght (battle of Doma- zlice, 1431).
uz: Bohemiya xoch yurishi gussitlarning vagonlari va ularning qo'shinlarining norozilik qo'shig'ining ovozi bilan erib ketdi va jang maydonidan uzoqlashdi; u hatto jang qilishni ham kutmadi (Vosa-zlice jangi, 1431).

en: In 1436 an agreement was patched up with the Hussites by a new Council of the church at Basle in which many of the special objections to Latin practice were conceded.
uz: 1436-yilda Baselda cherkovning yangi Kengashi huzitlar bilan kelishuvga erishdi, unda lotin amaliyotiga bo'lgan ko'plab maxsus e'tirozlar qabul qilindi.

en: PORTRAIT OF LUTHER  (From an early German engraving in the British Museum) In the ﬁfteenth century a great pestilence had produced much social dis- organization throughout Europe.
uz: LUTER PORTREYTI (Britaniya muzeyidagi dastlabki nemis oʻymalaridan) XV asrda buyuk vabo butun Yevropada koʻplab ijtimoiy buzilishlarni keltirib chiqardi.

en: There had been extreme misery and dis- content among the common people, and peasant risings against the land- lords and the wealthy in England and France.
uz: Oddiy xalq orasida nihoyatda azob-uqubat va norozilik, shuningdek, Angliya va Fransiyadagi yer xo'jayinlari va boylarga qarshi dehqonlarning qo'zg'olonlari bo'lgan edi.

en: After the Hussite Wars these peasant insurrections increased in gravity in Germany and took on a reli- gious character.
uz: Gussit urushlaridan so'ng bu dehqon isyonlari Germaniyada og'irlik bilan kuchayib, diniy xarakterga ega bo'ldi.

en: Printing came in as an inﬂuence upon this development.
uz: Bosmaxona bu rivojlanishga ta'sir sifatida kirdi.

en: By the middle of the ﬁfteenth century there were printers at work with movable type in Holland and the Rhineland.
uz: XV asr o'rtalariga kelib, Gollandiya va Reynlandiyada ko'chma turdagi printerlar ishlay boshladi.

en: The art spread to Italy and England,
uz: San'at Italiya va Angliyaga tarqaldi.

en: where Caxton was printing in Westminster in 1477.
uz: 1477-yilda Kekston Vestminsterda chop etayotgan joy.

en: The immediate conse- quence was a great increase and distribution of Bibles, and greatly in- creased facilities for widespread popular controversies.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Bibliyalarning katta ko'payishi va tarqalishi, shuningdek, keng tarqalgan ommaviy bahslar uchun qulayliklar sezilarli darajada oshdi.

en: The European world became a world of readers, to an extent that had never happened to any community in the past.
uz: Yevropa olami o'quvchilar dunyosiga aylandi, bu o'tmishda hech qanday jamiyat bilan sodir bo'lmagan darajada edi.

en: And this sudden irrigation of the general mind with clearer ideas and more accessible information occurred just at a time when the church was confused and divided and not in a position to defend itself effectively, and when many princes were looking for means to weaken its hold upon the vast wealth it claimed in their dominions.
uz: Va umumiy ongning to'satdan aniqroq g'oyalar va osonroq ma'lumot bilan sug'orilishi, cherkov chalkashib ketgan va bo'lingan, o'zini samarali himoya qila olmaydigan paytda va ko'plab shahzodalar o'z hukmronliklarida da'vo qilayotgan ulkan boylikka egaligini susaytirish yo'llarini qidirayotgan paytda sodir bo'ldi.

en: In Germany the attack upon the church gathered round the personality of an ex-monk, Martin Luther (1483-1546), who appeared in Wittenberg in 1517 offering disputations against various orthodox doctrines and practices.
uz: Germaniyada cherkovga hujum sobiq rohib Martin Lyuterning shaxsiyati atrofida yig'ildi (1483-1546), u 1517 yilda Wittenbergda turli xil pravoslav ta'limotlari va amaliyotlariga qarshi bahslarni taklif qilib paydo bo'ldi.

en: At ﬁrst he disputed in Latin in the fashion of the Schoolmen.
uz: Dastlab u Maktab o'quvchilari uslubida lotin tilida bahslashdi.

en: Then he took up the new weapon of the printed word and scattered his views far and wide in German addressed to the ordinary people.
uz: Keyin u bosma so'zning yangi qurolini oldi va o'z qarashlarini nemis tilida oddiy odamlarga yo'naltirilgan holda uzoq va keng tarqatdi.

en: An attempt was made to sup- press him as Huss had been suppressed, but the printing press had changed conditions and he had too many open and secret friends among the German princes for this fate to overtake him.
uz: Huss bostirilgani sababli uni bostirishga urinish qilindi, lekin bosmaxona sharoitlari o'zgardi va uning nemis shahzodalari orasida bu taqdir uni quvib o'tishi uchun ochiq va maxfiy do'stlari juda ko'p edi.

en: For now in this age of multiplying ideas and weakened faith there were many rulers who saw their advantage in breaking the religious ties between their people and Rome.
uz: Hozirgi kunda g'oyalarning ko'payishi va imonning zaiflashishi davrida o'z xalqlari va Rim o'rtasidagi diniy aloqalarni buzishda o'z afzalliklarini ko'rgan ko'plab hukmdorlar bor edi.

en: They sought to make themselves in person the heads of a more nationalized religion.
uz: Ular o'zlarini shaxsan milliyroq din rahbarlariga aylantirishga harakat qilishdi.

en: England, Scotland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, North Germany and Bohemia, one after another, separated them- selves from the Roman Communion.
uz: Angliya, Shotlandiya, Shvetsiya, Norvegiya, Daniya, Shimoliy Germaniya va Bohemiya birma-bir ularni Rim Kommunyasidan ajratib oldi.

en: They have remained separated ever since.
uz: Ular shundan beri ajralgan holda qolishdi.

en: A MAJOLICA DISH PAINED IN COLOURS  An allegory of the Church triumphant over heretics and inﬁdels.
uz: MAJOLIK RANGLAR BILAN PAYLANGAN TASHKI. Cherkovning bid'atchilar va kofirlar ustidan g'alaba qozonganligi haqidagi allegoriyasi.

en: Italian (Urbino), dated 1543  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum) The various princes concerned cared very little for the moral and intellec- tual freedom of their subjects.
uz: Italiyalik (Urbino), 1543-yilda (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida) Turli shahzodalar o'z fuqarolarining axloqiy va intellektual erkinligiga juda kam qayg'urishardi.

en: They used the religious doubts and insur- gence of their peoples to strengthen them against Rome, but they tried to keep a grip upon the popular movement as soon as that rupture was achieved and a national church set up under the control of the crown.
uz: Ular o'z xalqlarining diniy shubhalari va sug'urtasidan Rimga qarshi ularni kuchaytirish uchun foydalandilar, lekin bu yoriqqa erishilishi va toj nazorati ostida milliy cherkov tashkil etilishi bilanoq, xalq harakatini nazoratda ushlab turishga harakat qilishdi.

en: But there has always been a curious vitality in the teaching of Jesus, a direct ap- peal to righteousness and a man’s self-respect over every loyalty and every
uz: Lekin Iso Masihning ta'limotida doimo qiziqarli hayotiylik bor edi, adolatga bevosita javob va insonning har bir sadoqat va har bir...dan o'zini hurmat qilishi.

en: subordination, lay or ecclesiastical.
uz: bo'ysunish, oddiy yoki cherkovlik.

en: None of these princely churches broke off without also breaking off a number of fragmentary sects that would ad- mit the intervention of neither prince nor Pope between a man and his God.
uz: Bu shahzodalik cherkovlarining hech biri ajralmagan, lekin bir qator bo'lak-bo'lak sektalarni ham uzmagan, ular na shahzoda, na Papa inson va uning Xudosi o'rtasida aralashuvini qabul qilmas edi.

en: In England and Scotland, for example, there was a number of sects who now held ﬁrmly to the Bible as their one guide in life and belief.
uz: Misol uchun, Angliya va Shotlandiyada hayot va e'tiqoddagi yagona yo'lboshchi sifatida Muqaddas Kitobga qat'iy amal qilgan bir qator sektalar bor edi.

en: They re- fused the disciplines of a state church.
uz: Ular davlat cherkovining fanlarini qayta birlashtirdilar.

en: In England these dissentients were the Non- conformists, who played a very large part in the polities of that country in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
uz: Angliyada bu norozilar non-konformistlar edi, ular o'sha mamlakat siyosatida o'n yettinchi va o'n sakkizinchi asrlarda juda katta rol o'ynagan.

en: In England they carried their objection to a princely head to the church so far as to decapitate King Charles I (1649), and for eleven prosperous years England was a republic under Non- conformist rule.
uz: Angliyada ular o'z e'tirozlarini shahzodalik boshlig'iga cherkovga olib borishdi, hatto qirol Charlz I ni (1649) boshini oldirishdi va o'n bir farovon yil davomida Angliya konformistik bo'lmagan hukmronlik ostida respublika bo'ldi.

en: The breaking away of this large section of Northern Europe from Latin Christendom is what is generally spoken of as the Reformation.
uz: Shimoliy Yevropaning ushbu katta qismining Lotin xristianligidan ajralishi odatda Islohot deb ataladi.

en: But the shock and stress of these losses produced changes perhaps as profound in the Roman Church itself.
uz: Ammo bu yo'qotishlarning zarbasi va stresslari Rim cherkovining o'zida chuqur o'zgarishlarni keltirib chiqardi.

en: The church was reorganized and a new spirit came into its life.
uz: Cherkov qayta tashkil etildi va uning hayotiga yangi ruh kirdi.

en: One of the dominant ﬁgures in this revival was a young Spanish soldier, Inigo Lopez de Recalde, better known to the world as St.
uz: Bu uyg'onishning asosiy shaxslaridan biri yosh ispan askari Inigo Lopez de Recalde edi, u dunyoga avliyo sifatida tanilgan.

en: After some romantic beginnings he became a priest (1538) and was permitted to found the Society of Jesus, a direct attempt to bring the generous and chivalrous traditions of military discipline into the service of religion.
uz: Ba'zi romantik boshlanishlardan so'ng u ruhoniy bo'ldi (1538) va unga Iso Masih Jamiyatiga asos solishga ruxsat berildi, bu harbiy intizomning saxiy va otliq an'analarini din xizmatiga olib kirish uchun to'g'ridan-to'g'ri urinish edi.

en: This Society of Jesus, the Jesuits, became one of the greatest teaching and missionary societies the world has ever seen.
uz: Iso Masih Jamiyati, Jezuitlar, dunyo ko'rgan eng buyuk ta'lim va missionerlik jamiyatlaridan biriga aylandi.

en: It car- ried Christianity to India, China and America.
uz: U xristianlikni Hindiston, Xitoy va Amerikaga olib bordi.

en: It arrested the rapid disinte- gration of the Roman Church.
uz: Bu Rim cherkovining tez tarqalishini to'xtatdi.

en: It raised the standard of education throughout the whole Catholic world; it raised the level of Catholic intelligence and quickened the Catholic conscience everywhere; it stimulated Protestant Eu- rope to competitive educational efforts.
uz: U butun katolik dunyosi bo'ylab ta'lim darajasini oshirdi; u katolik aql darajasini ko'tardi va hamma joyda katolik vijdonini tezlashtirdi; u protestant Yevropani raqobatbardosh ta'lim harakatlariga undadi.

en: The vigorous and aggressive Ro- man Catholic Church we know to-day is largely the product of this Jesuit revival.
uz: Bugungi kunda biz biladigan kuchli va tajovuzkor Rim-Katolik cherkovi asosan ushbu iezuit uyg'onishining mahsulotidir.

en: LI THE EMPEROR CHARLES V The Holy Roman Empire came to a sort of climax in the reign of the Em- peror Charles V.
uz: LI THE EMPEROR CHARLES V Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi imperator Charlz V hukmronligida o'ziga xos cho'qqiga keldi.

en: He was one of the most extraordinary monarchs that Eu- rope has ever seen.
uz: U Yevropa tarixida ko'rgan eng g'ayrioddiy monarxlardan biri edi.

en: For a time he had the air of being the greatest monarch since Charlemagne.
uz: Bir vaqtlar u Charlz Buyukdan beri eng buyuk monarx bo'lgandek tuyuldi.

en: His greatness was not of his own making.
uz: Uning buyukligi o'zi yaratmagan edi.

en: It was largely the creation of his grandfather, the Emperor Maximilian I (1459- 1519).
uz: Bu asosan uning bobosi, imperator Maksimilian I (1459- 1519)ning yaratilishi edi.

en: Some families have fought, others have intrigued their way to world power; the Habsburgs married their way.
uz: Ba'zi oilalar urushgan, boshqalari jahon hokimiyatiga qiziqish bilan yo'l olishgan; Habsburglar o'z yo'llariga kelishgan.

en: Maximilian began his career with Austria, Styria, part of Alsace and other districts, the original Habsburg patrimony; he married— the lady’s name scarcely matters to us—the Netherlands and Burgundy.
uz: Maksimilian o'z faoliyatini Avstriya, Sturiya, Alzasning bir qismi va boshqa tumanlar, asl Habsburg merosidan boshladi; u turmushga chiqdi  xonimning ismi bizga deyarli ahamiyatga ega emas  Niderlandiya va Burgund.

en: Most of Burgundy slipped from him after his ﬁrst wife’s death, but the Netherlands he held.
uz: Uning birinchi xotini vafotidan so'ng Burgundning ko'p qismi undan chiqib ketdi, lekin Niderlandiya uni ushlab turdi.

en: Then he tried unsuccessfully to marry Brittany.
uz: Keyin u Brittanyga turmushga chiqishga muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

en: He be- came Emperor in succession to his father, Frederick III, in 1493, and mar- ried the duchy of Milan.
uz: U 1493-yilda otasi Frederik III ga vorislik qilib imperator bo'ldi va Milan gersogligini meros qilib oldi.

en: Finally he married his son to the weak-minded daughter of Ferdinand and Isabella, the Ferdinand and Isabella of Colum- bus, who not only reigned over a freshly united Spain and over Sardinia and the kingdom of the two Sicilies, but over all America west of Brazil.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'g'lini Ferdinand va Izabelaning zaif fikrli qizi, Kolumdan bo'lgan Ferdinand va Izabellaga turmushga chiqardi. Ular nafaqat yangi birlashgan Ispaniya va Sardiniya hamda ikki Sitsiliya qirolligi ustidan hukmronlik qilishdi, balki Braziliyadan butun Amerika g'arbida hukmronlik qilishdi.

en: So it was that this Charles V, his grandson, inherited most of the American conti- nent and between a third and a half of what the Turks had left of Europe.
uz: Shunday qilib, uning nabirasi Charlz V Amerika kontentining ko'p qismini va turklar Yevropadan qoldirgan uchdan bir yarmini meros qilib oldi.

en: He succeeded to the Netherlands in 1506.
uz: U 1506-yilda Niderlandiyaga voris bo'ldi.

en: When his grandfather Ferdinand died in 1516, he became practically king of the Spanish dominions, his mother being imbecile; and his grandfather Maximilian dying in 1519, he was in 1520 elected Emperor at the still comparatively tender age of twenty.
uz: 1516-yilda bobosi Ferdinand vafot etganida, u deyarli Ispaniya hukmronliklarining shohi bo'ldi, onasi esa ahmoq edi; va 1519-yilda bobosi Maksimilian vafot etganida, u 1520-yilda hali nisbatan nozik yigirma yoshida imperator etib saylandi.

en: He was a fair young man with a not very intelligent face, a thick upper lip and a long clumsy chin.
uz: U unchalik aqlli bo'lmagan, quyuq yuqori lablari va uzun g'alati kinosiga ega chiroyli yigit edi.

en: He found himself in a world of young and vig- orous personalities.
uz: U o'zini yosh va g'ayratli shaxsiyatlar olamiga duch keldi.

en: It was an age of brilliant young monarchs.
uz: Bu ajoyib yosh monarxlar davri edi.

en: Francis I had succeeded to the French throne in 1515 at the age of twenty-one, Henry VIII had become King of England in 1509 at eighteen.
uz: Fransisk I 1515-yilda yigirma bir yoshida Fransiya taxtiga o'tdi, Genrix VIII esa 1509-yilda o'n sakkiz yoshida Angliya qiroli bo'ldi.

en: It was the age of Baber in India (1526-1530) and Suleiman the Magniﬁcent in Turkey (1520), both exceptionally capable monarchs, and the Pope Leo X (1513) was also a very distinguished Pope.
uz: Bu Hindistondagi Baber davri edi (1526-1530), Turkiyadagi Buyuk Sulaymon (1520), ikkalasi ham juda qobiliyatli monarxlar edi va Rim Papasi Lev X (1513) ham juda taniqli Rim Papasi edi.

en: The Pope and Francis I attempted to prevent the election of Charles as Emperor because they dreaded the con- centration of so much power in the hands of one man.
uz: Rim Papasi va Fransisk I Charlzning imperator etib saylanishiga to'sqinlik qilishga harakat qilishdi, chunki ular bir odamning qo'lida shunchalik ko'p hokimiyatning jamlanishidan qo'rqishardi.

en: Both Francis I and Henry VIII offered themselves to the imperial electors.
uz: Fransisk I va Genrix VIII ham imperator saylovchilariga o'zlarini taklif qilishdi.

en: But there was now a long established tradition of Habsburg Emperors (since 1273), and some energetic bribery secured the election for Charles.
uz: Ammo Habsburg imperatorlarining allaqachon shakllangan an'anasi bor edi (1273-yildan beri), va Charlz uchun saylovni ba'zi kuchli poraxo'rlik ta'minladi.

en: At ﬁrst the young man was very much a magniﬁcent puppet in the hands of his ministers.
uz: Dastlab yigit o'z vazirlarining qo'lida juda ajoyib qo'g'irchoq edi.

en: Then slowly he began to assert himself and take control.
uz: Keyin sekin-asta o'zini ta'kidlay boshladi va o'zini nazoratga oldi.

en: He began to realize something of the threatening complexities of his exalted position.
uz: U o'zining ulug'vor mavqeining tahdid soluvchi murakkabliklarini anglay boshladi.

en: It was a position as unsound as it was splendid.
uz: Bu juda ajoyib bo'lgani kabi, unchalik jozibali pozitsiya emas edi.

en: From the very outset of his reign he was faced by the situation created by Luther’s agitations in Germany.
uz: U o'z hukmronligining boshidanoq Lyuterning Germaniyadagi tashviqotlari natijasida yuzaga kelgan vaziyat bilan yuzma-yuz keldi.

en: The Emperor had one reason for siding with the reformers in the opposition of the Pope to his election.
uz: Imperatorning Rim Papasining saylanishiga qarshilik ko'rsatgan islohotchilarning yonini olish uchun bir sababi bor edi.

en: But he had been brought up in Spain, that most Catholic of countries, and he decided against Luther.
uz: Lekin u Ispaniyada, mamlakatlarning aksariyati katolik bo'lgan joyda tarbiyalangan edi va u Lyuterga qarshi qaror qabul qildi.

en: So he came into conﬂict with the Protestant princes and par- ticularly the Elector of Saxony.
uz: Shunday qilib, u protestant shahzodalar va ayniqsa Saksoniyalik Saylovchi bilan ziddiyatga kirdi.

en: He found himself in the presence of an opening rift that was to split the outworn fabric of Christendom into two contending camps.
uz: U o'zini xristianlikning eskirgan matosini ikki kurashchi lagerga bo'lish uchun mo'ljallangan yoriqning huzurida topdi.

en: His attempts to close that rift were strenuous and honest and ineffective.
uz: Uning o'sha yoriqni yopishga urinishlari kuchli, halol va samarasiz edi.

en: There was an extensive peasant revolt in Germany which interwove with the general political and religious disturbance.
uz: Germaniyada keng ko'lamli dehqonlar isyoni bo'lib o'tdi, bu umumiy siyosiy va diniy tartibsizliklarga aralashdi.

en: And these internal troubles were complicated by attacks upon the Empire from east and west alike.
uz: Va bu ichki muammolar Sharqdan ham, G'arbdan ham Imperiyaga hujumlar natijasida murakkablashdi.

en: On the west of Charles was his spirited rival, Francis I; to the east was the ever advancing Turk, who was now in Hungary, in alliance with Francis and clamouring for certain arrears of tribute from the Austrian dominions.
uz: Charlzning g'arbida uning g'ayratli raqibi Fransisk I bor edi; sharqda esa doimo oldinga siljigan turk bor edi, u hozir Vengriyada edi, Fransisk bilan ittifoqda edi va Avstriya hukmdorliklaridan ma'lum miqdordagi soliq qarzdorligini talab qilardi.

en: Charles had the money and army of Spain at his disposal, but it was extremely difﬁcult to get any effective support in money from Ger- many.
uz: Charlzning ixtiyorida Ispaniya puli va armiyasi bor edi, lekin Germaniyaliklardan samarali pul yordamini olish juda qiyin edi.

en: His social and political troubles were complicated by ﬁnancial dis- tresses.
uz: Uning ijtimoiy va siyosiy muammolari moliyaviy muammolar bilan murakkablashdi.

en: He was forced to ruinous borrowing.
uz: U vayronkor qarzga majbur bo'ldi.

en: THE CHARLES V PORTRAIT BY TITIAN  (In the Gallery del Prado, Madrid)  Photo: Anderson On the whole, Charles, in alliance with Henry VIII, was successful against Francis I and the Turk.
uz: CHARLES V PORTREAT BY TITIAN (Gallery del Prado, Madrid) Foto: Anderson Umuman olganda, Charlz Genrix VIII bilan ittifoqda Fransisk I va turklarga qarshi muvaffaqiyatli edi.

en: Their chief battleﬁeld was North Italy; the
uz: Ularning asosiy jang maydoni Shimoliy Italiya edi;

en: generalship was dull on both sides; their advances and retreats depended mainly on the arrival of reinforcements.
uz: Generallik ikki tomondan ham xira edi; ularning oldinga siljishi va chekinishi asosan kuchaytirishlarning kelishiga bog'liq edi.

en: The German army invaded France, failed to take Marseilles, fell back into Italy, lost Milan, and was besieged in Pavia.
uz: Germaniya armiyasi Fransiyaga bostirib kirdi, Marselni egallay olmadi, Italiyaga qaytib tushdi, Milanni yo'qotdi va Paviyada qamalga uchradi.

en: Francis I made a long and unsuccessful siege of Pavia, was caught by fresh German forces, defeated, wounded and taken prisoner.
uz: Fransisk I Paviyani uzoq va muvaffaqiyatsiz qamal qildi, yangi nemis kuchlari tomonidan ushlanib, mag'lub etildi, yaralandi va asirga olindi.

en: But there- upon the Pope and Henry VIII, still haunted by the fear of his attaining ex- cessive power, turned against Charles.
uz: Ammo u yerda - Rim Papasi va Genrix VIII, hali ham uning sobiq kesessiy hokimiyatga erishishidan qo'rqib, Charlzga qarshi burildi.

en: The German troops in Milan, under the Constable of Bourbon, being unpaid, forced rather than followed their commander into a raid upon Rome.
uz: Milandagi nemis qo'shinlari, Burbon konstabli ostida, to'lanmagan holda, o'z qo'mondonlariga ergashib Rimga hujumga borishga majbur bo'lishdi.

en: They stormed the city and pillaged it (1527).
uz: Ular shaharga bostirib kirib, uni talon-toroj qilishdi (1527).

en: The Pope took refuge in the Castle of St.
uz: Rim Papasi Avliyo qal'asiga panoh topdi.

en: Angelo while the looting and slaughter went on.
uz: Angelo, talon-toroj va qirg'in davom etayotgan paytda.

en: He bought off the German troops at last by the pay- ment of four hundred thousand ducats.
uz: U nemis qo'shinlarini oxir-oqibat to'rt yuz ming dukat to'lov evaziga sotib oldi.

en: Ten years of such confused ﬁghting impoverished all Europe.
uz: Bunday chalkash janglarning o'n yili butun Yevropani kambag'allashtirdi.

en: At last the Emperor found himself triumphant in Italy.
uz: Nihoyat imperator Italiyada g'alaba qozondi.

en: In 1530, he was crowned by the Pope—he was the last German Em- peror to be so crowned—at Bologna.
uz: 1530-yilda u Rim Papasi tomonidan tojlandi  u Bolonyada shunday toj kiygan oxirgi nemis imperatori edi.

en: Meanwhile the Turks were making great headway in Hungary.
uz: Ayni paytda turklar Vengriyada katta yutuqlarga erishayotgan edi.

en: They had defeated and killed the king of Hungary in 1526, they held Buda-Pesth, and in 1529 Suleiman the Magniﬁcent very nearly took Vienna.
uz: Ular 1526-yilda Vengriya qirolini mag'lub etib, o'ldirishgan, Buda-Pestni ushlab turishgan va 1529-yilda Buyuk Sulaymon Vena deyarli egallagan edi.

en: The Emperor was greatly concerned by these advances, and did his utmost to drive back the Turks, but he found the greatest difﬁculty in getting the German princes to unite even with this formidable enemy upon their very borders.
uz: Imperator bu yutuqlardan juda xavotirda edi va turklarni orqaga haydash uchun bor kuchini sarfladi, lekin u nemis shahzodalarini hatto o'z chegaralarida ham bu dahshatli dushman bilan birlashish uchun eng katta qiyinchilikni ko'rdi.

en: Francis I remained implacable for a time, and there was a new French war; but in 1538 Charles won his rival over to a more friendly attitude after ravaging the south of France.
uz: Fransisk I bir muddat tinimsiz qoldi va yangi Fransiya urushi boshlandi; lekin 1538-yilda Charlz Fransiya janubini vayron qilganidan so'ng raqibini yanada do'stona munosabatda yengdi.

en: Francis and Charles then formed an alliance against the Turk.
uz: Fransisk va Charlz keyin turklarga qarshi ittifoq tuzdilar.

en: But the Protestant princes, the German princes who were resolved to break away from Rome, had formed a league, the Schmalkaldic League, against the Emperor, and in the place of a great campaign to recover Hun- gary for Christendom Charles had to turn his mind to the gathering internal struggle in Germany.
uz: Ammo protestant shahzodalar, Rimdan ajralib chiqishga qaror qilgan nemis shahzodalari imperatorga qarshi Schmalkaldiya Ligasi bo'lib, ulkan Hun-gariyani xristianlik uchun qaytarib olish kampaniyasi o'rniga Charlz Germaniyadagi yig'ilgan ichki kurashga e'tibor qaratishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Of that struggle he saw only the opening war.
uz: O'sha kurashdan u faqatgina ochilish urushini ko'rdi.

en: It was a struggle, a sanguinary irrational bickering of princes, for ascendancy, now ﬂaming into war and destruction, now sinking back to intrigues and diplo- macies; it was a snake’s sack of princely policies that was to go on writhing incurably right into the nineteenth century and to waste and desolate Central Europe again and again.
uz: Bu kurash edi, shahzodalarning hukmronlik uchun qonli irratsional janjallari, endi urush va vayronagarchilikka uchraydigan, endi intriqa va diplo-macilarga qaytadigan kurash edi; bu o'n to'qqizinchi asrgacha tuzalib ketadigan va Markaziy Yevropani qayta-qayta xarob va vayron qiladigan shahzoda siyosatlarining ilon sumkasi edi.

en: The Emperor never seems to have grasped the true forces at work in these gathering troubles.
uz: Imperator hech qachon bu yig'ilish muammolarida haqiqiy kuchlarni anglaganga o'xshamaydi.

en: He was for his time and station an exceptionally
uz: U o'z vaqti va mavqeyi uchun favqulodda edi.

en: worthy man, and he seems to have taken the religious dissensions that were tearing Europe into warring fragments as genuine theological differences.
uz: munosib inson edi va u Yevropani urushayotgan bo'laklarga bo'linib ketayotgan diniy kelishmovchiliklarni haqiqiy teologik farqlar deb qabul qilgan ko'rinadi.

en: He gathered diets and councils in futile attempts at reconciliation.
uz: U yarashuvga behuda urinishlarda parhezlar va maslahatlar yig'di.

en: Formulæ and confessions were tried over.
uz: Formulalar va e'tiroflar ko'rib chiqildi.

en: The student of German history must strug- gle with the details of the Religious Peace of Nuremberg, the settlement at the Diet of Ratisbon, the Interim of Augsburg, and the like.
uz: Nemis tarixining talabasi Nyurnberg diniy tinchligi,atisbon Dietidagi kelishuv,Augsburg vaqtinchalik davri va shunga o'xshash tafsilotlar bilan kurashishi kerak.

en: Here we do but mention them as details in the worried life of this culminating Emperor.
uz: Bu yerda biz ularni ushbu yakunlanayotgan imperatorning tashvishli hayotidagi tafsilotlar sifatida eslatib o'tamiz.

en: As a matter of fact, hardly one of the multifarious princes and rulers in Europe seems to have been acting in good faith.
uz: Aslida, Yevropadagi ko'p xil shahzodalar va hukmdorlardan deyarli hech biri yaxshi niyat bilan ish qilmaganga o'xshaydi.

en: The widespread religious trouble of the world, the desire of the common people for truth and social right- eousness, the spreading knowledge of the time, all those things were merely counters in the imaginations of princely diplomacy.
uz: Dunyodagi keng tarqalgan diniy muammolar, oddiy xalqning haqiqat va ijtimoiy adolatga intilishi, o'sha davr bilimini tarqatish, bularning barchasi shahzodalik diplomatiyasining tasavvurlarida shunchaki qarshiliklar edi.

en: Henry VIII of England, who had begun his career with a book against heresy, and who had been re- warded by the Pope with the title of “Defender of the Faith,” being anxious to divorce his ﬁrst wife in favour of a young lady named Anne Boleyn, and wishing also to loot the vast wealth of the church in England, joined the company of Protestant princes in 1530.
uz: Angliyalik Genrix VIII, o'z faoliyatini bid'atga qarshi kitob bilan boshlagan va Rim Papasi tomonidan Iymon himoyachisi unvoni bilan qayta himoyalangan, Anna Boleyn ismli yosh xonim foydasiga birinchi xotini ajrashishga shoshilgan va Angliyadagi cherkovning ulkan boyligini ham o'g'irlashni istagan holda, 1530-yilda protestant knyazlar jamoasiga qo'shildi.

en: Sweden, Denmark and Norway had already gone over to the Protestant side.
uz: Shvetsiya, Daniya va Norvegiya allaqachon protestantlar tomoniga o'tib ketgan edi.

en: The German religious war began in 1546, a few months after the death of Martin Luther.
uz: Germaniya diniy urushi 1546-yilda, Martin Lyuter vafotidan bir necha oy o'tgach boshlandi.

en: We need not trouble about the incidents of the campaign.
uz: Bizga kampaniya voqealari haqida tashvish kerak emas.

en: The Protestant Saxon army was badly beaten at Lochau.
uz: Protestant Sakson armiyasi Lochau shahrida yomon mag'lub etildi.

en: By something very like a breach of faith Philip of Hesse, the Emperor’s chief remaining antag- onist, was caught and imprisoned, and the Turks were bought off by the promise of an annual tribute.
uz: Imonni buzishga o'xshash bir narsa tufayli imperatorning bosh antagoniysi bo'lgan Filipp Hesse ushlanib, qamoqqa tashlandi va turklar yillik soliq va'dasi bilan sotib olindi.

en: In 1547, to the great relief of the Emperor, Francis I died.
uz: 1547-yilda imperatorning katta ta'siriga ko'ra, Fransisk I vafot etdi.

en: So by 1547 Charles got to a kind of settlement, and made his last efforts to effect peace where there was no peace.
uz: Shunday qilib, 1547 yilga kelib Charlz bir turdagi kelishuvga erishdi va tinchlik bo'lmagan joyda tinchlikni ta'minlashga oxirgi urinishlarini qildi.

en: In 1552 all Germany was at war again, only a precipitate ﬂight from Innsbruck saved Charles from capture, and in 1552, with the treaty of Passau, came another unstable equilibrium ....
uz: 1552-yilda butun Germaniya yana urushda edi, faqat Innsbruckdan tezkor uchish Charlzni asirlikdan qutqardi, 1552-yilda esa Passaw shartnomasi bilan yana bir beqaror muvozanat paydo bo'ldi....

en: Such is the brief outline of the politics of the Empire for thirty-two years.
uz: Imperiyaning o'ttiz ikki yillik siyosatining qisqacha mazmuni shunday.

en: It is interesting to note how entirely the European mind was concentrated upon the struggle for European ascendancy.
uz: Yevropa ongining toʻliq Yevropa ustunligi uchun kurashga qanchalik jamlanganini taʼkidlash qiziqarli.

en: Neither Turks, French, English nor Germans had yet discovered any political interest in the great continent of America, nor any signiﬁcance in the new sea routes to Asia.
uz: Turklar ham, fransuzlar ham, inglizlar ham, nemislar ham Amerika qit'asiga siyosiy qiziqish bildirmagan edilar, shuningdek, Osiyoga yangi dengiz yo'nalishlarida hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas edilar.

en: Great things were happening in America; Cortez with a mere handful of men had con- quered the great Neolithic empire of Mexico for Spain, Pizarro had crossed
uz: Amerikada buyuk ishlar sodir bo'layotgan edi; Kortez bir hovuch odam bilan Ispaniyaning Buyuk Neolitika imperiyasini ishlov bergan edi, Pizarro esa...

en: the Isthmus of Panama (1530) and subjugated another wonder-land, Peru.
uz: Panama Istmuyasi (1530) va yana bir mo'jizaviy yurt, Peruni bo'ysundirdi.

en: But as yet these events meant no more to Europe than a useful and stimulat- ing inﬂux of silver to the Spanish treasury.
uz: Lekin shunga qaramay, bu voqealar Yevropa uchun nafaqat Ispaniya xazinasiga foydali va rag'batlantiruvchi kumush oqimini anglatardi.

en: It was after the treaty of Passau that Charles began to display his distinc- tive originality of mind.
uz: Passaw shartnomasidan keyin Charlz o'zining o'ziga xos fikrlash o'ziga xosligini namoyon qila boshladi.

en: He was now entirely bored and disillusioned by his imperial greatness.
uz: U endi butunlay zerikib, o'zining imperatorlik ulug'vorligidan umidsiz edi.

en: A sense of the intolerable futility of these European ri- valries came upon him.
uz: Unga bu yevropalik g'aroyiblarning chidab bo'lmas befoydaligi sezildi.

en: He had never been of a very sound constitution, he was naturally indolent and he was suffering greatly from gout.
uz: U hech qachon juda sog'lom tuzilishga ega bo'lmagan, u tabiiy ravishda dangasa edi va u gipozdan juda azob chekayotgan edi.

en: He made over all his sovereign rights in Germany to his brother Ferdi- nand, and Spain and the Netherlands he resigned to his son Philip.
uz: U Germaniyadagi barcha suveren huquqlarini akasi Ferdi-Nandaga topshirdi, Ispaniya va Niderlandiyani esa o'g'li Filipga topshirdi.

en: Then in a sort of magniﬁcent dudgeon he retired to a monastery at Yuste, among the oak and chestnut forests in the hills to the north of the Tagus valley.
uz: Keyin u qandaydir ajoyib dudgeon shaklida Yuste shahridagi monastirga, Tagus vodiysining shimoliy tomonidagi tepaliklardagi eman va kashtan o'rmonlari orasida chekindi.

en: There he died in 1558.
uz: U yerda u 1558 yilda vafot etdi.

en: Much has been written in a sentimental vein of this retirement, this re- nunciation of the world by this tired majestic Titan, world-weary, seeking in an austere solitude his peace with God.
uz: Ko'p narsa shu nafaqaga chiqish, bu dunyoni qayta ruhoniy qilish haqidagi sentimental ruhda yozilgan, bu charchagan, ulug'vor Titan, dunyodan charchagan, Xudo bilan tinchligini qattiq yolg'izlikda izlayotgan.

en: But his retreat was neither solitary nor austere; he had with him nearly a hundred and ﬁfty attendants: his es- tablishment had all the splendour and indulgences without the fatigues or a court, and Philip II was a dutiful son to whom his father’s advice was a command.
uz: Ammo uning chekinishi na yolg'iz, na qattiqqo'l edi; uning yonida yuz ellikka yaqin xizmatchisi bor edi: uning ishlashi charchoqsiz yoki saroysiz barcha hashamat va imtiyozlarga ega edi, va Filipp II otasining maslahati buyruq bo'lgan itoatkor o'g'il edi.

en: PETER’S, ROME, SHOWING THE HIGH ALTAR  Photo: Alinari And if Charles had lost his living interest in the administration of Eu- ropean affairs, there were other motives of a more immediate sort to stir him.
uz: PETR, RIM, YUQORI ALTARNI KO'RSATISH Surat: Alinari Agar Charlz Yevropa ishlarining boshqaruviga bo'lgan hayotiy qiziqishini yo'qotgan bo'lsa, uni qo'zg'atish uchun boshqa, yaqinroq turdagi sabablar ham bor edi.

en: Says Prescott: “In the almost daily correspondence between Quixada, or Gaztelu, and the Secretary of State at Valladolid, there is scarcely a letter
uz: Prescott shunday deydi: Kixada yoki Gaztelu va Valladoliddagi Davlat kotibi o'rtasidagi deyarli har kuni sodir bo'ladigan yozishmalarda deyarli hech qanday xat yo'q.

en: that does not turn more or less on the Emperor’s eating or his illness.
uz: bu imperatorning ovqatlanishiga yoki uning kasalligiga ko'proq yoki kamroq ta'sir qilmaydi.

en: The one seems naturally to follow, like a running commentary, on the other.
uz: Birinchisi, xuddi yugurib borayotgan izoh kabi, ikkinchisiga tabiiy ravishda ergashgandek tuyuladi.

en: It is rare that such topics have formed the burden of communications with the department of state.
uz: Bunday mavzular davlat departamenti bilan aloqa yukini shakllantirishi kamdan-kam uchraydi.

en: It must have been no easy matter for the secretary to preserve his gravity in the perusal of despatches in which politics and gas- tronomy were so strangely mixed together.
uz: Sekretar uchun siyosat va gaz hukmronligi shunchalik g'alati tarzda aralashgan despatchalarni ko'rib chiqishda o'z og'irligini saqlab qolish oson ish bo'lmagan bo'lishi kerak.

en: The courier from Valladolid to Lisbon was ordered to make a detour, so as to take Jarandilla in his route, and bring supplies to the royal table.
uz: Valladoliddan Lissabongacha bo'lgan kurerga Jarandillani o'z yo'nalishiga olib borish va qirollik stoliga ta'minot olib kelish uchun aylanma yo'lni amalga oshirish buyurildi.

en: On Thursdays he was to bring ﬁsh to serve for the jour maigre that was to follow.
uz: Payshanba kunlari u keyingi kichkina kun uchun baliq olib kelishi kerak edi.

en: The trout in the neighbourhood Charles thought too small, so others of a larger size were to be sent from Valladolid.
uz: Charlzning qo'shnilaridagi trout juda kichik deb o'yladi, shuning uchun katta o'lchamdagi boshqa troutlar Valladoliddan yuborilishi kerak edi.

en: Fish of every kind was to his taste, as, indeed, was anything that in its nature or habits at all approached to ﬁsh.
uz: Har qanday turdagi baliq uning didiga mos edi, xuddi o'z tabiati yoki odatlari bilan baliqlarga yaqin bo'lgan har qanday narsa kabi.

en: Eels, frogs, oysters, occupied an important place in the royal bill of fare.
uz: Archalar, qurbaqalar, ustrinkalar qirollik to'lov hisobida muhim o'rin egallagan.

en: Potted ﬁsh, especially anchovies, found great favour with him; and he regretted that he had not brought a bet- ter supply of these from the Low Countries.
uz: Qadoqlangan baliqlar, ayniqsa anjaralar, unga juda yoqdi; va u quyi mamlakatlardan bularning yaxshiroq ta'minotini olib kelmaganidan afsusda edi.

en: On an eel-pasty he particularly doted.” ...
uz: U ayniqsa pastkadan yoqtirardi. ...

en: [1] In 1554 Charles had obtained a bull from Pope Julius III granting him a dispensation from fasting, and allowing him to break his fast early in the morning even when he was to take the sacrament.
uz: 1554-yilda Charlz Papa Yuliy III dan buqa oldi, unga ro'za tutishdan ruxsat berdi va hatto sakrament qabul qilishi kerak bo'lganda ham erta tongda ro'za tutishga ruxsat berdi.

en: Eating and doctoring!
uz: Ovqatlanish va davolanish!

en: it was a return to elemental things.
uz: Bu elementar narsalarga qaytish edi.

en: He had never acquired the habit of reading, but he would be read aloud to at meals after the fashion of Charlemagne, and would make what one narrator describes as a “sweet and heavenly commentary.” He also amused himself with me- chanical toys, by listening to music or sermons, and by attending to the im- perial business that still came drifting in to him.
uz: U hech qachon o'qish odatini qo'lga kiritmagan edi, lekin uni Charlz Buyukning uslubidagi taomlarda baland ovozda o'qirishardi va bir hikoyachi shirin va samoviy izoh deb ta'riflagan narsani yaratardi. U o'zini me-shanical o'yinchoqlari bilan ham xursand qilardi, musiqa yoki va'zlarni tinglash va unga hali ham kirib kelayotgan g'ayrioddiy ishlarga e'tibor berish orqali.

en: The death of the Empress, to whom he was greatly attached, had turned his mind towards religion, which in his case took a punctilious and ceremonial form; every Friday in Lent he scourged himself with the rest of the monks with such good will as to draw blood.
uz: Imperatorning o'limi, unga juda bog'liq bo'lgan, uning fikrini dinga qaratgan edi, bu esa uning holatida aniq va tantanali shaklga ega edi; har juma kuni ro'za paytida u o'zini qolgan rohiblar bilan qon tortishga qadar yaxshi niyat bilan urardi.

en: These exercises and the gout released a bigotry in Charles that had hitherto been restrained by considerations of policy.
uz: Bu mashqlar va gout Charlzda shu paytgacha siyosat mulohazalari tufayli cheklangan bigotlikni uyg'otdi.

en: The appear- ance of Protestant teaching close at hand in Valladolid roused him to fury.
uz: Valladolidda protestant ta'limotining yaqinlashib kelayotgan ko'rinishi uni g'azabga soldi.

en: “Tell the grand inquisitor and his council from me to be at their posts, and to lay the axe at the root of the evil before it spreads further.” .
uz: Buyuk inkvizitor va uning kengashiga mendan o'z postlarida bo'lishni va yovuzlik yanada tarqalishidan oldin bolta ildiziga qo'yishni ayt.

en: He ex- pressed a doubt whether it would not be well, in so black an affair, to dis- pense with the ordinary course of justice, and to show no mercy; “lest the criminal, if pardoned, should have the opportunity of repeating his crime.”
uz: U ilgari shunday qora ishda adolatning oddiy yo'li bilan kelishmaslik va rahm-shafqat ko'rsatmaslik yaxshi bo'lmasligiga shubha bilan qaradi; agar jinoyatchi afv etilsa, jinoyatini takrorlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: He recommended, as an example, his own mode or proceeding in the Netherlands, “where all who remained obstinate in their errors were burned alive, and those who were admitted to penitence were beheaded.” And almost symbolical of his place and role in history was his preoccu- pation with funerals.
uz: U misol tariqasida Niderlandiyada o'z uslubini yoki harakatini tavsiya qildi, u yerda xatolarida qat'iyat bilan qolganlarning barchasi tiriklayin yoqib yuborildi, tavba qilishga qabul qilinganlarning boshini kesildi. Va uning tarixda o'rni va roli deyarli ramziy edi  dafn marosimlari bilan tashvishlanishi.

en: He seems to have had an intuition that something great was dead in Europe and sorely needed burial, that there was a need to write Finis, overdue.
uz: U Yevropada buyuk bir narsa o'lik ekanligi va uni juda ko'mib tashlash kerakligi, Finisni yozishga ehtiyoj borligi, kechikkanligi haqida sezgan ko'rinadi.

en: He not only attended every actual funeral that was celebrat- ed at Yuste, but he had services conducted for the absent dead, he held a fu- neral service in memory of his wife on the anniversary of her death, and ﬁ- nally he celebrated his own obsequies.
uz: U nafaqat Yuste'da nishonlanadigan har bir dafn marosimida qatnashardi, balki yo'q o'liklar uchun ham marosimlar o'tkazardi, xotini vafoti yilligida uning xotirasiga hurmat bajo keltirdi va nihoyat o'z tabriklarini ham nishonlardi.

en: “The chapel was hung with black, and the blaze of hundreds of wax- lights was scarcely sufﬁcient to dispel the darkness.
uz: Kapella qora rangga osilgan edi va yuzlab mum chiroqlarining alangasi zulmatni yo'q qilishga deyarli yetarli emas edi.

en: The brethren in their conventual dress, and all the Emperor’s household clad in deep mourning, gathered round a huge catafalque, shrouded also in black, which had been raised in the centre of the chapel.
uz: Birodarlar o'zlarining ibodat liboslarida va imperatorning butun xonadoni chuqur motamga burkangan holda, ibodatxonaning markazida ko'tarilgan ulkan kataklok atrofida yig'ilishdi, u ham qora rangda o'ralgan edi.

en: The service for the burial of the dead was then performed; and, amidst the dismal wail of the monks, the prayers as- cended for the departed spirit, that it might be received into the mansions of the blessed.
uz: So'ngra marhumlarni dafn etish marosimi o'tkazildi; va rohiblarning dahshatli faryodlari orasida, vafot etgan ruh uchun qilingan duolar qudratlilarning uylariga qabul qilinishi uchun o'qildi.

en: The sorrowful attendants were melted to tears, as the image of their master’s death was presented to their minds—or they were touched, it may be, with compassion by this pitiable display of weakness.
uz: Qayg'uli xizmatkorlar ko'z yoshlariga to'lib ketdi, chunki ularning ongiga xo'jayinlarining o'limi tasviri tushdi  yoki ehtimol, bu achinarli zaiflik namoyishi ularga rahm-shafqat bilan tegdi.

en: Charles, mufﬂed in a dark mantle, and bearing a lighted candle in his hand, mingled with his household, the spectator of his own obsequies; and the doleful cer- emony was concluded by his placing the taper in the hands of the priest, in sign of his surrendering up his soul to the Almighty.” Within two months of this masquerade he was dead.
uz: Charlz, qorong'u manti bilan muffak, qo'lida yoniq sham bilan, o'z uyidagilar, o'z obsequiesining tomoshabinlari bilan aralashib ketdi; va azobli marosim ruhoniyning qo'liga taperni qo'yish bilan yakunlandi, bu uning Qodir Tangriga jonini topshirishining belgisi edi. Bu niqobdan ikki oy ichida u vafot etdi.

en: And the brief great- ness of the Holy Roman Empire died with him.
uz: Va Muqaddas Rim imperiyasining qisqa ulug'vorligi u bilan birga vafot etdi.

en: His realm was already di- vided between his brother and his son.
uz: Uning saltanati allaqachon akasi va o'g'li o'rtasida bo'lingan edi.

en: The Holy Roman Empire struggled on indeed to the days of Napoleon I but as an invalid and dying thing.
uz: Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi Napoleon I davrigacha kurashdi, lekin yaroqsiz va o'layotgan narsa sifatida.

en: To this day its unburied tradition still poisons the political air.
uz: Bugungi kunga qadar uning dafn etilmagan an'anasi siyosiy havoni zaharlamoqda.

en: [1] Prescott’s Appendix to Robertson’s History of Charles V.
uz: [1] Prescottning Robertsonning Charlz V. tarixiga ilovasi.

en: LII THE AGE OF POLITICAL EXPERIMENTS; OF GRAND MONARCHY AND PARLIAMENTS AND REPUBLICANISM IN EUROPE The Latin Church was broken, the Holy Roman Empire was in extreme de- cay; the history of Europe from the opening of the sixteenth century onward is a story of peoples feeling their way darkly to some new method of gov- ernment, better adapted to the new conditions that were arising.
uz: Siyosiy tajribalar davri; Yevropada Katta monarxiya va Parlamentlar va Respublikachilik. Lotin cherkovi buzilgan, Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi haddan tashqari de-kayda edi; XVI asr boshidan boshlab Yevropaning tarixi xalqlarning paydo bo'layotgan yangi sharoitlarga yaxshiroq moslashgan holda, qandaydir yangi boshqaruv usuliga qorong'u tarzda o'zlarini his qilishlari haqidagi hikoyadir.

en: In the An- cient World, over long periods of time, there had been changes of dynasty and even changes of ruling race and language, but the form of government through monarch and temple remained fairly stable, and still more stable was the ordinary way of living.
uz: An-cient olamida uzoq vaqt davomida sulola o'zgarishi va hatto hukmron irq va til o'zgarishi kuzatilgan edi, ammo monarx va ibodatxona orqali boshqaruv shakli ancha barqaror bo'lib qoldi va oddiy turmush tarzi yanada barqaror edi.

en: In this modern Europe since the sixteenth century the dynastic changes are unimportant, and the interest of history lies in the wide and increasing variety of experiments in political and social organization.
uz: Hozirgi zamonaviy Yevropada o'n oltinchi asrdan beri sulolaviy o'zgarishlar ahamiyatsiz, tarixning qiziqishi esa siyosiy va ijtimoiy tashkilotdagi keng va tobora ko'payib borayotgan tajribalarga bog'liq.

en: The political history of the world from the sixteenth century onward was, we have said, an effort, a largely unconscious effort, of mankind to adapt its political and social methods to certain new conditions that had now arisen.
uz: Dunyo siyosiy tarixi o'n oltinchi asrdan boshlab, biz aytganimizdek, insoniyatning siyosiy va ijtimoiy usullarini hozir paydo bo'lgan ayrim yangi sharoitlarga moslashtirish bo'yicha urinishi, asosan ongsiz urinishi edi.

en: The effort to adapt was complicated by the fad that the conditions them- selves were changing with a steadily increasing rapidity.
uz: Moslashuvga intilish, o'z-o'zlarining sharoitlari doimiy ravishda tez sur'atlar bilan o'zgarib borayotgani sababli murakkablashdi.

en: The adaptation, mainly unconscious and almost always unwilling (for man in general hates voluntary change), has lagged more and more behind the alterations in con- ditions.
uz: Moslashuv, asosan ongsiz va deyarli har doim istaksiz (chunki inson odatda ixtiyoriy o'zgarishlarni yomon ko'radi), sharoitlardagi o'zgarishlardan tobora orqada qoldi.

en: From the sixteenth century onward the history of mankind is a story
uz: O'n oltinchi asrdan boshlab insoniyat tarixi bir hikoya.

en: of political and social institutions becoming more and more plainly misﬁts, less comfortable and more vexatious, and of the slow reluctant realization of the need for a conscious and deliberate reconstruction of the whole scheme of human societies in the face of needs and possibilities new to all the former experiences of life.
uz: Siyosiy va ijtimoiy institutlarning tobora ko'proq noaniq, noqulay va noqulay bo'lib borayotgani, shuningdek, insoniy jamiyatlarning butun sxemasini hayotning barcha oldingi tajribalariga yangi ehtiyojlar va imkoniyatlar qarshisida ongli va ongli qayta qurish zarurligini sekin-asta anglashdan bosh tortish.

en: What are these changes in the conditions of human life that have disorga- nized that balance of empire, priest, peasant and trader, with periodic re- freshment by barbaric conquest, that has held human affairs in the Old World in a sort of working rhythm for more than a hundred centuries?
uz: Insoniyat hayoti sharoitidagi bu o'zgarishlar imperiyasi, ruhoniysi, dehqoni va savdogarining muvozanatini buzgan, vahshiyona bosqinlar bilan davriy yangilanish bilan, bu Eski Dunyoda inson ishlarini yuz asrdan ortiq vaqtdan beri bir xil ish ritmida ushlab turgan?

en: They are manifold and various, for human affairs are multitudinously complex; but the main changes seem all to turn upon one cause, namely the growth and extension of a knowledge of the nature of things, beginning ﬁrst of all in small groups of intelligent people and spreading at ﬁrst slowly, and in the last ﬁve hundred years very rapidly, to larger and larger proportions of the general population.
uz: Ular xilma-xil va xilma-xil, chunki inson ishlari juda murakkab; lekin asosiy o'zgarishlar hammasi bir sababga qaratilgan ko'rinadi, ya'ni narsalar tabiati haqidagi bilimning o'sishi va kengayishi, avvalo aqlli odamlarning kichik guruhlarida boshlanib, dastlab sekin, so'nggi besh yuz yil ichida esa juda tez, umumiy aholining kattaroq va kattaroq ulushlariga tarqalishi.

en: But there has also been a great change in human conditions due to a change in the spirit of human life.
uz: Lekin inson hayotining ruhi o'zgarishi tufayli inson sharoitida ham katta o'zgarish bo'ldi.

en: This change has gone on side by side with the increase and extension of knowledge, and is subtly connected with it.
uz: Bu o'zgarish bilimning ko'payishi va kengayishi bilan yonma-yon bordi va u bilan nozik bog'liq.

en: There has been an increasing disposition to treat a life based on the com- mon and more elementary desires and gratiﬁcations as unsatisfactory, and to seek relationship with and service and participation in a larger life.
uz: Umumiy va oddiyroq istaklar va qoniqishlarga asoslangan hayotni qoniqarsiz deb hisoblash, shuningdek, kengroq hayotda munosabat va xizmat hamda ishtirok izlashga moyillik ortib bormoqda.

en: This is the common characteristic of all the great religions that have spread throughout the world in the last twenty odd centuries, Buddhism, Christian- ity and Islam alike.
uz: Bu so'nggi yigirma g'alati asrlarda butun dunyo bo'ylab tarqalgan barcha buyuk dinlarning umumiy xususiyati, buddizm, xristianlik va islom kabi.

en: They have had to do with the spirit of man in a way that the older religions did not have to do.
uz: Ular inson ruhi bilan qadimgi dinlar bunday munosabatda bo'lmasligi kerak edi.

en: They are forces quite different in their nature and effect from the old fetishistic blood-sacriﬁce religions of priest and temple that they have in part modiﬁed and in part replaced.
uz: Ular ruhoniy va ibodatxonaning eski fetishistik qon qurbonligi dinlaridan o'z tabiati va ta'siri bilan ancha farq qiladigan kuchlardir, ularni qisman o'zgartirib, qisman almashtirgan.

en: They have gradually evolved a self-respect in the individual and a sense of participa- tion and responsibility in the common concerns of mankind that did not ex- ist among the populations of the earlier civilizations.
uz: Ular asta-sekin shaxsdagi o'z-o'ziga hurmatni va insoniyatning umumiy muammolarida ishtirok etish va mas'uliyat tuyg'usini rivojlantirdilar, bu esa avvalgi tsivilizatsiyalar aholisi orasida mavjud emas edi.

en: The ﬁrst considerable change in the conditions of political and social life was the simpliﬁcation and extended use of writing in the ancient civiliza- tions which made larger empires and wider political understandings practi- cable and inevitable.
uz: Siyosiy va ijtimoiy hayot sharoitlaridagi birinchi sezilarli o'zgarish qadimgi sivilizatsiyalarda yozuvning soddalashtirilishi va kengroq qo'llanilishi bo'ldi, bu esa katta imperiyalar va kengroq siyosiy tushunchalarni amaliy va muqarrar qildi.

en: The next movement forward came with the introduc- tion of the horse, and later on of the camel as a means of transport, the use
uz: Keyingi oldinga harakat otning, keyinroq esa tuyaning transport vositasi sifatida joriy etilishi bilan birga keldi, foydalanish.

en: of wheeled vehicles, the extension of roads and the increased military efﬁ- ciency due to the discovery of terrestrial iron.
uz: G'ildirakli transport vositalari, yo'llarning cho'zilishi va quruqlikdagi temir topilishi natijasida harbiy samaradorlikning oshishi.

en: Then followed the profound economic disturbances due to the device of coined money and the change in the nature of debt, proprietorship and trade due to this convenient but dan- gerous convention.
uz: Keyin tanga pul qurilmasi tufayli chuqur iqtisodiy tartibsizliklar va ushbu qulay, ammo qo'rqinchli konvensiya tufayli qarz, mulkchilik va savdo tabiati o'zgarishi kuzatildi.

en: The empires grew in size and range, and men’s ideas grew likewise to correspond with these things.
uz: Imperiyalar o'lchami va diapazoni bo'yicha o'sdi, odamlarning g'oyalari ham shu narsalarga mos ravishda o'sdi.

en: Came the disappearance of local gods, the age of theocrasia, and the teaching of the great world reli- gions.
uz: Mahalliy xudolarning yo'qolishi, teokratiya davri va buyuk jahon dinlarining ta'limoti keldi.

en: Came also the beginnings of reasoned and recorded history and ge- ography, the ﬁrst realization by man of his profound ignorance, and the ﬁrst systematic search for knowledge.
uz: Shuningdek, mulohaza yuritilgan va yozib olingan tarix va geografiyaning boshlanishi, inson o'zining chuqur bilimsizligini birinchi anglashi va bilimni birinchi tizimli izlashi ham keldi.

en: For a time the scientiﬁc process which began so brilliantly in Greece and Alexandria was interrupted.
uz: Gretsiya va Iskandariyada shunday ajoyib tarzda boshlangan ilmiy jarayon bir muddatga to'xtatildi.

en: The raids of the Teutonic barbarians, the west- ward drive of the Mongolian peoples, convulsive religious reconstruction and great pestilences put enormous strains upon political and social order.
uz: Teuton vahshiylarining reydlari, moʻgʻul xalqlarining gʻarbiy-gʻarbiy yurishi, shiddatli diniy rekonstruksiya va katta vabolar siyosiy va ijtimoiy tartibga katta bosim oʻtkazdi.

en: When civilization emerged again from this phase of conﬂict and confusion, slavery was no longer the basis of economic life; and the ﬁrst paper-mills were preparing a new medium for collective information and co-operation in printed matter.
uz: Sivilizatsiya ushbu mojaro va chalkashlik bosqichidan yana paydo bo'lganda, qullik iqtisodiy hayotning asosi bo'lmadi; va birinchi qog'oz tegirmonlari bosma nashrda kollektiv axborot va hamkorlik uchun yangi muhitni tayyorlayotgan edi.

en: Gradually at this point and that, the search for knowledge, the systematic scientiﬁc process, was resumed.
uz: asta-sekin shu nuqtada bilim izlash, tizimli ilmiy jarayon qayta tiklandi.

en: And now from the sixteenth century onward, as an inevitable by-product of systematic thought, appeared a steadily increasing series of inventions and devices affecting the intercommunication and interaction of men with one another.
uz: Va endi o'n oltinchi asrdan boshlab, tizimli fikrlashning muqarrar yon mahsuloti sifatida, odamlarning bir-biri bilan o'zaro aloqasi va o'zaro ta'siriga ta'sir etuvchi doimiy ravishda o'sib borayotgan ixtirolar va qurilmalar seriyasi paydo bo'ldi.

en: They all tended towards wider range of action, greater mutual beneﬁts or injuries, and increased co-operation, and they came faster and faster.
uz: Ularning barchasi kengroq harakatlar doirasiga, katta o'zaro foyda yoki zararga, hamkorlikni kuchaytirishga moyil edi va ular tobora tezroq keldi.

en: Men’s minds had not been prepared for anything of the sort, and until the great catastrophes at the beginning of the twentieth century quickened men’s minds, the historian has very little to tell of any intelligently planned attempts to meet the new conditions this increasing ﬂow of inventions was creating.
uz: Odamlarning ongi hech narsaga tayyorlanmagan edi va XX asr boshidagi buyuk falokatlar odamlarning ongini tezlashtirmaguncha, tarixchi bu ixtirolarning tobora ko'payib borayotgan oqimi yaratayotgan yangi sharoitlarga javob berish uchun aqlli rejalashtirilgan urinishlar haqida juda kam gapiradi.

en: The history of mankind for the last four centuries is rather like that of an imprisoned sleeper, stirring clumsily and uneasily while the prison that restrains and shelters him catches ﬁre, not waking but incorporating the crackling and warmth of the ﬁre with ancient and incongruous dreams, than like that of a man consciously awake to danger and opportunity.
uz: Insoniyatning so'nggi to'rt asrdagi tarixi xuddi qamoqdagi uyquchining o'ziga o'xshab ko'rinadi, u g'alati va noqulay tarzda harakatlanadi, uni ushlab turgan va himoya qiluvchi qamoq olovga uchraydi, uyg'onmay, balki olovning chaqnashi va iliqligini qadimiy va nomuvofiq tushlar bilan birlashtiradi, xatar va imkoniyatdan ongli ravishda uyg'ongan odamnikidek emas.

en: Since history is the story not of individual lives but of communities, it is inevitable that the inventions that ﬁgure most in the historical record are in- ventions affecting communications.
uz: Tarix shaxsiy hayotlar hikoyasi emas, balki jamiyatlar hikoyasi bo'lgani uchun, tarixiy yozuvlarda eng ko'p ko'rsatilgan ixtirolar aloqaga ta'sir etuvchi vositalar bo'lishi muqarrar.

en: In the sixteenth century the chief new
uz: O'n oltinchi asrda bosh yangi

en: things that we have to note are the appearance of printed paper and the sea- worthy, ocean-going sailing ship using the new device of the mariner’s compass.
uz: Biz e'tiborga olishimiz kerak bo'lgan narsalar - bosma qog'ozning ko'rinishi va dengizchi kompasining yangi qurilmasidan foydalangan holda dengizga munosib, okean bo'ylab suzuvchi kemadir.

en: The former cheapened, spread, and revolutionized teaching, pub- lic information and discussion, and the fundamental operations of political activity.
uz: Avvalgi ta'limni arzonlashtirdi, tarqatdi va inqilob qildi, ommaviy axborot va munozara, shuningdek, siyosiy faoliyatning asosiy operatsiyalarini.

en: The latter made the round world one.
uz: Oxirgisi dumaloq dunyoni yagona qildi.

en: But almost equally important was the increased utilization and improvement of guns and gunpowder which the Mongols had ﬁrst brought westward in the thirteenth century.
uz: Lekin deyarli bir xilda muhim bo'lgan narsa, mo'g'ullar birinchi marta o'n uchinchi asrda g'arbga olib kelgan qurol va poroxning ko'payib borishi va takomillashtirilishi edi.

en: This destroyed the practical immunity of barons in their castles and of walled cities.
uz: Bu baronlarning o'z qasrlaridagi va devorli shaharlardagi amaliy immunitetini yo'q qildi.

en: Guns swept away feudalism.
uz: Qurollar feodalizmni yo'q qildi.

en: Constantinople fell to guns.
uz: Konstantinopol qurollarga quladi.

en: Mexico and Peru fell before the terror of the Spanish guns.
uz: Meksika va Peru ispan qurollarining dahshatiga duch keldi.

en: CROMWELL DISSOLVES THE LONG PARLIAMENT AND SO BE- COMES AUTOCRAT OF THE ENGLISH REPUBLIC  (From a contemporary satirical print in the British Museum) The seventeenth century saw the development of systematic scientiﬁc publication, a less conspicuous but ultimately far more pregnant innovation.
uz: KROMVELL UZUN PARLAMENTNI YO'QOTDI VA Shunday qilib, INGLIZ RESPUBLIKASINING AVTOKRATI BO'LDI (Britaniya muzeyidagi zamonaviy satirik nashrdan). O'n yettinchi asrda sistematik ilmiy nashrning rivojlanishi kuzatildi, bu unchalik ko'zga tashlanmaydigan, ammo oxir-oqibatda ancha homilador innovatsiya edi.

en: Conspicuous among the leaders in this great forward step was Sir Francis Bacon (1561-1626) afterwards Lord Verulam, Lord Chancellor of England.
uz: Ushbu buyuk oldinga qadam tashlagan yetakchilar orasida Ser Fransisk Bekon (1561-1626) ko'zga tashlandi, keyinchalik Lord Verulam, Angliya Lord kansleri bo'ldi.

en: He was the pupil and perhaps the mouthpiece of another Englishman; Dr.
uz: U o'quvchisi va ehtimol boshqa inglizning og'zaki vakili edi; Doktor.

en: Gilbert, the experimental philosopher of Colchester (1540-1603).
uz: Gilbert, Kolchesterning eksperimental faylasufi (1540-1603).

en: This sec- ond Bacon, like the ﬁrst, preached observation and experiment, and he used the inspiring and fruitful form of a Utopian story, The New Atlantis, to ex- press his dream of a great service of scientiﬁc research.
uz: Bu sekund Bekon, xuddi birinchisidek, kuzatuv va tajriba haqida va'z qildi va u utopik hikoyaning ilhomlantiruvchi va samarali shaklini, Yangi Atlantidani ilmiy tadqiqotning buyuk xizmati haqidagi orzusini ilgari surdi.

en: Presently arose the Royal Society of London, the Florentine Society, and later other national bodies for the encouragement of research and the publi- cation and exchange of knowledge.
uz: Hozirda London Qirollik Jamiyati, Florensiya Jamiyati va keyinchalik tadqiqotlarni rag'batlantirish, nashr etish va bilim almashishni rag'batlantirish uchun boshqa milliy organlar tashkil etildi.

en: These European scientiﬁc societies be- came fountains not only of countless inventions but also of a destructive criticism of the grotesque theological history of the world that had dominat- ed and crippled human thought for many centuries.
uz: Bu Yevropa ilmiy jamiyatlari nafaqat son-sanoqsiz ixtirolar, balki ko'p asrlar davomida insoniy tafakkurni hukmronlik qilgan va falaj qilgan dunyoning g'alati teologik tarixini vayron qiluvchi tanqid qilish manbalariga ham aylandi.

en: Neither the seventeenth nor the eighteenth century witnessed any innova- tions so immediately revolutionary in human conditions as printed paper and the ocean-going ship, but there was a steady accumulation of knowl- edge and scientiﬁc energy that was to bear its full fruits in the nineteenth century.
uz: Na o'n yettinchi, na o'n sakkizinchi asr bosma qog'oz va okeanda suzuvchi kema kabi inson sharoitida darhol inqilobiy bo'lgan hech qanday innovatsiyaga guvoh bo'lmadi, lekin o'n to'qqizinchi asrda bilim va ilmiy energiyaning doimiy to'planishi o'z to'liq mevasini berishi kerak edi.

en: The exploration and mapping of the world went on.
uz: Dunyoni o'rganish va xaritalash davom etdi.

en: Tasmania, Australia, New Zealand appeared on the map.
uz: Tasmaniya, Avstraliya, Yangi Zelandiya xaritada paydo bo'ldi.

en: In Great Britain in the eigh- teenth century coal coke began to be used for metallurgical purposes, lead- ing to a considerable cheapening of iron and to the possibility of casting and using it in larger pieces than had been possible before, when it had been smelted with wood charcoal.
uz: Buyuk Britaniyada XVIII asrda ko'mir koksi metallurgiya maqsadlarida ishlatila boshlandi, bu temirning sezilarli darajada arzonlashuviga va uni yog'och ko'mir bilan eritilganda avvaldan mumkin bo'lganidan kattaroq bo'laklarga quyish va ishlatish imkoniyatiga olib keldi.

en: Modern machinery dawned.
uz: Zamonaviy uskunalar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Like the trees of the celestial city, science bears bud and ﬂower and fruit at the same time and continuously.
uz: Osmoniy shahar daraxtlari kabi, fan bir vaqtning o'zida va uzluksiz ravishda kurtaklar, gullar va mevalar beradi.

en: With the onset of the nineteenth century the real fruition of science—which indeed henceforth may never cease— began.
uz: XIX asr boshlanishi bilan fanning haqiqiy yutuqlari boshlandi  bu esa bundan buyon hech qachon to'xtamaydi.

en: First came steam and steel, the railway, the great liner, vast bridges and buildings, machinery of almost limitless power, the possibility of a bountiful satisfaction of every material human need, and then, still more wonderful, the hidden treasures of electrical science were opened to men ....
uz: Avval bug' va po'lat keldi, temir yo'l, ulkan layner, ulkan ko'priklar va binolar, deyarli cheksiz quvvatga ega mashinalar, har bir moddiy insoniy ehtiyojni mo'l-ko'l qondirish imkoniyati, keyin esa, yanada ajoyibrog'i, elektr fanining yashirin xazinalari odamlarga ochildi...

en: We have compared the political and social life of man from the sixteenth century onward to that of a sleeping prisoner who lies and dreams while his prison burns about him.
uz: Biz o'n oltinchi asrdan boshlab insonning siyosiy va ijtimoiy hayotini uyqudagi mahbusning o'ziga yaqin qamoqxona yonayotganda yotadigan va orzu qiladigan hayotiga o'xshatdik.

en: In the sixteenth century the European mind was still going on with its Latin Imperial dream, its dream of a Holy Roman Empire, united under a Catholic Church.
uz: XVI asrda Yevropa ongi hali ham o'zining Lotin imperatorlik orzusi, Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi orzusi bilan davom etayotgan edi, katolik cherkovi ostida birlashgan edi.

en: But just as some uncontrollable
uz: Lekin xuddi nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan ba'zi narsalar kabi.

en: element in our composition will insist at times upon introducing into our dreams the most absurd and destructive comments, so thrust into this dream we ﬁnd the sleeping face and craving stomach of the Emperor Charles V, while Henry VIII of England and Luther tear the unity of Catholicism to shreds.
uz: Bizning kompozitsiyamizdagi element ba'zan tushlarimizga eng bema'ni va vayronkor izohlarni kiritishda qat'iy turadi, shuning uchun bu tushga imperator Charlz V ning uyqudagi yuzi va ishtiyoqli qorni tushadi, Angliyalik Genrix VIII va Lyuter esa katolizm birlikini parchalaydi.

en: THE COURT AT VERSAILLES  (From the print after Watteau in the British Museum) In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the dream turned to personal monarchy.
uz: VERSAILLESDAGI SUD (Britaniya Muzeyining Watto nomidan chop etilgan) O'n yettinchi va o'n sakkizinchi asrlarda orzu shaxsiy monarxiyaga aylandi.

en: The history of nearly all Europe during this period tells with variations the story of an attempt to consolidate a monarchy, to make it ab- solute and to extend its power over weaker adjacent regions, and of the steady resistance, ﬁrst of the landowners and then with the increase of for- eign trade and home industry, of the growing trading and moneyed class, to the exaction and interference of the crown.
uz: Ushbu davrdagi deyarli butun Yevropaning tarixi monarxiyani mustahkamlash, uni qo'lga kiritish va kuchini zaifroq qo'shni hududlar ustidan kengaytirishga urinish, avval yer egalarining, keyin esa tashqi savdo va uy sanoatining ko'payishi, o'sib borayotgan savdo va pullik sinfining tojning harakatlari va aralashuviga doimiy qarshilik ko'rsatish haqidagi hikoyani o'zgaruvchanlik bilan aytib beradi.

en: There is no universal victory of either side; here it is the King who gets the upper hand while there it is the man of private property who beats the King.
uz: Hech qanday tomonning universal g'alabasi yo'q; bu yerda qirol ustunlik qiladi, u yerda esa xususiy mulk egasi qirolni mag'lub etadi.

en: In one case we ﬁnd a King be- coming the sun and centre of his national world, while just over his borders a sturdy mercantile class maintains a republic.
uz: Bir holatda biz qirolni topamiz - quyosh va o'z milliy olamining markazi bo'lib kelayotgan, shu bilan birga uning chegaralaridan biroz narida mustahkam tijorat sinfi respublikani saqlab turadi.

en: So wide a range of variation
uz: Shunday keng turli xillik diapazoni

en: shows how entirely experimental, what local accidents, were all the various governments of this period.
uz: Bu davrning turli hukumatlari qanchalik butunlay eksperimental, qanday mahalliy baxtsiz hodisalar bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

en: A very common ﬁgure in these national dramas is the King’s minister, often in the still Catholic countries a prelate, who stands behind the King, serves him and dominates him by his indispensable services.
uz: Bu milliy dramalarda juda keng tarqalgan shaxs qirolning vaziri bo'ladi, ko'pincha katolik bo'lgan mamlakatlarda u qirolning orqasida turib, unga xizmat qiladi va uning zarur xizmatlari bilan hukmronlik qiladi.

en: Here in the limits set to us it is impossible to tell these various national dramas in detail.
uz: Bu yerda bizga qo'yilgan chegaralarda bu turli milliy dramalarni batafsil aytib bo'lmaydi.

en: The trading folk of Holland went Protestant and republi- can, and cast off the rule of Philip II of Spain, the son of the Emperor Charles V.
uz: Gollandiyalik savdogarlar protestantlarga aylandi va qayta tiklandi va imperator Charlz V ning o'g'li Ispaniyalik Filipp II hukmronligini rad etdi.

en: In England Henry VIII and his minister Wolsey, Queen Elizabeth and her minister Burleigh, prepared the foundations of an absolutism that was wrecked by the folly of James I and Charles I.
uz: Angliyada Genrix VIII va uning vaziri Volsi, qirolicha Yelizaveta va uning vaziri Burli Jeyms I va Charlz I tentakliklari natijasida vayron bo'lgan absolutizm poydevorini tayyorladilar.

en: Charles I was beheaded for treason to his people (1649), a new turn in the political thought of Eu- rope.
uz: Charlz I o'z xalqiga xiyonat qilgani uchun (1649) boshini kesib tashlandi, bu Yevropa siyosiy fikrlashida yangi burilish edi.

en: For a dozen years (until 1660) Britain was a republic; and the crown was an unstable power, much overshadowed by Parliament, until George III (1760-1820) made a strenuous and partly successful effort to restore its pre- dominance.
uz: O'n yil davomida (1660. yilgacha) Britaniya respublika edi; va toj beqaror kuch edi, Parlament tomonidan ancha soyada qoldirildi, toki Jorj III (1760-1820). o'zining oldingi hukmronligini tiklash uchun qattiq va qisman muvaffaqiyatli harakat qildi.

en: The King of France, on the other hand, was the most successful of all the European Kings in perfecting monarchy.
uz: Fransiya qiroli esa, boshqa tomondan, monarxiyani takomillashtirishda Yevropa qirollarining eng muvaffaqiyatli biri edi.

en: Two great ministers, Richelieu (1585-1642) and Mazarin (1602-1661), built up the power of the crown in that country, and the process was aided by the long reign and very considerable abilities of King Louis XIV, “the Grand Monarque” (1643- 1715).
uz: Ikki buyuk vazir, Richelieu (1585-1642) va Mazarin (1602-1661), o'sha mamlakatda toj kuchini mustahkamladilar va bu jarayonga qirol Lui XIV ning uzoq hukmronligi va juda sezilarli qobiliyatlari, Buyuk Monark (1643- 1715) yordam berdi.

en: Louis XIV was indeed the pattern King of Europe.
uz: Lyudovik XIV haqiqatan ham Yevropaning namunaviy qiroli edi.

en: He was, within his limitations, an exceptionally capable King; his ambition was stronger than his baser passions, and he guided his country towards bankruptcy through the complication of a spirited foreign policy with an elaborate dignity that still extorts our admiration.
uz: U o'z imkoniyatlari doirasida nihoyatda qobiliyatli shoh edi; uning ambitsiyalari pastroq ehtiroslaridan kuchliroq edi va u o'z mamlakatini bankrotlikka yo'naltirdi, bu esa bizning hayratimizni hali ham tortib kelayotgan murakkab tashqi siyosat edi.

en: His immediate desire was to consolidate and extend France to the Rhine and Pyrenees, and to absorb the Spanish Nether- lands; his remoter view saw the French Kings as the possible successors of Charlemagne in a recast Holy Roman Empire.
uz: Uning bevosita istagi Fransiyani Reyn va Pireneya daryolarigacha mustahkamlash va kengaytirish, shuningdek, Ispaniya Niderlandiya yerlarini o'z ichiga olish edi; uning uzoqroq nuqtai nazarida Fransiya qirollari Muqaddas Rim imperiyasini qayta tiklashda Charlz Buyukning mumkin bo'lgan vorislari sifatida ko'rinardi.

en: He made bribery a state method almost more important than warfare.
uz: U poraxo'rlikni urushdan ko'ra deyarli muhimroq davlat usuliga aylantirdi.

en: Charles II of England was in his pay, and so were most of the Polish nobility, presently to be described.
uz: Angliyalik Charlz II ham uning paytida edi, shuningdek, hozirda ta'riflanadigan Polsha zodagonlarining aksariyati ham.

en: His money, or rather the money of the tax- paying classes in France, went everywhere.
uz: Uning puli, to'g'rirog'i Fransiyadagi soliq to'laydigan sinflarning puli hamma joyga ketardi.

en: But his prevailing occupation was splendour.
uz: Ammo uning hukmron kasb-hunari hashamat edi.

en: His great palace at Versailles with its salons, its corridors, its mirrors, its terraces and foun- tains and parks and prospects, was the envy and admiration of the world.
uz: Uning Versaldagi buyuk saroyi, o'z salonlari, yo'laklari, oynalari, terassalari, faun-taynlari, parklari va istiqbollari bilan dunyo havasida edi va hayratda edi.

en: THE SACK OF A VILLAGE DURING THE FRENCH REVOLUTION  (From Callot’s “Miseres de la Guerre”) He provoked a universal imitation.
uz: FRANSIYA INQILOBIDAN O'TGAN QISH QISMINING XALQASI (Callotning Miseres de la Guerre asaridan) U universal taqlidni keltirib chiqardi.

en: Every king and princelet in Europe was building his own Versailles as much beyond his means as his subjects and credits would permit.
uz: Yevropadagi har bir podshoh va shahzoda o'z Versalesini o'z fuqarolari va kreditlari ruxsat berganicha, o'z imkoniyatlaridan tashqari qurayotgan edi.

en: Everywhere the nobility rebuilt or extended their chateaux to the new pattern.
uz: Hamma joyda zodagonlar o'z saroylarini yangi naqshga qayta qurdilar yoki kengaytirdilar.

en: A great industry of beautiful and elaborate fab- rics and furnishings developed.
uz: Go'zal va murakkab fabrikalar va mebellarning ajoyib sanoati rivojlandi.

en: The luxurious arts ﬂourished everywhere; sculpture in alabaster, faience, gilt woodwork, metal work, stamped leather, much music, magniﬁcent painting, beautiful printing and bindings, ﬁne crockery, ﬁne vintages.
uz: Hashamatli san'at hamma joyda gullab-yashnadi; alabaster haykaltaroshligi, fayence, oltin yog'och, metall ishlov berish, shtamplangan charm, ko'p musiqa, ajoyib rassomlik, chiroyli bosma va bog'lamalar, nozik duradgorlik, nozik vintage.

en: Amidst the mirrors and ﬁne furniture went a strange race of “gentlemen” in tall powdered wigs, silks and laces, poised upon high red heels, supported by amazing canes; and still more wonderful “ladies,” under towers of powdered hair and wearing vast expansions of silk and satin sustained on wire.
uz: Ko'zgular va nozik mebellar orasida baland poshnali tukli, ipak va bog'ichli, baland qizil poshnali, ajoyib tayoqlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlangan jentelmenlarning g'alati poygasi bor edi; va yanada ajoyib xonimlar ham, poshnali sochli minoralar ostida va simda ushlab turilgan ipak va satindan iborat ulkan kengliklarda.

en: Through it all postured the great Louis, the sun of his world, unaware of the meagre and sulky and bitter faces that watched him from those lower darknesses to which his sunshine did not penetrate.
uz: Bularning barchasida buyuk Lui, o'z dunyosining quyoshi, o'zini quyoshi kirmagan quyi zulmatlardan uni kuzatib turgan mayda, achchiq va achchiq yuzlardan bexabar ko'rinardi.

en: The German people remained politically divided throughout this period of the monarchies and experimental governments, and a considerable num- ber of ducal and princely courts aped the splendours of Versailles on vary- ing scales.
uz: Nemis xalqi monarxiyalar va tajribaviy hukumatlarning bu davrida siyosiy jihatdan bo'linishda qoldi va gersoglik va knyazlik saroylarining sezilarli soni Versal shon-shuhratini turli miqyosda qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: The Thirty Years’ War (1618-48), a devastating scramble among the Germans, Swedes and Bohemians for ﬂuctuating political advantages, sapped the energies of Germany for a century.
uz: O'ttiz yillik urush (1618-48), nemislar, shvedlar va bohemlar o'rtasida siyosiy afzalliklar uchun halokatli kurash, Germaniyaning energiyasini bir asr davomida yo'qotdi.

en: A map must show the crazy patchwork in which this struggle ended, a map of Europe according to the peace of Westphalia (1648).
uz: Xaritada bu kurash qanday tugaydi, Vestfaliya tinchligiga ko'ra Yevropaning xaritasi (1648) ko'rsatilishi kerak.

en: One sees a tangle of principalities, dukedoms, free states and the like, some partly in and partly out of the Empire.
uz: Knyazliklar, knyazliklar, erkin davlatlar va shunga o'xshashlarning chalkashligini ko'rish mumkin, ba'zilari qisman Imperiyada va qisman undan tashqarida.

en: Swe- den’s arm, the reader will note, reached far into Germany; and except for a few islands of territory within the imperial boundaries France was still far
uz: O'quvchi ta'kidlashicha, Swe-denning qo'li Germaniyagacha yetib borgan; va imperiya chegaralari ichidagi bir nechta orollardan tashqari, Fransiya hali ham uzoqda edi.

en: Amidst this patchwork the Kingdom of Prussia—it became a Kingdom in 1701—rose steadily to prominence and sustained a series of successful wars.
uz: Bu patchwork o'rtasida Prussiya Qirolligi  1701-yilda Qirollikka aylandi  barqaror ravishda mashhurlikka ko'tarildi va bir qator muvaffaqiyatli urushlarni davom ettirdi.

en: Frederick the Great of Prussia (1740-86) had his Versailles at Potsdam, where his court spoke French, read French literature and ri- valled the culture of the French King.
uz: Fridrix Buyuk Prussiyalik (1740-86) Versalda Potsdamda o'z saroyini qurgan, u yerda uning saroyi fransuz tilida gapirgan, fransuz adabiyotini o'qigan va fransuz qirolining madaniyatini qadrlagan.

en: In 1714 the Elector of Hanover became King of England, adding one more to the list of monarchies half in and half out of the empire.
uz: 1714-yilda Gannoverlik Saylovchi Angliya Qiroli bo'ldi va imperiyaning yarmi va yarmi bo'lgan monarxiyalar ro'yxatiga yana bir marta qo'shdi.

en: The Austrian branch of the descendants of Charles V retained the title of Emperor; the Spanish branch retained Spain.
uz: Charlz V avlodlarining Avstriya filiali imperator unvonini saqlab qoldi; Ispaniya filiali Ispaniyani saqlab qoldi.

en: But now there was also an Emperor of the East again.
uz: Ammo endi yana Sharq imperatori ham bor edi.

en: After the fall of Constantinople (1453), the grand duke of Moscow, Ivan the Great (1462-1505), claimed to be heir to the Byzantine throne and adopted the Byzantine double-headed eagle upon his arms.
uz: Konstantinopol qulagandan so'ng (1453), Moskva buyuk gersogi Ivan Buyuk (1462-1505) Vizantiya taxtiga voris bo'lishni da'vo qildi va Vizantiya ikki boshli burgutini o'z qo'llariga oldi.

en: His grandson, Ivan IV, Ivan the Terrible (1533-1584), assumed the imperial title of Cæsar (Tsar).
uz: Uning nabirasi Ivan IV, Ivan dahshatli (1533-1584), imperator unvonini podshoh deb qabul qildi.

en: But only in the latter half of the seventeenth century did Russia cease to seem remote and Asiatic to the European mind.
uz: Lekin faqat XVII asrning oxirgi yarmida Rossiya Yevropa ongiga uzoq va osiyolik ko'rinishni to'xtatdi.

en: The Tsar Peter the Great (1682-1725) brought Russia into the arena of Western affairs.
uz: Shoh Pyotr Buyuk (1682-1725) Rossiyani G'arb ishlarining maydoniga olib kirdi.
