en: He built a new capital for his empire, Petersburg upon the Neva, that played the part of a window between Russia and Europe, and he set up his Versailles at Peterhof eighteen miles away, employing a French architect who gave him a terrace, fountains, cascades, picture gallery, park and all the recognized appointments of Grand Monarchy.
uz: U o'z imperiyasi uchun yangi poytaxt, Rossiya va Yevropa o'rtasidagi deraza rolini o'ynaydigan Peterburgni Neva ustida qurdi va o'n sakkiz milya uzoqlikda joylashgan Peterhofda o'zining Versalini qurdi, unga terassa, favvoralar, kaskadlar, rasmlar galereyasi, park va Buyuk monarxiyaning barcha tan olingan joylarini bergan fransuz me'morini ishga oldi.

en: In Russia as in Prussia French became the language of the court.
uz: Rossiyada Prussiya kabi fransuz tili ham saroy tiliga aylandi.

en: Unhappily placed between Austria, Prussia and Russia was the Polish kingdom, an ill-organized state of great landed proprietors too jealous of their own individual grandeur to permit more than a nominal kingship to the monarch they elected.
uz: Avstriya, Prussiya va Rossiya o'rtasida baxtsiz holatda joylashgan Polsha qirolligi, o'zlari saylagan monarxga nominal qirollikdan ko'ra ko'proq narsa berishga o'zlarining shaxsiy ulug'vorligiga hasad qiladigan buyuk yer egalarining noto'g'ri tashkil etilgan davlati edi.

en: Her fate was division among these three neighbours, in spite of the efforts of France to retain her as an independent ally.
uz: Uning taqdiri Fransiyaning uni mustaqil ittifoqchi sifatida saqlab qolish harakatlariga qaramay, bu uch qo'shni o'rtasida bo'linish edi.

en: Switzer- land at this time was a group of republican cantons; Venice was a republic; Italy like so much of Germany was divided among minor dukes and princes.
uz: Shveytsariya yerlari o'sha paytda respublika kantonlari guruhi edi; Venetsiya respublika edi; Italiya, Germaniya kabi, kichik gersoglar va shahzodalar orasida bo'lingan edi.

en: The Pope ruled like a prince in the papal states, too fearful now of losing the allegiance of the remaining Catholic princes to interfere between them and their subjects or to remind the world of the commonweal of Chris- tendom.
uz: Rim Papasi Papa davlatlarida shahzoda kabi hukmronlik qildi, hozirda qolgan katolik shahzodalarning sadoqatini yo'qotishdan qo'rqib, ularning va ularning fuqarolari o'rtasida aralashishga yoki dunyoga Chris- tendomning umumiy ahvolini eslatishga majbur edi.

en: There remained indeed no common political idea in Europe at all; Europe was given over altogether to division and diversity.
uz: Yevropada umuman umumiy siyosiy g'oya qolmadi; Yevropa butunlay bo'linish va xilma-xillikka berilgan edi.

en: All these sovereign princes and republics carried on schemes of aggran- dizement against each other.
uz: Bu suveren shahzodalar va respublikalarning barchasi bir-biriga qarshi tajovuzkorlik sxemalarini amalga oshirdi.

en: Each one of them pursued a “foreign policy” of aggression against its neighbours and of aggressive alliances.
uz: Ularning har biri qo'shnilariga nisbatan tajovuzkorlik va tajovuzkor ittifoqlarning chet el siyosatini yuritdi.

en: We Euro- peans still live to-day in the last phase of this age of the multifarious sov- ereign states, and still suffer from the hatreds, hostilities and suspicions it engendered.
uz: Biz yevropaliklar bugungi kunda ham turli sovet davlatlarining oxirgi davrida yashayapmiz va u keltirib chiqaradigan nafrat, dushmanlik va gumonlardan aziyat chekmoqdamiz.

en: The history of this time becomes more and more manifestly “gossip,” more and more unmeaning and wearisome to a modern intelli- gence.
uz: Bu davr tarixi tobora ko'proq g'iybatga aylanib bormoqda, zamonaviy aql uchun tobora bema'ni va zerikarli bo'lib bormoqda.

en: You are told of how this war was caused by this King’s mistress, and how the jealousy of one minister for another caused that.
uz: Sizga bu urushga bu qirolning bekasi qanday sabab bo'lgani va bir vazirning boshqa vazirga bo'lgan rashki bunga qanday sabab bo'lgani haqida aytiladi.

en: A tittle-tattle of bribes and rivalries disgusts the intelligent student.
uz: Pora va raqobat haqidagi mayda-chuyda gaplar aqlli talabani jirkanadi.

en: The more permanently signiﬁcant fact is that in spite of the obstruction of a score of frontiers, read- ing and thought still spread and increased and inventions multiplied.
uz: Aniqrog'i, bir qator chegaralar to'sib qo'yilganiga qaramay, o'qish va fikrlash hali ham tarqaldi va ko'paydi va ixtirolar ko'paydi.

en: The eighteenth century saw the appearance of a literature profoundly sceptical and critical of the courts and policies of the time.
uz: XVIII asr o'sha davrdagi sudlar va siyosatga chuqur shubha va tanqid qiluvchi adabiyotning paydo bo'lishini ko'rdi.

en: In such a book as Voltaire’s Candide we have the expression of an inﬁnite weariness with the planless confusion of the European world.
uz: Volterning Candide kabi kitobda biz Yevropa olamining rejasiz chalkashligi bilan cheksiz charchoq ifodasini topamiz.

en: LIII THE NEW EMPIRES OF THE EUROPEANS IN ASIA AND OVERSEAS While Central Europe thus remained divided and confused, the Western Eu- ropeans and particularly the Dutch, the Scandinavians, the Spanish, the Por- tuguese, the French and the British were extending the area of their strug- gles across the seas of all the world.
uz: Osiyo va UZBETDAGI EUROPEYALARNING YANGI EMPIRYOTLARI Markaziy Yevropa shunday bo'linish va chalkashlik ostida qolgan bir paytda, G'arbiy Yevropaliklar va ayniqsa Gollandiyaliklar, Skandinaviyaliklar, Ispanlar, Por-Tugueslar, Fransuzlar va Britaniyalar o'z kurash maydonini butun dunyo dengizlari bo'ylab kengaytirmoqdalar.

en: The printing press had dissolved the political ideas of Europe into a vast and at ﬁrst indeterminate fermentation, but that other great innovation, the ocean-going sailing ship, was inexorably extending the range of European experience to the furthermost limits of salt water.
uz: Bosmaxona Yevropaning siyosiy g'oyalarini ulkan va dastlab aniq bo'lmagan fermentatsiyaga aylantirib yuborgan edi, ammo bu boshqa buyuk yangilik, okean bo'ylab suzuvchi kema, Yevropa tajribasining doirasini tuzli suvning eng chekka chegaralarigacha tinimsiz kengaytirardi.

en: The ﬁrst overseas settlements of the Dutch and Northern Atlantic Euro- peans were not for colonization but for trade and mining.
uz: Gollandiyalik va Shimoliy Atlantika Yevropaliklarining birinchi xorijiy aholi punktlari mustamlakachilik uchun emas, balki savdo va konchilik uchun edi.

en: The Spaniards were ﬁrst in the ﬁeld; they claimed dominion over the whole of this new world of America.
uz: Ispanlar birinchi bo'lib maydonga tushishdi; ular butun Amerika yangi dunyosi ustidan hukmronlik qilishni talab qilishdi.

en: Very soon however the Portuguese asked for a share.
uz: Tez orada portugallar ulush so'rashdi.

en: The Pope—it was one of the last acts of Rome as mistress of the world—divided the new continent between these two ﬁrst-comers, giving Portugal Brazil and everything else east of a line 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde is- lands, and all the rest to Spain (1494).
uz: Rim Papasi  bu Rimning dunyoning bekasi sifatidagi so'nggi harakatlaridan biri edi  yangi qit'ani bu ikki birinchi kelgan o'rtasida bo'lib, Portugaliyaga Braziliyani va Kab Verde orolining g'arbida joylashgan chiziqdan 370 ligadan sharqda qolgan hamma narsani, qolganini esa Ispaniyaga (1494) berdi.

en: The Portuguese at this time were also pushing overseas enterprise southward and eastward.
uz: Portugaliyaliklar o'sha paytda chet el korxonalarini ham janubga va sharqqa surishardi.

en: In 1497 Vasco da Gama had sailed from Lisbon round the Cape to Zanzibar and then to Cali- cut in India.
uz: 1497-yilda Vasko da Gama Lissabondan Keyp boʻylab Zanzibarga va keyin Hindistondagi Kaliga suzib borgan edi.

en: In 1515 there were Portuguese ships in Java and the Moluccas, and the Portuguese were setting up and fortifying trading stations round and about the coasts of the Indian Ocean.
uz: 1515-yilda Java va Molukka orollarida portugal kemalari bor edi va portugallar Hind okeani qirg'oqlari atrofida va atrofida savdo stansiyalarini o'rnatib, mustahkamlab turishardi.

en: Mozambique, Goa, and two smaller possessions in India, Macao in China and a part of Timor are to this day Portuguese possessions.
uz: Mozambik, Goa va Hindistondagi ikkita kichikroq mulk, Xitoydagi Makao va Timorning bir qismi bugungi kungacha Portugaliya mulki hisoblanadi.

en: The nations excluded from America by the papal settlement paid little heed to the rights of Spain and Portugal.
uz: Rim papasi tomonidan Amerikadan chetlatilgan millatlar Ispaniya va Portugaliya huquqlariga unchalik e'tibor bermadilar.

en: The English, the Danes and Swedes, and presently the Dutch, were soon staking out claims in North America and the West Indies, and his Most Catholic Majesty of France heeded the papal settlement as little as any Protestant.
uz: Inglizlar, daniyaliklar va shvedlar, hozirda gollandlar, tez orada Shimoliy Amerika va G'arbiy Hindistonda da'volarni qo'zg'atishardi va Fransiyaning eng katolik oliyligi papalik kelishuvga har qanday protestant kabi kam e'tibor berardi.

en: The wars of Europe extended themselves to these claims and possessions.
uz: Yevropa urushlari shu da'volar va mulklargacha cho'zilgan edi.

en: In the long run the English were the most successful in this scramble for overseas possessions.
uz: Uzoq muddatda inglizlar chet el mulklari uchun bu kurashda eng muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishdi.

en: The Danes and Swedes were too deeply entangled in
uz: Daniyaliklar va shvedlar juda chuqur aralashgan edi.

en: the complicated affairs of Germany to sustain effective expeditions abroad.
uz: Germaniyaning murakkab ishlarini chet elga samarali ekspeditsiyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun.

en: Sweden was wasted upon the German battleﬁelds by a picturesque king, Gustavus Adolphus, the Protestant “Lion of the North.” The Dutch were the heirs of such small settlements as Sweden made in America, and the Dutch were too near French aggressions to hold their own against the British.
uz: Shvetsiya nemis jang maydonlariga protestant Gustav Adolphus, Shimoliy sher nomli go'zal qirol tomonidan vayron qilindi. Gollandiyaliklar Shvetsiya Amerikada qilganidek kichik aholi punktlarining merosxo'ri edilar va Gollandiyaliklar Britaniyaga qarshi fransuz tajovuzlariga juda yaqin edilar.

en: In the far East the chief rivals for empire were the British, Dutch and French, and in America the British, French and Spanish.
uz: Uzoq Sharqda imperiya uchun asosiy raqiblar Britaniya, Golland va Fransuzlar, Amerikada esa Britaniya, Fransuz va Ispaniya edi.

en: The British had the supreme advantage of a water frontier, the “silver streak” of the English Channel, against Europe.
uz: Britaniyaliklar Yevropaga qarshi Angliya kanalining kumush chizig'i bo'lgan suv chegarasidagi oliy ustunlikka ega edilar.

en: The tradition of the Latin Empire entangled them least.
uz: Lotin imperiyasining an'anasi ularni eng kam chalkashtirdi.

en: EUROPEANS TIGER HUNTING IN INDIA  (From the engraving of the picture by Zoffany in the British Museum) France has always thought too much in terms of Europe.
uz: YEVROPA YO'LCHILARI HINDISTONDA ovlanadi (Britaniya muzeyidagi Zoffanning rasmini o'yib yozganidan boshlab) Fransiya doimo Yevropa nuqtai nazaridan haddan tashqari ko'p o'ylagan.

en: Throughout the eighteenth century she was wasting her opportunities of expansion in West and East alike in order to dominate Spain, Italy and the German confusion.
uz: O'n sakkizinchi asr davomida u G'arbda ham, Sharqda ham kengayish imkoniyatlarini Ispaniya, Italiya va Germaniya chalkashligiga hukmronlik qilish uchun behuda sarflagan edi.

en: The religious and political dissensions of Britain in the seventeenth century had driven many of the English to seek a permanent home in America.
uz: XVII asrda Britaniyaning diniy va siyosiy bo'linishlari ko'plab inglizlarni Amerikada doimiy yashash joyiga izlashga undadi.

en: They struck root and increased and multiplied, giving the British a great ad- vantage in the American struggle.
uz: Ular ildiz otdi, ko'paydi va ko'paydi, bu esa inglizlarga Amerika kurashida katta ustunlik berdi.

en: In 1756 and 1760 the French lost Canada to the British and their American colonists, and a few years later the British trading company found itself completely dominant over French, Dutch and Portuguese in the peninsula of India.
uz: 1756 va 1760-yillarda fransuzlar Kanadaning Britaniya va ularning Amerikalik mustamlakachilari qo'liga yo'qotdilar, va bir necha yildan so'ng Britaniya savdo kompaniyasi Hindiston yarim orolida fransuz, golland va portugallarga nisbatan butunlay ustunlik qilganini aniqladi.

en: The great Mongol Empire of Baber, Akbar and their successors had now far gone in decay, and the story of its practical capture by a London trading company, the British East India Com- pany, is one of the most extraordinary episodes in the whole history of conquest.
uz: Bober, Akbar va ularning vorislarining buyuk moʻgʻul imperiyasi endi ancha parchalanib ketgan edi va uning London savdo kompaniyasi, Britaniya Sharqiy Hindiston Kom-pani tomonidan amaliy qoʻlga kiritilishi haqidagi hikoya butun zabt etish tarixidagi eng favqulodda epizodlardan biridir.

en: THE LAST EFFORT AND FALL OF TIPPOO SULTAN  (From the engraving of the picture by Singleton in the British Museum) This East India Company had been originally at the time of its incorpora- tion under Queen Elizabeth no more than a company of sea adventurers.
uz: TIPPO SULTONNING SO'NGGI SA'YOHI VA POYISHI (Britaniya muzeyidagi Singletonning suratini o'yib yozganidan) Ushbu Sharqiy Hindiston Kompaniyasi qirolicha Yelizaveta qo'l ostida tashkil topgan paytda dengiz sarguzashtchilari kompaniyasidan ko'proq narsa emas edi.

en: Step by step they had been forced to raise troops and arm their ships.
uz: Ular qadam-baqadam qo'shin to'plashga va kemalarini qurollantirishga majbur bo'lishdi.

en: And now this trading company, with its tradition of gain, found itself dealing not merely in spices and dyes and tea and jewels, but in the revenues and terri- tories of princes and the destinies of India.
uz: Endi bu savdo kompaniyasi o'zining daromad an'anasi bilan faqat ziravorlar, bo'yoqlar, choy va javohirlar bilan emas, balki shahzodalarning daromadlari va yerlari hamda Hindiston taqdirlari bilan shug'ullanayotganini ko'rdi.

en: It had come to buy and sell, and it found itself achieving a tremendous piracy.
uz: U sotib olish va sotish uchun kelgan edi va o'zini ulkan qaroqchilikka erishayotganini ko'rdi.

en: There was no one to challenge
uz: Hech kimga qarshi chiqishga imkon yo'q edi.

en: Is it any wonder that its captains and commanders and ofﬁ- cials, nay, even its clerks and common soldiers, came back to England loaded with spoils?
uz: Uning kapitanlari, qo'mondonlari va mansabdor shaxslari, hatto kotiblari va oddiy askarlari ham Angliyaga o'ljalar bilan qaytgani ajablanarli emasmi?

en: Men under such circumstances, with a great and wealthy land at their mercy, could not determine what they might or might not do.
uz: Bunday sharoitda, o'z qo'llarida buyuk va boy yurt bo'lgan odamlar, nima qilishlari yoki qilmasliklari mumkinligini aniqlay olishmas edi.

en: It was a strange land to them, with a strange sunlight; its brown people seemed a different race, outside their range of sympathy; its mysterious temples sus- tained fantastic standards of behaviour.
uz: U ular uchun g'alati zamin edi, g'alati quyosh nuri bilan; uning jigarrang xalqi ularning hamdardlik doirasidan tashqarida boshqa irqdek ko'rinardi; uning sirli ibodatxonalari fantastik xulq-atvor standartlarini qo'llab-quvvatlardi.

en: Englishmen at home were perplexed when presently these generals and ofﬁcials came back to make dark accusa- tions against each other of extortions and cruelties.
uz: Inglizlar uyda hayron bo'lishdi, chunki hozirda bu generallar va amaldorlar bir-birlariga nisbatan tovlamachilik va shafqatsizliklarda qora ayblovlar qo'yish uchun qaytib kelishdi.

en: Upon Clive Parliament passed a vote of censure.
uz: Klayv Parlament tanqid ovozini qabul qildi.

en: He committed suicide in 1774.
uz: U 1774 yilda o'z joniga qasd qildi.

en: In 1788 Warren Hastings, a second great Indian administrator, was impeached and acquitted (1792).
uz: 1788-yilda ikkinchi buyuk hindistonlik administrator Warren Hastings impichmentga uchradi va oqlandi (1792).

en: It was a strange and unprecedented situation in the world’s history.
uz: Bu dunyo tarixida g'alati va misli ko'rilmagan vaziyat edi.

en: The English Parliament found itself ruling over a London trading company, which in its turn was dominating an empire far greater and more populous than all the domains of the British crown.
uz: Ingliz Parlamenti o'zini London savdo kompaniyasi ustidan hukmronlik qilayotganini aniqladi, u o'z navbatida Britaniya tojining barcha hududlaridan ancha katta va aholi soni ko'p bo'lgan imperiyani hukmronlik qilayotgan edi.

en: To the bulk of the English people India was a remote, fantastic, almost inaccessible land, to which adventur- ous poor young men went out, to return after many years very rich and very choleric old gentlemen.
uz: Ingliz xalqining asosiy qismi uchun Hindiston olis, ajoyib, deyarli yetib bo'lmas zamin edi, unga sarguzashtga chiqqan bechora yigitlar ko'p yillardan keyin juda boy va juda mehrli keksa janoblar qaytishardi.

en: It was difﬁcult for the English to conceive what the life of these countless brown millions in the eastern sunshine could be.
uz: Inglizlar uchun sharqiy quyosh nurida bu son-sanoqsiz qo'ng'ir millionlarning hayoti qanday bo'lishi mumkinligini tasavvur qilish qiyin edi.

en: Their imaginations declined the task.
uz: Ularning tasavvurlari vazifani rad etdi.

en: India remained romantically unreal.
uz: Hindiston romantik jihatdan noaniqligicha qoldi.

en: It was impossible for the English, therefore, to exert any effective supervision and control over the company’s proceedings.
uz: Shunday qilib, inglizlar uchun kompaniyaning ish jarayonlariga hech qanday samarali nazorat va nazorat o'tkazishning imkoni bo'lmadi.

en: And while the Western European powers were thus ﬁghting for these fan- tastic overseas empires upon every ocean in the world, two great land con- quests were in progress in Asia.
uz: G'arbiy Yevropa davlatlari dunyoning har bir okeani bo'ylab ushbu fan-tastistik xorijiy imperiyalar uchun kurashayotgan bir paytda, Osiyoda ikkita buyuk quruqlik g'alabalari bo'layotgan edi.

en: China had thrown off the Mongol yoke in 1360, and ﬂourished under the great native dynasty of the Mings until 1644.
uz: Xitoy 1360-yilda Mo'g'ullar yukini tashlab yuborgan va 1644-yilgacha Minglar buyuk mahalliy sulolasi ostida gullab-yashnagan.

en: Then the Manchus, another Mongol people, reconquered China and re- mained masters of China until 1912.
uz: Keyin manxular, yana bir moʻgʻul xalqi, Xitoyni qaytarib bosib olishdi va 1912 yilgacha Xitoyning xoʻjayinlarini qayta qoʻlga kiritishdi.

en: Meanwhile Russia was pushing East and growing to greatness in the world’s affairs.
uz: Ayni paytda Rossiya Sharqni itarib, dunyo ishlarida buyuklikka intilayotgan edi.

en: The rise of this great central power of the old world, which is neither altogether of the East nor altogeth- er of the West, is one of the utmost importance to our human destiny.
uz: Eski dunyoning ushbu buyuk markaziy kuchining paydo bo'lishi, u na Sharqdan, na G'arbdan butunlay emas, insoniy taqdirimiz uchun eng muhim narsalardan biridir.

en: Its ex- pansion is very largely due to the appearance of a Christian steppe people, the Cossacks, who formed a barrier between the feudal agriculture of Poland and Hungary to the west and the Tartar to the east.
uz: Uning paydo bo'lishi asosan xristian dasht xalqining paydo bo'lishi, kazaklarning paydo bo'lishi bilan bog'liq, ular g'arbda Polsha va Vengriyaning feodal qishloq xo'jaligi va sharqda Tartar o'rtasida to'siq yaratgan.

en: The Cossacks were the wild east of Europe, and in many ways not unlike the wild west of
uz: Kazaklar Yevropaning yovvoyi sharqida edilar va ko'p jihatdan yovvoyi g'arbdan farqli emas edilar.

en: the United States in the middle nineteenth century.
uz: XIX asr o'rtalarida Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari.

en: All who had made Rus- sia too hot to hold them, criminals as well as the persecuted innocent, rebel- lious serfs, religious secretaries, thieves, vagabonds, murderers, sought asy- lum in the southern steppes and there made a fresh start and fought for life and freedom against Pole, Russian and Tartar alike.
uz: Rus-siyani ushlab turishga haddan tashqari issiq qilganlarning hammasi, jinoyatchilar, shuningdek, ta'qibga uchragan begunoh, isyonkor krepostlar, diniy kotiblar, o'g'rilar, begonalar, qotillar, janubiy dashtlarda Asy-lumni qidirdilar va u yerda yangi boshlandilar va hayot va erkinlik uchun Polsha, Rus va Tartarga qarshi kurashdilar.

en: Doubtless fugitives from the Tartars to the east also contributed to the Cossack mixture.
uz: Shubhasiz, sharqdagi tatarlar qochqinlari ham kazaklar aralashmasiga hissa qo'shgan.

en: Slowly these border folk were incorporated in the Russian imperial service, much as the highland clans of Scotland were converted into regiments by the British government.
uz: Sekin-asta bu chegara xalqlari Rossiya imperatorlik xizmatiga qo'shildi, xuddi Shotlandiyaning tog'li qabilalari Britaniya hukumati tomonidan polklarga aylantirilganidek.

en: New lands were offered them in Asia.
uz: Ularga Osiyoda yangi yerlar taklif qilindi.

en: They became a weapon against the dwindling power of the Mongolian nomads, ﬁrst in Turkestan and then across Siberia as far as the Amur.
uz: Ular avval Turkistonda, keyin esa Sibir bo'ylab, Amurgacha bo'lgan mo'g'ul ko'chmanchilarining kuchining kamayishiga qarshi qurolga aylandilar.

en: The decay of Mongol energy in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries is very difﬁcult to explain.
uz: O'n yettinchi va o'n sakkizinchi asrlardagi mo'g'ul energiyasining parchalanishini tushuntirish juda qiyin.

en: Within two or three centuries from the days of Jengis and Timurlane Central Asia had relapsed from a period of world as- cendancy to extreme political impotence.
uz: Jengis va Temurlayn davridan ikki-uch asr ichida Markaziy Osiyo jahon urf-odat davridan haddan tashqari siyosiy ojizlikka qaytdi.

en: Changes of climate, unrecorded pestilences, infections of a malarial type, may have played their part in this recession—which may be only a temporary recession measured by the scale of universal history—of the Central Asian peoples.
uz: Iqlim o'zgarishlari, qayd etilmagan o'latlar, malariya turidagi infeksiyalar, Markaziy Osiyo xalqlarining umumiy tarixi ko'lami bilan o'lchangan vaqtinchalik tanazzul bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ushbu tanazzulda o'z rolini o'ynagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Some authorities think that the spread of Buddhist teaching from China also had a pacifying inﬂu- ence upon them.
uz: Ba'zi rasmiylar Xitoydan buddaviy ta'limotning tarqalishi ularga tinchlantiruvchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi deb hisoblashadi.

en: At any rate, by the sixteenth century the Mongol, Tartar and Turkish peoples were no longer pressing outward, but were being in- vaded, subjugated and pushed back both by Christian Russia in the west and by China in the east.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, o'n oltinchi asrga kelib, mo'g'ul, tatar va turk xalqlari endi tashqi tomonga bosim o'tkazmay, balki g'arbda xristian Rossiya va sharqda Xitoy tomonidan g'azabga solinmoqda, bo'ysundirilib, orqaga itarilayotgan edi.

en: All through the seventeenth century the Cossacks were spreading east- ward from European Russia, and settling wherever they found agricultural conditions.
uz: O'n yettinchi asr davomida kazaklar Yevropa Rossiyadan sharqqa tarqalgan va qishloq xo'jaligi sharoitlarini topgan joylarga joylashgan.

en: Cordons of forts and stations formed a moving frontier to these settlements to the south, where the Turkomans were still strong and active; to the north-east, however, Russia had no frontier until she reached right to the Paciﬁc....
uz: Qoʻrgʻonlar va stansiyalar janubga qarab, turkomlar hali ham kuchli va faol boʻlgan ushbu aholi punktlariga harakatlanuvchi chegara yaratdi; shimoli-sharqda esa, Rossiya Tinch okeaniga toʻgʻri yetguncha hech qanday chegaraga ega emas edi....

en: LIV THE AMERICAN WAR OF INDEPENDENCE The third quarter of the eighteenth century thus saw the remarkable and un- stable spectacle of a Europe divided against itself, and no longer with any unifying political or religious idea, yet through the immense stimulation of men’s imaginations by the printed book, the printed map, and the opportuni- ty of the new ocean-going shipping, able in a disorganized and contentious manner to dominate all the coasts of the world.
uz: AMERIKA MUSTAQILLIK URUSHINING YASHIDA XVIII asrning uchinchi choragida Yevropaning o'ziga qarshi bo'linishi, endi hech qanday birlashtiruvchi siyosiy yoki diniy g'oya bilan emas, balki bosma kitob, bosma xarita va dunyo bo'ylab barcha qirg'oqlarni tartibsiz va bahsli tarzda egallashga qodir bo'lgan yangi okean orqali suzib o'tish imkoniyatining ulkan rag'batlantirilishi bilan ajoyib va beqaror ko'rinishi kuzatildi.

en: It was a planless, incoherent ebullition of enterprise due to temporary and almost accidental advantages over the rest of mankind.
uz: Bu biznesning vaqtinchalik va deyarli tasodifiy afzalliklari tufayli butun insoniyatga nisbatan rejalashtirilmagan, izchil bo'lmagan pasayishi edi.

en: By virtue of these advantages this new and still largely empty continent of America was peopled mainly from Western Eu- ropean sources, and South Africa and Australia and New Zealand marked down as prospective homes for a European population.
uz: Ushbu afzalliklar tufayli, bu yangi va hali ham asosan bo'sh Amerika qit'asi asosan G'arbiy Yevropa manbalaridan aholi bilan ta'minlangan va Janubiy Afrika, Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya Yevropa aholisi uchun istiqbolli uylar sifatida belgilangan edi.

en: The motive that had sent Columbus to America and Vasco da Gama to India was the perennial ﬁrst motive of all sailors since the beginning of things—trade.
uz: Kolumbni Amerikaga va Vasko da Gamani Hindistonga jo'natgan motiv, barcha dengizchilarning savdo boshidan beri doimiy birinchi maqsadi edi.

en: But while in the already populous and productive East the trade motive remained dominant, and the European settlements remained trading settlements from which the European inhabitants hoped to return home to spend their money, the Europeans in America, dealing with com- munities at a very much lower level of productive activity, found a new in- ducement for persistence in the search for gold and silver.
uz: Lekin, allaqachon gavjum va unumli Sharqda savdo maqsadi hukmronligicha qolgan va Yevropa aholi punktlari Yevropa aholisi o'z pullarini sarflash uchun uyga qaytishga umid qiladigan savdo aholi punktlari bo'lib qolgan bir paytda, Amerikadagi yevropaliklar, unumdorlik darajasining ancha past bo'lgan jamiyatlari bilan ishlagan holda, oltin va kumush qidirishda davom etish uchun yangi yo'nalishni topdilar.

en: Particularly did the mines of Spanish America yield silver.
uz: Ayniqsa, Ispaniya Amerikasi konlari kumush hosil berdi.

en: The Europeans had to go to America not simply as armed merchants but as prospectors, miners, searchers after natural products, and presently as planters.
uz: Yevropaliklar Amerikaga shunchaki qurollangan savdogarlar sifatida emas, balki qidiruvchilar, konchilar, tabiiy mahsulotlarni qidiruvchilar va hozirda o'simlik o'stiruvchilar sifatida borishga majbur bo'lishdi.

en: In the north they sought furs.
uz: Shimolda ular jun qidirishdi.

en: Mines and plantations necessitated settlements.
uz: Konlar va plantatsiyalar aholi punktlarini talab qilardi.

en: people to set up permanent overseas homes.
uz: Odamlar doimiy xorijiy uylarni tashkil etish uchun.

en: Finally in some cases, as when the English Puritans went to New England in the early seventeenth century to escape religious persecution, when in the eighteenth Oglethorpe sent peo- ple from the English debtors’ prisons to Georgia, and when in the end of the eighteenth the Dutch sent orphans to the Cape of Good Hope, the Euro- peans frankly crossed the seas to ﬁnd new homes for good.
uz: Nihoyat, ba'zi hollarda, XVII asr boshlarida ingliz puritanlari diniy ta'qibdan qochish uchun Yangi Angliyaga borganida, XVIII asrda Oglethorpe ingliz qarzdorlarining qamoqxonalaridan Gruziyaga panyu-ple yuborganida va XVIII asr oxirida gollandlar Yetimlarni Yaxshi Umid Kabiga yuborganida, yevropaliklar yangi uylar topish uchun ochiqchasiga dengizlarni kesib o'tishgan.

en: In the nine- teenth century, and especially after the coming of the steamship, the stream of European emigration to the new empty lands of America and Australia rose for some decades to the scale of a great migration.
uz: Toʻqqizinchi oʻninchi asrda, ayniqsa bugʻ kemasi kelgach, Yevropa emigratsiyasi oqimi Amerika va Avstraliyaning yangi boʻsh yerlariga bir necha oʻn yilliklar davomida katta migratsiya miqyosiga koʻtarildi.

en: So there grew up permanent overseas populations of Europeans, and the European culture was transplanted to much larger areas than those in which it had been developed.
uz: Shunday qilib, Yevropaliklarning doimiy xorijdagi aholisi o'sdi va Yevropa madaniyati rivojlangan hududlardan ancha kattaroq hududlarga ko'chirildi.

en: These new communities bringing a ready-made civi- lization with them to these new lands grew up, as it were, unplanned and unperceived; the statecraft of Europe did not foresee them, and was unpre- pared with any ideas about their treatment.
uz: Bu yangi hududlarga o'zlari bilan tayyor tsivilizatsiyani olib kelgan yangi jamoalar, go'yo, rejalashtirilmagan va anglanmagan holda o'sdi; Yevropaning davlatchilik mahorati ularni oldindan ko'rmagan va ularni davolash haqida hech qanday g'oyalar bilan oldindan ta'minlanmagan edi.

en: The politicians and ministers of Europe continued to regard them as essentially expeditionary establish- ments, sources of revenue, “possessions” and “dependencies,” long after their peoples had developed a keen sense of their separate social life.
uz: Yevropa siyosatchilari va vazirlari ularni asosan ekspeditsion muassasalar, daromad manbalari, mulklar va qaramliklar sifatida ko'rishda davom etishdi, ularning xalqlari o'zlarining alohida ijtimoiy hayotlarini chuqur his qilgandan ko'p o'tgach ham.

en: And also they continued to treat them as helplessly subject to the mother country long after the population had spread inland out of reach of any effectual punitive operations from the sea.
uz: Va shuningdek, ular ularni aholi dengizdan har qanday samarali jazo operatsiyalari qo'llanilishidan tashqari, ichkarida tarqalgandan ko'p vaqt o'tgach, ona yurtga ojiz bo'lib qarashda davom etishdi.

en: Because until right into the nineteenth century, it must be remembered, the link of all these overseas empires was the oceangoing sailing ship.
uz: Chunki to'qqizinchi asrga qadar, esda tutish kerakki, bu barcha xorijiy imperiyalarning bog'lami okean suzuvchi kema edi.

en: On land the swiftest thing was still the horse, and the cohesion and unity of po- litical systems on land was still limited by the limitations of horse communications.
uz: Quruqlikda eng tezkor narsa hali ham ot edi va quruqlikdagi siyosiy tizimlarning uyg'unligi va birligi hali ham ot kommunikatsiyalarining cheklovlari bilan cheklangan edi.

en: Now at the end of the third quarter of the eighteenth century the northern two-thirds of North America was under the British crown.
uz: XVIII asrning uchinchi choragining oxirida Shimoliy Amerikaning shimoliy uchdan ikki qismi Britaniya tojida edi.

en: France had aban- doned America.
uz: Fransiya Amerikaga begonalik qildi.

en: Except for Brazil, which was Portuguese, and one or two small islands and areas in French, British, Danish and Dutch hands, Florida, Louisiana, California and all America to the south was Spanish.
uz: Braziliyadan tashqari, u portugal edi, va bir-ikki kichik orol va Fransiya, Britaniya, Daniya va Golland qo'llarida joylashgan hududlar, Florida, Luiziana, Kaliforniya va janubdagi butun Amerika ispan edi.

en: It was the British colonies south of Maine and Lake Ontario that ﬁrst demonstrated the inadequacy of the sailing ship to hold overseas populations together in one political system.
uz: Aynan Meyn va Ontario ko'lining janubidagi Britaniya mustamlakalari dengiz kemasining chet el aholisini bir siyosiy tizimda birga ushlab turishga qodir emasligini birinchi bo'lib namoyish etdi.

en: These British colonies were very miscellaneous in their origin and char- acter.
uz: Bu Britaniya mustamlakalari kelib chiqishi va xarakterida juda xilma-xil edi.

en: There were French, Swedish and Dutch settlements as well as British; there were British Catholics in Maryland and British ultra-Protestants in New England, and while the New Englanders farmed their own land and denounced slavery, the British in Virginia and the south were planters em- ploying a swelling multitude of imported negro slaves.
uz: Fransuz, shved va golland aholi punktlari, shuningdek, britaniyaliklar bor edi; Merilendda britaniyalik katoliklar va Yangi Angliyada britaniyalik ultra-protestantlar bor edi. Yangi Angliyaliklar o'z yerlarini dehqonchilik qilib, qullikni qoralagan bir paytda, Virjiniyadagi va janubdagi britaniyaliklar import qilingan ko'plab qora qullarni ekish uchun plantator edilar.

en: There was no natur- al common unity in such states.
uz: Bunday davlatlarda tabiiy umumiy birlik yo'q edi.

en: To get from one to the other might mean a coasting voyage hardly less tedious than the transatlantic crossing.
uz: Biridan ikkinchisiga borish transatlantik kesishishdan kam zerikarli bo'lmagan qirg'oq bo'ylab sayohatni anglatishi mumkin.

en: But the union that diverse origin and natural conditions denied the British Ameri- cans was forced upon them by the selﬁshness and stupidity of the British government in London.
uz: Ammo turli kelib chiqishi va tabiiy sharoitlari Britaniya amerikaliklarini rad etgan ittifoq ularga Londondagi Britaniya hukumatining xudbinligi va ahmoqligi tufayli majbur bo'ldi.

en: They were taxed without any voice in the spending of the taxes; their trade was sacriﬁced to British interests; the highly prof- itable slave trade was maintained by the British government in spite of the opposition of the Virginians who—though quite willing to hold and use slaves—feared to be swamped by an ever-growing barbaric black population.
uz: Ular soliqlarni sarflashda hech qanday ovoz bermasdan soliq solingan; ularning savdosi Britaniya manfaatlariga qurbon qilingan; yuqori daromadli qul savdosi Britaniya hukumati tomonidan Virjiniyaliklarning qarshiligiga qaramay saqlanib qolgan edi, ular qullarni ushlab turishga va ishlatishga tayyor bo'lishsa ham, doimiy o'sib borayotgan vahshiy qora tanli aholi tomonidan suvga botirilishdan qo'rqishardi.

en: GEORGE WASHINGTON  (From a painting by Gilbert Stuart) Britain at that time was lapsing towards an intenser form of monarchy, and the obstinate personality of George III (1760- 1820) did much to force on a struggle between the home and the colonial governments.
uz: GEORGE VASHINGTON (Gilbert Stuartning rasmidan) O'sha paytda Britaniya monarxiyaning yanada shiddatli shakliga qarab ketayotgan edi va Georgiy IIIning qaysar shaxsiyati (1760-1820) uy va mustamlaka hukumatlar o'rtasidagi kurashga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: The conﬂict was precipitated by legislation which favoured the London East India Company at the expense of the American shipper.
uz: Mojaro Amerikalik yuk jo'natuvchi hisobidan London Sharqiy Hindiston kompaniyasini afzal ko'rsatgan qonunchilik tufayli tezlashtirildi.

en: Three cargoes of tea which were imported under the new conditions were thrown over- board in Boston harbour by a band of men disguised as Indians (1773).
uz: Yangi shartlar asosida import qilingan uchta choy yukini hindlar niqobi ostidagi bir guruh odamlar tomonidan 1773 yilda Boston portida tashlab yuborildi.

en: Fighting only began in 1775 when the British government attempted to ar- rest two of the American leaders at Lexington near Boston.
uz: Janglar faqatgina 1775-yilda boshlangan edi, Britaniya hukumati Boston yaqinidagi Lexington shahrida Amerika yetakchilaridan ikkitasini qo'lga olishga urinib ko'rganida.

en: The ﬁrst shots were ﬁred in Lexington by the British; the ﬁrst ﬁghting occurred at Concord.
uz: Birinchi o'q otish Leksingtonda britaniyaliklar tomonidan o'q uzildi; birinchi janglar Konkordda sodir bo'ldi.

en: THE BATTLE OF BUNKER HILL, NEAR BOSTON  (From the engraving of the picture by John Trumbull in the British Museum) So the American War of Independence began, though for more than a year the colonists showed themselves extremely unwilling to sever their links with the mother land.
uz: BUNKER GALL JANGASI, BOSTON YaQINIDA (Britaniya Muzeyidagi Jon Trumbullning rasm chizishidan) Shunday qilib, Amerika Mustaqillik Urushi boshlandi, garchi bir yildan ortiq vaqt davomida mustamlakachilar o'zlarining ona zamin bilan aloqalarini uzishga juda xohish bildirishmadi.

en: It was not until the middle of 1776 that the Con- gress of the insurgent states issued “The Declaration of Independence.” George Washington, who like many of the leading colonists of the time had had a military training in the wars against the French, was made comman- der-in-chief.
uz: 1776-yilning oʻrtalariga kelibgina isyonkor davlatlarning Kon-gresi Mustaqillik Deklaratsiyasini eʼlon qildi. Oʻsha davrning koʻplab yetakchi mustamlakachilari kabi fransuzlarga qarshi urushlarda harbiy tayyorgarlik koʻrgan Jorj Vashington bosh qoʻmondon etib tayinlandi.

en: In 1777 a British general, General Burgoyne, in an attempt to reach New York from Canada, was defeated at Freemans Farm and obliged to surrender at Saratoga.
uz: 1777-yilda Britaniyalik general, general Burgoyne, Kanadan Nyu-Yorkka yetib borishga urinib, Freemans fermasida mag'lub bo'ldi va Saratogaga taslim bo'lishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: In the same year the French and Spanish declared war upon Great Britain, greatly hampering her sea communications.
uz: Xuddi shu yili fransuzlar va ispanlar Buyuk Britaniyaga urush e'lon qilishdi va bu uning dengiz aloqalariga katta to'sqinlik qildi.

en: A sec- ond British army under General Cornwallis was caught in the Yorktown peninsula in Virginia and obliged to capitulate in 1781.
uz: General Kornuollis boshchiligidagi Britaniya armiyasi Virjiniyadagi Yorktown yarim orolida ushlandi va 1781-yilda kapitulyatsiya qilishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: In 1783 peace was made in Paris, and the Thirteen Colonies from Maine to Georgia became a union of independent sovereign States.
uz: 1783-yilda Parijda tinchlik o'rnatildi va Meyndan Gruziyagacha bo'lgan O'n Uchinchi Koloniya mustaqil suveren davlatlar ittifoqiga aylandi.

en: So the United States of America came into existence.
uz: Shunday qilib, Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: Canada remained loyal to the British ﬂag.
uz: Kanada Britaniya bayrog'iga sodiq qoldi.

en: For four years these States had only a very feeble central government un- der certain Articles of Confederation, and they seemed destined to break up into separate independent communities.
uz: To'rt yil davomida bu Shtatlar Konfederatsiyaning ayrim moddalari bo'yicha juda zaif markaziy hukumatga ega edi va ular alohida mustaqil jamiyatlarga bo'linishga mahkumdek ko'rinardi.

en: Their immediate separation was de- layed by the hostility of the British and a certain aggressiveness on the part of the French which brought home to them the immediate dangers of divi- sion.
uz: Ularning darhol ajralishi Britaniyaliklarning dushmanligi va fransuzlarning ma'lum bir tajovuzkorligi tufayli barbod bo'ldi, bu esa ularga bo'linishning bevosita xavflarini olib keldi.

en: A Constitution was drawn up and ratiﬁed in 1788 establishing a more efﬁcient Federal government with a President holding very considerable powers, and the weak sense of national unity was invigorated by a second
uz: 1788-yilda Konstitutsiya tuzilgan va ratifikatsiya qilingan boʻlib, unda juda katta vakolatlarga ega boʻlgan Prezident bilan yanada samarali Federal hukumat tashkil etilgan va milliy birlikning zaif tuygʻusi ikkinchi

en: war with Britain in 1812.
uz: 1812-yilda Britaniya bilan urush.

en: Nevertheless the area covered by the States was so wide and their interests so diverse at that time, that—given only the means of communication then available—a disintegration of the Union into separate states on the European scale of size was merely a question of time.
uz: Shunga qaramay, davlatlar qamrab olgan hudud o'sha paytda shunchalik keng va ularning manfaatlari shunchalik xilma-xil ediki,  o'sha paytda mavjud bo'lgan aloqa vositalarini hisobga olsak  Ittifoqning Yevropa miqyosidagi alohida davlatlarga bo'linishi vaqt masalasi edi xolos.

en: Attendance at Washington meant a long, tedious and insecure journey for the senators and congressmen of the remoter districts, and the mechanical impediments to the diffusion of a common education and a common litera- ture and intelligence were practically insurmountable.
uz: Vashingtonga tashrif chekka tumanlardagi senatorlar va kongressmenlar uchun uzoq, zerikarli va ishonchsiz sayohatni anglatardi, umumiy ta'lim va umumiy adabiyot hamda aql-idrok tarqalishiga mexanik to'siqlar amalda yengib bo'lmas edi.

en: Forces were at work in the world however that were to arrest the process of differentiation alto- gether.
uz: Dunyoda yuqori darajadagi differensiatsiya jarayonini to'xtatadigan kuchlar ishlamoqda edi.

en: Presently came the river steamboat and then the railway and the tele- graph to save the United States from fragmentation, and weave its dispersed people together again into the ﬁrst of great modern nations.
uz: Hozirda daryo bug' kemasi, keyin esa temir yo'l va tele-graf Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlarini bo'linishdan saqlab qolish va tarqoq xalqlarini yana bir qatorda ulkan zamonaviy davlatlarning birinchisiga aylantirish uchun keldi.

en: Twenty-two years later the Spanish colonies in America were to follow the example of the Thirteen and break their connection with Europe.
uz: Yigirma ikki yil o'tgach, Amerikadagi Ispaniya mustamlakalari O'n uchlikning namunasiga ergashishlari va Yevropa bilan aloqasini uzishlari kerak edi.

en: But being more dispersed over the continent and separated by great mountain- ous chains and deserts and forests and by the Portuguese Empire of Brazil, they did not achieve a union among themselves.
uz: Ammo qit'a bo'ylab tarqalgan va ulkan tog' zanjirlari, cho'llar va o'rmonlar hamda Braziliya Portugaliya imperiyasi bilan ajralib ketgan holda, ular o'zaro birlikka erisha olmadi.

en: They became a constella- tion of republican states, very prone at ﬁrst to wars among themselves and to revolutions.
uz: Ular respublika davlatlari to'plamiga aylandilar, dastlab o'zaro urushlarga va inqiloblarga juda moyil edilar.

en: Brazil followed a rather different line towards the inevitable separation.
uz: Braziliya muqarrar ajralishga nisbatan ancha boshqacha yo'l tutdi.

en: In 1807 the French armies under Napoleon had occupied the mother coun- try of Portugal, and the monarchy had ﬂed to Brazil.
uz: 1807-yilda Napoleon boshchiligidagi fransuz armiyalari Portugaliya ona mamlakatini bosib oldi va monarxiya Braziliyaga qochdi.

en: From that time on until they separated, Portugal was rather a dependency of Brazil than Brazil of Portugal.
uz: O'sha vaqtdan tortib, ular ajralguncha, Portugaliya Portugaliya Braziliyasidan ko'ra ko'proq Braziliyaga qaram edi.

en: In 1822 Brazil declared itself a separate Empire under Pedro I, a son of the Portuguese King.
uz: 1822-yilda Braziliya Portugaliya qirolining o'g'li Pedro I boshchiligida o'zini alohida imperiya deb e'lon qildi.

en: But the new world has never been very favourable to monarchy.
uz: Lekin yangi dunyo hech qachon monarxiya uchun unchalik qulay bo'lmagan.

en: In 1889 the Emperor of Brazil was shipped off qui- etly to Europe, and the United States of Brazil fell into line with the rest of republican America.
uz: 1889-yilda Braziliya imperatori tinchgina Yevropaga jo'natildi va Braziliya Qo'shma Shtatlari respublikachi Amerikaning qolgan qismi bilan bir xil ahvolda qoldi.

en: LV THE FRENCH REVOLUTION AND THE RESTORATION OF MONARCHY IN FRANCE Britain had hardly lost the Thirteen Colonies in America before a profound social and political convulsion at the very heart of Grand Monarchy was to remind Europe still more vividly of the essentially temporary nature of the political arrangements of the world.
uz: LV FRANSIYA INQILOBI VA FRANSIYADA MONARXIYANI Qayta tiklash Britaniya Buyuk Monarxiyaning o'z markazida chuqur ijtimoiy va siyosiy shovqin Yevropaga dunyoning siyosiy tuzilishlarining asosan vaqtinchalik mohiyatini yanada jonliroq eslatib turishi uchun Amerikadagi O'n Uchinchi Koloniyalarni deyarli yo'qotmagan edi.

en: We have said that the French monarchy was the most successful of the personal monarchies in Europe.
uz: Biz Fransiya monarxiyasi Yevropadagi shaxsiy monarxiyalardan eng muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganini aytdik.

en: It was the envy and model of a multitude of competing and minor courts.
uz: Bu raqobatchi va mayda sudlarning ko'pchiligining hasadi va namunasi edi.

en: But it ﬂourished on a basis of injustice that led to its dramatic collapse.
uz: Lekin u adolatsizlik asosida gullab-yashnadi, bu esa uning keskin qulashiga olib keldi.

en: It was brilliant and aggressive, but it was wasteful of the life and substance of its common people.
uz: U ajoyib va tajovuzkor edi, lekin u oddiy xalqining hayoti va mohiyatini behuda sarflagan edi.

en: The clergy and nobility were protected from taxation by a system of exemption that threw the whole burden of the state upon the middle and lower classes.
uz: Ruhoniylar va zodagonlar davlatning butun yukini o'rta va quyi sinflarga yuklagan soliqdan ozod qilish tizimi bilan himoyalangan edi.

en: The peasants were ground down by taxation; the middle classes were dominated and hu- miliated by the nobility.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaliklari soliqlar bilan ezildi; o'rta sinflar zodagonlar tomonidan hukmronlik qildi va siqib chiqarildi.

en: In 1787 this French monarchy found itself bankrupt and obliged to call representatives of the different classes of the realm into consultation upon the perplexities of defective income and excessive expenditure.
uz: 1787-yilda bu fransuz monarxiyasi bankrot bo'lib qoldi va nuqsonli daromad va haddan tashqari xarajatlarning chalkashliklari bo'yicha sohaning turli sinflari vakillarini maslahatga chaqirishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: In 1789 the States General, a gathering of the nobles, clergy and commons, roughly equivalent to the earlier form of the British Parliament, was called together at Versailles.
uz: 1789-yilda Versalda zodagonlar, ruhoniylar va oddiy xalq vakillarining umumiy yig'ilishi, taxminan Britaniya Parlamentining avvalgi shakliga teng bo'lgan General Shtatlar yig'ildi.

en: It had not assembled since 1610.
uz: U 1610-yildan beri yig'ilmagan edi.

en: For all that time France had been an absolute monarchy.
uz: O'sha vaqt davomida Fransiya mutlaq monarxiya edi.

en: Now the people found a means of expressing their long fermenting discontent.
uz: Endi xalq o'zining uzoq davom etgan noroziligini ifoda etish yo'lini topdi.

en: Disputes immediately broke out between
uz: O'zaro nizolar darhol kelib chiqdi.

en: the three estates, due to the resolve of the Third Estate, the Commons, to control the Assembly.
uz: Uch mulk, Uchinchi mulk, Umumiy Kengashning Assambleyani nazorat qilish qarori tufayli.

en: The Commons got the better of these disputes and the States General became a National Assembly, clearly resolved to keep the crown in order, as the British Parliament kept the British crown in order.
uz: Umumiy Kengashlar bu bahslardan ustun keldi va Bosh Shtatlar Milliy Assambleyaga aylandi, Britaniya parlamenti Britaniya tojini tartibga solganidek, tojni tartibga solishga aniq qaror qildi.

en: The king (Louis XVI) prepared for a struggle and brought up troops from the provinces.
uz: Shoh (Luis XVI) kurashga tayyorlandi va viloyatlardan qo'shinlarni yig'di.

en: Whereupon Paris and France revolted.
uz: Shundan so'ng Parij va Fransiya isyon ko'tardi.

en: The collapse of the absolute monarchy was very swift.
uz: Mutlaq monarxiyaning qulashi juda tez sodir bo'ldi.

en: The grim-looking prison of the Bastille was stormed by the people of Paris, and the insurrec- tion spread rapidly throughout France.
uz: Bastiliya qamoqxonasining xunuk ko'rinishi Parij aholisi tomonidan bostirib kirildi va qo'zg'olon Fransiya bo'ylab tez tarqaldi.

en: In the east and north-west provinces many chateaux belonging to the nobility were burnt by the peasants, their title-deeds carefully destroyed, and the owners murdered or driven away.
uz: Sharq va shimoli-g'arbiy viloyatlarda zodagonlarga tegishli ko'plab qasrlar dehqonlar tomonidan yoqib yuborilgan, ularning mulk hujjatlari ehtiyotkorlik bilan yo'q qilingan va egalari o'ldirilgan yoki haydalgan.

en: In a month the ancient and decayed system of the aristocratic order had col- lapsed.
uz: Bir oy ichida aristokratik tartibning qadimiy va chirigan tizimi qulab ketdi.

en: Many of the leading princes and courtiers of the queen’s party ﬂed abroad.
uz: Qirolichaning partiyasining ko'plab yetakchi shahzodalari va saroylari xorijga qochib ketishdi.

en: A provisional city government was set up in Paris and in most of the other large cities, and a new armed force, the National Guard, a force designed primarily and plainly to resist the forces of the crown, was brought into existence by these municipal bodies.
uz: Parijda va boshqa katta shaharlarning ko'pchiligida vaqtinchalik shahar hukumati tashkil etildi va ushbu shahar organlari tomonidan toj kuchlariga qarshi turish uchun asosan va aniq mo'ljallangan yangi qurolli kuch, Milliy Gvardiya paydo bo'ldi.

en: The National Assembly found it- self called upon to create a new political and social system for a new age.
uz: Milliy Assambleya o'zini yangi davr uchun yangi siyosiy va ijtimoiy tizim yaratishga chaqirgan deb topdi.

en: It was a task that tried the powers of that gathering to the utmost.
uz: Bu o'sha yig'ilishning kuchini cheksiz sinab ko'rgan vazifa edi.

en: It made a great sweep of the chief injustices of the absolutist regime; it abolished tax exemptions, serfdom, aristocratic titles and privileges and sought to es- tablish a constitutional monarchy in Paris.
uz: U absolyutsizm rejimining asosiy adolatsizliklarini katta yo'q qildi; u soliq imtiyozlari, krepostlik, aristokratik unvonlar va imtiyozlarni bekor qildi va Parijda konstitutsiyaviy monarxiyani o'rnatishga intildi.

en: The king abandoned Versailles and its splendours and kept a diminished state in the palace of the Tuileries in Paris.
uz: Shoh Versal va uning hashamatini tashlab, Parijdagi Tuiler saroyida kamaygan holatni saqlab qoldi.

en: For two years it seemed that the National Assembly might struggle through to an effective modernized government.
uz: Ikki yil davomida Milliy Assambleya samarali modernizatsiya qilingan hukumatga erishish uchun kurashishi mumkindek tuyuldi.

en: Much of its work was sound and still endures, if much was experimental and had to be undone.
uz: Uning ishlarining ko'p qismi sog'lom edi va hanuzgacha bardosh beradi, garchi ko'p qismi eksperimental bo'lsa va bekor qilinishi kerak bo'lsa ham.

en: Much was ineffective.
uz: Ko'p narsa samarasiz edi.

en: There was a clearing up of the penal code; torture, arbitrary imprisonment and persecutions for heresy were abolished.
uz: Jinoyat kodeksini tozalantirish bo'ldi; qiynoq, o'zboshimchalik bilan qamoq va bid'at uchun ta'qiblar bekor qilindi.

en: The an- cient provinces of France, Normandy, Burgundy and the like gave place to eighty departments.
uz: Fransiya, Normandiya, Burgundiya va shunga o'xshash o'lkalar saksonta departamentga joy berdi.

en: Promotion to the highest ranks in the army was laid open to men of every class.
uz: Armiyadagi eng yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilish har bir sinfdagi erkaklar uchun ochiq edi.

en: An excellent and simple system of law courts was set up, but its value was much vitiated by having the judges appointed by popular election for short periods of time.
uz: A'lo va sodda sudlar tizimi yaratildi, lekin uning qadri qisqa vaqt davomida xalq saylovi orqali sudyalarni tayinlashi bilan ancha buzildi.

en: This made the crowd a sort of ﬁnal court of appeal, and the judges, like the members of the Assembly, were forced to play to the gallery.
uz: Bu olomonni o'ziga xos yakuniy apellyatsiya sudiga aylantirdi va sudyalar, xuddi Assambleya a'zolari kabi, galereyaga o'ynashga majbur bo'lishdi.

en: And the whole vast property of the
uz: Va butun ulkan mulkning

en: church was seized and administered by the state; religious establishments not engaged in education or works of charity were broken up, and the salaries of the clergy made a charge upon the nation.
uz: Cherkov davlat tomonidan musodara qilindi va boshqariladi; ta'lim yoki xayriya ishlarida ishtirok etmaydigan diniy muassasalar buzildi va ruhoniylarning maoshlari millatga yuk bo'ldi.

en: This in itself was not a bad thing for the lower clergy in France, who were often scandalously un- derpaid in comparison with the richer dignitaries.
uz: Bu o'zi Fransiyadagi quyi ruhoniylar uchun yomon narsa emas edi, ular ko'pincha boyroq amaldorlar bilan solishtirganda rasvo tarzda haqsiz edilar.

en: But in addition the choice of priests and bishops was made elective, which struck at the very root idea of the Roman Church, which centred everything upon the Pope, and in which all authority is from above downward.
uz: Lekin bundan tashqari ruhoniylar va yepiskoplar tanlovi ham tanlovga aylantirildi, bu Rim cherkovining tub g'oyasiga tegdi, u hamma narsani Rim Papasiga qaratgan va unda barcha hokimiyat yuqoridan pastga tushirilgan edi.

en: Practically the National As- sembly wanted at one blow to make the church in France Protestant, in or- ganization if not in doctrine.
uz: Amalda, Milliy As- ma'nosida Fransiyadagi cherkovni bir zarba bilan protestant qilish, yoki-guloizatsiya qilish, agar ta'limotda bo'lmasa, kerak edi.

en: Everywhere there were disputes and conﬂicts between the state priests created by the National Assembly and the recalci- trant (non-juring) priests who were loyal to Rome.
uz: Hamma joyda Milliy Assambleya tomonidan yaratilgan davlat ruhoniylari va Rimga sodiq bo'lgan qasamyod qilmaydigan ruhoniylar o'rtasida nizolar va ziddiyatlar bo'lardi.

en: In 1791 the experiment of Constitutional monarchy in France was brought to an abrupt end by the action of the king and queen, working in concert with their aristocratic and monarchist friends abroad.
uz: 1791-yilda Fransiyadagi konstitutsiyaviy monarxiya tajribasi qirol va malikalarning chet eldagi aristokratik va monarxik do'stlari bilan birgalikda ishlash harakatlari bilan keskin yakunlandi.

en: Foreign armies gathered on the Eastern frontier and one night in June the king and queen and their children slipped away from the Tuileries and ﬂed to join the foreigners and the aristocratic exiles.
uz: Sharqiy chegarada xorijiy armiyalar to'planib, iyun oyining bir kechasida shoh va malika hamda ularning bolalari Tuileridan qochib, chet elliklar va aristokratik surgunlarga qo'shilish uchun qochib ketishdi.

en: They were caught at Varennes and brought back to Paris, and an France ﬂamed up into a passion of patriotic republicanism.
uz: Ular Varennesda qo'lga tushishdi va Parijga qaytarildilar, Fransiya esa vatanparvarlik respublikachiligiga ishtiyoq bilan yondi.

en: A Republic was proclaimed, open war with Austria and Prussia ensued, and the king was tried and executed (January, 1793) on the model already set by England, for treason to his people.
uz: Respublika e'lon qilindi, Avstriya va Prussiya bilan ochiq urush boshlanib ketdi va qirol Angliya tomonidan allaqachon o'rnatilgan modelga ko'ra, o'z xalqiga xiyonat qilgani uchun sud qilindi va qatl etildi (yanvar, 1793).

en: And now followed a strange phase in the history of the French people.
uz: Endi fransuz xalqining tarixida g'alati bir bosqich kuzatildi.

en: There arose a great ﬂame of enthusiasm for France and the Republic.
uz: Fransiya va Respublika uchun katta ishtiyoq alangasi paydo bo'ldi.

en: There was to be an end to compromise at home and abroad; at home royalists and every form of disloyalty were to be stamped out; abroad France was to be the protector and helper of all revolutionaries.
uz: Uyda ham, chet elda ham murosaga chek qo'yilishi kerak edi; uyda royalistlar va har qanday sadoqatsizlik yo'q qilinishi kerak edi; chet elda Fransiya barcha inqilobchilarning himoyachisi va yordamchisi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: All Europe, all the world, was to become Republican.
uz: Butun Yevropa, butun dunyo respublikachi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: The youth of France poured into the Republican armies; a new and wonderful song spread through the land, a song that still warms the blood like wine, the Marseillaise.
uz: Fransiya yoshlari Respublikachi armiyalariga oqib kirishdi; yangi va ajoyib qo'shiq yurt bo'ylab tarqaldi, qonni hali ham vino kabi isituvchi qo'shiq, Marselya.

en: Before that chant and the leap- ing columns of French bayonets and their enthusiastically served guns the foreign armies rolled back; before the end of 1792 the French armies had gone far beyond the utmost achievements of Louis XIV; everywhere they stood on foreign soil.
uz: O'sha qo'shiq va fransuz pichoqlarining sakrash ustunlari hamda ularning ishtiyoq bilan xizmat qilgan qurollaridan oldin xorijiy armiyalar orqaga qaytdi; 1792 yil oxirigacha fransuz armiyalari Lyudovik XIV ning eng katta yutuqlaridan ancha o'tib ketgan edi; hamma joyda ular xorijiy tuproqda turardi.

en: They were in Brussels, they had overrun Savoy, they had raided to Mayence; they had seized the Scheldt from Holland.
uz: Ular Bryusselda edilar, ular Savoyni bosib olishdi, ular Mayencega bostirib kirishdi; ular Gollandiyadan Scheldtni egallab olishdi.

en: Then the French Government did an unwise thing.
uz: Keyin Fransiya hukumati bema'ni ish qildi.

en: It had been exasperated by the ex-
uz: U sobiq... tomonidan g'azablangan edi.

en: pulsion of its representative from England upon the execution of Louis, and it declared war against England.
uz: O'z vakilining Angliyadan surilishi Lui qatl etilganda, u Angliyaga qarshi urush e'lon qildi.

en: It was an unwise thing to do, because the revolution which had given France a new enthusiastic infantry and a bril- liant artillery released from its aristocratic ofﬁcers and many cramping con- ditions had destroyed the discipline of the navy, and the English were supreme upon the sea.
uz: Bu aql bovar qilmas ish edi, chunki Fransiyaga yangi ishtiyoqli piyoda askarlari va aristokratik ofitserlaridan ozod qilingan yorqin artilleriya bergan inqilob dengiz floti intizomini yo'q qildi va inglizlar dengizda hukmron edi.

en: And this provocation united all England against France, whereas there had been at ﬁrst a very considerable liberal move- ment in Great Britain in sympathy with the revolution.
uz: Va bu provokatsiya butun Angliyani Fransiyaga qarshi birlashtirdi, garchi dastlab Buyuk Britaniyada inqilobga hamdardlik bildirishda juda sezilarli liberal harakat bo'lgan bo'lsa ham.

en: THE TRIAL OF LOUIS XVI  (From a print in the British Museum) Of the ﬁght that France made in the next few years against a European coalition we cannot tell in any detail.
uz: LOUIS XVI SUDI (Britaniya muzeyidagi nashrdan) Fransiya keyingi bir necha yil ichida Yevropa koalitsiyasiga qarshi olib borgan kurashini hech qanday tafsilot bilan ayta olmaymiz.

en: She drove the Austrians for ever out of Belgium, and made Holland a republic.
uz: U avstriyaliklarni Belgiyadan abadiy haydab chiqardi va Gollandiyani respublika qildi.

en: The Dutch ﬂeet, frozen in the Texel, surrendered to a handful of cavalry without ﬁring its guns.
uz: Gollandiya floti, Texel dengizida muzlab qolgan holda, o'z qurollarini otmasdan bir hovuch otliqlarga taslim bo'ldi.

en: For some time the French thrust towards Italy was hung up, and it was only in 1796 that a new general, Napoleon Bonaparte, led the ragged and hungry republi- can armies in triumph across Piedmont to Mantua and Verona.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt Fransiyaning Italiyaga bo'lgan intilishi to'xtadi va aynan 1796-yilda yangi general, Napoleon Bonapart, Piemontdan Mantua va Verona tomon g'alaba qozonib, g'azablangan va och qolgan respublika qo'shinlarini boshqardi.

en: Atkinson, [1] “What astonished the Allies most of all was the number and the velocity of the Republicans.
uz: Atkinson, [1]  ittifoqchilarni eng hayratga solgani respublikachilarning soni va tezligi edi.

en: These improvised armies had in fact noth- ing to delay them.
uz: Bu qo'llanma armiyalar aslida ularni kechiktirish uchun hech narsa qilmas edi.

en: Tents were unprocurable for want of money, untrans- portable for want of the enormous number of wagons that would have been required, and also unnecessary, for the discomfort that would have caused wholesale desertion in professional armies was cheerfully borne by the men of 1793- 94.
uz: Pul yetishmasligi sababli chodirlar topib bo'lmas edi, zarur bo'ladigan va keraksiz bo'lgan ulkan miqdordagi vagonlar tufayli ko'chmas edi, chunki professional armiyalarda ulgurji desersiyaga olib keladigan noqulaylik 1793- 94-yillardagi erkaklar tomonidan quvnoqlik bilan ko'tarildi.

en: Supplies for armies of then unheard-of size could not be car- ried in convoys, and the French soon became familiar with ‘living on the country.’ Thus 1793 saw the birth of the modern system of war—rapidity of movement, full development of national strength, bivouacs, requisitions and force as against cautious manœuvring, small professional armies, tents and full rations, and chicane.
uz: O'sha paytdagi g'ayrioddiy o'lchamdagi armiyalar uchun ta'minot karvonlarda olib yurish mumkin emas edi va fransuzlar tez orada yurtda yashash bilan tanishdilar. Shunday qilib, 1793-yilda urushning zamonaviy tizimi paydo bo'ldi  harakat tezligi, milliy kuchning to'liq rivojlanishi, bivakuslar, rekvizitsiyalar va ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilishga qarshi kuch, kichik professional armiyalar, chodirlar va to'liq ratsiyalar va chicane.

en: The ﬁrst represented the decision-compelling spir- it, the second the spirit of risking little to gain a little ...
uz: Birinchisi qaror qabul qilishga undaydigan ruhni ifodalardi, ikkinchisi esa ozgina yutish uchun ozroq xavf ostiga qo'yish ruhini...

en: .” And while these ragged hosts of enthusiasts were chanting the Marseil- laise and ﬁghting for la France, manifestly never quite clear in their minds whether they were looting or liberating the countries into which they poured, the republican enthusiasm in Paris was spending itself in a far less glorious fashion.
uz: Va bu g'azablangan ishqibozlar to'dasi Marsel-laise va la France uchun kurashayotgan paytda, ular to'kilgan mamlakatlarni talon-toroj qilayotganlari yoki ozod qilayotganlari aniq ko'rinmas edi, Parijdagi respublika ishtiyoqi o'zini ancha kamroq ulug'vor tarzda sarflayotgan edi.

en: The revolution was now under the sway of a fanatical leader, Robespierre.
uz: Inqilob endi fanatik yetakchi Robespierre ta'sirida edi.

en: This man is difﬁcult to judge; he was a man of poor physique, naturally timid, and a prig.
uz: Bu odamni baholash qiyin; u jismoniy jihatdan nochor, tabiatan uyatchan va qo'rqoq odam edi.

en: But he had that most necessary gift for power, faith.
uz: Lekin u qudrat uchun eng zarur sovg'a, imonga ega edi.

en: He set himself to save the Republic as he conceived it, and he imagined it could be saved by no other man than he.
uz: U o'zi tasavvur qilganidek Respublikani qutqarishga qaror qildi va uni o'zidan boshqa hech kim qutqara olmaydi deb o'yladi.

en: So that to keep in pow- er was to save the Republic.
uz: Shunday qilib, kuchda qolish Respublikani qutqarish edi.

en: The living spirit of the Republic, it seemed, had sprung from a slaughter of royalists and the execution of the king.
uz: Respublikaning tirik ruhi, go'yo, royalistlarning qirg'inidan va qirolning qatl etilishidan kelib chiqqan edi.

en: There were insurrections; one in the west, in the district of La Vendée, where the people rose against the conscription and against the dispossession of the orthodox clergy, and were led by noblemen and priests; one in the south, where Lyons and Marseilles had risen and the royalists of Toulon had admitted an English and Spanish garrison.
uz: G'arbda, La Vandeya tumanida isyonlar bo'ldi, u yerda xalq chaqiruvga va pravoslav ruhoniylarning taxtdan olinishiga qarshi ko'tarildi va ularni zodagonlar va ruhoniylar boshqardi; janubda esa Lion va Marsel ko'tarildi va Toulon qirollikchilari ingliz va ispan garnizonini qabul qildi.

en: To which there seemed no more effectual reply than to go on killing royalists.
uz: Bunga royalistlarni o'ldirishdan ko'ra samaraliroq javob bo'lmagandek tuyuldi.

en: The Revolutionary Tribunal went to work, and a steady slaughtering be- gan.
uz: Inqilobiy Tribunal ishga tushdi va barqaror so'yish bo'ldi.

en: The invention of the guillotine was opportune to this mood.
uz: Gilotin ixtirosi shu kayfiyatga mos keldi.

en: The queen was guillotined, most of Robespierre’s antagonists were guillotined, atheists who argued that there was no Supreme Being were guillotined; day by day, week by week, this infernal new machine chopped off heads and more
uz: Qirolicha gilotin qilindi, Robespierre'ning aksariyat dushmanlari gilotin qilindi, Oliy Mavjudlik yo'qligini ta'kidlagan ateistlar gilotin qilindi; kun sayin, hafta sayin, bu do'zaxdan yangi mashina boshlarini kesib tashladi va...

en: The reign of Robespierre lived, it seemed, on blood; and needed more and more, as an opium-taker needs more and more opium.
uz: Robespierre hukmronligi, go'yo, qon bilan yashagan; va afyon iste'molchisi tobora ko'proq afyonga muhtoj bo'lgani kabi, tobora ko'proq afyon kerak edi.

en: THE EXECUTION OF MARIE ANTOINETTE, QUEEN OF FRANCE, OCTOBER 16, 1793  (From a print in the British Museum) Finally in the summer of 1794 Robespierre himself was overthrown and guillotined.
uz: FRANSIYA QIROLASI MARI ANTOINETNING JONI, 1793-YIL 16-OKTyabr (Britaniya Muzeyining chop etilganidan). Nihoyat, 1794-yilning yozida Robespiyerning o'zi ag'darildi va gilotin qilindi.

en: He was succeeded by a Directory of ﬁve men which carried on the war of defence abroad and held France together at home for ﬁve years.
uz: Uning o'rnini besh kishidan iborat Katalog egalladi, ular xorijda mudofaa urushini olib bordilar va Fransiyani besh yil davomida o'z uyida birga ushlab turdilar.

en: Their reign formed a curious interlude in this history of violent changes.
uz: Ularning hukmronligi bu zo'ravon o'zgarishlar tarixida qiziqarli bir oraliqni shakllantirdi.

en: They took things as they found them.
uz: Ular narsalarni topganlaricha olishdi.

en: The propagandist zeal of the revolu- tion carried the French armies into Holland, Belgium, Switzerland, south Germany and north Italy.
uz: Inqilobning targ'ibot ishtiyoqi fransuz armiyasini Gollandiya, Belgiya, Shveytsariya, Janubiy Germaniya va Shimoliy Italiyaga olib kirdi.

en: Everywhere kings were expelled and republics set up.
uz: Hamma joyda qirollar quvib chiqarildi va respublikalar o'rnatildi.

en: But such propagandist zeal as animated the Directorate did not prevent the looting of the treasures of the liberated peoples to relieve the ﬁnancial embarrassment of the French Government.
uz: Lekin Direktorat tomonidan rag'batlantirilgan bunday targ'ibotchi g'ayrat Fransiya hukumatining moliyaviy sharmandaligini bartaraf etish uchun ozod qilingan xalqlarning xazinalarini talon-toroj qilishga to'sqinlik qilmadi.

en: Their wars became less and less the holy wars of freedom, and more and more like the aggressive wars of the ancient regime.
uz: Ularning urushlari tobora kamroq erkinlik uchun muqaddas urushlarga va tobora ko'proq qadimgi rejimning tajovuzkor urushlariga o'xshab bordi.

en: The last feature of Grand Monarchy that France was
uz: Buyuk monarxiyaning Fransiya bo'lgan so'nggi xususiyati

en: disposed to discard was her tradition of foreign policy.
uz: Uning tashqi siyosat an'anasi tashlab yuborishga moyil edi.

en: One discovers it still as vigorous under the Directorate as if there had been no revolution.
uz: Boshqarma nazorati ostida u hali ham inqilob bo'lmagandek jonli ekanligini aniqlaydi.

en: Unhappily for France and the world a man arose who embodied in its in- tensest form this national egotism of the French.
uz: Afsuski, Fransiya va dunyo uchun shunday bir odam paydo bo'ldiki, u o'zining eng tarang shaklida fransuzlarning milliy egoizmini mujassam etgan.

en: He gave that country ten years of glory and the humiliation of a ﬁnal defeat.
uz: U o'sha davlatga o'n yillik shon-shuhrat va yakuniy mag'lubiyatning xorligini berdi.

en: This was that same Napoleon Bonaparte who had led the armies of the Directory to victory in Italy.
uz: Bu aynan o'sha Napoleon Bonapart edi, u Direktorlik armiyasini Italiyada g'alabaga olib borgan edi.

en: Throughout the ﬁve years of the Directorate he had been scheming and working for self-advancement.
uz: Direktoratning besh yillik faoliyati davomida u o'zini rivojlantirish uchun reja tuzdi va ishladi.

en: Gradually he clambered to supreme power.
uz: asta-sekin u oliy hokimiyatga erishdi.

en: He was a man of severely limited understanding but of ruthless directness and great energy.
uz: U juda cheklangan tushunchaga ega, ammo shafqatsiz to'g'rilik va katta energiyaga ega odam edi.

en: He had begun life as an extremist of the school of Robe- spierre; he owed his ﬁrst promotion to that side; but he had no real grasp of the new forces that were working in Europe.
uz: U hayotini Robe-Spierre maktabining ekstremist sifatida boshlagan edi; u o'zining birinchi ko'tarilishiga shu tomonga qarzdor edi; lekin u Yevropada ishlayotgan yangi kuchlar haqida hech qanday haqiqiy tasavvurga ega emas edi.

en: His utmost political imagina- tion carried him to a belated and tawdry attempt to restore the Western Em- pire.
uz: Uning eng yuqori siyosiy tasavvuri uni G'arbiy Em-pireni tiklash uchun kechikkan va quruq urinishga olib keldi.

en: He tried to destroy the remains of the old Holy Roman Empire, intend- ing to replace it by a new one centring upon Paris.
uz: U eski Muqaddas Rim imperiyasining qoldiqlarini yo'q qilishga urindi, uni Parijga qaratilgan yangi imperiyasi bilan almashtirmoqchi edi.

en: The Emperor in Vienna ceased to be the Holy Roman Emperor and became simply Emperor of Aus- tria.
uz: Vena imperatori Muqaddas Rim imperatori bo'lishni to'xtatdi va shunchaki Aus- tria imperatoriga aylandi.

en: Napoleon divorced his French wife in order to marry an Austrian princess.
uz: Napoleon avstriyalik malikaga turmushga chiqish uchun fransuz xotini bilan ajrashdi.

en: He became practically monarch of France as First Consul in 1799, and he made himself Emperor of France in 1804 in direct imitation of Charle- magne.
uz: U 1799-yilda Fransiya monarxi sifatida Birinchi Konsul sifatida amalda monarx bo'ldi va 1804-yilda Charle-magnega bevosita taqlid qilib, o'zini Fransiya imperatoriga aylantirdi.

en: He was crowned by the Pope in Paris, taking the crown from the Pope and putting it upon his own head himself as Charlemagne had direct- ed.
uz: U Parijda Rim Papasi tomonidan tojlandi, tojni Rim Papasidan olib, Charlz Buyuk tomonidan buyurilganidek, o'z boshiga qo'ydi.

en: His son was crowned King of Rome.
uz: Uning o'g'li Rim qiroli etib tojlandi.

en: For some years Napoleon’s reign was a career of victory.
uz: Napoleon hukmronligi bir necha yillar davomida g'alaba karerasi edi.

en: He conquered most of Italy and Spain, defeated Prussia and Austria, and dominated all Europe west of Russia.
uz: U Italiya va Ispaniyaning katta qismini zabt etdi, Prussiya va Avstriyani mag'lub etdi va Rossiyaning g'arbiy qismidagi butun Yevropani hukmronlik qildi.

en: But he never won the command of the sea from the British and his ﬂeets sustained a conclusive defeat inﬂicted by the British Admiral Nelson at Trafalgar (1805).
uz: Ammo u hech qachon britaniyaliklardan dengiz qo'mondonligini qo'lga kiritmadi va uning flotlari Trafalgarda (1805) Britaniya admirali Nelson tomonidan yetkazilgan yakuniy mag'lubiyatga uchradi.

en: Spain rose against him in 1808 and a British army under Wellington thrust the French armies slowly northward out of the peninsula.
uz: 1808-yilda Ispaniya unga qarshi ko'tarildi va Vellington boshchiligidagi Britaniya armiyasi fransuz armiyasini yarim oroldan sekin shimolga chiqarib yubordi.

en: In 1811 Napoleon came into conﬂict with the Tsar Alexander I, and in 1812 he invaded Russia with a great conglomerate army of 600,000 men, that was defeated and largely destroyed by the Russians and the Russian winter.
uz: 1811-yilda Napoleon podshoh Aleksandr I bilan mojaroga kirdi va 1812-yilda u 600 000 kishilik ulkan konglomerat armiyasi bilan Rossiyaga bostirib kirdi, ular ruslar va rus qishi tomonidan mag'lub etildi va asosan yo'q qilindi.

en: Germany rose against him, Sweden turned against him.
uz: Germaniya unga qarshi ko'tarildi, Shvetsiya unga qarshi burildi.

en: The French armies were beaten back and at Fontainebleau Napoleon
uz: Fransuz armiyasi orqaga va Fontainebleoda Napoleon tomonidan mag'lub etildi.

en: He was exiled to Elba, returned to France for one last ef- fort in 1815 and was defeated by the allied British, Belgians and Prussians at Waterloo.
uz: U Elbaga surgun qilindi, 1815-yilda Fransiyaga oxirgi safarga qaytdi va Waterloo shahrida ittifoqdosh inglizlar, belgiyaliklar va prusslar tomonidan mag'lub etildi.

en: He died a British prisoner at St.
uz: U Britaniyalik mahbus sifatida Sent-da vafot etdi.

en: The forces released by the French revolution were wasted and ﬁnished.
uz: Fransuz inqilobi tomonidan ozod qilingan kuchlar behudaga sarflandi va tugatildi.

en: A great Congress of the victorious allies met at Vienna to restore as far as pos- sible the state of affairs that the great storm had rent to pieces.
uz: G'alaba qozongan ittifoqchilarning buyuk Kongressi Vena shahrida yig'ilib, buyuk bo'ron parchalab ketgan vaziyatni imkon qadar tiklash uchun yig'ildi.

en: For nearly forty years a sort of peace, a peace of exhausted effort, was maintained in Europe.
uz: Qariyb qirq yil davomida Yevropada bir turdagi tinchlik, charchagan harakatlar tinchligi saqlanib qoldi.

en: [1] In his article, “French Revolutionary Wars,” in the Encyclopædia Britannica.
uz: Uning Fransuz Inqilobiy Urushlari nomli maqolasida, Encyclopædia Britannica.

en: LVI THE UNEASY PEACE IN EUROPE THAT FOLLOWED THE FALL OF NAPOLEON Two main causes prevented that period from being a complete social and international peace, and prepared the way for the cycle of wars between 1854 and 1871.
uz: LVI YevrOPADA NAPOLEONning qulashi ortidan kelayotgan YUNESKO TINCHLIGI. Ikki asosiy sabab o'sha davrning to'liq ijtimoiy va xalqaro tinchlikka erishishiga to'sqinlik qildi va 1854 va 1871 yillar oralig'idagi urushlar davriga yo'l ochdi.

en: The ﬁrst of these was the tendency of the royal courts con- cerned, towards the restoration of unfair privilege and interference with freedom of thought and writing and teaching.
uz: Bularning birinchisi qirollik saroylarining adolatsiz imtiyozlarni tiklash va fikrlash, yozish va o'qitish erkinligiga aralashish tendentsiyasi edi.

en: The second was the impossi- ble system of boundaries drawn by the diplomatists of Vienna.
uz: Ikkinchisi, Vena diplomatlari tomonidan chizilgan imkonsiz chegaralar tizimi edi.

en: The inherent disposition of monarchy to march back towards past condi- tions was ﬁrst and most particularly manifest in Spain.
uz: Monarxiyaning o'tmish sharoitlariga qaytishga bo'lgan o'ziga xos moyilligi birinchi va ayniqsa Ispaniyada namoyon bo'ldi.

en: Here even the Inqui- sition was restored.
uz: Bu yerda hatto inkvizitsiya ham tiklandi.

en: Across the Atlantic the Spanish colonies had followed the example of the United States and revolted against the European Great Power System, when Napoleon set his brother Joseph on the Spanish throne in 1810.
uz: Atlantika dengizidan o'tib, Ispaniya mustamlakalari AQShning namunasiga ergashib, Napoleon 1810-yilda o'z akasi Yusufni Ispaniya taxtiga o'rnatganida, Yevropa Buyuk Kuchlar Tizimiga qarshi isyon ko'tardi.

en: The George Washington of South America was General Bolivar.
uz: Janubiy Amerikaning Jorj Vashington general Bolivar edi.

en: Spain was unable to suppress this revolt, it dragged on much as the United States War of Independence had dragged on, and at last the suggestion was made by Austria, in accordance with the spirit of the Holy Alliance, that the European monarch should assist Spain in this struggle.
uz: Ispaniya bu isyonni bostira olmadi, u AQSh Mustaqillik Urushi kabi cho'zildi va nihoyat Avstriya tomonidan Muqaddas Ittifoq ruhiga muvofiq, Yevropa monarxi Ispaniyaga bu kurashda yordam berishi kerakligi taklif qilindi.

en: This was opposed by Britain in Europe, but it was the prompt action of President Monroe of the United States in 1823 which conclusively warned off this projected monarchist restoration.
uz: Bunga Yevropada Britaniya qarshilik ko'rsatdi, lekin aynan 1823-yilda AQSh prezidenti Monroning tezkor harakati ushbu loyihalashtirilgan monarxik tiklanishni aniq ogohlantirdi.

en: He announced that the United States would regard any extension of the European system in the Western Hemisphere as a hos- tile act.
uz: U AQShning G'arbiy yarim sharda Yevropa tizimining har qanday uzaytirilishini hos- tile act deb hisoblashini e'lon qildi.

en: Thus arose the Monroe Doctrine, the doctrine that there must be no
uz: Shunday qilib, Monro doktrinasi paydo bo'ldi, u ta'limotga ko'ra, hech narsa bo'lishi kerak emas.

en: extension of extra- American government in America, which has kept the Great Power system out of America for nearly a hundred years and permit- ted the new states of Spanish America to work out their destinies along their own lines.
uz: Amerikada Amerika davlatlaridan tashqari hukumatning kengayishi, bu esa Buyuk Kuchlar tizimini deyarli yuz yil davomida Amerikadan uzoqlashtirgan va Ispaniya Amerikasining yangi shtatlariga o'z taqdirlarini o'z yo'nalishlarida ishlab chiqishga imkon bergan.

en: But if Spanish monarchism lost its colonies, it could at least, under the protection of the Concert of Europe, do what it chose in Europe.
uz: Lekin agar Ispaniya monarxiyasi o'z mustamlakalarini yo'qotsa, hech bo'lmaganda, Yevropa Konserti himoyasi ostida, Yevropada o'zi tanlagan narsani qilishi mumkin edi.

en: A popular insurrection in Spain was crushed by a French army in 1823, with a man- date from a European congress, and simultaneously Austria suppressed a revolution in Naples.
uz: Ispaniya xalq qo'zg'oloni 1823-yilda Fransiya armiyasi tomonidan bostirildi, Yevropa kongressidan man-dat bilan, shu bilan birga Avstriya Neapoldagi inqilobni bostirdi.

en: In 1824 Louis XVIII died, and was succeeded by Charles X.
uz: 1824-yilda Lui XVIII vafot etdi va uning o'rniga Charlz X keldi.

en: Charles set himself to destroy the liberty of the press and universities, and to restore ab- solute government; the sum of a billion francs was voted to compensate the nobles for the chateau burnings and sequestrations of 1789.
