uz: Charlz matbuot va universitetlarning erkinligini yo'q qilishga, shuningdek, mustaqil hukumatni tiklashga qaror qildi; bir milliard frank miqdori 1789-yildagi qasrning yoqilishi va musodaralari uchun zodagonlarni qoplash uchun ovoz berildi.

en: In 1830 Paris rose against this embodiment of the ancient regime, and replaced him by Louis Philippe, the son of that Philip, Duke of Orleans, who was executed during the Terror.
uz: 1830-yilda Parij qadimiy rejimning ushbu mujassamligiga qarshi ko'tarildi va uning o'rniga Orlean gertsogi Filippning o'g'li Lui Filipp keldi, u Terror davrida qatl etilgan edi.

en: The other continental monarchies, in face of the open ap- proval of the revolution by Great Britain and a strong liberal ferment in Germany and Austria, did not interfere in this affair.
uz: Boshqa qit'a monarxiyalari Buyuk Britaniyaning inqilobni ochiqdan-ochiq qo'llab-quvvatlashi va Germaniyada va Avstriyada kuchli liberal ferment qarshisida bu ishga aralashmadi.

en: After all, France was still a monarchy.
uz: Axir, Fransiya hali ham monarxiya edi.

en: This man Louis Philippe (1830-48) remained the constitu- tional King of France for eighteen years.
uz: Bu odam Lui Filipp (1830-48) o'n sakkiz yil Fransiya konstitutsiyaviy qiroli bo'lib qoldi.

en: Such were the uneasy swayings of the peace of the Congress of Vienna, which were provoked by the reactionary proceedings of the monarchists.
uz: Vena Kongressining tinchligining noqulay tebranishlari shunday edi, ular monarxlarning reaksion harakatlari natijasida kelib chiqdi.

en: The stresses that arose from the unscientiﬁc boundaries planned by the diplomatists at Vienna gathered force more deliberately, but they were even more dangerous to the peace of mankind.
uz: Venalik diplomatlar tomonidan rejalashtirilgan ilmiy bo'lmagan chegaralardan kelib chiqqan zo'riqishlar kuchni ko'proq ongli ravishda to'pladi, ammo ular insoniyat tinchligi uchun yanada xavfli edi.

en: It is extraordinarily inconvenient to administer together the affairs of peoples speaking different languages and so reading different literatures and having different general ideas, espe- cially if those differences are exacerbated by religious disputes.
uz: Turli tillarda so'zlashuvchi va shu sababli turli adabiyotlarni o'qiydigan va turli umumiy g'oyalarga ega bo'lgan xalqlarning ishlarini birgalikda boshqarish juda noqulay, ayniqsa, agar bu farqlar diniy nizolar tufayli kuchaytirilgan bo'lsa.

en: Only some strong mutual interest, such as the common defensive needs of the Swiss mountaineers, can justify a close linking of peoples of dissimilar languages and faiths; and even in Switzerland there is the utmost local autonomy.
uz: Faqatgina kuchli o'zaro manfaatdorlik, masalan, Shveytsariya tog'chilarining umumiy mudofaa ehtiyojlari, turli tillar va dinlarga ega xalqlarning yaqin bog'lanishini oqlashi mumkin; va hatto Shveytsariyada ham eng yuqori mahalliy avtonomiya mavjud.

en: When, as in Macedonia, populations are mixed in a patchwork of villages and districts, the cantonal system is imperatively needed.
uz: Makedoniyadagidek, aholi qishloqlar va tumanlar bilan aralashganda, kantonal tizim zarur zarur.

en: But if the reader will look at the map of Europe as the Congress of Vienna drew it, he will see that this gathering seems almost as if it had planned the maximum of local exasperation.
uz: Lekin agar o'quvchi Vena Kongressining chizgan Yevropa xaritasiga nazar solsa, u bu yig'ilish deyarli mahalliy g'azabning maksimal darajasini rejalashtirgandek ko'rinadi.

en: It destroyed the Dutch Republic, quite needlessly, it lumped together the Protestant Dutch with the French-speaking Catholics of the old Spanish (Austrian) Netherlands, and set up a kingdom of the Netherlands.
uz: U Golland Respublikasini vayron qildi, juda behudaga, protestant gollandlarni eski Ispaniya (Avstriya) Niderlandiyasining fransuz tilida so'zlashuvchi katoliklari bilan birlashtirdi va Golland qirolligini tuzdi.

en: It handed over not merely the old republic of Venice, but all of North Italy as far as Milan to the German-speaking Austrians.
uz: U nafaqat eski Venetsiya respublikasini, balki butun Shimoliy Italiyani, hatto Milangacha nemis tilida so'zlashuvchi avstriyaliklarga topshirdi.

en: French-speaking Savoy it com- bined with pieces of Italy to restore the kingdom of Sardinia.
uz: Fransuz tilida so'zlashuvchi Savoy uni Sardiniya qirolligini tiklash uchun Italiyaning bo'laklari bilan birlashtirdi.

en: Austria and Hungary, already a sufﬁciently explosive mixture of discordant nationali- ties, Germans, Hungarians, Czecho-Slovaks, Jugo-Slavs, Roumanians, and now Italians, was made still more impossible by conﬁrming Austria’s Polish acquisitions of 1772 and 1795.
uz: Avstriya va Vengriya, allaqachon kelishmovchilikli millatchiliklar, nemislar, vengerlar, chex-slovaklar, jugoslavlar, ruminlar va endi italyanlarning yetarlicha portlovchi aralashmasi bo'lgan, Avstriyaning 1772 va 1795-yillardagi Polsha qo'lga kiritganlarini tasdiqlash orqali yanada imkonsiz holga keldi.

en: The Catholic and republican-spirited Polish people were chieﬂy given over to the less civilized rule of the Greek-ortho- dox Tsar, but important districts went to Protestant Prussia.
uz: Katolik va respublikachilik ruhidagi polyak xalqi asosan yunon-ortho-dox podshosining kamroq madaniy hukmronligiga berilgan edi, lekin muhim tumanlar protestant Prussiyaga o'tdi.

en: The Tsar was also conﬁrmed in his acquisition of the entirely alien Finns.
uz: Shoh butunlay begona finlarni qo'lga kiritganida ham tasdiqlandi.

en: The very dis- similar Norwegian and Swedish peoples were bound together under one king.
uz: Shved va norveg xalqlarining o'ziga xos o'xshashligi bir qirol ostida bir-biriga bog'langan edi.

en: Germany, the reader will see, was left in a particularly dangerous state of muddle.
uz: Germaniya, o'quvchi ko'radi, ayniqsa xavfli chalkashlik holatida qoldi.

en: Prussia and Austria were both partly in and partly out of a Ger- man confederation, which included a multitude of minor states.
uz: Prussiya va Avstriya qisman Germaniya konfederatsiyasida ham, qisman undan tashqarida ham bo'lgan, unga ko'plab kichik davlatlar kirgan.

en: The King of Denmark came into the German confederation by virtue of certain German- speaking possessions in Holstein.
uz: Daniya qiroli Holshteynda nemis tilida so'zlashuvchi ayrim mulklari tufayli Germaniya konfederatsiyasiga kirdi.

en: Luxembourg was included in the German confederation, though its ruler was also King of the Netherlands, and though many of its peoples talked French.
uz: Lyuksemburg Germaniya konfederatsiyasiga kiritilgan edi, garchi uning hukmdori Niderlandiya qiroli ham bo'lsa va uning ko'pchilik xalqlari fransuz tilida gapirgan bo'lsa ham.

en: Here was a complete disregard of the fact that the people who talk Ger- man and base their ideas on German literature, the people who talk Italian and base their ideas on Italian literature, and the people who talk Polish and base their ideas on Polish literature, will all be far better off and most help- ful and least obnoxious to the rest of mankind if they conduct their own af- fairs in their own idiom within the ring-fence of their own speech.
uz: Bu yerda nemis tilida gapiradigan va o'z g'oyalarini nemis adabiyotiga asoslaydigan odamlar, italyan tilida gapiradigan va o'z g'oyalarini italyan adabiyotiga asoslaydigan odamlar, polyak tilida gapiradigan va o'z g'oyalarini polyak adabiyotiga asoslaydigan odamlar, agar ular o'z nutqlari doirasida o'z tillarida af-yarmlar o'tkazsalar, butun insoniyat uchun ancha yaxshiroq va eng foydali va eng kam zararli bo'lishadi.

en: Is it any wonder that one of the most popular songs in Germany during this period declared that wherever the German tongue was spoken, there was the Ger- man Fatherland!
uz: Ajab emasmi, Germaniyadagi shu davrdagi eng mashhur qo'shiqlardan biri nemis tili qayerda aytilsa, u yerda Germaniya Vatani borligini e'lon qilgan edi!

en: PORTRAIT OF NAPOLEON (CORONATION)  (From a print in the British Museum)
uz: NAPOLEON PO'RTRAYTI (Buyuk Britaniya Muzeyida chop etilgan)

en: In 1830 French-speaking Belgium, stirred up by the current revolution in France, revolted against its Dutch association in the kingdom of the Nether- lands.
uz: 1830-yilda Fransuz tilida so'zlashuvchi Belgiya, Fransiyadagi hozirgi inqilob tufayli qo'zg'algan holda, Niderlandiya qirolligida uning Gollandiya uyushmasiga qarshi qo'zg'olon ko'tardi.

en: The powers, terriﬁed at the possibilities of a republic or of annexa- tion to France, hurried in to pacify this situation, and gave the Belgians a monarch, Leopold I of Saxe-Coburg Gotha.
uz: Kuchlar, respublika yoki Fransiyaga qo'shilish imkoniyatidan dahshatga tushib, bu vaziyatni tinchlantirishga shoshilishdi va belgiyaliklarga Saksa-Koburg Gotalik Leopold I monarxini berishdi.

en: There were also ineffectual re- volts in Italy and Germany in 1830, and a much more serious one in Russ- ian Poland.
uz: 1830-yillarda Italiya va Germaniyada ham samarasiz revoltlar bo'lgan, Rossiya-Polshada esa ancha jiddiyroq.

en: A republican government held out in Warsaw for a year against Nicholas I (who succeeded Alexander in 1825), and was then stamped out of existence with great violence and cruelty.
uz: Varshavada Nikolay I ga qarshi bir yil davomida respublika hukumati (u 1825-yilda Aleksandrning o'rnini egallagan), keyin esa katta zo'ravonlik va shafqatsizlik bilan yo'q qilindi.

en: The Polish language was banned, and the Greek Orthodox church was substituted for the Roman Catholic as the state religion ....
uz: Polsha tili taqiqlandi va yunon pravoslav cherkovi Rim-katolik diniga davlat dini sifatida almashtirildi...

en: In 1821 there was an insurrection of the Greeks against the Turks.
uz: 1821-yilda yunonlarning turklarga qarshi qo'zg'oloni bo'lib o'tdi.

en: For six years they fought a desperate war, while the governments of Europe looked on.
uz: Olti yil davomida ular umidsiz urush olib bordilar, Yevropa hukumatlari esa qarab turishdi.

en: Liberal opinion protested against this inactivity; volunteers from every European country joined the insurgents, and at last Britain, France and Rus-
uz: Liberal fikr bu befaollikka qarshi norozilik bildirdi; har bir Yevropa davlatidan ko'ngillilar isyonchilarga qo'shildi va nihoyat Britaniya, Fransiya va Rus...

en: sia took joint action.
uz: Sia birgalikda harakat qildi.

en: The Turkish ﬂeet was destroyed by the French and English at the battle of Navarino (1827), and the Tsar invaded Turkey.
uz: Turkiya floti Navarino jangida (1827) fransuzlar va inglizlar tomonidan yo'q qilindi va podshoh Turkiyaga bostirib kirdi.

en: By the treaty of Adrianople (1829) Greece was declared free, but she was not permitted to resume her ancient republican traditions.
uz: Adrianopol shartnomasi (1829) bilan Gretsiya ozod deb e'lon qilindi, lekin unga o'zining qadimiy respublika an'analarini qayta tiklashga ruxsat berilmadi.

en: A German king was found for Greece, one Prince Otto of Bavaria, and Christian governors were set up in the Danubian provinces (which are now Roumania) and Serbia (a part of the Jugo-Slav region).
uz: Gretsiya uchun nemis shohi topildi, Bavariya shahzodasi Otto topildi va Dunay viloyatlarida (hozirgi Ruminiya bo'lgan) va Serbiya (Yugo-Slavyan mintaqasining bir qismi) xristian gubernatorlar o'rnatildi.

en: Much blood had still to run however before the Turk was altogether expelled from these lands.
uz: Ammo turk bu yerlardan butunlay quvib chiqarilishidan oldin hali ko'p qon oqishi kerak edi.

en: LVII THE DEVELOPMENT OF MATERIAL KNOWLEDGE Throughout the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries and the opening years of the nineteenth century, while these conﬂicts of the powers and princes were going on in Europe, and the patchwork of the treaty of Westphalia (1648) was changing kaleidoscopically into the patchwork of the treaty of Vienna (1815), and while the sailing ship was spreading European inﬂuence throughout the world, a steady growth of knowledge and a general clearing up of men’s ideas about the world in which they lived was in progress in the European and Europeanized world.
uz: XVII va XVIII asrlar davomida va XIX asrning dastlabki yillarida, Yevropada qudratlar va knyazlar to'qnashuvi davom etayotgan paytda, Vestfaliya shartnomasining parchasi kaleidoskopik tarzda Vena shartnomasining parchasiga o'zgarib borayotgan edi (1815), va yelkanli kema butun dunyoga Yevropa ta'sirini tarqatib borayotgan edi, bilimning barqaror o'sishi va odamlarning o'zlari yashayotgan dunyo haqidagi fikrlarining umumiy o'zgarishi Yevropa va Yevropalashgan dunyoda davom etayotgan edi.

en: It went on disconnected from political life, and producing throughout the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries no striking immediate results in politi- cal life.
uz: U siyosiy hayotdan uzilgan holda davom etdi va o'n yettinchi va o'n sakkizinchi asrlar davomida siyosiy hayotda sezilarli darhol natijalar bermadi.

en: Nor was it affecting popular thought very profoundly during this period.
uz: Na bu davrda xalq fikriga juda chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: These reactions were to come later, and only in their full force in the latter half of the nineteenth century.
uz: Bu reaksiyalar keyinroq kelishi kerak edi, va faqat XIX asrning oxirgi yarmida to'liq kuchda.

en: It was a process that went on chieﬂy in a small world of prosperous and independent-spirited people.
uz: Bu jarayon asosan farovon va mustaqil ruhdagi odamlarning kichik dunyosida davom etardi.

en: Without what the English call the “private gentleman,” the scientiﬁc process could not have begun in Greece, and could not have been renewed in Europe.
uz: Inglizlar xususiy janob deb ataydigan narsa bo'lmasa, ilmiy jarayon Gretsiyada boshlanmagan bo'lardi va Yevropada yangilanmagan bo'lardi.

en: The universities played a part but not a leading part in the philosophical and sci- entiﬁc thought of this period.
uz: Universitetlar bu davrning falsafiy va ilmiy fikrlashida rol o'ynadi, lekin yetakchi rol o'ynamadi.

en: Endowed learning is apt to be timid and con- servative learning, lacking in initiative and resistent to innovation, unless it has the spur of contact with independent minds.
uz: Muassasasiz ta'lim qo'rqoq va xizmatkor ta'lim bo'lishga moyil, tashabbus yetishmaydi va mustaqil onglar bilan aloqada bo'lishga turtki bo'lmasa, innovatsiyalarga qarshilik ko'rsatadi.

en: We have already noted the formation of the Royal Society in 1662 and its work in realizing the dream of Bacon’s New Atlantis.
uz: Biz 1662 yilda Qirollik Jamiyatining tashkil etilishini va uning Bekonning Yangi Atlantida orzusini amalga oshirishdagi ishini allaqachon qayd etganmiz.

en: Throughout the eigh-
uz: Sakkizinchi yil davomida...

en: teenth century there was much clearing up of general ideas about matter and motion, much mathematical advance, a systematic development of the use of optical glass in microscope and telescope, a renewed energy in classiﬁca- tory natural history, a great revival of anatomical science.
uz: O'ninchi asrda materiya va harakat haqidagi umumiy g'oyalarning ancha oydinlashishi, matematik taraqqiyot, mikroskop va teleskopda optik shisha ishlatishning tizimli rivojlanishi, klassik tabiiy tarixda yangilangan energiya, anatomiya fanining buyuk tiklanishi kuzatildi.

en: The science of geology—foreshadowed by Aristotle and anticipated by Leonardo da Vinci (1452-1519)—began its great task of interpreting the Record of the Rocks.
uz: Geologiya fani  Arastotel tomonidan bashorat qilingan va Leonardo da Vinchi tomonidan (1452-1519) kutilgan  Toshlar yozuvini talqin qilishning buyuk vazifasini boshladi.

en: EARLY ROLLING STOCK ON THE LIVERPOOL AND MAN- CHESTER RAILWAY IN THE FIRST DAYS OF THE RAILWAY The progress of physical science reacted upon metallurgy.
uz: Liverpol va Man-Chester temir yo'llarida erta rolik zaxira temir yo'lning birinchi kunlarida Fizika fanining taraqqiyoti metallurgiyaga ta'sir qildi.

en: Improved met- allurgy, affording the possibility of a larger and bolder handling of masses of metal and other materials, reacted upon practical inventions.
uz: Metallurgiyaning yaxshilanishi, metall va boshqa materiallarning massalarini kattaroq va dadilroq qayta ishlash imkoniyatini taqdim etib, amaliy ixtirolarga javob berdi.

en: Machinery on a new scale and in a new abundance appeared to revolutionize industry.
uz: Mashinasozlik yangi miqyosda va yangi mo'l-ko'llikda sanoatda inqilob ko'rsatdi.

en: In 1804 Trevithick adapted the Watt engine to transport and made the ﬁrst locomotive.
uz: 1804-yilda Trevitik Vatt dvigatelini transportga moslashtirdi va birinchi lokomotivni yaratdi.

en: In 1825 the ﬁrst railway, between Stockton and Darlington, was opened, and Stephenson’s “Rocket,” with a thirteen-ton train, got up to a speed of forty-four miles per hour.
uz: 1825-yilda Stockton va Darlington oʻrtasida birinchi temir yoʻl ochildi va oʻn uch tonnalik poyezdga ega boʻlgan Stephensonning Rocket poyezdi soatiga qirq toʻrt mil tezlikka koʻtarildi.

en: From 1830 onward railways multi- plied.
uz: 1830 yildan boshlab temir yo'llar ko'p qatlamli edi.

en: By the middle of the century a network of railways had spread all over Europe.
uz: Asr o'rtalariga kelib, Yevropa bo'ylab temir yo'l tarmog'i tarqaldi.

en: EARLY TRAVELLING ON THE LIVERPOOL AND MANCHESTER RAILWAY, 1833 Here was a sudden change in what had long been a ﬁxed condition of hu- man life, the maximum rate of land transport.
uz: LIVERPOUL VA MANCHESTER RAYON POYDONIDA DAVRDA SayoHAT QILISH, 1833-yil. Bu yerda uzoq vaqtdan beri inson hayotining qat'iy sharti bo'lgan, quruqlik transporti maksimal tezligida to'satdan o'zgarish yuz berdi.

en: After the Russian disaster, Napoleon travelled from near Vilna to Paris in 312 hours.
uz: Rossiya falokatidan so'ng, Napoleon Vilna yaqinidan Parijga 312 soat ichida yetib keldi.

en: ney of about 1,400 miles.
uz: taxminan 1400 mil uzoqlikda.

en: He was travelling with every conceivable advan- tage, and he averaged under 5 miles an hour.
uz: U har bir tasavvur qilinadigan oldinga siljish bilan sayohat qilardi va u o'rtacha soatiga 5 mildan kam tezlikda harakat qilardi.

en: An ordinary traveller could not have done this distance in twice the time.
uz: Oddiy sayohatchi bu masofani ikki marta bosib o'ta olmas edi.

en: These were about the same maxi- mum rates of travel as held good between Rome and Gaul in the ﬁrst centu- ry A.D.
uz: Bular taxminan milodiy birinchi asrda Rim va Galliya o'rtasida yaxshi saqlangan sayohatning eng yuqori darajasi edi.

en: Then suddenly came this tremendous change.
uz: Keyin to'satdan bu ulkan o'zgarish keldi.

en: The railways reduced this journey for any ordinary traveller to less than forty-eight hours.
uz: Temir yo'llar bu sayohatni oddiy sayohatchi uchun qirq sakkiz soatdan kamroq vaqtga qisqartirdi.

en: That is to say, they reduced the chief European distances to about a tenth of what they had been.
uz: Ya'ni, ular asosiy Yevropa masofalarini avvalgilarining taxminan o'ndan bir qismiga qisqartirdilar.

en: They made it possible to carry out administrative work in areas ten times as great as any that had hitherto been workable under one administration.
uz: Ular bir ma'muriyat ostida shu paytgacha amalga oshirilishi mumkin bo'lgan hududlardan o'n barobar kattaroq bo'lgan hududlarda ma'muriy ishlarni amalga oshirish imkonini berishdi.

en: The full signiﬁcance of that possibility in Europe still re- mains to be realized.
uz: Yevropada bu imkoniyatning toʻliq ahamiyati hali qayta amalga oshirilishi kerak.

en: Europe is still netted in boundaries drawn in the horse and road era.
uz: Yevropa hali ham ot va yo'l davrida chizilgan chegaralarda to'rga mixlangan.

en: In America the effects were immediate.
uz: Amerikada ta'sirlar darhol kuzatildi.

en: To the United States of America, sprawling westward, it meant the possibility of a continuous access to Washington, however far the frontier travelled across the conti- nent.
uz: Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari uchun, g'arbga cho'zilgan holda, bu Vashingtonga chegaradan qancha uzoq bo'lmasin, uzluksiz kirish imkoniyatini anglatardi.

en: It meant unity, sustained on a scale that would otherwise have been impossible.
uz: Bu birlikni anglatardi, boshqacha qilib aytganda imkonsiz bo'lgan miqyosda saqlanib qolgan.

en: THE STEAMBOAT: CLERMONT, 1807, U.S.A.
uz: STEAMBOAT: CLERMONT, 1807, AQSh.

en: The steamboat was, if anything, a little ahead of the steam engine in its earlier phases.
uz: Bug' kemasi, hech bo'lmasa, o'zining dastlabki bosqichlarida bug' dvigatelidan biroz oldinda edi.

en: There was a steamboat, the Charlotte Dundas, on the Firth of Clyde Canal in 1802, and in 1807 an American named Fulton had a steam-
uz: 1802-yilda Klayd kanalida Sharlotta Dundas nomli bugʻ kemasi bor edi va 1807-yilda Fulton ismli amerikalik bir bugʻ kemasiga ega edi.

en: er, the Clermont, with British-built engines, upon the Hudson River above New York.
uz: Er, Klermont, Britaniya tomonidan qurilgan dvigatellari bilan, Nyu-York ustidagi Hudson daryosida.

en: The ﬁrst steamship to put to sea was also an American, the Phœnix, which went from New York (Hoboken) to Philadelphia.
uz: Dengizga chiqarilgan birinchi bug' kemasi ham amerikalik Phœnix bo'lib, u Nyu-Yorkdan (Hoboken) Filadelfiyaga yo'l oldi.

en: So, too, was the ﬁrst ship using steam (she also had sails) to cross the Atlantic, the Savannah (1819).
uz: Shunday qilib, Atlantika okeanidan o'tish uchun bug'dan foydalangan birinchi kema (uning yelkanlari ham bor edi), Savanna edi (1819).

en: All these were paddle-wheel boats and paddle-wheel boats are not adapted to work in heavy seas.
uz: Bularning barchasi eshkakli g'ildirakli qayiqlar edi va eshkakli g'ildirakli qayiqlar og'ir dengizlarda ishlashga mos emas.

en: The paddles smash too easily, and the boat is then disabled.
uz: Arralar juda oson sinadi va keyin qayiq ishdan chiqadi.

en: The screw steamship followed rather slowly.
uz: Vintli bug' kemasi ancha sekin davom etdi.

en: Many difﬁculties had to be surmounted before the screw was a practicable thing.
uz: Vint amaliy narsa bo'lishidan oldin ko'plab qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tish kerak edi.

en: Not until the middle of the century did the tonnage of steamships upon the sea begin to overhaul that of sailing ships.
uz: Asrning o'rtalariga kelib dengizdagi bug' kemalari tonnasi suzuvchi kemalar tonnasini qayta ko'rib chiqishni boshladi.

en: After that the evolution in sea transport was rapid.
uz: Shundan so'ng dengiz transportida evolyutsiya tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlandi.

en: For the ﬁrst time men began to cross the seas and oceans with some certainty as to the date of their arrival.
uz: Odamlar birinchi marta dengizlar va okeanlarni kelish sanasiga nisbatan ma'lum bir ishonch bilan kesib o'ta boshladilar.

en: The transatlantic crossing, which had been an uncertain adventure of several weeks—which might stretch to months—was accelerated, until in 1910 it was brought down, in the case of the fastest boats, to under ﬁve days, with a practically notiﬁable hour of arrival.
uz: Transatlantik kesib o'tish, bir necha haftalik noaniq sarguzasht bo'lgan edi  oylargacha cho'zilishi mumkin edi  tezlashdi, toki 1910 yilda u eng tezkor qayiqlar holatida, deyarli xabar qilinmaydigan soat bilan besh kundan kamroqqa tushirildi.

en: Concurrently with the development of steam transport upon land and sea a new and striking addition to the facilities of human intercourse arose out of the investigations of Volta, Galvani and Faraday into various electrical phenomena.
uz: Yer va dengiz orqali bug' transporti rivojlanishi bilan birga Volta, Galvani va Faradayning turli elektr hodisalarini o'rganishidan inson aloqasi imkoniyatlariga yangi va ajoyib qo'shimcha paydo bo'ldi.

en: The electric telegraph came into existence in 1835.
uz: Elektr telegraf 1835-yilda paydo bo'lgan.

en: The ﬁrst underseas cable was laid in 1851 between France and England.
uz: Birinchi dengiz kabeli 1851-yilda Fransiya va Angliya o'rtasida yotqizilgan.

en: In a few years the telegraph system had spread over the civilized world, and news which had hitherto travelled slowly from point to point became practically simultaneous throughout the earth.
uz: Bir necha yil ichida telegraf tizimi sivilizatsiyalashgan dunyo bo'ylab tarqaldi va shu paytgacha sekin-asta nuqtadan nuqtaga tarqalgan yangiliklar butun yer yuzida deyarli bir vaqtning o'zida paydo bo'ldi.

en: These things, the steam railway and the electric telegraph, were to the popular imagination of the middle nineteenth century the most striking and revolutionary of inventions, but they were only the most conspicuous and clumsy ﬁrst fruits of a far more extensive process.
uz: Bu narsalar, bug' temir yo'li va elektr telegraf, XIX asr o'rtalarining ommabop tasavvurida eng hayratlanarli va inqilobiy ixtirolar edi, lekin ular ancha kengroq jarayonning eng ko'zga tashlanadigan va beodob birinchi mevalari edi xolos.

en: Technical knowledge and skill were developing with an extraordinary rapidity, and to an ex- traordinary extent measured by the progress of any previous age.
uz: Texnik bilim va mahorat g'ayrioddiy tezlikda rivojlanardi va oldingi har qanday yoshdagi taraqqiyot bilan o'lchangan g'ayrioddiy darajada edi.

en: Far less conspicuous at ﬁrst in everyday life, but ﬁnally far more important, was the extension of man’s power over various structural materials.
uz: Kundalik hayotda dastlab unchalik ko'zga tashlanmaydigan, lekin oxir-oqibatda ancha muhimroq bo'lgan narsa insonning turli xil konstruktiv materiallar ustidan kuchini cho'zishi edi.

en: Before the mid- dle of the eighteenth century iron was reduced from its ores by means of wood charcoal, was handled in small pieces, and hammered and wrought into shape.
uz: XVIII asrning o'rtalariga qadar temir o'z rudalaridan yog'och ko'miri yordamida olinardi, mayda bo'laklarga bo'linib ishlatilardi va bolg'a bilan maydalanib, shaklga keltirilardi.

en: It was material for a craftsman.
uz: Bu hunarmand uchun mo'ljallangan material edi.

en: Quality and treatment were enormously dependent upon the experience and sagacity of the individual
uz: Sifat va davolash shaxsning tajribasi va donoligiga juda bog'liq edi.

en: The largest masses of iron that could be dealt with under those conditions amounted at most (in the sixteenth century) to two or three tons.
uz: O'sha sharoitlarda ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan eng katta temir massasi (o'n oltinchi asrda) ko'pi bilan ikki-uch tonnaga yetardi.

en: (There was a very deﬁnite upward limit, therefore, to the size of cannon.) The blast-furnace rose in the eighteenth century and developed with the use of coke.
uz: Shunday qilib, to'p o'lchamiga juda aniq yuqori chegara bor edi. XVIII asrda portlatish pechi ko'tarilib, kok ishlatish bilan rivojlandi.

en: Not before the eighteenth century do we ﬁnd rolled sheet iron (1728) and rolled rods and bars (1783).
uz: XVIII asrgacha emas, balki rolikli list temir (1728) va rolikli sterjenlar va sterjenlar (1783) uchraydi.

en: Nasmyth’s steam hammer came as late as 1838.
uz: Nasmitning bug'li bolg'asi 1838-yilda paydo bo'lgan.

en: The ancient world, because of its metallurgical inferiority, could not use steam.
uz: Qadimgi dunyo metallurgiya nuqtai nazaridan bug'dan foydalana olmas edi.

en: The steam engine, even the primitive pumping engine, could not de- velop before sheet iron was available.
uz: Bug' dvigateli, hatto ibtidoiy nasos dvigateli ham varaq temir mavjud bo'lmaguncha de-velop qila olmas edi.

en: The early engines seem to the mod- ern eye very pitiful and clumsy bits of ironmongery, but they were the ut- most that the metallurgical science of the time could do.
uz: Dastlabki dvigatellari zamonaviy ko'zga juda achinarli va noqulay temirchilik qismlariga o'xshardi, lekin ular o'sha davr metallurgiya fani qila oladigan eng katta narsa edi.

en: As late as 1856 came the Bessemer process, and presently (1864) the open-hearth process, in which steel and every sort of iron could be melted, puriﬁed and cast in a manner and upon a scale hitherto unheard of.
uz: 1856-yilgacha Bessemer jarayoni keldi, hozirda esa (1864) ochiq yurakli jarayon, unda po'lat va har qanday temir allaqachon eshitilmagan darajada eritilishi, tozalanishi va quyilishi mumkin edi.

en: To-day in the electric furnace one may see tons of incandescent steel swirling about like boiling milk in a saucepan.
uz: Hozirgi kunda elektr pechda tonnalab qandilli po'latning tovada qaynoq sut kabi aylanib yurganini ko'rish mumkin.

en: Nothing in the previous practical advances of mankind is compa- rable in its consequences to the complete mastery over enormous masses of steel and iron and over their texture and quality which man has now achieved.
uz: Insoniyatning avvalgi amaliy yutuqlarida hech narsa inson hozir erishgan ulkan po'lat va temir massalari, ularning tuzilishi va sifati ustidan to'liq ustunlikka erishish oqibatlarida murakkab emas.

en: The railways and early engines of all sorts were the mere ﬁrst tri- umphs of the new metallurgical methods.
uz: Temir yo'llar va har xil turdagi dastlabki dvigatellari yangi metallurgiya usullarining birinchi uchta nusxasi edi.

en: Presently came ships of iron and steel, vast bridges, and a new way of building with steel upon a gigantic scale.
uz: Hozirda temir va po'latdan yasalgan kemalar, ulkan ko'priklar va ulkan miqyosda po'latdan yasalgan yangi qurilish usuli paydo bo'ldi.

en: Men realized too late that they had planned their railways with far too timid a gauge, that they could have organized their travelling with far more steadiness and comfort upon a much bigger scale.
uz: Erkaklar o'z temir yo'llarini juda qo'rqoq o'lchov bilan rejalashtirganliklarini juda kech anglab yetishdi, ular sayohatlarini ancha kengroq masshtabda ancha barqaror va qulaylik bilan tashkil qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: Before the nineteenth century there were no ships in the world much over 2,000 tons burthen; now there is nothing wonderful about a 50,000-ton lin- er.
uz: XIX asrgacha dunyoda 2000 tonnadan ortiq yuk ko'taradigan kemalar yo'q edi; hozirda 50 000 tonnalik kema haqida hech qanday ajoyib narsa yo'q.

en: There are people who sneer at this kind of progress as being a progress in “mere size,” but that sort of sneering merely marks the intellectual limita- tions of those who indulge in it.
uz: Ba'zi odamlar bunday taraqqiyotni oddiy o'lchamdagi taraqqiyot deb masxara qiladilar, lekin bu turdagi masxarabozlik faqat unga berilib ketayotganlarning intellektual cheklanishlarini belgilaydi.

en: The great ship or the steel-frame building is not, as they imagine, a magniﬁed version of the small ship or building of the past; it is a thing different in kind, more lightly and strongly built, of ﬁn- er and stronger materials; instead of being a thing of precedent and rule-of- thumb, it is a thing of subtle and intricate calculation.
uz: Katta kema yoki po'lat karkasli bino ular tasavvur qilganidek, o'tmishdagi kichik kema yoki binoning kattalashtirilgan versiyasi emas; u o'ziga xos, yengilroq va mustahkamroq qurilgan, mayda va mustahkam materiallardan iborat narsa; precedent va bosh barmoq qoidasi bo'lish o'rniga, nozik va murakkab hisoblash narsasidir.

en: In the old house or ship, matter was dominant—the material and its needs had to be slavishly obeyed; in the new, matter had been captured, changed, coerced.
uz: Eski uyda yoki kemada materiya hukmron edi  material va uning ehtiyojlariga qullik bilan bo'ysunish kerak edi; yangi uyda materiya asirga olindi, o'zgartirildi, majburlandi.

en: the coal and iron and sand dragged out of the banks and pits, wrenched, wrought, molten and cast, to be ﬂung at last, a slender glittering pinnacle of steel and glass, six hundred feet above the crowded city!
uz: Ko'mir, temir va qum qirg'oqlardan va chuqurlardan sudrab chiqariladi, ochiladi, ishlov beriladi, eritiladi va quyiladi, oxir-oqibat uloqtirilishi kerak, po'lat va shishadan yasalgan ingichka yaltiroq cho'qqisi, gavjum shahardan olti yuz fut balandlikda!

en: We have given these particulars of the advance in man’s knowledge of the metallurgy of steel and its results by way of illustration.
uz: Biz po'lat metallurgiyasi va uning natijalari haqidagi inson bilimidagi taraqqiyotning ushbu tafsilotlarini misol tariqasida keltirib o'tdik.

en: A parallel story could be told of the metallurgy of copper and tin, and of a multitude of met- als, nickel and aluminium to name but two, unknown before the nineteenth century dawned.
uz: Mis va qalayning metallurgiyasi, shuningdek, o'n to'qqizinchi asr boshlanishidan oldin noma'lum bo'lgan ko'plab metall alyuminiy, nikel va alyuminiy haqida parallel hikoya aytib berish mumkin.

en: It is in this great and growing mastery over substances, over different sorts of glass, over rocks and plasters and the like, over colours and textures, that the main triumphs of the mechanical revolution have thus far been achieved.
uz: Aynan shu katta va o'sib borayotgan moddalar, turli xildagi shisha, toshlar va gipslar va shunga o'xshash narsalar, ranglar va teksturalar ustidan ustunlikda mexanik inqilobning asosiy yutuqlariga shu paytgacha erishildi.

en: Yet we are still in the stage of the ﬁrst fruits in the matter.
uz: Shunga qaramay, biz hali bu masalada birinchi mevalar bosqichidamiz.

en: We have the power, but we have still to learn how to use our power.
uz: Bizda kuch bor, lekin hali ham kuchimizni qanday ishlatishni o'rganishimiz kerak.

en: Many of the ﬁrst employments of these gifts of science have been vulgar, tawdry, stupid or horrible.
uz: Ushbu fan sovg'alarining birinchi qo'llanilishlarining ko'pchiligi qo'pol, qo'pol, ahmoqona yoki dahshatli bo'lgan.

en: The artist and the adaptor have still hard- ly begun to work with the endless variety of substances now at their disposal.
uz: Rassom va adapter hali ham o'z ixtiyorida bo'lgan cheksiz xil moddalar bilan ishlashni qiyinlashtirib boshlashdi.

en: Parallel with this extension of mechanical possibilities the new science of electricity grew up.
uz: Mexanik imkoniyatlarning ushbu kengayishi bilan parallel ravishda elektr energiyasining yangi ilmi o'sdi.

en: It was only in the eighties of the nineteenth century that this body of enquiry began to yield results to impress the vulgar mind.
uz: Faqatgina XIX asrning saksoninchi yillarida bu so'rov guruhi vulgar ongni hayratga soladigan natijalar bera boshladi.

en: Then suddenly came electric light and electric traction, and the transmutation of forces, the possibility of sending power, that could be changed into mechan- ical motion or light or heat as one chose, along a copper wire, as water is sent along a pipe, began to come through to the ideas of ordinary people....
uz: Keyin to'satdan elektr chiroq va elektr tortish paydo bo'ldi va kuchlarning o'zgartirilishi, kuch yuborish imkoniyati paydo bo'ldi, uni xohlagan mexanik harakat yoki yorug'lik yoki issiqlikka o'zgartirish mumkin edi, mis sim bo'ylab, suv quvur bo'ylab yuborilgandek oddiy odamlarning g'oyalariga kirib kela boshladi....

en: The British and French were at ﬁrst the leading peoples in this great pro- liferation of knowledge; but presently the Germans, who had learnt humility under Napoleon, showed such zeal and pertinacity in scientiﬁc enquiry as to overhaul these leaders.
uz: Britaniyaliklar va fransuzlar dastlab bu buyuk bilim tarqatishda yetakchi xalq edilar; ammo hozirda Napoleon davrida kamtarlikni o'rgangan nemislar, ilmiy izlanishlarda bu yetakchilarni isloh qilish uchun shunchalik g'ayrat va g'ayrat ko'rsatdilar.

en: British science was largely the creation of English- men and Scotchmen working outside the ordinary centres of erudition.
uz: Britaniya fani asosan ingliz va shotlandlarning oddiy ta'lim markazlaridan tashqarida ishlashini yaratdi.

en: EIGHTEENTH CENTURY SPINNING WHEEL  In the Ipswich Museum MODEL OF ARKWRIGHT’S SPINNING JENNY, 1769  From the speciﬁcations in the Patent Ofﬁce
uz: O'N Sakkizinchi Asr Aylanuvchi G'ildiragi Ipsvich Muzeyida ARKRIGHTS SPINNING JENNY MODELI, 1769 Patent Ofisidagi spetsifikatsiyalardan

en: The universities of Britain were at this time in a state of educational ret- rogression, largely given over to a pedantic conning of the Latin and Greek classics.
uz: Britaniya universitetlari o'sha paytda ta'limiy retrogressiya holatida edi, asosan lotin va yunon klassikasining pedantik hiyla-nayranglariga berilib ketgan edi.

en: French education, too, was dominated by the classical tradition of the Jesuit schools, and consequently it was not difﬁcult for the Germans to organize a body of investigators, small indeed in relation to the possibilities of the case, but large in proportion to the little band of British and French inventors and experimentalists.
uz: Fransuz ta'limi ham Jesuit maktablarining klassik an'anasi bilan ustun edi va shuning uchun nemislar uchun ish imkoniyatlariga nisbatan kichik bo'lgan, ammo Britaniya va Fransiya ixtirochilari va eksperimentalistlarining kichik guruhiga mutanosib ravishda katta bo'lgan tergovchilar guruhini tashkil etish qiyin emas edi.

en: And though this work of research and ex- periment was making Britain and France the most rich and powerful coun- tries in the world, it was not making scientiﬁc and inventive men rich and powerful.
uz: Va garchi bu tadqiqot va tajriba Britaniya va Fransiyani dunyodagi eng boy va qudratli davlatlarga aylantirgan bo'lsa-da, u ilmiy va ixtirochi odamlarni boy va qudratli qilmayapti.

en: There is a necessary unworldliness about a sincere scientiﬁc man; he is too preoccupied with his research to plan and scheme how to make money out of it.
uz: Samimiy olim haqida zarur dunyoviylik bor; u o'z tadqiqoti bilan juda bandki, undan qanday qilib pul ishlashni rejalashtirish va rejalashtirish mumkin emas.

en: The economic exploitation of his discoveries falls very eas- ily and naturally, therefore, into the hands of a more acquisitive type; and so we ﬁnd that the crops of rich men which every fresh phase of scientiﬁc and technical progress has produced in Great Britain, though they have not dis- played quite the same passionate desire to insult and kill the goose that laid the national golden eggs as the scholastic and clerical professions, have been quite content to let that proﬁtable creature starve.
uz: Uning kashfiyotlarining iqtisodiy ekspluatatsiyasi juda oson va tabiiy tarzda, shuning uchun, yanada o'zlashtiruvchi turning qo'liga tushadi; va shunday qilib, biz Buyuk Britaniyada ilmiy va texnik taraqqiyotning har bir yangi bosqichida ishlab chiqarilgan boy odamlarning ekinlari, garchi ular milliy oltin tuxumlarni qo'ygan g'ozni haqorat qilish va o'ldirish istagini akademik va ruhoniy kasblar kabi o'ynamagan bo'lsalar ham, o'sha foydali maxluqni och qoldirishga to'g'ri kelganini aniqlaymiz.

en: Inventors and dis- coverers came by nature, they thought, for cleverer people to proﬁt by.
uz: Ixtirochilar va kashfiyotchilar tabiatdan kelib chiqqan, deb o'ylashardi, aqlliroq odamlar foyda olishlari uchun.

en: In this matter the Germans were a little wiser.
uz: Bu masalada nemislar biroz donoroq edilar.

en: The German “learned” did not display the same vehement hatred of the new learning.
uz: Nemislarning o'rganganlari yangi o'rganishga nisbatan xuddi shunday keskin nafratni namoyon etmadilar.

en: They permitted its development.
uz: Ular uning rivojlanishiga ruxsat berishdi.

en: The German business man and manufacturer again had not quite the same contempt for the man of science as had his British competi- tor.
uz: Nemis tadbirkori va ishlab chiqaruvchisi yana Britaniyalik raqobatchisi kabi olimga nisbatan unchalik nafratlanmadi.

en: Knowledge, these Germans believed, might be a cultivated crop, re- sponsive to fertilizers.
uz: Bilim, bu nemislar ishonishganidek, o'g'itlarga mos keladigan, yetishtirilgan ekin bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: They did concede, therefore, a certain amount of op- portunity to the scientiﬁc mind; their public expenditure on scientiﬁc work was relatively greater, and this expenditure was abundantly rewarded.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular ilmiy ongga ma'lum miqdorda imkoniyat berishdi; ularning ilmiy ishlarga bo'lgan davlat xarajatlari nisbatan kattaroq edi va bu xarajatlar mo'l-ko'l mukofotlandi.

en: By the latter half of the nineteenth century the German scientiﬁc worker had made German a necessary language for every science student who wished to keep abreast with the latest work in his department, and in certain branches, and particularly in chemistry, Germany acquired a very great su- periority over her western neighbours.
uz: XIX asrning oxiriga kelib, nemis ilmiy xodimi nemis tilini o'z kafedrasidagi so'nggi ishlardan xabardor bo'lishni istagan har bir fan talabasi uchun zarur tilga aylantirdi va ayrim sohalarda, ayniqsa kimyo bo'yicha, Germaniya o'zining g'arbiy qo'shnilaridan juda katta ustunlikka ega bo'ldi.

en: The scientiﬁc effort of the sixties and seventies in Germany began to tell after the eighties, and the German gained steadily upon Britain and France in technical and industrial prosperity.
uz: Oltmishinchi va yetmishinchi yillarning Germaniyadagi ilmiy sa'y-harakatlari saksoninchi yillardan keyin namoyon bo'la boshladi va nemis Britaniya va Fransiya ustidan texnik va sanoat ravnaqi bo'yicha barqaror ravishda ustun keldi.

en: A fresh phase in the history of invention opened when in the eighties a new type of engine came into use, an engine in which the expansive force of an explosive mixture replaced the expansive force of steam.
uz: 80-yillarda yangi turdagi dvigatel ishga tushganda, ixtiro tarixida yangi bosqich ochildi, unda portlovchi aralashmaning kengayish kuchi bug'ning kengayish kuchini almashtirdi.

en: The light, highly efﬁcient engines that were thus made possible were applied to the automobile, and developed at last to reach such a pitch of lightness and efﬁ- ciency as to render ﬂight—long known to be possible—a practical achieve- ment.
uz: Shunday qilib, imkon yaratilgan yengil, yuqori samarali dvigatellar avtomobilga qo'llanildi va nihoyat shunday yengillik va samaradorlikka erishish uchun ishlab chiqildi, bu esa uzoq vaqtdan beri mumkin bo'lgan parvozni amaliy yutuqga aylantirdi.

en: A successful ﬂying machine—but not a machine large enough to take up a human body—was made by Professor Langley of the Smithsonian In- stitute of Washington as early as 1897.
uz: Muvaffaqiyatli uchuvchi mashina  lekin inson tanasini sig'dira oladigan darajada katta mashina emas  Vashingtonning Smithsonian Instituti professori Langli tomonidan 1897-yilning boshidayoq yaratilgan.

en: By 1909 the aeroplane was available for human locomotion.
uz: 1909-yilga kelib, samolyot inson harakatlanishi uchun mavjud edi.

en: There had seemed to be a pause in the increase of human speed with the perfection of railways and automobile road traction, but with the ﬂying machine came fresh reductions in the effective distance between one point of the earth’s surface and another.
uz: Temir yo'llar va avtomobil yo'llarining mukammalligi bilan inson tezligini oshirishda to'xtash paydo bo'lgandek tuyuldi, lekin uchish mashinasi bilan yer yuzasi bir nuqtasi va boshqa nuqta o'rtasidagi samarali masofani yangi qisqartirishlar keldi.

en: In the eighteenth cen- tury the distance from London to Edinburgh was an eight days’ journey; in 1918 the British Civil Air Transport Commission reported that the journey from London to Melbourne, halfway round the earth, would probably in a few years’ time be accomplished in that same period of eight days.
uz: XVIII asrda Londondan Edinburgga boradigan masofa sakkiz kunlik sayohat edi; 1918-yilda Britaniya Fuqarolik Havo Transporti Komissiyasi Londondan Melburnga, yerning yarmi bo'ylab, bir necha yil ichida shu sakkiz kunlik davrda amalga oshirilishi mumkinligini xabar qildi.

en: AN EARLY WEAVING MACHINE  From an engraving by W.
uz: EARLY TO'QUV MACHINASI W. tomonidan o'yib ishlangan naqshdan.

en: Hincks in the British Museum Too much stress must not be laid upon these striking reductions in the time distances of one place from another.
uz: Britaniya muzeyidagi tiqilinchlar Bir joydan ikkinchi joygacha bo'lgan vaqt masofasining sezilarli qisqarishiga juda ko'p e'tibor qaratmaslik kerak.

en: They are merely one aspect of a much profounder and more momentous enlargement of human possibility.
uz: Ular inson imkoniyatlarining ancha chuqurroq va ahamiyatliroq kengayishining bir jihati xolos.

en: The science of agriculture and agricultural chemistry, for instance, made quite parallel advances during the nineteenth century.
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi va qishloq xo'jaligi kimyosi fani, masalan, XIX asrda ancha parallel taraqqiyotga erishdi.

en: Men learnt so to fer-
uz: Erkaklar shunday o'rgandilarki...

en: tilize the soil as to produce quadruple and quintuple the crops got from the same area in the seventeenth century.
uz: Tuproqni to'rt barobar va besh barobar ko'paytirish uchun tekislang, xuddi shu hududdan o'n yettinchi asrda olingan ekinlar.

en: There was a still more extraordinary advance in medical science; the average duration of life rose, the daily efﬁ- ciency increased, the waste of life through ill-health diminished.
uz: Tibbiyot fanida yanada g'ayrioddiy taraqqiyot bo'ldi; o'rtacha umr ko'rish davomiyligi oshdi, kundalik samaradorlik oshdi, sog'liqsizlik tufayli hayot behuda sarflanishi kamaydi.

en: Now here altogether we have such a change in human life as to constitute a fresh phase of history.
uz: Endi bizda inson hayotida shunday o'zgarish borki, u tarixning yangi bosqichini tashkil etadi.

en: In a little more than a century this mechanical revo- lution has been brought about.
uz: Bir asrdan sal ko'proq vaqt ichida bu mexanik o'zgarish amalga oshirildi.

en: In that time man made a stride in the materi- al conditions of his life vaster than he had done during the whole long inter- val between the palæolithic stage and the age of cultivation, or between the days of Pepi in Egypt and those of George III.
uz: O'sha davrda inson hayotidagi moddiy sharoitlarda paleolitika bosqichi va kultivatsiya davri o'rtasidagi butun uzun oraliq davrida yoki Misrdagi Pepi va Jorj III davrida qilganidan ko'ra kengroq qadam tashladi.

en: A new gigantic material framework for human affairs has come into existence.
uz: Inson ishlari uchun yangi ulkan moddiy asos paydo bo'ldi.

en: Clearly it demands great readjustments of our social, economical and political methods.
uz: Aniqki, bu bizning ijtimoiy, iqtisodiy va siyosiy usullarimizni katta o'zgartirishni talab qiladi.

en: But these readjustments have necessarily waited upon the development of the mechanical revolution, and they are still only in their opening stage to-day.
uz: Lekin bu qayta sozlashlar albatta mexanik inqilobning rivojlanishini kutgan va ular bugungi kunda faqatgina ochilish bosqichida.

en: LVIII THE INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION There is a tendency in many histories to confuse together what we have here called the mechanical revolution, which was an entirely new thing in human experience arising out of the development of organized science, a new step like the invention of agriculture or the discovery of metals, with something else, quite different in its origins, something for which there was already an historical precedent, the social and ﬁnancial development which is called the industrial revolution.
uz: LVIII SANOAT INQILOBI Ko'p tarixlarda biz bu yerda mexanik inqilob deb atagan narsani bir-biriga chalkashtirish tendentsiyasi mavjud. Bu inqilob inson tajribasida uyushgan fan rivojlanishidan kelib chiqqan butunlay yangi narsa edi, qishloq xo'jaligi ixtirosi yoki metallarni kashf etish kabi yangi qadam edi, uning kelib chiqishi bilan ancha farq qiladigan, allaqachon tarixiy precedent mavjud bo'lgan narsa edi, ijtimoiy va moliyaviy rivojlanish, bu esa sanoat inqilobi deb ataladi.

en: The two processes were going on togeth- er, they were constantly reacting upon each other, but they were in root and essence different.
uz: Ikki jarayon birga ketayotgan edi, ular doimiy ravishda bir-biriga ta'sir qilib turishardi, lekin ildizi va mohiyati jihatidan farq qilishardi.

en: There would have been an industrial revolution of sorts if there had been no coal, no steam, no machinery; but in that case it would probably have followed far more closely upon the lines of the social and ﬁ- nancial developments of the later years of the Roman Republic.
uz: Agar ko'mir, bug' yoki mashina bo'lmaganida, sanoat inqilobi bo'lar edi; lekin bu holda u, ehtimol, Rim Respublikasining keyingi yillaridagi ijtimoiy va moliyaviy rivojlanish yo'nalishlariga ancha yaqinroq ergashgan bo'lardi.

en: It would have repeated the story of dispossessed free cultivators, gang labour, great estates, great ﬁnancial fortunes, and a socially destructive ﬁnancial process.
uz: Bu o'zidan mahrum bo'lgan erkin kultivatorlar, guruhiy mehnat, katta mulklar, katta moliyaviy boyliklar va ijtimoiy vayronkor moliyaviy jarayon haqidagi hikoyani takrorlagan bo'lardi.

en: Even the factory method came before power and machinery.
uz: Hatto zavod usuli ham quvvat va mashinalardan oldin keldi.

en: Factories were the product not of machinery, but of the “division of labour.” Drilled and sweated workers were making such things as millinery cardboard boxes and furniture, and colouring maps and book illustrations and so forth, before even water-wheels had been used for industrial purposes.
uz: Fabrikalar mashinalar emas, balki mehnat taqsimoti mahsuli edi. Burg'ulashgan va terlangan ishchilar hatto suv g'ildiraklari sanoat maqsadlarida ishlatilishidan oldin ham, tegirmon karton qutilari va mebellar, rang berish xaritalari va kitob illustratsiyalari va hokazolarni yasashardi.

en: There were facto- ries in Rome in the days of Augustus.
uz: Avgust davrida Rimda amalda reyslar bo'lgan.

en: New books, for instance, were dictat- ed to rows of copyists in the factories of the book-sellers.
uz: Yangi kitoblar, masalan, kitob sotuvchilarning zavodlaridagi nusxa ko'chirish xodimlarining qatorlariga diktatsiya qilindi.

en: The attentive stu- dent of Defoe and of the political pamphlets of Fielding will realize that the idea of herding poor people into establishments to work collectively for their living was already current in Britain before the close of the seven-
uz: Defoe va Fieldingning siyosiy broshyuralariga e'tiborli talabalar kambag'al odamlarni yashash uchun birgalikda ishlash uchun muassasalarga joylashtirish g'oyasi Britaniyada yetti yil oxirigacha mavjud bo'lganini anglaydilar.

en: There are intimations of it even as early as More’s Utopia (1516).
uz: Uning haqida More'ning Utopia 1516-yildagidan boshlab ham ishoralar bor.

en: It was a social and not a mechanical development.
uz: Bu ijtimoiy rivojlanish edi, mexanik rivojlanish emas.

en: Up to past the middle of the eighteenth century the social and economic history of western Europe was in fact retreading the path along which the Roman state had gone in the last three centuries B.C.
uz: XVIII asrning o'rtalarigacha G'arbiy Yevropaning ijtimoiy va iqtisodiy tarixi aslida miloddan avvalgi uch asrda Rim davlati bosib o'tgan yo'ldan orqaga chekinayotgan edi.

en: But the political dis- unions of Europe, the political convulsions against monarchy, the recalci- trance of the common folk and perhaps also the greater accessibility of the western European intelligence to mechanical ideas and inventions, turned the process into quite novel directions.
uz: Lekin Yevropaning siyosiy razvedkalari, monarxiyaga qarshi siyosiy g'alayonlar, oddiy xalqning o'zgarishi va balki G'arbiy Yevropa intellektual olamining mexanik g'oyalar va ixtirolarga ko'proq ega bo'lishi jarayonni ancha yangi yo'nalishlarga aylantirdi.

en: Ideas of human solidarity, thanks to Christianity, were far more widely diffused in the newer European world, political power was not so concentrated, and the man of energy anxious to get rich turned his mind, therefore, very willingly from the ideas of the slave and of gang labour to the idea of mechanical power and the machine.
uz: Xristianlik tufayli insoniy birdamlik g'oyalari yangi Yevropa dunyosida ancha keng tarqalgan edi, siyosiy hokimiyat unchalik jamlanmagan edi va boy bo'lishga intiluvchi energiya egalari qul va guruh mehnat g'oyalaridan mexanik kuch va mashina g'oyasiga juda xohish bilan o'z fikrlarini o'zgartirishdi.

en: The mechanical revolution, the process of mechanical invention and dis- covery, was a new thing in human experience and it went on regardless of the social, political, economic and industrial consequences it might pro- duce.
uz: Mexanik inqilob, mexanik ixtiro va kashfiyot jarayoni insoniyat tajribasida yangi narsa edi va u ijtimoiy, siyosiy, iqtisodiy va sanoat oqibatlariga qaramay davom etdi.

en: The industrial revolution, on the other hand, like most other human affairs, was and is more and more profoundly changed and deﬂected by the constant variation in human conditions caused by the mechanical revolu- tion.
uz: Sanoat inqilobi, boshqa ko'pgina insoniy ishlar kabi, mexanik inqilob natijasida kelib chiqadigan insoniy sharoitlarning doimiy o'zgarishi tufayli tobora chuqur o'zgarib, chalg'itilib bormoqda.

en: And the essential difference between the amassing of riches, the ex- tinction of small farmers and small business men, and the phase of big ﬁ- nance in the latter centuries of the Roman Republic on the one hand, and the very similar concentration of capital in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries on the other, lies in the profound difference in the character of labour that the mechanical revolution was bringing about.
uz: Va boylik to'plash, kichik fermerlar va kichik tadbirkorlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi va Rim Respublikasining so'nggi asrlaridagi yirik moliya bosqichi o'rtasidagi asosiy farq, bir tomondan, va XVIII va XIX asrlarda kapitalning juda o'xshash konsentratsiyasi boshqa tomondan, mexanik inqilob keltirib chiqarayotgan mehnat xarakteridagi chuqur farqdadir.

en: The power of the old world was human power; everything depended ultimately upon the dri- ving power of human muscle, the muscle of ignorant and subjugated men.
uz: Eski dunyoning kuchi inson kuchi edi; hamma narsa oxir-oqibat inson mushaklarining, johil va bo'ysunuvchi odamlarning harakatlantiruvchi kuchiga bog'liq edi.

en: A little animal muscle, supplied by draft oxen, horse traction and the like, contributed.
uz: Ozgina hayvon mushaklari, qoramollar, ot tortish va shunga o'xshash narsalar bilan ta'minlangan, hissa qo'shdi.

en: Where a weight had to be lifted, men lifted it; where a rock had to be quarried, men chipped it out; where a ﬁeld had to be ploughed, men and oxen ploughed it; the Roman equivalent of the steamship was the galley with its bank of sweating rowers.
uz: Og'irlikni ko'tarish kerak bo'lgan joyda, odamlar uni ko'tarardi; toshni qazib olish kerak bo'lgan joyda, odamlar uni kesib tashlardi; dala haydash kerak bo'lgan joyda, odamlar va ho'kizlar uni haydashardi; bug' kemasining Rimdagi ekvivalenti terlangan eshkaklari bilan birga bo'lgan galley edi.

en: A vast proportion of mankind in the early civilizations were employed in purely mechanical drudgery.
uz: Ilk sivilizatsiyalarda insoniyatning katta qismi faqat mexanik ish bilan shug'ullangan.

en: At its onset, power-driven machinery did not seem to promise any release from such un- intelligent toil.
uz: Boshida, quvvat bilan ishlaydigan mashinalar bunday aqlli bo'lmagan mehnatdan xalos bo'lishga va'da bermaganga o'xshardi.

en: Great gangs of men were employed in excavating canals, in making railway cuttings and embankments, and the like.
uz: Katta erkaklar to'dalari kanallarni qazish, temir yo'l kesmalari va qirg'oqlarni yasash va shunga o'xshash ishlarda band edi.

en: miners increased enormously.
uz: Konchilar juda ko'paydi.

en: But the extension of facilities and the output of commodities increased much more.
uz: Lekin qulayliklarning kengayishi va tovarlarning ishlab chiqarish hajmi ancha oshdi.

en: And as the nineteenth century went on, the plain logic of the new situation asserted itself more clearly.
uz: Va o'n to'qqizinchi asr davom etar ekan, yangi vaziyatning oddiy mantig'i o'zini yanada aniqroq tasdiqladi.

en: Human beings were no longer wanted as a source of mere indiscriminated power.
uz: Insonlar endi shunchaki tanlanmagan kuch manbai sifatida xohlanmadi.

en: What could be done mechanically by a human being could be done faster and better by a machine.
uz: Inson tomonidan mexanik tarzda amalga oshirilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa, mashina tomonidan tezroq va yaxshiroq amalga oshirilishi mumkin edi.

en: The human being was needed now only where choice and intelligence had to be exercised.
uz: Inson hozir faqat tanlov va aql-idrok amalga oshirilishi kerak bo'lgan joylarda kerak edi.

en: Human beings were wanted only as human beings.
uz: Insonlar faqat inson sifatida xohlangan edi.

en: The drudge, on whom all the previous civilizations had rested, the creature of mere obedience, the man whose brains were su- perﬂuous, had become unnecessary to the welfare of mankind.
uz: Avvalgi barcha tsivilizatsiyalar suyanib turgan, shunchaki itoatkor maxluq, miyasi juda dabdabali inson, insoniyat farovonligi uchun keraksiz bo'lib qoldi.

en: INCIDENT IN THE DAYS OF THE SLAVE TRADE  From a print after Morland in the British Museum This was as true of such ancient industries as agriculture and mining as it was of the newest metallurgical processes.
uz: QOL SAVDO KUNLARIDAGI HISBAT Britaniya Muzeyining Morlanddan keyingi bosma nashridan. Bu qishloq xo'jaligi va konchilik kabi qadimiy sanoatlarga ham, eng yangi metallurgiya jarayonlariga ham tegishli edi.

en: For ploughing, sowing and har- vesting, swift machines came forward to do the work of scores of men.
uz: Arralash, ekish va o'rmon yig'ish uchun tezkor mashinalar o'nlab odamlarning ishini bajarish uchun paydo bo'ldi.

en: The Roman civilization was built upon cheap and degraded human beings; mod- ern civilization is being rebuilt upon cheap mechanical power.
uz: Rim sivilizatsiyasi arzon va degradatsiyalangan insonlar ustiga qurilgan; zamonaviy sivilizatsiya arzon mexanik quvvat ustiga qayta qurilmoqda.

en: For a hun- dred years power has been getting cheaper and labour dearer.
uz: Bir necha yildan beri quvvat arzonlashib, mehnat qimmatlashib bormoqda.

en: ation or so machinery has had to wait its turn in the mine, it is simply be- cause for a time men were cheaper than machinery.
uz: Mashinalar konda o'z navbatini kutishga majbur bo'ldi, bu shunchaki - chunki bir vaqtlar odamlar mashinalarga qaraganda arzonroq edi.

en: EARLY FACTORY, IN COLEBROOKDALE  From a print the British Museum Now here was a change-over of quite primary importance in human af- fairs.
uz: RAHAM FOYDALANISH, COLEBROOKDALE Britaniya Muzeyi nashridan. Endi bu yerda insoniy ko'rgazmalarda ancha asosiy ahamiyatga ega o'zgarish bo'ldi.

en: The chief solicitude of the rich and of the ruler in the old civilization had been to keep up a supply of drudges.
uz: Qadimgi tsivilizatsiyadagi boylar va hukmdorlarning asosiy e'tibori to'qimalarni ta'minlab turish edi.

en: As the nineteenth century went on, it became more and more plain to the intelligent directive people that the common man had now to be something better than a drudge.
uz: O'n to'qqizinchi asr davom etar ekan, aqlli yo'naltiruvchi odamlarga oddiy odam endi drudjdan yaxshiroq narsa bo'lishi kerakligi tobora aniqroq bo'lib bordi.

en: He had to be educated—if only to secure “industrial efﬁciency.” He had to understand what he was about.
uz: U o'qishi kerak edi  faqatgina sanoat samaradorligini ta'minlash uchun. U nima haqida gapirayotganini tushunishi kerak edi.

en: From the days of the ﬁrst Christian propaganda, popular education had been smouldering in Europe, just as it had smouldered in Asia wherever Islam has set its foot, because of the necessity of making the believer understand a little of the belief by which he is saved, and of en- abling him to read a little in the sacred books by which his belief is con- veyed.
uz: Birinchi xristian tashviqoti davridan boshlab, Yevropada xalq ta'limi xuddi Islom qadam qo'ygan Osiyoda ham g'azablandi kabi, imonli odamga o'zi najot topgan e'tiqodni biroz tushunishga majbur qilish va e'tiqodi aldangan muqaddas kitoblarda ozgina o'qishga imkon berish zarurati tufayli g'azablandi.

en: Christian controversies, with their competition for adherents, ploughed the ground for the harvest of popular education.
uz: Xristian bahslari, o'zlarining tarafdorlar uchun raqobati bilan, xalq ta'limining hosilini yig'ishtirdi.

en: instance, by the thirties and forties of the nineteenth century, the disputes of the sects and the necessity of catching adherents young had produced a se- ries of competing educational organizations for children, the church “Na- tional” schools, the dissenting “British” schools, and even Roman Catholic elementary schools.
uz: Masalan, XIX asrning o'ttizinchi va qirqinchi yillariga kelib, sektalarning bahslari va yoshlarni qo'lga kiritish zarurati bolalarga mo'ljallangan raqobatchi ta'lim tashkilotlari, Na-tional cherkov maktablari, Britaniya maktablarining noroziligi va hatto Rim-katolik boshlang'ich maktablarining bir qatorini keltirib chiqardi.

en: The second half of the nineteenth century was a period of rapid advance in popular education throughout all the Westernized world.
uz: XIX asrning ikkinchi yarmi butun G'arblashgan dunyo bo'ylab xalq ta'limida tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanish davri edi.

en: There was no parallel advance in the education of the upper classes—some advance, no doubt, but nothing to correspond—and so the great gulf that had divided that world hitherto into the readers and the non-reading mass became little more than a slightly perceptible difference in educational lev- el.
uz: Yuqori sinflarning taʼlimida parallel taraqqiyot yoʻq edi  baʼzi taraqqiyot, shubhasiz, lekin mos keladigan hech narsa yoʻq edi  va shuning uchun shu paytgacha oʻsha dunyoni oʻquvchilar va oʻqimaydigan ommaviyga boʻlgan katta qoʻltiq taʼlim darajasidagi biroz sezilarli farqdan koʻp narsa emas edi.

en: At the back of this process was the mechanical revolution, apparently regardless of social conditions, but really insisting inexorably upon the complete abolition of a totally illiterate class throughout the world.
uz: Bu jarayonning orqasida mexanik inqilob bor edi, ko'rinishicha ijtimoiy sharoitlardan qat'i nazar, lekin haqiqatan ham butun dunyo bo'ylab butunlay savodsiz sinfni butunlay yo'q qilishga qat'iy talab qilish edi.

en: The economic revolution of the Roman Republic had never been clearly apprehended by the common people of Rome.
uz: Rim Respublikasining iqtisodiy inqilobi hech qachon Rim oddiy xalqi tomonidan aniq anglanmagan edi.

en: The ordinary Roman citizen never saw the changes through which he lived, clearly and comprehensively as we see them.
uz: Oddiy Rim fuqarosi hech qachon o'zi boshidan kechirgan o'zgarishlarni biz ko'rayotganidek aniq va tushunarli tarzda ko'rmagan.

en: But the industrial revolution, as it went on towards the end of the nineteenth century, was more and more distinctly seen as one whole process by the common people it was affecting, because presently they could read and discuss and communicate, and because they went about and saw things as no commonalty had ever done before.
uz: Lekin sanoat inqilobi, XIX asr oxiriga tomon davom etar ekan, oddiy xalq tomonidan butun bir jarayon sifatida tobora aniqroq ko'rilardi, chunki hozirda ular o'qiy olish, muhokama qilish va muloqot qilishlari mumkin edi, va chunki ular hech qanday oddiy xalq ilgari hech qachon qilmaganidek harakat qilishardi va narsalarni ko'rishardi.

en: LIX THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERN POLITICAL AND SOCIAL IDEAS The institutions and customs and political ideas of the ancient civilizations grew up slowly, age by age, no man designing and no man foreseeing.
uz: Zamonaviy siyosiy va ijtimoiy g'oyalarning rivojlanishi. Qadimgi tsivilizatsiyalarning institutlari, urf-odatlari va siyosiy g'oyalari asta-sekin, yosh o'tishi bilan o'sib borardi, hech kim loyihalashtirmagan va hech kim oldindan ko'rmagan.

en: It was only in that great century of human adolescence, the sixth century B.C., that men began to think clearly about their relations to one another, and ﬁrst to question and ﬁrst propose to alter and rearrange the established beliefs and laws and methods of human government.
uz: Faqatgina o'sha buyuk insoniy o'smirlik asri, miloddan avvalgi oltinchi asrda odamlar o'zaro munosabatlari haqida aniq o'ylay boshladilar va avvalo inson boshqaruvining o'rnatilgan e'tiqodlari, qonunlari va usullarini o'zgartirish va qayta tuzishni so'roq qilishdi va taklif qilishdi.

en: We have told of the glorious intellectual dawn of Greece and Alexandria, and how presently the collapse of the slave- holding civilizations and the clouds of religious intolerance and absolutist government darkened the promise of that beginning.
uz: Biz Gretsiya va Iskandariyaning shonli intellektual tongi haqida aytib o'tdik va hozirda qul ushlab turuvchi sivilizatsiyalarning qulashi hamda diniy chidamsizlik va absolutistik hukumat bulutlari bu boshlanish va'dasini qanday xiralashtirganini aytdik.

en: The light of fearless thinking did not break through the European obscurity again effectually until the ﬁfteenth and six- teenth centuries.
uz: Qo'rqmas fikrlash nuri XV va XVI asrlargacha Yevropa zulmatini yana samarali tarzda yorib o'tmadi.

en: We have tried to show something of the share of the great winds of Arab curiosity and Mongol conquest in this gradual clearing of the mental skies of Europe.
uz: Biz Yevropaning aqliy osmonini asta-sekin tozalashda arab qiziqishining buyuk shamollari va mo'g'ul bosqinining ulushini ko'rsatishga harakat qildik.

en: And at ﬁrst it was chieﬂy material knowledge that increased.
uz: Va dastlab asosan moddiy bilimlar ortdi.

en: The ﬁrst fruits of the recovered manhood of the race were materi- al achievements and material power.
uz: Irqning tiklangan erkakligining birinchi mevalari moddiy yutuqlar va moddiy kuch edi.

en: The science of human relationship, of individual and social psychology, of education and of economics, are not only more subtle and intricate in themselves but also bound up inextricably with much emotional matter.
uz: Inson munosabatlari, individual va ijtimoiy psixologiya, ta'lim va iqtisodiyot fanlari nafaqat o'z-o'zidan nozikroq va murakkabroq, balki ko'plab hissiy narsalar bilan ham chambarchas bog'liqdir.

en: The advances made in them have been slower and made against greater opposition.
uz: Ularda erishilgan yutuqlar sekinroq bo'ldi va katta qarshilikka qarshi amalga oshirildi.

en: Men will listen dispassionately to the most diverse suggestions about stars or molecules, but ideas about our ways of life touch and reﬂect upon everyone about us.
uz: Erkaklar yulduzlar yoki molekulalar haqidagi eng xilma-xil takliflarga beparvo quloq tutishadi, lekin hayot tarzi haqidagi fikrlar biz haqimizda har bir kishiga ta'sir qiladi va aks etadi.

en: And just as in Greece the bold speculations of Plato came before Aristo- tle’s hard search for fact, so in Europe the ﬁrst political enquiries of the new phase were put in the form of “Utopian” stories, directly imitated from Pla- to’s Republic and his Laws.
uz: Va xuddi Gretsiyada Platonning dadil taxminlari Aristo- tle'ning qattiq haqiqat izlashidan oldin kelganidek, Yevropada yangi bosqichning birinchi siyosiy so'rovlari Pla-dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Respublika va uning Qonunlariga taqlid qilingan Utopiya hikoyalari shaklida o'tkazildi.

en: Sir Thomas More’s Utopia is a curious imita- tion of Plato that bore fruit in a new English poor law.
uz: Ser Tomas More'ning Utopiya kitobi Platonning qiziqarli taqlididir, u yangi ingliz qonunchiligida o'z mevasini berdi.

en: The Neapolitan Cam- panella’s City of the Sun was more fantastic and less fruitful.
uz: Neapolitan Cam-panella'ning Quyosh shahri yanada fantastik va unumliroq emas edi.

en: By the end of the seventeenth century we ﬁnd a considerable and grow- ing literature of political and social science was being produced.
uz: XVII asr oxiriga kelib, siyosiy va ijtimoiy fanlarning sezilarli va rivojlanayotgan adabiyoti ishlab chiqilayotganini aniqladik.

en: Among the pioneers in this discussion was John Locke, the son of an English republi- can, an Oxford scholar who ﬁrst directed his attention to chemistry and medicine.
uz: Ushbu muhokamada kashshoflardan biri ingliz respublikachisining o'g'li, kimyo va tibbiyotga birinchi navbatda e'tiborini qaratgan Oksford olimi Jon Lok edi.

en: His treatises on government, toleration and education show a mind fully awake to the possibilities of social reconstruction.
uz: Uning hukumat, bag'rikenglik va ta'lim haqidagi risolalari ijtimoiy tiklanish imkoniyatlariga to'liq uyg'oq ongni ko'rsatadi.

en: Parallel with and a little later than John Locke in England, Montesquieu (1689-1755) in France subjected social, political and religious institutions to a searching and fundamental analysis.
uz: Angliyadagi Jon Lokke bilan parallel ravishda va undan biroz keyinroq, Fransiyadagi Monteskyo (1689-1755) ijtimoiy, siyosiy va diniy institutlarni qidiruv va fundamental tahlilga duchor qildi.

en: He stripped the magical prestige from the abso- lutist monarchy in France.
uz: U Fransiyadagi abso-lutist monarxiyasidan sehrli obro'ni yo'qotdi.

en: He shares with Locke the credit for clearing away many of the false ideas that had hitherto prevented deliberate and con- scious attempts to reconstruct human society.
uz: U Lokke bilan birga insoniyat jamiyatini qayta qurish bo'yicha shu paytgacha ongli va ongli urinishlarga to'sqinlik qilgan ko'plab noto'g'ri g'oyalarni yo'q qilgani uchun minnatdorchilik bildiradi.

en: The generation that followed him in the middle and later decades of the eighteenth century was boldly speculative upon the moral and intellectual clearings he had made.
uz: XVIII asrning o'rta va keyingi o'n yilliklarida unga ergashgan avlod uning qilgan axloqiy va intellektual tozalashlariga jur'atkorlik bilan taxmin qildi.

en: A group of brilliant writers, the “Encyclopædists,” mostly rebel spirits from the excellent schools of the Jesuits, set themselves to scheme out a new world (1766).
uz: Bir guruh ajoyib yozuvchilar, Ensiklopediyachilar, asosan Yesuaitlarning alo maktablaridan bolgan isyonkor ruhlar bolib, yangi dunyoni rejalashtirishga kirishdi (1766).

en: Side by side with the Encyclopædists were the Economists or Physiocrats, who were making bold and crude en- quiries into the production and distribution of food and goods.
uz: Ensiklopediyachilar bilan yonma-yon iqtisodiylar yoki fiziokratlar edi, ular oziq-ovqat va tovarlarni ishlab chiqarish va tarqatishga jur'atli va qo'pol urinishlarni amalga oshirardilar.

en: Morelly, the author of the Code de La Nature, denounced the institution of private prop- erty and proposed a communistic organization of society.
uz: Morelly, Tabiat kodeksi muallifi, xususiy mulk institutini qoraladi va jamiyatni kommunistik tashkil etishni taklif qildi.

en: He was the pre- cursor of that large and various school of collectivist thinkers in the nine- teenth century who are lumped together as Socialists.
uz: U to'qqizinchi o'n o'ninchi asrdagi o'sha yirik va xilma-xil kollektivist mutafakkirlar maktabining sobiq kuratori edi, ular bir-biriga sotsialistiklar deb ataladi.

en: There are a hundred deﬁnitions of Socialism and a thousand sects of Socialists.
uz: Sotsialismning yuz ta'rifi va sotsialislarning mingta sektalari mavjud.

en: Essentially Socialism is no more and no less than a criticism of the idea of property in the light of the public good.
uz: Aslida, sotsializm davlat foydasi nuqtai nazaridan mulk g'oyasini tanqid qilishdan ko'proq va kam emas.

en: We may review the history of that idea through the ages very brieﬂy.
uz: Biz o'sha g'oyaning tarixini asrlar davomida juda qisqacha ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.

en: That and the idea of internationalism are the two cardinal ideas upon which most of our political life is turning.
uz: Bu va xalqarochilik g'oyasi siyosiy hayotimizning aksariyati qaytarilayotgan asosiy ikki g'oyadir.

en: CARL MARX  Photo: Linde & Co.
uz: CARL MARX Photo: Linde & Co.

en: The idea of property arises out of the combative instincts of the species.
uz: Mulk g'oyasi turning jangovar instinktlaridan kelib chiqadi.

en: Long before men were men, the ancestral ape was a proprietor.
uz: Odamlar erkak bo'lishidan ancha oldin, ajdod maymun egasi edi.

en: Primitive property is what a beast will ﬁght for.
uz: Ibtidoiy mulk - bu hayvon kurashadigan narsadir.

en: The dog and his bone, the tigress and her lair, the roaring stag and his herd, these are proprietorship blazing.
uz: It va uning suyaklari, yo'lbars va uning uyasi, g'ujg'aldoq boyo'g'i va uning suruvi, bular egalik o'chog'idir.

en: more nonsensical expression is conceivable in sociology than the term “primitive communism.” The Old Man of the family tribe of early palæolithic times insisted upon his proprietorship in his wives and daugh- ters, in his tools, in his visible universe.
uz: Sotsiologiyada primitiv kommunizm atamasiga qaraganda bema'niroq ifoda tasavvur qilish mumkin. Erta paleolitika davridagi oila qabilasining Keksa odami o'z xotinlari va qizlariga, asboblariga, ko'rinadigan olamiga egalik qilishni talab qilardi.

en: If any other man wandered into his visible universe he fought him, and if he could he slew him.
uz: Agar boshqa birorta inson uning ko'rinadigan olamiga kirib borsa, u unga qarshi kurashardi va agar qodir bo'lsa, uni o'ldirardi.

en: The tribe grew in the course of ages, as Atkinson showed convincingly in his Primal Law, by the gradual toleration by the Old Man of the existence of the younger men, and of their proprietorship in the wives they captured from outside the tribe, and in the tools and ornaments they made and the game they slew.
uz: Qabila asrlar davomida o'sdi, buni Atkinson o'zining Asl Qonuniga ishontirib ko'rsatganidek, Keksa odamning yosh erkaklarning mavjudligiga, qabila tashqarisidan asirga olgan xotinlariga egalik qilishlariga, ular yasagan asboblar va bezaklarga va o'ynagan o'yinga asta-sekin roziligi tufayli.

en: Human society grew by a compromise between this one’s property and that.
uz: Insoniyat jamiyati birovning mulki bilan boshqa birovning mulki o'rtasidagi murosaga kelish natijasida o'sdi.

en: It was a compromise with instinct which was forced upon men by the ne- cessity of driving some other tribe out of its visible universe.
uz: Bu instikt bilan murosaga kelish edi, u boshqa qabilalarni ko'rinadigan olamidan haydashning tinimsizligi tufayli odamlarga majbur bo'ldi.

en: If the hills and forests and streams were not your land or my land, it was because they had to be our land.
uz: Agar tepaliklar, o'rmonlar va soylar sening yoki mening yerim bo'lmasa, buning sababi ular bizning yerimiz bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Each of us would have preferred to have it my land, but that would not work.
uz: Har birimiz o'z yerimizga ega bo'lishni afzal ko'rgan bo'lardik, lekin bu ish bermas edi.

en: In that case the other fellows would have destroyed us.
uz: U holda qolgan do'stlar bizni yo'q qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Society, therefore, is from its beginning a mitigation of ownership.
uz: Demak, jamiyat o'z boshidanoq egalikni yumshatishdir.

en: Owner- ship in the beast and in the primitive savage was far more intense a thing than it is in the civilized world to- day.
uz: Xo'jayin - bu hayvon va ibtidoiy vahshiyda hozirgi madaniy dunyoda bo'lganidan ko'ra ancha shiddatli narsa edi.

en: It is rooted more strongly in our in- stincts than in our reason.
uz: U bizning aql-idroklarimizga qaraganda ko'proq ildiz otadi.

en: In the natural savage and in the untutored man to-day there is no limita- tion to the sphere of ownership.
uz: Tabiiy vahshiyda va o'qimagan odamda bugungi kunda mulkchilik sohasiga cheklov yo'q.

en: Whatever you can ﬁght for, you can own; women-folk, spared captive, captured beast, forest glade, stone-pit or what not.
uz: Qayer uchun kurasha olsangiz ham, egalik qilishingiz mumkin; ayollar-xalq, asrab olinganlarni ayamaydigan, asirga olingan hayvon, o'rmon xursandchiligi, tosh chuqur yoki boshqa narsalar.

en: As the community grew, a sort of law came to restrain internecine ﬁghting, men developed rough-and-ready methods of settling proprietor- ship.
uz: Jamiyat o'sib borar ekan, o'zaro janglarni cheklash uchun bir turdagi qonun paydo bo'ldi, odamlar egalik kemasini joylashtirishning qo'pol va tayyor usullarini ishlab chiqdilar.

en: Men could own what they were the ﬁrst to make or capture or claim.
uz: Erkaklar birinchi bo'lib yaratgan narsalariga egalik qilishlari, ularni qo'lga kiritishlari yoki da'vo qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: It seemed natural that a debtor who could not pay should become the property of his creditor.
uz: To'lay olmagan qarzdor o'z kreditorining mulkiga aylanishi tabiiy tuyuldi.

en: Equally natural was it that after claiming a patch of land a man should exact payments from anyone who wanted to use it.
uz: Xuddi shunday tabiiy edi, yer uchastkasini talab qilgan odam undan foydalanmoqchi bo'lgan har bir kishidan to'lovlarni talab qilishi kerak edi.

en: It was only slowly, as the possibilities of organized life dawned on men, that this unlim- ited property in anything whatever began to be recognized as a nuisance.
uz: Odamlarga tartibli hayot imkoniyatlari paydo bo'lishi bilan, faqat asta-sekin bu cheklanmagan mulk har qanday narsada bezovtalik sifatida tan olinishni boshladi.

en: Men found themselves born into a universe all owned and claimed, nay!
uz: Odamlar o'zlarini butunlay egalik qiladigan va da'vo qiladigan olamga tug'ilgan holda topdilar, yo'q!

en: they found themselves born owned and claimed.
uz: Ular o'zlarini tug'ilganda egalik qilishgan va da'vo qilishgan holda topdilar.

en: The social struggles of the earlier civilization are difﬁcult to trace now, but the history we have told of the Roman Republic shows a community waking up to the idea that debts may become a public inconvenience and should then be repudiated, and that the unlimited ownership of land is also an inconvenience.
uz: Ilk tsivilizatsiyaning ijtimoiy kurashlarini hozir kuzatish qiyin, lekin Rim Respublikasi haqida aytgan tariximiz jamiyatning qarzlar jamoatchilik uchun noqulaylik bo'lishi mumkinligi va keyin rad etilishi kerakligi, shuningdek, yerning cheksiz egaligi ham noqulaylik degan fikrga uyg'onayotganini ko'rsatadi.

en: We ﬁnd that later Babylonia severely limited the rights of property in slaves.
uz: Keyinchalik Bobil qullarning mulk huquqlarini qattiq cheklaganini aniqladik.

en: in the teaching of that great revolutionist, Jesus of Nazareth, such an attack upon property as had never been before.
uz: O'sha buyuk inqilobchi Iso Nosirotning ta'limotida mulkga hech qachon bo'lmagan bunday hujum.

en: Easier it was, he said, for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for the owner of great possessions to enter the kingdom of heaven.
uz: U aytdi: Buyuk boylikka ega bo'lgan odam osmon Shohligiga kirgandan ko'ra, tuyaning igna teshigidan o'tishi osonroq edi.

en: A steady, continuous criticism of the permis- sible scope of property seems to have been going on in the world for the last twenty-ﬁve or thirty centuries.
uz: Dunyoda mulkning ruxsat etilgan doirasiga nisbatan barqaror, uzluksiz tanqid oxirgi yigirma besh yoki o'ttiz asrdan beri davom etayotganga o'xshaydi.

en: Nineteen hundred years after Jesus of Nazareth we ﬁnd all the world that has come under the Christian teaching persuaded that there could be no property in human beings.
