uz: Iso Nosiralik Iso Masihdan keyin o'n to'qqiz yuz yil o'tgach, xristian ta'limotiga o'tgan butun dunyoni insonlarda hech qanday mulk bo'lishi mumkin emasligiga ishontirgan holda topamiz.

en: And also the idea that a man may “do what he likes with his own” was very much shaken in relation to other sorts of property.
uz: Shuningdek, odamning o'ziniki bilan o'ziga yoqqanini qilishi haqidagi g'oya boshqa turdagi mulklarga nisbatan juda larzaga kelgan edi.

en: But this world of the closing eighteenth century was still only in the in- terrogative stage in this matter.
uz: Lekin oxirlab borayotgan o'n sakkizinchi asrning bu dunyosi bu masalada faqatgina terrogativ bosqichda edi.

en: It had got nothing clear enough, much less settled enough, to act upon.
uz: U yetarlicha aniq narsa topmagan edi, ayniqsa yetarlicha o'rnashib qolgan edi, unga amal qilish uchun.

en: One of its primary impulses was to protect property against the greed and waste of kings and the exploitation of noble adventurers.
uz: Uning asosiy turtkilaridan biri mulklarni shohlarning ochko'zligi va isrofgarchiligidan hamda olijanob sarguzashtchilarning ekspluatatsiyasidan himoya qilish edi.

en: It was largely to protect private property from taxation that the French Revolution began.
uz: Fransiya inqilobi asosan xususiy mulkni soliqdan himoya qilish uchun boshlandi.

en: But the equalitarian formulæ of the Revolution carried it into a criticism of the very property it had risen to protect.
uz: Ammo Inqilobning teng huquqli formulari uni himoya qilish uchun ko'tarilgan mulkning o'ziga nisbatan tanqidga olib keldi.

en: How can men be free and equal when numbers of them have no ground to stand upon and nothing to eat, and the owners will neither feed nor lodge them unless they toil?
uz: Qanday qilib odamlar erkin va teng bo'lishi mumkin, chunki ularning ko'pchiligi turishga zamin yo'q va yeyishga hech narsa yo'q, va egalari ularni mehnat qilmaguncha na oziqlantirmaydilar, na turtki beradilar?

en: Excessively—the poor complained.
uz: Haddan tashqari  kambag'allar shikoyat qilishdi.

en: To which riddle the reply of one important political group was to set about “dividing up.” They wanted to intensify and universalize property.
uz: Bir muhim siyosiy guruhning javobi bo'linishni boshlash edi. Ular mulkni kuchaytirish va umumjahonlashtirishni xohlashardi.

en: Aiming at the same end by another route, there were the primitive socialists —or, to be more exact, communists—who wanted to “abolish” private property altogether.
uz: Xuddi shu nuqtaga boshqa yo'l bilan yo'naltirilgan holda, xususiy mulkni butunlay yo'q qilishni istagan ibtidoiy sotsialislar  aniqrog'i, kommunistlar ham bor edi.

en: The state (a democratic state was of course understood) was to own all property.
uz: Davlat (demokratik davlat tushuniladi, albatta) barcha mulkka egalik qilishi kerak edi.

en: It is paradoxical that different men seeking the same ends of liberty and happiness should propose on the one hand to make property as absolute as possible, and on the other to put an end to it altogether.
uz: Erkinlik va baxtning bir xil maqsadlarini izlayotgan turli odamlar bir tomondan mulkni imkon qadar mutlaq qilish va boshqa tomondan unga butunlay chek qo'yishni taklif qilishlari paradoksal.

en: And the clue to this paradox is to be found in the fact that ownership is not one thing but a multitude of different things.
uz: Va bu paradoksning mohiyati shundaki, egalik bir narsa emas, balki ko'plab turli xil narsalardir.

en: It was only as the nineteenth century developed that men began to realize that property was not one simple thing, but a great complex of ownerships of different values and consequences, that many things (such as one’s body, the implements of an artist, clothing, toothbrushes) are very profoundly and
uz: Faqatgina XIX asr rivojlanishi bilan odamlar mulk oddiy narsa emasligini, balki turli qadriyatlar va oqibatlarga ega bo'lgan egalik majmuasi ekanligini anglay boshladilar, ko'plab narsalar (masalan, tanasi, rassomning asboblari, kiyim-kechaklari, tish cho'tkalari) juda chuqur va...

en: incurably one’s personal property, and that there is a very great range of things, railways, machinery of various sorts, homes, cultivated gardens, pleasure boats, for example, which need each to be considered very particu- larly to determine how far and under what limitations it may come under private ownership, and how far it falls into the public domain and may be administered and let out by the state in the collective interest.
uz: Muqarrar ravishda shaxsiy mulk, va juda katta narsalar, temir yo'llar, turli xildagi mashinalar, uylar, dehqonchilik bog'lari, ko'ngilochar qayiqlar mavjudligi, masalan, ularning har biri xususiy mulkdorlikka qanchalik va qanday cheklovlar ostida tushishi mumkinligini aniqlash uchun juda katta e'tiborga olinishi kerak, va qanchalik jamoat mulkiga aylanishi mumkin va davlat tomonidan jamoaviy manfaatda boshqarilishi va chiqarilishi mumkin.

en: On the practi- cal side these questions pass into politics, and the problem of making and sustaining efﬁcient state administration.
uz: Amaliy tomondan bu savollar siyosatga o'tadi va samarali davlat boshqaruvini yaratish va uni qo'llab-quvvatlash muammosi.

en: They open up issues in social psy- chology, and interact with the enquiries of educational science.
uz: Ular ijtimoiy psixologiya masalalarini ochadilar va ta'limiy fan so'rovlari bilan o'zaro ta'sirlashadi.

en: The criti- cism of property is still a vast and passionate ferment rather than a science.
uz: Mulkni tanqid qilish hali ham fan emas, balki ulkan va ehtirosli fermentdir.

en: On the one hand are the Individualists, who would protect and enlarge our present freedoms with what we possess, and on the other the Socialists who would in many directions pool our ownerships and restrain our proprietory acts.
uz: Bir tomondan, hozirgi erkinliklarimizni biz egalik qilayotgan narsalar bilan himoya qiladigan va kengaytirishni istagan Individualistlar, ikkinchi tomondan esa, ko'p yo'nalishlarda egalik huquqlarimizni birlashtiradigan va mulkchilik harakatlarimizni cheklaydigan Sotsialistlar.

en: In practice one will ﬁnd every gradation between the extreme individ- ualist, who will scarcely tolerate a tax of any sort to support a government, and the communist who would deny any possessions at all.
uz: Amalda, hukumatni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun har qanday turdagi soliqni deyarli toqat qilmaydigan ekstremal individualist va umuman hech qanday mulkni rad etmaydigan kommunist o'rtasida har qanday gradatsiyani topish mumkin.

en: The ordinary socialist of to-day is what is called a collectivist; he would allow a consider- able amount of private property but put such affairs as education, transport, mines, land-owning, most mass productions of staple articles, and the like, into the hands of a highly organized state.
uz: Bugungi kunda oddiy sotsialistik shaxs kollektivist deb ataladi; u xususiy mulkning sezilarli miqdorida bo'lishiga yo'l qo'yadi, lekin ta'lim, transport, konlar, yer egaligi, asosiy mahsulotlarning ko'pchilik ommaviy ishlab chiqarilishi va shunga o'xshash masalalarni yuqori darajada tashkil etilgan davlat qo'liga topshiradi.

en: Nowadays there does seem to be a gradual convergence of reasonable men towards a moderate socialism sci- entiﬁcally studied and planned.
uz: Hozirgi kunda oqilona odamlarning ilmiy jihatdan o'rganilgan va rejalashtirilgan o'rtacha sotsializmga asta-sekin yaqinlashayotgandek tuyuladi.

en: It is realized more and more clearly that the untutored man does not co-operate easily and successfully in large under- takings, and that every step towards a more complex state and every func- tion that the state takes over from private enterprise, necessitates a corre- sponding educational advance and the organization of a proper criticism and control.
uz: Ko'proq va aniqroq anglanadiki, o'qimagan odam yirik korxonalarda oson va muvaffaqiyatli hamkorlik qilmaydi, va har bir murakkabroq davlatga va davlat xususiy korxonadan o'z zimmasiga oladigan har bir vazifani to'g'ri ta'lim ilgari surilishini hamda tegishli tanqid va nazoratni tashkil qilishni talab qiladi.

en: Both the press and the political methods of the contemporary state are far too crude for any large extension of collective activities.
uz: Zamonaviy davlatning matbuoti ham, siyosiy usullari ham har qanday katta jamoaviy faoliyatni kengaytirish uchun juda qo'pol.

en: But for a time the stresses between employer and employed and particu- larly between selﬁsh employers and reluctant workers, led to a world-wide dissemination of the very harsh and elementary form of communism which is associated with the name of Marx.
uz: Lekin bir muddat ish beruvchi va ish bilan ta'minlanganlar o'rtasidagi, ayniqsa xudbin ish beruvchilar va istamagan ishchilar o'rtasidagi ziddiyatlar butun dunyoga Marx nomi bilan bog'liq bo'lgan kommunizmning juda qattiq va oddiy shaklining tarqalishiga olib keldi.

en: Marx based his theories on a belief that men’s minds are limited by their economic necessities, and that there is a necessary conﬂict of interests in our present civilization between the pros- perous and employing classes of people and the employed mass.
uz: Marks o'z nazariyalarini odamlarning aqli ularning iqtisodiy ehtiyojlari bilan cheklangan degan ishonchga asoslagan va hozirgi tsivilizatsiyamizda odamlarning foydalanuvchi va ishchi sinfi hamda ishchi massa o'rtasida manfaatlar to'qnashuvi zarur ekanligiga ishongan.

en: With the advance in education necessitated by the mechanical revolution, this great employed majority will become more and more class-conscious and more
uz: Mexanik inqilob tufayli ta'lim sohasidagi taraqqiyot zarur bo'lishi bilan, bu katta ish bilan ta'minlangan ko'pchilik tobora sinfiy ongli va ko'proq bo'ladi.

en: and more solid in antagonism to the (class- conscious) ruling minority.
uz: va (sinfiy ongli) hukmron ozchilikka nisbatan dushmanlikda yanada mustahkamroq.

en: In some way the class-conscious workers would seize power, he prophesied, and inaugurate a new social state.
uz: Qandaydir tarzda sinfiy ongli ishchilar hokimiyatni egallab olishadi, deb bashorat qildi u va yangi ijtimoiy davlatni ochadi.

en: The antagonism, the insurrection, the possible revolution are understandable enough, but it does not follow that a new social state or anything but a socially destructive process will ensue.
uz: Antagonizm, qo'zg'olon, mumkin bo'lgan inqilob yetarlicha tushunarli, lekin bu yangi ijtimoiy holat yoki ijtimoiy vayron qiluvchi jarayondan boshqa hech narsa kelib chiqishiga olib kelmaydi.

en: Put to the test in Russia, Marxism, as we shall note later, has proved singu- larly uncreative.
uz: Rossiyada sinovdan o'tkazilganda, marksizm, keyinroq qayd etadiganimizdek, o'ziga xos ijodkor emasligini isbotladi.

en: SCIENCE IN THE COAL MINE  Portable Electric Loading Conveyor  Photo: Jeffrey Manufacturing Company, Columbus, Ohio Marx sought to replace national antagonism by class antagonisms; Marx- ism has produced in succession a First, a Second and a Third Workers’ In- ternational.
uz: KO'mir konidagi FAN Ko'chma elektr yuk konveyerining fotosurati: Jeffrey Manufacturing Company, Columbus, Ohio Marx milliy qarama-qarshilikni sinfiy qarama-qarshiliklar bilan almashtirishga intildi; Marks ketma-ket Birinchi, Ikkinchi va Uchinchi Ishchilarni  xalqaro.

en: But from the starting point of modern individualistic thought it is also possible to reach international ideas.
uz: Lekin zamonaviy individualist fikrlashning boshlang'ich nuqtasidan xalqaro g'oyalarga ham yetib borish mumkin.

en: From the days of that great English economist, Adam Smith, onward there has been an increasing real- ization that for world-wide prosperity free and unencumbered trade about the earth is needed.
uz: O'sha buyuk ingliz iqtisodchisi Adam Smit davridan boshlab, butun dunyo bo'ylab farovonlik uchun yer haqida erkin va hech qanday to'siqsiz savdo zarurligi tobora kuchayib bormoqda.

en: The individualist with his hostility to the state is hostile also to tariffs and boundaries and all the restraints upon free act and move-
uz: Davlatga dushmanligi bilan individualist tariflar va chegaralarga, shuningdek, erkin harakat va harakatga qo'yiladigan barcha cheklovlarga ham dushmanlik qiladi.

en: ment that national boundaries seem to justify.
uz: Milliy chegaralar o'zini oqlayotgandek tuyuladi.

en: It is interesting to see two lines of thought, so diverse in spirit, so different in substance as this class- war socialism of the Marxists and the individualistic free-trading philoso- phy of the British business men of the Victorian age heading at last, in spite of these primary differences, towards the same intimations of a new world- wide treatment of human affairs outside the boundaries and limitations of any existing state.
uz: Ikkita fikrlash tarzini ko'rish qiziq, ruhida shunchalik xilma-xil, mohiyati shunchalik xilma-xil, masalan, marksistlarning sinfiy urush sotsializmi va Viktoriya davri Britaniyalik tadbirkorlarining individualist erkin savdo filoso-fi, shu asosiy farqlarga qaramay, oxir-oqibatda mavjud davlatning chegaralari va cheklovlaridan tashqarida inson ishlarining yangi jahon miqyosida ko'rib chiqilishi haqidagi bir xil ishoralarni ko'rish.

en: The logic of reality triumphs over the logic of theory.
uz: Haqiqat mantig'i nazariya mantig'idan ustun keladi.

en: We begin to perceive that from widely divergent starting points individualist theory and socialist theory are part of a common search, a search for more spacious social and political ideas and interpretations, upon which men may contrive to work together, a search that began again in Europe and has in- tensiﬁed as men’s conﬁdence in the ideas of the Holy Roman Empire and in Christendom decayed, and as the age of discovery broadened their horizons from the world of the Mediterranean to the whole wide world.
uz: Biz keng tarqalgan farq qiluvchi boshlang'ich nuqtalardan individualist nazariyasi va sotsialistik nazariyaning umumiy izlanishning bir qismi ekanligini anglay boshlaymiz, odamlar birgalikda ishlashga urinishi mumkin bo'lgan kengroq ijtimoiy va siyosiy g'oyalar va talqinlarni qidirish, Yevropada yana boshlangan va Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi va xristianlik g'oyalariga bo'lgan odamlarning ishonchi taranglashganligi sababli, kashfiyotlar davri O'rta yer dengizi dunyosidan butun dunyoga o'z ufqlarini kengaytirgani sari taranglashgan.

en: To bring this description of the elaboration and development of social, economic and political ideas right down to the discussions of the present day, would be to introduce issues altogether too controversial for the scope and intentions of this book.
uz: Ijtimoiy, iqtisodiy va siyosiy g'oyalarning ishlab chiqilishi va rivojlanishi haqidagi bu ta'rifni hozirgi kun muhokamasiga olib borish, bu kitobning doirasi va niyatlari uchun umuman bahsli bo'lmagan masalalarni kiritishdan iborat bo'ladi.

en: But regarding these things, as we do here, from the vast perspectives of the student of world history, we are bound to recog- nize that this reconstruction of these directive ideas in the human mind is still an unﬁnished task—we cannot even estimate yet how unﬁnished the task may be.
uz: Lekin bu narsalarga kelsak, biz bu yerda qilayotganimizdek, jahon tarixi talabasining keng nuqtai nazaridan, biz inson ongidagi ushbu yo'riqnoma g'oyalarining qayta tiklanishi hali ham tugallanmagan vazifa ekanligini tan olishimiz shart  biz hali ham vazifa qanchalik tugallanmaganligini baholay olmaymiz.

en: Certain common beliefs do seem to be emerging, and their in- ﬂuence is very perceptible upon the political events and public acts of to- day; but at present they are not clear enough nor convincing enough to com- pel men deﬁnitely and systematically towards their realization.
uz: Ba'zi keng tarqalgan e'tiqodlar paydo bo'layotgandek tuyuladi va ularning o'ziga xosligi bugungi siyosiy voqealar va ommaviy harakatlarda juda seziladi; ammo hozirda ular odamlarni aniq va tizimli ravishda o'z amalga oshirishlariga undash uchun yetarlicha aniq ham, ishontiruvchi ham emas.

en: Men’s acts waver between tradition and the new, and on the whole they rather gravitate towards the traditional.
uz: Erkaklarning harakatlari an'ana va yangilik o'rtasida tebranadi va umuman olganda, ular an'anaviyga ko'proq tortishadi.

en: Yet, compared with the thought of even a brief life- time ago, there does seem to be an outline shaping itself of a new order in human affairs.
uz: Shunga qaramay, hatto qisqa umr o'tishi bilan solishtirganda, inson ishlarida yangi tartib shakllanayotgandek tuyuladi.

en: It is a sketchy outline, vanishing into vagueness at this point and that, and ﬂuctuating in detail and formulæ, yet it grows steadfastly clearer, and its main lines change less and less.
uz: Bu noaniq kontur bo'lib, shu nuqtada noaniqlikka ketadi va detallarda va formulalarda o'zgarib turadi, ammo u barqaror ravishda tiniqroq bo'lib boradi va uning asosiy yo'nalishlari tobora kamroq o'zgaradi.

en: CONSTRUCTIONAL DETAIL OF THE FORTH BRIDGE  Photo: Baker & Hurtzig It is becoming plainer and plainer each year that in many respects and in an increasing range of affairs, mankind is becoming one community, and
uz: TO'RTINCHI KO'PRIKNING CONSTRUKSIONALIK TAFSILI Foto: Baker & Hurtzig Har yili ko'p jihatdan va ishlarning tobora ko'payib borayotgan doirasida insoniyat bir jamiyatga aylanib borayotgani tobora tiniqlashib bormoqda va

en: that it is more and more necessary that in such matters there should be a common world-wide control.
uz: Bunday masalalarda butun dunyo bo'ylab umumiy nazorat bo'lishi tobora zarur bo'lib bormoqda.

en: For example, it is steadily truer that the whole planet is now one economic community, that the proper exploitation of its natural resources demands one comprehensive direction, and that the greater power and range that discovery has given human effort makes the present fragmentary and contentious administration of such affairs more and more wasteful and dangerous.
uz: Misol uchun, butun sayyoramiz endi yagona iqtisodiy jamiyat ekanligi, uning tabiiy resurslarini to'g'ri ishlatish yagona keng qamrovli yo'nalishni talab qilishi va kashfiyot insoniyat kuchini bergan katta kuch va diapazon bunday masalalarning hozirgi bo'lak-bo'lak va bahsli boshqaruvini tobora behuda va xavfli qilishi barqarorroqdir.

en: Financial and monetary expedients also become world-wide interests to be dealt with successfully only on world- wide lines.
uz: Moliyaviy va pul maqsadlari ham faqatgina jahon miqyosida muvaffaqiyatli hal qilinadigan butun dunyo manfaatlariga aylanadi.

en: Infectious diseases and the increase and migrations of popula- tion are also now plainly seen to be world-wide concerns.
uz: Yuqumli kasalliklar va aholining ko'payishi va migratsiyasi ham hozirda butun dunyo bo'ylab tashvish sifatida aniq ko'rinmoqda.

en: The greater pow- er and range of human activities has also made war disproportionately de- structive and disorganizing, and, even as a clumsy way of settling issues be- tween government and government and people and people, ineffective.
uz: Insoniyat faoliyatining katta qudrati va keng doirasi urushni nomutanosib ravishda de-strukturaga va tartibsizlikka olib keldi, hatto hukumat va hukumat hamda xalq va xalq o'rtasidagi muammolarni hal qilishning g'alati usuli sifatida ham samarasiz bo'ldi.

en: All these things clamour for controls and authorities of a greater range and greater comprehensiveness than any government that has hitherto existed.
uz: Bularning barchasi shu paytgacha mavjud bo'lgan har qanday hukumatdan ko'ra kengroq va kengroq qamrovli nazorat va hokimiyat organlariga chaqiradi.

en: But it does not follow that the solution of these problems lies in some su- per-government of all the world arising by conquest or by the coalescence of existing governments.
uz: Lekin bu muammolarning yechimi butun dunyo bo'ylab hukmronlik qilish yoki mavjud hukumatlarning birlashuvi natijasida yuzaga keladigan ba'zi bir su-per-hukumatlarda yotadi, degan ma'noni anglatmaydi.

en: By analogy with existing institutions men have thought of the Parliament of Mankind, of a World Congress, of a President or Emperor of the Earth.
uz: Mavjud institutlar bilan analogiya orqali odamlar Insoniyat Parlamenti, Jahon Kongressi, Yer Prezidenti yoki Imperatori haqida o'ylashgan.

en: Our ﬁrst natural reaction is towards some such conclusion, but the discussion and experiences of half a century of sug- gestions and attempts has on the whole discouraged belief in that ﬁrst obvi- ous idea.
uz: Bizning birinchi tabiiy reaksiyamiz shunday xulosaga qaratilgan, lekin yarim asrlik maslahatlar va urinishlarning muhokamasi va tajribasi butunlay o'sha birinchi aniq g'oyaga bo'lgan ishonchni susaytirdi.

en: Along that line to world unity the resistances are too great.
uz: O'sha yo'nalishda jahon birligiga qarshiliklar juda katta.

en: The drift of thought seems now to be in the direction of a number of special committees or organizations, with world-wide power delegated to them by existing governments in this group of matters or that, bodies concerned with the waste or development of natural wealth, with the equalization of labour conditions, with world peace, with currency, population and health, and so forth.
uz: Fikrning siljishi hozirda bir qator maxsus qo'mitalar yoki tashkilotlar yo'nalishida ko'rinadi, ularga ushbu yoki boshqa masalalarda mavjud hukumatlar tomonidan butun dunyo bo'ylab vakolat berilgan, tabiiy boyliklarning isrof bo'lishi yoki rivojlanishi, mehnat sharoitlarining tenglashuvi, jahon tinchligi, valyuta, aholi va sog'liq bilan bog'liq organlar va hokazo.

en: The world may discover that all its common interests are being managed as one concern, while it still fails to realize that a world government exists.
uz: Dunyo o'zining barcha umumiy manfaatlari bir muammo sifatida boshqarilayotganini anglashi mumkin, shu bilan birga u hali ham jahon hukumati mavjudligini anglamaydi.

en: But before even so much human unity is attained, before such international arrangements can be put above patriotic suspicions and jealousies, it is nec- essary that the common mind of the race should be possessed of that idea of human unity, and that the idea of mankind as one family should be a matter of universal instruction and understanding.
uz: Ammo hatto shunchalik insoniy birlikka erishilishidan oldin, bunday xalqaro kelishuvlar vatanparvarlik gumonlari va rashklardan ustun qo'yilishidan oldin, irqning umumiy ongi insoniy birlik g'oyasiga ega bo'lishi va insoniyatning bir oila sifatida g'oyasi universal ta'lim va tushunish masalasi bo'lishi zarur.

en: For a score of centuries or more the spirit of the great universal religions has been struggling to maintain and extend that idea of a universal human brotherhood, but to this day the spites, angers and distrusts of tribal, nation- al and racial friction obstruct, and successfully obstruct, the broader views and more generous impulses which would make every man the servant of all mankind.
uz: Bir necha asrlar yoki undan ko'proq vaqtdan beri buyuk universal dinlarning ruhi universal insoniy birodarlik g'oyasini saqlab qolish va kengaytirish uchun kurashmoqda, ammo bugungi kunga qadar qabila, millat va irqiy ishqalanishlarning nafratlari, g'azablari va ishonchsizliklari har bir insonni butun insoniyatning quli qiladigan kengroq qarashlar va saxiyroq turtkilarni to'sib qo'yadi va muvaffaqiyatli to'sadi.

en: The idea of human brotherhood struggles now to possess the human soul, just as the idea of Christendom struggled to possess the soul of Europe in the confusion and disorder of the sixth and seventh centuries of the Christian era.
uz: Insoniy birodarlik g'oyasi hozir inson ruhini egallash uchun kurashmoqda, xuddi xristianlik g'oyasi xristianlik davrining oltinchi va yettinchi asrlarida chalkashlik va tartibsizlikda Yevropa ruhini egallash uchun kurashganidek.

en: The dissemination and triumph of such ideas must be the work of a multitude of devoted and undistinguished missionaries, and no contemporary writer can presume to guess how far such work has gone or what harvest it may be preparing.
uz: Bunday g'oyalarning tarqalishi va g'alabasi ko'plab sadoqatli va o'ziga xos bo'lmagan missionerlarning ishi bo'lishi kerak va hech bir zamonaviy yozuvchi bunday ish qanchalik uzoqga ketganini yoki qanday hosil tayyorlayotganini taxmin qilishga jur'at eta olmaydi.

en: Social and economic questions seem to be inseparably mingled with in- ternational ones.
uz: Ijtimoiy va iqtisodiy masalalar xalqaro masalalar bilan ajralmas darajada aralashgan ko'rinadi.

en: The solution in each case lies in an appeal to that same spirit of service which can enter and inspire the human heart.
uz: Har bir holatda yechim xuddi shu xizmat ruhiga murojaat qilishda yotadi, u inson qalbiga kirib, ilhomlantirishi mumkin.

en: The distrust, intractability and egotism of nations reﬂects and is reﬂected by the distrust, intractability and egotism of the individual owner and worker in the face of the common good.
uz: Millatlarning ishonchsizligi, murosasizligi va xudbinligi umumiy manfaat oldidagi individual egasi va ishchining ishonchsizligi, murosasizligi va xudbinligi bilan aks etadi va aks etadi.

en: Exaggerations of possessiveness in the individual are parallel and of a piece with the clutching greed of nations and emperors.
uz: Shaxsdagi egalikparastlikning oshirib yuborilishi parallel va millatlar va imperatorlarning tutqich ochko'zligi bilan bir qismdir.

en: They are products of the same instinctive tendencies, and the same igno- rances and traditions.
uz: Ular bir xil instinktiv moyilliklarning, bir xil igno-rantlarning va an'analarning mahsulotidir.

en: Internationalism is the socialism of nations.
uz: Internatsionalizm - bu millatlarning sotsializmi.

en: No one who has wrestled with these problems can feel that there yet exists a sufﬁ- cient depth and strength of psychological science and a sufﬁciently planned-out educational method and organization for any real and ﬁnal so- lution of these riddles of human intercourse and cooperation.
uz: Bu muammolar bilan kurasha olgan hech kim psixologik fanning yetarli chuqurligi va kuchini, shuningdek, inson jinsiy aloqasi va hamkorligining bu jumboqlarini har qanday haqiqiy va yakuniy yechish uchun yetarlicha rejalashtirilgan ta'limiy usul va tashkilotni hali mavjudligini his qila olmaydi.

en: We are as in- capable of planning a really effective peace organization of the world to-day as were men in 1820 to plan an electric railway system, but for all we know the thing is equally practicable and may be as nearly at hand.
uz: Biz 1820-yilda elektr temir yo'l tizimini rejalashtirish uchun kelgan odamlar kabi, bugungi kunda dunyodagi haqiqiy samarali tinchlik tashkilotini rejalashtirish qobiliyatiga egamiz, ammo biz bilgan hamma narsa xuddi shunday amaliy va deyarli yaqin bo'lishi mumkin.

en: No man can go beyond his own knowledge, no thought can reach beyond contemporary thought, and it is impossible for us to guess or foretell how many generations of humanity may have to live in war and waste and inse- curity and misery before the dawn of the great peace to which all history seems to be pointing, peace in the heart and peace in the world, ends our night of wasteful and aimless living.
uz: Hech bir inson o'z bilimidan tashqariga chiqishi mumkin emas, hech bir fikr zamonaviy tafakkurdan tashqariga chiqishi mumkin emas va biz insoniyatning qancha avlodlari urush va isrofgarchilik, beqarorlik va musibatda yashashlari kerakligini taxmin qilish yoki bashorat qilishning iloji yo'q. Butun tarix ko'rsatayotgandek bo'lgan buyuk tinchlik, yurakdagi tinchlik va dunyoda tinchlik, behuda va maqsadsiz hayot kechamizni tugatadi.

en: Our proposed solutions are still vague and crude.
uz: Taklif etilayotgan yechimlarimiz hali ham noaniq va qo'pol.

en: Passion and suspicion surround them.
uz: Ularni ehtiros va gumon o'rab turadi.

en: A great task of intellectual reconstruction is going on, it is still incomplete, and our conceptions grow
uz: Intellektual rekonstruksiya qilishning katta vazifasi davom etmoqda, u hali ham to'liq emas va bizning tushunchalarimiz o'sib bormoqda.

en: clearer and more exact—slowly, rapidly, it is hard to tell which.
uz: Aniqroq va aniqroq  sekinroq, tezroq, qaysi birini aytish qiyin.

en: But as they grow clearer they will gather power over the minds and imaginations of men.
uz: Lekin ular tiniqlashgani sari, ular odamlarning ongi va tasavvuri ustidan kuch to'playdi.

en: Their present lack of grip is due to their lack of assurance and exact rightness.
uz: Ularning hozirgi ushlash qobiliyatining yo'qligi ishonchsizlik va aniq to'g'rilik yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.

en: They are misunderstood because they are variously and confus- ingly presented.
uz: Ular turli xil va chalkash tarzda taqdim etilgani uchun noto'g'ri tushuniladi.

en: But with precision and certainty the new vision of the world will gain compelling power.
uz: Ammo aniqlik va ishonch bilan dunyoga yangi qarash kuchli kuchga ega bo'ladi.

en: It may presently gain power very rapid- ly.
uz: Hozirda u juda tez quvvat olishi mumkin.

en: And a great work of educational reconstruction will follow logically and necessarily upon that clearer understanding.
uz: Va ta'limni qayta qurishning buyuk ishlari mantiqan va albatta o'sha aniqroq tushunchadan kelib chiqadi.

en: LX THE EXPANSION OF THE UNITED STATES The region of the world that displayed the most immediate and striking re- sults from the new inventions in transport was North America.
uz: LX AQShning kengayishi Dunyo mintaqasida transport sohasidagi yangi ixtirolardan eng tezkor va ta'sirchan natijalarni ko'rsatgan mintaqa Shimoliy Amerika edi.

en: Politically the United States embodied, and its constitution crystallized, the liberal ideas of the middle eighteenth century.
uz: Siyosiy jihatdan Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari XVIII asr o'rtalarining liberal g'oyalarini mujassam etgan va uning konstitutsiyasi kristalllashgan edi.

en: It dispensed with state-church or crown, it would have no titles, it protected property very jealously as a method of freedom, and—the exact practice varied at ﬁrst in the different states—it gave nearly every adult male citizen a vote.
uz: U davlat cherkovi yoki tojdan voz kechgan, unvonlari bo'lmas edi, mulkni erkinlik usuli sifatida juda rashk bilan himoya qilardi va  aniq amaliyot dastlab turli shtatlarda farq qilardi  u deyarli har bir voyaga yetgan erkak fuqaroga ovoz berdi.

en: Its method of voting was barbarically crude, and as a consequence its political life fell very soon under the control of highly organized party machines, but that did not pre- vent the newly emancipated population developing an energy, enterprise and public spirit far beyond that of any other contemporary population.
uz: Uning ovoz berish usuli vahshiyona qo'pol edi va natijada uning siyosiy hayoti juda tez orada yuqori darajada tashkil etilgan partiya mashinalari nazoratiga tushdi, ammo bu yangi ozod qilingan aholining energiya, tadbirkorlik va jamoat ruhini rivojlantirishiga hech qanday zamonaviy aholining o'zidan uzoqda yo'l qo'ymadi.

en: Then came that acceleration of locomotion to which we have already called attention.
uz: Keyin biz allaqachon e'tibor qaratgan joylashuv tezlashuvi keldi.

en: It is a curious thing that America, which owes most to this acceleration in locomotion, has felt it least.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, Amerika, bu harakat tezlashuviga eng ko'p qarzdor bo'lgan Amerika, buni eng kam his qilgan.

en: The United States have taken the railway, the river steamboat, the telegraph and so forth as though they were a natural part of their growth.
uz: Qo'shma Shtatlar temir yo'l, daryo bug' kemasi, telegraf va hokazolarni o'z o'sishining tabiiy qismi kabi qabul qildi.

en: These things happened to come along just in time to save American unity.
uz: Bu narsalar Amerika birligini saqlash uchun o'z vaqtida paydo bo'ldi.

en: The United States of to- day were made ﬁrst by the river steamboat, and then by the railway.
uz: Bugungi Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari avval daryo bug' kemasi, keyin esa temir yo'l bilan yaratilgan.

en: With- out these things, the present United States, this vast continental nation, would have been altogether impossible.
uz: Bu narsalarsiz hozirgi Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari, bu ulkan qit'a davlati umuman imkonsiz bo'lar edi.

en: The westward ﬂow of population would have been far more sluggish.
uz: Aholining g'arbga oqimi ancha sekinroq bo'lardi.

en: It might never have crossed the great central plains.
uz: U hech qachon buyuk markaziy tekisliklardan o'tmagan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: It took nearly two hundred years for effective settlement to reach from the coast to Missouri, much less than halfway across the conti-
uz: Sohildan Missurigacha yetib borish uchun samarali aholi yashash uchun deyarli ikki yuz yil kerak bo'ldi, bu esa Kontinentning yarmigacha yetib borganidan kamroq.

en: The ﬁrst state established beyond the river was the steamboat state of Missouri in 1821.
uz: Daryoning narigi tomonida tashkil etilgan birinchi shtat 1821-yilda Missuri bug' kemasi shtati bo'ldi.

en: But the rest of the distance to the Paciﬁc was done in a few decades.
uz: Lekin Tinch okeaniga bo'lgan qolgan masofa bir necha o'n yillikda amalga oshirildi.

en: If we had the resources of the cinema it would be interesting to show a map of North America year by year from 1600 onward, with little dots to represent hundreds of people, each dot a hundred, and stars to represent cities of a hundred thousand people.
uz: Agar bizda kino resurslari bo'lganida, Shimoliy Amerikaning xaritasini 1600 yildan boshlab, yuzlab odamni ifodalaydigan kichik nuqtalar, har bir nuqta yuz kishilik va yuz ming odamlik shaharlarni ifodalaydigan yulduzlar bilan ko'rsatish qiziqarli bo'lardi.

en: For two hundred years the reader would see that stippling creeping slow- ly along the coastal districts and navigable waters, spreading still more gradually into Indiana, Kentucky and so forth.
uz: Ikki yuz yil davomida o'quvchi sohil bo'ylari va suzish mumkin bo'lgan suvlar bo'ylab asta-sekin sudralib yuruvchi, Indiana, Kentukki va hokazolarga asta-sekinroq tarqalganini ko'rardi.

en: Then somewhere about 1810 would come a change.
uz: Keyin taxminan 1810-yillarda o'zgarish bo'lar edi.

en: Things would get more lively along the river cour- ses.
uz: Daryo bo'ylab ishlar jonliroq bo'lardi.

en: The dots would be multiplying and spreading.
uz: Nuqtalar ko'payib, tarqaladi.

en: That would be the steamboat.
uz: Bu bug' kemasi bo'lardi.

en: The pioneer dots would be spreading soon over Kansas and Ne- braska from a number of jumping-off places along the great rivers.
uz: Kashfiyotchi nuqtalar tez orada Kanzas va Ne-braska ustidan katta daryolar bo'ylab bir qator sakrash joylaridan tarqaladi.

en: Then from about 1850 onward would come the black lines of the rail- ways, and after that the little black dots would not simply creep but run.
uz: Keyin taxminan 1850 yildan boshlab temir yo'llarning qora chiziqlari paydo bo'ladi va shundan so'ng kichik qora nuqtalar shunchaki sirg'alib yurish emas, balki yugurishardi.

en: They would appear now so rapidly, it would be almost as though they were being put on by some sort of spraying machine.
uz: Ular hozir shunchalik tez paydo bo'lardi, go'yo ularni qandaydir purkagich mashinasi o'rnatayotgandek bo'lardi.

en: And suddenly here and then there would appear the ﬁrst stars to indicate the ﬁrst great cities of a hun- dred thousand people.
uz: Va birdan shu yerda va keyin birinchi yulduzlar paydo bo'lib, u yerda minglab odamning birinchi buyuk shaharlarini ko'rsatardi.

en: First one or two and then a multitude of cities—each like a knot in the growing net of the railways.
uz: Avval bir-ikki, keyin ko'plab shaharlar  har biri temir yo'llarning o'sib borayotgan tarmog'idagi tugun kabi.

en: The growth of the United States is a process that has no precedent in the world’s history; it is a new kind of occurrence.
uz: Qo'shma Shtatlarning o'sishi dunyo tarixida misli ko'rilmagan jarayon; bu yangi turdagi hodisa.

en: Such a community could not have come into existence before, and if it had, without railways it would certainly have dropped to pieces long before now.
uz: Bunday jamiyat ilgari mavjud bo'lishi mumkin emas edi va agar bo'lganida, temir yo'llarsiz u allaqachon ancha oldin parchalanib ketgan bo'lardi.

en: Without railways or tele- graph it would be far easier to administer California from Pekin than from Washington.
uz: Temir yo'llar yoki tele-grafik bo'lmasa, Kaliforniyani Pekin shahridan Vashingtondan boshqarishni ancha osonroq qilish mumkin edi.

en: But this great population of the United States of America has not only grown outrageously; it has kept uniform.
uz: Lekin Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlarining bu katta aholisi nafaqat dahshatli darajada o'sdi; u bir xilligini saqlab qoldi.

en: Nay, it has become more uniform.
uz: Yo'q, u bir xilroq bo'lib qoldi.

en: The man of San Francisco is more like the man of New York to- day than the man of Virginia was like the man of New England a century ago.
uz: San-Frantsisko odami bugungi Nyu-York odamiga bir asr oldin Virjiniya odamiga o'xshab qolganidan ko'ra ko'proq o'xshaydi.

en: And the process of assimilation goes on unimpeded.
uz: Va assimilyatsiya jarayoni to'siqsiz davom etadi.

en: The United States is being woven by railway, by telegraph, more and more into one vast unity, speaking, thinking and acting harmoniously with itself.
uz: Qo'shma Shtatlar temir yo'l, telegraf orqali tobora ko'proq bir ulkan birlikka to'qilib bormoqda, o'zi bilan uyg'unlikda gapiradi, o'ylaydi va harakat qiladi.

en: Soon aviation will be helping in the work.
uz: Tez orada aviatsiya ishda yordam beradi.

en: This great community of the United States is an altogether new thing in history.
uz: Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlarining bu buyuk jamiyati tarixga butunlay yangi narsa.

en: There have been great empires before with populations exceeding 100 millions, but these were associations of divergent peoples; there has never been one single people on this scale before.
uz: Avval ham 100 milliondan ortiq aholisi bo'lgan buyuk imperiyalar bo'lgan, lekin bular turli xalqlar uyushmalari edi; bu masshtabda hech qachon bitta xalq bo'lmagan.

en: We want a new term for this new thing.
uz: Biz bu yangi narsa uchun yangi atama xohlaymiz.

en: We call the United States a country just as we call France or Holland a country.
uz: Biz Qo'shma Shtatlarni xuddi Fransiya yoki Gollandiyani davlat deb ataganimiz kabi davlat deb ataymiz.

en: But the two things are as different as an automobile and a one-horse shay.
uz: Lekin bu ikki narsa xuddi avtomobil va bir otli shay kabi farq qiladi.

en: They are the creations of different periods and different conditions; they are going to work at a different pace and in an entirely dif- ferent way.
uz: Ular turli davrlar va turli sharoitlarning yaratilishidir; ular har xil sur'atda va butunlay boshqacha tarzda ishlashadi.

en: The United States in scale and possibility is halfway between a European state and a United States of all the world.
uz: Qo'shma Shtatlar miqyosi va imkoniyati bo'yicha Yevropa davlati va butun dunyo Qo'shma Shtatlari o'rtasida yarim yo'lda.

en: But on the way to this present greatness and security the American peo- ple passed through one phase of dire conﬂict.
uz: Ammo hozirgi ulug'vorlik va xavfsizlikka erishish yo'lida Amerika xalqining bir bosqichi keskin mojarolardan o'tdi.

en: The river steamboats, the rail- ways, the telegraph, and their associate facilities, did not come soon enough to avert a deepening conﬂict of interests and ideas between the southern and northern states of the Union.
uz: Daryo bug' kemalari, temir yo'llar, telegraf va ularning qo'shma inshootlari Ittifoqning janubiy va shimoliy shtatlari o'rtasidagi manfaatlar va g'oyalar to'qnashuvining chuqurlashuvining oldini olish uchun tez orada yetarli bo'lmadi.

en: The former were slave-holding states; the lat- ter, states in which all men were free.
uz: Birinchisi qul ushlab turuvchi davlatlar edi; ikkinchisi esa, barcha odamlar ozod bo'lgan davlatlar.

en: The railways and steamboats at ﬁrst did but bring into sharper conﬂict an already established difference between the two sections of the United States.
uz: Temir yo'llar va bug' kemalari dastlab Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlarining ikki qismi o'rtasida allaqachon o'rnatilgan farqni keskinroq mojaroga olib keldi.

en: The increasing uniﬁcation due to the new means of transport made the question whether the southern spirit or the northern should prevail an ever more urgent one.
uz: Yangi transport vositalari tufayli kuchayib borayotgan birlashuv, janubiy ruh yoki shimol ruh tobora dolzarbroq ruhda ustunlik qilishi kerakmi degan savolni keltirib chiqardi.

en: There was little possibility of compromise.
uz: Murosaga kelish ehtimoli kam edi.

en: The northern spirit was free and individualistic; the south- ern made for great estates and a conscious gentility ruling over a dusky sub- ject multitude.
uz: Shimoliy ruh erkin va individualist edi; janubiy - buyuk mulklar va qorong'u sub-dunyoviy olomon ustidan hukmronlik qiluvchi ongli millat uchun yaratilgan edi.

en: Every new territory that was organized into a state as the tide of popula- tion swept westward, every new incorporation into the fast growing Ameri- can system, became a ﬁeld of conﬂict between the two ideas, whether it should become a state of free citizens, or whether the estate and slavery sys- tem should prevail.
uz: Har bir yangi hudud, aholining g'arbga tomon oqimi kirib borar ekan, davlatga tashkil etilgan, Amerika-kan tizimiga tez o'sib borayotgan har bir yangi qo'shilish, ikki g'oya o'rtasidagi mojaro maydoniga aylandi, u erkin fuqarolar davlatiga aylanishi kerakmi yoki mulk va qullik tizimi ustun kelishi kerakmi.

en: From 1833 an American anti-slavery society was not merely resisting the extension of the institution but agitating the whole country for its complete abolition.
uz: 1833-yildan boshlab Amerika qullikka qarshi jamiyati nafaqat institutning kengayishiga qarshilik ko'rsatardi, balki butun mamlakatni uning butunlay bekor qilinishi uchun tashviqot qilardi.

en: The issue ﬂamed up into open conﬂict over the admission of Texas to the Union.
uz: Muammo Texasning Ittifoqqa kirishi bo'yicha ochiq mojaroga aylandi.

en: Texas had originally been a part of the republic of Mexico, but it was largely colonized by Americans from the slave-holding states, and it seceded from Mexico, established its inde- pendence in 1835, and was annexed to the United States in 1844.
uz: Texas dastlab Meksika Respublikasining bir qismi bo'lgan, ammo u asosan qul egalari davlatlaridan bo'lgan amerikaliklar tomonidan mustamlaka qilingan va u Meksikadan ajralib chiqqan, 1835 yilda mustaqilligini o'rnatgan va 1844 yilda AQShga qo'shilgan.

en: Under the Mexican law slavery had been forbidden in Texas, but now the South claimed Texas for slavery and got it.
uz: Meksika qonuniga ko'ra, Texasda qullik taqiqlangan edi, lekin endi Janubiy Texasni qullik uchun da'vo qildi va uni oldi.

en: Meanwhile the development of ocean navigation was bringing a growing swarm of immigrants from Europe to swell the spreading population of the northern states, and the raising of Iowa, Wisconsin, Minnesota and Oregon, all northern farm lands, to state level, gave the anti-slavery North the possi- bility of predominance both in the Senate and the House of Representatives.
uz: Ayni paytda okean navigatsiyasining rivojlanishi Yevropadan kelayotgan immigrantlarning tobora ko'payib borayotgan to'dasini shimoliy shtatlarning tarqalgan aholisini ko'paytirmoqda edi va Ayova, Viskonsin, Minnesota va Oregonning barcha shimoliy qishloq xo'jaligi yerlarini shtat darajasiga ko'tarilishi qullikka qarshi Shimoliyga Senat va Vakillar Palatasida ustunlik qilish imkoniyatini berdi.

en: The cotton- growing South, irritated by the growing threat of the Abolition- ist movement, and fearing this predominance in Congress, began to talk of secession from the Union.
uz: Paxta yetishtiruvchi janub, abolizion harakatining kuchayib borayotgan tahdididan bezovta bo'lib, Kongressdagi bu ustunlikdan qo'rqib, Ittifoqdan ajralish haqida gapira boshladi.

en: Southerners began to dream of annexations to the south of them in Mexico and the West Indies, and of great slave state, de- tached from the North and reaching to Panama.
uz: Janubliklar Meksika va G'arbiy Hindiston hududlarida ularning janubida anneksiyalarni, shuningdek, shimoldan ozod qilingan va Panamaga yetib boradigan buyuk qullar davlatini orzu qila boshladilar.

en: The return of Abraham Lincoln as an anti-extension President in 1860 decided the South to split the Union.
uz: Abraham Linkolnning 1860-yilda anti-extension prezidenti sifatida qaytishi Janubiy Ittifoqni bo'lishga qaror qildi.

en: South Carolina passed an “ordinance of secession” and prepared for war.
uz: Janubiy Karolina a'zolik to'g'risidagi nizomni qabul qildi va urushga tayyorlandi.

en: Mississippi, Florida, Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana and Texas joined her, and a convention met at Montgomery in Alabama, elected Jefferson Davis president of the “Confederated States” of America, and adopted a constitution speciﬁcally upholding “the institution of negro slavery.” ONE OF THE FIRST AMERICAN RIVER STEAMERS
uz: Missisipi, Florida, Alabama, Jorjiya, Luiziana va Texas unga qo'shilishdi va Alabama shtatining Montgomeri shahrida konferensiya bo'lib o'tdi, Jefferson Devisni Amerikaning Konfederatsiya Shtatlari prezidenti etib sayladi va aynan negro qullik institutini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan konstitutsiya qabul qildi.

en: Abraham Lincoln was, it chanced, a man entirely typical of the new peo- ple that had grown up after the War of Independence.
uz: Avraam Linkoln, ehtimol, Mustaqillik urushidan keyin ulg'aygan yangi xalq uchun butunlay xos odam edi.

en: His early years had been spent as a drifting particle in the general westward ﬂow of the popula- tion.
uz: Uning dastlabki yillari aholining umumiy g'arbga oqimida suzuvchi zarracha sifatida o'tkazilgan edi.

en: He was born in Kentucky (1809), was taken to Indiana as a boy and later on to Illinois.
uz: U Kentukki shtatida (1809 yilda) tug'ilgan, bolaligida Indiana shtatiga, keyinchalik esa Illinoysga olib ketilgan.

en: Life was rough in the backwoods of Indiana in those days; the house was a mere log cabin in the wilderness, and his schooling was poor and casual.
uz: O'sha kunlarda Indiana o'rmonlarida hayot beqaror edi; uy cho'lda oddiy yog'och kulba edi va uning maktabi yomon va beparvo edi.

en: But his mother taught him to read early, and he be- came a voracious reader.
uz: Ammo onasi unga erta o'qishni o'rgatdi va u juda ochko'z o'quvchi bo'ldi.

en: At seventeen he was a big athletic youth, a great wrestler and runner.
uz: O'n yetti yoshida u katta sportchi yosh edi, ajoyib kurashchi va yuguruvchi edi.

en: He worked for a time as clerk in a store, went into busi- ness as a storekeeper with a drunken partner, and contracted debts that he did not fully pay off for ﬁfteen years.
uz: U bir muddat do'konda kotiba bo'lib ishladi, mast hamkori bilan do'konchi bo'lib ishladi va o'n besh yil davomida to'liq to'lamagan qarzlarni oldi.

en: In 1834, when he was still only ﬁve and twenty, he was elected member of the House of Representatives for the State of Illinois.
uz: 1834-yilda, u hali yigirma besh yoshda bo'lganida, Illinoys shtati uchun Vakillar Palatasi a'zosi etib saylandi.

en: In Illinois particularly the question of slavery ﬂamed be- cause the great leader of the party for the extension of slavery in the nation- al Congress was Senator Douglas of Illinois.
uz: Illinoysda ayniqsa qullik masalasi qizg'in tarqalgan edi - chunki mamlakatda qullikni kengaytirish partiyasining buyuk yetakchisi - Kongressda Illinoysdan senator Duglas edi.

en: Douglas was a man of great ability and prestige, and for some years Lincoln fought against him by speech and pamphlet, rising steadily to the position of his most formidable and ﬁnally victorious antagonist.
uz: Duglas buyuk qobiliyat va obro'ga ega odam edi va bir necha yillar davomida Linkoln unga qarshi nutq va broshyura orqali kurashdi, barqaror ravishda o'zining eng dahshatli va nihoyat g'olib bo'lgan dushmani maqomiga ko'tarildi.

en: Their culminating struggle was the presi- dential campaign of 1860, and on the fourth of March, 1861, Lincoln was inaugurated President, with the southern states already in active secession from the rule of the federal government at Washington, and committing acts of war.
uz: Ularning eng yuqori cho'qqisi 1860-yildagi prezidentlik kampaniyasi bo'ldi va 1861-yil 4-martda Linkoln prezident etib tayinlandi, janubiy shtatlar Vashingtonda federal hukumat hukmronligidan faol ravishda ajralib chiqdi va urush harakatlarini sodir etdi.

en: This civil war in America was fought by improvised armies that grew steadily from a few score thousands to hundreds of thousands—until at last the Federal forces exceeded a million men; it was fought over a vast area between New Mexico and the eastern sea, Washington and Richmond were the chief objectives.
uz: Amerikadagi bu fuqarolar urushi bir necha mingdan yuz minglargacha barqaror o'sib borayotgan qo'shinlar tomonidan olib borildi  oxir-oqibat Federal kuchlar bir milliondan oshdi; u Nyu-Meksiko va sharqiy dengiz o'rtasidagi keng hududda, Vashington va Richmond asosiy maqsadlar edi.

en: It is beyond our scope here to tell of the mounting en- ergy of that epic struggle that rolled to and fro across the hills and woods of Tennessee and Virginia and down the Mississippi.
uz: Bu yerda Tennessi va Virjiniyaning tepaliklari va o'rmonlari bo'ylab hamda Missisipi daryosidan pastga va pastga aylanib o'tgan o'sha epik kurashning kuchayib borayotgan g'ayrati haqida gapirish bizning qobiliyatimizdan tashqari.

en: There was a terrible waste and killing of men.
uz: Ajoyib isrofgarchilik va odamlarning o'ldirilishi sodir bo'ldi.

en: Thrust was followed by counter thrust; hope gave way to despondency, and returned and was again disappointed.
uz: Tortish ortidan qarshi turtki keldi; umid tushkunlikka yo'l berdi va qaytib keldi va yana umidsizlandi.

en: Sometimes Washington seemed within the Confederate grasp; again the Federal armies were driving towards Richmond.
uz: Ba'zan Vashington Konfederatsiya qo'l ostida ko'rinardi; yana Federal armiyalar Richmondga qarab harakatlanardi.

en: The Confederates, outnumbered and far poorer in resources, fought under a general of supreme ability, General Lee.
uz: Konfederatlar, son jihatdan kamroq va resurs jihatidan ancha kambag'al bo'lgan holda, oliy qobiliyatga ega general, general Li ostida jang qilishdi.

en: The generalship of the Union was far inferior.
uz: Ittifoq generalligi ancha past edi.

en: Generals were dismissed, new generals appointed; until at last, under Sherman and Grant, came victo- ry over the ragged and depleted South.
uz: Generallar ishdan bo'shatildi, yangi generallar tayinlandi; oxir-oqibat, Sherman va Grant boshchiligida g'alaba g'arbiy va holdan toygan janub ustidan keldi.

en: In October, 1864, a Federal army
uz: 1864-yil oktabr oyida Federal armiya

en: under Sherman broke through the Confederate left and marched down from Tennessee through Georgia to the coast, right across the Confederate coun- try, and then turned up through the Carolinas, coming in upon the rear of the Confederate armies.
uz: Sherman Konfederatsiyani yorib o'tib, Tennessi shtatidan Gruziya orqali qirg'oqqa tushdi, Konfederatsiya hududidan o'tib, keyin Karolina orollaridan chiqib, Konfederatsiya armiyasining orqa tomoniga kirdi.

en: Meanwhile Grant held Lee before Richmond until Sherman closed on him.
uz: Shu bilan birga Grant Lini Richmonddan oldin Sherman unga yopilgunga qadar ushlab turdi.

en: On April 9th, 1865, Lee and his army surrendered at Appomattox Court House, and within a month all the remaining seces- sionist armies had laid down their arms and the Confederacy was at an end.
uz: 1865-yil 9-aprelda Li va uning armiyasi Appomattox saroyida taslim bo'lishdi va bir oy ichida qolgan barcha germaniyalik-sionist armiyalari qurollarini tashlashdi va Konfederatsiya tugadi.

en: ABRAHAM LINCOLN This four years’ struggle had meant an enormous physical and moral strain for the people of the United States.
uz: ABRAHAM LINKOLN Bu to'rt yillik kurash Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari xalqi uchun juda katta jismoniy va axloqiy zo'riqish tug'dirdi.

en: The principle of state autonomy was very dear to many minds, and the North seemed in effect to be forcing abolition upon the South.
uz: Davlat avtonomiyasi prinsipi ko'pchilik uchun juda qadrli edi va Shimol amalda Janubga bekor qilishni majburlayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: In the border states brothers and cousins, even fa-
uz: Chegara davlatlarida aka-ukalar va amakivachchalar, hatto...

en: thers and sons, would take opposite sides and ﬁnd themselves in antagonis- tic armies.
uz: Ular va o'g'illari qarama-qarshi tomonlarni qabul qilib, o'zlarini antagonis-tik armiyalarida topadilar.

en: The North felt its cause a righteous one, but for great numbers of people it was not a full-bodied and unchallenged righteousness.
uz: Shimol o'z sababini solih deb hisoblardi, lekin ko'pchilik odamlar uchun bu to'liq va bahssiz solihlik emas edi.

en: But for Lin- coln there was no doubt.
uz: Lekin Lin-koln uchun hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: He was a clear-minded man in the midst of much confusion.
uz: U ko'p chalkashlik paytida tiniq fikrli odam edi.

en: He stood for union; he stood for the wide peace of America.
uz: U ittifoq uchun edi; u Amerikaning keng tinchligi uchun edi.

en: He was opposed to slavery, but slavery he held to be a secondary issue; his pri- mary purpose was that the United States should not be torn into two con- trasted and jarring fragments.
uz: U qullikka qarshi edi, lekin qullikni ikkinchi darajali masala deb hisoblardi; uning asosiy maqsadi Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari ikki qarama-qarshi va g'alati bo'lakka bo'linmasligi edi.

en: When in the opening stages of the war Congress and the Federal generals embarked upon a precipitate emancipation, Lincoln opposed and mitigated their enthusiasm.
uz: Urushning dastlabki bosqichlarida Kongress va Federal generallar shoshilinch ozodlikka otlanganida, Linkoln ularga qarshi chiqdi va ularning ishtiyoqini yumshatdi.

en: He was for emancipation by stages and with compensa- tion.
uz: U bosqichma-bosqich va kompensatsiya bilan ozodlikka intildi.

en: It was only in January, 1865, that the situation had ripened to a point when Congress could propose to abolish slavery for ever by a constitutional amendment, and the war was already over before this amendment was rati- ﬁed by the states.
uz: Faqatgina 1865-yil yanvar oyida vaziyat shunday pishgan ediki, Kongress konstitutsiyaviy tuzatish orqali qullikni abadiy yo'q qilishni taklif qila olardi va bu tuzatish shtatlar tomonidan ratifikatsiya qilinishidan oldin urush allaqachon tugadi.

en: As the war dragged on through 1862 and 1863, the ﬁrst passions and en- thusiasms waned, and America learnt all the phases of war weariness and war disgust.
uz: Urush 1862 va 1863 yillarda cho'zilib o'tishi bilan, birinchi ehtiroslar va ishtiyoqlar susaydi va Amerika urush charchoqining barcha bosqichlarini va urush jirkanchligini o'rgandi.

en: The President found himself with defeatists, traitors, dismissed generals, tortuous party politicians, and a doubting and fatigued people be- hind him and uninspired generals and depressed troops before him; his chief consolation must have been that Jefferson Davis at Richmond could be in little better case.
uz: Prezident o'zini mag'lubiyatchilar, xoinlar, ishdan bo'shatilgan generallar, chalkash partiya siyosatchilari, va unga orqada turgan va charchoqlangan odamlar, va oldinda ilhomsiz generallar va tushkun qo'shinlar bilan topdi; uning asosiy tasalli bo'lishi kerakki, Richmonddagi Jefferson Davis undan yaxshiroq holatda bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The English government misbehaved, and permitted the Confederate agents in England to launch and man three swift privateer ships —the Alabama is the best remembered of them—which chased United States shipping from the seas.
uz: Ingliz hukumati noto'g'ri xulq-atvor ko'rsatdi va Angliyadagi Konfederatsiya agentlariga uchta tezkor xususiy kemani uchirish va boshqarishga ruxsat berdi  ularning eng yaxshi esda qolgan qismi Alabama bo'lib, u Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari kemasini dengizlardan quvib chiqardi.

en: The French army in Mexico was trampling the Monroe Doctrine in the dirt.
uz: Meksikadagi fransuz armiyasi Monro doktrinasini tuproqqa botirardi.

en: Came subtle proposals from Richmond to drop the war, leave the issues of the war for subsequent discussion, and turn, Federal and Confederate in alliance, upon the French in Mexico.
uz: Richmonddan urushni to'xtatish, urush masalalarini keyingi muhokama uchun qoldirish va federal va konfederatni ittifoqda Meksika fransuzlariga qaratish uchun nozik takliflar keldi.

en: But Lincoln would not listen to such proposals unless the supremacy of the Union was maintained.
uz: Lekin Linkoln Ittifoqning ustunligi saqlanib qolmaguncha, bunday takliflarga quloq solmas edi.

en: The Americans might do such things as one people but not as two.
uz: Amerikaliklar bir xalqdek shunday ishlarni qilishlari mumkin, lekin ikki xalqdek emas.

en: He held the United States together through long weary months of revers- es and ineffective effort, through black phases of division and failing courage; and there is no record that he ever faltered from his purpose.
uz: U Qo'shma Shtatlarni uzoq va charchagan oylar davomida teskari va samarasiz harakatlar, bo'linishning qora bosqichlari va jasoratning yetishmasligi orqali birga ushlab turdi; va u hech qachon o'z maqsadidan adashganligi haqida hech qanday yozuv yo'q.

en: There were times when there was nothing to be done, when he sat in the White
uz: Ba'zan hech narsa qilinmaydigan, oq rangda o'tirgan paytlar ham bo'lardi.

en: House silent and motionless, a grim monument of resolve; times when he relaxed his mind by jesting and broad anecdotes.
uz: Uy jim va harakatsiz, qat'iyatning xira yodgorligi; u hazillash va keng hazillar bilan ongini bo'shashtirgan paytlar.

en: He saw the Union triumphant.
uz: U Ittifoqni g'alaba qozonganini ko'rdi.

en: He entered Richmond the day after its sur- render, and heard of Lee’s capitulation.
uz: U Richmondga sur- renderdan keyingi kuni kirdi va Lining taslim bo'lganini eshitdi.

en: He returned to Washington, and on April 11th made his last public address.
uz: U Vashingtonga qaytib keldi va 11-aprel kuni oxirgi marta ommaviy nutq so'zladi.

en: His theme was reconciliation and the reconstruction of loyal government in the defeated states.
uz: Uning mavzusi yarashuv va mag'lubiyatga uchragan davlatlarda sodiq hukumatni qayta tiklash edi.

en: On the evening of April 14th he went to Ford’s theatre in Washington, and as he sat looking at the stage, he was shot in the back of the head and killed by an actor named Booth who had some sort of grievance against him, and who had crept into the box unobserved.
uz: 14-aprel oqshomida u Vashingtondagi Ford teatriga bordi va sahnaga qarab o'tirganida, uning boshining orqa tomoniga o'q uzildi va unga nisbatan qandaydir shikoyati bo'lgan va kuzatib bo'lmaganda qutiga kirib ketgan aktyor Bout tomonidan o'ldirildi.

en: But Lincoln’s work was done; the Union was saved.
uz: Lekin Linkolnning ishi tugadi; Ittifoq qutqarildi.

en: At the beginning of the war there was no railway to the Paciﬁc coast; af- ter it the railways spread like a swiftly growing plant until now they have clutched and held and woven all the vast territory of the United States into one indissoluble mental and material unity—the greatest real community— until the common folk of China have learnt to read—in the world.
uz: Urush boshida Tinch okeani qirg'og'iga temir yo'l yo'q edi; shundan so'ng temir yo'llar tez o'sib borayotgan o'simlik kabi tarqaldi, shu paytgacha ular Qo'shma Shtatlarning butun ulkan hududini bir bo'lmas ruhiy va moddiy birlikga  Xitoyning oddiy xalqi o'qishni o'rganmaguncha  to'qishdi va to'qishdi.

en: LXI THE RISE OF GERMANY TO PREDOMINANCE IN EUROPE WE have told how after the convulsion of the French Revolution and the Napoleonic adventure, Europe settled down again for a time to an insecure peace and a sort of modernized revival of the political conditions of ﬁfty years before.
uz: Germaniya Yevropada hukmronlikka ko'tarilishi Biz Fransiya inqilobi va Napoleon sarguzashtidan so'ng, Yevropa bir muddatga yana beqaror tinchlikka va ellik yil oldingi siyosiy sharoitlarning zamonaviy tiklanishiga joylashgani haqida aytib berdik.

en: Until the middle of the century the new facilities in the han- dling of steel and the railway and steamship produced no marked political consequences.
uz: Asr o'rtalarigacha po'latni qayta ishlash, temir yo'l va bug' kemalari sohasidagi yangi inshootlar hech qanday sezilarli siyosiy oqibatlarga olib kelmadi.

en: But the social tension due to the development of urban in- dustrialism grew.
uz: Lekin shahar sanoatining rivojlanishi natijasida ijtimoiy taranglik o'sdi.

en: France remained a conspicuously uneasy country.
uz: Fransiya sezilarli darajada noqulay mamlakat bo'lib qoldi.

en: The revolution of 1830 was followed by another in 1848.
uz: 1830-yilgi inqilobdan keyin 1848-yilda yana bir inqilob keldi.

en: Then Napoleon III, a nephew of Napoleon Bonaparte, became ﬁrst President, and then (in 1852) Emperor.
uz: Keyin Napoleon III, Napoleon Bonapartning jiyani, birinchi Prezident, keyin esa (1852 yilda) Imperator bo'ldi.

en: He set about rebuilding Paris, and changed it from a picturesque seven- teenth century insanitary city into the spacious Latinized city of marble it is to-day.
uz: U Parijni qayta qurishga kirishdi va uni o'n yettinchi asrning go'zal sanatoriy shahridan bugungi kunda bo'lgan keng lotinlashtirilgan marmar shahriga o'zgartirdi.

en: He set about rebuilding France, and made it into a brilliant-looking modernized imperialism.
uz: U Fransiyani qayta qurishga kirishdi va uni ajoyib ko'rinishga ega modernizatsiyalashgan imperializmga aylantirdi.

en: He displayed a disposition to revive that competi- tiveness of the Great Powers which had kept Europe busy with futile wars during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
uz: U o'n yettinchi va o'n sakkizinchi asrlarda Yevropani behuda urushlar bilan band qilgan Buyuk Kuchlarning o'sha raqobatini jonlantirishga moyil edi.

en: The Tsar Nicholas I of Russia (1825- 1856) was also becoming aggressive and pressing southward upon the Turkish Empire with his eyes on Constantinople.
uz: Rossiya podshosi Nikolay I (1825- 1856) ham Konstantinopolga ko'zlari bilan Turkiya imperiyasiga janubga qarab tajovuzkor bo'lib borayotgan edi.

en: After the turn of the century Europe broke out into a fresh cycle of wars.
uz: Asr boshidan so'ng Yevropa yangi urushlar davriga kirdi.

en: They were chieﬂy “balance-of- power” and ascendancy wars.
uz: Ular asosan kuch muvozanati va ustunlik urushlari edi.

en: England, France and Sardinia assailed Russia in the Crimean war in defence of Tur- key; Prussia (with Italy as an ally) and Austria fought for the leadership of
uz: Angliya, Fransiya va Sardiniya Tur-kiyni himoya qilish uchun Qrim urushida Rossiyaga hujum qildi; Prussiya (Italy ittifoqchi sifatida) va Avstriya yetakchilik uchun kurashdi.

en: Germany, France liberated North Italy from Austria at the price of Savoy, and Italy gradually uniﬁed itself into one kingdom.
uz: Germaniya, Fransiya Shimoliy Italiyani Avstriyadan Savoy narxi evaziga ozod qildi va Italiya asta-sekin o'zini bir qirollikka birlashtirdi.

en: Then Napoleon III was so ill advised as to attempt adventures in Mexico, during the American Civil War; he set up an Emperor Maximilian there and abandoned him hastily to his fate—he was shot by the Mexicans—when the victorious Federal Gov- ernment showed its teeth.
uz: Keyin Napoleon IIIga Amerika fuqarolar urushi davrida Meksikada sarguzashtlarga urinish shunchalik yomon maslahat berilgan edi; u yerda imperator Maksimilianni o'rnatdi va uni shoshilinch ravishda o'z taqdiriga tashlab ketdi  u meksikaliklar tomonidan otib o'ldirildi  g'alaba qozongan Federal hukumat o'z tishlarini ko'rsatganda.

en: In 1870 came a long-pending struggle for predominance in Europe be- tween France and Prussia.
uz: 1870-yilda Fransiya va Prussiya oʻrtasida Yevropada ustunlik uchun uzoq davom etgan kurash boshlandi.

en: Prussia had long foreseen and prepared for this struggle, and France was rotten with ﬁnancial corruption.
uz: Prussiya bu kurashni allaqachon oldindan ko'rgan va tayyorlagan edi, Fransiya esa moliyaviy korrupsiya bilan chirigan edi.

en: Her defeat was swift and dramatic.
uz: Uning mag'lubiyati tez va dramatik edi.

en: The Germans invaded France in August, one great French army under the Emperor capitulated at Sedan in September, another
uz: Nemislar avgust oyida Fransiyaga bostirib kirishdi, imperator boshchiligidagi bir buyuk fransuz armiyasi sentabr oyida sedan shahrida taslim bo'ldi, yana biri...

en: surrendered in October at Metz, and in January 1871, Paris, after a siege and bombardment, fell into German hands.
uz: Oktyabr oyida Metzda taslim bo'ldi va 1871-yil yanvar oyida Parij qamal va bombardimonlardan so'ng nemis qo'liga tushdi.

en: Peace was signed at Frankfort surrendering the provinces of Alsace and Lorraine to the Germans.
uz: Frankfortda Alzas va Lotreyn viloyatlarini nemislarga topshirib, tinchlik imzolandi.

en: Ger- many, excluding Austria, was uniﬁed as an empire, and the King of Prussia was added to the galaxy of European Cæsars, as the German Emperor.
uz: Germaniya, Avstriyani istisno qilgan holda, imperiya sifatida birlashtirildi va Prussiya qiroli Yevropa Sezarlar galaktikasiga Germaniya imperatori sifatida qo'shildi.

en: For the next forty-three years Germany was the leading power upon the European continent.
uz: Keyingi qirq uch yil davomida Germaniya Yevropa qit'asida yetakchi davlat edi.

en: There was a Russo-Turkish war in 1877-8, but there- after, except for certain readjustments in the Balkans, European frontiers remained uneasily stable for thirty years.
uz: 1877-yilda Rus-Turk urushi bo'lib o'tdi, lekin undan keyin, Bolqonda ayrim o'zgartirishlar bundan mustasno, Yevropa chegaralari o'ttiz yil davomida noqulay barqaror bo'lib qoldi.

en: LXII THE NEW OVERSEAS EMPIRES OF STEAMSHIP AND RAILWAY The end of the eighteenth century was a period of disrupting empires and disillusioned expansionists.
uz: LXII YANGI OVERSEAS EMPIRYAS OF STEAMSHIP AND RAILWAY XVIII asr oxiri imperiyalarni buzish va ekspansionistlarni umidsizlikka soladigan davr edi.

en: The long and tedious journey between Britain and Spain and their colonies in America prevented any really free coming and going between the home land and the daughter lands, and so the colonies separated into new and distinct communities, with distinctive ideas and interests and even modes of speech.
uz: Britaniya va Ispaniya o'rtasidagi uzoq va zerikarli sayohat va ularning Amerikadagi mustamlakalari o'z vatanlari va qizlar yerlari o'rtasida hech qanday erkin kelish va ketishga to'sqinlik qildi, shuning uchun mustamlakalar o'ziga xos g'oyalar, qiziqishlar va hatto nutq usullariga ega bo'lgan yangi va alohida jamoalarga ajralib ketdi.

en: As they grew they strained more and more at the feeble and uncertain link of shipping that had joined them.
uz: Ular o'sgan sari, ularga qo'shilgan yuk tashishning zaif va noaniq bo'g'iniga tobora kuchliroq edilar.

en: Weak trading-posts in the wilderness, like those of France in Canada, or trading establishments in great alien communities, like those of Britain in India, might well cling for bare existence to the nation which gave them support and a reason for their existence.
uz: Sahroda zaif savdo ustunlari, Fransiyadagi Kanada kabi, yoki Hindistondagi Buyuk Britaniya kabi yirik begona jamiyatlardagi savdo muassasalari, ularga tayanch va mavjudligining sababi bo'lgan millatga yalang'och hayotga yopishib olishlari mumkin.

en: That much and no more seemed to many thinkers in the early part of the nineteenth century to be the limit set to overseas rule.
uz: XIX asrning boshlarida ko'plab mutafakkirlarga bu ko'p narsa chet el hukmronligi uchun belgilangan cheklovdek tuyuldi.

en: In 1820 the sketchy great European “empires” outside of Europe that had ﬁgured so bravely in the maps of the middle eighteenth century, had shrunken to very small dimensions.
uz: 1820-yilda Yevropadan tashqaridagi o'rta XVIII asr xaritalarida shunchalik jasorat bilan namoyon bo'lgan sayoz buyuk Yevropa imperiyalari juda kichik o'lchamlarga qisqargan edi.

en: Only the Russian sprawled as large as ever across Asia.
uz: Faqat ruslar Osiyo bo'ylab har qachongidek keng tarqaldi.

en: The British Empire in 1815 consisted of the thinly populated coastal river and lake regions of Canada, and a great hinterland of wilderness in which the only settlements as yet were the fur-trading stations of the Hudson Bay Company, about a third of the Indian peninsula, under the rule of the East India Company, the coast districts of the Cape of Good Hope inhabited by blacks and rebellious-spirited Dutch settlers; a few trading stations on the coast of West Africa, the rock of Gibraltar, the island of Malta, Jamaica, a
uz: 1815-yilda Britaniya imperiyasi Kanadaning kam aholi yashaydigan qirg'oq daryo va ko'l hududlaridan, shuningdek, G'arbiy Afrika qirg'og'idagi bir nechta savdo stansiyalari, Gibraltar qoyasi, Sharqiy Hindiston kompaniyasi hukmronligi ostida bo'lgan Hindiston yarim orolining taxminan uchdan bir qismi, Yaxshi Umid buruni sohil tumanlaridan iborat edi; G'arbiy Afrika qirg'og'idagi bir nechta savdo stansiyalari, Gibraltar qoyasi, Malta oroli, Yamayka.

en: few minor slave-labour possessions in the West Indies, British Guiana in South America, and, on the other side of the world, two dumps for convicts at Botany Bay in Australia and in Tasmania.
uz: G'arbiy Hindiston, Janubiy Amerikadagi Britaniya Gviyanasidagi kichik qul-mehnat mulklari va dunyoning narigi tomonida, Avstraliyadagi Botany Bay va Tasmaniyadagi mahbuslar uchun ikkita quti.

en: Spain retained Cuba and a few settlements in the Philippine Islands.
uz: Ispaniya Kubani va Filippin orollarida joylashgan bir nechta aholi punktlarini saqlab qoldi.

en: Portugal had in Africa some vestiges of her ancient claims.
uz: Portugaliya Afrikada o'zining qadimiy da'volarining ba'zi qoldiqlariga ega edi.

en: Holland had various islands and possessions in the East Indies and Dutch Guiana, and Denmark an island or so in the West In- dies.
uz: Gollandiya Sharqiy Hindiston va Gollandiya Gvineyasida turli orollar va mulklarga ega edi, Daniya esa G'arbiy In- diesda taxminan bir orol edi.

en: France had one or two West Indian islands and French Guiana.
uz: Fransiyada bir-ikki G'arbiy Hind orollari va Fransuz Gviyanasi bor edi.

en: This seemed to be as much as the European powers needed, or were likely to ac- quire of the rest of the world.
uz: Bu Yevropa davlatlariga kerak bo'lgancha ko'rinardi, yoki dunyoning qolgan qismini ham talab qilishardi.

en: Only the East India Company showed any spirit of expansion.
uz: Faqatgina Sharqiy Hindiston kompaniyasi kengayish ruhini ko'rsatdi.

en: While Europe was busy with the Napoleonic wars the East India Compa- ny, under a succession of Governors-General, was playing much the same role in India that had been played before by Turkoman and such-like in- vaders from the north.
uz: Yevropa Napoleon urushlari bilan band bo'lgan paytda, Sharqiy Hindiston Kompaniyasi, bosh gubernatorlar ketma-ketligi ostida, Hindistonda avvalroq Turkoman va shimoldan kelgan shunga o'xshash o'rtoqlar o'ynagan rolni o'ynamoqda edi.

en: And after the peace of Vienna it went on, levying its revenues, making wars, sending ambassadors to Asiatic powers, a quasi- independent state, however, with a marked disposition to send wealth westward.
uz: Va Vena tinchligidan so'ng u o'z daromadlarini olib, urushlar olib, Osiyo davlatlariga elchilar yuborib, g'arbga boylik yuborish xususiyatiga ega bo'lgan, ammo deyarli mustaqil davlat edi.

en: We cannot tell here in any detail how the British Company made its way to supremacy sometimes as the ally of this power, sometimes as that, and ﬁnally as the conqueror of all.
uz: Biz bu yerda Britaniya Kompaniyasining ba'zan shu kuchning ittifoqchisi, ba'zan esa u, va nihoyat hammaning zabtkori sifatida qanday qilib ustunlikka erishganini hech qanday tafsilot bilan ayta olmaymiz.

en: Its power spread to Assam, Sind, Oudh.
uz: Uning qudrati Assam, Sind, Oudhga tarqaldi.

en: The map of India began to take on the outlines familiar to the English schoolboy of to-day, a patchwork of native states embraced and held together by the great provinces under direct British rule.
uz: Hindiston xaritasi bugungi ingliz maktab o'quvchisiga tanish bo'lgan konturlarga ega bo'la boshladi, bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Britaniya hukmronligi ostidagi buyuk viloyatlar tomonidan qabul qilingan va birga ushlab turilgan mahalliy davlatlarning parchasi edi.

en: In 1859, following upon a serious mutiny of the native troops in India, this empire of the East India Company was annexed to the British Crown.
uz: 1859-yilda Hindistonda mahalliy qoshinlarning jiddiy isyonidan song, Sharqiy Hindiston kompaniyasining ushbu imperiyasi Britaniya tojasiga qoshib yuborildi.

en: By an Act entitled An Act for the Better Government of India, the Governor- General became a Viceroy representing the Sovereign, and the place of the Company was taken by a Secretary of State for India responsible to the British Parliament.
uz: Hindistonning Yaxshiroq Hukumati Qonuni deb nomlangan qonun bilan general-gubernator Suverenni vakil qiluvchi Vitse-prezidentga aylandi va Kompaniyaning o'rnini Britaniya Parlamentiga mas'ul Hindiston Davlat kotibi egalladi.

en: In 1877, Lord Beaconsﬁeld, to complete the work, caused Queen Victoria to be proclaimed Empress of India.
uz: 1877-yilda Lord Beaconsfield ishni yakunlash uchun qirolicha Viktoriyani Hindiston imperatori deb e'lon qilishga majbur qildi.

en: Upon these extraordinary lines India and Britain are linked at the present time.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda Hindiston va Britaniya ushbu g'ayrioddiy chiziqlar orqali bog'langan.

en: India is still the empire of the Great Mogul, but the Great Mogul has been replaced by the “crowned republic” of Great Britain.
uz: Hindiston hali ham Buyuk Mogul imperiyasi, lekin Buyuk Mogul Buyuk Britaniyaning  toj kiygan respublikasi bilan almashtirildi.

en: India is an autoc- racy without an autocrat.
uz: Hindiston avtokratsiz avtokrat irqdir.

en: Its rule combines the disadvantage of absolute monarchy with the impersonality and irresponsibility of democratic ofﬁcial-
uz: Uning qoidasi mutlaq monarxiyaning kamchiligini demokratik amaldorning shaxsiyatsizligi va mas'uliyatsizligi bilan birlashtiradi.

en: The Indian with a complaint to make has no visible monarch to go to; his Emperor is a golden symbol; he must circulate pamphlets in England or inspire a question in the British House of Commons.
uz: Hindning shikoyati bor bo'lsa, unga boradigan ko'rinadigan monarx yo'q; uning imperatori oltin ramzdir; u Angliyada broshyuralar tarqatishi yoki Britaniya Umumiy palatasida savolni ilhomlantirishi kerak.

en: The more occupied Parliament is with British affairs, the less attention India will receive, and the more she will be at the mercy of her small group of higher ofﬁcials.
uz: Parlament Britaniya ishlari bilan qanchalik band bo'lsa, Hindiston shunchalik kam e'tiborga ega bo'ladi va u o'zining kichik yuqori lavozimli amaldorlar guruhi rahmatiga shunchalik ko'p qo'yiladi.

en: RAILWAY BRIDGE OVER THE GORGE, VICTORIA FALLS, OF THE ZAMBESI, SOUTHERN RHODESIA  Photo: British South African Co.
uz: RAYON POYDONI GORGE, VICTORIA FALLS, ZAMBESI, Janubiy RODESIA ustidagi ko'prik. Surat: British South African Co.

en: Apart from India, there was no great expansion of any European Empire until the railways and the steamships were in effective action.
uz: Hindistondan tashqari, temir yo'llar va bug' kemalari samarali ishga tushmaguncha, hech qanday Yevropa imperiyasining katta kengayishi bo'lmagan.

en: A consider- able school of political thinkers in Britain was disposed to regard overseas possessions as a source of weakness to the kingdom.
uz: Britaniyadagi siyosiy mutafakkirlarning mulohazakor maktabi chet eldagi mulkni qirollik uchun zaiflik manbai sifatida ko'rishga moyil edi.

en: The Australian settle- ments developed slowly until in 1842 the discovery of valuable copper mines, and in 1851 of gold, gave them a new importance.
uz: Avstraliya aholi punktlari 1842-yilda qimmatbaho mis konlari topilishigacha sekin rivojlandi, 1851-yilda esa oltin ularga yangi ahamiyat berdi.

en: Improvements in transport were also making Australian wool an increasingly marketable commodity in Europe.
uz: Transport sohasidagi yaxshilanishlar Avstraliya junini Yevropada tobora bozorga chiqarilayotgan tovarga aylantirayotgan edi.

en: Canada, too, was not remarkably progressive until 1849; it was troubled by dissensions between its French and British inhabi- tants, there were several serious revolts, and it was only in 1867 that a new constitution creating a Federal Dominion of Canada relieved its internal strains.
uz: Kanada ham 1849-yilgacha sezilarli darajada taraqqiyparvar emas edi; u fransuz va ingliz aralashmalari o'rtasidagi kelishmovchiliklar bilan bezovta bo'lgan, bir nechta jiddiy isyonlar sodir bo'lgan va faqat 1867-yilda Kanada Federal Hukmronligini yaratadigan yangi konstitutsiya uning ichki zo'riqishlarini yengillashtirgan edi.

en: It was the railway that altered the Canadian outlook.
uz: Aynan temir yo'l Kanadaning nuqtai nazarini o'zgartirdi.

en: It enabled Canada, just as it enabled the United States, to expand westward, to market its corn and other produce in Europe, and in spite of its swift and extensive growth, to remain in language and sympathy and interests one community.
uz: Bu Kanadaga, xuddi Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlariga imkon berganidek, g'arbga kengayishga, Yevropada makkajo'xori va boshqa mahsulotlarini sotishga va tez va keng o'sishiga qaramay, bir jamiyatning tili, hamdardligi va manfaatlarini saqlab qolishga imkon berdi.

en: The railway, the steamship and the telegraph cable were indeed changing all the conditions of colonial development.
uz: Temir yo'l, bug' kemasi va telegraf kabeli haqiqatan ham mustamlakachilik rivojlanishining barcha sharoitlarini o'zgartirardi.

en: Before 1840, English settlements had already begun in New Zealand, and a New Zealand Land Company had been formed to exploit the possibilities of the island.
uz: 1840-yilgacha Yangi Zelandiyada ingliz aholi punktlari allaqachon boshlangan edi va orol imkoniyatlaridan foydalanish uchun Yangi Zelandiya Yer Kompaniyasi tashkil etilgan edi.

en: In 1840 New Zealand also was added to the colonial posses- sions of the British Crown.
uz: 1840-yilda Yangi Zelandiya ham Britaniya tojining mustamlakachilik mulkiga qo'shildi.

en: Canada, as we have noted, was the ﬁrst of the British possessions to re- spond richly to the new economic possibilities that the new methods of transport were opening.
uz: Kanada, ta'kidlaganimizdek, Britaniya mulklaridan birinchi bo'lib yangi transport usullari ochayotgan yangi iqtisodiy imkoniyatlarga boy javob berdi.

en: Presently the republics of South America, and par- ticularly the Argentine Republic, began to feel in their cattle trade and cof- fee growing the increased nearness of the European market.
