uz: Hozirgi vaqtda Janubiy Amerika respublikalari, xususan Argentina Respublikasi, o'zlarining chorvachilik savdosi va tovarlar to'lovida Yevropa bozoriga yaqinlik kuchayganini his qila boshladi.

en: Hitherto the chief commodities that had attracted the European powers into unsettled
uz: Hozirgacha Yevropa davlatlarini o'ziga jalb qilgan asosiy tovarlar

en: and barbaric regions had been gold or other metals, spices, ivory, or slaves.
uz: va vahshiy hududlar oltin yoki boshqa metallar, ziravorlar, fil suyagi yoki qullar bo'lgan edi.

en: But in the latter quarter of the nineteenth century the increase of the Eu- ropean populations was obliging their governments to look abroad for sta- ple foods; and the growth of scientiﬁc industrialism was creating a demand for new raw materials, fats and greases of every kind, rubber, and other hitherto disregarded substances.
uz: Ammo XIX asrning oxirgi choragida Yevropa aholisining ko'payishi ularning hukumatlarini xorijga oziq-ovqat izlashga majbur qildi; va ilmiy sanoatchilikning o'sishi yangi xom ashyo, har qanday turdagi yog'lar va yog'lar, rezina va boshqa shu paytgacha e'tiborga olinmagan moddalarga talab yaratdi.

en: It was plain that Great Britain and Holland and Portugal were reaping a great and growing commercial advantage from their very considerable control of tropical and sub-tropical products.
uz: Buyuk Britaniya, Gollandiya va Portugaliya tropik va subtropik mahsulotlar ustidan juda katta nazoratidan katta va o'sib borayotgan tijorat afzalligini olishi aniq edi.

en: After 1871 Germany, and presently France and later Italy, began to look for unan- nexed raw-material areas, or for Oriental countries capable of proﬁtable modernization.
uz: 1871-yildan keyin Germaniya, hozirda Fransiya va keyinroq Italiya, bogʻlanmagan xomashyo maydonlarini yoki foydali modernizatsiyaga qodir Sharq davlatlarini qidirishni boshladi.

en: So began a fresh scramble all over the world, except in the American re- gion where the Monroe Doctrine now barred such adventures, for politically unprotected lands.
uz: Shunday qilib, butun dunyo bo'ylab yangi tartibsizlik boshlandi, faqatgina Amerika mintaqasida, Monroe doktrinasi hozirda bunday sarguzashtlarni, siyosiy jihatdan himoyasiz yerlarni taqiqlagan.

en: Close to Europe was the continent of Africa, full of vaguely known pos- sibilities.
uz: Yevropaga yaqin Afrika qit'asi edi, noaniq ma'lum imkoniyatlar bilan to'la edi.

en: In 1850 it was a continent of black mystery; only Egypt and the coast were known.
uz: 1850-yilda u qora sirli qit'a edi; faqat Misr va qirg'oq ma'lum edi.

en: Here we have no space to tell the amazing story of the explorers and adventurers who ﬁrst pierced the African darkness, and of the political agents, administrators, traders, settlers and scientiﬁc men who fol- lowed in their track.
uz: Bu yerda bizda Afrika zulmatini birinchi bo'lib yorib o'tgan kashfiyotchilar va sarguzashtchilarning ajoyib hikoyasini, shuningdek, o'z yo'lidan ketgan siyosiy agentlar, administratorlar, savdogarlar, ko'chmanchilar va ilmiy odamlarning ajoyib hikoyasini aytib berish uchun joy yo'q.

en: Wonderful races of men like the pygmies, strange beasts like the okapi, marvellous fruits and ﬂowers and insects, terrible dis- eases, astounding scenery of forest and mountain, enormous inland seas and gigantic rivers and cascades were revealed; a whole new world.
uz: Pigmeylar kabi ajoyib irqlardagi odamlar, okapi kabi g'alati hayvonlar, ajoyib mevalar, gullar va hasharotlar, dahshatli g'alayonlar, o'rmon va tog'larning hayratlanarli manzarasi, ulkan ichki dengizlar, ulkan daryolar va kaskadlar kashf etildi; butunlay yangi dunyo.

en: Even re- mains (at Zimbabwe) of some unrecorded and vanished civilization, the southward enterprise of an early people, were discovered.
uz: Hatto Zimbabvedagi ba'zi yozib olinmagan va yo'qolgan sivilizatsiyalarning qayta tiklanishi ham topildi, bu erta xalqning janubiy korxonasi edi.

en: Into this new world came the Europeans, and found the riﬂe already there in the hands of the Arab slave-traders, and negro life in disorder.
uz: Bu yangi dunyoga yevropaliklar kelishdi va miltiqni allaqachon arab qul savdogarlari qo'lida va tartibsizlikdagi qora tanlilarning hayotini topishdi.

en: By 1900, in half a century, all Africa was mapped, explored, estimated and divided between the European powers.
uz: 1900-yilga kelib, yarim asr ichida butun Afrika Yevropa davlatlari o'rtasida xaritalab chiqildi, o'rganildi, baholandi va bo'lindi.

en: Little heed was given to the welfare of the natives in this scramble.
uz: Bu tartibsizlikda mahalliy aholining farovonligiga unchalik e'tibor berilmadi.

en: The Arab slaver was indeed curbed rather than expelled, but the greed for rubber, which was a wild product col- lected under compulsion by the natives in the Belgian Congo, a greed exac- erbated by the clash of inexperienced European administrators with the na- tive population, led to horrible atrocities.
uz: Arab qullari haqiqatda quvilish o'rniga cheklangan edi, lekin rezinaga bo'lgan hirs, Belgiya Kongo tub aholisi tomonidan majburiy ravishda yig'ilgan yovvoyi mahsulot edi, tajribasiz yevropalik ma'murlarning na-tiv aholi bilan to'qnashuvi natijasida qo'zg'atilgan hirs dahshatli vahshiyliklarga olib keldi.

en: No European power has perfectly clean hands in this matter.
uz: Hech qaysi Yevropa davlatining bu masalada qo'li to'liq toza emas.

en: We cannot tell here in any detail how Great Britain got possession of Egypt in 1883 and remained there in spite of the fact that Egypt was techni- cally a part of the Turkish Empire, nor how nearly this scramble led to war between France and Great Britain in 1898, when a certain Colonel Marc- hand, crossing Central Africa from the west coast, tried at Fashoda to seize the Upper Nile.
uz: Biz bu yerda Buyuk Britaniya 1883-yilda Misrni qanday egallaganini va Misr texnik jihatdan Turkiya imperiyasining bir qismi bo'lishiga qaramay u yerda qolganini batafsil ayta olmaymiz, shuningdek, bu notinchlik 1898-yilda Fransiya va Buyuk Britaniya o'rtasida urushga olib kelishiga qanchalik yaqin bo'lganini ham aytolmaymiz, o'shanda bir polkovnik Mark G'arbiy Afrikadan o'tib, Fashoda shahrida Yuqori Nilni egallashga urinib ko'rgan edi.

en: Nor can we tell how the British Government ﬁrst let the Boers, or Dutch settlers, of the Orange River district and the Transvaal set up independent republics in the inland parts of South Africa, and then repented and annexed the Transvaal Republic in 1877; nor how the Transvaal Boers fought for freedom and won it after the battle of Majuba Hill (1881).
uz: Biz Britaniya hukumati avval Orange River tumani va Transvaaldan boerlar yoki golland ko'chmanchilarini Janubiy Afrikaning ichki qismlarida mustaqil respublikalar tashkil etishga qanday ruxsat berganini, keyin 1877 yilda tavba qilib Transvaal Respublikasini qo'shib olganini ham ayta olmaymiz; shuningdek, Transvaal boerlari ozodlik uchun kurashgan va Majuba tepaligi jangidan keyin uni qanday qo'lga kiritganini ham ayta olmaymiz (1881).

en: Majuba Hill was made to rankle in the memory of the English people by a persistent press campaign.
uz: Majuba Hill doimiy matbuot kampaniyasi orqali ingliz xalqining xotirasida o'rnashib turdi.

en: A war with both republics broke out in 1899, a three years’ war
uz: 1899-yilda ikkala respublika bilan urush boshlandi, uch yillik urush.

en: enormously costly to the British people, which ended at last in the surrender of the two republics.
uz: Britaniya xalqi uchun juda qimmatga tushdi, bu oxir-oqibatda ikki respublikani taslim bo'lish bilan yakunlandi.

en: Their period of subjugation was a brief one.
uz: Ularning bo'ysundirish davri qisqa davr edi.

en: In 1907, after the downfall of the imperialist government which had conquered them, the Liberals took the South African problem in hand, and these former republics became free and fairly willing associates with Cape Colony and Natal in a Confederation of all the states of South Africa as one self- governing republic under the British Crown.
uz: 1907-yilda, ularni zabt etgan imperialist hukumatning qulasidan so'ng, liberallar Janubiy Afrika muammosini o'z qo'llariga olishdi va bu sobiq respublikalar Buyuk Britaniya tojidagi yagona mustaqil respublika sifatida Janubiy Afrikaning barcha shtatlari Konfederatsiyasida Keyp Koloniya va Natal bilan erkin va ancha ixtiyoriy sherik bo'lishdi.

en: In a quarter of a century the partition of Africa was completed.
uz: Chorak asr ichida Afrikaning bo'linishi yakunlandi.

en: There re- mained unannexed three comparatively small countries: Liberia, a settle- ment of liberated negro slaves on the west coast; Morocco, under a Moslem Sultan; and Abyssinia, a barbaric country, with an ancient and peculiar form of Christianity, which had successfully maintained its independence against Italy at the battle of Adowa in 1896.
uz: U yerda qo'shilmagan uchta nisbatan kichik davlat qayta asoslandi: G'arbiy sohilda ozod qilingan qora qullarning joylashuvi bo'lgan Liberiya; musulmon sulton ostida Marokash; va 1896-yilda Adowa jangida Italiyaga qarshi mustaqilligini muvaffaqiyatli saqlab qolgan xristianlikning qadimiy va o'ziga xos shakliga ega bo'lgan vahshiy Abyssinia.

en: LXIII EUROPEAN AGGRESSION IN ASIA AND THE RISE OF JAPAN It is difﬁcult to believe that any large number of people really accepted this headlong painting of the map of Africa in European colours as a permanent new settlement of the worlds affairs, but it is the duty of the historian to record that it was so accepted.
uz: Osiyoda III Yevropa AGRESSIYASI VA YAPONNING YUKLANISHI Afrika xaritasining Yevropa ranglaridagi bu boshboshdoq rasmini dunyo ishlarining doimiy yangi hal bo'lishi sifatida qabul qilgan odamlarning ko'pchiligiga ishonish qiyin, lekin bu qabul qilinganini qayd etish tarixchining burchidir.

en: There was but a shallow historical back- ground to the European mind in the nineteenth century, and no habit of pen- etrating criticism.
uz: XIX asrda Yevropa tafakkuriga sayoz tarixiy asos bor edi, shuningdek, qalamga o'xshash tanqid qilish odati yo'q edi.

en: The quite temporary advantages that the mechanical revo- lution in the west had given the Europeans over the rest of the old world were regarded by people, blankly ignorant of such events as the great Mon- gol conquests, as evidences of a permanent and assured European leader- ship of mankind.
uz: G'arbdagi mexanik o'zgarish yevropaliklarga eski dunyoning qolgan qismidan ko'ra bergan vaqtinchalik afzalliklarni odamlar, buyuk Mon-gol g'alabalari kabi voqealarni beparvo bilmaganlar, insoniyatning doimiy va ishonchli Yevropa yetakchisi ekanligining dalillari sifatida ko'rishdi.

en: They had no sense of the transferability of science and its fruits.
uz: Ularda fan va uning mevalarining o'tkazuvchanligi haqida hech qanday his yo'q edi.

en: They did not realize that Chinamen and Indians could carry on the work of research as ably as Frenchmen or Englishmen.
uz: Ular xitoyliklar va hindlar fransuzlar yoki inglizlar kabi mohirona tadqiqot ishlarini olib borishlari mumkinligini anglamadilar.

en: They believed that there was some innate intellectual drive in the west, and some innate indo- lence and conservatism in the east, that assured the Europeans a world pre- dominance for ever.
uz: Ular g'arbda qandaydir tug'ma intellektual intilish, sharqda esa ba'zi tug'ma intilish va konservativlik borligiga ishonishardi, bu esa yevropaliklarga abadiy jahon hukmronligini kafolatlardi.

en: The consequence of this infatuation was that the various European for- eign ofﬁces set themselves not merely to scramble with the British for the savage and undeveloped regions of the world’s surface, but also to carve up the populous and civilized countries of Asia as though these people also were no more than raw material for exploitation.
uz: Bu ishtiyoqning oqibati shundan iborat ediki, turli Yevropa tashqi ishlar idoralari nafaqat inglizlar bilan dunyoning yovvoyi va rivojlanmagan hududlari uchun kurashishga, balki Osiyoning gavjum va madaniy mamlakatlarini ham xuddi bu odamlar ham ekspluatatsiya uchun xom ashyo bo'lgandek bo'lishga qaror qilishdi.

en: The inwardly precarious but outwardly splendid imperialism of the British ruling class in India, and the extensive and proﬁtable possessions of the Dutch in the East Indies,
uz: Hindistonda Britaniya hukmron sinfining ichki jihatdan beqaror, tashqi tomondan esa ajoyib imperializmi va Gollandiyaning Sharqiy Hindistondagi keng va foydali boyliklari.

en: ﬁlled the rival Great Powers with dreams of similar glories in Persia, in the disintegrating Ottoman Empire, and in Further India, China and Japan.
uz: Raqib Buyuk Kuchlarni Forsda, parchalanib borayotgan Usmonli imperiyasida, shuningdek, Hindiston, Xitoy va Yaponiyada ham shunga o'xshash shon-shuhrat orzulari bilan to'ldirdi.

en: In 1898 Germany seized Kiau Chau in China.
uz: 1898-yilda Germaniya Xitoyda Kiau Chauni egallab oldi.

en: Britain responded by seiz- ing Wei-hai-wei, and the next year the Russians took possession of Port Arthur.
uz: Britaniya Vey-xay-veyni bosib olish bilan javob berdi va keyingi yili ruslar Port-Arturni egallab oldi.

en: A ﬂame of hatred for the Europeans swept through China.
uz: Xitoyda yevropaliklarga nisbatan nafrat alangasi tarqaldi.

en: There were massacres of Europeans and Christian converts, and in 1900 an attack upon and siege of the European legations in Pekin.
uz: Yevropaliklar va nasroniylarni qirg'in qilishlar sodir bo'ldi, 1900-yilda Pekindagi Yevropa legatsiyalariga hujum va qamal bo'ldi.

en: A combined force of Europeans made a punitive expedition to Pekin, rescued the legations, and stole an enormous amount of valuable property.
uz: Yevropaliklarning birlashgan kuchlari Pekinga jazochi ekspeditsiyani amalga oshirdi, legatsiyalarni qutqardi va ulkan miqdordagi qimmatbaho mulkni o'g'irladi.

en: The Russians then seized Manchuria, and in 1904, the British invaded Tibet....
uz: Ruslar keyin Manjuriyani bosib olishdi va 1904-yilda Britaniya Tibetga bostirib kirdi....

en: But now a new Power appeared in the struggle of the Great Powers, Japan.
uz: Ammo endi Buyuk Kuchlar, Yaponiyaning kurashida yangi Kuch paydo bo'ldi.

en: Hitherto Japan has played but a small part in this history; her seclud- ed civilization has not contributed very largely to the general shaping of hu- man destinies; she has received much, but she has given little.
uz: Hozirgacha Yaponiya bu tarixda faqat kichik rol o'ynadi; uning ajralgan sivilizatsiyasi inson taqdirlarini umumiy shakllantirishga unchalik katta hissa qo'shmadi; u ko'p narsa oldi, lekin oz narsa berdi.

en: The Japanese proper are of the Mongolian race.
uz: Yaponlarning asl nusxalari moʻgʻul irqiga mansub.

en: Their civilization, their writing and their literary and artistic traditions are derived from the Chinese.
uz: Ularning sivilizatsiyasi, yozuvi va adabiy va badiiy an'analari xitoyliklardan kelib chiqqan.

en: Their history is an interesting and romantic one; they developed a feudal system and a sys- tem of chivalry in the earlier centuries of the Christian era; their attacks upon Korea and China are an Eastern equivalent of the English wars in France.
uz: Ularning tarixi qiziqarli va romantik; ular xristian davrining dastlabki asrlarida feodal tizim va ritsarlik tizimini rivojlantirgan; ularning Koreya va Xitoyga hujumlari Fransiyadagi ingliz urushlarining sharqiy ekvivalentidir.

en: Japan was ﬁrst brought into contact with Europe in the sixteenth century; in 1542 some Portuguese reached it in a Chinese junk, and in 1549 a Jesuit missionary, Francis Xavier, began his teaching there.
uz: Yaponiya birinchi marta Yevropa bilan XVI asrda aloqada bo'lgan; 1542 yilda ba'zi portugallar Xitoy axlatxonasida unga yetib borgan va 1549 yilda u yerda frensis Xavier ismli jezuit missioneri o'z darslarini boshlagan.

en: For a time Japan welcomed European intercourse, and the Christian missionaries made a great number of converts.
uz: Bir vaqtlar Yaponiya Yevropa aloqalarini qabul qildi va nasroniy missionerlar ko'p sonli odamlarni qabul qildilar.

en: A certain William Adams became the most trusted European adviser of the Japanese, and showed them how to build big ships.
uz: Uilyam Adams yaponiyaliklarning eng ishonchli yevropalik maslahatchisi bo'ldi va ularga katta kemalarni qanday qurish kerakligini ko'rsatdi.

en: There were voyages in Japanese-built ships to India and Peru.
uz: Yaponiya qurgan kemalarda Hindiston va Peruga sayohatlar bo'lgan.

en: Then arose complicated quarrels between the Spanish Dominicans, the Por- tuguese Jesuits, and the English and Dutch Protestants, each warning the Japanese against the political designs of the others.
uz: Keyin ispan Dominikanlari, Por-Tuguye Jezuitlari va ingliz va golland protestantlari o'rtasida murakkab janjallar kelib chiqdi, ularning har biri yaponlarni boshqalarning siyosiy loyihalariga qarshi ogohlantirdi.

en: The Jesuits, in a phase of ascendancy, persecuted and insulted the Buddhists with great acrimony.
uz: Yesuaitlar, ustunlik bosqichida, buddistlarni katta achchiqlanish bilan ta'qib qilishdi va haqorat qilishdi.

en: In the end the Japanese came to the conclusion that the Europeans were an intolerable nuisance, and that Catholic Christianity in particular was a mere cloak for the political dreams of the Pope and the Spanish monarchy—al- ready in possession of the Philippine Islands; there was a great persecution of the Christians, and in 1638 Japan was absolutely closed to Europeans, and remained closed for over 200 years.
uz: Oxir-oqibat yaponlar yevropaliklar chidab bo'lmas bezovtalik ekanligi, ayniqsa katolik xristianligi Rim Papasi va Ispaniya monarxiyasining siyosiy orzulari uchun shunchaki niqob ekanligi, Filippin orollariga egalik qilishga tayyor ekanligi, xristianlarga katta ta'qib bo'lgani va 1638 yilda Yaponiya yevropaliklarga mutlaqo yopiq bo'lgani va 200 yildan ortiq vaqt davomida yopiq qolganligi haqida xulosaga kelishdi.

en: During those two centuries the Ja-
uz: O'sha ikki asrda Ja-

en: panese were as completely cut off from the rest of the world as though they lived upon another planet.
uz: Paneselar xuddi boshqa sayyorada yashayotgandek, butun dunyodan butunlay uzilgan edilar.

en: It was forbidden to build any ship larger than a mere coasting boat.
uz: Qirg'oq qayiqidan kattaroq har qanday kemani qurish taqiqlangan edi.

en: No Japanese could go abroad, and no European enter the country.
uz: Hech bir yaponiyalik chet elga chiqa olmasdi, hech bir yevropalik ham mamlakatga kira olmasdi.

en: JAPANESE SOLDIER ON THE EIGHTEENTH CENTURY  (In the Victoria and Albert Museum)
uz: YAPON askari XVIII asrda (Viktoriya va Albert muzeyida)

en: For two centuries Japan remained outside the main current of history.
uz: Ikki asr davomida Yaponiya tarixning asosiy oqimidan tashqarida qoldi.

en: She lived on in a state of picturesque feudalism in which about ﬁve per cent of the population, the samurai, or ﬁghting men, and the nobles and their fami- lies, tyrannized without restraint over the rest of the population.
uz: U go'zal feodalizm davlatida yashadi, unda aholining taxminan besh foizi, samuraylar yoki jangchilar, zodagonlar va ularning oilasi qolgan aholini cheksiz zulm qilgan.

en: Meanwhile the great world outside went on to wider visions and new powers.
uz: Ayni paytda tashqi buyuk dunyo kengroq qarashlar va yangi kuchlarga o'tdi.

en: Strange shipping became more frequent, passing the Japanese headlands; sometimes ships were wrecked and sailors brought ashore.
uz: G'alati yuk tashish tez-tez ko'payib, Yaponiya qirg'og'idan o'tib borardi; ba'zan kemalar halokatga uchragan va dengizchilar qirg'oqqa olib kelingan.

en: Through the Dutch settle- ment in the island of Deshima, their one link with the outer universe, came warnings that Japan was not keeping pace with the power of the Western world.
uz: Gollandlarning Deshima oroliga ko'chib o'tishi orqali, ularning tashqi olam bilan yagona aloqasi, Yaponiya G'arb dunyosining qudratiga mos kelmayotgani haqida ogohlantirishlar keldi.

en: In 1837 a ship sailed into Yedo Bay ﬂying a strange ﬂag of stripes and stars, and carrying some Japanese sailors she had picked up far adrift in the Paciﬁc.
uz: 1837 yilda Yedo qo'ltig'iga g'alati chiziqlar va yulduzlar bayrog'i bilan suzib kirgan kema, o'zi bilan birga Tinch okeanida adashib qolgan ba'zi yapon dengizchilarini olib kirdi.

en: She was driven off by cannon shot.
uz: Uni to'p o'qlari haydab yubordi.

en: This ﬂag presently reap- peared on other ships.
uz: Bu bayroq hozirda boshqa kemalarda ham ko'zga tashlandi.

en: One in 1849 came to demand the liberation of eigh- teen shipwrecked American sailors.
uz: 1849-yilda sakkizta o'smir kemada halokatga uchragan amerikalik dengizchilarning ozod qilinishini talab qilish uchun kelgan.

en: Then in 1853 came four American war- ships under Commodore Perry, and refused to be driven away.
uz: Keyin 1853-yilda Komodor Perri qo'l ostida to'rtta Amerika harbiy kemasi keldi va haydab yuborishdan bosh tortdi.

en: He lay at an- chor in forbidden waters, and sent messages to the two rulers who at that time shared the control of Japan.
uz: U taqiqlangan suvlarda xorda yotdi va o'sha paytda Yaponiyaning nazoratini bo'lishgan ikki hukmdorga xabarlar yubordi.

en: In 1854 he returned with ten ships, amaz- ing ships propelled by steam, and equipped with big guns, and he made pro- posals for trade and intercourse that the Japanese had no power to resist.
uz: 1854-yilda u o'nta kema bilan qaytib keldi, ajoyib kemalar bug' bilan harakatlanardi va katta qurollar bilan jihozlangan edi, va u yaponlarning qarshilik ko'rsatish qobiliyati bo'lmagan savdo va aloqa uchun qo'llanmalarni yaratdi.

en: He landed with a guard of 500 men to sign the treaty.
uz: U shartnomani imzolash uchun 500 kishilik qo'riqchi bilan qo'ndi.

en: Incredulous crowds watched this visitation from the outer world, marching through the streets.
uz: Ishonchsiz olomon bu tashrifni tashqi dunyodan tomosha qilib, ko'chalarda yurishardi.

en: Russia, Holland and Britain followed in the wake of America.
uz: Rossiya, Gollandiya va Britaniya Amerika ortidan ergashdi.

en: A great nobleman whose estates commanded the Straits of Shimonoseki saw ﬁt to ﬁre on foreign vessels, and a bombardment by a ﬂeet of British, French, Dutch and American warships destroyed his batteries and scattered his swordsmen.
uz: Shimonoseki bo'g'ozlariga qo'mondonlik qiladigan buyuk zodagon xorijiy kemalarga o'q uzishni yaxshi ko'rdi va Britaniya, Fransiya, Golland va Amerika harbiy kemalari flotining bombardamenti uning batareyalarini yo'q qildi va qilichbozlarini tarqatib yubordi.

en: Finally an allied squadron (1865), at anchor off Kioto, imposed a ratiﬁcation of the treaties which opened Japan to the world.
uz: Nihoyat, Kioto yaqinida joylashgan ittifoqdosh eskadra (1865) Yaponiyani dunyoga ochgan shartnomalarni ratifikatsiya qilishni majbur qildi.

en: The humiliation of the Japanese by these events was intense.
uz: Bu voqealar tufayli yaponlarning xorlanishi shiddatli edi.

en: With aston- ishing energy and intelligence they set themselves to bring their culture and organization to the level of the European Powers.
uz: Ajoyib energiya va aql bilan ular o'z madaniyati va tashkilotlarini Yevropa davlatlari darajasiga olib chiqishga intildilar.

en: Never in all the history of mankind did a nation make such a stride as Japan then did.
uz: Insoniyat tarixida hech qachon birorta davlat Yaponiya kabi qadam tashlamagan.

en: In 1866 she was a medieval people, a fantastic caricature of the extremest romantic feudal- ism; in 1899 hers was a completely Westernized people, on a level with the most advanced European Powers.
uz: 1866-yilda u o'rta asr xalqi edi, eng romantik feodallikning ajoyib karikaturasi edi; 1899-yilda uning xalqi butunlay g'arblashgan xalq edi, eng ilg'or Yevropa davlatlari bilan teng edi.

en: She completely dispelled the persuasion that Asia was in some irrevocable way hopelessly behind Europe.
uz: U Osiyo qandaydir qaytarib bo'lmas tarzda umidsiz ravishda Yevropadan orqada ekanligi haqidagi ishonchni butunlay yo'qqa chiqardi.

en: She made all European progress seem sluggish by comparison.
uz: U barcha Yevropa taraqqiyotini solishtirganda sekin ko'rsatdi.

en: We cannot tell here in any detail of Japan’s war with China in 1894-95.
uz: Biz bu yerda Yaponiyaning 1894-95 yillardagi Xitoy bilan urushi haqida hech qanday tafsilot bilan ayta olmaymiz.

en: It demonstrated the extent of her Westernization.
uz: Bu uning g'arblashuvining darajasini ko'rsatdi.

en: She had an efﬁcient West- ernized army and a small but sound ﬂeet.
uz: Uning samarali G'arbga moslashtirilgan armiyasi va kichik, ammo sog'lom floti bor edi.

en: But the signiﬁcance of her re- nascence, though it was appreciated by Britain and the United States, who were already treating her as if she were a European state, was not under- stood by the other Great Powers engaged in the pursuit of new Indias in Asia.
uz: Lekin uning qayta tug'ilishining ahamiyati, Britaniya va Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari tomonidan qadrlangan bo'lsa-da, ular unga allaqachon Yevropa davlati kabi munosabatda bo'lishgan bo'lsalar ham, Osiyoda yangi Hindistonlarni izlash bilan shug'ullanuvchi boshqa Buyuk Kuchlar tomonidan ham kamsitilmadi.

en: Russia was pushing down through Manchuria to Korea.
uz: Rossiya Manchuriyadan Koreyaga qarab pastga itar edi.

en: France was already established far to the south in Tonkin and Annam, Germany was prowling hungrily on the look-out for some settlement.
uz: Fransiya allaqachon janubga, Tonkin va Annamda joylashgan edi, Germaniya esa biror bir aholi punktini qidirib och yurardi.

en: The three Powers combined to prevent Japan reaping any fruits from the Chinese war.
uz: Uchta Kuch Yaponiyaning Xitoy urushidan hech qanday meva olishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun birlashdi.

en: She was exhausted by the struggle, and they threatened her with war.
uz: U kurashdan charchagan edi va ular unga urush bilan tahdid qilishdi.

en: A STREET IN TOKIO Japan submitted for a time and gathered her forces.
uz: Tokio Yaponiyasidagi ko'cha bir muddatga taslim bo'ldi va o'z kuchlarini yig'di.

en: Within ten years she was ready for a struggle with Russia, which marks an epoch in the history of Asia, the close of the period of European arrogance.
uz: O'n yil ichida u Rossiya bilan kurashga tayyor edi, bu Osiyo tarixida davrni, Yevropa takabburligi davrining yakunini belgilaydi.

en: The Russian people were, of course, innocent and ignorant of this trouble that was being made for them halfway round the world, and the wiser Russian statesmen were
uz: Rus xalqi, albatta, butun dunyo bo'ylab ular uchun yaratilayotgan bu muammoga begunoh va johil edi, va donoroq rus davlat arboblari...

en: against these foolish thrusts; but a gang of ﬁnancial adventurers, including the Grand Dukes, his cousins, surrounded the Tsar.
uz: Bu ahmoqona turtkilarga qarshi; lekin moliyaviy sarguzashtchilarning guruhi, jumladan Buyuk Gersoglar, uning amakivachchalari podshohni o'rab oldi.

en: They had gambled deeply in the prospective looting of Manchuria and China, and they would suffer no withdrawal.
uz: Ular Manchuriya va Xitoyning istiqbolli talon-torojida chuqur qimor o'ynashgan edi va ular hech qanday chekinishga duch kelmas edilar.

en: So there began a transportation of great armies of Ja- panese soldiers across the sea to Port Arthur and Korea, and the sending of endless trainloads of Russian peasants along the Siberian railway to die in those distant battleﬁelds.
uz: Shunday qilib, Ja-pan askarlarining katta armiyalarini dengiz orqali Port-Artur va Koreyaga tashish va Sibir temir yo'li bo'ylab Rossiya dehqonlarining cheksiz poyezd yuklarini o'sha uzoq jang maydonlarida o'lish uchun yuborish boshlandi.

en: The Russians, badly led and dishonestly provided, were beaten on sea and land alike.
uz: Ruslar, yomon boshqarilib, halol bo'lmagan ta'minotga ega bo'lganlar, dengizda ham, quruqlikda ham kaltaklandilar.

en: The Russian Baltic Fleet sailed round Africa to be utterly destroyed in the Straits of Tshushima.
uz: Rossiya Boltiqbo'yi floti Afrika bo'ylab suzib, Tshushima bo'g'ozlarida butunlay yo'q qilinishi kerak edi.

en: A revolutionary movement among the common people of Russia, infuriated by this remote and reasonless slaughter, obliged the Tsar to end the war (1905); he returned the southern half of Saghalien, which had been seized by Russia in 1875, evacuated Manchuria, resigned Korea to Japan.
uz: Rossiya oddiy xalqining inqilobiy harakati, bu uzoq va bema'ni qirg'in tufayli g'azablanib, podshohni urushni tugatishga majbur qildi (1905 yil); u 1875-yilda Rossiya tomonidan bosib olingan Saghalienning janubiy yarmini qaytarib oldi, Manxuriyani tark etdi, Koreyani Yaponiyaga taslim qildi.

en: The European invasion of Asia was coming to an end and the retraction of Europe’s tentacles was beginning.
uz: Yevropaning Osiyoga bostirib kirishi yakunlanayotgan edi va Yevropaning tentakllarini qaytarish boshlanayotgan edi.

en: LXIV THE BRITISH EMPIRE IN 1914 We may note here brieﬂy the varied nature of the constituents of the British Empire in 1914 which the steamship and railway had brought together.
uz: LXIV BRITISH EMPIRIYASI 1914 yilda Biz bu yerda 1914-yilda Britaniya imperiyasining tarkibiy qismlarining bug' kemasi va temir yo'llari birlashtirgan xilma-xilligini qisqacha ta'kidlashimiz mumkin.

en: It was and is a quite unique political combination; nothing of the sort has ever existed before.
uz: Bu juda noyob siyosiy kombinatsiya edi va shunday hamdir; bunday narsa avval hech qachon mavjud bo'lmagan.

en: First and central to the whole system was the “crowned republic” of the United British Kingdom, including (against the will of a considerable part of the Irish people) Ireland.
uz: Butun tizimning birinchi va markaziy qismi Buyuk Britaniya Buyuk Britaniyasining  tojlashgan respublikasi edi, shu jumladan (Irelandiya xalqining sezilarli qismining irodasiga qarshi).

en: The majority of the British Parliament, made up of the three united parliaments of England and Wales, Scotland and Ireland, de- termines the headship, the quality and policy of the ministry, and determines it largely on considerations arising out of British domestic politics.
uz: Britaniya Parlamentining aksariyati, Angliya va Uels, Shotlandiya va Irlandiyaning uchta birlashgan parlamentidan tashkil topgan holda, rahbarlikni, vazirlikning sifatini va siyosatini bekor qiladi va asosan Britaniya ichki siyosatidan kelib chiqadigan mulohazalarga asoslanadi.

en: It is this ministry which is the effective supreme government, with powers of peace and war, over all the rest of the empire.
uz: Aynan shu vazirlik butun imperiyaning qolgan qismi ustidan tinchlik va urush kuchlariga ega bo'lgan samarali oliy hukumatdir.

en: Next in order of political importance to the British States were the “crowned republics” of Australia, Canada, Newfoundland (the oldest British possession, 1583), New Zealand and South Africa, all practically indepen- dent and self-governing states in alliance with Great Britain, but each with a representative of the Crown appointed by the Government in ofﬁce; Next the Indian Empire, an extension of the Empire of the Great Mogul with its dependent and “protected” states reaching now from Beluchistan to Burma, and including Aden, in all of which empire the British Crown and the India Ofﬁce (under Parliamentary control) played the role of the original Turkoman dynasty; Then the ambiguous possession of Egypt, still nominally a part of the Turkish Empire and still retaining its own monarch, the Khedive, but under
uz: Keyin Britaniya Shtatlari uchun siyosiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan Avstraliya, Kanada, Nyufaundlend (eng qadimgi Britaniya mulki, 1583), Yangi Zelandiya va Janubiy Afrika, ularning barchasi amalda mustaqil va o'zini o'zi boshqarish davlatlari bo'lib, Buyuk Britaniya bilan ittifoq tuzgan, lekin har biri hukumat tomonidan tayinlangan toj vakili bilan; Keyin Hindiston imperiyasi, Buyuk Mogul imperiyasining kengaytmasi, uning bog'liq va himoyalangan davlatlari hozirda Beluchistondan Birmagacha yetib bormoqda va Adenni o'z ichiga oladi, bularning barchasida Britaniya imperiyasi va Hindiston imperiyasi (parlament nazorati ostida) asl Turkoman sulolasining rolini o'ynadi; Keyin Misrning noaniq mulki, hali ham Turkiya imperiyasining bir qismi bo'lib, o'z monarxini saqlab qoladi, lekin

en: almost despotic British ofﬁcial rule; Then the still more ambiguous “Anglo-Egyptian” Sudan province, occu- pied and administered jointly by the British and by the (British controlled) Egyptian Government; Then a number of partially self-governing communities, some British in origin and some not, with elected legislatures and an appointed executive, such as Malta, Jamaica, the Bahamas and Bermuda; Then the Crown colonies, in which the rule of the British Home Govern- ment (through the Colonial Ofﬁce) verged on autocracy, as in Ceylon, Tri- nidad and Fiji (where there was an appointed council), and Gibraltar and St.
uz: Deyarli despotik Britaniya rasmiy hukmronligi; Keyin yanada noaniqroq Anglo-Misrlik Sudan viloyati, Britaniya tomonidan egallab olingan va birgalikda Misr hukumati tomonidan boshqariladigan; Keyin bir qator qisman o'zini o'zi boshqarish jamiyatlari, ba'zilari kelib chiqishi Britaniyalik va ba'zilari emas, saylangan qonun chiqaruvchilari va tayinlangan ijrochi, masalan, Malta, Yamayka, Bagama orollari va Bermudlar; Keyin Britaniya Boshqaruvi hukmronligi (kolonial idorasi orqali) Avtokratiyaga yaqinlashgan, masalan, Seylon, Tri-Nidad va Fiji (bu yerda tayinlangan kengash bor edi), va Gibraltar va

en: Helena (where there was a governor);
uz: Helena (boshliq bor edi).

en: GIBRALTAR  Photo: C.
uz: GIBRALTAR Foto: C.

en: Sinclair Then great areas of (chieﬂy) tropical lands, raw-product areas, with politi- cally weak and under-civilized native communities which were nominally protectorates, and administered either by a High Commissioner set over na- tive chiefs (as in Basutoland) or over a chartered company (as in Rhodesia).
uz: Sinclair O'shanda tropik yerlarning katta hududlari (asosan), xomashyo mahsulotlari bo'lgan hududlar, siyosiy jihatdan zaif va madaniy jihatdan kam rivojlangan mahalliy jamoalar bor edi, ular nominal protektoratlar edi va ularni yoki Bosh komissar tomonidan boshqarilardi (Basutoland kabi) yoki ijaraga olingan kompaniya ustidan (Rodesiyadagidek).

en: In some cases the Foreign Ofﬁce, in some cases the Colonial Ofﬁce, and in some cases the India Ofﬁce, has been concerned in acquiring the possessions that fell into this last and least deﬁnite class of all, but for the most part the Colonial Ofﬁce was now responsible for them.
uz: Ba'zi hollarda Tashqi ishlar vazirligi, ba'zi hollarda Mustamlakachilik idorasi va ba'zi hollarda Hindiston idorasi oxirgi va eng kam aniq toifadagi mulkni sotib olish bilan shug'ullangan, ammo ko'p hollarda Mustamlakachilik idorasi endi ular uchun mas'uldir edi.

en: It will be manifest, therefore, that no single ofﬁce and no single brain had ever comprehended the British Empire as a whole.
uz: Shunday qilib, hech bir mansab va hech bir miya Britaniya imperiyasini butunlay tushunmaganligi namoyon bo'ladi.

en: It was a mixture of growths and accumulations entirely different from anything that has ever been called an empire before.
uz: Bu avvalgi imperiya deb atalgan narsalardan butunlay farq qiladigan o'sish va to'planish aralashmasi edi.

en: It guaranteed a wide peace and security; that is why it was endured and sustained by many men of the “subject” races—in spite of ofﬁcial tyrannies and insufﬁciencies, and of much negligence on the part of the “home” public.
uz: U keng tinchlik va xavfsizlikni kafolatlardi; shuning uchun ham u rasmiy zulm va kamchiliklarga, shuningdek, uy jamoatchiligining ko'p beparvoligiga qaramay, sub'ekt irqlarining ko'plab erkaklari tomonidan bardoshli va qo'llab-quvvatlangan edi.

en: Like the Athenian Empire, it was an overseas em- pire; its ways were sea ways, and its common link was the British Navy.
uz: Afina imperiyasi kabi, u ham chet el imperiyasi edi; uning yo'llari dengiz yo'llari edi va uning umumiy aloqasi Britaniya dengiz floti edi.

en: Like all empires, its cohesion was dependent physically upon a method of communication; the development of seamanship, ship-building and steamships between the sixteenth and nineteenth centuries had made it a pos- sible and convenient Pax—the “Pax Britannica,” and fresh developments of air or swift land transport might at any time make it inconvenient.
uz: Barcha imperiyalar singari, uning uyg'unligi ham jismonan aloqa usuliga bog'liq edi; o'n oltinchi va o'n to'qqizinchi asrlar oralig'ida dengizchilik, kemasozlik va bug' kemalari rivojlanishi uni qulay va qulay Paxga aylantirdi  Pax Britannica, va havo yoki tezkor quruqlik transportidagi yangi rivojlanishlar uni istalgan vaqtda noqulay qilishi mumkin edi.

en: STREET IN HONG KONG  Photo: Underwood & Underwood
uz: HONGKONG KO'CHASI Foto: Underwood & Underwood

en: LXV THE AGE OF ARMAMENT IN EUROPE, AND THE GREAT WAR OF 1914-18 The progress in material science that created this vast steamboat-and-rail- way republic of America and spread this precarious British steamship em- pire over the world, produced quite other effects upon the congested nations upon the continent of Europe.
uz: LXV Yevropadagi Qurollanish Davri va 1914-18-yillardagi Buyuk Urush. Amerika kemalari va temir yo'llari bo'yicha ushbu ulkan respublikani yaratgan va bu beqaror Britaniya bug' kemasini butun dunyoga tarqatgan moddiy fanlardagi taraqqiyot Yevropa qit'asidagi tiqilinch davlatlarga ancha boshqa ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: They found themselves conﬁned within boundaries ﬁxed during the horse-and-high-road period of human life, and their expansion overseas had been very largely anticipated by Great Britain.
uz: Ular inson hayotining ot va yo'l davri davomida o'rnatilgan chegaralar ichida cheklangan holda qolishdi va ularning xorijga kengayishi asosan Buyuk Britaniya tomonidan kutilgan edi.

en: Only Russia had any freedom to expand eastward; and she drove a great railway across Siberia until she entangled herself in a conﬂict with Japan, and pushed south-eastwardly towards the borders of Persia and India to the annoyance of Britain.
uz: Faqatgina Rossiya sharqqa kengayish uchun erkinlikka ega edi; va u Sibir bo'ylab katta temir yo'l haydab o'tdi, toki Yaponiya bilan mojaroga aralashib, Britaniya g'azabi uchun Fors va Hindiston chegaralariga tomon janubi-sharqqa itarildi.

en: The rest of the European Powers were in a state of intensifying congestion.
uz: Qolgan Yevropa davlatlari tirbandlikning kuchayib borayotgan holatda edi.

en: In order to realize the full possibilities of the new apparatus of human life they had to rearrange their affairs upon a broader basis, either by some sort of voluntary union or by a union imposed upon them by some predominant power.
uz: Insoniyat hayotining yangi apparatining to'liq imkoniyatlarini ro'yobga chiqarish uchun ular o'z ishlarini kengroq asosda qayta tashkil etishlari kerak edi, xoh qandaydir ixtiyoriy ittifoq orqali, xoh ularga hukmron hokimiyat tomonidan yuklangan ittifoq orqali.

en: The tendency of modern thought was in the direction of the former alternative, but all the force of political tradition drove Europe towards the latter.
uz: Zamonaviy tafakkur tendensiyasi avvalgi muqobilga qaratilgan edi, lekin siyosiy an'ananing barcha kuchi Yevropani oxirgi muqobilga tomon itardi.

en: The downfall of the “empire” of Napoleon III, the establishment of the new German Empire, pointed men’s hopes and fears towards the idea of a Europe consolidated under German auspices.
uz: Napoleon III imperiyasining qulashi, yangi Germaniya imperiyasining tashkil etilishi odamlarning umidlari va qo'rquvlarini Germaniya homiyligida mustahkamlangan Yevropa g'oyasiga qaratdi.

en: For thirty-six years of uneasy peace the polities of Europe centred upon that possibility.
uz: O'ttiz olti yillik noqulay tinchlik davomida Yevropa siyosatchilari shu imkoniyatga e'tibor qaratdilar.

en: France, the stead- fast rival of Germany for European ascendancy since the division of the
uz: Fransiya, Germaniyaning Yevropa ustunligi uchun bo'linishidan beri doimiy raqibi.

en: empire of Charlemagne, sought to correct her own weakness by a close al- liance with Russia, and Germany linked herself closely with the Austrian Empire (it had ceased to be the Holy Roman Empire in the days of Napoleon I) and less successfully with the new kingdom of Italy.
uz: Charlz Buyuk imperiyasi o'z zaifligini Rossiya bilan yaqin ittifoq tuzish orqali tuzatishga intildi va Germaniya o'zini Avstriya imperiyasi bilan (Napoleon I davrida Muqaddas Rim imperiyasi bo'lishni to'xtatgan edi) va yangi Italiya qirolligi bilan kamroq muvaffaqiyatli bog'ladi.

en: At ﬁrst Great Britain stood as usual half in and half out of continental affairs.
uz: Avvaliga Buyuk Britaniya odatdagidek qit'a ishlarida yarmi ichida va yarmi tashqarida turardi.

en: But she was gradually forced into a close association with the Franco-Russian group by the aggressive development of a great German navy.
uz: Ammo u asta-sekin buyuk Germaniya flotining tajovuzkor rivojlanishi tufayli Fransiya-Rossiya guruhi bilan yaqin aloqada bo'lishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: The grandiose imagination of the Emperor William II (1888-1918) thrust Ger- many into premature overseas enterprise that ultimately brought not only Great Britain but Japan and the United States into the circle of her enemies.
uz: Imperator Uilyam II ning ulkan tasavvuri (1888-1918) Ger-ni ko'pchilikni erta xorijiy korxonalarga itarib yubordi, bu esa nafaqat Buyuk Britaniya, balki Yaponiya va AQShni uning dushmanlari davriga olib kirdi.

en: BRITISH TANK IN THE BATTLE OF THE MENIN ROAD  The crew came out for a breath of fresh air during a lull  Photo: British Ofﬁcial All these nations armed.
uz: BRITANIYA TANKI MENIN YO'LIDAGI JANGDA Ekipaj tinchlik paytida toza havo olish uchun tashqariga chiqdi. Surat: Britaniya rasmiylari Bu millatlarning barchasi qurollangan.

en: Year after year the proportion of national pro- duction devoted to the making of guns, equipment, battleships and the like, increased.
uz: Yildan yilga qurol-yarog', uskunalar, jangovar kemalar va shunga o'xshash narsalarni ishlab chiqarishga bag'ishlangan milliy ishlab chiqarish ulushi ortdi.

en: Year after year the balance of things seemed trembling towards war, and then war would be averted.
uz: Yildan yilga narsalarning muvozanati urushga qarab titrayotgandek tuyuldi va keyin urushning oldini olinardi.

en: Germany and Austria struck at France and Russia and Serbia; the German armies marching through Belgium, Britain immediately came into the war on the side of Bel- gium, bringing in Japan as her ally, and very soon Turkey followed on the German side.
uz: Germaniya va Avstriya Fransiyaga, Rossiya va Serbiyaga hujum qildi; Germaniya armiyasi Belgiya orqali yurdi, Britaniya darhol Belgiya tomonida urushga kirdi, Yaponiyani ittifoqchi sifatida olib keldi va tez orada Turkiya ham Germaniya tomonida edi.

en: Italy entered the war against Austria in 1915, and Bulgaria joined the Central Powers in the October of that year.
uz: Italiya 1915-yilda Avstriyaga qarshi urushga kirdi va Bolgariya o'sha yilning oktabr oyida Markaziy Kuchlarga qo'shildi.

en: In 1916 Rumania, and in 1917 the United States and China were forced into war against Germany.
uz: 1916-yilda Ruminiya, 1917-yilda esa Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlari va Xitoy Germaniyaga qarshi urushga majbur boʻldi.

en: It is not within the scope of this history to deﬁne the exact share of blame for this vast catastrophe.
uz: Bu ulkan falokat uchun aniq ayb ulushini aniqlash ushbu tarix doirasida emas.

en: The more interesting question is not why the Great War was begun but why the Great War was not anticipated and prevented.
uz: Eng qiziqarli savol Buyuk Urush nega boshlanganligi emas, balki Buyuk Urush nega oldindan kutilmagan va oldini olinmaganidir.

en: It is a far graver thing for mankind that scores of millions of people were too “patriotic,” stupid, or apathetic to prevent this disaster by a movement to- wards European unity upon frank and generous lines, than that a small num- ber of people may have been active in bringing it about.
uz: Insoniyat uchun millionlab odamlar bu falokatni oldini olish uchun ochiq va saxiy yo'nalishlarda Yevropa birligini himoya qilish harakati orqali juda vatanparvar, ahmoq yoki befarq bo'lishi, buni amalga oshirishda kichik bir guruh odamlar faol bo'lganidan ko'ra ancha jiddiyroq narsa.

en: THE RUINS OF YPRES (ONCE A DELIGHTFUL OLD FLEMISH TOWN)
uz: YPRES XALQALARI (YONLI QADIMGI FLEMISH QARANG'I QISMDA)

en: To show the complete destructiveness of modern war  Photo: Topical THE DEVASTATION OF MODERN WAR  Wire entanglements in the foreground  Photo: Photopress It is impossible within the space at our command here to trace the intri- cate details of the war.
uz: Zamonaviy urushning toʻliq vayronkorligini koʻrsatish uchun Foto: Zamonaviy urushning vayron boʻlishi. Oldingi fonda simli toʻqnashuvlar. Foto: Fotopress. Bizning buyrugʻimiz ostida boʻlgan fazoda urushning intri-cate tafsilotlarini izlashning iloji yoʻq.

en: Within a few months it became apparent that the progress of modern technical science had changed the nature of warfare very profoundly.
uz: Bir necha oy ichida zamonaviy texnik fan taraqqiyoti urush tabiatini juda chuqur o'zgartirgani aniq bo'ldi.

en: Physical science gives power, power over steel, over dis- tance, over disease; whether that power is used well or ill depends upon the moral and political intelligence of the world.
uz: Fizikaviy fan kuch beradi, kuch po'lat ustidan, kuchsizlik ustidan, kasallik ustidan; bu kuchning yaxshi yoki yomon ishlatilishi dunyoning axloqiy va siyosiy aqliga bog'liq.

en: The governments of Europe, inspired by antiquated policies of hate and suspicion, found themselves with unexampled powers both of destruction and resistance in their hands.
uz: Yevropa hukumatlari, nafrat va gumonning eskirgan siyosatlaridan ilhomlanib, o'z qo'llarida vayronagarchilik va qarshilik kabi misli ko'rilmagan kuchlarga ega bo'lishdi.

en: The war became a consuming ﬁre round and about the world, causing losses both to victors and vanquished out of all proportion to the issues involved.
uz: Urush butun dunyo bo'ylab o'tga aylandi va g'oliblarga ham, mag'lub bo'lganlarga ham tegishli masalalarga mutanosib ravishda yo'qotishlarga olib keldi.

en: The ﬁrst phase of the war was a tremendous rush of the Germans upon Paris and an invasion of East Prussia by the Russians.
uz: Urushning birinchi bosqichi nemislarning Parijga ulkan shoshilishi va ruslarning Sharqiy Prussiyaga bostirib kirishi edi.

en: Both attacks were held and turned.
uz: Ikkala hujum ham o'tkazildi va ag'darilib ketdi.

en: Then the power of the defensive developed; there was a rapid elabo- ration of trench warfare until for a time the opposing armies lay entrenched in long lines right across Europe, unable to make any advance without enor- mous losses.
uz: Keyin mudofaa kuchi rivojlandi; xandaq urushi tez sur'atlar bilan davom etdi, bir muddatga esa raqib armiyalar butun Yevropada uzun saflarda o'tirib, ulkan yo'qotishlarsiz hech qanday oldinga siljisha olmadi.

en: The armies were millions strong, and behind them entire popu- lations were organized for the supply of food and munitions to the front.
uz: Armiyalar millionlab kuchga ega edi va ularning ortida frontga oziq-ovqat va o'q-dorilar yetkazib berish uchun butun popu-lationlar tashkil etilgan edi.

en: Then was a cessation of nearly every sort of productive activity except such as contributed to military operations.
uz: Keyin harbiy operatsiyalarga hissa qo'shgan har qanday turdagi samarali faoliyatning deyarli to'xtatilishi kuzatildi.

en: All the able-bodied manhood of Eu- rope was drawn into the armies or navies or into the improvised factories that served them.
uz: Yevropaning barcha kuchli erkaklari armiya yoki dengiz flotiga yoki ularga xizmat ko'rsatuvchi improvizatsiya qilingan zavodlarga jalb qilindi.

en: There was an enormous replacement of men by women in industry.
uz: Sanoatda erkaklarni ayollar bilan katta almashtirish bo'ldi.

en: Probably more than half the people in the belligerent countries of Europe changed their employment altogether during this stupendous strug- gle.
uz: Ehtimol, Yevropaning urushayotgan mamlakatlaridagi odamlarning yarmidan ko'prog'i bu ulkan kurash davomida butunlay o'z ish joylarini o'zgartirgan.

en: They were socially uprooted and transplanted.
uz: Ular ijtimoiy ravishda sug'urib tashlandi va ko'chirib o'tkazildi.

en: Education and normal scientiﬁc work were restricted or diverted to immediate military ends, and the distribution of news was crippled and corrupted by military control and “propaganda” activities.
uz: Ta'lim va oddiy ilmiy ish to'xtatildi yoki bevosita harbiy maqsadlarga yo'naltirildi, yangilik tarqatilishi esa harbiy nazorat va propaganda faoliyatlari tufayli buzildi va buzildi.

en: The phase of military deadlock passed slowly into one of aggression upon the combatant populations behind the fronts by the destruction of food supplies and by attacks through the air.
uz: Harbiy tiqilinch bosqichi asta-sekin oziq-ovqat ta'minotini yo'q qilish va havo hujumlari orqali front ortidagi jangchi aholiga tajovuz qilish bosqichiga aylandi.

en: And also there was a steady im- provement in the size and range of the guns employed and of such inge- nious devices as poison-gas shells and the small mobile forts known as tanks, to break down the resistance of troops in the trenches.
uz: Shuningdek, ishlatiladigan qurollarning hajmi va diapazoni hamda zaharli gaz snaryadlari va tanklar deb nomlanuvchi kichik ko'chma qal'alar kabi xavfli qurilmalarning trenchlardagi qo'shinlarning qarshiligini sindirishda barqaror o'sish kuzatildi.

en: The air offen- sive was the most revolutionary of all the new methods.
uz: Havo hujumi - sive barcha yangi usullarning eng inqilobiysi edi.

en: It carried warfare from two dimensions into three.
uz: U urushni ikki o'lchamdan uch o'lchamga olib kirdi.

en: Hitherto in the history of mankind war had gone on only where the armies marched and met.
uz: Insoniyat tarixida shu paytgacha urush faqat armiyalar yurib, uchrashgan joylarda davom etgan.

en: Now it went on every- where.
uz: Endi u hamma joyga ketardi.

en: First the Zeppelin and then the bombing aeroplane carried war over and past the front to an ever- increasing area of civilian activities beyond.
uz: Avval Zeppelin, keyin esa bombardimon samolyoti urushni front bo'ylab va undan o'tib, undan tashqari doimiy ravishda o'sib borayotgan fuqarolik faoliyatining hududiga olib bordi.

en: The old distinction maintained in civilized warfare between the civilian and combatant population disappeared.
uz: Fuqarolar va jangchi aholi o'rtasidagi madaniy urushda saqlanib qolgan eski farq yo'qoldi.

en: Everyone who grew food, or who sewed a garment, everyone who felled a tree or repaired a house, every railway station and every warehouse was held to be fair game for destruction.
uz: Oziq-ovqat yetishtirgan yoki kiyim tikkan har bir kishi, daraxt kesgan yoki uy ta'mirlagan har bir kishi, har bir temir yo'l stantsiyasi va har bir ombor vayronagarchilik uchun adolatli o'yin deb hisoblanardi.

en: The air offensive increased in range and terror with every month in the war.
uz: Havo hujumi har oy urushda haddan tashqari kuchayib, dahshatga tushdi.

en: At last great areas of Europe were in a state of siege and subject to nightly raids.
uz: Nihoyat, Yevropaning katta hududlari qamal holatiga tushib, tungi reydlarga duchor bo'ldi.

en: Such exposed cities as London and Paris passed sleepless night after sleepless night while the bombs burst, the anti-aircraft guns maintained an intolerable racket, and the ﬁre engines and ambulances rattled headlong through the darkened and deserted streets.
uz: London va Parij kabi ochiq shaharlar uyqusiz tunlardan uyqusiz tunlarga o'tdi, bombalar portladi, zenit qurollari chidab bo'lmas raketa saqladi va o't o'chiruvchi mashinalar va tez yordam mashinalari qorong'u va tashlandiq ko'chalar bo'ylab bosh qotirdi.

en: The effects upon the minds and health of old people and of young children were particularly distressing and destructive.
uz: Keksa odamlarning va yosh bolalarning ongiga va sog'lig'iga ta'siri ayniqsa qayg'uli va vayronkor edi.

en: Pestilence, that old follower of warfare, did not arrive until the very end of the ﬁghting in 1918.
uz: Pestilence, urushning o'sha eski izdoshi, 1918-yildagi janglarning oxirigacha yetib kelmadi.

en: For four years medical science staved off any gener- al epidemic; then came a great outbreak of inﬂuenza about the world which
uz: To'rt yil davomida tibbiyot fani har qanday umumiy epidemiyani to'xtatdi; keyin dunyo bo'ylab grippning katta avj olishi keldi.

en: destroyed many millions of people.
uz: ko'p millionlab odamlarni yo'q qildi.

en: Famine also was staved off for some time.
uz: Ochlik ham bir muncha vaqtga to'xtatildi.

en: By the beginning of 1918 however most of Europe was in a state of mitigated and regulated famine.
uz: 1918-yil boshiga kelib, Yevropaning aksariyati ocharchilikning kamaytirilgan va tartibga solingan holatida edi.

en: The production of food throughout the world had fallen very greatly through the calling off of peasant mankind to the fronts, and the distribution of such food as was produced was impeded by the havoc wrought by the submarine, by the rupture of customary routes through the closing of frontiers, and by the disorganization of the transport system of the world.
uz: Butun dunyo bo'ylab oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarish dehqonlar insoniyatining frontlarga olib chiqilishi natijasida juda katta darajada pasaydi va ishlab chiqarilgan bunday oziq-ovqatning tarqalishiga suv osti kemalari tomonidan keltirilgan vayronagarchiliklar, chegaralar orqali odatiy yo'llarning uzilishi va dunyoning transport tizimining tartibsizligi to'sqinlik qildi.

en: The various governments took possession of the dwin- dling food supplies, and, with more or less success, rationed their popula- tions.
uz: Turli hukumatlar ikki tomonlama oziq-ovqat zaxiralariga egalik qilishdi va ozmi-ko'pmi muvaffaqiyat bilan o'z aholisini ratsionlashdi.

en: By the fourth year the whole world was suffering from shortages of clothing and housing and of most of the normal gear of life as well as of food.
uz: To'rtinchi yilga kelib butun dunyo kiyim-kechak va turar joy tanqisligi, shuningdek, hayotning ko'p qismini, shuningdek, oziq-ovqatni ta'minlashdan aziyat chekayotgan edi.

en: Business and economic life were profoundly disorganized.
uz: Biznes va iqtisodiy hayot tubdan tartibsiz edi.

en: Every-one was worried, and most people were leading lives of unwonted discomfort.
uz: Hamma xavotirda edi va ko'pchilik odamlar kutilmagan noqulaylik bilan hayot kechirardi.

en: The actual warfare ceased in November, 1918.
uz: Haqiqiy urush 1918-yil noyabr oyida to'xtadi.

en: After a supreme effort in the spring of 1918 that almost carried the Germans to Paris, the Central Powers collapsed.
uz: 1918-yil bahorida nemislarni Parijga olib borishga yaqin bo'lgan oliy sa'y-harakatdan so'ng, Markaziy Kuchlar quladi.

en: They had come to an end of their spirit and resources.
uz: Ular o'z ruhlari va resurslarining oxiriga yetgan edilar.

en: LXVI THE REVOLUTION AND FAMINE IN RUSSIA But a good year and more before the collapse of the Central Powers the half oriental monarchy of Russia, which had professed to be the continuation of the Byzantine Empire, had collapsed.
uz: LXVI RUSSIYADA INQILOB VA SHAMOLAT Lekin Markaziy Kuchlar qulashidan bir yil va undan ko'proq oldin, Vizantiya imperiyasining davomi deb da'vo qilgan Rossiyaning yarim sharqiy monarxiyasi qulab tushdi.

en: The Tsardom had been showing signs of profound rottenness for some years before the war; the court was under the sway of a fantastic religious impostor, Rasputin, and the public adminis- tration, civil and military, was in a state of extreme inefﬁciency and corrup- tion.
uz: Urushdan oldin podshohlik bir necha yillar davomida chuqur chiriganlik alomatlarini ko'rsatardi; sud ajoyib diniy firibgar Rasputinning hukmronligi ostida edi va davlat ma'muriyati, fuqarolik va harbiy, o'ta samarasiz va korruptsion holatda edi.

en: At the outset of the war there was a great ﬂare of patriotic enthusiasm in Russia.
uz: Urush boshida Rossiyada vatanparvarlik ishtiyoqi katta alangalandi.

en: A vast conscript army was called up, for which there was neither adequate military equipment nor a proper supply of competent ofﬁcers, and this great host, ill supplied and badly handled, was hurled against the Ger- man and Austrian frontiers.
uz: Katta chaqiriluvchi armiya chaqirildi, uning uchun na yetarli harbiy texnika, na yetarli darajada malakali ofitserlar ta'minoti yo'q edi va bu katta qo'shin, noto'g'ri ta'minlangan va yomon ishlov berilgan, Germaniya va Avstriya chegaralariga tashlandi.

en: There can be no doubt that the early appearance of Russian armies in East Prussia in September, 1914, diverted the energies and attention of the Germans from their ﬁrst victorious drive upon Paris.
uz: Shubhasizki, 1914-yil sentyabr oyida Sharqiy Prussiyaga rus armiyasining erta paydo bo'lishi nemislarning energiyasi va e'tiborini Parijga birinchi g'alaba qozongan yurishidan chalg'itdi.

en: The sufferings and deaths of scores of thousands of ill-led Russian peasants saved France from complete overthrow in that momentous opening campaign, and made all western Europe the debtors of that great and tragic people.
uz: O'n minglab yomon boshqariladigan rus dehqonlarining azob-uqubatlari va o'limi Fransiyani o'sha muhim ochilish kampaniyasida to'liq ag'darilishdan saqlab qoldi va butun G'arbiy Yevropani o'sha buyuk va fojiali xalqning qarzdorlariga aylantirdi.

en: But the strain of the war upon this sprawling, ill-organized empire was too heavy for its strength.
uz: Ammo bu keng tarqalgan, noto'g'ri tashkil etilgan imperiyaga urush zo'riqishi uning kuchidan haddan tashqari og'ir edi.

en: The Russian common soldiers were sent into battle without guns to support them, without even riﬂe ammunition; they were wasted by their ofﬁcers and generals in a delirium of militarist enthusiasm.
uz: Rus oddiy askarlari ularni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun qurolsiz, hatto miltiq o'q-dorilarsiz jangga yuborildi; ular ofitserlari va generallari tomonidan militarist ishtiyoqi shovqinida isrof qilindi.

en: For a time they seemed to be suffering mutely as the beasts suffer; but there is a limit to the endurance even of the most ignorant.
uz: Bir muddat ular hayvonlar azob chekkanidek, jim azob chekayotgandek tuyuldilar; lekin eng johillarning ham bardoshliligi cheklangan.

en: A profound disgust for Tsardom was
uz: Tsardom uchun chuqur nafrat edi.

en: creeping through these armies of betrayed and wasted men.
uz: xiyonatkor va behuda odamlarning bu qo'shinlari orasida emaklab yuribdi.

en: From the close of 1915 onward Russia was a source of deepening anxiety to her Western Allies.
uz: 1915-yilning oxiridan boshlab Rossiya o'zining G'arbiy ittifoqchilariga chuqurroq xavotir manbai bo'ldi.

en: Throughout 1916 she remained largely on the defensive, and there were rumours of a separate peace with Germany.
uz: 1916 yil davomida u asosan mudofaada qoldi va Germaniya bilan alohida tinchlik haqida mish-mishlar tarqaldi.

en: On December 29th, 1916, the monk Rasputin was murdered at a dinner party in Petrograd, and a belated attempt was made to put the Tsardom in order.
uz: 1916-yil 29-dekabrda ruhoniy Rasputin Petrograddagi kechki ovqat ziyofatida o'ldirildi va Tsardomni tartibga solishga kechikkan urinish amalga oshirildi.

en: By March things were moving rapidly; food riots in Petrograd devel- oped into a revolutionary insurrection; there was an attempted suppression of the Duma, the representative body, there were attempted arrests of liberal leaders, the formation of a provisional government under Prince Lvoff, and an abdication (March 15th) by the Tsar.
uz: Mart oyiga kelib ishlar tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanardi; Petrograddagi oziq-ovqat tartibsizliklari inqilobiy isyonga aylandi; Dumaning, vakillik organining bostirilishiga urinish bo'ldi, liberal rahbarlarni hibsga olishga urinishlar bo'ldi, shahzoda Lvov boshchiligida vaqtinchalik hukumat tuzildi va podshoh tomonidan 15-mart kuni iste'foga chiqdi.

en: For a time it seemed that a moder- ate and controlled revolution might be possible—perhaps under a new Tsar.
uz: Bir muddatga o'rtacha va nazorat qilinadigan inqilob mumkindek tuyuldi  ehtimol yangi podshoh ostida.

en: Then it became evident that the destruction of popular conﬁdence in Russia had gone too far for any such adjustments.
uz: Keyin Rossiyaga bo'lgan xalq ishonchini yo'q qilish bunday tuzatishlar uchun haddan tashqari ketgani aniq bo'ldi.

en: The Russian people were sick to death of the old order of things in Europe, of Tsars and wars and of Great Powers; it wanted relief, and that speedily, from unendurable miseries.
uz: Rus xalqi Yevropadagi eski tartib, podshohlar va urushlar hamda Buyuk Kuchlar tufayli o'limga chidamli edi; u chidab bo'lmas azoblardan tezda xalos bo'lishni xohlardi.

en: The Allies had no understanding of Russian realities; their diplomatists were ignorant of Russian, genteel persons with their attention directed to the Russian Court rather than to Russia, they blundered steadily with the new situation.
uz: Ittifoqchilar Rossiya voqeliklarini tushunishmagan; ularning diplomatlari rus, oddiy odamlarga bexabar edilar, ularning e'tibori Rossiyaga emas, balki Rossiya sudiga qaratilgan edi, ular yangi vaziyat bilan doimiy ravishda adashdilar.

en: There was little goodwill among these diplomatists for republi- canism, and a manifest disposition to embarrass the new government as much as possible.
uz: Bu diplomatlar orasida respublikachilik uchun yaxshi niyat kam edi va yangi hukumatni imkon qadar sharmanda qilish uchun ochiq niyat bor edi.

en: At the head of the Russian republican government was an eloquent and picturesque leader, Kerensky, who found himself assailed by the forces of a profounder revolutionary movement, the “social revolution,” at home and cold-shouldered by the Allied governments abroad.
uz: Rossiya respublika hukumatining boshida notiq va go'zal yetakchi Kerenskiy bor edi, u o'zini chuqur inqilobiy harakat, ijtimoiy inqilob kuchlari tomonidan hujumga uchraganini, o'z uyida va xorijda ittifoqchi hukumatlarning sovuq yelkasida qolganini ko'rdi.

en: His Allies would neither let him give the Russian peasants the land for which they craved nor peace beyond their frontiers.
uz: Uning ittifoqchilari unga rus dehqonlariga ular orzu qilgan yerni berishiga yo'l qo'yishmasdi, shuningdek, ularning chegaralaridan tashqarida tinchlik ham bermasdi.

en: The French and the British press pestered their exhausted ally for a fresh offensive, but when presently the Germans made a strong attack by sea and land upon Riga, the British Admi- ralty quailed before the prospect of a Baltic expedition in relief.
uz: Fransuz va Britaniya matbuoti o'zlarining charchoq ittifoqchilarini yangi hujum uchun bezovta qilishdi, lekin hozirda nemislar Rigaga dengiz va quruqlik orqali kuchli hujum qilganda, Britaniya Admi-ralty qutqaruvdagi Boltiqbo'yi ekspeditsiyasi istiqboliga ko'z yumdi.

en: The new Russian Republic had to ﬁght unsupported.
uz: Yangi Rossiya Respublikasi qo'llab-quvvatlanmagan holda kurashishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: In spite of their naval predomi- nance and the bitter protests of the great English admiral, Lord Fisher (1841-1920), it is to be noted that the British and their Allies, except for some submarine attacks, left the Germans the complete mastery of the Baltic throughout the war.
uz: Garchi dengiz ustunligi va buyuk ingliz admirali Lord Fisherning achchiq noroziliklariga qaramay (1841-1920), shuni ta'kidlash joizki, inglizlar va ularning ittifoqchilari, ba'zi suv osti hujumlaridan tashqari, urush davomida Boltiqbo'yi bo'ylab nemislarga to'liq egalik qilish huquqini qoldirishdi.

en: The Russian masses, however, were resolute to end the war.
uz: Rus ommaviylari esa urushni tugatishga qat'iy qaror qilishdi.

en: There had come into existence in Petrograd a body representing the workers and common soldiers, the Soviet, and this body clamoured for an in- ternational conference of socialists at Stockholm.
uz: Petrogradda ishchilar va oddiy askarlarni, Sovetni ifodalovchi organ paydo bo'lgan edi va bu organ Stokgolmda sotsialistiklarning xalqaro konferensiyasiga chaqirardi.

en: Food riots were occurring in Berlin at this time, war weariness in Austria and Germany was profound, and there can be little doubt, in the light of subsequent events, that such a conference would have precipitated a reasonable peace on democratic lines in 1917 and a German revolution.
uz: Berlin shahrida shu paytda oziq-ovqat tartibsizliklari sodir bo'layotgan edi, Avstriya va Germaniyada urushdan charchash chuqur edi va keyingi voqealarni hisobga olsak, bunday konferensiya 1917-yilda demokratik yo'nalishlarda oqilona tinchlikka va Germaniya inqilobiga olib kelishiga shubha yo'q.

en: Kerensky implored his Western allies to allow this conference to take place, but, fearful of a worldwide outbreak of socialism and republicanism, they refused, in spite of the favourable re- sponse of a small majority of the British Labour Party.
uz: Kerenskiy o'zining G'arb ittifoqchilaridan ushbu konferensiyaga o'tishga ruxsat berishni iltimos qildi, lekin ular, sotsializm va respublikachilikning butun dunyo bo'ylab tarqalishidan qo'rqib, Britaniya Mehnat partiyasining kichik bir qismining ijobiy javobidan qat'i nazar, rad etishdi.

en: Without either moral or physical help from the Allies, the unhappy “moderate” Russian Republic still fought on and made a last desperate offensive effort in July.
uz: Ittifoqchilarning na ma'naviy, na jismoniy yordami bo'lmasa ham, norozi o'rtacha Rossiya Respublikasi baribir kurashdi va iyul oyida oxirgi umidsiz hujum harakatini amalga oshirdi.

en: It failed after some preliminary successes, and there came another great slaughtering of Russians.
uz: U bir nechta dastlabki muvaffaqiyatlardan keyin muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi va yana bir buyuk ruslarni qirg'in qildi.

en: The limit of Russian endurance was reached.
uz: Rossiya chidamliligi chegarasiga yetdi.

en: Mutinies broke out in the Russian armies, and particularly upon the northern front, and on November 7th, 1917, Kerensky’s government was overthrown and power was seized by the Soviets, dominated by the Bolshevik socialists under Lenin, and pledged to make peace regardless of the Western powers.
uz: Rossiya armiyasida, ayniqsa shimoliy frontda isyonlar boshlandi va 1917-yil 7-noyabrda Kerenskiyning hukumati ag'darildi va hokimiyat Lenin boshchiligidagi bolshevik sotsialistiklar hukmronligidagi Sovetlar tomonidan egallandi va G'arb davlatlaridan qat'i nazar tinchlik o'rnatishga va'da berdi.

en: On March 2nd, 1918, a separate peace between Russia and Germany was signed at Brest- Litovsk.
uz: 1918-yil 2-mart kuni Brest-Litovskda Rossiya va Germaniya oʻrtasida alohida sulh imzolandi.

en: A VIEW IN PETERSBURG UNDER BOLSHEVIK RULE  A wooden house has been demolished for ﬁrewood  By courtesy of Messrs.
uz: PETERSBURGDA BOLSHEVIK HUKMATIDAGI KO'RINISH Janoblar hujjati bilan o'tin uchun yog'och uy buzib tashlandi.

en: Hodder & Stoughton It speedily became evident that these Bolshevik socialists were men of a very different quality from the rhetorical constitutionalists and revolutionar- ies of the Kerensky phase.
uz: Hodder va Stoughton Tez orada bu bolshevik sotsialistlar Kerenskiy davridagi ritorik konstitutsionistlar va inqilobiy fikrlardan juda farqli sifatga ega odamlar ekanligi ayon bo'ldi.

en: They were fanatical Marxist communists.
uz: Ular fanatik marksistik kommunistlar edi.

en: believed that their accession to power in Russia was only the opening of a world-wide social revolution, and they set about changing the social and economic order with the thoroughness of perfect faith and absolute inexpe- rience.
uz: Ularning Rossiyada hokimiyatga kelishi faqatgina jahon miqyosidagi ijtimoiy inqilobning boshlanishi deb hisoblangan va ular mukammal imon va mutlaq umidsizlik bilan ijtimoiy va iqtisodiy tartibni o'zgartirishga kirishdi.

en: The western European and the American governments were them- selves much too ill-informed and incapable to guide or help this ex- traordinary experiment, and the press set itself to discredit and the ruling classes to wreck these usurpers upon any terms and at any cost to them- selves or to Russia.
uz: G'arbiy Yevropa va Amerika hukumatlari o'zlari juda ham noto'g'ri ma'lumotga ega va bu g'ayrioddiy tajribani yo'naltirish yoki yordam berishga qodir emas edilar, va matbuot o'zini obro'sizlantirishga va hukmron sinflarni bu o'g'irlarni har qanday shartlarda va har qanday narxda yo'q qilishga majbur qildilar - o'zlari yoki Rossiya uchun.

en: A propaganda of abominable and disgusting inventions went on unchecked in the press of the world; the Bolshevik leaders were represented as incredible monsters glutted with blood and plunder and liv- ing lives of sensuality before which the realities of the Tsarist court during the Rasputin regime paled to a white purity.
uz: Butun dunyo matbuotida jirkanch va jirkanch ixtirolarning tashviqoti nazoratsiz davom etdi; bolshevik yetakchilari qon va talon-taroj bilan to'ldirilgan va shahvoniy hayot kechiruvchi aql bovar qilmas maxluqlar sifatida tasvirlangan edi, Rasputin rejimi davridagi podshohlik saroyining haqiqatlari oq tiniqlikka aylandi.

en: Expeditions were launched at the exhausted country, insurgents and raiders were encouraged, armed and subsidized, and no method of attack was too mean or too monstrous for the frightened enemies of the Bolshevik regime.
uz: Charchagan mamlakatga ekspeditsiyalar boshlangan, isyonchilar va tajovuzchilar rag'batlantirilgan, qurollangan va subsidiyalangan, va hech qanday hujum usuli bolsheviklar rejimining qo'rqinchli dushmanlari uchun juda yovuz yoki juda dahshatli bo'lmagan.

en: In 1919, the Russian Bolshe- viks, ruling a country already exhausted and disorganized by ﬁve years of intensive warfare, were ﬁghting a British Expedition at Archangel, Japanese invaders in Eastern Siberia, Roumanians with French and Greek contin- gents in the south, the Russian Admiral Koltchak in Siberia and General Deniken, supported by the French ﬂeet, in the Crimea.
uz: 1919-yilda rus bolshe-viklari, besh yillik intensiv urushdan allaqachon charchagan va tartibsizlashgan mamlakatni hukmronlik qilgan holda, Arxangelda Britaniya Ekspeditsiyasi, Sharqiy Sibirdagi yapon bosqinchilari, janubdagi fransuz va yunon qit'alari bilan Rumaniyaliklar, Sibirdagi rus admirali Koltchak va Fransiya floti tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlangan general Denken bilan Qrimda jang qilishardi.

en: In July of that year an Esthonian army, under General Yudenitch, almost got to Petersburg.
uz: O'sha yilning iyul oyida general Yudenitch boshchiligidagi estoniya armiyasi deyarli Sankt-Peterburgga yetib keldi.

en: In 1920 the Poles, incited by the French, made a new attack on Russia; and a new reactionary raider, General Wrangel, took over the task of General Deniken in invading and devastating his own country.
uz: 1920-yilda fransuzlar tomonidan qo'zg'atilgan polyaklar Rossiyaga yangi hujum uyushtirdilar; va yangi reaksion reyder, general Wrangel, general Denkenning o'z mamlakatini bosib olish va vayron qilish vazifasini o'z zimmasiga oldi.

en: In March, 1921, the sailors at Cronstadt revolted.
uz: 1921-yil mart oyida Cronstadtdagi dengizchilar isyon ko'tardilar.

en: The Russian Government under its president, Lenin, survived all these various attacks.
uz: Rossiya hukumati o'z prezidenti Lenin boshchiligida bu turli hujumlardan omon qoldi.

en: It showed an amazing tenacity, and the common people of Russia sustained it unswervingly under condi- tions of extreme hardship.
uz: U ajoyib qat'iyat ko'rsatdi va Rossiya oddiy xalqi uni haddan tashqari qiyinchilik sharoitida o'zgarmas tarzda qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: By the end of 1921 both Britain and Italy had made a sort of recognition of the communist rule.
uz: 1921-yil oxiriga kelib, Britaniya ham, Italiya ham kommunistik hukmronlikni qandaydir tarzda tan oldi.

en: But if the Bolshevik Government was successful in its struggle against foreign intervention and internal revolt, it was far less happy in its attempts to set up a new social order based upon communist ideas in Russia.
uz: Lekin bolsheviklar hukumati xorijiy aralashuv va ichki qo'zg'olishga qarshi kurashda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa, Rossiyada kommunistik g'oyalarga asoslangan yangi ijtimoiy tartibni o'rnatishga urinishlarida unchalik xursand emas edi.

en: The Russian peasant is a small land-hungry proprietor, as far from communism in his thoughts and methods as a whale is from ﬂying; the revolution gave him the land of the great landowners but could not make him grow food for anything but negotiable money, and the revolution, among other things, had practically destroyed the value of money.
uz: Rus dehqoni kichik yerga chanqoq mulkdordir, uning fikrlari va usullari kommunizmdan uzoqroq, xuddi kit uchgandek; inqilob unga buyuk yer egalarining yerini berdi, lekin uni faqat kelishuvga asoslangan pulga oziq-ovqat yetishtirishga majbur qila olmadi va inqilob, boshqa narsalar qatorida, pul qiymatini deyarli yo'q qildi.

en: Agricultural production, already
uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi ishlab chiqarish, allaqachon

en: greatly disordered by the collapse of the railways through war-strain, shrank to a mere cultivation of food by the peasants for their own consumption.
uz: Urush zo'riqishi natijasida temir yo'llarning qulashi natijasida juda tartibsizlashgan, dehqonlar tomonidan o'z iste'moli uchun oziq-ovqat yetishtirishga aylandi.

en: Hasty and ill-planned attempts to make over industrial production in accordance with communist ideas were equally unsuccessful.
uz: Shoshilinch va noto'g'ri rejalashtirilgan kommunistik g'oyalarga muvofiq sanoat ishlab chiqarishini qayta ishlashga urinishlar bir xilda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

en: By 1920 Russia presented the unprecedented spectacle of a modern civiliza- tion in complete collapse.
uz: 1920 yilga kelib, Rossiya zamonaviy sivilizatsiyaning toʻliq qulashdagi misli koʻrilmagan koʻrinishini taqdim etdi.

en: Railways were rusting and passing out of use, towns were falling into ruin, everywhere there was an immense mortality.
uz: Temir yo'llar zanglab, yaroqsiz holga kelib qolmoqda edi, shaharlar vayronaga aylanib bormoqda, hamma joyda ulkan o'lim holatlari kuzatilmoqda edi.

en: Yet the country still fought with its enemies at its gates.
uz: Shunga qaramay, mamlakat hali ham o'z darvozalarida dushmanlari bilan kurashardi.

en: In 1921 came a drought and a great famine among the peasant cultivators in the war-devas- tated south-east provinces.
uz: 1921-yilda urush devlari bilan bezatilgan janubi-sharqiy viloyatlardagi dehqon dehqonlari orasida qurg'oqchilik va katta ocharchilik yuz berdi.

en: Millions of people starved.
uz: Millionlab odamlar och qoldi.

en: But the question of the distresses and the possible recuperation of Russia brings us too close to current controversies to be discussed here.
uz: Lekin Rossiya azob-uqubatlari va uning qayta tiklanishi masalasi bizni bu yerda muhokama qilinadigan hozirgi bahs-munozaralarga juda yaqinlashtiradi.

en: LXVII THE POLITICAL AND SOCIAL RECONSTRUCTION OF THE WORLD The scheme and scale upon which this History is planned do not permit us to enter into the complicated and acrimonious disputes that centre about the treaties, and particularly of the treaty of Versailles, which concluded the Great War.
uz: LXVII DUNyoning siyosiy va ijtimoiy tiklanishi Ushbu Tarix rejalashtirilgan sxema va masshtab bizga shartnomalar, xususan, Buyuk Urushni yakunlagan Versal shartnomasi haqidagi murakkab va achchiq bahslarga kirishishga ruxsat bermaydi.

en: We are beginning to realize that that conﬂict, terrible and enor- mous as it was, ended nothing, began nothing and settled nothing.
uz: Biz shuni anglay boshlayapmizki, o'sha mojaro, qanday dahshatli va ulkan bo'lmasin, hech narsaga chek qo'ymadi, hech narsa boshlamadi va hech narsani hal qilmadi.

en: It killed millions of people; it wasted and impoverished the world.
uz: U millionlab odamlarni o'ldirdi; dunyoni behudaga aylantirdi va qashshoqlashtirdi.

en: It smashed Rus- sia altogether.
uz: Rus-siyani butunlay sindirdi.

en: It was at best an acute and frightful reminder that we were living foolishly and confusedly without much plan or foresight in a danger- ous and unsympathetic universe.
uz: Bu, eng yaxshi holatda, biz xavfli va shafqatsiz olamda ahmoqona va chalkash holda, ko'p reja yoki oldindan ko'rish qobiliyatisiz yashayotganimizni o'tkir va dahshatli eslatma edi.

en: The crudely organized egotisms and pas- sions of national and imperial greed that carried mankind into that tragedy, emerged from it sufﬁciently unimpaired to make some other similar disaster highly probable so soon as the world has a little recovered from its war ex- haustion and fatigue.
uz: Insoniyatni o'sha fojiaga olib kirgan qo'pol tashkil etilgan milliy va imperial hirs egotizmlari va passionlari, dunyo urushdan biroz tiklanganda, boshqa shunga o'xshash falokatlar yuqori ehtimolga ega bo'lishi uchun yetarli darajada zararsiz holda paydo bo'ldi.

en: Wars and revolutions make nothing; their utmost ser- vice to mankind is that, in a very rough and painful way, they destroy super- annuated and obstructive things.
uz: Urushlar va inqiloblar hech narsani anglatmaydi; ularning insoniyat uchun eng katta zararlari shundaki, ular juda qo'pol va og'riqli tarzda juda qo'pol va to'siq bo'lgan narsalarni yo'q qilishadi.

en: The great war lifted the threat of German imperialism from Europe, and shattered the imperialism of Russia.
uz: Buyuk urush Yevropadan Germaniya imperializmining tahdidini olib tashladi va Rossiyaning imperializmini parchalab tashladi.

en: It cleared away a number of monarchies.
uz: U bir qator monarxiyalarni yo'q qildi.

en: But a multitude of ﬂags still waves in Europe, the frontiers still exasperate, great armies accumulate fresh stores of equipment.
uz: Lekin Yevropada hali ham ko'plab bayroqlar tarqalmoqda, chegaralar hali ham g'azablanib bormoqda, buyuk armiyalar yangi uskunalar zaxiralarini to'playapti.

en: The Peace Conference at Versailles was a gathering very ill adapted to do more than carry out the conﬂicts and defeats of the war to their logical con- clusions.
uz: Versaldagi Tinchlik Konferensiyasi urushdagi mojarolar va mag'lubiyatlarni o'zlarining mantiqiy xulosalariga ko'ra amalga oshirishdan ko'proq narsaga juda yomon moslashgan yig'ilish edi.

en: The Germans, Austrians, Turks and Bulgarians were permitted no share in its deliberations; they were only to accept the decisions it dictated
uz: Germaniyaliklar, avstriyaliklar, turklar va bolgarlarga uning muhokamalarida ishtirok etishga ruxsat berilmadi; ular faqat u buyurgan qarorlarni qabul qilishlari kerak edi.

en: From the point of view of human welfare the choice of the place of meeting was particularly unfortunate.
uz: Inson farovonligi nuqtai nazaridan uchrashuv joyini tanlash ayniqsa achinarli edi.

en: It was at Versailles in 1871 that, with every circumstance of triumphant vulgarity, the new German Empire had been proclaimed.
uz: 1871-yilda Versalda, har qanday galaba qozongan beodoblik holatida, yangi Germaniya imperiyasi elon qilingan edi.
