uz: Va bir necha marta shunday bo'ldiki, ikki ruhoniy bir xoch bilan birga kimdir uchun borar ekan, uch yoki to'rt piyoz, tashuvchilar tomonidan ko'tarilib, oxirgisi orqasida saf tortardilar, 13 va ruhoniylar faqat bitta o'likni dafn etishni o'ylashgan bo'lsalar, ularning olti yoki sakkizta piyozi bor edi, va undan ham ko'proq.

en: Nor therefore were the dead honoured with aught of tears or candles or funeral train; nay, the thing was come to such a pass that folk recked no more of men that died than nowadays they would of goats; whereby it very manifestly appeared that that which the natural course of things had not availed, by dint of small and infrequent harms, to teach the wise to endure with patience, the very greatness of their ills had brought even the simple to expect and make no account of.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'liklar hech qanday ko'z yoshlari, shamlar yoki dafn marosimi bilan taqdirlanmagan; aksincha, bu holat shunday o'tib ketgan ediki, odamlar o'lgan odamlarni hozirgi kunda echkilardan ko'ra ko'p hisoblamagan edilar; shu bilan birga, tabiiy tabiatning kichik va kam uchraydigan zararlari tufayli donolarga sabr bilan bardosh berishni o'rgatmagan narsa, ularning yomonliklarining o'ta buyukligi hatto oddiylarni ham kutishga va hisobga bermaslikka olib kelgan edi.

en: The consecrated ground sufﬁcing not to the burial of the vast multitude of corpses aforesaid, which daily and well nigh hourly came car- ried in crowds to every church —especially if it were sought to give each his own place, according to ancient usance —there were made throughout the churchyards, after every other part was full, vast trenches, wherein those who came after were laid by the hundred and being heaped up therein by layers, as goods are stowed aboard ship, were covered with a little earth, till such time as they reached the top of the trench.
uz: Yuqorida aytilgan ko'plab jasadlarni dafn etish uchun yetarli bo'lmagan muqaddas yer, ular har kuni va deyarli har soatda har bir cherkovga olomon bilan kelardi  ayniqsa, agar u har biriga o'z o'rnini bermoqchi bo'lsa, qadimgi urfga ko'ra  cherkovlar bo'ylab qurilgan edi, har bir qismi to'la bo'lgandan so'ng, keng xandaqlar paydo bo'lgan edi, ulardan keyin kelganlar yuzlab qo'yilardi va u yerda qatlamlar bilan yig'ilgan edi, xuddi kemaga yuk tashlanganidek, ular xandaqning tepasiga yetguncha biroz tuproq bilan qoplangan edi.

en: Moreover —not to go longer searching out and recalling every particular of our past miseries, as they befell throughout the city —I say that, whilst so sinister a time prevailed in the latter, on no wise therefor was the surround- ing country spared, wherein, (letting be the castles,14 which in their little- ness15 were like unto the city), throughout the scattered villages and in the ﬁelds, the poor and miserable husbandmen and their families, without suc- cour of physician or aid of servitor, died, not like men, but well nigh like beasts, by the ways or in their tillages or about the houses, indifferently by day and night.
uz: Qolaversa  butun shahar boʻylab sodir boʻlgan oʻtmishdagi musibatlarimizning har bir tafsilotini qidirib, eslab qolmaslik uchun  aytmoqchimanki, oxirgi davrda shunchalik dahshatli davr hukm surgan boʻlsa-da, hech qanday sababga koʻra, atrofdagi qishloqlar (oʻzlarining kichikligi bilan shaharga oʻxshash boʻlgan, 14 qasrlarni hisobga olmaganda), tarqoq qishloqlar va dalalarda, kambagʻal va bechora dehqonlar va ularning oilalari, shifokor yordamisiz yoki xizmatkor yordamisiz, odamlar kabi emas, balki hayvonlar kabi befarq, yoʻllarda yoki ularning dehqonlarida yoki uylar atrofida, kunduzi va kechasi befarq oʻlishdi.

en: By reason whereof, growing lax like the townsfolk in their
uz: Shuning uchun ham, shahar aholisi kabi o'sib borayotgan beparvolik o'z...

en: manners and customs, they recked not of any thing or business of theirs; nay, all, as if they looked for death that very day, studied with all their wit, not to help to maturity the future produce of their cattle and their ﬁelds and the fruits of their own past toils, but to consume those which were ready to hand.
uz: odob-axloq va urf-odatlar, ular o'zlarining hech qanday narsasidan yoki ishlaridan beparvo edilar; yo'q, hamma, go'yo o'sha kuni o'limni qidirgandek, o'zlarining barcha aql-idroklari bilan o'qidilar, kelajakdagi qoramollari va dalalari hamda o'zlarining o'tmish mehnatlari mevalarini yetilishga yordam berish uchun emas, balki qo'lga tayyor bo'lganlarini iste'mol qilish uchun.

en: Thus it came to pass that the oxen, the asses, the sheep, the goats, the swine, the fowls, nay, the very dogs, so faithful to mankind, being driven forth of their own houses, went straying at their pleasure about the ﬁelds, where the very corn was abandoned, without being cut, much less gathered in; and many, well nigh like reasonable creatures, after grazing all day, re- turned at night, glutted, to their houses, without the constraint of any herdsman.
uz: Shunday qilib, shunday bo'ldiki, ho'kizlar, eshaklar, qo'ylar, echkilar, cho'chqalar, to'ng'izlar, yo'q, insoniyatga shunchalik sodiq bo'lgan itlar, o'z uylaridan haydalgan holda, o'z xohishlariga ko'ra dalalarda adashib ketishdi, u yerda makkajo'xori tashlab ketilgan, kesilmagan, deyarli yig'ilgan edi; va ko'pchilik, aql-idrokli mavjudotlarga o'xshab, butun kun o'tlab, tunlari qaytib, hech qanday chorvadorning cheklovisiz, uylariga to'yib ketishdi.

en: To leave the country and return to the city, what more can be said save that such and so great was the cruelty of heaven (and in part, peradventure, that of men) that, between March and the following July, what with the vir- ulence of that pestiferous sickness and the number of sick folk ill tended or forsaken in their need, through the fearfulness of those who were whole, it is believed for certain that upward of an hundred thousand human beings perished within the walls of the city of Florence, which, peradventure, be- fore the advent of that death-dealing calamity, had not been accounted to hold so many?
uz: Mamlakatni tark etib, shaharga qaytish uchun yana nima deyish mumkin, faqat shunday va shunchalik buyuk jannat shafqatsizligi (va qisman, tasodifan, odamlarning shafqatsizligi) bo'lganidan tashqari, martdan keyingi iyulgacha bo'lgan davrda o'sha o'latli kasallik va sog'lom odamlarning qo'rquvi tufayli davolangan yoki tashlab ketilgan bemorlar soni bilan birga, Florensiya shahri devorlari ichida yuz mingdan ortiq odam halok bo'lgani aniq ishoniladi, bu esa tasodifan, o'sha halokatli ofat kelishidan oldin, bunchalik ko'p odamni ushlab turishga arzimaydi.

en: Alas, how many great palaces, how many goodly houses, how many noble mansions, once full of families, of lords and of ladies, abode empty even to the meanest servant!
uz: Afsuski, naqadar buyuk saroylar, naqadar yaxshi uylar, naqadar olijanob saroylar, bir vaqtlar oilalar, xojayinlar va xonimlar bilan tola bolgan, eng oddiy xizmatkorga ham bosh joyda yashaydi!

en: How many memorable families, how many ample heritages, how many famous fortunes were seen to remain without lawful heir!
uz: Qancha xotirali oilalar, qancha keng meroslar, qancha mashhur boyliklar qonuniy merosxo'rsiz qolgani ko'rindi!

en: How many valiant men, how many fair ladies, how many sprightly youths, whom, not others only, but Galen, Hippocrates or Aesculapius themselves would have judged most hale, breakfasted in the morning with their kinsfolk, comrades and friends and that same night supped with their ancestors in the other world!
uz: Qancha jasur erkaklar, qancha go'zal ayollar, qancha yorqin yoshlar, ularni nafaqat boshqalar, balki Galen, Hippokrat yoki Aeskulapiusning o'zlari ham eng ko'p hurmat qilgan bo'lardi, ertalab qarindoshlari, o'rtoqlari va do'stlari bilan nonushta qilgan va o'sha kechasi boshqa dunyoda ajdodlari bilan ovqatlangan!

en: I am myself weary of going wandering so long among such miseries; wherefore, purposing henceforth to leave such part thereof as I can ﬁtly, I say that —our city being at this pass, well nigh void of inhabitants —it chanced (as I afterward heard from a person worthy of credit) that there foregathered in the venerable church of Santa Maria Novella, one Tuesday morning when there was well nigh none else there, seven young ladies, all knit one to another by friendship or neighbourhood or kinship, who had heard divine service in mourning attire, as sorted with such a season.
uz: Men o'zim ham bunday azoblar orasida shunchalik uzoq vaqt sarson bo'lishdan charchadim; shuning uchun, bundan buyon uning imkon qadar yaxshi qismini qoldirishni maqsad qilgan holda, aytamanki, shaharimiz shu bo'yida bo'lgani, aholisi deyarli yo'qligi sababli  tasodifan (keyinroq maqtovga loyiq odamdan eshitganimdek) Santa Maria Novellaning hurmatli cherkovida, bir seshanba kuni ertalab, u yerda deyarli hech kim yo'q edi, yetti yosh xonim, ularning barchasi do'stlik yoki qo'shnichilik yoki qarindoshlik bilan bir-biriga bog'langan edi, ular motam libosida ilohiy xizmatni eshitgan edilar, xuddi shunday mavsumda.

en: Not one of them had passed her eight-and-twentieth year nor was less than
uz: Ularning hech biri uning yigirma sakkizinchi yoshidan o'tmagan edi va undan kam ham emas edi.

en: eighteen years old, and each was discreet and of noble blood, fair of favour and well-mannered and full of honest sprightliness.
uz: O'n sakkiz yoshda edi, va ularning har biri nozik va olijanob qonli, xushmuomala, yaxshi tarbiyalangan va halol yorqinlikka to'la edi.

en: The names of these ladies I would in proper terms set out, did not just cause forbid me, to wit, that I would not have it possible that, in time to come, any of them should take shame by reason of the things hereinafter related as being told or hearkened by them, the laws of disport being nowadays somewhat straitened, which at that time, for the reasons above shown, were of the largest, not only for persons of their years, but for those of a much riper age; nor yet would I give occasion to the envious, who are still ready to carp at every praiseworthy life, on anywise to disparage the fair fame of these honourable ladies with unseemly talk.
uz: Bu xonimlarning ismlarini men to'g'ri tilda aytmoqchi bo'lganim, faqatgina meni taqiqlamaslikka sabab bo'lmadi, ya'ni kelajakda ularning hech biri ular tomonidan aytilgan yoki eshitilgan quyidagi narsalar tufayli uyalmasligi mumkin edi. Hozirgi kunda sport qonunlari biroz toraytirilgan edi, o'sha paytda, yuqorida ko'rsatilgan sabablarga ko'ra, nafaqat o'z yoshidagilar uchun, balki ancha yetuk yoshdagilar uchun eng kattaroq edi; shuningdek, men har qanday maqtovga sazovor hayotda yurishga tayyor bo'lgan hasadgo'ylarga hech qanday holatda bu hurmatga loyiq xonimlarning adolatli shuhratini kamsitishga imkon bermasdim.

en: Wherefore, so that which each saith may hereafterward be apprehended without confusion, I purpose to denominate them by names altogether or in part sorting with each one’s quality.16 The ﬁrst of them and her of ripest age I shall call Pampinea, the second Fiammetta, the third Filomena and the fourth Emilia.
uz: Shuning uchun, har kim aytgan gaplari kelajakda chalkashliksiz anglanishi uchun, ularni har birining sifatiga qarab to'liq yoki qisman ismlar bilan ajratishni niyat qilaman. 16 Ularning birinchisini va eng yetukini Pampinea deb atayman, ikkinchisini Fiammetta, uchinchisini Filomena va to'rtinchisini Emilia deb atayman.

en: To the ﬁfth we will give the name of Lauretta, to the sixth that of Neiﬁle and the last, not without cause, we will style Elisa.17 These, then, not drawn of any set pur- pose, but foregathering by chance in a corner of the church, having seated themselves in a ring, after divers sighs, let be the saying of paternosters and fell to devising with one another many and various things of the nature of the time.
uz: Beshinchisiga Lauretta nomini beramiz, oltinchisiga Neifile nomini beramiz va oxirgisiga bejizga emas, Elisa nomini beramiz. 17 Shunday qilib, bular hech qanday to'plamdan emas, balki cherkovning bir burchagida tasodifan yig'ilib, o'zlarini halqaga o'tqazib, turli xil nafaslardan so'ng, ota-onalarning so'zlari bo'lsin va o'sha davr tabiatining ko'p va xilma-xil narsalarini bir-birlari bilan o'ylab topishga tushdilar.

en: After awhile, the others being silent, Pampinea proceeded to speak thus: “Dear my ladies, you may, like myself, have many times heard that whoso honestly useth his right doth no one wrong; and it is the natural right of everyone who is born here below to succour, keep and defend his own life as best he may, and in so far is this allowed that it hath happened whiles that, for the preservation thereof, men have been slain without any fault.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, qolganlar jim bo'lib qolgach, Pampiyena shunday dedi: "Aziz xonimlar, siz ham o'zim kabi, kimki o'z huquqidan halol foydalansangiz, hech kimga zulm qilmasligini ko'p marta eshitgan bo'lishingiz mumkin; va bu yerda tug'ilgan har bir kishining o'z hayotini qo'llab-quvvatlash, qo'lidan kelgancha saqlab qolish va himoya qilish tabiiy huquqi, va hozirgacha bu sodir bo'lishiga ruxsat berilgan, ammo uni saqlash uchun odamlar hech qanday aybsiz o'ldirilgan."

en: If this much be conceded of the laws, which have in view the well-being of all mortals, how much more is it lawful for us and whatsoever other, without offence unto any, to take such means as we may for the preservation of our lives?
uz: Agar barcha o'luvchilarning farovonligini inobatga olgan qonunlardan shunchalik ko'p narsa qabul qilinsa, biz va boshqa har qanday narsa uchun hech kimga xiyonat qilmasdan, hayotimizni saqlash uchun qo'limizdan kelgancha vositalarni qo'llash qanchalik qonuniydir?

en: As often as I consider our fashions of this morning and those of many other mornings past and bethink me what and what manner discourses are ours, I feel, and you likewise must feel, that each of us is in fear for herself.
uz: Bugun ertalabki va o'tgan kunlarning ko'plab modalarini ko'rib chiqib, nutqlarimiz qanday va qanday bo'lishi haqida o'ylab ko'rsam, har birimiz o'zimizdan qo'rqayotganimizni his qilyapman va siz ham shunday his qilishingiz kerak.

en: Nor do I anywise wonder at this; but I wonder exceedingly, considering that we all have a woman’s wit, that we take no steps to provide ourselves against that which each of us justly feareth.
uz: Men bunga hech qanday hayron bo'lmayman; lekin har birimizda ayol aqli borligini hisobga olsak, har birimiz haqli ravishda qo'rqadigan narsaga qarshi o'zimizni ta'minlash uchun hech qanday qadam tashlamaymiz, deb juda hayron qolaman.

en: We abide here, to my seeming, no otherwise than as if we would or should be witness of how many dead
uz: Biz bu yerda, menimcha, faqatgina o'lganlar soniga guvoh bo'lgandek yoki guvoh bo'lishimiz kerakdek turamiz.

en: bodies are brought hither for burial or to hearken if the friars of the place, whose number is come well nigh to nought, chant their ofﬁces at the due hours or by our apparel to show forth unto whosoever appeareth here the nature and extent of our distresses.
uz: jasadlar bu yerga dafn etish uchun yoki eshitish uchun olib kelinadi, agar joydagi rohiblar, ularning soni nolga yaqin bo'lsa, o'z lavozimlarini tayinlangan soatlarda yoki kiyimimiz bilan baqirib, bu yerda paydo bo'lgan har bir kishiga azoblarimizning mohiyati va darajasini ko'rsatish uchun.

en: If we depart hence, we either see dead bodies or sick persons carried about or those, whom for their misdeeds the authority of the public laws whilere condemned to exile, overrun the whole place with unseemly excesses, as if scofﬁng at the laws, for that they know the executors thereof to be either dead or sick; whilst the dregs of our city, fattened with our blood, style themselves pickmen and rufﬂe it everywhere in mockery of us, riding and running all about and ﬂouting us with our dis- tresses in ribald songs.
uz: Agar biz bu yerdan ketadigan bo'lsak, biz yoki o'lik jasadlar yoki kasal odamlarni olib ketayotganini ko'ramiz, yoki o'z xatti-harakatlari uchun davlat qonunlarining hokimiyati ularni surgun qilishga mahkum etgan holda, butun joyni behayo haddan tashqari narsa bilan bosib, go'yo qonunlarni masxara qilgandek, chunki ular uning ijrochilarini yoki o'lik yoki kasal ekanligini bilishadi; bizning qonimiz bilan to'yingan shahar axlatlari esa, o'zlari bizni masxara qilib, hamma joyda o'ynashadi, minish va yugurish bilan bizni qo'shiqlar bilan bezovta qilishadi.

en: We hear nothing here but ‘Such an one is dead’ or ‘Such an one is at the point of death’; and were there any to make them, we should hear dolorous lamentations on all sides.
uz: Biz bu yerda faqat "Bunday odam o'ldi" yoki "Bunday odam o'lim yo'lida" degan gaplarni eshitmaymiz; va agar ularni yasash uchun biror narsa bo'lsa, har tomondan achinarli faryodlarni eshitishimiz kerak.

en: And if we return to our houses, I know not if it is with you as with me, but, for my part, when I ﬁnd none left therein of a great household, save my serving-maid, I wax fearful and feel every hair of my body stand on end; and wherever I go or abide about the house, meseemeth I see the shades of those who are departed and who wear not those countenances that I was used to see, but terrify me with a horrid aspect, I know not whence newly come to them.
uz: Agar uylarimizga qaytsak, u siz bilan ham men bilan bo'lganidekmi yo'qmi bilmayman, lekin men o'z navbatimda, u yerda xizmatkorimdan boshqa katta xonadondan qolmaganimni ko'rsam, qo'rqib ketaman va tanamning har bir tukini tik turganini his qilaman; va qayerga borsam ham, uy atrofida yashayman, men ketganlar va men ko'rgan ko'rinishlarni kiymaydiganlar soyalarini ko'raman, lekin meni dahshatli ko'rinish bilan qo'rqitadi, men ularga qayerdan kelganimni bilmayman.

en: By reason of these things I feel myself alike ill at ease here and abroad and at home, more by token that meseemeth none, who hath, as we have, the power and whither to go, is left here, other than ourselves; or if any such there be, I have many a time both heard and perceived that, without making any distinction between things lawful and unlawful, so but appetite move them, whether alone or in company, both day and night, they do that which affordeth them most delight.
uz: Shu narsalar tufayli men o'zimni shu yerda ham, chet elda ham, uyda ham bemalol his qilyapman, chunki hech kim, bizda boridek, kuchga va boradigan joyga ega bo'lmagan, bu yerda qoldirilmagan; yoki agar shunday narsa bo'lsa, men ko'p marta eshitganman va sezganman, qonuniy va noqonuniy narsalarni hech qanday farq qilmasdan, lekin ishtahani qo'zg'atadi, xoh yolg'iz bo'lsin, xoh kechasi, xoh kechasi, ular eng ko'p zavq olishlariga imkon beradigan ishni qilishadi.

en: Nor is it the laity alone who do thus; nay, even those who are shut in the monasteries, persuading themselves that what be- ﬁtteth and is lawful to others alike sortable and unforbidden unto them,18 have broken the laws of obedience and giving themselves to carnal delights, thinking thus to escape, are grown lewd and dissolute.
uz: Nafaqat dindorlar shunday qiladilar; aksincha, hatto monastirlarda qamalib qolganlar ham, o'zlarini boshqalarga mos keladigan va qonuniy bo'lgan narsa ularga bir xilda hal qilinishi va taqiqlanmasligi kerakligiga ishontirib, itoat qonunlarini buzib, o'zlarini shahvoniy lazzatlarga beradilar va shu tariqa qochib qutulishni o'ylab, behayo va buzuq bo'lib qolishadi.

en: If thus, then, it be, as is manifestly to be seen, what do we here?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, unda, ko'rinib turganidek, biz bu yerda nima qilyapmiz?

en: Why are we more sluggish and slower to provide for our safety than all the rest of the townsfolk?
uz: Nega biz o'z xavfsizligimizni ta'minlashda shahar aholisidan ko'ra dangasaroq va sekinroqmiz?

en: Deem we ourselves of less price than others, or do we hold our life to be bounden in our bodies with a stronger chain than is theirs and that therefore we need reck nothing of aught that hath power to harm it?
uz: O'zimizni boshqalardan arzonroq deb hisoblaymizmi yoki hayotimizni ularning tanasidan kuchliroq zanjir bilan bog'langan deb hisoblaymizmi va shuning uchun unga zarar yetkazishga qodir bo'lgan hech narsani hisoblamasligimiz kerakmi?

en: We err, we are deceived; what folly is ours, if we think thus!
uz: Xato qilamiz, aldanibmiz; agar shunday o'ylasak, qanday ahmoqligimiz bor!

en: As often as we choose to call to mind the number and quality of the youths and
uz: Yoshlarning soni va sifatini eslashga qanchalik ko'p qaror qilsak, va

en: ladies overborne of this cruel pestilence, we may see a most manifest proof thereof.
uz: Ayollar bu shafqatsiz o'latdan haddan tashqari aziyat chekkan bo'lsalar, biz buning eng aniq dalilini ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: Wherefore, in order that we may not, through wilfulness or nonchalance, fall into that wherefrom we may, peradventure, an we but will, by some means or other escape, I know not if it seem to you as it doth to me, but me- thinketh it were excellently well done that we, such as we are, depart this city, as many have done before us, and eschewing, as we would death, the dishonourable example of others, betake ourselves quietly to our places in the country, whereof each of us hath great plenty, and there take such diver- sion, such delight and such pleasance as we may, without anywise overpass- ing the bounds of reason.
uz: Shunday ekan, biz, qasddan yoki beparvolik bilan, tasodifan qayerdan qochib qutulishimiz mumkin bo'lsa, o'sha yerga tushib ketmasligimiz uchun, bilmadim, sizga menga shunday tuyulyaptimi, lekin menimcha, juda yaxshi bo'ldi, biz ham xuddi shundaymiz, bu shaharni tark etamiz, xuddi ko'pchilik oldimizda qilganidek, va o'limni xohlaganimizdek, boshqalarning sharmandali namunasidan chetda qolib, har birimizda juda ko'p narsa bor bo'lgan mamlakatdagi o'z joylarimizga sokin ravishda o'tamiz, va u yerda shunday ko'ngilxushlik va quvonchlarni hech qanday yo'l bilan o'tkazib yubormaymiz.

en: There may we hear the small birds sing, there may we see the hills and plains clad all in green and the ﬁelds full of corn wave even as doth the sea; there may we see trees, a thousand sorts, and there is the face of heaven more open to view, the which, angered against us though it be, nevertheless denieth not unto us its eternal beauties, far good- lier to look upon than the empty walls of our city.
uz: U yerda biz mayda qushlarning kuylashini eshitishimiz mumkin, u yerda tepaliklar va tekisliklar yashil rangda qoplanganini va dengiz kabi makkajo'xori to'lqinlariga to'la dalalarni ko'rishimiz mumkin; u yerda biz daraxtlar, ming xil turlarni ko'rishimiz mumkin va osmon yuzi ko'proq ochiq ko'rinadi, u bizga g'azablangan bo'lsa ham, bizga o'zining abadiy go'zalliklarini rad etmaydi, shaharimizning bo'sh devorlaridan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi.

en: Moreover, there is the air far fresher19 and there at this season is more plenty of that which behoveth unto life and less is the sum of annoys, for that, albeit the husbandmen die there, even as do the townsfolk here, the displeasance is there the less, in- somuch as houses and inhabitants are rarer than in the city.
uz: Qolaversa, u yerda havo ancha toza19 va bu faslda hayotga kerak bo'ladigan narsalar ko'proq va bezovtalik miqdori kamroq, chunki u yerda dehqonlar o'lsa ham, xuddi shu yerda shaharliklar kabi, norozilik kamroq, chunki uylar va aholi shahardagidan kamroq uchraydi.

en: Here, on the other hand, if I deem aright, we abandon no one; nay, we may far rather say with truth that we ourselves are abandoned, seeing that our kinsfolk, either dying or ﬂeeing from death, have left us alone in this great tribulation, as it were we pertained not unto them.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, agar men to'g'ri deb hisoblasam, biz hech kimni tashlab ketmaymiz; yo'q, balki rostini aytsak, biz o'zimiz ham tashlab ketilganmiz, chunki qarindoshlarimiz, o'layotgan yoki o'limdan qochayotgan bo'lsalar ham, bizni bu buyuk musibatda yolg'iz qoldirishdi, go'yo ularga tegishli bo'lmagandek.

en: No blame can therefore befall the ensuing of this counsel; nay, dolour and chagrin and be- like death may betide us, an we ensue it not.
uz: Shunday ekan, bu maslahatning amalga oshishiga hech qanday ayb yo'q; yo'q, g'azab va xafalik va go'yo o'lim bizga yetib kelishi mumkin, lekin biz unga ergashmaymiz.

en: Wherefore, an it please you, methinketh we should do well to take our maids and letting follow after us with the necessary gear, sojourn today in this place and tomorrow in that, taking such pleasance and diversion as the season may afford, and on this wise abide till such time (an we be not earlier overtaken of death) as we shall see what issue Heaven reserveth unto these things.
uz: Shunday ekan, sizga yoqsa, xizmatkor qizlarimizni olib, kerakli jihozlar bilan orqamizga ergashtirganimiz ma'qul, bugun shu yerda va ertaga o'sha yerda qolishimiz, mavsum imkon qadar ko'ngilxushlik va qiziqarli mashg'ulotlardan bahramand bo'lishimiz va shu tarzda shunday vaqtgacha (o'limdan oldinroq o'tib ketmaganimizcha) turishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman, chunki biz Osmon bu narsalarga qanday masala qo'yganini ko'ramiz.

en: And I would re- mind you that it is no more forbidden unto us honourably to depart than it is unto many others of our sex to abide in dishonour.” The other ladies, having hearkened to Pampinea, not only commended her counsel, but, eager to follow it, had already begun to devise more par- ticularly among themselves of the manner, as if, arising from their session there, they were to set off out of hand.
uz: Va men sizni eslatib o'taman, bizga ketish bizning jinsimizdagi ko'pchilikka sharmandalikda qolishdan ko'ra sharafliroq taqiqlanmagan. Boshqa xonimlar Pamfiyaga quloq solib, nafaqat uning maslahatini maqtashdi, balki unga amal qilishga intilishardi, go'yo u yerdagi sessiyadan turib, qo'ldan ketish kerakdek, o'zaro yanada alohida tarzda o'ylab topishni boshlashdi.

en: But Filomena, who was exceeding
uz: Lekin Filomena, kim haddan tashqari

en: discreet, said, “Ladies, albeit that which Pampinea allegeth is excellently well said, yet is there no occasion for running, as meseemeth you would do.
uz: Xotirjam, dedi: Xonimlar, Pampiyaning da'vo qilganlari a'lo darajada aytilgan bo'lsa-da, lekin siz qilmoqchi bo'lganidek, yugurish uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q.

en: Remember that we are all women and none of us is child enough not to know how [little] reasonable women are among themselves and how [ill], without some man’s guidance, they know how to order themselves.
uz: Unutmangki, biz hammamiz ayollarmiz va hech birimiz o'zaro oqilona ayollar qanday ekanligini bilmaydigan darajada bola emasmiz va qanday qilib, qandaydir erkakning yo'l-yo'rig'isiz, o'zlarini qanday tartibga solishni bilishadi.

en: We are ﬁckle, wilful, suspicious, fainthearted and timorous, for which reasons I misdoubt me sore, an we take not some other guidance than our own, that our company will be far too soon dissolved and with less honour to ourselves than were seemly; wherefore we should do well to provide ourselves, ere we begin.” “Verily,” answered Elisa, “men are the head of women, and without their ordinance seldom cometh any emprise of ours to good end; but how may we come by these men?
uz: Biz beqaror, qasdparast, gumonkor, nozik qalbli va qo'rqoqmiz, shuning uchun men o'zimizning yo'l-yo'riqlarimizdan boshqa hech qanday yo'l-yo'riqni qabul qilmaymiz, chunki kompaniyamiz juda tezda tarqalib ketadi va o'zimizga nisbatan kamroq sharafga ega bo'ladi; shuning uchun biz boshlashimizdan oldin o'zimizni ta'minlashimiz kerak." "Haqiqatan ham," deb javob berdi Elisa, "erkaklar ayollarning boshliqidir va ularning tartibsiz bizning hech qanday ishlarimiz kamdan-kam hollarda muvaffaqiyatga erishadi; lekin biz bu odamlardan qanday foydalanishimiz mumkin?"

en: There is none of us but knoweth that of her kins- men the most part are dead and those who abide alive are all gone ﬂeeing that which we seek to ﬂee, in divers companies, some here and some there, without our knowing where, and to invite strangers would not be seemly, seeing that, if we would endeavour after our welfare, it behoveth us ﬁnd a means of so ordering ourselves that, wherever we go for diversion and re- pose, scandal nor annoy may ensue thereof.” Whilst such discourse was toward between the ladies, behold, there entered the church three young men —yet not so young that the age of the youngest of them was less than ﬁve-and-twenty years —in whom neither the perversity of the time nor loss of friends and kinsfolk, no, nor fear for them- selves had availed to cool, much less to quench, the ﬁre of love.
uz: Hech birimiz bilmaymizki, uning qarindoshlari - erkaklarning aksariyati o'lik va tirik qolganlarning hammasi qochmoqchi bo'lgan narsadan qochib ketishgan, turli xil kompaniyalarda, ba'zilari u yerda va ba'zilari u yerda, qayerga borishni bilmaymiz, va begonalarni taklif qilish ko'rinmas edi, chunki agar biz o'z farovonligimizga intilsak, o'zimizni shunday tartibga solish vositasini topishimiz kerakki, qayerga borsak ham, chalg'imaslik va qayta ko'rish, janjal yoki bezovtalik kelib chiqishi mumkin.

en: Of these one was called Pamﬁlo,20 another Filostrato21 and the third Dioneo,22 all very agreeable and well-bred, and they went seeking, for their supreme solace, in such a perturbation of things, to see their mistresses, who, as it chanced, were all three among the seven aforesaid; whilst certain of the oth- er ladies were near kinswomen of one or other of the young men.
uz: Bulardan biri Pamfilo deb atalgan, yana biri Filostrato, 21 va uchinchisi Dioneo, 22 ularning barchasi juda kelishgan va yaxshi tarbiyalangan edilar. Ular bunday tartibsizlikda o'zlarining bekasilarini ko'rishga borishdi, ular, ehtimol, yuqorida aytilgan yetti kishi orasida uch kishi edilar; shu bilan birga, boshqa ayollarning ba'zilari yigitlarning yaqin qarindoshlari edi.

en: No sooner had their eyes fallen on the ladies than they were themselves espied of them; whereupon quoth Pampinea, smiling, “See, fortune is fa- vourable to our beginnings and hath thrown in our way young men of worth and discretion, who will gladly be to us both guides and servitors, an we disdain not to accept of them in that capacity.” But Neiﬁle, whose face was grown all vermeil for shamefastness, for that it was she who was beloved of one of the young men, said, “For God’s sake, Pampinea, look what thou sayest!
uz: Ularning ko'zlari xonimlarga tushishi bilan, ularning o'zlari ham ularni kuzatib borishdi; shuning uchun Pampiyena tabassum qilib dedi: "Mana, omad bizning boshlanishlarimizga mos keladi va bizga yo'limizga arzirli va ehtiyotkor yoshlarni tashladi, ular bizga ham yo'lboshchi, ham xizmatkor bo'lishadi, va biz ularni bu sifatda qabul qilmaslikni istamaymiz".

en: I acknowledge most frankly that there can be nought but all good
uz: Men eng ochiqchasiga tan olaman, hech narsa bo'lishi mumkin, lekin hamma narsa yaxshi.

en: said of which one soever of them and I hold them sufﬁcient unto a much greater thing than this, even as I opine that they would bear, not only ourselves, but far fairer and nobler dames than we, good and honourable company.
uz: Bu haqda ulardan birortasi va men ularni bundan ham kattaroq narsaga yetarli deb hisoblayman, hatto menimcha, ular nafaqat o'zimizni, balki bizdan ancha go'zal va olijanob ayollarni, yaxshi va sharafli hamrohlikni olib yurishardi.

en: But, for that it is a very manifest thing that they are enamoured of certain of us who are here, I fear lest, without our fault or theirs, scandal and blame ensue thereof, if we carry them with us.” Quoth Filomena, “That skilleth nought; so but I live honestly and conscience prick me not of aught, let who will speak to the contrary; God and the truth will take up arms for me.
uz: Lekin, shuning uchun ham ularning bu yerda bo'lgan ba'zi birimizga oshiq ekanligi juda aniq, men ularning yoki bizning aybi yo'q, ularni o'zimiz bilan olib yurganimizda janjal va ayblanish kelib chiqishi mumkinligidan qo'rqaman. Quot Filomena, Hech qanday farq qilmaydi; shuning uchun men halol yashayman va vijdonim meni hech narsadan bezovta qilmaydi, kim aksincha gapirsin; Xudo va haqiqat men uchun qurol oladi.

en: Wherefore, if they be disposed to come, verily we may say with Pampinea that fortune is favourable to our going.” The other ladies, hearing her speak thus absolutely, not only held their peace, but all with one accord agreed that the young men should be called and acquainted with their project and bidden to be pleased bear them com- pany in their expedition.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar ular kelishga tayyor bo'lsalar, Pampinea bilan birga aytishimiz mumkinki, omad bizning borishimiz uchun afzal." Boshqa xonimlar uning bu gapini mutlaqo eshitib, nafaqat jim bo'lishdi, balki barcha bir ovozdan yigitlarni chaqirish va ularning loyihasi bilan tanishtirish va ularni ekspeditsiyada xursand qilishlari kerakligiga rozi bo'lishdi.

en: Accordingly, without more words, Pampinea, who was knit by kinship to one of them, rising to her feet, made for the three young men, who stood fast, looking upon them, and saluting them with a cheerful countenance, discovered to them their intent and prayed them, on behalf of herself and her companions, that they would be pleased to bear them company in a pure and brotherly spirit.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, hech qanday so'zsiz, ulardan biriga qarindoshlik bilan bog'langan Pampinea oyoqqa turdi va ularga tikilib, ko'z tikib, quvnoq yuz bilan salom bergan uchta yigitni o'ziga va o'z hamrohlari nomidan ularning niyatini anglab yetdi va ularga sof va birodarona ruhda sherik bo'lishdan mamnun bo'lishlarini so'radi.

en: The young men at the ﬁrst thought themselves bantered, but, seeing that the lady spoke in good earn- est, they made answer joyfully that they were ready, and without losing time about the matter, forthright took order for that which they had to do against departure.
uz: Yosh yigitlar birinchi o'yida masxara qilishdi, lekin xonimning chin dildan gapirganini ko'rib, xursandchilik bilan tayyor ekanliklarini aytishdi va bu masalada vaqtni yo'qotmasdan, ketishga qarshi qiladigan ishlarini darhol buyurdilar.

en: On the following morning, Wednesday to wit, towards break of day, hav- ing let orderly make ready all things needful and despatched them in ad- vance whereas they purposed to go,23 the ladies, with certain of their wait- ing-women, and the three young men, with as many of their serving-men, departing Florence, set out upon their way; nor had they gone more than two short miles from the city, when they came to the place fore-appointed of them, which was situate on a little hill, somewhat withdrawn on every side from the high way and full of various shrubs and plants, all green of leafage and pleasant to behold.
uz: Ertasi kuni, chorshanba kuni ertalab, tong otishi arafasida, barcha zarur narsalarni tartibli ravishda tayyorlab, jo'natib yuborgan holda, ular bormoqchi bo'lishdi. 23 Xonimlar, o'z xizmatkorlari bilan birga, uch yigit ham, ularning xizmatkorlari bilan birga Florensiyadan jo'nab ketishdi; shuningdek, ular shahardan ikki mildan ko'proq uzoqlashmagan edilar, lekin ular oldindan belgilangan joyga yetib kelishdi. Bu joy kichik tepalikda joylashgan edi, baland yo'ldan biroz chekingan va turli xil butalar va o'simliklarga to'la edi, barg'alar bilan yashil va yoqimli edi.

en: On the summit of this hill was a palace, with a goodly and great courtyard in its midst and galleries24 and saloons and bedchambers, each in itself most fair and adorned and notable with jocund paintings, with lawns and grassplots round about and wonder-goodly gar- dens and wells of very cold water and cellars full of wines of price, things more apt unto curious drinkers than unto sober and modest ladies.
uz: Bu tepalikning cho'qqisida saroy bor edi, uning o'rtasida yaxshi va ulkan hovli bor edi, shuningdek, galereyalar24 va saloonlar va yotoqxonalar bor edi, ularning har biri juda chiroyli, bezatilgan va jozyund rasmlari bilan ajralib turardi, atrofida maysazorlar va o'tloqlar, ajoyib daraxtzorlar, juda sovuq suv va qimmatbaho vinolarga to'la podvallar bor edi, bu narsa sog'lom va kamtarona ayollarga qaraganda qiziquvchan ichuvchilarga ko'proq mos keladi.

en: comers, to their no little pleasure, found the place all swept and the beds made in the chambers and everything full of such ﬂowers as might be had at that season and strewn with rushes.
uz: Kelganlar, o'zlarining hech qanday quvonchiga ko'ra, joyni butunlay supurilgan va xonalarda yasalgan karavotlar va o'sha mavsumda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan va shov-shuvlar bilan to'ldirilgan gullarga to'la hamma narsani topdilar.

en: As soon as they had seated themselves, Dioneo, who was the merriest springald in the world and full of quips and cranks, said, “Ladies, your wit, rather than our foresight, hath guided us hither, and I know not what you purpose to do with your cares; as for my own, I left them within the city gates, whenas I issued thence with you awhile agone; wherefore, do you either address yourselves to make merry and laugh and sing together with me (in so far, I mean, as pertaineth to your dignity) or give me leave to go back for my cares and abide in the afﬂicted city.” Whereto Pampinea, no otherwise than as if in like manner she had banished all her own cares, answered blithely, “Dioneo, thou sayst well; it behoveth us live merrily, nor hath any other occasion caused us ﬂee from yonder miseries.
uz: Ular o'tirishi bilanoq, Dioneo, dunyodagi eng quvnoq prujina bo'lib, qichqiriq va g'ijirlarga to'la edi, dedi: "Xonimlar, sizning aql-idrokingiz bizni bu yerga yo'naltirdi, va men sizning g'amxo'rligingiz bilan nima qilishingizni bilmayman; o'zimniki bo'lsa, men ularni shahar darvozalari ichida qoldirdim, men u yerdan siz bilan biroz o'tib ketganimda; shuning uchun, sizlar ham men bilan birga xursand bo'lish, kulish va kuylash uchun murojaat qilasizlarmi (shungacha, men sizning qadr-qimmatingizga ko'ra aytyapman) yoki menga qayg'ularim uchun qaytib ketishga va azob chekkan shaharda qolishga ruxsat bering.

en: But, for that things which are without measure may not long endure, I, who began the discourse wherethrough this so goodly company came to be made, taking thought for the continuance of our gladness, hold it of necessity that we ap- point someone to be principal among us, whom we may honour and obey as chief and whose especial care it shall be to dispose us to live joyously.
uz: Lekin, o'lchovsiz narsalar uzoq davom etmasligi uchun, men, shu qadar yaxshi hamrohlik bo'lish orqali nutqni boshlagan, quvonchimizni davom ettirishni o'ylab, o'zimiz orasimizda boshliq bo'lishimiz va unga boshliq sifatida hurmat ko'rsatishimiz va itoat etishimiz mumkin bo'lgan, bizni xursandchilik bilan yashashga yo'naltirish uchun alohida g'amxo'rlik qiladigan odamni tayinlashimiz zarur deb hisoblayman.

en: And in order that each in turn may prove the burden of solicitude, together with the pleasure of headship; and that, the chief being thus drawn, in turn, from one and the other sex, there may be no cause for jealousy, as might happen, were any excluded from the sovranty, I say that unto each be attributed the burden and the honour for one day.
uz: Va har bir kishi o'z navbatida boshliqlik lazzatini, shuningdek, g'amxo'rlik yukini isbotlashi uchun; va boshliq, o'z navbatida, bir va boshqa jinsdan jalb qilinsa, rashk qilishga hech qanday sabab bo'lmasligi uchun, agar hukmronlikdan chetlatilsa, men har bir kishiga bir kunlik yuk va sharaf yuklanishi kerakligini aytaman.

en: Let who is to be our ﬁrst chief be at the election of us all.
uz: Bizning birinchi boshliq bo'ladigan odam hammamizning saylanishimizda bo'lsin.

en: For who shall follow, be it he or she whom it shall please the governor of the day to appoint, whenas the hour of vespers draweth near, and let each in turn, at his or her discretion, order and dispose of the place and manner wherein we are to live, for such time as his or her sei- gnory shall endure.” Pampinea’s words pleased mightily, and with one voice they elected her chief of the ﬁrst day; whereupon Filomena, running nimbly to a laurel- tree —for that she had many a time heard speak of the honour due to the leaves of this plant and how worship-worth they made whoso was de- servedly crowned withal —and plucking divers sprays therefrom, made her thereof a goodly and honourable wreath, which, being set upon her head, was thenceforth, what while their company lasted, a manifest sign unto every other of the royal ofﬁce and seignory.
uz: Chunki kimga ergashish kerak bo'lsa, u kunning hokimini tayinlashi mumkin bo'lsa, kechki payt yaqinlashganda, va har kim o'z xohishiga ko'ra, biz yashaydigan joy va uslubni o'zicha tartibga solsin va tartibga solsin, toki uning ushlash muddati uzoqroq bo'lsin." Pampinea'ning so'zlari juda quvonchga to'la edi va bir ovozda uni birinchi kunning boshlig'i etib sayladilar; Filomena esa, tezda lavr daraxtiga yugurib,  chunki u ko'p vaqt davomida bu o'simlikning barglari tufayli bo'lgan sharaf haqida eshitgan edi va ular qanday ibodatga loyiq bo'lganini  va uning boshidagi har bir qirollik uchun qanday yaxshi va sharafli xizmat ko'rsatganini

en: Pampinea, being made queen, commanded that everyone should be si- lent; then, calling the serving-men of the three young gentlemen and her own and the other ladies’ women, who were four in number, before herself and all being silent, she spoke thus: “In order that I may set you a ﬁrst ex- ample, by which, proceeding from good to better, our company may live and last in order and pleasance and without reproach so long as it is agree- able to us, I constitute, ﬁrstly, Parmeno, Dioneo’s servant, my seneschal and commit unto him the care and ordinance of all our household and [espe- cially] that which pertaineth to the service of the saloon.
uz: Pampiyena, malika qilib tayinlanganidan so'ng, har bir kishiga o'z qarzini berishni buyurdi; so'ngra, uchta yosh janobning xizmatkorlarini, o'zining va boshqa xonimlarning ayollarini, to'rt kishi bo'lib, o'zining oldida va hammasi jim bo'lib, shunday dedi: "Sizga birinchi ex-ample qo'yishim uchun, shu orqali yaxshilikdan yaxshilikka qarab, bizning kompaniyamiz bizga rozi bo'lgancha tartib va lazzat bilan, aybsiz yashashi va yashashi mumkin bo'lishi uchun, men, avvalo, Parmeno, Dioneo'ning xizmatkorini, mening oqsoqolimni tayinlayman va unga butun xonadonimiz va ayniqsa, xizmatga tegishli bo'lgan narsalarni vasiyat qilaman."

en: Sirisco, Pamﬁlo’s servant, I will shall be our purveyor and treasurer and ensue the command- ments of Parmeno.
uz: Sirisk, Pamfilaning quli, men Parmenoning buyruqlarini nazorat qiluvchi va g'aznachi bo'lib bajaraman.

en: Tindaro shall look to the service of Filostrato and the other two gentlemen in their bed chambers, what time the others, being oc- cupied about their respective ofﬁces, cannot attend thereto.
uz: Tindaro Filostrato va boshqa ikki janobning xizmatini o'z yotoqxonalarida ko'radi, qolganlari o'z lavozimlari bilan band bo'lib, u yerga kelolmay qolganda.

en: Misia, my wo- man, and Filomena’s Licisca shall still abide in the kitchen and there dili- gently prepare such viands as shall be appointed them of Parmeno.
uz: Misia, mening odamim va Filomena'ning Liceschasi hali ham oshxonada qoladi va u yerda Parmenodan tayinlanadigan go'shtlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tayyorlaydi.

en: Laur- etta’s Chimera and Fiammetta’s Stratilia it is our pleasure shall occupy themselves with the ordinance of the ladies’ chambers and the cleanliness of the places where we shall abide; and we will and command all and sever- al, as they hold our favour dear, to have a care that, whithersoever they go or whencesoever they return and whatsoever they hear or see, they bring us from without no news other than joyous.” These orders summarily given and commended of all, Pampinea, rising blithely to her feet, said, “Here be gardens, here be meadows, here be store of other delectable places, wherein let each go a-pleasuring at will; and when tierce25 soundeth, let all be here, so we may eat in the cool.” The merry company, being thus dismissed by the new queen, went stray- ing with slow steps, young men and fair ladies together, about a garden, de- vising blithely and diverting themselves
uz: Laur-ettaning Ximera va Fiammettaning Stratilia'si bizning zavqimizdir, ular xonimlarning xonalari va biz yashaydigan joylarning tozaligi bilan shug'ullanadilar; va biz ularga qayerga bormasinlar yoki qayerga qaytmasinlar va nima ko'rmasinlar, bizni xursandchilikdan boshqa yangiliksiz olib kelishlariga amr qilamiz va qat'iy buyuramiz.

en: with weaving goodly garlands of various leaves and carolling amorously.
uz: Turli xil barglardan yaxshi to'qilgan va shahvoniy tarzda kuylagan guldastalar bilan.

en: After they had abidden there such time as had been appointed them of the queen, they returned to the house, where they found that Parmeno had made a diligent beginning with his of- ﬁce, for that, entering a saloon on the ground ﬂoor, they saw there the tables laid with the whitest of cloths and beakers that seemed of silver and everything covered with the ﬂowers of the broom; whereupon, having washed their hands, they all, by command of the queen, seated themselves according to Parmeno’s ordinance.
uz: Ular u yerda qirolichadan tayinlangan vaqtni o'tkazgandan so'ng, uyga qaytib kelishdi va Parmenoning o'z farzandi bilan tinimsiz ish boshlaganini aniqladilar. Shuning uchun, birinchi qavatdagi salonga kirgach, u yerda kumushga o'xshash eng oq matolar va supurgilar va supurgi gullari bilan qoplangan hamma narsa yotqizilgan stollarni ko'rishdi. Shundan so'ng, qo'llarini yuvgach, ularning barchasi, qirolichaning buyrug'iga ko'ra, Parmenoning qoidalariga muvofiq o'tirishdi.

en: Then came viands delicately drest and choicest wines were proffered and the three serving-men, without more,
uz: Keyin go'shtlar nozik kiyimda paydo bo'ldi va eng yaxshi vinolar tortildi va uchta xizmatkor, hech narsa yo'q,

en: quietly tended the tables.
uz: Sekin stollarni parvarishladi.

en: All, being gladdened by these things, for that they were fair and orderly done, ate joyously and with store of merry talk, and the tables being cleared away,26 the queen bade bring instruments of music, for that all the ladies knew how to dance, as also the young men, and some of them could both play and sing excellent well.
uz: Barcha bu narsalardan xursand bo'lib, ularning adolatli va tartibli bo'lgani uchun, xursandchilik bilan va quvnoq gaplar bilan ovqatlanishdi, stollar esa tozalanib ketdi. 26 Qirolicha musiqa asboblarini olib kelishni buyurdi, chunki barcha ayollar raqsga tushishni bilishardi, shuningdek, yigitlar ham, ularning ba'zilari ham yaxshi o'ynashlari va kuylashlari mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, by her com- mandment, Dioneo took a lute and Fiammetta a viol and began softly to sound a dance; whereupon the queen and the other ladies, together with the other two young men, having sent the serving-men to eat, struck up a round and began with a slow pace to dance a brawl; which ended, they fell to singing quaint and merry ditties.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, uning buyrug'iga ko'ra, Dioneo lyut va Fiammetta skripkasini oldi va sekin raqsga tushishni boshladi; shundan so'ng malika va boshqa xonimlar, boshqa ikki yigit bilan birga xizmatchilarni ovqatga yuborgan holda, bir davra o'tkazib, sekin raqsga tushib, mushtlashuvni boshladilar; bu esa tugab, ular g'alati va quvnoq qo'shiqlarni kuylashga tushdilar.

en: On this wise they abode till it seemed to the queen time to go to sleep,27 and she accordingly dismissed them all; whereupon the young men retired to their chambers, which were withdrawn from the ladies’ lodging, and ﬁnding them with the beds well made and as full of ﬂowers as the saloon, put off their clothes and betook themselves to rest, whilst the ladies, on their part, did likewise.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular qirolicha uxlash vaqti kelmaguncha qoldilar, 27 va u hammasini shunga ko'ra quvib yubordi; shundan so'ng yigitlar xonadonlaridan olib qo'yilgan xonalariga chekindilar va ularni yaxshi tayyorlangan va saloon kabi gullarga to'la to'la to'shaklar bilan topib, kiyimlarini yechib, dam olishdi, xonimlar esa o'z navbatida shunday qilishdi.

en: None28 had not long sounded when the queen, arising, made all the other ladies arise, and on like wise the three young men, alleging overmuch sleep to be harmful by day; and so they betook themselves to a little meadow, where the grass grew green and high nor there had the sun power on any side.
uz: Qirolicha ko'p vaqt o'tmay turib, qolgan barcha ayollarni o'rnidan turishga majbur qildi, va xuddi dono kabi uchta yigit kunduzi ko'p uxlash zararli deb da'vo qildilar; va shuning uchun ular o'zlarini kichkina maysazorga tashlashdi, u yerda o'tlar yashil va baland edi va hech qayerda quyosh nuri yo'q edi.

en: There, feeling the waftings of a gentle breeze, they all, as their queen willed it, seated themselves in a ring on the green grass; while she bespoke them thus, “As ye see, the sun is high and the heat great, nor is aught heard save the crickets yonder among the olives; wherefore it were doubtless folly to go anywhither at this present.
uz: U yerda, mayin shabada tovushini his qilib, ularning hammasi, malika xohlaganidek, yashil o't ustida halqa bo'ylab o'tirishdi; u esa ularga shunday deb so'radi: "Ko'rib turibsizki, quyosh baland va issiqlik katta, zaytunlar orasida u yerdagi qichqiriqlardan boshqa hech narsa eshitilmaydi; shuning uchun hozir bu yerda qayerga borishni shubhasiz ahmoqlik edi."

en: Here is the sojourn fair and cool, and here, as you see, are chess and tables,29 and each can divert himself as is most to his mind.
uz: Mana shu yerda sayohat adolatli va salqin, va mana, ko'rib turganingizdek, shaxmat va stollar bor, 29 va har biri o'zini eng ko'p o'ylaganicha chalg'itishi mumkin.

en: But, an my counsel be followed in this, we shall pass away this sultry part of the day, not in gaming —wherein the mind of one of the play- ers must of necessity be troubled, without any great pleasure of the other or of those who look on —but in telling stories, which, one telling, may afford diversion to all the company who hearken; nor shall we have made an end of telling each his story but the sun will have declined and the heat be abated, and we can then go a-pleasuring whereas it may be most agreeable to us.
uz: Lekin, mening maslahatimga amal qiling, biz kunning bu achchiq qismini o'ynash bilan emas, balki o'ynash bilan o'tkazamiz  unda o'yin mualliflaridan birining ongi albatta bezovta bo'lishi kerak, boshqa birovning yoki tomoshabinlarning hech qanday katta zavqisiz  balki hikoyalarni aytib berishda, ularni aytib berish, eshitayotganlarning hammasiga chalg'itish imkonini beradi; shuningdek, har birimizning hikoyasini aytib tugatmaymiz, lekin quyosh tushib, issiqlik kamayadi va keyin bizga eng yoqimli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan joyga borishimiz mumkin.

en: Wherefore, if this that I say please you, (for I am disposed to follow your pleasure therein), let us do it; and if it please you not, let each until the hour of vespers do what most liketh him.” Ladies and men alike all ap- proved the story-telling, whereupon, “Then,” said the queen, “since this pleaseth you, I will that this ﬁrst day each be free to tell of such matters as
uz: Shunday ekan, agar bu gapim sizga ma'qul kelsa (chunki men sizning roziligingizga ko'ra shunga amal qilishga tayyorman), kelinglar, agar sizga ma'qul kelmasa, har kim kechki paytgacha o'ziga yoqqanini qilsin." Xonimlar va erkaklar birdek bu hikoyani isbotladilar, shundan so'ng, "Unda," dedi malika, "bu sizga yoqqanligi sababli, men bu birinchi kun har bir kishiga shunday narsalar haqida gapirishga erkin bo'lishini xohlayman."

en: are most to his liking.” Then, turning to Pamﬁlo, who sat on her right hand, she smilingly bade him give beginning to the story-telling with one of his; and he, hearing the commandment, forthright began thus, whilst all gave ear to him.
uz: "Uning o'ng tomoniga o'tirgan Pamfiloga qarab, u tabassum bilan uning o'zidan biri bilan hikoyani boshlashni buyurdi; va u buyrug'ni eshitib, darhol shunday boshladi, hamma unga quloq solgan holda."

en: THE FIRST STORY Master Ciappelletto dupeth a holy friar with a false confession and dieth; and having been in his lifetime the worst of men, he is, after his death, reputed a saint and called Saint Ciappelletto.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Ustoz Ciappelletto muqaddas rohibni soxta e'tirof bilan aldadi va o'ladi; va hayoti davomida odamlarning eng yomoni bo'lganligi sababli, o'limidan keyin avliyo deb tanildi va Avliyo Ciappelletto deb ataladi.

en: “It is a seemly thing, dearest ladies, that whatsoever a man doth, he give it beginning from the holy and admirable name of Him who is the maker of all things.
uz: Qadrli xonimlar, inson nima qilsa ham, hamma narsani yaratuvchining muqaddas va hayratlanarli ismini boshlash juda go'zal ishdir.

en: Wherefore, it behoving me, as the ﬁrst, to give commencement to our story-telling, I purpose to begin with one of His marvels, to the end that, this being heard, our hope in Him, as in a thing immutable, may be con- ﬁrmed and His name be ever praised of us.
uz: Shunday ekan, men birinchi bo'lib hikoyamizni boshlashga to'g'ri keladi, shuning uchun Uning bir mo'jizalaridan boshlashni maqsad qilaman, toki eshitilganimizdan so'ng, Unga bo'lgan umidimiz o'zgarmas narsadek mustahkam bo'lsin va Uning ismi bizdan doimo maqtalanilsin.

en: It is manifest that, like as things temporal are all transitory and mortal, even so both within and without are they full of annoy and anguish and travail and subject to inﬁnite perils, against which it is indubitable that we, who live enmingled therein and who are indeed part and parcel thereof, might avail neither to endure nor to de- fend ourselves, except God’s especial grace lent us strength and foresight; which latter, it is not to be believed, descendeth unto us and upon us by any merit of our own, but of the proper motion of His own benignity and the ef- ﬁcacy of the prayers of those who were mortals even as we are and having diligently ensued His commandments, what while they were on life, are now with Him become eternal and blessed and unto whom we —belike not daring to address ourselves unto the proper presence of so august a judge — proffer our petitions of the things which
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, barcha vaqtinchalik narsalar o'tkinchi va o'tkinchi bo'lgani kabi, ular ham ichki va tashqi tomondan bezovtalik, azob va mehnatga to'la va cheksiz xavflarga duchor. Shubhasizki, biz, ular ichida yashayotgan va haqiqatan ham ularning bir qismi bo'lganlar, o'zimizni himoya qilishga ham, bardosh berishga ham qodir emasmiz, faqat Xudoning maxsus marhamati bizga kuch va bashorat berdi; bu oxirgi narsa, ishonish mumkin emas, bizga va bizga o'zimizning har qanday yaxshiligimiz bilan tushadi, lekin Uning o'zining mehribonligi va o'zimiz kabi o'lik bo'lganlarning ibodatlarining samarali harakatidan, ular hayotda bo'lganida, endi U bilan abadiy va barakali bo'lishadi  shunday qilib, biz Uning buyruqlariga sodiq bo'lishimiz kerak

en: we deem needful unto ourselves, as unto advocates30 informed by experience of our frailty.
uz: Biz o'z zaifligimiz tajribasi orqali ma'lum bo'lgan himoyachilar kabi o'zimizga zarur deb hisoblaymiz.

en: And this more we discern in Him, full as He is of compassionate liberality towards us, that, whereas it chanceth whiles (the keenness of mortal eyes availing not in any wise to penetrate the secrets of the Divine intent), that we peradventure, be- guiled by report, make such an one our advocate unto His majesty, who is
uz: Va bundan ham ko'proq biz U orqali, U bizga nisbatan rahmdillik va bag'rikenglik bilan to'la ekanligi sababli, shuni anglaymizki, garchi u (o'lmas ko'zlarning o'tkirligi Ilohiy niyat sirlariga hech qanday tarzda kirishga yordam bermasa ham), biz hisobotdan yo'naltirilgan holda, shunday bir kishini Uning ulug'vorligiga bizning himoyachimiz qilishimizga jur'at etamiz.

en: outcast from His presence with an eternal banishment —nevertheless He, from whom nothing is hidden, having regard rather to the purity of the sup- pliant’s intent than to his ignorance or to the reprobate estate of him whose intercession be invoketh, giveth ear unto those who pray unto the latter, as if he were in very deed blessed in His aspect.
uz: Uning huzuridan abadiy haydash bilan chetlatildi  ammo U, undan hech narsa yashirin bo'lmasa ham, o'zining jaholatidan ko'ra, qo'llab-quvvatlovchi niyatining pokligiga yoki shafoat so'raladigan odamning xor holatiga ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor berar ekan, oxirgisiga ibodat qilayotganlarga xuddi O'z ko'rinishida barakali bo'lgandek quloq soladi.

en: The which will manifestly ap- pear from the story which I purpose to relate; I say manifestly, ensuing, not the judgment of God, but that of men.
uz: Men aytib bermoqchi bo'lgan hikoyadan yaqqol ko'rinib turadigan narsa; men yaqqol aytyapman, Xudoning emas, balki odamlarning hukmiga ko'ra.

en: It is told, then, that Musciatto Franzesi,31 being from a very rich and con- siderable merchant in France become a knight and it behoving him thereupon go into Tuscany with Messire Charles Sansterre,32 brother to the king of France,33 who had been required and bidden thither by Pope Bon- iface,34 found his affairs in one part and another sore embroiled, (as those of merchants most times are), and was unable lightly or promptly to disen- tangle them; wherefore he bethought himself to commit them unto divers persons and made shift for all, save only he abode in doubt whom he might leave sufﬁcient to the recovery of the credits he had given to certain Bur- gundians.
uz: Shunday qilib, aytilishicha, Musciatto Franzesi, 31 Fransiyadagi juda boy va sotqin savdogardan kelib chiqib, ritsar bo'lgan va shuning uchun u Fransiya qiroliga birodar bo'lgan Messire Charles Sansterre bilan Toskaniyaga borishi kerak edi, 32 u yerda Rim Papasi Bon-iface tomonidan talab qilingan va taklif qilingan edi, 34 o'z ishlarini bir qismda, boshqa bir qismida og'rigan deb topdi (ko'pincha savdogarlarniki kabi), va ularni yengil yoki tezda chalkashtira olmadi; shuning uchun u o'zini ularni turli shaxslarga topshirib, hamma uchun o'tkazdi, faqatgina u qaysidirga bergan kreditlarini qaytarishga yetarli darajada qo'yib yuborishiga shubha bilan qoldi.

en: The cause of his doubt was that he knew the Burgundians to be litigious, quarrelsome fellows, ill-conditioned and disloyal, and could not call one to mind, in whom he might put any trust, curst enough to cope with their perversity.
uz: Uning shubhasi bor edi, chunki u burgundliklarni bahsli, janjalkash, noqulay va sadoqatsiz odamlar deb bilardi va ularning buzuqligiga bardosh berish uchun yetarlicha qisiq bo'lgan hech kimni eslay olmasdi.

en: After long consideration of the matter, there came to his memory a certain Master Ciapperello da Prato, who came often to his house in Paris and whom, for that he was little of person and mighty nice in his dress, the French, knowing not what Cepparello35 meant and thinking it be the same with Cappello, to wit, in their vernacular, Chaplet, called him, not Cappello, but Ciappelletto,36 and accordingly as Ciappelletto he was known everywhere, whilst few knew him for Master Ciapperello.
uz: Masalani uzoq o'ylab ko'rgach, uning xotirasiga Parijdagi uyiga tez-tez keladigan va shu sababli ozgina odam bo'lgani va libosida juda chiroyli bo'lgani uchun, fransuzlar Cepparello35 nimani nazarda tutganini bilmay, uni Cappello bilan bir xil deb o'ylashardi. Ya'ni, ularning xalq tilida, Chaplet, uni Cappello emas, balki Ciappelletto deb atashardi, 36 va shuning uchun u hamma joyda Ciappelletto deb tanilgan, ammo uni Master Ciapperello deb bilganlar kam.

en: Now this said Ciappelletto was of this manner life, that, being a scriven- er, he thought very great shame whenas any of his instrument was found (and indeed he drew few such) other than false; whilst of the latter37 he would have drawn as many as might be required of him and these with a better will by way of gift than any other for a great wage.
uz: Endi bu Ciappelletto shunday hayot tarzida edi, u yozuvchi bo'lganligi sababli, o'z asboblaridan birortasi yolg'ondan boshqa topilsa (va haqiqatan ham, bunday asboblar kamdan-kam bo'lsa) juda katta sharmandalik deb hisoblardi; oxirgilaridan esa 37 undan talab qilinadigancha ko'pini tortgan bo'lardi va bularni boshqalardan ko'ra katta ish haqi evaziga sovg'a sifatida yaxshiroq irodasi bilan tortgan bo'lardi.

en: False witness he bore with especial delight, required or not required, and the greatest regard being in those times paid to oaths in France, as he recked nothing of for- swearing himself, he knavishly gained all the suits concerning which he was called upon to tell the truth upon his faith.
uz: U yolg'on guvohlik berishni alohida quvonch bilan, zarur bo'lsa ham, talab qilinmasa ham, va o'sha paytlarda Fransiyada qasamlarga eng katta hurmat ko'rsatilardi, chunki u hech narsa uchun qasam ichmas edi, u o'z e'tiqodiga asoslangan haqiqatni aytishga chaqirilgan barcha ayblovlarni qisiqlik bilan qo'lga kiritdi.

en: He took inordinate pleasure and was mighty diligent in stirring up troubles and enmities and scandals
uz: U haddan tashqari zavq oldi va muammolar, adovatlar va janjallarni qo'zg'atishda juda g'ayratli edi.

en: between friends and kinsfolk and whomsoever else, and the greater the mis- chiefs he saw ensue thereof, the more he rejoiced.
uz: do'stlari, qarindoshlari va boshqa har qanday odam o'rtasida, va qanchalik ko'p xato boshliqlar uning oqibatini ko'rsa, shunchalik ko'p xursand bo'lardi.

en: If bidden to manslaughter or whatsoever other naughty deed, he went about it with a will, without ever saying nay thereto; and many a time of his proper choice he had been known to wound men and do them to death with his own hand.
uz: Agar odam o'ldirishga yoki boshqa har qanday yovuz ishga buyurilsa, u hech qachon "yo'q" demasdan, vasiyat bilan borardi; va ko'p vaqt o'zining to'g'ri tanlovidan kelib chiqib, odamlarni o'z qo'li bilan jarohatlab, o'ldirishni bilgan edi.

en: He was a terrible blasphemer of God and the saints, and that for every triﬂe, being the most choleric man alive.
uz: U Xudo va avliyolarga nisbatan dahshatli kufrkash edi, va har bir mayda narsa uchun, tirikdagi eng xolerik odam edi.

en: To church he went never and all the sacraments thereof he ﬂouted in abominable terms, as things of no account; whilst, on the other hand, he was still fain to haunt and use taverns and other lewd places.
uz: U hech qachon cherkovga bormasdi va uning barcha sakramentlarini jirkanch so'zlar bilan, hech qanday ahamiyatga ega bo'lmagan narsalar kabi chetlab o'tmasdi; shu bilan birga, u hali ham taomxonalar va boshqa behayo joylarni ta'qib qilishga va ishlatishga moyil edi.

en: Of women he was as fond as dogs of the stick; but in the contrary he delighted more than any ﬁlthy fellow alive.
uz: U ayollarga tayoq itlari kabi mehribon edi; aksincha, u tirik har qanday iflos odamdan ko'ra ko'proq xursand edi.

en: He robbed and pillaged with as much conscience as a godly man would make oblation to God; he was a very glutton and a great wine bibber, insomuch that bytimes it wrought him shameful mischief, and to boot, he was a notorious gamester and a caster of cogged dice.
uz: U Xudodan qurbonlik qiladigan dindor odamchalik vijdon bilan o'g'irlik qildi va talon-toroj qildi; u juda ochko'z va katta sharobxo'r edi, shuning uchun vaqti-vaqti bilan uyatga to'la zarar yetkazardi, va undan tashqari, u mashhur o'yinchi va g'altak to'playdigan o'yinchi edi.

en: But why should I enlarge in so many words?
uz: Lekin nega bunchalik ko'p so'z bilan kattalashtirishim kerak?

en: He was belike the worst man that ever was born.38 His wickedness had long been upheld by the power and interest of Messer Musciatto, who had many a time safe- guarded him as well from private persons, to whom he often did a mischief, as from the law, against which he was a perpetual offender.
uz: U dunyoga kelgan eng yomon odamga o'xshardi. 38 Uning yovuzligi uzoq vaqtdan beri Messer Musciatto'ning kuchi va manfaatdorligi bilan qo'llab-quvvatlangan edi, u uni ko'p vaqt davomida shaxsiy shaxslardan ham himoya qilgan edi, ularga ko'pincha yomonlik qilgan, xuddi qonundan, unga qarshi doimiy huquqbuzar bo'lganidek.

en: This Master Ciappelletto then, coming to Musciatto’s mind, the latter, who was very well acquainted with his way of life, bethought himself that he should be such an one as the perversity of the Burgundians required and accordingly, sending for him, he bespoke him thus: ‘Master Ciappelletto, I am, as thou knowest, about altogether to withdraw hence, and having to do, amongst others, with certain Burgundians, men full of guile, I know none whom I may leave to recover my due from them more ﬁtting than thyself, more by token that thou dost nothing at this present; wherefore, an thou wilt undertake this, I will e’en procure thee the favour of the Court and give thee such part as shall be meet of that which thou shalt recover.’ Don Ciappelletto, who was then out of employ and ill provided with the goods of the world, seeing him who had long been his stay and his refuge about to depart thence,
uz: O'sha ustoz Ciappelletto Musciatto xayoliga kelib, o'z hayot tarzini juda yaxshi bilgan edi, o'zini burgundiyaliklarning buzuqligi talab qiladigan odam bo'lishi kerak deb o'yladi va shunga ko'ra, uni yuborib, shunday dedi: "Ustoz Ciappelletto, men, senga ma'lumki, bu yerdan butunlay chiqib ketishga majburman va boshqalar qatorida, ba'zi burgundiyaliklar bilan, hiyla-nayrang odamlar bilan shug'ullanishga majburman.

en: lost no time in deliberation, but, as of necessity con- strained, replied that he would well.
uz: U mulohazalarda vaqtni yo'qotmadi, lekin, zaruratga ko'ra, zo'riqilgan holda, u yaxshi bo'ladi deb javob berdi.

en: They being come to an accord, Musci- atto departed and Ciappelletto, having gotten his patron’s procuration and letters commendatory from the king, betook himself into Burgundy, where well nigh none knew him, and there, contrary to his nature, began cour- teously and blandly to seek to get in his payments and do that wherefor he
uz: Ular kelishuvga erishgach, Muschi-atti ketib ketdi va Ciappelletto, homiysining buyurtmasini va shohdan maqtov xatlarini olgach, o'zini Burgundga olib kirdi, u yerda uni deyarli hech kim tanimadi va u yerda, o'z tabiatiga zid ravishda, uning to'lovlarini to'lashga va buni amalga oshirishga urinishni odob va beparvolik bilan boshladi.

en: was come thither, as if reserving choler and violence for a last resort.
uz: u yerga kelgan edi, go'yo oxirgi chora uchun xoler va zo'ravonlikni saqlab qolgandek.

en: Deal- ing thus and lodging in the house of two Florentines, brothers, who there lent at usance and who entertained him with great honour for the love of Messer Musciatto, it chanced that he fell sick, whereupon the two brothers promptly fetched physicians and servants to tend him and furnished him with all that behoved unto the recovery of his health.
uz: Shunday qilib, ikki Florensiyalik birodarning uyida tunab, u yerda unga xizmat ko'rsatishdi va uni Messer Musciattoga bo'lgan muhabbati tufayli katta sharaf bilan kutib olishdi, shunda u kasal bo'lib qoldi, shundan so'ng ikki aka-uka uni parvarishlash uchun shifokorlar va xizmatkorlarni tezda olib kelishdi va sog'lig'ini tiklash uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani unga taqdim etishdi.

en: But every succour was in vain, for that, by the physicians’ report, the good man, who was now old and had lived disorderly, grew daily worse, as one who had a mortal sick- ness; wherefore the two brothers were sore concerned and one day, being pretty near the chamber where he lay sick, they began to take counsel to- gether, saying one to the other, ‘How shall we do with yonder fellow?
uz: Lekin har qanday yordam befoyda edi, chunki shifokorlarning xabar berishicha, endi keksa va tartibsiz hayot kechirgan yaxshi odam, o'lik bemor kabi kun sayin yomonlashib borardi; shuning uchun ikki aka-uka qattiq tashvishda edilar va bir kuni u kasal yotgan xonaga yaqinlashib, bir-biriga maslahatlasha boshladilar, "U odam bilan nima qilaylik?" deyishardi.

en: We have a sorry bargain on our hands of his affair, for that to send him forth of our house, thus sick, were a sore reproach to us and a manifest sign of little wit on our part, if the folk, who have seen us ﬁrst receive him and after let tend and medicine him with such solicitude, should now see him suddenly put out of our house, sick unto death as he is, without it being possible for him to have done aught that should displease us.
uz: Biz uning ishida achinarli kelishuvga egamiz, chunki uni uyimizdan, shunday kasal holda chiqarib yuborish bizga og'riqli malomat va biz tomonimizdan ochiq aqlsizlik alomati edi, agar uni avval ko'rgan va shunday ehtiyotkorlik bilan parvarishlagan va davolanishdan so'ng, odamlar uni to'satdan uyimizdan tashlab ketayotganini ko'rsalar, u hozirgidek o'limga to'la edi, bizga yoqmaydigan hech narsa qilolmagan holda.

en: On the other hand, he hath been so wicked a man that he will never consent to confess or take any sac- rament of the church; and he dying without confession, no church will re- ceive his body; nay, he will be cast into a ditch, like a dog.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, u shunchalik yovuz odam ediki, u hech qachon cherkovning hech qanday muqaddasligini tan olishga yoki qabul qilishga rozi bo'lmaydi; va agar u tan olmasdan o'lsa, hech qanday cherkov uning tanasini qayta qabul qilmaydi; aksincha, u it kabi ariqqa tashlanadi.

en: Again, even if he do confess, his sins are so many and so horrible that the like will come of it, for that there is nor priest nor friar who can or will absolve him thereof; wherefore, being unshriven, he will still be cast into the ditches.
uz: Yana, agar u tan olsa ham, uning gunohlari shunchalik ko'p va shunchalik dahshatliki, undan shunga o'xshash narsa kelib chiqadi, chunki uni bundan ozod qila oladigan yoki ozod qila oladigan ruhoniy ham, rohib ham yo'q; shuning uchun, qisqarmagan holda, u baribir ariqlarga tashlanadi.

en: Should it happen thus, the people of the city, as well on account of our trade, which appeareth to them most iniquitous and of which they missay all day, as of their itch to plunder us, seeing this, will rise up in riot and cry out, “These Lombard dogs, whom the church refuseth to receive, are to be suffered here no longer”; —and they will run to our houses and despoil us not only of our good, but may be of our lives, to boot; wherefore in any case it will go ill with us, if yonder fellow die.’ Master Ciappelletto, who, as we have said, lay near the place where the two brothers were in discourse, being quick of hearing, as is most times the case with the sick, heard what they said of him and calling them to him, be- spoke them thus: ‘I will not have you anywise misdoubt of me nor fear to take any hurt by me.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, shahar aholisi, shuningdek, ularga eng gunohkor ko'ringan va kun bo'yi xato qiladigan savdogarligimiz tufayli ham, bizni o'g'irlashga urinishlari sababli, buni ko'rib, g'alayon ko'tarib, qichqiradilar: "Bu Lombard itlar, cherkov qabul qilmoqchi bo'lmaganlar, bu yerda azob chekish kerak emas", - va ular uylarimizga yugurib, bizni nafaqat yaxshiligimizdan, balki hayotimizdan ham talon-toroj qilishadi; har qanday holatda bizga zarar yetkazadi, agar birov o'lsa.

en: I have heard what you say of me and am well assured that it would happen even as you say, should matters pass as you expect; but it shall go otherwise.
uz: Men siz men haqimda nima deyayotganingizni eshitdim va agar ishlar siz kutganingizdek o'tsa, xuddi siz aytganingizdek bo'lishiga aminman; lekin boshqacha bo'ladi.

en: I have in my lifetime done God the Lord so many an
uz: Men hayotim davomida Xudo Rabbiyga juda ko'p marotaba...

en: affront that it will make neither more nor less, an I do Him yet another at the point of death; wherefore do you make shift to bring me the holiest and worthiest friar you may avail to have, if any such there be,39 and leave the rest to me, for that I will assuredly order your affairs and mine own on such wise that all shall go well and you shall have good cause to be satisﬁed.’ The two brothers, albeit they conceived no great hope of this, neverthe- less betook themselves to a brotherhood of monks and demanded some holy and learned man to hear the confession of a Lombard who lay sick in their house.
uz: Bu nafrat na ko'proq, na kamroq qiladi, va men uni o'lim nuqtasida yana bir bor qilaman; shuning uchun, agar shunday bo'lsa, menga eng muqaddas va munosib rohibni olib kelishga harakat qilasiz, 39 va qolganini menga qoldiring, chunki men sizning ishlaringizni ham, o'zimnikini ham shunday tartibga solamanki, hammasi yaxshi bo'lsin va sizda yaxshi sabab bo'lsin." Ikki aka-uka, garchi bunga katta umid qilmagan bo'lsalar ham, hech qanday holda rohiblar birligiga murojaat qilishdi va uyida kasal yotgan bir Lombardning e'tirozini eshitishni talab qilishdi.

en: There was given them a venerable brother of holy and good life and a past master in Holy Writ, a very reverend man, for whom all the towns- folk had a very great and special regard, and they carried him to their house; where, coming to the chamber where Master Ciappelletto lay and seating himself by his side, he began ﬁrst tenderly to comfort him and after asked him how long it was since he had confessed last; whereto Master Ciappel- letto, who had never confessed in his life, answered, ‘Father, it hath been my usance to confess every week once at the least and often more; it is true that, since I fell sick, to wit, these eight days past, I have not confessed, such is the annoy that my sickness hath given me.’ Quoth the friar, ‘My son, thou hast done well and so must thou do henceforward.
uz: Ularga muqaddas va yaxshi hayotning hurmatli akasi va Muqaddas Kitobdagi o'tmishdagi ustoz berildi, juda hurmatli odam, barcha shaharliklar uni juda katta va alohida hurmat qilishardi va ular uni o'z uylariga olib ketishardi. U yerda, Ustoz Ciappelletto yotgan xonaga kelib, o'zi yonida o'tirganida, u avval uni muloyimlik bilan ovutishni boshladi va undan oxirgi marta qancha vaqtdan beri tan olganini so'raganidan so'radi; u yerda Muqaddas Kitobdagi o'tmishdagi ustoz, juda hurmatli odam, "Ota, har hafta bir marta va ko'p marta tan olish mening odatim edi; rostdan ham, men kasal bo'lganimdan beri, mana shu sakkiz kun ichida, men tan olmayman, mening kasalligim menga bergan g'azab."

en: I see, since thou confessest so often, that I shall be at little pains either of hearing or ques- tioning.’ ‘Sir,’ answered Master Ciappelletto, ‘say not so; I have never con- fessed so much nor so often but I would still fain make a general confession of all my sins that I could call to mind from the day of my birth to that of my confession; wherefore I pray you, good my father, question me as punc- tually of everything, nay, everything, as if I had never confessed; and con- sider me not because I am sick, for that I had far liefer displease this my ﬂesh than, in consulting its ease, do aught that might be the perdition of my soul, which my Saviour redeemed with His precious blood.’ These words much pleased the holy man and seemed to him to argue a well-disposed mind; wherefore, after he had much commended Master Ciappelletto for that his usance, he asked him if he had ever sinned by
uz: Ko'ryapman, chunki sen juda ko'p tan olasan, men eshitish yoki savollar berishdan unchalik azob chekmayman."  Janob,  javob berdi Ustoz Ciappelletto,  unday demang; men hech qachon bunchalik ko'p yoki bunchalik ko'p tan olmaganman, lekin men hali ham tug'ilgan kunimdan tan olish kunigacha eslay oladigan barcha gunohlarim haqida umumiy tan olishni xohlardim; shuning uchun sizdan iltimos qilaman, yaxshi otam, meni hamma narsadan, go'yo hech qachon tan olmaganimdek so'rang; va meni kasal bo'lganim uchun emas, chunki men o'z tanamdan ko'ra ko'proq norozi bo'lardim, chunki uning yengilligini maslahat berishda, mening jonimning halok bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki mening Najotkorim uni o'z qonidan qutqargan edi.

en: way of lust with any woman.
uz: Har qanday ayol bilan shahvat usuli.

en: ‘Father,’ replied Master Ciappelletto, sighing, ‘on this point I am ashamed to tell you the truth, fearing to sin by way of vain- glory.’ Quoth the friar, ‘Speak in all security, for never did one sin by telling the truth, whether in confession or otherwise.’ ‘Then,’ said Master Ciappel- letto, ‘since you certify me of this, I will tell you; I am yet a virgin, even as I came forth of my mother’s body.’ ‘O blessed be thou of God!’ cried the
uz: Ota,  javob berdi Ustoz Ciappelletto, xorsinadi,  shu nuqtada sizga haqiqatni aytishdan uyalyapman, behuda shon-sharaf yoli bilan gunoh qilishdan qorqaman.  Ruhoniy aytdi:  Toliq ishonch bilan gapiring, chunki hech qachon haqiqatni aytib gunoh qilmaganman, na iqror bolishda, na boshqa yol bilan.  Unda,  dedi Ustoz Ciappel- litov,  siz menga bu haqda guvohlik berganingizdan beri, men sizga aytaman; men hali bokira, onamning tanasidan chiqqanimdekman.  Ey Xudo!  deb baqirdi.

en: ‘How well hast thou done!
uz: Naqadar yaxshi ish qildingiz!

en: And doing thus, thou hast the more de- served, inasmuch as, an thou wouldst, thou hadst more leisure to do the contrary than we and whatsoever others are limited by any rule.’ After this he asked him if he had ever offended against God in the sin of gluttony; whereto Master Ciappelletto answered, sighing, Ay had he, and that many a time; for that, albeit, over and above the Lenten fasts that are yearly observed of the devout, he had been wont to fast on bread and water three days at the least in every week —he had oftentimes (and especially whenas he had endured any fatigue, either praying or going a-pilgrimage) drunken the water with as much appetite and as keen a relish as great drink- ers do wine.
uz: Shunday qilib, sen shunchalik ko'p xizmat qilding, chunki, sen xohlaganingdek, biz va boshqalarning har qanday qoidasi bilan cheklangan narsalardan ko'ra aksincha qilish uchun ko'proq dam olganding." Shundan so'ng u undan ovqatxo'rlik gunohida Xudoga qarshi gunoh qilganmi, deb so'radi; u yerda Ustoz Ciappelletto ingrab javob berdi: "Ha, u shunday edi, va u shunday ko'p vaqt edi; chunki, garchi, dindorlarning yillik ro'zalaridan tashqari, u har haftada kamida uch kun non va suvda ro'za tutgan bo'lsa ham, u (va ayniqsa, u har qanday charchoqni, xoh ibodat qilish yoki ziyoratga borganida) suvni xuddi katta ishtaha bilan ichgan va sharob ichgandek tez-tez ichgan edi.

en: And many a time he had longed to have such homely salads of potherbs as women make when they go into the country; and whiles eating had given him more pleasure than himseemed it should do to one who fasteth for devotion, as did he.
uz: Va ko'p vaqtlar u ayollarning qishloqqa kirganda tayyorlaydigan o'tlardan tayyorlangan shunday yoqimli salatlarga ega bo'lishni orzu qilardi; va unga ovqat yeyish unga ibodat uchun ro'za tutgan odamga ko'proq zavq bergan edi, xuddi u kabi.

en: ‘My son,’ said the friar, ‘these sins are natur- al and very slight and I would not therefore have thee burden thy con- science withal more than behoveth.
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi rohib,  bu gunohlar tabiiy va juda yengil, shuning uchun men senga kerak bo'lganidan ortiq bilim yukini yuklashni xohlamayman.
