en: Nevertheless, like a brave lady as she was, she determined to receive him with honour and summoning to her counsels sundry gentlemen of those who remained there, with their help, she let provide for everything needful.
uz: Shunga qaramay, o'zi qanday jasur ayol bo'lsa, u uni sharaf bilan qabul qilishga qaror qildi va u yerda qolganlarning turli janoblarini o'z maslahatlariga chaqirib, ularning yordami bilan zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani ta'minladi.

en: The ordinance of the repast and of the viands she reserved to her- self alone and having forthright caused collect as many hens as were in the country, she bade her cooks dress various dishes of these alone for the royal table.
uz: O'zining o'zi uchun saqlab qolgan taom va go'sht tartiblari, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qishloqda qancha tovuq yig'ilsa, shuncha ko'p tovuq yig'ishga majbur bo'lganidan so'ng, u o'z oshpazlariga ularning turli xil taomlarini qirollik stoli uchun tayyorlashni buyurdi.

en: The king came at the appointed time and was received by the lady with great honour and rejoicing.
uz: Shoh belgilangan vaqtda keldi va xonim uni katta sharaf va quvonch bilan kutib oldi.

en: When he beheld her, she seemed to him fair and noble and well-bred beyond that which he had conceived from the courtier’s words, whereat he marvelled exceedingly and commended her amain, waxing so much the hotter in his desire as he found the lady over- passing his foregone conceit of her.
uz: Uni ko'rganida, u unga saroy so'zlaridan o'ylaganidan ko'ra go'zal, olijanob va yaxshi tarbiyalangan ko'rinardi. Shunda u uni juda hayratda qoldirdi va hayrat bilan maqtadi, xotinni topgan sari, uning oldindan tasavvuridan o'tib ketgandek, o'z xohishida shunchalik qizg'in edi.

en: After he had taken somewhat of rest in chambers adorned to the utmost with all that pertaineth to the entertainment of such a king, the dinner hour being come, the king and the marchioness seated themselves at one table, whilst the rest, according to their quality, were honourably entertained at others.
uz: U shunday podshohning ko'ngilochar tadbirlariga oid barcha narsalar bilan bezatilgan xonalarda biroz dam olgandan so'ng, kechki ovqat vaqti kelgach, podshoh va meriza bir stolga o'tirdilar, qolganlari esa, sifatiga ko'ra, boshqalarda sharafli tarzda ko'ngilxushlik qilishdi.

en: The king, being served with many dishes in succession, as well as with wines of the best and costliest, and to boot gazing with delight the while upon the lovely marchioness, was migh- tily pleased with his entertainment; but, after awhile, as the viands followed
uz: Shoh ketma-ket ko'plab taomlar, shuningdek, eng yaxshi va qimmatbaho vinolar bilan ta'minlangan va go'zal malikaning ko'ziga zavq bilan tikilib turgan holda, o'zining ko'ngilxushligidan juda mamnun edi; lekin, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, go'shtlar...

en: one upon another, he began somewhat to marvel, perceiving that, for all the diversity of the dishes, they were nevertheless of nought other than hens, and this although he knew the part where he was to be such as should abound in game of various kinds and although he had, by advising the lady in advance of his coming, given her time to send a-hunting.
uz: Bir-biriga qarab, u biroz hayratlana boshladi, sezdi, barcha taomlarning xilma-xilligi tufayli, ular baribir tovuqlardan boshqa hech narsa emas edi, va bu uning turli xil o'yinlarda to'lib-toshishi kerak bo'lgan qismini bilganiga qaramay edi va u xonimga kelishi oldidan maslahat berib, unga ov yuborish uchun vaqt bergan bo'lsa ham edi.

en: However, much as he might marvel at this, he chose not to take occasion of engaging her in parley thereof, otherwise than in the matter of her hens, and accordingly, turning to her with a merry air, ‘Madam,’ quoth he, ‘are hens only born in these parts, without ever a cock?’ The marchioness, who understood the king’s question excellent well, herseeming God had vouchsafed her, accord- ing to her wish, an opportune occasion of discovering her mind, turned to him and answered boldly, ‘Nay, my lord; but women, albeit in apparel and dignities they may differ somewhat from others, are natheless all of the same fashion here as elsewhere.’ The King, hearing this, right well apprehended the meaning of the ban- quet of hens and the virtue hidden in her speech and perceived that words would be wasted upon such a lady and that violence was out of the ques- tion; wherefore, even as he had
uz: Ammo, bunga qanchalik hayron bo'lmasin, u uni uning parleyida o'ziga jalb qilish uchun hech qanday imkoniyatni tanlamadi, aksincha, uning tovuqlari masalasida emas, va shunga ko'ra, unga quvnoq ruhda murojaat qilib, u dedi: "Xonim, tovuqlar faqat shu joylarda tug'iladi, hech qachon xo'roz yo'q?" Shohning ajoyib savolini yaxshi tushungan, uning go'zal Xudosi unga o'z xohishiga ko'ra, uning ongini kashf etish uchun qulay imkoniyatni bergan edi, unga o'girilib, dadil javob berdi: "Yo'q, xo'jayinim; lekin ayollar, garchi kiyim va qadr-qimmatda boshqalardan biroz farq qilishsa ham, ular boshqa joylarda bo'lgani kabi bir xildir."

en: ill-advisedly taken ﬁre for her, so now it be- hoved him sagely, for his own honour’s sake, stiﬂe his ill-conceived pas- sion.
uz: U uchun noto'g'ri maslahat bilan olovda otashdi, shuning uchun endi uni aqldan ozgan holda, o'z sharafi yo'lida, o'zining noto'g'ri o'ylangan passionini bo'g'ib tashlang.

en: Accordingly, without making any more words with her, for fear of her replies, he dined, out of all hope; and the meal ended, thanking her for the honourable entertainment he had received from her and commending her to God, he set out for Genoa, so by his prompt departure he might make amends for his unseemly visit.”
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u bilan boshqa gaplashmasdan, uning javoblaridan qo'rqib, umidsiz ovqatlandi; va ovqat tugab, undan olgan sharafli ko'ngilxushlik uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirdi va Xudoga tasbeh berib, Genovaga yo'l oldi, shunda tezda ketishi bilan o'zining noqulay tashrifini qoplashi mumkin edi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY An honest man, with a chance pleasantry, putteth to shame the perverse hypocrisy of the religious orders.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Halol odam tasodifiy xushmuomalalik bilan diniy tartiblarning buzuq riyokorligini sharmanda qiladi.

en: Emilia, who sat next after Fiammetta —the courage of the marchioness and the quaint rebuke administered by her to the King of France having been commended of all the ladies —began, by the queen’s pleasure, boldly to speak as follows: “I also, I will not keep silence of a biting reproof given by an honest layman to a covetous monk with a speech no less laughable than commendable.
uz: Emiliya, Fiammettaning yonida o'tirgan  marsiyaxning jasorati va Fransiya qiroliga u tomonidan berilgan g'alati tanbeh barcha xonimlar tomonidan maqtanib  malika roziligi bilan quyidagicha dadil gapira boshladi: Men ham halol oddiy odamning ochko'z rohibga bergan achchiq tanbehini kam kulgili emas, balki maqtovga arziydigan nutq bilan sukut saqlamayman.

en: There was, then, dear lasses, no great while agone, in our city, a Minor friar and inquisitor of heretical pravity, who, for all he studied hard to ap- pear a devout and tender lover of the Christian religion, as do they all, was no less diligent in enquiring of who had a well-ﬁlled purse than of whom he might ﬁnd wanting in the things of the Faith.
uz: Shunday qilib, aziz qizlar, bizning shaharimizda o'tib ketgan bir ulug' mo'rik va bid'atchi haqiqatni so'roq qiluvchi kichik bir mo'rik bor edi. U xristian dinining sadoqatli va mehribon muhlisini, ularning hammasi kabi, din ishlarida kimning kamchilik ko'rishini topganidan ko'ra kimning ham yaxshi to'ldirilgan hamyoni borligini so'rashda unchalik g'ayratli emas edi.

en: Thanks to this his diligence, he lit by chance upon a good simple man, richer, by far in coin than in wit, who, of no lack of religion, but speaking thoughtlessly and belike over- heated with wine or excess of mirth, chanced one day to say to a company of his friends that he had a wine so good that Christ himself might drink thereof.
uz: Shu mehnatkashligi tufayli u tasodifan bir oddiy odamga duch keldi. U dindan ko'ra ancha boyroq edi. U dindan kam emas, lekin o'ylamasdan gapirardi va may yoki quvonchdan haddan tashqari qizg'in edi, bir kuni do'stlariga Masihning o'zi ichishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada yaxshi vino borligini aytishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: This being reported to the inquisitor and he understanding that the man’s means were large and his purse well ﬁlled, ran in a violent hurry cum gladiis et fustibus54 to clap up a right grievous suit against him, looking not for an amendment of misbelief in the defendant, but for the ﬁlling of his own hand with ﬂorins to ensue thereof (as indeed it did), and causing him to be cited, asked him if that which had been alleged against him were true.
uz: Bu haqda inkvizitorga xabar berilgan edi va u odamning boyligi katta va hamyoni yaxshi to'lganini anglab yetgach, unga qarshi jiddiy da'vo arizasini qo'zg'atish uchun shiddat bilan yugurdi. Ayblanuvchiga nisbatan ishonchsizlikni o'zgartirishni emas, balki o'z qo'lini florinlar bilan to'ldirishni (aslida shunday bo'ldi) va uni keltirilishiga sabab bo'lish uchun, undan unga nisbatan da'vo qilingan narsa rostmi yoki yo'qmi deb so'radi.

en: The good man replied that it was and told him how it chanced; whereupon quoth the most holy inquisitor, who was a devotee of St.
uz: Yaxshi odam javob berdi: "Ha, shunday edi" va unga bu qanday sodir bo'lganini aytdi; shundan so'ng eng muqaddas inkvizitor, Avliyoga sadoqatli edi.

en: John Goldenbeard,55 ‘Then hast thou made Christ a wine-bibber and curious in
uz: Jon Oltin Soqol, 55  Unda sen Masihni vinochi va qiziquvchan qilib yaratding.

en: wines of choice, as if he were Cinciglione56 or whatnot other of your drunk- en sots and tavern-haunters; and now thou speakest lowly and wouldst feign this to be a very light matter!
uz: Tanlangan vinolar, go'yo u Cinciglione56 yoki boshqa hech narsa emas, sizning mastxona va tavern ovchilaringizdek; va endi siz past gapirasiz va buni juda yengil narsa deb ko'rsatmoqchisiz!

en: It is not as thou deemest; thou hast merited the ﬁre therefor, an we were minded to deal with thee as we ought.’ With these and many other words he bespoke him, with as menacing a countenance as if the poor wretch had been Epicurus denying the immortality of the soul, and in brief so terriﬁed him that the good simple soul, by means of certain intermediaries, let grease his palm with a good dose of St.
uz: Bu sen o'ylaganingdek emas; sen olovga loyiq bo'lding, shuning uchun biz senga kerakli tarzda munosabatda bo'lishga qaror qildik." Shu va boshqa ko'plab so'zlar bilan u unga shunday tahdid soluvchi yuz bilan qaradi, go'yo bechora Epikur ruhning o'lmasligini inkor etgan va qisqa qilib aytganda, uni shunchalik dahshatga soldi, yaxshi oddiy ruh ma'lum vositachilar orqali uning kaftini yaxshi doza St. bilan yog'lasin.

en: John Golden- mouth’s ointment57 (the which is a sovereign remedy for the pestilential covetise of the clergy and especially of the Minor Brethren, who dare not touch money), so he should deal mercifully with him.
uz: Jon Golden - og'iz moylash 57 (bu ruhoniylarning va ayniqsa, pulga tegishga jur'at etmaydigan Kichik birodarlarning o'ta ochko'zligi uchun oliy vositadir), shuning uchun u unga rahmdillik bilan munosabatda bo'lishi kerak.

en: This unguent, being of great virtue (albeit Galen speaketh not thereof in any part of his Medicines), wrought to such purpose that the ﬁre denounced against him was by favour commuted into [the wearing, by way of penance, of] a cross, and to make the ﬁner banner, as he were to go a crusading bey- ond seas, the inquisitor imposed it him yellow upon black.
uz: Bu g'ayrioddiy, buyuk fazilatga ega bo'lgan (garchi Galen bu haqda o'zining dori-darmonlarining hech bir qismida gapirmasa ham), shunday maqsadga qaratilgan ediki, unga qarshi qoralangan olov xochga aylantirilib, nozikroq bayroqni yasash uchun, go'yo u sayohatga ketayotgandek, inkvizitor uni qoraga sariq qilib qo'ydi.

en: Moreover, when- as he had gotten the money, he detained him about himself some days, en- joining him, by way of penance, hear a mass every morning at Santa Croce and present himself before him at dinnertime, and after that he might do what most pleased him the rest of the day; all which he diligently performed.
uz: Qolaversa, u pulni olganidan so'ng, uni bir necha kun o'zi bilan ushlab turdi, tavba yo'li bilan unga qo'shilib, har kuni Santa Croce'da mis tinglardi va kechki ovqat paytida uning oldiga chiqardi, shundan so'ng kunning qolgan qismida unga eng yoqqan ishni qilishi mumkin edi; bularning hammasini u astoydil bajarardi.

en: One morning, amongst others, it chanced that at the Mass he heard a Gospel, wherein these words were chanted, ‘For every one ye shall receive an hundred and shall possess eternal life.’58 This he laid fast up in his memory and according to the commandment given him, presented him at the eating hour before the inquisitor, whom he found at dinner.
uz: Bir kuni ertalab, boshqa odamlar qatorida, u Misda shunday bir Injil eshitgan edi: unda quyidagi so'zlar aytilgan edi: "Chunki har biringiz yuzta olasiz va abadiy hayotga ega bo'lasiz". 58 Buni u xotirasiga joylashtirdi va unga berilgan amrga ko'ra, kechki ovqat paytida uni kechki ovqatda topgan inkvizitorga taqdim etdi.

en: The friar asked him if he had heard mass that morning, whereto he promptly answered, ‘Ay have I, sir.’ Quoth the inquisitor, ‘Heardest thou aught therein whereof thou doubtest or would question?’ ‘Certes,’ replied the good man, ‘I doubt not of aught that I heard, but do ﬁrmly believe all to be true.
uz: Rohib undan o'sha kuni ertalab massaj eshitganmi deb so'radi. U zudlik bilan javob berdi: "Ayo, men shunday qildim, janob." So'roqchi javob berdi: "Senga shubhalanadigan yoki so'roq qiladigan biror narsa eshitdingmi?" "Albatta," dedi yaxshi odam, "Men eshitgan narsamga shubham yo'q, lekin hamma narsa rost ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman."

en: I did indeed hear something which caused and yet causeth me have the greatest compassion of you and your brother friars, bethinking me of the ill case wherein you will ﬁnd yourselves over yonder in the next life.’ ‘And what was it that moved thee to such compassion of us?’ asked the inquisitor.
uz: Men shunday bir narsani eshitdimki, bu sizni va sizning birodarlaringizni keyingi hayotda qayerda uchrashingizni o'ylab, eng katta rahm-shafqatga sabab bo'ldi va meni shunday rahm-shafqatga soladi. Sizni bizga bunday rahm-shafqatga nima undagan edi? deb so'radi inkvizitor.

en: ‘Sir,’ answered the other, ‘it was that verse of the Evangel, which saith, “For every one ye shall receive an hundred.” ‘That is true,’ rejoined the inquisit- or; ‘but why did these words move thee thus?’ ‘Sir,’ replied the good man,
uz: Janob,  javob berdi ikkinchisi,  bu Injilning osha bayti edi, unda shunday deyilgan: Chunki har biringiz yuzta olasiz. Togri,  javob berdi soroqchi;  lekin bu sozlar sizni nega bunchalik tasirlantirdi?  Janob,  javob berdi yaxshi odam,

en: Since I have been used to resort hither, I have seen give out every day to a multitude of poor folk now one and now two vast great cauldrons of broth, which had been taken away from before yourself and the other brethren of this convent, as superﬂuous; wherefore, if for each one of these cauldrons of broth there be rendered you an hundred in the world to come, you will have so much thereof that you will assuredly all be drowned therein.’ All who were at the inquisitor’s table fell a-laughing; but the latter, feel- ing the hit at the broth-swilling59 hypocrisy of himself and his brethren, was mightily incensed, and but that he had gotten blame for that which he had already done, he would have saddled him with another prosecution, for that with a laughable speech he had rebuked him and his brother good-for- noughts; wherefore, of his despite, he bade him thenceforward do what most pleased
uz: Men bu yerga murojaat qilishga odatlanganimdan beri, har kuni bir qancha kambag'al odamlarga bir-ikki katta bulyon qozonini haddan tashqari haddan tashqari qilib berishni ko'rdim. Bu qozonlar o'zingizdan va shu monastirning boshqa birodarlaridan olib ketilgan edi. Shuning uchun, agar dunyo bo'ylab bu bulyon qozonlarining har biri uchun sizga yuzta taqdim etilsa, sizda shunchalik ko'p bo'ladiki, albatta, hammangiz u yerda cho'kib ketasiz.

en: him and not come before him again.”
uz: uni va uning oldiga qayta kelmaslik.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Bergamino, with a story of Primasso and the Abbot of Cluny, courteously rebuketh a ﬁt of parsimony newly come to Messer Cane Della Scala.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Bergamino, Primasso va Kluny abbatining hikoyasi bilan, mehribonlik bilan Messer Cane Della Scalaga yangi kelgan o'ziga xoslikni tanqid qiladi.

en: Emilia’s pleasantness and her story moved the queen and all the rest to laugh and applaud the rare conceit of this newfangled crusader.
uz: Emilia'ning yoqimliligi va uning hikoyasi malika va qolganlarni kulishga va bu yangi xochbozning kamdan-kam mag'rurligini olqishlashga undadi.

en: Then, after the laughter had subsided and all were silent again, Filostrato, whose turn it was to tell, began to speak on this wise: “It is a ﬁne thing, noble ladies, to hit a mark that never stirreth; but it is well-nigh miraculous if, when some unwonted thing appeareth of a sudden, it be forthright stricken of an archer.
uz: Keyin, kulgi tinchib, hammasi yana jim bo'lgandan so'ng, Filostrato, uning navbatida gapirish kerak bo'lgan odam, shunday mulohaza bilan gapira boshladi: "A'lo darajadagi xonimlar, hech qachon qo'zg'almaydigan nishonga urish yaxshi ishdir; lekin agar birdan kutilmagan narsa paydo bo'lsa, u to'satdan kamonchi bilan urilsa, bu deyarli mo'jiza."

en: The lewd and ﬁlthy life of the clergy, in many things as it were a constant mark for malice, giveth without much difﬁculty occasion to all who have a mind to speak of, to gird at and rebuke it; wherefore, albeit the worthy man, who pierced the inquisitor to the quick touching the hypocritical charity of the friars, who give to the poor that which it should behove them cast to the swine or throw away, did well, I hold him much more to be commended of whom, the foregoing tale moving me thereto, I am to speak and who with a quaint story rebuked Messer Cane della Scala, a magniﬁcent nobleman, of a sudden and unaccustomed niggardliness newly appeared in him, ﬁguring, in the person of another, that which he purposed to say to him concerning themselves; the which was on this wise.
uz: Ruhoniylarning behayo va iflos hayoti, ko'p jihatdan yovuzlikning doimiy belgisi bo'lgani kabi, gapirishga, uni mahkamlashga va tanbeh berishga ko'p qiyinchiliksiz imkoniyat beradi; shuning uchun, agar haqli inson, ixlosmandlarning riyokor xayriyasini tezda tekshira olsa, kambag'allarga o'zi tashlashi kerak bo'lgan narsani cho'chqaga tashlashi yoki tashlashi kerak bo'lsa, men uni ko'proq maqtashga loyiq deb bilaman, oldindan aytib o'tgan hikoya meni shunga undaydi, men aytmoqchiman va u ajoyib hikoya bilan Messer Cane della Scalani tanbeh bergan, ajoyib zodagon, birdan va odatdagidek noziklik unga yangi paydo bo'ldi, o'zi haqida o'ylab ko'rmoqchi edi,

en: As very manifest renown proclaimeth well nigh throughout the whole world, Messer Cane della Scala, to whom in many things fortune was fa- vourable, was one of the most notable and most magniﬁcent gentlemen that have been known in Italy since the days of the Emperor Frederick the Second.
uz: Butun dunyo bo'ylab keng tarqalgan shuhratga ko'ra, ko'p narsalarda omadga ega bo'lgan Messer Cane della Scala, imperator Frederik Ikkinchi davridan beri Italiyada tanilgan eng mashhur va ulug'vor janoblardan biri edi.

en: Being minded to make a notable and wonder-goodly entertainment in Verona, whereunto many folk should have come from divers parts and especially men of art60 of all kinds, he of a sudden (whatever might have
uz: Veronada diqqatga sazovor va ajoyib ko'ngilochar tadbir tashkil etish niyatida bo'lgan holda, u yerga ko'plab odamlar turli joylardan kelishi kerak edi va ayniqsa san'atning 60 har xil turdagi odamlari, u birdaniga (barcha narsa bo'lishi mumkin edi)

en: been the cause) withdrew therefrom and having in a measure requited those who were come thither, dismissed them all, save only one, Bergamino by name, a man ready of speech and accomplished beyond the credence of whoso had not heard him, who, having received neither largesse nor dis- missal, abode behind, in the hope that his stay might prove to his future ad- vantage.
uz: sabab bo'lgani uchun) u yerdan chekindi va u yerga kelganlarni ma'lum miqdorda jazolab, ularning hammasini haydaladi, faqat bittadan tashqari, Bergamino nomi bilan, uni eshitmaganlarning ishonchiga sig'maydigan va yetuk odam edi, u hech qanday kattalik yoki xalosgarchilikni olmagan holda, uning qolishi kelajakda o'zining afzalligini isbotlashi mumkin degan umidda orqada qoldi.

en: But Messer Cane had taken it into his mind that what thing soever he might give him were far worse bestowed than if it had been thrown into the ﬁre, nor of this did he bespeak him or let tell him aught.
uz: Ammo Messer Keyn unga nima bersa, o'tga tashlanganidan ham yomonroq sovg'a ekanligini yodda tutgan edi, va bu haqda unga hech narsa demagan yoki hech narsa demagan edi.

en: Bergamino, after some days, ﬁnding himself neither called upon nor re- quired unto aught that pertained to his craft and wasting his substance, to boot, in the hostelry with his horses and his servants, began to be sore con- cerned, but waited yet, himseeming he would not do well to depart.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng Bergamino o'zini na kasbga tegishli narsaga chaqirilmagan, na istamagan holda topdi va o'z mol-mulkini isrof qilib, otlari va xizmatkorlari bilan birga mehmonxonada botga tushdi, lekin hali ham kutdi, go'yo ketishni yaxshi ko'rmayotgandek edi.

en: Now he had brought with him three goodly and rich suits of apparel, which had been given him of other noblemen, that he might make a brave appearance at the festival, and his host pressing for payment, he gave one thereof to him.
uz: Endi u o'zi bilan uchta yaxshi va boy libos olib keldi, bu liboslar unga boshqa zodagonlar tomonidan berilgan edi, bayramda jasorat bilan ko'rinishi uchun. Mehmonlari esa pulni talab qilib, ulardan birini unga berdi.

en: After this, tarrying yet longer, it behoved him give the host the second suit, an he would abide longer with him, and withal he began to live upon the third, resolved to abide in expectation so long as this should last and then depart.
uz: Shundan so'ng, yana uzoqroq turar ekan, u qo'shinga ikkinchi kostyumni berishi kerak edi, u u bilan uzoqroq turardi va u bilan uchinchisida yashay boshladi, bu davom etar ekan va keyin ketar ekan, kutishda qolishga qaror qildi.

en: Whilst he thus fed upon the third suit, he chanced one day, Messer Cane being at dinner, to present himself before him with a rueful countenance, and Messer Cane, seeing this, more by way of rallying him than of intent to divert himself with any of his speech, said to him, ‘What aileth thee, Bergamino, to stand thus disconsolate?
uz: Shunday qilib, u uchinchi kostyumdan oziqlanar ekan, bir kuni kechki ovqat paytida Meser Kayn unga achinarli yuz bilan ko'rindi va Meser Kayn buni ko'rib, o'zini hech qanday nutqi bilan chalg'itishdan ko'ra ko'proq uni qo'llab-quvvatlash yo'li bilan unga dedi: "Senga nima kerak, Bergamino, bunday xafa bo'lishga?"

en: Tell us somewhat.’61 Whereupon Bergamino, without a moment’s hesitation, forthright, as if he had long considered it, related the following story to the purpose of his own affairs.
uz: Bizga bir oz ma'lumot bering.61 Shunday qilib, Bergamino bir lahza ham ikkilanmasdan, go'yo buni allaqachon o'ylab ko'rgandek, quyidagi hikoyani o'z ishlarining maqsadiga bog'ladi.

en: ‘My lord,’ said he, ‘you must know that Primasso was a very learned grammarian62 and a skilful and ready verse-maker above all others, which things rendered him so notable and so famous that, albeit he might not everywhere be known by sight, there was well nigh none who knew him not by name and by report.
uz: Hazratim,  dedi u,  bilishingiz kerakki, Primasso juda bilimdon grammatik62 va boshqalardan kora mohir va tayyor sher yasovchi edi, bu narsalar uni shunchalik etiborga loyiq va mashhur qilganki, garchi hamma joyda korinishi mumkin bolmasa ham, uni ismi va xabari bilan bilmaydigan deyarli hech kim yoq edi.

en: It chanced that, ﬁnding himself once at Paris in poor case, as indeed he abode most times, for that worth is63 little prized of those who can most,64 he heard speak of the Abbot of Cluny, who is believed to be, barring the Pope, the richest prelate of his revenues that the Church of God possesseth, and of him he heard tell marvellous and magniﬁcent things, in that he still held open house nor were meat and drink ever denied to any who went whereas he might be, so but he sought it what time the Abbot was
uz: Shunday bo'ldiki, bir vaqtlar Parijda kambag'al holatda bo'lib, aslida u ko'p vaqt turardi, chunki bu boylik eng ko'p imkoniyatga ega bo'lganlarning 63 nafariga arzimaydi. 64 U Klini abbatining gapini eshitdi, u Rim Papasidan tashqari, Xudoning cherkovida bo'lgan daromadlarining eng boy prelati deb ishoniladi va u haqida ajoyib va ulug'vor narsalar eshitdi, chunki u hali ham ochiq uyda edi, u borgan joyga borgan har bir kishiga hech qachon ovqat va ichimlik berilmas edi, shuning uchun u Abbatni qidirdi.

en: Primasso, hearing this and being one who delighted in looking upon men of worth and nobility, determined to go see the magniﬁcence of this Abbot and enquired how near he then abode to Paris.
uz: Buni eshitgan Primasso va qimmatbaho va olijanob odamlarga qarab xursand bo'lgan odam bo'lgani uchun, bu Abbotning ulug'vorligini ko'rishga qaror qildi va u Parijga qanchalik yaqin turishini so'radi.

en: It was answered him that he was then at a place of his maybe half a dozen miles thence; wherefore Primasso thought to be there at dinnertime, by starting in the morning betimes.
uz: Unga javob berishdi: u o'sha paytda undan yarim o'n mil uzoqlikda edi; shuning uchun Primasso ertalabki soatlardan boshlab kechki ovqat paytida u yerda bo'lishni o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, he enquired the way, but, ﬁnding none bound thither, he feared lest he might go astray by mischance and happen on a part where there might be no victual so readily to be found; wherefore, in order that, if this should betide, he might not suffer for lack of food, he bethought him- self to carry with him three cakes of bread, judging that water (albeit it was little to his taste) he should ﬁnd everywhere.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u yo'lni so'radi, lekin u yerga hech kimni topolmadi, u tasodifan adashib ketib, topilishi mumkin bo'lgan hech qanday qurbonlik bo'lmagan joyda sodir bo'lishidan xavotirda edi; shuning uchun, agar bu narsa sodir bo'lsa, u ovqat yetishmasligi uchun, o'zi bilan uchta non olib yurishni o'yladi, suvni (o'z ta'miga ko'ra kam bo'lsa ham) hamma joyda topishi kerak deb hisobladi.

en: The bread he put in his bosom and setting out, was fortunate enough to reach the Abbot’s residence before the eating-hour.
uz: Uning ko'kragida qo'ygan va jo'nab ketayotgan noni, ovqatlanish vaqtidan oldin Abbotning qarorgohiga yetib borishga omadli edi.

en: He entered and went spying all about and seeing the great multitude of tables set and the mighty preparations making in the kitchen and whatnot else provided against dinner, said in himself, “Of a truth this Abbot is as magniﬁcent as folk say.” After he had abidden awhile intent upon these things, the Abbot’s seneschal, eating-time being come, bade bring water for the hands; which being done, he seated each man at table, and it chanced that Primasso was set right over against the door of the chamber, whence the Abbot should come forth into the eating-hall.
uz: U kirib, atrofni kuzatdi va oshxonada juda ko'p stollar o'rnatilganini va kechki ovqatga tayyorgarlik ko'rayotganini ko'rib, o'ziga dedi: "Haqiqatan ham, bu Abbot xalq aytganidek ajoyibdir." U bu narsalarni biroz o'ylab ko'rgach, Abbotning oqsoqoli ovqatlanish vaqti kelgach, qo'llariga suv olib kelishdi; bu ish tugagandan so'ng, u har bir kishini stolga o'tqazdi va tasodifan, Primasso xonaning eshigiga qarama-qarshi qo'yildi, shundan Abbot ovqatlanish zaliga kirishi kerak edi.

en: Now it was the usance in that house that neither wine nor bread nor aught else of meat or drink should ever be set on the tables, except the Abbot were ﬁrst came to sit at his own table.
uz: O'sha uyda vino ham, non ham, boshqa go'sht ham, ichimlik ham hech qachon stol ustiga qo'yilmasligi odatiy hol edi, faqatgina Abbot o'z stoliga o'tirgani kelgan edi.

en: Accordingly, the seneschal, having set the tables, let tell the Abbot that, whenas it pleased him, the meat was ready.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, saroy boshlig'i dasturxonni tayyorlab, Abbotga go'sht tayyor ekanligini, unga yoqqanini aytdi.

en: The Abbot let open the chamber-door, that he might pass into the sa- loon, and looking before him as he came, as chance would have it, the ﬁrst who met his eyes was Primasso, who was very ill accoutred and whom he knew not by sight.
uz: Abbot xona eshigini ochdi, shunda u sa- loonga kirishi mumkin edi va u kelgan sari uning oldiga qarab, tasodifan ko'rinardi. Uning ko'ziga birinchi bo'lib Primasso tushdi, u juda yomon ahvolda edi va uni ko'zi bilan bilmas edi.

en: When he saw him, incontinent there came into his mind an ill thought and one that had never yet been there, and he said in himself, “See to whom I give my substance to eat!” Then, turning back, he bade shut the chamber-door and enquired of those who were about him if any knew yonder losel who sat at table over against his chamber-door; but all answered no.
uz: Uni ko'rgach, birdan xayoliga hech qachon bo'lmagan yomon bir fikr keldi va u o'ziga dedi: "Qarang, kimga ovqat yeyishga narsamni beraman!" Keyin orqaga o'girilib, xonaning eshigini yopdi va atrofidagilardan uning xonasi eshigiga qarama-qarshi o'tirgan hech kimni biladimi deb so'radi; lekin hamma javob bermadi.

en: Meanwhile Primasso, who had a mind to eat, having come a journey and being unused to fast, waited awhile and seeing that the Abbot came not, pulled out of his bosom one of the three cakes of bread he had brought with
uz: Ayni paytda, ovqat yeyishga aqli bor Primasso, sayohatga kelgan va ro'za tutishga odatlanmagan holda, biroz kutdi va Abbot kelmaganini ko'rib, o'zi olib kelgan uchta nondan birini ko'kragidan chiqarib oldi.

en: him and fell to eating.
uz: Uni va ovqat yeyishga tushdi.

en: The Abbot, after he had waited awhile, bade one of his serving-men look if Primasso were gone, and the man answered, “No, my lord; nay, he eateth bread, which it seemeth he hath brought with him.” Quoth the Abbot, “Well, let him eat of his own, an he have thereof; for of ours he shall not eat today.” Now he would fain have had Primasso depart of his own motion, himseeming it were not well done to turn him away; but the latter, having eaten one cake of bread and the Abbot coming not, began upon the second; the which was likewise reported to the Abbot, who had caused look if he were gone.
uz: Abbot biroz kutgandan so'ng, xizmatkorlaridan biri Primasso ketganini tekshirishni so'radi va u odam javob berdi: "Yo'q, xo'jayinim; yo'q, u o'zi bilan olib kelgan non yeydi." Abbot dedi: "Xo'sh, o'zinikidan yeyishi kerak, u undan ham bor; chunki bugun biznikidan yemaydi." Endi u Primassoning o'z xohishidan ketishini xohlardi, uni chetga qaytarish yaxshi emasdek tuyuldi; lekin oxirgi, bir non tortini yeb, Abbot kelmay qolganidan keyin, ikkinchisidan boshladi; bu ham Abbotga xabar qilingan edi, agar u ketgan bo'lsa, uni ko'rsatdi.

en: At last, the Abbot still tarrying, Primasso, having eaten the second cake, began upon the third, and this again was reported to the Abbot, who fell a- pondering in himself and saying, “Alack, what new maggot is this that is come into my head today?
uz: Nihoyat, Abbot hali ham qotib qolgan edi, Primasso ikkinchi tortni yeb, uchinchisini boshladi va bu haqda yana Abbotga xabar berildi. Abbot o'zini o'ylab dedi: Alak, bugun boshimga kirgan bu yangi qurt nima?

en: This many a year have I given my substance to eat to whosoever had a mind thereto, without regarding if he were gentle or simple, poor or rich, mer- chant or huckster, and have seen it with mine own eyes squandered by a multitude of ribald knaves; nor ever yet came there to my mind the thought that hath entered into me for yonder man.
uz: Shu yillar davomida men o'z mol-mulkimni kimning fikri bo'lsa, unga yeyishga berdim, u muloyimmi yoki oddiymi, kambag'almi yoki boymi, shunchaki qo'shiqchi yoki xorchi bo'lsa ham, o'z ko'zlarim bilan ko'rdim, ko'p qovurg'ali qo'rqoqlar tomonidan isrof qilingan; va hech qachon xayolimga o'sha odam uchun ichimga kirgan fikr kelmadi.

en: Of a surety avarice cannot have assailed me for a man of little account; needs must this who seemeth to me a losel be some great matter, since my soul hath thus repugned to do him honour.” So saying, he desired to know who he was and ﬁnding that it was Pri- masso, whom he had long known by report for a man of merit, come thither to see with his own eyes that which he had heard of his magniﬁcence, was ashamed and eager to make him amends, studied in many ways to do him honour.
uz: Albatta, baxillik meni arzimagan odam uchun hujum qila olmaydi; menga katta yo'qotishdek tuyulgan bu narsa katta narsa bo'lishi kerak, chunki jonim unga hurmat ko'rsatishdan jirkandi. Shunday qilib, u o'zi kimligini bilishni xohladi va u qadrdon inson haqida xabar bergan Pri-masso ekanligini topdi, u yerga o'z ko'zlari bilan uning ulug'vorligi haqida eshitgan narsalarni ko'rish uchun keldi, uyaldi va uni tuzatishga ishtiyoq edi, uni hurmat qilish uchun ko'p usullar bilan o'rgandi.

en: Moreover, after eating, he caused clothe him sumptuously, as beﬁt- ted his quality, and giving him money and a palfrey, left it to his own choice to go or stay; whereupon Primasso, well pleased with his entertainment, rendered him the best thanks in his power and returned on horseback to Par- is, whence he had set out afoot.
uz: Qolaversa, ovqatdan so'ng, u uni o'z sifatiga mos ravishda hashamatli kiydirdi va unga pul va palfri berib, borish yoki qolishni o'z ixtiyoriga qo'ydi; shundan so'ng, Primasso o'zining ko'ngilxushligidan juda mamnun bo'lib, unga qudratidagi eng yaxshi minnatdorchilikni bildirdi va otda Parga qaytib keldi, u yerdan yo'lga chiqdi.

en: Messer Cane, who was a gentleman of understanding, right well appre- hended Bergamino’s meaning, without further exposition, and said to him, smiling, ‘Bergamino, thou hast very aptly set forth to me thy wrongs and merit and my niggardliness, as well as that which thou wouldst have of me; and in good sooth, never, save now on thine account, have I been assailed of parsimony; but I will drive it away with that same stick which thou thyself hast shown me.’ Then, letting pay Bergamino’s host and clothing himself
uz: Janob Kayn, aqlli janob edi, Bergaminning ma'nosini to'g'ri angladi, hech qanday izohsiz va unga tabassum bilan dedi: Bergamino, sen menga o'z zulmlaring, yaxshiliklaring va baxilligingni, shuningdek, mendan nimani xohlashingni juda yaxshi ko'rsatding; va hech qachon, faqat sening hisobingdan, men xorlik hujumiga uchramaganman; lekin men uni o'zing ko'rsatgan tayoq bilan haydab yuboraman. Keyin, Bergaminning qo'shini va kiyimini o'zi to'lashga ruxsat berdim.

en: most sumptuously in a suit of his own apparel, he gave him money and a palfrey and committed to his choice for the nonce to go or stay.”
uz: Eng hashamatli tarzda o'z libosida, u unga pul va bir dona tanga berdi va u ketish yoki qolish uchun o'z tanlovini qilishga sodiq qoldi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Guglielmo Borsiere with some quaint words rebuketh the niggardliness of Messer Ermino de’ Grimaldi.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Guglielmo Borsiere ba'zi g'alati so'zlar bilan Messer Ermino de Grimaldi'ning beparvoligini tanqid qiladi.

en: Next Filostrato sat Lauretta, who, after she had heard Bergamino’s address commended, perceiving that it behoved her tell somewhat, began, without awaiting any commandment, blithely to speak thus: “The foregoing story, dear companions,65 bringeth me in mind to tell how an honest minstrel on like wise and not without fruit rebuked the covetise of a very rich merchant, the which, albeit in effect it resembleth the last story, should not therefore be less agreeable to you, considering that good came thereof in the end.
uz: Keyin Filostrato Laurettaga murojaat qildi. U Bergaminning maqtovga sazovor nutqini eshitgach, uning biroz aytib berishi kerakligini anglab yetgach, hech qanday buyruqni kutmasdan, shiddat bilan shunday dedi:  Yuqoridagi hikoya, aziz hamrohlar, 65 meni shunday eslatadiki, qanday qilib bir halol xizmatchi, xuddi dono kabi va mevalarsiz emas, juda boy savdogarning ochko'zligini tanbeh berdi, bu esa, aslida oxirgi hikoyaga o'xshasa ham, shuning uchun sizga kamroq yoqishi kerak edi, chunki uning natijasi yaxshi edi.

en: There was, then, in Genoa, a good while agone, a gentleman called Mess- er Ermino de’ Grimaldi, who (according to general belief) far overpassed in wealth of lands and monies the riches of whatsoever other richest citizen was then known in Italy; and like as he excelled all other Italians in wealth, even so in avarice and sordidness he outwent beyond compare every other miser and curmudgeon in the world; for not only did he keep a strait purse in the matter of hospitality, but, contrary to the general usance of the Gen- oese, who are wont to dress sumptuously, he suffered the greatest privations in things necessary to his own person, no less than in meat and in drink, rather than be at any expense; by reason whereof the surname de’ Grimaldi had fallen away from him and he was deservedly called of all only Messer Ermino Avarizia.
uz: O'shanda, Genovada ancha vaqt o'tgach, Mess-er Ermino de Grimaldi deb nomlangan janob bor edi. U (umumiy e'tiqodga ko'ra) yer va pul boyligida Italiyadagi eng boy fuqaroning boyligidan ancha ustun edi; va xuddi u boshqa italyanlardan boylikda ustun bo'lgani kabi, hatto ochko'zlik va badbo'ylikda ham dunyodagi har bir bechora va la'nati odamni solishtirardi; chunki u nafaqat mehmondo'stlik masalasida qattiq hamyon saqlardi, balki Gen-oeslarning umumiy odatiga zid ravishda, u o'ziga kerakli narsalarda, go'sht va ichimliklardan kam bo'lmasdan ham ko'ra, har qanday xarajatga duchor edi; chunki u faqatgina "Graviz" deb nomlangan edi.

en: It chanced that, whilst, by dint of spending not, he multiplied his wealth, there came to Genoa a worthy minstrel,66 both well-bred and well-spoken, by name Guglielmo Borsiere, a man no whit like those67 of the present day, who (to the no small reproach of the corrupt and blameworthy usances of those68 who nowadays would fain be called and reputed gentlefolk and sei-
uz: Shunday bo'ldiki, u xarajatlar bilan boyligini ko'paytirmagan bo'lsa-da, Genuyaga munosib vazir keldi. 66 U ham yaxshi tarbiyalangan, ham yaxshi gapiradigan, Guglielmo Borsiere ismli, bugungi kundagi 67 kishiga o'xshagan oq tanli odam edi.

en: gniors) are rather to be styled asses, reared in all the beastliness and deprav- ity of the basest of mankind, than [minstrels, bred] in the courts [of kings and princes].
uz: Skilorlar (skilorlar) insoniyatning eng pastki qismidagi barcha yovvoyilik va buzuqlikda tarbiyalangan eshaklar bo'lishdan ko'ra, saroylarda [shohlar va shahzodalarning] ko'paytirilgan eshaklardir.

en: In those times it used to be a minstrel’s ofﬁce and his wont to expend his pains in negotiating treaties of peace, where feuds or despites had befallen between noblemen, or transacting marriages, alliances and friendships, in solacing the minds of the weary and diverting courts with quaint and pleasant sayings, ay, and with sharp reproofs, father-like, rebuk- ing the misdeeds of the froward —and this for slight enough reward; but nowadays they study to spend their time in hawking evil reports from one to another, in sowing discord, in speaking naughtiness and obscenity and (what is worse) doing them in all men’s presence, in imputing evil doings, lewdnesses and knaveries, true or false, one to other, and in prompting men of condition with treacherous allurements to base and shameful actions; and he is most cherished and honoured and most muniﬁcently entertained and rewarded of the sorry
uz: O'sha davrlarda u vazirlik lavozimida edi va u tinchlik shartnomalari bo'yicha muzokaralar olib borishda, zodagonlar o'rtasida nizolar yoki umidsizliklar yuzaga kelgan joylarda, yoki turmush qurish, ittifoq va do'stliklarni amalga oshirishda, charchaganlarning ongini g'alati va yoqimli so'zlar bilan ovutish va sudlarni chalg'itish, ay, ota kabi o'tkir tanbehlar bilan, g'ayrioddiylarning yomonliklarini tanbeh berish va bu uchun ozgina mukofotga sarflash odati edi; ammo hozirgi kunda ular o'z vaqtlarini bir-biridan yomon xabarlarni tarqatishda, shunday xolislik va behayolik bilan gapirishda va (asosidan ham yomoni) barcha odamlarning yovuzliklarini qilishda, behayolik va xorlik bilan, yoki boshqa bir-biridan ko'proq ayblashda o'tkazishni o'rganishadi, lekin eng ko'p sharmandalik va haqoratli va

en: unmannerly noblemen of our time who saith and doth the most abominable words and deeds; a sore and shameful reproach to the present age and a very manifest proof that the virtues have departed this lower world and left us wretched mortals to wallow in the slough of the vices.
uz: Zamonaviy zamonimizning odobsiz zodagonlari eng jirkanch so'zlar va amallarni aytadilar va qilishadi; bu hozirgi davr uchun og'riqli va sharmandali malomat va fazilatlar bu quyi dunyoni tark etgani va bizni, bechora o'luvchilarni, yovuzliklar botqog'iga botirishga qoldirganiga juda yaqqol dalildir.

en: But to return to my story, from which a just indignation hath carried me somewhat farther astray than I purposed —I say that the aforesaid Guglielmo was honoured by all the gentlemen of Genoa and gladly seen of them, and having sojourned some days in the city and hearing many tales of Messer Ermino’s avarice and sordidness, he desired to see him.
uz: Lekin o'z hikoyamga qaytadigan bo'lsak, unda adolatli g'azab meni maqsad qilganimdan biroz uzoqroqqa olib bordi  aytishimcha, yuqorida aytilgan Guglielmo Genuaning barcha janoblari tomonidan hurmatga sazovor bo'lgan va ulardan mamnuniyat bilan ko'ringan edi. U bir necha kun shaharda bo'lib, Messer Erminoning baxilligi va beodobligi haqida ko'plab hikoyalarni eshitib, uni ko'rishni xohlagan edi.

en: Messer Er- mino having already heard how worthy a man was this Guglielmo Borsiere and having yet, all miser as he was, some tincture of gentle breeding, re- ceived him with very amicable words and blithe aspect and entered with him into many and various discourses.
uz: Janob Er-mino allaqachon bu Guglielmo Borsiere qanchalik munosib inson ekanligini eshitib, hali ham juda bechora bo'lgani uchun, muloyimlik bilan tanishib, uni juda do'stona so'zlar va xushmuomalalik bilan qabul qildi va u bilan birga ko'plab va xilma-xil nutqlarga kirdi.

en: Devising thus, he carried him, to- gether with other Genoese who were in his company, into a ﬁne new house of his which he had lately built and after having shown it all to him, said, ‘Pray, Messer Guglielmo, you who have seen and heard many things, can you tell me of something that was never yet seen, which I may have depic- tured in the saloon of this my house?’ Guglielmo, hearing this his preposter- ous question, answered, ‘Sir, I doubt me I cannot undertake to tell you of aught that was never yet seen, except it were sneezings or the like; but, an it like you, I will tell you of somewhat which me thinketh you never yet be- held.’ Quoth Messer Ermino, not looking for such an answer as he got, ‘I
uz: Shunday niyat qilib, u uni o'z kompaniyasida bo'lgan boshqa genovaliklar bilan birga yaqinda qurgan yangi uyga olib kirdi va unga hammasini ko'rsatgandan so'ng dedi: "Iltijo qiling, janob Guglielmo, ko'p narsalarni ko'rgan va eshitgan inson, menga hali ko'rinmagan narsa haqida ayta olasizmi, uni men bu uyimning salonida tasvirlagan bo'lishim mumkinmi?" Guglielmo o'z so'rovini eshitib, javob berdi: "Janob, men sizga hali ko'rinmagan narsa haqida aytishga majbur emasman, faqat aksirlar yoki shunga o'xshash narsalar haqida; lekin, siz kabi, men sizga hali hech qachon ushlab turilmayman deb o'ylaydigan narsa haqida aytaman."

en: pray you tell me what it is.’ Whereto Guglielmo promptly replied, ‘Cause Liberality to be here depictured.’ When Messer Ermino heard this speech, there took him incontinent such a shame that it availed in a manner to change his disposition altogether to the contrary of that which it had been and he said, ‘Messer Guglielmo, I will have it here depictured after such a fashion that neither you nor any other shall ever again have cause to tell me that I have never seen nor known it.’ And from that time forth (such was the virtue of Guglielmo’s words) he was the most liberal and the most courteous gentleman of his day in Genoa and he who most hospitably entreated both strangers and citizens.”
uz: Iltimos, menga nima ekanligini ayting." Vyereto Gugeliermo zudlik bilan javob berdi: "Chunki bu yerda Erkinlik tasvirlangan." Messer Ermino bu nutqni eshitgach, u shunchalik sharmanda bo'ldiki, bu uning xatti-harakatini avvalgidek o'zgartirishga yordam berdi va u dedi: "Messer Gugeliermo, men uni bu yerda shunday tasvirlaymanki, siz ham, boshqa hech kim ham uni hech qachon ko'rmaganman yoki bilmaganman deb aytishga hech qanday sabab bo'lmaydi." Va o'shandan beri (Gugeliermoning so'zlarining afzalligi shu edi), u Genuada o'z davridagi eng liberal va eng mehmondo'st janob edi va u begona va fuqarolarni eng mehmondo'stlik bilan qabul qilgan edi.

en: THE NINTH STORY The King of Cyprus, touched to the quick by a Gascon lady, from a mean- spirited prince becometh a man of worth and valiance.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA Kipr shohi, Gaskon xonimi tomonidan tezkor ta'sirlanib, o'rtacha ruhli shahzodadan qimmatli va jasur odamga aylanadi.

en: The Queen’s last commandment rested with Elisa, who, without awaiting it, began all blithely, “Young ladies, it hath often chanced that what all manner reproofs and many pains69 bestowed upon a man have not availed to bring about in him hath been effected by a word more often spoken at hazard than of purpose aforethought.
uz: Qirolichaning so'nggi buyrug'i Elisaga tegishli edi, u buni kutmasdan, hamma narsa shov-shuv bilan boshlandi: "Yosh xonimlar, ko'pincha erkakka berilgan barcha tanbehlar va ko'plab azoblar69 uni oldindan o'ylagandan ko'ra ko'proq xavf ostida aytilgan so'z bilan amalga oshishi mumkin edi."

en: This is very well shown in the story related by Lauretta and I, in my turn, purpose to prove to you the same thing by means of another and a very short one; for that, since good things may still serve, they should be received with a mind attent, whoever be the sayer thereof.
uz: Bu Lauretta va men hikoya qilgan hikoyada juda yaxshi ko'rsatilgan, o'z navbatida, sizga bir xil narsani boshqa va juda qisqa narsa orqali isbotlash maqsadida; chunki yaxshi narsalar hali ham xizmat qilishi mumkin, ularni kim aytgan bo'lsa, diqqat bilan qabul qilish kerak.

en: I say, then, that in the days of the ﬁrst King of Cyprus, after the conquest of the Holy Land by Godefroi de Bouillon, it chanced that a gentlewoman of Gascony went on a pilgrimage to the Holy Sepulchre and returning thence, came to Cyprus, where she was shamefully abused of certain lewd fellows; whereof having complained, without getting any satisfaction, she thought to appeal to the King for redress, but was told that she would lose her pains, for that he was of so abject a composition and so little of worth that, far from justifying others of their wrongs, he endured with shameful pusillanimity innumerable affronts offered to himself, insomuch that whose had any grudge [against him] was wont to vent his despite by doing him some shame or insult.
uz: Shunday qilib, men aytamanki, Kiprning birinchi shohi davrida, Godefroi de Bouillon tomonidan Muqaddas Yerni zabt etgandan so'ng, Gaskoniyalik bir ayol Muqaddas Qabrga ziyorat qilib, u yerdan qaytib kelib, Kiprga keldi. U yerda u ba'zi behayolardan sharmandali tarzda haqoratlangan edi; u shikoyat qilgan, hech qanday qoniqish olmagan holda, qiroldan tuzatish so'rashni o'yladi, lekin unga uning og'riqlaridan xalos bo'lish haqida aytildi, chunki u juda past kompozitsiyaga ega edi va boshqalarning haqoratlarini oqlashdan yiroq edi, u o'ziga nisbatan sharmandali va xorona haqoratlarni ko'tardi, chunki u hech qanday sharmandalik bilan hech qanday

en: The lady, hearing this and despairing of redress, bethought herself, by way of some small solacement of her chagrin, to seek to rebuke the king’s pusillanimity; wherefore, presenting herself in tears before him, she said to him, ‘My lord, I come not into thy presence for any redress that I expect of the wrong that hath been done me; but in satisfaction thereof, I prithee teach
uz: Xonim bu gapni eshitib, tuzatishdan umidsiz bo'lib, o'zini xafaligidan biroz taskin topish maqsadida, podshohning beparvoligini tanbeh bermoqchi deb o'yladi; shuning uchun, yig'lab uning oldiga kelib, unga dedi: "Ey xo'jayinim, men senga qilgan zulmdan hech qanday tuzatish kutganim uchun kelmayman; lekin buni qondirish uchun, men...

en: me how thou dost to suffer those affronts which I understand are offered unto thyself, so haply I may learn of thee patiently to endure mine own, the which God knoweth, an I might, I would gladly bestow on thee, since thou art so excellent a supporter thereof.’ The King, who till then had been sluggish and supine, awoke as if from sleep and beginning with the wrong done to the lady, which he cruelly avenged, thenceforth became a very rigorous prosecutor of all who commit- ted aught against the honour of his crown.”
uz: Menga qanday qilib o'zim tushunadigan bu haqoratlar sizga taklif etilishiga toqat qilishingiz mumkin, shunda men sizdan o'zimnikiga sabr bilan bardosh berishni o'rganishim mumkin, Xudo biladi, va men sizga quvonch bilan sovg'a berardim, chunki siz uni juda yaxshi qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz." O'sha paytgacha sustkash va nozik bo'lgan qirol, go'yo uyqudan uyg'onib, xonimga qilingan zulmdan boshlanib, uni shafqatsizlarcha qasos olgan edi, shundan keyin o'z tojining sharafiga qarshi gunoh qilganlarning barchasining juda qat'iy prokuroriga aylandi.

en: THE TENTH STORY Master Alberto of Bologna civilly putteth a lady to the blush who thought to have shamed him of being enamoured of her.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Bologniyalik ustoz Alberto unga oshiq bo'lgani uchun uni sharmanda qilgan deb o'ylagan bir xonimni xushmuomalalik bilan qizarishga majbur qiladi.

en: Elisa being now silent, the last burden of the story-telling rested with the queen, who, with womanly grace beginning to speak, said, “Noble damsels, like as in the lucid nights the stars are the ornament of the sky and as in Springtime the ﬂowers of the green meadows, even so are commendable manners and pleasing discourse adorned by witty sallies, which latter, for that they are brief, are yet more beseeming to women than to men, inas- much as much and long speech, whenas it may be dispensed with, is straitli- er forbidden unto women than to men, albeit nowadays there are few or no women left who understand a sprightly saying or, if they understand it, know how to answer it, to the general shame be it said of ourselves and of all women alive.
uz: Endi Elisa jim bo'lib, hikoyaning oxirgi yukini malikaga yukladi. U ayolona muloyimlik bilan gapira boshladi va dedi: "Ajdod qizlar, xuddi yorqin tunlarda yulduzlar osmonning bezagi va bahorda yashil o'tloqlarning gullari kabi, xuddi shunday maqtalgan odoblar va xushmuomala nutqlar ham xushmuomalalik bilan bezatilgan, ular qisqacha bo'lgani uchun ayollarga erkaklarga qaraganda ko'proq yoqimliroqdir, chunki ular ayollarga nisbatan juda ko'p va uzun nutqdir, chunki u erkaklarga qaraganda ayollarga taqiqlanadi, garchi hozirda yorqin gapni tushunadigan yoki tushunadigan ayollar kam yoki yo'qdir, agar ular buni tushunsalar, ularga javob berishni bilishadi, chunki ular ayollar haqida umumiy va

en: For that virtue,70 which was erst in the minds of the wo- men of times past, those of our day have diverted to the adornment of the body, and she on whose back are to be seen the most motley garments and the most gaudily laced and garded and garnished with the greatest plenty of fringes and purﬂings and broidery deemeth herself worthy to be held of far more account than her fellows and to be honoured above them, considering not that, were it a question of who should load her back and shoulders with bravery, an ass would carry much more thereof than any of them nor would therefore be honoured for more than an ass.
uz: O'sha fazilat uchun, 70 o'tmishdagi odamlar ongida avval bo'lgan, bizning zamonimizdagilar tana bezagiga o'tdilar va u orqa tomonida eng yumshoq kiyimlar va eng ehtiyotkorlik bilan to'qilgan, pardozlangan va eng ko'p chegaralar, to'rlar va ko'kraklar bilan bezatilgan bo'lsa, o'zini o'z sheriklaridan ko'ra ko'proq qadrlashga va ulardan ustun bo'lishga loyiq deb hisoblaydi, agar bu kimning orqa va yelkalarini jasorat bilan yuklashi kerakligi masalasi bo'lsa, u ulardan ko'ra ko'proq narsani ko'taradi va shuning uchun ham bir yildan ko'proq hurmatga sazovor bo'lmaydi.

en: I blush to avow it, for that I cannot say aught against other women but I say it against myself; these women that are so laced and purﬂed and painted and particoloured abide either mute and senseless, like marble statues, or, an they be questioned, answer after such a fashion that it were far better to have kept silence.
uz: Men buni rad etish uchun qizaraman, chunki boshqa ayollarga qarshi hech narsa ayta olmayman, lekin o'zimga qarshi aytaman; bunchalik to'qilgan, binafsha, bo'yalgan va rang-barang bo'lgan bu ayollar yoki marmar haykallar kabi jim va bema'ni bo'lib qoladilar, yoki, so'roq qilinsa, shunday tarzda javob berishadi, hatto jim bo'lish yaxshiroq edi.

en: And they would have you believe that their unableness to
uz: Va ular sizni o'zlarining qobiliyatsizligiga ishonishingizni xohlashadi.

en: converse among ladies and men of parts proceedeth from purity of mind, and to their witlessness they give the name of modesty, as if forsooth no woman were modest but she who talketh with her chamberwoman or her laundress or her bake-wench; the which had Nature willed, as they would have it believed, she had assuredly limited unto them their prattle on other wise.
uz: Ayollar va erkaklar o'rtasidagi turli xil muloqot aql-idrokdan kelib chiqadi va ularning beparvoligiga kamtarlik deb nom berishadi, go'yo hech qanday ayol kamtar emas, faqatgina o'z xonadoni, kir yuvuvchi xonadoni yoki pishiruvchi xonadoni bilan gapiradigan ayol; tabiat xohlaganidek, ular ishonishlariga ko'ra, u albatta boshqa yo'l bilan ularning o'yin-kulgilarini ularga cheklagan edi.

en: It is true that in this, as in other things, it behoveth to have regard to time and place and with whom one talketh; for that it chanceth bytimes that women or men, thinking with some pleasantry or other to put another to the blush and not having well measured their own powers with those of the lat- ter, ﬁnd that confusion, which they thought to cast upon another, recoil upon themselves.
uz: To'g'ri, bu yerda ham, boshqa narsalarda bo'lgani kabi, vaqt va joyga, shuningdek, kim bilan gaplashishga e'tibor qaratish kerak; chunki ba'zan ayollar yoki erkaklar, qandaydir xushmuomalalik bilan boshqa birovni qizarishga o'ylab, o'z kuchlarini oxirgilarning kuchlari bilan yaxshi o'lchamasdan, boshqa birovga uloqtirmoqchi bo'lgan chalkashlikni o'zlariga qaytarib olishadi.

en: Wherefore, so you may know how to keep yourselves and that, to boot, you may not serve as a text for the proverb which is current everywhere, to wit, that women in everything still take the worst, I would have you learn a lesson from the last of today’s stories, which falleth to me to tell, to the intent that, even as you are by nobility of mind distinguished from other women, so likewise you may show yourselves no less removed from them by excellence of manners.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'zingizni qanday saqlashni bilishingiz uchun va, boshida aytganda, hamma joyda tarqalgan maqol uchun matn bo'lmasligingiz mumkin, ya'ni ayollar hamma narsada eng yomonni qabul qilishadi, men sizlardan bugungi oxirgi hikoyalardan saboq olishingizni so'rayman, ularni aytish menga to'g'ri keladi, shu maqsadda, garchi siz aql-idrokingiz bilan boshqa ayollardan ajralib tursangiz ham, xuddi shunday qilib siz ham ulardan xulq-atvor mukammalligi bilan kamroq uzoqroq ko'rinishingiz mumkin.

en: It is not many years since there lived (and belike yet liveth) at Bologna a very great and famous physician, known by manifest renown to well nigh all the world.
uz: Bolonyada juda buyuk va mashhur shifokor yashaganiga (va ehtimol hali ham yashayotganiga) ko'p yillar bo'lmadi, u butun dunyoga yaqin taniqli bo'lgan.

en: His name was Master Alberto and such was the vivacity of his spirit that, albeit he was an old man of hard upon seventy years of age and well nigh all natural heat had departed his body, he scrupled not to expose himself to the ﬂames of love; for that, having seen at an entertainment a very beautiful widow lady, called, as some say, Madam Malgherida71 de’ Ghisolieri, and being vastly taken with her, he received into his mature bos- om, no otherwise than if he had been a young gallant, the amorous ﬁre, in- somuch that himseemed he rested not well by night, except the day fore- gone he had looked upon the delicate and lovesome countenance of the fair lady.
uz: Uning ismi ustoz Alberto edi va uning ruhi shunchalik jonli ediki, u yetmish yoshdan oshgan va tanasidan deyarli barcha tabiiy issiqlik chiqib ketgan qari odam bo'lsa ham, o'zini sevgi olovlariga duchor qilmaslikka ehtiyot bo'lardi; chunki, ko'ngilochar tadbirda juda go'zal beva ayolni ko'rib, ba'zilar aytgandek, Madam Malgherida71 de'isolieri deb atardi va u bilan juda ko'p olib ketilgan edi, u o'zining yetuk xo'jayiniga, go'yo u yosh gallant bo'lgandek, sevgi olovini qabul qilardi, chunki u kechasi yaxshi dam olmagan edi, faqat oldindan o'tib ketganidan keyin u go'zal ayolning nozik va yoqimli ko'rinishiga qaragan edi.

en: Wherefore he fell to passing continually before her house, now afoot and now on horseback, as the occasion served him, insomuch that she and many other ladies got wind of the cause of his constant passings to and fro and oftentimes made merry among themselves to see a man thus ripe of years and wit in love, as if they deemed that that most pleasant passion of love took root and ﬂourished only in the silly minds of the young and not otherwhere.
uz: Shuning uchun u uyning oldida tinimsiz o'tib ketishga tushdi, hozir yo'lda, endi otda, vaziyatga duch kelganda, shundayki, u va boshqa ko'plab xonimlar uning doimiy bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa o'tishining sababini bilib qoldilar va ko'pincha o'zaro xursand bo'lishdi, shunday bir odamni ko'rishdi, u yoshlarning ahmoqona ongida va boshqa joyda emas, go'yo o'sha eng yoqimli sevgi ishtiyoqi ildiz otgandek va gullab-yashnadi.

en: What while he continued to pass back and forth, it chanced one holiday that, the lady being seated with many others before her door and espying
uz: U oldinga va orqaga o'taverar ekan, bir bayram kelib qoldi, xonim uning eshigi oldida ko'pchilik bilan o'tirib, josuslik qilayotgan edi.

en: Master Alberto making towards them from afar, they one and all took coun- sel together to entertain him and do him honour and after to rally him on that his passion.
uz: Ustoz Alberto uzoqdan ularga qarab turar ekan, ular uni xursand qilish, hurmat qilish va keyin uni o'z ishtiyoqiga ishontirish uchun birgalikda maslahatlashdilar.

en: Accordingly, they all rose to receive him and inviting him [to enter], carried him into a shady courtyard, whither they let bring the choicest of wines and sweetmeats and presently enquired of him, in very civil and pleasant terms, how it might be that he was fallen enamoured of that fair lady, knowing her to be loved of many handsome, young and sprightly gentlemen.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ularning hammasi uni kutib olish uchun turishdi va taklif qilishdi, soyali hovliga olib kirishdi, u yerga eng yaxshi vino va shirinliklarni olib kelishdi va undan, juda odobli va yoqimli so'zlar bilan, uning o'sha go'zal xonimga qanday qilib oshiq bo'lishi mumkinligini so'rashdi, uning ko'plab chiroyli, yosh va yorqin janoblar tomonidan sevilishini bilishardi.

en: The physician, ﬁnding himself thus courteously at- tacked, put on a blithe countenance and answered, ‘Madam, that I love should be no marvel to any understanding person, and especially that I love yourself, for that you deserve it; and albeit old men are by operation of nature bereft of the vigour that behoveth unto amorous exercises, yet not for all that are they bereft of the will nor of the wit to apprehend that which is worthy to be loved; nay, this latter is naturally the better valued of them, inasmuch as they have more knowledge and experience than the young.
uz: Shifokor o'zini shunday xushmuomalalik bilan ta'qibga duchor bo'lganidan so'ng, xushmuomala yuz ko'rsatdi va javob berdi: "Xonim, men sevganim hech qanday tushunadigan odamga hayratlanarli emas, ayniqsa o'zingizni sevganim uchun, chunki siz bunga loyiqsiz; va garchi keksa odamlar tabiat ta'sirida sevgi mashqlariga kerakli kuchdan mahrum bo'lsalar ham, lekin ular sevishga arziydigan narsani anglashga xohish yoki aqldan mahrum bo'lsalar ham; yo'q, bu, albatta, ulardan qadrlanadi, chunki ular yoshlardan ko'ra ko'proq bilim va tajribaga ega."

en: As for the hope that moveth me, who am an old man, to love you who are cour- ted of many young gallants, it is on this wise: I have been many a time where I have seen ladies lunch and eat lupins and leeks.
uz: Meni, keksa odamni, sizni sevishga undaydigan umid shuki, siz ko'plab yosh zodagonlar uchun moyilsiz: men ko'p marta ayollar tushlik qilib, lupin va lyuklarni yeganimni ko'rganman.

en: Now, although in the leek no part is good, yet is the head72 thereof less hurtful and more agreeable to the taste; but you ladies, moved by a perverse appetite, com- monly hold the head in your hand and munch the leaves, which are not only naught, but of an ill savour.
uz: Endi, garchi ko'z-ko'zidagi hech qanday yaxshi qism bo'lmasa ham, uning boshi kamroq zararli va ta'mga ko'proq mos keladi; lekin siz ayollar, buzuq ishtaha tufayli, boshingizni qo'lingizga olib, barglarni yeng, ular nafaqat zararli, balki yomon ta'mga ega.

en: How know I, madam, but you do the like in the election of your lovers?
uz: Qanday bilaman, xonim, lekin siz sevishganlaringizni saylashda shunga o'xshash ishlar qilasiz?

en: In which case, I should be the one chosen of you and the others would be turned away.’ The gentlewoman and her companions were somewhat abashed and said, ‘Doctor, you have right well and courteously chastised our presumptuous emprise; algates, your love is dear to me, as should be that of a man of worth and learning; wherefore, you may in all assurance command me, as your creature, of your every pleasure, saving only mine honour.’ The physi- cian, rising with his companions, thanked the lady and taking leave of her with laughter and merriment, departed thence.
uz: Shunday holatda, men sizlardan tanlangan bo'lishim kerak edi va qolganlar yuz o'girib ketishardi. Janob ayol va uning hamrohlari biroz xijolatda bo'lishdi va dedilar: Do'xtir, siz bizning kibrli ishlarimizni to'g'ri va odob bilan tanqid qildingiz; algatlar, sizning muhabbatingiz menga qadrli, xuddi qadrli va bilimdon odamnikidek; shuning uchun, siz menga, o'z maxluqingiz kabi, har qanday lazzatingizdan, faqat mening hurmatimni saqlab qolishingizga ishonch bilan buyurishingiz mumkin. Physi-sian o'z hamrohlari bilan turib, xonimga rahmat aytdi va undan kulgi va xursandchilik bilan chiqib ketdi.

en: Thus the lady, looking not whom she rallied and thinking to discomﬁt another, was herself discom- ﬁted; wherefrom, an you be wise, you will diligently guard yourselves.”
uz: Shunday qilib, xonim kimga e'tibor bermay, boshqalarni noqulay his qilmoqchi bo'lib, o'zi noqulay edi; shuning uchun, dono bo'linglar, o'zingizni diqqat bilan qo'riqlaysizlar.

en: The sun had begun to decline towards the evening, and the heat was in great part abated, when the stories of the young ladies and of the three young men came to an end; whereupon quoth the queen blithesomely, “Henceforth, dear companions, there remaineth nought more to do in the matter of my governance for the present day, save to give you a new queen, who shall, according to her judgment, order her life and ours, for that73 which is to come, unto honest pleasance.
uz: Quyosh oqshomga tomon tushishni boshladi va issiqlik asosan kamaydi, shu bilan birga qizlar va uch yigit haqidagi hikoyalar tugab ketdi; shundan so'ng malika shovqin bilan dedi: "Endi, aziz do'stlar, mening boshqaruvim masalasida hozirgi kun uchun sizga yangi malika berishdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi, u o'z hukmiga ko'ra, uning hayoti va bizning hayotimizni, kelajakdagi, halol rohat uchun tartibga soladi."

en: And albeit the day may be held to endure from now until nightfall, yet —for that whoso taketh not somewhat of time in advance cannot, meseemeth, so well provide for the future and in order that what the new queen shall deem needful for the morrow may be pre- pared —methinketh the ensuing days should commence at this hour.
uz: Va garchi kun hozirdan kechga qadar davom etishi mumkin bo'lsa ham, lekin  chunki kimki oldindan vaqt olmagan bo'lsa, kelajakni yaxshi ta'minlaydi va yangi malika ertaga zarur deb hisoblagan narsa oldindan amalga oshirilishi uchun  keyingi kunlar shu soatdan boshlanishi kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: Where- fore, in reverence of Him unto whom all things live and for our own solace- ment, Filomena, a right discreet damsel, shall, as queen, govern our king- dom for the coming day.” So saying, she rose to her feet and putting off the laurel-wreath, set it reverently on the head of Filomena, whom ﬁrst herself and after all the other ladies and the young men likewise saluted as queen, cheerfully submitting themselves to her governance.
uz: Xo'sh, hamma narsa tirik bo'lgan Zotga hurmat bilan va o'z tasalliimiz uchun, Filomena, haqiqiy va nozik malika, kelajak kun uchun qirol domimizni malika sifatida boshqaradi. Shunday qilib, u oyoqqa turdi va laurel libosini yechib, uni hurmat bilan Filomena boshiga qo'ydi. Filomena avval o'zi, keyin boshqa xonimlar va yigitlar ham malika sifatida quvonch bilan o'zini unga bo'ysundirdilar.

en: Filomena blushed somewhat to ﬁnd herself invested with the queendom, but, calling to mind the words a little before spoken by Pampinea,74 —in or- der that she might not appear witless, she resumed her assurance and in the ﬁrst place conﬁrmed all the ofﬁces given by Pampinea; then, having de- clared that they should abide whereas they were, she appointed that which was to do against the ensuing morning, as well as for that night’s supper, and after proceeded to speak thus: “Dearest companions, albeit Pampinea, more of her courtesy than for any worth of mine, hath made me queen of you all, I am not therefore disposed to follow my judgment alone in the manner of our living, but yours together with mine; and that you may know that which meseemeth is to do and con- sequently at your pleasure add thereto or abate thereof, I purpose brieﬂy to declare it to you.
uz: Filomena malikalik bilan band bo'lganini biroz qizarib ketdi, lekin Pampiyaning biroz oldin aytgan so'zlarini esladi, 74  garchi u beparvo ko'rinmasligi uchun, u o'z ishonchini tikladi va birinchi navbatda Pampiyaning bergan barcha lavozimlarini tasdiqladi; keyin, ular qayerda bo'lishlari kerakligini aniq qilib, u kelayotgan ertalab, shuningdek, o'sha kechki ovqatga qarshi nima qilish kerakligini belgiladi va shunday dedi: Azizimli hamrohlar, garchi Pampiyaning hech narsaga arzimaganidan ko'ra ko'proq mehribonligi meni sizlarning barchangizdan malika qildi, men faqat o'zimning hayot tarzimda, balki siz bilan birga yashashga rozi bo'lishga tayyor emasman; va shunga ko'ra, siz shuni qisqacha qilib aytishingiz mumkinki,

en: If I have well noted the course this day held by Pampinea, meseemeth I have found it alike praiseworthy and delectable; wherefore till such time as, for overlong continuance or other reason, it grow irksome to us, I judge it not to be changed.
uz: Agar men Pampiyaning bugungi kundagi marosimini yaxshi qayd etgan bo'lsam, men uni bir xilda maqtovga sazovor va yoqimli deb topdim; shuning uchun, uzoq davom etish yoki boshqa sabablarga ko'ra, bizga yoqimsiz bo'lib qolmaguncha, uni o'zgartirish kerak emas deb hisoblayman.

en: Order, then, being taken for [the continuance of] that which we have already begun to do, we will, arising hence, go awhile a- pleasuring, and whenas the sun shall be for going under, we will sup in the cool of the evening, and after sundry canzonets and other pastimes, we shall
uz: Shunday qilib, biz allaqachon boshlagan ishimizni davom ettirish uchun, biz, shu sababli, bir oz xursandchilik bilan ketamiz va quyosh botish uchun bo'lganda, kechki sovuqda kechki ovqat qilamiz va turli xil kanzonetlar va boshqa o'yin-kulglardan so'ng, biz...

en: do well to betake ourselves to sleep.
uz: Yaxshi qilamiz, o'zimizni uxlashga majbur qilamiz.

en: Tomorrow, rising in the cool of the morning, we will on like wise go somewhither a-pleasuring, as shall be most agreeable to everyone; and as we have done today, we will at the due hour come back to eat; after which we will dance and when we arise from sleep, as today we have done, we will return hither to our story-telling, wherein meseemeth a very great measure to consist alike of pleasance and of proﬁt.
uz: Ertaga, ertalabning salqinida turib, biz donolar kabi hamma uchun eng yoqimli bo'lgan joyga boramiz; va bugun qilganimizdek, o'z vaqtida ovqatlanish uchun qaytamiz; shundan so'ng raqsga tushamiz va uyqudan uyg'onganimizda, bugun qilganimizdek, bu yerga o'z hikoyalarimizga qaytamiz, u yerda juda katta o'lchov bo'ladi, u yerda ham lazzat, ham foyda bo'ladi.

en: Moreover, that which Pampinea had indeed no opportunity of do- ing, by reason of her late election to the governance, I purpose now to enter upon, to wit, to limit within some bound that whereof we are to tell and to declare it75 to you beforehand, so each of you may have leisure to think of some goodly story to relate upon the theme proposed, the which, an it please you, shall be on this wise; namely, seeing that since the beginning of the world men have been and will be, until the end thereof, bandied about by various shifts of fortune, each shall be holden to tell OF THOSE WHO AFTER BEING BAFFLED BY DIVERS CHANCES HAVE WON AT LAST TO A JOYFUL ISSUE BEYOND THEIR HOPE.” Ladies and men alike all commended this ordinance and declared them- selves ready to ensue it.
uz: Qolaversa, Pampiyaning hukumatga kech saylanganligi sababli, qilishga imkoni bo'lmagani uchun, men hozir shunga kirishmoqchiman, ya'ni, oldindan sizga aytib berish va e'lon qilishimiz kerak bo'lgan 75-sonli mas'uliyatni cheklab qo'yishni maqsad qilaman, shunda har biringiz taklif qilingan mavzu bo'yicha ba'zi yaxshi hikoyalarni o'ylab topishga vaqt topasiz, va bu sizga yoqadi, shu yo'l bilan bo'ladi; ya'ni, dunyo boshidan beri odamlar turli xil omad o'zgarishlari bilan bog'langan va oxir-oqibatda shunday bo'ladi, har biringiz "DIVERS BYONDIR" tomonidan qo'rqib ketgandan keyin, oxir-oqibatda o'tishga tayyor bo'lganlar haqida aytishga majbur bo'lasiz.

en: Only Dioneo, the others all being silent, said, “Madam, as all the rest have said, so say I, to wit that the ordinance given by you is exceeding pleasant and commendable; but of especial favour I crave you a boon, which I would have conﬁrmed to me for such time as our company shall endure, to wit, that I may not be constrained by this your law to tell a story upon the given theme, an it like me not, but shall be free to tell that which shall most please me.
uz: Faqat Dioneo, qolganlarning hammasi jim bo'lib, dedi: Xonim, qolganlarning hammasi aytganidek, men ham shunday deyapman, chunki siz bergan farmoyish juda yoqimli va maqtovga sazovor; lekin sizdan alohida iltifot so'rayman, uni bizning kompaniyamiz davom etar ekan, menga tasdiqlagan bo'lardim, ya'ni, men sizning qonunga ko'ra berilgan mavzu bo'yicha hikoya aytishga majbur bo'lmasligim uchun, u menga yoqmaydigan, lekin menga eng yoqadigan narsani aytishga erkin bo'lardim.

en: And that none may think I seek this favour as one who hath not stories, in hand, from this time forth I am con- tent to be still the last to tell.” The queen —who knew him for a merry man and a gamesome and was well assured that he asked this but that he might cheer the company with some laughable story, whenas they should be weary of discoursing —with the others’ consent, cheerfully accorded him the favour he sought.
uz: Va hech kim o'ylamasligi uchun, men bu marhamatni qo'lida hech qanday hikoyasi bo'lmagan odam sifatida izlayman, bundan buyon men so'nggi bo'lishga tayyorman." Qirolicha  uni quvnoq odam va o'yinchi deb biladi va u buni so'raganidan amin edi, faqatgina u odamlarni bir kulgili hikoya bilan xursand qilishi mumkin edi, garchi ular boshqalar bilan rozilik bilan suhbatlashishdan charchagan bo'lsalar ham, u xohlagan marhamatni xursandchilik bilan berdi.

en: Then, arising from session, with slow steps they took their way towards a rill of very clear water, that ran down from a little hill, amid great rocks and green herbage, into a valley overshaded with many trees and there, going about in the water, bare-armed and shoeless, they fell to taking various diversions among themselves, till suppertime drew near, when they returned to the palace and there supped merrily.
uz: Keyin, majlisdan turib, sekin qadamlar bilan ular juda tiniq suvga ega bo'lgan, kichik tepalikdan, katta toshlar va yashil o'tlar orasida pastga tushib, ko'plab daraxtlar soyali vodiyga tomon yo'l olishdi va u yerda, suvda yalang'och va oyoqsiz yurib, bir-birlari bilan turli xil chalg'ituvchi mashg'ulotlar o'tkazishga tushishdi, to kechki ovqat yaqinlashguncha, saroyga qaytib, u yerda xursandchilik bilan ovqatlanishdi.

en: Supper ended, the queen called for instru- ments of music and bade Lauretta lead up a dance, whilst Emilia sang a
uz: Kechki ovqat tugab, malika musiqa o'rgatishlarini chaqirib, Lauretta raqsga tushishni buyurdi, Emilia esa...

en: song, to the accompaniment of Dioneo’s lute.
uz: Qo'shiq, Dioneoning lyutasi bilan birga.

en: Accordingly, Lauretta promptly set up a dance and led it off, whilst Emilia amorously warbled the following song: I burn for mine own charms with such a ﬁre,  Methinketh that I ne’er  Of other love shall reck or have desire.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Lauretta tezda raqsga tushdi va uni boshladi, Emilia esa quyidagi qo'shiqni mehr bilan o'ynadi: Men o'z jozibalarim uchun shunday olovda yonaman, boshqa sevgi meni tanlamasligini yoki xohishga ega bo'lishini o'ylayman.

en: Whene’er I mirror me, I see therein76  That good which still contenteth heart and spright;  Nor fortune new nor thought of old can win  To dispossess me of such dear delight.
uz: Qayerda o'zimni ko'rsam, u yerda 76 Qalb va nurni hali ham qondiradigan yaxshilikni ko'raman; Yangi boylik ham, eski fikr ham meni bunday aziz lazzatdan mahrum qilishga qodir emas.

en: What other object, then, could ﬁll my sight,  Enough of pleasance e’er  To kindle in my breast a new desire?
uz: Qanday boshqa narsa ko'zimni to'ldirishi mumkin, Ko'kragimda yangi istakni yoqishga yetarli lazzat?

en: This good ﬂees not, what time soe’er I’m fain  Afresh to view it for my solacement;  Nay, at my pleasure, ever and again  With such a grace it doth itself present  Speech cannot tell it nor its full intent  Be known of mortal e’er,  Except indeed he burn with like desire.
uz: Bu yaxshilik qochib ketmaydi, qachonki men uni tasalli olish uchun ko'rishga tayyor bo'lsam; Yo'q, mening xohishimga ko'ra, har doim shunday inoyat bilan u o'zini namoyon qiladi. Nutq uni aniqlay olmaydi va uning to'liq maqsadi ham o'lmaslikdan ma'lum bo'ladi, Agar u xuddi shunday istak bilan yonmasa.

en: And I, grown more enamoured every hour,  The straitlier ﬁxed mine eyes upon it be,  Give all myself and yield me to its power,  E’en tasting now of that it promised me,  And greater joyance yet I hope to see,  Of such a strain as ne’er  Was proven here below of love-desire.
uz: Men esa, har soatda yanada oshiq bo'lib, ko'zlarimni unga tikdim, butunlay o'zimni ber va uning qudratiga topshir, Endi u menga va'da qilgan narsadan tatib ko'rayapman, va bundan ham katta quvonchni ko'rishga umid qilaman, bu yerda sevgi-istakdan pastroq bo'lgan bunday zo'riqishdan.

en: Lauretta having thus made an end of her ballad,77 —in the burden of which all had blithely joined, albeit the words thereof gave some much mat- ter for thought —divers other rounds were danced and a part of the short night being now spent, it pleased the queen to give an end to the ﬁrst day; wherefore, letting kindle the ﬂambeaux, she commanded that all should be- take themselves to rest until the ensuing morning, and all, accordingly, re- turning to their several chambers, did so.
uz: Lauretta shunday qilib o'z balladasini tugatdi, 77  garchi uning so'zlari o'ylashga ko'p yordam bergan bo'lsa-da, hamma uning yukida birlashgan edi  boshqa raundlar raqsga tushdi va qisqa tunning bir qismi o'tib ketdi, shuning uchun qirolicha birinchi kunni yakunlashdan mamnun edi; shuning uchun, olovlarni yoqib, u hamma ertagacha dam olishi kerakligini buyurdi va hamma, shunga ko'ra, o'z xonalariga qaytib, shunday qildi.

en: Here endeth the First Day of the Decameron.
uz: Mana Dekameronning Birinchi Kuni tugaydi.

en: DAY THE SECOND INTRODUCTION Here beginneth the second day of the Decameron wherein under the governance of Filomena is discoursed of those who after being bafﬂed by divers chances have won at last to a joyful issue beyond their hope.
uz: IKKINCHI KUN KIRISH Mana Decameronning ikkinchi kuni boshlanadi, unda Filomena boshqaruvi ostida turli xil imkoniyatlardan hayratga tushib, nihoyat umidlaridan tashqari quvonchli masalaga erishganlar haqida so'z boradi.

en: The sun had already everywhere brought on the new day with its light and the birds, carolling blithely among the green branches, bore witness thereof unto the ear with their merry songs, when the ladies and the three young men, arising all, entered the gardens and pressing the dewy grass with slow step, went wandering hither and thither, weaving goodly garlands and dis- porting themselves, a great while.
uz: Quyosh hamma joyda o'zining nuri bilan yangi kunni keltirib chiqardi va qushlar yashil shoxlar orasida shovqinli o'ynab, quvonchli qo'shiqlari bilan bunga guvohlik berishdi. Xonimlar va uch yigit hammasi o'rnidan turib, bog'larga kirib, sekin qadamlar bilan xaroba o'tlarini bosib, u yoqqa va bu yoqqa adashib, yaxshi guldastalar to'qib, o'zlarini uzoq vaqt davomida yo'q qilishdi.

en: And like as they had done the day fore- gone, even so did they at present; to wit, having eaten in the cool and danced awhile, they betook them to repose and arising thence after none, came all, by command of their queen, into the fresh meadows, where they seated themselves round about her.
