uz: Va xuddi o'tgan kun qilganidek, ular ham hozir shunday qilishdi; ya'ni, sovuqda ovqatlanib, biroz raqsga tushgach, ularni dam olishga olib kelishdi va u yerdan hech kim turmasdan, barcha, malikalarining buyrug'i bilan, yangi o'tloqlarga kelishdi, u yerda ular uning atrofida o'tirishdi.

en: Then she, who was fair of favour and exceeding pleasant of aspect, having sat awhile, crowned with her laurel wreath, and looked all her company in the face, bade Neiﬁle give beginning to the day’s stories by telling one of her fashion; whereupon the latter, without making any excuse, blithely began to speak thus:
uz: Keyin u, go'zal va juda yoqimli ko'rinishga ega bo'lib, bir oz vaqt o'tirgach, lavr gullari bilan toj kiydirib, butun davrasining yuziga qaradi, kun hikoyalarini o'z modalaridan biriga aytib boshlamoqchi edi; shundan so'ng, hech qanday bahona qilmasdan, shiddat bilan gapira boshladi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Martellino feigneth himself a cripple and maketh believe to wax whole upon the body of St.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Martellino o'zini nogiron deb ko'rsatadi va avliyo Masihning tanasida butunlay nur sochishiga ishontiradi.

en: His imposture being discovered, he is beaten and being after taken (for a thief), goeth in peril of being hanged by the neck, but ultimately escapeth.
uz: Uning firibgarligi aniqlanib, kaltaklanadi va o'g'ri deb ushlanib, bo'yniga osilish xavfi ostida qoladi, ammo oxir-oqibat qutulib qoladi.

en: “It chanceth oft, dearest ladies, that he who studieth to befool others, and especially in things reverend, ﬁndeth himself with nothing for his pains but ﬂouts and whiles cometh not off scathless.
uz: Ko'pincha shunday bo'ladi, aziz ayollar, kimki boshqalarni, ayniqsa, hurmatli narsalarni aldashni o'rgansa, o'z azoblariga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaydi, faqatgina g'am-tashvish va g'am-tashvishlar qoladi.

en: Wherefore, that I may obey the queen’s commandment and give beginning to the appointed theme with a story of mine, I purpose to relate to you that which, ﬁrst misfortunately and after happily, beyond his every thought, betided a townsman of ours.
uz: Shuning uchun, malika amriga itoat etish va belgilangan mavzuni o'z hikoyam bilan boshlash uchun, men sizga avval afsuski, keyin esa xursandchilik bilan, har bir o'yidan tashqari, bizning bir shaharchimizga ta'sir qilgan narsani yetkazmoqchiman.

en: No great while agone there was at Treviso a German called Arrigo, who, being a poor man, served whoso required him to carry burdens for hire; and withal he was held of all a man of very holy and good life.
uz: Uzoq vaqt o'tgach, Trevisoda Arrigo ismli bir nemis bor edi. Arrigo kambag'al odam bo'lgani uchun, undan yuklarni ijaraga olib yurishni talab qiladiganlarga xizmat qilardi; va u juda muqaddas va yaxshi hayot kechiradigan odam edi.

en: Wherefore, be it true or untrue, when he died, it befell, according to that which the Trevisans avouch, that, in the hour of his death, the bells of the great church of Tre- viso began to ring, without being pulled of any.
uz: Shuning uchun, rost bo'ladimi yoki noto'g'ri, u vafot etganida, Trevizanlar aytganidek, uning o'lim soatida, hech kimdan tortilmasdan, Tre-Viso buyuk cherkovining qo'ng'iroqlari yangray boshladi.

en: The people of the city, ac- counting this a miracle, proclaimed this Arrigo a saint and running all to the house where he lay, bore his body, for that of a saint, to the Cathedral, whither they fell to bringing the halt, the impotent and the blind and others afﬂicted with whatsoever defect or inﬁrmity, as if they should all be made whole by the touch of the body.
uz: Shahar aholisi buni mo'jiza deb hisoblab, bu Arrigoni avliyo deb e'lon qilishdi va u yotgan uyga yugurib borishdi, avliyo jasadini, Katedralga olib ketishdi, u yerga to'xtash uchun yiqilishdi, ojizlar, ko'rlar va boshqa har qanday nuqson yoki zaiflik bilan kasallanganlar, go'yo ularning hammasi jasad teginishi bilan butun bo'lishi kerakdek.

en: In the midst of this great turmoil and concourse of folk, it chanced that there arrived at Treviso three of our townsmen, whereof one was called Stecchi, another Martellino and the third Marchese, men who visited the courts of princes and lords and diverted the beholders by travestying them-
uz: Bu katta shovqin va xalq to'planishi o'rtasida Trevisioga uch nafar shaharchimiz yetib keldi, ulardan biri Stecchi, yana biri Martellino va uchinchisi Marchese deb atalgan, shahzodalar va lordlarning saroylariga tashrif buyurib, tomoshabinlarni ularning atrofida sayr qilib chalg'itadigan odamlar edi.

en: selves and counterfeiting whatsoever other man with rare motions and grimaces.
uz: o'zini o'zi va kamdan-kam harakatlar va grimlar bilan boshqa odamni soxtalashtiradi.

en: Never having been there before and seeing all the folk run, they marvelled and hearing the cause, were for going to see what was toward; wherefore they laid up their baggage at an inn and Marchese said, ‘We would fain go look upon this saint; but, for my part, I see not how we may avail to win thither, for that I understand the Cathedral place is full of Ger- man and other men-at-arms, whom the lord of this city hath stationed there, so no riot may betide; more by token that they say the church is so full of folk that well nigh none else might enter there.’ ‘Let not that hinder you,’ quoth Martellino, who was all agog to see the show; ‘I warrant you I will ﬁnd a means of winning to the holy body.’ ‘How so?’ asked Marchese, and Martellino answered, ‘I will tell thee.
uz: Hech qachon u yerda bo'lmagan va butun xalq yugurganini ko'rmagan holda, ular hayratda qolishdi va ishni eshitishdi, nima bo'layotganini ko'rish uchun bormoqchi edilar; shuning uchun ular yuklarini mehmonxonaga qo'yishdi va Marcheselar dedi: "Biz bu avliyoga borishni xohlaymiz; lekin, o'z navbatida, u yerga qanday g'alaba qozonishimiz mumkinligini ko'rmayapman, chunki men tushunaman, sobor joyi Ger-man va boshqa qurol-yarog' egalari bilan to'la, bu shahar xo'jayini uni joylashtirgan, shuning uchun hech qanday tartibsizlik bo'lmasligi kerak; bundan tashqari, ular cherkov shunchalik odamlarga to'la, hech kim kirishi mumkin emas deb aytishadi." "Sizga xalaqit qilmang," dedi Martellino, u ko'rgazmani tomosha qilish uchun bor edi; "Men seni qanday qilib g'alaba qozonadigan muqaddas odamni topaman," deb javob berdi.

en: I will counterfeit myself a cripple and thou on one side and Stecchi on the other shall go upholding me, as it were I could not walk of myself, making as if you would fain bring me to the saint, so he may heal me.
uz: Men o'zimga nogironni soxtalashtiraman va sen bir tomonda, sen esa ikkinchi tomonda Stecchi meni qo'llab-quvvatlab borasan, go'yo o'zimni qo'ldan boy bermayotgandek, go'yo sen meni avliyoga olib bormoqchi bo'larding, u meni davolashi uchun.

en: There will be none but, seeing us, will make way for us and let us pass.’ The device pleased Marchese and Stecchi and they went forth of the inn without delay, all three.
uz: Hech kim bo'lmaydi, lekin bizni ko'rib, bizga yo'l ochib, o'tib ketishga ruxsat beradi." Qurilma Marchese va Stecchiga yoqdi va ular uchalasi ham kechiktirmasdan mehmonxonadan chiqib ketishdi.

en: Whenas they came to a solitary place, Martellino writhed his hands and ﬁngers and arms and legs and eke his mouth and eyes and all his visnomy on such wise that it was a frightful thing to look upon, nor was there any saw him but would have avouched him to be verily all fordone and palsied of his person.
uz: Ular yolg'iz joyga yetib kelganlarida, Martellino qo'llari, barmoqlari, qo'llari va oyoqlarini burab, og'zini, ko'zlarini va barcha ko'z-ko'zlarini shunday donolik bilan o'ynatdiki, bu juda dahshatli narsa edi, uni hech kim ko'rmadi, lekin uni o'z shaxsiyatidan butunlay xaroba va falaj bo'lishga majbur qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Marchese and Stecchi, taking him up, counterfeited as he was, made straight for the church, with a show of the utmost compunction, humbly beseeching all who came in their way for the love of God to make room for them, the which was lightly yielded them.
uz: Marchese va Stecchi uni o'ziga olib, o'zicha soxtalashtirib, cherkovga to'g'ri yo'l olishdi, eng katta rahm-shafqat ko'rsatib, yo'llarida kelganlarning barchasidan Xudoning muhabbati uchun joy ajratilishini, u ularga yengil taslim bo'lganini kamtarlik bilan iltimos qilishdi.

en: Brief, everyone gazing on them and crying well nigh all, ‘Make way!
uz: Qisqacha, hamma ularga tikilib, deyarli hamma yig'lab: "Yo'l oching!"

en: Make way!’ they came whereas Saint Arrigo’s body lay and Martellino was forth- right taken up by certain gentlemen who stood around and laid upon the body, so he might thereby regain the beneﬁt of health.
uz: Yo'l oching!  ular Muqaddas Arrigoning jasadi yotgan va Martellino oldinda turgan bir paytda kelishdi  uni atrofda turgan va jasad ustiga yotqizgan ayrim janoblar olib ketishdi, shunda u sog'lig'ining afzalligini qaytarib olishi mumkin edi.

en: Martellino, having lain awhile, whilst all the folk were on the stretch to see what should come of him, began, as right well he knew how, to make a show of opening ﬁrst one ﬁnger, then a hand and after putting forth an arm and so at last coming to stretch himself out altogether.
uz: Martellino bir oz yotgach, butun xalq undan nima kelishini ko'rish uchun cho'zilganida, avval bir barmog'ini, keyin bir qo'lini ochishni, keyin bir qo'lini ko'rsatishni va nihoyat o'zini butunlay cho'zishni boshladi.

en: Which when the people saw, they set up such an outcry in praise of Saint Arrigo as would have drowned the very thunder.
uz: Xalq buni ko'rib, Avliyo Arrigoni maqtab shunday hayqiriq chiqarardiki, xuddi momaqaldiroqning o'zini cho'ktirgandek bo'lardi.

en: Now, as chance would have it, there was therenigh a certain Florentine, who knew Martellino very well, but had not recognized him, counterfeited
uz: Xo'sh, tasodifga ko'ra, u yerda Florensiyalik bir odam bor edi, u Martellino'ni juda yaxshi bilardi, lekin uni tanimasdi, soxta edi.

en: as he was, whenas he was brought thither.
uz: u yerga olib kelinganida qanday bo'lgan bo'lsa, shunday edi.

en: However, when he saw him grown straight again, he knew him and straightway fell a-laughing and say- ing, ‘God confound him!
uz: Ammo, u uni yana to'g'ri o'sganini ko'rgach, u uni tanib oldi va darhol kuladi va dedi: "Xudo uni sharmanda qildi!"

en: Who that saw him come had not deemed him palsied in good earnest?’ His words were overheard of sundry Trevisans, who asked him incontinent, ‘How!
uz: Uni kelganini ko'rgan kim uni chin dildan falaj deb hisoblamagan edi? Uning so'zlarini turli xil Trevizanlar eshitib qolishdi va ular undan bemalol so'rashdi: Qanday qilib!

en: Was he not palsied?’ ‘God forbid!’ answered the Florentine.
uz: U falaj emasmidi? Xudo saqlasin! deb javob berdi florensiyalik.

en: ‘He hath ever been as straight as any one of us; but he knoweth better than any man in the world how to play off tricks of this kind and counterfeit what shape soever he will.’ When the others heard this, there needed nothing farther; but they pushed forward by main force and fell a-crying out and saying, ‘Seize yonder trait- or and scoffer at God and His saints, who, being whole of his body, hath come hither, in the guise of a cripple, to make mock of us and of our saint!’ So saying, they laid hold of Martellino and pulled him down from the place where he lay.
uz: U hech qachon hech birimiz kabi to'g'ri bo'lmagan; lekin u dunyodagi har qanday odamdan yaxshiroq biladi, qanday qilib bunday hiylalarni o'ynashni va xohlagan shaklini soxtalashtirishni. Boshqalar buni eshitgach, hech narsa kerak emas edi; lekin ular asosiy kuch bilan oldinga itarib, baqirib yuborishdi va dedilar: "Boshqa xususiyatni qo'lga oling-yoki butun tanasi bo'lgan Xudo va Uning avliyolarini masxara qiling, u bu yerga nogiron qiyofasida kelgan, bizni va avliyolarimizni masxara qilish uchun keldi!" Shunday qilib, ular Martellino'ni ushlab, yotgan joydan pastga tortib tashladilar.

en: Then, taking him by the hair of his head and tearing all the clothes off his back, they fell upon him with cuffs and kicks; nor him- seemed was there a man in the place but ran to do likewise.
uz: So'ngra uni boshidan ushlashdi va barcha kiyimlarini yirtirib, unga manjetlar va tepishlar bilan yiqilishdi; va u ham o'sha yerda hech kim yo'qdek tuyuldi, lekin xuddi shunday qilish uchun yugurdi.

en: Martellino roared out, ‘Mercy, for God’s sake!’ and fended himself as best he might, but to no avail; for the crowd redoubled upon him momently.
uz: Martellino qichqirdi: Alloh uchun rahm-shafqat! va ozini qolidan kelgancha himoya qildi, lekin hech qanday foyda bermadi; chunki olomon unga bir zumda bir necha barobar kopaydi.

en: Stecchi and Marchese, seeing this, began to say one to the other that things stood ill, but, fearing for themselves, dared not come to his aid; nay, they cried out with the rest to put him to death, bethinking them the while how they might avail to fetch him out of the hands of the people, who would certainly have slain him, but for a means promptly taken by Marchese; to wit, all the of- ﬁcers of the Seignory being without the church, he betook himself as quick- liest he might, to him who commanded for the Provost and said, ‘Help, for God’s sake!
uz: Stecchi va Marchese buni ko'rib, bir-birlariga narsalar yomon ekanligi haqida ayta boshladilar, lekin o'zlari uchun qo'rqib, unga yordam berishga jur'at etmadilar; yo'q, ular qolganlar bilan birga uni o'ldirish uchun baqirishdi, shu bilan birga uni xalq qo'lidan qanday olib chiqish mumkinligini o'ylab, ular uni albatta o'ldirgan bo'lardi, lekin Marchese tomonidan tezda qo'lga kiritilgan vosita uchun; ya'ni, Egamizning barcha yaratuvchilari cherkovdan tashqarida bo'lgani uchun, u o'zini imkon qadar tezda ko'rsatdi, Provost uchun buyruvchiga va dedi: "Yordam bering, Xudo uchun!"

en: There is a lewd fellow within who hath cut my purse, with a good hundred gold ﬂorins.
uz: Ichimda bir fohisha bor, u mening hamyonimni kesib tashladi, yuzlab oltin florinlar bilan.

en: I pray you take him, so I may have mine own again.’ Hearing this, a round dozen of sergeants ran straightway whereas the wretched Martellino was being carded without a comb and having with the greatest pains in the world broken through the crowd, dragged him out of the people’s hands, all bruised and tumbled as he was, and haled him off to the palace, whither many followed him who held themselves affronted of him and hearing that he had been taken for a cutpurse and themseeming they had no better occasion78 of doing him an ill turn,79 began each on like wise to say that he had cut his purse.
uz: Iltimos, uni oling, shunda yana o'zimniki bo'lsin." Buni eshitib, o'nlab serjantlar darhol yugurishdi. Bechora Martellino taroqsiz kartochkalar bilan o'ldirilib, dunyodagi eng katta azoblar bilan olomon orasidan o'tib, uni xalq qo'lidan sudrab olib chiqishdi, hamma shikastlangan va yiqilgan holda, va uni saroyga olib ketishdi. U yerda ko'pchilik unga ergashdi, unga nisbatan o'zini haqorat qilganlar va uni kesish uchun olib ketilganini eshitishdi va ularga yomon ish qilish uchun hech qanday imkoniyat yo'qdek tuyuldi.

en: The Provost’s judge, who was a crabbed, ill-conditioned fellow, hearing this, forthright took him apart and
uz: Provostning hakami, bu narsani eshitib, qattiqqo'l, ahvoli yomon odam edi, uni darhol yirtib tashladi va...

en: began to examine him of the matter; but Martellino answered jestingly, as if he made light of his arrest; whereat the judge, incensed, caused truss him up and give him two or three good bouts of the strappado, with intent to make him confess that which they laid to his charge, so he might after have him strung up by the neck.
uz: Martellino uni bu masalada tekshirishni boshladi; lekin Martellino masxara bilan javob berdi, go'yo u hibsga olinganini yengillashtirgandek; shundan so'ng, sudya g'azablanib, uni to'xtatib, ikki-uchta yaxshi bog'ichni unga berishga majbur qildi, uni ayblashlarini tan olishga majburlash maqsadida, shunda uni bo'ynidan bog'lab qo'yish mumkin edi.

en: When he was let down again, the judge asked him once more if that were true which the folk avouched against him, and Martellino, seeing that it availed him not to deny, answered, ‘My lord, I am ready to confess the truth to you; but ﬁrst make each who accuseth me say when and where I cut his purse, and I will tell you what I did and whatnot.’ Quoth the judge, ‘I will well,’ and calling some of his accusers, put the question to them; whereupon one said that he had cut his purse eight, another six and a third four days agone, whilst some said that very day.
uz: Uni yana pastga tushirishganida, sudya undan xalq unga qarshi aytgan gaplari rostmi yoki yo'qmi, deb yana so'radi. Martellino, inkor etish unga foyda bermaganini ko'rib, javob berdi: "Ey janob, men sizga haqiqatni tan olishga tayyorman; lekin avval meni ayblagan har bir kishi qachon va qayerda sumkasini kesganimni aytsin, men sizga nima qilganimni va nima qilmaganimni aytaman."

en: Martellino, hearing this, said, ‘My lord, these all lie in their throats and I can give you this proof that I tell you the truth, inasmuch as would God it were as sure that I had never come hither as it is that I was never in this place till a few hours agone; and as soon as I arrived, I went, of my ill fortune, to see yonder holy body in the church, where I was carded as you may see; and that this I say is true, the Prince’s ofﬁcer who keepeth the register of strangers can certify you, he and his book, as also can my host.
uz: Martellino buni eshitib, dedi: Hammasi ularning tomoqlarida yotadi, hazratim, va men sizga haqiqatni aytishimning ushbu isbotini bera olaman, agar Xudo bu yerga hech qachon kelmaganimga, xuddi bir necha soat o'tgunga qadar bu yerda bo'lmaganimga ishonch hosil qilgan bo'lsa edi; va men yetib kelgan zahoti, omadim yetmaganicha, men cherkovda boshqa muqaddas jismni ko'rishga bordim, u yerda meni ko'rganingizdek kartochkalar bilan ko'rishgan edi; va men aytishim rost, begonalar reyestrini saqlaydigan shahzoda, u va uning kitobi ham sizni tasdiqlashi mumkin, xuddi mening mehmonim kabi.

en: If, therefore, you ﬁnd it as I tell you, I be- seech you torture me not neither put me to death at the instance of these wicked men.’ Whilst things were at this pass, Marchese and Stecchi, hearing that the judge of the Provostry was proceeding rigorously against Martellino and had already given him the strappado, were sore affeared and said in them- selves, ‘We have gone the wrong way to work; we have brought him forth of the frying-pan and cast him into the ﬁre.’ Wherefore they went with all diligence in quest of their host and having found him, related to him how the case stood.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, men sizga aytganimdek bo'lsa, demak, meni bu yovuz odamlarning holatida azoblamang yoki o'ldirmang." Hozirgi paytda, Marches va Stecchi, Provostriya hakami Martellinoga qarshi qattiq harakat qilayotganini eshitib va unga allaqachon strappado berganini eshitib, qattiq ta'sirlanib, o'zlarida shunday dedilar: "Biz ish qilish uchun noto'g'ri yo'ldan o'tdik; biz uni pishirish idishidan olib chiqdik va olovga tashladik." Shuning uchun ular o'z qo'shinlarini qidirib, uni topdilar va ish qanday turganiga ishora qilishdi.

en: He laughed and carried them to one Sandro Agolanti, who abode in Treviso and had great interest with the Prince, and telling him everything in order, joined with them in beseeching him to occupy himself with Martellino’s affairs.
uz: U kuldi va ularni Trevisa shahrida yashovchi va shahzodaga katta qiziqish bildirgan Sandro Agolantiga olib bordi. U unga hamma narsani tartibga solib, Martellino ishlarida shug'ullanishini so'rab, ularga qo'shilib ketdi.

en: Sandro, after many a laugh, repaired to the Prince and prevailed upon him to send for Martellino.
uz: Sandro ko'p kulgudan so'ng, shahzodaga murojaat qildi va Martellinoga yuborishga majbur qildi.

en: The Prince’s messengers found Martellino still in his shirt before the judge, all confounded and sore adread, for that the judge would hear noth- ing in his excuse; nay, having, by chance, some spite against the people of Florence, he was altogether determined to hang him by the neck and would
uz: Shahzoda elchilari Martellino'ni sudya oldida hali ham ko'ylagida topishdi, hamma xijolat va achchiq edi, chunki sudya uning bahonasida hech narsa eshitmas edi; yo'q, tasodifan Florensiya xalqiga nisbatan biroz nafratga ega bo'lgani uchun, u uni bo'ynidan osib qo'yishga qat'iy qaror qildi va...

en: on no wise render him up to the Prince till such time as he was constrained thereto in his despite.
uz: Hech qanday yo'l bilan uni shahzodaga, unga majbur bo'lmaguncha topshirishga majbur qilmang.

en: Martellino, being brought before the lord of the city and having told him everything in order, besought him, by way of special favour, to let him go about his business, for that, until he should be in Florence again, it would still seem to him he had the rope about his neck.
uz: Martellino shahar xo'jayini huzuriga olib kelinib, unga hamma narsani tartibli aytib berganidan so'ng, alohida iltijo qilib, uni o'z ishlarida davom ettirishga qo'yib yuborishni so'radi, chunki u Florensiyada bo'lguncha, uning bo'ynida arqon bordek tuyulardi.

en: The Prince laughed heartily at his mischance and let give each of the three a suit of apparel, wherewith they returned home safe and sound, having, bey- ond all their hope, escaped so great a peril.”
uz: Shahzoda uning baxtsizligidan yurakdan kuldi va har uchchalasiga bir kiyim berdi, shunda ular uyga sog'-salomat qaytib kelishdi, butun umidi bilan shunday katta xavfdan qutulib qolishdi.

en: THE SECOND STORY Rinaldo d’Asti, having been robbed, maketh his way to Castel Guglielmo, where he is hospitably entertained by a widow lady and having made good his loss, returneth to his own house, safe and sound.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Rinaldo dAsti o'g'irlanganidan so'ng, Guglielmo qal'asiga yo'l oladi, u yerda beva ayol uni mehmondo'stona qabul qiladi va yo'qotishlarini qoplab, o'z uyiga xavfsiz va sog'lom qaytib keladi.

en: The ladies laughed immoderately at Martellino’s misfortunes narrated by Neiﬁle, as did also the young men and especially Filostrato, whom, for that he sat next Neiﬁle, the queen bade follow her in story-telling.
uz: Xonimlar Neifile tomonidan hikoya qilingan Martellino baxtsiz hodisalaridan haddan tashqari kulishdi, xuddi shunday yigitlar va ayniqsa Filostrato ham. Chunki u NEIFELning yonida o'tirganligi sababli, malika unga hikoya aytib berishda ergashdi.

en: Accordingly he began without delay, “Fair ladies, needs must I tell you a story80 of things Catholic,81 in part mingled with misadventures and love-matters, which belike will not be other than proﬁtable to hear, especially to those who are wayfarers in the perilous lands of love, wherein whoso hath not said St.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u hech kechiktirmasdan boshladi: Adolatli xonimlar, sizga katolik narsalarining 80 ta hikoyasini aytib berishim kerak, 81 qisman baxtsiz hodisalar va sevgi-muammolar bilan aralashgan, bularni eshitish foydali bo'ladi, ayniqsa sevgi xavfli yurtlarida sayohat qilayotganlarga, unda kimki avliyo deb aytmagan bo'lsa.

en: Julian his Paternoster is oftentimes ill lodged, for all he have a good bed.
uz: Julian o'zining otaxonasini ko'pincha yomon ushlab turadi, chunki u yaxshi karavotga ega.

en: In the days, then, of the Marquis Azzo of Ferrara, there came a merchant called Rinaldo d’Asti to Bologna on his occasions, which having des- patched and returning homeward, it chanced that, as he issued forth of Fer- rara and rode towards Verona, he fell in with certain folk who seemed mer- chants, but were in truth highwaymen and men of lewd life and condition, with whom he unwarily joined company and entered into discourse.
uz: O'sha kunlarda, Ferrara markizi Azzo tomonidan, Rinaldo dAsti deb nomlangan savdogar Bolognaga o'z marosimlarida keldi. U yerdan chiqib, uyga qaytgach, u Fer- raradan chiqib, Verona tomon minib borar ekan, u ba'zi bir odamlar bilan to'qnashdi, ular go'yo shoirlardek tuyulgan, ammo aslida haydovchilar va axloqsiz hayotga ega odamlar edi, ular bilan beparvolik bilan qo'shilib, suhbatga kirardi.

en: They, seeing him to be a merchant and judging him to have monies about him, took counsel together to rob him, at the ﬁrst opportunity that should offer; wherefore, that he might take no suspicion, they went devising with him, like decent peaceable folk, of things honest and seemly and of loyalty, or- dering themselves toward him, in so far as they knew and could, with re- spect and complaisance, so that he deemed himself in great luck to have met with them, for that he was alone with a serving-man of his on horseback.
uz: Ular uni savdogar ekanligini ko'rib, o'zlarida pul bor deb hisoblab, uni o'g'irlash uchun birinchi imkoniyatda maslahatlashdilar; shuning uchun, u hech qanday shubha qilmasligi uchun, ular u bilan halol va halol va sadoqatli narsalar haqida, yoki ular bilgan va qodir bo'lgancha, o'zlarini unga nisbatan ko'z-ko'z va mamnuniyat bilan o'ylab kelishdi, shuning uchun u o'zini ular bilan uchrashishga juda omadli deb hisobladi, chunki u otda o'zining xizmatkori bilan yolg'iz edi.

en: Thus faring on and passing from one thing to another, as it chanceth in discourse, they presently fell to talking of the orisons that men offer up to God, and one of the highwaymen, who were three in number, said to Rinaldo, ‘And you, fair sir, what orison do you use to say on a journey?’ Whereto he answered, ‘Sooth to say, I am but a plain man and little versed in these matters and have few orisons in hand; I live after the old fashion and let a couple of shillings pass for four-and-twenty pence.82 Nevertheless, I have still been wont, when on a journey, to say of a morning, what time I come forth of the inn, a Pater and an Ave for the soul of St.
uz: Shunday qilib, bir narsadan ikkinchisiga o'tib ketayotganda, suhbatda aytilishicha, ular darhol Xudoga taqdim etiladigan orisonlar haqida gapirishga tushishdi. Uchta kishi bo'lgan katta hayvondan biri Rinaldoga dedi: "Siz ham, janob, sayohatda qanday orison aytasiz?" U javob berdi: "Aytish kerakki, men bu masalalarda oddiy odamman va qo'lida ozmi yoki yo'qmi bilaman; men eski uslubda yashayman va bir necha shillingni to'rt yigirma pensiyaga o'tkazaman.

en: Julian’s father and mother, after which I pray God and the saint to grant me a good lodging for the ensuing night.
uz: Julianning otasi va onasi, shundan so'ng Xudoga va avliyoga kelgusi tun uchun yaxshi turar joy berishini so'rayman.

en: Many a time in my day have I, in the course of my journeyings, been in great perils, from all of which I have escaped and have still found myself at night, to boot, in a place of safety and well lodged.
uz: Kunim davomida ko'p marta sayohatlarim davomida katta xavflarda bo'lganman, ularning barchasidan qochib qutulganman va hali ham o'zimni tunda, xavfsizlik va yaxshi tunab qolgan joyda topganman.

en: Wherefore I ﬁrmly believe that St.
uz: Shuning uchun men qat'iy ishonamanki, Avliyo...

en: Julian, in whose honour I say it, hath gotten me this favour of God; nor meseemeth should I fare well by day nor come to good harbourage at night, except I had said it in the morning.’ ‘And did you say it83 this morning?’ asked he who had put the question to him.
uz: Yulian, men buni kimning sharafiga aytayotgan bo'lsam, menga Xudoning bu marhamatini berdi; na kunduzi yaxshi yurishim mumkin, na kechasi yaxshi joyga kelishim mumkin edi, agar men buni ertalab aytgan bo'lsam." Va siz buni bugun ertalab aytdingizmi? deb so'radi unga savol bergan odam.

en: ‘Ay did I,’ answered Rinaldo; whereupon quoth the other in himself, know- ing well how the thing was to go, ‘May it stand thee in stead!84 For, an no hindrance betide us, methinketh thou art e’en like to lodge ill.’ Then, to Rinaldo, ‘I likewise,’ quoth he, ‘have travelled much and have never said this orison, albeit I have heard it greatly commended, nor ever hath it be- fallen me to lodge other than well; and this evening maybe you shall chance to see which will lodge the better, you who have said it or I who have not.
uz: Voy men,  javob berdi Rinaldo; shundan song, ozida boshqa narsa borligini yaxshi bilgan holda,  senga orniga tursin! 84 Chunki, bizga hech qanday tosiqlar yoq, sen yomon tunashni xohlaysan. Shunda Rinaldoga dedi: Men ham,  kop sayohat qildim va hech qachon bu orzuni aytmadim, garchi uni juda maqtagan bolsam ham, hech qachon yaxshi tunashga togri kelmagan bolsam ham; va bu oqshom ehtimol qaysi biri yaxshiroq tunashini korasan, sen aytgandirsan yoki men qilmaganing.

en: True, I use, instead thereof, the Dirupisti or the Intemerata or the De Pro- fundis, the which, according to that which a grandmother of mine used to tell me, are of singular virtue.’ Discoursing thus of various matters and faring on their way, on the look out the while for time and place apt unto their knavish purpose, they came, late in the day, to a place a little beyond Castel Guglielmo, where, at the fording of a river, the three rogues, seeing the hour advanced and the spot solitary and close shut in, fell upon Rinaldo and robbed him of money, clothes and horse.
uz: To'g'ri, men buning o'rniga Dirupisti yoki Intemerata yoki De Pro-fundislardan foydalanaman, ular, buvim aytganidek, yagona fazilatga ega. Shunday qilib, turli masalalarni muhokama qilib, yo'lda ketayotganda, o'zlarining g'ayrioddiy maqsadiga mos vaqt va joyni ko'rib, ular kunduzi kechasi, Castel Guglielmo'dan biroz narida joylashgan joyga kelishdi. U yerda, daryoning o'tishida, soat oldinga o'tib, joy yolg'iz va yopiq bo'lganini ko'rib, uchta qo'rqoq Rinaldoga tushib, uni pul, kiyim va ot bilan o'g'irlashdi.

en: Then, leaving him afoot and in his shirt, they departed, saying, ‘Go see if thy St.
uz: So'ngra uni oyoq ostida va ko'ylagida qoldirib, ketib ketishdi va dedilar: "Boringlar, aziz..."

en: Julian will give thee a good lodging this night, even as ours85 will assuredly do for us.’ And passing the stream, they went their ways.
uz: Yulian senga shu kecha yaxshi turar joy beradi, xuddi bizning 85-yillarimiz biz uchun albatta qilganidek." Va daryodan o'tib, ular o'z yo'llariga ketishdi.

en: Rinaldo’s servant, seeing him attacked, like a cowardly knave as he was, did nought to help him, but turning his horse’s head, never drew
uz: Rinaldoning xizmatkori, uning hujumga uchraganini ko'rib, xuddi qo'rqoq kabi, unga hech qanday yordam bermadi, lekin otining boshini burib, hech qachon tortmadi.

en: bridle till he came to Castel Guglielmo and entering the town, took up his lodging there, without giving himself farther concern.
uz: U Guglielmo qal'asiga yetib kelib, shaharga kirguncha, o'zini boshqa tashvishlantirmasdan, u yerda tunadi.

en: Rinaldo, left in his shirt and barefoot, it being very cold and snowing hard, knew not what to do and seeing the night already at hand, looked about him, trembling and chattering the while with his teeth, if there were any shelter to be seen therenigh, where he might pass the night, so he should not perish of cold; but, seeing none, for that a little before there had been war in those parts and everything had been burnt, set off at a run, spurred by the cold, towards Castel Guglielmo, knowing not withal if his servant were ﬂed thither or otherwise and thinking that, so he might but avail to enter therein, God would send him some relief.
uz: Rinaldo, ko'ylagida va yalangoyoq holda qolgan, juda sovuq va qattiq qor yog'ayotgan edi, nima qilish kerakligini bilmas edi va tun allaqachon yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib, atrofga titrab va tishlari bilan gapirib qarardi. Agar u yerda tunni o'tkazishi mumkin bo'lgan biron bir boshpana bo'lsa, sovuqdan halok bo'lmasligi kerak edi; lekin, hech birini ko'rmagani uchun, chunki o'sha joylarda biroz oldin urush bo'lgan edi va hamma narsa kuygan edi, sovuqdan qochib, Castel Guglielmo tomon yugurdi, qulining u yerga yoki boshqa tomonga qochib ketayotganini bilmas edi va o'yladi, shuning uchun u u yerga kirishi mumkin edi, Xudo unga biroz yengillik yuborardi.

en: But darkness over- took him near a mile from the town, wherefore he arrived there so late that, the gates being shut and the drawbridges raised, he could get no admission.
uz: Ammo qorong'ulik uni shahardan bir milga yaqin olib ketdi, shuning uchun u u yerga shunchalik kech yetib keldi, darvozalar yopilib, tortish ko'priklari ko'tarilgach, u hech qanday kirishga qodir emas edi.

en: Thereupon, despairing and disconsolate, he looked about, weeping, for a place where he might shelter, so at the least it should not snow upon him, and chancing to espy a house that projected somewhat beyond the walls of the town, he determined to go bide thereunder till day.
uz: Shundan so'ng, umidsizlanib va xafa bo'lib, u atrofga yig'lab qaradi, hech bo'lmaganda unga qor yog'masligi uchun, shahar devorlaridan biroz narida joylashgan uyni kuzatishga urinib, u yerdan kun o'tguncha sayohat qilishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, betak- ing himself thither, he found there a door, albeit it was shut, and gathering at foot thereof somewhat of straw that was therenigh, he laid himself down there, tristful and woebegone, complaining sore to St.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u yerga kirib, u yerda eshik topdi, garchi u yopiq bo'lsa ham, va uning etagiga ozgina somon yig'ib, u yerga yotdi, qayg'uli va qayg'uli holda, avliyoga shikoyat qilib.

en: Julian and saying that this was not of the faith he had in him.
uz: Julian va bu uning o'ziga bo'lgan imonidan emasligini aytdi.

en: However, the saint had not lost sight of him and was not long in provid- ing him with a good lodging.
uz: Biroq, avliyo uni unutib qo'ymagan edi va uzoq vaqt unga yaxshi turar joy taqdim etmagan edi.

en: There was in the town a widow lady, as fair of favour as any woman living, whom the Marquis Azzo loved as his life and there kept at his disposition, and she abode in that same house, beneath the projection whereof Rinaldo had taken shelter.
uz: Shaharda bir beva ayol bor edi, u har qanday ayol kabi go'zal edi, Markiz Azzo uni hayoti kabi sevardi va u yerda uning ixtiyorida ushlab turardi. U Rinaldo panoh olgan shu uyda yashardi.

en: Now, as chance would have it, the Marquis had come to the town that day, thinking to lie the night with her, and had privily let make ready in her house a bath and a sumptuous supper.
uz: Xo'sh, tasodif bo'lsa kerak, o'sha kuni markiz shaharga kelib, u bilan tunab qolishni o'ylab, uning uyida hammom va hashamatli kechki ovqat tayyorlashga ruxsat bergan edi.

en: Everything being ready and nought awaited by the lady but the coming of the Marquis, it chanced that there came a serving-man to the gate, who brought him news, which obliged him to take horse forthright; wherefore, sending to tell his mistress not to expect him, he departed in haste.
uz: Hammasi tayyor bo'lib, xonim faqat markizning kelishini kutgan edi, shunda darvozaga xizmatkor keldi va unga otni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olib borishga majbur qiladigan xabarni olib keldi; shuning uchun u xo'jayiniga uni kutmaslikni aytish uchun jo'natdi va shoshilib ketdi.

en: The lady, somewhat disconsolate at this, knowing not what to do, de- termined to enter the bath prepared for the Marquis and after sup and go to bed.
uz: Xonim, bundan biroz xafa bo'lib, nima qilishni bilmay, Markiz uchun tayyorlangan vannaga kirishni, kechki ovqatdan keyin esa yotishni to'xtatdi.

en: Accordingly she entered the bath, which was near the door, against which the wretched merchant was crouched without the city-wall; wherefore she,
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u shahar devoridan tashqarida bechora savdogar cho'kkalab turgan eshik yaqinidagi vannaga kirdi; shuning uchun u,

en: being therein, heard the weeping and trembling kept up by Rinaldo, who seemed as he were grown a stork,86 and calling her maid, said to her, ‘Go up and look over the wall who is at the postern-foot and what he doth there.’ The maid went thither and aided by the clearness of the air, saw Rinaldo in his shirt and barefoot, sitting there, as hath been said, and trembling sore; whereupon she asked him who he was.
uz: U yerda Rinaldo yig'lab va titrab turganini eshitdi. Rinaldo go'yo o'zini laylakdek ko'rsatardi. 86 Va xizmatchisini chaqirib, unga dedi: "Yuqoriga chiqib, orqa oyoqdagi odamni va u yerda nima qilayotganini ko'r." Xizmatchi u yerga bordi va toza havoni ko'rib, Rinaldo ko'ylagida va yalang'och oyoqda, aytilganidek, o'tirganini ko'rdi va titradi; shundan so'ng u undan kim ekanligini so'radi.

en: He told her, as brieﬂiest he might, who he was and how and why he was there, trembling the while on such wise that he could scarce form the words, and after fell to beseeching her piteously not to leave him there all night to perish of cold, [but to succour him], an it might be.
uz: U unga qisqa qilib aytdi, u kim ekanligi, qanday va nega u yerda ekanligi haqida, shu zahotiyoq shunday titradi, so'zlarni deyarli ifodalay olmasdi, va keyin uni butun tun sovuqdan halok bo'lish uchun u yerda qoldirmaslikni achinarli tarzda iltimos qildi, balki shunday bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The maid was moved to pity of him and returning to her mistress, told her all.
uz: Xizmatchi unga rahm qildi va xo'jayiniga qaytib, unga hamma narsani aytdi.

en: The lady, on like wise taking compassion on him and remembering that she had the key of the door aforesaid, which served whiles for the privy entrances of the Marquis, said, ‘Go softly and open to him; here is this supper and none to eat it and we have commodity enough for his lodging.’ The maid, having greatly commended her mistress for this her humanity, went and opening to Rinaldo, brought him in; whereupon the lady, seeing him well nigh palsied with cold, said to him, ‘Quick, good man, enter this bath, which is yet warm.’ Rinaldo, without awaiting farther invitation, gladly obeyed and was so recomforted with the warmth of the bath that himseemed he was come back from death to life.
uz: Xonim unga rahm qilib, o'sha eshikning kaliti borligini esladi va u Markizning shaxsiy kirish joylari uchun mo'ljallangan edi, shunday dedi: "Yumaloq bo'lib, uning oldiga oching; mana bu kechki ovqat va uni yeyish uchun hech narsa yo'q va bizda uning turar joyi uchun yetarli narsa bor". Xizmatchi xonadonni bu insoniyligi uchun juda maqtadi va Rinaldoga borib, uni ochdi, uni ichkariga olib kirdi; shundan so'ng xonim uni yaxshi sovuqdan deyarli falaj bo'lganini ko'rib, unga dedi: "Tezroq, yaxshi odam, hali ham iliq bo'lgan bu vannaga kir." Rinaldo, uzoq kutmasdan, xursand bo'lib, vannaning issiqligi bilan xursand bo'lib, o'zini o'limdan qaytib kelganini ko'rdi.

en: The lady let fetch him a suit of clothes that had pertained to her husband, then lately dead, which when he had donned, they seemed made to his measure, and whilst awaiting what she should command him, he fell to thanking God and St.
uz: Xonim unga eriga tegishli bo'lgan, so'ng yaqinda o'lik bo'lgan kiyim olib kelishga ruxsat berdi. U kiygandan so'ng, bu kiyimlar unga mos kelardi va u unga nima buyurishini kutganida, u Xudoga va Avliyoga minnatdorchilik bildirishga tushdi.

en: Julian for that they had delivered him from the scurvy night he had in prospect and had, as he deemed, brought him to good harbourage.
uz: Yulian uni istiqbolli bo'lgan va o'zi hisoblaganidek yaxshi joyga olib borgan skorbi tunidan qutqargani uchun.

en: Presently, the lady, being somewhat rested,87 let make a great ﬁre in her dining-hall and betaking herself thither, asked how it was with the poor man; whereto the maid answered, ‘Madam, he hath clad himself and is a handsome man and appeareth a person of good condition and very well- mannered.’ Quoth the lady, ‘Go, call him and bid him come to the ﬁre and sup, for I know he is fasting.’ Accordingly, Rinaldo entered the hall and see- ing the gentlewoman, who appeared to him a lady of quality, saluted her re- spectfully and rendered her the best thanks in his power for the kindness done him.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda xonim biroz dam olib, 87 o'zining ovqatlanish zaliga katta o't qo'yib, u yerga o'zini qo'yib, kambag'al odam bilan nima bo'lganini so'radi. Xizmatchi javob berdi: "Xonim, u o'zini kiygan va chiroyli odam, yaxshi holatda va juda odobli odamdek ko'rinadi." Xonim aytdi: "Boring, uni olovga chaqirib keling va ovqatlang, chunki men bilaman u ro'za tutyapti." Shunga ko'ra, Rinaldo zalga kirdi va unga sifatli xonim ko'rinayotgan ayolni ko'rdi.

en: The lady, having seen and heard him and ﬁnding him even as her maid had said, received him graciously and making him sit familiarly with her by the ﬁre, questioned him of the chance that had brought him thither;
uz: Xonim uni ko'rib, eshitib, xizmatkorining aytganidek topib, uni mehribonlik bilan qabul qildi va olov yonida o'zi bilan yaqindan tanishtirdi, uni u yerga olib kelgan imkoniyat haqida so'radi;

en: whereupon he related everything to her in order.
uz: shundan so'ng u unga hamma narsani tartibli ravishda bog'ladi.

en: Now she had heard some- what of this at the time of his servant’s coming into the town, wherefore she gave entire belief to all he said and told him, in turn, what she knew of his servant and how he might lightly ﬁnd him again on the morrow.
uz: Endi u xizmatkorining shaharga kelishi paytida bu haqda eshitgan edi, shuning uchun u uning hamma gaplariga butunlay ishondi va o'z navbatida unga xizmatkori haqida nima bilganini va ertaga uni qanday qilib osonlik bilan topishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: Then, the table being laid, Rinaldo, at the lady’s instance, washed his hands and sat down with her to supper.
uz: Keyin, stol yotqizilganda, Rinaldo, xonimning o'rnida, qo'llarini yuvib, u bilan birga kechki ovqatga o'tirdi.

en: Now he was tall of his person and comely and pleasant of favour and very engaging and agreeable of manners and a man in the prime of life; wherefore the lady had several times cast her eyes on him and found him much to her liking, and her desires being already aroused for the Marquis, who was to have come to lie with her, she had taken a mind to him.
uz: Endi u o'ziga xos bo'yli, chiroyli va yoqimli edi, odob-axloqlari juda jozibali va hayotning eng zo'r davridagi odam edi; shuning uchun xonim unga bir necha bor ko'z tashlagan edi va uni juda yoqtirgan edi, va uning istaklari allaqachon uyg'onilgan edi, u bilan yotishga kelishi kerak bo'lgan markiz uchun, u unga e'tibor qaratgan edi.

en: Accordingly, after supper, whenas they were risen from table, she took counsel with her maid whether herseemed she would do well, the Marquis having left her in the lurch, to use the good which for- tune had sent her.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, kechki ovqatdan so'ng, ular stoldan turganda, u xizmatkori bilan maslahatlashdi, Markiz uni qo'lda qoldirib, unga yuborilgan yaxshilikdan foydalanishga tayyormi yoki yo'qmi, deb o'yladi.

en: The maid, seeing her mistress’s drift, encouraged her as best she might to ensue it; whereupon the lady, returning to the ﬁreside, where she had left Rinaldo alone, fell to gazing amorously upon him and said to him, ‘How now, Rinaldo, why bide you thus melancholy?
uz: Xizmatkor ayol, xo'jayinasining harakatini ko'rib, uni qo'lidan kelganicha unga ergashishga undadi; shundan so'ng xonim, Rinaldo yolg'iz qolgan o'choqqa qaytib, unga mehr bilan tikilib dedi: "Endi Rinaldo, nega seni bunchalik qayg'uga solyapsan?"

en: Think you you cannot be requited the loss of a horse and of some small matter of clothes?
uz: Ot yo'qotilgani va kiyim-kechakning mayda qismi uchun javob bera olmaysiz deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: Take comfort and be of good cheer; you are in your own house.
uz: Xotirjam bo'ling va xursand bo'ling; siz o'z uyingizda.

en: Nay, I will e’en tell you more, that, seeing you with those clothes on your back, which were my late husband’s, and meseeming you were himself, there hath taken me belike an hundred times tonight a longing to embrace you and kiss you: and but that I feared to displease you, I had certainly done it.’ Rinaldo, who was no simpleton, hearing these words and seeing the lady’s eyes sparkle, advanced towards her with open arms, saying, ‘Madam, considering that I owe it to you to say that I am now alive and having re- gard to that from which you delivered me, it were great unmannerliness in me, did I not study to do everything that may be agreeable to you; where- fore do you embrace me and kiss me to your heart’s content, and I will kiss and clip you more than willingly.’ There needed no more words.
uz: Yo'q, yana aytaman, seni o'sha kiyimlaring bilan ko'rib, seni o'zi ekanligingni bilgan holda, bugun seni quchoqlab o'pishga yuz marta intildim. Lekin seni xafa qilishdan qo'rqqanim uchun, buni albatta qilgan bo'lardim." Rinaldo, bu so'zlarni eshitib va xonimning ko'zlarini porlaganini ko'rib, uni ochiq qo'llar bilan oldinga tashladi va dedi: "Xonim, men sizdan hozir tirik ekanligimni va siz menga bergan narsadan qoniqqanimni qayta aytishga qarzdim, bu men uchun juda odobsizlik edi, men sizga ma'qul bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsani qilishga o'rganmadim.

en: The lady, who was all aﬁre with amorous longing, straightway threw herself into his arms and after she had strained him desirefully to her bosom and bussed him a thousand times and had of him been kissed as often, they went off to her chamber, and there without delay betaking themselves to bed, they fully and many a time, before the day should come, satisﬁed their desires one of the other.
uz: Xonim, sevgi orzu-havasidan to'lib-toshgan holda, darhol uning qo'llariga tashlandi va uni o'z ko'kragidan ishtiyoq bilan tortdi, ming marta urdi va uni odatdagidek o'pdi, so'ng uning xonasiga bordilar va u yerda bemalol o'zlarini yotishga qo'yishdi, kun kelmasidan oldin bir-birining istaklarini to'liq qondirishdi.

en: Whenas the day began to appear, they arose —it being her pleas-
uz: Kunduz paydo bo'la boshlagach, ular turdilar  bu uning iltijolari edi.

en: ure, so the thing might not be suspected of any —and she, having given him some sorry clothes and a purse full of money and shown him how he should go about to enter the town and ﬁnd his servant, put him forth at the postern whereby he had entered, praying him keep the matter secret.
uz: Xullas, bu narsa hech qanday gumonga solinmasligi uchun  va u unga achinarli kiyimlar va pulga tola hamyon berib, shaharga kirib, xizmatkorini topishga qanday kirishini korsatib, u kirgan posterga chiqarib, masalani sir saqlashini soradi.

en: As soon as it was broad day and the gates were opened, he entered the town, feigning to come from afar, and found his servant.
uz: Kunduz ochilishi bilanoq va darvozalar ochilishi bilanoq, u shaharga kirib, uzoqdan kelganini ko'rsatdi va o'z xizmatchisini topdi.

en: Therewithal he donned the clothes that were in the saddlebags and was about to mount the man’s horse and depart, when, as by a miracle, it befell that the three high- waymen, who had robbed him overnight, having been a little after taken for some other misdeed of them committed, were brought into the town and on their confession, his horse and clothes and money were restored to him, nor did he lose aught save a pair of garters, with which the robbers knew not what they had done.
uz: Shundan so'ng u egar sumkalaridagi kiyimlarni kiydirdi va odamning otiga minib ketmoqchi bo'ldi. Shunda mo'jiza bo'lib, uni bir kechada o'g'irlagan uchta yo'lboshchi birozdan so'ng shaharga olib kelindi va ular tan olganlarida, ot, kiyim va pullari unga qaytarib berildi. Shuningdek, u bir juft bog'ichdan boshqa hech narsani yo'qotmadi, ular bilan qaroqchilar nima qilganlarini bilishmadi.

en: Rinaldo accordingly gave thanks to God and St.
uz: Rinaldo shunga mos ravishda Xudoga va Avliyoga shukr qildi.

en: Julian and taking horse, returned home, safe and sound, leaving the three rogues to go kick on the morrow against the wind.”88
uz: Julian otni olib, uyga sogʻ-salomat qaytdi, uchta xarobaani ertaga shamolga qarshi tepish uchun qoldirdi.88

en: THE THIRD STORY Three young men squander their substance and become poor; but a nephew of theirs, returning home in desperation, falleth in with an abbot and ﬁndeth him to be the king’s daughter of England, who taketh him to husband and maketh good all his uncles’ losses, restoring them to good estate.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA Uch nafar yigit o'z mol-mulkini isrof qilib, kambag'al bo'lishadi; lekin ularning bir jiyani umidsizlik bilan uyga qaytib, abbot bilan birga keladi va uni Angliya qirolining qizi deb topadi, u uni turmushga oladi va barcha amakilarining yo'qotishlarini yaxshilaydi, ularni yaxshi mulkka qaytaradi.

en: The adventures of Rinaldo d’Asti were hearkened with admiration and his devoutness commended by the ladies, who returned thanks to God and St.
uz: Rinaldo dAstining sarguzashtlari hayrat bilan tinglandi va uning sadoqatini xonimlar maqtadi, ular Xudoga va Avliyoga minnatdorchilik bilan qaytishdi.

en: Julian for that they had succoured him in his utmost need.
uz: Julian uchun, chunki ular unga eng katta muhtojligida yordam berishdi.

en: Nor yet (though this was said half aside) was the lady reputed foolish, who had known how to take the good God had sent her in her own house.
uz: Hali ham (shuni yarim chetda aytilgan bo'lsa ham) xonim ahmoq deb hisoblanmas edi, u yaxshi Xudo uni o'z uyiga yuborganini qanday qabul qilishni bilardi.

en: But, whilst they discoursed, laughing in their sleeves, of the pleasant night she had had, Pampinea, seeing herself beside Filostrato and deeming, as indeed it befell, that the next turn would rest with her, began to collect her thoughts and take counsel with herself what she should say; after which, having received the queen’s commandment, she proceeded to speak thus, no less resolutely than blithely, “Noble ladies, the more it is discoursed of the doings of Fortune, the more, to whoso is fain to consider her dealings aright, remaineth to be said thereof; and at this none should marvel, an he consider advisedly that all the things, which we foolishly style ours, are in her hands and are con- sequently, according to her hidden ordinance, transmuted by her without cease from one to another and back again, without any method known unto us.
uz: Ammo, ular yenglarida kulgan holda, uning yoqimli kechasi haqida bahslashar ekanlar, Pampinea o'zini Filostrat yonida ko'rib, va keyingi navbat unga tegishli deb hisoblar ekan, o'z fikrlarini to'play boshladi va o'zi bilan nima deyishni maslahatlashdi; so'ngra, malika amrini olganidan so'ng, u shunday dedi: "Aziz xonimlar, taqdir ishlari haqida qanchalik ko'p gapirilsa, uning ishlarini ko'rib chiqishga qodir bo'lsa, bu haqda gapirish kerak; va bu bilan hech kim hayron bo'lmasligi kerak, va u ahmoqona uslubda ishlaydigan barcha narsalar uning qo'lida bo'ladi va ketma-ket yashirin, hech qanday yo'l bilan o'zgartirilmasdan, bizga qaytariladi."

en: Wherefore, albeit this truth is conclusively demonstrated in everything and all day long and hath already been shown forth in divers of the forego- ing stories, nevertheless, since it is our queen’s pleasure that we discourse upon this theme, I will, not belike without proﬁt for the listeners, add to the stories aforesaid one of my own, which methinketh should please.
uz: Shunday qilib, garchi bu haqiqat hamma narsada va butun kunda aniq namoyon bo'lsa-da va yuqoridagi turli hikoyalarda allaqachon ko'rsatib berilgan bo'lsa-da, shunga qaramay, bu mavzuda malikaga ma'qul bo'lgani uchun, tinglovchilar uchun befoyda bo'lmasdan, yuqorida aytib o'tilgan hikoyalarga o'zimning hikoyamni qo'shaman, bu hikoyalar menga yoqishi kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: There was once in our city a gentleman, by name Messer Tedaldo, who, as some will have it, was of the Lamberti family, albeit others avouch that he was of the Agolanti, arguing more, belike, from the craft after followed by his sons,89 which was like unto that which the Agolanti have ever prac- tised and yet practise, than from aught else.
uz: Bir vaqtlar bizning shaharimizda bir janob bor edi, uning ismi Messer Tedaldo edi. U, ba'zilarning aytishicha, Lamberti oilasiga mansub edi, garchi boshqalar uning Agolantiga mansub ekanligini bilsalar ham, o'g'illari ergashgan hunardan ko'proq bahslashardi, 89 bu esa Agolantilar hech qachon hech narsadan ko'ra mashq qilgan va amalda qo'llaydigan narsaga o'xshardi.

en: But, leaving be of which of these two houses he was, I say that he was, in his time, a very rich gentle- man and had three sons, whereof the eldest was named Lamberto, the second Tedaldo and the third Agolante, all handsome and sprightly youths, the eldest of whom had not reached his eighteenth year when it befell that the aforesaid Messer Tedaldo died very rich and left all his possessions, both moveable and immoveable, to them, as his legitimate heirs.
uz: Lekin, u shu ikki uydan qaysi biriga tegishli bo'lganini hisobga olsak, aytishim mumkinki, u o'z davrida juda boy, muloyim odam edi va uch o'g'li bor edi. Ularning kattasi Lamberto, ikkinchisi Tedaldo va uchinchisi Agolante deb nomlangan. Ularning barchasi chiroyli va yorqin yoshlar edi. Ularning kattasi o'n sakkizga yoshga to'lmagan edi, qachonki yuqorida aytilgan janob Tedaldo juda boy vafot etgan va barcha mulkini, ham ko'chmas, ham ko'chmas, ularga qonuniy merosxo'r sifatida qoldirgan edi.

en: The young men, seeing themselves left very rich both in lands and monies, began to spend without check or reserve or other governance than that of their own pleasure, keeping a vast household and many and goodly horses and dogs and hawks, still holding open house and giving largesse and making tilts and tournaments and doing not only that which pertaineth unto men of con- dition, but all, to boot, that it occurred to their youthful appetite to will.
uz: Yosh yigitlar o'zlarini yer va boylikda juda boy qoldirganini ko'rib, o'z xohishlariga ko'ra cheksiz, zaxira yoki boshqa boshqaruvni o'tkazmay boshladilar, ulkan xonadon va ko'plab yaxshi otlar, itlar va xurujlarni boqish, hali ham ochiq uyda bo'lish, saxiylik berish, egilishlar va turnirlar o'tkazish va nafaqat oddiy odamlarga tegishli bo'lgan narsalarni qilish, balki ularning yoshlik ishtiyoqiga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsani ham qilishdi.

en: They had not long led this manner of life before the treasure left by their father melted away and their revenues alone sufﬁcing not unto their current expenses, they proceeded to sell and mortgage their estates, and selling one today and another tomorrow, they found themselves well nigh to nought, without perceiving it, and poverty opened their eyes, which wealth had kept closed.
uz: Ular otasi qoldirgan xazina erib ketishidan va daromadlari hozirgi xarajatlariga yetmay qolishidan ko'p vaqt o'tmay, o'z mulklarini sotishga va garovga berishga kirishdi, bugun bittasini, ertaga esa bittasini sotishdi, buni sezmasdan hech narsaga yaqinlashdilar va qashshoqlik ularning ko'zlarini ochdi, boylik ularni yopiq tutgan edi.

en: Whereupon Lamberto, one day, calling the other two, reminded them how great had been their father’s magniﬁcence and how great their own and setting before them what wealth had been theirs and the poverty to which they were come through their inordinate expenditure, exhorted them, as best he knew, ere their distress should become more apparent, to sell what little was left them and get them gone, together with himself.
uz: Shundan so'ng Lamberto bir kuni qolgan ikkovini chaqirib, otasining ulug'vorligi qanchalik buyuk bo'lganini va o'zlarining ulug'vorligini eslatib, ularga o'zlarining boyliklari va haddan tashqari xarajatlari natijasida yetgan qashshoqliklarini taqdim etib, ularni, eng yaxshi bilganidek, qayg'usi yanada oshkor bo'lishidan oldin, ularga qolgan oz narsani sotishga va ularni o'zi bilan birga olib ketishga undadi.

en: They did as he counselled them and departing Florence, without leavetaking or cere- mony, stayed not till they came to England, where, taking a little house in London and spending very little, they addressed themselves with the utmost diligence to lend money at usance.
uz: Ular uning maslahatini bajardilar va Florensiyadan ketishdi, xamir yemasdan yoki hech qanday talablarsiz, Angliyaga kelguncha qolmadilar. U yerda Londonda kichik uy olib, juda oz pul sarflab, o'zlariga eng katta e'tibor bilan pul qarz berishdi.

en: In this fortune was so favourable to them that in a few years they amassed a vast sum of money, wherewith, returning to Florence, one after another, they bought back great part of their estates and purchased others to boot and took unto themselves wives.
uz: Bu omad ularga shunchalik yoqqan ediki, bir necha yil ichida ular juda katta miqdorda pul to'plashdi, shu bilan birga Florensiyaga ketma-ket qaytib kelib, mulklarining katta qismini qaytarib sotib olishdi va boshqalarini sotib olishdi va o'zlariga xotin olishdi.

en: Nevertheless, they still continued to lend money in England and sent thither, to look to their affairs, a young man, a nephew of theirs, Alessandro
uz: Shunga qaramay, ular Angliyada pul qarz berishda davom etishdi va u yerga o'z ishlarini nazorat qilish uchun o'zlarining jiyani Alessandroni yuborishdi.

en: by name, whilst themselves all three at Florence, for all they were become fathers of families, forgetting to what a pass inordinate expenditure had aforetime brought them, began to spend more extravagantly than ever and were high in credit with all the merchants, who trusted them for any sum of money, however great.
uz: Ismlari bilan aytganda, Florensiyada uchalasi ham oila otalari bo'lishgan edi, chunki ular ilgari haddan tashqari xarajatlar ularni nimaga olib kelganini unutib, har qachongidan ham dabdabaliroq sarflay boshlashdi va barcha savdogarlar oldida yuqori darajada edilar, ular ularga har qanday summada, qanchalik katta bo'lmasin, ishonishardi.

en: The monies remitted them by Alessandro, who had fallen to lending to the barons upon their castles and other their possessions, which brought him great proﬁt, helped them for some years to support these expenses; but, presently, what while the three brothers spent thus freely and lacking money, borrowed, still reckoning with all assurance upon England, it chanced that, contrary to all expectation, there broke out war in England between the king and his son, through which the whole island was divided into two parties, some holding with the one and some with the other; and by reason thereof all the barons’ castles were taken from Alessandro nor was there any other source of revenue that answered him aught.
uz: Alessandro ularni o'z qasrlari va boshqa mol-mulklari uchun baronlarga qarzga bergan pullarini o'tkazdi. Bu unga katta foyda keltirdi, bu xarajatlarni bir necha yil davomida qoplashga yordam berdi; lekin, hozirda, uch aka-uka Angliyadan bemalol va pulsiz qarz olib, hali ham butun ishonch bilan hisoblab, Angliyada, barcha kutilganidek, qirol va uning o'g'li o'rtasida urush boshlandi, shu orqali butun orol ikki tomonga bo'lindi, ba'zilari biridan, ba'zilari esa boshqasidan; va shu sababli barcha baronlarning qasrlari Alessandro'dan tortib olindi va unga javob beradigan boshqa daromad manbai ham yo'q edi.

en: Hoping that from day to day peace should be made between father and son and con- sequently everything restored to him, both interest and capital, Alessandro departed not the island and the three brothers in Florence no wise abated their extravagant expenditure, borrowing more and more every day.
uz: Ota va o'g'il o'rtasida kun sayin tinchlik o'rnatilishiga va keyinchalik unga hamma narsa, ham foiz, ham kapital tiklanishiga umid qilib, Alessandro orolni tark etmadi va Florensiyadagi uch birodar o'zlarining dabdabali xarajatlarini kamaytirmadilar, har kuni ko'proq qarz olishdi.

en: But, when, after several years, no effect was seen to follow upon their expecta- tion, the three brothers not only lost their credit, but, their creditors seeking to be paid their due, they were suddenly arrested and their possessions sufﬁ- cing not unto payment, they abode in prison for the residue, whilst their wives and little ones betook themselves, some into the country, some hither and some thither, in very ill plight, unknowing what to expect but misery for the rest of their lives.
uz: Ammo, bir necha yildan so'ng, ularning umidlariga hech qanday ta'sir ko'rinmaganda, uch aka-uka nafaqat o'z kreditlarini yo'qotdilar, balki, kreditorlari o'z haqlarini to'lashga intilishganda, to'satdan hibsga olindilar va ularning mol-mulklari to'lanishga yetarli bo'lmadi, qolgan qismini qamoqda o'tkazdilar, xotinlari va kichkintoylari esa o'zlarini, ba'zilarini qishloqqa, ba'zilarini u yerga, ba'zilarini u yerga, juda yomon ahvolda, qolgan umrlari uchun nima kutish kerakligini bilmay qoldilar.

en: Meanwhile, Alessandro, after waiting several years in England for peace, seeing that it came not and himseeming that not only was his tarrying there in vain, but that he went in danger of his life, determined to return to Italy.
uz: Ayni paytda, Alessandro, Angliyada tinchlik uchun bir necha yil kutgandan so'ng, tinchlik kelmasligini ko'rib, u yerda nafaqat behuda qolgani, balki hayotiga xavf solayotganini ham ko'rib, Italiyaga qaytishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, he set out all alone and as chance would have it, coming out of Bruges, he saw an abbot of white friars likewise issuing thence, accom- panied by many monks and with a numerous household and a great bag- gage-train in his van.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u butunlay yolg'iz yo'lga chiqdi va tasodifan, Bruge shahridan chiqib, u yerdan oq rohiblardan iborat abbat chiqayotganini ko'rdi, u yerda ko'plab rohiblar, ko'plab xonadonlar va furgonida katta sumka-gage-poyezd bor edi.

en: After him came two old knights, kinsmen of the King, whom Alessandro accosted as acquaintances and was gladly admitted into their company.
uz: Undan keyin qirolning qarindoshlari bo'lgan ikki keksa ritsar keldi. Alessandro ularni tanish sifatida qabul qildi va ularning kompaniyasiga xursandchilik bilan qabul qilindi.

en: As he journeyed with them, he asked them softly who were the monks that rode in front with so great a train and whither they were bound; and one of them answered, ‘He who rideth yonder is a young gentle- man of our kindred, who hath been newly elected abbot of one of the most
uz: U ular bilan birga sayohat qilayotganda, u ulardan shunday katta poyezdda oldinda ketayotgan rohiblar kim ekanligini va ular qayerga bog'langanini sekin so'radi; ulardan biri javob berdi: "U yerda minayotgan odam bizning qondoshlarimizdan bo'lgan yosh muloyim odam, u yaqinda birining abbasi etib saylangan."

en: considerable abbeys of England, and for that he is younger than is suffered by the laws for such a dignity, we go with him to Rome to obtain of the Holy Father that he dispense him of his defect of overmuch youthfulness and conﬁrm him in the dignity aforesaid; but this must not be spoken of with any.’ The new abbot, faring on thus, now in advance of his retinue and now in their rear, as daily we see it happen with noblemen on a journey, chanced by the way to see near him Alessandro, who was a young man exceedingly goodly of person and favour, well-bred, agreeable and fair of fashion as any might be, and who at ﬁrst sight pleased him marvellously, as nought had ever done, and calling him to his side, fell a-discoursing pleasantly with him, asking him who he was and whence he came and whither he was bound; whereupon Alessandro frankly discovered to him his whole case and satisﬁed his
uz: Angliyadagi ancha yosh abbatlar va u qonunlar tufayli bunday qadr-qimmat uchun azob chekadiganlardan yoshroq bo'lgani uchun, biz u bilan birga Rimga Muqaddas Otadan uni yoshlik nuqsonidan xalos qilish va yuqorida aytilgan qadr-qimmatni tasdiqlash uchun boramiz; lekin bu haqda hech kim bilan gaplashilmasligi kerak.

en: questions, offering himself to his service in what little he might.
uz: savollar, o'zini ozgina bo'lsa ham o'ziga xizmat qilishga taklif qiladi.

en: The abbot, hearing his goodly and well-ordered speech, took more particular note of his manners and inwardly judging him to be a man of gentle breeding, for all his business had been mean, grew yet more enam- oured of his pleasantness and full of compassion for his mishaps, comforted him on very friendly wise, bidding him be of good hope, for that, an he were a man of worth, God would yet replace him in that estate whence for- tune had cast him down, nay, in a yet higher.
uz: Abbat uning yaxshi va tartibli nutqini eshitib, uning odob-axloqini alohidaroq qayd etdi va uni ichki xotirada muloyim zotli odam deb baholadi, chunki uning barcha ishlari yomon bo'lgan edi, uning yoqimliligi yanada ko'proq sevildi va uning baxtsiz hodisalariga rahm qildi, uni juda do'stona tarzda tasalli berdi, unga yaxshi umid bildirdi, chunki u arzirli odam edi, Xudo uni o'sha mulkda hali ham o'rniga qo'yardi, chunki u uni tashlab yuborgan edi, yo'q, hatto undan ham yuqoriroq.

en: Moreover, he prayed him, since he was bound for Tuscany, that it would please him bear him com- pany, inasmuch as himself was likewise on the way thitherward; whereupon Alessandro returned him thanks for his encouragement and declared himself ready to his every commandment.
uz: Qolaversa, u unga ibodat qildi, chunki u Toskaniyaga borishga majbur edi, chunki u o'zi ham u yerga qarab ketayotgan edi, shuning uchun uni qabul qilish unga yoqdi; shundan so'ng Alessandro uning daldasi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi va o'zini har bir amriga tayyor deb e'lon qildi.

en: The abbot, in whose breast new feelings had been aroused by the sight of Alessandro, continuing his journey, it chanced that, after some days, they came to a village not overwell furnished with hostelries, and the abbot hav- ing a mind to pass the night there, Alessandro caused him alight at the house of an innkeeper, who was his familiar acquaintance, and let prepare him his sleeping-chamber in the least incommodious place of the house; and being now, like an expert man as he was, grown well nigh a master of the household to the abbot, he lodged all his company, as best he might, about the village, some here and some there.
uz: Alessandro o'zining sayohatini davom ettirayotganini ko'rib, ko'kragida yangi his-tuyg'ular uyg'ongan abbot, bir necha kundan so'ng, mehmonxonalar bilan jihozlanmagan qishloqqa kelishdi va abbot u yerda tunashni niyat qilib, Alessandro uni o'zining tanish tanishi bo'lgan mehmonxonaning uyiga tushirdi va uydagi eng noqulay joyda uning yotoq xonasini tayyorladi; va endi u, xuddi tajribali odam kabi, uy xo'jayini abbotga yaqinroq joylashtirdi, u qishloqda, ba'zi birida va ba'zi birida o'sdi.

en: After the abbot had supped, the night being now well advanced and everyone gone to bed, Alessandro asked the host where he himself could lie; whereto he answered, ‘In truth, I know not; thou seest that every place is full and I and my household must
uz: Abbat ovqatdan o'tgach, tun yaxshilab kech bo'lib, hamma uxlashga ketgach, Alessandro qo'shinni qayerda yotish mumkinligini so'radi; u javob berdi: Rostini aytsam, bilmayman; ko'ryapsanki, har bir joy to'la va men va mening uyim bor.

en: needs sleep upon the benches.
uz: O'rindiqlarda uxlash kerak.

en: Algates, in the abbot’s chamber there be cer- tain grain-sacks, whereto I can bring thee and spread thee thereon some small matter of bed, and there, an it please thee, thou shalt lie this night, as best thou mayst.’ Quoth Alessandro, ‘How shall I go into the abbot’s cham- ber, seeing thou knowest it is little and of its straitness none of his monks might lie there?
uz: Alget, abbat xonasida ma'lum bir don qoplari bor, u yerga seni olib kelib, biroz mayda to'shak ustiga yoysam bo'ladi, va u yerda, senga yoqsa, shu kecha imkon qadar yaxshilab yotasan." Alessandro aytdi: "Abotning xonasiga qanday kirsam bo'ladi, bilasanki, u kichkina va uning qalinligi tufayli uning hech bir rohiblari u yerda yotmaydi?"

en: Had I bethought me of this, ere the curtains were drawn, I would have let his monks lie on the grain-sacks and have lodged myself where they sleep.’ ‘Nay,’ answered the host, ‘the case standeth thus;90 but, an thou wilt, thou mayst lie whereas I tell thee with all the ease in the world.
uz: Agar men bu haqda o'ylab ko'rganimda edi, pardalar chizilmasidan oldin, uning rohiblarini don qoplarida yotqizgan bo'lardim va ular uxlagan joyda tunagan bo'lardim. Yo'q, javob berdi qo'shin,  hol shunday; 90 lekin, sen xohlaysan, men senga butun dunyo bo'ylab bemalol aytgandek yotishing mumkin.

en: The abbot is asleep and his curtains are drawn; I will quickly lay thee a pallet-bed there, and do thou sleep on it.’ Alessandro, seeing that this might be done without giving the abbot any annoy, consented thereto and settled himself on the grain-sacks as softliest he might.
uz: Abbot uxlayapti va pardalari tortilgan; men tezda senga pallet-krovat qo'yaman, unda sen uxla." Alessandro buni abbotga hech qanday g'azab bermasdan amalga oshirish mumkinligini ko'rib, bunga rozi bo'ldi va o'zi imkon qadar yumshoqroq don qoplariga o'tirdi.

en: The abbot, who slept not, nay, whose thoughts were ardently occupied with his new desires, heard what passed between Alessandro and the host and noted where the former laid himself to sleep, and well pleased with this, began to say in himself, ‘God hath sent an occasion unto my desires; an I take it not, it may be long ere the like recur to me.’ Accordingly, being alto- gether resolved to take the opportunity and himseeming all was quiet in the inn, he called to Alessandro in a low voice and bade him come couch with him.
uz: Uxlamaydigan, balki, o'ylari yangi istaklari bilan qizg'in band bo'lgan abbat Alessandro va qo'shinning o'rtasida nima bo'lganini eshitdi va birinchisi uxlagan joyini payqadi va bundan xursand bo'lib, o'zida dedi: "Xudo mening istaklarimga bir imkoniyat yubordi; va men uni qabul qilmayman, shunga o'xshash narsa menga qaytishi mumkin." Shunga ko'ra, u imkoniyatdan foydalanishga qaror qildi va mehmonxonada hamma narsa jimdek ko'rindi, u past ovozda Alessandroga chaqirib, uni u bilan birga yotishga chaqirdi.

en: Alessandro, after many excuses, put off his clothes and laid himself beside the abbot, who put his hand on his breast and fell to touching him no otherwise than amorous damsels use to do with their lovers; whereat Aless- andro marvelled exceedingly and misdoubted him the abbot was moved by unnatural love to handle him on that wise; but the latter promptly divined his suspicions, whether of presumption or through some gesture of his, and smiled; then, suddenly putting off a shirt that he wore, he took Alessandro’s hand and laying it on his own breast, said, ‘Alessandro, put away thy fool- ish thought and searching here, know that which I conceal.’ Alessandro accordingly put his hand to the abbot’s bosom and found there two little breasts, round and ﬁrm and delicate, no otherwise than as they were of ivory, whereby perceiving that the supposed prelate was a wo- man, without awaiting
uz: Alessandro ko'p bahonalardan so'ng kiyimlarini yechdi va abbotning yoniga yotdi. Abbot uning ko'kragini qo'ydi va unga faqatgina oshiq qizlar o'z sevgilisiga tegish uchun tegdi. Alessandro uni juda hayratda qoldirdi va shubhalandi. Abbot uni shu yo'l bilan boshqarish uchun g'ayritabiiy muhabbatdan ilhomlandi; lekin oxirgilari uning gumonlarini tezda angladilar, xoh u o'z qo'lida bo'lsin, xoh uning imo-ishorati orqali, va tabassum qildilar. Keyin, u kiygan ko'ylagini to'satdan yechdi, Alessandro'ning qo'lini olib, uni o'z ko'kragida qo'ydi va dedi: "Alessandro, ahmoqona ishingizni tashlab, nimani yashirishni biling."

en: farther bidding, he straightway took her in his arms and would have kissed her; but she said to him, ‘Ere thou draw nearer to me, hearken to that which I have to say to thee.
uz: Uzoqroq davom etib, u darhol uni quchog'iga oldi va o'pmoqchi edi; lekin u unga dedi: "Yana yaqinroq kel, senga aytadigan gapimga quloq sol."

en: As thou mayst see, I am a woman and not a man, and having left home a maid, I was on my way to the Pope, that he might marry me.
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, men erkak emas, balki ayolman va uyda xizmatkorni qoldirib, u menga turmushga chiqishi uchun Rim Papasiga yo'l oldim.

en: Be it thy good fortune or my mishap, no
uz: Sizning omadingiz bo'ladimi, mening omadsizlikimmi, yo'q.

en: sooner did I see thee the other day than love so ﬁred me for thee, that never yet was woman who so loved man.
uz: Seni o'tgan kuni ko'rganimdan oldin, sevgi meni sen uchun ishdan bo'shatdi, hech qachon erkakni bunchalik yaxshi ko'radigan ayol bo'lmagan.

en: Wherefore, I am resolved to take thee, before any other, to husband; but, an thou wilt not have me to wife, begone hence forthright and return to thy place.’ Alessandro, albeit he knew her not, having regard to her company and retinue, judged her to be of necessity noble and rich and saw that she was very fair; wherefore, without overlong thought, he replied that, if this pleased her, it was mighty agreeable to him.
uz: Shuning uchun, men seni boshqa hech kimdan oldin turmushga olishga qaror qildim; lekin, sen meni xotin qilmoqchi emassan, shundan keyin to'g'ri boshla va o'z joyiga qayt." Alessandro, uni tanimagan bo'lsa ham, uning hamrohlari va yigitlariga qarab, uni albatta olijanob va boy deb hisobladi va juda go'zal ekanligini ko'rdi; shuning uchun, uzoq o'ylamasdan, u javob berdi: agar bu unga yoqsa, bu unga juda mos keladi.

en: Accordingly, sitting up with him in bed, she put a ring into his hand and made him espouse her91 before a picture wherein our Lord was portrayed, after which they embraced each other and solaced themselves with amorous dalliance, to the exceeding pleasure of both parties, for so much as remained of the night.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u bilan birga to'shakda o'tirganida, u uning qo'liga uzuk qo'ydi va Rabbimiz tasvirlangan surat oldida uni turmushga chiqardi. Shundan so'ng ular bir-birlarini quchoqlab, ikki tomonning haddan tashqari zavqiga erishdilar, tunning qolgan qismi uchun.

en: When the day came, after they had taken order together concerning their affairs, Alessandro arose and departed the chamber by the way he had entered, without any knowing where he had passed the night.
uz: Kun kelgach, ular o'z ishlari bilan shug'ullanib bo'lgandan so'ng, Alessandro o'rnidan turib, tunni qayerda o'tkazganini hech kim bilmasdan, xonaga kirgan yo'l bilan jo'nab ketdi.

en: Then, glad beyond measure, he took to the road again with the abbot and his company and came after many days to Rome.
uz: Keyin, cheksiz xursand bo'lib, u abbot va uning kompaniyasi bilan yana yo'lga chiqdi va ko'p kunlardan keyin Rimga keldi.

en: There they abode some days, after which the abbot, with the two knights and Alessandro and no more, went in to the Pope and having done him due reverence, bespoke him thus, ‘Holy Father, as you should know better than any other, whoso is minded to live well and honestly should, inasmuch as he may, eschew every occasion that may lead him to do otherwise; the which that I, who would fain live hon- estly, may throughly do, having ﬂed privily with a great part of the treasures of the King of England my father, (who would have given me to wife to the King of Scotland, a very old prince, I being, as you see, a young maid), I set out, habited as you see me, to come hither, so your Holiness might marry me.
uz: Ular u yerda bir necha kun turdilar, shundan so'ng abbat ikki ritsar va Alessandro bilan birga Papa huzuriga kirdi va unga tegishli hurmat ko'rsatib, shunday dedi: "Muqaddas Ota, siz boshqalardan ko'ra yaxshiroq bilishingiz kerakki, yaxshi va halol yashashni istagan har bir kishi, iloji boricha, boshqacha qilishga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday vaziyatni chetlab o'tishi kerak; men, halol yashashni istagan odam, Angliya qirolining xazinasidan katta qismini yashirincha qochib ketgan holda, otam (u meni Shotlandiya qiroliga, juda keksa shahzoda, men, ko'rib turganingizdek, yosh xizmatkorga bergan bo'lardi), men bu yerga kelishim mumkin, shunday qilib, aziz

en: Nor was it so much the age of the King of Scotland that made me ﬂee as the fear, if I were married to him, lest I should, for the frailty of my youth, be led to do aught that might be contrary to the Divine laws and the honour of the royal blood of my father.
uz: Shotlandiya qirolining yoshi meni qochishga majbur qilgani ham, agar unga turmushga chiqsam, yoshligim zaifligi sababli, ilohiy qonunlarga va otamning qirollik qonining sharafiga zid bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsaga olib kelinishim mumkinligidan qo'rqqanimdek emas edi.

en: As I came, thus disposed, God, who alone knoweth aright that which behoveth unto everyone, set before mine eyes (as I believe, of His mercy) him whom it pleased Him should be my husband, to wit, this young man,’ showing Alessandro, ‘whom you see here beside me and whose fashions and desert are worthy of however great a lady, although belike the nobility of his blood is not so illustrious as the blood-royal.
uz: Kelganimda, shunday fikrlashdimki, har kimga nima kerakligini yolg'iz biladigan Xudo, ko'zlarimga (menimcha, Uning rahm-shafqatidan) O'ziga ma'qul bo'lgan odamni, ya'ni, Alessandro'ni ko'rsatayotgan bu yigitni ko'rsatdi, uni shu yerda ko'ryapsiz va uning uslublari va sahrolari qanday buyuk xonimga loyiq bo'lsa ham, garchi uning qonining olijanobligi qonli qirolchalik ulug'vor bo'lmasa ham.

en: Him, then, have I taken and him I desire, nor will I ever have any other than he, however it may seem to my father or to other folk.
uz: Uni men oldim va uni xohlayman, undan boshqa hech kimga ega bo'lmayman, otamga yoki boshqa odamlarga qanday ko'rinsa ham.

en: the principal occasion of my coming is done away; but it pleased me to make an end of my journey, at once that I might visit the holy and reveren- tial places, whereof this city is full, and your Holiness and that through you I might make manifest, in your presence and consequently in that of the rest of mankind, the marriage contracted between Alessandro and myself in the presence of God alone.
uz: Mening kelganimning asosiy sababi o'tib ketdi; lekin men o'z sayohatimni darhol yakunlashni xohladim, toki bu shahar to'la bo'lgan muqaddas va muqaddas joylarga tashrif buyurib, Sening Muqaddasligingni va Sen orqali Alessandro va men o'zim o'rtasida Xudo huzurida tuzilgan nikohni Sening huzuringda va, demak, butun insoniyat huzurida namoyon qilsam.

en: Wherefore I humbly pray you that this which hath pleased God and me may ﬁnd favour with you and that you will vouchsafe us your benison, in order that with this, as with more assurance of His ap- proof whose Vicar you are, we may live and ultimately die together.’ Alessandro marvelled to hear that the damsel was the King’s daughter of England and was inwardly ﬁlled with exceeding great gladness; but the two knights marvelled yet more and were so incensed, that, had they been other- where than in the Pope’s presence, they had done Alessandro a mischief and belike the lady also.
uz: Shuning uchun men sizdan xotirjamlik bilan iltijo qilamanki, Xudo va menga ma'qul bo'lgan narsa sizdan marhamat topsin va siz bizga o'z marhamatingizni taqdim eting, toki shu bilan birga yashasak va oxir-oqibat o'lsak." Alessandro qizaloqning Angliya qirolining qizi ekanligini eshitib hayratda qoldi va ichki tomondan juda katta quvonchga to'ldi; lekin ikki ritsar yanada hayratda qolishdi va shunchalik g'azablandilar, hatto ular Rim Papasi huzurida bo'lganlarida ham Alessandroga yomonlik qilishgan bo'lsa edi.

en: The Pope also, on his part, marvelled exceedingly both at the habit of the lady and at her choice; but, seeing that there was no going back on that which was done, he consented to satisfy her of her prayer.
uz: Rim Papasi ham, o'z navbatida, xonimning odatiga ham, uning tanloviga ham juda hayratda qoldi; lekin qilingan ishdan qaytishning iloji yo'qligini ko'rib, uni uning duosiga rozi bo'ldi.
