en: Ac- cordingly, having ﬁrst appeased the two knights, whom he knew to be angered, and made them well at one again with the lady and Alessandro, he took order for that which was to do, and the day appointed by him being come, before all the cardinals and many other men of great worship, come, at his bidding, to a magniﬁcent bride-feast prepared by him, he produced the lady, royally apparelled, who showed so fair and so agreeable that she was worthily commended of all, and on like wise Alessandro splendidly at- tired, in bearing and appearance no whit like a youth who had lent at usury, but rather one of royal blood, and now much honoured of the two knights.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u g'azablanishini bilgan ikki ritsarlarni birinchi bo'lib xursand qilib, ularni xonim va Alessandro bilan birga yana bir vaqtning o'zida yaxshilashtirib, u qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishni buyurdi va o'zi tayinlagan kun kelib, barcha kardinallar va boshqa ko'plab buyuk dindorlar uning buyurtmasiga ko'ra, o'zi tayyorlagan ajoyib kelin-kelinish bazmiga kelishdi. U xonimni, qirollik libosida, u juda adolatli va barcha tomonidan maqtovga loyiq ekanligini ko'rsatdi, va Alessandro kabi ajoyib tarzda, ko'rinishida nafaqaga qarz bergan yoshga o'xshab, balki qirollik qonidan, va hozirda ikki ritsarga ko'proq hurmat ko'rsatdi.

en: There he caused solemnly celebrate the marriage afresh and after goodly and magniﬁcent nuptials made, he dismissed them with his benison.
uz: U yerda u to'yni tantanali ravishda yangidan nishonlashga buyurdi va yaxshi va ajoyib to'ylardan so'ng, ularni o'z mehribonligi bilan quvib yubordi.

en: It pleased Alessandro, and likewise the lady, departing Rome, to betake themselves to Florence, whither report had already carried the news.
uz: Alessandro va xonim ham Rimga jo'nab ketayotganda, xabar allaqachon tarqalgan Florensiyaga borishga rozi bo'lishdi.

en: There they were received by the townsfolk with the utmost honour and the lady caused liberate the three brothers, having ﬁrst paid every man [his due].
uz: U yerda ularni shahar aholisi juda katta sharaf bilan kutib olishdi va xonim uchta aka-ukaga birinchi bo'lib har bir kishiga to'lagan holda ularni ozod qilishga majbur qildi.

en: Moreover, she reinstated them and their ladies in their possessions and with everyone’s goodwill, because of this, she and her husband departed Florence, carrying Agolante with them, and coming to Paris, were honour- ably entertained by the King.
uz: Qolaversa, u ularni va ularning xonimlarini o'z mulklariga va hammaning yaxshi niyatlari bilan tikladi, shuning uchun u va eri Florensiyani tark etishdi, Agolanteni o'zlari bilan olib, Parijga kelishdi va qirol tomonidan sharaf bilan qabul qilindi.

en: Thence the two knights passed into England and so wrought with the King that the latter restored to his daughter his good graces and with exceeding great rejoicing received her and his son-in-
uz: Shundan so'ng ikki ritsar Angliyaga o'tib, qirol bilan shunday hamkorlik qildilarki, qirol o'z qizi bilan yaxshi munosabatlarini tikladi va uni va uning kuyovini nihoyatda katta quvonch bilan qabul qildi.

en: law, whom he a little after made a knight with the utmost honour and gave him the Earldom of Cornwall.
uz: qonun, uni bir ozdan so'ng eng katta sharaf bilan ritsar qildi va unga Kornuoll grafligini berdi.

en: In this capacity he approved himself a man of such parts and made shift to do on such wise that he reconciled the son with his father, whereof there ensued great good to the island, and thereby he gained the love and favour of all the people of the country.
uz: Shu lavozimda u o'zini shunday bir odam deb ma'qulladi va shunday donolik bilan harakat qildi, o'g'ilni otasi bilan yarashtirdi, bu orolga katta foyda keltirdi va shu orqali butun mamlakat xalqining mehrini va marhamatini qozondi.

en: Moreover, Agolante thoroughly recovered all that was there due to him and his brethren and returned to Florence, rich beyond measure, having ﬁrst been knighted by Count Alessandro.
uz: Qolaversa, Agolante o'zi va birodarlari tufayli u yerda bo'lgan hamma narsani to'liq tikladi va Florensiyaga cheksiz boy holda qaytdi, avval graf Alessandro tomonidan ritsarlikka tayinlandi.

en: The latter lived long and gloriously with his lady, and according as some avouch, what with his wit and valour and the aid of his father-in-law, he after conquered Scotland and was crowned King thereof.”
uz: Oxirgisi xonimi bilan uzoq va shonli umr ko'rdi va ba'zilarning aytishicha, o'zining donoligi, jasorati va qaynonasining yordami bilan u Shotlandiyani zabt etib, uning qiroli etib tayinlandi.

en: THE FOURTH STORY Landolfo Ruffolo, grown poor, turneth corsair and being taken by the Genoese, is wrecked at sea, but saveth himself upon a coffer full of jewels of price and being entertained in Corfu by a woman, returneth home rich.
uz: TO'RTINCHI HIKOYA Landolfo Ruffolo, kambag'al bo'lib ulg'aygan, kursairga aylangan va Genualiklar tomonidan qo'lga olingan, dengizda vayron bo'lgan, ammo qimmatbaho javohirlarga to'la sandiqqa o'zini qutqargan va Korfuda bir ayol tomonidan ko'ngilxush qilingan holda, uyga boy qaytgan.

en: Lauretta, who sat next Pampinea, seeing her come to the glorious ending of her story, began, without awaiting more, to speak on this wise: “Most gra- cious ladies, there can, to my judgment, be seen no greater feat of fortune than when we behold one raised from the lowest misery to royal estate, even as Pampinea’s story hath shown it to have betided her Alessandro.
uz: Lauretta, Pampiyaning yonida o'tirgan, uning o'z hikoyasining shonli yakuniga yetganini ko'rib, uzoq kutmasdan, shunday fikrda gapira boshladi: "Eng hurmatli xonimlar, mening fikrimcha, eng past azobdan qirollik mulkiga ko'tarilgan odamni ko'rishdan ko'ra buyukroq omadli ish bo'lishi mumkin, xuddi Pampiyaning hikoyasi Alessandroga qarshi chiqqanini ko'rsatganidek."

en: And for that from this time forth whosoever relateth of the appointed matter must of necessity speak within these limits,92 I shall think no shame to tell a story, which, albeit it compriseth in itself yet greater distresses hath not withal so splendid an issue.
uz: Va shuning uchun ham, bundan buyon tayinlangan masalani aytadigan har bir kishi, albatta, shu chegaralar doirasida gapirishi kerak, 92 Men shunday ajoyib masalani o'z ichiga olgan bo'lishiga qaramay, undan ham katta azobni o'z ichiga olgan hikoyani aytishdan uyalmayman.

en: I know well, indeed, that, having regard unto that, my story will be hearkened with less diligence; but, as I can no other- wise, I shall be excused.
uz: Men yaxshi bilaman, albatta, shunga ko'ra, mening hikoyam kamroq e'tibor bilan tinglanadi; lekin, boshqa hech qanday donolik bo'la olmagani uchun, men oqlanaman.

en: The seacoast from Reggio to Gaeta is commonly believed to be well nigh the most delightful part of Italy, and therein, pretty near Salerno, is a hill- side overlooking the sea, which the countryfolk call Amalﬁ Side, full of little towns and gardens and springs and of men as rich and stirring in the matter of trade as any in the world.
uz: Reggio dan Gaetagacha bo'lgan dengiz sohili odatda Italiyaning eng yoqimli qismiga yaqin deb hisoblanadi va u yerda, Salernoga yaqin joyda, dengizga qaragan tepalik bor, uni qishloq aholisi Amalfi tomonini deb atashadi, kichik shaharchalar, bog'lar va buloqlar, shuningdek, dunyodagi barcha kabi boy va savdoda gavjum odamlar bilan to'la.

en: Among the said cities is one called Rav- ello and therein, albeit nowadays there are rich men there, there was afore- time one, Landolfo Ruffolo by name, who was exceeding rich and who, his wealth sufﬁcing him not, came nigh, in seeking to double it, to lose it all and himself withal.
uz: Aytilgan shaharlar orasida Rav- ello deb nomlangan bir shahar bor va u yerda, hozirda u yerda boy odamlar bo'lsa ham, ilgari bir shahar bor edi, ismi Landolfo Ruffolo edi, u haddan tashqari boy edi va uning boyligi yetarli bo'lmagani uchun, uni ikki barobar ko'paytirishga, hammasini yo'qotishga va o'zini olib ketishga intilardi.

en: This man, then, having, after the usance of merchants, laid his plans, bought a great ship and freighting it all of his own monies with divers merchandise, repaired therewith to Cyprus.
uz: Bu odam, savdogarlar odatidan so'ng, rejalarini tuzib, katta kemani sotib oldi va uni o'zining barcha pullari bilan turli xil tovarlarga jo'natdi, u bilan Kiprga ta'mirladi.

en: There he found sun- dry other ships come with the same kind and quality of merchandise as he
uz: U yerda u quyoshdan quruq boshqa kemalarni ham topdi, ular ham xuddi o'zi kabi turdagi va sifatli mahsulotlarni taklif qilishardi.

en: had brought, by reason of which not only was he constrained to make great good cheap of his own venture, but it behoved him, an he would dispose of his goods, well nigh to throw them away, whereby he was brought near unto ruin.
uz: olib kelgan edi, shuning uchun u nafaqat o'z tashabbusidan katta yaxshilik arzonlashtirishga majbur bo'ldi, balki u o'z mol-mulklarini tashlashga yaqin holda yo'q qilmoqchi edi, shu sababli u halokatga yaqinlashdi.

en: Sore chagrined at this mischance and knowing not what to do, seeing himself thus from a very rich man in brief space grown in a manner poor, he determined either to die or repair his losses by pillage, so he might not re- turn thither poor, whence he had departed rich.
uz: Sore bu baxtsiz hodisadan xafa bo'ldi va nima qilish kerakligini bilmay, o'zini qisqa vaqt ichida juda boy odamdan, kambag'al holda o'sayotganini ko'rib, o'lishiga yoki o'g'irlik bilan yo'qotishlarini tuzatishga qaror qildi, shunda u qaytib kambag'al bo'lib, boy bo'lib ketgan joyiga qaytmasligi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, having found a purchaser for his great ship, with the price thereof and that which he had gotten of his wares, he bought a little vessel, light and apt for cruising and arming and garnishing it excellent well with everything needful unto such a service, addressed himself to make his purchase of other men’s goods and especially of those of the Turks.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'zining ulkan kemasi uchun xaridor topib, uning narxi va o'z tovarlaridan olgan narsalari bilan, yengil va suzishga yaroqli kichik kema sotib oldi va uni bunday xizmat uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsa bilan yaxshi bezatdi, boshqa odamlarning va ayniqsa turklarning tovarlarini sotib olishga yo'l oldi.

en: In this trade fortune was far kinder to him than she had been in that of a merchant, for that, in some year’s space, he plundered and took so many Turkish vessels that he found he had not only gotten him his own again that he had lost in trade, but had more than doubled his former substance.
uz: Bu savdo boyligi unga savdogar boyligidan ancha yaxshiroq edi, chunki bir necha yil ichida u shunchalik ko'p turk kemasini talon-toroj qilib, o'zidan olib qo'ydi, hatto savdoda yo'qotgan narsalarini ham sotib olganiga qaramay, avvalgi boyligini ham ikki barobarga oshirdi.

en: Whereupon, schooled by the chagrin of his former loss and deeming he had enough, he persuaded himself, rather than risk a second mischance, to rest content with that which he had, without seeking more.
uz: Shunday qilib, avvalgi yo'qotishining qayg'usidan xafa bo'lib, yetarli deb hisoblab, u o'zini ikkinchi baxtsizlikni xavf ostiga qo'yishdan ko'ra, bor narsasidan ko'ra ko'proq izlamasdan mamnun bo'lishga ko'ndirdi.

en: Accordingly he resolved to return therewith to his own coun- try and being fearful of trade, concerned not himself to employ his money otherwise, but, thrusting his oars into the water, set out homeward in that same little vessel wherewith he had gained it.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u darhol o'z qo'liga qaytishga qaror qildi - savdodan qo'rqib, o'z pulini boshqa yo'l bilan ishlatishga qiziqmadi, balki eshkaklarini suvga itarib, o'sha kichik idishda uyiga yo'l oldi.

en: He had already reached the Archipelago when there arose one evening a violent southeast wind, which was not only contrary to his course, but raised so great a sea that his little vessel could not endure it; wherefore he took refuge in a bight of the sea, made by a little island, and there abode sheltered from the wind and purposing there to await better weather.
uz: U allaqachon Arxipelagga yetib kelgan edi, bir kuni kechqurun janubi-sharqiy kuchli shamol paydo bo'ldi, u nafaqat o'z yo'liga zid edi, balki shunchalik katta dengizni ko'tardiki, uning kichik kemasi unga bardosh bera olmadi; shuning uchun u kichik oroldan yasalgan dengiz bo'yoniga panoh topdi va u yerda shamoldan panoh topdi va ob-havo yaxshiroq bo'lishini kutishni maqsad qildi.

en: He had not lain there long when two great Genoese carracks, coming from Con- stantinople, made their way with great difﬁculty into the little harbour, to avoid that from which himself had ﬂed.
uz: U yerda uzoq yotmagan edi, qachonki Konstantinopoldan kelayotgan ikki buyuk genovalik karrak katta qiyinchilik bilan o'zi qochgan narsadan qochish uchun kichik portga yo'l olishdi.

en: The newcomers espied the little ship and hearing that it pertained to Landolfo, whom they already knew by report to be very rich, blocked against it the way by which it might depart and addressed themselves, like men by nature rapacious and greedy of gain,93 to make prize of it.
uz: Yangi kelganlar kichik kemani kuzatib borishdi va uning Landolfoga tegishli ekanligini eshitishdi. Ular uni allaqachon juda boy deb bilishardi, jo'nash yo'lini to'sib qo'yishdi va o'zlarini, tabiatan ochko'z va foyda istovchi odamlarga o'xshab, 93 undan foyda olish uchun murojaat qilishdi.

en: Accordingly, they landed part of their men well harnessed and armed with crossbows and posted them on such wise that none might come down from the bark, an he would not be shot; whilst the
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular o'z odamlarining yaxshi qurollangan va kamon bilan qurollangan bir qismini qo'lga tushirdilar va ularni shunday donolik bilan joylashtirdiki, hech biri po'stlog'idan tushmasligi va otib tashlanmasligi mumkin edi; shu bilan birga

en: rest, warping themselves in with small boats and aided by the current, laid Landolfo’s little ship aboard and took it out of hand, crew and all, without missing a man.
uz: Tinch qolish, o'zlarini kichik qayiqlar bilan o'rab olgan holda va oqim yordamida, Landolfoning kichkina kemasini bortga qo'ydilar va hech kimni yo'qotmasdan, ekipaj va hamma narsani qo'ldan boy berdilar.

en: Landolfo they carried aboard one of the carracks, leaving him but a sorry doublet; then, taking everything out of the ship, they scuttled her.
uz: Landolfoni ular kemaning bir qismini olib ketishdi, undan faqat achinarli ikki qismini qoldirishdi; keyin, kemadan hamma narsani olib, uni cho'ktirishdi.

en: On the morrow, the wind having shifted, the carracks made sail westward and fared on their voyage prosperously all that day; but towards evening there arose a tempestuous wind which made the waves run mountains high and parted the two carracks one from the other.
uz: Ertasi kuni, shamol o'zgarib ketganidan so'ng, karraklar g'arbga qarab suzib ketdilar va butun kun davomida o'z sayohatlarini muvaffaqiyatli davom ettirdilar; lekin kechga yaqin bo'ronli shamol paydo bo'ldi, bu to'lqinlarni baland tog'larga urib, ikki karrakni bir-biridan ajratib yubordi.

en: Moreover, from stress of wind it befell that that wherein was the wretched and unfortunate Landolfo smote with great violence upon a shoal over against the island of Cephalo- nia and parting amidships, broke all in sunder no otherwise than a glass dashed against a wall.
uz: Qolaversa, shamol zo'riqishi natijasida, bechora va bechora Landolfo Cephalo-nia oroliga qarshi sho'nga katta zo'ravonlik bilan urib, kemalar orasida bo'linib, devorga urilgan shishadagina hamma narsani sindirib tashladi.

en: The sea was in a moment all full of bales of mer- chandise and chests and planks, that ﬂoated on the surface, as is wont to happen in such cases, and the poor wretches on board, swimming, those who knew how, albeit it was a very dark night and the sea was exceeding great and swollen, fell to laying hold of such things as came within their reach.
uz: Dengiz bir zumda dengiz yuzida suzuvchi, odatda bunday holatlarda sodir bo'ladigan bo'lganidek, mer-chandiz, sandiqlar va taxtalar balkalari bilan to'la edi va kemadagi bechoralar, suzayotganlar, juda qorong'u tun bo'lishiga va dengiz juda katta va shishgan bo'lishiga qaramay, qo'l yetadigan narsalarni ushlashga tushishdi.

en: Among the rest the unfortunate Landolfo, albeit many a time that day he had called for death, (choosing rather to die than return home poor as he found himself), seeing it near at hand, was fearful thereof and like the oth- ers, laid hold of a plank that came to his hand, so haply, an he put off drowning awhile, God might send him some means of escape.
uz: Qolganlarning orasida bechora Landolfo, o'sha kuni ko'p marta o'limga chaqirgan bo'lsa ham (o'zini kambag'al holda uyga qaytishdan ko'ra o'lishni afzal ko'rgan), uni yaqin atrofda ko'rib, qo'rqib ketdi va boshqalar kabi, qo'liga kelgan taxtani ushladi, shuning uchun baxtsizki, cho'kishni biroz kechiktirdi, Xudo unga qandaydir qochish yo'lini yuborishi mumkin edi.

en: Bestriding this, he kept himself aﬂoat as best he might, driven hither and thither of the sea and the wind, till daylight, when he looked about him and saw nothing but clouds and sea and a chest ﬂoating on the waves, which by- times, to his sore affright, drew nigh unto him, for that he feared lest perad- venture it should dash against him on such wise as to do him a mischief; wherefore, as often as it came near him, he put it away from him as best he might with his hand, albeit he had little strength thereof.
uz: Buni yengib o'zini iloji boricha suzib yurdi, dengiz va shamolning bu tomoniga va bu tomoniga haydab yurdi, to kunduzgi kunduzgacha, atrofga qarasa, to'lqinlarda bulutlar, dengiz va sandiqdan boshqa hech narsa ko'rinmas edi. Ba'zan, uning og'riqli qo'rquvi tufayli, unga yaqinlashardi, chunki u qo'rqardi, agar u unga zarar yetkazadigan darajada urilsa; shuning uchun, u unga yaqinlashganda, u uni qo'li bilan iloji boricha uzoqlashtirardi, garchi uning kuchi kam bo'lsa ham.

en: But presently there issued a sudden ﬂaw of wind out of the air and falling on the sea, smote upon the chest and drove it with such violence against Landolfo’s plank that the latter was overset and he himself perforce went under water.
uz: Ammo hozirda to'satdan havodan shamol chiqib, dengizga tushdi, sandiqqa urdi va uni Landolfoning taxtasiga shunday zo'ravonlik bilan haydab yubordi, natijada u yiqilib ketdi va u o'zi ham suvga botdi.

en: However, he struck out and rising to the surface, aided more by fear than by strength, saw the plank far removed from him, wherefore, fearing he might be unable to reach it again, he made for the chest, which was pretty near him, and lay- ing himself ﬂat with his breast on the lid thereof, guided it with his arms as best he might.94
uz: Ammo u qo'rquvdan ko'ra kuch bilan yuzaga ko'tarilib, taxtani undan uzoqda ko'rdi. Shuning uchun, u yana unga yetib bora olmasligidan qo'rqib, o'ziga yaqin turgan sandiqni qo'ydi va uning qopqog'ida ko'kragini tekis qilib yotdi, uni qo'llari bilan imkon qadar yo'naltirdi.

en: On this wise, tossed about by the sea now hither and now thither, without eating, as one indeed who had not the wherewithal, but drinking more than he could have wished, he abode all that day and the ensuing night, unknow- ing where he was and descrying nought but sea; but, on the following day, whether it was God’s pleasure or stress of wind that wrought it, he came, grown well nigh a sponge and clinging fast with both hands to the marges of the chest, even as we see those do who are like to drown, to the coast of the island of Corfu, where a poor woman chanced to be scouring her pots and pans and making them bright with sand and salt water.
uz: Shunday qilib, dengiz bo'ylab bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa aylanib yurib, hech narsa yemasdan, hech narsaga qurbi bo'lmagani kabi, lekin xohlaganidan ko'ra ko'proq ichganidek, u butun kun va undan keyingi tunni o'tkazdi, qayerda ekanligini bilmay, dengizdan boshqa hech narsani tasvirlardi; lekin, ertasi kuni, buni Xudoning roziligi yoki shamol zo'riqishi qilganmi, u kelib, g'ovakga yaqinlashib, ikki qo'li bilan ko'krak qirg'og'iga yopishib oldi, xuddi cho'kishga tayyor bo'lganlarni ko'rganimizdek, Korfu oroli qirg'og'iga, u yerda bir bechora ayol o'z idishlari va idishlarini tekshira boshladi va ularni qum va suv bilan yorqin qildi.

en: Seeing Landolfo draw near and discerning in him no [human] shape, she drew back, af- frighted and crying out.
uz: Landolfoning yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib va unda hech qanday inson shaklini sezmay, u orqaga chekindi, qo'rqib, baqirib.

en: He could not speak and scarce saw, wherefore he said nothing; but presently, the sea carrying him landward, the woman descried the shape of the chest and looking straitlier, perceived ﬁrst the arms outspread upon it and then the face and guessed it for that which it was.
uz: U gapira olmadi va deyarli ko'rmas edi, shuning uchun u hech narsa demadi; lekin darhol, dengiz uni quruqlikka olib borar ekan, ayol ko'kragining shaklini va torroq ko'rinishini tasvirladi, avval uning ustiga qo'llarni, keyin esa yuzni sezdi va u nima ekanligini taxmin qildi.

en: Accordingly, moved with compassion, she entered somedele into the sea, which was now calm, and seizing Landolfo by the hair, dragged him ashore, chest and all.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, rahm-shafqat bilan harakatlanib, u somedelega dengizga kirdi, endi u xotirjam edi va Landolfoning sochidan ushlab, uni qirg'oqqa, ko'kragidan va boshqa narsalardan sudrab olib chiqdi.

en: There having with difﬁculty unclasped his hands from the chest, she set the latter on the head of a young daughter of hers, who was with her, and carried him off, as he were a little child, to her hut, where she put him in a bagnio and so chafed and bathed him with warm water that the strayed heat returned to him, together with somewhat of his lost strength.
uz: Qo'llarini ko'kragidan zo'rg'a ochib, u oxirgi qo'lini o'zi bilan birga bo'lgan yosh qizining boshiga qo'ydi va uni kichkina boladek kulbasiga olib bordi. U yerda uni bagnoga joylashtirdi va shunchalik qaynatib, iliq suv bilan cho'mdirdiki, yo'qolgan issiqlik unga qaytib keldi, shu bilan birga uning yo'qolgan kuchining bir qismi ham.

en: Then, taking him up out of the bath, whenas it seemed good to her, she comforted him with somewhat of good wine and confections and tended him some days, as best she might, till he had recovered his strength and knew where he was, when she judged it time to restore him his chest, which she had kept safe for him, and to tell him that he might now prosecute his fortune.
uz: Keyin, uni vannaxonadan olib chiqib, o'ziga yoqqanidek, u uni bir oz yaxshi vino va qandolatlar bilan ovutdi va bir necha kun, iloji boricha, kuchini tiklaguncha va qayerda ekanligini bilguncha, unga uning ko'kragini qaytarish vaqti keldi deb hisoblaganida, uni o'zi uchun saqlab qolganini va endi u o'z boyligini ta'qib qilishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: Landolfo, who had no recollection of the chest, yet took it, when the good woman presented it to him, thinking it could not be so little worth but that it might defray his expenses for some days, but, ﬁnding it very light, was sore abated of his hopes.
uz: Landolfo, sandiq haqida hech qanday eslay olmagan, ammo uni yaxshi ayol unga taqdim etganida, uni bir necha kunlik xarajatlarini qoplash uchun arzimaydi deb o'yladi, lekin uni juda yengil deb topgach, umidlaridan juda tushkunlikka tushdi.

en: Nevertheless, what while his hostess was abroad, he broke it open, to see what it contained, and found therein store of precious stones, both set and unset.
uz: Shunga qaramay, uning xonadoni chet elda bo'lganida, u uni ochdi, ichida nima borligini ko'rish uchun va u yerda qadimiy toshlar, ham tikilgan, ham tikilmagan, omborini topdi.

en: He had some knowledge of these mat- ters and seeing them, knew them to be of great value; wherefore he praised God, who had not yet forsaken him, and was altogether comforted.
uz: U bu mat-boshlar haqida ma'lumotga ega edi va ularni ko'rib, ularning juda qimmatli ekanligini bilardi; shuning uchun u hali tashlab ketmagan Xudoga hamd aytdi va butunlay tasalli topdi.

en: How- ever, as one who had in brief space been twice cruelly bafﬂed by fortune,
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, qisqa vaqt ichida baxtga ikki marta shafqatsizlarcha duch kelgan odam kabi,

en: fearing a third misadventure, he bethought himself that it behoved him use great wariness and he would bring those things home; wherefore, wrapping them, as best he might, in some rags, he told the good woman that he had no more occasion for the chest, but that, an it pleased her, she should give him a bag and take the chest herself.
uz: Uchinchi baxtsiz hodisalardan qo'rqib, u o'zini katta ehtiyotkorlik bilan bu narsalarni uyga olib kelishi kerak deb o'yladi; shuning uchun, ularni iloji boricha, ba'zi lattalarga o'rab, yaxshi ayolga ko'krak uchun endi hech qanday imkoniyat yo'qligini, lekin unga yoqqanini, u unga sumka berishi va ko'krakni o'zi olishi kerakligini aytdi.

en: This she willingly did and he, having rendered her the best thanks in his power for the kindness received from her, shouldered his bag and going aboard a bark, passed over to Brindisi and thence made his way, along the coast, to Trani.
uz: U buni ixtiyoriy ravishda qildi va u, undan olgan mehribonligi uchun unga eng yaxshi minnatdorchilik bildirgan holda, sumkasini ko'tarib, qayiqqa chiqdi, Brindisiga o'tdi va shundan sohil bo'ylab Traniga yo'l oldi.

en: Here he found certain townsmen of his, who were drapers and clad him for the love of God,95 after he had related to them all his adventures, except that of the chest; nay more, they lent him a horse and sent him, under es- cort, to Ravello, whither he said he would fain return.
uz: Bu yerda u o'zining ba'zi shahar aholisini topdi, ular uni Xudoning muhabbati bilan qoplagan va kiygan edilar. 95 U ularga o'zining barcha sarguzashtlarini, sandiqdan tashqari, aytib berganidan so'ng; bundan tashqari, ular unga ot qarz berishdi va uni es-korti ostida Ravelloga jo'natishdi, u yerga qaytib kelishini aytdi.

en: There, deeming him- self in safety and thanking God who had conducted him thither, he opened his bag and examining everything more diligently than he had yet done, found he had so many and such stones that, supposing he sold them at a fair price or even less, he was twice as rich again as when he departed thence.
uz: U yerda, o'zini xavfsiz deb hisoblab va uni u yerga olib borgan Xudoga shukr qilib, sumkasini ochdi va hamma narsani hali qilganidan ham ko'proq sinchiklab tekshirib, u yerda shunchalik ko'p tosh borligini ko'rdi, hatto ularni adolatli narxda yoki undan ham arzonroq narxda sotgandek bo'lsa ham, u u yerdan ketgan paytdagidan ikki barobar boyroq edi.

en: Then, ﬁnding means to dispose of his jewels, he sent a good sum of money to Corfu to the good woman who had brought him forth of the sea, in re- quital of the service received, and the like to Trani to those who had re- clothed him.
uz: So'ngra, o'z taqinchoqlarini tashlab yuborish yo'lini topgach, u uni dengizdan olib chiqqan yaxshi ayolga, olingan xizmatning evaziga va unga o'xshash Traniga uni qayta kiydirganlarga yaxshigina pul yubordi.

en: The rest he kept for himself and lived in honour and worship to the end of his days, without seeking to trade any more.”
uz: Qolganini o'zi uchun saqladi va umrining oxirigacha hurmat va ibodat bilan yashadi, hech qanday savdo qilishga intilmadi.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Andreuccio of Perugia, coming to Naples to buy horses, is in one night overtaken with three grievous accidents, but escapeth them all and returneth home with a ruby.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOYA Andreukcio, Neapolga ot sotib olish uchun kelganida, bir kechada uchta og'ir baxtsiz hodisaga duch keldi, lekin ularning hammasidan qutulib, uyga rubin bilan qaytdi.

en: “The stones found by Landolfo,” began Fiammetta, to whose turn it came to tell, “have brought to my mind a story scarce less full of perilous scapes than that related by Lauretta, but differing therefrom inasmuch as the ad- ventures comprised in the latter befell in the course of belike several years and these of which I have to tell in the space of a single night, as you shall hear.
uz: Landolfo tomonidan topilgan toshlar,  deb boshladi Fiammetta, uning navbatida aytish kerak bolgan narsa,  hayolimga Lauretta aytib berganidan kamroq xavfli qochish hikoyasini keltirdi, lekin undan farqli olaroq, oxirgisidagi sarguzashtlar bir necha yillar davomida sodir boldi va bularni bir kechaning ichida aytib berishga majburman, eshitganingizdek.

en: There was once in Perugia, as I have heard tell aforetime, a young man, a horse-courser, by name Andreuccio di Pietro,96 who, hearing that horses were good cheap at Naples, put ﬁve hundred gold ﬂorins in his purse and betook himself thither with other merchants, having never before been away from home.
uz: Bir vaqtlar Perugiyada, avvalroq eshitganimdek, Andreuccio di Pietro ismli ot haydovchisi96 ismli bir yigit bor edi. U Neapolda otlar arzon ekanligini eshitib, hamyoniga besh yuz tilla florinni soldi va u yerga boshqa savdogarlar bilan birga bordi, hech qachon uydan uzoqda bo'lmagan edi.

en: He arrived there one Sunday evening, towards vespers, and having taken counsel with his host, sallied forth next morning to the market, where he saw great plenty of horses.
uz: U u yerga bir yakshanba kuni kechqurun, kechki paytga yaqin keldi va o'z mehmonlari bilan maslahatlashib, ertasi kuni ertalab bozorga yo'l oldi, u yerda juda ko'p otlarni ko'rdi.

en: Many of them pleased him and he cheapened one and another, but could not come to an accord concerning any.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi unga yoqdi va u bir-birini arzonlashtirdi, lekin hech biri haqida kelisha olmadi.

en: Meanwhile, to show that he was for buying, he now and again, like a raw unwary clown as he was, pulled out the purse of ﬂorins he had with him, in the presence of those who came and went.
uz: Ayni paytda, o'zini sotib olishga tayyor ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun, u vaqti-vaqti bilan, xuddi xom va beparvo masxaraboz kabi, o'zi bilan bo'lgan florin hamyonini, kelgan va ketganlarning huzurida tortib chiqardi.

en: As he was thus engaged, with his purse displayed, it chanced that a Sicilian damsel, who was very handsome, but disposed for a small matter to do any man’s pleasure, passed near him, without his seeing her, and catching sight of the purse, said straightway in herself, ‘Who would fare better than I, if yonder money were mine!’ And passed on.
uz: U shunday unashtirilganida, hamyon ko'rsatilganida, shunday bo'lib qoldi: juda chiroyli, lekin har qanday odamga yoqadigan kichik ishlarga moyil bo'lgan bir siciliyalik qiz uning yonidan o'tib, uni ko'rmasdan, hamyonni ko'rib, darhol o'ziga dedi: "Agar pul meniki bo'lsa, mendan yaxshiroq kim yashardi!" Va o'tib ketdi.

en: Now there was with her an old woman, likewise a Sicilian, who, seeing Andreuccio, let her companion pass on and running to him, embraced him affectionately, which when the damsel saw, she stepped aside to wait for her, without saying aught.
uz: Endi u bilan birga bir keksa ayol bor edi, shuningdek, bir siciliyalik ham bor edi. Andreuccio uni ko'rib, sherigi uning yonidan o'tib, yugurib, uni mehr bilan quchoqladi. Qiz uni ko'rgach, hech narsa demasdan, uni kutish uchun chetga o'tdi.

en: Andreuccio, turning to the old woman and recog- nizing her, gave her a hearty greeting and she, having promised to visit him at his inn, took leave, without holding overlong parley there, whilst he fell again to chaffering, but bought nothing that morning.
uz: Andreukcio kampirga o'girilib, uni tanib oldi, unga samimiy salom berdi va u mehmonxonasiga tashrif buyurishga va'da berib, u yerda uzoq suhbat o'tkazmasdan ketdi, u esa yana g'azablanishga tushdi, lekin o'sha kuni ertalab hech narsa sotib olmadi.

en: The damsel, who had noted ﬁrst Andreuccio’s purse and after her old woman’s acquaintance with him, began cautiously to enquire of the latter, by way of casting about for a means of coming at the whole or part of the money, who and whence he was and what he did there and how she came to know him.
uz: Xizmatkor ayol, avval Andreuccio'ning hamyonini va keksa ayolining u bilan tanishuvidan keyin, ehtiyotkorlik bilan oxirgi odamni so'ray boshladi, pulning butun yoki bir qismini, kim va qayerdan ekanligini, u yerda nima qilganini va uni qanday taniganini qidirib.

en: The old woman told her every particular of Andreuccio’s affairs well nigh as fully as he himself could have done, having long abidden with his father, ﬁrst in Sicily and after at Perugia, and acquainted her, to boot, where he lodged and wherefore he was come thither.
uz: Kampir Andreuccioga Andreuccio o'zi qila oladigan har bir tafsilotni, otasi bilan uzoq vaqt yashirinib, avval Sitsiliyada, keyin Perugiyada bo'lib, uni o'zi bilan tanishtirdi, qayerda yashaganini va u yerga nega kelganini aytib berdi.

en: The damsel, being thus fully informed both of his name and parentage, thereby with subtle craft laid her plans for giving effect to her desire and returning home, set the old woman awork for the rest of the day, so she might not avail to return to Andreuccio.
uz: Xizmatkor qiz, uning ismi va kelib chiqishi haqida to'liq xabardor bo'lib, shu bilan birga o'z xohishlariga erishish va uyga qaytish rejalarini nozik usullar bilan tuzdi, kampirni kunning oxirigacha ish bilan ta'minladi, shunda Andreuccioga qaytishga imkoniyat bo'lmasligi mumkin edi.

en: Then, calling a maid of hers, whom she had right well lessoned unto such ofﬁces, she despatched her, towards evensong, to the inn where Andreuccio lodged.
uz: Keyin, o'zining xizmatkorini chaqirib, u bunday lavozimlarga haqli ravishda yaxshi o'rgatgan edi, uni Andreuccio yotgan mehmonxonaga, teng kun tomon jo'natib yubordi.

en: As chance would have it, she found him alone at the door and enquired at him of himself.
uz: Tasodifan, u uni eshik oldida yolg'iz holda topdi va undan o'zi haqida so'radi.

en: He answered that he was the man she sought, whereupon she drew him aside and said to him, ‘Sir, an it please you, a gentlewoman of this city would fain speak with you.’ Andreuccio, hearing this, considered himself from head to foot and himseeming he was a handsome varlet of his person, he concluded (as if there were no other well-looking young fellow to be found in Naples), that the lady in question must have fallen in love with him.
uz: U javob berdi: "U o'zi qidirayotgan odam edi, shundan so'ng u uni chetga tortib, unga dedi: "Janob, sizdan iltimos qilaman, bu shaharlik bir ayol siz bilan gaplashishi mumkin." Andreuccio buni eshitib, o'zini boshdan oyoqqa qarab va o'ziga o'zini go'zal yigitdek ko'rsatib, u (Napoliyda boshqa hech qanday chiroyli yosh yigit topilmagandek) shu xulosaga keldi: "Shu ayol unga oshiq bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak".

en: Accordingly, he answered without further deliberation that he was ready and asked the girl when and where the lady would speak with him; whereto she answered, ‘Sir, whenas it pleaseth you to come, she awaiteth you in her house’; and Andreuccio forthwith rejoined, without saying aught to the people of the inn, ‘Go thou on before; I will come after thee.’ Thereupon the girl carried him to the house of her mistress, who dwelt in a street called Malpertugio,97 the very name whereof denoteth how reput- able a quarter it is.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u o'zi tayyor ekanligi haqida ko'proq o'ylamasdan javob berdi va qizdan xonim qachon va qayerda u bilan gaplashishini so'radi; u javob berdi: "Janob, qachon kelishni xohlasangiz, u sizni o'z uyida kutadi"; va Andreukcio darhol mehmonxona odamlariga hech narsa demasdan javob berdi: "O'zingiz oldinga boring; men sizdan keyin kelaman." Shundan so'ng qiz uni Malpertugio ko'chasida yashovchi bekasining uyiga olib bordi, 97 bu nomning o'zi qanchalik obro'li ekanligini anglatadi.

en: But he, unknowing neither suspecting aught thereof and thinking to go to a most honourable place and to a lady of quality, entered
uz: Ammo u hech narsani bilmay, hech qanday gumon qilmay va eng sharafli joyga va sifatli xonimga borishni o'ylab, kirdi.

en: the house without hesitation —preceded by the serving-maid, who called her mistress and said, ‘Here is Andreuccio,’ —and mounting the stair, saw the damsel come to the stairhead to receive him.
uz: Uy hech ikkilanmasdan  xizmatkor xonim oldinda edi, u xonadonini chaqirib, Mana Andreuccio dedi,  va zinapoyaga chiqib, xonim uni kutib olish uchun zinapoya boshiga kelganini ko'rdi.

en: Now she was yet in the prime of youth, tall of person, with a very fair face and very handsomely dressed and adorned.
uz: Endi u hali yoshlikning eng yuqori cho'qqisida edi, baland bo'yli, juda chiroyli yuzli va juda chiroyli kiyimda edi.

en: As he drew near her, she came down three steps to meet him with open arms and clasping him round the neck, abode awhile without speaking, as if hindered by excess of tenderness; then kissed him on the forehead, weeping, and said, in a somewhat broken voice, ‘O my Andreuc- cio, thou art indeed welcome.’ He was amazed at such tender caresses and answered, all confounded, ‘Madam, you are well met.’ Thereupon, taking him by the hand, she carried him up into her saloon and thence, without saying another word to him, she brought him into her chamber, which was all redolent of roses and orange ﬂowers and other perfumes.
uz: U unga yaqinlashar ekan, u uch pog'ona pastga tushdi, uni ochiq qo'llar bilan kutib oldi va bo'yniga qisdi. U biroz gapirmadi, go'yo haddan tashqari mehribonlik tufayli to'sqinlik qilgandek; so'ngra peshonasidan o'pdi, yig'lab, biroz sindirilgan ovozda dedi: "Ey Andreuk-tio, siz haqiqatan ham xush kelibsiz." U bunday mayin erkalarga hayratda qoldi va hamma hayratda javob berdi: "Xonim, siz yaxshi kutib oldingiz." Shunda uni qo'lidan ushlab, o'z saloniga olib kirdi va undan keyin, unga boshqa so'z demasdan, uni o'zining xonasiga olib kirdi, u butunlay atirgul va to'q sariq gullar va boshqa atirlardan iborat edi.

en: Here he saw a very ﬁne bed, hung round with curtains, and store of dresses upon the pegs and other very goodly and rich gear, after the usance of those parts; by reason whereof, like a freshman as he was, he ﬁrmly believed her to be no less than a great lady.
uz: Bu yerda u juda chiroyli karavotni ko'rdi, pardalari bilan o'ralgan, qoziqlar ustidagi ko'ylaklar va boshqa juda yaxshi va boy buyumlarni ko'rgan edi; shu sababli, xuddi birinchi yoshdagi kabi, u uni buyuk xonimdan kam emas deb qat'iy ishonardi.

en: She made him sit with her on a chest that stood at the foot of the bed and bespoke him thus, ‘Andreuccio, I am very certain thou marvellest at these caresses that I bestow on thee and at my tears, as he may well do who knoweth me not and hath maybe never heard speak of me; but I have that to tell thee which is like to amaze thee yet more, namely, that I am thy sister; and I tell thee that, since God hath vouchsafed me to look upon one of my brothers, (though fain would I see you all), before my death, henceforth I shall not die discon- solate; and as perchance thou has never heard of this, I will tell it thee.
uz: U uni o'zi bilan karavot etagida turgan ko'kragida o'tqazdi va unga shunday dedi: "Andreuccio, men senga bergan bu erkalarga va ko'z yoshlarimga juda ishonaman, meni tanimagan va ehtimol men haqimda hech qachon eshitmagan odam ham shunday qilsa yaxshi bo'lardi; lekin senga yanada hayratlanarli bo'lgan narsani aytishim kerak, ya'ni men sening singlingman; va senga aytamanki, Xudo meni o'limimdan oldin bir akamga qarashga tayinlagan ekan (garchi hammangizni ko'rishim yaxshi bo'lsa ham), demak, men hech qachon xafa bo'lmayman; va agar sen bu haqda hech qachon eshitmagan bo'lsang, men senga aytaman.

en: Pietro, my father and thine, as I doubt not thou knowest, abode long in Palermo and there for his good humour and pleasant composition was and yet is greatly beloved of those who knew him; but, among all his lovers, my mother, who was a lady of gentle birth and then a widow, was she who most affected him, insomuch that, laying aside the fear of her father and brethren, as well as the care of her own honour, she became so private with him that I was born thereof and grew up as thou seest me.
uz: Pietro, otam va sening, shubham yo'qki, bilganingdek, Palermoda uzoq vaqt turar edi va u yerda uning yaxshi hazili va yoqimli kompozitsiyasi tufayli uni taniganlar orasida juda yaxshi ko'ringan edi; ammo, barcha sevganlari orasida, unga eng ko'p ta'sir qilgan onam edi, u yengil tug'ilgan va keyin beva edi, shuning uchun u otasi va aka-ukalaridan qo'rqishni, shuningdek, o'z sharafiga g'amxo'rlik qilishni chetga surib, u bilan shunchalik yolg'iz bo'ldiki, men u yerda tug'ildim va o'sdim, xuddi sen ko'rib turganingdek.

en: Presently, having occasion to depart Palermo and return to Perugia, he left me a little maid with my mother nor ever after, for all that I could hear, remembered him of me or her; whereof, were he not my father, I should blame him sore, having regard to the ingratitude shown by him to my mother (to say nothing of the love it behoved him bear me, as his daughter, born of no serving-wench nor wo-
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, Palermo shahridan ketib, Perugiyaga qaytish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lib, u menga onam bilan birga kichik bir xizmatkorni qoldirdi va undan keyin ham, eshitganlarim uchun, uni men yoki u haqida esladi; bundan, agar u otam bo'lmaganida, men uni og'riqli ayblashim kerak edi, onamga ko'rsatgan noshukurligini hisobga olsak (uning menga bo'lgan muhabbatidan hech narsa demaslik kerak edi, xuddi xizmatkor qizidan tug'ilgan qizidek).

en: man of mean extraction) who had, moved by very faithful love, without anywise knowing who he might be, committed into his hands her posses- sions and herself no less.
uz: O'rtacha kelib chiqishga ega bo'lgan odam) juda sadoqatli muhabbat ta'sirida, u kim bo'lishi mumkinligini hech qanday bilmasdan, o'z egaliklarini - sions va o'zini o'z qo'liga topshirgan edi.

en: But what [skilleth it]?
uz: Lekin nima farq qiladi?

en: Things ill done and long time passed are easier blamed than mended; algates, so it was.
uz: Yomon ish qilingan va uzoq vaqt o'tgan narsalar tuzatilgandan ko'ra ayblanishi osonroq; xatolar, shunday bo'ldi.

en: He left me a little child in Palermo, where being grown well nigh as I am now, my mother, who was a rich lady, gave me to wife to a worthy gentle- man of Girgenti, who, for her love and mine, came to abide at Palermo and there, being a great Guelph,98 he entered into treaty with our King Charles,99 which, being discovered by King Frederick,100 ere effect could be given to it, was the occasion of our being enforced to ﬂee from Sicily, whenas I looked to be the greatest lady was ever in the island; wherefore, taking such few things as we might (I say few, in respect of the many we had) and leaving our lands and palaces, we took refuge in this city, where we found King Charles so mindful of our services that he hath in part made good to us the losses we had sustained for him, bestowing on us both lands and houses, and still maketh my husband, thy kinsman that is, a goodly pro- vision, as
uz: U meni Palermo shahrida kichkina bolaga qoldirdi, u yerda men hozirgidek yaxshi ulg'aygan edim, onam, boy xonim, meni Girgentilik munosib muloyim odamga turmushga berdi. U o'z muhabbati va mening mehrim tufayli Palermoga keldi va u yerda, buyuk Guelph bo'lib, 98-yilda qirol Charlz bilan shartnoma tuzdi, 99-yilda qirol Frederik tomonidan aniqlangan edi, 100-yilda unga berilishi mumkin edi, bu bizning Sitsiliyadan qochishga majbur bo'lishimizning sababi edi, men esa orolda eng buyuk xonim bo'lib ko'rardim; shuning uchun, biz (men aytaman, ko'p yerlarimizga nisbatan) va saroylarimizdan chiqib ketib, shu shaharga qochdik.

en: thou shalt hereafter see.
uz: Bundan keyin ko'rasiz.

en: On this wise come I in this city, where, Godamercy and no thanks to thee, sweet my brother, I now behold thee.’ So saying, she embraced him over again and kissed him on the forehead, still weeping for tenderness.
uz: Shunday qilib, men bu shaharga keldim, u yerda, Xudo rahm-shafqat va senga rahmat yo'q, aziz akam, endi seni ko'ryapman. Shunday deb, u uni yana quchoqladi va peshonasidan o'pdi, hali ham mehrdan yig'lardi.

en: Andreuccio, hearing this fable so orderly, so artfully delivered by the damsel, without ever stammering or faltering for a word, and remembering it to be true that his father had been in Palermo, knowing, moreover, by himself the fashions of young men and how lightly they fall in love in their youth and seeing the affectionate tears and embraces and the chaste kisses that she lavished on him, held all she told him for more than true; where- fore, as soon as she was silent, he answered her, saying, ‘Madam, it should seem to you no very great matter if I marvel, for that in truth, whether it be that my father, for whatsoever reason, never spoke of your mother nor of yourself, or that if he did, it came not to my notice, I had no more know- ledge of you than if you had never been, and so much the dearer is it to me to ﬁnd you my sister here, as I am alone in this city and the less expected
uz: Andreukcio bu masalni shunchalik tartibli, shunchalik mohirona malika tomonidan yetkazilganini eshitib, hech qachon bir og'iz gapirmasdan yoki hech qanday ikkilanmasdan, va otasining Palermoda bo'lganini eslab, bundan tashqari, o'zi yosh yigitlarning modalarini va ularning yoshligida qanchalik yengil oshiq bo'lishini bilgan holda, va unga bag'ishlagan mehrli ko'z yoshlari, quchoqlari va xolis o'pichlarini ko'rib, unga aytgan hamma narsani haqiqatdan ham ko'proq ushlab turdi; ammo, u jim bo'lishi bilanoq, u unga javob berdi: "Xonim, men sizga hayratda bo'lishim kerak emas, chunki bu haqiqatda, otam hech qanday sababga ko'ra, na onangiz haqida, na o'zingiz haqida gapirmagan bo'lsa ham, yoki agar u hech qachon, men sizdan ko'proq narsani kutmagan bo'lardim, agar siz bu yerda bo'lsangiz, men sizdan ko'proq

en: this.
uz: Bu.

en: Indeed, I know no man of so high a condition that you should not be dear to him, to say nothing of myself, who am but a petty trader.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men shunday yuqori darajadagi odamni bilmaymanki, unga qadrdon bo'lmasliging kerak, o'zim haqida gapirmasa ham bo'ladi, men shunchaki mayda savdogardaman.

en: But I pray you make me clear of one thing; how knew you that I was here?’ Whereto she made answer, ‘A poor woman, who much frequenteth me, gave me this morning to know of thy coming, for that, as she telleth me, she abode long
uz: Lekin iltimos qilaman, menga bir narsani aniqlashtiring; men bu yerda ekanligimni qayerdan bilardingiz? U javob berdi: Menga tez-tez tashrif buyuruvchi bir bechora ayol bugun ertalab sening kelishingni bilish uchun menga berdi, chunki u menga aytganidek, u uzoq qoldi.

en: with our father both at Palermo and at Perugia; and but that meseemed it was a more reputable thing that thou shouldst visit me in my own house than I thee in that of another, I had come to thee this great while agone.’ After this, she proceeded to enquire more particularly of all his kinsfolk by name, and he answered her of all, giving the more credence, by reason of this, to that which it the less behoved him to believe.
uz: Otamiz bilan birga Palermoda ham, Perugyada ham; va men seni boshqalarning uyidagidan ko'ra o'z uyimga tashrif buyurishing hurmatliroq deb hisoblaganimda, men senga shu buyuk azob chekkanimda kelgan edim." Shundan so'ng, u barcha qarindoshlari haqida ismlari bilan alohida so'rashga kirishdi va u unga hamma narsa haqida javob berdi, shu sababli unga ishonishi kerak bo'lgan narsalarga ko'proq ishondi.

en: The talk being long and the heat great, she called for Greek wine and confections and let give Andreuccio to drink, after which he would have taken leave, for that it was suppertime; but she would on no wise suffer it and making a show of being sore vexed, embraced him and said, ‘Ah, woe is me!
uz: Suhbat uzun va issiq bo'lgani uchun, u yunon vinosi va qandolatlarni chaqirdi va Andreuccioga ichishga ruxsat berdi, shundan so'ng u ta'tilga chiqardi, chunki bu ovqat edi; lekin u bunga hech qanday toqat qilmasdi va achchiqlanib qolganini ko'rsatib, uni quchoqladi va dedi: "Oh, menga voy!"

en: I see but too clearly how little dear I am to thee!
uz: Men senga qanchalik kam aziz ekanligimni juda aniq ko'ryapman!

en: Who would believe that thou couldst be with a sister of thine, whom thou hast never yet seen and in whose house thou shouldst have lighted down, whenas thou earnest hither, and offer to leave her, to go sup at the inn?
uz: Kim ishonardi, sen hech qachon ko'rmagan singling bilan birga bo'lishing mumkin edi va sen bu yerga mehnat qilib, uni mehmonxonada ovqatlanish uchun qoldirishni taklif qilganingda, u uyida yoqib yuborishing kerak edi?

en: Indeed, thou shalt sup with me, and albeit my husband is abroad, which grieveth me mightily, I shall know well how to do thee some little honour, such as a woman may.’ To which Andreuccio, unknowing what else he should say, answered, ‘I hold you as dear as a sister should be held; but, an I go not, I shall be expec- ted to supper all the evening and shall do an unmannerliness.’ ‘Praised be God!’ cried she.
uz: Darhaqiqat, sen men bilan kechki ovqat yeysan, va erim chet elda bo'lsa ham, bu meni juda xafa qilsa ham, men senga ayol kabi kichik bir hurmat ko'rsatishni yaxshi bilaman." Andreukcio nima deyishni bilmay, javob berdi: "Men seni xuddi opa-singil kabi qadrlayman; lekin, men ketmayman, butun oqshom kechki ovqatni yeyishga majbur bo'laman va odobsizlik qilaman." "Allohni poklayman!" deb baqirdi u.

en: ‘One would think I had no one in the house to send to tell them not to expect thee; albeit thou wouldst do much greater courtesy and indeed but thy duty an thou sentest to bid thy companions come hither to supper; and after, am thou must e’en begone, you might all go away togeth- er.’ Andreuccio replied that he had no desire for his companions that even- ing; but that, since it was agreeable to her, she might do her pleasure of him.
uz: "Uyda seni kutmaslikka yuboradigan hech kimim yo'q deb o'ylash mumkin edi; garchi sen ancha ko'p marhamat ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsang ham, lekin sen o'z sheriklaringni bu yerga kechki ovqatga buyurishga yuborganing bor edi; va keyin, sen boshlashing kerak bo'lsa, hammangiz birga ketishingiz mumkin edi." Andreuccio javob berdi: "Uning sheriklariga hech qanday istaklari yo'q edi, lekin u unga rozi bo'lgani uchun, u unga rozi bo'lishi mumkin edi."

en: Accordingly, she made a show of sending to the inn to say that he was not to be expected to supper, and after much other discourse, they sat down to supper and were sumptuously served with various meats, whilst she adroitly contrived to prolong the repast till it was dark night.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u mehmonxonaga kechki ovqatni kutmaslik kerakligini aytish uchun murojaat qildi va ko'p boshqa suhbatlardan so'ng, ular kechki ovqatni qabul qilishga o'tirdilar va turli xil go'shtlar bilan dabdabali tarzda tortiq qilishdi, u esa kechki ovqatni qorong'u tungacha cho'zishga mohirlik bilan harakat qildi.

en: Then, when they rose from table and Andreuccio would have taken his leave, she declared that she would on no wise suffer this, for that Naples was no place to go about in by night especially for a stranger, and that, whenas she sent to the inn to say that he was not to be expected to supper, she had at the same time given notice that he would lie abroad.
uz: Keyin, ular dasturxondan turib, Andreuccio ta'tilga ketganida, u bunga hech qanday toqat qilmasligini e'lon qildi, chunki Neapol kechasi, ayniqsa notanish odam uchun sayohat qilish uchun joy emas edi va u mehmonxonaga kechki ovqatni kutmaslik kerakligini aytish uchun xabar yuborganida, u ayni paytda chet elda yotishi haqida xabar bergan edi.

en: Andreuccio, believing this and taking pleas- ure in being with her, beguiled as he was by false credence, abode where he was, and after supper they held much and long discourse, not without reas-
uz: Andreuccio bunga ishonib, u bilan birga bo'lishdan xursand bo'lib, soxta e'tiqodga berilib, u turgan joyda qoldi va kechki ovqatdan keyin ular uzoq va uzoq suhbatlashdilar, hech qanday asossiz emas.

en: on,101 till a part of the night was past, when she withdrew with her women into another room, leaving Andreuccio in her own chamber, with a little lad to wait upon him, if he should lack aught.
uz: 101 da, tunning bir qismi o'tguncha, u ayollari bilan boshqa xonaga chekindi, Andreuccio o'z xonasida qoldi, agar u hech narsaga muhtoj bo'lsa, unga kichkina yigitcha kutib turardi.

en: The heat being great, Andreuccio, as soon as he found himself alone, stripped to his doublet and putting off his hosen, laid them at the bedhead; after which, natural use soliciting him to rid himself of the overmuch bur- den of his stomach, he asked the boy where this might be done, who showed him a door in one corner of the room and said, ‘Go in there.’ Ac- cordingly he opened the door and passing through in all assurance, chanced to set foot on a plank, which, being broken loose from the joist at the oppos- ite end, [ﬂew up] and down they went, plank and man together.
uz: Issiqlik juda kuchli bo'lgani uchun, Andreuccio o'zi yolg'iz qolishi bilanoq, qo'ltiqlarini yechdi va o'z qo'llarini qo'yib, ularni karavot boshiga qo'ydi; shundan so'ng, tabiiy ravishda qorinining ortiqcha og'rig'idan xalos bo'lishga undadi, u boladan buni qayerdan amalga oshirish mumkinligini so'radi, u unga xonaning bir burchagida eshik ko'rsatib, "Unga kir" dedi. Shunga ko'ra, eshikni ochdi va ishonch bilan o'tib, taxtani oyoqqa qo'yishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: God so fa- voured him that he did himself no hurt in the fall, albeit he fell from some height; but he was all bemired with the ordure whereof the place was full; and in order that you may the better apprehend both that which hath been said and that which ensueth, I will show you how the place lay.
uz: Xudo unga shunday qasam ichdiki, u yiqilish paytida o'ziga hech qanday zarar yetkazmadi, garchi u biroz balandlikdan yiqilgan bo'lsa ham; lekin u joy to'la axlatdan xafagarchilikda edi; va siz aytilgan narsani ham, keyin sodir bo'layotgan narsani ham yaxshiroq tushunishingiz uchun, men sizga joy qanday ekanligini ko'rsataman.

en: There were in a narrow alley, such as we often see between two houses, a pair of rafters laid from one house to another, and thereon sundry boards nailed and the place of session set up; of which boards that which gave way with Andreuc- cio was one.
uz: Tor bir ko'chada, ko'pincha ikki uy o'rtasida ko'rishimiz mumkin bo'lganidek, bir uydan ikkinchisiga bir juft to'siq yotqizilardi va u yerda turli xil taxtalar mixlangan va majlis joyi o'rnatilgan edi; ulardan Andreuc-tio bilan o'tadigan taxtalar bir edi.

en: Finding himself, then, at the bottom of the alley and sore chagrined at the mishap, he fell a-bawling for the boy; but the latter, as soon as he heard him fall, had run to tell his mistress, who hastened to his chamber and searching hurriedly if his clothes were there, found them and with them the money, which, in his mistrust, he still foolishly carried about him.
uz: Shunda o'zini xiyobinning tubida topib, baxtsiz hodisadan xafa bo'lib, u bola uchun qichqirdi; lekin u yiqilganini eshitishi bilanoq, xo'jayiniga xabar berish uchun yugurdi. U xonasiga shoshildi va u yerda kiyimlari bor-yo'qligini qidirib, ularni topdi va ular bilan birga pulni ham topdi. Bu esa, ishonchsizligida, u hali ham ahmoqona tarzda uni olib yurardi.

en: Having now got- ten that for which, feigning herself of Palermo and sister to a Perugian, she had set her snare, she took no more reck of him, but hastened to shut the door whereby he had gone out when he fell.
uz: Endi o'n narsa olgandan so'ng, o'zini Palermo va Peresis singlisiga o'xshatib, u tuzoqni qo'ydi, u endi undan xafa bo'lmadi, balki yiqilganda tashqariga chiqqan eshikni tezda yopdi.

en: Andreuccio, getting no answer from the boy, proceeded to call loudlier, but to no purpose; whereupon, his suspicions being now aroused, he began too late to smoke the cheat.
uz: Andreukcio boladan javob ololmay, balandroq qo'ng'iroq qilishga kirishdi, lekin maqsadsiz; shundan so'ng, uning shubhalari endi uyg'onib, u firibgarlikni chekishga juda kech kirishdi.

en: Accordingly, he scrambled over a low wall that shut off the alley from the street, and letting himself down into the road, went up to the door of the house, which he knew very well, and there called long and loud and shook and beat upon it amain, but all in vain.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u xiyobonni ko'chadan to'sib qo'ygan past devor ustidan sakrab o'tdi va o'zini yo'lga qo'yib, o'zi juda yaxshi bilgan uyning eshigiga chiqdi va u yerda uzoq va baland ovoz bilan jar solib, hayrat bilan urdi, lekin hammasi befoyda.

en: Wherefore, bewailing himself, as one who was now fully aware of his mischance, ‘Ah, woe is me!’ cried he.
uz: Shuning uchun, o'zini xafagarchilikdan to'liq xabardor bo'lgandek xafa qilib, u: "Voy, menga!" deb baqirdi.

en: ‘In how little time have I lost ﬁve hundred ﬂorins and a sister!’ Then, after many other words, he fell again to battering the door and crying out and this he did so long and so lustily that many of the neigh-
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida besh yuz florin va bir singlimni yo'qotdim! Keyin, ko'p so'zlardan so'ng, u yana eshikni urib, baqirib yiqildi va buni shunchalik uzoq va shunchalik beparvolik bilan qildi, hatto ko'plab qo'shnilar...

en: bours, being awakened and unable to brook the annoy, arose and one of the courtezan’s waiting-women, coming to the window, apparently all sleepy- eyed, said peevishly, ‘Who knocketh below there?’ ‘What?’ cried Andreuccio.
uz: Bo'rilar uyg'onib, g'azablanganni yo'qota olmagani uchun, o'rnidan turdilar va derazadan kelayotgan hovli ayollardan biri, ko'rinishicha, butunlay uyqusiragan holda, achchiqlanib dedi: "U yerda kim taqillayapti?" "Nima?" - deb baqirdi Andreuccio.

en: ‘Dost thou not know me?
uz: Meni tanimaysanmi?

en: I am Andreuccio, brother to Madam Fjordaliso.’ Whereto quoth she, ‘Good man, an thou have drunken overmuch, go sleep and come back tomorrow morning.
uz: Men Andreuccio, Madam Fjordalisoning ukamman." U qayerga kelsa, dedi: "Yaxshi odam, sen juda ko'p mast bo'lding, uxlab ket va ertaga ertalab qaytib kel."

en: I know no Andreuccio nor what be these idle tales thou tellest.
uz: Men Andreuccio'ni ham, sen aytib yurgan bekorchi hikoyalar nima ekanligini ham bilmayman.

en: Begone in peace and let us sleep, so it please thee.’ ‘How?’ replied Andreuccio.
uz: "Tinchlikda boshlang va biz uxlaymiz, shunda sizga yoqadi." "Qanday?" - javob berdi Andreuccio.

en: ‘Thou knowest not what I mean?
uz: Nima demoqchiligimni bilmayapsanmi?

en: Certes, thou knowest; but, if Sicilian kinships be of such a fashion that they are forgotten in so short a time, at least give me back my clothes and I will begone with all my heart.’ ‘Good man,’ rejoined she, as if laughing, ‘methinketh thou dreamest’; and to say this and to draw in her head and shut the window were one and the same thing.
uz: Albatta, bilasiz; lekin, agar Sicilian mushuklari shunday uslubda bo'lsa, ular shunchalik qisqa vaqt ichida unutilib ketsa, hech bo'lmaganda menga kiyimlarimni qaytarib bering, shunda men butun qalbim bilan boshlayman. Yaxshi odam, deb javob berdi u, xuddi kulgandek, meningcha, sen tush ko'ryapsan; va buni aytish va boshini chizish va derazani yopish bir xil edi.

en: Whereat Andreuc- cio, now fully certiﬁed of his loss, was like for chagrin to turn his exceeding anger into madness and bethought himself to seek to recover by violence that which he might not have again with words; wherefore, taking up a great stone, he began anew to batter the door more furiously than ever.
uz: Andreuk-tio, endi o'z yo'qotishidan to'liq amin bo'lgan holda, g'azabini telbalikka aylantirishga o'xshardi va o'zini zo'ravonlik bilan yana so'zlar bilan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lmagan narsani tiklashga harakat qilishga o'yladi; shuning uchun, katta toshni olib, u eshikni har qachongidan ham g'azab bilan yana urishni boshladi.

en: At this many of the neighbours, who had already been awakened and had arisen, deeming him some pestilent fellow who had trumped up this story to spite the woman of the house and provoked at the knocking he kept up, came to the windows and began to say, no otherwise than as all the dogs of a quarter bark after a strange dog, ’Tis a villainous shame to come at this hour to decent women’s houses and tell these cock-and-bull stories.
uz: Shunda qo'shnilarning ko'pchiligi, allaqachon uyg'onib, o'rnidan turishgan, uni uy ayolini xafa qilish uchun bu hikoyani o'ylab topgan va taqillatishni davom ettirgan odam deb hisoblagan holda, derazalarga kelib, g'alati itning butun itlari kabi, "Bu soatlarda munosib ayollarning uylariga kelib, bu xo'roz-buzoq hikoyalarini aytib berish yomon sharmandalikdir", deyishni boshladilar.

en: For God’s sake, good man, please you begone in peace and let us sleep.
uz: Xudo haqqi, yaxshi inson, iltimos, tinchlikda boshlang va bizni uxlating.

en: An thou have aught to mell with her, come back tomorrow and spare us this annoy tonight.’ Taking assurance, perchance, by these words, there came to the window one who was within the house, a bully of the gentlewoman’s, whom Andreuccio had as yet neither heard nor seen, and said, in a terrible big rough voice, ‘Who is below there?’ Andreuccio, hearing this, raised his eyes and saw at the window one who, by what little he could make out, himseemed should be a very masterful fel- low, with a bushy black beard on his face, and who yawned and rubbed his eyes, as he had arisen from bed or deep sleep; whereupon, not without fear, he answered, ‘I am a brother of the lady of the house.’ The other waited not for him to make an end of his reply, but said, more ﬁercely than before, ‘I know not what hindereth me from coming down and cudgelling thee what while I see thee stir, for a pestilent drunken
uz: "Sen unga hech narsa qilmaysan, ertaga qaytib kel va bu bezovtalikdan bizni qutqar." Shu so'zlar bilan ishonch hosil qilib, uyning ichkarisida yotgan, Andreuccio hali eshitmagan yoki ko'rmagan ayolning zo'ravon biri derazaga keldi va dahshatli baland qo'pol ovoz bilan dedi: "U yerda kim bor?" Andreuccio buni eshitib, ko'zlarini ko'tardi va deraza oldida juda mohirona past ko'rinadigan, yuzida buta bilan qora soqol bor, va u ko'zlarini chaynab, ishqaladi, chunki u to'shadan yoki chuqur uyqudan turgan edi; keyin, qo'rqmasdan javob berdi: "Men uyning birodaramman." Andreuccio buni eshitib, uni ko'rmadi, lekin men uni qattiqroq ko'rish uchun, men uni...

en: ass as thou must be, who will
uz: sen bo'lishing kerak bo'lgan eshak, kim xohlaydi

en: not let us sleep this night.’ Then, drawing back into the house, he shut the window; whereupon certain of the neighbours, who were better acquainted with the fellow’s quality, said softly to Andreuccio, ‘For God’s sake, good man, begone in peace and abide not there tonight to be slain; get thee gone for thine own good.’ Andreuccio, terriﬁed at the fellow’s voice and aspect and moved by the exhortations of the neighbours, who seemed to him to speak out of charity, set out to return to his inn, in the direction of the quarter whence he had fol- lowed the maid, without knowing whither to go, despairing of his money and woebegone as ever man was.
uz: Bu kecha uxlamaylik. Keyin, u uyga qaytib kirib, deraza yopdi; shundan so'ng, o'sha odamning sifati bilan yaxshiroq tanish bo'lgan ba'zi qo'shnilar Andreuccioga sekinlik bilan dedilar: "Xudo haqqi, yaxshi odam, bugun kechqurun tinch yurib, o'ldirilmang; o'z foydangiz uchun keting." Andreuccio, o'sha odamning ovozi va tashqi ko'rinishidan dahshatga tushib, qo'shnilarning maslahatlaridan qo'rqib, unga xayriya deb o'ylagan qo'shnisining maslahatlaridan xafa bo'lib, u qayerga borishni bilmay, qayerga borishni umid qilmay, xonimga qaytishga yo'l oldi.

en: Being loathsome to himself, for the stench that came from him, and thinking to repair to the sea to wash him- self, he turned to the left and followed a street called Ruga Catalana,102 that led towards the upper part of the city.
uz: O'ziga jirkanch bo'lib, undan kelayotgan badbo'y hiddan va o'zini yuvish uchun dengizga qaytishni o'ylab, u chapga burilib, shaharning yuqori qismiga olib boruvchi Ruga Catalana 102 ko'chasiga ergashdi.

en: Presently, he espied two men coming towards him with a lantern and fearing they might be ofﬁcers of the watch or other ill-disposed folk, he stealthily took refuge, to avoid them, in a hov- el, that he saw hard by.
uz: Hozirda u ikki kishining chiroq bilan unga yaqinlashayotganini kuzatardi va ular qo'riqchilar ofitserlari yoki boshqa yomon niyatli odamlar bo'lishidan qo'rqib, ularni yashirincha, qattiq kuzatib turgan hovlida qochdi.

en: But they, as of malice aforethought, made straight for the same place and entering in, began to examine certain irons which one of them laid from off his shoulder, discoursing various things thereof the while.
uz: Ammo ular, yomon niyat bilan oldindan o'ylab, o'sha joyga to'g'ri yo'l olishdi va kirib, ularning birontasi yelkasidan osib qo'ygan ba'zi dazmollarni tekshirishni boshladilar, shu bilan birga ularning turli xil narsalarni muhokama qilishdi.

en: Presently, ‘What meaneth this?’ quoth one.
uz: Hozirda, "Bu nimani anglatadi?" deb so'rayman.

en: ‘I smell the worst stench me- seemeth I ever smelt.’ So saying, he raised the lantern and seeing the wretched Andreuccio, enquired, in amazement.
uz: "Men eng yomon hidni sezyapman - go'yo hech qachon hidlaganga o'xshayman." Shunday deb, u chiroqni ko'tardi va bechora Andreuccio hayrat bilan so'raganini ko'rdi.

en: ‘Who is there?’ Andreuccio made no answer, but they came up to him with the light and asked him what he did there in such a pickle; whereupon he related to them all that had be- fallen him, and they, conceiving where this might have happened, said, one to the other, ‘Verily, this must have been in the house of Scarabone But- tafuocco.’ Then, turning to him, ‘Good man,’ quoth one, ‘albeit thou hast lost thy money, thou hast much reason to praise God that this mischance betided thee, so that thou fellest nor couldst after avail to enter the house again; for, hadst thou not fallen, thou mayst be assured that, when once thou wast fallen asleep, thou hadst been knocked on the head and hadst lost thy life as well as thy money.
uz: U yerda kim bor? Andreukcio javob bermadi, lekin ular unga yorug'lik bilan yaqinlashib, undan bunday tuzlama ichida nima qilganini so'rashdi. Shunda u ularga unga tushgan hamma narsani aytib berdi va ular, bu nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'ylab, bir-biriga dedilar: Haqiqatan ham, bu Scarabone But- tafuocco uyida bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak. Keyin unga o'girilib, Yaxshi odam, dedi u:  garchi pulingni yo'qotgan bo'lsang ham, bu ish senga zarar yetkazgani uchun Xudoga maqtov aytishga ko'p sababing bor, shuning uchun sen uyga qayta kirishga qodir emassan; chunki, agar sen tushmaganingda, sen uyquga ketganingda, boshingni urib, hayotingni yo'qotgandek bo'lganing edi.

en: But what booteth it now to repine?
uz: Lekin endi nima uni qayta dam olishga undaydi?

en: Thou mayst as well look to have the stars out of the sky as to recover a farthing of thy money; nay, thou art like to be murdered, should yonder fellow hear that thou makest any words thereof.’ Then they consulted together awhile and presently said to him, ‘Look you, we are moved to pity for thee; wherefore, an thou wilt join with us in somewhat we go about to do, it seemeth to us
uz: Siz ham pulingizdan bir chimdimni qaytarib olish uchun osmondan yulduzlarni qidirishingiz mumkin; yo'q, agar u yerda odam eshitsa, siz bu haqda gapiryapsiz, o'ldirilgandek bo'lasiz." Keyin ular biroz maslahatlashib, darhol unga dedilar: "Mana, biz sizga rahm qilamiz; shuning uchun, agar siz biz bilan birga qiladigan biror ishda qo'shilsangiz, bizga ko'rinadi."

en: certain that there will fall to thee for thy share much more than the value of that which thou hast lost.’ Whereupon Andreuccio, in his desperation, answered that he was ready.
uz: Ishonch komilki, sening ulushing yo'qotgan narsaning qiymatidan ko'ra ancha ko'proq narsa senga to'g'ri keladi." Shunda Andreukcio umidsizlikka tushib, tayyorligini javob berdi.

en: Now there had been that day buried an archbishop of Naples, by name Messer Filippo Minutolo, and he had been interred in his richest ornaments and with a ruby on his ﬁnger worth more than ﬁve hundred ﬂorins of gold.
uz: O'sha kuni Neapol arxiyepiskopi, Messer Filippo Minutolo nomi bilan dafn etilgan edi va u o'zining eng boy bezaklariga va barmog'ida besh yuz florindan ortiq qimmatga ega oltin yoqut bilan dafn etilgan edi.

en: Him they were minded to despoil and this their intent they discovered to Andreuccio, who, more covetous than well-advised, set out with them for the cathedral.
uz: Uni o'g'irlash niyatida edilar va bu niyatlarini Andreuccioga topdilar. Andreuccio esa, xushchaqchaqlikdan ko'ra ochko'zroq bo'lib, ular bilan soborga yo'l oldi.

en: As they went, Andreuccio still stinking amain, one of the thieves said, ‘Can we not ﬁnd means for this fellow to wash himself a little, be it where it may, so he may not stink so terribly?’ ‘Ay can we,’ answered the other.
uz: Ular ketayotganda, Andreuccio hali ham badbo'y hidda edi, o'g'rilardan biri dedi: Bu odam uchun ozgina yuvinish uchun hech qanday vosita topa olmaymizmi, qayerda bo'lsa ham, shunchalik badbo'y hidga botmasligi uchun? Ha, qila olamizmi,  javob berdi boshqasi.

en: ‘We are here near a well, where there useth to be a rope and pul- ley and a great bucket; let us go thither and we will wash him in a trice.’ Ac- cordingly they made for the well in question and found the rope there, but the bucket had been taken away; wherefore they took counsel together to tie him to the rope and let him down into the well, so he might wash himself there, charging him shake the rope as soon as he was clean, and they would pull him up.
uz: Biz bu yerda qudug' yaqinida turibmiz, u yerda arqon, pul-ley va katta chelak bor; kelinglar u yerga boraylik va uni trichkada yuvamiz. Shunga ko'ra, ular so'ralgan quduqqa yo'l olishdi va u yerda arqonni topishdi, lekin chelak olib ketilgan edi; shuning uchun ular uni arqonga bog'lab, quduqqa tushirishni maslahatlashdilar, shunda u o'zi yuvinishi mumkin edi, toza bo'lishi bilanoq arqani silkitishni buyurdilar va uni olib chiqishardi.

en: Hardly had they let him down when, as chance would have it, certain of the watch, being athirst for the heat and with running after some rogue or another, came to the well to drink, and the two rogues, setting eyes on them, made off incontinent, before the ofﬁcers saw them.
uz: Ular uni deyarli yiqitishmagan edi, qachonki, tasodif bo'lsa, soatning bir qismi, issiqlikdan chanqoq va qandaydir bir badbo'y yoki boshqa birovning orqasidan yugurib, quduqqa ichish uchun keldi va ikki badbo'y, ularga ko'z tikib, ofitserlar ularni ko'rishidan oldin qotib qoldi.

en: Presently, Andreuccio, having washed himself at the bottom of the well, shook the rope, and the thirsty ofﬁcers, laying by their targets and arms and surcoats, began to haul upon the rope, thinking the bucket full of water at the other end.
uz: Hozirda Andreuccio quduqning tubida yuvinib, arqonni chayqadi, chanqoq ofitserlar esa nishonlari, qurollari va paltolari bilan yotishib, arqonni sudrab yurishni boshladilar, chunki ular boshqa uchida suv to'la chelak bor deb o'ylashardi.

en: As soon as Andreuccio found himself near the top, he let go the rope and laid hold of the marge with both hands; which when the ofﬁcers saw, overcome with sudden affright, they dropped the rope, without saying a word, and took to their heels as quickliest they might.
uz: Andreuccio o'zini tepaga yaqinlashishi bilanoq, arqonni qo'yib yubordi va ikki qo'li bilan chekkani ushladi; ofitserlar to'satdan dahshatga tushib, hech narsa demasdan arqonni tashlab, oyoqlariga imkon qadar tezroq tutdilar.

en: At this Andreuccio marvelled sore, and but that he had fast hold of the marge, would have fallen to the bottom, to his no little hurt or maybe death.
uz: Shu paytda Andreukcio hayratga tushdi, va lekin u qirg'oqni tezda ushlagan bo'lsa, pastga tushib ketardi, uning hech qanday jarohat olmagani yoki balki o'limiga.

en: However, he made his way out and ﬁnding the arms, which he knew were none of his companions’ bringing, he was yet more amazed; but, knowing not what to make of it and misdoubting [some snare], he determined to begone without touching aught and accord- ingly made off he knew not whither, bewailing his ill-luck.
uz: Biroq, u yo'lga chiqdi va hech kim olib kelmagan qurollarni topdi  u bundan ham hayratda edi; lekin nima qilish kerakligini bilmay, nimadirga qo'l urib, hech narsaga tegmasdan boshlashga qaror qildi va qayerga borishini bilmay, o'z omadidan xafa bo'lib ketdi.

en: As he went, he met his two comrades, who came to draw him forth of the well; and when they saw him, they marvelled exceedingly and asked him
uz: U ketayotganda, ikki o'rtog'i uni quduqdan chiqarib olish uchun kelishdi. Uni ko'rgach, juda hayratda qolishdi va undan so'rashdi.

en: who had drawn him up.
uz: Uni kim tortgan edi.

en: Andreuccio replied that he knew not and told them orderly how it had happened and what he had found by the wellside, whereupon the others, perceiving how the case stood, told him, laughing, why they had ﬂed and who these were that had pulled him up.
uz: Andreukcio javob berdi: "Bilmayman" va ularga nima bo'lgani va quduq yonida nima topganini tartibli tarzda aytdi. Shunda qolganlar ish qanday holatda ekanligini anglab, unga nega qochganliklarini va uni kimga olib kelganliklarini kulishdi.

en: Then, without farther parley, it being now middle night, they repaired to the cathedral and making their way thereinto lightly enough, went straight to the archbishop’s tomb, which was of marble and very large.
uz: Keyin, uzoqroq suhbatsiz, endi yarim tun bo'lgani uchun, ular soborga yo'l olishdi va u yerga yetarlicha yengil kirib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri marmar va juda katta bo'lgan arxiyepiskopning qabriga borishdi.

en: With their irons they raised the lid, which was very heavy, and propped it up so as a man might enter; which being done, quoth one, ‘Who shall go in?’ ‘Not I,’ answered the other.
uz: Ular temirlari bilan juda ogir bolgan qopqogini kotardilar va uni odam kirishi uchun tayanchga qoydilar; bu ish tugagach, biri: Kim kiradi? Men emas, dedi ikkinchisi.

en: ‘Nor I,’ rejoined his fellow; ‘let Andreuccio enter.’ ‘That will I not,’ said the latter; whereupon the two rogues turned upon him and said, ‘How!
uz: Men ham,  deb javob berdi ortogi; Andreuksiy kirsin. Men unday qilmayman,  dedi ikkinchisi; shundan song ikki badboy unga qarab dedi: Qanday!

en: Cock’s faith, an thou enter not, we will clout thee over the costard with one of these iron bars till thou fall dead.’ Andreuccio, affrighted, crept into the tomb, saying in himself the while, ‘These fellows will have me go in here so they may cheat me, for that, when I shall have given them everything, they will begone about their busi- ness, whilst I am labouring to win out of the tomb, and I shall abide empty- handed.’ Accordingly, he determined to make sure of his share beforehand; wherefore, as soon as he came to the bottom, calling to mind the precious ring whereof he had heard them speak, he drew it from the archbishop’s ﬁn- ger and set it on his own.
uz: Xo'rozning e'tiqodi, agar kirmasang, seni shu temir tayoqlardan biri bilan yonboshga uramiz, toki o'lasan." Andreukcio xavotirda qabrga kirib, o'zicha dedi: "Bu yigitlar meni bu yerga kirib, meni aldashlari mumkin, chunki men ularga hamma narsani berganimdan so'ng, ular o'zlarining ishini boshlashadi, men esa qabrdan chiqib ketishga harakat qilyapman va men bo'sh qo'l bilan qolaman." Shunga ko'ra, u oldindan o'z ulushini ta'minlashga qaror qildi; shuning uchun, u pastga kelib, ularni eshitgan qimmatbaho halqani esladi, u uni arxiyepiskopdan tortib, o'zi uchun joylashtirdi.

en: Then he passed them the crozier and mitre and gloves and stripping the dead man to his shirt, gave them everything, saying that there was nothing more.
uz: Keyin u ularga kruzer, mitre va qo'lqoplarni uzatdi va o'likni ko'ylagini yechdi, ularga hamma narsani berdi va bundan boshqa hech narsa yo'q dedi.

en: The others declared that the ring must be there and bade him seek everywhere; but he replied that he found it not and mak- ing a show of seeking it, kept them in play awhile.
uz: Qolganlar uzuk u yerda bo'lishi kerakligini e'lon qilishdi va uni hamma joyda qidirishni talab qilishdi; lekin u topmaganini va uni izlayotganini ko'rsatib, ularni bir oz vaqt davomida o'ynatib turdi, deb javob berdi.

en: At last, the two rogues, who were no less wily than himself, bidding him seek well the while, took occasion to pull away the prop that held up the lid and made off, leaving him shut in the tomb.
uz: Nihoyat, o'zidan kam bo'lmagan ikki xurofotkor, uni yaxshilab izlashga buyurib, qopqog'ini ushlab turgan va yo'qotgan prokladkani tortib olish uchun imkoniyat topdilar va uni qabrga qamab qo'yishdi.

en: What became of Andreuccio, when he found himself in this plight, you may all imagine for yourselves.
uz: Andreuccio o'zini shu ahvolga tushganda nima bo'lganini hammangiz tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.

en: He strove again and again to heave up the lid with his head and shoulders, but only wearied himself in vain; where- fore, overcome with chagrin and despair, he fell down in a swoon upon the archbishop’s dead body; and whoso saw him there had hardly known which was the deader, the prelate or he.
uz: U boshini va yelkalarini qayta-qayta ko'tarib, qopqog'ini ko'tarishga harakat qildi, lekin faqatgina behuda charchadi; shuning uchun ham, xafalik va umidsizlikdan toyib, arxiyepiskopning o'limiga yiqildi; va uni u yerda ko'rganlar o'lik, prelat yoki u kim ekanligini deyarli bilmas edilar.

en: Presently, coming to himself, he fell into a passion of weeping, seeing he must there without fail come to one of two ends, to wit, either he must, if none came thither to open the tomb again, die
uz: Hozir o'ziga kelgach, u yig'lash ishtiyoqiga tushdi, chunki u u yerda ikki nuqtaga kelish kerak edi, ya'ni, agar u yerda qabrni qayta ochish uchun hech kim kelmasa, o'lishi kerak edi.

en: of hunger and stench, among the worms of the dead body, or, if any came and found him there, he would certainly be hanged for a thief.
uz: Ochlik va badbo'y hid, o'lik jasadning qurtlari orasida, yoki, agar kimdir kelib uni u yerda topsangiz, u albatta o'g'ri uchun osilgan bo'lardi.

en: As he abode in this mind, exceeding woebegone, he heard folk stirring in the Church and many persons speaking and presently perceived that they came to do that which he and his comrades had already done; whereat fear redoubled upon him.
uz: U shu xayolida yashar ekan, juda ham tashvishga tushgan holda, u cherkovda odamlarning g'azablanayotganini va ko'plab odamlarning gapirayotganini eshitdi va darhol o'zi va o'rtoqlari allaqachon qilgan ishni qilish uchun kelganliklarini angladilar; shu sababli qo'rquv uning ustida ikki barobar ko'paydi.

en: But, after the newcomers had forced open the tomb and propped up the lid, they fell into dispute of who should go in, and none was willing to do it.
uz: Ammo, yangi kelganlar qabrni majburan ochib, qopqog'ini qo'llab-quvvatlagandan so'ng, kim kirishi kerakligi haqida bahslashdilar va hech kim bunga rozi bo'lmadi.

en: However, after long parley, a priest said, ‘What fear ye?
