uz: Ammo uzoq suhbatdan so'ng, bir ruhoniy dedi: Nimaga qo'rqasizlar?

en: Think you he will eat you?
uz: Sizningcha, u sizni yeydi deb o'ylayapsizmi?

en: The dead eat not men.
uz: O'liklar odamlarni yemaydi.

en: I will go in myself.’ So saying, he set his breast to the marge of the tomb and turning his head outward, put in his legs, thinking to let himself drop.
uz: Men o'zim kiraman. Shunday deb, u ko'kragini qabr chetiga qo'ydi va boshini tashqariga burib, oyoqlariga qo'ydi, o'zini tushirishni o'yladi.

en: Andreuccio, seeing this, started up and catching the priest by one of his legs, made a show of offering to pull him down into the tomb.
uz: Andreukcio buni ko'rib, ruhoniyni oyoqlaridan biridan ushladi va uni qabrga tortish uchun qurbonlik ko'rsatdi.

en: The other, feeling this, gave a ter- rible screech and ﬂung precipitately out of the tomb; whereupon all the oth- ers ﬂed in terror, as they were pursued by an hundred thousand devils, leav- ing the tomb open.
uz: Boshqasi esa buni his qilib, dahshatli qichqiriq chiqardi va qabrdan shiddat bilan tashqariga uloqtirildi; shundan so'ng barcha boshqa sheriklar dahshatdan qochib ketdilar, chunki ularni yuz minglab shaytonlar ta'qib qilib, qabrni ochiq qoldirdilar.

en: Andreuccio, seeing this, scrambled hastily out of the tomb, rejoiced bey- ond all hope, and made off out of the church by the way he had entered in.
uz: Andreuksiy buni ko'rib, qabrdan shoshilinch chiqib ketdi, butun umid bilan xursand bo'ldi va kirgan yo'li bilan cherkovdan chiqib ketdi.

en: The day now drawing near, he fared on at a venture, with the ring on his ﬁn- ger, till he came to the seashore and thence made his way back to his inn, where he found his comrades and the host, who had been in concern for him all that night.
uz: Kun yaqinlashar ekan, u qanotida halqa bilan sayohatda davom etdi, toki dengiz sohiliga yetib keldi va shundan so'ng mehmonxonaga qaytib keldi. U yerda o'zining o'rtoqlari va o'sha tun bo'yi uni tashvishga solayotgan qo'shini topdi.

en: He told them what had betided him and themseemed, by the host’s counsel, that he were best depart Naples incontinent.
uz: U ularga o'ziga kelgan narsalarni aytdi va ular, qo'shin maslahati bilan, u Neapoldan bemalol ketishi yaxshiroq edi, deb o'ylashdi.

en: Accordingly, he set out forthright and returned to Perugia, having invested his money in a ring, whereas he came to buy horses.”
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u to'g'ri yo'lga chiqdi va Perugiyaga qaytib keldi, pulini halqaga investitsiya qildi, shu bilan birga ot sotib olishga keldi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY Madam Beritola, having lost her two sons, is found on a desert island with two kids and goeth thence into Lunigiana, where one of her sons, taking service with the lord of the country, lieth with his daughter and is cast into prison.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Madam Beritola ikki o'g'lini yo'qotganidan so'ng, ikki bolasi bilan cho'l orolda topildi va u yerdan Lunigianaga bordi. U yerda uning o'g'illaridan biri, mamlakat xo'jayini bilan xizmat qilib, qizi bilan yotadi va qamoqqa tashlanadi.

en: Sicily after rebelling against King Charles and the youth being recognized by his mother, he espouseth his lord’s daughter, and his brother being likewise found, they are all three restored to high estate.
uz: Sitsiliya qirol Charlzga qarshi isyon ko'targanidan so'ng va yosh yigit onasi tomonidan tan olinganidan so'ng, u xo'jayinining qiziga turmushga chiqadi va akasi ham topilganidan so'ng, ularning barchasi yuqori martabali lavozimga qaytariladi.

en: Ladies and young men alike laughed heartily at Andreuccio’s adventures, as related by Fiammetta, and Emilia, seeing the story ended, began, by the queen’s commandment, to speak thus: “Grievous things and woeful are the various shifts of Fortune, whereof —for that, whenassoever it is discoursed of them, it is an awakenment for our minds, which lightly fall asleep under her blandishments —methinketh it should never be irksome either to the happy or the unhappy to hear tell, inasmuch as it rendereth the former wary and consoleth the latter.
uz: Xonimlar ham, yigitlar ham Andreuccio'ning Fiammetta hikoya qilgan sarguzashtlariga chin dildan kuldilar, va Emilia, hikoya tugagandan so'ng, malika buyrug'i bilan shunday deyishni boshladi: Baxtning turli o'zgarishlari dahshatli va qayg'uli narsalardir, chunki  bu, qachonki ular haqida gapirilsa, bizning ongimiz uchun uyg'onishdir, u uning aldovlari ostida yengil uxlab qoladi  menimcha, bu hech qachon baxtli yoki baxtsizlarga aytishni eshitish uchun bezovta qilmasligi kerak, chunki bu oldingilarni ogohlantiradi va oxirgilarni ovutadi.

en: Wherefore, albeit great things have already been recounted upon this subject, I purpose to tell you thereanent a story no less true than pitiful, whereof, for all it had a joyful ending, so great and so longsome was the bitterness that I can scarce believe it to have been as- suaged by any subsequent gladness.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu mavzuda allaqachon katta narsalar rivoyat qilingan bo'lsa-da, men sizga achinarli hikoyadan kam bo'lmagan haqiqatni aytmoqchiman, chunki uning barchasi quvonchli yakun topgan, shunchalik katta va shunchalik uzun bo'lgan achchiqlikki, men uni keyingi quvonchdan o'zgartirilgan deb ishonmayman.

en: You must know, dearest ladies, that, after the death of the Emperor Fred- erick the Second, Manfred was crowned King of Sicily, in very high estate with whom was a gentleman of Naples called Arrighetto Capece, who had to wife a fair and noble lady, also of Naples, by name Madam Beritola Ca- racciola.
uz: Siz bilishingiz kerakki, aziz xonimlar, imperator Fred- Erik Ikkinchining vafotidan so'ng, Manfred Siciliya qiroli etib tojlandi. U bilan birga Neapollik Arrighetto Capece ismli bir janob bor edi, u ham Neapollik bir go'zal va olijanob xonimga turmushga chiqishi kerak edi, uning ismi Madam Beritola Ca-racciola edi.

en: The said Arrighetto, who had the governance of the island in his hands, hearing that King Charles the First103 had overcome and slain Man- fred at Benevento and that all the realm had revolted to him and having scant assurance of the short-lived ﬁdelity of the Sicilians, prepared for
uz: Aytilgan Arrighetto, orol boshqaruvi uning qo'lida bo'lgan, qirol Charlz Birinchi 103 Beneventoda Man-fredni yengib o'ldirganini va butun saltanat unga qarshi isyon ko'targanini eshitib, Siciliyaliklarning qisqa muddatli sadoqatidan kam ishonchga ega bo'lib, tayyor edi.

en: ﬂight, misliking to become a subject of his lord’s enemy; but, his intent be- ing known of the Sicilians, he and many other friends and servants of King Manfred were suddenly made prisoners and delivered to King Charles, to- gether with possession of the island.
uz: qochdi, xo'jayinining dushmaniga obro' bo'lishni istamadi; lekin, uning maqsadi Siciliyaliklarga ma'lum bo'lgani sababli, u va qirol Manfredning boshqa ko'plab do'stlari va xizmatkorlari to'satdan asirga olinib, qirol Charlzga topshirishdi, orolga egalik qilish bilan birga.

en: Madam Beritola, in this grievous change of affairs, knowing not what was come of Arrighetto and sore adread of that which had befallen, aban- doned all her possessions for fear of shame and poor and pregnant as she was, embarked, with a son of hers and maybe eight years of age, Giusfredi by name, in a little boat and ﬂed to Lipari, where she gave birth to another male child, whom she named Scacciato,104 and getting her a nurse, took ship with all three to return to her kinsfolk at Naples.
uz: Xonim Beritola, vaziyatning bu og'ir o'zgarishida, Arrighetto nima bo'lganini va boshiga tushgan azobni bilmay, aban- sharmandalik va kambag'allik tufayli barcha mol-mulkini tashlab, homilador bo'lgani uchun, o'g'li bilan, ehtimol sakkiz yoshli, Giusfredi ismli kichik qayiqqa chiqdi va Lipariga qochdi, u yerda yana bir o'g'il tug'di, uni Scacciato deb atadi, 104 va unga hamshira olib, uchalasi bilan birga kemaga chiqdi va o'z qarindoshlariga qaytdi.

en: But it befell otherwise than as she purposed; for that the ship, which should have gone to Naples, was carried by stress of wind to the island of Ponza,105 where they entered a little bight of the sea and there awaited an occasion for continuing their voyage.
uz: Ammo u ko'zlaganidek bo'lmadi; chunki Neapolga borishi kerak bo'lgan kema shamol ta'sirida Ponza oroliga olib ketildi, 105-yilda u yerda dengizning biroz bo'yiga kirishdi va u yerda sayohatlarini davom ettirish uchun imkoniyat kutishdi.

en: Madam Beritola, going up, like the rest, into the island and ﬁnding a remote and solitary place, addressed herself to make moan for her Ar- righetto, all alone there.
uz: Madam Beritola, qolganlar kabi orolga ko'tarilib, olis va yolg'iz joyni topib, u yerda yolg'iz qolgan Ar-righetto uchun motam tutdi.

en: This being her daily usance, it chanced one day that, as she was occupied in bewailing herself, there came up a pirate galley, unobserved of any, sailor or other, and taking them all at unawares, made off with her prize.
uz: Bu uning kundalik odati bo'lgani uchun, bir kuni u o'zini xafa qilish bilan band bo'lganida, hech kim, dengizchi yoki boshqa hech kim ko'rmagan holda qaroqchi galereyasi paydo bo'lib, ularning hammasini bexosdan olib, o'z sovrinini olib ketdi.

en: Madam Beritola, having made an end of her diurnal lamentation, returned to the seashore, as she was used to do, to visit her children, but found none there; whereat she ﬁrst marvelled and after, suddenly misdoubting her of that which had happened, cast her eyes out to sea and saw the galley at no great distance, towing the little ship after it; whereby she knew but too well that she had lost her children, as well as her husband, and seeing herself there poor and desolate and forsaken, unknowing where she should ever again ﬁnd any of them, she fell down aswoon upon the strand, calling upon her husband and her children.
uz: Xonim Beritola kunlik motamlarini tugatgach, odatdagidek, o'z bolalariga tashrif buyurish uchun dengiz sohiliga qaytdi, lekin u yerda hech kimni topmadi. U birinchi hayratda qoldi va keyin, sodir bo'lgan voqeadan birdan shubhalanib, dengizga ko'zini ko'tardi va yaqin masofada galereyani ko'rdi, kichik kemani ortidan tortdi; shu bilan u o'z farzandlarini, shuningdek, erini yo'qotganini, o'zini u yerda kambag'al, xaroba va tashlandiq, qayerdan topishini bilmay, eriga va bolalariga murojaat qilib, yerga yiqildi.

en: There was none there to recall her distracted spir- its with cold water or other remedy, wherefore they might at their leisure go wandering whither it pleased them; but, after awhile, the lost senses return- ing to her wretched body, in company with tears and lamentations, she called long upon her children and went a great while seeking them in every cavern.
uz: U yerda uning chalg'igan ruhini eslaydigan hech kim yo'q edi - sovuq suv yoki boshqa vosita bilan, shuning uchun ular dam olishlari mumkin bo'lgan joyga adashib yurishardi; lekin, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, yo'qolgan hislar uning achinarli tanasiga qaytib, ko'z yoshlari va motamlari bilan birga, u bolalariga uzoq vaqt chaqirardi va ularni har bir g'orda qidirib yurardi.

en: At last, ﬁnding all her labour in vain and seeing the night coming on, she began, hoping and knowing not what, to be careful for herself and departing the seashore, returned to the cavern where she was wont to weep and bemoan herself.
uz: Nihoyat, butun mehnatini behuda topib, tun yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib, u nimaga umid qilib ham bilmay, o'ziga ehtiyot bo'lishni boshladi va dengiz sohilini tark etib, o'zi yig'lab noliydigan g'orga qaytdi.

en: She passed the night in great fear and inexpressible dolour and the new day being come and the hour of tierce past, she was fain, constrained by hunger, for that she had not supped overnight, to browse upon herbs; and having fed as best she might, she gave herself, weeping, to various thoughts of her future life.
uz: U kechani katta qo'rquv va ifodalab bo'lmaydigan shiddat bilan o'tkazdi, yangi kun keldi va uchinchi soat o'tdi, u yengil edi, ochlikdan cheklangan edi, chunki u kechasi ovqatlanmagan edi, o'tlarni ko'zdan kechirdi; va qo'lidan kelgancha ovqatlanib, u o'zini yig'lab, kelajak hayoti haqida turli xil o'ylarga berardi.

en: Pondering thus, she saw a she-goat enter a cavern hard by and presently issue thence and betake herself into the wood; whereupon she arose and entering whereas the goat had come forth, found there two little kidlings, born belike that same day, which seemed to her the quaintest and prettiest things in the world.
uz: Shunday o'ylab, u bir echki go'rdan qattiq kirib kelganini ko'rdi va u yerdan chiqib, o'rmonga kirib ketdi; shundan so'ng u o'rnidan turib, echki chiqqanida, u yerda xuddi o'sha kuni tug'ilgan ikkita kichkina qo'zichoqni topdi, ular unga dunyodagi eng g'alati va chiroyli narsalardek tuyuldi.

en: Her milk being yet undried from her recent de- livery, she tenderly took up the kids and set them to her breast.
uz: Uning suti yaqinda quritilmaganidan keyin, u bolalarni muloyimlik bilan ko'tarib, ko'kragiga qo'ydi.

en: They re- fused not the service, but sucked her as if she had been their dam and thenceforth made no distinction between the one and the other.
uz: Ular xizmatni qayta qo'shishmadi, balki uni go'yo ularning bekasi kabi so'rishdi va bundan buyon bir-biridan farq qilishmadi.

en: Wherefore, herseeming she had found some company in that desert place, and growing no less familiar with the old goat than with her little ones, she resigned her- self to live and die there and abode eating of herbs and drinking water and weeping as often as she remembered her of her husband and children and of her past life.
uz: Shuning uchun, go'yo u o'sha cho'l joyida biror hamroh topgandek tuyuldi va keksa echki bilan o'z bolalaridan kam tanishmay, u yerda yashash va o'lish uchun o'z-o'zini taslim qildi va erini, bolalarini va o'tmish hayotini eslagan sari o'tlar yeyish, suv ichish va yig'lash bilan mashg'ul bo'ldi.

en: The gentle lady, thus grown a wild creature, abiding on this wise, it be- fell, after some months, that there came on like wise to the place whither she had aforetime been driven by stress of weather, a little vessel from Pisa and there abode some days.
uz: Mehribon xonim, shu tariqa yovvoyi maxluq bo'lib ulg'ayib, shu hikmatga amal qildi, bir necha oy o'tgach, u ilgari ob-havo zo'riqishi tufayli haydalgan joyga, Pisa shahridan kelgan kichik kemaga keldi va u yerda bir necha kun turdi.

en: On broad this bark was a gentleman named Currado [of the family] of the Marquises of Malespina, who, with his wife, a lady of worth and piety, was on his return home from a pilgrimage to all the holy places that be in the kingdom of Apulia.
uz: Umuman olganda, bu teriga Malespin markizlarining Currado ismli janoblari kirgan edi. U o'zining munosib va taqvodor xotini bilan birga Apuliya qirolligida bo'lgan barcha muqaddas joylarga ziyoratdan uyga qaytayotgan edi.

en: To pass away the time, Currado set out one day, with his lady and certain of his servants and his dogs, to go about the island, and not far from Madam Beritola’s place of harbourage, the dogs started the two kids, which were now grown pretty big, as they went grazing.
uz: Vaqtni o'tkazish uchun, Kurrado bir kuni xonimi, ba'zi xizmatkorlari va itlari bilan orol bo'ylab sayohatga chiqdi. Madam Beritolaning port joyiga yaqin joyda itlar endi ancha katta bo'lgan ikki bolani qo'rqitdi, ular o'tga qarab ketishardi.

en: The latter, chased by the dogs, ﬂed to no other place but into the cavern where was Madam Beritola, who, seeing this, star- ted to her feet and catching up a staff, beat off the dogs.
uz: Oxirgisi, itlar ta'qib qilib, boshqa joyga qochmadi, faqatgina Madam Beritola joylashgan g'orga kirdi. Buni ko'rib, u oyoqlariga o'rnashib, tayoq tutdi va itlarni urdi.

en: Currado and his wife, who came after them, seeing the lady, who was grown swart and lean and hairy, marvelled, and she yet more at them.
uz: Kurrado va uning xotini ularning orqasidan kelishdi, qizni ko'rib, qora tanli, ozg'in va tukli, hayratda edilar va u ularga yanada ko'proq qarardi.

en: But after Currado had, at her instance, called off his dogs, they prevailed with her, by dint of much entreaty, to tell them who she was and what she did there; whereupon she fully discovered to them her whole condition and all that had befallen her, together with her ﬁrm resolution [to abide alone in the island].
uz: Ammo Kurrado o'z vaqtida itlarini chaqirib olgandan so'ng, ular unga ko'p iltijolar bilan kim ekanligini va u yerda nima qilganini aytishga yordam berishdi; shundan so'ng u ularga butun ahvolini va unga tushgan hamma narsani, shuningdek, o'zining qat'iy qarorini (orolda yolg'iz qolishga) to'liq oshkor qildi.

en: Currado, who had know Arrighetto Capece very well, hearing this, wept for pity, and did his utmost to divert her with words from so barbarous a purpose, offering to carry her back to her own house or to keep her with himself, holding her in such honour as his sister, until God should send her happier fortune.
uz: Kurrado, Arrighetto Kepetseni juda yaxshi bilgan edi, buni eshitib, achinish uchun yig'ladi va uni shunday vahshiyona maqsaddan so'zlar bilan chalg'itishga harakat qildi, uni o'z uyiga olib ketishni yoki o'zi bilan saqlab qolishni taklif qildi, Xudo unga baxtliroq boylik yubormaguncha, uni singlisi kabi hurmat bilan ushlab turdi.

en: The lady not yielding to these proffers, Currado left his wife with her, bidding the latter cause bring thither to eat and clothe the lady, who was all in rags, with some of her own apparel, and charging her contrive, by whatsoever means, to bring her away with her.
uz: Xonim bu payg'ambarlarga taslim bo'lmay, Kurrado xotini bilan qoldirdi va oxirgi xonimni u yerga olib kelishni buyurdi, u yerda hamma narsa latta bo'lgan, o'z kiyimlari bilan kiyintirilgan xonimni yeydi va uni o'zi bilan olib ketish uchun har qanday usul bilan uni o'ylab topishga majbur qildi.

en: Accordingly, the gentle lady, being left with Madam Beritola, after condoling with her amain of her misfortunes, sent for raiment and victual and prevailed on her, with all the pains in the world, to don the one and eat the other.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, muloyim xonim, Madam Beritola bilan qolgan holda, uning baxtsiz hodisalariga ta'ziya qilib, kiyim-kechak va qurbonlik so'rab yubordi va dunyodagi barcha azoblar bilan uni birini kiydirib, ikkinchisini yeyishga majbur qildi.

en: Ultimately, after many prayers, Madam Beritola protesting that she would never consent to go whereas she might be known, she persuaded her to go with her into Lunigiana, together with the two kids and their dam, which latter were meantime returned and had greeted her with the utmost fondness, to the no small wonderment of the gentlewoman.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, ko'p duolardan so'ng, Madam Beritola o'zini hech qachon tanilgan joyga borishga rozi bo'lmasligini e'tiroz bildirgan holda, uni ikki bolasi va ularning uyi bilan birga Lunigianaga borishga ko'ndirdi, ular shu vaqt ichida qaytib kelishdi va uni eng katta mehr bilan kutib olishdi, bu ayolning hech qanday hayratlanishiga sabab bo'lmas edi.

en: Accordingly, as soon as fair weather was come, Madam Beritola embarked with Currado and his lady in their vessel, carrying with her the two kids and the she-goat (on whose account, her name being everywhere unknown, she was styled Cavriuola106) and setting sail with a fair wind, came speedily to the mouth of the Magra,107 where they landed and went up to Currado’s castle.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ob-havo yaxshi bo'lishi bilanoq, Madam Beritola Kurrado va uning xonimi bilan birga kemaga chiqdi, ikki bolasi va echkini (uning hisobi bo'yicha, uning ismi hamma joyda noma'lum, u Cavriuola 106 deb nomlangan) olib, yaxshi shamol bilan suzib, tezda Magra 107 og'ziga keldi, u yerda ular qo'ndilar va Kurrado qasriga ko'tarildilar.

en: There Madam Beritola abode, in a widow’s habit, about the person of Currado’s lady, as one of her waiting-women, humble, modest and obedient, still cher- ishing her kids and letting nourish them.
uz: U yerda xonim Beritola, bevalik odatida, Kurrado xonimning shaxsi haqida, uning kutgan ayollaridan biri sifatida yashardi - kamtar, kamtar va itoatkor, hali ham bolalarini qadrlab, ularga oziqlantirishga ruxsat berardi.

en: Meanwhile, the corsairs, who had taken the ship wherein Madam Berit- ola came to Ponza, but had left herself, as being unseen of them, betook themselves with all the other folk to Genoa, where, the booty coming to be shared among the owners of the galley, it chanced that the nurse and the two children fell, amongst other things, to the lot of a certain Messer Guaspar- rino d’Oria,108 who sent them all three to his mansion, to be there employed as slaves about the service of the house.
uz: Ayni paytda, Madam Berit-ola Ponzaga kelgan kemani olgan, lekin o'zini ulardan g'oyibona qoldirgan kursajchilar, boshqa odamlar bilan birga Genuyaga yo'l olishdi. U yerda, galley egalari o'rtasida bo'lish uchun kelayotgan o'lja, hamshira va ikki bola boshqa narsalar qatorida, ularning barchasini uy xizmatida qul bo'lib ishlash uchun uyiga jo'natgan bir certain Messer Guaspar- Ino dOria 108 ga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The nurse, afﬂicted beyond meas- ure at the loss of her mistress and at the wretched condition where into she found herself and the two children fallen, wept long and sore; but, for that, albeit a poor woman, she was discreet and well-advised, when she saw that tears availed nothing and that she was become a slave together with them, she ﬁrst comforted herself as best she might and after, considering whither they were come, she bethought herself that, should the two children be
uz: Hamshira, xo'jayinasining yo'qolishi va o'zi va ikki bolasi qulagan bechora ahvoldan cheksiz azob chekib, uzoq va achchiq yig'ladi; lekin, kambag'al ayol bo'lishiga qaramay, u ehtiyotkor va yaxshi maslahatli edi, ko'z yoshlari hech narsaga foyda bermasligini va ular bilan birga qul bo'lib qolganini ko'rgach, avval o'zini iloji boricha ovutdi va keyin, ular qayerga kelganini o'ylab, o'ziga shunday deb o'yladi:

en: known, they might lightly chance to suffer hindrance; wherefore, hoping withal that, sooner or later fortune might change and they, an they lived, re- gain their lost estate, she resolved to discover to no one who they were, un- til she should see occasion therefor, and told all who asked her thereof that they were her sons.
uz: Ma'lumki, ular yengilgina to'siqga duch kelishlari mumkin edi; shuning uchun, erta yoki kech omad o'zgarishi va ular yashasalar, yo'qolgan mulkini qaytarib olishlariga umid qilib, u hech kimga ularning kimligini topishga qaror qildi, toki u bunga imkoniyat ko'rmaguncha va undan so'raganlarning barchasiga ularning o'g'illari ekanligini aytdi.

en: The elder she named, not Giusfredi, but Giannotto di Procida (the name of the younger she cared not to change), and explained to him, with the utmost diligence, why she had changed his name, showing him in what peril he might be, an he were known.
uz: U keksa odamni Giusfredi deb emas, balki Giannotto di Procida deb atadi (uning o'zgarmasligiga e'tibor qaratgan kichkintoyning ismi), va unga nima uchun uning ismini o'zgartirganini, u qanday xavf ostida ekanligini ko'rsatib, u nima ekanligi haqida eng ko'p harakat bilan tushuntirdi.

en: This she set out to him not once, but many and many a time, and the boy, who was quick of wit, punctually obeyed the enjoinment of his discreet nurse.
uz: Bu gapni u unga bir marta emas, balki ko'p va ko'p marta aytdi, va o'tkir bo'lgan bola o'zining ehtiyotkor hamshirasining buyrug'iga o'z vaqtida itoat qildi.

en: Accordingly, the two boys and their nurse abode patiently in Messer Guasparrino’s house several years, ill-clad and worse shod and employed about the meanest ofﬁces.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ikki o'g'il bola va ularning hamshirasi bir necha yil davomida Messer Guasparrinoning uyida bemalol, yomon kiyimda va eng xunuk lavozimlarda ish bilan band bo'lishdi.

en: But Giannotto, who was now sixteen years of age, and had more spirit than pertained to a slave, scorning the baseness of a menial condition, embarked on board certain galleys bound for Alexan- dria and taking leave of Messer Guasparrino’s service, journeyed to divers parts, without any wise availing to advance himself.
uz: Ammo Giannotto, endi o'n olti yoshda edi va qulga xos bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq ruhga ega edi, past darajadagi ahvolning tubanligini mensimay, Alexan-driaga bog'langan ayrim galerelarga chiqdi va Messer Guasparrinoning xizmatidan ketdi, turli joylarga sayohat qildi, o'zini oldinga siljitishga hech qanday oqilona imkoniyat topmadi.

en: At last some three or four years after his departure from Genoa, being grown a handsome youth and tall of his person and hearing that his father, whom he thought dead, was yet alive, but was kept by King Charles in prison and duresse, he went wandering at a venture, well nigh despairing of fortune, till he came to Lunigiana and there, as chance would have it, took service with Currado Malespina, whom he served with great aptitude and acceptance.
uz: Nihoyat, Genovadan ketganidan keyin uch-to'rt yil o'tib, chiroyli yosh va o'ziga xos bo'yli bo'lib, o'zi o'lgan deb o'ylagan otasining hali tirik ekanligini eshitib, qamoqda va zo'ravonlikda qirol Charlz tomonidan saqlanayotganini eshitib, u omaddan umidsiz bo'lib, sayohatga ketdi, toki u Lunigianaga keldi va u yerda, imkoniyat bo'lsa, katta salohiyat va qabul bilan xizmat qilgan Kurrado Malespin bilan xizmat qildi.

en: And albeit he now and again saw his mother, who was with Currado’s lady, he never recognized her nor she him, so much had time changed the one and the oth- er from that which they were used to be, whenas they last set eyes on each other.
uz: Va garchi u vaqti-vaqti bilan Currado xonimi bilan birga bo'lgan onasini ko'rsa ham, u uni ham, uni ham hech qachon tanimadi, vaqt o'tgach, ular bir-birlariga ko'z tashlaganlarida, odatdagidek bo'lishgan narsalardan bir-birini ham o'zgartirdi.

en: Giannotto being, then, in Currado’s service, it befell that a daughter of the latter, by name Spina, being left the widow of one Niccolo da Grignano, returned to her father’s house and being very fair and agreeable and a girl of little more than sixteen years of age, chanced to cast eyes on Giannotto and he on her, and they became passionately enamoured of each other.
uz: Shunday qilib, Giannotto Kurrado xizmatida bo'lgani uchun, uning Spina ismli qizi bir Nikolo da Grignanoning bevasasi bo'lib, otasining uyiga qaytib keldi va juda go'zal va xushmuomala bo'lib, o'n olti yoshdan oshgan qiz Giannottoga va unga ko'z tashlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldi va ular bir-birlariga ishtiyoq bilan oshiq bo'lishdi.

en: Their love was not long without effect and lasted several months ere any was ware thereof.
uz: Ularning muhabbati uzoq davom etmadi va bir necha oy davom etdi, shundan keyin ham hech narsa bo'lmadi.

en: Wherefore, taking overmuch assurance, they began to order themselves with less discretion than behoveth unto matters of this kind, and one day, as they went, the young lady and Giannotto together, through a fair and thickset wood, they pushed on among the trees, leaving the rest of the
uz: Shuning uchun, haddan tashqari ishonch hosil qilib, ular o'zlarini bunday masalalarda zarur bo'lganidan kamroq ehtiyotkorlik bilan tartibga solay boshladilar va bir kuni, yosh xonim va Giannotto birga ketayotganlarida, chiroyli va qalin daraxtdan o'tib, daraxtlar orasida surib, qolganlarini qoldirishdi.

en: Presently, themseeming they had far foregone the others, they laid themselves down to rest in a pleasant place, full of grass and ﬂowers and shut in with trees, and there fell to taking amorous delight one of the other.
uz: Hozirda, go'yo boshqalardan ancha oldinga o'tib ketgandek, ular o't va gullarga to'la, daraxtlar bilan yopilgan yoqimli joyga dam olish uchun yotishdi va bir-biridan shahvoniy zavq olishdi.

en: In this occupation, the greatness of their delight making the time seem brief to them, albeit they had been there a great while, they were surprised, ﬁrst by the girl’s mother and after by Currado, who, chagrined beyond measure at this sight, without saying aught of the cause, had them both seized by three of his serving-men and carried in bonds to a castle of his and went off, boiling with rage and despite and resolved to put them both to a shameful death.
uz: Bu mashg'ulotda, ularning zavqining ulug'ligi ularga qisqa tuyuldi, garchi ular u yerda ancha vaqt bo'lishgan bo'lsalar ham, ular avval qizning onasi, keyin esa Kurrado tomonidan hayratda qolishdi. Currado bu ko'rishda haddan tashqari g'azablanib, hech qanday sababni aytmasdan, ularning ikkalasi ham o'z xizmatkorlaridan uch kishiga qo'lga olinib, o'z qal'asiga bog'lab olib ketishdi va g'azab bilan qaynab ketishdi va baribir ikkalasi ham sharmandali o'limga mahkum etishga qaror qilishdi.

en: The girl’s mother, although sore incensed and holding her daughter worthy of the severest punishment for her default, having by cer- tain words of Currado apprehended his intent towards the culprits and un- able to brook this, hastened after her enraged husband and began to beseech him that it would please him not run madly to make himself in his old age the murderer of his own daughter and to soil his hands with the blood of one of his servants, but to ﬁnd other means of satisfying his wrath, such as to clap them in prison and there let them pine and bewail the fault commit- ted.
uz: Qizning onasi, garchi jahli chiqqan bo'lsa-da va qizini o'zining kamchiliklari uchun eng og'ir jazoga loyiq deb hisoblagan bo'lsa-da, Kurradoning aniq so'zlari bilan aybdorlarga nisbatan niyatini anglab yetib, bunga qodir bo'lmagani sababli, g'azablangan eridan keyin shoshilib, unga o'zini keksaligida o'z qizining qotilisi qilib qo'ymaslik va qo'llarini xizmatkorlaridan birining qoni bilan bulg'amaslikni, balki uning g'azabini qondirishning boshqa yo'llarini topishni iltimos qila boshladi, masalan, ularni qamoqxonada urish va u yerda aybdor bo'lishga ruxsat berish.

en: With these and many other words the pious lady so wrought upon him that she turned his mind from putting them to death and he bade imprison them, each in a place apart, where they should be well guarded and kept with scant victual and much unease, till such time as he should determine farther of them.
uz: Shu va boshqa ko'plab so'zlar bilan dindor xonim unga shunchalik ta'sir qildi, ularni o'ldirishdan ko'nglini o'zgartirdi va u ularni har birini alohida joyga qamoqqa tashlashni buyurdi, u yerda ular yaxshi qo'riqlanishi va kam miqdorda zarar va ko'p noqulaylik bilan saqlanishi kerak edi, toki u ulardan uzoqroq vaqt o'tgunga qadar.

en: As he bade, so was it done, and what their life was in duresse and continual tears and in fasts longer than might have behoved unto them, each may picture to himself.
uz: U buyurganidek, shunday bo'ldi va ularning hayoti azob-uqubat, doimiy ko'z yoshlar va ro'zalarda bo'lgani, har kim o'ziga ko'ra ko'proq vaqt o'tkazishi mumkin edi.

en: What while Giannotto and Spina abode in this doleful case and had therein already abidden a year’s space, unremembered of Currado, it came to pass that King Pedro of Arragon, by the procurement of Messer Gian di Procida, raised the island of Sicily against King Charles and took it from him, whereat Currado, being a Ghibelline,109 rejoiced exceedingly, Gian- notto, hearing of this from one of those who had him in guard, heaved a great sigh and said, ‘Ah, woe is me!
uz: Giannotto va Spina shu azobli ishda qolayotgandek va u yerda allaqachon bir yil bo'sh turganlarida, Currado eslanmagan edi, shunday bo'ldiki, Arragon qiroli Pedro, Messer Gian di Procida sotib olishi bilan, Sitsiliya orolini qirol Charlzga qarshi ko'tardi va undan oldi, Currado esa Ghibellin bo'lganligi sababli, 109 juda xursand bo'ldi, Gian esa uni qo'riqlaganlardan biridan bu haqda eshitib, katta xo'rsindi va dedi: "Oh, voy men!"

en: These fourteen years have I gone ran- ging beggarlike about the world, looking for nought other than this, which, now that it is come, so I may never again hope for weal, hath found me in a prison whence I have no hope ever to come forth, save dead.’ ‘How so?’ asked the gaoler.
uz: Bu o'n to'rt yil davomida dunyo bo'ylab yolvordek yugurib yurdim, bundan boshqa hech narsa qidirdim, endi u kelganidan keyin, endi hech qachon boylikka umid qilmasligim uchun, meni qamoqxonada topdi, undan hech qachon chiqishga umidim yo'q, faqat o'liklardan boshqa.Qanday bo'ladi? deb so'radi g'amxo'r.

en: ‘What doth that concern thee which great kings do to one another?
uz: Buyuk podshohlarning bir-biriga qilgan ishlari senga nima aloqasi bor?

en: What hast thou to do in Sicily?’ Quoth Giannotto, ‘My heart is
uz: Sitsiliyada nima qilmoqchisan? Quoth Giannotto, Mening yuragim...

en: like to burst when I remember me of that which my father erst had to do there, whom, albeit I was but a little child, when I ﬂed thence, yet do I mind me to have been lord thereof, in the lifetime of King Manfred.’ ‘And who was thy father?’ asked the gaoler.
uz: Otam avval u yerda nima qilishi kerakligini eslasam, qotib ketishga o'xshaydi. U yerdan qochganimda, men kichkina bola bo'lsam ham, qirol Manfred davrida uning xo'jayini bo'lganim esimda yo'q edi. Va otang kim edi? deb so'radi g'alati.

en: ‘My father’s name,’ answered Giannotto, ‘I may now safely make known, since I ﬁnd myself in the peril whereof I was in fear, an I discovered it.
uz: Otamning ismini,  javob berdi Giannotto,  endi bemalol e'lon qilishim mumkin, chunki men o'zimni qo'rqayotgan xavfga duch keldim va uni kashf qildim.

en: He was and is yet, an he live, called Ar- righetto Capece, and my name is, not Giannotto, but Giusfredi, and I doubt not a jot, an I were quit of this prison, but I might yet, by returning to Sicily, have very high place there.’ The honest man, without asking farther, reported Giannotto’s words, as ﬁrst he had occasion, to Currado, who, hearing this —albeit he feigned to the gaoler to make light of it —betook himself to Madam Beritola and cour- teously asked her if she had had by Arrighetto a son named Giusfredi.
uz: U tirik edi va hozir ham tirik, Ar-righetto Capece deb ataladi, va mening ismim Giannotto emas, balki Giusfredi, va men shubhasizki, men bu qamoqxonadan ozod bo'ldim, lekin men hali ham Sitsiliyaga qaytib, u yerda juda yuqori lavozimga ega bo'lishim mumkin edi." Halol odam, bundan orqaga so'ramasdan, Giannottoning so'zlarini birinchi marta eshitganidek, Kurradoga aytdi. U buni eshitib  garchi u buni yengil deb ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsa ham  o'zini Madam Beritolaga qaratdi va undan Arrighetto tomonidan Giusfredi ismli o'g'li bor-yo'qligini so'radi.

en: The lady answered, weeping, that, if the elder of her two sons were alive, he would so be called and would be two-and-twenty years old.
uz: Xonim yig'lab javob berdi, agar uning ikki o'g'lining kattasi tirik bo'lganida, u shunday atalgan bo'lardi va yigirma ikki yoshda bo'lardi.

en: Currado, hear- ing this, concluded that this must be he and bethought himself that, were it so, he might at once do a great mercy and take away his own and his daugh- ter’s shame by giving her to Giannotto to wife; wherefore, sending privily for the latter, he particularly examined him touching all his past life and ﬁnding, by very manifest tokens, that he was indeed Giusfredi, son of Ar- righetto Capece, he said to him, ‘Giannotto, thou knowest what and how great is the wrong thou hast done me in the person of my daughter, whereas, I having ever well and friendly entreated thee, it behoved thee, as a servant should, still to study and do for my honour and interest; and many there be who, hadst thou used them like as thou hast used me, would have put thee to a shameful death, the which my clemency brooked not.
uz: Kurrado, buni eshitib, bu u bo'lishi kerak deb xulosa qildi va o'zini shunday bo'lsa, u darhol katta rahm-shafqat ko'rsatib, o'zining va qizining sharmandaligini Giannottoga turmushga berib olib qo'yishi mumkin deb o'yladi; shuning uchun, oxirgi hayotini alohida tekshirib, uning butun o'tmish hayotiga tegishli ekanligini aniqladi va juda aniq belgilar bilan u haqiqatan ham Giusfredi, Ar-hetto Kabetsining o'g'li ekanligini aniqladi. U unga dedi: Giannotto, sen bilasan, mening qizim shaxsiyatida menga nima va qanchalik katta xato qilganing, garchi men senga yaxshi va do'stona iltijo qilgan bo'lsam ham, hali ham o'qish va men uchun xizmatkor bo'lish kerak edi; va ko'p odamlar, seni o'zing kabi o'ldirgandek, men ham senga uyat ko'rsatgan bo'lsam ham,

en: Now, if it be as thou tellest me, to wit, that thou art the son of a man of condition and of a noble lady, I purpose, an thou thyself be willing, to put an end to thy tribu- lations and relieving thee from the misery and duresse wherein thou abidest, to reinstate at once thine honour and mine own in their due stead.
uz: Endi, agar sen menga aytganingdek bo'lsang, ya'ni, sen ahvolli odam va olijanob ayolning o'g'lisan, men seni o'zingni maqsad qilaman, o'zingni o'z hurmatingni to'xtatishga va o'zing yashab turgan azob-uqubat va zo'ravonlikdan xalos qilishga tayyor bo'lsang, o'z sharafingni va o'zligingni darhol o'z o'rniga tikla.

en: As thou knowest, Spina, whom thou hast, though after a fashion misbeseeming both thyself and her, taken with love-liking, is a widow and her dowry is both great and good; as for her manners and her father and mother, thou knowest them, and of thy present state I say nothing.
uz: Bilasanmi, Spina, seni o'zingni ham, uni ham yomon ko'rib, sevgi bilan qabul qilgan bo'lsang ham, beva va uning mahrlari ham katta va yaxshi; uning odoblari, otasi va onasi haqida esa, ularni bilasan, va hozirgi holating haqida hech narsa demayman.

en: Wherefore, an thou will, I pur- pose that, whereas she hath unlawfully been thy mistress, she shall now lawfully become thy wife and that thou shalt abide here with me and with her, as my very son, so long as it shall please thee.’
uz: Shunday qilib, men senga shunday amr beraman: u noqonuniy ravishda xo'jayin bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, endi u qonuniy ravishda senga xotin bo'ladi va sen bu yerda men bilan birga, o'g'lim kabi, senga yoqqancha yashaysan.

en: Now prison had mortiﬁed Giannotto’s ﬂesh, but had nothing abated the generous spirit, which he derived from his noble birth, nor yet the entire af- fection he bore his mistress; and albeit he ardently desired that which Cur- rado proffered him and saw himself in the latter’s power, yet no whit did he dissemble of that which the greatness of his soul prompted him to say; wherefore he answered, ‘Currado, neither lust of lordship nor greed of gain nor other cause whatever hath ever made me lay snares, traitor-wise, for thy life or thy good.
uz: Endi qamoqxona Giannottoning tanasini o'ldirgan edi, lekin u o'zining olijanob tug'ilishidan olgan saxiy ruhini hech narsa susaytirmagan edi, na butun mehribonligini bekasiga ko'targan edi; va garchi u Cur-ROda unga taklif qilgan narsani chin dildan xohlagan va o'zini oxirgi kuchda ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, u o'z ruhining ulug'vorligi uni aytishga undaydigan hech qanday narsaga o'xshamas edi; shuning uchun u javob berdi: "Currado, na xo'jayinlik shahvati, na foyda ochko'zligi, na boshqa hech qanday sabab meni hayoting yoki sening yaxshiliging uchun tuzoq yotqtirmagan.

en: I loved and love thy daughter and still shall love her, for that I hold her worthy of my love, and if I dealt with her less than honour- ably, in the opinion of the vulgar, my sin was one which still goeth hand in hand with youth and which an you would do away, it behoveth you ﬁrst do away with youth.
uz: Men sening qizingni sevdim va sevaman va hali ham uni sevaman, chunki men uni o'z muhabbatimga loyiq deb bilaman va agar men unga kamroq hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'lsam, qo'pol odamlarning fikricha, mening gunohim hali ham yoshlik bilan birga borgan va uni yo'q qilmoqchi bo'lgan gunoh edi, uni avval yoshlik bilan yo'q qilish kerak.

en: Moreover, it is an offence which, would the old but re- member them of having been young and measure the defaults of others by their own and their own by those of others, would show less grievous than thou and many others make it; and as a friend, and not as an enemy, I com- mitted it.
uz: Qolaversa, bu shunday bir jinoyatki, agar keksa, ammo yosh bo'lganlari uchun ularni qayta a'zo qilib, boshqalarning kamchiliklarini o'zlarining kamchiliklari bilan, o'zlarining kamchiliklarini esa boshqalarning kamchiliklari bilan o'lchaganlarida, bu sen va ko'pchilikdan kamroq og'riqli bo'lardi; va do'st sifatida, dushman sifatida emas, men buni buyurgan bo'lardim.

en: This that thou profferest me I have still desired and had I thought it should be vouchsafed me, I had long since sought it; and so much the dearer will it now be to me, as my hope thereof was less.
uz: Sen menga taqdim etayotgan bu narsani men hali ham orzu qilganman va agar u menga sovg'a qilinishi kerak deb o'ylaganimda, men uni allaqachon izlagan bo'lardim; va hozir u men uchun shunchalik qadrliroq bo'ladi, chunki umidim undan kamroq edi.

en: If, then, thou have not that intent which thy words denote, feed me not with vain hope; but re- store me to prison and there torment me as thou wilt, for, so long as I love Spina, even so, for the love of her, shall I still love thee, whatsoever thou dost with me, and have thee in reverence.’ Currado, hearing this, marvelled and held him great of soul and his love fervent and tendered him therefore the dearer; wherefore, rising to his feet, he embraced him and kissed him and without more delay bade privily bring Spina thither.
uz: Agar sening so'zlaringda ko'rsatilgan niyating bo'lmasa, meni behuda umid bilan boqma; balki meni qamoqqa qaytarib, u yerda xohlaganingcha azob ber. Chunki, men Spina'ni sevganimcha, hatto uning muhabbati uchun ham seni sevaman, men bilan nimaiki qilsang ham, seni hurmat qilaman." Buni eshitgan Currado hayratda qoldi va uni katta ruhda, uning ishtiyoqi esa uni yanada aziz deb hisobladi; shuning uchun u oyoqqa turdi, uni quchoqladi va o'pdi va keyinchalik Spinasini olib kelishni xohladi.

en: Accordingly, the lady —who was grown lean and pale and weakly in prison and showed well nigh another than she was wont to be, as on like wise Giannotto another man —being come, the two lovers in Cur- rado’s presence with one consent contracted marriage according to our usance.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xonim  qamoqxonada ozg'in, oq tanli va zaif bo'lib qolgan va odatdagidan ko'ra yaqinroq ko'rsatgan  xuddi dono Giannotto kabi boshqa bir odam kabi  kelib, Cur- rado'dagi ikki oshiq bizning odatimizga ko'ra nikohga rozilik bilan kirishdi.

en: Then, after some days, during which he had let furnish the newly- married pair with all that was necessary or agreeable to them, he deemed it time to gladden their mothers with the good news and accordingly calling his lady and Cavriuola, he said to the latter, ‘What would you say, madam, an I should cause you have again your elder son as the husband of one of my daughters?’ Whereto she answered, ‘Of that I can say to you no other- what than that, could I be more beholden to you than I am, I should be so much the more so as you would have restored to me that which is dearer to
uz: Keyin, bir necha kundan so'ng, u yangi turmush qurgan juftlikni ularga kerakli yoki yoqimli bo'lgan hamma narsa bilan ta'minlashga ruxsat berganidan so'ng, u ularning onalarini xushxabar bilan xursand qilish vaqti keldi deb hisobladi va shunga ko'ra xotini va Kaviruolani chaqirib, oxirgisiga dedi: "Nima dersiz, xonim, men sizning katta o'g'lingizni yana bir qizimning eri bo'lishiga sababchi qilsammi?" U javob berdi: "Sizga bundan boshqa hech narsa ayta olmayman - bundan ko'ra, men sizdan ko'ra qarzdor bo'lishim mumkinmi, men shunchalik ko'proq bo'lardimki, siz menga qimmatroq narsani qaytargan bo'lardingiz.

en: me than mine own self; and restoring it to me on such wise as you say, you would in some measure reawaken in me my lost hope.’ With this, she held her peace, weeping, and Currado said to his lady, ‘And thou, mistress, how wouldst thou take it, were I to present thee with such a son-in-law?’ The lady replied, ‘Even a common churl, so he pleased you, would please me, let alone one of these,110 who are men of gentle birth.’ ‘Then,’ said Currado, ‘I hope, ere many days, to make you happy women in this.’ Accordingly, seeing the two young folk now restored to their former cheer, he clad them sumptuously and said to Giusfredi, ‘Were it not dear to thee, over and above thy present joyance, an thou sawest thy mother here?’ Whereto he answered, ‘I dare not ﬂatter myself that the chagrin of her un- happy chances can have left her so long alive; but, were it indeed so, it were dear to me above all,
uz: meni o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq xafa qiladi; va uni menga shunday tarzda qaytarasizki, siz aytganingizdek, siz mendan yo'qolgan umidimni qaytarib uyg'otasiz." Shu bilan u xotirjam bo'ldi, yig'lab, Currado xonimiga dedi: "Siz-chi, xonim, qanday qilib qabul qilasiz, agar men sizga bunday kuyovni taqdim etsam?" Xonim javob berdi: "Hatto oddiy bir qiz ham sizga yoqqan bo'lsa, meni xursand qiladi, faqat shulardan birortasi emas, 110 nafar yumshoq tug'ilgan erkaklardan biri." "Endi," dedi Currado, "Umid qilaman, siz bu ishda ko'p kunlar baxtli bo'lasiz." Shunga ko'ra, ikki yosh odam endi o'zlarining oldingi ko'ngillariga qaytganini ko'rib, u ularni dabdabali va jozi bilan kiydirdi.

en: more by token that methinketh I might yet, by her counsel, avail to recover great part of my estate in Sicily.’ Thereupon Cur- rado sent for both the ladies, who came and made much of the newly-wed- ded wife, no little wondering what happy inspiration it could have been that prompted Currado to such exceeding complaisance as he had shown in join- ing Giannotto with her in marriage.
uz: Menimcha, uning maslahati bilan Sitsiliyadagi mulkimning katta qismini qaytarib olishga erishishim mumkin edi. Shu zahoti Kur-Rado ikkala xonimni ham chaqirib yubordi. Ular kelib, yangi turmush qurgan xotinining ko'p qismini yig'ishdi va Curradoga u bilan turmush qurishda Giannotto kabi haddan tashqari mamnuniyat ko'rsatganidek, qanday baxtli ilhom bo'lishi mumkin edi, deb o'ylamasdan.

en: Madam Beritola, by reason of the words she had heard from Currado, began to consider Giannotto and some remembrance of the boyish lineaments of her son’s countenance being by occult virtue awakened in her, without awaiting farther explanation, she ran, open-armed, to cast herself upon his neck, nor did overabounding emotion and maternal joy suffer her to say a word; nay, they so locked up all her senses that she fell into her son’s arms, as if dead.
uz: Xonim Beritola, Kurradodan eshitgan so'zlariga ko'ra, Giannottoni va o'g'lining ko'rinishidagi o'g'il bolalik ildizlarini eslashni o'ylay boshladi, chunki ularda okkult fazilat uyg'onardi, hech qanday izoh kutmasdan, u yugurdi, ochiq qo'llar bilan o'zini uning bo'yniga tashladi, ortiqcha hissiyotlar va onalik quvonchi unga bir so'z aytishga yo'l qo'ymadi; yo'q, ular uning barcha sezgilarini shunday qulflab qo'yishdi, go'yo u o'g'lining quchog'iga yiqildi.

en: The latter, albeit he was sore amazed, remembering to have many times before seen her in that same castle and never recognized her, nevertheless knew incontinent the maternal odour and blaming himself for his past heed- lessness, received her, weeping, in his arms and kissed her tenderly.
uz: Oxirgisi, garchi u juda hayratda bo'lsa ham, avval ham uni o'sha qasrda ko'p marta ko'rganini va hech qachon tanimaganini esladi, shunga qaramay, onalik hidini bilmas edi va o'zining o'tmishdagi beparvoligi uchun o'zini ayblardi, uni yig'lab, quchog'iga oldi va mehr bilan o'pdi.

en: After awhile, Madam Beritola, being affectionately tended by Currado’s lady and Spina and plied both with cold water and other remedies, recalled her strayed senses and embracing her son anew, full of maternal tenderness, with many tears and many tender words, kissed him a thousand times, whilst he all reverently beheld and entreated her.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, Currado xonimi va Spina tomonidan mehr bilan parvarishlangan va sovuq suv va boshqa dorilar bilan siylangan Madam Beritola, o'zining adashgan his-tuyg'ularini esladi va o'g'lini yana quchoqladi, onalik mehrga to'la, ko'p yoshlar va ko'p nozik so'zlar bilan, uni ming marta o'pdi, shu bilan birga u unga hurmat bilan qaradi va yolvordi.

en: After these joyful and hon- ourable greetings had been thrice or four times repeated, to the no small contentment of the bystanders, and they had related unto each other all that had befallen them, Currado now, to the exceeding satisfaction of all, signi-
uz: Bu quvonchli va hurmatga sazovor tabriklar uch-to'rt marta takrorlanganidan so'ng, tomoshabinlarning unchalik qoniqmasligi uchun, ular bir-biriga boshlariga tushgan hamma narsani, endi Currado, hammaning juda mamnunligiga yetkazishdi.

en: ﬁed to his friends the new alliance made by him and gave ordinance for a goodly and magniﬁcent entertainment.
uz: do'stlariga o'zi tuzgan yangi ittifoqni taqdim etdi va yaxshi va ajoyib ko'ngilochar tadbirlar uchun buyruq berdi.

en: Then said Giusfredi to him, ‘Currado, you have made me glad of many things and have long honourably entertained my mother; and now, that no whit may remain undone of that which it is in your power to do, I pray you gladden my mother and bride-feast and myself with the presence of my brother, whom Messer Guasparrino d’Oria holdeth in servitude in his house and whom, as I have already told you, he took with me in one of his cruises.
uz: Shunda Giusfredi unga dedi: "Currado, sen meni ko'p narsalardan xursand qilding va onamni uzoq vaqtdan beri hurmat bilan boqding; va endi, qo'lingizdan kelgan ishlardan hech narsa qolmasligi uchun, iltimos, onamni, kelin-kelinimni va o'zimni akamning huzurida xursand qilgin, uni Messer Guasparrino d'Oria o'z uyida qullikda ushlab turadi va men senga aytganimdek, u meni o'z sayohatlaridan birida olib ketdi."

en: Moreover, I would have you send into Sicily one who shall thoroughly in- form himself of the state and condition of the country and study to learn what is come of Arrighetto, my father, an he be alive or dead, and if he be alive, in what estate; of all which having fully certiﬁed himself, let him re- turn to us.’ Giusfredi’s request was pleasing to Currado, and without any delay he despatched very discreet persons both to Genoa and to Sicily.
uz: Qolaversa, men sizdan Sitsiliyaga o'z holatini va ahvolini to'liq o'rganib, Arrighetto, otam, u tirikmi yoki o'likmi, agar tirik bo'lsa, qanday holatda ekanligini o'rganish uchun yuborishni so'rardim; o'zini to'liq tasdiqlaganidan so'ng, bizga qaytib kelsin." Giusfredi'ning so'rovi Kurradodan mamnun bo'ldi va u hech qanday kechiktirmasdan Genuyaga ham, Sitsiliyaga ham juda maxfiy odamlarni jo'natdi.

en: He who went to Genoa there sought out Messer Guasparrino and in- stantly besought him, on Currado’s part, to send him Scacciato and his nurse, orderly recounting to him all his lord’s dealings with Giusfredi and his mother.
uz: U yerda Genuaga borgan odam Ser Guasparrinoni qidirdi va darhol undan, Kurrado tomonidan, Scacciato va uning hamshirasini yuborishni so'radi, unga xo'jayinining Giusfredi va onasi bilan qilgan barcha ishlarini tartibli tarzda aytib berdi.

en: Messer Guasparrino marvelled exceedingly to hear this and said, ‘True is it I would do all I may to pleasure Currado, and I have, in- deed, these fourteen years had in my house the boy thou seekest and one his mother, both of whom I will gladly send him; but do thou bid him, on my part, beware of lending overmuch credence to the fables of Giannotto, who nowadays styleth himself Giusfredi, for that he is a far greater knave than he deemeth.’ So saying, he caused honourably entertain the gentleman and sending privily for the nurse, questioned her shrewdly touching the matter.
uz: Janob Guasparrino buni eshitib juda hayratda qoldi va dedi: Rostmi, men Kurradoni xursand qilish uchun qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qilardim, va aslida, shu o'n to'rt yil davomida uyimda sen qidirayotgan bola va uning onasi bor edi, ularni ikkalasi ham xursandchilik bilan jo'nataman; lekin men esa unga Giannottoning ertaklariga haddan tashqari ishonishdan ehtiyot bo'lishni buyuraman, u hozir o'zini Giusfredi deb ataydi, chunki u undan ancha katta qo'lqopdir. Shunday qilib, u janobni hurmat bilan o'ynatdi va hamshirani jo'natdi, uni bu masalaga nisbatan donolik bilan so'roq qildi.

en: Now she had heard of the Sicilian revolt and understood Arrighetto to be alive, wherefore, casting off her former fears, she told him everything in or- der and showed him the reasons that had moved her to do as she had done.
uz: Endi u Sitsiliya isyonini eshitgan edi va Arrigettoni tirik ekanligini tushunardi, shuning uchun o'zining avvalgi qo'rquvlarini tashlab, unga hamma narsani aytib berdi va uni qilgan ishini qilishga undaydigan sabablarni ko'rsatdi.

en: Messer Guasparrino, ﬁnding her tale to accord perfectly with that of Cur- rado’s messenger, began to give credit to the latter’s words and having by one means and another, like a very astute man as he was, made enquiry of the matter and happening hourly upon things that gave him more and more assurance of the fact, took shame to himself of his mean usage of the lad, in amends whereof, knowing what Arrighetto had been and was, he gave him to wife a fair young daughter of his, eleven years of age, with a great dowry.
uz: Ser Guasparrino o'z hikoyasini Kur- rado'ning elchisi bilan mukammal mos keladigan qilib topib, uning so'zlariga ishonishni boshladi va o'zi kabi juda dono odam kabi bu masalani so'roq qilib, unga haqiqatga tobora ko'proq ishonch beradigan narsalar haqida soat sayin gapirib, o'ziga xijolat bo'ldi, shu sababli Arrighetto nima bo'lganini va nima bo'lganini bilgan holda, unga o'zining o'n bir yoshli qizini katta marh bilan xotinlikka berdi.

en: Then, after making a great bride-feast thereon, he embarked with the boy and girl and Currado’s messenger and the nurse in a well-armed galliot and
uz: Keyin, u yerda ajoyib kelin ziyofatini o'tkazgach, u o'g'il va qiz, Kurrado'ning elchisi va hamshirasi bilan yaxshi qurollangan galliotga chiqdi va

en: betook himself to Lerici, where he was received by Currado and went up, with all his company, to one of the latter’s castles, not far removed thence, where there was a great banquet toward.
uz: O'zini Lericiga olib bordi, u yerda uni Kurrado qabul qildi va butun kompaniyasi bilan birga u yerdan uncha uzoqda bo'lmagan, katta ziyofat bo'lib o'tadigan oxirgilarning qasrlaridan biriga ko'tarildi.

en: The mother’s joy at seeing her son again and that of the two brothers in each other and of all three in the faithful nurse, the honour done of all to Messer Guasparrino and his daughter and of him to all and the rejoicing of all together with Currado and his lady and children and friends, no words might avail to express; wherefore, ladies, I leave it to you to imagine.
uz: O'g'lini yana ko'rgan onaning quvonchi va bir-biridagi ikki aka-ukalarning quvonchi hamda sadoqatli hamshiraning quvonchi, mehribon Guasparrinoning, uning qizi va uning o'ziga bo'lgan barcha hurmat va Currado hamda uning xonim, bolalari va do'stlari bilan birga bo'lgan barcha xursandchilikni ifodalashga hech qanday so'z yetmaydi; shuning uchun, xonimlar, buni tasavvur qilishingizga qoldiraman.

en: Thereunto,111 that it might be complete, it pleased God the Most High, a most abundant giver, whenas He beginneth, to add the glad news of the life and well-being of Arrighetto Capece; for that, the feast being at its height and the guests, both ladies and men, yet at table for the ﬁrst service, there came he who had been sent into Sicily and amongst other things, reported of Arrighetto that he, being kept in captivity by King Charles, whenas the revolt against the latter broke out in the land, the folk ran in a fury to the prison and slaying his guards, delivered himself and as a capital enemy of King Charles, made him their captain and followed him to expel and slay the French: wherefore he was become in especial favour with King Pedro,112 who had reinstated him in all his honours and possessions, and was now in great good case.
uz: Shunday qilib, 111, bu to'liq bo'lishi uchun, Oliy Xudo, eng mo'l-ko'l sovg'a, Arrighetto Kepetsening hayoti va farovonligi haqidagi xushxabarni qo'shishni boshlaganida, uni mamnuniyat bilan qabul qildi; chunki, bayram o'z cho'qqisida va mehmonlar, ham ayollar, ham erkaklar, birinchi xizmat uchun stol ustida turganida, Sitsiliyaga yuborilgan va boshqa narsalar bilan birga, Arrighetto haqida xabar berdi, u qirol Charlz tomonidan asirlikda saqlanib qolgan edi, qachonki qirolga qarshi qo'zg'olon mamlakatda boshlandi, xalq qamoqxonaga g'azab bilan yugurdi va uning qo'riqchilarini o'ldirdi, o'zini va qirol Charlzning asosiy dushmani sifatida topshirishdi va unga ergashib, uni quvdi va fransuzlarni o'ldirdi: shuning uchun u qirol Pedro bilan birga bo'ldi, u uning barcha sharafini saqladi va hozirda katta edi.

en: The messenger added that he had received himself with the utmost honour and had rejoiced with inexpressible joy in the recovery of his wife and son, of whom he had heard nothing since his capture; moreover, he had sent a brigantine for them, with divers gentlemen aboard, who came after him.
uz: Xabarchi o'zini eng katta sharaf bilan qabul qilganini va asirga olinganidan beri hech narsa eshitmagan xotini va o'g'lining sog'ayganidan ifodalab bo'lmaydigan quvonch bilan xursand bo'lganini qo'shimcha qildi; bundan tashqari, u ularga brigantin yuborgan edi, uning orqasidan kelgan turli janoblar bilan birga.

en: The messenger was received and hearkened with great gladness and re- joicing, whilst Currado, with certain of his friends, set out incontinent to meet the gentlemen who came for Madam Beritola and Giusfredi and wel- coming them joyously, introduced them into his banquet, which was not yet half ended.
uz: Xabarchi katta quvonch va quvonch bilan qabul qilindi va tinglandi, Kurrado esa o'zining ba'zi do'stlari bilan Madam Beritola va Giusfredi uchun kelgan janoblar bilan uchrashishga shoshilmasdan yo'lga chiqdi va ularni quvonch bilan kutib oldi, ularni o'zining to'yinga kiritdi, bu to'y hali yarim tugamadi.

en: There both the lady and Giusfredi, no less than all the others, beheld them with such joyance that never was heard the like; and the gen- tlemen, ere they sat down to meat, saluted Currado and his lady on the part of Arrighetto, thanking them, as best they knew and might, for the honour done both to his wife and his son and offering himself to their pleasure,113 in all that lay in his power.
uz: U yerda xonim ham, Giusfredi ham, boshqalardan kam bo'lmagan darajada, ularga hech qachon eshitilmagan quvonch bilan qaradi; va janoblar, ovqatga o'tirishlaridan oldin, Arrighetto tomonida Kurrado va uning xonimiga salom berishdi, ularga xotin va o'g'liga qilingan hurmat va o'zini ularning roziligiga bag'ishlaganliklari uchun, o'zlari bilgancha va kuchlaricha minnatdorchilik bildirishdi, 113.

en: Then, turning to Messer Guasparrino, whose kindness was unlooked for, they avouched themselves most certain that, whenas that which he had done for Scacciato should be known of Ar- righetto, the like thanks and yet greater would be rendered him.
uz: Keyin, mehribonligi unchalik ko'z yumilmagan Messer Guasparrinoning oldiga murojaat qilib, ular Scacciato uchun qilgan ishi Ar-righetto haqida ma'lum bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa, unga shunga o'xshash va undan ham kattaroq minnatdorchiliklar berilishiga juda amin bo'lishdi.

en: Thereafter they banqueted right joyously with the new-made bride- grooms at the bride-feast of the two newly-wedded wives; nor that day alone did Currado entertain his son-in-law and other his kinsmen and friends, but many others.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular yangi kelin- Kuyovlar bilan yangi turmush qurgan ikki xotinning kelin-tomonida xursandchilik bilan ziyofat qilishdi; o'sha kunning o'zida Kurrado o'z kuyovi va boshqa qarindoshlari va do'stlarini, balki ko'plab boshqalarni ham ko'z-ko'z qilmadi.

en: As soon as the rejoicings were somewhat abated, it appearing to Madam Beritola and to Giusfredi and the others that it was time to depart, they took leave with many tears of Currado and his lady and Messer Guasparrino and embarked on board the brigantine, carrying Spina with them; then, setting sail with a fair wind, they came speedily to Sicily, where all alike, both sons and daughters-in-law, were received by Ar- righetto in Palermo with such rejoicing as might never be told; and there it is believed that they all lived happily a great while after, in love and thank- fulness to God the Most High, as mindful of the beneﬁts received.”
uz: Xursandchilik biroz susayishi bilanoq, Madam Beritola va Giusfredi va boshqalarga ketish vaqti kelganini ko'rishlari bilan, ular Currado va uning xonimi va Messer Guasparrinoning ko'p ko'z yoshlari bilan xayrlashdilar va brigantin kemasiga chiqdilar, ular bilan Spina; so'ngra, yengil shamol bilan suzib, ular tezda Sitsiliyaga kelishdi, u yerda hammasi bir xilda, o'g'illari ham kelinlari ham, Ar- righetto tomonidan Palermoda hech qachon aytib bo'lmaydigan xursandchilik bilan qabul qilindi; va ularning barchasi eng yuqori Xudoga bo'lgan muhabbat va minnatdorchilik bilan, olingan foydalarni eslab, uzoq vaqt baxtli hayot kechirgan deb ishonishadi.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY The Soldan of Babylon sendeth a daughter of his to be married to the King of Algarve, and she, by divers chances, in the space of four years cometh to the hands of nine men in various places.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Bobil askari o'z qizini Algarve qiroliga turmushga chiqaradi va u, turli tasodiflar bilan, to'rt yil ichida turli joylarda to'qqiz kishining qo'liga keladi.

en: Ultimately, being restored to her father for a maid, she goeth to the King of Algarve to wife, as ﬁrst she did.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, xizmatkor sifatida otasiga qaytarilgan holda, u avvalgidek Algarve qiroliga xotinlikka boradi.

en: Had Emilia’s story been much longer protracted, it is like the compassion had by the young ladies on the misfortunes of Madam Beritola would have brought them to tears; but, an end being now made thereof, it pleased the queen that Pamﬁlo should follow on with his story, and accordingly he, who was very obedient, began thus, “Uneath, charming ladies, is it for us to know that which is meet for us, for that, as may oftentimes have been seen, many, imagining that, were they but rich, they might avail to live without care and secure, have not only with prayers sought riches of God, but have diligently studied to acquire them, grudging no toil and no peril in the quest, and who —whereas, before they became enriched, they loved their lives — once having gotten their desire, have found folk to slay them, for greed of so ample an inheritance.
uz: Agar Emilia hikoyasi ancha cho'zilganida edi, go'yo yosh xonimlarning Madam Beritola baxtsizligiga bo'lgan rahm-shafqati ularni yoshga to'ldirgan bo'lardi; lekin, endi bu haqda gap tugagach, Pamfilo o'z hikoyasini davom ettirishini ma'qul ko'rdi va shunga ko'ra u, juda itoatkor bo'lgan holda, shunday boshladi: "Yana, jozibali xonimlar, bizga nima mos kelishini bilish kerakmi, chunki, ko'p hollarda ko'rilganidek, ko'pchilik, agar ular boy bo'lsalar ham, xavfsiz va xavfsiz hayot kechirishlari mumkin deb o'ylashardi, faqatgina ibodatlar bilan emas, balki ularni qo'lga kiritish uchun astoydil o'rganishgan, hech qayerga emas va hech qanday xavf yo'q edi, va  chunki, ular o'z hayotlarini boyitish uchun, bir vaqtlar o'z hayotlarini boyitib,

en: Others of low estate, having, through a thousand perilous battles and the blood of their brethren and their friends, mounted to the summit of kingdoms, thinking in the royal estate to enjoy supreme feli- city, without the innumerable cares and alarms whereof they see and feel it full, have learned, at the cost of their lives, that poison is drunken at royal tables in cups of gold.
uz: Boshqa quyi mulk egalari, mingta xavfli janglar va birodarlarining va do'stlarining qonidan so'ng, qirollik cho'qqisiga chiqqan holda, oliy baxtli shahardan bahramand bo'lishni o'ylab, ular ko'rgan va to'lgan son-sanoqsiz tashvishlar va vahimalarsiz, oltin stakanlarda qirollik stollarida zahar ichilishini o'z hayotlari evaziga bilib olishdi.

en: Many there be who have with most ardent appetite desired bodily strength and beauty and divers personal adornments and per- ceived not that they had desired ill till they found these very gifts a cause to them of death or dolorous life.
uz: Ko'pchilik insonlar tana mustahkamligi, go'zalligi va turli xil shaxsiy bezaklarni eng katta ishtiyoq bilan istashgan va o'zlarining yomon niyatlarini qabul qilmaganlar, toki aynan shu sovg'alarni o'lim yoki azobli hayot uchun sabab deb topmagunlaricha.

en: In ﬁne, not to speak particularly of all the objects of human desire, I dare say that there is not one which can, with en- tire assurance, be chosen by mortal men as secure from the vicissitudes of
uz: Xullas, insoniy istakning barcha ob'ektlari haqida alohida gapirmasa ham bo'ladi, men shuni aytishga jur'at etamanki, u hech kim yo'qki, charchagan ishonch bilan, o'luvchi odamlar tomonidan o'zgarishlardan xavfsiz deb tanlanishi mumkin.

en: fortune; wherefore, an we would do aright, needs must we resign ourselves to take and possess that which is appointed us of Him who alone knoweth that which behoveth unto us and is able to give it to us.
uz: Omad; shuning uchun, agar biz to'g'ri ish qilmoqchi bo'lsak, muhtoj bo'lsak, bizga kerak bo'lgan narsani faqat bizga kerakligini biladigan va bizga bera oladigan Zot tomonidan tayinlangan narsani olish va egallash uchun o'zimizni taslim qilishimiz kerak.

en: But for that, where- as men sin in desiring various things, you, gracious ladies, sin, above all, in one, to wit, in wishing to be fair —insomuch that, not content with the charms vouchsafed you by nature, you still with marvellous art study to augment them —it pleaseth me to recount to you how ill-fortunedly fair was a Saracen lady, whom it befell, for her beauty, to be in some four years’ space nine times wedded anew.
uz: Lekin buning uchun, odamlar turli xil narsalarni istashda gunoh qilganlarida, siz, hurmatli xonimlar, avvalo, birida, ya'ni, adolatli bo'lishni istashda gunoh qilasiz  shundayki, tabiat sizga bergan jozibalarga qoniqmay, ularni kengaytirish uchun ajoyib san'at darajasini o'rganasiz  menga sizga Saracen xonimining naqadar baxtsiz adolatli ekanligini aytib berish yoqadi, uning go'zalligi uchun to'rt yil ichida to'qqiz marta to'y qilish kerak edi.

en: It is now a pretty while since there was a certain Soldan of Babylon,114 by name Berminedab, to whom in his day many things happened in accord- ance with his pleasure.115 Amongst many other children, both male and fe- male, he had a daughter called Alatiel, who, by report of all who saw her, was the fairest woman to be seen in the world in those days, and having, in a great defeat he had inﬂicted upon a vast multitude of Arabs who were come upon him, been wonder-well seconded by the King of Algarve,116 had, at his request, given her to him to wife, of especial favour; wherefore, embarking her aboard a ship well armed and equipped, with an honourable company of men and ladies and store of rich and sumptuous gear and fur- niture, he despatched her to him, commending her to God.
uz: Hozir juda ko'p vaqt bo'ldi, chunki Bobil askari bor edi, Berminedab nomli 114 kishi, uning davrida ko'p narsalar uning xohishiga ko'ra sodir bo'lgan. 115 Uning ko'plab boshqa bolalari orasida, erkak va erkak, Alatiel ismli qizi bor edi. U uni ko'rganlarning barchasining xabar berishicha, o'sha davrda dunyodagi eng go'zal ayol edi va katta mag'lubiyatda unga kelgan arablarning ulkan olomonini Algarve shohi tomonidan ajoyib tarzda qo'llab-quvvatlagan edi. 116. Uning iltimosiga ko'ra, uni alohida xotinlikka bergan edi. Shuning uchun, uni yaxshi qurollangan va jihozlangan kemaga, boy va xonimlar va boy va do'konlar bilan birga, uni Xudoga yuborib,

en: The sailors, seeing the weather favourable, gave their sails to the wind and departing the port of Alexandria, fared on prosperously many days, and having now passed Sardinia, deemed themselves near the end of their voy- age, when there arose one day of a sudden divers contrary winds, which, being each beyond measure boisterous, so harassed the ship, wherein was the lady, and the sailors, that the latter more than once gave themselves over for lost.
uz: Dengizchilar, ob-havo qulayligini ko'rib, yelkanlarini shamolga topshirdilar va Iskandariya portidan jo'nab ketishdi, ko'p kunlar bemalol yo'lga chiqdilar va Sardiniyadan o'tib, o'zlarini o'z yoshlarining oxiriga yaqin deb hisobladilar. Bir kuni to'satdan bir-biriga zid shamollar paydo bo'ldi, ularning har biri haddan tashqari shovqinli bo'lgani uchun, xonim va dengizchilar bo'lgan kemani shunday bezovta qildilar, ularning oxirgilari bir necha marta o'zlarini yo'qotilgandek his qildilar.

en: However, like valiant men, using every art and means in their power, they rode it out two days, though buffeted by a terrible sea; but, at nightfall of the third day, the tempest abating not, nay, waxing momently, they felt the ship open, being then not far off Majorca, but knowing not where they were neither availing to apprehend it either by nautical reckon- ing or by sight, for that the sky was altogether obscured by clouds and dark night; wherefore, seeing no other way of escape and having each himself in mind and not others, they lowered a shallop into the water, into which the ofﬁcers cast themselves, choosing rather to trust themselves thereto than to the leaking ship.
uz: Ammo, jasur erkaklar kabi, qo'llaridagi har qanday san'at va vositalardan foydalanib, ular uni ikki kun davomida haydashdi, garchi dahshatli dengiz bilan to'ldirilgan bo'lsalar ham; lekin, uchinchi kunning kechasi bo'ron tinchlanmay, balki bir zumda kuchayib, kemani ochiq his qilishdi, o'shanda Mallorca'dan uncha uzoqda emas edilar, lekin qayerga borayotganlarini bilishmadi, na dengiz hisobi bilan, na ko'rish orqali, chunki osmon butunlay bulutlar va qorong'u tun bilan qoplangan edi; shuning uchun, qochishning boshqa yo'lini ko'rmay, o'zini va boshqalarni o'ylab, ofitserlar o'zlarini suvga tashlashdi, unga o'zlarini ishonishni afzal ko'rishdi.

en: The rest of the men in the ship crowded after them into the boat, albeit those who had ﬁrst embarked therein opposed it, knife in
uz: Kema ichidagi qolgan odamlar ularning orqasidan qayiqqa to'planishdi, garchi u yerga birinchi bo'lib chiqqanlar unga qarshi chiqishgan bo'lsalar ham, pichoq bilan.

en: hand —and thinking thus to ﬂee from death, ran straight into it, for that the boat, availing not, for the intemperance of the weather, to hold so many, foundered and they perished one and all.
uz: qo'l  va shu tariqa o'limdan qochishni o'ylab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri unga yugurdi, chunki qayiq, ob-havoning chidamsizligi tufayli ko'pchilikni ushlab turishga qodir bo'lmagani uchun, qulab ketdi va ular hammasi halok bo'ldi.

en: As for the ship, being driven by a furious wind and running very swiftly, albeit it was now well nigh waterlogged, (none being left on board save the princess and her women, who all, overcome by the tempestuous sea and by fear, lay about the decks as they were dead), it stranded upon a beach of the island of Majorca and such and so great was the shock that it well nigh bur- ied itself in the sand some stone’s cast from the shore, where it abode the night, beaten by the waves, nor might the wind avail to stir it more.
uz: Kema esa, g'azablangan shamol tomonidan haydalgan va juda tez yugurgan bo'lsa-da, garchi hozir suvga yaqin bo'lsa-da, (krinkessadan va uning ayollaridan boshqa hech kim kemada qolmagan edi, ular hammasi bo'ronli dengiz va qo'rquv tufayli o'likdek taxtalarda yotardi), u Mallorca orolining sohilida qolib ketdi va shunchalik katta edi-ki, u qirg'oqqa deyarli ko'mildi - u tun bo'yi tunab yotgan, to'lqinlar urgan, shamol ham uni ko'tarishga qodir emas edi.

en: Broad day came and the tempest somewhat abating, the princess, who was half dead, raised her head and weak as she was, fell to calling now one, now an- other of her household, but to no purpose, for that those she called were too far distant.
uz: Kun yor bo'ldi va bo'ron biroz susaydi, yarim o'lik bo'lgan malika boshini ko'tardi va o'zi kabi zaif edi, u uyidagilarni bir-biridan chaqirishga tushdi, lekin hech qanday maqsad yo'q edi, chunki chaqirayotganlari juda uzoqda edi.

en: Finding herself unanswered of any and seeing no one, she mar- velled exceedingly and began to be sore afraid; then, rising up, as best she might, she saw the ladies who were in her company and the other women lying all about and trying now one and now another, found few who gave any signs of life, the most of them being dead what with sore travail of the stomach and what with affright; wherefore fear redoubled upon her.
uz: O'zini hech kim javob bermayotganini va hech kimni ko'rmayotganini ko'rib, u juda hayratga tushdi va qattiq qo'rqishni boshladi; keyin, o'rnidan turib, qo'lidan kelgancha, u o'zining hamrohligida bo'lgan ayollar va boshqa ayollar birma-bir yotib, bir-birini sinab ko'rdilar. Hayot alomatlarini ko'rsatadiganlar kam edi, ularning aksariyati qorin og'rig'i bilan va qo'rquv bilan o'lgan edi; shuning uchun qo'rquv uning ustiga ko'paydi.

en: Nevertheless, necessity constraining her, for that she saw herself alone there and had neither knowledge nor inkling where she was, she so goaded those who were yet alive that she made them arise and ﬁnding them un- knowing whither the men were gone and seeing the ship stranded and full of water, she fell to weeping piteously, together with them.
uz: Shunga qaramay, uni zarurat cheklardi, chunki u o'zini u yerda yolg'iz ko'rardi va qayerda ekanligini bilmasdi ham, tasavvur ham yo'q edi, u hali tirik bo'lganlarni shunday aldardiki, ularni o'rnidan turg'azdi va topdi - odamlar qayerga ketayotganini bilmasdi va kemaning qolib ketganini va suv bilan to'laligini ko'rgach, u ham ular bilan birga yig'lab tashlandi.

en: It was noon ere they saw any about the shore or elsewhere, whom they might move to pity and succour them; but about that hour there passed by a gentleman, by name Pericone da Visalgo, returning by chance from a place of his, with sundry of his servants on horseback.
uz: Ular qirg'oq bo'ylab yoki boshqa joyda kimni rahm qilib, ularga yordam berishlari mumkin bo'lgan odamni ko'rishlaridan oldin tush payti edi; lekin o'sha soatda Perikone da Visalgo ismli bir janob tasodifan o'z joyining o'zidan, otda turli xizmatkorlari bilan qaytib kelayotgan edi.

en: He saw the ship and forthright con- ceiving what it was, bade one of the servants board it without delay and tell him what he found there.
uz: U kemani ko'rdi va uning nima ekanligini darhol anglab yetdi, xizmatchilardan biri uni hech kechiktirmasdan ko'tarib, u yerda nima topganini aytdi.

en: The man, though with difﬁculty, made his way on board and found the young lady, with what little company she had, crouched, all adread, under the heel of the bowsprit.
uz: Erkak, qiyinchilik bilan bo'lsa-da, bortga yo'l oldi va yosh xonimni topdi, u bilan birga bo'lgan kichkina odam, butun boshini egib, kamonning poshnali ostida edi.

en: When they saw him, they besought him, weeping, of mercy again and again; but, perceiving that he understood them not nor they him, they made shift to make known to him their misadventure by signs.
uz: Uni ko'rganlarida, yig'lab, rahm-shafqat so'rashdi. Ammo u ham, ular ham ularni tushunmasligini anglab yetgach, o'zlarining musibatlarini unga alomatlar orqali bildirish uchun o'zgarishdi.

en: The servant having examined everything as best he might, reported to Pericone that which was on board; whereupon the latter promptly caused to
uz: Xizmatkor hamma narsani qo'lidan kelgancha tekshirib, Perikonga kemada nima borligini xabar qildi; shundan so'ng, u darhol sabab bo'ldi:

en: bring the ladies ashore, together with the most precious things that were in the ship and might be gotten, and carried them off to a castle of his, where, the women being refreshed with food and rest, he perceived, from the rich- ness of her apparel, that the lady whom he had found must needs be some great gentlewoman, and of this he was speedily certiﬁed by the honour that he saw the others do her and her alone; and although she was pale and sore disordered of her person, for the fatigues of the voyage, her features seemed to him exceeding fair; wherefore he forthright took counsel with himself, an she had no husband, to seek to have her to wife, and if he might not have her in marriage, to make shift to have her favours.
uz: Xonimlarni qirg'oqqa olib chiqdi, kemada bo'lgan va olinishi mumkin bo'lgan eng qimmatbaho narsalar bilan birga, va ularni o'z qasriga olib keldi. Ayollar oziq-ovqat va dam olish bilan tetiklanib, u kiyimining boyligidan ko'rdi, u topgan xonim qandaydir buyuk janob ayol bo'lishi kerak edi, va bu haqda tezda boshqalar uni va uni yolg'iz o'zi qilayotganini ko'rgan sharafiga amin bo'ldi; va garchi u oq sochli va uning shaxsiyatidan bezovta bo'lsa ham, sayohat charchoqlari tufayli uning xususiyatlari unga juda go'zal ko'rinardi; shuning uchun u o'zi bilan maslahatlashdi, uning eri yo'q edi, uni xotinlikka olmoqchi edi va agar u uni turmushga qo'yishi mumkin bo'lsa, uni o'ziga ko'rsatmoqchi edi.

en: He was a man of commanding presence and exceeding robust and having for some days let tend the lady excellently well and she being thereby alto- gether restored, he saw her lovely past all conception and was grieved bey- ond measure that he could not understand her nor she him and so he might not learn who she was.
uz: U hukmronlik qiluvchi va haddan tashqari kuchli odam edi va bir necha kun davomida xonimga a'lo darajada g'amxo'rlik qilib, uning shu bilan birga tiklanganini ko'rdi. U uning go'zalligini barcha homiladorlikdan o'tib ketganini ko'rdi va uni ham, uni ham tushunmasligi uchun qayg'urardi, shuning uchun u kimligini bilmas edi.

en: Nevertheless, being inordinately inﬂamed by her charms, he studied, with pleasing and amorous gestures, to engage her to do his pleasure without contention; but to no avail; she altogether rejected his advances and so much the more waxed Pericone’s ardour.
uz: Shunga qaramay, uning jozibasidan haddan tashqari jahli chiqqan holda, u uni o'ziga yoqimli va sevgiona imo-ishoralar bilan o'ziga yoqimli ishtiyoq bilan tortishishga harakat qildi; lekin foydasi yo'q; u uning takliflarini butunlay rad etdi va Perikone'ning g'ayratini shunchalik ko'paytirdi.

en: The lady, seeing this and having now abidden there some days, perceived, by the usances of the folk, that she was among Christians and in a country where, even if she could, it had little proﬁted her to make herself known and foresaw that, in the end, either perforce or for love, needs must she resign herself to do Pericone’s pleasure, but resolved nevertheless by dint of magnanimity to override the wretchedness of her fortune; wherefore she commanded her women, of whom but three were left her, that they should never discover to any who she was, except they found themselves whereas they might look for manifest furtherance in the regaining of their liberty, and urgently exhor- ted them, moreover, to preserve their chastity, avouching herself determined that none, save her husband, should ever enjoy her.
uz: Xonim buni ko'rib, u yerda bir necha kun yashirinib yurganidan so'ng, xalq odatlariga ko'ra, u xristianlar orasida ekanligini va o'zini ko'rsatishga unchalik foyda bermagan mamlakatda ekanligini angladi va oldindan ko'rdi.
