Oxir-oqibat, xoh kuch bilan, xoh muhabbat bilan, u Perikone'ning roziligini bajarishi kerak edi, lekin shunga qaramay, boyligining bechoraligini bartaraf etishga bag'rikenglik bilan qaror qildi; shuning uchun u o'z ayollariga, ulardan faqat uch nafari uni tark etgan bo'lsalar ham, hech kimga uning kimligini kashf etmasliklari kerak edi, faqat ular o'z erkinliklarini namoyon etishda yanada ko'rinish qidirishlari mumkin edi, va shoshilinch ravishda ularni qutqarish uchun, bundan tashqari, o'zlarining xorliklarini saqlab qolishga qaror qildilar.

en: They commended her for this and promised to observe her commandment to the best of their power.
uz: Ular uni buning uchun maqtashdi va uning amrlariga qo'llaridan kelgancha rioya qilishga va'da berishdi.

en: Meanwhile Pericone, waxing daily more inﬂamed, insomuch as he saw the thing desired so near and yet so straitly denied, and seeing that his blandishments availed him nothing, resolved to employ craft and artiﬁce, reserving force unto the last.
uz: Ayni paytda Perikone kun sayin yanada alangalib borardi, shunchalik yaqin va shu bilan birga qat'iy rad etilgan narsani ko'rib, o'zining zerikarli narsalari unga hech qanday foyda bermasligini ko'rib, hunarmandchilik va sun'iylik bilan shug'ullanishga qaror qildi, kuchni oxirigacha saqlab qoldi.

en: Wherefore, having observed bytimes that wine was pleasing to the lady, as being unused to drink thereof, for that her law forbade it, he bethought himself that he might avail to take her with this, as
uz: Shunday qilib, u ayolning vino ichishga odatlanmagani uchun, uning qonuni bunga taqiq qo'yganligi sababli, uning vino ichishi yoqqanini ba'zan kuzatganidan so'ng, u uni shu bilan birga olishni maqsad qilgan, deb o'yladi.

en: with a minister of enus.
uz: Enus vaziri bilan.

en: Accordingly, feigning to reck no more of that whereof she showed herself so chary, he made one night by way of special festival a goodly supper, whereto he bade the lady, and therein, the repast being gladdened with many things, he took order with him who served her that he should give her to drink of various wines mingled.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u o'zini shunchalik beparvo ko'rsatgan narsalarning hech birini hisobga olmagani uchun, u bir kecha maxsus bayram yo'li bilan yaxshi kechki ovqat tayyorladi, u yerda xonimni taklif qildi va u yerda taom ko'p narsalardan xursand bo'lganidan so'ng, unga xizmat qilayotgan odamga turli xil vinolardan ichishga buyurdi.

en: The cupbearer did his bidding punctually and she, being nowise on her guard against this and allured by the pleasantness of the drink, took more thereof than con- sisted with her modesty; whereupon, forgetting all her past troubles, she waxed merry and seeing some women dance after the fashion of Majorca, herself danced in the Alexandrian manner.
uz: Vinochi o'z vazifasini o'z vaqtida bajardi va u, bundan ogoh bo'lib, ichimlikning yoqimliligi bilan maftun bo'lgan holda, o'zining kamtarligi bilan ko'proq ichdi; shundan so'ng, o'zining barcha o'tmishdagi tashvishlarini unutib, xursand bo'lib, Majorka uslubida raqsga tushayotgan ba'zi ayollarni ko'rib, o'zi Aleksandriya uslubida raqsga tushdi.

en: Pericone, seeing this, deemed himself on the high road to that which he desired and continuing the supper with great plenty of meats and wines, protracted it far into the night.
uz: Perikone buni ko'rib, o'zini xohlagan yo'lda deb hisobladi va kechki ovqatni ko'p go'sht va vino bilan davom ettirib, uni tungacha cho'zdi.

en: Ultimately, the guests having departed, he entered with the lady alone into her chamber, where she, more heated with wine than restrained by modesty, without any reserve of shamefastness, un- did herself in his presence, as he had been one of her women, and betook herself to bed.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, mehmonlar ketgach, u xonim bilan birga uning xonasiga kirdi. U yerda u xotirjamlikdan ko'ra sharob bilan issiqroq, hech qanday sharmandalikdan xoli bo'lmagan holda, uning huzurida, xuddi uning ayollaridan biri bo'lgandek, o'zini yechdi va o'zini yotoqqa tortdi.

en: Pericone was not slow to follow her, but, putting out all the lights, promptly hid himself beside her and catching her in his arms, pro- ceeded, without any gainsayal on her part, amorously to solace himself with her; which when once she had felt —having never theretofore known with what manner horn men butt —as if repenting her of not having yielded to Pericone’s solicitations, thenceforth, without waiting to be bidden to such agreeable nights, she oftentimes invited herself thereto, not by words, which she knew not how to make understood, but by deeds.
uz: Perikone unga ergashish uchun sekinlik qilmadi, lekin barcha chiroqlarni o'chirib, darhol uning yonida yashirinib, uni quchog'iga olib, hech qanday urinishsiz, o'zini u bilan sevgi bilan ovutishga kirishdi; bir vaqtlar u  erkaklar qanday qilib qo'ng'iroq bilan urishini hech qachon bilmagan  deb his qilganida  xuddi Perikone'ning so'rovlariga rozi bo'lmagani uchun tavba qilgandek, keyinchalik, bunday yoqimli tunlarga taklif qilinishni kutmasdan, u ko'pincha o'zini u yerga so'zlar bilan emas, balki amallar bilan taklif qilardi.

en: But, in the midst of this great pleasance of Pericone and herself, fortune, not content with having reduced her from a king’s bride to be the mistress of a country gentleman, had foreordained unto her a more barbarous alli- ance.
uz: Ammo, Perikona va uning o'zining bu katta zavqi o'rtasida, boylik uni qirol kelinidan qishloq janobining bekasi bo'lishga kamaytirgani bilan kifoyalanmay, unga yanada vahshiyona ittifoq tayinlagan edi.

en: Pericone had a brother by name Marato, ﬁve-and-twenty years of age and fair and fresh as a rose, who saw her and she pleased him mightily.
uz: Perikoning Marato ismli bir akasi bor edi, u yigirma besh yoshda edi va gul kabi go'zal va yangi edi. U uni ko'rdi va u unga juda yoqdi.

en: Himseemed, moreover, according to that which he could apprehend from her gestures, that he was very well seen of her and conceiving that nought hindered him of that which he craved of her save the strait watch kept on her by Pericone, he fell into a barbarous thought, whereon the nefarious ef- fect followed without delay.
uz: Qolaversa, uning imo-ishoralaridan anglaganidek, u undan juda yaxshi ko'rinardi va unga Perikone tomonidan ushlab turilgan tor soatdan boshqa hech narsa unga xalaqit bermasligini anglab yetardi, shuning uchun u vahshiyona fikrga tushdi, shunda yovuz harakat kechiktirmasdan davom etdi.

en: There was then, by chance, in the harbour of the city a vessel laden with merchandise and bound for Chiarenza117 in Roumelia; whereof two young Genoese were masters, who had already hoisted sail to depart as soon as the
uz: O'shanda, tasodifan, shahar portida tovarlar bilan yuklangan va Rumelyadagi Chiarenza 117ga yo'naltirilgan kema bor edi; uning ikki nafar yosh genovski ustasi bor edi, ular allaqachon jo'nab ketish uchun yelkan ko'targan edilar, zudlik bilan...

en: wind should be fair.
uz: Shamol adolatli bo'lishi kerak.

en: Marato, having agreed with them, took order how he should on the ensuing night be received aboard their ship with the lady; and this done, as soon as it was dark, having inwardly determined what he should do, he secretly betook himself, with certain of his trustiest friends, whom he had enlisted for the purpose, to the house of Pericone, who nowise mistrusted him.
uz: Marato ular bilan kelishgan holda, keyingi kechada uni xonim bilan birga kemasiga qanday qabul qilish kerakligini buyurdi; va shu bilan birga, qorong'u bo'lishi bilanoq, nima qilish kerakligini ich-ichidan aniqlab, u o'zini, maqsadga ko'ra yollagan eng ishonchli do'stlaridan ba'zilari bilan, endi unga ishonmaydigan Perikonening uyiga yashirincha jo'natib yubordi.

en: There he hid himself, according to the ordinance appointed between them, and after a part of the night had passed, he admitted his com- panions and repaired with them to the chamber where Pericone lay with the lady.
uz: U yerda ular o'rtasida belgilangan tartibga ko'ra yashirindi va tunning bir qismi o'tgandan so'ng, u o'z sheriklarini tan oldi va ular bilan Perikone xonim bilan yotgan xonaga qaytdi.

en: Having opened the door, they slew Pericone, as he slept, and took the lady, who was now awake and in tears, threatening her with death, if she made any outcry; after which they made off, unobserved, with great part of Pericone’s most precious things and betook themselves in haste to the sea- shore, where Marato and the lady embarked without delay on board the ship, whilst his companions returned whence they came.
uz: Eshikni ochib, ular Perikonni uxlayotganida o'ldirishdi va endi uyg'oq va yig'lab turgan xonimni olib ketishdi, agar u hech qanday faryod chiqarsa, o'lim bilan tahdid qilishdi; shundan so'ng ular kuzatilmasdan Perikoning eng qimmatbaho narsalarining katta qismini olib ketishdi va shoshilinch ravishda dengiz sohiliga yo'l olishdi, u yerda Marato va xonim kechikmasdan kemaga chiqdilar, uning hamrohlari esa kelgan joydan qaytishdi.

en: The sailors, having a fair wind and a fresh, made sail and set out on their voyage, whilst the princess sore and bitterly bewailed both her former and that her second misadventure; but Marato, with that Saint Waxeth-in-hand, which God hath given us [men], proceeded to comfort her after such a fash- ion that she soon grew familiar with him and forgetting Pericone, began to feel at her ease, when fortune, as if not content with the past tribulations wherewith it had visited her, prepared her a new afﬂiction; for that, she be- ing, as we have already more than once said, exceeding fair of favour and of very engaging manners, the two young men, the masters of the ship, be- came so passionately enamoured of her that, forgetting all else, they studied only to serve and pleasure her, being still on their guard lest Marato should get wind of the cause.
uz: Dengizchilar, yengil shamol va tozalik bilan sayohatga chiqishdi, malika esa avvalgi va ikkinchi baxtsiz hodisalarini achchiq va achchiq o'ylab kuydi; lekin Marato, Xudo bizga bergan o'sha Avliyo Vaks bilan, uni shunday tasalli berishga kirishdi-ki, u tez orada unga yaqinlashdi va Perikonni unutdi, u o'zini bemalol his qila boshladi, qachonki omad, o'tmishdagi musibatlardan qoniqmagandek, unga yangi azob tayyorladi; chunki, biz allaqachon aytganimizdek, juda ko'p marotaba, juda jozibali va qiziqarli odoblar bilan, ikki yosh yigit, kemaning xo'jayinlari, uni shunday sevishdi, chunki ular uni faqatgina...

en: Each becoming aware of the other’s passion, they privily took counsel together thereof, and agreed to join in getting the lady for themselves and enjoy her in common, as if love should suffer this, as do merchandise and gain.
uz: Har biri bir-birining ehtirosini anglab yetgach, ular bu haqda maxfiy maslahatlashdilar va xonimni o'zlari uchun olishda qo'shilishga va uni birgalikda rohatlanishga rozi bo'lishdi, go'yo muhabbat ham bu narsani boshdan kechirishi kerak, xuddi savdo va foyda kabi.

en: Seeing her straitly guarded by Marato and being thereby hindered of their purpose, one day, as the ship fared on at full speed under sail and Marato stood at the poop, looking out on the sea and nowise on his guard against them, they went of one accord and laying hold of him suddenly from be- hind, cast him into the sea, nor was it till they had sailed more than a mile farther that any perceived Marato to be fallen overboard.
uz: Uni Marato qattiq qo'riqlayotganini va shu bilan ularning maqsadiga to'sqinlik qilayotganini ko'rib, bir kuni kema to'liq tezlikda suzib ketayotganda va Marato dengizga qarab, ularga qarshi qo'riqlayotganda, ular bir ovozdan uni orqa tomondan ushlab, dengizga uloqtirishdi. Ular bir mildan ko'proq suzib ketmagunlaricha, Marato dengizdan yiqilganini hech kim sezmas edi.

en: Alatiel, hearing this and seeing no possible way of recovering him, began anew to make moan for herself; whereupon the two lovers came incontinent to her succour
uz: Alatiel buni eshitib, uni tuzatishning iloji yo'qligini ko'rib, yana o'zi uchun ingrashni boshladi; shundan so'ng ikki oshiq uning yordamiga bemalol kelishdi.

en: and with soft words and very good promises, whereof she understood but little, studied to soothe and console the lady, who lamented not so much her lost husband as her own ill fortune.
uz: va yumshoq so'zlar va juda yaxshi va'dalar bilan, ularni faqat oz tushunardi, o'z baxtsizligi uchun emas, balki yo'qolgan eri uchun qayg'urgan xonimni tinchlantirish va tasalli berishga o'rgandi.

en: After holding much discourse with her at one time and another, themseeming after awhile they had well nigh com- forted her, they came to words with one another which should ﬁrst take her to lie with him.
uz: Bir vaqtlar u bilan ko'p suhbatlashgandan so'ng, bir oz vaqtdan keyin uni yaqinroq qo'llab-quvvatlagandek tuyulgach, ular bir-birlari bilan avval uni o'zi bilan yotishga olib borishi kerak bo'lgan so'zlarga kelishdi.

en: Each would fain be the ﬁrst and being unable to come to any accord upon this, they ﬁrst with words began a sore and hot dispute and thereby kindled into rage, they clapped hands to their knives and falling furiously on one another, before those on board could part them, dealt each other several blows, whereof one incontinent fell dead, whilst the other abode on life, though grievously wounded in many places.
uz: Har biri birinchi bo'lib kelisholmay, so'zlar bilan achchiq va qizg'in bahs boshlashdi va shu bilan g'azabga tushishdi, pichoqlariga qo'llarini urib, bir-birlariga g'azab bilan yiqilishdi, bortdagilar ularni ajrata olishmasidan oldin bir-birlariga bir necha marta zarba berishdi, ulardan biri keskin o'ldi, ikkinchisi esa hayotda qoldi, garchi ko'p joylarda og'ir yaralandi.

en: This new mishap was sore unpleasing to the lady, who saw herself alone, without aid or counsel of any, and feared lest the anger of the two masters’ kinsfolk and friends should revert upon herself; but the prayers of the wounded man and their speedy arrival at Chiarenza delivered her from danger of death.
uz: Bu yangi baxtsiz hodisa xonimga juda yoqmadi, u o'zini hech kimning yordami yoki maslahati yo'q holda yolg'iz ko'rardi va ikki xo'jayinning qarindoshlari va do'stlarining g'azabi o'z zimmasiga tushishidan qo'rqardi; lekin yaralangan odamning duolari va ularning Chiarenzaga tezda yetib kelishi uni o'lim xavfasidan saqlardi.

en: There she went ashore with the wounded man and took up her abode with him in an inn, where the report of her great beauty soon spread through the city and came to the ears of the Prince of the Morea, who was then at Chiarenza and was fain to see her.
uz: U yerda u yarador odam bilan qirg'oqqa chiqdi va u bilan mehmonxonada turdi. U yerda uning buyuk go'zalligi haqidagi xabar tez orada shahar bo'ylab tarqaldi va o'sha paytda Chiarenza shahrida bo'lgan va uni ko'rishga tayyor bo'lgan Morea shahzodasining qulog'iga yetdi.

en: Having gotten sight of her and himseeming she was fairer than report gave out, he straightway be- came so sore enamoured of her that he could think of nothing else and hear- ing how she came thither, doubted not to be able to get her for himself.
uz: Uni ko'rib, u xabar berganidan ko'ra go'zalroq ko'rinsa, u darhol unga shunchalik oshiq bo'lib ketdi, hech narsa o'ylay olmadi va u yerga qanday kelganini eshitib, uni o'zi uchun topa olmasligiga shubha qilmadi.

en: As he cast about for a means of effecting his purpose, the wounded man’s kinsfolk got wind of his desire and without awaiting more, sent her to him forthright, which was mighty agreeable to the prince and to the lady also, for that herseemed she was quit of a great peril.
uz: U o'z maqsadini amalga oshirish vositasini qidirar ekan, yaralangan odamning qarindoshlari uning istaklarini anglab yetishdi va ko'proq kutmasdan, uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri unga jo'natishdi, bu shahzoda va xonimga ham juda yoqimli edi, chunki u katta xavfdan xalos bo'lgan deb o'yladi.

en: The prince, seeing her graced, over and above her beauty, with royal manners and unable other- wise to learn who she was, concluded her to be some noble lady, wherefore he redoubled in his love for her and holding her in exceeding honour, en- treated her not as a mistress, but as his very wife.
uz: Shahzoda uni o'z go'zalligidan ham ustun, qirollik odoblari va kimligini bilishga qodir bo'lmagan holda bezatganini ko'rib, uni qandaydir olijanob xonim deb hisobladi, shuning uchun u unga bo'lgan muhabbatini kuchaytirdi va uni haddan tashqari hurmat bilan ushladi, uni xo'jayin emas, balki o'zining rafiqasi kabi qabul qildi.

en: The lady, accordingly, having regard to her past troubles and herseeming she was well enough bestowed, was altogether comforted and waxing blithe again, her beauties ﬂourished on such wise that it seemed all Roumelia could talk of nothing else.
uz: Xonim, o'zining o'tmishdagi tashvishlarini hisobga olgan holda va o'ziga yetarlicha boy ko'rinayotganini ko'rib, butunlay taskin topdi va yana baxtiyor bo'ldi, uning go'zalliklari shunchalik donolik bilan gullab-yashnadi, go'yo Roumeliya boshqa hech narsa haqida gapira olmasdi.

en: The report of her loveliness reaching the Duke of Athens, who was young and handsome and doughty of his person and a friend and kinsman of the prince, he was taken with a desire to see her and making a show of paying him a visit, as he was wont bytimes to do, re-
uz: Uning go'zalligi haqidagi xabar Afina gersogiga yetib bordi, u yosh, chiroyli va o'ziga xos edi, shahzoda do'sti va qarindoshi edi. U uni ko'rishga va unga tashrif buyurish istagini ko'rsatdi, xuddi u odatda qilganidek.

en: paired, with a fair and worshipful company, to Chiarenza, where he was honourably received and sumptuously entertained.
uz: Yaxshi va sadoqatli hamrohlar bilan birga, Chiarenzaga jo'r bo'lib, u yerda u sharafli qabul qilindi va dabdabali ko'ngilxushlik ko'rsatildi.

en: Some days after, the two kinsmen coming to discourse together of the lady’s charms, the duke asked if she were indeed so admirable a creature as was reported; to which the prince answered, ‘Much more so; but thereof I will have not my words, but thine own eyes certify thee.’ Accordingly, at the duke’s solicitation, they betook themselves together to the princess’s lodging, who, having had no- tice of their coming, received them very courteously and with a cheerful fa- vour, and they seated her between them, but might not have the pleasure of conversing with her, for that she understood little or nothing of their lan- guage; wherefore each contented himself with gazing upon her, as upon a marvel, and especially the duke, who could scarce bring himself to believe that she was a mortal creature and thinking to satisfy his desire with her sight, heedless of the amorous poison he drank in at
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, ikki qarindosh xonimning jozibasini muhokama qilish uchun birga kelishganda, gersog undan xabar qilinganidek, u haqiqatan ham hayratlanarli mavjudotmi deb so'radi; unga shahzoda javob berdi: "Boshqa gaplarim yo'q, lekin bu haqda o'z ko'zlaring bilan tasdiqlayman." Shunga ko'ra, gersogning iltimosiga ko'ra, ular malikaga mehmon bo'lishdi. Ularning kelishiga hech qanday ishonchi bo'lmagani uchun, ularni juda xushmuomalalik bilan va quvnoqlik bilan qabul qilishdi va ular o'rtasida o'tirishdi, lekin u bilan suhbatlashishdan zavq olishmadi, chunki u ularning hech narsasini tushunmas edi; chunki har biri unga qarab, mo'jiza kabi, va ayniqsa gersog'ning o'zini o'zi bilan ko'rishga qodir edi, chunki u o'zini o'zi bilan

en: his eyes, beholding her, he miserably ensnared himself, becoming most ardently enamoured of her.
uz: Uning ko'zlari uni ko'rib, o'zini achinarli darajada tuzoqqa soldi va unga juda qattiq oshiq bo'lib qoldi.

en: After he had departed her presence with the prince and had leisure to be- think himself, he esteemed his kinsman happy beyond all others in having so fair a creature at his pleasure, and after many and various thoughts, his unruly passion weighing more with him than his honour, he resolved, come thereof what might, to do his utmost endeavour to despoil the prince of that felicity and bless himself therewith.
uz: U uning huzuridan shahzoda bilan ketgach va o'zini o'ylashga vaqt topgach, u o'z qarindoshini o'ziga yoqqan go'zal mavjudotga ega bo'lishidan boshqalardan ko'ra baxtliroq deb hisobladi va ko'p va xilma-xil fikrlardan so'ng, uning itoatsiz ishtiyoqi uning sharafiga qaraganda ko'proq og'irligini ko'rsatib, u shu baxt shahzodasini o'g'irlashga va o'ziga baraka berishga bor kuchini sarflashga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, being minded to make a quick despatch of the matter and setting aside all reason and all equity, he turned his every thought to the devising of means for the attainment of his wishes, and one day, in accordance with the nefarious ordinance taken by him with a privy chamberlain of the prince’s, by name Ciuriaci, he let make ready in secret his horses and baggage for a sudden departure.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, masalani tezda yo'qotish va barcha aql-idrok va adolatni chetga surib, u o'z istaklarini amalga oshirish yo'llarini o'ylab topishga burildi va bir kuni, shahzoda Siuriatsining shaxsiy xonasi bilan qabul qilgan yovuz farmoyishiga muvofiq, u o'z otlari va yuklarini to'satdan jo'nab ketish uchun yashirincha tayyorladi.

en: The night come, he was, with a companion, both armed, stealthily intro- duced by the aforesaid Ciuriaci into the prince’s chamber and saw the latter (the lady being asleep) standing, all naked for the great heat, at a window overlooking the seashore, to take a little breeze that came from that quarter; whereupon, having beforehand informed his companion of that which he had to do, he went softly up to the window and striking the prince with a knife, stabbed him, through and through the small of his back; then, taking him up in haste, he cast him forth of the window.
uz: Kech kirdi, u hamroh bilan birga, ikkalasi ham qurollangan, o'g'irlik bilan yuqorida aytib o'tilgan Kuryasiy tomonidan shahzoda xonasiga olib kirildi va oxirgi (xonim uxlayotganini) katta issiqdan butunlay yalang'och holda dengiz sohiliga qaragan deraza oldida ozgina shamol olish uchun turganini ko'rdi; shundan so'ng, o'z hamrohiga oldindan nima qilish kerakligini aytib, u derazadan sekin ko'tarilib, shahzodaga pichoq bilan xabar berdi, uni orqa tomondan ham, kichik tomondan ham pichoqladi; keyin, uni tezda ko'tarib, derazadan uloqtirdi.

en: The palace stood over against the sea and was very lofty and the window in question looked upon certain houses that had been undermined by the beating of the waves and where seldom or never any came; wherefore it happened, as the duke had
uz: Saroy dengiz ro'parasida turardi va juda baland edi va savoldagi deraza to'lqinlar urishi natijasida vayron bo'lgan va kamdan-kam yoki hech qachon kelmaydigan ayrim uylarga qarardi; shuning uchun ham bu shunday bo'ldi, chunki gersog

en: foreseen, that the fall of the prince’s body was not nor might be heard of any.
uz: bashorat qilinganidek, shahzodaning jasadi qulashi haqida hech narsa eshitilmadi va eshitilmas edi.

en: The duke’s companion, seeing this done, pulled out a halter he had brought with him to that end and making a show of caressing Ciuriaci, cast it adroitly about his neck and drew it so that he could make no outcry; then, the duke coming up, they strangled him and cast him whereas they had cast the prince.
uz: Gertsogning hamrohi buni ko'rib, o'zi bilan olib kelgan bir xaltani chiqarib oldi va Siuriatsiyni erkalash ko'rinishida uni bo'yniga mahorat bilan tashladi va u hech qanday shikoyat qilmasligi uchun tortdi; keyin, gertsog kelgach, uni bo'g'ib tashladilar va shahzodani tashlaganlarida tashladilar.

en: This done and they being manifestly certiﬁed that they had been unheard of the lady or of any other, the duke took a light in his hand and carrying it to the bedside, softly uncovered the princess, who slept fast.
uz: Bu amalga oshdi va ular xonimdan yoki boshqa hech kimdan eshitmaganliklari aniq tasdiqlandi, gersog qo'liga chiroq oldi va uni yotoq yonboshiga olib bordi, asta-sekin malikaga ko'rsatib berdi, u tez uxlardi.

en: He considered her from head to foot and mightily commended her; for, if she was to his liking, being clothed, she pleased him, naked, beyond all compare.
uz: U uni boshidan oyoqqa qadar e'tiborga oldi va uni kuchli maqtadi; chunki, agar u unga yoqqan bo'lsa, kiyimda bo'lsa, u uni yalang'och holda, barcha narsalardan ko'ra mamnun qilardi.

en: Where- fore, ﬁred with hotter desire and unawed by his new-committed crime, he couched himself by her side, with hands yet bloody, and lay with her, all sleepy-eyed as she was and thinking him to be the prince.
uz: Qayerda bo'lsa ham, issiqroq istak bilan va yangi sodir etgan jinoyatidan beparvo, u uning yonida qonli qo'llari bilan yotdi va u bilan birga yotdi, xuddi u kabi uyqusiragan ko'zlari bilan va uni shahzoda deb o'yladi.

en: After he had abidden with her awhile in the utmost pleasure, he arose and summoning certain of his companions, caused take up the lady on such wise that she could make no outcry and carry her forth by a privy door, whereat he had entered; then, setting her on horseback, he took to the road with all his men, as softliest he might, and returned to his own dominions.
uz: U bir oz vaqt uning yonida juda xursand bo'lgandan so'ng, u o'rnidan turdi va ba'zi hamrohlari bilan chaqirdi, xonimni shunday donolik bilan olib chiqdiki, u hech qanday faryod qilolmadi va uni yopiq eshikdan tashqariga olib chiqdi, u yerga kirdi; so'ngra uni otga mindirib, barcha odamlari bilan birga imkon qadar yumshoq yo'lga chiqdi va o'z hukmdorligiga qaytdi.

en: However (for that he had a wife) he carried the lady, who was the most distressful of women, not to Athens, but to a very goodly place he had by the sea, a little without the city, and there entertained her in secret, causing honourably furnish her with all that was needful.
uz: Ammo (uning xotini bor edi), u ayollarning eng qayg'uli bo'lgan xonimni Afinaga emas, balki o'zining dengiz bo'yidagi juda yaxshi joyiga, shahardan biroz tashqarida olib bordi va u yerda uni yashirincha kutib oldi, unga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani hurmat bilan ta'minladi.

en: The prince’s courtiers on the morrow awaited his rising till none, when, hearing nothing, they opened the chamber-doors, which were but closed, and ﬁnding no one, concluded that he was gone somewhither privily, to pass some days there at his ease with his fair lady, and gave themselves no farther concern.
uz: Ertasi kuni shahzodaning saroylari uning uyg'onishini hech narsa eshitmaguncha kutdilar, keyin hech narsa eshitmay, faqat yopiq bo'lgan xona eshiklarini ochdilar va hech kimni topolmadilar, u u yerda go'zal xonimi bilan bir necha kun bemalol o'tkazish uchun hech kimni topmagani haqida xulosa qilishdi va o'zlarini boshqa tashvishlantirishmadi.

en: Things being thus, it chanced next day that an idiot, enter- ing the ruins where lay the bodies of the prince and Ciuriaci, dragged the latter forth by the halter and went haling him after him.
uz: Shunday bo'lgani uchun, ertasi kuni bir ahmoq shahzoda va Kyuriatsining jasadlari yotgan xarobalarga kirib, oxirgi odamni xaltadan sudrab olib chiqdi va uning orqasidan o'ldirib tashladi.

en: The body was, with no little wonderment, recognized by many, who, coaxing the idiot to bring them to the place whence he had dragged it, there, to the exceeding grief of the whole city, found the prince’s corpse and gave it honourable burial.
uz: Jasad, hech qanday ajablanarli holatda, ko'pchilik tomonidan tanildi, ular ahmoqni uni sudrab olgan joyiga olib borishga undashdi, u yerda butun shaharning haddan tashqari qayg'usi bilan shahzodaning jasadini topdilar va unga sharafli dafn marosimi berishdi.

en: Then, enquiring for the authors of so heinous a crime and ﬁnding that the Duke of Athens was no longer there, but had departed by stealth, they con- cluded, even as was the case, that it must be he who had done this and car- ried off the lady; whereupon they straightway substituted a brother of the
uz: Keyin, bunchalik dahshatli jinoyat mualliflarini so'rab, Afina gersogining endi u yerda emasligini, balki yashirincha jo'nab ketganini aniqlab, ular, xuddi shunday bo'lgani kabi, buni qilgan va xonimni qo'yib yuborgan odam aynan u bo'lishi kerakligini aniqladilar; shundan so'ng ular darhol bir akani almashtirdilar.

en: dead man to their prince and incited him with all their might to vengeance.
uz: O'lik odam o'z shahzodasiga va uni butun kuchlari bilan qasos olishga undadi.

en: The new prince, being presently certiﬁed by various other circumstances that it was as they had surmised, summoned his friends and kinsmen and servants from divers parts and promptly levying a great and goodly and powerful army, set out to make war upon the Duke of Athens.
uz: Yangi shahzoda, hozirda ular o'ylagandek bo'lganini turli xil holatlar bilan tasdiqlagan holda, do'stlari, qarindoshlari va xizmatkorlarini turli joylardan chaqirib, darhol buyuk, yaxshi va qudratli armiyani yig'ib, Afina gersogiga qarshi urushga otlandi.

en: The latter, hearing of this, on like wise mustered all his forces for his own defence, and to his aid came many lords, amongst whom the Emperor of Constantinople sent Constantine his son and Manual his nephew, with a great and goodly following.
uz: Oxirgisi, bu haqda eshitgach, donolar kabi o'z kuchlarini o'z himoyasiga jamladi va unga ko'plab beklar yordamga keldi, ularning orasida Konstantinopol imperatori o'g'li va Jiyani katta va yaxshi obunachilar bilan yubordi.

en: The two princes were honourably received by the duke and yet more so by the duchess, for that she was their sister,118 and matters drawing thus daily nearer unto war, taking her occasion, she sent for them both one day to her chamber and there, with tears galore and many words, related to them the whole story, acquainting them with the causes of the war.
uz: Ikki shahzoda gersog tomonidan hurmat bilan qabul qilindi, ayniqsa gersoginya tomonidan, chunki u ularning singlisi edi, 118 va urushga kun sayin yaqinlashayotgan masalalarni hisobga olgan holda, u ularni bir kuni o'z xonasiga va u yerga ko'z yoshlari va ko'p so'zlar bilan yuborib, ularga butun voqeani aytib, urush sabablarini tanishtirdi.

en: Moreover, she discovered to them the affront done her by the duke in the matter of the woman whom it was believed he privily entertained, and complaining sore thereof, besought them to apply to the matter such remedy as best they might, for the honour of the duke and her own solacement.
uz: Qolaversa, u ularga gersogning uni yashirincha o'ynagan ayol masalasida haqorat qilganini aniqladi va bundan shikoyat qilib, ulardan gersogning sharafi va o'z tasalli uchun bu masalaga qo'ldan kelgancha chora ko'rishni so'radi.

en: The young men already knew all the facts as it had been; wherefore, without enquiring farther, they comforted the duchess, as best they might, and ﬁlled her with good hope.
uz: Yigitlar barcha faktlarni allaqachon bilgan edilar; shuning uchun, bundan keyin ham so'ramasdan, gertsoginni iloji boricha ovutdilar va uni yaxshi umidga to'ldirishdi.

en: Then, having learned from her where the lady abode, they took their leave and having a mind to see the latter, for that they had oftentimes heard her commended for marvellous beauty, they be- sought the duke to show her to them.
uz: Keyin, undan xonim qayerda yashayotganini bilib, ular ketishdi va oxirgisini ko'rishga qaror qilishdi, chunki ular uni ajoyib go'zalligi uchun ko'p marta maqtashni eshitishgan edi, shuning uchun ular uni ularga ko'rsatish uchun gersogdan so'rashdi.

en: He, unmindful of that which had be- fallen the Prince of the Morea for having shown her to himself, promised to do this and accordingly next morning, having let prepare a magniﬁcent col- lation in a very goodly garden that pertained to the lady’s place of abode, he carried them and a few others thither to eat with her.
uz: U, Morea shahzodasi unga ko'rsatgani uchun yiqilganidan beparvo bo'lib, buni qilishga va'da berdi va shunga ko'ra ertalab, xonimning yashash joyiga tegishli bo'lgan juda yaxshi bog'da ajoyib taom tayyorlashga ruxsat berib, ularni va yana bir nechta boshqalarni u yerga olib bordi va u bilan birga ovqatlanishdi.

en: Constantine, sitting with Alatiel, fell a-gazing upon her, full of wonderment, avouching in him- self that he had never seen aught so lovely and that certes the duke must needs be held excused, ay, and whatsoever other, to have so fair a creature, should do treason or other foul thing, and looking on her again and again and each time admiring her more, it betided him no otherwise than it had betided the duke; wherefore, taking his leave, enamoured of her, he aban- doned all thought of the war and occupied himself with considering how he might take her from the duke, carefully concealing his passion the while from everyone.
uz: Konstantin, Alatiel bilan o'tirgan holda, unga tikilib qoldi, hayratga to'lib, o'ziga qarab turardi. U hech qachon bunchalik go'zal narsani ko'rmagan edi va albatta, gersogni oqlash kerak edi, shunday go'zal maxluq bo'lishi uchun, xiyonat yoki boshqa jirkanch ish qilishi kerak edi, va unga qayta-qayta va har safar unga ko'proq qoyil qolishi kerak edi, bu unga gersogdan boshqa hech narsa emas edi; shuning uchun u ketib, unga oshiq bo'lib, urush haqida butunlay o'yladi va uni gersogdan qanday olib ketish mumkinligini o'ylab, o'zini ehtiyotkorlik bilan yashirdi.

en: Whilst he yet burnt in this ﬁre, the time came to go out against the new prince, who now drew near to the duke’s territories; wherefore the latter and Constantine and all the others, sallied forth of Athens according to the given ordinance and betook themselves to the defence of certain frontiers, so the prince might not avail to advance farther.
uz: U hali shu olovda kuyganida, endi gersogning hududlariga yaqinlashgan yangi shahzodaga qarshi chiqish vaqti keldi; shuning uchun oxirgi va Konstantin hamda qolganlarning barchasi berilgan farmoyishga muvofiq Afina shahridan chiqib, ma'lum chegaralarni himoya qilishga o'zlarini bag'ishladilar, shunda shahzoda yanada oldinga siljishga qodir bo'lmas edi.

en: When they had lain there some days, Constantine having his mind and thought still intent upon the lady and conceiving that, now the duke was no longer near her, he might very well avail to accomplish his pleasure, feigned himself sore indisposed of his per- son, to have an occasion of returning to Athens; wherefore, with the duke’s leave, committing his whole power to Manuel, he returned to Athens to his sister, and there, after some days, putting her upon talk of the affront which herseemed she suffered from the duke by reason of the lady whom he enter- tained, he told her that, an it liked her, he would soon ease her thereof by causing take the lady from whereas she was and carry her off.
uz: Ular u yerda bir necha kun yotganlarida, Konstantin xonimga o'z aql-idrokini va fikrini saqlab qolgan holda, endi gersog u yaqinida bo'lmagani uchun o'z xohish-istaklarini ro'yobga chiqarishi mumkinligini, o'zini o'g'lidan xavotirda ko'rsatib, Afinaga qaytish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishini o'ylagan edi; shuning uchun gersog ketishi bilan, butun kuchini Manuelga topshirib, Afinaga qaytib keldi va u yerda, bir necha kundan so'ng, unga duch kelgan xonim tufayli undan azob chekkan deb o'ylagan haqorat haqida gapirib, unga aytdiki, bu unga yoqdi, uni olib ketish orqali yengillashtiradi.

en: The duchess, conceiving that he did this of regard for herself and not for love of the lady, answered that it liked her exceeding well so but it might be done on such wise that the duke should never know that she had been party thereto, which Constantine fully promised her, and thereupon she consented that he should do as seemed best to him.
uz: Gersoginya, buni xonimga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun emas, balki o'ziga hurmat bilan qilganini o'ylab, unga juda yoqqanini, lekin bu shunday donolik bilan amalga oshirilishi mumkinligini, gersog hech qachon uning Konstantin unga to'liq va'da qilgan narsada ishtirok etganini bilmasligi kerakligini va shundan so'ng u unga eng yaxshi ko'rganini qilishga rozi bo'lishini aytdi.

en: Constantine, accordingly, let secretly equip a light vessel and sent it one evening to the neighbourhood of the garden where the lady abode; then, having taught certain of his men who were on board what they had to do, he repaired with others to the lady’s pavilion, where he was cheerfully re- ceived by those in her service and indeed by the lady herself, who, at his instance, betook herself with him to the garden, attended by her servitors and his companions.
uz: Konstantin shunga ko'ra, yumshoq idishni yashirincha jihozladi va uni bir kechqurun xonim yashaydigan bog'ning qo'shniga jo'natib yubordi; so'ngra, bortda bo'lgan ba'zi odamlariga nima qilish kerakligini o'rgatgach, u boshqalar bilan xonimning paviloniga yo'l oldi. U yerda uni uning xizmatidagilar va hatto xonimning o'zi xursandchilik bilan qabul qilishdi, ular esa o'z navbatida o'zlari bilan bog'ga, xizmatkorlari va hamrohlari bilan birga olib borishdi.

en: There, making as he would speak with her on the duke’s part, he went with her alone towards a gate, which gave upon the sea and had already been opened by one of his men, and calling the bark thither with the given signal, he caused suddenly seize the lady and carry her aboard; then, turning to her people, he said to them, ‘Let none stir or utter a word, an he would not die; for that I purpose not to rob the duke of his wench, but to do away the affront which he putteth upon my sister.’ To this none dared make answer; whereupon Constantine, embarking with his people and seating himself by the side of the weeping lady, bade thrust the oars into the water and make off.
uz: U yerda, gersog tomonidan u bilan gaplashgandek, u bilan birga dengizga qaragan va o'z odamlaridan biri tomonidan allaqachon ochilgan darvozaga tomon bordi va berilgan signal bilan u yerga qo'ng'iroq qilib, xonimni to'satdan ushlashni va uni bortga olib chiqishni buyurdi; so'ngra uning odamlariga o'girildi va ularga dedi: "Hech kim bir so'z demasin, u o'lmas edi; chunki men gersogning o'g'rini o'g'irlamasdim, balki u singlimga qilgan haqoratni yo'q qilmoqchi edim." Bunga hech kim javob berishga jur'at eta olmadi; shundan so'ng Konstantin o'z odamlari bilan birga yig'layotgan xonim yonida o'tirdi va o'zini suvga surdi.

en: Accordingly, they put out to sea and not hieing, but ﬂying,119 came, after a little after daybreak on the mor- row, to Egina, where they landed and took rest, whilst Constantine solaced
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular dengizga chiqishdi va uxlamay, balki uchib ketishdi. 119 kishi tong otgandan ko'p o'tgach, mor- qatorida Eginaga yetib kelishdi va u yerda qo'nishdi va dam olishdi, Konstantin esa tasalli topdi.

en: himself awhile with the lady, who bemoaned her ill-fated beauty.
uz: o'zi bir oz vaqt uning bechora go'zalligini xafa qilgan xonim bilan edi.

en: Thence, going aboard the bark again, they made their way, in a few days, to Chios, where it pleased Constantine to take up his sojourn, as in a place of safety, for fear of his father’s resentment and lest the stolen lady should be taken from him.
uz: Shundan so'ng, yana kemaga chiqib, bir necha kundan so'ng Chiosga yo'l olishdi. U yerda Konstantin otasining g'azabidan qo'rqib, o'g'irlangan xonim undan olinmasligi uchun xavfsiz joyda qolishni xohlardi.

en: There the fair lady bewailed her ill fate some days, but, being presently comforted by Constantine, she began, as she had done other- whiles, to take her pleasure of that which fortune had foreordained to her.
uz: U yerda go'zal xonim bir necha kun o'z baxtsiz taqdirini kutdi, lekin hozirda Konstantin tomonidan tasalli topgach, u, boshqa safarlar qilganidek, omad unga oldindan belgilagan narsadan zavqlanishni boshladi.

en: Things being at this pass, Osbech, King of the Turks, who abode in con- tinual war with the Emperor, came by chance to Smyrna, where hearing how Constantine abode in Chios, without any precaution, leading a wanton life with a mistress of his, whom he had stolen away, he repaired thither one night with some light-armed ships and entering the city by stealth with some of his people, took many in their beds, ere they knew of the enemy’s coming.
uz: Shu nuqtada turklar shohi Osbek, imperator bilan doimiy urushda bo'lgan, tasodifan Smyrnaga keldi. U yerda Konstantin Chiosda yashayotganini eshitib, hech qanday ehtiyotsizliksiz, o'g'irlagan bekasi bilan behuda hayot kechirganini eshitdi. U bir kecha yengil qurolli kemalar bilan shaharga kirib, o'z odamlari bilan yashirincha kirdi, dushman kelishini bilmaslaridan oldin ko'pchilikni o'z karavotlariga oldi.

en: Some, who, taking the alert, had run to arms, he slew and having burnt the whole place, carried the booty and captives on board the ships and returned to Smyrna.
uz: Ba'zilar, ogoh bo'lib, qurollarga yugurib ketishdi, u o'ldirdi va butun joyni yoqib yubordi, o'lja va asirlarni kemalar kemasiga olib kirdi va Smirnaga qaytib keldi.

en: When they arrived there, Osbech, who was a young man, passing his prisoners in review, found the fair lady among them and knowing her for her who had been taken with Constantine asleep in bed, was mightily rejoiced at sight of her.
uz: Ular u yerga yetib kelganlarida, yosh yigit bo'lgan Osbek, asirlarini ko'zdan kechirayotganda, ularning orasida go'zal xonimni topdi va uni Konstantin bilan birga to'shakda uxlab yotgan holda olib ketilganini bilgan holda, uni ko'rib juda xursand bo'ldi.

en: Accordingly, he made her his wife without delay, and celebrating the nuptials forthright, lay with her some months in all joyance.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uni hech kechiktirmasdan o'z xotiniga aylantirdi va to'ylarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nishonlab, u bilan bir necha oy quvonchda yotdi.

en: Meanwhile, the Emperor, who had, before these things came to pass, been in treaty with Bassano, King of Cappadocia, to the end that he should come down upon Osbech from one side with his power, whilst himself as- sailed him on the other, but had not yet been able to come to a full accord with him, for that he was unwilling to grant certain things which Bassano demanded and which he deemed unreasonable, hearing what had betided his son and chagrined beyond measure thereat, without hesitating farther, did that which the King of Cappadocia asked and pressed him as most he might to fall upon Osbech, whilst himself made ready to come down upon him from another quarter.
uz: Ayni paytda, imperator, bu voqealar sodir bo'lishidan oldin, Kappadoniya qiroli Bassano bilan shartnoma tuzgan edi, toki u bir tomondan Osbek ustiga o'z qudrati bilan tushsin, o'zi esa uni boshqa tomondan suzib o'tsin, lekin u bilan hali to'liq kelisha olmagan edi, chunki u Bassano talab qilgan va o'zi asossiz deb hisoblagan ba'zi narsalarni berishni istamagan edi, o'g'li nimaga ikkilanayotganini va undan xafa bo'lganini eshitgach, u bundan ortig'iga bormasdan, Kappadoniya qiroli so'ragan va uni Osbek ustiga tushishga majburlaganini qildi, o'zi esa unga boshqa tomondan tushishga tayyor edi.

en: Osbech, hearing this, assembled his army, ere he should be straitened between two such puissant princes, and marched against Bassano, leaving his fair lady at Smyrna, in charge of a trusty ser- vant and friend of his.
uz: Buni eshitib, Osbek o'z qo'shinini yig'di, u ikki shunchalik qudratli shahzoda o'rtasida taranglashishi kerak bo'lganidan oldin, Bassanoga qarshi yurdi va o'zining go'zal xonimni Smirnda, ishonchli ser-vent va do'stiga mas'ul bo'lgan holda qoldirdi.

en: After some time he encountered the King of Cap- padocia and giving him battle, was slain in the mellay and his army discom- ﬁted and dispersed; whereupon Bassano advanced in triumph towards
uz: Biroz vaqtdan so'ng u Kap-padia qiroliga duch keldi va unga jang qildi, mellada o'ldirildi va uning qo'shini tarqalib ketdi; shundan so'ng Bassano g'alaba bilan oldinga siljidi.

en: Smyrna, unopposed, and all the folk submitted to him by the way, as to a conqueror.
uz: Smirna, qarshiliksiz, va butun xalq yo'l bo'ylab unga bo'ysundirdi, go'yo zabtchiga o'xshab.

en: Meanwhile, Osbech’s servant, Antiochus by name, in whose charge the lady had been left, seeing her so fair, forgot his plighted faith to his friend and master and became enamoured of her, for all he was a man in years.
uz: Ayni paytda, Osbekning xizmatkori, ismi Antiox, xonimning qaramog'ida qoldirilgan edi, uni juda go'zal ko'rib, do'sti va xo'jayiniga bo'lgan sadoqatini unutdi va unga oshiq bo'ldi, chunki u yillar davomida erkak edi.

en: Urged by love and knowing her tongue (the which was mighty agreeable to her, as well as it might be to one whom it had behoved for some years live as she were deaf and dumb, for that she understood none neither was under- standed of any) he began, in a few days, to be so familiar with her that, ere long, having no regard to their lord and master who was absent in the ﬁeld, they passed from friendly commerce to amorous privacy, taking marvellous pleasure one of the other between the sheets.
uz: Muhabbat va uning tilini bilishga undalgan (bu uning uchun juda yoqimli edi, shuningdek, bir necha yillar davomida kar va soqov bo'lib yashashni xohlagan odamga kerak bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki u hech narsani tushunmasdi va hech narsadan kam emas edi), u bir necha kun ichida u bilan shunchalik tanish bo'la boshladiki, uzoq vaqt davomida dalada yo'q bo'lgan xo'jayinlari va xo'jayinlariga e'tibor bermay, ular do'stona tijoratdan ishqiy maxfiylikka o'tdilar, varaqlar orasida bir-biridan ajoyib zavq olishardi.

en: When they heard that Osbech was defeated and slain and that Bassano came carrying all before him, they took counsel together not to await him there and laying hands on great part of the things of most price that were there pertaining to Osbech, gat them privily to Rhodes, where they had not long abidden ere Antiochus sickened unto death.
uz: Ular Osbek mag'lub bo'lganini va o'ldirilganini va Bassano hamma narsani o'z oldiga olib kelganini eshitgach, uni u yerda kutmaslikka maslahatlashdilar va Osbekga tegishli bo'lgan eng qimmatbaho narsalarning katta qismini o'z qo'llariga qo'yib, ularni yashirincha Rodosga jo'natdilar, u yerda Antiox kasal bo'lib o'lgunga qadar uzoq qolishmagan edi.

en: As chance would have it, there was then in lodging with him a merchant of Cyprus, who was much loved of him and his fast friend, and Antiochus, feeling himself draw to his end, bethought himself to leave him both his possessions and his beloved lady; wherefore, being now nigh upon death, he called them both to him and bespoke them thus, ‘I feel myself, without a doubt, passing away, which grieveth me, for that never had I such delight in life as I presently have.
uz: Tasodifan, o'shanda u bilan birga Kiprlik savdogar mehmon bo'lgan edi, u unga va uning yaqin do'stiga juda yaqin edi. Antiox esa o'zini o'ziga yaqin his qilib, unga ham mol-mulkini, ham sevimli xotini qoldirishni o'yladi. Shuning uchun, o'lim yaqinlashganda, u ularni o'ziga chaqirib, shunday dedi: "Men o'zimni shubhasiz, o'tib ketayotganimni his qilyapman, bu meni xafa qiladi, chunki men hayotda hozirgidek zavq ko'rmaganman."

en: Of one thing, indeed, I die most content, in that, since I must e’en die, I see myself die in the arms of those twain whom I love over all others that be in the world, to wit, in thine, dearest friend, and in those of this lady, whom I have loved more than mine own self, since ﬁrst I knew her.
uz: Bir narsadan, aslida, men eng ko'p qoniqish bilan o'laman, chunki o'lishim kerak bo'lgani uchun, men o'zimni dunyodagi barcha boshqalardan ko'ra, ya'ni, sening eng aziz do'stingda va o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevgan bu xonimning qo'lida o'layotganimni ko'raman, chunki men uni birinchi marta tanidim.

en: True, it grieveth me to feel that, when I am dead, she will abide here a stranger, without aid or counsel; and it were yet more grievous to me, did I not know thee here, who wilt, I trust, have that same care of her, for the love of me, which thou wouldst have had of myself.
uz: Rostini aytsam, o'lganimda, u bu yerda begona, yordamsiz yoki maslahatsiz yashashi meni qayg'uga soladi; va bu men uchun yanada achinarli edi, bu yerda seni bilmasam edi, senga ishonamanki, menga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun unga xuddi shunday g'amxo'rlik qilgansan, o'zingdan bo'lgandek.

en: Wherefore, I entreat thee, as most I may, if it come to pass that I die, that thou take my goods and her into thy charge and do with them and her that which thou deemest may be for the solacement of my soul.
uz: Shuning uchun, men Sendan, agar o'lsam, eng ko'p iltimos qilaman, mening mol-mulkimni va uni o'z zimmangga olgin va ular bilan va uning bilan jonimga tasalli beradigan deb hisoblagan ishingni qilgin.

en: And thou, dearest lady, I prithee forget me not after my death, so I may vaunt me, in the other world, of being beloved here below of the fairest lady ever nature formed; of
uz: Va sen, aziz xonim, men o'limimdan keyin meni unutmasliging kerak, shunda men boshqa dunyoda tabiat yaratgan eng go'zal xonimdan pastroqda sevilganim bilan maqtanishim mumkin;

en: which two things an you will give me entire assurance, I shall depart without misgiving and comforted.’ The merchant his friend and the lady, hearing these words, wept, and when he had made an end of his speech, they comforted him and promised him upon their troth to do that which he asked, if it came to pass that he died.
uz: Siz menga ikki narsa haqida to'liq ishonch berasiz, men hech qanday aybsiz va tasalli bermasdan ketaman. Savdogar do'sti va xonim bu so'zlarni eshitib, yig'lashdi va u so'zini tugatgach, uni tasalli berishdi va agar u o'lsa, u so'ragan narsani qilishga va'da berishdi.

en: He tarried not long, but presently departed this life and was honour- ably interred of them.
uz: U uzoq qolmadi, lekin yaqinda bu hayotdan ketdi va ular bilan faxr bilan dafn etildi.

en: A few days after, the merchant having despatched all his business in Rhodes and purposing to return to Cyprus on board a Catalan carrack that was there, asked the fair lady what she had a mind to do, for that it behoved him return to Cyprus.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, savdogar Rodosga bor-budini jo'natib, u yerda Kataloniya kemasida Kiprga qaytishni maqsad qilganidan so'ng, go'zal xonimdan nima qilishni o'ylayotganini so'radi, chunki bu unga Kiprga qaytishi kerak edi.

en: She answered that, an it pleased him, she would gladly go with him, hoping for Antiochus his love to be of him entreated and regarded as a sister.
uz: U javob berdi: "U unga ma'qul bo'lgani uchun, u bilan xursandchilik bilan borardi, Antioxusning muhabbati undan iltijo qilib, singlisi kabi qabul qilinishini umid qilardi."

en: The merchant replied that he was content to do her every pleasure, and the better to defend her from any affront that might be offered her, ere they came to Cyprus, he avouched that she was his wife.
uz: Savdogar unga har qanday xohish-istakni bajarishga rozi ekanligini va ular Kiprga kelishidan oldin uni har qanday haqoratdan himoya qilish yaxshiroq ekanligini aytdi. U uning xotini ekanligini aytdi.

en: Accordingly, they embarked on board the ship and were given a little cabin on the poop, where, that the fact might not belie his words, he lay with her in one very small bed.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular kemaga chiqishdi va ularga axlat ustidagi kichik bir xona berildi, u yerda, uning so'zlariga ishonmaslik uchun, u bilan birga juda kichik bir karavotda yotardi.

en: Whereby there came about that which was not intended of the one or the other of them at departing Rhodes, to wit, that —darkness and commodity and the heat of the bed, mat- ters of no small potency, inciting them —drawn by equal appetite and for- getting both the friendship and the love of Antiochus dead, they fell to dal- lying with each other and before they reached Baffa, whence the Cypriot came, they had clapped up an alliance together.
uz: Shunday qilib, Rodosga ketayotganda ularning bir-biridan ko'zlangan narsa sodir bo'ldi, ya'ni: zulmat va tovar hamda karavotning issiqligi, hech qanday kuchga ega bo'lmagan gilamlar, ularni qo'zg'atish  teng ishtaha bilan tortib, Antioxning do'stligi va muhabbatini qo'lga kiritib, ular bir-birlari bilan yolg'on gapirishga tushishdi va Baffaga yetib kelishlaridan oldin, u yerdan Kiprlik kelganida, ular birgalikda ittifoq tuzishdi.

en: At Baffa she abode some time with the merchant till, as chance would have it, there came thither, for his occasions, a gentleman by name Antigo- nus, great of years and greater yet of wit, but little of wealth, for that, inter- meddling in the affairs of the King of Cyprus, fortune had in many things been contrary to him.
uz: Baffada u bir muncha vaqt savdogar bilan birga turdi, toki, tasodif bo'lgunga qadar, u yerga uning imkoniyatlari uchun Antigo- nus ismli bir janob keldi. U yoshda katta, lekin aqlli edi, lekin boyligi kam edi, chunki Kipr shohi ishiga aralashib, boylik ko'p narsalarda unga zid edi.

en: Chancing one day to pass by the house where the fair lady dwelt with the merchant, who was then gone with his merchandise into Armenia, he espied her at a window and seeing her very beautiful, fell to gazing ﬁxedly upon her and presently began to recollect that he must have seen her otherwhere, but where he could on no wise call to mind.
uz: Bir kuni go'zal xonim savdogar bilan yashagan uydan o'tib ketish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lib, u o'z tovarlari bilan Armanistonga borgan edi, uni derazadan kuzatib, juda go'zal ko'rdi, unga tikilib qaradi va darhol uni boshqa joyda ko'rgan bo'lishi kerakligini eslay boshladi, lekin u yerda hech qanday eslay olmadi.

en: As for the lady, who had long been the sport of fortune, but the term of whose ills was now drawing near, she no sooner set eyes on Antigonus than she re- membered to have seen him at Alexandria in no mean station in her father’s service; wherefore, conceiving a sudden hope of yet by his aid regaining her royal estate, and knowing her merchant to be abroad, she let call him to her
uz: Xonimga kelsak, u allaqachon omad o'yini bo'lgan, ammo uning kasalliklari davri yaqinlashayotgan edi, u Antigonga ko'z tashlashidan oldin, uni otasining xizmatida hech qanday ahamiyatga ega bo'lmagan holda Iskandariyada ko'rishga kirdi; shuning uchun, uning yordamidan uning qirollik mulkini qaytarib olish va uning savdogari chet elda ekanligini bilgach, u uni chaqirdi.

en: as quickliest she might and asked him, blushing, an he were not, as she sup- posed, Antigonus of Famagosta.
uz: U imkon qadar tezroq harakat qildi va undan qizarib so'radi: "U Famagostalik Antigon emas edi, deb o'yladi u."

en: He answered that he was and added, ‘Madam, meseemeth I know you, but on no wise can I remember me where I have seen you; wherefore I pray you, an it mislike you not, put me in mind who you are.’ The lady hearing that it was indeed he, to his great amazement, cast her arms about his neck, weeping sore, and presently asked him if he had never seen her in Alexandria.
uz: U javob berdi va qo'shib qo'ydi: "Xonim, men sizni bilaman, lekin sizni qayerda ko'rganimni hech qachon eslay olmayman; shuning uchun iltimos qilaman, sizni noto'g'ri ko'rmasin, meni kimligingizni eslang." Xonim bu haqiqatan ham u ekanligini eshitib, juda hayratga tushdi, bo'ynidan quchoqlarini tashladi, achchiq yig'ladi va darhol undan Iskandariyada uni hech qachon ko'rmaganmi, deb so'radi.

en: Antigonus, hearing this, incontinent knew her for the Soldan’s daughter Alatiel, who was thought to have perished at sea, and would fain have paid her the homage due to her quality; but she would on no wise suffer it and besought him to sit with her awhile.
uz: Antigon bu gapni eshitib, uni Soldanning qizi Alatiel deb biladi, u dengizda halok bo'lgan deb o'ylanardi va uning sifati tufayli unga hurmat ko'rsatgan bo'lardi; lekin u bunga hech qanday yo'l qo'ymasdi va undan bir oz vaqt o'tirishni iltimos qildi.

en: Accordingly, seat- ing himself beside her, he asked her respectfully how and when and whence she came thither, seeing that it was had for certain, through all the land of Egypt, that she had been drowned at sea years agone.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, uning yonida o'tirib, u undan qanday, qachon va qayerdan u yerga kelganini hurmat bilan so'radi, chunki Misr zaminida uning bir necha yil oldin dengizda cho'kib ketganligi aniq edi.

en: ‘Would God,’ replied she, ‘it had been so, rather than that I should have had the life I have had; and I doubt not but my father would wish the like, if ever he came to know it.’ So saying, she fell anew to weeping wonder-sore; whereupon quoth Anti- gonus to her, ‘Madam, despair not ere it behove you; but, an it please you, relate to me your adventures and what manner of life yours hath been; it may be the matter hath gone on such wise that, with God’s aid, we may avail to ﬁnd an effectual remedy.’ ‘Antigonus,’ answered the fair lady, ‘when I beheld thee, meseemed I saw my father, and moved by that love and tenderness, which I am bounden to bear him, I discovered myself to thee, having it in my power to conceal myself from thee, and few persons could it have befallen me to look upon in whom I could have been so well- pleased as I am to have seen and known thee before any other; wherefore
uz: Xudo xohlasa edi, javob berdi u, menga bergan hayotim bolgandan kora shunday bolar edi; va men otam ham buni bilsa, xuddi shundayni xohlagan bolishidan shubhalanmayman. Shunday qilib, u yana yiglab, hayratga tushdi; shundan song Anti-gonous unga dedi: Xonim, umidsizlikka tushmang; lekin, iltimos, menga sizning sarguzashtlaringiz va hayotingiz qanday bolganini aytib bering; bu shunday bolishi mumkinki, Xudoning yordami bilan biz samarali davo topishga qodir bolamiz. Antigonus, javob berdi chiroyli xonim, Qachonki men otamni kordim, va men uni sizga kora oldim, men uni sizga qanday qilib kora oldim, men uni sizdan kora oldim va uni qanday qilib kora oldim, men uni sizdan yaxshi kora oldim.

en: that which in my ill fortune I have still kept hidden, to thee, as to a father, I will discover.
uz: Baxtsizlikda hali ham yashirganimni senga otadek ochib beraman.

en: If, after thou hast heard it, thou see any means of restoring me to my pristine estate, prithee use it; but, if thou see none, I beseech thee never tell any that thou hast seen me or heard aught of me.’ This said, she recounted to him, still weeping, that which had befallen her from the time of her shipwreck on Majorca up to that moment; whereupon he fell a-weeping for pity and after considering awhile, ‘Madam,’ said he, ‘since in your misfortunes it hath been hidden who you are, I will, without fail, restore you, dearer than ever, to your father and after to the King of Al- garve to wife.’ Being questioned of her of the means, he showed her orderly
uz: Agar eshitganingizdan so'ng meni o'z asl holatimga qaytarishning biron bir vositasini ko'rsangiz, uni ishlating; lekin agar hech birini ko'rmasangiz, iltimos qilaman, hech qachon menga ko'rganingizni yoki mendan hech narsa eshitganingizni hech kimga aytmang." Bu gapni u unga Mallorca kemasida halokatdan o'sha paytgacha bo'lgan voqeani yig'lab aytib berdi. Shundan so'ng u achinish uchun yig'ladi va biroz o'ylab, "Xonim," dedi u, "Chunki sizning baxtsizligingizda kimligingiz yashirilgan, men sizni hech qachon, otangizga va keyin Al-Ave shohiga nisbatan qadrdonroq qaytaraman."

en: that which was to do, and lest any hindrance should betide through delay, he presently returned to Famagosta and going in to the king, said to him, ‘My lord, an it like you, you have it in your power at once to do yourself exceed- ing honour and me, who am poor through you, a great service, at no great cost of yours.’ The king asked how and Antigonus replied, ‘There is come to Baffa the Soldan’s fair young daughter, who hath so long been reputed drowned and who, to save her honour, hath long suffered very great unease and is presently in poor case and would fain return to her father.
uz: Nima qilish kerak edi, va hech qanday to'sqinlik kechikish orqali kelmasligi uchun, u darhol Famagostaga qaytib keldi va podshoh huzuriga kirib, unga dedi: "Ey hazratim, senga o'xshagan, o'zingni va meni bir zumda haddan tashqari sharaflashga qodirsan, men esa senga katta xizmat qilaman, hech qanday qimmatga arzimayman." Podshoh qanday qilib so'radi va Antigon javob berdi: "Baffa Soldanning go'zal yosh qizi keldi, u juda uzoq vaqtdan beri cho'kib ketgan deb hisoblangan va uning sharafini saqlab qolish uchun juda katta noqulaylikka duch kelgan va hozirda juda kambag'al holatda va otasiga qaytmoqchi edi."

en: An it pleased you send her to him under my guard, it would be much to your hon- our and to my weal, nor do I believe that such a service would ever be for- gotten of the Soldan.’ The king, moved by a royal generosity of mind, answered forthright that he would well and sending for Alatiel, brought her with all honour and wor- ship to Famagosta, where she was received by himself and the queen with inexpressible rejoicing and entertained with magniﬁcent hospitality.
uz: Uni mening qo'riqlashim ostida unga jo'natganingizdan xursand bo'lardim, bu sizning hurmatingiz va mening boyligingiz uchun juda katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lardi, shuningdek, men bunday xizmat Soldan tomonidan hech qachon amalga oshirilishiga ishonmayman." Shoh, shohona saxiy fikridan ta'sirlanib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Alatielni jo'natadi, uni barcha sharaf va tashvish bilan Famagostaga olib keldi, u yerda u o'zi va qirolicha tomonidan ifodasiz quvonch bilan kutib olindi va ajoyib mehmondo'stlik bilan qabul qilindi.

en: Being presently questioned of the king and queen of her adventures, she answered according to the instructions given her by Antigonus and related everything;120 and a few days after, at her request, the king sent her, under the governance of Antigonus, with a goodly and worshipful company of men and women, back to the Soldan, of whom let none ask if she was re- ceived with rejoicing, as also was Antigonus and all her company.
uz: Hozirda o'z sarguzashtlarining shohi va malikasi haqida so'ralganidan so'ng, u Antigon tomonidan berilgan ko'rsatmalarga ko'ra javob berdi va hamma narsani aytib berdi; 120 va bir necha kundan keyin, uning so'roviga ko'ra, shoh uni Antigon hukmronligi ostida, yaxshi va sadoqatli erkaklar va ayollardan iborat jamoa bilan Soldanga qaytardi, ulardan hech kim uni xursandchilik bilan qabul qilgani haqida so'ramadi, xuddi Antigon va uning butun kompaniyasi kabi.

en: As soon as she was somewhat rested, the Soldan desired to know how it chanced that she was yet alive and where she had so long abidden, without having ever let him know aught of her condition; whereupon the lady, who had kept Antigonus his instructions perfectly in mind, bespoke him thus, ‘Father mine, belike the twentieth day after my departure from you, our ship, having sprung a leak in a terrible storm, struck in the night upon cer- tain coasts yonder in the West,121 near a place called Aguamorta, and what became of the men who were aboard I know not nor could ever learn; this much only do I remember that, the day come and I arisen as it were from death to life, the shattered vessel was espied of the country people, who ran from all the parts around to plunder it.
uz: U biroz dam olishi bilanoq, Soldan uning qanday qilib tirik ekanligi va u o'z ahvoli haqida hech narsa bilmasdan uzoq vaqt yashiringanini bilmoqchi edi; shundan so'ng, Antigonusning ko'rsatmalarini mukammal yodga olgan xonim unga shunday dedi: "Otam, xuddi men sizdan ketganimdan keyingi yigirmanchi kundagidek, bizning kemamiz dahshatli bo'ron kelib, G'arbdagi atrofda, Aguamorta deb ataladigan joyga yaqin, tun bo'yi yaqinida 121 yerga urildi va men bilmayman va o'rgana olmagan odamlarning nima bo'lgani haqida eslayman; faqat shuni eslaymanki, kun kelib, men o'limdan turgandek, vayron bo'lgan kemamiz butun mamlakatni kuzatib borardi.

en: I and two of my women were ﬁrst set ashore and the latter were incontinent seized by certain of the young men, who ﬂed with them, one this way and the other that, and what came of them I never knew.
uz: Men va ikki ayolim avval qirg'oqqa qo'yildi va oxirgilari ba'zi yigitlar tomonidan qo'lga olindi, ular bilan birga qochishdi, biri bu yoqqa, ikkinchisi esa boshqa yoqqa, va ulardan nima kelishini hech qachon bilmasdim.

en: As for myself, I was taken, despite my resistance, by two young men, and haled along by the hair, weeping sore the while; but, as they crossed over a
uz: O'zimga kelsak, men qarshiligimga qaramay, ikki yigit tomonidan olib ketildim va sochlarimdan yig'lab olib ketildim; lekin, ular kesib o'tayotganda...

en: road, to enter a great wood, there passed by four men on horseback, whom when my ravishers saw, they loosed me forthwith and took to ﬂight.
uz: Yo'l, katta o'rmonga kirish uchun, u yerda otda uchib o'tgan to'rt kishi bor edi. Zo'ravonlarim ularni ko'rgach, meni darhol qo'yib yuborishdi va qochib ketishdi.

en: The newcomers, who seemed to me persons of great authority, seeing this, ran where I was and asked me many questions; whereto I answered much, but neither understood nor was understanded of them.
uz: Yangi kelganlar, buni ko'rib menga katta hokimiyatga ega odamlardek tuyulganlari, men bor joyga yugurib, menga ko'p savollar berishdi; ularga ko'p javob berdim, lekin ularni tushunmadim ham, tushunmadim ham.

en: However, after long con- sultation they set me on one of their horses and carried me to a convent of women vowed to religion, according to their law, where, whatever they said, I was of all the ladies kindly received and still entreated with honour, and there with great devotion I joined them in serving Saint Waxeth-in- Deepdene, a saint for whom the women of that country have a vast regard.
uz: Ammo uzoq muloqotdan so'ng, meni o'z otlaridan biriga mindirib, o'z qonuniga ko'ra dinga qasamyod qilgan ayollar monastiriga olib borishdi. U yerda, ular nima desangiz ham, meni barcha xonimlar orasida mehribonlik bilan qabul qilishdi va u yerda katta sadoqat bilan ularga Sankt Vakset-in-Depdenega xizmat qilishda qo'shildim, u yerda o'sha yurt ayollari katta hurmatga ega bo'lgan aziz.

en: After I had abidden with them awhile and learned somewhat of their lan- guage, they questioned me of who I was and fearing, an I told the truth, to be expelled from amongst them, as an enemy of their faith, I answered that I was the daughter of a great gentleman of Cyprus, who was sending me to be married in Crete, when, as ill-luck would have it, we had run thither and suffered shipwreck.
uz: Ular bilan bir oz vaqt yashirganimdan va ularning o'z fikr-mulohazalarini o'rganganimdan so'ng, ular meni kimligimdan so'rashdi va qo'rqishardi. Men rostini aytdim, ularning orasidan haydalish uchun, ularning dinining dushmani sifatida, men Kiprlik buyuk janobning qizi ekanligimni, u meni Kritga turmushga yuborayotganini aytdim, qachonki omadsizlik bo'lsa, u yerga yugurib borib, kemaning halokatini boshdan kechirgan edik.

en: Moreover, many a time and in many things I observed their customs, for fear of worse, and being asked by the chief of the ladies, her whom they call abbess, if I wished to return thence to Cyprus, I answered that I desired nothing so much; but she, tender of my honour, would never consent to trust me to any person who was bound for Cyprus, till some two months agone, when there came thither certain gentlemen of France with their ladies.
uz: Qolaversa, ko'p vaqtlar va ko'p narsalarda men ularning odatlariga rioya qilardim, yomonroq bo'lishdan qo'rqib va ularni abbis deb ataydigan xonimlarning boshliqlaridan so'rashganda, u yerdan Kiprga qaytishni xohlasam, deb javob berdim, men bunchalik ko'p narsa xohlamayman; lekin u, hurmatim uchun, Kiprga boradigan har qanday odamga meni ishonishga hech qachon rozi bo'lmasdi, to ikki oy o'tmaguncha, u yerga Fransiyalik ba'zi janoblar o'z xonimlari bilan kelishdi.

en: One of the latter being a kinswoman of the abbess and she hearing that they were bound for Jerusalem, to visit the Sepulchre where He whom they hold God was buried, after He had been slain by the Jews, she commended me to their care and besought them to deliver me to my father in Cyprus.
uz: Oxirgilardan biri abbatning qarindoshi bo'lib, ular Quddusga, Xudo deb hisoblagan Zot dafn etilgan qabrga tashrif buyurish uchun borayotganlarini eshitib, yahudiylar tomonidan o'ldirilganidan so'ng, meni ularning g'amxo'rligiga topshirdi va ulardan meni Kiprdagi otamga topshirishlarini iltimos qildi.

en: With what honour these gentlemen entreated me and how cheerfully they received me together with their ladies, it were a long story to tell; sufﬁce it to say that we took ship and came, after some days, to Baffa, where ﬁnding myself arrived and knowing none in the place, I knew not what to say to the gentlemen, who would fain have delivered me to my father, according to that which had been enjoined them of the reverend lady; but God, taking pity belike on my afﬂiction, brought me Antigonus upon the beach what time we disembarked at Baffa, whom I straightway hailed and in our tongue, so as not to be understood of the gentlemen and their ladies, bade him receive me as a daughter.
uz: Bu janoblar meni qanday sharaf bilan iltijo qilishdi va xonimlari bilan birga meni qanchalik quvnoq kutib olishdi, bu uzoq hikoya edi; bir necha kundan so'ng kemaga chiqib, Baffaga yetib keldik, u yerga o'zim yetib kelganimni va hech kimni bilmasligimni bilmasdim. Meni otamga topshirgan janoblarga nima deyishni bilmasdim, hurmatli xonim ularga buyurganidek; lekin Xudo, mening dardimga rahm qilganidek, meni Baffaga chiqqanimizda, plyajga Antigonusni olib keldi. Men uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kutib oldim va ularning xonimlari tomonidan tushunil bo'lmasligi uchun, uni qiz sifatida qabul qilishni buyurdim.

en: He promptly apprehended me and receiving me with a great show of joy, entertained the gentlemen and their ladies with
uz: U meni tezda ushladi va katta quvonch bilan kutib oldi, janoblar va ularning xonimlarini xursand qildi.

en: such honour as his poverty permitted and carried me to the King of Cyprus, who received me with such hospitality and hath sent me back to you [with such courtesy] as might never be told of me.
uz: Uning qashshoqligi meni Kipr shohi huzuriga olib borishga imkon berdi, u meni shunday mehmondo'stlik bilan qabul qildi va meni sizlarning oldingizga qaytarib yubordi, bu haqda hech qachon aytib bo'lmas edi.

en: If aught remain to be said, let Antigonus, who hath ofttimes heard from me these adventures, recount it.’ Accordingly Antigonus, turning to the Soldan, said, ‘My lord, even as she hath many a time told me and as the gentlemen and ladies, with whom she came, said to me, so hath she recounted unto you.
uz: Agar aytishga arziydigan biror narsa qolsa, Antigon, mendan bu sarguzashtlarni ko'p eshitgan odam, buni aytib bersin." Shunga ko'ra, Antigon soldanga o'girildi va dedi: "Ey xo'jayinim, u menga ko'p marta aytganidek va u kelgan janoblar va xonimlar menga aytganidek, u ham sizga aytib berdi."

en: Only one part hath she forborne to tell you, the which methinketh she left unsaid for that it be- seemeth her not to tell it, to wit, how much the gentlemen and ladies, with whom she came, said of the chaste and modest life which she led with the religious ladies and of her virtue and commendable manners and the tears and lamentations of her companions, both men and women, when, having restored her to me, they took leave of her.
uz: Faqatgina bir qismini aytishni unutdi, uni aytmagan deb o'ylaydi, chunki u buni aytmaydiganga o'xshaydi, ya'ni u kelgan janoblar va xonimlar diniy xonimlar bilan o'tkazgan odob-axloq va kamtarona hayotlari, uning fazilatlari, maqtalgan xulq-atvorlari, erkaklar va ayollar bo'lgan hamrohlari, uni menga qaytarganlaridan keyin, ular uni tark etganlarida.

en: Of which things were I fain to tell in full that which they said to me, not only this present day, but the ensuing night would not sufﬁce unto us; be it enough to say only that (according to that which their words attested and that also which I have been able to see thereof), you may vaunt yourself of having the fairest daughter and the chastest and most virtuous of any prince that nowadays weareth a crown.’ The Soldan was beyond measure rejoiced at these things and besought God again and again to vouchsafe him of His grace the power of worthily requiting all who had succoured his daughter and especially the King of Cyprus, by whom she had been sent back to him with honour.
uz: Ularning menga aytganlarini faqat shu kun emas, balki keyingi tun ham bizga yetarli bo'lmas edi; faqatgina shunday deyish kifoya edi (ularning so'zlari tasdiqlagan va men bundan ham ko'ra olgan narsalarga ko'ra), siz o'zingizni eng go'zal qizi va hozirda toj kiygan har qanday shahzodalarning eng chiroyli va fazilatli biri bilan maqtanishingiz mumkin edi.

en: After some days, having caused prepare great gifts for Antigonus, he gave him leave to return to Cyprus and rendered, both by letters and by special ambassadors, the utmost thanks to the king for that which he had done with his daughter.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, Antigon uchun katta sovg'alar tayyorlab qo'yganidan so'ng, u Kiprga qaytish uchun ruxsat berdi va qiziga qilgan ishi uchun qirolga xatlar va maxsus elchilar orqali eng katta minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

en: Then desiring that that which was begun should have effect, to wit, that she should be the wife of the King of Algarve, he acquainted the latter with the whole matter and wrote to him to boot, that, an it pleased him have her, he should send for her.
uz: So'ngra boshlangan narsa, ya'ni, u Algarve qirolining xotini bo'lishini istar ekan, u oxirgi qizni butun masala bilan tanishtirdi va unga xat yo'lladi, agar u unga yoqqan bo'lsa, u uni chaqirib yuborishi kerak edi.

en: The King of Algarve was mightily rejoiced at this news and sending for her in state, received her joyfully; and she, who had lain with eight men belike ten thousand times, was put to bed to him for a maid and making him believe that she was so, lived happily with him as his queen awhile after; wherefore it was said, ‘Lips for kissing forfeit no fa- vour; nay, they renew as the moon doth ever.’ ”
uz: Algarve qiroli bu xabardan juda xursand bo'ldi va uni xursandchilik bilan qabul qildi. U o'n ming marta sakkizta erkak bilan yotgan edi, unga xizmatkor sifatida yotqizildi va unga shunday ekanligiga ishontirildi, keyinchalik u bilan malika sifatida baxtli yashadi; shuning uchun aytildi: "O'pish uchun lablar hech qachon o'tmaydi; yo'q, ular oy kabi yangilanadi."

en: THE EIGHTH STORY The Count of Antwerp, being falsely accused, goeth into exile and leaveth his two children in different places in England, whither, after awhile, returning in disguise and ﬁnding them in good case, he taketh service as a horseboy in the service of the King of France and being approved innocent, is restored to his former estate.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Antverpen grafi, soxta ayblanib, surgunga ketadi va ikki farzandini Angliyada turli joylarda qoldiradi. U yerda, bir oz vaqtdan so'ng, niqobda qaytib kelib, ularni yaxshi holatda topib, Fransiya qirolining xizmatida otboz sifatida xizmat qiladi va begunoh deb topilgach, o'zining sobiq mulkiga qaytariladi.

en: The ladies sighed amain over the fortunes of the fair Saracen; but who knoweth what gave rise to those sighs?
uz: Xonimlar go'zal Saracenning boyliklari haqida hayratda xotirjam bo'lishdi; lekin bu xotirjamlikni keltirib chiqaradigan narsa kimga ma'lum?

en: Maybe there were some of them who sighed no less for envy of such frequent nuptials than for pity of Al- atiel.
uz: Ehtimol, ularning ba'zilari Al-atielga achinishdan ko'ra, bunday tez-tez to'ylarga hasad qilishdan kamroq xafa bo'lmaganlardir.

en: But, leaving that be for the present, after they had laughed at Pamﬁlo’s last words, the queen, seeing his story ended, turned to Elisa and bade her follow on with one of hers.
uz: Ammo, buni hozircha qoldirib, ular Pamfiloning so'nggi so'zlaridan kulgandan so'ng, malika uning hikoyasi tugagandan so'ng, Elisaga o'girilib, uni o'zidan biri bilan davom ettirishga buyurdi.

en: Elisa cheerfully obeyed and began as follows: “A most ample ﬁeld is that wherein we go today a-ranging, nor is there any of us but could lightly enough run, not one, but half a score courses there, so abounding hath Fortune made it in her strange and grievous chances; wherefore, to come to tell of one of these latter, which are innumerable, I say that: When the Roman Empire was transferred from the French to the Ger- mans,122 there arose between the one and the other nation an exceeding great enmity and a grievous and continual war, by reason whereof, as well for the defence of their own country as for the offence of that of others, the King of France and a son of his, with all the power of their realm and of such friends and kinsfolk as they could command, levied a mighty army to go forth upon the foe; and ere they proceeded thereunto —not to leave the realm without governance —knowing
uz: Elisa xursand bo'lib itoat qildi va quyidagicha boshladi: Eng keng maydon shuki, biz bugun sayohat qilayotgan joyda, hech birimiz yengil yugurib bo'lmaymiz, u yerda bir emas, balki yarim ball yugurib, shunchalik ko'p omad g'alati va og'riqli imkoniyatlarga ega bo'ldi; shuning uchun, bu oxirgi imkoniyatlardan biri haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, ular son-sanoqsiz: Rim imperiyasi fransuzlardan germanlarga o'tkazilganda, 122, bir va boshqa millat o'rtasida juda katta dushmanlik va og'riqli va uzluksiz urush paydo bo'ldi, chunki ular o'z mamlakatlarini himoya qilish uchun, shuningdek, boshqalarning qirollari, Fransiya o'g'li va uning o'g'li uchun, o'z saltanatlari va do'stlari va xalqlarining barcha kuchini sarflab, ular qo'ldan boy berishga majbur bo'lishdi;

en: Gautier, Count of Antwerp,123 for a noble and discreet gentleman and their very faithful friend and servant, and for that (albeit he was well versed in the art of war) he seemed to them
uz: Gautier, Antverpen grafi, 123 olijanob va ehtiyotkor janob va ularning juda sadoqatli do'sti va xizmatkori uchun, va buning uchun ( garchi u urush san'atidan yaxshi xabardor bo'lsa ham) ularga ko'rindi.

en: more apt unto things delicate than unto martial toils, they left him vicar general in their stead over all the governance of the realm of France and went on their way.
uz: Harbiy mehnatdan ko'ra nozik narsalarga ko'proq moyil bo'lganlar, Fransiya saltanatining butun hukumati ustidan general vicardni o'z o'rniga qoldirib, yo'lga tushishdi.

en: Gautier accordingly addressed himself with both order and discretion to the ofﬁce committed unto him, still conferring of everything with the queen and her daughter-in-law, whom, for all they were left under his custody and jurisdiction, he honoured none the less as his liege ladies and mistresses.
uz: Gautier o'ziga yuklatilgan lavozimga ham tartibli, ham ixchamlik bilan murojaat qildi, shunga qaramay, hamma narsani qirolicha va keliniga topshirdi. Ularning barchasi uning qo'l ostida va yurisdiktsiyasida qolgan bo'lsa ham, u ularni o'zining hurmatli xonimlari va bekasi sifatida hech kimga kam bo'lmagan darajada hurmat ko'rsatdi.

en: Now this Gautier was exceedingly goodly of his body, being maybe forty years old and as agreeable and well-mannered a gentleman as might be; and withal, he was the sprightliest and daintiest cavalier known in those days and he who went most adorned of his person.
uz: Endi bu Gutier tanasi juda yaxshi edi, ehtimol qirq yoshda edi va u imkon qadar xushmuomala va yaxshi xulqli janob edi; va shunga qaramay, u o'sha davrda tanilgan eng yorqin va nafis chavandoz edi va o'z shaxsiyatidan eng ko'p bezangan edi.
