en: His countess was dead, leav- ing him two little children, a boy and a girl, without more, and it befell that, the King of France and his son being at the war aforesaid and Gautier using much at the court of the aforesaid ladies and speaking often with them of the affairs of the kingdom, the wife of the king’s son cast her eyes on him and considering his person and his manners with very great affection, was secretly ﬁred with a fervent love for him.
uz: Grafinasi vafot etgan edi, unga ikki kichkina bola, bir o'g'il va bir qizni qoldirib, hech narsa qolmadi. Va shunday bo'ldiki, Fransiya qiroli va uning o'g'li urushda bo'lishganda va Gautier yuqorida aytilgan xonimlarning saroyida ko'p ishlatib, ular bilan qirollik ishlari haqida tez-tez gapirishganda, qirolning o'g'lining xotini unga ko'zini tashladi va uning shaxsiyatini va odobini juda katta mehr bilan ko'rib, yashirincha unga nisbatan qizg'in muhabbat bilan ishqalashdi.

en: Feeling herself young and lusty and knowing him wifeless, she doubted not but her desire might lightly be accomplished unto her and thinking nought hindered her thereof but shame- fastness, she bethought herself altogether to put that away and discover to him her passion.
uz: O'zini yosh va shahvoniy his qilib, uni xotinsiz deb bilgan holda, u shubha qilmadi, chunki uning istagi unga osonlikcha amalga oshishi mumkin edi va unga bundan hech narsa to'sqinlik qilmadi, faqat uyat - qattiqqo'llik, u o'zini butunlay o'sha narsani chetga surib, unga o'z ishtiyoqini topishni o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, being one day alone and it seeming to her time, she sent for him into her chamber, as though she would discourse with him of other matters.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir kun yolg'iz bo'lib, uning vaqti kelgandek tuyulgach, u uni o'z xonasiga chaqirtirdi, go'yo u bilan boshqa masalalar haqida gaplashgandek edi.

en: The count, whose thought was far from that of the lady, betook himself to her without any delay and at her bidding, seated himself by her side on a couch; then, they being alone together, he twice asked her the occasion for which she had caused him come thither; but she made him no reply.
uz: Graf, xonimning fikridan yiroq bo'lgan holda, hech qanday kechiktirmasdan va uning buyrug'iga ko'ra uning yoniga keldi va divanda uning yonida o'tirdi; keyin, ular birga yolg'iz bo'lganlarida, u undan uni u yerga kelishiga sababini ikki marta so'radi; lekin u unga hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: At last, urged by love and grown all vermeil for shame, well nigh in tears and all trembling, with broken speech she thus began to say: ‘Dearest and sweet friend and my lord, you may easily as a man of understanding apprehend how great is the frailty both of men and of women, and that more, for divers reasons, in one than in another; wherefore, at the hands of a just judge, the same sin in diverse kinds of qualities of persons should not in equity receive one same punishment.
uz: Nihoyat, sevgi tomonidan rag'batlantirilib, sharmandalik uchun butunlay o'sdi, ko'z yoshlariga yaqin va butunlay titradi, buzilgan nutq bilan u shunday dedi: "Aziz va shirin do'stim va xo'jayinim, siz aql-idrokli inson sifatida erkaklar va ayollarning zaifligi qanchalik buyuk ekanligini va boshqa sabablarga ko'ra, bir-biridan ko'ra ko'proq ekanligini tushunishingiz mumkin; shuning uchun, adolatli hakamning qo'lida, odamlarning turli xil sifatlarida bir xil gunoh adolatda bir xil jazoga tortilmasligi kerak."

en: And who is there will deny that a poor man or a poor woman, whom it behoveth gain with their toil that which is needful for their livelihood, would, an they were stricken with Love’s smart and followed after him, be far more blameworthy than a lady who is rich and idle and to
uz: Va u yerda kim kambag'al erkak yoki kambag'al ayol bo'lishini inkor qiladi, agar u o'z mehnatlari bilan tirikchilik uchun zarur bo'lgan narsani qozonsa, ular sevgi bilan urilgan va unga ergashgan bo'lsalar, boy va bekorchi ayoldan ko'ra ancha aybdor bo'lishadi va...

en: whom nothing is lacking that can ﬂatter her desires?
uz: Uning istaklariga mos keladigan hech narsa yetishmayotgan odammi?

en: Certes, I believe, no one.
uz: Albatta, menimcha, hech kim emas.

en: For which reason methinketh the things aforesaid [to wit, wealth and leisure and luxurious living] should furnish forth a very great measure of excuse on behalf of her who possesseth them, if, peradventure, she suffer herself lapse into loving, and the having made choice of a lover of worth and discretion should stand for the rest,124 if she who loveth hath done that.
uz: Shuning uchun, yuqorida aytilgan narsalar [masalan, boylik va dam olish va hashamatli hayot] ularga ega bo'lgan ayol uchun juda katta bahona taqdim etishi kerak, agar, tasodifan, u o'zini sevgiga yo'naltirsa va qadr-qimmatga ega va ehtiyotkor sevgini tanlagan bo'lsa, qolganlari uchun turishi kerak, 124 agar sevgan kishi shunday qilgan bo'lsa.

en: These circumstances being both, to my seeming, in myself (beside several others which should move me to love, such as my youth and the absence of my husband), it behoveth now that they rise up in my behalf for the defence of my ardent love in your sight, wherein if they avail that which they should avail in the eyes of men of understanding, I pray you afford me counsel and succour in that which I shall ask of you.
uz: Bu holatlar ham, menimcha, o'zimda (masalan, yoshligim va erimning yo'qligi kabi meni sevishga undashi kerak bo'lgan bir nechta holatlar bilan birga), hozir ular mening nomimdan ko'z o'ngingizda mening achchiq muhabbatimni himoya qilish uchun ko'tarilishi kerak. Agar ular tushunadigan odamlar ko'z o'ngida foydali bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsani qo'lga kiritsalar, sizdan so'ragan narsada maslahat va yordam berishni so'rayman.

en: True is it, that availing not, for the absence of my husband, to withstand the pricks of the ﬂesh nor the might of love-liking, the which are of such potency that they have erst many a time overcome and yet all days long overcome the strongest men, to say nothing of weak women —and enjoying the commodities and the leisures wherein you see me, I have suffered myself lapse into ensuing love his pleasures and becoming enamoured; the which —albeit, were it known, I acknowledge it would not be seemly, yet —being and abiding hidden, I hold125 well nigh nothing unseemly; more by token that Love hath been insomuch gracious to me that not only hath he not bereft me of due discernment in the choice of a lover, but hath lent me great plenty thereof126 to that end, showing me your- self worthy to be loved of a lady such as I —you whom, if my fancy beguile me not, I hold the goodliest, the most
uz: Rostmi, erim yo'qligi sababli, na taning tikanlariga bardosh berishga, na muhabbatni yoqtirish kuchiga, ular juda ko'p vaqtdan beri kuchli erkaklarni yengib o'tgan, ammo barcha kunlar davomida eng kuchli erkaklarni yengib o'tgan, zaif ayollarni aytmasa ham bo'ladi  va siz meni ko'rayotgan tovarlar va dam olishlardan bahramand bo'lib, men o'zimni muhabbatga yo'naltirdim va uning lazzatlariga oshiq bo'lib qoldim; bu  garchi ma'lum bo'lsa ham, ko'rinmas edi, lekin  yashirin bo'lib, yashirin, men hech narsani yaxshi ko'rmayman; bundan tashqari, Sevgi menga shunchalik marhamatli bo'ldiki, u nafaqat meni sevgan odamni tanlashda ko'rishga arziydi, balki men sizga ko'rishga arziydi,

en: agreeable, the sprightliest and the most accomplished cavalier that may be found in all the realm of France; and even as I may say that I ﬁnd myself without a husband, so likewise are you without a wife.
uz: Ma'qul, Fransiya olamida topilishi mumkin bo'lgan eng yorqin va eng yetuk chavandoz; va men o'zimni ersiz topganimni aytganimdek, siz ham xotinimizsizsiz.

en: Wherefore, I pray you, by the great love which I bear you, that you deny me not your love in return, but have compassion on my youth, the which, in very deed, consumeth for you, as ice before the ﬁre.’ With these words her tears welled up in such abundance that, albeit she would fain have proffered him yet other prayers, she had no power to speak farther, but, bowing her face, as if overcome, she let herself fall, weeping, her head on the count’s bosom.
uz: Shuning uchun, senga bo'lgan ulkan muhabbatim bilan iltimos qilaman, menga muhabbatingni rad etma, balki yoshligimga rahm qilgin, u aslida senga olov oldidagi muz kabi yonadi. Bu so'zlar bilan uning ko'z yoshlari shunchalik ko'p to'kildiki, garchi unga boshqa ibodatlar qilmoqchi bo'lsa ham, u boshqa gapirishga qodir emas edi, lekin yuzini egib, go'yo yengilgandek, u yig'lab, boshini grafning ko'ksiga tashladi.

en: The latter, who was a very loyal gentleman, began with the gravest reproofs to rebuke so fond a passion and to repel the princess, who would fain have cast herself on his neck, avouching to her with oaths that he had liefer be torn limb from limb than consent unto such an offence against his lord’s honour, whether in himself or in another.
uz: Oxirgisi, juda sadoqatli janob bo'lgan u, shunchalik qattiq ehtirosni tanbeh berish va malikaga qarshi turishni boshladi. Malika o'zini uning bo'yniga tashlagan bo'lardi, unga qasam ichib, o'z xo'jayinining sha'niga qarshi bunday huquqbuzarlikka rozi bo'lishdan ko'ra, oyoq-qo'llarini uzishni afzal ko'rardi, xoh o'zi bo'lsa, xoh boshqasida.

en: lady, hearing this, forthright forgot her love and kindling into a furious rage, said, ‘Felon knight that you are, shall I be this wise ﬂouted by you of my desire?
uz: Xonim buni eshitib, darhol o'z muhabbatini unutdi va g'azabga to'lib, dedi: Sen soxta ritsar ekansan, men senga nisbatan o'z xohishimdan shunchalik dono bo'lishim kerakmi?

en: Now God forbid, since you would have me die, but I have you put to death or driven from the world!’ So saying, she set her hands to her tresses and altogether disordered and tore them; then, rending her raiment at the breast, she fell to crying aloud and saying, ‘Help!
uz: Endi Xudo saqlasin, chunki sen meni o'ldirmoqchi eding, lekin men seni o'ldirdim yoki dunyodan haydadim! Shunday qilib, u qo'llarini o'zining to'rlariga qo'ydi va butunlay tartibsiz qilib, ularni yirtib tashladi; keyin, ko'kragidagi kiyimini yirtib, baland ovozda yig'lab dedi: Yordam bering!

en: The Count of Antwerp would do me violence.’ The count, seeing this, misdoubting far more the courtiers’ envy than his own conscience and fearful lest, by reason of this same envy, more credence should be given to the lady’s malice than to his own innocence, started up and departing the chamber and the palace as quickliest he might, ﬂed to his own house, where, without taking other counsel, he set his children on horseback and mounting himself to horse, made off with them, as most he might, towards Calais.
uz: Antverpen grafi menga zo'ravonlik qilardi. Buni ko'rgan graf, saroy a'zolarini o'z vijdonidan ko'ra ko'proq shubhalantirib, xuddi shu hasad tufayli xonimning yovuzligiga o'z begunohligidan ko'ra ko'proq ishonch berilmasligi kerakligidan qo'rqib, qo'lidan kelganicha xonadan va saroydan chiqib, o'z uyiga qochib ketdi. U yerda, boshqa maslahatlarsiz, bolalarini otga mindirib, o'zini otga minib, ular bilan imkon qadar, Kale tomon yo'l oldi.

en: Meanwhile, many ran to the princess’s clamour and seeing her in that plight and hearing [her account of] the cause of her outcry, not only gave credence to her words, but added127 that the count’s gallant bearing and de- bonair address had long been used by him to win to that end.
uz: Ayni paytda ko'pchilik malikaga yugurib bordi, uni o'sha ahvolda ko'rib va uning noroziligi sababini eshitib, nafaqat uning so'zlariga ishondi, balki 127 ta qo'shimcha qildilarki, grafning jasoratli xulq-atvori va de-bonair murojaatlari u tomonidan shu maqsadda g'alaba qozonish uchun allaqachon ishlatilgan edi.

en: Accordingly, they ran in a fury to his houses to arrest him, but ﬁnding him not, ﬁrst plundered them all and after razed them to the foundations.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular uni hibsga olish uchun g'azab bilan uning uylariga yugurishdi, lekin topolmay, avval ularning hammasini talon-toroj qilishdi, keyin esa poydevorlargacha vayron qilishdi.

en: The news, in its perverted shape, came presently to the army to the king and his son, who, sore incensed, doomed Gautier and his descendants to perpetual banish- ment, promising very great guerdons to whoso should deliver him to them alive or dead.
uz: Xabar, o'zining buzuq shaklida, tez orada shoh va uning o'g'liga armiyaga yetib keldi. Ular g'azablanib, Gautier va uning avlodlarini abadiy surgun qilishga hukm qilishdi va uni tirik yoki o'lik holda ularga topshirish kerak bo'lganlarga juda katta qo'riqchilarni va'da qilishdi.

en: The count, woeful for that by his ﬂight he had, innocent as he was, ap- proved himself guilty, having, without making himself known or being re- cognized, reached Calais with his children, passed hastily over into England and betook himself in mean apparel to London, wherein ere he entered, with many words he lessoned his two little children, and especially in two things; ﬁrst, that they should brook with patience the poor estate, where- unto, without their fault, fortune had brought them, together with himself — and after, that with all wariness they should keep themselves from ever dis- covering unto any whence or whose children they were, as they held life dear.
uz: Graf, o'z qochishi tufayli afsusda edi, begunoh bo'lgani uchun, o'zini aybdor deb isbotladi, o'zini ko'rsatmasdan yoki qayta tanishtirmasdan, bolalari bilan Kalaga yetib borib, shoshilinch ravishda Angliyaga o'tib, o'zini oddiy kiyimda Londonga olib bordi. U yerga kirishdan oldin, ko'p so'zlar bilan ikki kichkina farzandini, ayniqsa, ikki narsaga o'rgatdi: birinchidan, ular sabr bilan bechora mulkni, ularning aybi yo'q boylikni olib kelgan joyni, o'zi bilan birga, va keyin esa, barcha ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'zlarini hech qachon yashirmasliklari kerak edi, qayerga yoki kimning bolalari bor edi, ular hayotga aziz edilar.

en: The boy, Louis by name, who was some nine and the girl, who was called Violante and was some seven years old, both, as far as their tender age comported, very well apprehended their father’s lessons and showed it thereafter by deed.
uz: Bola, ismi Lui bo'lgan, taxminan to'qqiz yoshda edi, va qiz, Violante deb atalgan va taxminan yetti yoshda edi, ikkalasi ham o'z yoshlariga ko'ra, otasining saboqlarini juda yaxshi tushunib yetishgan va keyin ularni amalda ko'rsatishgan.

en: That this might be the better done,128 he deemed it well to change their names; wherefore he named the boy Perrot and the girl Jean-
uz: Buning yaxshiroq bo'lishi uchun, 128 u ularning ismlarini o'zgartirishni ma'qul ko'rdi; shuning uchun u o'g'ilga Perrot va qizga Jean deb ism qo'ydi.

en: nette and all three, entering London, meanly clad, addressed themselves to go about asking alms, like as we see yonder French vagabonds do.
uz: Nette va ularning uchalasi ham Londonga kirib, mayda kiyim kiygan holda, o'zlarini sadaqa so'rash uchun yo'naltirishdi, xuddi u yerda ko'rayotgan fransuz vahshiylari kabi.

en: They being on this account one morning at a church door, it chanced that a certain great lady, the wife of one of the king’s marshals of England, com- ing forth of the church, saw the count and his two little ones asking alms and questioned him whence he was and if the children were his, to which he replied that he was from Picardy and that, by reason of the misfeasance of a rakehelly elder son of his, it had behoved him depart the country with these two, who were his.
uz: Ular shu sababli bir kuni ertalab cherkov eshigida bo'lishdi, shunday bo'ldiki, Angliya qirolining marshallaridan birining xotini, cherkovdan chiqib kelayotganda, graf va uning ikki kichkina bolasi sadaqa so'rayotganini ko'rib, undan qayerdan kelganini va bolalar o'ziniki ekanligini so'rashdi. U unga Pikardiyadan ekanligini va uning katta o'g'lining noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlari tufayli bu ikki kishi bilan mamlakatni tark etishga majbur bo'lganini aytdi.

en: The lady, who was pitiful, cast her eyes on the girl and being much taken with her, for that she was handsome, well-mannered and engaging, said, ‘Honest man, an thou be content to leave thy daughter with me, I will willingly take her, for that she hath a good favour, and if she prove an honest woman, I will in due time marry her on such wise that she shall fare well.’ This offer was very pleasing to the count, who promptly answered, ‘Yes,’ and with tears gave up the girl to the lady, urgently com- mending her to her care.
uz: Ayol, achinarli bo'lgani uchun, qizga ko'zlarini qaratdi va uni juda yaxshi ko'rishdi, chunki u chiroyli, yaxshi xulqli va qiziqarli edi, dedi: "Ey halol inson, agar sen qizingni men bilan qoldirmoqchi bo'lsang, men uni o'zim xohlab olaman, chunki u yaxshilik ko'rsatadi va agar u halol ayol bo'lsa, o'z vaqtida unga shunday turmushga chiqamanki, unga yaxshilik yetadi." Bu taklif grafga juda yoqdi, u tezda javob berdi: "Ha," va yosh bilan qizni xonimga topshirdi, uni zudlik bilan tuzatadi.

en: Having thus disposed of his daughter, well knowing to whom, he re- solved to abide there no longer and accordingly, begging his way across the island, came, not without sore fatigue, as one who was unused to go afoot, into Wales.
uz: Shunday qilib, qizini yo'qotib qo'yib, kimga murojaat qilishni yaxshi bilgach, u yerda qolishga qaror qildi va shunga ko'ra, orol bo'ylab yolvorib, Uelsga borishga odatlanmagan odam kabi, og'riqli charchoqsiz kelmadi.

en: Here dwelt another of the king’s marshals, who held great state and entertained a numerous household, and to his court both the count and his son whiles much resorted to get food.
uz: Bu yerda qirolning yana bir marshallari yashagan edi, u katta davlatga ega edi va ko'p xonadonni boqardi. Uning saroyiga graf ham, o'g'li ham ko'p marta ovqat olish uchun murojaat qilardi.

en: Certain sons of the said marshal and other gentlemen’s children being there engaged in such boyish exer- cises as running and leaping, Perrot began to mingle with them and to do as dextrously as any of the rest, or more so, each feat that was practised among them.
uz: U yerda marshalning ayrim o'g'illari va boshqa janoblarning bolalari yugurish va sakrash kabi bolalarcha mashqlarda ishtirok etayotgan edi, Perrot ular bilan aralashib, ular orasida mashq qilingan har bir featni qolganlar kabi jirkanchlik bilan bajarishni boshladi.

en: The marshal, chancing whiles to see this and being much taken with the manners and fashion of the boy, asked who he was and was told that he was the son of a poor man who came there bytimes for alms; whereupon he caused require him of the count, and the latter, who indeed besought God of nought else, freely resigned the boy to him, grievous as it was to him to be parted from him.
uz: Marshal buni ko'rishga va bolaning odob-axloqi va uslubiga juda qiziqib, u kimligini so'radi va unga u yerga vaqti-vaqti bilan sadaqa qilish uchun kelgan bir kambag'al odamning o'g'li ekanligini aytishdi; shundan so'ng u uni hisobdan talab qildi va oxirgi, aslida hech narsadan boshqa hech narsa so'ramagan, bolani undan ayrilish uchun qayg'urib, unga bemalol topshirib yubordi.

en: Having thus provided his son and daughter, he determined to abide no longer in England and passing over into Ireland, made his way, as best he might, to Stamford, where he took service with a knight belong- ing to an earl of the country, doing all such things as pertain unto a lackey or a horseboy, and there, without being known of any, he abode a great while in unease and travail galore.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'g'li va qizini ta'minlab, u Angliyada qolmaslikka va Irlandiyaga o'tishga qaror qildi, qo'lidan kelgancha Stamfordga yo'l oldi, u yerda mamlakat grafligiga tegishli ritsar bilan xizmat qildi, lakey yoki ot bolasiga tegishli bo'lgan barcha ishlarni qildi va u yerda hech kimga ma'lum bo'lmay, uzoq vaqt noqulaylik va mehnatda qoldi.

en: Meanwhile Violante, called Jeannette, went waxing with the gentlewo- man in London in years and person and beauty and was in such favour both with the lady and her husband and with every other of the house and whoso else knew her, that it was a marvellous thing to see; nor was there any who noted her manners and fashions but avouched her worthy of every greatest good and honour.
uz: Ayni paytda Violante, Jeannette deb atalgan, Londondagi muloyim odam bilan yillar davomida, shaxsan va go'zallikda mashhur bo'lib yurardi va xonim, uning eri, uyning har bir a'zosi va uni taniydiganlarning hammasi bilan shunchalik yaxshi munosabatda ediki, buni ko'rish ajoyib narsa edi; shuningdek, uning odoblari va modalarini qayd etadigan, lekin har qanday buyuk yaxshilik va sharafga loyiq deb hisoblaydigan hech kim yo'q edi.

en: Wherefore the noble lady who had received her from her father, without having ever availed to learn who he was, otherwise than as she had heard from himself, was purposed to marry her honourably accord- ing to that condition whereof she deemed her.
uz: Shunday qilib, uni otasidan olgan olijanob xonim, uning kimligini hech qachon bilishga ulgurmagan holda, o'zidan eshitganidan boshqa narsani bilmagan holda, unga hurmat bilan turmushga chiqishni maqsad qilgan edi - uni o'zi deb hisoblagan shartga ko'ra.

en: But God, who is a just ob- server of folk’s deserts, knowing her to be of noble birth and to bear, without fault, the penalty of another’s sin, ordained otherwise, and fain must we believe that He of His benignity permitted that which came to pass to the end that the gentle damsel might not fall into the hands of a man of low estate.
uz: Lekin Xudo, xalqning sahrolariga adolatli xizmatkor bo'lgan, uni olijanob zot ekanligini biladi va boshqalarning gunohlari uchun jazosini aybsiz ko'tarishi kerakligini biladi, boshqacha qilib tayinlangan edi va biz Uning mehribonligi bilan muloyim qizning past darajadagi odamning qo'liga tushmasligi uchun sodir bo'lgan narsaga ruxsat berganligiga ishonishimiz kerak.

en: The noble lady with whom Jeannette dwelt had of her husband one only son, whom both she and his father loved with an exceeding love, both for that he was their child and that he deserved it by reason of his worth and virtues.
uz: Jeannette yashagan olijanob xonimning eridan yagona o'g'li bor edi, uni u ham, otasi ham haddan tashqari mehr bilan sevishardi, chunki u ularning farzandi edi va u bunga o'z qadri va fazilatlari tufayli loyiq edi.

en: He, being some six years older than Jeannette and seeing her ex- ceeding fair and graceful, became so sore enamoured of her that he saw nought beyond her; yet, for that he deemed her to be of mean extraction, not only dared he not demand her of his father and mother to wife, but, fearing to be blamed for having set himself to love unworthily, he held his love, as most he might, hidden; wherefore it tormented him far more than if he had discovered it; and thus it came to pass that, for excess of chagrin, he fell sick and that grievously.
uz: U, Jeannettadan olti yoshga katta bo'lgani va uning sobiq go'zal va nafisligini ko'rib, unga shunchalik oshiq bo'lib ketdiki, undan boshqa hech narsani ko'rmasdi; ammo, uni hech qanday qadriyatsiz deb hisoblagani uchun, nafaqat otasi va onasidan uni xotinlikka talab qilmaslikka jur'at etdi, balki o'zini nojo'ya sevganlikda ayblashdan qo'rqqan holda, o'z muhabbatini imkon qadar yashirdi; shuning uchun u uni topganidan ko'ra ancha azob chekdi; va shunday qilib, g'amginlik tufayli u kasal bo'lib qoldi va...

en: Divers physicians were called in to medicine him, who, having noted one and another symptom of his case and being never- theless unable to discover what ailed him, all with one accord despaired of his recovery; whereat the young man’s father and mother suffered dolour and melancholy so great that greater might not be brooked, and many a time, with piteous prayers, they questioned him of the cause of his malady, whereto or sighs he gave for answer or replied that he felt himself all wast- ing away.
uz: Uni turli xil shifokorlar davolanishga chaqirdilar. Ular uning holatining bir xil alomatlarini payqashdi va hech qachon nima ekanligini aniqlay olishmadi, ularning barchasi sog'ayib ketishidan bir ovozdan umidsizlikka tushishdi; yigitning otasi va onasi esa shunchalik katta tashvish va qayg'uga duch kelishdiki, uni tashlab ketish mumkin emas edi va ko'p marta achinarli duolar bilan uning kasalligining sababini so'rashardi, u qayerga yoki qayg'uga javob berardi yoki o'zini yo'q deb his qilganini javob berardi.

en: It chanced one day that, what while a doctor, young enough, but exceed- ingly deeply versed in science, sat by him and held him by the arm in that part where leaches use to seek the pulse, Jeannette, who, of regard for his mother, tended him solicitously, entered, on some occasion or another, the chamber where the young man lay.
uz: Bir kuni shunday bo'ldiki, yetarlicha yosh, lekin fan bo'yicha juda chuqur bilimga ega bo'lgan shifokor uning yonida o'tirardi va uni puls qidirish uchun ishlatiladigan o'sha qismdagi qo'lidan ushladi, Jeannette, onasini hurmat qilgan holda, unga ehtiyotkorlik bilan g'amxo'rlik qilgan holda, qandaydir holatda yoki boshqa holatda yigit yotgan xonaga kirdi.

en: When the latter saw her, without word
uz: Oxirgisi uni so'zsiz ko'rganida.

en: said or gesture made, he felt the amorous ardour redouble in his heart, wherefore his pulse began to beat stronglier than of wont; the which the leach incontinent noted and marvelling, abode still to see how long this should last.
uz: Aytgan yoki imo-ishora qilganida, u yuragida ishqiy ishtiyoqning ikki barobar kuchayganini his qildi, shuning uchun uning yuragi odatdagidan ham kuchliroq urishni boshladi; uni siydik to'kilmasligi payqadi va hayratda qoldirdi, bu qancha vaqt davom etishini ko'rish uchun hali ham qoldi.

en: As soon as Jeannette left the chamber, the beating abated, wherefore it seemed to the physician he had gotten impartment of the cause of the young man’s ailment, and after waiting awhile, he let call Jeannette to him, as he would question her of somewhat, still holding the sick man by the arm.
uz: Jeannette xonadan chiqib ketishi bilanoq, kaltaklash kamaydi, shuning uchun shifokorga yigitning dardining sababini aytgandek tuyuldi va biroz kutgandan so'ng, u Jeannettani unga chaqirishga ruxsat berdi, xuddi uni biroz so'roq qilgandek, hali ham bemorni qo'lidan ushlab turardi.

en: She came to him incontinent and no sooner did she enter than the beating of the youth’s pulse returned and she being gone again, ceased.
uz: U uning oldiga kelishdan oldin keldi va tez orada yigitning urishi qaytib keldi va u yana yo'q bo'lib, to'xtadi.

en: Thereupon, it seeming to the physician that he had full enough assurance, he rose and taking the young man’s father and mother apart, said to them, ‘The healing of your son is not in the succour of physicians, but abideth in the hands of Jeannette, whom, as I have by sure signs manifestly recog- nized, the young man ardently loveth, albeit, for all I can see, she is un- aware thereof.
uz: Shundan so'ng, shifokorga yetarli ishonchga ega bo'lib, u o'rnidan turdi va yigitning otasi va onasini ajratib, ularga dedi: "O'g'lingizning shifo topishi shifokorlarning yordamida emas, balki Jeannette'ning qo'lida qoladi. Men aniq belgilar bilan tan olganimdek, yigit uni juda qattiq sevadi, garchi, ko'rishim mumkinki, u bundan bexabar."

en: You know now what you have to do, if his life be dear to you.’ The gentleman and his lady, hearing this, were well pleased, inasmuch as some means was found for his recoverance, albeit it irked them sore that the means in question should be that whereof they misdoubted them, to wit, that they should give Jeannette to their son to wife.
uz: Endi nima qilish kerakligini bilasiz, agar uning hayoti sizga qimmat bo'lsa." Buni eshitgan janob va uning xonimi juda xursand bo'lishdi, chunki uning tuzalib ketish uchun qandaydir vosita topildi, garchi bu ularni xafa qilgan bo'lsa ham, bu vosita ularni shubhalantirgan narsa bo'lishi kerak edi, ya'ni ular Jeannette'ni o'g'liga xotinlikka berishlari kerak edi.

en: Accordingly, the physi- cian being gone, they went into the sick man and the lady bespoke him thus: ‘Son mine, I could never have believed that thou wouldst keep from me any desire of thine, especially seeing thyself pine away for lack thereof; for that thou shouldst have been and shouldst be assured that there is nought I can for thy contentment, were it even less than seemly, which I would not do as for myself.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, shifokorlar ketgach, ular bemor odamga kirishdi va xonim unga shunday dedi: O'g'lim, men hech qachon sendan hech qanday istakni, ayniqsa sening yetishmovchiliging uchun azob chekayotganingni o'ylashingga ishonmas edim; chunki sen bo'lishing kerak edi va men sening qoniqishingga hech narsa bera olmasligimga amin bo'lishing kerak edi, hatto ko'rinishdan ham kam bo'lsa ham, men buni o'zim uchun qilmagan bo'lardim.

en: But, since thou hast e’en done this, God the Lord hath been more pitiful over thee than thou thyself and that thou mayst not die of this sickness, hath shown me the cause of thine ill, which is no otherwhat than excess of love for some damsel or other, whoever she may be; and this, in- deed, thou needest not have thought shame to discover, for that thine age requireth it, and wert thou not enamoured, I should hold thee of very little account.
uz: Lekin, sen buni qilganing uchun, Xudo Rabbiy senga o'zingdan ko'ra rahm qildi va bu kasallikdan o'lmasliging uchun, menga kasalliging sababini ko'rsatdi, u qandaydir bir qizga yoki boshqa ayolga bo'lishidan boshqa hech narsa emas; va bu, aslida, seni topishga uyat qilmasliging kerak edi, chunki sening yoshing buni talab qiladi va sen sevmaganing uchun, men seni juda kam baholamas edim.

en: Wherefore, my son, dissemble not with me, but in all security dis- cover to me thine every desire and put away from thee the melancholy and the thought-taking which be upon thee and from which proceedeth this thy sickness and take comfort and be assured that there is nothing of that which thou mayst impose on me for thy satisfaction but I will do it to the best of my power, as she who loveth thee more than her life.
uz: Shuning uchun, o'g'lim, menga o'xshama, lekin butun xotirjamlikda menga har bir istakingni yashir va sendan bu kasalliging kelib chiqadigan qayg'u va o'y-fikrlarni olib tashla. Taskin ol va shunga amin bo'l, sening qoniqishing uchun menga hech narsa yuklay olmayman, lekin men buni o'z kuchim bilan qilaman, xuddi seni o'z hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq sevganidek.

en: Banish shamefastness
uz: Uyatsizlikni quvib yuboring.

en: and fearfulness and tell me if I can do aught to further thy passion; and if thou ﬁnd me not diligent therein or if I bring it not to effect for thee, ac- count me the cruellest mother that ever bore son.’ The young man, hearing his mother’s words, was at ﬁrst abashed, but presently, bethinking himself that none was better able than she to satisfy his wishes, he put away shamefastness and said thus to her: ‘Madam, noth- ing hath wrought so effectually with me to keep my love hidden as my hav- ing noted of most folk that, once they are grown in years, they choose not to remember them of having themselves been young.
uz: va qo'rquv bilan menga ishtiyoqlaringni kuchaytirish uchun nimadir qila olamanmi, demang; va agar meni bu ishda tirishqoq bo'lmasligingni topsang yoki senga bu ish bajarmasligimni ko'rsatsang, meni o'g'il tug'gan eng shafqatsiz ona deb hisobla." Yigit onasining so'zlarini eshitib, dastlab hayron bo'ldi, lekin tez orada o'z istaklarini qondirish uchun undan yaxshiroq hech kim qodir emas deb o'ylab, uyatni yo'qqa chiqardi va unga dedi: "Xonim, men ko'pchilik odamlarning sevishimni yashirish uchun shunchalik samarali ish qildimki, ular yosh bo'lishganini eslashmaydi."

en: But, since in this I ﬁnd you reasonable, not only will I not deny that to be true which you say you have observed, but I will, to boot, discover to you of whom [I am enam- oured], on condition that you will, to the best of your power, give effect to your promise; and thus may you have me whole again.’ Whereto the lady (trusting overmuch in that which was not to come to pass for her on such wise as she deemed in herself) answered freely that he might in all assur- ance discover to her his every desire, for that she would without any delay address herself to contrive that he should have his pleasure.
uz: Lekin, men sizni oqilona deb topganim uchun, nafaqat siz kuzatganingizni aytganingiz haqiqat ekanligini inkor etmayman, balki men sizga kim haqida ekanligini aniqlayman, agar siz kuchingiz yetganicha va'dangizni amalga oshirsangiz; va shu tariqa siz meni yana butunlay his qilsangiz.

en: ‘Madam,’ then said the youth, ‘the exceeding beauty and commendable fashions of our Jeannette and my unableness to make her even sensible, still less to move her to pity, of my love and the having never dared to discover it unto any have brought me whereas you see me; and if that which you have promised me come not, one way or another, to pass, you may be assured that my life will be brief.’ The lady, to whom it appeared more a time for comfort than for reproof, said, smilingly, ‘Alack, my son, hast thou then for this suffered thyself to languish thus?
uz: Xonim, dedi yigit, Bizning Jeannettamizning haddan tashqari gozalligi va maqtovga sazovor modalari hamda uni hatto aqlga sigdira olmasligim, ayniqsa uni achinishga unday olmasligim, sevgiyim va uni hech kimga kashf etishga jurat etmaganligim meni korib turganingizda olib keldi; va agar siz menga vada bergan narsa bir yol bilan kelmasa, shunda mening hayotim qisqa bolishiga amin bolishingiz mumkin.

en: Take comfort and leave me do, once thou shalt be recovered.’ The youth, full of good hope, in a very short time showed signs of great amendment, whereas the lady, being much rejoiced, began to cast about how she might perform that which she had promised him.
uz: "Tinchlan va meni qo'yib yubor, tuzalganingdan so'ng." Yaxshi umidga to'la yigit juda qisqa vaqt ichida katta o'zgarish alomatlarini ko'rsatdi, xonim esa juda xursand bo'lib, unga va'da qilgan narsani qanday amalga oshirish mumkinligi haqida o'ylay boshladi.

en: Accordingly, calling Jeannette to her one day, she asked her very civilly, as by way of a jest, if she had a lover; whereupon she waxed all red and answered, ‘Madam, it concerneth not neither were it seemly in a poor damsel like my- self, banished from house and home and abiding in others’ service, to think of love.’ Quoth the lady, ‘An you have no lover, we mean to give you one, in whom you may rejoice and live merry and have more delight of your beauty, for it behoveth not that so handsome a girl as you are abide without a lover.’ To this Jeannette made answer, ‘Madam, you took me from my
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir kuni Jeannettani o'ziga chaqirib, u undan juda odob bilan, hazil tariqasida, agar uning sevgilisi bo'lsa, deb so'radi; shundan so'ng u butunlay qizarib, javob berdi: "Xonim, bu mening kabi bechora xonimga ham tegishli emas, u uy-uydan haydalgan va boshqalarda yashayotgan bo'lsa, sevgi haqida o'ylash kerak." Xonim aytdi: "Sizda sevgilisi yo'q, biz sizga sevgilisi bor, unda xursand bo'lishingiz, xursandchilik bilan yashashingiz va go'zalligingizdan ko'proq zavq olishingiz mumkin, chunki siz sevgilisiz yashayotgan kabi qizga ham kerak emas."

en: father’s poverty and have reared me as a daughter, wherefore it behoveth me to do your every pleasure; but in this I will nowise comply with you, and therein methinketh I do well.
uz: Otamning kambag'alligi meni qizdek tarbiyaladi, shuning uchun sizning har bir xohishingizni qilishim kerak; lekin bu borada men siz bilan rozi bo'lishga tayyorman va unda yaxshi ish qilaman deb o'ylayman.

en: If it please you give me a husband, him do I purpose to love, but none other; for that, since of the inheritance of my an- cestors nought is left me save only honour, this latter I mean to keep and preserve as long as life shall endure to me.’ This speech seemed to the lady very contrary to that whereto she thought to come for the keeping of her promise to her son —albeit, like a discreet woman as she was, she inwardly much commended the damsel therefor — and she said, ‘How now, Jeannette?
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, menga er bering, men uni sevishni niyat qilaman, lekin boshqa hech kimni emas; chunki mening an- cestors yo'q merosimdan faqatgina sharaf qoldi, men bu oxirgisini menga umrbod saqlab qolmoqchiman." Bu nutq xonimga o'g'liga bergan va'dasini bajarish uchun qayerga kelishni o'ylaganiga juda zid ko'rindi  garchi u, o'zi kabi ehtiyotkor ayol bo'lsa ham, u ich-ichidan bu qizni juda maqtadi  va u dedi: "Xo'sh, Jeannette?"

en: If our lord the king, who is a young cavalier, as thou art a very fair damsel, would fain have some easance of thy love, wouldst thou deny it to him?’ Whereto she answered forthright, ‘The king might do me violence, but of my consent he should never avail to have aught of me save what was honourable.’ The lady, seeing how she was minded, left parleying with her and bethought herself to put her to the proof; wherefore she told her son that, whenas he should be recovered, she would contrive to get her alone with him in a chamber, so he might make shift to have his pleasure of her, saying that it appeared to her unseemly that she should, procuress-wise, plead for her son and solicit her own maid.
uz: Agar janobimiz podshoh, yosh chavandoz bo'lsa va siz juda go'zal qiz bo'lsangiz, sizning muhabbatingizga biroz yordam berishni xohlasangiz, uni rad etasizmi? U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob berdi:  Podshoh menga zo'ravonlik qilishi mumkin, lekin mening roziligimga ko'ra u mendan hech narsa ololmasligi kerak, faqat hurmatga sazovor narsa. Xonim o'z fikrini ko'rib, u bilan gaplashdi va o'zini sinovdan o'tkazish uchun o'yladi; shuning uchun u o'g'liga u sog'ayishi kerak bo'lganda, uni xonada yolg'iz o'zi bilan birga olib yurishni o'ylab topishini aytdi, shunda u undan rozi bo'lishi mumkin edi, unga u o'z o'g'li va o'z xizmatkorini mas'uldek ko'rindi.

en: With this the young man was nowise content and presently waxed griev- ously worse, which when his mother saw, she opened her mind to Jeannette, but, ﬁnding her more constant than ever, recounted what she had done to her husband, and he and she resolved of one accord, grievous though it seemed to them, to give her to him to wife, choosing rather to have their son alive with a wife unsorted to his quality than dead without any; and so, after much parley, they did; whereat Jeannette was exceeding content and with a devout heart rendered thanks to God, who had not forgotten her; but for all that she never avouched herself other than the daughter of a Picard.
uz: Shu bilan yigit hozir mamnun edi va darhol qayg'usi yanada yomonlashdi. Onasi uni ko'rgach, Jeannettega fikrini ochdi, lekin uni har qachongidan ham doimiyroq topib, eriga qilgan ishini aytib berdi. U va u bir ovozdan, garchi ularga achinarli tuyulsa ham, uni unga xotinlikka berishga qaror qilishdi, o'g'lini o'z sifatiga mos bo'lmagan xotin bilan o'limsiz yashashni afzal ko'rishdi; va shunday qilib, ko'p maslahatdan so'ng, ular shunday qilishdi; ammo Jeannette juda mamnun edi va uni unutmagan Xudoga chin dildan minnatdor edi; lekin u hech qachon o'zini Picardning qizidan boshqa hech kimga ko'rsatmadi.

en: As for the young man, he presently recovered and celebrating his nuptials, the gladdest man alive, proceeded to lead a merry life with his bride.
uz: Yigitga kelsak, u hozirda tuzalib, to'y marosimini nishonlamoqda edi, tirik eng xursand odam, kelini bilan quvonchli hayot kechirishga kirishdi.

en: Meanwhile, Perrot, who had been left in Wales with the King of Eng- land’s marshal, waxed likewise in favour with his lord and grew up very goodly of his person and doughty as any man in the island, insomuch that neither in tourneying nor jousting nor in any other act of arms was there any in the land who could cope with him; wherefore he was everywhere known and famous under the name of Perrot the Picard.
uz: Ayni paytda, Angliya qirolining marshallari bilan Uelsda qolgan Perrot ham o'z xo'jayiniga yoqib, oroldagi har qanday odam kabi o'ziga xos va jozibali bo'lib o'sdi, shuning uchun na sayohatda, na jangda, na boshqa qurol-yarog' harakatida unga bardosh bera oladigan hech kim yo'q edi; shuning uchun u hamma joyda Perrot Pikar nomi bilan tanilgan va mashhur edi.

en: And even as God had not forgotten his sister, so on like wise He showed that He had him also in
uz: Xuddi Xudo singlisini unutmaganidek, dono kabi U ham unga ega ekanligini ko'rsatdi.

en: mind; for that a pestilential sickness, being come into those parts, carried off well nigh half the people thereof, besides that most part of those who survived ﬂed for fear into other lands; wherefore the whole country ap- peared desert.
uz: Eslatma: o'sha hududlarga kelib, o'sha odamlarning deyarli yarmini o'ldirgan va omon qolganlarning aksariyati qo'rquvdan boshqa yurtlarga qochib ketgan; shuning uchun butun mamlakat cho'lga aylandi.

en: In this mortality, the marshal his lord and his lady and only son, together with many others, brothers and nephews and kinsmen, all died, nor was any left of all his house save a daughter, just husband-ripe, and Perrot, with sundry other serving folk.
uz: Bu o'limda marshal, uning xo'jayini va xotini va yagona o'g'li, shuningdek, ko'plab boshqalar, aka-ukalar, jiyanlar va qarindoshlar hammasi vafot etdilar, butun uyidan faqat bir qiz, adolatli er-pishgan va Perrot, boshqa xizmatchi odamlar bilan qolmadi.

en: The pestilence being somewhat abated, the young lady, with the approof and by the counsel of some few gentlemen of the country129 left alive, took Perrot, for that he was a man of worth and prowess, to husband and made him lord of all that had fallen to her by inheritance; nor was it long ere the King of England, hearing the marshal to be dead and knowing the worth of Perrot the Picard, substituted him in the dead man’s room and made him his marshal.
uz: Vabo biroz kamaytirilganidan so'ng, yosh xonim, mamlakatning bir nechta janoblarining taxminiy va maslahatlari bilan 129 tirik qolgan holda, Perrotni oldi, chunki u qimmatli va mohir odam edi, uni eriga oldi va unga meros bo'lib tushgan hamma narsaga xo'jayin qildi; shuningdek, Angliya qiroli marshalning o'lganini eshitib, Perrot Pikarning qadrini bilgach, uni o'lik odam xonasida o'rniga qo'ydi va o'z marshalini o'z marshalini qildi.

en: This, in brief, is what came of the two innocent children of the Count of Antwerp, left by him for lost.
uz: Qisqacha qilib aytganda, bu Antverpen grafining ikki begunoh farzandidan kelib chiqqan narsa edi, ular u tomonidan yo'qolgan deb qoldirilgan edi.

en: Eighteen years were now passed since the count’s ﬂight from Paris, when, as he abode in Ireland, having suffered many things in a very sorry way of life, there took him a desire to learn, as he might, what was come of his children.
uz: Grafning Parijdan qochganiga o'n sakkiz yil bo'ldi, o'shanda u Irlandiyada yashab, juda achinarli hayot tarzida ko'p azob chekkanida, bolalaridan nima kelganini iloji boricha o'rganish istagi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Wherefore, seeing himself altogether changed of favour from that which he was wont to be and feeling himself, for long exercise, grown more robust of his person than he had been when young and abiding in ease and idlesse, he took leave of him with whom he had so long abidden and came, poor and ill enough in case, to England.
uz: Shuning uchun, o'zini odatdagidan butunlay o'zgarib ketganini ko'rib, uzoq mashqdan so'ng o'zini yoshligidan ko'ra kuchliroq his qilib, bemalol va bekorchilikda yashayotganini ko'rib, u uzoq vaqt davomida birga yashagan odamdan xayr oldi va, agar kerak bo'lsa, kambag'al va kasal bo'lib, Angliyaga keldi.

en: Thence he betook himself whereas he had left Perrot and found him a marshal and a great lord and saw him robust and goodly of person; the which was mighty pleasing unto him, but he would not make himself known to him till he should have learned how it was with Jeannette.
uz: Shundan so'ng u Perrotni tark etganida, o'zini yo'q qildi va uni marshal va buyuk lord topdi va uni kuchli va yaxshi odam deb ko'rdi; bu unga juda yoqardi, lekin u Jeannette bilan qanday ekanligini bilmaguncha o'zini unga tanitmadi.

en: Accordingly, he set out and stayed not till he came to London, where, cautiously enquiring of the lady with whom he had left his daughter and of her condition, he found Jeannette married to her son, which greatly rejoiced him and he counted all his past adversity a little thing, since he had found his children again alive and in good case.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u jo'nab ketdi va Londonga kelmaguncha qolmadi. U yerda, qizini qoldirgan xonim va uning ahvolini ehtiyotkorlik bilan so'rab, Jeannettani o'g'liga turmushga chiqqanini topdi. Bu unga katta xursandchilik baxsh etdi va u o'tmishdagi barcha qiyinchiliklarini ozgina narsa deb hisobladi, chunki u bolalarini yana tirik va yaxshi holatda topdi.

en: Then, desirous of seeing Jeannette, he began beggarwise, to haunt the neighbourhood of her house, where one day Jamy Lamiens, (for so was Jeannette’s husband called), espying him and having compassion on him, for that he saw him old and poor, bade one of his servants bring him in and give him to eat for the love of God, which the man readily did.
uz: So'ngra, Jeannettani ko'rishni istagan holda, u bir kun kelib Jeymi Lamines (Jeannettening eri shunday atalgan) degan uyining qo'shni qismini ta'qib qila boshladi. Jeannette uni yosh va kambag'al ko'rgani uchun, unga rahm qilib, xizmatkorlaridan biri uni Xudoning muhabbati uchun olib kirib, ovqat berishni buyurdi, bu esa u bemalol qildi.

en: Now Jean- nette had had several children by Jamy, whereof the eldest was no more
uz: Endi Jan-nette Jami bilan bir nechta farzand ko'rgan edi, ularning kattasi endi yo'q edi.

en: than eight years old, and they were the handsomest and sprightliest children in the world.
uz: sakkiz yoshdan katta edi va ular dunyodagi eng go'zal va yorqin bolalar edi.

en: When they saw the count eat, they came one and all about him and began to caress him, as if, moved by some occult virtue, they divined him to be their grandfather.
uz: Ular grafning ovqatlanayotganini ko'rgach, uning atrofida birma-bir kelib, uni erkalay boshladilar, go'yo qandaydir sehrli fazilatdan ta'sirlanib, uni o'z bobolari deb bashorat qilishardi.

en: He, knowing them for his grandchildren, fell to fondling and making much of them, wherefore the children would not leave him, albeit he who had charge of their governance called them.
uz: U ularni nevaralari uchun bilganidan so'ng, ularni mehr bilan kutib, ko'p narsa qilishga tushdi, shuning uchun bolalar uni tark etmadilar, garchi ularning hokimiyatiga mas'ul bo'lgan odam ularni chaqirgan bo'lsa ham.

en: Jeannette, hearing this, issued forth of a chamber therenigh and coming whereas the count was, chid them amain and threatened to beat them, an they did not what their governor willed.
uz: Jeannette buni eshitib, kechasi xonadan chiqib, graf bo'lgan joyga keldi, ularni hayratda qoldirdi va urish bilan tahdid qildi, lekin ular hokimining xohishiga ko'ra ishlamadi.

en: The children began to weep and say that they would fain abide with that honest man, who loved them better than their governor, whereat both the lady and the count laughed.
uz: Bolalar yig'lay boshlashdi va o'sha halol odam bilan birga qolishni xohlashlarini aytishdi, u ularni hokimidan ham ko'ra yaxshiroq sevgan edi, xonim ham, graf ham kulishdi.

en: Now the latter had risen, nowise as a father, but as a poor man, to do honour to his daughter, as to a mistress, and seeing her, felt a marvellous pleasure at his heart.
uz: Endi oxirgi o'rnidan turdi, otasi kabi, lekin kambag'al odam kabi, qizi, xo'jayiniga hurmat ko'rsatish uchun, va uni ko'rib, yuragida ajoyib zavq his qildi.

en: But she nor then nor after knew him any whit, for that he was beyond measure changed from what he was used to be, being grown old and hoar and bearded and lean and swart, and appeared altogether another man than the count.
uz: Ammo u o'shandan keyin ham, keyin ham uni hech qanday yaxshi ko'rmadi, chunki u odatdagidan haddan tashqari o'zgargan edi, keksa, g'ijirlagan, soqolli, ozg'in va sarg'ish bo'lib, umuman boshqa odamga o'xshardi.

en: The lady then, seeing that the children were unwilling to leave him and wept, when she would have them go away, bade their governor let them be awhile and the children thus being with the good man, it chanced that Jamy’s father returned and heard from their governor what had passed, whereupon quoth the marshal, who held Jeannette in despite, ‘Let them be, God give them ill-luck!
uz: Shunda xonim bolalarning uni tark etishni istamaganini ko'rib, yig'ladilar va ularni ketmoqchi bo'lganida, ularning hokimidan biroz vaqt qoldirishni va bolalarning yaxshi odam bilan birga bo'lishini so'radilar. Shunda Jami otasi qaytib kelib, ularning hokimidan nima bo'lganini eshitdi, shundan so'ng Jeannetteni ushlab turgan marshal: "Bor bo'lsin, Xudo ularga omad bersin!" dedi.

en: They do but hark back to that whence they sprang.
uz: Ular faqat o'zlari sakrab chiqqan joyga qaytishadi.

en: They come by their mother of a vagabond and therefore it is no wonder if they are fain to herd with vagabonds.’ The count heard these words and was mightily chagrined thereat; nevertheless, he shrugged his shoulders and put up with the affront, even as he had put up with many others.
uz: Ular o'z onalari bilan kelgan va shuning uchun ular o'g'il bolalar bilan birga yurishga moyil bo'lishlari ajablanarli emas." Graf bu so'zlarni eshitib, bundan juda xafa bo'ldi; shunga qaramay, u yelkalarini qisdi va ko'pchilik bilan chidaganidek, haqoratga bardosh berdi.

en: Jamy, hearing how the children had welcomed the honest man, to wit, the count, albeit it misliked him, nevertheless so loved them that, rather than see them weep, he commanded that, if the good man chose to abide there in any capacity, he should be received into his service.
uz: Jami, bolalar halol odamni qanday kutib olganini eshitib, xolos, graf, garchi uni yomon ko'rsa ham, ularni shunchalik yaxshi ko'rar ediki, ularni yig'layotganini ko'rish o'rniga, agar yaxshi odam u yerda biron bir lavozimda qolishni tanlasa, uni o'z xizmatiga qabul qilishni buyurdi.

en: The count answered that he would gladly abide there, but he knew not to do aught other than tend horses, whereto he had been used all his lifetime.
uz: Graf u yerda xursandchilik bilan qolishini aytdi, lekin u butun umri davomida ishlatilgan otlarni boqishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmasligini bilardi.

en: A horse was accordingly assigned to him and when he had cared for it, he busied himself with making sport for the children.
uz: Unga ot tegishli ravishda tayinlangan edi va unga g'amxo'rlik qilganidan so'ng, u bolalar uchun sport o'yinlari bilan band bo'ldi.

en: Whilst fortune handled the Count of Antwerp and his children on such wise as hath been set out, it befell that the King of France, after many truces
uz: Garchi omad Antverpen grafini va uning bolalarini belgilanganidek boshqargan bo'lsa-da, Fransiya qiroliga ko'plab sulhlardan so'ng...

en: made with the Germans, died and his son, whose wife was she through whom the count had been banished, was crowned in his place; and no soon- er was the current truce expired than he again began a very ﬁerce war.
uz: Germaniyaliklar bilan tuzilgan, vafot etdi va uning o'g'li, uning xotini esa grafning surgun qilingan edi, uning o'rniga tojlandi; va tez orada joriy sulh tugadi, u yana juda shiddatli urush boshladi.

en: To his aid the King of England, as a new-made kinsman, despatched much people, under the commandment of Perrot his marshal and Jamy Lamiens, son of the other marshal, and with them went the good man, to wit, the count, who, without being recognized of any, abode a pretty while with the army in the guise of a horseboy, and there, like a man of mettle as he was, wrought good galore, more than was required of him, both with counsels and with deeds.
uz: Unga Angliya qiroli yangi qarindosh sifatida Perrot marshal va boshqa marshalning o'g'li Jamy Lamiensning buyrug'i ostida ko'p odamlarni yordamga yubordi va ular bilan birga yaxshi odam, xususan, hech kim tan olmasdan, ot bolasi ko'rinishida qo'shin bilan ancha vaqt turdi va u yerda, xuddi bir jasur odam kabi, undan talab qilinadiganidan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi ishlar qildi, maslahatlar va amallar bilan.

en: During the war, it came to pass that the Queen of France fell grievously sick and feeling herself nigh unto death, contrite for all her sins, confessed herself unto the Archbishop of Rouen, who was held of all a very holy and good man.
uz: Urush davrida Fransiya qirolichasi og'ir kasal bo'lib qoldi va o'zini o'limga yaqin his qilib, barcha gunohlaridan pushaymon bo'lib, Ruan arxiyepiskopiga o'zini tan oldi, u juda muqaddas va yaxshi inson deb hisoblanardi.

en: Amongst her other sins, she related to him that which the Count of Antwerp had most wrongfully suffered through her; nor was she content to tell it to him alone, nay, but before many other men of worth she recoun- ted all as it had passed, beseeching them so to do with the king that the count, an he were on life, or, if not, one of his children, should be restored to his estate; after which she lingered not long, but, departing this life, was honourably buried.
uz: Boshqa gunohlari orasida, u unga Antverpen grafining o'zi orqali eng nohaq azob chekkanini aytib berdi; va buni unga yolg'iz aytishga ham rozi bo'lmadi, yo'q, lekin ko'plab boshqa qimmatli odamlar oldida u o'tgan voqeani aytib berdi, ularni podshoh bilan shunday qilishlarini iltimos qildi, chunki graf, u tirik edi, yoki, agar yo'q bo'lsa, uning farzandlaridan biri, o'z mulkiga qaytarilishi kerak edi; shundan so'ng u uzoq qolmadi, lekin bu hayotdan chiqib, hurmat bilan dafn etildi.

en: Her confession, being reported to the king, moved him, after he had heaved divers sighs of regret for the wrong done to the noble- man, to let cry throughout all the army and in many other parts, that whoso should give him news of the Count of Antwerp or of either of his children should for each be wonder-well guerdoned of him, for that he held him, upon the queen’s confession, innocent of that for which he had gone into exile and was minded to restore him to his ﬁrst estate and more.
uz: Uning e'tirofi qirolga xabar berilgach, uni oliyjanobga qilingan zulm uchun pushaymonlik g'azablaridan so'ng, butun armiya va boshqa ko'plab joylarda faryod qilishga undadi. Antverpen grafining yoki uning farzandlarining har biri haqida xabar berishi kerak bo'lgan har bir kishi uni ajoyib tarzda himoya qilishi kerak edi, chunki u uni qirolichaning e'tirofiga ko'ra, surgun qilingan narsasidan aybsiz deb hisoblagan va uni birinchi mulkiga qaytarish niyatida edi.

en: The count, in his guise of a horseboy, hearing this and being assured that it was the truth,130 betook himself forthright to Jamy Lamiens and prayed him go with him to Perrot, for that he had a mind to discover to them that which the king went seeking.
uz: Graf, ot bolasi qiyofasida buni eshitib, bu haqiqat ekanligiga amin bo'lib, 130-yilda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Jami Laminesga murojaat qildi va uni Perrotga hamroh bo'lishga iltimos qildi, chunki u qirol qidirayotgan narsani ularga kashf etishni o'ylab edi.

en: All three being then met together, quoth the count to Perrot, who had it already in mind to discover himself, ‘Perrot, Jamy here hath thy sister to wife nor ever had any dowry with her; where- fore, that thy sister may not go undowered, I purpose that he and none other shall, by making thee known as the son of the Count of Antwerp, have this great reward that the king promiseth for thee and for Violante, thy sister and his wife, and myself, who am the Count of Antwerp and your father.’ Perrot, hearing this and looking steadfastly upon him, presently knew him and cast
uz: Uch kishi ham yig'ilganda, graf Perrotga murojaat qildi, u allaqachon o'zini topishni o'ylagani uchun: Perrot, Jamy, bu yerda singlingizning xotini yo'q va u bilan hech qanday mahr ham bo'lmagan; lekin, agar singlingiz beparvo bo'lmasligi uchun, u va boshqa hech kim sizni Antverpen grafining o'g'li sifatida tanitib, shoh sizga va Violante, singlingiz va uning xotiniga va Antverpen graf va otangiz bo'lgan o'zimga va'zi va'da va'da qilayotgan buyuk mukofotga ega bo'lishini maqsad qilganman. Perrot buni eshitib, unga qat'iy nazar bilan qaradi va uni tezda tanib oldi va

en: himself, weeping, at his feet and embraced him, saying, ‘Father mine, you are dearly welcome.’ Jamy, hearing ﬁrst what the count said and after seeing what Perrot did, was overcome at once with such wonderment and such gladness that he scarce knew what he should do.
uz: o'zi yig'lab, oyoqlari ostida uni quchoqlab, dedi: "Otam, sizdan juda mamnuniyat so'rayman". Jami, avval grafning aytganlarini eshitib, keyin Perrot nima qilganini ko'rgach, darhol shunchalik hayrat va shunchalik xursandchilikka to'lib ketdi, nima qilish kerakligini deyarli bilmas edi.

en: However, after awhile, giving credence to the former’s speech and sore ashamed for the injurious words he had whiles used to the hostler-count, he let himself fall, weeping, at his feet and humbly besought him pardon of every past affront, the which the count, having raised him to his feet, graciously accorded him.
uz: Ammo, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, avvalgilarning so'zlariga ishonib, xostler-grafga o'rgatgan zararli so'zlaridan qattiq uyalgan holda, u oyoqlari ostida yig'lab yiqildi va pastki har qanday haqorat uchun undan kechirim so'radi. Graf uni oyoqqa turgandan so'ng, unga marhamat bilan rozilik berdi.

en: Then, after they had all three discoursed awhile of each one’s various ad- ventures and wept and rejoiced together amain, Perrot and Jamy would have reclad the count, who would on nowise suffer it, but willed that Jamy, having ﬁrst assured himself of the promised guerdon, should, the more to shame the king, present him to the latter in that his then plight and in his groom’s habit.
uz: Keyin, ularning har uchalasi ham har birining turli xil sarguzashtlari haqida biroz gaplashgandan so'ng, yig'lab, xursand bo'lishdi. Perrot va Jami o'sha paytdagi ahvolda va kuyovining odatida qirolga uni taqdim etishni xohlashdi, ammo Jamy avval o'ziga va'da qilingan qo'riqchiga ishontirgan edi.

en: Accordingly, Jamy, followed by the count and Perrot, presented himself before the king, and offered, provided he would guerdon him according to the proclamation made, to produce to him the count and his children.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Jamy, undan keyin graf va Perrot, o'zini shoh huzuriga ko'rsatdi va agar u chiqarilgan farmoyishga muvofiq uni qo'riqlashiga rozi bo'lsa, graf va uning bolalarini unga olib kelishni taklif qildi.

en: The king promptly let bring for all three a guerdon marvellous in Jamy’s eyes and commanded that he should be free to carry it off, when- as he should in very deed produce the count and his children, as he prom- ised.
uz: Shoh darhol Jamining ko'zlariga ajoyib qo'riqchini olib kelishga buyurdi va uni olib ketishga ruxsat berishni buyurdi, qachonki u aslida graf va uning bolalarini, u ko'rsatganidek, dunyoga keltirishi kerak bo'lganda.

en: Jamy, then, turning himself about and putting forward the count his horseboy and Perrot, said, ‘My lord, here be the father and the son; the daughter, who is my wife and who is not here, with God’s aid you shall soon see.’ The king, hearing this, looked at the count and albeit he was sore changed from that which he was used to be, yet, after he had awhile con- sidered him, he knew him and well nigh with tears in his eyes raised him — for that he was on his knees before him —to his feet and kissed and em- braced him.
uz: Jeymi esa o'girilib, ot bolasi va Perrotni oldinga surib dedi: "Hazratim, mana ota va o'g'il; xotinim bo'lgan va bu yerda bo'lmagan qizni tez orada ko'rasiz." Buni eshitgan shoh grafga qaradi va garchi u odatdagidan qattiq o'zgarib ketgan bo'lsa ham, bir oz uni tanidi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan uni ko'tardi  chunki u uning oldida tizzalarida edi  oyoqlariga o'pdi va uni quchoqladi.

en: Perrot, also, he graciously received and commanded that the count should incontinent be furnished anew with clothes and servants and horses and harness, according as his quality required, which was straight- way done.
uz: Perrot ham, u mehribonlik bilan qabul qildi va grafga uning talablariga ko'ra, kiyim-kechak, xizmatkorlar, otlar va kamarlar bilan yangi ta'minlanishi kerakligini buyurdi, bu esa to'g'ri amalga oshirildi.

en: Moreover, he entreated Jamy with exceeding honour and would fain know every particular of his131 past adventures.
uz: Qolaversa, u Jamiga juda katta sharaf bilan yolvordi va uning 131 ta o'tmish sarguzashtlarining har bir tafsilotini bilishni xohlardi.

en: Then, Jamy being about to receive the magniﬁcent guerdons appointed him for having dis- covered the count and his children, the former said to him, ‘Take these of the muniﬁcence of our lord the king and remember to tell thy father that thy children, his grandchildren and mine, are not by their mother born of a vag- abond.’ Jamy, accordingly, took the gifts and sent for his wife and mother to
uz: Keyin, Jami graf va uning bolalarini yoritganligi uchun tayinlangan ajoyib qo'riqchilarni qabul qilmoqchi bo'lganida, sobiq yigit unga dedi: "Egamiz podshohning marhamatidan bularni olib, otangga aytishni unutma, uning bolalari, nevaralari va mening bolalarim ularning onasi tomonidan tug'ilmagan". Jami, shunga ko'ra, sovg'alarni oldi va xotiniga va onasiga jo'natdi.

en: Paris, whither came also Perrot’s wife; and there they all foregathered in the utmost joyance with the count, whom the king had reinstated in all his good and made greater than he ever was.
uz: Parij, u yerga Perrotning xotini ham keldi; va u yerda ularning hammasi qirol barcha boyliklarida tiklagan va uni har qachongidan ham buyukroq qilgan graf bilan juda xursandchilik bilan yig'ilishdi.

en: Then all, with Gautier’s leave, returned to their several homes and he until his death abode in Paris more worship- fully than ever.”
uz: Keyin hamma, Gautierning ta'tiliga ko'ra, o'zlarining bir nechta uylariga qaytdilar va u o'limigacha Parijda hech qachongidan ham to'liqroq ibodat qildi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Bernabo of Genoa, duped by Ambrogiuolo, loseth his good and commandeth that his innocent wife be put to death.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA: Jenoalik Bernabo, Ambrogiuolo tomonidan aldangan holda, o'z mol-mulkini yo'qotadi va begunoh xotinining o'ldirilishiga buyruq beradi.

en: She escapeth and serveth the Soldan in a man’s habit.
uz: U qochib ketadi va erkak odatida Soldanga xizmat qiladi.

en: Here she lighteth upon the deceiver of her husband and bringeth the latter to Alexandria, where, her traducer being punished, she resumeth woman’s apparel and returneth to Genoa with her husband, rich.
uz: Bu yerda u erining aldovchisi ustidan nur sochadi va oxirgi ayolni Iskandariyaga olib keladi, u yerda tarjimoni jazolanib, ayolning kiyimini tiklaydi va erining bilan Genaraga, boy holda qaytadi.

en: Elisa having furnished her due with her pitiful story, Filomena the queen, who was tall and goodly of person and smiling and agreeable of aspect bey- ond any other of her sex, collecting herself, said, “Needs must the covenant with Dioneo be observed, wherefore, there remaining none other to tell than he and I, I will tell my story ﬁrst, and he, for that he asked it as a favour, shall be the last to speak.” So saying, she began thus, “There is a proverb oftentimes cited among the common folk to the effect that the deceiver abideth132 at the feet of the deceived; the which meseemeth may by no reas- oning be shown to be true, an it approve not itself by actual occurrences.
uz: Elisa o'zining achinarli hikoyasi bilan munosib tarzda ta'minlaganidan so'ng, qirolicha Filomena, bo'yi baland va yaxshi inson, tabassumli va o'z jinsidagi har qanday odamga mos kelishgan holda, o'zini yig'ib, dedi: "Dioneo bilan ahdga rioya qilinishi kerak, shuning uchun u va mendan boshqa hech kim qolmadi, men avval o'z hikoyamni aytib beraman va u, buni iltifot sifatida so'ragani uchun, oxirgi bo'ladi." Shunday qilib, u shunday boshladi: "O'rta xalq orasida ko'pincha aldabgar aldanganlarning oyoqlarida132 yashaydi degan maqol bor; bu esa hech qanday asos bilan tasdiqlanmaydi, chunki u haqiqiy bo'lishi mumkin."

en: Wherefore, whilst ensuing the appointed theme, it hath occurred to me, dearest ladies, to show you, at the same time, that this is true, even as it is said; nor should it mislike you to hear it, so you may know how to keep yourselves from deceivers.
uz: Shunday qilib, belgilangan mavzu davom etar ekan, menga shunday keldi, aziz xonimlar, ayni paytda bu aytilganidek, bu haqiqat ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun; shuningdek, uni eshitish sizga yoqmasligi kerak, shunda siz o'zingizni aldovchilardan qanday himoya qilishni bilishingiz mumkin.

en: There were once at Paris in an inn certain very considerable Italian mer- chants, who were come thither, according to their usance, some on one oc- casion and some on another, and having one evening among others supped all together merrily, they fell to devising of divers matters, and passing from one discourse to another, they came at last to speak of their wives, whom they had left at home, and one said jestingly, ‘I know not how mine doth; but this I know well, that, whenas there cometh to my hand here any lass
uz: Parijda bir vaqtlar bir mehmonxonada juda katta italyan qo'shiqlari bo'lgan edi. Ular o'z odatlariga ko'ra, u yerga kelgan edilar, ba'zilari bir marta, ba'zilari esa boshqa birida, bir kechada birga xursandchilik bilan ovqatlanishardi, ular turli xil narsalarni o'ylab topishga tushishardi va bir nutqdan ikkinchisiga o'tishardi, oxir-oqibatda ular uyda masxara qilib qo'ygan xotinlari haqida gapirishga kelishardi va biri hazillashib dedi: "Men buni qanday qilishimni bilmayman; lekin buni bilaman, bu yerda mening qo'limga kelganda..."

en: that pleaseth me, I leave on one side the love I bear my wife and take of the other such pleasure as I may.’ ‘And I,’ quoth another, ‘do likewise, for that if I believe that my wife pusheth her fortunes [in my absence], she doth it, and if I believe it not, still she doth it; wherefore tit for tat be it; an ass still getteth as good as he giveth.’133 A third, following on, came well nigh to the same conclusion, and in brief all seemed agreed upon this point, that the wives they left behind had no mind to lose time in their husbands’ absence.
uz: Bu menga yoqadi, men bir tomonga xotinimga bo'lgan muhabbatni qoldiraman va boshqasidan xohlaganimcha zavq olaman." Men ham,  deydi boshqasi, shunday qil, chunki agar xotinim o'z boyligini tashlashiga ishonsam, u shunday qiladi, agar ishonmasam, u shunday qiladi; shuning uchun emizish kerak; eshak hali ham u berganidek yaxshi bo'ladi.133 Uchinchi, keyinchalik, xuddi shu xulosaga yaqin keldi va qisqacha aytganda, ular tashlab ketgan xotinlar erlarining yo'qligida vaqt yo'qotish niyatida emas edilar.

en: One only, who hight Bernabo Lomellini of Genoa, maintained the contrary, avouching that he, by special grace of God, had a lady to wife who was be- like the most accomplished woman of all Italy in all those qualities which a lady, nay, even (in great part) in those which a knight or an esquire, should have; for that she was fair of favour and yet in her ﬁrst youth and adroit and robust of her person; nor was there aught that pertaineth unto a woman, such as works of broidery in silk and the like, but she did it better than any other of her sex.
uz: Genuyalik Bernabo Lomellini yuqoriga ko'targan yagona shaxs, aksincha, Xudoning alohida marhamati bilan butun Italiyaning eng yetuk ayoli bo'lgan xotin-xotiniga ega edi, u barcha xususiyatlarda, hatto (asosan) ritsar yoki eskirda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan xususiyatlarda ham shunday edi; chunki u go'zal edi, ammo o'zining birinchi yoshligida, ziyrak va kuchli edi; shuningdek, ayolga tegishli bo'lgan hech narsa yo'q edi, masalan, ipakdan pishirish va shunga o'xshash, lekin u buni o'z jinsidagi boshqa har qanday narsadan yaxshiroq qildi.

en: Moreover, said he, there was no sewer, or in other words, no serving-man, alive who served better or more deftly at a nobleman’s table than did she, for that she was very well bred and exceeding wise and discreet.
uz: Qolaversa, u aytdiki, hech qanday kanalizatsiya yo'q edi, yoki boshqacha qilib aytganda, zodagonning stolida undan yaxshiroq yoki mohirroq xizmat qiladigan tirik xizmatchi yo'q edi, chunki u juda yaxshi tarbiyalangan va juda dono va ehtiyotkor edi.

en: He after went on to extol her as knowing better how to ride a horse and ﬂy a hawk, to read and write and cast a reckoning than if she were a merchant; and thence, after many other commendations, coming to that whereof it had been discoursed among them, he avouched with an oath that there could be found no honester nor chaster woman than she; wherefore he ﬁrmly believed that, should he abide half a score years, or even always, from home, she would never incline to the least levity with another man.
uz: Keyin u uni savdogardan ko'ra ot minishni, akani uchirishni, o'qishni, yozishni va hisob-kitob qilishni yaxshiroq biladiganini maqtadi; va shundan so'ng, ko'plab maqtovlardan so'ng, ular orasida bu haqda gapirilgan narsalarga kelib, undan ko'ra halolroq va odobli ayol topilmasligiga qasam ichdi; shuning uchun u qat'iy ishonardi, agar u yarim yil, hatto har doim, uydan uzoqroq bo'lsa, u hech qachon boshqa erkak bilan hech qanday xotirjamlikka moyil bo'lmaydi.

en: Among the merchants who discoursed thus was a young man called Ambro- giuolo of Piacenza, who fell to making the greatest mock in the world of this last commendation bestowed by Bernabo upon his wife and asked him scofﬁngly if the emperor had granted him that privilege over and above all other men.
uz: Shunday bahslashgan savdogarlar orasida Piacenzalik Ambro- giuolo ismli yigit bor edi. U Bernabo xotiniga bergan so'nggi maqtov haqida dunyodagi eng katta masxaraga duch keldi va undan imperator unga boshqa odamlardan ustun bo'lgan imtiyoz berganmi yoki yo'qmi, masxara bilan so'radi.

en: Bernabo, some little nettled, replied that not the emperor, but God, who could somewhat more than the emperor, had vouchsafed him the favour in question.
uz: Bernabo, kichkina qizg'anchoq, imperator emas, balki imperatordan biroz ko'ra ko'proq narsa qila oladigan Xudo unga bu marhamatni berganini javob berdi.

en: Whereupon quoth Ambrogiuolo, ‘Bernabo, I doubt not a whit but that thou thinkest to say sooth; but meseemeth thou hast paid little regard to the nature of things; for that, hadst thou taken heed thereunto, I deem thee not so dull of wit but thou wouldst have noted therein certain matters which had made thee speak more circumspectly on this subject.
uz: Shundan so'ng Ambrogiuolo dedi: "Bernabo, men hech qanday shubha qilmayman, faqat sen xotirjam deb o'ylayapsan; lekin menimcha, sen narsalarning mohiyatiga unchalik e'tibor bermading; chunki, agar bunga e'tibor berganingda, seni unchalik bema'ni deb hisoblamayman, lekin unda seni bu mavzuda yanada ehtiyotkorlik bilan gapirishga majbur qilgan ba'zi masalalarni qayd etgan bo'larding."

en: And that thou mayst not think that we, who have spoken much at large of our wives, believe that we have wives other or otherwise made than thine,
uz: Va biz, xotinlarimiz haqida ko'p gapirganlarimiz, sening xotinlaringdan boshqa yoki boshqacha qilib yaratilgan xotinlarimiz borligiga ishonmaymiz deb o'ylama.

en: but mayst see that we spoke thus, moved by natural perception, I will e’en reason with thee a little on this matter.
uz: Lekin tabiiy idrok tufayli shunday gaplashganimizni ko'rsangiz, men bu masala bo'yicha siz bilan biroz maslahatlashaman.

en: I have always understood man to be the noblest animal created of God among mortals, and after him, woman; but man, as is commonly believed and as is seen by works, is the more per- fect and having more perfection, must without fail have more of ﬁrmness and constancy, for that women universally are more changeable; the reason whereof might be shown by many natural arguments, which for the present I purpose to leave be.
uz: Men har doim insonni Xudo o'luvchilar orasida yaratgan eng olijanob hayvon deb tushunganman, undan keyin esa ayol; lekin odatda ishlarda ko'rinib turganidek, inson qanchalik mukammal va mukammal bo'lsa, shunchalik qat'iy va barqaror bo'lishi kerak, chunki ayollar butun olamda ko'proq o'zgaruvchan; buning sababini ko'plab tabiiy dalillar ko'rsatib berishi mumkin, ularni hozirda qoldirishni maqsad qilganman.

en: If then man be of more stability and yet cannot keep himself, let alone from complying with a woman who soliciteth him, but even from desiring one who pleaseth him, nay more, from doing what he can, so he may avail to be with her —and if this betide him not once a month, but a thousand times a day —what canst thou expect a woman, nat- urally unstable, to avail against the prayers, the blandishments, the gifts and a thousand other means which an adroit man, who loveth her, will use?
uz: Agar erkak yanada barqaror bo'lsa va o'zini ushlab tura olmasa, uni so'ragan ayolga rozi bo'lishdan qo'rqmasa, balki uni yoqtirgan ayolga istak bildirsa, yo'q, qo'lidan kelgancha, u bilan birga bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa  va agar bu unga oyda bir marta emas, balki kuniga ming marta zarar yetkazsa  uni sevuvchi mohir erkak ibodatlar, beodobliklar, sovg'alar va mingta boshqa vositalardan foydalanishga qarshi ayoldan nima kutish mumkin?

en: Thinkest thou she can hold out?
uz: Sizningcha, u chiday oladi deb o'ylayapsizmi?

en: Certes, how much soever thou mayst afﬁrm it, I believe not that thou believest it; and thou thyself sayst that thy wife is a woman and that she is of ﬂesh and blood, as are other women.
uz: Albatta, qancha tasdiqlasang ham, men sening bunga ishonishingga ishonmayman; va sen o'zing xotining ayol ekanligini va boshqa ayollar kabi go'sht va qon ekanligini aytasan.

en: If this be so, those same desires must be hers and the same powers that are in other women to resist these natural appetites; wherefore, however honest she be, it is possible she may do that which other women do; and nothing that is possible she be so peremptorily denied nor the contrary thereof afﬁrmed with such rigour as thou dost.’ To which Bernabo made answer, saying, ‘I am a merchant, and not a philosopher, and as a merchant I will answer; and I say that I acknowledge that what thou sayst may happen to foolish women in whom there is no shame; but those who are discreet are so careful of their honour that for the guarding thereof they become stronger than men, who reck not of this; and of those thus fashioned is my wife.’ ‘Indeed,’ rejoined Ambrogiuolo, ‘if, for every time they occupy themselves with toys of this kind, there sprouted from their foreheads a horn to bear witness of
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, o'sha istaklar uningiki bo'lishi kerak va boshqa ayollarda shu tabiiy ishtahalarga qarshi turish uchun mavjud bo'lgan kuchlar ham xuddi shunday bo'lishi kerak; shuning uchun, u qanchalik halol bo'lmasin, u boshqa ayollar qilgan ishni qilishi mumkin; va u uchun imkon bo'lgan hech narsa unga shunchalik qat'iy rad etilmasligi kerak, va buning aksi ham sen kabi qat'iy tasdiqlanmasligi kerak." Bunga Bernabo javob berib dedi: "Men savdogarman, faylasuf emasman, va savdogar sifatida javob beraman; va men aytamanki, sen aytgan gaplar ahmoq ayollarga sodir bo'lishi mumkin, unda hech qanday sharmandalik yo'q; lekin ular o'z sharafiga shunchalik ehtiyot bo'lishadi, chunki ular buni hisobga olmaydigan erkaklardan kuchliroq bo'lishadi; va bu haqda mening xotinimdan so'raladi."

en: that which they have done, there be few, I believe, who would incline thereto; but, far from the horn sprouting, there appeareth neither trace nor token thereof in those who are discreet, and shame and soil of honour consist not but in things discovered; wherefore, whenas they may secretly, they do it, or, if they forebear, it is for stupidity.
uz: Ularning qilgan ishlari, menimcha, bunga moyil bo'ladiganlar kam; lekin, shox unib chiqishi bilan uzoqda, sirlilarda uning izi ham, belgisi ham ko'rinmaydi, uyat va sharaf tuprog'i faqat topilgan narsalardan iborat emas; shuning uchun, ular yashirincha bo'lsa ham, buni qilishadi, yoki agar ular uzoqlashsa, bu ahmoqlik uchun.

en: And have thou this for certain that she alone is chaste, who hath either never been solicited of any or who, having herself solicited, hath not been hearkened.
uz: Va shuni aniq bilingki, faqat u pokdir, hech kimdan so'ralmagan yoki o'zi so'ragan bo'lsa, eshitilmagan.

en: And although I know by natural and true reasons that it is e’en as I say, yet should I not speak thereof with
uz: Va garchi men tabiiy va haqiqiy sabablarga ko'ra aytganimdek ekanligini bilsam ham, bu haqda gapirmasam kerak.

en: so full an assurance, had I not many a time and with many women made es- say thereof.
uz: Shunday ishonch bilan, men ko'p vaqt va ko'p ayollar bilan bu haqda gapirmagan edim.

en: And this I tell thee, that, were I near this most sanctiﬁed wife of thine, I warrant me I would in brief space of time bring her to that which I have already gotten of other women.’ Whereupon quoth Bernabo, ‘Disput- ing with words might be prolonged without end; thou wouldst say and I should say, and in the end it would all amount to nothing.
uz: Va senga aytamanki, agar men sening eng muqaddas xotiningga yaqin bo'lsam, men uni qisqa vaqt ichida boshqa ayollardan olgan narsamga olib borishga rozi bo'lardim." Shunda Bernabo dedi: "So'zlar bilan bahs cheksiz davom etishi mumkin; sen aytasan va men aytaman, va oxir-oqibatda bu hech narsaga aylanadi."

en: But, since thou wilt have it that all women are so compliant and that thine address is such, I am content, so I may certify thee of my wife’s honesty, to have my head cut off, and thou canst anywise avail to bring her to do thy pleasure in aught of the kind; and if thou fail thereof, I will have thee lose no otherwhat than a thousand gold ﬂorins.’ ‘Bernabo,’ replied Ambrogiuolo, who was now grown heated over the dispute, ‘I know not what I should do with thy blood, if I won the wager; but, an thou have a mind to see proof of that which I have advanced, do thou stake ﬁve thousand gold ﬂorins of thy monies, which should be less dear to thee than thy head, against a thousand of mine, and whereas thou settest no limit [of time], I will e’en bind myself to go to Genoa and within three months from the day of my departure hence to have done my will of thy wife and to bring back with me, in
uz: Lekin, chunki sen barcha ayollar shunchalik itoatkor bo'lishini va sening manzing shunday bo'lishini xohlaysan, men rozi bo'laman, shuning uchun men senga xotinimning halolligini tasdiqlayman, boshimni kesib tashlayman, va sen uni hech qanday narsada o'z xohishingga ko'ndirishing uchun olib kelishing mumkin; va agar bu ishingdan o'tmasang, senga ming oltin florindan kam narsa yo'qotaman." Bernabo,  deb javob berdi Ambrogiuolo, hozir bahsda qizg'in edi,  Agar men garov yutsam, qon bilan nima qilishim kerakligini bilmayman; lekin, agar men garov yutgan narsani ko'rishga aqling bo'lsa, sen o'zingning pulingdan besh ming flordan kam bo'lishi kerak, garovingni o'zing bilan birga olib keling, va men seni uch oy ichida o'zim bilan bog'layman,
