en: proof thereof, sun- dry of her most precious things and such and so many tokens that thou shalt thyself confess it to be truth, so verily thou wilt pledge me thy faith not to come to Genoa within that term nor write her aught of the matter.’ Bernabo said that it liked him well and albeit the other merchants endeavoured to hinder the affair, foreseeing that sore mischief might come thereof, the two merchants’ minds were so inﬂamed that, in despite of the rest, they bound themselves one to other by express writings under their hands.
uz: Buning isboti, uning eng qimmatbaho narsalari va shunchalik ko'p belgilari, o'zing buni haqiqat deb tan olasiz, shuning uchun shu muddat ichida Genuyaga kelmaslikka va bu haqda hech narsa yozmaslikka menga va'da berasiz." Bernabo unga yoqqanini aytdi va boshqa savdogarlar ishning oldini olishga harakat qilishsa ham, bundan og'ir zarar kelishini oldindan ko'rishsa ham, ikki savdogarning onglari shunchalik qizg'in ediki, qolganlariga qaramay, ular o'zlarini bir-biriga yozuvlar bilan bog'lashardi.

en: This done, Bernabo abode behind, whilst Ambrogiuolo, as quickliest he might, betook himself to Genoa.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, Bernabo orqada qoldi, Ambrogiuolo esa imkon qadar tezroq Genuyaga o'zini olib ketdi.

en: There he abode some days and informing himself with the utmost precaution of the name of the street where the lady dwelt and of her manner of life, understood of her that and more than that which he had heard of her from Bernabo, wherefore himseemed he was come on a fool’s errand.
uz: U yerda bir necha kun turdi va xonim yashaydigan ko'chaning nomi va uning turmush tarzi haqida o'zini eng ehtiyotkorlik bilan xabardor qilib, u haqida Bernabo'dan eshitganidan ham ko'proq narsani tushundi, shuning uchun u ahmoqona ish bilan kelgan deb o'yladi.

en: However, he presently clapped up an acquaintance with a poor wo- man, who was much about the house and whose great well-wisher the lady was, and availing not to induce her to aught else, he debauched her with money and prevailed with her to bring him, in a chest wroughten after a fashion of his own, not only into the house, but into the gentlewoman’s very bedchamber, where, according to the ordinance given her of him, the good woman commended it to her care for some days, as if she had a mind to go
uz: Biroq, u darhol bir bechora woy odam bilan tanish boldi, u uy haqida kop narsa bilgan va xonimning katta xayrixohligi bor edi, uni boshqa narsaga undashdan foydalanib, pul bilan aybladi va uni ozicha shakllangan sandiqda, nafaqat uyga, balki janob ayolning oz yotoqxonasiga olib kirishga rozi boldi. U yerda, undan berilgan farmoyishga kora, yaxshi ayol uni bir necha kunga gamxorlik qilishga topshirardi, goyo u...

en: The chest, then being left in the chamber and the night come, Ambrogiuolo, what time he judged the lady to be asleep, opened the chest with certain engines of his and came softly out into the chamber, where there was a light burning, with whose aid he proceeded to observe the or- dinance of the place, the paintings and every other notable thing that was therein and ﬁxed them in his memory.
uz: Sandiq, keyin xonada qoldirilib, tun kelgach, Ambrogiuolo xonimning uxlaganini o'ylagan paytda, sandiqni o'zining ba'zi dvigatellari bilan ochdi va sekin xonadan chiqdi, u yerda chiroq yonayotgan edi, uning yordamida u joyning ob-havo, rasmlar va u ichidagi boshqa diqqatga sazovor narsalarni kuzatishga kirdi va ularni xotirasiga mahkamladi.

en: Then, drawing near the bed and per- ceiving that the lady and a little girl, who was with her, were fast asleep, he softly altogether uncovered the former and found that she was as fair, na- ked, as clad, but saw no sign about her that he might carry away, save one, to wit, a mole which she had under the left pap and about which were sun- dry little hairs as red as gold.
uz: Keyin, karavotga yaqinlashib, xonim va uning yonida bo'lgan kichkina qizning qattiq uxlayotganini anglab yetdi, u asta-sekin birinchisini ochdi va u xuddi chiroyli, kiyimda emasligini aniqladi, lekin u haqida olib ketishi mumkinligi haqida hech qanday belgi ko'rmadi, faqat bittasini, ya'ni chap varaq ostida va atrofida quyoshdan quruq, oltindek qizil sochlari bo'lgan toshni ko'rdi.

en: This noted he covered her softly up again, al- beit, seeing her so fair, he was tempted to adventure his life and lay himself by her side; however, for that he had heard her to be so obdurate and un- complying in matters of this kind, he hazarded not himself, but, abiding at his leisure in the chamber the most part of the night, took from one of her coffers a purse and a night-rail, together with sundry rings and girdles, and laying them all in his chest, returned thither himself and shut himself up therein as before; and on this wise he did two nights, without the lady being ware of aught.
uz: U uni yana sekin yopdi, al-beit, uni shunchalik go'zal ko'rib, u o'z hayotini sarguzasht qilishga va uning yonida yotishga vasvasaga tushdi; ammo, uning bu kabi masalalarda shunchalik o'jar va itoatsiz ekanligini eshitgani uchun, o'zini xavf ostiga qo'ymadi, balki tunning ko'p qismini xonada o'tkazdi, uning javonlaridan bir hamyon va tungi relsni oldi, turli xil halqalar va kamarlar bilan birga, ularning hammasini ko'kragida qo'ydi, u yerga qaytib, avvalgidek o'zini yopdi; va shu tariqa u ikki kecha, xonimsiz qoldi.

en: On the third day the good woman came back for the chest, according to the given ordinance, and carried it off whence she had taken it, whereupon Ambrogiuolo came out and having rewarded her according to promise, returned, as quickliest he might, with the things aforesaid, to Paris, where he arrived before the term appointed.
uz: Uchinchi kuni yaxshi ayol ko'krak uchun qaytib keldi, berilgan farmoyishga ko'ra, uni olgan joyiga olib ketdi. Shundan so'ng Ambrogiuolo chiqib, va'daga ko'ra mukofotlab, imkon qadar tezroq, yuqorida aytilgan narsalar bilan Parijga qaytib keldi, u yerda belgilangan muddatdan oldin yetib keldi.

en: There he summoned the mer- chants who had been present at the dispute and the laying of the wager and declared, in Bernabo’s presence, that he had won the wager laid between them, for that he had accomplished that whereof he had vaunted himself; and to prove this to be true, he ﬁrst described the fashion of the chamber and the paintings thereof and after showed the things he had brought with him thence, avouching that he had them of herself.
uz: U yerda u bahsda va garov qo'yishda ishtirok etgan qo'shiqchilarni chaqirib oldi va Bernaboning huzurida ularning o'rtasida qo'yilgan garovni yutganini, chunki u o'zi maqtanayotgan narsani amalga oshirganini e'lon qildi; va buni to'g'riligini isbotlash uchun u avval xonaning uslubi va uning rasmlarini tasvirladi, so'ngra u bilan olib kelgan narsalarni ko'rsatdi, chunki u ularni o'zidan olgan edi.

en: Bernabo confessed the chamber to be as he had said and owned, moreover, that he recognized the things in question as being in truth his wife’s; but said that he might have learned from one of the servants of the house the fashion of the chamber and have gotten the things in like manner; wherefore, an he had nought else to say, himseemed not that this should sufﬁce to prove him to have won.
uz: Bernabo xonani o'zi aytgan va egalik qilganidek ekanligini tan oldi, bundan tashqari, u savoldagi narsalarni haqiqatan ham xotiniga tegishli ekanligini tan oldi; lekin u uyning xizmatkorlaridan biridan xonaning tartibini o'rgangan bo'lishi mumkinligini va shunga o'xshash tarzda olganini aytdi; shuning uchun, boshqa hech narsa demas edi, bu uning g'alaba qozonganligini isbotlash uchun yetarli emas deb o'yladi.

en: Whereupon quoth Ambrogiuolo, ‘In sooth this should sufﬁce, but, since thou wilt have me say more, I will say it.
uz: Shundan so'ng Ambrogiuolo aytdi: "Tinchlikda bu yetarli bo'lsa kerak, lekin, agar sen menga ko'proq gapirishni xohlasang, men aytaman."

en: I tell thee that Madam Ginevra thy wife hath under her left pap a pretty big mole, about which are maybe half a
uz: Sizga aytamanki, Madam Ginevra, xotiningizning chap otasi ostida juda katta ko'krak bor, uning haqida yarim...

en: dozen little hairs as red as gold.’ When Bernabo heard this, it was as if he had gotten a knife-thrust in the heart, such anguish did he feel, and though he had said not a word, his countenance, being all changed, gave very mani- fest token that what Ambrogiuolo said was true.
uz: o'nlab tilla kabi qizg'ish tuklar. Buni eshitganida, Bernabo go'yo yuragiga pichoq sanchig'ini olgan, shunday azobni his qilgan va garchi bir so'z ham aytmagan bo'lsa ham, uning yuzidagi o'zgarish Ambrogiuoloning aytganlarining haqiqat ekanligini juda yaqqol ko'rsatardi.

en: Then, after awhile, ‘Gen- tlemen,’ quoth he, ‘that which Ambrogiuolo saith is true; wherefore, he hav- ing won, let him come whenassoever it pleaseth him and he shall be paid.’ Accordingly, on the ensuing day Ambrogiuolo was paid in full and Bern- abo, departing Paris, betook himself to Genoa with fell intent against the lady.
uz: Keyin, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, u: General-tlemen, dedi u, Ambrogiuoloning aytganlari rost; shuning uchun, u g'alaba qozongan bo'lsa, u xohlagan vaqtda kelsin va u to'lanadi. Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni Ambrogiuoloning to'liq to'lovi to'landi va Bern-abo Parijdan jo'nab, xonimga qarshi qasd bilan Genuyaga yo'l oldi.

en: When he drew near the city, he would not enter therein, but lighted down a good score miles away at a country house of his and despatched one of his servants, in whom he much trusted, to Genoa with two horses and let- ters under his hand, advising his wife that he had returned and bidding her come to him; and he privily charged the man, whenas he should be with the lady in such place as should seem best to him, to put her to death without pity and return to him.
uz: U shaharga yaqinlashganda, u yerga kirmasdi, balki o'zining qishloq uyiga yaqinroq masofada bir necha mil masofada yo'naltirdi va o'ziga ishongan xizmatkorlaridan birini Genuyaga ikki ot va qo'li ostida qo'yib yubordi, xotiniga qaytib kelganini maslahat berdi va unga kelishni buyurdi; va u erkakni, xonim bilan o'zi uchun eng yaxshi ko'ringan joyda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan paytda, rahm-shafqat bilan o'ldirib, o'ziga qaytishga buyurdi.

en: The servant accordingly repaired to Genoa and de- livering the letters and doing his errand, was received with great rejoicing by the lady, who on the morrow took horse with him and set out for their country house.
uz: Xizmatkor shunga ko'ra Genovaga yo'l oldi va xatlarni tarqatdi va o'z vazifasini bajardi, xonim uni katta quvonch bilan kutib oldi, u ertasi kuni otni o'zi bilan olib, o'z qishloq uyiga yo'l oldi.

en: As they fared on together, discoursing of one thing and an- other, they came to a very deep and lonely valley, beset with high rocks and trees, which seeming to the servant a place wherein he might, with assur- ance for himself, do his lord’s commandment, he pulled out his knife and taking the lady by the arm, said, ‘Madam, commend your soul to God, for needs must you die, without faring farther.’ The lady, seeing the knife and hearing these words, was all dismayed and said, ‘Mercy, for God’s sake!
uz: Ular bir-birlari bilan yo'lda ketayotganda, ular juda chuqur va yolg'iz vodiyga kelishdi, baland toshlar va daraxtlar bilan o'ralgan edi. Bu yerda xizmatchi o'z xo'jayinining buyrug'ini ishonch bilan bajarishi mumkin bo'lgan joyga o'xshardi. U pichoqni chiqarib, xonimning qo'lidan ushladi va dedi: "Xonim, joningizni Xudoga taslim eting, uzoqroq yurmasdan o'lishingiz kerak". Xonim pichoqni ko'rib va bu so'zlarni eshitib, butunlay dahshatga tushdi va dedi: "Rahmat, Xudo uchun!"

en: Ere thou slay me, tell me wherein I have offended thee, that thou wouldst put me to death.’ ‘Madam,’ answered the man, ‘me you have nowise offen- ded; but wherein you have offended your husband I know not, save that he hath commanded me slay you by the way, without having any pity upon you, threatening me, an I did it not, to have me hanged by the neck.
uz: Meni o'ldirishdan oldin, meni qayerdan xafa qilganimni ayting, meni o'ldirmoqchi bo'lsangiz." Xonim,  javob berdi odam, men hozir xafa bo'ldim; lekin siz eringizni qayerda xafa qilganingizni bilmayman, faqat u sizga rahm qilmasdan, meni sizga tahdid qilib, sizni yo'lda o'ldirishga buyurgan, men buni qilmadim, meni bo'yniga osib qo'ydi.

en: You know well how much I am beholden to him and how I may not gainsay him in aught that he may impose upon me; God knoweth it irketh me for you, but I can no otherwise.’ Whereupon quoth the lady, weeping, ‘Alack, for God’s sake, consent not to become the murderer of one who hath never wronged thee, to serve another!
uz: Siz yaxshi bilasiz, men unga qanchalik qarzdorman va u menga hech narsa yuklashi uchun uni qanday qo'lga kiritmasligimni; Xudo biladi, bu meni siz uchun g'azablantiradi, lekin men bundan boshqa ilojim yo'q." Shunda xonim yig'lab dedi: "Lalak, Xudo haqqi, senga hech qachon zulm qilmagan odamning qotilisi bo'lishga rozi bo'lma, boshqaga xizmat qilma!"

en: God who knoweth all knoweth that I never did aught for which I should receive such a recompense from my husband.
uz: Hamma narsani biladigan Xudo biladi, men hech qachon erimdan bunday mukofot olishim kerak bo'lgan hech narsa qilmaganimni.

en: But let that be; thou mayst, an thou wilt, at once content God and thy master and me, on this wise; to wit, that thou take these my clothes and give me
uz: Lekin shunday bo'lsin; sen, albatta, darhol Xudoga, xo'jayiningga va menga shu yo'l bilan rozi bo'lgin; ya'ni, bu kiyimlarimni olib, menga bergin.

en: but thy doublet and a hood and with the former return to my lord and thine and tell him that thou hast slain me; and I swear to thee, by that life which thou wilt have bestowed on me, that I will remove hence and get me gone into a country whence never shall any news of me win either to him or to thee or into these parts.’ The servant, who was loath to slay her, was lightly moved to compassion; wherefore he took her clothes and give her a sorry doublet of his and a hood, leaving her sundry monies she had with her.
uz: Lekin sening ikki qo'ling va bir kapyushang va avvalgi bilan xo'jayinimga va senikiga qaytib, unga meni o'ldirganingni ayt; va men senga qasam ichaman, menga bergan hayotingga qasam ichaman, men bu yerdan chiqib ketaman va meni u yerdan hech qachon menga, na senga, na bu yerlarga hech qanday xabar kelmaydigan yurtga olib boraman." Uni o'ldirishni istamagan xizmatkor yengil rahm-shafqatga tushdi; shuning uchun u uning kiyimini olib, unga o'zining bir qo'ltig'ini va bir kapyushni berdi va uning o'zida bo'lgan turli xil boyliklarini qoldirdi.

en: Then praying her depart the country, he left her in the valley and afoot and betook himself to his master, to whom he avouched that not only was his commandment accomplished, but that he had left the lady’s dead body among a pack of wolves, and Bernabo presently returned to Genoa, where the thing becoming known, he was much blamed.
uz: Keyin uni yurtdan ketishiga duo qilib, u uni vodiyda qoldirdi va o'zini xo'jayiniga olib bordi. U unga nafaqat amrining bajarilganini, balki xonimning o'lik jasadini bo'rilar to'dasi orasida qoldirganini aytdi va Bernabo tez orada Genovaga qaytib keldi, u yerda bu narsa ma'lum bo'lib, u ko'p ayblandi.

en: As for the lady, she abode alone and disconsolate till nightfall, when she disguised herself as most she might and repaired to a village hard by, where, having gotten from an old woman that which she needed, she ﬁtted the doublet to her shape and short- ening it, made a pair of linen breeches of her shift; then, having cut her hair and altogether transformed herself in the guise of a sailor, she betook her- self to the seashore, where, as chance would have it, she found a Catalan gentleman, by name Señor Encararch, who had landed at Alba from a ship he had in the ofﬁng, to refresh himself at a spring there.
uz: Xonim esa, u yolg'iz qoldi va tun bo'lguncha taskin bermadi. U o'zini imkon qadar ko'rsatdi va bir qishloqqa qattiq qaytdi. U yerda, keksa ayoldan o'ziga kerakli narsani olib, uni shakliga moslashtirdi va qisqa qilib, o'z navbatida zig'ir ko'ylaklarini yasadi; so'ngra sochlarini kesib, butunlay dengizchi qiyofasida o'zini dengiz bo'yiga ko'tardi. U yerda, imkoniyat bo'lishiga ko'ra, u yerda bahorda tetiklanish uchun ketayotgan kemasidan Albaga qo'ng'ib kelgan Señor Encararch ismli kataloniyalik janobni topdi.

en: With him she entered into parley and engaging with him as a servant, embarked on board the ship, under the name of Sicurano da Finale.
uz: U bilan birga u parleyga kirdi va u bilan xizmatkor sifatida ishladi, Sicurano da Finale nomi ostida kemaga chiqdi.

en: There, being furnished by the gentleman with better clothes, she proceeded to serve him so well and so aptly that she became in the utmost favour with him.
uz: U yerda, janob tomonidan yaxshiroq kiyimlar bilan ta'minlanganidan so'ng, u unga shunchalik yaxshi va mohirona xizmat ko'rsatdi, hatto u unga juda yoqdi.

en: No great while after it befell that the Catalan made a voyage to Alexandria with a lading of his and carrying thither certain peregrine falcons for the Soldan, presented them to him.
uz: Kataloniyalik Aleksandriyaga o'z yukini olib borgani va u yerga Soldan uchun ba'zi ko'chmanchi varraklarni olib borgani, unga sovg'a qilganidan ko'p o'tmay qoldi.

en: The Soldan, having once and again entertained him at meat and not- ing with approof the fashions of Sicurano, who still went serving him, begged him134 of his master, who yielded him to him, although it irked him to do it, and Sicurano, in a little while, by his good behaviour, gained the love and favour of the Soldan, even as he had gained that of the Catalan.
uz: Soldanlar uni bir necha bor go'sht bilan xursand qilishdi va Sicurano'ning uslublariga yaqinlashmagan holda, u hali ham unga xizmat qilib yurardi, uni xo'jayinidan134 iltimos qildi, u uni unga topshirdi, garchi bu unga yoqqan bo'lsa ham, va Sicurano, ozgina vaqt o'tgach, o'zining yaxshi xulq-atvori bilan, xuddi Katalanning sevgisini qo'lga kiritganidek, Soldanlarning mehriga va marhamatiga sazovor bo'ldi.

en: Wherefore, in process of time, it befell that —the time coming for a great assemblage, in the guise of a fair, of merchants, both Christian and Saracen, which was wont at a certain season of the year to be held in Acre, a town under the seignory of the Soldan, and to which, in order that the merchants and their merchandise might rest secure, the latter was still used to des- patch, besides other his ofﬁcers, some one of his chief men, with troops, to
uz: Shunday qilib, vaqt o'tishi bilan shunday bo'ldiki, birja ko'rinishida, xristian va saracen savdogarlarining katta yig'ilishi vaqti keldi. Bu yig'ilish yilning ma'lum bir faslida Soldan hukmronligi ostidagi Akrada o'tkazilishi odatiy edi. Savdogarlar va ularning tovarlari xavfsiz bo'lishi uchun, u hali ham boshqa ofitserlaridan tashqari, uning boshliqlaridan bir nechtasini, qo'shinlari bilan,

en: look to the guard —he bethought himself to send Sicurano, who was by this well versed in the language of the country, on this service; and so he did.
uz: Qo'riqchiga qarang  u o'zini shu xizmatga mamlakat tilida yaxshi xabardor bo'lgan Sicurano'ni yuborishga o'ylagan edi; va u shunday qildi.

en: Sicurano accordingly came to Acre as governor and captain of the guard of the merchants and their merchandise and there well and diligently doing that which pertained to his ofﬁce and going round looking about him, saw many merchants there, Sicilians and Pisans and Genoese and Venetians and other Italians, with whom he was fain to make acquaintance, in remem- brance of his country.
uz: Sicurano shunga ko'ra Akre shahriga savdogarlar va ularning tovarlari qo'riqlashining gubernatori va sardori sifatida keldi va u yerda o'z ofisiga tegishli bo'lgan ishlarni yaxshilab va astoydil bajardi va atrofini aylanib, u yerda ko'plab savdogarlarni ko'rdi: siziliyaliklar va pizanliklar, genovaliklar va venetsiyaliklar va boshqa italyanlar, ular bilan o'z mamlakatini eslab, tanishishga moyil edi.

en: It befell, one time amongst others, that, having lighted down at the shop of certain Venetian merchants, he espied among other trinkets, a purse and a girdle, which he straightway knew for having been his and marvelled thereat; but, without making any sign, he carelessly asked to whom they pertained and if they were for sale.
uz: Shunday bo'lib qoldiki, bir vaqtlar boshqalarning orasida shunday bo'ldiki, u ba'zi Venetsiyalik savdogarlarning do'konida boshqa mayda-chuyda narsalar orasida, bir hamyon va kamarni kuzatdi, ularni darhol o'ziniki ekanligini bilib, hayratda qoldirdi; lekin hech qanday belgi ko'rsatmasdan, beparvolik bilan ularning kimga tegishliligini va ular sotuvda ekanligini so'radi.

en: Now Ambrogiuolo of Piacenza was come thither with much merchandise on board a Venetian ship and hearing the captain of the guard ask whose the trinkets were, came forward and said, laughing, ‘Sir, the things are mine and I do not sell them; but, if they please you, I will gladly give them to you.’ Sicurano, seeing him laugh, misdoubted he had recognized him by some gesture of his; but yet, keeping a steady countenance, he said, ‘Belike thou laughest to see me, a soldier, go questioning of these women’s toys?’ ‘Sir,’ answered Ambrogi- uolo, ‘I laugh not at that; nay, but at the way I came by them.’ ‘Marry, then,’ said Sicurano, ‘an it be not unspeakable, tell me how thou gottest them, so God give thee good luck.’ Quoth Ambrogiuolo, ‘Sir, a gentlewoman of Gen- oa, hight Madam Ginevra, wife of Bernabo Lomellini, gave me these things, with certain others, one night that I lay with her, and
uz: Endi Piacenzalik Ambrogiuolo Venetsiya kemasida ko'p tovar bilan u yerga keldi va soqchi kapitanining kimning mayda-chuyda ekanligi haqida so'raganini eshitdi. U oldinga chiqib, kuldi: "Janob, bu narsalar meniki va men ularni sotmayman; lekin, agar ular sizga yoqsa, men ularni sizga mamnuniyat bilan beraman." Sicurano uni kulganini ko'rib, u uni bir imo-ishorati bilan tanidi, ammo qat'iy nazar, u dedi: "Siz meni ko'rib, askar, bu ayollar o'yinchoqlarini so'rashga borasizmi?"   Janob Ambrogi-uolo javob berdi: Men bu haqda kulmayman; yo'q, lekin men ulardan o'tib kelganimda. Marry, Geneva,  siz menga shunday yaxshi narsa bermaysiz,  siz menga shunday yaxshi narsa berasiz, xonim,

en: prayed me keep them for the love of her.
uz: U menga ularni o'z muhabbati uchun saqlab qolishimni so'radi.

en: Now I laugh for that I mind me of the simplicity of Bernabo, who was fool enough to lay ﬁve thousand ﬂorins to one that I would not bring his wife to do my pleasure; the which I did and won the wager; whereupon he, who should rather have punished himself for his stu- pidity than her for doing that which all women do, returned from Paris to Genoa and there, by what I have since heard, caused her put to death.’ Sicurano, hearing this, understood forthwith what was the cause of Bern- abo’s anger against his wife135 and manifestly perceiving this fellow to have been the occasion of all her ills, determined not to let him go unpunished therefor.
uz: Endi men Bernaboning soddaligi haqida o'ylayman, u o'z xotinimga rozi bo'lish uchun besh ming florinni berishga ahmoq edi; men qilgan va garovni yutgan narsa; shundan so'ng u, barcha ayollar qiladigan ishni qilganidan ko'ra o'zini qattiqroq jazolashi kerak bo'lgan odam, Parijdan Genuyaga qaytib keldi va u yerda, o'shandan beri eshitganlarimga ko'ra, uni o'ldirishga majbur qildi." Buni eshitgan Sicurano, Bern-abo'ning xotiniga nisbatan g'azabining sababi nima ekanligini darhol tushundi va bu odamni uning barcha illatlari sababi ekanligini aniq anglab, unga jazosiz qoldirmaslikka qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly he feigned to be greatly diverted with the story and artfully clapped up a strait acquaintance with him, insomuch that, the fair being ended, Ambrogiuolo, at his instance, accompanied him, with all his good, to Alexandria.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u hikoya bilan juda chalg'iganini ko'rsatdi va u bilan mohirona yaqin tanishuvni qo'llab-quvvatladi, shunda go'zallik tugagandan so'ng, Ambrogiuolo uni butun boyligi bilan Iskandariyaga jo'natib bordi.

en: Here Sicurano let build him a warehouse and lodged in
uz: Bu yerda Sicurano unga ombor qurdirdi va u yerda tunadi.

en: his hands store of his own monies; and Ambrogiuolo, foreseeing great ad- vantage to himself, willingly took up his abode there.
uz: Uning qo'llari o'z boyliklarini saqlaydi; va Ambrogiuolo o'ziga katta imtiyoz ko'rib, u yerda o'z xohishi bilan turar joyini egalladi.

en: Meanwhile, Sicurano, careful to make Bernabo clear of his136 innocence, rested not till, by means of certain great Genoese merchants who were then in Alexandria, he had, on some plausible occasion of his137 own devising, caused him come thith- er, where ﬁnding him in poor enough case, he had him privily entertained by a friend of his138 against it should seem to him139 time to do that which he purposed.
uz: Ayni paytda, Sikorano, Bernaboni o'zining 136 begunohligini aniq aytishga harakat qildi, o'shanda Iskandariyada bo'lgan ba'zi buyuk genovlik savdogarlar yordamida, u o'zining 137 ta o'ylab topganligi sababli, uni shunday qilishga majbur qildi, uni yetarli darajada kambag'al holatda topib, uni o'zining 138 ta do'sti bilan maxfiy ravishda o'yin-kulgi qildi, bu unga o'zi maqsad qilgan narsani qilish uchun 139 marta tuyulishi kerak edi.

en: Now he had already made Ambrogiuolo recount his story be- fore the Soldan for the latter’s diversion; but seeing Bernabo there and thinking there was no need to use farther delay in the matter, he took occa- sion to procure the Soldan to have Ambrogiuolo and Bernabo brought be- fore him and in the latter’s presence, to extort from the former, by dint of severity, an it might not easily be done [by other means], the truth of that whereof he vaunted himself concerning Bernabo’s wife.
uz: Endi u Ambrogiuoloni o'z hikoyasini aytib berishga majbur qilgan edi  Soldanning bu ishidan chalg'ish uchun; lekin u yerda Bernaboni ko'rib, bu masalada uzoqroq kechikishning hojati yo'q deb o'ylagan holda, u Soldanni Ambrogiuoloni va Bernaboning oldinga olib kelishiga va oxirgilarning huzurida birinchisidan qattiqqo'llik bilan, bu osonlik bilan amalga oshirilmasligi mumkin edi, u o'zini Bernoboning xotini haqida maqtaganining haqiqatini.

en: Accordingly, they both being come, the Soldan, in the presence of many, with a stern counten- ance commanded Ambrogiuolo to tell the truth how he had won of Bernabo the ﬁve thousand gold ﬂorins; and Sicurano himself, in whom he most trus- ted, with a yet angrier aspect, threatened him with the most grievous tor- ments, an he told it not; whereupon Ambrogiuolo, affrighted on one side and another and in a measure constrained, in the presence of Bernabo and many others, plainly related everything, even as it passed, expecting no worse punishment therefor than the restitution of the ﬁve thousand gold ﬂorins and of the stolen trinkets.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ularning ikkalasi ham kelganida, Soldan ko'pchilikning huzurida qattiq yuz bilan Ambrogiuolonga Bernabodan besh ming oltin florinni qanday yutganini haqiqatni aytishni buyurdi; va Sicurano o'zi, unga eng ishonchli, yanada g'azablangan ko'rinish bilan, uni eng og'ir azoblar bilan tahdid qildi, lekin u buni aytmadi; shundan so'ng, bir tomondan xafa bo'lgan va cheklangan Ambrogiuolo, Bernabo va boshqalarning huzurida, hamma narsani aniq aytib berdi, hatto o'tganidek, u uchun besh ming oltin florinni va o'g'irlangan bochkalarni qaytarishdan yomonroq jazo kutmadi.

en: He having spoken, Sicurano, as he were the Soldan’s minister in the matter, turned to Bernabo and said to him, ‘And thou, what didst thou to thy lady for this lie?’ Whereto Bernabo replied, ‘Overcome with wrath for the loss of my money and with resentment for the shame which meseemed I had gotten from my wife, I caused a servant of mine put her to death, and according to that which he reported to me, she was straightway devoured by a multitude of wolves,’ These things said in the presence of the Soldan and all heard and apprehended of him, albeit he knew not yet to what end Sicurano, who had sought and ordered this, would fain come, the latter said to him, ‘My lord, you may very clearly see how much reason yonder poor lady had to vaunt herself of her gallant and her husband, for that the former at once bereaved her of honour, marring her fair fame with lies, and despoiled her husband,
uz: U gapirib bo'lgach, Sikorano, bu masalada Soldanning vaziri bo'lgani kabi, Bernaboga o'girilib, unga dedi: Sen-chi, bu yolg'on uchun xonimiga nima qilding? Shunda Bernabo javob berdi: Pul yo'qotilgani uchun g'azabdan va xotinimdan olgan sharmandaligimdan xafa bo'lib, men bir xizmatchimni o'ldirtirdim va menga xabar berganlariga ko'ra, u darhol bir qancha bo'rilar tomonidan yeb bitkazildi. Bu gaplarni Soldan huzurida aytdi va hamma eshitdi va undan xavotirlandi, garchi u hali nimaga kelishini bilmagan edi. Sikorano, bu haqda buyruq bergan edi, u unga dedi: Ey xo'jayinim, siz o'z eringizning bir marta uni qanday qilib yirtganini ko'rishingiz mumkin edi, chunki u o'zining

en: whilst the latter more credu- lous of others’ falsehoods than of the truth which he might by long experi- ence have known, caused her to be slain and eaten of wolves; and moreover,
uz: Ikkinchisi esa, uzoq vaqt davomida bilgan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan haqiqatdan ko'ra, boshqalarning yolg'onlariga ko'ra ko'proq ishonadi va uni bo'rilar o'ldirib yeydi; va bundan tashqari,

en: such is the goodwill and the love borne her by the one and the other that, having long abidden with her, neither of them knoweth her.
uz: Bunday yaxshi niyat va unga bir-biridan kelgan muhabbat shundayki, ular uzoq vaqt davomida u bilan yashirinib, hech biri uni tanimaydi.

en: But that you may the better apprehend that which each of these hath deserved, I will —so but you vouchsafe me, of special favour to punish the deceiver and pardon the dupe —e’en cause her come hither into your and their presence.’ The Soldan, disposed in the matter altogether to comply with Sicurano’s wishes, answered that he would well and bade him produce the lady; whereat Bern- abo marvelled exceedingly, for that he ﬁrmly believed her to be dead, whilst Ambrogiuolo, now divining his danger, began to be in fear of worse than paying of monies and knew not whether more to hope or to fear from the coming of the lady, but awaited her appearance with the utmost amazement.
uz: Lekin ularning har biri nimaga loyiq ekanligini yaxshiroq anglashingiz uchun, men  shunday ekan, siz meni, firibgarni jazolash va dupeni kechirish uchun maxsus imtiyoz bilan taminlaysiz  toki u sizning oldingizga va ularning huzuriga kelsin. Soldan, bu masalada Sicurano'ning istaklariga to'liq mos kelishga tayyor bo'lib, unga xonimni olib kelishni buyurdi; Bern-abo esa uni o'lgan deb qattiq ishondi, Ambrogiuolo esa, endi o'z xavfini bashorat qilayotganda, pul to'lashdan ko'ra yomonroqdan qo'rqay boshladi va xonimning kelishini ko'proq umid qilish yoki qo'rqish kerakligini bilmas edi, lekin uning paydo bo'lishini juda hayrat bilan kutdi.

en: The Soldan, then, having accorded Sicurano his wish, the latter threw him- self, weeping, on his knees before him and putting off, as it were at one and the same time, his manly voice and masculine demeanour, said, ‘My lord, I am the wretched misfortunate Ginevra, who have these six years gone wan- dering in man’s disguise about the world, having been foully and wickedly aspersed by this traitor Ambrogiuolo and given by yonder cruel and unjust man to one of his servants to be slain and eaten of wolves.’ Then, tearing open the fore part of her clothes and showing her breast, she discovered herself to the Soldan and all else who were present and after, turning to Am- brogiuolo, indignantly demanded of him when he had ever lain with her, according as he had aforetime boasted; but he, now knowing her and fallen well nigh dumb for shame, said nothing.
uz: Soldan, keyin Sicuranoga o'z xohishini berganidan so'ng, u oxirgi o'zini, yig'lab, uning oldida tizzalariga tashladi va go'yo bir vaqtning o'zida o'zining erkakona ovozi va erkakona xulq-atvorini so'ndirdi va dedi: "Ey Rabbim, men bechora baxtsiz Ginevraman, bu olti yil davomida insonning dunyodagi niqobi bilan o'tib ketganman, bu xoin Ambrogiuolo tomonidan iflos va yovuz tarzda ezilgan va u yerda shafqatsiz va adolatsiz odam tomonidan o'z xizmatkorlaridan biriga o'ldirilishi va bo'rilardan yeyilishi uchun berilgan edi." Keyin, kiyimining old qismini yirtib, ko'kraklarini ko'rsatib, u Soldan va boshqa barcha odamlarga o'zini topdi va keyin, u bilan birga bo'lganda, u hech narsa uchun uyalmagan edi.

en: The Soldan, who had always held her a man, seeing and hearing this, fell into such a wonderment that he more than once misdoubted that which he saw and heard to be rather a dream than true.
uz: Soldan, uni doimo erkak deb hisoblagan, buni ko'rib va eshitib, shunchalik hayratga tushdiki, ko'p marta ko'rgan va eshitgan narsalari haqiqatdan ko'ra ko'proq orzu ekanligiga shubha qildi.

en: However, after his amazement had abated, apprehending the truth of the matter, he lauded to the utmost the life and fashions of Ginevra, till then called Sicurano, and extolled her constancy and virtue; and letting bring her very sumptuous woman’s apparel and women to attend her, he pardoned Bernabo, in accordance with her request, the death he had merited, whilst the latter, recognizing her, cast himself at her feet, weeping and craving forgiveness, which she, ill worthy as he was thereof, graciously accorded him and raising him to his feet, embraced him tenderly, as her husband.
uz: Ammo, hayratdan so'ng, masalaning haqiqatini anglab yetgach, u Ginevraning hayoti va modalarini, shu paytgacha Sicurano deb atalganini eng yuqori baholadi va uning qat'iyat va fazilatini ulug'ladi; va unga juda hashamatli ayolning kiyimlari va ayollarini olib kelishga ruxsat berdi, u Bernaboni kechirdi, uning so'roviga ko'ra, o'zi loyiq bo'lgan o'limni, oxirgi esa uni tanidi, oyoqlariga tashladi, yig'ladi va kechirim so'radi, u esa, unga loyiq bo'lmaganicha, uni mehribonlik bilan berdi va oyoqlariga ko'tardi, uni eridek, yumshoq quchoqladi.

en: Then the Soldan commanded that Ambrogiuolo should incontin- ent be bound to a stake and smeared with honey and exposed to the sun in some high place of the city, nor should ever be loosed thence till such time as he should fall of himself; and so was it done.
uz: Shunda Soldan Ambrogiuoloni do'zaxga bog'lab, asal bilan surtish va shaharning qaysidir baland joyida quyoshga duchor qilish kerakligini buyurdi. U yerda hech qachon o'zidan yiqilish paytigacha bo'shatilmasligi kerak edi; va shunday bo'ldi.

en: After this he commanded
uz: Shundan so'ng u buyurdi:

en: that all that had belonged to him should be given to the lady, the which was not so little but that it outvalued ten thousand doubloons.
uz: Unga tegishli bo'lgan hamma narsa xonimga berilishi kerak edi, bu unchalik kichik emas edi, balki o'n ming ikki barobar qimmatroq edi.

en: Moreover, he let make a very goodly banquet, wherein he entertained Bernabo with honour, as Madam Ginevra’s husband, and herself as a very valiant lady and gave her, in jewels and vessels of gold and silver and monies, that which amoun- ted to better140 than other ten thousand doubloons.
uz: Qolaversa, u juda yaxshi ziyofat uyushtirdi, unda u Bernaboni Madam Ginevraning eri sifatida, o'zini esa juda jasur xonim sifatida sharaf bilan kutib oldi va unga zargarlik buyumlari, oltin, kumush va pul idishlarida, boshqa o'n mingta dublonga qaraganda 140 dan ko'proq narsa berdi.

en: Then, the banquet over, he caused equip them a ship and gave them leave to return at their pleasure to Genoa, whither accordingly they returned with great joyance and exceed- ing rich; and there they were received with the utmost honour, especially Madam Ginevra, who was of all believed to be dead and who, while she lived, was still reputed of great worth and virtue.
uz: Keyin ziyofat tugagandan so'ng, u ularga kema jihozladi va ularga Genuyaga o'z xohishlariga ko'ra qaytishga ruxsat berdi. Shunga ko'ra, ular katta quvonch va nihoyatda boylik bilan qaytib kelishdi; va u yerda ularni eng katta sharaf bilan kutib olishdi, ayniqsa, o'lgan deb hisoblangan va u tirikligida hali ham katta qadr-qimmat va fazilatga ega deb hisoblangan Madam Ginevra.

en: As for Ambrogiuolo, be- ing that same day bounded to the stake and anointed with honey, he was, to his exceeding torment, not only slain, but devoured, of the ﬂies and wasps and gadﬂies, wherewith that country aboundeth, even to the bones, which latter, waxed white and hanging by the sinews, being left unremoved, long bore witness of his villainy to all who saw them.
uz: Ambrogiuologa kelsak, o'sha kuni o'tga bog'langan va asal bilan moylangan bo'lsa-da, u o'zining haddan tashqari azobida nafaqat o'ldirilgan, balki hasharotlar, arilar va gadflylardan ham yemirilgan edi, ular bilan o'sha yurt suyaklargacha to'lib-toshgan edi, ular oq va mushaklar bo'ylab osilib qolgan, uzoq vaqt davomida ularni ko'rgan barchaga o'z yovuzligi haqida guvohlik berdi.

en: And on this wise did the deceiver abide at the feet of the deceived.”
uz: Shunday qilib, firibgar aldanganlarning oyoqlari ostida turdi.

en: THE TENTH STORY Paganino of Monaco stealeth away the wife of Messer Ricciardo di Chinzica, who, learning where she is, goeth thither and making friends with Paganino, demandeth her again of him.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Monakolik Paganino Messer Ricciardo di Chinzicaning xotinini o'g'irlaydi, u qayerda ekanligini bilib, u yerga boradi va Paganino bilan do'stlashadi, undan uni yana talab qiladi.

en: The latter concedeth her to him, an she will; but she refuseth to return with him and Messer Ricciardo dying, she becometh the wife of Paganino.
uz: Oxirgisi uni unga beradi, bu uning irodasi; lekin u u bilan qaytishdan bosh tortadi va Messer Ricciardo o'layotganda, u Paganinning xotiniga aylanadi.

en: Each of the honourable company highly commended for goodly the story told by their queen, especially Dioneo, with whom alone for that present day it now rested to tell, and who, after many praises bestowed upon the preceding tale, said, “Fair ladies, one part of the queen’s story hath caused me change counsel of telling you one that was in my mind, and determine to tell you another —and that is the stupidity of Bernabo (albeit good betided him thereof) and of all others who give themselves to believe that which he made a show of believing and who, to wit, whilst going about the world, diverting themselves now with this woman and now with that, ima- gine that the ladies left at home abide with their hands in their girdles, as if we knew not, we who are born and reared among the latter, unto what they are fain.
uz: Hurmatli kompaniyalarning har biri o'z malikalari tomonidan aytilgan hikoyani yaxshilik uchun yuqori baholadi, ayniqsa Dioneo, u bilan faqat o'sha kun uchun aytib berish qoldi va u, oldingi hikoyaga ko'p maqtovlar berganidan so'ng, dedi: "Adolatli xonimlar, malika hikoyasining bir qismi meni sizlarning xayolimda bo'lgan narsani aytishga undadi va sizga boshqa bir narsani aytishga qaror qildi  va bu Bernaboning ahmoqligi ( garchi unga yaxshilik bilan aytib bergan bo'lsa ham) va o'zini u ishongan narsalarga ishongan barcha boshqalarning ahmoqligidir va ular, xususan, dunyo bo'ylab sayr qilib, hozir bu ayol bilan o'zlarini chalg'itib, endi shu bilan birga, uyda qolgan xonimlar o'z qo'llarida qolib ketishlarini bilmasligimiz kerak, go'yo biz ular orasida tug'ilganlar,

en: In telling you this story, I shall at once show you how great is the folly of these folk and how greater yet is that of those who, deeming them- selves more potent than nature herself, think by dint of sophistical inven- tions141 to avail unto that which is beyond their power and study to bring others to that which they themselves are, whenas the complexion of those on whom they practise brooketh it not.
uz: Sizga bu hikoyani aytib berar ekanman, men darhol bu odamlarning ahmoqligi qanchalik buyuk ekanligini va ularni tabiatdan kuchliroq deb hisoblaydigan, o'zlarini puxta ixtirolar bilan o'ylab, o'z kuchlaridan tashqariga chiqadigan narsalardan foydalanish va boshqalarni o'zlari bo'lgan narsaga olib kelish uchun o'rganish qanchalik buyuk ekanligini ko'rsataman, ammo ular amal qiladiganlarning yakuniyligi uni yo'qotmaydi.

en: There was, then, in Pisa a judge, by name Messer Ricciardo di Chinzica, more gifted with wit than with bodily strength, who, thinking belike to sat- isfy a wife by the same means which served him to despatch his studies and being very rich, sought with no little diligence to have a fair and young lady
uz: O'shanda, Pisa shahrida bir sudya bor edi, uning ismi Messer Ricciardo di Chinzica edi. U jismoniy kuchdan ko'ra aql-idrok qobiliyatiga ko'proq ega edi. U o'z o'qishini davom ettirish va juda boy bo'lish uchun xizmat qiladigan bir xil usullar bilan xotin olishni o'ylagan holda, adolatli va yosh ayolga ega bo'lishga unchalik intilmagan edi.

en: to wife; whereas, had he but known to counsel himself as he counselled oth- ers, he should have shunned both the one and the other.
uz: xotiniga; agar u o'zini boshqalarga maslahat berganidek maslahat berishni bilganida edi, u ikkalasi ham ulardan chetda bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: The thing came to pass according to his wish, for Messer Lotto Gualandi gave him to wife a daughter of his, Bartolomea by name, one of the fairest and handsomest young ladies of Pisa, albeit there be few there that are not very lizards to look upon.
uz: Ish uning xohishiga ko'ra sodir bo'ldi, chunki Messer Lotto Gualandi unga o'zining qizi, Pisaning eng go'zal va chiroyli yosh ayollaridan biri bo'lgan Bartolomea ismli qizini xotinlikka berdi, garchi u yerda unchalik ko'rinadigan kaltakesaklar kam bo'lsa ham.

en: The judge accordingly brought her home with the utmost pomp and having held a magniﬁcent wedding, made shift the ﬁrst night to hand her one venue for the consummation of the marriage, but came within an ace of making a stalemate of it, whereafter, lean and dry and scant of wind as he was, it behoved him on the morrow bring himself back to life with malmsey and restorative confections and other remedies.
uz: Sudya uni uyiga juda hashamat bilan olib keldi va ajoyib to'y o'tkazdi, birinchi kechada unga nikohning yakuniy yakunlanishi uchun bir joyni topshirish uchun navbatchilik qildi, lekin bir zumda uni to'xtab qoldi, shundan so'ng, u qanday bo'lsa, ozg'in, quruq va shamol hididan keyin, ertaga o'zini malmsey va tiklovchi shirinliklar va boshqa vositalar bilan tiriltirishni buyurdi.

en: Thenceforward, being now a better judge of his own powers than he was, he fell to teaching his wife a calendar ﬁt for children learning to read and belike made afore- time at Ravenna,142 for that, according to what he feigned to her, there was no day in the year but was sacred not to one saint only, but to many, in rev- erence of whom he showed by divers reasons that man and wife should ab- stain from carnal conversation; and to these be added, to boot, fast days and Emberdays and the vigils of the Apostles and of a thousand other saints and Fridays and Saturdays and Lord’s Day and all Lent and certain seasons of the moon and store of other exceptions, conceiving belike that it behoved to keep holiday with women in bed like as he did bytimes whilst pleading in the courts of civil law.
uz: Shundan so'ng, o'z kuchini o'zidan yaxshiroq baholab, u rafiqasiga o'qishni o'rganadigan va oldindan yaratilgan bolalar uchun taqvimni o'rgatishga qaror qildi. 142 Chunki, unga o'ylaganidek, yilning bir kuni bo'lmagan, faqat bitta avliyoga emas, balki ko'pchilikka muqaddas edi. U turli sabablarga ko'ra erkak va xotin jinsiy muloqotdan dog' tushmasligi kerakligini ko'rsatdi; va bularga qo'shimcha ravishda, tovuq, ro'za kunlari va Emberdaylar va Havoriylar va minglab boshqa avliyolarning, juma va shanba kunlari hamda Rabbiy kunlari va barcha Ro'za kunlari, shuningdek, oyning ayrim fasllari va boshqa istisnolar kabi, ayollarni o'zi bilan birga saqlashni nazarda tutdi.

en: This fashion (to the no small chagrin of the lady, whom he handled maybe once a month, and hardly that) he followed a great while, still keeping strait watch over her, lest peradventure some other should teach her to know working-days, even as he had taught her holidays.
uz: Bu moda (xonimning mayda-chuyda xafa bo'lishiga qaramay, u bir oyda bir marta uni qabul qilardi, va bu deyarli emas) u uzoq vaqt davom etdi, hali ham uni qattiq kuzatib turardi, ehtimol boshqa birov unga ta'tillarini o'rgatganidek, ish kunlarini ham bilishni o'rgatishi kerak edi.

en: Things standing thus, it chanced that, the heat being great and Messer Ric- ciardo having a mind to go a-pleasuring to a very fair country-seat he had, near Monte Nero, and there abide some days to take the air, he betook him- self thither, carrying with him his fair lady.
uz: Shunday holatda, shunday bo'ldiki, issiqlik juda kuchli bo'lgani va janob Rits-siardo Monte Neronga yaqin joylashgan juda chiroyli qishloq o'rindig'iga borishni o'ylab, u yerda bir necha kun dam olib, o'zini u yerga olib bordi va o'zi bilan go'zal xotini olib bordi.

en: There sojourning, to give her some diversion, he caused one day ﬁsh and they went out to sea in two boats, he in one with the ﬁshermen, and she in another with other ladies.
uz: U yerda qolayotganda, unga biroz chalg'itish uchun, bir kuni baliq tutdi va ular ikki qayiqda dengizga chiqishdi, u birida baliqchilar bilan, u esa boshqa birida boshqa ayollar bilan.

en: The sport luring them on, they drifted some miles out to sea, well nigh without perceiving it, and whilst they were intent upon their diversion, there came up of a sudden a galliot belonging to Paganino da Mare, a famous cor- sair of those days.
uz: Ularni o'yin o'ziga rom etayotgan edi, ular dengizga bir necha mil uzoqlikda suzib ketishdi, buni sezmasdan, va ular o'zlarini chalg'itishga qaror qilishayotgan bir paytda, to'satdan Paganino da Marega tegishli bo'lgan bir galliot paydo bo'ldi, o'sha kunlarning mashhur qo'ng'irog'i.

en: The latter, espying the boats, made for them, nor could they ﬂee so fast but he overtook that in which were the women and seeing therein the judge’s fair lady, he carried her aboard the galliot, in full sight of
uz: Oxirgisi, qayiqlarni kuzatib, ular uchun yasadi, va ular bunchalik tez qochib ketolmadilar, lekin u ayollar bor joyni bosib o'tdi va u yerda hakamning go'zal xotini ko'rib, uni to'liq ko'z o'ngida galliyoga olib chiqdi.

en: Messer Ricciardo, who was now come to land, and made off without reck- ing of aught else.
uz: Messer Ricciardo, endi qirg'oqqa kelgan edi, boshqa hech narsa hisoblamasdan jo'nab ketdi.

en: When my lord judge, who was so jealous that he mis- doubted of the very air, saw this, it booteth not to ask if he was chagrined; and in vain, both at Pisa and otherwhere, did he complain of the villainy of the corsairs, for that he knew not who had taken his wife from him nor whither he had carried her.
uz: Shunday rashk qilganki, aynan havodan shubhalanayotgan hukmdorim buni ko'rib, xafa bo'lganmi, deb so'rashga jur'at eta olmaydi; va bekorga, Pisa va boshqa joylarda ham, u qayiqchilarning yovuzligidan shikoyat qilardi, chunki u o'zidan xotinini kim olganini ham, qayerga olib ketganini ham bilmas edi.

en: As for Paganino, ﬁnding her so fair, he deemed himself in luck and having no wife, resolved to keep her for himself.
uz: Paganinoga kelsak, uni shunchalik go'zal deb topgach, u o'zini omadli va xotini yo'q deb hisobladi, uni o'zi uchun saqlab qolishga qaror qildi.

en: Ac- cordingly, seeing her weeping sore, he studied to comfort her with soft words till nightfall, when, his calendar having dropped from his girdle and saints’ days and holidays gone clean out of his head, he fell to comforting her with deeds, himseeming that words had availed little by day; and after such a fashion did he console her that, ere they came to Monaco, the judge and his ordinances had altogether escaped her mind and she began to lead the merriest of lives with Paganino.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, uning yig'layotganini ko'rib, u uni yumshoq so'zlar bilan yupatish uchun tun bo'lguncha o'rgandi. Qachonki, uning taqvimi kamaridan tushib, avliyolarining kunlari va bayramlari boshidan tozalanib ketgach, u uni amallar bilan yupatishga tushdi, go'yo so'zlar kun sayin kam foyda berardi; va shunday uslubda uni yupatdiki, ular Monakoga kelishidan oldin, sudya va uning hukmlari butunlay uning xotirasidan chiqib ketgan edi va u Paganino bilan eng quvonchli hayot kechira boshladi.

en: The latter carried her to Monaco and there, over and above the consolations with which he plied her night and day, he entreated her honourably as his wife.
uz: Oxirgisi uni Monakoga olib bordi va u yerda, uni tunu kun ta'ziyalashdan tashqari, xotin sifatida hurmat bilan yolvordi.

en: After awhile it came to Messer Ricciardo’s ears where his wife was and he, being possessed with the most ardent desire to have her again and bethinking himself that none other might thoroughly sufﬁce to do what was needful to that end, resolved to go thither himself, determined to spend any quantity of money for her ransom.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, Messer Ricciardo'ning qulog'iga xotini qayerda ekanligi tushdi va u, uni yana ko'rishni eng qattiq istagan holda va o'zini boshqa hech kim bu maqsadda zarur bo'lgan ishni qilishga yetarli emas deb o'ylab, u yerga o'zi borishga qaror qildi, uning to'lovi uchun har qanday miqdorda pul sarflashga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly he set out by sea and coming to Monaco, there both saw and was seen of the lady, who told it to Paganino that same evening and ac- quainted him with her intent.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u dengiz bo'ylab yo'lga chiqib, Monakoga keldi, u yerda xonimni ham ko'rdi, ham ko'rindi, u o'sha oqshom Paganinoga aytdi va uni o'z niyati bilan o'ziga xos qildi.

en: Next morning Messer Ricciardo, seeing Pa- ganino, accosted him and quickly clapped up a great familiarity and friend- ship with him, whilst the other feigned not to know him and waited to see at what he aimed.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab janob Ricciardo Pa-ganinoni ko'rib, unga yaqinlashdi va tezda u bilan katta tanishuv va do'stona aloqa o'rnatdi, boshqalari esa uni tanimayotgandek ko'rindi va nimaga qaratilganini ko'rishni kutdi.

en: Accordingly, whenas it seemed to him time, Messer Ric- ciardo discovered to him, as best and most civilly he knew, the occasion of his coming and prayed him take what he pleased and restore him the lady.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, unga vaqt kelgandek tuyulganda, Messer Ric-ciardo uning kelishi sababini, eng yaxshi va eng madaniy tarzda bilganidek, aniqladi va undan xohlaganini olib, xonimni qaytarishini so'radi.

en: To which Paganino made answer with a cheerful countenance, ‘Sir, you are welcome, and to answer you brieﬂy, I say thus; it is true I have a young lady in my house, if she be your wife or another’s I know not, for that I know you not nor indeed her, save in so much as she hath abidden awhile with me.
uz: Bunga Paganino quvnoq yuz bilan javob berdi: Janob, siz xush kelibsiz, va sizga qisqacha javob berish uchun shunday deyman; rostmi, uyimda yosh xonim bor, u sizning xotiningiz yoki boshqa birov bo'lsa ham  bilmayman, chunki men sizni ham, uni ham bilmayman, faqat u bir muncha vaqt men bilan yashiringanidan tashqari.

en: If you be, as you say, her husband, I will, since you seem to me a civil gentleman, carry you to her and I am assured that she will know you right well.
uz: Agar sen, aytganingdek, uning eri bo'lsang, men seni unga olib boraman, chunki sen menga odobli janobga o'xshaysan va men ishonamanki, u seni yaxshi taniydi.

en: If she say it is as you avouch and be willing to go with you, you shall, for the sake of your civility, give me what you yourself will to her ransom; but, an it be not so, you would do ill to seek to take her from me, for that I
uz: Agar u siz bilan birga borishga rozi bo'lganingizdek bo'lsa, siz o'z odobingiz tufayli uning to'lovi uchun o'zingiz xohlagan narsani menga berasiz; lekin, agar unday bo'lmasa, siz mendan uni olib qo'yishga harakat qilishingiz yomon bo'lardi, chunki

en: am a young man and can entertain a woman as well as another, and espe- cially such an one as she, who is the most pleasing I ever saw.’ Quoth Mess- er Ricciardo, ‘For certain she is my wife, an thou bring me where she is, thou shalt soon see it; for she will incontinent throw herself on my neck; wherefore I ask no better than that it be as thou proposest.’ ‘Then,’ said Pa- ganino, ‘let us be going.’ Accordingly they betook themselves to the cor- sair’s house, where he brought the judge into a saloon of his and let call the lady, who issued forth of a chamber, all dressed and tired, and came where- as they were, but accosted Messer Ricciardo no otherwise than as she would any other stranger who might have come home with Paganino.
uz: Men yosh yigitman va bir ayolni boshqa birov kabi xursand qila olaman, ayniqsa unga o'xshagan, men ko'rgan eng yoqimli odam." Quoth Mess-er Ricciardo, "Albatta, u mening xotinim, va meni u bor joyga olib kel, tez orada ko'rasan; chunki u o'zini mening bo'ynimga tashlaydi; shuning uchun men sen aytganingdek bo'lishini so'ramayman." "Unda," dedi Pa- Ganino, "ketamiz." Shunga ko'ra ular o'zlarini kor- beto's uyiga tashlashdi, u yerda sudyani o'z salooniga olib kirdilar va xonadan chiqqan xonimni, butunlay charchagan holda, qayerga kelgan bo'lsa, ular kabi, lekin Masser Ricciardo hech qanday begona odam kabi kelmas edi.

en: The judge, who looked to have been received by her with the utmost joy, marvelled sore at this and fell a-saying in himself, ‘Belike the chagrin and long grief I have suffered, since I lost her, have so changed me that she knoweth me not.’ Wherefore he said to her, ‘Wife, it hath cost me dear to carry thee a- ﬁshing, for that never was grief felt like that which I have suffered since I lost thee, and now meseemeth thou knowest me not, so distantly dost thou greet me.
uz: Sudya, uni quvonch bilan kutib olgan ko'rindi, bunga hayron bo'lib, o'ziga dedi: "Uni yo'qotganimdan beri chekkan qayg'u va uzoq qayg'u meni shunchalik o'zgartirdi, meni tanimaydi". Shuning uchun u unga dedi: "Xotin, seni olib yurish menga qimmatga tushdi, chunki bu qayg'u seni yo'qotganimdan beri boshimdan kechirganidek tuyulmadi, endi esa meni tanimaysan, shuning uchun meni uzoqdan kutib olyapsan".

en: Seest thou not that I am thine own Messer Ricciardo, come hither to pay that which this gentleman, in whose house we are, shall require to thy ransom and to carry thee away?
uz: Ko'rmayapsanmi, men sening o'z Messer Ricciardoningman, bu yerga kelib, shu janob, biz uning uyida bo'lganimiz uchun, seni to'lash va olib ketish uchun talab qiladigan narsani to'laymanmi?

en: And he, of his favour, restoreth thee to me for what I will.’ The lady turned to him and said, smiling somewhat, ‘Speak you to me, sir?
uz: Va u, o'z marhamatiga ko'ra, seni men xohlagan narsa uchun menga qaytaradi. Xonim unga o'girilib, biroz jilmaydi va dedi: Menga gapiring, janob?

en: Look you mistake me not, for, for my part, I mind me not ever to have seen you.’ Quoth Ricciardo, ‘Look what thou sayest; consider me well; an thou wilt but recollect thyself, thou wilt see that I am thine own Ricciardo di Chinzica.’ ‘Sir,’ answered the lady, ‘you will pardon me; belike it is not so seemly a thing as you imagine for me to look much on you.
uz: "Qarang, meni adashtirmang, chunki men sizni hech qachon ko'rmaganimdan xafa bo'laman." Qo'shimcha Ricciardo, "Siz nima deyayotganingizga qarang; meni yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring; va o'zingizni eslaysiz, shunda men sizning Ricciardo di Chinzica'ingiz ekanligimni ko'rasiz." "Janob," javob berdi xonim, "meni kechirasiz; chunki siz tasavvur qilganingizdek, men sizga ko'p qarashim unchalik ko'rinmas narsa."

en: Nevertheless I have seen enough of you to know that I never before set eyes on you.’ Ricciardo, concluding that she did this for fear of Paganino and chose not to confess to knowing him in the latter’s presence, besought him of his favour that he might speak with her in a room alone.
uz: Shunga qaramay, men sizdan oldin hech qachon ko'z tashlamaganimni bilish uchun yetarli darajada ko'rdim." Ricciardo, buni Paganinodan qo'rqib qilganini va uni ikkinchisining huzurida tan olmaslikni tan olganini xulosa qilib, u bilan yolg'iz xonada gaplashishini so'radi.

en: Paganino replied that he would well, so but he would not kiss her against her will, and bade the lady go with him into a chamber and there hear what he had to say and answer him as it should please her.
uz: Paganino unga yaxshi deb javob berdi, lekin u uni uning irodasiga qarshi o'pmasdi va xonimni u bilan birga xonaga kirishni buyurdi, u yerda uning nima deyishini eshitib, unga yoqishi kerak bo'lgan javob berishni so'radi.

en: Accordingly the lady and Messer Ricciardo went into a room apart and as soon as they were seated, the latter began to say, ‘Alack, heart of my body, sweet my soul and my hope, know- est thou not thy Ricciardo, who loveth thee more than himself?
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xonim va janob Ricciardo alohida xonaga kirishdi va ular o'tirishi bilanoq, ikkinchisi aytdi: "Alak, tanamning yuragi, jonim va umidimning shirinligi, sen Ricciardo, seni o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevishini bilmaysanmi?"

en: Prithee, fair mine eye, do but look on me a little.’ The lady began to laugh and without letting him say more, replied, ‘You
uz: "Prithi, go'zal ko'zim, menga biroz qaragin." Xonim kulishni boshladi va unga boshqa gapirishga ruxsat bermasdan, javob berdi: "Sen..."

en: may be assured that I am not so scatterbrained but that I know well enough you are Messer Ricciardo di Chinzica, my husband; but, what time I was with you, you showed that you knew me very ill, for that you should have had the sense to see that I was young and lusty and gamesome and should consequently have known that which behoveth unto young ladies, over and above clothes and meat, albeit for shamefastness they name it not; the which how you performed, you know.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, men unchalik tarqoq emasman, lekin sizni erim, Messer Ricciardo di Chinzica ekanligingizni yetarli darajada yaxshi bilaman; lekin, men siz bilan bo'lgan vaqtimda, meni juda yomon bilganingizni ko'rsatdingiz, chunki siz yosh va shahvoniy va o'yinchoq ekanligimni ko'rishingiz kerak edi va shuning uchun yosh ayollarga kerak bo'lgan narsalarni bilishingiz kerak edi, kiyim va go'shtdan tashqari, garchi uyat uchun buni aytishmasa ham; buni qanday bajarganingizni bilasiz.

en: If the study of the laws was more agreeable to you than your wife, you should not have taken her, albeit it never appeared to me that you were a judge; nay, you seemed to me rather a common crier of saints’ days and sacraments and fasts and vigils, so well you knew them.
uz: Agar qonunlarni o'rganish sizga xotiningizdan ko'ra ko'proq yoqqan bo'lsa, uni qabul qilmasligingiz kerak edi, garchi menga siz hakam ekanligingiz hech qachon ko'rinmagan bo'lsa ham; aksincha, siz menga avliyolarning kunlari va sakramentlari, ro'zalari va uyg'oqliklarining oddiy faryodiga o'xshardingiz, shuning uchun ularni yaxshi bilardingiz.

en: And I tell you this, that, had you suffered the husbandmen who till your lands keep as many holidays as you allowed him who had the tilling of my poor little ﬁeld, you would never have reaped the least grain of corn.
uz: Va men senga aytamanki, agar sen yerlaringni yig'adigan dehqonlarga mening bechora maydonim dehqonligiga ruxsat berganingdek ko'p bayram o'tkazishga ruxsat berganingda, hech qachon eng kichik makkajo'xori donini yig'magan bo'larding.

en: However, as God, having compassion on my youth, hath willed it, I have happened on yonder man, with whom I abide in this chamber, wherein it is unknown what manner of thing is a holiday (I speak of those holidays which you, more assiduous in the service of God than in that of the ladies, did so diligently celebrate) nor ever yet entered in at this door Saturday nor Friday nor vigil nor Emberday nor Lent, that is so long; nay, here swink we day and night and thump our wool; and this very night after matinsong, I know right well how the thing went, once he was up.
uz: Ammo, Xudo yoshligimga rahm qilganidek, men ham shunday bo'ldim, men shu xonada yashayotgan bir odam bilan birga yashayman, u yerda bayram qanday bo'lishi noma'lum (men siz, xonimlarnikidan ko'ra Xudoga xizmat qilishda g'ayrat bilan nishonlaydigan bayramlar haqida gapiryapman), hech qachon bu eshikdan shanba, juma, uyg'onish, Emberday yoki Ro'za kunlari kirmagan, bu juda uzun; yo'q, bu yerda biz kunduzi va kechasi g'azablanib, junimizni to'kamiz; va aynan shu kechadan keyin, u uyg'onganidan keyin, narsa qanday o'tganini yaxshi bilaman.

en: Wherefore I mean to abide with him and work; whilst I am young, and leave saints’ days and ju- bilees and fasts for my keeping when I am old; so get you gone about your business as quickliest you may, good luck go with you, and keep as many holidays as you please, without me.’ Messer Ricciardo, hearing these words, was distressed beyond endurance and said, whenas he saw she had made an end of speaking.
uz: Shuning uchun men u bilan birga qolmoqchiman va ishlayman; men yosh bo'lsam, avliyolarning kunlari va ju-bileylari va ro'zalarini qariganimda saqlash uchun qoldirmoqchiman; shuning uchun ishingizda imkon qadar tezroq keting, omad sizga hamroh bo'lsin va mensiz xohlagancha ta'tillar o'tkazing." Messer Ricciardo bu so'zlarni eshitib, chidab bo'lmas darajada xafa bo'ldi va dedi, u gapini tugatganini ko'rgach.

en: ‘Alack, sweet my soul, what is this thou sayest?
uz: Alack, jonim, bu nima deyapsan?

en: Hast thou no regard for thy kinsfolk’s honour and thine own?
uz: Qarindoshlaringning va o'zingning sharafiga ahamiyat bermaysanmi?

en: Wilt thou rather abide here for this man’s whore and in mortal sin than at Pisa as my wife?
uz: Bu odamning fohishasi va o'lim gunohida Pisa shahrida mening xotinim bo'lishdan ko'ra, shu yerda qolishni afzal ko'rasizmi?

en: He, when he is weary of thee, will turn thee away to thine own exceeding re- proach, whilst I will still hold thee dear and still (e’en though I willed it not) thou shalt be mistress of my house.
uz: U sizdan charchaganida, sizni o'zining haddan tashqari xatti-harakatlariga qaytaradi, men esa sizni hali ham qadrlayman va hali ham (garchi xohlamasam ham) uyimning bekasi bo'lasiz.

en: Wilt thou for the sake of a lewd and dis- orderly appetite, forsake thine honour and me, who love thee more than my life?
uz: Zinokor va tartibsiz ishtaha tufayli sen o'z sharafingni va meni, seni jonimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevganimni tashlab ketmoqchimisan?

en: For God’s sake, dear my hope, speak no more thus, but consent to come with me; henceforth, since I know thy desire, I will enforce myself [to content it]; wherefore, sweet my treasure, change counsel and come away with me, who have never known weal since thou wast taken from me.’
uz: Xudo haqqi, aziz umidim, endi bunday gapirma, balki men bilan kelishga rozi bo'l; bundan buyon, sening xohishingni bilganim uchun, o'zimni majburlayman; shuning uchun, xazinamga shirinlik ber, maslahat o'zgartirib, men bilan birga ket, sen mendan olib ketilgandan beri hech qachon boylik bilmaganlar.

en: Whereto answered the lady, ‘I have no mind that any, now that it availeth not, should be more tender of my honour than I myself; would my kinsfolk had had regard thereto, whenas they gave me to you!
uz: Xonim javob berdi: Men hech kimning, endi foydasi bo'lmagani uchun, o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq hurmatga sazovor bo'lishi kerakligini xohlamayman; qarindoshlarim menga berganlarida, bunga e'tibor berishardi!

en: But, as they had then no care for my honour, I am under no present concern to be careful of theirs; and if I am herein mortar143 sin, I shall abide though it be in pestle144 sin.
uz: Lekin, ular o'shanda mening obro'yim haqida qayg'urmaganlari sababli, men ularning oldida ehtiyot bo'lish uchun hozirgi tashvishda emasman; va agar men bu yerda "g'ishtli143 gunoh"da bo'lsam, u "g'ishtli144 gunoh"da bo'lsa ham, men yashayman.

en: And let me tell you that here meseemeth I am Paganino’s wife, whereas at Pisa meseemed I was your whore, seeing that there, by season of the moon and quadratures of geometry, needs must be planets concur to couple betwixt you and me, whereas here Paganino holdeth me all night in his arms and straineth me and biteth me, and how he serveth me, let God tell you for me.
uz: Va sizga aytamanki, bu yerda men Paganinning xotini ekanman, Pisa shahrida esa men sizning fohisha ekanligimni ko'rdim, chunki u yerda oy va geometriya kvadratlari mavsumiga ko'ra, siz va men o'rtamizda planetalar bir-biriga mos kelishi kerak, bu yerda Paganino meni butun tun davomida qo'lida ushlab turadi, zo'riqtiradi va tishlaydi, va u menga qanday xizmat qiladi, Xudo sizga aytsin.

en: You say forsooth you will enforce yourself; to what?
uz: Siz oldindan o'zingizni majburlashingizni aytasiz; nimaga?

en: To do it in three casts and cause it stand by dint of cudgelling?
uz: Buni uchta kastda qilish va uni cudgellingning yonida turishiga sabab bo'lishmi?

en: I warrant me you are grown a doughty cavalier since I saw you last!
uz: Sizni oxirgi marta ko'rganimdan beri yaxshi chavandoz bo'lib ulg'ayganingizga kafolat beraman!

en: Begone and enforce yourself to live, for methinketh indeed you do but sojourn here below upon sufferance, so peaked and scant o’ wind you show to me.
uz: Boshla va o'zingni yashashga majburla, chunki menimcha, sen bu yerda azob chekib, shunchalik cho'qqi va kam shamol ko'rsatasan menga.

en: And yet more I tell you, that, should he leave me (albeit meseemeth he is nowise inclined thereto, so I choose to stay), I purpose not therefor ever to return to you, of whom squeeze you as I might, there were no making a porringer of sauce; for that I abode with you once to my grievous hurt and loss, wherefore in such a case I should seek my vantage elsewhere.
uz: Va yana sizlarga aytamanki, agar u meni tark etsa (shuningdek, u hozir shunga moyil bo'lsa ham, shuning uchun men qolishni tanlayman), men hech qachon siz tomon qaytishni maqsad qilmayman. Sizni qanchalik siqsam, hech qanday sho'r-so'r qilmagan bo'lardim; chunki men siz bilan bir marta og'riqli jarohat va yo'qotish uchun birga bo'lganman, shuning uchun bunday holatda o'z afzalligimni boshqa joydan izlardim.

en: Nay, once again I tell you, here be neither saints’ days nor vigils; wherefore here I mean to abide; so get you gone in God’s name as quickliest you may, or I will cry out that you would fain force me.’ Messer Ricciardo, seeing himself in ill case and now recognizing his folly in taking a young wife, whenas he was himself for- spent, went forth the chamber tristful and woebegone, and bespoke Pa- ganino with many words, that skilled not a jot.
uz: Yo'q, yana bir bor aytaman, bu yerda na avliyolar kunlari, na uyg'oqlik kunlari bo'lmasin; shuning uchun bu yerda qolmoqchiman; shuning uchun sizni Xudoning nomi bilan imkon qadar tezroq yo'qoting, aks holda meni majburlashingizni faryod qilaman." Messer Ricciardo o'zini yomon ahvolda ko'rib, endi yosh xotin olishdagi ahmoqligini anglab yetdi, o'zi sarflagan paytida qayg'uli va qayg'uli xonadan chiqib, Pa-ganinoni ko'p so'zlar bilan so'radi, u hech narsaga usta emas edi.

en: Ultimately, leaving the lady, he returned to Pisa, without having accomplished aught, and there for chag- rin fell into such dotage that, as he went about Pisa, to whoso greeted him or asked him of anywhat, he answered nought but ‘The ill hole145 will have no holidays;’146 and there, no great while after, he died.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, xonimni tark etib, u hech narsa qilmasdan Pisaga qaytib keldi va u yerda shunday ahvolga tushdiki, u Pisa atrofida sayr qilar ekan, uni kutib olgan yoki undan biror narsa so'ragan har bir kishiga hech narsa demadi, faqat: "Yomon teshik 145 ta ta'tilga ega bo'lmaydi;" 146 va u yerda, ancha vaqt o'tgach, u vafot etdi.

en: Paganino, hearing this and knowing the love the lady bore himself, espoused her to his lawful wife and thereafter, without ever observing saints’ day or vigil or keeping Lent, they wrought what while their legs would carry them and led a jolly life of it.
uz: Paganino buni eshitib, xonimning o'ziga bo'lgan muhabbatini bilgach, uni o'zining qonuniy xotiniga turmushga chiqardi va shundan so'ng, hech qachon avliyolarning kunini, uyg'onishni yoki Ro'za tutishni kuzatmasdan, oyoqlari ularni ko'tarib yurgan holda shunday ishlar qildilar va undan quvnoq hayot kechirdilar.

en: Wherefore, dear my ladies, meseemeth Bernabo, in his dispute with Ambrogiuolo, rode the she-goat down the steep.”147
uz: Shuning uchun, aziz xonimlarim, Bernabo, Ambrogiuolo bilan bahsda, tik yo'ldan echkiga minib tushdi.147

en: This story gave such occasion for laughter to all the company that there was none whose jaws ached not therefor, and all the ladies avouched with one accord that Dioneo spoke sooth and that Bernabo had been an ass.
uz: Bu hikoya butun jamoaga shunday kulgi bag'ishladiki, hech kimning jag'i og'rimasdi, va barcha xonimlar Dioneo xotirjam gapirgani va Bernabo eshak ekanligi haqida bir ovozdan gapirishdi.

en: But, after the story was ended and the laughter abated, the queen, observing that the hour was now late and that all had told and seeing that the end of her sei- gnory was come, according to the ordinance commenced, took the wreath from her own head and set it on that of Neiﬁle, saying, with a blithe aspect, “Henceforth, companion dear, be thine the governance of this little people”; and reseated herself.
uz: Ammo, hikoya tugagach va kulgi susaygach, malika soat kech bo'lganini va hamma aytgani va uning sei-gnori oxirini boshlaganini ko'rganidan so'ng, tartibga ko'ra, gulchambarni o'z boshidan olib, Neifile'ning boshiga qo'ydi va go'zal ko'rinish bilan dedi: "Bundan buyon, aziz hamroh, bu kichkina xalqning hukmronligi seniki bo'lsin"; va o'zini qayta tikladi.

en: Neiﬁle blushed a little at the honour received and be- came in countenance like as showeth a new-blown rose of April or of May in the breaking of the day, with lovesome eyes some little downcast, spark- ling no otherwise than the morning-star.
uz: Neifile olgan sharafdan biroz qizarib ketdi va ko'rinishi aprel yoki mayning yangi gulini kunduzning boshida ko'rsatgandek, yoqimli ko'zlari bilan biroz tushkunlikka tushgan, tong yulduzidan boshqa hech qanday uchqun yo'q edi.

en: But, after the courteous murmur of the bystanders, whereby they gladsomely approved their goodwill towards the new-made queen, had abated and she had taken heart again, she seated herself somewhat higher than of wont and said, “Since I am to be your queen, I will, departing not from the manner holden of those who have fore- gone me and whose governance you have by your obedience commended, make manifest to you in few words my opinion, which, an it be approved by your counsel, we will ensue.
uz: Ammo, tomoshabinlarning xushmuomala shiviridan so'ng, ular yangi qirolichaga nisbatan yaxshi niyatlarini mamnuniyat bilan tasdiqlab, u yana ruhlandi, u odatdagidan biroz balandroq o'tirdi va dedi: "Men sizning qirolichangiz bo'lishim kerak bo'lganligi sababli, men, meni tark etganlarning uslubidan chetga chiqmay va sizning itoatkorligingiz bilan o'z hukmronligingizga ishonib, sizga qisqa so'zlar bilan mening fikrimni bayon etaman, agar u sizning maslahatingiz bilan ma'qullansa, biz..."

en: Tomorrow, as you know, is Friday and the next day is Saturday, days which, by reason of the viands that are used therein,148 are somewhat irksome to most folk, more by token that Friday, considering that He who died for our life on that day suffered passion, is worthy of reverence; wherefore I hold it a just thing and a seemly that, in honour of the Divinity, we apply ourselves rather to orisons than to story- telling.
uz: Ertaga, bilasizki, juma, ertasi shanba, unda ishlatiladigan go'shtlar tufayli ko'pchilik uchun biroz bezovta qiladigan 148 kunlar, ko'proq juma kuni, o'sha kuni hayotimiz uchun azob chekkan Zot hurmatga loyiq ekanligini hisobga olgan holda; shuning uchun men buni adolatli narsa deb hisoblayman va go'yo, Ilohiyot sharafiga ko'ra, biz o'zimizni hikoya qilishdan ko'ra, yoki bularga qo'llashimiz kerak.

en: As for Saturday, it is the usance of ladies on that day to wash their heads and do away all dust and all uncleanliness befallen them for the la- bours of the past week; and many, likewise, use, in reverence of the Virgin Mother of the Son of God, to fast and rest from all manner of work in hon- our of the ensuing Sunday.
uz: Shanba kuniga kelsak, o'sha kuni ayollarning odatlari bo'lib, ular o'tgan haftaning la-bo'rilari uchun boshlarini yuvish va barcha chang va nopokliklarni yo'q qilishadi; va ko'pchilik, shuningdek, Xudoning O'g'lining Bokira Onasiga hurmat bilan, keyingi yakshanba kunidagi barcha mehnatlardan ro'za tutish va dam olishadi.

en: Wherefore, we being unable fully to ensue the order of living taken by us, on like wise methinketh we were well to rest from story-telling on that day also; after which, for that we shall then have sojourned here four days, I hold it opportune, an we would give no occasion for newcomers to intrude upon us, that we remove hence and get us gone elsewhither; where I have already considered and provided.
uz: Shuning uchun, biz o'zimiz qabul qilgan hayot tartibini to'liq ta'minlay olmaganimiz sababli, o'sha kuni ham hikoya qilishdan dam olishimiz yaxshi bo'ldi deb o'ylaymiz; shundan so'ng, biz bu yerda to'rt kun bo'lishimiz kerak edi, men buni qulay deb hisoblayman, yangi kelganlarga bizga bostirib kirishlariga hech qanday imkoniyat bermas edik, biz bu yerdan chiqib ketib, boshqa tomonga ketamiz; men allaqachon o'ylab ko'rgangan va ta'minlagan joyda.

en: There when we shall be assembled together on Sunday, after sleeping —we having today had leisure enough for discoursing at large,149 —I have bethought myself — at once that you may have more time to consider and because it will be yet
uz: U yerda yakshanba kuni birga yig'ilganimizda, uxlaganimizdan keyin  bugun keng suhbatlashish uchun yetarli dam olganimiz sababli, 149 Men o'zimga o'yladim  darhol sizda ko'proq vaqt bo'lishi mumkinligini va chunki u hali...

en: goodlier that the license of our story-telling be somewhat straitened and that we devise of one of the many fashions of fortune —that our discourse shall be OF SUCH AS HAVE, BY DINT OF DILIGENCE,150 ACQUIRED SOME MUCH DESIRED THING OR RECOVERED SOME LOST GOOD.
uz: Yaxshisi, hikoyamiz litsenziyasi biroz toraytirilgan bo'lsa va biz omadning ko'plab shakllaridan birini o'ylab topamiz  bizning nutqimiz shunday bo'lishi kerakki, DILIGENCE DENT orqali, 150 KATTA ISHTIRGAN NARSAGA OLILGAN YOKI YO'QOLGAN YAXSHI YARATGAN.

en: Whereupon let each think to tell some- what that may be useful or at least entertaining to the company, saving al- ways Dioneo his privilege.” All commended the speech and disposition of the queen and ordained that it should be as she had said.
uz: Shunday ekan, har bir kishi o'ylab ko'rsin-ki, kompaniyaga foydali yoki hech bo'lmaganda ko'ngil ochadigan narsa nima bo'lsa, Dioneo o'z imtiyozini saqlab qolsin." Hammasi malika nutqini va xulq-atvorini maqtadi va u aytganidek bo'lishini buyurdi.

en: Then, calling for her seneschal, she particularly instructed him where he should set the tables that evening and after of what he should do during all the time of her sei- gnory; and this done, rising to her feet, she gave the company leave to do that which was most pleasing unto each.
uz: Keyin, o'zining oqsoqolini chaqirib, u unga o'sha kechqurun stollarni qayerga qo'yishi kerakligi va undan keyin uning butun hayoti davomida nima qilishi kerakligi haqida alohida ko'rsatmalar berdi; va shundan so'ng, o'rnidan turib, u har bir kishiga eng yoqqan ishni qilishga ruxsat berdi.

en: Accordingly, ladies and men betook themselves to a little garden and there, after they had disported themselves awhile, the hour of supper being come, they supped with mirth and pleasance; then, all arising thence and Emilia, by the queen’s com- mandment, leading the round, the ditty following was sung by Pampinea, whilst the other ladies responded: What lady aye should sing, and if not I,  Who’m blest with all for which a maid can sigh?
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xonimlar va erkaklar o'zlarini kichik bog'ga olib borishdi va u yerda, biroz o'zlarini bezovta qilgandan so'ng, kechki ovqat vaqti kelgach, xursandchilik va rohat bilan ovqatlanishdi; keyin, hamma o'rnidan turib, Emiliya, malika buyrug'i bilan, aylanani boshqarayotganda, keyingi qo'shiq Pampinea tomonidan kuylandi, qolgan xonimlar esa javob berishdi: "Aye xonim qanday qo'shiq aytishi kerak, agar men bo'lmasa, xizmatkor yig'lashi mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsa bilan kim la'natlangan?"

en: Come then, O Love, thou source of all my weal,  All hope and every issue glad and bright  Sing ye awhile yfere  Of sighs nor bitter pains I erst did feel,  That now but sweeten to me thy delight,  Nay, but of that ﬁre clear,  Wherein I, burning, live in joy and cheer,  And as my God, thy name do magnify.
uz: Shunday qilib, ey Sevgi, barcha boyligim manbai, Barcha umid va har bir masala xursand va yorqin bo'lsin. Avval his qilgan oh-u achchiq og'riqlarimdan bir oz xursand bo'lib kuyla. Endi menga sening zavqing shirin bo'lsin, Yo'q, balki o'sha olov tiniq bo'lsin, Unda men yonib, quvonch va xursandchilik bilan yashayman, Va Xudoyim kabi, sening isming ulug'lansin.

en: Thou settest, Love, before these eyes of mine  Whenas thy ﬁre I entered the ﬁrst day,  A youngling so beseen  With valour, worth and loveliness divine,  That never might one ﬁnd a goodlier, nay,  Nor yet his match, I ween.
uz: Sen, Sevgi, mening ko'zlarim oldida o'tirasan, O'tingga birinchi kun kirganimda, Qudrat, qadr-qimmat va ilohiy go'zallik bilan shunchalik zaif bo'lgan yoshki, Hech kim undan yaxshiroq topa olmaydi, yo'q, Na uning tengi, men ko'rardim.

en: So sore I burnt for him I still must e’en  Sing, blithe, of him with thee, my lord most high.
uz: U uchun shunchalik kuygan edimki, hali ham uni sen bilan birga kuylashim kerak, ey oliy hazratim.

en: And that in him which crowneth my liesse  Is that I please him, as he pleaseth me,
uz: Va kimda mening mehrimni tojlaydi, men unga yoqsam, xuddi u menga yoqqanidek,

en: Thanks to Love debonair;  Thus in this world my wish I do possess  And in the next I trust at peace to be,  Through that fast faith I bear  To him; sure God, who seeth this, will ne’er  The kingdom of His bliss to us deny.
uz: Sevgi tufayli debonair; Shunday qilib, bu dunyoda mening xohishimga ega bo'laman Va keyingisida tinchlikka ishonaman, O'sha mustahkam imon orqali Unga bardosh beraman; buni ko'rgan Xudo, albatta, Uning baxtli Shohligini bizga inkor etmaydi.

en: After this they sang sundry other songs and danced sundry dances and played upon divers instruments of music.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular turli xil qo'shiqlarni kuylashdi, turli xil raqslarni raqsga tushishdi va turli xil musiqa asboblarida chalishdi.

en: Then, the queen deeming it time to go to rest, each betook himself, with torches before him, to his chamber, and all on the two following days, whilst applying themselves to those things whereof the queen had spoken, looked longingly for Sunday.
uz: Keyin, malika dam olishga ketish vaqti keldi deb hisoblab, har biri oldidagi mash'alalar bilan o'zini xonasiga olib keldi va keyingi ikki kunda, malika aytgan narsalarga e'tibor qaratgan holda, yakshanbaga intiqlik bilan qaradi.

en: Here endeth the Second Day of the Decameron.
