uz: Mana Dekameronning Ikkinchi Kuni tugaydi.

en: DAY THE THIRD INTRODUCTION Here beginneth the third day of the Decameron wherein under the governance of Neiﬁle is discoursed of such as have by dint of diligence acquired some much desired thing or recovered some lost good.
uz: UCHINCHI KUN Kirish Mana Decameronning uchinchi kuni boshlanadi, unda Neifile hukmronligi ostida harakat bilan juda ko'p kerakli narsani olgan yoki yo'qolgan mol-mulkni qaytarib olganlar haqida gapiriladi.

en: The dawn from vermeil began to grow orange-tawny, at the approach of the sun, when on the Sunday the queen arose and caused all her company rise also.
uz: Veruildan ertalab quyosh yaqinlashganda to'q sariq-qora rangda o'sishni boshladi, yakshanba kuni malika turib, butun kompaniyasini ham ko'tardi.

en: The seneschal had a great while before despatched to the place whither they were to go store of things needful and folk who should there make ready that which behoved, and seeing the queen now on the way, straight- way let load everything else, as if the camp were raised thence, and with the household stuff and such of the servants as remained set out in rear of the ladies and gentlemen.
uz: Senesxal ancha vaqt o'tgach, ular kerakli narsalarni va u yerda kerak bo'lgan narsalarni tayyorlaydigan odamlarni saqlash uchun boradigan joyga jo'nab ketdilar. Qirolichaning endi yo'lda ekanligini ko'rib, xuddi lager o'sha yerdan ko'tarilgandek, uy-ro'zg'or buyumlari va qolgan xizmatkorlarning xonimlar va janoblarning orqa tomonida yo'lga qo'yilganidek, boshqa hamma narsani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yukladilar.

en: The queen, then, with slow step, accompanied and followed by her ladies and the three young men and guided by the song of some score nightingales and other birds, took her way westward, by a little- used footpath, full of green herbs and ﬂowers, which latter now all began to open for the coming sun, and chatting, jesting and laughing with her com- pany, brought them a while before half tierce,151 without having gone over two thousand paces, to a very fair and rich palace, somewhat upraised above the plain upon a little knoll.
uz: Shundan so'ng, malika sekin qadam tashlab, uning xonimlari va uchta yigitlari hamrohligida va ularning ortidan ergashib, ba'zi to'rtburchaklar va boshqa qushlarning qo'shig'i bilan yo'naltirilgan holda, g'arbga tomon yo'l oldi, ozgina ishlatilgan, yashil o'tlar va gullarga to'la yo'l bo'ylab. Bu yo'l endi barcha quyoshga ochilishni boshladi va u bilan suhbatlashdi, hazillashdi va kuldi, ularni yarim darajadan oldin, ikki ming qadamdan oshmasdan, juda go'zal va boy saroyga olib keldi.

en: Here they entered and having gone all about and viewed the great saloons and the quaint and elegant chambers all throughly furnished with that which pertaineth thereunto, they mightily commended the place and accounted its lord magniﬁcent.
uz: Ular bu yerga kirib, aylanib, ulkan salonlarni va unga tegishli narsalar bilan to'liq jihozlangan g'aroyib va nafis xonalarni ko'rib chiqishdi va bu joyni kuchli maqtashdi va uni ulug'vor deb hisoblashdi.

en: Then, going be- low and seeing the very spacious and cheerful court thereof, the cellars full of choicest wines and the very cool water that welled there in great abund- ance, they praised it yet more.
uz: Keyin, pastga qarab, uning juda keng va quvnoq hovlisini, eng yaxshi vinolarga to'la podvallarni va u yerda mo'l-ko'l oqib kelayotgan juda salqin suvni ko'rib, ular uni yanada ko'proq maqtashdi.

en: Thence, as if desirous of repose, they betook themselves to sit in a gallery which commanded all the courtyard and was all full of ﬂowers, such as the season afforded, and leafage, whereupon
uz: Shundan so'ng, go'yo dam olishni xohlagandek, ular butun hovliga hukmronlik qiluvchi va barcha gullarga to'la galereyada o'tirishga majbur bo'lishdi, masalan, mavsum va barglar kabi.

en: there came the careful seneschal and entertained and refreshed them with costliest confections and wines of choice.
uz: U yerda ehtiyotkor keksa odam keldi va ularni eng qimmatbaho shirinliklar va eng yaxshi vinolar bilan xursand qildi va tetikladi.

en: Thereafter, letting open to them a garden, all walled about, which coasted the palace, they entered therein and it seeming to them, at their entering, altogether152 wonder-goodly, they ad- dressed themselves more intently to view the particulars thereof.
uz: Shundan so'ng, ularga bir bog' ochib, saroy qirg'og'i bo'ylab devor bilan o'ralgan holda, ular unga kirdilar va ularga shunday tuyuldi, kirganlarida, jami 152 ta ajoyib-yaxshi, ular uning tafsilotlarini ko'rish uchun o'zlarini yanada diqqat bilan kiyintirishdi.

en: It had about it and athwart the middle very spacious alleys, all straight as arrows and embowered with trellises of vines, which made great show of bearing abundance of grapes that year and being then all in blossom, yielded so rare a savour about the garden, that, as it blent with the fragrance of many an- other sweet-smelling plant that there gave scent, themseemed they were among all the spiceries that ever grew in the Orient.
uz: U atrofida juda keng ko'chalar bor edi, ularning barchasi o'qdek to'g'ri va tokzorlar bilan o'ralgan edi. Bu o'sha yili uzumning mo'lligi ko'rsatilgan va gullab-yashnaganligi sababli, bog'ga shunchalik kamdan-kam ta'm bergan ediki, u yerda xushbo'y hid beradigan ko'plab boshqa shirin hidli o'simliklarning xushbo'yligi bilan aralashganida, ular Sharqda o'sgan barcha ziravorlar qatoridagandek tuyuldi.

en: The sides of these al- leys were all in a manner walled about with roses, red and white, and jessa- mine, wherefore not only of a morning, but what while the sun was highest, one might go all about, untouched thereby, neath odoriferous and delight- some shade.
uz: Bu al-leylarning yon tomonlari xuddi shunday qilib atirgullar, qizil va oq, va jessa-meniki bilan o'ralgan edi, shuning uchun nafaqat ertalabki, balki quyosh eng baland bo'lganida ham, u bilan teginmasdan, xushbo'y va yoqimli bo'lmagan hamma narsani aylanib yurish mumkin edi - ba'zi soyalar.

en: What and how many and how orderly disposed were the plants that grew in that place, it were tedious to recount; sufﬁce it that there is none goodly of those which may brook our air but was there in abundance.
uz: O'sha joyda o'sgan o'simliklar qanchalik ko'p va qanchalik tartibli edi, ularni sanab o'tish zerikarli edi; yetarli bo'lsa-da, havomizni oqizadigan, ammo mo'l-ko'l bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan hech bir yaxshi narsa yo'q edi.

en: Amiddleward the garden (what was not less, but yet more commendable than aught else there) was a plat of very ﬁne grass, so green that it seemed well nigh black, enamelled all with belike a thousand kinds of ﬂowers and closed about with the greenest and lustiest of orange and citron trees, the which, bearing at once old fruits and new and ﬂowers, not only afforded the eyes a pleasant shade, but were no less grateful to the smell.
uz: Bog'ning o'rtasida (bu unchalik kam emas edi, lekin undan ham maqtovga sazovorroq edi) juda nozik o'tlar bor edi, shunchalik yashil ediki, u juda qora ko'rinardi, barchasi ming xil gullar bilan emal qilingan va eng yashil va hashamatli apelsin va limon daraxtlari bilan yopilgan edi, ular bir vaqtning o'zida eski mevalar, yangi va gullar bilan ko'zlarga yoqimli soya berish bilan bir qatorda, hidga ham kam minnatdor emas edi.

en: Midmost the grass-plat was a fountain of the whitest marble, enchased with wonder- goodly sculptures, and thence —whether I know not from a natural or an ar- tiﬁcial source —there sprang, by a ﬁgure that stood on a column in its midst, so great a jet of water and so high towards the sky, whence not without a delectable sound it fell back into the wonder-limpid fount, that a mill might have wrought with less; the which after (I mean the water which overﬂowed the full basin) issued forth of the lawn by a hidden way, and coming to light therewithout, encompassed it all about by very goodly and curiously wroughten channels.
uz: O't maydonining o'rtasida eng oq marmar favvorasi bor edi, ajoyib haykallar bilan o'ralgan edi va shundan  tabiiy yoki ar- rasmiydan bilmasligim kerakmi  u yerda paydo bo'ldi, uning o'rtasida ustunda turgan, shunchalik katta suv oqimi va osmonga qarab baland edi, u yoqimli tovushsiz ajoyib-silliq favvoraga qaytib tushmadi, tegirmon kamroq ishlashi mumkin edi; undan keyin (men to'la havzani to'ldirgan suvni nazarda tutyapman) maysazordan bir yo'l bilan chiqib, u yerda yashirincha paydo bo'ldi, uni juda yaxshi va g'adir-budur kanallar bilan qamrab oldi.

en: Thence by like channels it ran through well nigh every part of the pleasance and was gathered again at the last in a place whereby it had issue from the fair garden and whence it descended, in the clearest of streams, towards the plain; but, ere it won thither, it turned two mills with exceeding power and to the no small vantage of the lord.
uz: Shundan so'ng, xuddi shunday kanallar orqali u zavqning deyarli har bir qismidan o'tib, oxirida yana bir joyga yig'ildi, u yerda go'zal bog'dan chiqdi va undan, eng tiniq soylardan, tekislik tomon tushdi; lekin u yerga g'alaba qozonishdan oldin, u juda kuchli va xo'jayinning kichik afzalligiga erishadigan ikki tegirmonni aylantirdi.

en: The sight of this garden and its fair ordinance and the plants and the fountain, with the rivu-
uz: Bu bog'ning ko'rinishi va uning go'zal tartib-qoidalari, o'simliklar va favvora, daryo bilan.

en: lets proceeding therefrom, so pleased the ladies and the three young men that they all of one accord avouched that, an Paradise might be created upon earth, they could not avail to conceive what form, other than that of this garden, might be given it nor what farther beauty might possibly be added thereunto.
uz: Shundan so'ng, xonimlar va uch yigit shunchalik xursand bo'lishdiki, ularning barchasi bir ovozdan yer yuzida jannat yaratilishiga, unga ushbu bog'dan boshqa qanday shakl berilishiga va unga qanday ko'proq go'zallik qo'shilishi mumkinligini tasavvur qilishga qodir emas edilar.

en: However, as they went most gladsomely thereabout, weaving them the goodliest garlands of the various leafage of the trees and hearken- ing the while to the carols of belike a score of different kinds of birds, that sang as if in rivalry one of other, they became aware of a delectable beauty, which, wonderstricken as they were with the other charms of the place, they had not yet noted; to wit, they found the garden full of maybe an hundred kinds of goodly creatures, and one showing them to other, they saw on one side rabbits issue, on another hares run; here lay kids and there fawns went grazing, and there was many another kind of harmless animal, each going about his pastime at his pleasure, as if tame; the which added unto them a yet greater pleasure than the others.
uz: Ammo, ular u yerga borar ekanlar, daraxtlarning turli barglarining eng yaxshi gulchambarlarini to'qib, bir-birlariga raqib bo'lgandek kuylagan turli xil qushlarning qo'shiqlariga quloq solib, ular yoqimli go'zallikni anglab yetdilar, ular bu joyning boshqa jozibasi bilan hayratda qolishardi, ammo hali e'tiborga olishmagan edi; ya'ni, ular bog'da yuz xil yaxshi mavjudot bor edi, ulardan biri boshqalarga ko'rsatar ekan, bir tomonda quyonlar, boshqa bir tomonda itlar bor edi; bu yerda o'tlar yotardi va u yerda o'tlar edi, va har biri o'z zavqida, o'z zavqida yurardi; bu ularga boshqa bolalardan ham kattaroq qo'shardi.

en: After they had gone about their ﬁll, viewing now this thing and now that, the queen let set the tables around the fair fountain and at her commandment, having ﬁrst sung half a dozen can- zonets and danced sundry dances, they sat down to meat.
uz: Ular to'lib-toshganlaridan so'ng, endi bu narsani va endi bu narsani ko'rib, malika go'zal favvora atrofida stollarni o'rnatdi va uning buyrug'iga ko'ra, avval yarim o'nlab qozonli zonalarni kuylab, turli raqslarni raqsga tushirib, go'shtga o'tirdilar.

en: There, being right well and orderly served, after a very fair and sumptuous and tranquil fash- ion, with goodly and delicate viands, they waxed yet blither and arising thence, gave themselves anew to music-making and singing and dancing till it seemed good to the queen that those whom it pleased should betake them- selves to sleep.
uz: U yerda, juda yaxshi va tartibli xizmat ko'rsatib, juda adolatli, hashamatli va sokin fash- ion, yaxshi va nozik go'shtlar bilan, ular yanada salqinroq va undan ko'tarilib, o'zlarini yana musiqa yaratishga, kuylashga va raqsga bag'ishladilar, toki malikaga yoqqan odamlarni o'zlari uyquga o'tkazishlari ma'qul bo'lmaguncha.

en: Accordingly some went thither, whilst others, overcome with the beauty of the place, willed not to leave it, but, abiding there, ad- dressed themselves, some to reading romances and some to playing chess or tables, whilst the others slept.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ba'zilar u yerga borishdi, boshqalari esa joyning go'zalligidan hayratga tushib, undan ketishni xohlashmadi, lekin u yerda qolishdi va o'zlarini ad-ga kiyintirishdi, ba'zilar roman o'qishga, ba'zilar esa shaxmat yoki stol o'ynashga, boshqalari esa uxlashdi.

en: But presently, the hour of none being past and the sleepers having arisen and refreshed their faces with cold water, they came all, at the queen’s commandment, to the lawn hard by the fountain and there seating themselves, after the wonted fashion, waited to fall to story- telling upon the subject proposed by her.
uz: Ammo hozirgi vaqtda, hech narsa o'tmagan soat o'tib, uxlovchilar turib, sovuq suv bilan yuzlarini tetiklaganlaridan so'ng, ular hammasi, malika buyrug'iga ko'ra, favvora yonidagi maysazorga qattiq kelishdi va o'sha yerda o'tirishdi, odatdagidek, u taklif qilgan mavzuni aytib berishni kutishdi.

en: The ﬁrst upon whom she laid this charge was Filostrato, who began on this wise:
uz: U bu mas'uliyatni birinchi bo'lib Filostrato zimmasiga yuklagan, u shunday deb boshlagan edi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Masetto of Lamporecchio feigneth himself dumb and becometh gardener to a convent of women, who all ﬂock to lie with him.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Lamporekkioning Masetto o'zini ahmoqdek ko'rsatadi va u bilan birga yotishga yig'ilgan ayollar monastiriga bog'bon bo'ladi.

en: “Fairest ladies, there be many men and women foolish enough to believe that, whenas the white ﬁllet is bound about a girl’s head and the black cowl clapped upon her back, she is no longer a woman and is no longer sensible of feminine appetites, as if the making her a nun had changed her to stone; and if perchance they hear aught contrary to this their belief, they are as much incensed as if a very great and heinous misdeed had been committed against nature, considering not neither having regard to themselves, whom full license to do that which they will availeth not to sat, nor yet to the much potency of idlesse and thought-taking.153 On like wise there are but too many who believe that spade and mattock and coarse victuals and hard liv- ing do altogether purge away carnal appetites from the tillers of the earth and render them exceeding dull of wit and judgment.
uz: Haqiqiy xonimlar, ko'p erkaklar va ayollar shunchalik ahmoqki, qizning boshiga oq file bog'langan va uning orqa tomoniga qora tovon urilgan bo'lsa, u endi ayol emas va ayollik ishtahalariga sezgir emas, go'yo uni rohiba qilish uni toshga aylantirgandek; va agar ular bu e'tiqodlariga zid biror narsa eshitishsa, ular tabiatga nisbatan juda katta va shafqatsiz ish sodir etilganidek g'azablangan bo'lishadi, o'zlarini hurmat qilmaslikni, ular o'tirishga yaroqli bo'lmagan narsani qilishga to'liq ruxsat bermaslikni, beparvolik va fikrlashning katta kuchini ham hisobga olmaydilar.

en: But how much all who believe thus are deluded, I purpose, since the queen hath commanded it to me, to make plain to you in a little story, without departing from the theme by her appointed.
uz: Lekin shunday ishonuvchilarning barchasi qanchalik aldangan bo'lsa, buni malika menga o'zi tayinlagan mavzudan chetga chiqmasdan, sizga kichik bir hikoyada tushuntirishni buyurganidan maqsad qilaman.

en: There was (and is yet) in these our parts a convent of women, very fam- ous for sanctity (the which, that I may not anywise abate its repute, I will not name), wherein no great while agone, there being then no more than eight nuns and an abbess, all young, in the nunnery, a poor silly dolt of a fellow was gardener of a very goodly garden of theirs, who, being miscon- tent with his wage, settled his accounts with the ladies’ bailiff and returned to Lamporecchio, whence he came.
uz: Bizning hududlarimizda (va hali ham bor edi) muqaddaslik uchun juda mashhur ayollar monastiri bor edi (uning obro'sini hech qanday tarzda kamaytirmasligim mumkin, nom bermayman), u yerda katta bir kishi yo'q edi, o'sha paytda sakkiztadan ortiq rohiba va abita, ularning barchasi yosh edi, rohibxonada bir bechora ahmoq yigit o'zlarining juda yaxshi bog'i bog'bon edi, u o'z ish haqi bilan adashgan holda, xonimlar bilan hisob-kitob qildi va Lamporecchioga qaytib keldi, u yerdan keldi.

en: There, amongst others who welcomed him home, was a young labouring man, stout and robust and (for a country- man) a well-favoured fellow, by name of Masetto, who asked him where he
uz: U yerda uni uyida kutib olgan boshqalar qatorida, kuchli va mustahkam yosh mehnatkash yigit bor edi va (qishloqi odam uchun) Masetto ismli yaxshi ko'ringan yigit undan qayerdaligini so'radi.

en: The good man, whose name was Nuto, told him, whereupon Masetto asked him in what he had served the convent, and he, ‘I tended a great and goodly garden of theirs, and moreover I went while to the coppice for faggots and drew water and did other such small matters of service; but the nuns gave me so little wage that I could scare ﬁnd me in shoon withal.
uz: Yaxshi odam, Nuto deb nomlanardi, unga aytdi, shundan so'ng Masetto undan monastirga nima xizmat qilganini so'radi va u dedi: "Men ularning katta va yaxshi bog'ini boqdim, bundan tashqari, qirg'ichlar uchun qirg'ichga bordim va suv tortdim, shuningdek, boshqa shu kabi kichik xizmat ishlarini ham qildim; lekin rohibalar menga shunchalik kam ish haqi berishardiki, men o'zimni shoon bilan topishdan qo'rqardim."

en: Besides, they are all young and methinketh they are possessed of the devil, for there was no doing anything to their liking; nay, when I was at work whiles in the hortyard,154 quoth one, “Set this here,” and another, “Set that here,” and a third snatched the spade from my hand, saying, “That is naught”; brief, they gave me so much vexation that I would leave work be and begone out of the hortyard; insomuch that, what with one thing and what with another, I would abide there no longer and took myself off.
uz: Qolaversa, ularning hammasi yosh va o'ylashlaricha, ularga shayton ta'sir qilgan, chunki ularga yoqadigan hech narsa qilinmas edi; yo'q, men ishda bo'lganimda, birinchidan, "Buni shu yerga qo'y", yana biri, "Buni shu yerga qo'y", va uchinchisi qo'limdan pichoqni tortib olib, "Bu hech narsa emas", dedi; qisqacha aytganda, ular menga shunchalik ko'p g'azablandiki, men ishdan ketib, o'rmondan ketardim; shundayki, bir narsa bilan nima bilan bo'lsa ham, u yerda qolmasdim va o'zimni yechardim.

en: When I came away, their bailiff besought me, an I could lay my hand on anyone apt unto that service, to send the man to him, and I promised it him; but may God make him sound of the loins as he whom I shall get him, else will I send him none at all!’ Masetto, hearing this, was taken with so great a de- sire to be with these nuns that he was all consumed therewith, judging from Nuto’s words that he might avail to compass somewhat of that which he de- sired.
uz: Men qaytib kelganimda, ularning sudyalari meni so'rashdi, men bu xizmatga layoqatli bo'lgan har bir kishiga qo'limni qo'yib, uni unga yuborishim mumkin edi va men unga va'da berdim; lekin Xudo uni kimni olgan bo'lsam, uning belini xuddi shunday eshitsin, boshqa hech kimni yubormayman! Masetto buni eshitgach, u bu rohibalar bilan birga bo'lish uchun shunchalik katta de-siy bilan qabul qilindi, u Nuto'ning so'zlaridan xulosa qilib, u o'zi qilgan narsalardan biroz o'tishga qodir bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: However, foreseeing that he would fail of his purpose, if he dis- covered aught thereof to Nuto, he said to the latter, ‘Egad, thou didst well to come away.
uz: Ammo, agar Nutoga biror narsani yashirsa, u o'z maqsadiga erisha olmasligini oldindan ko'rib, u undan keyin unga dedi: "Egad, sen yaxshi ish qilding, ketding."

en: How is a man to live with women?
uz: Erkak ayol bilan qanday yashashi kerak?

en: He were better abide with devils.
uz: U shaytonlar bilan yaxshiroq yashar edi.

en: Six times out of seven they know not what they would have them- selves.’ But, after they had made an end of their talk, Masetto began to cast about what means he should take to be with them and feeling himself well able to do the ofﬁces of which Nuto had spoken, he had no fear of being re- fused on that head, but misdoubted him he might not be received, for that he was young and well-looked.
uz: Yetti martadan olti marta ular o'zlari bilan nima bo'lishini bilmaydilar  o'zlari. Ammo, ular gaplarini tugatgandan so'ng, Masetto ular bilan birga bo'lish uchun qanday vositalar bilan borishi kerakligi haqida o'ylay boshladi va Nuto aytgan vazifalarni bajarishga o'zini yaxshi his qildi, u o'sha boshida qayta qo'yilishdan qo'rqmadi, lekin uni qabul qilinmasligi mumkinligiga shubha qildi, chunki u yosh va chiroyli ko'rinardi.

en: Wherefore, after pondering many things in himself, he bethought himself thus: ‘The place is far hence and none knoweth me there, an I can but make a show of being dumb, I shall for cer- tain be received there.’ Having ﬁxed upon this device, he set out with an axe he had about his neck, without telling any whither he was bound, and betook himself, in the guise of a beggarman, to the convent, where being come, he entered in and as luck would have it, found the bailiff in the court- yard.
uz: Shuning uchun, o'zida ko'p narsalarni o'ylab, u shunday o'yladi: "Bu joy uzoqda va meni u yerda hech kim tanimaydi, men faqat ahmoq ekanligimni ko'rsata olaman, u yerda albatta qabul qilinaman." Bu qurilmaga mahkam yopishib, bo'ynida bolta bilan yo'lga chiqdi, qayerga bog'langanini hech kimga aytmasdan, o'zini tilanchi qiyofasida, qayerga kelganini ko'rsatdi, u monastirga kirdi va omadga ko'ra, hovlida sudyani topdi.

en: Him he accosted with signs such as dumb folk use and made a show of asking food of him for the love of God and that in return he would, an it were needed, cleave wood for him.
uz: U unga ahmoq xalq odatlari kabi belgilar bilan yaqinlashdi va undan Xudoning muhabbati uchun ovqat so'rashni ko'rsatdi va buning evaziga, agar kerak bo'lsa, unga yog'och yopishtirardi.

en: The bailiff willingly gave him to eat and after set before him divers logs that Nuto had not availed to cleave, but of
uz: Sud ijrochisi unga o'z xohishi bilan ovqat berdi va keyin uning oldiga Nuto chopishga ulgurmagan, balki...

en: all which Masetto, who was very strong, made a speedy despatch.
uz: Masetto, juda kuchli bo'lgani uchun, tezda jo'natdi.

en: By and by, the bailiff, having occasion to go to the coppice, carried him thither and put him to cutting faggots; after which, setting the ass before him, he gave him to understand by signs that he was to bring them home.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan sudya, piyozxonaga borishga imkoniyat topib, uni u yerga olib bordi va qirg'ichlarni kesishga qo'ydi; so'ngra eshakni uning oldiga qo'yib, ularni uyga olib kelishini belgilar bilan tushuntirdi.

en: This he did very well; wherefore the bailiff kept him there some days, so he might have him do certain things for which he had occasion.
uz: Bu ishni u juda yaxshi qildi; shuning uchun sudya uni bir necha kun o'sha yerda saqladi, toki u o'ziga tegishli bo'lgan ba'zi ishlarni qilsin.

en: One day it chanced that the abbess saw him and asked the bailiff who he was.
uz: Bir kuni monastir uni ko'rib, sud hokimiyatidan kimligini so'radi.

en: ‘Madam,’ answered he, ‘this is a poor deaf and dumb man, who came hither the other day to ask an alms; so I took him in out of charity and have made him do sundry things of which we had need.
uz: Xonim,  javob berdi u,  bu bir bechora kar va soqov odam, u bir kun oldin bu yerga sadaqa so'rash uchun kelgan edi; shuning uchun men uni xayriya uchun qabul qildim va bizga kerak bo'lgan turli xil ishlarni qilishga majbur qildim.

en: If he knew how to till the hortyard and chose to abide with us, I believe we should get good service of him; for that we lack such an one and he is strong and we could make what we would of him; more by token that you would have no occasion to fear his playing the fool with yonder lasses of yours.’ ‘I’ faith,’ rejoined the abbess, ‘thou sayst sooth.
uz: Agar u issiqzorni qanday ekishni bilgan va biz bilan birga yashashni tanlaganida edi, menimcha, biz unga yaxshi xizmat ko'rsatishimiz kerak edi; chunki bizda bunday odam yetishmaydi va u kuchli va biz undan xohlaganimizni qila olamiz; bundan tashqari, sizda uning o'z qo'ltiqlaringiz bilan ahmoqona o'ynashidan qo'rqish uchun hech qanday sabab bo'lmas edi." Men ishonaman,  deb javob berdi abbat, siz shunday deyapsiz.

en: Learn if he knoweth how to till and study to keep him here; give him a pair of shoes and some old hood or other and make much of him, caress him, give him plenty to eat.’ Which the bailiff promised to do.
uz: Uni bu yerda ushlab turish uchun dehqonchilik qilishni va o'qishni bilishini o'rganing; unga oyoq kiyim va eski kapyushon yoki boshqa narsa bering va undan ko'p narsa tayyorlang, erkalab, unga to'yib ovqat bering. Bu ishni sudya qilishga va'da berdi.

en: Masetto was not so far distant but he heard all this, making a show the while of sweeping the courtyard, and said merrily in himself, ‘An you put me therein, I will till you your hortyard as it was never tilled yet.’ Accordingly, the bailiff, seeing that he knew right well how to work, asked him by signs if he had a mind to abide there and he replied on like wise that he would do whatsoever he wished; whereupon the bailiff engaged him and charged him till the hort- yard, showing him what he was to do; after which he went about other busi- ness of the convent and left him.
uz: Masetto unchalik uzoqda emas edi, lekin u bularning hammasini eshitdi, hovlini supurish paytida ko'z-ko'z qilib, o'ziga xursand bo'lib dedi: "Agar meni u yerga qo'ysang, men senga hech qachon dazmollanmagan o'rmoningni yig'aman." Shunga ko'ra, mahkama boshlig'i, u qanday ishlashni yaxshi bilganini ko'rib, undan u yerda qolishga aqli bor-yo'qligini so'radi va u donolik bilan u xohlagan narsani qiladi deb javob berdi; shundan so'ng mahkama boshlig'i uni o'rmonxonaga olib bordi va nima qilish kerakligini ko'rsatib, unga nima qilish kerakligini ko'rsatdi; shundan so'ng u monastirning boshqa ishlarida bo'ldi va uni tark etdi.

en: Presently, as Masetto went working one day after another, the nuns fell to plaguing him and making mock of him, as ofttimes it betideth that folk do with mutes, and bespoke him the naughtiest words in the world, thinking he understood them not; whereof the abbess, mayhap supposing him to be tailless as well as tongueless, recked little or nothing.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, Masetto kunma-kun ishga ketayotganda, rohibalar uni bezovta qilishdi va masxara qilishdi, chunki ko'pincha odamlar jimlar bilan shug'ullanishadi va unga dunyodagi eng xunuk so'zlarni gapirishardi, chunki u ularni tushunmas edi; bundan keyin abbatasi uni dumsiz va tilsiz deb o'ylashardi, kam yoki hech narsa demasdi.

en: It chanced one day, however, that, as he rested himself after a hard morning’s work, two young nuns, who went about the garden,155 drew near the place where he lay and fell to looking upon him, whilst he made a show of sleeping.
uz: Ammo bir kuni shunday bo'lib qoldiki, u og'ir ertalabki ishdan keyin dam olayotganida, bog' atrofida aylanib yurgan ikki yosh rohiba, 155, u yotgan joyga yaqinlashib, unga qarab yiqilishdi, u esa uxlayotgan ko'rinish berdi.

en: Presently quoth one who was somewhat the bolder of the twain to the other, ‘If I thought thou wouldst keep my counsel, I would tell thee a thought which I have once and again had and which might perchance proﬁt thee also.’ ‘Speak in all assurance,’ answered the other, ‘for certes I will never tell it to any.’ Then said the forward wench, ‘I know not if thou have
uz: Hozirda bir oz jasurroq bo'lgan bir kishi ikkinchisiga dedi: "Agar men sen mening maslahatimga sodiq qolishingni o'ylaganimda, senga bir fikr aytardim, bu fikrim bir necha bor bo'lgan va ehtimol senga ham foyda keltirishi mumkin". "To'liq ishonch bilan gapir," javob berdi ikkinchisi, "chindan ham hech kimga aytmayman".

en: ever considered how straitly we are kept and how no man dare ever enter here, save the bailiff, who is old, and yonder dumb fellow; and I have again and again heard ladies, who come to visit us, say that all other delights in the world are but toys in comparison with that which a woman enjoyeth, whenas she hath to do with a man.
uz: Biz qanchalik tor turishimiz va hech kim bu yerga kirishga jur'at eta olmasligi haqida o'ylab ko'rdim, faqat sudya, u keksa va ahmoq odam edi; va men bizga tashrif buyuradigan ayollarni qayta-qayta eshitdim, ular dunyodagi barcha boshqa lazzatlar ayol erkak bilan munosabatda bo'lganda undan zavqlanadigan narsalar bilan solishtirganda shunchaki o'yinchoqlar ekanligini aytishardi.

en: Wherefore I have often had it in mind to make trial with this mute, since with others I may not, if it be so.
uz: Shuning uchun men ko'pincha bu soqov bilan sudlashishni o'ylab yurardim, chunki boshqa odamlar bilan bunday qilmasam ham bo'ladi.

en: And in- deed he is the best in the world to that end, for that, e’en if he would, he could not nor might tell it again.
uz: Va aslida u dunyodagi eng yaxshisi shu maqsadda, chunki, agar xohlasa, buni yana ayta olmas edi va ayta olmas edi ham.

en: Thou seest he is a poor silly lout of a lad, who hath overgrown his wit, and I would fain hear how thou deemest of the thing.’ ‘Alack!’ rejoined the other, ‘what is this thou sayest?
uz: Ko'ryapsan-ku, u bechora, ahmoq bola, aqldan ozgan, va men bu haqda sening fikringni eshitishni xohlardim." Alack! - deb javob berdi ikkinchisi, - bu nima deyapsan?

en: Knowest thou not that we have promised our virginity to God?’ ‘Oh, as for that,’ answered the ﬁrst, ‘how many things are promised Him all day long, whereof not one is fulﬁlled unto Him!
uz: "Bilmaysanmi, biz bokiraligimizni Xudoga va'da qilganmiz?"  "Ha, shunga kelsak,  javob berdi birinchisi,  Unga kun bo'yi qancha va'dalar berilsa, ularning hech biri Unga amalga oshmaydi!

en: An we have promised it Him, let Him ﬁnd Himself another or others to perform it to Him.’ ‘Or if,’ went on her fellow, ‘we should prove with child, how would it go then?’ Quoth the other, ‘Thou be- ginnest to take thought unto ill ere it cometh; when that betideth, then will we look to it; there will be a thousand ways for us of doing so that it shall never be known, provided we ourselves tell it not.’ The other, hearing this and having now a greater itch than her companion to prove what manner beast a man was, said, ‘Well, then, how shall we do?’ Quoth the ﬁrst, ‘Thou seest it is nigh upon none and methinketh the sisters are all asleep, save only ourselves; let us look about the hortyard if there be any there, and if there be none, what have we to do but to take him by the hand and carry him into yonder hut, whereas he harboureth against the rain, and there let one of us abide with him,
uz: Biz Unga va'da berdik, U O'ziga buni bajarish uchun boshqa yoki boshqalarni topsin."  Yoki agar,  deb davom etdi u o'rtog'iga,  biz bola bilan sinovdan o'tkazsak, unda qanday bo'lardi?  Boshqa aytdi,  Sen kelmasidan oldin yomon o'ylashing kerak; qachonki u betid bo'lsa, biz unga qaraymiz; biz uchun buni qilishning mingta usuli bo'ladi, agar biz buni hech qachon aytmasak.

en: whilst the other keepeth watch?
uz: Boshqasi esa hushyor bo'lib turadimi?

en: He is so simple that he will do whatever we will.’ Masetto heard all this talk and disposed to compliance, waited but to be taken by one of the nuns.
uz: U shunchalik oddiyki, biz xohlagan narsani qiladi. Masetto bu gaplarning hammasini eshitib, rozilikka tayyor edi, ammo rohibalardan biri tomonidan olib ketilishini kutdi.

en: The latter having looked well all about and satisﬁed themselves that they could be seen from nowhere, she who had broached the matter came up to Masetto and aroused him, whereupon he rose incontinent to his feet.
uz: Oxirgisi atrofga yaxshi qaragan va ularni hech qayerdan ko'rish mumkinligiga ishonch hosil qilganidan so'ng, masalani ko'rib chiqqan ayol Masetto huzuriga kelib, uni uyg'otdi, shundan so'ng u oyoqlari bilan tik turdi.

en: The nun took him coaxingly by the hand and led him, grinning like an idiot, to the hut, where, without overmuch pressing, he did what she would.
uz: Rohiba uni qo'lidan ushlab, ahmoqdek jilmaydi, kulbaga olib bordi, u yerda ortiqcha bosim o'tkazmasdan, u xohlaganini qildi.

en: Then, like a loyal comrade, having had her will, she gave place to her fellow, and Masetto, still feigning himself a simpleton, did their pleasure.
uz: Keyin, sodiq o'rtoq kabi, uning irodasiga ega bo'lib, u o'z sheriklariga joy berdi va Masetto, hali ham o'zini sodda deb ko'rsatgan holda, ularning xohishlarini qildi.

en: Before they departed thence, each of the girls must needs once more prove how the mute could horse it, and after devising with each other, they agreed that the thing was as delectable as they had heard, nay, more so.
uz: Ular u yerdan ketishdan oldin, har bir qizga soqov qanday qilib otda uchrashi mumkinligini yana bir bor isbotlash kerak edi va ular bir-birlari bilan maslahatlashib, bu narsa eshitgandek yoqimli ekanligiga rozi bo'lishdi, yo'q, undan ham ko'proq.

en: Accordingly, watching their opportunity, they
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'z imkoniyatlarini kuzatib, ular...

en: went oftentimes at ﬁtting seasons to divert themselves with the mute, till one day it chanced that one of their sisters, espying them in the act from the lattice of her cell, showed it to other twain.
uz: Ular ko'pincha mavsumlarda o'zlarini soqov bilan chalg'itish uchun borar edilar, toki bir kuni ularning bir opasi, ularni hujayrasi panjarasidan kuzatib, buni boshqa ikki kishiga ko'rsatdi.

en: At ﬁrst they talked of denoun- cing the culprits to the abbess, but, after, changing counsel and coming to an accord with the ﬁrst two, they became sharers with them in Masetto’s services, and to them the other three nuns were at divers times and by divers chances added as associates.
uz: Avvaliga ular aybdorlarni abbasiga ayblash haqida gapirishdi, lekin keyin maslahat o'zgarib, birinchi ikkalasi bilan kelishib, ular Masetto'ning xizmatlarida ular bilan sherik bo'lishdi va ularga qolgan uchta rohiba turli vaqtlarda va turli imkoniyatlar bilan sherik bo'lishdi.

en: Ultimately, the abbess, who had not yet gotten wind of these doings, walking one day alone in the garden, the heat being great, found Masetto (who had enough of a little fatigue by day, because of overmuch posting it by night) stretched out asleep under the shade of an al- mond-tree, and the wind lifting the forepart of his clothes, all abode dis- covered.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, bu ishlardan hali xabardor bo'lmagan abbasi, bir kun bog'da yolg'iz yurib, issiqlik juda kuchli edi, Masetto (kun davomida biroz charchagan, kechasi ko'p tashlaganligi sababli) al-mond daraxti soyasida uxlab yotganini va shamol uning kiyimlarining old qismini ko'tarayotganini, barchasi qoplangan holda yotganini topdi.

en: The lady, beholding this and seeing herself alone, fell into that same appetite which had gotten hold of her nuns, and arousing Masetto, carried him to her chamber, where, to the no small miscontent of the others, who complained loudly that the gardener came not to till the hortyard, she kept him several days, proving and reproving that delight which she had erst been wont to blame in others.
uz: Xonim buni ko'rib, o'zini yolg'iz ko'rib, rohibalarini o'ziga rom etgan ishtahaga tushdi va Masetto'ni uyg'otdi, uni o'z xonasiga olib bordi. U yerda, boshqalar norozi bo'lishiga qaramay, ular bog'bon hovliga kelmasligini baland ovozda shikoyat qilishdi, uni bir necha kun ushlab turdi, avval boshqalarda aybdor bo'lgan o'sha zavqni isbotladi va tanqid qildi.

en: At last she sent him back to his own lodging, but was fain to have him often again and as, moreover, she re- quired of him more than her share, Masetto, unable to satisfy so many, be- thought himself that his playing the mute might, an it endured longer, result in his exceeding great hurt.
uz: Nihoyat, u uni o'z turar joyiga qaytarib yubordi, lekin uni tez-tez ko'rishga rozi edi va bundan tashqari, u undan o'z ulushidan ko'ra ko'proq narsani talab qilardi. Masetto, ko'pchilikni qondira olmagani uchun, o'zi o'yladi, uning jim o'ynashi uzoqroq davom etishi uning juda katta zarariga olib keladi.

en: Wherefore, being one night with the abbess, he gave loose to156 his tongue and bespoke her thus: ‘Madam, I have heard say that one cock sufﬁceth unto half a score hens, but that half a score men can ill or hardly satisfy one woman; whereas needs must I serve nine, and to this I can no wise endure; nay, for that which I have done up to now, I am come to such a pass that I can do neither little nor much; wherefore do ye either let me go in God’s name or ﬁnd a remedy for the matter.’ The abbess, hearing him speak whom she held dumb, was all amazed and said, ‘What is this?
uz: Shuning uchun ham, abtes bilan bir kecha bo'lganida, u tilini bo'shatib 156 ga berdi va uni shunday chaqirdi: "Xonim, men bir xo'roz yarim ming tovuqqa yetadi, lekin yarim ming erkak bir ayolni kasal yoki deyarli qondira olmaydi, chunki men to'qqizta ehtiyojni qondirishim kerak, va bunga aql bilan bardosh bera olmayman; yo'q, men shu paytgacha qilgan ishlarim uchun, men na kam, na ko'p narsa qila olmayman, shuning uchun meni Xudoning nomiga kirishga yoki bu masalaga yechim topishga ruxsat berasizlar." Abtes, uni eshitib, u kimni soqol deb ushlab turganini, butunlay hayron bo'ldi va dedi: "Bu nima?"

en: Methought thou wast dumb.’ ‘Madam,’ answered Masetto, ‘I was in- deed dumb, not by nature, but by reason of a malady which bereft me of speech, and only this very night for the ﬁrst time do I feel it restored to me, wherefore I praise God as most I may.’ The lady believed this and asked him what he meant by saying that he had to serve nine.
uz: O'yladimki, sen ahmoq eding. Xonim,  javob berdi Masetto, Men aslida ahmoq edim, tabiatan emas, balki meni so'zlashdan mahrum qilgan kasallik tufayli, va aynan shu kechagina menga bu narsa birinchi marta tiklanganini his qilyapman, shuning uchun men Xudoga qo'limdan kelgancha hamd aytaman. Xonim bunga ishondi va undan to'qqizta xizmat qilish kerakligini aytish bilan nimani nazarda tutganini so'radi.

en: Masetto told her how the case stood, whereby she perceived that she had no nun but was far wiser than herself; but, like a discreet woman as she was, she resolved to take counsel with her nuns to ﬁnd some means of arranging the matter, without letting Masetto go, so the convent might not be defamed by him.
uz: Masetto unga ish qanday holatda ekanligini aytdi, shu sababli u rohiba yo'qligini, lekin o'zidan ancha dono ekanligini angladi; lekin, o'zi kabi, hushyor ayol kabi, u rohibalari bilan masalani tartibga solish yo'llarini topishga qaror qildi, Masetto'ni qo'yib yubormasdan, monastir u tomonidan tuhmat qilinmasligi uchun.

en: Accordingly, having openly confessed to one another that which had been secretly done of each, they all of one accord, with Masetto’s consent, so ordered it that the people round about believed speech to have been restored to him, after he had long been mute, through their prayers and by the merits of the saint in whose name the convent was intituled, and their bailiff being lately dead, they made Masetto bailiff in his stead and apportioned his toils on such wise that he could endure them.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, har birining yashirincha qilingan ishini ochiqchasiga tan olgan holda, ular Masetto'ning roziligi bilan bir ovozdan, atrofdagi odamlar uning uzoq vaqtdan beri soqov bo'lganidan keyin, ibodatlari va monastir nomi bilan atalgan avliyosining xizmatlari tufayli uning nutqi tiklanganiga ishonishlarini buyurdilar va ularning sudyasi yaqinda vafot etganligi sababli, ular Masetto o'rniga sudyani tayinladilar va u ularga bardosh bera olishi uchun uning ishini taqsimladilar.

en: Thereafter, albeit he began upon them monikins galore, the thing was so discreetly ordered that nothing took vent thereof till after the death of the abbess, when Masetto began to grow old and had a mind to return home rich.
uz: Shundan so'ng, garchi u ularga monikins galore boshlagan bo'lsa-da, bu narsa shunchalik yashirincha buyurilgan ediki, Abtesaning vafotidan keyin, Masetto qarishni boshlagan va uyga boy qaytish niyatida bo'lgunga qadar hech narsa chiqmadi.

en: The thing becoming known, en- abled him lightly to accomplish his desire, and thus Masetto, having by his foresight contrived to employ his youth to good purpose, returned in his old age, rich and a father, without being at the pains or expense of rearing chil- dren, to the place whence he had set out with an axe about his neck, avouching that thus did Christ entreat whoso set horns to his cap.”
uz: Bu narsa ma'lum bo'lib, uni ozgina o'z xohish-istaklarini amalga oshirishga majbur qildi va shu tariqa Masetto, o'zining aql-idrok bilan yoshligini yaxshi maqsadga yo'naltirgan holda, keksaligida, boy va otasi bo'lib, sovuqlikni parvarishlash og'rig'i yoki xarajatlaridan xoli bo'lmasdan, o'zining bo'yniga bolta bilan chiqqan joyiga qaytdi, chunki Masih uning shapkasiga shox qo'yganlarga shunday murojaat qilardi.

en: THE SECOND STORY A horsekeeper lieth with the wife of King Agilulf, who, becoming aware thereof, without word said, ﬁndeth him out and polleth him; but the polled man polleth all his fellows on like wise and so escapeth ill hap.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Bir otsoch qirol Agilulfning xotini bilan yotadi, u buni bilib, hech qanday so'zsiz uni topib, so'kadi; lekin so'kilgan odam barcha sheriklarini dono kabi so'kadi va shuning uchun yomonlikdan qutuladi.

en: The end of Filostrato’s story, whereat whiles the ladies had some little blushed and other whiles laughed, being come, it pleased the queen that Pampinea should follow on with a story, and she accordingly, beginning with a smiling countenance, said, “Some are so little discreet in seeking at all hazards to show that they know and apprehend that which it concerneth them not to know, that whiles, rebuking to this end unperceived defects in others, they think to lessen their own shame, whereas they do inﬁnitely aug- ment it; and that this is so I purpose, lovesome ladies, to prove to you by the contrary thereof, showing you the astuteness of one who, in the judgment of a king of worth and valour, was held belike of less account than Masetto himself.
uz: Filostratning hikoyasining oxiri, ayollar biroz qizargan va boshqa ayollar kulishganida, kelgach, Pampiyaning hikoyani davom ettirishini ma'qul ko'rdi va u, xuddi shunday qilib, tabassum bilan boshladi va dedi: "Ba'zilar o'zlari bilmaydigan narsani bilishlarini va anglashlarini ko'rsatish uchun hech qanday xavfsizlikni talab qilishda juda kam xotirjam, ayollar bu maqsadda boshqalarning sezilmagan nuqsonlarini tanbeh berishadi, ular o'zlarining sharmandaligini kamaytirish uchun o'ylashadi, garchi ular buni cheksiz ko'paytirishadi; va bu men, yoqimtoy ayollar, sizga aksincha, siz uchun qadrli va qadrli bo'lgan shohning hukmida o'zini kamroq ko'rsatishni maqsad qilgan."

en: Agilulf, King of the Lombards, as his predecessors had done, ﬁxed the seat of his kingship at Pavia, a city of Lombardy, and took to wife Theodolinda157 the widow of Autari, likewise King of the Lombards, a very fair lady and exceeding discreet and virtuous, but ill fortuned in a lover.158 The affairs of the Lombards having, thanks to the valour and judgment of King Agilulf, been for some time prosperous and in quiet, it befell that one of the said queen’s horse-keepers, a man of very low condition, in respect of birth, but otherwise of worth far above so mean a station, and comely of person and tall as he were the king, became beyond measure enamoured of his mistress.
uz: Agilulf, Lombardlar qiroli, o'zidan oldingilar qilganidek, o'z qirolligining o'rnini Lombardiyaning Paviyasida o'rnatdi va Avtariyning bevasasi Teodolinda 157 ni, shuningdek, Lombardlar qiroli, juda go'zal, juda nozik va fazilatli, ammo sevgilisiga omadsizlik qilgan edi. 158 Lombardlarning ishlari, qirol Agilulfning jasorati va hukmi tufayli, bir muncha vaqtdan beri farovon va sokin bo'lganligi sababli, aytilgan malika otchilaridan biri, tug'ilishga nisbatan juda past ahvoldagi, lekin undan yuqori darajadagi, shuningdek, baland bo'yli va qirol kabi bo'lgan odam, uning bekasiga nisbatan juda ham oshiq bo'lgan.

en: His mean estate hindered him not from being sensible that this love of his was out of all reason, wherefore, like a discreet man as he was, he discovered it unto none, nor dared he make it known to her even with his
uz: Uning beparvoligi uning bu muhabbatining bejizga ekanligiga to'sqinlik qilmadi. Shuning uchun, o'zi kabi hushyor odam kabi, uni hech kimga kashf etmadi, hatto unga ham oshkor qilishga jur'at etmadi.

en: But, albeit he lived without any hope of ever winning her favour, yet inwardly he gloried in that he had bestowed his thoughts in such high place, and being all aﬂame with amorous ﬁre, he studied, beyond every other of his fellows, to do whatsoever he deemed might pleasure the queen; whereby it befell that, whenas she had occasion to ride abroad, she liefer mounted the palfrey of which he had charge than any other; and when this happened, he reckoned it a passing great favour to himself nor ever stirred from her stirrup, accounting himself happy what time he might but touch her clothes.
uz: Lekin, u hech qachon uning marhamatiga erishishga umid qilmagan bo'lsa-da, lekin o'z fikrlarini shunday yuksak joyda taqdim etganidan ichki maqtanib yurardi va barcha o'z sheriklaridan tashqari, malikaga yoqimli deb hisoblagan har qanday ishni qilishni o'rganardi; shu sababli, u chet elga chiqish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganda, u boshqalardan ko'ra uning mas'uliyatiga ega bo'lgan palfreyga minib yotardi; va bu sodir bo'lganda, u buni o'ziga o'zi uchun katta marhamat deb hisoblardi va hech qachon uning xursand bo'lishidan qo'zg'almasdi, o'zi uchun qachon uning kiyimlariga tegmasligi mumkinligini hisoblardi.

en: But, as often enough we see it happen that, even as hope groweth less, so love waxeth greater, so did it betide this poor groom, insomuch that sore uneath it was to him to avail to brook his great desire, keeping it, as he did, hidden and being upheld by no hope; and many a time, unable to rid himself of that his love, he determined in himself to die.
uz: Lekin, qanchalik ko'p ko'rsak, umid kamroq o'ssa, sevgi ham kuchaysa, bu bechora kuyovga shunday zarar yetkazardi, shunchalik ko'ngli og'ridi, u o'zining katta istakini yo'qotishga yordam berardi, uni yashirgan va hech qanday umid bilan qo'llab-quvvatlamagan holda saqlardi; va ko'p vaqtlar o'sha muhabbatidan qutulolmay, o'zida o'lishga qaror qilardi.

en: And considering inwardly of the manner, he resolved to seek his death on such wise that it should be manifest he died for the love he bore the queen, to which end he bethought himself to try his fortune in an enterprise of such a sort as should afford him a chance of having or all or part of his desire.
uz: Va o'zini shunday o'ldirishni o'ylab ko'rgach, shunday yo'l bilan o'limini izlashga qaror qildi, shunda malikaga bo'lgan muhabbati uchun o'lganligi aniq bo'lishi kerak edi. Shu maqsadda u o'ziga xohishining bir qismi yoki butun qismiga ega bo'lish imkoniyatini beradigan bir korxonada o'z omadini sinab ko'rishni o'yladi.

en: He set not himself to seek to say aught to the queen nor to make her sensible of his love by letters, know- ing he should speak and write in vain, but chose rather to essay an he might by practice avail to lie with her; nor was there any other shift for it but to ﬁnd a means how he might, in the person of the king, who, he knew, lay not with her continually, contrive to make his way to her and enter her bed- chamber.
uz: U o'zini malikaga hech narsa demaslikka yoki uning muhabbatini xatlar orqali tushunishga undamaslikka qaror qilmadi, chunki u behuda gapirishi va yozishi kerak edi, balki u bilan birga yotish uchun amaliy yordam ko'rishni tanladi; shuningdek, uning uchun boshqa hech qanday yo'l yo'q edi, faqatgina uning shaxsiyatida, u biladi, u doimiy ravishda u bilan yotmaydi, unga yo'l topish va uning yotoqxonasiga kirishga urinishi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, that he might see on what wise and in what habit the king went, whenas he visited her, he hid himself several times by night in a great saloon of the palace, which lay between the king’s bedchamber and that of the queen, and one night, amongst others, he saw the king come forth of his chamber, wrapped in a great mantle, with a lighted taper in one hand and a little wand in the other, and making for the queen’s chamber, strike once or twice upon the door with the wand, without saying aught, whereupon it was incontinent opened to him and the taper taken from his hand.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, shoh unga tashrif buyurganida, qanday donolik va odat bilan yurganini ko'rish uchun, u tun bo'yi bir necha marta saroyning katta mehmonxonasida yashiringan, u shohning yotoqxonasi va malika yotoqxonasi o'rtasida joylashgan edi. Bir kecha, boshqalardan tashqari, u shohning o'z xonasidan chiqib kelganini ko'rdi, katta manti bilan o'ralgan, bir qo'lida yoritilgan tikan va ikkinchi qo'lida kichik tayoq bor edi. U esa, hech narsa demasdan, qirolicha xonasiga bir-ikki marta tayoq bilan eshikni urdi, shundan so'ng u unga ochiq edi va tayoq uning qo'lidan olib ketildi.

en: Noting this and having seen the king return after the same fashion, he bethought himself to do likewise.
uz: Buni payqab, podshohning xuddi shu uslubda qaytganini ko'rib, u ham xuddi shunday qilishni o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, ﬁnding means to have a cloak like that which he had seen the king wear, together with a taper and a wand, and having ﬁrst well washed himself in a bagnio, lest haply the smell of the muck should offend the queen or cause her smoke the cheat, he hid himself in the great saloon, as of wont.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, topish degani, qirol kiygan ko'ylakni, to'r va tayoq bilan birga olib, avval xaltada yaxshilab yuvib, axlatning hidi malikaga xafa bo'lmasligi yoki uning aldovga sabab bo'lmasligi uchun, u odatdagidek katta salonga yashirindi.

en: Whenas he knew that all were asleep and it seemed to him time either to give effect to his desire or to
uz: Qachonki u hamma uxlayotganini bilganida va unga xohishiga erishish yoki

en: make his way by high emprise159 to the wished-for death, he struck a light with a ﬂint and steel he had brought with him and kindling the taper, wrapped himself fast in the mantle, then, going up to the chamber-door, smote twice upon it with the wand.
uz: Yuqori emprise159 orqali o'lim istagi tomon yo'l oldi, o'zi bilan olib kelgan tosh va po'lat bilan chiroqni urdi va o'tni yoqdi, o'zini mantiqqa mahkam o'rab oldi, so'ngra xona eshigiga chiqib, unga tayoq bilan ikki marta urdi.

en: The door was opened by a bedchamber- woman, all sleepy-eyed, who took the light and covered it; whereupon, without saying aught, he passed within the curtain, put off his mantle and entered the bed where the queen slept.
uz: Eshikni bir yotoqxona ayol ochdi  uyqusiragan kozlar bilan, u chiroqni olib, uni yopdi; shundan song, hech narsa demasdan, parda ichidan otib, koylakni yechdi va malika uxlagan karavotga kirdi.

en: Then, taking her desirefully in his arms and feigning himself troubled (for that he knew the king’s wont to be that, whenas he was troubled, he cared not to hear aught), without speaking or being spoken to, he several times carnally knew the queen; after which, grievous as it seemed to him to depart, yet, fearing lest his too long stay should be the occasion of turning the gotten delight into dolour, he arose and taking up the mantle and the light, withdrew, without word said, and returned, as quickliest he might, to his own bed.
uz: Keyin, uni istak bilan quchog'iga olib, o'zini bezovta qilib ko'rsatdi (chunki u podshohning odatlari shunday ekanligini bilardi, chunki u bezovta bo'lganida hech narsa eshitmasdi), hech narsa demasdan yoki gapirilmasdan, u bir necha marta malika bilan jasorat bilan tanishardi; keyin, u ketayotgandek qayg'urardi, ammo, uning uzoq qolishi olingan lazzatni bo'rttirishga sabab bo'lmasligi mumkinligidan qo'rqib, u o'rnidan turdi va mantiyani va yorug'likni olib, hech narsa demasdan orqaga qaytdi va imkon qadar tezroq o'z karavotiga qaytdi.

en: He could scarce yet have been therein when the king arose and repaired to the queen’s chamber, whereat she marvelled exceedingly; and as he entered the bed and greeted her blithely, she took courage by his cheerfulness and said, ‘O my lord, what new fashion is this of tonight?
uz: U podshoh o'rnidan turib, qirolichaning xonasiga qaytganida, u juda hayratda edi; va u karavotga kirib, uni xushmuomalalik bilan kutib olganida, u uning quvnoqligidan jasorat topdi va dedi: "Ey xo'jayinim, bu kechagi yangi moda nima?"

en: You left me but now, after having taken pleasure of me beyond your wont, and do you return so soon?
uz: Siz meni tashlab ketdingiz, lekin endi, odatdagidan ko'ra mendan zavqlanib, shunchalik tez qaytasizmi?

en: Have a care what you do.’ The king, hearing these words, at once concluded that the queen had been deceived by likeness of manners and person, but, like a wise man, bethought himself forthright, seeing that neither she nor any else had perceived the cheat, not to make her aware thereof; which many sim- pletons would not have done, but would have said, ‘I have not been here, I.
uz: "Nima qilayotganingizga e'tibor bering." Bu so'zlarni eshitgan shoh, darhol malika odob va shaxsga o'xshashlik bilan aldangan degan xulosaga keldi, lekin dono odam kabi o'zini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rib, na u, na boshqa hech kim firibgarlikni sezmaganini ko'rib, uni bu haqda xabardor qilmagan edi; bu ko'pgina o'yinchilar qilmagan bo'lardi, lekin aytgan bo'lardi: "Men bu yerda bo'lmaganman, men..."

en: Who is it hath been here?
uz: Bu yerda kim bo'lgan?

en: Who came hither?’ Whence many things might have arisen, whereby he would needlessly have afﬂicted the lady and given her ground for desiring another time that which she had already tasted; more by token that, an he kept silence of the matter, no shame might revert to him, whereas, by speaking, he would have brought dishonour upon himself.
uz: Bu yerga kim keldi? Qanday ko'p narsalar paydo bo'lishi mumkin edi, shu sababli u xonimni ortiqcha azoblagan bo'lardi va u allaqachon tatib ko'rgan narsani boshqa bir marta xohlaganligi uchun unga joy bergan bo'lardi; ayniqsa, agar u bu masalada sukut saqlaganida, uyatga qaytmas edi, lekin gapirib, o'ziga sharmandalik keltirardi.

en: The king, then, more troubled at heart than in looks or speech, answered, saying, ‘Wife, seem I not to you man enough to have been here a ﬁrst time and to come yet again after that?’ ‘Ay, my lord,’ answered she.
uz: Shunda shoh ko'rinish yoki nutqidan ko'ra ko'proq xavotirda javob berib dedi: "Xotin, men sizga birinchi marta bu yerga kelgan va keyin yana kelishga arzimaydigan odamdek tuyulyapmanmi?" "Ha, xo'jayinim," dedi u.

en: ‘Nevertheless, I beseech you have regard to your health.’ Quoth Agilulf, ‘And it pleaseth me to follow your counsel, wherefore for the nonce I will get me gone again, without giving you more annoy.’ This said, taking up his mantle, he departed the chamber, with a heart full of wrath and despite for the affront that he saw had been done him, and be-
uz: Shunga qaramay, sizdan sog'lig'ingizga e'tibor berishni so'rayman." Agilulf aytdi: "Va men sizning maslahatingizga amal qilishdan mamnunman, shuning uchun men sizni yanada bezovta qilmasdan, yana ketaman." Bu so'zlarni aytib, u g'azabga to'la yurak va ko'rgan haqoratga qaramay, xonadan ketdi va...

en: thought himself quietly to seek to discover the culprit, concluding that he must be of the household and could not, whoever he might be, have issued forth of the palace.
uz: O'zini xotirjam o'ylab, aybdorni topishga intildi, u uydagilardan bo'lishi kerak va kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, saroydan chiqa olmasligini xulosaladi.

en: Accordingly, taking a very small light in a little lantern, he betook himself to a very long gallery that was over the stables of his palace and where all his household slept in different beds, and judging that, whoever he might be that had done what the queen said, his pulse and the beating of his heart for the swink endured could not yet have had time to abate, he silently, beginning at one end of the gallery, fell to feeling each one’s breast, to know if his heart beat high.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, kichkina chiroq ichidagi juda kichik chiroqni olib, u o'z saroyining podvallari ustida joylashgan va butun xonadoni turli xil karavotlarda uxlaydigan juda uzun galereyaga yo'l oldi va kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, malika aytganini qilgan bo'lsa ham, uning urishi va yuragi cho'kishi uchun hali sekinlashishga ulgurmas edi, deb hisoblab, u galereyaning bir chetidan boshlab, har birining ko'kragini his qilib, yuragining baland urishini bilish uchun yiqildi.

en: Although every other slept fast, he who had been with the queen was not yet asleep, but, seeing the king come and guessing what he went seeking, fell into such a fright that to the beating of the heart caused by the late-had fatigue, fear added yet a greater and he doubted not but the king, if he became aware of this, would put him to death without delay, and many things passed through his thought that he should do.
uz: Garchi har biri tez uxlagan bo'lsa ham, malika bilan birga bo'lgan odam hali uxlamagan edi, lekin shoh kelib, nima qidirayotganini taxmin qilganini ko'rib, shunday qo'rquvga tushdiki, kechki charchoq tufayli yurak urishiga qo'rquv yanada kuchaytirdi va u shubhalanmadi, agar shoh buni anglasa, uni zudlik bilan o'ldirib qo'yardi va ko'p narsalar uning o'yidan o'tib ketdi.

en: However, seeing him all unarmed, he resolved to feign sleep and await what he should do.
uz: Ammo, uni qurolsiz ko'rib, u o'zini uyquga solib, nima qilish kerakligini kutishga qaror qildi.

en: Agilulf, then, having examined many and found none whom he judged to be he of whom he was in quest, came presently to the horsekeeper and feeling his heart beat high, said in himself, ‘This is the man.’ Nevertheless, an he would have nought be known of that which he purposed to do, he did nought to him but poll, with a pair of scissors he had brought with him, somewhat on one side of his hair, which they then wore very long, so by that token he might know him again on the morrow; and this done, he withdrew and returned to his own chamber.
uz: Agilulf esa ko'pchilikni tekshirib, o'zi qidirayotgan odam deb hisoblagan hech kimni topmadi. Shundan so'ng, otsoz huzuriga keldi va yuragi baland bo'lib, o'ziga dedi: "Bu odam shu." Shunga qaramay, u nima qilmoqchi ekanligi haqida hech narsa bilmas edi, faqat so'ramadi, o'zi bilan olib kelgan bir juft qaychi bilan, ular keyin juda uzun kiyardi, shuning uchun u ertaga uni yana tanishi mumkin edi; va bu bilan u o'z xonasiga qaytib ketdi.

en: The culprit, who had felt all this, like a shrewd fellow as he was, understood plainly enough why he had been thus marked; wherefore he arose without delay and ﬁnd- ing a pair of shears, whereof it chanced there were several about the stables for the service of the horses, went softly up to all who lay in the gallery and clipped each one’s hair on like wise over the ear; which having done without being observed, he returned to sleep.
uz: Aybdor, bularning hammasini o'zi kabi aqlli odamdek his qilgan holda, nega bunday belgilanganini yetarlicha aniq tushunardi; shuning uchun u zudlik bilan turib, bir juft qirindi topdi, ulardan bir nechtasi otlarga xizmat ko'rsatish uchun bo'lardi, galereyada yotganlarning barchasiga sekin bordi va har birining sochlarini dono kabi qulog'iga kesdi; buni kuzatilmasdan qilganidan so'ng, uyquga qaytdi.

en: When the king arose in the morning, he commanded that all his household should present themselves before him, or ever the palace-doors were opened; and it was done as he said.
uz: Shoh ertalab turganda, butun xonadoni uning oldiga kelishini buyurdi, agar saroy eshiklari ochilsa, shunday bo'ldi.

en: Then, as they all stood before him with uncovered heads, he began to look that he might know him whom he had polled; but, seeing the most part of them with their hair clipped after one and the same fashion, he marvelled and said in himself, ‘He whom I seek, for all he may be of mean estate, showeth right well he is of no mean wit.’ Then, seeing that he could not, without making a stir, avail to have him whom he sought, and having no
uz: Keyin, ularning hammasi uning oldida boshlarini ochib turganlarida, u kimni so'roq qilganini bilishga harakat qila boshladi; lekin ularning ko'pchiligini sochlari bir-biridan kesilgan holda ko'rib, hayratda qoldi va o'zida dedi: "Men kimni qidiryapman, baribir u oddiy odam bo'lsa ham, u yaxshi ko'rsatadi, u oddiy odam emas".

en: mind to incur a great shame for the sake of a paltry revenge, it pleased him with one sole word to admonish the culprit and show him that he was ware of the matter; wherefore, turning to all who were present, he said, ‘Let him who did it do it no more and get you gone in peace.’ Another would have been for giving them the strappado, for torturing, examining and question- ing, and doing this, would have published that which everyone should go about to conceal; and having thus discovered himself, though he should have taken entire revenge for the affront suffered, his shame had not been minished, nay, were rather much enhanced therefor and his lady’s honour sullied.
uz: Kichik qasos uchun katta sharmandalikka duchor bo'lish uni birgina so'z bilan aybdorni tanbeh berishga va bu masalada g'amxo'rlik qilayotganini ko'rsatishga undadi; shuning uchun, u yerda bo'lganlarning hammasiga murojaat qilib, dedi: "Buni qilgan odam endi qilmasin va tinch qo'ysin." Boshqa biri ularga strappado berish, qiynoq solish, tekshirish va so'roq qilish uchun bo'lardi va buni qilish orqali, hamma yashirish kerak bo'lgan narsani e'lon qilgan bo'lardi; va shu tariqa o'zini anglab yetdi, garchi u azob chekkan uchun butunlay qasos olishi kerak bo'lsa ham, uning sharmandaligi kamsitilmagan, balki u yerda uning xonimning sha'ni ko'paytirilgan edi.

en: Those who heard the king’s words marvelled and long debated amongst themselves what he meant by this speech; but none understood it, save he whom it concerned, and he, like a wise man, never, during Agilulf’s lifetime, discovered the matter nor ever again committed his life to the haz- ard of such a venture.”
uz: Shohning so'zlarini eshitganlar hayratda qoldilar va bu nutq bilan nima demoqchi ekanligi haqida o'zaro uzoq bahslashdilar; lekin uni faqatgina u bilan bog'liq bo'lgan odam tushundi va u, dono odam kabi, hech qachon, Agilulfning hayoti davomida bu masalani aniqlamadi va hech qachon o'z hayotini bunday urinishning xavfiga qo'ymadi.

en: THE THIRD STORY Under colour of confession and of exceeding niceness of conscience, a lady, being enamoured of a young man, bringeth a grave friar, without his misdoubting him thereof, to afford a means of giving entire effect to her pleasure.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA E'tirof rangi va vijdonning haddan tashqari mehribonligi ostida, bir xonim, bir yigitga oshiq bo'lib, uni shubhalanmasdan, o'z zavqiga to'liq ta'sir ko'rsatish vositasini taqdim etish uchun qabrli rohibni olib keladi.

en: Pampinea being now silent and the daring and subtlety of the horsekeeper having been extolled by several of the company, as also the king’s good sense, the queen, turning to Filomena, charged her follow on; whereupon she blithely began to speak thus, “I purpose to recount to you a cheat which was in very deed put by a fair lady upon a grave friar and which should be so much the more pleasing to every layman as these [ —friars, to wit —], al- beit for the most part very dull fools and men of strange manners and usances, hold themselves to be in everything both better worth and wiser than others, whereas they are of far less account than the rest of mankind, being men who, lacking, of the meanness of their spirit, the ability to provide themselves, take refuge, like swine, whereas they may have what to eat.
uz: Pampiyena endi jim bo'lib, otsozning jasorati va nozikligi bir nechta kompaniya tomonidan maqtangan edi, shuningdek, qirolning oq aqli ham, malika Filomenaga murojaat qilib, unga ergashishni buyurdi; shundan so'ng u shiddat bilan shunday dedi: "Men sizga bir firibgar tomonidan mo'rt bir friarga qo'yilgan firibgarlik haqida hikoya qilmoqchiman va bu har bir oddiy odamga shunchalik yoqishi kerak edi, chunki bular, ko'p hollarda juda bema'ni ahmoqlar va g'alati xulq-atvorli odamlar va biz kabi, o'zlarini hamma narsada boshqalardan yaxshiroq va donoroq deb bilishadi, chunki ular butun insoniyatdan ancha kamroq hisoblashadi, chunki ular o'zlarining yovuzligi, ruhini ta'minlash qobiliyatiga ega bo'lgan, o'zlarini qanday

en: And this story, charming ladies, I shall tell you, not only for the ensuing of the order imposed, but to give you to know withal that even the clergy, to whom we women, beyond measure credulous as we are, yield overmuch faith, can be and are whiles adroitly befooled, and that not by men only, but even by certain of our own sex.
uz: Va bu hikoyani, go'zal xonimlar, sizlarga nafaqat buyrug'ning amalga oshishi uchun aytaman, balki shuni ma'lum qilish uchun aytamanki, hatto ruhoniylar ham, biz ayollar, biz qadar ishonchli bo'lsak ham, juda ko'p imon keltirishlari mumkin va ular mohirona yo'naltirilishi mumkin, va bu faqat erkaklar tomonidan emas, balki hatto o'z jinsimizdagi ba'zilar tomonidan ham.

en: In our city, the which is fuller of cozenage than of love or faith, there was, not many years agone, a gentlewoman adorned with beauty and charms and as richly endowed by nature as any of her sex with engaging manners and loftiness of spirit and subtle wit, whose name albeit I know, I purpose not to discover it, no, nor any other that pertaineth unto the present story, for that there be folk yet alive who would take it in despite, whereas it
uz: Bizning shaharimizda, sevgi yoki imondan ko'ra ko'proq gullik bilan to'la shaharda, ko'p yillar o'tmay, go'zallik va joziba bilan bezatilgan, tabiatda o'z jinsining har qanday a'zosi kabi jozibali xulq-atvorlar, nafis ruh va nozik aql-idrok bilan boy ayol bor edi. Men uning nomini bilsam ham, uni topishni maqsad qilmayman, yo'q, va hozirgi hikoyaga tegishli boshqa hech qanday, chunki uni qabul qiladigan tirik odamlar bor edi, garchi u...

en: should be passed over with a laugh.
uz: kulgi bilan o'tkazib yuborilishi kerak.

en: This lady, then, seeing herself, though of high lineage, married to a wool-monger and unable, for that he was a craftsman, to put off the haughtiness of her spirit, whereby she deemed no man of mean condition, how rich soever he might be, worthy of a gentlewo- man and seeing him moreover, for all his wealth, to be apt unto nothing of more moment than to lay a warp for a piece of motley or let weave a cloth or chaffer with a spinster anent her yarn, resolved on no wise to admit of his embraces, save in so far as she might not deny him, but to seek, for her own satisfaction, to ﬁnd someone who should be worthier of her favours than the wool-monger appeared to her to be, and accordingly fell so fervently in love with a man of very good quality and middle age, that, whenas she saw him not by day, she could not pass the ensuing night without unease.
uz: Shunda bu xonim o'zini yuqori naslga ega bo'lishiga qaramay, jun sotuvchisiga turmushga chiqqanini ko'rib, u hunarmand edi va uning ruhining kibrini yo'qotishga qodir emas edi. Shuning uchun u hech kimni yomon ahvolga ega emas deb hisoblardi. U qanchalik boy bo'lmasin, mehribon odamga loyiq bo'lardi va uni butun boyligi bilan ko'rsa ham, bir bo'lak jun uchun to'shak yotqizish yoki o'zining ipidan bir mato yoki cho'tka to'qishdan boshqa hech narsaga qodir emas edi. U uning quchoqlarini tan olmaslikka, balki o'z mamnuniyatiga ko'ra, unga yarim yoshda bo'lganidan ko'ra afzalroq bo'lgan odamni topishga qaror qildi va uni juda qattiq sevib, o'rtasi bilan ko'rmadi.

en: The gentle- man, perceiving not how the case stood, took no heed of her, and she, being very circumspect, dared not make the matter known to him by sending of women nor by letter, fearing the possible perils that might betide.
uz: Yumshoq odam, ish qanday holatda ekanligini anglamagan holda, unga e'tibor bermadi, va u juda ehtiyotkor bo'lib, bu masalani unga ayollarni yuborish orqali ham, xat orqali ham bildirishga jur'at etmadi, chunki u xavfli bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: However, observing that he companied much with a churchman, who, albeit a dull lump of a fellow, was nevertheless, for that he was a man of very devout life, reputed of well nigh all a most worthy friar, she bethought herself that this latter would make an excellent go-between herself and her lover and having considered what means she should use, she repaired, at a ﬁtting sea- son, to the church where he abode, and letting call him to her, told him that, an he pleased, she would fain confess herself to him.
uz: Ammo, u cherkovdosh bilan ko'p hamroh bo'lganini kuzatgach, u, garchi zerikarli odam bo'lsa ham, baribir, juda taqvodor inson edi, u deyarli eng munosib rohib deb hisoblanardi. U o'zini bu sohib o'zi va sevgilisi o'rtasida ajoyib yo'l ochadi deb o'yladi va qanday vositalardan foydalanishi kerakligini o'ylab, u o'zi yashaydigan cherkovga mos dengiz o'g'lini ta'mirladi va uni chaqirib, unga u rozi bo'lsa, o'zini tan olishini aytdi.

en: The friar seeing her and judging her to be a woman of condition, willingly gave ear to her, and she, after confession, said to him, ‘Father mine, it behoveth me have re- course to you for aid and counsel anent that which you shall hear.
uz: Rohib uni ko'rib, uni ahvoli yaxshi ayol deb hisoblab, unga ixtiyoriy ravishda quloq soldi va u, e'tirof etganidan so'ng, unga dedi: "Otam, senga yordam va maslahat berishim kerak, eshitadigan narsang haqida."

en: I know, as having myself told you, that you know my kinsfolk and my husband, who loveth me more than his life, nor is there aught I desire but I have it of him incontinent, he being a very rich man and one who can well afford it; wherefore I love him more than mine own self and should I but think, let alone do, aught that might be contrary to his honour and pleasure, there were no woman more wicked or more deserving of the ﬁre than I.
uz: Men sizga o'zim aytganimdek, siz mening qarindoshlarimni va erimni bilasiz, u meni o'z hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq sevadi, va men undan hech narsa xohlamayman, lekin u menga yetarli emas, u juda boy odam va bunga qodir; shuning uchun men uni o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevaman va men uning sharafiga va rohatlanishiga zid bo'lgan narsani qilmasam ham, men kabi yovuz yoki olovga loyiq ayol yo'q edi.

en: Now one, whose name in truth I know not, but who is, meseemeth, a man of condi- tion, and is, if I mistake not, much in your company —a well-favoured man and tall of his person and clad in very decent sad-coloured raiment —un- aware belike of the constancy of my purpose, appeareth to have laid siege to me, nor can I show myself at door or window nor go without the house, but he incontinent presenteth himself before me, and I marvel that he is not
uz: Endi bir odam bor, uning ismini rostini bilmayman, lekin u, menimcha, shunga o'xshash odam, va agar adashmasam, sizning oldingizda ko'p bor  o'ziga xos bo'yli va juda yaxshi tushkun rangli libos kiygan  maqsadimning doimiyligini anglamagan, menga qamal qilib qo'ygan ko'rinadi, na eshikda, na deraza, na uydan tashqariga chiqa olmayman, lekin u beqaror ravishda o'zini oldimga taqdim etadi va men hayronmanki, u

en: here now; whereat I am sore concerned, for that such fashions as these often bring virtuous women into reproach, without their fault.
uz: Hozir shu yerda; chunki meni juda xavotirga solaman, chunki bu kabi modalar ko'pincha fazilatli ayollarni aybsiz ayblashga olib keladi.

en: I have whiles had it in mind to have him told of this by my brothers; but then I have bethought me that men oftentimes do messages on such wise that ill answers ensue, which give rise to words and from words they come to deeds; wherefore, lest mischief spring therefrom and scandal, I have kept silence of the matter and have determined to discover it to yourself rather than to another, at once because meseemeth you are his friend and for that it beseemeth you to re- buke not only friends, but strangers, of such things.
uz: Men uni bu haqda akalarim tomonidan aytishni o'ylab yurganman; lekin keyin o'yladimki, odamlar ko'pincha shunday donolik haqida xabar berishadi, yomon javoblar kelib chiqadi, bu so'zlarga sabab bo'ladi va so'zlardan amallarga olib keladi; shuning uchun, undan yomonlik kelib chiqmasligi va janjal chiqmasligi uchun, men bu masalani o'zimga emas, balki boshqaga aniqlashga qaror qildim, chunki u sizni do'sti deb biladi va bu sizni nafaqat do'stlar, balki begonalarni ham bu kabi narsalar haqida qayta ogohlantirishga undaydi.

en: I beseech you, there- fore, for the one God’s sake, that you rebuke him of this and pray him leave these his fashions.
uz: Sizdan iltimos qilaman, shuning uchun, yagona Xudo uchun, uni bundan tanbeh bering va bu modalaridan voz kechishini so'rang.

en: There be women enough, who incline belike to these toys and would take pleasure in being dogged and courted by him, whereas to me, who have no manner of mind to such matters, it is a very grievous annoy.’ So saying, she bowed her head as she would weep.
uz: Bu o'yinchoqlarga moyil bo'lgan va undan ta'qib va erkalashdan zavqlanadigan ayollar yetarli, lekin men uchun bunday masalalarga munosabatda bo'lish juda achinarli narsa." Shunday deb, u boshini egdi, xuddi yig'lagandek.

en: The holy friar understood incontinent of whom she spoke and ﬁrmly believing what she said to be true, greatly commended her righteous intent and promised her to do on such wise that she should have no farther annoy from the person in question; and knowing her to be very rich, he commended to her works of charity and almsdeeds, recounting to her his own need.
uz: Muqaddas rohib uning kim haqida gapirganini tushunmas edi va uning aytganlarining haqiqat ekanligiga qat'iy ishonardi, uning adolatli niyatini juda maqtadi va so'ralgan odamdan boshqa xafa bo'lmasligi uchun shunday donolik bilan ish tutishga va'da berdi; va uning juda boy ekanligini bilgan holda, u uning xayriya va sadaqa ishlariga ishonardi, o'z ehtiyojlarini aytib berardi.

en: Quoth the lady, ‘I beseech you thereof for God’s sake, and should he deny, prithee scruple not to tell him that it was I who told you this and complained to you thereof.’ Then, having made her confession and gotten her penance, recalling the fri- ar’s exhortations to works of almsgiving, she stealthily ﬁlled his hand with money, praying him to say masses for the souls of her dead kinsfolk; after which she rose from his feet and taking leave of him, returned home.
uz: Xonim aytdi: Sizdan iltimos qilaman, Xudo haqqi uchun, va agar u inkor etsa, unda unga men bu gapni sizga aytib, sizga shikoyat qilganimni aytmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling. Keyin, uning iqrorligini tan olib, tavbasini olgach, sadaqa ishlariga undashni eslab, u uning qo'lini pul bilan to'ldirib, o'lik qarindoshlari jonlari uchun ko'p so'rashni iltimos qildi; shundan so'ng u oyoqlaridan turdi va undan ketdi va uyga qaytdi.

en: Not long after up came the gentleman, according to his wont, and after they had talked awhile of one thing and another, the friar, drawing his friend aside, very civilly rebuked him of the manner in which, as he believed, he pursued and spied upon the lady aforesaid, according to that which she had given him to understand.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay janob o'z odatiga ko'ra keldi va ular biroz bir-ikki narsa haqida gaplashganlaridan so'ng, rohib do'stini chetga tortib, uni o'zi ishonganidek, yuqorida ayolni ta'qib qilib, tushunishga berganidek, josuslik qilganligi uchun juda odob bilan tanbeh berdi.

en: The other marvelled, as well he might, having never set eyes upon her and being used very rarely to pass before her house, and would have excused himself; but the friar suffered him not to speak, saying, ‘Now make no show of wonderment nor waste words in denying it, for it will avail thee nothing; I learnt not these matters from the neighbours; nay, she herself told them to me, complaining sore of thee.
uz: Boshqasi hayron bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki u unga hech qachon ko'z tikmagan va uyning oldida juda kam o'tishga odatlangan edi, va o'zini oqlagan bo'lardi; lekin rohib unga gapirishga ruxsat bermadi, dedi: "Endi hech qanday hayratga tushma yoki uni inkor etishda behuda gapirma, chunki bu senga hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi; men bu narsalarni qo'shnilardan o'rganmadim; yo'q, u o'zi menga aytdi, sendan shikoyat qilib."

en: And besides that such toys beseem not a man of thine age, I may tell thee this much of her, that if ever I saw a woman averse to these follies, it is she; wherefore, for thine
uz: Va bundan tashqari, bunday o'yinchoqlar sening yoshingdagi odamga tegishli emas, men senga u haqida ko'p narsa ayta olaman, agar men ayol bu ahmoqliklarga nafratlanayotganini ko'rsam, u aynan u; shuning uchun, sening uchun

en: own credit and her comfort, I prithee desist therefrom and let her be in peace.’ The gentleman, quicker of wit than the friar, was not slow to appre- hend the lady’s device and feigning to be somewhat abashed, promised to meddle no more with her thenceforward; then, taking leave of the friar, he betook himself to the house of the lady, who still abode await at a little win- dow, so she might see him, should he pass that way.
uz: O'z sharafini va uning rohatini, men undan voz kechaman va uni tinch qo'yaman." Janob, rohibdan ko'ra aqlliroq, xonimning qurilmasini tushunishga va biroz uyatchilikka o'xshatib, bundan keyin unga boshqa aralashmaslikka va'da berdi; so'ngra rohibdan xayr olib, u xonimning uyiga yo'l oldi, u hali ham ozgina vaqt kutmoqda, agar u shu yo'ldan o'tsa, uni ko'rishi mumkin edi.

en: When she saw him come, she showed herself so rejoiced and so gracious to him, that he might very well understand that he had gathered the truth from the friar’s words, and thenceforward, under colour of other business, he began with the ut- most precaution to pass continually through the street, to his own pleasure and to the exceeding delight and solace of the lady.
uz: U uni kelganini ko'rgach, u shunchalik xursand va unga shunchalik mehribon bo'lib ko'rindi, u rohibning so'zlaridan haqiqatni topganini juda yaxshi tushunishi mumkin edi va bundan keyin, boshqa ishlarning ko'rinishi ostida, u eng ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'chadan doimiy ravishda o'tishni boshladi, o'z zavqiga va xonimning haddan tashqari zavqiga va tasalli olishga.
