en: After awhile, perceiving that she pleased him even as he pleased her and wishful to inﬂame him yet more and to certify him of the love she bore him, she betook herself again, choosing her time and place, to the holy friar and seating herself at his feet in the church, fell a-weeping.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, uning unga yoqqanidek, unga ham yoqishini anglab yetgach va uni yanada ko'proq jahlini chiqarishni va unga bo'lgan muhabbatini tasdiqlashni istagan holda, u yana o'zini tashladi, o'z vaqti va joyini tanladi, muqaddas rohibga yaqinlashdi va cherkovda uning oyoqlari ostida o'tirdi, yig'lab yubordi.

en: The friar, seeing this, asked her affectionately what was to do with her anew.
uz: Rohib buni ko'rib, undan yana nima qilish kerakligini mehr bilan so'radi.

en: ‘Alack, father mine,’ answered she, ‘that which aileth me is none other than yonder God-accursed friend of yours, of whom I complained to you the other day, for that methinketh he was born for my especial torment and to make me do a thing, such that I should never be glad again nor ever after dare to seat myself at your feet.’ ‘How?’ cried the friar.
uz: Alack, otam,  javob berdi u,  meni tashvishga soladigan narsa faqat o'sha Xudo la'natlagan do'stingizdir, undan sizga bir kun oldin shikoyat qilgan edim, chunki u mening maxsus azobim uchun tug'ilgan va meni shunday bir ish qilishga majbur qilganki, keyin hech qachon xursand bo'lmayman va hech qachon o'z oyoqlaringizga o'tirishga jur'at eta olmayman. Qanday qilib?  deb baqirdi rohib.

en: ‘Hath he not given over annoying thee?’ ‘No, indeed,’ answered she; ‘nay, since I complained to you of him, as if of despite, maybe taking it ill that I should have done so, for every once he used to pass before my house, I verily believe he hath passed seven times.
uz: U seni bezovta qilishdan to'xtatmadimi? Yo'q, rostini aytsam, javob berdi u; yo'q, chunki men u haqida senga shikoyat qilgan edim, go'yo xafagarchilik, balki buni yomon ko'rib qilgan bo'lardim, chunki u mening uyim oldida har safar o'tganida, men uning yetti marta o'tganligiga ishonaman.

en: And would to God he were content with passing and spying upon me!
uz: Va Xudo xohlasa edi, u meni o'tib, kuzatib yurganida kifoyalanardi!

en: Nay, he is grown so bold and so malapert that but yesterday he despatched a woman to me at home with his idle tales and toys and sent me a purse and a girdle, as if I had not purses and girdles galore; the which I took and take so ill that I believe, but for my having regard to the sin of it and after for the love of you, I had played the devil.
uz: Yo'q, u shunchalik jasur va befarosat bo'lib ketganki, lekin kecha u menga uyga bir ayolni bekorchi hikoyalari va o'yinchoqlari bilan jo'natdi va menga hamyon va kamar yubordi, go'yo menda hamyon va belbog'lar yo'qdek; uni shunday yomon qabul qildim va qabul qildimki, ishonaman, lekin uning gunohini hisobga olganim uchun va keyin seni sevganim uchun, men iblisni o'ynagan edim.

en: However, I contained myself and would not do or say aught whereof I should not ﬁrst have let you know.
uz: Lekin, men o'zimni ushlab turdim va avval sizga xabar bermasligim kerak bo'lgan hech narsa qilmasdim yoki aytmasdim.

en: Nay, I had already re- turned the purse and the girdle to the baggage who brought them, that she might carry them back to him, and had given her a rough dismissal, but after, fearing she might keep them for herself and tell him that I had accep- ted them, as I hear women of her fashion do whiles, I called her back and took them, full of despite, from her hands and have brought them to you, so you may return them to him and tell him I want none of his trash, for that,
uz: Yo'q, men hamyonni va kamarni ularni olib kelgan sumkaga qaytarib qo'ygandim, ularni o'ziga qaytarib olib kelishi uchun, qo'pol ravishda ishdan bo'shatdim, lekin keyin, ularni o'zi uchun saqlab qolishidan va unga ularni qabul qilganimni aytishdan qo'rqib, o'ziga xos ayollarning g'alati ishlarini eshitganimda, uni qaytarib chaqirdim va ularni qo'lidan to'la g'azab bilan olib, sizga olib keldim, shunda ularni unga qaytarib olib kelishingiz mumkin va unga uning hech qanday axlatini xohlamasligimni aytdim, chunki

en: thanks to God and my husband, I have purses and girdles enough to smoth- er him withal.
uz: Xudoga va erimga shukr, uni bo'g'ish uchun yetarli sumka va kamarlarim bor.

en: Moreover, if hereafter he desist not from this, I tell you, as a father, you must excuse me, but I will tell it, come what may, to my hus- band and my brothers; for I had far liefer he should brook an affront, if needs he must, than that I should suffer blame for him; wherefore let him look to himself.’ So saying, still weeping sore, she pulled out from under her surcoat a very handsome and rich purse and a quaint and costly girdle and threw them into the lap of the friar, who, fully crediting that which she told him and incensed beyond measure, took them and said to her, ‘Daugh- ter, I marvel not that thou art provoked at these doings, nor can I blame thee therefor; but I much commend thee for following my counsel in the matter.
uz: Qolaversa, agar u bundan keyin ham to'xtamasin, senga ota sifatida aytaman, meni kechirishing kerak, lekin men buni aytarman, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, xotinimga va akalarimga; chunki agar kerak bo'lsa, u haqorat ko'rishni afzal ko'rdim, undan ko'ra, men uning uchun aybdor bo'lishim kerak edi; u o'ziga nazar solsin. Shunday qilib, hali ham achchiq yig'lab, u ko'ylagidan juda chiroyli va boy sumka va g'alati va qimmatbaho kamarni olib, ularni rohibning tizzasiga tashladi. U unga aytganlarini to'liq ishonib, haddan tashqari g'azablandi, ularni olib, unga dedi: "Qiz, men seni bu ishlarga qo'zg'atganing uchun hayron emasman, shuning uchun men senga ko'p ayb ayta olmayman; lekin men senga maslahat beraman."

en: I rebuked him the other day and he hath ill performed that which he prom- ised me; wherefore, as well for that as for this that he hath newly done, I mean to warm his ears160 for him after such a fashion that methinketh he will give thee no farther concern; but do thou, God’s benison on thee, suffer not thyself to be so overcome with anger that thou tell it to any of thy folk, for that overmuch harm might ensue thereof unto him.
uz: Men uni o'tgan kuni tanbeh berdim va u menga va'da bergan narsani noto'g'ri bajardi; shuning uchun, u yangi qilgan ishi uchun ham, men unga shunday tarzda quloqlarini isitmoqchimanki, u senga boshqa tashvish bermaydi deb o'ylayman; lekin sen, Xudo senga marhamat qilsin, o'zingni shunday g'azabga to'ldirib yuborma, buni hech kimga aytma, chunki undan unga juda ko'p zarar yetishi mumkin.

en: Neither fear thou lest this blame anywise ensue to thee, for I shall still, before both God and men, be a most constant witness to thy virtue.’ The lady made believe to be some- what comforted and leaving that talk, said, as one who knew his greed and that of his fellow-churchmen, ‘Sir, these some nights past there have ap- peared to me sundry of my kinsfolk, who ask nought but almsdeeds, and meseemeth they are indeed in exceeding great torment, especially my moth- er, who appeareth to me in such ill case and afﬂiction that it is pity to be- hold.
uz: "Xavotir olma, bu ayb senga hech qanday tarzda ta'sir qilmasin, chunki men hali ham Xudo va odamlar oldida sening fazilatingning eng doimiy guvohi bo'laman." Xonim o'zini nimadir deb ishontirdi va bu gapni tashlab, o'zining ochko'zligini va dindorlarining ishtiyoqini bilganidek dedi: "Janob, shu bir necha kechalar menga hech narsa so'ramaydigan turli qarindoshlarimdan ko'rindi, ular hech narsa emas, balki sadaqa so'rashadi va ular haqiqatan ham juda katta azob chekishmoqda, ayniqsa mening onam, u menga shunday yomon va azobda ko'rinadiki, uni ushlab turishga achinarli."

en: Methinketh she suffereth exceeding distress to see me in this tribula- tion with yonder enemy of God; wherefore I would have you say me forty masses of Saint Gregory for her and their souls, together with certain of your own prayers, so God may deliver them from that penitential ﬁre.’ So saying, she put a ﬂorin into his hand, which the holy father blithely received and conﬁrming her devoutness with fair words and store of pious instances, gave her his benison and let her go.
uz: Menimcha, u meni Xudoning dushmani bilan bu musibatda ko'rishdan juda azob chekadi; shuning uchun men sizdan o'z duolaringiz bilan birga u uchun va ularning jonlari uchun qirqta Avliyo Gregoriyning massasini aytishni so'rardim, toki Xudo ularni o'sha tavba olovidan qutqarsin. Shunday qilib, u uning qo'liga bir florini qo'ydi, uni muqaddas ota xushchaqchaqlik bilan qabul qildi va o'z taqvodorligini yaxshi so'zlar va taqvodorlik namunalari bilan tasdiqladi, unga o'z marhamatini berdi va uni qo'yib yubordi.

en: The lady being gone, the friar, never thinking how he was gulled, sent for his friend, who, coming and ﬁnding him troubled, at once divined that he was to have news of the lady and awaited what the friar should say.
uz: Xonim yo'q bo'lib ketganidan so'ng, rohib uning qanday qotib qolganini o'ylamasdan, do'stini chaqirib yubordi. Do'st kelib, uni tashvishda topgach, u darhol xonimdan xabar olishni va rohib nima deyishini kutishini bashorat qildi.

en: The latter repeated that which he had be- fore said to him and bespeaking him anew angrily and reproachfully, re- buked him severely of that which, according to the lady’s report, he had done.
uz: Oxirgisi unga oldindan aytgan gaplarini takrorladi va yana g'azab va malomat bilan gapirib, xonimning hisobotiga ko'ra, u qilgan ishidan qattiq ogohlantirdi.

en: The gentleman, not yet perceiving the friar’s drift, faintly enough
uz: Janob, rohibning harakatini hali sezmay, yetarlicha mayin edi.

en: denied having sent her the purse and the girdle, so as not to undeceive the friar, in case the lady should have given him to believe that he had done this; whereat the good man was sore incensed and said, ‘How canst thou deny it, wicked man that thou art?
uz: Unga hamyon va kamarni yuborganini rad etdi, chunki u rohibni aldamagan bo'lardi, ehtimol xonim unga buni qilganligiga ishontirgan bo'lardi; yaxshi odam esa achchiqlanib dedi: "Qanday qilib sen, yovuz odam, buni rad qila olasan, sen ekanligingni?"

en: See, here they are, for she herself brought them to me, weeping; look if thou knowest them.’ The gentleman feigned to be sore abashed and answered, ‘Yes, I do indeed know them and I confess to you that I did ill; but I swear to you, since I see her thus dis- posed, that you shall never more hear a word of this.’ Brief, after many words, the numskull of a friar gave his friend the purse and the girdle and dismissed him, after rating him amain and beseeching him occupy himself no more with these follies, the which he promised him.
uz: Mana ular, chunki u o'zi ularni menga yig'lab olib keldi, ko'ryapsanmi, ularni bilasanmi." Janob o'zini og'rigan deb ko'rsatdi va javob berdi: "Ha, men ularni bilaman va men senga yomonlik qilganimni tan olaman; lekin men senga qasam ichaman, chunki uni bunday bezovta qilganimni ko'ryapman, bundan keyin hech qachon bu haqda eshitmaysan." Qisqa qilib aytganda, bir rohibning xonim do'stiga hamyon va kamarni berdi va uni hayratga solib, unga va'da bergan bu ahmoqlik bilan shug'ullanmaslikni so'rab, uni qo'yib yubordi.

en: The gentleman, overjoyed both at the assurance that himseemed he had of the lady’s love and at the goodly gift, was no sooner quit of the friar than he betook himself to a place where he made shift to let his mistress see that he had the one and the other thing; whereat she was mightily rejoiced, more by token that herseemed her device went from good to better.
uz: Janob, xonimning muhabbatidan va yaxshi sovg'asidan juda xursand bo'lib, rohibdan tezroq voz kechib, xo'jayiniga bir-biridan ko'rish uchun o'zgarish yasagan joyga bordi; u yerda u juda xursand bo'ldi, chunki uning qurilmasi yaxshi tomondan yaxshi tomonga borardi.

en: She now awaited nought but her husband’s going abroad to give completion to the work, and it befell not long after that it behoved him repair to Genoa on some occasion or oth- er.
uz: Endi u erining ishni yakunlash uchun xorijga ketishini kutdi, ammo ko'p o'tmay, u qandaydir bir vaziyatda Genuyaga qaytishi kerak bo'ldi.

en: No sooner had he mounted to horse in the morning and gone his way, than the lady betook herself to the holy man and after many lamentations, said to him, weeping, ‘Father mine, I tell you now plainly that I can brook no more; but, for that I promised you the other day to do nought, without ﬁrst telling you, I am come to excuse myself to you; and that you may be- lieve I have good reason both to weep and to complain, I will tell you what your friend, or rather devil incarnate, did to me this very morning, a little before matins.
uz: U ertalab otga minib, yo'lga chiqqanidan ko'p o'tmay, xonim o'zini muqaddas odamga qaratdi va ko'p faryodlardan so'ng, yig'lab, unga dedi: "Otam, senga endi aniq aytyapman, men boshqa hech narsa qila olmayman; lekin, shuning uchun men senga o'tgan kuni hech narsa qilmaslikka va'da bergan edim, avval aytmasdan, senga o'zimni kechirishga keldim; va sen esa, azizim, yig'lash va shikoyat qilish uchun yaxshi sababga egaman, senga bugun ertalab, biroz oldin, do'sting, yoki aksincha, iblisning timsolga singdirilgan odam menga nima qilganini aytaman."

en: I know not what ill chance gave him to know that my hus- band was to go to Genoa yestermorn; algates, this morning, at the time I tell you, he came into a garden of mine and climbing up by a tree to the window of my bedchamber, which giveth upon the garden, had already opened the lattice and was for entering, when I of a sudden awoke and starting up, offered to cry out, nay, would assuredly have cried out, but that he, who was not yet within, besought me of mercy in God’s name and yours, telling me who he was; which when I heard, I held my peace for the love of you and naked as I was born, ran and shut the window in his face; whereupon I sup- pose he took himself off (ill-luck go with him!), for I heard no more of him.
uz: Bilmadim, unga qanday omadsizlik sabab bo'ldi, chunki u mening hus-bandim Genuyaga bormoqchi edi; albatta, bugun ertalab, men sizga aytayotgan vaqtda, u mening bog'imga kirib, bog'ga qaragan yotoqxonamning derazasiga daraxtga chiqdi, u allaqachon deraza ochib, kirmoqchi edi, birdan uyg'onib, baqirib yubordim, yo'q, albatta baqirgan bo'lardim, lekin u hali ichkarida bo'lmagan, menga Xudo nomi bilan va sizning ismingizda rahm-shafqat so'ragan, kimligini aytdi; men eshitganimda, senga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun tinch qolib, tug'ilganimda yalang'och holda yugurdim va uning derazasiga qarab turdim; keyin u o'zini (yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo'q-yo

en: Look you now if this be a goodly thing and to be endured.
uz: Endi qarang, bu yaxshi narsa bo'lsa-yu, bardosh berish kerak bo'lsa.

en: For my part I mean to bear with him no more; nay, I have already forborne him overmuch
uz: Men endi u bilan birga bo'lishni xohlamayman; yo'q, men uni allaqachon juda ham tashlab yubordim.

en: for the love of you.’ The friar, hearing this, was the wrathfullest man alive and knew not what to say, except to ask again and again if she had well cer- tiﬁed herself that it was indeed he and not another; to which she answered, ‘Praised be God!
uz: Sizga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun. Buni eshitgan rohib eng g'azablantiruvchi tirik odam edi va nima deyishni bilmas edi, faqat qayta-qayta so'rashdan tashqari, u haqiqatan ham u boshqa emas, balki u ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilganmi yoki yo'qmi, deb so'rashdan boshqa hech narsa bilmas edi; unga javob berdi: Allohga hamd bo'lsin!

en: As if I did not yet know him from another!
uz: Xuddi uni hali boshqa birovdan tanimagandek!

en: I tell you it was himself, and although he should deny it, credit him not.’ Then said the friar, ‘Daughter, there is nothing to be said for it but that this was exceeding effrontery and a thing exceeding ill done, and in sending him off, as thou didst, thou didst that which it behoved thee to do.
uz: Sizga aytaman, bu o'zi edi, va garchi u buni inkor etsa ham, unga ishonmang." Shunda rohib dedi: "Qizim, bu juda beodoblik va juda yomon ish ekanligi haqida gapirish mumkin emas, va uni siz qilganingizdek jo'natishda, siz o'zingiz qilishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsani qildingiz."

en: But I beseech thee, since God hath preserved thee from shame, that, like as thou hast twice followed my counsel, even so do thou yet this once; to wit, without complaining to any kinsman of thine, leave it to me to see an I can bridle yonder devil broke loose, whom I believed a saint.
uz: Lekin men senga iltimos qilaman, Xudo seni sharmandalikdan saqlagan ekan, mening maslahatimga ikki marta ergashganingdek, sen ham bu safar shunday qilgin; ya'ni, hech qanday qarindoshingga shikoyat qilmasdan, men o'sha singan shaytonni ozod qila olishimni ko'rishga qo'y, men uni avliyo deb hisoblaganman.

en: If I can make shift to turn him from this lewdness, well and good; if not, I give thee leave henceforth to do with him that which thy soul shall judge best, and my benison go with thee.’ ‘Well, then,’ answered the lady, ‘for this once I will well not to vex or dis- obey you; but look you do on such wise that he be ware of annoying me again, for I promise you I will never again return to you for this cause.’ Thereupon, without saying more, she took leave of the friar and went away, as if in anger.
uz: Agar men uni bu behayolikdan qaytarishga qodir bo'lsam, yaxshi va yaxshi bo'lsin; aks holda, senga bundan buyon o'z joning eng yaxshi baholaydigan ishni qilish uchun ruxsat beraman va mening barakaim sen bilan birga boradi. Xo'sh, unda,  javob berdi xonim,  chunki bu safar seni xafa qilmaslikka yoki itoat etmaslikka qaror qilaman; lekin shunday donolik bilan qilginki, u meni yana bezovta qilmasin, chunki senga va'da beraman, bu ish uchun senga hech qachon qaytmayman. Keyin, bundan orqaga aytmasdan, u rohibni tark etdi va go'yo g'azabda bo'lgandek ketdi.

en: Hardly was she out of the church when up came the gentle- man and was called by the friar, who, taking him apart, gave him the sound- est rating ever man had, calling him disloyal and forsworn and traitor.
uz: U deyarli cherkovdan chiqmagan edi, qachonki muloyim odam paydo bo'ldi va rohib uni chaqirib oldi. Rohib uni ajratib olib, unga har qanday odamga xos bo'lgan eng yuqori baho berdi, uni sadoqatsiz, qasam ichgan va xoin deb atadi.

en: The other, who had already twice had occasion to know to what the monk’s rep- rimands amounted, abode expectant and studied with embarrassed answers to make him speak out, saying, at the ﬁrst, ‘Why all this passion, Sir?
uz: Boshqasi, rohibning rep-romanlari qancha ekanligini ikki marta bilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lgan, kutib qoldi va uni gapirishga majbur qilish uchun uyatli javoblar bilan o'qidi, avvalo: "Nega bunchalik ehtiros, janob?" dedi.

en: Have I cruciﬁed Christ?’ Whereupon, ‘Mark this shameless fellow!’ cried the fri- ar.
uz: Men Masihni xochga mixladimmi? Shunda, Bu uyatsiz odamga qarang! deb baqirdi fri-ar.

en: ‘Hear what he saith!
uz: Uning nima deyayotganini eshiting!

en: He speaketh as if a year or two were passed and he had for lapse of time forgotten his misdeeds and his lewdness!
uz: U gapiradi go'yo bir-ikki yil o'tib, bir oz vaqtga o'z gunohlarini va behayoliklarini unutgandek!

en: Hath it then escaped thy mind between this and matinsong that thou hast outraged someone this very morning?
uz: Shunday ekan, bu va ertalabki qo'shiq o'rtasida, bugun ertalab kimnidir g'azablantirganing xotiradan chiqib ketdimi?

en: Where wast thou this morning a little before day?’ ‘I know not,’ answered the gentleman; ‘but wherever it was, the news thereof hath reached you mighty early.’ Quoth the friar, ‘Certes, the news hath reached me.
uz: Bugun ertalab ertalabdan biroz oldin qayerda eding? Bilmayman, javob berdi janob; lekin qayerda bolsa ham, uning xabari sizga juda erta yetib keldi. Ruhoniy dedi: Albatta, xabar menga yetib keldi.

en: Doubtless thou supposedst because her husband was abroad, that needs must the gentlewoman receive thee incontinent in her arms.
uz: Shubhasiz, sen ering chet elda bo'lgani uchun, mehribon ayol seni o'z quchog'iga bemalol qabul qilishi kerak deb o'ylaysan.

en: A ﬁne thing, indeed!
uz: Ajoyib narsa, haqiqatan ham!

en: Here’s a pretty fellow!
uz: Mana bir chiroyli yigit!

en: Here’s an honourable man!
uz: Mana, hurmatli odam!

en: He’s grown a nighthawk, a garden-breaker, a tree-climber!
uz: U tungi ilon, bog'dosh, daraxtga o't o'rnatuvchi o'stirdi!

en: Thinkest thou by importunity to overcome this lady’s chastity, that thou climbest up to her windows anights by the trees?
uz: Siz bu xonimning xorligini yengib o'tish uchun g'amxo'rlik bilan uning derazalariga tungi paytlarda daraxtlar yonidan ko'tarilib chiqasizmi deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: There is nought in the world so dis-
uz: Dunyoda hech narsa yo'q, shuning uchun...

en: pleasing to her as thou; yet must thou e’en go essaying it again and again.
uz: Unga xuddi sen kabi yoqish; ammo uni qayta-qayta sinab ko'rishing kerak.

en: Truly, thou hast proﬁted ﬁnely by my admonitions, let alone that she hath shown thee her aversion in many ways.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, mening tanbehlarimdan oz foyda olding, faqatgina u senga ko'p yo'llar bilan o'z nafratini ko'rsatdi.

en: But this I have to say to thee; she hath up to now, not for any love she beareth thee, but at my instant entreaty, kept silence of that which thou hast done; but she will do so no more; I have given her leave to do what seemeth good to her, an thou annoy her again in aught.
uz: Lekin senga shuni aytmoqchiman: u hozirgacha seni hech qanday muhabbat uchun ko'tara olmayapti, lekin mening iltimosim bilan, sen qilgan ishing haqida sukut saqladi; lekin u bundan keyin bunday qilmaydi; men unga o'ziga ma'qul ko'rgan ishni qilishga ruxsat berdim, va sen uni yana hech narsada bezovta qil.

en: What wilt thou do, an she tell her brothers?’ The gentleman having now gathered enough of that which it concerned him to know, appeased the friar, as best he knew and might, with many and ample promises, and taking leave of him, waited till matinsong161 of the ensuing night, when he made his way into the garden and climbed up by the tree to the window.
uz: U akalariga nima qilmoqchisan, dedi u? Janob endi bilishga arziydigan narsalardan yetarlicha to'plagani uchun, rohibni o'zi bilgan va kuchli bo'lganidek, ko'plab va keng va'dalar bilan tinchlantirdi va undan xayrlashib, keyingi tunning 161-sahiligacha kutdi, u bog'ga yo'l oldi va daraxtdan derazaga chiqdi.

en: He found the lattice open and entering the chamber as quickliest he might, threw him- self into the arms of his fair mistress, who, having awaited him with the ut- most impatience, received him joyfully, saying, ‘Gramercy to my lord the friar for that he so well taught thee the way hither!’ Then, taking their pleas- ure one of the other, they solaced themselves together with great delight, devising and laughing amain anent the simplicity of the dolt of a friar and gibing at wool-hanks and teasels and carding-combs.
uz: U panjarani ochiq holda topdi va imkon qadar tezroq xonaga kirdi, o'zini go'zal bekasining qo'llariga tashladi. Bekasi uni juda sabrsizlik bilan kutib, quvonch bilan kutib oldi va dedi: "Mening xo'jayinim rohibga shu yo'lni shunchalik yaxshi o'rgatgani uchun rahmat!" Keyin, ularning bir-biridan iltijolarini qabul qilib, bir-birlarini katta xursandchilik bilan tasalli berishdi, rohibning qo'lidagi oddiylikni o'ylab topib, kulishdi va jun-qo'l, choy va karton-qo'llarga o'ynashdi.

en: Moreover, having taken order for their future converse, they did on such wise that, without having to resort anew to my lord the friar, they foregathered in equal joy- ance many another night, to the like whereof I pray God, of His holy mercy, speedily to conduct me and all Christian souls who have a mind thereto.”
uz: Qolaversa, ularning kelajakdagi suhbatlari uchun tartib olgandan so'ng, ular shunday yo'l tutdilarki, yana janobim rohibga murojaat qilishga hojat qolmasdan, teng xursandchilik bilan yig'ilishdi  yana bir kecha, Xudodan, Uning muqaddas rahm-shafqati bilan, meni va bunga aqli bor barcha xristian ruhlarni tezda yetaklab borishini so'rayman.

en: THE FOURTH STORY Dom Felice teacheth Fra Puccio how he may become beatiﬁed by performing a certain penance of his fashion, which the other doth, and Dom Felice meanwhile leadeth a merry life of it with the good man’s wife.
uz: TO'RTINCHI HIKOYA Dom Felitsi Fra Puccioga o'z uslubidagi ma'lum bir tavbani bajarish orqali qanday qilib beatified bo'lish mumkinligini o'rgatadi, bu esa boshqasi qiladi, va Dom Felitsi shu bilan birga yaxshi odamning xotini bilan undan xursand hayot kechiradi.

en: Filomena, having made an end of her story, was silent and Dioneo having with dulcet speech mightily commended the lady’s shrewdness and eke the prayer with which Filomena had concluded, the queen turned with a smile to Pamﬁlo and said, “Come, Pamﬁlo, continue our diversion with some pleasant triﬂe.” Pamﬁlo promptly answered that he would well and began thus: “Madam, there are many persons who, what while they study to enter Paradise, unwittingly send others thither; the which happened, no great while since, to a neighbour of ours, as you shall hear.
uz: Filomena o'z hikoyasini tugatgach, sukut saqladi va Dioneo xonimning xushmuomalaligi va Filomena yakunlagan duoni kuchli maqtaganidan so'ng, malika Pamfiloga tabassum bilan o'girilib dedi: "Keling, Pamfilo, yoqimli mayda-chuyda narsa bilan chalg'itishni davom ettiring." Pamfilo tezda yaxshi deb javob berdi va shunday boshladi: "Xonim, jannatga kirishni o'rganayotgan bir paytda, bilmasdan boshqalarni u yerga jo'natadigan ko'p odamlar bor; bu esa, eshitganingizdek, yaqinda sodir bo'ldi.

en: According to that which I have heard tell, there abode near San Pancrazio an honest man and a rich, called Puccio di Rinieri, who, devoting himself in his latter days altogether to religious practices, became a tertiary162 of the order of St.
uz: Eshitishimcha, San Pancrazio yaqinida Puccio di Rinieri deb nomlangan halol bir va boy odam yashagan, u oxirgi kunlarida diniy amaliyotlarga butunlay bag'ishlangan holda, Avliyo dining 162-turkumiga aylangan.

en: Francis, whence he was styled Fra Puccio, and ensuing this his devout life, much frequented the church, for that he had no family other than a wife and one maid and consequently, it behoved him not apply him- self to any craft.
uz: Frantsisk, u Fra Puccio deb atalgan va shundan kelib chiqib, o'zining sadoqatli hayoti bilan cherkovga ko'p borardi, chunki uning xotini va bir xizmatchidan boshqa oilasi yo'q edi va shuning uchun u o'zini hech qanday hunarga qo'llamasligi kerak edi.

en: Being an ignorant, clod-pated fellow, he said his pater- nosters, went to preachments and attended mass, nor ever failed to be at the Lauds chanted by the seculars,163 and fasted and mortiﬁed himself; nay, it was buzzed about that he was of the Flagellants.164 His wife, whose name was Mistress Isabetta,165 a woman, yet young, of eight-and-twenty to thirty years of age, fresh and fair and plump as a lady-apple, kept, by reason of the piety and belike of the age of her husband, much longer and more fre- quent fasts than she could have wished, and when she would have slept or maybe frolicked with him, he recounted to her the life of Christ and the
uz: O'zining befarosat, kalta-kiluvchan odami bo'lgani uchun, u ota-bobolarining aytishicha, va'zlarga borardi va massada qatnashardi, hech qachon dunyoviylar tomonidan qo'shiladigan Laudlarda bo'lmadi, 163 va ro'za tutdi va o'zini xor qildi; yo'q, u Flagellantlardan ekanligi haqida gapirildi. 164 Uning rafiqasi, uning ismi Mistress Isabetta edi, 165 yosh ayol, ammo, yigirma ikki yoshdan o'ttiz yoshgacha, yangi va adolatli va semiz, xonim kabi, erining taqvodorligi va yoshiga o'xshashligi sababli, u xohlaganidan ko'ra uzoqroq va erkinroq tutdi va qachonki u uxlagan bo'lsa, u bilan birga bo'lmasin, u unga Masihning hayotini aytib berdi.

en: preachments of Fra Nastagio or the Complaint of Mary Magdalene or the like.
uz: Fra Nastagio yoki Maryam Magdalena shikoyati va shunga o'xshash va'zlar.

en: Meantime there returned home from Paris a monk hight Dom166 Fe- lice, Conventual167 of San Pancrazio, who was young and comely enough of person, keen of wit and a profound scholar, and with him Fra Puccio con- tracted a strait friendship.
uz: Ayni paytda Parijdan uyga qaytgan bir rohib baland Dom166 Fe- bit, San Pancrazio Conventual167 edi. U yosh va chiroyli inson edi, xushchaqchaq va chuqur olim edi va u bilan Fra Puccio yaqin do'stlik o'rnatdi.

en: And for that this Dom Felice right well resolved him his every doubt and knowing his pious turn of mind, made him a show of exceeding devoutness, Fra Puccio fell to carrying him home bytimes and giving him to dine and sup, as the occasion offered; and the lady also, for her husband’s sake, became familiar with him and willingly did him honour.
uz: Va shuning uchun ham Dom Felice uning har bir shubhasini yaxshi hal qildi va uning taqvodor fikrlashini bilgan holda, unga haddan tashqari sadoqat ko'rsatdi. Fra Puccio uni vaqti-vaqti bilan uyga olib borishga va imkoniyat bo'yicha ovqatlanish va kechki ovqatga taklif qilishga majbur bo'ldi; va xonim ham eri uchun u bilan tanishdi va uni o'z xohishi bilan hurmat qildi.

en: The monk, then, continuing to frequent Fra Puccio’s house and seeing the latter’s wife so fresh and plump, guessed what should be the thing whereof she suffered the most default and bethought himself, an he might, to go about to furnish her withal himself, and so spare Fra Puccio fatigue.
uz: Rohib esa, Fra Puccio'ning uyiga tez-tez borishda davom etib, uning xotini shunchalik yangi va semiz ekanligini ko'rib, uning eng ko'p zarar ko'radigan narsa nima bo'lishi kerakligini taxmin qildi va o'zini, uni o'zi bilan ta'minlashga borishi mumkinligini o'yladi, shu bilan Fra Puccio charchoqdan xalos bo'ladi.

en: Ac- cordingly, craftily casting his eyes on her, at one time and another, he made shift to kindle in her breast that same desire which he had himself, which when he saw, he bespoke her of his wishes as ﬁrst occasion betided him.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u unga mohirona ko'z tashlab, bir vaqtning o'zida o'zida bo'lgan o'sha istakni uning ko'kragida yoqishga harakat qildi. U uni ko'rganida, birinchi marta unga duch kelganidek, unga o'z istaklarini aytdi.

en: But, albeit he found her well disposed to give effect to the work, he could ﬁnd no means thereunto, for that she would on nowise trust herself to be with him in any place in the world save her own house, and there it might not be, seeing that Fra Puccio never went without the town.
uz: Lekin, garchi uni ishga ta'sir ko'rsatishga yaxshi niyatda ekanligini topgan bo'lsa ham, u bunga hech qanday yo'l topa olmadi, chunki u endi o'z uyidan boshqa dunyodagi har qanday joyda u bilan birga bo'lishga ishonardi va u yerda bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, chunki Fra Puccio hech qachon shahar tashqarisiga chiqmagan edi.

en: At this the monk was sore chagrined; but, after much consideration, he hit upon a device whereby he might avail to foregather with the lady in her own house, without suspect, for all Fra Puccio should be at home.
uz: Bunga rohib qattiq xafa bo'ldi; lekin, ko'p o'ylab ko'rgach, u bir qurilmaga duch keldi, u orqali u xonim bilan o'z uyida, gumonsiz uchrashishi mumkin edi, chunki barcha Fra Puccio uyda bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Accordingly, the lat- ter coming one day to visit him, he bespoke him thus, ‘I have many a time understood, Fra Puccio, that all thy desire is to become a saint and to this end meseemeth thou goest about by a long road, whereas there is another and a very short one, which the Pope and the other great prelates, who know and practise it, will not have made known, for that the clergy, who for the most part live by alms, would incontinent be undone, inasmuch as the laity would no longer trouble themselves to propitiate them with alms or otherwhat.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, oxirgi kuni uni ziyorat qilgani kelgan odam unga shunday dedi: Men ko'p vaqtdan beri tushunib yetdim, Frasi Putsiy, sening butun orzuing avliyo bo'lish va shu maqsadda uzoq yo'ldan o'tishing kerak, ammo yana bir yo'l bor va juda qisqa, uni Rim Papasi va uni biladigan va amalda qo'llaydigan boshqa buyuk ruhoniylar ma'lum qilmagan bo'lsalar, chunki ko'p hollarda sadaqa orqali yashaydigan ruhoniylar, ko'p hollarda, ularni sadaqa yoki boshqa muammolar bilan himoya qilish uchun o'zlarini bekor qilmagan bo'lsalar.

en: But, for that thou art my friend and hast very honourably enter- tained me, I would teach it thee, so I were assured thou wouldst practise it and wouldst not discover it to any living soul.’ Fra Puccio, eager to know the thing, began straightway to entreat him with the utmost instancy that he would teach it him and then to swear that never, save in so far as it should please him, would he tell it to any, engaging, an if it were such as he might avail to follow, to address himself thereunto.
uz: Lekin, sen mening do'stim bo'lganing uchun va meni juda hurmat bilan qabul qilganing uchun, men senga buni o'rgatardim, shuning uchun sen buni amalda qo'llashingga va hech qanday tirik jon uchun buni kashf qilmasligingga amin edim." Fr Puccio, bu narsani bilishga ishtiyoqmand bo'lib, darhol uni o'rgatishini iltimos qila boshladi va keyin hech qachon, agar unga yoqmasa, u buni hech kimga aytmasligini, jalb qilmasligini va agar u bunga ergashishga qodir bo'lsa, o'zi unga murojaat qilmasligini qasam ichdi.

en: Whereupon quoth the monk,
uz: Shundan so'ng rohib to'xtadi.

en: ‘Since thou promisest me this, I will e’en discover it to thee.
uz: Sen menga bu haqda va'da berganing uchun, men senga buni oshkor qilaman.

en: Thou must know that the doctors of the church hold that it behoveth whoso would be- come blessed to perform the penance which thou shalt hear; but understand me aright; I do not say that, after the penance, thou wilt not be a sinner like as thou presently art; but this will betide, that the sins which thou hast com- mitted up to the time of the penance will all by virtue thereof be purged and pardoned unto thee, and those which thou shalt commit thereafterward will not be written to thy prejudice, but will pass away with the holy water, as venial sins do now.
uz: Siz bilishingiz kerakki, cherkov shifokorlari siz eshitadigan tavbani amalga oshirish uchun kim barakali bo'lishni istasa, shunday deb hisoblashadi; lekin meni to'g'ri tushuning; men tavbadan so'ng hozirgidek gunohkor bo'lmasligingizni aytmayapman; lekin bu shuni anglatadiki, tavba vaqtigacha qilgan gunohlaringizning barchasi shu tufayli tozalanib, kechirilishi mumkin, va keyinchalik qilgan gunohlaringiz sizning xurofotingizga yozilmaydi, balki muqaddas suv bilan o'tib ketadi, xuddi gunohlar kabi.

en: It behoveth a man, then, in the ﬁrst place, whenas he cometh to begin the penance, to confess himself with the utmost diligence of his sins, and after this he must keep a fast and a very strict abstinence for the space of forty days, during which time thou168 must abstain from touch- ing, not to say other women, but even thine own wife.
uz: Shunday qilib, erkak kishi, avvalo, tavba qilishni boshlash uchun kelganida, o'z gunohlarini eng qattiq e'tirof etishi kerak, va shundan so'ng u qirq kun davomida ro'za tutishi va juda qattiq tiyilishi kerak, shu vaqt ichida sen boshqa ayollarga emas, hatto o'z xotiningga ham teginmasliging kerak.

en: Moreover, thou must have in thine own house some place whence thou mayst see the sky by night, whither thou must betake thyself towards the hour of complines,169 and there thou must have a wide plank set up, on such wise that, standing upright, thou mayst lean thy loins against it and keeping thy feet on the ground, stretch out thine arms, cruciﬁx fashion.
uz: Qolaversa, o'z uyingda tunlari osmonni ko'ra oladigan joy bo'lishi kerak, u yerda o'zingni to'y soatiga yaqinlashtirishing kerak, 169 va u yerda shunday keng taxtani o'rnatishing kerakki, tik turganingda unga belingni suyan va oyoqlaringni yerga qo'yib, qo'llaringni cho'zishing, xochga qo'yishing kerak.

en: An thou wouldst rest them upon some peg or other, thou mayst do it, and on this wise thou must abide gazing upon the sky, without budging a jot, till matins.
uz: Ularni qandaydir bir qarag'ayga yoki boshqa bir qarag'ayga qo'ymoqchi bo'lsang, buni qila olasan va shu tariqa ertalabgacha birorta ham qimirlamasdan osmonga tikilib turishing kerak.

en: Wert thou a scholar, thou wouldst do well to repeat certain orisons I would give thee; but, as thou art it not, thou must say three hundred Paternosters and as many Ave Marys, in honour of the Trinity, and looking upon heaven, still have in re- membrance that God is the Creator of heaven and earth and the passion of Christ, abiding on such wise as He abode on the cross.
uz: Sen olim bo'lsang, senga bermoqchi bo'lgan ba'zi orzularni takrorlashing yaxshi bo'lardi; lekin, sen bo'lmagandek, uch yuz Paternoster va ko'p Avliyo Maryam deb aytishing kerak, Uch Birlikka hurmat ko'rsatib, osmonni ko'rib, Xudo osmon va yerning Yaratuvchisi va Masihning azob-uqubatlari ekanligi, U xochda yashaganidek donolik bilan yashashi kerak.

en: When the bell ringeth to matins, thou mayst, an thou wilt, go and cast thyself, clad as thou art, on thy bed and sleep, and after, in the forenoon, betake thyself to church and there hear at least three masses and repeat ﬁfty Paternosters and as many Aves; after which thou shalt with a single heart do all and sundry thine occasions, if thou have any to do, and dine and at evensong be in church again and there say certain orisons which I will give thee by writ and without which it cannot be done.
uz: Tongga qo'ng'iroq chalinganda, xohlasang, borib, o'zingni o'zingdagidek, to'shakka va uyquga tashla, so'ngra, ertalab, cherkovga o'tir va u yerda kamida uchta namoz eshit va ellik Paternoster va shuncha Avesni takrorla; shundan so'ng, agar biror narsa qilmoqchi bo'lsang, bir yurak bilan hamma narsani va turli xil holatlarni qil, va ovqatlan va hatto cherkovda yana bo'l va men senga yozuvlar orqali va ularsiz bajara olmaydigan ba'zi maslahatlar beraman.

en: Then, towards complines, do thou re- turn to the fashion aforesaid, and thus doing, even as I have myself done aforetime, I doubt not but, ere thou come to the end of the penance, thou wilt, (provided thou shalt have performed it with devoutness and compunc- tion), feel somewhat marvellous of eternal beatitude.’ Quoth Fra Puccio, ‘This is no very burdensome matter, nor yet overlong, and may very well be
uz: Keyin, to'g'ri yo'l bilan, yuqorida aytilgan uslubga qayting va shunday qilib, xuddi avval ham qilganimdek, men shubha qilmayman, lekin, tavbaning oxiriga yetib borguncha, (agar sen uni sadoqat va murosasizlik bilan bajargan bo'lsang), abadiy baxtning biroz ajoyibligini his qilasiz.

en: done; wherefore I purpose in God’s name to begin on Sunday.’ Then, taking leave of him and returning home, he related everything in due order to his wife, having the other’s permission therefor.
uz: "Butun bo'ldi; shuning uchun men Xudoning nomi bilan yakshanba kuni boshlashni niyat qilaman." Keyin, undan xayr olib, uyga qaytib, u hamma narsani xotiniga tegishli tartibda yetkazdi, buning uchun boshqa kishining ruxsatini oldi.

en: The lady understood very well what the monk meant by bidding him stand fast without stirring till matins; wherefore, the device seeming to her excellent, she replied that she was well pleased therewith and with every other good work that he did for the health of his soul and that, so God might make the penance proﬁtable to him, she would e’en fast with him, but do no more.
uz: Xonim rohibning unga ertalabgacha tinimsiz turishni buyurib, nimani nazarda tutganini juda yaxshi tushunardi; shuning uchun, qurilma unga a'lo ko'rinsa, u undan va uning ruhi salomatligi uchun qilgan har bir yaxshi ishidan juda mamnun ekanligini va Xudo tavbani unga foydali qilishi uchun, u bilan birga ro'za tutishini, lekin boshqa qilmasligini aytdi.

en: They being thus of ac- cord and Sunday come, Fra Puccio began his penance and my lord monk, having agreed with the lady, came most evenings to sup with her, bringing with him store of good things to eat and drink, and after lay with her till matinsong, when he arose and took himself off, whilst Fra Puccio returned to bed.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular yakshanba kuni kelishgan ekan, Fra Puccio tavbasini boshladi va rafiqam rohib xonim bilan kelishgan holda, ko'p kechqurun u bilan kechki ovqatga keldi, o'zi bilan birga ovqatlanish va ichish uchun yaxshi narsalar olib keldi va ertalabgacha u bilan yotdi, u turib, o'zini yechdi, Fra Puccio esa yotoqqa qaytdi.

en: Now the place which Fra Puccio had chosen for his penance ad- joined the chamber where the lady lay and was parted therefrom but by a very slight wall, wherefore, Master Monk wantoning it one night overfreely with the lady and she with him, it seemed to Fra Puccio that he felt a shak- ing of the ﬂoor of the house.
uz: Endi Fra Puccio tavba qilish uchun tanlagan joyi xonim yotgan xonaga qo'shildi va undan juda kichik devor bilan ajraldi, shuning uchun ustoz Monk uni xonim va u bilan bir kecha bemalol tashlab, Fra Puccioga uyning polining silkinishini his qilgandek tuyuldi.

en: Accordingly, having by this said an hundred of his Paternosters, he made a stop there and without moving, called to his wife to know what she did.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, yuzlab Paternosterlari shu gapni aytganidan so'ng, u shu yerda to'xtadi va hech qimirlamasdan, xotiniga nima qilganini bilish uchun qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: The lady, who was of a waggish turn and was then belike astride of San Benedetto his beast or that of San Giovanni Gual- berto, answered, ‘I’ faith, husband mine, I toss as most I may.’ ‘How?’ quoth Fra Puccio.
uz: Xonim, o'ziga xos burilishga ega bo'lgan va keyin San Benedetto, uning hayvoni yoki San Giovanni Gual-berto hayvoniga o'xshab, javob berdi: "Men  ishonaman, erim, men imkon qadar tashlayman." Qanday?"  deb javob berdi Fra Puccio.

en: What meaneth this tossing?’ The lady, laughing, for that she was a frolicsome dame and doubtless had cause to laugh, answered merrily; ‘How?
uz: Bu tashlash nimani anglatadi? Xonim kuldi, chunki u quvnoq ayol edi va shubhasiz, kulishga sababi bor edi, xursandchilik bilan javob berdi; Qanday qilib?

en: You know not what it meaneth?
uz: Bu nimani anglatishini bilmaysizmi?

en: Why, I have heard you say a thousand times, “Who suppeth not by night must toss till morning light.” ’ Fra Puccio doubted not but that the fasting was the cause of her unableness to sleep and it was for this she tossed thus about the bed; wherefore, in the simplicity of his heart, ‘Wife,’ said he, ‘I told thee not to fast; but, since thou wouldst e’en do it, think not of that, but address thy- self to rest; thou givest such vaults about the bed that thou makest all in the place shake.’ ‘Have no care for that,’ answered the lady; ‘I know what I am about; do you but well, you, and I will do as well as I may.’ Fra Puccio, ac- cordingly, held his peace and betook himself anew to his Paternosters; and after that night my lord monk and the lady let make a bed in another part of the house, wherein they abode in the utmost joyance what while Fra Puccio’s penance lasted.
uz: Nima uchun, men sizni ming marta aytganingizni eshitdim: Kim kechasi ovqatlanmasa, ertalabki yorug'likkacha tashlashi kerak  Fra Puccio shubhalanmadi, lekin ro'za uning uyquga qobiliyatsizligining sababi edi va shuning uchun u to'shak atrofida shunday tashladi; shuning uchun, uning qalbi soddaligida, Xotin, dedi u, Men senga ro'za tutmaslikni aytdim; lekin, chunki sen buni qilmoqchi eding, shuni o'ylama, balki o'zingni tinchlantirishga murojaat qil; sen hamma narsani tebratgan joying haqida shunday g'amxo'rlik qil. Bu haqida qayg'urma, javob berdi xonim; Men nima haqida gapirashimni bilaman; senga yaxshilik qil, men senga ham yaxshilik qilaman. Puccio, o'zining bir qismiga va xonimga tinchlik beraman, chunki ular o'z uyida

en: At one and the same hour the monk took himself off and the lady returned to her own bed, whereto a little after came Fra
uz: Xuddi shu soatning o'zida rohib o'zini yechdi va xonim o'z karavoriga qaytib keldi, u yerda birozdan keyin Fra keldi.

en: Puccio from his penance; and on this wise the latter continued to do pen- ance, whilst his wife did her delight with the monk, to whom quoth she merrily, now and again, ‘Thou hast put Fra Puccio upon performing a pen- ance, whereby we have gotten Paradise.’ Indeed, the lady, ﬁnding herself in good case, took such a liking to the monk’s fare, having been long kept on low diet by her husband, that, whenas Fra Puccio’s penance was accom- plished, she still found means to feed her ﬁll with him elsewhere and using discretion, long took her pleasure thereof.
uz: Puccio tavbasidan qaytdi; va shu tariqa, ikkinchisi ham tavba qilishda davom etdi, xotini esa rohibni xursand qildi. U unga vaqti-vaqti bilan xursandchilik bilan ta'kidlardi: "Sen Fra Puccioga tavba qilgansan, shu orqali biz Jannatga erishdik." Haqiqatan ham, xonim o'zini yaxshi holatda his qilib, erining past ovqatlanishiga shunchalik yoqdi, hatto Fra Puccio tavbasining qondirilganiga qaramay, u uni boshqa joyda ham oziqlantirish uchun yo'l topdi va undan uzoq vaqt zavq oldi.

en: Thus, then, that my last words may not be out of accord with my ﬁrst, it came to pass that, whereas Fra Puccio, by doing penance, thought to win Paradise for himself, he put therein the monk, who had shown him the speedy way thither, and his wife, who lived with him in great lack of that whereof Dom Felice, like a charit- able man as he was, vouchsafed her great plenty.”
uz: Shunday qilib, so'nggi so'zlarim birinchisimiga zid kelmasligi uchun, shunday bo'ldiki, Fra Puccio tavba qilib, o'zi uchun Jannatni qozonishni o'ylaganida, u yerga unga tezkor yo'l ko'rsatgan rohibni va Dom Felice kabi xayriya qila oladigan odam kabi u bilan birga yashaydigan xotiniga katta boylik berdi.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Ricciardo, surnamed Il Zima, giveth Messer Francesco Vergellesi a palfrey of his and hath therefor his leave to speak with his wife.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOYA Ricciardo, Il Zima familiyasi bilan tanilgan, Messer Francesco Vergellesiga o'zining bir parchasi beradi va shuning uchun u xotini bilan gaplashishga ruxsat oladi.

en: She keeping silence, he in her person replieth unto himself, and the effect after ensueth in accordance with his answer.
uz: U sukut saqlaydi, u o'z shaxsiyatida o'ziga javob beradi va keyingi oqibat uning javobiga mos keladi.

en: Pamﬁlo having made an end, not without laughter on the part of the ladies, of the story of Fra Puccio, the queen with a commanding air bade Elisa fol- low on.
uz: Pamfilo Fra Puccio haqidagi hikoyani xonimlar tomonidan kulgisiz emas, balki qudratli ruhga ega bo'lgan qirolicha Elisa fol- pastga qarab tugatdi.

en: She, rather tartly than otherwise, not out of malice, but of old habit, began to speak thus, “Many folk, knowing much, imagine that others know nothing, and so ofttimes, what while they think to overreach others, ﬁnd, after the event, that they themselves have been outwitted of them; where- fore I hold his folly great who setteth himself without occasion to test the strength of another’s wit.
uz: U, boshqacharoqdan ko'ra ancha achchiq, yomon niyatdan emas, balki eski odatdan kelib chiqib, shunday dedi: Ko'pchilik odamlar, ko'p narsani bilgan holda, boshqalarning hech narsa bilmasligini tasavvur qiladilar va ko'pincha, ular boshqalarga yetib borish haqida o'ylashar ekan, voqea o'tgandan so'ng, o'zlari ulardan befarq bo'lganlarini topadilar; men esa o'zini boshqalarning kuchini sinash uchun hech qanday sababsiz o'rnatib qo'yadigan ahmoqni buyuk deb hisoblayman.

en: But, for that maybe all are not of my opinion, it pleaseth me, whilst following on the given order of the discourse, to relate to you that which befell a Pistolese gentleman170 by reason thereof.
uz: Lekin, balki hamma ham mening fikrimga ko'ra bo'lmasa kerak, men sizga Pistole janob170ga shu sababli tushgan narsani ma'lum qilishdan mamnunman, nutqning berilgan tartibiga amal qilgan holda.

en: There was in Pistoia a gentleman of the Vergellesi family, by name Mess- er Francesco, a man of great wealth and understanding and well advised in all else, but covetous beyond measure.
uz: Pistoyada Vergellesi oilasining bir janobsi bor edi, uning ismi Mess-er Francesco edi. U juda boy, tushunarli va hamma narsada yaxshi maslahatga ega, lekin haddan tashqari ochko'z edi.

en: Being made provost of Milan, he had furnished himself with everything necessary for his honourable going thither, except only with a palfrey handsome enough for him, and ﬁnding none to his liking, he abode in concern thereof.
uz: Milan shahriga tayinlanganidan so'ng, u u yerga hurmat bilan borish uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani ta'minladi, faqatgina o'ziga yetarlicha ko'rkam va o'ziga yoqadigan hech narsa topmagani uchun, u bu haqda qayg'urib qoldi.

en: Now there was then in the same town a young man called Ricciardo, of little family, but very rich, who still went so quaintly clad and so brave of his person that he was com- monly known as Il Zima,171 and he had long in vain loved and courted Messer Francesco’s wife, who was exceeding fair and very virtuous.
uz: O'sha paytda o'sha shaharda Ricciardo ismli bir yigit bor edi. U kichkina oilali, lekin juda boy edi. U hali ham o'ziga xos kiyimda yurardi va o'ziga shunchalik jasorat ko'rsatardiki, u "Il Zima" deb tanilgan edi. 171. U uzoq vaqtdan beri bejizga Messer Francesco'ning xotiniga mehr qo'ygan va uni yoqtirgan edi. U juda adolatli va juda fazilatli edi.

en: Now he had one of the handsomest palfreys in all Tuscany and set great store by it for its beauty and it being public to everyone that he was enamoured of
uz: Endi u butun Toskana bo'ylab eng go'zal palfreylardan biriga ega edi va uning go'zalligi va o'ziga oshiq bo'lgan hamma uchun ochiq bo'lishi uchun unga katta hurmat ko'rsatardi.

en: Messer Francesco’s wife, there were those who told the latter that, should he ask it, he might have the horse for the love Il Zima bore his lady.
uz: Francesco xotini, undan so'rasa, Il Zima xonimiga bergan muhabbati uchun otga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini aytganlar bor edi.

en: Ac- cordingly, moved by covetise, Messer Francesco let call Il Zima to him and sought of him his palfrey by way of sale, so he should proffer it to him as a gift.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, hirsga berilib, janob Fransesko unga Il Zimni chaqirtirdi va undan o'zining palfriini sotish yo'li bilan so'radi, shuning uchun u uni unga sovg'a qilishi kerak edi.

en: The other, hearing this, was well pleased and made answer to him, say- ing, “Sir, though you gave me all you have in the world, you might not avail to have my palfrey by way of sale, but by way of gift you may have it, whenas it pleaseth you, on condition that, ere you take it, I may have leave to speak some words with your lady in your presence, but so far removed from everyone that I may be heard of none other than herself.’ The gentle- man, urged by avarice and looking to outwit the other, answered that it liked him well and [that he might speak with her] as much as he would; then, leaving him in the saloon of his palace, he betook himself to the lady’s chamber and telling her how easily he might acquire the palfrey, bade her come hearken to Il Zima, but charged her take good care to answer neither little or much to aught that he should say.
uz: Boshqasi buni eshitib, juda xursand bo'ldi va unga javob berdi: "Janob, garchi siz menga dunyodagi hamma narsangizni bergan bo'lsangiz ham, men sizga "palfrey"ni sotuvda emas, balki sovg'a sifatida olishingiz mumkin, agar sizga yoqsa, sharti shuki, uni olinguncha, men sizning huzuringizda xonim bilan bir oz gaplashish uchun ruxsat bersam, lekin hamma mendan uzoqroq bo'lib, o'zimdan boshqa hech kim haqida eshitmasligim mumkin."

en: To this the lady much demurred, but, it behoving her ensue her husband’s pleasure, she promised to do his bidding and followed him to the saloon, to hear what Il Zima should say.
uz: Bunga xonim juda xotirjam bo'ldi, lekin erining roziligiga ko'ra, u uning buyrug'ini bajarishga va Il Zimaning nima deyishini eshitish uchun unga ergashdi.

en: The latter, having renewed his covenant with the gentleman, seated himself with the lady in a part of the saloon at a great distance from everyone and began to say thus, ‘Noble lady, meseemeth certain that you have too much wit not to have long since perceived how great a love I have been brought to bear you by your beauty, which far transcendeth that of any woman whom methinketh I ever beheld, to say nothing of the engaging manners and the peerless virtues which be in you and which might well avail to take the loftiest spirits of mankind; wherefore it were needless to declare to you in words that this [my love] is the greatest and most fervent that ever man bore woman; and thus, without fail, will I do172 so long as my wretched life shall sustain these limbs, nay, longer; for that, if in the other world folk love as they do here below, I shall love you to all eternity.
uz: So'nggi, janob bilan ahdini yangilab, xonim bilan birga hamma bilan uzoq masofada joylashgan salonning bir qismida o'tirdi va shunday dedi: Este janob, menimcha, siz uzoq vaqtdan beri sizning go'zalligingiz orqali sizga qanday buyuk muhabbat yetkazilganini anglamagansiz, bu muhabbat men hech qachon ko'rmagan har qanday ayolnikidan ancha yuqoriroq, sizdagi jozibali odoblar va tengsiz fazilatlar haqida hech narsa demaslik kerak emas va bu insoniyatning eng oliy ruhlarini olish uchun foydali bo'lishi mumkin edi; shuning uchun sizga bu muhabbat eng katta va eng achchiq ayol ekanligi haqida so'zlar bilan e'lon qilish kerak edi; va shu tariqa, men hech kimga ayamaymanki, men sevganim uchun, agar bu yerda, agar men...

en: Wherefore you may rest assured that you have nothing, be it much or little worth, that you may hold so wholly yours and whereon you may in every wise so surely reckon as myself, such as I am, and that likewise which is mine.
uz: Shunday ekan, siz hech narsaga ega emasligingizga amin bo'lishingiz mumkin, xoh katta bo'lsin, xoh oz, toki butunlay o'zingizniki bo'ling va har tomonlama men kabi, men ham o'zimniki deb hisoblasangiz.

en: And that of this you may take assurance by very certain argument, I tell you that I should count myself more graced, did you command me somewhat that I might do and that would pleasure you, than if, I commanding, all the world should promptliest obey me.
uz: Va shunga ishonch hosil qilishingiz uchun juda aniq dalil bilan aytamanki, men o'zimni ko'proq ulug'vor deb hisoblashim kerak edi, agar men buyursam, butun dunyo menga tezroq itoat qilsa, menga biroz buyurgan bo'lsangiz va bu sizga yoqadigan bo'lsa.

en: Since, then, I am yours, even as you have heard, it is
uz: Shunday ekan, men sizniki, xuddi siz eshitganingizdek, bu...

en: not without reason that I dare to offer up my prayers to your nobility, wherefrom alone can all peace, all health and all well-being derive for me, and no otherwhence; yea, as the humblest of your servants, I beseech you, dear my good and only hope of my soul, which, midmost the ﬁre of love, feedeth upon its hope in you —that your benignity may be so great and your past rigour shown unto me, who am yours, on such wise be molliﬁed that I, recomforted by your kindness, may say that, like as by your beauty I was stricken with love, even so by your pity have I life, which latter, an your haughty soul incline not to my prayers, will without fail come to nought and I shall perish and you may be said to be my murderer.
uz: Bejizga emas, men o'z ibodatlarimni oliyjanobligingizga bag'ishlashga jur'at etaman, chunki faqat shu orqali menga barcha tinchlik, barcha sog'liq va farovonlik keladi, va boshqa hech qanday sabab yo'q; ha, sizning xizmatkorlaringizning eng kamtarinlari sifatida, iltimos qilaman, azizim, mening yaxshiligim va jonimning yagona umidi, u sevgi o'tining o'rtasida sizdan umid qiladi  sizning mehribonligingiz shunchalik katta bo'lsin va sizga tegishli bo'lgan menga o'tmishdagi qattiqqo'lligingiz shunchalik yengil bo'lsinki, men sizning mehribonligingizdan tasalli topgan holda, sizning go'zalligingiz tufayli sevgi bilan urilganim kabi, sizning rahm-shafqatingiz tufayli men ham hayotga ega bo'laman, bu esa sizning mag'rur ruhingiz mening ibodatlarimga qarshi kelmasligi uchun, hech narsa yo'q bo'lmasligi va men sizni yo'q qilish uchun yo'q qilishimni ko'rsataman.

en: Letting be that my death will do you no honour, I doubt not eke but that, conscience bytimes pricking you therefor, you will regret having wrought it173 and whiles, bet- ter disposed, will say in yourself, “Alack, how ill I did not to have compas- sion upon my poor Zima!” and this repentance, being of no avail, will cause you the great annoy.
uz: O'limim senga hech qanday sharaf keltirmasligiga shubham yo'q, lekin shunga shubham yo'q, lekin vijdon vaqti-vaqti bilan seni shu ish uchun bezovta qiladi, sen buni qilganingga afsuslanasan173 va o'zingda "Alak, bechora Zimaga rahm qilmaganim qanday yomon edi!" deb o'ylaysan va bu tavba, foydasiz bo'lgani uchun, senga katta g'azab keltiradi.

en: Wherefore, so this may not betide, now that you have it in your power to succour me, bethink yourself and ere I die, be moved to pity on me, for that with you alone it resteth to make me the happiest or the most miserable man alive.
uz: Shunday ekan, bu narsa o'zgarmasligi kerak, endi menga yordam berish uchun kuching bor ekan, o'zingni o'ylab ko'r va o'lishimdan oldin menga rahm qil, chunki faqat sen bilan meni eng baxtli yoki eng baxtsiz tirik odamga aylantirish qoladi.

en: I trust your courtesy will be such that you will not suffer me to receive death in guerdon of such and so great a love, but will with a glad response and full of favour quicken my fainting spirits, which ﬂutter, all dismayed, in your presence.’ Therewith he held his peace and heaving the deepest of sighs, followed up with sundry tears, proceeded to await the lady’s answer.
uz: Sizning muloyimligingiz shunday bo'lishiga ishonamanki, siz meni shunday buyuk muhabbat qo'rquvida o'limga yo'l qo'ymaysiz, balki xursandchilik bilan javob berib va mehribonlik bilan hushsizlanib qolgan ruhlarimni tezlashtirasiz, ular sizning huzuringizda titraydi, hammasi dahshatga tushdi." Shu bilan u xotirjam bo'lib, eng chuqur ohlarni ko'tarib, ko'z yoshlari bilan xonimning javobini kutishga kirishdi.

en: The latter —whom the long court he had paid her, the joustings held and the serenades given in her honour and other like things done of him for the love of her had not availed to move —was moved by the passionate speech of this most ardent lover and began to be sensible of that which she had never yet felt, to wit, what manner of thing love was; and albeit, in ensuance of the commandment laid upon her by her husband, she kept silence, she could not withal hinder sundry gentle sighs from dis- covering that which, in answer to Il Zima, she would gladly have made manifest.
uz: Oxirgisi  unga toʻlagan uzun saroyi, unga atalgan hurmatlar, unga atalgan shovqinlar va unga nisbatan qilingan muhabbat uchun qilingan boshqa shunga oʻxshash ishlar hech qanday yordam bermadi  bu eng ashaddiy oshiqning ehtirosli soʻzlaridan taʼsirlanib, u hali hech qachon his qilmagan narsani anglay boshladi, masalan, sevgi qanday narsa edi; va garchi erining unga buyurgan buyrugʻiga koʻra, u jim boʻlsa ham, Il Zimaga javob berganda, u xursand boʻlib namoyon qilgan narsani yashirishdan biroz mayin ingrashlarni toʻxtata olmadi.

en: Il Zima, having waited awhile and seeing that no response ensued, was wondered and presently began to divine the husband’s device; but yet, looking her in the face and observing certain ﬂashes of her eyes towards him now and again and noting, moreover, the sighs which she suffered not to escape her bosom with all her strength, conceived fresh hope and heartened thereby, took new counsel174 and proceeded to answer himself after the following fashion, she hearkening the while: ‘Zima mine, this long
uz: Il Zima biroz kutdi va javob berilmaganini ko'rib, hayron bo'ldi va darhol erining qurilmasini bashorat qila boshladi; ammo, unga qarab, unga qarab, ko'zlarining ba'zi bir miltillashlarini vaqti-vaqti bilan kuzatdi va, bundan tashqari, uning ko'kragidan butun kuchini bilan chiqib ketmasligiga duch kelgan ohlarni sezdi, yangi umidni o'ylab, shu bilan ruhlandi, yangi maslahat qabul qildi 174 va quyidagi uslubda javob berishga kirishdi, u shunday dedi: Zima, bu

en: time, in good sooth, have I perceived thy love for me to be most great and perfect, and now by thy words I know it yet better and am well pleased therewith, as indeed I should be.
uz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan, men sening menga bo'lgan muhabbatingni eng buyuk va mukammal deb his qildim, va endi sening so'zlaring bilan buni yanada yaxshiroq bilaman va bundan juda mamnunman, xuddi men bo'lishim kerak bo'lganidek.

en: Algates, an I have seemed to thee harsh and cruel, I will not have thee believe that I have at heart been that which I have shown myself in countenance; nay, I have ever loved thee and held thee dear above all other men; but thus hath it behoved me do, both for fear of others and for the preserving of my fair fame.
uz: Alget, men senga qattiqqo'l va shafqatsiz ko'ringanman, seni yuragimda o'zimni yuzma-yuz ko'rsatgan narsa bo'lganimga ishonmasligingga yo'l qo'ymayman; yo'q, men seni boshqa odamlardan ko'ra sevganman va qadrlaganman; lekin bu menga boshqalardan qo'rqib ham, go'zal shuhratimni saqlab qolish uchun ham shunday qilishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: But now is the time at hand when I may show thee clearly that I love thee and guerdon thee of the love that thou hast borne and bearest me.
uz: Lekin hozir senga aniq sevganimni ko'rsata oladigan va seni sen ko'rgan va ko'tarayotgan muhabbatdan himoya qiladigan vaqt keldi.

en: Take comfort, therefore, and be of good hope, for that a few days hence Messer Francesco is to go to Milan for provost, as indeed thou knowest, who hast for the love of me given him thy goodly palfrey; and whenas he shall be gone, I promise thee by my troth and of the true love I bear thee, that, before many days, thou shalt without fail foregather with me and we will give gladsome and entire accomplish- ment to our love.
uz: Shunday ekan, tasalli oling va yaxshi umid qiling, chunki bir necha kundan keyin janob Francesko Milan shahriga mehmon bo'lish uchun boradi, buni bilasizki, menga bo'lgan muhabbatingiz uchun unga o'z yaxshilikingizni bergansiz; va u ketganidan so'ng, men sizga o'z sadoqatim va sizga bo'lgan chin muhabbatim bilan va'da beraman, ko'p kunlardan oldin siz albatta men bilan uchrashasiz va biz muhabbatimizga quvonchli va butunlay mukammallik beramiz.

en: And that I may not have to bespeak thee otherwhiles of the matter, I tell thee presently that, whenas thou shalt see two napkins dis- played at the window of my chamber, which giveth upon our garden, do thou that same evening at nightfall make shift to come to me by the garden door, taking good care that thou be not seen.
uz: Va senga bu borada boshqa gapirib bermasligim uchun, senga aytaman, darhol, bizning bog'imizga qaragan xonamning derazasidan ikki xil salfetka o'ynab turganini ko'rsang, o'sha kechqurun kechqurun bog' eshigi bo'ylab oldimga kelishing kerak, ko'rinmasliging uchun yaxshilab ehtiyot bo'l.

en: Thou wilt ﬁnd me awaiting thee and we will all night long have delight and pleasance one of another, to our hearts’ content.’ Having thus spoken for the lady, he began again to speak in his own person and rejoined on this wise, ‘Dearest lady, my every sense is so transported with excessive joy for your gracious reply that I can scarce avail to make response, much less to render you due thanks; nay, could I e’en speak as I desire, there is no term so long that it might sufﬁce me fully to thank you as I would fain do and as it behoveth me; wherefore I leave it to your discreet consideration to imagine that which, for all my will, I am unable to express in words.
uz: Siz meni sizni kutgan holda topasiz va biz butun tun davomida bir-birimizning xursandchiligimiz va rohatimizdan rohatlanamiz, xonim nomidan shunday deb, u yana o'z so'zida gapira boshladi va shu tarzda javob berdi: "Aziz xonim, mening har bir hisim sizning marhamatli javobingiz uchun haddan tashqari xursandchilik bilan ko'tariladi, shuning uchun men sizga javob berishga unchalik imkoniyat yo'q, kamdan kam sizga minnatdorchilik bildirishga haqlim bor; yo'q, men xohlaganimcha gapira olaman, men sizga xohlaganimdek va menga kerak bo'lganidek to'liq minnatdorchilik bildirishga yetarli muddat yo'q; shuning uchun men buni tasavvur qilishga ixtiyor qilaman, men barcha xohishlarim uchun, so'zlar bilan ifodalay olmayman.

en: This much only I tell you that I will without fail bethink myself to do as you have charged me, and being then, peradventure, better certiﬁed of so great a grace as that which you have vouchsafed me, I will, as best I may, study to render you the utmost thanks in my power.
uz: Faqatgina shuni aytamanki, men o'zimni siz buyurganidek qilishga majbur bo'laman va shundan so'ng, ehtimol, siz menga sovg'a qilgan eng buyuk inoyatdan yaxshiroq xabardor bo'lganimdan so'ng, imkon qadar sizga kuchim bo'yicha eng katta minnatdorchilik bildirishga harakat qilaman.

en: For the nonce there abideth no more to say; wherefore, dearest lady mine, God give you that gladness and that weal which you most desire, and so to Him I commend you.’ For all this the lady said not a word; whereupon Il Zima arose and turned towards the husband, who, seeing him risen, came up to him and said, laughing ‘How deemest thou?
uz: Endi aytishga hech narsa qolmadi; shuning uchun, aziz xonim, Xudo sizga eng ko'p xohlagan quvonch va boylikni bersin, va shuning uchun sizni Unga tavsiya qilaman." Bularning hammasi uchun xonim bir so'z demadi; shundan so'ng Il Zima o'rnidan turib, eriga yuzlandi, u tirilganini ko'rib, uning oldiga kelib, kuldi va dedi: "Senga qanday tuyuladi?"

en: Have I well performed my promise to thee?’ ‘Nay, sir’ answered Il Zima; ‘for you
uz: Sizga bergan va'damni yaxshi bajardimmi? Yo'q, janob javob berdi Il Zima; siz uchun

en: promised to let me speak with your lady and you have caused me speak with a marble statue.’ These words were mighty pleasing to the husband, who, for all he had a good opinion of the lady, conceived of her a yet better and said, ‘Now is thy palfrey fairly mine.’ ‘Ay is it, sir,’ replied Il Zima, ‘but, had I thought to reap of this favour received of you such fruit as I have gotten, I had given you the palfrey, without asking it175 of you; and would God I had done it, for that now you have bought the palfrey and I have not sold it.’ The other laughed at this and being now provided with a palfrey, set out upon his way a few days after and betook himself to Milan, to enter upon the Provostship.
uz: Siz meni xonimingiz bilan gaplashishga ruxsat berishga va'da berdingiz va siz meni marmar haykal bilan gaplashishga majbur qildingiz. Bu so'zlar erga juda yoqdi. Er xonim haqida yaxshi fikrda edi, u uni yanada yaxshiroq his qildi va dedi: Endi sizning palfiringiz ancha o'zimniki.  Ha, shundaymi, janob,  javob berdi Il Zima,  lekin, agar men sizdan olganimdek meva olishni o'ylagandim, men sizga sizdan so'ramagan holda 175 ta palfir berardim; va Xudo xohlardi, men buni qilgan bo'lardim, chunki endi siz palfir sotib oldingiz va men uni sotmadim. Boshqa bir kishi bu haqda kuldi va endi palfir bilan ta'minlangan holda, bir necha kundan keyin Milanga yo'lga chiqdi va o'zi bilan birga kirdi.

en: The lady, left free in her house, called to mind Il Zima’s words and the love he bore her and the palfrey given for her sake and seeing him pass often by the house, said in herself, ‘What do I?
uz: Xonim, uyida bo'sh qolgan holda, Il Zimaning so'zlarini, unga bo'lgan muhabbatini va u uchun berilgan palfriyni esladi va uni uy yonidan tez-tez o'tishini ko'rib, o'ziga dedi: "Men nima qilmoqchiman?"

en: Why waste I my youth?
uz: Nega yoshligimni behuda sarflayman?

en: Yonder man is gone to Milan and will not return these six months.
uz: Yonder odam Milanga ketdi va shu olti oy ichida qaytib kelmaydi.

en: When will he ever render me them176 again?
uz: U qachon yana menga ularni 176 qilib beradi?

en: Moreover, when shall I ever ﬁnd such a lover as Il Zima?
uz: Qolaversa, qachon Il Zima kabi oshiqni topaman?

en: I am alone and have no one to fear.
uz: Men yolg'izman va qo'rqadigan hech kimim yo'q.

en: I know not why I should not take this good opportunity what while I may; I shall not always have such leisure as I presently have.
uz: Nega bu yaxshi imkoniyatdan foydalanmasligim kerakligini bilmayman, imkon bo'lsa ham; hozirgidek doim ham dam olmayman.

en: None will know the thing, and even were it to be known, it is better to do and repent, than to abstain and repent.’ Having thus taken counsel with her- self, she one day set two napkins in the garden window, even as Il Zima had said, which when he saw, he was greatly rejoiced and no sooner was the night come than he betook himself, secretly and alone, to the gate of the lady’s garden and ﬁnding it open, passed on to another door that opened into the house, where he found his mistress awaiting him.
uz: Hech kim bu narsani bilmaydi, hatto ma'lum bo'lsa ham, tavba qilish va tavba qilish o'z-o'ziga maslahat qilib, bir kuni bog' oynasiga ikki salfetka qo'ydi, xuddi Il Zima aytganidek, uni ko'rgach, juda xursand bo'ldi va tun yaqinlashmadi, u xonimning bog'ining eshigiga yashirincha va yolg'iz kirib, uni ochilganini topdi va u yerda uyga ochilgan boshqa eshikga o'tdi, u yerda uni bekasi kutib turardi.

en: She, seeing him come, started up to meet him and received him with the utmost joy, whilst he clipped and kissed her an hundred thousand times and followed her up the stair to her chamber, where, getting them to bed without a moment’s delay, they knew the utmost term of amorous delight.
uz: U uning kelganini ko'rib, uni kutib olishga otlandi va uni eng katta quvonch bilan kutib oldi, u esa uni yuz ming marta urdi va o'pdi va uning xonasiga zinadan ko'tarilib, ularni bir lahza ham kechiktirmasdan yotqizdi, u yerda sevgi baxtidagi eng katta ma'lumotni bilishardi.

en: Nor was this ﬁrst time the last, for that, what while the gentleman abode at Milan and even after his coming back, Il Zima returned thither many another time, to the exceed- ing satisfaction of both parties.”
uz: Bu birinchi marta ham oxirgisi emas edi, chunki janob Milanda yashaganida va hatto qaytganidan keyin ham, Il Zima u yerga yana ko'p marta qaytib kelgan, bu ikki tomonning juda katta mamnuniyatini keltirdi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY Ricciardo Minutolo, being enamoured of the wife of Filippello Fighinolﬁ and knowing her jealousy of her husband, contriveth, by representing that Filippello was on the ensuing day to be with his own wife in a bagnio, to bring her to the latter place, where, thinking to be with her husband, she ﬁndeth that she hath abidden with Ricciardo.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOY Ricciardo Minutolo Filippello Fighinolfining xotiniga oshiq bo'lib, uning eriga hasad qilganini bilgan holda, Filippello ertasi kuni o'z xotini bilan bagnoda bo'lishini, uni oxirgi joyga olib borishini tasvirlab beradi, u yerda eriga bo'lishni o'ylab, Ricciardo bilan yashiringanini aniqlaydi.

en: Elisa having no more to say, the queen, after commending the sagacity of Il Zima, bade Fiammetta proceed with a story, who answered, all smilingly, “Willingly, Madam,” and began thus: “It behoveth somedele to depart our city (which, like as it aboundeth in all things else, is fruitful in instances of every subject) and as Elisa hath done, to recount somewhat of the things that have befallen in other parts of the world; wherefore, passing over to Naples, I shall tell how one of those she-saints, who feign themselves so shy of love, was by the ingenuity of a lover of hers brought to taste the fruits of love, ere she had known its ﬂowers; the which will at once teach you circumspection in the things that may hap and afford you diversion of those already befallen.
uz: Elisa boshqa hech narsa demay, malika Il Zimaning donoligini maqtatib, Fiammetta hikoya bilan davom etdi. U hamma tabassum bilan javob berdi: Xo'sh, xonim, va shunday boshladi: Bizning shahrimizni tark etish kerak (bu shahar hamma narsada mo'l bo'lgani kabi, har bir mavzuda unumli bo'ladi) va Elisa qilganidek, dunyoning boshqa qismlarida sodir bo'lgan voqealarni aytib berish; shuning uchun, Neapolga o'tib, men sevishdan shunchalik uyalgan azizlardan biriga sevgi mevasini tatib ko'rishga qanday yordam berganini aytib beraman, u uning gullarini bilgan edi; bu esa bir vaqtning o'zida sizni ishtiyoqqa undash va o'rgatish mumkin.

en: In Naples, a very ancient city and as delightful as any in Italy or maybe more so, there was once a young man, illustrious for nobility of blood and noted for his much wealth, whose name was Ricciardo Minutolo.
uz: Neapol shahrida, juda qadimiy shahar va Italiyadagidek yoqimli yoki undan ham ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan, bir vaqtlar qon oliyjanobligi bilan mashhur va boyligi bilan mashhur bo'lgan bir yigit bor edi, uning ismi Ricciardo Minutolo edi.

en: Albeit he had to wife a very fair and lovesome young lady, he fell in love with one who, according to general opinion, far overpassed in beauty all the other ladies of Naples.
uz: Garchi u juda chiroyli va yoqimli yosh ayolga turmushga chiqishi kerak bo'lsa-da, u umumiy fikrga ko'ra, Neapolning boshqa ayollaridan go'zallikda ancha ustun bo'lgan bir ayolga oshiq bo'ldi.

en: Her name was Catella and she was the wife of another young gentleman of like condition, hight Filippello Fighinolﬁ, whom, like a very virtuous woman as she was, she loved and cherished over all.
uz: Uning ismi Katella edi va u xuddi shunday ahvoldagi yana bir yosh janobning, baland Filippello Fighinolfining rafiqasi edi. U uni juda fazilatli ayol kabi, hamma narsadan ko'ra sevardi va qadrlardi.

en: Ric- ciardo, then, loving this Catella and doing all those things whereby the love and favour of a lady are commonly to be won, yet for all that availing not to
uz: Ric-ciardo esa, bu Katellani yaxshi ko'rib, xonimning muhabbati va marhamati odatda qozonadigan barcha ishlarni qiladi, ammo foydasi yo'q bo'lgan barcha narsa uchun...

en: compass aught of his desire, was like to despair; and unknowing or unable to rid him of his passion, he neither knew how to die nor did it proﬁt him to live.
uz: Uning istaklarining hech biri umidsizlikka tushgandek edi; va uni o'z ishtiyoqidan xalos qila olmasdan yoki bilmasdan, na o'lishni bilmas edi, na yashash unga foyda bermas edi.

en: Abiding in this mind, it befell that he was one day urgently exhorted by certain ladies of his kinsfolk to renounce this passion of his, seeing he did but weary himself in vain, for that Catella had none other good than Filip- pello, of whom she lived in such jealousy that she fancied every bird that ﬂew through the air would take him from her.
uz: Shu fikrda qolgan holda, bir kuni uning qarindoshlari orasida ba'zi xonimlar uni bu ishtiyoqidan voz kechishga zudlik bilan undashdi, chunki u behuda charchagan edi, chunki Katellada Filip-pello'dan boshqa yaxshilik yo'q edi, u undan shunchalik rashk bilan yashardiki, u havodan uchib o'tgan har bir qush uni o'zidan oladi deb o'ylardi.

en: Ricciardo, hearing of Ca- tella’s jealousy, forthright bethought himself how he might compass his wishes and accordingly proceeded to feign himself in despair of her love and to have therefore set his mind upon another lady, for whose love he began to make a show of jousting and tourneying and doing all those things which he had been used to do for Catella; nor did he do this long before well nigh all the Neapolitans, and among the rest the lady herself, were per- suaded that he no longer loved Catella, but was ardently enamoured of this second lady; and on this wise he persisted until it was so ﬁrmly believed not only of others, but of Catella herself, that the latter laid aside a certain re- serve with which she was wont to entreat him, by reason of the love he bore her, and coming and going, saluted him familiarly, neighbourwise, as she did others.
uz: Ricciardo, Ca- tella'ning rashqini eshitib, o'z istaklarini qanday amalga oshirish mumkinligini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'yladi va shunga ko'ra, uning muhabbatidan umidsiz holda o'zini ko'rsatdi va shuning uchun boshqa bir xonimga e'tibor qaratdi. Uning muhabbati uchun u o'zini xursand qila boshladi va sayohatga chiqdi va Katella uchun odatdagidek barcha ishlarni qildi; shuningdek, u buni uzoq vaqt oldin barcha Neapolitlarga yaqinroq qilmadi va qolganlarning orasida xonim ham Katellani endi sevmasligiga, balki bu ikkinchi xonimga qattiq oshiq bo'lganligiga ishonch hosil qildi; va shu bilan birga, u faqat boshqa xonimga emas, balki Katellaga ham shunday qat'iy ishondi, chunki bu xonim unga mehmon bo'lish uchun uni qabul qilgan edi, chunki u uni yaxshi ko'rgandi va u, albatta, uni qabul qilardi.

en: It presently befell that, the weather being warm, many companies of ladies and gentlemen went, according to the usance of the Neapolitans, to divert themselves on the banks of the sea and there to dine and sup, and Ricciardo, knowing Catella to be gone thither with her company, betook himself to the same place with his friends and was received into Catella’s party of ladies, after allowing himself to be much pressed, as if he had no great mind to abide there.
uz: Tez orada shunday bo'ldiki, issiq ob-havo bo'lgani sababli, ko'plab xonimlar va janoblar jamoalari, Napoleonlarning odatiga ko'ra, dengiz bo'ylariga o'zlarini olib borishga va u yerga ovqatlanish va kechki ovqatlanish uchun borishdi. Ritsardo esa, Katella o'z kompaniyasi bilan u yerga borishini bilgach, o'zini do'stlari bilan bir joyga olib bordi va Katella'ning xonimlar partiyasiga qabul qilindi, go'yo u yerda qolishga unchalik katta fikrga ega emas edi.

en: The ladies and Catella fell to rallying him upon his new love, and he, feigning himself sore inﬂamed therewith, gave them the more occasion for discourse.
uz: Xonimlar va Katella uni yangi muhabbatiga ishontirishga tushishdi, va u, o'zini shu bilan og'riqli his qilib, ularga suhbatlashish uchun ko'proq imkoniyat berdi.

en: Presently, one lady going hither and thith- er, as commonly happeneth in such places, and Catella being left with a few whereas Ricciardo was, the latter cast at her a hint of a certain amour of Fil- ippello her husband, whereupon she fell into a sudden passion of jealousy and began to be inwardly all aﬁre with impatience to know what he meant.
uz: Hozirda bir xonim bu yerga va bu yerga borardi, odatda bunday joylarda sodir bo'ladi, va Katella Ricciardo bo'lganda, bir nechtasi bilan qoldirilib, u unga Fil- ippello erining ma'lum bir muhabbatini ishora qildi, shundan so'ng u to'satdan rashk o'tga tushdi va u nima demoqchi ekanligini bilishga ich-ichidan juda qayg'urishni boshladi.
