en: At last, having contained herself awhile and being unable to hold out longer, she besought Ricciardo, for that lady’s sake whom he most loved, to be pleased to make her clear177 of that which he had said of Filippello; whereupon quoth he, ‘You conjure me by such a person that I dare not deny
uz: Nihoyat, o'zini bir oz ushlab, uzoqroq ushlab tura olmagani uchun, u Ricciardodan, o'zi eng yaxshi ko'rgan xonim uchun, Filippello haqida aytgan gaplarini unga tushuntirishni so'radi; shundan so'ng u dedi: "Sen meni shunday odam bilan o'ylayapsanki, men inkor eta olmayman."

en: aught you ask me; wherefore I am ready to tell it you, so but you promise me that you will never say a word thereof either to him or to any other, save whenas you shall by experience have seen that which I shall tell you to be true; for that, when you please, I will teach you how you may see it.’ The lady consented to that which he asked and swore to him never to re- peat that which he should tell her, believing it the more to be true.
uz: Menga so'ra, nega men buni senga aytishga tayyorman, lekin menga hech qachon unga yoki boshqa hech kimga bu haqda bir so'z aytmaslikka va'da berasan, agar men senga aytadigan narsa haqiqat ekanligini tajriba orqali ko'rmaguningcha; chunki, qachon xohlasang, men senga buni qanday ko'rishni o'rgataman.

en: Then, withdrawing apart with her, so they might not be overheard of any, he pro- ceeded to say thus: ‘Madam, an I loved you as once I loved, I should not dare tell you aught which I thought might vex you; but, since that love is passed away, I shall be less chary of discovering to you the whole truth.
uz: Keyin, ular hech kim eshitmasligi uchun undan uzoqlashib, u shunday dedi: Xonim, men sizni avvalgi sevgimdek sevgan edim, sizni xafa qiladigan hech narsa aytishga jur'at etmas edim; lekin bu sevgi o'tib ketganidan beri, men sizga butun haqiqatni kashf etishdan kamroq charchayman.

en: I know not if Filippello have ever taken umbrage at the love I bore you or have believed that I was ever loved of you.
uz: Filippello sizga bo'lgan muhabbatimdan hech qachon xafa bo'lganmi yoki siz meni hech qachon sevganingizga ishonganmi, bilmayman.

en: Be this as it may, he hath never personally shown me aught thereof; but now, having peradventure awaited a time whenas he deemed I should be less suspicious, it seemeth he would fain do unto me that which I misdoubt me he feareth I have done unto him, to wit, [he seeketh] to have my wife at his pleasure.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u hech qachon menga bu haqda shaxsan hech narsa ko'rsatmagan; lekin hozir, u mening kamroq gumon qilishim kerak deb hisoblagan vaqtni kutgan holda, u menga men unga qilganimdan qo'rqqan narsani qilmoqchi emasdek tuyuladi, ya'ni, u xotinimni o'z xohishiga ko'ra olishga intiladi.

en: As I ﬁnd, he hath for some little time past secretly solicited her with sundry messages, all of which I have known from herself, and she hath made answer thereunto ac- cording as I have enjoined her.
uz: Aniqlashimcha, u bir oz vaqtdan beri uni turli xil xabarlar bilan yashirincha so'ragan, ularning hammasini o'zidan bilganman va u menga buyurganimdek javob berdi.

en: This very day, however, ere I came hither, I found in the house, in close conference with my wife, a woman whom I set down incontinent for that which she was, wherefore I called my wife and asked her what the woman wanted.
uz: Ammo aynan shu kuni, bu yerga kelishimdan oldin, uyda, xotinim bilan yaqin muloqotda, men uni o'ziga xos bo'lgani uchun ko'rib chiqmaslikka majbur qilgan bir ayolni topdim, shuning uchun xotinimga qo'ng'iroq qilib, ayol nima xohlashini so'radim.

en: Quoth she, “She is the agent of Filip- pello, with whom thou hast saddled me, by dint of making me answer him and give him hopes, and she saith that he will e’en know once for all what I mean to do and that, an I will, he would contrive for me to be privily at a bagnio in this city; nay, of this he prayeth and importuneth me; and hadst thou not, I know not why, caused me keep this trafﬁc with him, I would have rid myself of him after such a fashion that he should never more have looked whereas I might be.” Thereupon meseemed this was going too far and that it was no longer to be borne; and I bethought myself to tell it to you, so you might know how he requiteth that entire ﬁdelity of yours, whereby aforetime I was nigh upon death.
uz: U aytdi: U Filip-Pelloning agenti bolib, meni unga javob berishga undash va unga umidlar berish orqali unga ornini bosganingni aytdi. U aytdiki, u men nima qilishni butunlay biladi va men uni bu shaharda bagnioda maxfiy bolishga urinib koradi; yoq, u meni shu haqda ibodat qiladi va bezovta qiladi; va agar sen, bilmayman, nega, meni u bilan bu muomalaga sabab bolmading, men uni shunday yol bilan yoqotgan bolardimki, u men bolishim mumkin bolgan joyga hech qachon qaramasdi. Shunda bu juda uzoqqa ketayotganini va endi bardosh bera olmasligini angladim; va men ozimni senga aytishga oyladim, toki u olimning butun sadoqatini qanday talab qilishini bilsam, men...

en: And so you shall not believe this that I tell you to be words and fables, but may, whenas you have a mind thereto, openly both see and touch it, I caused my wife make this answer to her who awaited it, that she was ready to be at the bagnio in question to- morrow at none, whenas the folk sleep; with which the woman took leave of her, very well pleased.
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga so'zlar va ertaklar bo'lishini aytishimga ishonmaysiz, lekin balki, agar sizda bu haqda fikr bo'lsa, uni ochiqchasiga ko'ring va teging, men xotinimni buni kutgan odamga bu javobni aytishga majbur qildim, u ertaga hech qachon, xalq uxlagan paytda, tegishli bagnioda bo'lishga tayyor edi; bu bilan ayol undan ketdi, juda xursand edi.

en: Now methinketh not you believe that I will send
uz: Endi men yuboraman deb ishonmayapsizmi?

en: my wife thither; but, were I in your place, I would contrive that he should ﬁnd me there in the room of her he thinketh to meet, and whenas I had abid- den with him awhile, I would give him to know with whom he had been and render him such honour thereof as should beseem him; by which means methinketh you would do him such a shame that the affront he would fain put upon yourself and upon me would at one blow be avenged.’ Catella, hearing this, without anywise considering who it was that said it to her or suspecting his design, forthright, after the wont of jealous folk, gave credence to his words and fell a-ﬁtting to his story certain things that had already befallen; then, ﬁred with sudden anger, she answered that she would certainly do as he counselled —it was no such great matter —and that assuredly, if Filippello came thither, she would do him such a shame that it should still recur
uz: Xotinim u yerda edi; lekin, agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, u meni u bilan uchrashishni o'ylayotgan xonasida topishga harakat qilardim. Va men u bilan bir oz vaqt yashaganimdan so'ng, unga kim bilan bo'lganini aytib berardim va unga shunday hurmat ko'rsatardim, unga shunday hurmat ko'rsatardim; demak, siz unga shunday sharmandalik ko'rsatardingizki, u o'zingizga va menga bir zarba bilan qasos olmasdi.

en: to his mind, as often as he saw a woman.
uz: xayoliga, xuddi bir ayolni ko'rganidek.

en: Ricciardo, well pleased at this and himseeming his device was a good one and in a fair way of success, conﬁrmed her in her purpose with many other words and strengthened her belief in his story, praying her, natheless, never to say that she had heard it from him, the which she promised him on her troth.
uz: Ricciardo bundan juda xursand edi va uning qurilmasi yaxshi va ancha muvaffaqiyatli ko'rinardi, uni o'z maqsadiga ko'plab boshqa so'zlar bilan tasdiqladi va uning hikoyasiga bo'lgan ishonchini mustahkamladi, ammo uni hech qachon u undan eshitganini aytmaslikka iltijo qildi, bu haqda u unga va'da bergan edi.

en: Next morning, Ricciardo betook himself to a good woman, who kept the bagnio he had named to Catella, and telling her what he purposed to do, prayed her to further him therein as most she might.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Ritsardo o'zini yaxshi ayolga yaqinlashtirdi. U Katellaga nomlagan bagni saqlab qoldi va unga nima qilmoqchiligini aytdi, undan uni imkon qadar u yerga olib borishini so'radi.

en: The good woman, who was much beholden to him, answered that she would well and agreed with him what she should do and say.
uz: Yaxshi ayol, unga juda e'tiborli bo'lgani uchun, u yaxshi deb javob berdi va u bilan nima qilish va aytishi kerakligi haqida kelishib oldi.

en: Now in the house where the bagnio was she had a very dark chamber, for that no window gave thereon by which the light might enter.
uz: Endi bagnio turgan uyda uning juda qorong'u xonasi bor edi, chunki u yerga yorug'lik kiradigan hech qanday deraza berilmas edi.

en: This chamber she made ready and spread a bed there, as best she might, wherein Ricciardo, as soon as he had dined, laid himself and proceeded to await Catella.
uz: U bu xonani tayyorladi va imkon qadar u yerda karavot yotqizdi. Ricciardo ovqatdan keyin o'zini yotqizib, Katellaning kechasini kutishga kirishdi.

en: The latter, having heard Ricciardo’s words and giving more credence thereto than behoved her, returned in the evening, full of despite, to her house, whither Filippello also returned and being by chance full of other thought, maybe did not show her his usual fondness.
uz: Oxirgisi, Ricciardo'ning so'zlarini eshitib, unga kerak bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq ishonib, kechqurun, norozilik bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, uning uyiga qaytib keldi. Filippello ham u yerga qaytib, tasodifan boshqa fikrlarga to'lib-toshgan holda, balki unga odatdagi mehrini ko'rsatmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: When she saw this, her suspicions rose yet higher and she said in herself, ‘Forsooth, his mind is occupied with yonder lady with whom he thinketh to take his pleasure tomorrow; but of a surety this shall not come to pass.’ An in this thought she abode well nigh all that night, considering how she should bespeak him, whenas she should be with him [in the bagnio].
uz: Buni ko'rganida, uning shubhalari yanada kuchaydi va u o'ziga dedi: "Aytmoqchi bo'lsam, uning fikri ertaga o'zini xursand qiladigan bir ayol bilan band; lekin, albatta, bu sodir bo'lmaydi." Va shu fikrda u butun tun davomida unga qanday murojaat qilish kerakligini o'ylab, u bilan birga bo'lishi kerak bo'lganda, unga qanday murojaat qilish kerakligini o'ylab turdi.

en: What more [need I say]?
uz: Yana nima kerak?

en: The hour of none come, she took her waiting- woman and without anywise changing counsel, repaired to the bagnio that Ricciardo had named to her, and there ﬁnding the good woman, asked her if
uz: Hech kimga kerak bo'lmagan soat keldi, u o'zining kutgan ayolini oldi va hech qanday maslahat o'zgartirmasdan, Ricciardo unga nomlagan bagnoga qaytdi va u yerda yaxshi ayolni topib, undan so'radi:

en: Filippello had been there that day, whereupon quoth the other, who had been duly lessoned by Ricciardo, ‘Are you the lady that should come to speak with him?’ ‘Ay am I,’ answered Catella.
uz: Filippello o'sha kuni u yerda bo'lgan edi, shundan so'ng Ricciardo tomonidan tegishli ravishda o'rgatilgan boshqa bir kishi: "Sen u bilan gaplashish uchun kelishi kerak bo'lgan xonimmisan?" - "Ay men," dedi Katella.

en: ‘Then,’ said the woman, ‘get you in to him.’ Catella, who went seeking that which she would fain not have found, caused herself to be brought to the chamber where Ricciardo was and entering with covered head, locked herself in.
uz: Unda,  dedi ayol,  unga kir.  Katella, topolmagan narsasini qidirib borganida, o'zini Ricciardo yotgan xonaga olib kelishga majbur qildi va boshini yumshoq holda kirib, o'zini qamab oldi.

en: Ricciardo, seeing her enter, rose joyfully to his feet and catching her in his arms, said softly, ‘Welcome, my soul!’ Whilst she, the better to feign herself other than she was, clipped him and kissed him and made much of him, without saying a word, fearing to be known of him if she should speak.
uz: Ricciardo, uning kirganini ko'rib, xursand bo'lib oyoqlariga turdi va uni quchoqlab, sekin dedi: "Xush kelibsiz, jonim!" U esa, o'zini undan yaxshiroq ko'rsatib, uni urdi va o'pdi va bir so'z demasdan, agar gapirsa, u haqida ma'lum bo'lishdan qo'rqib, undan ko'p narsa qildi.

en: The chamber was very dark, wherewith each of them was well pleased, nor for long abiding there did the eyes recover more power.
uz: Xona juda qorong'i edi, ularning har biri undan juda mamnun edi, uzoq vaqt o'tirgach ham ko'zlar ko'proq kuchga ega bo'lmadi.

en: Ricciardo carried her to the bed and there, without speaking, lest their voices should betray them, they abode a long while, to the greater delight and pleasance of the one party than the other.
uz: Ricciardo uni karavotga olib bordi va u yerda, ularning ovozlari ularga xiyonat qilmasligi uchun gapirmadi, ular bir tomondan boshqa tomonga qaraganda ko'proq xursandchilik va rohatga erishish uchun uzoq vaqt turdilar.

en: But presently, it seeming to Catella time to vent the resentment she felt, she began, all aﬁre with rage and despite, to speak thus, ‘Alas, how wretched is women’s lot and how ill bestowed the love that many of them bear their husbands!
uz: Ammo hozirgi vaqtda, Katella o'zida his qilgan xafagarchilikni chiqarishga vaqt kelgandek tuyuldi, u g'azab bilan shiddat bilan gapira boshladi va shunga qaramay, shunday dedi: "Alas, ayollarning taqdiri naqadar achinarli va ularning ko'pchiligi erlariga bergan muhabbat naqadar yomon!"

en: I, unhappy that I am, these eight years have I loved thee more than my life, and thou, as I have felt, art all aﬁre and all con- sumed with love of a strange woman, wicked and perverse man that thou art!
uz: Men baxtsizman, shu sakkiz yil davomida seni hayotimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevdim, va sen, o'zimni his qilganimdek, butunlay olovda va butunlay begona ayol, yovuz va buzuq odamning muhabbati bilan to'lib-toshgan ekansan!

en: Now with whom thinkest thou to have been?
uz: Endi kim bilan bo'lgan deb o'ylayapsan?

en: Thou hast been with her whom thou hast too long beguiled with thy false blandishments, making a show of love to her and being enamoured elsewhere.
uz: Sen uzoq vaqtdan beri yolg'on masxarabozlaring bilan aldanib, unga muhabbat ko'rsatib, boshqa joyda oshiq bo'lganing uchun u bilan birga bo'lgan eding.

en: I am Catella, not Ric- ciardo’s wife, disloyal traitor that thou art!
uz: Men Katellaman, Ric-ciardo xotini emasman, sen sodiq bo'lmagan xoin ekansan!

en: Hearken if thou know my voice; it is indeed I; and it seemeth to me a thousand years till we be in the light, so I may shame thee as thou deservest, scurvy discredited cur that thou art!
uz: Agar mening ovozimni bilsang, eshit; bu haqiqatan ham menman; va menga ming yil ko'rinadi, toki biz nurda bo'lsak, seni haqli bo'lganingdek sharmanda qilsam, sen haqli bo'lganing uchun obro'sizlantirilgan la'nat bo'lsang!

en: To whom have I borne so much love these many years?
uz: Bu yillar davomida kimga bunchalik ko'p muhabbat ko'rsatdim?

en: To this disloyal dog, who, thinking to have a strange woman in his arms, hath lavished on me more caresses and more fondnesses in this little while I have been here with him than in all the rest of the time I have been his.
uz: Bu sadoqatsiz itga, uning qo'lida g'alati ayol bor deb o'ylagan, men u bilan shu yerda bo'lgan qisqa davrimda unga qolgan barcha vaqtlarimdagidan ko'ra ko'proq erkalash va mehr ko'rsatdi.

en: Thou hast been brisk enough today, renegade cur that thou art, that usest at home to show thyself so feeble and forspent and impotent; but, praised be God, thou hast tilled thine own ﬁeld and not, as thou thoughtest, that of an- other.
uz: Bugun sen yetarlicha tezkor bo'lding, o'zingdan voz kechding, uyda o'zingni shunchalik zaif, beparvo va ojiz ko'rsatish uchun o'zingdan voz kechding; lekin, Xudoga hamd bo'lsin, sen o'z dalasanni terding, o'ylaganingdek, boshqa birovning dalasini emas.

en: No wonder thou camest not anigh me yesternight; thou lookedst to discharge thee of thy lading elsewhere and wouldst fain come fresh to the battle; but, thanks to God and my own foresight, the stream hath e’en run in
uz: Ajab emas, kecha menga yaqin kelmading; boshqa joyda o'z yukingdan ozod bo'lishni va jangga yangi kelishni xohlarding; lekin, Xudoga va o'z ko'rishimga shukr, oqim oqib ketdi.

en: Why answerest thou not, wicked man?
uz: Nega javob bermaysan, ey yovuz odam?

en: Why sayst thou not somewhat?
uz: Nega biroz demaysiz?

en: Art thou grown dumb, hearing me?
uz: Meni eshitib, ahmoq bo'lib qoldingmi?

en: Cock’s faith, I know not what hindereth me from thrusting my hands into thine eyes and tearing them out for thee.
uz: Xo'rozning ishonchi, qo'llarimni ko'zlaringga tiqish va ularni senga yirtib tashlashdan meni nima to'sqinlik qilayotganini bilmayman.

en: Thou thoughtest to do this treason very secretly; but, perdie, one knoweth as much as another; thou hast not availed to compass thine end; I have had better beagles at thy heels than thou thoughtest.’ Ricciardo inwardly rejoiced at these words and without making any reply, clipped her and kissed her and fondled her more than ever; whereupon quoth she, following on her speech, ‘Ay, thou thinkest to cajole me with thy feigned caresses, fashious dog that thou art, and to appease and console me; but thou art mistaken; I shall never be comforted for this till I have put thee to shame therefor in the presence of all our friends and kins- men and neighbours.
uz: Sen bu xiyonatni juda yashirincha qilmoqchisan; lekin, afsuski, birov boshqa birov kabi ko'p narsani biladi; sen o'z oxiringni qamrab olishga muvaffaq bo'lmading; men sen o'ylaganingdan ko'ra yaxshiroq poshnali oyoq kiyimga ega bo'ldim." Ricciardo bu so'zlardan ich-ichidan xursand bo'ldi va hech qanday javob bermasdan, uni urdi, o'pdi va uni har qachongidan ham ko'proq erkaladi; shundan so'ng u so'zlariga amal qilib: "Ey, sen meni o'zingni soxta erkalaring, moda it ekanliging bilan bezovta qilmoqchisan, meni tinchlantirish va tasalli bermoqchisan, lekin sen adashding; men hech qachon bundan hech qachon tasalli topilmayman, toki do'stlarimiz, qarindoshlarimiz va qo'shnilarimiz oldida sharmanda qilmagunimcha.

en: Am I not as fair as Ricciardo’s wife, thou villain?
uz: Men Ricciardo'ning xotini kabi go'zal emasmanmi, ey yovuz odam?

en: Am I not as good a gentlewoman?
uz: Men unchalik yaxshi janob ayol emasmanmi?

en: Why dost thou not answer, thou sorry dog?
uz: Nega javob bermaysan, ey achinarli it?

en: What hath she more than I?
uz: Uning mendan ko'ra ko'proq nimasi bor?

en: Keep thy distance; touch me not; thou hast done enough feats of arms for today.
uz: Masofangizni saqlang; menga tegmang; bugungi kun uchun qurol-yarog' harakatlarini yetarli darajada qildingiz.

en: Now thou knowest who I am, I am well assured that all thou couldst do would be perforce; but, so God grant me grace, I will yet cause thee suffer want thereof, and I know not what hindereth me from sending for Ricciardo, who hath loved me more than himself and could never boast that I once even looked at him; nor know I what harm it were to do it.
uz: Endi sen kimligimni bilasan, men sening qo'lingdan keladigan hamma narsa kuch bilan amalga oshishiga aminman; lekin, agar Xudo menga inoyat bersa, men seni bundan mahrum qilaman, va menga o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevgan va unga bir marta ham qaraganim haqida hech qachon maqtanolmagan Ricciardo'ni yuborishdan nima to'sqinligini bilmayman; shuningdek, bunga qanday zarar yetkazganimni ham bilmayman.

en: Thou thoughtest to have his wife here and it is as if thou hadst had her, inasmuch as it is none of thy fault that the thing hath miscarried; wherefore, were I to have himself, thou couldst not with reason blame me.’ Brief, many were the lady’s words and sore her complaining.
uz: Siz uning xotini bu yerda bor deb o'ylayapsiz va go'yo uni olganingizdek tuyuladi, chunki bu narsa homilador bo'lishda sizning aybing yo'q; shuning uchun, agar men o'zimga ega bo'lsam, meni oqilona ayblay olmas edingiz." Qisqacha qilib aytganda, xonimning so'zlari ko'p edi va uning shikoyat qilishi juda achinarli edi.

en: However, at last, Ricciardo, bethinking himself that, an he let her go in that belief, much ill might ensue thereof, determined to discover himself and undeceive her; wherefore, catching her in his arms and holding her fast, so she might not get away, he said, ‘Sweet my soul, be not angered; that which I could not have of you by simply loving you, Love hath taught me to obtain by prac- tice; and I am your Ricciardo.’ Catella, hearing this and knowing him by the voice, would have thrown herself incontinent out of bed, but could not; whereupon she offered to cry out; but Ricciardo stopped her mouth with one hand and said, ‘Madam, this that hath been may henceforth on nowise be undone, though you should cry all the days of your life; and if you cry out or cause this ever anywise to be known of anyone, two things will come thereof; the one (which should no little concern you) will be that
uz: Ammo, nihoyat, Ritsardo o'zini shunday deb o'yladi: agar u uni shu e'tiqodga qo'yib yuborsa, undan ko'p yomonliklar kelib chiqishi mumkin edi. Shuning uchun, o'zini topishga va uni aldashga qaror qildi. Shuning uchun, uni quchoqlab, ushlab, qochib ketmasligi uchun, u dedi: "Siziq jonim, g'azablanma; seni shunchaki sevish orqali sizdan ololmagan narsa, sevgi meni amaliyot orqali olishni o'rgatdi; va men sizning Ritsardoningman." Katella buni eshitib va uni ovozi bilan, o'zini bemalol to'xtatib, yig'lashni taklif qildi, lekin u yerda emas; lekin Ritsardo bir qo'li bilan og'zini to'xtatdi va dedi: "Xonim, bu hozirgacha hech narsa bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, garchi siz hayotingizning barcha kunlari davomida shunday bo'lsa ham; va agar siz hech kim yig'lamasligi kerak edi,

en: your hon-
uz: Sizning hurmatingiz...

en: our and fair fame will be marred, for that, albeit you may avouch that I brought you hither by practice, I shall say that it is not true, nay, that I caused you come hither for monies and gifts that I promised you, whereof for that I gave you not so largely as you hoped, you waxed angry and made all this talk and this outcry; and you know that folk are more apt to credit ill than good, wherefore I shall more readily be believed than you.
uz: Bizning va adolatli shuhratimiz buziladi, chunki, garchi siz sizni bu yerga amaliyot orqali olib kelganimni anglasangiz ham, men aytamanki, bu rost emas, balki men sizni bu yerga sizga va'da qilgan pul va sovg'alar uchun olib kelganman, shuning uchun men sizga siz kutganingizdek ko'p bermadim, shuning uchun g'azablandingiz va bu gap va bu hayqiriqlarni keltirdingiz; va bilasizki, odamlar yaxshilikdan ko'ra yomonni ko'proq qabul qilishadi, shuning uchun men sizga ko'proq ishonaman.

en: Secondly, there will ensue thereof a mortal enmity between your husband and myself, and it may as well happen that I shall kill him as he me, in which case you are never after like to be happy or content.
uz: Ikkinchidan, bu sizning eringiz va men o'rtasida o'lim dushmanligi paydo bo'ladi va men uni o'zim kabi o'ldirishim mumkin, bunday holatda siz hech qachon baxtli yoki qoniqmaysiz.

en: Wherefore, heart of my body, go not about at once to dishonour yourself and to cast your husband and myself into strife and peril.
uz: Shuning uchun, tanamning yuragi, o'zingni sharmanda qilish va eringni hamda o'zimni janjal va xavfga solishga darhol borma.

en: You are not the ﬁrst woman, nor will you be the last, who hath been deceived, nor have I in this practised upon you to bereave you of your own, but for the exceeding love that I bear you and am minded ever to bear you and to be your most humble servant.
uz: Sen birinchi ayol emassan, aldangan oxirgi ayol ham bo'lmaysan, va men senga bu ishda seni o'zingdan mahrum qilishga o'rgatmadim, balki senga bo'lgan cheksiz muhabbatim uchun va seni doimo ko'tarib yurish va eng kamtar xizmatkoring bo'lish niyatidaman.

en: And although it is long since I and all that I possess or can or am worth have been yours and at your service, henceforward I purpose that they shall be more than ever so.
uz: Va garchi men va menda bor, mumkin yoki arziydigan barcha narsalar seniki bo'lib, sening xizmatingda bo'lganiga ancha bo'lsa ham, bundan buyon ular har qachongidan ham ko'proq bo'lishini niyat qilaman.

en: Now, you are well advised in other things and so I am certain you will be in this.’ Catella, what while Ricciardo spoke thus, wept sore, but, albeit she was sore provoked and complained grievously, nevertheless, her reason allowed so much force to his true words that she knew it to be possible that it should happen as he said; wherefore quoth she, ‘Ricciardo, I know not how God will vouchsafe me strength to suffer the affront and the cheat thou hast put upon me; I will well to make no outcry here whither my simplicity and overmuch jealousy have brought me; but of this be assured that I shall never be content till one way or another I see myself avenged of this thou hast done to me.
uz: Endi senga boshqa narsalarda ham yaxshi maslahat berilgan va shuning uchun men bunga aminman." Katella, Ritsardo shunday deb aytganida, achchiq yig'ladi, lekin, garchi u qattiq jahldor bo'lib, achchiqlanayotgan bo'lsa ham, uning aqli uning haqiqiy so'zlariga shunchalik kuch berdi, u uning aytganidek bo'lishi mumkinligini bilardi; shuning uchun u aytdi: "Ritsardo, men Xudo menga sening menga qilgan haqorat va aldovga bardosh berish uchun qanday kuch berishini bilmayman; men bu yerda mening soddaligim va haddan tashqari rashkim meni olib kelgan joyga hech qanday shikoyat qilmayman; lekin shunga amin bo'lingki, men hech qachon bir yo'l bilan qoniq bo'lmayman, toki sen bu ishdan o'zimga qasos olmaguncha.

en: Wherefore, leave me, hold me no longer; thou hast had that which thou desiredst and hast tumbled me to thy heart’s content; it is time to leave me; let me go, I prithee.’ Ricciardo, seeing her mind yet overmuch disordered, had laid it to heart never to leave her till he had gotten his pardon of her; wherefore, studying with the softest words to appease her, he so bespoke and so entreated and so conjured her that she was prevailed upon to make peace with him, and of like accord they abode together a great while thereafter in the utmost de- light.
uz: Shuning uchun, meni tashla, meni ushlab turma; sen xohlagan narsangni olding va meni yuragingga tashlading; meni tashlab ketish vaqti keldi; meni qo'yib yubor, azizim bor." Ricciardo uning aqli hali ham juda tartibsiz ekanligini ko'rib, uni kechirim olmaguncha hech qachon tark etmaslikka qaror qildi; shuning uchun, uni tinchlantirish uchun eng yumshoq so'zlar bilan o'rganib, u uni shunday urdi va shunday yolvordi, toki u bilan tinchlik o'rnatishga muvaffaq bo'ldi va shunga o'xshab, ular keyinchalik eng yorug'likda uzoq vaqt birga yashadilar.

en: Moreover, Catella, having thus learned how much more savoury were the lover’s kisses than those of the husband and her former rigour being changed into kind love-liking for Ricciardo, from that day forth she loved
uz: Qolaversa, Katella, oshiqning o'pishlari eridan qanchalik mazali ekanligini va uning sobiq qat'iyatining Ricciardoga mehribon sevgiga aylanishini bilib, o'sha kundan boshlab sevdi.

en: him very tenderly and thereafter, ordering themselves with the utmost dis- cretion, they many a time had joyance of their loves.
uz: Uni juda mehribonlik bilan qabul qildilar va keyin, o'zlarini eng katta e'tibor bilan tartibga solib, ko'p vaqt davomida o'z muhabbatlaridan zavq olishdi.

en: God grant us to enjoy ours!”
uz: Xudo bizga biznikidan zavqlanishimizni bersin!

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Tedaldo Elisei, having fallen out with his mistress, departeth Florence and returning thither, after awhile, in a pilgrim’s favour, speaketh with the lady and maketh her cognisant of her error; after which he delivereth her husband, who had been convicted of murdering him, from death and reconciling him with his brethren, thenceforward discreetly enjoyeth himself with his mistress.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Tedaldo Elisey o'z bekasi bilan kelishmovchilikka uchraganidan so'ng, Florensiyadan jo'nab, u yerga qaytib keladi, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, ziyoratkorning marhamatiga ko'ra, bekasi bilan gaplashadi va uning xatosi haqida xabardor qiladi; shundan so'ng u o'ldirganlikda ayblangan erini o'limdan qutqaradi va uni birodarlari bilan yarashtiradi, shundan keyin yashirincha bekasi bilan o'zini rohatlantiradi.

en: Fiammetta being now silent, commended of all, the queen, to lose no time, forthright committed the burden of discourse to Emilia, who began thus: “It pleaseth me to return to our city, whence it pleased the last two speakers to depart, and to show you how a townsman of ours regained his lost mistress.
uz: Fiammetta endi jim bo'lib, hammaga maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan holda, hech qanday vaqtni yo'qotmaslik uchun, Emiliyaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq yukini yukladi. Emilia shunday boshladi: "Menga oxirgi ikki notiqning ketgan shahrimizga qaytishdan mamnun bo'ldim va sizga bir shaharchimiz yo'qolgan bekasini qanday tiklaganini ko'rsatishdan xursandman."

en: There was, then, in Florence a noble youth, whose name was Tedaldo Elisei and who, being beyond measure enamoured of a lady called Madam Ermellina, the wife of one Aldobrandino Palermini, deserved for his praise- worthy fashions, to enjoy his desire.
uz: O'shanda Florensiyada Tedaldo Elisey ismli olijanob bir yosh yigit bor edi va u Madam Ermellina ismli xonimga cheksiz oshiq edi, Aldobrandino Palerminiyning xotini, uning maqtovga loyiq modalari uchun, uning istaklaridan bahramand bo'lishga loyiq edi.

en: However, Fortune, the enemy of the happy, denied him this solace, for that, whatever might have been the cause, the lady, after complying awhile with Tedaldo’s wishes, suddenly altogether withdrew her good graces from him and not only refused to hearken to any message of his, but would on no wise see him; wherefore he fell into a dire and cruel melancholy; but his love for her had been so hidden that none guessed it to be the cause of his chagrin.
uz: Biroq, baxtlilarning dushmani bo'lgan omad unga bu tasalli berishni rad etdi, chunki buning sababi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, xonim Tedaldo'ning istaklariga biroz rozi bo'lgandan so'ng, birdaniga undan o'z yaxshiliklarini qaytarib oldi va nafaqat uning har qanday xabarini eshitishdan bosh tortdi, balki uni hech qanday yo'l bilan ko'rmadi; shuning uchun u qattiq va shafqatsiz qayg'uga tushdi; lekin uning unga bo'lgan muhabbati shunchalik yashirilgan ediki, hech kim buni uning xafaligi sababi deb hisoblamadi.

en: After he had in divers ways stud- ied amain to recover the love himseemed he had lost without his fault and ﬁnding all his labour vain, he resolved to withdraw from the world, that he might not afford her who was the cause of his ill the pleasure of seeing him pine away; wherefore, without saying aught to friend or kinsman, save to a comrade of his, who knew all, he took such monies as he might avail to have and departing secretly, came to Ancona, where, under the name of Fil-
uz: U turli yo'llar bilan o'zi aybsiz yo'qotgandek tuyulgan muhabbatni qaytarib olishga urinib, butun mehnatini behuda topgach, o'z kasalligiga sabab bo'lgan unga azob chekish zavqini bermaslik uchun dunyodan chekinib ketishga qaror qildi; shuning uchun, do'stiga yoki qarindoshiga hech narsa demasdan, hamma narsani biladigan o'zining o'rtoqidan boshqa hech narsa demasdan, o'ziga yetadigan pulni olib, yashirincha jo'nab, Ankonga keldi, u yerda, Fil nomi ostida...

en: ippo di Sanlodeccio, he made acquaintance with a rich merchant and taking service with him, accompanied him to Cyprus on board a ship of his.
uz: Ippo di Sanlodeccio, u bir boy savdogar bilan tanishdi va u bilan xizmat olib, uni Kiprga o'z kemasida hamroh qildi.

en: His manners and behaviour so pleased the merchant that he not only as- signed him a good wage, but made him in part his associate and put into his hands a great part of his affairs, which he ordered so well and so diligently that in a few years he himself became a rich and famous and considerable merchant; and albeit, in the midst of these his dealings, he oft remembered him of his cruel mistress and was grievously tormented of love and yearned sore to look on her again, such was his constancy that seven years long he got the better of the battle.
uz: Uning odob-axloqi va xulq-atvori savdogarga shunchalik yoqdiki, u nafaqat unga yaxshi maosh qo'shdi, balki uni qisman hamkoriga aylantirdi va ishlarining katta qismini o'z qo'liga topshirdi. U buni shunchalik yaxshi va astoydil tartibga soldi, hatto bir necha yil ichida o'zi ham boy va mashhur va sezilarli savdogarga aylandi; va garchi, bu ishlarining o'rtasida u uni shafqatsiz bekasi haqida ko'p eslardi, muhabbatdan qattiq azob chekardi va unga yana qayg'urish istagida edi, uning yetti yil davomida jangdan ustun bo'lishiga sabab bo'ldi.

en: But, chancing one day to hear sing in Cyprus a song that himself had made aforetime and wherein was recounted the love he bore his mistress and she him and the pleasure he had of her, and think- ing it could not be she had forgotten him, he ﬂamed up into such a passion of desire to see her again that, unable to endure longer, he resolved to return to Florence.
uz: Ammo, bir kun kelib Kiprda o'zi ilgari yaratgan qo'shiqni eshitib qolish ehtimoli paydo bo'ldi va unda u o'z bekasiga va unga bo'lgan muhabbati, unga bo'lgan zavqi va uni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emasligini o'ylab, u uni yana ko'rishga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan yonib ketdi, uzoqroq chiday olmasdan, Florensiyaga qaytishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, having set all his affairs in order, he betook himself with one only servant to Ancona and transporting all his good thither, despatched it to Florence to a friend of the Anconese his partner, whilst he himself, in the disguise of a pilgrim returning from the Holy Sepulchre, followed secretly after with his servant and coming to Florence, put up at a little hostelry kept by two brothers, in the neighbourhood of his mistress’s house, whereto he repaired ﬁrst of all, to see her, an he might.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, barcha ishlarini tartibga solib, u o'zini birgina xizmatkor bilan Ankonga olib bordi va butun mol-mulkini u yerga tashdi, uni Florensiyaga Ankonlik sherikining do'stiga jo'natdi. O'zi esa, Muqaddas Qabrdan qaytgan ziyoratchi qiyofasida, xizmatkorini yashirincha kuzatib, Florensiyaga kelib, ikki aka-uka tomonidan saqlanadigan kichik xostelyaga joylashdi, xo'jayining uyi yaqinida, u yerda birinchi navbatda uni ko'rish uchun ta'mirladi.

en: However, he found the windows and doors and all else closed, wherefore his heart misgave him she was dead or had removed thence and he betook himself, in great con- cern, to the house of his brethren, before which he saw four of the latter clad all in black.
uz: Ammo u derazalar, eshiklar va boshqa hamma narsani yopiq deb topdi, shuning uchun uning yuragi uni o'lgan yoki u yerdan ko'chirilgan deb ishontirdi va u o'zini katta tashvish bilan birodarlarining uyiga olib bordi, uning oldida ularning to'rttasi qora kiyimda edi.

en: At this he marvelled exceedingly and knowing himself so changed both in habit and person from that which he was used to be, when- as he departed thence, that he might not lightly be recognized, he boldly ac- costed a cordwainer hard by and asked him why they were clad in black; whereto he answered, ‘Yonder men are clad in black for that it is not yet a fortnight since a brother of theirs, who had not been here this great while, was murdered, and I understand they have proved to the court that one Al- dobrandino Palermini, who is in prison, slew him, for that he was a well- wisher of his wife and had returned hither unknown to be with her.’ Tedaldo marvelled exceedingly that anyone should so resemble him as to be taken for him and was grieved for Aldobrandino’s ill fortune.
uz: Shunda u juda hayratda qoldi va o'zini odatdagidan ham, odatdagidan ham o'zgartirganini bildi. U o'sha yerdan ketayotganda, uni yengil tanimaslik uchun, u jasorat bilan arqon to'quvchiga qattiq urdi va undan nega ular qora rangda kiyinganini so'radi. U javob berdi: "Yana erkaklar qora rangda kiyingan, chunki ularning birodari, bu vaqt ichida bu yerda bo'lmagan, o'ldirilganiga hali o'n besh kun bo'lmadi, va men tushunamanki, ular sudga qamoqda bo'lgan Al-Andino Palermini uni o'ldirgan, chunki u xotiniga yaxshi niyat qilgan va u bilan birga bo'lishga qaytgan edi."

en: Then, hav- ing learned that the lady was alive and well and it being now night, he re-
uz: Keyin, xonim tirik va sog'lom ekanligini va endi tun bo'lgani uchun, u...

en: turned, full of various thoughts, to the inn and having supped with his ser- vant, was put to sleep well nigh at the top of the house.
uz: Turli xil o'ylarga to'la mehmonxonaga burilib, ser-vent bilan ovqatlanib, uyning tepasida yaxshi uxlatildi.

en: There, what with the many thoughts that stirred him and the badness of the bed and peradventure also by reason of the supper, which had been meagre, half the night passed whilst he had not yet been able to fall asleep; wherefore, being awake, him- seemed about midnight he heard folk come down into the house from the roof, and after through the chinks of the chamber-door he saw a light come up thither.
uz: U yerda, uni qo'zg'atgan ko'p o'ylar va karavotning yomonligi va kechki ovqatning kamligi tufayli sodir bo'lgan voqealar bilan birga, tunning yarmi hali uxlay olmagan holda o'tdi; shuning uchun, uyg'oq bo'lgan holda, u taxminan yarim tunda odamlarning tomdan uyga tushayotganini eshitdi va xonaning eshigidan o'tib, u yerga nur chiqayotganini ko'rdi.

en: Thereupon he stole softly to the door and putting his eye to the chink, fell a-spying what this might mean and saw a comely enough lass who held the light, whilst three men, who had come down from the roof, made towards her; and after some greetings had passed between them, one of them said to the girl, ‘Henceforth, praised be God, we may abide secure, since we know now for certain that the death of Tedaldo Elisei hath been proved by his brethren against Aldobrandino Palermini, who hath confessed thereto, and judgment is now recorded; nevertheless, it behoveth to keep strict silence, for that, should it ever become known that it was we [who slew him], we shall be in the same danger as is Aldobrandino.’ Having thus bespoken the woman, who showed herself much rejoiced thereat, they left her and going below, betook themselves to bed.
uz: Shundan so'ng u eshikga sekin yugurdi va ko'zini cho'g'ga qaratdi, bu nimani anglatishini kuzatdi va chiroqni ushlab turgan chiroyli qizni ko'rdi. Uchta erkak tomdan tushib, unga qarab turishdi. Ularning orasida salomlar o'tgach, ulardan biri qizga dedi: "Endi, Xudoga hamd bo'lsin, biz xavfsiz yashay olamiz, chunki biz endi aniq bilamizki, Tedaldo El betoiseyning o'limi Aldobrandino Palerminiga qarshi uning birodarlari tomonidan isbotlangan, u bunga iqror bo'ldi va hukm hozir yozib qo'yilgan; ammo, agar u biz ekanligi ma'lum bo'lsa, biz ham xuddi Aldobrandino kabi xavf ostida bo'lamiz."

en: Tedaldo, hearing this, fell a-considering how many and how great are the errors which may befall the minds of men, bethinking him ﬁrst of his broth- ers who had bewept and buried a stranger in his stead and after of the inno- cent man accused on false suspicion and brought by untrue witness to the point of death, no less than of the blind severity of laws and rulers, who oft- times, under cover of diligent investigation of the truth, cause, by their cruelties, prove that which is false and style themselves ministers of justice and of God, whereas indeed they are executors of iniquity and of the devil; after which he turned his thought to the deliverance of Aldobrandino and determined in himself what he should do.
uz: Tedaldo buni eshitib, odamlarning ongiga tushishi mumkin bo'lgan xatolar qanchalik ko'p va qanchalik ulkan ekanligini o'ylab, avval o'z o'rniga begona odamni ko'mib ko'mgan va ko'mib tashlagan sho'rvachchalarini, keyin esa yolg'on gumonda ayblangan va yolg'on guvohlik bilan o'limga olib kelgan yuzlab odamlarni o'ylab, ko'pincha, haqiqatni astoydil o'rganish ostida, o'z shafqatsizliklari bilan o'zlarini adolat va Xudoning soxta va uslubi xizmatkorlari ekanligini isbotlaydigan qonunlar va hukmdorlarning ko'r-ko'rona qat'iyligidan kam bo'lmasdan, ular aslida yovuzlik va shaytonning ijrochilari ekanliklarini ko'rsatdi; keyin esa o'z fikrini Aldobrandinning ozod etilishiga qaratdi va o'zida nima qilish kerakligini aniqladi.

en: Accordingly, arising in the morn- ing, he left his servant at the inn and betook himself alone, whenas it seemed to him time, to the house of his mistress, where, chancing to ﬁnd the door open, he entered in and saw the lady seated, all full of tears and bitterness of soul, in a little ground ﬂoor room that was there.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ertalab turib, u xizmatkorini mehmonxonada qoldirdi va o'zini yolg'iz o'tkazdi. Vaqti kelganda, xo'jayinasining uyiga bordi. U yerda eshik ochiqligini topishga shoshildi va xonimning ko'z yoshlari va qalb achchiqligi bilan o'tirganini ko'rdi, u yerda joylashgan kichik birinchi qavat xonasida.

en: At this sight he was like to weep for compassion of her and drawing near to her, said, ‘Madam, afﬂict not yourself; your peace is at hand.’ The lady, hearing this, lifted her eyes and said, weeping, ‘Good man, thou seemest to me a stranger pilgrim; what knowest thou of my peace or of my afﬂiction?’
uz: Bu ko'rinishda u unga rahm-shafqat bilan yig'lagandek edi va unga yaqinlashib, dedi: "Xonim, o'zingizni azoblamang; tinchligingiz yaqinlashdi." Buni eshitgan xonim ko'zlarini ko'tardi va yig'lab dedi: "Yaxshi inson, menga begona ziyoratchiga o'xshaysiz; mening tinchligim yoki azobim haqida nima bilasiz?"

en: ‘Madam,’ answered Tedaldo, ‘I am of Constantinople and am but now come hither, being sent of God to turn your tears into laughter and to deliver your husband from death.’ Quoth she, ‘An thou be of Constantinople and newly come hither, how knowest thou who I am or who is my husband?’ Thereupon, the pilgrim beginning from the beginning, recounted to her the whole history of Aldobrandino’s troubles and told her who she was and how long she had been married and other things which he very well knew of her affairs; whereat she marvelled exceedingly and holding him for a prophet, fell on her knees at his feet, beseeching him for God’s sake, an he were come for Aldobrandino’s salvation, to despatch, for that the time was short.
uz: Xonim,  javob berdi Tedaldo, Men Konstantinopoldanman va hozirgina bu yerga keldim, Xudo sizning koz yoshlaringizni kulguga aylantirish va eringizni olimdan qutqarish uchun yuborgan. U aytdi: Sen Konstantinopoldan bolsang-u, bu yerga yangi keldingmi, men kimligimni yoki erim kimligini qanday bilasan? Shundan song, ziyoratchi boshidanoq unga Aldobrandinoning butun tashvishlarini aytib berdi va u kim ekanligini, u qancha vaqt turmushga chiqqanini va uning ishlaridan juda yaxshi bilgan boshqa narsalarni aytdi.

en: The pilgrim, feigning himself a very holy man, said, ‘Madam, arise and weep not, but hearken well to that which I shall say to you and take good care never to tell it to any.
uz: Ziyoratchi o'zini juda muqaddas odamdek ko'rsatib, dedi: "Xonim, tur va yig'lama, balki senga aytayotgan gaplarimga yaxshilab quloq sol va hech kimga aytmaslikka ehtiyot bo'l."

en: According to that which God hath revealed unto me, the tribulation wherein you now are hath betided you because of a sin committed by you aforetime, which God the Lord hath chosen in part to purge with this present annoy and will have altogether amended of you; else will you fall into far greater afﬂiction.’ ‘Sir,’ answered the lady, ‘I have many sins and know not which one, more than another, God the Lord would have me amend; wherefore, an you know it, tell me and I will do what I may to amend it.’ ‘Madam,’ rejoined the pilgrim, ‘I know well enough what it is, nor do I question you thereof the better to know it, but to the intent that, telling it yourself, you may have the more remorse thereof.
uz: Xudo menga ma'lum qilganidek, siz hozirda duch kelayotgan musibat sizga oldindan sodir etgan gunohingiz tufayli keldi. Xudo Rabbiy hozirgi g'azab bilan tozalash uchun qisman tanlagan va sizni butunlay tuzatadi; aks holda siz yanada katta musibatga duch kelasiz.  Janob,  javob berdi xonim, Menda ko'p gunohlar bor va Rabbiy meni qaysi birini, boshqasidan ko'proq, tuzatishni xohlashini bilmayman; shuning uchun, siz buni bilasiz, menga ayting va men uni tuzatish uchun nima qilishim mumkinligini qilasiz. Xonim,  dedi ziyoratchi, Men bu nima ekanligini yaxshi bilaman, men sizni undan yaxshiroq bilishga undamayman, lekin siz buni o'zingiz aytishingiz uchun ko'proq pushaymon qilishingiz mumkin.

en: But let us come to the fact; tell me, do you remember, ever to have had a lover?’ The lady, hearing this, heaved a deep sigh and marvelled sore, supposing none had ever known it, albeit, in the days when he was slain who had been buried for Tedaldo, there had been some whispering thereof, for certain words not very discreetly used by Tedaldo’s conﬁdant, who knew it; then answered, ‘I see that God discovereth unto you all men’s secrets, wherefore I am resolved not to hide mine own from you.
uz: Lekin keling, haqiqatga kelaylik; ayting-chi, eslaysizmi, hech qachon sevgilisi bo'lganmisiz? Buni eshitib, xonim chuqur ingradi va hayratda qoldi, hech kim buni bilmagan deb o'yladi, garchi u o'ldirilgan kunlarda, u Tedaldo uchun dafn etilgan bo'lsa ham, ba'zi shivirlar tarqalgan edi, chunki Tedaldo'ning maxfiyasi uni juda yashirincha ishlatmagan ba'zi so'zlar bor edi, u buni bilardi; keyin javob berdi: Men Xudo barcha odamlarning sirlarini sizga ochib berishini ko'ryapman, shuning uchun men o'zimning sirimni sizlardan yashirmaslikka qaror qildim.

en: True it is that in my youth I loved over all the ill-fortuned youth whose death is laid to my husband’s charge, which death I have bewept as sore as it was grievous to me, for that, albeit I showed myself harsh and cruel to him before his departure, yet neither his long absence nor his unhappy death hath availed to tear him from my heart.’ Quoth the pilgrim, ‘The hapless youth who is dead you nev- er loved, but Tedaldo Elisei ay.178 But tell me, what was the occasion of your falling out with him?
uz: Rostini aytsam, yoshligimda erimning o'limiga yuklangan barcha baxtsiz yoshlarni sevardim, bu o'lim menga qanchalik og'riqli bo'lsa, shunchalik qattiq va shafqatsiz ko'rsatgan bo'lsam ham, uning uzoq yo'qligi ham, baxtsiz o'limi ham uni yuragimdan yirtishga yordam bermadi." Hajjo'r aytdi: "O'lgan baxtsiz yoshni sevmading, lekin Tedaldo Elisei ay."

en: Did he ever give you any offence?’ ‘Certes, no,’
uz: U sizga hech qachon hech qanday haqorat qilganmi? Albatta, yoq,

en: replied she; ‘he never offended against me; the cause of the breach was the prate of an accursed friar, to whom I once confessed me and who, when I told him of the love I bore Tedaldo and the privacy I had with him, made such a racket about my ears that I tremble yet to think of it, telling me that, an I desisted not therefrom, I should go in the devil’s mouth to the deepest deep of hell and there be cast into everlasting ﬁre; whereupon there entered into me such a fear that I altogether determined to forswear all further con- verse with him, and that I might have no occasion therefor, I would no longer receive his letters or messages; albeit I believe, had he persevered awhile, instead of getting him gone (as I presume) in despair, that, seeing him, as I did, waste away like snow in the sun, my harsh resolve would have yielded, for that I had no greater desire in the world.’ ‘Madam,’
uz: U javob berdi:  u menga hech qachon xafa bo'lmadi; buzilish sababi bir la'nati rohibning qasamyodi edi, men uni bir vaqtlar tan olganman va men unga Tedaldoga bo'lgan muhabbatim va u bilan bo'lgan shaxsiy hayotim haqida aytganimda, quloqlarimga shunday shovqin soldi, men hali ham bu haqda o'ylamayman, menga aytdi, agar men undan voz kechmaganimda, shaytonning og'ziga eng chuqur do'zaxga kirib, abadiy olovga tashlanishi kerak edi; shundan so'ng shunday qo'rquv ichimga kirdiki, men u bilan yanada ko'proq yolg'on gapirishga qaror qildim va u yerda uning xatlari yoki xabarlarini olmasligim mumkin edi; garchi, u undan voz kechmagan bo'lsam ham, men uni ko'rib, men...

en: rejoined the pilgrim, ‘it is this sin alone that now afﬂicteth you.
uz: Ziyoratchi yana javob berdi: Seni hozir faqat shu gunoh tashvishga solayapti.

en: I know for certain that Tedaldo did you no manner of violence; whenas you fell in love with him, you did it of your own free will, for that he pleased you; and as you yourself would have it, he came to you and enjoyed your privacy, wherein both with words and deeds you showed him such com- plaisance that, if he loved you before, you caused his love redouble a thou- sandfold.
uz: Men aniq bilaman, Tedaldo senga hech qanday zo'ravonlik qilmagan; qachonki uni sevib qolganingda, uni o'zing xohlaganing bilan qilgan eding, chunki u senga yoqdi; va o'zing xohlaganingdek, u senga keldi va shaxsiy hayotingdan zavq oldi, bunda so'z va amallar bilan unga shunday zavq ko'rsatdingki, agar u seni avval sevgan bo'lsa, sen uning muhabbatini bir necha barobar ko'paytirding.

en: And this being so (as I know it was) what cause should have availed to move you so harshly to withdraw yourself from him?
uz: Va bu shunday bo'lgani uchun (men bilganimdek) sizni undan voz kechishga bunchalik qattiq turtki berishga nima sabab bo'lishi kerak edi?

en: These things should be pondered awhile beforehand and if you think you may presently have cause to repent thereof, as of ill doing, you ought not to do them.
uz: Bu narsalar oldindan o'ylangan bo'lishi kerak va agar sizda hozirda tavba qilishga sabab bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylasangiz, yomonlik qilganingiz uchun ularni qilmasligingiz kerak.

en: You might, at your pleasure, have ordained of him, as of that which belonged to you, that he should no longer be yours; but to go about to de- prive him of yourself, you who were his, was a theft and an unseemly thing, whenas it was not his will.
uz: Siz, xohlaganingizcha, undan o'zingizga tegishli bo'lgan narsani, endi sizniki bo'lmasligini buyurishingiz mumkin edi; lekin uni o'zingizdan mahrum qilishga borishingiz mumkin edi, siz unga tegishli bo'lganlar, bu o'g'irlik va behayo narsa edi, ammo bu uning irodasi emas edi.

en: Now you must know that I am a friar and am therefore well acquainted with all their usances; and if I speak somewhat at large of them for your proﬁt, it is not forbidden me, as it were to another; nay, and it pleaseth me to speak of them, so you may henceforward know them better than you appear to have done in the past.
uz: Endi bilishingiz kerakki, men rohibman va shuning uchun ularning barcha urf-odatlari bilan yaxshi tanishman; va agar men sizning foydangiz uchun ular haqida biroz kengroq gapirsam, bu menga taqiqlanmagan, go'yo boshqalarga kabi; yo'q, va men ular haqida gapirishni yoqtiraman, shunda siz ularni bundan buyon o'tmishda qilganingizdek ko'rsatganingizdan yaxshiroq bilib olasiz.

en: Friars of old were very pious and worthy men, but those who nowadays style themselves friars and would be held such have nothing of the monk but the gown; nor is this latter even that of a true friar, for that —whereas of the founders of the monastic orders they179 were ordained strait and poor and of coarse stuff and demonstrative180 of the spirit of the wearers, who testiﬁed that they held things temporal in contempt whenas they wrapped their bodies in so mean a habit —those of our time have them made full and
uz: Qadimgi rohiblar juda taqvodor va munosib odamlar edilar, lekin hozirgi kunda o'zlarini rohib deb ko'rsatadigan va shunday deb hisoblanadiganlarning rohibdan boshqa hech narsasi yo'q edi; na bu oxirgi narsa haqiqiy rohibniki ham emas, chunki  garchi rohiblik tartiblari asoschilari 179-yilda tor va kambag'al va qo'pol narsalar hamda kiyuvchilarning ruhini namoyish etuvchi 180-yil tayinlangan bo'lsalar, ular tanasini shunday oddiy odat bilan o'rab olganlarida, vaqtinchalik narsalarni mensim deb hisoblaganliklari haqida guvohlik berishgan  bizning zamonamizning o'shalari ularni to'ldirgan va

en: double and glossy and of the ﬁnest cloth and have brought them to a quaint pontiﬁcal cut, insomuch that they think it no shame to ﬂaunt it withal pea- cock-wise, in the churches and public places, even as do the laity with their apparel; and like as with the sweep-net the ﬁsher goeth about to take many ﬁshes in the river at one cast, even so these, wrapping themselves about with the amplest of skirts, study to entangle therein great store of prudish maids and widows and many other silly women and men, and this is their chief concern over any other exercise; wherefore, to speak more plainly, they have not the friar’s gown, but only the colours thereof.
uz: Ikki qavatli va yaltiroq va eng yaxshi matolardan iborat bo'lib, ularni g'alati pontifik uslubga olib kelishdi. Shunday qilib, ular cherkovlar va jamoat joylarida uni xuddi oddiy odamlarning kiyimlari bilan ko'rsatganidek, piyoz bilan ko'rsatishni uyat deb hisoblamaydilar; va xuddi to'r bilan baliqchi daryoda ko'plab baliqlarni bir tomonda olib ketgandek, xuddi shunday qilib, bular o'zlarini yubkalarning kengligi bilan o'rab, unda aql bovar qilmas xizmatkorlar, bevalar va boshqa ko'plab ahmoqona ayollar va erkaklarni o'rab olishni o'rganadilar va bu ularning boshqa har qanday mashg'ulotdan asosiy tashvishidir; shuning uchun, aniqroq aytganda, ularda rohibning libosi emas, balki faqat uning ranglari bor.

en: Moreover, whereas the ancients181 desired the salvation of mankind, those of our day covet women and riches and turn their every thought to ter- rifying the minds of the foolish with clamours and depicturements182 and to making believe that sins may be purged with almsdeeds and masses, to the intent that unto themselves (who, of poltroonery, not of devoutness, and that they may not suffer fatigue,183 have, as a last resort, turned friars) one may bring bread, another send wine and a third give them a dole of money for the souls of their departed friends.
uz: Qolaversa, qadimgilar 181 insoniyatning najotini istagan bo'lsa-da, bugungi kundagilar ayollar va boylikka hirs qo'yishadi va har bir fikrini ahmoqlarning ongini faryodlar va tasvirlar bilan o'ylashga qaratadilar182 va gunohlar sadaqa va olomonni poklashga ishontirishadi, o'zlari uchun (ko'chadan emas, balki dindorlikdan emas, va charchoqqa charchamasliklari uchun, 183 oxirgi chora sifatida rohiblar bo'lishlari uchun) biri non olib kelishi, boshqasi vino yuborishi va uchinchisi ularga o'tgan do'stlarining jonlari uchun pul berishlari mumkin.

en: Certes, it is true that almsdeeds and pray- ers purge away sins; but, if those who give alms knew on what manner folks they bestow them, they would or keep them for themselves or cast them before as many hogs.
uz: Albatta, sadaqa va namozlar gunohlarni tozalaydi; lekin agar sadaqa beruvchilar ularni qanday tarzda berayotganlarini bilsalar, ularni o'zlari uchun saqlab qolishardi yoki ko'p cho'chqalar oldiga tashlashardi.

en: And for that these184 know that, the fewer the possessors of a great treasure, the more they live at ease, every one of them studieth with clamours and bugbears to detach others from that whereof he would fain abide sole possessor.
uz: Va shuning uchun bu 184 ta odam biladi, qancha ko'p xazina egalari kam bo'lsa, shuncha ko'p bemalol yashasa, ularning har biri boshqalarni faqat o'z egasi bo'lib qolishni xohlagan narsadan uzoqlashtirish uchun baqir-chaqir va xarobalar bilan o'qiydi.

en: They decry lust in men, in order that, they who are chidden desisting from women, the latter may be left to the chiders; they condemn usury and unjust gains, to the intent that, it being entrusted to them to make restitution thereof, they may, with that which they declare must bring to perdition him who hath it, make wide their gowns and pur- chase bishopricks and other great beneﬁces.
uz: Ular erkaklarda shahvatni qoralashadi, toki, ayollardan voz kechib, sabrli bo'lganlar, oxirgilar sabrlilarga qoldirilsin; ular pora va adolatsiz daromadni qoralashadi, chunki ularga uni qaytarish ishonib topshirilgan bo'lsa, ular o'z egalarini halokatga olib kelishi kerak deb e'lon qiladigan narsalari bilan o'z liboslarini keng qilib, yepiskoplar va boshqa buyuk xayriyalarni quvishsin.

en: And when they are taken to task of these and many other unseemly things that they do, they think that to answer, “Do as we say and not as we do,” is a sufﬁcient discharge of every grave burden, as if it were possible for the sheep to be more constant and stouter to resist temptation185 than the shep- herds.
uz: Va qachonki ular bu va boshqa ko'plab bema'ni ishlarga duchor bo'lishsa, ular "Biz aytganimizdek qiling, biz qilganimizdek qilmang" deb javob berish har qanday og'ir yukdan yetarli darajada xalos bo'ladi deb o'ylashadi, go'yo qo'ylar vasvasaga qarshi turish uchun qo'ylardan ko'ra ko'proq doimiy va kuchliroq bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: And how many there be of those to whom they make such a reply who apprehend it not after the fashion186 in which they say it, the most part of them know.
uz: Va shunday javob beradiganlarning nechtasi borki, ular uni aytgan usullari186 bo'yicha tushunmaydilar, ularning aksariyati biladi.

en: The monks of our day would have you do as they say, to wit, ﬁll their purses with money, trust your secrets to them, observe chastity, practise patience and forgiveness of injuries and keep yourselves from evil
uz: Zamonaviy rohiblar sizdan o'zlarining aytganlarini qilishingizni xohlashadi, masalan, hamyonlarini pul bilan to'ldirishingizni, ularga sirlaringizni ishonib topshirishingizni, poklikni saqlashni, sabr va jarohatlarni kechirishni mashq qilishingizni va o'zingizni yovuzlikdan saqlab qolishingizni.

en: speaking —all things good, seemly and righteous; but why would they have this?
uz: gapirib  hamma narsa yaxshi, go'zal va solih; lekin nega ularga bu narsa kerak bo'lardi?

en: So they may do that, which if the laity did, themselves could not do.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular shunday qilishlari mumkinki, agar oddiy odamlar shunday qilishsa, o'zlari ham qila olmasdilar.

en: Who knoweth not that without money idleness may not endure?
uz: Kim bilmaydi, pulsiz bekorchilik bardosh bera olmaydi?

en: An thou expend thy monies in thy pleasures, the friar will not be able to idle it in the monastery; an thou follow after women, there will be no room for him, and except thou be patient or a forgiver of injuries, he will not dare to come to thy house to corrupt thy family.
uz: Agar pulingni rohat-farog'atingga sarflasang, rohib uni monastirda bekorga qoldira olmaydi; agar ayollarga ergashsang, unga joy bo'lmaydi va agar sabr qilmasang yoki jarohatlarni kechirmasang, u sening uyingga kelib, oilangni buzishga jur'at eta olmaydi.

en: But why should I hark back after every par- ticular?
uz: Lekin nega har bir partikuldan keyin orqaga tortishim kerak?

en: They condemn themselves in the eyes of the understanding as often as they make this excuse.
uz: Ular buni bahona qilishlari bilan o'zlarini tushuncha ko'z o'ngida ayblashadi.

en: An they believe not themselves able to abstain and lead a devout life, why do they not rather abide at home?
uz: Ular o'zlarini tiyilishga va taqvodor hayot kechirishga qodir emas deb hisoblasalar, nega uyda qolishni afzal ko'rmaydilar?

en: Or, if they will e’en give themselves unto this,187 why do they not ensue that other holy saying of the Gospel, “Christ began to do and to teach?”188 Let them ﬁrst do and after teach others.
uz: Yoki, agar ular bunga berilib ketishsa, 187 nega ular Injilning boshqa muqaddas so'ziga, "Masih qila boshladi va o'rgatdi?"188 Nega ular avval o'zlari qila boshlashsin va keyin boshqalarga o'rgatishsin.

en: I have in my time seen a thousand of them wooers, lovers and haunters, not of lay women alone, but of nuns; ay, and of those that make the greatest outcry in the pulpit.
uz: Men o'z davrimda ularning minglab g'aroyiblarini, oshiqlarini va ovlovchilarini ko'rdim, oddiy ayollarning yolg'iz emas, balki rohibalarning; oh, va minbarda eng katta faryod chiqarganlarning.

en: Shall we, then, follow after these who are thus fashioned?
uz: Xo'sh, shunday shakllanganlarga ergashamizmi?

en: Whoso doth it doth that which he will, but God knoweth if he do wisely.
uz: Kim xohlasa, o'zi xohlagan ishni qiladi, lekin Xudo biladi, agar u donolik bilan ish qilsa.

en: But, granted even we are to allow that which the friar who chid you said to you, to wit, that it is a grievous sin to break the marriage vow, is it not a far greater sin to rob a man and a greater yet to slay him or drive him into exile, to wander miserably about the world?
uz: Lekin, agar hatto sizga chidagan rohib sizga aytgan gapga ham ruxsat bersak, masalan, nikoh qasamini buzish og'ir gunoh, odamni o'g'irlash undan ham kattaroq gunoh emasmi, uni o'ldirish yoki surgun qilish, dunyoni bechora kezib yurish uchun?

en: Everyone must allow this.
uz: Hamma bunga ruxsat berishi kerak.

en: For a woman to have converse with a man is a sin of nature; but to rob him or slay him or drive him into exile proceedeth from malignity of mind.
uz: Ayolning erkak bilan suhbatlashishi tabiiy gunohdir; lekin uni o'g'irlash, o'ldirish yoki surgun qilish ong yomonligidan kelib chiqadi.

en: That you robbed Tedaldo I have already shown you, in despoiling him of your- self, who had become his of your spontaneous will, and I say also that, so far as in you lay, you slew him, for that it was none of your fault —showing yourself, as you did, hourly more cruel —that he slew not himself with his own hand; and the law willeth that whoso is the cause of the ill that is done be held alike guilty with him who doth it.
uz: Siz Tedaldo'ni o'g'irlaganingizni sizga allaqachon ko'rsatdim, uni o'z xohishingizga ko'ra o'zingizga aylantirgan o'zligingizni yo'q qilib, va men yana aytaman, siz uni o'ldirdingiz, chunki bu sizning aybingiz emas edi  o'zingizni, siz qilganingizdek, soat sayin shafqatsizroq ko'rsatib  o'zini o'z qo'li bilan o'ldirmagan; va qonun shuni xohlaydi, kimki qilingan yomonlikning sababchisi bo'lsa, uni qilgan odam bilan birga aybdor bo'lsin.

en: And that you were the cause of his exile and of his going wandering seven years about the world cannot be denied.
uz: Va uning surgun qilinishiga va yetti yil davomida dunyo bo'ylab sarson bo'lishiga sababchi bo'lganingni inkor etib bo'lmaydi.

en: So that in whichever one of these three things aforesaid you have committed a far greater sin than in your converse with him.
uz: Shunday qilib, yuqorida aytilgan uchta narsadan qaysi birida u bilan suhbatlashgandan ko'ra ancha katta gunoh qilgansiz.

en: But, let us see; maybe Tedaldo deserved this usage?
uz: Lekin, ko'raylikchi; balki Tedaldo bu foydalanishga loyiqdir?

en: Certes, he did not; you yourself have already confessed it, more by token that I know he loveth189 you more than himself.
uz: Albatta, u buni qilmadi; buni sen o'zing allaqachon tan olding, ko'proq shuni ko'rsatmoqchimanki, u seni o'zidan ham ko'proq sevadi 189

en: No woman was ever so honoured, so exal- ted, so magniﬁed over every other of her sex as were you by him, whenas he found himself where he might fairly speak of you, without engendering
uz: Hech bir ayol hech qachon o'z jinsining har bir a'zosi uchun siz kabi ulug'langan, hurmatga sazovor bo'lmagan, o'zini siz haqingizda adolatli gapira oladigan joyda topgan, tug'masdan.

en: His every good, his every honour, his every liberty were all com- mitted by him into your hands.
uz: Uning har bir yaxshiligi, har bir sharafi, har bir erkinligi uning qo'liga topshirilgan edi.

en: Was he not noble and young?
uz: U olijanob va yosh emasmidi?

en: Was he not handsome among all his townsmen?
uz: U barcha shahar aholisi orasida chiroyli emasmidi?

en: Was he not accomplished in such things as pertain unto young men?
uz: U yigitlarga tegishli bo'lgan narsalarda yetuk emasmidi?

en: Was he not loved, cherished and well seen of everyone?
uz: U hamma tomonidan sevilmagan, qadrlanmagan va yaxshi ko'rilmaganmi?

en: You will not say nay to this either.
uz: Bunga ham "yo'q" demaysiz.

en: Then how, at the bid- ding of a scurvy, envious numskull of a friar, could you take such a cruel resolve against him?
uz: Xo'sh, qanday qilib, bir rohibning hasadgo'y no'xatkashligi kabi, unga nisbatan bunchalik shafqatsiz qaror qabul qila oldingiz?

en: I know not what error is that of women who eschew men and hold them in little esteem, whenas, considering what themselves are and what and how great is the nobility, beyond every other animal, giv- en of God to man, they should rather glory whenas they are loved of any and prize him over all and study with all diligence to please him, so he may never desist from loving them.
uz: Men erkaklarni chetlab o'tib, ularni kamsitadigan ayollarning qanday xato ekanligini bilmayman. O'zlarining nima ekanligini, nima va oliyjanoblik qanchalik buyuk ekanligini hisobga olsak, Xudo insonni har qanday hayvondan ustun qo'ygan bo'lsa, ular hech kim tomonidan sevilganda faxrlanishlari va uni hamma narsadan ustun qo'yishlari va uni yoqtirish uchun astoydil o'rganishlari kerak, shunda u ularni sevishdan hech qachon to'xtamasin.

en: This how you did, moved by the prate of a friar, who must for certain have been some broth-swilling pasty-gorger, you yourself know; and most like he had a mind to put himself in the place whence he studied to expel others.
uz: Siz shunday qildingiz, bir rohibning jahldorligidan ta'sirlangan holda, u, albatta, bulyon o'yuvchi pasty-gorger bo'lishi kerak edi, o'zingiz bilasiz; va ko'pincha u boshqalarni haydash uchun o'qigan joyiga o'zini qo'yishni o'ylagan edi.

en: This, then, is the sin that Divine justice, the which with a just balance bringeth all its operations to effect, hath willed not to leave unpunished; and even as you without reason studied to withdraw yourself from Tedaldo, so on like wise hath your husband been and is yet, without reason, in peril for Tedaldo, and you in tribulation.
uz: Demak, bu Xudo adolatining gunohidir, u adolatli muvozanat bilan barcha ishlarini amalga oshiradi, jazosiz qolishni xohlamadi; va xuddi siz bejizga Tedaldo'dan voz kechishni o'rganganingizdek, sizning eringiz ham bejizga Tedaldo uchun xavf ostida bo'lgan va hozir ham xavf ostida, siz esa musibatda.

en: Wherefrom an you would be delivered, that which it behoveth you to promise, and yet more to do, is this; that, should it ever chance that Tedaldo return hither from his long banishment, you will render him again your favour, your love, your goodwill and your privacy and reinstate him in that condition wherein he was, ere you foolishly hearkened to yonder crackbrained friar.’ The pilgrim having thus made an end of his discourse, the lady, who had hearkened thereto with the utmost attention, for that his arguments appeared to her most true and that, hearing him say, she accounted herself of a cer- tainty afﬂicted for the sin of which he spoke, said, ‘Friend of God, I know full well that the things you allege are true, and in great part by your show- ing do I perceive what manner of folk are these friars, whom till now I have held all saints.
uz: Siz qayerdan ozod bo'lishingiz kerak, va'da berishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsa, va yana qilishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsa, bu: agar Tedaldo uzoq vaqt davomida surgun qilinganidan bu yerga qaytib kelsa, siz unga o'z marhamatingizni, muhabbatingizni, yaxshi niyatingizni va shaxsiy hayotingizni qaytarasiz va uni o'sha ahvolga qaytarasiz, o'sha ahmoqona tarzda o'sha aqldan ozgan birodarga quloq solmaganingizda.

en: Moreover, I acknowledge my default without doubt to have been great in that which I wrought against Tedaldo; and an I might, I would gladly amend it on such wise as you have said; but how may this be done?
uz: Qolaversa, men o'z kamchilikimni shubhasiz Tedaldoga qarshi qilgan ishimda katta bo'lganini tan olaman; va agar kuchim bo'lsa, siz aytganidek, uni mamnuniyat bilan tuzatardim; lekin buni qanday amalga oshirish mumkin?

en: Tedaldo can never more return hither; he is dead; wherefore I know not why it should behove me promise that which may not be performed.’ ‘Madam,’ replied the pilgrim, ‘according to that which God hath revealed unto me,
uz: Tedaldo bu yerga hech qachon qaytib kelolmaydi; u o'lik; shuning uchun men bilmayman, nega bajarilmaydigan narsani va'da qilishim kerak. Xonim,  javob berdi ziyoratchi,  Xudo menga vahiy qilgan narsaga ko'ra,

en: Tedaldo is nowise dead, but alive and well and in good case, so but he had your favour.’ Quoth the lady, ‘Look what you say; I saw him dead before my door of several knife-thrusts and had him in these arms and bathed his dead face with many tears, the which it may be gave occasion for that which hath been spoken thereof unseemly.’ ‘Madam,’ replied the pilgrim, ‘whatever you may say, I certify you that Tedaldo is alive, and if you will e’en promise me that [which I ask], with intent to fulﬁl your promise, I hope you shall soon see him.’ Quoth she, ‘That do I promise and will gladly perform; nor could aught betide that would afford me such content as to see my husband free and unharmed and Tedaldo alive.’ Thereupon it seemed to Tedaldo time to discover himself and to comfort the lady with more certain hope of her husband, and accordingly he said, ‘Madam, in order that I may comfort you for
uz: Tedaldo hozir o'lik, lekin tirik va sog'lom va yaxshi holatda, shuning uchun ham u sizning marhamatingizga ega edi."  Xonim aytdi: Sizning gapingizga qarang; men uni eshigim oldida bir nechta pichoq bilan o'ldirgan holda ko'rdim va uni qo'llarimda ko'p yosh bilan yuvdim, bu esa uning o'lik yuzini ko'p yosh bilan yuvdi, bu esa uning haqida noto'g'ri gapirilganini anglatadi. Xonim, javob berdi ziyoratchi, Siz nima desangiz ham, men sizga Tedaldo tirik ekanligini tasdiqlayman va agar siz menga va'da bersangiz, men sizdan o'zingizga bergan va'dani bajarishga umid qilaman. Men va'da va'da beraman va xursandchilik bilan bajaraman; Xonim, men uni ko'rish uchun hech narsa bera olmasdim, chunki u o'z erimning

en: your husband, it behoveth me reveal to you a secret, which look you discover not unto any, as you value your life.’ Now they were in a very retired place and alone, the lady having conceived the utmost conﬁdence of the sanctity which herseemed was in the pilgrim; wherefore Tedaldo, pulling out a ring, which she had given him the last night he had been with her and which he had kept with the utmost dili- gence, and showing it to her, said, ‘Madam, know you this?’ As soon as she saw it, she recognized it and answered, ‘Ay, sir; I gave it to Tedaldo afore- time.’ Whereupon the pilgrim, rising to his feet, hastily cast off his palmer’s gown and hat and speaking Florence-fashion, said, ‘And know you me?’ When the lady saw this, she knew him to be Tedaldo and was all aghast, fearing him as one feareth the dead, an they be seen after death to go as if alive; wherefore she made not towards him
uz: Erim, senga bir sirni aytishim kerak, uni hech kimga oshkor qilmaydigandek tuyuladi, chunki sen o'z hayotingni qadrlaysan. Endi ular juda nafaqaga chiqqan va yolg'iz joyda edilar, xonim o'ziga xos bo'lgan muqaddaslikning eng yuqori ishonchini ziyoratchiga bergan edi; shuning uchun Tedaldo, o'zi bilan o'tgan kecha unga bergan va eng yuqori dilbarlik bilan saqlagan uzukni tortib, unga ko'rsatib, dedi: "Xonim, buni bilasizmi?" U buni ko'rishi bilanoq, u buni tanidi va javob berdi: "Ha, janob; men buni oldindan ziyoratchiga berdim." Shunda ziyoratchi oyoqlariga turib, uni ko'tarib, palma kiyimini va o'limga tashladi va uni o'limga qarab, "Qayerda uni ko'rganish kerak bo'lsa, u..." dedi.

en: to welcome him as Tedaldo re- turned from Cyprus, but would have ﬂed from him in affright, as he were Tedaldo come back from the tomb.
uz: uni Tedaldo Kiprdan qaytib kelganida kutib olish uchun, lekin undan xavotirda qochgan bo'lardi, xuddi Tedaldo qabrdan qaytib kelganidek.

en: Whereupon, ‘Madam,’ quoth he, ‘fear not; I am your Tedaldo, alive and well, and have never died nor been slain, whatsoever you and my brothers may believe.’ The lady, somewhat reas- sured and knowing his voice, considered him awhile longer and avouched in herself that he was certainly Tedaldo; wherefore she threw herself, weep- ing, on his neck and kissed him, saying, ‘Welcome back, sweet my Tedaldo.’ Tedaldo, having kissed and embraced her, said, ‘Madam, it is no time now for closer greetings; I must e’en go take order that Aldobrandino may be restored to you safe and sound; whereof I hope that, ere tomorrow come eventide, you shall hear news that will please you; nay, if, as I expect, I
uz: Shunda u: Xonim, dedi u, qo'rqmang; men sizning Tedaldo'zingizman, tirik va sog'lomman, va hech qachon o'lmaganman ham, siz va akalarim ishonishingiz mumkin bo'lsa ham. Xonim, biroz asoslanib, uning ovozini bilgan holda, uni uzoqroq vaqt o'ylab, u albatta Tedaldo edi; shuning uchun u o'zini tashladi, yig'lab, uning bo'yniga o'pdi va uni o'pdi, Xush kelibsiz, shirin Tedaldo dedi.

en: have good news of his safety, I trust this night to be able to come to you and report them to you at more leisure than I can at this present.’ Then, donning his gown and hat again, he kissed the lady once more and bidding her be of good hope, took leave of her and repaired whereas Aldobrandino lay in prison, occupied more with fear of imminent death than with hopes of de- liverance to come.
uz: Xavfsizligi haqida yaxshi yangilik bor edi, men bu kechasi sizlarning oldingizga kelishga va ularni hozirgi kunga qaraganda ko'proq bemalol sizga xabar berishga umid qilaman. Keyin, yana ko'ylagi va shapkasini kiyib, u xonimni yana bir bor o'pdi va unga yaxshi umid bilan murojaat qildi, uni tark etdi va tuzatdi, Aldobrandino esa qamoqda yotgan edi, yaqinlashib kelayotgan o'limdan qo'rqib, kelajakdagi ta'til umididan ko'ra ko'proq band edi.

en: Tedaldo, with the gaoler’s consent, went in to him, in the guise of a ghostly comforter, and seating himself by his side, said to him, ‘Aldobrandino, I am a friend of thine, sent thee for thy deliverance by God, who hath taken pity on thee because of thine innocence; wherefore, if, in reverence to Him, thou wilt grant me a little boon that I shall ask of thee, thou shalt without fail, ere tomorrow be night, whereas thou lookest for sen- tence of death, hear that of thine acquittance.’ ‘Honest man,’ replied the prisoner, ‘since thou art solicitous of my deliv- erance, albeit I know thee not nor mind me ever to have seen thee, needs must thou be a friend, as thou sayst.
uz: Tedaldo, begunohning roziligi bilan, uning oldiga arvoh tasalli beruvchi qiyofasida kirdi va yonida o'tirdi va unga dedi: Aldobrandino, men sening do'stingman, seni Xudo qutqarishi uchun yubordi, u senga begunohliging uchun rahm qildi; shuning uchun, agar Unga hurmat bilan menga bir oz iltifot berishingni so'rasang, ertaga kechasi, sen o'limning o'n o'n o'nligini qidirayotganingda, o'zingning oqliging haqida eshitishing kerak. Halol, javob berdi mahbus, chunki sen mening hayotingdan xavotirlanasan, garchi men seni hech qachon ko'rmagan bo'lsam ham, do'st bo'lishing kerak,

en: In truth, the sin, for which they say I am to be doomed to death, I never committed; though others enough have I committed aforetime, which, it may be, have brought me to this pass.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men hech qachon o'limga mahkum qilinadigan gunoh qilmaganman; garchi boshqa gunohlarni ham oldinroq qilgan bo'lsam-da, bu gunoh meni shu ahvolga olib kelgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But this I say to thee, of reverence to God; an He presently have compassion on me, I will not only promise, but gladly do anything, however great, to say nothing of a little one; wherefore ask that which pleaseth thee, for without fail, if it come to pass that I escape with life, I will punctually perform it.’ Then said the pilgrim, ‘What I would have of thee is that thou pardon Te- daldo’s four brothers the having brought thee to this pass, believing thee guilty of their brother’s death, and have them again for brethren and for friends, whenas they crave thee pardon thereof.’ Whereto quoth Aldo- brandino, ‘None knoweth but he who hath suffered the affront how sweet a thing is vengeance and with what ardour it is desired; nevertheless, so God may apply Himself to my deliverance, I will freely pardon them; nay, I par- don them now, and if I come off hence alive and escape, I will in this
uz: Lekin senga shunday deyman, Xudoga hurmat bilan; va U menga tez orada rahm qiladi, men nafaqat va'da beraman, balki kichik bir narsani aytishga unchalik katta bo'lmasin, xursandchilik bilan hech narsa qilaman; shuning uchun senga yoqqan narsani so'ra, chunki albatta, agar hayotdan qutulsam, uni o'z vaqtida bajaraman." Shunda ziyoratchi dedi: "Sendan xohlaganim shuki, Te-Daldo'ning to'rtta birodarini seni bu yo'ldan o'tkazib, akasining o'limida aybdor deb hisoblab, ularni yana birodarlar va do'stlar uchun, seni kechirishni xohlaganda, yana o'zingni kechiring." "Aldo-Brando" dedi: "Hech kimga ma'lum emas, lekin u shirin narsa qandaydir va u bilan qandaydir; agar men ularni hech qachon o'chirishni xohlamasam, men ularni hech qachon qutqarmayman.

en: hold such course as shall be to thy liking.’ This pleased the pilgrim and without concerning himself to say more to him, he exhorted him to be of good heart, for that, ere the ensuing day came to an end, he should without fail hear very certain news of his safety.
uz: O'zingizga ma'qul bo'lgan yo'lni tuting. Bu pilgrimga yoqdi va u o'ziga ortiqcha gapirishga hojat qoldirmasdan, uni yaxshi yurakli bo'lishga undadi, chunki keyingi kun tugaguniga qadar u o'zining xavfsizligi haqida aniq xabar eshitishi kerak edi.

en: Then, taking leave of him, he repaired to the Seignory and said privily to a gentle- man who was in session there, ‘My lord, everyone should gladly labour to bring to light the truth of things, and especially those who hold such a room as this of yours, to the end that those may not suffer the penalty who have
uz: So'ngra undan xayrlashib, u oliyxonaga qaytib keldi va u yerda o'tirgan muloyim bir odamga xotirjamlik bilan dedi: Ey hazratim, hamma narsa haqiqatini ochib berish uchun xursandchilik bilan mehnat qilsin, ayniqsa siz kabi xonani ushlab turganlar, toki ular jazosini boshdan kechirmasinlar.

en: not committed the crime and that the guilty may be punished; that which may be brought about, to your honour and the bane of those who have mer- ited it, I am come hither to you.
uz: Jinoyatni sodir etmagan va aybdorlar jazolanib qolmasligi uchun; bu sizning sharafingizga va uni qo'ldan boy berganlarning sharfiga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa uchun, men bu yerga siz tomon keldim.

en: As you know, you have rigorously pro- ceeded against Aldobrandino Palermini and thinking you have found for truth that it was he who slew Tedaldo Elisei, are minded to condemn him; but this is most certainly false, as I doubt not to show you, ere midnight betide, by giving into your hands the murderers of the young man in ques- tion.’ The worthy gentleman, who was in concern for Aldobrandino, willingly gave ear to the pilgrim’s words and having conferred at large with him upon the matter, on his information, took the two innkeeper brothers and their servant, without resistance, in their ﬁrst sleep.
