uz: Bilasizki, siz Aldobrandino Palerminiga qarshi qat'iy qaror qabul qildingiz va Tedaldo Eliseyni o'ldirgan odam ekanligini haqiqat deb topdingiz deb o'yladingiz va uni hukm qilishga qaror qildingiz; lekin bu, albatta, noto'g'ri, chunki shubha qilamanki, sizga yarim tunda so'roqdagi yigitni qotillarini qo'lingizga topshirish orqali ko'rsatmoqchi emasman." Aldobrandino haqida qayg'urgan munosib janob hajchining so'zlariga ixtiyoriy ravishda quloq soladi va bu haqda u bilan maslahatlashdi. Uning ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, ikki mehmonxona bekasi va ularning xizmatkori, qarshiliksiz, birinchi uyqusida.

en: He would have put them to the question, to discover how the case stood; but they brooked it not and each ﬁrst for himself, and after all together, openly confessed that it was they who had slain Tedaldo Elisei, knowing him not.
uz: U ularni savolga solgan bo'lardi, ish qanday holatda ekanligini aniqlash uchun; lekin ular uni birinchi bo'lib o'zlari uchun ko'rib chiqishmadi va oxir-oqibat, birgalikda, Tedaldo Eliseyni bilmasdan o'ldirganlari ekanligini ochiq tan olishdi.

en: Being questioned of the case, they said [that it was] for that he had given the wife of one of them sore annoy, what while they were abroad, and would fain have enforced her to do his will.
uz: Holat yuzasidan so'ralgan holda, ular aytdilarki, bu ularning birining xotiniga azob berganidan, ular chet elda bo'lganlarida, uni o'z irodasini bajarishga majburlagan bo'lardi.

en: The pilgrim, having heard this, with the magistrate’s consent took his leave and repairing privily to the house of Madam Ermellina, found her alone and awaiting him, (all else in the house being gone to sleep), alike de- sirous of having good news of her husband and of fully reconciling herself with her Tedaldo.
uz: Ziyoratchi bu gapni eshitgach, magistratning roziligi bilan ketdi va Madam Ermellinaning uyiga xotirjamlik bilan qaytdi. U uni yolg'iz va uni kutgan holda topdi (uyda hamma uxlab qolgan edi), xuddi eridan yaxshi xabar eshitganidan va Tedaldo bilan to'liq yarashganidan befarq emas edi.

en: He accosted her with a joyful countenance and said, ‘Dearest lady mine, be of good cheer, for tomorrow thou shalt certainly have thine Aldobrandino here again safe and sound’; and to give her more entire assurance thereof, he fully recounted to her that which he had done.
uz: U uni quvonchli yuz bilan yaqinlashtirdi va dedi: "Azizim, xursand bo'l, chunki ertaga Aldobrandino sening yana sog'lom va sog'lom bo'lishing aniq; va unga bu haqda to'liq ishonch berish uchun, u qilgan ishini unga to'liq aytib berdi."

en: Whereupon she, glad as ever woman was of two so sudden and so happy chances, to wit, the having her lover alive again, whom she verily believed to have bewept dead, and the seeing Aldobrandino free from peril, whose death she looked ere many days to have to mourn, affectionately embraced and kissed Tedaldo; then, getting them to bed together, with one accord they made a glad and gracious peace, taking delight and joyance one of the other.
uz: Shunda u, har doimgidek ayolning ikki birdan va juda baxtli imkoniyatidan xursand edi, masalan, sevgilisi tirik bo'lgani, uni haqiqatan ham o'lik deb hisoblaganligi va Aldobrandino xavfli holatdan ozod bo'lganini ko'rishi, uning o'limiga ko'p kun yig'lash kerak bo'lganini ko'rishi, Tedaldo'ni mehr bilan quchoqlab va o'pdi; keyin ularni birga yotishga olib, bir ovozdan xursandchilik va marhamat bilan tinchlik qildilar, bir-biridan quvonch va quvonch olishdi.

en: Whenas the day drew near, Tedaldo arose, after showing the lady that which he purposed to do and praying her anew to keep it a close secret, and went forth, even in his pilgrim’s habit, to attend, whenas it should be time, to Al- dobrandino’s affairs.
uz: Kun yaqinlashar ekan, Tedaldo xonimga nima qilmoqchi ekanligini ko'rsatib, uni yana sir saqlashni so'rab turdi va vaqti kelganda, hatto ziyoratchi odatida Al- Doblandino'ning ishlariga borishga ketdi.

en: The day come, it appearing to the Seignory that they had full information of the matter, they straightway discharged Aldo-
uz: Kun kelib, Sayyorga bu haqda to'liq ma'lumotga ega bo'lganlari ko'rinib, ular darhol Aldo-ni ishdan bo'shatishdi.

en: brandino and a few days after let strike off the murderers’ heads whereas they had committed the crime.
uz: brandino va bir necha kundan so'ng qotillarning jinoyat sodir etgan bo'lsalar ham, boshlarini kesib tashlashdi.

en: Aldobrandino being now, to the great joy of himself and his wife and of all his friends and kinsfolk, free and manifestly acknowledging that he owed his deliverance to the good ofﬁces of the pilgrim, carried the latter to his house for such time as it pleased him to sojourn in the city; and there they could not sat themselves of doing him honour and worship, especially the lady, who knew with whom she had to do.
uz: Aldobrandino hozir o'zining, xotini va barcha do'stlari va qarindoshlarining katta quvonchiga ko'ra, o'zining ziyoratchilarning yaxshi lavozimlaridan ozod bo'lishi kerakligini ochiq va ravshan tan olgan holda, ularni shaharda qolishni istagan vaqtga o'z uyiga olib bordi; va u yerda ular unga hurmat va ibodat qilishdan o'zlarini tiya olishmadi, ayniqsa u kim bilan ishlashi kerakligini biladigan xonim.

en: After awhile, deeming it time to bring his brothers to an accord with Aldobrandino and knowing that they were not only put to shame by the latter’s acquittance, but went armed for fear [of his resentment], he demanded of his host the fulﬁlment of his prom- ise.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, birodarlarini Aldobrandino bilan kelishuvga olib kelish vaqti kelganini va ularning nafaqat Aldobrandino oqlashi bilan sharmanda bo'lganini, balki qo'rquvdan qurollanganini bilgach, u o'z qo'shinidan va'dasining bajarilishini talab qildi.

en: Aldobrandino freely answered that he was ready, whereupon the pil- grim caused him prepare against the morrow a goodly banquet, whereat he told him he would have him and his kinsmen and kinswomen entertain the four brothers and their ladies, adding that he himself would go incontinent and bid the latter on his part to peace and his banquet.
uz: Aldobrandino bemalol tayyor ekanligiga javob berdi, shundan so'ng pil-grim unga ertangi kunga yaxshi ziyofat tayyorlashni buyurdi. Shunda u unga o'zi va qarindoshlari va qarindoshlari to'rtta aka-uka va ularning xonimlarini ko'z-ko'z qilishini aytdi, shuningdek, o'zi ham ziyofatga borishini va oxirgilarini o'z tomondan tinchlik va ziyofatga taklif qilishini aytdi.

en: Aldobrandino con- senting to all that liked the pilgrim, the latter forthright betook himself to the four brothers and plying them with store of such words as behoved unto the matter, in ﬁne, with irrepugnable arguments, brought them easily enough to consent to regain Aldobrandino’s friendship by asking pardon; which done, he invited them and their ladies to dinner with Aldobrandino next morning, and they, being certiﬁed of his good faith, frankly accepted the invitation.
uz: Aldobrandino ziyoratchiga yoqqanlarning barchasiga murojaat qilib, u darhol to'rt aka-ukalarning oldiga bordi va ularga bu masalada zarur bo'lgan so'zlarni aytdi, xullas, rad etish mumkin bo'lmagan dalillar bilan, ularni Aldobrandinning do'stligini kechirim so'rash orqali qayta tiklashga rozi bo'lishga osonlik bilan olib keldi; buni amalga oshirdi, u ularni va ularning ayollarini ertasi kuni ertalab Aldobrandino bilan kechki ovqatga taklif qildi va ular, uning yaxshi niyatidan amin bo'lgan holda, taklifni ochiqchasiga qabul qilishdi.

en: Accordingly, on the morrow, towards dinnertime, Tedaldo’s four broth- ers, clad all in black as they were, came, with sundry of their friends, to the house of Aldobrandino, who stayed for them, and there, in the presence of all who had been bidden of him to bear them company, cast down their arms and committed themselves to his mercy, craving forgiveness of that which they had wrought against him.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni, kechki ovqatga yaqin, Tedaldo'ning to'rtta sho'rvachisi, o'zlari qanday bo'lishsa, shunday qora rangda, turli do'stlari bilan birga Aldobrandinning uyiga kelishdi. Aldobrandino ularga qolib ketdi va u yerda, ularni olib yurishga buyurilgan barcha odamlar oldida, qo'llarini tashlab, unga nisbatan qilgan gunohlarini kechirishni istab, o'zlarini uning rahm-shafqatiga topshirdilar.

en: Aldobrandino, weeping, received them affectionately, and kissing them all on the mouth, despatched the mat- ter in a few words, remitting unto them every injury received.
uz: Aldobrandino yig'lab, ularni mehr bilan kutib oldi va ularning barchasini og'zidan o'pib, bir necha so'z bilan mat-terni yo'qotdi, ularga yetkazilgan har qanday jarohatni kechirdi.

en: After them came their wives and sisters, clad all in sad-coloured raiment, and were gra- ciously received by Madam Ermellina and the other ladies.
uz: Ulardan keyin ularning xotinlari va opa-singillari tushkun rangli liboslarda kelishdi va ularni Madam Ermellina va boshqa xonimlar xushmuomalalik bilan qabul qilishdi.

en: Then were all, ladies and men alike, magniﬁcently entertained at the banquet, nor was there aught in the entertainment other than commendable, except it were the taciturnity occasioned by the yet fresh sorrow expressed in the sombre raiment of Tedaldo’s kinsfolk.
uz: Shunda hamma, ayollar ham, erkaklar ham, ziyofatda ajoyib tarzda xursand bo'lishdi, va bu ko'ngilxushlikda maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan hech narsa yo'q edi, faqatgina Tedaldo'ning qarindoshlarining xira kiyimida ifodalangan hali yangi qayg'usi tufayli yuzaga kelgan sukutsizlik edi.

en: Now on this account the pilgrim’s device of
uz: Endi shu hisobda ziyoratchining qurilmasi...

en: the banquet had been blamed of some and he had observed it; wherefore, the time being come to do away with the constraint aforesaid, he rose to his feet, according as he had foreordained in himself, what while the rest still ate of the fruits, and said, ‘Nothing hath lacked to this entertainment that should make it joyful, save only Tedaldo himself; whom (since having had him continually with you, you have not known him) I will e’en discover to you.’ So saying, he cast off his palmer’s gown and all other his pilgrim’s weeds and abiding in a jerkin of green sendal, was with no little amazement, long eyed and considered of all, ere any would venture to believe it was indeed he.
uz: Ba'zilar ziyofatni ayblashgan edi va u buni kuzatgan edi; shuning uchun, yuqorida aytilgan cheklovni yo'qotish vaqti kelganida, u o'zida oldindan belgilaganidek oyoqqa turdi, qolganlari esa mevalardan yeyishganida va dedi: "Bu ko'ngilxushlikda faqat Tedaldo xursand bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan hech narsa yo'q edi, faqat o'zi; uni (uni doimiy ravishda siz bilan birga bo'lganimdan beri, siz uni bilmagansiz) sizga aniqlayman." Shunday qilib, u palma ko'ylagini va barcha boshqa ziyoratgohlarining barcha o'rmonlarini tashladi va yashil sendal ustida turdi, hech qanday hayratga, uzoq ko'zga va albatta, hech kim ishonmas edi.

en: Tedaldo, seeing this, recounted many particulars of the relations and things betided between them, as well as of his own adventures; whereupon his brethren and the other gentlemen present ran all to embrace him, with eyes full of joyful tears, as after did the ladies on like wise, as well strangers as kinswomen, except only Madam Ermellina.
uz: Tedaldo buni ko'rib, ular o'rtasidagi munosabatlar va o'zaro munosabatlarning ko'plab tafsilotlarini, shuningdek, o'zining sarguzashtlarini hikoya qildi; shundan so'ng uning birodarlari va hozir bo'lgan boshqa janoblar uni quchoqlab, quvonchli ko'z yoshlari bilan quchoqlash uchun yugurishdi, keyin esa xonimlar ham dono, qarindoshlar kabi begona, faqatgina Madam Ermellina bundan mustasno.

en: Which Aldobrandino seeing, ‘What is this, Ermellina?’ quoth he.
uz: Aldobrandino qaysi birini ko'rib, "Bu nima, Ermellina?" dedi.

en: ‘Why dost thou not welcome Tedaldo, as do the other ladies?’ Whereto she answered, in the hearing of all, ‘There is none who had more gladly welcomed and would yet welcome him than myself, who am more beholden to him than any other woman, seeing that by his means I have gotten thee again; but the unseemly words spoken in the days when we mourned him whom we deemed Tedaldo made me refrain therefrom.’ Quoth her husband, ‘Go to; thinkest thou I believe in the howl- ers?190 He hath right well shown their prate to be false by procuring my de- liverance; more by token that I never believed it.
uz: Nega sen Tedaldo'ni boshqa xonimlar kabi qabul qilmaysan? Shunda u hammaga javoban dedi: Uni o'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq xursandchilik bilan qabul qilgan va qabul qiladigan hech kim yo'q. U menga boshqa ayollardan ko'ra ko'proq qarzdor, chunki uning yordamida men seni qaytarib oldim; lekin biz uni motam tutgan kunlarda aytgan bema'ni so'zlar, biz uni Tedaldo deb hisoblaganimizda, meni undan tiyishga majbur qildi. Eriga: Bor, sen howlga ishonasanmi? 190 U o'zining haqli ekanligini ko'rsatdi; ko'proq, men hech qachon ishonmaganman.

en: Quick, rise and go and embrace him.’ The lady, who desired nothing better, was not slow to obey her husband in this and accordingly, arising, embraced Tedaldo, as the other ladies had done, and gave him joyous welcome.
uz: Tezroq turing, uni quchoqlab oling. Bundan yaxshiroq narsani xohlamagan xonim, eriga bu borada itoat etishda sekin turmadi va shunga ko'ra, o'rnidan turib, boshqa xonimlar qilganidek, Tedaldo'ni quchoqladi va uni quvonch bilan kutib oldi.

en: This liberality of Aldobrandino was mighty pleasing to Tedaldo’s brothers and to every man and woman there, and thereby all suspect191 that had been aroused in the minds of some by the words aforesaid was done away.
uz: Aldobrandino'ning bu bag'rikengligi Tedaldo'ning aka-ukalariga va u yerdagi har bir erkak va ayolga juda yoqdi va shu bilan yuqorida aytilgan so'zlar bilan ba'zilarning ongida uyg'ongan barcha shubha191 yo'q qilindi.

en: Then, everyone having given Tedaldo joy, he with his own hands rent the black clothes on his brothers’ backs and the sad-coloured on those of his sisters and kinswomen and would have them send after other apparel, which whenas they had donned, they gave themselves to singing and dancing and other diversions galore; wherefore the banquet, which had had a silent beginning had a loud-resounding end- ing.
uz: Keyin, hamma Tedaldoga quvonch berganidan so'ng, u o'z qo'llari bilan aka-ukalarining orqa tomonidagi qora kiyimlarni va opa-singillari va qarindoshlarining achchiq rangdagi kiyimlarini yirtib tashlardi va ularni boshqa kiyimlar ortidan yuborardi, ular kiyganlarida ham, o'zlarini qo'shiq, raqs va boshqa ko'ngilochar mashg'ulotlarga bag'ishlardi; shuning uchun sokin boshlangan ziyofatning oxiri baland edi.

en: Thereafter, with the utmost mirth, they one and all repaired, even as
uz: Shundan so'ng, eng katta quvonch bilan, ular hammasi birdek ta'mirlandi, hatto...

en: they were, to Tedaldo’s house, where they supped that night, and on this wise they continued to feast several days longer.
uz: Ular o'sha kecha Tedaldoning uyiga borishdi, u yerda ovqatlanishdi va shu tariqa bir necha kun davomida ziyofat qilishda davom etishdi.

en: The Florentines awhile regarded Tedaldo with amazement, as a man risen from the dead; nay, in many an one’s mind, and even in that of his brethren, there abode a certain faint doubt an he were indeed himself and they did not yet thoroughly believe it, nor belike had they believed it for a long time to come but for a chance which made them clear who the murdered man was which was on this wise.
uz: Florensiyaliklar bir vaqtlar Tedaldoga o'liklardan tirilgan odam kabi hayrat bilan qarashardi; yo'q, ko'pchilikning ongida, hatto birodarlarining ongida ham, u haqiqatan ham o'zi ekanligiga bir oz shubha bor edi va ular bunga hali to'liq ishonishmagan edi, yoki ular bu haqda uzoq vaqtdan beri ishonishmagan bo'lsa ham, lekin bu usulda o'ldirilgan odam kimligini aniqlashtiradigan imkoniyat edi.

en: There passed one day before their house certain footmen192 of Lunigiana, who, seeing Tedaldo, made towards him and said, ‘Give you good day, Faziuolo.’ Whereto Tedaldo in his brothers’ presence answered, ‘You mistake me.’ The others, hearing him speak, were abashed and cried him pardon, saying, ‘Forsooth you resemble, more than ever we saw one man favour another, a comrade of ours called Faziuolo of Pontremoli, who came hither some fortnight or more agone, nor could we ever since learn what is come of him.
uz: Bir kun ularning uyi oldida bir nechta Lunigianalik piyodalar bor edi. Ular Tedaldo'ni ko'rib, unga qarab, "Xayrli kun, Faziuolo" deyishdi. Tedaldo akalari huzurida javob berdi: "Meni adashtiryapsan." Boshqalar uni gapirayotganini eshitib, hayratga tushishdi va uni kechirim so'rashdi, "Chunki siz hech qachon birovga o'xshamaysiz, har qachongidan ham ko'proq biz birovga mehr ko'rdik, bizning pontremolilik Faziuolo ismli o'rtoqimiz, u yerga bir necha yil yoki undan ko'proq vaqt oldin kelgan edi, biz hech qachon undan nima kelganini bilolmadik."

en: Indeed, we marvelled at the dress, for that he was a soldier, even as we are.’ Tedaldo’s elder brother, hearing this, came forward and enquired how this Faziuolo had been clad.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, biz ko'ylagidan hayratda qoldik, chunki u askar edi, xuddi biz kabi. Tedaldo'ning katta akasi buni eshitib, oldinga chiqib, bu Faziuolo qanday qilib qoplanganini so'radi.

en: They told him and it was found to have been punctually as they said; wherefore, what with these and what with other tokens, it was known for certain that he who had been slain was Faziuolo and not Tedaldo, and all doubt of the latter193 ac- cordingly departed [the minds of] his brothers and of every other.
uz: Ular unga aytishdi va bu ular aytganidek, aniqki, o'z vaqtida sodir bo'ldi; shuning uchun, bular va boshqa belgilar bilan nima bo'lsa, o'ldirilgan odam Tedaldo emas, balki Faziuolo ekanligi aniq ma'lum edi va oxirgi 193-yildagi barcha shubha unga ko'ra uning birodarlari va har birining ongidan chiqib ketdi.

en: Tedaldo, then, being returned very rich, persevered in his love and the lady falling out with him no more, they long, discreetly dealing, had enjoyment of their love.
uz: Tedaldo esa, juda boy bo'lib qaytganidan so'ng, o'z muhabbatiga sodiq qolgan va xonim endi u bilan ajrashmayotgan edi, ular yashirincha muomala qilib, o'z muhabbatlaridan zavqlanishardi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Ferondo, having swallowed a certain powder, is entombed for dead and being taken forth of the sepulchre by the abbot, who enjoyeth his wife the while, is put in prison and given to believe that he is in Purgatory; after which, being raised up again, he reareth for his own a child begotten of the abbot on his wife.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Ferondo, ma'lum bir kukun yutib, o'lik deb dafn etiladi va qabrdan abbot tomonidan olib chiqiladi. Abbot xotinidan zavqlanadi, qamoqqa tashlanadi va o'zini Purgatoriyda deb ishontiriladi; keyin, qayta tirilganidan so'ng, u o'z xotiniga abbotdan tug'ilgan farzandini tarbiyalaydi.

en: The end being come of Emilia’s long story —which had not withal for its length been unpleasing to any of the company, nay, but was held of all the ladies to have been brieﬂy narrated, having regard to the number and di- versity of the incidents therein recounted —the queen, having with a mere sign intimated her pleasure to Lauretta, gave her occasion to begin thus: “Dearest ladies, there occurreth to me to tell you a true story which hath much more semblance of falsehood than of that which it indeed is and which hath been recalled to my mind by hearing one to have been bewept and buried for another.
uz: Emilia'ning uzun hikoyasining oxiri keldi  bu hikoya o'z uzunligi bilan hech kimga yoqmadi, lekin barcha xonimlar tomonidan qisqacha hikoya qilingan deb hisoblandi, chunki u yerda aytib o'tilgan voqealar soni va xilma-xilligi bor edi  malika, birgina belgi bilan Laurettaga o'z zavqini bildirgan holda, unga shunday boshlashga imkon berdi: Azizimli xonimlar, men sizlarga yolg'onga o'xshaydigan va biridan ko'ra ko'proq yolg'onga o'xshash bo'lgan va biridan ko'ra ko'proq xotirlangan haqiqiy hikoyani aytib bermoqchiman.

en: I purpose then, to tell you how a live man was en- tombed for dead and how after he and many other folk believed himself to have come forth of the sepulchre as one raised from the dead, by reason whereof he194 was adored as a saint who should rather have been con- demned as a criminal.
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga tirik odamning o'lik deb dafn etilganini va u va boshqa ko'plab odamlar o'zlarini o'liklardan tirilgan deb o'ylagandan so'ng, 194-yilda jinoyatchi sifatida qoralash kerak bo'lgan avliyo sifatida sig'inilganini aytmoqchiman.

en: There was, then, and yet is, in Tuscany, an abbey situate, like as we see many thereof, in a place not overmuch frequented of men, whereof a monk was made abbot, who was a very holy man in everything, save in the matter of women, and in this he contrived to do so warily that well nigh none, not to say knew, but even suspected him thereof, for that he was holden exceed- ing godly and just in everything.
uz: O'shanda, va shunga qaramay, Toskanada, ko'pchilik ko'rganimizdek, juda ko'p odamlar ko'p bo'lmagan joyda joylashgan bir abbat bor edi. U yerda rohib abbat qilib tayinlangan edi, u ayollardan tashqari hamma narsada juda muqaddas odam edi va bu borada ehtiyotkorlik bilan ish tutishga harakat qilardi, deyarli hech kim bilmasdi, balki hatto uni shubhalanardi, chunki u hamma narsada juda taqvodor va adolatli edi.

en: It chanced that a very wealthy farmer, by name Ferondo, contracted a great intimacy with him, a heavy, clodpate fel- low and dull-witted beyond measure, whose commerce pleased the abbot
uz: Baxtga ko'ra, Ferondo ismli juda badavlat dehqon u bilan juda yaqin munosabatda bo'lgan, og'ir, to'lishgan, past va xira aqlli, uning savdosi abbatni xursand qilgan.

en: but for that his simplicity whiles afforded him some diversion, and in the course of their acquaintance, the latter perceived that Ferondo had a very handsome woman to wife, of whom he became so passionately enamoured that he thought of nothing else day or night; but, hearing that, simple and shallow-witted as Ferondo was in everything else, he was shrewd enough in the matter of loving and guarding his wife, he well nigh despaired of her.
uz: Lekin shuning uchun ham uning soddaligi unga biroz chalg'itish imkonini berdi va ularning tanishuvlari davomida Ferondo juda chiroyli xotinga ega ekanligini angladi, unga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan oshiq bo'ldiki, na kechasi, na kunduzi boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylamadi; lekin, Ferondo hamma narsada oddiy va sayoz bo'lgani kabi, u xotinini sevish va qo'riqlash masalasida yetarlicha aqlli edi, deb eshitib, u undan deyarli umidsiz edi.

en: However, like a very adroit man as he was, he wrought on such wise with Ferondo that he came whiles, with his wife, to take his pleasance in the ab- bey-garden, and there he very demurely entertained them with discourse of the beatitude of the life eternal and of the pious works of many men and women of times past, insomuch that the lady was taken with a desire to con- fess herself to him and asked and had Ferondo’s leave thereof.
uz: Ammo, o'zi juda mohir odam kabi, u Ferondo bilan shunchalik donolik bilan ishladiki, u xotini bilan birga ab-bey bog'iga o'z zavqini olish uchun keldi va u yerda ularni abadiy hayot baxti va o'tmishdagi ko'plab erkaklar va ayollarning taqvodor ishlari haqida juda odob bilan o'ynatdi, shuning uchun xonim unga o'zini tan olish istagi bilan qabul qilindi va Ferondo'dan ruxsat so'radi.

en: Accordingly, to the abbot’s exceeding pleasure, she came to confess to him and seating herself at his feet, before she proceeded to say otherwhat, began thus: ‘Sir, if God had given me a right husband or had given me none, it would belike be easy to me, with the help of your exhortations, to enter upon the road which you say leadeth folk unto life eternal; but I, having regard to what Ferondo is and to his witlessness, may style myself a widow, and yet I am married, inasmuch as, he living, I can have no other husband; and dolt as he is, he is without any cause, so out of all measure jealous of me that by reas- on thereof I cannot live with him otherwise than in tribulation and misery; wherefore, ere I come to other confession, I humbly beseech you, as most I may, that it may please you give me some counsel concerning this, for that, an the occasion of my well-doing begin not therefrom,
uz: Shunga ko'ra, abbotning haddan tashqari mamnunligiga ko'ra, u unga tan oldi va uning oyoqlariga o'tirdi, boshqa narsa deyishdan oldin shunday boshladi: "Janob, agar Xudo menga to'g'ri er bergan bo'lsa yoki menga hech kim bermagan bo'lsa, sizning maslahatlaringiz yordamida menga oson bo'lardi, siz odamlarni abadiy hayotga olib boradigan yo'lga kirish; lekin men, Ferondo nima ekanligini va uning beparvoligini hisobga olgan holda, o'zimni beva deb hisoblasam bo'ladi, lekin men turmush qurganman, chunki u tirik, boshqa erim bo'lishi mumkin emas; va u hech qanday sababsiz, shuning uchun u men bilan hech qanday darajada rashk qilmaydi, aks holda men u bilan birga yashay olmayman, aks holda kamtarona va kamtarona bilan keladigan bo'lsam; lekin, men sizdan iltimos qilaman, men bu borada bir

en: confession or other good work will proﬁt me little.’ This speech gave the abbot great satisfaction and himseemed fortune had opened him the way to his chief desire; wherefore, ‘Daughter,’ quoth he, ‘I can well believe that it must be a sore annoy for a fair and dainty dame such as you are to have a blockhead to husband, but a much greater meseemeth to have a jealous man; wherefore, you having both the one and the other, I can lightly credit that which you avouch of your tribulation.
uz: Menga iqrorlik yoki boshqa yaxshi ish kam foyda keltiradi." Bu nutq abbatga katta qoniqish berdi va unga katta omad yo'lini ochgandek tuyuldi; shuning uchun, "Qizim," dedi u, "Siz kabi go'zal va nozik ayol uchun eringizga bosh qotirish og'riqli bo'lishi kerakligiga yaxshi ishonaman, lekin undan ham ko'proq rashk qiluvchi odamga ega bo'lish mumkin; shuning uchun, sizda ikkalasi ham borligi sababli, men sizning musibatingizdan xavotirlanayotganingizni yengillik bilan ayta olaman.

en: But for this, speaking brieﬂy, I see neither counsel nor remedy save one, the which is that Ferondo be cured of this jealousy.
uz: Lekin buning uchun, qisqacha qilib aytganda, men hech qanday maslahat yoki vosita ko'rmayapman, faqat bitta maslahat bor, ya'ni Ferondo shu rashkdan davolanishi kerak.

en: The medicine that will cure him I know very well how to make, provided you have the heart to keep secret that which I shall tell you.’ ‘Father mine,’ answered the lady, ‘have no fear of that, for I would liefer suffer death than tell any that which you bid me not repeat; but how may this be done?’ Quoth the abbot, ‘An we would
uz: Uni davolaydigan dori-darmonni qanday tayyorlashni juda yaxshi bilaman, agar men sizga aytayotgan narsani sir saqlashga yuragingiz bo'lsa. Otam, dedi xonim, shundan qo'rqmang, chunki men siz menga takrorlamaslikni buyurgan har qanday narsani aytishdan ko'ra o'limni afzal ko'raman; lekin buni qanday qilish mumkin? Abbat aytdi: Biz...

en: have him cured, it behoveth of necessity that he go to purgatory.’ ‘But how,’ asked she, ‘can he go thither alive?’ ‘Needs must he die,’ replied the abbot, ‘and so go thither; and whenas he shall have suffered such penance as shall sufﬁce to purge him of his jealousy, we will pray God, with certain orisons that he restore him to this life, and He will do it.’ ‘Then,’ said the lady, ‘I am to become a widow?’ ‘Ay,’ answered the abbot, ‘for a certain time, wherein you must look well you suffer not yourself to be married again, for that God would take it in ill part, and whenas Ferondo returned hither, it would be- hove you return to him and he would then be more jealous than ever.’ Quoth she, ‘Provided he be but cured of this calamity, so it may not behove me abide in prison all my life, I am content; do as it pleaseth you.’ ‘And I will do it,’195 rejoined he; ‘but what guerdon am I to have
uz: Uni davolantirish zarur, albatta u tozalovchiga borishi kerak. Lekin, dedi u, u u yerga tirik borishi mumkinmi? U olishi kerak, javob berdi abbat, va u yerga boradi; va u uni rashkidan tozalashga yetadigan tavbani boshdan kechirganidan song, biz Xudoga, aniq umidlar bilan, uni bu hayotga qaytarishini soraymiz, va U buni qiladi.  Unda, men beva bolaman?  Ha,  deb javob berdi abbat, mabir muddatga koz bilan qaraysan, ozingni qayta turmushga bermasang, chunki Xudo uni yomonlik bilan olib qoyadi, va qachonki u senga bu hayotga qaytib keladi va u meni hech kimga yol qoymaydi,  lekin men uni...

en: of you for such a ser- vice?’ ‘Father,’ answered the lady, ‘you shall have whatsoever pleaseth you, so but it be in my power; but what can the like of me that may beﬁt such a man as yourself?’ ‘Madam,’ replied the abbot ‘you can do no less for me than that which I undertake to do for you; for that, like as I am disposed to do that which is to be your weal and your solacement, even so can you do that which will be the saving and assainment of my life.’ Quoth she, ‘An it be so, I am ready.’ ‘Then,’ said the abbot, ‘you must give me your love and vouchsafe me satisfaction of yourself, for whom I am all aﬁre with love and languishment.’ The lady, hearing this, was all aghast and answered, ‘Alack, father mine, what is this you ask?
uz: Sizdan bunday yomonlik uchunmi? Ota, javob berdi xonim, Sizga yoqqan har qanday narsaga ega bo'lasiz, lekin bu mening qo'limda bo'lsin; lekin men kabi o'zingiz kabi odamga nima mos kelishi mumkin? Xonim, javob berdi abbat Siz men uchun siz uchun qilishga o'z zimmangizda turgan narsadan kam qila olmaysiz; chunki men sizning boyligingiz va tasallingiz bo'lishga qasd qilganimdek, siz ham mening hayotimni saqlab qolish va tinchlantirishga yordam beradigan narsani qila olasiz. Xo'sh, u aytdi: Xo'sh, men tayyorman.  Unda, dedi abbat, Siz menga o'zingizning muhabbatingizni berishingiz kerak, chunki men siz bilan muhabbat va muhabbat bilan birga bo'laman.

en: Methought you were a saint.
uz: Siz avliyo ekanligingizni o'yladim.

en: Doth it beseem holy men to require women, who come to them for counsel, of such things?’ ‘Fair my soul,’ rejoined the abbot, ‘marvel not, for that sanctity nowise abateth by this, seeing it hath its seat in the soul and that which I ask of you is a sin of the body.
uz: Muqaddas erkaklar maslahat olish uchun ularga kelgan ayollardan bunday narsalarni talab qilishlari mumkinmi? Jonimni, deb javob berdi abbat, hayron bo'lma, chunki bu muqaddaslik endi ruhda o'rnashib, men sizdan so'rayotgan narsa tana gunohidir.

en: But, be that as it may, your ravishing beauty hath had such might that love constraineth me to do thus; and I tell you that you may glory in your charms over all other women, considering that they please holy men, who are used to look upon the beauties of heaven.
uz: Lekin, baribir, sizning hayratlanarli go'zalligingiz shunday kuchga ega ediki, sevgi meni shunday qilishga majbur qiladi; va men sizga aytamanki, siz o'z jozibangiz bilan boshqa ayollardan ko'ra faxrlanishingiz kerak, chunki ular samoviy go'zalliklarga qarashga odatlangan muqaddas erkaklarni mamnun qiladilar.

en: Moreover, abbot though I be, I am a man like another and am, as you see, not yet old.
uz: Qolaversa, abbat bo'lsam ham, men boshqalarga o'xshagan odamman va ko'rib turganingizdek, hali ham keksa emasman.

en: Nor should this that I ask be grievous to you to do; nay, you should rather desire it, for that, what while Ferondo sojourneth in purgatory, I will bear you company by night and render you that solacement which he should give you; nor shall any ever come to know of this, for that everyone believeth of me that, and more than that, which you but now believed of me.
uz: Men sizdan so'rayotgan bu ishni qilishingiz uchun qayg'urmanglar; yo'q, undan ko'ra xohlamanglar, chunki Ferondo do'zaxda qolayotganida, men sizni kechasi birga olib, u sizga berishi kerak bo'lgan tasalli beraman; hech kim bu haqda hech qachon bilmaydi, chunki hamma menga ishonadi, va undan ham ko'proq, siz hozir menga ishonasiz.

en: Reject not the grace that God sendeth you, for there be women enough who covet that which you
uz: Xudo sizga yuborgan inoyatni rad etmang, chunki siz xohlagan narsaga hirs qo'yadigan ayollar yetarli.

en: may have and shall have, if, like a wise woman, you hearken to my counsel.
uz: bo'lishi mumkin va bo'lishi ham mumkin, agar, dono ayol kabi, mening maslahatimga quloq solsangiz.

en: Moreover, I have fair and precious jewels, which I purpose shall belong to none other than yourself.
uz: Qolaversa, menda chiroyli va qimmatbaho taqinchoqlar bor, ularni faqat o'zingizniki bo'lishga maqsad qilaman.

en: Do, then, for me, sweet my hope, that which I willingly do for you.’ The lady hung her head, knowing not how to deny him, whilst herseemed it were ill done to grant him what he asked; but the abbot, seeing that she hearkened and hesitated to reply and himseeming he had already half con- verted her, followed up his ﬁrst words with many others and stayed not till he had persuaded her that she would do well to comply with him.
uz: Xo'sh, men uchun, umidim shirin bo'lsin, men siz uchun ixtiyoriy ravishda qilganimni. Xonim boshini osib qo'ydi, uni qanday inkor qilishni bilmay, o'ziga ko'rinsa-da, unga so'raganini berish yomon ish edi; lekin abbat uning tinglaganini va javob berishga ikkilanganini va u allaqachon yarim aldanganini ko'rib, uning birinchi so'zlarini ko'pchilik bilan birga davom ettirdi va u unga rozi bo'lish yaxshi bo'ladi deb ishontirmaguncha qolmadi.

en: Accord- ingly, she said, blushing, that she was ready to do his every commandment, but might not avail thereto till such time as Ferondo should be gone to pur- gatory; whereupon quoth the abbot, exceeding well pleased, ‘And we will make shift to send him thither incontinent; do you but contrive that he come hither tomorrow or next day to sojourn with me.’ So saying, he privily put a very handsome ring into her hand and dismissed her.
uz: U rozi bo'ldi, dedi qizarib, uning har bir buyrug'ini bajarishga tayyor edi, lekin Ferondo pur-gatorga borguncha bunga foyda keltirmasligi mumkin edi; shundan so'ng abbat juda xursand bo'lib, Va biz uni u yerga bemalol jo'natamiz; faqat u ertaga yoki ertasi kuni men bilan birga qolishi uchun bu yerga kelishini o'ylab toping. Shunday qilib, u qo'liga juda chiroyli uzukni qo'ydi va uni qo'yib yubordi.

en: The lady rejoiced at the gift and looking to have others, rejoined her companions, to whom she fell to relating marvellous things of the abbot’s sanctity, and presently re- turned home with them.
uz: Xonim sovg'adan xursand bo'ldi va boshqalarga ega bo'lishni xohladi, o'z hamrohlariga qo'shildi, ularga abbatning muqaddasligi haqidagi ajoyib narsalarni aytib berishga tushdi va tez orada ular bilan birga uyga qaytdi.

en: A few days after Ferondo repaired to the abbey, whom, whenas the abbot saw, he cast about to send him to purgatory.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng Ferondo abbatga qaytdi, uni abbat ko'rganida, uni purgoriyaga yuborish uchun tashladi.

en: Accordingly, he sought out a powder of marvellous virtue, which he had gotten in the parts of the Levant of a great prince who avouched it to be that which was wont to be used of the Old Man of the Mountain,196 whenas he would fain send anyone, sleep- ing, into his paradise or bring him forth thereof, and that, according as more or less thereof was given, without doing any hurt, it made him who took it sleep more or less [time] on such wise that, whilst its virtue lasted, none would say he had life in him.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u ajoyib fazilatning bir kukunini izladi, uni u ulug' shahzodaning Levant qismlaridan topgan edi. U uni Tog' Keksa odatdagidek ishlatadigan narsa deb hisoblagan edi. 196-yilda u hech kimni, uxlab, o'z jannatiga jo'natmoqchi edi yoki undan olib chiqmoqchi edi. Va uning ko'p yoki kam qismi berilgan bo'lsa ham, hech qanday zarar yetkazmasdan, uni qabul qilgan odamni shunday uxlatdiki, uning fazilatlari saqlanib qolgan bo'lsa ham, hech kim uning ichida hayot borligini aytmasdi.

en: Of this he took as much as might sufﬁce to make a man sleep three days and putting it in a beaker of wine, that was not yet well cleared, gave it to Ferondo to drink in his cell, without the latter suspecting aught; after which he carried him into the cloister and there with some of his monks fell to making sport of him and his dunceries; nor was it long before, the powder working, Ferondo was taken with so sudden and overpowering a drowsiness, that he slumbered as yet he stood afoot and presently fell down fast asleep.
uz: Bundan u odamni uch kun uxlatish uchun yetarlicha ko'p narsa oldi va uni hali yaxshi tozalangan bo'lmagan vino kosasiga soldi, Ferondoga xonasida ichish uchun berdi, oxirgi hech narsani gumon qilmasdan; keyin uni ibodatxonaga olib kirdi va u yerda ba'zi rohiblari uni va uning xarobalarini masxara qilish uchun yiqildi; shuningdek, ancha oldin ham kukun ishlayotgan edi, Ferondo shunday to'satdan va g'ayrat bilan ushlanib ketdiki, u hali ham uxlab qoldi, u turdi va tezda uxlab qoldi.

en: The abbot made a show of being concerned at this accident and letting untruss him, caused fetch cold water and cast it in his face and essay many other remedies of his fashion, as if he would recall the strayed life and
uz: Abbot bu baxtsiz hodisa haqida xavotirda ekanligini ko'rsatdi va unga ishonchsizlikka yo'l qo'ydi, sovuq suv olib kelishga undadi va uni yuziga tashladi va o'z modasining ko'plab boshqa davolarini o'ylab ko'rdi, go'yo adashgan hayotni eslayotgandek.

en: senses from [the oppression of] some fumosity of the stomach or whatnot like affection that had usurped them.
uz: O'zlashtirgan mehrga o'xshagan oshqozonning tutunligi yoki boshqa narsa kabi hissiyotlar.

en: The monks, seeing that for all this he came not to himself and feeling his pulse, but ﬁnding no sign of life in him, all held it for certain that he was dead.
uz: Rohiblar, bularning barchasi uchun u o'ziga kelmaganini va o'z impulsini his qilmaganini, balki unda hayot alomatini topmaganini ko'rib, uning o'lganiga ishonch hosil qilishdi.

en: Accordingly, they sent to tell his wife and his kinsfolk, who all came thither forthright, and the lady having bewept him awhile with her kinswomen, the abbot caused lay him, clad as he was, in a tomb; whilst the lady returned to her house and giving out that she meant never to part from a little son, whom she had had by her husband, abode at home and occupied herself with the governance of the child and of the wealth which had been Ferondo’s.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular uning xotini va qarindoshlariga xabar yuborishdi, ularning hammasi u yerga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelishdi. Xonim uni qarindoshlari bilan biroz ko'chirib, abbat uni xuddi o'zi kabi ko'ringan holda qabrga yotqizdi; xonim esa uyiga qaytib, eridan bo'lgan kichkina o'g'lidan hech qachon ajralmasligini, uyda qolishini va Ferondoga tegishli bo'lgan bolani va boyligini boshqarish bilan shug'ullanishini aytdi.

en: Meanwhile, the abbot arose stealthily in the night and with the aid of a Bolognese monk, in whom he much trus- ted and who was that day come thither from Bologna, took up Ferondo out of the tomb and carried him into a vault, in which there was no light to be seen and which had been made for prison of such of the monks as should make default in aught.
uz: Ayni paytda, sobor kechasi yashirincha turdi va Bolonyalik rohibning yordami bilan, unga juda ishonardi va u o'sha kuni Boloniyadan u yerga kelgan edi, Ferondoni qabrdan olib chiqib, uni ko'rinadigan hech qanday yorug'lik bo'lmagan va hech qanday zarar yetkazmasligi kerak bo'lgan rohiblarning qamoqxonasi uchun yaratilgan gumbazga olib kirdi.

en: There they pulled off his garments and clothing him monk-fashion, laid him on a truss of straw and there left him against he should recover his senses, whilst the Bolognese monk, having been instruc- ted by the abbot of that which he had to do, without any else knowing aught thereof, proceeded to await his coming to himself.
uz: U yerda ular uning kiyimlarini yechib, rohibona kiyimlarini kiydirishdi, uni somon ustiga qo'yishdi va u yerda o'z aql-idrokini tiklash uchun qoldirishdi. Bolonya rohib esa, nima qilish kerakligi haqida abbatdan ko'rsatma olgan holda, bundan boshqa hech narsa bilmasdan, uning o'ziga kelishini kutishga kirishdi.

en: On the morrow, the abbot, accompanied by sundry of his monks, betook himself, by way of visitation, to the house of the lady, whom he found clad in black and in great tribulation, and having comforted her awhile, he softly required her of her promise.
uz: Ertasi kuni abbat turli rohiblari bilan birga xonimning uyiga tashrif buyurdi. U uni qora va katta musibatga botgan holda topdi va bir oz tasalli berib, uning va'dasidan sekin talab qildi.

en: The lady, ﬁnding herself free and unhindered of Ferondo or any other and seeing on his ﬁnger another ﬁne ring, replied that she was ready and appointed him to come to her that same night.
uz: Xonim o'zini Ferondo yoki boshqa har qanday narsadan ozod va hech qanday to'siqsiz his qilib, uning barmog'ida yana bir nozik uzukni ko'rib, u tayyor ekanligini va uni o'sha kecha uning oldiga kelishini tayinlaganini javob berdi.

en: Accord- ingly, night come, the abbot, disguised in Ferondo’s clothes and accompan- ied by the monk his conﬁdant, repaired thither and lay with her in the ut- most delight and pleasance till the morning, when he returned to the abbey.
uz: Shunday qilib, kech kirgach, Ferondo libosida niqoblangan va rohib o'z sirdoshiga hamroh bo'lgan abbat u yerga qaytdi va ertalabgacha, u abbatga qaytib kelguncha, u bilan eng ko'p zavq va rohatda yotdi.

en: After this he very often made the same journey on a like errand and being whiles encountered, coming or going, of one or another of the villagers, it was believed he was Ferondo who went about those parts, doing penance; by reason whereof many strange stories were after bruited about among the simple countryfolk, and this was more than once reported to Ferondo’s wife, who well knew what it was.
uz: Shundan so'ng u ko'pincha xuddi shunday ishga qatnashib, qishloq aholisining bir yoki biridan uchrashib, kelib-ketib, ketayotganda, u yerlarda aylanib yurgan, tavba qilgan Ferondo deb ishongan; shuning uchun oddiy qishloq aholisi orasida ko'plab g'alati hikoyalar tarqalgan va bu Ferondo xotiniga bir necha bor xabar berilgan edi, u buni yaxshi bilardi.

en: As for Ferondo, when he recovered his senses and found himself he knew not where, the Bolognese monk came in to him with a horrible noise and laying hold of him, gave him a sound drubbing with a rod he had in his
uz: Ferondoga kelsak, u o'zini tutib, qayerga borishini bilmasligini anglaganida, Bolonya rohib dahshatli shovqin bilan uning oldiga kirib, uni ushladi va o'zida turgan tayoq bilan unga tomchilab turgan ovoz berdi.

en: Ferondo, weeping and crying out, did nought but ask, ‘Where am I?’ To which the monk answered, ‘Thou art in purgatory.’ ‘How?’ cried Fer- ondo.
uz: Ferondo yig'lab, baqirib, hech narsa qilmadi, faqat so'radi: "Men qayerdaman?" Bunga rohib javob berdi: "Sen tozaxonadasan." "Qanday qilib?" deb baqirdi Fer- OK.

en: ‘Am I then dead?’ ‘Ay, certes,’ replied the other; whereupon Ferondo fell to bemoaning himself and his wife and child, saying the oddest things in the world.
uz: Shunday qilib, men o'lgan bo'ldimmi? Ha, albatta,  javob berdi ikkinchisi; shundan so'ng Ferondo o'zi, xotini va farzandi bilan dunyodagi eng g'alati narsalarni aytib, achinishga tushdi.

en: Presently the monk brought him somewhat of meat and drink, which Ferondo seeing, ‘What!’ cried he.
uz: Hozir rohib unga bir oz go'sht va ichimlik olib keldi, Ferondo uni ko'rib, "Nima!" deb baqirdi.

en: ‘Do the dead eat?’ ‘Ay do they,’ answered the monk.
uz: O'liklar yeydimi? Oh, ular yeyishadi,  javob berdi rohib.

en: ‘This that I bring thee is what the woman, thy wife that was, sent this morning to the church to let say masses for thy soul, and God the Lord willeth that it be made over to thee.’ Quoth Ferondo, ‘God grant her a good year!
uz: "Senga olib kelayotgan narsa, bu ertalab sening xotining bo'lgan ayolning senga joning uchun namoz o'qish uchun cherkovga yuborgan narsasidir. Xudo Rabbiy senga uni qaytarishini xohlaydi." Ferondo aytdi: "Xudo unga yaxshi yil bersin!"

en: I still cherished her ere I died, insomuch that I held her all night in mine arms and did nought but kiss her, and t’ other thing also I did, when I had a mind thereto.’ Then, being very sharp-set, he fell to eating and drinking and himseeming the wine was not overgood, ‘Lord confound her!’ quoth he.
uz: Men uni o'limimdan oldin ham qadrlardim, shuning uchun uni butun tun qo'llarimda ushlab turdim va uni o'pdim, va boshqa narsa ham qildim, qachonki o'zimni o'ylagandim. Keyin juda o'tkir his qilgan holda, u yeb-ichishga tushdi va vino juda yaxshi emas deb o'yladi, "Egam uni sharmanda qilsin!" - dedi u.

en: ‘Why did not she give the priest wine of the cask against the wall?’ After he had eaten, the monk laid hold of him anew and gave him another sound beating with the same rod; whereat Ferondo roared out lustily and said, ‘Alack, why dost thou this to me?’ Quoth the monk, ‘Because thus hath God the Lord ordained that it be done unto thee twice every day.’ ‘And for what cause?’ asked Ferondo.
uz: Nega u ruhoniyga tomchadan vino devorga qarshi bermadi? Yechgach, rohib uni yana ushladi va xuddi shu tayoq bilan yana bir marta urdi; shunda Ferondo shahvoniy ovoz bilan qichqirdi va dedi: Alak, nega menga buni qilyapsan? Rohib aytdi: Chunki Xudo Rabbiy senga har kuni ikki marta shunday qilishni buyurdi. Va nima uchun? deb so'radi Ferondo.

en: ‘Because,’ answered the monk, ‘thou wast jealous, having the best woman in the country to wife.’ ‘Alas!’ said Fer- ondo.
uz: Chunki,  javob berdi rohib, sen qishloqdagi eng yaxshi ayolni xotinlikka olganing uchun rashk qilgansan. Alas! dedi Fer- OK.

en: ‘Thou sayst sooth, ay, and the kindest creature; she was sweeter than syrup; but I knew not that God the Lord held it for ill that a man should be jealous; else had I not been so.’ Quoth the monk, ‘Thou shouldst have be- thought thyself of that, whenas thou wast there below,197 and have amended thee thereof; and should it betide that thou ever return thither, look thou so have in mind that which I do unto thee at this present that thou be never- more jealous.’ ‘What?’ said Ferondo.
uz: "Sen xotirjamsan, ey, va eng mehribon maxluqsan, u siropdan ham shirinroq edi; lekin men Xudo Egamning odam rashk qilishi kerakligini yomon ko'rishini bilmas edim; aks holda men bunday bo'lmas edim."  Rohib aytdi: Sen o'zing o'ylab ko'rishing kerak edi, chunki sen u yerda eding, 197 va unga o'zgartirishlar kiritgan eding; va agar u yerga qaytib kelishing kerak bo'lsa, hozir senga nima qilayotganimni shunday esla, endi sen hech qachon rashk qilma.  Nima? dedi Ferondo.

en: ‘Do the dead ever return thither?’ ‘Ay,’ answered the monk; ‘whom God willeth.’ ‘Marry,’ cried Ferondo, ‘and I ever return thither, I will be the best husband in the world; I will never beat her nor give her an ill word, except it be anent the wine she sent hither this morning and for that she sent no candles, so it behoved me to eat in the dark.’ ‘Nay,’ said the monk, ‘she sent candles enough, but they were all burnt for the masses.’ ‘True,’ rejoined Ferondo; ‘and assuredly, an I return thither, I will let her do what she will.
uz: O'liklar u yerga qaytib boradimi? Ha, javob berdi rohib; Xudo xohlagan. Uylang, Ferondo qichqirdi, va men u yerga qaytib boraman, men dunyodagi eng yaxshi er bo'laman; men uni hech qachon urmayman va unga yomon so'z aytmayman, faqatgina bugun ertalab u bu yerga yuborgan vino bo'lsa va shuning uchun u sham yuborgan bo'lsa, shuning uchun qorong'ida ovqatlanishim kerak edi. Yo'q, dedi rohib, u yetarli sham yuborgan, lekin ularning hammasi olomon uchun yoqilgan edi. To'g'ri, javob berdi Ferondo;  va ishonch bilan, men u yerga qaytib boraman, unga xohlaganini qilaman.

en: But tell me, who art thou that usest me thus?’ Quoth the monk, ‘I also am dead.
uz: Lekin menga aytgin, sen meni shunday ishlatadigan kimsan? Rohib iqtibos berdi: Men ham olganman.

en: I was of Sardinia and for that aforetime I much commended a master of mine of being jealous, I have
uz: Men Sardiniyadan edim va o'sha vaqt davomida xo'jayinimni rashk qilgani uchun juda maqtadim, men...

en: been doomed of God to this punishment, that I must give thee to eat and drink and beat thee thus, till such time as God shall ordain otherwhat of thee and of me.’ Then said Ferondo, ‘Is there none here other than we twain?’ ‘Ay,’ answered the monk, ‘there be folk by the thousands; but thou canst neither see nor hear them, nor they thee.’ Quoth Ferondo, ‘And how far are we from our own countries?’ ‘Ecod,’ replied the other, ‘we are distant thence more miles than we can well cack at a bout.’ ‘Faith,’ rejoined the farmer, ‘that is far enough; meseemeth we must be out of the world, an it be so much as all that.’ In such and the like discourse was Ferondo entertained half a score months with eating and drinking and beating, what while the abbot assidu- ously visited the fair lady, without miscarriage, and gave himself the goodli- est time in the world with her.
uz: Xudo seni shu jazoga mahkum qildi, men seni yeyishga, ichishga va shunday urishga majbur bo'laman, toki Xudo sendan va mendan boshqa narsani tayinlamaguncha." Shunda Ferondo dedi: "Bizdan boshqa hech kim yo'qmi?" "Ha," dedi rohib, "minglab odamlar bor; lekin sen ularni na ko'ra olmaysan, na eshitmaysan, na ular seni ham eshitmaydilar." Quoth Ferondo: "Va biz o'z mamlakatlarimizdan qanchalik uzoqdamiz?" "Ecod," javob berdi, "biz u yerdan bir necha mil uzoqroqmiz." "Iymon," dedi fermer, "bu yetarli;" deb javob berdi, "biz dunyodan uzoqroq bo'lishimiz kerak, bu hammasi shunday."

en: At last, as ill-luck would have it, the lady found herself with child and straightway acquainted the abbot therewith, wherefore it seemed well to them both that Ferondo should without delay be recalled from purgatory to life and return to her, so she might avouch herself with child by him.
uz: Nihoyat, omadsiz bo'lgani kabi, xonim o'zini farzandli deb topdi va darhol abbot bilan tanishtirdi. Shuning uchun, Ferondo zudlik bilan purgoriydan hayotga chaqirib olinsa va u bilan birga qaytib kelsa, u o'zini undan farzandli qilib olishi mumkinligi ularning ikkalasi uchun ham ma'qul tuyuldi.

en: Accordingly, the abbot that same night caused call to Ferondo in prison with a counterfeit voice, saying, ‘Ferondo, take comfort, for it is God’s pleasure that thou return to the world, where thou shalt have a son by thy wife, whom look thou name Benedict, for that by the prayers of thy holy abbot and of thy wife and for the love of St.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'sha kecha abbat Ferondoga qamoqxonada soxta ovoz bilan qo'ng'iroq qilib, dedi: "Ferondo, tasalli ol, chunki Xudoning irodasi shuki, sen dunyoga qaytib, xotiningdan o'g'il ko'rishing kerak, uni Benedikt deb ataysan, chunki bu sening muqaddas abbating va xotiningning duolari va muhabbati bilan va avliyo...

en: Bene- dict He doth thee this favour.’ Ferondo, hearing this, was exceedingly re- joiced and said, ‘It liketh me well, Lord grant a good year to Seignior God Almighty and to the abbot and St.
uz: Xudo senga bu inoyatni ko'rsatadi. Ferondo buni eshitib, juda xursand bo'lib dedi:  Menga yaxshi yoqdi, Rabbiy, Rabbiy Xudo Qodir va abbat va Avliyoga yaxshi yil ato etgin.

en: Benedict and my cheesy198 sweet honey wife.’ The abbot let give him, in the wine that he sent him, so much of the powder aforesaid as should cause him sleep maybe four hours and with the aid of his monk, having put his own clothes on him, restored him privily to the tomb wherein he had been buried.
uz: Benedikt va mening pishloqli 198 ta shirin asal xotinim.  Abbat unga yuborilgan vinodan, ehtimol to'rt soat uxlashi kerak bo'lgan, deb aytilgan kukunni berdi va rohibining yordami bilan o'z kiyimlarini kiydirib, uni yashirincha dafn etilgan qabrga qaytardi.

en: Next morning, at break of day, Ferondo came to himself and espying light —a thing which he had not seen for good ten months —through some crevice of the tomb, doubted not but he was alive again.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, kunduzgi tongda Ferondo o'ziga keldi va o'n oy davomida ko'rmagan narsasini ko'rib, qabrning biror teshigidan o'tib, u yana tirik ekanligiga shubha qilmadi.

en: Accordingly, he fell to bawling out, ‘Open to me!
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u qichqirib dedi: Menga och!

en: Open to me!’ and heaving so lustily at the lid of the tomb with his head that he stirred it, for that it was eath to move, and had begun to move it away, when the monks, having now made an end of saying matins, ran thither and knew Ferondo’s voice and saw him in act to come forth of the sepulchre; whereupon, all aghast for the strangeness of the case, they took to their heels and ran to the abbot, who made a show of
uz: Menga och! va qabrning qopqog'iga boshini shunday ko'tarib, uni harakatga keltirdi, chunki u harakatlanishga tayyor edi va uni uzoqlashtirishni boshlagan edi, endi matin so'zlaridan so'ng rohiblar yugurib o'sha yerga borishdi va Ferondo'ning ovozini bildilar va uni qabrdan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rishdi; shundan so'ng, bu holatning g'alatiligidan hayratda bo'lib, oyoqlarini tutib, abbatga yugurdilar, u esa

en: rising from prayer and said, ‘My sons, have no fear; take the cross and the holy water and follow after me, so we may see that which God willeth to show forth to us of His might’; and as he said, so he did.
uz: Duodan turib dedi: Ey ogillarim, qorqmanglar, xochni va muqaddas suvni olib, menga ergashinglar, shunda biz Xudo Oz qudratini bizga korsatmoqchi bolgan narsani koramiz; va u aytganidek, shunday qildi.

en: Now Ferondo was come forth of the sepulchre all pale, as well might he be who had so long abidden without seeing the sky.
uz: Endi Ferondo qabrdan butunlay oqarib chiqdi, xuddi osmonni ko'rmasdan uzoq yashiringan odam bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: As soon as he saw the abbot, he ran to cast himself at his feet and said, ‘Father mine, according to that which hath been revealed to me, your prayers and those of St.
uz: U abbatni ko'rishi bilanoq, u yugurib, oyoqlari ostiga quladi va dedi: "Otam, menga vahiy qilingan narsaga ko'ra, sizning ibodatlaringiz va Avliyo..."

en: Benedict and my wife have delivered me from the pains of purgatory and restored me to life, wherefore I pray God to give you a good year and good calends now and always.’ Quoth the abbot, ‘Praised be God His might!
uz: Benedikt va rafiqam meni pokxona azoblaridan qutqardilar va hayotni tikladilar, shuning uchun men Xudodan sizga hozir ham, doimo yaxshi yil va yaxshi yillar berishini so'rayman." Abbat ta'kidladi: "Xudoga Uning qudrati muborak bo'lsin!"

en: Go, my son, since He hath sent thee back hither; comfort thy wife, who hath been still in tears, since thou departedst this life, and henceforth be a friend and servant of God.’ ‘Sir,’ replied Ferondo, ‘so hath it indeed been said to me; only leave me do; for, as soon as I ﬁnd her, I shall buss her, such goodwill do I bear her.’ The abbot, left alone with his monks, made a great show of wonderment at this miracle and caused devoutly sing Miserere therefor.
uz: Bor, o'g'lim, chunki U seni bu yerga qaytarib yubordi; bu hayotdan ketganingdan beri hali ham yig'layotgan xotiningni ovut, va bundan buyon Xudoning do'sti va xizmatkori bo'l. Janob,  javob berdi Ferondo,  Menga shunday deyilgan edi; faqat menga qo'yib yubor; chunki, uni topishim bilanoq, men uni uraman, unga shunday yaxshilik qilaman. Avvat rohiblari bilan yolg'iz qolgan holda, bu mo'jizaga katta hayrat ko'rsatdi va unga taqvodorlik bilan Miserere qo'shig'ini aytdi.

en: As for Ferondo, he returned to his village, where all who saw him ﬂed, as men use to do from things frightful; but he called them back and avouched himself to be raised up again.
uz: Ferondoga kelsak, u o'z qishlog'iga qaytib keldi, u yerda uni ko'rganlarning hammasi qochib ketdi, odamlar qo'rqinchli ishlardan odatdagidek; lekin u ularni qaytarib chaqirib oldi va qayta tiklanish uchun o'zini tashladi.

en: His wife on like wise feigned to be adread of him; but, after the folk were somewhat reassured anent him and saw that he was indeed alive, they questioned him of many things, and he, as it were he had re- turned wise, made answer to all and gave them news of the souls of their kinsfolk, making up, of his own motion, the ﬁnest fables in the world of the affairs of purgatory and recounting in full assembly the revelation made him by the mouth of the Rangel Bragiel199 ere he was raised up again.
uz: Uning xotini o'zini dono ko'rsatib, unga murojaat qildi; lekin odamlar unga biroz ishonch hosil qilib, uning haqiqatan ham tirik ekanligini ko'rgach, uni ko'p narsalardan so'roq qilishdi va u, go'yo dono bo'lgandek, hammaga javob berdi va ularga qarindoshlarining ruhlari haqida xabar berdi, o'z xohishi bilan purgoh ishlarining dunyodagi eng yaxshi ertaklarini yaratdi va Rangel Bragiel199 og'zi orqali unga berilgan vahiy haqida to'liq yig'ilish orqali aytib berdi, u qayta tirildi.

en: Then, returning to his house and entering again into possession of his goods, he got his wife, as he thought, with child, and by chance it befell that, in due time —to the thinking of the fools who believe that women go just nine months with child —the lady gave birth to a boy, who was called Benedict Ferondi.200 Ferondo’s return and his talk, well nigh everyone believing him to have risen from the dead, added inﬁnitely to the renown of the abbot’s sanctity, and he himself, as if cured of his jealousy by the many beatings he had re- ceived therefor, thenceforward, according to the promise made by the abbot to the lady, was no more jealous; whereat she was well pleased and lived honestly with him, as of her wont, save indeed that, whenas she conveni-
uz: Keyin, uyiga qaytib, yana o'z mulkiga kirdi, u o'ylagandek, xotiniga farzand ko'rdi va tasodifan shunday bo'ldi: o'z vaqtida  ayollar bola bilan atigi to'qqiz oy yuradi deb hisoblaydigan ahmoqlarning fikrlariga ko'ra  xonim o'g'il tug'di, u Benedikt Ferondi deb atalgan. 200 Ferondo'ning qaytishi va uning gaplari, deyarli hamma uni o'liklardan tirilgan deb hisoblardi, abbotning muqaddasligiga cheksiz qo'shdi, va u o'zi ham, xuddi ko'p kaltaklar tufayli rashkidan tuzalgandek, shundan keyin, abbotning xonimga bergan va'dosiga ko'ra, u hali ham hech qanday rashk qilmadi; u o'zi bilan yaxshi edi va xolis,

en: ently might, she willingly foregathered with the holy abbot, who had so well and diligently served her in her greatest needs.”
uz: Quvvat bilan, u muqaddas abbot bilan ixtiyoriy ravishda oldinga yig'ildi, u unga eng katta ehtiyojlarida juda yaxshi va astoydil xizmat qilgan edi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Gillette de Narbonne recovereth the King of France of a ﬁstula and demandeth for her husband Bertrand de Roussillon, who marrieth her against his will and betaketh him for despite to Florence, where, he paying court to a young lady, Gillette, in the person of the latter, lieth with him and hath by him two sons; wherefore after, holding her dear, he entertaineth her for his wife.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA Gillette de Narbonne Fransiya qirolini fistuladan qutqaradi va eriga Bertrand de Roussillonni talab qiladi. Er uni o'z xohishiga zid ravishda turmushga chiqardi va Florensiyaga qaramasdan uni ta'qib qildi. U yerda u yosh xonimga hurmat ko'rsatar ekan, Gillette, oxirgi xonimning shaxsiyasida, u bilan yotadi va uning yonida ikki o'g'il bor; shuning uchun uni qadrlab, uni xotinlikka oladi.

en: Lauretta’s story being now ended, it rested but with the queen to tell, an she would not infringe upon Dioneo’s privilege; wherefore, without waiting to be solicited by her companions, she began all blithesomely to speak thus: “Who shall tell a story that may appear goodly, now we have heard that of Lauretta?
uz: Laurettaning hikoyasi endi tugagach, uni aytish faqat malikaga tegishli edi, chunki u Dioneoning imtiyozini buzmas edi; shuning uchun, o'z hamrohlari tomonidan so'ralishini kutmasdan, u shiddat bilan shunday gapira boshladi: "Kim yaxshi ko'rinadigan hikoyani aytadi, endi biz Laurettani eshitdik?"

en: Certes, it was well for us that hers was not the ﬁrst, for that few of the others would have pleased after it, as I misdoubt me201 will betide of those which are yet to tell this day.
uz: Albatta, uning birinchi bo'lmasligi biz uchun yaxshi edi, chunki undan keyin qolganlarning bir nechtasi xursand bo'lardi, chunki men shubhalanamanki, men hali bu kunni aytmaganlardan afzalroq bo'laman.

en: Natheless, be that as it may, I will e’en recount to you that which occurreth to me upon the proposed theme.
uz: Shunga qaramay, qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, men sizga taklif etilgan mavzu bo'yicha o'zim bilan sodir bo'lgan narsani aytib beraman.

en: There was in the kingdom of France a gentleman called Isnard, Count of Roussillon, who, for that he was scant of health, still entertained about his person a physician, by name Master Gerard de Narbonne.
uz: Fransiya qirolligida Isnard ismli janob bor edi, Roussillon grafi. U sog'lig'i yomon bo'lgani uchun, o'z shaxsi haqida usta Gerard de Narbonne ismli shifokor haqida o'ylardi.

en: The said count had one little son, and no more, hight Bertrand, who was exceeding hand- some and agreeable, and with him other children of his own age were brought up.
uz: Aytilgan grafning bitta kichkina o'g'li bor edi, undan ham ko'proq, baland Bertrand, u juda qo'lchan va xushmuomala edi, va u bilan birga o'z yoshidagi boshqa bolalar ham tarbiyalandi.

en: Among these latter was a daughter of the aforesaid physician, by name Gillette, who vowed to the said Bertrand an inﬁnite love and fer- vent more than pertained unto her tender years.
uz: Ularning orasida yuqorida aytilgan shifokorning qizi Gillette bor edi. U Bertrandga uning yoshlik yillariga tegishli bo'lgan cheksiz sevgi va mehrni va'da qilgan edi.

en: The count dying and leav- ing his son in the hands of the king, it behoved him betake himself to Paris, whereof the damsel abode sore disconsolate, and her own father dying no great while after, she would fain, an she might have had a seemly occasion, have gone to Paris to see Bertrand: but, being straitly guarded, for that she
uz: Graf o'layotgan va o'g'lini qirol qo'lida qoldirgan holda, u Parijga borishi kerak edi, u yerda xonim xafa bo'lib qoldi va otasi ham ancha vaqt o'tgach o'lib ketdi, u bemalol Bertranni ko'rish uchun Parijga borgan bo'lishi mumkin edi: lekin qattiq qo'riqlangan holda, chunki u

en: was left rich and alone, she saw no honourable way thereto; and being now of age for a husband and having never been able to forget Bertrand, she had, without reason assigned, refused many to whom her kinsfolk would have married her.
uz: boy va yolg'iz qolgan edi, u bunga hech qanday sharafli yo'l ko'rmas edi; va endi erga ulg'aygan va Bertranni hech qachon unutolmaganligi sababli, u hech qanday sababsiz ravishda qarindoshlari uni turmushga chiqargan ko'pchilikni rad etgan edi.

en: Now it befell that, what while she burned more than ever for love of Ber- trand, for that she heard he was grown a very goodly gentleman, news came to her how the King of France, by an imposthume which he had had in his breast and which had been ill tended, had gotten a ﬁstula, which occasioned him the utmost anguish and annoy, nor had he yet been able to ﬁnd a physi- cian who might avail to recover him thereof, albeit many had essayed it, but all had aggravated the ill; wherefore the king, despairing of cure, would have no more counsel nor aid of any.
uz: Endi shunday bo'ldiki, u Ber-trandga bo'lgan muhabbatidan har qachongidan ham ko'proq kuyganida, uning juda yaxshi janob bo'lib ulg'ayganini eshitganda, unga Fransiya qiroli ko'kragida bo'lgan va yomon parvarishlangan firibgarlik natijasida unga qattiq azob va g'azab keltirib chiqaradigan fitula qanday paydo bo'lganligi haqida xabar keldi, va u hali uni undan qutqarishga yordam beradigan birorta jismoniy vosita topa olmadi, garchi ko'pchilik buni sinab ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, lekin hammasi kasallikni kuchaytirgan edi; shuning uchun qirol davolanishdan umidvor bo'lib, hech qanday maslahat va yordamga ega bo'lmas edi.

en: Hereof the young lady was beyond measure content and bethought herself that not only would this furnish her with a legitimate occasion of going to Paris, but that, should the king’s ail- ment be such as she believed, she might lightly avail to have Bertrand to husband.
uz: Bundan yosh xonim haddan tashqari mamnun edi va o'zini nafaqat bu Parijga borish uchun qonuniy imkoniyat yaratadi, balki, agar qirolning ahvoli o'zi ishonadiganidek bo'lsa, u Bertranni eriga olishdan yengil foydalanishi mumkin deb o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, having aforetime learned many things of her father, she made a powder of certain simples useful for such an inﬁrmity as she conceived the king’s to be and taking horse, repaired to Paris.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, otasidan ko'p narsalarni o'rganganidan so'ng, u Parijga ta'mirlangan otni olib, qirolning kasalligi uchun foydali bo'lgan ba'zi oddiy narsalardan kukun yasadi.

en: Before aught else she studied to see Bertrand and next, presenting herself before the king, she prayed him of his favour to show her his ailment.
uz: Bundan oldin u Bertranni ko'rishga o'qidi va keyin, o'zini shoh huzuriga olib kelib, unga o'z dardini ko'rsatish uchun iltijo qildi.

en: The king, seeing her a fair and engaging damsel, knew not how to deny her and showed her that which ailed him.
uz: Shoh uni go'zal va jozibali qizni ko'rib, uni qanday inkor qilishni bilmas edi va unga o'ziga yoqqan narsani ko'rsatdi.

en: Whenas she saw it, she was certiﬁed in- continent that she could heal it and accordingly said, ‘My lord, an it please you, I hope in God to make you whole of this your inﬁrmity in eight days’ time, without annoy or fatigue on your part.’ The king scoffed in himself at her words, saying, ‘That which the best physicians in the world have availed not neither known to do, how shall a young woman know?’ Accord- ingly, he thanked her for her good will and answered that he was resolved no more to follow the counsel of physicians.
uz: Uni ko'rganida, u uni davolay olganiga qit'ada ishonch hosil qildi va shunga ko'ra dedi: "Hazratim, bu sizga yoqdi, men Xudoga umid qilamanki, sizni sakkiz kun ichida bu kasalligingizdan butunlay qutqaradi, siz tomondan asabiylik yoki charchoq bo'lmasin". Shoh uning so'zlaridan o'zini masxara qilib dedi: "Dunyodagi eng yaxshi shifokorlar hech qanday foyda ko'rmagan va bilmagan narsani yosh ayol qanday biladi?"

en: Whereupon quoth the damsel, ‘My lord, you make light of my skill, for that I am young and a woman; but I would have you bear in mind that I medicine not of mine own science, but with the aid of God and the science of Master Gerard de Narbonne, who was my father and a famous physician whilst he lived.’ The king, hearing this, said in himself, ‘It may be this woman is sent me of God; why should I not make proof of her knowledge, since she saith she will, without annoy of mine, cure me in little time?’ Accordingly, being re- solved to essay her, he said, ‘Damsel, and if you cure us not, after causing
uz: Shundan so'ng qiz dedi: "Hazratim, siz mening mahoratimni kamsitasiz, chunki men yoshman va ayolman; lekin shuni yodda tutingki, men o'z bilimim bilan davolanmayman, balki Xudoning yordami bilan va otam va tirikligida mashhur shifokor bo'lgan ustoz Gerard de Narbonning bilimlari bilan davolanaman." Buni eshitib, shoh o'ziga dedi: "Bu ayol menga Xudodan yuborilgan bo'lishi mumkin; nega uning bilimini isbotlamasligim kerak, chunki u mening jahli chiqmasdan meni qisqa vaqt ichida davolaydi," dedi. Shunga ko'ra, uni qayta davolash uchun javob olgach, u dedi: "Qiz, agar siz bizni davolamasangiz,

en: us break our resolution, what will you have ensue to you therefor?’ ‘My lord,’ answered she, ‘set a guard upon me and if I cure you not within eight days, let burn me alive; but, if I cure you, what reward shall I have?’ Quoth the king, ‘You seem as yet unhusbanded; if you do this, we will marry you well and worshipfully.’ ‘My lord,’ replied the young lady, ‘I am well pleased that you should marry me, but I will have a husband such as I shall ask of you, excepting always any one of your sons or of the royal house.’ He read- ily promised her that which she sought, whereupon she began her cure and in brief, before the term limited, she brought him back to health.
uz: Qarorimizni buzsak, sizga nima bo'ladi? Hazratim, javob berdi u, Menga qo'riqchi qo'ying, agar sizni sakkiz kun ichida davolamasam, meni tiriklayin yoqing; lekin, agar sizni davolasam, menga nima mukofot bo'ladi? Qarang, Siz hali turmushga chiqmagan ko'rinasiz; agar shunday qilsangiz, biz sizga yaxshi va sadoqat bilan turmushga chiqamiz. Hazratim, javob berdi yosh xonim, Siz meni turmushga chiqishingizdan xursandman, lekin sizdan so'ragan erim bo'ladi, har doim o'g'illaringizdan yoki qirollik uyidan birortasidan tashqari. U unga qidirgan narsasini aytdi, shundan so'ng u davolanishni boshladi va qisqa muddat ichida uni sog'aytirdi.

en: The king, feeling himself healed, said, ‘Damsel, you have well earned your husband’; whereto she answered, ‘Then, my lord, I have earned Ber- trand de Roussillon, whom I began to love even in the days of my child- hood and have ever since loved over all.’ The king deemed it a grave matter to give him to her; nevertheless, having promised her and unwilling to fail of his faith, he let call the count to himself and bespoke him thus: ‘Bertrand, you are now of age and accomplished [in all that behoveth unto man’s es- tate];202 wherefore it is our pleasure that you return to govern your county and carry with you a damsel, whom we have given you to wife.’ ‘And who is the damsel, my lord?’ asked Bertrand; to which the king answered, ‘It is she who hath with her medicines restored to us our health.’ Bertrand, who had seen and recognized Gillette, knowing her (albeit she seemed to him very fair)
uz: Shoh o'zini sog'ayganini his qilib, dedi: "Xonim, sen eringni yaxshi qo'lga kiritding"; unga javob berdi: "Unda, xo'jayinim, men Ber- trand de Roussillonni qo'lga kiritdim, uni men bolaligimdan ham sevishni boshladim - kapyushon va shundan beri hammadan ham sevaman." Shoh unga uni berish juda og'ir ish deb hisobladi; ammo, unga va'da berib, o'z e'tiqodidan qaytishni istamadi, u grafni o'ziga chaqirib, uni shunday so'radi: "Bertrand, sen endi yoshsan va odamga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani uddalading;202 qayerda sizning okrugingizga qaytishingiz va siz bilan bir qizni olib yurishingiz bizga ma'qul edi, biz esa seni xotinlikka berdik." "Va u bizning xo'jayinim bilan birga kimni ko'rgan edi?

en: to be of no such lineage as sorted with his quality, said all disdainfully, ‘My lord, will you then marry me to a she-leach?
uz: Uning sifatiga mos keladigan nasl bo'lmasligi uchun, hamma nafrat bilan dedi: Ey xo'jayin, unda menga qizga turmushga chiqasizmi?

en: Now God forbid I should ever take such an one to wife!’ ‘Then,’ said the king, ‘will you have us fail of our faith, the which, to have our health again, we pledged to the damsel, who in guerdon thereof demanded you to husband?’ ‘My lord,’ answered Bertrand, ‘you may, an you will, take from me whatso- ever I possess or, as your liegeman, bestow me upon whoso pleaseth you; but of this I certify you, that I will never be a consenting party unto such a marriage.’ ‘Nay,’ rejoined the king, ‘but you shall, for that the damsel is fair and wise and loveth you dear; wherefore we doubt not but you will have a far happier life with her than with a lady of higher lineage.’ Bertrand held his peace and the king let make great preparations for the celebration of the marriage.
uz: Endi Xudo menga bunday odamni xotin qilmasin!  Unda,  dedi shoh,  biz sogligimizni tiklash uchun sizni turmushga soragan qizga qasam ichamizmi?  Egam,  javob berdi Bertrand,  siz mendan xohlagan narsangizni olishingiz mumkin yoki, yolgonchi sifatida, sizga yoqqan odamni menga sovga qiling; lekin men sizga shuni tasdiqlaymanki, men bunday nikohga hech qachon rozi bolmayman.  Yoq,  dedi shoh,  lekin siz, chunki qiz sizni yaxshi koradi va dono va sizni sevadi; shuning uchun biz sizda uning hayoti bilan yuqori bolgan ayol borligiga shubha yoq, lekin sizda katta xursandchilik va xursandchilik bolsin.

en: The appointed day being come, Bertrand, sore against his will, in the presence of the king, espoused the damsel, who loved him more than her- self.
uz: Belgilangan kun kelgach, Bertrand o'z irodasidan norozi bo'lib, shoh huzurida uni o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq sevuvchi qizga turmushga chiqdi.

en: This done, having already determined in himself what he should do, he
uz: Buni qilgan, o'zida nima qilish kerakligini allaqachon aniqlagan holda, u...

en: sought leave of the king to depart, saying he would fain return to his county and there consummate the marriage; then, taking horse, he repaired not thither, but betook himself into Tuscany, where, hearing that the Florentines were at war with those of Sienna, he determined to join himself to the former, by whom he was joyfully received and made captain over a certain number of men-at-arms; and there, being well provided203 of them, he abode a pretty while in their service.
uz: Shohdan ketish uchun ruxsat so'radi, u o'z okrugiga qaytib, u yerda nikohni yakunlashni xohladi; keyin ot olib, u yerga qaytmadi, balki Toskaniyaga o'tdi. U yerda Florensiyaliklar Siennaliklar bilan urush qilayotganini eshitib, avvalgilarga qo'shilishga qaror qildi, ular uni xursandchilik bilan qabul qilishdi va ma'lum miqdordagi qurollangan odamlar ustidan kapitan qilib tayinlashdi; va u yerda, ulardan 203 nafari yaxshi ta'minlangan holda, u ularning xizmatida ancha vaqt turdi.

en: The newly-made wife, ill content with such a lot, but hoping by her fair dealing to recall him to his county, betook herself to Roussillon, where she was received of all as their liege lady.
uz: Yangi turmush o'rtog'i, bunchalik ko'p narsadan norozi bo'lib, lekin uning adolatli muomalasi uni o'z okrugiga qaytarishiga umid qilib, Roussillonga yo'l oldi, u yerda u barcha tomonidan o'z xo'jayini sifatida qabul qilindi.

en: There, ﬁnding everything waste and disordered for the long time that the land had been without a lord, with great diligence and solicitude, like a discreet lady as she was, she set all in order again, whereof the count’s vassals were mightily content and held her exceeding dear, vowing her a great love and blaming the count sore for that he accepted not of her.
uz: U yerda, yer xo'jayinsiz bo'lgan uzoq vaqt davomida hamma narsa behuda va tartibsiz bo'lib qolganini ko'rib, u juda g'ayrat va g'amxo'rlik bilan, o'zi kabi nozik xonim kabi, hamma narsani yana tartibga soldi. Shundan grafning vassalari juda mamnun edi va uni juda qadrlardi, unga katta muhabbat va grafning undan qabul qilmaganligi uchun ayblardi.

en: The lady, having thoroughly ordered the county, no- tiﬁed the count thereof by two knights, whom she despatched to him, pray- ing him that, an it were on her account he forbore to come to his county, he should signify it to her and she, to pleasure him, would depart thence; but he answered them very harshly, saying, ‘For that, let her do her pleasure; I, for my part, will return thither to abide with her, whenas she shall have this my ring on her ﬁnger and in her arms a son by me begotten.’ Now the ring in question he held very dear and never parted with it, by reason of a certain virtue which it had been given him to understand that it had.
uz: Xonim, okrugga batafsil buyruq berganidan so'ng, uning hisobiga ikki ritsar yuborib, uni o'z okrugiga kelishni taqiqlagan bo'lsa, unga xabar berishi kerakligini so'rab duo qildi. U esa, uni xursand qilish uchun, u yerdan jo'nab ketadi; lekin u ularga juda qattiq javob berdi: "Shuning uchun, u o'z xohishiga ko'ra qilsin; men, o'z navbatimda, u yerga qaytib, uning qo'lida mening uzugim bo'ladi va uning qo'lida men tomonidan tug'ilgan o'g'il bo'ladi." Endi u bu uzukni juda qadrlardi va hech qachon undan ajralmasdi, chunki unga berilgan bir fazilat bor edi.

en: The knights understood the hardship of the condition implied in these two well nigh impossible requirements, but, seeing that they might not by their words avail to move him from his purpose, they returned to the lady and reported to her his reply; whereat she was sore afﬂicted and determined, after long consideration, to seek to learn if and where the two things afore- said might be compassed, to the intent that she might, in consequence, have her husband again.
uz: Ritsarlar bu ikki deyarli imkonsiz talabda nazarda tutilgan shartning qiyinligini tushundilar, lekin o'z so'zlari bilan uni maqsadidan uzoqlashtirishga yordam bermasligini ko'rib, xonimga qaytib kelib, unga javobini xabar berishdi; u esa qattiq azob chekdi va uzoq mulohazalardan so'ng, oldindan aytilgan ikki narsani qayerga kiritishni o'rganishga qaror qildi, shunda u, natijada, eriga qayta ega bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, having bethought herself what she should do, she assembled certain of the best and chiefest men of the county and with plaintive speech very orderly recounted to them that which she had already done for love of the count and showed them what had ensued there- of, adding that it was not her intent that, through her sojourn there, the count should abide in perpetual exile; nay, rather she purposed to spend the rest of her life in pilgrimages and works of mercy and charity for her soul’s health; wherefore she prayed them take the ward and governance of the
uz: Shunga ko'ra, nima qilish kerakligini o'ylab, u viloyatning eng yaxshi va yetakchi odamlarini yig'di va juda tartibli nutq so'zladi, ularga grafga bo'lgan muhabbat tufayli allaqachon qilgan ishlarini aytib berdi va u yerda nima sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatdi. U yerda qolishi orqali graf abadiy surgunda qolishi uning niyatida emas edi; aksincha, u butun umrini ziyoratlarda, rahm-shafqat va uning sog'lig'i uchun xayriya ishlarida o'tkazishni maqsad qildi; shuning uchun u ularga g'amxo'rlik va boshqaruvni qabul qilishlarini so'radi.

en: county and notify the count that she had left him free and vacant possession and had departed the country, intending nevermore to return to Roussillon.
uz: okrugga va grafga uning undan bo'sh va bo'sh mulkni qoldirgani va mamlakatni tark etgani, hech qachon Rossillonga qaytmoqchi emasligini xabar bering.

en: Many were the tears shed by the good folk, whilst she spoke, and many the prayers addressed to her that it would please her change counsel and abide there; but they availed nought.
uz: U gapirayotganda, yaxshi odamlar to'kkan ko'z yoshlari ko'p edi va unga maslahatini o'zgartirish va u yerda qolish uchun qaratilgan ko'p duolar edi; lekin ular hech qanday foyda bermadi.

en: Then, commending them to God, she set out upon her way, without telling any whither she was bound, well furnished with monies and jewels of price and accompanied by a cousin of hers and a chamberwoman, all in pilgrims’ habits, and stayed not till she came to Florence, where, chancing upon a little inn, kept by a decent widow wo- man, she there took up her abode and lived quietly, after the fashion of a poor pilgrim, impatient to hear news of her lord.
uz: So'ngra ularni Xudoga topshirib, u yo'lga chiqdi, hech kimga aytmasdan qayerga bog'langanini, pul va qimmatbaho taqinchoqlar bilan yaxshi jihozlangan holda, amakivachchasi va xonadoni hamrohligida, hammasi ziyorat odatlarida, Florensiyaga kelguncha qolmadi.
