uz: Bunday kuchga ega bo'lishni hech qachon xohlamaganman va xohlamaganman ham; va agar menda bo'lsa, uni o'zim uchun ishlatishdan ko'ra boshqalarga berishni afzal ko'rardim.

en: Wherefore, let the carpers be silent and an they avail not to warm themselves, let them live star- stricken220 and abiding in their delights —or rather their corrupt appetites — leave me to abide in mine for this brief life that is appointed me.
uz: Shuning uchun, quruvchilar jim bo'lsinlar va o'zlarini isitishga hojat qolmasinlar, yulduz urgan holda220 yashasinlar va o'z lazzatlarida  yoki to'g'rirog'i, buzilgan ishtahalarida  meni tayinlangan bu qisqa hayotim uchun o'zimnikiga qo'yib yuborsinlar.

en: But now, fair ladies, for that we have strayed enough, needs must we return whence we set out and ensue the ordinance commenced.
uz: Ammo endi, go'zal xonimlar, biz yetarlicha adashganimiz uchun, biz jo'nab ketgan joydan qaytishimiz va tartib boshlanishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.

en: The sun had already banished every star from the sky and had driven from the earth the humid vapours of the night, when Filostrato, arising, caused all his company arise and with them betook himself to the fair garden, where they all proceeded to disport themselves, and the eating-hour come, they dined whereas they had supped on the foregoing evening.
uz: Quyosh har bir yulduzni osmondan haydab chiqargan edi va tunning nam bug'larini yerdan haydab chiqargan edi. Filostrato o'rnidan turib, butun jamoasini ko'tardi va ular bilan birga go'zal bog'ga yo'l oldi. U yerda ularning barchasi o'zlarini xotirjam qilish uchun ketishdi va ovqatlanish vaqti keldi, ular o'tgan oqshom ovqatlangan holda ovqatlanishdi.

en: Then, after having slept, what time the sun was at its highest, they seated them- selves, after the wonted fashion, hard by the fair fountain, and Filostrato bade Fiammetta give beginning to the story-telling; whereupon, without awaiting further commandment, she began with womanly grace as follows:
uz: Keyin, uxlab bo'lgandan so'ng, quyosh eng baland vaqtda bo'lganida, ular o'zlarini, odatdagi uslubdan so'ng, chiroyli favvora yonida qattiq o'tirdilar va Filostrato Fiammetta hikoyani boshlashni buyurdi; shundan so'ng, keyingi buyruqni kutmasdan, u ayolona nafosat bilan quyidagicha boshladi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Tancred, Prince of Salerno, slayeth his daughter’s lover and sendeth her his heart in a bowl of gold; whereupon, pouring poisoned water over it, she drinketh thereof and dieth.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Salerno shahzodasi Tankred o'z qizining sevgilisini o'ldiradi va unga yuragini oltin idishda jo'natadi; shundan so'ng, unga zaharli suv quyib, undan ichadi va o'ladi.

en: “Our king hath this day appointed us a woeful subject of discourse, consid- ering that, whereas we came hither to make merry, needs must we tell of others’ tears, the which may not be recounted without moving both those who tell and those who hearken to compassion thereof.
uz: Bizning podshohimiz bugun bizni qayg'uli nutq mavzusiga aylantirdi, chunki biz bu yerga xursandchilik qilish uchun kelgan ekanmiz, boshqalarga kerakli narsalarni aytishimiz kerakligini hisobga oldik  ko'z yoshlari, ularni aytadiganlarni ham, eshitadiganlarni ham rahm qilmasdan aytib bo'lmaydi.

en: He hath mayhap done this somedele to temper the mirth of the foregoing days; but, whatso- ever may have moved him thereto, since it pertaineth not to me to change his pleasure, I will relate a piteous chance, nay, an ill-fortuned and a worthy of your tears.
uz: U bu ishni o'tgan kunlarning quvonchini totish uchun qilgan bo'lishi mumkin; lekin, uni bunga undagan har qanday narsa, chunki uning zavqini o'zgartirish menga tegishli emas, men achinarli imkoniyatni, aksincha, baxtsiz va sizning ko'z yoshingizga loyiq bo'lgan odamni hikoya qilaman.

en: Tancred, Lord of Salerno, was a humane prince and benign enough of nature, (had he not in his old age imbrued his hands in lover’s blood), who in all the course of his life had but one daughter, and happier had he been if he had none.
uz: Tancred, Salerno hukmdori, insoniy shahzoda va tabiatning yetarlicha mehribon inson edi (qariligida qo'llarini sevgilisining qoniga botirmadi), hayoti davomida faqat bitta qizi bor edi va agar hech biri bo'lmasa, baxtliroq edi.

en: She was of him as tenderly loved as ever daughter of father, and knowing not, by reason of this his tender love for her, how to part with her, he married her not till she had long overpassed the age when she should have had a husband.
uz: U uni otasining qizi kabi doimgi mehr bilan sevardi va shu sababli unga bo'lgan mehrini, undan qanday ajralishni bilmasdan, u bilan turmushga chiqishi kerak bo'lgan yoshdan ancha o'tmaguncha turmushga chiqmadi.

en: At last, he gave her to wife to a son of the Duke of Capua, with whom having abidden a little while, she was left a widow and returned to her father.
uz: Nihoyat, u uni Kapua gersogining o'g'liga xotinlikka berdi. U bilan biroz yashar ekan, u beva bo'lib qoldi va otasiga qaytdi.

en: Now she was most fair of form and favour, as ever was woman, and young and sprightly and learned perchance more than is required of a lady.
uz: Endi u har doimgidek ayol bo'lgani kabi shakl va ko'rinishga ega edi, yosh, yorqin va bilimdon edi, ehtimol, xonimdan talab qilinadiganidan ham ko'proq.

en: Abiding, then, with her father in all ease and luxury, like a great lady as she was, and seeing that, for the love he bore her, he recked little of marrying her again, nor did it seem to her a seemly thing to require him thereof, she bethought herself to seek, an it might be, to get her privily a worthy lover.
uz: Shunday qilib, otasi bilan bemalol va hashamat bilan, xuddi u kabi buyuk xonim kabi yashar edi va unga ko'rsatgan muhabbati tufayli, uni qayta turmushga chiqarishdan uncha qayg'urmasligini, undan talab qilish ham unga yoqimli narsa emasdek tuyulishini ko'rib, u o'zini qidirishga, balki, unga yashirincha munosib sevgilini topishga o'yladi.

en: She saw men galore, gentle and simple, frequent her father’s
uz: U otasining uylariga tez-tez boradigan, muloyim va sodda erkaklarni ko'rdi.

en: court, and considering the manners and fashions of many, a young serving- man of her father’s, Guiscardo by name, a man of humble enough extrac- tion, but nobler of worth and manners than whatsoever other, pleased her over all and of him, seeing him often, she became in secret ardently enam- oured, approving more and more his fashions every hour; whilst the young man, who was no dullard, perceiving her liking for him, received her into his heart, on such wise that his mind was thereby diverted from well nigh everything other than the love of her.
uz: saroy, va ko'pchilikning odob-axloqini hisobga olgan holda, otasining yosh xizmatkori, ismi Guiscardo, yetarlicha kamtarin, ammo boshqalardan ko'ra qimmatli va odob-axloqli odam, uni hamma narsadan mamnun qildi, uni tez-tez ko'rdi, u yashirincha qizg'in osildi, har soatda uning modalarini tobora ko'proq ma'qulladi; shu bilan birga, o'zini yaxshi ko'rgan, unga yoqqan yosh yigit uni o'z qalbiga qabul qildi, shu tariqa uning aqli uning sevgisidan boshqa hamma narsasidan uzoqlashdi.

en: Each, then, thus secretly tendering the other, the young lady, who desired nothing so much as to foregather with him, but had no mind to make any- one a conﬁdant of her passion, bethought herself of a rare device to apprize him of the means; to wit, she wrote him a letter, wherein she showed him how he should do to foregather with her on the ensuing day, and placing it in the hollow of a cane, gave the letter jestingly to Guiscardo, saying, ‘Make thee a bellows thereof for thy serving-maid, wherewith she may blow up the ﬁre tonight.’ Guiscardo took the cane and bethinking himself that she would not have given it him nor spoken thus, without some cause, took his leave and returned therewith to his lodging.
uz: Har biri, keyin, bir-birini yashirincha yumshoqlik bilan yondashib, yosh xonim, u bilan oldindan uchrashishdan ko'ra hech narsa xohlamagan, lekin hech kimni o'z ishtiyoqiga sodiq qo'yishni istamagan, o'zini uni bahona olish uchun kam uchraydigan vosita deb o'yladi; xususan, u unga xat yozdi, unda u unga ertasi kuni u bilan oldindan uchrashishi kerakligini ko'rsatdi va uni tayoqning bo'yniga qo'ydi, hazillashib, Guiscardoga xat berdi va dedi: "Senga xizmatkor xizmatchiging uchun undan bir o'tin yasang, u bilan bugun o't yoqishi mumkin." Guiscardo tayoqni oldi va o'zini shunday gapirmagan bo'lsa, hech qanday sababsiz, u bilan qaytib ketdi va o'sha yerda o'tirdi.

en: There he examined the cane and seeing it to be cleft, opened it and found therein the letter, which having read and well apprehended that which he had to do, he was the joy- fullest man alive and set about taking order how he might go to her, accord- ing to the fashion appointed him of her.
uz: U yerda u tayoqni ko'rib, uning yoriq ekanligini ko'rdi, uni ochdi va unda xat topdi. U o'qigan va nima qilish kerakligini yaxshi anglaganidan so'ng, u eng quvonchli tirik odam edi va unga qanday borishni tartibga solib, unga tayinlangan uslubga moslasha boshladi.

en: There was, beside the prince’s palace, a grotto hewn out of the rock and made in days long agone, and to this grotto some little light was given by a tunnel221 by art wrought in the mountain, which latter, for that the grotto was abandoned, was well nigh blocked at its mouth with briers and weeds that had overgrown it.
uz: Shahzoda saroyining yonida toshdan o'yib olingan va kunlar davomida o'tib ketgan g'or bor edi. Bu g'orga tog'da san'at bilan ishlangan tunnel221 biroz yorug'lik berdi. Oxirgisi, g'or tashlab ketilganligi sababli, uning og'zida uni o'sib chiqqan g'o'lalar va begona o'tlar bilan deyarli to'sib qo'yilgan edi.

en: Into this grotto one might go by a privy stair which was in one of the ground ﬂoor rooms of the lady’s apartment in the palace and which was shut in by a very strong door.
uz: Bu g'orga saroydagi xonimning kvartirasining birinchi qavatidagi xonalardan birida joylashgan va juda kuchli eshik bilan yopiq bo'lgan shaxsiy zinadan o'tish mumkin edi.

en: This stair was so out of all folk’s minds, for that it had been unused from time immemorial, that well nigh none remembered it to be there; but Love, to whose eyes there is noth- ing so secret but it winneth, had recalled it to the memory of the enamoured lady, who, that none should get wind of the matter, had laboured sore many days with such tools as she might command, ere she could make shift to open the door; then, going down alone thereby into the grotto and seeing the tunnel, she sent to bid Guiscardo study to come to her thereby and ac-
uz: Bu zinapoya shunchalik odamlarning ongidan chetda edi, chunki u qadim zamonlardan beri foydalanilmagan edi, deyarli hech kim uni u yerda ekanligini eslamagan edi; lekin Sevgi, uning ko'zlarida hech qanday sir yo'q, lekin u g'alaba qozonardi, uni sevuvchi xonimning xotirasiga eslatgan edi, u hech kimga bu haqda xabar bermasligi uchun, u eshikni ochish uchun bir necha kun davomida shunday vositalar bilan mehnat qilgan edi; keyin, u yerdan o'zi g'orga tushib, tunnelni ko'rgach, u bilan birga kelish uchun Guiscardo'ni chaqirdi va...

en: quainted him with the height which herseemed should be from the mouth thereof to the ground.
uz: Uni uning og'zidan yerga qadar bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan balandligi bilan o'ziga xos qildi.

en: To this end Guiscardo promptly made ready a rope with certain knots and loops, whereby he might avail to descend and ascend, and donning a leath- ern suit, that might defend him from the briers, he on the ensuing night re- paired, without letting any know aught of the matter, to the mouth of the tunnel.
uz: Shu maqsadda, Giskardo darhol muayyan tugunlar va halqalar bilan arqon tayyorladi, shunda u pastga tushish va ko'tarilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi mumkin edi va uni to'rlardan himoya qilishi mumkin bo'lgan yarim qirrali kostyum kiygan holda, keyingi kechasi hech kimga xabar bermasdan, tunnel og'ziga qaytdi.

en: There making one end of the rope fast to a stout tree-stump that had grown up in the mouth, he let himself down thereby into the grotto and there awaited the lady, who, on the morrow, feigning a desire to sleep, dis- missed her women and shut herself up alone in her chamber; then, opening the privy door, she descended into the grotto, where she found Guiscardo.
uz: Arqonning bir uchini og'zida o'sgan katta daraxt poyasiga mahkamlab, u o'zini shu orqali g'orga tushirdi va u yerda xonim kutib turardi. U ertasi kuni uxlash istagini soxta ko'rsatib, ayollarini sog'inib, xonasida yolg'iz o'zini yopdi; keyin, shaxsiy eshikni ochib, u g'orga tushdi va u yerda Guiscardo'ni topdi.

en: They greeted one another with marvellous joy and betook themselves to her chamber, where they abode great part of the day in the utmost delight; and after they had taken order together for the discreet conduct of their loves, so they might abide secret, Guiscardo returned to the grotto, whilst she shut the privy door and went forth to her women.
uz: Ular bir-birlarini ajoyib quvonch bilan kutib olishdi va uning xonasiga kelishdi, u yerda kunning katta qismini juda xursandchilik bilan o'tkazishdi; va ular o'z sevgilarining yashirin xulq-atvori uchun birgalikda tartib olgandan so'ng, yashirincha qolishlari uchun, Guiscardo g'orga qaytib keldi, u esa shaxsiy eshikni yopdi va ayollariga chiqdi.

en: The night come, Guiscardo climbed up by his rope to the mouth of the tunnel and issuing forth whence he had entered in, returned to his lodging; and having learned this road, he in process of time returned many times thereafter.
uz: Kech kirgach, Gvisardo arqoni bilan tunnel og'ziga ko'tarildi va o'zi kirgan joydan chiqib, o'z turar joyiga qaytdi; va bu yo'lni o'rganganidan so'ng, vaqt o'tishi bilan undan keyin ko'p marta qaytdi.

en: But fortune, jealous of so long and so great a delight, with a woeful chance changed the gladness of the two lovers into mourning and sorrow; and it befell on this wise.
uz: Ammo omad, shunchalik uzoq va shunchalik buyuk lazzatga rashk qilib, qayg'uli bir imkoniyat bilan ikki oshiqning quvonchini motam va qayg'uga aylantirdi; va u shunday donolikka tushdi.

en: Tancred was wont to come bytimes all alone into his daughter’s chamber and there abide with her and converse awhile and after go away.
uz: Tancred odatda o'z qizining xonasiga yolg'iz kirib, u yerda u bilan birga turardi, bir oz suhbatlashardi va keyin ketardi.

en: Accordingly, one day, after dinner, he came thither, what time the lady (whose name was Ghismonda) was in a garden of hers with all her women, and willing not to take her from her diversion, he entered her chamber, without being seen or heard of any.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir kuni kechki ovqatdan keyin u yerga keldi. Ayol (ismi Ghismonda edi) barcha ayollari bilan o'z bog'ida bo'lganida va uni o'z qiziqishidan olib qo'ymaslikka tayyor bo'lganida, u uning xonasiga hech kim ko'rinmasdan yoki eshitilmasdan kirdi.

en: Finding the windows closed and the curtains let down over the bed, he sat down in a corner on a hassock at the bedfoot and leant his head against the bed; then, drawing the curtain over himself, as if he had studied to hide himself there, he fell asleep.
uz: Derazalar yopiq va pardalar to'shak ustidan tushayotganini ko'rib, u to'shak oyoqlari yonidagi paypoq ustida burchakka o'tirdi va boshini to'shakka suyanib turdi; so'ngra, parda o'z ustiga tortib, go'yo u yerda yashirinishni o'rgandek, u uxladi.

en: As he slept thus, Ghismonda, who, as ill chance would have it, had appointed her lover to come thither that day, softly entered the chamber, leaving her women in the garden, and having shut herself in, without per- ceiving that there was someone there, opened the secret door to Guiscardo, who awaited her.
uz: U shunday uxlar ekan, Ghismonda, omadsizlikka qaramay, o'z sevgilisiga o'sha kuni u yerga kelishni tayinlagan holda, xonadan sekin kirib, uning ayollarini bog'da qoldirdi va o'zini ichkariga yopib, u yerda kimdir borligini anglamagan holda, uni kutayotgan Guiscardoning maxfiy eshigini ochdi.

en: They straightway betook themselves to bed, as of their wont, and what while they sported and solaced themselves together, it befell that Tancred awoke and heard and saw that which Guiscardo and his daugh-
uz: Ular darhol odatlariga ko'ra yotishga tushdilar va bir vaqtning o'zida birga o'ynashar va tasalli berar ekanlar, Tankred uyg'onib, Giscardo va uning qizi nimalarni eshitganini va ko'rganini ko'rdi.

en: ter did; whereat beyond measure grieved, at ﬁrst he would have cried out at them, but after bethought himself to keep silence and abide, an he might, hidden, so with more secrecy and less shame to himself he might avail to do that which had already occurred to his mind.
uz: U shunday qildi; haddan tashqari qayg'urib, dastlab ularga baqirdi, lekin o'zini jim bo'lishga va yashirishga o'ylaganidan so'ng, u yashirincha, o'zi uchun ko'proq maxfiylik va kamroq sharmandalik bilan o'zi xayolida allaqachon o'ylangan narsani qilishga qodir bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The two lovers abode a great while together, according to their usance, without observing Tancred, and coming down from the bed, whenas it seemed to them time, Guiscardo returned to the grotto and she departed the chamber; whereupon Tancred, for all he was an old man, let himself down into the garden by a window and returned, unseen of any, to his own cham- ber, sorrowful unto death.
uz: Ikki oshiq o'z odatlariga ko'ra ancha vaqt birga qoldilar, Tankredga rioya qilmasdan va to'shakdan tushayotganda, ularga vaqt kelgandek tuyulganda, Gvisardo g'orga qaytib, xonadan ketdi; shundan so'ng Tankred, baribir keksa odam bo'lgani uchun, o'zini bog'ga deraza bo'ylab pastga tushirdi va hech kim ko'rmay, o'z xonasiga qayg'uli holda qaytdi.

en: That same night, at the time of the ﬁrst sleep, Guiscardo, by his orders, was seized by two men, as he came forth of the tunnel, and carried secretly, trussed as he was in his suit of leather, to Tan- cred, who, whenas he saw him, said, well nigh weeping, ‘Guiscardo, my kindness to thee merited not the outrage and the shame thou hast done me in mine own ﬂesh and blood, as I have this day seen with my very eyes.’ Whereto Guiscardo answered nothing but this, ‘Love can far more than either you or I.’ Tancred then commanded that he should be kept secretly under guard and in one of the chambers of the palace, and so was it done.
uz: O'sha kecha, birinchi uyqu paytida, Guiskardo o'z buyrug'iga ko'ra, tunneldan chiqayotganda ikki kishi tomonidan ushlanib, terisidan kiyim kiygan holda yashirincha, Tan-creedga olib ketildi. Tan-creed uni ko'rgach, yig'lab dedi: "Guiscardo, senga bo'lgan mehribonligim menga o'z tanam va qonim bilan qilgan jafo va sharmandaligimga loyiq emas edi, xuddi shu kuni ko'rganimdek." Guiscardo bundan boshqa hech narsa javob bermadi, "Sevgi sizdan ham, men ham ko'ra ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin." Tancred keyin uni yashirincha qo'riqlash va saroy xonalaridan birida saqlashni buyurdi va shunday bo'ldi.

en: On the morrow, having meanwhile revolved in himself many and divers devices, he betook himself, after eating, as of his wont, to his daughter’s chamber and sending for the lady, who as yet knew nothing of these things, shut himself up with her and proceeded, with tears in his eyes, to bespeak her thus: ‘Ghismonda, meseemed I knew thy virtue and thine honesty, nor might it ever have occurred to my mind, though it were told me, had I not seen it with mine own eyes, that thou wouldst, even so much as in thought, have abandoned thyself to any man, except he were thy husband; wherefore in this scant remnant of life that my eld reserveth unto me, I shall still abide sorrowful, remembering me of this.
uz: Ertasi kuni, o'zida ko'p va xilma-xil niyatlar bilan o'ylanib, u odatdagidek, ovqatlanib, qizining xonasiga bordi va xonimni chaqirib yubordi. Xonim hali bu haqda hech narsa bilmagan edi, u bilan o'zini yopdi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan unga shunday dedi: "Ghismonda, men sizning fazilatingizni va halolligingizni bilganman deb o'yladim, va hech qachon xayolimga kelmagan bo'lardi, garchi menga aytilsa ham, o'z ko'zlarim bilan ko'rmagan bo'lsam ham, siz o'zingizni hech kimga tashlab qo'yardingiz, agar u sizning eringiz bo'lmasa; shuning uchun bu kichik hayot qoldiqida, mening katta yoshim menga saqlab qoladi, men hali ham buni eslayman.

en: Would God, an thou must needs stoop to such wantonness, thou hadst taken a man sortable to thy quality!
uz: Xudoyim, sen bunday beparvolikka tushishing kerak edi, sen o'z sifatingga mos keladigan odamni tanlagan eding!

en: But, amongst so many who frequent my court, thou hast chosen Guiscardo, a youth of the meanest condition, reared in our court, well nigh of charity, from a little child up to this day; wherefore thou hast put me in sore travail of mind, for that I know not what course to take with thee.
uz: Lekin, mening saroyimga tez-tez tashrif buyuruvchilarning ko'pchiligi orasida, siz bizning saroyimizda tarbiyalangan, mehribonlikka yaqin, kichkina bolalikdan bugungacha eng yomon ahvoldagi yosh Gishardoni tanladingiz; shuning uchun meni og'riqli mehnatga tashladingiz, chunki men siz bilan qanday yo'l tutishni bilmayman.

en: With Guiscardo, whom I caused take yesternight, as he issued forth of the tunnel and have in ward, I am already resolved how to deal; but with thee God knoweth I know not what to do.
uz: Guiscardo bilan, uni kecha tuneldan chiqib, qo'riqlash uchun olib ketishga buyurdim, men allaqachon qanday munosabatda bo'lishga qaror qildim; lekin sen bilan Xudo biladi, nima qilish kerakligini bilmayman.

en: On one side love draweth me, which I still borne thee more than father ever bore daughter, and on the other most just despite, conceived
uz: Bir tomondan meni sevgi tortadi, men hali ham otam qiz tug'ganidan ko'ra ko'proq tug'dim, ikkinchi tomondan esa eng adolatli, garchi, homilador bo'lganim uchun.

en: for thine exceeding folly; the one would have me pardon thee, the other would have me, against my nature, deal harshly by thee.
uz: Chunki sening ahmoqliging juda katta edi; biri meni seni kechirishni xohlardi, ikkinchisi esa tabiatimga qarshi seni qattiq tutishimni xohlardi.

en: But ere I come to a decision, I would fain hear what thou hast to say to this.’ So saying, he bowed his head and wept sore as would a beaten child.
uz: Lekin bir qarorga kelmasimdan oldin, bu haqda nima deyishingizni eshitishni xohlardim. Shunday deb, u boshini egdi va urilgan bola kabi achchiq yig'ladi.

en: Ghismonda, hearing her father’s words and seeing that not only was her secret love discovered, but Guiscardo taken, felt an inexpressible chagrin and came many a time near upon showing it with outcry and tears, as wo- men mostly do; nevertheless, her haughty soul overmastering that weak- ness, with marvellous fortitude she composed her countenance and rather than proffer any prayer for herself, determined inwardly to abide no more on life, doubting not but her Guiscardo was already dead.
uz: Ghismonda otasining so'zlarini eshitib, nafaqat uning sirli muhabbati aniqlanganini, balki Guiscardo ham olib ketilganini ko'rib, ifodalab bo'lmaydigan xafalikni his qildi va ko'pincha odamlar ko'rganidek, uni g'azab va yosh bilan ko'rsatib, ko'p yaqinlashdi; shunga qaramay, o'zining mag'rur ruhi o'sha zaiflikni yengib, ajoyib jasorat bilan o'z yuzini jamladi va o'zi uchun hech qanday ibodat qilmasdan, hayotda qolishga, shubhalanmaslikka qaror qildi, chunki uning Guiscardo allaqachon o'lgan edi.

en: Wherefore, not as a woman rebuked and woeful for her default, but as one undaunted and valiant, with dry eyes and face open and nowise troubled, she thus bespoke her father: ‘Tancred, I purpose neither to deny nor to entreat, for that the one would proﬁt me nothing nor would I have the other avail me; more by token that I am nowise minded to seek to render thy mansuetude and thine affection favourable to me, but rather, confessing the truth, ﬁrst with true arguments to vindicate mine honour and after with deeds right resolutely to ensue the greatness of my soul.
uz: Shuning uchun, ayol o'z kamchiliklari uchun tanbeh bergan va qayg'uga botganidek emas, balki xotirjam va jasur, ko'zlari ochiq, yuzlari ochiq va tashvishli bo'lganidek, u otasiga shunday dedi: "La'nati, men na inkor etishni, na iltijo qilishni xohlamayman, chunki biri menga hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi va mendan boshqasi ham menga foyda keltirmaydi; ko'proq, men hozir sening insoniyliging va mehringni menga yoqtirishga harakat qilmoqchiman, balki avvalo, haqiqatni tan olaman, avvalo mening sharafimni oqlash uchun haqiqiy dalillar bilan, keyin esa jonimning ulug'vorligini ta'minlash uchun to'g'ri amallar bilan."

en: True is it I have loved and love Guiscardo, and what while I live, which will be little, I shall love him, nor, if folk live after death, shall I ever leave loving him; but unto this it was not so much my feminine frailty that moved me as thy little solicitude to remarry me and his own worth.
uz: Rostmi, men Giskardoni sevganman va sevganman, va men tirik ekanman, bu oz bo'ladi, uni sevaman, va agar odamlar o'limdan keyin yashasalar, uni sevishdan hech qachon ketmayman; lekin bunga meni sizning menga va o'z qadriga qayta turmushga chiqishga bo'lgan kichik ehtiyotkorligingiz kabi ko'proq ayollik zaifligim emas edi.

en: It should have been manifest to thee, Tancred, being as thou art ﬂesh and blood, that thou hadst begotten a daughter of ﬂesh and blood and not of iron or stone; and thou shouldst have remembered and should still remember, for all thou art old, what and what like are the laws of youth and with what po- tency they work; nor, albeit thou, being a man, hast in thy best years exer- cised thyself in part in arms, shouldst thou the less know what ease and leis- ure and luxury can do in the old, to say nothing of the young.
uz: Senga ma'lum bo'lishi kerak edi, Tancred, sen go'sht va qon bo'lganing uchun, na temir yoki toshdan emas, balki go'sht va qon bilan tug'gan qizingni; va sen esda tutishing va hali ham esda tutishing kerak edi, chunki sen qari odamsan, yoshlik qonunlari nima va qanday kuch bilan ishlaydi; va, garchi sen, erkak bo'lganingda, eng yaxshi yillaringda o'zingni qurol-yarog'da qisman mashq qildirgan bo'lsang ham, yoshlar haqida hech narsa demay, eski davrda nima osonlik, dam olish va dabdaba qilish mumkinligini bilmasang kerak edi.

en: I am, then, as being of thee begotten, of ﬂesh and blood and have lived so little that I am yet young and (for the one and the other reason) full of carnal desire, whereunto the having aforetime, by reason of marriage, known what pleas- ure it is to give accomplishment to such desire hath added marvellous strength.
uz: Shunday ekan, men sening farzanding bo'lgan, go'sht va qon bo'lgan va hali yosh bo'lganim uchun juda kam umr ko'rganman va (bir sababga ko'ra) nafs xohishlariga to'laman. Ularga avvalgi, turmush qurish tufayli, bunday istakga erishish qanday lazzat ekanligini bilish ajoyib kuch qo'shdi.

en: Unable, therefore, to withstand the strength of my desires, I ad- dressed myself, being young and a woman, to ensue that whereto they prompted me and became enamoured.
uz: Shunday qilib, istaklarimning kuchini ko'tara olmasdan, yosh va ayol bo'lib, ular meni qayerga undashi va oshiq bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun o'zimni ad- kiydim.

en: And certes in this I set my every fac-
uz: Va shubhasiz, men bu borada har bir yuzimni...

en: ulty to the endeavouring that, so far as in me lay, no shame should ensue either to thee or to me through this to which natural frailty moved me.
uz: Oxirgi urinish, men ichimda yo'q bo'lsa ham, hech qanday uyat na senga, na menga shu orqali ta'sir qilmasin, bunga meni tabiiy zaiflik ilhomlantirdi.

en: To this end compassionate Love and favouring Fortune found and showed me a very occult way, whereby, unknown of any, I won to my desire, and this, whoever it be discovered it to thee or howsoever thou knowest it, I nowise deny.
uz: Shu maqsadda shafqatli Muhabbat va Mehribon Omad menga juda yashirin yo'l topdi va ko'rsatdi. Shu yo'l bilan hech kimga ma'lum bo'lmagan holda, men o'z xohishimga erisha oldim va bu, u senga kimga ma'lum bo'lsa ham yoki sen qanday bilsang ham, men hozir inkor etaman.

en: Guiscardo I took not at hazard, as many women do; nay, of deliberate counsel I chose him before every other and with advisement prepense drew him to me222 and by dint of perseverance and discretion on my part and on his, I have long had enjoyment of my desire.
uz: Guiscardo men ko'p ayollar kabi xavfga tushmadim; aksincha, uni har biridan oldin ataylab tanladim va maslahat bilan oldindan o'zimga tortdim222 va men va uning tomonidagi qat'iyat va mulohazakorlik tufayli men allaqachon o'z istaklarimdan zavq oldim.

en: Whereof it seemeth that thou, ensuing rather vulgar prejudice than truth, reproachest me with more bitter- ness than of having sinned by way of love, saying (as if thou shouldst not have been chagrined, had I chosen therefor a man of gentle birth), that I have committed myself with a man of mean condition.
uz: Shunday tuyuladiki, sen haqiqatdan ko'ra ko'proq qo'pol xurofotga berilib, meni sevgi yo'li bilan gunoh qilganimdan ko'ra achchiqroq tanqid qilayapsan, go'yo xafa bo'lmasang kerak edi, agar men unga yumshoq tug'ilgan odamni tanlaganimda edi, men o'zimni yomon ahvoldagi odam bilan bog'lagan edim.

en: Wherein thou seest not that thou blamest not my default, but that of fortune, which too often advanceth the unworthy to high estate, leaving the worthiest alow.
uz: Shunda ko'rmayapsanki, sen mening kamchiligimni emas, balki boyligingni ayblayapsan, bu boylik juda ko'p hollarda loyiq bo'lmaganlarni yuqori lavozimga ko'tarib, eng munosiblarini tashlab ketadi.

en: But now let us leave this and look somewhat to the ﬁrst principles of things, whereby thou wilt see that we all get our ﬂesh from one same stock and that all souls were by one same Creator created with equal faculties, equal powers and equal virtues.
uz: Lekin endi buni qoldirib, biroz narsalarning birinchi tamoyillariga nazar solaylik, ular orqali siz ko'rasizki, hammamiz bir xil zotdan tanamizni olamiz va barcha jonlar bir xil Yaratuvchi tomonidan teng qobiliyatlar, teng kuchlar va teng fazilatlar bilan yaratilgan.

en: Worth it was that ﬁrst distinguished between us, who were all and still are born equal; wherefore those who had and used the greatest sum thereof were called noble and the rest abode not noble.
uz: Avvalo biz, hammamiz bo'lgan va hali ham teng tug'ilganlar orasidan ajralib turish kerak edi; shuning uchun uning eng katta summasiga ega bo'lgan va undan foydalanganlar olijanob deb atalgan, qolganlar esa olijanob bo'lmagan.

en: And albeit contrary usance hath since obscured this primary law, yet is it nowise done away nor blotted out from nature and good manners; wherefore he who doth worthily manifestly showeth himself a gentleman, and if any call him otherwise, not he who is called, but he who calleth com- mitteth default.
uz: Va garchi qarama-qarshi urf-odat shu vaqtdan beri bu asosiy qonunni yashirgan bo'lsa-da, u hozirda tabiat va yaxshi xulq-atvordan yo'qolgan yoki o'chirilgan; shuning uchun o'zini munosib ko'rsatib, o'zini janob ko'rsatadi va agar kimdir uni boshqacha deb atasa, chaqirilgan emas, balki chaqiruvchi xatoga yo'l qo'yadi.

en: Look among all thy gentlemen and examine into their worth, their usances and their manners, and on the other hand consider those of Guiscardo; if thou wilt consent to judge without animosity, thou wilt say that he is most noble and that these thy nobles are all churls.
uz: Barcha janoblaringizni ko'rib chiqing va ularning qadrini, urf-odatlarini va odoblarini tekshiring, boshqa tomondan Gishardoning odoblarini ko'rib chiqing; agar dushmanliksiz hukm chiqarishga rozi bo'lsangiz, u eng olijanob deb ayting va bu zodagonlaringizning hammasi xarobalardir.

en: With regard to his worth and virtue, I trusted not to the judgment of any other, but to that of thy words and of mine own eyes.
uz: Uning qadri va fazilatiga kelsak, men hech kimning hukmiga ishonmadim, faqat sening so'zlaringga va o'z ko'zlarimga ishonardim.

en: Who ever so commended him as thou didst in all those praiseworthy things wherefor a man of worth should be commended?
uz: Uni kim shunday maqtadi, xuddi sen maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan barcha narsalarda shunday maqtadigandek, shuning uchun ham arzirli odam maqtovga sazovor bo'lishi kerak edi?

en: And certes not without reason; for, if mine eyes de- ceived me not, there was no praise given him of thee which I saw him not justify by deeds, and that more admirably than thy words availed to express; and even had I suffered any deceit in this, it is by thyself I should have been
uz: Va albatta bejizga emas; chunki, agar mening ko'zlarim meni qabul qilmagan bo'lsa, sendan unga amallar bilan oqlanmagan va sening so'zlaringdan ko'ra hayratlanarliroq maqtov berilmagan bo'lardi; va agar men bunda biror aldovga duch kelgan bo'lsam ham, men o'zing orqali bo'lishim kerak edi.

en: An, then, thou say that I have committed myself with a man of mean condition, thou sayst not sooth; but shouldst thou say with a poor man, it might peradventure be conceded thee, to thy shame who hast so ill known to put a servant of thine and a man of worth in good case; yet poverty bereaveth not any of gentilesse; nay, rather, wealth it is that doth this.
uz: Shunday ekan, sen o'zingni yomon ahvoldagi odam bilan bog'ladim, demaysan, tinch emassan; lekin agar kambag'al odam bilan bog'lanasan, ehtimol senga berilishi mumkin, chunki sen o'z xizmatingni va qimmatli odamni yaxshi holatda qo'yishni unchalik bilmagan eding; ammo qashshoqlik hech kimni begonalardan mahrum qilmaydi; aksincha, buni qilayotgan narsa boylikdir.

en: Many kings, many great princes were once poor and many who delve and tend sheep were once very rich.
uz: Ko'plab podshohlar, ko'plab buyuk shahzodalar bir vaqtlar kambag'al bo'lgan va qo'ylarni ko'p terib, boqadiganlar bir vaqtlar juda boy bo'lgan.

en: The last doubt that thou broachest, to wit, what thou shouldst do with me, drive it away altogether; an thou in thine extreme old age be disposed to do that which thou usedst not, being young, namely, to deal cruelly, wreak thy cruelty upon me, who am minded to proffer no prayer unto thee, as being the prime cause of this sin, if sin it be; for of this I certify thee, that whatso- ever thou hast done or shalt do with Guiscardo, an thou do not the like with me, mine own hands shall do it.
uz: Oxirgi shubhang, ya'ni, men bilan nima qilishing kerakligi haqida, uni butunlay haydang; va sen o'ta keksaligingda yoshligingda menga shafqatsiz munosabatda bo'lish uchun ishlatmagan narsangni qilishga tayyor bo'l, ya'ni menga shafqatsiz munosabatda bo'l, agar bu gunoh bo'lsa, senga ibodat qilmaslikka niyat qilaman; chunki men senga shunga ishontiraman, sen hech qachon Guiscardo bilan nima qilmading yoki qilmaysan, va sen men bilan xuddi shunday qilma, mening qo'llarim buni qiladi.

en: Now begone; go shed tears with women and waxing cruel, slay him and me with one same blow, an it seem to thee we have deserved it.’ The prince knew the greatness of his daughter’s soul, but notwithstanding believed her not altogether so ﬁrmly resolved as she said unto that which her words gave out.
uz: Endi boshlang; ayollar bilan birga ko'z yosh to'k va shafqatsiz bo'lib, uni ham, meni ham bir zarba bilan o'ldiring, va sizga shunday tuyuladi, biz bunga loyiqmiz." Shahzoda qizining ruhining ulug'vorligini bilardi, lekin shunga qaramay, u o'z so'zlariga aytganidek qat'iy qarorga kelmasligiga ishonardi.

en: Wherefore, taking leave of her and having laid aside all intent of using rigour against her person, he thought to cool her fervent love with others’ suffering and accordingly bade Guiscardo’s two guardians strangle him without noise that same night and taking out his heart, bring it to him.
uz: Shuning uchun, u bilan xayrlashib, uning shaxsiga nisbatan qattiqqo'llik ishlatishning barcha niyatini chetga surib, u uning boshqalarning azob-uqubatlariga bo'lgan qizg'in muhabbatini sovutishni o'yladi va shunga ko'ra, Guiscardoning ikki qo'riqchisiga o'sha kechaning o'zida shovqinsiz bo'g'ib, uning yuragini olib, unga olib kelishni buyurdi.

en: They did even as it was commanded them, and on the morrow the prince let bring a great and goodly bowl of gold and setting therein Guis- cardo’s heart, despatched it to his daughter by the hands of a very privy ser- vant of his, bidding him say, whenas he gave it her, ‘Thy father sendeth thee this, to solace thee of the thing thou most lovest, even as thou hast solaced him of that which he loved most.’ Now Ghismonda, unmoved from her stern purpose, had, after her father’s departure, let bring poisonous herbs and roots and distilled and reduced them in water, so she might have it at hand, an that she feared should come to pass.
uz: Ular ularga buyurilganidek qilishdi. Ertasi kuni shahzoda katta va yaxshi oltin kosa olib keldi va unga Guis-cardo'ning yuragini joylashtirdi. Uni o'zining juda yaqin xizmatkori qo'li bilan qizi oldiga jo'natib, unga berganida, "Otang senga eng yaxshi ko'rgan narsangdan tasalli berish uchun shunday yuboryapti, xuddi sen uni eng yaxshi ko'rgan narsadan tasalli berganingdek."

en: The serving-man coming to her with the prince’s present and mes- sage, she took the cup with a steadfast countenance and uncovered it.
uz: Xizmatkor shahzodaning sovg'asi va donolik sovg'asi bilan uning oldiga kelganida, u stakanni qat'iy yuz bilan oldi va uni ochdi.

en: Whenas she saw the heart and apprehended the words of the message, she was throughly certiﬁed that this was Guiscardo’s heart and turning her eyes upon the messenger, said to him, ‘No sepulchre less of worth than one of gold had beseemed a heart such as this; and in this my father hath done dis-
uz: U yurakni ko'rib, xabarning so'zlarini anglaganida, bu Gishardo yuragi ekanligiga butunlay amin bo'ldi va elchiga ko'zlarini qaratdi va unga dedi: "Bunday yurakni oltindan arzimaydigan hech qanday qabr zabt etmagan edi; va bu borada otam shunday qildi..."

en: creetly.’ So saying, she set the heart to her lips and kissing it, said, ‘Still in everything and even to this extreme limit of my life have I found my fath- er’s love most tender towards me; but now more than ever; wherefore do thou render him on my part for so great a gift the last thanks I shall ever have to give him.’ Then, bending down over the cup, which she held fast, she said, looking upon the heart, ‘Alack, sweetest harbourage of all my pleasures, accursed be his cruelty who maketh me now to see thee with the eyes of the body!
uz: Shunday deb, u yuragini lablariga qo'ydi va uni o'pdi, dedi: Shunday bo'lsa ham, hamma narsada va hatto hayotimning shu cheklangan qismida ham otamning menga bo'lgan muhabbatini eng yumshoq topdim; lekin endi har qachongidan ham ko'proq; shuning uchun unga shunday buyuk sovg'a uchun oxirgi minnatdorchilikni berasan. Keyin, uni mahkam ushlab turgan kosadan pastga egilgach, u yurakka qarab dedi: Lalak, barcha lazzatlarimning eng shirin maskani, meni hozir seni tana ko'zlari bilan ko'rishga majbur qiladigan shafqatsizligiga la'nat bo'lsin!

en: Enough was it for me at all hours to behold thee with those of the mind.
uz: Menga har soatda seni aql egalari bilan ko'rish yetarli edi.

en: Thou hast ﬁnished thy course and hast acquitted thyself on such wise as was vouchsafed thee of fortune; thou art come to the end whereunto each run- neth; thou hast left the toils and miseries of the world, and of thy very en- emy thou hast that sepulchre which thy worth hath merited.
uz: Siz o'z yo'lingizni tugatdingiz va o'zingizni shunday oqladingizki, sizga boylik berilgan edi; har bir yuguradigan oxiriga keldingiz; dunyo mashaqqatlari va musibatlarini tashlab ketdingiz va o'z g'azabingizdan o'sha qadringiz loyiq bo'lgan qabrga ega bo'ldingiz.

en: There lacked nought to thee to make thy funeral rites complete save her tears whom in life thou so lovedst, the which that thou mightest have, God put it into the heart of my unnatural father to send thee to me and I will give them to thee, albeit I had purposed to die with dry eyes and visage undismayed of aught; and having given them to thee, I will without delay so do that my soul, thou working it,223 shall rejoin that soul which thou erst so dearly guardedst.
uz: Hayotda seni juda yaxshi ko'rgan ko'z yoshlaringdan boshqa hech narsa senga to'liq dafn marosimlaringni o'tkazish uchun yetarli emas edi, sening qo'lingda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ko'z yoshlaringdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi. Xudo seni menga yuborish uchun otamning qalbiga joylashtirdi va men ularni senga beraman, garchi men quruq ko'zlar va hech narsadan xafa bo'lmagan yuz bilan o'lishni niyat qilgan bo'lsam ham; va senga berganimdan so'ng, sen uni ishlayotgan jonim, 223 sen qattiq qo'riqlagan jonimga qayta qo'shiladi.

en: And in what company could I betake me more contentedly or with better assurance to the regions unknown than with it?224 Certain am I that it abide- th yet herewithin225 and vieweth the seats of its delights and mine and as that which I am assured still loveth me, awaiteth my soul, whereof it is over all beloved.’ So saying, no otherwise than as she had a fountain of water in her head, bowing herself over the bowl, without making any womanly outcry, she began, lamenting, to shed so many and such tears that they were a marvel to behold, kissing the dead heart the while an inﬁnite number of times.
uz: Qanday qilib men o'zimni u bilan bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq mamnuniyat bilan yoki ishonch bilan noma'lum hududlarga qarata olaman? 224 Aniqmanki, u shu yerda qoladi - lekin u yerda225 va o'zining lazzatlari va mening joylarimga qaraydi va men ishonchim komilki, u meni hali ham sevadi, jonimni kutadi, u barcha seviklilardan ustundir. Shunday qilib, u boshida suv bulog'i bo'lgani kabi, o'zini kosa ustiga egib, hech qanday ayolona faryod qilmasdan, u yig'lab, ko'z yoshlariga shunday ko'z yosh to'kishni boshladi, ular ko'rish uchun mo'jiza edi, o'lik yurakni cheksiz vaqt o'pib.

en: Her women, who stood about her, understood not what this heart was nor what her words meant, but, overcome with compassion, wept all and in vain questioned her affectionately of the cause of her lament and studied yet more, as best they knew and might, to comfort her.
uz: Uning atrofida turgan ayollar bu yurak nima ekanligini ham, uning so'zlari nimani anglatishini ham tushunmas edilar, lekin rahm-shafqatdan to'lib-toshgan holda, hamma narsani yig'lashdi va bejizga uning motamining sababini mehr bilan so'rashdi va uni ovutish uchun o'zlari bilgan va kuchlari yetgancha ko'proq o'rganishdi.

en: The lady, having wept as much as herseemed ﬁt, raised her head and drying her eyes, said, ‘O much-loved heart, I have accomplished mine every ofﬁce towards thee, nor is there left me aught else to do save to come with my soul and bear thine company.’ So saying, she called for the vial wherein was the water she had made the day before and poured the latter into the bowl where was the heart
uz: Xonim, o'ziga ma'qul ko'ringancha yig'lab, boshini ko'tardi va ko'zlarini quritdi va dedi: "Ey, sevikli yurak, men senga nisbatan har bir vazifamni bajardim, va menga jonim bilan kelishim va sening hamrohligingni ko'rsatishimdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi." Shunday qilib, u bir kun oldin tayyorlagan suvi bo'lgan flakonni chaqirib oldi va oxirgini bochkaga quydi.

en: bathed with so many of her tears; then, setting her mouth thereto without any fear, she drank it all off and having drunken, mounted, with the cup in her hand, upon the bed, where composing her body as most decently she might, she pressed her dead lover’s heart to her own and without saying aught, awaited death.
uz: Ko'pgina ko'z yoshlari bilan cho'mildi; keyin, hech qanday qo'rqmasdan og'zini unga qo'yib, hammasini ichdi va ustiga o'tirdi, qo'lidagi kosasi bilan to'shakka, u yerda o'z tanasini imkon qadar yaxshilab to'ldirib, o'lik sevgilisining yuragini o'ziga bosdi va hech narsa demasdan, o'limni kutdi.

en: Her women, seeing and hearing all this, albeit they knew not what water this was she had drunken, had sent to tell Tancred everything, and he, fear- ing that which came to pass, came quickly down into his daughter’s cham- ber, where he arrived what time she laid herself on her bed and addressed himself too late to comfort her with soft words; but, seeing the extremity wherein she was, he fell a-weeping grievously; whereupon quoth the lady to him, ‘Tancred, keep these tears against a less desired fate than this of mine and give them not to me, who desire them not.
uz: Ayollari bularning hammasini ko'rib va eshitib, garchi bu qanday suv ekanligini bilmagan bo'lsalar ham, Tancredga hamma narsani aytish uchun yuborgan edilar. U esa sodir bo'lgan voqeadan qo'rqib, qizining chodiriga tezda tushdi. U yerga u o'zini to'shakka qo'yganida yetib keldi va uni yengil so'zlar bilan tasalli berishga juda kech murojaat qildi; lekin u qayerda ekanligini ko'rib, qayg'uli holda yig'ladi; shundan so'ng xonim unga dedi: "Tancred, bu ko'z yoshlarni menikiga emas, menikiga berma."

en: Who ever saw any, other than thou, lament for that which he himself hath willed?
uz: Sizdan boshqa hech kim o'zi xohlagan narsa uchun qayg'urganini ko'rganmi?

en: Nevertheless, if aught yet live in thee of the love which once thou borest me, vouchsafe me for a last boon that, since it was not thy pleasure that I should privily and in secret live with Guiscardo, my body may openly abide with his, whereasso- ever thou hast caused cast him dead.’ The agony of his grief suffered not the prince to reply; whereupon the young lady, feeling herself come to her end, strained the dead heart to her breast and said, ‘Abide ye with God, for I go hence.’ Then, closing her eyes and losing every sense, she departed this life of woe.
uz: Shunga qaramay, agar sizda meni bir vaqtlar zeriktirgan muhabbatning hech biri yashasa, meni oxirgi bir marhamat bilan xalos qiling, chunki sizning xohishingizga ko'ra, men Giiscardo bilan yashirincha yashayman, tanam ochiqchasiga uning bilan yashasin, qayerda uni o'ldirgan bo'lsangiz ham." Uning qayg'usi shahzodaga javob berishga imkon bermadi; shundan so'ng yosh xonim o'zini oxiriga yaqinlashayotganini his qilib, o'lik yuragini ko'ksiga tortdi va dedi: "Xudo bilan birga qolinglar, chunki men bu yo'ldan ketaman." Keyin ko'zlarini yumib, har bir hisni yo'qotdi va bu baxtsiz hayotni tark etdi.

en: Such, then, as you have heard, was the sorrowful ending of the loves of Guiscardo and Ghismonda, whose bodies Tancred, after much lam- entation, too late repenting him of his cruelty, caused honourably bury in one same sepulchre, amid the general mourning of all the people of Salerno.”
uz: Shunday qilib, siz eshitganingizdek, Guiscardo va Ghismonda muhabbatlarining qayg'uli yakunlandi. Tankredning jasadlari, ko'p azob chekkanidan so'ng, uni shafqatsizligidan juda kech tavba qilganidan so'ng, butun Salerno xalqining umumiy motamida bir xil qabrga faxr bilan dafn etildi.

en: THE SECOND STORY Fra Alberto giveth a lady to believe that the angel Gabriel is enamoured of her and in his shape lieth with her sundry times; after which, for fear of her kinsmen, he casteth himself forth of her window into the canal and taketh refuge in the house of a poor man, who on the morrow carrieth him, in the guise of a wild man of the woods, to the piazza, where, being recognized, he is taken by his brethren and put in prison.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Fra Alberto bir xonimga Jabroil farishta unga oshiq ekanligiga va uning shaklida uning turli xil holatlarida yotganiga ishontiradi; shundan so'ng, qarindoshlari qo'rquvi bilan, u derazasidan kanalga otilib chiqadi va bir kambag'al odamning uyida panoh topadi, u ertaga uni o'rmonning yovvoyi odami qiyofasida maydonga olib boradi, u yerda tan olinganidan so'ng, birodarlari tomonidan olib ketiladi va qamoqqa tashlanadi.

en: The story told by Fiammetta had more than once brought the tears to the eyes of the ladies her companions; but, it being now ﬁnished, the king with a stern countenance said, “My life would seem to me a little price to give for half the delight that Guiscardo had with Ghismonda, nor should any of you ladies marvel thereat, seeing that every hour of my life I suffer a thou- sand deaths, nor for all that is a single particle of delight vouchsafed me.
uz: Fiammetta aytib bergan hikoya bir necha bor uning hamrohlari xonimlarining ko'zlariga yosh olib kelgan edi; lekin, endi u tugagandan so'ng, shoh qattiq yuz bilan dedi: "Mening hayotim Ghismonda bilan bo'lgan zavqning yarmi uchun biroz qimmatga tengdek tuyuladi, va sizlardan hech kim hayron bo'lmasligi kerak, chunki hayotimning har bir soati bir mingta o'limni boshdan kechiradi, va bu menga bir zarracha ham zavq bermaydi."

en: But, leaving be my affairs for the present, it is my pleasure that Pampinea follow on the order of the discourse with some story of woeful chances and fortunes in part like to mine own; which if she ensue like as Fiammetta hath begun, I shall doubtless begin to feel some dew fallen upon my ﬁre.” Pampinea, hearing the order laid upon her, more by her affection apprehen- ded the mind of the ladies her companions than that of Filostrato by his words,226 wherefore, being more disposed to give them some diversion than to content the king, farther than in the mere letter of his commandment, she bethought herself to tell a story, that should, without departing from the pro- posed theme, give occasion for laughter, and accordingly began as follows: “The vulgar have a proverb to the effect that he who is naught and is held good may do ill and it is not believed of him; the which affordeth me
uz: Lekin, hozircha mening ishim bo'lib qolsa, Pampinea o'zimnikiga o'xshab, qayg'uli tasodiflar va omadlar hikoyasi bilan nutq tartibiga amal qilishdan mamnunman; agar u Fiammetta boshlaganidek davom etsa, men shubhasiz o'zimning olovimga tushadigan shudringni his qila boshlayman. Pampinea unga qo'yilgan buyrug'ni eshitgach, uning mehr-muhabbati bilan Filostratning so'zlaridan ko'ra uning hamrohlarining fikrini angladi.

en: ample matter for discourse upon that which hath been proposed to me and at the same time to show what and how great is the hypocrisy of the clergy, who,
uz: Menga taklif qilingan narsa haqida muhokama qilish uchun yetarli masala va shu bilan birga ruhoniylarning riyokorligi qanchalik katta ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun, kimki,

en: with garments long and wide and faces paled by art and voices humble and meek to solicit the folk, but exceeding loud and ﬁerce to rebuke in others their own vices, pretend that themselves by taking and others by giving to them come to salvation, and to boot, not as men who have, like ourselves, to purchase paradise, but as in a manner they were possessors and lords thereof, assign unto each who dieth, according to the sum of the monies left them by him, a more or less excellent place there, studying thus to deceive ﬁrst themselves, an they believe as they say, and after those who put faith for that matter in their words.
uz: Uzoq va keng liboslar bilan, san'at bilan yaltiragan yuzlar va xalqni undash uchun kamtar va kamtarona ovozlar bilan, lekin boshqalarda o'z illatlarini tanbeh berish uchun juda baland va shiddatli, o'zlarini olib, boshqalarni ularga berish orqali najotga erishgan deb ko'rsatadilar va o'zimiz kabi jannatni sotib olgan odamlar kabi emas, balki shunday qilib o'z so'zlariga ishonib, o'z so'zlariga ishonadiganlar kabi, o'zidan qolgan mablag'ga ko'ra o'lgan har bir kishiga, o'sha yerdan ko'proq yoki kamroq ajoyib joy tayinlaydilar.

en: Anent whom, were it permitted me to discov- er as much as it behoved, I would quickly make clear to many simple folk that which they keep hidden under those huge wide gowns of theirs.
uz: Agar menga kerak bo'lgancha kashf etishga ruxsat berilsa, men ko'p oddiy odamlarga o'sha ulkan keng ko'ylaklari ostida nimani yashirganliklarini tezda tushuntirardim.

en: But would God it might betide them all of their cozening tricks, as it betided a certain minor friar, and he no youngling, but held one of the ﬁrst casuists227 in Venice; of whom it especially pleaseth me to tell you, so as peradventure somewhat to cheer your hearts, that are full of compassion for the death of Ghismonda, with laughter and pleasance.
uz: Ammo Xudo ularning barcha g'aroyib hiylalarini xuddi bir kichik rohibga qilganidek, ularga ham g'aroyiblik qilsinmi? U yosh bo'lmagan, lekin Venetsiyadagi birinchi qurbonlardan biri edi. U haqida sizga aytib berish menga ayniqsa yoqadi, Ghismonda o'limiga rahm-shafqat bilan, kulgu va rohat bilan to'la qalblaringizni biroz xursand qilish uchun.

en: There was, then, noble ladies, in Imola, a man of wicked and corrupt life, who was called Berto della Massa and whose lewd fashions, being well known of the Imolese, had brought him into such ill savour with them that there was none in the town who would credit him, even when he said sooth; wherefore, seeing that his shifts might no longer stand him in stead there, he removed in desperation to Venice, the receptacle of every kind of trash, thinking to ﬁnd there new means of carrying on his wicked practices.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Imolada shunday olijanob xonimlar bor edi, yovuz va buzuq hayotga ega bo'lgan bir odam bor edi. U Berto della Massa deb atalgan edi va uning behayo modalari, imoliklar tomonidan yaxshi tanilganligi sababli, uni shu qadar yomon ta'mga olib kelgan ediki, hatto u tinch gapirsa ham, uni hurmat qiladigan hech kim yo'q edi; shuning uchun, uning navbatchiliklari endi unga qarshi turmasligini ko'rib, u umidsizlik bilan Venetsiyaga, har qanday axlat idishini olib bordi va u yerda o'zining yovuz amaliyotlarini davom ettirishning yangi usullarini topishni o'ylab,

en: There, as if conscience-stricken for the evil deeds done by him in the past, feigning himself overcome with the utmost humility and waxing devouter than any man alive, he went and turned Minor Friar and styled himself Fra Alberta da Imola; in which habit he proceeded to lead, to all appearance, a very aus- tere life, greatly commending abstinence and mortiﬁcation and never eating ﬂesh nor drinking wine, whenas he had not thereof that which was to his liking.
uz: U yerda, go'yo o'tmishda qilgan yovuz ishlari tufayli vijdonidan azob chekkan, o'zini eng kamtarona va tirik odamlardan ko'ra dindorroq ko'rsatgandek ko'rsatgan holda, u kichik Friarga aylandi va o'zini Fra Alberta da Imola deb atadi; shu odat bilan u barcha ko'rinishlarga juda yaxshi hayot kechirardi, o'zini tiyishni va xor bo'lishni, hech qachon na go'sht yeyishni, na vino ichishni juda maqtadi, garchi undan o'ziga yoqqan narsa yo'q edi.

en: In short, scarce was any ware of him when from a thief, a pimp, a forger, a manslayer, he suddenly became a great preacher, without having for all that forsworn the vices aforesaid, whenas he might secretly put them in practice.
uz: Qisqasi, u o'g'ridan, fohisha, soxtachi, qotildan kelib, birdan buyuk voiz bo'lganida, yuqorida aytilgan barcha yomonliklardan voz kechmagan holda, ularni yashirincha amalga oshirganida, uning hech qanday narsasi kam edi.

en: Moreover, becoming a priest, he would still, whenas he celeb- rated mass at the altar, an he were seen of many, beweep our Saviour’s pas- sion, as one whom tears cost little, whenas he willed it.
uz: Qolaversa, ruhoniy bo'lib, u hali ham, ko'pchilik ko'rgan holda, qurbongohda massani nishonlaganida, Najotkorimizning o'limini, ko'z yoshlari arzimaydigan odam kabi, xohlaganidek, ko'tarardi.

en: Brief, what with his preachings and his tears, he contrived on such wise to inveigle the Vene- tians that he was trustee and depository of well nigh every will made in the
uz: Qisqacha qilib aytganda, u o'z va'zlari va ko'z yoshlari bilan Venetsiyaliklarni shunday donolik bilan o'ziga jalb qildi, hatto u deyarli har bir vasiyatnomaga vasiy va omonatchi bo'ldi.

en: town and guardian of folk’s monies, besides being confessor and counsellor of the most part of the men and women of the place; and doing thus, from wolf he was become shepherd and the fame of his sanctity was far greater in those parts than ever was that of St.
uz: shahar va xalqning boyliklarini himoya qiluvchi, shu yerdagi ko'pchilik erkaklar va ayollarning iqror va maslahatchisi bo'lishdan tashqari; va shu tariqa, u bo'ridan cho'pon bo'ldi va uning muqaddasligi shuhratini o'sha hududlarda har qachongidan ham kattaroq bo'ldi.

en: It chanced one day that a vain simple young lady, by name Madam Lis- etta da Ca228 Quirino, wife of a great merchant who was gone with the gal- leys into Flanders, came with other ladies to confess to this same holy friar, at whose feet kneeling and having, like a true daughter of Venice as she was (where the women are all featherbrained), told him part of her affairs, she was asked of him if she had a lover.
uz: Bir kuni shunday bo'lib qoldiki, Madam Lis- etta da Ca228 Quirino ismli oddiy yosh xonim, Flandriyaga gal- leys bilan borgan buyuk savdogarning xotini, xuddi shu muqaddas rohibga tan olish uchun boshqa xonimlar bilan birga keldi. Uning oyoqlari tizzalab, xuddi haqiqiy Venetsiya qizi kabi (ayollar hamma qomatda) bo'lgani holda, unga o'z ishlarining bir qismini aytib berdi, undan sevgilisi bor-yo'qligini so'radi.

en: Whereto she answered, with an offen- ded air, ‘Good lack, sir friar, have you no eyes in your head?
uz: U qayerga javob berdi, xafa ruh bilan:  Yaxshi yo'q, janob rohib, boshingizda ko'zlaringiz yo'qmi?

en: Seem my charms to you such as those of yonder others?
uz: Sizga mening jozibalarim boshqalarning jozibasidek tuyuladimi?

en: I might have lovers and to spare, an I would; but my beauties are not for this one nor that.
uz: Mening oshiqlarim bo'lishi mumkin edi va men ularni ayamasligim mumkin edi; lekin go'zallarim na bu, na bu uchun emas.

en: How many women do you see whose charms are such as mine, who would be fair in Paradise?’ Brief, she said so many things of this beauty of hers that it was a weariness to hear.
uz: Mening jozibalarimga o'xshash, jannatda go'zal bo'ladigan nechta ayolni ko'ryapsiz? Qisqacha qilib aytganda, u o'zining bu go'zalligi haqida shunchalik ko'p gapirdi, eshitish charchatdi.

en: Fra Alberto incontinent perceived that she savoured of folly and himseeming she was a ﬁt soil for his tools, he fell suddenly and beyond measure in love with her; but, reserving blandishments for a more convenient season, he proceeded, for the nonce, so he might show himself a holy man, to rebuke her and tell her that this was vainglory and so forth.
uz: Fra Alberto behayolik bilan uning ahmoqlikdan zavqlanishini va o'zini asboblari uchun mos tuproqdek ko'rishini angladi, u birdaniga va haddan tashqari unga oshiq bo'ldi; lekin, qulayroq mavsum uchun o'ziga xos narsalarni saqlab, o'zini muqaddas odam deb ko'rsatishi uchun, uni tanbeh berishi va bu behudalik ekanligini aytishi uchun davom etdi.

en: The lady told him he was an ass and knew not what one beauty was more than another, whereupon he, unwilling to vex her overmuch, took her con- fession and let her go away with the others.
uz: Xonim unga uning eshak ekanligini va bir go'zallikning boshqa go'zallikdan ustunligini bilmasligini aytdi, shuning uchun u uni haddan tashqari bezovta qilmoqchi bo'lmagani uchun, uning e'tiborini tortdi va qolganlar bilan birga ketishiga ruxsat berdi.

en: He let some days pass, then, taking with him a trusty companion of his, he repaired to Madam Lisetta’s house and withdrawing with her into a room apart, where none might see him, he fell on his knees before her and said, ‘Madam, I pray you for God’s sake pardon me that which I said to you last Sunday, whenas you bespoke me of your beauty, for that the following night I was so cruelly chastised there that I have not since been able to rise from my bed till today.’ Quoth Mistress Featherbrain, ‘And who chastised you thus?’ ‘I will tell you,’ replied the monk.
uz: U bir necha kun o'tgach, o'zining ishonchli hamrohini olib, Madam Lisetta uyiga qaytib keldi va uni hech kim ko'rmaydigan xonaga olib kirdi. U uning oldida tizzalari bilan yiqildi va dedi: Madam, siz meni Xudo haqqi bilan kechiring, o'tgan yakshanba kuni siz meni go'zalligingiz haqida gapirganingizda, chunki keyingi kechasi u yerda shunchalik shafqatsizlarcha jazolangan edimki, shu kundan beri to'shagimdan turolmadim. Quoth Mistress Featherbrain, Sizni kim jazolagan edi? Men sizga aytaman,  dedi rohib.

en: ‘Being that night at my orisons, as I still use to be, I saw of a sudden a great light in my cell and ere I could turn me to see what it might be, I beheld over against me a very fair youth with a stout cudgel in his hand, who took me by the gown and dragging me to my feet, gave me such a drubbing that he broke every bone in my body.
uz: O'sha kechasi, men odatdagidek, o'z uyimda bo'lganimda, to'satdan xujayramda katta nurni ko'rdim va nima bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rish uchun burilishimdan oldin, qo'lida katta dumbali juda chiroyli yosh yigitni ko'rdim. U meni ko'ylagimdan ushladi va oyoqlarimga tortdi, u menga tanamdagi har bir suyakni sindirdi.

en: I asked him why he used me thus and he answered, “For that thou pre- sumedst today, to disparage the celestial charms of Madam Lisetta, whom I
uz: Men undan nega meni shunday ishlatganini so'radim va u javob berdi: "Bugun siz Madam Lisetta'ning osmoniy jozibasini kamsitishni oldindan rejalashtirganingiz uchun, men..."

en: love over all things, save only God.” “Who, then, are you?” asked I; and he replied that he was the angel Gabriel.
uz: "Hamma narsaga muhabbat, faqat Xudodan tashqari." Xo'sh, sen kimsan? deb so'radim; va u Jabroil farishtasiman, deb javob berdi.

en: “O my lord,” said I, “I pray you par- don me”; and he, “So be it; I pardon thee on condition that thou go to her, as ﬁrst thou mayst, and get her pardon; but if she pardons thee not, I will return to thee and give thee such a bout of it that I will make thee a woeful man for all the time thou shalt live here below.” That which he said to me after I dare not tell you, except you ﬁrst pardon me.’ My Lady Addlepate, who was somewhat scant of wit, was overjoyed to hear this, taking it all for gospel, and said, after a little, ‘I told you, Fra Al- berto, that my charms were celestial, but, so God be mine aid, it irketh me for you and I will pardon you forthright, so you may come to no more harm, provided you tell me truly that which the angel said to you after.’ ‘Madam,’ replied Fra Alberto, ‘since you pardon me, I will gladly tell it you; but I must warn you of one thing, to wit, that
uz: Ey hazratim,  dedim men, Sizdan iltimos qilaman, meni kechiring; va u dedi: Xullas, shunday bolsin; men sizni kechiraman, agar siz avval unga borishingiz mumkin bolganidek va uni kechirib qoysangiz; lekin agar u sizni kechirmasa, men sizga qaytib kelib, sizni shu yerdagi hayotingiz davomida qayguli odamga aylantiraman. U sizga aytishga jurat etayotgan narsani, faqat siz meni kechiring.

en: whatever I tell you, you must have a care not to repeat it to anyone alive, an you would not mar your affairs, for that you are the luckiest lady in the world.
uz: Sizga nima desam ham, buni hech kimga tirik holda takrorlamaslikka ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak, chunki siz dunyodagi eng omadli xonim ekanligingiz uchun ishingizni buzmas edingiz.

en: The angel Gabriel bade me tell you that you pleased him so much that he had many a time come to pass the night with you, but that he feared to affright you.
uz: Jabroil farishta menga senga aytishni so'radi, sen unga shunchalik yoqqan edingki, tunni sen bilan o'tkazishga ko'p kelgan edi, lekin seni qo'rqitishdan qo'rqardi.

en: Now he sendeth to tell you by me that he hath a mind to come to you one night and abide awhile with you and (for that he is an angel and that, if he came in angel-form, you might not avail to touch him), he purposeth, for your delectation, to come in guise of a man, wherefore he biddeth you send to tell him when you would have him come and in whose form, and he will come hither; whereof you may hold yourself blest over any other lady alive.’ My Lady Conceit answered that it liked her well that the angel Gabriel loved her, seeing she loved him well nor ever failed to light a candle of a groat before him, whereas she saw him depictured, and that what time so- ever he chose to come to her, he should be dearly welcome and would ﬁnd her all alone in her chamber, but on this condition, that he should not leave her for the Virgin Mary, whose great well-wisher it was said he was, as in- deed
uz: Endi u menga siz tomon bir kecha kelib, siz bilan bir oz qolishni o'ylayotganini va (chunki u farishta va agar farishta qiyofasida kelsa, unga teginmasligingiz mumkinligini) aytish uchun yuboradi. U sizning zavqingiz uchun erkak qiyofasida kelishni maqsad qilgan. Shuning uchun u sizga qachon kelishini va qaysi qiyofasida kelishini aytishni buyuradi va u bu yerga keladi; shundan keyin siz o'zingizni boshqa bir ayol ustida tirik tutishingiz mumkin.

en: appeareth, inasmuch as in every place where she saw him [limned], he was on his knees before her.
uz: ko'rinadi, chunki u uni ko'rgan har bir joyda, u uning oldida tizzalab turardi.

en: Moreover, she said it must rest with him to come in whatsoever form he pleased, so but she was not affrighted.
uz: Qolaversa, u uning xohlagan shaklda kelishiga ruxsat berishi kerakligini aytdi, lekin u xavotirda emas edi.

en: Then said Fra Alberto, ‘Madam, you speak sagely and I will without fail take order with him of that which you tell me.
uz: Shunda Fra Alberto dedi: Xonim, siz aqlli gapirasiz va men siz menga aytgan gaplarni u bilan bemalol tartibga solaman.

en: But you may do me a great favour, which will cost you nothing; it is this, that you will him come with this my body.
uz: Lekin siz menga katta bir marhamat qilishingiz mumkin, bu sizga hech qanday qimmatga tushmaydi; aynan shu, uni mening tanam bilan birga olib kelishingiz kerak.

en: And I will tell you in what you will do me a favour; you must
uz: Va men sizga menga qanday yordam ko'rsatishingiz mumkinligini aytaman; siz

en: know that he will take my soul forth of my body and put it in Paradise, whilst he himself will enter into me; and what while he abideth with you, so long will my soul abide in Paradise.’ ‘With all my heart,’ answered Dame Littlewit.
uz: Bilingki, u mening ruhimni tanamdan olib, Jannatga qo'yadi, o'zi esa menga kiradi; va u siz bilan qolguncha, mening ruhim Jannatda uzoq qoladi.  Butun qalbim bilan,  javob berdi Xonim Kichkina.

en: ‘I will well that you have this consolation, in requital of the buf- fets he gave you on my account.’ Then said Fra Alberto, ‘Look that he ﬁnd the door of your house open tonight, so he may come in thereat, for that, coming in human form, as he will, he might not enter save by the door.’ The lady replied that it should be done, whereupon the monk took his leave and she abode in such a transport of exultation that her breech touched not her shift and herseemed a thousand years till the angel Gabriel should come to her.
uz: Men sizga bu tasalli bo'lishini yaxshi ko'raman, u sizga mening hisobimda bergan buf- fets evaziga. Shunda frasi Alberto dedi: Barang, u bugun kechqurun uyingizning eshigini ochiq topsin, shunda u u yerga kirishi mumkin, chunki u inson qiyofasida, xohlaganidek, eshikdan tashqari kirmasligi mumkin. Xonim javob berdi: Buning o'zi amalga oshirilishi kerak, shundan so'ng rohib ketadi va u shunday xursandchilikda yashaydi, uning ko'ylagi uning shiftga tegmaydi va Gabriel farishtasining kelguncha ming yil yashaydi.

en: Meanwhile, Fra Alberto, bethinking him that it behoved him play the cavalier, not the angel, that night proceeded to fortify himself with confec- tions and other good things, so he might not lightly be unhorsed; then, get- ting leave, as soon as it was night, he repaired with one of his comrades to the house of a woman, a friend of his, whence he was used whiles to take his start what time he went to course the ﬁllies; and thence, whenas it seemed to him time, having disguised himself, he betook him to the lady’s house.
uz: Ayni paytda, janob Alberto, o'sha kechasi farishta emas, balki chavandoz o'ynashi kerak deb o'ylab, o'zini shirinliklar va boshqa yaxshi narsalar bilan mustahkamlashga kirishdi, shunda u yengil ravishda o'zini beparvo qilmasligi mumkin edi; so'ngra, ketib, tun bo'lishi bilan, o'z safdoshlari bilan bir ayolning uyiga, do'stiga bordi, u yerdan u fillarni o'rganishga boradigan vaqtni boshlash uchun mo'ljallangan bo'ladi; va keyin, vaqt kelganda, o'zini niqotgan holda, u uni xonimning uyiga olib bordi.

en: There he tricked himself out as an angel with the trappings he had brought with him and going up, entered the chamber of the lady, who, see- ing this creature all in white, fell on her knees before him.
uz: U yerda u o'zi olib kelgan tuzoqlar bilan farishta kabi o'zini aldadi va yuqoriga ko'tarilib, xonimaning xonasiga kirdi. Xonimaning xonasiga kirdi, u bu oq kiyimdagi maxluqni ko'rib, uning oldida tizzasiga yiqildi.

en: The angel blessed her and raising her to her feet, signed to her to go to bed, which she, studious to obey, promptly did, and the angel after lay down with his de- votee.
uz: Farishta uni duo qildi va oyoqlariga ko'tardi, unga yotishga ishora qildi, u itoat qilishga tayyor bo'lib, zudlik bilan shunday qildi va farishta o'z de-voiti bilan yotdi.

en: Now Fra Alberto was a personable man of his body and a lusty and excellent well set up on his legs; wherefore, ﬁnding himself in bed with Madam Lisetta, who was young and dainty, he showed himself another guess bedfellow than her husband and many a time that night took ﬂight without wings, whereof she avowed herself exceeding content; and eke he told her many things of the glories of heaven.
uz: Endi Fra Alberto o'z tanasi bilan mehribon inson edi va oyoqlarida hashamatli va ajoyib quduq o'rnatilgan edi; shuning uchun u yosh va nafis Madam Lisetta bilan to'shakda o'zini topib, o'ziga eridan ko'ra boshqa bir yotoqdoshni ko'rsatdi va o'sha tun qanotsiz uchib ketdi, shundan u o'zini juda mamnun deb hisoblardi; va u unga osmon shon-shuhratlari haqida ko'p narsalarni aytdi.

en: Then, the day drawing near, after taking order for his return, he made off with his trappings and returned to his comrade, whom the good woman of the house had meanwhile borne amicable company, lest he should get a fright, lying alone.
uz: Keyin, kun yaqinlashganda, qaytib kelishi uchun buyruq olganidan so'ng, u o'z tuzoqlari bilan jo'nab ketdi va o'rtoqining oldiga qaytib keldi. U bilan uyning yaxshi ayoli do'stona munosabatda bo'lgan edi, toki u yolg'iz yotganda qo'rqib qolmasin.

en: As for the lady, no sooner had she dined than, taking her waiting-woman with her, she betook herself to Fra Alberto and gave him news of the angel Gabriel, telling him that which she had heard from him of the glories of life eternal and how he was made and adding to boot, marvellous stories of her own invention.
uz: Xonimga kelsak, u ovqatdan oldinroq, o'zi bilan birga bo'lgan xizmatkor ayolini olib, frasi Albertoga bordi va unga Gabriel farishtasining xabarini berdi, undan abadiy hayotning shon-shuhratlari va u qanday yaratilganligi haqida eshitganlarini aytib, o'z ixtirosi haqidagi ajoyib hikoyalarni qo'shib yubordi.

en: ‘Madam,’ said he, ‘I know not how you fared with him; I
uz: Xonim,  dedi u, Men u bilan qanday munosabatda bo'lganingizni bilmayman; men

en: only know that yesternight, whenas he came to me and I did your message to him, he suddenly transported my soul amongst such a multitude of roses and other ﬂowers that never was the like thereof seen here below, and I abode in one of the most delightsome places that was aye until the morning; but what became of my body meanwhile I know not.’ ‘Do I not tell you?’ answered the lady.
uz: Faqatgina bilingki, o'tgan kecha u menga kelganida va men unga xabaringizni aytganimda, u birdaniga ruhimni shu yerdagi gullar va boshqa gullar orasida ko'rmagan, va men ertalabgacha eng yoqimli joylardan birida yashadim; lekin shu vaqt ichida tanamga nima bo'lganini bilmayman." Men sizga aytmayapmanmi? deb javob berdi xonim.

en: ‘Your body lay all night in mine arms with the angel Gabriel.
uz: Sening jasading butun tun mening qo'llarimda farishta Jabroil bilan yotdi.

en: If you believe me not, look under your left pap, whereas I gave the angel such a kiss that the marks of it will stay by you for some days to come.’ Quoth the friar, ‘Say you so?
uz: Agar menga ishonmasangiz, chap papangiz ostiga qarang, men farishtaga shunday o'pich berdimki, uning izlari sizda bir necha kun qoladi." Ruhoniy dedi: "Shunday deyapsizmi?"

en: Then will I do today a thing I have not done this great while; I will strip myself, to see if you tell truth.’ Then, after much prating, the lady returned home and Fra Alberto paid her many visits in angel-form, without suffering any hindrance.
uz: Unda bugun men bu buyuk vaqt davomida qilmagan ishni qilaman; rost gapirasizmi, deb o'zimni yechaman. Keyin, ko'p gapirishdan so'ng, xonim uyga qaytib keldi va Fra Alberto unga farishta qiyofasida ko'p tashrif buyurdi, hech qanday to'siqsiz.

en: However, it chanced one day that Madam Lisetta, being in dispute with a gossip of hers upon the question of female charms, to set her own above all others, said, like a woman who had little wit in her noddle, ‘An you but knew whom my beauty pleaseth, in truth you would hold your peace of oth- er women.’ The other, longing to hear, said, as one who knew her well, ‘Madam, maybe you say sooth; but knowing not who this may be, one can- not turn about so lightly.’ Thereupon quoth Lisetta, who was eath enough to draw, ‘Gossip, it must go no farther; but he I mean is the angel Gabriel, who loveth me more than himself, as the fairest lady (for that which he telleth me) who is in the world or the Maremma.’229 The other had a mind to laugh, but contained herself, so she might make Lisetta speak farther, and said, ‘Faith, madam, an the angel Gabriel be your lover and tell you this, needs must it be
uz: Ammo, bir kuni Madam Lisetta ayollarning jozibasi masalasida o'zining g'iybatidan bahslashib, o'zini boshqalardan ustun qo'yish uchun shunday dedi: "Sen faqat go'zalliging kimga yoqishini bilasan, aslida boshqa ayollarga nisbatan sukut saqlaysan." Boshqa biri esa, eshitishni orzu qilib, uni yaxshi bilgan odam kabi dedi: "Janob, sen tinch aytasan; lekin bu kim bo'lishi mumkinligini bilmay, bunchalik yengillik bilan o'girib bo'lmaydi." Shunda Lisetta, o'ziga yetarlicha dono bo'lib, dedi: "Go'zallik, bu uzoqroq yurmasligi kerak; lekin men o'zini o'zi sevgan Gabrielni, meni dunyodagi eng go'zal ayol (u meni shunday deb aytadi), balki u shunday deb aytdi."

en: so; but methought not the angels did these things.’ ‘Gossip,’ answered the lady, ‘you are mistaken; zounds, he doth what you wot of bet- ter than my husband and telleth me they do it also up yonder; but, for that I seem to him fairer than any she in heaven, he hath fallen in love with me and cometh full oft to lie with me; seestow now?’230 The gossip, to whom it seemed a thousand years till she should be where- as she might repeat these things, took her leave of Madam Lisetta and fore- gathering at an entertainment with a great company of ladies, orderly re- counted to them the whole story.
uz: Shunday qilib, farishtalar bu ishlarni qilgan deb o'ylamaganman. G'iybat, javob berdi xonim, siz adashasiz; chunki u erimdan ko'ra yaxshiroq ish qiladi va menga aytadi, ular buni yuqorida ham qilishadi; lekin, men unga osmondagi har qanday ayoldan ko'ra go'zalroq tuyulganim uchun, u menga oshiq bo'lib qoldi va men bilan birga yotishga tez-tez keladi; endi ko'rinib turibdimi?230 G'iybat, unga ming yilgacha qayerda bo'lishi kerak deb tuyulgan - u bu narsalarni takrorlayotgandek, u xonim Lisettadan ruxsat oldi va oldindan ko'p xonimlar bilan birga bo'lgan ko'ngilocharga yig'ildi, ularga butun hikoyani tartibli tarzda qayta ko'rsatdi.

en: They told it again to their husbands and other ladies, and these to yet others, and so in less than two days Venice was all full of it.
uz: Ular buni yana erlariga va boshqa ayollarga, bularni esa yana boshqalarga aytishdi va shunday qilib, ikki kundan kamroq vaqt ichida Venetsiya hammasi to'lib ketdi.

en: Among others to whose ears the thing came were Lisetta’s brothers-in-law, who, without saying aught to her, bethought themselves to ﬁnd the angel in question and see if he knew how to ﬂy, and to this end they
uz: Quloqlariga bu narsa tushgan boshqalar orasida Lisetta'ning kuyovlari ham bor edi. Ular unga hech narsa demasdan, so'ralgan farishtani topib, u qanday uchishni biladi, deb o'ylashardi va shu maqsadda ular...

en: lay several nights in wait for him.
uz: Uni bir necha kecha kutdi.

en: As chance would have it, some inkling of the matter231 came to the ears of Fra Alberto, who accordingly repaired one night to the lady’s house, to reprove her, but hardly had he put off his clothes ere her brothers-in-law, who had seen him come, were at the door of her chamber to open it.
uz: Tasodifan, Fra Albertoning qulog'iga 231 masalasidan ma'lumot keldi. U bir kecha xonimning uyini ta'mirlab, uni tanqid qildi, lekin uning kelishini ko'rgan qaynotalari uning xonasining eshigida uni ochish uchun deyarli kiyimlarini yechmagan edi.

en: Fra Alberto, hearing this and guessing what was to do, started up and having no other resource, opened a window, which gave upon the Grand Canal, and cast himself thence into the water.
uz: Buni eshitib, nima qilish kerakligini taxmin qilib, boshqa hech qanday resursga ega bo'lmay, ishga tushdi, Buyuk Kanalga qaragan oynani ochdi va o'sha yerdan suvga tashlandi.

en: The canal was deep there and he could swim well, so that he did himself no hurt, but made his way to the opposite bank and hastily entering a house that stood open there, besought a poor man, whom he found within, to save his life for the love of God, telling him a tale of his own fashion, to explain how he came there at that hour and naked.
uz: U yerda kanal chuqur edi va u yaxshi suzishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun u o'ziga hech qanday zarar yetkazmadi, lekin qarama-qarshi qirg'oqqa yo'l oldi va u yerda ochiq turgan uyga shoshilinch kirdi, ichida topgan bir bechoraga Xudoning muhabbati uchun hayotini saqlab qolishni so'radi, unga o'z uslubidagi ertakni aytib berdi, o'sha soatda qanday qilib u yerga yalang'och kelganini tushuntirdi.

en: The good man was moved to pity and it behoving him to go do his occasions, he put him in his own bed and bade him abide there against his return; then, locking him in, he went about his affairs.
uz: Yaxshi odam rahm-shafqatga to'ldi va unga o'z tadbirlarini o'tkazishga majbur bo'ldi, uni o'z karavoyiga qo'ydi va qaytib kelguncha u yerda qolishini buyurdi; so'ngra, uni mahkamlab, o'z ishlarini davom ettirdi.

en: Mean- while, the lady’s brothers-in-law entered her chamber and found that the an- gel Gabriel had ﬂown, leaving his wings there; whereupon, seeing them- selves bafﬂed, they gave her all manner hard words and ultimately made off to their own house with the angel’s trappings, leaving her disconsolate.
uz: Ayni paytda, xonimaning kuyovlari uning xonasiga kirib, an-gel Gabriel uchib ketganini va u yerda qanotlarini qoldirganini topdilar; shundan so'ng, ularni ko'rib, o'zlari xafa bo'lishdi, unga har xil qattiq so'zlar aytishdi va oxir-oqibat farishtaning tuzoqlari bilan o'z uylariga jo'nab ketishdi, uni xafa qoldirishdi.
