en: Broad day come, the good man with whom Fra Alberto had taken refuge, being on the Rialto, heard how the angel Gabriel had gone that night to lie with Madam Lisetta and being surprised by her kinsmen, had cast himself for fear into the canal, nor was it known what was come of him, and con- cluded forthright that this was he whom he had at home.
uz: Kun yor bo'ldi, Fra Alberto bilan birga panoh topgan yaxshi odam, Rialtoda bo'lib, o'sha kechasi Gabriel Maryam Lisetta bilan yotgani va uning qarindoshlari tomonidan hayratda qolgani, qo'rquvdan o'zini kanalga tashlaganini eshitdi, undan nima kelgani ham noma'lum edi va u yerda shu odam borligini aniq ko'rsatdi.

en: Accordingly, he returned thither and recognizing the monk, found means after much parley, to make him fetch him ﬁfty ducats, an he would not have him give him up to the lady’s kinsmen.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u u yerga qaytib keldi va rohibni tanib oldi, ko'p suhbatdan so'ng uni ellik dukat olib kelishga majbur qilish uchun vosita topdi, lekin u uni xonimning qarindoshlariga topshirishga ruxsat bermasdi.

en: Having gotten the money and Fra Alberto offering to depart thence, the good man said to him, ‘There is no way of escape for you, an it be not one that I will tell you.
uz: Pulni olgach va Fra Alberto u yerdan ketishni taklif qilib, yaxshi odam unga dedi: Senga hech qanday qochish yo'li yo'q, men senga aytadigan yo'q.

en: We hold today a festival, wherein one bringeth a man clad bear-fashion and another one accoutred as a wild man of the woods and whatnot else, some one thing and some another, and there is a hunt held in St.
uz: Bugun biz bayram o'tkazmoqdamiz, unda biri ayiq libosida kelgan odamni, yana biri o'rmon yovvoyi odami va hokazo kabi kiyingan odamni olib keladi, ba'zi bir narsa va ba'zi bir narsa, va Sankt-Peterburgda ov o'tkaziladi.

en: Mark’s Place, which ﬁnished, the festival is at an end and after each goeth whither it pleaseth him with him whom he hath brought.
uz: Markning joyi, tugadi, bayram oxirida va har bir kishi o'zi olib kelgan odam bilan xursand bo'lgan joyga boradi.

en: An you will have me lead you thither, after one or other of these fashions, I can after carry you whither you please, ere it be spied out that you are here; else I know not how you are to get away, without being recog-
uz: Siz meni sizni u yerga olib borishga majbur qilasiz, bu yoki bu modalardan keyin, sizni xohlagan joyingizga olib borishim mumkin, agar siz bu yerda ekanligingiz aniqlanmasa; aks holda qanday qilib tanib olinmasdan qutulishingiz mumkinligini bilmayman.

en: nized, for the lady’s kinsmen, concluding that you must be somewhere here- about, have set a watch for you on all sides.’ Hard as it seemed to Fra Alberto to go on such wise, nevertheless, of the fear he had of the lady’s kinsmen, he resigned himself thereto and told his host whither he would be carried, leaving the manner to him.
uz: Xonimning qarindoshlari, siz bu yerda bo'lishingiz kerak degan xulosaga kelib, sizni har tomondan kuzatib kelishdi.  Fr Albertoga bunday oqilona yo'l tutish qiyin tuyulgan bo'lsa-da, ammo u xonimning qarindoshlariga nisbatan qo'rqib, o'zini bunga rozi qildi va o'z xostiriga qayerga olib ketilishini aytdi, odobni unga qoldirdi.

en: Accordingly, the other, having smeared him all over with honey and covered him with down, clapped a chain about his neck and a mask on his face; then giving him a great staff in on hand and in the other two great dogs which he had fetched from the shambles he despatched one to the Rialto to make public proclamation that whoso would see the angel Gabriel should repair to St.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ikkinchisi, uni butunlay asal bilan to'kib, pastga yopib, bo'yniga zanjir va yuziga niqob taqdi; so'ngra unga qo'lida katta tayoq berdi va boshqa ikki katta itni, u axlatdan olib kelganida, Rialtoga yuborib, farishta Jabroilni kim ko'rsa, uni tuzatishi kerakligi haqida ommaviy e'lon qildi.

en: Mark’s Place; and this was Venetian loyalty!
uz: Markning joyi; va bu Venetsiya sadoqati edi!

en: This done, after a while, he brought him forth and setting him before himself, went holding him by the chain behind, to the no small clamour of the folk, who said all, ‘What be this?
uz: Shundan so'ng, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, u uni tashqariga olib chiqdi va o'z oldiga qo'ydi, zanjirdan orqaga ushlab, xalqning hech qanday kichik shovqiniga bordi, ular hammasi: "Bu nima?" deyishdi.

en: What be this?’232 till he came to the place, where, what with those who had followed after them and those who, hearing the proclamation, were come thither from the Rialto, were folk without end.
uz: Bu nima bo'ldi?232 toki u joyga yetib keldi, u yerda ularning ortidan ergashganlar va Rialtodan xabarni eshitib, u yerga kelganlar cheksiz xalq edi.

en: There he tied his wild man to a column in a raised and high place, making a show of awaiting the hunt, whilst the ﬂies and gads gave the monk exceeding annoy, for that he was besmeared with honey.
uz: U yerda u o'zining yovvoyi odamini baland va baland joydagi ustunga bog'ladi, ovni kutish ko'rinishida, pashshalar va yillar rohibni juda bezovta qildi, chunki u asal bilan bulg'angan edi.

en: But, when he saw the place well ﬁlled, making as he would unchain his wild man, he pulled off Fra Alberto’s mask and said, ‘Gentlemen, since the bear cometh not and there is no hunt toward, I purpose, so you may not be come in vain, that you shall see the angel Gab- riel, who cometh down from heaven to earth anights, to comfort the Vene- tian ladies.’ No sooner was the mask off than Fra Alberto was incontinent recognized of all, who raised a general outcry against him, giving him the scurviest words and the soundest rating was ever given a canting knave; moreover, they cast in his face, one this kind of ﬁlth and another that, and so they baited him a great while, till the news came by chance to his brethren, whereupon half a dozen of them sallied forth and coming thither, unchained him and threw a gown over him; then, with a general hue and cry behind them, they carried him off to the
uz: Ammo, u joy yaxshi to'lganini ko'rib, yovvoyi odamni kishanini yechmoqchi bo'lgandek qildi, u Fr Alberto niqobi bilan yechdi va dedi: "Janoblar, ayiq kelmagani va ovga yo'l qo'yilmagani uchun, men behuda kelmasligingizni maqsad qilganman, shunda siz osmondan yerga tushadigan farishta Gab-rielni ko'rasiz, u tunlari Vena-Tiyan xonimlarini yupatadi." Tez orada niqob yechilganidan so'ng, Fr Alberto hammaga tanildi, u unga qarshi umumiy faryod ko'tardi, unga eng g'alati so'zlar va eng baland baho berildi; bundan tashqari, ular uning yuziga bir xil ifloslik tashlashdi, va ular unga bir oz vaqt davomida katta baho berishdi, toki xabar tasodifan uning birodarlariga yetib kelguncha, ular uni orqaga tashlashdi va ularni...

en: convent, where it is believed he died in prison, after a wretched life.
uz: Monastir, u yerda u qamoqxonada, achinarli hayotdan keyin vafot etgan deb ishoniladi.

en: Thus then did this fellow, held good and doing ill, without it being believed, dare to feign himself the angel Gabriel, and after being turned into a wild man of the woods and put to shame, as he de- served, bewailed, when too late, the sins he had committed.
uz: Shunday qilib, yaxshilik qilib, yomonlik qilib yurgan bu odam, ishonmasdan, o'zini Gabriel farishtasi deb ko'rsatishga jur'at etdi va o'rmonning yovvoyi odamiga aylanib, sharmanda bo'lgandan so'ng, juda kech bo'lgach, qilgan gunohlarini xafa qildi.

en: God grant it happen thus to all other knaves of his fashion!”
uz: Xudo o'z uslubidagi boshqa barcha xasislarga shunday bo'lishini intilsin!

en: THE THIRD STORY Three young men love three sisters and ﬂee with them into Crete, where the eldest sister for jealousy slayeth her lover.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA Uch nafar yigit uch singilni sevib, ular bilan birga Kritga qochib ketishadi, u yerda katta opa rashk tufayli sevgilisini o'ldiradi.

en: The second, yielding herself to the Duke of Crete, saveth her sister from death, whereupon her own lover slayeth her and ﬂeeth with the eldest sister.
uz: Ikkinchisi, o'zini Krit gersogiga topshirib, singlisini o'limdan qutqaradi, shundan so'ng o'z sevgilisi uni o'ldiradi va katta singlisi bilan qochadi.

en: Meanwhile the third lover and the youngest sister are accused of the new murder and being taken, confess it; then, for fear of death, they corrupt their keepers with money and ﬂee to Rhodes, where they die in poverty.
uz: Ayni paytda uchinchi oshiq va eng kichkina opa-singil yangi qotillikda ayblanib, olib ketilmoqda, buni tan olishadi; so'ngra, o'limdan qo'rqib, o'z qo'riqchilariga pul berib, Rodosga qochib ketishadi va u yerda qashshoqlikda o'lishadi.

en: Filostrato, having heard the end of Pampinea’s story, bethought himself awhile and presently, turning to her, said, “There was some little that was good and that pleased me in the ending of your story; but there was over- much before that which gave occasion for laughter and which I would not have had there.” Then, turning to Lauretta, “Lady,” said he, “ensue you with a better, and it may be.” Quoth she, laughing, “You are too cruel towards lovers, an you desire of them only an ill end;233 but, to obey you, I will tell a story of three who all ended equally ill, having had scant enjoyment of their loves.” So saying, she began thus: “Young ladies, as you should mani- festly know, every vice may turn to the grievous hurt of whoso practiseth it, and often of other folk also; but of all others that which with the slackest rein carrieth us away to our peril, meseemeth is anger, which is none
uz: Filostrato, Pampiyaning hikoyasining oxirini eshitgach, bir oz o'zini o'yladi va darhol unga o'girilib dedi: "Sizning hikoyangizning oxirida yaxshi va menga yoqadigan bir oz narsa bor edi; lekin undan oldin kulishga sabab bo'ladigan va men u yerda bo'lmagan ko'p narsa bor edi." So'ngra Laurettaga o'girilib, "Xonim," dedi u, "Sizni yaxshiroq bilan ta'minlayman, va bu bo'lishi mumkin." U kuldi: "Siz ishqibozlarga nisbatan juda shafqatsizsiz, ulardan faqat yomon oqibatni xohlaysiz;233 lekin sizga itoat etish uchun, men ularning barchasi bir xil darajada yomon bo'lgan, ularning sevgisidan cheklangan holda, ularning hamma narsasidan zavq olgan uch kishi haqida hikoya aytib beraman." Shunday qilib, u boshladi: "Yosh xonimlar, siz ham ko'pincha g'azabni nazorat qilishingiz kerak, lekin bu bizning xalqimiz uchun ham...

en: other- what than a sudden and unconsidered emotion, aroused by an affront suffered, and which, banishing all reason and overclouding the eyes of the understanding with darkness, kindleth the soul to the hottest fury.
uz: boshqa - to'satdan va o'ylanmagan hissiyotdan boshqa narsa, azob chekkan haqorat tomonidan uyg'onilgan va barcha aqlni haydab, tushunishning ko'zlarini zulmat bilan qoplagan holda, ruhni eng qaynoq g'azabga yo'naltiradigan.

en: And al- though this often cometh to pass in men and more in one than in another, yet hath it been seen aforetime to work greater mischiefs in women, for that it is lightlier enkindled in these latter and burneth in them with a ﬁercer ﬂame and urgeth them with less restraint.
uz: Va garchi bu ko'pincha erkaklarda va birida boshqalarda ko'proq sodir bo'lsa-da, ammo avvalroq ayollarda katta yomonliklar qilish ko'rindi, chunki u oxirgilarda yengilroq yoqiladi va ularda yanada shiddatli olov bilan yonadi va ularni kamroq tiyish bilan majburlaydi.

en: Nor is this to be marvelled at, for
uz: Na bunga hayron bo'lish kerak, chunki

en: that, an we choose to consider, we may see that ﬁre, of its nature, catcheth quicklier to light and delicate things than to those which are denser and more ponderous; and we women, indeed —let men not take it ill —are more delicately fashioned than they and far more mobile.
uz: Shuni ko'rib chiqsak, o'z tabiatiga ko'ra olov zichroq va og'irroq narsalarga qaraganda yengil va nozik narsalarga tezroq yetib borishini ko'rishimiz mumkin; va biz ayollar, haqiqatan ham erkaklar uni yomon qabul qilmasinlar, ulardan ko'ra nozikroq va ancha harakatchanroqdir.

en: Wherefore, seeing that we are naturally inclined thereunto234 and considering after how our mansu- etude and our loving kindness are of repose and pleasance to the men with whom we have to do and how big with harm and peril are anger and fury, I purpose, to the intent that we may with a more steadfast mind keep ourselves from these latter, to show you by my story how the loves of three young men and as many ladies came, as I said before, to an ill end, becom- ing, through the ire of one of the latter, from happy most unhappy.
uz: Shuning uchun, biz tabiiy ravishda bunga moyil ekanligimizni ko'rib,234 va bizning insonparvarligimiz va mehr-muhabbatimiz bilan munosabatda bo'lishimiz kerak bo'lgan erkaklarga qanday tinchlik va mamnuniyat berishini, g'azab va g'azabning qanchalik katta zarari va xavfi borligini hisobga olgan holda, men o'zimning hikoyam orqali uchta yosh yigitning va ko'plab ayollarning muhabbatlari qanday qilib, avval aytganimdek, baxtsizlardan birining g'azabi orqali yomon natijaga olib kelganini ko'rsatmoqchiman.

en: Marseilles is, as you know, a very ancient and noble city, situate in Provence on the seashore, and was once more abounding in rich and great merchants than it is nowadays.
uz: Marsel, sizga ma'lumki, Provansda, dengiz sohilida joylashgan juda qadimiy va olijanob shahar bo'lib, bir vaqtlar hozirgidan ko'ra boy va buyuk savdogarlar bilan to'la edi.

en: Among the latter was one called Narnald Cluada, a man of mean extraction, but of renowned good faith and a loyal merchant, rich beyond measure in lands and monies, who had by a wife of his several children, whereof the three eldest were daughters.
uz: Oxirgisi orasida Narnald Cluada deb nomlangan odam bor edi. U o'rtacha kelib chiqishga ega, ammo yaxshi niyatli va sadoqatli savdogar edi, yer va boylikda cheksiz boy edi. Uning bir nechta farzandlari bor edi, ularning eng kattalari uchta qizi edi.

en: Two of these latter, born at a birth, were ﬁfteen and the third fourteen years old, nor was aught awaited by their kinsfolk to marry them but the return of Narnald, who was gone into Spain with his merchandise.
uz: Ularning ikkitasi tug'ilganda o'n besh yoshda edi, uchinchisi esa o'n to'rt yoshda edi. Ularning qarindoshlari ularga turmushga chiqish uchun Narnaldning Ispaniyaga o'z tovarlari bilan borganidan boshqa hech narsa kutishmagan edi.

en: The names of the two elder were the one Ninetta and the other Maddalena and the third called Bertella.
uz: Ikki oqsoqolning ismlari biri Ninetta, ikkinchisi Maddalena va uchinchisi Bertella edi.

en: Of Ninetta a young man of gentle birth, though poor, called Restagnone, was enamoured as much as man might be, and she of him, and they had contrived to do on such wise that, without any knowing it, they had enjoy- ment of their loves.
uz: Ninetta'dan kambag'al bo'lsa ham, yumshoq tug'ilgan bir yigit, Restagnone deb atalgan, odamga va unga imkon qadar oshiq edi va ular shunchalik donolik bilan ish tutishni o'ylab topdilarki, hech kim bilmasdan, o'z sevgilaridan rohatlanishdi.

en: They had already a pretty while enjoyed this satisfaction when it chanced that two young companions, named the one Folco and the other Ughetto, whose fathers were dead, leaving them very rich, fell in love, the one with Maddalena and the other with Bertella.
uz: Ular allaqachon ancha vaqt davomida shu qoniqishdan bahramand bo'lishgan edi, shunda bir vaqtning o'zida ikkita yosh hamroh, biri Folko, ikkinchisi Ughetto deb nomlangan, otasi o'lgan va ularni juda boy qoldirgan, biri Maddalena, ikkinchisi Bertella bilan sevib qolishdi.

en: Restagnone, noting this (it having been shown him of Ninetta), bethought himself that he might make shift to supply his own lack by means of the newcomers’ love.
uz: Restagnone, buni qayd etib (uning Ninetta haqida ko'rsatilganini), yangi kelganlarning muhabbati orqali o'z kamchiligini ta'minlash uchun o'zgarish qilishi mumkinligini o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, he clapped up an acquaintance with them, so that now one, now the other of them accompanied him to visit their mistresses and his; and when him- seemed he was grown privy enough with them and much their friend, he called them one day into his house and said to them, ‘Dearest youths, our commerce should have certiﬁed you how great is the love I bear you and that I would do for you that which I would do for myself; and for that I love
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u ular bilan tanishuvni boshladi, shunda endi ulardan biri, endi ikkinchisi unga malikalari va o'zinikiga tashrif buyurishga hamroh bo'ldi; va u bilan yetarlicha tanish bo'lib qolgan va ularning do'stidek tuyulgach, bir kuni ularni uyiga chaqirib dedi va ularga dedi: "Azizimli yoshlar, bizning tijoratimiz sizga bo'lgan muhabbatim naqadar buyuk ekanligini va men siz uchun o'zim uchun nima qilsam bo'lishini tasdiqlashi kerak edi; va shuning uchun men...

en: you greatly, I purpose to discover to you that which hath occurred to my mind, and you and I together will after take such counsel thereof as shall seem to you best.
uz: Sizni juda katta xursand qilaman, xayolimga kelgan narsani sizga ma'lum qilishni niyat qilaman va siz bilan men keyinchalik siz uchun eng yaxshi ko'ringan maslahatni qabul qilamiz.

en: You, an your words lie not and for that to boot which me- seemeth I have apprehended by your deeds, both daily and nightly, burn with an exceeding passion for the two young ladies beloved of you, as do I for the third their sister; and to this ardour, an you will consent thereunto,235 my heart giveth me to ﬁnd a very sweet and pleasing remedy, the which is as follows.
uz: Sen, sening so'zlaring yolg'on emas va men seni qo'lga olish uchun emas, balki sening ishlaringdan, har kuni ham, kechasi ham, seni sevgan ikki yosh xonimga nisbatan haddan tashqari ishtiyoq bilan yonaman, xuddi ularning uchinchi singlisiga nisbatan ham; va bu ishtiyoqga, sen bunga rozi bo'lasan, 235 mening qalbim menga juda shirin va yoqimli davo topishga imkon beradi, u quyidagicha.

en: You are both very rich, which I am not; now, if you will agree to bring your riches into a common stock, making me a third sharer with you therein, and determine in which part of the world we shall go lead a merry life with our mistresses, my heart warranteth me I can without fail so do that the three sisters, with a great part of their father’s good, will go with, us whithersoever we shall please, and there, each with his wench, like three brothers, we may live the happiest lives of any men in the world.
uz: Siz ikkalangiz ham juda boysiz, men esa emasman; endi, agar siz o'z boyligingizni umumiy aksiyaga olib kirish, meni u bilan uchinchi bo'lishga rozi bo'lsangiz va dunyoning qaysi qismida bekalarimiz bilan quvnoq hayot kechirishni aniqlasangiz, mening qalbim ishonch bilan aytadi, men buni albatta qila olaman, shunda uch opa-singil, otasining yaxshiligining katta qismi bilan, biz bilan qayerga xohlasak, u yerga boradi va u yerda, har biri o'z kelinlari bilan, uch aka-uka kabi, dunyodagi eng baxtli hayot kechirishimiz mumkin.

en: It resteth with you now to determine whether you will go about to solace yourself in this or leave it be.’ The two young men, who were beyond measure inﬂamed, hearing that they were to have their lasses, were not long in making up their minds, but answered that, so this236 should ensue, they were ready to do as he said.
uz: Endi bu ishda o'zingizni ovutmoqchimisiz yoki qo'yib yubormoqchimisiz, buni hal qilish sizning zimmangizda qoladi." Ikkita yigit, o'zlarining qizg'inliklari borligini eshitib, haddan tashqari jahli chiqqan holda, uzoq o'ylashmadi, lekin javob berishdi: "Shunday bo'lishi kerakki, bu236, ular uning aytganidek qilishga tayyor edilar".

en: Restagnone, having gotten this answer from the young men, found means a few days after to foregather with Ninetta, to whom he could not come without great unease, and after he had abidden with her awhile, he told her what he had proposed to the others and with many arguments studied to commend the emprise to her.
uz: Restagnone, yigitlardan bu javobni olgach, bir necha kundan keyin Ninetta bilan uchrashishni aniqladi, u yerga katta tashvishsiz kelolmasdi va u bilan bir oz vaqt yashiringanidan so'ng, unga boshqalarga nima taklif qilganini aytdi va unga tajribani maqtash uchun ko'plab dalillar bilan o'rganildi.

en: This was little uneath to him, seeing that she was yet more desirous than himself to be with him without suspect; where- fore she answered him frankly that it liked her well and that her sisters would do whatever she wished, especially in this, and bade him make ready everything needful therefor as quickliest he might.
uz: Bu unga unchalik yoqmas edi, chunki u o'zidan ham ko'ra shubha qilmasdan u bilan birga bo'lishga ko'proq ishtiyoqli edi; lekin u unga ochiqchasiga javob berdi: bu unga yoqadi va uning opa-singillari o'zi xohlagan narsani qilishadi, ayniqsa bu borada, va undan buning uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani imkon qadar tezroq tayyorlashni so'radi.

en: Restagnone accordingly returned to the two young men, who still importuned him amain to do that whereof he had bespoken them, and told them that, so far as concerned their mistresses, the matter was settled.
uz: Restagnone shunga ko'ra ikki yigitga qaytib keldi, ular uni u buyurgan ishni qilishga hali ham bezovta qilishardi va ularga malikalariga kelsak, masala hal bo'lganini aytishdi.

en: Then, having determined among them- selves to go to Crete, they sold certain lands they had, under colour of meaning to go a-trading with the price, and having made money of all their other goods, bought a light brigantine and secretly equipped it to the utmost advantage.
uz: Keyin, o'zaro qat'iyat bilan Kritga borishga qaror qilib, ular ma'no rangida o'zlarining ayrim yerlarini sotib, narx bilan savdo qilishdi va qolgan barcha tovarlaridan pul topib, yengil brigantin sotib olishdi va uni maxfiy ravishda maksimal darajada jihozlashdi.

en: Meanwhile, Ninetta, who well enough knew her sisters’ mind, with soft words inﬂamed them with such a liking for the venture that themseemed
uz: Ayni paytda, Ninetta, singillarining fikrini yaxshi bilgan holda, ularni yumshoq so'zlar bilan shunday ishtiyoq bilan qo'zg'atdiki, ular...

en: they might not live to see the thing accomplished.
uz: Ular bu ishni amalga oshirilganini ko'rish uchun yashamasliklari mumkin.

en: Accordingly, the night come when they were to go aboard the brigantine, the three sisters opened a great coffer of their father’s and taking thence a vast quantity of money and jewels, stole out of the house, according to the given order.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular brigantin kemasiga chiqishlari kerak bo'lgan tun keldi va uch opa-singil otasining katta sandig'ini ochib, u yerdan juda ko'p pul va javohirlarni olib, berilgan buyruq bo'yicha uydan o'g'irlab ketishdi.

en: They found their gallants awaiting them and going straightway all aboard the brigantine, they thrust the oars into the water and put out to sea nor rested till they came, on the following evening, to Genoa, where the new lovers for the ﬁrst time took ease and joyance of their loves.
uz: Ular o'zlarining zodagonlari ularni kutib turganini topdilar va darhol brigantin kemasiga o'tirdilar, kamonlarni suvga uloqtirishdi va dengizga chiqishdi. Ertasi kuni kechqurun Genuyaga kelishguncha dam olishmadi, u yerda yangi oshiqlar birinchi marta o'z sevgilaridan xotirjamlik va quvonch olishdi.

en: There having refreshed them- selves with that whereof they had need, they set out again and sailing from port to port, came, ere it was the eighth day, without any hindrance, to Crete, where they bought great and goodly estates near Candia and made them very handsome and delightsome dwelling-houses thereon.
uz: U yerda ularga kerak bo'lgan narsalar bilan tetiklantirib, ular yana jo'nab ketishdi va portdan portga suzib, sakkizinchi kun bo'lgandan so'ng, hech qanday to'siqlarsiz Kritga kelishdi. U yerda ular Candia yaqinidagi katta va yaxshi yerlarni sotib olishdi va ularga juda chiroyli va yoqimli turar joylar berishdi.

en: Here they fell to living like lords and passed their days in banquets and joyance and merrymaking, the happiest men in the world, they and their mistresses, with great plenty of servants and hounds and hawks and horses.
uz: Bu yerda ular xo'jayinlar kabi yashashga tushishdi va kunlarini ziyofatlarda, xursandchilik va xursandchilikda o'tkazishdi, dunyodagi eng baxtli odamlar, ular va ularning bekasi, juda ko'p xizmatkorlar, itlar, so'rg'ichlar va otlar bilan.

en: Abiding on this wise, it befell (even as we see it happen all day long that, how much soever things may please, they grow irksome, an one have over- great plenty thereof) that Restagnone, who had much loved Ninetta, being now able to have her at his every pleasure, without let or hindrance, began to weary of her, and consequently his love for her began to wane.
uz: Shu hikmatga amal qilib, shunday bo'ldiki (shuningdek, kun bo'yi ko'ryapmizki, har qanday narsa qanchalik yoqmasa ham, u g'alati bo'lib qoladi, birida juda ko'p narsa bo'lsa ham), Ninettaga juda ko'p muhabbat qo'ygan Restagnone, endi uni har qanday xohishida, hech qanday qo'l qo'ymasdan yoki to'sqinliksiz bo'lishiga qodir bo'lib, undan charchaya boshladi va natijada unga bo'lgan muhabbati so'na boshladi.

en: Having seen at entertainment a damsel of the country, a fair and noble young lady, who pleased him exceedingly, he fell to courting her with all his might, giv- ing marvellous entertainments in her honor and plying her with all manner gallantries; which Ninetta coming to know, she fell into such a jealousy that he could not go a step but she heard of it and after harassed both him and herself with words and reproaches on account thereof.
uz: Ko'ngilochar tadbirda qishloqning bir xonimini ko'rib, uni juda ham xursand qilgan go'zal va olijanob yosh xonimni ko'rib, u uni butun kuchini sarflab, uning sharafiga ajoyib ko'ngilochar tadbirlar o'tkazdi va unga har xil saxiylik ko'rsatdi; buni bilgach, Ninetta shunchalik rashk qildi, bir qadam ham yurolmadi, lekin u bu haqda eshitdi va keyin uni ham, o'zini ham so'zlar va malomatlar bilan bezovta qildi.

en: But, like as over- abundance of aught begetteth weariness, even so doth the denial of a thing desired redouble the appetite; accordingly, Ninetta’s reproaches did but fan the ﬂame of Restagnone’s new love and in process of time it came to pass that, whether he had the favours of the lady he loved or not, Ninetta held it for certain, whoever it was reported it to her; wherefore she fell into such a passion of grief and thence passed into such a ﬁt of rage and despite that the love which she bore Restagnone was changed to bitter hatred, and blinded by her wrath, she bethought herself to avenge, by his death, the affront which herseemed she had received.
uz: Ammo, xuddi nimaning ko'pligi charchoqni keltirib chiqarganidek, xohlagan narsadan voz kechish ham ishtahani kuchaytiradi; shunga ko'ra, Ninetta'ning tanbehlari Restagnone'ning yangi muhabbatining olovini yoqtirdi va vaqt o'tishi bilan, u sevgan xonimning afzalliklari bor-yo'qligiga qaramay, Ninetta buni aniq ushladi, kimga xabar berilsa ham; shuning uchun u bunday qayg'uga botdi va keyin shunday g'azabga aylandi va garchi u achchiq Restagnone'ga bergan muhabbat nafratga aylanib, uning g'azabi bilan ko'r bo'lsa ham, u o'zini uning o'limi bilan qasos olishga o'yladi, o'zi olgan haqoratni.

en: Accordingly, betaking herself to an old Greek woman, a past mistress in the art of compounding poisons, she induced her with gifts and promises to
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'zini eski yunon ayoliga, zaharlarni aralashtirish san'atidagi sobiq bekasiga o'xshab, u uni sovg'alar va va'dalar bilan yo'naltirdi.

en: make her a death-dealing water, which she, without considering farther, gave Restagnone one evening to drink he being heated and misdoubting him not thereof; and such was the potency of the poison that, ere morning came, it had slain him.
uz: Unga o'limga olib keladigan suvni tayyorlang, uni hech qayerga o'ylamasdan, bir kechasi Restagnonega ichish uchun berdi, u qizg'in edi va undan shubhalanmas edi; va zaharning kuchi shunday ediki, ertalab kelmasidan oldin uni o'ldirgan edi.

en: Folco and Ughetto and their mistresses, hearing of his death and knowing not of what poison he had died,237 bewept him bit- terly, together with Ninetta, and caused bury him honourably.
uz: Folco va Ughetto va ularning bekasi uning o'limini eshitib, qanday zahardan o'lganini bilmay, 237 uni Ninetta bilan birga qattiq larzaga keltirdilar va uni hurmat bilan dafn etishga majbur qildilar.

en: But not many days after it chanced that the old woman, who had compounded the poisoned water for Ninetta, was taken for some other misdeed and being put to the torture, confessed to this amongst her other crimes, fully declaring that which had betided by reason thereof; whereupon the Duke of Crete, without saying aught of the matter, beset Folco’s palace by surprise one night and without any noise or gainsayal, carried off Ninetta prisoner, from whom, without putting her to the torture, he readily got what he would know of the death of Restagnone.
uz: Ammo shundan ko'p kun o'tmay, Ninetta uchun zaharli suvni to'ldirgan kampir boshqa bir ish uchun olib ketilishi va qiynoqqa solinishi, boshqa jinoyatlari orasida buni tan olishi, shu sababli o'ziga kelganini to'liq e'lon qilishi va shundan so'ng, Krit gersogi hech narsa demasdan, bir kecha kutilmaganda Folko saroyini o'rab olib, hech qanday shovqin yoki ishoralarsiz Ninetta mahbusini olib ketdi. Undan uni qiynoqqa solmasdan, u Restagnone o'limi haqida bilmoqchi bo'lgan narsani tezda oldi.

en: Folco and Ughetto (and from them their ladies) had privy notice from the duke why Ninetta had been taken, the which was exceeding grievous to them and they used their every endeavour to save her from the ﬁre, whereto they doubted not she would be condemned, as indeed she richly deserved; but all seemed vain, for that the duke abode ﬁrm in willing to do justice upon her.
uz: Folko va Ughetto (va ulardan ularning xonimlari) Ninetta nega olib ketilganligi haqida gersogdan xabardor bo'lishdi, bu ularga juda og'ir edi va ular uni olovdan qutqarish uchun bor kuchlarini sarflashdi. Ular uning boylik bilan loyiq bo'lgani kabi hukm qilinishiga shubha qilmas edilar; lekin hamma narsa behuda ko'rinardi, chunki gersog unga nisbatan adolat qilishga qat'iy tayyor edi.

en: However, Maddalena, who was a beautiful young woman and had long been courted by the duke, but had never yet consented to do aught that might pleasure him, thinking that, by complying with his wishes, she might avail to save her sister from the ﬁre, signiﬁed to him by a trusty messenger that she was at his commandment in everything, provided two things should ensue thereof, to wit, that she should have her sister again safe and sound and that the thing should be secret.
uz: Biroq, Maddalena, go'zal yosh ayol edi va uzoq vaqtdan beri gersog tomonidan erka qilingan, lekin unga yoqadigan hech narsa qilishga hali rozi bo'lmagan, uning istaklariga ko'ra, singlisini olovdan qutqarishga qodir bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylagan holda, unga ishonchli elchi orqali uning hamma narsada uning buyrug'iga bo'lganligini bildirdi, agar bundan ikki narsa kelib chiqsa, ya'ni uning singlisining yana xavfsiz va sog'lom bo'lishi va bu narsa maxfiy bo'lishi kerak.

en: Her message pleased the duke, and after long debate with himself if he should do as she proposed, he ultimately agreed thereto and said that he was ready.
uz: Uning xabari gersogga yoqdi va u o'zi bilan uzoq munozaralardan so'ng, u uning taklifini bajarishi kerakmi yoki yo'qmi, u oxir-oqibat bunga rozi bo'ldi va tayyor ekanligini aytdi.

en: Accordingly, one night, having, with the lady’s consent, caused detain Folco and Ughetto, as he would fain examine them of the matter, he went secretly to couch with Maddalena and having ﬁrst made a show of putting Ninetta in a sack and of purposing to let sink her that night in the sea, he carried her with him to her sister, to whom on the morrow he delivered her at parting, in payment of the night he had passed with her, praying her that this,238 which had been the ﬁrst of their loves, might not be the last and charging her send the guilty lady away, lest blame betide himself and it behove him anew proceed against her with rigour.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir kecha, xonimning roziligi bilan Folko va Ugettoni hibsga oldirib, ularni bu masalani o'rganishga majbur qilganidan so'ng, u Maddalena bilan yashirincha yotishga kirdi va avval Ninettani xaltaga solib, o'sha kecha uni dengizga botirishni maqsad qilganidan so'ng, uni o'zi bilan singlisiga olib bordi. Ertasi kuni u bilan ajrashganda uni unga topshirdi, u bilan o'tkazgan tun evaziga, unga duo qilib, bu, ularning birinchi muhabbati bo'lgan narsa, oxirgisi bo'lmasligi kerak edi va uni aybdor xonimni yuborishga majbur qildi, aks holda u o'zini aybladi va bu uni yana bir bor qayg'urishtirdi.

en: Next morning, Folco and Ughetto, having heard that Ninetta had been sacked overnight and believing it, were released and returned home to com- fort their mistresses for the death of their sister.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Folco va Ughetto, Ninetta bir kechada ishdan bo'shatilganini eshitib va bunga ishonib, ozod etildi va singlisining o'limi uchun bekasini tinchlantirish uchun uyga qaytdilar.

en: However, for all Maddalena could do to hide her, Folco soon became aware of Ninetta’s presence in the palace, whereat he marvelled exceedingly and suddenly waxing suspi- cious —for that he had heard of the duke’s passion for Maddalena —asked the latter how her sister came to be there.
uz: Biroq, Maddalena uni yashirish uchun nima qila olsa ham, Folko tez orada Ninettaning saroyda borligini angladi, u nihoyatda hayratda qoldi va to'satdan shubha bilan  chunki u gersogning Maddalenaga bo'lgan ishtiyoqi haqida eshitgan edi  u yerda uning singlisi qanday paydo bo'lganini so'radi.

en: Maddalena began a long story, which she had devised to account to him therefor, but was little believed of her lover, who was shrewd and constrained her to confess the truth, which, after long parley, she told him.
uz: Maddalena uzoq hikoya boshladi, uni unga tushuntirish uchun o'ylab topgan edi, lekin uning sevgilisiga unchalik ishonishmadi, u aqlli edi va uni haqiqatni tan olishga majbur qildi, buni uzoq suhbatdan so'ng u unga aytdi.

en: Folco, overcome with chagrin and inﬂamed with rage, pulled out a sword and slew her, whilst she in vain besought mercy; then, fearing the wrath and justice of the duke, he left her dead in the chamber and repairing whereas Ninetta was, said to her, with a feigned air of cheerfulness, ‘Quick, let us begone whither it hath been appointed of thy sister that I shall carry thee, so thou mayst not fall again into the hands of the duke.’ Ninetta, believing this and eager, in her fearfulness, to begone, set out with Folco, it being now night, without seeking to take leave of her sister; whereupon he and she, with such monies (which were but few) as he could lay hands on, betook themselves to the seashore and embarked on board a vessel; nor was it ever known whither they went.
uz: Folko g'azabdan g'azablanib, g'azabdan jahli chiqib, qilichini chiqarib, uni o'ldirdi, u behuda rahm-shafqat so'ragan edi; keyin, g'azab va shahzodaning adolatidan qo'rqib, uni xonada o'lik holda qoldirdi va ta'mirladi, ammo Ninetta unga o'ziga xos quvnoqlik bilan dedi: "Tezroq, singlingdan tayinlangan joyga boraylik, seni olib ketaylik, shunda sen yana shahzoda qo'liga tushib qolmaysan". Ninetta, bunga ishonib va qo'rqib, endi tun bo'lganda, singlisidan ketishga intilib, Folco bilan yo'lga chiqdi; keyin u va u, qo'llari yetib borishi mumkin bo'lgan, ammo bir necha kishi bilan birga dengizga tushdi va hech qachon

en: On the morrow, Maddalena being found murdered, there were some who, of the envy and hatred they bore to Ughetto, forthright gave notice thereof to the duke, whereupon the latter, who loved Maddalena exceedingly, ran furiously to the house and seizing Ughetto and his lady, who as yet knew nothing of the matter —to wit, of the departure of Folco and Ninetta —con- strained them to confess themselves guilty, together with Folco, of his mis- tress’s death.
uz: Ertasi kuni, Maddalena o'ldirilgan holda topilganda, Ugettoga bo'lgan hasad va nafratdan darhol gersogga xabar berganlar bor edi. Shunda, Maddalena'ni juda yaxshi ko'rgan oxirgi g'azablanib uyga yugurib, Ughetto va uning xotiniga bostirib kirdi, ular hali hech narsa bilishmas edi  masalan, Folco va Ninettaning ketishi  ularni Folco bilan birga o'zlarining o'limida aybdor ekanligini tan olishga majbur qildi.

en: They, apprehending with reason death in consequence of this confession, with great pains corrupted those who had them in keeping, giv- ing them a certain sum of money, which they kept hidden in their house against urgent occasions, and embarking with their guards, without having leisure to take any of their goods, ﬂed by night to Rhodes, where they lived no great while after in poverty and distress.
uz: Ular, bu e'tirof natijasida oqilona o'limni qo'lga olib, ularni saqlab qolganlarni katta azoblar bilan buzdilar, ularga zarur vaziyatlar tufayli uylarida yashirib qo'ygan ma'lum miqdordagi pulni berishdi va qo'riqchilari bilan birga bordilar, hech qanday mol-mulklarini olishga vaqti bo'lmay, kechasi Rodosga qochib ketishdi, u yerda kambag'allik va azobda yashadilar.

en: To such a pass, then, did Restagnone’s mad love and Ninetta’s rage bring themselves and others.”
uz: Shunday o'tishga Restagnonening telbalik muhabbati va Ninettaning jahli o'zini ham, boshqalarni ham olib keldi.

en: THE FOURTH STORY Gerbino, against the plighted faith of his grandfather, King Guglielmo of Sicily, attacketh a ship of the King of Tunis, to carry off a daughter of his, who being put to death of those on board, he slayeth these latter and is after himself beheaded.
uz: TO'RTINCHI HIKOY Gerbino, bobosining, Sitsiliya qiroli Guglielmo'ning azob chekkan e'tiqodiga qarshi, Tunis qiroli kemasiga hujum qilib, uning qizini olib ketadi. U bortdagilarning o'limiga uchragan, keyin bularning o'zini o'ldiradi va keyin o'zi boshini kesib tashlaydi.

en: Lauretta, having made an end of her story, was silent, whilst the company bewailed the illhap of the lovers, some blaming Ninetta’s anger and one saying one thing and another another, till presently the king, raising his head, as if aroused from deep thought, signed to Elisa to follow on; whereupon she began modestly, “Charming ladies, there are many who be- lieve that Love launcheth his shafts only when enkindled of the eyes and make mock of those who hold that one may fall in love by hearsay; but that these are mistaken will very manifestly appear in a story that I purpose to relate, wherein you will see that report not only wrought this, without the lovers having ever set eyes on each other, but it will be made manifest to you that it brought both the one and the other to a miserable death.
uz: Lauretta o'z hikoyasini tugatgach, sukut saqladi, shundan so'ng kompaniya oshiqlarning g'azabini kutayotgan edi, ba'zilar Ninettaning g'azabini ayblab, bir narsa va yana bir narsa deyishardi, toki yaqin orada shoh, boshini ko'tarib, go'yo chuqur o'ylardan uyg'ongan holda, Elisaga qo'l qo'ydi va davom ettirdi; shundan so'ng u kamtarona boshladi: "Joyli xonimlar, ko'pchilik sevgi o'z vallarini faqat ko'zlaridan ko'tarilganda uloqtiradi va bir kishini g'iybat bilan sevib qolishi mumkin deb o'ylaganlarni masxara qiladi; lekin bu xatolar men aytmoqchi bo'lgan hikoyada juda yaqqol paydo bo'ladi, unda siz nafaqat bu xabarni, balki oshiqlar bir-biriga ko'zi bilan ko'rmasdan, balki bir-birini ham o'ldirib qo'yishi kerakligini ko'rasizingizga ko'rsatadi.

en: Guglielmo, the Second, King of Sicily, had (as the Sicilians pretend) two children, a son called Ruggieri and a daughter called Costanza.
uz: Guglielmo II, Sitsiliya qiroli, (Sitsiliyaliklar da'vo qilganidek) ikki farzandi bor edi: Ruggieri ismli o'g'il va Costanza ismli qizi.

en: The former, dying before his father, left a son named Gerbino, who was diligently reared by his grandfather and became a very goodly youth and a renowned for prowess and courtesy.
uz: Birinchisi otasidan oldin vafot etib, Gerbino ismli o'g'lini qoldirdi. U bobosi tomonidan astoydil tarbiyalangan va juda yaxshi yosh, mahorat va odob-axloq bilan mashhur bo'lgan odamga aylandi.

en: Nor did his fame abide conﬁned within the limits of Sicily, but, resounding in various parts of the world, was nowhere more glorious than in Barbary, which in those days was tributary to the King of Sicily.
uz: Uning shuhrati Sitsiliya chegaralarida qolmadi ham, lekin dunyoning turli qismlarida tarqalgan holda, o'sha davrda Sitsiliya qiroliga hurmat bajo keltirilgan Barbaridagina ulug'vorroq joy yo'q edi.

en: Amongst the rest to whose ears came the magniﬁcent fame of Gerbino’s valour and courtesy was a daughter of the King of Tunis, who, according to the report of all who had seen her, was one of the fairest creatures ever fashioned by nature and the best bred and of a noble and
uz: Gerbinoning jasorat va odob-axloqining ajoyib shuhrati qulog'iga yetib kelgan qolganlar orasida Tunis qirolining qizi ham bor edi. Uni ko'rganlarning barchasining rivoyatiga ko'ra, u tabiat tomonidan yaratilgan eng go'zal mavjudotlardan biri va eng yaxshi zotdor va olijanob edi.

en: She, delighting to hear tell of men of valour, with such goodwill received the tales recounted by one and another of the deeds valiantly done of Gerbino and they so pleased her that, picturing to herself the prince’s fashion, she became ardently enamoured of him and discoursed more will- ingly of him than of any other and hearkened to whoso spoke of him.
uz: U jasur odamlarning hikoyalarini eshitishdan xursand bo'lib, Gerbinning jasorat bilan qilgan ishlari haqidagi hikoyalarni bir-birining o'zidan yaxshi niyat bilan qabul qildi va bu unga shunchalik yoqdi, shahzoda uslubini o'ziga tasavvur qilib, u unga juda oshiq bo'ldi va u haqida boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq gapirdi va u haqida gapirganlarga quloq tutdi.

en: On the other hand, the great renown of her beauty and worth had won to Sicily, as elsewhither, and not without great delight nor in vain had it reached the ears of Gerbino; nay, it had inﬂamed him with love of her, no less than that which she herself had conceived for him.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, uning go'zalligi va qadr-qimmatining buyuk shuhrati Sitsiliyaga ham boshqa joylarda bo'lgani kabi yetib kelgan edi va bu Gerbinning qulog'iga bejizga yoki bejizga yetib bormagan edi; aksincha, u uni o'zi uchun o'ylab topganidan kam bo'lmagan darajada, unga bo'lgan muhabbat bilan qo'zg'atgan edi.

en: Wherefore, desiring beyond measure to see her, against he should ﬁnd a colourable occasion of having his grandfather’s leave to go to Tunis, he charged his every friend who went thither to make known to her, as best he might, his secret and great love and bring him news of her.
uz: Shuning uchun, uni ko'rishni haddan tashqari istab, bobosining Tunisga borishga ruxsat berishining ajoyib imkoniyatini topmasligi uchun, u yerga borgan har bir do'stini unga o'z sirini va buyuk muhabbatini imkon qadar oshkor qilishga va undan xabar olib kelishga buyurdi.

en: This was very dexterously done by one of them, who, under pretence of carrying her women’s trinkets to view, as do merchants, throughly discovered Gerbino’s passion to her and avouched the prince and all that was his to be at her commandment.
uz: Buni ulardan biri juda mohirona qildi. U, savdogarlar kabi, ayollarining mayda-chuyda narsalarini ko'rsatish uchun olib yurish niyatida, Gerbinning unga bo'lgan ishtiyoqini aniqladi va shahzoda va uning buyrug'iga bo'ysunadigan hamma narsani unga berdi.

en: The princess received the messenger and the message with a glad ﬂavour and answering that she burnt with like love for the prince, sent him one of her most precious jewels in token thereof.
uz: Malika elchini va xabarni xursandchilik bilan qabul qildi va shahzodaga bo'lgan muhabbati bilan yonib ketganini javob berib, unga eng qimmatbaho javohirlaridan birini shunga o'xshab yubordi.

en: This Gerbino received with the ut- most joy wherewith one can receive whatsoever precious thing and wrote to her once and again by the same messenger, sending her the most costly gifts and holding certain treaties239 with her, whereby they should have seen and touched one another, had fortune but allowed it.
uz: Bu Gerbinoni har qanday qimmatbaho narsani olish mumkin bo'lgan eng katta quvonch bilan qabul qildi va unga bir xil elchi tomonidan qayta-qayta yozdi, unga eng qimmatbaho sovg'alarni yubordi va u bilan birga ba'zi shartnomalarni ushlab turdi. 239 Ular bir-birini ko'rishlari va tegishlari kerak edi, boylik bor edi, lekin bunga ruxsat berdi.

en: But, things going thus and somewhat farther than was expedient, the young lady on the one hand and Gerbino on the other burning with desire, it befell that the King of Tunis gave her in marriage to the King of Granada, whereat she was beyond measure chagrined, bethinking herself that not only should she be separated from her lover by long distance, but was like to be altogether parted from him; and had she seen a means thereto, she would gladly, so this might not betide, have ﬂed from her father and be- taken herself to Gerbino.
uz: Ammo, ishlar shunday ketayotganda va maqsadga muvofiq bo'lmaganidan biroz uzoqroqqa, bir tomondan yosh xonim va boshqa tomondan Gerbino ishtiyoq bilan yonayotganda, Tunis qiroli uni Granada qiroliga turmushga bergan bo'ldi. Shunda u haddan tashqari g'azabda edi, o'zini nafaqat sevgilisidan uzoq masofagacha ajratilishi kerakligini, balki undan butunlay ajralgandek his qilardi; va agar u bunga bir yo'l ko'rgan bo'lsa, u xursand bo'lardi, chunki bu bejiz bo'lmas edi, otasidan qochib ketib, Gerbinoga olib ketilgan edi.

en: Gerbino, in like manner, hearing of this marriage, was beyond measure sorrowful therefor and often bethought himself to take her by force, if it should chance that she went to her husband by sea.
uz: Gerbino ham bu nikoh haqida eshitib, cheksiz qayg'uga botardi va ko'pincha uni kuch bilan olib ketishni o'ylardi, agar tasodifan eriga dengiz orqali borsa.

en: The King of Tunis, getting some inkling of Gerbino’s love and purpose and fear- ing his valour and prowess, sent to King Guglielmo, whenas the time came for despatching her to Granada, advising him of that which he was minded to do and that, having assurance from him that he should not be hindered
uz: Tunis qiroli Gerbinoning muhabbati, maqsadi va qo'rquvi haqida biroz tasavvurga ega bo'lib, o'z jasorati va mahoratiga ishonib, uni Granadaga jo'natish vaqti kelganda, qirol Gugeliermoga xabar yubordi. U unga nima qilishni o'ylayotganini va undan to'sqinlik qilmaslik kerakligiga ishonch hosil qilib, nima qilishni maslahat berdi.

en: therein by Gerbino or others, he purposed to do it.
uz: u yerda Gerbino yoki boshqalar tomonidan, u buni amalga oshirishni maqsad qilgan edi.

en: The King of Sicily, who was an old man and had heard nothing of Gerbino’s passion and con- sequently suspected not that it was for this that such an assurance was de- manded, freely granted it and in token thereof, sent the King of Tunis a glove of his.
uz: Sitsiliya qiroli, u keksa odam edi va Gerbinoning ehtirosidan hech narsa eshitmagan edi, shuning uchun ham bunday kafolat aynan shu sababli bekor qilingan deb gumon qilmagan, unga bemalol ruxsat bergan va buning ramzi sifatida Tunis qiroliga uning qo'lqog'ini yuborgan edi.

en: The latter, having gotten the desired assurance, caused equip a very great and goodly ship in the port of Carthage and furnish it with what was needful for those who were to sail therein and having ﬁtted and ad- orned it for the sending of his daughter into Granada, awaited nought but weather.
uz: Oxirgisi, kerakli kafolatni olganidan so'ng, Karfagen portida juda katta va yaxshi kemani jihozladi va u yerda suzib yuradiganlar uchun zarur bo'lgan narsalarni ta'minladi. Qizini Granadaga jo'natish uchun moslashtirib, ob-havo kutdi.

en: The young lady, who saw and knew all this, despatched one of her ser- vants secretly to Palermo, bidding him salute the gallant Gerbino on her part and tell him that she was to sail in a few days for Granada, wherefore it would now appear if he were as valiant a man as was said and if he loved her as much as he had sundry times declared to her.
uz: Yosh xonim, bularning hammasini ko'rib va bilgan holda, o'z xizmatkorlaridan birini yashirincha Palermoga jo'natib, unga o'z tomondan Gerbinoga salom aytishni va unga bir necha kundan keyin Granadaga suzib borishini aytishni buyurdi. Shuning uchun, u aytilganidek jasur odam bo'lsa va u uni turli marta aytganidek sevsa, endi ko'rinardi.

en: Her messenger did his errand excellent well and returned to Tunis, whilst Gerbino, hearing this and knowing that his grandfather had given the King of Tunis assurance, knew not what to do.
uz: Uning elchisi topshirig'ini a'lo darajada bajardi va Tunisga qaytib keldi, Gerbino esa buni eshitib, bobosi Tunis qiroliga ishonch berganini bilgach, nima qilishni bilmas edi.

en: However, urged by love and that he might not appear a craven, he betook himself to Messina, where he hastily armed two light galleys and manning them with men of approved valour, set sail with them for the coast of Sardinia, looking for the lady’s ship to pass there.
uz: Ammo, muhabbat ta'sirida va qo'rqoq ko'rinmasligi uchun, u Messinaga yo'l oldi, u yerda shoshilinch ravishda ikkita yengil galeriyani qurollantirdi va ularni ma'qullangan jasoratli odamlar bilan birga Sardiniya qirg'og'iga jo'natib, u yerdan o'tadigan xonimning kemasini qidirdi.

en: Nor was he far out in his reckoning, for he had been there but a few days when the ship hove in sight with a light wind not far from the place where he lay ex- pecting it.
uz: U o'z hisob-kitoblarida ham uzoqda emas edi, chunki u yerda bir necha kun edi, kema uning oldinda turgan joyiga yaqin joylashgan yengil shamol bilan ko'rinardi.

en: Gerbino, seeing this, said to his companions, ‘Gentlemen, an you be the men of mettle I take you for, methinketh there is none of you but hath either felt or feeleth love, without which, as I take it, no mortal can have aught of valour or worth in himself; and if you have been or are enamoured, it will be an easy thing to you to understand my desire.
uz: Gerbino buni ko'rib, o'z hamrohlariga dedi: "Janoblar, men sizlarni o'zimga oladigan erkaklardir, menimcha, sizlarning hech biringizda na his qilgan, na his qilgan muhabbat yo'qdir. Usiz, men o'ylagandek, hech bir o'lik o'zida hech qanday jasorat yoki qimmatga ega bo'la olmaydi; va agar siz oshiq bo'lgan bo'lsangiz yoki oshiq bo'lsangiz, mening xohishimni tushunishingiz oson bo'ladi."

en: I love and love hath moved me to give you this present pains; and she whom I love is in the ship which you see becalmed yonder and which, beside that thing which I most desire, is full of very great riches.
uz: Men sevaman va sevgi meni sizga bu hozirgi og'riqni berishga undadi; va men sevgan ayol u yerda tinch holda ko'rayotgan kemada va eng ko'p xohlagan narsamdan tashqari, juda katta boyliklarga to'la.

en: These latter, an ye be men of valour, we may with little difﬁculty acquire, ﬁghting manfully; of which victory I desire nothing to my share save one sole lady, for whose love I have taken up arms; everything else shall freely be yours.
uz: Bu oxirgilar, sizlar jasur odamlar bo'lsangiz, biz kam qiyinchilik bilan, erkaklarcha kurashib, erishishimiz mumkin; bu g'alabaning hech bir qismini men o'zimga bo'lishishni xohlamayman, faqat bitta xonimdan boshqa hech narsa, uning muhabbati uchun qurol oldim; qolgan hamma narsa bemalol sizniki bo'ladi.

en: Come, then, and let us right boldly assail the ship; God is favourable to our emprise and holdeth it here fast, without vouchsaﬁng it a breeze.’
uz: Xo'sh, kelinglar, kelinglar, kemani darhol jasorat bilan hujum qilaylik; Xudo bizning hukmronligimiz uchun mehribon va uni bu yerda mahkam ushlab turadi, hech qanday shamolsiz.

en: The gallant Gerbino had no need of many words, for that the Messinese, who were with him, being eager for plunder, were already disposed to do that unto which he exhorted them.
uz: Gerbinoning ko'p so'zlarga hojati yo'q edi, chunki u bilan birga bo'lgan va o'ljaga ishtiyoqli bo'lgan messinliklar, u ularni undagan ishni qilishga allaqachon tayyor edilar.

en: Wherefore, making a great outcry, at the end of his speech, that it should be so, they sounded the trumpets and catch- ing up their arms, thrust the oars into the water and made for the Tunis ship.
uz: Shuning uchun, uning nutqi oxirida shunday bo'lishi kerakligi haqida katta faryod qilib, ular karnay chalishdi va qo'llarini tutishdi, eshkaklarni suvga surib, Tunis kemasiga yo'l olishdi.

en: They who were aboard this latter, seeing the galleys coming afar off and be- ing unable to ﬂee,240 made ready for defence.
uz: Oxirgisi bortida bo'lganlar, olisdan kelayotgan va qochib qutula olmaydigan galereyalarni ko'rib, 240 ta mudofaa uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rdilar.

en: The gallant Gerbino accosting the ship, let command that the masters thereof should be sent on board the galleys, an they had no mind to ﬁght; but the Saracens, having certiﬁed themselves who they were and what they sought, declared themselves at- tacked of them against the faith plighted them by King Guglielmo; in token whereof they showed the latter’s glove, and altogether refused to surrender themselves, save for stress of battle, or to give them aught that was in the ship.
uz: Qahramon Gerbino kemani qo'llab-quvvatlab, uning xo'jayinlarini galereyalarga jo'natishni buyurdi, chunki ular jang qilishga unchalik xohish bildirmas edilar; lekin saracenlar o'zlarini kim ekanliklarini va nimani izlayotganliklarini tasdiqlab, qirol Gugeliermo tomonidan ularga duchor bo'lgan e'tiqodga qarshi qo'rqib chiqishni e'lon qilishdi; buning ramzi sifatida ular oxirgisining qo'lqog'ini ko'rsatdilar va umuman olganda o'zlarini taslim qilishdan bosh tortdilar, faqat jang zo'riqishidan tashqari, yoki ularga kemada bo'lgan narsani berishdan bosh tortdilar.

en: Gerbino, who saw the lady upon the poop, far fairer than he had pictured her to himself, and was more inﬂamed than ever, replied to the showing of the glove that there were no falcons there at that present and consequently there needed no gloves; wherefore, an they chose not to give up the lady, they must prepare to receive battle.
uz: Gerbino, xonimni axlat ustida ko'rgan, o'zi tasavvur qilganidan ancha go'zalroq va har qachongidan ham ko'proq yallig'langan edi, qo'lqopning ko'rsatmasiga javob berdi: o'sha paytda u yerda bolg'alar yo'q edi va shuning uchun qo'lqoplar kerak emas edi; shuning uchun, ular xonimni taslim qilmaslikni tanladilar, ular jangga tayyorlanishlari kerak edi.

en: Accordingly, without further parley, they fell to casting shafts and stones at one another, and on this wise they fought a great while, with loss on either side.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, keyingi bahslarsiz, ular bir-birlariga val va tosh otishga tushdilar va shu tariqa ikki tomondan mag'lubiyat bilan ancha vaqt jang qilishdi.

en: At last, Gerbino, seeing that he did little to the purpose, took a little vessel he had brought with him out of Sardinia and setting ﬁre therein, thrust it with both the galleys aboard the ship.
uz: Nihoyat, Gerbino o'zining maqsadga erishish uchun kam ish qilganini ko'rib, Sardiniyadan olib kelgan kichik bir kemani oldi va unga o't qo'ydi, uni kemaning ikkala galeri bilan birga itarib yubordi.

en: The Saracens, seeing this and knowing that they must of necessity sur- render or die, fetched the king’s daughter, who wept below, on deck and brought her to the ship’s prow; then, calling Gerbino, they butchered her before his eyes, what while she called for mercy and succour, and cast her into the sea, saying, ‘Take her; we give her to thee, such as we may and such as thine unfaith hath merited.’ Gerbino, seeing their barbarous deed, caused lay himself alongside the ship and recking not of shaft or stone, boarded it, as if courting death, in spite of those who were therein; then —even as a hungry lion, coming among a herd of oxen, slaughtereth now this, now that, and with teeth and claws sateth rather his fury than his hunger —sword in hand, hewing now at one, now at another, he cruelly slew many of the Saracens; after which, the ﬁre now waxing in the enkindled ship, he caused the
uz: Saracenlar buni ko'rib, albatta o'lishlari yoki o'lishlari kerakligini bilgach, podshohning qizini olib kelishdi. U deckda yig'lab, kemaning suzgichiga olib keldi. Keyin, Gerbinoni chaqirib, uning ko'z o'ngida so'yishdi. U rahm-shafqat va yordam so'raganida, uni dengizga uloqtirishdi va aytdilar: "Uni olib qo'ying; biz unga senga senga senga haqqing yetganidek beramiz." Gerbino ularning shafqatsiz ishini ko'rib, o'zini kemaning yoniga yotqizdi va o'zini val yoki toshni hisobga olmagandek, unga o'tirdi, u yerda bo'lganlarga qaramay, o'limga qarab turgandek; keyin shunda xuddi sherga o'xshab, bir to'da bo'lsa ham, endi bu ishni qilyapmiz, endi u o'zining tishlari bilan o'tga qarab, endi...

en: sailors fetch thereout what they might, in payment of their pains, and descended thence, having
uz: Dengizchilar o'zlarining azoblari evaziga u yerga boradigan narsalarini olib kelishdi va u yerdan tushishdi,

en: gotten but a sorry victory over his adversaries.
uz: Ammo raqiblari ustidan achinarli g'alaba qozondi.

en: Then, letting take up the fair lady’s body from the sea, long and with many tears he bewept it and steer- ing for Sicily, buried it honourably in Ustica, a little island over against Trapani; after which he returned home, the woefullest man alive.
uz: So'ngra, go'zal xonimning jasadini dengizdan olib chiqdi, uzoq va ko'p yoshlar bilan uni silkitdi va Sitsiliyaga yo'l oldi, uni sharafli tarzda Ustiyaga, Trapaniga qarama-qarshi kichik orolga ko'mdi; shundan so'ng u uyga qaytdi, eng to'la odam tirik edi.

en: The King of Tunis, hearing the heavy news, sent his ambassadors, clad all in black, to King Guglielmo, complaining of the ill observance of the faith which he had plighted him.
uz: Tunis qiroli og'ir xabarni eshitib, o'z elchilarini qora kiyimda, qirol Gugeliermo huzuriga yuborib, o'ziga xalaqit bergan e'tiqodga rioya qilmaslik haqida shikoyat qildi.

en: They recounted to him how the thing had passed, whereat King Guglielmo was sore incensed and seeing no way to deny them the justice they sought, caused take Gerbino; then himself —al- beit there was none of his barons but strove with prayers to move him from his purpose —condemned him to death and let strike off his head in his pres- ence, choosing rather to abide without posterity than to be held a faithless king.
uz: Ular unga voqea qanday o'tganini aytib berishdi. Qirol Gugeliermo g'azabda edi va ular izlagan adolatni rad etishning iloji yo'qligi sababli, Gerbinoni olib ketishga majbur bo'ldi; keyin o'zi  chunki uning baronlari yo'q edi, lekin uni o'z maqsadidan uzoqlashtirish uchun ibodat qildi  uni o'limga hukm qildi va boshini o'z huzurida urdi, sadoqatsiz shoh bo'lishdan ko'ra avlodsiz qolishni afzal ko'rdi.

en: Thus, then, as I have told you, did these two lovers within a few days241 die miserably a violent death, without having tasted any fruit of their loves.”
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga aytganimdek, bu ikki oshiq bir necha kun ichida 241 da shafqatsizlarcha va shafqatsizlarcha o'ldilar, ularning muhabbatlaridan hech qanday meva tatib ko'rmadilar.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Lisabetta’s242 brothers slay her lover, who appeareth to her in a dream and showeth her where he is buried, whereupon she privily disinterreth his head and setteth it in a pot of basil.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOYA Lisabettas242 aka-ukalari uning sevgilisini o'ldirishadi, u tushida unga ko'rinadi va unga qayerga dafn etilganini ko'rsatadi, shundan so'ng u uning boshini yashirincha ochib, rayhon qozoniga qo'yadi.

en: Thereover making moan a great while every day, her brothers take it from her and she for grief dieth a little thereafterward.
uz: Bundan tashqari, har kuni katta motam tutishardi, aka-ukalari uni undan tortib olishardi va u undan keyin qayg'udan biroz o'lardi.

en: Elisa’s tale being ended and somedele commended of the king, Filomena was bidden to discourse, who, full of compassion for the wretched Gerbino and his mistress, after a piteous sigh, began thus: “My story, gracious ladies, will not treat of folk of so high condition as were those of whom Elisa hath told, yet peradventure it will be no less pitiful; and what brought me in mind of it was the mention, a little before, of Messina, where the case befell.
uz: Elishaning hikoyasi tugagach va podshoh haqida maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan Filomenaga gapirishga chaqiriq berildi. Filomena, bechora Gerbino va uning bekasiga rahm-shafqat bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, achinarli xo'rsinishdan so'ng shunday boshladi: "Mening hikoyam, hurmatli xonimlar, Elishaning aytganidek yuqori darajadagi odamlarga munosabatda bo'lmaydilar, ammo ehtimol, bu unchalik achinarli bo'lmaydi; va meni esga keltirgan narsa, biroz oldin, bu holat yuz bergan Messina haqida eslatish edi.

en: There were then in Messina three young brothers, merchants and left very rich by their father, who was a man of San Gimignano, and they had an only sister, Lisabetta by name, a right fair and well-mannered maiden, whom, whatever might have been the reason thereof, they had not yet mar- ried.
uz: O'shanda Messinada uchta yosh aka-uka bor edi, savdogarlar va otasidan juda boy qolgan edilar. U San Gimignano'dan edi. Ularning yagona singlisi bor edi, ismi Lisabetta, juda go'zal va yaxshi xulqli qiz edi. Buning sababi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, ular hali turmushga chiqmagan edilar.

en: Now these brothers had in one of their warehouses a youth of Pisa, called Lorenzo, who did and ordered all their affairs and was very comely and agreeable of person; wherefore, Lisabetta looking sundry times upon him, it befell that he began strangely to please her; of which Lorenzo taking note at one time and another, he in like manner, leaving his other loves, began to turn his thoughts to her; and so went the affair, that, each being alike pleasing to the other, it was no great while before, taking assurance, they did that which each of them most desired.
uz: Endi bu aka-ukalarning omborlaridan birida Pisalik bir yigit bor edi, uning ismi Lorenzo edi. U o'z ishlarini bajarardi va tartibga solardi, odamga juda yoqimli va xushmuomala edi; shuning uchun, Lisabetta unga har xil qarashda, u uni g'alati tarzda yoqtirishni boshladi; bu haqda Lorenzo vaqti-vaqti bilan eslay boshladi, u ham xuddi shunday tarzda, boshqa sevgilarini tashlab, o'z fikrlarini unga qaratishni boshladi; va shunday bo'ldiki, har biri bir-birini bir xilda yoqtirgan bo'lsa ham, bu unchalik yaxshi emas edi, lekin avvallari, har biri eng ko'p xohlaganini qilishdi.

en: Continuing on this wise and enjoying great pleasure and delight one of the other, they knew not how to do so secretly but that, one night, Lisabetta,
uz: Shu oqilona yo'l bilan davom etib, bir-biridan katta zavq va quvonch his qilib, ular buni yashirincha qanday qilishni bilishmasdi, lekin bir kecha Lisabetta...

en: going whereas Lorenzo lay, was, unknown to herself, seen of the eldest of her brothers, who, being a prudent youth, for all the annoy it gave him to know this thing, being yet moved by more honourable counsel, abode without sign or word till the morning, revolving in himself various things anent the matter.
uz: Lorenzo yotgan joyga borar ekan, o'ziga noma'lum bo'lgan holda, akasilarning kattasi ko'rinardi. U aqlli yosh edi, bu narsani bilishga bergan barcha g'ashini ko'rib, hali ham sharafli maslahatga ta'sirlanib, ertalabgacha hech qanday alomat yoki so'zsiz turardi, o'zida bu borada turli narsalarni aylanardi.

en: The day being come, he recounted to his brothers that which he had seen the past night of Lisabetta and Lorenzo, and after long advisement with them, determined (so that neither to them nor to their sister should any reproach ensue thereof) to pass the thing over in silence and feign to have seen and known nothing thereof till such time as, without hurt or unease to themselves, they might avail to do away this shame from their sight, ere it should go farther.
uz: Kun kelib, u o'z akalariga Lisabetta va Lorenzo o'tgan kecha ko'rganlarini aytib berdi va ular bilan uzoq maslahatlashgandan so'ng (na ularga, na singlisiga bu haqda hech qanday ayb bo'lmasligi uchun) bu narsani jim o'tishga va o'zlarini hech narsa ko'rmagan va bilmagan deb ko'rsatishga qaror qildi, toki o'zlariga zarar yetkazmasdan yoki xafa bo'lmasdan, bu sharmandalikni ularning ko'zlaridan yo'qotishga, toki u uzoqroqqa ketmasin.

en: In this mind abiding and devising and laugh- ing with Lorenzo as was their wont, it befell that one day, feigning to go forth the city, all three, a-pleasuring, they carried him with them to a very lonely and remote place; and there, the occasion offering, they slew him, whilst he was off his guard, and buried him on such wise that none had knowledge of it; then, returning to Messina, they gave out that they had des- patched him somewhither for their occasions, the which was the lightlier credited that they were often used to send him abroad about their business.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'z odatlariga ko'ra, Lorenzo bilan birga yashab, o'ylab topib, kulishardi, shunday bo'ldiki, bir kuni uchalasi ham shaharga chiqib ketmoqchi bo'lib, juda yolg'iz va olis joyga olib ketishdi. U yerda, ehtimol, uni o'ldirishdi, u o'z qo'lida bo'lmaguncha, va hech kim bilmaydigan tarzda ko'mib tashlashdi. Keyin Messinaga qaytib, ular uni o'zlarining tadbirlari uchun biroz tuzatishganini aytishdi, bu esa ularni ko'pincha chet elga yuborish uchun ishlatilgan deb hisoblardi.

en: Lorenzo returning not and Lisabetta often and instantly questioning her brothers of him, as one to whom the long delay was grievous, it befell one day, as she very urgently enquired of him, that one of them said to her, ‘What meaneth this?
uz: Lorenzo tez-tez qaytib kelmas edi va Lisabetta o'z aka-ukalaridan uzoq kechikish qayg'uga solgani uchun darhol so'rayotgan edi. Bir kuni, u juda shoshilinch ravishda so'raganida, ulardan biri unga dedi: "Bu nimani anglatadi?"

en: What hast thou to do often of him?
uz: U haqida tez-tez nima qilyapsan?

en: An thou question of him with Lorenzo, that thou askest thus more, we will make thee such answer as thou deservest.’ Wherefore the girl, sad and grieving and fearful she knew not of what, abode without more asking; yet many a time anights she piteously called him and prayed him come to her, and whiles with many tears she complained of his long tarrying; and thus, without a moment’s gladness, she abode expecting him alway, till one night, having sore lamen- ted Lorenzo for that he returned not and being at last fallen asleep, weeping, he appeared to her in a dream, pale and all disordered, with clothes all rent and mouldered, and herseemed he bespoke her thus: ‘Harkye, Lisabetta; thou dost nought but call upon me, grieving for my long delay and cruelly impeaching me with thy tears.
uz: Siz undan Lorenzo bilan so'rang, shunda siz bundan ham ko'proq so'raysiz, biz sizga qanday javob berishga haqli bo'lsangiz, shunday javob beramiz." Shuning uchun qiz, qayg'uli, qayg'uli va qo'rqoq bo'lib, nima haqida bilmas edi, so'ramasdan qo'ydi; ammo ko'p tunlari uni achinish bilan chaqirardi va unga kelishni iltimos qilardi, va ko'p yosh bilan uning uzoq umr ko'rishidan shikoyat qilardi; va shunday qilib, bir lahza ham xursand bo'lmasdan, uni kutdi, bir kechagacha, qaytib kelmaganidan azob chekkan - ted ted Lorenzo, oxir-da uxlab, yig'lab, unga tushida paydo bo'ldi, va hamma tartibsiz, hamma kiyim yirtilgan va mo'ylangan edi, va u uni shunday ta'qib qildi: "Ha, Lisa, lekin meni ko'rmaysan, meni kechiktirganing va ko'zingni yig'la."

en: Know, therefore, that I may never more re- turn to thee, for that, the last day thou sawest me, thy brothers slew me.’ Then, having discovered to her the place where they had buried him, he charged her no more call him nor expect him and disappeared; whereupon she awoke and giving faith to the vision, wept bitterly.
uz: Shunday qilib, bilginki, men senga hech qachon qaytib kelmayman, chunki meni oxirgi kuni ko'rganingda, aka-ukalaring meni o'ldirishdi." Keyin, uni ko'mgan joyini bilib, u endi uni chaqirmaslikka va kutmaslikka buyurdi va yo'q bo'lib ketdi; shundan so'ng u uyg'onib, vahiyga ishonib, achchiq yig'ladi.

en: In the morning, being risen and daring not say aught to her brothers, she determined to go to the place appointed and see if the thing were true, as it had appeared to her in the dream.
uz: Ertalab turib, akalariga hech narsa demaslikka jur'at etib, u belgilangan joyga borishga va bu narsa tushida ko'ringanidek, rostmi yoki yo'qmi, tekshirishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, having leave to go somedele without the city for her disport, she betook herself thither,243 as quickliest she might, in company of one who had been with them244 otherwhiles and knew all her affairs; and there, clearing away the dead leaves from the place, she dug whereas herseemed the earth was less hard.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'z musobaqasi uchun shahardan tashqariga borishga ketganidan so'ng, u o'zini u yerga olib bordi, imkon qadar tezroq, ular bilan birga bo'lgan va barcha ishlarini bilgan 244 ta boshqa cho'ri bilan birga; va u yerda o'lik barglarni joydan olib tashlab, yer kamroq qattiq deb o'ylagan holda qazdi.

en: She had not dug long before she found the body of her unhappy lover, yet nothing changed nor rotted, and thence knew manifestly that her vision was true, wherefore she was the most distressful of women; yet, knowing that this was no place for lament, she would fain, an she but might, have borne away the whole body, to give it ﬁtter burial; but, seeing that this might not be, she with a knife did off245 the head from the body, as best she could, and wrapping it in a napkin, laid it in her maid’s lap.
uz: U o'zining baxtsiz sevgilisining jasadini topishga uncha ko'p vaqt qolmadi, ammo hech narsa o'zgarmadi ham, chirimmadi ham, va shundan so'ng o'z ko'rinishi rost ekanligini aniq bildi, shuning uchun u ayollarning eng qayg'uli edi; ammo, bu yig'lash joyi emasligini bilgach, u butun jasadni tashlab, unga mosroq dafn berishga majbur bo'lardi; lekin, bu mumkin bo'lmagani uchun, u pichoq bilan jasaddan boshini, iloji boricha 245, salfetkaga o'rab, xizmatkorining tizzasiga qo'ydi.

en: Then, casting back the earth over the trunk, she departed thence, without being seen of any, and returned home, where, shutting herself in her chamber with her lover’s head, she bewept it long and bitterly, insomuch that she bathed it all with her tears, and kissed it a thousand times in every part.
uz: Keyin, tuproqni yukxonaning ustiga tashlab, u yerdan hech kim ko'rinmasdan ketdi va uyga qaytib keldi. U yerda, sevgilisining boshi bilan o'z xonasiga yopilib, uni uzoq va achchiq silkitdi, shu qadarki, hamma narsani ko'z yoshlari bilan cho'mdi va har bir qismida ming marta o'pdi.

en: Then, taking a great and goodly pot, of those wherein they plant marjoram or sweet basil, she set the head therein, folded in a fair linen cloth, and covered it with earth, in which she planted sundry heads of right fair basil of Salerno; nor did she ever water these with other water than that of her tears or rose or orange-ﬂower water.
uz: Keyin, marjoram yoki shirin rayhon ekish uchun mo'ljallangan katta va chiroyli idishni olib, u yerga boshini qo'ydi, uni chiroyli zig'ir matosiga bukib, tuproqqa yopdi va unga Salernoning chiroyli rayhonining turli xil boshlarini ekdi; shuningdek, ularni hech qachon o'z ko'z yoshlari yoki atirgul yoki apelsin-gul suvidan boshqa suv bilan sug'ormadi.

en: Moreover she took wont to sit still near the pot and to gaze amorously upon it with all her desire, as upon that which held her Lorenzo hid; and after she had a great while looked thereon, she would bend over it and fall to weeping so sore and so long that her tears bathed all the basil, which, by dint of long and as- siduous tending, as well as by reason of the fatness of the earth, proceeding from the rotting head that was therein, waxed passing fair and very sweet of savour.
uz: Qolaversa, u qozon yonida jim o'tirishga va unga Lorenzo yashirgan narsa ustida ishtiyoq bilan tikilib turishga odatlangan edi; va unga ko'p vaqt qaraganidan so'ng, u uning ustiga egilib, shunchalik achchiq va uzoq yig'lab yilardi, hatto ko'z yoshlari butun rayhonni ham cho'mdirdi, u uzoq va juda qattiq parvarishlash tufayli, shuningdek, yerning yog'ligi tufayli, u ichidagi chirigan boshdan oqib o'tib, juda shirin ta'm bilan.

en: The damsel, doing without cease after this wise, was sundry times seen of her neighbours, who to her brothers, marvelling at her waste beauty and that her eyes seemed to have ﬂed forth her head [for weeping], related this, saying, ‘We have noted that she doth every day after such a fashion.’ The brothers, hearing and seeing this and having once and again reproved her therefor, but without avail, let secretly carry away from her the pot, which she, missing, with the utmost instance many a time required, and for that it was not restored to her, stinted not to weep and lament till she fell sick; nor
uz: Qiz bu hikmatdan tinimsiz foydalanib, qo'shnilaridan turli marta ko'rinardi. Ular uning akasiga uning behuda go'zalligiga hayratda bo'lishgan va ko'zlari boshidan qochib ketgan ko'rinishlarini aytib berishardi va shunday deyishardi: "Biz uning har kuni shunday uslubda harakat qilayotganini payqadik." Akalar buni eshitib, ko'rib, uni bir necha bor tanbeh berishdi, lekin hech qanday foyda yo'q, undan yashirincha ko'p vaqt talab qiladigan, va u uchun qaytarib berilmagan idishni olib ketishardi va u kasal bo'lmaguncha yig'lamasdi;

en: in her sickness did she ask aught other than the pot of basil.
uz: U kasalligida rayhon qozonidan boshqa hech narsa so'ramadi.

en: The young men marvelled greatly at this continual asking and bethought them therefor to see what was in this pot.
uz: Yigitlar bu tinimsiz so'rashdan juda hayratda qolishdi va bu idishda nima borligini ko'rish uchun ularni o'ylashdi.

en: Accordingly, turning out the earth, they found the cloth and therein the head, not yet so rotted but they might know it, by the curled hair, to be that of Lorenzo.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, yerga qarab, ular mato va u ichidagi boshni topdilar, hali unchalik chirigan emas edi, lekin ular uni jingalak sochlari bilan Lorenzoniki ekanligini bilishlari mumkin edi.

en: At this they were mightily amazed and feared lest the thing should get wind; wherefore, burying the head, without word said, they privily departed Messina, having taken order how they should withdraw thence, and betook themselves to Naples.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular juda hayratga tushdilar va bu narsa shamolga uchrashiga qo'rqdilar; shuning uchun, boshlarini ko'mib, hech qanday so'z aytmasdan, Messinaga yashirincha jo'nab ketishdi, u yerdan qanday chiqib ketish kerakligini buyurib, Neapolga yo'l olishdi.

en: The damsel, ceasing never from lamenting and still demanding her pot, died, weeping; and so her ill-fortuned love had end.
uz: Qizaloq hech qachon yig'lashni to'xtatmay, o'z qozonini talab qilib, yig'lab o'ldi; va shunday qilib uning baxtsiz muhabbati tugab ketdi.

en: But, after a while the thing being grown manifest unto many, there was one who made thereon the song that is yet sung, to wit: Alack!
uz: Ammo, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, narsa ko'pchilikka ma'lum bo'lib, u haqida hali kuylanayotgan qo'shiqni yaratgan odam paydo bo'ldi, ya'ni: Alack!

en: ah, who can the ill Christian be,  That stole my pot away?” etc.246
uz: "Ah, yomon nasroniy kim bo'lishi mumkin, mening idishimni o'g'irlab ketgan odam?" va hokazo. 246

en: THE SIXTH STORY Andrevuola loveth Gabriotto and recounteth to him a dream she hath had, whereupon he telleth her one of his own and presently dieth suddenly in her arms.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Andrevuola Gabriyottoga oshiq bo'ladi va unga tushini aytib beradi, shundan so'ng u unga o'zidan birini aytib beradi va birdan uning qo'llarida vafot etadi.

en: What while she and a waiting woman of hers bear him to his own house, they are taken by the ofﬁcers of justice and carried before the provost, to whom she discovereth how the case standeth.
uz: U va uning kutgan ayoli uni o'z uyiga olib ketayotganda, ular adolat xodimlari tomonidan olib ketiladi va prokuror huzuriga olib boriladi, u esa ishni qanday holatda ekanligini aniqlaydi.

en: The provost would fain force her, but she suffereth it not and her father, coming to hear of the matter, procureth her to be set at liberty, she being found innocent; whereupon, altogether refusing to abide longer in the world, she becometh a nun.
uz: Provost uni majburlamoqchi edi, lekin u bunga yo'l qo'ymaydi va otasi bu masalani eshitib, uni ozod qilishga harakat qiladi, u begunoh deb topildi; shundan so'ng, dunyoda uzoqroq qolishdan umuman bosh tortgan holda, rohiba bo'ladi.

en: Filomela’s story was very welcome to the ladies, for that they had many a time heard sing this song, yet could never, for asking, learn the occasion of its making.
uz: Filomelaning hikoyasi xonimlar uchun juda ma'qul edi, chunki ular bu qo'shiqni ko'p eshitishgan edi, ammo so'raganlari uchun uning qanday yaratilganini hech qachon bilmas edilar.

en: But the king, having heard the end thereof, charged Pamﬁlo fol- low on the ordinance; whereupon quoth he, “The dream in the foregoing story giveth me occasion to recount one wherein is made mention of two dreams, which were of a thing to come, even as the former was of a thing [already] betided, and scarce were they ﬁnished telling by those who had dreamt them than the accomplishment followed of both.
uz: Ammo podshoh bu oxirini eshitgach, Pamfilo fol-ni bu farmon haqida aybladi; shundan so'ng u dedi: "Oldingi hikoyadagi tush menga ikkita tush haqida hikoya qilish imkonini beradi, ularda kelajakdagi narsa haqida gap ketadi, xuddi birinchisi allaqachon ma'lum bo'lganidek, va ularning orzu qilganlar tomonidan ikkalasi ham amalga oshgandan keyin aytib bo'lmadi."

en: You must know, then, lovesome ladies, that it is an affection common to all alive to see vari- ous things in sleep, whereof —albeit to the sleeper, what while he sleepeth, they all appear most true and he, awakened, accounteth some true, others probable and yet others out of all likelihood —many are natheless found to be come to pass.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, go'zal xonimlar, barcha tiriklar uchun uyquda turli xil narsalarni ko'rish odatiy hol, garchi uxlayotgan odamga ko'rinsa ham, ularning barchasi eng to'g'ri ko'rinadi va u uyg'onganida ba'zilarini to'g'ri, ba'zilarini ehtimoldan yiroq va boshqalarni esa hech qanday ehtimoldan yiroq deb hisoblaydi  ko'plari baribir amalga oshadi.

en: By reason whereof many lend to every dream as much be- lief as they would to things they should see, waking, and for their proper dreams they sorrow or rejoice, according as by these they hope or fear.
uz: Shuning uchun ko'pchilik har bir tushga ko'rishi kerak bo'lgan narsalar, uyg'onishi kerak bo'lgan narsalar kabi qaraydi va o'zlarining haqiqiy tushlari uchun umid qilishlari yoki qo'rqishlari kabi qayg'urishadi yoki xursand bo'lishadi.

en: And contrariwise, there are those who believe none thereof, save after they ﬁnd themselves fallen into the peril foreshown.
uz: Aksincha, ularning hech biriga ishonmaydiganlar bor, faqatgina o'zlarini oldindan ko'rsatilgan xavfga duchor bo'lganlaridan keyin.

en: Of these,247 I approve neither
