uz: Shulardan 247 tasini men hech birini ma'qullamayman.

en: the one nor other, for that dreams are neither always true nor always false.
uz: na ikkinchisi, chunki orzular doimo haqiqiy ham emas, doimo yolg'on ham emas.

en: That they are not all true, each one of us must often enough have had occa- sion to know; and that they are not all false hath been already shown in Filomena her story, and I also purpose, as I said before, to show it in mine.
uz: Ularning hammasi rost emasligini har birimiz tez-tez bilgan bo'lsak kerak; va ularning hammasi yolg'on emasligi Filomena o'z hikoyasida allaqachon ko'rsatilgan, va men ham, avval aytganimdek, buni o'zimda ko'rsatmoqchiman.

en: Wherefore I am of opinion that, in the matter of living and doing virtuously, one should have no fear of any dream contrary thereto nor forego good in- tentions by reason thereof; as for perverse and wicked things, on the other hand, however favourable dreams may appear thereto and how much soever they may hearten him who seeth them with propitious auguries, none of them should be credited, whilst full faith should be accorded unto all that tend to the contrary.248 But to come to the story.
uz: Shunday ekan, men shunday fikrdamanki, yaxshilik bilan yashash va yaxshilik bilan ishlash masalasida, unga zid tushdan qo'rqmaslik kerak va shuning uchun yaxshiliklardan voz kechmaslik kerak; buzuq va yomon narsalar haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, ularga qanchalik yaxshi tushlar ko'rinmasin va ularni yaxshilik bilan ko'rgan odamni qanchalik xursand qilmasin, ularning hech biri hisobga olinmasligi kerak, aksincha, bunga moyil bo'lganlarning barchasiga to'liq ishonch berilishi kerak.

en: There was once in the city of Brescia a gentleman called Messer Negro da Ponte Carraro, who amongst sundry other children had a daughter named Andrevuola, young and unmarried and very fair.
uz: Bir vaqtlar Bressiya shahrida Messer Negro da Ponte Carraro ismli bir janob bor edi. Uning turli xil bolalar orasida Andrevuola ismli qizi bor edi, yosh va turmushga chiqmagan, juda chiroyli edi.

en: It chanced she fell in love with a neighbour of hers, Gabriotto by name, a man of mean condition, but full laudable fashions and comely and pleasant of his person, and by the means and with the aid of the serving-maid of the house, she so wrought that not only did Gabriotto know himself beloved of her, but was many and many a time brought, to the delight of both parties, into a goodly garden of her father’s.
uz: Shunday qilib, u qo'shnisi, ismi Gabriotto bo'lgan odamga oshiq bo'lib qoldi, u oddiy, ammo maqtovga sazovor modalarga to'la, uning shaxsiyatiga yoqimli va yoqimli edi. Va u uy xizmatkorining vositalari va yordami bilan shunday harakat qildi, shunda Gabriotto nafaqat o'zini o'ziga yaqin deb bildi, balki ko'p va ko'p marta otasining yaxshi bog'iga olib keldi, bu ikki tomonning ham xursandchiligini keltirdi.

en: And in order that no cause, other than death, should ever avail to sever those their delightsome loves, they became in secret husband and wife, and so stealthily continuing their foregatherings, it befell that the young lady, being one night asleep, dreamt that she was in her garden with Gabriotto and held him in her arms, to the exceeding pleasure of each; but, as they abode thus, herseemed she saw come forth of his body something dark and frightful, the form whereof she could not discern; the which took Gabriotto and tearing him in her despite with marvellous might from her embrace, made off with him underground, nor ever more might she avail to see either the one or the other.
uz: Va o'limdan boshqa hech qanday sabab ularning yoqimli sevgilarini uzishga yordam bermasligi uchun, ular yashirincha er-xotin bo'lishdi va o'zlarining oldindan uchrashuvlarini shunday yashirincha davom ettirishdi, shunday bo'ldiki, bir kecha yosh xonim uxlab yurib, o'z bog'ida Gabriotto bilan ekanligini tush ko'rdi va uni har birining quchog'iga bosdi; lekin, ular shu tariqa yashaganlarida, u uning tanasidan nimadir qorong'u va qo'rqinchli chiqqanini ko'rdi, uning shaklini u sezmas edi; bu esa Gabriotto uni uning quchog'idan ajoyib kuch bilan olib, uni yer ostida ko'tarib tashladi, va u hech qachon birini ko'rishga qodir emas edi.

en: At this she fell into an inexpressible passion of grief, whereby she awoke, and albeit, awaking, she was rejoiced to ﬁnd that it was not as she had dreamed, nevertheless fear entered into her by reason of the dream she had seen.
uz: Shu bilan u ifodalab bo'lmaydigan qayg'u ishtiyoqiga tushdi, shu bilan uyg'ondi va uyg'onib, u tushdagidek emasligini bilib xursand bo'ldi, shunga qaramay, ko'rgan orzusi tufayli qo'rquv unga kirib ketdi.

en: Wherefore, Gabriotto presently desiring to visit her that next night, she studied as most she might to prevent his coming; however, seeing his desire and so he might not misdoubt him of otherwhat, she received him in the garden and having gathered great store of roses, white and red (for that it was the season), she went to sit with him at the foot of a very goodly and
uz: Shuning uchun, Gabriotto keyingi kecha unga tashrif buyurishni istardi, u uning kelishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun qo'lidan kelganicha o'qidi; ammo, uning xohishini ko'rib, uni boshqa narsadan gumon qilmasligi uchun, uni bog'da qabul qildi va katta miqdorda gullar yig'ib oldi, oq va qizil (chunki bu mavsum edi), u bilan yonida o'tirdi juda yaxshi va

en: clear fountain that was there.
uz: U yerda ochiq favvora bor edi.

en: After they had taken great and long delight together, Gabriotto asked her why she would have forbidden his coming that night; whereupon she told him, recounting to him the dream she had seen the foregoing night and the fear she had gotten therefrom.
uz: Ular birga katta va uzoq vaqt zavq olgandan so'ng, Gabriotto undan nega o'sha kechada uning kelishini taqiqlaganini so'radi; shundan so'ng u unga aytib, oldingi kechada ko'rgan tushini va undan olgan qo'rquvini aytib berdi.

en: He, hearing this, laughed it to scorn and said that it was great folly to put any faith in dreams, for that they arose of excess of food or lack thereof and were daily seen to be all vain, adding, ‘Were I minded to follow after dreams, I had not come hither, not so much on account of this of thine as of one I myself dreamt last night; which was that meseemed I was in a fair and delightsome wood, wherein I went hunting and had taken the fairest and loveliest hind was ever seen; for methought she was whiter than snow and was in brief space become so familiar with me that she never left me a mo- ment.
uz: U buni eshitib, masxara qilib kuldi va tushlarga ishonish juda ahmoqlik ekanligini aytdi, chunki ular ortiqcha ovqat yoki yetishmovchilikdan kelib chiqqan va har kuni behuda ko'rinardi. Qo'shimcha qilib aytdi: "Agar men tushlarga ergashishni xohlagan bo'lsam, bu yerga kelmagan edim, xuddi kecha tush ko'rganimdek emas; chunki men adolatli va yoqimli o'rmonda edim, u yerda ovga chiqib, eng go'zal va yoqimtoy hindni ko'rganman; chunki u qordan oqroq edi va qisqa vaqt ichida men bilan shunchalik tanishgan ediki, u meni hech qachon tashlab ketmagan edi."

en: Moreover, meseemed I held her so dear that, so she might not depart from me, I had put a collar of gold about her neck and held her in hand with a golden chain.
uz: Qolaversa, men uni shunchalik qadrlagandek his qilgandimki, u mendan ketmasligi uchun, uning bo'yniga oltin yoqani taqdim va qo'limda oltin zanjir bilan ushladim.

en: After this medreamed that, once upon a time, what while this hind lay couched with its head in my bosom,249 there issued I know not whence a greyhound bitch as black as coal, anhungred and passing grue- some of aspect, and made towards me.
uz: Shundan so'ng tush ko'rdimki, bir vaqtlar bu orqa burun boshini ko'kragimda yotganida, men bilmayman, qayerdan ko'mirdek qora, och va o'tkinchi qo'pol, ko'rinishidan menga qarab chiqqan kulrang it chiqdi.

en: Methought I offered it no resistance, wherefore meseemed it thrust its muzzle into my breast on the left side and gnawed thereat till it won to my heart, which methought it tore from me, to carry it away.
uz: O'yladimki, unga qarshilik ko'rsatmadim, shuning uchun u o'z tumshug'ini chap tomondagi ko'kragimga tiqdi va u yerdan kemirardi, toki u yuragimga yetib bordi, u o'yladi, uni mendan yirtib, olib ketish uchun.

en: Therewith I felt such a pain that my sleep was broken and awaking, I straightway clapped my hand to my side, to see if I had aught there; but, ﬁnding nothing amiss with me, I made mock of myself for hav- ing sought.
uz: Shu bilan men shunday og'riq his qildimki, uyqularim uzildi va uyg'onib ketdim, darhol yonimga qo'limni urdim, u yerda biror narsa bor-yo'qligini ko'rishga; lekin, menda hech qanday muammo yo'qligini topib, izlaganim uchun o'zimni masxara qildim.

en: But, after all, what booteth this dream?250 I have dreamed many such and far more frightful, nor hath aught in the world befallen me by reas- on thereof; wherefore let it pass and let us think to give ourselves a good time.’ The young lady, already sore adread for her own dream, hearing this, waxed yet more so, but hid her fear, as most she might, not to be the occa- sion of any unease to Gabriotto.
uz: Lekin, axir, bu tushni nima boshlaydi? 250 Men bunday va undan ham dahshatliroq ko'p narsalarni tush ko'rganman, dunyoga hech narsa bunday sabab bilan tush kelmagan; shuning uchun o'tib ketaylik va o'zimizga yaxshi vaqt o'tkazaylik deb o'ylab ko'raylik. Yosh xonim, o'z orzusi uchun allaqachon og'riqdan azob chekkan edi, buni eshitib, yanada ko'proq o'sdi, lekin qo'rquvini yashirdi, Gabriottoga hech qanday noqulaylik sabab bo'lmasligi uchun.

en: Nevertheless, what while she solaced her- self with him, clipping and kissing him again and again and being of him clipped and kissed, she many a time eyed him in the face more than of her wont, misdoubting she knew not what, and whiles she looked about the garden, and she should see aught of black come anywhence.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u o'zini u bilan birga tasalli berar ekan, uni qayta-qayta qisib, o'pib, uni qisib va o'pib, odatdagidan ko'ra ko'proq uning yuziga ko'z tikardi, shubhalanib, nima ekanligini bilmas edi va bog' atrofida qarardi, va u har qanday tomondan qora narsa kelishini ko'rishi kerak edi.

en: Presently, as they abode thus, Gabriotto heaved a great sigh and embracing her said, ‘Alas, my soul, help me, for I die!’ So saying, he fell to the ground upon the grass of the lawn.
uz: Hozir, ular shu tarzda turar ekanlar, Gabriotto katta xo'rsindi va uni quchoqlab dedi: "Alas, jonim, menga yordam ber, chunki o'laman!" Shunday deb, u maysazordagi o't ustida yerga yiqildi.

en: The young lady, seeing this, drew him up into her lap and
uz: Buni ko'rgan yosh ayol uni o'z tizzasiga tortdi va...

en: said, well nigh weeping, ‘Alack, sweet my lord, what aileth thee?’ He answered not, but, panting sore and sweating all over, no great while after departed this life.
uz: dedi, yig'lab, "Alak, azizim, senga nima bo'ldi?" U javob bermadi, lekin, achchiqlanib, terlab, bu hayotdan ketgandan keyin hech qanday buyuk narsa yo'q edi.

en: How grievous, how dolorous was this to the young lady, who loved him more than her life, each one of you may conceive for herself.
uz: Yosh xonim uchun bu qanchalik qayg'uli, qanchalik og'riqli edi, uni hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq sevardi, har biringiz o'zingiz uchun tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.

en: She bewept him sore and many a time called him in vain; but after she had handled him in every part of his body and found him cold in all, perceiving that he was altogether dead and knowing not what to do or to say, she went, all tearful as she was and full of anguish, to call her maid, who was privy to their loves, and discovered to her misery and her grief.
uz: U uni og'riq bilan qimirlatdi va ko'p marta behuda chaqirardi; lekin u uni tanasining har bir qismida ushlaganidan so'ng va uni butunlay sovuq holda topgach, u butunlay o'lik ekanligini va nima deyishni bilmasligini anglab yetgach, u barcha yig'lagan holda va azobga to'la holda, ularning muhabbatidan xabardor bo'lgan xizmatkorini chaqirishga bordi va uning azobini va qayg'usini angladi.

en: Then, after they had awhile made woeful lamentation over Gabriotto’s dead face, the young lady said to the maid, ‘Since God hath bereft me of him I love, I purpose to abide no longer on life; but, ere I go about to slay myself, I would fain take ﬁtting means to preserve my honour and the secret of the love that hath been between us twain and that the body, wherefrom the gracious spirit is departed, may be buried.’ ‘Daughter mine,’ answered the maid, ‘talk not of seeking to slay thyself, for that, if thou have lost him in this world, by slaying thyself thou wouldst lose him in the world to come also, since thou wouldst go to hell, whither I am assured his soul hath not gone; for he was a virtuous youth.
uz: Keyin, ular Gabrielottoning o'lik yuzi haqida biroz qayg'uli faryod qilganlaridan so'ng, yosh xonim xizmatchiga dedi: "Xudo meni undan sevganimdan mahrum qilgani uchun, men endi hayotda qolishni maqsad qilmayman; lekin o'zimni o'ldirishdan oldin, men o'z sharafimni va biz o'rtamizda bo'lgan muhabbat sirini saqlab qolish uchun tegishli vositalarni topishni xohlardim va qalbimiz, undan rahmatli ruh ketgan, dafn etilishi mumkin edi." "Qizim," dedi xizmatchi, "o'zingni o'ldirishga urinma, chunki agar uni dunyoda yo'qotsang, o'zingni o'ldirib, uni kelajakda ham yo'qotasan, chunki sen do'zaxga borasan, unda uning joning bor, chunki u..."

en: It were bet- ter far to comfort thyself and think of succouring his soul with prayers and other good works, so haply he have need thereof for any sin committed.
uz: O'zingni ovutish va uning ruhini duolar va boshqa yaxshi ishlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash haqida o'ylash ancha yaxshiroq edi, shuning uchun u qilgan har qanday gunoh uchun bunga muhtoj bo'ladi.

en: The means of burying him are here at hand in this garden and none will ever know of the matter, for none knoweth that he ever came hither.
uz: Uni dafn etish vositalari shu bog'da qo'l ostida va hech kim bu haqda hech qachon bilmaydi, chunki hech kim uning bu yerga kelganini bilmaydi.

en: Or, an thou wilt not have it so, let us put him forth of the garden and leave him be; he will be found tomorrow morning and carried to his house, where his kinsfolk will have him buried.’ The young lady, albeit she was full of bitter sorrow and wept without ceasing, yet gave ear to her maid’s counsels and consenting not to the ﬁrst part thereof, made answer to the second, saying, ‘God forbid that I should suffer so dear a youth and one so beloved of me and my husband to be buried after the fashion of a dog or left to lie in the street!
uz: Yoki, agar xohlamasang, uni bog'dan tashqariga chiqarib yuboraylik va qo'yib yuboraylik; u ertaga ertalab topiladi va o'z uyiga olib ketiladi, u yerda qarindoshlari uni dafn etishadi." Yosh xonim, garchi achchiq qayg'uga to'la bo'lsa ham va tinimsiz yig'lasa ham, xizmatkorining maslahatlariga quloq solib, uning birinchi qismiga rozi bo'lmadi, ikkinchisiga javob berdi: "Xudo menga shunchalik yoqqan yosh va men va erimdan shunchalik sevimli bo'lgan bir yigitning it uslubida dafn etilishi yoki ko'chada yotishi mumkin emas!"

en: He hath had my tears and inasmuch as I may, he shall have those of his kinsfolk, and I have already bethought me of that which we have to do to that end.’ Therewith she despatched her maid for a piece of cloth of silk, which she had in a coffer of hers, and spreading it on the earth, laid Gabriotto’s body thereon, with his head upon a pillow.
uz: U mening ko'z yoshlariga ega bo'ldi va men imkon qadar, u o'z qarindoshlarinikiga ega bo'ladi, va men bu maqsadga erishish uchun nima qilishimiz kerakligini allaqachon o'ylab ko'rdim. Shu bilan u xizmatchisini o'zining sandig'ida bo'lgan ipak mato uchun jo'natdi va uni yerga yoyib, Gabrielottoning jasadini unga, boshini yostiq ustiga qo'ydi.

en: Then with many tears she closed his
uz: Keyin ko'p ko'z yoshlari bilan uning...

en: eyes and mouth and weaving him a chaplet of roses, covered him with all they had gathered, he and she; after which she said to the maid, ‘It is but a little way hence to his house; wherefore we will carry him thither, thou and I, even as we have arrayed him, and lay him before the door.
uz: Ko'zlari, og'zi va unga atirgullar to'qigancha, uni o'zlari to'plagan hamma narsa bilan qopladilar, u va u; keyin u xizmatchiga dedi: "Bu uning uyiga bir oz yo'l; shuning uchun biz uni u yerga olib boramiz, sen va men uni o'rnatganimizdek, va eshik oldiga qo'yamiz."

en: It will not be long ere it be day and he will be taken up; and although this may be no con- solation to his friends, yet to me, in whose arms he died, it will be a pleas- ure.’ So saying, once more with most abundant tears she cast herself upon his face and wept a great while.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay kun bo'ladi va u ko'tariladi; va garchi bu uning do'stlariga tasalli bo'lmasa ham, lekin u o'lgan qo'lida men uchun bu xursandchilik bo'ladi." Shunday qilib, u yana bir bor eng ko'p ko'z yoshlari bilan uning yuziga tashlandi va ancha vaqt yig'ladi.

en: Then, being urged by her maid to despatch, for that the day was at hand, she rose to her feet and drawing from her ﬁn- ger the ring wherewith Gabriotto had espoused her, she set it on his and said, weeping, ‘Dear my lord, if thy soul now seeth my tears or if any sense or cognizance abide in the body, after the departure thereof, benignly re- ceive her last gift, whom, living, thou lovedst so well.’ This said, she fell down upon him in a swoon, but, presently coming to herself and rising, she took up, together with her maid, the cloth whereon the body lay and going forth the garden therewith, made for his house.
uz: Keyin, xizmatkori uni jo'natishga undashib, kun yaqinlashgani uchun, u o'rnidan turdi va Gabrielto uni turmushga chiqqan uzukni suzgichidan tortib, uni uning ustiga qo'ydi va yig'lab dedi: "Agar joningiz endi mening ko'z yoshlarimni ko'rsa yoki uning ketishidan keyin biror ma'no yoki bilim tanada bo'lsa, uning oxirgi sovg'asini yaxshilik bilan qabul qiling, siz uni tirik holda juda yaxshi ko'rgan edingiz."

en: As they went, they were discovered and taken with the dead body by the ofﬁcers of the provostry, who chanced to be abroad at that hour about some other matter.
uz: Ular ketayotganda, ularni provostry ofitserlari topib, o'lik jasad bilan birga olib ketishdi, ular shu soatda boshqa bir masala bo'yicha chet elda bo'lishgan edi.

en: Andrevuola, more desirous of death than of life, recognizing the ofﬁcers, said frankly, ‘I know who you are and that it would avail me nothing to seek to ﬂee; I am ready to go with you before the Seignory and there declare how the case standeth; but let none of you dare to touch me, provided I am obedient to you, or to remove aught from this body, an he would not be accused of me.’ Accordingly, without being touched of any, she repaired, with Gabriotto’s body, to the palace, where the Provost, hear- ing what was to do, arose and sending for her into his chamber, proceeded to enquire of this that had happened.
uz: Andrevuola, hayotdan ko'ra o'limni ko'proq xohlagan, ofitserlarni tanigan holda, ochiqchasiga dedi: "Men sizning kimligingizni bilaman va qochishga urinishdan hech qanday foyda ko'rmasligingizni; men siz bilan Rabbiy huzuriga borishga va u yerda ish qanday ekanligini e'lon qilishga tayyorman; lekin hech biringiz menga tegishga jur'at qilmang, agar men sizga itoat qilsam yoki bu tanadan hech narsa olib tashlasam, u mendan ayblanmas edi." Shunga ko'ra, hech narsaga tegmasdan, u Gabrielottoning tanasi bilan saroyga, nima qilish kerakligini eshitib, o'rnidan turib, uni o'z xonasiga yuborib, sodir bo'lgan voqea haqida so'rashga kirdi.

en: To this end he caused divers physi- cians look if the dead man had been done to death with poison or otherwise, who all afﬁrmed that it was not so, but that some imposthume had burst near the heart, the which had suffocated him.
uz: Shu maqsadda u turli xil fizik olimlarga o'lik odam zahar bilan yoki boshqa usulda o'ldirilganmi yoki yo'qmi, deb tekshirishga majbur qildi. Ularning barchasi bunday emasligini, balki uni bo'g'ib yuborgan yurak yaqinida qandaydir soxta narsa portlaganini tasdiqladilar.

en: The magistrate hearing this and feeling her to be guilty in [but] a small matter, studied to make a show of giving her that which he could not sell her and told her that, an she would consent to his pleasures, he would release her; but, these words availing not, he offered, out of all seemliness, to use force.
uz: Magistrat buni eshitib, uni kichik bir ishda aybdor deb hisoblab, unga sotolmaydigan narsani berishni ko'rsatish uchun o'rganib chiqdi va unga, agar u uning lazzatlariga rozi bo'lsa, uni ozod qilishini aytdi; lekin, bu so'zlar foyda bermadi, u, hech qanday ko'rinishsiz, kuch ishlatishni taklif qildi.

en: However, Andrevuola, ﬁred with disdain and waxed strong [for indignation], defended herself manfully, rebutting him with proud and scornful words.
uz: Ammo, Andrevuola nafrat bilan ishdan bo'shatildi va kuchliroq bo'ldi, o'zini mardona himoya qildi, uni mag'rur va haqoratli so'zlar bilan rad etdi.

en: Meanwhile, broad day come and these things being recounted to Messer Negro, he betook himself, sorrowful unto death, to the palace, in company with many of his friends, and being there acquainted by the Provost with the whole matter, demanded resentfully251 that his daughter should be re- stored to him.
uz: Shu bilan birga, kunduzgi kun kelib, bu narsalar Messer Negroga rivoyat qilinar ekan, u o'zini, o'limgacha qayg'uga to'lib, ko'plab do'stlari bilan birga saroyga olib bordi va u yerda Provost bilan butun masala bilan tanishib, qizini unga qayta saqlashni g'azab bilan talab qildi.

en: The Provost, choosing rather to accuse himself of the viol- ence he would have done her than to be accused of her, ﬁrst extolled the damsel and her constancy and in proof thereof, proceeded to tell that which he had done; by reason whereof, seeing her of so excellent a ﬁrmness, he had vowed her an exceeding love and would gladly, an it were agreeable to him, who was her father, and to herself, espouse her for his lady, notwith- standing she had had a husband of mean condition.
uz: Provost, uni ayblashdan ko'ra, o'zini zo'ravonlikda ayblashni afzal ko'rgan holda, avvalo qizni va uning qat'iyatini maqtab, buning isboti sifatida qilgan ishini aytishga kirishdi; shu sababli, uni shunchalik ajoyib qat'iyat bilan ko'rib, unga haddan tashqari muhabbat va'da qilgan edi va otasi bo'lgan unga va o'ziga ma'qul bo'lgan holda, uni xotiniga turmushga chiqarish uchun rozi bo'lardi, garchi uning turmush o'rtog'i yomon ahvolda bo'lgan bo'lsa ham.

en: Whilst they yet talked, Andrevuola presented herself and weeping, cast herself before her father and said, ‘Father mine, methinketh there is no need that I recount to you the story of my boldness and my illhap, for I am assured that you have heard and know it; wherefore, as most I may, I humbly ask pardon of you for my default, to wit, the having without your knowledge taken him who most pleased me to husband.
uz: Ular hali gaplashayotganlarida, Andrevuola o'zini ko'rsatdi va yig'lab, otasining oldiga tashlandi va dedi: "Otam, menimcha, men senga o'z jasoratim va jabrim haqida hikoya qilishim shart emas, chunki men ishonamanki, sen buni eshitding va bilasan; shuning uchun, eng ko'p imkoniyatlarim bo'lsa, men seni beparvolik uchun kechirim so'rayman, ya'ni seni bilmagan holda meni eng yoqtirgan odamni olib ketganim uchun."

en: And this boon I ask of you, not for that my life may be spared me, but to die your daughter and not your enemy.’ So saying, she fell weeping at his feet.
uz: Va men sizdan bu inoyatni so'rayman, hayotim saqlanib qolishi uchun emas, balki qizingizning o'limi uchun, dushmaningiz emas. Shunday qilib, u uning oyoqlari ostida yig'lab yiqildi.

en: Messer Negro, who was an old man and kindly and affectionate of his nature, hearing these words, began to weep and with tears in his eyes raised his daughter tenderly to her feet and said, ‘Daughter mine, it had better pleased me that thou shouldst have had such a husband as, according to my thinking, behoved unto thee; and that thou shouldst have taken such an one as was pleasing unto thee had also been pleasing to me; but that thou shouldst have concealed him, of thy little conﬁdence in me, grieveth me, and so much the more as I see thee to have lost him, ere I knew it.
uz: Men bu so'zlarni eshitganimda, keksa va mehribon va mehrli odam bo'lgan Messer Negro yig'lay boshladi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan qizini mayin oyoqqa ko'tardi va dedi: "Qizim, menimcha, senga shunday er bo'lgani ma'qul edi; va senga yoqqanini ham menga yoqqanini olishing kerak edi; lekin sen uni yashirganing kerak edi, menga bo'lgan kam ishonching meni xafa qiladi, va men seni yo'qotganingni ko'rayotganimdan ko'ra, men buni bilmasimdan oldin."

en: However, since the case is so, that which had he lived, I had gladly done him, to con- tent thee, to wit, honour, as to my son-in-law, be it done him, now he is dead.’ Then, turning to his sons and his kinsfolk, he commanded that great and honourable obsequies should be prepared for Gabriotto.
uz: Ammo, shunday bo'lgani uchun, u yashagan narsa, men uni senga sig'dirish uchun xursandchilik bilan qilgan edim, ya'ni, kuyovimga nisbatan hurmat, u bo'lsin, endi u o'ldi. Keyin o'g'illari va qarindoshlariga murojaat qilib, u Gabrielotta uchun katta va sharafli taomlar tayyorlashni buyurdi.

en: Meanwhile, the kinsmen and kinswomen of the young man, hearing the news, had ﬂocked thither, and with them well nigh all the men and women in the city.
uz: Ayni paytda, yigitning qarindoshlari va qarindoshlari bu xabarni eshitib, u yerga oqib kelishdi va ular bilan birga shahardagi barcha erkaklar va ayollar ham bor edi.

en: Therewith, the body, being laid out amiddleward the courtyard upon Andrevuola’s silken cloth and strewn with all her roses, was there not only bewept by her and his kinsfolk, but publicly mourned by well nigh all the ladies of the city and by many men, and being brought forth of the
uz: Shu bilan jasad, hovlining o'rtasiga Andrevuolaning ipak matosi ustiga yotqizilgan va barcha atirgullari bilan to'ldirilgan holda, nafaqat u va uning qarindoshlari tomonidan ko'chirilgan, balki shaharning barcha ayollari va ko'plab erkaklar tomonidan ommaviy ravishda motam tutilgan va olib kelingan edi.

en: courtyard of the Seignory, not as that of a plebeian, but as that of a noble- man, it was with the utmost honour borne to the sepulchre upon the shoulders of the most noble citizens.
uz: Sayyora hovlisi plebeyn hovlisi kabi emas, balki olijanob odam hovlisi kabi edi, u eng olijanob fuqarolarning yelkalariga eng katta sharaf bilan qabrga olib borilgan edi.

en: Some days thereafterward, the Provost ensuing that which he had demanded, Messer Negro propounded it to his daughter, who would hear nought thereof, but, her father being willing to comply with her in this, she and her maid made themselves nuns in a con- vent very famous for sanctity and there lived honourably a great while after.”
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, Payg'ambar o'zi talab qilgan narsani amalga oshirib, Messer Negro buni o'z qiziga taklif qildi, u bu haqda hech narsa eshitmas edi, lekin otasi unga bu borada rozi bo'lishga tayyor bo'lgani uchun, u va uning xizmatchisi o'zlarini muqaddaslik uchun juda mashhur bo'lgan bir maskanda rohibalar qildilar va u yerda ancha vaqt hurmat bilan yashadilar.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Simona loveth Pasquino and they being together in a garden, the latter rubbeth a leaf of sage against his teeth and dieth.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA: Simona Paskinoni yaxshi ko'radi va ular bog'da birga bo'lishganda, oxirgilari tishlariga hikmat bargi urib, o'ladi.

en: She, being taken and thinking to show the judge how her lover died, rubbeth one of the same leaves against her teeth and dieth on like wise.
uz: U olib ketilayotganda, sudyaga sevgilisi qanday o'lganini ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lib, rubbeth tishlariga bir xil varaq qoldirib, dono kabi o'ladi.

en: Pamﬁlo having delivered himself of his story, the king, showing no compas- sion for Andrevuola, looked at Emilia and signed to her that it was his pleasure she should with a story follow on those who had already told; whereupon she, without delay, began as follows: “Dear companions, the story told by Pamﬁlo putteth me in mind to tell you one in nothing like unto his save that like as Andrevuola lost her beloved in a garden, even so did she of whom I have to tell, and being taken in like manner as was Andre- vuola, freed herself from the court, not by dint of fortitude nor constancy, but by an unlooked-for death.
uz: Pamfilo o'z hikoyasini aytib bo'lgach, podshoh Andrevuolaga hech qanday rahm-shafqat ko'rsatmay, Emiliyaga qaradi va unga aytdiki, u allaqachon aytib berganlarga hikoya qilishdan mamnun bo'lishi kerak edi; shundan so'ng, u kechiktirmasdan quyidagicha boshladi: "Aziz hamrohlar, Pamfilo aytgan hikoya menga o'ziga o'xshash hech narsa haqida sizga aytishga undaydi, faqat Andrevuola bog'da sevgilisini yo'qotganidek, xuddi Andrevuola aytganidek, va Andre-vuolaga o'xshab, suddan ozod bo'lib, na kuch, na doimiylik, balki ko'rib chiqilmagan o'lim tufayli.

en: And as hath otherwhile been said amongst us, albeit Love liefer inhabiteth the houses of the great, yet not therefor doth he decline the empery of those of the poor; nay, whiles in these latter he so manifesteth his power that he maketh himself feared, as a most puissant sei- gnior, of the richer sort.
uz: Va boshqalar ham bizda aytganidek, garchi Sevgi buyuklarning uylarida yashasa ham, u kambag'allarning imperatorligini rad etmaydi; aksincha, bu oxirgilarda u o'z kuchini shunday namoyon etadi, o'zini eng qudratli, boyroq turdagi eng qudratli zot kabi qo'rqitadi.

en: This, if not in all, yet in great part, will appear from my story, with which it pleaseth me to re-enter our own city, wherefrom this day, discoursing diversely of divers things and ranging over various parts of the world, we have so far departed.
uz: Bu, agar hamma narsada bo'lmasa ham, ko'p jihatdan, mening hikoyamdan ko'rinadi, u bilan o'z shahrimizga qaytishdan mamnunman, u yerdan bugungi kunga kelib, turli xil narsalarni muhokama qilib va dunyoning turli burchaklarida tarqalgan holda, biz shu qadar uzoq yo'lga chiqqanmiz.

en: There was, then, no great while ago, in Florence a damsel very handsome and agreeable, according to her condition, who was the daughter of a poor father and was called Simona; and although it behoved her with her own hands earn the bread she would eat and sustain her life by spinning wool, she was not therefor of so poor a spirit but that she dared to admit into her heart Love, which —by means of the pleasing words and fashions of a youth
uz: Shunday qilib, ancha avval Florensiyada juda chiroyli va yoqimli bir qiz bor edi, uning holatiga ko'ra, u kambag'al otaning qizi edi va Simona deb atalgan edi; va garchi u o'z qo'llari bilan yeyishi kerak bo'lgan nonni ishlab, jun o'rash orqali hayotini ta'minlashi kerak bo'lsa ham, u shunchalik kambag'al ruh emas edi, balki o'z qalbiga sevgi kiritishga jur'at etdi, bu  yoqimli so'zlar va modalar orqali...

en: of no greater account than herself, who went giving wool to spin for a mas- ter of his, a wool-monger —had long made a show of wishing to enter there.
uz: O'zidan ko'ra kattaroq hisob yo'q edi, u o'zining xo'jayini, jun sotuvchisi uchun jun aylantirishga borgan edi  u yerga kirishni xohlaganini allaqachon ko'rsatgan edi.

en: Having, then, received Him into her bosom with the pleasing aspect of the youth who loved her whose name was Pasquino, she heaved a thousand sighs, hotter than ﬁre, at every hank of yarn she wound about the spindle, bethinking her of him who had given it her to spin and ardently desiring, but venturing not to do more.
uz: Shunday qilib, Uni Paskino ismli sevgan yosh yigitning yoqimli qiyofasi bilan bag'riga olganidan so'ng, u olovdan ham issiqroq ming nafas tashladi, har bir ip bo'lagida shpindel atrofida o'raladi, uni aylantirishga bergan va ishtiyoq bilan xohlagan odam haqida o'ylab, lekin bundan ortig'ini qilmaslikka jur'at etdi.

en: He, on his side, grown exceeding anxious that his master’s wool should be well spun, overlooked Simona’s spinning more diligently than that of any other, as if the yarn spun by her alone and none other were to furnish forth the whole cloth; wherefore, the one soliciting and the other delighting to be solicited, it befell that, he growing bolder than of his wont and she laying aside much of the timidity and shamefastness she was used to feel, they gave themselves up with a common accord to mutual pleasures, which were so pleasing to both that not only did neither wait to be bidden thereto of the other, but each forewent other in the matter of invitation.
uz: U, o'z tomoni bilan, xo'jayinining junini yaxshi o'rashidan haddan tashqari xavotirda o'sib, Simonaning har qanday boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq astoydil o'ralayotgandek, go'yo o'zi o'ragan ip butun matoni ta'minlayotgandek; shuning uchun, birlari iltijo qilgan va ikkinchisi so'ralganidan xursand bo'lgan, shunday bo'ldiki, u o'z odatidan ko'ra jasurroq bo'lib, u his qiladigan uyatchanlik va uyatchanlikning ko'p qismini chetga surib, ular o'zaro quvonchlarga umumiy rozilik bilan voz kechdilar, bular ham ikkalasi uchun ham juda yoqimli edi, nafaqat bir-biridan taklif qilinishni kutishardi, balki taklif qilish masalasida ham bir-birini o'zlaridan tiyishardi.

en: Ensuing this their delight from day to day and waxing ever more en- kindled for continuance, it chanced one day that Pasquino told Simona he would fain have her ﬁnd means to come to a garden, whither he wished to carry her so they might there foregather more at their ease and with less suspect.
uz: Shu sababli ularning kun sayin zavqi kuchayib, davomiylikka tobora ko'proq intilishi sababli, bir kuni Paskino Simonaga uni bog'ga olib borishni xohlagan holda topishini aytdi, shunda ular u yerda ko'proq bemalol va kamroq gumon bilan yig'ilishlari mumkin edi.

en: Simona answered that she would well and accordingly on Sunday, after eating, giving her father to believe that she meant to go a-pardoning to San Gallo,252 she betook herself, with a friend of hers, called Lagina, to the garden appointed her of Pasquino.
uz: Simona javob berdi: "Yakshanba kuni yaxshi bo'ladi va shunga ko'ra, ovqatdan keyin otasiga San Galloga kechirim so'rab bormoqchi ekanligiga ishontirib, 252 o'zini Lagina ismli do'sti bilan Pasquino tomonidan tayinlangan bog'ga olib bordi."

en: There she found him with a comrade of his, whose name was Puccino, but who was commonly called Stramba,253 and an amorous acquaintance being quickly clapped up between the latter and Lagina, Simona and her lover withdrew to one part of the garden, to do their pleasure, leaving Stramba and Lagina in another.
uz: U yerda uni Puccino ismli o'zining o'rtog'i bilan topdi, lekin u odatda Stramba deb atalardi. 253 va oxirgi va Lagina o'rtasida tezda sevgi tanishlari qo'shilib ketgach, Simona va uning sevgilisi bog'ning bir qismiga chekindilar, o'z zavqlarini bajarish uchun Stramba va Laginani boshqa joyda qoldirishdi.

en: Now in that part of the garden, whither Pasquino and Simona had be- taken themselves, was a very great and goodly bush of sage, at the foot whereof they sat down and solaced themselves together a great while, hold- ing much discourse of a collation they purposed to make there at their leis- ure.
uz: Endi bog'ning o'sha qismida, Paskino va Simona o'zlari olib ketilgan joyda, juda katta va yaxshi donishmandlar butalari bor edi. Ular uning etagida o'tirishdi va uzoq vaqt birga tasalli berishdi, o'z vaqtlarida u yerda tayyorlamoqchi bo'lgan taom haqida ko'p gapirishardi.

en: Presently, Pasquino turned to the great sage-bush and plucking a leaf thereof, began to rub his teeth and gums withal, avouching that sage cleaned them excellent well of aught that might be left thereon after eating.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda Paskino buyuk hikmatli butaga o'girilib, uning bir bargini yulib, tishlari va sonlarini maydalab ishqalashni boshladi, chunki hikmatli hikmatli ularda ovqatdan keyin qolishi mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib bir quduqni tozalardi.

en: After he had thus rubbed them awhile, he returned to the subject of the col- lation, of which he had already spoken, nor had he long pursued his dis-
uz: U ularni bir oz ishqalagandan so'ng, u allaqachon gapirgan va uzoq vaqt davomida o'z shogirdlarini izlamagan aloqa mavzusiga qaytdi.

en: course when he began altogether to change countenance and well nigh im- mediately after lost sight and speech, and in a little while he died.
uz: Qachonki u ko'rinishi va nutqini yo'qotgandan so'ng butunlay ko'rinishini o'zgartira boshladi va bir ozdan so'ng vafot etdi.

en: Simona, seeing this, fell to weeping and crying out and called Stramba and Lagina, who ran thither in haste and seeing Pasquino not only dead, but already grown all swollen and full of dark spots about his face and body, Stramba cried out of a sudden, ‘Ah, wicked woman!
uz: Buni ko'rib, Simona yig'lab, baqirib yubordi va shoshilib u yerga yugurib borgan Stramba va Laginani chaqirib, Paskino nafaqat o'lik, balki yuzida va tanasida allaqachon shishgan va qora dog'lar paydo bo'lganini ko'rdi. Stramba birdaniga: "Oh, yomon ayol!" deb baqirdi.

en: Thou hast poisoned him.’ Mak- ing a great outcry, he was heard of many who dwelt near the garden and who, running to the clamour, found Pasquino dead and swollen.
uz: Sen uni zaharlading. Buyuk faryod qilib, u bog' yaqinida yashovchi va shov-shuvga yugurib, Paskinoni o'lik va shishgan holda topgan ko'pchilik haqida eshitdi.

en: Hearing Stramba lamenting and accusing Simona of having poisoned him of her malice, whilst she, for dolour of the sudden mishap that had carried off her lover, knew not how to excuse herself, being as it were beside her- self, they all concluded that it was as he said; and accordingly she was taken and carried off, still weeping sore, to the Provost’s palace, where, at the in- stance of Stramba and other two comrades of Pasquino, by name Atticciato and Malagevole, who had come up meanwhile, a judge addressed himself without delay to examine her of the fact and being unable to discover that she had done malice in the matter or was anywise guilty, he bethought him- self, in her presence, to view the dead body and the place and manner of the mishap, as recounted to him by her, for that he apprehended it not very well by her words.
uz: Stramba uni o'z yovuzligi uchun zaharlaganlikda shikoyat qilayotganini eshitib va Simonani ayblayotganini eshitib, u o'z sevgilisini o'ldirgan to'satdan sodir bo'lgan baxtsiz hodisa uchun o'zini qanday oqlashni bilmas edi, go'yo o'zi yonida bo'lgani uchun, hamma uning aytganidek degan xulosaga keldi; va shunga ko'ra u hali ham og'riq bilan yig'lab, Provost saroyiga olib ketildi. U yerda, Stramba va Pasquino'ning boshqa ikki o'rtog'i, Atticciato va Malagevola ismli, shu bilan birga kelgan holda, sudya uni faktni tekshirmasdan o'zini aybdor deb hisoblamadi va u bu ishda yovuzlik qilganini yoki hech qanday aybdor ekanligini aniqlamadi, u uni o'ziga ko'rib, uning o'zi bilan bog'liqligini ko'rish uchun, uning o'zini ko'rganish va uning o'limiga yo'l qo'yishi kerak deb hisobladi.

en: Accordingly, he let bring her, without any stir, whereas Pasquino’s body lay yet, swollen as it were a tun, and himself following her thither, mar- velled at the dead man and asked her how it had been; whereupon, going up to the sage-bush, she recounted to him all the foregoing story and to give him more fully to understand how the thing had befallen, she did even as Pasquino had done and rubbed one of the sage-leaves against her teeth.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uni hech qanday harakatsiz olib kelishga ruxsat berdi, Paskinoning tanasi hali ham xuddi tun kabi shishgan holda yotgan edi va o'zi ham unga ergashib, o'lik odamga hayrat bilan qarab, undan nima bo'lgani haqida so'radi; shundan so'ng, dono-bushga chiqib, u unga yuqoridagi barcha hikoyani aytib berdi va voqea qanday sodir bo'lganini yanada to'liq tushunish uchun, xuddi Paskinoning qilganidek qildi va dono-barglardan birini tishlariga ishqadi.

en: Then —whilst her words were, in the judge’s presence, ﬂouted by Stramba and Atticciato and the other friends and comrades of Pasquino as frivolous and vain and they all denounced her wickedness with the more instance, de- manding nothing less than that the ﬁre should be the punishment of such perversity —the wretched girl, who abode all confounded for dolour of her lost lover and fear of the punishment demanded by Stramba fell, for having rubbed the sage against her teeth, into that same mischance, whereinto her lover had fallen [and dropped dead], to the no small wonderment of as many as were present.
uz: Keyin  garchi uning so'zlari, sudya huzurida, Stramba va Atticciato va Paskinoning boshqa do'stlari va o'rtoqlari tomonidan beparvo va behuda deb e'tiroz bildirilgan bo'lsa-da, va ularning barchasi uning yovuzligini yanada ko'proq qoralab, olov bunday buzuqlikning jazosi bo'lishi kerakligini buyurgan bo'lsa ham  bechora qiz, yo'qotilgan sevgilisining jazosidan va Stramba talab qilgan jazo qo'rquvidan butunlay hayratda qolgan, donishmandni tishlariga ishqalab, o'sha baxtsizlikka, uning sevgilisi tushib ketgan joyga, kelganlarning hech qanday kichik ajablanishiga tushdi.

en: O happy souls, to whom it fell in one same day to terminate at once your fervent love and your mortal life!
uz: Ey baxtli jonlar, sizlarga bir kunda bir zumda o'tkir muhabbatingizni va o'lmas hayotingizni tugatish nasib etdi!

en: Happier yet, an ye went together to one same place!
uz: Bundan ham baxtliroq, sizlar bir joyga birga bordingiz!

en: And most happy, if folk love in the other
uz: Va eng baxtiyor, agar xalq sevganda boshqa...

en: life and ye love there as you loved here below!
uz: Hayot va siz u yerda sevasiz, xuddi quyida sevganingizdek!

en: But happiest beyond com- pare —at least in our judgment who abide after her on life —was Simona’s soul, whose innocence fortune suffered not to fall under the testimony of Stramba and Atticciato and Malagevole, wool-carders belike or men of yet meaner condition, ﬁnding her a more honourable way, with a death like unto that of her lover, to deliver herself from their calumnies and to follow the soul, so dearly loved of her, of her Pasquino.
uz: Ammo eng baxtlisi, hech bo'lmaganda, uning hayotda davom etadigan, bizning fikrimizcha, undan keyin ham baxtliroq bo'lgan  bu Simonaning ruhi edi. Uning begunohligi Stramba va Atticciato hamda Malagevole, jun tashuvchi belike yoki undan ham yomonroq ahvoldagi odamlarning guvohligiga tushmadi, uni sevgilisining o'limi kabi, o'zini ularning tuhmatlaridan xalos qilish va unga, uning Pasquinoga juda yaqin bo'lgan ruhga ergashish uchun yanada sharafli yo'l topdi.

en: The judge, in a manner astonied, as were likewise as many as were there, at this mischance and unknowing what to say, abode long silent; then, recol- lecting himself, he said, ‘It seemeth this sage is poisonous, the which is not wont to happen of sage.
uz: Sudya, xuddi u yerda bo'lganlarning hammasi kabi hayratda bo'lib, bu xatoga va nima deyishni bilmay, uzoq jim turdi; so'ngra, o'zini qaytarib, dedi: "Ko'rinadi, bu donishmand zaharli, donishmandga bunday bo'lishi odatiy emas."

en: But, so it may not avail to offend on this wise against any other, be it cut down even to the roots and cast into the ﬁre.’ This the keeper of the garden proceeded to do in the judge’s presence, and no sooner had he levelled the great bush with the ground than the cause of the death of the two unfortunate lovers appeared; for thereunder was a toad of marvellous bigness, by whose pestiferous breath they concluded the sage to have become venomous.
uz: Lekin, bunday tarzda boshqa birovga nisbatan xafa bo'lishning foydasi bo'lmasligi uchun, hatto ildizgacha kesib, olovga tashlang. Buni bog'bon sudyaning huzurida qildi va u ikki baxtsiz oshiqning o'limi sababi paydo bo'lgandan so'ng, katta butalarni yerga tekisladi; chunki u yerda ajoyib qirg'oq bor edi, uning o'tli nafasi bilan ular donishmandni zaharli deb xulosa qilishdi.

en: None daring approach the beast, they made a great hedge of brushwood about it and there burnt it, together with the sage.
uz: Hech kim hayvonga yaqinlashishga jur'at etmadi, ular uning atrofida katta cho'tka yog'ochidan panjara yasashdi va u yerda donishmand bilan birga yoqib yuborishdi.

en: So ended the judge’s inquest upon the death of the unfortunate Pasquino, who, together with his Simona, all swollen as they were, was buried by Stramba and Atticciato and Guccio Imbratta and Malagevole in the church of St.
uz: Shunday qilib, sudyaning bechora Paskinoning o'limi haqidagi surishtiruvi yakunlandi. U o'zining Simona bilan birga, xuddi shishganidek, Stramba va Atticciato, Guccio Imbratta va Malagevole tomonidan St cherkovida dafn etildi.

en: Paul, whereof it chanced they were parishioners.”
uz: Pol, ularning cherkovi a'zolari ekanligi ehtimoli bor edi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Girolamo loveth Salvestra and being constrained by his mother’s prayers to go to Paris, returneth and ﬁndeth his mistress married; whereupon he entereth her house by stealth and dieth by her side; and he being carried to a church, Salvestra dieth beside him.
uz: Sakkizinchi Hikoya Girolamo Salvestrani yaxshi ko'radi va onasining Parijga borishga majbur bo'lgani uchun qaytib kelib, bekasini turmushga chiqqanini topdi; shundan so'ng u uning uyiga o'g'irlab kiradi va uning yonida vafot etadi; va u cherkovga olib ketilayotganda, Salvestra uning yonida vafot etadi.

en: Emilia’s story come to an end, Neiﬁle, by the king’s commandment, began thus: “There are some, noble ladies, who believe themselves to know more than other folk, albeit, to my thinking, they know less, and who, by reason thereof, presume to oppose their judgment not only to the counsels of men, but even to set it up against the very nature of things; of which presumption very grave ills have befallen aforetime, nor ever was any good known to come thereof.
uz: Emiliya hikoyasi shu tariqa yakunlandi, Neifile shohning buyrug'i bilan shunday boshlandi: Ba'zi hurmatli xonimlar o'zlarini boshqa odamlardan ko'ra ko'proq biladi deb hisoblashadi, ammo mening fikrimcha, ular kamroq biladilar va shu sababli o'z hukmlarini nafaqat odamlarning maslahatlariga qarshi, balki hatto narsalarni tabiatga qarshi qo'yishga jur'at etishadi; bu taxminlar ilgari juda og'ir illatlarga duch kelgan, undan kelib chiqishi hech qachon ma'lum bo'lmagan.

en: And for that of all natural things love is that which least brooketh contrary counsel or opposition and whose nature is such that it may lightlier consume of itself than be done away by advisement, it hath come to my mind to narrate to you a story of a lady, who, seeking to be wiser than pertained unto her and than she was, nay, than the matter com- ported in which she studied to show her wit, thought to tear out from an en- amoured heart a love which had belike been set there of the stars, and so doing, succeeded in expelling at once love and life from her son’s body.
uz: Va barcha tabiiy narsalardan sevgi eng kam qarshi maslahat yoki qarama-qarshilikka ega bo'lgan narsa va uning tabiati maslahat bilan yo'q qilinishdan ko'ra o'zini yengilroq iste'mol qilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa bo'lgani uchun, men sizga bir ayol haqidagi hikoyani aytib berishni o'yladim. U o'ziga tegishli bo'lgan va undan ko'ra donoroq bo'lishni, aksincha, o'z aql-idrokini ko'rsatish uchun o'rgangan narsasidan ko'ra, bir zumda o'g'lining tanasidan sevgi va hayotni yoritib tashlashga muvaffaq bo'lgan edi.

en: There was, then, in our city, according to that which the ancients relate, a very great and rich merchant, whose name was Lionardo Sighieri and who had by his wife a son called Girolamo, after whose birth, having duly set his affairs in order, he departed this life.
uz: O'shanda bizning shaharimizda, qadimgilarning rivoyatiga ko'ra, juda buyuk va boy savdogar bor edi. Uning ismi Lionardo Sighieri edi va uning xotini tomonidan Girolamo ismli o'g'li bor edi. Tug'ilgandan so'ng, u o'z ishlarini tartibga solib, bu hayotdan ketdi.

en: The guardians of the boy, together with his mother, well and loyally ordered his affairs, and he, growing up with his neighbour’s children, became familiar with a girl of his own age, the daugh- ter of the tailor, more than with any other of the quarter.
uz: O'g'ilning vasiylari onasi bilan birga uning ishlarini yaxshi va sadoqat bilan tartibga solishdi, va u qo'shnisining bolalari bilan birga o'sib, o'z yoshidagi qiz, tikuvchining qizi bilan mahalladagi boshqa qizlardan ko'ra ko'proq tanish bo'ldi.

en: As he waxed in age, use turned to love so great and so ardent that he was never easy save
uz: U yosh o'tishi bilan, foydalanish shunchalik buyuk va shunchalik shiddatli sevgiga aylandi, uni hech qachon osonlikcha saqlab qolmadi.

en: what time he saw her, and certes she loved him no less than she was loved of him.
uz: U uni qachon ko'rganini, va albatta, u uni undan sevilgandan kam sevmas edi.

en: The boy’s mother, observing this, many a time chid and rebuked him therefor and after, Girolamo availing not to desist therefrom, com- plained thereof to his guardians, saying to them, as if she thought, thanks to her son’s great wealth, to make an orange-tree of a bramble, ‘This boy of ours, albeit he is yet scarce fourteen years old, is so enamoured of the daughter of a tailor our neighbour, by name Salvestra, that, except we re- move her from his sight, he will peradventure one day take her to wife, without anyone’s knowledge, and I shall never after be glad; or else he will pine away from her, if he see her married to another; wherefore meseemeth, to avoid this, you were best send him somewhither far from here, about the business of the warehouse; for that, he being removed from seeing her, she will pass out of his mind and we may after avail to give him some wellborn damsel to
uz: O'g'ilning onasi buni kuzatib, ko'p sabr qildi va keyin uni tanbeh berdi. Girolamo bundan to'xtamasdan, o'z vasiylariga buni tushuntirdi va ularga shunday dedi: go'yo o'g'lining katta boyligi tufayli bir apelsin daraxti yasashni o'ylagandek, "Bu bizning o'g'limiz, garchi u hali o'n to'rt yoshda bo'lmasa ham, Salvestra ismli qo'shnimizning qizi bilan shunchalik oshiqki, agar biz uni ko'zidan ko'chirmasa, u bir kun kelib uni hech kim bilmasdan xotiniga olib ketadi va men undan keyin hech qachon xursand bo'lmayman; aks holda, agar u uni boshqaga turmushga olsa, u undan uzoqroq yuradi; shuning uchun, uni qayerga yuborish kerak bo'lsa, u uni ko'rib,

en: wife.’ The guardians answered that the lady said well and that they would do this to the best of their power; wherefore, calling the boy into the ware- house, one of them began very lovingly to bespeak him thus, ‘My son, thou art now somewhat waxen in years and it were well that thou shouldst begin to look for thyself to thine affairs; wherefore it would much content us that thou shouldst go sojourn awhile at Paris, where thou wilt see how great part of thy wealth is employed, more by token that thou wilt there become far better bred and mannered and more of worth than thou couldst here, seeing the lords and barons and gentlemen who are there in plenty and learning their usances; after which thou mayst return hither.’ The youth hearkened diligently and answered curtly that he was nowise disposed to do this, for that he believed himself able to fare as well at Florence as another.
uz: Himoyachilar javob berishdi: "Xonim yaxshi dedi va ular buni qo'llaridan kelgancha qilishadi; shuning uchun, bolani omborxonaga chaqirib, ulardan biri unga juda mehribonlik bilan shunday dedi: "O'g'lim, sen hozir biroz ulg'ayding va o'z ishlaringni izlashni boshlaganing yaxshi edi; shuning uchun Parijga bir muddat qolishing bizga juda yoqadi, u yerda sen o'z boyligingning katta qismini qanchalik sarflaganingni ko'rasan, chunki u yerda sen bu yerda ko'p bo'lgan hukmdorlar, baronlar va janoblarni ko'rib, ularning amaliyotlarini o'rganishing kerak edi."

en: The worthy men, hearing this, essayed him again with sundry discourse, but, failing to get other answer of him, told his mother, who, sore provoked thereat, gave him a sound rating, not because of his unwillingness to go to Paris, but of his enamourment; after which, she fell to cajoling him with fair words, coaxing him and praying him softly be pleased to do what his guard- ians wished; brief, she contrived to bespeak him to such purpose that he consented to go to France and there abide a year and no more.
uz: Buni eshitgan munosib odamlar uni yana turli xil bahslar bilan sinashdi, lekin undan boshqa javob ololmay, onasiga aytdilar. Ona esa, bundan qattiq jahli chiqib, unga Parijga borishni xohlamasligi uchun emas, balki muhabbati uchun yaxshi baho berdi; shundan so'ng, u uni yaxshi so'zlar bilan yo'ldan urdi, unga dalda berdi va uning qo'riqchilari xohlaganini bajarishga sekin iltijo qildi; qisqacha aytganda, u unga Fransiyaga borishga rozi bo'lishga va u yerda bir yil va undan ko'proq yashashga rozi bo'lishga harakat qildi.

en: Accordingly, ardently enamoured as he was, he betook himself to Paris and there, being still put off from one day to another, he was kept two years; at the end of which time, returning, more in love than ever, he found his Salvestra married to an honest youth, a tent maker.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'zi qanday bo'lgan bo'lsa, shunchalik oshiq bo'lib, u Parijga yo'l oldi va u yerda, bir kundan ikkinchi kungacha kechiktirilgan holda, ikki yil ushlab turildi; shu vaqt oxirida, qaytib kelganida, har qachongidan ham ko'proq sevib, Salvestraning halol yoshga, chodir yasovchiga turmushga chiqqanini topdi.

en: At this he was beyond
uz: Shu bilan u haddan tashqari edi.

en: measure woebegone; but, seeing no help for it, he studied to console him- self therefor and having spied out where she dwelt, began, after the wont of young men in love, to pass before her, expecting she should no more have forgotten him than he her.
uz: U g'amgin edi; lekin, bunga hech qanday yordam ko'rmay, uni ovutish uchun o'rganib chiqdi - shuning uchun ham u qayerda yashayotganini kuzatib, sevishgan yigitlarning odatlariga ko'ra, uning oldidan o'tishni boshladi, u uni undan ko'ra ko'proq unutmasligini kutdi.

en: But the case was otherwise; she had no more re- membrance of him than if she had never seen him; or, if indeed she re- membered aught of him, she feigned the contrary; and of this, in a very brief space of time, Girolamo became aware, to his no small chagrin.
uz: Ammo vaziyat boshqacha edi; u uni hech qachon ko'rmagandek unga nisbatan hech qanday hurmat ko'rsatmasdi; yoki, agar u undan biror narsa qabul qilmagan bo'lsa, aksincha ko'rsatdi; va bundan, juda qisqa vaqt ichida, Girolamo uning juda kichik xafaligiga ko'ra xabardor bo'ldi.

en: Nev- ertheless, he did all he might to bring himself to her mind; but, himseeming he wrought nothing, he resolved to speak with her, face to face, though he should die for it.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u o'zini uning xotirasiga olib kelish uchun bor kuchini ishga soldi; lekin, hech narsa qilmagandek tuyulgach, u u bilan yuzma-yuz gapirishga qaror qildi, garchi buning uchun o'lishi kerak bo'lsa ham.

en: Accordingly, having learned from a neighbour how her house stood, one evening that she and her husband were gone to keep wake with their neigh- bours, he entered therein by stealth and hiding himself behind certain tent cloths that were spread there, waited till, the twain having returned and got- ten them to bed, he knew her husband to be asleep; whereupon he came whereas he had seen Salvestra lay herself and putting his hand upon her breast, said softly, ‘Sleepest thou yet, O my soul?’ The girl, who was awake, would have cried out; but he said hastily, ‘For God’s sake, cry not, for I am thy Girolamo.’ She, hearing this, said, all trembling, ‘Alack, for God’s sake, Girolamo, get thee gone; the time is past when it was not for- bidden unto our childishness to be lovers.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir qo'shnidan uning uyi qanday turgani haqida eshitib, bir kuni kechqurun u va eri qo'shnilari bilan birga uyg'onish uchun ketishganini bilgach, u yashirincha kirdi va u yerda tarqalgan ba'zi chodirlar ortiga yashirinib, ular qaytib kelib, ularni yotoqqa qo'yganini bilgach, u eri uxlayotganini ko'rdi; shundan so'ng u Salvestraning o'zini ko'rib, qo'lini ko'kragiga qo'yganini ko'rib, sekinlik bilan dedi: "Endi ham uxlayapsanmi, ey mening jonim?" Uyg'ongan qiz qichqirardi; lekin u shoshilinch ravishda dedi: "Xudo uchun emas, chunki men sening Giro bo'laman." U buni eshitib, hamma titrab dedi: "Lalamo, Xudo uchun, bolajon, qichqirmoq kerak edi; o'tmish sen uchun emas edi."

en: I am, as thou seest, married and it beseemeth me no more to have regard to any man other than my husband; wherefore I beseech thee, by God the Only, to begone, for that, if my hus- band heard thee, even should no other harm ensue thereof, yet would it fol- low that I might never more avail to live with him in peace or quiet, where- as now I am beloved of him and abide with him in weal and in tranquility.’ The youth, hearing these words, was grievously endoloured and recalled to her the time past and his love no whit grown less for absence, mingling many prayers and many great promises, but obtained nothing; wherefore, desiring to die, he prayed her at last that, in requital of so much love, she would suffer him couch by her side, so he might warm himself somewhat, for that he was grown chilled, awaiting her, promising her that he would neither say aught to her nor touch her and would get
uz: Men, ko'rib turganingizdek, turmushga chiqqanman va erimdan boshqa hech kimga e'tibor berishga haqli emasman; shuning uchun men Sendan, yolg'iz Xudo bilan, boshlashni so'rayman, chunki agar xotinim senga quloq solsa, undan boshqa zarar kelmasa ham, hech qachon u bilan tinch yoki sokin yashashga qodir bo'lmasdim, chunki hozir men unga suyukdaman va u bilan tinch va osoyishta yashayman.

en: him gone, so soon as he should be a little warmed.
uz: U biroz isishi kerak bo'lgan zahotiyoq ketdi.

en: Salvestra, having some little compassion of him, granted him this he asked, upon the conditions aforesaid, and he ac- cordingly lay down beside her, without touching her.
uz: Salvestra, unga nisbatan biroz rahm-shafqat ko'rsatib, unga yuqorida aytilgan shartlarga ko'ra so'ragan narsani berdi va u unga tegmasdan, uning yoniga bemalol yotdi.

en: Then, collecting into one thought the long love he had borne her and her present cruelty and his
uz: Keyin, u unga ko'rsatgan uzoq muhabbatni, uning hozirgi shafqatsizligini va...

en: lost hope, he resolved to live no longer; wherefore, straitening in himself his vital spirits,254 he clenched his hands and died by her side, without word or motion.
uz: Umidini yo'qotdi, u endi yashashga qaror qilmadi; shuning uchun, o'zida hayotiy ruhlarini siqib, 254 qo'llarini qisdi va uning yonida so'zsiz va harakatsiz vafot etdi.

en: After a while the young woman, marvelling at his continence and fearing lest her husband should awake, began to say, ‘Alack, Girolamo, why dost thou not get thee gone?’ Hearing no answer, she concluded that he had fallen asleep and putting out her hand to awaken him, found him cold to the touch as ice, whereat she marvelled sore; then, nudging him more sharply and ﬁnding that he stirred not, she felt him again and knew that he was dead; whereat she was beyond measure woebegone and abode a great while, unknowing what she should do.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, yosh ayol uning o'zini tuta olmasligiga hayron bo'lib, erining uyg'onmasligidan qo'rqib, dedi: "Alak, Girolamo, nega ketmayapsan?" Javob eshitmasdan, u uxlaganini va uni uyg'otish uchun qo'lini cho'zganini, uni muz kabi sovuq deb topganini, u esa hayratda qoldi; keyin, uni yanada keskin itarib, u uyg'otmaganini ko'rib, u yana uni his qildi va uning o'lganini bildi; u esa o'lchovdan tashqari edi va uzoq vaqt yashadi, nima qilish kerakligini bilmas edi.

en: At last she bethought herself to try, in the person of another, what her husband should say was to do [in such a case]; wherefore, awakening him, she told him, as having happened to an- other, that which had presently betided herself and after asked him what counsel she should take thereof,255 if it should happen to herself.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'zini boshqa birovning qiyofasida erining aytishi kerak bo'lgan narsani qilishga harakat qilishga o'yladi; shuning uchun, uni uyg'otib, unga xuddi boshqa birov bilan sodir bo'lgandek, o'ziga yaqinlashib qolgan narsani aytdi va undan qanday maslahat olish kerakligini so'radi, 255 agar bu o'ziga bo'lsa.

en: The good man replied that himseemed the dead man should be quietly carried to his house and there left, without bearing any ill will thereof to the woman, who, it appeared to him, had nowise done amiss.
uz: Yaxshi odam javob berdi: "O'lik odamni tinchgina o'z uyiga olib ketish kerak deb o'ylayman va u yerda ketdim, ayolga hech qanday yomonlik qilmasdan, chunki u unga noto'g'ri ish qilgan ko'rinardi."

en: Then said Salvestra, ‘And so it behoveth us do’; and taking his hand, made him touch the dead youth; whereupon, all confounded, he arose, without entering into farther parley with his wife, and kindled a light; then, clothing the dead body in its own garments, he took it, without any delay, on his shoulders and carried it, his innocence aiding him, to the door of Girolamo’s house, where he set it down and left it.
uz: Shunda Salvestra aytdi: Shunday qilishimiz kerak; va uning qolini olib, olik yigitga tegdi; shundan song, hamma xijolat bolib, u ornidan turdi, xotini bilan uzoqqa kirmasdan, chiroq yoqdi; songra, olik jasadni oz kiyimlariga kiydirib, hech kechiktirmasdan, yelkasiga olib, begunohligi yordamida Girolamo uyining eshigiga olib bordi, u yerda uni qoydi va tashladi.

en: When the day came and Girolamo was found dead before his own door, great was outcry, especially on the part of his mother, and the physicians having examined him and searched his body everywhere, but ﬁnding no wound nor bruise whatsoever on him, it was generally concluded that he had died of grief, as was indeed the case.
uz: Kun kelib, Girolamo o'z eshigi oldida o'lik holda topilganda, ayniqsa onasi tomonidan katta faryod bo'ldi va shifokorlar uni tekshirib, butun tanasini tekshirib, lekin unda hech qanday jarohat yoki ko'karish topmagani uchun, odatda u qayg'udan vafot etgan degan xulosaga kelishdi, xuddi shunday bo'lganidek.

en: Then was the body carried into a church and the sad mother, repairing thither with many other ladies, kins- women and neighbours, began to weep without stint and make sore moan over him, according to our usance.
uz: Keyin jasad cherkovga olib kirildi va qayg'uli ona, u yerda ko'plab boshqa xonimlar, qarindosh-ayollar va qo'shnilar bilan birga tuzatib, odatimizga ko'ra, tinimsiz yig'lay boshladi va uning ustidan og'riqli ingradi.

en: What while the lamentation was at it highest, the good man, in whose house he had died, said to Salvestra, ‘Harkye, put some mantlet or other on thy head and get thee to the church whither Girolamo hath been carried and mingle with the women and hearken to that which is discoursed of the matter; and I will do the like among the men, so we may hear if aught be said against us.’ The thing
uz: Qayg'u eng yuqori cho'qqida bo'lgan paytda, u o'lgan yaxshi odam Salvestraga dedi: "Harkye, boshingga bir yoki boshqa ko'ylak kiydirib, Girolamo olib ketilgan cherkovga bor, ayollar bilan aralashib, bu borada aytilgan narsalarni tingla; va men ham erkaklar orasida xuddi shunday qilaman, shunda bizga qarshi biror narsa aytilsa, eshitamiz."

en: pleased the girl, who was too late grown pitiful and would fain look upon him, dead, whom, living, she had not willed to pleasure with one poor kiss, and she went thither.
uz: Qiz xursand bo'ldi, u juda kech achinarli bo'lib ulg'ayib, unga beparvo qarardi, o'lik, tirik bo'lib, bir bechora o'pich bilan rohatlanishni xohlamagan edi va u yerga bordi.

en: A marvellous thing it is to think how uneath to search out are the ways of love!
uz: Muhabbat yo'llari qanchalik izlashga yaroqsiz ekanligi haqida o'ylash ajoyib narsa!

en: That heart, which Girolamo’s fair fortune had not availed to open, his illhap opened and the old ﬂames reviving all therein, whenas she saw the dead face it256 melted of a sudden into such compassion that she pressed between the women, veiled as she was in the mantlet, and stayed not till she won to the body, and there, giving a terrible great shriek, she cast herself, face downward, on the dead youth, whom she bathed not with many tears, for that no sooner did she touch him than grief bereaved her of life, even as it had bereft him.
uz: Girolamo'ning boyligi ochishga ulgurmagan o'sha yurak, uning shijoati ochildi va u yerda eski olovlar jonlandi. U o'lik yuzini ko'rganida, u birdaniga shunday rahm-shafqatga eridi, u ayollarning o'rtasiga bosdi, qopqoqda bo'lgani kabi yashirindi va u tanani yutmaguncha qolmadi, va u yerda dahshatli katta qichqiriq bilan o'zini pastga, ko'p yosh bilan cho'miltirmagan o'lik yoshga tashladi, chunki u unga tegmasdan oldin qayg'u uni hayotdan mahrum qildi, hatto uni yo'qotgan edi.

en: The women would have comforted her and bidden her arise, not yet knowing her; but after they had bespoken her awhile in vain, they sought to lift her and ﬁnding her motionless, raised her up and knew her at once for Salvestra and for dead; whereupon all who were there, overcome with double pity, set up a yet greater clamour of lamentation.
uz: Ayollar uni tasalli berishardi va turishga buyurishardi, lekin uni hali bilmaganlar; lekin behudaga ko'tarib, uni ko'tarishga harakatsiz holda topishga harakat qilishdi, uni tiriltirishdi va darhol Salvestra uchun va o'lik uchun tanishdi; shundan so'ng, u yerda bo'lganlarning hammasi, ikki marta achinib, yanada katta motam faryodini qo'zg'atdilar.

en: The news soon spread abroad among the men without the church and came presently to the ears of her husband, who was amongst them and who, without lending ear to consolation or comfort from any, wept a great while; after which he re- counted to many of those who were there the story of that which had be- fallen that night between the dead youth and his wife; and so was the cause of each one’s death made everywhere manifest, the which was grievous unto all.
uz: Xabar tez orada cherkovdan tashqari odamlarning orasida tarqaldi va tez orada ularning orasida bo'lgan va hech kimdan tasalli yoki tasalli berishga quloq solmagan erining qulog'iga yetdi. Keyin u o'sha kecha o'lgan yosh va uning xotini o'rtasida sodir bo'lgan voqeani ko'pchilikka aytib berdi; va shuning uchun har birining o'limi sababi hamma joyda ochiq edi, bu hammaga achinarli edi.

en: Then, taking up the dead girl and decking her, as they use to deck the dead, they laid her beside Girolamo on the same bier and there long be- wept her; after which the twain were buried in one same tomb, and so these, whom love had not availed to conjoin on life, death conjoined with an in- separable union.”
uz: So'ngra, o'lik qizni olib, uni o'liklarni o'ldirish uchun ishlatganidek, Girolamo yonida xuddi shu ko'rpada yotqizdilar va u yerda uzoq vaqt yig'lashdi; shundan so'ng Twainlar bir xil qabrga dafn etildilar, va shunday qilib, sevgi hayotda birlashtirishga ulgurmagan bular, o'lim ajralmas birlashuv bilan birlashgan edi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Sir Guillaume de Roussillon giveth his wife to eat the heart of Sir Guillaume de Gardestaing by him slain and loved of her, which she after coming to know, casteth herself from a high casement to the ground and dying, is buried with her lover.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA Ser Guillome de Roussillon xotiniga Ser Guillome de Gardestaingning yuragini yeyishga ruxsat beradi, u uni o'ldirgan va sevuvchi edi. U bilgach, u o'zini baland qavatdan yerga tashlaydi va o'ladi, sevgilisi bilan birga dafn etiladi.

en: Neiﬁle having made an end of her story, which had awakened no little com- passion in all the ladies her companions, the king, who purposed not to in- fringe Dioneo his privilege, there being none else to tell but they twain, began, “Gentle ladies, since you have such compassion upon ill-fortuned loves, it hath occurred to me to tell you a story whereof it will behove you have no less pity than of the last, for that those to whom that which I shall tell happened were persons of more account than those of whom it hath been spoken and yet more cruel was the mishap that befell them.
uz: Neifile o'z hikoyasini tugatgach, bu uning barcha hamrohlari xonimlarida hech qanday achinish uyg'otmagan edi. Dioneo o'z imtiyozini chetlab o'tmoqchi bo'lmagan podshoh, ularga aytadigan hech narsa yo'q edi, shunday dedi: "Janob xonimlar, siz baxtsiz sevgilarga shunchalik rahm qilganingizdan so'ng, sizga oxirgisidan kam rahm qilmasligingiz kerak bo'lgan hikoyani aytib berish o'ylanib qoldi, chunki men aytadigan narsa ularga sodir bo'lgan odamlardan ko'ra ko'proq edi va ularga yetkazilgan baxtsiz hodisa undan ham shafqatsizroq edi."

en: You must know, then, that according to that which the Provençals relate, there were aforetime in Provence two noble knights, each of whom had castles and vassals under him, called the one Sir Guillaume de Roussillon and the other Sir Guillaume de Guardestaing, and for that they were both men of great prowess in arms, they loved each other with an exceeding love and were wont to go still together and clad in the same colours to every tournament or jousting or other act of arms.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, Provensallarning rivoyat qilishicha, bir vaqtlar Provensda ikkita zodagon ritsar bo'lgan, ularning har biri uning ostida qasrlar va vasallar bo'lgan, biri Ser Guillaume de Roussillon va ikkinchisi Ser Guillaume de Guardestaing deb atalgan. Ularning ikkalasi ham qurollarda buyuk mahoratga ega odamlar bo'lgani uchun, ular bir-birlarini haddan tashqari sevgi bilan sevishgan va har bir turnirga, jangga yoki boshqa qurollarga bir xil rangda qatnashib kelishgan.

en: Although they abode each in his own castle and were distant, one from other, a good half score miles, yet it came to pass that, Sir Guillaume de Roussillon having a very fair and lovesome lady to wife, Sir Guillaume de Guardestaing, notwithstanding the friendship and fellowship that was between them, become beyond measure enamoured of her and so wrought, now with one means and now with an- other, that the lady became aware of his passion and knowing him for a very valiant knight, it pleased her and she began to return his love, insomuch that
uz: Garchi ularning har biri o'z qasrida yashagan va bir-biridan yarim ming mil uzoq bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, shunday bo'ldiki, Ser Guillaume de Roussillonning juda go'zal va yoqimli xotini bor edi, Ser Guillaume de Guardestaing, ular o'rtasidagi do'stlik va do'stlikka qaramay, unga cheksiz oshiq bo'lib qoldi va shunday qildi, endi bir yo'l bilan, endi esa boshqa yo'l bilan, xonim uning ehtirosidan xabardor bo'ldi va uni juda jasur ritsar deb biladi, bu unga yoqdi va u uning muhabbatini qaytarishni boshladi, shuning uchun

en: she desired and tendered nothing more than him nor awaited otherwhat than to be solicited of him; the which was not long in coming to pass and they foregathered once and again.
uz: U undan boshqa hech narsani xohlamadi va mehr ko'rsatmadi, undan so'rashdan boshqa narsani kutmadi; bu esa tez sodir bo'ldi va ular qayta-qayta yig'ilishdi.

en: Loving each other amain and conversing together less discreetly than be- hoved, it befell that the husband became aware of their familiarity and was mightily incensed thereat, insomuch that the great love he bore to Guardes- taing was turned into mortal hatred; but this he knew better to keep hidden than the two lovers had known to conceal their love and was fully resolved in himself to kill him.
uz: Bir-birini yaxshi ko'rish va kamroq yashirincha suhbatlashish, shunday bo'ldiki, er ularning tanishligini anglab yetdi va bundan juda g'azablandi, shu sababli Gvardiyaga bo'lgan katta muhabbati o'limga aylandi; lekin u buni yashirishni ikki sevishganidan ko'ra yaxshiroq bilardi va uni o'ldirishga to'liq qaror qildi.

en: Roussillon being in this mind, it befell that a great tourneying was proclaimed in France, the which he forthright signiﬁed to Guardestaing and sent to bid him come to him, an it pleased him, so they might take counsel together if and how they should go thither; whereto the other very joyously answered that he would without fail come to sup with him on the ensuing day.
uz: Roussillon shu fikrda bo'lgani uchun, Fransiyada buyuk turne e'lon qilindi, buni u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Guardestaingga bildirdi va unga kelishni taklif qildi, bu unga yoqdi, agar u yerga qanday borish kerak bo'lsa va qanday borish kerakligi haqida birgalikda maslahatlashishlari mumkin edi; u yerda ikkinchisi juda xursand bo'lib, u keyingi kuni albatta u bilan kechki ovqatga kelardi, deb javob berdi.

en: Roussillon, hearing this, thought the time come whenas he might avail to kill him and accordingly on the morrow he armed himself and mounting to horse with a servant of his, lay at ambush, maybe a mile from his castle, in a wood whereas Guardestaing must pass.
uz: Roussillon buni eshitib, uni o'ldirish vaqti kelganini o'yladi va shuning uchun ertasi kuni o'zini qurollantirdi va o'z xizmatkori bilan otga minib, qasridan bir mil uzoqlikda, o'rmonda yotardi, gardiostaing esa o'tishi kerak edi.

en: There after he had awaited him a good while, he saw him come, unarmed and followed by two servants in like case, as one who apprehends nothing from him; and when he saw him come whereas he would have him, he rushed out upon him, lance in hand, full of rage and malice, crying, ‘Traitor, thou art dead!’ And to say thus and to plunge the lance into his breast were one and the same thing.
uz: U yerda uni ancha kutgandan so'ng, u uni xuddi shunday holatda, hech narsani tushunmaydigan ikki xizmatkor bilan, qurolsiz kelganini ko'rdi. U uni xohlagan joyga kelganini ko'rgach, qo'lida nayza bilan yugurib, g'azab va yomonlik bilan: "Xoin, sen o'ldirilding!" - deb baqirdi. Va shunday deyish va nayzani ko'kragiga botirish bir xil edi.

en: Guardestaing, without being able to make any de- fence or even to say a word, fell from his horse, transﬁxed of the lance, and a little after died, whilst his servants, without waiting to learn who had done this, turned their horses’ heads and ﬂed as quickliest they might, towards their lord’s castle.
uz: Qo'riqchi hech qanday to'siq qo'ya olmadi, hatto bir so'z ham ayta olmadi, otidan yiqildi, nayza bilan bog'landi va birozdan keyin vafot etdi, xizmatkorlari esa buni kim qilganini bilishni kutmasdan, otlarining boshlarini burib, imkon qadar tezroq xo'jayinlarining qasriga tomon qochdilar.

en: Roussillon dismounted and opening the dead man’s breast with a knife, with his own hands tore out his heart, which he let wrap in the pennon of a lance and gave to one of his men to carry.
uz: Roussillon otdan tushdi va o'lik odamning ko'kragini pichoq bilan ochdi, o'z qo'llari bilan uning yuragini yirtib tashladi, uni nayza patasiga o'rab, o'z odamlaridan biriga olib yurishga berdi.

en: Then, com- manding that none should dare make words of the matter, he remounted, it being now night, and returned to his castle.
uz: So'ngra, hech kim bu haqda gapirishga jur'at etmasligini buyurib, u tun bo'lgani uchun, qayta ko'tarildi va o'z qasriga qaytdi.

en: The lady, who had heard that Guardestaing was to be there that evening to supper and looked for him with the utmost impatience, seeing him not come, marvelled sore and said to her husband, ‘How is it, sir, that Guardes- taing is not come?’ ‘Wife,’ answered he, ‘I have had [word] from him that he cannot be here till tomorrow’; whereat the lady abode somewhat troubled.
uz: Xonim, Guardestaing o'sha oqshom kechki ovqatga borishini eshitib, uni juda sabrsizlik bilan qidirdi, u kelmaganini ko'rib, xafa bo'lib, eriga dedi: "Qanday qilib, janob, Guardes- Thanks kelmadi?" "Xotin," dedi u, "Mendan u ertagacha bu yerda bo'la olmaydi degan xabar bor edi"; xonim esa biroz tashvish bilan turardi.

en: Roussillon then dismounted and calling the cook, said to him,
uz: Roussillon o'sha zahoti tushdi va oshpazni chaqirib, unga dedi:

en: ‘Take this wild boar’s heart and look thou make a dainty dish thereof, the best and most delectable to eat that thou knowest, and when I am at table, send it to me in a silver porringer.’ The cook accordingly took the heart and putting all his art thereto and all his diligence, minced it and seasoning it with store of rich spices, made of it a very dainty ragout.
uz: Bu yovvoyi cho'chqaning yuragini ol va undan mazali taom yasang, o'zing biladigan eng yaxshi va mazali taomni, va men dasturxonda bo'lganimda, uni kumush maydalangan holda menga yubor. Oshpaz shunga ko'ra yurakni oldi va butun san'atini unga va butun mehnatini sarfladi, uni maydaladi va boy ziravorlar bilan ziravorladi, uni juda mazali ziravorga aylantirdi.

en: When it was time, Sir Guillaume sat down to table with his wife and the viands came; but he ate little, being hindered in thought for the ill deed he had committed.
uz: Vaqti kelganda, Ser Guillome xotini bilan dasturxonga o'tirdi va go'shtlar keldi; lekin u kam ovqat yedi, qilgan yomon ishi uchun fikrlashdan to'sildi.

en: Presently the cook sent him the ragout, which he caused set before the lady, feigning himself disordered257 that evening and commend- ing the dish to her amain.
uz: Hozirda oshpaz unga ragoutni yubordi, uni xonimning oldiga qo'ydi, o'sha oqshom tartibsiz bo'lib ko'rsatdi va taomni unga maqtadi.

en: The lady, who was nowise squeamish, tasted thereof and ﬁnding it good, ate it all; which when the knight saw, he said to her, ‘Wife, how deem you of this dish?’ ‘In good sooth, my lord,’ answered she, ‘it liketh me exceedingly.’ Whereupon, ‘So God be mine aid,’ quoth Roussillon; ‘I do indeed believe it you, nor do I marvel if that please you, dead, which, alive, pleased you more than aught else.’ The lady, hearing this, hesitated awhile, then said, ‘How?
uz: Xonim, endi shivirlagan holda, uni tatib ko'rdi va yaxshi topdi, hammasini yedi; ritsar uni ko'rgach, unga dedi: "Xotin, bu taomni qanday his qilyapsan?" "Xotirjam bo'lding, xo'jayinim," dedi u. "Menga juda yoqadi." Shunday qilib, "Xudo menga yordam bersin," dedi Roussillon; "Men sizga chin dildan ishonaman, va siz, o'lik, tirik bo'lganingizdan ko'ra ko'proq xursand bo'lganingizdan hayron bo'lmayman." Xonim buni eshitib, biroz ikkilanib qoldi va dedi: "Qanday qilib?"

en: What have you made me eat?’ ‘This that you have eaten,’ answered the knight, ‘was in very truth the heart of Sir Guillaume de Guardestaing, whom you, disloyal wife as you are, so loved; and know for certain that it is his very heart, for that I tore it from his breast with these hands a little before my return.’ It needeth not to ask if the lady were woebegone, hearing this of him whom she loved more than aught else; and after awhile she said, ‘You have done the deed of a disloyal and base knight, as you are; for, if I, unenforced of him, made him lord of my love and therein offended against you, not he, but I should have borne the penalty thereof.
uz: Meni nima yeyishga majbur qildingiz? Siz yegan narsa,  javob berdi ritsar,  haqiqatan ham sir Guillaume de Guardestaingning yuragi edi, uni siz, sadoqatsiz xotin kabi, juda yaxshi ko'rar edingiz; va aniq bilingki, bu uning yuragidir, chunki men uni qaytib kelishimdan biroz oldin shu qo'llarim bilan ko'kragidan yirtib tashladim.
