Xonim uni boshqa narsadan ko'ra ko'proq sevgan odamdan eshitib xafa bo'lganmi, deb so'ramasligi kerak emas, lekin biroz vaqtdan keyin u dedi: Siz siz kabi sadoqatsiz va past ritsarlik ishini qildingiz; chunki, agar men uni zo'ravonligimdan o'zib, uni o'z sevgim hukmdoriga aylantirgan bo'lsam va u sizga qarshi xafa bo'lgan bo'lsam, men uning jazosini ko'targan bo'lardim.

en: But God forfend that ever other victual should follow upon such noble meat the heart of so valiant and so courteous a gentleman as was Sir Guillaume de Guardestaing!’ Then, rising to her feet, without any manner of hesitation, she let herself fall backward through a window which was behind her and which was exceeding high above the ground; wherefore, as she fell, she was not only killed, but well nigh broken in pieces.
uz: Lekin Xudo saqlasin, bunday olijanob go'shtga sir Guillaume de Guardestaing kabi jasur va odobli janobning yuragi ergashib ketmasin! Keyin, oyoqqa turib, hech qanday ikkilanishsiz, u orqasida turgan va yer ustida juda baland bo'lgan deraza orqali orqaga yiqildi; shuning uchun, yiqilganda, u nafaqat o'ldirildi, balki deyarli parchalanib ketdi.

en: Sir Guillaume, seeing this, was sore dismayed and himseemed he had done ill; wherefore, being adread of the country people and of the Count of Provence, he let saddle his horses and made off.
uz: Ser Guillome buni ko'rib, juda xavotirda qoldi va go'yo yomonlik qilgan deb o'yladi; shuning uchun, qishloq xalqidan va Provans grafidan nafratlanib, otlarini egar qilib, yo'lga chiqdi.

en: On the morrow it was known all over the country how the thing had passed; whereupon the two bodies were, with the utmost grief and lamentation, taken up by Guardesta- ing’s people and those of the lady and laid in one same sepulchre in the
uz: Ertasi kuni butun mamlakat bo'ylab voqea qanday sodir bo'lgani ma'lum bo'ldi; shundan so'ng, ikki jasad, eng katta qayg'u va motam bilan, Gvardiya xodimlari va xonimning xodimlari tomonidan ko'tarilib, bir xil qabrga qo'yildi.

en: chapel of the latter’s own castle; and thereover were verses written, signify- ing who these were that were buried therewithin and the manner and occa- sion of their death.”258
uz: Ikkinchisining o'z qal'asining ibodatxonasi; va ustiga o'sha yerda dafn etilganlar kim ekanligi va ularning o'limining usuli va holatini ko'rsatuvchi misralar yozilgan edi.258

en: THE TENTH STORY A physician’s wife putteth her lover for dead in a chest, which two usurers carry off to their own house, gallant and all.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Bir shifokorning xotini sevgilisini o'lik deb sandiqqa qo'ydi, uni ikki pulxo'r o'z uyiga olib ketadi, go'zal va hamma.

en: The latter, who is but drugged, cometh presently to himself and being discovered, is taken for a thief; but the lady’s maid avoucheth to the seignory that she herself had put him into the chest stolen by the two usurers, whereby he escapeth the gallows and the thieves are amerced in certain monies.
uz: Oxirgisi, faqatgina giyohvand moddalar bilan mast bo'lgan, tez orada o'ziga keladi va aniqlanadi, o'g'ri deb topiladi; lekin xonimning xizmatkori uni o'zi ikki pul o'g'irlari tomonidan o'g'irlangan sandiqqa joylashtirganini ma'lum qiladi, shu orqali u osishdan qochadi va o'g'rilar ma'lum miqdorda pulga qo'lga kiritadilar.

en: Filostrato having made an end of his telling, it rested only with Dioneo to accomplish his task, who, knowing this and it being presently commanded him of the king, began as follows: “The sorrows that have been this day re- lated of ill fortuned loves have saddened not only your eyes and hearts, ladies, but mine also; wherefore I have ardently longed for an end to be made thereof.
uz: Filostrato o'z so'zini tugatgach, vazifasini bajarish faqat Dioneoga qoldi. Dioneo buni bilgach va bu unga podshoh tomonidan buyurilib, quyidagicha boshladi: Bugun baxtsiz muhabbatlar bilan qayta-qayta bog'langan qayg'ular nafaqat ko'zlaringizni va yuraklaringizni, balki mening ham qayg'uga soldi, xonimlar; shuning uchun men bundan yakun topishni juda xohladim.

en: Now that, praised be God, they are ﬁnished (except I should choose to make an ill addition to such sorry ware, from which God keep me!), I will, without farther ensuing so dolorous a theme, begin with some- thing blither and better, thereby perchance affording a good argument for that which is to be related on the ensuing day.
uz: Endi, Xudoga hamd bo'lsin, ular tugagandan so'ng (agar men bunday achinarli buyumlarga yomon qo'shimcha qilishni tanlamasam, Xudo meni undan saqlasin!), men, shunchalik og'riqli mavzuni davom ettirmasdan, nimadir yaxshiroq va yaxshiroq narsa bilan boshlayman, shu bilan keyingi kunda tegishli bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsa uchun yaxshi dalil taqdim etaman.

en: You must know, then, fairest lasses, that there was in Salerno, no great while since, a very famous doctor in surgery, by name Master Mazzeo della Montagna, who, being already come to extreme old age, took to wife a fair and gentle damsel of his city and kept better furnished with sumptuous and rich apparel and jewels and all that can pleasure a lady than any woman of the place.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, eng go'zal qizlar, Salernoda, o'shandan beri ancha vaqt o'tmay, juda mashhur jarrohlik shifokori bo'lgan, o'sha ismli Ustoz Mazzeo della Montagna, allaqachon juda keksa bo'lib, o'z shahrining go'zal va muloyim kampirini xotinlikka oldi va hashamatli va boy kiyimlar, taqinchoqlar va u yerdagi har qanday ayoldan ko'ra xonimni xursand qila oladigan hamma narsa bilan yaxshiroq ta'minlandi.

en: True it is she went a-cold most of her time, being kept of her hus- band ill covered abed; for, like as Messer Ricardo di Chinzica (of whom we already told) taught his wife to observe saints’ days and holidays, even so the doctor pretended to her that once lying with a woman necessitated I know not how many days’ study to recruit the strength and the like toys;
uz: To'g'ri, u ko'p vaqtini sovuqdan o'tkazdi, xotini bilan yomon yotoq ostida ushlab turilgan edi; chunki, mas'ul Ricardo di Chinzica (uning haqida allaqachon aytib o'tganimizdek) xotiniga avliyolarning kunlari va bayramlarini kuzatishni o'rgatganidek, shifokor ham unga ayol bilan yotgandan so'ng, kuchni jalb qilish uchun necha kun o'qish kerakligini bilmayman, deb o'ylagan edi.

en: whereof she abode exceeding ill content and like a discreet and high-spir- ited woman as she was, bethought herself, so she might the better husband the household good, to betake herself to the highway and seek to spend oth- ers’ gear.
uz: U haddan tashqari norozilik bilan yashadi va o'zi qanday bo'lsa, o'zini ham shunday yashirin va yuqori ruhli ayol kabi o'yladi, shunday qilib u uy xo'jaligi uchun yaxshiroq er bo'lishi mumkin edi, o'zini yo'lga qo'yib, boshqa narsalarni sarflashga harakat qiladi.

en: To this end, considering divers young men, at last she found one to her mind and on him she set all her hope; whereof he becoming aware and she pleasing him mightily, he in like manner turned all his love upon her.
uz: Shu maqsadda, turli xil yigitlarni hisobga olgan holda, u nihoyat bir yigitni xotirasiga soldi va unga butun umidini qo'ydi; u buni anglab yetdi va u uni juda mamnun qildi, xuddi shunday qilib u ham butun muhabbatini unga qaratdi.

en: The spark in question was called Ruggieri da Jeroli, a man of noble birth, but of lewd life and blameworthy carriage, insomuch that he had left him- self neither friend nor kinsman who wished him well or cared to see him and was defamed throughout all Salerno for thefts and other knaveries of the vilest; but of this the lady recked little, he pleasing her for otherwhat, and with the aid of a maid of hers, she wrought on such wise that they came together.
uz: Mavzudagi uchqun Ruggieri da Jeroli deb atalgan edi, olijanob nasldan bo'lgan, lekin behayo turmush tarzi va aybdor yurish odati bor odam edi, chunki u uni tashlab ketgan edi  na do'sti, na qarindoshi, unga yaxshilik tilaydigan, na uni ko'rishga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan va butun Salernoni o'g'irlik va boshqa yovuzlik uchun tuhmat qilingan edi; lekin bu haqda xonim unchalik ahamiyat bermadi, u uni boshqa narsa bilan maqtadi va xizmatkorining yordami bilan u shunday donolikka erishdiki, ular birga kelishdi.

en: After they had taken some delight, the lady proceeded to blame his past way of life and to pray him, for the love of her, to desist from these ill fashions; and to give him the means of doing this, she fell to succouring him, now with one sum of money and now with another.
uz: Ular bir oz zavq olgandan so'ng, xonim uning o'tmishdagi turmush tarzini ayblashga va unga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun bu yomon odatlardan voz kechish uchun ibodat qilishga kirishdi; va unga buni qilish imkoniyatini berish uchun, u unga yordam berishga tushdi, hozir bir pul bilan, endi esa boshqa bilan.

en: On this wise they abode together, using the utmost discretion, till it befell that a sick man was put into the doctor’s hands, who had a gangrened leg, and Master Mazzeo, having examined the case, told the patient’s kinsfolk that, except a decayed bone he had in his leg were taken out, needs must he have the whole limb cut off or die, and that, by taking out the bone, he might recover, but that he would not undertake him otherwise than for a dead man; to which those to whom the sick man pertained agreed and gave the latter into his hands for such.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan birga yashashdi, toki kasal odamning oyog'i gangren bo'lgan shifokorning qo'liga topshirilmaguncha. Ustoz Mazzeo ishni ko'rib chiqqach, bemorning qarindoshlariga uning oyog'idagi chirigan suyakdan tashqari, butun a'zosi kesilishi kerak yoki o'lishi kerakligini va suyakni olib tashlab, tuzalib ketishi mumkinligini, lekin u uni o'lik odam uchun boshqa yo'l bilan qabul qilmasligini aytdi. Bu haqda kasal odamga tegishli bo'lganlar rozi bo'lishdi va buni qo'liga berishdi.

en: The doctor, judging that the patient might not brook the pain nor would suffer himself to be operated, without an opiate, and having appoin- ted to set about the matter at evensong, let that morning distil a certain wa- ter of his composition, which being drunken by the sick man, should make him sleep so long as he deemed necessary for the performing of the opera- tion upon him, and fetching it home, set it in his chamber, without telling any what it was.
uz: Shifokor bemorning og'rig'ini yengib bo'lmasligini, o'zini afsussiz operatsiya qilinishiga yo'l qo'ymasligini va bu masalani kechqurun boshlashga tayinlanganini hisoblab, o'sha kuni ertalab bemor uni mast qilgani sababli, operatsiyani o'ziga zarur deb hisoblagancha uxlatishi kerakligini aytdi va uni uyga olib kelib, xonasiga joylashtirdi, hech kimga aytmasdan.

en: The hour of vespers come and the doctor being about to go to the patient in question, there came to him a messenger from certain very great friends of his at Malﬁ, charging him fail not for anything to repair thither incontin- ent, for that there had been a great fray there, in which many had been wounded.
uz: Kechki ovqatlar vaqti keldi va shifokor savolli bemorga bormoqchi bo'lganida, uning oldiga Malfi shahridagi ba'zi juda buyuk do'stlaridan xabar keldi va unga u yerda hech narsani tuzatishga urinmaslikni so'radi, chunki u yerda katta janjal bo'lgan edi, unda ko'p odamlar yaralangan edi.

en: Master Mazzeo accordingly put off the tending of the leg until the ensuing morning and going aboard a boat, went off to Malﬁ, whereupon
uz: Ustoz Mazzeo oyoq parvarishini ertasi kungacha kechiktirdi va qayiqqa chiqib, Malfiga jo'nab ketdi, shundan so'ng...

en: his wife, knowing that he would not return home that night, let fetch Rug- gieri, as of her wont, and bringing him into her chamber, locked him there- within, against certain other persons of the house should be gone to sleep.
uz: Uning xotini, o'sha kechasi uyiga qaytmasligini bilgan holda, Rug-gieri odatdagidek olib kelinadi va uni o'z xonasiga olib kirsin, u yerda qulflab qo'ysin, chunki uyning boshqa ba'zi bir a'zolari uxlab qolishi kerak edi.

en: Ruggieri, then, abiding in the chamber, awaiting his mistress, and being — whether for fatigue endured that day or salt meat that he had eaten or maybe for usance —sore, athirst, caught sight of the ﬂagon of water, which the doc- tor had prepared for the sick man and which stood in the window, and deeming it drinking water, set it to his mouth and drank it all off; nor was it long ere a great drowsiness took him and he fell asleep.
uz: Ruggieri esa xonada o'tirib, bekasini kutib turardi va  o'sha kuni charchoq tufayli bardosh bergan bo'lsa ham, yoki u yeygan tuzli go'shtmi yoki ehtimol odat uchunmi  tashna bo'lib, shifokor kasal odam uchun tayyorlagan va deraza oldida turgan suv idishini ko'rib qoldi va uni ichayotgan suv deb hisoblab, og'ziga qo'ydi va hammasini ichdi; va ko'p o'tmay uni katta uyqu bosdi va u uxladi.

en: The lady came to the chamber as ﬁrst she might and ﬁnding Ruggieri asleep, nudged him and bade him in a low voice arise, but to no effect, for he replied not neither stirred anywhit; whereat she was somewhat vexed and nudged him more sharply, saying, ‘Get up, slugabed!
uz: Xonim imkon qadar birinchi bo'lib xonaga keldi va Ruggieri uxlayotganini topdi, uni itarib yubordi va past ovozda ta'zim qildi, lekin hech qanday natija bermadi, chunki u javob bermadi va hech qanday xafa bo'lmadi; shu bilan birga u biroz g'azablanib, uni yanada keskin itarib dedi: "Tur, qul!"

en: An thou hadst a mind to sleep, thou shouldst have betaken thee to thine own house and not come hither.’ Ruggieri, being thus pushed, fell to the ground from a chest whereon he lay and gave no more sign of life than a dead body; whereupon the lady, now somewhat alarmed, began to seek to raise him up and to shake him more roughly, tweaking him by the nose and plucking him by the beard, but all in vain; he had tied his ass to a fast picket.259 At this she began to fear lest he were dead; nevertheless she proceeded to pinch him sharply and burn his ﬂesh with a lighted taper, but all to no purpose; wherefore, being no doctress, for all her husband was a physician, she doubted not but he was dead in very deed.
uz: Uxlashing kerak edi, o'z uyingga qaytishing kerak edi va bu yerga kelmasliging kerak edi. Ruggieri, shunday itarib yuborilgan holda, u yotgan ko'kragidan yerga yiqildi va o'lik jasaddan boshqa tiriklik alomatini bermadi; shundan so'ng xonim, biroz xavotirda, uni ko'tarishga va uni qo'polroq silkitishga harakat qildi, burundan ushladi va soqolini yirtib tashladi, lekin bularning bari behuda edi; u uning eshagini qattiq piquetga bog'lagan edi.

en: Loving him over all else as she did, it needeth no asking if she were woebegone for this and daring not make any outcry, she silently fell a-weeping over him and bewailing so sore a mishap.
uz: Uni o'zi sevganidek sevish, buning uchun qayg'uga botganmi yoki yo'qmi, so'rash shart emas va hech qanday shikoyat qilmaslikka jur'at etardi, u jimgina uning ustidan yig'lab yig'ladi va juda og'riqli baxtsiz hodisa haqida qayg'urdi.

en: After awhile, fearing to add shame to her loss, she bethought herself that it behoved her without delay ﬁnd a means of carrying the dead man forth of the house and knowing not how to contrive this, she softly called her maid and discovering to her her misadventure sought counsel of her.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, o'z yo'qotishlariga sharmandalik qo'shishdan qo'rqib, u o'ziga o'sha o'likni uydan olib chiqish yo'lini topishi kerak deb o'yladi va buni qanday yasashni bilmay, asta-sekin xizmatkorini chaqirib, o'z baxtsiz hodisasini bilib, undan maslahat so'radi.

en: The maid marvelled exceedingly and herself pulled and pinched Ruggieri, but, ﬁnding him without sense or motion, agreed with her mistress that he was certainly dead and counselled her put him forth of the house.
uz: Xizmatchi juda hayratda qoldi va o'zi Ruggieriyni tortdi va qisdi, lekin uni hech qanday hissiyot va harakatsiz holda topgach, xo'jayini bilan uning albatta o'lganiga rozi bo'ldi va uni uydan chiqarib yuborishni maslahat berdi.

en: Quoth the lady, ‘And where can we put him, so it may not be suspected, whenas he shall be seen tomorrow morning, that he hath been brought out hence?’ ‘Madam,’ answered the maid, ‘I saw, this evening at nightfall, over against the shop of our neighbour yonder the carpenter, a chest not overbig, the which, an the owner have not taken it in again, will come very apt for our affair; for that
uz: Xonim aytdi: Va uni qayerga qo'ysak bo'ladi, ertaga ertalab ko'rilganda, u shu yerdan olib chiqilganidan shubhalanmasligi uchun? Xonim,  javob berdi xizmatkor, Men bugun kechqurun, duradgorning qo'shnimizning do'koniga qarshida juda katta bo'lmagan sandiqni ko'rdim, uni egasi qayta qabul qilmagan, bizning ishimizga juda mos keladi; chunki

en: we can lay him therein, after giving him two or three slashes with a knife, and leave him be.
uz: Biz uni unga pichoq bilan ikki-uchta kesib berganimizdan so'ng, unga yotqizishimiz mumkin va uni qo'yib yuborishimiz mumkin.

en: I know no reason why whoso ﬁndeth him should suppose him to have been put there from this house rather than otherwhence; nay, it will liefer be believed, seeing he was a young man of lewd life, that he hath been slain by some enemy of his, whilst going about to do some mischief or other, and after clapped in the chest.’ The maid’s counsel pleased the lady, save that she would not hear of giv- ing him any wound, saying that for naught in the world would her heart suf- fer her to do that.
uz: Men uni topgan odamning uni bu uydan boshqa joydan emas, balki u yerga qo'yilgan deb o'ylashining hech qanday sababini bilmayman; yo'q, bu unga ishonish osonroq, chunki u fohisha hayot kechirgan yigit edi, u qandaydir dushmani tomonidan o'ldirilgan edi, u qandaydir yomonlik yoki boshqa ishni qilmoqchi edi va ko'kragida qarsak chalardi." Xizmatkorning maslahati xonimga yoqdi, faqat unga hech qanday jarohat berishni eshitmasligini, dunyoda uning yuragi uni bunga majbur qilmasligini aytdi.

en: Accordingly she sent her to see if the chest were yet whereas she had noted it and she presently returned and said, ‘Ay.’ Then, being young and lusty, with the aid of her mistress, she took Ruggieri on her shoulders and carrying him out —whilst the lady forewent her, to look if any came —clapped him into the chest and shutting down the lid, left him there.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uni sandiq hali ham bor-yo'qligini tekshirishga yubordi va u darhol qaytib keldi va dedi: "Ay." Keyin, yosh va shahvoniy bo'lib, bekasining yordami bilan Ruggieriyni yelkasiga olib, uni olib chiqdi  xonim esa unga birortasi kelishini ko'rish uchun  uni sandiqqa urdi va qopqog'ini yopib, uni u yerda qoldirdi.

en: Now it chanced that, a day or two before, two young men, who lent at usance, had taken up their abode in a house a little farther and lacking household gear, but having a mind to gain much and spend little, had that day espied the chest in question and had plotted together, if it should abide there the night, to carry it off to their own house.
uz: Endi shunday bo'ldiki, bir-ikki kun oldin, bir necha yosh yigitlar, o'z uylarida biroz uzoqroqda turishgan va uy-ro'zg'or buyumlari yo'q edilar, lekin ko'p narsa topishni va oz narsa sarflashni o'ylab, o'sha kuni sandiqni kuzatib, agar u yerda tunab qolsa, uni o'z uylariga olib ketishni rejalashtirgan edilar.

en: Accordingly, midnight come, they sallied forth and ﬁnding the chest still there, without looking farther, they hastily carried it off, for all it seemed to them somewhat heavy, to their own house, where they set it down beside a chamber in which their wives slept and there leaving it, without concerning themselves for the nonce to settle it overnicely, betook them to bed.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, yarim tunda ular saf tortishdi va sandiqni u yerda to'xtab qolishganini topishdi. Uzoqroq qaramasdan, uni shoshilinch ravishda o'z uylariga olib ketishdi, chunki bu ularga biroz og'ir tuyuldi. U yerda uni xotinlari uxlaydigan xona yonida yotqizishdi va uni u yerda qoldirishdi, uni ortiqcha joylashtirish uchun o'zlarini tashlamasdan, ularni to'shakka yotqizdilar.

en: Presently, the morning drawing near, Ruggieri, who had slept a great while, having by this time digested the sleeping draught and exhausted its effects, awoke and albeit his sleep was broken and his senses in some meas- ure restored, there abode yet a dizziness in his brain, which held him stu- peﬁed, not that night only, but some days after.
uz: Hozirgi kunda, ertalab yaqinlashayotganda, Ruggieri, ancha uxlagan, shu vaqtga kelib uxlab yotgan suvni hazm qilib, uning ta'sirini tugatgan holda, uyg'onib, garchi uyqusi uzilgan va sezgilari bir oz tiklangan bo'lsa ham, uning miyasida bosh aylanishi bor edi, bu uni faqat o'sha kechasi emas, balki bir necha kundan keyin ham hayratda ushlab turardi.

en: Opening his eyes and seeing nothing, he put out his hands hither and thither and ﬁnding himself in the chest, bethought himself and said, ‘What is this?
uz: Ko'zlarini ochdi va hech narsa ko'rmadi, qo'llarini bu yoqqa-bu yoqqa cho'zdi va o'zini ko'kragida topdi, o'zini o'ylab dedi: Bu nima?

en: Am I asleep or awake?
uz: Men uxlayapmanmi yoki uyg'oqmanmi?

en: Algates I mind me that I came this evening into my mistress’s chamber and now meseemeth I am in a chest.
uz: Algetlar menga bu oqshom xo'jayinimning xonasiga kelganimni eslatadi va endi ko'kragimda ekanligimni sezyapman.

en: Can the physician have returned or other accident befallen, by reason whereof the lady hath hidden me here, I being asleep?
uz: Doktor qaytib kelganmi yoki boshqa baxtsiz hodisa sodir bo'lganmi, shu sababli xonim meni uyquda yashirib qo'yganmi?

en: Methinketh it must have been thus; assuredly it was so.’ Accordingly, he addressed himself to abide quiet and hearken if he could hear aught and after he had abidden thus a great while, being somewhat ill at ease in the chest, which was small, and the side
uz: Menimcha, shunday bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak edi; albatta shunday edi." Shunga ko'ra, u o'ziga murojaat qilib, hech narsa eshitmasa, jim turishga va eshitishga kirishdi. Va shunday uzoq vaqt yashiringanidan so'ng, kichkina ko'kragida biroz bemor bo'lib, va

en: whereon he lay irking him, he would have turned over to the other and wrought so dexterously that, thrusting his loins against one of the sides of the chest, which had not been set on a level place, he caused it ﬁrst to in- cline to one side and after topple over.
uz: U uni bezovta qilib yotardi, u boshqa tomonga burilib, shunchalik mohirona ish qilgan bo'lardi, ko'kragining tekis joyga o'rnatilmagan bir tomoniga belini itarib, avval bir tomonga egilib, keyin ag'darilib ketishiga sabab bo'lardi.

en: In falling, it made a great noise, whereat the women who slept therenigh awoke and being affrighted, were silent for fear.
uz: Yiqilish paytida u katta shovqin chiqardi, shunda u yerda uxlagan ayollar uyg'onib, qo'rqib, qo'rquvdan jim edilar.

en: Ruggieri was sore alarmed at the fall of the chest, but, ﬁnding that it had opened in the fall, chose rather, if aught else should betide, to be out of it than to abide therewithin.
uz: Ruggieri ko'krakning yiqilishidan qattiq xavotirda edi, lekin u kuzda ochilganini bilib, agar boshqa narsa kerak bo'lsa, ichida qolishdan ko'ra undan tashqariga chiqishni afzal ko'rdi.

en: Accordingly, he came forth and what with knowing not where he was and what with one thing and another, he fell to groping about the house, so haply he should ﬁnd a stair or a door, whereby he might get him gone.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u tashqariga chiqdi va qayerda ekanligini va nima ekanligini bilmay, bir narsa va boshqa narsa bilan uyning atrofini kuzatishga yiqildi, shunda u zinapoya yoki eshik topishi mumkin edi, undan uni olib ketishi mumkin edi.

en: The women, hearing this, began to say, ‘Who is there?’ But Ruggieri, knowing not the voice, answered not; whereupon they proceeded to call the two young men, who, for that they had overwatched themselves, slept fast and heard nothing of all this.
uz: Ayollar buni eshitib, "U yerda kim bor?" deyishni boshlashdi. Ammo Ruggieri ovozni bilmay, javob bermadi; shundan so'ng ular o'zlarini haddan tashqari kuzatganliklari sababli, tez uxlab, bularning hammasidan hech narsa eshitmagan ikki yigitni chaqirishga kirishdi.

en: Thereupon the women, waxing more fearful, arose and betaking themselves to the windows, fell a-crying, ‘Thieves!
uz: Shundan so'ng ayollar yanada qo'rqib, o'rnidan turdilar va derazalarga o'zlarini qoqishib, baqirib: "O'g'rilar!" deyishdi.

en: Thieves!’ At this sundry of the neighbours ran up and made their way, some by the roof and some by one part and some by another, into the house; and the young men also, awaking for the noise, arose and seized Ruggieri, who ﬁnding himself there, was in a manner beside himself for wonderment and saw no way of escape.
uz: O'g'rilar! Shundan so'ng turli qo'shnilar yugurib kelib, uyga kirishdi, ba'zilari tom bo'ylab, ba'zilari bir tomondan, ba'zilari esa boshqa tomondan; yigitlar ham shovqindan uyg'onib, o'zlarini u yerda topgan Ruggieriyni ushlashdi. Ruggieri hayrat bilan o'zidan chetda edi va hech qanday qochish yo'lini ko'rmadi.

en: Then they gave him into the hands of the ofﬁcers of the governor of the city, who had now run thither at the noise and carried him before their chief.
uz: Keyin uni shahar hokimining amaldorlari qo'liga topshirdilar, ular shovqin ostida u yerga yugurib, uni o'z boshliqlari huzuriga olib borishdi.

en: The latter, for that he was held of all a very sorry fel- low, straightway put him to the question and he confessed to having entered the usurers’ house to steal; whereupon the governor thought to let string him up by the neck without delay.
uz: Oxirgisi, chunki u juda achinarli va past deb hisoblangan edi, uni darhol savolga tortdi va u pul o'g'irlash uchun pul o'g'irlari uyiga kirganini tan oldi; shundan so'ng hokim uni bevaqt bo'ynidan osib qo'yishni o'yladi.

en: The news was all over Salerno by the morning that Ruggieri had been taken in the act of robbing the moneylenders’ house, which the lady and her maid hearing, they were ﬁlled with such strange and exceeding wonderment that they were like to persuade themselves that they had not done, but had only dreamed of doing, that which they had done overnight; whilst the lady, to boot, was so concerned at the news of the danger wherein Ruggieri was that she was like to go mad.
uz: Ertalab Salernoning hamma joyida Ruggieri qarz beruvchilarning uyini o'g'irlashda qo'lga olinganligi haqida xabar tarqaldi. Xonim va uning xizmatkori buni eshitib, g'alati va haddan tashqari hayratga tushishdi, hatto o'zlarini tun bo'yi qilgan ishini emas, balki faqat orzu qilganliklarini qilishga ishontirishdi; xonim esa, albatta, Ruggieri haqidagi xavfli xabardan shunchalik xavotirda ediki, u aqldan ozdi.

en: Soon after half tierce260 the physician, having returned from Malﬁ and wishing to medicine his patient, called for his pre- pared water and ﬁnding the ﬂagon empty, made a great outcry, saying that nothing could abide as it was in his house.
uz: Yarim darajali 260 dan ko'p o'tmay, shifokor Malfi shahridan qaytib kelib, bemorini davolashni xohlab, oldindan tayyorlangan suvini chaqirib oldi va idishni bo'sh topib, uyida hech narsa o'z holatida turolmasligini aytib, katta norozilik bildirdi.

en: The lady, who was troubled with another great chagrin, answered angrily, saying ‘What wouldst thou say,
uz: Xonim, yana bir katta xafalikdan bezovta bo'lgan holda, g'azab bilan javob berdi va dedi: Nima demoqchisiz?

en: doctor, of grave matter, whenas thou makest such an outcry anent a ﬂagon- let of water overset?
uz: Doktor, og'ir masalani, qachonki siz bunday faryodni suv tomchisi ustida qilyapsiz?

en: Is there no more water to be found in the world?’ ‘Wife,’ rejoined the physician, ‘thou thinkest this was common water; it was not so; nay, it was a water prepared to cause sleep’; and told her for what occasion he had made it.
uz: Dunyoda boshqa suv topilmaydimi? Xotin, deb javob berdi shifokor, sen bu oddiy suv deb oylaysan; unday emas edi; aksincha, bu uyquga ketish uchun tayyorlangan suv edi; va unga buni qanday sababga kora qilganini aytdi.

en: When she heard this, she understood forthright that Ruggieri had drunken the opiate and had therefore appeared to them dead and said to her husband, ‘Doctor, we knew it not; wherefore do you make yourself some more’; and the physician, accordingly, seeing he might not do otherwise, let make thereof anew.
uz: U buni eshitgach, Ruggieri o't ichganini va shuning uchun ham ularga o'lik ko'ringanini aniq tushundi va eriga dedi: "Do'xtir, biz buni bilmas edik; nega o'zingizga yana ko'proq tayyorlayapsiz?" Va shifokor, boshqacha yo'l qo'ymasligini ko'rib, uni yangidan tayyorlasin.

en: A little after, the maid, who had gone by her mistress’s commandment to learn what should be reported of Ruggieri, returned and said to her, ‘Madam, everyone missaith of Ruggieri; nor, for aught I could hear, is there friend or kinsman who hath risen up or thinketh to rise up to assist him, and it is held certain that the prefect of police will have him hanged tomorrow.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, xo'jayinasining buyrug'iga ko'ra Ruggieri haqida nima xabar berish kerakligini o'rganish uchun borgan xizmatkor ayol qaytib kelib, unga dedi: "Xonim, Ruggieri haqida hamma gapiradi; men eshitganimdek, unga yordam berish uchun ko'tarilgan yoki ko'tarilmoqchi bo'lgan do'st yoki qarindosh bormi, va ertaga politsiya boshlig'i uni osib qo'yishi aniq."

en: Moreover, I have a strange thing to tell you, to wit, meseemeth I have dis- covered how he came into the moneylenders’ house, and hear how.
uz: Qolaversa, sizga g'alati bir narsani aytmoqchiman, xususan, men uning pul qarz beruvchilarning uyiga qanday kirganini va qanday eshitganimni aniqladim.

en: You know the carpenter overagainst whose shop was the chest wherein we laid him; he was but now at the hottest words in the world with one to whom it seemeth the chest belonged; for the latter demanded of him the price of his chest, and the carpenter replied that he had not sold it, but that it had that night been stolen from him.
uz: Bilasiz, duradgor uni biz yotqizgan sandiq bo'lgan do'konida juda ko'p narsa ishlagan edi; u endi dunyodagi eng qizg'in so'zlarda edi, sandiq kimga tegishli bo'lsa, shunga o'xshardi; chunki bu sandiq undan uning ko'kragining narxini talab qilardi va duradgor uni sotmaganini, balki o'sha kecha undan o'g'irlanganini javob berdi.

en: Whereto, “Not so,” quoth the other, “nay, thou soldest it to the two young men, the moneylenders yonder, as they told me yesternight, when I saw it in their house what time Ruggieri was taken.” “They lie,” answered the carpenter.
uz: Qayerda bo'lsa ham,  unday emas,  deb javob beradi ikkinchisi,  yo'q, sen uni u yerdagi ikki yigitga, pul qarz beruvchilarga sotding, xuddi ular menga kecha kechqurun Ruggieri qanday vaqtda olinganini ko'rganimda aytganidek.

en: “I never sold it to them; but they stole it from me yesternight.
uz: Men uni ularga hech qachon sotmadim; lekin ular uni kecha tunda mendan o'g'irlashdi.

en: Let us go to them.” So they went off with one accord to the moneylenders’ house, and I came back hither.
uz: Keling, ularga boraylik. Shunday qilib, ular bir ovozdan pul beruvchilarning uyiga ketishdi va men bu yerga qaytib keldim.

en: On this wise, as you may see, I conclude that Ruggieri was transported whereas he was found; but how he came to life again I cannot divine.’ The lady now understood very well how the case stood and telling the maid what she had heard from the physician, besought her help to save Ruggieri, for that she might, an she would, at once save him and preserve her honour.
uz: Shu ma'noda, ko'rib turganingizdek, Ruggieri topilganda ko'chirilgan degan xulosaga kelaman; lekin u qanday qilib qayta tirilgani haqida tasavvurga ega emasman." Xonim endi ish qanday ekanligini yaxshi tushundi va xizmatchiga shifokordan eshitganlarini aytib, Ruggieri qutqarish uchun yordam so'radi, chunki u uni bir zumda qutqarishi va o'z sharafini saqlab qolishi mumkin edi.

en: Quoth she, ‘Madam, teach me how, and I will gladly do any- thing.’ Whereupon the lady, whose wits were sharpened by the urgency of the case, having promptly bethought herself of that which was to do, partic- ularly acquainted the maid therewith, who ﬁrst betook herself to the physi- cian and weeping, began to say to him, ‘Sir, it behoveth me ask you pardon of a great fault, which I have committed against you.’ ‘In what?’ asked the
uz: U aytdi: Xonim, menga qanday qilishni orgating, shunda men har qanday ishni xursandchilik bilan qilaman. Shundan song, ishning shoshilinchligidan aqllari otkir bolgan xonim, nima qilish kerakligini tezda oylab, ayniqsa, ozini birinchi bolib fizikaga qaratib, yiglayotgan xizmatchini tanidi va unga dedi: Janob, sizdan katta xato uchun kechirim sorashim kerak, men sizga qarshi qilgan gunohim uchun. Nima? deb soradi.

en: doctor, and she, never giving over weeping, answered, ‘Sir, you know what manner young man is Ruggieri da Jeroli.
uz: Doktor, va u hech qachon yig'lashni to'xtatmasdan javob berdi: Janob, siz Ruggieri da Jeroli yigitining qanday xulq-atvorga ega ekanligini bilasiz.

en: He took a liking to me awhile agone and partly for fear and partly for love, needs must I become his mis- tress.
uz: U menga bir oz azob chekib, qisman qo'rquvdan, qisman muhabbatdan yoqdi, men uning g'azabiga aylanishim kerak.

en: Yesternight, knowing that you were abroad, he cajoled me on such wise that I brought him into your house to lie with me in my chamber, and he being athirst and I having no whither more quickly to resort for water or wine, unwilling as I was that your lady, who was in the saloon, should see me, I remembered me to have seen a ﬂagon of water in your chamber.
uz: Kecha kechqurun, sen chet elda ekanligingni bilgan holda, meni shunchalik xafa qildi-ki, uni uyingga olib kirdim, xonamda men bilan yotishga. U chanqagan edi va men suv yoki vinoga tezroq murojaat qilish uchun boshqa joyga ega emas edim, chunki men salondagi xonim meni ko'rishni xohlamagan edim, men xonangizda bir piyola suv ko'rganimni esladim.

en: Ac- cordingly, I ran for it and giving him the water to drink, replaced the ﬂagon whence I had taken it, whereof I ﬁnd you have made a great outcry in the house.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, yugurib bordim va unga ichimlik suvini berdim, qayerdan olgan bochkani almashtirdim, shundan uyda katta norozilik bildirganingizni ko'rdim.

en: And certes I confess I did ill; but who is there doth not ill bytimes?
uz: Va albatta, men yomonlik qilganimni tan olaman; lekin kimki vaqt o'tishi bilan yomonlik qilmaydi?

en: Indeed, I am exceeding grieved to have done it, not so much for the thing itself as for that which hath ensued of it and by reason whereof Ruggieri is like to lose his life.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men buni qilganimdan juda ham qayg'uraman, bu narsa uchun emas, balki undan kelib chiqqan va Ruggieri o'z hayotini yo'qotgandek bo'lgan narsa uchun.

en: Wherefore I pray you, as most I may, pardon me and give me leave to go succour Ruggieri inasmuch as I can.’ The physician, hearing this, for all he was angry, answered jestingly, ‘Thou hast given thy- self thine own penance therefor, seeing that, whereas thou thoughtest yes- ternight to have a lusty young fellow who would shake thy skincoats well for thee, thou hadst a sluggard; wherefore go and endeavour for the deliver- ance of thy lover; but henceforth look thou bring him not into the house again, or I will pay thee for this time and that together.’ The maid, thinking she had fared well for the ﬁrst venue, betook herself, as quickliest she might, to the prison, where Ruggieri lay and coaxed the gaoler to let her speak with the prisoner, whom after she had instructed what answers he should make to the prefect of police, an he would fain es- cape, she contrived to gain admission to the
uz: Shunday ekan, men sizdan iltimos qilaman, imkon qadar meni kechirib, imkon qadar Ruggieri yordamida ketishga ruxsat bering." Shifokor buni eshitgach, chunki u g'azablangan edi, hazil bilan javob berdi: "Siz o'zingizga tavba qildingiz, chunki, ha deb o'ylasangiz, uch kecha siz uchun teringizni yaxshi silkitadigan shahvoniy yosh yigit bor edi, sizda dangasalik bor edi; shuning uchun borib, sevganingizni qutqarishga harakat qiling; lekin bundan keyin uni yana uyga olib kirmang, yoki bu vaqtga ham, o'sha vaqtga ham sizga to'layman." Xiz, o'zini yaxshi deb o'ylagan holda, tezroq qamoqxonaga bordi, u yerda uni politsiya bilan gaplashishga majbur qildi.

en: magistrate himself.
uz: Magistratning o'zi.

en: The latter, for that she was young and buxom, would fain, ere he would hearken to her, cast his grapnel aboard the good wench, whereof she, to be the better heard, was no whit chary; then, having quitted herself of the grinding due,261 ‘Sir,’ said she, ‘you have here Ruggieri da Jeroli taken for a thief; but the truth is not so.’ Then, beginning from the beginning, she told him the whole story; how she, being his mistress, had brought him into the physician’s house and had given him the drugged water to drink, unknowing what it was, and how she had put him for dead into the chest; after which she told him the talk she had heard between the master carpenter and the owner of the chest, showing him thereby how Ruggieri had come into the moneylenders’ house.
uz: Oxirgisi, chunki u yosh va boy edi, u unga quloq solmasidan oldin, o'zining grepnelini yaxshi qizga tashlardi. U, yaxshi eshitilsa, hech qanday charchamaydi. Keyin, maydalashdan voz kechgach, 261 "Janob," dedi u, "bu yerda siz Ruggieri da Jeroli o'g'ri deb o'yladingiz; lekin haqiqat unday emas." Keyin, boshidan boshlab, u unga butun hikoyani aytib berdi: qanday qilib u, uning bekasi, uni shifokorning uyiga olib kirgan edi va unga ichish uchun giyohvand suv bergan edi, nima ekanligini bilmasdan, uni qanday qilib o'lik qafsiga qo'yganini; keyin u unga usta va ko'krak egasi o'rtasida eshitganini aytdi, qanday qilib Ruggierilar uni uyga olib kirganini ko'rsatdi.

en: The magistrate, seeing it an easy thing to come at the truth of the matter, ﬁrst questioned the physician if it were true of the water and found that it was as she had said; whereupon he let summon the carpenter and him to whom the chest belonged and the two moneylenders and after much parley, found that the latter had stolen the chest overnight and put it in their house.
uz: Magistrat, masalaning haqiqatiga kelish oson ekanligini ko'rib, avval shifokorni suv haqida rostmi yoki yo'qmi deb so'radi va u aytganidek ekanligini aniqladi; shundan so'ng u duradgorni va sandiq unga tegishli bo'lgan odamni, shuningdek, ikki qarz beruvchini chaqirib oldi va ko'p bahslashgandan so'ng, oxirgilari sandiqni bir kechada o'g'irlaganini va ularning uyiga qo'yganini aniqladi.

en: Ultimately he sent for Ruggieri and questioned him where he had lain that night, whereto he replied that where he had lain he knew not; he re- membered indeed having gone to pass the night with Master Mazzeo’s maid, in whose chamber he had drunken water for a sore thirst he had; but what became of him after he knew not, save that, when he awoke, he found himself in the moneylenders’ house in a chest.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u Ruggieriyni chaqirib, o'sha kechasi qayerda yotganini so'radi. U javob berdi: qayerda yotganini bilmayman; u haqiqatan ham ustoz Mazzeoning xizmatkori bilan tunab o'tgan, uning xonasida qattiq chanqoqligi sababli suv ichgan edi; lekin undan keyin nima bo'lganini bilmadi, faqat u uyg'onganida o'zini sandiqda pul beruvchilarning uyida topdi.

en: The prefect, hearing these things and taking great pleasure therein, caused the maid and Ruggieri and the carpenter and the moneylenders repeat their story again and again; and in the end, seeing Ruggieri to be innocent, he released him and amerced the moneylenders in half a score ounces for that they had stolen the chest.
uz: Prefekt bu gaplarni eshitib, undan juda xursand bo'lib, xizmatchi qiz va Ruggieri, duradgor va pul qarz beruvchilarni o'z hikoyasini qayta-qayta takrorlashga majbur qildi; va oxir-oqibat, Ruggieri begunoh ekanligini ko'rib, uni ozod qildi va pul qarz beruvchilarni sandiqni o'g'irlagani uchun yarim ounsiyaga minnatdor qildi.

en: How welcome this was to Ruggieri, none need ask, and it was beyond measure pleasing to his mistress, who together with her lover and the precious maid, who had proposed to give him the slashes with the knife, many a time after laughed and made merry of the matter, still continuing their loves and their disport from good to better; the which I would well might so betide myself, save always the being put in the chest.” If the former stories had saddened the hearts of the lovesome ladies, this last one of Dioneo’s made them laugh heartily, especially when he spoke of the prefect casting his grapnel aboard the maid, that they were able thus to recover themselves of the melancholy caused by the others.
uz: Ruggieri uchun bu qanchalik xush kelibsiz edi, so'rash shart emas edi va bu uning bekasiga cheksiz yoqdi. U o'z sevgilisi va qimmatbaho xizmatkori bilan birga, unga pichoq bilan bo'lak berish taklifini bergan holda, ko'p vaqt kulgandan keyin ham ishdan xursand bo'lib, o'z muhabbatlarini davom ettirib, yaxshilikdan yaxshilikka tortishardi; men buni o'zimni shunday yomon ko'rardimki, doim ko'krakka tiqishni istamasdim.

en: But the king, seeing that the sun began to grow yellow and that the term of his seignory was come, with very courteous speech excused himself to the fair ladies for that which he had done, to wit, that he had caused discourse of so sorrowful a matter as that of lovers’ infelicity; which done, he rose to his feet and tak- ing from his head the laurel wreath, whilst the ladies waited to see on whom he should bestow it, set it daintily on Fiammetta’s fair head, saying, “I make over this crown to thee, as to her who will, better than any other, know how with tomorrow’s pleasance to console these ladies our companions of today’s woefulness.”
uz: Ammo shoh quyosh sarg'ayishni boshlaganini va uning hukmronlik muddati kelganini ko'rib, juda odobli so'z bilan go'zal xonimlarga qilgan ishi uchun uzr so'radi, xususan, sevishganlar baxtsizligi kabi qayg'uli masalani muhokama qilishga sabab bo'lganligi uchun; shunday qilib, u oyoqlari bilan turdi va boshidan lavr gulini oldi, xonimlar esa uni kimga sovg'a qilishini kutishar ekan, uni Fiammetta'ning oq boshiga qo'yib, dedi: "Men bu tojni senga taqdim etaman, chunki u ertaga bu xonimlarni bugungi kunning qayg'uli bilan qanday tasalli berishni biladi."

en: Fiammetta, whose locks were curled and long and golden and fell over her white and delicate shoulders and whose soft-rounded face was all resplendent with white lilies and vermeil roses commingled, with two eyes in her head as they were those of a peregrine falcon and a dainty little mouth, the lips whereof seemed twin rubies, answered, smiling, “And I, Filostrato, I take it willingly, and that thou mayst be the better cognizant of that which thou hast done, I presently will and command that each prepare to discourse tomorrow of THAT WHICH HATH HAPPILY BETIDED LOVERS AFTER SUNDRY CRUEL AND MISFORTUNATE ADVENTURES.” Her proposition262 was pleas- ing unto all and she, after summoning the seneschal and taking counsel with him of things needful, arising from session, blithely dismissed all the com- pany until suppertime.
uz: Fiammetta, uning qulflari jingalak va uzun va oltin bo'lib, oq va nozik yelkalariga tushdi va uning yumshoq yuzi oq nilufarlar va ko'k atirgullar bilan aralashgan edi. Uning boshida ikki ko'zi xuddi peregrin varrak va nozik kichkina og'iz kabi edi, lablari egizak qizilga o'xshardi, u tabassum qilib javob berdi: "Men, Filostrato, buni ixtiyoriy ravishda olaman va sen qilgan ishingni yaxshiroq bilishing uchun, men ertaga har bir kishi SUNDRY CRESH VA MISFORTUN ADAVAVENTSdan keyin SUNDRY BETHGA YARITILGAN SUNDRY CRESH SUNDRY VA MISFORTUNNING SIZNING SIZNING SIZNING SIZNIKLARING UCHUN BETCHIGA KIRITISH UCHUN,

en: Accordingly, they all proceeded, according to their various appetites, to take their several pleasures, some wandering about the garden, whose beauties were not such as might lightly tire, and other some betaking themselves towards the mills which wrought therewithout, whilst the rest fared some hither and some thither, until the hour of supper, which being come, they all foregathered, as of their wont, anigh the fair fountain and there supped with exceeding pleasance and well served.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ularning barchasi o'zlarining turli ishtahalariga ko'ra, bir nechta lazzatlarni qabul qilish uchun yo'lga tushdilar, ba'zilari bog'da sayr qilishdi, uning go'zalliklari yengil charchamaydi, boshqalari esa u yerda ishlaydigan tegirmonlarga qarab o'tirdilar, qolganlari esa bu yoqqa, ba'zilari esa u yoqqa ketishdi, kechki ovqat soati kelguncha, ularning odatlariga ko'ra, go'zal favvora yaqinida to'planib, u yerda haddan tashqari lazzat va yaxshi taomlar bilan ta'minlandilar.

en: Presently, arising thence, they addressed themselves, as of their wont, to dancing and singing, and Filomena leading off the dance, the queen said, “Filostrato, I purpose not to depart from the usance of those who have foregone me in the sovranty, but, like as they have done, so I intend that a song be sung at my commandment; and as I am assured that thy songs are even such as are thy stories, it is our pleasure that, so no more days than this be troubled with thine ill fortunes, thou sing such one thereof as most pleaseth thee.” Filostrato replied that he would well and forthright proceeded to sing on this wise: Weeping, I demonstrate  How sore with reason doth my heart complain  Of love betrayed and plighted faith in vain.
uz: Hozir o'sha joydan turib, ular odatlariga ko'ra raqsga tushish va kuylashdi, Filomena esa raqsni boshlashdi. Qirolicha dedi: "Filostrato, men meni hukmronlikda ustun qo'yganlarning odatlaridan voz kechmoqchi emasman, lekin ular qilganidek, men ham mening amrimga ko'ra qo'shiq kuylashni niyat qilaman; va men sizning qo'shiqlaringiz sizning hikoyalaringizga o'xshash ekanligiga amin bo'lganim uchun, bu bizning zavqimizdir, shuning uchun bundan ortiq emas, siz o'z baxtsiz kunlaringiz bilan bosh qotirmay, sizga eng yoqqanini kuylaysiz." Filostrato shunday javob berdi: "Men yaxshi va to'g'ri shunday kuylashni xohlardim: Yig'laymiz, men yuragimning qanchalik achchiqligini ko'rsataman, xiyonat qilingan va behuda ishongan muhabbatdan shikoyat qilaman."

en: Love, whenas ﬁrst there was of thee imprest  Thereon263 her image for whose sake I sigh,  Sans hope of succour aye,  So full of virtue didst thou her pourtray,  That every torment light accounted I  That through thee to my breast
uz: Sevgi, qachonki avval Sendan bo'lganida, U 263 ga uning qiyofasini singdirgan edim, men uning uchun motam tutgan edim, hech qanday umidsiz edi, shunchalik fazilatga to'la edingki, uning nurini to'kding, shunchalikki, har bir azob meni sen orqali ko'kragimga yetkazdi.

en: Grown full of drear unrest  And dole, might come; but now, alack!
uz: G'amgin tartibsizliklar bilan to'lib-toshgan va pastga tushib, kelishi mumkin; lekin endi, alack!

en: I’m fain  To own my error, not withouten pain.
uz: Xatoyimga ega bo'lishga moyilman, og'riqsiz emas.

en: Yea, of the cheat ﬁrst was I made aware,  Seeing myself of her forsaken sheer,  In whom I hoped alone;  For, when I deemed myself most fairly grown  Into her favour and her servant dear,  Without her thought or care  Of my to-come despair,  I found she had another’s merit ta’en  To heart and put me from her with disdain.
uz: Ha, aldov haqida birinchi bo'lib xabardor bo'ldim, o'zimni uning tashlab ketilgan xotirasidan ko'rib, unga yolg'iz umid qilgan edim; chunki, men o'zimni uning marhamatiga va xizmatkoriga eng ko'p o'sgan deb hisoblaganimda, uning fikri yoki mening kelajakdagi umidsizlikim haqida qayg'urmasdan, uning yuragidan boshqa bir afzalligi borligini va mendan nafrat bilan uzoqlashganini aniqladim.

en: Whenas I knew me banished from my stead,  Straight in my heart a dolorous plaint there grew,  That yet therein hath power,  And oft I curse the day and eke the hour  When ﬁrst her lovesome visage met my view,  Graced with high goodlihead;  And more enamouréd  Than eye, my soul keeps up its dying strain,  Faith, ardour, hope, blaspheming still amain.
uz: Qachonki men o'z o'rnimdan quvilganimni bilganimda, To'g'ri yuragimda og'riqli shikoyat paydo bo'ldi, Undan kuch ham bor edi, Va ko'pincha kunni la'natlayman va soatni o'tkazib yuboraman, Birinchi marta uning sevgi yuzlari mening ko'zimga duch kelganida, Yuqori yaxshilik bilan bezatilgan; Va ko'zdan ko'ra mehrga to'lgan, jonim o'layotgan zo'riqishni davom ettiradi, Ishonch, g'ayrat, umid, haqorat hali ham hayratda.

en: How void my misery is of all relief  Thou mayst e’en feel, so sore I call thee, sire,  With voice all full of woe;  Ay, and I tell thee that it irks me so  That death for lesser torment I desire.
uz: Qanday befoyda mening musibatim, sen qanday ham yengillik his qilsang, seni shunchalik azob bilan chaqiraman, otajon, ovozim hammasi qayg'uga to'la; Ha, va senga aytaman, bu meni shunday g'azablantiradi, o'limni kamroq azob uchun xohlayman.

en: Come, death, then; shear the sheaf  Of this my life of grief  And with thy stroke my madness eke assain;  Go where I may, less dire will be my bane.
uz: Kel, o'lim, demak; bu qayg'u hayotimning cho'qqisini kesib tashla. Va sening zarbang bilan aqldan ozganim yengil bo'lsin; Qayerga borsam ham, kamroq azobim bo'ladi.

en: No other way than death is left my spright,  Ay, and none other solace for my dole;  Then give it264 me straightway,  Love; put an end withal to my dismay:  Ah, do it; since fate’s spite  Hath robbed me of delight;
uz: O'limdan boshqa yo'l qolmadi, Ey, va dolim uchun boshqa tasalli yo'q; Keyin uni menga darhol bergin, Sevgi; dahshatimga chek qo'y: Oh, qilgin; chunki taqdirning jahli meni lazzatdan mahrum qildi;

en: Gladden thou her, lord, with my death, love-slain,  As thou hast cheered her with another swain.
uz: Ey xo'jayin, uni mening sevgi o'limi bilan xursand qilgin, Xuddi uni boshqa bir ayg'ir bilan xursand qilganingdek.

en: My song, though none to learn thee lend an ear,  I reck the less thereof, indeed, that none  Could sing thee even as I;  One only charge I give thee, ere I die,  That thou ﬁnd Love and unto him alone  Show fully how undear  This bitter life and drear  Is to me, craving of his might he deign  Some better harbourage I may attain.
uz: Mening qo'shig'im, garchi seni o'rganishga hech kim quloq solmasa ham, men undan kamroq sanayman, chunki hech kim seni men kabi kuylay olmas edi; Men senga faqat bir amr beraman, o'lishimdan oldin, Muhabbatni topishing va faqat unga O'zing bu achchiq hayot va achinarli menga qanday bo'lishini to'liq ko'rsat, u o'z qudratiga intilib, men erishishim mumkin bo'lgan yaxshiroq joyni xohlaydi.

en: Weeping I demonstrate  How sore with reason doth my heart complain  Of love betrayed and plighted faith in vain.
uz: Yig'lab ko'rsataman, yuragim aql bilan qanchalik og'riyotganidan shikoyat qilyapti, xiyonat qilingan muhabbatdan va behudaga vayron qilingan imondan.

en: The words of this song clearly enough discovered the state of Filostrato’s mind and the cause thereof, the which belike the countenance of a certain lady who was in the dance had yet plainlier declared, had not the shades of the now fallen night hidden the blushes that rose to her face.
uz: Bu qo'shiqning so'zlari Filostratoning ongidagi holatni va uning sababini aniq ko'rsatdi, chunki raqsga tushayotgan ma'lum bir ayolning yuz ko'rinishi hali aniqroq e'lon qilingan edi, endi tushgan tunning soyalari uning yuziga ko'tarilgan qizarishlarni yashirmagan edi.

en: But, when he had made an end of his song, many others were sung, till such time as the hour of sleep arrived, whereupon, at the queen’s commandment, each of the ladies withdrew to her chamber.
uz: Ammo, u o'z qo'shig'ini tugatgach, ko'pchilik boshqa qo'shiqlarni kuylardi, toki uyqu vaqti kelguncha, shundan so'ng, malika buyrug'iga ko'ra, har bir xonim o'z xonasiga chekindi.

en: Here endeth the Fourth Day of the Decameron.
uz: Mana Dekameronning to'rtinchi kuni tugaydi.

en: DAY THE FIFTH INTRODUCTION Here beginneth the ﬁfth day of the Decameron wherein under the governance of Fiammetta is discoursed of that which hath happily betided lovers after sundry cruel and misfortunate adventures.
uz: BESHINCHI KUN Kirish Bu yerda Dekameronning beshinchi kuni boshlanadi, unda Fiammetta hukmronligi ostida turli shafqatsiz va baxtsiz sarguzashtlardan so'ng oshiqlarni xursand qilgan narsa haqida gapiriladi.

en: The East was already all white and the rays of the rising sun had made it light through all our hemisphere, when Fiammetta, allured by the sweet song of the birds that blithely chanted the ﬁrst hour of the day upon the branches, arose and let call all the other ladies and the three young men; then, with leisured pace descending into the ﬁelds, she went a-pleasuring with her company about the ample plain upon the dewy grasses, discoursing with them of one thing and another, until the sun was somewhat risen, when, feeling that its rays began to grow hot, she turned their steps to their abiding-place.
uz: Sharq allaqachon oq edi va chiqayotgan quyosh nurlari butun yarim shartimizni yoritib yuborgan edi. Fiammetta, kunning birinchi soatini shoxlar ustida shovqin bilan kuylayotgan qushlarning shirin qo'shig'iga maftun bo'lib, o'rnidan turdi va boshqa barcha xonimlar va uchta yigitni chaqirib oldi; so'ngra, sokin qadam bilan dalalarga tushgach, u o'z kompaniyasi bilan keng tekislik haqida mazza qildi, ular bilan bir-bir narsa haqida suhbatlashdi, quyosh biroz ko'tarilguncha, uning nurlari issiq bo'la boshlaganini his qilib, ularning yashash joyiga qadam tashladi.

en: There, with excellent wines and confections, she let restore the light fatigue had and they disported themselves in the delightsome garden until the eating hour, which being come and everything made ready by the discreet seneschal, they sat blithely down to meat, such being the queen’s pleasure, after they had sung sundry roundelays and a ballad or two.
uz: U yerda, ajoyib vinolar va shirinliklar bilan, yengil charchoqni tikladi va ular ovqatlanish vaqtigacha shirin bog'da o'zlarini bezovta qilishdi. Va bu vaqt kelib, hamma narsa nozik oqsoqol tomonidan tayyorlanganidan so'ng, ular go'shtga bemalol o'tirishdi, bu malikaga yoqimli edi, turli xil raundaylar va bir-ikki ballada kuylaganlaridan so'ng.

en: Having dined orderly and with mirth, not unmindful of their wonted usance of dancing, they danced sundry short dances to the sound of songs and tabrets, after which the queen dismissed them all until the hour of slum- ber should be past.
uz: tartibli va quvnoq ovqatlanib, o'zlarining odatdagi raqsga tushish odatlarini unutib qo'ymagan holda, ular qo'shiqlar va tabetlar ovoziga ko'ra turli xil qisqa raqslarni raqsga tushdilar, shundan so'ng malika ularning barchasini slum-ber soati o'tguncha qo'yib yubordi.

en: Accordingly, some betook themselves to sleep, whilst others addressed themselves anew to their diversion about the fair garden; but all, according to the wonted fashion, assembled together again, a little after none, near the fair fountain, whereas it pleased the queen.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ba'zilar uyquga ketishdi, boshqalari esa go'zal bog' atrofida o'zlarining qiziqarli mashg'ulotlariga qaytishdi; lekin hamma, odatdagi uslubga ko'ra, yana yig'ilishdi, birozdan keyin, go'zal favvora yaqinida, bu esa malikaga yoqdi.

en: Then she, having seated herself in the chief room, looked towards Pamﬁlo and smil- ingly charged him make a beginning with the fair-fortuned stories; whereto he willingly addressed himself and spoke as follows:
uz: Keyin u, bosh xonada o'tirib, Pamfiloga qaradi va tabassum bilan unga omadli hikoyalarni boshlashni buyurdi; u o'zini xohlab shunday dedi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Cimon, loving, waxeth wise and carrieth off to sea Iphigenia his mistress.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Shimon, sevuvchi, dono bo'lib, o'z bekasini Ifijiniyaga dengizga olib ketadi.

en: Being cast into prison at Rhodes, he is delivered thence by Lysimachus and in concert with him carrieth off Iphigenia and Cassandra on their wedding- day, with whom the twain ﬂee into Crete, where the two ladies become their wives and whence they are presently all four recalled home.
uz: Rhodosda qamoqqa tashlanganidan so'ng, u Lyzmax tomonidan u yerdan olib ketiladi va u bilan birgalikda Ifigeniya va Kassandraning to'y kunida jo'natiladi. Ular bilan Twain Kritga qochadi, u yerda ikki xonim ularning xotinlari bo'ladi va hozirda ularning to'rttasi ham uyga qaytariladi.

en: “Many stories, delightsome ladies, apt to give beginning to so glad a day as this will be, offer themselves unto me to be related; whereof one is the most pleasing to my mind, for that thereby, beside the happy issue which is to mark this day’s discourses, you may understand how holy, how puissant and how full of all good is the power of Love, which many, unknowing what they say, condemn and vilify with great unright; and this, an I err not, must needs be exceeding pleasing to you, for that I believe you all to be in love.
uz: Ko'plab hikoyalar, go'zal xonimlar, shu kabi quvonchli kunni boshlashga moyil bo'lganlar, menga hikoya qilish uchun o'zlarini taklif qilishadi; ulardan biri mening ongimga eng yoqadi, chunki shu orqali, bugungi kun nutqlarini nishonlash uchun mo'ljallangan baxtli masaladan tashqari, siz Sevgining qanchalik muqaddas, qanchalik qudratli va barcha yaxshiliklarga to'la ekanligini tushunishingiz mumkin, ko'pchilik nima deyayotganini bilmasdan, katta nohaqlik bilan qoralaydi va haqorat qiladi; va bu, men adashmayman, siz uchun juda yoqimli bo'lishi kerak, chunki men sizlarning barchangizni sevishingizga ishonaman.

en: There was, then, in the island of Cyprus, (as we have read aforetime in the ancient histories of the Cypriots), a very noble gentleman, by name Ar- istippus, who was rich beyond any other of the country in all temporal things and might have held himself the happiest man alive, had not fortune made him woeful in one only thing, to wit, that amongst his other children he had a son who overpassed all the other youths of his age in stature and goodliness of body, but was a hopeless dullard and well nigh an idiot.
uz: O'shanda Kipr orolida (qadimgi Kipr tarixlarida o'qiganimizdek), Ar- istippus ismli juda olijanob janob bor edi. U barcha vaqtinchalik narsalarda mamlakatning boshqalaridan boyroq edi va o'zini eng baxtli odam deb his qilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi. Faqat bir narsada omad unga achinarli bo'lmagan edi, ya'ni boshqa farzandlari orasida o'z yoshidagi barcha yoshlardan bo'yi va jismi yaxshilikda o'zib ketadigan o'g'li bor edi, lekin u umidsiz ahmoq va deyarli ahmoq edi.

en: His true name was Galesus, but for that neither by toil of teacher nor blandish- ment nor beating of his father nor study nor endeavour of whatsoever other had it been found possible to put into his head any inkling of letters or good breeding and that he had a rough voice and an uncouth and manners more beﬁtting a beast than a man, he was of well nigh all by way of mockery called Cimon, which in their tongue signiﬁed as much as brute beast in ours.
uz: Uning haqiqiy ismi Geles edi, lekin buning uchun na o'qituvchining mehnati, na otasining urishi, na o'rganishi, na boshqa hech qanday urinishi bilan uning boshiga har qanday harflar yoki yaxshi nasl qoldirish imkoniyati topilmagan edi va uning qo'pol ovozi va odamdan ko'ra hayvonga mos bo'lmagan odob-axloqlari bor edi, u Cimon deb ataladigan masxarabozlik yo'li bilan yaqin edi, bu ularning tilida bizning tilda shafqatsiz hayvonga o'xshardi.

en: His father brooked his wastrel life with the most grievous concern and
uz: Otasi o'zining behuda hayotini eng og'ir tashvish bilan o'tkazdi va...

en: having presently given over all hope of him, he bade him begone to his country house265 and there abide with his husbandmen, so he might not still have before him the cause of his chagrin; the which was very agreeable to Cimon, for that the manners and usages of clowns and churls were much more to his liking than those of the townsfolk.
uz: Undan umidini uzganidan so'ng, u unga o'zining qishloq uyiga borishni va u yerda dehqonlari bilan qolishni buyurdi, toki u hali ham o'z xafaligiga sabab bo'lmasin; bu esa Simonga juda yoqardi, chunki masxarabozlar va xarobalarning odoblari va odatlari shahar aholisidan ko'ra ko'proq yoqardi.

en: Cimon, then, betaking himself to the country and there employing him- self in the things that pertained thereto, it chanced one day, awhile after noon, as he passed from one farm to another, with his staff on his shoulder, that he entered a very fair coppice which was in those parts and which was then all in leaf, for that it was the month of May.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Simon o'zini qishloqqa olib borar va u yerda o'zini u bilan bog'liq ishlarda mashg'ul qilar edi. Bir kuni, tushdan keyin biroz vaqt o'tgach, u bir fermadan ikkinchisiga, yelkasida tayoq bilan o'tayotganida, u o'sha qismlarda bo'lgan va o'sha paytda bargda bo'lgan juda chiroyli bir piyozga kirdi, chunki bu may oyi edi.

en: Passing therethrough, he happened (even as his fortune guided him thither) upon a little mead com- passed about with very high trees, in one corner whereof was a very clear and cool spring, beside which he saw a very fair damsel asleep upon the green grass, with so thin a garment upon her body that it hid well nigh noth- ing of her snowy ﬂesh.
uz: U o'sha yo'ldan o'tayotganda, u (omadining shu yo'nalishida bo'lsa ham) juda baland daraxtlar bilan o'tib ketayotgan kichik maysaga duch keldi. Uning bir burchagida juda tiniq va salqin buloq bor edi. Uning yonida yashil o't ustida uxlayotgan juda go'zal qizni ko'rdi, uning tanasida shunday ingichka kiyim bor ediki, u qorli go'shtidan yaxshi yashiringan edi.

en: She was covered only from the waist down with a very white and light coverlet; and at her feet slept on like wise two women and a man, her servants.
uz: U faqat beldan pastga juda oq va yengil ko'rpa bilan qoplangan edi; va uning oyoqlari ostida ikki donishmand ayol va bir erkak kabi, xizmatkorlari uxlab yotardi.

en: When Cimon espied the young lady, he halted and leaning upon his staff, fell, without saying a word, to gazing most intently upon her with the utmost admiration, no otherwise than as he had never yet seen a woman’s form, whilst in his rude breast, wherein for a thousand les- sonings no least impression of civil pleasance had availed to penetrate, he felt a thought awaken which intimated to his gross and material spirit that this maiden was the fairest thing that had been ever seen of any living soul.
uz: Cimon yosh xonimni kuzatganda, u to'xtadi va tayoqlariga suyanib, hech narsa demasdan, unga eng diqqat bilan, eng katta hayrat bilan tikilib, hech qachon ayolning shaklini ko'rmagandek, qo'pol ko'kragida, unda mingta ohangda fuqarolik rohatining hech qanday taassurotlari bo'lmagan holda, u o'zining qo'pol va moddiy ruhiga bu qiz har qanday tirik jonning ko'rgan eng go'zal narsasi ekanligini ko'rsatuvchi bir fikr uyg'ondi.

en: Thence he proceeded to consider her various parts —commending her hair, which he accounted of gold, her brow, her nose, her mouth, her throat and her arms, and above all her breast, as yet but little upraised —and grown of a sudden from a churl a judge of beauty, he ardently desired in himself to see the eyes, which, weighed down with deep sleep, she kept closed.
uz: Shundan so'ng u uning turli qismlarini ko'rib chiqishga kirishdi  sochlariga buyurdi, ularni oltin, qoshlari, burni, og'zi, tomoqlari va qo'llari, va eng asosiysi, ko'kragi hali kichkina ko'tarilgan  va birdan go'zallik hakamidan o'sdi, u o'zida chuqur uyqu bilan og'irlashgan ko'zlarni ko'rishni juda xohladi, u yopiq edi.

en: To this end, he had it several times in mind to awaken her; but, for that she seemed to him beyond measure fairer than the other women aforetime seen of him, he misdoubted him she must be some goddess.
uz: Shu maqsadda, u uni bir necha bor uyg'otishni o'yladi; lekin, chunki u unga avval ko'rgan boshqa ayollardan ko'ra haddan tashqari go'zalroq ko'rinardi, u uni qandaydir ma'buda ekanligiga shubha qildi.

en: Now he had wit enough to account things divine worthy of more reverence than those mundane; wherefore he forbore, waiting for her to awake of herself; and albeit the delay seemed overlong to him, yet, taken as he was with an unwonted pleasure, he knew not how to tear himself away.
uz: Endi u dunyodan ko'ra ko'proq hurmatga sazovor bo'lgan ilohiy narsalarni hisoblashga yetarli aqlga ega edi; shuning uchun u to'xtadi, uning o'zidan uyg'onishini kutdi; va garchi kechikish unga haddan tashqari uzoq tuyulsa ham, lekin u o'zini qanday yirtib tashlashni bilmas edi, chunki u o'zi uchun keraksiz lazzat bilan edi.

en: It befell, then, that, after a long while, the damsel, whose name was Iphigenia, came to herself, before any of her people, and opening her eyes,
uz: Shunday qilib, ancha vaqt o'tgach, Ifygeniya ismli qiz o'ziga kelib, o'z odamlaridan birining oldiga keldi va ko'zlarini ochdi.

en: saw Cimon (who, what for his fashion and uncouthness and his father’s wealth and nobility, was known in a manner to everyone in the country) standing before her, leant on his staff, marvelled exceedingly and said, ‘Ci- mon, what goest thou seeking in this wood at this hour?’ He made her no answer, but, seeing her eyes open, began to look steadfastly upon them, himseeming there proceeded thence a sweetness which fulﬁlled him with a pleasure such as he had never before felt.
uz: Kimonni ko'rdi (o'zining kiyim-kechakligi, odobsizligi, otasining boyligi va olijanobligi bilan qishloqdagi hamma birdek tanilgan), uning oldida turib, tayoqchasiga suyanib, juda hayron bo'lib dedi: "Cimon, bu soatda bu o'rmonda nimani qidiryapsan?" U unga javob bermadi, lekin uning ko'zlari ochiq bo'lganini ko'rib, ularga tik qaray boshladi, u yerdan unga hech qachon his qilmagan darajada zavq beradigan shirinlik kelardi.

en: The young lady, seeing this, began to misdoubt her lest his so ﬁxed looking upon her should move his rusticity to somewhat that might turn to her shame; wherefore, calling her women, she rose up, saying, ‘Cimon, abide with God.’ To which he replied, ‘I will begone with thee’; and albeit the young lady, who was still in fear of him, would have declined his company, she could not win to rid herself of him till he had accompanied her to her own house.
uz: Buni ko'rgan yosh xonim, uning unga shunchalik qattiq qarashi uning uyatini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalarga o'z qo'rqoqligini ko'chirishidan shubhalana boshladi. Shuning uchun, ayollarini chaqirib, u o'rnidan turdi va dedi: "Simon, Xudo bilan birga qoling." Unga javob berdi: "Sendan boshlayman"; va yosh xonim, undan hali ham qo'rqqan bo'lsa ham, uning kompaniyasidan voz kechgan bo'lsa ham, u uni o'z uyiga olib bormaguncha, undan xalos bo'la olmadi.

en: Thence he repaired to his father’s house [in the city], and declared to him that he would on no wise consent to return to the country; the which was irksome enough to Aristippus and his kinsfolk; nevertheless they let him be, awaiting to see what might be the cause of his change of mind.
uz: Shundan so'ng u otasining uyiga [shaharda] bordi va unga mamlakatga qaytishga hech qanday rozilik bermasligini e'lon qildi; bu Aristippus va uning qarindoshlariga juda g'ash edi; shunga qaramay, ular uni tinch qo'yishdi, uning fikrini o'zgartirishga nima sabab bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rishni kutishardi.

en: Love’s ar- row having, then, through Iphigenia’s beauty, penetrated into Cimon’s heart, whereinto no teaching had ever availed to win an entrance, in a very brief time, proceeding from one idea to another, he made his father marvel and all his kinsfolk and every other that knew him.
uz: Muhabbatning g'alabasi, keyin, Ifygenia go'zalligi orqali, Cimonning qalbiga kirib bordi, unga hech qanday ta'lim hech qachon kirish yo'lini qozonishga muvaffaq bo'lmagan joyda, juda qisqa vaqt ichida bir g'oyadan ikkinchisiga o'tib, u otasini, barcha qarindoshlarini va uni bilgan har bir kishini hayratga soldi.

en: In the ﬁrst place he besought his father that he would cause him go bedecked with clothes and every oth- er thing, even as his brothers, the which Aristippus right gladly did.
uz: Avvalo, u otasidan uni kiyimlar va har qanday boshqa narsalar bilan bezatishni buyurishini so'radi, hatto aka-ukalari kabi, buni Aristipp ham xursandchilik bilan qildi.

en: Then, consorting with young men of condition and learning the fashions and car- riage that behoved unto gentlemen and especially unto lovers, he ﬁrst, to the utmost wonderment of everyone, in a very brief space of time, not only learned the ﬁrst [elements of] letters, but became very eminent among the students of philosophy, and after (the love which he bore Iphigenia being the cause of all this) he not only reduced his rude and rustical manner of speech to seemliness and civility, but became a past master of song and sound266 and exceeding expert and doughty in riding and martial exercises, both by land and by sea.
uz: So'ngra, yosh yigitlar bilan do'st bo'lib, janoblar va ayniqsa oshiqlar uchun zarur bo'lgan moda va transportni o'rganib, u avvalo, hammaning hayratiga ko'ra, juda qisqa vaqt ichida nafaqat birinchi harflarni o'rgangan, balki falsafa talabalari orasida juda mashhur bo'lgan, va undan keyin (uning Ifijiniyaga bo'lgan muhabbati bularning barchasiga sabab bo'lgan) u nafaqat o'zining qo'pol va rustik so'zlashuvini go'zallik va odobga aylantirdi, balki o'tmishdagi qo'shiq va ovoz ustasi bo'ldi.

en: In short, not to go recounting every particular of his merits, the fourth year was not accomplished from the day of his ﬁrst falling in love, ere he was grown the sprightliest and most accomplished gentleman of all the young men in the island of Cyprus, ay, and the best en- dowed with every particular excellence.
uz: Xullas, o'zining har bir fazilatini hikoya qilishga bormaslik kerak, to'rtinchi yil birinchi muhabbat kunidan boshlab amalga oshirilmadi, u Kipr orolidagi barcha yigitlar orasida eng yorqin va eng yetuk janob bo'lib yetilmadi, ha, va har bir mukammallikka eng yaxshi moslashdi.

en: What, then, charming ladies, shall we say of Cimon?
uz: Xo'sh, go'zal xonimlar, Cimon haqida nima deyish mumkin?

en: Certes, none other thing than that the lofty virtues im-
uz: Albatta, oliy fazilatlar bundan boshqa hech narsa emas.

en: planted by heaven in his generous soul had been bounden with exceeding strong bonds of jealous fortune and shut in some straitest corner of his heart, all which bonds Love, as a mightier than fortune, broke and burst in sunder and in its quality of awakener and quickener of drowsed and slug- gish wits, urged forth into broad daylight the virtues aforesaid, which had till then been overdarkened with a barbarous obscurity, thus manifestly dis- covering from how mean a room it can avail to uplift those souls that are subject unto it and to what an eminence it can conduct them with its beams.
uz: Uning saxiy qalbida osmon tomonidan o'rnatilgan, hasadgo'ylik boyligining haddan tashqari kuchli bog'lari bilan bog'langan va uning yuragining eng tor burchagida mahkamlangan edi. Bu bog'lar Muhabbatni boylikdan kuchliroq bo'lib, yorib yuboradi va uning uyg'otuvchi va tezlashtiruvchi sifatida uxlagan va sustkash aql-idroklarni uyg'otadi, yuqorida aytilgan fazilatlarni kunduzgi yorug'likka chiqarib yuboradi, bu esa shu paytgacha shafqatsiz xiralik bilan qoplangan edi, shu tariqa u o'ziga bo'ysunuvchi ruhlarni qanday ko'tarishga va qanday yuksaklikka olib borishi mumkinligini yaqqol yashiradi.

en: Although Cimon, loving Iphigenia as he did, might exceed in certain things, as young men in love very often do, nevertheless Aristippus, consid- ering that Love had turned him from a dunce into a man, not only patiently bore with the extravagances into which it might whiles lead him, but en- couraged him to ensue its every pleasure.
uz: Garchi Cimon, Ifigenni o'zi kabi sevgan holda, ba'zi narsalarda, sevgi yoshlari ko'pincha qilganidek, haddan tashqari haddan tashqari harakat qilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, ammo Aristippus, Sevgi uni tuproqdan odamga aylantirdi deb hisoblagan holda, nafaqat uni olib borishi mumkin bo'lgan dabdabalarga sabr bilan bardosh berdi, balki uni o'zining har qanday lazzatini izlashga undadi.

en: But Cimon, (who refused to be called Galesus, remembering that Iphigenia had called him by the former name), seeking to put an honourable term to his desire, once and again caused essay Cipseus, Iphigenia’s father, so he should give him his daughter to wife; but Cipseus still answered that he had promised her to Pasimondas, a young nobleman of Rhodes, to whom he had no mind to fail of his word.
uz: Ammo Simon, (Ifgeniya uni avvalgi nomi bilan chaqirganini eslab, Galles deb atashdan bosh tortgan), o'z xohishiga hurmatli atama qo'ymoqchi bo'lib, yana va yana Ifgeniyaning otasi Cipseyni unga qizini xotinlikka berishga majbur qildi; lekin Cipseus baribir unga Rodosning yosh zodagonasi Pasimondasga va'da berganini javob berdi, unga o'z so'zida adashishni istamadi.

en: The time coming the covenanted nuptials of Iphigenia and the bridegroom having sent for her, Cimon said to himself, ‘Now, O Iphigenia, is the time to prove how much thou are beloved of me.
uz: Ifygeniyaning ahdlashgan to'ylari va uni chaqirib yuborgan kuyov vaqti kelganda, Kimon o'ziga dedi: "Endi, ey Ifygeniya, sening men seni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rishingni isbotlash vaqti keldi."

en: By thee am I become a man and so I may but have thee, I doubt not to become more glorious than any god; and for certain I will or have thee or die.’ Accordingly, having secretly recruited certain young noblemen who were his friends and let privily equip a ship with everything apt for naval battle, he put out to sea and awaited the vessel wherein Iphigenia was to be trans- ported to her husband in Rhodes.
uz: "Sen tufayli men odam bo'ldim va shuning uchun senga ega bo'lishim mumkin, men hech qanday xudolardan ulug'vorroq bo'lishga shubham yo'q; va albatta, senga ega bo'laman yoki o'laman." Shunga ko'ra, o'zining do'stlari bo'lgan ba'zi yosh zodagonlarni yashirincha yollab, dengiz jangiga mos keladigan hamma narsa bilan maxsus jihozlab, u dengizga chiqdi va Ifijiniyaning Rodosdagi eriga olib ketilishi kerak bo'lgan kemani kutdi.

en: The bride, after much honour done of her father to the bridegroom’s friends, took ship with the latter, who turned their prow towards Rhodes and departed.
uz: Kelin otasining kuyovning do'stlariga ko'rsatgan katta hurmatidan so'ng, ular bilan birga kemaga o'tirdi, ular Rodosga qarab suzib ketishdi va jo'nab ketdilar.

en: On the following day, Cimon, who slept not, came out upon them with his ship and cried out, in a loud voice, from the prow, to those who were on board Iphigenia’s vessel, saying, ‘Stay, strike your sails or look to be beaten and sunken in the sea.’ Cimon’s ad- versaries had gotten up their arms on deck and made ready to defend them- selves; whereupon he, after speaking the words aforesaid, took a grappling- iron and casting it upon the poop of the Rhodians, who were making off at the top of their speed, made it fast by main force to the prow of his own ship.
uz: Ertasi kuni uxlamaydigan Simon o'z kemasi bilan ularga qarshi chiqib, ignaxonadan baland ovoz bilan Iphigenia kemasida bo'lganlarga baqirdi: "Turinglar, yelkanlaringizni uringlar yoki dengizda mag'lub bo'lishga harakat qilinglar." Simonning ad-versarylari qurollarini deckga ko'tarib, o'zlarini himoya qilishga tayyor bo'lishdi; shundan so'ng, u yuqorida aytilgan so'zlarni aytib, qo'lga oluvchi temirni oldi va uni tezlik bilan o'z kemasining egasiga otgan Rodyanlarning po'stlog'iga uloqtirdi.

en: Then, bold as a lion, he leapt on board their ship, without waiting for
uz: Keyin, sherdek jasur bo'lib, u ularning kemasiga sakrab kirdi, kutmasdan.

en: any to follow him, as if he held them all for nought, and Love spurring him, he fell upon his enemies with marvellous might, cutlass in hand, striking now this one and now that and hewing them down like sheep.
uz: Unga ergashish uchun hech kim yo'qdek, go'yo hammasini hech narsa deb hisoblardi, va Sevgi uni itarib, u ajoyib kuch bilan, qo'lida qo'ltiq bilan dushmanlariga yiqildi, hozir bu va endi bularni urdi va ularni qo'ylar kabi yiqitdi.

en: The Rhodians, seeing this, cast down their arms and all as with one voice confessed themselves prisoners; whereupon quoth Cimon to them, ‘Young men, it was neither lust of rapine nor hate that I had against you made me depart Cyprus to assail you, arms in hand, in mid sea.
uz: Rodiylar buni ko'rib, qurollarini tashladilar va hammasi bir ovozdan o'zlarini asirlardek tan oldilar; shundan so'ng Kimon ularga dedi: "Ey yigitlar, men sizlarga qarshi bo'lgan na o'g'irlik shahvati, na nafrat meni Kiprga chiqib, qo'limda qurol bilan, dengiz o'rtasida sizga hujum qilishga majbur qildi."

en: That which moved me thereunto was the desire of a thing which to have gotten is a very grave matter to me and to you a very light one to yield me in peace; it is, to wit, Iphigenia, whom I loved over all else and whom, availing not to have of her father on friendly and peaceful wise, Love hath constrained me to win from you as an enemy and by force of arms.
uz: Meni bunga undaydigan narsa, men uchun va siz uchun juda yengil bo'lgan, meni tinch qo'yishga undaydigan narsaga erishish istagi edi; ya'ni, men uni hamma narsadan ko'ra sevgan va otasidan do'stona va tinchlikparvarlik yo'lida foydalanmagan Iphigenia edi. Sevgi meni sizdan dushman va qurol kuchi bilan g'alaba qozonishga majbur qildi.

en: Wherefor I mean to be to her that which your friend Pasimondas should have been.
uz: Chunki men unga do'stingiz Pasimondas bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsa bo'lishni xohlayman.

en: Give her to me, then, and begone and God’s grace go with you.’ The Rhodians, more by force constrained than of freewill, surrendered Iphigenia, weeping, to Cimon, who, seeing her in tears, said to her, ‘Noble Lady, be not disconsolate; I am thy Cimon, who by long love have far better deserved to have thee than Pasimondas by plighted faith.’ Thereupon he caused carry her aboard his own ship and returning to his companions, let the Rhodians go, without touching aught else of theirs.
uz: Uni menga ber, keyin boshlang va Xudoning marhamati siz bilan birga bo'lsin." Rodyanlar, erkin xohishdan ko'ra kuch bilan majbur bo'lgan holda, Ifgeniyani yig'lab, Kimonga topshirdilar. Kim uni yig'layotganini ko'rib, unga dedi: "A'lo darajadagi xonim, xafa bo'lma; men sening Simoningman, men uzoq sevgi bilan Pasimonning imoni bilan senga ega bo'lishga ancha yaxshiroq loyiq bo'lganman." Shundan so'ng u uni o'z kemasiga olib bordi va o'z hamrohlariga qaytib, Rodyanlarni hech narsaga tegmasdan jo'natib qo'ydi.

en: Then, glad beyond any man alive to have gotten so dear a prey, after devoting some time to comforting the weeping lady, he took counsel with his comrades not to re- turn to Cyprus at that present; wherefore, of one accord, they turned the ship’s head towards Crete, where well nigh everyone, and especially Ci- mon, had kinsfolk, old and new, and friends in plenty and where they doubted not to be in safety with Iphigenia.
