uz: Keyin, hech kim tirik bo'lganidan ko'ra, shunchalik aziz o'ljaga ega bo'lganidan xursand bo'lib, yig'layotgan xonimni yupatishga biroz vaqt ajratgandan so'ng, u o'rtoqlari bilan Kiprga qaytib kelmaslikni maslahatlashdi; shuning uchun, bir ovozdan, ular kemaning boshini Kritga qaratdilar, u yerda deyarli hamma, ayniqsa Si-mon, qarindoshlari, eski va yangi, do'stlari ko'p edi va ular Iphigenia bilan xavfsiz bo'lishga shubha qilishardi.

en: But fortune the unstable, which had cheerfully enough vouchsafed unto Cimon the acquisition of the lady, suddenly changed the inexpressible joyance of the enamoured youth into sad and bitter mourning; for it was not four full told hours since he had left the Rhodians when the night (which Cimon looked to be more delightsome than any he had ever known) came on and with it a very troublous and tem- pestuous shift of weather, which ﬁlled all the sky with clouds and the sea with ravening winds, by reason whereof none could see what to do or whither to steer, nor could any even keep the deck to do any ofﬁce.
uz: Ammo baxtsiz, Cimon xonimni olishni quvnoqlik bilan sovg'a qilgan edi, birdan oshiq yoshning ifodalab bo'lmaydigan xursandchiligini qayg'u va achchiq motamga aylantirdi; chunki u Roddan ketganidan beri to'rt soat o'tmagan edi, qachonki tun (Cimon hech qachon bilmaganidan ko'ra yoqimliroq tuyulgan) boshlandi va u bilan birga juda bezovta va juda achinarli ob-havo o'zgarishi bo'ldi, u butun osmonni bulutlar va dengizni och shamol bilan to'ldirdi, shuning uchun hech kim nima qilishni yoki boshqarishni ko'ra olmasdi, hatto deckni ham hech qanday ish uchun saqlay olmasdi.

en: How sore concerned was Cimon for this it needeth not to ask; himseemed the gods had vouchsafed him his desire but to make death the more griev- ous to him, whereof, without that, he had before recked little.
uz: Kimon bundan qanchalik xavotirda edi, so'rash shart emas; go'yo xudolar unga o'z xohishlarini bergandek edi, lekin o'limni unga yanada og'riqli qilishardi, shundan tashqari, u avval ham kam narsa hisoblagan bo'lardi.

en: lamented on like wise, but Iphigenia bewailed herself over all, weeping sore and fearing every stroke of the waves; and in her chagrin she bitterly cursed Cimon’s love and blamed his presumption, avouching that the tempest had arisen for none other thing but that the gods chose not that he, who would fain against their will have her to wife, should avail to enjoy his presumptu- ous desire, but, seeing her ﬁrst die, should after himself perish miserably.
uz: O'zini dono deb xafa qildi, lekin Ifiga hamma narsa uchun yig'ladi, og'riq bilan yig'ladi va har bir to'lqin urishidan qo'rqardi; va o'zining g'azabida u Kimonning muhabbatini achchiqlab la'natladi va uning g'ururini aybladi, chunki bo'ron boshqa hech narsa uchun paydo bo'lmagan, balki xudolar uni xotinlikka olishni istamagan odam o'z g'ururidan bahramand bo'lishini xohlamadi, lekin uning birinchi o'limini ko'rgach, o'zi achinarli tarzda halok bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Amidst such lamentations and others yet more grievous, the wind waxing hourly ﬁercer and the seamen knowing not what to do, they came, without witting whither they went or availing to change their course, near to the is- land of Rhodes, and unknowing that it was Rhodes, they used their every endeavour to get to land thereon, an it were possible, for the saving of their lives.
uz: Bunday faryodlar va undan ham achinarliroq narsalar orasida, shamol soat sayin kuchayib, dengizchilar nima qilish kerakligini bilmay, qayerga borayotganini bilmasdan yoki yo'nalishini o'zgartirishdan foydalanmay, Rodos oroliga yaqinlashib, Rodos ekanligini bilmay, u yerga yetib borish uchun bor kuchlarini ishga soldilar, chunki bu ularning hayotini saqlab qolish uchun mumkin edi.

en: In this fortune was favourable to them and brought them into a little bight of the sea, where the Rhodians whom Cimon had let go had a little before arrived with their ship; nor did they perceive that they had struck the island of Rhodes till the dawn broke and made the sky somewhat clearer, when they found themselves maybe a bowshot distant from the ship left of them the day before.
uz: Bu omad ularga ma'qul keldi va ularni dengizning kichik qo'rg'oniga olib keldi. U yerda Kimon qo'yib yuborgan rodliklar ozgina oldin o'z kemalari bilan yetib kelishdi; shuningdek, ular Rodos orolini tong otguncha urganliklarini va osmonni biroz tiniqroq qilganliklarini sezishmadi, qachonki o'zlarini bir kun oldin ulardan qolgan kemadan biroz uzoqroq topdilar.

en: At this Cimon was beyond measure chagrined and fearing lest that should betide them which did in very deed ensue, bade use every endeavour to issue thence and let fortune after carry them whither it should please her, for that they could be nowhere in worse case than there.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Cimon cheksiz xafa bo'ldi va bu ularga ta'sir qilishi mumkinligidan qo'rqdi, bu esa amalda sodir bo'ldi, u yerdan chiqish uchun har qanday harakatni ishga soldi va omad ularni o'ziga yoqadigan joyga olib bordi, chunki u yerdan yomonroq holatda hech qayerda bo'lmasligi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, they made the utmost efforts to put to sea, but in vain; for the wind blew so mightily against them that not only could they not avail to is- sue from the little harbour, but whether they would or no, it drove them ashore.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular dengizga otish uchun bor kuchlarini sarflashdi, lekin befoyda; chunki shamol ularga shunday kuchli esdiki, ular nafaqat kichik portdan chiqishga qodir emas edilar, balki xohlasalar ham, xohlamasalar ham, u ularni qirg'oqqa haydab chiqardi.

en: No sooner were they come thither than they were recognized by the Rho- dian sailors, who had landed from their ship, and one of them ran nimbly to a village hard by, whither the young Rhodian gentlemen had betaken them- selves, and told the latter that, as luck would have it,267 Cimon and Iphigenia were come thither aboard their ship, driven, like themselves, by stress of weather.
uz: Ular u yerga tezroq yetib kelishdi, shundan so'ng ularni Rho- dian dengizchilari tanib olishdi. Ular kemadan qo'nishdi va ulardan biri qishloqqa tez yugurib keldi, u yerga yosh Rodin janoblari ularni o'z-o'zidan o'g'irlashdi va oxirgilarga omadga ko'ra, 267 Kimon va Ifigenya o'z kemasida kelishdi, xuddi o'zlari kabi ob-havo stressidan haydalgan holda.

en: They, hearing this, were greatly rejoiced and repairing in all haste to the seashore, with a number of the villagers, took Cimon, to- gether with Iphigenia and all his company, who had now landed and taken counsel together to ﬂee into some neighbouring wood, and carried them to the village.
uz: Buni eshitib, ular juda xursand bo'lishdi va shoshilinch ravishda dengiz sohiliga tomon yo'l olishdi. Bir qancha qishloq aholisi bilan birga Kimonni olib, Ifiga va uning butun kompaniyasi bilan birga olib ketishdi. Ular endi qo'lga tushishdi va qo'shni o'rmonga qochib ketish uchun birgalikda maslahatlashib, ularni qishloqqa olib ketishdi.

en: The news coming to Pasimondas, he made his complaint to the senate of the island and according as he had ordered it with them, Lysimachus, in whom the chief magistracy of the Rhodians was for that year vested, coming thither from the city with a great company of men-at-
uz: Pasimondasga kelgan xabarni eshitgach, u orol senatiga shikoyat qildi va ular bilan buyurganidek, o'sha yili Rodliklar bosh prokuraturasi vazifasini bajargan Lismak shahardan u yerga katta odamlar bilan kelayotgan edi.

en: arms, haled Cimon and all his men to prison.
uz: Qo'llar bilan, Kimonni va uning barcha odamlarini qamoqqa olib ketdi.

en: On such wise did the wretched and lovelorn Cimon lose his Iphigenia, scantwhile before won of him, without having taken of her more than a kiss or two; whilst she herself was received by many noble ladies of Rhodes and comforted as well for the chagrin had of her seizure as for the fatigue suffered by reason of the troubled sea; and with them she abode against the day appointed for her nuptials.
uz: Shunday qilib, bechora va mehribon Kimon o'zining Iphigeniyasini yo'qotdi, u undan bir-ikki o'pichdan ko'p narsa olmagan holda, undan ko'p narsa olmagan edi; shu bilan birga, u Rodosning ko'plab olijanob ayollari tomonidan qabul qilindi va uning tashvishlari tufayli ko'rgan charchoqlari uchun ham tasalli berildi; va u bilan birga to'y uchun tayinlangan kungacha qoldi.

en: As for Cimon and his companions, their lives were granted them, in con- sideration of the liberty given by them to the young Rhodians the day be- fore —albeit Pasimondas used his utmost endeavour to procure them to be put to death —and they were condemned to perpetual prison, wherein, as may well be believed, they abode woebegone and without hope of any re- lief.
uz: Kimon va uning hamrohlariga kelsak, ularning hayoti ularga berilgan edi, ular tomonidan o'tgan kundagi yosh Rodinliklarga berilgan erkinlikni hisobga olgan holda  garchi Pasimondas ularni o'ldirish uchun bor kuchini sarflagan bo'lsa ham  va ular abadiy qamoqqa hukm qilingan edilar, u yerda, yaxshi gumon qilinishi mumkin, ular hech qanday umidsiz va tashvishda qolishardi.

en: However, whilst Pasimondas, as most he might, hastened the prepara- tions for his coming nuptials, fortune, as if repenting her of the sudden in- jury done to Cimon, brought about a new circumstance for his deliverance, the which was on this wise.
uz: Biroq, Pasimonda, eng ko'p iloji boricha, kelayotgan nikohlariga tayyorgarlikni tezlashtirgan bo'lsa-da, omad, go'yo uni Kimonga qilingan to'satdan qilingan sud a'zolaridan tavba qilgandek, uning ozod bo'lishi uchun yangi holatni keltirib chiqardi, bu esa shunday edi.

en: Pasimondas had a brother called Ormisdas, less in years, but not in merit, than himself, who had been long in treaty for the hand of a fair and noble damsel of the city, by name Cassandra, whom Lysimachus ardently loved, and the match had sundry times been broken off by divers untoward accidents.
uz: Pasimondasning Ormisdas degan akasi bor edi, u o'zidan ko'ra yoshida kamroq, lekin fazilatda emas edi. U uzoq vaqtdan beri shaharning go'zal va olijanob kelini, Lismakni chin dildan sevuvchi Kassandra bilan shartnoma tuzgan edi va bu uchrashuv turli tasodifiy baxtsiz hodisalar tufayli uzilgan edi.

en: Now Pasimondas, being about to celebrate his own nuptials with the utmost splendour, bethought himself that it were excellently well done if he could procure Ormisdas likewise to take wife on the same occasion, not to resort afresh to expense and festival making.
uz: Endi Pasimondas, o'z to'ylarini eng ulug'vor tarzda nishonlashga yaqinlashar ekan, Ormisdani ham xuddi shu paytda xotin olib ketishi mumkin bo'lsa, bu juda yaxshi ish bo'lardi, deb o'yladi, xarajatlarga va festivalga qaytmasdan.

en: Ac- cordingly, he took up again the parleys with Cassandra’s parents and brought them to a successful issue; wherefore he and his brother agreed, in concert with them, that Ormisdas should take Cassandra to wife on the same day whenas himself took Iphigenia.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u yana Kassandra ota-onasi bilan suhbatlashdi va ularni muvaffaqiyatli masalaga olib keldi; shuning uchun u va akasi, ular bilan birgalikda, Ormisdas Kassandrani o'zi Iphigeniyani olgan kunning o'zida rafiqasiga olishi kerakligiga kelishdilar.

en: Lysimachus hearing this, it was beyond measure displeasing to him, for that he saw himself bereaved of the hope which he cherished, that, an Orm- isdas took her not, he should certainly have her.
uz: Lysimax bu gapni eshitib, unga cheksiz yoqmadi, chunki u o'zi qadrlagan umiddan mahrum bo'lganini ko'rdi, ya'ni, agar Orm-isdas uni olmagan bo'lsa, u albatta uni olishi kerak edi.

en: However, like a wise man, he kept his chagrin hidden and fell to considering on what wise he might avail to hinder this having effect, but could see no way possible save the carrying her off.
uz: Ammo, dono odam kabi, u o'z xafaligini yashirdi va buning ta'siriga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun qanday yo'l topishi mumkinligini o'ylashga tushdi, lekin uni olib ketishdan boshqa hech qanday yo'l ko'rmadi.

en: This seemed easy to him to compass for the ofﬁce which he held, but he accounted the deed far more dishonourable than if he had not held the ofﬁce in question.
uz: Bu unga o'zi egallagan lavozimga nisbatan oson tuyuldi, lekin u bu ishni, agar u ushbu lavozimni egallagan bo'lmasa, undan ko'ra ancha sharmandali deb hisobladi.

en: Ultimately, however, after long deliberation, honour gave place to love and he determined, come what might of it, to carry off Cassandra.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, uzoq mulohazalardan so'ng, hurmat muhabbatga o'rin berdi va u Cassandrani olib ketishga qaror qildi.

en: Then, bethinking himself of the company he must have
uz: Keyin, o'zini kompaniya haqida o'ylab, u bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan

en: and the course he must hold to do this, he remembered him of Cimon, whom he had in prison with his comrades, and concluded that he might have no better or trustier companion than Cimon in this affair.
uz: Va bu yo'lni tutishi kerak edi, u uni o'rtoqlari bilan qamoqda saqlagan Kimondan esladi va bu ishda Kimondan yaxshiroq yoki ishonchliroq hamrohga ega bo'lishi mumkin emas deb xulosa qildi.

en: Accordingly, that same night he had him privily into his chamber and proceeded to bespeak him on this wise: ‘Cimon, like as the gods are very excellent and bountiful givers of things to men, even so are they most saga- cious provers of their virtues, and those, whom they ﬁnd resolute and con- stant under all circumstances, they hold deserving, as the most worthy, of the highest recompenses.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'sha kecha uni o'z xonasiga yashirincha olib kirdi va unga shunday dedi: Simon, xuddi xudolar odamlarga narsa beradigan juda a'lo va saxiy bo'lgani kabi, ular ham o'z fazilatlarining eng dono isbotlovchilari, va ularni har qanday holatda qat'iy va bardoshli deb topganlari, eng yuqori mukofotlarga loyiq deb hisoblashadi.

en: They have been minded to have more certain proof of thy worth than could be shown by thee within the limits of thy father’s house, whom I know to be abundantly endowed with riches; where- fore, ﬁrst, with the poignant instigations of love they brought thee from a senseless animal to be a man, and after with foul fortune and at this present with prison dour, they would fain try if thy spirit change not from that which it was, whenas thou wast scantwhile glad of the gotten prize.
uz: Ular sening qadringni otang xonadoni ichida ko'rsatganidan ko'ra aniqroq dalilga ega bo'lishni xohlashdi, men ularni boylik bilan boyligini bilaman; avval, sevgi bilan qo'rqinchli undovlar bilan seni bema'ni hayvondan inson bo'lishga olib kelishdi, keyin esa iflos omad bilan va hozirda qamoq quroli bilan, agar sening ruhing olingan mukofotdan xursand bo'lganingda, o'zgarmasa, ular harakat qilishlari kerak edi.

en: If that268 be the same as it was erst, they never yet vouchsafed thee aught so gladsome as that which they are presently prepared to bestow on thee and which, so thou mayst recover thy wonted powers and resume thy whilom spirit, I purpose to discover to thee.
uz: Agar o'sha 268 avvalgidek bo'lsa, ular senga hozirda senga berishga tayyor bo'lgan va sen o'z kuchlaringni tiklashing va butun ruhingni tiklashing uchun senga ochib bermoqchi bo'lgan narsa kabi quvonchliroq narsani hech qachon sovg'a qilishmagan.

en: Pasimondas, rejoicing in thy misadventure and a diligent promoter of thy death, bestirreth himself as most he may to celebrate his nuptials with thine Iphigenia, so therein he may enjoy the prize which fortune ﬁrst blithely con- ceded thee and after, growing troubled, took from thee of a sudden.
uz: Pasimondas, sening baxtsizligingdan xursand bo'lib, o'limingni g'ayrat bilan targ'ib qilgandan so'ng, o'zini iloji boricha ko'proq ifigening bilan to'ylarini nishonlashga undaydi, shunda u birinchi bo'lib seni yengillik bilan taslim qilgan va keyin, tashvishga tushib, sendan birdan tortib olgan mukofotdan bahramand bo'lishi mumkin.

en: How much this must grieve thee, an thou love as I believe, I know by myself, to whom Ormisdas his brother prepareth in one same day to do a like injury in the person of Cassandra, whom I love over all else.
uz: Bu senga qanchalar qayg'urishi kerak, senga ishonadigan muhabbat, men o'zim bilaman, Ormisdasning akasi bir kun ichida Kassandra shaxsiyatida xuddi shunday jarohat yetkazishga tayyorlagan, men uni hamma narsadan ham ko'proq sevaman.

en: To escape so great an unright and annoy of fortune, I see no way left open of her to us, save the valour of our souls and the might of our right hands, wherein it behoveth us take our swords and make us a way to the carrying off of our two mis- tresses, thee for the second and me for the ﬁrst time.
uz: Bunday buyuk nohaq va g'azablantiruvchi omaddan qochish uchun, undan bizga hech qanday yo'l qoldirilmaganini ko'rmayapman, faqatgina jonlarimizning jasorati va o'ng qo'llarimizning kuchidan tashqari, unda biz qilichlarimizni olib, ikki xatolarimizni, ikkinchidan senga va mendan birinchi marta olib ketishga yo'l topishimiz kerak.

en: If, then, it be dear to thee to have again —I will not say thy liberty, whereof methinketh thou reckest little without thy lady, but —thy mistress, the gods have put her in thy hands, an thou be willing to second me in my emprize.’ All Cimon’s lost spirit was requickened in him by these words and he replied, without overmuch consideration, ‘Lysimachus, thou canst have no stouter or trustier comrade than myself in such an enterprise, an that be to ensue thereof for me which thou avouchest; wherefore do thou command
uz: Agar senga yana bir bor qadrli bo'lsa  men sening ozodligingni aytmayman, sen xonimingdan tashqari uncha ko'p narsa sanamaysan, balki  xo'jayining, xudolar uni qo'lingga topshirgan, va sen meni mening asirligimda qo'llab-quvvatlashga tayyorsan. Bu so'zlar Simonning butun yo'qotilgan ruhini o'ziga tortdi va u haddan tashqari mulohaza qilmasdan javob berdi: Lysimax, sening bunday ishda mendan kuchliroq yoki ishonchliroq sheriking bo'lishi mumkin emas, sen meni o'zing qo'llab-quvvatlaganing uchun; shuning uchun

en: me that which thou deemest should be done of me, and thou shalt ﬁnd thy- self wonder-puissantly seconded.’ Then said Lysimachus, ‘On the third day from this the new-married wives will for the ﬁrst time enter their husbands’ houses, whereinto thou with thy companions armed and I with certain of my friends, in whom I put great trust, will make our way towards nightfall and snatching up our mistresses out of the midst of the guests, will carry them off to a ship, which I have caused secretly equip, slaying whosoever shall presume to offer opposition.’ The devise pleased Cimon and he abode quiet in prison until the appointed time.
uz: "Mendan nima qilsam bo'ladi deb o'ylaganingni, o'zingni ajoyib-kuchli tarzda qo'llab-quvvatlaganingni topasan." Lyzmax dedi: "Uchinchi kundan boshlab yangi turmush qurgan xotinlar birinchi marta erlariga kiradilar." U yerga sen hamrohlaring bilan qurollangan va men ba'zi do'stlarim bilan birga, men ularga katta ishonch bildiraman, tun bo'yi tomon yo'lga chiqamiz va mehmonlar orasidan malikalarimizni tortib, ularni yashirincha jihozlagan kemaga olib ketamiz, kim qarshilik ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsa, o'ldiramiz." Bu hiyla Shimonga yoqdi va u tayinlangan vaqtgacha qamoqda tinch turdi.

en: The wedding-day being come, great and magniﬁcent was the pomp of the festival and every part of the two brothers’ house was full of mirth and mer- rymaking; whereupon Lysimachus, having made ready everything needful, divided Cimon and his companions, together with his own friends, all armed under their clothes, into three parties and having ﬁrst kindled them to his purpose with many words, secretly despatched one party to the harbour, so none might hinder their going aboard the ship, whenas need should be.
uz: To'y kuni kelgach, bayramning ulug'vorligi va ulug'vorligi katta edi va ikki aka-uka uyining har bir qismi quvonch va shodlikka to'la edi; shundan so'ng, Lismak hamma narsani tayyorlab, Kimonni va uning hamrohlarini o'z do'stlari bilan birga, ularning barcha kiyimlari ostida qurollangan holda uchta guruhga bo'lib, avval o'z maqsadiga ko'p so'zlar bilan yo'naltirdi va bir guruhni portga yashirincha jo'natdi, shunda hech kim ularga kerak bo'lganda kemaga chiqishga to'sqinlik qilmasdi.

en: Then, coming with the other twain, whenas it seemed to him time, to Pasi- mondas his house, he left one party of them at the door, so as none might shut them up therewithin or forbid them the issue, and with Cimon and the rest went up by the stairs.
uz: Keyin, boshqa ikki kishi bilan birga kelgach, o'ziga vaqt kelganda, Pasi-mondalar uyiga bordi, u ulardan bir guruhini eshik oldida qoldirdi, toki hech kim ularni u yerda yopib qo'ymasligi yoki bu masalaga xalaqit bermasligi uchun, va Kimon va qolganlar zinadan yuqoriga ko'tarildilar.

en: Coming to the saloon where the new-wedded brides were seated orderly at meat with many other ladies, they rushed in upon them and overthrowing the tables, took each his mistress and putting them in the hands of their comrades, bade straightway carry them to the ship that was in waiting.
uz: Yangi turmush qurgan kelinlar boshqa ko'plab xonimlar bilan birga go'shtda tartibli o'tirgan salonga kelib, ularning ustiga shoshilishdi va stollarni ag'darib, har biri o'z bekasini olib, o'rtoqlarining qo'liga topshirib, ularni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kutilayotgan kemaga olib borishardi.

en: The brides fell a-weeping and shrieking, as did likewise the other ladies and the servants, and the whole house was of a sudden full of clamour and lamentation.
uz: Kelinlar yig'lab, qichqiriq qilib yiqilishdi, xuddi boshqa xonimlar va xizmatchilar ham shunday qilishdi, va butun uy birdan shovqin va motamga to'ldi.

en: Cimon and Lysimachus and their companions, drawing their swords, made for the stairs, without any opposition, all giving way to them, and as they descended, Pasimondas presented himself before them, with a great cudgel in his hand, being drawn thither by the outcry; but Cimon dealt him a swashing blow on the head and cleaving it sheer in sunder, laid him dead at his feet.
uz: Simon va Lysimax va ularning hamrohlari qilichlarini tortib, hech qanday qarshiliksiz zinapoyalarga chiqdilar, ularning barchasi ularga yo'l berdilar va ular pastga tushayotganda, Pasimonda o'zini ularning oldiga ko'rsatdi, qo'lida katta dastak bilan, u yerga hayqiriqdan tortildi; lekin Simon uning boshiga qattiq zarba berdi va uni kesib tashladi, oyoqlari ostida o'lik holda yotqizdi.

en: The wretched Ormisdas, running to his brother’s aid, was on like wise slain by one of Cimon’s strokes, and divers others who sought to draw nigh them were in like manner wounded and beaten off by the companions of the latter and Lysimachus, who, leaving the house full of blood and clam- our and weeping and woe, drew together and made their way to the ship with their prizes, unhindered of any.
uz: Bechora Ormisdalar, akasining yordamiga yugurib, xuddi Kimonning bir zarbasi bilan dono o'ldirilgandek edi va ularga yaqinlashmoqchi bo'lgan boshqa turli xil odamlar ham xuddi shunday tarzda yaralandi va kaltaklandi, oxirgi va Lisimakning hamrohlari tomonidan. Ular uyni qon va shovqin bilan to'ldirgan holda tark etishdi  bizning va yig'layotgan va qayg'uga to'la bo'lib, hech kimga to'sqinlik qilmasdan, sovg'alari bilan kemaga yo'l olishdi.

en: Here they embarked with their mis-
uz: Bu yerda ular o'z xatolariga yo'l olishdi.

en: tresses and all their companions, the shore being now full of armed folk come to the rescue of the ladies, and thrusting the oars into the water, made off, rejoicing, about their business.
uz: To'siqlar va ularning barcha hamrohlari, qirg'oq endi qurollangan odamlar bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, xonimlarni qutqarishga kelishadi va eshkaklarni suvga itarib, xursand bo'lib, o'z ishlaridan xursand bo'lishadi.

en: Coming presently to Crete, they were there joyfully received by many, both friends and kinsfolk, and espousing their mistresses with great pomp, gave themselves up to the glad enjoyment of their purchase.
uz: Yaqinda Kritga kelib, ular u yerda ko'pchilik tomonidan quvonch bilan kutib olindilar, do'stlari ham, qarindoshlari ham. Ular malikalarini katta dabdaba bilan turmushga chiqarib, xarid qilishdan quvonch bilan rohatlanishdi.

en: Loud and long were the clamours and differences in Cyprus and in Rhodes by reason of their doings; but, ultimately, their friends and kinsfolk, interposing in one and the other place, found means so to adjust matters that, after some exile, Cimon joyfully returned to Cyprus with Iphigenia, whilst Lysimachus on like wise returned to Rhodes with Cassandra, and each lived long and happily with his mistress in his own country.”
uz: Kipr va Rodosdagi farqlar va farqlar ularning harakatlari tufayli baland va uzoq davom etdi; ammo, oxir-oqibat, ularning do'stlari va qarindoshlari bir joyda va boshqa joyda o'zaro aloqa qilib, vaziyatni shunday tuzatish yo'lini topdiki, bir muddat surgundan so'ng, Kimon quvonch bilan Kiprga Ifigeniya bilan qaytdi, Lisimak esa xuddi shunday donolik bilan Kassandra bilan Rodosga qaytdi va har biri o'z xo'jayini bilan uzoq va baxtli yashadi.

en: THE SECOND STORY Costanza loveth Martuccio Gomito and hearing that he is dead, embarketh for despair alone in a boat, which is carried by the wind to Susa.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Costanza Martuccio Gomitoga oshiq bo'ladi va uning o'lganini eshitib, Susaga shamol tomonidan olib ketiladigan qayiqda yolg'iz umidsizlikka tushadi.

en: Finding her lover alive at Tunis, she discovereth herself to him and he, being great in favour with the king for counsels given, espouseth her and returneth rich with her to Lipari.
uz: Tunisda sevgilisini tirik holda topgach, u unga o'zini topadi va u, berilgan maslahatlar uchun shohning marhamatiga sazovor bo'lib, uni turmushga chiqadi va u bilan Lipariga boy bo'lib qaytadi.

en: The queen, seeing Pamﬁlo’s story at an end, after she had much commen- ded it, enjoined Emilia to follow on, telling another, and she accordingly began thus: “Everyone must naturally delight in those things wherein he seeth rewards ensue according to the affections;269 and for that love in the long run deserveth rather happiness than afﬂiction, I shall, intreating of the present theme, obey the queen with much greater pleasure to myself than I did the king in that of yesterday.
uz: Qirolicha, Pamfiloning hikoyasini oxirida ko'rib, uni juda ko'p boshlaganidan so'ng, Emiliyaga boshqaga aytib, davom etishni buyurdi va u shunga mos ravishda shunday boshladi: "Har bir inson o'ziga xos bo'lgan mehribonlikka ko'ra mukofotlarni ko'rishi kerak; 269 va bu muhabbat uzoq muddatda baxtdan ko'ra azobga loyiq bo'lgani uchun, men hozirgi mavzuga murojaat qilib, qirolga o'zimga kecha bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq mamnuniyat bilan itoat qilaman."

en: You must know, then, dainty dames, that near unto Sicily is an islet called Lipari, wherein, no great while agone, was a very fair damsel called Cost- anza, born of a very considerable family there.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, go'zal xonimlar, Sitsiliyaga yaqin Lipari degan kichik orol bor edi. U yerda, o'tmishda, Cost-anza ismli juda go'zal bir qiz bor edi, u yerda juda katta oiladan tug'ilgan edi.

en: It chanced that a young man of the same island, called Martuccio Gomito, who was very agreeable and well bred and of approved worth270 in his craft,271 fell in love with her; and she in like manner so burned for him that she was never easy save whenas she saw him.
uz: Shunday bo'lib qoldiki, xuddi shu orollik yigit, Martuccio Gomito deb nomlanuvchi, juda xushmuomala va yaxshi tarbiyalangan, o'z kasbida 270 dollarlik bo'lgan yigit, 271 yil davomida unga oshiq bo'lib qoldi; va u xuddi shunday tarzda unga shunchalik ishqiboz ediki, uni ko'rmaguncha hech qachon oson bo'lmadi.

en: Martuccio, wishing to have her to wife, caused demand her of her father, who answered that he was poor and that therefore he would not give her to him.
uz: Martutsiyo uni xotinlikka olishni xohlab, otasidan uni talab qilishga majbur qildi. Otasi esa uni kambag'al ekanligini va shuning uchun unga bermasligini aytdi.

en: The young man, enraged to see himself rejected for poverty, in concert with certain of his friends and kinsmen, equipped a light ship and swore never to return to Lipari, except rich.
uz: Yigit, o'zini qashshoqlik uchun rad etilganini ko'rib g'azablanib, ba'zi do'stlari va qarindoshlari bilan birgalikda yengil kemani jihozladi va boylardan boshqa hech qachon Lipariga qaytmaslikka qasam ichdi.

en: Accordingly, he depar- ted thence and turning corsair, fell to cruising off the coast of Barbary and plundering all who were weaker than himself; wherein fortune was favour- able enough to him, had he known how to set bounds to his wishes; but, it
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u u yerdan jo'nab, kursairga aylandi, Barbar qirg'og'idan suzib chiqishga va o'zidan zaif bo'lganlarning hammasini talon-toroj qilishga tushdi; bunda unga boylik yetarli edi, agar u o'z istaklariga chek qo'yishni bilganida edi; lekin,

en: sufﬁcing him not to have waxed very rich, he and his comrades, in a brief space of time, it befell that, whilst they sought to grow overrich, he was, after a long defence, taken and plundered with all his companions by certain ships of the Saracens, who, after scuttling the vessel and sacking the greater part of the crew, carried Martuccio to Tunis, where he was put in prison and long kept in misery.
uz: Unga juda boy bo'lib ketish kifoya qilmagani uchun, u va uning o'rtoqlari qisqa vaqt ichida boyib ketishga urinib, uzoq mudofaa o'tgach, Saracenlarning ayrim kemalari tomonidan barcha hamrohlari bilan birga talon-toroj qilindi. Ular kemani cho'ktirib, ekipajning katta qismini o'g'irlaganidan so'ng, Martuccioni Tunisga olib ketishdi, u yerda qamoqqa olindi va uzoq vaqt azob chekdi.

en: The news was brought to Lipari, not by one or by two, but by many and divers persons, that he and all on board the bark had been drowned; whereupon the girl, who had been beyond measure woebegone for her lov- er’s departure, hearing that he was dead with the others, wept sore and re- solved in herself to live no longer; but, her heart suffering her not to slay herself by violence, she determined to give a new occasion272 to her death.273 Accordingly, she issued secretly forth of her father’s house one night and betaking herself to the harbour, happened upon a ﬁshing smack, a little aloof from the other ships, which, for that its owners had but then landed therefrom, she found furnished with mast and sail and oars.
uz: Lipariga xabar yetkazildi, bir-ikki emas, balki ko'p va xilma-xil shaxslar tomonidan, u va kemadagilarning hammasi cho'kib ketganligi haqida; shundan so'ng, uning sevgilisi ketgani uchun cheksiz tashvishga tushgan qiz, u boshqalarning o'zi bilan birga o'lganini eshitib, og'riq bilan yig'ladi va o'zicha yashashga qaror qildi; lekin, uning yuragi zo'ravonlik bilan o'zini o'ldirmaslikka qiynalib, u o'z o'limiga yangi 272 berishga qaror qildi.

en: In this she hastily embarked and rowed herself out to sea; then, being somewhat skilled in the mariner’s art, as the women of that island mostly are, she made sail and casting the oars and rudder adrift, committed herself altogeth- er to the mercy of the waves, conceiving that it must needs happen that the wind would either overturn a boat without lading or steersman or drive it upon some rock and break it up, whereby she could not, even if she would, escape, but must of necessity be drowned.
uz: Shu bilan u shoshilinch ravishda jo'nab, dengizga chiqdi; keyin, dengizchi san'atida biroz mohir bo'lgan holda, o'sha orol ayollari ko'pchilik kabi, u yelkanni suzib, eshkaklar va rulonlarni suzib yurdi, o'zini to'lqinlarning rahm-shafqatiga bag'ishladi, shamol yoki yuk tashuvchi yoki boshqaruvchisiz qayiqni ag'darib yuborishi kerak, yoki uni biror toshga haydab, sindirib tashlashi kerak, shunda u, hatto xohlasa ham, qochib qutula olmasdi, lekin albatta cho'kib ketishi kerak edi.

en: Accordingly, wrapping her head in a mantle, she laid herself, weeping, in the bottom of the boat.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, boshini mantiqqa o'rab, u qayiqning tubiga yig'lab yotdi.

en: But it befell altogether otherwise than as she conceived, for that, the wind being northerly and very light and there being well nigh no sea, the boat rode it out in safety and brought her on the morrow, about vespers, to a beach near a town called Susa, a good hundred miles beyond Tunis.
uz: Ammo u o'ylaganidan butunlay boshqacha bo'ldi, shuning uchun shamol shimoldan va juda yengil edi va dengiz deyarli yo'q edi, qayiq uni xavfsiz holda haydab chiqdi va ertasi kuni, ertalab, tunisdan bir necha yuz mil uzoqlikda joylashgan Susa shahri yaqinidagi plyajga olib keldi.

en: The girl, who, for aught that might happen, had never lifted nor meant to lift her head, felt nothing of being ashore more than at sea;274 but, as chance would have it, there was on the beach, whenas the bark struck upon it, a poor wo- man in act to take up from the sun the nets of the ﬁshermen her masters, who, seeing the bark, marvelled how it should be left to strike full sail upon the land.
uz: Qiz, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, hech qachon boshini ko'tarmagan va ko'tarmoqchi ham bo'lmagan, dengizdan ko'ra qirg'oqda bo'lishni hech narsa his qilmagan; 274 lekin, tasodifan, sohilda, po'stlog'i unga urilganda, bechora bir odam quyoshdan o'z xo'jayinlarining to'rlarini olmoqchi edi, u po'stlog'ini ko'rib, quruqlikka to'liq suzish uchun qanday qoldirilishi kerakligi haqida hayratda edi.

en: Thinking that the ﬁshermen aboard were asleep, she went up to the bark and seeing none therein but the damsel aforesaid, who slept fast, called her many times and having at last aroused her and knowing her by her habit for a Christian, asked her in Latin how she came there in that bark all alone.
uz: Baliqchilar kemada uxlayotganini o'ylab, u qoyaga chiqdi va u yerda faqat yuqorida aytilgan qizni ko'rmadi. U tez uxlagan, uni ko'p marta chaqirgan va nihoyat uni uyg'otgan va xristian bo'lish odati bilan tanigan, undan lotin tilida o'sha qoyada qanday qilib kelganini so'radi.

en: The girl, hearing her speak Latin, misdoubted her a shift of wind must have driven her back to Lipari and starting suddenly to her feet, looked about her, but knew not the country, and seeing herself on land, asked the good wo- man where she was; to which she answered, ‘Daughter mine, thou art near unto Susa in Barbary.’ The girl, hearing this, was woeful for that God had not chosen to vouchsafe her the death she sought, and being in fear of shame and knowing not what to do, she seated herself at the foot of her bark and fell a-weeping.
uz: Qiz uni lotin tilida gapirganini eshitib, bir shamolning o'zgarishi uni Lipariga qaytargan bo'lishi kerak edi va birdaniga oyoqqa turdi, atrofga qaradi, lekin mamlakatni bilmasdi va o'zini quruqlikda ko'rib, yaxshi odamdan qayerda ekanligini so'radi; unga javob berdi: "Qizim, sen Barbaridagi Susaga yaqinsan." Qiz buni eshitib, Xudo unga izlagan o'limni berishni tanlamaganidan xafa bo'ldi va uyatdan qo'rqib, nima qilish kerakligini bilmay, o'zini qovog'ining etagiga o'tqazib, yig'ladi.

en: The good woman, seeing this, took pity upon her and brought her, by dint of entreaty, into a little hut of hers and there so humoured her that she told her how she came thither; whereupon, seeing that she was fasting, she set before her her own dry bread and somewhat of ﬁsh and water and so be- sought her that she ate a little.
uz: Yaxshi ayol buni ko'rib, unga rahm qildi va iltijo bilan uni o'zining kichkina kulbasiga olib kirdi. U yerda uni shunday hazillashdiki, u yerga qanday yetib kelganini aytdi; shundan so'ng, ro'za tutganini ko'rib, o'zining quruq nonini, bir oz baliq va suvini oldinga qo'ydi va uni biroz yeyish uchun qidirdi.

en: Costanza after asked her who she was that she spoke Latin thus; to which she answered that she was from Trapani and was called Carapresa and served certain Christian ﬁshermen there.
uz: Costanza undan kimligini so'raganidan so'ng, u lotin tilida shunday gapirganini aytdi; unga u Trapaniydan ekanligi, Karapresa deb atalgani va u yerda ba'zi xristian baliqchilarga xizmat qilayotganini aytdi.

en: The girl, hearing the name of Carapresa, albeit she was exceeding woebegone and knew not what reason moved her thereunto, took it unto herself for a good augury to have heard this name275 and began to hope, without knowing what, and somewhat to abate of her wish to die.
uz: Qiz, Karapressaning ismini eshitib, garchi juda ham g'amgin bo'lsa ham va uni bunga nima sababdan undayotganini bilmasa ham, bu ismni eshitganidan yaxshi gumon deb o'ziga oldi va nima ekanligini bilmasdan umid qila boshladi va o'lim istagidan biroz susaydi.

en: Then, without discovering who or whence she was, she earnestly besought the good woman to have pity, for the love of God, on her youth and give her some counsel how she might escape any affront being offered her.
uz: Keyin, kim yoki qayerdan ekanligini bilmasdan, u yaxshi ayoldan yoshligi uchun, Xudoning muhabbati uchun rahm qilishini va unga har qanday haqoratdan qanday qutulish mumkinligi haqida maslahat berishni chin dildan so'radi.

en: Carapresa, like a good woman as she was, hearing this, left her in her hut, whilst she hastily gathered up her nets; then, returning to her, she wrapped her from head to foot in her own mantle and carried her to Susa, where she said to her, ‘Costanza, I will bring thee into the house of a very good Sara- cen lady, whom I serve oftentimes in her occasions and who is old and piti- ful.
uz: Karapresa, o'zi yaxshi ayol kabi, buni eshitib, uni kulbasida qoldirdi, u shoshilinch ravishda to'rlarini yig'di; so'ngra, unga qaytib, uni boshidan oyoqqa o'rab, Susaga olib bordi va u unga dedi: Kostanza, men seni juda yaxshi Sara-cen xonimaning uyiga olib kiraman, unga tez-tez xizmat qilaman va u keksa va achinarli.

en: I will commend thee to her as most I may and I am very certain that she will gladly receive thee and use thee as a daughter; and do thou, abiding with her, study thine utmost, in serving her, to gain her favour, against God send thee better fortune.’ And as she said, so she did.
uz: Men seni unga imkon qadar tavsiya qilaman va u seni xursandchilik bilan qabul qilishi va qiz sifatida ishlatishiga juda aminman; va sen u bilan birga bo'lib, unga xizmat qilishda, uning marhamatiga erishish uchun bor kuchingni sarfla, Xudo senga yaxshiroq omad ato etsin." Va u aytganidek, u shunday qildi.

en: The lady, who was well stricken in years, hearing the woman’s story, looked the girl in the face and fell a-weeping; then taking her by the hand, she kissed her on the fore- head and carried her into her house, where she and sundry other women abode, without any man, and wrought all with their hands at various crafts, doing divers works of silk and palm-ﬁbre and leather.
uz: Ayolning bu hikoyasini eshitib, yillar davomida qattiq azob chekkan xonim qizning yuziga qaradi va yig'lab yubordi; so'ngra uni qo'lidan ushladi, old boshidan o'pdi va uyiga olib kirdi, u yerda u va boshqa turli ayollar hech qanday erkaksiz yashardilar va turli hunarmandchilikda o'z qo'llari bilan ishladilar, ipak, palma tolasi va charmdan turli xil ishlar qilishardi.

en: Costanza soon learned to do some of these and falling to working with the rest, became in
uz: Costanza tez orada bularning ba'zilarini qilishni o'rganib, qolganlari bilan ishlashga tushdi va...

en: such favour with the lady and the others that it was a marvellous thing; nor was it long before, with their teaching, she learnt their language.
uz: Xonim va boshqalar tomonidan shunday marhamat ko'rsatdiki, bu ajoyib narsa edi; ularning ta'limoti bilan u ularning tilini o'rgangan ham emas edi.

en: What while she abode thus at Susa, being now mourned at home for lost and dead, it befell that, one Mariabdela276 being King of Tunis, a certain youth of great family and much puissance in Granada, avouching that that kingdom belonged to himself, levied a great multitude of folk and came upon King Mariabdela, to oust him from the kingship.
uz: U Susa shahrida shu tariqa yashab turganida, hozirda yo'qolgan va o'lganlar uchun uyida motam tutganida, shunday bo'ldi: bir Maryambdela276 Tunis qiroli bo'lib, Granada shahrida katta oila va qudratga ega bo'lgan, o'sha qirollik o'ziga tegishli ekanligini anglagan, ko'p xalqni yig'ib, uni qirollikdan haydash uchun Maryambdelaga keldi.

en: This came to the ears of Martuccio Gomito in prison and he knowing the Barbary language excel- lent well and hearing that the king was making great efforts for his defence, said to one of those who had him and his fellows in keeping, ‘An I might have speech of the king, my heart assureth me that I could give him a coun- sel, by which he should gain this his war.’ The keeper reported these words to his chief, and he carried them incontinent to the king, who bade fetch Martuccio and asked him what might be his counsel; whereto he made an- swer on this wise, ‘My lord, if, what time I have otherwhiles frequented these your dominions, I have noted aright the order you keep in your battles, meseemeth you wage them more with archers than with aught else; wherefore, if a means could be found whereby your adversary’s bowmen should lack of arrows, whilst your own had abundance thereof, methinketh
uz: Bu Martuccio Gomitoga qamoqxonada eshitildi va u Barbariy tilini yaxshi o'rgatganini bilib, qirol uning himoyasi uchun katta kuch sarflayotganini eshitib, o'zi va uning sheriklaridan biriga dedi: "Menda qirolning so'zi bo'lishi mumkin, qalbim ishonadi, men unga urushni qozonish uchun bir maslahat bera olaman." Qo'riqchi bu so'zlarni o'z boshlig'iga yetkazdi va ularni qirolga tashladi. Martuccio uni olib borib, undan maslahat so'radi.

en: your battle would be won.’ ‘Without doubt,’ answered the king, ‘and this might be compassed, I should deem myself assured of victory.’ Whereupon, ‘My lord,’ quoth Martuccio, ‘an you will, this may very well be done, and you shall hear how.
uz: "Sizning jangingiz g'alaba qozonadi." Shubha yo'q,  javob berdi shoh, va bu g'alaba qozonilishi mumkin, men o'zimni g'alabaga ishonuvchi deb hisoblayman. Shunda, Ey xo'jayinim, dedi Martuchcho, agar siz xohlasangiz, bu juda yaxshi amalga oshirilishi mumkin va siz qanday eshitasiz.

en: You must let make strings for your archers’ bows much thinner than those which are everywhere commonly used and after let make arrows, the notches whereof shall not serve but for these thin strings.
uz: Kamonchilaringiz uchun arqonlar yasashingiz kerak  kamonlar hamma joyda keng qo'llaniladigan kamonlardan ancha ingichka bo'lishi kerak va o'q yasashdan keyin, ularning teshiklari faqat shu ingichka arqonlar uchun xizmat qilmaydi.

en: This must be so secretly done that your adversary should know nought thereof; else would he ﬁnd a remedy therefor; and the reason for which I counsel you thus is this.
uz: Bu shunday yashirincha amalga oshirilishi kerakki, dushmaningiz hech narsani bilmasin; aks holda u bunga chora topgan bo'lardi; va men sizga maslahat beradigan sabab shu.

en: After your enemy’s archers and your own shall have shot all their arrows, you know that, the battle lasting, it will behove your foes to gather up the arrows shot by your men and the latter in like manner to gath- er theirs; but the enemy will not be able to make use of your arrows, by reason of the strait notches which will not take their thick strings, whereas the contrary will betide your men of the enemy’s arrows, for that the thin strings will excellently well take the wide-notched arrows; and so your men will have abundance of ammunition, whilst the others will suffer default thereof.’
uz: Dushmaningizning kamonchilari va o'zingizning o'qlaringiz ularning barcha o'qlarini otgandan so'ng, bilasizki, jang davom etar ekan, dushmanlaringiz sizning odamlaringiz tomonidan otilgan o'qlarni to'plashga majbur bo'ladilar va oxirgilari o'zlarining o'qlarini to'plashga majbur bo'ladilar; lekin dushman o'zlarining qalin o'qlarini qabul qilmaydigan teshiklar tufayli sizning o'qlaringizdan foydalana olmaydi, aksincha, dushmaningizning o'qlariga qarama-qarshilik qiladi, chunki ingichka o'qlar keng teshikli o'qlarni mukammal ushlaydi; va shuning uchun sizning odamlaringiz o'q-dorilar bilan to'lib-toshadi, qolganlari esa ulardan aziyat chekadi.

en: The king, who was a wise prince, was pleased with Martuccio’s counsel and punctually following it, found himself thereby to have won his war.
uz: Shoh, dono shahzoda bo'lganligi sababli, Martuchkoning maslahatiga rozi bo'ldi va unga o'z vaqtida amal qildi, shu bilan o'z urushida g'alaba qozonganini aniqladi.

en: Wherefore Martuccio became in high favour with him and rose in con- sequence to great and rich estate.
uz: Shuning uchun Martutsiyo unga yuqori hurmat qozondi va ketma-ket buyuk va boy mulkka ko'tarildi.

en: The report of these things spread over the land and it came presently to Costanza’s ears that Martuccio Gomito, whom she had long deemed dead, was alive, whereupon the love of him, that was now grown cool in her heart, broke out of a sudden into fresh ﬂame and waxed greater than ever, whilst dead hope revived in her.
uz: Bu narsalarning xabari butun yurt bo'ylab tarqaldi va Costanza'ning qulog'iga tezda u allaqachon o'lik deb hisoblagan Martuccio Gomito tirik ekanligi, shundan so'ng uning yuragida sovib ketgan muhabbati to'satdan yangi olovga aylanib, har qachongidan ham buyukroq bo'lib, unda o'lik umid tirildi.

en: Therewithal she altogether discovered her every adventure to the good lady, with whom she dwelt, and told her that she would fain go to Tunis, so she might satisfy her eyes of that whereof her ears had made them desireful, through the reports received.
uz: Shundan so'ng u o'zining har bir sarguzashtini o'zi yashayotgan yaxshi xonimga topdi va unga Tunisga borishni xohlashini aytdi, shunda u olgan xabarlar orqali quloqlari orzu qilgan narsalarga ko'zlarini qondirishi mumkin edi.

en: The old lady greatly commended her purpose and taking ship with her, carried her, as if she had been her mother, to Tunis, where they were honourably entertained in the house of a kinswoman of hers.
uz: Kampir o'z maqsadiga katta baho berdi va uni o'zi bilan kemaga olib, go'yo onasi bo'lgandek Tunisga olib bordi, u yerda ular o'z qarindoshining uyida sharafli tarzda ko'rishdi.

en: There she des- patched Carapresa, who had come with them, to see what she could learn of Martuccio, and she, ﬁnding him alive and in great estate and reporting this to the old gentlewoman, it pleased the latter to will to be she who should signify unto Martuccio that his Costanza was come thither to him; where- fore, betaking herself one day whereas he was, she said to him, ‘Martuccio, there is come to my house a servant of thine from Lipari, who would fain speak with thee privily there; wherefore, not to trust to others, I have my- self, at his desire, come to give thee notice thereof.’ He thanked her and fol- lowed her to her house, where when Costanza saw him, she was like to die of gladness and unable to contain herself, ran straightway with open arms to throw herself on his neck; then, embracing him, without availing to say aught, she fell a-weeping tenderly, both for compassion of
uz: U yerda u bilan kelgan Karapreskani tuzatdi, Martuccio haqida nima o'rganishi mumkinligini ko'rish uchun. U uni tirik va juda yaxshi holatda topib, bu haqda keksa ayolga xabar berganida, u Martuccioga Costanza unga kelganini bildirishni xohladi. U esa bir kuni o'zini u yerda ko'rib, unga dedi: "Martuccio, mening uyimga Lipari'dan bir xizmatkoring keldi, u bilan shaxsan gaplashishni istamaydi; shuning uchun men boshqalarga ishonmayman, uning xohishiga ko'ra, bu haqda xabar berishga boraman." U unga rahmat aytdi va uni uyiga tashladi.

en: their past ill for- tunes and for present gladness.
uz: Ularning o'tmishdagi yomonliklari - ohanglar va hozirgi quvonch uchun.

en: Martuccio, seeing his mistress, abode awhile dumb for amazement, then said sighing, ‘O my Costanza, art thou then yet alive?
uz: Martuchcho o'z bekasini ko'rib, hayratdan biroz jim qoldi, so'ngra ingrab dedi: "Ey mening Costanza, sen hali ham tirikmisan?"

en: It is long since I heard that thou wast lost; nor in our country was aught known of thee.’ So saying, he embraced her, weeping, and kissed her tenderly.
uz: Sen yo'qolib ketganingni eshitganimga ancha bo'ldi; bizning mamlakatimizda sening haqingda hech narsa ma'lum emas edi. Shunday deb, u uni quchoqlab, yig'ladi va mehr bilan o'pdi.

en: Costanza then related to him all that had befallen her and the honourable treatment which she had received from the gentlewoman with whom she dwelt; and Martuc- cio, after much discourse, taking leave of her, repaired to the king his mas- ter and told him all, to wit, his own adventures and those of the damsel, adding that, with his leave, he meant to take her to wife, according to our law.
uz: Kostanza unga boshidan kechirgan hamma narsani va u yashayotgan janob ayoldan olgan hurmatli muomalasini aytib berdi; va Martuc-tio uzoq suhbatdan so'ng, undan xayr so'rab, podshohga o'z xo'jayiniga murojaat qilib, unga o'z sarguzashtlari va qizning sarguzashtlarini, shuningdek, uning ruxsatnomasi bilan uni bizning qonuniga muvofiq xotinlikka olib ketmoqchi ekanligini aytdi.

en: The king marvelled at these things and sending for the damsel and
uz: Shoh bu narsalarga hayratda qoldi va qizni olib kelishni buyurdi.

en: hearing from her that it was even as Martuccio had avouched, said to her, ‘Then hast thou right well earned him to husband.’ Then, letting bring very great and magniﬁcent gifts, he gave part thereof to her and part to Martuc- cio, granting them leave to do one with the other that which was most pleas- ing unto each of them; whereupon Martuccio, having entreated the gentle- woman who had harboured Costanza with the utmost honour and thanked her for that which she had done to serve her and bestowed on her such gifts as sorted with her quality, commended her to God and took leave of her, he and his mistress, not without many tears from the latter.
uz: Undan Martucko xuddi shunday bo'lgani haqida eshitib, unga dedi: "Unda sen uni erga yaxshigina topding." Keyin, juda katta va ajoyib sovg'alar olib kelishga ruxsat berib, u ularning bir qismini unga va bir qismini Martuckoga berdi, ularga har biriga eng yoqqan narsani qilish uchun ruxsat berdi; shundan so'ng Martuccio Costantzani eng katta sharaf bilan qabul qilgan muloyim ayolga iltijo qilib, unga xizmat qilish uchun qilgan ishi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi va unga o'z sifatiga mos keladigan sovg'alar berdi, uni Xudoga maqtadi va undan ketdi, u va uning bekasi esa undan ko'p yoshlarsiz.

en: Then, with the king’s leave, they embarked with Carapresa on board a little ship and re- turned with a fair wind to Lipari, where so great was the rejoicing that it might never be told.
uz: So'ngra, shohning ruxsatnomasi bilan, ular kichik kemaga Karapresnaga chiqishdi va yaxshi shamol bilan Lipariga qaytishdi, u yerda quvonch shunchalik katta ediki, buni hech qachon aytish mumkin emas edi.

en: There Martuccio took Costanza to wife and held great and goodly nuptials; after which they long in peace and repose had enjoy- ment of their loves.”
uz: U yerda Martucko Costantzani xotinlikka oldi va ajoyib va yaxshi nikohlar o'tkazdi; shundan so'ng ular tinchlikda va dam olishda o'z sevgilaridan zavqlanishdi.

en: THE THIRD STORY Pietro Boccamazza, ﬂeeing with Agnolella, falleth among thieves; the girl escapeth through a wood and is led (by fortune) to a castle, whilst Pietro is taken by the thieves, but presently, escaping from their hands, winneth, after divers adventures, to the castle where his mistress is and espousing her, returneth with her to Rome.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA Pietro Boccamazza Agnolella bilan qochib, o'g'rilar orasida qolib ketadi; qiz o'rmondan qochib, omad bilan qasrga olib boriladi, Pietro esa o'g'rilar tomonidan qo'lga olinadi, lekin hozirda ularning qo'lidan qochib, turli sarguzashtlardan so'ng, uning bekasi bor va uni turmushga chiqqan qasrga qaytib keladi va u bilan Rimga qaytadi.

en: There was none among all the company but commended Emilia’s story, which the queen seeing to be ﬁnished, turned to Elisa and bade her follow on.
uz: Butun jamoa orasida Emilia'ning hikoyasini maqtamdan boshqa hech kim yo'q edi. Qirolicha uni tugatganini ko'rib, Elisaga o'girilib, uni davom ettirishga buyurdi.

en: Accordingly, studious to obey, she began: “There occurreth to my mind, charming ladies, an ill night passed by a pair of indiscreet young lovers; but, for that many happy days ensued thereon, it pleaseth me to tell the story, as one that conformeth to our proposition.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, itoat qilishga intilib, u boshladi: Mening xayolimda, yoqimli xonimlar, bir yomon tun bir juft beparvo yosh oshiqlar tomonidan o'tdi; lekin, undan keyin ko'plab baxtli kunlar o'tib ketganligi sababli, bu hikoyani bizning taklifimizga mos keladiganidek aytib berish menga yoqadi.

en: There was, a little while agone, at Rome —once the head, as it is nowadays the tail of the world277 —a youth, called Pietro Boccamazza, of a very worshipful family among those of the city, who fell in love with a very fair and lovesome damsel called Agnolella, the daughter of one Gigliuozzo Saullo, a plebeian, but very dear to the Romans, and loving her, he con- trived so to do that the girl began to love him no less than he loved her; whereupon, constrained by fervent love and himseeming he might no longer brook the cruel pain that the desire he had of her gave him, he demanded her in marriage; which no sooner did his kinsfolk know than they all re- paired to him and chid him sore for that which he would have done; and on the other hand they gave Gigliuozzo to understand that he should make no account of Pietro’s words, for that, an he did this, they would never have him for friend or
uz: Rimda bir oz vaqt o'tgach, bir vaqtlar bosh bo'lgan edi  hozirgi kunda dunyo dumi bo'lgani kabi 277  shahar aholisidan Pietro Boccamazza ismli yosh yigit, shaharning juda ibodatli oilasidan bo'lib, u juda go'zal va yoqimli Agnolella ismli ayolga oshiq bo'lgan edi. U bir Gigliuozzo Saullo'ning qizi edi, plebeyn edi, lekin Rimliklarga juda aziz edi, va uni yaxshi ko'rardi, shuning uchun u qiz uni sevganidan kam sevishni boshladi; shundan so'ng, Pedro qizg'in muhabbat bilan cheklangan edi va u unga bergan shafqatsiz og'riqni ko'ra olmasdi, u uni turmushga soladi; u yaqin qarindoshlari uni ham unga qayta juftlashtirganini va u unga do'st bo'lishi kerakligini tushunmas edi; va u unga hech qachon bu so'zlarni bermasdi, chunki u...

en: kinsman.
uz: qarindosh.

en: Pietro seeing that way barred whereby alone he deemed he might avail to win to his desire, was like to die of chagrin, and had Gigliuozzo consented, he would have taken his daughter to wife, in
uz: Pietro bu yo'lni ko'rib, o'z xohishiga erishish uchun faqat o'zi foydalana olishini o'ylagan holda, xafalikdan o'lgandek edi va Gigliuozzo rozi bo'lganida, qizini xotinlikka olib ketgan bo'lardi.

en: despite of all his kindred.
uz: barcha qarindoshlariga qaramay.

en: However, he determined, an it liked the girl, to contrive to give effect to their wishes, and having assured himself, by means of an intermediary, that this was agreeable to her, he agreed with her that she should ﬂee with him from Rome.
uz: Biroq, u qizga ma'qul bo'lgani uchun, ularning istaklarini amalga oshirishga urinishga qaror qildi va vositachi orqali bu unga ma'qul ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilib, u bilan birga Rimdan qochishiga rozi bo'ldi.

en: Accordingly, having taken order for this, Pietro arose very early one morning and taking horse with the damsel, set out for Anagni, where he had certain friends in whom he trusted greatly.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bunga buyruq olgan Pietro bir kuni ertalab juda erta turib, xonim bilan ot olib, Anagniga yo'l oldi, u yerda u juda ishonadigan ba'zi do'stlari bor edi.

en: They had no leisure to make a wedding of it, for that they feared to be followed, but rode on, devising of their love and now and again kissing one another.
uz: Ularning to'y o'tkazishga vaqti bo'lmadi, chunki ular ergashishdan qo'rqishardi, lekin sevgilarini o'ylab, vaqti-vaqti bilan bir-birlarini o'pishardi.

en: It chanced that, when they came mayhap eight miles from Rome, the way not being overwell known to Pietro, they took a path to the left, whereas they should have kept to the right; and scarce had they ridden more than two miles farther when they found themselves near a little castle, wherefrom, as soon as they were seen, there issued suddenly a dozen footmen.
uz: Shunday bo'ldiki, ular Rimdan taxminan sakkiz mil uzoqlikda kelganlarida, Pietroga yaxshi tanish bo'lmagan yo'l bilan, chap tomonga yo'l olishdi, o'ng tomonga yurishlari kerak edi; va kamdan-kam hollarda ular kichik qasrga yaqinlashganda ikki mildan ko'proq yo'l bosib o'tishardi, u yerdan, ularni ko'rishlari bilanoq, to'satdan o'nlab piyodalar paydo bo'lardi.

en: The girl, espying these, when- as they were already close upon them, cried out, saying, ‘Pietro, let us be- gone, for we are attacked’; then, turning her rouncey’s head, as best she knew, towards a great wood hard by, she clapped her spurs fast to his ﬂank and held on to the saddlebow, whereupon the nag, feeling himself goaded, bore her into the wood at a gallop.
uz: Qiz bularni kuzatar ekan, ular allaqachon ularga yaqinlashganida, baqirib dedi: Pietro, ketdik, chunki hujumga uchradik; songra, ozining yugurib yurgan boshini, ozi bilganidek, katta daraxtga qattiq burib, u uning qanotidan qattiq qarsildoq urdi va egarga ushladi, shundan song goroz ozini oziga tortib, uni ormonga tashladi.

en: Pietro, who went gazing more at her face than at the road, not having be- come so quickly aware as she of the newcomers, was overtaken and seized by them, whilst he still looked, without yet perceiving them, to see whence they should come.
uz: Pietro, yo'ldan ko'ra uning yuziga ko'proq tikilib yurgan, yangi kelganlar haqida u kabi tez xabardor bo'lmagani uchun, ularni quvib o'tib, ushlagan edi, u hali ham ularni sezmasdan, qayerdan kelishini ko'rish uchun qarardi.

en: They made him alight from his hackney and enquired who he was, which he having told, they proceeded to take counsel together and said, ‘This fellow is of the friends of our enemies; what else should we do but take from him these clothes and this nag and string him up to one of yonder oaks, to spite the Orsini?’ They all fell in with this counsel and bade Pietro put off his clothes, which as he was in act to do, foreboding him by this of the ill fate which awaited him, it chanced that an ambush of good ﬁve-and-twenty footmen started suddenly out upon the others, crying, ‘Kill!
uz: Ular uni o'z xaltasidan pastga tushirishdi va kimligini so'rashdi, u buni aytib berganidan so'ng, ular birgalikda maslahatlashib, dedilar: "Bu odam dushmanlarimizning do'stlaridan; undan bu kiyimni va bu g'azabni olib, Orsinilarga qarshi bir mingta emanga osib qo'yishdan boshqa nima qilishimiz kerak?" Bu maslahatga hammasi ishonib ketishdi va Pietro o'z kiyimlarini yechdi, u qilayotgan ishida, uni kutilayotgan taqdirdan ilhomlantirib, birdan birdan yigirma besh nafar yaxshi odamdan iborat hiyla boshqalarga chiqib, "O'ldir!" deb baqirdilar.

en: Kill!’ The rogues, taken by surprise, let Pietro be and turned to stand upon their defence, but, seeing themselves greatly outnumbered by their assail- ants, betook themselves to ﬂight, whilst the others pursued them.
uz: O'ldir! Hayron bo'lib qolgan g'aroyiblar Pietroni qo'yib, o'zlarining himoyasiga o'girilib turishdi, lekin hujumdagi chumolilardan ancha o'zib ketayotganlarini ko'rib, qochishga majbur bo'lishdi, qolganlar esa ularni ta'qib qilishdi.

en: Pietro, seeing this, hurriedly caught up his gear and springing on his hackney, addressed himself, as best he might, to ﬂee by the way he had seen his mistress take; but ﬁnding her not and seeing neither road nor footpath in the wood neither perceiving any horse’s hoof marks, he was the woefullest
uz: Pietro buni ko'rib, shoshilinch ravishda o'z jihozlarini yig'di va o'zining qirg'og'iga sakradi, qo'lidan kelganicha, bekasi yurgan yo'ldan qochishga yo'l oldi; lekin uni topmadi va o'rmonda yo'l ham, piyoda yo'lini ham ko'rmadi, otning tuyoq izlarini ham sezmadi, u...

en: man alive; and as soon as himseemed he was safe and out of reach of those who had taken him, as well as of the others by whom they had been as- sailed, he began to drive hither and thither about the wood, weeping and calling; but none answered him and he dared not turn back and knew not where he might come, an he went forward, more by token that he was in fear of the wild beasts that use to harbour in the woods, at once for himself and for his mistress, whom he looked momently to see strangled of some bear or some wolf.
uz: U tirik edi; va u o'zini olib ketganlar, shuningdek, ular bilan birga suzib ketgan boshqalarning qo'lidan ham qutqarilgan ko'rinishi bilanoq, u o'rmon atrofida bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa haydab, yig'lab va chaqirib yurardi; lekin hech kim unga javob bermadi va u orqaga qaytishga jur'at eta olmadi va qayerga kelishini bilmas edi, va u oldinga bordi, ayniqsa o'rmonda qo'riqlash uchun ishlatiladigan yovvoyi hayvonlardan qo'rqqanligi sababli, bir zumda o'zi va bekasi uchun, uni birozda bir ayiq yoki bo'ridan bo'g'ilgan holda ko'rishga o'xshardi.

en: On this wise, then, did the unlucky Pietro range all day about the wood, crying and calling, whiles going backward, when as he thought to go forward, until, what with shouting and weeping and fear and long fasting, he was so spent that he could no more and seeing the night come and knowing not what other course to take, he dismounted from his hackney and tied the latter to a great oak, into which he climbed, so he might not be devoured of the wild beasts in the night.
uz: Shunday qilib, omadsiz Pietro kun bo'yi o'rmon atrofida yo'l oldi, yig'lab va chaqirib, orqaga qarab yurardi, qachonki u oldinga borishni o'ylaganida, u shunchalik band ediki, tun kelishini ko'rib, boshqa yo'lni bilmas edi, u o'z qovog'idan tushdi va oxirgi yog'ochni katta emanga bog'ladi, unga chiqdi, shunda u tun davomida yovvoyi hayvonlardan yemirilmasligi mumkin edi.

en: A little after the moon rose and the night being very clear and bright, he abode there on wake, sighing and weeping and cursing his ill luck, for that he durst not go to sleep, lest he should fall, albeit, had he had more commodity thereof, grief and the concern in which he was for his mistress would not have suffered him to sleep.
uz: Oy ko'tarilgandan va tun juda tiniq va yorqin bo'lgandan biroz so'ng, u u yerda uyg'onib, oh-voh va yig'lab, o'z omadsizligini la'natlab turdi, chunki u uxlashga majbur emas edi, aks holda yiqilib ketardi, garchi uning bundan ko'proq boyligi bo'lsa ham, qayg'usi va bekasiga bo'lgan tashvishi uni uxlashga qo'ymagan bo'lardi.

en: Meanwhile, the damsel, ﬂeeing, as we have before said, and knowing not whither to betake herself, save whereas it seemed good to her hackney to carry her, fared on so far into the wood that she could not see where she had entered, and went wandering all day about that desert place, no otherwise than as Pietro had done, now pausing [to hearken] and now going on, weep- ing the while and calling and making moan of her illhap.
uz: Ayni paytda, qizaloq, avval aytganimizdek, qochib ketib, o'zini qayerga tortishni bilmay, uni olib yurish o'ziga yaxshi tuyulganidan tashqari, o'rmonga shunchalik bordi, qayerga kirganini ko'ra olmadi va butun kun davomida o'sha cho'l atrofida aylanib yurdi, faqat Pietro qilganidek, endi to'xtab, endi davom etib, yig'lab, chaqirib, uning dardidan ingradi.

en: At last, seeing that Pietro came not and it being now eventide, she happened on a little path, into which her hackney turned, and following it, after she had ridden some two or more miles she saw a little house afar off.
uz: Nihoyat, Pietro kelmaganini va endi voqea sodir bo'layotganini ko'rib, u kichkina yo'ldan o'tib ketdi, unga o'zining tumshug'i burildi va undan keyin, ikki yoki undan ko'proq milya yurganidan so'ng, uzoqdagi kichkina uyni ko'rdi.

en: Thither she made her way as quickliest she might and found there a good man sore stricken in years and a woman, his wife alike old, who, seeing her alone, said to her, ‘Daugh- ter, what dost thou alone at this hour in these parts?’ The damsel replied, weeping, that she had lost her company in the wood and enquired how near she was to Anagni.
uz: U yerga imkon qadar tezroq bordi va u yerda bir yaxshi odamni, ko'p yillar azob chekkanini va bir ayolni topdi. Uning xotini ham xuddi shunday keksa edi. U uni yolg'iz ko'rib, unga dedi: "Qizim, bu yerlarda bu soatda yolg'iz bo'lib nima qilyapsan?" Xizmatkor ayol yig'lab javob berdi: "U o'rmonda o'z hamrohini yo'qotgan edi va u Anagniga qanchalik yaqin ekanligini so'radi."

en: ‘Daughter mine,’ answered the good man, ‘this is not the way to go to Anagni; it is more than a dozen miles hence.’ Quoth the girl, ‘And how far is it hence to any habitations where I may have a lodging for the night?’ To which the good man answered, ‘There is none anywhere so near that thou mayst come thither by daylight.’ Then said the damsel, ‘Since
uz: Qizim,  javob berdi yaxshi odam, Anagniga boradigan yol bu emas; u yerda on mildan ortiq. Qiz javob berdi: Va bu yerda tunab qolishim mumkin bolgan turar joylarga qancha masofa bor? Yaxshi odam javob berdi:  kunduz kuni u yerga kelishingiz mumkin bolgan yaqin joy yoq. Shunda qiz dedi:

en: I can go no otherwhere, will it please you harbour me here tonight for the love of God?’ ‘Young lady,’ replied the old man, ‘thou art very welcome to abide with us this night; algates, we must warn you that there are many ill companies, both of friends and of foes that come and go about these parts both by day and by night, who many a time do us sore annoy and great mis- chief; and if, by ill chance, thou being here, there come any of them and seeing thee, fair and young as thou art, should offer to do thee affront and shame, we could not avail to succour thee therefrom.
uz: Men boshqa joyga borolmayman, iltimos, meni Xudoning muhabbati uchun bugun kechqurun shu yerda qo'yinglarmi? Yosh xonim,  javob berdi chol,  siz bugun kechqurun biz bilan qolishga juda xush kelibsiz; do'stlar va dushmanlarning ko'plab yomon kompaniyalari borligini, ular kunduzi ham, kechasi ham bu hududlarni aylanib yurishlarini, bizni ko'p marta bezovta qilishlarini va katta baxtsizliklarni keltirishlarini ogohlantirishimiz kerak; va agar siz tasodifan shu yerda bo'lsangiz, ularning birortasi kelib, sizni ko'rib, siz qanday chiroyli va yosh bo'lsangiz, sizga haqorat va sharmandalik taklif qilsa, biz sizga yordam bera olmas edik.

en: We deem it well to ap- prise thee of this, so that, an it betide, thou mayst not be able to complain of us.’ The girl, seeing that it was late, albeit the old man’s words affrighted her, said, ‘An it please God, He will keep both you and me from that annoy; and even if it befall me, it were a much less evil to be maltreated of men than to be mangled of the wild beasts in the woods.’ So saying, she alighted from the rouncey and entered the poor man’s house, where she supped with him on such poor fare as they had and after, all clad as she was, cast herself, to- gether with them, on a little bed of theirs.
uz: Biz sizga bu haqda maslahat berishni yaxshi deb hisoblaymiz, toki, agar shunday bo'lsa ham, siz bizdan shikoyat qila olmasligingiz mumkin bo'lsin. Qiz, keksa odamning so'zlari uni qo'rqitgan bo'lsa ham, kech bo'lganini ko'rib, dedi: "Xudo rozi bo'lsa, U ham sizni, ham meni o'sha g'azabdan saqlaydi; va hatto menga ham shunday bo'lsa, o'rmonda yovvoyi hayvonlardan xor bo'lishdan ko'ra odamlardan kamroq yomonlik edi." Shunday qilib, u ayvondan tushib, kambag'al odamning uyiga kirdi, u yerda u bilan ular boridek kambag'al ovqatda ovqatlanardi va keyin, hamma narsa o'zi kiyinganidek, o'zini ular bilan birga, ularning kichkina to'shagida tashladi.

en: She gave not over sighing and be- wailing her own mishap and that of Pietro all night, knowing not if she might hope other than ill of him; and when it drew near unto morning, she heard a great trampling of folk approaching, whereupon she arose and be- taking herself to a great courtyard, that lay behind the little house, saw in a corner a great heap of hay, in which she hid herself, so she might not be so quickly found, if those folk should come thither.
uz: U tun bo'yi o'zining va Petrening xatosi haqida qayg'urish va yig'lashdan to'xtmadi, undan yomonlikdan boshqa umid qilish mumkinmi yo'qmi, bilmas edi; va ertalab yaqinlashganda, odamlarning katta oyoq ostilarini eshitdi, shundan so'ng u o'rnidan turib, kichkina uy orqasida yotgan katta hovliga o'zini olib bordi, bir burchakda katta pichan to'plamini ko'rdi, unda o'zini yashirardi, agar u odamlar u yerga kelsa, uni bunchalik tezda topmaslik kerak edi.

en: Hardly had she made an end of hiding herself when these, who were a great company of ill knaves, came to the door of the little house and causing open to them, entered and found Agnolella’s hackney yet all saddled and bridled; whereupon they asked who was there and the good man, not seeing the girl, answered, ‘None is here save ourselves; but this rouncey, from whomsoever it may have escaped, came hither yestereve and we brought it into the house, lest the wolves should eat it.’ ‘Then,’ said the captain of the troop, ‘since it hath none other master, it is fair prize for us.’ Thereupon they all dispersed about the little house and some went into the courtyard, where, laying down their lances and targets, it chanced that one of them, knowing not what else to do, cast his lance into the hay and came very near to slay the hidden girl and she to discover herself, for that the lance passed so
uz: U deyarli yashirinishni tugatmagan edi, qachonki bu yovuz odamlarning katta guruhi kichkina uyning eshigiga kelib, ularga ochib berganda, kirib, Agnoletsaning tikanini hali ham egri va qoplangan holda topdilar. Shunda ular u yerda kim borligini so'rashdi va yaxshi odam qizni ko'rmay, javob berdi: "Bizdan boshqa hech kim qolmadi; lekin bu g'urbat, kimdan qutulgan bo'lsa ham, bu yoqqa keldi va biz uni uyga olib kirdik, bo'lmasa bo'rilar uni yeyishadi." "Endi," dedi qo'shin boshlig'i, "chunki u boshqa xo'jayin emas, bu biz uchun adolatli mukofotdir." Shunda ular hammasi kichkina uy atrofida tarqaldi va ba'zilari hovliga kirishdi, u yerda ularning nayzalari va nishonlarini tashlab, ularning birini yashirib, o'zini topishga va

en: close to her left breast that the steel tore a part of her dress, wherefore she was like to utter a great cry, fearing to be wounded;
uz: Uning chap ko'kragining yaqinida po'lat uning ko'ylagining bir qismini yirtib tashladi, shuning uchun u yaralanishdan qo'rqib, katta faryod aytgandek edi;

en: but, remembering where she was, she abode still, all fear-stricken.
uz: Lekin, u qayerda ekanligini eslab, qo'rquvdan to'lib-toshgan holda, tinmay qoldi.

en: Presently, the rogues, having dressed the kids and other meat they had with them and eaten and drunken, went off, some hither and some thither, about their affairs, and carried with them the girl’s hackney.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, xarobalar bolalarni va ular bilan birga bo'lgan boshqa go'shtni kiyintirib, yeb-ichib, ba'zilari bu yoqqa, ba'zilari esa bu yoqqa, o'z ishlari haqida ketishdi va qizning xakneyini o'zlari bilan olib ketishdi.

en: When they had gone some distance, the good man asked his wife, ‘What befell of our young wo- man, who came thither yestereve?
uz: Ular bir oz uzoqroq yurganlaridan so'ng, yaxshi odam xotiniga dedi: O'sha yerga tirik holda kelgan yosh voyaga nima bo'ldi?

en: I have seen nothing of her since we arose.’ The good wife replied that she knew not and went looking for her, whereupon the girl, hearing that the rogues were gone, came forth of the hay, to the no small contentment of her host, who, rejoiced to see that she had not fallen into their hands, said to her, it now growing day, ‘Now that the day cometh, we will, an it please thee, accompany thee to a castle ﬁve miles hence, where thou wilt be in safety; but needs must thou go afoot, for yonder ill folk, that now departed hence, have carried off thy rouncey.’ The girl concerned herself little about the nag, but besought them for God’s sake to bring her to the castle in question, whereupon they set out and came thither about half tierce.
uz: "Biz uyg'onganimizdan beri undan hech narsa ko'rmadim." Yaxshi xotin javob berdi: "U bilmas edi va uni qidirib bordi. Shunda qiz, xarobalar ketganini eshitib, somondan chiqdi. U o'z qo'shinining hech qanday qoniqmasidan xursand bo'lib, ularning qo'liga tushmaganini ko'rib, unga dedi: "Endi kun kelsa, biz seni, iltimos, senga besh mil uzoqlikdagi qasrga hamrohlik qilamiz, u yerda sen xavfsiz bo'lasan; lekin sen sayohat qilishing kerak, chunki u yerdan ketgan yomon odamlar seni aylanib yurishardi." Qiz o'zi haqida qayg'urdi, lekin Xudo uchun ularni so'radi: "Uni savolli qasrga olib chiqing, u yerdan yarim..."

en: Now this castle belonged to one of the Orsini family, by name Lionello di Campodiﬁore, and there by chance was his wife, a very pious and good lady, who, seeing the girl, knew her forthright and received her with joy and would fain know orderly how she came thither.
uz: Endi bu qasr Orsinilar oilasining biriga tegishli edi, uning ismi Lionello di Campodifiore edi va tasodifan uning xotini, juda taqvodor va yaxshi xonim bor edi. U qizni ko'rib, uni bevosita tanidi va quvonch bilan qabul qildi va u yerga qanday kelganini tartibli ravishda bilishni xohlardi.

en: Agnolella told her all and the lady, who knew Pietro on like wise, as being a friend of her husband’s, was grieved for the ill chance that had betided and hearing where he had been taken, doubted not but he was dead; wherefore she said to Agnolella, ‘Since thou knowest not what is come of Pietro, thou shalt abide here till such time as I shall have a commodity to send thee safe to Rome.’ Meanwhile Pietro abode, as woebegone as could be, in the oak, and to- wards the season of the ﬁrst sleep, he saw a good score of wolves appear, which came all about his hackney, as soon as they saw him.
uz: Agnoella unga hamma narsani aytdi va xonim, Pietro uni dono deb bilgan, erining do'sti sifatida, u bebet qilgan va uni qayerga olib ketilganini eshitgan baxtsiz hodisa uchun qayg'urardi, shubhalanmadi, lekin u o'lgan edi; shuning uchun u Agnoleyaga dedi: "Sen Pietro'dan nima kelishini bilmaganing uchun, seni Rimga xavfsiz jo'natish uchun menga yetarli narsa bo'lguncha shu yerda qol." Ayni paytda Pietro, iloji boricha yog'ochdan xoli, eman ichida qoldi va birinchi uyqu faslini kutish uchun, u ko'rgan zahotiyoq uning bo'rlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: The horse, scenting them, tugged at his bridle, till he broke it, and would have ﬂed, but being surrounded and unable to escape, he defended himself a great while with his teeth and his hoofs.
uz: Ot ularni hidlab, tumshug'ini tortib, uni sindirib qo'yguncha, qochmoqchi edi, lekin o'rab olingan va qochib qutula olmagani uchun, u o'zini tishlari va tuyoqlari bilan uzoq vaqt himoya qildi.

en: At last, however, he was brought down and strangled and quickly disembowelled by the wolves, which took all their ﬁll of his ﬂesh and having devoured him, made off, without leaving aught but the bones, whereat Pietro, to whom it seemed he had in the rouncey a com- panion and a support in his troubles, was sore dismayed and misdoubted he should never avail to win forth of the wood.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u pastga tushirildi va bo'rilar tomonidan bo'g'ib tashlandi. Bo'rilar uning butun go'shtini yeb, suyaklardan boshqa hech narsa qoldirmay, yo'q qildilar. Pietro esa, uning tashvishlarida qo'rquv va yordamchi bo'lib tuyulganiga qaramay, hech qachon o'rmondan g'alaba qozonishga unchalik yordam bermasligiga qattiq hayron bo'ldi va shubhalandi.

en: However, towards daybreak, being perished with cold in the oak and looking still all about him, he
uz: Ammo, tong otishi sari, eman ichida sovuqdan halok bo'lib, atrofga qarab, u...

en: caught sight of a great ﬁre before him, mayhap a mile off, wherefore, as soon as it was grown broad day, he came down from the oak, not without fear, and making for the ﬁre, fared on till he came to the place, where he found shepherds eating and making merry about it, by whom he was re- ceived for compassion.
uz: Uning oldida bir chaqirim uzoqlikda katta olov ko'rindi, shuning uchun, kun keng bo'lishi bilanoq, u qo'rqmasdan emandan tushdi va olovga intildi, u yerga yetib borguncha davom etdi, u yerda cho'ponlar yeyayotgan va xursand bo'layotganini ko'rdi, ular uni rahm-shafqat uchun qaytarib tashlashdi.

en: After he had eaten and warmed himself, he acquainted them with his mis- adventure and telling them how he came thither alone, asked them if there was in those parts a village or castle, to which he might betake himself.
uz: Ovqatlanib, isinib bo'lgandan so'ng, u ularga o'zining baxtsiz sarguzashtlari bilan tanishtirdi va u yerga qanday qilib yolg'iz kelganini aytib berdi, ulardan o'sha hududlarda o'zini qo'lga kiritishi mumkin bo'lgan qishloq yoki qasr bormi, deb so'radi.

en: The shepherds answered that some three miles thence there was a castle belong- ing to Lionello di Campodiﬁore, whose lady was presently there; whereat Pietro was much rejoiced and besought them that one of them should ac- company him to the castle, which two of them readily did.
uz: Cho'ponlar javob berishdi: u yerdan taxminan uch mil uzoqlikda Lionello di Campodifiorega tegishli qasr bor edi, uning xonimi hozirda u yerda edi; u yerda Pietro juda xursand bo'lib, ulardan biri uni qasrga qo'shishini so'radi, bu esa ularning ikkitasi osonlik bilan qildi.

en: There he found some who knew him and was in act to enquire for a means of having search made about the forest for the damsel, when he was bidden to the lady’s presence and incontinent repaired to her.
uz: U yerda u o'zini biladigan odamlarni topdi va xonimning huzuriga chaqirilganda, uni o'rmonda qidiruv o'tkazishga yo'l topishni so'rab harakat qildi va unga kasallik tuzatildi.

en: Never was joy like unto his, when he saw Agnolella with her, and he was all consumed with desire to embrace her, but forbore of respect for the lady, and if he was glad, the girl’s joy was no less great.
uz: Hech qachon u Agnolelani u bilan birga ko'rganida unga o'xshagan quvonch bo'lmagan edi, va u uni quchoqlash istagida edi, lekin xonimga hurmat ko'rsatishni istamadi, va agar u xursand bo'lsa, qizning quvonchi undan kam emas edi.

en: The gentle lady, having welcomed him and made much of him and heard from him what had betided him, chid him amain of that which he would have done against the will of his kinsfolk; but, seeing that he was e’en resolved upon this and that it was agreeable to the girl also, she said in herself, ‘Why do I weary myself in vain?
uz: Xonim uni kutib olib, ko'p yaxshi ko'rsatdi va undan nima yomon bo'lganini eshitdi. U qarindoshlariga qarshi nima qilmoqchi bo'lganidan hayratda qoldi; lekin u bunga qat'iy qaror qilganini va bu qizga ham yoqqanini ko'rib, o'ziga dedi: "Nega bekorga o'zimni charchatdim?"

en: These two love and know each other and both are friends of my husband.
uz: Bu ikkalasi bir-birini yaxshi ko'radi va biladi va ikkalasi ham erimning do'stlari.
