en: Their desire is an honourable one and meseemeth it is pleasing to God, since the one of them hath scaped the gibbet and the other the lance-thrust and both the wild beasts of the wood; wherefore be it as they will.’ Then, turning to the lovers, she said to them, ‘If you have it still at heart to be man and wife, it is my pleasure also; be it so, and let the nuptials be celebrated here at Lionello’s expense.
uz: Ularning istaklari sharafli va Xudoga ma'qul keladi, chunki ulardan biri gibbetdan, ikkinchisi nayza o'qidan va o'rmon yovvoyi hayvonlaridan xalos bo'ldi; shuning uchun ular xohlaganidek bo'lsin." So'ngra, oshiqlarga murojaat qilib, ularga dedi: "Agar sizda hali ham er-xotin bo'lish istagi bor bo'lsa, bu mening ham mamnuniyatimdir; shunday bo'lsin va to'ylar bu yerda Lionello'ning hisobidan nishonlansin."

en: I will en- gage after to make peace between you and your families.’ Accordingly, they were married then and there, to the great contentment of Pietro and the yet greater satisfaction of Agnolella, and the gentle lady made them honourable nuptials, in so far as might be in the mountains.
uz: Keyinroq siz va oilangiz o'rtasida tinchlik o'rnatishga harakat qilaman. Shunga ko'ra, ular u yerda va u yerda turmush qurishdi, Pietroning katta mamnuniyati va Agnoletyaning yanada katta mamnuniyatiga ko'ra, va muloyim xonim ularga tog'larda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada sharafli to'ylar qildi.

en: There, with the utmost de- light, they enjoyed the ﬁrst-fruits of their love and a few days after, they took horse with the lady and returned, under good escort, to Rome, where she found Pietro’s kinsfolk sore incensed at that which he had done, but contrived to make his peace with them, and he lived with his Agnolella in all peace and pleasance to a good old age.”
uz: U yerda ular eng yaxshi nur bilan o'z muhabbatlarining birinchi mevalaridan bahramand bo'lishdi va bir necha kundan so'ng xonim bilan otga minib, yaxshi kuzatuv ostida Rimga qaytdilar. U yerda Pietro'ning qarindoshlari uning qilgan ishidan g'azablangan, ammo ular bilan tinchlik o'rnatishga qodir bo'lganlarini ko'rdi va u o'z Agnoellasi bilan yaxshi qariyagacha tinch va rohatda yashadi.

en: THE FOURTH STORY Ricciardo Manardi, being found by Messer Lizio da Valbona with his daughter, espouseth her and abideth in peace with her father.
uz: TO'RTINCHI HIKOYA Ricciardo Manardi, Messer Lizio da Valbonaning qizi bilan topilishi, unga turmushga chiqishi va otasi bilan tinchlikda yashashi.

en: Elisa holding her peace and hearkening to the praises bestowed by the ladies her companions upon her story, the Queen charged Filostrato tell one of his own, whereupon he began, laughing, “I have been so often rated by so many of you ladies for having imposed on you matter for woeful dis- course and such as tended to make you weep, that methinketh I am behold- en, an I would in some measure requite you that annoy, to relate somewhat whereby I may make you laugh a little; and I mean therefore to tell you, in a very short story, of a love that, after no worse hindrance than sundry sighs and a brief fright, mingled with shame, came to a happy issue.
uz: Elisa o'zini tinchlantirib, uning hikoyasiga asoslangan rafiqalari tomonidan berilgan maqtovlarga quloq solib, Qirolicha Filostratga o'zidan birortasini aytishni buyurdi, shundan so'ng u kuldi: Men ko'p hollarda siz rafiqalari tomonidan sizni achinarli va sizni yig'latishga moyil qilganim uchun baholanib kelganman, menimcha, men sizni biroz bezovta qilganim uchun, sizni biroz kuldirib qo'yishim mumkin bo'lgan narsani aytib berishni xohlardim; va shuning uchun men sizga juda qisqa hikoyada, qisqa nafaslar va qo'rquvdan ko'ra yomonroq to'siq bo'lmaganidan keyin, uyat bilan aralashgan, baxtli muhabbat haqida aytmoqchiman.

en: It is, then, noble ladies, no great while ago since there lived in Romagna a gentleman of great worth and good breeding, called Messer Lizio da Val- bona, to whom, well nigh in his old age, it chanced there was born of his wife, Madam Giacomina by name, a daughter, who grew up fair and agree- able beyond any other of the country; and for that she was the only child that remained to her father and mother, they loved and tendered her exceed- ing dear and guarded her with marvellous diligence, looking to make some great alliance by her.
uz: Demak, hurmatli xonimlar, Romaniyada ancha vaqt oldin katta qadr-qimmatga va yaxshi naslga ega bo'lgan, Messer Lizio da Val-bona deb nomlangan janob yashagan edi. Uning keksaligi yaqinida uning xotini, Madam Giacomina ismli, mamlakatning boshqalaridan ko'ra go'zal va kelishgan bo'lib ulg'aygan qizi tug'ilgan edi; va shuning uchun u otasi va onasiga qolgan yagona farzand edi, ular uni juda qadrlashardi va mehr qo'yishardi, uni ajoyib mehnat bilan qo'riqlashardi, u bilan qandaydir ulkan ittifoq tuzishmoqchi edi.

en: Now there was a young man of the Manardi of Bret- tinoro, comely and lusty of his person, by name Ricciardo, who much fre- quented Messer Lizio’s house and conversed amain with him and of whom the latter and his lady took no more account than they would have taken of a son of theirs.
uz: Endi Bret-tinorlik manardilardan bo'lgan, o'ziga xos va shahvoniy yigit bor edi, uning ismi Ritsyardo edi. U Messer Lizioning uyini juda erkin tark etgan va u bilan ajoyib suhbatlashgan va u va uning xonimi o'z o'g'illaridan ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor bermagan edi.

en: Now, this Ricciardo, looking once and again upon the young lady and seeing her very fair and sprightly and commendable of manners and fashions, fell desperately in love with her, but was very careful to keep his love secret.
uz: Xo'sh, bu Ricciardo yosh xonimga qayta-qayta tikilib, uni juda go'zal, yorqin va maqtovga sazovor tarzda ko'rib, unga juda oshiq bo'ldi, lekin o'z muhabbatini sir saqlashga juda ehtiyot bo'ldi.

en: The damsel presently became aware thereof and without
uz: Qiz darhol bundan xabardor bo'ldi va...

en: anywise seeking to shun the stroke, began on like wise to love him; whereat Ricciardo was mightily rejoiced.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, zarbani qochishga urinib, uni yaxshi ko'rishni donolik bilan boshladi; Ricciardo esa juda xursand bo'ldi.

en: He had many a time a mind to speak to her, but kept silence of misdoubtance; however, one day, taking courage and opportunity, he said to her, ‘I prithee, Caterina, cause me not die of love.’ To which she straightway made answer, ‘Would God thou wouldst not cause me die!’ This answer added much courage and pleasure to Ricciardo and he said to her, ‘Never shall aught that may be agreeable to thee miscarry278 for me; but it resteth with thee to ﬁnd a means of saving thy life and mine.’ ‘Ric- ciardo,’ answered she, ‘thou seest how straitly I am guarded; wherefore, for my part, I cannot see how thou mayst avail to come at me; but, if thou canst see aught that I may do without shame to myself, tell it me and I will do it.’ Ricciardo, having bethought himself of sundry things, answered promptly, ‘My sweet Caterina, I can see no way, except that thou lie or make shift to come upon the gallery
uz: U ko'p vaqt unga gapirishga o'yladi, lekin shubhasizlikdan sukut saqladi; ammo bir kuni jasorat va imkoniyatni ishga solib, u unga dedi: "Men senga iltimos qilaman, Katerina, meni sevgi tufayli o'ldirma." U darhol javob berdi: "Xudo meni o'ldirmasangchi!" Bu javob Ricsardoga katta jasorat va quvonch qo'shdi va u unga dedi: "Senga hech qachon mos kelmaydigan hech narsa yo'q. 278 men uchun; lekin senga o'z hayotingni va dam olishingni saqlab qolish yo'lini topish kerak." "Rics-ciardo," u javob berdi: "Sen meni qanchalik qattiq qo'riqlayotganingni ko'rmaysan; qayerda, mening tomondan, men menga qanday yordam berishni ko'rmayapsan; agar sen o'zimni shunday qilmasang, men seni o'zimni ko'rishga majbur qilaman.

en: that adjoineth thy father’s garden, where an I knew that thou wouldst be anights, I would without fail contrive to come to thee, how high soever it may be.’ ‘If thou have the heart to come thither,’ rejoined Caterina, ‘methinketh I can well enough win to be there.’ Ricciardo assented and they kissed each other once only in haste and went their ways.
uz: Otangning bog'iga tutash, tunab qolishingni bilgan joyim bor edi, men seni topishga harakat qilardim, qanchalik baland bo'lmasin. Agar u yerga kelishga jur'ating bo'lsa, dedi Katerina yana, o'ylaymanki, u yerda bo'lish uchun yetarli darajada g'alaba qozonaman. Ricciardo rozi bo'ldi va ular bir-birlarini bir marta o'pdilar, shoshilinch ravishda yo'lga tushdilar.

en: Next day, it being then near the end of May, the girl began to complain before her mother that she had not been able to sleep that night for the ex- cessive heat.
uz: Ertasi kuni, may oyining oxiriga yaqinlashganda, qiz onasi oldida o'sha kecha sobiq kesessiv issiqlik tufayli uxlay olmasligidan shikoyat qila boshladi.

en: Quoth the lady, ‘Of what heat dost thou speak, daughter?
uz: Xonim aytdi: Qanday issiqlik haqida gapiryapsan, qizim?

en: Nay, it was nowise hot.’ ‘Mother mine,’ answered Caterina, ‘you should say “To my seeming,” and belike you would say sooth; but you should consider how much hotter are young girls than ladies in years.’ ‘Daughter mine,’ rejoined the lady, ‘that is true; but I cannot make it cold and hot at my pleasure, as belike thou wouldst have me do.
uz: Yo'q, hozir issiq edi. Onam, javob berdi Katerina, sen Mening ko'rinishimga ko'ra deb aytishing kerak, go'yo xotirjam deb aytgandek bo'larding; lekin yosh qizlar yillar davomida ayollardan qanchalik issiq ekanligini o'ylab ko'rishing kerak. Qizim, dedi xonim yana, bu rost; lekin men uni xohlaganimcha sovuq va issiq qila olmayman, go'yo sen xohlagandek.

en: We must put up with the weather, such as the seasons make it; maybe this next night will be cooler and thou wilt sleep better.’ ‘God grant it may be so!’ cried Caterina.
uz: Biz ob-havoga bardosh berishimiz kerak, masalan, fasllar shunday qiladi; balki keyingi tun salqinroq bo'ladi va sen yaxshiroq uxlay olasan. Xudo shunday bo'lsin! deb baqirdi Katerina.

en: ‘But it is not usual for the nights to go cooling, as it groweth towards summer.’ ‘Then what wouldst thou have done?’ asked the mother; and she answered, ‘An it please my father and you, I would fain have a little bed made in the gallery, that is be- side his chamber and over his garden, and there sleep.
uz: Lekin tunlar sovuq bo'lishi odatiy hol emas, chunki u yozga qarab o'sib boradi.  Unda nima qilganding edi? deb so'radi ona; va u javob berdi: Otam va sen rozi bo'lsang, men galereyada kichik bir karavot yasagan bo'lardim, ya'ni uning xonasi yonida va bog'i ustida, va u yerda uxlagan bo'lardim.

en: There I should hear the nightingale sing and having a cooler place to lie in, I should fare much better than in your chamber.’ Quoth the mother, ‘Daughter, comfort thyself; I will tell thy father, and as he will, so will we do.’
uz: U yerda bulbulning kuylashini eshitib, salqinroq joyda yotishim mumkin edi, sizning xonangizdan ko'ra ancha yaxshiroq ahvolda bo'lardim. Ona aytdi: "Qizim, o'zingni ovut; men otangga aytaman, u xohlaganidek qilamiz."

en: Messer Lizio hearing all this from his wife, said, for that he was an old man and maybe therefore somewhat cross-grained, ‘What nightingale is this to whose song she would sleep?
uz: Xotini bularning hammasini eshitib, janob Lizio, u keksa odam bo'lgani uchun va ehtimol shuning uchun biroz o'zaro donli bo'lgani uchun, dedi: Bu qanday bulbulki, uning qo'shig'iga uxlaydi?

en: I will yet make her sleep to the chirp of the crickets.’ Caterina, coming to know this, more of despite than for the heat, not only slept not that night, but suffered not her mother to sleep, still com- plaining of the great heat.
uz: Men uni hali ham qichqiriqlarning shivirlashidan uxlataman. Buni bilib olgan Katerina, issiqdan ko'ra ko'proq, nafaqat o'sha kecha uxlamadi, balki onasini ham uxlashga qo'ymadi, hali ham katta issiqdan xafa edi.

en: Accordingly, next morning, the latter repaired to her husband and said to him, ‘Sir, you have little tenderness for yonder girl; what mattereth it to you if she lie in the gallery?
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni eriga javoban dedi: Janob, siz o'sha qizga nisbatan unchalik mehribon emassiz; agar u galereyada yotgan bo'lsa, sizga nima aloqasi bor?

en: She could get no rest all night for the heat.
uz: U butun tun issiqlik tufayli dam ololmadi.

en: Besides, can you wonder at her having a mind to hear the nightingale sing, seeing she is but a child?
uz: Qolaversa, uning bulbulning kuylashini eshitishga aqli yetganiga hayron bo'lishing mumkinmi, chunki u faqatgina bola?

en: Young folk are curious of things like themselves.’ Messer Lizio, hearing this, said, ‘Go to, make her a bed there, such as you think ﬁt, and bind it about with some curtain or other, and there let her lie and hear the nightingale sing to her heart’s content.’ The girl, learning this, straightway let make a bed in the gallery and meaning to lie there that same night, watched till she saw Ricciardo and made him a signal appointed between them, by which he understood what was to be done.
uz: Yoshlar o'zlariga o'xshagan narsalarga qiziqishadi. Buni eshitgan Messer Lizio dedi: Boring, unga o'zing mos deb o'ylagan joyga karavot yasating, uni qandaydir parda yoki boshqa narsa bilan bog'lang, u yerda yotsin va bulbulning yuragidan kuylaganini tinglasin. Qiz buni bilib, darhol galereyada karavot yasadi va o'sha kecha u yerda yotishni xohladi, Ricciardo'ni ko'rmaguncha kuzatdi va u uchun ular o'rtasida belgi belgiladi, shu orqali u nima qilish kerakligini tushundi.

en: Messer Lizio, hearing the girl gone to bed, locked a door that led from his chamber into the gallery and betook himself likewise to sleep.
uz: Xonim Lizio qizning uxlaganini eshitib, xonasidan galereyaga olib kiradigan eshikni qulfladi va o'zini ham uxlashga majbur qildi.

en: As for Ricciardo, as soon as he heard all quiet on every hand, he mounted a wall, with the aid of a ladder, and thence, laying hold of certain toothings of another wall, he made his way, with great toil and danger, if he had fallen, up to the gallery, where he was quietly received by the girl with the utmost joy.
uz: Ricciardoga kelsak, hamma tomondan jimlik eshitishi bilanoq, u narvon yordamida devorga o'tirdi va shundan keyin, boshqa devorning ba'zi tishlarini ushlab, katta mehnat va xavf bilan, agar yiqilgan bo'lsa, galereyagacha yo'l oldi, u yerda uni qiz juda xursandchilik bilan tinch kutib oldi.

en: Then, after many kisses, they went to bed together and took delight and pleasure one of another well nigh all that night, making the nightingale sing many a time.
uz: Keyin, ko'p o'pishlardan so'ng, ular birga yotishdi va butun tun davomida bir-birlaridan zavq va rohat olishdi, bulbulni ko'p marta kuylatdi.

en: The nights being short and the delight great and it being now, though they thought it not, near day, they fell asleep without any covering, so overheated were they what with the weather and what with their sport, Caterina having her right arm entwined about Ric- ciardo’s neck and holding him with the left hand by that thing which you ladies think most shame to name among men.
uz: Kechalar qisqa va zavq buyuk edi va hozir, garchi ular buni o'ylamagan bo'lsalar ham, kunduzi yaqinlashganda, hech qanday qopqoqsiz uxlashardi. Ular ob-havo va sport bilan shunchalik qizg'in edilar, Katerina o'ng qo'lini Ric-ciardo bo'yniga bog'lab, chap qo'li bilan Ric-ciardo'ni ushlab turardi, bu narsani siz ayollar erkaklar orasida aytishga eng uyat deb o'ylaysiz.

en: As they slept on this wise, without awaking, the day came on and Messer Lizio arose and remembering him that his daughter lay in the gallery, opened the door softly, saying in himself, ‘Let us see how the nightingale hath made Caterina sleep this night.’ Then, going in, he softly lifted up the serge, wherewith the bed was curtained about, and saw his daughter and Ricciardo lying asleep, naked and uncovered, embraced as it hath before been set out; whereupon, having recognized Ricciardo, he went out again
uz: Ular shu yo'l bilan uxlayotganlarida, uyg'onmasdan, kun keldi va Messer Lizio o'rnidan turdi va uning qizi galereyada yotganini esladi, eshikni sekin ochdi va o'zida dedi: "Keling, bulbul bu kechasi Katerinaning qanday uxlaganiga nazar solaylik". Keyin, ichkariga kirib, u sekin o'rnidan turadigan serjini ko'tardi, to'shak to'r bilan qoplangan edi va qizini va Ritsardoni yalang'och va ochiq holda uxlayotganini ko'rdi, avvalgi kabi quchoqlab olgan edi; shundan so'ng, Ritsardoni tanib, u yana tashqariga chiqdi.

en: and repairing to his wife’s chamber, called to her, saying, ‘Quick, wife, get thee up and come see, for that thy daughter hath been so curious of the nightingale that she hath e’en taken it and hath it in hand.’ ‘How can that be?’ quoth she; and he answered, ‘Thou shalt see it, an thou come quickly.’ Accordingly, she made haste to dress herself and quietly followed her hus- band to the bed, where, the curtain being drawn, Madam Giacomina might plainly see how her daughter had taken and held the nightingale, which she had so longed to hear sing; whereat the lady, holding herself sore deceived of Ricciardo, would have cried out and railed at him; but Messer Lizio said to her, ‘Wife, as thou holdest my love dear, look thou say not a word, for, verily, since she hath gotten it, it shall be hers.
uz: va xotini xonasiga qaytarib, unga chaqirib dedi: "Tezroq tur, xotinim, tur va ko'r, chunki qizing bulbulni shunday qiziqtirganki, uni olib qo'lida olib qo'ydi." "Bu qanday bo'lishi mumkin?" dedi u; va u javob berdi: "Ko'rasan, tezroq kel." Shunga ko'ra, u tezda kiyindi va sokin o'z xotinini to'shakka olib bordi, u yerda parda tortilgan edi, Giacomina xonim qizining qanday qilib bulbulni olib, uni eshitishni juda xohlaganini aniq ko'rishi mumkin edi; u yerda xonim, Ricciardodan xafa bo'lib, unga qichqirgan bo'lardi; lekin Mzio Li unga dedi: "Sevgi, sen buni qilmagandek, sevgin,

en: Ricciardo is young and rich and gently born; he cannot make us other than a good son-in-law.
uz: Ricciardo yosh, boy va muloyim tug'ilgan; u bizni yaxshi kuyovdan boshqa hech kimga aylantira olmaydi.

en: An he would part from me on good terms, needs must he ﬁrst marry her, so it will be found that he hath put the nightingale in his own cage and not in that of another.’ The lady was comforted to see that her husband was not angered at the matter and considering that her daughter had passed a good night and rested well and had caught the nightingale, to boot, she held her tongue.
uz: Agar u mendan yaxshi munosabatda ajralsa, avval unga turmushga chiqishi kerak, shunda u bulbulni o'zining qafasida, boshqasining qafasida emas, deb topilishi mumkin. Xonim erining bu ishdan g'azablanmaganini ko'rib, va qizi yaxshi tun o'tkazganini, yaxshi dam olganini va bulbulni tutib, uni oyoqqa tutganini hisobga olgan holda, tilini tutdi.

en: Nor had they abidden long after these words when Ricciardo awoke and seeing that it was broad day, gave himself over for lost and called Caterina, saying, ‘Alack, my soul, how shall we do, for the day is come and hath caught me here?’ Whereupon Messer Lizio came forward and lifting the curtain, answered, ‘We shall do well.’ When Ricciardo saw him, himseemed the heart was torn out of his body and sitting up in bed, he said, ‘My lord, I crave your pardon for God’s sake.
uz: Ricciardo uyg'onib, kunduzning kengligini ko'rib, o'zini adashtirdi va Katerinaga chaqirib dedi: "Alak, jonim, nima qilaylik, chunki kun keldi va meni bu yerga oldi?" Shunda Messer Lizio oldinga chiqib, parda ko'tardi va javob berdi: "Biz yaxshi qilamiz." Ricciardo uni ko'rganida, yuragi tanasidan yirtilgan va karavotda o'tirgandek edi, u dedi: "Ey xo'jayinim, men sizni Xudo uchun kechirishni xohlayman."

en: I acknowledged to have deserved death, as a disloyal and wicked man; wherefore do you with me as best pleaseth you; but, I prithee, an it may be, have mercy on my life and let me not die.’ ‘Ricciardo,’ answered Messer Lizio, ‘the love that I bore thee and the faith I had in thee merited not this return; yet, since thus it is and youth hath car- ried thee away into such a fault, do thou, to save thyself from death and me from shame, take Caterina to thy lawful wife, so that, like as this night she hath been thine, she may e’en be thine so long as she shall live.
uz: Men sadoqatsiz va yovuz odam sifatida o'limga loyiq ekanligimni tan oldim; shuning uchun men bilan o'zingizni eng yaxshi his qilganingizni qiling; lekin, iltimos qilaman, bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa, hayotimga rahm qiling va o'lmasligimga qo'ying." Ricciardo, javob berdi Messer Lizio, Senga bo'lgan muhabbatim va senga bo'lgan ishonchim bu javobga loyiq emas edi; ammo, shunday bo'lgani va yoshlik sizni bunday xatoga yo'l qo'yganligi sababli, o'zingni o'limdan va meni sharmandalikdan saqlab qolish uchun, Katerinani qonuniy xotiningga oling, toki, xuddi shu tun senga bo'lgani kabi, u ham senga bo'lsin.

en: On this wise thou mayst gain my pardon and thine own safety; but, an thou choose not to do this, commend thy soul to God.’ Whilst these words were saying, Caterina let go the nightingale and cov- ering herself, fell to weeping sore and beseeching her father to pardon Ric- ciardo, whilst on the other hand she entreated her lover to do as Messer Liz-
uz: Shunday qilib, sen mening afvimni va o'z xavfsizligingni qo'lga kiritasan; lekin, sen buni qilmaslikni tanlaysan, joningni Xudoga topshir. Bu so'zlar aytilganda, Katerina bulbulni qo'yib yubordi va o'zini yopdi, achchiq yig'lab, otasidan Ric-ciardo'ni kechirishni iltimos qildi, shu bilan birga sevgilisiga Messer Liz kabi qilishni iltimos qildi.

en: io wished, so they might long pass such nights together in security.
uz: Men xohlardimki, ular bunday tunlarni uzoq vaqt birga xavfsizlikda o'tkazishsin.

en: But there needed not overmany prayers, for that, on the one hand, shame of the fault committed and desire to make amends for it, and on the other, the fear of death and the wish to escape —to say nothing of his ardent love and long- ing to possess the thing beloved —made Ricciardo freely and without hesit- ation avouch himself ready to do that which pleased Messer Lizio; whereupon the latter borrowed of Madam Giacomina one of her rings and there, without budging, Ricciardo in their presence took Caterina to his wife.
uz: Lekin ko'p ibodatlar kerak emas edi, buning uchun bir tomondan, sodir etilgan xatoga uyat va uni tuzatish istagi, ikkinchi tomondan, o'limdan qo'rqish va qochish istagi  sevgan narsasiga ega bo'lishga bo'lgan qizg'in muhabbati va orzu haqida gapirmasa ham bo'ladi  Ricciardo o'zini erkin va hech ikkilanmasdan, janob Lizioga yoqqan ishni qilishga tayyor qildi; shundan so'ng, u Madam Giacomina'dan uning uzuklaridan birini qarzga oldi va u yerda, hech qanday harakat qilmasdan, Ricciardo ularning huzurida Katerinani o'z xotiniga olib ketdi.

en: This done, Messer Lizio and his lady departed, saying, ‘Now rest yourselves, for belike you have more need thereof than of rising.’ They be- ing gone, the young folk clipped each other anew and not having run more than half a dozen courses overnight, they ran other twain ere they arose and so made an end of the ﬁrst day’s tilting.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Messer Lizio va uning xonimi ketishdi va dedilar: "Endi dam olinglar, chunki ko'tarilishdan ko'ra ko'proq narsaga muhtoj ekansizlar." Ular ketgach, yoshlar bir-birlarini yana bir-biriga urishdi va bir kecha yarim o'nlab kursdan ortiq yugurishmaganidan so'ng, ular turishlaridan oldin yana ikki marta yugurishdi va shu bilan birinchi kunning egilishini yakunlashdi.

en: Then they arose and Ricciardo hav- ing had more orderly conference with Messer Lizio, a few days after, as it beseemed, he married the damsel over again, in the presence of their friends and kinsfolk, and brought her with great pomp to his own house.
uz: Keyin ular turdilar va Ritsardo Messer Lizio bilan tartibliroq uchrashuv o'tkazdi. Bir necha kundan so'ng, ko'rinishicha, u qizni yana turmushga chiqardi, do'stlari va qarindoshlari huzurida va uni katta dabdaba bilan o'z uyiga olib keldi.

en: There he held goodly and honourable nuptials and after went long nightingale-fowl- ing with her to his heart’s content, in peace and solace, both by night and by day.”
uz: U yerda u yaxshi va sharafli to'ylarni o'tkazdi va keyin u bilan uzoq vaqt davomida, kechasi ham, kunduzi ham tinchlik va taskin bilan, yuragiga to'yib yurdi.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Guidotto da Cremona leaveth to Giacomino da Pavia a daughter of his and dieth.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOY Guidotto da Cremona Giacomino da Paviyaga o'z qizini qoldiradi va vafot etadi.

en: Giannole di Severino and Minghino di Mingole fall in love with the girl at Faenza and come to blows on her account.
uz: Giannole di Severino va Minghino di Mingole Faenza shahridagi qizga oshiq bo'lishadi va uning hisobi uchun jo'r bo'lishadi.

en: Ultimately she is proved to be Giannole’s sister and is given to Minghino to wife.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u Giannole'ning singlisi ekanligi isbotlandi va Minghinoga xotinlikka berildi.

en: All the ladies, hearkening to the story of the nightingale, had laughed so much that, though Filostrato had made an end of telling, they could not yet give over laughing.
uz: Bulut haqidagi hikoyani tinglagan barcha xonimlar shunchalik ko'p kuldiki, Filostrato gapni tugatgan bo'lsa ham, hali kulishdan to'xtata olishmadi.

en: But, after they had laughed awhile, the queen said to Filostrato, “Assuredly, if thou afﬂictedest us ladies yesterday, thou hast so tickled us today that none of us can deservedly complain of thee.” Then, ad- dressing herself to Neiﬁle, she charged her tell, and she blithely began to speak thus: “Since Filostrato, discoursing, hath entered into Romagna, it pleaseth me on like wise to go ranging awhile therein with mine own story.
uz: Ammo, ular biroz kulgach, malika Filostratoga dedi: Albatta, agar kecha bizni, xonimlarni azoblagan bolsang, bugun bizni shunchalik erkaladingki, hech birimiz haqli ravishda sendan shikoyat qila olmaymiz. Keyin, Neifilega ozini kiyintirib, aytishni buyurdi va u shiddat bilan shunday dedi: Filostrato nutq sozlab, Romaniyaga kirganidan beri, u yerda oz hikoyam bilan biroz vaqt sayr qilib yurish menga aql-idrokdek yoqadi.

en: I say, then, that there dwelt once in the city of Fano two Lombards, whereof the one was called Guidotto da Cremona and the other Giacomino da Pavia, both men advanced in years, who had in their youth been well nigh always soldiers and engaged in deeds of arms.
uz: Men aytamanki, Fano shahrida bir vaqtlar ikki Lombard yashagan, ulardan biri Guidotto da Cremona va ikkinchisi Giacomino da Pavia deb atalgan. Ularning ikkalasi ham yoshligida doimo askar bo'lib, qurol-yarog' ishlariga yaqinlashgan.

en: Guidotto, being at the point of death and having nor son nor other kinsmen nor friend in whom he trusted more than in Giacomino, left him a little daughter he had, of maybe ten years of age, and all that he possessed in the world, and after having be- spoken him at length of his affairs, he died.
uz: Gidotto, o'lim arafasida bo'lib, Giacominodan ko'ra ko'proq ishonadigan o'g'li ham, boshqa qarindoshi ham, do'sti ham bo'lmagani uchun, unga o'n yoshli kichkina qizi va dunyodagi bor-budini qoldirdi. Va u bilan uzoq vaqt o'z ishlari haqida gaplashganidan so'ng, u vafot etdi.

en: In those days it befell that the city of Faenza, which had been long in war and ill case, was restored to somewhat better estate and permission to sojourn there was freely conceded to all who had a mind to return thither; wherefore Giacomino, who had abidden there otherwhile and had a liking for the place, returned thither with all his good and carried with him the girl left him by Guidotto, whom he loved and entreated as his own child.
uz: O'sha kunlarda Faenza shahri, uzoq vaqt urushda va yomon ahvolda bo'lgan, biroz yaxshiroq holatga qaytarildi va u yerga qaytish istagi bor barchaga bemalol ruxsat berildi; shuning uchun u yerda qolgan va bu joyga yoqqan Giacomino, butun boyligi bilan u yerga qaytib keldi va o'zi bilan birga Guidotto tomonidan qoldirilgan qizni olib ketdi, uni o'zi sevgan va o'z farzandi kabi iltijo qilgan.

en: The latter grew up and became as fair a damsel as any in the city, ay, and as virtuous and well bred as she was fair; wherefore she began to be courted of many, but especially two very agreeable young men of equal worth and condition vowed her a very great love, insomuch that for jealousy they came to hold each other in hate out of measure.
uz: Oxirgisi ulg'ayib, shahardagi har qanday qizdek go'zal qizga aylandi, ey, va u go'zal bo'lgani kabi fazilatli va yaxshi tarbiyalangan edi; shuning uchun uni ko'pchilik yoqtirishni boshladi, lekin ayniqsa teng darajadagi va sharoitga ega bo'lgan ikki juda yoqimli yigit unga juda katta muhabbat va'da qilishdi, shuning uchun rashk tufayli ular bir-birlarini haddan tashqari nafratda ushlab turishga kelishdi.

en: They were called, the one Giannole di Severino and the other Minghino di Mingole; nor was there either of them but would gladly have taken the young lady, who was now ﬁfteen years old, to wife, had it been suffered of his kinsfolk; wherefore, seeing her denied to them on honourable wise, each cast about to get her for himself as best he might.
uz: Ularni birlari Giannole di Severino, ikkinchisi Minghino di Mingole deb atashardi; ularning hech biri yo'q edi, lekin endi o'n besh yoshli yosh xonimni, agar qarindoshlari azob chekganida, xursandchilik bilan xotinlikka olishardi; shuning uchun, uni ularga hurmat bilan rad etganini ko'rib, har biri uni o'zi uchun imkon qadar olishni xohlardi.

en: Now Giacomino had in his house an old serving- wench and a serving-man, Crivello by name, a very merry and obliging per- son, with whom Giannole clapped up a great acquaintance and to whom, whenas himseemed time, he discovered his passion, praying him to be fa- vourable to him in his endeavour to obtain his desire and promising him great things an he did this; whereto quoth Crivello, ‘Look you, I can do nought for thee in this matter other than that, when next Giacomino goeth abroad to supper, I will bring thee whereas she may be; for that, an I offered to say a word to her in thy favour, she would never stop to listen to me.
uz: Endi Giacominoning uyida keksa xizmatkor qiz va xizmatkor bor edi, ismi Crivello edi, juda xursand va majburiyatli per-o'g'li edi. Giannole bilan katta tanishuvni qo'llab-quvvatladi va vaqti kelganda, u o'z ishtiyoqini topdi, unga o'z xohish-istaklarini ro'yobga chiqarish uchun iltijo qildi va unga buyuk narsalarni va'da qildi; u yerda Crivello dedi: "Qarang, men senga bu masalada bundan boshqa hech narsa qila olmayman, keyingi Giacomino kechki ovqatga ketganda, men seni olib kelaman, chunki men unga yaxshi so'z aytishni taklif qildim, u hech qachon meni tinglamaydi."

en: If this like thee, I promise it to thee and will do it; and do thou after, an thou know how, that which thou deemest shall best serve thy purpose.’ Giannole answered that he desired nothing more and they abode on this understand- ing.
uz: Agar senga bu yoqsa, senga va'da beraman va bajaraman; keyin esa, qanday qilishni bilasan, sen o'ylagan narsa maqsadingga eng yaxshi xizmat qiladi." Giannole javob berdi: "U bundan ortiq hech narsa xohlamadi va ular bu tushunishda qoldilar."

en: Meanwhile Minghino, on his part, had suborned the maidservant and so wrought with her that she had several times carried messages to the girl and had well nigh inﬂamed her with love of him; besides which she had prom- ised him to bring him in company with her, so soon as Giacomino should chance to go abroad of an evening for whatever cause.
uz: Minghino esa, o'z navbatida, xizmatkor qizni o'ziga o'g'irlab, shunday ish qildi, hatto u bir necha marta qizga xabarlar yetkazdi va uni unga nisbatan sevgi bilan juda yaqin qo'zg'atdi; bundan tashqari, Giacomino qandaydir sababga ko'ra chet elga kechqurun borishi mumkin bo'lsa, uni o'zi bilan birga olib kelishga taklif qildi.

en: Not long after this it chanced that, by Crivello’s contrivance, Giacomino went to sup with a friend of his, whereupon Crivello gave Giannole to know thereof and appointed with him that, whenas he made a certain signal, he should come and would ﬁnd the door open.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, Krivello'ning qo'lidan kelib chiqdiki, Giacomino do'sti bilan kechki ovqatga bordi, shundan so'ng Krivello buni Giannolega ma'lum qildi va u bilan birga tayinladi, u ma'lum bir signal berganida, u kelib eshikni ochiq topishi kerak edi.

en: The maid, on her side, knowing nothing of all this, let Minghino know that Giacomino was to sup abroad and bade him abide near the house, so that, whenas he saw a signal which she should make he might come and enter therein.
uz: Xizmatkor ayol, o'z tomoni bilan, bularning hammasidan hech narsa bilmay, Minghinoga Giacomino chet elda kechki ovqatlanishini va uyning yaqinida qolishini aytishini aytdi, shunda u uning kelishi va u yerga kirishi kerak bo'lgan signalni ko'rsa.

en: The evening come, the two lovers, knowing nothing of each other’s designs, but each misdoubting of his rival, came, with sundry companions armed, to enter into possession.
uz: Kech kirdi, ikki oshiq bir-birining niyatlarini bilmay, har biri raqibidan gumon qilib, turli xil safdoshlar bilan qurollanib, egalik qilish uchun kelishdi.

en: Minghino, with his troop took up his quarters in the house of a friend of his, a neighbour of the young lady’s; whilst Giannole and his friends stationed
uz: Minghino o'z qo'shini bilan o'zining do'sti, yosh xonimning qo'shnisi uyiga joylashdi; Giannole va uning do'stlari esa joylashdilar.

en: themselves at a little distance from the house.
uz: o'zlarini uydan biroz uzoqlikda.

en: Meanwhile, Crivello and the maid, Giacomino being gone, studied each to send the other away.
uz: Ayni paytda, Krivello va Giacomino ketgan xizmatkor qiz, bir-birini jo'natish uchun har birini o'rganib chiqishdi.

en: Quoth he to her, ‘Why dost thou not get thee to bed?
uz: U unga shunday dedi: Nega uxlab ketmayapsan?

en: Why goest thou still wandering about the house?’ ‘And thou,’ retorted she, ‘why goest thou not for thy mas- ter?
uz: Nega hali ham uyda aylanib yuribsan? Sen-chi,  javob berdi u,  nega xojayiningga bormaysan?

en: What awaitest thou here, now that thou hast supped?’ And so neither could make other avoid the place; but Crivello, seeing the hour come that he had appointed with Giannole said in himself, ‘What reck I of her?
uz: "Endi ovqat berganing uchun bu yerda nima kutyapsan?" Shunday qilib, hech kim bu joydan qochib qutulmas edi; lekin Krivello, Giannole bilan tayinlagan soat kelishini ko'rib, o'ziga dedi: "U haqida nima deb o'ylayman?"

en: An she abide not quiet, she is like to smart for it.’ Accordingly, giving the appointed signal, he went to open the door, whereupon Giannole, coming up in haste with two companions, entered and ﬁnding the young lady in the saloon, laid hands on her to carry her off.
uz: U jim turmaydi, u bu uchun aqlli bo'lgandek." Shunga ko'ra, tayinlangan signalni berib, u eshikni ochish uchun bordi, shundan so'ng Giannole ikki hamroh bilan shoshilinch ravishda kirib, salondagi yosh xonani topdi va uni olib ketish uchun unga qo'l qo'ydi.

en: The girl began to struggle and make a great outcry, as likewise did the maid, which Minghino hearing, he ran thither with his companions and seeing the young lady being presently dragged out at the door, they pulled out their swords and cried all, ‘Ho, traitors, ye are dead men!
uz: Qiz qiynalay boshladi va katta faryod aytdi, xuddi shu kabi xizmatkor ham Minghino eshitib, u o'z hamrohlari bilan u yerga yugurdi va yosh xonimning yaqinda eshik oldida sudralib chiqishini ko'rib, ular qilichlarini tortib, hammasi qichqirdi: "Voy, xoinlar, sizlar o'lik odamlarsizlar!"

en: The thing shall not go thus.
uz: Ish bunday bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: What is this violence?’ So saying, they fell to hewing at them, whilst the neighbors, issuing forth at the clamour with lights and arms, began to blame Giannole’s behaviour and to second Minghino; wherefore, after long contention, the latter rescued the young lady from his rival and restored her to Giacomino’s house.
uz: Bu zo'ravonlik nima ekan? Shunday deb, ular ularga o'g'irlashdi, qo'shnilar esa, chaqnoq va qurollar bilan shov-shuvga javoban, Giannole'ning xatti-harakatini va ikkinchi Minghino'ni ayblay boshladilar; shuning uchun, uzoq bahsdan so'ng, oxirgi qiz yosh xonimni raqibidan qutqardi va uni Giacomino'ning uyiga qaytardi.

en: But, before the fray was over, up came the town-cap- tain’s ofﬁcers and arrested many of them; and amongst the rest Minghino and Giannole and Crivello were taken and carried off to prison.
uz: Ammo, janjal tugashidan oldin, shahar hokimi ofitserlari ko'tarilib, ularning ko'pchiligini hibsga olishdi; qolganlar orasida Minghino, Giannole va Crivello olib ketildi va qamoqqa olib ketildi.

en: After mat- ters were grown quiet again, Giacomino returned home and was sore chag- rined at that which had happened; but, enquiring how it had come about and ﬁnding that the girl was nowise at fault, he was somewhat appeased and de- termined in himself to marry her as quickliest he might, so the like should not again betide.
uz: Mat-terlar yana jim bo'lgandan so'ng, Giacomino uyga qaytib keldi va sodir bo'lgan voqeadan xafa bo'ldi; lekin, bu qanday sodir bo'lganini o'rganib, qizning aybdor ekanligini aniqlab, biroz xotirjam bo'ldi va unga imkon qadar tezroq turmushga chiqishga qaror qildi, shuning uchun bunday narsa yana qilmasligi kerak edi.

en: Next morning, the kinsfolk of the two young men, hearing the truth of the case and knowing the ill that might ensue thereof for the imprisoned youths, should Giacomino choose to do that which he reasonably might, repaired to him and prayed him with soft words to have regard, not so much to the af- front which he had suffered from the little sense of the young men as to the love and goodwill which they believed he bore to themselves who thus be- sought him, submitting themselves and the young men who had done the mischief to any amends it should please him take.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, ikki yigitning qarindoshlari, ishning haqiqatini eshitib, qamoqdagi yoshlar uchun undan kelib chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan yomonlikni bilgan holda, Giacomino o'zi oqilona chora ko'rishni tanlasa, uni tuzatsa va unga yumshoq so'zlar bilan murojaat qilsa, u yoshlarning ozgina hissiyotlari tufayli ko'rgan af-frontga emas, balki o'zlariga bo'lgan muhabbat va yaxshi niyatlariga nisbatan emas, ular uni qidirayotganlar uchun shunday bo'lishi kerak edi, o'zlarini va yovuzlik qilgan yoshlarni har qanday tuzatishga bo'ysundirishlari kerak edi.

en: Giacomino, who had in his time seen many things and was a man of sense, answered brieﬂy, ‘Gen- tlemen, were I in mine own country, as I am in yours, I hold myself so
uz: Giacomino, o'z davrida ko'p narsalarni ko'rgan va aql-idrokli odam bo'lgan, qisqa javob berdi:  General-tlemen, men o'z mamlakatimda bo'lganimda, men sizning mamlakatingizda bo'lganimdek, o'zimni shunday tutaman.

en: much your friend that neither in this nor in otherwhat would I do aught save insomuch as it should please you; besides, I am the more bounden to com- ply with your wishes in this matter, inasmuch as you have therein offended against yourselves, for that the girl in question is not, as belike many sup- pose, of Cremona nor of Pavia; nay, she is a Faentine,279 albeit neither I nor she nor he of whom I had her might ever learn whose daughter she was; wherefore, concerning that whereof you pray me, so much shall be done by me as you yourselves shall enjoin me.’ The gentlemen, hearing this, marvelled and returning thanks to Giac- omino for his gracious answer, prayed him that it would please him tell them how she came to his hands and how he knew her to be a Faentine; whereto quoth he, ‘Guidotto da Cremona, who was my friend and comrade, told me, on his deathbed, that, when this city was
uz: Do'stingizning aytishicha, na bu yerda, na boshqa hech narsada sizga yoqishi kerak bo'lgan narsalardan boshqa hech narsa qilmas edim; bundan tashqari, men bu masalada sizning xohishingizga ko'proq mos kelishga majburman, chunki siz o'zingizga qarshi xafa bo'ldingiz, chunki bu qiz, ko'pchilik kabi Cremona yoki Paviadan emas; yo'q, u Faentina, 279 garchi men ham, u ham, men ham uning kimning qizi ekanligini hech qachon bilmagan bo'lsam ham; shuning uchun, siz menga nima haqida ibodat qilayotgan bo'lsangiz, siz menga buyurganingizdek men tomonidan qilinadi.

en: taken by the Emperor Fre- derick and everything given up to pillage, he entered with his companions into a house and found it full of booty, but deserted by its inhabitants, save only this girl, who was then some two years old or thereabouts and who, seeing him mount the stairs, called him “father”; whereupon, taking com- passion upon her, he carried her off with him to Fano, together with all that was in the house, and dying there, left her to me with what he had, charging me marry her in due time and give her to her dowry that which had been hers.
uz: Imperator Frederik va hamma narsani talon-toroj qilishga topshirib, u o'z hamrohlari bilan bir uyga kirdi va uni o'ljaga to'la deb topdi, lekin uning aholisi tomonidan tashlab ketilgan edi, faqat shu qiz bundan mustasno edi, u o'sha paytda taxminan ikki yoshda edi va uni zinapoyalarga chiqqanini ko'rib, uni "ota" deb atardi; shundan so'ng, unga shahvat bilan Fanoga, uyning bor narsalari bilan birga olib bordi va u yerda o'lib, uni o'zi bor narsa bilan menga qoldirdi, uni o'z vaqtida menga turmushga berishni va unga o'ziga tegishli bo'lgan mahrini berishni buyurdi.

en: Since she hath come to marriageable age, I have not yet found an oc- casion of marrying her to my liking, though I would gladly do it, rather than that another mischance like that of yesternight should betide me on her ac- count.’ Now among the others there was a certain Guiglielmino da Medicina, who had been with Guidotto in that affair280 and knew very well whose house it was that he had plundered, and he, seeing the person in question281 there among the rest, accosted him, saying, ‘Bernabuccio, hearest thou what Giacomino saith?’ ‘Ay do I,’ answered Bernabuccio, ‘and I was presently in thought thereof, more by token that I mind me to have lost a little daughter of the age whereof Giacomino speaketh in those very troubles.’ Quoth Guiglielmino, ‘This is she for certain, for that I was once in company with Guidotto, when I heard him tell where he had done the plundering and knew it to be
uz: U turmushga chiqish yoshiga kelganidan beri, men uni o'zimga yoqqan tarzda turmushga chiqish imkoniyatini hali topmadim, garchi buni xursandchilik bilan qilsam ham, balki o'tgan kechaga o'xshagan boshqa baxtsizlik meni uning ishiga duchor qilsin. Endi qolganlar orasida Guidotto bilan shu ishda birga bo'lgan va kimning uyini talon-toroj qilganini juda yaxshi bilgan bir odam bor edi.

en: thy house that he had sacked; wherefore do thou bethink thee if thou mayst credibly recognize her by any token and let make search therefor; for thou wilt assuredly ﬁnd that she is thy daughter.’
uz: U talon-toroj qilgan uyingni; nima uchun uni biron bir dalil bilan aniqlab, qidirib ko'rsang, o'zingni o'ylama; chunki u albatta sening qizing ekanligini aniqlaysan.

en: Accordingly, Bernabuccio bethought himself and remembered that she should have a little cross-shaped scar over her left ear, proceeding from a tumour, which he had caused cut for her no great while before that occur- rence; whereupon, without further delay, he accosted Giacomino, who was still there, and besought him to carry him to his house and let him see the damsel.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Bernabukcho o'zini o'ylab, chap qulog'ida kichik xoch shaklidagi jarohat bo'lishi kerakligini esladi. Bu jarohat o'sha hodisa sodir bo'lishidan ancha oldin uning uchun kesilgan edi; shundan so'ng, kechiktirmasdan u yerda bo'lgan Giacominoga yaqinlashdi va undan uni o'z uyiga olib borishni va kampirni ko'rishni so'radi.

en: To this he readily consented and carrying him thither, let bring the girl before him.
uz: Bunga u bemalol rozi bo'ldi va uni u yerga olib bordi, keling, qizni uning oldiga olib keling.

en: When Bernabuccio set eyes on her, himseemed he saw the very face of her mother, who was yet a handsome lady; nevertheless, not contenting himself with this, he told Giacomino that he would fain of his favour have leave to raise her hair a little above her left ear, to which the other consented.
uz: Bernabukcho unga ko'z tashlaganida, u onasining yuzini ko'rgandek edi, u hali ham chiroyli ayol edi; shunga qaramay, bunga rozi bo'lmay, u Giacominoga uning sochini chap qulog'idan biroz yuqoriroqqa ko'tarishga ruxsat berishini aytdi, bunga boshqa qulog'i rozi bo'ldi.

en: Accordingly, going up to the girl, who stood shamefast, he lifted up her hair with his right hand and found the cross; whereupon, knowing her to be indeed his daughter, he fell to weeping tenderly and em- bracing her, notwithstanding her resistance; then, turning to Giacomino, ‘Brother mine,’ quoth he, ‘this is my daughter; it was my house Guidotto plundered and this girl was, in the sudden alarm, forgotten there of my wife and her mother; and until now we believed that she had perished with the house, which was burned me that same day.’ The girl, hearing this, and seeing him to be a man in years, gave credence to his words and submitting herself to his embraces, as moved by some oc- cult instinct, fell a-weeping tenderly with him.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, uyatchan holda turgan qizga yaqinlashib, o'ng qo'li bilan sochlarini ko'tardi va xochni topdi; shundan so'ng, u haqiqatan ham o'z qizi ekanligini bilgach, uning qarshiligiga qaramay, nozik yig'lab, uni quchoqladi; keyin, Giacominoga o'girilib, dedi: "Ukam, bu mening qizim; bu mening uyim Guidotto talon-toroj qilingan edi va bu qiz, to'satdan uyg'onib, xotinim va onamning unutilgan edi; va shu kungacha biz uning o'sha kuni menga yoqilgan uy bilan birga halok bo'lgan deb hisobladik." Qiz buni eshitib, uni ko'rib, bir necha yillar davomida erkak bo'lganini ko'rib, uning so'zlariga ishondi va uning quchog'iga bo'ldi, chunki u birdan ko'ra, birdan ko'ngillab...

en: Bernabuccio presently sent for her mother and other her kinswomen and for her sisters and brothers and presented her to them all, recounting the matter to them; then, after a thou- sand embraces, he carried her home to his house with the utmost rejoicing, to the great satisfaction of Giacomino.
uz: Bernabukcho darhol onasini va boshqa qarindoshlarini, opa-singillari va aka-ukalarini chaqirib yubordi va uni hammaga taqdim etib, bu masalani ularga aytib berdi; so'ngra, qum quchoqlaridan so'ng, u Giacomino'ning katta mamnuniyatiga ko'ra, uni o'zining uyiga eng katta quvonch bilan olib bordi.

en: The town-captain, who was a man of worth, learning this and knowing that Giannole, whom he had in prison, was Bernabuccio’s son and therefore the lady’s own brother, determined in- dulgently to overpass the offence committed by him and released with him Minghino and Crivello and the others who were implicated in the affair.
uz: Shahar sardori, qadrli odam bo'lgan, buni bilib, u qamoqxonada bo'lgan Giannole Bernabutsyoning o'g'li va shuning uchun ham xonimning o'z akasi ekanligini bilgach, u sodir etgan jinoyatni beparvolik bilan yengib o'tishga qaror qildi va u bilan birga Minghino, Crivello va boshqa ishda aloqador bo'lganlarni ozod qildi.

en: Moreover, he interceded with Bernabuccio and Giacomino concerning these matters and making peace between the two young men, gave the girl, whose name was Agnesa, to Minghino to wife, to the great contentment of all their kinsfolk; whereupon Minghino, mightily rejoiced, made a great and goodly wedding and carrying her home, lived with her many years after in peace and weal.”
uz: Qolaversa, u Bernabucko va Giacomino bilan bu masalalarda til biriktirdi va ikki yigit o'rtasida tinchlik o'rnatdi, ismli qizni, Agnesa, Minghinoga xotinlikka berdi, bu ularning barcha qarindoshlarining katta mamnuniyatini keltirdi; shundan so'ng Minghino qudrat bilan xursand bo'lib, katta va yaxshi to'y qildi va uni uyida olib yurib, ko'p yillar davomida u bilan tinch va farovon yashadi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY Gianni di Procida being found with a young lady, whom he loved and who had been given to King Frederick of Sicily, is bound with her to a stake to be burnt; but, being recognized by Ruggieri dell’ Oria, escapeth and becometh her husband.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA: Gianni di Procida sevgan va Sitsiliya qiroli Frederikga berilgan yosh xonim bilan topilishi, u bilan birga yoqish uchun qoziqga bog'langan; lekin Ruggieri dell Oria tomonidan tan olinganidan so'ng, qochib ketadi va eri bo'ladi.

en: Neiﬁle’s story, which had much pleased the ladies, being ended, the queen bade Pampinea address herself to tell another, and she accordingly, raising her bright face, began: “Exceeding great, charming ladies, is the might of Love and exposeth lovers to sore travails, ay, and to excessive and unfore- seen perils, as may be gathered from many a thing that hath been related both today and otherwhiles; nevertheless, it pleaseth me yet again to demonstrate it to you with a story of an enamoured youth.
uz: Neifile'ning hikoyasi, ayollar juda xursand bo'lganidan so'ng, qirolicha Pampinea o'ziga murojaat qilib, boshqa odamga aytdi va u shunga mos ravishda yorqin yuzini ko'tarib, shunday dedi: Ajoyib, jozibali ayollar, Sevgi kuchidir va sevishtiruvchilarni og'riqli azoblarga, hay, va haddan tashqari va misli ko'rilmagan xavflarga duchor qiladi, xuddi bugun ham, boshqa vaqtlarda ham aytib o'tilgan ko'p narsadan yig'ilganidek; shunga qaramay, men uni sizga yana bir bor sevingan yoshlik hikoyasi bilan ko'rsatishdan mamnunman.

en: Ischia is an island very near Naples, and therein, among others, was once a very fair and sprightly damsel, by name Restituta, who was the daughter of a gentleman of the island called Marino Bolgaro and whom a youth named Gianni, a native of a little island near Ischia, called Procida, loved more than his life, as she on like wise loved him.
uz: Ischia Neapolga juda yaqin orol bo'lib, u yerda, boshqa joylar qatorida, bir vaqtlar juda go'zal va yorqin xonim bo'lgan. Restituta ismli ayol Marino Bolgaro ismli orol janobining qizi edi va unga Ischia yaqinidagi kichik oroldan bo'lgan, Procida deb nomlanuvchi yosh Gianni o'z hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq sevardi, chunki u uni dono kabi sevgan edi.

en: Not only did he come by day from Procida to see her, but oftentimes anights, not ﬁnding a boat, he had swum from Procida to Ischia, at the least to look upon the walls of her house, an he might no otherwise.
uz: Nafaqat kunduzi Prozidadan uni ko'rish uchun kelardi, balki ko'pincha tunlari ham, qayiq topmasdan, Prozidadan Ishchiyaga suzib borardi, hech bo'lmaganda uning uyining devorlariga qarash uchun, aks holda topolmas edi.

en: During the continuance of this so ardent love, it befell that the girl, being all alone one summer day on the seashore, chanced, as she went from rock to rock, loosening shellﬁsh from the stones with a knife, upon a place hidden among the cliffs, where, at once for shade and for the commodity of a spring of very cool water that was there, certain young men of Sicily, coming from Naples, had taken up their quarters with a pinnace they had.
uz: Shu qadar achchiq muhabbat davom etar ekan, shunday bo'ldiki, qiz bir yoz kuni dengiz sohilida yolg'iz bo'lib, toshdan toshga o'tib, pichoq bilan toshlardan qobiqlarni bo'shatar ekan, qoyalar orasida yashiringan joyga keldi. U yerda, soya olish uchun va juda salqin suv bulog'ining qulayligi uchun, Neapoldan kelayotgan Sitsiliyalik ba'zi yosh yigitlar o'zlarining tikanlari bilan o'z xonalarini egalladilar.

en: They, seeing that she was alone and very handsome and was yet unaware of them, took counsel together to seize her and carry her
uz: Ular uning yolg'iz va juda chiroyli ekanligini ko'rib, ularni hali bilmagan holda, uni ushlash va olib yurish uchun maslahatlashdilar.

en: off and put their resolve into execution.
uz: va o'z qarorlarini amalga oshiring.

en: Accordingly, they took her, for all she made a great outcry, and carrying her aboard the pinnace, made the best of their way to Calabria, where they fell to disputing of whose she should be.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular uni olib ketishdi, chunki u juda katta faryod ko'tardi va uni pinnacega olib, Kalebriyaga borishga harakat qilishdi, u yerda u kim bo'lishi kerakligi haqida bahslashishga tushishdi.

en: Brief, each would fain have her; wherefore, being unable to agree among themselves and fearing to come to worse and to mar their affairs for her, they took counsel together to present her to Frederick, King of Sicily, who was then a young man and delighted in such toys.
uz: Qisqacha qilib aytganda, har biri uni xohlardi; shuning uchun, o'zaro kelisholmay, yomonlashib ketishdan va u uchun o'z ishlarini buzishdan qo'rqib, ular uni Sitsiliya qiroli Frederikga taqdim etish uchun maslahatlashdilar, u o'sha paytda yosh yigit edi va bunday o'yinchoqlardan zavqlanardi.

en: Accordingly, com- ing to Palermo, they made gift of the damsel to the king, who, seeing her to be fair, held her dear; but, for that he was presently somewhat inﬁrm of his person, he commanded that, against he should be stronger, she should be lodged in a very goodly pavilion, belonging to a garden of his he called La Cuba, and there tended; and so it was done.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Palermoga kelib, ular qizni shohga sovg'a qilishdi. Shoh uni go'zal ekanligini ko'rib, uni qadrlardi; lekin, u hozirda o'zidan biroz zaif bo'lgani uchun, unga qarshi kuchliroq bo'lishi uchun, uni La Kuba deb ataydigan bog'iga tegishli juda yaxshi pavilonga joylashtirishni buyurdi va u yerda unga g'amxo'rlik qilindi; va shunday bo'ldi.

en: Great was the outcry in Ischia for the ravishment of the damsel and what most chagrined them was that they could not learn who they were that had carried her off; but Gianni, whom the thing concerned more than any other, not looking to get any news of this in Ischia and learning in what direction the ravishers had gone, equipped another pinnace and embarking therein, as quickliest as he might, scoured all the coast from La Minerva to La Scalea in Calabria, enquiring everywhere for news of the girl.
uz: Iskiyadagi qizning jabrlanishiga qarshi hayqiriq juda katta edi va ularni eng xafa qilgan narsa, uni olib ketganlar kim ekanligini bilmasliklari edi; lekin bu narsa boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq tashvishlanardigan Gianni, Iskiyada bu haqda hech qanday xabar olmoqchi emas edi va zo'ravonlar qayerga borganini bilmay, yana bir pinnaza o'rnatdi va unga imkon qadar tezroq kirib, La Minervadan La Scaleagacha bo'lgan butun qirg'oqni Calabriyada qidirib, qizning xabarini topdi.

en: Being told at La Scalea that she had been carried off to Palermo by some Sicilian sailors, he betook himself thither, as quickliest he might, and there, after much search, ﬁnding that she had been presented to the king and was by him kept under ward at La Cuba, he was sore chagrined and lost well nigh all hope, not only of ever having her again, but even of seeing her.
uz: La Scaleada unga Sitsiliyalik dengizchilar tomonidan Palermoga olib ketilganligi aytilgach, u u yerga imkon qadar tezroq bordi va u yerda, ko'p qidiruvdan so'ng, u qirolga taqdim etilganini va La Kubada uning qo'lida saqlanayotganini bilib, qattiq xafa bo'ldi va uni qayta ko'rishdan tashqari, hatto ko'rishdan ham umidini yo'qotdi.

en: Nevertheless, de- tained by love, having sent away his pinnace and seeing that he was known of none there, he abode behind and passing often by La Cuba, he chanced one day to catch sight of her at a window and she saw him, to the great con- tentment of them both.
uz: Shunga qaramay, muhabbatdan bezovta bo'lib, o'zining pinnazini jo'natib yuborgan va u yerda hech kim tanimasligini ko'rgan holda, u orqada qoldi va La Kubadan tez-tez o'tib, bir kuni uni derazadan ko'rishga muvaffaq bo'ldi va u uni ko'rdi, ularning ikkalasi ham katta xursandchilik bilan.

en: Gianni, seeing the place lonely, approached as most he might and be- speaking her, was instructed by her how he must do, an he would thereafter- ward have further speech of her.
uz: Gianni, bu joyni yolg'iz ko'rib, imkon qadar yaqinlashdi va unga gapirdi. Undan nima qilish kerakligi haqida ko'rsatma oldi, keyin esa u haqida boshqa gapiradigan bo'lardi.

en: He then took leave of her, having ﬁrst par- ticularly examined the ordinance of the place in every part, and waited till a good part of the night was past, when he returned thither and clambering up in places where a woodpecker had scarce found a foothold, he made his way into the garden.
uz: Keyin u bilan xayrlashdi, avval har bir joyning tartibini aniq o'rganib chiqdi va tunning yaxshi qismi o'tguncha kutdi, keyin u yerga qaytib kelib, o'tinchoq deyarli turadigan joylarga chiqib, bog'ga yo'l oldi.

en: There he found a long pole and setting it against the window which his mistress had shown him, climbed up thereby lightly enough.
uz: U yerda u uzun ustun topdi va uni xo'jayini ko'rsatgan derazaga qo'ydi, undan osongina ko'tarilib chiqdi.

en: The damsel, herseeming she had already lost her honour, for the
uz: Qizaloq, o'ziga o'xshagan holda, allaqachon o'z sharafini yo'qotgan edi, chunki...

en: preservation whereof she had in times past been somewhat coy to him, thinking that she could give herself to none more worthily than to him and doubting not to be able to induce him to carry her off, had resolved in her- self to comply with him in every his desire; wherefore she had left the win- dow open, so he might enter forthright.
uz: U o'tmishda unga nisbatan biroz beparvo bo'lgan, o'zini undan qimmatliroq hech kimga berolmasligini o'ylagan va uni olib ketishga unday olmasligiga shubha qilmagan holda, o'z-o'zidan uning har bir istakida unga rozi bo'lishga qaror qilgan edi; shuning uchun u g'alaba qozonishni ochiq qoldirdi, shunda u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kirishi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, Gianni, ﬁnding it open, softly made his way into the chamber and laid himself beside the girl, who slept not and who, before they came to otherwhat, discovered to him all her intent, instantly beseeching him to take her thence and carry her away.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Gianni uni ochiq deb topgach, sekin xonadan o'tib, uxlamagan va boshqa narsaga kelishidan oldin unga butun niyatini anglagan qizning yoniga yotdi va darhol uni u yerdan olib ketish va olib ketish uchun iltimos qildi.

en: Gianni answered that nothing could be so pleasing to him as this and promised that he would without fail, as soon as he should have taken his leave of her, put the matter in train on such wise that he might carry her away with him, the ﬁrst time he returned thither.
uz: Janni unga bundan ko'ra yoqadigan hech narsa bo'lmasligini javob berdi va u bilan xayrlashishi kerak bo'lgan zahoti, birinchi marta u yerga qaytib kelganida, uni o'zi bilan olib ketishi mumkin bo'lgan tarzda masalani aniqlashtirishga va'da berdi.

en: Then, embracing each oth- er with exceeding pleasure, they took that delight beyond which Love can afford no greater, and after reiterating it again and again, they fell asleep, without perceiving it, in each other’s arms.
uz: So'ngra, har birini haddan tashqari zavq bilan quchoqlab, ular Sevgi bundan buyukroq narsa bera olmaydigan zavqni qabul qilishdi va uni qayta-qayta takrorlaganlaridan so'ng, bir-birlarining qo'llarida sezmasdan uxlab qolishdi.

en: Meanwhile, the king, who had at ﬁrst sight been greatly taken with the damsel, calling her to mind and feeling himself well of body, determined, albeit it was nigh upon day, to go and abide with her awhile.
uz: Ayni paytda, bir qarashda qiz bilan juda ko'zga tashlangan, uni esga olib, o'zini sog'lom his qilgan shoh, garchi kun yaqinlashayotgan bo'lsa ham, u bilan bir oz qolishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, he betook himself privily to La Cuba with certain of his servants and enter- ing the pavilion, caused softly open the chamber wherein he knew the girl slept.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u o'zining ba'zi xizmatkorlari bilan La Kubaga sayohat qilib bordi va pavilonga kirib, qiz uxlayotganini bilgan xonani sekin ochdi.

en: Then, with a great lighted ﬂambeau before him, he entered therein and looking upon the bed, saw her and Gianni lying asleep and naked in each other’s arms; whereas he was of a sudden furiously incensed and ﬂamed up into such a passion of wrath that it lacked of little but he had, without saying a word, slain them both then and there with a dagger he had by his side.
uz: So'ngra, uning oldida katta yonayotgan olov olov bilan, u ichkariga kirdi va karavotga qaradi, uni va Gianni bir-birining qo'llarida yalang'och holda uxlayotganini ko'rdi; u esa birdaniga g'azabda g'azablanib, g'azabga to'lib ketdi, shuning uchun unga hech narsa yetishmadi, lekin u bir so'z demasdan ularni yonida turgan pichog'i bilan o'ldirdi.

en: However, esteeming it a very base thing of any man, much more a king, to slay two naked folk in their sleep, he contained himself and determined to put them to death in public and by ﬁre; wherefore, turning to one only companion he had with him, he said to him, ‘How deemest thou of this vile woman, on whom I had set my hope?’ And after he asked him if he knew the young man who had dared enter his house to do him such an af- front and such an outrage; but he answered that he remembered not ever to have seen him.
uz: Ammo, har qanday odamning, hatto podshohning ham, uyqusida ikki yalang'och odamni o'ldirishini juda past ish deb hisoblagan holda, u o'zini tiydi va ularni omma oldida va olovda o'ldirishga qaror qildi. Shuning uchun, o'zi bilan birga bo'lgan yagona hamrohiga o'girilib, unga dedi: "Men umid bog'lagan bu jirkanch ayolga qanday qaraysan?"

en: The king then departed the chamber, full of rage, and com- manded that the two lovers should be taken and bound, naked as they were, and that, as soon as it was broad day, they should be carried to Palermo and there bound to a stake, back to back, in the public place, where they should be kept till the hour of tierce, so they might be seen of all, and after burnt,
uz: Shundan so'ng shoh g'azabga to'la xonadan chiqib ketdi va ikki oshiqni olib, o'zlari qanday bo'lishsa, shunday yalang'och holda bog'lashni buyurdi. Kunduz ochiq bo'lishi bilanoq, ularni Palermoga olib borib, u yerda do'zaxga bog'lash kerak edi, orqaga, jamoat joyida, u yerda uchinchi soatgacha saqlanishi kerak edi, toki ular hamma ko'rsin va yoqilgandan so'ng,

en: even as they had deserved; and this said, he returned to his palace at Palermo, exceeding wroth.
uz: xuddi ular haqli bo'lganidek; va bu gapni aytgach, u g'azabdan tashqari Palermodagi saroyiga qaytdi.

en: The king gone, there fell many upon the two lovers and not only awakened them, but forthright without any pity took them and bound them; which when they saw, it may lightly be conceived if they were woeful and feared for their lives and wept and made moan.
uz: Shoh ketdi, ikki oshiqning ustiga ko'p narsa tushdi va nafaqat ularni uyg'otdi, balki ularni hech qanday rahm-shafqatsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ushladi va bog'ladi; ular buni ko'rgach, agar ular qayg'uli va hayotdan qo'rqqan bo'lsalar, yig'lab ingrashsa, yengil tasavvur qilish mumkin edi.

en: According to the king’s commandment, they were carried to Palermo and bound to a stake in the public place, whilst the faggots and the ﬁre were made ready before their eyes, to burn them at the hour appointed.
uz: Shohning buyrug'iga ko'ra, ular Palermoga olib ketildi va ommaviy joyda qoziqga bog'landilar, ularning ko'z o'ngida esa qaroqchalar va olov tayyorlab qo'yildi, belgilangan vaqtda yoqib yuborish uchun.

en: Thither straightway ﬂocked all the townsfolk, both men and women, to see the two lovers; the men all pressed to look upon the damsel and like as they praised her for fair and well made in every part of her body, even so, on the other hand, the women, who all ran to gaze upon the young man, supremely commended him for handsome and well shapen.
uz: U yerga butun shahar aholisi, erkaklar ham, ayollar ham, ikki oshiqni ko'rishga to'g'ri keldi; erkaklarning barchasi qizga qarashga shoshilishdi va uni tanasining har bir qismini go'zal va chiroyli ko'rsatgani uchun maqtashdi, xuddi shunday, boshqa tomondan, yigitga qarab yugurgan ayollar uni chiroyli va chiroyli ko'rinishi uchun juda maqtashdi.

en: But the wretched lovers, both sore ashamed, stood with bowed heads and bewailed their sorry fortune, hourly expecting the cruel death by ﬁre.
uz: Ammo bechora oshiqlar, ikkalasi ham juda xijolat bo'lib, boshlarini egib turishardi va achinarli taqdirlarini yig'lashardi, har soatda shafqatsiz o'limni olovda kutishardi.

en: Whilst they were thus kept against the appointed hour, the default of them committed, being bruited about everywhere, came to the ears of Rug- gieri dell’ Oria, a man of inestimable worth and then the king’s admiral, whereupon he repaired to the place where they were bound and considering ﬁrst the girl, commended her amain for beauty, then, turning to look upon the young man, knew him without much difﬁculty and drawing nearer to him, asked him if he were not Gianni di Procida.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular belgilangan soatga qadar ushlab turilgan bo'lsalar ham, ularning xatolari sodir bo'ldi, hamma joyda g'azablangan holda, bebaho qiymatga ega bo'lgan va so'ngra podshohning admirali bo'lgan Rug-gieri dell' Orianing qulog'iga yetdi. Shundan so'ng u bog'langan joyga qaytib keldi va avval qizni ko'rib, uni go'zalligi uchun maqtadi, keyin yigitga o'girilib, uni ko'p qiyinchiliksiz tanidi va unga yaqinlashdi, undan Gianni di Procida emasmi deb so'radi.

en: The youth, raising his eyes and recognizing the admiral, answered, ‘My lord, I was indeed he of whom you ask; but I am about to be no more.’ The admiral then asked him what had brought him to that pass, and he answered, ‘Love and the king’s anger.’ The admiral caused him tell his story more at large and having heard everything from him as it had happened, was about to depart, when Gianni called him back and said to him, ‘For God’s sake, my lord, an it may be, get me one favour of him who maketh me to abide thus.’ ‘What is that?’ asked Ruggieri; and Gianni said, ‘I see I must die, and that speedily, and I ask, therefore, by way of favour —as I am bound with my back to this damsel, whom I have loved more than my life, even as she hath loved me, and she with her back to me —that we may be turned about with our faces one to the other, so that, dying, I may look upon her face and get me gone,
uz: Yigit ko'zlarini ko'tarib admiralni tanib, javob berdi: "Egam, men siz so'ragan odam edim; lekin men endi bo'lmayman." Admiral undan o'sha yo'lga nima olib kelganini so'radi va u javob berdi: "Sevgi va shohning g'azabi." Admiral o'z hikoyasini kengroq aytib berishga undadi va undan sodir bo'lgan hamma narsani eshitib, ketmoqchi edi, qachonki Gianni uni qaytarib chaqirib, unga dedi: "Xudo haqqi, janobim, menga shunday yashashga majbur qiladigan odamdan bir marta iltimos qiling." "Bu nima?"  Ruggieri; va Gianni aytdi: "Men o'lishim kerak, va tezroq, va men so'rayman, iltimos, iltimos, iltimos, men o'zimga qaytib kelishim kerak, chunki men bu hayotimga bog'langanman, men uni o'zim bilan bir marta ko'rish uchun, u bilan bir marta ko'rish mumkin edi, men uni o'zi bilan bir

en: comforted.’ ‘With all my heart,’ answered Ruggieri, laughing; ‘I will do on such wise that thou shalt yet see her till thou grow weary of her sight.’
uz: tasalli topdim. Toliq yuragim bilan,  javob berdi Ruggieri kulgunicha; Men shunday donolik bilan ish qilamanki, sen uni kormaguncha, kozingdan charchaguncha korasan.

en: Then, taking leave of him, he charged those who were appointed to carry the sentence into execution that they should proceed no farther therein, without other commandment of the king, and straightway betook himself to the latter, to whom, albeit he saw him sore incensed, he spared not to speak his mind, saying, ‘King, in what have the two young folk offended against thee, whom thou hast commanded to be burned yonder in the public place?’ The king told him and Ruggieri went on, ‘The offence committed by them deserveth it indeed, but not from thee; for, like as defaults merit punish- ment, even so do good ofﬁces merit recompense, let alone grace and clem- ency.
uz: So'ngra, undan xayrlashib, hukmni ijro etish uchun tayinlanganlarga shohning boshqa buyrug'isiz undan uzoqroqqa bormaslikni buyurdi va darhol oxirgisiga murojaat qildi. Garchi uni g'azablanganini ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, u o'z fikridan qaytmadi va dedi: "Ey shoh, bu ikki yosh odam senga nisbatan nima aybdor edi, ularni sen ommaviy joyda yoqib yuborishga buyurdingmi?" Shoh unga aytdi va Ruggieri davom etdi: "Ular tomonidan sodir etilgan ayb haqiqatan ham bunga loyiq, lekin sendan emas; chunki, xuddi xatolar jazolagandek, yaxshi amaldorlar ham yaxshilik bilan jazolaydi, faqatgina...

en: Knowest thou who these are thou wouldst have burnt?’ The king answered no, and Ruggieri continued, ‘Then I will have thee know them, so thou mayst see how discreetly282 thou sufferest thyself to be carried away by the transports of passion.
uz: "Sen bularni kimni yoqmoqchi bo'lganingni bilasanmi?" Shoh yo'q dedi va Ruggieri davom etdi: "Unda men seni ularni tanitaman, shunda sen qanday yashirincha 282 o'zingni ehtiros transportlariga olib ketishga ruxsat berishingni ko'rasan."

en: The young man is the son of Landolfo di Pro- cida, own brother to Messer Gian di Procida,283 by whose means thou art king and lord of this island, and the damsel is the daughter of Marino Bol- garo, to whose inﬂuence thou owest it that thine ofﬁcers have not been driv- en forth of Ischia.
uz: Yigit Landolfo di Pro- cida o'g'li, Messer Gian di Procidaga o'z akasi, 283 uning vositasi bilan siz bu orolning shohi va xo'jayini bo'lasiz, va qizaloq Marino Bol- garoning qizi, uning ta'siriga ko'ra sizning ofitserlaringiz Isxiyadan quvib chiqarilmagan.

en: Moreover, they are lovers who have long loved one an- other and constrained of love, rather than of will to do despite to thine au- thority, have done this sin, if that can be called sin which young folk do for love.
uz: Qolaversa, ular bir-birini allaqachon sevgan va muhabbatdan cheklangan, o'z erkinligingga qaramay, ixtiyoriy ravishda qilgandan ko'ra, yoshlar sevgi uchun qiladigan gunoh deb atash mumkin bo'lgan bu gunohni qilgan oshiqlardir.

en: Wherefore, then, wilt thou put them to death, whenas thou shouldst rather honour them with the greatest favours and boons at thy commandment?’ The king, hearing this and certifying himself that Ruggieri spoke sooth, not only forbore from proceeding to do worse, but repented him of that which he had done, wherefore he commanded incontinent that the two lov- ers should be loosed from the stake and brought before him; which was forthright done.
uz: Shunday ekan, ularni o'ldirishni xohlaysanmi, sen esa ularni buyruqlaring bo'yicha eng katta marhamat va mukofotlar bilan hurmat qilmoqchisan? Buni eshitib, qirol Ruggieri xotirjam gapirganini tasdiqlab, nafaqat yomonlik qilishdan qaytardi, balki qilgan ishidan tavba qildi, shuning uchun u ikki sevgilisini qoziqdan bo'shatishni va oldinga olib kelishni bevosita buyurdi; bu esa to'g'ridan-to'g'ri amalga oshirildi.

en: Therewith, having fully acquainted himself with their case, he concluded that it behoved him requite them the injury he had done them with gifts and honour; wherefore he let clothe them anew on sumptuous wise and ﬁnding them of one accord, caused Gianni to take the damsel to wife.
uz: Shu bilan birga, ularning ishi bilan toʻliq tanish boʻlgach, u ularga yetkazgan zararni sovgʻalar va sharaf bilan qaytarishi kerak degan xulosaga keldi; shuning uchun u ularni hashamatli donolik bilan yangi kiydirdi va ularni bir xilda topdi, shuning uchun Gianni qizni xotinlikka oldi.

en: Then, making them magniﬁcent presents, he sent them back, re- joicing, to their own country, where they were received with the utmost joy- ance and delight.”
uz: So'ngra, ularga ajoyib sovg'alar tayyorlab, ularni o'z yurtiga qaytarib, quvonch bilan jo'natib yubordi, u yerda ular eng katta quvonch va quvonch bilan kutib olindilar.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Teodoro, being enamoured of Violante, daughter of Messer Amerigo his lord, getteth her with child and is condemned to be hanged; but, being recognized and delivered by his father, as they are leading him to the gallows, scourging him the while, he taketh Violante to wife.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Teodoro, xo'jayinining qizi Violanteni oshiq qilib, uni homilador qilib oldi va osishga mahkum bo'ldi; lekin, otasi tomonidan tanib olingan va ozod qilingan holda, uni dorga tortishayotganda, o'sha paytda kaltaklashayotganda, u Violanteni xotinlikka oldi.

en: The ladies, who abode all fearful in suspense to know if the lovers should be burnt, hearing of their escape, praised God and were glad; whereupon the queen, seeing that Pampinea had made an end of her story, imposed on Lauretta the charge of following on, who blithely proceeded to say: “Fairest ladies, in the days when good King William284 ruled over Sicily, there was in that island a gentleman hight Messer Amerigo Abate of Trapani, who, among other worldly goods, was very well furnished with children; where- fore, having occasion for servants and there coming thither from the Levant certain galleys of Genoese corsairs, who had, in their cruises off the coast of Armenia, taken many boys, he bought some of these latter, deeming them Turks, and amongst them one, Teodoro by name, of nobler mien and better bearing than the rest, who seemed all mere shepherds.
uz: Sevishganlar kuyib ketishi kerakmi, deb xavotirda qolgan xonimlar, ularning qochganini eshitib, Xudoni maqtashdi va xursand bo'lishdi; shundan so'ng, malika, Pampinea o'z hikoyasini tugatganini ko'rib, Laurettaga ergashish yukini yukladi. U bemalol shunday dedi: "Adolatli xonimlar, yaxshi qirol Uilyam284 Sitsiliya ustidan hukmronlik qilgan kunlarda, o'sha orolda yuqori martabali janob Messerigo Abate of Trapani bor edi, u boshqa dunyoviy narsalar qatorida bolalar bilan juda yaxshi jihozlangan edi; oldindan, xizmatkorlar uchun va Genovadan kelayotgan Levant galleylaridan kelgan, Armaniston qirg'og'idan ko'plab yigitlarni sotib olgan edi, u ularning ba'zilarini sotib olgan, ularni Turkiya va ularning orasida ko'proq zodagon deb hisoblagan va ularning bir

en: Teodoro, although entreated as a slave, was brought up in the house with Messer Amerigo’s children and conforming more to his own nature than to the accidents of fortune, approved himself so accomplished and well-bred and so commen- ded himself to Messer Amerigo that he set him free and still believing him to be a Turk, caused baptize him and call him Pietro and made him chief over all his affairs, trusting greatly in him.
uz: Teodoro, garchi qul sifatida iltijo qilingan bo'lsa ham, Messer Amerigoning bolalari bilan birga uyda tarbiyalangan va omad baxtsiz hodisalaridan ko'ra o'z tabiatiga ko'proq moslashgan, o'zini shunchalik yetuk va yaxshi tarbiyalangan deb hisoblagan va Messer Amerigoga shunchalik sadoqatli bo'lganki, uni ozod qildi va hali ham uni turk deb hisoblardi, uni suvga cho'mdirdi va Pietroga chaqirib, barcha ishlariga boshliq qilib, unga katta ishonardi.

en: As Messer Amerigo’s children grew up, there grew up with them a daughter of his, called Violante, a fair and dainty damsel, who, her father tarrying overmuch to marry her, became by chance enamoured of Pietro and loving him and holding his manners and fashions in great esteem, was yet
uz: Messer Amerigo'ning bolalari ulg'aygan sari, ular bilan birga uning qizi, Violante deb nomlangan, go'zal va nozik qiz ham ulg'aydi. Otasi unga turmushga chiqishga juda ko'p shoshilgach, tasodifan Pietroga oshiq bo'lib qoldi, uni yaxshi ko'rdi va uning odoblari va modalarini katta hurmat qildi.

en: ashamed to discover this to him.
uz: Unga buni kashf etishdan uyalgan.

en: But Love spared her that pains, for that Pietro, having once and again looked upon her by stealth, had become so passionately enamoured of her that he never knew ease save whenas he saw her; but he was sore afraid lest any should become aware thereof, himseem- ing that in this he did other than well.
uz: Ammo Muhabbat uni o'sha og'riqlardan saqladi, chunki Pietro unga bir necha bor yashirincha qaragan holda, unga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan oshiq bo'lgan ediki, uni ko'rmaguncha hech qachon yengillik bilmas edi; lekin u hech kim bu haqda xabardor bo'lmasligidan xavotirda edi, chunki u bu borada yaxshilikdan boshqa narsa qilgandek edi.

en: The young lady, who took pleasure in looking upon him, soon perceived this and to give him more assurance, showed herself exceeding well pleased therewith, as indeed she was.
uz: Unga qarashdan zavq olgan yosh xonim buni tezda angladi va unga ko'proq ishonch berish uchun, o'zini juda ham xursand qilib ko'rsatdi, xuddi shunday bo'lgani kabi.

en: On this wise they abode a great while, daring not to say aught to one another, much as each desired it; but, whilst both, alike enamoured, languished en- kindled in the ﬂames of love, fortune, as if it had determined of will afore- thought that this should be, furnished them with an occasion of doing away the timorousness that baulked them.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular bir-birlariga xohlagancha hech narsa demaslikka jur'at qilib, ancha vaqt qoldilar; lekin, ikkalasi ham birdek oshiq bo'lib, sevgi olovida yonib ketganlarida, baxt, go'yo bu avvaldan shunday bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylaganidek, ularni qo'rqitgan qo'rquvni yo'q qilish imkoniyatini taqdim etdi.

en: Messer Amerigo had, about a mile from Trapani, a very goodly place,285 to which his lady was wont ofttimes to resort by way of pastime with her daughter and other women and ladies.
uz: Messer Amerigo Trapaniydan taxminan bir milya uzoqlikda, 285 ta juda yaxshi joyga ega edi, unga uning xonimi ko'pincha qizi va boshqa ayollar va xonimlar bilan vaqt o'tkazish uchun murojaat qilardi.

en: Thither accordingly they betook themselves one day of great heat, carrying Pietro with them, and there abid- ing, it befell, as whiles we see it happen in summer time, that the sky be- came of a sudden overcast with dark clouds, wherefore the lady set out with her company to return to Trapani, so they might not be there overtaken of the foul weather, and fared on as fast as they might.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular bir kuni katta issiqlik bilan o'zlarini o'sha yerga olib ketishdi, Pietroni o'zlari bilan olib ketishdi va o'sha yerda qolishdi. Yozda sodir bo'layotganini ko'rayotganimizdek, osmon to'satdan qorong'u bulutlar bilan qoplandi. Shuning uchun xonim o'z kompaniyasi bilan Trapaniga qaytishga yo'l oldi, shunda ular buzuq ob-havoda yetib bormasliklari va imkon qadar tezroq yo'lga chiqishlari mumkin edi.

en: But Pietro and Violante, being young, outwent her mother and the rest by a great way, urged belike, no less by love than by fear of the weather, and they being already so far in advance that they were hardly to be seen, it chanced that, of a sudden, after many thunderclaps, a very heavy and thick shower of hail began to fall, wherefrom the lady and her company ﬂed into the house of a husbandman.
uz: Ammo Pietro va Violante yosh bo'lgani uchun onasidan va qolganlardan ancha o'zib ketishdi, ularni ob-havo qo'rquvidan kam bo'lmagan darajada sevgi bilan majburlashdi va ular shunchalik oldinda bo'lishdiki, ularni deyarli ko'rish mumkin emas edi, shunday bo'ldiki, to'satdan, ko'plab momaqaldiroqlardan so'ng, juda kuchli va qalin do'l yog'dira boshladi, undan xonim va uning kompaniyasi bir dehqonning uyiga qochib kirishdi.
