en: Pietro and the young lady, having no readier shelter, took refuge in a little old hut, well nigh all in ruins, wherein none dwelt, and there huddled to- gether under a small piece of roof, that yet remained whole.
uz: Pietro va yosh xonim, hech qanday tayyor boshpanaga ega bo'lmagani uchun, xarobalarga yaqin bo'lgan kichik bir kulbada panoh topdilar, unda hech kim yashamagan va u yerda kichik bir tom ostida yashiringan edilar, lekin u hali ham butun edi.

en: The scantness of the cover constrained them to press close one to other, and this touching was the means of somewhat emboldening their minds to discover the amor- ous desires that consumed them both; and Pietro ﬁrst began to say, ‘Would God this hail might never give over, so but I might abide as I am!’ ‘Indeed,’ answered the girl, ‘that were dear to me also.’ From these words they came to taking each other by the hands and pressing them and from that to clip- ping and after to kissing, it hailing still the while; and in short, not to re- count every particular, the weather mended not before they had known the utmost delights of love and had taken order to have their pleasure secretly
uz: Qopqoqning siyrakligi ularni bir-biriga yaqinroq yaqinlashishga majbur qildi va bu teginish ularning ikkalasi ham yutgan sevgi istaklarini aniqlash uchun biroz jasorat berish vositasi edi; va Pietro avvaliga: "Xudo bu do'l hech qachon taslim bo'lmasmidi, lekin men qanday bo'lsam shunday turardim!" - dedi, "Ha," dedi qiz, - bu menga ham juda qadrli edi.

en: The storm ended, they fared on to the gate of the city, which was near at hand, and there awaiting the lady, returned home with her.
uz: Bo'ron tugab, ular shahar darvozasiga tomon yo'l olishdi, bu darvoza yaqin edi va u yerda xonim kutib turardi, u bilan birga uyga qaytdi.

en: Thereafter, with very discreet and secret ordinance, they foregathered again and again in the same place, to the great contentment of them both, and the work went on so briskly that the young lady became with child, which was sore unwelcome both to the one and the other; wherefore she used many arts to rid herself, contrary to the course of nature, of her burden, but could nowise avail to accomplish it.
uz: Shundan so'ng, juda maxfiy va maxfiy tartib bilan, ular qayta-qayta bir joyga yig'ilishdi, ikkalalarining ham katta mamnuniyatiga ko'ra, va ish shunchalik shiddat bilan davom etdi, yosh xonim bola bilan homilador bo'ldi, bu ham biriga, ham ikkinchisiga juda yoqimsiz edi; shuning uchun u o'z yukidan tabiyatga zid ravishda xalos bo'lish uchun ko'plab san'atlardan foydalandi, lekin endi buni amalga oshirishga qodir edi.

en: Therewithal, Pietro, fearing for his life, bethought himself to ﬂee and told her, to which she answered, ‘An thou depart, I will without fail kill myself.’ Whereupon quoth Pietro, who loved her exceedingly, ‘Lady mine, how wilt thou have me abide here?
uz: Shundan so'ng, Pietro o'z joniga xavf solib, qochishni o'yladi va unga dedi: "Sen ket, men o'zimni o'ldiraman." Shundan so'ng uni juda yaxshi ko'rgan Pietro dedi: "Xonim, meni bu yerda qanday qilib qo'yib yuborasiz?"

en: Thy preg- nancy will discover our default and it will lightly be pardoned unto thee; but I, poor wretch, it will be must needs bear the penalty of thy sin and mine own.’ ‘Pietro,’ replied she, ‘my sin must indeed be discovered; but be as- sured that thine will never be known, an thou tell not thyself.’ Then said he, ‘Since thou promisest me this, I will remain; but look thou keep thy prom- ise to me.’ After awhile, the young lady, who had as most she might, concealed her being with child, seeing that, for the waxing of her body, she might no longer dissemble it, one day discovered her case to her mother, beseeching her with many tears to save her; whereupon the lady, beyond measure woe- ful, gave her hard words galore and would know of her how the thing had come about.
uz: Sizning homiladorligingiz bizning kamchiliklarimizni aniqlaydi va u sizga yengil kechiriladi; lekin men, bechora, sizning va mening gunohlarimning jazosini ko'tarishim kerak bo'ladi." Pietro, javob berdi u, Mening gunohim aniqlanishi kerak; lekin ishonch hosil qilingki, sen hech qachon ma'lum bo'lmaysan, va o'zingizga aytma. Keyin u dedi: Sen menga buni aytganingdan beri, men qoladi; lekin menga va'dangni saqla. Bir oz vaqtdan so'ng, o'zi bor kuchi bilan bo'lgan yosh xonim, o'zining bola bilan ekanligini yashirdi, chunki u tanasining ko'payib ketishi mumkin edi, bir kuni onasiga uning ishini topdi, uni qutqarish uchun ko'p yosh bilan iltijo qildi; xonim, qayerga kelishini va uning so'zlarini berdi.

en: Violante, in order that no harm might come to Pietro, told her a story of her own devising, disguising the truth in other forms.
uz: Violante, Pietroga hech qanday zarar yetmasligi uchun, unga o'zining hiyla-nayrang hikoyasini aytib berdi va haqiqatni boshqa shakllarda yashirdi.

en: The lady be- lieved it and to conceal her daughter’s default, sent her away to a country house of theirs.
uz: Xonim buni yashirdi va qizining to'lovini yashirish uchun uni o'zlarining qishloq uyiga jo'natdi.

en: There, the time of her delivery coming and the girl crying out, as women use to do, what while her mother never dreamed that Messer Amerigo, who was well nigh never wont to do so, should come thither, it chanced that he passed, on his return from hawking, by the chamber where his daughter lay and marvelling at the outcry she made, suddenly entered the chamber and demanded what was to do.
uz: U yerda, tug'ilish vaqti kelganda va qiz ayollarning odatdagidek baqirib yig'layotganida, onasi hech qachon tushida ko'rmagan bo'lsa-da, mehribon Amerigo, deyarli hech qachon bunday qilmas edi, u yerga kelishi kerak edi, ehtimol, u havolanishdan qaytganida, qizi yotgan xonaning yonidan o'tib ketdi va u aytgan baqiriqdan hayratda, to'satdan xonaga kirib, nima qilish kerakligini talab qildi.

en: The lady, seeing her husband come unawares, started up all woebegone and told him that which had be- fallen the girl.
uz: Xonim erining bexabar kelganini ko'rib, xafa bo'lib ishga tushdi va unga qizning nima bo'lganini aytdi.

en: But he, less easy of belief than his wife had been, declared that it could not be true that she knew not by whom she was with child and would altogether know who he was, adding that, by confessing it, she might regain his favour; else must she make ready to die without mercy.
uz: Ammo u, xotiniga qaraganda ishonishga oson bo'lmagan, uning kim tomonidan homilador ekanligini bilmasligi va u umuman uning kimligini bilishi mumkin emasligini e'lon qildi va buni tan olish orqali uning marhamatini qaytarib olishi mumkinligini qo'shimcha qildi; aks holda u shafqatsiz o'lishga tayyor bo'lishi kerak.

en: The lady did her utmost to persuade her husband to abide content with that which she had said; but to no purpose.
uz: Xonim erini aytganlariga rozi bo'lishga ko'ndirish uchun bor kuchini sarfladi, lekin hech qanday maqsadda emas.

en: He ﬂew out into a passion and running, with his naked sword in his hand, at his daughter, who, what while her mother held her father in parley, had given birth to a male child, said, ‘Either do thou discover by whom the child was begotten, or thou shalt die without delay.’ The girl, fearing death, broke her promise to Pietro and dis- covered all that had passed between him and her; which when the gentle- man heard, he fell into a fury of anger and hardly withheld himself from slaying her.
uz: U shahvatga uchib, qo'lida yalang'och qilichi bilan uning qiziga yugurdi. Qiz onasi otasini parleyda ushlab turganida, o'g'il tug'ganini aytdi: "Yo'qsa, bola kim tomonidan tug'ilganini aniqlaysan, yo'qsa, tezroq o'lasan." Qiz o'limdan qo'rqib, Pietroga bergan va'dasini buzdi va u bilan o'rtasida sodir bo'lgan hamma narsani yashirdi; bu haqda muloyim odam eshitgach, g'azabga to'ldi va uni o'ldirishdan deyarli o'zini tiydi.

en: However, after he had said to her that which his rage dictated to him, he took horse again and returning to Trapani, recounted the affront that Pietro had done him to a certain Messer Currado, who was captain there for the king.
uz: Biroq, u unga g'azabi buyurgan narsani aytganidan so'ng, u yana otga o'tirdi va Trapaniga qaytib, Pietro u yerda shoh uchun kapitan bo'lgan bir certain Messer Curradoga qilgan haqoratini aytib berdi.

en: The latter caused forthright seize Pietro, who was off his guard, and put him to the torture, whereupon he confessed all and being a few days after sentenced by the captain to be ﬂogged through the city and after strung up by the neck, Messer Amerigo (whose wrath had not been done away by the having brought Pietro to death), in order that one and the same hour should rid the earth of the two lovers and their child, put poison in a hanap with wine and delivering it, together with a naked poniard, to a serving-man of his, said to him, ‘Carry these two things to Violante and bid her, on my part, forthright take which she will of these two deaths, poison or steel; else will I have her burned alive, even as she hath deserved, in the presence of as many townsfolk as be here.
uz: Oxirgisi darhol Pietro'ni qo'lga olib, uni qiynoqqa tortishga majbur qildi. Shundan so'ng u hammasini tan oldi va kapitan tomonidan shahar bo'ylab qamchilash va bo'ynidan osib tashlashga hukm qilinganidan bir necha kun o'tgach, Messer Amerigo (uning g'azabi Pietro'ni o'ldirish orqali yo'q qilindi), bir-birining ikki sevgilisining yerini va ularning farzandini yo'q qilish uchun, uni vino bilan zaharga solib, yalang'och poni bilan birga uning xizmatkoriga yetkazib berish uchun, unga dedi: "Bu ikki narsani Violantega olib boring va menga ayt, u bu ikki o'limdan xohlaganini, yoki po'latni, men uni tirik holda yoqib yuboraman, chunki u bu yerda ko'p odamlarning huzurida bo'lishi kerak edi."

en: This done, thou shalt take the child, a few days agone born of her, and dash its head against the wall and after cast it to the dogs to eat.’ This barbarous sentence passed by the cruel father upon his daughter and his grandchild, the servant, who was more disposed to ill than to good, went off upon his errand.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, undan tug'ilgan bolani bir necha kun o'tgach olib, boshini devorga urib tashla va keyin itlarga yeyish uchun tashla. Bu shafqatsiz hukm shafqatsiz ota tomonidan uning qiziga va nabirasiga, yaxshilikdan ko'ra yomonlikka ko'proq moyil bo'lgan xizmatkorga berildi va u o'z vazifasini bajardi.

en: Meanwhile, Pietro, as he was carried to the gallows by the ofﬁcers, being scourged of them the while, passed, according as it pleased those who led the company, before a hostelry wherein were three noblemen of Armenia, who had been sent by the king of that country ambassadors to Rome, to treat with the Pope of certain matters of great moment, concerning a cru- sade that was about to be undertaken, and who had lighted down there to take some days’ rest and refreshment.
uz: Ayni paytda, Pietro ofitserlar tomonidan dorga olib ketilayotganda, ular tomonidan kaltaklanayotganda, kompaniyani boshqarayotganlarga yoqqanidek, Armanistonning uch nafar zodagonlari joylashgan mehmonxona oldida o'tdi. Ular o'sha mamlakat qiroli tomonidan Rimga katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan ba'zi masalalarda Rim Papasi bilan muzokara olib borish uchun yuborilgan edi, bu yerda bir necha kun dam olish va tetiklanish uchun yonib kelgan edi.

en: They had been much honoured by the noblemen of Trapani and especially by Messer Amerigo, and hearing those pass who led Pietro, they came to a window to see.
uz: Ularni Trapani zodagonlari va ayniqsa Messer Amerigo juda hurmat qilgan edilar va Pietroga rahbarlik qilgan o'sha odamlarni eshitib, bir derazaga kelib ko'rishdi.

en: Now Pietro was all na- ked to the waist, with his hands bounden behind his back, and one of the
uz: Endi Pietro beligacha to'lib-toshgan edi, qo'llari orqasida bog'langan edi va bir...

en: three ambassadors, a man of great age and authority, named Fineo, espied on his breast a great vermeil spot, not painted, but naturally imprinted on his skin, after the fashion of what women here call roses.
uz: Uchta elchi, katta yosh va obro'ga ega bo'lgan Fineo ismli odam, uning ko'kragida katta ko'k dog'ini kuzatdi. Bu dog' uning terisiga bo'yalmagan, balki tabiiy ravishda bosilgan edi, bu yerda ayollar gul deb ataydigan uslubga ko'ra.

en: Seeing this, there suddenly recurred to his memory a son of his who had been carried off by corsairs ﬁfteen years agone upon the coast of Lazistan and of whom he had never since been able to learn any news; and considering the age of the poor wretch who was scourged, he bethought himself that, if his son were alive, he must be of such an age as Pietro appeared to him.
uz: Buni ko'rib, to'satdan uning xotirasiga o'g'li keldi. U Laziston qirg'og'ida kursyorlar tomonidan o'n besh yil oldin olib ketilgan va undan keyin hech qanday yangilik o'rgana olmagan edi; va kaltaklangan bechora odamning yoshini hisobga olgach, u o'zicha o'yladi: agar o'g'li tirik bo'lsa, u Pietro unga ko'ringan yoshda bo'lishi kerak.

en: Wherefore he began to suspect by that token that it must be he and bethought himself that, were he indeed his son, he should still remember him of his name and that of his father and of the Armenian tongue.
uz: Shuning uchun u shu belgi bilan u bo'lishi kerak deb gumon qila boshladi va o'zini shunday deb o'yladi: agar u haqiqatan ham o'g'li bo'lsa, uni o'z ismi, otasi nomi va arman tili bilan eslashi kerak.

en: Accordingly, as he drew near, he called out, saying, ‘Ho, Teodoro!’ Pietro, hearing this, straightway lifted up his head and Fineo, speaking in Armenian, said to him, ‘What countryman art thou and whose son?’ The sergeants who had him in charge halted with him, of respect for the nobleman, so that Pietro answered, saying, ‘I was of Armenia and son to one Fineo and was brought hither, as a little child, by I know not what folk.’ Fineo, hearing this, knew him for certain to be the son whom he had lost, wherefore he came down, weeping, with his companions, and ran to em- brace him among all the sergeants; then, casting over his shoulders a mantle of the richest silk, which he had on his own back, he besought the ofﬁcer who was escorting him to execution to be pleased to wait there till such time as commandment should come to him to carry the prisoner back; to which he answered that he would
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u yaqinlashar ekan, u qichqirib dedi: Ho, Teodoro! Pietro buni eshitib, darhol boshini ko'tardi va Fineo arman tilida gapirganda unga dedi: Sen qanday yurtdoshsan va kimning o'g'lisan? Uni nazorat qilayotgan serjantlar uni zodagonni hurmat qilish uchun to'xtatdilar, shuning uchun u javob berdi: Men Armanistondanman va bir Fineoning o'g'lim edim va bu yerga kichkina bola sifatida olib kelinganman, men buni bilmayman. Fineo buni eshitib, u albatta yo'qotgan o'g'li ekanligini bildi, shuning uchun u o'z askarlari bilan birga yig'lab, uni barcha serjantlar orasida qo'rqitish uchun pastga tushdi; keyin, u o'z yelkasidan eng boy ipakni tashlab, uni qaytarib, o'z ofitseriga olib kelishi kerak bo'lganini kutdi.

en: well.
uz: Xo'sh.

en: Now Fineo had already learned the reason for which Pietro was being led to death, report having noised it abroad everywhere; wherefore he straightway betook himself, with his companions and their retinue, to Messer Currado and bespoke him thus: ‘Sir, he whom you have doomed to die, as a slave, is a free man and my son and is ready to take to wife her whom it is said he hath bereft of her maid- enhead; wherefore may it please you to defer the execution till such time as it may be learned if she will have him to husband, so, in case she be willing, you may not be found to have done contrary to the law.’ Messer Currado, hearing that the condemned man was Fineo’s son, marvelled and confessing that which the latter said to be true, was somewhat ashamed of the unright of fortune and straightway caused carry Pietro home; then, sending for Messer Amerigo, he acquainted him with these things.
uz: Endi Fineo Pietro o'limga olib borilayotganining sababini allaqachon bilgan edi, xabar berishicha, uni hamma joyda chet elga tarqatgan ekan; shuning uchun u darhol o'zi, o'zining hamrohlari va ularning a'zolari bilan Maser Kurradoga murojaat qilib, uni shunday so'radi: "Janob, siz qul sifatida o'limga hukm qilgan odam, ozod odam va mening o'g'lim va u ayolga turmushga chiqarishga tayyor, u xizmatkoridan mahrum bo'lgan deb aytiladi; shuning uchun siz uni eriga berish haqida ma'lumot olguncha qatl qilishni kechiktirishga ruxsat bering, shunda, agar shunday bo'lsa, siz qonunga zid deb topilmasligingiz mumkin." Maser Kurrado, bu odamning o'g'li bo'lganini eshitib, hayratga tushdi va oxirgi marta u bilan birga bo'lganini tanidi, keyin u bilan biroz uyalgan edi va u...

en: Messer Amerigo, who by this believed his daughter and grandson to be dead, was the woefullest man in the world for that which he had done, see- ing that all might very well have been set right, so but Violante were yet alive.
uz: Amerigo janob, shu bilan o'z qizi va nabirasini o'lik deb hisoblagan, u qilgan ishi uchun dunyodagi eng shafqatsiz odam edi, shunda hammasi juda yaxshi tuzatilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin Violante hali ham tirik edi.

en: Nevertheless, he despatched a runner whereas his daughter was, to the intent that, in case his commandment had not been done, it should not be carried into effect.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u qizini yugurtirgan holda, agar uning buyrug'i bajarilmagan bo'lsa, bu amr amalga oshirilmasligi kerak degan niyat bilan yubordi.

en: The messenger found the servant sent by Messer Amerigo rating the lady, before whom he had laid the poniard and the pois- on, for that she made not her election as speedily [as he desired], and would have constrained her to take the one or the other.
uz: Xizmatkor Messer Amerigo tomonidan yuborilgan xizmatchini topdi, u xonimga poniard va zaharni qo'ygan edi, chunki u o'z tanlovini tezroq qilmagan edi va uni bir yoki ikkinchisini olishga majburlagan bo'lardi.

en: But, hearing his lord’s commandment, he let her be and returning to Messer Amerigo, told him how the case stood, to the great satisfaction of the latter, who, betaking him- self whereas Fineo was, excused himself, well nigh with tears, as best he knew, of that which had passed, craving pardon therefor and evouching that, an Teodoro would have his daughter to wife, he was exceeding well pleased to give her to him.
uz: Ammo, xo'jayinining buyrug'ini eshitib, u uni tinch qo'ydi va Messer Amerigo huzuriga qaytib kelib, uning holati qanday ekanligini aytdi. Bu holat oxirgilarning katta mamnuniyatini keltirdi. Fineo o'zini masxara qilib, o'zini, yaxshi bilganicha, ko'z yoshlari bilan kechirdi, kechirim so'radi va Teodoro o'z qizini xotinlikka olishini angladi, u uni unga berishga juda xursand edi.

en: Fineo gladly received his excuses and answered, ‘It is my intent that my son shall take your daughter to wife; and if he will not, let the sentence passed upon him take its course.’ Accordingly, being thus agreed, they both repaired whereas Teodoro abode yet all fearful of death, albeit he was rejoiced to have found his father again, and questioned him of his mind concerning this thing.
uz: Fineo uning bahonalarini mamnuniyat bilan qabul qildi va javob berdi: O'g'lim sizning qizingizni xotinlikka olishi mening niyatim; agar xohlamasa, hukm o'z yo'liga o'tsin. Shunga ko'ra, shunday kelishilgan holda, ikkalasi ham tuzalib ketishdi, Teodoro esa hali ham o'limdan qo'rqib yashardi, garchi u otasini yana topganidan xursand edi va bu borada uning fikridan so'radi.

en: When he heard that, an he would, he might have Violante to wife, such was his joy that himseemed he had won from hell to heaven at one bound, and he answered that this would be to him the utmost of favours, so but it pleased both of them.
uz: U Violantega xotin bo'lishi mumkinligini eshitgach, xursandchiligi shunchalik bo'ldiki, go'yo do'zaxdan jannatga bir qarama-qarshilikda g'alaba qozongan edi, va u javob berdi: bu unga eng katta marhamat bo'lardi, lekin bu ularning ikkalasiga ham yoqdi.

en: Thereupon they sent to know the mind of the young lady, who, whereas she abode in expectation of death, the woefullest woman alive, hearing that which had betided and was like to betide Teodoro, after much parley, began to lend some faith to their words and taking a little comfort, answered that, were she to ensue her own wishes in the matter, no greater happiness could betide her than to be the wife of Teodoro; algates, she would do that which her father should command her.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular yosh xonimning fikrini bilish uchun yuborishdi. U o'limni kutayotganda, tirik bo'lgan eng to'la yog'ochli ayol, o'ziga kelgan narsani eshitib, Teodoroga o'xshab qolganini ko'rib, uzoq suhbatdan so'ng, ularning so'zlariga biroz ishonishni boshladi va ozgina tasalli oldi. U javob berdi: agar u bu masalada o'z istaklarini amalga oshirsa, Teodoroga xotin bo'lishdan ko'ra katta baxt bo'lmas edi; albatta, u otasi buyurgan ishni qiladi.

en: Accordingly, all parties being of accord, the two lovers were married with the utmost magniﬁcence, to the exceeding satisfaction of all the towns- folk; and the young lady, heartening herself and letting rear her little son, became ere long fairer than ever.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, barcha tomonlar bir fikrda bo'lib, ikki oshiq butun shahar xalqining juda katta mamnuniyatiga ko'ra, eng ajoyib tarzda turmush qurishdi; va yosh xonim o'zini xursand qilib, kichkina o'g'lini tarbiyalab, har qachongidan ham go'zalroq bo'lib qoldi.

en: Then, being risen from childbed, she went out to meet Fineo, whose return was expected from Rome, and paid him reverence as to a father; whereupon he, exceeding well pleased to have so fair a daughter-in-law, caused celebrate their nuptials with the utmost pomp
uz: Keyin, bolalik karavotidan turgach, u Rimdan qaytishi kutilayotgan Fineoni kutib olishga chiqdi va unga otadek hurmat ko'rsatdi; shundan so'ng u, shunchalik go'zal keliniga ega bo'lishdan juda xursand bo'lib, ularning to'ylarini juda hashamat bilan nishonlashga majbur qildi.

en: and rejoicing and receiving her as a daughter, ever after held her such.
uz: va xursand bo'lib, uni qiz sifatida qabul qilib, doimo shunday ushladi.

en: And after some days, taking ship with his son and her and his little grandson, he carried them with him into Lazistan, where the two lovers abode in peace and happiness, so long as life endured unto them.”
uz: Va bir necha kundan so'ng, o'g'li, u va kichkina nabirasi bilan kemada ularni o'zi bilan Lazistonga olib bordi, u yerda ikki oshiq hayot davom etar ekan, tinch va baxtli yashashardi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Nastagio degli Onesti, falling in love with a lady of the Traversari family, spendeth his substance without being beloved in return, and betaking himself, at the instance of his kinsfolk, to Chiassi, he there seeth a horseman give chase to a damsel and slay her and cause her be devoured of two dogs.
uz: ONESTIYALAR SHAXSIYASI: Nastgio degli Onesti Traversari oilasining bir xonimiga oshiq bo'lib qoladi, o'z boyligini hech qanday evaziga sevilmasdan sarflaydi va o'zini qarindoshlari misolida Chiassiga qaratib, u yerda bir chavandoz bir xotinni quvib, o'ldiradi va uni ikki itdan yeyishga majbur qiladi.

en: Therewithal he biddeth his kinsfolk and the lady whom he loveth to a dinner, where his mistress seeth the same damsel torn in pieces and fearing a like fate, taketh Nastagio to husband.
uz: Shundan so'ng u o'z qarindoshlari va sevgan xonimni kechki ovqatga taklif qiladi, u yerda uning bekasi xuddi shu qizni bo'laklarga bo'linib ketganini ko'radi va o'xshash taqdirdan qo'rqib, Nastagioni eriga oladi.

en: No sooner was Lauretta silent than Filomena, by the queen’s command- ment, began thus: “Lovesome ladies, even as pity is in us commended, so also is cruelty rigorously avenged by Divine justice; the which that I may prove to you and so engage you altogether to purge yourselves therefrom, it pleaseth me tell you a story no less pitiful than delectable.
uz: Lauretta qirolichaning buyrug'i bilan Filomenadan oldin jim bo'lib, shunday boshladi: "Sevgilimjonlar, bizga rahm-shafqat buyurilganidek, shafqatsizlik ham Ilohiy adolat tomonidan qattiq qasos oladi; men sizga isbotlab, o'zingizni undan butunlay tozalashga undashim mumkin bo'lgan narsani, men sizga yoqimli va achinarli bo'lmagan hikoyani aytib berishni xohlayman."

en: In Ravenna, a very ancient city of Romagna, there were aforetime many noblemen and gentlemen, and amongst the rest a young man called Nasta- gio degli Onesti, who had, by the death of his father and an uncle of his, been left rich beyond all estimation and who, as it happeneth often with young men, being without a wife, fell in love with a daughter of Messer Paolo Traversari, a young lady of much greater family than his own, hoping by his fashions to bring her to love him in return.
uz: Romaniyaning juda qadimgi shahri bo'lgan Ravennada bir vaqtlar ko'plab zodagonlar va janoblar yashagan edi, qolganlari orasida esa Ota va amakisi vafotidan so'ng, hech qanday baholanmagan boy bo'lib qolgan, yosh yigitlar bilan sodir bo'ladiganidek, xotinsiz bo'lgan holda, o'zidan ancha katta oiladan bo'lgan yosh ayol Messer Paolo Traversari qizi bilan oshiq bo'lib qoldi.

en: But these, though great and goodly and commendable, not only proﬁted him nothing; nay, it seemed they did him harm, so cruel and obdurate and intractable did the beloved damsel show herself to him, being grown belike, whether for her singular beauty or the nobility of her birth, so proud and disdainful that neither he nor aught that pleased him pleased her.
uz: Lekin bular, garchi buyuk, yaxshi va maqtovga sazovor bo'lsalar ham, unga hech qanday foyda keltirmagan; aksincha, ular unga zarar yetkazgandek tuyuldi, shunchalik shafqatsiz, o'jar va murosasizki, sevikli qiz unga o'zini ko'rsatdi, uning yagona go'zalligi yoki tug'ilgan zodagonligi uchun o'zini shunday ko'rsatdi, shunchalik mag'rur va nafratlanadiki, na u, na unga yoqqan narsa uni xursand qilmadi.

en: This was so grievous to Nastagio to bear that many a time, for chagrin, being weary of complaining, he had it in his thought to kill himself, but held his hand therefrom; and again and again
uz: Bu Nastagio uchun shunchalik og'ir edi, ko'p vaqt davomida xafa bo'lib, shikoyat qilishdan charchab, o'zini o'ldirishni o'yladi, lekin undan qo'lini ushladi; va yana va yana.

en: he took it to heart to let her be altogether or have her, an he might, in hatred, even as she had him.
uz: U uni butunlay qo'yib yuborishga yoki unga ega bo'lishga ko'ngliga oldi, va u nafratda, hatto u uni qanday bo'lsa ham, shunday bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: But in vain did he take such a resolve, for that, the more hope failed him, the more it seemed his love redoubled.
uz: Ammo u bejizga bunday qat'iyatni qo'ydi, chunki unga umid qanchalik ko'p tushsa, muhabbati shunchalik ko'paygandek tuyuldi.

en: Accordingly, he persisted both in loving and in spending without stint or measure, till it seemed to certain of his friends and kinsfolk that he was like to consume both himself and his substance; wherefore they besought him again and again and counselled him depart Ravenna and go sojourn awhile in some other place, for that, so doing, he would abate both his passion and his ex- penditure.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u do'stlari va qarindoshlariga o'zini ham, mol-mulkini ham yo'q qilishga o'xshashi aniq bo'lgunga qadar, tinimsiz sevishda ham, sarflashda ham davom etdi; shuning uchun ular uni qayta-qayta so'rashdi va undan Ravenna shahridan chiqib, biroz boshqa joyga qolib ketishni maslahat berishdi, chunki shu bilan u o'z ishtiyoqini ham, sobiq xizmatini ham kamaytirardi.

en: Nastagio long made light of this counsel, but, at last, being im- portuned of them and able no longer to say no, he promised to do as they would have him and let make great preparations, as he would go into France or Spain or some other far place.
uz: Nastagio bu maslahatni uzoq vaqt davomida e'tiborga olmadi, lekin oxir-oqibat, ulardan befarq bo'lib, endi yo'q deyishga qodir bo'lmagani uchun, ular uni xohlaganidek qilishga va katta tayyorgarlik ko'rishga va'da berdi, xuddi Fransiyaga yoki Ispaniyaga yoki boshqa uzoq joylarga borar edi.

en: Then, taking horse in company with many of his friends, he rode out of Ravenna and betook himself to a place called Chiassi, some three miles from the city, where, sending for tents and pavilions, he told those who had accompanied him thither that he meant to abide and that they might return to Ravenna.
uz: So'ngra, ko'plab do'stlari bilan birga otga minib, u Ravennaning ortidan chiqib, shahardan taxminan uch mil uzoqlikda joylashgan Chiassi deb nomlangan joyga yo'l oldi. U yerda chodirlar va pavilonlar qidirib, u yerda unga hamroh bo'lganlarga u yerda qolmoqchi ekanligini va ular Ravennaga qaytishlari mumkinligini aytdi.

en: Accordingly, having encamped there, he proceeded to lead the goodliest and most magniﬁcent life that was aye, inviting now these, now those others, to supper and to din- ner, as he was used.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u yerda lager qurib, eng yaxshi va ulug'vor hayotni olib borishga kirishdi, u endi bularni, endi boshqalarni, o'zi ishlatilganidek kechki ovqatga va ovqatlanishga taklif qildi.

en: It chanced one day, he being come thus well nigh to the beginning of May and the weather being very fair, that, having entered into thought of his cruel mistress, he bade all his servants leave him to himself, so he might muse more at his leisure, and wandered on, step by step, lost in melancholy thought, till he came [unwillingly] into the pine-wood.
uz: Shunday bir kun kelib qoldi, u may oyining boshiga shunday yaqinlashdiki va ob-havo juda chiroyli edi, o'zining shafqatsiz bekasi haqida o'ylab, barcha xizmatkorlarini uni o'ziga tashlab ketishga buyurdi, shunda u dam olish paytida ko'proq mulohaza yuritishi mumkin edi va qadam-baqadam, qayg'uli xayolga berilib, qarag'ay daraxtiga kirib keldi.

en: The ﬁfth hour of the day was well nigh past and he had gone a good half mile into the wood, re- membering him neither of eating nor of aught else, when himseemed of a sudden he heard a terrible great wailing and loud cries uttered by a woman; whereupon, his dulcet meditation being broken, he raised his head to see what was to do and marvelled to ﬁnd himself among the pines; then, look- ing before him, he saw a very fair damsel come running, naked through a thicket all thronged with underwood and briers, towards the place where he was, weeping and crying sore for mercy and all dishevelled and torn by the bushes and the brambles.
uz: Kunduzning beshinchi soati yaqinlashdi va u o'rmonga yarim milya borgan edi, uni na yeyishga, na boshqa hech narsaga qo'shmay, birdan ayol tomonidan dahshatli katta faryod va baland qichqiriq eshitdi; shundan so'ng, uning nozik mulohazalari buzilgach, u nima qilish kerakligini ko'rish uchun boshini ko'tardi va qarag'ida juda go'zal bir qizni ko'rdi, yog'och va g'o'lalar bilan to'ldirilgan o'rmon bo'ylab yugurib kelayotgan edi, u qayerda bo'lgan bo'lsa, rahm-shafqatdan yig'lab, azob chekib, butunlay xaroba va xarobalar tomonidan yirtilgan edi.

en: At her heels ran two huge and ﬁerce mastiffs, which followed hard upon her and ofttimes bit her cruelly, whenas they overtook her; and after them he saw come riding upon a black courser a knight arrayed in sad-coloured armour, with a very wrathful aspect and a tuck in his hand, threatening her with death in foul and fearsome words.
uz: Uning poshnalarida ikki ulkan va shiddatli mastif yugurardi, ular unga qattiq ergashardi va ko'pincha uni shafqatsizlarcha tishlardi, qachonki ular uni quvib o'tishganda; va ulardan keyin u qora kurserga g'amgin rangdagi zirh kiygan, juda g'azablangan ko'rinishi va qo'lida tufli bilan kelgan ritsarni ko'rdi, u unga jirkanch va dahshatli so'zlar bilan o'lim bilan tahdid qilardi.

en: This sight ﬁlled Nastagio’s mind at once with terror and amazement and after stirred him to compassion of the ill-fortuned lady, wherefrom arose a desire to deliver her, an but he might, from such anguish and death.
uz: Bu manzara Nastagio'ning ongini darhol dahshat va hayrat bilan to'ldiradi va keyin uni baxtsiz xonimning rahm-shafqatiga qo'zg'atdi, shundan uni bunday azob va o'limdan qutqarish istagi paydo bo'ldi, lekin u bunga qodir edi.

en: Finding himself without arms, he ran to take the branch of a tree for a club, armed wherewith, he advanced to meet the dogs and the knight.
uz: O'zini qo'lsiz holda topgach, u daraxt shoxini to'siq uchun olib ketish uchun yugurdi, qurollanib, itlar va ritsarlarni kutib olishga oldinga chiqdi.

en: When the latter saw this, he cried out to him from afar off, saying, ‘Nastagio, meddle not; suffer the dogs and myself to do that which this wicked woman hath mer- ited.’ As he spoke, the dogs, laying fast hold of the damsel by the ﬂanks, brought her to a stand and the knight, coming up, lighted down from his horse; whereupon Nastagio drew near unto him and said, ‘I know not who thou mayst be, that knowest me so well; but this much I say to see that it is a great felony for an armed knight to seek to slay a naked woman and to set the dogs on her, as she were a wild beast; certes, I will defend her as most I may.’ ‘Nastagio,’ answered the knight, ‘I was of one same city with thyself and thou wast yet a little child when I, who hight Messer Guido degli Anastagi, was yet more passionately enamoured of this woman than thou art presently of yonder one of the Traversari and my ill fortune for
uz: Oxirgisi buni ko'rib, u uzoqdan unga qichqirib dedi: "Nastagio, aralashma; itlarga va o'zimga bu yovuz ayol qilgan ishni qilishga ruxsat ber." U gapirayotganda, itlar kampirning yon tomonlaridan mahkam ushlashdi va ritsar, ko'tarilib, otdan tushib ketdi. Shunda Nastgio unga yaqinlashib dedi: "Men sen kim bo'lishing mumkinligini bilmayman, meni bunchalik yaxshi bilasan; lekin men buni qurollangan ritsar uchun yalang'och ayolni o'ldirishga va unga itlarni o'rnatishga urinish katta jinoyat ekanligini ko'rish uchun aytyapman; albatta, men uni imkon qadar himoya qilaman." "Nastagio," - bola, men seni bir xil shaharda ko'rganman va men bu ayol uchun biroz ko'proq ishtiyoq edim,

en: her hardheartedness and barbarity came to such a pass that one day I slew myself in despair with this tuck thou seest in my hand and was doomed to eternal punishment.
uz: Uning qattiqqo'lligi va vahshiyligi shunchalik o'tib ketdi, bir kuni men qo'limda ko'rib turgan bu tiqin bilan umidsizlikda o'zimni o'ldirib, abadiy azobga mahkum bo'ldim.

en: Nor was it long ere she, who was beyond measure rejoiced at my death, died also and for the sin of her cruelty and of the delight had of her in my tor- ments (whereof she repented her not, as one who thought not to have sinned therein, but rather to have merited reward), was and is on like wise con- demned to the pains of hell.
uz: Va mening o'limimdan cheksiz xursand bo'lgan u ham vafot etmadi, va uning shafqatsizligi va mening azoblarimdagi zavqi uchun (shundan tavba qilmadi, chunki u gunoh qilmagan deb o'yladi, balki mukofotga loyiq deb o'yladi), do'zax azoblariga oqilona aylandi va shundaydir.

en: Wherein no sooner was she descended than it was decreed unto her and to me, for penance thereof,286 that she should ﬂee before me and that I, who once loved her so dear, should pursue her, not as a beloved mistress, but as a mortal enemy, and that, as often as I overtook her, I should slay her with this tuck, wherewith I slew myself, and ripping open her loins, tear from her body, as thou shalt presently see, that hard and cold heart, wherein nor love nor pity might ever avail to enter, together with the other entrails, and give them to the dogs to eat.
uz: U menga va unga tavba qilish uchun buyurilgandan ko'ra tezroq tushmadi. 286 U mendan qochishi kerak edi va men, uni bir vaqtlar juda yaxshi ko'rganim uchun, uni sevikli bekasi sifatida emas, balki o'lik dushman sifatida ta'qib qilishim kerak edi. Va men uni har safar o'zib o'tganimda, o'zimni o'ldirgan holda, uning belini yirtib, tanasidan yirtib tashlashim kerak edi, buni tez orada ko'rasiz, unda na mehr, na rahm boshqa ichaklar bilan birga kirishga yordam bermasdi va ularni itlarga yeyishga berardi.

en: Nor is it a great while after ere, as God’s justice and puissance will it, she riseth up again, as she had not been dead, and beginneth anew her woeful ﬂight, whilst the dogs and I again pursue her.
uz: Va undan keyin ham, Xudoning adolati va qudrati xohlaganidek, u o'lmaganidek qayta tiklanadi va yana qayg'uli parvozini boshlaydi, itlar va men esa uni yana ta'qib qilamiz.

en: And every Friday it betideth that I come up with her here at this hour and wreak on her the slaughter that thou shalt see; and think not that we rest the other days; nay, I overtake her in other places,
uz: Va har juma kuni men uni shu soatda bu yerga olib kelib, sen ko'rayotgan qirg'inni uning ustida o'tkazishim kerak; va boshqa kunlarda dam olamiz deb o'ylama; yo'q, men uni boshqa joylarda ortda qoldiraman.

en: wherein she thought and wrought cruelly against me.
uz: Unda u menga nisbatan shafqatsizlarcha o'yladi va ish qildi.

en: Thus, being as thou seest, from her lover grown her foe, it behoveth me pursue her on this wise as many years as she was cruel to me months.
uz: Shunday qilib, ko'rib turganingizdek, uning sevgilisidan dushmani paydo bo'ldi, shuning uchun men uni shu yo'l bilan shuncha yil quvib yurishim kerak, xuddi u menga nisbatan shafqatsiz bo'lgani kabi.

en: Wherefore leave me to carry the justice of God into effect and seek not to oppose that which thou mayst not avail to hinder.’ Nastagio, hearing these words, drew back, grown all adread, with not an hair on his body but stood on end, and looking upon the wretched damsel, began fearfully to await that which the knight should do.
uz: Shuning uchun, meni Xudoning adolatini amalga oshirishga qo'ying va siz to'sqinlik qila olmaydigan narsaga qarshilik ko'rsatmaslikka harakat qilmang." Nastagio bu so'zlarni eshitib, orqaga chekindi, butunlay o'sdi, tanasida tuklari yo'q edi, balki tik turardi va bechora qizga qarab, ritsar nima qilishi kerakligini qo'rqib kutishni boshladi.

en: The latter, having made an end of his discourse, ran, tuck in hand, as he were a ravening dog, at the damsel, who, fallen on her knees and held fast by the two mastiffs, cried him mercy, and smiting her with all his might amiddleward the breast, pierced her through and through.
uz: Oxirgisi, gapini tugatgach, qizga yugurib, qo'lini och itdek ushladi. Bu qiz uning tizzasiga yiqilib, ikki mastifni ushlab, unga rahm-shafqat so'radi va butun kuchini bilan ko'krakning o'rtasiga urib, uni teshib o'tdi.

en: No sooner had she received this stroke than she fell grovelling on the ground, still weeping and crying out; whereupon the knight, clapping his hand to his hunting-knife, ripped open her loins and tearing forth her heart and all that was thereabout, cast them to the two mastiffs, who devoured them incontinent, as being sore anhungred.
uz: U bu zarbani olishi bilanoq, u yerga egilib yiqildi, hali ham yig'lab va faryod qilib; shundan so'ng ritsar ov pichog'iga qo'lini urib, belini yirtib, yuragini va u atrofidagi hamma narsani yirtib tashladi, ularni ikki mastiffga tashladi, ular ularni och holda yutib yuborishdi, go'yo og'riq ostida edilar.

en: Nor was it long ere, as if none of these things had been, the damsel of a sud- den rose to her feet and began to ﬂee towards the sea, with the dogs after her, still rending her; and in a little while they had gone so far that Nastagio could see them no more.
uz: Va ko'p o'tmay, go'yo bularning hech biri bo'lmagandek, bir sud-dinning qizi oyoqqa turdi va dengizga qarab qochishni boshladi, itlar uning orqasidan hali ham uni yirtishardi; va bir ozdan so'ng ular shunchalik uzoqqa ketdiki, Nastagio ularni endi ko'ra olmasdi.

en: The latter, seeing these things, abode a great while between pity and fear, and presently it occurred to his mind that this might much avail him, seeing that it befell every Friday; wherefore, marking the place, he returned to his servants and after, whenas it seemed to him ﬁt, he sent for sundry of his kinsmen and friends and said to them, ‘You have long urged me leave loving this mine enemy and put an end to my expenditure, and I am ready to do it, provided you will obtain me a favour; the which is this, that on the coming Friday you make shift to have Messer Paolo Tra- versari and his wife and daughter and all their kinswomen and what other ladies soever it shall please you here to dinner with me.
uz: Oxirgisi, bu narsalarni ko'rib, achinish va qo'rquv o'rtasida uzoq vaqt turdi va tez orada bu unga juda foydali bo'lishi mumkinligi xayoliga keldi, chunki bu har juma kuni sodir bo'lardi; shuning uchun u joyni belgilab, o'z xizmatkorlariga qaytib keldi va keyin, o'ziga ma'qul kelganda, turli qarindoshlari va do'stlarini chaqirib, ularga dedi: "Siz meni uzoq vaqtdan beri bu dushmanimni sevish va xarajatlarimni to'xtatishga undadingiz va men buni qilishga tayyorman, agar siz menga bir marhamat ko'rsangiz; bu juma kuni siz Paolo Tra-versari va uning rafiqasi va ularning barcha qarindoshlari bilan bu yerda kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlasangiz."

en: That for which I wish this, you shall see then.’ This seemed to them a little thing enough to do, wherefore, returning to Ravenna, they in due time invited those whom Nastagio would have to dine with him, and albeit it was no easy matter to bring thither the young lady whom he loved, natheless she went with the other ladies.
uz: Men buni nima uchun xohlasam, shuni ko'rasiz." Bu ularga yetarlicha kichik ishdek tuyuldi, shuning uchun, Ravennaga qaytib, ular o'z vaqtida Nastagio bilan birga ovqatlanishlari kerak bo'lganlarni taklif qilishdi va garchi u yerga sevgan yosh xonani olib kelish oson ish bo'lmasa ham, u boshqa xonimlar bilan birga bordi.

en: Meanwhile, Nastagio let make ready a magniﬁcent banquet and caused set the tables under the pines round about the place where he had witnessed the slaughter of the cruel lady.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Nastagio ajoyib ziyofat tayyorladi va shafqatsiz xonimning qirg'in qilingan joy atrofidagi qarag'aylar ostiga stollarni qo'ydi.

en: The time come, he seated the gentlemen and the ladies at table and so ordered it that his mistress should be placed right over against the spot where the thing should befall.
uz: Vaqti keldi, u janoblar va xonimlarni stolga o'tqazdi va shunday buyurdiki, uning bekasi voqea sodir bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan joyga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarama-qarshi joyga joylashtirilsin.

en: Accordingly, hardly was the last dish come when the despairful outcry of the hunted damsel began to be heard of all, whereat each of the company marvelled and enquired what was to do, but none could say; whereupon all started to their feet and looking what this might be, they saw the woeful damsel and the knight and the dogs; nor was it long ere they were all there among them.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ov qilingan qizning umidsiz faryodi hammaga eshitila boshlanganda, oxirgi taom deyarli kelmadi. Shunda har bir kishi hayratda qoldi va nima qilish kerakligini so'radi, lekin hech kim ayta olmadi; shundan so'ng hamma oyoqqa turib, bu nima bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rib, qayg'uli qizni, ritsarni va itlarni ko'rdi; va ularning hammasi o'rtasida bo'lgani ham uzoq emas edi.

en: Great was the clamor against both dogs and knight, and many rushed forward to succour the damsel; but the knight, bespeaking them as he had bespoken Nastagio, not only made them draw back, but ﬁlled them all with terror and amazement.
uz: Itlarga ham, ritsarga ham qarshi shovqin katta edi va ko'pchilik kampirga yordam berish uchun oldinga shoshildi; lekin ritsar ularni Nastagio aytganidek gapirib, nafaqat orqaga tortdi, balki ularning hammasini dahshat va hayratga soldi.

en: Then did he as he had done before, whereat all the ladies that were there (and there were many present who had been kinswomen both to the woeful damsel and to the knight and who remembered them both of his love and of his death) wept as piteously as if they had seen this done to themselves.
uz: Keyin u avval qilganidek qildi, u yerda bo'lgan barcha xonimlar (va ularning ko'pchiligi qayg'uli xonimga ham, ritsarga ham qarindosh bo'lgan va ularni o'z muhabbati va o'limi bilan eslagan) xuddi o'zlariga qilinganini ko'rgandek achinarli yig'lashdi.

en: The thing carried to its end and the damsel and the knight gone, the ad- venture set those who had seen it upon many and various discourses; but of those who were the most affrighted was the cruel damsel beloved of Nasta- gio, who had distinctly seen and heard the whole matter and understood that these things concerned her more than any other who was there, remember- ing her of the cruelty she had still used towards Nastagio; wherefore herseemed she ﬂed already before her enraged lover and had the mastiffs at her heels.
uz: Ish oxiriga yetdi va qiz va ritsar ketdi, ad-sarguzasht uni ko'rganlarni ko'plab va turli xil nutqlarga duchor qildi; lekin eng qo'rqinchlilari Nasta- gioning shafqatsiz sevgilisi qiz edi, u butun masalani aniq ko'rgan va eshitgan va bu narsalar unga u yerda bo'lgan boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq tegishli ekanligini tushungan edi, u hali ham Nastagioga nisbatan ishlatgan shafqatsizligini esladi; shuning uchun u allaqachon g'azablangan sevgilisidan qochib ketdi va uning oyoqlarida mastiflar bor edi.

en: Such was the terror awakened in her thereby that —so this might not betide her —no sooner did she ﬁnd an opportunity (which was afforded her that same evening) than, turning her hatred into love, she despatched to Nastagio a trusty chamberwoman of hers, who besought him that it should please him to go to her, for that she was ready to do all that should be his pleasure.
uz: Shunday dahshat uyg'onardi undaki  bu unga tegmasligi mumkin edi  u o'sha kechqurun unga berilgan imkoniyatni topmasidan oldin, nafratini muhabbatga aylantirib, Nastagioga o'zining ishonchli xonadoni yubordi, u undan uning oldiga borishga rozi bo'lishini so'radi, chunki u uning xohishiga ko'ra bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani qilishga tayyor edi.

en: He answered that this was exceeding agreeable to him, but that, so it pleased her, he desired to have his pleasure of her with honour, to wit, by taking her to wife.
uz: U javob berdi: bu unga juda yoqimli edi, lekin bu unga yoqqanligi sababli, u uni hurmat bilan, ya'ni, xotin qilib olish orqali mamnun qilishni xohlardi.

en: The damsel, who knew that it rested with none other than herself that she had not been his wife, made answer to him that it liked her well; then, playing the messenger herself, she told her father and mother that she was content to be Nastagio’s wife, whereat they were mightily re- joiced, and he, espousing her on the ensuing Sunday and celebrating his nuptials, lived with her long and happily.
uz: Xotin uning xotini emasligini o'zidan boshqa hech kimga tegishli emasligini bilgan qiz unga yaxshi ko'rishini aytdi; so'ngra, xabarchi o'yinini o'ynab, otasi va onasiga Nastagio'ning xotini bo'lishdan mamnun ekanligini aytdi, bunda ular juda xursand bo'lishdi va u, keyingi yakshanba kuni uni turmushga chiqib, to'ylarini nishonlab, u bilan uzoq va baxtli hayot kechirdi.

en: Nor was this affright the cause of that good only; nay, all the ladies of Ravenna became so fearful by reason
uz: Na bu qo'rquv faqatgina o'sha yaxshilikning sababi emas edi; balki, Ravenna ayollarining hammasi aql bilan shunchalik qo'rqib ketishdi.

en: thereof, that ever after they were much more amenable than they had before been to the desires of the men.”
uz: shundanki, ular avvalgilaridan ko'ra ko'proq odamlarning istaklariga moyil bo'lishgan edi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Federigo degli Alberighi loveth and is not loved.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Federigo Alberighi sevadi va sevilmaydi.

en: He wasteth his substance in prodigal hospitality till there is left him but one sole falcon, which, having nought else, he giveth his mistress to eat, on her coming to his house; and she, learning this, changeth her mind and taking him to husband, maketh him rich again.
uz: U o'z mol-mulkini behuda mehmondo'stlik bilan behuda sarflaydi, toki o'zida faqat bitta boyo'g'li qolmaguncha. U hech narsasi bo'lmagani uchun xo'jayinini uyiga kelganda yeyishga beradi; va u buni bilib, fikrini o'zgartiradi va uni turmushga chiqarib, yana boy qiladi.

en: Filomena having ceased speaking, the queen, seeing that none remained to tell save only herself and Dioneo, whose privilege entitled him to speak last, said, with blithe aspect, “It pertaineth now to me to tell and I, dearest ladies, will willingly do it, relating a story like in part to the foregoing, to the intent that not only may you know how much the love of you287 can avail in gentle hearts, but that you may learn to be yourselves, whenas it be- hoveth, bestowers of your guerdons, without always suffering fortune to be your guide, which most times, as it chanceth, giveth not discreetly, but out of all measure.
uz: Filomena gapirishni to'xtatgach, malika o'zidan boshqa hech kim qolmaganini ko'rib, oxirgi marta gapirishga haqli bo'lgan Dioneodan boshqa hech kimni aytmadi. U shunday dedi: "Endi aytish menga tegishli va men, aziz xonimlar, buni ixtiyoriy ravishda qilaman, yuqoridagi kabi hikoyani qisman aytib beraman, faqatgina siz bilish uchun emas, balki sizning 287 muhabbatingiz yumshoq yuraklarda qanchalik foydali bo'lishi mumkinligini, balki o'zingiz bo'lishni o'rganishingiz uchun, u doim yo'lboshchi bo'lish uchun omad chekmasdan, o'z qo'riqchilaringizni beradi.

en: You must know, then, that Coppo di Borghese Domenichi, who was of our days and maybe is yet a man of great worship and authority in our city and illustrious and worthy of eternal renown, much more for his fashions and his merit than for the nobility of his blood, being grown full of years, delighted oftentimes to discourse with his neighbours and others of things past, the which he knew how to do better and more orderly and with more memory and elegance of speech than any other man.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, bizning kunlarimizda bo'lgan va ehtimol, hozir ham bizning shahrimizda buyuk ibodat va obro'ga ega, mashhur va abadiy shon-shuhratga loyiq bo'lgan Coppo di Borghese Domenichi, o'z qonining olijanobligi, yoshi to'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq, qo'shnilari va boshqa o'tmishdagi narsalar bilan ko'p marotaba suhbatlashishdan zavq olardi, bularni boshqa odamlarga qaraganda yaxshiroq, tartibliroq va xotira va nafosat bilan qanday qilish mumkinligini bilardi.

en: Amongst other ﬁne things of his, he was used to tell that there was once in Florence a young man called Federigo, son of Messer Filippo Alberighi and renowned for deeds of arms and courtesy over every other bachelor in Tuscany, who, as betideth most gentlemen, became enamoured of a gentlewoman named Madam Giovanna, in her day held one of the fairest and sprightliest ladies
uz: Uning boshqa go'zalliklari orasida, u Florensiyada Federigo ismli bir yigit bor edi, u Filippo Alberighi janobining o'g'li edi va u Toskanadagi har bir bo'ydoqdan ko'ra qurol-yarog' va odob bilan mashhur edi. Ko'pgina janoblar aytganidek, u Madam Giovanna ismli ayolga oshiq bo'lib qolgan edi, o'z davrida eng go'zal va yorqin ayollardan biri edi.

en: that were in Florence; and to win her love, he held jousts and tourneyings and made entertainments and gave gifts and spent his substance without any stint; but she, being no less virtuous than fair, recked nought of these things done for her nor of him who did them.
uz: Florensiyada edi; va uning muhabbatini qozonish uchun u musobaqalar va turnirlar o'tkazardi, ko'ngilochar tadbirlar o'tkazardi, sovg'alar berardi va mol-mulkini hech qanday harakatsiz sarflardi; lekin u, go'zallikdan kam bo'lmagani uchun, na u uchun qilingan bu ishlarning, na ularni qilgan odamning hech qanday hisobini berardi.

en: Federigo spending thus far beyond his means and gaining nought, his wealth, as lightly happeneth, in course of time came to an end and he abode poor, nor was aught left him but a poor little farm, on whose returns he lived very meagrely, and to boot a falcon he had, one of the best in the world.
uz: Federigo o'z mablag'idan tashqari sarflab, hech narsa orttirmay, o'z boyligini, vaqti-vaqti bilan tugab ketdi va u kambag'al bo'lib qoldi, undan faqat bir bechora kichkina fermadagina qolmadi, uning pullari juda bepul edi va u dunyodagi eng yaxshilardan biri bo'lgan falconni uloqtirish uchun bor edi.

en: Wherefore, being more in love than ever and himseeming he might no longer make such a ﬁgure in the city as he would fain do, he took up his abode at Campi, where his farm was, and there bore his poverty with patience, hawking whenas he might and asking of no one.
uz: Shuning uchun, har qachongidan ham ko'proq muhabbatga berilib, shaharda o'zi xohlaganidek suratga tusholmaydiganga o'xshab, u Kampida, o'z fermasida turar joyini egalladi va u yerda o'z qashshoqligini sabr bilan ko'tardi, qo'lidan kelganda hech kimdan so'ramaydi.

en: Federigo being thus come to extremity, it befell one day that Madam Gio- vanna’s husband fell sick and seeing himself nigh upon death, made his will, wherein, being very rich, he left a son of his, now well grown, his heir, after which, having much loved Madam Giovanna, he substituted her to his heir, in case his son should die without lawful issue, and died.
uz: Federigo shunday haddan tashqari ahvolga kelgan edi, bir kuni Madam Gio-vannaning eri kasal bo'lib qoldi va o'zini o'limga yaqin ko'rib, vasiyatnomani tuzdi. Shunda, juda boy bo'lib, u o'zining endi yaxshi ulg'aygan o'g'lini, merosini qoldirdi. Shundan so'ng, Madam Giovannaning o'rniga uni o'z merosiga qo'ydi, agar uning o'g'li qonuniy farzandsiz vafot etsa va vafot etdi.

en: Madam Gio- vanna, being thus left a widow, betook herself that summer, as is the usance of our ladies, into the country with her son to an estate of hers very near that of Federigo; wherefore it befell that the lad made acquaintance with the lat- ter and began to take delight in hawks and hounds, and having many a time seen his falcon ﬂown and being strangely taken therewith, longed sore to have it, but dared not ask it of him, seeing it so dear to him.
uz: Gio-vanna xonim, shu tariqa beva qolgan holda, o'sha yozda, xonimlarimizning odatlariga ko'ra, o'g'li bilan dalaga, Federigoning o'ziga yaqin joylashgan mulkga olib bordi; shuning uchun yigit lat-ter bilan tanishib, so'rg'ichlar va itlardan zavqlana boshladi va ko'p vaqt o'zining bolg'asini uchib, g'alati tarzda olib ketilganini ko'rib, uni olishni juda xohladi, lekin undan so'rashga jur'at etmadi, chunki u uni juda qadrlardi.

en: The thing standing thus, it came to pass that the lad fell sick, whereat his mother was sore concerned, as one who had none but him and loved him with all her might, and abode about him all day, comforting him without cease; and many a time she asked him if there were aught he desired, beseeching him tell it her, for an it might be gotten, she would contrive that he should have it.
uz: Shunday qilib, bola kasal bo'lib qoldi, onasi esa uni o'zi bilan birga hech kim bo'lmagan, butun kuchini sarflab sevgan va butun kun davomida uni o'rab, tinimsiz tasalli berayotgan odam kabi qattiq tashvishda edi; va ko'p marta u undan xohlagan narsasi bormi deb so'radi, unga aytishini iltimos qildi, chunki u uni olishi mumkin edi, u uni o'ziga topishga harakat qilardi.

en: The lad, having heard these offers many times repeated, said, ‘Mother mine, an you could procure me to have Federigo’s falcon, methinketh I should soon be whole.’ The lady hearing this, bethought herself awhile and began to consider how she should do.
uz: Yigit bu takliflarni ko'p marta takrorlaganini eshitib, dedi: "Onajon, siz menga Federigoning bolg'asini sotib olsangiz bo'ladi, menimcha tez orada sog'ayib ketaman." Buni eshitgan xonim bir oz o'yladi va qanday qilish kerakligi haqida o'ylay boshladi.

en: She knew that Federigo had long loved her and had never gotten of her so much as a glance of the eye; wherefore quoth she in herself, ‘How shall I send or go to him to seek of him this falcon, which is, by all I hear, the best that ever ﬂew and which, to boot, maintaineth him in the world?
uz: U Federigo uni allaqachon sevganini va undan hech qachon ko'z nuridek ko'rmaganini bilardi; shuning uchun u o'ziga dedi: "Undan bu so'rg'ichni qanday qilib qidirib yuboraymi yoki unga boraymi, u, eshitishimcha, dunyodagi eng yaxshi uchgan va uni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan eng yaxshisi?"

en: And how can I be so graceless as to offer to take this from a gen-
uz: Va qanday qilib men bunchalik nafosatsiz bo'lishim mumkinki, buni gen-dan olishni taklif qila olaman?

en: tleman who hath none other pleasure left?’ Perplexed with this thought and knowing not what to say, for all she was very certain of getting the bird, if she asked for it, she made no reply to her son, but abode silent.
uz: Kimda boshqa lazzat qolmagan? Bu fikrdan chalkashib, nima deyishni bilmay qoldi, chunki u qushni olishidan juda amin edi, agar so'rasa, o'g'liga javob bermadi, lekin jim turdi.

en: However, at last, the love of her son so got the better of her that she resolved in herself to satisfy him, come what might, and not to send, but to go herself for the falcon and fetch it to him.
uz: Ammo, nihoyat, o'g'lining muhabbati uni shunchalik ustun qo'ydi-ki, u o'zida uni qondirishga, bor kuchini ishga solishga va yuborishga emas, balki o'zi boyo'g'ini olib kelishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly she said to him, ‘My son, take com- fort and bethink thyself to grow well again, for I promise thee that the ﬁrst thing I do tomorrow morning I will go for it and fetch it to thee.’ The boy was rejoiced at this and showed some amendment that same day.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u unga dedi: "O'g'lim, o'zingni mustahkam tut va o'zingni yaxshi o'stirishing uchun o'ylagin, chunki senga va'da beramanki, ertaga ertalab qiladigan birinchi ishimni senga olib boraman." Bola bundan xursand bo'ldi va o'sha kuni o'zgartirilgan narsalarni ko'rsatdi.

en: Next morning, the lady, taking another lady to bear her company, re- paired, by way of diversion, to Federigo’s little house and enquired for the latter, who, for that it was no weather for hawking nor had been for some days past, was then in a garden he had, overlooking the doing of certain little matters of his, and hearing that Madam Giovanna asked for him at the door, ran thither, rejoicing and marvelling exceedingly.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, xonim yana bir xonimni o'z kompaniyasini olib, chalg'itish yo'li bilan Federigoning kichkina uyiga qaytdi va oxirgi uydan so'radi. Chunki u yerda na hajmi bor edi, na bir necha kundan beri bor edi, u yerda bog'da edi, uning ba'zi kichik ishlarini ko'rib turardi va xonim Giovanna uni eshikdan so'raganini eshitib, u yerga yugurdi, juda xursand va hayratlanardi.

en: She, seeing him come, rose and going with womanly graciousness to meet him, answered his respectful salutation with ‘Give you good day, Federigo!’ then went on to say, ‘I am come to make thee amends for that which thou hast suffered through me, in loving me more than should have behooved thee; and the amends in question is this that I purpose to dine with thee this morning fa- miliarly, I and this lady my companion.’ ‘Madam,’ answered Federigo humbly, ‘I remember me not to have ever received any ill at your hands, but on the contrary so much good that, if ever I was worth aught, it came about through your worth and the love I bore you; and assuredly, albeit you have come to a poor host, this your gracious visit is far more precious to me than it would be an it were given me to spend over again as much as that which I have spent aforetime.’ So saying, he shamefastly received her into his
uz: U uning kelganini ko'rib, o'rnidan turdi va ayolning mehribonligi bilan uni kutib oldi. Uning hurmatli salomiga "Xayrli kun bering, Federigo!" deb javob berdi. Keyin u davom etdi: "Men sizni men orqali azob chekkaningiz uchun, meni kerak bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq sevganingiz uchun qoplashga keldim; va shubhali qoplama shundaki, bugun ertalab siz bilan bir necha milliarddan ko'proq ovqatlanish niyatidaman, men va bu xonim." "Xonim," Federigo kamtarona javob berdi, "Men sizni hech qachon qo'lingizdan hech qanday zarar ko'rmaganimni eslayman, aksincha, agar men biror narsaga arzimagan bo'lsam, bu sizning qadringiz va sizga ko'rsatgan muhabbatim orqali sodir bo'ldi; va albatta, garchi siz kambag'al mehmonga kelgan bo'lsangiz ham, bu sizning mehribonligingiz menga u uchun sarflaganidan ko'ra ko'proq zarar ko'rishga arziydi."

en: house and thence brought her into his garden, where, having none else to bear her company, he said to her, ‘Madam, since there is none else here, this good woman, wife of yonder husbandman, will bear you company, whilst I go see the table laid.’ Never till that moment, extreme as was his poverty, had he been so dolor- ously sensible of the straits to which he had brought himself for the lack of those riches he had spent on such disorderly wise.
uz: Uyni u yerdan o'z bog'iga olib kirdi. U yerda, unga boshqa hech kim birga bo'lmasligi sababli, u unga dedi: "Xonim, bu yerda boshqa hech kim bo'lmagani uchun, bu yaxshi ayol, u yerdagi erning xotini, men stol yotqizilganini ko'rgunimcha, sizni birga olib yuradi." Hech qachon o'sha paytgacha, qanchalik qashshoq bo'lmasin, u o'zini bunday tartibsiz boyliklarga sarflaganligi uchun qanday qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganini shunchalik his qilmagan edi.

en: But that morning, ﬁnding he had nothing wherewithal he might honourably entertain the lady, for love of whom he had aforetime entertained folk without number, he was made perforce aware of his default and ran hither and thither, perplexed beyond
uz: Ammo o'sha kuni ertalab, u xonimni sharaf bilan xursand qiladigan hech narsa topmagani uchun, uning muhabbati tufayli bir necha marta son-sanoqsiz odamlarni xursand qilgan edi, u o'zining kamchiliklarini majburiy ravishda anglab yetdi va u yerda-bu yerda, hayron holda yugurdi.

en: measure, like a man beside himself, inwardly cursing his ill fortune, but found neither money nor aught he might pawn.
uz: O'zini o'ziga yaqin odam kabi o'lchang, o'z baxtsizligini ich-ichidan la'natlang, lekin na pul topdi, na hech narsa topolmadi.

en: It was now growing late and he having a great desire to entertain the gentle lady with somewhat, yet choosing not to have recourse to his own labourer, much less anyone else, his eye fell on his good falcon, which he saw on his perch in his little sa- loon; whereupon, having no other resource, he took the bird and ﬁnding him fat, deemed him a dish worthy of such a lady.
uz: Endi kech bo'layotgan edi va u muloyim xonimni nimadir bilan xursand qilish uchun katta ishtiyoqqa ega edi, ammo o'z ishchisiga murojaat qilmaslikni tanladi, hech kim bo'lmasa, uning ko'zi o'zining yaxshi bolg'asiga tushdi, uni o'zining kichik sa- loonidagi o'rnida ko'rdi; shuning uchun, boshqa resursga ega bo'lmagani uchun, u qushni oldi va uni semirtirgan holda topdi, uni shunday xonimga loyiq taom deb hisobladi.

en: Accordingly, without more ado, he wrung the hawk’s neck and hastily caused a little maid of his pluck it and truss it and after put it on the spit and roast it diligently.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u ortiqcha e'tibor bermasdan, xo'rozning bo'ynini g'ijirlatdi va shoshilinch ravishda kichkina xizmatchisiga uni yulib tashlashni buyurdi, keyin tupurgichga qo'ydi va astoydil qovurdi.

en: Then, the table laid and covered with very white cloths, whereof he had yet some store, he returned with a blithe countenance to the lady in the garden and told her that dinner was ready, such as it was in his power to provide.
uz: Keyin, stol yotqizilib, juda oq matolar bilan qoplandi, uning hali biroz do'koni bor edi, u bog'dagi xonimga xushmuomala yuz bilan qaytib keldi va unga kechki ovqat tayyor ekanligini, uni ta'minlash uning qo'lidan kelgani kabi ekanligini aytdi.

en: Ac- cordingly, the lady and her friend, arising, betook themselves to table and in company with Federigo, who served them with the utmost diligence, ate the good falcon, unknowing what they did.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xonim va uning do'sti o'rnidan turib, dasturxonga tushishdi va Federigo bilan birga, u ularga eng ko'p e'tibor bilan xizmat qildi, nima qilayotganlarini bilmasdan, yaxshi so'rg'ichni yedilar.

en: Presently, after they had risen from table and had abidden with him awhile in cheerful discourse, the lady, thinking it time to tell that wherefor she was come, turned to Federigo and courteously bespoke him, saying, ‘Federigo, I doubt not a jot but that, when thou hearest that which is the es- pecial occasion of my coming hither, thou wilt marvel at my presumption, remembering thee of thy past life and of my virtue, which latter belike thou reputedst cruelty and hardness of heart; but, if thou hadst or hadst had chil- dren, by whom thou mightest know how potent is the love one beareth them, meseemeth certain that thou wouldst in part hold me excused.
uz: Tez orada, ular stoldan turib, u bilan bir oz quvnoq suhbatlashgandan so'ng, xonim, qayerdan kelganini aytish vaqti keldi deb o'ylagan holda, Federigoga o'girilib, uni xushmuomalalik bilan so'kdi va dedi: "Federigo, men hech qanday shubha qilmayman, lekin sen bu yerga kelishimning maxsus sababini eshitganingda, mening taxminimga hayron bo'lasan, o'tmish hayotingni va mening fazilatlarimni eslaysan, bularning oxirgilari seni shafqatsiz va yurak qattiqligi deb hisoblaydi; lekin agar sen shunday bo'lganingda, kim orqali ularni ko'tarish qanchalik kuchli ekanligini bilishing mumkin edi, demak, sen meni bir qismida ushlab turishing kerak edi."

en: But, although thou hast none, I, who have one child, cannot therefore escape the common laws to which other mothers are subject and whose enforcements it behoveth me ensue, need must I, against my will and contrary to all right and seemliness, ask of thee a boon, which I know is supremely dear to thee (and that with good reason, for that thy sorry fortune hath left thee none other delight, none other diversion, none other solace), to wit, thy falcon, whereof my boy is so sore enamoured that, an I carry it not to him, I fear me his present disorder will be so aggravated that there may presently ensue thereof somewhat whereby I shall lose him.
uz: Lekin, garchi sening hech kiming bo'lmasa ham, men, bir farzandim bor, shuning uchun boshqa onalar bo'ysunuvchi umumiy qonunlardan qochib qutula olmayman va bu qonunlarning bajarilishi menga kerak bo'lsa ham, men o'z xohishimga zid ravishda va barcha huquq va go'zallikka zid ravishda sendan bir ne'mat so'rashim kerak, bu men senga juda qadrli ekanligini bilaman (va yaxshi sababga ko'ra, chunki sening achinarli omading senga boshqa hech qanday lazzat, boshqa hech qanday chalg'ituvchilik, boshqa tasalli bermadi), ya'ni, mening o'g'lim uni shunday qattiq sevgan, men uni unga olib bormasam, men uning hozirgi tartibsizliklari uni yo'qotadigan darajada og'irlashidan qo'rqaman.

en: Wherefore I conjure thee —not by the love thou bearest me and whereto thou art nowise beholden, but by thine own nobility, which in doing courtesy hath approved itself greater than in any other —that it please thee give it to me, so by the gift I may say I have kept my son alive and thus made him forever thy debtor.’
uz: Shuning uchun men Sendan iltimos qilaman  sen meni ko'tarib yurgan muhabbatingga va hozir qaram bo'lgan joyingga emas, balki o'zingning oliyjanobligingga, o'zingni boshqalardan ko'ra buyukroq ko'rsatganingga  menga berishingni xohla, shunday qilib sovg'a orqali aytishim mumkinki, men o'g'limni tirik qoldirdim va shu tariqa uni abadiy qarzdor qilib qo'ydim.

en: Federigo, hearing what the lady asked and knowing that he could not ob- lige her, for that he had given her the falcon to eat, fell a-weeping in her presence, ere he could answer a word.
uz: Federigo, xonimning so'raganlarini eshitib, uni qondira olmasligini, chunki u unga yemak uchun so'rg'ich berganini bilgach, bir so'z javob berishidan oldin uning oldida yig'lab yubordi.

en: The lady at ﬁrst believed that his tears arose from grief at having to part from his good falcon and was like to say that she would not have it.
uz: Xonim dastlab uning yaxshi so'rg'ichidan ajralganidan qayg'udan ko'z yoshlari paydo bo'lganiga ishondi va u buni xohlamasligini aytgandek edi.

en: However, she contained herself and awaited what Federigo should reply, who, after weeping awhile, made answer thus: ‘Madam, since it pleased God that I should set my love on you, I have in many things reputed fortune contrary to me and have complained of her; but all the ill turns she hath done me have been a light matter in comparison with that which she doth me at this present and for which I can never more be reconciled to her, considering that you are come hither to my poor house, whereas you deigned not to come what while I was rich, and seek of me a little boon, the which she hath so wrought that I cannot grant you; and why this cannot be I will tell you brieﬂy.
uz: Ammo u o'zini ushlab, Federigo nima javob berishi kerakligini kutdi. Federigo biroz yig'lagandan so'ng shunday javob berdi: "Xonim, Xudo sizga muhabbat qo'yishimni xohlagani uchun, men ko'p narsalarda menga qarshi omad deb hisobladim va undan shikoyat qildim; lekin u menga qilgan barcha yomonliklari hozir menga qilayotgan narsalariga nisbatan yengilroq edi va men u bilan hech qachon murosaga kelolmayman, chunki siz mening kambag'al uyimga kelgansiz, garchi siz boy bo'lganimda menga kelmaslikni buyurgansiz va mendan ozgina ne'mat so'ragansiz, uni u sizga berolmayman; va nima uchun buni qisqacha aytib bera olmayman.

en: When I heard that you, of your favour, were minded to dine with me, I deemed it a light thing and a seemly, having regard to your worth and the nobility of your station, to honour you, as far as in me lay, with some choicer victual than that which is commonly set be- fore other folk; wherefore, remembering me of the falcon which you ask of me and of his excellence, I judged him a dish worthy of you.
uz: Sening marhamating bilan men bilan ovqatlanish niyatida ekanligingni eshitganimda, men seni qadrlashing va mansabing oliyjanobligini hisobga olgan holda, odatda boshqa xalqlar uchun mo'ljallanganidan ko'ra yaxshiroq qurbonlik bilan hurmat qilishni yengil va jozibali ish deb hisobladim; shuning uchun, mendan so'ragan so'rg'ichni va uning mukammalligini eslab, men uni senga loyiq taom deb hisobladim.

en: This very morning, then, you have had him roasted upon the trencher, and indeed I had accounted him excellently well bestowed; but now, seeing that you would fain have had him on other wise, it is so great a grief to me that I cannot oblige you therein that methinketh I shall never forgive myself therefor.’ So saying, in witness of this, he let cast before her the falcon’s feathers and feet and beak.
uz: Shunday qilib, bugun ertalab uni xandaq ustida qovurib qo'ydingiz, va men uni juda yaxshi sovg'a qilgan deb hisobladim; lekin endi, uni boshqa yo'l bilan qo'lga kiritganingizni ko'rib, men uchun shunchalik katta qayg'u borki, men sizni u yerda majburlay olmayman, men hech qachon o'zimni kechirmayman." Shunday qilib, bunga guvoh bo'lgan holda, u uning oldiga bolg'aning patlari, oyoqlari va tumshug'ini tashladi.

en: The lady, seeing and hearing this, ﬁrst blamed him for having, to give a woman to eat, slain such a falcon, and after inwardly much commended the greatness of his soul, which poverty had not availed nor might anywise avail to abate.
uz: Xonim buni ko'rib va eshitib, avvalo uni ayolga ovqat berish uchun shunday so'rg'ichni o'ldirgani uchun aybladi va keyin ich-ichidan uning ruhining ulug'vorligini ko'p maqtadi, bu esa qashshoqlikning foydasi bo'lmagan va hech qanday foyda keltirmaydigan edi.

en: Then, being put out of all hope of having the falcon and fallen therefore in doubt of her son’s recovery, she took her leave and re- turned, all disconsolate, to the latter, who, before many days had passed, whether for chagrin that he could not have the bird or for that his disorder was e’en fated to bring him to that pass, departed this life, to the inexpress- ible grief of his mother.
uz: So'ngra, so'rg'ichga ega bo'lishdan umidi pir bo'lib, o'g'lining sog'ayib ketishiga shubha bilan qaradi, u xayrlashdi va qaytib keldi, hammasi taskinsiz, oxirgiga. Ko'p kunlar o'tmay, u qushga ega bo'la olmasligi uchun qayg'urdi yoki uning kasalligi uni o'sha yoqqa olib kelishga qadar taqdirlangan edi, bu hayotdan, onasining ifodasiz qayg'usiga ketdi.

en: After she had abidden awhile full of tears and af- ﬂiction, being left very rich and yet young, she was more than once urged by her brothers to marry again, and albeit she would fain not have done so, yet, ﬁnding herself importuned and calling to mind Federigo’s worth and
uz: U ko'z yoshlari va afsus-nadomatga to'la bir muddat yashiringanidan so'ng, juda boy va ammo yosh bo'lib qolganidan so'ng, uni bir necha bor aka-ukalari qayta turmushga chiqishga undashdi va garchi bunday qilmagan bo'lsa ham, o'zini g'amxo'r deb topib, Federigoning qadrini esladi.

en: his last magniﬁcence, to wit, the having slain such a falcon for her enter- tainment, she said to them, ‘I would gladly, an it liked you, abide as I am; but, since it is your pleasure that I take a [second] husband, certes I will never take any other, an I have not Federigo degli Alberighi.’ Whereupon her brothers, making mock of her, said ‘Silly woman that thou art, what is this thou sayest?
uz: Uning so'nggi ulug'vorligi, xususan, o'z ta'minoti uchun shunday boyo'g'ini o'ldirganidan so'ng, u ularga dedi: "Men sizga yoqqan holda, men qanday bo'lsam shunday qolishni xohlardim; lekin, sizning roziligingiz bo'lgani uchun men [ikkinchi] er olsam, albatta, boshqa hech qachon olmayman, va men Federigo degli Alberighiga ega emasman." Shunda uning aka-ukalari uni masxara qilib, dedilar: "Sen ahmoq ayol ekansan, bu nima deysan?"

en: How canst thou choose him, seeing he hath nothing in the world?’ ‘Brothers mine,’ answered she, ‘I know very well that it is as you say; but I would liefer have a man that lacketh of riches than riches that lack of a man.’ Her brethren, hearing her mind and knowing Federigo for a man of great merit, poor though he was, gave her, with all her wealth, to him, even as she would; and he, seeing himself married to a lady of such worth and one whom he had loved so dear and exceeding rich, to boot, became a better husband of his substance and ended his days with her in joy and solace.”
uz: Qanday qilib uni tanlay olasan, garchi dunyoda hech narsasi bo'lmasa?"  Akalarim,  javob berdi u, Men sizning aytganingizdek ekanligini juda yaxshi bilaman; lekin men odamning boyligidan ko'ra boylikka ega bo'lmagan odamni xohlardim. Uning aka-ukalari uning fikrini eshitib, Federigoni juda yaxshi odam deb bilishdi, u kambag'al bo'lsa ham, uni butun boyligi bilan unga berdi, xuddi u xohlaganidek; va u o'zini shunday qimmatli ayolga va shunchalik aziz va haddan tashqari boy sevgan odamga turmushga berganini ko'rib, o'z boyligiga yaxshiroq er bo'ldi va kunlarini u bilan xursandchilik va tasalli bilan yakunladi.

en: THE TENTH STORY Pietro di Vinciolo goeth to sup abroad, whereupon his wife letteth fetch her a youth to keep her company, and her husband returning, unlooked for, she hideth her gallant under a hen-coop.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Pietro di Vinciolo xorijga kechki ovqatga boradi, shundan so'ng xotini unga mehmondo'st bo'lish uchun bir yoshni olib kelishga ruxsat beradi va eri qaytib kelganda, ko'rinmay qoladi, u o'zining jasoratini tovuq tagida yashiradi.

en: Pietro telleth her how there had been found in the house of one Arcolano, with whom he was to have supped, a young man brought in by his wife, and she blameth the latter.
uz: Pietro unga qanday qilib bir Arcolononing uyida, u bilan birga ovqatlanish kerak bo'lgan, xotini olib kelgan bir yigit topilganini aytdi va u oxirgisini aybladi.

en: Presently, an ass, by mischance, setteth foot on the ﬁngers of him who is under the coop and he roareth out, whereupon Pietro runneth thither and espying him, discovereth his wife’s unfaith, but ultimately cometh to an accord with her for his own lewd ends.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, bir eshak tasodifan qo'rg'oshin ostidagi odamning barmoqlariga qadam qo'yadi va u o'kirib chiqadi, shunda Pietro u yerga yugurib boradi va uni kuzatadi, xotining xiyonatini aniqlaydi, lekin oxir-oqibatda u bilan o'zining behayo maqsadlari uchun kelishib oladi.

en: The queen’s story come to an end and all having praised God for that He had rewarded Federigo according to his desert, Dioneo, who never waited for commandment, began on this wise: “I know not whether to say if it be a casual vice, grown up in mankind through perversity of manners and usances, or a defect inherent in our nature, that we laugh rather at things ill than at good works, especially when they concern us not.
uz: Qirolichaning hikoyasi tugaydi va hamma Xudo Federigoni o'z sahroga mos ravishda mukofotlagani uchun maqtadi, Dioneo, hech qachon buyruq kutmagan, shunday boshladi: Men bu oddiy illatmi, insoniyatda odob-axloq buzilishlari va urf-odatlar orqali o'sganmi yoki tabiatimizga xos nuqsonmi, ayniqsa, bizga tegishli bo'lmagan yaxshi ishlardan ko'ra yomon narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq kulamizmi, deb aytishni bilmayman.

en: Wherefore, seeing that the pains I have otherwhiles taken and am now about to take aim at none other end than to rid you of melancholy and afford you occasion for laughter and merriment —albeit the matter of my present story may be in part not altogether seemly, nevertheless, lovesome lasses, for that it may af- ford diversion, I will e’en tell it you, and do you, hearkening thereunto, as you are wont to do, whenas you enter into gardens, where, putting out your dainty hands, you cull the roses and leave the thorns be.
uz: Shuning uchun, mening boshqa azoblarim borligini ko'rib, hozir sizni qayg'udan xalos qilish va kulgu va quvonchga sabab bo'lishdan boshqa maqsadga qaratmoqchi emasman  garchi hozirgi hikoyamning mohiyati qisman umuman ko'rinmas bo'lsa ham, ammo, yoqimli qizlar, bu sizni chalg'itishi uchun, men sizga aytib beraman va siz, unga quloq solib, odatdagidek, bog'larga kirganingizda, u yerda nozik qo'llaringizni cho'zib, atirgullarni kesib, tikanlarni tashlab ketasiz.

en: On this wise must you do with my story, leaving the naughty man of whom I shall tell you to his infamy and ill-luck go with him, what while you laugh merrily at the amorous devices of his wife, having compassion, whenas need is, of the mischances of others.
uz: Shunday qilib, mening hikoyam bilan shug'ullanishingiz kerak, men sizga uning iflosligi va omadsizligi haqida gapiradigan buzuq odamni tashlab, u bilan birga boring, shu bilan birga uning xotinining shahvoniy fitnalariga xursandchilik bilan kulsangiz, kerak bo'lganda boshqalarning yomonliklariga rahm qilsangiz.

en: There was, then, in Perugia, no great while agone, a rich man called Pietro di Vinciolo, who, belike more to beguile others and to abate the gen- eral suspect in which he was had of all the Perugians, than for any desire of his own, took him a wife, and fortune in this was so far conformable to his inclination that the wife he took was a thickset, red-haired, hot-complex- ioned wench, who would liefer have had two husbands than one, whereas she happened upon one who had a mind far more disposed to otherwhat than to her.
uz: O'shanda, Perugiyada, o'sha paytlarda, Pietro di Vinciolo ismli bir boy odam bor edi.
