uz: U yerda men hurmatli otam, bendam Blamemenot Anitni topdim - iltimos, siz, juda ibodatli Quddus Patriarxi, u, odatga hurmat ko'rsatish uchun men hali ham bendam Baron St.ni kiyib yurgan.

en: Anthony, would have me see all the holy relics that he had about him and which were so many that, an I sought to recount them all to you, I should not come to an end thereof in several miles.
uz: Entoni, menga uning atrofida bor bo'lgan va shunchalik ko'p bo'lgan barcha muqaddas yodgorliklarni ko'rishimni xohlardi, men ularning hammasini sizga aytib bermoqchi edim, lekin ularning oxiriga bir necha mil uzoqlikda yetib bormasdim.

en: However, not to leave you disconsolate, I will tell you some thereof.
uz: Lekin sizni xafa qilmaslik uchun, bu haqda ba'zi narsalarni aytib beraman.

en: First, he showed me the ﬁnger of the Holy Ghost, as whole and sound as ever it was, and the forelock of the seraph that appeared to St.
uz: Avvalo, u menga Muqaddas Ruhning barmog'ini, u doimgidek butun va sog'lom bo'lganini va Avliyoga ko'ringan serafning old qovog'ini ko'rsatdi.

en: Francis and one of the nails of the Cherubim and one of the ribs of the Verbum Caro335 Get-thee-to-the-windows and some of the vestments of the Holy Catholic Faith and divers rays of the star that appeared to the Three Wise Men in the East and a vial of the sweat of St.
uz: Fransisk va Cherubim tirnoqlaridan biri va Verbum Caro335 qovurg'alaridan biri. Derazalarga o'ting va Muqaddas Katolik E'tiqodining ba'zi kiyimlari va Sharqdagi Uch Donishmandga ko'ringan yulduzning turli nurlari hamda Avliyo...

en: Michael, whenas he fought with the devil, and the jawbone of the death of St.
uz: Maykl, shayton bilan kurashganida va Avliyo o'limining jag' suyagi...

en: Lazarus and oth- ers.
uz: Lazar va boshqalar.

en: And for that I made him a free gift of the Steeps336 of Monte Morello in the vernacular and of some chapters of the Caprezio,337 which he had long gone seeking, he made me a sharer in his holy relics and gave me one of the teeth of the Holy Rood and somewhat of the sound of the bells of So- lomon’s Temple in a vial and the feather of the Angel Gabriel, whereof I have already bespoken you, and one of the pattens of St.
uz: Va shuning uchun men unga Monte Morello Steeps 336 dan xalq tilida va Caprezio 337 ning ba'zi boblaridan bepul sovg'a qildim, uni uzoq vaqt qidirib yurgan edi, u meni o'zining muqaddas yodgorliklariga sherik qildi va menga Muqaddas Yo'l tishlaridan birini va So-Lomon'ning ibodatxonasining bir oz tovushini flakon va Gabriel farishtasining patini berdi, men uni allaqachon sizga topshirganman, va patenlardan birini.

en: Gherardo da Villa Magna, which not long since at Florence I gave to Gherardo di Bonsi, who hath a particular devotion for that saint; and he gave me also of the coals wherewith the most blessed martyr St.
uz: Gherardo da Villa Magna, yaqinda Florensiyada men Gherardo di Bonsiga bergan edim, u o'sha avliyoga alohida sadoqatga ega; va u menga eng muqaddas shahid Avliyo bilan birga bo'lgan ko'mirlardan ham berdi.

en: Lawrence was roasted; all which things I devoutly brought home with me and yet have.
uz: Lourens qovurilgan edi; men o'zim bilan uyga sadoqat bilan olib kelgan va hali ham saqlab qolgan barcha narsalar.

en: True it is that my su- perior hath never suffered me to show them till such time as he should be certiﬁed if they were the very things or not.
uz: Rostini aytsam, mening su-periorim ularni aynan shu narsalar ekanligi yoki yo'qligi tasdiqlanishi kerak bo'lgan vaqtgacha ko'rsatishga hech qachon ruxsat bermagan.

en: But now that, by certain mir- acles performed by them and by letters received from the patriarch, he hath been made certain of this, he hath granted me leave to show them; and I, fearing to trust them to others, still carry them with me.
uz: Ammo endi, ular tomonidan ba'zi buyuk ishlar amalga oshirilgan va patriarxdan kelgan xatlar orqali bunga ishonch hosil qilgach, menga ularni ko'rsatishga ruxsat berdi; va men ularni boshqalarga ishonib topshirishdan qo'rqqan holda, ularni hali ham o'zim bilan olib yuraman.

en: Now I carry the Angel Gabriel’s feather, so it may not be marred, in one casket, and the coals wherewith St.
uz: Endi men Farishta Jabroilning patini olib yuribman, shunda u bir sandiqda, va St. bilan birga ko'mir bilan ifloslanmasligi kerak.

en: Lawrence was roasted in another, the which are so like one to other, that it hath often happened to me to take one for the other, and so hath it betided me at this present, for that, thinking to bring hither the casket wherein was the feather, I have brought that wherein are the coals.
uz: Lourens boshqa birida qovurilgan edi, ular bir-biriga shunchalik o'xshash ediki, menga bir-birini boshqa birining o'rniga olish ko'p uchraydi, va shu sababli u hozir menga be'da bo'ldi, chunki patli sandiqni bu yerga olib kelishni o'ylab, men ko'mirlar bor narsani olib keldim.

en: The which I hold not to have been an error; nay, meseemeth certain that it was God’s will and that He Himself placed the casket with the coals in my hands, especially now I mind me that the feast of St.
uz: Men xato bo'lmagan deb hisoblayman; aksincha, bu Xudoning irodasi ekanligiga va U O'zi qo'limdagi ko'mirlar bilan birga tobutni joylashtirganiga aminman, ayniqsa hozir men o'ylaymanki, Avliyo...

en: Lawrence is but two days hence; wherefore God, willing that, by showing you the coals wherewith he was roasted, I should rekindle in your hearts the devo- tion it behoveth you have for him, caused me take, not the feather, as I pur- posed, but the blessed coals extinguished by the sweat of that most holy body.
uz: Lourensga endi ikki kun qoldi; shuning uchun Xudo xohlasa, u qovurilgan ko'mirlarni ko'rsatib, men sizning qalbingizda unga bo'lgan zarur bo'lgan sadoqatni uyg'otishim kerak edi, chunki u menga, men so'raganimdek, patni emas, balki eng muqaddas tanasining teridan o'chirilgan barakali ko'mirni olib qo'ydi.

en: So, O my blessed children, put off your bonnets and draw near de- voutly to behold them; but ﬁrst I would have you know that whoso is scored with these coals, in the form of the sign of the cross, may rest assured, for the whole year to come, that ﬁre shall not touch him but he shall feel it.’ Having thus spoken, he opened the casket, chanting the while a canticle in praise of St.
uz: Shunday qilib, ey mening barakali farzandlarim, qalpoqlaringizni yeching va ularni ko'rish uchun butunlay yaqinlashing; lekin avvalo shuni bilmoqchimanki, kimki xoch belgisi shaklida bu ko'mirlar bilan o'ralgan bo'lsa, butun yil davomida ishonch hosil qilishi mumkin, olov unga tegmaydi, lekin u buni his qiladi.

en: Lawrence, and showed the coals, which after the simple multitude had awhile beheld with reverent admiration, they all crowded about Fra Cipolla and making him better offerings than they were used, be- sought him to touch them withal.
uz: Lourens va ko'mirlarni ko'rsatdi, oddiy olomon bir oz vaqt hurmat bilan tomosha qilganidan so'ng, ular hammasi Fra Cipolla atrofida to'planib, unga ishlatilganidan yaxshiroq qurbonliklar keltirishdi, uni ularga teginishini so'rashdi.

en: Accordingly, taking the coals in hand, he fell to making the biggest crosses for which he could ﬁnd room upon their white smocks and doublets and upon the veils of the women, avouching that how much soever the coals diminished in making these crosses, they after grew again in the casket, as he had many a time proved.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ko'mirni qo'liga olib, u eng katta xochlarni yasashga tushdi, ular uchun oq shimlar va qo'lqoplari, shuningdek, ayollarning pardalarida joy topishi mumkin edi, chunki bu xochlarni yasashda ko'mir qanchalik kam bo'lsa ham, ular ko'p vaqt davomida isbotlaganidek, sandiqda yana o'sdi.

en: On this wise he crossed all the people of Certaldo, to his no small proﬁt, and thus, by his ready wit and presence of mind, he bafﬂed those who, by taking the feather from him, had thought to bafﬂe him and who, being present at his preach- ment and hearing the rare shift employed by him and from how far he had taken it and with what words, had so laughed that they thought to have cracked their jaws.
uz: Shu yo'l bilan u Certaldodagi barcha odamlarni o'zining arzimagan foydasiga ko'ndirdi va shu tariqa, o'zining tayyor aql-idrok va aql-idrok bilan, undan pat olib, uni hayratga soladigan deb o'ylaganlarni hayratga soldi va ular uning va'zida hozir bo'lib, u ishlatgan kamdan-kam o'zgarishni eshitib, qanchalik uzoqqa olib ketganidan va qanday so'zlar bilan, shunday kulishganki, ular jag'larini yorib yuborgan deb o'ylashdi.

en: Then, after the common folk had departed, they went up to him and with all the mirth in the world discovered to him that which they had done and after restored him his feather, which next year stood him in as good stead as the coals had done that day.”
uz: Keyin, oddiy xalq ketgach, ular uning oldiga borishdi va dunyodagi barcha quvonch bilan unga qilgan ishlarini topdilar va keyin unga patlarini tiklashdi, bu esa keyingi yil unga o'sha kuni ko'mir kabi yaxshi holatda turardi.

en: This story afforded unto all the company alike the utmost pleasure and solace, and it was much laughed of all at Fra Cipolla, and particularly of his pilgrimage and the relics seen and brought back by him.
uz: Bu hikoya butun jamoaga eng katta zavq va tasalli berdi va u Fra Cipollada hammaga, ayniqsa uning ziyorati va u ko'rgan va olib kelgan yodgorliklariga juda kuldi.

en: The queen, seeing the story and likewise her sovantry at an end, rose to her feet and put off the crown, which she set laughingly on Dioneo’s head, saying, “It is time, Dio- neo, that thou prove awhile what manner charge it is to have ladies to gov- ern and guide; be thou, then, king and rule on such wise that, in the end, we may have reason to give ourselves joy of thy governance.” Dioneo took the crown and answered, laughing, “You may often enough have seen much better kings than I, I mean chess-kings; but, an you obey me as a king should in truth be obeyed, I will cause you enjoy that without which as- suredly no entertainment is ever complete in its gladness.
uz: Qirolicha, hikoyani va shu bilan birga uning hukmronligini ko'rib, oyoqlaridan turdi va tojni yechdi. Uni Dioneoning boshiga kulgi bilan qo'ydi va dedi: "Dio-neo, ayollar hukmronlik qilish va yo'naltirish uchun qanday buyruq kerakligini bir muddat isbotlash vaqti keldi; unda sen shoh bo'l va shunday hukmronlik qilginki, oxir-oqibatda biz o'zimizga hukmronligingdan quvonch his qilishimiz mumkin." Dioneo tojni oldi va kuldi: "Siz mendan ko'ra ko'p yaxshi shohlarni ko'rgan bo'lsangiz kerak, men shaxmat shohlari demoqchiman; lekin, agar siz menga shoh sifatida itoat qilsangiz, men sizga hech qanday xursandchilikda to'liq bo'lmasligini ta'minlayman."

en: But let that talk be; I will rule as best I know.” Then, sending for the seneschal, according to the wonted usance, he or- derly enjoined him of that which he should do during the continuance of his seignory and after said, “Noble ladies, it hath in divers manners been de- vised of human industry338 and of the various chances [of fortune], in- somuch that, had not Dame Licisca come hither a while agone and found me matter with her prate for our morrow’s relations, I misdoubt me I should have been long at pains to ﬁnd a subject of discourse.
uz: Lekin shunday bo'lsin, men o'zim bilganimcha hukm qilaman." Keyin, odatdagi odatga ko'ra, senesxalga xabar yuborib, u unga o'z oliyjanobligi davrida nima qilish kerakligini buyurdi va keyin dedi: "Aziz xonimlar, u inson sanoati va turli xil usullar bilan ko'rib chiqilgan edi, 338 va turli xil omad imkoniyatlari, shundayki, bir oz vaqt oldin bu yerga kelmaganida va mening ertaga bo'ladigan munosabatlar uchun moyilligini topganida, men uzoq vaqt davomida bahs mavzusini topishga harakat qilgan bo'lardim, deb shubham bor.

en: As you heard, she avouched that she had not a single gossip who had come to her husband a maid and added that she knew right well how many and what manner tricks married women yet played their husbands.
uz: Eshitganingizdek, u eriga xizmatkor kelgani haqida hech qanday g'iybat qilmaganini aytdi va u turmush qurgan ayollarning hali erlarini qanday hiylalar bilan o'ynashini yaxshi biladi, deb qo'shimcha qildi.

en: But, letting be the ﬁrst part, which is a childish matter, methinketh the second should be an agreeable subject for discourse; wherefore I will and ordain it that, since Licisca hath given us occasion therefor, it be discoursed tomorrow OF THE TRICKS WHICH, OR FOR LOVE OR FOR THEIR OWN PRESERVATION, WOMEN HAVE HERETOFORE PLAYED THEIR HUSBANDS, WITH OR WITHOUT THE LATTER’S COGNIZANCE THEREOF.” It seemed to some of the ladies that to discourse of such a matter would ill beseem them and they prayed him, therefore, to change the theme pro- posed; wherefore answered he, “Ladies, I am no less cognizant than yourselves of that which I have ordained, and that which you would fain allege to me availed not to deter me from ordaining it, considering that the times are such that, provided men and women are careful to eschew un- seemly actions, all liberty of discourse is permitted.
uz: Lekin, birinchi qism bo'lsa-da, bu bolalar masalasi bo'lsa, ikkinchisi muhokama uchun maqbul mavzu bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylayman; shuning uchun men Litskina bizga imkon berganidan beri, ertaga shunday hiylalar haqida gapirilsin, ya'ni: "Sevgi uchun yoki o'z ta'minoti uchun, ayollar o'z er-xotinlari bilan yoki oxirgi tan olishsiz o'ynashgan," deb.

en: Know you not that, for the malignity of the season, the judges have forsaken the tribunals, that the laws, as well Divine as human, are silent and full licence is conceded unto
uz: Bilmaysizlarmi, mavsumning yovuzligi tufayli sudyalar tribunallarni tark etishdi, qonunlar ham ilohiy, ham insoniy, jim va to'liq litsenziya berilgan.

en: everyone for the preservation of his life?
uz: Har kim o'z hayotini saqlab qolish uchunmi?

en: Wherefore, if your modesty allow itself some little freedom in discourse, not with intent to ensue it with aught of unseemly in deeds, but to afford yourselves and others diversion, I see not with what plausible reason any can blame you in the future.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar sizning kamtarligingiz nutqda ozgina erkinlikka imkon bersa, uni har qanday noto'g'ri ishlarda davom ettirish maqsadida emas, balki o'zingizni va boshqalarni chalg'itish uchun, kelajakda sizni qanday asosli ayblashi mumkinligini ko'rmayapman.

en: Moreover, your company, from the ﬁrst day of our assembling until this present, hath been most decorous, nor, for aught that hath been said here, doth it appear to me that its honour hath anywise been sullied.
uz: Qolaversa, bizning yig'ilishimizning birinchi kunidan hozirgi kungacha sizning hamrohligingiz juda go'zal bo'lmadi, va bu yerda aytilgan hech narsa uchun, menga uning sha'n-sharaflari hech qanday tarzda haqoratlangan ko'rinmaydi.

en: Again, who is there knoweth not your virtue?
uz: Yana, sening fazilatingni bilmaydigan kim bor u yerda?

en: Which, not to say mirthful discourse, but even fear of death I do not believe could avail to shake.
uz: Bu, quvnoq nutq emas, balki hatto o'lim qo'rquvi ham silkitishga yordam berishi mumkin deb o'ylamayman.

en: And to tell you the truth, whosoever should hear that you shrank from devising bytimes of these toys would be apt to suspect that you were guilty in the matter and were there- fore unwilling to discourse thereof.
uz: Haqiqatni aytsam, kimki siz bu o'yinchoqlarni o'ylab topishdan bosh tortganingizni eshitsa, u siz bu ishda aybdor ekanligingizni va bu borada gapirishga xohishsiz ekanligingizni gumon qilishga tayyor bo'ladi.

en: To say nothing of the ﬁne honour you would do me in that, I having been obedient unto all, you now, having made me your king, seek to lay down the law to me, and not to discourse of the subject which I propose.
uz: Siz menga barchaga itoatkor bo'lganim sababli, meni o'z shozingiz qilib qo'yganingiz uchun, qonunni menga qo'yib berishga harakat qilyapsiz va men taklif qilayotgan mavzuni muhokama qilmayapsiz, degan ajoyib hurmat haqida hech narsa demaysiz.

en: Put off, then, this misdoubtance, apter to mean minds than to yours, and good luck to you, let each of you bethink herself of some goodly story to tell.” When the ladies heard this, they said it should be as he pleased; whereupon he gave them all leave to do their several pleasures until suppertime.
uz: Shunday ekan, bu shubhalarni o'chirib qo'yinglar, sizlarning aql-idrokingizdan ko'ra ko'proq ma'noga ega bo'linglar, sizga omad tilayman, har biringiz o'zingizga aytadigan yaxshi hikoya haqida o'ylab ko'ringlar. Buni eshitgan ayollarga u xohlagandek bo'lishi kerak dedi; shundan so'ng u hammaga ovqatlanish vaqtigacha bir nechta lazzatlarini qilishlariga ruxsat berdi.

en: The sun was yet high, for that the discoursement339 had been brief; wherefor Dioneo having addressed himself to play at tables with the other young men, Elisa called the other ladies apart and said to them, “Since we have been here, I have still wished to carry you to a place very near at hand, whither methinketh none of you hath ever been and which is called the Ladies’ Valley, but have never yet found an occasion of bringing you thither unto today; wherefore, as the sun is yet high, I doubt not but, an it please you come thither, you will be exceeding well pleased to have been there.” They answered that they were ready and calling one of their maids, set out upon their way, without letting the young men know aught thereof; nor had they gone much more than a mile, when they came to the Ladies’ Valley.
uz: Quyosh hali ko'tarilmagan edi, chunki 339 ta nutq qisqa edi; Dioneo boshqa yigitlar bilan stol ustida o'ynashga murojaat qilib, Elisa boshqa ayollarni chaqirib, ularga dedi: "Biz bu yerda bo'lganimizdan beri, men sizni hali ham juda yaqin joyga olib borishni xohlardim, u yerda hech kim bo'lmagan deb o'ylayman va u yerda hech kim yo'q edi va u "Ladies" vodiysi deb ataladi, lekin hali sizni u yerga olib kelish imkoniyati topilmadi; shuning uchun, quyosh hali ko'tarilganiga shubham yo'q, lekin, iltimos, u yerga keling, u yerda bo'lganingizdan juda xursand bo'lasiz." Ular tayyor ekanliklarini va xizmatkorlaridan birini chaqirib, yosh yigitlarga hech narsa xabar bermasdan yo'lga chiqishni xohlashdi; va ular hali ham bir mildan ko'proq yo'l bosib ketishmadi, chunki ular "Ladies" vodiysiga kelgan edilar.

en: They entered therein by a very strait way, on one side whereof ran a very clear streamlet, and saw it as fair and as delectable, especially at that season whenas the heat was great, as most might be conceived.
uz: Ular u yerga juda tor yo'ldan kirishdi, uning bir tomonida juda tiniq oqim o'tdi va uni juda jozibali va yoqimli deb ko'rishdi, ayniqsa o'sha faslda, issiqlik juda kuchli bo'lganda, ko'pchilik tasavvur qilishi mumkin bo'lganidek.

en: According to that which one of them after told me, the plain that was in the valley was as round as if it had been traced with the compass, albeit it seemed the work of nature and not of art, and was in circuit a little more than half a mile, en- compassed about with six little hills not over-high, on the summit of each of
uz: Ulardan biri keyin menga aytganidek, vodiydagi tekislik xuddi kompas bilan izlanganidek yumaloq edi, garchi bu tabiatning asari bo'lib ko'rinsa ham, san'atning asari emas, yarim mildan sal ko'proq masofada edi, har birining cho'qqisida juda baland bo'lmagan oltita kichik tepalik bilan o'ralgan edi.

en: which stood a palace builded in guise of a goodly castle.
uz: Yaxshi qasr qiyofasida qurilgan saroy edi.

en: The sides of these hills went sloping gradually downward to the plain on such wise as we see in amphitheatres, the degrees descend in ordered succession from the highest to the lowest, still contracting their circuit; and of these slopes those which looked toward the south were all full of vines and olives and almonds and cherries and ﬁgs and many another kind of fruit-bearing trees, without a span thereof being wasted; whilst those which faced the North Star340 were all covered with thickets of dwarf oaks and ashes and other trees as green and straight as might be.
uz: Bu tepaliklarning yon tomonlari asta-sekin tekislikka tushdi, xuddi amfiteatrlarda ko'rganimizdek, darajalar ketma-ket eng yuqoridan eng pastga tushadi, hali ham o'z aylanasini qisqartiradi; va bu qiyaliklardan janubga qaraganlari tokzorlar, zaytunlar, bodomlar, giloslar va anjirlar va boshqa ko'plab meva beradigan daraxtlar bilan to'la edi, ularning bir qismi behuda ketmaydi; Shimoliy Yulduz340 qarshisidagilar esa, barchasi mitti emanlar, kul va boshqa daraxtlar bilan to'la edi.

en: The middle plain, which had no other inlet than that whereby the ladies were come thither, was full of ﬁrs and cypresses and laurels and various sorts of pines, as well arrayed and ordered as if the best artist in that kind had planted them; and between these little or no sun, even at its highest, made its way to the ground, which was all one meadow of very ﬁne grass, thick-sown with ﬂowers purpurine and others.
uz: O'rta tekislik, ayollar u yerga kelganidan boshqa kirish joyi bo'lmagan, archalar, cypresslar, lavrlar va turli xil archalarga to'la edi, go'yo o'sha turdagi eng yaxshi rassom ularni ekgandek yaxshi joylashtirilgan va tartibga solingan edi; va shu kichik yoki yo'q quyosh o'rtasida, hatto eng balandida ham, yerga yo'l oldi, bu juda nozik o'tdan iborat, binafsha va boshqa gullar bilan to'la ekilgan bir o'tloq edi.

en: Moreover, that which afforded no less delight than otherwhat was a little stream, which ran down from a valley that divided two of the hills aforesaid and falling over cliffs of live rock, made a murmur very delectable to hear, what while it showed from afar, as it broke over the stones, like so much quicksilver jetting out, under pressure of somewhat, into ﬁne spray.
uz: Qolaversa, boshqalardan kamroq zavq bermagan narsa, yuqorida aytib o'tilgan tepaliklarning ikkitasini bo'luvchi va tirik tosh qoyalari ustiga qulaydigan vodiydan pastga tushadigan kichik oqim edi. U uzoqdan ko'rinib turardi, toshlar ustida yorilganda, biroz bosim ostida, mayda purkagichga aylanib ketgandek edi.

en: As it came down into the little plain, it was there received into a fair channel and ran very swiftly into the middest thereof, where it formed a lakelet, such as the townsfolk made whiles, by way of ﬁshpond, in their gardens, whenas they have a commodity thereof.
uz: Kichkina tekislikka tushgach, u yerda go'zal kanalga qabul qilindi va uning o'rtasiga juda tez yugurdi, u yerda ko'lcha paydo bo'ldi, xuddi shahar aholisi o'z bog'larida baliq havzasi orqali g'ildirak yasagandek, chunki u yerda ularning tovarlari bor edi.

en: This lakelet was no deeper than a man’s stature, breast high, and its waters being exceeding clear and altogether untroubled with any admixture, it showed its bottom to be of a very ﬁne gravel, the grains whereof whoso had nought else to do might, an he would, have availed to number; nor, looking into the water, was the bottom alone to be seen, nay, but so many ﬁsh ﬂeeting hither and thither that, over and above the pleasure thereof, it was a marvel to behold; nor was it enclosed with other banks than the very soil of the meadow, which was the goodlier there- about in so much as it received the more of its moisture.
uz: Bu ko'ltiq odamning bo'yidan chuqurroq emas edi, ko'kraklari baland edi, suvlari juda tiniq va hech qanday aralashma bilan bezovta emas edi, u o'zining tubini juda nozik shag'aldan ekanligini ko'rsatdi, undan boshqa hech qanday kuchga ega bo'lmaganlar soniga ega bo'lishardi; suvga qarab, faqat tubini ko'rish mumkin emas edi, balki shunchalik ko'p baliqlar u yoqqa va bu yoqqa o'tib ketayotgan ediki, uning zavqidan tashqari, uni ko'rish ajoyib edi; va u o'tloqning tuprog'idan ko'ra boshqa qirg'oqlar bilan ham o'ralmagan edi, chunki u u yerda undan ko'proq namlikni oladi.

en: The water that abounded over and above the capacity of the lake was received into another channel, whereby, issuing forth of the little valley, it ran off into the lower parts.
uz: Ko'l sig'imidan ham ko'proq to'lib-toshgan suv boshqa kanalga qabul qilindi, shu orqali kichik vodiydan chiqib, quyi qismlarga oqib ketdi.

en: Hither then came the young ladies and after they had gazed all about and much commended the place, they took counsel together to bathe, for that the heat was great and that they saw the lakelet before them and were in no
uz: Keyin bu yerga yosh xonimlar kelishdi va atrofni ko'rib, joyni juda maqtashganlaridan so'ng, ular birga cho'milish uchun maslahatlashdilar, chunki issiqlik juda kuchli edi va ular oldinda ko'lmakni ko'rishdi va hech narsada emas edilar.

en: Accordingly, bidding their serving maid abide over against the way whereby one entered there and look if any should come and give them notice thereof, they stripped themselves naked, all seven, and entered the lake, which hid their white bodies no otherwise than as a thin glass would do with a vermeil rose.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xizmatkor qizlarini u yerga kiradigan yo'ldan narigi tomonga o'tishga va agar kimdir kelib, ularga bu haqda xabar berishini ko'rishga buyurdilar, ular yalang'och holda, hammasi yetti kishi bo'lib ko'lga kirishdi, ko'l esa ularning oq tanasini xuddi ingichka stakan ko'k bilan qiladiganidek yashirmas edi.

en: Then, they being therein and no troub- ling of the water ensuing thereof, they fell, as best they might, to faring hither and thither in pursuit of the ﬁsh, which had uneath where to hide themselves, and seeking to take them with the naked hand.
uz: So'ngra ular u yerda bo'lib, undan kelayotgan suvdan tashvishlanmay, baliqlarni qidirib, qo'llaridan kelganicha u yoqqa va bu yoqqa borishga tushdilar, chunki ularning yashirinadigan joyi yo'q edi va ularni yalang'och qo'l bilan ushlashni xohlashardi.

en: After they had abidden awhile in such joyous pastime and had taken some of the ﬁsh, they came forth of the lakelet and clad themselves anew.
uz: Ular shunday quvnoq vaqt o'tkazganlaridan va baliqlardan ushlaganlaridan so'ng, ko'ldan chiqib, o'zlarini yangidan kiydirishdi.

en: Then, unable to com- mend the place more than they had already done and themseeming time to turn homeward, they set out, with soft step, upon their way, discoursing much of the goodliness of the valley.
uz: Keyin, joyni allaqachon qilganlaridan ko'ra ko'proq ta'mirlay olmagach va uyga qaytish vaqti kelgandek tuyulgach, ular yumshoq qadamlar bilan yo'lga chiqdilar va vodiyning go'zalliklaridan ko'p narsalarni aytib o'tdilar.

en: They reached the palace betimes and there found the young men yet at play where they had left them; to whom quoth Pampinea, laughing.
uz: Ular saroyga yetib kelishdi va u yerda yosh yigitlar ularni tashlab ketgan joyda hali ham o'ynayotganini topishdi; ularga Pampiye kulgan holda javob berdi.

en: “We have e’en stolen a march on you today.” “How?” asked Dioneo.
uz: Biz bugun sizga yurishni ogirladik. Qanday qilib? deb soradi Dioneo.

en: “Do you begin to do deeds ere you come to say words?”341 “Ay, my lord,” answered she and related to him at large whence they came and how the place was fashioned and how far distant thence and that which they had done.
uz: So'z aytishga kelmasdan oldin amallarni qila boshlaysizmi? 341 Ha, xo'jayinim,  javob berdi u va unga qayerdan kelganliklarini, joy qanday shakllanganligini, u yerdan qanchalik uzoqda ekanligini va nima qilganliklarini batafsil aytib berdi.

en: The king, hearing tell of the goodliness of the place and desirous of seeing it, caused straightway order the supper, which being dispatched to the general satisfaction, the three young men, leaving the ladies, betook themselves with their servants to the valley and having viewed it in every part, for that none of them had ever been there before, extolled it for one of the goodliest things in the world.
uz: Shoh bu joyning go'zalligi haqida eshitib, uni ko'rishni istadi va darhol kechki ovqatni buyurdi. Bu kechki ovqat umumiy qoniqish uchun yuborildi. Uch yigit xonimlarni tashlab, xizmatkorlari bilan vodiyga borishdi va uni har bir qismida ko'rishdi, chunki ularning hech biri u yerda hech qachon bo'lmagan edi, uni dunyodagi eng yaxshi narsalardan biri deb maqtagan edi.

en: Then, for that it grew late, after they had bathed and donned their clothes, they returned home, where they found the ladies dan- cing a round, to the accompaniment of a song sung by Fiammetta.
uz: Keyin, shu sababli kech bo'ldi, ular cho'milib, kiyimlarini kiydirib bo'lgach, uyga qaytdilar va u yerda Fiammetta tomonidan kuylangan qo'shiq hamrohligida raqsga tushayotgan xonimlarni topdilar.

en: The dance ended, they entered with them into a discourse of the Ladies’ Valley and said much in praise and commendation thereof.
uz: Raqs tugab, ular ular bilan "Ayollar vodiysi" nutqiga kirishdi va uning maqtovi va maqtovi haqida ko'p gapirishdi.

en: Moreover, the king, sending for the seneschal, bade him look that the dinner be made ready there on the following morning and have sundry beds carried thither, in case any should have a mind to lie or sleep there for nooning; after which he let bring lights and wine and confections and the company having somedele refreshed themselves, he commanded that all should address themselves to dancing.
uz: Qolaversa, podshoh oqsoqolni chaqirib, unga ertaga ertalab u yerga kechki ovqat tayyorlanishini va u yerga turli xil karavotlar olib borilishini buyurdi, agar kimdir u yerda tunash uchun yotishga yoki uxlashga qaror qilsa; shundan so'ng u chiroqlar, vino va qandolatlarni olib kelishga ruxsat berdi va biroz dam olgach, hamma raqsga tushishga qaror qildi.

en: Then, Pamﬁlo having, at his commandment, set up a dance, the king turned to Elisa and said courteously to her, “Fair damsel, thou has today done me the honour of the crown and I purpose this evening
uz: Keyin, Pamfilo uning buyrug'iga ko'ra raqsga tushdi, shoh Elisaga o'girilib, unga xushmuomalalik bilan dedi: "Adolatli qiz, bugun menga toj sharafini ko'rsatding va bugun kechqurun maqsad qilaman."

en: to do thee that of the song; wherefore look thou sing such an one as most liketh thee.” Elisa answered, smiling, that she would well and with dulcet voice began on this wise: Love, from thy clutches could I but win free,  Hardly, methinks, again  Shall any other hook take hold on me.
uz: "Senga qo'shiqdagidek qilmoqchiman; shuning uchun senga eng yoqqanini kuyla." Elisa jilmayib javob berdi, u yaxshi ko'rardi va shirin ovozda shunday dedi: "Sevgi, men sening qo'ltiqlaringdan ozod bo'lishim mumkin edi, deyarli, hech qachon, yana meni boshqa hech qanday ilgak ushlay olmaydi."

en: I entered in thy wars a youngling maid,  Thinking thy strife was utmost peace and sweet,  And all my weapons on the ground I laid,  As one secure, undoubting of defeat;  But thou, false tyrant, with rapacious heat,  Didst fall on me amain  With all the grapnels of thine armoury.
uz: Men sening urushlaringga yosh qiz bo'lib kirdim, sening janjaling nihoyatda tinch va shirin deb o'ylardim, Va barcha qurollarimni yerga qo'ydim, Xavfsiz, mag'lubiyatga shubha yo'qdek; Lekin sen, soxta zolim, ochko'z issiqlik bilan, Menga hayrat bilan tushding, Barcha qurollaringning o'rmonlari bilan.

en: Then, wound about and fettered with thy chains,  To him, who for my death in evil hour  Was born, thou gav’st me, bounden, full of pains  And bitter tears; and syne within his power  He hath me and his rule’s so harsh and dour  No sighs can move the swain  Nor all my wasting plaints to set me free.
uz: So'ngra, o'ralgan va zanjirband bo'lib, yovuz soatda o'limim uchun tug'ilgan Zotga, meni bog'lab, og'riqlar va achchiq ko'z yoshlarga to'ldirding; va o'z qudratida meni va uning hukmronligi shunchalik qattiq va qat'iyki, Na ohlar o'rnini siljitadi Na barcha behuda shikoyatlarimni ozod qilish uchun.

en: My prayers, the wild winds bear them all away;  He hearkeneth unto none and none will hear;  Wherefore each hour my torment waxeth aye;  I cannot die, albeit life irks me drear.
uz: Duolarim, yovvoyi shamollar ularni hammasini olib ketadi; U hech kimga quloq solmaydi va hech kim eshitmaydi; Shuning uchun har soatda azobim kuchayadi; Men o'lay olmayman, garchi hayot meni g'azablantirsa ham.

en: Ah, Lord, have pity on my heavy cheer;  Do that I seek in vain  And give him bounden in thy chains to me.
uz: Oh, Rabbim, mening og'ir g'azabimga rahm qilgin; Men behuda izlagan narsani qilgin Va uni menga zanjirband qilib bergin.

en: An this thou wilt not, at the least undo  The bonds erewhen of hope that knitted were;  Alack, O Lord, thereof to thee I sue,  For, an thou do it, yet to waxen fair  Again I trust, as was my use whilere,  And being quit of pain  Myself with white ﬂowers and with red besee.
uz: Buni hech bo'lmaganda, to'qilgan umid bog'ichlarini yechmaysan; Yo'q, ey Rabbim, men Senga shikoyat qilaman, chunki, sen buni qilsang, yana go'zal bo'lishga ishonaman, xuddi o'zimda bo'lganidek, va o'zimni oq gullar va qizil bilan og'riqdan xalos bo'lishga.

en: Elisa ended her song with a very plaintive sigh, and albeit all marvelled at the words thereof, yet was there none who might conceive what it was that caused her sing thus.
uz: Elisa o'z qo'shig'ini juda achinarli oh bilan yakunladi va garchi uning so'zlaridan hamma hayratda bo'lsa ham, uning bunday kuylashiga nima sabab bo'lganini hech kim tasavvur qila olmasdi.

en: But the king, who was in a merry mood, calling for Tindaro, bade him bring out his bagpipes, to the sound whereof he let dance many dances; after which, a great part of the night being now past, he bade each go sleep.
uz: Ammo shoh, xursand kayfiyatda bo'lib, Tindaroga chaqirib, uni o'zining naychalarini olib chiqishni buyurdi, ularning ovoziga ko'p raqsga tushirdi; shundan so'ng, tunning katta qismi o'tib ketganidan so'ng, har bir kishini uxlashga buyurdi.

en: Here endeth the Sixth Day of the Decameron.
uz: Mana Dekameronning oltinchi kuni tugaydi.

en: DAY THE SEVENTH INTRODUCTION Here beginneth the seventh day of the Decameron wherein under the governance of Dioneo is discoursed of the tricks which or for love or for their own preservation women have heretofore played their husbands with or without the latter’s cognizance thereof.
uz: YETINCHINCHI KUN KIRISH Bu yerda Dekameronning yettinchi kuni boshlanadi, unda Dioneo hukmronligi davrida ayollar sevgi yoki o'zlarining himoyasi uchun erlarini bu haqda bilgan yoki bilmagan holda o'ynagan hiylalar haqida gapiriladi.

en: Every star was already ﬂed from the parts of the East, save only that which we style Lucifer and which shone yet in the whitening dawn, when the sen- eschal, arising, betook himself, with a great baggage-train, to the Ladies’ Valley, there to order everything, according to commandment had of his lord.
uz: Har bir yulduz Sharqning qismlaridan qochib ketgan edi, faqatgina biz "Lucifer" deb ataydigan va oqarib borayotgan tongda porlagan yulduz bundan mustasno, qachonki sen-eschal, ko'tarilib, katta yuk poyezdi bilan o'zini Ladies' vodiysiga olib borganida, u yerda xo'jayinidan bo'lgan buyruq bo'yicha hamma narsani tartibga solish uchun.

en: The king, whom the noise of the packers and of the beasts had awakened, tarried not long after his departure to rise and being risen, caused arouse all the ladies and likewise the young men; nor had the rays of the sun yet well broken forth, when they all entered upon the road.
uz: Qirol, uni to'quvchilar va hayvonlarning shovqini uyg'otgan edi, ketishidan ko'p o'tmay turdi va ko'tarildi, barcha xonimlarni ham, yigitlarni ham uyg'otdi; quyosh nurlari ham yetib bormagan edi, qachonki ularning hammasi yo'lga kirishgan edi.

en: Never yet had the nightingales and the other birds seemed to them to sing so blithely as they did that morning, what while, accompanied by their carols, they re- paired to the Ladies’ Valley, where they were received by many more, which seemed to them to make merry for their coming.
uz: Hech qachon bulbullar va boshqa qushlar o'sha kuni ertalabgidek shovqinli kuylashmagandek tuyulmagan edi. Shu bilan birga, ular o'z qo'shiqlari bilan birga Ladies' vodiysiga qayta qo'shilishdi, u yerda ularni yana ko'pchilik kutib olishdi, bu esa ularning kelishi bilan xursand qilishdi.

en: There, going round about the place and reviewing it all anew, it appeared to them so much fairer than on the foregoing day as the season of the day was more sorted to its goodliness.
uz: U yerda aylanib, hamma narsani yangidan ko'rib chiqib, ularga o'tgan kundagidan ancha go'zal ko'rindi, chunki kun fasli uning go'zalligiga ko'proq moslashtirilgan edi.

en: Then, after they had broken their fast with good wine and confections, not to be behindhand with the birds in the matter of song, they fell a-singing and the valley with them, still echoing those same songs which they did sing, whereto all the birds, as if they would not be outdone, added new and dulcet notes.
uz: Keyin, ular yaxshi vino va shirinliklar bilan ro'zalarini uzganlaridan so'ng, qo'shiq masalasida qushlar bilan orqada qolmaslik uchun, ular qo'shiq aytishdi va vodiy o'zlari bilan birga o'sha qo'shiqlarni yangradilar, go'yo ulardan ustun bo'lmagandek, barcha qushlar yangi va shirin notalar qo'shdilar.

en: Presently, the dinner-hour being come and the tables spread hard by the fair lakelet under the thickset laurels and other goodly trees, they seated themselves there, as it pleased the king, and eat- ing, watched the ﬁsh swim in vast shoals about the lake, which gave by-
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda kechki ovqat vaqti keldi va stollar go'zal ko'l bo'ylab, quyuq lavr va boshqa yaxshi daraxtlar ostida qattiq tarqaldi. Ular o'zlari o'tirdilar, podshohga yoqqanidek, va ovqatlanib, baliqlarning ko'l atrofida katta ko'llarda suzishini tomosha qilishdi, bu esa...

en: times occasion for talk as well as observation.
uz: vaqtlar suhbat va kuzatish uchun imkoniyatdir.

en: When they had made an end of dining and the meats and tables were removed, they fell anew to singing more blithely than ever; after which, beds having been spread in various places about the little valley and all enclosed about by the discreet sen- eschal with curtains and canopies of French serge, whoso would might with the king’s permission, go sleep; whilst those who had no mind to sleep might at their will take pleasure of their other wonted pastimes.
uz: Ovqatlanish tugagach, go'shtlar va stollar olib tashlangandan so'ng, ular yana har qachongidan ham shiddatliroq kuylashga tushdilar; shundan so'ng, kichik vodiy atrofida turli joylarda to'shaklar tarqaldi va ularning barchasi sirpanchiq fransuz serjlarining pardalari va tomchilari bilan o'raldi, kimki podshohning ruxsatisiz uyquga ketmoqchi bo'lsa, uxlashga umidi bo'lmasa, o'zining boshqa mashg'ulotlaridan zavqlanardi.

en: But, after awhile, all being now arisen and the hour come when they should assemble together for story-telling, carpets were, at the king’s commandment, spread upon the grass, not far from the place where they had eaten, and all having seated themselves thereon hard by the lake, the king bade Emilia begin; whereupon she blithely proceeded to speak, smiling, thus:
uz: Ammo, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, hamma o'rnidan turdi va ular birga hikoya qilish uchun yig'ilishlari kerak bo'lgan soat keldi. Shohning buyrug'iga ko'ra, gilamlar o't ustida, ular ovqatlangan joydan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan joyda tarqaldi va hamma o'sha yerda ko'l bo'yida qattiq o'tirganidan so'ng, shoh Emiliyani boshlashni buyurdi; shundan so'ng u bemalol gapirishga kirishdi, shunday tabassum qildi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Gianni Lotteringhi heareth knock at his door by night and awakeneth his wife, who giveth him to believe that it is a phantom; whereupon they go to exorcise it with a certain orison and the knocking ceaseth.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Gianni Lotteringhi kechasi uning eshigini taqillatib eshitadi va xotini uni uyg'otadi, u unga bu arvoh ekanligiga ishontiradi; shundan so'ng ular uni ma'lum bir nido bilan quvishga borishadi va taqillash to'xtaydi.

en: “My Lord, it had been very agreeable to me, were such your pleasure, that other than I should have given a beginning to so goodly a matter as is that whereof we are to speak; but, since it pleaseth you that I give all the other ladies assurance by my example, I will gladly do it.
uz: Ey Rabbim, agar Sening roziliging bo'lganida, mendan boshqa, biz gapiradigan yaxshi ishning boshlanishiga yo'l qo'ygan bo'lardim; lekin, senga boshqa barcha ayollarga o'z misolim bilan ishontirishim yoqqanligi sababli, men buni xursandchilik bilan qilaman.

en: Moreover, dearest ladies, I will study to tell a thing that may be useful to you in time to come, for that, if you others are as fearful as I, and especially of phantoms, (though what manner of thing they may be God knoweth I know not, nor ever found I any woman who knew it, albeit all are alike adread of them), you may, by noting well my story, learn a holy and goodly orison of great virtue for the conjuring them away, should they come to you.
uz: Qolaversa, aziz xonimlar, men kelajakda sizga foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan bir narsani aytib berishni o'rganaman, shunda, agar siz boshqalar ham men kabi qo'rqoq bo'lsangiz, ayniqsa arvohlardan (ularning qanday turdagi ekanligini Xudo bilmasa ham, hech qachon buni biladigan ayol topmadim, garchi ularning barchasi bir xil bo'lsa ham), siz mening hikoyamni yaxshilab eslab, ularni siz tomon kelganda, ularni yo'q qilish uchun muqaddas va yaxshi fazilatni o'rganishingiz mumkin.

en: There was once in Florence, in the quarter of San Brancazio, a wool- comber called Gianni Lotteringhi, a man more fortunate in his craft than wise in other things, for that, savoring of the simpleton, he was very often made captain of the Laudsingers342 of Santa Maria Novella and had the governance of their confraternity, and he many a time had other little ofﬁces of the same kind, upon which he much valued himself.
uz: Bir vaqtlar Florensiyada, San-Brankazio kvartalida, Gianni Lotteringhi ismli jun ustasi bor edi. U o'z ishida boshqa narsalarda dono bo'lishidan ko'ra omadliroq odam edi. Shuning uchun u soddalikdan bahramand bo'lib, Santa Maria Novella'ning Laudsingers342 kompaniyasiga juda ko'p marta kapitan qilib tayinlanardi va ularning birodarligi boshqaruviga ega edi. U ko'p vaqtlar xuddi shu turdagi boshqa kichik lavozimlarga ega bo'lardi, ularga o'zini juda qadrlardi.

en: This betided him for that, being a man of substance, he gave many a good pittance to the clergy, who, getting of him often, this a pair of hose, that a gown and another a scapulary, taught him in return store of goodly orisons and gave him the pa- ternoster in the vulgar tongue, the Song of Saint Alexis, the Lamentations of Saint Bernard, the Canticles of Madam Matilda and the like trumpery, all which he held very dear and kept very diligently for his soul’s health.
uz: Bu uni shunga ishontirdi, chunki u moddiy inson bo'lganligi sababli ruhoniylarga ko'p yaxshi narsa berdi. Ruhoniylar undan ko'p marta, bu shlang, bu ko'ylak va yana bir ayyorlik, yaxshi so'zlar o'rgatdi va unga g'alati tildagi pa- ternoster, Avliyo Aleksis qo'shig'i, Avliyo Bernardning motamlari, Madam Matilda qo'shiqlari va shunga o'xshash g'am-g'ochoqlarni berishdi. Bularning barchasini u juda qadrlardi va o'z sog'lig'i uchun juda diqqat bilan saqlardi.

en: Now he had a very fair and lovesome lady to wife, by name Mistress Tessa, who
uz: Endi uning juda go'zal va yoqimli rafiqasi bor edi, uning ismi Tessa xonim edi, u...

en: was the daughter of Mannuccio dalla Cuculia and was exceeding discreet and well advised.
uz: Mannuccio dalla Cuculia ning qizi edi va juda ehtiyotkor va yaxshi maslahat berilgan edi.

en: She, knowing her husband’s simplicity and being enam- oured of Federigo di Neri Pegolotti, a brisk and handsome youth, and he of her, took order with a serving-maid of hers that he should come speak with her at a very goodly country house which her husband had at Camerata, where she sojourned all the summer and whither Gianni came whiles to sup and sleep, returning in the morning to his shop and bytimes to his Laudsingers.
uz: U, erining soddaligini bilgan va Federigo di Neri Pegolottiga, uning o'ziga xos yigitga va unga yaqin bo'lganligi sababli, xizmatkor xodimiga u bilan Camerata'da joylashgan juda yaxshi qishloq uyida gaplashishni buyurdi, u yerda u butun yozni o'tkazdi va Gianni kechki ovqat va uxlash uchun kelgan joyda, ertalab do'koniga va vaqti-vaqti bilan uning Laudsingerlariga qaytdi.

en: Federigo, who desired this beyond measure, taking his opportunity, re- paired thither on the day appointed him towards vespers and Gianni not coming thither that evening, supped and lay the night in all ease and delight with the lady, who, being in his arms, taught him that night a good half dozen of her husband’s lauds.
uz: Federigo, buni haddan tashqari xohlagan holda, imkoniyatidan foydalanib, o'sha kuni u yerga qayta qo'shildi, uni kechki ovqatga tayinladi va Gianni u yerga kelmaslikka qaror qildi. U kechqurun xonim bilan bemalol va rohat uxladi, xonim uning qo'lida bo'lib, o'sha kecha unga erining yarim o'nlab qo'shiqlarini o'rgatdi.

en: Then, neither she nor Federigo purposing that this should be the last, as it had been the ﬁrst time [of their foregathering], they took order together on this wise, so it should not be needful to send the maid for him each time, to wit, that every day, as he came and went to and from a place he had a little farther on, he should keep his eye on a vineyard that adjoined the house, where he would see an ass’s skull set up on one of the vine poles, which whenas he saw with the muzzle turned towards Florence, he should without fail and in all assurance betake himself to her that evening after dark; and if he found the door shut he should knock softly thrice and she would open to him; but that, whenas he saw the ass’s muzzle turned towards Fiesole, he should not come, for that Gianni would be there; and doing on this wise, they foregathered many a time.
uz: Keyin, na u, na Federigo bu oxirgi bo'lishini niyat qilmadi, chunki bu birinchi marta bo'lgan edi, ular shu yo'l bilan birga buyurtma berishdi, shuning uchun har safar unga xizmatkorni yuborish zarur bo'lmasligi kerak edi, ya'ni, har kuni u kelgan va borgan joyda, u biroz uzoqroq joyda bo'lgan joyda, u uyga tutash bo'lgan tokzorga ko'z tikishi kerak edi, u yerda u tok ustunlaridan biriga eshakning bosh suyagi o'rnatilganini ko'rardi, u burun bilan Florensiya tomon burilganini ko'rganda, u shu oqshomdan keyin o'zini unga bemalol va butun ishonch bilan yopishi kerak edi; va agar eshikni topsa, u uch marta yumshoq taqilsa va u unga ochardi; lekin, u eshakni ko'rganda, u burun tomonga burun, u uchun kelmasligi kerak edi, chunki u...

en: But once, amongst other times, it chanced that, Federigo being one night to sup with Mistress Tessa and she having let cook two fat capons, Gianni, who was not expected there that night, came thither very late, whereat the lady was much chagrined and having supped with her husband on a piece of salt pork, which she had let boil apart, caused the maid wrap the two boiled capons in a white napkin and carry them, together with good store of new- laid eggs and a ﬂask of good wine, into a garden she had, whither she could go, without passing through the house, and where she was wont to sup whiles with her lover, bidding her lay them at the foot of a peach-tree that grew beside a lawn there.
uz: Ammo bir safar, boshqa vaqtlar orasida, Federigo bir kecha Tessa xonim bilan kechki ovqatda bo'lib, u ikki semiz kapyushonni pishirishga ruxsat bergan edi. O'sha kecha u yerda kutilmagan Gianni u yerga juda kech keldi. Xonim juda xafa bo'lib, eriga bir bo'lak tuzli cho'chqa go'shtini bergan edi, uni qaynatganidan so'ng, xizmatchi qiz ikki qaynatilgan kapyushonni oq salfetkaga o'rab olib, yangi tuxum va bir banka yaxshi vino bilan birga u yotadigan bog'ga olib kirdi. U yerda u uydan o'tmasdan borishi mumkin edi va u yerda sevgilisi bilan birga shaftoli daraxtga yotqizdi.

en: But such was her trouble and annoy that she re- membered not to bid the maid wait till Federigo should come and tell him that Gianni was there and that he should take the viands from the garden; wherefore, she and Gianni betaking themselves to bed and the maid like-
uz: Lekin uning muammosi va g'azabi shu darajada ediki, u xizmatkorga Federigo kelib, unga Gianni borligini va u bog'dan go'shtni olishi kerakligini aytguncha, uni kutmaslikka qaror qildi; shuning uchun, u va Gianni o'zlarini to'shakka qo'yishdi va xizmatkorga o'xshab...

en: wise, it was not long before Federigo came to the door and knocked softly once.
uz: Aqlli, Federigo eshik oldiga kelib, bir marta sekin taqillatgani ko'p emas edi.

en: The door was so near to the bedchamber that Gianni heard it incontin- ent, as also did the lady; but she made a show of being asleep, so her hus- band might have no suspicion of her.
uz: Eshik yotoqxonaga shunchalik yaqin ediki, Gianni uni eshitdi, xonim ham xuddi shunday eshitdi; lekin u uxlayotganini ko'rsatdi, shunda uning xotini unga hech qanday shubha qilmasligi kerak edi.

en: After waiting a little, Federigo knocked a second time, whereupon Gianni, marvelling, nudged his wife somewhat and said, ‘Tessa, hearest thou what I hear?
uz: Biroz kutgandan so'ng, Federigo ikkinchi marta taqillatdi, shundan so'ng Gianni hayrat bilan xotiniga biroz itarildi va dedi: Tessa, men eshitayotgan narsani eshityapsanmi?

en: Meseemeth there is a knocking at our door.’ The lady, who had heard it much better than he, made a show of awaking and said, ‘Eh?
uz: Eshikimizga taqillatish eshitilyapti. Undan ko'ra ancha yaxshiroq eshitgan xonim uyg'onish ko'rinishini ko'rsatib, dedi: Ha?

en: How sayst thou?’ ‘I say,’ answered Gianni, ‘that meseemeth there is a knocking at our door.’ ‘Knocking!’ cried she.
uz: Qanday deysan? Men aytaman,  javob berdi Gianni, ki eshigimizda taqillatish bor ekan. Taqillatish! deb baqirdi u.

en: ‘Alack, Gianni mine, knowst thou not what it is?
uz: Alack, Gianni, bu nima ekanligini bilmaysanmi?

en: It is a phantom, that hath these last few nights given me the greatest fright that ever was, insomuch that, whenas I hear it, I put my head under the clothes and dare not bring it out again until it is broad day.’ Quoth Gianni, ‘Go to, wife; have no fear, if it be so; for I said the Te Lucis and the Intemerata and such and such other pious orisons, before we lay down, and crossed the bed from side to side, in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Ghost, so that we have no need to fear, for that, what power soever it have, it cannot avail to harm us.’ The lady, fearing lest Federigo should perchance suspect otherwhat and be angered with her, determined at all hazards to arise and let him know that Gianni was there; wherefore quoth she to her husband, ‘That is all very well; thou sayst thy words, thou; but, for my part, I shall never hold myself safe nor secure, except we exorcise
uz: Bu shunday bir arvohki, so'nggi bir necha kechalar menga eng katta qo'rquv berdi, shundayki, uni eshitganimda, boshimni kiyim ostiga qo'yib, kunduzgacha uni yana chiqarishga jur'at etmayman." Quoth Gianni, "Bor, xotin; agar shunday bo'lsa, qo'rqma; chunki men Te Lucis va Intemerata va shunga o'xshash boshqa taqvodor yokizonlarni aytdim, biz yotishdan oldin, va otaning, O'g'ilning va Muqaddas Ruhning nomi bilan yonma-yon to'shakni kesib o'tdik, shuning uchun qo'rqishga hojat yo'q, chunki u qanday kuchga ega bo'lsa ham, bizga zarar yetkazmaydi." Xonim, qo'rqib, boshqa gumon qilish va undan g'azablanish kerak edi, chunki u hech qachon o'zini xavfsiz tutmas edi, lekin men uni hech qachon...

en: it, since thou art here.’ ‘And how is it to be exorcised?’ asked he; and she, ‘I know full well how to exorcise it; for, the other day, when I went to the Pardon at Fiesole, a certain anchoress (the very holiest of creatures, Gianni mine, God only can say how holy she is), seeing me thus fearful, taught me a pious and effectual orison and told me that she had made trial of it several times, ere she became a recluse, and that it had always availed her.
uz: Shunday, chunki sen shu yerdasan. Va qanday qilib jonni chiqarish kerak? deb so'radi u; va u: Men uni qanday jonni chiqarishni yaxshi bilaman; chunki, bir kun avval, men Fiesoledagi Pardonga borganimda, ma'lum bir langar (eng muqaddas mavjudotlar, mening Gianni, faqat Xudo aytishi mumkin, u qanchalik muqaddas), meni shunday qo'rqoq holda ko'rib, menga bir necha marta sinovdan o'tkazganini va bu unga doimo foydali bo'lganini aytdi.

en: God knoweth I should never have dared go alone to make proof of it; but, now that thou art here, I would have us go exorcise the phantom.’ Gianni answered that he would well and accordingly they both arose and went softly to the door, without which Federigo, who now began to mis- doubt him of somewhat, was yet in waiting.
uz: Xudo biladi, men hech qachon buni isbotlash uchun yolg'iz borishga jur'at etmagan bo'lardim; lekin, sen shu yerda bo'lganing uchun, bizdan arvohni haydab chiqarishni xohlardim." Gianni javob berdi: "Yaxshi bo'lardi va shunga ko'ra ikkalasi ham o'rnidan turishdi va sekin eshik tomon borishdi, u holda Federigo, endi uni biroz shubhalana boshlagan, hali ham kutardi."

en: When they came thither, the lady said to Gianni, ‘Do thou spit, whenas I shall bid thee.’ And he answered, ‘Good.’ Then she began the conjuration and said, ‘Phantom, phantom that goest by night, with tail upright343 thou cam’st to us; now get
uz: Ular u yerga yetib kelganlarida, xonim Gianniga dedi: Shu tug'asanmi, men senga buyurganimdek. U javob berdi: Yaxshi. Shunda u sehrlashni boshladi va dedi:  arvoh, tun bo'yi yuradigan arvoh, dum tik turib 343 sen bizga kelding; endi

en: thee gone with tail upright.
uz: Sen dumingni tik qilib ketding.

en: Begone into the garden to the foot of the great peach tree; there shalt thou ﬁnd an anointed twice-anointed one344 and an hundred turds of my sitting hen;345 set thy mouth to the ﬂagon and get thee gone again and do thou no hurt to my Gianni nor to me.’ Then to her hus- band, ‘Spit, Gianni,’ quoth she, and he spat.
uz: Bog'ga katta shaftoli daraxti etagiga kiring; u yerda ikki marta moylangan bir 344 ta va o'tirgan tovuqlarimning yuz turini topasiz; 345 og'zingni qadahga qo'yib, yana ket va mening Gianniga ham, menga ham hech qanday zarar yetkazma.

en: Federigo, who heard all this from without and was now quit of jealousy, had, for all his vexation, so great a mind to laugh that he was like to burst, and when Gianni spat, he said under his breath ‘[Would it were] thy teeth!’ The lady, having thrice conjured the phantom on this wise, returned to bed with her husband, whilst Federigo, who had not supped, looking to sup with her, and had right well apprehended the words of the conjuration, betook himself to the garden and ﬁnding the capons and wine and eggs at the foot of the great peach-tree, carried them off to his house and there supped at his ease; and after, when he next foregathered with the lady, he had a hearty laugh with her anent the conjuration aforesaid.
uz: Federigo, bularning hammasini tashqaridan eshitib, endi rashkdan xalos bo'lgan edi, butun g'azabidan kulishga shunchalik katta aql bor ediki, u xuddi otilib ketgandek edi, va Gianni tupurganida, u nafas ostida dedi: Sening tishlaring bo'lardi-da! Xonim, bu yo'l bilan uch marta arvohni sehrlab, eri bilan yotdi, Federigo esa unga yordam bermagan edi, u bilan birga kechki ovqatni kutmoqchi edi va fitnaning so'zlarini yaxshi tushunib yetgan edi, o'zini bog'ga qaratib, katta shaftoli daraxtidan kepkalar, vino va tuxumlarni topdi, ularni uyiga olib bordi va u yerda o'z xohishida edi; va keyin, u xonim bilan birga bo'lganida, u uning yordamida yurakli kulgiga ega edi.

en: Some say in- deed that the lady had actually turned the ass’s skull towards Fiesole, but that a husbandman, passing through the vineyard, had given it a blow with a stick and caused it spin round and it had become turned towards Florence, wherefore Federigo, thinking himself summoned, had come thither, and that the lady had made the conjuration on this wise: ‘Phantom, phantom, get thee gone in God’s name; for it was not I turned the ass’s head; but another it was, God put him to shame!
uz: Ba'zilar aytishicha, xonim aslida eshakning bosh suyagini Fiesole tomonga burgan edi, lekin uzumzordan o'tayotgan bir dehqon unga tayoq urib aylantirib Florensiya tomon burilgan edi, shuning uchun Federigo o'zi chaqirilgan deb o'ylab, u yerga kelgan edi va xonim shunday so'zlagan edi: "Fantom, fantom, seni Xudo nomi bilan yo'q qil, chunki men eshakning boshini burmadim; lekin bu boshqa edi, Xudo uni sharmanda qildi!"

en: and I am here with my Gianni in bed’; whereupon he went away and abode without supper or lodging.
uz: va men bu yerda Gianni bilan to'shakda; shundan so'ng u ketib, kechki ovqat va tunashsiz qoldi.

en: But a neighbour of mine, a very ancient lady, telleth me that, according to that which she heard, when a child, both the one and the other were true; but that the latter happened, not to Gianni Lotteringhi, but to one Gianni di Nello, who abode at Porta San Piero and was no less exquisite a ninny than the other.
uz: Lekin bir qo'shnim, juda qadimgi xonim menga aytdiki, bolaligida eshitganlariga ko'ra, ikkalasi ham rost edi; lekin bu oxirgi narsa Gianni Lotteringhi bilan emas, balki Porta San Pieroda yashovchi va boshqalardan kam bo'lmagan nozik Gianni di Nello bilan sodir bo'lgan.

en: Wherefore, dear my ladies, it abideth at your election to take whether of the two orisons most pleaseth you, except you will have both.
uz: Shunday ekan, aziz xonimlar, siz tanlagan holda, sizga eng yoqadigan ikki xil maskanni tanlashingiz kerak, aks holda ikkalasi ham bo'ladi.

en: They have great virtue in such cases, as you have had proof in the story you have heard; get them, therefore, by heart and they may yet avail you.”
uz: Ularning bunday holatlarda buyuk fazilatlari bor, chunki siz eshitgan hikoyada dalilga ega bo'ldingiz; shuning uchun ularni yoddan oling, shunda ular sizga hali ham foyda keltirishi mumkin.

en: THE SECOND STORY Peronella hideth a lover of hers in a vat, upon her husband’s unlooked for return, and hearing from the latter that he hath sold the vat, avoucheth herself to have sold it to one who is presently therewithin, to see if it be sound; whereupon the gallant, jumping out of the vat, causeth the husband scrape it out for him and after carry it home to his house.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Peronella erining qaytib kelishini kutmagan holda, o'z sevgilisini idishga yashiradi va eridan idishni sotganini eshitib, u yerda hozir bo'lgan odamga sotgan bo'lishiga qasd qiladi, u sog'lommi yoki yo'qmi, shuni ko'rish uchun; shundan so'ng, bahodir idishdan sakrab chiqib, erini uni u uchun qirib chiqarib, keyin uyiga olib ketadi.

en: Emilia’s story was received with loud laughter and the conjuration com- mended of all as goodly and excellent; and this come to an end, the king bade Filostrato follow on, who accordingly began, “Dearest ladies, so many are the tricks that men, and particularly husbands, play you, that, if some woman chance whiles to put a cheat upon her husband, you should not only be blithe that this hath happened and take pleasure in coming to know it or hearing it told of any, but should yourselves go telling it everywhere, so men may understand that, if they are knowing, women, on their part, are no less so!
uz: Emiliya hikoyasi baland kulgi bilan qabul qilindi va barcha yaxshi va a'lo darajada g'aroyiblik qildi; va bu yakunlandi, shoh Filostratga ergashishni buyurdi, u shunga mos ravishda boshladi: "Aziz ayollar, erkaklar, ayniqsa erlar, sizni o'ynaydigan hiylalar shunchalik ko'pki, agar biror ayol eriga xiyonat qilish uchun tasodif qilsa, bu sodir bo'lganidan xursand bo'lishingiz va buni bilishdan yoki haqida eshitishdan zavq olishingiz kerak emas, balki o'zingiz ham bu haqda hamma joyga aytib yurishingiz kerak, shunda erkaklar tushunishlari mumkinki, agar ular bilsalar, ayollar, o'z navbatida, kam emas!

en: the which cannot be other than useful unto you, for that, when one knoweth that another is on the alert, he setteth himself not overlightly to cozen him.
uz: Sizga foydali bo'lishdan boshqa hech narsa bo'lmaydi, chunki kimdir boshqa birov hushyor ekanligini bilsa, uni juda yengil tortishga tayyor bo'lmaydi.

en: Who, then, can doubt but that which we shall say today con- cerning this matter, coming to be known of men, may be exceeding effectu- al in restraining them from cozening you ladies, whenas they ﬁnd that you likewise know how to cozen, an you will?
uz: Xo'sh, kim shubha qila oladi, lekin bugun bu masala bo'yicha aytayotgan gaplarimiz, odamlar tomonidan ma'lum bo'lishi mumkin, ularni siz xonimlar bilan jinsiy aloqa qilishdan tiyishda juda samarali bo'lishi mumkin, chunki ular siz ham jinsiy aloqa qilishni bilasiz, shundaymi?

en: I purpose, therefore, to tell you the trick which, on the spur of the moment, a young woman, albeit she was of mean condition, played her husband for her own preservation.
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga shunday hiylani aytib bermoqchimanki, bir zumda bir yosh ayol, garchi ahvoli yomon bo'lsa ham, o'z himoyasi uchun erini o'ynadi.

en: In Naples no great while agone there was a poor man who took to wife a fair and lovesome damsel called Peronella, and albeit he with his craft, which was that of a mason, and she by spinning, earned but a slender pit- tance, they ordered their life as best they might.
uz: Neapol shahrida bir bechora odam bor edi, u Peronella ismli go'zal va yoqimli bir xonimni xotinlikka oldi. U o'z hunari bilan, masonsimonlik bilan shug'ullangan bo'lsa-da, u aylanib, ingichka chuqurcha topgan bo'lsa-da, ular o'z hayotlarini imkon qadar tartibga soladilar.

en: It chanced one day that a young gallant of the neighbourhood saw this Peronella and she pleasing him
uz: Bir kuni mahalladagi bir yosh zodagon Peronellani ko'rib, uni xursand qildi.

en: mightily, he fell in love with her and importuned her one way and another till he became familiar with her and they took order with each other on this wise, so they might be together; to wit, seeing that her husband arose every morning betimes to go to work or to ﬁnd work, they agreed that the young man should be whereas he might see him go out, and that, as soon as he was gone —the street where she abode, which was called Avorio, being very sol- itary —he should come to her house.
uz: U kuchli tarzda unga oshiq bo'lib qoldi va uni bir-biriga qiziqtirdi, toki u bilan tanish bo'lmaguncha va ular bir-birlari bilan shu yo'l bilan kelishdi, toki ular birga bo'lishsin; xususan, erining har kuni ertalab ishga borish yoki ish topish uchun turishini ko'rib, yigit uni ko'rsa, u chiqib ketishi mumkin deb kelishdi va u ketishi bilanoq  u yashaydigan ko'cha, u juda oson edi  u uning uyiga kelishi kerak edi.

en: On this wise they did many times; but one morning, the good man having gone out and Giannello Strignario (for so was the lover named) having entered the house and being with Peronella, it chanced that, after awhile, the husband returned home, whereas it was his wont to be abroad all day, and ﬁnding the door locked within, knocked and after fell a-saying in himself, ‘O my God, praised be Thou ever!
uz: Shu yo'l bilan ular buni ko'p marta qilishdi; lekin bir kuni ertalab, yaxshi odam chiqib, Giannello Strignario (shuning uchun oshiq shunday nomlangan) uyga kirib, Peronella bilan bo'lganidan so'ng, biroz vaqt o'tgach, er uyiga qaytib keldi, garchi u butun kun davomida chet elda bo'lish odati bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, eshikni ichkarida qulflab turganini ko'rib, taqilladi va keyin o'ziga dedi: "Ey Xudoyim, Senga hamd bo'lsin!"

en: For, though Thou hast made me poor, at least Thou hast comforted me with a good and honest damsel to wife.
uz: Garchi Sen meni kambag'al qilding, hech bo'lmaganda meni yaxshi va halol xotin bilan ovutding.

en: See how she locked the door within as soon as I was gone out, so none might enter to do her any annoy.’ Peronella, knowing her husband by his way of knocking, said to her lov- er, ‘Alack, Giannello mine, I am a dead woman!
uz: "Men chiqib ketishim bilanoq, u eshikni ichkariga qanday qulflaganini ko'ring, shunda hech kim unga hech qanday bezovta qilish uchun kirmasin." Peronella erini uning taqillatish usuli bilan tanigan holda, sevgilisiga dedi: "Alack, Giannello mening, men o'lik ayolman!"

en: For here is my husband, whom God confound, come back and I know not what this meaneth, for never yet came he back hither at this hour; belike he saw thee whenas thou enteredst here.
uz: Mana, Xudo xijolat qilgan erim qaytib keldi, bu nimani anglatishini bilmayman, chunki u hali bu yerga bu soatga qaytib kelmadi; go'yo seni bu yerga kirganingda ko'rgandek bo'ldi.

en: But, for the love of God, however the case may be, get thee into yonder vat, whilst I go open to him, and we shall see what is the mean- ing of his returning home so early this morning.’ Accordingly, Giannello betook himself in all haste into the vat, whilst Peronella, going to the door, opened to her husband and said to him, with an angry air, ‘What is to do now, that thou returnest home so soon this morning?
uz: Lekin, Xudoning muhabbati uchun, qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, o'zingni u yerga kir, men esa unga ochilgunimcha, va biz uning bugun ertalab uyga qaytishining ma'nosini ko'ramiz." Shunga ko'ra, Giannello shoshilinch ravishda o'zini uyga kirdi, Peronella esa eshikga borar ekan, eriga ochdi va g'azablangan holda dedi: "Endi nima qilmoq kerak, bugun ertalab uyga tezroq qaytasan?"

en: Meseemeth thou hast a mind to do nought today, that I see thee come back, tools in hand; and if thou do thus, on what are we to live?
uz: Nahotki bugun hech narsa qilmoqchi bo'lsang, men seni qo'lda asboblar bilan qaytib kelganingni ko'rsam; va agar shunday qilsang, biz nimaga yashaymiz?

en: Whence shall we get bread?
uz: Biz qachon non olamiz?

en: Thinkest thou I will suffer thee pawn my gown and my other poor clothes?
uz: Sizningcha, men senga ko'ylagimni va boshqa bechora kiyimlarimni sotishga ruxsat beramanmi?

en: I, who do nothing but spin day and night, till the ﬂesh is come apart from my nails, so I may at the least have so much oil as will keep our lamp burning!
uz: Men, kun bo'yi va tun bo'yi faqat aylanib yuradigan, go'sht tirnoqlarimdan uzilgunga qadar, hech bo'lmaganda chiroqimizni yonib turadigan yog'ga ega bo'lishim uchun!

en: Husband, husband, there is not a neighbour’s wife of ours but marvelleth thereat and maketh mock of me for the pains I give myself and all that I endure; and thou, thou returnest home to me, with thy hands a-dangle, whenas thou shouldst be at work.’ So saying, she fell a-weeping and went on to say, ‘Alack, woe is me, un- happy woman that I am!
uz: Er, er, qo'shnimizning xotini yo'q, lekin u menga hayratda qoladi va men bergan azoblar va bardosh bergan barcha narsalar uchun meni masxara qiladi; va sen uyingga qaytasan, qo'llaring bilan, ishda bo'lishing kerak bo'lganda." Shunday deb, u yig'lab yubordi va davom etdi: "Voy, menga, baxtsiz ayolga!"

en: In what an ill hour was I born, at what an ill mo- ment did I come hither!
uz: Qanday yomon soatda tug'ildim, qanday yomon zamonda bu yerga keldim!

en: I who might have had a young man of such worth
uz: Men bunday qimmatli yigitga ega bo'lgan bo'lardim.

en: and would none of him, so I might come to this fellow here, who taketh no thought to her whom he hath brought home!
uz: va undan hech kimni xohlamasdim, toki men bu yerdagi bu odamga kelsam, u uyga olib kelgan ayol haqida hech qanday o'ylamaydi!

en: Other women give themselves a good time with their lovers, for there is none [I know] but hath two and some three, and they enjoy themselves and show their husbands the moon for the sun.
uz: Boshqa ayollar sevgilisi bilan yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishadi, chunki ularning ikki va uchtalaridan boshqa hech kim yo'q, ular o'zlarini xursand qilishadi va erlariga quyosh uchun oyni ko'rsatishadi.

en: But I, wretch that I am!
uz: Lekin men, qanday ham bechora!

en: because I am good and occupy myself not with such toys, I suffer ill and ill hap.
uz: Chunki men yaxshi odamman va o'zimni bunday o'yinchoqlar bilan mashg'ul qilmayman, men kasal va yomon azob chekaman.

en: I know not why I do not take me a lover, as do other women.
uz: Nega boshqa ayollar kabi o'zimni ham oshiq deb bilmasligimni bilmayman.

en: Understand well, husband mine, that had I a mind to do ill, I could soon enough ﬁnd the wherewithal, for there be store of brisk young fellows who love me and wish me well and have sent to me, proffering money galore or dresses and jewels, at my choice; but my heart would never suffer me to do it, for that I was no mother’s daughter of that ilk; and here thou comest home to me, whenas thou shouldst be at work.’ ‘Good lack, wife,’ answered the husband, ‘fret not thyself, for God’s sake; thou shouldst be assured that I know what manner of woman thou art, and indeed this morning I have in part had proof thereof.
uz: Tushuning-chi, erim, men yomonlik qilish niyatida edim, men tez orada shunday narsani topishim mumkin edi, chunki meni yaxshi ko'radigan, menga yaxshilik tilaydigan va menga pul, ko'ylak va javohirlar taklif qilib, o'z xohishimga ko'ra jo'natgan yosh yigitlarning do'koni bor edi; lekin yuragim menga buni qilishga yo'l qo'ymagan edi, chunki men o'sha paytdagi onamning qizi emas edim; va mana sen uyimga kelding, sen ishda bo'lsang.

en: It is true that I went out to go to work; but it seemeth thou knowest not, as I myself knew not, that this is the Feast-day of San Galeone and there is no work doing; that is why I am come back at this hour; but none the less I have provided and found a means how we shall have bread for more than a month, for I have sold yonder man thou seest here with me the vat which, as thou know- est, hath this long while cumbered the house; and he is to give me ﬁve lily- ﬂorins346 for it.’ Quoth Peronella, ‘So much the more cause have I to com- plain; thou, who art a man and goest about and should be versed in the things of the world, thou hast sold a vat for ﬁve ﬂorins, whilst I, a poor silly woman who hath scarce ever been without the door, seeing the hindrance it gave us in the house, have sold it for seven to an honest man, who entered it but now, as thou camest back, to see if it were sound!’
uz: Rostini aytsam, men ishga ketdim; lekin sen bilmasang shekilli, xuddi o'zim bilmaganimdek, bu San Galeone bayrami va ish bo'lmaydi; shuning uchun men shu soatda qaytib keldim; lekin shunga qaramay, men bir oydan ko'proq vaqt davomida non topishimiz uchun vosita topdim va ta'minladim, chunki men bu yerda sen bilganingdek, u yerda men bilan birga shu vaqtdan beri uyni to'ldirgan bir odamni sotdim; va u menga buning uchun besh liliya-ins 346 beradi." Quoth Peronella, "Shunchaki men ochiq aytishim kerak; sen, erkak bo'lib yurib, dunyo narsalariga mohir bo'lishing kerak edi, sen u yerda besh dona gul sotib olding, men esa, agar bir kambag'al odamni ko'rmagan bo'lsang, u uyga kirgan bo'lsang, uni ko'rding, agar u hech qachon...

en: When the husband heard this, he was more than satisﬁed and said to him who had come for the vat, ‘Good man, begone in peace; for thou hearest that my wife hath sold the vat for seven ﬂorins, whereas thou wast to give me but ﬁve for it.’ ‘Good,’ replied the other and went his way; whereupon quoth Peronella to her husband, ‘Since thou art here, come up and settle with him thyself.’ Gi- annello, who abode with his ears pricked up to hear if it behoved him fear or be on his guard against aught, hearing his mistress’s words, straightway scrambled out of the vat and cried out, as if he had heard nothing of the hus- band’s return, ‘Where art thou, good wife?’ whereupon the goodman, com- ing up, answered, ‘Here am I; what wouldst thou have?’ ‘Who art thou?’
uz: Er bu gapni eshitgach, u juda ham qoniqdi va idishga kelgan odamga dedi: "Yaxshi odam, tinchlik bilan boshlang; chunki sen eshityapsan, xotinim yetti floringa idishni sotdi, sen esa menga buning uchun faqat beshtasini berasan." "Yaxshi," dedi ikkinchisi va yo'lga chiqdi; shundan so'ng Peronella eriga dedi: "Sen bu yerda bo'lganing uchun, u bilan o'zing o'tir." Gi-annello, u xo'jayining so'zlarini eshitib, qo'rqib ketsa yoki hech narsadan ehtiyot bo'lsa, quloqlari bilan o'tirardi, darhol idishdan chiqib, go'yo u hech narsa eshitmagan bo'lsa, "Qayerda, yaxshi xotin?" deb javob berdi. "Sen qayerdasan, yaxshi xotin?"

en: ‘I want the woman with whom I made the bargain for this vat.’ Quoth the other, ‘You may deal with me in all assurance, for I am her husband.’ Then said Giannello, ‘The vat appeareth to me sound enough; but meseemeth you have kept dregs or the like therein, for it is all overcrusted with I know not what that is so hard and dry that I cannot remove aught thereof with my nails; wherefore I will not take it, except I ﬁrst see it clean.’ ‘Nay,’ answered Peronella, ‘the bargain shall not fall through for that; my husband will clean it all out.’ ‘Ay will I,’ rejoined the latter, and laying down his tools, put off his coat; then, calling for a light and a scraper, he entered the vat and fell to scraping.
uz: Men shu idish uchun kelishuvga erishgan ayolni xohlayman. Boshqa biri aytdi: Siz men bilan bemalol munosabatda bo'lishingiz mumkin, chunki men uning eri bo'laman. Shunda Giannello dedi: Menga idish yetarlicha sog'lom ko'rinadi; lekin u yerda suv yoki shunga o'xshash narsalarni saqlagansiz, chunki u bilan to'lib-toshgan, men uncha qattiq va quruq emasligini bilmayman, shuning uchun undan hech narsani tirnoqlarim bilan olib tashlay olmayman; shuning uchun uni birinchi navbatda toza ko'rmagunimcha olmayman. Yo'q,  javob berdi Peronella,  kelishuv bu uchun muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramaydi; erim hammasini tozalaydi. Yo'q,  deb aytdi u, so'ngra o'zining asboblarini qo'yib, paltosini qo'ydi; keyin, yengil va mayda qilib, u idishga kirdi va yiqildi.

en: Peronella, as if she had a mind to see what he did, thrust her head and one of her arms, shoulder and all, in at the mouth of the vat, which was not overbig, and fell to saying, ‘Scrape here’ and ‘There’ and ‘There also’ and ‘See, here is a little left.’ Whilst she was thus engaged in directing her husband and showing him where to scrape, Giannello, who had scarce yet that morning done his full desire, when they were interrupted by the mason’s coming, seeing that he could not as he would, bethought himself to accomplish it as he might; wherefore, boarding her, as she held the mouth of the vat all closed up, on such wise as in the ample plains the unbridled stallions, aﬁre with love, as- sail the mares of Parthia, he satisﬁed his juvenile ardour, the which enter- prise was brought to perfection well nigh at the same moment as the scrap- ing of the vat; whereupon he dismounted and
uz: Peronella, go'yo uning nima qilayotganini ko'rish uchun aqli bor edi, boshini va bir qo'lini, yelkasini va hammasini, katta bo'lmagan idishning og'ziga urdi va yiqilib dedi: "Bu yerga qirib tashla" va "U yerda" va "Mana, bu yerda biroz chapda". Shunday qilib, u eriga yo'naltirish va unga qayerga qirib tashlashni ko'rsatishda band bo'lganida, Giannello, o'sha kuni ertalab to'liq xohlaganini bajarganida, u duradgorning kelishi bilan to'xtatilganda, o'zi xohlaganidek qila olmasligini ko'rganda, uni qo'lidan kelganicha bajarishga ishondi; u yerda, idishning og'zini yopganida, u keng tekisliklarda, muhabbat bilan to'xtatganidek, u Partiya uni to'xtatdi, chunki u...

en: Peronella withdrawing her head from the mouth of the vat, the husband came forth thereof.
uz: Peronella boshini idish og'zidan tortib, er undan chiqdi.

en: Then said she to her gallant, ‘Take this light, good man, and look if it be clean to thy mind.’ Giannello looked in and said that it was well and that he was satis- ﬁed and giving the husband seven ﬂorins, caused carry the vat to his own house.”
uz: Keyin u o'zining jasoratiga dedi: "Bu chiroqni ol, yaxshi odam, va uning aqlingda toza ekanligini ko'r." Giannello ichkariga qaradi va u yaxshi ekanligini, u rozi ekanligini va eriga yetti florinni berishini aytdi, va idishni o'z uyiga olib borishni buyurdi.

en: THE THIRD STORY Fra Rinaldo lieth with his gossip and being found of her husband closeted with her in her chamber, they give him to believe that he was in act to conjure worms from his godson.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA Fra Rinaldo o'zining g'iybatlari bilan yotadi va erining xonasida u bilan birga yotganini topdi, ular unga o'z o'g'lidan qurtlarni o'ylab topmoqchi bo'lganligiga ishontirishadi.

en: Filostrato had not known to speak so obscurely of the mares of Parthia but that the roguish ladies laughed thereat, making believe to laugh at other- what.
uz: Filostrato Parfiya dengizlari haqida bunchalik noaniq gapirishni bilmagan edi, lekin u yerda xor xonimlar kulishardi, boshqa narsalardan kulgandek ko'rsatishardi.

en: But, when the king saw that his story was ended, he bade Elisa tell, who accordingly, with obedient readiness, began, “Charming ladies, Emil- ia’s conjuration of the phantom hath brought to my memory the story of an- other conjuration, which latter, though it be not so goodly as hers, neverthe- less, for that none other bearing upon our subject occurreth to me at this present, I will proceed to relate.
uz: Ammo, shoh o'z hikoyasi tugaganini ko'rgach, Elisaga aytishni buyurdi. Elisa esa itoatkorlik bilan shunday dedi: "Joyli xonimlar, Emil-ia'ning arvohning hiylasi menga boshqa bir hiylasining hikoyasini eslatdi, bu hiylasi, garchi uningniki kabi yaxshi bo'lmasa ham, men hozirda bizning mavzuga oid boshqa hech qanday ma'noga ega emasligimni aytishga harakat qilaman."

en: You must know that there was once in Siena a very agreeable young man and of a worshipful family, by name Rinaldo, who was passionately enam- ored of a very beautiful lady, a neighbour of his and the wife of a rich man, and ﬂattered himself that, could he but ﬁnd means to speak with her unsus- pected, he might avail to have of her all that he should desire.
uz: Siz bilishingiz kerakki, bir vaqtlar Siena shahrida Rinaldo ismli juda mehribon va dindor oilaning bir yigiti bor edi. U juda go'zal xonimga, o'zining qo'shnisiga va boy odamning xotiniga ishtiyoq bilan oshiq edi va o'zini shunday maqtagan ediki, agar u u bilan gaplashishga imkon topsa, u undan xohlagan hamma narsasini olishi mumkin edi.

en: Seeing none other way and the lady being great with child, he bethought himself to be- come her gossip and accordingly, clapping up an acquaintance with her hus- band, he offered him, on such wise as appeared to him most seemly, to be godfather to his child.
uz: Boshqa hech qanday yo'lni ko'rmay, xonimning bola bilan zo'r ekanligi sababli, u o'zini uning g'iybatidan kelib chiqqan deb o'yladi va shunga ko'ra, uning xotin-qizlari bilan tanish bo'lib, unga o'ziga eng ko'ringanidek, o'g'liga o'gay ota bo'lishni taklif qildi.

en: His offer was accepted and he being now become Madam Agnesa’s gossip and having a somewhat more colourable excuse for speaking with her, he took courage and gave her in so many words to know that of his intent which she had indeed long before gathered from his looks; but little did this proﬁt him, although the lady was nothing displeased to have heard him.
uz: Uning taklifi qabul qilindi va u endi Madam Agnesa'ning g'iybatchisiga aylandi va u bilan gaplashishga biroz rang-barangroq bahona topdi, u jasorat ko'rdi va unga o'z niyatini ko'p so'zlar bilan ko'rsatdi, buni u ancha oldin uning ko'rinishidan anglagan edi; lekin bu unga kam foyda keltirmadi, garchi xonim uni eshitganidan xursand bo'lmasdi.
