uz: Janob yuqoriga ko'tarilib, xotini zinapoyada, butunlay tartibsiz va qo'rqoq holda topdi va unga dedi: Bularning hammasi nima?

en: Whom goeth Messer Lamber- tuccio threatening thus in such a fury?’ The lady, withdrawing towards the chamber where Leonetto was, so he might hear her, answered, ‘Sir, never had I the like of this fright.
uz: "Messer Lamber- tuccio bunday g'azab bilan kimga tahdid qilyapti?" Xonim Leonetto turgan xonaga qarab chekinib, uni eshitishi uchun javob berdi: "Janob, men hech qachon bunday qo'rquvga ega bo'lmaganman."

en: There came ﬂeeing hither but now a young man, whom I know not, followed by Messer Lambertuccio, hanger in hand, and ﬁnding by chance the door of this chamber open, said to me, all trembling, “For God’s sake, madam, help me, that I be not slain in your arms.” I rose to my feet and was about to question him who he was and what ailed him, when, behold, in rushed Messer Lambertuccio, saying, “Where art thou, traitor?” I set myself before the chamber-door and hindered him from enter- ing; and he was in so far courteous that, after many words, seeing it pleased me not that he should enter there, he went his way down, as you have seen.’ Quoth the husband, ‘Wife, thou didst well, it were too great a reproach to us, had a man been slain in our house, and Messer Lambertuccio did ex- ceeding unmannerly to follow a person who had taken refuge here.’ Then he asked where the young man was, and the
uz: Hozir bu yerga bir yigit qochib keldi, men uni tanimayman, uning orqasidan Messer Lambertuccio keldi, qo'lida osilib turgan edi va tasodifan bu xonaning eshigi ochiqligini ko'rib, u menga shunday dedi: "Xudo haqqi, xonim, qo'lingda o'ldirmasligimga yordam ber." O'rnimdan turdim va undan kimligini va nima qilayotganini so'rashni xohlardim. Shunda, mana, Messer Lambertuccio shoshib keldi: "Sen qayerdasan, xiyonatkor?" Men xonaning eshigi oldiga o'tirdim va unga kirishga to'sqinlik qildim; va u shunchalik odobli ediki, ko'p so'zlardan so'ng, u menga u yerga kirmasligini ko'rib, u o'z yo'lini so'radi, siz ko'rganingizdek.

en: lady answered, ‘Indeed sir, I know not where he hath hidden himself.’ Then said the husband ‘Where art thou?
uz: Xonim javob berdi: Haqiqatan ham janob, u qayerda yashiringanini bilmayman. Shunda er dedi: Qayerdasiz?

en: Come forth in safety.’ Whereupon Leonetto, who had heard everything, came forth all trembling for fear, (as indeed he had had a great fright), of the place where he had hidden himself, and the gentleman said to him, ‘What hast thou to do with Messer Lambertuccio?’ ‘Sir,’ answered he, ‘I have nothing in the world to do with him, wherefore me- thinketh assuredly he is either not in his right wits or he hath mistaken me for another; for that no sooner did he set eyes on me in the road not far from this house than he forthright clapped his hand to his hanger and said, “Trait-
uz: Xavfsiz chiqib kelinglar. Shunda Leonetto, hamma narsani eshitib, qo'rquvdan titrab chiqdi (chindan ham, u juda qo'rqib ketgan edi), o'zini yashirgan joydan, va janob unga dedi: Messer Lambertuccio bilan senga nima aloqasi bor?  Janob, javob berdi u: Menda u bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q, shuning uchun men aniq o'ylaymanki, u yoki aqli to'g'ri emas, yoki meni boshqa bilan adashtirgan; chunki u shu uydan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan yo'lda menga ko'z tashlamadi, shunda u osilib turgan tayoqga qo'lini urdi va dedi:

en: or, thou art a dead man!” I stayed not to ask why, but took to my heels as best I might and made my way hither, where, thanks to God and to this gen- tlewoman, I have escaped.’ Quoth the husband, ‘Go to; have no fears; I will bring thee to thine own house safe and sound, and thou canst after seek out what thou hast to do with him.’ Accordingly, when they had supped, he mounted him a-horseback and carrying him back to Florence, left him in his own house.
uz: Yoki, sen o'lik odamsan! deb so'rash uchun qolmadim, balki oyoq kiyimimga qo'yib, shu yerga yo'l oldim, u yerda Xudoga va bu ayolga shukr qilib, qochib qoldim. Er aytdi: Bor, qo'rqma; seni o'z uyingga sog'lom va sog'lom olib kelaman, keyin u bilan nima qilishing kerakligini topishing mumkin. Shunga ko'ra, ular ta'minlanganidan so'ng, u otga minib, uni Florensiyaga qaytarib olib bordi va o'z uyida qoldirdi.

en: As for Leonetto, that same evening, according as he had been lessoned of the lady, he privily bespoke Messer Lambertuccio and took such order with him, albeit there was much talk of the matter thereafter- ward, the husband never for all that became aware of the cheat that had been put on him by his wife.”
uz: Leonettoga kelsak, o'sha oqshom, xonimdan o'rganganidek, u maxfiy ravishda janob Lambertucconi chaqirdi va bu buyruqni o'zi bilan olib ketdi, garchi bu haqda keyinchalik ko'p gapirildi  lekin er hech qachon xotini tomonidan unga qilingan firibgarlikdan xabardor bo'lmadi.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Lodovico discovereth to Madam Beatrice the love he beareth her, whereupon she sendeth Egano her husband into the garden, in her own favour, and lieth meanwhile with Lodovico, who, presently arising, goeth and cudgelleth Egano in the garden.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Lodoviko Madam Beatrichga uning muhabbatini ochib beradi, shundan so'ng u Egano erini o'z foydasiga bog'ga jo'natadi va shu bilan birga Lodovico bilan yotadi, u esa hozir turadi va Egano bog'da o'ldiradi.

en: Madam Isabella’s presence of mind, as related by Pampinea, was held ad- mirable by all the company; but, whilst they yet marvelled thereat, Filom- ena, whom the king had appointed to follow on, said, “Lovesome ladies, and I mistake not, methinketh I can tell you no less goodly a story on the same subject, and that forthright.
uz: Madam Izabellaning aql-idrokining Pampinea tomonidan rivoyat qilinganidek, butun jamoa tomonidan hayratlanarli edi; lekin, ular hali ham hayratda qolishar ekan, shoh unga ergashish uchun tayinlagan Filom- ena dedi: "Sevgich xonimlar, va men adashmayman, menimcha, men sizga xuddi shu mavzuda, shu haqda hech qanday yaxshi hikoya aytib bera olmayman."

en: You must know, then, that there was once in Paris a Florentine gentle- man, who was for poverty turned merchant and had thriven so well in com- merce that he was grown thereby very rich.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, Parijda bir vaqtlar bir florensiyalik muloyim odam bor edi, u kambag'allik tufayli savdogarga aylangan va tijoratda shunchalik yaxshi rivojlangan ediki, shu orqali juda boy bo'lib ulg'aygan edi.

en: He had by his lady one only son, whom he had named Lodovico, and for that he might concern himself with his father’s nobility and not with trade, he had willed not to place him in any warehouse, but had sent him to be with other gentlemen in the ser- vice of the King of France, where he learned store of goodly manners and other ﬁne things.
uz: Uning xonimida yagona o'g'li bor edi, uni Lodovico deb atashgan edi. Shuning uchun u otasining zodagonligi bilan shug'ullanishi kerak edi, savdo bilan emas, uni hech qanday omborga joylashtirishni xohlamagan edi, balki uni Fransiya qirolining xizmatida boshqa janoblar bilan birga bo'lishga yuborgan edi, u yerda u yaxshi xulq-atvor va boshqa nozik narsalarni o'rganardi.

en: During his sojourn there, it befell that certain gentlemen, who were returned from visiting the Holy Sepulchre, coming in upon a con- versation between certain young men, of whom Lodovico was one, and hearing them discourse among themselves of the fair ladies of France and England and other parts of the world, one of them began to say that as- suredly, in all the lands he had traversed and for all the ladies he had seen, he had never beheld the like for beauty of Madam Beatrice, the wife of Messer Egano de’ Gulluzzi of Bologna; to which all his companions, who had with him seen her at Bologna, agreed.
uz: U yerda bo'lgan davrida, Muqaddas Qabrga tashrif buyurib qaytgan ayrim janoblar, Lodovico ulardan biri bo'lgan ba'zi yigitlar o'rtasida uchrashuvga kelib, ularning o'zaro Fransiya, Angliya va dunyoning boshqa qismlaridagi go'zal ayollarning suhbatini eshitib, ulardan biri, albatta, o'zi bosib o'tgan barcha yurtlarda va ko'rgan barcha ayollarda, u Messer Egano de' Gulluzzi Bolognadan kelgan ayol Beatricening go'zalligini hech qachon ko'rmaganini ayta boshladi; bunga uning barcha hamrohlari, u bilan birga Bolonyada bo'lganlar, rozi bo'lishdi.

en: Lodovico, who had never yet been enamoured of any woman, hearkening to this, was ﬁred with such longing to see her that he could hold his thought to nothing else and being altogether resolved to journey to Bologna for that purpose and there, if she pleased him, to abide awhile, he feigned to his father that he had a mind to go visit the Holy Sepulchre, the which with great difﬁculty he obtained of him.
uz: Lodoviko, hech qachon hech qanday ayolga oshiq bo'lmagan edi, buni eshitib, uni ko'rishga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan ishdan chiqdiki, u boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylamasdi va shu maqsadda Bolonyaga sayohat qilishga butunlay qaror qildi va u yerda, agar u unga yoqsa, bir oz qolishga qaror qildi. U otasiga Muqaddas Qabrni ziyorat qilish niyatida ekanligini ko'rsatdi, uni undan juda qiyinchilik bilan oldi.

en: Accordingly, taking the name of Anichino, he set out for Bologna, and on the day following [his arrival], as fortune would have it, he saw the lady in question at an entertainment, where she seemed to him fairer far than he had imagined her; wherefore, falling most ardently enamoured of her, he resolved never to depart Bo- logna till he should have gained her love.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Anichino nomini olib, u Bolonyaga yo'l oldi va ertasi kuni, omadga ko'ra, u qiziqarli tadbirda so'ralayotgan xonimni ko'rdi, u yerda u unga tasavvur qilganidan ko'ra ancha uzoqroq tuyuldi; shuning uchun, unga juda qattiq oshiq bo'lib, u Bo-lognadan hech qachon ketmaslikka qaror qildi, toki u uning muhabbatiga erishmaguncha.

en: Then, devising in himself what course he should take to this end, he bethought himself, leaving be all other means, that, an he might but avail to become one of her husband’s servants, whereof he entertained many, he might peradventure compass that which he desired.
uz: Keyin, bu maqsadga qanday yo'l tutishni o'zida o'ylab, u o'zini boshqa barcha vositalardan voz kechib, erining xizmatkorlaridan biri bo'lishga qodir bo'lsa, ko'pchilikni xursand qiladigan bo'lsa, u o'zi xohlagan narsani topishi mumkin deb o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, having sold his horses and disposed as best might be of his servants, bidding them make a show of knowing him not, he entered into discourse with his host and told him that he would fain engage for a servant with some gentleman of condition, could such an one be found.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, otlarini sotib, xizmatkorlaridan eng yaxshilarini sotib, o'zini bilmaslikni ko'rsatishga buyurib, u o'z qo'shini bilan suhbatga kirdi va unga shunday bir janob topilsa, qandaydir holatdagi xizmatkorga murojaat qilishni xohlashini aytdi.

en: Quoth the host, ‘Thou art the right serving-man to please a gentleman of this city, by name Egano, who keepeth many and will have them all well looking, as thou art.
uz: Qo'shin aytdi: Sen bu shaharning Egano ismli janobini xursand qilish uchun to'g'ri xizmatchisan, u ko'plarni saqlaydi va ularning hammasi sen kabi yaxshi ko'rinadi.

en: I will bespeak him of the matter.’ As he said, so he did, and ere he took leave of Egano, he had brought Anichino to an accord with him, to the exceeding satisfaction of the latter, who, abiding with Egano and having abundant opportunity of seeing his lady often, proceeded to serve him so well and so much to his liking that he set such store by him that he could do nothing without him and committed to him the governance, not of himself alone, but of all his affairs.
uz: Men unga bu haqda gapiraman." U aytganidek, u shunday qildi va Egano bilan ketishdan oldin, u Anichino bilan kelishuvga erishdi, bu esa uni oxirgilarning haddan tashqari mamnunligiga olib keldi. Egano bilan birga qolgan va xotini bilan ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganligi sababli, u unga shunchalik yaxshi va o'ziga yoqqan darajada xizmat qildi, hatto u undan tashqari hech narsa qila olmaydigan darajada g'amxo'rlik qildi va unga o'zi emas, balki barcha ishlarini boshqarishni topshirdi.

en: It chanced one day that, Egano being gone a-fowling and having left Anichino at home, Madam Beatrice (who was not yet become aware of his love for her, albeit, considering him and his fashions, she had ofttimes much commended him to herself and he pleased her), fell to playing chess with him and he, desiring to please her, very adroitly contrived to let him- self be beaten, whereat the lady was marvellously rejoiced.
uz: Shunday bo'ldiki, bir kuni Egano o'g'il bo'lib ketgan va Anichino uyiga tashlab ketganidan so'ng, Madam Beatrice (uning unga bo'lgan muhabbatidan hali xabardor bo'lmagan, garchi u va uning modalarini hisobga olsak ham, u uni ko'p marta o'ziga maqtashgan va u uni xursand qilgan), u bilan shaxmat o'ynashga tushdi va u, uni xursand qilishni istar ekan, uni o'zini urishga qo'yib yuborishga juda mohirona harakat qildi, bu esa xonim ajoyib tarzda xursand edi.

en: Presently, all her women having gone away from seeing them play and left them playing alone, Anichino heaved a great sigh, whereupon she looked at him and said, ‘What aileth thee, Anichino?
uz: Hozir ularning o'ynayotganini ko'rib, ularni yolg'iz qoldirgan ayollarining hammasi ketgach, Anichino katta ingradi, shunda unga qarab dedi: "Senga nima bo'ldi, Anichino?"

en: Doth it irk thee that I should beat thee?’ ‘Madam,’ answered he, ‘a far greater thing than that was the cause of my
uz: "Seni urishim seni bezovta qilmaydimi?" Xonim,  javob berdi u,  bundan ham kattaroq narsa mening sababim edi.

en: sighing.’ Quoth the lady, ‘Prithee, as thou wishest me well, tell it me.’ When Anichino heard himself conjured, ‘as thou wishest me well,’ by her whom he loved over all else, he heaved a sigh yet heavier than the ﬁrst; wherefore the lady besought him anew that it would please him tell her the cause of his sighing.
uz: Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.  Xonim aytdi: Prithi, meni qanday yaxshi istasangiz, ayting. Anichino o'zining menni yaxshi istasangiz, degan so'zini eshitgach, o'zi sevgan ayoldan hamma narsadan ko'ra og'irroq xo'rsindi; shuning uchun xonim undan yana bir bor o'z xo'rsinishining sababini aytishga ruxsat berishini so'radi.

en: ‘Madam,’ replied Anichino, ‘I am sore fearful lest it displease you, if I tell it you, and moreover I misdoubt me you will tell it again to oth- ers.’ Whereto rejoined she, ‘Certes, it will not displease me, and thou mayst be assured that, whatsoever thou sayest to me I will never tell to any, save whenas it shall please thee.’ Quoth he, ‘Since you promise me this, I will e’en tell it you.’ Then, with tears in his eyes, he told her who he was and what he had heard of her and when and how he was become enamoured of her and why he had taken service with her husband and after humbly be- sought her that it would please her have compassion on him and comply with him in that his secret and so fervent desire, and in case she willed not to do this, that she should suffer him to love her, leaving him be in that his then present guise.
uz: Xonim,  javob berdi Anichino,  Agar sizga aytsam, sizga yoqmasligi mumkin deb qo'rqaman, bundan tashqari, siz buni boshqalarga ham aytishingizdan gumon qilaman.  Shunda u javob berdi:  Albatta, bu menga yoqmaydi, va siz amin bo'lingki, siz menga nima deysiz, hech kimga hech qachon aytmayman, faqat sizga yoqmasa.

en: O singular blandness of the Bolognese blood!
uz: Ey Bolonya qonining noyob bema'niligi!

en: How art thou still to be commended in such circumstance!
uz: Bunday vaziyatda seni qanday ham maqtashga arziydi!

en: Never wast thou desirous of tears or sighs; still wast thou compliant unto prayers and amenable unto amorous desires!
uz: Hech qachon ko'z yoshlari yoki oh-vohlarni xohlamading; baribir duolarga rozi bo'lding va shahvoniy istaklarga moyil eding!

en: Had I words worthy to commend thee, my voice should never weary of singing thy praises.
uz: Agar Senga maqtashga arziydigan so'zlarim bo'lsa, ovozim Seni madh etishdan charchamas edi.

en: The gentle lady, what while Anichino spoke, kept her eyes ﬁxed on him and giving full credence to his words, received, by the prevalence of his prayers, the love of him with such might into her heart that she also fell a-sighing and presently answered, ‘Sweet my Anichino, be of good courage; neither presents nor promises nor solicita- tions of nobleman or gentleman or other (for I have been and am yet cour- ted of many) have ever availed to move my heart to love any one of them; but thou, in this small space of time that thy words have lasted, hast made me far more thine than mine own.
uz: Janob xonim, Anichino gapirayotganda, unga ko'zlarini tikib, uning so'zlariga to'liq ishonardi. Uning ibodatlarining keng tarqalishi tufayli, uning muhabbati shunchalik kuchli edi, u ham nafasini tashlab, darhol javob berdi: "Siziq Anichinoyim, yaxshi jasoratli bo'l; na va'dalar, na janoblar yoki boshqalarning va'dalari (chunki men ularning birortasini sevishga harakat qildim va hali ham ulardan birortasini sevaman), lekin sen, sening so'zlaring davom etgan shu kichik vaqt ichida meni o'zingnikidan ancha aziz qilding.

en: Methinketh thou hast right well earned my love, wherefore I give it thee and promise thee that I will cause thee have enjoyment thereof ere this next night be altogether spent.
uz: Menimcha, sen mening muhabbatimni to'g'ri topding, shuning uchun men uni senga beraman va keyingi kecha butunlay o'tmasidan oldin undan zavqlanishingni va'da beraman.

en: And that this may have effect, look thou come to my chamber about midnight.
uz: Va bu natija bo'lishi uchun, mana, yarim tunda mening xonamga kel.

en: I will leave the door open; thou knowest which side the bed I lie; do thou come thither and if I sleep, touch me so I may awake, and I will ease thee of this so long desire that thou hast had.
uz: Men eshikni ochiq qoldiraman; sen to'shakning qaysi tomonida yotganimni bilasan; u yerga kel va agar uxlasam, menga teggin, uyg'onishim uchun, va men seni shunchalik uzoq vaqtdan beri orzu qilganingdan xalos qilaman.

en: And that thou mayst believe this that I say, I will e’en give thee a kiss by way of arles.’ Accordingly, throwing her arms about his neck, she kissed him amorously and he on like wise kissed her.
uz: Shunday qilib, men senga kamon orqali o'pich beraman deganimga ishonishing uchun. Shunday qilib, u uning bo'yniga qo'llarini tashlab, uni oshiqona o'pdi va u dono kabi uni o'pdi.

en: These things said, he left her and went to do certain occasions of his, await- ing with the greatest gladness in the world the coming of the night.
uz: Shundan so'ng, u uni tark etdi va o'zining ba'zi tadbirlarini o'tkazishga ketdi, dunyodagi eng katta quvonch bilan tunning kelishini kutdi.

en: Presently, Egano returned from fowling and being weary, betook himself to bed, as soon as he had supper, and after him the lady, who left the cham- ber-door open, as she had promised.
uz: Hozirda Egano ovdan va charchoqdan qaytib keldi, kechki ovqatdan so'ng o'zini yotqizdi va undan keyin xonim va'da qilganidek, chodir eshigini ochiq qoldirdi.

en: Thither, at the appointed hour, came Anichino and softly entering the chamber, shut the door again from within; then, going up to the bed on the side where the lady lay, he put his hand to her breast and found her awake.
uz: U yerga, belgilangan soatda, Anichino keldi va xonadan sekin kirib, eshikni ichkaridan yana yopdi; so'ngra, xonim yotgan yon tomondagi karavotga ko'tarilib, qo'lini uning ko'ksiga qo'ydi va uni uyg'oq holda topdi.

en: As soon as she felt him come, she took his hand in both her own and held it fast; then, turning herself about in the bed, she did on such wise that Egano, who was asleep, awoke; whereupon quoth she to him, ‘I would not say aught to thee yestereve, for that meseemed thou was weary; but tell me, Egano, so God save thee, whom holdest thou thy best and trustiest servant and him who most loveth thee of those whom thou hast in the house?’ ‘Wife,’ answered Egano, ‘what is this whereof thou askest me?
uz: U kelishini sezishi bilanoq, uning qo'lini o'zining qo'liga oldi va uni mahkam ushladi; so'ngra, karavotda o'girilib, Egano uxlab yotganini uyg'otib qo'ydi; shundan so'ng unga dedi: "Senga hech narsa demayman, chunki sen charchaganingni his qilgandek bo'larding; lekin menga ayt, Egano, Xudo seni saqlasin, sen o'zingning eng yaxshi va ishonchli xizmatkoringni va uyingdagi eng ko'p sevganingni kim deb bilasan?" Xotin,  Egano javob berdi: Mendan so'raysan, bu nima?

en: Knowest thou it not?
uz: Buni bilmaysanmi?

en: I have not nor had aye any in whom I so trusted and whom I loved as I love and trust in Anichino.
uz: Mening Anichino'ga ishonib, uni sevganim va ishonganim kabi, hech kimga ishonmaganman ham.

en: But why dost thou ask me thereof?’ Anichino, seeing Egano awake and hearing talk of himself, was sore afraid lest the lady had a mind to cozen him and offered again and again to draw his hand away, so he might begone; but she held it so fast that he could not win free.
uz: Lekin nega mendan bu haqda so'rayapsan? Anichino Egano uyg'oq bo'lganini va o'zi haqida gapirganini ko'rib, xonim uni qo'zg'atishdan juda qo'rqib, qo'lini uzoqroq tortishni qayta-qayta taklif qildi, shunda u ketishi mumkin edi; lekin u buni shunchalik qattiq ushladiki, u ozod bo'la olmadi.

en: Then said she to Egano, ‘I will tell thee.
uz: Shunda u Eganoga dedi: Men senga aytaman.

en: I also believed till today that he was even such as thou sayest and that he was more loyal to thee than any other, but he hath undeceived me; for that, what while thou wentest a-fowling today, he abode here, and whenas it seemed to him time, he was not ashamed to solicit me to yield myself to his pleasures, and I, so I might make thee touch and see this thing and that it might not behove me certify thee thereof with too many proofs, replied that I would well and that this very night, after midnight, I would go into our garden and there await him at the foot of the pine.
uz: Men ham shu kungacha uning sen aytganingdek ekanligiga va senga boshqalardan ko'ra sadoqatliroq ekanligiga ishonardim, lekin u meni aldamadi; chunki, sen bugun o'zingni yo'qotganingda, u shu yerda qoldi va unga vaqt kelganda, o'zini o'ziga berishga undashdan uyalmadi. Men esa, senga tegib, bu narsani ko'rishim va bu haqda ko'p dalillar bilan tasdiqlashga majbur bo'lmasligim uchun, men yaxshi edim va shu kecha yarim tunda bizning bog'imizga kirib, uni qarag'ay ostida kutaman, deb javob berdim.

en: Now for my part I mean not to go thither; but thou, an thou have a mind to know thy servant’s ﬁdelity, thou mayst lightly do it by donning a gown and a veil of mine and going down yonder to wait and see if he will come thither, as I am assured he will.’ Egano hearing this, answered, ‘Certes, needs must I go see,’ and rising, donned one of the lady’s gowns, as best he knew in the dark; then, covering his head with a veil, he betook himself to the garden and proceeded to await Anichino at the foot of the pine.
uz: Endi men u yerga bormaslikni xohlayman; lekin sen, qulingning sadoqatini bilishga aqling yetganing uchun, yengillik bilan mening ko'ylagim va pardaimni kiyib, u yerga tushib, u yerga keladimi, deb kutishing mumkin, chunki men ishonaman, u yerga keladi. Egano buni eshitib, javob berdi: "Albatta, men borib ko'rishim kerak", va o'rnidan turib, qorong'ida bilganidek, xonimning ko'ylaklaridan birini kiydirdi; keyin, boshini parda bilan yopib, o'zini bog'ga tashladi va qarag'ayning etagida Anichinoga kutdi.

en: As for the lady, as soon as she knew him gone forth of the chamber, she arose and locked the door from within, whilst Anichino, (who had had the greatest fright he had ever known and had enforced himself as most he might to escape from the lady’s hands, cursing her and her love and himself who had trusted in her an hundred thousand times), seeing this that she had done in the end, was the joyfullest man that was aye.
uz: Xo'sh, xonim uning xonadan chiqqanini bilishi bilanoq, u o'rnidan turdi va eshikni ichkaridan qulfladi, Anichino esa (u hech qachon bilmagan eng katta qo'rquviga ega edi va xonimning qo'lidan qochishga harakat qildi, uni, uning muhabbatini va unga yuz ming marta ishongan o'zini la'natladi), buni ko'rib, oxir-oqibatda u qilgan eng quvonchli odam edi.

en: Then, she having re- turned to bed, he, at her bidding, put off his clothes and coming to bed to her, they took delight and pleasure together a pretty while; after which, herseeming he should not abide longer, she caused him arise and dress him- self and said to him, ‘Sweetheart, do thou take a stout cudgel and get thee to the garden and there, feigning to have solicited me to try me, rate Egano, as he were I, and ring me a good peal of bells on his back with the cudgel, for that thereof will ensue to us marvellous pleasance and delight.’ Anichino accordingly repaired to the garden, with a sallow-stick in his hand, and Egano, seeing him draw near the pine, rose up and came to meet him, as he would receive him with the utmost joy; whereupon quoth Anichino, ‘Ah, wicked woman, art thou then come hither, and thinkest thou I would do my lord such a wrong?
uz: Keyin, u yana yotishga burildi, u, uning iltimosiga ko'ra, kiyimlarini yechib, unga yotishga keldi, ular bir oz vaqt birga xursandchilik va rohatlanishdi; keyin, uning uzoqroq qolmasligi ko'rinishidan so'ng, u uni o'zini ko'tarib kiyintirdi va unga dedi: "Do'stim, qalin qo'lqop olib, bog'ga bor, meni sinab ko'rsatgandek, Egano, men qanday bo'lsam, menga yaxshi qo'ng'iroq chal, chunki bu bizga ajoyib rohat va rohat olib keladi." Anichino xuddi shunday qilib bog'ga, qo'lida biroz tayoq bilan keldi va Egano uni ko'rib, uni oldiga tortdi va men bilan birga uni qabul qildi, u qanday yomonlik bilan kelishini o'ylaysiz?

en: A thousand times ill come to thee!’ Then, raising the cudgel, he began to lay on to him.
uz: Ming marta yomonlik senga! Shunda u qo'ltig'ini ko'tarib, unga yotishni boshladi.

en: Egano, hearing this and seeing the cudgel, took to his heels, without say- ing a word, whilst Anichino still followed after him, saying, ‘Go to, God give thee an ill year, vile woman that thou art!
uz: Egano buni eshitib va chaddgelni ko'rib, bir so'z demasdan oyoqlarini qo'lga oldi, Anichino esa uning orqasidan ergashib, dedi: "Bor, Xudo senga yomon yil bersin, sen yomon ayolsan!"

en: I will certainly tell it to Egano tomorrow morning.’ Egano made his way back to the chamber as quickliest he might, having gotten sundry good clouts, and being questioned of the lady if Anichino had come to the garden, ‘Would God he had not!’ answered he.
uz: Men buni ertaga ertalab Eganoga aytaman. Egano xonasiga imkon qadar tezroq qaytdi, turli xil yaxshi tajribalarga ega bo'ldi va Anichino bog'ga kelgan bo'lsa, xonimdan so'raldi: "Xudo xohlamagan bo'lardi!" - deb javob berdi u.

en: ‘For that, taking me for thee, he hath cudgelled me to a mummy and given me the soundest rating that was aye bestowed upon lewd woman.
uz: Shuning uchun, meni senga olib, u meni bir mumyadan o'g'irladi va menga fohisha ayolga berilgan eng yaxshi baho berdi.

en: Certes, I marvelled sore at him that he should have said these words to thee, with intent to do aught that might be a shame to me; but, for that he saw thee so blithe and gamesome, he had a mind to try thee.’ Then said the lady, ‘Praised be God that he hath tried me with words and thee with deeds!
uz: Albatta, men uning senga bu so'zlarni aytganiga juda hayron bo'ldim, menga sharmandalik keltiradigan biror narsa qilish niyatida edi; lekin seni shunchalik jozibali va o'yinchoq ko'rganligi uchun, seni sinashni o'yladi." Shunda xonim dedi: "Allohim, meni so'zlar bilan, seni esa amallar bilan sinagan Xudo!"

en: Methinketh he may say that I suffered his words more patiently than thou his deeds.
uz: Menimcha, u uning so'zlariga sening qilmishlariga qaraganda sabrliroq bardosh berganimni aytishi mumkin.

en: But, since he is so loyal to thee, it behoveth thee hold him dear and do him honour.’ ‘Certes,’ answered Egano, ‘thou sayst sooth’; and reasoning by this, he concluded that he had the truest wife and the trustiest servant that ever gentleman had; by reason whereof, albeit both he and the lady made merry more than once with Anichino over this adventure,
uz: Lekin, u senga shunchalik sodiq bo'lgani uchun, uni qadrlash va hurmat qilishing kerak. Albatta, javob berdi Egano, sen xotirjamsan; va shu bilan mulohaza yuritib, u eng sodiq xotin va eng ishonchli xizmatkorga ega ekanligi haqida xulosa qildi; shu sababli, u ham, xonim ham Anichino bilan bu sarguzashtdan bir necha bor xursand bo'lishgan bo'lsalar ham,

en: the latter and his mistress had leisure enough of that which belike, but for this, they would not have had, to wit, to do that which afforded them pleas- ance and delight, that while it pleased Anichino abide with Egano in Bo- logna.”
uz: Oxirgisi va uning bekasi o'ziga yoqqan narsalardan yetarlicha dam olishardi, lekin buning uchun ularga, xususan, Anichinoga yoqqan bo'lsa-da, Egano bilan Bo-logna'da qolish uchun ularga rohat va rohat beradigan narsani qilishga to'g'ri kelmas edi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY A man waxeth jealous of his wife, who bindeth a piece of packthread to her great toe anights, so she may have notice of her lover’s coming.
uz: Sakkizinchi Hikoya: Bir erkak xotiniga rashk qiladi, u kechasi katta barmog'iga bir bo'lak ip bog'lab, sevgilisining kelgani haqida xabar berishi mumkin.

en: One night her husband becometh aware of this device and what while he pursueth the lover, the lady putteth another woman to bed in her room.
uz: Bir kuni eriga bu qurilma va uning oshiqini ta'qib qilayotganida, xonim boshqa bir ayolni xonasida yotqizishi haqida xabar bo'ldi.

en: This latter the husband beateth and cutteth off her hair, then fetcheth his wife’s brothers, who, ﬁnding his story [seemingly] untrue, give him hard words.
uz: Bu oxirgi er uni urib, sochlarini kesib tashlaydi, so'ngra xotinining aka-ukalarini olib keladi, ular uning hikoyasini yolg'on deb topib, unga qattiq so'zlar aytishadi.

en: It seemed to them all that Madam Beatrice had been extraordinarily ingeni- ous in cozening her husband and all agreed that Anichino’s fright must have been very great, whenas, being the while held fast by the lady, he heard her say that he had required her of love.
uz: Ularning barchasiga Madam Beatrice erini o'ziga xos darajada mohirona yaratgan ko'rindi va hamma Anichino'ning qo'rquvi juda katta bo'lishi kerakligiga qo'shilishdi, chunki u xonim tomonidan ushlab turilgan holda, uning uni sevgi talab qilganini aytganini eshitdi.

en: But the king, seeing Filomena silent, turned to Neiﬁle and said to her, “Do you tell”; whereupon she, smiling ﬁrst a little, began, “Fair ladies, I have a hard task before me if I desire to pleas- ure you with a goodly story, as those of you have done, who have already told; but, with God’s aid, I trust to discharge myself thereof well enough.
uz: Lekin shoh Filomena jimligini ko'rib, Neifilega o'girilib dedi: "Aytyapsizmi?" Shunda u biroz jilmaydi va boshladi: "Adolatli xonimlar, agar sizni yaxshi hikoya bilan xursand qilmoqchi bo'lsam, sizga iltifot aytmoqchiman, xuddi siz aytganlar qilganingizdek; lekin, Xudoning yordami bilan, o'zimni undan yetarli darajada xalos qilishga ishonaman."

en: You must know, then, that there was once in our city a very rich merchant called Arriguccio Berlinghieri, who, foolishly thinking, as merchants yet do every day, to ennoble himself by marriage, took to wife a young gentlewo- man ill sorting with himself, by name Madam Sismonda, who, for that he, merchant-like, was much abroad and sojourned little with her, fell in love with a young man called Ruberto, who had long courted her, and clapped up a lover’s privacy with him.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, bir vaqtlar bizning shaharimizda Arriguccio Berlinghieri ismli juda boy savdogar bor edi. U ahmoqona o'ylab, savdogarlar har kuni qilganidek, turmush qurish orqali o'zini obro'sizlantirish uchun, o'zi bilan yomon munosabatda bo'lgan, Madam Sismonda ismli yosh muloyim bir odamni xotinlikka oldi. U shuning uchun ham, savdogarga o'xshagan holda, ancha chet elda edi va u bilan kam turardi. U Ruberto ismli yosh yigitga oshiq bo'lib qoldi, u uni allaqachon yoqtirgan va bir sevgilining shaxsiy hayotiga qo'llab-quvvatlagan edi.

en: Using belike over-little discretion in her deal- ings with her lover, for that they were supremely delightsome to her, it chanced that, whether Arriguccio scented aught of the matter or how else soever it happened, the latter became the most jealous man alive and leav- ing be his going about and all his other concerns, applied himself well nigh altogether to the keeping good watch over his wife; nor would he ever fall
uz: Uning sevgilisi bilan munosabatlarida juda kam mulohazakorlik bilan, chunki ular unga juda yoqimli edi, shunday bo'ldiki, Arriguccio bu masalani xushbo'y his qilsinmi yoki qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u hayotdagi eng rashkchi odamga aylandi va uning hayoti va boshqa barcha tashvishlarini tashlab, xotiniga yaxshi qarashga butunlay yaqinlashdi; va u hech qachon...

en: asleep, except he ﬁrst felt her come into the bed; by reason whereof the lady suffered the utmost chagrin, for that on no wise might she avail to be with her Ruberto.
uz: uxlayotgan edi, faqat u birinchi bo'lib uni to'shakka tushayotganini sezdi; shuning uchun xonim juda xafa bo'ldi, chunki u hech qanday holatda uning Ruberto bilan birga bo'lishga qodir emas edi.

en: However, after pondering many devices for ﬁnding a means to foregather with him and being to boot continually solicited thereof by him, it presently occurred to her to do on this wise; to wit, having many a time observed that Arriguccio tarried long to fall asleep, but after slept very soundly, she de- termined to cause Ruberto come about midnight to the door of the house and to go open to him and abide with him what while her husband slept fast.
uz: Ammo, u bilan oldindan uchrashish uchun ko'p usullar o'ylab ko'rgach va u tomonidan doimiy ravishda so'ralgan holda, unga bu yo'lni tutish o'ylandi; ya'ni, Arriguccho uxlash uchun uzoq vaqt kutib qolganini ko'rib, lekin juda yaxshi uxlaganidan so'ng, u Rubertoni yarim tunda uy eshigiga kelishiga va unga ochiq bo'lishga va erining tez uxlaganini unga qo'yib berishga qaror qildi.

en: And that she might know when he should be come, she bethought her- self to hang a twine out of the window of her bedchamber, which looked upon the street, on such wise that none might perceive it, one end whereof should well nigh reach the ground, whilst she carried the other end along the ﬂoor of the room to the bed and hid it under the clothes, meaning to make it fast to her great toe, whenas she should be abed.
uz: Va u qachon kelishi kerakligini bilishi uchun, u o'zini ko'chaga qaragan yotoqxonasining oynasidan bir ip osishni o'yladi, hech kim sezmasligi uchun, uning bir uchi yerga yaqin yetishi kerak edi, u esa boshqa uchini xonaning polining bo'ylab to'shakka olib bordi va kiyimlar ostiga yashirdi, ya'ni uni katta barmog'igacha mahkamlash uchun, o'zi esa bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Accordingly, she sent to acquaint Ruberto with this and charged him, when he came, to pull the twine, whereupon, if her husband slept, she would let it go and come to open to him; but, if he slept not, she would hold it fast and draw it to her- self, so he should not wait.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u Rubertoni bu bilan tanishtirishga yubordi va u kelganida ipni tortishni buyurdi. Shundan so'ng, agar eri uxlagan bo'lsa, uni qo'yib yuborib, unga ochib beradi; lekin, agar u uxlamasa, uni mahkam ushlab, o'ziga tortadi, shuning uchun u kutmasligi kerak edi.

en: The device pleased Ruberto and going thither frequently, he was whiles able to foregather with her and whiles not.
uz: Qurilma Rubertoni xursand qildi va u yerga tez-tez borardi, u u bilan oldindan uchrashishga qodir edi, lekin u bilan emas.

en: On this wise they continued to do till, one night, the lady being asleep, it chanced that her husband stretched out his foot in bed and felt the twine, whereupon he put his hand to it and ﬁnding it made fast to his wife’s toe, said in himself, ‘This should be some trick’; and presently perceiving that the twine led out of window, he held it for certain.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular shunday qilishda davom etishdi, bir kecha xonim uxlab yotganida, erining oyog'ini to'shakda cho'zib, ipni sezguniga qadar. Shunda u unga qo'lini qo'ydi va uni xotinining barmog'iga mahkam tortdi, o'zida dedi: "Bu qandaydir hiyla bo'lishi kerak edi"; va shu zahotiyoq ip derazadan chiqib ketayotganini sezdi, u buni aniq ushladi.

en: Accordingly, he cut it softly from the lady’s toe and making it fast to his own, abode on the watch to see what this might mean.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uni xonimning oyog'idan sekin kesib, o'zining oyog'iga tezroq olib keldi va bu nimani anglatishini ko'rish uchun qo'riqxonada qoldi.

en: He had not waited long before up came Ruberto and pulled at the twine, as of his wont; whereupon Arriguccio star- ted up; but, he not having made the twine well fast to his toe and Ruberto pulling hard, it came loose in the latter’s hand, whereby he understood that he was to wait and did so.
uz: U ko'p kutmadi, keyin Ruberto paydo bo'ldi va odatdagidek arqonni tortdi; shundan so'ng Arriguccio yulduzcha turdi; lekin, u arqonni barmog'igacha yaxshilab mahkamlamadi va Ruberto qattiq tortdi, u oxirgi qo'lida bo'shatildi, shu bilan u kutishi kerakligini tushundi va shunday qildi.

en: As for Arriguccio, he arose in haste and taking his arms, ran to the door, to see who this might be and do him a mischief, for, albeit a merchant, he was a stout fellow and a strong.
uz: Arriguchchoga kelsak, u shoshilinch turib, qo'llarini oldi, eshik tomon yugurdi, bu kim bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rish va unga zarar yetkazish uchun, chunki u savdogar bo'lishiga qaramay, kuchli odam va kuchli edi.

en: When he came to the door, he opened it not softly as the lady was used to do, which when Ruberto, who was await, observed, he guessed how the case stood, to wit, that it was Arriguccio who opened the door, and accordingly made off in haste and the other after him.
uz: U eshik oldiga kelganida, u uni xonim odatdagidek sekin ochmadi. Ruberto, kutib turgan, kuzatganida, u eshikni qanday turganini taxmin qildi, ya'ni eshikni aynan Arriguccio ochgan edi va shunga ko'ra shoshilinch ravishda jo'nab ketdi, undan keyin esa boshqasi.

en: At last, having ﬂed a great way and Arriguc-
uz: Nihoyat, ajoyib yo'l bilan qochib, Arriguc-

en: cio stinting not from following him, Ruberto, being also armed, drew his sword and turned upon his pursuer, whereupon they fell to blows, the one attacking and the other defending himself.
uz: Uning orqasidan ergashishdan tortinmay, Ruberto ham qurollanib, qilichini tortdi va ta'qibchisiga o'girildi, shundan so'ng ular zarba berishdi, biri hujum qilmoqda, ikkinchisi esa o'zini himoya qilmoqda.

en: Meanwhile, the lady, awaking, as Arriguccio opened the chamber-door, and ﬁnding the twine cut from her toe, knew incontinent that her device was discovered, whereupon, perceiving that her husband had run after her lover, she arose in haste and foreseeing what might happen, called her maid, who knew all, and conjured her to such purpose that she prevailed with her to take her own place in the bed, beseeching her patiently to endure, without discovering herself, whatsoever buffets Arriguccio might deal her, for that she would requite her therefor on such wise that she should have no cause to complain; after which she did out the light that burnt in the chamber and going forth thereof, hid herself in another part of the house and there began to await what should betide.
uz: Ayni paytda, xonim uyg'onib, Arriguccio xona eshigini ochdi va uning barmog'idan kesilgan egizakni topdi, u o'z qurilmasi aniqlanganini bilmas edi. Shuning uchun, erining sevgilisining orqasidan yugurganini anglab, u shoshilinch turib, nima bo'lishini oldindan ko'rdi, hamma narsani biladigan xizmatchisini chaqirib, uni shunday maqsadga undadi, u bilan birga to'shakda o'z o'rnini egallashga rozi bo'ldi, o'zini topmasdan, Arriguccio unga qanday bufetlar berishini sabr bilan kutishga undadi, chunki u unga shikoyat qilishga hojat qoldirmasligi kerak edi; shundan so'ng u xonada yonib turgan nurni o'chirdi va undan tashqari, u yerda yashirindi va u yerda nima bo'lishi kerakligini kutishni boshladi.

en: Meanwhile, the people of the quarter, aroused by the noise of the affray between Arriguccio and Ruberto, arose and fell a-railing at them; whereupon the husband, fearing to be known, let the youth go, without hav- ing availed to learn who he was or to do him any hurt, and returned to his house, full of rage and despite.
uz: Ayni paytda, kvartal aholisi, Arriguccio va Ruberto o'rtasidagi g'alayon shovqinidan uyg'onib, ularga qarshi turib yiqilishdi; shundan so'ng er, tanilib qolishdan qo'rqib, yoshni qo'yib yubordi, u kimligini yoki unga zarar yetkazishni bilmasdan, g'azabga to'la va qaramay, uyiga qaytdi.

en: There, coming into the chamber, he cried out angrily, saying, ‘Where art thou, vile woman?
uz: U yerda, xonaga kirib, g'azab bilan qichqirib dedi: Qayerda ekansan, iflos ayol?

en: Thou hast done out the light, so I may not ﬁnd thee; but thou art mistaken.’ Then, coming to the bedside, he seized upon the maid, thinking to take his wife, and laid on to her so lustily with cuffs and kicks, as long as he could wag his hands and feet, that he bruised all her face, ending by cutting off her hair, still giving her the while the hardest words that were ever said to worthless woman.
uz: Sen yorug'likni o'chirib qo'yding, shuning uchun seni topolmayapman; lekin sen adashding." Keyin, karavot yonida kelib, u xotini olishni o'ylab, uni shunday shahvoniy tarzda manjetlar va tepkilar bilan yotqizdiki, qo'llari va oyoqlarini qimirlata olardi, hatto butun yuzini maydalab, sochlarini kesib tashladi, shu bilan birga unga hech kimga arzimaydigan ayolga aytilgan eng qattiq so'zlarni aytdi.

en: The maid wept sore, as indeed she had good cause to do, and albeit she said whiles, ‘Alas, mercy, for God’s sake!’ and ‘Oh, no more!’ her voice was so broken with sobs and Arriguccio was so hindered with his rage that he never dis- cerned it to be that of another woman than his wife.
uz: Xizmatkor ayol achchiq yig'ladi, chunki u yaxshi sababga ega edi, va garchi u "Alas, rahm-shafqat, Xudo haqqi uchun!" va "Oh, endi emas!" - desa ham, uning ovozi yig'lashdan shunchalik buzildi va Arriguccio uning g'azabi bilan shunchalik to'sildi, u buni hech qachon xotinidan boshqa ayolniki deb bilmas edi.

en: Having, then, as we have said, beaten her to good purpose and cut off her hair, he said to her, ‘Wicked woman that thou art, I mean not to touch thee otherwise, but shall now go fetch thy brothers and acquaint them with thy ﬁne doings and after bid them come for thee and deal with thee as they shall deem may do them honour and carry thee away; for assuredly in this house thou shalt abide no longer.’ So saying, he departed the chamber and locking the door from without, went away all alone.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz aytganimizdek, uni yaxshi niyat bilan urib, sochlarini kesib tashlab, u unga dedi: "Sen yomon ayol ekansan, men senga boshqa teginishni xohlamayman, lekin endi borib akalaringni olib kelib, yaxshi ishlaring bilan tanishtiraman va keyin ularni senga buyurib, ularni hurmat qilish va seni olib ketishga qaror qilishlaricha ish tutaman; chunki bu uyda endi qolmaysan." Shunday qilib, u xonadan chiqib, eshikni tashqaridan qulflab, butunlay yolg'iz ketdi.

en: As soon as Madam Sismonda, who had heard all, was certiﬁed of her husband’s departure, she opened the
uz: Madam Sismonda, hamma narsani eshitgan holda, erining ketgani haqida xabar topishi bilanoq, u...ni ochdi.

en: door and rekindling the light, found her maid all bruised and weeping sore; whereupon she comforted her as best she might and carried her back to her own chamber, where she after caused privily tend her and care for her and so rewarded her of Arriguccio’s own monies that she avouched herself con- tent.
uz: Eshikni qayta yoqib, uning xizmatkori butunlay ko'kargan va yig'layotganini ko'rdi; shundan so'ng u uni imkon qadar tinchlantirdi va o'z xonasiga qaytarib olib bordi, u yerda uni alohida parvarishladi va unga g'amxo'rlik qildi va shunday qilib, uni Arrigucconing o'z pullaridan mukofotladi, shuning uchun u o'zini chodirga tashladi.

en: No sooner had she done this than she hastened to make the bed in her own chamber and all restablished it and set it in such order as if none had lain there that night; after which she dressed and tired herself, as if she had not yet gone to bed; then, lighting a lamp, she took her clothes and seated herself at the stairhead, where she proceeded to sew and await the issue of the affair.
uz: U buni tezroq qildi, shunda u o'z xonasida karavot yasashga shoshildi va hamma uni qayta tikladi va xuddi o'sha kecha hech kim uxlagandek tartibga soldi; shundan so'ng u o'zini kiyintirdi va charchadi, go'yo hali yotmagandek edi; keyin, chiroq yoqib, kiyimlarini olib, zinapoyaga o'tirdi, u yerda tikuvga o'tdi va ish masalasini kutdi.

en: Meanwhile Arriguccio betook himself in all haste to the house of his wife’s brothers and there knocked so long and so loudly that he was heard and it was opened to him.
uz: Ayni paytda Arriguccio shoshilinch ravishda xotinining aka-ukalarining uyiga bordi va u yerda shunday uzun va shiddatli taqillatdiki, uni eshitishdi va u unga ochildi.

en: The lady’s three brothers and her mother, hearing that it was Arriguccio, rose all and letting kindle lights, came to him and asked what he went seeking at that hour and alone.
uz: Xonimning uch akasi va onasi Arriguccio ekanligini eshitib, butunlay turishib, yoqilg'i chiroqlarini yoqib, uning oldiga kelib, o'sha soatda yolg'iz nima izlayotganini so'rashdi.

en: Whereupon, beginning from the twine he had found tied to wife’s toe, he recounted to them all that he had discovered and done, and to give them entire proof of the truth of his story, he put into their hands the hair he thought to have cut from his wife’s head, ending by requiring them to come for her and do with her that which they should judge pertinent to their honour, for that he meant to keep her no longer in his house.
uz: Shundan so'ng, xotinining oyog'iga bog'langan ipdan boshlab, u ularga o'zi topgan va qilgan barcha narsalarni aytib berdi va o'z hikoyasining haqiqatini to'liq isbotlash uchun, u xotini boshidan kesgan deb o'ylagan sochlarini ularning qo'llariga qo'ydi, so'ng ulardan uni olib kelishlarini va u bilan o'z sharafiga mos deb hisoblaydigan ishlarni qilishlarini talab qildi, chunki u uni endi uyida qoldirmoqchi emas edi.

en: The lady’s brothers, hearing this and holding it for cer- tain, were sore incensed against her and letting kindle torches, set out to ac- company Arriguccio to his house, meaning to do her a mischief; which their mother seeing, she followed after them, weeping and entreating now the one, now the other not to be in such haste to believe these things of their sister, without seeing or knowing more of the matter, for that her husband might have been angered with her for some other cause and have maltreated her and might now allege this in his own excuse, adding that she marvelled exceedingly how this [whereof he accused her] could have happened, for that she knew her daughter well, as having reared her from a little child, with many other words to the like purpose.
uz: Xonimning aka-ukalari buni eshitib, uni xotirjam deb ushlashdi, unga achchiqlanib, olov chiroqlarini qo'yib, uning uyiga, ya'ni unga yomonlik qilish uchun Arriguccio kompaniyasiga yo'l olishdi. Onasi buni ko'rib, ularning orqasidan ergashdi, hozir yig'lab va iltijo qilib, endi boshqa birov singlisining bu gaplariga ishonishga shoshilmasligi kerak edi, lekin bu haqda ko'rmadi yoki ko'proq bilmadi, chunki uning eri boshqa sababga ko'ra undan g'azablanardi va unga yomon munosabatda bo'lishi mumkin edi va endi buni o'z bahonasi bilan bahona qilishi mumkin edi, qo'shimcha qilib aytdi: u bu qanday sodir bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki u o'z qizini yaxshi bilardi, uni kichkina boladan tarbiyalaganidek, boshqa ko'p so'zlar bilan.

en: When they came to Arriguccio’s house, they entered and proceeded to mount the stair, whereupon Madam Sismonda, hearing them come, said, ‘Who is there?’ To which one of her brothers answered, ‘Thou shalt soon know who it is, vile woman that thou art!’ ‘God aid us!’ cried she.
uz: Arriguccio'ning uyiga yetib kelganlarida, ular zinapoyaga chiqish uchun kirishdi. Shundan so'ng Madam Sismonda ularning kelayotganini eshitib, dedi: "U yerda kim bor?" Unga birodarlaridan biri javob berdi: "Sen tez orada kim ekanligingni bilib qolasan, yomon ayol!" "Xudo bizga yordam bersin!" deb baqirdi u.

en: ‘What meaneth this?’ Then, rising to her feet, ‘Brothers mine,’ quoth she, ‘you are welcome; but what go you all three seeking at this hour?’ The brothers —
uz: Bu nimani anglatadi? Shunda, oyoqlariga turib, u dedi: Ey birodarlarim, xush kelibsiz; lekin bu soatda uchingiz nima qidiryapsizlar? Akalar

en: seeing her seated sewing, with no sign of beating on her face, whereas Ar- riguccio avouched that he had beaten her to a mummy —began to marvel and curbing the violence of their anger, demanded of her how that had been whereof Arriguccio accused her, threatening her sore, and she told them not all.
uz: Uning o'tirganini tikayotganini ko'rib, yuziga urish alomatlari yo'q edi, Ar-Riguccio esa uni mumy kabi urganini aytdi  hayratga tushib, ularning g'azablarining zo'ravonligini jilovlay boshladi, undan Arriguccio uni qanday qilib ayblab, og'rig'iga tahdid qilganini talab qildi va u ularga hammasini aytmadi.

en: Quoth she, ‘I know not what you would have me say nor of what Ar- riguccio can have complained to you of me.’ Arriguccio, seeing her thus, eyed her as if he had lost his wits, remembering that he had dealt her belike a thousand buffets on the face and scratched her and done her all the ill in the world, and now he beheld her as if nothing of all this had been.
uz: U aytdi: Men bilmayman, siz menga nima deyishingiz mumkin edi, Arriguccio sizga mendan nima shikoyat qilishi mumkin edi. Arriguccio uni shunday korib, xuddi aqldan ozganidek unga qaradi, uning yuziga mingta bufet berganini esladi va unga butun dunyodagi barcha yomonliklarni qilganini tirnadi, endi esa bularning hech biri bolmagandek unga qaradi.

en: Her brothers told her brieﬂy what they had heard from Arriguccio, twine and beating and all, whereupon she turned to him and said, ‘Alack, husband mine, what is this I hear?
uz: Uning aka-ukalari unga Arriguccio'dan eshitganlarini qisqacha aytib berishdi, u arqon va kaltak va hokazo, shundan so'ng u unga o'girilib dedi: Alak, erim, bu nima eshityapsan?

en: Why wilt thou make me pass, to thine own great shame, for an ill woman, where as I am none, and thyself for a cruel and wicked man, which thou art not?
uz: Nega meni o'zingning buyuk sharmingga, men yo'qdek yomon ayol uchun, va o'zingni zolim va yovuz odam uchun o'tkazasan, sen esa yo'qsan?

en: When wast thou in this house tonight till now, let alone with me?
uz: Qachon bu uyda shu kecha shu paytgacha bo'lding, men bilan birga bo'lmaydimi?

en: When didst thou beat me?
uz: Meni qachon urding?

en: For my part, I have no remembrance of it.’ ‘How, vile woman that thou art!’ cried he.
uz: Mening esa bu haqda hech qanday eslashim yo'q. Qanday jirkanch ayol ekansan! deb baqirdi u.

en: ‘Did we not go to bed together here?
uz: Biz bu yerda birga yotmadikmi?

en: Did I not return hither, after running after thy lov- er?
uz: Men bu yerga qaytib kelmadimmi, sening sevgilining orqasidan yugurib?

en: Did I not deal thee a thousand buffets and cut off thy hair?’ ‘Thou wentest not to bed in this house tonight,’ replied Sismonda.
uz: "Senga mingta bufet bermadimmi va sochlaringni kesmadimmi?" Sen bugun kechasi bu uyda yotmading,  javob berdi Sismonda.

en: ‘But let that pass, for I can give no proof thereof other than mine own true words, and let us come to that which thou sayest, to wit, that thou didst beat me and cut off my hair.
uz: Lekin shuni o'tkazing, chunki men buning isbotini o'z haqiqat so'zlarimdan boshqa hech narsa bera olmayman, va keling, siz meni urib, sochimni kesib tashlaganingiz haqida aytgan gapingizga kelaylik.

en: Me thou hast never beaten, and do all who are here and thou thy- self take note of me, if I have any mark of beating in any part of my person.
uz: Meni hech qachon mag'lub etmagansiz, va bu yerda bo'lganlarning hammasi va o'zing ham, agar shaxsimning biron bir qismida mag'lubiyat alomati bo'lsa, meni e'tiborga ol.

en: Indeed, I should not counsel thee make so bold as to lay a hand on me, for, by Christ His Cross, I would mar thy face for thee!
uz: Darhaqiqat, men senga menga qo'l qo'yishga jur'at etmasligingni maslahat bermas edim, chunki Masih o'z Xoch orqali sen uchun yuzingni so'rardim!

en: Neither didst thou cut off my hair, for aught that I felt or saw; but haply thou didst it on such wise that I perceived it not; let me see if I have it shorn or no.’ Then, putting off her veil from her head, she showed that she had her hair unshorn and whole.
uz: Sen sochlarimni ham kesmading, chunki men hech narsani his qilmadim yoki ko'rmadim; balki shunday donolik bilan qilgansanki, men buni sezmadim; ko'ray, u kesilganmi yoki yo'qmi. Keyin, boshidan parda olib tashlab, u sochlari kesilmagan va butun ekanligini ko'rsatdi.

en: Her mother and brothers, seeing and hearing all this, turned upon her husband and said to him, ‘What meanest thou, Arriguccio?
uz: Uning onasi va aka-ukalari bularning hammasini ko'rib va eshitib, eriga qarab, unga dedilar: Arriguccio, sen nimani nazarda tutyapsan?

en: This is not that so far which thou camest to tell us thou hadst done, and we know not how thou wilt make good the rest.’ Arriguccio stood as one in a trance and would have spoken; but, seeing that it was not as he thought he could show, he dared say nothing; whereupon the lady, turning to her brothers, said to them, ‘Brothers mine, I see he hath gone seeking to have me do what I have never yet chosen to do, to wit, that I should acquaint you with his lewdness and his vile fashions, and I will do it.
uz: Bu sen bizga qilgan ishingni aytishga kelganing emas, qolganini qanday qilib yaxshilashingni bilmaymiz." Arriguccio o'ziga xos holatda turdi va gapirmoqchi edi; lekin, o'zi ko'rsata olmaganini ko'rib, hech narsa demaslikka jur'at etdi; shundan so'ng xonim akalariga qarab dedi: "Ey birodarlarim, men ko'ryapman, u meni hech qachon qilmoqchi bo'lmagan ishni qilishga majburlamoqchi bo'lib ketdi, ya'ni men sizni o'zining behayoligi va jirkanch modalari bilan tanishtirishim kerak, va men buni qilaman."

en: I ﬁrmly believe that this he hath told
uz: Men uning aytganlariga qat'iy ishonaman.

en: you hath verily befallen him and that he hath done as he saith; and you shall hear how.
uz: Albatta, unga tushdingiz va u aytganidek qildi; va qanday ekanligini eshitasizlar.

en: This worthy man, to whom in an ill hour for me you gave me to wife, who calleth himself a merchant and would be thought a man of credit, this fellow, forsooth, who should be more temperate than a monk and chaster than a maid, there be few nights but he goeth fuddling himself about the taverns, foregathering now with this lewd woman and now with that and keeping me waiting for him, on such wise as you ﬁnd me, half the night and whiles even till morning.
uz: Bu munosib odam, menga yomon bir vaqtda xotinlik qildingiz, o'zini savdogar deb ataydi va o'zini hurmatli deb hisoblaydi, bu odam, albatta, rohibdan ko'ra kamtarroq va xizmatkordan ko'ra odobliroq bo'lishi kerak, tunlari kam, lekin u o'zini taomxonalarda o'ynaydi, hozir bu fohisha ayol bilan birga, hozir esa shu bilan birga va meni uni kutib turadi, meni topganingizdek, yarim kechasi va hatto ertalabgacha.

en: I doubt not but that, having well drunken, he went to bed with some trull of his and waking, found the twine on her foot and after did all these his ﬁne feats whereof he telleth, winding up by returning to her and beating her and cutting off her hair; and not being yet well come to himself, he fancied (and I doubt not yet fancieth) that he did all this to me; and if you look him well in the face, you will see he is yet half fuddled.
uz: Shubham yo'q, lekin yaxshi mast bo'lganidan so'ng, u o'zining ba'zi bir to'plami bilan yotdi va uyg'onib, oyog'ida egizakni topdi va keyin u aytgan barcha yaxshi harakatlarini amalga oshirdi, unga qaytib kelib uni urib, sochlarini kesib tashladi; va hali o'ziga kelmaganidan keyin, u bularning hammasini menga qilgan deb o'yladi (va men hali o'ylamayman) va agar unga yaxshi qarasangiz, u hali yarim aldanganini ko'rasiz.

en: Algates, whatsoever he may have said of me, I will not have you take it to yourselves except as a drunken man’s talk, and since I forgive him, do you also pardon him.’ Her mother, hearing this, began to make an outcry and say, ‘By Christ His Cross, daughter mine, it shall not pass thus!
uz: Algates, u men haqimda nima desa ham, men uni mast odamning gapiga o'xshab o'zingizga olib bormasligingizni xohlayman, va men uni kechirganimdan so'ng, uni ham kechirasiz. Onasi buni eshitib, faryod qila boshladi va dedi: "Mening qizim, Masihning Xochiga qasam ichib, bunday bo'lmaydi!"

en: Nay, he should rather be slain for a thankless, ill-conditioned dog, who was never worthy to have a girl of thy fashion to wife.
uz: Yo'q, u minnatdor bo'lmagan, ahvoli yomon it uchun o'ldirilishi yaxshiroq edi, u hech qachon sizning uslubingizdagi qizni xotinlikka olishga loyiq bo'lmagan.

en: Marry, a ﬁne thing, forsooth!
uz: Turmush qur, chiroyli narsa, oldindan!

en: He could have used thee no worse, had he picked thee up out of the dirt!
uz: Agar seni tuproqdan olib chiqqanida, undan ham yomonroq foydalana olmas edi!

en: Devil take him if thou shalt abide at the mercy of the spite of a paltry little merchant of asses’ dung!
uz: Shayton uni ol, agar sen arzimagan eshak savdogarining rahm-shafqati ostida qolsang  axlat!

en: They come to us out of their pigsties in the country, clad in homespun frieze, with their bag-breeches and pen in arse, and as soon as they have gotten a leash of groats, they must e’en have the daughters of gentlemen and right ladies to wife and bear arms and say, “I am of such a family” and “Those of my house did thus and thus.” Would God my sons had followed my counsel in the matter, for that they might have stablished thee so wor- shipfully in the family of the Counts Guidi, with a crust of bread to thy dowry!
uz: Ular qishloqdagi cho'chqaxonalaridan bizga kelishadi, uyga o'rnatiladigan freza kiygan holda, sumka-briketlari va ruchkalari bilan, va ular bir to'rga ega bo'lishlari bilanoq, janoblar va huquqli xonimlarning qizlarini xotinlikka olib, qurol olib, "Men shunday oiladanman" va "Uyimdagilar shunday qildi va shunday qildi" deyishlari kerak. Xudo xohlasa, mening o'g'illarim bu masalada mening maslahatimga amal qilishardi, chunki ular sizni Konts Guidi kemasining oilasiga bir qobiq non bilan shunday tashvish bilan joylashtirgan bo'lardi!

en: But they must needs give thee to this ﬁne jewel of fellow, who, whereas thou art the best girl in Florence and the modestest, is not ashamed to knock us up in the middle of the night, to tell us that thou art a strumpet, as if we knew thee not.
uz: Lekin ular seni Florensiyadagi eng yaxshi qiz va eng kamtarin bo'lsang-da, tun o'rtasida bizni to'xtatib qo'yishdan uyalmaydigandek, go'yo biz seni bilmaganimizdek, sen bir axlat ekanligingni aytishdan uyalmaydigan bu go'zal yigitga berishlari kerak.

en: But, by God His faith, an they would be ruled by me, he should get such a trouncing therefor that he should stink for it!’ Then, turning to the lady’s brothers, ‘My sons,’ said she, ‘I told you this could not be.
uz: Lekin, Xudoga qasamki, Uning imoni bilan, agar ular men tomonidan hukmronlik qilinsa, u shunday mag'lub bo'lishi kerak edi, toki u bundan badbo'y bo'lsin! Keyin xonimning akalariga qarab, O'g'illarim, dedi u, Men sizga bu mumkin emasligini aytgan edim.

en: Have you heard how your ﬁne brother-in-law here entreateth your sister?
uz: Siz bu yerda sizning mehribon qaynog'angiz singlingizga qanday yolvorayotganini eshitdingizmi?

en: Four-farthing355 huckster that he is!
uz: To'rt kishilik 355 ta haydovchi u!

en: Were I in your shoes, he
uz: Agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, u...

en: having said what he hath of her and doing that which he doth, I would never hold myself content nor appeased till I had rid the earth of him; and were I a man, as I am a woman, I would trouble none other than myself to despatch his business.
uz: U unga nisbatan nima degan bo'lsa, o'sha narsani qilgan bo'lsa, men hech qachon o'zimni qoniqtirmasdim va tinchlantirmasdim, toki yer yuzini undan xalos qilmagunimcha; va agar men erkak bo'lsam, men ayol bo'lganimdek, uning ishini tashlash uchun o'zimdan boshqa hech kimni bezovta qilmasdim.

en: Confound him for a sorry drunken beast, that hath no shame!’ The young men, seeing and hearing all this, turned upon Arriguccio and gave him the soundest rating ever losel got; and ultimately they said to him.
uz: Uni sharmanda qiluvchi mast hayvonga aylantiringlar, uyat yo'q! Bularning hammasini ko'rib va eshitib, yigitlar Arrigucchoga yuzlanib, unga eng yaxshi mag'lub bahosini berishdi; va oxir-oqibat unga dedilar.

en: ‘We pardon thee this as to a drunken man; but, as thou tenderest thy life, look henceforward we hear no more news of this kind, for, if aught of the like come ever again to our ears, we will pay thee at once for this and for that.’ So saying, they went their ways, leaving Arriguccio all aghast, as it were he had taken leave of his wits, unknowing in himself whether that which he had done had really been or whether he had dreamed it; wherefore he made no more words thereof, but left his wife in peace.
uz: Biz seni mast odam kabi kechiramiz; lekin, sen hayotingni his qilgandek, bundan buyon bunday xabar eshitmaymiz, chunki agar bunday narsa quloqlarimizga yana kelsa, biz senga bu va bu uchun darhol to'laymiz. Shunday qilib, ular o'z yo'llariga ketishdi va Arrigutchani butunlay hayratda qoldirishdi, go'yo u aqldan ozgan edi, o'zi bilmas edi, nima qilganini rostmi yoki tush ko'rganmi; shuning uchun u bundan keyin bu haqda gapirmadi, balki xotini tinch qo'ydi.

en: Thus the lady, by her ready wit, not only escaped the imminent peril [that threatened her], but opened herself a way to do her every pleasure in time to come, without evermore having any fear of her husband.”
uz: Shunday qilib, xonim o'zining tayyor aqli bilan nafaqat yaqinlashib kelayotgan xavfdan qochdi, balki kelajakda eridan hech qanday qo'rqmasdan, o'ziga har qanday xohish-istakni bajarish yo'lini ochdi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Lydia, wife of Nicostratus, loveth Pyrrhus, who, so he may believe it, requireth of her three things, all which she doth.
uz: TO'qqizinchi Hikoya: Nikostratning xotini Lidiya Pirrni yaxshi ko'radi. Pirr unga ishonishi mumkin bo'lganidek, u undan uchta narsani talab qiladi, bularning barchasini qiladi.

en: Moreover, she solaceth herself with him in the presence of Nicostratus and maketh the latter believe that that which he hath seen is not real.
uz: Qolaversa, u Nikostratning huzurida u bilan o'zini ovutadi va oxirgi odamni u ko'rgan narsa haqiqiy emasligiga ishontiradi.

en: Neiﬁle’s story so pleased the ladies that they could neither give over to laugh at nor to talk of it, albeit the king, having bidden Pamﬁlo tell his story, had several times imposed silence upon them.
uz: Neifile'ning hikoyasi ayollarga shunchalik yoqqan ediki, ular uni na kulishga, na gapirishga majbur bo'lishardi, garchi shoh Pamfiloga o'z hikoyasini aytib berishni buyurgan bo'lsa ham, ularga bir necha bor sukut saqlagan edi.

en: However, after they had held their peace, Pamﬁlo began thus: “I do not believe, worshipful ladies, that there is anything, how hard and doubtful soever it be, that whoso loveth passionately will not dare to do; the which, albeit it hath already been demonstrated in many stories, methinketh, nevertheless, I shall be able yet more plainly to show forth to you in one which I purpose to tell you and wherein you shall hear of a lady, who was in her actions much more favoured of fortune than well-advised of reason; wherefore I would not counsel anyone to adventure herself in the footsteps of her of whom I am to tell, for that fortune is not always well disposed nor are all men in the world equally blind.
uz: Ammo ular jim bo'lishganidan so'ng, Pamfilo shunday boshladi: Men ishonmayman, hurmatli xonimlar, qanday qiyin va shubhali bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, sevgan odam bunga jur'at eta olmaydi; bu, garchi ko'p hikoyalarda allaqachon isbotlangan bo'lsa ham, shunga qaramay, men sizga aytmoqchi bo'lgan bir hikoyada yanada aniqroq ko'rsata olaman va unda siz uning harakatlarida aqldan ko'ra boylikka ko'proq moyil bo'lgan bir xonim haqida eshitasiz; shuning uchun men hech kimga uning izidan sayohat qilishni maslahat bermayman, chunki bu boylik har doim ham yaxshi ko'r bo'lmaydi va dunyodagi barcha odamlar bir xil ko'r emas.

en: In Argos, city of Achia far more famous for its kings of past time than great in itself, there was once a nobleman called Nicostratus, to whom, when already neighbouring on old age, fortune awarded a lady of great fam- ily to wife, whose name was Lydia and who was no less high-spirited than fair.
uz: Argosda, Osiyo shahrida o'tmishdagi podshohlari bilan o'zining buyukligidan ancha mashhur bo'lgan shaharda, bir vaqtlar Nikostratus ismli zodagon bor edi. U keksalikda qo'shni bo'lganida, unga katta oilali xonim, uning ismi Lidiya edi va u go'zallikdan kam bo'lmagan darajada yuqori ruhli edi.

en: Nicostratus, like a nobleman and a man of wealth as he was, kept many servants and hounds and hawks and took the utmost delight in the chase.
uz: Nikostratus, olijanob va boy odam kabi, ko'plab xizmatkorlar, itlar va ko'rshapalaklarni boqib, quvishdan cheksiz zavq olardi.

en: Among his other servants he had a young man called Pyrrhus, who was sprightly and well bred and comely of his person and adroit in all that he had a mind to do, and him he loved and trusted over all else.
uz: Uning boshqa xizmatkorlari orasida Pirrus ismli bir yigit bor edi. U yorqin, yaxshi tarbiyalangan va o'ziga xos, har bir ishida mohir edi. Uni hamma narsadan ko'ra sevardi va ishonardi.

en: Lydia became so sore enamoured that neither by day nor by night could she have her thought otherwhere than with him; but he, whether it was that he perceived not her liking for him or that he would none of it, appeared to reck nothing thereof, by reason whereof the lady suffered intolerable chag- rin in herself and being altogether resolved to give him to know of her pas- sion, called a chamberwoman of hers, Lusca by name, in whom she much trusted, and said to her, ‘Lusca, the favours thou hast had of me should make thee faithful and obedient; wherefore look thou none ever know that which I shall presently say to thee, save he to whom I shall charge thee tell it.
uz: Lidiya shu qadar qattiq oshiq bo'ldiki, na kunduzi, na kechasi uning fikrini undan boshqa hech qayerda ko'ra olmasdi; lekin u, uning unga yoqqanini sezmasligidan yoki hech narsasini xohlamasligidan qat'i nazar, hech narsa bilan ahamiyatga ega emas edi. Shuning uchun xonim o'zida chidab bo'lmas azob chekkan va umuman unga o'z xonadonidan xabar berishga qaror qilgan edi. Uning xonasi, uning ismi Luska edi, unga juda ishonardi va unga dedi: "Luska, mendan qilgan yaxshiliklar seni sadoqatli va itoatkor qilgandir; shuning uchun ko'r, men senga nima deyishimni hech kim bilmaydi, faqat unga aytaman."

en: As thou seest, Lusca, I am a young and lusty lady, abundantly endowed with all those things which any woman can desire; in brief, I can complain of but one thing, to wit, that my husband’s years are overmany, an they be measured by mine own, wherefore I fare but ill in the matter of that thing wherein young women take most pleasure, and none the less desiring it, as other women do, I have this long while determined in myself, since fortune hath been thus little my friend in giving me so old a husband, that I will not be so much mine own enemy as not to contrive to ﬁnd means for my pleas- ures and my weal; which that I may have as complete in this as in other things, I have bethought myself to will that our Pyrrhus, as being worthier thereof than any other, should furnish them with his embracements; nay, I have vowed him so great a love that I never feel myself at ease save whenas I see
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, Luska, men yosh va shahvatparast ayolman, har qanday ayol xohlashi mumkin bo'lgan barcha narsalarga boyman; qisqacha aytganda, faqat bir narsadan shikoyat qila olaman, ya'ni, erimning yoshi o'zimniki bilan o'lchanadi, shuning uchun men yosh ayollar eng ko'p zavq oladigan va undan kamroq umid qilmaydigan narsa masalasida juda yomon yashayman, boshqa ayollar kabi, men o'zimda shu qadar uzoq vaqt qaror qildim, chunki omad menga shunchalik eski erni bergan, men o'z xohishlarim va hayotim uchun hech qanday vosita topishga harakat qilmayman; men buni boshqa narsalarda ham to'liq his qilmasligim kerak, chunki men Pyrrning, boshqa har qanday kabi, uni o'zim bilan birga quchoqlashim kerakligini his qilganman, men hech qachon o'zimni shunday...

en: him or think of him, and except I foregather with him without delay, methinketh I shall certainly die thereof.
uz: U haqida o'ylab ko'ring, agar men u bilan zudlik bilan uchrashmasam, albatta o'laman deb o'ylayman.

en: Wherefore, if my life be dear to thee, thou wilt, on such wise as shall seem best to thee, signify to him any love and beseech him, on my part, to be pleased to come to me, whenas thou shalt go for him.’ The chamberwoman replied that she would well and taking Pyrrhus apart, whenas ﬁrst it seemed to her time and place, she did her lady’s errand to him as best she knew.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar hayotim senga qadrli bo'lsa, senga ma'qul ko'ringan tarzda unga muhabbat ko'rsat va men tomondan uni o'zi uchun borganda, menga kelishga rozi bo'lishini iltimos qil." Xona xodimi javob berdi: "Yaxshi bo'lardi va Pirrusni olib tashlardi, avval vaqt va joyga o'xshardi, u xonimning unga topshirig'ini o'zi bilganidek qildi."

en: Pyrrhus, hearing this, was sore amazed thereat, as one who had never anywise perceived aught of the matter, and misdoubted him the lady had let say this to him to try him; wherefore he answered roughly and hastily, ‘Lusca, I cannot believe that these words come from my lady; wherefore, have a care what thou sayst; or, if they do indeed come from her, I do not believe that she caused thee say them with intent, and even if she did so, my lord doth me more honour than I deserve and I would not for my life do him such an outrage; wherefore look thou bespeak me no more of such things.’ Lusca, nowise daunted by his austere speech, said to
uz: Pirrus buni eshitib, bundan juda hayron bo'ldi, chunki u hech qachon bu masalani anglamagan edi va xonim unga buni uni sinash uchun aytganiga shubha qildi; shuning uchun u qo'pol va shoshilinch javob berdi: "Luska, men bu so'zlar xonimdan kelishiga ishonmayman; shuning uchun, sening gapingdan ehtiyot bo'l; yoki, agar ular haqiqatan ham undan kelgan bo'lsa, u senga ularni qasddan aytishga majbur qilganligiga ishonmayman, va agar u shunday qilsa ham, xo'jayinim menga loyiq bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq hurmat ko'rsatadi va men unga hayotim uchun bunday haqorat qilmoqchi emasman."

en: him, ‘Pyrrhus, I will e’en bespeak thee both of this and of everything else wherewithal my lady shall charge me when and as often as she shall bid me, whether it cause thee pleasure or annoy; but thou art an ass.’ Then, some- what despited at his words, she returned to her mistress, who, hearing what Pyrrhus had said, wished for death, but, some days after, she again bespoke the chamberwoman of the matter and said to her, ‘Lusca, thou knowest that the oak falleth not for the ﬁrst stroke; wherefore meseemeth well that thou return anew to him who so strangely willeth to abide loyal to my prejudice, and taking a sortable occasion, throughly discover to him my passion and do thine every endeavour that the thing may have effect; for that, an it fall through thus, I shall assuredly die of it.
uz: U unga dedi: Pirrus, men senga bu haqda ham, xonim menga qachon va qachon buyursa, menga ayblov qo'yadigan hamma narsa haqida ham gapiraman, xoh bu senga yoqsa ham, xoh bezovta qilmasa ham; lekin sen eshaksan. Keyin, ba'zi bir narsalar uning so'zlaridan jirkanch bo'lib, u xotiniga qaytdi. Pirrus aytganini eshitib, o'limni tiladi, lekin bir necha kundan keyin u yana bu masalada xonadon xodimiga murojaat qildi va unga dedi: Lusca, sen bilasan, eman birinchi zarba uchun tushmaydi; shuning uchun, g'alati tarzda mening xurofotimga sodiq bo'lishni istagan odamga yana sodiq bo'lishing kerak, va bir imkoniyatni qo'lga olib, uni o'limdan o'tishga undaydi, va men uning har bir narsasi uchun...

en: Moreover, he will think to have been befooled, and whereas we seek to have his love, hate will ensue there- of.’ The maid comforted her and going in quest of Pyrrhus found him merry and well-disposed and said to him, ‘Pyrrhus I showed thee, a few days agone, in what a ﬁre my lady and thine abideth for the love she beareth thee, and now anew I certify thee thereof, for that, an thou persist in the rigour thou showedst the other day, thou mayst be assured that she will not live long; wherefore I prithee be pleased to satisfy her of her desire, and if thou yet abide fast in thine obstinacy, whereas I have still accounted thee mighty discreet, I shall hold thee a blockhead.
uz: Qolaversa, u o'zini befarq deb o'ylaydi va biz uning muhabbatiga ega bo'lishni istaganimizda, nafrat ham u yerda ta'minlanadi. Qiz uni yupatib, Pirrni qidirib borar ekan, uni xursand va xushmuomala holda topdi va unga dedi: "Pirr, men senga bir necha kun oldin, xonim va sening senga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun qanday olovda yashayotganingni ko'rsatdim. Endi yana bir bor tasdiqlayman, chunki sen o'sha kuni ko'rsatgan qattiqqo'llikda, u uzoq umr ko'rmasligiga amin bo'lishing mumkin; shuning uchun men uni o'z xohishidan qondirishni xohlayman va agar sen hali ham qattiqqo'l bo'lsang, men hali ham seni qattiq saqlayman, men seni qattiq saqlayman."

en: What can be a greater glory for thee than that such a lady, so fair and so noble, should love thee over all else?
uz: Senga shunday go'zal va olijanob xonim seni hamma narsadan ham ko'proq sevishidan ko'ra buyukroq sharaf nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Besides, how greatly shouldst thou acknowledge thyself beholden unto Fortune, seeing that she proffereth thee a thing of such worth and so conformable to the desires of thy youth and to boot, such a resource for thy necessities!
uz: Qolaversa, o'zingni omadga qanchalik qarzdor ekanligingni tan olishing kerak, chunki u senga shunday qimmatli va yoshliging istaklariga mos keladigan, ehtiyojlaring uchun shunday resurs taklif qilmoqda!

en: Which of thy peers knowest thou who fareth better by way of delight than thou mayst fare, an thou be wise?
uz: Sizning tengdoshlaringizdan qaysi birini bilasizki, u sizdan ko'ra ko'proq xursandchilikda yaxshiroq yashaydi va siz dono bo'lasiz?

en: What other couldst thou ﬁnd who may fare so well in the matter of arms and horses and apparel and monies as thou mayst do, so thou wilt but vouchsafe thy love to this lady?
uz: Qurol-yarog', otlar, kiyim-kechak va pul masalasida senchalik yaxshi ishlaydigan boshqa kimni topa olarding, shunda sen bu xonimga muhabbatingni bag'ishlaysan?

en: Open, then, thy mind to my words and return to thy senses; bethink thee that once, and no oftener, it is wont to betide that fortune cometh unto a man with smiling face and open arms, who an he know not then to wel- come, if after he ﬁnd himself poor and beggarly, he hath himself and not her to blame.
uz: Shunday ekan, ongingni mening so'zlarimga och va o'z aql-idrokingga qayt; shuni o'yla, bir marta, va undan ko'ra ko'p emas, baxt tabassumli yuzli va ochiq qo'llar bilan keladigan odamga kelishi odatiy hol, uni qabul qilishni bilmasa, agar u o'zini kambag'al va tilanchi deb topsa, u o'ziga emas, balki unga aybdor bo'ladi.

en: Besides, there is no call to use that loyalty between servants and masters that behoveth between friends and kinsfolk; nay, servants should use their masters, in so far as they may, like as themselves are used of them.
uz: Qolaversa, xizmatkorlar va xo'jayinlar o'rtasidagi sadoqatni do'stlar va qarindoshlar o'rtasida zarur bo'lganidek ishlatishga chaqiruv yo'q; aksincha, xizmatkorlar o'z xo'jayinlaridan, ularga nisbatan o'zlari qanday foydalanilsa, shunday foydalanishlari kerak.

en: Thinkest thou, an thou hadst a fair wife or mother or daughter or sister, who
uz: O'ylaysizmi, agar sizda chiroyli xotin, ona, qiz yoki opa-singil bo'lsa, kim...

en: pleased Nicostratus, that he would go questing after this loyalty that thou wouldst fain observe towards him in respect of this lady?
uz: Nikostratni xursand qildingizmi, u bu xonimga nisbatan unga nisbatan ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lgan sadoqatingizni izlab borishini?

en: Thou are a fool, if thou think thus; for thou mayst hold it for certain that, if blandishments and prayers sufﬁced him not, he would not scruple to use force in the matter, whatsoever thou mightest deem thereof.
uz: Sen ahmoqsan, agar shunday o'ylaysan; chunki shubhasizki, agar unga masxarabozlar va duolar yetarli bo'lmasa, u bu masalada, siz qanday ko'rsangiz ham, kuch ishlatishni xohlamaydi.

en: Let us, then, entreat them and their affairs even as they entreat us and ours.
uz: Bas, ularga va ularning ishlariga, xuddi ular bizga va biznikiga iltijo qilganidek, iltijo qilaylik.

en: Proﬁt by the favour of fortune and drive her not away, but welcome her with open arms and meet her halfway, for assuredly, and thou do it not, thou wilt yet (leave alone the death that will without fail ensue thereof to thy lady) repent thee thereof so many a time thou wilt be fain to die therefor.’ Pyrrhus, who had again and again pondered the words that Lusca had said to him, had determined, and she should return to him, to make her an- other guess answer and altogether to submit himself to comply with the lady’s wishes, so but he might be certiﬁed that it was not a trick to try him, and accordingly answered, ‘Harkye, Lusca; all that thou sayst to me I allow to be true; but, on the other hand, I know my lord for very discreet and well-advised, and as he committeth all his affairs to my hands, I am sore ad- read lest Lydia, with his counsel and by his wish, do this to try me; where-
uz: Omaddan foyda oling va uni haydab yubormang, balki uni ochiq qo'llar bilan kutib oling va yarim yo'lda uchrashing, albatta, lekin unday qilmaysiz, siz hali ham (o'limni xotiningizga albatta ta'minlaydigan) undan shunchalik ko'p marta tavba qilasizki, o'lmaysiz." Pirsus, Lushka unga aytgan so'zlarni qayta-qayta o'ylab, unga qaytishi kerakligini aniqladi, uni boshqacha javob berishga va xotinning xohishlariga rozi bo'lishga, lekin u uni sinash hiyla emasligiga amin bo'lishi uchun va shunga mos ravishda javob berdi: "Ha, men sizga ruxsat beraman; lekin, men o'z qo'llarim bilan maslahat beraman va men buni yaxshi bilaman, chunki u Lidiya bilan...

en: fore, an it please her for mine assurance do three things that I shall ask, she shall for certain thereafterward command me nought but I will do it forth- right.
