uz: Provost, o'z navbatida, bu haqda eshitib, katta shov-shuv ko'tardi; lekin, do'stlari unga bu faqat Florensiyaliklar qanday qilib, u sudyalarni olib kelishi kerak bo'lsa, ularga achinarli yamoqlarni olib kelganini yaxshi tushunishlarini bildirish uchun qilinganini ko'rsatdi, shuning uchun ularni arzonroq qilish uchun, ularni tinch qo'yish yaxshiroq deb o'yladi va shuning uchun bu narsa uzoqqa ketmaydi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY Bruno and Buffalmacco, having stolen a pig from Calandrino, make him try the ordeal with ginger boluses and sack and give him (instead of the ginger) two dog-balls compounded with aloes, whereby it appeareth that he himself hath had the pig and they make him pay blackmail, an he would not have them tell his wife.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Bruno va Buffalmacco Calandrino'dan cho'chqa o'g'irlab, unga zanjabil boluslari va xaltasi bilan sinovdan o'tkazishga majbur qilishadi va unga (zanjabil o'rniga) aloye bilan aralashtirilgan ikkita it to'pi berishadi, shunda u o'zi cho'chqani olgan ko'rinadi va ular uni shantaj qilishga majbur qilishadi, lekin u ularning xotiniga aytishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: No sooner had Filostrato despatched his story, which had given rise to many a laugh, than the queen bade Filomena follow on, whereupon she began: “Gracious ladies, even as Filostrato was led by the mention of Maso to tell the story which you have just heard from him, so neither more nor less am I moved by that of Calandrino and his friends to tell you another of them, which methinketh will please you.
uz: Filostrato o'z hikoyasini yuborishi bilanoq, bu ko'p kulgiga sabab bo'ldi, qirolicha Filomena keyinroq davom etdi va u shunday dedi: Hazratli xonimlar, Filostrato Maso haqida siz undan eshitgan hikoyani aytib berishga undalganidek, men ham Calandrino va uning do'stlarining sizga ulardan yana birini aytib berishiga unchalik ham undamayman, chunki u sizga yoqadi deb o'ylayman.

en: Who Calandrino, Bruno and Buffalmacco were I need not explain to you, for that you have already heard it well enough; wherefore, to proceed with my story, I must tell you that Calandrino owned a little farm at no great dis- tance from Florence, that he had had to his wife’s dowry.
uz: Calandrino, Bruno va Buffalmacco kim ekanligi haqida sizga tushuntirishim shart emas, chunki siz buni allaqachon yetarli darajada yaxshi eshitgansiz; shuning uchun, hikoyamni davom ettirish uchun sizga aytishim kerakki, Calandrino Florensiyadan uncha katta bo'lmagan kichik fermaga ega edi, u o'z xotinining marosimiga ega edi.

en: From this farm, amongst other things that he got thence, he had every year a pig, and it was his wont still to betake himself thither, he and his wife, and kill the pig and have it salted on the spot.
uz: Bu fermadan, u yerdan olgan boshqa narsalar qatorida, har yili bir cho'chqa bor edi va u yerda o'zini, xotini bilan o'ynash, cho'chqani o'ldirish va uni joyida tuzlatish odati edi.

en: It chanced one year that, his wife being somewhat ailing, he went himself to kill the pig, which Bruno and Buffalmacco hear- ing and knowing that his wife was not gone to the farm with him, they re- paired to a priest, very great friend of theirs and a neighbor of Calandrino, to sojourn some days with him.
uz: Bir yil o'tgach, xotini biroz kasal bo'lgani uchun, u o'zi cho'chqani o'ldirishga bordi. Buni Bruno va Buffalmacco eshitib, xotini u bilan fermaga bormaganini bilgach, ular bir ruhoniyga, o'zlarining juda yaxshi do'stiga va Kalandrino qo'shnisiga bir necha kun qolish uchun qayta qo'shilishdi.

en: Now Calandrino had that very morning killed the pig and seeing them with the priest, called to them saying, ‘You are welcome.
uz: Calandrino o'sha kuni ertalab cho'chqani o'ldirdi va ularni ruhoniy bilan ko'rib, ularni chaqirib dedi: Xush kelibsiz.

en: I would fain have you see what a good husband384 I am.’ Then carrying them into the house, he showed them the pig, which they seeing to be a very ﬁne one and understanding from Calandrino that he meant to salt
uz: Sizga qanday yaxshi er ekanligimni ko'rishni xohlardim. 384" Keyin ularni uyga olib kirgach, u cho'chqani ko'rsatdi, ular uni juda chiroyli ekanligini ko'rishdi va Calandrino'dan tuzmoqchi ekanligini tushunishdi.

en: it down for his family, ‘Good lack,’ quoth Bruno to him, ‘what a ninny thou art!
uz: O'z oilasi uchun shunday dedi: "Yaxshi yetishmayapti," deb javob berdi Bruno unga, "Qanday ahmoqsan-a!"

en: Sell it and let us make merry with the price, and tell thy wife that it hath been stolen from thee.’ ‘Nay,’ answered Calandrino, ‘she would never be- lieve it and would drive me out of the house.
uz: Uni soting, narx bilan xursand bo'laylik va xotiningizga aytingki, u sizdan o'g'irlangan. Yo'q,  javob berdi Kalandrino,  u hech qachon uni yoqtirmasdi va meni uydan haydab chiqarmoqchi edi.

en: Spare your pains, for I will never do it.’ And many were the words, but they availed nothing.
uz: Og'riqlaringni saqla, chunki men buni hech qachon qilmayman." Va so'zlar ko'p edi, lekin hech qanday foyda bermadi.

en: Calandrino invited them to supper, but with so ill a grace that they re- fused to sup there and took their leave of him; whereupon quoth Bruno and Buffalmacco, ‘What sayest thou to stealing yonder pig from him tonight?’ ‘Marry,’ replied the other, ‘how can we do it?’ Quoth Bruno, ‘I can see how well enough, an he remove it not from where it was but now.’ ‘Then,’ re- joined his companion, ‘let us do it.
uz: Kalandrino ularni kechki ovqatga taklif qildi, lekin shunchalik yomon marhamat bilan ular u yerda yana birga ovqatlanishdi va undan xayrlashdilar; shundan so'ng Bruno va Buffalmacco: "Bu tun undan o'sha cho'chqani o'g'irlashga nima deysiz?" - dedi, "Marry," javob berdi ikkinchisi: "Buni qanday qilish mumkin?" - dedi Bruno: "Men buni qanchalik yaxshi ko'ryapman, lekin u uni hozirgi joydan olib tashlamadi." - "Endi," - dedi hamroziga qo'shilgan, "keling, biz buni qilaylik."

en: And after we will make merry over it with the parson here.’ The priest answered that he would well, and Bruno said, ‘Here must some little art be used.
uz: Va keyin biz bu yerda ruhoniy bilan xursand bo'lamiz." Ruhoniy yaxshi bo'lardi, deb javob berdi va Bruno dedi: "Bu yerda kichik san'at ishlatilishi kerak."

en: Thou knowest, Buffalmacco, how niggardly Calandrino is and how gladly he drinketh when others pay; let us go and carry him to the tavern, where the priest shall make believe to pay the whole scot in our honor nor suffer him to pay aught.
uz: Siz bilasiz, Buffalmacco, Calandrino qanchalik beparvo va boshqalar to'laganida qanchalik xursand bo'lib ichishini; keling, uni tavernga olib boraylik, u yerda ruhoniy bizning sharafimizga butun Shotlandiyani to'lashga ishonadi va unga hech narsa to'lashga ruxsat bermaydi.

en: Calandrino will soon grow fuddled and then we can manage it lightly enough, for that he is alone in the house.’ As he said, so they did and Calandrino seeing that the priest suffered none to pay, gave himself up to drinking and took in a good load, albeit it needed no great matter to make him drunk.
uz: Kalandrino tez orada o'sadi va keyin biz buni yetarlicha yengil uddalay olamiz, chunki u uyda yolg'iz." U aytganidek, ular shunday qilishdi va Kalandrino ruhoniyning hech qanday to'lovga yo'l qo'ymasligini ko'rib, o'zini ichishga bag'ishladi va yaxshi yukni qabul qildi, garchi uni mast qilish uchun katta narsa kerak bo'lmasa ham.

en: It was pretty late at night when they left the tavern and Calandrino, without troubling himself about supper, went straight home, where, thinking to have shut the door, he left it open and betook himself to bed.
uz: Kechasi ancha kech bo'lgan edi, ular tavernni tark etishdi va Calandrino kechki ovqat haqida tashvishlanmasdan to'g'ri uyga bordi, u yerda eshikni yopdim deb o'ylab, uni ochiq qoldirdi va o'zini yotqizdi.

en: Buffalmacco and Bruno went off to sup with the priest and after supper repaired quietly to Calandrino’s house, carrying with them certain imple- ments wherewithal to break in whereas Bruno had appointed it; but, ﬁnding the door open, they entered and unhooking the pig, carried it off to the priest’s house, where they laid it up and betook themselves to sleep.
uz: Buffalmacco va Bruno ruhoniy bilan kechki ovqatga ketishdi va kechki ovqatdan so'ng Calandrino'ning uyiga sekin borishdi. Ular bilan birga Bruno buyurganidek, u yerga kirish uchun ba'zi usullarni olib kelishdi; lekin eshik ochiq bo'lganini topib, ichkariga kirib, cho'chqani yechib, ruhoniyning uyiga olib ketishdi, u yerda uni qo'yib, uxlashga majbur qilishdi.

en: On the morrow, Calandrino, having slept off the fumes of the wine, arose in the morning and going down, missed his pig and saw the door open; whereupon he questioned this one and that if they knew who had taken it and getting no news of it, began to make a great outcry, saying, ‘Woe is me, miserable wretch that I am!’ for that the pig had been stolen from him.
uz: Ertasi kuni Calandrino, vino tutunidan uxlab, ertalab turib pastga tushdi, cho'chqasini sog'inib, eshikni ochilganini ko'rdi; shundan so'ng, uni kim olganini bilsalar va bundan xabar topmasalar, katta faryod chiqara boshladilar va dedilar: "Voy menga, bechora menman!" chunki undan cho'chqa o'g'irlangan edi.

en: As soon as Bruno and Buffalmacco were risen, they repaired to Calandrino’s house, to hear what he would say anent the pig, and he no sooner saw them than he called out to them, well nigh weeping, and said, ‘Woe’s me, com- rades mine; my pig hath been stolen from me!’ Whereupon Bruno came up
uz: Bruno va Buffalmacco tirilgach, ular Kalandrino uyiga yo'l olishdi, u cho'chqa haqida nima deyayotganini eshitish uchun. U ularni tez orada ko'rmadi, shunda u ularga yaqinlashib yig'lab, dedi: "Voy menga, mening qo'rtoqlarim; mening cho'chkam mendan o'g'irlandi!" Shunda Bruno keldi.

en: to him and said softly, ‘It is a marvel that thou hast been wise for once.’ ‘Alack,’ replied Calandrino, ‘indeed I say sooth.’ ‘That’s the thing to say,’ quoth Bruno.
uz: Unga dedi va sekin: Bir marta dono bo'lganing ajoyib!  Alack,  javob berdi Kalandrino,  haqiqatan ham tinchman.  Shunday gap,  dedi Bruno.

en: ‘Make a great outcry, so it may well appear that it is e’en as thou sayst.’ Therewithal Calandrino bawled out yet loudlier, saying, ‘Cock’s body, I tell thee it hath been stolen from me in good earnest!’ ‘Good, good,’ replied Bruno; ‘that’s the way to speak; cry out lustily, make thyself well heard, so it may seem true.’ Quoth Calandrino, ‘Thou wouldst make me give my soul to the Fiend!
uz: Katta faryod qiling, shunda u siz aytganingizdek ko'rinishi mumkin. Shundan so'ng, Kalandrino yanada baland ovoz bilan baqirib, dedi: Tovuqning jasadi, senga aytaman, u mendan chin dildan o'g'irlandi! Yaxshi, yaxshi,  javob berdi Bruno; Shu gapirish usuli; o'zingni yaxshi eshit, shunda bu rost bo'lib ko'rinishi mumkin. Kalandrino aytdi: Sen meni jonimni Iblisga berishga majbur qilmoqchisan!

en: I tell thee and thou believest me not.
uz: Senga aytyapman, lekin sen menga ishonmaysan.

en: May I be strung up by the neck an it have not been stolen from me!’ ‘Good lack!’ cried Bruno.
uz: "Mendan o'g'irlanmagan bo'lsam ham, bo'ynimdan bog'langan bo'lishsin!"  Yaxshi yetishmayapti!  deb baqirdi Bruno.

en: I saw it here but yesterday.
uz: Men buni bu yerda ko'rdim, lekin kecha.

en: Thinkest thou to make me believe that it hath ﬂown away?’ Quoth Calandrino, ‘It is as I tell thee.’ ‘Good lack,’ repeated Bruno, ‘can it be?’ ‘Certes,’ replied Calandrino, ‘it is so, more by token that I am undone and know not how I shall return home.
uz: Meni u uchib ketganiga ishontirasizmi deb o'ylayapsanmi? Kalandrino aytdi: Men senga aytganimdek. Yaxshi yetishmayapti, takrorladi Bruno, bo'lishi mumkinmi? Albatta,  javob berdi Kalandrino, bu shunday, ko'proq men yo'q bo'lib ketganim va uyga qanday qaytishni bilmasligim sababli.

en: My wife will never believe me; or even if she do, I shall have no peace with her this year to come.’ Quoth Bruno, ‘So God save me, this is ill done, if it be true; but thou knowest, Calandrino, I lessoned thee yesterday to say thus and I would not have thee at once cozen thy wife and us.’ There- withal Calandrino fell to crying out and saying, ‘Alack, why will you drive me to desperation and make me blaspheme God and the Saints?
uz: Xotinim menga hech qachon ishonmaydi; yoki agar u ishonsa ham, bu yil ham u bilan tinchlik bo'lmaydi." Brunu aytdi: "Xudo meni saqlasin, bu noto'g'ri ish, agar rost bo'lsa; lekin bilasan, Kalandrino, men seni kecha shunday deyishga o'rgatdim va seni bir zumda xotiningni va bizni qo'zg'atishni xohlamas edim." U yerda Kalandrino qichqirib dedi: "Lalak, nega meni umidsizlikka solib, Xudoni va Avliyolarni kufrlamoqchi bo'lishga majbur qilyapsan?"

en: I tell you the pig was stolen from me yesternight.’ Then said Buffalmacco, ‘If it be so indeed, we must cast about for a means of having it again, an we may contrive it.’ ‘But what means,’ asked Calandrino, ‘can we ﬁnd?’ Quoth Buffalmacco, ‘We may be sure that there hath come none from the Indies to rob thee of thy pig; the thief must have been some one of thy neighbors.
uz: Sizga aytaman, kecha kechqurun mendan cho'chqa o'g'irlandi." Shunda Buffalmacco dedi: "Agar shunday bo'lsa, uni yana olish uchun bir vosita qidirib tashlashimiz kerak, shunda uni o'ylab topishimiz mumkin." "Lekin nima degani," dedi Kalandrino, "topishimiz mumkinmi?" Buffalmacco javob berdi: "Biz Hindistondan hech kim kelmaganligiga amin bo'lishimiz mumkin, seni cho'chkangdan o'g'irlab ketgani yo'q; o'g'ri qo'shninglardan biri bo'lishi kerak."

en: An thou canst make shift to assemble them, I know how to work the ordeal by bread and cheese and we will presently see for certain who hath had it.’ ‘Ay,’ put in Bruno, ‘thou wouldst make a ﬁne thing of bread and cheese with such gentry as we have about here, for one of them I am certain hath had the pig, and he would smoke the trap and would not come.’ ‘How, then, shall we do?’ asked Buffalmacco, and Bruno said, ‘We must e’en do it with ginger boluses and good vernage385 and invite them to drink.
uz: "Sen ularni yig'ish uchun o'zgarish qila olasan, men non va pishloq bilan muammoni qanday ishlashni bilaman va biz uni kimga berganini tez orada aniq ko'ramiz." "Ay," - deb qo'ydi Bruno, - sen bu yerda bor kabi odob bilan non va pishloqdan yaxshi narsa yasamoqchisan, chunki ulardan birida cho'chqa bo'lgani aniq edi, u tuzoqni tutadi va kelmas edi." "Unda nima qilamiz?" - deb so'radi Buffalmacco, va Bruno dedi: "Biz buni zanjabil boluslari va yaxshi Vernage385 bilan qilishimiz kerak va ularni ichishga taklif qilamiz."

en: They will suspect nothing and come, and the ginger boluses can be blessed even as the bread and cheese.’ Quoth Buffalmacco, ‘Indeed, thou sayst sooth.
uz: Ular hech narsaga shubha qilmaydilar va kelishadi, va zanjabil boluslari non va pishloq kabi baraka topishi mumkin. Quoth Buffalmacco, Haqiqatan ham, siz tinchlik deyapsiz.

en: What sayst thou, Calandrino?
uz: Siz nima deysiz, Kalandrino?

en: Shall’s do ’t?’ ‘Nay,’ replied the gull, ‘I pray you thereof for the love of God; for, did I but know who hath had it, I should hold myself half con- soled.’ ‘Marry, then,’ said Bruno, ‘I am ready to go to Florence, to oblige
uz: "Bo'ladimi, yo'qmi?" Yo'q, javob berdi Oltin, Men sizdan buni Xudoning muhabbati uchun so'rayman; chunki, kimda borligini bilsam, o'zimni yarim yolg'iz tutishim kerak edi.  Unda turmush qur, dedi Bruno, Men Florensiyaga borishga tayyorman, majburlash uchun.

en: thee, for the things aforesaid, so thou wilt give me the money.’ Now Calandrino had maybe forty shillings, which he gave him, and Bruno ac- cordingly repaired to Florence to a friend of his, a druggist, of whom he bought a pound of ﬁne ginger boluses and caused compound a couple of dogballs with fresh confect of hepatic aloes; after which he let cover these latter with sugar, like the others, and set thereon a privy mark by which he might very well know them, so he should not mistake them nor change them.
uz: "Sen, yuqorida aytilgan narsalar uchun, demak, menga pul berasan." Endi Kalandrinoda qirq shilling bo'lishi mumkin edi, uni u bergan edi va Bruno uni Florensiyaga do'stiga, giyohvandga mos ravishda ta'mirladi. U undan bir funt ingichka bolus sotib oldi va bir nechta it bolalarini yangi qovurilgan jigar aloosi bilan biriktirdi; shundan so'ng u bularni boshqalarga o'xshab shakar bilan yopdi va ularga ularni juda yaxshi tanishadigan shaxsiy belgi qo'ydi, shuning uchun ularni adashtirmasligi kerak edi va o'zgartirmasligi kerak edi.

en: Then, buying a ﬂask of good vernage, he returned to Calandrino in the country and said to him, ‘Do thou tomorrow morning invite those whom thou suspectest to drink with thee; it is a holiday and all will willingly come.
uz: So'ngra bir banka yaxshi vino sotib olib, u qishloqqa, Kalandrinoga qaytib keldi va unga dedi: Ertaga ertalab o'zing gumon qilayotganlarni o'zing bilan birga ichishga taklif qil; bu bayram va hamma xohlab keladi.

en: Meanwhile, Buffalmacco and I will tonight make the conjuration over the pills and bring them to thee tomorrow morning at home; and for the love of thee I will administer them myself and do and say that which is to be said and done.’ Calandrino did as he said and assembled on the following morning a goodly company of such young Florentines as were presently about the vil- lage and of husbandmen; whereupon Bruno and Buffalmacco came with a box of pills and the ﬂask of wine and made the folk stand in a ring.
uz: Ayni paytda, Buffalmacco va men bugun kechqurun tabletkalar haqida g'oya tuzamiz va ularni ertaga ertalab uyingizga olib kelamiz; va seni sevganim uchun ularni o'zim boshqaraman va aytiladigan va qilinadigan narsalarni qilaman." Kalandrino aytganidek qildi va ertasi kuni ertalab villa-lage va dehqonlar haqida shunday yaxshi Florensiyaliklarni yig'di; shundan so'ng Bruno va Buffalmacco bir quti tabletkalar va vino bilan kelishdi va xalqni bir halqaga qo'ydi.

en: Then said Bruno, ‘Gentlemen, needs must I tell you the reason wherefore you are here, so that, if aught betide that please you not, you may have no cause to complain of me.
uz: Shunda Bruno dedi: Janoblar, men sizga bu yerda bo'lishingizning sababini aytishim kerak, shunda, agar sizga yoqmaydigan biror narsa bo'lsa, mendan shikoyat qilishga hech qanday asosingiz bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: Calandrino here was robbed yesternight of a ﬁne pig, nor can he ﬁnd who hath had it; and for that none other than some one of us who are here can have stolen it from him, he proffereth each of you, that he may discover who hath had it, one of these pills to eat and a draught of wine.
uz: Kalandrino bu yerda kecha yaxshi cho'chqa o'g'irlandi, uni kimga berganini topa olmaydi; va shuning uchun undan uni o'g'irlaganlardan boshqa hech kim yo'q, u har biringizni o'g'irlaydi, kimga berganini topishi uchun, yeydigan tabletkalardan birini va bir qultum vino.

en: Now you must know that he who hath had the pig will not be able to swallow the pill; nay, it will seem to him more bitter than poison and he will spit it out; wherefore, rather than that shame be done him in the pres- ence of so many, he were better tell it to the parson by way of confession and I will proceed no farther with this matter.’ All who were there declared that they would willingly eat of the pills, whereupon Bruno ranged them in order and set Calandrino among them; then, beginning at one end of the line, he proceeded to give each his bolus, and whenas he came over against Calandrino, he took one of the dogballs and put it into his hand.
uz: Endi bilishingiz kerakki, cho'chqa bo'lgan odam tabletkani yutolmaydi; aksincha, u zahardan ham achchiqroq tuyuladi va u uni tupuradi; shuning uchun, bu sharmandalik unga ko'pchilik oldida sodir bo'lishidan ko'ra, u buni parsonga iqror bo'lish orqali aytishi yaxshiroq edi va men bu masalada undan uzoqroq bormayman.

en: Calandrino clapped it incontinent into his mouth and began to chew it; but no sooner did his tongue taste the aloes, than he spat it out again, being unable to brook the bitterness.
uz: Kalandrino uni tinimsiz og'ziga urdi va chaynay boshladi; lekin tili aloya ta'mini tezda tatib ko'rmay, yana tupurib chiqardi, achchiqlikni yo'qotishga qodir bo'lmadi.

en: Meanwhile, each was looking other in the face, to see who should spit out his bolus, and whilst
uz: Ayni paytda, har biri o'z bolusini kim tupurishi kerakligini ko'rish uchun bir-birining yuziga qarardi va...

en: Bruno, not having made an end of serving them out, went on to do so, feigning to pay no heed to Calandrino’s doing, he heard say behind him, ‘How now, Calandrino?
uz: Bruno ularga xizmat ko'rsatishni tugatmagani uchun, Calandrino'ning ishiga e'tibor bermaslikka o'xshab, buni davom ettirdi va orqasidan: "Ho'sh, Calandrino?" degan so'zni eshitdi.

en: What meaneth this?’ Whereupon he turned sud- denly round and seeing that Calandrino had spat out his bolus, said, ‘Stay, maybe somewhat else hath caused him spit it out.
uz: Bu nimani anglatadi? Shundan so'ng u shiddat bilan o'girilib, Kalandrino o'zining bolusini sachratganini ko'rib, dedi: Turing, balki unga boshqa narsa uni sachratganiga sabab bo'lgandir.

en: Take another of them.’ Then, taking the other dogball, he thrust it into Calandrino’s mouth and went on to ﬁnish giving out the rest.
uz: Ulardan yana birini oling. Keyin, boshqa it to'pini olib, u uni Kalandrinning og'ziga tiqdi va qolganini tarqatishni tugatdi.

en: If the ﬁrst ball seemed bitter to Calandrino, the second was bitterer yet; but, being ashamed to spit it out, he kept it awhile in his mouth, chewing it and shedding tears that seemed hazelnuts so big they were, till at last, unable to hold out longer, he cast it forth, like as he had the ﬁrst.
uz: Agar birinchi to'p Kalandrinoga achchiq tuyulgan bo'lsa, ikkinchisi hali achchiqroq edi; lekin, uni tupurishga uyalgan holda, u uni og'zida bir oz saqladi, chaynab, shunday katta ko'z yoshlari to'kdi, hatto oxir-oqibat, uzoqroq chiday olmaguncha, xuddi avvalgidek uni tashqariga uloqtirdi.

en: Meanwhile Buffalmacco and Bruno gave the company to drink, and all, seeing this, declared that Calandrino had cer- tainly stolen the pig from himself; nay, there were those there who rated him roundly.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Buffalmacco va Bruno kompaniyaga ichimlik berishdi va hamma buni ko'rib, Calandrino o'zidan cho'chqani aniq o'g'irlaganini e'lon qildi; aksincha, uni yumaloq baholaganlar ham bor edi.

en: After they were all gone, and the two rogues left alone with Calandrino, Buffalmacco said to him, ‘I still had it for certain that it was thou tookst the pig thyself and wouldst fain make us believe that it had been stolen from thee, to escape giving us one poor while to drink of the monies thou hadst for it.’ Calandrino, who was not yet quit of the bitter taste of the aloes, began to swear that he had not had it, and Buffalmacco said, ‘But in good earnest, comrade, what gottest thou for it?
uz: Ularning hammasi ketgach va ikki xo'roz Kalandrino bilan yolg'iz qolgach, Buffalmacco unga dedi: Men hali ham aniq bilardimki, sen cho'chqani o'zing olib, o'zingdan o'g'irlangan deb ishontirmoqchi eding, o'zing uchun bor pulingdan bir kambag'alga berib, undan ichib qutqarmoqchi eding. Kalandrino, hali aloesning achchiq ta'midan to'xtamagan edi, uni ichmagan deb qasam ichdi va Buffalmacco dedi: Lekin chin dildan, o'rtoq, bu uchun nima kerak?

en: Was it six ﬂorins?’ Calandrino, hearing this, began to wax desperate, and Bruno said, ‘Harkye, Calandrino, there was such an one in the company that ate and drank with us, who told me that thou hast a wench over yonder, whom thou keepest for thy pleasure and to whom thou givest whatsoever thou canst scrape together, and that he held it for certain that thou hadst sent her the pig.
uz: Olti florinmi? Buni eshitgan Kalandrino umidsizlikka tushdi va Bruno dedi: Harkye, Kalandrino, biz bilan birga ovqatlanib, ichgan bir odam bor edi, u menga u yerda bir qizing borligini aytdi, uni o'zingning xohishing uchun saqlaysan va unga qo'lingdan kelgan hamma narsani berasan, va u senga cho'chqa yuborganingni aniq ko'rsatdi.

en: Thou hast learned of late to play pranks of this kind; thou carriedst us off t’other day down the Mugnone, picking up black stones, and whenas thou hadst gotten us aboard ship without biscuit,386 thou madest off and wouldst after have us believe that thou hadst found the magic stone; and now on like wise thou thinkest, by dint of oaths, to make us believe that the pig, which thou hast given away or more like sold, hath been stolen from thee.
uz: Siz yaqinda bu kabi hazillarni o'ynashni o'rgandingiz; bizni kecha Mugnone bo'ylab olib ketdingiz, qora toshlarni yig'dingiz, va bizni kemada pechenyesiz bo'lganingizda, 386 aqldan ozdingiz va keyin bizni sehrli toshni topganingizga ishontirishni xohlardingiz; va endi esa, qasam ichib, siz bergan yoki sotgandek bo'lgan cho'chqa sizdan o'g'irlangan deb ishonamiz deb o'ylayapsiz.

en: But we are used to thy tricks and know them; thou shalt not avail to play us any more of them, and to be plain with thee, since we have been at pains to make the conjuration, we mean that thou shalt give us two pairs of capons; else will we tell Mis- tress Tessa everything.’ Calandrino, seeing that he was not believed and himseeming he had had vexation enough, without having his wife’s scold-
uz: Lekin biz sening hiylalaringga o'rganib qoldik va ularni bilamiz; sen bizni ulardan boshqa o'ynashga hojat qilmaysan, va sen bilan ochiqchasiga bo'lish uchun, biz fitna tuzishga qiynalayotganimiz sababli, sen bizga ikki juft qalpoq berasan demoqchimiz; aks holda biz Mis-tress Tessaga hamma narsani aytamiz.

en: ing into the bargain, gave them two pairs of capons, which they carried off to Florence, after they had salted the pig, leaving Calandrino to digest the loss and the ﬂouting as best he might.”
uz: Kelishmovchilikka qo'shilgach, ularga ikki juft qalpoq berdilar, ularni Florensiyaga olib ketishdi, cho'chqani tuzlab bo'lgandan so'ng, Calandrinoga yo'qotish va g'am-g'uvillashni imkon qadar hazm qilish uchun qoldirdilar.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY A scholar loveth a widow lady, who, being enamoured of another, causeth him spend one winter’s night in the snow awaiting her, and he after contriveth, by his sleight, to have her abide naked, all one mid-July day, on the summit of a tower, exposed to ﬂies and gads and sun.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Bir olim beva xotinni yaxshi ko'radi, u boshqa birovga oshiq bo'lib, uni qishki bir kecha qorda kutadi va keyin o'z tajribasi bilan uni yalang'och holda, iyul oyining o'rtalarida, minoraning cho'qqisida, pashshalar, yillar va quyoshga duchor bo'lib turishga muvaffaq bo'ladi.

en: The ladies laughed amain at the unhappy Calandrino and would have laughed yet more, but that it irked them to see him ﬂeeced of the capons, to boot, by those who had already robbed him of the pig.
uz: Xonimlar baxtsiz Kalandrinoga hayrat bilan kulishdi va undan ham ko'proq kulishardi, lekin uni allaqachon cho'chqadan o'g'irlaganlar tomonidan qopqoqlardan tozalanganini ko'rish ularni bezovta qilardi.

en: But, as soon as the end of the story was come, the queen charged Pampinea tell hers, and she promptly began thus: “It chanceth oft, dearest ladies, that craft is put to scorn by craft and it is therefore a sign of little wit to delight in making mock of others.
uz: Ammo, hikoyaning oxiri kelishi bilanoq, malika Pampiyaga o'zidan aytishni buyurdi va u tezda shunday boshladi: "Ko'pincha, aziz xonimlar, hunar hunar hunar tomonidan mensimaydi va shuning uchun boshqalarni masxara qilishdan zavqlanish aqldan ozish belgisidir."

en: We have, for several stories, laughed amain at tricks that have been played upon folk and whereof no vengeance is recorded to have been taken; but I purpose now to cause you have some compassion of a just retribution wreaked upon a townswoman of ours, on whose head her own cheat recoiled and was retorted well nigh unto death; and the hearing of this will not be without proﬁt unto you, for that henceforward you will the better keep yourselves from making mock of others, and in this you will show great good sense.
uz: Biz bir necha hikoyalar uchun xalq ustidan o'ynab o'ynalgan va hech qanday qasos olgani qayd etilmagan hiylalarga kulganmiz; lekin hozir sizlarni bizning bir shaharlik ayolimizga nisbatan adolatli jazoga duchor qilishingizni xohlayman, uning boshiga o'z hiylasi tushdi va o'limga yaqinlashdi; va bu haqda eshitish sizga befoyda bo'lmaydi, chunki bundan buyon siz o'zingizni boshqalarni masxara qilishdan yaxshiroq saqlaysiz va bunda katta aql-idrok ko'rsatasiz.

en: Not many years ago there was in Florence, a young lady, by name Elena, fair of favour and haughty of humour, of very gentle lineage and endowed with sufﬁcient abundance of the goods of fortune, who, being widowed of her husband, chose never to marry again, for that she was enamoured of a handsome and agreeable youth of her own choice, and with the aid of a maid of hers, in whom she put great trust, being quit of every other care, she often with marvellous delight gave herself a good time with him.
uz: Ko'p yillar oldin Florensiyada Elena ismli yosh bir ayol bor edi. U juda mehribon va hazilkash edi, juda muloyim nasldan edi va yetarli darajada boylikka ega edi. U eridan beva bo'lib, hech qachon boshqa turmush qurishni tanlamagan edi, chunki u o'zi tanlagan chiroyli va xushmuomala yigitga oshiq edi va xizmatkorining yordami bilan, unga katta ishonch bildirgan, boshqa har qanday g'amxo'rlikdan voz kechgan holda, u ko'pincha ajoyib zavq bilan o'zi bilan yaxshi vaqt o'tkazardi.

en: In these days it chanced that a young gentleman of our city, by name Rinieri,
uz: Shu kunlarda bizning shahrimizning Rinieri ismli bir yosh janobining...

en: having long studied in Paris, not for the sake of after selling his knowledge by retail, as many do, but to know the nature of things and their causes, the which excellently becometh a gentleman, returned thence to Florence and there lived citizen-fashion, much honoured as well for his nobility as for his learning.
uz: Parijda uzoq vaqt o'qiganidan so'ng, ko'pchilik o'qiganidek, o'z bilimini chakana savdo orqali sotish uchun emas, balki narsalarning mohiyatini va ularning sabablarini bilish uchun, u yerda janob bo'lib, Florensiyaga qaytib keldi va u yerda fuqarolik uslubida yashadi, nafaqat oliyjanobligi uchun, balki o'qishi uchun ham juda hurmatga sazovor edi.

en: But, as it chanceth often that those, who have the most experience of things profound, are the soonest snared of love, even so it befell this Rinieri; for, having one day repaired, by way of diversion, to an entertain- ment, there presented herself before his eyes the aforesaid Elena, clad all in black, as our widows go, and full, to his judgment, of such beauty and pleasantness as himseemed he had never beheld in any other woman; and in his heart he deemed that he might call himself blest whom God should vouchsafe to hold her naked in his arms.
uz: Lekin, ko'pincha shunday bo'ladiki, eng chuqur narsalar tajribasiga ega bo'lganlar muhabbatning eng tez tuzoqlari bo'ladi, xuddi shu narsa Rinieri bilan sodir bo'lganidek; chunki bir kuni o'yin-kulgi yo'li bilan tuzatilganda, yuqorida aytilgan Elena uning ko'z o'ngida paydo bo'ldi, bevalarimiz kabi butunlay qora kiyimda, va uning hukmiga to'la, u boshqa ayollarda hech qachon ko'rmagan go'zallik va yoqimlilikni; va o'z qalbida u o'zini Xudo uni qo'llarida yalang'och ushlab turishi kerak deb ataydi.

en: Then, furtively considering her once and again and knowing that great things and precious were not to be acquired without travail, he altogether determined in himself to devote all his pains and all his diligence to the pleasing her, to the end that thereby he might gain her love and so avail to have his ﬁll of her.
uz: Keyin, uni bir necha bor yashirincha o'ylab, buyuk va qimmatbaho narsalar mehnatsiz olinmasligini bilgach, u butunlay o'ziga barcha azoblarini va barcha mehnatini uni mamnun qilishga bag'ishlashga qaror qildi, toki shu orqali uning muhabbatiga erishsin va undan to'yib-to'yib foydalansin.

en: The young lady, (who kept not her eyes ﬁxed upon the nether world, but, conceiting herself as much and more than as much as she was, moved them artfully hither and thither, gazing all about, and was quick to note who de- lighted to look upon her), soon became aware of Rinieri and said, laughing, in herself, ‘I have not come hither in vain today; for, an I mistake not, I have caught a woodcock by the bill.’ Accordingly, she fell to ogling him from time to time with the tail of her eye and studied, inasmuch as she might, to let him see that she took note of him, thinking that the more men she allured and ensnared with her charms, so much the more of price would her beauty be, especially to him on whom she had bestowed it, together with her love.
uz: Yosh xonim (ko'zlarini pastki dunyoga qaratmagan, balki o'zini qanchalik ko'p va undan ham ko'p mag'rur ko'rsatib, ularni u yerga va u yerga mohirona harakatlantirib, hamma narsaga tikilib, unga kim qaraganini tezda payqadi) tezda Rinieri haqida xabardor bo'ldi va o'zicha kuldi: "Bugun bekorga kelmadim; chunki, men xato qilmadim, men bir xo'rozni to'g'riladim." Shunga ko'ra, uni vaqti-vaqti bilan ko'z bilan ko'rib, unga e'tibor berishini ko'rsatish uchun o'rganib chiqdi, o'zi qanchalik ko'p erkaklarni ko'rsa, uning go'zalligi shunchalik ko'p bo'ladi, ayniqsa uni kimga sovg'a qilgan bo'lsa, u bilan birga...

en: The learned scholar, laying aside philosophical speculations, turned all his thoughts to her and thinking to please her, enquired where she lived and proceeded to pass to and fro before her house, colouring his com- ings and goings with various pretexts, whilst the lady, idly glorying in this, for the reason already set out, made believe to take great pleasure in seeing him.
uz: Olim falsafiy mulohazalarni chetga surib, barcha fikrlarini unga qaratdi va unga yoqish uchun o'yladi, u qayerda yashayotganini so'radi va uyning oldidan o'tib, turli bahonalar bilan o'z kelish-kelishlarini ko'rsatdi, xonim esa, allaqachon ko'rsatilgan sababga ko'ra shu bilan behuda maqtanar ekan, uni ko'rishdan katta zavq olishni xohladi.

en: Accordingly, he found means to clap up an acquaintance with her maid and discovering to her his love, prayed her make interest for him with her mistress, so he might avail to have her favour.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uning xizmatkori bilan tanishuvni qo'llab-quvvatlash va unga o'z muhabbatini kashf etish uchun yo'l topdi, uning bekasi bilan unga qiziqish uyg'otishini so'radi, shunda u uning marhamatiga ega bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: The maid promised freely and told the lady, who hearkened with the heartiest laughter in the world and said, ‘Seest thou where yonder man cometh to lose the wit he hath brought back from Paris?
uz: Xizmatkor ayol bemalol va'da berdi va dunyodagi eng dildan kulgan xonimga aytdi: "Ko'ryapsanmi, u yerda Parijdan olib kelgan aql-idrokini yo'qotish uchun odam qayerga keladi?"

en: Marry, we will give him that which he goeth
uz: Uylang, biz unga boradigan narsasini beramiz.

en: An he bespeak thee again, do thou tell him that I love him far more than he loveth me; but that it behoveth me look to mine honour, so I may hold up my head with the other ladies; whereof and he be as wise as folk say, he will hold me so much the dearer.’ Alack, poor silly soul, she knew not aright, ladies mine, what it is to try conclusions with scholars.
uz: Agar u senga yana so'zlasha olsa, unga aytginki, men uni u meni sevganidan ancha ko'proq sevaman; lekin menga o'z sharafimga qarash kerak, shunda boshqa xonimlar bilan boshimni ko'tarishim mumkin; u xalq aytganidek dono bo'lsa, meni shunchalik qadrlaydi." Voy, bechora ahmoqona jon, u olimlar bilan xulosalar chiqarishni bilmas edi, xonimlar.

en: The maid went in search of Rinieri and ﬁnding him, did that which had been enjoined her of her mistress, whereat he was overjoyed and proceeded to use more urgent entreaties, writing letters and sending presents, all of which were ac- cepted, but he got nothing but vague and general answers; and on this wise she held him in play a great while.
uz: Xizmatchi Rinieriyni qidirib bordi va uni topdi, xo'jayinasidan buyurilgan narsani qildi. Shunda u juda xursand bo'lib, shoshilinch iltimoslar, xatlar yozish va sovg'alar yuborishga kirishdi, ularning barchasi qabul qilindi, lekin u faqat noaniq va umumiy javoblarga ega bo'ldi; va shu tariqa u uni ancha vaqt o'yin ichida ushlab turdi.

en: At last, to show her lover, to whom she had discovered everything and who was whiles somewhat vexed with her for this and had conceived some jealousy of Rinieri, that he did wrong to suspect her thereof, she despatched to the scholar, now grown very pressing, her maid, who told him, on her mistress’s part, that she had never yet had an opportunity to do aught that might pleasure him since he had certiﬁed her of his love, but that on the oc- casion of the festival of the Nativity she hoped to be able to be with him; wherefore, an it liked him, he was on the evening of the feast to come by night to her courtyard, whither she would go for him as ﬁrst she might.
uz: Nihoyat, o'z sevgilisiga ko'rsatish uchun, u hamma narsani aniqlagan edi va bu uchun undan biroz xafa edi va Rinieriga nisbatan biroz rashk o'ylab topgan edi, u bu haqda gumon qilish noto'g'ri edi, u olimga yo'l oldi, endi juda shoshilinch, uning xizmatkori unga aytdi, uning bekasi tomonidan, u hali unga yoqadigan hech narsa qilishga ulgurmagan edi, chunki u uni o'z muhabbati bilan tasdiqlagan edi, lekin Rojdestvo bayrami munosabati bilan u bilan birga bo'lishga umid qilardi; shuning uchun, unga yoqdi, u ziyofat oqshomida uning hovlisiga kecha kelishi kerak edi, u uni birinchi bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: At this the scholar was the gladdest man alive and betook himself at the ap- pointed time to his mistress’s house, where he was carried by the maid into a courtyard and being there locked in, proceeded to wait the lady’s coming.
uz: Shunda olim tirik eng xursand odam edi va belgilangan vaqtda o'zini bekasining uyiga olib bordi. U yerda xizmatkor xonim tomonidan hovliga olib kirildi va u yerda qulflab qo'yilgan holda, xonimning kelishini kutishga kirishdi.

en: The latter had that evening sent for her lover and after she had supped mer- rily with him, she told him that which she purposed to do that night, adding, ‘And thou mayst see for thyself what and how great is the love I have borne and bear him of whom thou hast taken a jealousy.’ The lover heard these words with great satisfaction and was impatient to see by the fact that which the lady gave him to understand with words.
uz: Oxirgisi o'sha oqshom sevgilisini chaqirib yuborgan edi va u bilan birga xursandchilik bilan ovqatlanib bo'lgandan so'ng, u unga o'sha kechasi nima qilishni niyat qilganini aytib, qo'shib qo'ydi: "Va sen o'zing ko'rasan, men qanday katta muhabbat ko'rganimni va sen rashk qilgan odamni qanday ko'rganingni." Sevgilisi bu so'zlarni katta mamnuniyat bilan eshitdi va xonim unga so'zlar bilan tushunish uchun bergan narsasini ko'rishga sabrsizlik qildi.

en: It had by chance snowed hard during the day and everything was covered with snow, wherefore the scholar had not long abidden in the courtyard be- fore he began to feel colder than he could have wished; but, looking to re- cruit himself speedily, he was fain to endure it with patience.
uz: Kunduzi tasodifan qattiq qor yog'gan edi va hamma narsa qor bilan qoplangan edi, shuning uchun olim hovlida uzoq yashirinib o'tirmagan edi, u o'zini xohlaganidan ham sovuqroq his qila boshlagan edi; lekin, o'zini tezda qayta-qayta ko'rishga harakat qilib, bunga sabr bilan bardosh bera olardi.

en: Presently, the lady said to her lover, ‘Let us go look from a lattice what yonder fellow, of whom thou art waxed jealous, doth and hear what he shall answer the maid, whom I have sent to parley with him.’ Accordingly, they betook themselves to a lattice and thence, seeing, without being seen, they heard the maid from another lattice bespeak the scholar and say, ‘Rinieri, my lady is the woe-
uz: Ayni paytda xonim o'z sevgilisiga dedi: "Kelinglar, bir panjaradan o'sha odamni ko'rib chiqaylik, sen kimga hasad qilgan bo'lsang, u bilan suhbatlashishga jo'natgan xizmatkorga nima javob berishini eshitadi." Shunga ko'ra, ular panjaraga o'zlarini burishdi va u yerdan, ko'rinmay turib, boshqa panjaradan kelgan xizmatkorning olim haqida gapirayotganini eshitishdi va dedilar: "Rinieri, xonim - vay-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a

en: fullest woman that was aye, for that there is one of her brothers come hither tonight, who hath talked much with her and after must needs sup with her, nor is yet gone away; but methinketh he will soon be gone; wherefore she hath not been able to come to thee, but will soon come now and prayeth thee not to take the waiting in ill part.’ Rinieri, believing this to be true, replied, ‘Tell my lady to give herself no concern for me till such time as she can at her commodity come to me, but bid her do this as quickliest she may.’ The maid turned back into the house and betook herself to bed, whilst the lady said to her gallant, ‘Well, how sayst thou?
uz: Ayniqsa, bu kecha uning bir akasi keldi, u bilan ko'p gaplashgan va keyin u bilan kechki ovqatga muhtoj bo'lgan, hali ham ketmagan; lekin u tez orada ketadi deb o'ylaydi; shuning uchun u senga kelolmadi, lekin tez orada keladi va senga yomon tomonga kutmaslikni so'raydi." Rinieri buni rost deb hisoblab, javob berdi: "Xonimga ayt, u menga o'z narsasidan kelguncha o'ziga hech qanday tashvish bermasin, lekin buni imkon qadar tezroq qilishga buyur." Xiz ayol uyga qaytib, o'zini yotqishga tortdi, xonim esa unga dedi: "Xo'sh, qanday deysan?"

en: Thinkest thou that, an I wished him such weal as thou fearest, I would suffer him stand a-freezing down yonder?’ So saying, she betook herself to bed with her lover, who was now in part satisﬁed, and there they abode a great while in joyance and liesse, laughing and making mock of the wretched scholar, who fared to and fro the while in the courtyard, making shift to warm himself with exercise, nor had whereas he might seat himself or shelter from the night-damp.
uz: Siz o'ylaysizmi, agar men unga siz qo'rqqaningizdek baxtli bo'lishni istasam, uni u yerda muzlab turishga qo'yardim? Shunday qilib, u o'zini qisman qoniqqan sevgilisi bilan yotqizdi va u yerda uzoq vaqt quvonch va rohatda o'tirishdi, bechora olimni kuldirishdi va masxara qilishdi, u hovlida bir vaqtning o'zida yurardi, mashq bilan isitish uchun o'tirardi, u yerda o'tirishi yoki tun zulmatidan panoh topishi mumkin edi.

en: He cursed her brother’s long stay with the lady and took everything he heard for the opening of a door to him by her, but hoped in vain.
uz: U uning akasining xonim bilan uzoq qolishini la'natladi va eshitgan hamma narsani u orqali unga eshik ochish uchun oldi, lekin behuda umid qildi.

en: The lady, having solaced herself with her lover till near upon midnight, said to him, ‘How deemest thou, my soul, of our scholar?
uz: Xonim o'z sevgilisi bilan yarim tungacha tasalli berib, unga dedi: Ey jonim, bizning olimimizga qanday qaraysan?

en: Whether seemeth to thee the greater, his wit or the love I bear him?
uz: Sizga uning donoligi yoki men unga bo'lgan muhabbat kattaroq ko'rinadimi?

en: Will the cold which I presently cause him suffer do away from thy mind the doubts which my pleasantries aroused therein the other day?’ Whereto he replied, ‘Heart of my body, yes, I know right well that, like as thou art my good and my peace and my delight and all my hope, even so am I thine.’ ‘Then,’ rejoined she, ‘kiss me a thousand times, so I may see if thou say sooth.’ Whereupon he clipped her fast in his arms and kissed her not a thousand, but more than an hundred thousand times.
uz: Hozir unga azob berayotgan sovuq, o'tgan kundagi xushmuomalaliklarim uyg'otgan shubhalarni ongingdan yo'qotadimi? U javob berdi: Tuvumning yuragi, ha, men yaxshi bilaman, sen mening yaxshiligim, tinchligim, zavqim va butun umidim bo'lganingdek, men ham senga tegishliman.  Unda u javob berdi: Menga ming marta o'p, agar sen tinchlik so'rasang, ko'ray. Shundan so'ng u uni qo'liga oldi va uni ming emas, balki yuz mingdan ko'proq o'pdi.

en: Then, after they had abidden awhile in such dis- course, the lady said, ‘Marry, let us arise a little and go see if the ﬁre is any- dele spent, wherein this my new lover wrote me that he burnt all day long.’ Accordingly, they arose and getting them to the accustomed lattice, looked out into the courtyard, where they saw the scholar dancing a right merry jig on the snow, so fast and brisk that never had they seen the like, to the sound of the chattering of the teeth that he made for excess of cold; whereupon quoth the lady, ‘How sayst thou, sweet my hope?
uz: Keyin, ular bir oz shu ahvolda yashiringanlaridan so'ng, xonim dedi: Marry, keling, biroz turaylik va olovning hech qanday sarflanmaganligini ko'raylik, shunda mening yangi sevganim menga kun bo'yi kuyganini yozdi. Shunga ko'ra, ular o'rnidan turdilar va ularni odatdagi panjaraga olib borishdi, hovliga qarishdi, u yerda olim qor ustida shunday tez va tez raqsga tushayotganini ko'rishdi, hech qachon bunday narsani ko'rmagan edilar, sovuqdan tashqari qilgan tishlarining shivirlash ovoziga; shundan so'ng xonim dedi: Qanday deysiz, shirin umidim?

en: Seemeth to thee that I know how to make folk jig it without sound of trump or bagpipe?’ Whereto he answered, laughing, ‘Ay dost thou, my chief delight.’ Quoth the lady, ‘I will that we go down to the door; thou shalt abide quiet, whilst I bespeak
uz: Senga shunday tuyulyaptiki, men uni odamlarni karnay yoki xalta ovozi eshitmasdan qanday qimirlatishni bilaman? U javob berdi va kuldi: Ey, mening bosh quvonchim! Xonim shunday dedi: Biz eshikdan pastga tushamiz; sen jim turasan, men esa...

en: him, and we shall hear what he will say; belike we shall have no less diver- sion thereof than we had from seeing him.’ Accordingly, they softly opened the chamber and stole down to the door, where, without opening it anydele, the lady called to the scholar in a low voice by a little hole that was there.
uz: uni, va biz uning nima deyayotganini eshitamiz; go'yo bizda uni ko'rishdan ko'rganimizdan kamroq farq bo'lmasa kerak." Shunga ko'ra, ular xonani sekin ochib, eshikgacha o'g'irlashdi, u yerda hech qanday ochilmasdan, xonim u yerdagi kichik teshikdan past ovozda olimni chaqirdi.

en: Rinieri hearing himself called, praised God, taking it oversoon for granted that he was to be presently admitted, and coming up to the door, said, ‘Here am I, madam; open for God’s sake, for I die of cold.’ ‘O ay,’ replied the lady, ‘I know thou art a chilly one; is then the cold so exceeding great, because, forsooth, there is a little snow about?
uz: Rinieri o'zini chaqirganini eshitib, Xudoni maqtadi, tez orada kirishi kerakligini qabul qilib, eshik oldiga chiqib dedi: "Mana men, xonim; Xudo haqqi, men sovuqdan o'laman."  Voy,  dedi xonim,  bilaman, siz salqin odamsiz; demak, sovuq shunchalik ko'pmi, chunki, albatta, biroz qor bor?

en: I wot the nights are much colder in Paris.
uz: Parijda tunlar ancha sovuq bo'ladi deb o'ylayman.

en: I cannot open to thee yet, for that accursed brother of mine, who came to sup with me tonight, is not yet gone; but he will soon begone and I will come incontinent to open to thee.
uz: Men senga hali ochilmayapman, chunki bugun kechqurun men bilan ovqatlanishga kelgan la'nati akam hali ham ketgani yo'q; lekin u tez orada boshlaydi va men senga ochish uchun tezroq kelaman.

en: I have but now very hardly stolen away from him, that I might come to exhort thee not to wax weary of waiting.’ ‘Alack, madam,’ cried the scholar, ‘I pray you for God’s sake open to me, so I may abide within under cover, for that this little while past there is come on the thickest snow in the world and it yet snoweth, and I will wait for you as long as it shall please you.’ ‘Woe’s me, sweet my treasure,’ replied the lady, ‘that cannot I; for this door maketh so great a noise, whenas it is opened, that it would lightly be heard of my brother, if I should open to thee; but I will go bid him begone, so I may after come back and open to thee.’ ‘Then go quickly,’ rejoined he; ‘and I prithee let make a good ﬁre, so I may warm me as soon as I come in, for that I am grown so cold I can scarce feel myself.’ Quoth the lady, ‘That should not be possible, an that be true which thou hast many a time
uz: Men undan deyarli uzoqlashdim, sizni kutishdan charchamaslikka undash uchun kelishim uchun." Alak, xonim,  deb baqirdi olim, Men sizdan Xudo uchun iltimos qilaman, menga ochilsin, shunda men yashirincha yashirinaman, chunki bu kichik vaqt dunyodagi eng qalin qorga yaqinlashdi va hali qor yog'moqda, va men sizni sizga yoqqancha kutaman. Voy menga, azizim,  javob berdi xonim,  chunki bu eshik juda katta shovqin chiqaradi, u ochilganda, agar men ochsam, akam haqida yengil eshitish mumkin; lekin men uni boshlashga chaqiraman, shunda men tezda sizga qaytib kelaman va sizga qaytib kelishim mumkin. Unda men sizga shunday bir sovuq bo'lishim mumkin,

en: written me, to wit, that thou burnest for the love of me.
uz: Menga yozdi, ya'ni, sen menga bo'lgan muhabbating uchun yonasan.

en: Now, I must go, wait and be of good heart.’ Then, with her lover, who had heard all this with the utmost pleasure, she went back to bed, and that night they slept little, nay, they spent it well nigh all in dalliance and delight and in making mock of Rinieri.
uz: Endi men borishim kerak, kutishim kerak va yaxshi yurak bo'lishim kerak. Keyin, bularning hammasini eng katta zavq bilan eshitgan sevgilisi bilan birga, u yana uxlashga ketdi va o'sha tun ular kam uxladilar, yo'q, ular buni deyarli hammasi xursandchilik va lazzat bilan o'tkazishdi va Rinieri haqida masxara qilishdi.

en: Meanwhile, the unhappy scholar (now well nigh grown a stork, so sore did his teeth chatter), perceiving at last that he was befooled, essayed again and again to open the door and sought an he might not avail to issue thence by another way; but, ﬁnding no means thereunto, he fell a-ranging to and fro like a lion, cursing the foulness of the weather and the lady’s malignity and the length of the night, together with his own credulity; wherefore, be- ing sore despited against his mistress, the long and ardent love he had borne her was suddenly changed to ﬁerce and bitter hatred and he revolved in
uz: Ayni paytda, baxtsiz olim (hozir yaxshilab ulg'aygan laylak, tishlari shunchalik og'riyotgan ediki), nihoyat o'zining befarosat ekanligini anglab yetdi, eshikni qayta-qayta ochishga harakat qildi va undan boshqa yo'l bilan chiqish imkoni bo'lmasligini istadi; lekin bunga hech qanday imkoniyat topolmagach, u sher kabi bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa tashlandi, ob-havoning iflosligini, xonimning yovuzligini va tunning uzunligini la'natladi, o'zining ishonchi bilan birga; shuning uchun, xo'jayiniga nisbatan nafrat bilan qaraganda, unga yetkazgan uzoq va achchiq muhabbat birdan shafqatsiz va achchiq nafratga aylandi va u...

en: himself many and various things, so he might ﬁnd a means of revenge, the which he now desired far more eagerly than he had before desired to be with the lady.
uz: o'ziga ko'p va xilma-xil narsalar, shunda u qasos olish vositasini topishi mumkin edi, uni endi xonim bilan bo'lishni xohlaganidan ko'ra ancha intiqlik bilan xohlardi.

en: At last, after much long tarriance, the night drew near unto day and the dawn began to appear; whereupon the maid, who had been les- soned by the lady, coming down, opened the courtyard door and feigning to have compassion of Rinieri, said, ‘Bad luck may he have who came hither yestereve!
uz: Nihoyat, uzoq vaqt turgandan so'ng, tun kunduzga yaqinlashdi va tong chiqishni boshladi; shundan so'ng xonim tomonidan kamsitilgan xizmatkor ayol pastga tushib, hovli eshigini ochdi va Rinieriga rahm qilish uchun o'zini soxta ko'rsatdi va dedi: "Oldin bu yerga kelgan odamga omad bo'lsin!"

en: He hath kept us all night upon thorns and hath caused thee freeze; but knowest thou what?
uz: U bizni tun bo'yi tikan ustida saqladi va seni muzlatdi; lekin nima ekanligini bilasanmi?

en: Bear it with patience, for that which could not be tonight shall be another time.
uz: Bunga sabr bilan bardosh ber, chunki bugun kechqurun bo'lishi mumkin bo'lmagan narsa boshqa vaqt bo'ladi.

en: Indeed, I know nought could have happened that had been so displeasing to my lady.’ The despiteful scholar, like a wise man as he was, who knew that threats are but arms for the threatened, locked up in his breast that which un- tempered will would fain have vented and said in a low voice, without any- wise showing himself vexed, ‘In truth I have had the worst night I ever had; but I have well apprehended that the lady is nowise to blame for this, inas- much as she herself of her compassion for me, came down hither to excuse herself and to hearten me; and as thou sayest, that which hath not been to- night shall be another time.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men bilaman, xonimga bunchalik yoqimsiz bo'lgan hech narsa bo'lishi mumkin emas edi. O'ziga o'xshagan dono olim, tahdidlar tahdid qilinganlar uchun qurol ekanligini bilgan holda, o'zining ko'kragida o'ziga xos bo'lmagan narsani qulflab, past ovozda, hech qanday g'azabni ko'rsatmasdan dedi: "Haqiqatan ham men eng yomon tunni boshdan kechirdim; lekin men xonim hozir bu uchun aybdor ekanligini yaxshi angladim, chunki u o'zi menga nisbatan rahm-shafqatidan, o'zini oqlash va meni tinglash uchun bu yerga tushdi; va sen aytgandek, tun bo'lmagan narsa - boshqa vaqt bo'ladi.

en: Commend me to her and God be with thee.’ Therewithal, well nigh stark with cold, he made his way, as best he might, back to his house, where, being drowsed to death, he cast himself upon his bed to sleep and awoke well nigh crippled of his arms and legs; wherefore, sending for sundry physicians and acquainting them with the cold he had suffered, he caused take order for his cure.
uz: Meni unga tavsiya etgin va Xudo senga hamroh bo'lsin." Shunday qilib, sovuqdan juda yaqin bo'lganida, u imkon qadar o'z uyiga qaytdi. U yerda, o'limga ketib, o'z karavotiga tashlandi va qo'llari va oyoqlaridan deyarli nogiron holda uyg'ondi; shuning uchun turli xil shifokorlarni yuborib, ularga azob chekkan sovuq bilan tanishtirdi va davolash uchun buyurtma berdi.

en: The leaches, plying him with prompt and very potent remedies, hardly, after some time, availed to recov- er him of the shrinking of the sinews and cause them relax; and but that he was young and that the warm season came on, he had overmuch to suffer.
uz: Uni tezkor va juda kuchli dorilar bilan to'ldirgan siydiklar, biroz vaqt o'tgach, uni mushaklarning qisqarishidan va ularni bo'shashtirishga hech qanday yordam bermadi; lekin u yosh bo'lgani va issiq mavsum boshlanishi sababli, u juda ko'p azob chekishi kerak edi.

en: However, being restored to health and lustihead, he kept his hate to himself and feigned himself more than ever enamoured of his widow.
uz: Biroq, sog'lig'i va shahvoniyligi tiklangandan so'ng, u o'z nafratini o'zida saqladi va hech qachon o'zini bevaligiga oshiqdek ko'rsatdi.

en: Now it befell, after a certain space of time, that fortune furnished him with an occasion of satisfying his desire [for vengeance], for that the youth beloved of the widow being, without any regard for the love she bore him, fallen enamoured of another lady, would have nor little nor much to say to her nor do aught to pleasure her, wherefore she pined in tears and bitterness.
uz: Endi shunday bo'ldiki, ma'lum vaqt o'tgach, baxt unga o'z istaklarini qondirish imkoniyatini taqdim etdi, chunki bevaning sevgilisi, unga bo'lgan muhabbatiga hech qanday e'tibor bermasdan, boshqa bir xonimga oshiq bo'lib, unga aytadigan hech narsa ham, uni xursand qiladigan hech narsa ham yo'q edi, shuning uchun u yig'lab, achchiq edi.

en: But her maid, who had great compassion of her, ﬁnding no way of rousing her mistress from the chagrin into which the loss of her lover had cast her and seeing the scholar pass along the street, after the wonted manner, entered into a fond conceit, to wit, that the lady’s lover might be brought by
uz: Ammo uning xizmatkori, unga nisbatan juda rahm-shafqat ko'rsatgan, sevgilisining yo'qolishi uni tashvishga solganidan uyg'otishning hech qanday yo'lini topolmay, olimni ko'chada o'tib ketayotganini ko'rib, odatdagidek, xonimning sevgilisi olib kelinishi mumkinligi haqida mehribonlik qildi.

en: some necromantic operation or other to love her as he had been wont to do and that the scholar should be a past master in this manner of thing, and told her thought to her mistress.
uz: uni odatdagidek sevish va olim bu borada o'tmishdagi ustasi bo'lishi kerakligi haqida qandaydir nekromantik operatsiya yoki boshqa narsa, va u o'z bekasiga fikrini aytdi.

en: The latter, little wise, without considering that, had the scholar been acquainted with the black art, he would have practised it for himself, lent her mind to her maid’s words and bade her forthright learn from him if he would do it and give him all assurance that, in requital thereof, she would do whatsoever pleased him.
uz: Oxirgisi, ozgina dono, olim qora san'at bilan tanish bo'lganida, uni o'zi mashq qilgan bo'lardi, xizmatkorining so'zlariga e'tibor qaratgan bo'lardi va agar u buni qilmoqchi bo'lsa, undan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'rganishni buyurgan bo'lardi va unga buning evaziga u o'ziga yoqqanini qiladiganligiga to'liq ishonch bergan bo'lardi.

en: The maid did her errand well and diligently, which when the scholar heard, he was overjoyed and said in himself, ‘Praised be Thou, my God!
uz: Xizmatchi o'z vazifasini yaxshi va astoydil bajardi, olim buni eshitgach, juda xursand bo'lib, o'ziga dedi: "Senga hamd bo'lsin, Xudoyim!"

en: The time is come when with Thine aid I may avail to make yonder wicked woman pay the penalty of the harm she did me in requital of the great love I bore her.’ Then to the maid, ‘Tell my lady,’ quoth he, ‘that she need be in no concern for this, for that, were her lover in the Indies, I would speedily cause him come to her and crave pardon of that which he hath done to displeasure her; but the means she must take to this end I purpose to impart to herself, when and where it shall most please her.
uz: Vaqti keldi, Sening yordaming bilan men o'sha yovuz ayolni men unga bergan katta muhabbat evaziga menga yetkazgan zararning jazosini to'lashga qodir bo'laman." Shunda xizmatchiga aytdi: "Xonimga ayt," dedi u, "uning bu haqda qayg'urishi kerak emas, chunki agar uning sevgilisi Hind orollarida bo'lganida, men uni tezda uning oldiga yuborardim va unga yoqtirmaslik uchun qilgan ishidan kechirim so'rardim; lekin bu maqsadda u o'ziga qachon va qayerda ko'proq yoqishini o'rgatish uchun kerak bo'lgan vositalarni oldim.

en: So say to her and hearten her on my part.’ The maid carried his answer to her mistress and it was agreed that they should foregather at Santa Lucia del Prato, whither, accordingly, the lady, and the scholar being come and speaking together alone, she, remembering her not that she had aforetime brought him well nigh to death’s door, openly discovered to him her case and that which she desired and besought him to succour her.
uz: Shunday qilib, unga ayting va uni mendan xursand qiling." Xizmatkor ayol uning javobini xo'jayiniga yetkazdi va ular Santa Lucia del Pratoga kelishlari kelishib olindi, u yerga xonim va olim birga kelib, yolg'iz gaplashgan holda, u, avvalroq uni o'lim eshigiga yaqin olib kelganini eslamagan holda, unga o'z holatini va xohlagan narsasini ochiqchasiga ochib berdi va undan yordam so'radi.

en: ‘Madam,’ answered he, ‘it is true that amongst the other things I learned at Paris was necromancy, whereof for certain I know that which is extant thereof; but for that the thing is supremely displeasing unto God, I had sworn never to practise it either for myself or for others.
uz: Xonim,  javob berdi u,  Parijda organgan boshqa narsalar orasida necromantika ham borligi rost, buning uchun men undan qolganini aniq bilaman; lekin bu narsa Xudoga juda yoqmaydigan narsa bolgani uchun, hech qachon uni na ozim uchun, na boshqalar uchun ishlatmaslikka qasam ichgan edim.

en: Nevertheless, the love I bear you is of such potency that I know not how I may deny you aught that you would have me do; wherefore, though it should behove me for this alone go to the devil’s stead, I am yet ready to do it, since it is your pleasure.
uz: Shunga qaramay, senga bo'lgan muhabbatim shunchalik kuchliki, sening menga qilmoqchi bo'lgan hech narsani senga qanday rad etishni bilmayman; shuning uchun, agar bu menga faqat shaytonga o'tishga majbur bo'lsa ham, men buni qilishga tayyorman, chunki bu sening xohishingdir.

en: But I must forewarn you that the thing is more uneath to do than you perchance imagine, especially whenas a woman would recall a man to loving her or a man a woman, for that this cannot be done save by the very person unto whom it pertaineth; and it behoveth that whoso doth it be of an assured mind, seeing it must be done anights and in solitary places without company; which things I know not how you are disposed to do.’ The lady, more enamoured than discreet, replied, ‘Love spurreth me on such wise that there is nothing I would not do to have again him who hath wrongfully for- saken me.
uz: Lekin men sizni ogohlantirishim kerakki, bu narsa siz tasavvur qilganingizdan ham ko'ra ko'proq behayo ishdir, ayniqsa ayol erkakni o'zini yoki erkakni ayolni sevishga chaqirganda, chunki bu faqat unga tegishli bo'lgan odam tomonidan amalga oshirilishi mumkin emas; va bu ishonch bilan amalga oshirilishi kerak, chunki bu tunlari va yolg'iz joylarda, hech kim bilan birga bo'lmasdan amalga oshirilishi kerak; bu narsalar siz qanday qilishga moyil ekanligingizni bilmayman.

en: Algates, an it please you, show me in what I must approve my-
uz: Algetlar, sizga yoqsa, menga nimani tasdiqlashim kerakligini ko'rsating...

en: self assured of mind.’ ‘Madam,’ replied the scholar, who had a patch of ill hair to his tail,387 ‘I must make an image of pewter in his name whom you desire to get again, which whenas I shall send you, it will behove you seven times bathe yourself therewith, all naked, in a running stream, at the hour of the ﬁrst sleep, what time the moon is far on the wane.
uz: O'ziga ishongan holda.  Xonim,  javob berdi olim, dumida yomon tuklar bo'lgan, 387  Uning ismiga bir tikan yasashim kerak, uni yana olishni xohlaysan, qachonki seni yuborsam, u bilan yetti marta cho'milishing kerak bo'ladi, butunlay yalang'och holda, yugurib yuruvchi daryoda, birinchi uyqu soatida, oy qancha uzoq bo'lsa.

en: Thereafter, naked as you are, you must get you up into a tree or to the top of some uninhabited house and turning to the north, with the image in your hand, seven times running say certain words which I shall give you written; which when you shall have done, there will come to you two of the fairest damsels you ever beheld, who will salute you and ask you courteously what you would have done.
uz: Shundan so'ng, o'zingdagidek yalang'och holda, daraxtga yoki biror bir begona uyning tepasiga ko'tarilib, shimolga buriling, qo'lingizda rasm bilan yetti marta yugurib, sizga yozilgan ba'zi so'zlarni ayting; ularni bajarganingizdan so'ng, siz ko'rgan eng go'zal qizlardan ikkitasi oldingizga keladi, ular sizga salom beradilar va sizdan nima qilganingizni odob bilan so'raydilar.

en: Do you well and throughly discover to them your desires and look it betide you not to name one for another.
uz: Ularga xohishlaringizni yaxshilab va to'liq ochib berasizmi va bir-birini boshqaga nomlamasligingizni o'ylab ko'rasizmi?

en: As soon as you have told them, they will depart and you may then come down to the place where you shall have left your clothes and re-clothe yourself and return home; and for certain, ere it be the middle of the ensuing night, your lover will come, weeping, to crave you pardon and mercy; and know that from that time forth he will never again leave you for any other.’ The lady, hearing all this and lending entire faith thereto, was half com- forted, herseeming she already had her lover again in her arms, and said, ‘Never fear; I will very well do these things, and I have therefor the ﬁnest commodity in the world; for I have, towards the upper end of the Val d’Arno, a farm, which is very near the riverbank, and it is now July, so that bathing will be pleasant; more by token that I mind me there is, not far from the stream, a little uninhabited tower, save that the shepherds climb up by-
uz: Ularga aytishingiz bilanoq, ular ketishadi va siz o'z kiyimlaringizni qoldirgan joyingizga tushishingiz mumkin, qayta kiyinishingiz va uyga qaytishingiz mumkin; va albatta, kelayotgan tunning yarmidan oldin, sevganingiz sizni kechirish va rahm qilish uchun yig'lab keladi; va bilingki, o'shandan keyin u sizni hech qachon boshqa hech kimga tashlab ketmaydi." Xonim bularning barchasini eshitib, bunga butun ishonchini qaratdi, yarim jasoratli edi, go'yo sevgan sevgilisi endi uning qo'lida edi va dedi: "Hech qachon qo'rqmang; men bu ishlarni juda yaxshi qilaman va men dunyodagi eng yaxshi tovar uchun borman; chunki menda, daryo bo'yidagi yuqori qismida, deyarli ko'pga yaqin joylashgan, va endi iyul oyi, u meni ko'proq xursand qiladi;

en: times, by a ladder of chestnut-wood that is there, to a sollar at the top, to look for their strayed beasts: otherwise it is a very solitary out-of-the- way388 place.
uz: vaqtlar, u yerda kashtan yog'ochidan yasalgan zinapoya bo'ylab, tepasidagi quyoshga qarab, o'zlarining adashgan hayvonlarini qidirish uchun: aks holda bu juda yolg'iz, yo'ldan tashqari joy. 388

en: Thither will I betake myself and there I hope to do that which you shall enjoin me the best in the world.’ The scholar, who very well knew both the place and the tower mentioned by the lady, was rejoiced to be certi- ﬁed of her intent and said, ‘Madam, I was never in these part and therefore know neither the farm nor the tower; but, an it be as you say, nothing in the world can be better.
uz: U yerga o'zimni qo'yaman va u yerda siz menga dunyodagi eng yaxshi amr qiladigan ishni qilishga umid qilaman." Olim, xonim tilga olgan joyni ham, minorni ham juda yaxshi bilgan holda, uning niyatidan xursand bo'lib dedi: "Xonim, men bu yerda hech qachon bo'lmaganman va shuning uchun na fermani, na minorni bilmayman; lekin, siz aytganingizdek, dunyoda bundan yaxshiroq hech narsa bo'lishi mumkin emas."

en: Wherefore, whenas it shall be time, I will send you the image and the conjuration; but I pray you instantly, whenas you shall have gotten your desire and shall know I have served you well, that you be mind- ful of me and remember to keep your promise to me.’ She answered that she would without fail do it and taking leave of him, returned to her house; whilst the scholar, rejoiced for that himseemed his desire was like to have
uz: Shunday qilib, vaqti kelganda, men sizga rasm va fitnaning nusxasini yuboraman; lekin sizdan iltimos qilaman, xohishingizga erishganingizdan va sizga yaxshi xizmat qilganimni bilganingizdan so'ng, menga e'tiborli bo'ling va menga bergan va'dangizni bajarishni unutmang." U javob berdi: "U buni albatta qiladi va undan ketib, uyiga qaytadi; olim esa uning xohishi shunga o'xshash bo'lgani uchun xursand edi."

en: effect, made an image with certain talismanic characters of his own devis- ing, and wrote a rigmarole of his fashion, by way of conjuration; the which, whenas it seemed to him time, he despatched to the lady and sent to tell her that she must that very night, without more tarriance, do that which he had enjoined her; after which he secretly betook himself, with a servant of his, to the house of one of his friends who abode very near the tower, so he might give effect to his design.
uz: ta'sir qilib, o'zining o'ylab topgan ba'zi talisman qahramonlari bilan tasvir yasadi va o'z uslubidagi "triguarole"ni, sehrgarlik usuli bilan yozdi; bu vaqt unga kelganda, u xonimga xabar yuborib, unga o'sha kecha o'zi buyurgan narsani hech qanday to'xtashsiz qilishi kerakligini aytdi; shundan so'ng u o'zining xizmatkori bilan yashirincha o'zi bilan minoraga yaqin joylashgan do'stlaridan birining uyiga bordi, shunda u o'z loyihasiga amal qilishi mumkin edi.

en: The lady, on her part, set out with her maid and repaired to her farm, where, as soon as the night was come, she made a show of going to bed and sent the maid away to sleep, but towards the hour of the ﬁrst sleep, she is- sued quietly forth of the house and betook herself to the bank of the Arno hard by the tower, where, looking ﬁrst well all about and seeing nor hearing any, she put off her clothes and hiding them under a bush, bathed seven times with the image; after which, naked as she was, she made for the tower, image in hand.
uz: Xonim, o'z navbatida, xizmatkori bilan jo'nab ketdi va o'z fermasiga qaytdi. U yerda, tun kirishi bilanoq, uxlashga o'zini ko'rsatdi va xizmatchini uxlatdi. Ammo birinchi uyqu soatiga kelib, u xotirjam ravishda uydan chiqdi va minora bo'yidagi Arno daryosiga qattiq bordi. U yerda, avval yaxshilab ko'rib, hech narsani ko'rmay, eshitmay, kiyimlarini yechdi va ularni buta ostiga yashirdi, tasvir bilan yetti marta cho'mdi; keyin, yalang'och holda, u minora uchun, qo'lida tasvir yasadi.

en: The scholar, who had, at the coming on of the night, hidden himself with his servant among the willows and other trees near the tower and had witnessed all this, seeing her, as she passed thus naked close to him, overcome the darkness of the night with the whiteness of her body and after considering her breast and the other parts of her person and seeing them fair, bethought himself what they should become in a little while and felt some compassion of her; whilst, on the other hand, the pricks of the ﬂesh assailed him of a sudden and caused that stand on end which erst lay prone, inciting him to issue forth of his ambush and go take her and do his will of her.
uz: Olim, tun kirganda, minora yaqinidagi emanlar va boshqa daraxtlar orasida o'z xizmatkori bilan yashiringan va bularning barchasini guvohi bo'lgan edi. U uni yalang'och holda o'z tanasining oqligi bilan tun zulmatini yengib o'tayotganini ko'rib, ko'kraklari va boshqa qismlarini ko'rib, ularni go'zal ko'rganidan so'ng, bir oz vaqt ichida nima bo'lishi kerakligini o'ylab, unga nisbatan biroz rahm-shafqat ko'rdi.

en: Between the one and the other he was like to be overcome; but, calling to mind who he was and what the injury he had suffered and where- fore and at whose hands and he being thereby rekindled in despite and com- passion and carnal appetite banished, he abode ﬁrm in his purpose and let her go.
uz: U ikkalasi orasida yengilgandek edi; lekin, o'zi kim ekanligini va qanday jarohat olganini, qayerdan va kimning qo'lida ekanligini eslab, shunga qaramay qayta tirildi va shahvoniy ishtiyoq va nafs ishtahasi quvib ketdi, u o'z maqsadiga qat'iy sodiq qoldi va uni qo'yib yubordi.

en: The lady, going up on to the tower and turning to the north, began to re- peat the words given her by the scholar, who, coming quietly into the tower awhile after, little by little removed the ladder, which led to the sollar where she was, and after awaited that which she should do and say.
uz: Xonim minoraga ko'tarilib, shimolga burilib, olim tomonidan berilgan so'zlarni qayta-qayta asoslay boshladi. U birozdan keyin minoraga kirib, asta-sekin narvonni olib tashladi, u u turgan quyoshga olib borardi va keyin nima qilish va aytishini kutdi.

en: Meanwhile, the lady, having seven times said her conjuration, began to look for the two damsels and so long was her waiting (more by token that she felt it cooler than she could have wished) that she saw the dawn appear; whereupon, woeful that it had not befallen as the scholar had told her, she said in her- self, ‘I fear me yonder man hath had a mind to give me a night such as that
uz: Ayni paytda, xonim yetti marta sehrini aytganidan so'ng, ikki xonimni qidirishni boshladi va shunchalik uzoq kutdi (aslida u buni xohlaganidan ko'ra salqinroq his qildi)ki, tong chiqishini ko'rdi; shundan so'ng, u olim aytganidek bo'lmaganiga xafa bo'lib, o'zicha dedi: "Qo'rqaman, u yerda menga shunday tun berishga aqli bor edi."

en: which I gave him; but, an that be his intent, he hath ill known to avenge himself, for that this night hath not been as long by a third as was his, for- bye that the cold was of anothergates sort.’ Then, so the day might not sur- prise her there, she proceeded to seek to go down from the tower, but found the ladder gone; whereupon her courage forsook her, as it were the world had failed beneath her feet, and she fell down aswoon upon the platform of the tower.
uz: Men unga berdim; lekin, bu uning maqsadi edi, u o'zini qasos olishni bilmaydi, chunki bu tun uningnikidan ko'ra uchinchi bo'lmagan, chunki sovuq boshqa darvozalardan edi.

en: As soon as her sense returned to her, she fell to weeping piteously and bemoaning herself, and perceiving but too well that this must have been the scholar’s doing, she went on to blame herself for having af- fronted others and after for having overmuch trusted in him whom she had good reason to believe her enemy; and on this wise she abode a great while.
uz: U o'ziga kelishi bilanoq, o'ziga achinish va achinish bilan yig'ladi va bu olimning ishi bo'lganini juda yaxshi anglab yetgach, boshqalarni oldinga qo'yganligi va keyin dushmaniga ishonish uchun asosli sababga ega bo'lgan unga haddan tashqari ishonganligi uchun o'zini ayblashga ketdi; va shu tariqa u uzoq vaqt qoldi.

en: Then, looking if there were no way of descending and seeing none, she fell again to her lamentation and gave herself up to bitter thought, saying in her- self, ‘Alas, unhappy woman!
uz: Keyin, pastga tushishning hech qanday yo'li yo'qligini ko'rib, u yana o'zining motamlariga duch keldi va o'zini achchiq o'yga soldi, o'zicha dedi: "Alas, baxtsiz ayol!"

en: What will be said of thy brothers and kinsfolk and neighbours and generally of all the people of Florence, when it shall be known that thou has been found here naked?
uz: Florensiyaning barcha aholisi va akangiz, qarindoshlaringiz, qo'shningiz va umuman olganda, bu yerda yalang'och holda topilganingiz ma'lum bo'lganda, ular haqida nima deyishadi?

en: Thy repute, that hath hitherto been so great, will be known to have been false; and shouldst thou seek to frame lying excuses for thyself, (if indeed there are any to be found) the ac- cursed scholar, who knoweth all thine affairs, will not suffer thee lie.
uz: Sizning shu qadar buyuk obro'ingiz yolg'on ekanligi ma'lum bo'ladi; va agar o'zingiz uchun yolg'on bahonalar tuzmoqchi bo'lsangiz (agar rostdan ham biror biri topilsa), la'nati olim, barcha ishlaringizni biladigan, sizga yolg'on gapirishga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: Oh wretched woman, that wilt at one stroke have lost the youth so ill-fatedly beloved and thine own honour!’ Therewithal she fell into such a passion of woe that she was like to cast herself down from the tower to the ground; but, the sun being now risen and she drawing near to one side of the walls of the tower, to look if any boy should pass with cattle, whom she might send for her maid, it chanced that the scholar, who had slept awhile at the foot of a bush, awaking, saw her and she him; whereupon quoth he to her, ‘Good day, madam; are the dam- sels come yet?’ The lady, seeing and hearing him, began afresh to weep sore and besought him to come within the tower, so she might speak with him.
uz: Ey bechora ayol, sen bir zumda shunchalik baxtsiz sevgan yoshligingni va o'z sharafingni yo'qotgansan! Shu zahoti u shunchalik azob chekdi, hatto minordan yerga tashlanishga o'xshardi; lekin quyosh chiqishi bilan minoraning devorlarining bir tomoniga yaqinlashib, biror bola mol bilan o'tib ketayotganini ko'rmoqchi bo'ldingmi, uni xizmatkoriga yuborsa, shunday bo'ldiki, bir muddat buta etagida uxlagan olim uni ko'rib, uni ko'rdi; shundan so'ng u unga dedi: "Xayrli kun, damlar hali kelyaptimi?" Xonim uni ko'rib, uni eshitib, yana achchiq yig'lay boshladi va unga minora ichiga kirishni iltimos qildi, shunda u bilan gaplashdi.

en: In this he was courteous enough to comply with her and she laying herself prone on the platform and showing only her head at the opening, said, weeping, ‘Assuredly, Rinieri, if I gave thee an ill night, thou hast well avenged thyself of me, for that, albeit it is July, I have thought to freeze this night, naked as I am, more by token that I have so sore bewept both the trick I put upon thee and mine own folly in believing thee that it is a wonder I have any eyes left in my head.
uz: Shunda u unga rozilik bildirishga yetarlicha xushmuomala edi va u platformaga egilib, faqat boshini ochilishida ko'rsatib, yig'lab dedi: "Albatta, Rinieri, agar men senga yomon tun bergan bo'lsam, mendan o'zingni yaxshi qasos olding, chunki, garchi iyul oyi bo'lsa ham, men bu tunni shunday yalang'och holda muzlatishni o'yladim, ko'proq, chunki men senga qo'ygan hiylani ham, senga ishonishdagi o'zimning ahmoqligimni ham shunchalik qattiq urganmanki, bu mo'jiza, mening boshimda hech qanday ko'zim qolmagan."

en: Wherefore I entreat thee, not for the love of me, whom thou hast no call to love, but for the love of thyself, who are a
uz: Shuning uchun men Sendan iltimos qilaman, menga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun emas, seni sevishga chaqirig'ing yo'q, balki o'zingni sevishing uchun, ular...

en: gentleman, that thou be content, for vengeance of the injury I did thee, with that which thou hast already done and cause fetch me my clothes and suffer me come down hence, nor seek to take from me that which thou couldst not after restore me, an thou wouldst, to wit, my honour; for, if I took from thee the being with me that night, I can render thee many nights for that one, whenassoever it liketh thee.
uz: Janob, senga yetkazgan zararim uchun qasos olishing kerak, sen allaqachon qilgan ishing uchun va menga kiyimlarimni olib kelishingni va meni bu yerdan tushirishingni buyur. Meni tiklay olmagan narsani mendan olib qo'yishni istamasang, ya'ni, mening sharafimni; chunki agar men o'sha kecha seni o'zim bilan birga bo'lganingni olib qo'ysam, senga o'sha kecha uchun ko'p tunlar beraman, agar u senga yoqsa.

en: Let this, then, sufﬁce and let it content thee, as a man of honour, to have availed to avenge thyself and to have caused me confess it.
uz: Shunday ekan, bu yetarli bo'lsin va sizni, hurmatli inson sifatida, o'zingizdan qasos olishga va meni buni tan olishga majbur qilishga qodir qilsin.

en: Seek not to use thy strength against a woman; no glory is it for an eagle to have overcome a dove, wherefore, for the love of God and thine own honour, have pity on me.’ The scholar, with stern mind revolving in himself the injury suffered and seeing her weep and beseech, felt at once both pleasure and annoy; pleasure in the revenge which he had desired more than aught else, and annoy he felt, for that his humanity moved him to compassion of the unhappy wo- man.
uz: Qudratingni ayolga qarshi ishlatma; burgut uchun kaptar ustidan g'alaba qozonish sharaf emas, shuning uchun, Xudoning muhabbati va o'z sharafing uchun, menga rahm qil.
