Olim, o'zida qattiq fikr bilan jarohat olganini va uning yig'layotganini ko'rib, darhol ham zavq va g'azabni his qildi; u hech narsadan ko'ra xohlagan qasosdan zavq, va u g'azablandi, chunki uning insoniyligi uni baxtsiz odamga rahm qilishga undadi.

en: However, humanity availing not to overcome the ﬁerceness of his ap- petite [for vengeance], ‘Madam Elena,’ answered he, ‘if my prayers (which, it is true, I knew not to bathe with tears nor to make honeyed, as thou presently knowest to proffer thine), had availed, the night when I was dying of cold in thy snow-ﬁlled courtyard, to procure me to be put of thee but a little under cover, it were a light matter to me to hearken now unto thine; but, if thou be presently so much more concerned for thine honour than in the past and it be grievous to thee to abide up there naked, address these thy prayers to him in whose arms thou didst not scruple, that night which thou thyself recallest, to abide naked, hearing me the while go about thy court- yard, chattering with my teeth and trampling the snow, and get thee succour of him; cause him fetch thee thy clothes and set thee the ladder, whereby
uz: Ammo insoniyat o'z ap-pittasining shafqatsizligini yengishga yordam bermay, Madam Elena, deb javob berdi u. Agar mening duolarim (to'g'ri, men na ko'z yosh bilan cho'milishni, na asal bilan to'yishni bilmasdim, chunki sen hozir o'zingnikini tozalashni bilasan), qor bilan to'ldirilgan hovlingda sovuqdan o'layotgan tunimda, meni sendan biroz yashirishni so'rashga yordam bergan bo'lsa, hozir senga quloq solish oson edi; lekin agar hozir sening shon-shuhrating uchun o'tmishdagidan ko'ra ko'proq qayg'urgan bo'lsam va u yerda yalang'och qolish qiyin bo'lsa, sen o'zingni qulog'ingda tutganingda, seni yalang'och holda, seni ko'tarib yurganingda, seni ko'tarib yurganing va uni ko'tarib yurganing,

en: thou mayest descend, and study to inform him with tenderness for thine honour, the which thou hast not scrupled both now and a thousand other times to imperil for him.
uz: Sen tushishing va unga o'z sharafing uchun mehr bilan xabar berish uchun o'rganishing mumkin, bu sharafni hozir ham, ming marta ham unga xavf ostiga qo'ymaganing uchun.

en: Why dost thou not call him to come help thee?
uz: Nega uni yordamga chaqirmaysan?

en: To whom pertaineth it more than unto him?
uz: Undan ko'ra kimga tegishli?

en: Thou art his; and what should he regard or succour, an he regard not neither succour thee?
uz: Sen uning egasisan; va u senga yordam bermasa, nimaga e'tibor berishi kerak yoki yordam berishi kerak?

en: Call him, silly wo- man that thou art, and prove if the love thou bearest him and thy wits and his together can avail to deliver thee from my folly, whereof, dallying with him the while, thou questionedst aforetime whether himseemed the greater, my folly or the love thou borest him.389 Thou canst not now be lavish to me of that which I desire not, nor couldst thou deny it to me, an I desired it; keep thy nights for thy lover, an it chance that thou come off hence alive; be
uz: Uni chaqir, ahmoq odam, sen o'zing ekanligingni isbotla va unga bo'lgan muhabbating, aql-idroking va uning birgaligi seni mening ahmoqligimdan qutqarishga yordam berishini isbotla. U bilan vaqt o'tishi bilan birga, avvalroq undan kattaroqmi, ahmoqligimmi yoki muhabbatingmi, deb so'rading. 389 Sen endi menga xohlamagan narsadan boy bo'la olmaysan, va men xohlagan narsadan menga rad eta olmaysan; tunlaringni sevganing uchun saqla, shunda undan tirik chiqishing mumkin;

en: I had overmuch of one of them and it sufﬁceth me to have been once befooled.
uz: Ulardan birontasi haddan tashqari ko'p edi va menga bir marta befarq bo'lish kifoya.

en: Again, using thy craft and wiliness in speech, thou studiest, by extolling me, to gain my goodwill and callest me a gentle- man and a man of honour, thinking thus to cajole me into playing the mag- nanimous and forebearing to punish thee for thy wickedness; but thy bland- ishments shall not now darken me the eyes of the understanding, as did thy disloyal promises whilere.
uz: Yana, so'zlaringda mahorating va donoliging bilan, meni ulug'lab, o'z roziligimni qozonish va meni yumshoq va sharafli odam deb atash uchun o'qiysan, shu tariqa seni yovuzliging uchun jazolash uchun katta-badiiy va bashoratchi bo'lishga undashni o'ylaysan; lekin sening bema'ni ishlaring endi meni tushunishning ko'zlarini xiralashtirmaydi, xuddi sening sadoqatsiz va'dalaring kabi.

en: I know myself, nor did I learn so much of myself what while I sojourned at Paris as thou taughtest me in one single night of thine.
uz: Men o'zimni bilaman, Parijda bo'lganimda, sening bir kechingda menga o'rgatganing kabi, o'zimdan ham ko'p narsa o'rganmadim.

en: But, granted I were indeed magnanimous, thou art none of those to- wards whom magnanimity should be shown; the issue of punishment, as likewise of vengeance, in the case of wild beasts such as thou art, behoveth to be death, whereas for human beings that should sufﬁce whereof thou speakest.
uz: Lekin, men haqiqatan ham saxovatli bo'lsam-da, sen saxovat ko'rsatilishi kerak bo'lgan odamlardan emassan; jazo masalasi, xuddi qasos masalasi kabi, sen kabi yovvoyi hayvonlar holatida o'lim bo'lishi kerak, lekin sen gapirayotgan insonlar uchun yetarli bo'lishi kerak.

en: Wherefore, albeit I am no eagle, knowing thee to be no dove, but a venomous serpent, I mean to pursue thee, as an immemorial enemy, with every hate and all my might, albeit this that I do to thee can scarce properly be styled vengeance, but rather chastisement, inasmuch as vengeance should overpass the offence and this will not attain thereto; for that, an I sought to avenge myself, considering to what a pass thou broughtest my soul, thy life, should I take it from thee, would not sufﬁce me, no, nor the lives of an hundred others such as thou, since, slaying thee, I should but slay a vile, wicked and worthless trull of a woman.
uz: Shuning uchun, garchi men burgut bo'lmasam ham, seni kaptar emas, balki zaharli ilondek bilsam ham, seni abadiy dushman sifatida, har qanday nafrat va butun kuchim bilan ta'qib qilmoqchiman. Garchi senga qilgan ishim qasos deb atalsa ham, balki jazo bo'lsa ham, qasos gunohdan o'tib, bunga erisha olmaydi; chunki men o'zimni qasos olishga harakat qildim, sen jonimni qanday o'tkazganingni hisobga olib, sening joning, agar men uni sendan olsam, menga ham yetarli bo'lmas edi, yo'q, sen kabi yuz nafar boshqa odamning hayotiga ham, chunki men seni o'ldirgan holda, men faqat bir ayolning yovuz, yovuz va qadrsiz qulini o'ldirgan bo'lardim.

en: And what a devil more account (setting aside this thy scantling of fair favour,390 which a few years will mar, ﬁlling it with wrinkles), art thou than whatsoever other sorry serving-drab?
uz: Va shaytondan ham ko'ra (bu go'zal marhamatning siyrakligini bir chetga surib qo'yib, bir necha yil davomida buzadi va ajinlar bilan to'ldiradi), sen boshqa har qanday achinarli xizmatkorlardan ko'ra afsuslanasanmi?

en: Whereas it was no fault of thine that thou failedst of causing the death of a man of honour, as thou styledst me but now, whose life may yet in one day be of more service to the world than an hundred thousand of thy like could be what while the world endureth.
uz: Garchi sening aybing yo'q edi, meni hozirgina shunday deb atayotganingdek, bir sharafli odamning o'limiga sabab bo'lmading, uning hayoti bir kun ichida senga o'xshagan yuz ming kishidan ko'ra dunyoga ko'proq xizmat qilishi mumkin edi, dunyo azob chekayotganda.

en: I will teach thee, then, by means of this annoy that thou sufferest, what it is to ﬂout men of sense, and particularly scholars, and will give thee cause never more, an thou comest off alive, to fall into such a folly.
uz: Shunday qilib, senga azob chekayotgan bu g'azabing orqali aql egalarini, ayniqsa olimlarni aldash nima ekanligini o'rgataman va senga hech qachon tirik qolganing uchun bunday ahmoqlikka tushishga sabab bermayman.

en: But, an thou have so great a wish to des- cend, why dost thou not cast thyself down?
uz: Lekin, sening shunchalik katta umiding bor ekan, nega o'zingni pastga tashlamaysan?

en: On this wise, with God’s help, thou wilt, by breaking thy neck, at once deliver thyself from the torment, wherein it seemeth to thee thou art, and make me the joyfullest man in the world.
uz: Shu tariqa, Xudoning yordami bilan bo'yningni sindirib, o'zingdek tuyuladigan azobdan o'zingni darhol qutqarasan va meni dunyodagi eng quvonchli odamga aylantirasan.

en: Now, I have no more to say to thee.
uz: Endi senga aytadigan boshqa gapim yo'q.

en: I knew to contrive on such wise that I caused thee go up thither; do thou now contrive to come down thence, even as thou knewest to befool me.’
uz: Men seni u yerga ko'tarishga undaydigan darajada hiyla o'ylab topishni bilardim; endi meni ahmoq qilishni bilganing kabi, u yerdan tushishga ham hiyla o'ylab ko'r.

en: What while the scholar spoke thus, the wretched lady wept without ceas- ing and the time lapsed by, the sun still rising high and higher; but, when she saw that he was silent, she said, ‘Alack, cruel man, if the accursed night was so grievous to thee and if my default seem to thee so heinous a thing that neither my young beauty nor my bitter tears and humble prayers may avail to move thee to any pity, at least let this act of mine alone some little move thee and abate the rigour of thy rancour, to wit, that I but now trusted in thee and discovered to thee mine every secret, opening withal to thy de- sire a way whereby thou mightest avail to make me cognizant of my sin; more by token that, except I had trusted in thee, thou hadst had no means of availing to take of me that vengeance, which thou seemest to have so ar- dently desired.
uz: Olim shunday gapirar ekan, bechora xonim tinimsiz yig'lardi va vaqt o'tib borardi, quyosh hali baland va baland chiqardi; lekin, u uning jimligini ko'rgach, dedi: "Alak, shafqatsiz odam, agar la'nati tun senga shunchalik og'riqli bo'lsa va mening xatolarim senga shunchalik dahshatli tuyulsa, na yosh go'zalligim, na achchiq ko'z yoshlari va kamtarona ibodatlarim senga hech qanday rahm qilmaydi, hech bo'lmaganda, mening bu ishim senga ozgina ta'sir qilsin va ranjingning og'irligini susaytirsin, ya'ni, men senga ishonardim va har bir sirimni ochib, gunohimdan voz kechish yo'lini topdim; bundan tashqari, agar men senga yordam bermagan bo'lsam, sen meni o'chirish uchun hech qanday vositaga ega emas eding.

en: For God’s sake, leave thine anger and pardon me henceforth; I am ready, so thou wilt but forgive me and bring me down hence, altogeth- er to renounce yonder faithless youth and to have thee alone to lover and lord, albeit thou decriest my beauty, avouching it short-lived and little worth; natheless, whatever it be, compared with that of other women, yet this I know, that, if for nought else, it is to be prized for that it is the desire and pastime and delight of men’s youth, and thou art not old.
uz: Xudo haqqi uchun, g'azabingni tashla va meni bundan buyon kechir; men tayyorman, shuning uchun meni kechir va meni shu yerdan pastga tushir, xolos - bu seni yolg'iz sevgan va xo'jayin sifatida qoldirish, garchi sen mening go'zalligimni qoralab, uni qisqa umr va arzimaydigan bo'lsang ham; shunga qaramay, boshqa ayollarning go'zalligi bilan solishtirganda, men bilaman, agar hech narsa bo'lmasa, bu erkaklarning xohishi, ko'ngilxushligi va zavqi uchun qadrlanishi kerak, va sen qari emassan.

en: And albeit I am cruelly entreated of thee, I cannot believe withal that thou wouldst fain see me die so unseemly a death as were the casting myself down from this tower, as in desperation, before thine eyes, wherein, an thou was not a liar as thou are since become, I was erst so pleasing.
uz: Va garchi men Sendan shafqatsizlarcha iltijo qilsam ham, sening meni shu minordan tushgandek, umidsizlikda, ko'zlaring oldida shunday noxush o'limni ko'rishni xohlaganingga ishonolmayman, unda sen yolg'onchi emas eding, chunki sen paydo bo'lganingdan beri, men avval bunchalik yoqimli edim.

en: Alack, have ruth on me for God’s sake and pity’s!
uz: Alack, menga rahm qil, Xudo haqqi va rahm qil!

en: The sun beginneth to wax hot, and like as the over- much cold irked me this night, even so doth the heat begin to do me sore annoy.’ The scholar, who held her in parley for his diversion, answered, ‘Madam, thou hast not presently trusted thine honour in my hands for any love that thou borest me, but to regain him whom thou hast lost, wherefore it mer- iteth but greater severity, and if thou think that this way alone was apt and opportune unto the vengeance desired of me, thou thinkest foolishly; I had a thousand others; nay, whilst feigning to love thee, I had spread a thousand snares about thy feet, and it would not have been long, had this not chanced, ere thou must of necessity have fallen into one of them, nor couldst thou have fallen into any but it had caused thee greater torment and shame than this present, the which I took, not to ease thee, but to be the quicklier satis- ﬁed.
uz: Quyosh issiq bo'la boshlaydi va xuddi shu kechada juda sovuq meni bezovta qilganidek, issiqlik ham meni qattiq bezovta qila boshlaydi. Olim, uni o'ziga jalb qilish uchun o'ziga tortgan holda, javob berdi: Xonim, siz meni sevish uchun qo'limga o'z sharafini ishonmadingiz, balki siz yo'qotgan odamni qaytarib olish uchun, chunki bu juda katta qiyinchilikdir, va agar siz bu yo'l faqat o'ch olish uchun mos va qulay deb o'ylasangiz, ahmoqona o'ylaysiz; menda mingta boshqalar bor edi; yo'q, men sevishga urinayotganimda, men sizning oyoqlaringizga mingta tuzoq tashlagan edim, va bu sizga uzoq bo'lmas edi, agar siz ulardan birortasini tezroq tushirgan bo'lsangiz, siz ulardan birortasini ham ko'proq azobga duch kelmas edingiz.

en: And though all else should have failed me, the pen had still been left me, wherewithal I would have written such and so many things of thee and
uz: Va garchi hamma narsa meni muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchratgan bo'lsa ham, qalam hali ham meni tark etgan bo'lardi, unda men siz haqingizda shunday va hokazo ko'p narsalarni yozgan bo'lardim va...

en: after such a fashion that, whenas thou camest (as thou wouldst have come) to know of them, thou wouldst a thousand times a day have wished thyself never born.
uz: Shundayki, ularni bilmoqchi bo'lganingda, kuniga ming marta o'zing hech qachon tug'ilmasligingni xohlarding.

en: The power of the pen is far greater than they imagine who have not proved it with experience.
uz: Qalamning kuchi tajriba bilan isbotlamaganlar tasavvur qilganidan ancha katta.

en: I swear to God (so may He gladden me to the end of this vengeance that I take of thee, even as He hath made me glad thereof in the beginning!) that I would have written such things of thee, that, being ashamed, not to say before other folk, but before thine own self, thou shouldst have put out thine own eyes, not to see thyself in the glass; wherefore let not the little rivulet twit the sea with having caused it wax.
uz: Allohga qasam ichaman (U meni sendan olgan qasosning oxirigacha xursand qilsin, xuddi boshida xursand qilganidek), men sen haqingda shunday narsalarni yozgan bo'lardimki, boshqa odamlar oldida emas, balki o'z joning oldida aytishdan uyalganing uchun, o'zingni oynada ko'rmaslik uchun ko'zlaringni ko'rsatishing kerak edi; shuning uchun kichik to'lqin dengizni ko'pirtirib yubormasin.

en: Of thy love or that thou be mine, I reck not, as I have already said, a jot; be thou e’en his, an thou may, whose thou wast erst and whom, as I once hated, so at this present I love, having regard unto that which he hath wrought towards thee of late.
uz: Sizning muhabbatingiz yoki meniki ekanligingiz haqida, men allaqachon aytganimdek, hech qanday narsa deb hisoblamayman; siz undan bo'lishingiz kerak, yoki sizdan bo'lishingiz mumkin, siz avval kimni yoqtirgansiz va men qachonlardir kimni yomon ko'rgan bo'lsam, hozir men uni sevaman, u sizga nisbatan oxirgi paytlarda qilgan ishlariga qarab.

en: You women go falling enamoured of young springalds and covet their love, for that you see them somewhat fresher of colour and blacker of beard and they go erect and jaunty and dance and joust, all which things they have had who are somewhat more in years, ay, and these know that which those have yet to learn.
uz: Siz ayollar yosh bahorgichlarga oshiq bo'lib ketasiz va ularning muhabbatiga oshiq bo'lasiz, chunki ularni biroz yangi rangda va qora soqolda ko'rasiz va ular tik turib raqsga tushishadi, raqsga tushishadi va joist bo'lishadi, bularning barchasi yillar davomida biroz ko'proq bo'lgan narsalarga ega bo'lishadi, ha, va bular hali o'rganmagan narsalarni bilishadi.

en: Moreover, you hold them better cavaliers and deem that they fare more miles in a day than men of riper age.
uz: Qolaversa, ularni yaxshiroq chavandozlar deb hisoblaysiz va ular bir kunda yetukroq odamlarga qaraganda ko'proq milya yurishadi deb hisoblaysiz.

en: Certes, I confess that they jumble a wench’s furbelows more briskly; but those more in years, being men of experience, know better where the ﬂeas stick, and little meat and savoury is far and away rather to be chosen than much and insipid, more by token that hard trotting undoth and wearieth folk, how young soever they be, whereas easy going, though belike it bring one somewhat later to the inn, at the least carrieth him thither unfatigued.
uz: Albatta, tan olaman, ular bir yoshdagi qizning pastki qismini tezroq aralashtiradilar; lekin tajribali odamlar burgalar qayerda qo'nishini yaxshiroq bilishadi, va oz go'sht va mazali narsa ko'p va mazali bo'lishdan ko'ra yaxshiroq tanlanadi, ko'proq qattiq yurish odamlarni charchatadi, qanchalik yosh bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, oson borish, garchi uni mehmonxonaga biroz keyinroq olib kelsa ham, hech bo'lmaganda uni u yerga charchoqsiz olib boradi.

en: You women perceive not, animals without understanding that you are, how much ill lieth hid under this scantling of fair seeming.
uz: Siz ayollar, o'zingizni anglamagan hayvonlar, bu go'zal ko'rinishning g'ijimasi ostida qancha yomonlik yashiringanini anglamaydilar.

en: Young fellows are not content with one woman; nay, as many as they see, so many do they covet and of so many themseemeth they are worthy; wherefore their love cannot be stable, and of this thou mayst presently of thine own experi- ence bear very true witness.
uz: Yosh yigitlar bir ayol bilan kifoyalanishmaydi; aksincha, ko'pchilik ko'rsa, ko'pchilikni xohlashadi va ko'pchilikni o'ziga loyiq ko'rishadi; shuning uchun ularning muhabbati barqaror bo'la olmaydi va buning uchun hozirda o'z tajribangizdan juda haqiqiy guvohlik berishingiz mumkin.

en: Themseemeth they are worthy to be wor- shipped and caressed of their mistresses and they have no greater glory than to vaunt them of those whom they have had; the which default of theirs hath aforetime cast many a woman into the arms of the monks, who tell no tales.
uz: Ularga o'z bekasilaridan qayg'urishga va erkalashga loyiq ko'rinadi va ularga ega bo'lganlari haqida maqtanishdan ko'ra buyukroq sharaf yo'q; ularning xatolari ilgari ko'p ayollarni hech qanday hikoya qilmaydigan rohiblar qo'liga tashlagan.

en: Albeit thou sayst that never did any know of thine amours, save thy maid and myself, thou knowest it ill and believest awry, an thou think thus.
uz: Garchi sen hech qachon sevganlaring haqida hech kim bilmagan desang ham, faqat xizmatkoring va o'zimdan boshqa hech kim bilmagan bo'lsam ham, sen buni yomon bilasan va noto'g'ri ishonasan, shunday deb o'ylaysan.

en: His391 quarter talketh well nigh of nothing else, and thine likewise; but most times the last to whose ears such things come is he to whom they per-
uz: Uning 391 qismi boshqa hech narsa haqida yaxshi gapirmaydi, sizniki ham xuddi shunday; lekin ko'pincha bu kabi narsalar qulog'iga oxirgi kelgan odam, ular uchun...

en: Young men, to boot, despoil you, whereas it is given you392 of men of riper years.
uz: Yosh yigitlar, sizni poyabzalga tushirish, o'g'irlash uchun, garchi sizga yetukroq yoshdagi 392 ta erkak berilgan bo'lsa.

en: Since, then, thou hast ill chosen, be thou his to whom thou gavest thyself and leave me, of whom thou madest mock, to others, for that I have found a mistress of much more account than thou, who hath been wise enough to know me better than thou didst.
uz: Shunday ekan, sen yomon tanlaganing uchun, o'zingni kimga berganingni o'zing bo'l va meni, seni masxara qilganingni boshqalarga tashla, chunki men sendan ko'ra ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lgan, mendan yaxshiroq bilishga yetarlicha dono bekani topdim.

en: And that thou mayst carry into the other world greater assurance of the desire of mine eyes than me- seemeth thou gatherest from my words, do but cast thyself down forthright and thy soul, being, as I doubt not it will be, straightway received into the arms of the devil, will be able to see if mine eyes be troubled or not at see- ing thee fall headlong.
uz: Va sen mening so'zlarimdan ko'ra ko'zlarimning istaklariga mendan ko'ra ko'proq ishonch bilan boshqa dunyoga olib kirishing uchun, o'zingni to'g'ri pastga tashla va joningni, shubhasiz, shayton qo'liga darhol qabul qilinib, ko'zlarim bezovta bo'lsa yoki seni ko'rib boshingga yiqilmasligini ko'ra ol.

en: But, as medoubteth thou wilt not consent to do me so much pleasure, I counsel thee, if the sun begin to scorch thee, remember thee of the cold thou madest me suffer, which an thou mingle with the heat aforesaid, thou wilt without fail feel the sun attempered.’ The disconsolate lady, seeing that the scholar’s words tended to a cruel end, fell again to weeping and said, ‘Harkye, since nothing I can say availeth to move thee to pity of me, let the love move thee, which thou bearest that lady whom thou hast found wiser than I and of whom thou sayst thou art beloved, and for the love of her pardon me and fetch me my clothes, so I may dress myself, and cause me descend hence.’ Therewith the scholar began to laugh and seeing that tierce was now passed by a good hour, replied, ‘Marry, I know not how to say thee nay, since thou conjurest me by such a lady; tell me where thy clothes are and I will
uz: Lekin, shu qadar ko'p zavqlanishga rozi bo'lmasliging uchun, agar quyosh seni kuydiradigan bo'lsa, men senga maslahat beraman, meni sovuqdan azob chekkaningni esla, uni oldindan aytib o'tilgan issiqlik bilan aralashtirib, albatta quyoshdan azob chekkaningni his qil.

en: go for them and help thee come down from up yonder.’ The lady, believing this, was some- what comforted and showed him where she had laid her clothes; whereupon he went forth of the tower and bidding his servant not depart thence, but abide near at hand and watch as most he might that none should enter there till such time as he should return, went off to his friend’s house, where he dined at his ease and after, whenas himseemed time, betook himself to sleep; whilst the lady, left upon the tower, albeit some little heartened with fond hope, natheless beyond measure woebegone, sat up and creeping close to that part of the wall where there was a little shade, fell awaiting, in com- pany of very bitter thoughts.
uz: Ularni qidirib, yuqoridan tushishga yordam ber." Xonim bunga ishongan holda, uni tasalli bergan edi va kiyimlarini qayerga qo'yganini ko'rsatdi. Shundan so'ng u minordan chiqib, xizmatkoriga u yerdan ketmaslikni buyurdi, balki yaqinroq turdi va qaytib kelguncha hech kim u yerga kirmasligini qo'lidan kelganicha kuzatdi, do'sti uyiga bordi, u yerda u o'z xohishiga ko'ra ovqatlandi va keyin, o'zi yetgan vaqtda, uxlashga tushdi; xonim esa minordan biroz umid bilan qutulgan bo'lsa ham, cheksiz azob chekmasdan, o'rnidan o'tib, devorning o'sha qismiga yaqin kirib, biroz soya bor edi, juda achchiq fikrlar bilan kutib turdi.

en: There she abode, now hoping and now des- pairing of the scholar’s return with her clothes, and passing from one thought to another, she presently fell asleep, as one who was overcome of dolour and who had slept no whit the past night.
uz: U yerda u turardi, endi olimning o'z kiyimlari bilan qaytishiga umid qilib va endi umid qilib, bir fikrdan ikkinchisiga o'tib, o'tgan kecha hech narsa uxlamagan va g'azabdan o'zib ketgan odam kabi uxlab qoldi.

en: The sun, which was exceeding hot, being now risen to the meridian, beat full and straight upon her tender and delicate body and upon her head,
uz: Quyosh, haddan tashqari issiq bo'lib, endi meridianga ko'tarilganda, uning mayin va nozik tanasiga hamda boshiga to'liq va to'g'ri urdi.

en: which was all uncovered, with such force that not only did it burn her ﬂesh, wherever it touched it, but cracked and opened it all over little by little, and such was the pain of the burning that it constrained her to awake, albeit she slept fast.
uz: Bularning hammasi shunday kuch bilan ochilgan ediki, u nafaqat uning tanasini qayerga tegsa ham yoqib yuborardi, balki uni asta-sekin yorib ochardi va kuyishning og'rig'i uni uyg'otishga majbur qildi, garchi u tez uxlagan bo'lsa ham.

en: Feeling herself on the roast and moving somewhat, it seemed as if all her scorched skin cracked and clove asunder for the motion, as we see happen with a scorched sheepskin, if any stretch it, and to boot her head irked her so sore that it seemed it would burst, which was no wonder.
uz: O'zini qovurilgan his qilib, biroz harakatlanayotgandek tuyuldi, go'yo uning butun kuygan terisi yorilib, harakat uchun bo'linib ketgandek edi, xuddi kuygan qo'y terisi bilan sodir bo'layotganini ko'rayotganimizdek, agar uni cho'zsak, boshini shunday qiynardiki, u yorib ketgandek tuyuldi, bu ajablanarli emas.

en: And the platform of the tower was so burning hot that she could ﬁnd no resting- place there either for her feet or for otherwhat; wherefore, without standing fast, she still removed now hither and now thither, weeping.
uz: Va minoraning platformasi shunchalik issiq edi, u yerda na oyoqlari uchun, na boshqa narsalar uchun dam olish joyini topa olmadi; shuning uchun, qattiq turmasdan, u hali ham bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa yig'lab ketardi.

en: Moreover, there being not a breath of wind, the ﬂies and gads ﬂocked thither in swarms and settling upon her cracked ﬂesh, stung her so cruelly that each prick seemed to her a pike-stab; wherefore she stinted not to ﬂing her hands about, still cursing herself, her life, her lover and the scholar.
uz: Qolaversa, shamol ham yo'qligi sababli, pashshalar va yillar to'dalarga to'lib-toshdi va uning yoriq go'shtiga qo'nishdi, uni shunchalik shafqatsizlarcha tishladiki, har bir tikan unga igna sanchig'idek tuyuldi; shuning uchun u qo'llarini tashlamasdan tiyildi, hali ham o'zini, hayotini, sevgilisini va olimini la'natladi.

en: Being thus by the inexpressible heat of the sun, by the ﬂies and the gads and likewise by hunger, but much more by thirst, and by a thousand irk- some thoughts, to boot, tortured and stung and pierced to the quick, she started to her feet and addressed herself to look if she might see or hear any- one near at hand, resolved, whatever might betide thereof, to call him and crave aid.
uz: Shunday qilib, quyoshning ifodalab bo'lmaydigan issiqligi, pashshalar va yillar, shuningdek, ochlik, lekin undan ham ko'proq chanqoqlik va mingta g'azab - ba'zi o'ylar tufayli, oyoqlari bilan turib, oyoqlari bilan o'ziga murojaat qildi va yaqin atrofdagi biror kishini ko'rishga yoki eshitishga qaror qildi, undan boshqa narsani chaqirishga va yordam so'rashga qaror qildi.

en: But of this resource also had her unfriendly fortune deprived her.
uz: Lekin bu resursdan uni do'stona bo'lmagan boyligi ham mahrum qildi.

en: The husbandmen were all departed from the ﬁelds for the heat, more by token that none had come that day to work therenigh, they being all en- gaged in threshing out their sheaves beside their houses; wherefore she heard nought but crickets and saw the Arno, which latter sight, provoking in her desire of its waters, abated not her thirst, but rather increased it.
uz: Dehqonlarning hammasi issiqlik uchun dalalardan jo'nab ketishdi, chunki o'sha kuni kechasi hech kim ishga kelmagan edi, ularning hammasi uylari yonidagi o'roqlarini terishda band edilar; shuning uchun u faqat qichqiriqlarni eshitdi va Arno'ni ko'rdi, bu so'nggi ko'rinish uning suvlariga bo'lgan ishtiyoqi bilan uning chanog'ini kamaytirmadi, aksincha, uni kuchaytirdi.

en: In sev- eral places also she saw thickets and shady places and houses here and there, which were all alike to her an anguish for desire of them.
uz: Ba'zi joylarda u o'rmonlar, soyali joylar va u yerda-bu yerda uylarni ham ko'rdi, ularning barchasi unga ularning orzusi uchun azob edi.

en: What more shall we say of the ill-starred lady?
uz: Yulduzsiz xonim haqida yana nima deyish mumkin?

en: The sun overhead and the heat of the platform underfoot and the stings of the ﬂies and gads on every side had so entreated her that, whereas with her whiteness she had overcome the dark- ness of the foregoing night, she was presently grown red as ruddle,393 and all bescabbed as she was with blood, had seemed to whoso saw her the foulest thing in the world.
uz: Quyosh tepasida, platforma ostidagi issiqlik, har tomondagi pashshalarning chaqishi va yillar uni shunchalik iltijo qilgan ediki, o'zining oqligi bilan o'tgan tunning qorong'uligini yenggan bo'lsa-da, u hozirda rul kabi qizarib ketgan edi, 393 va qon bilan qoplanganidek, uni dunyodagi eng iflos narsa deb ko'rgandek edi.

en: As she abode on this wise, without aught of hope or counsel,394 expect- ing death more than otherwhat, it being now past half none, the scholar, arising from sleep and remembering him of his mistress, returned to the tower, to see what was come of her, and sent his servant, who was yet fast-
uz: U shu tariqa turar ekan, hech qanday umid yoki maslahatga ega bo'lmay, 394 o'limni boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq kutardi, endi yarmi yo'q edi, olim uyqudan turib, uni bekasini esladi, undan nima kelishini ko'rish uchun minoraga qaytib keldi va hali tezda bo'lgan xizmatkorini yubordi.

en: The lady, hearing him, came, all weak and anguishful as she was for the grievous annoy she had suffered, overagainst the trap-door and seat- ing herself there, began, weeping, to say, ‘Indeed, Rinieri, thou hast beyond measure avenged thyself, for, if I made thee freeze in my courtyard by night, thou hast made me roast, nay burn, on this tower by day and die of hunger and thirst to boot; wherefore I pray thee by the One only God that thou come up hither and since my heart suffereth me not give myself death with mine own hands, give it me thou, for that I desire it more than aught else, such and so great are the torments I endure.
uz: Xonim, uni eshitib, keldi, xuddi o'zi azob chekkan, azob chekkan, tuzoq eshigidan o'tirgan holda, yig'lab, dedi: "Haqiqatan ham, Rinieri, sen o'zingdan haddan tashqari qasos olding, chunki agar men seni kechasi hovlimda muzlatib qo'ysam, sen meni kunduzi shu minoraga qovurib yubording, balki yoqib yubording va ochlik va chanqoqlikdan o'ldirganding; shuning uchun men seni shu yerga ko'tarilishga ruxsat beradigan yagona Xudoga qasam ichaman, o'zimni o'z qo'llarim bilan o'ldirma, menga ber, chunki men uni boshqa hech narsadan ko'ra ko'proq xohlayman, shunday azoblar men bardosh beraman.

en: Or, an thou wilt not do me that favour, let bring me, at the least, a cup of water, so I may wet my mouth, whereunto my tears sufﬁce not; so sore is the drouth and the burning that I have therein.’ The scholar knew her weakness by her voice and eke saw, in part, her body all burnt up of the sun; wherefore and for her humble prayers there overcame him a little compassion of her; but none the less he answered, ‘Wicked woman, thou shalt not die by my hands; nay, by thine own shalt thou die, an thou have a mind thereto; and thou shalt have of me as much water for the allaying of thy heat as I had ﬁre of thee for the comforting of my cold.
uz: Yoki, agar menga bu marhamatni qilmasang, hech bo'lmaganda, bir piyola suv olib kel, shunda men og'zimni ho'llab qo'yaman, ko'z yoshlarim yetarli bo'lmasa; undagi uyqu va kuyish shunchalik og'riqli. Olim uning zaifligini ovozi bilan bilardi va bir qismi uning tanasi quyoshda kuyganini ko'rdi; shuning uchun uning kamtarona ibodatlari tufayli unga biroz rahm keldi; lekin u shunday javob berdi: "Yomon ayol, sen mening qo'llarim bilan o'lmaysan; yo'q, o'zing bilan o'lasan, sening o'zingda bor; va men sendan ko'p suv ichasan, sening issig'ingni yengish uchun, men sendan sovuqni yengish uchun o't oldim."

en: This much I sore regret that, whereas it behoved me heal the in- ﬁrmity of my cold with the heat of stinking dung, that of thy heat will be healed with the coolth of odoriferous rose-water; and whereas I was like to lose both limbs and life, thou, ﬂayed by this heat, wilt abide fair none other- wise than doth the snake, casting its old skin.’ ‘Alack, wretch that I am,’ cried the lady, ‘God give beauties on such wise acquired to those who wish me ill!
uz: Men shunchalik afsusdamanki, garchi mening sovuqligimning qattiqligini badbo'y go'ngning issig'i bilan davolashim kerak bo'lsa-da, sening issig'ing hidli atirgul suvi bilan shifo topadi; va garchi men oyoq-qo'l va hayotni yo'qotishga o'xshardim, sen bu issiqdan so'ng, ilondan boshqa hech kimdan dono bo'lmaysan, eski terisini tashlab." Lalak, men qanday bechora ekanman,  deb baqirdi xonim,  Xudo menga yomonlik tilaydiganlarga shunday sotib olingan go'zalliklarni bersin!

en: But thou, that are more cruel than any wild beast, how couldst thou have the heart to torture me after this fashion?
uz: Lekin sen, yovvoyi hayvonlardan ham shafqatsizroq bo'lganing uchun, meni bu tarzda azoblashga qanday jur'at qila olasan?

en: What more could I expect from thee or any other, if I had done all thy kinsfolk to death with the cruellest torments?
uz: Agar men barcha qarindoshlaringni shafqatsiz azoblar bilan o'ldirganimda, sendan yoki boshqalardan yana nima kutardim?

en: Certes, meknoweth not what greater cruelty could be wreaked upon a traitor who had brought a whole city to slaughter than that whereto thou hast exposed me in causing me to be roasted of the sun and devoured of the ﬂies and withal denying me a cup of water, whenas to mur- derers condemned of justice is oftentimes, as they go to their death, given to drink of wine, so but they ask it.
uz: Albatta, butun bir shaharni qirg'in qilish uchun olib kelgan xoinga nisbatan quyoshda qovurib, pashshalardan yutib, menga bir piyola suv berish orqali meni fosh qilganingdan ko'ra qanday buyuk shafqatsizlik bo'lishi mumkinligini bilmayman, xuddi adolat hukm qilingan qotillarga ko'pincha o'limga ketayotganda, vino ichishga ruxsat berilganda, ular so'rashadi.

en: Nay, since I see thee abide ﬁrm in thy sav- age cruelty and that my sufferance availeth not anywise to move thee, I will resign myself with patience to receive death, so God, whom I beseech to look with equitable eyes upon this thy dealing, may have mercy upon my soul.’
uz: Yo'q, seni asr shafqatsizligingda sobit turganingni va sabrim seni hech qanday harakatga keltirmayotganini ko'rganim uchun, o'limni qabul qilish uchun sabr bilan taslim bo'laman, toki Xudo, bu ishingga adolatli ko'zlar bilan qarashni so'rayman, jonimga rahm qilsin.

en: So saying, she dragged herself painfully to the midward of the platform, despairing to escape alive from so ﬁerce a heat; and not once, but a thou- sand times, over and above her other torments, she thought to swoon for thirst, still weeping and bemoaning her illhap.
uz: Shunday deb, u o'zini og'riqli tarzda minbar o'rtasiga sudradi, shunchalik shiddatli issiqdan tirik qutulishga umid qilmay; va bir marta emas, balki ming marta, boshqa azoblaridan ko'ra, u chanqoqlikdan hushini yo'qotishni o'yladi, hali ham yig'lab, dardidan afsuslanardi.

en: However, it being now ves- pers and it seeming to the scholar he had done enough, he caused his ser- vant take up the unhappy lady’s clothes and wrap them in his cloak; then, betaking himself to her house, he found her maid seated before the door, sad and disconsolate and unknowing what to do, and said to her, ‘Good woman, what is come of thy mistress?’ ‘Sir,’ replied she, ‘I know not.
uz: Ammo, endi bu juda g'ayrioddiy edi va u olimga yetarli ish qilgan ko'rinardi, u o'zining ser-ventini baxtsiz xonimning kiyimlarini olib, ularni o'z ko'ylagini o'rashga majbur qildi; so'ngra, uyiga yaqinlashib, uning xizmatchisini eshik oldida, qayg'uli, taskinsiz va nima qilish kerakligini bilmay o'tirgan holda topdi va unga dedi: "Yaxshi ayol, xo'jayiningdan nima bo'ldi?" Janob,  javob berdi u: Men bilmayman.

en: I thought to ﬁnd her this morning in the bed whither meseemed I saw her betake herself yesternight; but I can ﬁnd her neither there nor otherwhere and know not what is come of her; wherefore I suffer the utmost concern.
uz: Men uni bugun ertalab to'shakda topishni o'yladim, u yerda kecha o'zini o'ldirganini ko'rdim; lekin men uni na u yerda, na boshqa joyda topa olmayman va undan nima kelishini bilmayman; shuning uchun men juda tashvishlanaman.

en: But you, sir, can you not tell me aught of her?’ Quoth he, ‘Would I had had thee together with her whereas I have had her, so I might have punished thee of thy de- fault, like as I have punished her for hers!
uz: Lekin siz, janob, menga u haqida hech narsa ayta olmaysizmi? U javob berdi: Agar men sizni u bilan birga olganimda, uni olganimda, sizni uning aybi uchun jazolaganim kabi jazolagan bo'lardim!

en: But assuredly thou shalt not es- cape from my hands, ere I have so paid thee for thy dealings that thou shalt never more make mock of any man, without remembering thee of me.’ Then to his servant, ‘Give her the clothes,’ quoth he, ‘and bid her go to her mis- tress, an she will.’ The man did his bidding and gave the clothes to the maid, who, knowing them and hearing what Rinieri said, was sore afraid lest they should have slain her mistress and scarce refrained from crying out; then, the scholar being done, she set out with the clothes for the tower, weeping the while.
uz: Lekin, albatta, sen qo'limdan qochmaysan, toki men senga qilgan ishlaring uchun shunchalik to'lamaguncha, hech qachon hech kimni masxara qilmaysan, meni eslamay." Shunda u xizmatchisiga dedi: "Uni kiyimga ber," - dedi u, - va uni o'z qo'li bilan o'z to'riga borishga buyuradi, u shunday qiladi." Er o'z buyurishini qildi va kiyimlarni xizmatchiga berdi. U ularni bilib, Rinieri aytganlarini eshitib, ularning xo'jayini o'ldirishidan qo'rqdi va yig'lashdan juda tiyildi; keyin, olim bo'lib, u to'rga kiyimlar bilan chiqdi, yig'layotgan edi.

en: Now it chanced that one of the lady’s husbandmen had that day lost two of his swine and going in search of them, came, a little after the scholar’s departure, to the tower.
uz: Endi shunday bo'ldiki, xonimning dehqonlaridan biri o'sha kuni ikkita cho'chqog'ini yo'qotib, ularni qidirib, olim ketganidan biroz keyin minoraga keldi.

en: As he went spying about everywhere if he should see his hogs, he heard the piteous lamentation made of the miserable lady and climbing up as most he might, cried out, ‘Who maketh moan there aloft?’ The lady knew her husbandman’s voice and calling him by name, said to him, ‘For God’s sake, fetch me my maid and contrive so she may come up hither to me.’ Whereupon quoth the man, recognizing her, ‘Alack, madam, who hath brought you up yonder?
uz: U hamma joyni kuzatib yurganida, agar o'z cho'chqalarini ko'rsa, u bechora xonimning qanchalik ko'p ko'tarilsa, shunchalik ko'tarilayotganini eshitdi va qichqirdi: "U yerda kim ingraydi?" Xonim erining ovozini tanib, uni ism-sharifi bilan chaqirib, unga dedi: "Alloh uchun xizmatkorimni olib keling va u menga shu yerga kelishi uchun g'ilof qiling." Shundan so'ng erkak uni tanib, dedi: "Alak, xonim, seni u yerga kim olib keldi?"

en: Your maid hath gone seeking you all day; but who had ever thought you could be here?’ Then, taking the ladder-poles, he set them up in their place and addressed himself to bind the cross-staves thereto with withy bands.395 Meanwhile, up came the maid, who no sooner entered the tower than, unable any longer to hold her tongue, she fell to crying out, buffeting herself the while with her hands, ‘Alack,
uz: Xizmatkoringiz seni butun kun qidirib yuribdi; lekin seni bu yerda bo'lishing mumkin deb kim o'ylagan edi? Keyin, narvon ustunlarini olib, ularni o'z joyiga qo'ydi va xoch tayoqlarini u yerga sepilgan bog'ichlar bilan bog'lash uchun o'ziga yo'l oldi. 395 Shu bilan birga, minoraga tezroq kirmagan xizmatkor, endi tilini ushlab tura olmay, o'zini qo'llari bilan urib, qichqirib yubordi, Alack,

en: sweet my lady, where are you?’ The lady, hearing her, answered as loudliest she might, ‘O sister mine, I am here aloft.
uz: "Siziq xonim, qayerdasiz?" Xonim uni eshitib, imkon qadar baland ovozda javob berdi: "Ey singlim, men bu yerdaman."

en: Weep not, but fetch me my clothes quickly.’ When the maid heard her speak, she was in a manner all recomforted and with the husbandman’s aid, mounting the ladder, which was now well nigh repaired, reached the sollar, where, whenas she saw her lady lying naked on the ground, all forspent and wan, more as she were a half-burnt log than a human being, she thrust her nails into her own face and fell a-weeping over her, no otherwise than as she had been dead.
uz: Yig'lama, menga tezroq kiyimlarimni olib kel." Xizmatkor ayol uning gapirganini eshitgach, u biroz xotirjam edi va erining yordami bilan, hozir yaxshi ta'mirlangan narvonga chiqib, quyoshga yetdi. U yerda xonimning yerda yalang'och holda yotganini ko'rgach, butunlay sarflangan va holdan toygan edi. U yarim kuygan yog'och bo'lgani kabi, o'z yuziga mixlarini tiqdi va ustidan yig'lab tushdi, xuddi o'lganidek.

en: The lady besought her for God’s sake be silent and help her dress herself, and learning from her that none knew where she had been save those who had carried her the clothes and the husbandman there present, was some- what comforted and prayed them for God’s sake never to say aught of the matter to anyone.
uz: Xonim uni Xudo haqqi bilan jim bo'lishga va o'zini kiyintirishga yordam berishga iltimos qildi va undan uning qayerga borganini hech kim bilmasligini, faqat unga kiyim ko'tarib kelganlar va u yerda bo'lgan erdan boshqa hech kim bilmasligini bilib, ularni Xudo haqqi bilan hech kimga bu haqda hech narsa demaslik uchun tasalli berdi va duo qildi.

en: Then, after much parley, the husbandman, taking the lady in his arms, for that she could not walk, brought her safely without the tower; but the unlucky maid, who had remained behind, descending less cir- cumspectly, made a slip of the foot and falling from the ladder to the ground, broke her thigh, whereupon she fell a-roaring for the pain, that it seemed a lion.
uz: Keyin, ko'p suhbatdan so'ng, dehqon xonimni quchoqlab, uning yurolmasligi uchun minoraning tashqarisiga xavfsiz olib keldi; lekin omadsiz xizmatchi, orqada qolgan, kamroq ehtiyotkorlik bilan pastga tushayotgan, oyog'ini sirg'alib, zinadan yerga tushib, sonini sindirdi, shundan so'ng u og'riqdan g'uvillab, sherga o'xshab yiqildi.

en: The husbandman, setting the lady down on a plot of grass, went to see what ailed the maid and ﬁnding her with her thigh broken, car- ried her also to the grass-plat and laid her beside her mistress, who, seeing this befallen in addition to her other troubles and that she had broken her thigh by whom she looked to have been succoured more than by any else, was beyond measure woebegone and fell a-weeping afresh and so piteously that not only could the husbandman not avail to comfort her, but himself fell a-weeping like wise.
uz: Xo'jayin xonimni o'tga qo'ydi, xizmatkor qizni nima qiynayotganini ko'rish uchun bordi va uni sonini sindirib topdi, uni o't tokchasiga olib keldi va uni xonasi yoniga yotqizdi. Bu uning boshqa tashvishlaridan tashqari sodir bo'lganini va uning sonini boshqa hech kimdan ko'ra ko'proq qo'llab-quvvatlagandek tuyulganini ko'rib, u cheksiz xafa bo'ldi va shunday achinarli va achinarli tarzda yig'lab yubordi, hatto xo'jayin uni tinchlantirishga qodir emas, balki o'zi ham dono kabi yig'lab tushdi.

en: But presently, the sun being now low, he repaired, at the instance of the disconsolate lady, lest the night should overtake them there, to his own house, and there called his wife and two brothers of his, who returned to the tower with a plank and setting the maid thereon, carried her home, whilst he himself, having comforted the lady with a little cold water and kind words, took her up in his arms and brought her to her own chamber.
uz: Ammo shu zahoti, quyosh botgach, u xotinning taskinini to'xtatdi, toki tun ularni u yerga, o'z uyiga yetkazmasin. U yerda xotini va ikki akasini chaqirib, ular minoraga taxtasi bilan qaytib kelib, unga xizmatkorni o'rnatishdi, uni uyiga olib ketishdi, o'zi esa xotinni biroz sovuq suv va mehribon so'zlar bilan ovutib, quchog'iga olib, o'z xonasiga olib keldi.

en: His wife gave her a wine-sop to eat and after, undressing her, put her to bed; and they contrived that night to have her and her maid carried to Florence.
uz: Uning xotini unga yeyishga vino sho'rva berdi va keyin yechinib, uni yotqizdi; va o'sha kechasi uni va uning xizmatkorini Florensiyaga olib ketish uchun tuzoq tuydirishdi.

en: There, the lady, who had shifts and devices great plenty, framed a story of her fashion, altogether out of conformity with that which had passed, and gave her brothers and sisters and everyone else to believe that this had befallen herself and her maid by dint of diabolical bewitchments.
uz: U yerda xonim, o'z navbatlari va qurilmalari juda ko'p bo'lgan holda, o'tgan narsaga mutlaqo mos kelmaydigan o'z modasi haqidagi hikoyani yaratdi va aka-ukalari, opa-singillari va boshqalarning barchasiga bu shayton sehrlari bilan o'ziga va xizmatkoriga tushganiga ishontirdi.

en: Physicians were quickly at hand, who, not without putting her to very great anguish and vexation, recovered the lady of a sore fever, after she had once and again left her skin sticking to the sheets, and on like wise healed the maid of her broken thigh.
uz: Shifokorlar tezda yordamga kelishdi, ular uni juda katta azob va g'azabga solmasdan emas, balki xonimni og'riqli isitmadan tuzatishdi, u bir necha bor terisini varaqlarga yopishib qo'yganidan so'ng, xuddi donolik bilan singan sonining xizmatchisini davoladilar.

en: Wherefore, forgetting her lover, from that time forth she discreetly forbore both from making mock of others and from lov- ing, whilst the scholar, hearing that the maid had broken her thigh, held himself fully avenged and passed on, content, without saying otherwhat thereof.
uz: Shuning uchun, sevgilisini unutib, o'sha vaqtdan boshlab u boshqalarni masxara qilishdan ham, sevishdan ham yashirincha taqiqladi, olim esa xizmatkorning sonini sindirganini eshitib, o'zini to'liq qasos oldi va boshqa hech narsa demasdan mamnun holda o'tib ketdi.

en: Thus, then, did it befall the foolish young lady of her pranks, for that she thought to fool it with a scholar as she would have done with anoth- er, unknowing that scholars —I will not say all, but the most part of them — know where the devil keepeth his tail.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'z hazillarining ahmoqona yosh xonimiga ham shunday bo'ldi, chunki u ulamo bilan o'zini aldashni o'yladi, xuddi u boshqa hech kim bilan qilgan bo'lardi, bilmasdanki, olimlar  hammasini aytmayman, lekin ularning aksariyati  shayton o'z dumini qayerga qo'yishini bilishadi.

en: Wherefore, ladies, beware of making mock of folk, and especially of scholars.”
uz: Shuning uchun, xonimlar, xalqni, ayniqsa olimlarni masxara qilishdan ehtiyot bo'ling.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Two men consorting together, one lieth with the wife of his comrade, who, becoming aware thereof, doth with her on such wise that the other is shut up in a chest, upon which he lieth with his wife, he being inside the while.
uz: Sakkizinchi HIKOYA Ikki erkak birga yotishibdi, biri o'z sherikining xotini bilan yotadi, u buni anglab yetgach, u bilan shunday donolik bilan yashaydi, ikkinchisi esa xotini bilan birga yotgan sandiqqa qamaladi, u yerda u o'sha paytda yashaydi.

en: Elena’s troubles had been irksome and grievous to the ladies to hear; nathe- less, for that they deemed them in part justly befallen her, they passed them over with more moderate compassion, albeit they held the scholar to have been terribly stern and obdurate, nay, cruel.
uz: Elenaning tashvishlari xonimlar uchun g'alati va achinarli edi; aksincha, ular ularni qisman adolatli deb hisoblaganlari uchun, ular ularni o'rtacha rahm-shafqat bilan o'tkazib yuborishdi, garchi olimni juda qattiqqo'l va qat'iyatli, yo'q, shafqatsiz deb hisoblashgan bo'lsalar ham.

en: But, Pampinea being now come to the end of her story, the queen charged Fiammetta follow on, who, noth- ing loath to obey, said, “Charming ladies, for that meseemeth the severity of the offended scholar hath somedele distressed you, I deem it well to solace your rufﬂed spirits with somewhat more diverting; wherefore I purpose to tell you a little story of a young man who received an injury in a milder spirit and avenged it after a more moderate fashion, by which you may un- derstand that, whenas a man goeth about to avenge an injury suffered, it should sufﬁce him to give as good as he hath gotten, without seeking to do hurt overpassing the behoof of the feud.
uz: Ammo, Pampiyena endi o'z hikoyasining oxiriga yetgach, malika Fiammettaga ergashishni buyurdi. Fiammetta itoat qilishni istamadi va dedi: "Joyli xonimlar, chunki xafa bo'lgan olimning qattiqqo'lligi sizni biroz xafa qildi, men sizning g'azablangan ruhlaringizni biroz ko'proq chalg'ituvchi narsa bilan tinchlantirishni yaxshi ko'raman; shuning uchun men sizga yengilroq ruhda jarohat olgan va undan o'rtacha tarzda qasos olgan yosh yigit haqida kichik bir hikoya aytmoqchiman, shu orqali siz odam jarohatdan qasos olish uchun borganda, unga yetarli bo'lgan zararni berish kerakligini tushunishingiz mumkin.

en: You must know, then, that there were once in Siena, as I have understood aforetime, two young men in easy enough case and of good city families, whereof one was named Spinelloccio Tanena and the other Zeppa di Mino, and they were next-door neighbours in Camollia.396 These two young men still companied together and loved each other, to all appearance, as they had been brothers, or better; and each of them had a very fair wife.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, avvalroq tushunganimdek, Siena shahrida bir vaqtlar yetarlicha qulay va yaxshi shahar oilalaridan bo'lgan ikki yigit bor edi. Ularning biri Spinelloccio Tanena, ikkinchisi Zeppa di Mino deb nomlangan va ular Kamolliyada qo'shni qo'shni edilar.

en: It chanced that Spinelloccio, by dint of much frequenting Zeppa’s house, both when the latter was at home and when he was abroad, grew so private with his wife that he ended by lying with her, and on this wise they abode a pretty while, before any became aware thereof.
uz: Shundan kelib chiqadiki, Spinelloccio Zeppaning uyiga tez-tez kelganligi sababli, u uyda bo'lganida ham, chet elda bo'lganida ham, xotini bilan shunchalik yolg'izlashib ketdiki, u bilan yotdi va shu tariqa ular bir oz vaqt qolishdi, hech kim bundan xabardor bo'lmaguncha.

en: However, at last, one day, Zeppa
uz: Ammo, nihoyat, bir kuni Zeppa...

en: being at home, unknown to his wife, Spinelloccio came to call him and the lady said that he was abroad; whereupon the other came straightway up into the house and ﬁnding her in the saloon and seeing none else there, he took her in his arms and fell to kissing her and she him.
uz: Uyda bo'lib, xotiniga ma'lum bo'lmagani uchun, Spinelloccio uni chaqirgani keldi va xonim u chet elda ekanligini aytdi; shundan so'ng, ikkinchisi darhol uyga chiqib, uni salon ichida topdi va u yerda boshqa hech kimni ko'rmadi, uni quchoqladi va uni o'pdi, u ham uni.

en: Zeppa, who saw this, made no sign, but abode hidden to see in what the game should result and presently saw his wife and Spinelloccio betake themselves, thus embraced, to a chamber and there lock themselves in; whereat he was sore angered.
uz: Zeppa buni ko'rib, hech qanday alomat ko'rsatmadi, lekin o'yin qanday natija berishi kerakligini ko'rish uchun yashirinib turdi va tez orada xotini va Spinelloccio o'zlarini quchoqlab, xonaga olib kirganini ko'rdi va u yerda o'zlarini qamab qo'ydi; u esa juda g'azablangan edi.

en: But, knowing that his injury would not become less for making an outcry nor for otherwhat, nay, that shame would but wax therefor, he set himself to think what revenge he should take thereof, so his soul might abide content, without the thing being known all about, and himseeming, after long con- sideration, he had found the means, he abode hidden so long as Spinelloccio remained with his wife.
uz: Ammo, uning jarohatlanishi shikoyat qilgani uchun ham, boshqa narsa uchun ham kam bo'lmasligini bilgan holda, yo'q, u bundan faqat uyatni kuchaytiradi, u o'zini undan qanday qasos olish kerakligini o'ylashga boshladi, shunda uning ruhi hamma narsa haqida ma'lum bo'lmasdan mamnun bo'lib turishi mumkin edi va unga ko'rinadiki, uzoq vaqt davomida u o'ylab ko'rishga ulgurganidan so'ng, u Spinelloccio xotini bilan qolguncha yashirin edi.

en: As soon as the other was gone away, he entered the chamber and there ﬁnding the lady, who had not yet made an end of adjusting her head-veils, which Spinelloccio had plucked down in dallying with her, said to her, ‘Wife, what dost thou?’ Quoth she, ‘Seest thou not?’ And Zeppa answered, ‘Ay, indeed, I have seen more than I could wish.’ So saying, he taxed her with that which had passed and she, in sore affright, confessed to him, after much parley, that which she could not aptly deny of her familiarity with Spinelloccio.
uz: Ikkinchisi ketishi bilanoq, u xonaga kirdi va u yerda xonimni topdi. Xonim hali bosh pardalarini tuzatishni tugatmagan edi, Spinelloccio uni o'ziga tortib olib, unga dedi: "Xotin, sen nima qilyapsan?" U javob berdi: "Ko'rmayapsanmi?" Va Zeppa javob berdi: "Ha, haqiqatan ham, men o'zim xohlaganimdan ko'proq ko'rdim." Shunday qilib, u uni o'tgan voqealar bilan aybladi va u, xafa bo'lib, ko'p bahslardan so'ng, Spinelloccio bilan tanishligini aniq inkor eta olmaganini unga tanidi.

en: Then she began to crave him pardon, weeping, and Zeppa said to her, ‘Harkye, wife, thou hast done ill, and if thou wilt have me pardon it to thee, bethink thee punctually to do that which I shall enjoin thee, which is this; I will have thee bid Spinelloccio ﬁnd an occasion to part company with me tomorrow morning, towards tierce, and come hither to thee.
uz: Keyin u uni kechirishni xohlay boshladi, yig'lab, va Zeppa unga dedi: "Harkye, xotin, sen yomon ish qilding, agar meni senga kechirishni istasang, senga buyuradigan narsani tezroq qil; men senga Spinelloccioga ertaga ertalab uchinchi safarga yaqinroq men bilan birga bo'lish uchun imkoniyat topishga ruxsat beraman va sening oldiga kel."

en: When he is here I will come back and so soon as thou hearest me, do thou make him enter this chest here and lock him therein.
uz: U bu yerda bo'lganda, men qaytib kelaman va meni eshitishingiz bilanoq, uni shu sandiqqa kiriting va unga qulflang.

en: Then, when thou shalt have done this, I will tell thee what else thou shalt do; and have thou no fear of doing this, for that I promise thee I will do him no manner of hurt.’ The lady, to satisfy him, promised to do his bidding, and so she did.
uz: Keyin, buni qilganingda, yana nima qilishingni aytaman; va bundan qo'rqma, chunki senga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaslikka va'da beraman." Xonim uni qondirish uchun uning buyrug'ini bajarishga va'da berdi, va u shunday qildi.

en: The morrow come and Zeppa and Spinelloccio being together towards tierce, the latter, who had promised the lady to be with her at that hour, said to the former, ‘I am to dine this morning with a friend, whom I would not keep waiting for me; wherefore God be with thee.’ Quoth Zeppa, ‘It is not dinnertime yet awhile’; but Spinelloccio answered, ‘No matter; I am to speak with him also of an affair of mine, so that needs must I be there be- times.’ Accordingly, taking leave of him, he fetched a compass and making
uz: Ertasi kuni Zeppa va Spinelloccio uchinchi tomon birga bo'lishdi. Uchinchisi, xonimga o'sha soatda u bilan bo'lishga va'da bergan edi, birinchisiga dedi: "Men bugun ertalab meni kutmaydigan do'stim bilan kechki ovqat yeyishim kerak; shuning uchun Xudo sen bilan bo'lsin." Zeppa aytdi: "Endi kechki ovqat hali kelmadi"; lekin Spinelloccio javob berdi: "Mendagi bir ish haqida ham u bilan gaplashishim kerak, shuning uchun men u yerda bo'lishim kerak." Shunga ko'ra, undan xayr olib, u

en: for Zeppa’s house, entered a chamber with the latter’s wife.
uz: Zeppaning uyi uchun, oxirgisining xotini bilan birga xonaga kirdi.

en: He had not been there long ere Zeppa returned, whom when the lady heard, feigning to be mightily affrighted, she made him take refuge in the chest, as her hus- band had bidden her, and locking him therein, went forth of the chamber.
uz: U yerda Zeppa qaytib kelmaguncha ko'p vaqt qolmagan edi. Xonim uni eshitgach, juda qo'rqqandek ko'rsatdi, uni ko'kragida qo'rqitdi, xuddi uning xotin-qizlari buyurganidek, va uni u yerda qulflab, xonadan chiqdi.

en: Zeppa, coming up, said, ‘Wife, is it dinnertime?’ ‘Ay,’ answered she, ‘forth- right.’ Quoth he, ‘Spinelloccio is gone to dine this morning with a friend of his and hath left his wife alone; get thee to the window and call her and bid her come dine with us.’ The lady, fearing for herself and grown therefor mighty obedient, did as he bade her and Spinelloccio’s wife, being much pressed by her and hearing that her own husband was to dine abroad, came hither.
uz: Zeppa chiqib, dedi: Xotin, kechki ovqat vaqti keldimi? Ha, javob berdi u, togri. U aytdi: Spinelloccio bugun ertalab dosti bilan ovqatlanishga bordi va xotini yolgiz qoldirdi; derazadan oting, uni chaqirib, biz bilan ovqatlanishga chaqirib keling. Xonim ozi uchun qorqib, undan kuchli itoatkorlik bilan osdi, u buyurganidek qildi va Spinelloccioning xotini ham, uning tomonidan juda bosim ostida bolib, oz eri chet elda ovqatlanishini eshitib, bu yerga keldi.

en: Zeppa made much of her and whispering his wife begone into the kit- chen, took her familiarly by the hand and carried her into the chamber, wherein no sooner were they come than, turning back, he locked the door within.
uz: Zeppa undan juda ko'p xafa bo'ldi va xotini shivirlab kit- Chenga kirdi, uni qo'lidan yaxshilab ushladi va xonaga olib kirdi, u yerda ular tezroq kelishdi, keyin u orqaga o'girilib, eshikni ichkariga qulfladi.

en: When the lady saw him do this, she said, ‘Alack, Zeppa, what meaneth this?
uz: Xonim uni buni qilayotganini ko'rib, dedi: "Alack, Zeppa, bu nimani anglatadi?"

en: Have you then brought me hither for this?
uz: Xo'sh, meni shu yerga shu uchun olib keldingizmi?

en: Is this the love you bear Spinelloccio and the loyal companionship you practise towards him?’ Whereupon quoth Zeppa, drawing near to the chest wherein was her hus- band locked up and holding her fast, ‘Madam, ere thou complainest, hearken to that which I have to say to thee.
uz: Bu sizning Spinelloccioga bo'lgan muhabbatingiz va unga nisbatan sadoqatli hamrohligingizmi? Shunda Zeppa, o'z xotin-qizlari bog'langan sandiqqa yaqinlashib, uni mahkam ushlagan holda, dedi: Xonim, shikoyat qilsangiz, sizga aytadigan gapimga quloq soling.

en: I have loved and love Spinelloc- cio as a brother, and yesterday, albeit he knoweth it not, I found that the trust I had in him was come to this, that he lieth with my wife even as with thee.
uz: Men Spinelloc-tio'ni aka-uka kabi sevdim va yaxshi ko'raman, va kecha, garchi u bilmasa ham, unga bo'lgan ishonchim shu darajaga yetganini angladim, u xotinim bilan xuddi sen bilan uxlagandek yotadi.

en: Now, for that I love him, I purpose not to take vengeance of him, save on such wise as the offence hath been; he hath had my wife and I mean to have thee.
uz: Endi, men uni sevganim uchun, undan qasos olishni maqsad qilmayman, faqatgina shunday donolik tufayli; u mening xotinimga ega edi va men seni olishni xohlayman.

en: An thou wilt not, needs must I take him here and for that I mean not to let this affront go unpunished, I will play him such a turn that neither thou nor he shall ever again be glad.’ The lady, hearing this and believing what Zeppa said, after many afﬁrmations made her of him, replied, ‘Zeppa mine, since this vengeance is to fall on me, I am content, so but thou wilt contrive, notwithstanding what we are to do, that I may abide at peace with thy wife, even as I intend to abide with her, notwithstanding this that she hath done to me.’ ‘Assuredly,’ rejoined Zeppa, ‘I will do it; and to boot, I will give thee a precious and ﬁne jewel as none other thou hast.’ So saying, he embraced her; then, laying her ﬂat on the chest, there to his heart’s con- tent, he solaced himself with her, and she with him.
uz: Agar xohlamasangiz, uni bu yerga olib borishim kerak va men bu haqoratni jazosiz qoldirmasligim uchun, unga shunday burilishni o'ynaymanki, na siz, na u hech qachon xursand bo'lmaydi." Xonim buni eshitib va Zeppaning aytganlariga ishonib, unga ko'p tasdiqlar berganidan so'ng, javob berdi: "Zeppa mening, chunki bu qasos menga tushadi, men rozi bo'laman, lekin siz biz nima qilishimiz kerak bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, xotiningiz bilan tinch qolishimni rejalashtirasiz, xuddi u menga shunday qilganiga qaramay, u menga shunday qilmagan bo'lsa ham." "Albatta," dedi Zeppa, "Men buni qilaman; va boshlash uchun, men sizga boshqa hech qanday qimmatbaho tosh bermayman." Shunday qilib, u uni o'z ko'yi bilan quchoqladi, u uni o'zi bilan tinch qo'ydi.

en: Spinelloccio, hearing from within the chest all that Zeppa said his wife’s answer and feeling the morrisdance397 that was toward over his head, was at
uz: Spinelloccio, Zeppaning xotini javobini ichidan eshitib, uning boshi ustida turgan morrisdance397 ni his qilib, ...da edi.

en: ﬁrst so sore despited that himseemed he should die; and but that he stood in fear of Zeppa, he had rated his wife ﬁnely, shut up as he was.
uz: Avvaliga u o'lishi kerak deb o'ylagan darajada qattiq xafa bo'ldi; lekin Zeppadan qo'rqib turgani uchun, u xotiniga nozik baho bergan edi, o'zi qanday bo'lsa, shunday jim edi.

en: However, be- thinking himself that the offence had begun with him and that Zeppa was in his right to do as he did and had indeed borne himself towards him hu- manely and like a comrade, he presently resolved in himself to be, an he would, more than ever his friend.
uz: Ammo, o'zi bilan jinoyat boshlanganini va Zeppaning o'zi qilganidek qilish huquqiga ega ekanligini va haqiqatan ham unga o'zini erkakona va o'rtoqdek tutganini o'ylab, u hozir o'zida do'sti bo'lishga qaror qildi, va u har qachongidan ham ko'proq bo'lardi.

en: Zeppa, having been with the lady so long as it pleased him, dismounted from the chest, and she asking for the prom- ised jewel, he opened the chamber-door and called his wife, who said nought else than ‘Madam, you have given me a loaf for my bannock’; and this she said laughing.
uz: Zeppa, xonim bilan unga yoqqancha birga bo'lganidan so'ng, ko'kragidan tushdi va u prom uchun mo'ljallangan javohirni so'radi. U xona eshigini ochdi va xotiniga qo'ng'iroq qildi. Xotini esa faqat: "Xonim, siz menga bankok uchun bir dona non berdingiz" dedi; va u buni kulgu bilan aytdi.

en: To her quoth Zeppa, ‘Open this chest.’ Accordingly she opened it and therein Zeppa showed the lady her husband, saying, ‘Here is the jewel I promised thee.’ It were hard to say which was the more abashed of the twain, Spinelloccio, seeing Zeppa and knowing that he knew what he had done, or his wife, seeing her husband and knowing that he had both heard and felt that which she had done over his head.
uz: Zeppaning qutiga: Bu sandiqni och. Shunga kora, uni ochdi va Zeppasi xonimga erini korsatib dedi: Mana senga vada qilgan javohir. Twain, Spinelloccio, Zeppani korib va nima qilganini bilganini bilganini, yoki uning xotinini korib, erini eshitganini va uning boshida nima qilganini his qilganini bilganini aytish qiyin edi.

en: But Spinelloccio, coming forth of the chest, said, without more parley, ‘Zeppa, we are quits; wherefore it is well, as thou saidst but now to my wife, that we be still friends as we were, and that, since there is nothing unshared between us two but our wives, we have these also in common.’ Zeppa was content and they all four dined together in the utmost possible harmony; and thenceforward each of the two ladies had two husbands and each of the latter two wives, without ever having any strife or grudge anent the matter.”
uz: Ammo Spinelloccio ko'krakdan chiqib, hech qanday bahslashmasdan dedi: "Zeppa, biz ajrashdik; shuning uchun, hozir xotinimga aytganingdek, biz hamon do'st bo'lishimiz kerak, chunki biz ikkimiz o'rtamizda xotinlarimizdan boshqa hech narsa bo'lmagan, bizda ham bular umumiy." Zeppa rozi bo'ldi va ularning to'rttasi birgalikda imkon qadar uyg'unlikda ovqatlanishdi; va bundan keyin har ikkala xonimning ikki eri bor edi va har birining oxirgi ikki xotini bor edi, hech qachon bu masalada hech qanday janjal yoki adovatga ega bo'lmadi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Master Simone the physician, having been induced by Bruno and Buffalmacco to repair to a certain place by night, there to be made a member of a company that goeth a-roving, is cast by Buffalmacco into a trench full of ordure and there left.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA Ustoz Simon shifokor, Bruno va Buffalmacco tomonidan tun bo'yi ma'lum bir joyga ta'mirlashga undalgan holda, u yerda kovlash uchun boradigan kompaniya a'zosiga aylantiriladi, Buffalmacco tomonidan axlatga to'la xandaqqa tashlanadi va u yerda qoladi.

en: After the ladies had chatted awhile over the community of wives practised by the two Siennese, the queen, with whom alone it rested to tell, so she would not do Dioneo an unright, began on this wise: “Right well, lovesome ladies, did Spinelloccio deserve the cheat put upon him by Zeppa; where- fore meseemeth he is not severely to be blamed (as Pampinea sought awhile ago to show), who putteth a cheat on those who go seeking it or deserve it.
uz: Xonimlar ikki Siyenlik tomonidan mashq qilingan xotinlar jamoasi haqida biroz suhbatlashgandan so'ng, malika, Dioneoga noto'g'ri ish qilmasligi uchun faqat u bilan gaplashish kerak edi, shunday dedi: "To'g'ri, chiroyli xonimlar, Spinelloccio Zeppa tomonidan unga nisbatan aldovga loyiq edi; lekin u qattiq ayblanishga loyiq emas (Pampinea ancha vaqt oldin ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lganidek), u uni qidirayotgan yoki loyiq bo'lganlarga nisbatan aldov qo'yadi."

en: Now Spinelloccio deserved it, and I mean to tell you of one who went seek- ing it for himself.
uz: Endi Spinelloccio bunga loyiq edi va men sizga uni o'zi qidirib borgan odam haqida aytib bermoqchiman.

en: Those who tricked him, I hold not to be blameworthy, but rather commendable, and he to whom it was done was a physician, who, having set out for Bologna a sheepshead, returned to Florence all covered with miniver.398 As we see daily, our townsmen return hither from Bologna, this a judge, that a physician and a third a notary, tricked out with robes long and large and scarlets and minivers and store of other ﬁne paraphernalia, and make a mighty brave show, to which how far the effects conform we may still see all day long.
uz: Uni aldaganlar aybdor emas, balki maqtovga loyiq deb hisoblayman, va bu ish qilingan odam bir shifokor edi. U Bolonga qo'y boshini olib borgach, butunlay miniver bilan qoplangan holda Florensiyaga qaytdi. 398 Har kuni ko'rib turganimizdek, shahar ahlimiz Bolonadan bu yerga qaytadi, bu sudya, shifokor va uchinchi notarius, uzun va katta xalatlar, qizil sochlar va miniverlar va boshqa nozik paraphernaliyalar bilan aldangan va kuchli jasorat ko'rsatuvini yaratadi, bunga biz hali ham kun bo'yi qanchalik mos kelishini ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: Among the rest a certain Master Simone da Villa, richer in in- herited goods than in learning, returned hither, no great while since, a doc- tor of medicine, according to his own account, clad all in scarlet399 and with a great miniver hood, and took a house in the street which we call nowadays the Via del Cocomero.
uz: Qolganlarning orasida, merosxo'r narsalarga boyroq bo'lgan, ta'limdan ko'ra boyroq bo'lgan bir ustoz Simone da Villa o'z hisoblariga ko'ra, tibbiyot doktori bo'lganidan beri bu yerga qaytib keldi va o'zining so'zlariga ko'ra, hammasini qizil 399 va katta miniver kapyushon bilan kiyib, hozirgi kunda "Via del Cocomero" deb ataydigan ko'chada uy oldi.

en: This said Master Simone, being thus newly returned, as hath been said, had, amongst other his notable customs, a trick of asking whosoever was with him who was no matter what man he saw pass in the
uz: Bu gapni ustoz Simon aytdi, shunday qilib, yaqinda qaytgani aytilganidek, u, boshqa muhim odatlari qatorida, u bilan birga bo'lgan har bir kishidan so'rash hiylasiga ega edi, u qanday odamni ko'rmasin.

en: street, and as if of the doings and fashions of men he should compound the medicines he gave his patients, he took note of all and laid them all up in his memory.
uz: ko'cha, va go'yo odamlarning harakatlari va modalari haqida o'z bemorlariga bergan dori-darmonlarini birlashtirgandek, u hammasini esladi va xotirasida saqladi.

en: Amongst others on whom it occurred to him more particularly to cast his eyes were two painters of whom it hath already twice today been discoursed, namely, Bruno and Buffalmacco, who were neighbours of his and still went in company.
uz: Uning ko'z o'ngida ko'proq ko'z tashlash xayoliga kelgan boshqa rassomlar orasida bugun allaqachon ikki marta tilga olingan ikki rassom bor edi, ya'ni, uning qo'shnilari bo'lgan va hali ham birga bo'lgan Bruno va Buffalmacco bor edi.

en: Himseeming they recked less of the world and lived more merrily than other folk, as was indeed the case, he questioned divers persons of their condition and hearing from all that they were poor men and painters, he took it into his head that it might not be they lived so blithely of their poverty, but concluded, for that he had heard they were shrewd fellows, that they must needs derive very great proﬁts from some source unknown to the general; wherefore he was taken with a desire to clap up an acquaintance, an he might, with them both, or at least with one of them, and succeeded in making friends with Bruno.
uz: Ular dunyo haqida kamroq hisoblashgan va boshqa odamlarga qaraganda ko'proq xursandchilik bilan yashayotgan ko'rinardi, xuddi shunday bo'lganidek, u ularning ahvolidan xilma-xil odamlarni so'radi va ularning kambag'al odamlar va rassomlar ekanligini eshitib, ularning kambag'alligidan shunchalik achchiq yashashi mumkin emasligini o'ylab, lekin xulosa qildi, chunki u ularning aqlli odamlar ekanligini eshitgan edi, ular generalga noma'lum bo'lgan biron bir manbadan juda katta foyda olishlari kerak edi; shuning uchun u bilan tanishish istagi bilan qabul qilindi, u ikkalasi bilan ham, hech bo'lmaganda ulardan biri bilan ham do'stlashishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: The latter, perceiv- ing, after he had been with him a few times, that the physician was a very jackass, began to give himself the ﬁnest time in the world with him and to be hugely diverted with his extraordinary humours, whilst Master Simone in like manner took a marvellous delight in his company.
uz: Oxirgisi, u bilan bir necha marta bo'lganidan so'ng, shifokor juda ahmoq ekanligini anglab yetgach, u bilan dunyodagi eng yaxshi vaqtni o'tkazishni boshladi va o'zining g'ayrioddiy hazil-mutoyibalari bilan juda qiziqarli bo'ldi, Master Simone ham xuddi shunday tarzda uning kompaniyasidan ajoyib zavq oldi.

en: After a while, having sundry times bidden him to dinner and thinking himself entitled in consequence to discourse familiarly with him, he dis- covered to him the wonderment that he felt at him and Buffalmacco, how, being poor men, they lived so merrily, and besought him to apprise him how they did.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, uni har xil marta kechki ovqatga taklif qilib, o'zini shuning uchun ham u bilan tanish suhbatlashishga haqli deb hisoblaganidan so'ng, u unga va Buffalmaccoga nisbatan his qilgan hayratini, qanday qilib kambag'al odamlar ekanliklarida, shunchalik xursandchilik bilan yashashlari haqida aytib berdi va undan qanday yashashlarini so'radi.

en: Bruno, hearing this talk from the physician and himseeing the question was one of his wonted witless impertinences, fell a-laughing in his sleeve, and bethinking himself to answer him according as his folly de- served, said, ‘Doctor, there are not many whom I would tell how we do; but you I shall not scruple to tell, for that you are a friend and I know you will not repeat it to any.
uz: Bruno shifokorning bu gapini eshitib, bu savol uning odatdagi bema'niliklaridan biri ekanligini ko'rib, yengida kuldi va unga ahmoqona javob berishni o'ylab dedi: "Do'xtir, men buni qanday qilishimizni aytadigan ko'p odam yo'q; lekin sizni aytishga jur'at etmayman, chunki siz do'stsiz va men bilaman, buni hech kimga takrorlamaysiz."

en: It is true we live, my friend and I, as merrily and as well as it appeareth to you, nay, more so, albeit neither of our craft nor of reven- ues we derive from any possessions might we have enough to pay for the very water we consume.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, do'stim va men sizga ko'ringanidek, xursandchilik bilan va yaxshi yashaymiz, yo'q, undan ham ko'proq, garchi na ishimiz, na daromadimiz hech qanday mulkdan kelib chiqmasa ham, biz iste'mol qiladigan suv uchun to'lashga qodir bo'lsak ham.

en: Yet I would not, for all that, have you think that we go steal; nay, we go a-roving, and thence, without hurt unto any, we get us all to which we have a mind or for which we have occasion; hence the merry life you see us lead.’ The physician, hearing this and believing it, without knowing what it was, marvelled exceedingly and forthright conceiving an ardent desire to know what manner of thing this going a-roving might be, besought him
uz: Lekin men bularning hammasi uchun sizlarni o'g'irlik qilamiz deb o'ylashingizni xohlamayman; yo'q, biz g'alayon qilamiz va shundan so'ng hech kimga zarar yetkazmasdan, hammamizni o'z fikrimiz yoki imkoniyatimiz bor joyga olib boramiz; shuning uchun siz bizni olib borayotgan quvonchli hayotni ko'rasiz." Buni eshitib va ishonib, bu nima ekanligini bilmasdan, shifokor bu g'alayon qanday bo'lishi mumkinligini bilish uchun juda qattiq va aniq ishtiyoq bilan o'ylab topdi.

en: very urgently to tell him, afﬁrming that he would assuredly never discover it to any.
uz: juda shoshilinch ravishda unga aytish kerak edi, u hech qachon hech kimga buni aniqlamasligini tasdiqlab.

en: ‘Alack, doctor,’ cried Bruno, ‘what is this you ask me?
uz: Alack, doktor,  deb baqirdi Bruno,  mendan nima deb so'rayapsan?

en: This you would know is too great a secret and a thing to undo me and drive me from the world, nay, to bring me into the mouth of the Lucifer of San Gallo,400 should any come to know it.
uz: Bu siz bilasizki, meni yo'q qilish va dunyodan haydash uchun juda katta sir va narsa, aksincha, meni San Gallo Luciferining og'ziga olib kirish uchun, agar kimdir buni bilsa.

en: But so great is the love I bear your right wor- shipful pumpkinheadship of Legnaja401 and the conﬁdence I have in you that I can deny you nothing you would have; wherefore I will tell it you, on condition that you swear to me by the cross at Montesone, never, as you have promised, to tell it to anyone.
uz: Lekin shunchalik buyukki, men Legnaja401ning to'g'ri tashvishli qovoq boshlig'iga bo'lgan muhabbatim va senga ishonchim borki, senga hech narsa bermasligingni rad eta olmayman; shuning uchun senga aytaman, Montesonda menga xochga qasam ichishing shartida, hech qachon, va'da qilganingdek, hech kimga aytmasliging shart.

en: The physician declared that he would never repeat what he should tell him, and Bruno said, ‘You must know, then, honey doctor mine, that not long since there was in this city a great master in necromancy, who was called Michael Scott, for that he was of Scotland, and who received the greatest hospitality from many gentlemen, of whom few are nowadays alive; wherefore, being minded to depart hence, he left them, at their instant prayers, two of his ablest disciples, whom he enjoined still to hold them- selves in readiness to satisfy every wish of the gentlemen who had so wor- shipfully entertained him.
uz: Shifokor unga aytishi kerak bo'lgan narsani hech qachon takrorlamasligini e'lon qildi va Bruno dedi: Shunday qilib, aziz shifokorim, bilishingiz kerakki, bu shaharda yaqinda Necromantika bo'yicha buyuk ustoz bor edi, u Maykl Skott edi, chunki u Shotlandiyadan edi va u ko'plab janoblardan eng katta mehmondo'stlikni qabul qilgan, ulardan kamchiligi hozirda tirik; shuning uchun, u bu yerdan ketishni o'ylagani uchun, ularning bir zumda ibodat qilishlari bilan, ularni ushlab turishga buyurgan ikki eng yaxshi shogirdini tashlab ketdi. U uni shunchalik tashvishga soladigan janoblarning har bir istakini qondirishga tayyor edi.

en: These two, then, freely served the aforesaid gen- tlemen in certain amours of theirs and other small matters, and afterward, the city and the usages of the folk pleasing them, they determined to abide there always.
uz: Keyin bu ikki kishi yuqorida aytilgan janoblarga o'zlarining ayrim ishlarida va boshqa mayda masalalarda bemalol xizmat qilishdi, keyin esa shahar va xalqning urf-odatlari ularni mamnun qilib, u yerda doimiy qolishga qaror qilishdi.

en: Accordingly, they contracted great and strait friendship with certain of the townfolk, regarding not who they were, whether gentle or simple, rich or poor, but solely if they were men comfortable to their own usances; and to pleasure these who were thus become their friends, they founded a company of maybe ﬁve-and-twenty men, who should foregather twice at the least in the month in some place appointed of them, where be- ing assembled, each should tell them his desire, which they would forthright accomplish unto him for that night.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular shahar aholisining ayrimlari bilan katta va yaqin do'stlik o'rnatdilar, ular kim bo'lishlari haqida emas, xoh muloyim bo'lsin, oddiy bo'lsin, boy bo'lsin, kambag'al bo'lsin, faqat o'z odatlariga mos odamlar bo'lsalargina; va shu tariqa ularning do'stlari bo'lganlarni xursand qilish uchun, ular o'zlari uchun belgilangan joyda oyning kamida ikki marta yig'ilishlari kerak bo'lgan, har biri ularga o'z xohishini aytishi kerak bo'lgan, uni o'sha kecha uchun to'g'ridan-to'g'ri amalga oshirishlari kerak bo'lgan.

en: Buffalmacco and I, having an especial friendship and intimacy with these two, were put of them on the roll of the aforesaid company and are still thereof.
uz: Buffalmacco va men bu ikkisi bilan alohida do'stlik va yaqinlikka ega bo'lganimiz sababli, ular tomonidan yuqorida aytilgan kompaniya ro'yxatiga qo'yildi va biz hali ham uning tarkibidamiz.

en: And I may tell you that, what time it chanceth that we assemble together, it is a marvellous thing to see the hangings about the saloon where we eat and the tables spread on royal wise and the multitude of noble and goodly servants, as well female as male, at the pleasure of each one who is of the company, and the basons and ewers and ﬂagons and goblets and the vessels of gold and silver, wherein we eat and drink, more by token of the many and various viands that are set before us, each in its season, according to that which each one desireth.
