uz: Va men sizga aytishim mumkinki, qachonki birga yig'ilsak, biz ovqatlanadigan salon atrofidagi osmalarni ko'rish ajoyib narsa, shuningdek, qirollik donoligi va olijanob va yaxshi xizmatkorlarning ko'pligi, ayol va erkak, har bir kishiga ma'qul bo'lgan holda, har bir kishiga yoqqan holda, har bir kishi xohlagan vaqtda, har bir kishi xohlaganidek, oldimizga qo'yiladigan ko'plab va xilma-xil go'shtlarni ko'rish va ichish.

en: never avail to set out to you what and how many are the sweet sounds of innumerable instruments and the songs full of melody that are heard there; nor might I tell you how much wax is burned at these suppers nor what and how many are the confections that are consumed there nor how costly are the wines that are drunken.
uz: Sizga u yerda eshitilgan son-sanoqsiz asboblarning shirin ovozlari va ohangga to'la qo'shiqlarning qancha ekanligini aytib berishga hech qachon hojat yo'q; shuningdek, bu kechki ovqatlarda qancha mum yoqilganini, u yerda iste'mol qilinadigan shirinliklar qancha va qancha ekanligini, ichiladigan vinolarning qanchalik qimmatligini ham aytib berolmayman.

en: But I would not have you believe, good saltless pumpkinhead mine, that we abide there in this habit and with these clothes that you see us wear every day; nay, there is none of us of so little account but would seem to you an emperor, so richly are we adorned with vestments of price and ﬁne things.
uz: Lekin men seni ishonmasligingni xohlardim, ey yaxshi tuzsiz qovoqboshim, biz u yerda shu odatda va har kuni kiygan kiyimlarimiz bilan yashaymiz; yo'q, hech birimiz sizga imperatordek tuyulmaymiz, shunchalik boylik bilan qimmatbaho liboslar va nafis narsalar bilan bezatilganmiz.

en: But, over all the other pleasures that be there is that of fair ladies, who, so one but will it, are incontinent brought thither from the four quarters of the world.
uz: Lekin, boshqa barcha lazzatlardan ko'ra, go'zal ayollarning lazzatlari bor, ular, hech bo'lmaganda, dunyoning to'rt choragidan u yerga kelishmaydi.

en: There might you see the Sovereign Lady of the Rascal-Roughs, the Queen of the Basques, the wife of the Soldan, the Empress of the Usbeg Tartars, the Driggledraggletail of Norroway, the Moll-a-green of Flapdoodleland and the Madkate of Woolgathergreen.
uz: U yerda Rascal-Roughsning hukmdor xonimi, Basklar malikasi, Soldanning rafiqasi, Usbeg tatarlarining imperatori, Norrowayning Driggledraggletail, Flapdoodlelandning Moll-a-greeni va Woolgathergreenning Madkatelarini ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: But why need I enumerate them to you?
uz: Lekin nega ularni sizga sanashim kerak?

en: There be all the queens in the world, even, I may say, to the Sirreverence of Prester John, who hath his horns amiddleward his arse; see you now?
uz: Dunyodagi barcha malikalar bor, hatto, men aytishim mumkinki, ruhoniy Jonning hurmatga sazovor bo'lishiga, uning shoxlari orqa tomoniga yaqin; hozir ko'ryapsizmi?

en: There, after we have drunken and eaten confections and walked a dance or two, each lady betaketh herself to her bedchamber with him at whose instance she hath been brought thither.
uz: U yerda ichib, shirinliklar yeganimizdan so'ng va bir-ikki raqsga tushganimizdan so'ng, har bir ayol o'zining yotoqxonasiga o'zi bilan birga keladi, u yerga olib kelingan odam bilan birga.

en: And you must know that these bedchambers are a very paradise to behold, so goodly they are; ay, and they are no less odoriferous than are the spice- boxes of your shop, whenas you let bray cummin-seed, and therein are beds that would seem to you goodlier than that of the Doge of Venice, and in these they betake themselves to rest.
uz: Va shuni bilishingiz kerakki, bu yotoqxonalar juda yaxshi ko'rish uchun jannatdir; ey, va ular sizning do'koningizdagi ziravor qutilaridan kam xushbo'y emas, qachonki siz kumin urug'ini so'rsangiz, va ularda Venetsiya Dogi'nikidan ko'ra sizga yaxshiroq ko'rinadigan karavotlar bor, va ularda ular o'zlarini dam olish uchun o'ynashadi.

en: Marry, what a working of the treadles, what a hauling-to of the battens to make the cloth close, these weaveresses keep up, I will e’en leave you to imagine; but of those who fare best, to my seeming, are Buffalmacco and myself, for that he most times letteth come thither the Queen of France for himself, whilst I send for her of England, the which are two of the fairest ladies in the world, and we have known so to do that they have none other eye in their head than us.402 Wherefore you may judge for yourself if we can and should live and go more merrily than other men, seeing we have the love of two such queens, more by token that, whenas we would have a thousand or two thousand ﬂorins of them, we get them not.
uz: Uylang, qanday ish yurish yo'llari, qanday to'rlarni olib yurish mato yopish uchun, bu to'quvchilar to'qishga harakat qiladi, men sizni tasavvur qilishga qo'yib yuboraman; lekin mening ko'rinishimcha, eng yaxshi natijalarga erishadiganlar Buffalmacco va o'zim, chunki u ko'pincha o'zi uchun Fransiya malikasiga boradi, men esa uni Angliyadan yuboraman, ular dunyodagi eng go'zal ayollardan ikkitasi, va biz ularning boshida bizdan boshqa hech kimning ko'zi yo'qligini bilamiz.

en: This, then, we commonly style going a-roving, for that, like as the rovers take every man’s good, even so do we, save that we are in this much different from them that they never restore that which they take, whereas we return it again, whenas we have used it.
uz: Demak, biz odatda "roving" deb ataymiz, chunki xuddi roverlar har bir odamning foydasini olgandek, biz ham shunday qilamiz, faqatgina biz ulardan ancha farq qilamiz, chunki ular hech qachon olmagan narsani tiklamaydilar, biz esa uni ishlatganimizdan keyin qaytarib olamiz.

en: Now, worthy doctor mine, you
uz: Endi, mening munosib doktorim, sen...

en: have heard what it is we call going a-roving; but how strictly this requireth to be kept secret you can see for yourself, and therefore I say no more to you nor pray you thereof.’ The physician, whose science reached no farther belike than the curing children of the scald-head, gave as much credit to Bruno’s story as had been due to the most manifest truth and was inﬂamed with as great desire to be received into that company as might be kindled in any for the most desir- able thing in the world; wherefore he made answer to him that assuredly it was no marvel if they went merry and hardly constrained himself to defer requesting him to bring him to be there until such time as, having done him further hospitality, he might with more conﬁdence proffer his request to him.
uz: Biz buni "roving" deb ataydigan narsani eshitganmiz; lekin buni qanchalik qattiq sir saqlashni talab qilish kerakligini o'zingiz ko'rishingiz mumkin, shuning uchun sizga bundan boshqa hech narsa demayman va sizdan iltimos ham qilmayman. "Shifokor, uning ilmi qobiq boshning davolash bolalaridan ko'ra hech narsaga yaqinlashmagan, Brunoning hikoyasiga eng ochiq haqiqatga ko'ra katta baho berdi va dunyodagi eng xohish-istak uchun u yerda qabul qilinish istagi kabi katta ishtiyoq bilan yondi; shuning uchun u unga xursand bo'lishsa ajab emasligini va uni u yerga olib kelishni so'rashni davom ettirish uchun o'zini majburladi, chunki u uni yanada mehmondo'stlik bilan ko'rsatishi mumkin edi.

en: Accordingly, reserving this unto a more favourable season, he pro- ceeded to keep straiter usance with Bruno, having him morning and evening to eat with him and showing him an inordinate affection; and indeed so great and so constant was this their commerce that it seemed as if the physi- cian could not nor knew how to live without the painter.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, buni qulayroq mavsumga qo'yib, u Brunoni ertalab va kechqurun birga ovqatlantirish va unga haddan tashqari mehr ko'rsatish uchun yanada qattiqroq odat tutishga qaror qildi; va haqiqatan ham, bu ularning shunchalik buyuk va doimiy savdolari ediki, go'yo fizi-siyani rassomsiz qanday yashashni ham bilmasdi.

en: The latter, ﬁnding himself in good case, so he might not appear ungrateful for the hospitality shown him, had painted Master Simone a picture of Lent in his saloon, be- sides an Agnus Dei at the entering in of his chamber and a chamberpot over the street-door, so those who had occasion for his advice might know how to distinguish him from the others; and in a little gallery he had, he had de- pictured him the battle of the rats and the cats, which appeared to the physi- cian a very ﬁne thing.
uz: Oxirgisi, o'zini yaxshi holatda ko'rgach, unga ko'rsatilgan mehmondo'stlik uchun minnatdorchilik bildirmasligi uchun, Ustoz Simonaga o'z salonida Ro'za rasmini chizgan edi, xonasiga kirishda Agnus Dei va ko'cha-eshik ustidagi qozichoqni, uning maslahatiga ega bo'lganlar uni boshqalardan qanday ajrata olishlarini bilishlari uchun; va uning kichik galereyasida u unga kalamushlar va mushuklar jangini tasvirlagan edi, bu esa fiziga juda nozik narsa ko'rinardi.

en: Moreover, he said whiles to him, whenas he had not supper with him overnight, ‘I was at the society yesternight and being a triﬂe tired of the Queen of England, I caused fetch me the Dolladoxy of the Grand Cham of Tartary.’ ‘What meaneth Dolladoxy?’ asked Master Simone.
uz: Qolaversa, u u bilan kechasi ovqatlanmaganida, unga dedi: Men kecha kechqurun jamiyatda edim va Angliya qirolichasidan biroz charchaganim sababli, menga Tataristonning Buyuk Chamasi Dolladoxiyasini olib kelishga majbur bo'ldim. Dolladoxi nima degani? deb so'radi Ustoz Simone.

en: ‘I do not understand these names.’ ‘Marry, doctor mine,’ replied Bruno, ‘I marvel not thereat, for I have right well heard that Porcograsso and Van- nacena403 say nought thereof.’ Quoth the physician.
uz: Men bu ismlarni tushunmayman. Uylan, doktorim, javob berdi Bruno, Men bunga hayron emasman, chunki Porcograsso va Van- nacena403 hech narsa demaganini togri eshitganman. Shifokor aytdi.

en: ‘Thou meanest Ipo- crasso and Avicenna.’ ‘I’ faith,’ answered Bruno, ‘I know not; I understand your names as ill as you do mine; but Dolladoxy in the Grand Cham’s lingo meaneth as much as to say Empress in our tongue.
uz: Sen Ipo-crasso va Avicenna degan ma'noni nazarda tutyapsan. Men ishonaman,  javob berdi Bruno,  bilmayman; men sizning ismlaringizni o'zimnikidek tushunaman; lekin Grand Chamdagi Dolladoxy zarosida bizning tilimizda Empress deyish kabi ma'noga ega.

en: Egad, you would think her a plaguy ﬁne woman!
uz: Egad, sen uni mayda-chuyda bezori ayol deb o'ylaysan!

en: I dare well say she would make you forget your drugs and your clysters and all your plasters.’ On this wise he bespoke him at one time and another, to enkindle him the more, till one night, what while it chanced my lord doctor held the light to Bruno, who was in act to paint the battle of the rats and the cats, the former,
uz: Men bemalol aytishga jur'at etaman, u seni dori-darmonlaringni, qulog'laringni va barcha plastinkalaringni unuttiradi. Shu yo'l bilan u uni bir vaqtning o'zida va boshqa paytlarda ko'proq xursand qilish uchun so'radi, toki bir kecha, tasodifan doktorim kalamushlar va mushuklar jangini tasvirlash uchun harakat qilayotgan Brunoga nurni tutdi.

en: himseeming he had now well taken him with his hospitalities, determined to open his mind to him, and accordingly, they being alone together, he said to him, ‘God knoweth, Bruno, there is no one alive for whom I would do everything as I would for thee; indeed, shouldst thou bid me go hence to Peretola, methinketh it would take little to make me go thither; wherefore I would not have thee marvel if I require thee of somewhat familiarly and with conﬁdence.
uz: Xuddi u endi uni mehmondo'stligi bilan qabul qilgan ko'rinardi, unga fikrini ochishga qaror qildi va shunga ko'ra, ular birga bo'lganlarida, u unga dedi: "Xudo biladi, Bruno, senga xohlagan hamma narsani qiladigan tirik odam yo'q; rostini aytsam, agar sen bu yerdan Peretolaga borishimni buyursang, menimcha, u yerga borishim oson bo'lardi; shuning uchun men seni biroz tanish va ishonch bilan talab qilsam, hayron bo'lma."

en: As thou knowest, it is no great while since thou bespokest me of the fashions of your merry company, wherefore so great a longing hath taken me to be one of you that never did I desire aught so much.
uz: Bilasan-ku, sen meni xursandchilik bilan birga bo'lganingdan beri ko'p vaqt o'tmadi, shuning uchun meni shunchalik katta orzu qabul qildi, men hech qachon bunchalik ko'p narsani xohlamaganman, sizlardan biri bo'lishga.

en: Nor is this my desire without cause, as thou shalt see, if ever it chance that I be of your company; for I give thee leave to make mock of me an I cause not come thither the ﬁnest serving-wench thou ever setst eyes on.
uz: Bu mening xohishim ham bejiz emas, ko'rasiz, agar men sizning hamrohligingizdan bo'lishim mumkin bo'lsa ham; chunki men senga meni masxara qilishga ruxsat beraman va eng yaxshi xizmatkorni u yerga kelmasligimga sabab beraman - agar ko'zingni qursang.

en: I saw her but last year at Cacavincigli and wish her all my weal;404 and by the body of Christ, I had e’en given her half a score Bolognese groats, so she would but have consented to me; but she would not.
uz: Men uni o'tgan yili Cacavinciglida ko'rdim va unga bor-budimni tiladim; 404 va Masih tanasiga qasam ichib, men unga Bolonya buyuklarining yarmini bergan bo'lardim, shuning uchun u menga rozi bo'lardi; lekin u qilmas edi.

en: Wherefore, as most I may, I prithee teach me what I must do to avail to be of your company and do thou also do and contrive so I may be thereof.
uz: Shuning uchun, men ko'pchilikning qobiliyatiga ko'ra, siz bilan birga bo'lish uchun nima qilishim kerakligini o'rgataman va siz ham shunday qiling va o'ylab ko'ringki, men ham shunga qo'shilaman.

en: Indeed, you will have in me a good and loyal comrade, ay, and a worshipful.
uz: Darhaqiqat, menda yaxshi va sodiq hamrohingiz bo'ladi, ey, va ibodat qiluvchi ham.

en: Thou seest, to begin with, what a ﬁne man I am and how well I am set up on my legs.
uz: Avvalo, men qanday yaxshi odam ekanligimni va oyoqlarimga qanchalik yaxshi tikilganimni ko'ryapsiz.

en: Ay, and I have a face as it were a rose, more by token that I am a doctor of medicine, such as I believe you have none among you.
uz: Ha, va mening yuzim xuddi atirgul kabi, ayniqsa men tibbiyot doktori ekanligim uchun, sizning orangizda hech kim yo'q deb o'ylayman.

en: Moreover, I know many ﬁne things and goodly canzonets; marry, I will sing you one.’ And incontinent he fell a- singing.
uz: Qolaversa, men ko'p yaxshi narsalarni va yaxshi qo'shiqlarni bilaman; turmush qur, men seni kuylayman." Va u birdan qo'shiq aytib yiqildi.

en: Bruno had so great a mind to laugh that he was like to burst; however he contained himself and the physician, having made an end of his song, said, ‘How deemedst thou thereof?’ ‘Certes,’ answered Bruno, ‘there’s no Jew’s harp but would lose with you, so archigothically do you caterwarble it.’ Quoth Master Simone, ‘I tell thee thou wouldst never have believed it, hadst thou not heard me.’ ‘Certes,’ replied Bruno, ‘you say sooth!’ and the physician went on, ‘I know store of others; but let that be for the present.
uz: Bruno shunchalik katta xayoliga ega ediki, u shunday kulgandek edi, hatto to'kilib ketganday edi; ammo u o'zini ushlab turdi va shifokor qo'shig'ini tugatgach, dedi: "Senga bu qanday tuyuldi?" "Albatta," javob berdi Bruno, "Siz bilan yutqazadigan yahudiy arpa yo'q, shuning uchun arxitekturada uni ta'minlaysiz." "O'qituvchi Simon aytdi: "Men sizga aytaman, siz hech qachon ishonmas edingiz, agar meni eshitmagan bo'lsangiz." "Albatta," javob berdi Bruno, "siz xotirjam aytasiz!" va shifokor davom etdi: "Men boshqalarni bilaman; lekin buni hozirgi vaqt uchun saqlang."

en: Such as thou seest me, my father was a gentleman, albeit he abode in the country, and I myself come by my mother of the Vallecchio family.
uz: Meni ko'rib turganingizdek, otam janob edi, garchi u qishloqda yashagan bo'lsa ham, men esa Vallekchio oilasining onamdanman.

en: Moreover, as thou mayst have seen, I have the ﬁnest books and gowns of any physician in Florence.
uz: Qolaversa, ko'rganingizdek, menda Florensiyadagi har qanday shifokorning eng yaxshi kitoblari va liboslari bor.

en: Cock’s faith, I have a gown that stood me, all reckoned, in nigh upon an hundred pounds of doits, more than half a score years ago; wherefore I pray thee as most I may, to bring me to be of your
uz: Xo'rozning e'tiqodi, menda shunday ko'ylak bor edi, hammasi taxminan yuz funt sterlingga yaqin edi, bundan yarim yuz yildan ko'proq vaqt oldin; shuning uchun men Sendan imkon qadar ko'proq iltimos qilaman, meni sening...

en: company, and by Cock’s faith, an thou do it, thou mayst be as ill as thou wilt, for I will never take a farthing of thee for my services.’ Bruno, hearing this and the physician seeming to him a greater numskull than ever, said, ‘Doctor, hold the light a thought more this way and take pa- tience till I have made these rats their tails, and after I will answer you.’ The tails being ﬁnished, Bruno made believe that the physician’s request was exceeding irksome to him and said, ‘Doctor mine, these be great things you would do for me and I acknowledge it; nevertheless, that which you ask of me, little as it may be for the greatness of your brain, is yet to me a very grave matter, nor know I anyone in the world for whom, it being in my power, I would do it, an I did it not for you, both because I love you as it behoveth and on account of your words, which are seasoned with so much wit that
uz: Kompaniya va Xo'rozning ishonchi bilan, va sen shunday qil, sen xohlaganingcha kasal bo'lishing mumkin, chunki men hech qachon senga xizmatlarim uchun hech qanday zarar ko'rmayman." Buni eshitgan Bruno va shifokor unga har qachongidan ham kattaroq ko'rinayotganini tan olgach, dedi: "Do'xtir, yorug'likni shu yo'l bilan ko'proq ushlab tur va men bu kalamushlarning dumlarini tayyorlaguncha sabr qilgin, keyin senga javob beraman." Dumlar tugagandan so'ng, Bruno shifokorning so'rovi unga juda achinarli ekanligiga ishontirdi va dedi: "Do'xtir, bular men uchun juda katta ishlar qilishing kerak va men buni tan olaman; shunga qaramay, siz mendan so'ragan narsa, sizning miyangiz uchun juda katta ehtiyoj bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa ham, men uchun juda og'ir, men dunyodagi hech kimni bilmayman, chunki men uni siz uchun juda ko'p qilmagan, chunki men siz bilan

en: they would draw the straps out of a pair of boots, much more me from my purpose; for the more I consort with you, the wiser you appear to me.
uz: Ular bir juft etikdan tasmalarni tortib olishardi, men esa maqsadimdan ancha uzoqlashardim; chunki men siz bilan qanchalik ko'p sherik bo'lsam, siz menga shunchalik dono ko'rinardingiz.

en: And I may tell you this, to boot, that, though I had none other reason, yet do I wish you well, for that I see you enamoured of so fair a creature as is she of whom you speak.
uz: Va men sizga shuni aytishim mumkinki, boshqasining sababi yo'q bo'lsa ham, men sizga yaxshilik tilayman, chunki men sizni siz gapirayotgan go'zal mavjudotga oshiq ekanligingizni ko'ryapman.

en: But this much I will say to you; I have no such power in this matter as you suppose and cannot therefore do for you that which were behoving; however, an you will promise me, upon your solemn and surbated405 faith, to keep it me secret, I will tell you the means you must use and meseemeth certain that, with such ﬁne books and other gear as you tell me you have, you will gain your end.’ Quoth the doctor, ‘Say on in all assurance; I see thou art not yet well ac- quainted with me and knowest not how I can keep a secret.
uz: Lekin senga shuni aytaman; bu masalada sen o'ylaganchalik kuchim yo'q va shuning uchun senga kerak bo'lgan narsani qila olmayman; ammo, sen menga, o'ta jiddiy va g'ayratli405 e'tiqoding bilan, meni sir tutishga va'da berasan, ishlatishing kerak bo'lgan vositalarni aytaman va ishonamanki, sening borliging kabi nozik kitoblar va boshqa jihozlar bilan oxiriga yetasan." Doktor aytdi: "To'liq ishonch bilan ayt, men seni hali men bilan yaxshi tanishmaganingni ko'ryapman va qanday qilib sir saqlashni bilmayman."

en: There be few things indeed that Messer Guasparruolo da Saliceto did, whenas he was judge of the Provostry at Forlimpopoli, but he sent to tell me, for that he found me so good a secret-keeper.406 And wilt thou judge an I say sooth?
uz: Messer Guasparruolo da Saliceto Forlimpopolida Provostriyada sudya bo'lganida, juda kam narsa qilgan edi, lekin u menga aytishga yubordi, chunki u meni juda yaxshi sirparvar deb topdi. 406 Va men tinchman deb o'ylaysizmi?

en: I was the ﬁrst man whom he told that he was to marry Bergamina: seest thou now?’ ‘Marry, then,’ rejoined Bruno, ‘all is well; if such a man trusted in you, I may well do so.
uz: Men Bergaminaga turmushga chiqishini aytgan birinchi odam edim: "Ko'ryapsanmi endi?" Xo'sh, uylang,  javob berdi Bruno, hammasi yaxshi; agar shunday odam senga ishongan bo'lsa, men ham shunday qilishim mumkin.

en: The course you must take is on this wise.
uz: Siz tutishingiz kerak bo'lgan yo'l shu yo'nalishda.

en: You must know that we still have to this our company a captain and two counsellors, who are changed from six months to six months, and without fail, at the ﬁrst of the month, Buffalmacco will be captain and I shall be counsellor; for so it is settled.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, kompaniyamizda hali ham kapitan va ikki maslahatchi bor, ular olti oydan olti oyga o'zgartiriladi va shubhasiz, oyning boshida Buffalmacco kapitan bo'ladi va men maslahatchi bo'laman; chunki shunday qilib hal bo'ldi.

en: Now whoso is captain can do much by way of procuring whomsoever he will to be admitted into the company; wherefore me- seemeth you should seek, inasmuch as you may, to gain Buffalmacco’s friendship and do him honour.
uz: Endi kapitan bo'lgan har bir kishi o'zi xohlagan odamni kompaniyaga qabul qilish orqali ko'p narsa qila oladi; shuning uchun, menimcha, siz, imkon qadar, Buffalmacco'ning do'stligini qozonishga va unga hurmat ko'rsatishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.

en: He is a man, seeing you so wise, to fall in
uz: U sizni shunchalik dono ko'rib, yiqilish uchun odamdir.

en: love with you incontinent, and whenas with your wit and with these ﬁne things you have you shall have somedele ingratiated yourself with him, you can make your request to him; he will not know how to say you nay.
uz: Sizga muhabbatingiz doimiy emas, va qachonki sizda bu aql-idrok va yaxshi narsalar bo'lsa, u bilan o'zingizni nimadir bilan xursand qilgan bo'lsangiz, unga so'rovingiz bo'lishi mumkin; u sizga "yo'q" deyishni bilmaydi.

en: I have already bespoken him of you and he wisheth you all the weal in the world; and whenas you shall have done this, leave me do with him.’ Quoth the physician, ‘That which thou counsellest liketh me well.
uz: Men uni sizlardan uzoqlashtirdim va u sizga dunyodagi barcha boylikni tilaydi; va buni qilganingizdan so'ng, meni u bilan birga qo'ying." Shifokor ta'kidladi: "Siz maslahat bergan narsa menga yaxshi yoqadi."

en: Indeed, an he be a man who delighteth in men of learning and talketh but with me a little, I will engage to make him go still seeking my company, for that, as for wit, I have so much thereof that I could stock a city withal and yet abide exceed- ing wise.’ This being settled, Bruno imparted the whole matter to Buffalmacco, wherefore it seemed to the latter a thousand years till they should come to do that which this arch-zany went seeking.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, u odam bo'lsa, u o'qimishli odamlardan zavqlanadi va men bilan biroz gaplashadi, men uni o'z kompaniyamni izlashda davom etishga majbur qilaman, chunki menda shunchalik ko'p narsa borki, men bir shaharni o'zim bilan ta'minlay olaman va hatto juda dono bo'lishim mumkin." Shundan so'ng, Bruno butun masalani Buffalmaccoga yetkazdi, shuning uchun oxirgi ming yilga ular bu arx-zoy qidirayotgan narsani qilishlari kerak deb tuyuldi.

en: The physician, who longed bey- ond measure to go a-roving, rested not till he made friends with Buffal- macco, which he easily succeeded in doing, and therewithal he fell to giv- ing him, and Bruno with him, the ﬁnest suppers and dinners in the world.
uz: Doktor, sayohatga borishni juda xohlagan, Buffal- macco bilan do'stlashguncha tinmadi, buni osonlik bilan uddaladi va shu zahoti unga, shuningdek, Brunoga dunyodagi eng yaxshi kechki ovqat va kechki ovqatlarni hadya qilishga tushdi.

en: The two painters, like the accommodating gentlemen they were, were noth- ing loath to engage with him and having once tasted the excellent wines and fat capons and other good things galore, with which he plied them, stuck very close to him and ended by quartering themselves upon him, without awaiting overmuch invitation, still declaring that they would not do this for another.
uz: Ikki rassom ham, mehmondo'st janoblar kabi, u bilan aloqa qilishni istashmas edilar va bir vaqtlar ajoyib vinolar, yog'li qalpoqlar va boshqa yaxshi narsalarni tatib ko'rishganlari sababli, ularni u bilan yopishtirib, unga juda yaqin qo'yishdi va oxirida ko'p taklifni kutmasdan, boshqa uchun buni qilmasliklarini e'lon qilishdi.

en: Presently, whenas it seemed to him time, the physician made the same request to Buffalmacco as he had made Bruno aforetime; whereupon Buffalmacco feigned himself sore chagrined and made a great outcry against Bruno, saying, ‘I vow to the High God of Pasignano that I can scarce withhold myself from giving thee such a clout over the head as should cause thy nose drop to thy heels, traitor that thou art; for none other than thou hath discovered these matters to the doctor.’ Master Simone did his utmost to excuse Bruno, saying and swearing that he had learned the thing from another quarter, and after many of his wise words, he succeeded in pacifying Buffalmacco; whereupon the latter turned to him and said, ‘Doctor mine, it is very evident that you have been at Bo- logna and have brought back a close mouth to these parts; and I tell you moreover that you have not learnt your A.B.C.
uz: Hozir, o'z vaqti kelgandek tuyulganda, shifokor Buffalmaccoga avvalroq Bruno qilganidek bir xil so'rovni qildi; shundan so'ng Buffalmacco o'zini g'azablangan ko'rsatib, Brunoga qarshi katta shikoyat qildi va dedi: "Men Pasignano Oliy Xudosiga qasam ichamanki, senga oyoqlaringga tushadigan burningni berishdan o'zimni tiymayman, chunki sen xoin ekansan; chunki bu masalalarni faqatgina doktorga aytgansan." Ustoz Simone buni kechirishga harakat qildi, u boshqa tomondan o'rganganini aytib va qasam ichib, ko'p dono so'zlaridan so'ng, u Buffalmaccoga muvaffaqiyat qozondi; shundan so'ng u unga o'girilib dedi: "Doctor, juda aniqki, siz qaytib kelgansiz va og'zingizni ochib bergansiz va men bularni sizga aytdim."

en: on the apple as many block- heads are fain to do; nay, you have learned it aright on the pumpkin, that is so long;407 and if I mistake not, you were baptized on a Sunday.408 And al- beit Bruno hath told me that you studied medicine there, meseemeth you
uz: Olma ustida ko'p blok boshlar yaxshi ish qiladi; yo'q, buni qovoqda to'g'ri o'rgangansiz, bu juda uzun; 407 va agar adashmasam, siz yakshanba kuni suvga cho'mgansiz. 408 Va al-beit Bruno menga u yerda tibbiyot o'qiganingizni aytdi, u...

en: studied rather to learn to catch men, the which you, with your wit and your ﬁne talk, know better to do than any man I ever set eyes on.’ Here the physi- cian took the words out of his mouth and breaking in, said to Bruno, ‘What a thing it is to talk and consort with learned men!
uz: U odamlarni tutishni o'rganishni afzal ko'rdi, buni siz, o'zingizning aql-idrokingiz va nozik gaplaringiz bilan, men ko'rgan har qanday odamdan yaxshiroq bilasiz." Bu yerda fizik-siyan og'zidan so'zlarni olib, o'z ichiga kirib, Brunoga dedi: "O'qimishli odamlar bilan gaplashish va maslahatlashish qanday narsa!"

en: Who would so have quickly apprehended every particular of my intelligence as hath this worthy man?
uz: Kim mening aql-idrokimning har bir detalini shu munosib odam kabi tezda anglab yetgan bo'lardi?

en: Thou didst not half so speedily become aware of my value as he; but, at the least, that which I told thee, whenas thou saidst to me that Buffal- macco delighted in learned men, seemeth it to thee I have done it?’ ‘Ay hast thou,’ replied Bruno, ‘and better.’ Then said the doctor to Buffalmacco, ‘Thou wouldst have told another tale, hadst thou seen me at Bologna, where there was none, great or small, doctor or scholar, but wished me all the weal in the world, so well did I know to content them all with my discourse and my wit.
uz: Sen mening qadrimni u kabi tezroq anglab yetmading; lekin hech bo'lmasa, senga aytganlarim, sen menga Buffal- macco olimlardan xursand deb aytganingda, men buni qilgan deb o'ylaysanmi? Xo'sh,  javob berdi Bruno,  va undan ham yaxshiroq. Keyin doktor Buffalmaccoga dedi: Sen yana bir hikoya aytib bergan bo'larding, meni Bolonyada ko'rgan eding, u yerda katta ham, kichik ham, shifokor ham, olim ham yo'q edi, lekin dunyodagi barcha boylik tilardi, shuning uchun hammasini o'z nutqim va aql-idrokim bilan qondirishni yaxshi bilardim.

en: And what is more, I never said a word there, but I made everyone laugh, so hugely did I please them; and whenas I departed thence, they all set up the greatest lament in the world and would all have had me remain there; nay, to such a pass came it for that I should abide there, that they would have left it to me alone to lecture on medicine to as many students as were there; but I would not, for that I was e’en minded to come hither to certain very great heritages which I have here and which have still been in my family; and so I did.’ Quoth Bruno to Buffalmacco, ‘How deemest thou?
uz: Va bundan tashqari, u yerda hech qachon bir so'z demaganman, lekin hammani kuldira oldim, shuning uchun ularni juda xursand qildim; va u yerdan ketayotganimda, ularning barchasi dunyodagi eng katta motamni qo'zg'atishdi va meni u yerda qolishimni xohlashardi; yo'q, shunday bir holatga keldi, ular meni u yerda qolishim uchun yolg'iz qoldirishardi, u yerda bo'lgancha ko'p talabalarga tibbiyot bo'yicha ma'ruza qilishardi; lekin men bunday qilmasdim, chunki men bu yerga kelishni niyat qilgan edim, men bu yerda borgan va hali ham o'z oilamda bo'lgan juda katta meroslarga; va men shunday qildim. Bruno Buffalmaccoga dedi: Siz qanday deb o'ylaysiz?

en: Thou believedst me not, when- as I told it thee.
uz: Menga ishonmading, qachonki senga aytganimdek.

en: By the Evangels, there is not a leach in these parts who is versed in asses’ water to compare with this one, and assuredly thou wouldst not ﬁnd another of him from here to Paris gates.
uz: Injillar bilan qasam ichadigan bo'lsak, bu qismlarda eshaklarga o'rgangan suv bilan taqqoslanadigan hech qanday oqish yo'q va shubhasiz, bu yerdan Parij darvozalarigacha undan boshqa hech kimni topa olmaysiz.

en: Marry, hold yourself henceforth [if you can], from doing that which he will.’ Quoth Master Si- mone, ‘Bruno saith sooth; but I am not understood here.
uz: "Uylan, bundan buyon o'zingni ushlab tur, xohlagan ishingni qil." "Ustoz Si-Mone aytdi: "Bruno xotirjam deydi; lekin men bu yerda tushunmayman."

en: You Florentines are somewhat dull of wit; but I would have you see me among the doctors, as I am used to be.’ ‘Verily, doctor,’ said Buffalmacco, ‘you are far wiser than I could ever have believed; wherefore to speak to you as it should be spoken to scholars such as you are, I tell you, cut-and-slash fashion,409 I will without fail procure you to be of our company.’ After this promise the physician redoubled in his hospitalities to the two rogues, who enjoyed themselves [at his expense], what while they crammed him with the greatest extravagances in the world and fooled him to the top of his bent, promising him to give him to mistress the Countess of Jakes,410 who was the fairest creature to be found in all the back-settlements of the human generation.
uz: Siz florensiyaliklarning aql-idrokingiz biroz zerikarli; lekin men sizni shifokorlar orasida ko'rishni xohlardim, odatdagidek." Haqiqatan ham, doktor,  dedi Buffalmacco,  siz men o'ylaganimdan ancha donoroqsiz; shuning uchun sizga shunday olimlarga gapirilishi kerakki, men sizga aytaman, kesib-kesib uslubda, 409 Men sizni albatta bizning kompaniyamizga jalb qilaman.

en: The physician enquired who this countess was, whereto
uz: Doktor bu grafning kimligini, qayerga borishini so'radi.

en: quoth Buffalmacco, ‘Good my seed-pumpkin, she is a very great lady and there be few houses in the world wherein she hath not some jurisdiction.
uz: quoth Buffalmacco, Yaxshi urug-qovoqcham, u juda buyuk ayol va dunyoda u hech qanday yurisdiksiyaga ega bolmagan uylar kam.

en: To say nothing of others, the Minor Friars themselves render her tribute, to the sound of kettledrums.411 And I can assure you that, whenas she goeth abroad, she maketh herself well felt,412 albeit she abideth for the most part shut up.
uz: Boshqalarni aytmasa ham, Kichik Ruhoniylarning o'zlari unga hurmat bajo keltirishadi, choynaklar ovoziga. 41 Va men sizga ishontira olamanki, u chet elga ketganda o'zini yaxshi his qiladi, 422, garchi u ko'p hollarda yopiq holda tursa ham.

en: Natheless, it is no great while since she passed by your door, one night that she repaired to the Arno, to wash her feet and take the air a little; but her most continual abiding-place is in Draughthouseland.413 There go ofttimes about store of her serjeants, who all in token of her supremacy, bear the staff and the plummet, and of her barons many are everywhere to be seen, such as Sirreverence of the Gate, Goodman Turd, Hardcake,414 Squitterbreech and others, who methinketh are your familiars, albeit you call them not presently to mind.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u sizning eshigingizdan o'tganidan beri unchalik zo'r vaqt emas, bir kecha u Arnoga borib, oyoqlarini yuvib, biroz havo olish uchun bordi; lekin uning eng doimiy yashash joyi Draughthouselandda. 413 Uning serjantlari haqida ko'p gap ketadi, ularning barchasi o'z ustunligi uchun xodimlar va ustunlikni ko'taradi, va uning baronlarining ko'pchiligi hamma joyda ko'rinadi, masalan, Darvozaning Sirreverence, Goodman Turd, Hardcake, 414 Squitterbreech va boshqalar, ular sizning tanishlaringiz deb o'ylashadi, garchi siz ularni hozirda eslay olmasangiz ham.

en: In the soft arms, then, of this great lady, leaving be her of Cacavincigli, we will, an expectation cheat us not, bestow you.’ The physician, who had been born and bred at Bologna, understood not their canting terms and accordingly avouched himself well pleased with the lady in question.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu buyuk xonimning yumshoq qo'llarida, Cacavinciglidan chiqib ketayotganda, biz sizni sovg'a qilamiz, bizni aldamaymiz. Bolonyada tug'ilib o'sgan shifokor ularning qo'shiq so'zlarini tushunmadi va shunga ko'ra, o'zini so'ralgan xonimdan xursand qilib ko'rsatdi.

en: Not long after this talk, the painters brought him news that he was accepted to member of the company and the day being come before the night appointed for their assembly, he had them both to dinner.
uz: Bu suhbatdan ko'p o'tmay rassomlar unga kompaniyaning a'zosiga qabul qilinganligi va ularning yig'ilishiga tayinlangan kechadan oldingi kuni ularning ikkalasi ham kechki ovqatga taklif qilinganligi haqida xabar berishdi.

en: When they had dined, he asked them what means it behoved him take to come thither; whereupon quoth Buffalmacco, ‘Look you, doctor, it behoveth you have plenty of assurance; for that, an you be not mighty resolute, you may chance to suffer hindrance and do us very great hurt; and in what it be- hoveth you to approve yourself very stouthearted you shall hear.
uz: Ular ovqatlanib bo'lgandan so'ng, u ulardan u yerga kelish uchun nima qilish kerakligini so'radi; shundan so'ng Buffalmacco dedi: "Eshiting, doktor, sizga ko'p ishonch kerak; chunki, agar siz kuchli qat'iyatli bo'lmasangiz, siz qiyinchilikka duch kelib, bizga juda katta zarar yetkazishingiz mumkin; va siz o'zingizni juda jasur deb topishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsani eshitasiz."

en: You must ﬁnd means to be this evening, at the season of the ﬁrst sleep, on one of the raised tombs which have been lately made without Santa Maria Novella, with one of your ﬁnest gowns on your back, so you may make an honour- able ﬁgure for your ﬁrst appearance before the company and also because, according to what was told us (we were not there after) the Countess is minded, for that you are a man of gentle birth, to make you a Knight of the Bath at her own proper costs and charges; and there you must wait till there cometh for you he whom we shall send.
uz: Siz bugun kechqurun, birinchi uyqu faslida, Santa Maria Novellasiz yaqinda qurilgan ko'tarilgan qabrlardan birida, orqangizda eng yaxshi ko'ylaklar bilan bo'lish uchun yo'l topishingiz kerak, shunda siz kompaniya oldidagi birinchi ko'rinishingizga munosib shaxs yaratishingiz mumkin va shuningdek, bizga aytilganidek (biz u yerda bo'lmadik) grafessa sizni o'z xarajatlari va to'lovlari evaziga Vanna ritsarisiga aylantirish uchun muloyim inson ekanligingiz uchun sizni u yerga yuboradigan odam kelguncha kutishingiz kerak.

en: And so you may be apprised of everything, there will come for you a black horned beast, not overbig, which will go capering about the piazza before you and making a great whistling and bounding, to terrify you; but, when he seeth that you are not to be daunted, he will come up to you quietly.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz hamma narsadan xabardor bo'lishingiz mumkinki, siz uchun qora shoxli, juda katta bo'lmagan hayvon keladi, u siz oldingizdagi maydonni aylanib, sizni qo'rqitish uchun katta hushtak chaladi va cheklaydi; lekin, u sizni qo'rqitmasligini ko'rgach, u sizga sekin keladi.

en: Then do you, without any
uz: Unda siz hech qanday...

en: fear, come down from the tomb and mount the beast, naming neither God nor the Saints; and as soon as you are settled on his back, you must cross your hands upon your breast, in the attitude of obeisance, and touch him no more.
uz: Qo'rqing, qabrdan tushing va hayvonga o'tiring, na Xudoni, na Avliyolarni nomlamang; va uning orqasiga o'rnashib olgandan so'ng, qo'llaringizni ko'kragingizga, taslim bo'lish holatida kesib, unga boshqa tegmang.

en: He will then set off softly and bring you to us; but if you call upon God or the Saints or show fear, I must tell you that he may chance to cast you off or strike you into some place where you are like to stink for it; wherefore, an your heart misgive you and unless you can make sure of be- ing mighty resolute, come not thither, for you would but do us a mischief, without doing yourself any good.’415 Quoth the physician, ‘I see you know me not yet; maybe you judge of me by my gloves and long gown.
uz: U keyin sekin yo'lga chiqib, seni bizga olib keladi; lekin agar sen Xudoga yoki Avliyolarga murojaat qilsang yoki qo'rqsang, men senga aytishim kerakki, u seni tasodifan uloqtirib yuborishi yoki seni yomon hidlaydigan joyga urishi mumkin; shuning uchun, qalbing seni adashtiradi va agar kuchli qat'iyatni ta'minlay olmasang, u yerga kelma, chunki sen bizga zarar yetkazgan bo'larding, o'zingga hech qanday yaxshilik qilmay.

en: If you knew what I did aforetimes at Bologna anights, when I went a-wenching whiles with my comrades, you would marvel.
uz: Agar siz avvalroq Bolonyada tunlari, o'rtoqlarim bilan g'ildiraklar o'ynaganimda nima qilganimni bilganingizda, hayratda qolar edingiz.

en: Cock’s faith, there was such and such a night when, one of them refusing to come with us, (more by token that she was a scurvy little bag- gage, no higher than my ﬁst), I dealt her, to begin with, good store of cuffs, then, taking her up bodily, I dare say I carried her a crossbowshot and wrought so that needs must she come with us.
uz: Xo'rozning e'tiqodi, shunday va shunday tunlar bo'lgan ediki, ulardan biri biz bilan kelishni istamadi, (aslida u mayda sumka edi, mushtimdan baland emas), men unga dastlab yaxshi miqdorda manjetlar berdim, keyin uni tanasiga olib, aytishga jur'at etaman, men unga kamon o'q tashladim va shunday qildimki, u biz bilan kelishi kerak edi.

en: Another time I remember me that, without any other in my company than a serving-man of mine, I passed yonder alongside the Cemetery of the Minor Friars, a little after the Ave Maria, albeit there had been a woman buried there that very day, and felt no whit of fear; wherefore misdoubt you not of this, for I am but too stout of heart and lusty.
uz: Yana bir safar eslayman, men o'z kompaniyamda xizmatchimdan boshqa hech kim bo'lmagan holda, Minor Friars qabristoni yonidan o'tib ketdim, Ave Maria'dan biroz keyin, garchi o'sha kuni u yerda bir ayol dafn etilgan bo'lsa ham va hech qanday qo'rquv his qilmagan bo'lsam ham; shuning uchun bu haqda shubha qilmang, chunki men juda jasur va shahvatparastman.

en: Moreover, I tell you that, to do you credit at my coming thither, I will don my gown of scarlet, wherein I was admitted doctor, and we shall see if the company rejoice not at my sight and an I be not made captain out of hand.
uz: Qolaversa, sizga aytamanki, u yerga kelishimga hurmat ko'rsatish uchun, men qizil ko'ylagimni kiyib, unda shifokor sifatida qabul qilinganman, va biz kompaniyaning mening ko'zimdan xursand bo'lmasligini va meni bexosdan kapitan qilib tayinlamasligini ko'ramiz.

en: You shall e’en see how the thing will go, once I am there, since, without having yet set eyes on me, this countess hath fallen so enamoured of me that she is minded to make me a Knight of the Bath.
uz: Men u yerda bo'lganimdan so'ng, bu narsa qanday ketishini ko'rasiz, chunki menga ko'z tashlamasdan, bu graf meni shunchalik oshiq qilib qo'yganki, u meni Vanna ritsarisiga aylantirishni niyat qilgan.

en: It may be knighthood will not sit so ill on me nor shall I be at a loss to carry it off with worship!
uz: Ehtimol, ritsarlik menga bunchalik yomon ta'sir qilmasligi mumkin, va men uni ibodat bilan o'tkazishga ham befarq bo'lmayman!

en: Marry, only leave me do.’ ‘You say very well,’ answered Buffalmacco; ‘but look you leave us not in the lurch and not come or not be found at the trysting-place, whenas we shall send for you; and this I say for that the weather is cold and you gentlemen doctors are very careful of yourselves thereanent.’ ‘God forbid!’ cried Master Simone.
uz: Uylang, faqat menga qo'ying. Siz juda yaxshi deyapsiz,  javob berdi Buffalmacco;  lekin qarang, bizni hech qanday joyda qoldirmayapsiz va kelmayapsiz yoki siz uchun jo'natadigan uchrashuv joyida topilmayapsiz; va men buni ob-havo sovuq bo'lgani va siz janob shifokorlar o'zingizdan juda ehtiyot bo'lishingiz uchun aytyapman. Xudo saqlasin! deb baqirdi Ustoz Simone.

en: ‘I am none of your chilly ones.
uz: Men sizning salqinlaringizdan emasman.

en: I reck not of the cold; seldom or never, whenas I rise of a night for my bodily occasions, as a man will bytimes, do I put me on more than my fur gown over my doublet.
uz: Men sovuqdan xavotir olmayman; kamdan-kam hollarda, hech qachon, bir kecha o'zimning jismoniy vaziyatlarim uchun uyg'onib, odam xohlaganidek, mo'ynali ko'ylagimdan ko'ra ko'proq ko'ylak kiyaman.

en: Wherefore I will certainly be there.’
uz: Shuning uchun men albatta u yerda bo'laman.

en: Thereupon they took leave of him and whenas it began to grow towards night, Master Simone contrived to make some excuse or other to his wife and secretly got out his ﬁne gown; then, whenas it seemed to him time, he donned it and betook himself to Santa Maria Novella, where he mounted one of the aforesaid tombs and huddling himself up on the marble, for that the cold was great, he proceeded to wait the coming of the beast.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular undan xayrlashdilar va kechga yaqinlashganda, ustoz Simon xotiniga qandaydir bahona topishga harakat qildi va o'zining mayin ko'ylagini yashirincha yechdi; so'ngra, vaqti kelganda, uni kiydirdi va Santa Maria Novellaga o'zini olib bordi. U yerda yuqorida aytilgan qabrlardan biriga o'tirdi va marmarga o'zini qo'ydi, chunki sovuq juda kuchli edi, u hayvonning kelishini kutishga kirishdi.

en: Mean- while Buffalmacco, who was tall and robust of his person, made shift to have one of those masks that were wont to be used for certain games which are not held nowadays, and donning a black fur pelisse, inside out, arrayed himself therein on such wise that he seemed a very bear, save that his mask had a devil’s face and was horned.
uz: O'rtacha ma'noda, o'zining bo'yi baland va mustahkam shaxsi bo'lgan Buffalmacco hozirgi kunda o'tkaziladigan ba'zi o'yinlarda ishlatilmaydigan niqoblardan biriga ega bo'lishga harakat qildi va ichki tomondan qora mo'yna terisini kiyib, unga shunchalik donolik bilan yopindi, hatto u juda ayiqdek tuyuldi, faqat uning niqobi shayton yuziga ega edi va shoxli edi.

en: Thus accoutred, he betook himself to the new Piazza of Santa Maria, Bruno following him to see how the thing should go.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'zini Santa Maria'ning yangi Piazzasiga olib bordi, Bruno esa uning ortidan bordi, ish qanday ketishi kerakligini ko'rish uchun.

en: As soon as he perceived that the physician was there, he fell a- capering and caracoling and made a terrible great blustering about the piazza, whistling and howling and bellowing as he were possessed of the devil.
uz: U shifokorning u yerda ekanligini sezishi bilanoq, u yiqilib tushdi va qichqirib, maydon atrofida dahshatli katta shovqin ko'tardi, iblisga botganidek hushtak chalib, o'kirib va g'uvillab.

en: When Master Simone, who was more fearful than a woman, heard and saw this, every hair of his body stood on end and he fell a-trembling all over, and it was now he had liefer been at home than there.
uz: Ustoz Simon, ayollardan ham qo'rqoqroq bo'lgan, buni eshitib va ko'rib, tanasining har bir sochi tik turardi va u butunlay titrab yiqildi, va endi u uydan ko'ra ko'proq uyda edi.

en: Nevertheless, since he was e’en there, he enforced himself to take heart, so overcome was he with desire to see the marvels whereof the painters had told him.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u u yerda bo'lgani uchun, u o'zini jasorat olishga majbur qildi, shuning uchun rassomlar unga aytgan mo'jizalarni ko'rishga ishtiyoqi juda kuchli edi.

en: After Buffalmacco had raged about awhile, as hath been said, he made a show of growing paciﬁed and coming up to the tomb whereon was the physician, stood stock-still.
uz: Buffalmacco bir oz g'azablanib ketganidan so'ng, aytilganidek, tinchlanib, shifokor turgan qabrga yaqinlashayotganini ko'rsatdi va jim turdi.

en: Master Simone, who was all a-tremble for fear, knew not what to do, whether to mount or abide where he was.
uz: Ustoz Simone, qo'rquvdan titrayotgan edi, nima qilishni, o'zi turgan joyga o'tirishni yoki turishni bilmas edi.

en: However, at last, fearing that the beast should do him a mischief, an he mounted him not, he did away the ﬁrst fear with the second and coming down from the tomb, mounted on his back, saying softly, ‘God aid me!’ Then he settled himself as best he might and still trembling in every limb, crossed his hands upon his breast, as it had been enjoined him; whereupon Buffalmacco set off at an amble towards Santa Maria della Scala and going on all fours, brought him hard by the Nunnery of Ripole.
uz: Ammo, nihoyat, hayvon unga zarar yetkazmasligidan qo'rqib, unga minmadi, u birinchi qo'rquvni ikkinchi qo'rquv bilan yo'q qildi va qabrdan tushdi, orqasiga o'tirdi, sekin: "Xudo menga yordam bersin!" dedi. Keyin u o'zini qo'lidan kelgancha o'rnashib oldi va har bir a'zosi titrab, qo'llarini ko'kragini kesdi, unga buyurilganidek; shundan so'ng Buffalmacco mehribon Santa Maria della Scalaga yo'l oldi va to'rt oyoqlab, uni qattiq Ripole rohibasiga olib keldi.

en: In those days there were dykes in that quarter, wherein the tillers of the neighbouring lands let empty the jakes, to manure their ﬁelds withal; whereto whenas Buffalmacco came nigh, he went up to the brink of one of them and taking the opportunity, laid hold of one of the physician’s legs and jerking him off his back, pitched him clean in, head foremost.
uz: O'sha kunlarda o'sha hududda dengizlar bor edi, u yerda qo'shni yerlarning dehqonlari o'z dalalarini go'ng bilan o'g'itlash uchun ko'chatlarni bo'shatishardi; bu yerda, Buffalmacco yaqinlashganda, u ulardan birining chetiga ko'tarilib, imkoniyatdan foydalanib, shifokorning bir oyog'idan ushladi va uni orqasiga tortib, toza holda oldinga tashladi.

en: Then he fell a-snorting and snarling and capering and raged about awhile; after which he made off alongside Santa Maria
uz: So'ngra u bir oz uxlab, qichqiriq qilib, g'azablanib, g'azablandi; shundan so'ng u Santa Mariya bilan birga yo'lga chiqdi.

en: della Scala till he came to Allhallows Fields.
uz: della Scala Allhallows Fieldsga kelguncha.

en: There he found Bruno, who had taken to ﬂight, for that he was unable to restrain his laughter; and with him, after they had made merry together at Master Simone’s expense, he addressed himself to see from afar what the bemoiled physician should do.
uz: U yerda u Brunoni topdi, u qochishga ketgan edi, chunki u kulgisini tiyolmas edi; va u bilan birga, Ustoz Simonaning hisobidan birga xursand bo'lgandan so'ng, u uzoqdan qayg'urgan shifokor nima qilishi kerakligini ko'rish uchun o'ziga murojaat qildi.

en: My lord leech, ﬁnding himself in that abominable place, struggled to arise and strove as best he might to win forth thereof; and after falling in again and again, now here and now there, and swallowing some drachms of the ﬁlth, he at last succeeded in making his way out of the dyke, in the woe- fullest of plights, bewrayed from head to foot and leaving his bonnet behind him.
uz: Mening xo'jayinim leech, o'sha jirkanch joyda o'zini topib, turishga qiynaldi va undan qutulish uchun qo'lidan kelgancha harakat qildi; va qayta-qayta yiqilib, u yerda-bu yerda, va ba'zi bir ifloslik pullarini yutgandan so'ng, nihoyat u boshidan oyoqqa aylanib, boshidan oyoqqa bo'lgan va o'z qalpoqchasini orqasidan qoldirgan tashvishlar to'la bo'shlig'ida, botqoqlikdan chiqib ketishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Then, having wiped himself as best he might with his hands and know- ing not what other course to take, he returned home and knocked till it was opened to him.
uz: Keyin, qo'llari bilan iloji boricha o'zini artib, boshqa qanday yo'l tutishni bilmay, uyiga qaytib keldi va u uchun ochilguncha taqillatdi.

en: Hardly was he entered, stinking as he did, and the door shut again ere up came Bruno and Buffalmacco, to hear how he should be re- ceived of his wife, and standing hearkening, they heard the lady give him the foulest rating was ever given poor devil, saying, ‘Good lack, what a pickle thou art in!
uz: U zo'rg'a kirdi, xuddi badbo'y hid bilan, eshik yana yopildi, shunda Bruno va Buffalmacco paydo bo'lishdi, uni xotinidan qanday qutqarish kerakligini eshitish uchun. To'xtab eshitib, xonim unga eng yomon baho berganini eshitishdi, bechora iblis dedi: "Yaxshi kamchilik, qanday achchiqsan!"

en: Thou hast been gallanting it to some other woman and must needs seek to cut a ﬁgure with thy gown of scarlet!
uz: Siz uni boshqa ayolga ko'rsatyapsiz va qizil ko'ylagingiz bilan qarangki, o'z qiyofangizni kesib olishni xohlaysiz!

en: What, was not I enough for thee?
uz: Nima, men senga yetarli emasmidim?

en: Why, man alive, I could sufﬁce to a whole people, let alone thee.
uz: Nega, tirik inson, men senga qo'shimcha ravishda butun bir xalq uchun yetarli bo'lardim.

en: Would God they had choked thee, like as they cast thee whereas thou deservedst to be thrown!
uz: Xudo seni tashlaganidek bo'g'ib tashlagan bo'lardi, sen esa tashlanishga loyiq eding!

en: Here’s a ﬁne physician for you, to have a wife of his own and go a-gadding anights after other folk’s womankind!’ And with these and many other words of the same fashion she gave not over tormenting him till midnight, what while the physician let wash him- self from head to foot.
uz: Mana sizga ajoyib shifokor, o'z xotiniga ega bo'lish va boshqa odamlarning ayollari ortidan kechalari g'azillab yurish uchun! Va shu va boshqa ko'plab o'xshash so'zlar bilan u uni yarim tungacha qiynashdan to'xtatmadi, shifokor esa uni yuvishga qo'ydi - boshidan oyoqqa o'zi.

en: Next morning up came Bruno and Buffalmacco, who had painted all their ﬂesh under their clothes with livid blotches, such as beatings use to make, and entering the physician’s house, found him already arisen.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Bruno va Buffalmacco paydo bo'lishdi. Ular butun tanasini kiyimlari ostiga yashil dog'lar bilan bo'yashgan edi, masalan, urish uchun ishlatiladigan, va shifokorning uyiga kirib, uni allaqachon tirilgan holda topishdi.

en: Accordingly they went in to him and found the whole place full of stench, for that they had not yet been able so to clean everything that it should not stink there.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular uning oldiga kirib, butun joyni badbo'y hid bilan to'ldirishdi, chunki ular hali hamma narsani tozalay olishmagan edi, toki u yerda badbo'y bo'lmasin.

en: Master Simone, seeing them enter, came to meet them and bade God give them good day; whereto the two rogues, as they had agreed beforehand, replied with an angry air, saying, ‘That say we not to you; nay, rather, we pray God give you so many ill years that you may die a dog’s death, as the most disloyal man and the vilest traitor alive; for it was no thanks to you that, whereas we studied to do you pleasure and worship, we were not slain like dogs.
uz: Ustoz Simona ularni kirganini ko'rib, ularni kutib oldi va Xudodan yaxshi kun berishini so'radi. Shunda, oldindan kelishib olganidek, ikki badbo'y odam g'azablangan ruhda javob berishdi va dedilar: "Sizga bunday demaymiz; aksincha, biz Xudodan sizga ko'p yomon yillar berishini so'raymiz, shunda siz itning o'limini, eng sadoqatsiz odam va eng yomon xoin kabi o'laysiz; chunki sizdan minnatdorchilik yo'q edi, chunki biz sizga rohat berish va ibodat qilish uchun o'qigan edik, lekin biz itlar kabi o'ldirilgan edik.

en: As it is, thanks to your disloyalty, we have gotten so many buffets this past night that an ass would go to Rome for less, without reckoning that
uz: Hozirgidek, sizning sadoqatsizligingiz tufayli, biz o'tgan kecha shunchalik ko'p bufetlarga ega bo'ldikki, hatto Rimga ham arzon narxda borardik, buni hisobga olmagan holda.

en: we have gone in danger of being expelled the company into which we had taken order for having you received.
uz: Sizni qabul qilganimiz uchun buyurtma olgan kompaniyamizdan haydash xavfi ostida qoldik.

en: An you believe us not, look at our bod- ies and see how they have fared.’ Then, opening their clothes in front, they showed him, by an uncertain light, their breasts all painted and covered them up again in haste.
uz: "Siz bizga ishonmayapsizmi, bizning tanamizga qarang va ularning qanday ahvolda bo'lganini ko'ring." Keyin, old tomondagi kiyimlarini ochib, ular unga noaniq yorug'lik bilan ko'kraklari bo'yalganini ko'rsatdilar va ularni yana shoshib yopishdi."

en: The physician would have excused himself and told of his mishaps and how and where he had been cast; but Buffalmacco said, ‘Would he had thrown you off the bridge into the Arno!
uz: Shifokor o'zini oqlagan bo'lardi va o'zining xatolari, qanday va qayerga tashlanganini aytib bergan bo'lardi; lekin Buffalmacco dedi: U seni ko'prikdan Arno daryosiga uloqtirgan bo'lardi!

en: Why did you call on God and the Saints?
uz: Nega Xudoni va Avliyolarni chaqirding?

en: Were you not forewarned of this?’ ‘By God His faith,’ replied the physician, ‘I did it not.’ ‘How?’ cried Buffalmacco.
uz: Siz bu haqda oldindan ogohlantirilmagan edingizmi? Xudoga qasamki, Uning imoni bilan, javob berdi shifokor, Men buni qilmadim. Qanday qilib? deb baqirdi Buffalmacco.

en: ‘You did not call on them?
uz: Siz ularni chaqirmadingizmi?

en: Egad, you did it again and again; for our messenger told us that you shook like a reed and knew not where you were.
uz: Egad, sen buni qayta-qayta qilding; chunki bizning elchimiz bizga sen qamish kabi titraganingni va qayerdaligingni bilmasligingni aytdi.

en: Marry, for the nonce you have befooled us ﬁnely; but never again shall anyone serve us thus, and we will yet do you such honour thereof as you merit.’ The physician fell to craving pardon and conjuring them for God’s sake not to dishonour him and studied to appease them with the best words he could command.
uz: Turmush qur, chunki sen bizni mayda-chuyda masxara qilding; lekin hech qachon bizga bunday xizmat qilmaydi, va biz senga bundan keyin ham sen haqli bo'lgan sharafni taqdim etamiz." Doktor kechirim so'rashga va uni haqorat qilmaslik uchun ularni Alloh uchun yolvorishga tushdi va ularni eng yaxshi so'zlar bilan tinchlantirishni o'rgandi.

en: And if aforetime he had entreated them with honour, from that time forth he hon- oured them yet more and made much of them, entertaining them with ban- quets and otherwhat, for fear lest they should publish his shame.
uz: Agar avvalroq u ularni sharaf bilan iltijo qilgan bo'lsa, o'shandan beri ularni yanada hurmat qildi va ko'p qilib, ularni taqiqlar va boshqa narsalar bilan ko'ngil ochib, uyatlarini e'lon qilishlaridan qo'rqib.

en: Thus, then, as you have heard, is sense taught to whoso hath learned no great store thereof at Bologna.”
uz: Shunday qilib, siz eshitganingizdek, Bolonyada uning katta ahamiyatini o'rganmaganlarga aql o'rgatilgan.

en: THE TENTH STORY A certain woman of Sicily artfully despoileth a merchant of that which he had brought to Palermo; but he, making believe to have returned thither with much greater plenty of merchandise than before, borroweth money of her and leaveth her water and tow in payment.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Sitsiliyalik bir ayol Palermoga olib kelgan narsalaridan bir savdogarni mohirona talon-toroj qiladi; lekin u u yerga oldingidan ko'ra ancha ko'p tovar bilan qaytganini o'ylab, undan pul qarz oladi va suvini qoldiradi va pulini to'laydi.

en: How much the queen’s story in divers places made the ladies laugh, it needed not to ask; sufﬁce it to say that there was none of them to whose eyes the tears had not come a dozen times for excess of laughter: but, after it had an end, Dioneo, knowing that it was come to his turn to tell, said, “Gracious ladies, it is a manifest thing that sleights and devices are the more pleasing, the subtler the trickster who is thereby artfully outwitted.
uz: Qirolichaning turli joylardagi hikoyasi xonimlarni qanchalik kuldirdi, so'ramaslik kerak edi; faqat shuni aytish kifoya, ularning hech biri ko'zlariga ortiqcha kulgidan o'nlab marta yosh kelmagan edi: lekin, bu tugagandan so'ng, Dioneo o'z navbatida ekanligini bilib, dedi: Hazratli xonimlar, bu aniqki, sniderlar va qurilmalar shunchalik yoqimli, shunchalik nozik hiylachi shu orqali mohirona o'rgatilgan.

en: Wherefore, albeit you have related very ﬁne stories, I mean to tell you one, which should please you more than any other that hath been told upon the same subject, inasmuch as she who was cheated was a greater mistress of the art of cheating others than was any of the men or women who were cozened by those of whom you have told.
uz: Shunday qilib, garchi siz juda yaxshi hikoyalar aytib bergan bo'lsangiz ham, men sizga shunday hikoya aytmoqchiman, u xuddi shu mavzuda aytilgan boshqa har qanday hikoyadan ko'ra ko'proq sizga yoqishi kerak, chunki aldangan ayol siz aytib bergan erkaklar yoki ayollar tomonidan o'ziga jalb qilinganlardan ko'ra boshqalarni aldash san'atining kattaroq ustasi edi.

en: There used to be, and belike is yet, a custom, in all maritime places which have a port, that all merchants who come thither with merchandise, having unloaded it, should carry it all into a warehouse, which is in many places called a customhouse, kept by the commonality or by the lord of the place.
uz: Ilgari portga ega bo'lgan barcha dengiz joylarida shunday odat bor edi va shunday bo'lishi mumkinki, u yerga tovar olib kelgan barcha savdogarlar uni yukdan chiqqan holda, ko'p joylarda bojxona uyi deb ataladigan omborga olib borishlari kerak edi, bu odat umumiy yoki joyning egasi tomonidan saqlanadi.

en: There they give unto those who are deputed to that end a note in writ- ing of all their merchandise and the value thereof, and they thereupon make over to each merchant a storehouse, wherein he layeth up his goods under lock and key.
uz: U yerda ular o'sha maqsadda tayinlanganlarga o'zlarining barcha tovarlari va qiymati haqida xat berishadi va shundan so'ng har bir savdogarga ombor qilib berishadi, u yerda o'z mol-mulkini qulf va kalit ostida qo'yadi.

en: Moreover, the said ofﬁcers enter in the book of the Customs, to each merchant’s credit, all his merchandise, causing themselves after he paid their dues of the merchants, whether for all his said merchandise or for such part thereof as he withdraweth from the customhouse.
uz: Qolaversa, aytilgan ofitserlar Har bir savdogarning qarziga barcha tovarlarini kiritadilar va u savdogarlarning to'lovlarini to'lagandan so'ng, aytilgan barcha tovarlari uchunmi yoki bojxonaxonadan qaytarib olgan qismlari uchunmi, o'zlariga zarar yetkazadilar.

en: the Customs the brokers mostly inform themselves of the quality and the quantity of the goods that are in bond there and also who are the merchants that own them; and with these latter, as occasion serveth them, they treat of exchanges and barters and sales and other transactions.
uz: Bojxona vositachilari asosan u yerda mavjud bo'lgan tovarlarning sifati va miqdori, shuningdek, ularga egalik qiluvchi savdogarlar kim ekanligi haqida o'zlarini xabardor qiladilar; va bu oxirgilar bilan, ularga qulay bo'lganda, ular almashinuvlar, almashinuvlar va sotuvlar hamda boshqa tranzaksiyalarni ko'rib chiqadilar.

en: This usance, amongst many other places, was current at Palermo in Sicily, where like- wise there were and are yet many women, very fair of their person, but sworn enemies to honesty, who would be and are by those who know them not held great ladies and passing virtuous and who, being given not to shave, but altogether to ﬂay men, no sooner espy a merchant there than they inform themselves by the book of the Customs of that which he hath there and how much he can do;416 after which by their lovesome and engaging fashions and with the most dulcet words, they study to allure the said mer- chants and draw them into the snare of their love; and many an one have they aforetime lured thereinto, from whom they have wiled great part of their merchandise; nay, many have they despoiled of all, and of these there be some who have left goods and ship and ﬂesh and bones in their hands, so sweetly hath
uz: Bu urf-odat, boshqa ko'plab joylar qatorida, Sitsiliyadagi Palermo shahrida keng tarqalgan edi. U yerda, go'yo, o'z shaxsiyatiga juda go'zal, lekin halollikka qasamyod qilgan dushman ayollar bor edi va bor edi. Ularni taniganlar, buyuk xonimlar va fazilatli ayollar emas, balki erkaklarni qo'rqitish uchun mo'ljallangan bo'lsalar, u yerdagi savdogarni o'zlariga u yerda nima olib borayotganini va qancha qila olishini odat kitobidan xabardor qilishdan ko'ra tezroq kutishmaydi.

en: the barberess known to ply the razor.
uz: Soch kesuvchi qiz o't o'rash bilan mashhur.

en: It chanced, not long since, that there came thither, sent by his masters, one of our young Florentines, by name Niccolo da Cignano, though more commonly called Salabaetto, with as many woollen cloths, left on his hands from the Salerno fair, as might be worth some ﬁve hundred gold ﬂorins, which having given the customhouse ofﬁcers the invoice thereof, he laid up in a magazine and began, without showing overmuch haste to dispose of them, to go bytimes a-pleasuring about the city.
uz: Yaqinda u yerga ustalari tomonidan yuborilgan, yosh florensiyaliklardan biri, Niccolo da Cignano ismli, ko'pincha Salabaetto deb ataladigan, Salerno yarmarkasidan qo'llarida qolgan, taxminan besh yuz oltin floringa teng bo'lgan jun matolar bilan kelgan, u bojxona xodimlariga uning hisob-fakturasini berganidan so'ng, jurnalga joylashtirdi va ularni tashlashga unchalik shoshilmasdan, shahar bo'ylab sayr qila boshladi.

en: He being of a fair complex- ion and yellow-haired and withal very sprightly and personable, it chanced that one of these same barberesses, who styled herself Madam Biancoﬁore, having heard somewhat of his affairs, cast her eyes on him; which he per- ceiving and taking her for some great lady, concluded that he pleased her for his good looks and bethought himself to order this amour with the ut- most secrecy; wherefore, without saying aught thereof to any, he fell to passing and repassing before her house.
uz: U juda murakkab - ion va sariq sochli va juda yorqin va shaxsiyatli bo'lgani uchun, tasodifan, o'zini Madam Biancofiore deb atagan shu sartaroshlardan biri unga ko'z tashladi; u buni rad etib, uni qandaydir buyuk xonim deb qabul qildi, uni o'zining chiroyli ko'rinishi uchun yoqtirdi va bu sevgiga eng maxfiy tarzda buyurtma berishni o'yladi; shuning uchun, hech kimga hech narsa demasdan, u uning uyidan o'tib ketadi va o'tib ketadi.

en: She, noting this, after she had for some days well enkindled him with her eyes, making believe to languish for him, privily despatched to him one of her women, who was a past mistress in the procuring art and who, after much parley, told him, well nigh with tears in her eyes, that he had so taken her mistress with his comeliness and his pleasing fashions that she could ﬁnd no rest day or night; wherefore, whenas it pleased him, she desired, more than aught else, to avail to fore-
uz: U buni ta'kidlab, bir necha kun davomida uni ko'zlari bilan yaxshi yoqib, unga sog'inganini ko'rsatgandan so'ng, unga o'z ayollaridan birini yashirincha jo'natdi. Bu ayol tug'ish san'atida o'tmishdagi bekasi edi va uzoq suhbatdan so'ng, ko'zlarida yosh bilan unga shunday dedi, u o'z bekasini o'zining go'zalligi va yoqimli modalari bilan shunday qabul qilgan ediki, u na kunduzi, na kechasi dam ololmas edi; shuning uchun, u unga yoqqanida, u boshqa hech narsadan ko'ra, foydalanishni xohlardi.

en: gather with him privily in a bagnio; then, pulling a ring from her pouch, she gave it to him on the part of her mistress.
uz: U bilan bagnoda xotirjam yig'il; keyin, xaltasidan uzuk tortib, uni bekasi tomonidan unga berdi.

en: Salabaetto, hearing this, was the joyfullest man that was aye and taking the ring, rubbed it against his eyes and kissed it; after which he set it on his ﬁnger and replied to the good wo- man that, if Madam Biancoﬁore loved him, she was well requited it, for that he loved her more than his proper life and was ready to go whereassoever it should please her and at any hour.
uz: Salabaetto buni eshitib, eng quvonchli odam edi, u ayani olib, uzukni ko'zlariga ishqaladi va o'pdi; keyin uni barmog'iga qo'ydi va yaxshi odamga javob berdi: agar Madam Biancofiore uni yaxshi ko'rsa, u unga o'z hayotidan ko'ra ko'proq mehr bergan va istalgan joyga, istalgan soatda borishga tayyor edi.

en: The messenger returned to her mistress with this answer and it was appointed Salabaetto out of hand at what bagnio he should expect her on the ensuing day after vespers.
uz: Xabarchi bu javob bilan xonimiga qaytib keldi va Salabaetto qo'lidan kelmaydigan tarzda, ertalabki kuni uni qanday kutib olishi kerakligi haqida tayinlandi.

en: Accordingly, without saying aught of the matter to any, he punctually re- paired thither at the hour appointed him and found the bagnio taken by the lady; nor had he waited long ere there came two slave-girls laden with gear and bearing on their heads, the one a ﬁne large mattress of cotton wool and the other a great basket full of gear.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, hech kimga bu haqda hech narsa demasdan, u o'zi tayinlagan soatda o'sha yerga qaytdi va xonim tomonidan olib ketilgan sumkani topdi; va uzoq kutmaganidan keyin, ikkita qul-qiz kelib qoldi, ular uskunalar bilan yuklangan va boshlarida ushlagan, biri paxtadan yasalgan mayda katta matras, ikkinchisi esa uskunalar bilan to'la katta savat.

en: The mattress they set on a bedstead in one of the chambers of the bagnio and spread thereon a pair of very ﬁne sheets, laced with silk, together with a counterpane of snow-white Cyprus buckram417 and two pillows wonder-curiously wrought.418 Then, putting off their clothes they entered the bath and swept it all and washed it excel- lent well.
uz: Ular matrasni bagnioning bir xonasiga qo'ydilar va ustiga juda nozik, ipak bilan bog'langan bir juft choyshabni, qor-oq Kipr buckram417 va ajoyib tarzda yasalgan ikkita yostiq bilan birga yoydilar. 418 Keyin, kiyimlarini yechib, hammomga kirishdi va hammasini supurib yuvdilar - juda yaxshi.

en: Nor was it long ere the lady herself came thither, with other two slave-girls, and accosted Salabaetto with the utmost joy; then, as ﬁrst she had commodity, after she had both clipped and kissed him amain, heaving the heaviest sighs in the world, she said to him, ‘I know not who could have brought me to this pass, other than thou; thou hast kindled a ﬁre in my vi- tals, little dog of a Tuscan!’ Then, at her instance, they entered the bath, both naked, and with them two of the slave-girls; and there, without letting any else lay a ﬁnger on him, she with her own hands washed Salabaetto all wonder-well with musk and clove-scented soap; after which she let herself be washed and rubbed of the slave-girls.
uz: U yerda xonimning o'zi ham, boshqa ikki quli bilan birga kelib, Salabettoga eng katta quvonch bilan yaqinlashdi. Keyin, avval u yaxshi narsalarga ega bo'lgandan so'ng, uni bir-biridan o'pib, dunyodagi eng og'ir ohlarni eshitib, unga dedi: "Meni bu o'tga kim olib kelishi mumkin edi, bilmayman, sendan boshqa; sen mening hayotimda olov yoqding, Toskanalik itcha!" Keyin, uning holatida ular yalang'och holda ham, ikki quli bilan ham vannaga kirishdi; va u yerda, hech kimga unga barmoq qo'ymasdan, Salabettoga o'z qo'llari bilan mushak va tutunli sovun bilan yaxshi yuvdi; keyin u o'zini quldan yuvdi.

en: This done, the latter brought two very white and ﬁne sheets, whence came so great a scent of roses that everything there seemed roses, in one of which they wrapped Salabaetto and in the other the lady and taking them in their arms, carried them both to the bed prepared for them.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, ikkinchisi ikkita juda oq va nozik choyshab olib keldi. Ulardan shunday katta atirgul hidi kelardi, hamma narsa atirgulga o'xshardi, ulardan biriga Salabaetto o'rab, ikkinchisiga esa xonim ularni quchog'iga olib, ikkalasi ham ular uchun tayyorlangan karavotga olib borardi.

en: There, whenas they had left sweating, the slave- girls did them loose from the sheets wherein they were wrapped and they abode naked in the others, whilst the girls brought out of the basket wonder- goodly casting-bottles of silver, full of sweet waters, rose and jessamine and orange and citron-ﬂower scented, and sprinkled them all therewith; after
uz: U yerda, terlab ketgach, qul qizlar ularni o'ralgan choyshablardan bo'shatishdi va boshqalarda yalang'och holda turishdi, qizlar esa savatdan ajoyib-yaxshilik bilan quyilgan kumush butilkalarni olib chiqishdi, shirin suvlar, atirgul va jessamin, apelsin va limon gullari hidlari bilan to'ldirildi va ularning hammasini sepdilar;

en: which boxes of succades and wines of great price were produced and they refreshed themselves awhile.
uz: Qaysi qutilarda katta narxdagi sukadlar va vinolar ishlab chiqarilgan va ular bir oz vaqt davomida tetiklanishdi.

en: It seemed to Salabaetto as he were in Paradise and he cast a thousand glances at the lady, who was certes very handsome, himseeming each hour was an hundred years till the slave-girls should begone and he should ﬁnd himself in her arms.
uz: Salabettoga xuddi jannatdagidek tuyuldi va u xonimga ming bir nazar tashladi. Xonim, albatta, juda chiroyli edi, unga har bir soat qul-qizlar boshlanib, o'zini uning qo'llarida topguncha yuz yil bo'lgandek tuyuldi.

en: Presently, at her commandment, the girls departed the chamber, leaving a ﬂambeau alight there; whereupon she embraced Salabaetto and he her, and they abode together a great while, to the exceed- ing pleasure of the Florentine, to whom it seemed she was all aﬁre for love of him.
uz: Hozirda, uning buyrug'iga ko'ra, qizlar xonadan chiqib ketishdi, u yerda olov yoqib turardi; shundan so'ng u Salabaetto va uni quchoqladi va ular Florensiyalikning haddan tashqari zavqiga ko'ra uzoq vaqt birga turdilar, unga u butunlay uni sevgandek tuyuldi.

en: Whenas it seemed to her time to rise, she called the slave-girls and they clad themselves; then they recruited themselves somedele with a second collation of wine and sweetmeats and washed their hands and faces with odoriferous waters; after which, being about to depart, the lady said to Salabaetto, ‘So it be agreeable to thee, it were doing me a very great favour an thou camest this evening to sup and lie the night with me.’ Salabaetto, who was by this time altogether captivated by her beauty and the artful pleasantness of her fashions and ﬁrmly believed himself to be loved of her as he were the heart out of her body, replied, ‘Madam, your every pleasure is supremely agreeable to me, wherefore both tonight and at all times I mean to do that which shall please you and that which shall be commanded me of you.’ Accordingly the lady returned to her house, where she caused well be- deck her
uz: Uning turish vaqti kelganday bo'lgach, u qul qizlarni chaqirib oldi va ular o'zlarini kiyishdi; so'ngra ular o'zlarini vino va shirinliklarning ikkinchi damlamasi bilan biroz chaqirishdi va qo'llari va yuzlarini xushbo'y suvlar bilan yuvdilar; so'ngra ketmoqchi bo'lganida, xonim Salabettaga dedi: "Senga rozi bo'lishim kerak edi, bugun kechqurun men bilan birga tunab yotish uchun juda katta iltifot ko'rsatding." Salabetto, bu vaqtga kelib uning go'zalligi va uning modalarining hunarmandona yoqimliligi bilan butunlay o'ziga maftun bo'lgan va o'zini yuragidan chiqqanidek sevikli deb ishongan holda, javob berdi: "Xonim, sizning roziligingiz menga juda muhim edi, bugun ham, har doim siz uni qayerga qaytarishingiz kerak bo'lsa, men uni xursand qilaman va u..."

en: bedchamber with her dresses and gear and letting make ready a splendid supper, awaited Salabaetto, who, as soon as it was grown some- what dark, betook himself thither and being received with open arms, supped with all cheer and commodity of service.
uz: Yotoqxona, liboslari va jihozlari bilan, ajoyib kechki ovqat tayyorlab, Salabetto kutib turardi. Salabetto, u o'sishi bilanoq - qorong'i narsa, o'zini u yerga tashlab, ochiq qo'llar bilan kutib olinardi, barcha quvonch va xizmat ko'rsatish qulayliklari bilan ta'minlardi.

en: Thereafter they betook themselves into the bedchamber, where he smelt a marvellous fragrance of aloes-wood and saw the bed very richly adorned with Cyprian singing- birds419 and store of ﬁne dresses upon the pegs, all which things together and each of itself made him conclude that this must be some great and rich lady.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular yotoqxonaga kirib ketishdi, u yerda u aloy yog'ochining ajoyib hidini sezdi va karavotni Kipr qushlari bilan juda boy bezatilganini ko'rdi - qushlar419 va paypoqlarda nozik ko'ylaklar to'plami, bularning barchasi birgalikda va har biri uni bu buyuk va boy ayol bo'lishi kerak degan xulosaga olib keldi.

en: And although he had heard some whispers to the contrary anent her manner of life, he would not anywise believe it; or, if he e’en gave so much credit thereto as to allow that she might erst have cozened others, for noth- ing in the world could he have believed that this might possibly happen to himself.
uz: Va garchi u uning turmush tarzi haqida aksincha shivirlar eshitgan bo'lsa ham, unga hech qanday ishonmas edi; yoki, agar u bunga shunchalik ko'p e'tirof bergan bo'lsa, u avval boshqalarni o'ziga jalb qilishi mumkin edi, chunki dunyoda u bu o'zi bilan sodir bo'lishi mumkinligiga ishonmagan bo'lardi.

en: He lay that night with her in the utmost delight, still waxing more enamoured, and in the morning she girt him on a quaint and goodly girdle of silver, with a ﬁne purse thereto, saying, ‘Sweet my Salabaetto, I com-
uz: U o'sha kecha u bilan juda ham xursand bo'lib yotdi, hali ham yanada oshiq bo'lib borardi, va ertalab uni g'alati va chiroyli kumush kamarga bog'ladi, unga nozik hamyon bilan, dedi: "Sevgilim Salabaetto, men..."

en: mend myself to thy remembrance, and like as my person is at thy pleasure, even so is all that is here and all that dependeth upon me at thy service and commandment.’ Salabaetto, rejoiced, embraced and kissed her; then, going forth of her house, he betook himself whereas the other merchants were used to resort.
uz: O'zimni Sening xotiratingga bag'ishla, va mening shaxsim Sening roziligingda bo'lgani kabi, shu yerda bo'lgan hamma narsa va Sening xizmating va amringda menga bog'liq bo'lgan hamma narsa ham shundaydir. Salabaetto xursand bo'lib, uni quchoqladi va o'pdi; so'ngra, uning uyidan chiqib, boshqa savdogarlar foydalanadigan joyda o'zini ko'rsatdi.

en: On this wise consorting with her at one time and another, without its costing him aught in the world, and growing every hour more entangled, it befell that he sold his stuffs for ready money and made a good proﬁt thereby; of which the lady incontinent heard, not from him, but from others, and Salabaetto being come one night to visit her, she fell to prattling and wantoning with him, kissing and clipping him and feigning herself so en- amoured of him that it seemed she must die of love in his arms.
uz: Shu tariqa, u bilan bir vaqtning o'zida, unga dunyoga hech narsa to'lamasdan, va har soatda tobora aralashib borar ekan, u o'z narsalarini tayyor pulga sotdi va shu bilan yaxshi foyda ko'rdi; bu haqda xonim notinchlik bilan undan emas, balki boshqalardan eshitdi, va Salabaetto bir kecha uni ziyorat qilish uchun kelganida, u bilan gaplashishga, uni o'pishga va kesishga tushdi va o'zini shunday sevib ko'rsatdiki, go'yo uning qo'lida muhabbatdan o'lishi kerak edi.

en: Moreover, she would fain have given him two very ﬁne hanaps of silver that she had; but he would not take them, for that he had had of her, at one time and an- other, what was worth a good thirty gold ﬂorins, without availing to have her take of him so much as a groat’s worth.
uz: Qolaversa, u unga o'zida bor bo'lgan ikkita juda chiroyli kumush g'altakni bergan bo'lardi; lekin u ularni olmasdi, chunki u bir vaqtlar undan o'ttiz oltin floringa arziydigan narsa olgan edi, lekin undan bir necha so'm qimmatga teng narsa olishdan foyda ko'rmas edi.

en: At last, whenas she had well en- kindled him by showing herself so enamoured and freehanded, one of her slave-girls called her, as she had ordained beforehand; whereupon she left the chamber and coming back, after awhile, in tears cast herself face down- ward on the bed and fell to making the woefullest lamentation ever woman made.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'zini shunchalik oshiq va erkin ko'rsatish orqali uni juda xursand qilganida, uning bir quli-qizlari uni oldindan tayinlaganidek chaqirdi; shundan so'ng u xonadan chiqib, birozdan keyin qaytib kelib, yig'lab, o'zini karavotga tashladi va ayol hech qachon qilgan eng g'amgin motamni aytishga tushdi.

en: Salabaetto, marvelling at this, caught her in his arms and fell a-weep- ing with her and saying, ‘Alack, heart of my body, what aileth thee thus suddenly?
uz: Salabaetto, bunga hayratlanib, uni quchog'iga oldi va u bilan birga yig'lab dedi: "Alack, mening tanamning yuragi, senga nima bo'ldi to'satdan?"

en: What is the cause of this grief?
uz: Bu qayg'uning sababi nima?
