en: For God’s sake, tell it me, my soul.’ The lady, after letting herself be long entreated, answered, ‘Woe’s me, sweet my lord, I know not what to say or to do; I have but now received let- ters from Messina and my brother writeth me that, should I sell or pawn all that is here,420 I must without fail send him a thousand gold ﬂorins within eight days from this time, else will his head be cut off; and I know not how I shall do to get this sum so suddenly.
uz: Xudo haqqi, menga ayting, jonim. Xonim uzoq vaqt iltijo qilishga ruxsat berib, javob berdi: Voy menga, azizim, nima deyishimni ham, nima qilishimni ham bilmayman; men hozir Messina'dan xat oldim va akam menga yozyapti, agar men bu yerda bor narsani sotsam yoki garovga bersam, 420 yil ichida unga mingta oltin florini yuborishim kerak, aks holda uning boshi kesiladi; va men bu summani bunchalik to'satdan olish uchun qanday chora ko'rishimni bilmayman.

en: Had I but ﬁfteen days’ grace, I would ﬁnd a means of procuring it from a certain quarter whence I am to have much more, or I would sell one of our farms; but, as this may not be, I had liefer be dead than that this ill news should have come to me.’ So saying, she made a show of being sore afﬂicted and stinted not from weeping; whereupon quoth Salabaetto, whom the ﬂames of love had bereft of great part of his wonted good sense, so that he believed her tears to be true and her words truer yet, ‘Madam, I cannot oblige you with a thousand ﬂorins, but ﬁve hundred I can very well advance you, since you believe you
uz: Agar menda o'n besh kunlik rahmat bo'lganida, uni ma'lum bir joydan topardim, u yerdan ko'proq narsa olsam bo'lardi, yoki bizning fermamizdan birini sotardim; lekin, bu bo'lmasligi mumkin bo'lsa ham, bu yomon xabar menga yetib kelganidan ko'ra o'limni afzal ko'rardim. Shunday qilib, u azob chekkanini ko'rsatdi va yig'lashdan to'xtamadi; shundan so'ng, sevgi olovlari uning o'z aqlini yo'qotdi, shuning uchun u uning ko'z yoshlari rost deb ishondi va uning so'zlari hali ham rost, "Xonim, men sizni ming florin bilan majburlay olmayman, lekin besh yuz bilan juda yaxshi oldinga siljitishim mumkin, chunki siz ishonasizki,

en: will be able to return them to me within a fortnight from this time; and this is of your good fortune that I chanced but yesterday to sell my stuffs; for, had it not been so, I could not have lent you a groat.’ ‘Alack,’ cried the lady, ‘hast thou then been straitened for lack of money?
uz: Ularni shu vaqtdan keyin o'n ikki hafta ichida menga qaytarib bera olaman; va bu sizning omadingizdan, kecha o'z narsalarimni sotishga ulgurdim; chunki, agar unday bo'lmaganida, sizga hech qanday qarz bera olmasdim." Alack,  deb baqirdi xonim,  unda pul yetishmasligi tufayli qiynalganmisiz?

en: Marry, why didst thou not require me thereof?
uz: Uylan, nega mendan buni talab qilmading?

en: Though I have not a thousand, I had an hundred and even two hundred to give thee.
uz: Garchi menda mingta bo'lmasa ham, senga berishga yuz, hatto ikki yuzta bor edi.

en: Thou hast deprived me of all heart to accept of thee the service thou profferest me.’ Salabaetto was more than ever taken with these words and said, ‘Madam, I would not have you refrain on that account, for, had I had such an occasion therefor as you presently have, I would assuredly have asked you.’ ‘Alack, Salabaetto mine,’ replied the lady, ‘now know I aright that thine is a true and perfect love for me, since, without waiting to be required, thou freely succoureth me, in such a strait, with so great a sum of money.
uz: Siz meni siz taklif qilayotgan xizmatni qabul qilish uchun butun qalbimdan mahrum qildingiz. Salabaetto bu so'zlarga har qachongidan ham ko'proq quloq soldi va dedi: "Xonim, men sizdan bu gapni qaytarmasligimni xohlardim, chunki, agar sizda hozirgidek shunday imkoniyat bo'lganida, men sizdan so'rar edim." "Alak, Salabaetto mening," dedi xonim, "endi men sizning menga bo'lgan chin va mukammal muhabbatingizni bilaman, chunki siz talab qilinishini kutmasdan, bunday qiyin vaziyatda menga juda katta miqdorda yordam berasiz."

en: Certes, I was all thine without this, but with this I shall be far more so; nor shall I ever forget that I owe thee my broth- er’s life.
uz: Albatta, men bu yo'q holda butunlay seniki edim, lekin bu bilan bundan ham ko'proq bo'laman; va hech qachon unutmaymanki, men sendan mening sho'rvaxon hayotimni qarzdorman.

en: But God knoweth I take it sore unwillingly, seeing that thou art a merchant and that with money merchants transact all their affairs; however, since need constraineth me, and I have certain assurance of speedily restor- ing it to thee, I will e’en take it; and for the rest, an I ﬁnd no readier means, I will pawn all these my possessions.’ So saying, she let herself fall, weep- ing, on Salabaetto’s neck.
uz: Lekin Xudo biladi, men buni istamagan holda og'ir his qilaman, chunki sen savdogarsan va pul bilan sotuvchilar barcha ishlarini amalga oshiradilar; ammo, muhtojlik meni majbur qilgani uchun, uni tezda senga qaytarishga ishonch hosil qilganim uchun, uni olaman; va qolganlari uchun, agar tayyorroq yo'l topmasam, bu barcha mol-mulkimni garovga beraman." Shunday qilib, u o'zini yig'lab, Salabaettoning bo'yniga tashladi.

en: He fell to comforting her and after abiding the night with her, he, next morning, to approve himself her most liberal ser- vant, without waiting to be asked by her, carried her ﬁve hundred right gold ﬂorins, which she received with tears in her eyes, but laughter in her heart, Salabaetto contenting himself with her simple promise.
uz: U uni tasalli berishga tushdi va u bilan tunab qolgach, u ertasi kuni ertalab uning eng liberal ser-ventini ma'qullash uchun, undan so'ralganini kutmasdan, uning besh yuzta to'g'ri oltin florini olib keldi, uni ko'zlarida yosh bilan, lekin yuragida kulgi bilan qabul qildi, Salabaetto o'zining oddiy va'dasidan mamnun edi.

en: As soon as the lady had the money, the signs began to change, and whereas before he had free access to her whenassoever it pleased him, reas- ons now began to crop up, whereby it betided him not to win admission there once out of seven times, nor was he received with the same counten- ance nor the same caresses and rejoicings as before.
uz: Xonim pulni olishi bilanoq, belgilar o'zgarishni boshladi va ilgari u unga xohlagan vaqtda erkin kirishi mumkin bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, endi paydo bo'la boshladi, bu esa unga yetti martadan bir marta u yerga kirish imkoniyatini bermaslikka va oldingidek na bir xil hurmat bilan, na bir xil erkalash va quvonch bilan qabul qilinmasligiga ishora qildi.

en: And the term at which he was to have had his monies again being, not to say come, but past by a month or two and he requiring them, words were given him in payment.
uz: Va uning pullari yana kelishi kerak bo'lgan muddat, kelmadi deyish uchun emas, balki bir-ikki oy o'tib ketdi va u ularni talab qilganda, unga to'lov evaziga so'zlar berildi.

en: Thereupon his eyes were opened to the wicked woman’s arts and his own lack of wit, wherefore, feeling that he could say nought of her beyond that which might please her concerning the matter, since he had neither script nor other evidence thereof, and being ashamed to complain to any, as well for that he had been forewarned thereof as for fear of the scoffs which he
uz: Shundan so'ng uning ko'zlari buzuq ayolning hunarmandchiligiga va o'zining aqlsizligiga ochildi. Shuning uchun, u bu borada unga yoqadigan boshqa hech narsa ayta olmasligini his qildi, chunki uning na yozuvi bor edi, na boshqa dalili bor edi va hech kimga shikoyat qilishdan uyaldi, shuningdek, u haqoratlardan qo'rqib oldindan ogohlantirilgan edi.

en: might reasonably expect for his folly, he was beyond measure woeful and inwardly bewailed his credulity.
uz: O'zining ahmoqligi uchun oqilona kutish mumkin edi, u haddan tashqari qayg'uli edi va ich-ichidan o'z ishonchini xafa qildi.

en: At last, having had divers letters from his masters, requiring him to change421 the monies in question and remit them to them, he determined to depart, lest, an he did it not, his default should be discovered there, and ac- cordingly, going aboard a little ship, he betook himself, not to Pisa, as he should have done, but to Naples.
uz: Nihoyat, xo'jayinlaridan turli xil xatlar kelib, undan so'ralgan pulni 421 ga o'zgartirishni va ularga topshirishni talab qilib, u jo'nab ketishga qaror qildi, aks holda, agar u bunday qilmasa, uning buyrug'i u yerda topilishi kerak edi va shunga ko'ra, kichik kemaga chiqib, u Pisaga emas, balki Neapolga yo'l oldi.

en: There at that time was our gossip Pietro dello Canigiano, treasurer to the Empress of Constantinople, a man of great understanding and subtle wit and a fast friend of Salabaetto and his family; and to him, as to a very discreet man, the disconsolate Florentine recounted that which he had done and the mischance that had befallen him, requiring him of aid and counsel, so he might contrive to gain his living there, and avouching his intention nevermore to return to Florence.
uz: O'sha paytda bizning mish-mishlarimiz bo'lgan Pietro dello Canigiano, Konstantinopol imperatorining g'aznachisi, katta tushunchaga ega va nozik aqlga ega bo'lgan, Salabetto va uning oilasining tezkor do'sti edi; va unga, juda ehtiyotkor odamga kelsak, taskin beruvchi Florensiyalik o'zi qilgan ishini va unga yetgan yomonlikni aytib berdi, yordam va maslahat so'radi, shunda u u yerda tirikchilik qilishga urinishi mumkin edi va hech qachon Florensiyaga qaytmaslik niyatini aytdi.

en: Canigiano was concerned for this and said, ‘Ill hast thou done and ill hast thou carried thy- self; thou hast disobeyed thy masters and hast, at one cast, spent a great sum of money in wantonness; but, since it is done, we must look for otherwhat.’422 Accordingly, like a shrewd man as he was, he speedily be- thought himself what was to be done and told it to Salabaetto, who was pleased with the device and set about putting it in execution.
uz: Kanigiano bundan xavotirda edi va dedi: Sen o'zingni yomonlik bilan tutding va yomonlik bilan o'zingni tutding; sen xo'jayinlaringga itoat qilmading va bir yo'lda behudaga katta pul sarflading; lekin, bu ish tugagandan so'ng, boshqa narsani qidirishimiz kerak. 422 Shunday qilib, o'zi kabi aqlli odam kabi, u tezda o'zi nima qilish kerakligini o'ylab, bu haqda Salabaettoga aytdi. Salabaetto bu qurilmadan mamnun bo'lib, uni amalga oshirishga kirishdi.

en: He had some money and Canigiano having lent him other some, he made up a number of bales well packed and corded; then, buying a score of oil-casks and ﬁlling them, he embarked the whole and returned to Palermo, where, having given the customhouse ofﬁcers the bill of lading and the value of the casks and let enter everything to his account, he laid the whole up in the magazines, say- ing that he meant not to touch them till such time as certain other mer- chandise which he expected should be come.
uz: Uning biroz puli bor edi va Kanigano unga yana biroz qarz berganidan so'ng, bir qancha yaxshi qadoqlangan va simlar bilan to'ldirilgan ballarni tayyorladi; so'ngra bir nechta moy qutilarini sotib olib, ularni to'ldirib, butunligi bilan Palermoga qaytib keldi. U yerda bojxona xodimlariga yuk varaqasi va qutilarning qiymatini bergan va hamma narsani o'z hisob raqamiga kiritganidan so'ng, butunligini jurnallarga joylashtirdi, u kelishini kutgan boshqa bir xil mer- Chandise kabi vaqtgacha ularga teginmasligini aytdi.

en: Biancoﬁore, getting wind of this and hearing that the merchandise he had presently brought with him was worth good two thousand ﬂorins, without reckoning what he looked for, which was valued at more than three thou- sand, bethought herself that she had ﬂown at too small game and determ- ined to restore him the ﬁve hundred ﬂorins, so she might avail to have the greater part of the ﬁve thousand.
uz: Biancofiore bu haqda eshitib, yaqinda o'zi bilan olib kelgan buyumning qiymati ikki ming floringa teng ekanligini eshitib, nima qidirayotganini hisobga olmaganda, uch mingdan ortiq qumga baholanganini o'ylab, o'zini juda kichik o'yinda uchib ketgan deb o'yladi va besh ming florinni unga qaytarishga qaror qildi, shunda u besh mingning ko'p qismini olishga qodir bo'ladi.

en: Accordingly, she sent for him and Salabaetto, grown cunning, went to her; whereupon, making believe to know nothing of that which he had brought with him, she received him with a great show of fondness and said to him, ‘Harkye, if thou wast vexed with me, for that I repaid thee not thy monies on the very day.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u uni chaqirib yubordi va Salabaetto, o'sgan hiyla bilan, uning oldiga bordi; shundan so'ng, u o'zi bilan olib kelgan narsalardan hech narsa bilmaslikka ishora qilib, uni katta mehr bilan kutib oldi va unga dedi: "Harkye, agar sen mendan xafa bo'lsang, chunki men senga o'sha kuni pulingni qaytarmadim."

en: …’ Salabaetto fell a-laughing and answered; ‘In truth, madam, it did somewhat displease me,
uz: ... Salabaetto kuldi va javob berdi: Rostini aytsam, xonim, bu menga biroz yoqmadi,

en: seeing I would have torn out my very heart to give it you, an I thought to pleasure you withal; but I will have you hear how I am vexed with you.
uz: Ko'rib turib, uni senga berish uchun o'z qalbimni yirtib tashlagan bo'lardim, seni xursand qilishni o'yladim; lekin senga qanday g'azablanayotganimni eshitishingni aytaman.

en: Such and so great is the love I bear you, that I have sold the most part of my possessions and have presently brought hither merchandise to the value of more than two thousand ﬂorins and expect from the westward as much more as will be worth over three thousand, with which I mean to stock me a warehouse in this city and take up my sojourn here, so I may still be near you, meseeming I fare better of your love than ever lover of his lady.’ ‘Look you, Salabaetto,’ answered the lady, ‘every commodity of thine is mighty pleasing to me, as that of him whom I love more than my life, and it pleaseth me amain that thou art returned hither with intent to sojourn here, for that I hope yet to have good time galore with thee; but I would fain ex- cuse myself somedele to thee for that, whenas thou wast about to depart, thou wouldst bytimes have come hither and couldst not, and whiles thou camest and
uz: Sizga bo'lgan muhabbatim shunchalik buyukki, men mol-mulkimning ko'p qismini sotdim va hozir bu yerga ikki ming florindan ortiq qiymatga ega bo'lgan tovarlarni olib keldim va g'arbdan uch mingdan ortiq qiymatga ega bo'lishini kutmoqchiman. Shu bilan men bu shaharda ombor yig'ib, shu yerda qolmoqchiman, shunda men hali ham siz bilan bo'lishim mumkin, chunki men sizning muhabbatingizdan xotiniga bo'lgan muhabbatingizdan yaxshiroq bahramand bo'laman." "Mana, Salabaetto," dedi xonim, "Sizning har bir qulayligingiz menga juda yoqadi, xuddi hayotimdan ko'ra ko'proq sevgan odamdan, va bu meni hayratga soladi, chunki siz bu yerda qolish uchun qaytib kelgansiz, chunki men hali ham siz bilan yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishga umid qilaman, lekin siz...

en: wast not so gladly seen as thou wast used to be, more by token that I returned thee not thy monies at the time promised.
uz: Sizni odatdagidek xursandchilik bilan ko'rmaganman, chunki men sizga va'da qilingan vaqtda pulingizni qaytarmaganman.

en: Thou must know that I was then in very great concern and sore afﬂiction, and whoso is in such case, how much soever he may love another, cannot always show him so cheerful a countenance or pay him such attention as he might wish.
uz: Shuni bilishing kerakki, o'shanda men juda katta tashvish va og'riqli ahvolda edim va kim shunday holatda bo'lsa ham, u boshqa birovni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rmasin, unga har doim shunchalik quvnoq yuz ko'rsata olmaydi yoki unga xohlaganchalik e'tibor bera olmaydi.

en: Moreover, thou must know that it is mighty uneasy for a woman to avail to ﬁnd a thousand gold ﬂorins; all day long we are put off with lies and that which is promised us is not performed unto us; wherefore needs must we in our turn lie unto others.
uz: Qolaversa, bilishing kerakki, ayol uchun mingta oltin florini topishdan foydalanish juda qiyin; kun bo'yi yolg'onlar bilan uzoqlashamiz va bizga va'da qilingan narsa bizga bajarilmaydi; shuning uchun biz o'z navbatimizda boshqalarga yolg'on gapirishimiz kerak.

en: Hence cometh it, and not of my default, that I gave thee not back thy monies.
uz: Shunday qilib, men senga pulingni qaytarib bermaganim mening xatoyimdan emas.

en: However, I had them a little after thy departure, and had I known whither to send them, thou mayst be assured that I would have remitted them to thee; but, not knowing this, I kept them for thee.’ Then, letting fetch a purse wherein were the very monies he had brought her, she put it into his hand, saying, ‘Count them if there be ﬁve hundred.’ Never was Salabaetto so glad; he counted them and ﬁnding them ﬁve hun- dred, put them up and said, ‘Madam, I am assured that you say sooth; but you have done enough [to convince me of your love for me], and I tell you that, for this and for the love I bear you, you could never require me, for any your occasion, of whatsoever sum I might command, but I would ob- lige you therewith; and whenas I am established here, you may put this to the proof.’ Having again on this wise renewed his loves with her in words, he fell again to using amically with her,
uz: Ammo, sen ketgandan keyin biroz vaqt o'tgach, ularni menda bor edi va ularni qayerga jo'natishni bilganimda edi, senga ularni jo'natgan bo'lardim, deb ishonch hosil qilgin; lekin, buni bilmasdan, men ularni senga saqladim. Keyin, u olib kelgan pullar bo'lgan hamyonni olib kelishga ruxsat berib, uni uning qo'liga qo'ydi va dedi: "Besh yuz bo'lsa, sanab ko'r." Salabaetto hech qachon bunchalik xursand bo'lmadi; u ularni sanadi va ularni beshta bo'lib topdi, ularni qo'ydi va dedi: "Xonim, men senga ishonganimga ishonaman; lekin sen menga bo'lgan muhabbatingni ishontirish uchun yetarli ish qilding", va men senga aytamanki, bu va senga bo'lgan muhabbat uchun hech qachon meni hech qanday sababga ko'ra talab qilolmaysan, lekin men seni bu bilan birga qo'yib, bu so'zlarni qayta tiklagan bo'lsam, men seni...

en: whilst she made much of him and showed
uz: U undan ko'p narsa qildi va ko'rsatdi.

en: him the greatest goodwill and honour in the world, feigning the utmost love for him.
uz: Unga dunyodagi eng buyuk xayrixohlik va sharaf, unga bo'lgan eng cheksiz muhabbatni soxtalashtirish.

en: But he, having a mind to return her cheat for cheat, being one day sent for by her to sup and sleep with her, went thither so chapfallen and so woebegone that it seemed as he would die.
uz: Lekin u, uning aldovini aldov evaziga qaytarishni o'ylab, bir kuni u bilan ovqatlanib, uxlashga yuborilganligi sababli, u yerga shunchalik yiqilib ketgan va shunchalik g'amgin bo'lib ketgan ediki, o'lishiga o'xshardi.

en: Biancoﬁore, embracing him and kissing him, began to question him of what ailed him to be thus melancholy, and he, after letting himself be importuned a good while, answered, ‘I am a ruined man, for that the ship, wherein is the merchandise I expected, hath been taken by the corsairs of Monaco and held to ransom in ten thousand gold ﬂorins, whereof it falleth to me to pay a thousand, and I have not a farthing, for that the ﬁve hundred pieces thou returnedst to me I sent incon- tinent to Naples to lay out in cloths to be brought hither; and should I go about at this present to sell the merchandise I have here, I should scarce get a penny for two pennyworth, for that it is no time for selling.
uz: Biankofiore uni quchoqlab, o'pdi va unga bunday qayg'uga sabab bo'lgan narsa haqida so'ray boshladi. U bir oz vaqt o'zini bezovta qilgandan so'ng, javob berdi: "Men vayron bo'lgan odamman, chunki unda men kutgan tovarlar Monako kurserlari tomonidan olib ketilgan va o'n ming oltin florinda to'lov uchun ushlab turilgan, shuning uchun menga ming to'lash kerak, va menda uncha ko'p narsa yo'q, chunki besh yuz dona menga qaytib kelganing uchun men Neapolga matoni olib kelishga jo'natdim; va agar shu yerda boradigan tovarlarimni sotish uchun bu yerga borsam, men bir tiyin ham ololmayman, chunki u yerda hech qanday noqulaylik yo'q."

en: Nor am I yet so well known that I could ﬁnd any here to help me to this, wherefore I know not what to do or to say; for, if I send not the monies speedily, the merchandise will be carried off to Monaco and I shall never again have aught thereof.’ The lady was mightily concerned at this, fearing to lose him altogether, and considering how she should do, so he might not go to Monaco, said, ‘God knoweth I am sore concerned for the love of thee; but what availeth it to afﬂict oneself thus?
uz: Men bu yerda menga yordam beradigan hech kimni topa olmasligim ham yetarli emas, shuning uchun nima qilish yoki nima deyishni bilmayman; chunki, agar pulni tez jo'natmasam, tovar Monakoga olib ketiladi va men hech qachon undan hech narsa olmayman." Xonim bu haqda juda xavotirda edi, uni butunlay yo'qotishdan qo'rqardi va qanday qilish kerakligini o'ylab, Monakoga bormasligi kerak deb, dedi: "Xudo biladiki, men senga bo'lgan muhabbatdan juda xavotirdaman; lekin o'zini bunday azoblashdan nima foyda?"

en: If I had the monies, God knoweth I would lend them to thee incontinent; but I have them not.
uz: Agar menda pullar bo'lganida, Xudo biladi, ularni senga bemalol berardim; lekin menda yo'q.

en: True, there is a certain person here who obliged me the other day with the ﬁve hundred ﬂorins that I lacked; but he will have heavy usance for his monies; nay, he requireth no less than thirty in the hundred, and if thou wilt borrow of him, needs must he be made secure with a good pledge.
uz: To'g'ri, bu yerda bir odam bor edi, u meni kecha yo'q bo'lgan besh yuz florinni majbur qildi; lekin u o'z pulini og'ir sarflaydi; yo'q, u yuzdan o'ttizdan kam talab qilmaydi, va agar undan qarz olmoqchi bo'lsang, uni yaxshi garov bilan himoya qilish kerak.

en: For my part, I am ready to engage for thee all these my goods and my person, to boot, for as much as he will lend thereon; but how wilt thou assure him of the rest?’ Salabaetto readily appre- hended the reason that moved her to do him this service and divined that it was she herself who was to lend him the money; wherewith he was well pleased and thanking her, answered that he would not be put off for exorbit- ant usance, need constraining him.
uz: O'z navbatida, men senga barcha mol-mulkimni va o'z odamimni sotishga tayyorman, chunki u unga qancha qarz bersa shuncha; lekin qolganini unga qanday ishontirasan? Salabaetto uni bu xizmatni qilishga undaydigan sababni tezda angladi va pulni unga o'zi qarz berishi kerakligini bashorat qildi; bundan xursand bo'ldi va unga minnatdorchilik bildirdi, javob berdi: "U bizga qarshi haddan tashqari, uni majburlash uchun kechiktirmayman."

en: Moreover, he said that he would give assurance of the merchandise he had in the customhouse, letting inscribe it to him who should lend him the money; but that needs must be kept the key of the magazines, as well that he might be able to show his wares, an it were required of him, as that nothing might be touched or changed or tampered withal.
uz: Qolaversa, u bojxonada bor mol-mulkidan kafolat berishini, uni kimga qarz berishi kerak bo'lsa, o'sha odamga yozib berishini aytdi; lekin bu ehtiyoj jurnallarning kalitini saqlab qolishi kerak, shuningdek, u o'z tovarlarini ko'rsata olishi kerak edi, chunki bu undan hech narsa teginmasligi, o'zgartirilmasligi yoki buzilmasligi kerak edi.

en: The lady answered that it was well said and that this was good enough assurance; wherefore, as soon as the day was come, she sent for a broker, in whom she trusted greatly, and taking order with him of the matter, gave him a thousand gold ﬂorins, which he lent to Salabaetto, letting inscribe in his own name at the customhouse that which the latter had there; then, having made their writings and counter-writings together and being come to an ac- cord,423 they occupied themselves with their other affairs.
uz: Xonim javob berdi, bu yaxshi aytilgan va bu yetarli ishonch edi; shuning uchun, kun kelishi bilanoq, u bir brokerni chaqirib yubordi, unga juda ishondi va undan bu ish bo'yicha buyurtma olib, unga mingta oltin florini berdi, uni Salabaettoga qarzga berdi va u o'z nomiga o'sha yerda bo'lgan bojxona uyida yozishga ruxsat berdi; keyin, o'z yozuvlari va kontr-yozuvlarini birgalikda tuzib, kelishuvga erishgach, 423 ular o'zlarining boshqa ishlari bilan band bo'lishdi.

en: Salabaetto, as soonest he might, embarked, with the ﬁfteen hundred gold ﬂorins, on board a little ship and returned to Pietro dello Canigiano at Naples, whence he re- mitted to his masters, who had despatched him with the stuffs, a good and entire account thereof.
uz: Salabaetto, imkon qadar tezroq, o'n besh yuz tilla florini olib, kichik kemaga chiqdi va Neapoldagi Pietro dello Canigianoga qaytib keldi. U yerdan unga buyumlarni jo'natgan xo'jayinlariga xabar berdi, bu haqda yaxshi va to'liq ma'lumot berdi.

en: Then, having repaid Pietro and every other to whom he owed aught, he made merry several days with Canigiano over the cheat he had put upon the Sicilian trickstress; after which, resolved to be no more a merchant, he betook himself to Ferrara.
uz: So'ngra, Pietro va undan qarzdor bo'lgan har bir kishini qaytargach, u Siciliyalik hiylachiga qo'ygan hiyla tufayli bir necha kun Kanigano bilan xursand bo'ldi; shundan so'ng, endi savdogar bo'lmaslikka qaror qilib, o'zini Ferraraga tashladi.

en: Meanwhile, Biancoﬁore, ﬁnding that Salabaetto had left Palermo, began to marvel and wax misdoubtful and after having awaited him good two months, seeing that he came not, she caused the broker force open the magazines.
uz: Ayni paytda, Biancofiore Salabaetto Palermoni tark etganini bilib, hayratga tusha boshladi va shubha bilan ko'rindi. Uni ikki oy kutgandan so'ng, kelmaganini ko'rib, broker kuchini jurnallarni ochishga majbur qildi.

en: Trying ﬁrst the casks, which she believed to be ﬁlled with oil, she found them full of seawater, save that there was in each maybe a runlet of oil at the top near the bunghole.
uz: Avval yog' bilan to'ldirilgan deb o'ylagan idishlarni sinab ko'rib, u ularni dengiz suvi bilan to'ldirganini topdi, faqat har birida, ehtimol, bunghole yaqinidagi tepada yog' cho'kmasi bor edi.

en: Then, undoing the bales, she found them all full of tow, with the exception of two, which were stuffs; and in brief, with all that was there, there was not more than two hundred ﬂorins’ worth.
uz: So'ngra, balkalarni yechib, ularning hammasini to'la topdi, faqat ikkita narsa bor edi, bundan mustasno; va qisqacha aytganda, u yerda bor-budini ikki yuz florindan ortiq emas edi.

en: Wherefore Biancoﬁore, confessing herself outwitted, long lamented the ﬁve hundred ﬂorins repaid and yet more the thousand lent, saying often, ‘Who with a Tuscan hath to do, Must nor be blind nor see askew.’ On this wise, having gotten nothing for her pains but loss and scorn, she found, to her cost, that some folk know as much as others.” No sooner had Dioneo made an end of his story than Lauretta, knowing the term to be come beyond which she was not to reign and having commended Canigiano’s counsel (which was approved good by its effect) and Salabaetto’s shrewdness (which was no less commendable) in carrying it into execution, lifted the laurel from her own head and set it on that of Emilia, saying, with womanly grace, “Madam, I know not how pleasant a queen we shall have of you; but, at the least, we shall have a fair one.
uz: Shuning uchun Biankofiore o'zini aqldan ozganini tan olib, besh yuz florinni qaytarganidan va undan ham ko'proq mingini qarzga berganidan uzoq afsusda edi, ko'pincha: "Tuskan bilan kim shug'ullanishi kerak, ko'r ham ko'r ham bo'lmasligi kerak", deb aytdi. Shu tariqa, uning azoblari uchun yo'qotish va haqoratdan boshqa hech narsa olmagan holda, u o'z xarajatlari bilan ba'zi odamlar boshqalarga qaraganda ko'proq bilishini aniqladi.

en: then, that your actions be conformable to your beauties.” So saying, she re- turned to her seat, whilst Emilia, a thought abashed, not so much at being made queen as to see herself publicly commended of that which women use most to covet, waxed such in face as are the new-blown roses in the dawn- ing.
uz: Shunday qilib, harakatlaringiz go'zallikingizga mos bo'lsin. Shunday qilib, u o'z o'rindig'iga qaytib keldi, Emilia esa, malika bo'lishdan shunchalik hayratlanmaganidan, ayollarning eng ko'p xohlagan narsasi haqida ommaviy ravishda maqtovga sazovor bo'lganini ko'rish uchun, tongda yangi ochilgan atirgullar kabi ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: However, after she had kept her eyes awhile lowered, till the redness had given place, she took order with the seneschal of that which concerned the general entertainment and presently said, “Delightsome ladies, it is common, after oxen have toiled some part of the day, conﬁned under the yoke, to see them loosed and eased thereof and freely suffered to go a-pas- turing, where most it liketh them, about the woods; and it is manifest also that leafy gardens, embowered with various plants, are not less, but much more fair than groves wherein one seeth only oaks.
uz: Biroq, u ko'zlarini biroz pastga tushirgandan so'ng, qizarish paydo bo'lgunga qadar, u umumiy ko'ngilxushlikka tegishli bo'lgan narsalarning kattalari bilan maslahatlashdi va darhol dedi: "Siziq xonimlar, bu odatiy holki, ho'kizlar kunning bir qismini mehnat qilib, bo'yinturug' ostida qamab, ularni bo'shashganini ko'rish va undan ozod bo'lib, o'rmonlar atrofida erkin o'tishga ruxsat berishadi; va shuningdek, turli xil o'simliklar bilan to'la bargli bog'lar, faqat emanlarni ko'radigan o'rmonlardan kam emas, balki ancha go'zalroqdir."

en: Wherefore, seeing how many days we have discoursed, under the restraint of a ﬁxed law, I opine that, as well unto us as to those whom need constraineth to labour for their daily bread, it is not only useful, but necessary, to play the truant awhile and wandering thus aﬁeld, to regain strength to enter anew under the yoke.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz qat'iy qonunning cheklovlari ostida qancha kun suhbatlashganimizni ko'rib, menimcha, bizga ham, kundalik nonini topish uchun mehnat qilishga majbur bo'lganlarga ham, bu nafaqat foydali, balki zarurdir, balki o'sha vaqtni o'ynash va shu yoqqa sayohat qilib, yana bir bor bo'yinga kirish uchun kuch to'plash kerak.

en: Wherefore, for that which is to be related tomorrow, ensuing your delect- able usance of discourse, I purpose not to restrict you to any special subject, but will have each discourse according as it pleaseth him, holding it for cer- tain that the variety of the things which will be said will afford us no less entertainment than to have discoursed of one alone; and having done thus, whoso shall come after me in the sovranty may, as stronger than I, avail with greater assurance to restrict us within the limits of the wonted laws.” So saying, she set everyone at liberty till suppertime.
uz: Shuning uchun, ertaga tegishli bo'ladigan narsa uchun, sizning ta'sirchan nutq odatingizga ko'ra, sizni hech qanday maxsus mavzuga cheklamayman, balki har bir nutqni o'ziga yoqqanidek o'tkazaman, shuni ta'kidlaymanki, aytiladigan narsalar xilma-xilligi bizga faqat bittadan nutq so'zlashdan kam ko'ngilxushlik bermaydi; va shunday qilib, mendan keyin hukmronlikda kim kelsa, mendan kuchliroq bo'lsa, bizni amaldagi qonunlar doirasida cheklash uchun ko'proq ishonch bilan foydalanishi mumkin.

en: All commended the queen of that which she had said, holding it sagely spoken, and rising to their feet, addressed themselves, this to one kind of diversion and that to another, the ladies to weaving garlands and to gam- bolling and the young men to gaming and singing.
uz: Hamma malika aytgan gapini maqtadi, uni mayin gapirib, oyoqqa turishib, o'zlariga murojaat qilishdi, bu bir xil chalg'ituvchilikka, bu boshqa bir xilga, ayollar esa to'qilgan atirgullarga va o'ynashga, yigitlar esa o'yin va qo'shiq aytishga.

en: On this wise they passed the time until the supper-hour, which being come, they supped with mirth and good cheer about the fair fountain and after diverted themselves with singing and dancing according to the wonted usance.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular kechki ovqat soatigacha vaqt o'tkazib, u kelganidan so'ng, chiroyli favvora atrofida quvonch va xush kayfiyat bilan ovqatlanishdi va keyin odatdagidek qo'shiq va raqsga tushish bilan o'zlarini chalishdi.

en: At last, the queen, to ensue the fashion of her predecessors, commanded Pamﬁlo to sing a song, notwithstanding those which sundry of the company had already sung of their freewill; and he readily began thus: Such is thy pleasure, Love  And such the allegresse I feel thereby
uz: Nihoyat, malika o'zidan oldingilarning uslubini ta'minlash uchun, Pamfiloga o'z xohishlariga ko'ra allaqachon qo'shiq kuylaganlarga qaramay, qo'shiq kuylashni buyurdi; va u bemalol shunday boshladi: "Sening zavqing shunday, Sevgi va men shunday xursandchilikni his qilyapman."

en: That happy, burning in thy ﬁre, am I.
uz: Sening olovingda yonayotgan baxtiyor menman.

en: The abounding gladness in my heart that glows,  For the high joy and dear  Whereto thou hast me led,  Unable to contain there, overﬂows  And in my face’s cheer  Displays my happihead;  For being enamouréd  In such a worship-worthy place and high  Makes eath to me the burning I aby.
uz: Qalbimdagi to'lib-toshgan shodlik nur sochadi, Baland quvonch va aziz qayerga olib borganing uchun, U yerda sig'dira olmaydigan, to'lib-toshadi va yuzimda xursandchilik baxtiyor boshimni ko'rsatadi; Bunday ibodatga loyiq joyda muhabbatga ega bo'lganim uchun va baland bo'lganim uchun menga yonayotgan qasam ichadi.

en: I cannot with my ﬁnger what I feel  Limn, Love, nor do I know  My bliss in song to vent;  Nay, though I knew it, needs must I conceal,  For, once divulged, I trow  ’Twould turn to dreariment.
uz: Men barmog'im bilan Limn, Sevgini his qila olmayman, na mening quvonchimni qo'shiq bilan chiqarish uchun bilaman; Yo'q, garchi bilsam ham, yashirishim kerak, Chunki, bir marta oshkor bo'lgandan so'ng, men Orzuga aylanardim.

en: Yet am I so content,  All speech were halt and feeble, did I try  The least thereof with words to signify.
uz: Lekin men shunchalik xursandmanki, barcha nutqlar to'xtab va zaif edi, men ularning eng kichigini so'zlar bilan anglatishga harakat qildim.

en: Who might conceive it that these arms of mine  Should anywise attain  Whereas I’ve held them aye,  Or that my face should reach so fair a shrine  As that, of favour fain  And grace, I’ve won to?
uz: Kim tasavvur qilishi mumkinki, bu qo'llarim baribir erishishi kerak edi, Men ularni ushlab turganimda, Yoki yuzim shunchalik go'zal ziyoratgohga yetishi kerak edi, Men g'alaba qozongan inoyat va marhamat uchun?

en: Nay,  Such fortune ne’er a day  Believed me were; whence all aﬁre am I,  Hiding the source of my liesse thereby.
uz: Yo'q, bunday omad menga ishonib kelgan kun yo'q edi; men o'sha yerdan olovga otlanganman, shu bilan o'z shahvatimning manbaini yashirganman.

en: This was the end of Pamﬁlo’s song, whereto albeit it had been completely responded of all, there was none but noted the words thereof with more at- tent solicitude than pertained unto him, studying to divine that which, as he sang, it behoved him to keep hidden from them; and although sundry went imagining various things, nevertheless none happened upon the truth of the case.424 But the queen, seeing that the song was ended and that both young ladies and men would gladly rest themselves, commanded that all should betake themselves to bed.
uz: Bu Pamfiloning qo'shig'ining oxiri edi, garchi u hammaga to'liq javob berilgan bo'lsa ham, uning so'zlarini o'ziga xos bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor bilan qayd etmagan, u kuylar ekan, ulardan yashirishni talab qiladigan narsalarni o'rganib chiqardi; va turli xil narsalarni tasavvur qilib yurgan bo'lsa ham, ammo bu ishning haqiqatiga hech narsa kelmadi. 42 Lekin malika qo'shiq tugagandan va yosh ayollar ham, erkaklar ham xursand bo'lib dam olishni ko'rib, hamma o'zlarini yotqishga buyurdi.

en: Here endeth the Eighth Day of the Decameron.
uz: Mana Dekameronning sakkizinchi kuni tugaydi.

en: DAY THE NINTH INTRODUCTION Here beginneth the ninth day of the Decameron wherein under the governance of Emilia each discourseth according as it pleaseth him and of that which is most to his liking.
uz: TO'IXINCHI KUN Kirish Mana, Dekameronning to'qqizinchi kuni boshlanadi, unda Emiliya hukmronligi ostida har bir kishi o'ziga yoqqanidek va unga eng yoqqan narsa haqida gapiradi.

en: The light, from whose resplendence the night ﬂeeth, had already changed all the eighth heaven425 from azure to watchet-colour426 and the ﬂowerets began to lift their heads along the meads, when Emilia, uprising, let call the ladies her comrades and on like wise the young men, who, being come, fared forth, ensuing the slow steps of the queen, and betook themselves to a coppice but little distant from the palace.
uz: Tunning porlashi undan qochib ketayotgan nur, allaqachon sakkizinchi osmonni, azur rangdan, nurli rangga o'zgartirgan edi. 426 va gullar o'tloqlar bo'ylab boshlarini ko'tarishni boshladi. Emiliya o'rnidan turib, xonimlarni o'z hamkasblarini chaqirdi va dono yigitlar kabi, ular kelib, qirolichaning sekin qadamlariga ergashib, o'zlarini qasrdan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan misga o'xshatdilar.

en: Therein entering, they saw the an- imals, wild goats and deer and others, as if assured of security from the hunters by reason of the prevailing pestilence, stand awaiting them no oth- erwise than as they were grown without fear or tame, and diverted them- selves awhile with them, drawing near, now to this one and now to that, as if they would fain lay hands on them, and making them run and skip.
uz: U yerga kirganlarida, ular hayvonlarni, yovvoyi echkilarni, bug'ularni va boshqalarni ko'rishdi, go'yo hukmron bo'lgan vabo tufayli ovchilardan xavfsizlikka ishonch hosil qilgandek, ularni qo'rqmasdan o'stirgandek va o'zlashtirgandek kutishardi, va ularni bir muddat o'zlari bilan o'zgartirardilar, hozir bu yerga yaqinlashardi, hozir esa u yerga, go'yo ularga qo'l qo'yib, ularni yugurtirgandek.

en: But, the sun now waxing high, they deemed it well to turn back.
uz: Ammo quyosh endi baland ko'tarilayotgan edi, ular orqaga qaytishni yaxshi deb hisobladilar.

en: They were all garlanded with oak leaves, with their hands full of ﬂowers and sweet-scen- ted herbs, and whoso encountered them had said no otherwhat than “Or these shall not be overcome of death or it will slay them merry.” On this wise, then, they fared on, step by step, singing and chatting and laughing, till they came to the palace, where they found everything orderly disposed and their servants full of mirth and joyous cheer.
uz: Ularning hammasi eman barglari bilan bezatilgan edi, qo'llari gullar va shirin ko'rinishga to'la o'tlar bilan, va ularni uchratganlar faqat "yoki bular o'limdan yengilmaydi, aks holda u ularni xursandchilik bilan o'ldiradi" degan edilar. Shunday qilib, ular qadam-baqadam, qo'shiq aytib, suhbatlashib va kulishib, saroyga kelishdi, u yerda hamma narsa tartibli va xizmatkorlari quvonch va quvonch bilan to'la edilar.

en: There having rested awhile, they went not to dinner till half a dozen canzonets, each merrier than other, had been carolled by the young men and the ladies; then, water being given to their hands, the seneschal seated them all at table, according to the queen’s pleasure, and the viands being brought, they all ate blithely.
uz: U yerda biroz dam olib, ular kechki ovqatga bormadilar, faqat yarim o'nlab kanzonetlar, ularning har biri boshqalardan ko'ra quvonchliroq, yigitlar va xonimlar tomonidan erkalab qo'yilgunga qadar; keyin, ularning qo'llariga suv berilgach, oqsoqol ularni hammasini malika xohishiga ko'ra dasturxonga o'tqazdi va olib kelingan go'shtlar, hammasi xush kelibdi.

en: Rising thence, they gave themselves awhile to dancing and music-making,
uz: U yerdan ko'tarilib, ular o'zlarini raqsga va musiqa yaratishga biroz vaqt berishdi.

en: and after, by the queen’s commandment, whoso would betook himself to rest.
uz: va keyin, malika buyrug'i bilan, kim o'zini dam olishga majbur qilmoqchi bo'lsa.

en: But presently, the wonted hour being come, all in the accustomed place assembled to discourse, whereupon the queen, looking at Filomena, bade her give commencement to the stories of that day, and she, smiling, began on this wise:
uz: Ammo shu zahoti, odatdagi soat kelishi bilan, barcha odatdagi joyda suhbatga yig'ilishdi. Shundan so'ng malika Filomenaga qarab, unga o'sha kundagi hikoyalarni boshlashni buyurdi va u tabassum qilib, shunday dedi:

en: THE FIRST STORY Madam Francesca, being courted by one Rinuccio Palermini and one Alessandro Chiarmontesi and loving neither the one nor the other, adroitly riddeth herself of both by causing one enter for dead into a sepulchre and the other bring him forth thereof for dead, on such wise that they cannot avail to accomplish the condition imposed.
uz: BIRINCHI HIKOYA Madam Franceska, birgina Rinuccio Palermini va birgina Alessandro Chiarmontesi tomonidan erkalab, na birini, na ikkinchisini yaxshi ko'rib, birini o'lik uchun qabrga kiritib, ikkinchisini o'lik uchun undan chiqarib yuborish orqali o'zini mohirona yo'q qiladi, shunday qilibki, ular qo'yilgan shartni bajara olmaydilar.

en: “Since it is your pleasure, madam, I am well pleased to be she who shall run the ﬁrst ring in this open and free ﬁeld of story-telling, wherein your magni- ﬁcence hath set us; the which an I do well, I doubt not but that those who shall come after will do well and better.
uz: Sizning xohishingizga ko'ra, xonim, men sizning ulug'vorligingiz bizni o'rnatgan ushbu ochiq va erkin hikoya maydonida birinchi qo'ng'iroqni o'tkazadigan odam bo'lishdan mamnunman; men buni yaxshi qilaman, bundan keyin keladiganlar yaxshi va yaxshiroq qilishlariga shubham yo'q.

en: Many a time, charming ladies, hath it been shown in our discourses what and how great is the power of love; natheless, for that medeemeth not it hath been fully spoken thereof (no, nor would be, though we should speak of nothing else for a year to come), and that not only doth love bring lovers into divers dangers of death, but causeth them even to enter for dead into the abiding-places of the dead, it is my pleasure to relate to you a story thereof, over and above those which have been told, whereby not only will you apprehend the puissance of love, but will know the wit used by a worthy lady in ridding herself of two who loved her against her will.
uz: Ko'p marta, go'zal xonimlar, bizning nutqlarimizda muhabbatning kuchi qanday va qanchalik buyuk ekanligi ko'rsatilgan; ammo, bu haqda to'liq gapirilmagan (yo'q, bo'lmas ham, garchi kelgusi yilga boshqa hech narsa haqida gapirsak ham), va sevgi nafaqat sevishganlar uchun turli xil o'lim xavflariga olib keladi, balki ularni hatto o'liklarning abadiy joylariga ham olib kiradi, men sizga uning hikoyasini, aytib berilganlardan ham yuqoriroq bo'lganini aytib berishdan mamnunman, u orqali nafaqat muhabbat kuchini anglaysiz, balki uni sevgan ikki kishidan qutulishda munosib ayol tomonidan qo'llaniladigan hiyla-nayrangni ham bilib olasiz.

en: You must know, then, that there was once in the city of Pistoia a very fair widow lady, of whom two of our townsmen, called the one Rinuccio Paler- mini and the other Alessandro Chiarmontesi, there abiding by reason of banishment from Florence, were, without knowing one of other, passion- ately enamoured, having by chance fallen in love with her and doing privily each his utmost endeavour to win her favour.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, Pistoya shahrida bir vaqtlar juda go'zal bir beva ayol bor edi. Ulardan ikki nafar shahar aholisi, biri Rinuccio Paler-mini, ikkinchisi Alessandro Chiarmontesi deb atalgan, Florensiyadan surgun tufayli u yerda yashayotgan, bir-birini bilmasdan, bir-birini ishtiyoq bilan oshiq bo'lgan, tasodifan unga oshiq bo'lgan va har biri uning marhamatini qozonish uchun maxfiy ravishda bor kuchini sarflagan.

en: The gentlewoman in question, whose name was Madam Francesca de’ Lazzari, being still importuned of the one and the other with messages and entreaties, to which she had whiles
uz: Muhokama qilinadigan janob ayol, uning ismi Madam Francesca de Lazzari edi, u hali ham ikkalasi bilan xabarlar va iltimoslar bilan bezovta edi, ularga u...

en: somewhat unwisely given ear, and desiring, but in vain, discreetly to retract, bethought herself how she might avail to rid herself of their importunity by requiring them of a service, which, albeit it was possible, she conceived that neither of them would render her, to the intent that, they not doing that which she required, she might have a fair and colourable occasion of refus- ing to hearken more to their messages; and the device which occurred to her was on this wise.
uz: Biroz aqlsizlik bilan quloq solingan va behuda, lekin yashirincha qaytarib olishni istagan holda, o'ziga ularning beparvoligidan qanday qutulish uchun ulardan xizmat so'rashni o'yladi. Garchi bu imkoni bo'lsa ham, u ularning hech biri unga xizmat qilmasligini o'yladi, chunki ular o'zi talab qilgan narsani qilmagan holda, u ularning xabarlariga ko'proq quloq solishdan adolatli va rang-barang imkoniyatga ega bo'lishi mumkin edi; va unga kelgan qurilma shu yo'l bilan edi.

en: There had died that very day at Pistoia, one, who, albeit his ancestors were gentlemen, was reputed the worst man that was, not only in Pistoia, but in all the world; more by token that he was in his lifetime so misshapen and of so monstrous a favour that whoso knew him not, seeing him for the ﬁrst time, had been affeared of him; and he had been buried in a tomb without the church of the Minor Friars.
uz: O'sha kuni Pistoyada vafot etgan edi. Garchi ajdodlari janob bo'lsalar ham, u nafaqat Pistoyada, balki butun dunyoda eng yomon odam deb hisoblangan edi; ko'proq shuni anglatadiki, u hayotida shunchalik noto'g'ri va shunchalik dahshatli bo'lganki, uni tanimaganlar uni birinchi marta ko'rganlarida, unga ta'sir qilishgan edi; va u Kichik Mo'ristonlar cherkovisiz qabrda dafn etilgan edi.

en: This circumstance she bethought herself would in part be very apt to her purpose and accordingly she said to a maid of hers, ‘Thou knowest the annoy and the vexation I suffer all day long by the messages of yonder two Florentines, Rinuccio and Alessandro.
uz: Bu holat u o'ziga qisman o'z maqsadiga mos keladi deb o'yladi va shunga ko'ra o'z xizmatchisiga dedi: "Sen bilasan, men butun kun davomida u yerdagi ikki florensiyalik, Rinuccio va Alessandro xabarlaridan azob chekaman."

en: Now I am not disposed to gratify [either of] them with my love, and to rid myself of them, I have bethought myself, for the great proffers that they make, to seek to make proof of them in somewhat which I am certain they will not do; so shall I do away from me this their importunity, and thou shalt see how.
uz: Endi men ularni o'z muhabbatim bilan qondirishni va ulardan qutulishni xohlamayman, men o'zimni o'yladim, chunki ularning buyuk payg'ambarlari, ular qilmasligiga amin bo'lgan nimada ularga dalil keltirishni istaydilar; shunday qilib, men ulardan bu muhimligini yo'q qilaman, va sen ko'rasan qanday.

en: Thou knowest that Scannadio,’427 for so was the wicked man called of whom we have already spoken, ‘was this morning buried in the burial-place of the Minor Brethren, Scannadio, of whom, whenas they saw him alive, let alone dead, the doughtiest men of this city went in fear; wherefore go thou privily ﬁrst to Alessandro and bespeak him, saying, “Madam Francesca giveth thee to know that now is the time come whenas thou mayst have her love, which thou hast so much desired, and be with her, an thou wilt, on this wise.
uz: Siz bilasizki, Scannadio, 427 chunki biz allaqachon gaplashgan yovuz odam shunday atalgan edi,  bugun ertalab Kichik Akalarning dafn marosimiga dafn etilgan edi. Scannadio, uni tirik holda, hatto o'lik holda ko'rganlarida, bu shaharning eng jozibali odamlari qo'rqib ketishgan edi; shuning uchun avval Alessandroga borib, unga gapirib: Madam Francesca sizga uning sevgilisiga ega bo'lish vaqti kelganini aytadi, uni juda xohladingiz va u bilan birga bo'lasiz, shunday qilib.

en: This night, for a reason which thou shalt know after, the body of Scannadio, who was this morning buried, is to be brought to her house by a kinsman of hers, and she, being in great fear of him, dead though he be, would fain not have him there; wherefore she prayeth thee that it please thee, by way of doing her a great service, go this evening, at the time of the ﬁrst sleep, to the tomb wherein he is buried, and donning the dead man’s clothes, abide as thou wert he until such time as they shall come for thee.
uz: Bugun kechasi, keyinroq bilishingiz kerak bo'lgan sababga ko'ra, bugun ertalab dafn etilgan Skannadio jasadi o'z qarindoshi tomonidan uyiga olib kelinadi va u undan juda qo'rqib, o'lgan bo'lsa ham, uni u yerda topmasligini xohlardi; shuning uchun u senga iltijo qiladi, unga katta xizmat ko'rsatish orqali, bugun kechqurun, birinchi uyqu vaqtida, u dafn etilgan qabrga bor, va o'lik odamning kiyimlarini kiyib, uni qayerga kelguncha o'sha yerda o'tir.

en: Then, without moving or speaking, thou must suf- fer thyself be taken up out of the tomb and carried to her house, where she will receive thee, and thou mayst after abide with her and depart at thy leis-
uz: Keyin, hech qanday harakat qilmasdan yoki gapirmasa ham, qabrdan ko'tarilib, uning uyiga olib ketilishi kerak, u yerda seni qabul qiladi, keyin u bilan birga qolishing va xohlaganingda ketishing mumkin.

en: ure, leaving to her the care of the rest.” An he say that he will do it, well and good; but, should he refuse, bid him on my part, never more show himself whereas I may be and look, as he valueth his life, that he send me no more letters or messages.
uz: "Uy, qolganini unga qoldiryapman." U buni yaxshi va yaxshi qilaman, deydi; lekin agar rad etsa, menga boshqa hech qachon o'zini men bo'lishim mumkin bo'lgan joyda ko'rsatmaslikni buyuradi va o'z hayotini qadrlagan holda, menga boshqa xatlar yoki xabarlar yubormasligini ko'rsatadi.

en: Then shalt thou betake thee to Rinuccio Palermini and say to him, “Madam Francesca saith that she is ready to do thine every pleasure, an thou wilt render her a great service, to wit, that tonight, towards the middle hour, thou get thee to the tomb wherein Scannadio was this morning buried and take him up softly thence and bring him to her at her house, without saying a word of aught thou mayst hear or feel.
uz: Keyin Rinukcio Palerminiga o'zingni bog'la va unga ayt: "Francheska xonim aytadiki, u sening xohishingga ko'ra hamma narsani qilishga tayyor, va sen unga katta xizmat ko'rsatasan, ya'ni bugun kechasi, yarim soatga yaqin, sen Skanadio bugun ertalab dafn etilgan qabrga borasan va uni sekin o'sha yerdan ko'tarib, uning uyiga hech narsa demasdan, eshitishing yoki his qilishing mumkin bo'lgan narsaga olib borasan."

en: There shalt thou learn what she would with him and have of her thy pleasure; but, an it please thee not to do this, she chargeth thee never more send her writ nor message.” ’ The maid betook herself to the two lovers and did her errand punctually to each, saying as it had been enjoined her; whereto each made answer that, an it pleased her, they would go, not only into a tomb, but into hell itself.
uz: U yerda u bilan nima qilishni xohlashini o'rganasan va undan rozi bo'lishing mumkin; lekin, agar senga buni qilmasliging yoqsa ham, u senga hech qachon o'z xatini yoki xabarini yuborishni buyurmaydi.  Xizmatchi ikki sevgilisiga o'zini tortib, har biriga buyurilganidek o'z vazifasini bajardi; har biri unga ma'qul bo'lganda, ular faqat qabrga emas, balki do'zaxning o'ziga ham borishini aytdi.

en: The maid carried their reply to the lady and she waited to see if they would be mad enough to do it.
uz: Xizmatchi ularning javobini xonimga olib bordi va u buni qilishga yetarlicha g'azablanganmi yoki yo'qmi, ko'rishni kutdi.

en: The night come, whenas it was the season of the ﬁrst sleep, Alessandro Chiarmontesi, having stripped himself to his doublet, went forth of his house to take Scannadio’s place in the tomb; but, by the way, there came a very frightful thought into his head and he fell a-saying in himself, ‘Good lack, what a fool I am!
uz: Kech kirdi, birinchi uyqu mavsumi bo'lganida, Alessandro Chiarmontesi o'zining qo'ltiqchog'ini yechib, uydan Scannadio'ning qabrdagi o'rnini egallash uchun chiqdi; lekin, aytgancha, uning boshiga juda dahshatli fikr keldi va u o'ziga dedi: "Yaxshi kamchilik, men qanday ahmoqman!"

en: How know I but yonder woman’s kinsfolk, having maybe perceived that I love her and be- lieving that which is not, have caused me do this, so they may slaughter me in yonder tomb?
uz: Qanday qilib bilaman, lekin o'sha ayolning qarindoshlari, balki men uni sevishimni va yo'q narsani sevishimni anglab yetgan holda, menga buni qilishga sabab bo'lishdi, shunda ular meni o'sha qabrda so'yishlari mumkin?

en: An it should happen thus, I should suffer for it nor would aught in the world be ever known thereof to their detriment.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, men buning uchun azob chekishim kerak edi va dunyoda ularning zarariga hech narsa ma'lum bo'lmas edi.

en: Or what know I but maybe some enemy of mine hath procured me this, whom she belike loveth and seeketh to oblige therein?’ Then said he, ‘But, grant that neither of these things be and that her kinsfolk are e’en for carrying me to her house, I must believe that they want not Scannadio’s body to hold it in their arms or to put it in hers; nay, it is rather to be conceived that they mean to do it some mischief, as the body of one who maybe disobliged them in somewhat aforetime.
uz: Yoki nima bilsam, balki bir dushmanim menga bu narsani olib bergan bo'lishi mumkin, u uni yaxshi ko'radi va bunga majburlamoqchi bo'lishi mumkin? Shunda u dedi: Lekin, bularning hech biri bo'lmasligi va uning qarindoshlari meni uning uyiga olib ketish uchun xursand bo'lmasligi kerak, men ishonishim kerakki, ular Skanadio jasadini o'z qo'llarida ushlab turishni yoki uni o'z joniga qo'yishni xohlashmaydi; aksincha, ular buni qandaydir yomonlik qilmoqchi deb o'ylashlari kerak, xuddi avvalroq ularni majbur qilgan odamning jasadi kabi.

en: She saith that I am not to say a word for aught that I may feel.
uz: U aytadiki, men his qilishim mumkin bo'lgan hech narsa uchun birorta so'z aytmasligim kerak.

en: But, should they put out mine eyes or draw my teeth or lop off my hands or play me any other such trick, how shall I do?
uz: Lekin, agar ular ko'zlarimni chiqarib yuborishsa, tishlarimni tortishsa, qo'llarimni kesib tashlashsa yoki menga shunga o'xshash boshqa hiyla o'ynashsa, nima qilishim kerak?

en: How could I abide quiet?
uz: Qanday qilib jim turishim mumkin edi?

en: And if I speak, they will know me and mayhap do me a mischief, or, though they do me no hurt, yet shall I have accomplished nothing, for that they will not leave me with the lady; whereupon she will say that I have
uz: Va agar gapirsam, ular meni tanishadi va menga yomonlik qilishlari mumkin, yoki, garchi ular menga hech qanday zarar yetkazmasalar ham, men hech narsaga erisha olmayman, chunki ular meni xonim bilan qoldirmaydilar; shundan so'ng u aytadi: men...

en: broken her commandment and will never do aught to pleasure me.’ So say- ing, he had well nigh returned home; but, nevertheless, his great love urged him on with counter arguments of such potency that they brought him to the tomb, which he opened and entering therein, stripped Scannadio of his clothes; then, donning them and shutting the tomb upon himself, he laid himself in the dead man’s place.
uz: Uning buyrug'ini buzdi va hech qachon menga yoqadigan hech narsa qilmaydi. Shunday qilib, u yaqin orada uyga qaytdi; ammo, shunga qaramay, uning katta muhabbati uni shunchalik qudratli dalillar bilan undadi, ular uni qabrga olib kelishdi, uni ochib, u yerga kirdi, Skannadio kiyimlarini yechdi; keyin ularni kiyib, qabrni o'ziga yopdi va o'zini o'lik odamning joyiga qo'ydi.

en: Thereupon he began to call to mind what manner of man the latter had been and remembering him of all the things whereof he had aforetime heard tell as having befallen by night, not to say in the sepulchres of the dead, but even otherwhere, his every hair began to stand on end and himseemed each moment as if Scannadio should rise up- right and butcher him then and there.
uz: Shundan so'ng u oxirgi odam qanday inson bo'lganini eslay boshladi va ilgari eshitgan barcha narsalar haqida kechasi sodir bo'lgandek eslay boshladi, hatto o'lik qabrlarda emas, balki boshqa joylarda ham, uning har bir sochlari tik turardi va u har lahzada xuddi Skannadio o'rnidan turib, uni u yerda qirib tashlagandek ko'rinardi.

en: However, aided by his ardent love, he got the better of these and the other fearful thoughts that beset him and abiding as he were the dead man, he fell to awaiting that which should betide him.
uz: Ammo, o'zining achchiq muhabbati yordamida, u bu va uni o'rab turgan va o'lik odamdek qolayotgan boshqa qo'rqinchli fikrlardan ustun keldi, u o'ziga yaqin bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsani kutishga tushdi.

en: Meanwhile, Rinuccio, midnight being now at hand, departed his house, to do that which had been enjoined him of his mistress, and as he went, he entered into many and various thoughts of the things which might possibly betide him; as, to wit, that he might fall into the hands of the police, with Scannadio’s body on his shoulders, and be doomed to the ﬁre as a sorcerer, and that he should, an the thing came to be known, incur the ill-will of his kinsfolk, and other like thoughts, whereby he was like to have been de- terred.
uz: Ayni paytda, tun yarmi yaqinlashganda, Rinukcio uyidan ketdi, xo'jayinidan unga buyurilgan ishni qilish uchun. U ketayotib, unga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalar haqida ko'plab va xilma-xil fikrlarga kirdi; xususan, u politsiya qo'liga tushishi, Skannadio jasadi yelkasida bo'lishi va sehrgar sifatida olovga mahkum bo'lishi, va u, bu narsa ma'lum bo'lishi kerak edi, qarindoshlari yovuzligiga duch kelishi va boshqa shunga o'xshash fikrlarga duch kelishi kerak edi, shu orqali u yo'q qilingan bo'lardi.

en: But after, bethinking himself again, ‘Alack,’ quoth he, ‘shall I deny this gentlewoman, whom I have so loved and love, the ﬁrst thing she re- quireth of me, especially as I am thereby to gain her favour?
uz: Ammo keyin, yana o'zini o'ylab,  Alack,  deb so'radi u,  men shunchalik sevgan va sevgan bu janob ayolni, u mendan so'raydigan birinchi narsani, ayniqsa men shu orqali uning marhamatiga erishmoqchi bo'lganim uchun, rad etamanmi?

en: God forbid, though I were certainly to die thereof, but I should set myself to do that which I have promised!’ Accordingly, he went on and presently coming to the sepulchre, opened it easily; which Alessandro hearing, abode still, albeit he was in great fear.
uz: Xudo ko'rsatmasin, garchi men bundan o'lsam ham, lekin o'zim va'da qilgan narsani qilishga qaror qilsam kerak! Shunga ko'ra, u yo'lga chiqdi va tez orada qabrga kelib, uni oson ochdi; Alessandro buni eshitib, juda qo'rqib qolgan bo'lsa ham, hali ham turardi.

en: Rinuccio, entering in and thinking to take Scannadio’s body, laid hold of Alessandro’s feet and drew him forth of the tomb; then, hoisting him on his shoulders, he made off towards the lady’s house.
uz: Rinukcio ichkariga kirib, Skanadio jasadini olishni o'ylab, Alessandro oyoqlarini ushladi va qabrdan chiqarib oldi; keyin uni yelkalariga ko'tarib, xonimning uyiga tomon yo'l oldi.

en: Going thus and taking no manner of heed to his burden, he jolted it many a time now against one corner and now another of certain benches that were beside the way, more by token that the night was so cloudy and so dark he could not see whither he went.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'z yukini hech qanday e'tiborga olmasdan, u uni yo'l chetidagi ayrim o'rindiqlarga ko'p marta, bir burchakga va yana bir burchakka urdi, ko'proq tun shunchalik bulutli va qorong'i ediki, qayerga borayotganini ko'ra olmas edi.

en: He was already well nigh at the door of the gentlewoman, who had posted herself at the window with her maid, to see if he would bring Alessandro, and was ready armed with an excuse to send them both away, when it chanced that the ofﬁcers of the watch, who were
uz: U allaqachon ayolning eshigiga yaqin edi, u o'zini xizmatkori bilan derazaga qo'yib, Alessandro olib kelishini ko'rmoqchi edi va ularni ikkalasi ham jo'natish uchun bahona bilan qurollangan edi, qachonki soat ofitserlari,

en: ambushed in the street and abode silently on the watch to lay hands upon a certain outlaw, hearing the scufﬂing that Rinuccio made with his feet, sud- denly put out a light, to see what was to do and whither to go, and rattled their targets and halberds, crying, ‘Who goeth there?’ Rinuccio, seeing this and having scant time for deliberation, let fall his burden and made off as fast as his legs would carry him; whereupon Alessandro arose in haste and made off in his turn, for all he was hampered with the dead man’s clothes, which were very long.
uz: Ko'chada qamalib, bir noqonuniy odamga qo'llarini qo'yish uchun soqchixonada jim turardi. Rinukcio oyoqlari bilan urishayotganini eshitib, nima qilish kerakligini va qayerga borish kerakligini ko'rish uchun birdan chiroq o'chirdi va nishonlari va tayoqlarini urib, "U yerga kim boryapti?" deb baqirdi. Rinukcio buni ko'rib, o'ylab ko'rish uchun kam vaqtga ega bo'lib, yukini tashladi va oyoqlari ko'targancha tezda yo'l oldi; shundan so'ng Alessandro shoshilib turdi va o'z navbatida ketdi, chunki unga o'lik odamning juda uzun kiyimlari to'sqinlik qildi.

en: The lady, by the light of the lantern put out by the police, had plainly recognized Rinuccio, with Alessandro on his shoulders, and perceiving the latter to be clad in Scannadio’s clothes, marvelled amain at the exceeding hardihood of both; but, for all her wonderment, she laughed heartily to see Alessandro cast down on the ground and to see him after take to ﬂight.
uz: Xonim politsiya tomonidan o'chirilgan chiroq nuri bilan Rinuksioning yelkasida Alessandro borligini aniq tanidi va oxirgisining Skannadio libosida ekanligini anglab, ikkovining haddan tashqari qat'iyatidan hayratda qoldi; lekin, barcha hayratlariga qaramay, Alessandro yerga tashlanganini ko'rib va uni uchib ketgandan keyin ko'rib yurakdan kuldi.

en: Then, rejoiced at this accident and praising God that He had rid her of the annoy of these twain, she turned back into the house and betook herself to her chamber, avouching to her maid that without doubt they both loved her greatly, since, as it appeared, they had done that which she had enjoined them.
uz: Keyin, bu baxtsiz hodisa tufayli xursand bo'lib, Xudo uni bu ikki kishining g'azabidan xalos qilganini maqtadi, u uyga qaytib, o'zini xonasiga olib kirdi va xizmatchisiga aytdi: shubhasiz, ikkalasi ham uni juda yaxshi ko'rishardi, chunki, ko'rinishicha, ular u buyurgan narsani qilishgan edi.

en: Meanwhile Rinuccio, woeful and cursing his ill fortune, for all that re- turned not home, but, as soon as the watch had departed the neighbourhood, he came back whereas he had dropped Alessandro and groped about, to see if he could ﬁnd him again, so he might make an end of his service; but, ﬁnding him not and concluding that the police had carried him off, he re- turned to his own house, woebegone, whilst Alessandro, unknowing what else to do, made off home on like wise, chagrined at such a misadventure and without having recognized him who had borne him thither.
uz: Ayni paytda Rinukcio, xafa bo'lib va o'z omadsizligini la'natlab, uyiga qaytmadi, lekin soat mahalladan ketishi bilanoq, u Alessandro'ni tashlab ketganidan keyin qaytib keldi va uni yana topolmasligini ko'rish uchun atrofni qamashtirdi, shunda u xizmatini tugatishi mumkin edi; lekin uni topolmay, politsiya uni olib ketganiga ishonib, u o'z uyiga qaytdi, qaytib ketdi, Alessandro esa nima qilish kerakligini bilmay, bunday baxtsiz hodisaga g'azablangan va uni u yerga olib kelgan odamni tanimagan holda uyiga qaytdi.

en: On the mor- row, Scannadio’s tomb being found open and his body not to be seen, for that Alessandro had rolled it to the bottom of the vault, all Pistoia was busy with various conjectures anent the matter, and the simpler sort concluded that he had been carried off by the devils.
uz: Keyingi qatorda, Skanadio qabri ochiq holda topildi va uning jasadi ko'rinmas edi, chunki Alessandro uni g'orning tagiga ag'dargan edi, butun Pistoniya bu borada turli xil taxminlar bilan band edi va oddiyroq turdagilar uni shaytonlar olib ketgani haqida xulosa qilishdi.

en: Nevertheless, each of the two lov- ers signiﬁed to the lady that which he had done and what had befallen and excusing himself withal for not having full accomplished her command- ment, claimed her favour and her love; but she, making believe to credit neither of this, rid herself of them with a curt response to the effect that she would never consent to do aught for them, since they had not done that which she had required of them.”
uz: Shunga qaramay, har ikki sevgilik xonimga nima qilganini va nima sodir bo'lganini ma'lum qildi va uning buyrug'ini to'liq bajarmaganligi uchun o'zini oqladi, uning marhamatini va muhabbatini talab qildi; lekin u, hech birini hisobga olmaganiga ishonib, ulardan qisqa javob bilan xalos bo'ldi, chunki u ulardan hech qachon hech narsa qilishga rozi bo'lmaydi, chunki ular ulardan talab qilgan narsani qilmagan edi.

en: THE SECOND STORY An abbess, arising in haste and in the dark to ﬁnd one of her nuns, who had been denounced to her, in bed with her lover and thinking to cover her head with her coif, donneth instead thereof the breeches of a priest who is abed with her; the which the accused nun observing and making her aware thereof, she is acquitted and hath leisure to be with her lover.
uz: IKKINCHI HIKOYA Bir abtes, shoshilinch va zulmatda turib, o'ziga aybdor qilingan rohibalaridan birini, sevgilisi bilan karavotda yotganini va uning boshini o'g'irasi bilan yopmoqchi bo'lganini topdi, buning o'rniga unga yashagan ruhoniyning ko'ylaklarini beradi; ayblanayotgan rohiba uni kuzatib va xabardor qilib, u oqlanadi va sevgilisi bilan birga bo'lishga ruxsat beradi.

en: Filomena was now silent and the lady’s address in ridding herself of those whom she chose not to love having been commended of all, whilst, on the other hand, the presumptuous hardihood of the two gallants was held of them to be not love, but madness, the queen said gaily to Elisa, “Elisa, fol- low on.” Accordingly, she promptly began, “Adroitly, indeed, dearest ladies, did Madam Francesca contrive to rid herself of her annoy, as hath been told; but a young nun, fortune aiding her, delivered herself with an apt speech from an imminent peril.
uz: Filomena endi jim edi va xonimning o'zini sevmaslikni tanlaganlardan xalos bo'lishga qaratilgan murojaatlari barcha tomonidan maqtovga sazovor edi, shu bilan birga, ikki nafratlanuvchanning kibrli qat'iyatlari ularga sevgi emas, balki aqldan ozish deb qaralgan edi, deb malika xursandchilik bilan Elisaga dedi: "Elisa, aqldan ozish." Shunga ko'ra, u tezda boshladi: "Aql bilan, haqiqatan ham, aziz xonimlar, Francheska xonim aytilganidek, o'zini g'azabdan xalos qilishga harakat qildi; lekin unga yordam bergan yosh rohiba yaqinlashib kelayotgan xavfdan o'zini mohirona nutq bilan himoya qildi."

en: As you know, there be many very dull folk, who set up for teachers and censors of others, but whom, as you may apprehend from my story, fortune bytimes deservedly putteth to shame, as befell the abbess, under whose governance was the nun of whom I have to tell.
uz: Bilasizki, ko'plab juda xunuk odamlar bor, ular boshqalarning o'qituvchilari va senzorlari bo'lishadi, lekin, mening hikoyamdan anglaganingizdek, omad vaqti-vaqti bilan haqli ravishda sharmanda qiladi, xuddi men aytishim kerak bo'lgan rohiba hukmronligi ostida bo'lgan abtes kabi.

en: You must know, then, that there was once in Lombardy a convent, very famous for sanctity and religion, wherein, amongst the other nuns who were there, was a young lady of noble birth and gifted with marvellous beauty, who was called Isabetta and who, coming one day to the grate to speak with a kinsman of hers, fell in love with a handsome young man who accompan- ied him.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, bir vaqtlar Lombardiyada muqaddaslik va din bilan juda mashhur bir monastir bor edi. U yerda u yerda bo'lgan boshqa rohibalar orasida olijanob va ajoyib go'zallikka ega bo'lgan yosh ayol bor edi. U Isabetta deb atalgan edi va bir kuni uning qarindoshi bilan gaplashish uchun stolga kelib, unga hamrohlik qiladigan chiroyli yigitga oshiq bo'lgan edi.

en: The latter, seeing her very fair and divining her wishes with his eyes, became on like wise enamoured of her, and this love they suffered a great while without fruit, to the no small unease of each.
uz: Oxirgisi, uni juda go'zal ko'rib, o'z ko'zlari bilan uning istaklarini bashorat qilib, unga dono kabi oshiq bo'lib qoldi va bu muhabbatdan bir oz vaqt davomida hech qanday meva bermasdan, har birining ozgina tashvishiga duch kelishdi.

en: At last, each being solicited by a like desire, the young man hit upon a means of coming at his nun in all secrecy, and she consenting thereto, he visited her, not once, but
uz: Nihoyat, har biri o'xshash istak bilan undalgan holda, yigit rohibining oldiga yashirincha kelish yo'lini topdi va u bunga rozi bo'lib, uni bir marta emas, balki...

en: many times, to the great contentment of both.
uz: ko'p marta, ikkalasining ham katta mamnuniyatiga.

en: But, this continuing, it chanced one night that he was, without the knowledge of himself or his mistress, seen of one of the ladies of the convent to take leave of Isabetta and go his ways.
uz: Ammo, bu davom etayotganda, bir kecha u o'zi ham, bekasi ham bilmagan holda, monastir xonimlaridan biri tomonidan Isabetta bilan xayrlashib, yo'llariga ketgani ko'rindi.

en: The nun communicated her discovery to divers others and they were minded at ﬁrst to denounce Isabetta to the abbess, who was called Madam Usimbalda and who, in the opinion of the nuns and of whosoever knew her, was a good and pious lady; but, on consideration, they bethought themselves to seek to have the abbess take her with the young man, so there might be no room for denial.
uz: Rohiba o'z kashfiyotini boshqa xilma-xillarga ham yetkazdi va ular dastlab Isabettani Madam Usimbalda deb ataladigan va rohibalarning va uni taniganlarning fikricha, yaxshi va taqvodor ayol bo'lgan abbatga ayblash niyatida edilar; lekin, o'ylab ko'rgach, ular abbatani yosh yigit bilan birga olib ketishga urinishlarini o'ylashdi, shunda rad etish uchun hech qanday joy bo'lmas edi.

en: Accordingly, they held their peace and kept watch by turns in secret to surprise her.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular sukut saqlashdi va uni hayratda qoldirish uchun yashirincha navbatma-navbat kuzatib turishdi.

en: Now it chanced that Isabetta, suspecting nothing of this nor being on her guard, caused her lover come thither one night, which was forthright known to those who were on the watch for this and who, whenas it seemed to them time, a good part of the night being spent, divided themselves into two parties, whereof one abode on guard at the door of her cell, whilst the other ran to the abbess’s chamber and knocking at the door, till she answered, said to her, ‘Up, madam; arise quickly, for we have discovered that Isabetta hath a young man in her cell.’ Now the abbess was that night in company with a priest, whom she ofttimes let come to her in a chest; but, hearing the nuns’ outcry and fearing lest, of their overhaste and eagerness, they should push open the door, she hurriedly arose and dressed herself as best she might in the dark.
uz: Endi shunday bo'ldiki, Isabetta bundan hech narsa gumon qilmay, na o'zini qo'riqlayotgani sababli, uning sevgilisi bir kecha u yerga kelishiga sabab bo'ldi. Bu haqda qo'riqlayotganlarga aniq ma'lum edi va ular uchun tunning yaxshi qismi o'tgandek tuyulganda, ular ikki guruhga bo'linishdi. Ularning biri xonasi eshigida qo'riqladi, ikkinchisi esa abbasining xonasiga yugurib, eshikni taqillatdi, toki u unga javob berdi: "Tur, tezda tur, xonim; chunki biz bilib oldikki, Isabetta uning xonasida yosh yigit bor edi." Endi abbas o'sha kechada ruhoniy bilan birga edi, uni u tezda o'ziga olib kelishi mumkin edi; lekin, rohiblar  baqirib, eshikni ochish uchun, ular o'zlarining shoshqinligi va ishtiyoqlari bilan o'tib ketishidan, u...

en: Thinking to take certain plaited veils, which nuns wear on their heads and call a psalter, she caught up by chance the priest’s breeches, and such was her haste that, without remarking what she did, she threw them over her head, in lieu of the psalter, and going forth, hurriedly locked the door after her, saying, ‘Where is this accursed one of God?’ Then, in com- pany with the others, who were so ardent and so intent upon having Isabetta taken in default that they noted not that which the abbess had on her head, she came to the cell-door and breaking it open, with the aid of the others, entered and found the two lovers abed in each other’s arms, who, all con- founded at such a surprise, abode fast, unknowing what to do.
uz: Rohibalar boshlariga taqadigan va qo'shiqchi deb ataydigan ba'zi to'qilgan pardalarni olishni o'ylab, u tasodifan ruhoniyning ko'ylaklarini ushladi va shoshilinchligi shunchalik ediki, u nima qilganini aytmasdan, qo'shiqchi o'rniga boshining ustiga uloqtirdi va tashqariga chiqib, ortidan eshikni shoshilib qulfladi, "Bu Xudoning la'nati qayerda?" dedi. Keyin, boshqalar bilan birgalikda, Isabetta boshida nima borligini sezmasliklari uchun shunchalik qizg'in va qat'iyatli bo'lganlari uchun, u xonadagi eshikga keldi va uni ochdi, boshqalarning yordami bilan, va ikki oshiqning bir-birining qo'lida yashayotganini ko'rdi.

en: The young lady was incontinent seized by the other nuns and haled off, by command of the abbess, to the chapter-house, whilst her gallant dressed himself and abode await to see what should be the issue of the adventure, resolved, if any hurt were offered to his mistress, to do a mischief to as many nuns as he could come at and carry her off.
uz: Yosh xonim boshqa rohibalar tomonidan qo'lga olinib, abbatning buyrug'i bilan bo'lim-uyga olib ketildi, uning zodagoni o'zini kiyintirib, sarguzasht masalasi nima bo'lishini ko'rishni kutadi, agar uning bekasiga biron bir zarar yetkazilsa, u yetib kelib, uni olib ketishi mumkin bo'lgan ko'p rohibalarga zarar yetkazishga qaror qildi.

en: The abbess, sitting in chapter, proceeded, in the presence of all the nuns, who had no eyes but for
uz: Abbasi, bobda o'tirgan holda, barcha rohibalarning huzurida, faqat ko'zlari bor edi.

en: the culprit, to give the latter the foulest rating that ever woman had, as hav- ing by her lewd and ﬁlthy practices (an the thing should come to be known without the walls) sullied the sanctity, the honour and the fair fame of the convent; and to this she added very grievous menaces.
uz: aybdor, ayollarning eng past bahoga ega bo'lganini berish uchun, o'zining behayo va iflos amaliyoti bilan (bu narsa devorlarsiz ma'lum bo'lishi kerak edi) monastirning muqaddasligi, sharafi va adolatli shuhratiga dog' tushirdi; va bunga juda og'ir tahdidlar qo'shdi.

en: The young lady, shamefast and fearful, as feeling herself guilty, knew not what to answer and keeping silence, possessed the other nuns with compassion for her.
uz: Yosh xonim, uyatchan va qo'rqoq, o'zini aybdor his qilgandek, nima javob berishni bilmasdi va sukut saqlardi, boshqa rohibalarga unga rahm-shafqat bilan egalik qilardi.

en: However, after a while, the abbess multiplying words, she chanced to raise her eyes and espied that which the former had on her head and the hose- points that hung down therefrom on either side; whereupon, guessing how the matter stood, she was all reassured and said, ‘Madam, God aid you, tie up your coif and after say what you will to me.’ The abbess, taking not her meaning, answered, ‘What coif, vile woman that thou art?
uz: Ammo, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, abbasi so'zlarni ko'pirtirib, ko'zlarini ko'tardi va birinchisining boshida va undan ikki tomondan osilib turgan shlang nuqtalarini kuzatdi; shundan so'ng, vaziyat qanday ekanligini taxmin qilib, u butunlay xotirjam bo'lib dedi: "Xonim, Xudo sizga yordam bersin, o'z qobig'ingizni bog'lang va keyin menga nima xohlasangiz ayting." Abbasi uning ma'nosini tushunmay, javob berdi: "Qanday qo'rqoq, jirkanch ayol ekansiz?"

en: Hast thou the face to bandy pleasantries at such a time?
uz: Bunday paytda yovuz lazzatlarga yuz beryapsizmi?

en: Thinkest thou this that thou hast done is a jesting matter?’ ‘Prithee, madam,’ answered Isabetta, ‘tie up your coif and after say what you will to me.’ Thereupon many of the nuns raised their eyes to the abbess’s head and she also, putting her hand thereto, perceived, as did the others, why Isabetta spoke thus; wherefore the abbess, becoming aware of her own default and perceiving that it was seen of all, past hope of recoverance, changed her note and proceeding to speak after a fashion altogether different from her beginning, came to the conclusion that it is impossible to withstand the pricks of the ﬂesh, wherefore she said that each should, whenas she might, privily give herself a good time, even as it had been done until that day.
uz: Sizningcha, bu siz qilgan ish hazil ishmi? Prithee, xonim, javob berdi Isabetta, koifingizni bog'lang va keyin menga nima demoqchi bo'lsangiz, shuni ayting. Shundan so'ng rohibalarning ko'pchiligi abbasining boshiga ko'zlarini ko'tardi va u ham, unga qo'lini qo'ygan holda, boshqalar kabi, nega Isabetta shunday dedi deb angladi; shuning uchun abbassa o'z nuqsonidan xabardor bo'lib, hammasi ko'rinib turganini his qilib, o'z navbatini o'zgartirdi va o'zidan butunlay farq qiladigan tarzda gapirishga kirishdi, shuning uchun u har biriga, hatto o'sha kungacha qilinganidek, o'ziga yaxshi vaqt berish kerakligini aytdi.

en: Ac- cordingly, setting the young lady free, she went back to sleep with her priest and Isabetta returned to her lover, whom many a time thereafter she let come thither, in despite of those who envied her, whilst those of the others who were loverless pushed their fortunes in secret, as best they knew.”
uz: Shunga ko'ra, yosh xonimni ozod qilib, u ruhoniysi bilan birga uxlashga qaytdi va Isabetta o'z sevgilisiga qaytdi. U ko'p vaqtdan keyin unga hasad qilganlarga qaramay, unga u yerga kelishga ruxsat berdi, qolganlarning esa sevgilisi yo'qlari esa o'z boyliklarini eng yaxshi bilganlaricha yashirib yurishdi.

en: THE THIRD STORY Master Simone, at the instance of Bruno and Buffalmacco and Nello, maketh Calandrino believe that he is with child; wherefore he giveth them capons and money for medicines and recovereth without bringing forth.
uz: UCHINCHI HIKOYA Ustoz Simon, Bruno, Buffalmacco va Nello misolida, Kalandrinoga homilador ekanligiga ishontiradi; shuning uchun u ularga qalpoq va dori-darmonlar uchun pul beradi va tug'masdan tuzalib ketadi.
