en: After Elisa had ﬁnished her story and all the ladies had returned thanks to God, who had with a happy issue delivered the young nun from the claws of her envious companions, the queen bade Filostrato follow on, and he, without awaiting further commandment, began, “Fairest ladies, the unman- nerly lout of a Marchegan judge, of whom I told you yesterday, took out of my mouth a story of Calandrino and his companions, which I was about to relate; and for that, albeit it hath been much discoursed of him and them, aught that is told of him cannot do otherwise than add to our merriment, I will e’en tell you that which I had then in mind.
uz: Elisa o'z hikoyasini tugatgach va barcha xonimlar Xudoga minnatdorchilik bilan qaytgach, u xursandchilik bilan yosh rohibalarni uning hasadgo'y hamrohlari tirnoqlaridan qutqarganidan so'ng, malika Filostratga ergashishni buyurdi va u, boshqa buyruqni kutmasdan, boshladi: "Adolatli xonimlar, kecha sizga aytgan marshgalik sudyaning shafqatsiz o'chog'i Kalandrino va uning hamrohlari haqidagi hikoyani og'zimdan chiqardi, men uni aytib bermoqchi edim; va buning uchun, garchi u va ular haqida ko'p gapirilgan bo'lsa ham, u haqida aytilgan narsa bizning xursandchiligimizga qo'shishdan boshqa narsa qilolmaydi, men o'sha paytdagi fikrimni sizga aytaman.

en: It hath already been clearly enough shown who Calandrino was and who were the others of whom I am to speak in this story, wherefore, without fur- ther preface, I shall tell you that an aunt of his chanced to die and left him two hundred crowns in small coin; whereupon he fell a-talking of wishing to buy an estate and entered into treaty with all the brokers in Florence, as if he had ten thousand gold ﬂorins to expend; but the matter still fell through, when they came to the price of the estate in question.
uz: Kalandrino kim ekanligini va bu hikoyada men gapiradigan boshqa odamlar kim ekanligi allaqachon aniq ko'rsatilgan, shuning uchun, hech qanday so'zboshimcha, sizga aytamanki, uning xolasi tasodifan o'lib, unga ikki yuz korona mayda tanga qoldirdi; shundan so'ng u mulk sotib olish haqida gapirib, Florensiyadagi barcha brokerlar bilan shunday shartnoma tuzdi, go'yo sarflash uchun o'n ming oltin floriniga ega edi; lekin masala hali ham o'tib ketdi, ular so'ralgan mulk narxiga kelganda.

en: Bruno and Buffal- macco, knowing all this, had told him once and again that he were better spend the money in making merry together with them than go buy land, as if he had had to make pellets;428 but, far from this, they had never even availed to bring him to give them once to eat.
uz: Bruno va Buffal - bularning hammasini bilgan holda, unga bir necha bor aytishgan ediki, go'yo u yer sotib olishga majbur bo'lgandek, pulni ular bilan birga xursandchilik qilishga sarflagan yaxshiroq, lekin bundan tashqari, ular uni ularga bir marta ovqat berish uchun olib kelishdan ham foydalana olishmagan.

en: One day, as they were com- plaining of this, there came up a comrade of theirs, a painter by name Nello, and they all three took counsel together how they might ﬁnd a means of greasing their gullets at Calandrino’s expense; wherefore, without more
uz: Bir kuni, ular bu haqda shikoyat qilayotganlarida, ularning o'rtoqlari keldi, Nello ismli rassom, va ular uchalasi birgalikda Kalandrino'ning hisobidan o'z o'qlarini yog'lash usulini qanday topish mumkinligi haqida maslahatlashdilar; shuning uchun,

en: delay, having agreed among themselves of that which was to do, they watched next morning for his coming forth of his house, nor had he gone far when Nello accosted him, saying, ‘Good day, Calandrino.’ Calandrino answered God give him good day and good year, and Nello, halting awhile, fell to looking him in the face; whereupon Calandrino asked him, ‘At what lookest thou?’ Quoth the painter, ‘Hath aught ailed thee this night?
uz: Kechikib, nima qilish kerakligi haqida o'zaro kelishib, ular ertalab uning uydan chiqishini kuzatishdi, Nello uni yaqinlashib, "Xayrli kun, Kalandrino" deb uzoqga bormagan edi. Kalandrino javob berdi: "Alloh unga yaxshi kun va yaxshi yil bersin", va Nello biroz to'xtab, unga yuzma-yuz qaradi; shundan so'ng Kalandrino undan so'radi: "Nimaga qarayapsan?" - rassom dedi: "Bu tun senga nima bo'ldi?"

en: Me- seemeth thou are not thyself this morning.’ Calandrino incontinent began to quake and said, ‘Alack, how so?
uz: "Men - go'yo sen bugun ertalab o'zing emassan." Kalandrino beqaror titray boshladi va dedi: "Alack, qanday qilib shunday?"

en: What deemest thou aileth me?’ ‘Egad,’ answered Nello, ‘as for that I can’t say; but thou seemest to me all changed; belike it is nothing.’ So saying, he let him pass, and Calandrino fared on, all misdoubtful, albeit he felt no whit ailing; but Buffalmacco, who was not far off, seeing him quit of Nello, made for him and saluting him, enquired if aught ailed him.
uz: "Menga nima kerak deb o'ylayapsan?" Egad,  javob berdi Nello, shuning uchun ayta olmayman; lekin sen menga hamma narsa o'zgargandek tuyulasan; go'yo hech narsa emas. Shunday deb, u uni o'tkazib yubordi va Kalandrino, hech qanday shubha bilan davom etdi, garchi u hech qanday kasallik his qilmagan bo'lsa ham; lekin uzoq bo'lmagan, uni Nellodan voz kechganini ko'rib, unga yordam bergan va salom bergan, biror narsa bo'lsa so'radi.

en: Quoth Calandrino, ‘I know not; nay, Nello told me but now that I seemed to him all changed.
uz: Kalandrino aytdi: Men bilmayman; yoq, Nello menga aytdi, lekin endi unga hamma narsa ozgargandek tuyuldi.

en: Can it be that aught aileth me?’ ‘Ay,’ re- joined Buffalmacco, ‘there must e’en be something or other amiss with thee, for thou appearest half dead.’ By this time it seemed to Calandrino that he had the fevers, when, lo, up came Bruno and the ﬁrst thing he said was, ‘Calandrino, what manner of face is this?’ Calandrino, hearing them all in the same tale, held it for cer- tain that he was in an ill way and asked them, all aghast, ‘what shall I do?’ Quoth Bruno, ‘Methinketh thou wert best return home and get thee to bed and cover thyself well and send thy water to Master Simone the doctor, who is, as thou knowest, as our very creature and will tell thee incontinent what thou must do.
uz: "Menga hech narsa kerak emasmi?"  Ha,  dedi Buffalmacco yana qoshilib,  Senda nimadir bolishi kerak, chunki sen yarim olik korinasan. Shu paytga kelib, Kalandrinoga isitma bor edi, deb tuyuldi. Shunda, mana, Bruno keldi va birinchi aytgan sozi: Crino, bu qanday yuz-korinish? Kalandrino ularning hammasini bir xil hikoyada eshitib, u yomon ahvolda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qildi va ulardan soradi, butunlay hayron bolib, Men nima qilsam ekan?  Bruno dedi: Yaxshi deb oylaysan, uyga qaytib, ozingni yopib, ustoz doktorga, ustoz Simononi yubor, u, seni juda yaxshi biladi, u bizning yaratilishimizdek, va sen nima qilishing kerakligini ayt.

en: We will go with thee and if it behoveth to do aught, we will do it.’ Accordingly, Nello having joined himself to them, they returned home with Calandrino, who betook himself, all dejected, into the bedcham- ber and said to his wife, ‘Come, cover me well, for I feel myself sore dis- ordered.’ Then, laying himself down, he despatched his water by a little maid to Master Simone, who then kept shop in the Old Market, at the sign of the Pumpkin, whilst Bruno said to his comrades, ‘Abide you here with him, whilst I go hear what the doctor saith and bring him hither, if need be.’ ‘Ay, for God’s sake, comrade mine,’ cried Calandrino, ‘go thither and bring me back word how the case standeth, for I feel I know not what within me.’ Accordingly, Bruno posted off to Master Simone and coming thither be- fore the girl who brought the water, acquainted him with the case; where- fore, the maid being come
uz: Biz sen bilan boramiz va agar biror narsa qilish kerak bo'lsa, biz buni qilamiz." Shunga ko'ra, Nello ularga qo'shilib, Calandrino bilan birga uyga qaytdilar. Calandrino o'zini xafa qilib, yotoqxonaga kirdi va xotiniga dedi: "Keling, meni yaxshilab yoping, chunki men o'zimni yomon his qilyapman." Keyin, yotgach, u o'z suvini kichik xizmatkor Simon'ga yubordi. U o'shanda Pumpkin belgisi bilan Eski Bozorda xarid qiladi, Bruno esa o'z hamkasblariga dedi: "Siz bilan shu yerda qoling, men doktorning nima deyayotganini eshitib, agar kerak bo'lsa, uni bu yerga olib keling." "Yaxshi, Xudo uchun, do'st," dedi u.

en: and the physician, having seen the water, he said to her, ‘Begone and bid Calandrino keep himself well warm, and I will
uz: va shifokor suvni ko'rib, unga dedi: Bor va Kalandrinoga o'zini yaxshilab isiting, shunda men...

en: come to him incontinent and tell him that which aileth him and what he must do.’ The maid reported this to her master nor was it long before the physician and Bruno came, whereupon the former, seating himself beside Calandrino, fell to feeling his pulse and presently, the patient’s wife being there present, he said, ‘Harkye, Calandrino, to speak to thee as a friend, there aileth thee nought but that thou art with child.’ When Calandrino heard this, he fell a-roaring for dolour and said, ‘Woe’s me!
uz: Uning oldiga tezroq kelib, unga nima bo'lishini va nima qilish kerakligini ayting." Xizmatchi bu haqda xo'jayiniga xabar berdi. Doktor va Bruno kelmasidan ko'p vaqt o'tmay, avvalgi kishi Kalandrino yonida o'tirib, o'z pulsini his qildi va shu zahotiyoq bemorning xotini u yerda bo'lganida, u dedi: "Harkye, Kalandrino, senga do'stdek gapirish uchun hech narsa yo'q, faqat sen homilador ekansan".

en: Tessa, this is thy doing, for that thou wilt still be uppermost; I told thee how it would be.’ The lady, who was a very modest person, hearing her husband speak thus, blushed all red for shamefastness and hanging her head, went out of the room, without answering a word; whilst Calandrino, pursuing his com- plaint, said, ‘Alack, wretch that I am!
uz: Tessa, bu sening ishing, chunki sen hali ham eng yuqori bo'lishing kerak; senga qanday bo'lishini aytdim." Xonim, erining bu gapini eshitib juda kamtarona odam edi, uyatdan butunlay qizarib, boshini osib, javob bermasdan xonadan chiqdi; Kalandrino esa uning shikoyatini izlab, dedi: "Lalak, men qanday bechora odamman!"

en: How shall I bring forth this child?
uz: Bu bolani qanday qilib tug'ib chiqarsam bo'ladi?

en: Whence shall he issue?
uz: U qachon chiqishi kerak?

en: I see plainly I am a dead man, through the mad lust of yonder wife of mine, whom God make as woeful as I would fain be glad!
uz: Men aniq ko'ryapmanki, men o'lik odamman, o'sha xotinimning telbalik shahvatidan, Xudo uni xursand bo'lishni xohlaganimdek qayg'uli qiladi!

en: Were I as well as I am not, I would arise and deal her so many and such buffets that I would break every bone in her body; albeit it e’en serveth me right, for that I should never have suffered her get the up- per hand; but, for certain, an I come off alive this time, she may die of de- sire ere she do it again.’ Bruno and Buffalmacco and Nello were like to burst with laughter, hear- ing Calandrino’s words; however, they contained themselves, but Doctor Simple-Simon429 laughed so immoderately that you might have drawn every tooth in his head.
uz: Agar men o'zimdagidek yaxshi bo'lganimda, unga shunchalik ko'p va shunday bufetlar tarqatardimki, uning tanasidagi har bir suyakni sindirardim; garchi bu menga to'g'ri kelsa ham, chunki men hech qachon uning qo'l bilan ko'tarilishiga yo'l qo'ymas edim; lekin, albatta, bu safar tirik bo'lsam, u yana shunday qilmasidan oldin de-sayrdan o'lishi mumkin." Bruno va Buffalmacco va Nello Calandrino'ning so'zlarini eshitib, kulgandek edilar; ammo ular o'zlarini tiyishdi, lekin Doktor Simple-Simon429 shunday nomoddiy kuldilarki, siz uning boshidagi har bir tishni tortgan bo'lardingiz.

en: Finally, Calandrino commending himself to the physician and praying him give him aid and counsel in this his strait, the latter said to him, ‘Calandrino, I will not have thee lose heart; for, praised be God, we have taken the case so betimes that, in a few days and with a little trouble, I will deliver thee thereof; but it will cost thee some little ex- pense.’ ‘Alack, doctor mine,’ cried Calandrino, ‘ay, for the love of God, do it!
uz: Nihoyat, Kalandrino o'zini shifokorga topshirib, unga bu dardida yordam va maslahat berishini so'rab, u unga dedi: "Crinoaland, men seni xafa qilmayman; chunki, Xudoga hamd bo'lsin, biz bu ishni shunchalik tez oldikki, bir necha kun ichida va biroz tashvish bilan seni undan qutqaraman; lekin bu senga ozgina ex-pensega tushadi." "Alak, mening shifokorim," deb baqirdi Kalandrino, "ey, Xudo muhabbati uchun, buni qil!"

en: I have here two hundred crowns, wherewith I was minded to buy me an estate; take them all, if need be, so I be not brought to bed; for I know not how I should do, seeing I hear women make such a terrible outcry, whereas they are about to bear child, for all they have ample commodity therefor, that methinketh, if I had that pain to suffer, I should die ere I came to the bringing forth.’ Quoth the doctor, ‘Have no fear of that; I will let make thee a certain ptisan of distilled waters, very good and pleasant to drink, which will in three mornings’ time carry off everything and leave thee sounder than a ﬁsh; but look thou be more discreet for the future and suffer not thy-
uz: Menda bu yerda ikki yuz toj bor edi, men uni menga mulk sotib olishni rejalashtirgandim; agar kerak bo'lsa, hammasini olib qo'ying, meni yotqizishmasin; chunki men qanday qilishim kerakligini bilmayman, chunki men ayollarning shunday dahshatli faryodini eshityapman, chunki ular tug'ishga tayyor, chunki ularning barchasi uchun yetarli narsa bor, agar men bu og'riqqa duch kelsam, tug'ruqqa kelgunimcha o'lishim kerak deb o'ylayman." Doktor aytdi: "Undan qo'rqma; men senga uch ertalabdan keyin hamma narsani olib ketadigan, baliqdan kamroq bo'ladigan, juda yaxshi va yoqimli bo'lgan distillangan suvdan bir qirg'och tayyorlayman; lekin sen kelajak uchun hushyor bo'l va...

en: self fall again into these follies.
uz: O'z-o'zini yana shu ahmoqliklarga tashlang.

en: Now for this water it behoveth us have three pairs of ﬁne fat capons, and for other things that are required therean- ent, do thou give one of these (thy comrades) ﬁve silver crowns, so he may buy them, and let carry everything to my shop; and tomorrow, in God’s name, I will send thee the distilled water aforesaid, whereof thou shalt pro- ceed to drink a good beakerful at a time.’ ‘Doctor mine,’ replied Calandrino, ‘I put myself in your hands’; and giving Bruno ﬁve crowns and money for three pairs of capons, he besought him to oblige him by taking the pains to buy these things.
uz: Endi bu suv uchun bizga uch juft mayda yog'li qalpoq kerak bo'ladi, va u yerda talab qilinadigan boshqa narsalar uchun ham. Ulardan biriga (o'rtoqlaringizga) beshta kumush toj berasanmi, u ularni sotib olsin va hamma narsani do'konimga olib borsin; va ertaga, Xudoning nomi bilan, senga yuqorida aytilgan distillangan suvni yuboraman, undan bir vaqtning o'zida yaxshi bir piyola ichishni to'xtatasan." Mening doktorim, javob berdi Kalandrino, Men o'zimni senga topshirdim; va u Brunoni uch juft qalpoq uchun beshta toj va pul berib, uni bu narsalarni sotib olish uchun majburladi.

en: The physician then took his leave and letting make a little clary,430 des- patched it to Calandrino, whilst Bruno, buying the capons and other things necessary for making good cheer, ate them in company with his comrades and Master Simone.
uz: Keyin shifokor ta'til oldi va ozgina klary yasashga ruxsat berdi, 430 des- uni Calandrinoga yopishtirdi, Bruno esa, yaxshi kayfiyat yaratish uchun zarur bo'lgan kepkalar va boshqa narsalarni sotib olib, ularni o'rtoqlari va Master Simone bilan birga yedi.

en: Calandrino drank of his clary three mornings, after which the doctor came to him, together with his comrades, and feeling his pulse, said to him, ‘Calandrino, thou art certainly cured; wherefore hence- forth thou mayst safely go about thine every business nor abide longer at home for this.’ Accordingly, Calandrino arose, overjoyed, and went about his occasions, mightily extolling, as often as he happened to speak with anyone, the ﬁne cure that Master Simone had wrought of him, in that he had unbegotten him with child in three days’ time, without any pain; whilst Bruno and Buffalmacco and Nello abode well pleased at having contrived with this device to overreach his niggardliness, albeit Dame Tessa, smoking the cheat, rated her husband amain thereanent.”
uz: Kalandrino o'zining klaryidan uch kun ichdi, shundan so'ng shifokor uning oldiga o'rtoqlari bilan birga keldi va uning pulsini his qilib, unga dedi: "Calandrino, sen albatta shifo topding; shuning uchun bundan buyon o'z ishingni bemalol tashlab, uyda uzoqroq qolishing mumkin." Shunga ko'ra, Kalandrino o'rnidan turdi, juda xursand bo'ldi va o'z imkoniyatlari haqida gapirdi, u har qanday odam bilan tez-tez gaplashganidek, ustoz Simoning unga bergan ajoyib davosi, uni uch kun ichida farzand bilan tug'dirganligi bilan  hech qanday og'riqsiz vaqtni o'tkazdi; Bruno va Buffalmacco va Nello esa bu qurilmadan o'z qovog'ini yengib o'tishdan xursand edilar, garchi Tessa xonim, uning erini hayratga soladi.

en: THE FOURTH STORY Cecco Fortarrigo gameth away at Buonconvento all his good and the monies of Cecco Angiolieri (his master); moreover, running after the latter, in his shirt, and avouching that he hath robbed him, he causeth him be taken of the countryfolk; then, donning Angiolieri’s clothes and mounting his palfrey, he maketh off and leaveth the other in his shirt.
uz: TO'RTINCHI HISSA Cecco Fortarrigo Buonconventoda Cecco Angiolieri (uning xo'jayini)ning barcha mol-mulkini va pulini yo'qotib qo'yadi; bundan tashqari, u oxirgisining orqasidan ko'ylagida yugurib, uni o'g'irlaganini bilib, uni qishloq odamlaridan olib ketishga majbur qiladi; so'ngra, Angiolieri kiyimlarini kiyib, o'zining palferiga o'tirib, boshqa birini ko'ylagida qoldiradi.

en: Calandrino’s speech concerning his wife had been hearkened of all the com- pany with the utmost laughter; then, Filostrato being silent, Neiﬁle, as the queen willed it, began, “Noble ladies, were it not uneather for men to show forth unto others their wit and their worth than it is for them to exhibit their folly and their vice, many would weary themselves in vain to put a bridle on their tongues; and this hath right well been made manifest to you by the folly of Calandrino, who had no call, in seeking to be made whole of the ailment in which his simplicity caused him believe, to publish the privy di- versions of his wife; and this hath brought to my mind somewhat of con- trary purport to itself, to wit, a story of how one man’s knavery got the bet- ter of another’s wit, to the grievous hurt and confusion of the overreached one, the which it pleaseth me to relate to you.
uz: Kalandrinning xotini haqidagi so'zi butun raislar tomonidan juda kulgi bilan tinglandi; keyin, Filostrato qirolicha xohlaganidek, jim bo'lib, nopoklik bilan boshladi: "Agar erkaklar o'z aql-idroklari va qadriyatlarini boshqalarga ko'rsatish uchun vaqt bo'lmasa edi, ko'pchilik o'zlarining ahmoqligi va buzuqligini ko'rsatishga majbur bo'lardi, ko'pchilik o'z tillariga jilvir qo'yish uchun behuda charchardi; va bu haq Kalandrinning aql-idrokidan sizga ma'lum bo'ldi, u o'zining soddaligi bilan ishonadigan dardni butunlay ochishga, o'z xotinining shaxsiy versiyalarini nashr etishga intiladi; va bu odamning bir qismini o'ziga qanday qilib...

en: There were, then, in Siena, not many years ago, two (as far as age went) full-grown men, each of whom was called Cecco.
uz: O'shanda, Siena shahrida, ko'p yillar oldin emas, ikki nafar yetuk erkak bor edi, ularning har biri Secco deb atalgan.

en: One was the son of Mess- er Angiolieri and the other of Messer Fortarrigo, and albeit in most other things they sorted ill of fashions one with the other, they were natheless so far of accord in one particular, to wit, that they were both hated of their fathers, that they were by reason thereof grown friends and companied of- ten together.
uz: Biri Mess-er Angiolieri o'g'li, ikkinchisi esa Mess-er Fortarrigo o'g'li edi. Ular boshqa ko'p narsalarda bir-biriga yomon munosabatda bo'lishsa-da, bir jihatida shunchalik mos kelishmagan edilar, ya'ni ikkalasi ham otalaridan nafratlangan edilar, shuning uchun ular o'n kishilik do'st va hamroh bo'lishdi.

en: After awhile, Angiolieri, who was both a handsome man and a well-mannered, himseeming he could ill live at Siena of the provision as- signed him of his father and hearing that a certain cardinal, a great patron of
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, Angiolieri, ham kelishgan odam, ham yaxshi tarbiyalangan, xuddi Siena shahrida yashashga qodir emasdek tuyulganidek, otasidan imzo chekdi va ma'lum bir kardinal, buyuk homiy haqida eshitdi.

en: his, was come into the Marches of Ancona as the Pope’s Legate, determined to betake himself to him, thinking thus to better his condition.
uz: uning, Ankonadagi marshlarga Papa Legati sifatida kelgan edi, o'zini unga qo'shib, shu tariqa uning ahvolini yaxshilashni o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, acquainting his father with his purpose, he took order with him to have at once that which he was to give him in six months, so he might clothe and horse himself and make an honourable ﬁgure.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, otasini maqsadi bilan tanishtirgach, u olti oy ichida bermoqchi bo'lgan narsasini darhol olishi kerakligini buyurdi, shunda u o'zi kiyinishi, otga minib, sharafli shaxs yaratishi mumkin edi.

en: As he went seeking someone whom he might carry with him for his service, the thing came to Fortar- rigo’s knowledge, whereupon he presently repaired to Angiolieri and be- sought him, as best he knew, to carry him with him, offering himself to be to him lackey and serving-man and all, without any wage beyond his ex- penses paid.
uz: U xizmatida o'zi bilan birga olib yuradigan odamni qidirar ekan, bu narsa Fortar-rigoning xabariga yetdi, shundan so'ng u darhol Angiolieriga qaytdi va uni o'zi bilganidek, o'zi bilan olib yurishni so'radi, o'zini unga xizmatchi va xizmatchi bo'lishga taklif qildi, hech qanday maoshsiz, uning oldindan to'langanidan tashqari.

en: Angiolieri answered that he would nowise take him, not but he knew him to be right well sufﬁcient unto every manner of service, but for that he was a gambler and bytimes a drunkard, to boot.
uz: Angiolieri javob berdi: "U uni qabul qilishni xohlamaydi, lekin u uni har qanday xizmat uchun to'g'ri yetarli ekanligini bilardi, lekin shuning uchun u qimorboz va vaqti-vaqti bilan mast bo'lgan, oyoq kiydirish uchun."

en: But the other replied that he would without fail keep himself from both of these defaults and af- ﬁrmed it unto him with oaths galore, adding so many prayers that Angiolieri was prevailed upon and said that he was content.
uz: Lekin ikkinchisi javob berdi: u bu ikki xatolikdan o'zini albatta saqlaydi va uni katta qasamlar bilan unga tasdiqladi, Angiolieri g'alaba qozonadigan va qoniqishini aytadigan ko'plab duolarni qo'shdi.

en: Accordingly, they both set out one morning and went to dine at Buoncon- vento, where, after dinner, the heat being great, Angiolieri let make ready a bed at the inn and undressing himself, with Fortarrigo’s aid, went to sleep, charging the latter call him at the stroke of none.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ikkalasi ham bir kuni ertalab yo'lga chiqib, Buoncon- ventoga ovqatlanish uchun borishdi. U yerda kechki ovqatdan so'ng, issiqlik juda kuchli bo'lgani uchun, Angiolieri mehmonxonada karavot tayyorlab, Fortarrigo yordamida yechinib, uxlashga ketdi va oxirgi uni hech narsa deb chaqirdi.

en: As soon as his master was asleep, Fortarrigo betook himself to the tavern and there, after drinking awhile, he fell to gaming with certain men, who in a trice won of him some money he had and after, the very clothes he had on his back; whereupon, desirous of retrieving himself, he repaired, in his shirt as he was, to Angio- lieri’s chamber and seeing him fast asleep, took from his purse what monies he had and returning to play, lost these as he had lost the others.
uz: Xo'jayini uxlab qolishi bilanoq, Fortarrigo o'zini tavernga olib bordi va u yerda biroz ichgandan so'ng, ba'zi odamlar bilan o'ynashga tushdi. Ular bir zumda undan pul yeyishdi va keyin, orqa tomonida turgan kiyimlarini o'zidan olishdi; shundan so'ng, o'zini qaytarib olishni istagan holda, u o'z ko'ylagini Angio-lieri xonasiga, uni uyquda ko'rib, sumkasidan bor pulini olib, o'ynashga qaytdi, qolganlarini yo'qotganidek, ularni yo'qotdi.

en: Presently, Angiolieri awoke and arising, dressed himself and enquired for Fortarrigo.
uz: Hozirda Angiolieri uyg'onib, o'rnidan turdi, kiyindi va Fortarrigo haqida so'radi.

en: The latter was not to be found and Angiolieri, concluding him to be asleep, drunken, somewhere, as was bytimes his wont, determined to leave him be and get himself another servant at Corsignano.
uz: Oxirgisi topilmadi va Angiolieri uni uyquda, mast holda, qayerdadir, odatdagidek, tashlab ketishga va Corsignano'da o'ziga yana bir xizmatkor olishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, he caused put his saddle and his valise on a palfrey he had and thinking to pay the reckon- ing, so he might get him gone, found himself without a penny; whereupon great was the outcry and all the hostelry was in an uproar, Angiolieri declar- ing that he had been robbed there and threatening to have the host and all his household carried prisoners to Siena.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u egarini va sumkasini o'zida bo'lgan palfriga qo'ydi va hisobni to'lashni o'yladi, shunda u ketishi mumkin edi, o'zini bir tiyinsiz topdi; shundan so'ng shovqin katta bo'ldi va barcha xostellar g'azablanib ketdi, Angiolieri u yerda o'g'irlanganini e'lon qildi va xostel va uning butun xonadoniga asirlarni Sienaga olib ketish bilan tahdid qildi.

en: At this moment up came Fortarrigo in his shirt, thinking to take his mas- ter’s clothes, as he had taken his money, and seeing the latter ready to mount, said, ‘What is this, Angiolieri?
uz: Ayni paytda Fortarrigo ko'ylagida o'zini ko'tardi, pulini olganidek, ustozining kiyimlarini ham olishni o'yladi. Oxirgisi o'tirishga tayyor bo'lganini ko'rib, dedi: Bu nima, Angiolieri?

en: Must we needs be gone already?
uz: Biz allaqachon ketishimiz kerakmi?

en: Good lack, wait awhile; there will be one here forthwith who hath my doublet in pawn for eight-and-thirty shillings; and I am certain that he will render it up for ﬁve-and-thirty, money down.’ As he spoke, there came one who certiﬁed Angiolieri that it was Fortarrigo who had robbed him of his monies, by showing him the sum of those which the latter had lost at play; wherefore he was sore incensed and loaded Fortarrigo with reproaches; and had he not feared others more than he feared God, he had done him a mis- chief; then, threatening to have him strung up by the neck or outlawed from Siena, he mounted to horse.
uz: Yaxshi yo'q, bir oz kuting; darhol shu yerda mening ikki barmog'im sakkizta o'ttiz shillingga sotiladigan odam bo'ladi; va men aniqman, u buni besh o'ttiz pulga to'laydi." U gapirayotganda, bir kishi Angiolieriga uning pulini Fortarrigo o'g'irlaganini tasdiqlab, oxirgi o'yinida yo'qotganlarning yig'indisini ko'rsatdi; shuning uchun u g'azablandi va Fortarrigoga ayblovlar yukladi; va agar u Xudodan qo'rqqanidan ko'ra boshqalardan qo'rqmagan bo'lsa, u unga xato qildi; keyin, uni otdan bog'lab tashlash yoki Siena'dan taqiqlash bilan tahdid qilib, u mindi.

en: Fortarrigo, as if he spoke not to him, but to an- other, said, ‘Good lack, Angiolieri, let be for the nonce this talk that skilleth not a straw, and have regard unto this; by redeeming it431 forthright, we may have it again for ﬁve-and-thirty shillings; whereas, if we tarry but till tomorrow, he will not take less than the eight-and-thirty he lent me thereon; and this favour he doth me for that I staked it after his counsel.
uz: Fortarrigo, go'yo u o'ziga emas, balki boshqa birovga gapirmagandek, dedi: "Yaxshi kamchilik, Angiolieri, bir so'z so'z bo'lsa ham, unga e'tibor beraylik; uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sotib olish orqali yana besh-u o'ttiz shillingga olishimiz mumkin; agar ertagacha qolsak, u menga bergan sakkiz-u o'ttizdan kam olmaydi; va u menga bu marhamatni o'z maslahati bilan qo'yganim uchun beradi."

en: Marry, why should we not better ourselves by these three shillings?’ Angiolieri, hearing him talk thus, lost all patience (more by token that he saw himself eyed askance by the bystanders, who manifestly believed, not that Fortarrigo had gamed away his monies, but that he had yet monies of Fortarrigo’s in hand) and said to him, ‘What have I to do with thy doublet?
uz: "Uylan, nega biz bu uch shilling bilan o'zimizni yaxshiroq his qilmaylik?" Angiolieri, uning bu gapini eshitib, sabrini yo'qotdi (aslida u o'zini atrofdagilarning ko'zlari bilan ko'rib, Fortarrigo o'z pullarini yo'qotganiga ishonmagan edi, balki Fortarrigo'ning qo'lida pullari bor edi) va unga dedi: "Men sening qo'shing bilan nima aloqam bor?"

en: Mayst thou be strung up by the neck, since not only hast thou robbed me and gambled away my money, but hinderest me to boot in my journey, and now thou makest mock of me.’ However, Fortarrigo still stood to it, as it were not spoken to him and said, ‘Ecod, why wilt thou not better me these three shillings?
uz: Sen bo'yningdan osilib qo'yilishing mumkinmi, chunki sen nafaqat meni o'g'irlagansan va pulimni qimorga o'tkazgansan, balki safarimga to'sqinlik qilyapsan, endi esa meni masxara qilyapsan." Biroq, Fortarrigo unga gapirilmaganidek turib, dedi: "Ekod, nega menga bu uch shillinni afzal ko'rmaysan?"

en: Thinkest thou I shall not be able to oblige thee therewith an- other time?
uz: Sizningcha, men bu bilan sizni boshqa safar majburlay olmaymanmi?

en: Prithee, do it, an thou have any regard for me.
uz: Ey do'st, buni qil, va sening menga hech qanday e'tiboring yo'q.

en: We shall yet reach Torrenieri betimes this evening.
uz: Biz bugun kechqurun Torrenieriga yetib boramiz.

en: Come, ﬁnd the purse; thou knowest I might ransack all Siena and not ﬁnd a doublet to suit me so well as this; and to think I should let yonder fellow have it for eight- and-thirty shillings!
uz: Keling, hamyonni toping; bilasanmi, men butun Sienani buzib, menga bunchalik mos keladigan ikki qavatli hamyon topmasligim mumkin; va o'ylashim kerakki, uni o'sha odamga sakkizta o'ttiz shillingga bersam kerak!

en: It is worth yet forty shillings or more, so that thou wouldst worsen me in two ways.’432 Angiolieri, beyond measure exasperated to see himself ﬁrst robbed and now held in parley after this fashion, made him no further answer, but, turn- ing his palfrey’s head, took the road to Torrenieri, whilst Fortarrigo, be- thinking himself of a subtle piece of knavery, proceeded to trot after him in his shirt good two miles, still requiring him of his doublet.
uz: U yana qirq shillinga yoki undan ko'proqqa arziydi, shuning uchun meni ikki yo'l bilan yomonlashtirmoqchi bo'lasiz. 432 Angiolieri, avval o'g'irlanganini ko'rib, endi shu uslubda yurib yurganini ko'rib haddan tashqari g'azablangan holda, unga boshqa javob bermadi, lekin boshini burib, Torreneriga yo'l oldi, Fortarrigo esa o'zini nozik bir qullik deb o'ylagan holda, uning orqasidan ko'ylagida ikki mil yurdi, ammo undan ikki marta tortishni talab qildi.

en: Presently, Angi- olieri pricking on amain, to rid his ears of the annoy, Fortarrigo espied some husbandmen in a ﬁeld, adjoining the highway in advance of him, and cried
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, Angi-olieri g'azabdan qutulish uchun amaynga tishladi, Fortarrigo undan oldingi yo'lga tutashgan dalada ba'zi dehqonlarni kuzatdi va yig'ladi.

en: out to them, saying, ‘Stop him, stop him!’ Accordingly, they ran up, some with spades and others with mattocks, and presenting themselves in the road before Angiolieri, concluding that he had robbed him who came crying after him in his shirt, stopped and took him.
uz: Ularga chiqib, "Uni to'xtating, to'xtating!" deyishdi. Shunga ko'ra, ular yugurib kelishdi, ba'zilari pichoqlari bilan, boshqalari esa matoklari bilan, yo'lda Angiolieriga o'zlarini ko'rsatib, u ko'ylagida yig'lab kelgan odamni o'g'irlagan deb xulosa qilishdi, to'xtashdi va uni olib ketishdi.

en: It availed him little to tell them who he was and how the case stood, and Fortarrigo, coming up, said with an angry air, ‘I know not what hindereth me from slaying thee, disloyal thief that thou wast to make off with my gear!’ Then, turning to the coun- trymen, ‘See, gentlemen,’ quoth he, ‘in what a plight he left me at the inn, having ﬁrst gamed away all his own!
uz: U ularga o'zi kim ekanligini va holat qanday ekanligini aytishga unchalik yordam bermadi, va Fortarrigo chiqib, g'azablangan havoda dedi: "Seni o'ldirishimga nima xalaqit berayotganini bilmayman, ey sadoqatsiz o'g'ri, sen mening jihozlarimni olib tashlamoqchi eding!" Keyin, qo'shnilarga o'girilgach, u dedi: "Ko'ringlar, janoblar," "u meni mehmonxonada qanday ahvolda qoldirdi, avval o'zinikilarni o'ynatib qo'ydi!"

en: I may well say by God and by you have I gotten back this much, and thereof I shall still be beholden to you.’ Angiolieri told them his own story, but his words were not heeded; nay, Fortarrigo, with the aid of the countrymen, pulled him off his palfrey and stripping him, clad himself in his clothes; then, mounting to horse, he left him in his shirt and barefoot and returned to Siena, avouching everywhere that he had won the horse and clothes of Angiolieri, whilst the latter, who had thought to go, as a rich man, to the cardinal in the Marches, returned to Buonconvento, poor and in his shirt, nor dared for shamefastness go straight back to Siena, but, some clothes being lent him, he mounted the rouncey that Fortarrigo had ridden and betook himself to his kinsfolk at Corsignano, with whom he abode till such time as he was furnished anew by his father.
uz: Men Xudo haqi bilan va siz orqali buni qaytarib oldim deb ayta olaman, va bundan hali ham sizga qarzdor bo'laman." Angiolieri ularga o'z hikoyasini aytdi, lekin uning so'zlari e'tiborga olinmadi; yo'q, Fortarrigo, vatandoshlar yordamida, uni palfriini yechib, yechib, o'z kiyimlariga kiydirdi; keyin otga minib, uni ko'ylagida va yalangoyoq qoldirib, Sienaga qaytib keldi, Angiolieri otini va kiyimlarini yutib, hamma joyda ko'rib chiqdi.

en: On this wise Fortarrigo’s knavery bafﬂed Angiolieri’s fair advisement,433 albeit his villainy was not left by the latter unpunished in due time and place.”
uz: Shu ma'noda, Fortarrigo'ning mohirligi Angiolieri'ning adolatli maslahatini hayratga soldi, 433-yil, garchi uning yovuzligi oxirgi tomonidan o'z vaqtida va joyida jazolanmagan bo'lsa ham.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Calandrino falleth in love with a wench and Bruno writeth him a talisman, wherewith when he toucheth her, she goeth with him; and his wife ﬁnding them together, there betideth him grievous trouble and annoy.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOYA Kalandrino bir kampirga oshiq bo'ladi va Bruno unga talisman yozadi. U unga tegsa, u bilan birga boradi; va uning xotini ularni birga topsa, u yerda unga qayg'uli tashvish va g'azab keladi.

en: Neiﬁle’s short story being ﬁnished and the company having passed it over without overmuch talk or laughter, the queen turned to Fiammetta and bade her follow on, to which she replied all blithely that she would well and began, “Gentlest ladies, there is, as methinketh you may know, nothing, how much soever it may have been talked thereof, but will still please, provided whoso is minded to speak of it know duly to choose the time and the place that beﬁt it.
uz: Neifile'ning qisqa hikoyasi tugadi va kompaniya uni ortiqcha gap-so'z va kulgularsiz o'tkazib yubordi. Qirolicha Fiammettaga o'girilib, unga ergashishni buyurdi. U bunga xushmuomalalik bilan javob berdi va boshladi: Janob xonimlar, siz bilishingiz mumkinki, bu haqda qancha gapirilmagan bo'lsa ham, hech narsa yo'q, lekin baribir iltimos qilaman, agar bu haqda gapirishga tayyor bo'lsangiz, unga mos vaqt va joyni tanlashni bilsangiz.

en: Wherefore, having regard to our intent in being here (for that we are here to make merry and divert ourselves and not for other- what), meseemeth that everything which may afford mirth and pleasance hath here both due place and due time; and albeit it may have been a thou- sand times discoursed thereof, it should natheless be none the less pleasing, though one speak of it as much again.
uz: Shuning uchun, bu yerda bo'lish niyatimizga ko'ra (chunki biz bu yerda o'zimizni xursand qilish va boshqa narsalarga emas, balki boshqa narsalarga jalb qilish uchun) shuni ko'rsatmoqchimanki, bu yerda xursandchilik va rohatga imkon beradigan har bir narsa o'z o'rniga va o'z vaqtida keladi; va garchi bu haqda minglab marta gapirilgan bo'lsa ham, bu unchalik yoqimsiz bo'lmasligi kerak, garchi bu haqda yana ko'p gapirilsa ham.

en: Wherefore, notwithstanding it hath been many times spoken among us of the sayings and doings of Calandrino, I will make bold, considering, as Filostrato said awhile ago, that these are all diverting, to tell you yet another story thereof, wherein were I minded to swerve from the fact, I had very well known to disguise and recount it un- der other names; but, for that, in the telling of a story, to depart from the truth of things betided detracteth greatly from the listener’s pleasure, I will e’en tell it you in its true shape, moved by the reason aforesaid.
uz: Shunday qilib, Kalandrinning so'zlari va ishlari biz orasida ko'p marta aytilganiga qaramay, Filostrato biroz oldin aytganidek, bularning barchasi chalg'ituvchi ekanligini hisobga olib, sizga bu haqda yana bir hikoya aytib beraman, unda men uni boshqa nomlardan yashirishni va aytib berishni juda yaxshi bilardim; lekin, chunki hikoyani aytib berishda, eshituvchining zavqiga katta zarar yetkazadigan narsalarning haqiqatidan chetga chiqish, men uni o'zining haqiqiy shaklida sizga aytib beraman, yuqoridagi sababdan ta'sirlangan holda.

en: Niccolo Cornacchini was a townsman of ours and a rich man and had, among his other possessions, a ﬁne estate at Camerata, whereon he let build a magniﬁcent mansion and agreed with Bruno and Buffalmacco to paint it all for him; and they, for that the work was great, joined to themselves
uz: Nikolo Kornacchini bizning shaharchimiz va boy odam edi va uning boshqa mol-mulklari qatorida Camerata shahrida ajoyib mulk bo'lgan. U yerda ajoyib saroy qurishga ruxsat bergan va Bruno va Buffalmacco bilan uning uchun hammasini chizishga kelishib olgan; va ular, ish juda katta bo'lgani uchun, o'zlariga qo'shilishdi.

en: Nello and Calandrino and fell to work.
uz: Nello va Calandrino ishga tushishdi.

en: Thither, for that there was none of the family in the house, although there were one or two chambers furnished with beds and other things needful and an old serving-woman abode there, as guardian of the place, a son of the said Niccolo, by name Filippo, being young and without a wife, was wont bytimes to bring some wench or other for his diversion and keep her there a day or two and after send her away.
uz: U yerda, shuning uchun uyning hech bir a'zosi yo'q edi, garchi bir-ikki xona yotoq va boshqa zarur narsalar bilan jihozlangan bo'lsa-da, u yerda keksa xizmatchi ayol yashardi. U yerda uning o'g'li, Filippo ismli, yosh va xotini yo'q edi, vaqti-vaqti bilan o'zining qiziqarli mashg'ulotlari uchun bir-ikki kun yoki undan keyin uni u yerda ushlab turishga odatlangan edi.

en: It chanced once, among other times, that he brought thither one called Nicco- losa, whom a lewd fellow, by name Mangione, kept at his disposal in a house at Camaldoli and let out on hire.
uz: Bir marta, boshqa vaqtlar qatorida, u yerga Nikko- losa ismli bir odamni olib kelgan, uni Mangione ismli fohisha odam Camaldolidagi uyda o'z ixtiyorida saqlab, ijaraga qo'yib yuborgan.

en: She was a woman of a ﬁne person and well clad and for her kind well enough mannered and spoken.
uz: U nozik inson ayol edi, yaxshi kiyingan va o'z mehribonligi uchun yetarlicha yaxshi xulqli va gapiradigan edi.

en: One day at noontide, she having come forth her chamber in a white petti- coat, with her hair twisted about her head, and being in act to wash her hands and face at a well that was in the courtyard of the mansion, it chanced that Calandrino came thither for water and saluted her familiarly.
uz: Bir kuni tush paytida, u oq petti-po'shtokda, sochlari boshida burilgan holda, uy hovlisida joylashgan quduqda qo'llari va yuzini yuvishga harakat qilib, xonadan chiqib kelganidan so'ng, tasodifan Kalandrino u yerga suv so'rab kelib, uni tanish tarzda salomladi.

en: She re- turned him his greeting and fell to eying him, more because he seemed to her an odd sort of fellow than for any fancy she had for him; whereupon he likewise fell a-considering her and himseeming she was handsome, he began to ﬁnd his occasions for abiding there and returned not to his com- rades with the water, but, knowing her not, dared not say aught to her.
uz: U unga salom berdi va unga ko'z tashladi, chunki u unga unga o'ziga hech qanday tasavvurga ega bo'lmaganidan ko'ra g'alati odamdek tuyulgan edi; shundan so'ng u ham uni o'ylab, uni chiroyli ko'rishga tushdi, u yerda qolish uchun imkoniyat topishni boshladi va suv bilan birga o'z sheriklariga qaytmadi, lekin uni bilmagan holda, unga hech narsa demasdi.

en: She, who had noted his looking, glanced at him from time to time, to make game of him, heaving some small matter of sighs the while; wherefore Calandrino fell suddenly over head and ears in love with her and left not the courtyard till she was recalled by Filippo into the chamber.
uz: Uning ko'rinishini payqagan u vaqti-vaqti bilan unga ko'z tashlardi, uni o'ynash uchun, shu bilan birga kichik bir ohlar bilan; shuning uchun Kalandrino to'satdan boshi va quloqlari bilan unga oshiq bo'lib qoldi va Filippo uni xonaga chaqirmaguncha hovlini tark etmadi.

en: Therewithal he returned to work, but did nought but sigh, which Bruno, who had still an eye to his do- ings, for that he took great delight in his fashions, remarking, ‘What a devil aileth thee, friend Calandrino?’ quoth he.
uz: Shundan so'ng u ishga qaytdi, lekin hech narsa demasdan ingradi, buni Bruno, hali ham o'z ishlarini ko'rib turgan edi, shuning uchun o'z modalaridan juda zavqlanib, dedi: "Senga qanday jin tegdi, do'stim Kalandrino?"

en: ‘Thou dost nought but sigh.’ ‘Comrade,’ answered Calandrino, ‘had I but someone to help me, I should fare well.’ ‘How so?’ enquired Bruno; and Calandrino replied, ‘It must not be told to any; but there is a lass down yonder, fairer than a fairy, who hath fallen so mightily in love with me that ’twould seem to thee a grave matter.
uz: Sen faqatgina ingrashdan boshqa hech narsa qilmayapsan. O'rtoq, javob berdi Kalandrino, Menga yordam beradigan boshqa odam bo'lsa, yaxshi bo'lardi. Qanday bo'lardi? so'radi Bruno; va Kalandrino javob berdi: Buni hech kimga aytish kerak emas; lekin u yerda ertakdan ham go'zalroq, menga shunchalik qattiq oshiq bo'lgan bir begona borki, sen uchun bu juda og'ir narsa bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: I noted it but now, whenas I went for the water.’ ‘Ecod,’ cried Bruno, ‘look she be not Filippo’s wife.’ Quoth Calandrino, ‘Methinketh it is she, for that he called her and she went to him in the chamber; but what of that?
uz: Men buni qayd etdim, lekin hozir, suvga borganimda. Ekod, deb baqirdi Bruno, qarang, u Filipponing xotini emas. Quoth Calandrino, U o'ylaydi, bu u, chunki u uni chaqirgan va u xonada uning oldiga borgan; lekin bundan nima?

en: In mat- ters of this kind I would jockey Christ himself, let alone Filippo; and to tell thee the truth, comrade, she pleaseth me more than I can tell thee.’ ‘Com- rade,’ answered Bruno, ‘I will spy thee out who she is, and if she be Fil- ippo’s wife, I will order thine affairs for thee in a brace of words, for she is
uz: Bunday turdagi o'yinlarda men Masihning o'zini, Filipponni qo'yib yubormaslikni xohlardim; va rostini aytsam, o'rtoq, u menga senga aytishimdan ko'ra ko'proq yoqadi. Radi, javob berdi Bruno, Men seni kimligini kuzataman, va agar u Fil-ippo'ning xotini bo'lsa, men sen uchun ishlaringni bir qator so'zlar bilan buyuraman, chunki u...

en: a great friend of mine.
uz: Mening ajoyib do'stim.

en: But how shall we do, so Buffalmacco may not know?
uz: Ammo qanday qilamiz, shunda Buffalmacco bilmasligi mumkin?

en: I can never get a word with her, but he is with me.’ Quoth Calandrino, ‘Of Buffalmacco I reck not; but we must beware of Nello, for that he is Tessa’s kinsman and would mar us everything.’ And Bruno said, ‘True.’ Now he knew very well who the wench was, for that he had seen her come and moreover Filippo had told him.
uz: Men hech qachon u bilan gaplasholmayman, lekin u men bilan. Quoth Calandrino, Buffalmacco haqida men oylamayman; lekin Nello'dan ehtiyot bolishimiz kerak, chunki u Tessa'ning qarindoshi va u bizga hamma narsani buzadi. Va Bruno dedi: Togri. Endi u kelinning kimligini juda yaxshi bilardi, chunki u uni kelganini korgan va bundan tashqari Filippo unga aytgan edi.

en: Accordingly, Calandrino having left work awhile and gone to get a sight of her, Bruno told Nello and Buffal- macco everything and they took order together in secret what they should do with him in the matter of this his enamourment.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Kalandrino bir oz vaqt ishdan chiqib, uni ko'rishga ketganidan so'ng, Bruno Nello va Buffalga hamma narsani aytdi va ular uning muhabbati masalasida u bilan nima qilishlari kerakligini yashirincha birgalikda tartibga keltirishdi.

en: When he came back, Bruno said to him softly, ‘Hast seen her?’ ‘Alack, yes,’ replied Calandrino; ‘she hath slain me.’ Quoth Bruno, ‘I must go see an it be she I suppose; and if it be so, leave me do.’ Accordingly, he went down into the courtyard and ﬁnding Filippo and Niccolosa there, told them precisely what manner of man Calandrino was and took order with them of that which each of them should do and say, so they might divert themselves with the lovesick gull and make merry over his passion.
uz: U qaytib kelganida, Bruno unga sekin dedi: Uni ko'rdingmi?  Alack, ha,  javob berdi Kalandrino;  u meni o'ldirgan.  Bruno ta'kidladi:  Men borib ko'rishim kerak, menimcha u shunday bo'lsa; agar shunday bo'lsa, meni qo'yib yuboring.  Shunga ko'ra, u hovliga tushdi va u yerda Filippo va Nikolosani topdi, ularga Kalandrino qanday odam ekanligini aniq aytdi va ularning har biri nima qilishi va aytishi kerakligini buyurdi, toki ular sevgi kasalligi bilan o'zlarini xursand qilishsin va uning ehtirosidan xursand bo'lishsin.

en: Then, returning to Calandrino, he said, ‘It is indeed she; wherefore needs must the thing be very discreetly managed, for, should Filippo get wind of it, all the water in the Arno would not wash us.
uz: Keyin, Kalandrinoga qaytib kelib, u dedi: Haqiqatan ham u; shuning uchun bu narsani juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan hal qilish kerak, chunki, Filippo bundan xabar topsa, Arnodagi barcha suv bizni yuvmaydi.

en: But what wouldst thou have me say to her on thy part, if I should chance to get speech of her?’ ‘Faith,’ answered Calandrino, ‘thou shalt tell her, to begin with, that I will her a thousand measures of that good stuff that getteth with child, and after, that I am her servant and if she would have aught.
uz: Lekin agar men u haqida gapirsam, unga nima deyishimni xohlardingiz? Iymon, javob berdi Kalandrino, sen unga avvalo, homilador bo'ladigan o'sha yaxshi narsalarning ming o'lchamini beraman, keyin esa, agar u hech narsaga ega bo'lsa, men uning xizmatkori ekanligimni ayt.

en: … Thou takest me?’ ‘Ay,’ said Bruno, ‘leave me do.’ Presently, suppertime being come, the painters left work and went down into the courtyard, where they found Filippo and Niccolosa and tarried there awhile, to oblige Calandrino.
uz: "Sen meni olasanmi?"  Ha,  dedi Bruno,  menga qoyib yubor. Hozir, kechki ovqat vaqti kelganda, rassomlar ishdan chiqib, hovliga tushishdi, u yerda Filippo va Nikkologani topishdi va bir oz vaqt qolishdi, Kalandrino'ni majburlash uchun.

en: The latter fell to ogling Niccolosa and making the oddest grimaces in the world, such and so many that a blind man would have remarked them.
uz: Oxirgisi Nikolosa'ni ko'z-ko'z qilishga va dunyodagi eng g'alati grimlar yasashga tushdi, shunchalik ko'pki, ularni ko'r odam ham sezgan bo'lardi.

en: She on her side did everything that she thought apt to inﬂame him, and Filippo, in accordance with the instructions he had of Bruno, made believe to talk with Buffalmacco and the others and to have no heed of this, whilst taking the utmost diversion in Calandrino’s fashions.
uz: U o'z tomoni bilan uni aldab yuborishga arziydigan hamma narsani qildi va Filippo, Bruno'ga bergan ko'rsatmalariga muvofiq, Buffalmacco va boshqalar bilan gaplashish va bunga e'tibor bermaslikka ishontirdi, shu bilan birga Calandrino'ning modalariga eng ko'p e'tibor qaratdi.

en: However, after a while, to the latter’s exceeding chagrin, they took their leave and as they returned to Florence, Bruno said to Calandrino, ‘I can tell thee thou makest her melt like ice in the sun.
uz: Ammo, bir oz vaqt o'tgach, oxirgilarning haddan tashqari xafaligiga ko'ra, ular ketishdi va Florensiyaga qaytayotganlarida, Bruno Kalandrinoga dedi: "Senga aytishim mumkinki, sen uni quyoshda muz kabi eritib yuborasan."

en: Cock’s body, wert thou to fetch thy rebeck and warble thereto some of those amorous ditties of thine, thou wouldst cause her cast herself out of window to come to thee.’ Quoth
uz: Xo'roz tanasi, agar sen o'z rebekingni olib kelib, u yerga o'sha ishqiy qoyalaringni solsang, uni derazadan tashlab, senga kelishiga majbur qilgansan.

en: Calandrino, ‘Deemest thou, gossip?
uz: Kalandrino, Sen g'iybat deb o'ylaysanmi?

en: Deemest thou I should do well to fetch it?’ ‘Ay, do I,’ answered Bruno; and Calandrino went on, ‘Thou wouldst not credit me this morning, whenas I told it thee; but, for certain, gossip, me- thinketh I know better than any man alive to do what I will.
uz: "Men uni olib kelishim yaxshi deb o'ylayapmanmi?" Ha, shundaymi,  javob berdi Bruno; va Kalandrino davom etdi: Senga aytganimdek, bugun ertalab menga ishonmaysan; lekin, albatta, meni g'iybat qilish  o'ylaydi, men o'zim xohlagan narsani qilishni har qanday tirik odamdan yaxshiroq bilaman.

en: Who, other than I, had known to make such a lady so quickly in love with me?
uz: Mendan boshqa kim bunday xonimni bunchalik tez sevib qolishini bilardi?

en: Not your trumpeting young braggarts,434 I warrant you, who are up and down all day long and could not make shift, in a thousand years, to get together three handsful of cherry stones.
uz: Sizning karnay chalgan yosh maqtanchoqlaringiz emas, 343 Sizga kafolat beraman, kun bo'yi yuqoriga va pastga qarab yurgan va ming yil ichida siljishga qodir bo'lmaganlar, uch qo'l cherry toshi yig'ishsin.

en: I would fain have thee see me with the rebeck; ’twould be ﬁne sport for thee.
uz: Men seni rebek bilan ko'rishingni xohlardim; sen uchun sport yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: I will have thee to understand once for all that I am no dotard, as thou deemest me, and this she hath right well perceived, she; but I will make her feel it othergates fashion, so once I get my claw into her back; by the very body of Christ, I will lead her such a dance that she will run after me, as the madwoman after her child.’ ‘Ay,’ rejoined Bruno, ‘I warrant me thou wilt rummage her; methinketh I see thee, with those teeth of thine that were made for virginal jacks,435 bite that little ver- meil mouth of hers and those her cheeks, that show like two roses, and after eat her all up.’ Calandrino, hearing this, fancied himself already at it and went singing and skipping, so overjoyed that he was like to jump out of his skin.
uz: Men seni bir bor tushunishga majbur qilamanki, men seni o'ylagandek, hech kim emasman, va bu uning haqqi edi, u buni yaxshi tushundi; lekin men uni boshqa yo'l bilan his qilishga majbur qilaman, shuning uchun men tirnog'imni uning orqa tomoniga olsam, Masihning tanasi bilan unga shunday raqsga yo'naltiramanki, u mendan orqamdan yuguradi, xuddi o'z farzandi orqasidagi telba kabi." Oh, javob berdi Bruno, menga uning ustidan o'ynashga haqqim bor; menimcha, men seni o'sha bokira qizlar uchun yasalgan tishlaring bilan ko'ryapman, 435 ta o'sha kichkina ver-kisini va uning yonoqlarini tishlayman, ular ikki gulga o'xshaydi, va keyin uni yeydi. Kalandrino buni eshitib, o'zini allaqachon o'ylab qo'ydi va o'zini tashladi va sakradi va xursand bo'ldi, shuning uchun u og'zidan chiqib ketdi.

en: On the morrow, having brought the rebeck, he, to the great diversion of all the company, sang sundry songs thereto; and in brief, he was taken with such an itch for the frequent seeing of her that he wrought not a whit, but ran a thousand times a day, now to the window, now to the door and anon into the courtyard, to get a look at her, whereof she, adroitly carrying out Bruno’s instructions, afforded him ample occasion.
uz: Ertasi kuni Rebekni olib kelib, u butun jamoaning katta chalg'ishiga qarab, unga turli xil qo'shiq kuyladi; va qisqacha aytganda, uni tez-tez ko'rish unga shunchalik ishtiyoq baxsh etardi, hatto kuniga ming marta yugurardi, endi derazadan, endi eshikdan va keyin hovliga, unga bir nazar tashlash uchun, u esa Brunoning ko'rsatmalarini mohirona bajargan holda, unga yetarli imkoniyat yaratdi.

en: Bruno, on his side, answered his messages in her name and bytimes brought him others as from her; and whenas she was not there, which was mostly the case, he carried him letters from her, wherein she gave him great hopes of compassing his desire, feign- ing herself at home with her kinsfolk, where he might not presently see her.
uz: Bruno, o'z tomoni bilan, uning xabarlariga uning nomidan javob berdi va vaqti-vaqti bilan unga o'zidan kelganidek boshqa xabarlarni olib keldi; va u u yerda bo'lmaganda, bu ko'pincha shunday edi, u undan xatlar olib yurdi, unda u unga o'z xohishlarini amalga oshirishga katta umidlar berdi, o'zini qarindoshlari bilan uyda ko'rsatdi, u yerda uni ko'rmasligi mumkin edi.

en: On this wise, Bruno, with the aid of Buffalmacco, who had a hand in the matter, kept the game afoot and had the greatest sport in the world with Calandrino’s antics, causing him give them bytimes, as at his mistress’s re- quest, now an ivory comb, now a purse and anon a knife and suchlike toys, for which they brought him in return divers paltry counterfeit rings of no value, with which he was vastly delighted; and to boot, they had of him, for their pains, store of dainty collations and other small matters of entertain- ment, so they might be diligent about his affairs.
uz: Shu yoʻl bilan, Bruno, bu masalada qoʻli bor Buffalmacco yordamida, oʻyinni davom ettirdi va Calandrino hiylalari bilan dunyodagi eng zoʻr sport turini oʻynadi. Shuning uchun u ularga, xoʻjayinasining qayta qidiruvida boʻlgani kabi, vaqti-vaqti bilan, endi fil suyagi, endi hamyon va yana pichoq va shunga oʻxshash oʻyinchoqlarni berdi. Ular unga qimmatga arzimaydigan turli xil soxta halqalarni olib kelishdi, ular uni juda xursand qilishardi; va boshida esa, ular uning ishlarida gʻamxoʻrlik qilishlari uchun, nozik boʻyinchoqlar va boshqa kichik narsalarni saqlashlari mumkin edi.

en: On this wise they kept him in play good two months, without getting a step farther, at the end of which time, seeing the work draw to an end and bethinking himself that, an he brought not his amours to an issue in the meantime, he might never have another chance thereof, he began to urge and importune Bruno amain; wherefore, when next the girl came to the mansion, Bruno, having ﬁrst taken order with her and Filippo of what was to be done, said to Calandrino, ‘Harkye, gossip, yonder lady hath promised me a good thousand times to do that which thou wouldst have and yet doth nought thereof, and meseemeth she leadeth thee by the nose; wherefore, since she doth it not as she promiseth, we will an it like thee, make her do it, will she, nill she.’ ‘Ecod, ay!’ answered Calandrino.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular uni bir qadam ham uzoqlashmasdan, yaxshilab ikki oy davomida o'ynashda ushlab turishdi. Vaqti oxirida, ish yakunlanayotganini ko'rib, o'zini shunday deb o'yladi: "U o'z sevgilisini shu vaqt ichida muammoga olib kelmagan bo'lsa, boshqa hech qachon bunday imkoniyatga ega bo'lmasligi mumkin", deb o'yladi. Shuning uchun, qiz uyga kelganda, Bruno o'zi va Filippo bilan nima qilish kerakligini avval buyurib, Kalandrinoga dedi: "Harkye, g'iybat, u xonim menga ming marta yaxshi va'da bergan, sen xohlagan narsani qilish uchun, lekin hali ham bundan hech narsa yo'q, va u seni burningizdan olib ketadi; shuning uchun, u va'da aytganidek, biz senga shunday qilamiz, u shunday qiladi,"  u javob berdi.

en: ‘For the love of God let it be done speedily.’ Quoth Bruno, ‘Will thy heart serve thee to touch her with a script I shall give thee?’ ‘Ay, sure,’ replied Calandrino; and the other, ‘Then do thou make shift to bring me a piece of virgin parchment and a live bat, together with three grains of frankincense and a candle that hath been blessed by the priest, and leave me do.’ Accordingly, Calandrino lay in wait all the next night with his engines to catch a bat and having at last taken one, carried it to Bruno, with the other things required; whereupon the lat- ter, withdrawing to a chamber, scribbled divers toys of his fashion upon the parchment, in characters of his own devising, and brought it to him, saying, ‘Know, Calandrino, that, if thou touch her with this script, she will incontin- ent follow thee and do what thou wilt.
uz: Xudo muhabbati uchun shoshilinch bo'lsin. Bruno aytdi: Ko'ngling senga men senga beradigan yozuv bilan unga tegishga xizmat qiladimi? Ha, albatta,  javob berdi Kalandrino; va ikkinchisi: Keyin menga bir bo'lak bokira parchama va tirik ko'rshapalak olib kel, uch dona xushbo'y tutatqi va ruhoniy tomonidan duo qilingan sham bilan birga, meni qo'yib yubor. Shunga ko'ra, Kalandrino butun kecha mashinasi bilan birga yotib, bir ko'rshapalakni ushladi va oxir-oqibat birini olib, uni Brunoga olib bordi, boshqa talablar bilan birga; shundan so'ng, u xonadan chiqib, o'zi o'ylab topgan turli xil qog'oz o'yinchoqlariga yozib qo'ydi, va uni o'zi yasagan holda, Kandalino, agar u senga bu yozuvni olib kelsa,

en: Wherefore, if Filippo should go abroad anywhither today, do thou contrive to accost her on some pretext or other and touch her; then betake thyself to the barn yonder, which is the best place here for thy purpose, for that no one ever frequenteth there.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar Filippo bugun biror yerga chet elga borsa, unga qandaydir bahona bilan yaqinlashishga va unga tegishga harakat qil; keyin o'zingni u yerdagi omborxonaga qo'y, bu sen uchun eng yaxshi joy, chunki u yerga hech kim tez-tez bormaydi.

en: Thou wilt ﬁnd she will come thither, and when she is there, thou knowest well what thou hast to do.’ Calandrino was the joyfullest man alive and took the script, saying, ‘Gossip, leave me do.’ Now Nello, whom Calandrino mistrusted, had as much diversion of the matter as the others and bore a hand with them in making sport of him: wherefore, of accord with Bruno, he betook himself to Florence to Calandrino’s wife and said to her, ‘Tessa, thou knowest what a beating Calandrino gave thee without cause the day he came back, laden with stones from the Mugnone; wherefore I mean to have thee avenge thyself on him; and if thou do it not, hold me no more for kinsman or for friend.
uz: U yerda bo'lishini topasiz, u yerda bo'lganda, nima qilish kerakligini yaxshi bilasiz." Kalandrino tirikdagi eng quvnoq odam edi va yozuvni oldi, "Gossip, meni qo'yib yubor" dedi. Endi Nello, unga Kalandrino ishonchsiz bo'lgan, boshqalarga o'xshab ishdan chalg'igan va unga o'ynashda ularning qo'lini cho'zgan edi: shuning uchun, Bruno bilan kelishgan holda, u Florensiyaga Kalandrino'ning xotiniga murojaat qildi va unga dedi: "Tessa, sen bilasan, Kalandrino senga qaytib kelgan kuni bejizga, Mugnondan toshlar bilan to'ldirilgan holda qanday kaltak bergan edi; shuning uchun men seni o'ziga qasos olishni xohlayman; va agar sen buni qilmasang, meni endi qarindosh yoki do'st deb hisoblama.

en: He hath fallen in love with a woman over yonder, and she is lewd enough to go very often closeting herself with him.
uz: U u yerda bir ayolga oshiq bo'lib qolgan, va u juda ko'p marta u bilan yaqinlashadigan darajada behayo.

en: A little while agone, they appointed
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, ular tayinladilar.

en: each other to foregather together this very day; wherefore I would have thee come thither and lie in wait for him and chastise him well.’ When the lady heard this, it seemed to her no jesting matter, but, starting to her feet, she fell a-saying, ‘Alack, common thief that thou art, is it thus that thou usest me?
uz: Bir-birimizni aynan shu kuni oldindan yig'ishtirish uchun; shuning uchun men seni u yerga kelib, uni kutishni va yaxshilab jazolashni xohlardim." Buni eshitgan xonim, bu unga hech qanday hazil emasdek tuyuldi, lekin oyoqlariga turib dedi: "Alak, oddiy o'g'ri, sen meni shunday ishlatyapsanmi?"

en: By Christ His Cross, it shall not pass thus, but I will pay thee therefor!’ Then, taking her mantle and a little maid to bear her company, she started off at a good round pace for the mansion, together with Nello.
uz: Iso Masihning xochidan qasam ichib, bu shunday bo'lmaydi, lekin men senga buning uchun to'layman! Keyin, uning ko'ylagi va uning hamrohini ko'tarib, u Nello bilan birga saroyga yaxshi qadam tashladi.

en: As soon as Bruno saw the latter afar off, he said to Filippo, ‘Here cometh our friend’; whereupon the latter, betaking himself whereas Calandrino and the others were at work, said, ‘Masters, needs must I go presently to Florence; work with a will.’ Then, going away, he hid himself in a place when he could, without being seen, see what Calandrino should do.
uz: Brunu oxirgisini uzoqda ko'rishi bilanoq, Filippoga dedi: Mana, do'stimiz kelyapti; shundan so'ng, oxirgisining o'zi Calandrino va boshqalar ishda bo'lganida, dedi: Ustozlar, men hozir Florensiyaga borishim kerak; vasiyat bilan ishlasam kerak. Keyin, ketib, u o'zini ko'rinmasdan, Calandrino nima qilishi kerakligini ko'ra oladigan joyga yashirdi.

en: The lat- ter, as soon as he deemed Filippo somewhat removed, came down into the courtyard and ﬁnding Niccolosa there alone, entered into talk with her, whilst she, who knew well enough what she had to do, drew near him and entreated him somewhat more familiarly than of wont.
uz: Doktor, Filippo biroz uzoqlashganini sezishi bilanoq, hovliga tushdi va u yerda yolg'iz Niccolosani topdi, u bilan gaplashishga kirishdi, u esa nima qilish kerakligini yaxshi bilgan holda, unga yaqinlashdi va odatdagidan ko'ra biroz yaqinroq yolvordi.

en: Thereupon he touched her with the script and no sooner had he done so than he turned, without saying a word, and made for the barn, whither she followed him.
uz: Shundan so'ng u unga yozuv bilan tegdi va u buni qilmasdanoq, hech narsa demasdan o'girilib, omborxonaga yo'l oldi, u esa unga ergashdi.

en: As soon as she was within, she shut the door and taking him in her arms, threw him down on the straw that was on the ﬂoor; then, mounting astride of him and holding him with her hands on his shoulders, without letting him draw near her face, she gazed at him, as he were her utmost desire, and said, ‘O sweet my Calandrino, heart of my body, my soul, my treasure, my com- fort, how long have I desired to have thee and to be able to hold thee at my wish!
uz: U ichkariga kirishi bilanoq, eshikni yopdi va uni quchog'iga oldi, uni poldagi somonga tashladi; so'ngra, uning ustiga minib, uni yelkasiga qo'llari bilan ushladi, uning yuziga yaqinlashishiga yo'l qo'ymasdan, unga o'zining eng katta orzusi kabi tikilib dedi: "Ey shirin Kalandrino, tanam yuragi, jonim, xazinam, qudratim, seni qancha vaqtdan beri xohladim va seni o'z xohishimga ko'ra ushlab turishga qodir bo'ldim!"

en: Thou hast drawn all the thread out of my shift with thy gentilesse; thou hast tickled my heart with thy rebeck.
uz: Sen o'z begonaliging bilan mening ish turimdan butun ipni tortding; sen o'z rebeking bilan yuragimni qitiqlading.

en: Can it be true that I hold thee?’ Calandrino, who could scarce stir, said, ‘For God’s sake, sweet my soul, let me buss thee.’ ‘Marry,’ answered she, ‘thou art in a mighty hurry.
uz: "Seni ushlaganim rost bo'lishi mumkinmi?" Kalandrino, deyarli harakatlana olmagan holda, dedi: "Xudo haqqi, jonim shirin, senga urib yuboray." "Uylan," dedi u, "sen juda shoshilyapsan."

en: Let me ﬁrst take my ﬁll of looking upon thee; let me sat mine eyes with that sweet face of thine.’ Now Bruno and Buffalmacco were come to join Filippo and all three heard and saw all this.
uz: Avval senga qarab to'yinsam mayli; o'sha shirin yuzing bilan ko'zlarimga o'tirsam mayli. Endi Bruno va Buffalmacco Filippoga qo'shilish uchun kelishdi va uchalasi ham bularning hammasini eshitib ko'rishdi.

en: As Calandrino was now offering to kiss Niccolosa perforce, up came Nello with Dame Tessa and said, as soon as he reached the place, ‘I vow to God they are together.’ Then, coming up to the door of the barn, the lady, who was all a-fume with rage, dealt it such a push with her hands that she sent it ﬂying, and entering, saw Niccolosa astride of Calandrino.
uz: Kalandrino endi Nikolosani kuchli o'pmoqchi bo'lganida, Nello dam Tessa bilan birga keldi va u yerga yetib borishi bilanoq dedi: "Men Xudoga qasam ichamanki, ular birga." Keyin, omborning eshigiga yetib borgach, g'azabdan butunlay tutun chiqqan xonim uni qo'llari bilan shunday itarib yubordi, u uni uchib yubordi va kirayotganda Nikolosaning Kalandrino ustida ekanligini ko'rdi.

en: The former, seeing the lady, started up in haste and taking to
uz: So'nggi, xonimni ko'rib, shoshilinch ravishda o'rnidan turdi va...

en: ﬂight, made off to join Filippo, whilst Dame Tessa fell tooth and nail upon Calandrino, who was still on his back, and clawed all his face; then, clutch- ing him by the hair and haling him hither and thither, ‘Thou sorry shitten cur,’ quoth she, ‘dost thou then use me thus?
uz: Uchilib, Filippoga qo'shilish uchun yo'lga tushdi, dam Tessa esa Calandrinoga tish va mix tushdi, u hali ham orqa tomonda edi va butun yuzini tirnadi; so'ngra, uni sochidan ushladi va u yerda-bu yerda qondirdi, "Senga achinadi, axloqsiz," dedi u, "shunday qilib meni ishlatyapsanmi?"

en: Besotted dotard that thou art, accursed be the weal I have willed thee!
uz: Qamalgan do'st ekanliging, seni xohlagan baxtimga la'nat bo'lsin!

en: Marry, seemeth it to thee thou hast not enough to do at home, that thou must go wantoning it in other folk’s preserves?
uz: Turmush qur, uyda qiladigan ishlaring yetarli emasdek tuyuladimi, uni boshqa odamlarning qo'llariga tashlab ketishing kerakmi?

en: A ﬁne gallant, i’faith!
uz: Ajoyib gallant, ifaith!

en: Dost thou not know thyself, losel that thou art?
uz: O'zingni bilmaysanmi, o'zing ekanligini yo'qotdingmi?

en: Dost thou not know thyself, good for nought?
uz: O'zingni bilmaysanmi, hech narsaga yaramaysanmi?

en: Wert thou to be squeezed dry, there would not come as much juice from thee as might sufﬁce for a sauce.
uz: Quruq siqilishga arziydigan bo'lsang, sendan sous uchun yetarli miqdorda sharbat kelmas edi.

en: Cock’s faith, thou canst not say it was Tessa that was presently in act to get thee with child, God make her sorry, who ever she is, for a scurvy trull as she must be to have a mind to so ﬁne a jewel as thou!’ Calandrino, seeing his wife come, abode neither dead nor alive and had not the hardihood to make any defence against her; but, rising, all scratched and ﬂayed and bafﬂed as he was, and picking up his bonnet, he fell to humbly beseeching her leave crying out, an she would not have him cut in pieces, for that she who had been with him was the wife of the master of the house; whereupon quoth she, ‘So be it, God give her an ill year.’ At this mo- ment, Bruno and Buffalmacco, having laughed their ﬁll at all this, in com- pany with Filippo and Niccolosa, came up, feigning to be attracted by the clamour, and having with no little ado appeased the lady, counselled Calandrino betake himself
uz: Xo'rozning e'tiqodi, seni farzandlikka olish uchun hozir harakat qilayotgan Tessa edi, deb ayta olmaysan, Xudo uni kim bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, xuddi senga o'xshagan javohirni maydalashga aqli yetganidek, xuddi xuddi o'sha kabi bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan mayda trull uchun afsusda tutadi! Calandrino xotini kelganini ko'rib, na o'lik, na tirik edi va unga qarshi hech qanday himoya qilishga jur'at eta olmadi; lekin, o'rnidan turib, hamma narsani tirnadi va o'ynadi, va u o'z qalpoqidan olib, uni xotirjamlik bilan yig'lab yuborishni iltimos qildi, chunki u bilan birga bo'lgan ayol uy xo'jayining xotini edi; shundan so'ng u: "Xudo unga bir yil kasallik bersin", dedi.

en: to Florence and return thither no more, lest Fil- ippo should get wind of the matter and do him a mischief.
uz: Florensiyaga bor va u yerga qaytib kelma, Fil-ippo bu ishdan xabar topib, unga zarar yetkazmasligi uchun.

en: Accordingly he returned to Florence, chapfallen and woebegone, all ﬂayed and scratched, and never ventured to go thither again; but, being plagued and harassed night and day with his wife’s reproaches, he made an end of his fervent love, having given much cause for laughter to his companions, no less than to Niccolosa and Filippo.”
uz: Shunga ko'ra u Florensiyaga qaytib keldi, cho'kib ketgan va yig'lab ketgan edi, hammasi g'ijirlagan va tirnalgan holda, va u yerga boshqa borishga jur'at etmadi; lekin xotinining tanbehlari bilan tun va kunduz qiynalgan va bezovta qilingan holda, u o'zining qizg'in muhabbatiga chek qo'ydi va o'z hamrohlariga, hech bo'lmaganda Nikoloza va Filippoga ham ko'p kulgi keltirdi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY Two young gentlemen lodge the night with an innkeeper, whereof one goeth to lie with the host’s daughter, whilst his wife unwittingly coucheth with the other; after which he who lay with the girl getteth him to bed with her father and telleth him all, thinking to bespeak his comrade.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Ikki yosh janob mehmonxona bekasi bilan tunadi, ulardan biri mehmonning qizi bilan yotadi, xotini esa bilmasdan ikkinchisi bilan yotadi; shundan so'ng qiz bilan yotgan odam uni otasi bilan yotqizib, o'rtoqidan xabar so'rashni o'ylab, hamma narsani aylantiradi.

en: Therewithal they come to words, but the wife, perceiving her mistake, entereth her daughter’s bed and thence with certain words appeaseth everything.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular gapga kelishadi, lekin xotin xatosini anglab, qizining karovatiga kiradi va u yerdan ba'zi so'zlar bilan hamma narsani tinchlantiradi.

en: Calandrino, who had otherwhiles afforded the company matter for laughter, made them laugh this time also, and whenas the ladies had left devising of his fashions, the queen bade Pamﬁlo tell, whereupon quoth he, “Laudable ladies, the name of Niccolosa, Calandrino’s mistress, hath brought me back to mind a story of another Niccolosa, which it pleaseth me to tell you, for that therein you shall see how a goodwife’s ready wit did away a great scandal.
uz: Kalandrino, u boshqa ayollar ham bu safar kulguga sababchi bo'lgan edi, ularni bu safar ham kuldirdi. Xotinlar uning modalarini o'ylab topishni tugatgach, malika Pamfilo aytdi va u shunday dedi: "Ajoyib xonimlar, Kalandrino bekasi Nikoloza ismli ayol menga boshqa Nikolozaning bir hikoyasini eslatdi, uni sizga aytib berish menga yoqadi, chunki unda siz kelinning qanday qilib katta janjalni yo'qotganini ko'rasiz."

en: In the plain of Mugnone there was not long since a good man who gave wayfarers to eat and drink for their money, and although he was poor and had but a small house, he bytimes at a pinch gave, not every one, but sundry acquaintances, a night’s lodging.
uz: Mugnone tekisligida yaqinda yo'lovchilarga o'z pullari evaziga ovqat va ichimlik beradigan yaxshi bir odam bor edi. Garchi u kambag'al va kichik uyga ega bo'lsa ham, vaqti-vaqti bilan har bir kishiga emas, balki turli tanishuvlarga bir kechaga turar joy berardi.

en: He had a wife, a very handsome woman, by whom he had two children, whereof one was a ﬁne buxom lass of some ﬁfteen or sixteen years of age, who was not yet married, and the other a little child, not yet a year old, whom his mother herself suckled.
uz: Uning juda chiroyli xotini bor edi, u bilan ikki farzand ko'rgan edi, ulardan biri hali turmushga chiqmagan, o'n besh yoki o'n olti yoshlardagi chiroyli buxom qiz edi, ikkinchisi esa onasining o'zi emizgan bir yoshga to'lmagan kichkina bola edi.

en: Now a young gentleman of our city, a sprightly and pleasant youth, who was often in those parts, had cast his eyes on the girl and loved her ardently; and she, who gloried greatly in being beloved of a youth of his quality, whilst study- ing with pleasing fashions to maintain him in her love, became no less en- amoured of him, and more than once, by mutual accord, this their love had had the desired effect, but that Pinuccio (for such was the young man’s
uz: Endi bizning shahrimizning bir yosh janobsi, o'sha joylarda tez-tez bo'lgan yorqin va yoqimli yosh yigit qizga ko'z tikib, uni juda yaxshi ko'rardi; va u, o'ziga xos yoshning sevimli ekanligi bilan juda faxrlanar edi, uni o'z muhabbatida ushlab turish uchun yoqimli modalar bilan o'qigan holda, unga unchalik ham oshiq bo'lmadi va bir necha bor, o'zaro kelishuvga ko'ra, bu ularning muhabbati kerakli natijaga erishdi, lekin bu Pinuccio (uning uchun yigit

en: name) feared to bring reproach upon his mistress and himself.
uz: ism) xo'jayiniga va o'ziga tuhmat keltirishdan qo'rqardi.

en: However, his ardour waxing from day to day, he could no longer master his desire to fore- gather with her and bethought himself to ﬁnd a means of harbouring with her father, doubting not, from his acquaintance with the ordinance of the latter’s house, but he might in that event contrive to pass the night in her company, without any being the wiser; and no sooner had he conceived this design than he proceeded without delay to carry it into execution.
uz: Ammo, kun sayin uning ishtiyoqi kuchayib borar ekan, u endi u bilan oldindan uchrashish istagiga ega bo'la olmadi va otasi bilan bir yo'l topishni o'yladi, shubhalanmasdan, otasining uyining tartibi bilan tanish bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin u o'sha holda hech kim dono bo'lmasdan, uning huzurida tunashni o'ylab topishi mumkin edi; va u bu niyatni o'ylab topgandan so'ng, uni amalga oshirishga shoshilinch harakat qildi.

en: Accordingly, in company with a trusty friend of his called Adriano, who knew his love, he late one evening hired a couple of hackneys and set there- on two pairs of saddlebags, ﬁlled belike with straw, with which they set out from Florence and fetching a compass, rode till they came overagainst the plain of Mugnone, it being by this night; then, turning about, as they were on their way back from Romagna, they made for the good man’s house and knocked at the door.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'zining sodiq do'sti Adriano bilan birga, uning muhabbatini biladigan holda, u bir kechqurun bir nechta xakni yolladi va u yerda o'tirdi - Florensiyadan chiqib, Mugnone tekisligiga yetib borguncha, shu kechaga kelib, to'plangan somon bilan to'ldirilgan ikki juft egar sumkasiga; keyin, aylanib, Romaniyadan qaytayotganlarida, yaxshi odamning uyiga kelishdi va eshikni taqillatdilar.

en: The host, being very familiar with both of them, promptly opened the door and Pinuccio said to him, ‘Look you, thou must needs harbour us this night.
uz: Ularning ikkalasi bilan ham juda tanish bo'lgan mehmon darhol eshikni ochdi va Pinutsiyo unga dedi: Mana, bugun kechqurun bizga joy kerak bo'ladi.

en: We thought to reach Florence before dark, but have not availed to make such haste but that we ﬁnd ourselves here, as thou seest at this hour.’ ‘Pinuccio,’ answered the host, ‘thou well knowest how little commodity I have to lodge such men as you are; however, since the night hath e’en overtaken you here and there is no time for you to go other- where, I will gladly harbour you as I may.’ The two young men accordingly alighted and entered the inn, where they ﬁrst eased436 their hackneys and after supper with the host, having taken good care to bring provision with them.
uz: Biz Florensiyaga qorong'u bo'lishdan oldin yetib borishni o'ylagandik, lekin bunday shoshilishga muvaffaq bo'lmadik, faqat shu soatda o'zimizni shu yerda topamiz, xuddi shu soatda ko'rayotganingizdek. Pinuccio, javob berdi xost, Siz yaxshi bilasiz, men siz kabi odamlarni joylashtirish uchun juda kam narsa kerak; ammo, tun sizni bu yerga yetib borgani va boshqa joyga borishga vaqtingiz bo'lmagani uchun, men sizni iloji boricha xursandchilik bilan kutib olaman. Ikki yigit shunga ko'ra tushdilar va mehmonxonaga kirdilar, u yerda avval o'zlarining uylarini yengillashtirdilar va kechki ovqatdan keyin xost bilan birga ovqatlanish uchun yaxshi g'amxo'amxo'rlik qilishdi.

en: Now the good man had but one very small bedchamber, wherein were three pallet-beds set as best he knew, two at one end of the room and the third overagainst them at the other end; nor for all that was there so much space left that one could go there otherwise than straitly.
uz: Yaxshi odamning faqat bitta juda kichik yotoqxonasi bor edi, unda u bilganidek uchta pallet-krovat o'rnatilgan edi, ikkitasi xonaning bir uchida, uchinchisi esa ularning narigi uchida; shuningdek, u yerda shunchalik ko'p joy qolmagan ediki, u yerga torroqdan boshqa yo'l bilan borish mumkin edi.

en: The least ill of the three the host let make ready for the two friends and put them to lie there; then, after a while neither of the gentlemen being asleep, though both made a show thereof, he caused his daughter betake herself to bed in one of the two others and lay down himself in the third, with his wife, who set by the bedside the cradle wherein she had her little son.
uz: Uchta kishidan eng kam yomoni, mehmon ikki do'stini tayyorlab, ularni u yerga yotqizdi; keyin, biroz vaqt o'tgach, hech bir janob uxlamadi, garchi ikkalasi ham buni ko'rsatib ko'rsatgan bo'lsa ham, u qizini boshqa ikki kishidan birida yotishga buyurdi va uchinchisida o'zini yotqizdi, xotini esa uning kichkina o'g'li bor beshik yonida o'rnatdi.

en: Things being ordered after this fashion and Pinuccio having seen everything, after a while, himseeming that everyone was asleep, he arose softly and going to the bed where slept the girl beloved of him, laid himself beside the latter, by whom, for all she did it timorously, he was joyfully received, and with her he proceeded to
uz: Bu uslubdan so'ng tartibga solingan narsalar va Pinukcio hamma narsani ko'rib, birozdan so'ng, hamma uxlagandek tuyulgach, u sekin turdi va sevimli qiz uxlagan karavotga bordi, o'zini oxirgisi yonida yotqizib qo'ydi, u tomonidan, u bu ishlarning barchasini qo'rqinchli tarzda qilganligi uchun, u xursandchilik bilan kutib olindi va u bilan birga davom etdi.

en: take of that pleasure which both most desired.
uz: Ikkalasi ham eng ko'p xohlagan lazzatdan bahramand bo'ling.

en: Whilst Pinuccio abode thus with his mistress, it chanced that a cat caused certain things fall, which the good wife, awaking, heard; whereupon, fearing lest it were otherwhat, she arose, as she was, in the dark and betook herself whereas she had heard the noise.
uz: Pinukcio o'z bekasi bilan shunday yashayotganida, shunday bo'ldiki, bir mushuk ma'lum narsalarni yiqitib yubordi, yaxshi xotin uyg'onib eshitdi; shundan so'ng, boshqa narsa bo'lishidan qo'rqib, qorong'ida o'zi qanday bo'lsa, shunday turdi va shovqinni eshitganida o'zini bezovta qildi.
