en: Meanwhile, Adriano, without intent aforethought, arose by chance for some natural occasion and going to despatch this, came upon the cradle, whereas it had been set by the good wife, and unable to pass without mov- ing it, took it up and set it down beside his own bed; then, having accom- plished that for which he had arisen, he returned and betook himself to bed again, without recking of the cradle.
uz: Ayni paytda, Adriano hech o'ylab o'tirmasdan, tasodifan bir tabiiy holatga ko'tarilib, buni jo'natmoqchi bo'lib, yaxshi xotin tomonidan o'rnatilgan beshik ustiga keldi va harakatsiz o'ta olmadi, uni ko'tarib, o'z karavoti yonida yotqizdi; keyin, o'zi turganiga rozi bo'lib, yana beshikni hisobga olmasdan, o'zini yotqizdi.

en: The good wife, having searched and found the thing which had fallen was not what she thought, never troubled herself to kindle a light, to see it, but, chiding the cat, returned to the cham- ber and groped her way to the bed where her husband lay.
uz: Yaxshi xotin, yiqilgan narsani qidirib topib, o'ylaganidek emas edi, hech qachon chiroq yoqishga, uni ko'rishga tashvishlanmadi, balki mushukni urib, xonasiga qaytib keldi va erining yotgan joyiga, ushladi.

en: Finding the cradle not there, ‘Mercy o’ me!’ quoth she in herself.
uz: U yerda beshikni topib, o'ziga: "Menga rahm qil!" - deb qichqirdi.

en: ‘See what I was about to do!
uz: Qarang, men nima qilmoqchi edim!

en: As I am a Christian, I had well nigh gone straight to our guest’s bed.’ Then, going a little farther and ﬁnding the cradle, she entered the bed whereby it stood and laid herself down beside Adriano, thinking to couch with her husband.
uz: Men xristian bo'lganim sababli, mehmonimizning karavoriga yaqinlashdim. Keyin, biroz uzoqroq borgach, beshikni topib, u turgan karavotga kirdi va Adriano yonida yotdi, o'zini eriga qo'shib yotishni o'yladi.

en: Adriano, who was not yet asleep, feeling this, received her well and joyously and laying her aboard in a trice, clapped on all sail, to the no small contentment of the lady.
uz: Adriano, hali uxlamayotgan edi, buni his qilib, uni yaxshi va quvnoq kutib oldi va xonimning bebaho mamnuniyatidan xursand bo'lib, butun yelkaga qarsak chalib, trichkada uni bortga qo'ydi.

en: Meanwhile, Pinuccio, fearing lest sleep should surprise him with his lass and having taken of her his ﬁll of pleasure, arose from her, to return to his own bed, to sleep, and ﬁnding the cradle in his way, took the adjoining bed for that of his host; wherefore, going a little farther, he lay down with the latter, who awoke at his coming.
uz: Ayni paytda, Pinukcio, uyqu uni o'z qizi bilan ajablantirmasligidan va undan zavqlanib to'yinganidan qo'rqib, o'z to'shagini topib, uxlash uchun undan turdi va yo'lida beshikni topib, qo'shni to'shakni o'z qo'shiniga oldi; shuning uchun, biroz uzoqroqqa borgach, u kelganida uyg'ongan oxirgi bilan birga yotdi.

en: Pinuccio, deeming himself beside Adriano, said, ‘I tell thee there never was so sweet a creature as is Niccolosa.
uz: Pinuccio o'zini Adriano yonida deb hisoblab, dedi: Senga aytaman, Nikolozaga o'xshab hech qachon bunchalik shirin maxluq bo'lmagan.

en: Cock’s body, I have had with her the rarest sport ever man had with woman, more by token that I have gone upwards of six times into the country, since I left thee.’ The host, hearing this talk and being not overwell pleased therewith, said ﬁrst in himself, ‘What a devil doth this fellow here?’ Then, more angered than well-advised, ‘Pinuccio,’ quoth he, ‘this hath been a great piece of villainy of thine, and I know not why thou shouldst have used me thus; but, by the body of God, I will pay thee for it!!’ Pinuccio, who was not the wisest lad in the world, seeing his mistake, addressed not himself to mend it as best he might, but said, ‘Of what wilt thou pay me?
uz: Xo'roz tanasi, men u bilan erkakning ayol bilan qilgan eng kam uchraydigan o'yinini o'tkazdim, chunki men seni tark etganimdan beri oltita marta qishloqqa chiqqanman." Xo'jayin bu gapni eshitib, bundan xursand bo'lmay, avval o'ziga dedi: "Bu odam bu yerda nima qilyapti?" Keyin, aqldan ozganidan ko'ra g'azablangan holda, "Pinuccio," dedi u: "Bu sening katta yovuzliging bo'ldi va nega mendan bunday foydalanishing kerakligini bilmayman; lekin, Xudoning tanasiga qasam ichaman, men senga buning uchun to'layman!!" Pinuccio, dunyodagi eng dono yigit bo'lmagani, o'z xatosiga qarab, uni eng yaxshi yo'l bilan tuzatishga urinmadi, lekin dedi: "Menga nima to'laysiz?"

en: What canst thou do to me?’ Therewithal the hostess, who thought herself with her hus-
uz: Menga nima qila olasiz? Shundan so'ng uy bekasi o'zini xotin bilan o'yladi.

en: band, said to Adriano, ‘Good lack, hark to our guests how they are at I know not what words together!’ Quoth Adriano, laughing, ‘Leave them do, God land them in an ill year!
uz: Guruh, Adrianoga dedi: Yaxshi yetishmayapti, mehmonlarimizga qanday ahvolda ekanliklarini aytdi, bilmayman, qanday so'zlarni birga aytish kerak! Adriano qahqirab dedi: Ularga qo'yinglar, Xudo ularni yomon yilga tushirsin!

en: They drank overmuch yesternight.’ The good wife, herseeming she had heard her husband scold and hearing Adriano speak, incontinent perceived where and with whom she had been; whereupon, like a wise woman as she was, she arose forthright, without saying a word, and taking her little son’s cradle, carried it at a guess, for that there was no jot of light to be seen in the chamber, to the side of the bed where her daughter slept and lay down with the latter; then, as if she had been aroused by her husband’s clamour, she called him and enquired what was to do between himself and Pinuccio.
uz: Ular kechqurun juda ko'p ichishdi.  Yaxshi xotin, go'yo eri Adrenoning tanbehini eshitgan va gapirayotgandek, qayerda va kim bilan bo'lganini darhol anglab yetdi; shundan so'ng, o'zi dono ayol kabi, bir so'z demasdan turib, kichkina o'g'lining beshigini olib, uni taxmin qilib ko'tardi, chunki xonada, qizining yotoq yonida ko'rinadigan hech qanday yorug'lik yo'q edi, u yerda uning qizi uxlagan va oxirgi bilan yotgandek edi; keyin, go'yo erining shovqinidan uyg'onilgandek, u uni chaqirib, o'zi va Pinuccio o'rtasida nima qilish kerakligini so'radi.

en: He answered, ‘Hearest thou not what he saith he hath done this night unto Niccolosa?’ ‘Marry,’ quoth she, ‘he lieth in his throat, for he was never abed with Niccolosa, seeing that I have lain here all night; more by token that I have not been able to sleep a wink; and thou art an ass to believe him.
uz: U javob berdi: Nikolasaga bugun kechasi nima qilganini eshitmayapsanmi? Uylang, dedi u, u tomoqda yotadi, chunki u Nikolosada hech qachon yashamagan, chunki men bu yerda tun bo'yi yotdim; ko'proq, bir chimdim ham uxlay olmaganim uchun; va sen unga ishonish uchun eshaksan.

en: You men drink so much of an evening that you do nothing but dream all night and fare hither and thither, without knowing it, and fancy you do wonders.
uz: Siz odamlar shunchalik kechqurun ichasizki, tun bo'yi faqat tush ko'rasizlar va bilmasdan bu yoqqa ketasizlar va mo'jizalar yaratasizlar deb o'ylaysizlar.

en: ’Tis a thousand pities you don’t break your necks.
uz: Ming afsuski, bo'yningni sindirmaysan.

en: But what doth Pinuccio yonder?
uz: Ammo Pinuccio u yerda nima qilyapti?

en: Why bideth he not in his own bed?’ Adriano, on his part, seeing how adroitly the good wife went about to cover her own shame and that of her daughter, chimed in with, ‘Pinuccio, I have told thee an hundred times not to go abroad, for that this thy trick of arising in thy sleep and telling for true the extravagances thou dreamest will bring thee into trouble some day or other.
uz: Nega u o'z karavotida buyurmaydi? Adriano, o'z navbatida, yaxshi xotin o'z uyatini va qizining uyatini qanday hiyla bilan yashirganini ko'rib, qichqirib dedi: Pinuccio, men senga yuz marta chet elga bormaslikni aytdim, chunki bu hiylaking uyqingda turish va orzuingdagi buzuqliklarni haqiqatga aylantirish seni bir kun yoki boshqa tashvishga soladi.

en: Come back here, God give thee an ill night!’ The host, hearing what his wife and Adriano said, began to believe in good earnest that Pinuccio was dreaming; and accordingly, taking him by the shoulders, he fell to shaking and calling him, saying, ‘Pinuccio, awake; return to thine own bed.’ Pinuccio having apprehended all that had been said began to wander off into other extravagances, after the fashion of a man a- dream; whereat the host set up the heartiest laughter in the world.
uz: "Bu yerga qayting, Xudo senga yomon tun bersin!" Xotini va Adriano aytgan gaplarni eshitgan qo'shin Pinutsioning tush ko'rayotganligiga chin dildan ishona boshladi; va shunga ko'ra, uni yelkalaridan ushlagan holda, titrab yiqildi va uni chaqirib dedi: "Pinutsiyo, uyg'on, o'z karavotingga qayt." Pinutsiy aytilgan hamma narsani anglab yetgach, odamning orzusi kabi boshqa dabdabalarga ketishni boshladi; u yerda qo'shin dunyodagi eng qaynoq kulgilarni o'rnatdi.

en: At last, he made believe to awake for stress of shaking, and calling to Adriano, said, ‘Is it already day, that thou callest me?’ ‘Ay,’ answered the other, ‘come hither.’ Accordingly, Pinuccio, dissembling and making a show of being sleepy-eyed, arose at last from beside the host and went back to bed with Adriano.
uz: Nihoyat, u titroqdan uyg'onishga ishontirdi va Adrianoga qo'ng'iroq qilib, dedi: Menga qo'ng'iroq qilishing uchun kunduz bo'ldimi? Ha, javob berdi ikkinchisi, bu yerga kel. Shunga ko'ra, Pinuccio uyqusiragan ko'rinish berib, oxir-oqibat mehmonxonadan turib, Adriano bilan birga yotdi.

en: The day come and they being risen, the host fell to laughing and mocking at Pinuccio and his dreams; and so they passed from one jest to another, till the young men, having saddled their rounceys and strapped on
uz: Kun kelib, ular tirilgach, qo'shin Pinuccio va uning tushlariga kulishga va masxara qilishga tushdi; va shunday qilib ular bir hazildan ikkinchisiga o'tishdi, to yigitlar o'z egarlarini egarlab, bog'lab qo'yguncha.

en: their valises and drunken with the host, remounted to horse and rode away to Florence, no less content with the manner in which the thing had betided than with the effect itself thereof.
uz: ularning sumkalari va mehmonlar bilan mast holda, otga ko'tarilib, Florensiyaga otda ketishdi, narsa qanday yashashidan ko'ra uning ta'siriga ham kamroq qoniqdilar.

en: Thereafter Pinuccio found other means of foregathering with Niccolosa, who vowed to her mother that he had cer- tainly dreamt the thing; wherefore the goodwife, remembering her of Adri- ano’s embracements, inwardly avouched herself alone to have waked.”
uz: Shundan so'ng Pinukcio Nikoloza bilan uchrashishning boshqa usullarini topdi. Nikoloza onasiga bu narsani albatta tush ko'rganini va'da berdi; shuning uchun xotinning Adri-ano'ning quchoqlarini eslab, ich-ichidan uyg'onib qolgani uchun yolg'iz o'zini ko'rsatdi.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY Talano di Molese dreameth that a wolf mangleth all his wife’s neck and face and biddeth her beware thereof; but she payeth no heed to his warning and it befalleth her even as he had dreamed.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOY Talano di Molese tushida bo'ri xotining bo'yni va yuzini teshadi va unga ehtiyot bo'lishni buyuradi; lekin u uning ogohlantirishiga e'tibor bermaydi va unga xuddi u tush ko'rganidek keladi.

en: Pamﬁlo’s story being ended and the goodwife’s presence of mind having been commended of all, the queen bade Pampinea tell hers and she thereupon began, “It hath been otherwhile discoursed among us, charming ladies, of the truths foreshown by dreams, the which many of our sex scoff at; wherefore, notwithstanding that which hath been said thereof, I shall not scruple to tell you, in a very few words, that which no great while ago befell a she-neighbour of mine for not giving credit to a dream of herself seen by her husband.
uz: Pamfilaning hikoyasi tugagach va xotinning aql-idrokliligi hammaga maqtovga sazovor bo'lgandan so'ng, malika Pampinea o'ziga aytdi va u shundan so'ng boshladi: "Biz, go'zal xonimlar, ko'pchiligimiz masxara qiladigan tushlar bilan ko'rsatilgan haqiqatlar haqida boshqa bir paytlarda gapirildi; shuning uchun, bu haqda aytilgan bo'lsa ham, men sizga juda oz so'zlar bilan aytishdan bosh tortmayman, bu yaqin orada mening qo'shnimga erining ko'rgan orzusiga ishonish uchun sodir bo'lgan."

en: I know not if you were acquainted with Talano di Molese, a very wor- shipful man, who took to wife a young lady called Margarita, fair over all others, but so humoursome, ill-conditioned and froward that she would do nought of other folk’s judgment, nor could others do aught to her liking; the which, irksome as it was to Talano to endure, natheless, as he could no oth- erwise, needs must he put up with.
uz: Bilmadim, siz Talano di Molese bilan tanishganmisiz? U juda tashvishlanarli odam edi. U Margarita ismli yosh xotinni xotinlikka oldi, u boshqalardan ko'ra ancha go'zal edi, lekin shunchalik hazilkash, noqulay va xushchaqchaq edi, u boshqa odamlarning fikridan hech narsa qilmasdi, boshqalar ham unga yoqadigan hech narsa qilmasdi; bu Talanoga bardosh berish qanchalik kulgili bo'lsa ham, lekin u hech qanday yordam bera olmaganidek, unga bardosh berish kerak edi.

en: It chanced one night that, being with this Margarita of his at an estate he had in the country, himseemed in his sleep he saw his wife go walking in a very fair wood which they had not far from their house, and as she went, himseemed there came forth of a thicket a great and ﬁerce wolf, which sprang straight at her throat and pulling her to the ground, enforced himself to carry her off, whilst she screamed for aid; and after, she winning free of his fangs, it seemed he had marred all her throat and face.
uz: Bir kecha shunday bo'lib qoldiki, u o'zining Margaritasini qishloqda joylashgan mulkida ushlab turganida, uyqusida xotini uyidan uncha uzoqda bo'lmagan juda go'zal o'rmonda yurganini ko'rdi va u ketayotganda, xuddi bir to'rdan katta va shiddatli bo'ri chiqib, uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tomog'iga otib, yerga tortgandek bo'ldi, uni haydab olib ketishga majbur bo'ldi, u esa yordam so'rab baqirdi; va keyin, u uning tishlaridan xalos bo'lgandan so'ng, go'yo u butun tomoq va yuzini shikastlagan edi.

en: Accordingly, when he arose in the morning, he said to the lady, ‘Wife, albeit thy frowardness hath never suffered me to have a good day with thee, yet it would grieve me should ill betide thee; wherefore, an
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u ertalab turgach, xonimga dedi: "Xotin, garchi befarosatliging meni hech qachon sen bilan yaxshi kun o'tkazishga yo'l qo'ymagan bo'lsa ham, senga yomon munosabatda bo'lish meni xafa qiladi; shuning uchun,

en: thou wilt hearken to my counsel, thou wilt not go forth the house today’; and being asked of her why, he orderly recounted to her his dream.
uz: Sen mening maslahatimga quloq solmoqchisan, bugun uydan chiqmaysan; va undan nima uchun deb so'ralganda, u unga o'z tushini tartibli tarzda aytib berdi.

en: The lady shook her head and said, ‘Who willeth thee ill, dreameth thee ill.
uz: Xonim boshini chayqadi va dedi: Senga yomon niyat qilgan odam, senga yomon tush ko'radi.

en: Thou feignest thyself mighty careful of me; but thou dreamest of me that which thou wouldst fain see come to pass; and thou mayst be assured that I will be careful both today and always not to gladden thee with this or other mischance of mine.’ Quoth Talano, ‘I knew thou wouldst say thus; for that such thanks still hath he who combeth a scald-head; but, believe as thou listeth, I for my part tell it to thee for good, and once more I counsel thee abide at home today or at least beware of going into our wood.’ ‘Good,’ answered the lady, ‘I will do it’; and after fell a-saying to herself, ‘Sawest thou how artfully yonder man thinketh to have feared me from going to our wood today?
uz: "Sen o'zingni menga nisbatan juda ehtiyotkor deb ko'rsatyapsan; lekin men haqimda shunday tush ko'rasan, men bugun ham, har doim ham seni shu yoki bu noqulayligimdan xursand qilmasligimga amin bo'lishing mumkin." Quoth Talano, "Men bilardimki, sen shunday deysan; chunki bunday minnatdorchilik hali ham bor, chunki u qo'zg'alovchi odamda bor; lekin, sen eshitganingdek, men o'z navbatimda senga yaxshilik uchun aytaman va yana bir bor senga uyda qolishni yoki hech bo'lmaganda bizning o'rmonga kirishdan ehtiyot bo'lishni maslahat beraman." "Xo'p," dedi xonim, "Men buni qilaman"; va odam o'ziga dedi: "Bugun meni o'rmonga tashlashdan qanday qo'rqasan deb o'ylayapsan?"

en: Doubtless he hath given some trull or other tryst there and would not have me ﬁnd him with her.
uz: Shubhasiz, u u yerda qandaydir "trull" yoki boshqa kelishuv bergan va men uni u bilan topishimni xohlamagan.

en: Marry, it were ﬁne eating for him with blind folk and I should be a right simpleton an I saw not his drift and if I believed him!
uz: Turmush qur, u uchun ko'r odamlar bilan ovqatlanish yaxshi edi va men to'g'ri ahmoq bo'lishim kerak edi va men uning harakatini ko'rmadim va agar unga ishonsam!

en: But certes he shall not have his will; nay, though I abide there all day, needs must I see what trafﬁc is this that he hath in hand today.’ Accordingly, her husband being gone out at one door, she went out at the other and betook herself as most secretly she might straight to the wood and hid herself in the thickest part thereof, standing attent and looking now here and now there, an she should see anyone come.
uz: Lekin, albatta, u xohishiga ega bo'lmaydi; yo'q, men u yerda kun bo'yi tursam ham, bugun uning qo'lida qanday tirbandlik borligini ko'rishim kerak. Shunga ko'ra, eri bir eshikdan chiqib, boshqa eshikdan chiqib, o'zini eng yashirincha yog'ochga qaratib, uning eng qalin qismiga yashiringan holda, hozir bu yerga va hozir bu yerga qarab turardi, toki u kimdir kelishini ko'rsin.

en: As she abode on this wise, without any thought of danger, behold, there sallied forth of a thick coppice hard by a terrible great wolf, and scarce could she say, ‘Lord, aid me!’ when it ﬂew at her throat and laying fast hold of her, proceeded to carry her off, as she were a lambkin.
uz: U shu yo'l bilan turar ekan, hech qanday xavf haqida o'ylamasdan, qarang, qalin bir piyoz qattiq, dahshatli katta bo'ri tomonidan urib chiqardi va u kamdan-kam "Egam, menga yordam ber!" deb ayta olardi. Shunda u uning tomoqidan uchib, uni mahkam ushlab, go'dakdek olib ketardi.

en: She could neither cry nor aid herself on other wise, so sore was her gullet straitened; wherefore the wolf, carrying her off, would assuredly have throttled her, had he not encountered certain shep- herds, who shouted at him and constrained him to loose her.
uz: U na yig'lay olmadi, na o'ziga yordam bera olmadi, shunchalik og'riq bilan uning bo'g'zi taranglashardi; shuning uchun uni olib ketayotgan bo'ri, albatta, uni bo'g'ib qo'yardi, agar u ba'zi qo'ylarga duch kelmaganida edi, ular unga baqirishardi va uni qo'yib yuborishga majburlashardi.

en: The shepherds knew her and carried her home, in a piteous plight, where, after long tend- ing by the physicians, she was healed, yet not so wholly but she had all her throat and a part of her face marred on such wise that, whereas before she was fair, she ever after appeared misfeatured and very foul of favour; wherefore, being ashamed to appear whereas she might be seen, she many a time bitterly repented her of her frowardness and her perverse denial to put faith, in a matter which cost her nothing, in her husband’s true dream.”
uz: Cho'ponlar uni tanib, achinarli ahvolda uyga olib ketishdi. U yerda, shifokorlar tomonidan uzoq vaqt davomida parvarishlanganidan so'ng, u butunlay tuzalgan edi, ammo butun tomoqlari va yuzining bir qismi shunchalik dog'langan ediki, garchi ilgari go'zal bo'lsa ham, u keyinchalik beodob va juda xunuk ko'rinardi; shuning uchun, ko'rinishi mumkin bo'lgan joyda ko'rinishdan uyalgan holda, u ko'p marta o'zining befarosatligi va erining haqiqiy orzusiga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaydigan ishda imon keltirishdan achchiq tavba qildi.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Biondello cheateth Ciacco of a dinner, whereof the other craftily avengeth himself, procuring him to be shamefully beaten.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Biondello Ciacconi kechki ovqatga aldaydi, undan boshqasi mohirona qasos oladi va uni sharmandali tarzda kaltaklashga majbur qiladi.

en: The merry company with one accord avouched that which Talano had seen in sleep to have been no dream, but a vision, so punctually, without there failing aught thereof, had it come to pass.
uz: Shod-xotirlanganlar Talano uyqusida ko'rgan narsani hech qanday tush emas, balki bir vaqtning o'zida, hech qanday kamchiliksiz, ro'yo bo'lib amalga oshganini bir ovozdan aytishdi.

en: But, all being silent the queen charged Lauretta follow on, who said, “Like as those, most discreet ladies, who have today foregone me in speech, have been well nigh all moved to discourse by something already said, even so the stern vengeance wreaked by the scholar, of whom Pampinea told us yesterday, moveth me to tell of a piece of revenge, which, without being so barbarous as the former, was nev- ertheless grievous unto him who brooked it.
uz: Lekin, hamma jim bo'lib, qirolicha Laurettaga murojaat qildi va u dedi: "Bugun meni nutqdan o'zib ketgan eng sokin xonimlar, allaqachon aytilgan narsa tufayli gapirishga yaqinlashganidek, Pampinea kecha bizga aytgan olim tomonidan sodir etilgan qattiq qasos ham, meni oldingi kabi shafqatsiz bo'lmagan, ammo uni o'ziga urgan odamga achinarli qasos haqida aytishga undaydi."

en: I must tell you, then, that there was once in Florence a man whom all called Ciacco,437 as great a glutton as ever lived.
uz: Shuni aytishim kerakki, Florensiyada bir vaqtlar Ciacco, 437 deb ataladigan odam bor edi, u hech qachon yashagan buyuk ochko'z edi.

en: His means sufﬁcing him not to support the expense that his gluttony required and he being, for the rest, a very well-mannered man and full of goodly and pleasant sayings, he addressed himself to be, not altogether a buffoon, but a spunger438 and to company with those who were rich and delighted to eat of good things; and with these he went often to dine and sup, albeit he was not always bidden.
uz: Uning imkoniyati uning ochko'zligi talab qiladigan xarajatlarni qoplashga yetarli emas edi va u, boshqa tomondan, juda yaxshi xulqli odam va yaxshi va yoqimli maqollarga to'la bo'lgani uchun, o'zini umuman ahmoq emas, balki g'alayon bo'lishga va boy va yaxshi narsalardan yeyishga xursand bo'lganlar bilan do'st bo'lishga qaratdi; va bular bilan tez-tez ovqatlanish va kechki ovqatga borardi, garchi u har doim taklif qilinmagan bo'lsa ham.

en: There was likewise at Florence, in those days, a man called Biondello, a little dapper fellow of his person, very quaint of his dress and sprucer than a ﬂy, with his coif on his head and his yellow periwig still drest to a nicety, without a hair awry, who plied the same trade as Ciacco.
uz: Florensiyada ham o'sha kunlarda Biondello ismli bir odam bor edi. U o'ziga xos bir yigit edi, ko'ylagidan juda g'alati va pashshadan ko'ra chiroyli, boshiga koif va sariq perivigi hali ham sochlari o'zgarmagan chiroyli libosda edi, u Ciacco bilan bir xil hunar bilan shug'ullanardi.

en: Going one morn- ing in Lent whereas they sell the ﬁsh and cheapening two very ﬁne lampreys for Messer Vieri de’ Cerchj, he was seen by Ciacco, who accosted him and said, ‘What meaneth this?’ Whereto Biondello made answer, ‘Yes- tereve there were sent unto Messer Corso Donati three lampreys, much ﬁner
uz: Bir kuni ertalab Ro'za paytida, ular Messer Vieri de' Cerchj uchun baliq sotishayotgan va ikkita juda yaxshi lampochkani arzonlashtirayotgan paytda, u Ciacco tomonidan ko'rindi. Ciacco unga yaqinlashib, dedi: "Bu nimani anglatadi?" Biondello javob berdi: "Ha, u yerda Messer Corso Donatining uchta lampochkasi jo'natilgan edi, ancha nozikroq."

en: than these, and a sturgeon; to which sufﬁcing him not for a dinner he is minded to give certain gentlemen, he would have me buy these other two.
uz: Bulardan ko'ra, va bir boyo'g'li; unga kechki ovqat uchun yetarli bo'lmagani uchun u ba'zi janoblarga berishni niyat qildi, u meni bu ikkitani sotib oldirmoqchi edi.

en: Wilt thou not come thither, thou?’ Quoth Ciacco, ‘Thou knowest well that I shall be there.’ Accordingly, whenas it seemed to him time, he betook himself to Messer Corso’s house, where he found him with sundry neighbours of his, not yet gone to dinner, and being asked of him what he went doing, answered, ‘Sir, I am come to dine with you and your company.’ Quoth Messer Corso, ‘Thou art welcome; and as it is time, let us to table.’ Thereupon they seated them- selves at table and had, to begin with, chickpease and pickled tunny, and after a dish of fried ﬁsh from the Arno, and no more, Ciacco, perceiving the cheat that Biondello had put upon him, was inwardly no little angered there- at and resolved to pay him for it; nor had many days passed ere he again en- countered the other, who had by this time made many folk merry with the trick he had played him.
uz: "Sen u yerga kelmaysanmi, shundaymi?" - Kuotsiya, "Sen mening u yerda bo'lishimni yaxshi bilasan." Shunday qilib, unga vaqt kelganda, u Messer Korso'ning uyiga bordi. U uni turli qo'shnilari bilan topdi, kechki ovqatga hali bormagan edi. Undan nima qilayotganini so'rashganda, u javob berdi: "Janob, men siz bilan va sizning hamrohingiz bilan ovqatlanishga keldim." Kuotsiya, "Sizni qabul qilamiz; va vaqti kelganda, ovqatlanamiz." Shunda ular o'zlarini o'tirdilar va, boshida, tovuq va tovuq tanladilar, Arno'dan qovurilgan baliq taomidan so'ng, va undan keyin, yana bir oz vaqt o'tgach, Biondello uni ko'p vaqt o'ynamaganini sezdi va u bilan birga o'ynamadi.

en: Biondello, seeing him, saluted him and asked him, laughing, how he had found Messer Corso’s lampreys; to which Ciacco answered, ‘That shalt thou know much better than I, ere eight days be past.’ Then, without wasting time over the matter, he took leave of Biondello and agreeing for a price with a shrewd huckster, carried him near to the Cavicciuoli Gallery and showing him a gentleman there, called Messer Fil- ippo Argenti, a big burly rawboned fellow and the most despiteful, choleric and humoursome man alive, gave him a great glass ﬂagon and said to him, ‘Go to yonder gentleman with this ﬂask in hand and say to him, “Sir Biondello sendeth me to you and prayeth you be pleased to rubify him this ﬂask with your good red wine, for that he would fain make merry somedele with his minions.” But take good care he lay not his hands on thee; else will he give thee an ill morrow and thou wilt have
uz: Biondello uni ko'rib, salom berdi va undan kulib, qanday qilib Messer Corso'ning lampochkalarini topganini so'radi. Ciacco javob berdi: "Sening bundan ko'ra ko'proq bilishing kerak, sakkiz kun o'tmasidan oldin." Keyin, bu masalaga vaqtni behuda sarflamasdan, u Biondelloni tark etdi va aqlli hakker bilan narxga rozi bo'lib, uni Cavicciuoli galereyasiga olib bordi va u yerda katta xom yog'ochli yigit, Messer Fil- ippo Argentiyni ko'rsatdi. U eng qattiqqo'l, xolerik va hazilkash odam edi va unga katta stakan berdi. Va unga dedi: "Borga bu kolba bilan yuboring va unga: "Janob Biondello meni sizga yordam berasiz va u sizga bu yaxshi vino bilan yordam beradi, lekin u sizga yaxshilik qilmaydi."

en: marred my plans.’ ‘Have I aught else to say,’ asked the huckster; and Ciacco answered, ‘No; do but go and say this and after come back to me here with the ﬂask and I will pay thee.’ The huckster accordingly set off and did his errand to Messer Filippo, who, hearing the message and being lightly rufﬂed, concluded that Biondello, whom he knew, had a mind to make mock of him, and waxing all red in the face, said, ‘What “rubify me” and what “minions” be these?
uz: rejalarimni buzdim. Men boshqa hech narsa deyishga majbur bo'ldimmi,  deb so'radi hakster; va Ciacco javob berdi: Yo'q; shunchaki bor va buni ayt va keyin bu yerga kolba bilan qaytib kel, men senga to'layman. Hakster shunga ko'ra yo'lga chiqdi va xabarni eshitib, yengil g'azablanayotgan Filippoga o'z vazifasini qildi. U xabarni eshitib, Biondello, uni bilgan odam, uni masxara qilish uchun o'ylab, yuziga qizargan holda, dedi: Meni qaytarib yubor va bu minionlar nima?

en: God land thee and him an ill year!’ Then, starting to his feet, he put out his hand to lay hold of the huckster; but the latter, who was on his guard, promptly took to his heels and returning by another way to Ciacco, who had seen all that had passed, told him what Messer Filippo had said to him.
uz: Xudo senga va unga yomon yilni yog'dirsin! Keyin, oyoqlaridan turib, u xoksterni ushlash uchun qo'lini cho'zdi; lekin uning qo'riqchisi darhol oyoq kiyimini ushladi va boshqa yo'l bilan Ciaccoga qaytib keldi, u o'tganlarning hammasini ko'rgan edi va unga Messer Filippo aytgan gaplarni aytdi.

en: Ciacco, well pleased, paid him and rested not till he found Biondello, to whom quoth he, ‘Hast thou been late at the Cavicciuoli Gallery?’ ‘Nay,’ answered the other.
uz: Ciacco xursand bo'lib, unga pul berdi va Biondelloni topmaguncha tinmadi. U unga: "Cvicciuoli galereyasida kechikdingmi?" - deb javob berdi, "Yo'q," dedi ikkinchisi.

en: ‘Why dost thou ask me?’ ‘Because,’ replied Ciacco, ‘I must tell thee that Messer Filippo enquireth for thee; I know not what he would have.’ ‘Good,’ rejoined Biondello; ‘I am going that way and will speak with him.’ Accordingly, he made off, and Ciacco followed him, to see how the thing should pass.
uz: Nega mendan so'rayapsan? Chunki,  javob berdi Siyakko, Senga aytishim kerakki, janob Filippo sen uchun so'rayapti; uning nimaga ega bo'lishini bilmayman. Xo'p,  javob berdi Biondello; Men u tomonga ketyapman va u bilan gaplashaman. Shunga ko'ra, u yo'lga chiqdi va Siyakko uning orqasidan bordi, ish qanday o'tishini ko'rish uchun.

en: Meanwhile Messer Filippo, having failed to come at the huckster, abode sore disordered and was inwardly all a-fume with rage, being unable to make anything in the world of the huckster’s words, if not that Biondello, at whosesoever instance, was minded to make mock of him.
uz: Ayni paytda, janob Filippo haksterga kelolmagani uchun, qattiq tartibsizlikda qoldi va ichki tomondan g'azabdan to'lib ketdi, haksterning so'zlaridan hech narsa qila olmasdi, faqat Biondello, har qanday holatda ham uni masxara qilishga moyil edi.

en: As he fretted himself thus, up came Biondello, whom no sooner did he espy than he made for him and dealt him a sore buffet in the face.
uz: U o'zini shunday bezovta qilar ekan, Biondello paydo bo'ldi, u unga tayyorlaganidan ko'ra tezroq g'azablandi va yuziga og'riqli bufet berdi.

en: ‘Alack, sir,’ cried Biondello, ‘what is this?’ Whereupon Messer Filippo, clutching him by the hair and tearing his coif, cast his bonnet to the ground and said, laying on to him amain the while, ‘Knave that thou art, thou shalt soon see what it is!
uz: Alack, janob,  deb baqirdi Biondello,  bu nima? Shundan song, Messer Filippo uni sochidan ushladi va koifasini yirtib tashladi, shlyapasini yerga tashladi va unga hayrat bilan yopishib, dedi: Knave, sen qanday bolsang, tez orada nima ekanligini korasan!

en: What is this thou sendest to say to me with thy “rubify me” and thy “minions”?
uz: Sen menga "rubify me" va "minions" bilan aytish uchun nima yuboryapsan?

en: Deemest thou me a child, to be ﬂouted on this wise?’ So saying, he battered his whole face with his ﬁsts, which were like very iron, nor left him a hair on his head unrufﬂed; then, rolling him in the mire, he tore all the clothes off his back; and to this he applied himself with such a will that Biondello could not avail to say a word to him nor ask why he served him thus.
uz: "Sen meni shunday qilib qo'zg'alishga majbur bo'ladigan bola deb o'ylaysanmi?" Shunday deb, u butun yuzini juda temirga o'xshash mushtlari bilan urdi, boshida birorta ham tukni qo'yib yubormadi; so'ngra loyga o'rab, barcha kiyimlarini yirtib tashladi; va bunga shunday ishonch bilan murojaat qildi, Biondello unga bir so'z aytishga ham, nega unga bunday xizmat qilganini so'rashga ham qodir bo'lmadi.

en: He had heard him indeed speak of ‘rubify me’ and ‘minions,’ but knew not what this meant.
uz: U uni haqiqatan ham "rubify me" va "minions" haqida gapirganini eshitgan edi, lekin bu nimani anglatishini bilmas edi.

en: At last, Messer Filippo having beaten him soundly, the bystanders, whereof many had by this time gathered about them, dragged him, with the utmost difﬁculty, out of the other’s clutches, all bruised and battered as he was, and told him why the gentleman had done this, blaming him for that which he had sent to say to him and telling him that he should by that time have known Messer Filippo better and that he was not a man to jest withal.
uz: Nihoyat, janob Filippo uni qattiq urib, atrofidagi ko'pchilik to'planib qolgan tomoshabinlar uni juda qiyinchilik bilan, qolganlarning ushlari ostidan, xuddi shunday ko'kargan va kaltaklangan holda sudrab olib chiqishdi va unga janob nega bunday qilganini aytishdi, unga aytmoqchi bo'lgan narsasida ayblashdi va unga o'sha paytga kelib janob Filippo yaxshiroq bilishi kerakligini va u hazillashadigan odam emasligini aytishdi.

en: Biondello, all in tears protested his innocence, declaring that he had never sent to Messer Filippo for wine, and as soon as he was somewhat recovered, he returned home, sick and sorry, divining that this must have been Ciacco’s doing.
uz: Biondello ko'z yoshlari bilan o'zining beg'uborligiga qarshi chiqdi, hech qachon Messer Filippoga vino so'rab yubormaganini e'lon qildi va u biroz tuzalib ketishi bilanoq, uyiga kasal va afsus bilan qaytib keldi, bu Ciacco'ning ishi bo'lganini bashorat qildi.

en: When, after many days, the bruises being gone, he began to go abroad again, it chanced that Ciacco encountered him and asked him, laugh- ing, ‘Harkye, Biondello, how deemest thou of Messer Filippo’s wine?’ ‘Even as thou of Messer Corso’s lampreys,’ replied the other; and Ciacco
uz: Ko'p kunlardan so'ng, ko'karishlar yo'qolgach, u yana xorijga chiqishni boshlagach, tasodifan Ciacco unga duch keldi va kulgidan so'radi: "Harkye, Biondello, siz Messer Filippo'ning vinosini qanday ko'rasiz?" "Hatto siz Messer Corso'ning chiroqlari kabi", - javob berdi boshqasi; va Ciacco

en: said, ‘The thing resteth with thee henceforth.
uz: dedi: Bu narsa bundan buyon senga qoladi.

en: Whenever thou goest about to give me to eat as thou didst, I will give thee in return to drink after t’other day’s fashion.’ Biondello, knowing full well that it was easier to wish Ciacco ill than to put it in practise, besought God of his peace439 and thenceforth was careful to affront him no more.”
uz: Qachonki menga xuddi sen qilganingdek ovqat bermoqchi bo'lsang, men senga o'tgan kunning uslubidek ichimlik beraman. Biondello, Ciaccoga yomonlik tilash amaliyotga qo'yishdan ko'ra osonroq ekanligini yaxshi bilgan holda, tinchlik Xudosidan iltijo qildi439 va bundan buyon unga qarshi turishga ehtiyot bo'lmadi.

en: THE NINTH STORY Two young men seek counsel of Solomon, one how he may be loved and the other how he may amend his froward wife, and in answer he biddeth the one love and the other get him to Goosebridge.
uz: TO'IXINCHI HIKOYA Ikki yigit Sulaymondan maslahat so'rashadi, biri uni qanday sevish mumkinligi haqida, ikkinchisi esa o'z beparvo xotinini qanday tuzatish mumkinligi haqida, va javob tariqasida u birini sevishga buyuradi, ikkinchisi esa uni Goosebridgega olib boradi.

en: None other than the queen remaining to tell, so she would maintain Dioneo his privilege, she, after the ladies had laughed at the unlucky Biondello, began blithely to speak thus: “Lovesome ladies, if the ordinance of created things be considered with a whole mind, it will lightly enough be seen that the general multitude of women are by nature, by custom and by law sub- jected unto men and that it behoveth them order and govern themselves ac- cording to the discretion of these latter; wherefore each woman, who would have quiet and ease and solace with those men to whom she pertaineth, should be humble, patient and obedient, besides being virtuous, which latter is the supreme and especial treasure of every wise woman.
uz: Qirolichadan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi, Dioneo uning imtiyozini saqlab qolishi uchun, u, xonimlar omadsiz Biondello ustidan kulganidan so'ng, shunday deb gapira boshladi: Sevgilimli xonimlar, agar yaratilgan narsalarning tartibini butun aql bilan ko'rib chiqilsa, ayollar umumiy ko'pligi tabiat, odat va qonun bo'yicha erkaklarga bo'ysunadi va ularga bularning ixtiyoriga ko'ra tartib va o'zlariga mos kelishi kerakligi juda oson ko'rinadi; shuning uchun, u tegishli bo'lgan erkaklar bilan tinch va osoyishta bo'lishni istagan har bir ayol, kamtar, sabrli va itoatkor bo'lishi kerak, bundan tashqari, fazilatli bo'lishi kerak, bu esa har bir oqilaning oliy va xazinasidir.

en: Nay, though the laws, which in all things regard the general weal, and usance or (let us say) custom, whose puissance is both great and worship-worth, taught us not this, nature very manifestly showeth it unto us, inasmuch as she hath made us women tender and delicate of body and timid and fearful of spirit and hath given us little bodily strength, sweet voices and soft and graceful movements, all things testifying that we have need of the governance of others.
uz: Yo'q, garchi qonunlar, har bir narsada umumiy xulq-atvor, urf-odat yoki (aytaylik) odatga oid bo'lsa-da, ularning qudrati ham buyuk, ham ibodatga arziydigan bo'lsa-da, bizga buni o'rgatmagan bo'lsa-da, tabiat buni bizga juda yaqqol ko'rsatadi, chunki u bizga ayollarni tanasi nozik va nozik, qo'rqoq va ruhidan qo'rqoq qilib, bizga oz tana kuchini, shirin ovozlarini va yumshoq va nafis harakatlarni berdi, bularning barchasi bizga boshqalarning boshqaruviga muhtoj ekanligimizni ko'rsatadi.

en: Now, those who have need to be helped and governed, all reason re- quireth that they be obedient and submissive and reverent to their gov- ernors; and whom have we to governors and helpers, if not men?
uz: Endi, yordamga va boshqaruvga muhtoj bo'lganlar, barcha aql-idrok ularning o'z hukumatlariga itoatkor, itoatkor va hurmatli bo'lishini talab qiladi; va bizda hokimlar va yordamchilar uchun kim bor, agar odamlar bo'lmasa?

en: To men, therefore, it behoveth us submit ourselves, honouring them supremely; and whoso departeth from this, I hold her deserving, not only of grave reprehen- sion, but of severe punishment.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz odamlarga o'zimizni bo'ysundirishimiz, ularni oliy darajada hurmat qilishimiz kerak; va kim bundan chetga chiqsa, men uni nafaqat og'ir tanbehga, balki qattiq jazoga loyiq deb hisoblayman.

en: To these considerations I was lead, though not for the ﬁrst time, by that which Pampinea told us a while ago of
uz: Bu mulohazalarga meni, garchi birinchi marta bo'lmasa ham, Pampiyeya bizga ancha oldin aytgan narsa olib keldi.

en: Talano’s froward wife, upon whom God sent that chastisement which her husband had not known to give her; wherefore, as I have already said, all those women who depart from being loving, compliant and amenable, as nature, usance and law will it, are, in my judgment, worthy of stern and severe chastisement.
uz: Talononing beparvo xotini, unga Xudo erining berishni bilmagan jazosini yuborgan edi; shuning uchun, men allaqachon aytganimdek, tabiat, urf va qonun xohlaganidek, sevgi, itoatkorlik va muloyimlikdan voz kechgan barcha ayollar, mening fikrimcha, qattiq va qattiq jazoga loyiqdir.

en: It pleaseth me, therefore, to recount to you a counsel given by Solomon, as a salutary medicine for curing women who are thus made of that malady; which counsel let none, who meriteth not such treat- ment, repute to have been said for her, albeit men have a byword which saith, ‘Good horse and bad horse both the spur need still, And women need the stick, both good and ill.’ Which words, an one seek to interpret them by way of pleasantry, all women will lightly allow to be true; nay, but consid- ering them morally,440 I say that the same must be conceded of them; for that women are all naturally unstable and prone [to frailty], wherefore, to correct the iniquity of those who allow themselves too far to overpass the limits appointed them, there needeth the stick which punisheth them, and to support the virtue of others who suffer not themselves to transgress, there needeth the stick which
uz: Shunday ekan, men sizga Sulaymon tomonidan berilgan maslahatni, o'sha kasallikdan aziyat chekkan ayollarni davolash uchun foydali dori sifatida aytib berishni mamnun qilaman; bunday muomalaga loyiq bo'lmagan hech kim unga shunday degan bo'lmasligi kerak, garchi erkaklarda shunday ibora bo'lsa ham: "Yaxshi ot ham, yomon ot ham tikan kerak, ayollarga ham tayoq kerak, yaxshi ham, yomon ham."

en: sustaineth and affeareth them.
uz: Ularni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va qo'rqitadi.

en: But, to leave be preaching for the nonce and come to that which I have it in mind to tell.
uz: Lekin, tashlab, xushxabarni tarjima qilib, men aytmoqchi bo'lgan narsaga kelmoqchiman.

en: You must know that, the high renown of Solomon’s miraculous wisdom being bruited abroad well nigh throughout the whole world, no less than the liberality with which he dispensed it unto whoso would fain be certiﬁed thereof by experience, there ﬂocked many to him from divers parts of the world for counsel in their straitest and most urgent occasions.
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, Sulaymonning mo'jizaviy donoligining yuqori shuhrati butun dunyo bo'ylab keng tarqalgan bo'lsa-da, u tajriba bilan tasdiqlanishga loyiq bo'lganlarga uni keng tarqatganidan kam emas, dunyo bo'ylab turli xil joylardan uning oldiga eng yaqin va eng zarur vaziyatlarda maslahat olish uchun ko'p odamlar oqib kelishardi.

en: Amongst oth- ers who thus resorted to him was a young man, Melisso by name, a gentle- man of noble birth and great wealth, who set out from the city of Lajazzo,441 whence he was and where he dwelt; and as he journeyed to- wards Jerusalem, it chanced that, coming forth of Antioch, he rode for some distance with a young man called Giosefo, who held the same course as himself.
uz: Shunday qilib, unga murojaat qilganlar orasida ismli Melisso ismli bir yigit bor edi. U olijanob va katta boylikka ega bo'lgan muloyim odam edi. U Lajazzo shahridan, 441 dan jo'nab, u yerda yashardi; va u Quddus atroflariga sayohat qilayotganda, ehtimol, Antioxyadan chiqib, u o'zi kabi yo'l tutgan Jozefo ismli yigit bilan biroz uzoqlikda uchib ketdi.

en: As the custom is of wayfarers, he entered into discourse with him and having learned from him what and whence he was, he asked him whith- er he went and upon what occasion; to which Giosefo replied that he was on his way to Solomon, to have counsel of him what course he should take with a wife he had, the most froward and perverse woman alive, whom neither with prayers nor with blandishments nor on any other wise could he avail to correct of her waywardness.
uz: Yo'lovchilar odatdagidek, u u bilan suhbatlashdi va undan nima va qayerdan ekanligini bilib, undan qayerga borganini va qanday holatda borganini so'radi; unga Giosefo Sulaymonga borayotganini, undan qanday yo'l tutishi kerakligini maslahat olishni so'raganini, u hayotdagi eng beparvo va buzuq ayol edi, uning buzuqligini na ibodatlar, na hech qanday yo'l bilan tuzatishga qodir edi.

en: Then he in his turn questioned Melisso whence he was and whither he went and on what errand, and he answered, ‘I am of Lajazzo, and like as thou hast a grievance, even so have I one; I am
uz: Shunda u o'z navbatida Melissodan qayerdan ekanligini, qayerga borishini va nima ish bilan shug'ullanishini so'radi va u javob berdi: "Men Lajazzo'danman va xuddi sening aybingga o'xshab, men ham shundayman; men..."

en: young and rich and spend my substance in keeping open house and enter- taining my fellow-townsmen, and yet, strange to say, I cannot for all that ﬁnd one who wisheth me well; wherefore I go whither thou goest, to have counsel how I may win to be beloved.’ Accordingly, they joined company and journeyed till they came to Jerus- alem, where, by the introduction of one of Solomon’s barons, they were ad- mitted to the presence of the king, to whom Melisso brieﬂy set forth his oc- casion.
uz: Yosh va boy bo'lib, o'z boyligimni ochiq uyni saqlash va o'z shahardoshlarimni boqishga sarflayman, ammo g'alati gap, men hamma uchun menga yaxshilik tilaydigan odam topa olmayman; shuning uchun sen boradigan joyga boraman, qanday qilib sevib qolishim mumkinligi haqida maslahat olmoqchiman. Shunday qilib, ular saf tortishdi va Yerusalimga yetib kelishguncha yo'l olishdi, u yerda Sulaymonning baronlaridan biri kelishi bilan ular shohning huzuriga yuborilishdi, unga Melisso qisqacha o'z imkoniyatlarini taqdim etdi.

en: Solomon answered him, ‘Love’; and this said, Melisso was straight- way put forth and Giosefo told that for which he was there.
uz: Sulaymon unga javob berdi: Sevgi; va bu soz Melisso togri yol bilan chiqdi va Giosefo u yerda nima uchun ekanligini aytdi.

en: Solomon made him no other answer than ‘Get thee to Goosebridge’; which said, Giosefo was on like wise removed, without delay, from the king’s presence and ﬁnd- ing Melisso awaiting him without, told him that which he had had for an- swer.
uz: Sulaymon unga faqatgina: Goosebridgega bor,  deb javob berdi; u shunday dedi: Giosefo donolik bilan shoh huzuridan uzoqlashdi, hech ikkilanmay, va uni tashqarida kutib turgan Melissoni topib, unga oziga kerak bolgan narsani aytdi.

en: Thereupon, pondering Solomon’s words and availing to apprehend therefrom neither signiﬁcance nor proﬁt whatsoever for their occasions, they set out to return home, as deeming themselves ﬂouted.
uz: Shundan so'ng, Sulaymonning so'zlarini o'ylab, ulardan hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emasligini va o'z imkoniyatlari uchun hech qanday foyda keltirmasligini anglab yetib, ular o'zlarini beparvo deb hisoblab, uylariga qaytishga qaror qilishdi.

en: After journey- ing for some days, they came to a river, over which was a ﬁne bridge, and a caravan of pack-mules and sumpter-horses being in act to pass, it behoved them tarry till such time as these should be crossed over.
uz: Bir necha kunlik sayohatdan so'ng, ular bir daryoga yetib kelishdi, uning ustidan nozik ko'prik bor edi va to'da-to'da va qo'rqoq otlar karvoni o'tib ketayotgan edi, shuning uchun ular bularni kesib o'tish kerak bo'lgan vaqtgacha turishlari kerak edi.

en: Presently, the beasts having well nigh all crossed, it chanced that one of the mules took umbrage, as oftentimes we see them do, and would by no means pass on; whereupon a muleteer, taking a stick, began to beat it at ﬁrst moderately enough to make it go on; but the mule shied now to this and now to that side of the road and whiles turned back altogether, but would on no wise pass on; whereupon the man, incensed beyond measure, fell to dealing it with the stick the heaviest blows in the world, now on the head, now on the ﬂanks and anon on the crupper, but all to no purpose.
uz: Hozirda hayvonlar deyarli kesib o'tgach, shunday bo'ldiki, mullardan biri, ko'pincha ko'rimizdek, orqa teshikni oldi va hech qanday yo'ldan o'tmadi; shundan so'ng, mulletchi tayoq olib, uni davom ettirish uchun avval yetarlicha o'rtacha urishni boshladi; lekin mul endi bu tomonga va endi yo'lning o'sha tomoniga burilib ketdi va g'ildiraklar butunlay orqaga qaytdi, lekin hech qanday oqilona yo'ldan o'tmadi; shundan so'ng odam, haddan tashqari g'azablanib, tayoq bilan kurashishga tushdi, endi boshga, endi yon tomonga va maydalovchiga, lekin hammasi befoyda.

en: Melisso and Giosefo stood watching this and said often to the muleteer, ‘Alack, wretch that thou art, what dost thou?
uz: Melisso va Giosefo buni kuzatib turishardi va ko'pincha muletchiga: "Alak, bechora, sen nima qilyapsan?" deyishardi.

en: Wilt thou kill the beast?
uz: Hayvonni o'ldirmoqchimisan?

en: Why studiest thou not to manage him by fair means and gentle dealing?
uz: Nega uni adolatli usullar va muloyimlik bilan boshqarishni o'rganmaysan?

en: He will come quicklier than for cudgeling him as thou dost.’ To which the man answered, ‘You know your horses and I know my mule; leave me do with him.’ So saying, he fell again to cudgelling him and belaboured him to such purpose on one side and on the other, that the mule passed on and the mu- leteer won the bout.
uz: U uni sen kabi urishdan tezroq keladi. Bunga odam javob berdi: Sen otlaringni bilasan, men oz otimni bilaman; meni u bilan shugullanishga qoy. Shunday qilib, u yana uni urishga yiqildi va uni bir tomondan ham, ikkinchi tomondan ham shunday ishdan chiqarib yubordi, shunda ot otib ketdi va mu- leteer jangda galaba qozondi.

en: Then, the two young men being now about to depart, Giosefo asked a poor man, who sat at the bridgehead, how the place was called, and he answered, ‘Sir, this is called Goosebridge.’ When Giosefo heard this, he straightway called to mind Solomon’s words and said to
uz: Keyin, ikki yigit ketmoqchi bo'lganida, Giosefo ko'prik tepasida o'tirgan bir kambag'al odamdan bu joy qanday nomlanishini so'radi va u javob berdi: "Janob, bu Goosebridge deb ataladi." Giosefo buni eshitgach, u darhol Sulaymonning so'zlarini esladi va dedi:

en: Melisso, ‘Marry, I tell thee, comrade, that the counsel given me by Solomon may well prove good and true, for I perceive very plainly that I knew not how to beat my wife; but this muleteer hath shown me what I have to do.’ Accordingly, they fared on and came, after some days, to Antioch, where Giosefo kept Melisso with him, that he might rest himself a day or two, and being scurvily enough received of his wife, he bade her prepare supper ac- cording as Melisso should ordain; whereof the latter, seeing that it was his friend’s pleasure, acquitted himself in a few words.
uz: Melisso, Uylan, senga aytaman, ortoq, Sulaymon menga bergan maslahat yaxshi va togri bolishi mumkin, chunki men xotinimni qanday urishni bilmasligimni juda aniq anglayman; lekin bu zoravon menga nima qilishim kerakligini korsatdi. Shunga kora, ular davom etishdi va bir necha kundan song Antioxyaga kelishdi, u yerda Jozefo Melissoning ozi bilan bir-ikki kun dam olishi uchun uni saqlab turdi va xotiniga nisbatan yetarlicha beparvo bolgani uchun, u uni Melisso buyurishi kerak bolganidek kechki ovqat tayyorlashni qabul qildi; keyin esa, bu uning dostiga yoqqanini korib, ozini bir necha soz bilan oqladi.

en: The lady, as her usance had been in the past, did not as Melisso had ordained, but well nigh alto- gether the contrary; which Giosefo seeing, he was vexed and said, ‘Was it not told thee on what wise thou shouldst prepare the supper?’ The lady, turning round haughtily, answered, ‘What meaneth this?
uz: Xonim, odatdagidek o'tmishda bo'lgani kabi, Melissoning buyurganidek qilmadi, aksincha, juda yaqinlashdi; buni ko'rib, Jozef xafa bo'lib dedi: "Senga kechki ovqatni qanday donolik bilan tayyorlash kerakligi aytilmaganmi?" Xonim o'zini mag'rur his qilib, javob berdi: "Bu nimani anglatadi?"

en: Good lack, why dost thou not sup, an thou have a mind to sup?
uz: Yaxshi yetishmovchilik, nega sup qilmaysan, lekin suplashga aqling yetadi?

en: An if it were told me other- wise, it seemed good to me to do thus.
uz: Agar menga boshqacha ma'lumot aytilsa, shunday qilish menga ma'qul tuyuldi.

en: If it please thee, so be it; if not, leave it be.’ Melisso marvelled at the lady’s answer and blamed her exceedingly; whilst Giosefo, hearing this, said, ‘Wife, thou art still what thou wast wont to be; but, trust me, I will make thee change thy fashion.’ Then turning to Melisso, ‘Friend,’ said he, ‘we shall soon see what manner of counsel was Solomon’s; but I prithee let it not irk thee to stand to see it and hold that which I shall do for a sport.
uz: Agar senga yoqsa, shunday bo'lsin; agar yoqmasa, qo'ya qol." Melisso xonimning javobidan hayratda qoldi va uni juda aybladi; Giosefo esa buni eshitib, dedi: "Xotin, sen hali ham odatdagidek bo'lasan; lekin menga ishon, men seni o'zgartirishga majbur qilaman." Keyin Melissoga o'girilib, u dedi: "Do'stim, biz tez orada Sulaymonning qanday maslahat berganini ko'ramiz; lekin iltimos, uni ko'rishga va men o'yin uchun qiladigan narsani ushlab turishga majbur qilma.

en: And that thou mayest not hinder me, bethink thee of the answer the muleteer made us, when we pitied his mule.’ Quoth Melisso, ‘I am in thy house, where I purpose not to depart from thy good pleasure.’ Giosefo then took a round stick, made of a young oak, and repaired a chamber, whither the lady, having arisen from table for despite, had betaken herself, grumbling; then, laying hold of her by the hair, he threw her down at his feet and proceeded to give her a sore beating with the stick.
uz: Va menga xalaqit bermasliging uchun, o'g'irchoqning o'g'irchog'iga rahm qilganimizda bergan javobini o'ylab ko'r." Quoth Melisso, "Men sening uyingda, sening yaxshiligingdan voz kechmoqchi emasman." Josefo yosh emandan yasalgan dumaloq tayoq oldi va xonani ta'mirladi, u yerda xonim stoldan turib, g'azab bilan o'zini o'ziga urdi; keyin, uni sochidan ushlab, oyoqlariga tashladi va tayoq bilan og'riqli urdi.

en: The lady at ﬁrst cried out and after fell to threats; but, seeing that Giosefo for all that stinted not and being by this time all bruised, she began to cry him mercy for God’s sake and besought him not to kill her, declaring that she would never more depart from his pleasure.
uz: Xonim dastlab qichqirdi, keyin esa tahdidlarga tushdi; lekin, Jozefoning hech narsa uchun qotib qolmaganini va shu vaqtga kelib butunlay shikastlanganini ko'rib, u Xudoga rahm qilishini va uni o'ldirmamasligini so'ragan holda, u boshqa hech qachon uning roziligidan voz kechmasligini e'lon qildi.

en: Nevertheless, he held not his hand; nay, he continued to baste her more furiously than ever on all her seams, belabouring her amain now on the ribs, now on the haunches and now about the shoulder, nor stinted till he was weary and there was not a place left un- bruised on the good lady’s back.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u uning qo'lini ushlab turmadi; aksincha, u uni har qachongidan ham g'azab bilan barcha choklariga ushlab turardi, endi qovurg'alarida, endi tumshuqlarda va endi yelkasiga o'rab turardi, charchagunicha va yaxshi xonimning orqa tomonida jarohatsiz qolmagan joy qolmadi.

en: This done, he returned to his friend and said to him, ‘Tomorrow we shall see what will be the issue of the counsel to go to Goosebridge.’ Then, after he had rested awhile and they had washed
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, u do'stiga qaytib keldi va unga dedi: "Ertaga Goosebridjga borishga bo'lgan maslahat masalasi nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz." Keyin, u biroz dam olgach va ular yuvib bo'lgandan so'ng,

en: their hands, he supped with Melisso and in due season they betook them- selves to bed.
uz: Ularning qo'llarini, u Melisso bilan ovqatlanardi va o'z vaqtida ularni o'zlari yotishga olib ketishdi.

en: Meanwhile the wretched lady arose with great pain from the ground and casting herself on the bed, there rested as best she might until the morning, when she arose betimes and let ask Giosefo what he would have dressed for dinner.
uz: Shu bilan birga, bechora ayol katta og'riq bilan yerdan turdi va o'zini karavotga tashladi, u yerda ertalabgacha imkon qadar dam oldi, keyin u uyg'onib, Giosefodan kechki ovqatga nima kiyganini so'rashi kerak edi.

en: The latter, making merry over this with Melisso, appointed it in due course, and after, whenas it was time, returning, they found everything ex- cellently well done and in accordance with the ordinance given; wherefore they mightily commended the counsel at ﬁrst so ill apprehended of them.
uz: Oxirgisi, bu borada Melisso bilan xursand bo'lib, uni o'z vaqtida tayinladi va keyin, vaqti kelgach, qaytib kelganlarida, hamma narsa allaqachon yaxshi bajarilgan va berilgan tartibga muvofiq ekanligini topdilar; shuning uchun ular maslahatni avvaliga juda yomon tushunib yetgan holda kuchli maqtashdi.

en: After some days, Melisso took leave of Giosefo and returning to his own house, told one, who was a man of understanding, the answer he had had from Solomon; whereupon quoth the other, ‘He could have given thee no truer nor better counsel.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, Meliso Jozefodan xayrlashib, o'z uyiga qaytib keldi va Sulaymondan olgan javobini tushunadigan odamga aytdi; shundan so'ng ikkinchisi: "U senga bundan yaxshiroq va eng yaxshi maslahat bera olmas edi."

en: Thou knowest thou lovest no one, and the honours and services thou renderest others, thou dost not for love that thou bearest them, but for pomp and ostentation.
uz: Sen hech kimni sevmasligingni bilasan va boshqalarga ko'rsatayotgan hurmat va xizmatlarni, ularni ko'tarish uchun emas, balki dabdaba va ko'z-ko'z qilish uchun qilasan.

en: Love, then, as Solomon bade thee, and thou shalt be loved.’ On this wise, then, was the froward wife corrected and the young man, loving, was beloved.”
uz: Shunday qilib, Sulaymon senga buyurganidek sev, shunda sen ham sevilgan bo'lasan. Shunday qilib, beparvo xotin tuzatildi va sevgan yigit sevildi.

en: THE TENTH STORY Dom Gianni, at the instance of his gossip Pietro, performeth a conjuration for the purpose of causing the latter’s wife to become a mare; but, whenas he cometh to put on the tail, Pietro marreth the whole conjuration, saying that he will not have a tail.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Dom Gianni o'zining Pietro haqidagi g'iybatida, ikkinchisining xotini kelin bo'lishi uchun fitna uyushtiradi; lekin, dumiga o'rnatishga kelganda, Pietro butun fitna uyushtiradi va dumi bo'lmaydi, deb aytadi.

en: The queen’s story made the young men laugh and gave rise to some mur- murs on the part of the ladies; then, as soon as the latter were quiet, Dioneo began to speak thus, “Sprightly ladies, a black crow amongst a multitude of white doves addeth more beauty than would a snow-white swan, and in like manner among many sages one less wise is not only an augmentation of splendour and goodliness to their maturity, but eke a source of diversion and solace.
uz: Qirolichaning hikoyasi yigitlarni kuldirdi va ayollar tomonidan ba'zi mur-murslarni keltirib chiqardi; keyin, ular jim bo'lishlari bilanoq, Dioneo shunday dedi: Yorqin ayollar, oq kaptarlar orasida qora qarg'a qor-oq oqqushdan ko'ra ko'proq go'zallik qo'shadi, xuddi shunday qilib, ko'plab donolar orasida kamroq donolik nafaqat ularning yetukligiga hashamat va go'zallik qo'shadi, balki chalg'itish va tasalli manbai bo'ladi.

en: Wherefore, you ladies being all exceeding discreet and modest, I, who savour somewhat of the scatterbrain, should be dearer to you, caus- ing, as I do, your worth to shine the brightlier for my default, than if with my greater merit I made this of yours wax dimmer; and consequently, I should have larger license to show you myself such as I am and should more patiently be suffered of you, in saying that which I shall say, than if I were wiser.
uz: Shuning uchun, siz xonimlar, juda hushyor va kamtarona bo'lganingiz uchun, men, tarqoq miyaning biroz ta'mini his qiladigan odam, siz uchun qimmatroq bo'lishim kerak, men qilganimdek, sizning qadringiz mening yo'qligim uchun yanada yorqinroq porlashi kerak, agar mening katta mukofotim bilan sizning bu narsangizni xiralashtirgan bo'lsam; va shuning uchun, men sizga o'zim qanday bo'lsam, shundayligini ko'rsatish uchun kattaroq huquqga ega bo'lishim kerak va sizdan sabr bilan azob chekishim kerak, agar men dono bo'lsam, aytgan gaplarimdan ko'ra.

en: I will, therefore, tell you a story not overlong, whereby you may apprehend how diligently it behoveth to observe the conditions imposed by those who do aught by means of enchantment and how slight a default thereof sufﬁceth to mar everything done by the magician.
uz: Shunday qilib, men sizga juda uzun bo'lmagan hikoyani aytib beraman, unda sehrgarlik orqali hech narsa qilmaydiganlar tomonidan qo'yilgan shartlarni qanchalik astoydil kuzatish zarurligini va sehrgar tomonidan qilingan hamma narsani buzish uchun uning ozgina buzilishi qanchalik yetarli ekanligini tushunishingiz mumkin.

en: A year or two agone there was at Barletta a priest called Dom Gianni di Barolo, who, for that he had but a poor curé, took to eking out his liveli- hood by hawking merchandise hither and thither about the fairs of Apulia with a mare of his and buying and selling.
uz: Bir-ikki yil o'tgach, Barlettada Dom Gianni di Barolo ismli ruhoniy bor edi. U faqat kambag'al ruhoniy bo'lgani uchun, Apuliya yarmarkalari bo'ylab bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa savdo-sotiq qilib, o'z tirikchilik qalpoqlarini ko'chirishni boshlagan edi.

en: In the course of his travels he contracted a strait friendship with one who styled himself Pietro da Tresanti and plied the same trade with the aid of an ass he had.
uz: Sayohatlari davomida u Pietro da Tresanti deb nomlangan odam bilan yaqin do'stlik o'rnatdi va o'zida bor bo'lgan eshak yordamida xuddi shu savdoni amalga oshirdi.

en: In token of friendship
uz: Do'stlik ramzi sifatida

en: and affection, he called him still Gossip Pietro, after the Apulian fashion, and whenassoever he visited Barletta, he carried him to his parsonage and there lodged him with himself and entertained him to the best of his power.
uz: va mehr bilan, u uni hali ham Gossip Pietro deb atardi, Apuliya uslubiga ko'ra, va qachonki u Barlettaga tashrif buyursa, uni o'z ibodatxonasiga olib borardi va u yerda o'zi bilan yotardi va uni qo'lidan kelgancha xursand qildi.

en: Gossip Pietro, on his part, albeit he was very poor and had but a sorry little house at Tresanti, scarce sufﬁcing for himself and a young and buxom wife he had and his ass, as often as Dom Gianni came to Tresanti, carried him home with him and entertained him as best he might, in requital of the hos- pitality received from him at Barletta.
uz: Pietro, o'z navbatida, juda kambag'al bo'lishiga qaramay va Tresantida achinarli kichkina uyi bo'lishiga qaramay, o'ziga yetarli bo'lmagan, yosh va serhosil xotini va dumbalari bor edi. Dom Gianni Tresantiga kelganida, uni u bilan birga uyga olib borardi va Barletta'da undan olgan mehribonlik evaziga imkon qadar ko'nglini soladi.

en: Nevertheless, in the matter of lodging, having but one sorry little bed, in which he slept with his hand- some wife, he could not entertain him as he would, but, Dom Gianni’s mare being lodged with Pietro’s ass in a little stable he had, needs must the priest himself lie by her side on a truss of straw.
uz: Shunga qaramay, turar joy masalasida, faqat bitta achinarli kichkina karavotga ega bo'lib, u yerda qo'li bilan uxlardi - bir xotin, uni o'zi xohlaganidek ko'rtara olmasdi, lekin Dom Gianniyning kelini Petrening eshagisi bilan o'zining kichik o'rmonida yotgani uchun, ruhoniyning o'zi uning yonida somon ustida yotishi kerak edi.

en: The goodwife, knowing the hospitality which the latter did her husband at Barletta, would more than once, whenas the priest came thither, have gone to lie with a neighbor of hers, by name Zita Caraprese, [daughter] of Giudice Leo, so he might sleep in the bed with her husband, and had many a time proposed it to Dom Gianni, but he would never hear of it; and once, amongst other times, he said to her, ‘Gossip Gemmata, fret not thyself for me; I fare very well, for that, whenas it pleaseth me, I cause this mare of mine become a handsome wench and couch with her, and after, when I will, I change her into a mare again; wherefore I care not to part from her.’ The young woman marvelled, but believed his tale and told her husband, saying, ‘If he is so much thy friend as thou sayest, why dost thou not make him teach thee his charm, so thou mayst avail to make of me a mare and do thine affairs
uz: Yaxshi xotin, erining Barlettada qilgan mehmondo'stligini bilgan holda, ruhoniy u yerga kelganida, bir necha marta uning qo'shnisi Zita Karaprese, Giudice Leoning qizi bilan yotishga borardi, toki u erining yotoqida uxlasin va buni Dom Gianniga ko'p taklif qilgan edi, lekin u buni hech qachon eshitmagan edi; va bir marta u unga dedi: "Gossip Gemmata, o'zingni men uchun tashvishlantirma; men juda yaxshi ketaman, chunki menga yoqqan paytda, men o'zimning bu qizimni unga kelin bo'lishga majbur qilaman va u bilan yotaman, keyin, men uni yana kelin bo'lishga o'zgartiraman; shuning uchun men undan ajralmayman." Ayolning qo'llari bilan aytdi: "Agar u menga shunday ish qilsam, u senga shunday qilib,

en: with the ass and the mare?
uz: Eshak va ot bilanmi?

en: So should we gain two for one; and when we were back at home, thou couldst make me a woman again, as I am.’ Pietro, who was somewhat dull of wit, believed what she said and fall- ing in with her counsel, began, as best he knew, to importune Dom Gianni to teach him the trick.
uz: Shunday qilib, ikkitadan bittasi uchun yutsak; va uyga qaytib kelganimizda, meni yana shunday ayol qila olasiz, xuddi men kabi. Biroz g'alati aqlga ega bo'lgan Pietro, uning aytganlariga ishondi va uning maslahatiga qo'shilib, o'zi bilganidek, Dom Gianni unga hiylani o'rgatishga unday boshladi.

en: The latter did his best to cure him of that folly, but availing not thereto, he said, ‘Harkye, since you will e’en have it so, we will arise tomorrow morning before day, as of our wont, and I will show you how it is done.
uz: Oxirgisi uni o'sha ahmoqlikdan davolash uchun bor kuchini sarfladi, lekin bunga erisha olmadi va dedi: Harkye, agar sizda shunday bo'lsa, ertaga ertalab ertalabdan oldin, odatdagidek turamiz va bu qanday amalga oshirilishini sizga ko'rsataman.

en: To tell thee the truth, the uneathest part of the matter is the putting on of the tail, as thou shalt see.’ Accordingly, whenas it drew near unto day, Goodman Pietro and Gossip Gemmata, who had scarce slept that night, with such impatience did they await the accomplishment of the matter, arose and called Dom Gianni, who, arising in his shirt, betook himself to Pietro’s little chamber and said to him,
uz: Rostini aytsam, masalaning eng xunuk qismi dumni kiyishdir, ko'rasiz." Shunday qilib, kun yaqinlashganda, o'sha kecha kam uxlagan Yaxshi odam Pietro va Gossip Gemmata, masalaning amalga oshirilishini shunday sabrsizlik bilan kutishardi, turib Dom Gianni chaqirdilar, u esa ko'ylagida turib, Petroning kichik xonasiga yaqinlashib, unga dedi:

en: ‘I know none in the world, except you, for whom I would do this; where- fore since it pleaseth you, I will e’en do it; but needs must you do as I shall bid you, an you would have the thing succeed.’ They answered that they would do that which he should say; whereupon, taking the light, he put it into Pietro’s hand and said to him, ‘Mark how I shall do and keep well in mind that which I shall say.
uz: Dunyoda sizdan boshqa hech kimni bilmayman, men buni kim uchun qilmoqchi bo'lganimni; chunki bu sizga yoqsa, men ham qilaman; lekin men sizga buyurganimni qilishingiz kerak, shunda ish muvaffaqiyatli bo'ladi. Ular javob berishdi: ular u aytgan narsani qilishardi; shundan so'ng, yorug'likni olib, Petroning qo'liga qo'ydi va unga dedi: "Qanday qilishim kerakligini aniqlashtiring va nima deyishimni yaxshilab eslang."

en: Above all, have a care, an thou wouldst not mar everything, that, whatsoever thou hearest or seest, thou say not a single word, and pray God that the tail may stick fast.’ Pietro took the light, prom- ising to do exactly as he said, whereupon Dom Gianni let strip Gemmata naked as she was born and caused her stand on all fours, mare-fashion, en- joining herself likewise not to utter a word for aught that should betide.
uz: Eng muhimi, ehtiyot bo'ling, hamma narsani buzmasliging kerak, eshitgan yoki ko'rgan narsangdan birorta ham so'z aytmasliging kerak, va Xudoga duming mahkam yopishsin deb ibodat qil." Pietro nurni oldi, aytganidek ish tutdi, shundan so'ng Dom Gianni Gemmata tug'ilganidek yalang'och holda qo'ydi va uni to'rt oyoqda turishga majbur qildi, xuddi shunday qilib, o'ziga kelishi kerak bo'lgan narsa uchun bir so'z aytmaslikka qo'shildi.

en: Then, passing his hand over her face and her head, he proceeded to say, ‘Be this a ﬁne mare’s head,’ and touching her hair, said, ‘Be this a ﬁne mare’s mane’; after which he touched her arms, saying, ‘Be these ﬁne mare’s legs and feet,’ and coming presently to her breast and ﬁnding it round and ﬁrm, such an one awoke that was not called and started up on end,442 whereupon quoth he, ‘Be this a ﬁne mare’s chest.’ And on like wise he did with her back and belly and crupper and thighs and legs.
uz: So'ngra, qo'lini uning yuziga va boshiga o'tkazib, u dedi: "Bu mayda echki bosh bo'lsin", va sochlariga tegdi, dedi: "Bu mayda echki burn bo'lsin"; so'ngra u uning qo'llariga tegdi, dedi: "Bu mayda echki oyoqlari va oyoqlari bo'lsin", va darhol uning ko'ksiga kelib, uni yumaloq va mustahkam topdi, shunday uyg'onib ketdiki, chaqirilmadi va oxiriga yetdi, 442 shundan so'ng u: "Bu mayda echki ko'kragi bo'lsin", dedi.

en: Ultimately, nothing remain- ing to do but the tail, he pulled up his shirt and taking the dibble with which he planted men, he thrust it hastily into the furrow made therefor and said, ‘And be this a ﬁne mare’s tail.’ Pietro, who had thitherto watched everything intently, seeing this last proceeding and himseeming it was ill done, said, ‘Ho there, Dom Gianni, I won’t have a tail there, I won’t have a tail there!’ The radical moisture, wherewith all plants are made fast, was by this come, and Dom Gianni drew it forth, saying, ‘Alack, gossip Pietro, what hast thou done?
uz: Oxir-oqibat, dumdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi, u ko'ylagini tortdi va odamlarni ekkan bo'lsa, o'sha dumg'azani oldi, shoshilinch ravishda o'sha uchun yasalgan o'rmaga itarib, dedi: "Va bu mayda dengiz dumi bo'lsin." Pyotro, shu paytgacha hamma narsani diqqat bilan kuzatib borgan, bu oxirgi harakatni ko'rib, uni yomon qilingan deb o'ylagan, dedi: "Xo'sh, Dom Gianni, menda u yerda dum yo'q, menda u yerda dum yo'q!" "Barcha o'simliklar tez tayyorlanadigan radikal namlik shu sababli keldi va Dom Gianni uni tortib, dedi: "Alak, g'iybat, sen nima qilding?"

en: Did I not bid thee say not a word for aught that thou shouldst see?
uz: Men senga ko'rishing kerak bo'lgan narsa uchun birorta so'z aytmaslikni buyurmadimmi?

en: The mare was all made; but thou hast marred everything by talking, nor is there any means of doing it over again henceforth.’ Quoth Pietro, ‘Marry, I did not want that tail there.
uz: "Butun narsa tayyor edi; lekin sen gapirib hamma narsani buzding, bundan buyon buni qayta qilishning hech qanday iloji yo'q." Quoth Pietro dedi: "Uylan, men u yerda o'sha dumni xohlamadim."

en: Why did you not say to me, “Make it thou”?
uz: Nega menga "O'zing qil" demading?

en: More by token that you were for setting it too low.’ ‘Because,’ answered Dom Gianni, ‘thou hadst not known for the ﬁrst time to set it on so well as I.’ The young woman, hearing all this, stood up and said to her husband, in all good faith, ‘Dolt that thou art, why hast thou marred thine affairs and mine?
uz: Ko'proq shuni anglatadiki, siz uni juda past qo'ygan edingiz. Chunki, javob berdi Dom Gianni, sen uni birinchi marta men kabi yaxshi qo'yishni bilmas eding. Buni eshitgan yosh ayol o'rnidan turdi va eriga butun yaxshi niyat bilan dedi: Sen shunday ekansan, nega o'z ishlaringni va mening ishlarimni buzding?

en: What mare saw- est thou ever without a tail?
uz: Qaysi dengizni hech qachon dumsiz ko'rgansiz?

en: So God aid me, thou art poor, but it would serve thee right, wert thou much poorer.’ Then, there being now, by reason of the words that Pietro had spoken, no longer any means of making a mare
uz: Shunday qilib, Xudo menga yordam bersin, sen kambag'alsan, lekin bu senga to'g'ri bo'lardi, agar sen ancha kambag'alroq bo'lsang." O'shanda, endi Petroning aytgan so'zlari tufayli, endi dengizga chiqishning hech qanday vositasi yo'q edi.

en: of the young woman, she donned her clothes, woebegone and disconsolate, and Pietro, continuing to ply his old trade with an ass, as he was used, betook himself, in company with Dom Gianni, to the Bitonto fair, nor ever again required him of such a service.” How much the company laughed at this story, which was better understood of the ladies than Dioneo willed, let her who shall yet laugh thereat imagine for herself.
uz: Yosh ayolning kiyimlarini kiydirdi, xafa bo'ldi va xafa bo'ldi, Pietro esa eski hunarini eshak bilan davom ettirib, u odatdagidek, Dom Gianni bilan birga Bitonto yarmarkasiga bordi va undan bunday xizmatni talab qilmadi.

en: But, the day’s stories being now ended and the sun beginning to abate of its heat, the queen, knowing the end of her seignory to be come, rose to her feet and putting off the crown, set it on the head of Pamﬁlo, whom alone it remained to honour after such a fashion, and said, smiling, “My lord, there devolveth on thee a great burden, inasmuch as with thee it resteth, thou being the last, to make amends for my default and that of those who have foregone me in the dignity which thou presently holdest; whereof God lend thee grace, even as He hath vouchsafed it unto me to make thee king.” Pamﬁlo blithely received the honour done him and answered, “Your merit and that of my other subjects will do on such wise that I shall be ad- judged deserving of commendation, even as the others have been.” Then, having, according to the usance of his predecessors, taken order with the seneschal of the
uz: Ammo, kun hikoyalari endi tugagach va quyoshning issig'i so'nay boshlaganda, malika, o'z oliyjanobligining oxiri kelishini bilgach, oyoqqa turdi va tojni yechdi, uni Pamfilaning boshiga qo'ydi. Bunday uslubda uni sharaflash uchun faqat u qoldi va tabassum bilan dedi: "Ey xo'jayinim, senga katta yuk yuk tushadi, chunki senga qolganidek, sen oxirgi bo'lib, mening xatoyim va meni hozirda bor hurmatda yo'qotganlar uchun tuzatish berasan; Xudo senga marhamat beradi, hatto u menga seni shoh qilish uchun berganidek." Pamfilo esa unga qilingan hurmatni qabul qildi va javob berdi: "Sen va mening boshqa sub'yodimning bunday marhamatlariga ko'ra, men seni qabul qilmoqchiman.

en: things that were needful, he turned to the expectant ladies and said to them, “Lovesome ladies, it was the pleasure of Emilia, who hath this day been our queen, to give you, for the purpose of affording some rest to your powers, license to discourse of that which should most please you; wherefore, you being now rested, I hold it well to return to the wonted or- dinance, and accordingly I will that each of you bethink herself to discourse tomorrow of this, to wit, OF WHOSO HATH ANYWISE WROUGHT GENEROUSLY OR MAGNIFICENTLY IN MATTERS OF LOVE OR OTHERWHAT.
uz: Kerakli bo'lgan narsalar haqida gapirganda, u kutilayotgan xonimlarga murojaat qildi va ularga dedi: Sevgili xonimlar, bu kun bizning malika bo'lgan Emiliyaning zavqi edi, sizga qudratingizga biroz dam berish maqsadida, sizga eng ko'p yoqishi kerak bo'lgan narsani nutq so'zlash huquqini berish uchun; shuning uchun, endi dam olganingizdan so'ng, men odatdagidek nutqga qaytishni yaxshi ko'raman va shunga ko'ra, har biringiz ertaga bu haqda, ya'ni, sevgi yoki boshqa masalalarda G'ayrioddiy yoki Kattalik bilan sodir bo'lgan narsa haqida nutq so'zlash uchun o'zingizni o'ylaysiz.

en: The telling and doing of these things will doubtless ﬁre your well-disposed minds to do worthily; so will our life, which may not be other than brief in this mortal body, be made perpetual in laudatory renown; a thing which all, who serve not the belly only, as do the beasts, should not only desire, but with all diligence seek and endeavour after.” The theme pleased the joyous company, who having all, with the new king’s license, arisen from session, gave themselves to their wonted diver- sions, according to that unto which each was most drawn by desire; and on
uz: Bularni aytib berish va qilish, shubhasiz, sizning yaxshi niyatli ongingizni munosib ish qilishga undaydi; shunday qilib, bu o'luvchi tanada qisqa bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan hayotimiz ham maqtovga sazovor bo'ladi; bu narsa faqat qorniga xizmat qilmaydigan, hayvonlar kabi, faqat orzu qilmasligi kerak, balki butun mehnat bilan izlashi va intilishi kerak.

en: this wise they did until the hour of supper, whereunto they came joyously and were served with diligence and fair ordinance.
uz: Ular bu hikmatni kechki ovqat soatigacha qilishdi, u yerga xursandchilik bilan kelishdi va mehnatsevarlik va adolatli tartib bilan xizmat ko'rsatildi.

en: Supper at an end, they arose to the wonted dances, and after they had sung a thousand canzonets, more diverting of words than masterly of music, the king bade Neiﬁle sing one in her own name; whereupon, with clear and blithesome voice, she cheerfully and without delay began thus: A youngling maid am I and full of glee,  Am fain to carol in the new-blown May,  Love and sweet thoughts-a-mercy, blithe and free.
uz: Kechki ovqatdan so'ng, ular mashhur raqslarga ko'tarilishdi va mingta qo'shiq kuylagandan so'ng, so'zlardan ko'ra mohirona musiqaga ko'ra ko'proq chalg'ituvchi, shoh Neifil o'z nomidan bir qo'shiq kuylashni buyurdi; shundan so'ng, tiniq va shiddatli ovoz bilan, u xursandchilik bilan va kechikmasdan shunday boshladi: Men yosh xizmatkorman va quvonchga to'la, Yangi May oyida kuylashga moyilman, Sevgi va shirin fikrlar - rahm-shafqat, xushchaqchaq va ozod.

en: I go about the meads, considering  The vermeil ﬂowers and golden and the white,  Roses thorn-set and lilies snowy-bright,  And one and all I fare a-likening  Unto his face who hath with love-liking  Ta’en and will hold me ever, having aye  None other wish than as his pleasures be; Whereof when one I ﬁnd me that doth show,  Unto my seeming, likest him, full fain  I cull and kiss and talk with it amain  And all my heart to it, as best I know,  Discover, with its store of wish and woe,  Then it with others in a wreath I lay,  Bound with my hair so golden-bright of blee.
uz: Men o'tloqlar atrofida aylanib yuraman, Vervuil gullari va oltin va oq ranglarni, Tikanli atirgullar va qorli-yorqin nilufarlarni o'ylab, Va men faqat va faqat sevgi Ta'en bilan bo'lgan va meni doimo ushlab turadigan yuziga o'xshash bo'laman, hech qachon boshqa istak yo'q, faqat uning lazzatlari bo'lishi kerak; Qachonki meni ko'rsatsam, Mening ko'rinishimga ko'ra, uni yoqtiradi, to'la mehribonlik bilan uni kesaman va o'paman va u bilan gaplashaman Va unga butun qalbim bilan, eng yaxshi bilganimdek, O'zimni topaman, uning qayg'usi va istaklari bilan, Keyin u boshqalar bilan gulda yotaman, Sochlarim bilan bog'langan, juda oltin-yorqin.

en: Ay, and that pleasure which the eye doth prove,  By nature, of the ﬂower’s view, like delight  Doth give me as I saw the very wight  Who hath inﬂamed me of his dulcet love,  And what its scent thereover and above  Worketh in me, no words indeed can say;  But sighs thereof bear witness true for me, The which from out my bosom day nor night  Ne’er, as with other ladies, ﬁerce and wild,  Storm up; nay, thence they issue warm and mild  And straight betake them to my loved one’s sight,  Who, hearing, moveth of himself, delight
uz: Ha, va ko'z isbotlaydigan lazzat, Tabiatga ko'ra, gulning ko'rinishidan, xuddi o'zining shirin muhabbatidan meni yondirgan kuchni ko'rganimdek, menga beradi. Va uning hidi mendan ustun va ustun ishlaydi, hech qanday so'z bo'lmaydi; Lekin uning ohlari men uchun haqiqatga guvohlik beradi, U mening ko'kragimdan kunduzi ham, kechasi ham boshqa ayollar kabi, shiddatli va yovvoyi, bo'ron ko'tarmaydi; yo'q, undan ular issiq va yumshoq chiqadilar va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sevganimning ko'ziga o'tadilar, U eshitib, o'zidan harakatlanadi,

en: To give me; ay, and when I’m like to say  “Ah come, lest I despair,” still cometh he.
uz: Menga bermoq; ha, va qachonki men "Ah kel, umidsizlikka tushmasam" demoqchi bo'lsam, u baribir keladi.
