uz: Shunga ko'ra, u qaytib, o'tirganida, ularning hammasi uni kutganini topdi, xuddi xonim ham, har doimgidan ham go'zalroq va sog'lomroq, va uning kichkina o'g'li ham yaxshi holatda edi, va u mehmonlarini stolga o'tqazganidan ifodalab bo'lmaydigan quvonch bilan, ularga ajoyib tarzda turli xil go'shtlar taklif qildi.

en: Whenas the repast was near its end, having ﬁrst told the lady what he meant to do and taken order with her of the course that she should hold, he began to speak thus: ‘Gentlemen, I remember to have heard whiles that there is in Persia a custom and to my thinking a pleasant one, to wit, that, whenas any is minded supremely to honour a friend of his, he biddeth him to his house and there showeth him the thing, be it wife or mistress or daughter or whatsoever else, he holdeth most dear, avouching that, like as he showeth him this, even so, an he might, would he yet more willingly show him his very heart; which custom I purpose to observe in Bologna.
uz: Ovqatning oxiriga yaqinlashganda, u xonimga nima qilishni o'ylayotganini aytib, u bilan o'zi tutishi kerak bo'lgan kursni buyurib, u shunday dedi: "Janoblar, eslaymanki, Forsda odat bor va menimcha, yoqimli odat bor, ya'ni, har kim o'z do'stini hurmat qilishni juda xohlasa, u uni o'z uyiga taklif qiladi va u yerga narsa ko'rsatadi, u yerda xotin, bekasi, qizi yoki boshqa har qanday narsani ko'rsatadi, u buni ko'rsatgandek, u yanada ko'proq ko'nglini ko'rsatadi, buni men Bolonyada kuzatishni maqsad qilganman."

en: You, of your favour, have honoured my banquet with your presence, and I in turn mean to honour you, after the Persian fashion, by showing you the most precious thing I have or may ever have in the world.
uz: Siz, o'z marhamatingiz bilan, mening ziyofatimni sizning huzuringiz bilan sharafladingiz, va men, o'z navbatida, sizni Fors uslubida, dunyodagi eng qimmatbaho narsamni ko'rsatish orqali sharaflamoqchiman.

en: But, ere I proceed to do this, I pray you tell me what you deem of a doubt452 which I shall broach to you and which is this.
uz: Lekin, men buni amalga oshirishdan oldin, iltimos, sizga taqdim etadigan 452 ta shubha haqida nima deb hisoblayotganingizni va bu nima ekanligini ayting.

en: A certain person hath in his house a very faithful and good servant, who falleth grievously sick, whereupon the former, without awaiting the sick man’s end, letteth carry him into the middle street and hath no more heed of him.
uz: Bir odamning uyida juda sadoqatli va yaxshi xizmatkori bor, u og'ir kasal bo'lib qoladi, shundan so'ng uning oxirini kutmasdan, uni o'rta ko'chaga olib boradi va unga endi e'tibor bermaydi.

en: Cometh a stranger, who, moved to compassion of the sick man, carrieth him off to his own house and with great diligence and expense bringeth him again to his former health.
uz: Begona odam keladi, u bemorga rahm qilib, uni o'z uyiga olib ketadi va katta mehnat va xarajatlar bilan uni avvalgi sog'lig'iga qaytaradi.

en: Now I would fain know whether, if he keep him and make use of his services, his former master can in equity complain of or blame the second, if, he demanding him again, the latter refuse to restore him.’ The gentlemen, after various discourse among themselves, concurring all in one opinion, committed the response to Niccoluccio Caccianimico, for that he was a goodly and eloquent speaker; whereupon the latter, having ﬁrst commended the Persian usage, declared that he and all the rest were of opinion that the ﬁrst master had no longer any right in his servant, since he had, in such a circumstance, not only abandoned him, but cast him away, and that, for the kind ofﬁces done him by the second, themseemed the ser- vant was justly become his; wherefore, in keeping him, he did the ﬁrst no hurt, no violence, no unright whatsoever.
uz: Endi men bilmoqchiman, agar u uni saqlab qolsa va xizmatlaridan foydalansa, uning sobiq xo'jayini ikkinchisidan adolat bilan shikoyat qilishi yoki ayblashi mumkinmi, agar u undan yana talab qilsa, u uni tiklashni rad etsa." Janoblar o'zaro turli xil bahslardan so'ng, hammasi bir fikrda bo'lib, Nikolutsiyo Katsyanimga javob berishdi, chunki u yaxshi va notiq edi; shundan so'ng, oxirgi, avval fors tilini maqtatib, u va qolganlarning fikricha, birinchi xo'jayinning o'z xizmatkoriga hech qanday huquqi yo'q edi, chunki u bunday vaziyatda uni tashlab qo'ymagan, balki tashlab yuborgan, va unga zarar yetkazgan yaxshi vazifalar tufayli, ular uni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ma'ruzachiga aylantirgan edilar;

en: The other guests at table (and there were men there of worth and worship) said all of one accord that they
uz: Boshqa mehmonlar (va u yerda qadr-qimmatli va sig'inuvchi odamlar bor edi) bir ovozdan aytdilarki, ular...

en: held to that which had been answered by Niccoluccio; and Messer Gentile, well pleased with this response and that Niccoluccio had made it, avouched himself also to be of the same opinion.
uz: Nikolutsiy tomonidan javob berilgan narsaga sodiq qoldi; va Messer Gentile, bu javobdan va Nikolutsiy buni qilganidan xursand bo'lib, o'zi ham xuddi shunday fikrda bo'lishga qaror qildi.

en: Then said he, ‘It is now time that I honour you according to promise,’ and calling two of his servants, des- patched them to the lady, whom he had let magniﬁcently dress and adorn, praying her be pleased to come gladden the company with her presence.
uz: Shunda u dedi: Seni vada boyicha hurmat qilish vaqti keldi va ikki xizmatchisini chaqirib, ularni xonimga yopishtirdi. U ularni ajoyib tarzda kiydirib, bezatgan edi va uning huzurida odamlarni xursand qilish uchun kelishini soradi.

en: Accordingly, she took her little son, who was very handsome, in her arms and coming into the banqueting-hall, attended by two serving-men seated herself, as Messer Gentile willed it, by the side of a gentleman of high standing.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u o'zining kichkina o'g'lini, juda chiroyli ko'rinishga ega bo'lganini quchoqladi va ziyofat zaliga kirib, ikki xizmatchi ishtirok etib, o'zi, janob Gentil xohlaganidek, yuqori martabali janobning yonida o'tirdi.

en: Then said he, ‘Gentlemen, this is the thing which I hold and pur- pose to hold dearer than any other; look if it seem to you that I have reason to do so.’ The guests, having paid her the utmost honour, commending her amain and declaring to Messer Gentile that he might well hold her dear, fell to looking upon her; and there were many there who had avouched her to be herself,453 had they not held her for dead.
uz: Shunda u dedi: Janoblar, men buni boshqalardan kora qadrlayman va qadrlayman; koringlar-chi, men buni qilishga asosim bor deb tuyulsa. Mehmonlar uni juda hurmat bilan maqtashdi va Janob Gentilega uni yaxshi korish mumkinligini elon qilishdi, unga qarashga tushishdi; va uni ozi deb oylagan kop odamlar bor edi, 453 agar ular uni olik deb hisoblamagan bolishardi.

en: But Niccoluccio gazed upon her above all and unable to contain himself, asked her, (Messer Gentile having withdrawn awhile), as one who burned to know who she was, if she were a Bolognese lady or a foreigner.
uz: Ammo Nikolutsiy unga hamma narsadan ustun tikilib, o'zini tuta olmadi va undan so'radi, (Messer Gentile biroz chekinib, u Bolonyalik ayolmi yoki chet ellikmi, kimligini bilishga ishtiyoqmandek).

en: The lady, seeing herself questioned of her husband, hardly restrained herself from answering; but yet, to observe the appointed ordinance, she held her peace.
uz: Xonim eridan so'ralayotganini ko'rib, javob berishdan o'zini deyarli tiymadi; ammo, belgilangan tartibga rioya qilish uchun, u jim turdi.

en: Another asked her if the child was hers and a third if she were Messer Gentile’s wife or anywise akin to him; but she made them no reply.
uz: Yana biri undan bolaning o'ziniki ekanligini, uchinchisi esa Messer Gentile'ning xotini yoki unga o'xshashligini so'radi; lekin u ularga javob bermadi.

en: Presently, Messer Gentile coming up, one of his guests said to him, ‘Sir, this is a fair creature of yours, but she seemeth to us mute; is she so?’ ‘Gentlemen,’ replied he, ‘her not having spoken at this present is no small proof of her virtue.’ And the other said, ‘Tell us, then, who she is.’ Quoth Messer Gentile, ‘That will I gladly, so but you will promise me that none, for aught that I shall say, will budge from his place till such time as I shall have made an end of my story.’ All promised this and the tables being presently removed, Messer Gen- tile, seating himself beside the lady, said, ‘Gentlemen, this lady is that loyal and faithful servant, of whom I questioned you awhile agone and who, be- ing held little dear of her folk and so, as a thing without worth and no longer useful, cast out into the midward of the street, was by me taken up; yea, by my solicitude and of my
uz: Hozirda, janob Gentil yaqinlashib kelayotgan edi, uning mehmonlaridan biri unga dedi: "Janob, bu sizning go'zal maxluqingiz, lekin u bizga jim ko'rinadi; shundaymi?" "Janoblar," javob berdi u, "uning bu hozirda gapirmagani uning fazilatining hech qanday dalili emas." Va ikkinchisi aytdi: "Shunday qilib, u kim ekanligini ayting." "Men xursand bo'laman, lekin siz menga hech kim, men aytganim uchun, men hikoyamni tugatguncha, uning joydan qimirlamasligiga va'da berasiz."

en: handiwork I brought her forth of the jaws of death, and God, having regard to my good intent, hath caused her, by my means, from a frightful corpse become thus beautiful.
uz: Men uni o'lim qovurg'asidan olib chiqdim, va Xudo mening yaxshi niyatimga ko'ra, uni qo'rqinchli murdadan shu qadar go'zal qilib yaratdi, o'z yordamim bilan.

en: more manifestly apprehend how this betided me, I will brieﬂy declare it to you.’ Then, beginning from his falling enamoured of her, he particularly re- lated to them that which had passed until that time, to the great wonderment of the hearers, and added, ‘By reason of which things, an you, and espe- cially Niccoluccio, have not changed counsel since awhile ago, the lady is fairly mine, nor can any with just title demand her again of me.’ To this none made answer; nay, all awaited that which he should say farther; whilst Niccoluccio and the lady and certain of the others who were there wept for compassion.454 Then Messer Gentile, rising to his feet and taking the little child in his arms and the lady by the hand, made for Niccoluccio and said to him, ‘Rise up, gossip; I do not restore thee thy wife, whom thy kinsfolk and hers cast away; nay, but I will well bestow on thee this lady my
uz: Bu menga qanday ta'sir ko'rsatganini aniqroq tushunib yeting, men buni sizga qisqacha e'lon qilaman." Keyin, u unga oshiq bo'lganidan boshlab, u eshitganlarning katta hayratlanishiga olib kelgan o'sha vaqtgacha bo'lgan voqealarni ularga alohida ta'kidladi va qo'shimcha qildi: "Shuning uchun, siz va ayniqsa Nikolukcio, ancha vaqt oldin maslahatini o'zgartirmagansiz, xonim juda o'zimniki, hech kim uni mendan yana talab qila olmaydi." Bunga hech kim javob bermadi; yo'q, hamma u nima deyishini kutdi; Nikolukcio va xonim va u yerda bo'lgan boshqalarning ba'zilari esa rahm-shafqat uchun tashlab ketishdi. 454 Shunda Messer Gentile o'rnidan turib, o'z qo'llari bilan kichkina xonimni qo'liga olib, uni senga va unga aytdi: "Men senga yaxshilik qilaman, lekin sening

en: gossip, with this her little son, who I am assured, was begotten of thee and whom I held at bap- tism and named Gentile; and I pray thee that she be none the less dear to thee for that she hath abidden near upon three months in my house; for I swear to thee —by that God who belike caused me aforetime fall in love with her, to the intent that my love might be, as in effect it hath been, the occasion of her deliverance —that never, whether with father or mother or with thee, hath she lived more chastely than she hath done with my mother in my house.’ So saying, he turned to the lady and said to her, ‘Madam, from this time forth I absolve you of every promise made me and leave you free [to return] to Niccoluccio.’455 Then, giving the lady and the child into Niccoluccio’s arms, he returned to his seat.
uz: Shu bilan uning kichkina o'g'li, men ishonamanki, sendan tug'ilgan va men uni batismda ushlab, butparast deb ataganman; va senga iltimos qilaman, u mening uyimda uch oy yaqin qolganligi uchun senga unchalik qadrli bo'lmasin; chunki senga qasam ichaman: "Xonim, bu vaqtdan boshlab menga muhabbat qo'zg'atdi, mening muhabbatim uning ozod bo'lishi uchun, xuddi shunday bo'lgani kabi, uning ozod bo'lish vaqti bo'lishi uchun"  otasi bilan ham, onasi bilan ham, sen bilan ham, u mening uyimda onam bilan qilganidan ko'ra xolisroq yashamagan.

en: Niccoluccio received them with the utmost eagerness, so much the more rejoiced as he was the farther re- moved from hope thereof, and thanked Messer Gentile, as best he might and knew; whilst the others, who all wept for compassion, commended the latter amain of this; yea, and he was commended of whosoever heard it.
uz: Nikolutsiy ularni juda katta ishtiyoq bilan qabul qildi, shunchalik xursand bo'ldiki, u umididan yanada ko'proq qaytdi va Messer Gentilga imkon qadar minnatdorchilik bildirdi va bildi; qolganlar esa, hammasi rahm-shafqatdan yig'laganlar, oxirgilarni bundan hayratda qoldirishdi; ha, va u buni eshitgan har bir kishi tomonidan maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.

en: The lady was received in her house with marvellous rejoicing and long beheld with amazement by the Bolognese, as one raised from the dead; whilst Messer Gentile ever after abode a friend of Niccoluccio and of his kinsfolk and those of the lady.
uz: Xonim o'z uyiga ajoyib quvonch bilan qabul qilindi va Bolonyaliklar tomonidan o'liklardan tirilgandek uzoq hayrat bilan ko'rildi; Messer Gentile esa do'sti Nikolutsiy, uning qarindoshlari va xonimning do'sti bo'lib turardi.

en: What, then, gentle ladies, will you say [of this case]?
uz: Xo'sh, janob xonimlar, bu haqda nima deysiz?

en: Is, think you, a king’s having given away his sceptre and his crown or an abbot’s having, without cost to himself, reconciled an evildoer with the pope or an old man’s having proffered his weasand to the enemy’s knife to be evened with this deed of Messer Gentile, who, being young and ardent and himseeming
uz: Sizningcha, qirol o'z qamchini va tojini yoki abbat o'ziga bepul ravishda yovuz odamni Papa bilan yarashtirganmi yoki keksa odam o'z bedarakdorligini va dushmanning pichog'ini dushmanning bu ishini tenglashtirishga taklif qilganmi, kichik bir begona xalqning, yosh va g'ayratli va...

en: he had a just title to that which the heedlessness of others had cast away and he of his good fortune had taken up, not only honourably tempered his ar- dour, but, having in his possession that which he was still wont with all his thoughts to covet and to seek to steal away, freely restored it [to its owner]?
uz: Uning boshqalarning beparvoligi yo'qotgan narsaga adolatli huquqi bor edi va u o'z boyligidan foydalanardi, nafaqat o'z ar-duriga hurmat bilan ishlov berdi, balki o'zida hali ham o'ziga xos bo'lgan va o'g'irlashga odatlangan narsani egallab, uni bemalol qaytarib oldi.

en: Certes, meseemeth none of the magniﬁcences already recounted can com- pare with this.”
uz: Albatta, allaqachon aytib o'tilgan hech bir ajoyibot bunga teng kelmaydi.

en: THE FIFTH STORY Madam Dianora requireth of Messer Ansaldo a garden as fair in January as in May, and he by binding himself (to pay a great sum of money) to a nigromancer, giveth it to her.
uz: BESHINCHI HIKOYA Madam Dianora janob Ansaldo'dan yanvar oyida may oyidagidek go'zal bog'ni talab qiladi va u o'zini (katta miqdorda pul to'lash uchun) nigromancerga bog'lab, unga beradi.

en: Her husband granteth her leave to do Messer Ansaldo’s pleasure, but he, hearing of the former’s generosity, absolveth her of her promise, whereupon the nigromancer, in his turn, acquitteth Messer Ansaldo of his bond, without willing aught of his.
uz: Uning eri unga Messer Ansaldoga rozilik bildirishga ruxsat beradi, lekin u avvalgilarning saxiyligini eshitib, uni va'dasidan ozod qiladi, shundan so'ng begona ishqiboz, o'z navbatida, Messer Ansaldoga o'z majburiyatidan hech narsa xohlamasdan ozod qiladi.

en: Messer Gentile having by each of the merry company been extolled to the very skies with the highest praise, the king charged Emilia follow on, who conﬁdently, as if eager to speak, began as follows: “Dainty dames, none can with reason deny that Messer Gentile wrought magniﬁcently; but, if it be sought to say that his magnanimity might not be overpassed, it will not be- like be uneath to show that more is possible, as I purpose to set out to you in a little story of mine.
uz: Har bir xushchaqchaq kompaniyasi tomonidan eng yuqori maqtov bilan osmonga ko'tarilgan Messer Gentildan so'ng, qirol Emiliyaga davom etishni buyurdi. Emilia, gapirishga ishtiyoq bilan, quyidagicha boshladi: Go'zal xonimlar, hech kim Messer Gentilning ajoyib ish qilganini asos bilan inkor eta olmaydi; lekin, agar uning saxovatini o'tkazib bo'lmasligini aytishga harakat qilinsa, men sizga o'zimning kichik hikoyamda ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lganimdek, ko'proq imkoni borligini ko'rsatishga haqli emas.

en: In Friuli, a country, though cold, glad with goodly mountains and store of rivers and clear springs, is a city called Udine, wherein was aforetime a fair and noble lady called Madam Dianora, the wife of a wealthy gentleman named Gilberto, who was very debonair and easy of composition.
uz: Friulida, garchi sovuq bo'lsa ham, yaxshi tog'lar, daryolar va tiniq buloqlar bilan xursand bo'lgan bir mamlakatda Udine deb nomlangan shahar bor edi. U yerda bir vaqtlar Madam Dianora ismli go'zal va olijanob ayol, Gilberto ismli boy janobning rafiqasi bor edi, u juda nozik va oson kompozitsiyaga ega edi.

en: The lady’s charm procured her to be passionately loved of a noble and great bar- on by name Messer Ansaldo Gradense, a man of high condition and every- where renowned for prowess and courtesy.
uz: Xonimning jozibasi uni oliyjanob va buyuk barda - Messer Ansaldo Gradense ismli, yuqori sifatli va har joyda mahorat va odob bilan mashhur odam tomonidan ishtiyoq bilan sevilishiga sabab bo'ldi.

en: He loved her fervently and did all that lay in his power to be beloved of her, to which end he frequently so- licited her with messages, but wearied himself in vain.
uz: U uni juda qattiq sevardi va o'z kuchidan kelgancha, uni sevib qolish uchun harakat qilardi, shuning uchun u uni tez-tez xabarlar bilan erkalardi, lekin behuda charchadi.

en: At last, his impor- tunities being irksome to the lady and she seeing that, for all she denied him everything he sought of her, he stinted not therefor to love and solicit her, she determined to seek to rid herself of him by means of an extraordinary and in her judgment an impossible demand; wherefore she said one day to a
uz: Nihoyat, uning muhim ohanglari xonimga g'azablantirgan edi va u unga undan so'ragan hamma narsani rad etganini ko'rib, uni sevishga va iltimos qilishga unchalik intilmadi, shuning uchun u o'zini undan g'ayrioddiy va uning fikricha imkonsiz talab yordamida qutulishga qaror qildi; shuning uchun u bir kuni dedi:

en: woman, who came often to her on his part, ‘Good woman, thou hast many times avouched to me that Messer Ansaldo loveth me over all things and hast proffered me marvellous great gifts on his part, which I would have him keep to himself, seeing that never thereby might I be prevailed upon to love him or comply with his wishes; but, an I could be certiﬁed that he loveth me in very deed as much as thou sayest, I might doubtless bring my- self to love him and do that which he willeth; wherefore, an he choose to certify me of this with that which I shall require of him, I shall be ready to do his commandments.’ Quoth the good woman, ‘And what is that, madam, which you would have him do?’ ‘That which I desire,’ replied the lady, ‘is this; I will have, for this coming month of January, a garden, near this city, full of green grass and ﬂowers and trees in full leaf, no otherwise than as it were
uz: Ayol, uning tomoniga tez-tez kelgan, Yaxshi ayol, menga ko'p marta aytdingizki, janob Ansaldo meni hamma narsadan ham yaxshi ko'radi va menga o'zi uchun ajoyib buyuk sovg'alar taklif qildi. Men uni o'zimga saqlab qo'yishni xohlardim, chunki bu orqali uni sevishga yoki uning istaklariga qodir bo'lishga hech qachon erisha olmas edim; lekin, men uning meni siz aytganingizdek yaxshi ko'rishini tasdiqlasam bo'ladi, men uni albatta sevishga va u xohlaganini qilishga o'zimni majbur qila olaman; shuning uchun, u meni undan talab qiladigan narsa bilan tasdiqlashni tanladi, men uning buyruqlarini bajarishga tayyor bo'laman. Yaxshi ayol, Va bu nima, xonim, siz uni nima qilmoqchisiz?  Bu savolga javob berdi: Men buni xohlayman, agar bu yog'ochlar uchun to'la bo'lsa, men bu yerda yashil va

en: May; the which if he contrive not, let him never more send me thee nor any other, for that, an he importune me more, so surely as I have hitherto kept his pursuit hidden from my husband and my kinsfolk, I will study to rid myself of him by complaining to them.’ The gentleman, hearing the demand and the offer of his mistress, for all it seemed to him a hard thing and in a manner impossible to do and he knew it to be required of the lady for none otherwhat than to bereave him of all hope, determined nevertheless to essay whatsoever might be done thereof and sent into various parts about the world, enquiring if there were any to be found who would give him aid and counsel in the matter.
uz: Agar u o'ylab topmasa, meni senga ham, boshqa hech kimga ham yubormasin, chunki u meni ko'proq bezovta qiladi, shuning uchun men shu paytgacha erimdan va qarindoshlarimdan yashiringanimdek, ulardan shikoyat qilib, o'zimni qutulishga o'rganaman." Janob, xo'jayinasining talabi va taklifini eshitib, bu unga qiyin va imkonsizdek tuyuldi va u buni xonimdan uni umidini yo'qotishdan boshqa hech narsa talab qilinmasligini bilardi, shunga qaramay, bu haqda nima qilish mumkin bo'lsa ham sinab ko'rishga va dunyo bo'ylab turli burchaklarga jo'natishga qaror qildi, agar unga yordam va maslahat beradigan odam topilsa.

en: At last, he happened upon one who offered, so he were well guerdoned, to do the thing by nigromantic art, and having agreed with him for a great sum of money, he joyfully awaited the appointed time, which come and the cold being ex- treme and everything full of snow and ice, the learned man, the night before the calends of January, so wrought by his arts in a very goodly meadow ad- joining the city, that it appeared in the morning (according to the testimony of those who saw it) one of the goodliest gardens was ever seen of any, with grass and trees and fruits of every kind.
uz: Nihoyat, u shunday bir odamga duch keldi, u taklif qildi, shuning uchun u yaxshi qo'riqlangan edi, bu ishni nigromantik san'at bilan amalga oshirish uchun, va u bilan katta miqdorda pulga kelishib, belgilangan vaqtni xursandchilik bilan kutdi, u kelardi va sovuq juda sovuq edi va hamma narsa qor va muz bilan to'la edi. O'qimishli odam, yanvar yilining oldingi kechasi, shaharga qo'shilgan juda yaxshi o'tloqda o'z san'tlari bilan yaratdi, shuning uchun u ertalab paydo bo'ldi (ko'rganlarning guvohligiga ko'ra), har qanday bog'ning eng yaxshi bog'laridan biri, o't va daraxtlar va mevalar bilan.

en: Messer Ansaldo, after viewing this with the utmost gladness, let cull of the ﬁnest fruits and the fairest ﬂowers that were there and caused privily present them to his mistress, bidding her come and see the garden required by her, so thereby she might know how he loved her and after, remembering her of the promise made him and sealed with an oath, bethink herself, as a loyal lady, to accomplish it to him.
uz: Janob Ansaldo, buni juda xursandchilik bilan ko'rib, u yerda bo'lgan eng yaxshi mevalar va eng go'zal gullarni terib, xotiniga hadya qildi va uni o'ziga kerakli bog'ni ko'rishga taklif qildi, shunda u uni qanday sevishini bilishi mumkin edi va keyin, unga bergan va'dasini eslab, qasam bilan muhrlanganidan so'ng, o'zini sadoqatli xonim deb o'ylab, unga buni amalga oshirish uchun.

en: The lady, seeing the fruits and ﬂowers and having already from many heard tell of the miraculous garden, began to repent of her promise.
uz: Xonim mevalar va gullarni ko'rib, mo'jizaviy bog' haqida ko'pchilikdan eshitib bo'lgach, o'z va'dasidan tavba qila boshladi.

en: less, curious, for all her repentance, of seeing strange things, she went with many other ladies of the city to view the garden and having with no little wonderment commended it amain, returned home, the woefullest woman alive, bethinking her of that to which she was bounden thereby.
uz: Kamroq, g'alati narsalarni ko'rgan barcha tavbalari uchun, u shaharning boshqa ko'plab ayollari bilan bog'ni tomosha qilish uchun bordi va hech qanday hayratlanmasdan uni maqtadi, uyiga qaytdi, eng to'la ayol tirik edi, u bilan bog'langan narsasini o'ylab.

en: Such was her chagrin that she availed not so well to dissemble it but needs must it ap- pear, and her husband, perceiving it, was urgent to know the reason.
uz: Uning xafaligi shunchalik ediki, uni ko'rib chiqishga unchalik unchalik unumli bo'lmadi, lekin uni ko'rishga hojat bor edi, er esa buni anglab yetgach, sababini bilishga shoshildi.

en: The lady, for shamefastness, kept silence thereof a great while; but at last, con- strained to speak, she orderly discovered to him everything; which Gilberto, hearing, was at the ﬁrst sore incensed, but presently, considering the purity of the lady’s intent and chasing away anger with better counsel, he said, ‘Dianora, it is not the part of a discreet nor of a virtuous woman to give ear unto any message of this sort nor to compound with any for her chastity un- der whatsoever condition.
uz: Xonim uyatsizlik tufayli ancha vaqt sukut saqladi; lekin oxir-oqibat, gapirishga zo'r bo'lgach, u unga hamma narsani aniqladi; buni eshitgan Gilberto dastlab jahli chiqdi, lekin tez orada xonimning niyatining tozaligini hisobga olib, g'azabni yaxshiroq maslahat bilan quvib chiqarib, dedi: "Dianora, bu hech qanday bunday xabarga quloq solmaslik yoki uning xorligi uchun hech qanday holatga qo'shilmaslik, bu xolis ayolning bir qismi emas."

en: Words received into the heart by the channel of the ears have more potency than many conceive and well nigh everything becometh possible to lovers.
uz: Qalbga quloq orqali qabul qilingan so'zlar ko'pchilik tasavvur qilganidan ko'ra kuchliroqdir va deyarli hamma narsa oshiqlarga mumkin bo'ladi.

en: Thou didst ill, then, ﬁrst to hearken and after to enter into terms of composition; but, for that I know the purity of thine intent, I will, to absolve thee of the bond of the promise, concede thee that which peradventure none other would do, being thereto the more induced by fear of the nigromancer, whom Messer Ansaldo, an thou cheat him, will maybe cause make us woeful.
uz: Shunday qilib, sen avval eshitib, keyin tarkibga kirish uchun yomonlik qilding; lekin, men sening niyatingning sofligini bilganim uchun, senga va'dadan ozod bo'lish uchun, boshqa hech kim qilmagan narsani senga beraman, chunki men uni yolg'onchi Ansaldo, sen uni aldaysan, bizni qayg'uga soladigan odamdan qo'rqishga ko'proq majbur bo'laman.

en: I will, then, that thou go to him and study to have thyself absolved of this thy promise, preserving thy chastity, if thou mayst anywise contrive it; but, an it may not be otherwise, thou shalt, for this once, yield him thy body, but not thy soul.’ The lady, hearing her husband’s speech, wept and denied herself willing to receive such a favour from him; but, for all her much denial, he would e’en have it be so.
uz: Shunday ekan, men senga uning oldiga borishni va bu va'dingdan o'zingni xalos qilishni o'rganishni istayman, agar uni qandaydir tarzda o'ylab topishing mumkin bo'lsa, pokligingni saqlab qol; lekin, agar boshqacha bo'lmasa, bu safar unga joningni emas, balki tanangni berishing kerak." Xonim erining so'zlarini eshitib, yig'ladi va undan bunday marhamatni olishni rad etdi; lekin, uning ko'p rad etishi uchun, u shunday bo'lishini xohlardi.

en: Accordingly, next morning, at daybreak, the lady, without overmuch adorning herself, repaired to Messer Ansaldo’s house, with two of her serving-men before and a chamberwoman after her.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni ertalab, kunduzgi tongda, xonim o'zini ortiqcha bezamasdan, ikki xizmatchisi oldinda va undan keyin xonadon xodimi bilan Messer Ansaldo uyiga qaytdi.

en: An- saldo, hearing that his mistress was come to him, marvelled sore and letting call the nigromancer, said to him, ‘I will have thee see what a treasure thy skill hath gotten me.’ Then, going to meet her, he received her with decency and reverence, without ensuing any disorderly appetite, and they entered all456 into a goodly chamber, wherein was a great ﬁre.
uz: An- saldo, uning bekasi uning oldiga kelganini eshitib, xafa bo'lib, beg'uborni chaqirib yuborib, unga dedi: "Sening mahorating menga qanday xazina olib kelganini ko'rishga ruxsat beraman". So'ngra, uni kutib olgach, u uni odob va hurmat bilan qabul qildi, hech qanday tartibsiz ishtahani qo'llamasdan, va ular barcha 456 ta yaxshi xonaga kirdilar, unda katta olov bor edi.

en: There he caused set her a seat and said, ‘Madam, I prithee, if the long love I have borne you merit any recompense, let it not irk you to discover to me the true cause which hath brought you hither at such an hour and in such company.’ The lady, shamefast and well nigh with tears in her eyes, answered, ‘Sir, neither
uz: U yerda uni o'rindiqqa joylashtirdi va dedi: Xonim, azizim, agar sizga bergan uzoq muhabbatim hech qanday mukofotga loyiq bo'lsa, sizni shu soat va shu paytda sizni bu yerga olib kelgan haqiqiy sababni topishingiz sizni bezovta qilmasin. Xonim, uyatchan va ko'zlarida yosh bilan yaqin bo'lgan holda, javob berdi: Janob,

en: love that I bear you nor plighted faith bringeth me hither, but the command- ment of my husband, who, having more regard to the travails of your dis- orderly passion than to his honour and mine own, hath caused me come hither; and by his behest I am for this once disposed to do your every pleas- ure.’ If Messer Ansaldo had marvelled at the sight of the lady, far more did he marvel, when he heard her words, and moved by Gilberto’s generosity, his heat began to change to compassion and he said, ‘God forbid, madam, an it be as you say, that I should be a marrer of his honour who hath com- passion of my love; wherefore you shall, what while it is your pleasure to abide here, be no otherwise entreated than as you were my sister; and when- as it shall be agreeable to you, you are free to depart, so but you will render your husband, on my part, those thanks which you shall deem beﬁtting unto
uz: Sizga bo'lgan muhabbat meni bu yerga olib kelmaydi, ammo erimning buyrug'i meni bu yerga olib keldi. Erimning buyrug'i sizning tartibsiz ehtirosingizning ishtiyoqlariga o'z sharafim va o'zimnikiga qaraganda ko'proq e'tibor qaratgan holda, meni bu yerga olib keldi; va uning ko'rsatmasi bilan men bu uchun bir marta sizning har qanday iltimosingizni qilishga tayyorman.

en: courtesy such as his hath been and have me ever, in time to come, for broth- er and for servant.’ The lady, hearing these words, was the joyfullest woman in the world and answered, saying, ‘Nothing, having regard to your fashions, could ever make me believe that aught should ensue to me of my coming other than this that I see you do in the matter; whereof I shall still be beholden to you.’ Then, taking leave, she returned, under honourable escort, to Messer Gil- berto and told him that which had passed, of which there came about a very strait and loyal friendship between him and Messer Ansaldo.
uz: Uning bo'lganidek va kelajakda ham menga xizmatkor sifatida xizmat qilganidek." Bu so'zlarni eshitib, xonim dunyodagi eng quvnoq ayol edi va javob berdi: "Sizning modalaringiz meni kelishimdan boshqa hech narsa kelishiga ishonishga majbur qila olmas edi, faqat siz bu masalada nima qilayotganingizni ko'ryapman; men bundan hali ham sizga qarzdor bo'laman." Keyin, ta'til olib, u hurmatli kuzatuv ostida Messer Gilga qaytib keldi va unga o'tgan voqeani aytib berdi, bundan tashqari u va Messer Ansaldo o'rtasida juda qattiq va sadoqatli do'stlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: Moreover, the nigromancer, to whom the gentleman was for giving the promised guerdon, seeing Gilberto’s generosity towards his wife’s lover and that of the latter towards the lady, said, ‘God forbid, since I have seen Gilberto liberal of his honour and you of your love, that I should not on like wise be liberal of my hire; wherefore, knowing it457 will stand you in good stead, I intend that it shall be yours.’ At this the gentleman was ashamed and studied to make him take or all or part; but, seeing that he wearied himself in vain and it pleasing the nigromancer (who had, after three days, done away his garden) to de- part, he commended him to God and having extinguished from his heart his lustful love for the lady, he abode ﬁred with honourable affection for her.
uz: Qolaversa, janob va'da qilingan g'amxo'rlikni berganligi uchun Gilberto'ning xotiniga va xotinning sevgilisiga nisbatan saxiyligini ko'rib, u dedi: "Xudo saqlasin, chunki men Gilberto'ni o'z sharafiga va sizning muhabbatingizga nisbatan saxiy ekanligini ko'rganimdan so'ng, men o'z ish haqiga nisbatan dono bo'lmasligim kerak edi; shuning uchun, u 457 sizni yaxshi o'rinda turishini bilgan holda, men uni sizniki bo'lishini niyat qilaman." Shunda janob uyaldi va uni butunlay yoki bir qismini olishga majburlash uchun o'rgandi; lekin, u o'zini behuda zo'rlaganini ko'rib, g'amxo'rga (uch kundan keyin o'z bog'ini qurib tashlagan) yoqtirganini ko'rib, u uni Xudoga topshirdi va uning ishtiyoqidan uni o'chirib tashladi.

en: How say you now, lovesome ladies?
uz: Xo'sh, hozir qanday deysiz, yoqimli ayollar?

en: Shall we prefer [Gentile’s resignation of] the in a manner dead lady and of his love already cooled for hope for- spent, before the generosity of Messer Ansaldo, whose love was more ar- dent than ever and who was in a manner ﬁred with new hope, holding in his hands the prey so long pursued?
uz: Biz [Gentilning iste'fosini] o'lik xonim va uning umid uchun allaqachon sovutilgan muhabbatidan afzal ko'ramizmi, Messer Ansaldo'ning saxiyligidan ko'ra, uning muhabbati har qachongidan ham ko'ra ardoqroq edi va u yangi umid bilan o'tga uchragan, qo'lida shunchalik uzoq vaqt quvib yurgan o'ljani ushlab turgan edi?

en: Meseemeth it were folly to pretend that this generosity can be evened with that.”
uz: Menimcha, bu saxovatni shu bilan tenglashtirish mumkin deb o'ylash ahmoqlik edi.

en: THE SIXTH STORY King Charles the Old, the victorious, falleth enamoured of a young girl, but after, ashamed of his fond thought, honourably marrieth both her and her sister.
uz: OLTINCHI HIKOYA Qirol Charlz Keksa, g'olib, yosh qizga oshiq bo'lib qoladi, lekin keyin, uning mehribon fikridan uyalgan holda, u bilan ham, singlisini ham sharaf bilan turmushga chiqaradi.

en: It were over longsome fully to recount the various discourse that had place among the ladies of who used the greatest generosity, Gilberto or Messer Ansaldo or the nigromancer, in Madam Dianora’s affairs; but, after the king had suffered them debate awhile, he looked at Fiammetta and bade her, telling a story, put an end to their contention; whereupon she, without hesit- ation, began as follows: “Illustrious ladies, I was ever of opinion that, in companies such as ours, it should still be discoursed so much at large that the overstraitness458 of intent of the things said be not unto any matter for debate, the which is far more sortable among students in the schools than among us [women], who scarce sufﬁce unto the distaff and the spindle.
uz: Xonim Dianora ishlarida eng katta saxovatni kim ishlatganini, Gilberto yoki Messer Ansaldo yoki nigromancer ayollari orasida bo'lgan turli xil nutqlarni to'liq hikoya qilish juda uzun edi; lekin, shoh ularni biroz bahsga duchor qilgandan so'ng, u Fiammettaga qaradi va unga hikoya aytib, ularning bahsini to'xtatishni buyurdi; shundan so'ng u hech ikkilanmasdan quyidagicha boshladi: "Ajoyib xonimlar, men bizning kabi kompaniyalarda, gaplarning haddan tashqari to'g'riligi hech qanday narsaga tegishli emasligi uchun juda ko'p muhokama qilinishi kerak deb hisoblardim, chunki u maktablardagi talabalar orasida bizdan ko'ra ko'proq bahsga ega bo'ladi."

en: Wherefore, seeing that you are presently at cross-purposes by reason of the things already said, I, who had in mind a thing maybe somewhat doubtful [of meaning], will leave that be and tell you a story, treating nowise of a man of little account, but of a valiant king, who therein wrought knightly, in nothing attainting his honour.
uz: Shuning uchun, siz allaqachon aytilgan narsalar tufayli o'zaro maqsadlarda ekanligingizni ko'rib, men, ma'nosi biroz shubhali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsani o'ylab, sizga bir hikoya qoldiraman, u yerda ozgina hisobga ega bo'lmagan, ammo unda otliqlik bilan ishlagan, o'z sha'niga erisha olmaydigan bir jasur shoh haqida so'zlab beraman.

en: Each one of you must many a time have heard tell of King Charles the Old or First, by whose magnanimous emprise, and after by the glorious vic- tory gained by him over King Manfred, the Ghibellines were expelled from Florence and the Guelphs returned thither.
uz: Har biringiz ko'p marta qirol Charlz Keksa yoki Birinchisi haqida eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak, uning saxiy qo'lga kiritishi va qirol Manfred ustidan qozongan shonli zafaridan so'ng, Ghibellinlar Florensiyadan quvib chiqarilgan va Guelflar u yerga qaytgan.

en: In consequence of this a certain gentleman, called Messer Neri degli Uberti, departing the city with all his household and much monies and being minded to take refuge no other- where than under the hand of King Charles, betook himself to Castellamare di Stabia.459 There, belike a crossbowshot removed from the other habita-
uz: Natijada, bir janob, Messer Neri degli Uberti deb atalgan, butun xonadoni va ko'p pulini olib, shahardan chiqib ketdi va boshqa hech kimga panoh topishga qaror qilmadi - faqatgina qirol Charlzning qo'li ostida, o'zini Castellamare di Stabiaga olib ketdi.

en: tions of the place, among olive-trees and walnuts and chestnuts, wherewith the country aboundeth, he bought him an estate and built thereon a goodly and commodious dwelling-house, with a delightsome garden thereby, amid- dleward which, having great plenty of running water, he made, after our country fashion, a goodly and clear ﬁshpond and lightly ﬁlled it with good store of ﬁsh.
uz: U yerga, zaytun daraxtlari, yong'oqlar va kashtanlar orasida, u yerga ko'p narsa to'lib-toshgan, unga mulk sotib oldi va u yerda yaxshi va qulay turar joy qurdi, u yerda yoqimli bog' bor edi, uning o'rtasida, juda ko'p oqimli suv bo'lgani uchun, u bizning mamlakatimiz modasiga ko'ra, yaxshi va tiniq baliq havzasini yaratdi va uni yaxshi baliq bilan yengil to'ldirdi.

en: Whilst he concerned himself to make his garden goodlier every day, it befell that King Charles repaired to Castellamare, to rest him- self awhile in the hot season, and there hearing tell of the beauty of Messer Neri’s garden, he desired to behold it.
uz: U har kuni o'z bog'ini go'zalroq qilish haqida qayg'urgan bo'lsa-da, shunday bo'ldiki, qirol Charlz issiq mavsumda o'zi dam olish uchun Kastellamarega bordi va u yerda Messer Neri bog'ining go'zalligi haqida eshitib, uni ko'rishni xohladi.

en: Hearing, moreover, to whom it be- longed, he bethought himself that, as the gentleman was of the party ad- verse to his own, it behoved to deal the more familiarly with him, and ac- cordingly sent to him to say that he purposed to sup with him privily in his garden that evening, he and four companions.
uz: Qolaversa, kimga sog'inganini eshitib, u o'zini shunday deb o'yladi: "Janob o'zining partiyasidan bo'lgani uchun, unga yanada yaqinroq munosabatda bo'lish kerak", va unga o'sha oqshom u va to'rt nafar hamrohi bilan bog'ida u bilan alohida kechki ovqat qilishni niyat qilganini aytdi.

en: This was very agreeable to Messer Neri, and having made magniﬁcent preparation and taken order with his household of that which was to do, he received the king in his fair garden as gladliest he might and knew.
uz: Bu Messer Neriga juda yoqdi va ajoyib tayyorgarlik ko'rib, uyidagilar bilan nima qilish kerakligi haqida kelishganidan so'ng, u podshohni o'zining go'zal bog'ida imkon qadar xursandchilik bilan qabul qildi va bildi.

en: The latter, after having viewed and commended all the garden and Messer Neri’s house and washed, seated himself at one of the tables, which were set beside the ﬁshpond, and seating Count Guy de Montfort, who was of his company, on one side of him and Messer Neri on the other, commanded other three, who were come thither with them, to serve according to the order appointed of his host.
uz: Oxirgisi, butun bog'ni va Messer Neri uyini ko'rib, maqtatib, yuvib bo'lgach, baliq havzasi yonida o'rnatilgan stollardan birida o'tirdi va o'z kompaniyasidan bo'lgan graf Gi de Montfortga, uning bir tomoniga va Messer Neriga boshqa tomonga o'tirganidan so'ng, u bilan birga kelgan boshqa uch kishiga o'z qo'shinining tayinlangan buyrug'iga muvofiq xizmat qilishni buyurdi.

en: Thereupon there came dainty meats and there were wines of the best and costliest and the ordinance was exceeding goodly and praiseworthy, without noise or an- noy whatsoever, the which the king much commended.
uz: Shundan so'ng mazali go'shtlar paydo bo'ldi va eng yaxshi va qimmatbaho vinolar paydo bo'ldi. Hukm juda yaxshi va maqtovga sazovor edi, hech qanday shovqin yoki shovqinsiz edi, uni shoh juda maqtadi.

en: Presently, as he sat blithely at meat, enjoying the solitary place, there entered the garden two young damsels of maybe ﬁfteen years of age, with hair like threads of gold, all ringleted and hanging loose, whereon was a light chaplet of pervinck-blossoms.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda u go'shtdan xotirjam o'tirib, yolg'iz joydan zavqlanayotganida, bog'ga o'n besh yoshli, sochlari oltin iplar kabi, barchasi halqali va osilgan, ustiga pervink gullarining yengil sochli qizaloqlari kirdi.

en: Their faces bespoke them rather angels than otherwhat, so delicately fair they were, and they were clad each upon her skin in a garment of the ﬁnest linen and white as snow, the which from the waist upward was very strait and thence hung down in ample folds, pa- vilionwise, to the feet.
uz: Ularning yuzlari boshqalardan ko'ra farishtalarga ko'proq o'xshardi, ular juda nozik chiroyli edilar va ularning har biri terisiga eng yaxshi zig'ir va qor kabi oq libos bilan qoplangan edi. Bu libos beldan yuqoriga juda tor edi va keyin keng buklamalarda, pa-vilyon shaklida oyoqlarga osilib turardi.

en: She who came ﬁrst bore on her left shoulder a pair of hand-nets and in her right hand a long pole, and the other had on her left shoulder a frying-pan and under the same arm a faggot of wood, whilst in her left hand she held a trivet and in the other a ﬂask of oil and a lighted ﬂambeau.
uz: Birinchi kelgan ayol chap yelkasida bir juft qo'l to'rlarini, o'ng qo'lida uzun ustunni ko'tarib yurardi, ikkinchisining chap yelkasida qovurish idishi va bir xil qo'l ostida yog'ochdan yasalgan mato bor edi, chap qo'lida esa o'tin, ikkinchi qo'lida esa yog' kolbasini va yonib turgan olovni ushlab turardi.

en: The king, seeing them, marvelled and in suspense awaited what this should mean.
uz: Shoh ularni ko'rib hayratda qoldi va bu nimani anglatishini xavotirda kutdi.

en: The damsels came forward modestly and blushingly did
uz: Qizlar kamtarona va qizargan holda oldinga chiqishdi.

en: obeisance to him, then, betaking themselves whereas one went down into the ﬁshpond, she who bore the frying-pan set it down and the other things by it and taking the pole that the other carried, they both entered the water, which came up to their breasts.
uz: Unga ta'zim qilib, keyin o'zlarini xotirjam qilib, birlari baliq havzasiga tushishdi. Qovurish idishini olib yurgan ayol uni pastga qo'ydi va uning yonidagi boshqa narsalarni olib, ikkalasi ham ko'kragigacha yetib boradigan suvga kirishdi.

en: Meanwhile, one of Messer Neri’s servants deftly kindled ﬁre under the trivet and setting the pan thereon, poured therein oil and waited for the damsels to throw him ﬁsh.
uz: Ayni paytda, Messer Neri xizmatkorlaridan biri mohirona olov yoqib, qozonni unga qo'ydi, unga yog' quydi va qizlarning unga baliq tashlashlarini kutdi.

en: The latter, the one groping with the pole in those parts whereas she knew the ﬁsh lay hid and the other standing ready with the net, in a short space of time took ﬁsh galore, to the exceeding pleasure of the king, who eyed them attently; then, throwing some thereof to the servant, who put them in the pan, well nigh alive, they proceeded, as they had been lessoned, to take of the ﬁnest and cast them on the table before the king and his table-fellows.
uz: Oxirgisi, o'sha qismlarda ustun bilan g'amlab yurgan, baliq yashiringanini bilgan, ikkinchisi esa to'r bilan tayyor turgan, qisqa vaqt ichida shohning haddan tashqari mamnuniyatiga ko'ra baliqlarni oldi, u ularga diqqat bilan qaradi; so'ngra, ulardan bir qismini xizmatchiga tashlab, ularni tovaga qo'ydi, deyarli tirik holda, ular o'rganganidek, eng yaxshisidan olib, shoh va uning dasturxonadoshlari oldidagi stolga tashladilar.

en: The ﬁsh wriggled about the table, to the marvellous diversion of the king, who took of them in his turn and sportively cast them back to the damsels; and on this wise they frolicked awhile, till such time as the servant had cooked the ﬁsh which had been given him and which, Messer Neri having so ordered it, were now set before the king, more as a relish than as any very rare and de- lectable dish.
uz: Baliqlar dasturxon atrofida aylanib yurdi, shohning ajoyib chalg'ishiga, u ularni o'z navbatida oldi va sport bilan qizlarga qaytarib yubordi; va shu tariqa ular biroz xursand bo'lishdi, toki xizmatkor unga berilgan baliqni pishirmaguncha va Messer Neri shunday buyurganidan so'ng, u endi shoh oldiga har qanday juda kam uchraydigan va o'qish mumkin bo'lgan taomdan ko'ra ko'proq lazzat sifatida qo'yildi.

en: The damsels, seeing the ﬁsh cooked and having taken enough, came forth of the water, their thin white garments all clinging to their skins and hiding well nigh nought of their delicate bodies, and passing shamefastly before the king, returned to the house.
uz: Qizlar baliq pishirilganini va yetarlicha ichganini ko'rib, suvdan chiqdilar, ularning yupqa oq kiyimlari terilariga yopishib, nozik tanasidan deyarli hech narsa yashirinib, shoh huzuriga sharmandalik bilan o'tib, uyga qaytdilar.

en: The latter and the count and the others who served had well considered the damsels and each inwardly greatly commen- ded them for fair and well shapen, no less than for agreeable and well mannered.
uz: Oxirgisi va graf va xizmat qilgan boshqa odamlar qizlarni yaxshi ko'rib chiqishgan va ularning har biri ichki jihatdan ularni go'zal va yaxshi shakl uchun juda qadrlashgan, faqatgina yoqimli va odobli bo'lish uchun emas.

en: But above all they pleased the king, who had so intently eyed every part of their bodies, as they came forth of the water, that, had any then pricked him, he would not have felt it, and as he called them more particu- larly to mind, unknowing who they were, he felt a very fervent desire awaken in his heart to please them, whereby he right well perceived himself to be in danger of becoming enamoured, an he took no heed to himself thereagainst; nor knew he indeed whether of the twain it was the more pleased him, so like in all things was the one to the other.
uz: Lekin eng asosiysi, ular podshohga ma'qul kelishdi. U suvdan chiqqanlarida, ularning har bir qismiga shunchalik diqqat bilan qaragan edi, agar unga tish urganida, u buni his qilmagan bo'lardi. U ularni ko'proq esga olganida, ularning kimligini bilmasdan, yuragida ularni xursand qilish uchun juda kuchli istak uyg'onardi, shu sababli u o'zini oshiq bo'lish xavfi ostida deb yaxshi his qildi va bunga qarshi o'ziga hech qanday e'tibor bermadi; shuningdek, u Twain'dan unga qanchalik yoqqanini ham bilmas edi, xuddi hamma narsada biriga yoqqanidek.

en: After he had abid- den awhile in this thought, he turned to Messer Neri and asked him who were the two damsels, to which the gentleman answered, ‘My lord, these are my daughters born at a birth, whereof the one is called Ginevra the Fair and the other Isotta the Blonde.’ The king commended them greatly and ex- horted him to marry them, whereof Messer Neri excused himself, for that
uz: U biroz shu fikrda qolgach, u Messer Neriga o'girilib, undan ikki xonim kimligini so'radi, unga janob javob berdi: "Egam, bular tug'ilgan qizlarim, ulardan biri Gobivra Chiroyli va ikkinchisi Isotta Sariq deb ataladi." Shoh ularni juda maqtadi va ularni turmushga chiqarish uchun oldindan ogohlantirdi, bundan Messer Neri o'zini kechirdi, chunki

en: he was no more able thereunto.
uz: U endi bunga qodir emas edi.

en: Meanwhile, nothing now remaining to be served of the supper but the fruits, there came the two damsels in very goodly gowns of sendal, with two great silver platters in their hands, full of various fruits, such as the season afforded, and these they set on the table before the king; which done, they withdrew a little apart and fell to singing a canzonet, whereof the words began thus: Whereas I’m come, O Love,  It might not be, indeed, at length recounted, etc.
uz: Ayni paytda, kechki ovqatdan faqat mevalar tortilishi kerak edi, shunda ikki qiz juda chiroyli sendal liboslarida, qo'llarida turli xil mevalar, masalan, mavsum kabi katta kumush idishlar bilan keldi va ularni shoh oldida stolga qo'ydilar; shundan so'ng, ular biroz uzoqlashib, bir qo'shiq kuylashga tushdilar, uning so'zlari quyidagicha boshlandi: "Men kelgan bo'lsam ham, ey Sevgi, Bu, albatta, oxir-oqibatda aytib bo'lmas edi, va hokazo."

en: This song they carolled on such dulcet wise and so delightsomely that to the king, who beheld and hearkened to them with ravishment, it seemed as if all the hierarchies of the angels were lighted there to sing.
uz: Ular bu qo'shiqni shunchalik shirin va yoqimli kuylashdiki, ularni hayrat bilan ko'rib va tinglagan shoh uchun go'yo farishtalarning barcha ierarxiyalari u yerda kuylash uchun yoritilgandek tuyuldi.

en: The song sung, they fell on their knees and respectfully craved of him leave to depart, who, albeit their departure was grievous to him, yet with a show of blitheness ac- corded it to them.
uz: Qo'shiq aytilganda, ular tizzalab yiqilishdi va hurmat bilan uni ketib ketishga ishtiyoq qilishdi, u, ketishi unga og'riqli bo'lsa ham, buni ularga achchiqlik bilan tanqid qildi.

en: The supper being now at an end, the king remounted to horse with his company and leaving Messer Neri, returned to the royal lodging, devising of one thing and another.
uz: Kechki ovqat tugagach, shoh o'z kompaniyasi bilan otga minib, Messer Neri'ni tark etib, bir narsani va boshqa narsani o'ylab, qirollik turar joyiga qaytdi.

en: There, holding his passion hid- den, but availing not, for whatsoever great affair might supervene, to forget the beauty and grace of Ginevra the Fair, (for love of whom he loved her sister also, who was like unto her), he became so fast entangled in the amor- ous snares that he could think of well nigh nought else and feigning other occasions, kept a strait intimacy with Messer Neri and very often visited his fair garden, to see Ginevra.
uz: U yerda, o'z ishtiyoqini yashirib, lekin foydasi yo'q, har qanday buyuk ish sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganda, Ginevra Go'zalning go'zalligi va marhamatini unutish uchun (bu sevgi tufayli u singlisini ham sevgan, u ham unga o'xshash edi), u sevgi tuzoqlariga shunchalik tez kirib borardiki, u hech narsani o'ylay olmasdi va boshqa holatlarni soxtalashtirardi, Messer Neri bilan yaqin munosabatda bo'lardi va uning go'zal bog'iga tez-tez tashrif buyurardi, Ginevrani ko'rish uchun.

en: At last, unable to endure longer and bethinking himself, in default of oth- er means of compassing his desire, to take not one alone, but both of the damsels from their father, he discovered both his passion and his intent to Count Guy, who, for that he was an honourable man, said to him, ‘My lord, I marvel greatly at that which you tell me, and that more than would anoth- er, inasmuch as meseemeth I have from your childhood to this day known your fashions better than any other; wherefore, meseeming never to have known such a passion in your youth, wherein Love might lightlier have ﬁxed his talons, and seeing you presently hard upon old age, it is so new and so strange to me that you should love by way of enamourment460 that it seemeth to me well nigh a miracle, and were it my ofﬁce to reprove you thereof, I know well that which I should say to you thereanent, having in regard that you
uz: Nihoyat, uzoqroq chiday olmasdan va o'zini o'ylamasdan, o'z istaklarini to'ldirishning boshqa bir vositasi bo'lmagani uchun, otasidan bir emas, balki ikkala qizni ham olishni istamasdan, u o'z ishtiyoqini ham, Count Guyga bo'lgan niyatini ham angladi. U unga dedi: "Ey hazratim, siz menga aytgan narsangizdan juda hayronman va bundan ham ko'p narsa bo'lmaydi, chunki men sizning bolaligingizdan hozirgacha sizning modalaringizni boshqalardan yaxshiroq bilganman; shuning uchun, yoshligingizda sevgi o'z tovonlarini osonroq tiklaganini va sizni qarilikda ko'rganimda, siz meni ishtiyoq bilan sevishingiz juda yangi va g'alati tuyuladi.

en: are yet with your harness on your back in a kingdom newly
uz: hali ham orqangizdagi kamaringiz bilan yangi bir qirollikda.

en: gained, amidst a people unknown and full of wiles and treasons, and are all occupied with very grave cares and matters of high moment, nor have you yet availed to seat yourself [in security]; and yet, among such and so many affairs, you have made place for the allurements of love.
uz: Ma'lum bo'lmagan va hiyla-nayrang va hiylalarga to'la xalq orasida g'alaba qozonib, hammasi juda og'ir tashvishlar va dolzarb masalalar bilan band bo'lib, hali o'tirishga ulgurmadingiz; ammo, bunday va ko'p ishlar orasida siz muhabbat vasvasasi uchun joy yaratdingiz.

en: This is not the fashion of a magnanimous king; nay, but rather that of a pusillanimous boy.
uz: Bu saxovatli shohning uslubi emas; yo'q, aksincha, u jozibali bolaning uslubi.

en: Moreover, what is far worse, you say that you are resolved to take his two daughters from a gentleman who hath entertained you in his house beyond his means and who, to do you the more honour, hath shown you these twain in a manner naked, thereby attesting how great is the faith he hath in you and that he ﬁrmly believeth you to be a king and not a ravening wolf.
uz: Bundan tashqari, undan ham yomoni, siz uning ikki qizini sizni o'z uyida o'z boyligidan tashqari ko'paytirgan va sizga ko'proq hurmat ko'rsatish uchun bu ikki kishini yalang'och holda ko'rsatgan bir janobdan olishga qaror qilganingizni aytasiz, shu bilan u sizdagi imon naqadar buyuk ekanligini va u sizni yirtqich bo'ri emas, balki shoh ekanligingizga qat'iy ishonishini isbotlaysiz.

en: Again, hath it so soon dropped your memory that it was the violences done of Manfred to women that opened you the entry into this kingdom?
uz: Yana, shunchalik tez esingizdan chiqib ketdiki, aynan Manfredning ayollarga qilgan zo'ravonliklari sizga bu shohlikka kirish imkonini berdi?

en: What treason was ever wroughten more deserving of eternal punishment than this would be, that you should take from him who hospitably entreateth you his honour and hope and comfort?
uz: Sizga mehmondo'stlik bilan yolvoradigan Zotdan o'z sharafini, umidini va taskinini olishingiz uchun abadiy jazoga loyiqroq qanday xiyonat bo'lgan?

en: What would be said of you, an you should do it?
uz: Siz haqingizda nima deyish mumkin, va siz buni qilishingiz kerakmi?

en: You think, maybe, it were a sufﬁcient excuse to say, “I did it for that he is a Ghibelline.” Is this of the justice of kings, that they who resort on such wise to their arms should be entreated after such a fashion, be they who they may?
uz: Siz o'ylaysizki, balki, "Men buni u Ghibellin bo'lgani uchun qildim" deyish yetarli bahona bo'lgandir. Bu qirollarning adolatimi, qurollariga shunday donolik bilan murojaat qilganlar shunday uslubda iltijo qilinishi kerak, xoh ular kim bo'lishmasin?

en: Let me tell you, king, that it was an exceedingly great glory to you to have overcome Manfred, but a far greater one it is to overcome one’s self; wherefore do you, who have to correct others, conquer yourself and curb this appetite, nor offer with such a blot to mar that which you have so gloriously gained.’ These words stung the king’s conscience to the quick and afﬂicted him the more inasmuch as he knew them for true; wherefore, after sundry heavy sighs, he said, ‘Certes, Count, I hold every other enemy, however strong, weak and eath enough to the well-lessoned warrior to overcome in compar- ison with his own appetites; natheless, great as is the travail and inexpress- ible as is the might it requireth, your words have so stirred me that needs must I, ere many days be past, cause you see by deed that, like as I know how to conquer others, even so do I know how to overcome myself.’ Nor
uz: Sizga aytay, shoh, Manfredni yengganingiz siz uchun juda katta sharaf edi, lekin undan ham kattaroq bo'lsa, o'zini yengishdir; shuning uchun, o'zingizni tuzatishingiz va bu ishtahani cheklashingiz kerak bo'lganingiz uchun, o'zingizdan shunday dog' bilan o'zingizning shonli yutuqlaringizni ko'rsata olmaysiz.

en: had many days passed after this discourse when the king, having returned to Naples, determined, as well to deprive himself of occasion to do dishonour- ably as to requite the gentleman the hospitality received from him, to go about (grievous as it was to him to make others possessors of that which he coveted over all for himself) to marry the two young ladies, and that not as Messer Neri’s daughters, but as his own.
uz: Bu nutqdan ko'p kun o'tgach, shoh Neapolga qaytib kelib, janobga o'zidan olgan mehmondo'stlikni qaytarish uchun o'zini sharmanda qilish imkoniyatini ham yo'qotishga qaror qildi. (O'ziga orzu qilgan narsalarning egalari bo'lishidan qayg'urgan holda) bu ikki yosh xonimga turmushga chiqishga qaror qildi, va bu Messer Neri qizlari kabi emas, balki o'zining qizlari kabi emas.

en: Accordingly, with Messer Neri’s
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Messer Neri bilan

en: accord, he dowered them magniﬁcently and gave Ginevra the Fair to Mess- er Maffeo da Palizzi and Isotta the Blonde to Messer Guglielmo della Magna, both noble cavaliers and great barons, to whom with inexpressible chagrin consigning them, he betook himself into Apulia, where with con- tinual fatigues he so mortiﬁed the ﬁerceness of his appetite that, having burst and broken the chains of love, he abode free of such passion for the rest of his life.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u ularni ajoyib tarzda ulug'ladi va Ginevra Fair'ni Messer Maffeo da Palizzi va Isotta the Blonde'ga Magna janob Guglielmo della Magnaga berdi. Ular ham olijanob chavandozlar, ham buyuk baronlar edi. U ularni ifodalab bo'lmaydigan xafalik bilan Apuliyaga tashladi va u yerda doimiy charchoq bilan ishtahasining shiddatini shunchalik xiralashtirdiki, sevgi zanjirlarini yorib, sindirib, umr bo'yi bunday ehtirosdan xoli bo'lib qoldi.

en: There are some belike who will say that it was a little thing for a king to have married two young ladies, and that I will allow; but a great and a very great thing I call it, if we consider that it was a king enam- oured who did this and who married to another her whom he loved, without having gotten or taking of his love leaf or ﬂower or fruit.
uz: Ba'zi odamlar shunday deyishadi: "Qirol uchun ikkita yosh xonimga turmushga chiqish kichkina narsa edi va men bunga ruxsat beraman"; lekin men buni buyuk va juda buyuk narsa deb atayman, agar biz buni qilgan va sevgan qiroli enamed ekanligini va uning sevgi bargi, guli yoki mevasini olmagan yoki olmagan holda boshqa bir ayolga turmushga chiqqanini hisobga olsak."

en: On this wise, then, did this magnanimous king, at once magniﬁcently guerdoning the noble gentleman, laudably honouring the young ladies whom he loved and bravely overcoming himself.”
uz: Shunday qilib, bu saxovatli shoh darhol olijanob janobni ajoyib tarzda qo'llab-quvvatladi, sevgan yosh ayollarni maqtovga sazovor qildi va o'zini jasorat bilan yengdi.

en: THE SEVENTH STORY King Pedro of Arragon, coming to know the fervent love borne him by Lisa, comforteth the lovesick maid and presently marrieth her to a noble young gentleman; then, kissing her on the brow, he ever after avoucheth himself her knight.
uz: YETINCHINCHI HIKOYA Arragon shohi Pedro, Liza tomonidan unga berilgan achchiq muhabbatni bilib, oshiq qizni ovutadi va uni hozirda olijanob yosh janobga turmushga chiqaradi; keyin, uni qoshdan o'pib, keyinchalik uning ritsarini o'ziga topshiradi.

en: Fiammetta having made an end of her story and the manful magnanimity of King Charles having been much commended, albeit there was one lady there who, being a Ghibelline, was loath to praise him, Pampinea, by the king’s commandment, began thus, “There is no one of understanding, wor- shipful ladies, but would say that which you say of good King Charles, ex- cept she bear him ill-will for otherwhat; but, for that there occurreth to my memory a thing, belike no less commendable than this, done of one his ad- versary to one of our Florentine damsels, it pleaseth me to relate it to you.
uz: Fiammetta o'z hikoyasini tugatdi va qirol Charlzning erkakona saxovatini ko'p maqtadi, garchi u yerda bir xonim bo'lsa ham, u Ghibellin bo'lganligi sababli uni maqtashdan nafratlanardi, Pampinea, qirolning buyrug'iga ko'ra, shunday boshladi: "Hech kim tushunadigan, g'amxo'r xonim yo'q, lekin siz yaxshi qirol Charlz haqida nima deysiz, u undan boshqa narsa uchun yomon niyat ko'rsatadi; lekin, mening xotiramda bundan kam bo'lmagan maqtovga loyiq bo'lmagan narsa paydo bo'lsa ham, u Florensiyalik kampirlarimizdan biriga nisbatan qilgan ad-versa, men buni sizga yetkazmoqchiman.

en: At the time of the expulsion of the French from Sicily, one of our Florentines was an apothecary at Palermo, a very rich man called Bernardo Puccini, who had by his wife an only daughter, a very fair damsel and already apt for marriage.
uz: Fransuzlar Sitsiliyadan surgun qilinganda, Florensiyaliklardan biri Palermo shahrida farrosh edi. Bernardo Pucchini ismli juda boy odam edi. Uning xotini yagona qizi, juda go'zal va allaqachon turmushga tayyor qiz edi.

en: Now King Pedro of Arragon, become lord of the island, held high festival with his barons at Palermo, wherein he tilting after the Catalan fashion, it chanced that Bernardo’s daughter, whose name was Lisa, saw him running [at the ring] from a window where she was with oth- er ladies, and he so marvellously pleased her that, looking upon him once and again, she fell passionately in love with him; and the festival ended and she abiding in her father’s house, she could think of nothing but of this her illustrious and exalted love.
uz: Endi Arragon qiroli Pedro, orol bekasi bo'lib, Palermo shahrida baronlari bilan yuqori bayram o'tkazdi. Unda u Kataloniya uslubini yoqtirardi. Tasodifan, Bernardo qizi, ismi Liza, uni derazadan yugurganini ko'rdi, u yerda boshqa xonimlar bilan edi va u uni shunchalik ajoyib tarzda xursand qildi, uni bir necha bor ko'rib, u unga ishtiyoq bilan oshiq bo'ldi; va festival tugab, u otasining uyida qoldi, u faqat shu ulug'vor va ulug'vor muhabbatidan boshqa hech narsani o'ylay olmadi.

en: And what most irked her in this was the con- sciousness of her own mean condition, which scarce suffered her to cherish any hope of a happy issue; natheless, she could not therefor bring herself to leave loving the king, albeit, for fear of greater annoy, she dared not discov-
uz: Va uni bu borada eng ko'p bezovta qilgan narsa o'zining oddiy ahvolini anglash edi, bu unga baxtli vaziyatdan umid qilishga kamdan-kam imkon berardi; shunga qaramay, u qirolni sevganidan ketishga jur'at eta olmasdi, garchi katta g'azabdan qo'rqib, kashf eta olmasdi.

en: The king had not perceived this thing and recked not of her, wherefor she suffered intolerable chagrin, past all that can be imagined.
uz: Shoh bu narsani anglamagan edi va uni unutmagan edi, shuning uchun u tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydigan darajada azob chekdi.

en: Thus it befell that, love still waxing in her and melancholy redoubling upon melancholy, the fair maid, unable to endure more, fell sick and wasted vis- ibly away from day to day, like snow in the sun.
uz: Shunday qilib, shunday bo'ldiki, unda muhabbat hali ham o'sib, qayg'u qayg'uga ko'payib borar ekan, go'zal xizmatkor, endi chiday olmasdan, kun sayin quyoshdagi qor kabi bemor bo'lib, xaroba bo'lib ketdi.

en: Her father and mother, sore concerned for this that befell her, studied with assiduous tenderness to hearten her and succoured her in as much as might be with physicians and medicines, but it availed nothing, for that, despairing of her love, she had elected to live no longer.
uz: Uning otasi va onasi, unga bo'lgan voqeadan juda xavotirda bo'lib, uni do'xtirlar va dori-darmonlar bilan iloji boricha yordamini berish uchun tinimsiz va mehribonlik bilan o'qidilar, ammo bu hech qanday foyda bermadi, chunki u uning muhabbatidan umidsizlanib, endi yashashni tanladi.

en: It chanced one day that, her father offering to do her every pleasure, she bethought herself, and she might aptly, to seek, before she died, to make the king acquainted with her love and her intent, and accordingly she prayed him bring her Minuccio d’Arezzo.
uz: Bir kuni otasi unga har qanday ishtiyoq bilan shug'ullanishni taklif qilib, u o'zini o'yladi va u o'limidan oldin qirolga uning muhabbati va niyatini tanishtirishni maqsad qilgan holda, o'ziga Minuccio dArezzo olib kelishini so'radi.

en: Now this Minuccio was in those days held a very quaint and subtle singer and player and was gladly seen of the king; and Bernardo concluded that Lisa had a mind to hear him sing and play awhile.
uz: O'sha paytlarda bu Minuccio juda g'alati va nozik qo'shiqchi va o'yinchi edi va uni qirol xursandchilik bilan ko'rardi; va Bernardo Lizaning uning bir oz vaqt davomida kuylab va o'ynashini eshitish aqli bor deb xulosa qildi.

en: Accordingly, he sent to tell him, and Minuccio, who was a man of a debonair humour, incontinent came to her and having somedele com- forted her with kindly speech, softly played her a ﬁt or two on a viol he had with him and after sang her sundry songs, the which were ﬁre and ﬂame unto the damsel’s passion, whereas he thought to solace her.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u unga xabar berishga yubordi, va Minuccio, o'ziga xos hazilga ega odam, uning oldiga shoshilinch ravishda keldi va uni yaxshi so'zlar bilan ko'ndirib, o'zi bilan birga bo'lgan skripkada unga sekin bir-ikki marta chalib, keyin uning turli xil qo'shiqlarini kuyladi, ular qizning ishtiyoqiga olov va alangadir, u esa uni ovutmoqchi edi.

en: Presently she told him that she would fain speak some words with him alone, wherefore, all else having withdrawn, she said to him, ‘Minuccio, I have chosen thee to keep me very faithfully a secret of mine, hoping in the ﬁrst place that thou wilt never discover it to anyone, save to him of whom I shall tell thee, and after that thou wilt help me in that which lieth in thy power; and of this I pray thee.
uz: Hozirda u unga u bilan yolg'iz gaplashishni xohlashini aytdi, shuning uchun hammasi chekinib, unga dedi: "Minuccio, men seni sirimni juda sodiq saqlab qolish uchun tanladim, birinchi navbatda uni hech kimga oshkor qilmasligingni umid qilaman, faqat senga aytib beradigan odamdan boshqa, keyin esa qo'lingda bor narsalarda menga yordam berasan; va bundan iltimos qilaman."

en: Thou must know, then, Minuccio mine, that the day our lord King Pedro held the great festival in honour of his exaltation to the throne, it befell me, as he tilted, to espy him at so dour a point461 that for the love of him there was kindled in my heart a ﬁre that hath brought me to this pass wherein thou seest me, and knowing how ill my love beseemeth to a king, yet availing not, let alone to drive it away, but even to abate it, and it being beyond measure grievous to me to bear, I have as a lesser evil elected to die, as I shall do.
uz: Shuni bilishing kerakki, Minukcio, bizning xo'jayin podshoh Pedro taxtga ko'tarilish sharafiga katta bayram o'tkazgan kuni, u egilib, uni shunchalik qo'rqitib yubordi 461ki, uning muhabbati tufayli yuragimda meni shu daryoga olib kelgan olov yoqildi va mening muhabbatim qanday yomon ekanligini bilgan holda, uni haydashga ham, hatto yo'q qilishga ham yordam bermadi, va bu men uchun juda og'ir bo'lgani uchun, men o'limni tanladim, xuddi shunday qilaman.

en: True it is that I should begone hence cruelly disconsolate, an he ﬁrst knew it not; wherefore, unknowing by whom I could more aptly ac- quaint him with this my resolution than by thyself, I desire to commit it to thee and pray thee that thou refuse not to do it, and whenas thou shalt have
uz: To'g'ri, men shu sababli shafqatsizlarcha xotirjam bo'lishni boshlagan bo'lardim, lekin u buni avval bilmas edi; shuning uchun, kim orqali uni bu qarorim bilan o'zingdan ko'ra yaxshiroq tanishtirishimni bilmasam, uni senga topshirmoqchiman va senga buni qilishdan bosh tortmasligingni so'rayman, va qachonki sen

en: done it, that thou give me to know thereof, so that, dying comforted, I may be assoiled of these my pains.’ And this said, she stinted, weeping.
uz: Shunday qildimki, sen menga bu haqda xabar ber, toki tasalli topib o'layotganimda, bu azoblarimdan xalos bo'lishim mumkin." Va bularni aytib, u yig'lab jim bo'ldi.

en: Minuccio marvelled at the greatness of the damsel’s soul and at her cruel resolve and was sore concerned for her; then, it suddenly occurring to his mind how he might honourably oblige her, he said to her, ‘Lisa, I pledge thee my faith, whereof thou mayst live assured that thou wilt never ﬁnd thy- self deceived, and after, commending thee of so high an emprise as it is to have set thy mind upon so great a king, I proffer thee mine aid, by means whereof I hope, an thou wilt but take comfort, so to do that, ere three days be past, I doubt not to bring thee news that will be exceeding grateful to thee; and to lose no time, I mean to go about it forthright.’ Lisa, having anew besought him amain thereof and promised him to take comfort, bade him God speed; whereupon Minuccio, taking his leave, betook himself to one Mico da Siena, a mighty good rhymer of those days, and constrained him with
uz: Minuccio qizning ruhining buyukligiga va uning shafqatsiz qat'iyatidan hayratda qoldi va unga qattiq qayg'urdi; keyin, birdan uning xayoliga qanday qilib uni hurmat bilan ayblash mumkinligi tushdi, u unga dedi: "Lisa, men senga o'z dinimga qasam ichaman, shunda sen hech qachon o'zingni aldamaysan, va seni shunday yuksak qudratga sazovor qilganimdan so'ng, men senga yordam beraman, umid qilamanki, lekin tasalli beraman, shuning uchun uch kundan keyin senga haddan tashqari minnatdor bo'ladigan xabarni olib kelishga shubham yo'q; va hech qachon, men seni bu haqda tashlab ketmoqchi emasman."

en: prayers to make the following canzonet: Bestir thee, Love, and get thee to my Sire And tell him all the torments I aby; Tell him I’m like to die, For fearfulness concealing my desire.
uz: Quyidagi qo'shiqlarni yozish uchun duolar: Seni tark et, Sevgi, va xo'jayinimga olib bor va unga men yetkazayotgan barcha azoblarni ayt; Unga ayt, men o'lishga o'xshayman, Qo'rquv xohishimni yashirgani uchun.

en: Love, with clasped hands I cry thee mercy, so  Thou mayst betake thee where my lord doth dwell.
uz: Sevgi, qo'llarimni bir-biriga bog'lab senga rahm-shafqat so'rayman, toki sen xo'jayinim yashaydigan joyda o'zingni qurib olgin.

en: Say that I love and long for him, for lo,  My heart he hath inﬂamed so sadly well;  Yea, for the ﬁre wherewith I’m all aglow,  I fear to die nor yet the hour can tell  When I shall part from pain so ﬁerce and fell  As that which, longing, for his sake I dree  In shame and fear; ah me,  For God’s sake, cause him know my torment dire.
uz: Aytingki, men uni sevaman va sog'inaman, chunki, mana, mening qalbim shunchalik qayg'uli tarzda yonib ketdi; Ha, men hamma yonayotgan olov uchun, o'lishdan qo'rqaman va hali soat qachon og'riqdan shunchalik qattiq ajralib tushishimni ayta olmayman, xuddi uning uchun sog'inib, uyat va qo'rquvda quriladigan narsa kabi; oh men, Xudo uchun, uning azobimni bilishiga sabab bo'lsin.

en: Since ﬁrst enamoured, Love, of him I grew,  Thou hast not given me the heart to dare  So much as one poor once my lord unto  My love and longing plainly to declare,  My lord who maketh me so sore to rue;  Death, dying thus, were hard to me to bear.
uz: Avvaliga oshiq bo'lganimdan beri, Sevgi, Undan o'sdim, Sen menga bir marta kambag'al xo'jayinimning sevgisiga jur'at etishga jur'at bermading va ochiqchasiga e'lon qilishga intilding, Meni shunchalik azobga soladigan xo'jayinim; O'lim, shunday o'layotganda, menga bardosh berish qiyin edi.

en: Belike, indeed, for he is debonair,
uz: Belike, albatta, chunki u debonair,

en: ’Twould not displease him, did he know what pain  I feel and didst thou deign  Me daring to make known to him my ﬁre.
uz: Uni xafa qilmasdim, u mening qanday og'riqni his qilayotganimni biladimi va sen menga o'timni unga bildirishga jur'at etganingni ko'rsatdingmi?

en: Yet, since ’twas not thy pleasure to impart,  Love, such assurance to me that by glance  Or sign or writ I might make known my heart  Unto my lord, for my deliverance  I prithee, sweet my master, of thine art  Get thee to him and give him souvenance  Of that fair day I saw him shield and lance  Bear with the other knights and looking more,  Enamoured fell so sore  My heart thereof doth perish and expire.
uz: Lekin, sen menga shunday ishonch bildirmaganing uchun, Sevgi, ko'z bilan, imo-ishora bilan yoki xat bilan yuragimni xo'jayinimga bildirishim mumkin edi. Qutqaruvim uchun men, azizim, xo'jayinim, san'atingdan Uni olgin va unga esdalik bergin. O'sha go'zal kunida men uni qalqon va nayza bilan boshqa ritsarlar bilan birga ko'rdim va ko'proq ko'rdim, Oshiq bo'lib, yuragim shu qadar og'ridi, u halok bo'ladi va o'ladi.

en: These words Minuccio forthwith set to a soft and plaintive air, such as the matter thereof required, and on the third day he betook himself to court, where, King Pedro being yet at meat, he was bidden by him sing somewhat to his viol.
uz: Bu so'zlar Minuccio darhol uning masalasi kabi yumshoq va shikoyatchan ruhga kirdi va uchinchi kuni u saroyga chiqdi. U yerda, qirol Pedro hali ovqatlanayotganida, u o'zining skripkasi uchun biroz qo'shiq aytishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Thereupon he fell to singing the song aforesaid on such dulcet wise that all who were in the royal hall appeared men astonied, so still and attent stood they all to hearken, and the king maybe more than the others.
uz: Shundan so'ng u yuqorida aytilgan qo'shiqni shunchalik donolik bilan kuylashga tushdiki, saroy zalida bo'lganlarning hammasi hayratda ko'rinishardi, shuning uchun hammasi jim va hushyor turishardi, eshitishardi, va shoh boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Minuccio having made an end of his singing, the king enquired whence came this song that himseemed he had never before heard.
uz: Minuccio o'z qo'shig'ini tugatgach, shoh u hech qachon eshitmagan deb o'ylagan bu qo'shiq qayerdan kelganini so'radi.

en: ‘My lord,’ replied the minstrel, ‘it is not yet three days since the words were made and the air.’ The king asked for whom it had been made; and Minuccio answered, ‘I dare not discover it save to you alone.’ The king, desirous to hear it, as soon as the tables were removed, sent for Minuccio into his chamber and the latter orderly recounted to him all that he had heard from Lisa; wherewith Don Pedro was exceeding well pleased and much com- mended the damsel, avouching himself resolved to have compassion of so worthful a young lady and bidding him therefore go comfort her on his part and tell her that he would without fail come to visit her that day towards vespers.
uz: Hazratim,  javob berdi vazir,  sozlar va havo yaratilganidan hali uch kun otmadi. Shoh kim uchun yaratilganini soradi; Minukcio javob berdi: Men buni faqat sizdan boshqa topishga jurat eta olmayman. Buni eshitishni istagan podshoh stollar olib tashlangan zahoti Minuksioning xonasiga jonatdi va oxirgi biri unga Lisa'dan eshitgan hamma narsani tartibli tarzda aytib berdi; shu bilan Don Pedro juda xursand edi va kampirni juda yaxshi tuzatdi, ozini shunday munosib yosh xonimga rahm qilishga qaror qildi va unga oz tomoniga borishni buyurdi, shuning uchun u unga osha kuni kechaga borishini bemalol aytdi.

en: Minuccio, overjoyed to be the bearer of such pleasing news, betook himself incontinent, viol and all, to the damsel and bespeaking her in private, recounted to her all that had passed and after sang her the song to his viol; whereat she was so rejoiced and so content that she straightway showed manifest signs of great amendment and longingly awaited the hour
uz: Minuccio, bunday yoqimli xabarni olib yurganidan juda xursand bo'lib, o'zini beparvo, violet va boshqa narsalarga qaratib, xonimga yolg'iz gapirib, unga o'tgan hamma narsani aytib berdi va keyin unga violetga qo'shiq kuyladi; u shunchalik xursand edi va shunchalik xursand ediki, u darhol katta o'zgarish alomatlarini ko'rsatdi va intiqlik bilan kutdi.

en: of vespers, whenas her lord should come, without any of the household knowing or guessing how the case stood.
uz: Kechki kunlar, xo'jayini kelishi kerak bo'lganda, hech kim uydagilar bu ish qanday ekanligini bilmasdan yoki taxmin qilmasdan.

en: Meanwhile, the king, who was a debonair and generous prince, having sundry times taken thought to the things heard from Minuccio and very well knowing the damsel and her beauty, waxed yet more pitiful over her and mounting to horse towards vespers, under colour of going abroad for his di- version, betook himself to the apothecary’s house, where, having required a very goodly garden which he had to be opened to him, he alighted therein and presently asked Bernardo what was come of his daughter and if he had yet married her.
uz: Ayni paytda, mehribon va saxiy shahzoda bo'lgan qirol, Minuccio'dan eshitgan narsalar haqida turli vaqtlar o'ylab, malika va uning go'zalligini juda yaxshi bilgan holda, unga yanada achinarli bo'lib, kechki paytlarga qarab otga minib, o'zining versiyasi uchun chet elga boradigan rangda, o'zini dorixonachining uyiga qaradi. U yerda, unga ochilishi kerak bo'lgan juda yaxshi bog'ni talab qilib, u yerga tushdi va darhol Bernardodan qizidan nima kelib qolganini va u hali unga turmushga chiqqanmi, deb so'radi.

en: ‘My lord,’ replied the apothecary, ‘she is not married; nay, she hath been and is yet very sick; albeit it is true that since none she hath mended marvellously.’ The king readily apprehended what this amendment meant and said, ‘In good sooth, ’twere pity so fair a creature should be yet taken from the world.
uz: Hazratim,  javob berdi dorixonachi,  u turmushga chiqmagan; yoq, u juda kasal bolgan va hali ham juda kasal; garchi u hech kimni ajoyib tarzda tuzatgani rost bolsa ham. Shoh bu tuzatish nimani anglatishini tezda anglab yetdi va dedi: Xotirjam boling, dunyodan hali ham shunday gozal mavjudot olinishi kerak edi.

en: We would fain go visit her.’ Accordingly, a little after, he betook himself with Bernardo and two companions only to her chamber and going up to the bed where the damsel, somedele upraised,462 awaited him with impatience, took her by the hand and said to her, ‘What meaneth this, my mistress?
