uz: Biz uni ziyorat qilishga borardik." Shunga ko'ra, birozdan so'ng u Bernardo va ikki hamrohi bilan faqat uning xonasiga bordi va xonim, somedele uni sabrsizlik bilan kutib turgan karavotga ko'tarilib, uni qo'lidan ushladi va dedi: "Bu nimani anglatadi, bekam?"

en: You are young and should comfort other women; yet you suffer yourself to be sick.
uz: Siz yoshsiz va boshqa ayollarga tasalli berishingiz kerak; ammo o'zingizni kasal bo'lishingizga toqat qilasiz.

en: We would beseech you be pleased, for the love of us, to hearten yourself on such wise that you may speedily be whole again.’ The damsel, feeling herself touched of his hands whom she loved over all else, albeit she was somewhat shamefast, felt yet such gladness in her heart as she were in Paradise and answered him, as best she might, saying, ‘My lord, my having willed to subject my little strength unto very grievous bur- dens hath been the cause to me of this mine inﬁrmity, whereof, thanks to your goodness, you shall soon see me quit.’ The king alone understood the damsel’s covert speech and held her momently of more account; nay, sun- dry whiles he inwardly cursed fortune, who had made her daughter unto such a man; then, after he had tarried with her awhile and comforted her yet more, he took his leave.
uz: Sizdan iltimos qilamiz, bizni sevish uchun, tezda sog'ayib ketishingiz uchun o'zingizni shunday xursand qiling. Qizaloq, o'zini sevgan qo'llari bilan qo'llab-quvvatlaganini his qilib, garchi u biroz uyatchan bo'lsa ham, yuragida jannatdagidek quvonch his qildi va unga javob berdi, iloji boricha: "Ey xo'jayin, mening kichik kuchimni juda og'ir darajada ko'mib tashlashni xohlaganim mening bu zaifligimga sabab bo'ldi, shuning uchun sizning yaxshiligingiz tufayli meni tezda tashlab ketishimni ko'rasiz." Qizaloq qizning yashirin nutqini tushundi va uni bir zumda ko'proq hisobga oldi; yo'q, quyoshdan quruq bo'lsa ham, u ich-ichida uning qizini shunday odamga la'natladi; keyin u uni o'zi bilan birga qo'yib,

en: This humanity of the king was greatly commended and attributed for great honour to the apothecary and his daughter, which latter abode as well pleased as ever was woman of her lover, and sustained of better hope, in a few days recovered and became fairer than ever.
uz: Shohning bu insoniyligi apoteker va uning qizi uchun katta maqtovga va katta sharafga sazovor bo'ldi. Ular sevgilisidan har doimgidek mamnun bo'lishdi va yaxshiroq umidga ega bo'lishdi, bir necha kun ichida tuzalib, har qachongidan ham go'zalroq bo'lishdi.

en: When she was whole again, the king, having taken counsel with the queen of what return he should make her for so much love, mounting one day to horse with many of his barons, repaired to the apothecary’s house and entering the garden, let
uz: U yana sog'ayganida, shoh malika bilan uning qaytib kelishi kerakligi haqida maslahatlashib, bir kuni o'zining ko'plab baronlari bilan otga minib, dorixonachining uyiga borib, bog'ga kirdi.

en: call Master Bernardo and his daughter; then, the queen presently coming thither with many ladies and having received Lisa among them, they fell to making wonder-merry.
uz: Ustoz Bernardo va uning qizini chaqiring; keyin, qirolicha tez orada ko'plab xonimlar bilan u yerga kelib, ularning orasida Lisani qabul qilib, hayratga tushishdi.

en: After a while, the king and queen called Lisa to them and the former said to her, ‘Noble damsel, the much love you have borne us hath gotten you a great honour from us, wherewith we would have you for the love of us be content; to wit, that, since you are apt for marriage, we would have you take him to husband whom we shall bestow on you, purposing, notwithstanding this, to call ourselves still your knight, without desiring aught from you of so much love but one sole kiss.’ The damsel, grown all vermeil in the face for shamefastness, making the king’s pleasure hers, replied in a low voice on this wise, ‘My lord, I am well assured that, were it known that I had fallen enamoured of you, most folk would account me mad therefor, thinking belike that I had forgotten myself and knew not mine own condition nor yet yours; but God, who alone seeth the hearts of mortals, knoweth that, in that same
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, podshoh va malika Lizani ularga chaqirib olishdi va sobiq qiz unga dedi: "Aziz qiz, bizga ko'rsatgan ko'p muhabbatingiz bizdan sizga katta sharaf keltirdi, biz sizni bizga bo'lgan muhabbatingiz uchun mamnun qilmoqchimiz; xususan, siz turmushga chiqishga tayyor ekansiz, uni sizga sovg'a qiladigan erga olib borishni xohlaymiz, shunga qaramay, o'zimizni sizdan ko'p muhabbat istamasdan, faqat bitta o'pichdan boshqa hech narsa istamasdan, o'z otangiz deb atashni maqsad qilgan holda."

en: hour whenas ﬁrst you pleased me, I knew you for a king and myself for the daughter of Bernardo the apothecary and that it ill beseemed me to address the ardour of my soul unto so high a place.
uz: Siz meni birinchi marta xursand qilganingizda, men sizni shoh deb bilardim va o'zimni Bernardo dorixonaning qizi deb bilardim va bunchalik baland joyga jonimning ishtiyoqi bilan murojaat qilish menga juda yoqmas edi.

en: But, as you know far better than I, none here below falleth in love according to ﬁtness of election, but according to appetite and inclination, against which law I once and again strove with all my might, till, availing no farther, I loved and love and shall ever love you.
uz: Lekin, siz mendan ancha yaxshi bilasizki, bu yerda hech kim muhabbatga saylanish mosligiga ko'ra tushmaydi, balki ishtaha va moyillikka ko'ra tushadi, bu qonunga qarshi bir necha bor bor bor kuchim bilan kurashdim, toki, bundan keyin ham hech qanday foyda ko'rmay, sevdim va sevaman va seni ham sevaman.

en: But, since ﬁrst I felt myself taken with love of you, I determined still to make your will mine; wherefore, not only will I gladly obey you in this matter of taking a hus- band at your hands and holding him dear whom it shall please you to be- stow on me, since that will be mine honour and estate, but, should you bid me abide in the ﬁre, it were a delight to me, an I thought thereby to pleasure you.
uz: Lekin, men avval o'zimni senga oshiq bo'lganimdan beri, sening irodangni o'zimniki qilishga qaror qildim; shuning uchun, nafaqat qo'lingizda hus-bog'ni olib, seni yoqtirgan odamni ushlab turish masalasida sizga mamnuniyat bilan itoat qilaman, chunki bu mening sharafim va mulkim bo'ladi, balki, agar menga olovda qolishimni buyursangiz, bu menga zavq bag'ishlaydi, va men shu orqali sizni mamnun qilishni o'yladim.

en: To have you, a king, to knight, you know how far it beﬁtteth me, wherefore to that I make no farther answer; nor shall the kiss be vouchsafed you, which alone of my love you would have, without leave of my lady the queen.
uz: Sizni, shohni, ritsarlikka olish menga qanchalik mos kelishini bilasiz, shuning uchun men bunga boshqa javob bermayman; va faqat mening sevgimdan olgan o'pich sizga malika xonimning ruxsatisiz sovg'a qilinmaydi.

en: Natheless, of such graciousness as hath been yours towards me and that of our lady the queen here God render you for me both thanks and re- compense, for I have not the wherewithal.’ And with that she was silent.
uz: Shunga qaramay, siz menga va bu yerdagi malikaxonimizning marhamatidan ko'ra, Xudo sizga minnatdorchilik va minnatdorchilik bildiradi, chunki menda hech qanday imkoniyat yo'q." Va u jim bo'ldi.

en: Her answer much pleased the queen and she seemed to her as discreet as the king had reported her.
uz: Uning javobi malikaga juda yoqdi va u shoh unga xabar berganidek, o'ziga kamtarona ko'rindi.

en: Don Pedro then let call the girl’s father and moth- er and ﬁnding that they were well pleased with that which he purposed to do, summoned a young man, by name Perdicone, who was of gentle birth, but poor, and giving certain rings into his hand, married him, nothing loath,
uz: Don Pedro qizning otasi va onasini chaqirib, ular o'zi qilmoqchi bo'lgan ishdan juda mamnun ekanligini bilgach, muloyim, ammo kambag'al bo'lgan Perdikone ismli yigitni chaqirib, qo'liga ayrim uzuklarni berib, unga turmushga chiqdi, hech narsa yoqimsiz edi.

en: to Lisa; which done, he then and there, over and above many and precious jewels bestowed by the queen and himself upon the damsel, gave him Cef- falu and Calatabellotta, two very rich and goodly ﬁefs, and said to him, ‘These we give thee to the lady’s dowry.
uz: Lizaga shunday qildi, u u yerda va u yerda, qirolicha va o'zi malikaga sovg'a qilgan ko'plab va qimmatbaho javohirlardan tashqari, unga Cef-falu va Calatabellotta, juda boy va yaxshi ikki qizni berdi va unga dedi: "Bularni senga xonimning marosimiga beramiz."

en: That which we purpose to do for thyself, thou shalt see in time to come.’ This said, he turned to the damsel and saying, ‘Now will we take that fruit which we are to have of your love,’ took her head in his hands and kissed her on the brow.
uz: O'zing uchun qilmoqchi bo'lgan ishimizni kelajakda ko'rasan." Shundan so'ng, u qizga o'girildi va dedi: "Endi sening muhabbatingdan bo'ladigan o'sha mevadan olamiz", - deb, uning boshini qo'liga oldi va qovog'idan o'pdi.

en: Perdicone and Lisa’s father and mother, well pleased, (as indeed was she herself), held high fest- ival and joyous nuptials; and according as many avouch, the king very faithfully kept his covenant with the damsel, for that, whilst she lived, he still styled himself her knight nor ever went about any deed of arms but he wore none other favour than that which was sent him of her.
uz: Perdikone va Lizaning otasi va onasi, juda xursand bo'lishgan edi (aslida u o'zi ham shunday edi), yuqori bayram va quvnoq to'ylarni o'tkazishardi; va ko'pchilikning fikricha, shoh qiz bilan ahdini juda sodiqlik bilan saqlardi, chunki u tirik bo'lganida ham, o'zini ritsar deb bilmasdi va hech qachon hech qanday qurol-yarog' ishini qilmasdi, lekin undan yuborilganidan boshqa hech qanday marhamatga ega emas edi.

en: It is by doing, then, on this wise that subjects’ hearts are gained, that others are incited to do well and that eternal renown is acquired; but this is a mark at which few or none nowadays bend the bow of their understanding, most princes being presently grown cruel and tyrannical.”
uz: Shunday qilib, shu yo'l bilan sub'ektlarning yuraklari qozoniladi, boshqalar yaxshilikka undiriladi va abadiy shuhrat qozoniladi; lekin bu belgi bo'lib, hozirda kamdan kam yoki hech kim o'z tushunchasining kamonini bukmaydi, aksariyat shahzodalar hozirda shafqatsiz va zulmkor bo'lib ulg'aymoqda.

en: THE EIGHTH STORY Sophronia, thinking to marry Gisippus, becometh the wife of Titus Quintius Fulvus and with him betaketh herself to Rome, whither Gisippus cometh in poor case and conceiving himself slighted of Titus, declareth, so he may die, to have slain a man.
uz: Sakkizinchi Hikoya: Sofroniya, Gisippga turmushga chiqishni o'ylab, Tit Kvintiy Fulvning xotiniga aylanadi va u bilan birga Rimga boradi. U yerga Gisipp kambag'al holda keladi va o'zini Titdan kamsitilgan deb hisoblaydi va o'ldirilishi mumkinligini, odamni o'ldirganini e'lon qiladi.

en: Titus, recognizing him, to save him, avoucheth himself to have done the deed, and the true murderer, seeing this, discovereth himself; whereupon they are all three liberated by Octavianus and Titus, giving Gisippus his sister to wife, hath all his good in common with him.
uz: Tit uni tanib, uni qutqarish uchun, bu ishni qilganini tan oldi va haqiqiy qotil buni ko'rib, o'zini topdi; shundan so'ng, ularning uchalasi ham Oqtavian va Tit tomonidan ozod qilindi, Gisippni singlisini xotinlikka berdi, uning barcha yaxshiliklari bilan birga edi.

en: Pampinea having left speaking and all having commended King Pedro, the Ghibelline lady more than the rest, Fiammetta, by the king’s commandment, began thus, “Illustrious ladies, who is there knoweth not that kings, when they will, can do everything great and that it is, to boot, especially required of them that they be magniﬁcent?
uz: Pampinea gapini tugatgach va hamma gapni boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq maqtab, Ghibellin xonimi podshoh Pedroni, Fiammetta, podshohning buyrug'iga ko'ra, shunday boshladi: "Ajoyib xonimlar, u yerda kim bilmaydi, qachonki podshohlar xohlasalar, hamma narsani buyuk qila olishadi va bu, ayniqsa ulardan ajoyib bo'lishlari talab etiladi?"

en: Whoso, then, having the power, doth that which pertaineth unto him, doth well; but folk should not so much marvel thereat nor exalt him to such a height with supreme praise as it would be- hove them do with another, of whom, for lack of means, less were required.
uz: Kimda kuch bo'lsa, o'ziga tegishli bo'lgan narsani qilsa, yaxshi qiladi; lekin odamlar unga shunchalik hayron bo'lmasinlar va uni oliy maqtovga ko'tarmasliklari kerak bo'lgan darajada yuqoriga ko'tarmasinlar - ularni boshqa bir kishi bilan tutsalar, undan mablag' yetishmasligi sababli kamroq talab qilinardi.

en: Wherefore, if you with such words extol the actions of kings and they seem to you fair, I doubt not anywise but those of our peers, whenas they are like unto or greater than those of kings, will please you yet more and be yet highlier commended of you, and I purpose accordingly to recount to you, in a story, the praiseworthy and magnanimous dealings of two citizens and friends with each other.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar siz bunday so'zlar bilan shohlarning harakatlarini ulug'lasangiz va ular sizga adolatli ko'rinsa, men hech qanday shubha qilmayman, lekin bizning tengdoshlarimizning harakatlari, ular shohlarga o'xshash yoki ulardan kattaroq bo'lsa, sizni yanada mamnun qiladi va sizdan yanada yuqori maqtovga sazovor bo'ladi. Shunday ekan, men sizga bir hikoyada ikki fuqaro va do'stning bir-biriga bo'lgan maqtovga loyiq va saxovatli munosabatlarini aytib bermoqchiman.

en: You must know, then, that at the time when Octavianus Caesar (not yet styled Augustus) ruled the Roman empire in the ofﬁce called Triumvirate, there was in Rome a gentleman called Publius Quintius Fulvus,463 who, having a son of marvellous understanding, by name Titus Quintius Fulvus,
uz: Shuni bilishingiz kerakki, Oktavian Sezar (hozircha Avgust deb atalmagan) Rim imperiyasini Triumvirat deb nomlangan lavozimda boshqargan paytda, Rimda Publius Quintius Fulvus, 463 ismli bir janob bor edi, u ajoyib tushunchaga ega bo'lgan o'g'il bo'lib, Titus Quintius Fulvus deb nomlangan.

en: sent him to Athens to study philosophy and commended him as most he might to a nobleman there called Chremes, his very old friend, by whom Titus was lodged in his own house, in company of a son of his called Gisip- pus, and set to study with the latter, under the governance of a philosopher named Aristippus.
uz: Uni Afinaga falsafani o'rganish uchun yubordi va uni u yerdagi Chremes ismli zodagonga imkon qadar ko'proq maqtadi. Bu uning juda eski do'sti edi. Tit o'z uyida, o'g'li Gisip- pus bilan birga yashagan va Aristippus ismli faylasufning boshqaruvi ostida oxirgi bilan o'qishga kirishgan edi.

en: The two young men, coming to consort together, found each other’s usances so conformable that there was born thereof a brother- hood between them and a friendship so great that it was never sundered by other accident than death, and neither of them knew weal nor peace save in so much as they were together.
uz: Ikki yigit, birga kelishib, bir-birlarining odatlarini shunchalik yaxshi ko'rishdiki, ular o'rtasida bir aka-ukalik va shunchalik katta do'stlik paydo bo'ldiki, u hech qachon o'limdan boshqa tasodif bilan uzilmagan va ularning hech biri birga bo'lganidan boshqa hech qanday boylik yoki tinchlikni bilmasdi.

en: Entering upon their studies and being each alike endowed with the highest understanding, they ascended with equal step and marvellous commendation to the glorious altitudes of philosophy; and in this way of life they continued good three years, to the exceeding contentment of Chremes, who in a manner looked upon the one as no more his son than the other.
uz: Ularning o'qishlari boshlanib, har biri eng yuqori tushunchaga ega bo'lganligi sababli, ular falsafaning ulug'vor cho'qqilariga teng qadamlar va ajoyib maqtov bilan ko'tarilishdi; va shu hayot tarzida ular uch yil davomida yaxshi hayot kechirdilar, Chremesning haddan tashqari mamnunligiga erishdilar, u bir tomonga o'g'ildan ko'ra ko'proq o'g'il deb qarardi.

en: At the end of this time it befell, even as it befalleth of all things, that Chremes, now an old man, departed this life, whereof the two young men suffered a like sorrow, as for a common father, nor could his friends and kinsfolk discern which of the twain was the more in need of consolation for that which had betided them.
uz: Vaqt oxirida, xuddi hamma narsaga o'xshab, Chremes, endi keksa odam, bu hayotdan ketdi. Bu hayotda ikki yigit oddiy otadek qayg'uga duch kelishdi, do'stlari va qarindoshlari esa ularni tashvishga solgan narsa uchun qaysi Twain ko'proq tasalliga muhtoj ekanligini aniqlay olishmadi.

en: It came to pass, after some months, that the friends and kinsfolk of Gisip- pus resorted to him and together with Titus exhorted him to take a wife, to which he consenting, they found him a young Athenian lady of marvellous beauty and very noble parentage, whose name was Sophronia and who was maybe ﬁfteen years old.
uz: Va shunday bo'ldiki, bir necha oy o'tgach, Gisip-pusning do'stlari va qarindoshlari unga murojaat qilishdi va Tit bilan birga uni xotin olishga undashdi. U rozi bo'ldi va unga ajoyib go'zallik va juda olijanob kelib chiqishga ega bo'lgan, ismi Sofroniya bo'lgan va ehtimol o'n besh yoshda bo'lgan yosh afinalik xonimni topdilar.

en: The term of the future nuptials drawing nigh, Gisippus one day besought Titus to go visit her with him, for that he had not yet seen her.
uz: Kelajakdagi nikoh muddati yaqinlashayotgan edi, Gisippus bir kuni Titdan uni u bilan birga ziyorat qilishga so'radi, chunki u uni hali ko'rmagan edi.

en: Accordingly, they being come into her house and she seated between the twain, Titus proceeded to consider her with the utmost atten- tion, as if to judge of the beauty of his friend’s bride, and every part of her pleasing him beyond measure, what while he inwardly commended her charms to the utmost, he fell, without showing any sign thereof, as passion- ately enamoured of her as ever yet man of woman.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ular uning uyiga kirib, u ikki kishi o'rtasida o'tirgach, Tit uni eng yuqori e'tibor bilan ko'rib chiqishga kirishdi, go'yo do'stining kelinining go'zalligini va uning har bir qismini o'lchovdan tashqari mamnun qilgandek. U ich-ichidan uning jozibasini eng yuqori darajada taslim etgan holda, hech qanday alomat ko'rsatmasdan, unga nisbatan ishtiyoq bilan, hech qachon ayol bo'lmaganidek oshiq bo'lib qoldi.

en: After they had been with her awhile, they took their leave and returned home, where Titus, betaking himself alone into his chamber, fell a-thinking of the charming damsel and grew the more enkindled the more he enlarged upon her in thought; which, perceiving, he fell to saying in himself, after many ardent sighs, ‘Alack, the wretchedness of thy life, Titus!
uz: Ular u bilan bir oz vaqt birga bo'lgandan so'ng, xonadan ketishdi va qaytib kelishdi. U yerda Tit o'z xonasiga yolg'iz kirib, jozibali qiz haqida o'ylab, uning ustida fikrlar tobora kattalashib borardi; buni anglab yetgach, u o'zida ko'p achchiq nafaslardan so'ng dedi: "Laak, hayotingning bechoraligi, Tit!"

en: Where and on what settest thou thy mind and thy love and thy hope?
uz: Qayerda va nimaga umid qilyapsan, sevgi va umidingni?

en: Knowest thou not that it behoveth thee, as well for the kindness received from Chremes and his family as for the entire
uz: Bilmaysanmi, bu senga kerak, xuddi Chremes va uning oilasidan olingan mehribonlik uchun ham butun...

en: friendship that is between thee and Gisippus, whose bride she is, to have yonder damsel in such respect as a sister?
uz: Siz bilan Gisipp o'rtasidagi do'stlik, uning kelini bo'lgan, u yerda bir ayolning singlisi kabi hurmatga ega bo'lishi uchunmi?

en: Whom, then, lovest thou?
uz: Xo'sh, kimni sevasiz?

en: Whith- er lettest thou thyself be carried away by delusive love, whither by falla- cious hope?
uz: Nima uchun aldovli muhabbatga, noto'g'ri umidga yo'l qo'yib, o'zingni yo'ldan ozdirding?

en: Open the eyes of thine understanding and recollect thyself, wretch that thou art; give place to reason, curb thy carnal appetite, temper thine unhallowed desires and direct thy thoughts unto otherwhat; gainstand thy lust in this its beginning and conquer thyself, whilst it is yet time.
uz: O'z aqlingni och va o'zingni esla, ey bechora, aqlga yo'l ber, nafs ishtahangni jilovla, nopok istaklaringni jilovla va fikrlaringni boshqa narsaga yo'naltir; shahvatingni shu boshida qo'lga kiriting va o'zingni zabt et, hali vaqti kelmagan paytda.

en: This thou wouldst have is unseemly, nay, it is dishonourable; this thou art minded to ensue it behoveth thee, even wert thou assured (which thou art not) of obtaining it, to ﬂee from, an thou have regard unto that which true friendship requireth and that which thou oughtest.
uz: Siz xohlagan narsa behayo, yo'q, u sharmandali; bu narsa sizga kerak bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun mo'ljallangan, garchi (sizda bo'lmagan) unga erishishga ishonchingiz komil bo'lsa, undan qochishga qaror qilsangiz ham, haqiqiy do'stlik talab qiladigan va sizga kerak bo'lgan narsaga e'tibor berasiz.

en: What, then, wilt thou do, Titus?
uz: Xo'sh, unda nima qilmoqchisan, Tit?

en: Thou wilt leave this unseemly love, an thou wouldst do that which behoveth.’ Then, remembering him of Sophronia and going over to the contrary, he denounced all that he had said, saying, ‘The laws of love are of greater puissance than any others; they annul even the Divine laws, let alone those of friendship; how often aforetime hath father loved daughter, brother sister, stepmother stepson, things more monstrous than for one friend to love the other’s wife, the which hath already a thousand times befallen!
uz: Sen bu behayo muhabbatni tark etmoqchisan, va kerak bo'lgan narsani qilmoqchisan." Keyin, uni Sofroniyadan eslab, aksincha, u aytgan hamma narsani qoralab dedi: "Muhabbat qonunlari boshqalardan ko'ra kuchliroqdir; ular hatto do'stlik qonunlarini ham bekor qiladilar; avval otasi qizini, aka-uka, o'gay onani, bir do'stning boshqa birovning xotinini sevishidan ko'ra dahshatli narsalarni qanchalar yaxshi ko'rgan edi, bu allaqachon ming marta sodir bo'lgan!

en: Moreover, I am young and youth is altogether subject to the laws of Love; wherefor that which pleaseth Him, needs must it please me.
uz: Qolaversa, men yoshman va yoshlik muhabbat qonunlariga butunlay bo'ysunadi; chunki Unga ma'qul keladigan narsa menga ma'qul kelishi kerak.

en: Things honourable pertain unto maturer folk; I can will nought save that which Love willeth.
uz: Shon-shuhratli narsalar keksa odamlarga tegishli; Men Sevgi xohlagan narsadan boshqa hech narsa qilolmayman.

en: The beauty of yonder damsel deserveth to be loved of all, and if I love her, who am young, who can justly blame me therefor?
uz: O'sha qizning go'zalligi hamma tomonidan sevilishga loyiq, va agar men uni sevsam, kim yosh bo'lsa, meni buning uchun kim ayblashi mumkin?

en: I love her not because she is Gisippus’s; nay, I love her for that I should love her, whosesoever she was.
uz: Men uni Gisippga tegishli bo'lgani uchun sevmayman; aksincha, men uni sevishim kerakligi uchun sevaman, kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.

en: In this fortune sinneth that hath allotted her to Gisippus my friend, rather than to another; and if she must be loved, (as she must, and deservedly, for her beauty), Gisippus, an he came to know it, should be better pleased that I should love her, I, than another.’ Then, from that reasoning he reverted again to the contrary, making mock of himself, and wasted not only that day and the ensuing night in passing from this to that and back again, but many others, insomuch that, losing appetite and sleep therefor, he was constrained for weakness to take to his bed.
uz: Bu baxtda uni boshqaga emas, balki do'stim Gisippga ajratgan gunoh qiladi; va agar u sevilishi kerak bo'lsa, (uning go'zalligi uchun, albatta va haqli ravishda), Gisipp, buni bilgach, men uni boshqalardan ko'ra yaxshiroq sevishim kerak edi. Keyin, shu mulohazalardan tashqariga qaytdi, o'zini masxara qildi va nafaqat o'sha kun va keyingi tunni u tomonga va orqaga o'tishda, balki ko'plab boshqalarni ham, chunki u yerda ishtaha va uyqu yo'qotgani uchun, zaiflik tufayli o'z karavotiga olib ketishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Gisippus, having beheld him several days full of melancholy thought and seeing him presently sick, was sore concerned and with every art and all so- licitude studied to comfort him, never leaving him and questioning him of- ten and instantly of the cause of his melancholy and his sickness.
uz: Gisipp uni bir necha kun davomida qayg'uli o'ylarga to'la ko'rib, yaqinda kasal bo'lganini ko'rib, qattiq tashvishlanardi va har bir san'at va har qanday odob bilan uni taskin berish uchun o'rganardi, hech qachon tashlab ketmasdi va uni o'n marta va bir zumda qayg'uli va kasalligining sababini so'rardi.

en: after having once and again given him idle tales, which Gisippus knew to be such, by way of answer, ﬁnding himself e’en constrained thereunto, with tears and sighs replied to him on this wise, ‘Gisippus, had it pleased the Gods, death were far more agree to me than to live longer, considering that fortune hath brought me to a pass whereas it behoved me make proof of my virtue and that I have, to my exceeding shame, found this latter overcome; but certes I look thereof to have ere long the reward that beﬁtteth me, to wit, death, and this will be more pleasing to me than to live in remembrance of my baseness, which latter, for that I cannot nor should hide aught from thee, I will, not without sore blushing, discover to thee.’ Then, beginning from the beginning, he discovered to him the cause of his melancholy and the conﬂict of his thoughts and ultimately gave him to know which had gotten
uz: Gisipp unga qayta-qayta bekorchi hikoyalar aytib berganidan so'ng, javob sifatida, o'zini bunga majbur deb topgach, unga shunday deb javob berdi: "Gisippus, agar Xudolarga yoqqanida, o'lim menga uzoqroq yashashdan ko'ra ko'proq ma'qul bo'lardi, chunki omad meni o'z fazilatlarimdan dalolat berishi kerak edi va men haddan tashqari uyatim tufayli bu oxirgi narsani yengib o'tganman." Ammo, albatta, men o'limga mos keladigan mukofotga ega bo'lishga umid qilaman va bu menga o'limni eslashdan ko'ra ko'proq yoqadi.

en: the victory and confessed himself perishing for love of Sophronia, declaring that, knowing how much this misbeseemed him, he had for penance thereof resolved himself to die, whereof he trusted speedily to make an end.
uz: g'alaba va Sofroniyaga bo'lgan muhabbat tufayli halok bo'lganini tan oldi, bu uni qanchalik yomon ko'rsatganini bilgan holda, uning tavbasi uchun o'zini o'ldirishga qaror qilganini e'lon qildi, bunga tezda yakun yasashga ishondi.

en: Gisippus, hearing this and seeing his tears, abode awhile irresolute, as one who, though more moderately, was himself taken with the charms of the fair damsel, but speedily bethought himself that his friend’s life should be dearer to him than Sophronia.
uz: Gisippus buni eshitib va uning ko'z yoshlari ko'rinib, biroz qat'iyatsiz qoldi, xuddi o'rtacha bo'lsa ham, o'zi go'zal qizning jozibasiga tushgandek, lekin tezda do'stining hayoti unga Sofroniyadan qimmatroq bo'lishi kerak deb o'yladi.

en: Accordingly, solicited to tears by those of his friend, he answered him, weeping, ‘Titus, wert thou not in need as thou art of comfort, I should complain of thee to thyself, as of one who hath transgressed against our friendship in having so long kept thy most grievous passion hidden from me; since, albeit it appeared not to thee honourable, nevertheless dishonourable things should not, more than honourable, be hidden from a friend; for that a friend, like as he rejoiceth with his friend in honourable things, even so he studieth to do away the dishonourable from his friend’s mind; but for the present I will refrain therefrom and come to that which I perceive to be of greater urgency.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, do'stining ko'z yoshlari tufayli u yig'lab javob berdi: "Tit, agar sen taskin topganing uchun muhtoj bo'lmaganding, men seni o'zingga shikoyat qilsam kerak, chunki u do'stligimizga zid bo'lib, eng og'riqli azobingni mendan uzoq yashirdi; chunki, garchi u senga sharafli ko'rinmasa ham, sharafdan ko'ra sharafsiz narsalar do'stdan yashirilmasligi kerak; chunki do'st, do'sti bilan faxrli narsalarda xursand bo'lgani kabi, u ham do'stining fikridan sharafsiz narsalarni olib tashlashni o'rganadi; lekin hozircha men undan voz kechaman va men shoshilinch deb hisoblagan narsalarga kelaman.

en: That thou lovest Sophronia, who is betrothed to me, I marvel not: nay, I should marvel, indeed, if it were not so, knowing her beauty and the nobility of thy mind, so much the more susceptible of passion as the thing that pleaseth hath the more excellence.
uz: Menga unashtirilgan Sofroniyani sevishing meni hayratga solmaydi: yo'q, agar shunday bo'lmasa, hayron bo'lardim, chunki uning go'zalligini va aql-idroking oliyligini bilganimda, yoqtiradigan narsa shunchalik ehtirosga beriluvchan bo'lsa, shunchalik mukammal bo'lardi.

en: And the more reason thou hast to love Sophronia, so much the more un- justly dost thou complain of fortune (albeit thou expressest this not in so many words) in that it hath awarded her to me, it seeming to thee that thy love for her had been honourable, were she other than mine; but tell me, if thou be as well advised as thou usest to be, to whom could fortune have awarded her, whereof thou shouldst have more cause to render it thanks,
uz: Va Sofroniyani qancha ko'p sevishing kerak bo'lsa, shuncha adolatsizroq bo'lishing mumkin. Garchi buni bunchalik ko'p so'z bilan ifodalamasang ham, sen boylikdan shikoyat qilasan, chunki u menga uni sovg'a qildi, go'yo unga bo'lgan muhabbating meniki bo'lmaganida hurmatga sazovor bo'lgandek tuyuladi; lekin menga ayt, agar sen o'zing bo'lishing kerak bo'lganidek yaxshi maslahat bergan bo'lsang, unga kimga boylik bergan bo'larding, bunga ko'proq minnatdorchilik bildirishing kerak edi.

en: than of having awarded her to me?
uz: Uni menga sovg'a qilganimdan ko'ra?

en: Whoso else had had her, how honour- able soever thy love had been, had liefer loved her for himself464 than for thee,465 a thing which thou shouldst not fear466 from me, an thou hold me a friend such as I am to thee, for that I mind me not, since we have been friends, to have ever had aught that was not as much thine as mine.
uz: Uni kimda bo'lsa ham, sening muhabbating qanday sharafli bo'lsa ham, uni senga nisbatan o'zi uchun yaxshiroq sevgan bo'lardi 464, 465. Bu mendan qo'rqmasliging kerak bo'lgan narsa 466, va sen meni senga o'xshagan do'st deb hisoblaysan, chunki biz do'st bo'lganimizdan beri, hech qachon meniki kabi bo'lmagan hech narsaga ega bo'lganim haqida o'ylamayman.

en: Now, were the matter so far advanced that it might not be otherwise, I would do with her as I have done with my other possessions;467 but it is yet at such a point that I can make her thine alone; and I will do so, for that I know not why my friendship should be dear to thee, if, in respect of a thing that may honourably be done, I knew not of a desire of mine to make thine.
uz: Xo'sh, agar masala shunchalik oldinga siljigan bo'lsa, boshqacha bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, men u bilan boshqa mol-mulklarim bilan qilganimdek ish tutardim; 467 lekin hozircha uni yolg'iz o'zingniki qila olaman; va men buni qilaman, chunki men bilmayman, nega do'stligim senga qimmat bo'lishi kerak, agar sharaf bilan qilinadigan narsa haqida bilmagan bo'lsam, men o'zingniki qilish istagim bor edi.

en: True it is that Sophronia is my promised bride and that I loved her much and looked with great joyance for my nuptials with her; but, since thou, being far more understanding than I, with more ardour desirest so dear a thing as she is, live assured that she shall enter my chamber, not as my wife, but as thine.
uz: To'g'ri, Sofron mening va'da qilingan kelinimdir va men uni juda yaxshi ko'rardim va u bilan to'ylarim uchun katta quvonch bilan qarardim; lekin, sen mendan ancha tushunchliroq bo'lganingdan, u kabi qadrdon narsani ko'proq ishtiyoq bilan xohlaganingdan, u mening xonamga mening xotinim kabi emas, balki sening xotining kabi kirishiga ishonch bilan yashang.

en: Wherefore leave thought-taking, put away melancholy, call back thy lost health and comfort and allegresse and from this time forth expect with blitheness the reward of thy love, far worthier than was mine.’ When Titus heard Gisippus speak thus, the more the ﬂattering hopes giv- en him of the latter afforded him pleasure, so much the more did just reason inform him with shame, showing him that, the greater was Gisippus his lib- erality, the more unworthy it appeared of himself to use it; wherefore, without giving over weeping, he with difﬁculty replied to him thus, ‘Gisip- pus, thy generous and true friendship very plainly showeth me that which it pertaineth unto mine to do.
uz: Shunday ekan, o'ylashni tashla, qayg'uni qo'y, yo'qotilgan sog'lig'ingni, taskiningni va xushmuomalaligingni qaytarib ol va bundan buyon menikiga qaraganda ancha arziydigan muhabbating mukofotini baxt bilan kut." Tit Gisippusning bu gapini eshitganida, unga bu haqda berilgan xushomadli umidlar qanchalik ko'p rohat bergan bo'lsa, shunchalik adolat unga uyat bilan xabar berdi, unga Gisippusning erkinligi qanchalik katta bo'lsa, u undan foydalanishga shunchalik loyiq ko'rinardi; shuning uchun, yig'lab yubormasdan, u unga shunday javob berdi: "Gisippus, sening saxiy va chin do'stliging menga bu ish menga tegishli ekanligini juda aniq ko'rsatadi."

en: God forfend that her, whom He hath bestowed upon thee as upon the worthier, I should receive from thee for mine!
uz: Xudo senga munosibroq deb berganini, sendan o'zimniki uchun olishimga yo'l qo'ymasin!

en: Had He judged it ﬁtting that she should be mine, nor thou nor others can believe that He would ever have bestowed her on thee.
uz: Agar U uni meniki deb topganida edi, na sen, na boshqalar U uni senga sovg'a qilgan bo'lishiga ishonolmaysan.

en: Use, therefore, joyfully, thine election and discreet counsel and His gifts, and leave me to languish in the tears, which, as to one undeserving of such a treasure, He hath pre- pared unto me and which I will either overcome, and that will be dear to thee, or they will overcome me and I shall be out of pain.’ ‘Titus,’ rejoined Gisippus, ‘an our friendship might accord me such license that I should en- force thee to ensue a desire of mine and if it may avail to induce thee to do so, it is in this case that I mean to use it to the utmost, and if thou yield not to my prayers with a good grace, I will, with such violence as it behoveth us use for the weal of our friends, procure that Sophronia shall be thine.
uz: Shunday ekan, xursandchilik bilan Sening tanlaganingdan, maxfiy maslahatingdan va Uning sovg'alaridan foydalan, va meni shunday xazinaga loyiq bo'lmagan odamga nisbatan, U menga oldindan g'amxo'rlik qilgan va men uni yengaman, va bu senga qimmat bo'ladi, yoki ular meni yengadi va men og'riqdan xalos bo'laman."  Tit,  javob berdi Gisippus,  agar bizning do'stligimiz senga kuchimning ehtiyojini ta'minlash uchun shunday ruxsat berishi mumkin edi va agar u senga buni qilishga undashga yordam bersa, men uni maksimal darajada ishlatmoqchiman, va agar sen mening duolarimga yaxshi inoyat bilan berilmasang, men, do'stlarimiz uchun shunday zo'ravonlik bilan ishlataman, biz esa...

en: I know how great is the might of love and that, not once, but many a time, it
uz: Men sevgi kuchining naqadar buyuk ekanligini bilaman va bu, bir marta emas, balki ko'p marta,

en: hath brought lovers to a miserable death; nay, unto this I see thee so near that thou canst neither turn back nor avail to master thy tears, but, proceed- ing thus, wouldst pine and die; whereupon I, without any doubt, should speedily follow after.
uz: Oshiqlarni achinarli o'limga olib keldi; yo'q, men seni shunchalik yaqin ko'ryapmanki, na orqaga qaytara olmaysan, na ko'z yoshingni o'zlashtirishga yordam bera olmaysan, lekin shunday qilib, azob chekib o'lishni xohlaysan; shundan so'ng, hech qanday shubhasiz, tezda ergashaman.

en: If, then, I loved thee not for otherwhat, thy life is dear to me, so I myself may live.
uz: Agar seni boshqa hech narsa uchun sevmasam, sening hayoting menga qadrli, shunda men ham yashashim mumkin.

en: Sophronia, therefore, shall be thine, for that thou couldst not lightly ﬁnd another woman who would so please thee, and as I shall easily turn my love unto another, I shall thus have contented both thyself and me.
uz: Sofroniya, demak, seniki bo'ladi, chunki sening ko'nglingga yetadigan boshqa ayolni oson topa olmas eding, va men muhabbatimni boshqaga osonlikcha o'girganim kabi, men ham o'zingni, ham o'zimni qoniqtirgan bo'lardim.

en: I should not, peradventure, be so free to do this, were wives as scarce and as uneath to ﬁnd as friends; however, as I can very easily ﬁnd me another wife, but not another friend, I had liefer (I will not say lose her, for that I shall not lose her, giving her to thee, but shall transfer her to an- other and a better self, but) transfer her than lose thee.
uz: Men, ehtimol, buni qilishga shunchalik erkin bo'lmasligim kerak edi, chunki xotinlar juda kam va do'st topish uchun yaroqsiz edi; ammo, men o'zimga boshqa xotin topishim mumkin bo'lgani uchun, boshqa do'st emas, men uni yo'qotishim kerak edi (uning yo'qotishini aytmayman, chunki men uni yo'qotmayman, senga beraman, lekin uni boshqaga va yaxshiroq o'zimga o'tkazaman, lekin) uni yo'qotishdan ko'ra o'tkazaman.

en: Wherefore, if my prayers avail aught with thee, I beseech thee put away from thee this afﬂic- tion and comforting at once thyself and me, address thee with good hope to take that joyance which thy fervent love desireth of the thing beloved.’ Although Titus was ashamed to consent to this, namely, that Sophronia should become his wife, and on this account held out yet awhile, neverthe- less, love on the one hand drawing him and Gisippus his exhortations on the other urging him, he said, ‘Look you, Gisippus, I know not which I can say I do most, my pleasure or thine, in doing that whereof thou prayest me and which thou tellest me is so pleasing to thee, and since thy generosity is such that it overcometh my just shame, I will e’en do it; but of this thou mayst be assured that I do it as one who knoweth himself to receive of thee, not only the beloved lady, but with her his life.
uz: Shunday ekan, agar duolarim senga hech qanday foyda keltirsa, iltimos qilaman, bu azobni sendan olib tashla va o'zingni va meni darhol tasalli ber, sevgan narsadan o'sha ishtiyoq bilan istaydigan quvonchni olish uchun senga murojaat qil." Tit bunga rozi bo'lishdan uyalgan bo'lsa-da, Sofroning unga xotin bo'lishi kerak edi, va shu sababli biroz cho'ziladi, hech bo'lmaganda, bir tomondan sevgi uni tortib, Gisippusning uni boshqa tomondan o'ziga undashi kerak edi, u dedi: "Senga qara, Gisippus, men senga aytishim mumkin bo'lgan eng ko'p narsani, xohishimni yoki sening ibodatingni, ya'ni sen meni senga shunday yoqtirganingni, va chunki sening saxiyliging uni faqat o'zing bilan qabul qilishingni xohlaysan, lekin men buni faqat o'zim bilan qilmasligingni bilaman.

en: The Gods grant, an it be possible, that I may yet be able to show thee, for thine honour and thy weal, how grateful to me is that which thou, more pitiful for me than I for myself, dost for me!’ These things said, ‘Titus,’ quoth Gisippus, ‘in this matter, an we would have it take effect, meseemeth this course is to be held.
uz: Xudolar imkon bersin, agar men senga hali ham ko'rsata olsam, sening sharafing va boyliging uchun, menga qanchalik minnatdor bo'lishing mumkin, sen menga nisbatan o'zimga nisbatan achinarliroq bo'lsang, menga shunday qilgin! Bu gaplarni aytdi: Titus, dedi Gisippus, bu masalada, biz buni amalga oshirishni xohlardik, chunki bu kurs o'tkazilishi kerak.

en: As thou knowest, Sophronia, after long treaty between my kinsfolk and hers, is be- come my afﬁanced bride; wherefore, should I now go about to say that I will not have her to wife, a sore scandal would ensue thereof and I should anger both her kinsfolk and mine own.
uz: Bilasanmi, Sofron, qarindoshlarim va uning qarindoshlari o'rtasida uzoq muddatli shartnoma tuzilganidan so'ng, kelinim bo'ldi; shuning uchun, agar men uni xotin qilmayman deb aytmoqchi bo'lsam, bundan og'ir janjal kelib chiqadi va men uning qarindoshlari ham, o'zimning qarindoshlarim ham g'azablanishim kerak.

en: Of this, indeed, I should reck noth- ing, an I saw that she was thereby to become thine; but I misdoubt me that, an I renounce her at this point, her kinsfolk will straightway give her to an- other, who belike will not be thyself, and so wilt thou have lost that which I shall not have gained.
uz: Bundan, rostini aytsam, men hech narsa hisoblamasam kerak, va men uning shu orqali senga tegishli bo'lishini ko'rdim; lekin men shu nuqtada undan voz kechganimda, uning qarindoshlari uni darhol boshqaga berishadi, u o'zing bo'lmasang ham bo'ladi, va shuning uchun men qo'lga kiritmagan narsani yo'qotasan.

en: Wherefore meseemeth well, an thou be content, that I follow on with that which I have begun and bring her home as mine and
uz: Shuning uchun yaxshi ko'rinadi, va sen rozi bo'l, men boshlagan ishimni davom ettiraman va uni uyimga o'zimniki sifatida olib kelaman va

en: hold the nuptials, and thou mayst after, as we shall know how to contrive, privily lie with her as with thy wife.
uz: Turmush qurish marosimlarini o'tkazing, keyin esa, biz qanday tuzishni bilganimizdek, xotining bilan yashirincha yotishingiz mumkin.

en: Then, in due place and season, we will make manifest the fact, which, if it please them not, will still be done and they must perforce be content, being unable to go back upon it.’ The device pleased Titus; wherefore Gisippus received the lady into his house, as his, (Titus being by this recovered and in good case), and after holding high festival, the night being come, the ladies left the new-married wife in her husband’s bed and went their ways.
uz: Keyin, o'z vaqtida va mavsumida, biz shunday faktni oshkor qilamizki, agar ularga yoqmasa, baribir amalga oshiriladi va ular bunga qaytib bora olmasliklari uchun majbur bo'lishlari kerak." Qurilma Titga yoqdi; shuning uchun Gisippus xonimni o'z uyiga o'z uyidek qabul qildi (Titus sog'aygan va yaxshi holatda edi), va bayram o'tkazgandan so'ng, tun kelgach, xonimlar yangi turmush qurgan xotinini erining karovatida qoldirib, yo'lga ketishdi.

en: Now Titus his chamber ad- joined that of Gisippus and one might go from the one room into the other; wherefore Gisippus, being in his chamber and having put out all the lights, betook himself stealthily to his friend and bade him go couch with his mis- tress.
uz: Endi Tit o'z xonasi Gisippning xonasiga qo'shildi va biri bir xonadan ikkinchisiga o'tishi mumkin edi; shuning uchun Gisipp xonasida bo'lib, barcha chiroqlarni o'chirib bo'lgandan so'ng, o'zini do'stining oldiga yashirincha olib bordi va unga o'zining beparvoligi bilan yotishni buyurdi.

en: Titus, seeing this, was overcome with shame and would fain have re- pented and refused to go; but Gisippus, who with his whole heart, no less than in words, was minded to do his friend’s pleasure, sent him thither, after long contention.
uz: Tit buni ko'rib, xijolatga to'lib ketdi va qaytadan rozi bo'lib, ketishdan bosh tortdi; lekin Gisippus, do'stining roziligini butun qalbi bilan, so'z bilan emas, balki so'z bilan qilmoqchi bo'lgan, uzoq bahsdan so'ng uni u yerga jo'natdi.

en: Whenas he came into the bed, he took the damsel in his arms and asked her softly, as if in sport, if she chose to be his wife.
uz: U karavotga kirganida, u qizni quchog'iga oldi va undan, xuddi sport kabi, xotini bo'lishni xohlaydimi, deb sekin so'radi.

en: She, thinking him to be Gisippus, answered, ‘Yes’; whereupon he set a goodly and rich ring on her ﬁnger, saying, ‘And I choose to be thy husband.’ Then, the marriage consummated, he took long and amorous pleasance of her, without her or others anywise perceiving that other than Gisippus lay with her.
uz: U uni Gisippus deb o'ylagan holda, javob berdi: "Ha"; shundan so'ng u barmog'iga yaxshi va boy uzuk qo'ydi va dedi: "Men sening ering bo'lishni tanlayman". Keyin, nikoh tugagandan so'ng, u undan uzoq va ishqiy lazzat oldi, u yoki boshqalar Gisippusdan boshqa hech kim uning bilan yotganini sezmasdan.

en: The marriage of Sophronia and Titus being at this pass, Publius his father departed this life, wherefore it was written him that he should without delay return to Rome, to look to his affairs, and he accordingly took counsel with Gisippus to betake himself thither and carry Sophronia with him; which might not nor should aptly be done without discovering to her how the case stood.
uz: Sofroniya va Titning turmush qurishi shu davrda bo'lganligi sababli, otasi Publiy bu hayotdan ketdi, shuning uchun unga Rimga kechiktirmasdan qaytib, o'z ishlarini ko'rib chiqishi kerakligi yozilgan edi va u Gisipp bilan o'zini u yerga olib borish va Sofroniyani o'zi bilan olib ketish haqida maslahatlashdi; bu ish qanday holatda ekanligini bilmasdan amalga oshirilishi mumkin emas va to'g'ri ham bo'lmas edi.

en: Accordingly, one day, calling her into the chamber, they thoroughly discovered to her the fact and thereof Titus certiﬁed her by many particulars of that which had passed between them twain.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, bir kuni uni xonaga chaqirib, ular bu faktni unga to'liq anglab yetishdi va bu haqda Tit ularni ikki o'rtasida sodir bo'lgan voqealarning ko'plab tafsilotlari bilan tasdiqladi.

en: Sophronia, after eying the one and the other somewhat despitefully, fell a-weeping bitterly, complain- ing of Gisippus his deceit; then, rather than make any words of this in his house, she repaired to that of her father and there acquainted him and her mother with the cheat that had been put upon her and them by Gisippus, avouching herself to be the wife of Titus and not of Gisippus, as they be- lieved.
uz: Sofrona, bir-biriga biroz norozilik bilan qaraganidan so'ng, achchiq yig'lab, Gisippusning aldovidan shikoyat qildi; keyin, uning uyida bu haqda hech qanday so'z aytmasdan, otasining so'ziga murojaat qildi va u yerda uni va onasini Gisippus tomonidan unga va ularga qo'yilgan firibgarlik bilan tanishtirdi, o'zini Titning xotini deb tan oldi, Gisippusning emas, chunki ular...

en: This was exceeding grievous to Sophronia’s father, who made long and sore complaint thereof to her kinsfolk and those of Gisippus, and much and great was the talk and the clamour by reason thereof.
uz: Bu Sofronning otasi uchun juda achinarli edi, u bu haqda qarindoshlariga va Gisippusning odamlariga uzoq va achchiq shikoyat qildi, va shu sababli gap-so'zlar va shov-shuvlar juda ko'p edi.

en: in despite both by his own kindred and those of Sophronia and everyone de- clared him worthy not only of blame, but of severe chastisement; whilst he, on the contrary, avouched himself to have done an honourable thing and one for which thanks should be rendered him by Sophronia’s kinsfolk, hav- ing married her to a better than himself.
uz: Shunga qaramay, o'z qarindoshlari ham, Sofroning qarindoshlari ham uni nafaqat ayblashga, balki qattiq jazolashga loyiq deb topdilar; aksincha, u o'zini sharafli ish qilgan deb hisoblardi va buning uchun Sofroning qarindoshlari unga minnatdorchilik bildirishi kerak edi, chunki u uni o'zidan yaxshiroqga turmushga bergan edi.

en: Titus, on his part, heard and suffered everything with no little annoy and knowing it to be the usance of the Greeks to press on with clamours and menaces, till such times as they found who should answer them, and then to become not only humble, but abject, he bethought himself that their clam- our was no longer to be brooked without reply and having a Roman spirit and an Athenian wit, he adroitly contrived to assemble Gisippus his kinsfolk and those of Sophronia in a temple, wherein entering, accompanied by Gisippus alone, he thus bespoke the expectant folk: ‘It is the belief of many philosophers that the actions of mortals are determined and foreor- dained of the immortal Gods, wherefore some will have it that all that is or shall ever be done is of necessity, albeit there be others who attribute this necessity to that only which is already done.
uz: Tit, o'z navbatida, hamma narsani unchalik g'azablanmasdan eshitdi va chekdi va buni yunonlarning shovqin va tahdidlar bilan davom etish odati ekanligini bildi, toki ular ularga javob berishni topguncha, keyin nafaqat kamtar, balki beparvo bo'lib qolish uchun, u o'zini shunday deb hisoblardi - ularning shikoyati javobsiz oqib ketmasligi kerak edi va Rim ruhi va Afina hiylasiga ega edi, u mohirona ravishda Gisippusning o'z qarindoshlari va Sofroniyadagilarini ibodatxonaga yig'ishni o'ylab topdi, u yerda Gisippus bilan birga kirib, umidvor odamlarga shunday dedi: "Ko'p faylasuflarning harakatlari o'lmas xudolarning tomonidan aniqlangan va yo'q qilingan deb ishonadi, chunki ba'zilar uchun bu zarur bo'lishi kerak, faqatgina ular uchun zarur bo'lishi kerak."

en: If these opinions be considered with any diligence, it will very manifestly be seen that to blame a thing which cannot be undone is to do no otherwhat than to seek to show oneself wiser than the Gods, who, we must e’en believe, dispose of and govern us and our affairs with unfailing wisdom and without any error; wherefore you may very easily see what fond and brutish overweening it is to presume to ﬁnd fault with their operations and eke how many and what chains they merit who suffer themselves be so far carried away by hardihood as to do this.
uz: Agar bu fikrlar har qanday e'tibor bilan ko'rib chiqilsa, shuni juda yaqqol ko'rish mumkinki, bartaraf etib bo'lmaydigan narsani ayblash - bu o'zini Xudolardan donoroq ko'rsatishga urinishdan boshqa narsa emas. Ularga ishonishimiz kerakki, ular bizni va ishlarimizni hech qanday xatolarsiz va beqiyos donolik bilan boshqaradi; shuning uchun siz juda osonlik bilan ularning harakatlarida ayb topishga va o'zlarini qattiqqo'llik bilan olib ketishga majbur bo'lganlarning qancha va qanday zanjirlarga loyiq ekanliklarini taxmin qilish qanday mehribonlik va shafqatsiz ustunlik ekanligini ko'rish mumkin.

en: Of whom, to my thinking, you are all, if that be true which I under- stand you have said and still say for that Sophronia is become my wife, whereas you had given her to Gisippus, never considering that it was fore- ordained from all eternity that she should become not his, but mine, as by the issue is known at this present.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, sizlarning barchangiz, agar men asosli bo'lsa, Sofroniya mening xotinim bo'ldi deb aytganingiz va hali ham aytayotganingiz rost bo'lsa, siz uni Gisippga bergan edingiz, bu masala hozirda ma'lum bo'lganidek, u uning emas, balki meniki bo'lishi butun abadiylikdan oldindan belgilangan edi.

en: But, for that to speak of the secret fore- ordinance and intention of the Gods appeareth unto many a hard thing and a grievous to apprehend, I am willing to suppose that they concern not them- selves with aught of our affairs and to condescend to the counsels468 of mankind, in speaking whereof, it will behove me to do two things, both very contrary to my usances, the one, somedele to commend myself, and the other, in some measure to blame or disparage others; but, for that I pur- pose, neither in the one nor in the other, to depart from the truth and that the present matter requireth it, I will e’en do it.
uz: Lekin, Xudolarning sirli tartiblari va niyatlari haqida gapirish ko'pchilik uchun qiyin va tushunish qiyin tuyulgani uchun, men ularning bizning ishlarimizga qiziqmasligi va insoniyat maslahatlariga kamsitilishi kerak deb taxmin qilishga tayyorman. Bu haqda gapirganda, menga ikki narsani qilish kerak bo'ladi, ikkalasi ham mening odatlarimga zid, biri o'zimni maqtash uchun, ikkinchisi esa, bir ozda boshqalarni ayblash yoki kamsitish uchun; lekin, men na birida, na ikkinchisida ham haqiqatdan chetga chiqishga va hozirgi masala uni talab qilishiga yo'l qo'yishim uchun, men buni qilaman.

en: Your complainings, dictated more by rage than by reason, upbraid, revile and condemn Gisippus with continual murmurs or rather clamours, for that, of his counsel, he hath given me to wife her whom you of yours469 had giv- en him; whereas I hold that he is supremely to be commended therefor, and that for two reasons, the one, for that he hath done that which a friend should do, and the other, for that he hath in this wrought more discreetly than did you.
uz: Sizning shikoyatlaringiz, aql-idrokdan ko'ra g'azabga bog'liq, Gisippni doimiy pichirlash yoki aksincha, hayqiriq bilan tanqid qiladi va hukm qiladi, chunki u o'z maslahati bilan menga o'zingizdan bergan 469 ta ayolni xotinlikka berdi; ammo men uni shu uchun oliy darajada maqtashga loyiq deb hisoblayman va ikki sababga ko'ra, biri, do'sti qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishni qilganligi uchun, ikkinchisi esa, bu ishda sizdan ko'ra yashirinroq qilganligi uchun.

en: That which the sacred laws of friendship will that one friend should do for the other, it is not my intention at this present to expound, be- ing content to have recalled to you this much only thereof, to wit, that the bonds of friendship are far more stringent than those of blood or of kindred, seeing that the friends we have are such as we choose for ourselves and our kinsfolk such as fortune giveth us; wherefore, if Gisippus loved my life more than your goodwill, I being his friend, as I hold myself, none should marvel thereat.
uz: Do'stlikning muqaddas qonuniyatlari bir do'stning boshqa do'st uchun qilishi kerak bo'lgan narsani hozirda tushuntirish niyatim emas, faqat shuni eslatib o'tishga kifoyalanaman, ya'ni, do'stlik rishtalari qon yoki qarindoshlik rishtalaridan ancha qattiqroq, chunki bizda bo'lgan do'stlar o'zimiz tanlaganidek va qarindoshlarimiz bizga omad berganidek; shuning uchun, agar Gisippus mening hayotimni sizning yaxshiligingizdan ko'ra ko'proq sevgan bo'lsa, men uning do'sti ekanligimdan hayron bo'lmasligim kerak.

en: But to come to the second reason, whereanent it more in- stantly behoveth to show you that he hath been wiser than yourselves, since meseemeth you reck nothing of the foreordinance of the Gods and know yet less of the effects of friendship: —I say, then, that you of your judgment, of your counsel and of your deliberation, gave Sophronia to Gisippus, a young man and a philosopher; Gisippus of his gave her to a young man and a philosopher; your counsel gave her to an Athenian and that of Gisippus to a Roman; your counsel gave her to a youth of noble birth and his to one yet nobler; yours to a rich youth, his to a very rich; yours to a youth who not only loved her not, but scarce knew her, his to one who loved her over his every happiness and more than his very life.
uz: Lekin ikkinchi sababga kelsak, u sizga o'zingizdan donoroq ekanligini ko'rsatish kerak, chunki siz Xudolarning ustunligini hisobga olmaysiz va do'stlik oqibatlarini hali ham kamroq bilasiz: Men aytaman, shunda siz o'z hukmingiz, maslahatingiz va mulohazalaringiz bilan Sofroniyani Yosh va faylasufga berdingiz; Uning Gisipi uni yosh yigitga va faylasufga berdi; sizning maslahatingiz uni Afinaga va Gisipiga Rimga berdi; sizning maslahatingiz uni olijanob tug'ilgan yoshga va undan ham olijanobroq yoshga berdi; o'zining boy yigitga, juda boyga berdi; uni nafaqat sevgan, balki o'z hayotini sevgan, o'z hayotini sevgan yoshga.

en: And to show you that this I say is true and that Gisippus his action is more commendable than yours, let us consider it, part by part.
uz: Va senga bu gapim rost ekanligini va Gisippning bu ishi senikidan ko'ra maqtovliroq ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun, keling, buni qisman-qisman ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: That I, like Gisippus, am a young man and a philo- sopher, my favour and my studies may declare, without more discourse thereof.
uz: Men, Gisippus kabi, yosh yigit va filosofman, bu haqda ko'proq gapirmasdan, o'z minnatdorchiligim va o'rganishlarimni e'lon qila olaman.

en: One same age is his and mine and still with equal step have we pro- ceeded studying.
uz: Bir xil yosh uning ham, mening ham va baribir teng qadamda o'qishni davom ettirdik.

en: True, he is an Athenian and I am a Roman.
uz: To'g'ri, u ateyslik, men esa rimlikman.

en: If it be dis- puted of the glory of our native cities, I say that I am a citizen of a free city and he of a tributary one; I am of a city mistress of the whole world and he of a city obedient unto mine; I am of a city most illustrious in arms, in em- pery and in letters, whereas he can only commend his own for letters.
uz: Agar o'zimizning ona shaharlarimizning ulug'vorligidan voz kechilsa, men erkin shahar fuqarosiman va u daryolardan; men butun dunyo shahar bekasiman va u menga itoatkor shahardan; men qurol-yarog' va maktublar bo'yicha eng mashhur shahardanman, ammo u faqat o'z xatlari uchun maqtov ayta oladi.

en: Moreover, albeit you see me here on lowly wise enough a student, I am not born of the dregs of the Roman populace; my houses and the public places of Rome are full of antique images of my ancestors and the Roman annals will be found full of many a triumph led by the Quintii up to the Roman
uz: Qolaversa, garchi meni bu yerda yetarlicha dono talaba sifatida ko'rsangiz ham, men Rim aholisining xarobalaridan tug'ilmaganman; mening uylarim va Rimning jamoat joylari ajdodlarimning qadimiy tasvirlariga to'la va Rim yilnomalari Quintii boshchiligidagi ko'plab g'alabalarga to'la bo'ladi.

en: Capitol; nor is the glory of our name fallen for age into decay, nay, it presently ﬂourisheth more splendidly than ever.
uz: Kapitoliy; bizning ismimizning ulug'vorligi ham asrlar davomida chirib ketgani yo'q, aksincha, u hozir har qachongidan ham ulug'vorroq gullab-yashnaydi.

en: I speak not, for shamefast- ness, of my riches, bearing in mind that honourable poverty hath ever been the ancient and most ample patrimony of the noble citizens of Rome; but, if this be condemned of the opinion of the vulgar and treasures commended, I am abundantly provided with these latter, not as one covetous, but as be- loved of fortune.470 I know very well that it was and should have been and should be dear unto you to have Gisippus here in Athens to kinsman; but I ought not for any reason to be less dear to you at Rome, considering that in me you would have there an excellent host and an useful and diligent and powerful patron, no less in public occasions than in matters of private need.
uz: Men o'z boyligim haqida uyatchanlik bilan gapirmayapman, chunki hurmatli qashshoqlik Rim oliyjanob fuqarolarining qadimiy va eng keng boyligi bo'lganini yodda tutaman; lekin, agar bu g'alati va tavsiya etilgan xazinalar fikri bilan qoralangan bo'lsa, men bu oxirgilar bilan to'yib ta'minlanaman, emas, balki boylikparast sifatida emas. 470. Men yaxshi bilaman, Afina shahrida Gisippusni qarindoshingizga berish siz uchun qadrli edi va qadrli bo'lishi kerak edi; lekin men hech qanday sababga ko'ra Rimda sizga kamroq qadrli bo'lmasligim kerak, chunki menda sizda shaxsiy ehtiyojlarda, kam bo'lmagan darajada ajoyib qo'shinga, foydali va g'ayratli va qudratli homiy bo'lar edi.

en: Who then, letting be wilfulness and considering with reason, will com- mend your counsels above those of my Gisippus?
uz: Xo'sh, kim, ixtiyoriy bo'lishga va aql bilan mulohaza yuritishga ruxsat berib, mening Gisippumning maslahatlaridan ko'ra sizning maslahatlaringizni yaxshiroq ko'rsatadi?

en: Sophronia, then, is well and duly married to Titus Quintius Fulvus, a noble, rich and long-descended citizen of Rome and a friend of Gisippus; wherefore whoso complaineth or maketh moan of this doth not that which he ought neither knoweth that which he doth.
uz: Sofrona, demak, Rim fuqarosi, boy va uzoq yillardan beri kelib chiqadigan, Gisippning do'sti bo'lgan Tit Kvintiy Fulvga yaxshi va munosib turmushga chiqqan; shuning uchun, kim shikoyat qilsa yoki bu haqda noliydi, u nima qilmasligi kerakligini ham bilmaydi.

en: Some perchance will say that they complain not of Sophronia being the wife of Titus, but of the manner wherein she be- came his wife, to wit, in secret and by stealth, without friend or kinsman knowing aught thereof; but this is no marvel nor thing that betideth newly.
uz: Ba'zilar Sofroniya Titning xotini ekanligidan shikoyat qilishmaydi, balki uning xotini yashirincha va yashirincha, do'sti yoki qarindoshi bundan hech narsa bilmasdan kelganligi haqida shikoyat qilishadi; lekin bu hech qanday ajoyib va yangi narsa emas.

en: I willingly leave be those who have aforetime taken husbands against their parents’ will and those who have ﬂed with their lovers and have been mis- tresses before they were wives and those who have discovered themselves to be married rather by pregnancy or childbearing than with the tongue, yet hath necessity commended it to their kinsfolk; nothing of which hath happened in Sophronia’s case; nay, she hath orderly, discreetly and honour- ably been given by Gisippus to Titus.
uz: Men avval ota-onasiga qarshi er olganlarni, sevgilisi bilan qochib ketganlarni va xotin bo'lishidan oldin xaroba qilganlarni va til bilan emas, balki homiladorlik yoki tug'ish orqali turmushga chiqishni aniqlaganlarni ixtiyoriy ravishda tark etaman, ammo zarurat bo'lsa-da, buni o'z qarindoshlariga topshirgan; Sofroning holatida hech narsa sodir bo'lmadi; yo'q, u tartibli, yashirincha va hurmat bilan Gisippus tomonidan Titga berilgan.

en: Others will say that he gave her in marriage to whom it appertained not to do so; but these be all foolish and womanish complaints and proceed from lack of advisement.
uz: Boshqalar esa, u uni o'ziga tegishli bo'lmagan odamga turmushga berganini aytishadi; lekin bularning barchasi ahmoqona va ayolona shikoyatlar bo'lib, maslahat yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.

en: This is not the ﬁrst time that fortune hath made use of various means and strange instru- ments to bring matters to foreordained issues.
uz: Bu omadning turli xil vositalar va g'alati ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, ishlarni oldindan belgilangan masalalarga olib borishi birinchi marta emas.

en: What have I to care if it be a cordwainer rather than a philosopher, that hath, according to his judgment, despatched an affair of mine, and whether in secret or openly, provided the issue be good?
uz: Menga nima farqi bor, agar u faylasufdan ko'ra, mening ishimni o'z hukmiga ko'ra, yashirincha yoki ochiqchasiga, agar masala yaxshi bo'lsa, yuborib yuborgan odam bo'lsa?

en: If the cordwainer be indiscreet, all I have to do is to look well that he have no more to do with my affairs and thank him for that which is done.
uz: Agar to'qimachilik xizmatchisi beparvo bo'lsa, men faqatgina uning mening ishlarim bilan aloqasi yo'qligini yaxshi ko'rsatishim va qilgan ishim uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirishim kerak.

en: If Gisippus hath married Sophronia well, it is a superﬂuous folly to go complaining of the manner and of him.
uz: Agar Gisipp Sophroniyani yaxshi turmushga chiqargan bo'lsa, uning uslubi va undan shikoyat qilish ortiqcha ahmoqlikdir.

en: If you have no conﬁd-
uz: Agar sizda hech qanday ishonch bo'lmasa...

en: ence in his judgment, look he have no more of your daughters to marry and thank him for this one.
uz: Uning hukmiga ishoning, mana, u endi turmushga chiqadigan qizlaringiz yo'q va shu uchun unga rahmat ayt.

en: Nevertheless I would have you to know that I sought not, either by art or by fraud, to impose any stain upon the honour and illustriousness of your blood in the person of Sophronia, and that, albeit I took her secretly to wife, I came not as a ravisher to rob her of her maidenhead nor sought, after the manner of an enemy, whilst shunning your alliance, to have her otherwise than honourably; but, being ardently enkindled by her lovesome beauty and by her worth and knowing that, had I sought her with that ordinance which you will maybe say I should have used, I should not (she being much be- loved of you) have had her, for fear lest I should carry her off to Rome, I used the occult means that may now be discovered to you and caused Gisip- pus, in my person, consent unto that which he himself was not disposed to do.
uz: Shunga qaramay, shuni bilishingiz kerakki, men Sofroning shaxsiga san'at yoki firibgarlik yo'li bilan qoningizning sha'ni va mashhurligiga dog' solmoqchi emasdim va garchi uni yashirincha xotinlikka olsam ham, uni bokiralikdan o'g'irlash uchun zo'ravon sifatida kelmadim va dushman uslubida, sizning ittifoqingizdan qochgan holda, uni boshqa narsadan hurmat bilan emas, balki hurmat bilan olishni xohlamadim; balki, uning yoqimli go'zalligi va uning qadri bilan qizdirilgan holda va siz aytishingiz kerak bo'lgan bu tartib bilan uni qidirganimda, men uni (u sizdan juda sevgan bo'lishi kerak edi) sizdan ko'rmagan bo'lardim, chunki uni Rimga olib ketishdan qo'rqardim, men hozir siz uchun g'oyib va o'zimning roziligim bo'lgan holda, u...

en: Moreover, ardently as I loved her, I sought her embraces not as a lover, but as a husband, nor, as she herself can truly testify, did I draw near to her till I had ﬁrst both with the due words and with the ring espoused her, ask- ing her if she would have me for husband, to which she answered ay.
uz: Qolaversa, men uni chin dildan sevganim uchun, uni sevgilim sifatida emas, balki er sifatida quchoqlashga harakat qildim, va o'zi haqiqatan ham guvohlik bera oladiganidek, men unga yaqinlashmadim, toki avval uni munosib so'zlar bilan ham, uzuk bilan ham turmushga chiqarib, undan meni turmushga chiqishni xohlaydimi deb so'ramasdim, unga javob berdi.

en: If it appear to her that she hath been deceived, it is not I who am to blame there- for, but she, who asked me not who I was.
uz: Agar unga aldangan ko'rinsa, unda aybdor men emasman, balki mendan kimligimni so'ramagan u.

en: This, then, is the great misdeed, the grievous crime, the sore default committed by Gisippus as a friend and by myself as a lover, to wit, that Sophronia hath secretly become the wife of Titus Quintius, and this it is for which you defame and menace and plot against him.
uz: Demak, bu Gisippusning do'st sifatida va men tomonidan oshiq sifatida sodir etilgan buyuk xatti-harakat, og'ir jinoyat, ya'ni Sofroning Tit Kintiyning xotini bo'lib qolgani, shu sababli siz uni tuhmat qildingiz, tahdid qildingiz va fitna qildingiz.

en: What more could you do, had he bestowed her upon a churl, a losel or a slave?
uz: Agar u unga bir chiroyli qiz, bir bechora yoki bir qul berganida, yana nima qila olar eding?

en: What chains, what prison, what gibbets had sufﬁced thereunto?
uz: Qanday zanjirlar, qanday qamoqxona, u yerda qanday gibbetlar yetarli edi?

en: But let that be for the present; the time is come which I looked not for yet, to wit, my father is dead and it behoveth me return to Rome; wherefore, meaning to carry Sophronia with me, I have discovered to you that which I should otherwise belike have yet kept hidden from you and with which, an you be wise, you will cheerfully put up, for that, had I wished to cheat or outrage you, I might have left her to you, scorned and dishonored; but God forfend that such a baseness should ever avail to harbour in a Roman breast!
uz: Lekin bu hozircha bo'lsin; men hali kutmagan vaqt keldi, masalan, otam vafot etdi va Rimga qaytishim kerak; shuning uchun, men Sofroniyani o'zim bilan olib ketmoqchi bo'lganimda, sizga sizdan hali yashirgan bo'lishim kerak bo'lgan narsani topdim va siz, oqil bo'lsangiz, uni xursandchilik bilan ko'tarasiz, chunki agar men sizni aldamoqchi yoki haqorat qilmoqchi bo'lganimda, men uni sizga, xo'rlangan va sharmanda qilingan holda qoldirgan bo'lardim; lekin Xudo bunday pastkashlikni hech qachon Rim ko'kragida yashirishga yordam bermasligini inobatga solsin!

en: She, then, namely Sophronia, by the consent of the Gods and the operation of the laws of mankind, no less than by the admirable contrivance of my Gisippus and mine own amorous astuteness, is become mine, and this it seemeth that you, holding yourselves belike wiser than the Gods and than the rest of mankind, brutishly condemn, showing your disapproval in two
uz: Unda u, ya'ni Sofrona, Xudolarning roziligi va insoniyat qonunlarining ishlashi bilan, mening Gisipponimning hayratlanarli mahorati va o'zimning sevimli o'tkirligim bilan, menikiga aylandi va bu siz o'zingizni Xudolardan va qolgan insondan donoroq deb hisoblagan holda shafqatsizlarcha qoralayotgandek tuyuladi, o'z noroziligingizni ko'rsatib.

en: ways both exceedingly noyous to myself, ﬁrst by detaining Sophronia, over whom you have no right, save in so far as it pleaseth me to allow it, and secondly, by entreating Gisippus, to whom you are justly beholden, as an enemy.
uz: Ikkala yo'l ham o'zim uchun juda ham g'alati, birinchidan, Sofroniyani ushlab turish orqali, uning ustidan hech qanday huquqingiz yo'q, agar menga ruxsat berishga ruxsat berilsa, va ikkinchidan, siz adolat bilan qaram bo'lgan Gisippuni dushman sifatida yolvorish orqali.

en: How foolishly you do in both which things I purpose not at this present to make farther manifest to you, but will only counsel you, as a friend, to lay by your despites and altogether leaving your resentments and the rancours that you have conceived, to restore Sophronia to me, so I may joyfully depart your kinsman and live your friend; for of this, whether that which is done please you or please you not, you may be assured that, if you offer to do otherwise, I will take Gisippus from you and if I win to Rome, I will without fail, however ill you may take it, have her again who is justly mine and ever after showing myself your enemy, will cause you know by experience that whereof the despite of Roman souls is capable.’ Titus, having thus spoken, rose to his feet, with a countenance all dis- ordered for anger, and taking Gisippus by the hand, went forth of the temple, shaking his head
uz: Qanday ahmoqlik bilan bu ikki ishni ham qilyapsiz, men hozir sizga yanada oshkor qilishni maqsad qilmayapman, lekin faqat do'st sifatida sizga maslahat beraman, o'z xafaligingizni va umuman olganda o'zingiz o'ylab topgan noroziligingizni va qo'zg'alishingizni tashlab, Sofroniyani menga qaytaring, shunda men xursandchilik bilan qarindoshingizni tark etaman va do'stingizni yashayman; chunki, bu ish sizga yoqadimi yoki yoqmaydimi, shunga ishonch hosil qilingki, agar siz boshqa narsani taklif qilsangiz, men sizdan Gisippusni olaman va agar men Rimga g'alaba qozonsam, men uni qabul qilmasam ham, uni o'zimga qo'yib berganimdan keyin, men sizning dushmaningizga ko'rsatib, sizdan tajribadan bilib olishingizni so'rayman.

en: threateningly and showing that he recked little of as many as were there.
uz: tahdid bilan va u yerda bor bo'lganlarning hammasini unchalik qadrlamasligini ko'rsatib.

en: The latter, in part reconciled by his reasonings to the alliance and desirous of his friendship and in part terriﬁed by his last words, of one accord determined that it was better to have him for a kinsman, since Gisippus had not willed it, than to have lost the latter to kinsman and gotten the former for an enemy.
uz: Oxirgisi, qisman ittifoq haqidagi mulohazalari bilan yarashgan va do'stligini istagan, qisman so'nggi so'zlaridan qo'rqib ketgan holda, bir ovozdan uni qarindosh sifatida olish yaxshiroq edi, chunki Gisippus buni xohlamagan edi, undan ko'ra oxirgisini qarindoshga yo'qotish va birinchisini dushman sifatida olishdan ko'ra.

en: Accordingly, going in quest of Titus, they told him that they were willing that Sophronia should be his and to have him for a dear kinsman and Gisippus for a dear friend; then, having mutually done each other such honours and courtesies as beseem between kinsmen and friends, they took their leaves and sent Sophronia back to him.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, Titni izlab borar ekanlar, ular unga Sofroning o'ziga bo'lishini va uni qadrdon qarindosh va Gisippni qadrdon do'st sifatida qabul qilishni xohlashlarini aytdilar; so'ngra, qarindoshlar va do'stlar o'rtasida bir-birlariga shunday hurmat va muloyimlik ko'rsatib, barglarini olib, Sofronini unga qaytarib yuborishdi.

en: She, like a wise woman, making a virtue of necessity, readily transferred to Titus the affection she bore Gisippus and repaired with him to Rome, where she was received with great honour.
uz: U, dono ayol kabi, zarurat fazilatini yaratib, Titga Gisippga bo'lgan mehrini bemalol o'tkazdi va u bilan birga Rimga jo'nadi, u yerda uni katta sharaf bilan qabul qilishdi.

en: Meanwhile, Gisippus abode in Athens, held in little esteem of well nigh all, and no great while after, through certain intestine troubles, was, with all those of his house, expelled from Athens, in poverty and misery, and con- demned to perpetual exile.
uz: Ayni paytda, Gisippus Afina shahrida qoldi, deyarli hamma narsaga unchalik hurmat ko'rsatmadi, va undan keyin, ma'lum ichak muammolari tufayli, butun uyidagilar bilan birga Afina shahridan qashshoqlik va nochorlikda quvildi va abadiy surgunga hukm qilindi.

en: Finding himself in this case and being grown not only poor, but beggarly, he betook himself, as least ill he might, to Rome, to essay if Titus should remember him.
uz: O'zini shu holatda his qilib, nafaqat kambag'al, balki tilanchilik bilan ham ulg'aygan holda, u o'zini, imkon qadar kasal bo'lmasdan, Rimga olib bordi, agar Tit uni eslasa, sinab ko'rish uchun.

en: There, learning that the latter was alive and high in favour with all the Romans and enquiring for his dwelling- place, he stationed himself before the door and there abode till such time as Titus came, to whom, by reason of the wretched plight wherein he was, he
uz: U yerda, so'nggisi barcha Rimliklar oldida tirik va yuqori hurmatga sazovor ekanligini bilib, o'zining yashash joyini so'rab, u eshik oldida turdi va u yerda Tit kelguncha turdi.

en: dared not say a word, but studied to cause himself be seen of him, so he might recognize him and let call him to himself; wherefore Titus passed on, [without noting him], and Gisippus, conceiving that he had seen and shunned him and remembering him of that which himself had done for him aforetime, departed, despiteful and despairing.
uz: Birorta so'z aytishga jur'at etmadi, balki o'zini undan ko'rsatish uchun o'rgandi, toki u uni tanib, o'ziga chaqirsin; shuning uchun Tit uni qayd etmasdan, o'tib ketdi va Gisippus uni ko'rganini va undan qochganini va o'zi oldindan unga qilgan ishini eslab, betaraf va umidsiz holda ketdi.

en: It being by this night and he fasting and penniless, he wandered on, unknowing whither and more de- sirous of death than of otherwhat, and presently happened upon a very desert part of the city, where seeing a great cavern, he addressed himself to abide the night there and presently, forspent with long weeping, he fell asleep on the naked earth and ill in case.
uz: Bugun kechasi ro'za tutgan va pulsiz bo'lganligi sababli, u qayerga va boshqa narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq o'limni bilmay sayohat qildi va tez orada shaharning juda cho'l qismiga kelib qoldi. U yerda katta g'orni ko'rib, u yerda tunashga qaror qildi va tez orada uzoq yig'lab, yalang'och yerda uxladi va bemor edi.

en: To this cavern two, who had gone a-thieving together that night, came towards morning, with the booty they had gotten, and falling out over the division, one, who was the stronger, slew the other and went away.
uz: O'sha kecha birga o'g'irlik qilib yurgan ikki kishi ertalabga yaqin kelib, topgan o'ljalari bilan bo'linma ustidan qulab tushishdi, biri kuchliroq bo'lsa, ikkinchisini o'ldirib ketishdi.

en: Gisippus had seen and heard this and him- seemed he had found a way to the death so sore desired of him, without slaying himself; wherefore he abode without stirring, till such time as the Serjeants of the watch, who had by this gotten wind of the deed, came thith- er and laying furious hands of him, carried him off prisoner.
uz: Gisippus buni ko'rgan va eshitgan edi va u - xuddi o'zini o'ldirmasdan, undan juda ko'p istaydigan o'lim yo'lini topgandek edi; shuning uchun u qo'zg'atmasdan turdi, toki qo'riqlash xizmatchilari, bu ishning shamolidan kelib, undan g'azablangan qo'llarini qo'yib, uni asirga olib ketguncha.

en: Gisippus, being examined, confessed that he had murdered the man nor had since availed to depart the cavern; whereupon the praetor, who was called Marcus Varro, commanded that he should be put to death upon the cross, as the usance then was.
uz: Gisippus so'roq qilingach, u odamni o'ldirganini va shundan beri g'ordan ketishga ulgurmaganini tan oldi; shundan so'ng, Mark Varro deb atalgan praetor uni o'sha paytdagi odatdagidek xochga mixlashni buyurdi.

en: Now Titus was by chance come at that juncture to the praetorium and looking the wretched condemned man in the face and hearing why he had been doomed to die, suddenly knew him for Gisippus; whereupon, marvel- ling at his sorry fortune and how he came to be in Rome and desiring most ardently to succour him, but seeing no other means of saving him than to accuse himself and thus excuse him, he thrust forward in haste and cried out, saying, ‘Marcus Varro, call back the poor man whom thou hast con- demned, for that he is innocent.
uz: Endi Tit tasodifan o'sha paytda pretoriumga kelib, bechora hukm qilingan odamning yuziga qaradi va nega o'limga hukm qilinganini eshitib, uni Gisipp uchun birdan tanib oldi; shundan so'ng, uning achinarli omadidan va Rimga qanday kelganiga hayron bo'lib, unga yordam berishni juda xohladi, lekin o'zini ayblashdan va shu tariqa uni oqlashdan boshqa hech qanday yo'l topmadi, u shoshilinch ravishda oldinga chiqib, "Markus Varro, sen ayblagan bechorni qaytarib ol, chunki u begunoh", deb baqirdi.

en: I have enough offended against the Gods with one crime, in slaying him whom thine ofﬁcer found this morning dead, without willing presently to wrong them with the death of another innocent.’ Varro marvelled and it irked him that all the praetorium should have heard him; but, being unable, for his own honour’s sake, to forbear from doing that which the laws commanded, he caused bring back Gisippus and in the presence of Titus said to him, ‘How camest thou to be so mad that, without suffering any torture, thou confessedst to that which thou didst not, it being a capital matter?
uz: Men bir jinoyat bilan Xudolarga qarshi yetarli darajada xafa bo'ldim, chunki bugun ertalab sizning ofitseringiz o'lik deb topgan odamni o'ldirib, ularga boshqa begunoh odamning o'limi bilan zarar yetkazishga tayyor emasman. Varro hayratda qoldi va bu uni butun pretorium tinglashi kerakligini ko'rsatdi; lekin, o'z sharafi uchun qonunlar buyurgan ishni qilmaslikka qodir bo'lmagani uchun, u Gisippni qaytarib olib kelishga majbur qildi va Tit huzurida unga dedi: "Qanday qilib siz hech qanday azob chekmasdan, o'zingiz qilmagan ishni, ya'ni kapital ekanligini tan olgandingiz?"

en: Thou declaredst thyself to be he who slew the man yes-
uz: Siz o'zingizni o'sha odamni o'ldirgan deb e'lon qildingiz, ha.
