uz: Messer Torello uning uzukini og'ziga olib, uni hech kim ko'rmagan holda piyola ichiga tushirish uchun o'ylab topdi. Unda ozgina vino qolganidan so'ng, uni yana yopdi va xonimga jo'natdi.

en: Madam Adalieta, taking the cup and uncovering it, that she might accom- plish his usance, set it to her mouth and seeing the ring, considered it awhile, without saying aught; then, knowing it for that which she had given to Messer Torello at parting, she took it up and looking ﬁxedly upon him whom she deemed a stranger, presently recognized him; whereupon, as she were waxen mad, she overthrew the table she had before her and cried out, saying, ‘It is my lord, it is indeed Messer Torello!’ Then, running to the place where he sat, she cast herself as far forward as she might, without tak- ing thought to her clothes or to aught that was on the table, and clipped him close in her arms nor could, for word or deed of any there, be loosed from his neck till she was bidden of Messer Torello contain herself somewhat, for that time enough would yet be afforded her to embrace him.
uz: Adalieta xonim, kosani olib, uni ochib, uning odatlariga moslashishi uchun, uni og'ziga qo'ydi va uzukni ko'rdi, biroz o'ylab, hech narsa demadi; so'ngra, ajralishda Messer Torelloga bergan narsasini bilib, uni ko'tarib, o'zi notanish deb hisoblagan odamga tikilib qaradi, uni tezda tanib oldi; shundan so'ng, aqldan ozganida, u oldidagi stolni ag'darib yubordi va baqirib dedi: "Bu mening xo'jayinim, bu haqiqatan ham Messer Torello!" Keyin, u o'tirgan joyga qarab, o'zini imkon qadar oldinga tashladi, kiyimlariga yoki stol ustida turgan narsa haqida o'ylamasdan, uni yaqin qo'liga, hech qanday ish yoki so'z uchun ham tortilmadi, u hali ham uni o'zi uchun yetarli darajada ko'tara olmaydi.

en: She accord- ingly having arisen and the nuptials being by this all troubled, albeit in part more joyous than ever for the recovery of such a gentleman, everyone, at Messer Torello’s request, abode quiet; whereupon he related to them all that
uz: U rozi bo'ldi va nikohlar shu sababli bezovta bo'ldi, garchi qisman bunday janobning tuzalib ketgani uchun har qachongidan ham quvonchliroq bo'lsa-da, hamma, Messer Torelloning iltimosiga ko'ra, tinch qoldi; shundan so'ng u ularga hammasini bog'ladi.

en: had betided him from the day of his departure up to that moment, conclud- ing that the gentleman, who, deeming him dead, had taken his lady to wife, must not hold it ill if he, being alive, took her again unto himself.
uz: uni ketgan kunidan o'sha lahzagacha ta'kidlab kelgan edi, uni o'lik deb hisoblagan janob xotiniga xotinlik qilgan bo'lsa, agar u tirik bo'lib, uni o'ziga qaytarib olgan bo'lsa, bunga achinmasligi kerak edi.

en: The bridegroom, though somewhat mortiﬁed, answered frankly and as a friend that it rested with himself to do what most pleased him of his own.
uz: Kuyov, biroz xafa bo'lsa ham, ochiqchasiga va do'stdek javob berdi: o'ziga eng yoqqan ishni qilish o'ziga tegishli.

en: Accordingly, the lady put off the ring and crown had of her new groom and donned the ring which she had taken from the cup and the crown sent her by the Soldan; then, issuing forth of the house where they were, they betook themselves, with all the nuptial train, to Messer Torello’s house and there recomforted his disconsolate friends and kindred and all the townsfolk, who regarded his return as well nigh a miracle, with long and joyous festival.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, xonim yangi kuyovidan olgan uzuk va tojini yechdi va soldan tomonidan yuborilgan piyola va tojdan olgan uzukni kiydirdi; so'ngra, ular turgan uydan chiqib, butun nikoh poyezdi bilan Messer Torello'ning uyiga borishdi va u yerda uning qaytib kelishini mo'jiza deb hisoblagan, uzoq va quvnoq bayram bilan xursand bo'lgan barcha do'stlari va qarindoshlarini va shahar ahlini tasalli berishdi.

en: As for Messer Torello, after imparting of his precious jewels to him who had had the expense of the nuptials, as well as to the abbot and many others, and signifying his happy repatriation by more than one message to Saladin, whose friend and servant he still professed himself, he lived many years thereafterward with his noble lady and thenceforth, used more hospitality and courtesy than ever.
uz: Messer Torello o'zining qimmatbaho javohirlarini to'y xarajatlaridan o'tgan kishiga, shuningdek, abbotga va boshqa ko'plab kishilarga topshirib, o'zining baxtli vatanparvarligini Saladinga bir necha xabar bilan bildirganidan so'ng, u hali ham o'zini do'sti va xizmatkori deb e'tirof etardi, keyinchalik ko'p yillar o'zining oliyjanob xonimi bilan yashadi va bundan keyin har qachongidan ham ko'proq mehmondo'stlik va muloyimlik ko'rsatdi.

en: Such then was the issue of the troubles of Messer Torello and his beloved lady and the recompense of their cheerful and ready hospitalities, the which many study to practise, who, albeit they have the wherewithal, do yet so ill contrive it that they make those on whom they be- stow their courtesies buy them, ere they have done with them, for more than their worth; wherefore, if no reward ensue to them thereof, neither them- selves nor others should marvel thereat.”
uz: Shunday qilib, Messer Torello va uning sevimli xonimi tashvishlarining va ularning quvnoq va tayyor mehmondo'stliklarining mukofotlari haqida gap bor edi. Ko'pchilik buni amaliyotda qo'llashni o'rganadi. Ular imkoniyatga ega bo'lishsa ham, uni shunchalik yomon o'ylab topadilarki, ular o'zlarining mehmonlarini sotib olishlari uchun, ular bilan ish bitirgunga qadar, o'zlarining qiymatidan ko'ra ko'proqga sotib olishadi; shuning uchun, agar ularga bundan mukofot kelmasa, na o'zlari, na boshqalar bundan hayratlanishlari kerak.

en: THE TENTH STORY The Marquess of Saluzzo, constrained by the prayers of his vassals to marry, but determined to do it after his own fashion, taketh to wife the daughter of a peasant and hath of her two children, whom he maketh believe to her to put to death; after which, feigning to be grown weary of her and to have taken another wife, he letteth bring his own daughter home to his house, as she were his new bride, and turneth his wife away in her shift; but, ﬁnding her patient under everything, he fetcheth her home again, dearer than ever, and showing her her children grown great, honoureth and letteth honour her as marchioness.
uz: O'NCHINCHI HIKOYA Saluzzo markizasi, o'z vassallarining turmushga chiqish uchun ibodatlari tufayli majbur bo'lgan, ammo o'z uslubida qilishga qaror qilgan holda, bir dehqonning qizini xotinlikka oladi va uning ikki farzandidan birini o'ldirishga ishonadi; keyin, undan charchaganini va boshqa xotin olgandek ko'rsatib, o'z qizini o'z uyiga olib keladi, xuddi u yangi kelini bo'lgani kabi, va xotini uning navbatchiligida o'g'irlaydi; lekin, uni har narsadan sabrli holda topib, uni yana uyiga olib keladi, har doimgidan aziz, va uning katta bo'lgan bolalarini katta ko'rsatadi, uni hurmat qiladi va marsiya sifatida hurmat qiladi.

en: The king’s long story being ended and having, to all appearance, much pleased all, Dioneo said, laughing, “The good man,480 who looked that night to abase the phantom’s tail upright,481 had not given a brace of farthings of all the praises that you bestow on Messer Torello.” Then, know- ing that it rested with him alone to tell, he proceeded: “Gentle ladies mine, it appeareth to me that this day hath been given up to Kings and Soldans and the like folk; wherefore, that I may not remove overfar from you, I pur- pose to relate to you of a marquess, not an act of magniﬁcence, but a mon- strous folly, which, albeit good ensued to him thereof in the end, I counsel not any to imitate, for it was a thousand pities that weal betided him thereof.
uz: Qirolning uzun hikoyasi tugagach va, ko'rinishicha, hammaga juda yoqqanidan so'ng, Dioneo kuldi: "O'sha kechasi arvohning dumini tik ko'rsatishga qaragan yaxshi odam, 481 siz janob Torelloga bergan barcha maqtovlarning bir dastagi ham bermagan edi." Keyin, uning o'zi aytishi kerakligini bilgan holda, u davom etdi: "Janob xonimlar, menga ko'rinadiki, bu kun podshohlar, soldatlar va shunga o'xshash odamlarga berilgan; shuning uchun, men sizdan uzoqqa ketmasligim uchun, men sizga buyuklik, balki butunlay ahmoqlik haqida xabar berishga jur'at qilaman, bu esa, garchi uning oxirida yaxshilik bo'lsa ham, unga yordam berishga arziydi, men unga mingta maslahat bermasligim kerak edi."

en: It is now a great while agone since the chief of the house among the Mar- quesses of Saluzzo was a youth called Gualtieri, who, having neither wife nor children, spent his time in nought but hunting and hawking nor had any thought of taking a wife nor of having children; wherein he deserved to be reputed very wise.
uz: Saluzzo mar-kesslari orasidagi uy boshlig'i Gualtieri ismli yosh yigit bo'lgani sababli, hozir juda ko'p vaqt o'tdi. U na xotini, na bolasi bo'lgani uchun, vaqtini ovlash va dengizda sayr qilishdan boshqa hech narsaga sarflamagan, na xotin olish haqida o'ylamagan, na farzand ko'rish haqida o'ylamagan edi; u juda dono deb hisoblanishga loyiq edi.

en: The thing, however, not pleasing his vassals, they be- sought him many times to take a wife, so he might not abide without an heir nor they without a lord, and offered themselves to ﬁnd him one of such a
uz: Ammo uning vassallariga ma'qul kelmagan narsa, ular uni ko'p marta xotin olish uchun qidirishardi, toki u merosxo'rsiz ham, ular ham xo'jayinsiz qolmasligi uchun, va unga shunday odamni topishni taklif qilishardi.

en: fashion and born of such parents that good hopes might be had of her and he be well content with her; whereto he answered, ‘My friends, you con- strain me unto that which I was altogether resolved never to do, considering how hard a thing it is to ﬁnd a wife whose fashions sort well within one’s own humour and how great an abundance there is of the contrary sort and how dour a life is his who happeneth upon a woman not well suited unto him.
uz: Shunday ota-onalardan tug'ilganki, undan yaxshi umidlar bo'lishi va u undan rozi bo'lishi mumkin edi; unga javob berdi: "Do'stlarim, meni hech qachon qilmaslikka qaror qilgan ishimga majbur qilasizlar, o'z hazil-mutoyibalari ichida yaxshi turadigan xotinni topish naqadar qiyin ekanligini va unga mos kelmaydigan ayolga qanday katta mo'l-ko'llik bo'lishini va uning hayoti naqadar shiddatli bo'lishini hisobga olsak."

en: To say that you think, by the manners and fashions of the parents, to know the daughters, wherefrom you argue to give me a wife such as will please me, is a folly, since I know not whence you may avail to know their fathers nor yet the secrets of their mothers; and even did you know them, daughters are often unlike their parents.
uz: Ota-onalarning odob-axloqlari va uslublariga ko'ra, o'zingizga yoqadigan xotin berish uchun bahslashayotgan qizlaringizni bilishni o'ylashingiz ahmoqlikdir, chunki men ularning otalarini ham, ularning onalarining sirlarini ham qayerdan bilishingiz mumkinligini bilmayman; va hatto ularni bilgan bo'lsangiz ham, qizlar ko'pincha ota-onalaridan farq qiladi.

en: However, since it e’en pleaseth you to bind me in these chains, I am content to do your desire; but, that I may not have occasion to complain of other than myself, if it prove ill done, I mean to ﬁnd a wife for myself, certifying you that, whomsoever I may take me, if she be not honoured of you as your lady and mistress, you shall prove, to your cost, how much it irketh me to have at your entreaty taken a wife against mine own will.’ The good honest men replied that they were content, so he would but bring himself to take a wife.
uz: Lekin, meni bu zanjirlar bilan bog'lash sizga yoqqanligi sababli, men sizning xohishingizni qilishga rozi bo'laman; lekin, agar yomon ish bo'lsa, o'zimdan boshqa haqida shikoyat qilishga hech qanday sabab bo'lmasligi uchun, o'zim uchun xotin topmoqchiman. Sizga shuni kafolat beramanki, agar meni sizdan xonim va bekam sifatida hurmat qilmasa, siz o'z ixtiyoringizga qarshi xotin olish meni qanchalik bezovta qilishini o'z hisobingizdan isbotlaysiz.

en: Now the fashions of a poor girl, who was of a village near to his house, had long pleased Gualtieri, and himseeming she was fair enough, he judged that he might lead a very comfortable life with her; wherefore, without seeking farther, he determined to marry her and sending for her father, who was a very poor man, agreed with him to take her to wife.
uz: Endi uning uyiga yaqin qishloqqa tegishli bo'lgan bechora qizning modalari allaqachon Gualtieriga yoqdi va u yetarlicha chiroyli ko'rinardi, shuning uchun u bilan juda qulay hayot kechirishni o'yladi; shuning uchun, hech narsa qidirmasdan, u bilan turmush qurish va otasini yuborishga qaror qildi, u juda bechora odam edi, uni xotinlikka olishga rozi bo'ldi.

en: This done, he assembled all his friends of the country round and said to them, ‘My friends, it hath pleased and pleaseth you that I should dis- pose me to take a wife and I have resigned myself thereto, more to com- please you than of any desire I have for marriage.
uz: Shundan so'ng, u butun qishloqdagi barcha do'stlarini yig'di va ularga dedi: "Do'stlarim, men turmushga chiqishimga rozi bo'lmadim va bunga rozi bo'ldim, chunki men turmush qurish istagidan ko'ra ko'proq sizni xursand qilish uchun bunga rozi bo'ldim."

en: You know what you promised me, to wit, that you would be content with and honour as your lady and mistress her whom I should take, whosoever she might be; where- fore the time is come when I am to keep my promise to you and when I would have you keep yours to me.
uz: Siz menga va'da berganingizni bilasiz, ya'ni, men kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uni xonimingiz va bekangiz sifatida qabul qilishingizga rozi bo'lishingizni va hurmat qilishingizni; qachonki men sizga bergan va'damni bajaradigan vaqt kelsa va sizdan o'zingiznikini o'zimga saqlashingizni xohlasam.

en: I have found a damsel after mine own heart and purpose within some few days hence to marry her and bring her home to my house; wherefore do you bethink yourselves how the bride- feast may be a goodly one and how you may receive her with honour, on such wise that I may avouch myself contented of your promise, even as you will have cause to be of mine.’ The good folk all answered joyfully that this liked them well and that, be she who he would, they would hold her for lady
uz: Men bir necha kun ichida o'z qalbim va niyatim bilan kelinni topdim, shuning uchun unga turmushga chiqdim va uni uyimga olib keldim; nega kelin-bazm qanday yaxshi bo'lishi mumkinligi va uni qanday qilib sharaf bilan qabul qilishingiz mumkinligi haqida o'ylab ko'ryapsizlar, shunda men o'zimni va'dangizdan mamnun bo'lishim mumkin, hatto sizda mening haqim bo'lishiga sabab bo'lsa ham.

en: and mistress and honour her as such in all things; after which they all ad- dressed themselves to hold fair and high and glad festival and on like wise did Gualtieri, who let make ready very great and goodly nuptials and bade thereto many his friends and kinsfolk and great gentlemen and others of the neighbourhood.
uz: va xo'jayin va uni hamma narsada shunday deb hurmat qilishadi; shundan so'ng ularning barchasi adolatli, baland va quvnoq bayram o'tkazish uchun kiyinishdi va xuddi Galtieri kabi donolik bilan, u juda katta va yaxshi to'ylarni tayyorladi va ko'plab do'stlari, qarindoshlari, buyuk janoblari va boshqa qo'shnilarni u yerga taklif qildi.

en: Moreover, he let cut and fashion store of rich and goodly apparel, after the measure of a damsel who seemed to him like of her person to the young woman he was purposed to marry, and provided also rings and girdles and a rich and goodly crown and all that behoveth unto a bride.
uz: Qolaversa, u o'zi turmushga chiqmoqchi bo'lgan qizga o'ziga o'xshagan bir qizning o'lchoviga ko'ra boy va yaxshi kiyimlar, moda do'konini kesdi, shuningdek, uzuklar, kamarlar, boy va yaxshi toj va kelin uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani taqdim etdi.

en: The day come that he had appointed for the nuptials, Gualtieri towards half tierce mounted to horse, he and all those who were come to do him honour, and having ordered everything needful.
uz: Kun keldi, u to'ylarga tayinlagan edi, Gualtieri yarim qavatga otda o'tirdi, u va unga hurmat ko'rsatish uchun kelganlarning hammasi, va kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani buyurib.

en: ‘Gentlemen,’ quoth he, ‘it is time to go fetch the bride.’ Then, setting out with all his company, he rode to the village and betaking himself to the house of the girl’s father, found her returning in great haste with water from the spring, so she might after go with other women to see Gualtieri’s bride come.
uz: Janoblar,  dedi u,  kelinni olib ketish vaqti keldi. Keyin, butun jamoasi bilan yolga chiqib, qishloqqa yol oldi va qizning otasining uyiga bordi. U uni bahordan suv bilan juda shoshilinch qaytayotganini kordi, shunda u boshqa ayollar bilan birga Gualtieriyning kelini korishga borishi mumkin edi.

en: When the marquess saw her, he called her by name, to wit, Griselda, and asked her where her father was; to which she answered bashfully, ‘My lord, he is within the house.’ Thereupon Gualtieri dismounted and bidding all await him, entered the poor house alone, where he found her father, whose name was Giannucolo, and said to him, ‘I am come to marry Griselda, but ﬁrst I would fain know of her somewhat in thy presence.’ Accordingly, he asked her if, an he took her to wife, she would still study to please him, nor take umbrage at aught that he should do or say, and if she would be obedient, and many other like things, to all of which she answered ay; whereupon Gualtieri, taking her by the hand, led her forth and in the presence of all his company and of every- one else, let strip her naked.
uz: Markiz uni ko'rgach, uni ismi bilan chaqirdi, masalan, Griselda, va otasi qayerda ekanligini so'radi; unga u uyat bilan javob berdi: "Egam, u uy ichida." Shunda Gualtieri tushdi va hamma uni kutishga buyurdi, u yerda bechora uyga yolg'iz kirdi, u yerda otasi Giannucolo edi va unga dedi: "Men Griselda bilan turmushga chiqdim, lekin avval uni sening huzuringda biroz bilmoqchiman." Shunga ko'ra, u uni xotinlikka olsa, u hali ham unga yoqish uchun o'qisa, u nima qilmasin, deb javob bermasa, va agar u itoatkor bo'lsa, va boshqa ko'p narsalarni aytsa, u unga olib bordi; keyin Gualti uni qo'lidan tortib, uning har bir yoriq va uning yonida...

en: Then, sending for the garments which he had let make, he caused forthright clothe and shoe her and would have her set the crown on her hair, all tumbled as it was; after which, all marvelling at this, he said, ‘Gentlemen, this is she who I purpose shall be my wife, an she will have me to husband.’ Then, turning to her, where she stood, all shame- fast and confounded, he said to her, ‘Griselda, wilt thou have me to thy hus- band?’ To which she answered, ‘Ay, my lord.’ Quoth he, ‘And I will have thee to my wife’; and espoused her in the presence of all.
uz: So'ngra, o'zi yasagan kiyimlarni olib kelib, uni to'g'ri kiyim va poyabzal bilan to'ldiradi va sochlariga toj qo'yishni buyuradi, barchasi qanday bo'lsa shunday yiqilib turardi. Shundan so'ng, hamma bundan hayratda, u dedi: "Janoblar, bu men xohlagan ayol mening xotinim bo'ladi, u meni erga oladi." So'ngra, u turgan joyga o'girilib, sharmanda va sharmanda bo'lib, u unga dedi: "Griselda, meni senga bog'laysanmi?" U javob berdi: "Ha, xo'jayinim." U aytdi: "Va men seni xotinimga beraman"; va uni hamma oldida turmushga berdi.

en: Then, mounting her on a palfrey, he carried her, honourably accompanied, to his mansion, where the nuptials were celebrated with the utmost splendour and rejoicing, no otherwise than as he had taken to wife the king’s daughter of France.
uz: So'ngra, uni palfreyga mindirib, u uni hurmat bilan birga o'z saroyiga olib bordi, u yerda to'ylar eng ulug'vor va quvonch bilan nishonlanardi, faqatgina qirolning Fransiya qizi bilan turmushga chiqqanidek.

en: The young wife seemed to have, together with her clothes, changed her mind and her manners.
uz: Yosh xotin kiyimlari bilan birga fikrini va xulq-atvorini o'zgartirgandek tuyuldi.

en: She was, as we have already said, goodly of person and countenance, and even as she was fair, on like wise she became so en- gaging, so pleasant and so well-mannered that she seemed rather to have been the child of some noble gentleman than the daughter of Giannucolo and a tender of sheep; whereof she made everyone marvel who had known her aforetime.
uz: U, biz allaqachon aytganimizdek, shaxsiyat va tashqi ko'rinishi yaxshi edi, va hatto u go'zal bo'lgani uchun ham, u shunchalik xushmuomala, yoqimli va odobli bo'lib ketdi, hatto u Giannucoloning qizi va qo'ylarning mehribonligidan ko'ra, qandaydir olijanob janobning farzandiga o'xshab qoldi; bu uni ilgari bilgan har bir kishini hayratga soldi.

en: Moreover, she was so obedient to her husband and so diligent in his service that he accounted himself the happiest and best contented man in the world; and on like wise she bore herself with such graciousness and such loving kindness towards her husband’s subjects that there was none of them but loved and honoured her with his whole heart, praying all for her welfare and prosperity and advancement; and whereas they were used to say that Gualtieri had done as one of little wit to take her to wife, they now with one accord declared that he was the sagest and best-advised man alive, for that none other than he might ever have availed to know her high worth, hidden as it was under poor clothes and a rustic habit.
uz: Qolaversa, u eriga shunchalik itoatkor edi va uning xizmatida shunchalik g'ayratli ediki, u o'zini dunyodagi eng baxtli va eng yaxshi qoniqqan odam deb hisoblardi; va xuddi shunday donolik bilan u erining sub'ektlariga nisbatan shunchalik mehribonlik va mehr-oqibat ko'rsatdiki, ularning hech biri uni butun qalbi bilan sevmasdi va hurmat qilmasdi, uning farovonligi, farovonligi va taraqqiyoti uchun ibodat qilardi; va ular Gualtieri uni xotinlikka olish uchun aqldan ozgan deb aytishardi, lekin ular endi bir ovozdan u tirik eng eng aqldan ozgan va eng yaxshi maslahat bergan odam ekanligini e'lon qilishardi, chunki undan boshqa hech kim uning yuqori qadrini bilmas edi, chunki bu kiyim ostida yashirilgan va yomon odat edi.

en: Brief, it was no great while ere she knew so to do that, not only in her husband’s marquisate, but everywhere else, she made folk talk of her virtues and her well-doing and turned to the contrary whatsoever had been said against her husband on her account, whenas he married her.
uz: Qisqacha aytganda, u buni qilishni bilmaguncha unchalik zo'r emas edi, nafaqat erining markizligida, balki boshqa hamma joyda, u o'z fazilatlari va yaxshiliklari haqida xalqqa gapirdi va u turmushga chiqqanida eriga nisbatan aytilgan har qanday gapga zid bo'ldi.

en: She had not long abidden with Gualtieri ere she conceived with child and in due time bore a daughter, whereat he rejoiced greatly.
uz: U Gualtieri bilan uzoq yashamagan edi, chunki u homilador bo'lib, o'z vaqtida qiz tug'di va u juda xursand bo'ldi.

en: But, a little after, a new482 thought having entered his mind, to wit, to seek, by dint of long tribulation and things unendurable, to make trial of her patience, he ﬁrst goaded her with words, feigning himself troubled and saying that his vas- sals were exceeding ill content with her, by reason of her mean extraction, especially since they saw that she bore children, and that they did nothing but murmur, being sore chagrined for the birth of her daughter.
uz: Ammo, birozdan so'ng, uning xayoliga yangi bir fikr kirib keldi, ya'ni, uzoq azob va chidab bo'lmas narsalar tufayli uning sabrini sinash uchun, u avval uni so'zlar bilan masxara qildi, o'zini tashvishga solib, o'zini unga nisbatan juda norozi ekanligini aytdi, ayniqsa, ular uning farzand ko'rganini ko'rishdi va ular faqat pichirlashardi, qizining tug'ilishi uchun achinarli edilar.

en: The lady, hearing this, replied, without anywise changing countenance or showing the least distemperature, ‘My lord, do with me that which thou deemest will be most for thine honour and solace, for that I shall be content with all, know- ing, as I do, that I am of less account than they483 and that I was unworthy of this dignity to which thou hast advanced me of thy courtesy.’ This reply was mighty agreeable to Gualtieri, for that he saw she was not uplifted into aught of pridefulness for any honour that himself or others had done her; but, a little after, having in general terms told her that his vassals could not brook this girl that had been born of her, he sent to her a serving-man of his,
uz: Xonim buni eshitib, hech qanday yuz o'zgartirmasdan yoki hech qanday noqulaylik ko'rsatmasdan javob berdi: Hazratim, men bilan o'z sharafing va taskining uchun eng ko'p bo'ladigan ish qilgin, chunki men hammaga rozi bo'laman, bilganimdek, men ulardan kamroq hisoblayman483 va sen meni sizning odobing bilan ko'rsatgan bu qadr-qimmatga loyiq emasman. Bu javob Gualtieriga juda mos keldi, chunki u uning o'zi yoki boshqalar uchun bo'lgan har qanday sharaf uchun g'ururga aylanmaganini ko'rdi; lekin, birozdan keyin, odatda unga o'z vassallari tug'ilgan bu qizni tortib ololmasligini aytdi, u unga o'zining xizmatkorini yubordi.

en: whom he had lessoned and who said to her with a very woeful countenance, ‘Madam, an I would not die, needs must I do that which my lord com- mandeth me.
uz: U unga saboq bergan edi va unga juda qayg'uli yuz bilan dedi: "Xonim, men o'lishni xohlamayman, lekin xo'jayinim menga buyurgan narsani qilishim kerak."

en: He hath bidden me take this your daughter and.
uz: U menga bu qizingizni olib ketishni buyurdi.

en: …’ And said no more.
uz: ... Va boshqa hech narsa demadi.

en: The lady, hearing this and seeing the servant’s aspect and remem- bering her of her husband’s words, concluded that he had enjoined him put the child to death; whereupon, without changing countenance, albeit she felt a sore anguish at heart, she straightway took her from the cradle and having kissed and blessed her, laid her in the servant’s arms, saying, ‘Take her and punctually do that which thy lord hath enjoined thee; but leave her not to be devoured of the beasts and the birds, except he command it thee.’ The ser- vant took the child and reported that which the lady had said to Gualtieri, who marvelled at her constancy and despatched him with the child to a kinswoman of his at Bologna, praying her to bring her up and rear her dili- gently, without ever saying whose daughter she was.
uz: Xonim buni eshitib, xizmatkorning qiyofasini ko'rib, erining so'zlarini eslatib, u unga bolani o'ldirishni buyurganini xulosa qildi. Shundan so'ng, yuz o'zgartirmasdan, garchi yuragi og'rigan bo'lsa ham, u darhol beshikdan olib, uni o'pdi va duo qildi, xizmatkorning qo'liga qo'ydi va dedi: "Uni olib, xo'jayining senga buyurganini vaqtida qil; lekin uni hayvonlar va qushlardan yemaslikka qo'yma, agar u buyurmagan bo'lsa." Xonim bolani olib, uning qat'iyatidan hayratlanib, uni Bolognadagi qarindoshiga jo'natib, uni o'z qizini olib kelishga buyurdi.

en: In course of time the lady again conceived and in due season bore a male child, to her husband’s great joy; but, that which he had already done sufﬁ- cing him not, he addressed himself to probe her to the quick with a yet sorer stroke and accordingly said to her one day with a troubled air, ‘Wife, since thou hast borne this male child, I have nowise been able to live in peace with these my people, so sore do they murmur that a grandson of Giannu- colo should become their lord after me; wherefore I misdoubt me, an I would not be driven forth of my domains, it will behove me do in this case that which I did otherwhen and ultimately put thee away and take another wife.’ The lady gave ear to him with a patient mind nor answered otherwhat then, ‘My lord, study to content thyself and to satisfy thy pleasure and have no thought of me, for that nothing is dear to me save in so much as I see it
uz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan xonim yana homilador bo'ldi va o'z vaqtida erining quvonchiga ko'ra o'g'il tug'di; lekin, u allaqachon qilgan ishi yetarli emas edi, u uni tezroq, yanada qayg'uli zarba bilan tekshirishga murojaat qildi va shunga ko'ra unga bir kuni tashvishli ruhda dedi: "Xonim, chunki sen bu o'g'il bolani tug'ding, endi men bu odamlarim bilan tinch yashay oldim, shunday achinamanki, ular mendan keyin Giannu'ning nabirasi ularning xo'jayini bo'lishi kerak deb shivirlashadi; chunki men shubha qilaman, men o'z hududlarimdan haydalmayman, bu holda men seni va boshqa xotinimni tashlab ketadigan narsani qilaman." Xonim unga sabr bilan javob berdi: "Xo'jayinim, meni qondirish uchun hech narsa yo'q edi, chunki u meni ko'rishga majbur qiladi."

en: please thee.’ Not many days after, Gualtieri sent for the son, even as he had sent for the daughter, and making a like show of having him put to death, despatched him to Bologna, there to be brought up, even as he had done with the girl; but the lady made no other countenance nor other words there- of than she had done of the girl; whereat Gualtieri marvelled sore and af- ﬁrmed in himself that no other woman could have availed to do this that she did; and had he not seen her tender her children with the utmost fondness, what while it pleased him, he had believed that she did this because she recked no more of them; whereas in effect he knew that she did it of her dis- cretion.
uz: Iltimos, iltimos." Oradan ko'p kun o'tmay, Gualtieri o'g'lini olib keldi, xuddi u qizni olib kelganidek, va uni o'ldirishni ko'rsatganidek, Bolonyaga jo'natdi, u yerda tarbiyalangan bo'lishi uchun, xuddi u qiz bilan qilganidek; lekin xonim qizga nisbatan qilgan ishidan boshqa hech qanday ko'rinish yoki so'z aytmadi; ammo Gualtieri o'zida xafa bo'lib, boshqa hech qanday ayol buni qilishga qodir bo'lmasligini angladi; va u o'ziga yoqqanini ko'rmagani uchun, u o'z bolalariga eng samimiy mehr bilan qaraganini, u buni qilganini ishondi, chunki u ularni boshqa hech kimga e'tibor bermas edi; aslida u buni qilganini bilardi.

en: His vassals, believing that he had caused put the children to death, blamed him sore, accounting him a barbarous man, and had the utmost
uz: Uning vassallari, u bolalarni o'ldirishga sabab bo'lgan deb hisoblab, uni qattiq ayblashdi, uni vahshiy odam deb hisoblashdi va eng...

en: compassion of his wife, who never answered otherwhat to the ladies who condoled with her for her children thus slain, than that that which pleased him thereof who had begotten them, pleased her also.
uz: Xotini rahm-shafqati, u o'z bolalari uchun shunday o'ldirilganligi uchun unga hamdard bo'lgan ayollarga hech qachon javob bermagan, ularni tug'ganidan xursand bo'lganidan boshqa, uni ham xursand qilgan.

en: At last, several years being passed since the birth of the girl, Gualtieri, deeming it time to make the supreme trial of her endurance, declared, in the presence of his people, that he could no longer endure to have Griselda to wife and that he perceived that he had done ill and boyishly in taking her, wherefore he purposed, as far as in him lay, to make interest with the Pope to grant him a dispensation, so he might put her away and take another wife.
uz: Nihoyat, qizning tug'ilganidan bir necha yil o'tgach, Gualtieri, uning bardoshini oliy sinovdan o'tkazish vaqti kelganini his qilib, o'z xalqi huzurida Griseldani xotinlikka olib ketishga endi bardosh bera olmasligini va uni olib, yomon va o'g'ilona ish qilganini anglaganini e'lon qildi. Shuning uchun u, o'zidan kelib chiqib, Rim Papasi bilan unga ruxsat berishni maqsad qildi, shunda u uni yo'q qilib, boshqa xotin olishi mumkin edi.

en: For this he was roundly taken to task by many men of worth, but answered them nothing save that needs must it be so.
uz: Buning uchun uni ko'p arzirli odamlar jazolashdi, lekin ularga faqat kerak bo'lgan narsalardan boshqa hech narsa javob bermadi.

en: The lady, hearing these things and herseeming she must look to return to her father’s house and maybe tend sheep again as she had done aforetime, what while she saw another woman in possession of him to whom she willed all her weal, sor- rowed sore in herself; but yet, even as she had borne the other affronts of fortune, so with a ﬁrm countenance she addressed herself to bear this also.
uz: Xonim bu gaplarni eshitib, o'ziga o'xshagan holda otasining uyiga qaytishga va ehtimol avvalgidek qo'ylarni boqishga harakat qilishi kerak edi, chunki u boshqa bir ayolni uning egaligida ko'rgan edi, unga butun boyligini meros qilib bergan, o'zida qayg'urgan edi; ammo, hatto u baxtning boshqa burchlarini ko'targan bo'lsa ham, u bunga ham qat'iy yuz bilan murojaat qildi.

en: Gualtieri no great while after let come to him from Rome counterfeit letters of dispensation and gave his vassals to believe that the Pope had thereby licensed him to take another wife and leave Griselda; then, sending for the latter, he said to her, in presence of many, ‘Wife, by concession made me of the Pope, I am free to take another wife and put thee away, and accordingly, for that mine ancestors have been great gentlemen and lords of this country, whilst thine have still been husbandmen, I mean that thou be no more my wife, but that thou return to Giannucolo his house with the dowry which thou broughtest me, and I will after bring hither another wife, for that I have found one more sorted to myself.’ The lady, hearing this, contained her tears, contrary to the nature of wo- man, though not without great unease, and answered, ‘My lord, I ever knew my mean estate to be nowise
uz: Gualtieri unga Rimdan soxta dispens xatlari kelganiga ko'p vaqt qolmadi va o'z vassallariga Rim Papasi uni yana bir xotin olib, Griselda tashlab ketishga ruxsat berganligiga ishontirdi. Keyin, oxirgi xotinini yuborib, ko'pchilikning oldida unga dedi: "Xotin, Rim Papasidan ruxsat olganim uchun, men boshqa xotin olib, seni tarqatib yuborishga haqlim bor, va shunga ko'ra, mening ajdodlarim bu mamlakatning buyuk janoblari va bekaslari bo'lganlar, sening esa hali ham er bo'lganing uchun, men seni mening xotinim emasman, balki sen menga olib kelgan marjon bilan Giannucologa qaytib kelishingni va men undan keyin yana bir xotinimni olib kelaman, chunki men seni yana bir marta tuzatdim." Xonim, buni eshitib, uning ko'z yoshlari, tabiatga zid bo'lgan holda, men hech qachon...

en: sortable with your nobility, and for that which I have been with you I have still confessed myself indebted to you and to God, nor have I ever made nor held it mine, as given to me, but have still accounted it but as a loan.
uz: Sizning oliyjanobligingiz bilan ajratib olinadi va men siz bilan birga bo'lganim uchun hali ham siz va Xudoga qarzdor ekanligimni tan oldim, hech qachon uni menga berilganidek qabul qilmadim yoki o'zimga bermadim, lekin hali ham uni faqat qarz sifatida hisobladim.

en: It pleaseth you to require it again and it must and doth please me to restore it to you.
uz: Sizdan uni yana talab qilish mamnun bo'ladi va men uni sizga qaytarishimni xohlayman va xohlayman.

en: Here is your ring wherewith you es- poused me; take it.
uz: Mana meni itarib yuborgan halkangiz; uni oling.

en: You bid me carry away with me that dowry which I brought hither, which to do you will need no paymaster and I neither purse nor packhorse, for I have not forgotten that you had me naked, and if you account it seemly that this my body, wherein I have carried children begot-
uz: Siz menga bu yerga olib kelgan mahrni olib ketishimni buyurdingiz, buni qilish uchun sizga hech qanday pul to'lovchisi kerak bo'lmaydi va men hamyon ham, ot ham kerak bo'lmaydi, chunki men siz meni yalang'och qilganingizni unutmaganman va agar siz buni mening tanam deb hisoblasangiz, unda men farzand ko'rgan bo'laman.

en: ten of you, be seen of all, I will begone naked; but I pray you, in requital of my maidenhead, which I brought hither and bear not hence with me, that it please you I may carry away at the least one sole shift over and above my dowry.’ Gualtieri, who had more mind to weep than to otherwhat, natheless kept a stern countenance and said, ‘So be it; carry away a shift.’ As many as stood around besought him to give her a gown, so that she who had been thirteen years and more his wife should not be seen go forth of his house on such mean and shameful wise as it was to depart in her shift; but their pray- ers all went for nothing; wherefore the lady, having commended them to God, went forth his house in her shift, barefoot and nothing on her head, and returned to her father, followed by the tears and lamentations of all who saw her.
uz: Sizlardan o'n kishining ko'rinishicha, men yalang'och holda boshlayman; lekin sizdan iltimos qilaman, bu yerga olib kelgan qiz qizligim evaziga, bu yerda men bilan birga olib yurmang, agar sizga yoqsa, men hech bo'lmaganda bir marta ham mahrimdan ko'proq yig'lashga ko'proq aqlim yetgan Gualtieri, ammo qattiqroq yuz tutdi va dedi: "Shunday bo'lsin; bir marta ham olib keting." Ko'pchilik atrofda turganlar undan unga ko'ylak berishni so'rashdi, toki o'n uch yoshdan oshgan va undan ko'proq bo'lgan xotini o'z navbatida ketishi kerak bo'lganidek, uning uyidan shunday xunuk va sharmandali holda chiqmasligi kerak edi; lekin ularning ibodatlari hech narsaga arzimagan edi; shuning uchun xonim ularni Xudoga tavsiya qildi, u o'z uyidan chiqib, uning boshiga va otasi bilan birga yig'lab,

en: Giannucolo, who had never been able to believe it true that Gual- tieri should entertain his daughter to wife and went in daily expectation of this event, had kept her the clothes which she had put off the morning that Gualtieri had married her and now brought them to her; whereupon she donned them and addressed herself, as she had been wont to do, to the little ofﬁces of her father’s house, enduring the cruel onslaught of hostile fortune with a stout heart.
uz: Giannukolo, Gual-tieri o'z qizini xotinlikka olib borishi kerakligiga hech qachon ishonmagan va bu voqeani har kuni kutgan, Gualtieri unga turmushga chiqqan kuni ertalab yechgan kiyimlarini unga olib kelgan edi; shundan so'ng u ularni kiydirib, odatdagidek otasining uyining kichik ofislariga bordi va dushmanlik hujumini qattiq yurak bilan ko'tardi.

en: Gualtieri, having done this, gave out to his people that he had chosen a daughter of one of the Counts of Panago and letting make great prepara- tions for the nuptials, sent for Griselda to come to him and said to her, ‘I am about to bring home this lady, whom I have newly taken to wife, and mean, at this her ﬁrst coming, to do her honour.
uz: Gualtieri buni qilganidan so'ng, o'z xalqiga Panago graflaridan birining qizini tanlaganini va to'y uchun katta tayyorgarlik ko'rishga ruxsat berganini aytdi. Griselda uning oldiga kelishini so'rab yubordi va unga dedi: Men yangi turmushga chiqqan bu xonimni uyga olib kelmoqchiman va bu uning birinchi kelishi bilan uning sharafini ko'rsatmoqchiman.

en: Thou knowest I have no women about me who know how to array me the rooms nor to do a multitude of things that behove unto such a festival; wherefore do thou, who art better versed than any else in these household matters, order that which is to do here and let bid such ladies as it seemeth good to thee and receive them as thou wert mistress here; then, when the nuptials are ended, thou mayst be- gone back to thy house.’ Albeit these words were all daggers to Griselda’s heart, who had been unable to lay down the love she bore him as she had laid down her fair fortune, she replied, ‘My lord, I am ready and willing.’ Then, in her coarse homespun clothes, entering the house, whence she had a little before departed in her shift, she fell to sweeping and ordering the chambers and letting place hangings and cover-cloths about the saloons and make ready the viands, putting her hand to
uz: Bilasan-ku, men atrofimda xonalarni qanday bezashni biladigan va bunday bayramga kerak bo'lgan ko'p narsalarni qiladigan ayollar yo'q. Shuning uchun, sen, bu uy ishlarida boshqalardan ko'ra yaxshiroq bilimdon bo'lganing, bu yerda nima qilish kerakligini buyur va senga ma'qul bo'lgan ayollarni bu yerda xonim sifatida qabul qil; so'ngra, nikoh tugagandan so'ng, sen o'z uyingga qaytib ketishing mumkin.

en: everything, as she were some paltry serving-wench of the house, nor ever gave over till she had arrayed and ordered everything as it behoved.
uz: hamma narsa, xuddi uyning arzimagan xizmatkor kelindisi kabi, hamma narsani kerakli darajada bezatib, tartibga solmaguncha hech qachon topshirmagan.

en: Thereafter, having let invite all the
uz: Shundan so'ng, barcha takliflarga ruxsat bergan holda,

en: ladies of the country on Gualtieri’s part, she awaited the day of the festival, which being come, with a cheerful countenance and the spirit and bearing of a lady of high degree, for all she had mean clothes on her back, she re- ceived all the ladies who came thither.
uz: Gualtieri tomonidagi qishloq ayollari bayram kunini kutishdi. U bayram kuni kelganida, quvnoq yuz va yuqori darajadagi xonimning ruhi va ko'rinishi bilan, uning orqasida oddiy kiyimlari bor edi, u yerga kelgan barcha ayollarni qabul qildi.

en: Meanwhile, Gualtieri, who had caused the two children be diligently reared in Bologna by his kinswoman, (who was married to a gentleman of the Panago family), the girl being now twelve years old and the fairest creature that ever was seen and the boy six, had sent to his kinsman484 at Bologna, praying him be pleased to come to Saluzzo with his son and daughter and take order to bring with him a goodly and honourable com- pany and bidding him tell everyone that he was carrying him the young lady to his wife, without otherwise discovering to any aught of who she was.
uz: Ayni paytda, Gualtieri, ikki bolani Bolonyada qarindoshi tomonidan astoydil tarbiyalantirgan ( Panago oilasining bir janobiga turmushga chiqqan), qiz endi o'n ikki yoshda va hech qachon ko'rmagan eng go'zal maxluq va o'g'il olti yoshda bo'lgan, Bolonyada o'z qarindoshiga 484 ga xabar yuborib, undan o'g'li va qizi bilan Saluzzoga kelishini va u bilan yaxshi va hurmatli kom-pani olib kelishini so'rab, unga yosh xotinni o'z xotiniga olib borayotganini hamma bilan aytishni buyurdi, hech qanday narsani bilmasdan.

en: The gentleman did as the marquess prayed him and setting out, with the girl and boy and a goodly company of gentlefolk, after some days’ journey, arrived, about dinnertime, at Saluzzo, where he found all the countryfolk and many others of the neighbourhood awaiting Gualtieri’s new bride.
uz: Janob markizning iltijoini qildi va jo'nab ketdi, qiz, bola va yaxshi bir guruh janoblar bilan bir necha kunlik sayohatdan so'ng, kechki ovqat paytida Saluzzoga yetib keldi. U yerda barcha qishloq aholisi va qo'shnilarning ko'pchiligi Gualtieriyning yangi kelini kutganini ko'rdi.

en: The latter, be- ing received by the ladies and come into the saloon where the tables were laid, Griselda came to meet her, clad as she was, and accosted her blithely, saying, ‘Welcome and fair welcome to my lady.’ Thereupon the ladies (who had urgently, but in vain, besought Gualtieri to suffer Griselda to abide in a chamber or lend her one of the gowns that had been hers, so that she might not go thus before his guests) were seated at table and it was proceeded to serve them.
uz: Oxirgisi, xonimlar tomonidan qabul qilinib, stollar yotqizilgan salonga kirgach, Griselda uni kutib oldi, o'zi qanday kiyinsa, shunday qilib, unga yaqinlashdi va dedi: "Xonimga xush kelibsiz va adolat bilan xush kelibsiz". Shundan so'ng xonimlar (shoshilinch, lekin befoyda, Gualtieriga Griseldaga o'z xonasida qolishiga ruxsat berishni yoki unga o'ziga tegishli bo'lgan ko'ylaklardan birini berishni so'rashdi, toki u mehmonlarining oldiga bunday tarzda bormasligi uchun) stolga o'tirdilar va u ularga xizmat ko'rsatildi.

en: The girl was eyed by everyone and all declared that Gualtieri had made a good exchange; and among the rest Griselda commended her amain, both her and her young brother.
uz: Qizga hamma e'tibor qaratdi va hamma Gualtieri yaxshi muloqot qilganini e'lon qildi; qolganlar orasida Griselda uni ham, uning kichik akasini ham maqtadi.

en: Gualtieri perceiving that the strangeness of the case in no wise changed her and being assured that this proceeded not from lack of understanding, for that he knew her to be very quick of wit, himseemed he had now seen fully as much as he desired of his lady’s patience and he judged it time to deliver her from the bitterness which he doubted not she kept hidden under her constant countenance; wherefore, calling her to himself, he said to her, smiling, in the presence of everyone, ‘How deemest thou of our bride?’ ‘My lord,’ answered she, ‘I deem exceeding well of her, and if, as I believe, she is as discreet as she is fair, I doubt not a whit but you will live the hap- piest gentleman in the world with her; but I beseech you, as most I may, that you inﬂict not on her those pangs which you inﬂicted whilere on her who was sometime yours; for methinketh she might scarce avail to endure them,
uz: Gualtieri ishni g'alatiligi uni hech qanday o'zgartirmadi va bu tushunmovchilikdan kelib chiqmasligiga amin edi, chunki u uni juda tezkor ekanligini bilardi, u endi xonimning sabrini xohlagancha to'liq ko'rgan deb o'yladi va u uni uning doimiy yuzining ostida yashirgan achchiqligidan xalos qilish vaqti keldi deb hisobladi; shuning uchun, uni o'ziga chaqirib, hamma oldida tabassum qilib dedi: "Kelinimizni qanday deb hisoblaysiz?" "Mening xo'jayinim," deb javob berdi u, "Men uni juda yaxshi ko'raman, va agar u mening fikrimcha, u qanchalik dono bo'lsa, men hech qanday shubha qilmayman, lekin siz uni dunyodagi eng aziz odam bilan birga yashaysiz; lekin men uni sizga yordam bermasligingizni so'rayman, chunki u siz uchun eng ko'p

en: both because she is younger and because she hath been delicately reared, whereas the other had been in continual fatigues from a little child.’ Thereupon, Gualtieri, seeing she ﬁrmly believed that the young lady was to be his wife nor therefore spoke anywise less than well, seated her by his side and said to her, ‘Griselda, it is now time that thou reap the fruits of thy long patience and that those who have reputed me cruel and unjust and bru- tish should know that this which I have done I wrought to an end aforeseen, willing to teach thee to be a wife and to show them how to take and use one and at the same time to beget myself perpetual quiet, what while I had to live with thee; the which, whenas I came to take a wife, I was sore afraid might not betide me, and therefore, to make proof thereof, I probed and af- ﬂicted thee after such kind as thou knowest.
uz: U yosh bo'lgani uchun ham, nozik tarbiyalanganligi uchun ham, ikkinchisi esa kichkina bolalikdan doimiy charchoqda bo'lgan edi." Shunda, Gualtieri, yosh xonimning xotin bo'lishiga va undan kam gapirishga qat'iy ishonib, uning yonida o'tirdi va unga dedi: "Griselda, endi sen uzoq sabr-toqating mevasini olishing vaqti keldi va meni shafqatsiz, adolatsiz va shafqatsiz deb hisoblaganlar bilishlari kerakki, men bu ishni oldindan ko'rsatilgan maqsadga ko'ra qildim, senga xotin bo'lishni o'rgatishga va ularni qanday qilib olib, bir vaqtning o'zida o'zimni doimiy tinch tutishga tayyorligini ko'rsatishga tayyor edim, men sen bilan birga yashashim kerak edi.

en: And meseeming, for that I have never perceived that either in word or in deed hast thou departed from my pleasure, that I have of thee that solace which I desired, I purpose presently to restore thee, at one stroke, that which I took from thee at many and to re- quite thee with a supreme delight the pangs I have inﬂicted on thee.
uz: Va ko'rinishidan, hech qachon so'zida ham, amalda ham mening xohishimdan voz kechganingizni anglamaganim uchun, men sizdan o'zim xohlagan tasalliga ega ekanligimni, men hozir sizni bir zumda, sizdan ko'p marta olgan narsani tiklashni va sizga yetkazgan azoblarni oliy quvonch bilan qayta tiklashni niyat qilaman.

en: Where- fore with a joyful heart take this whom thou deemest my bride and her brother for thy children and mine; for these be they whom thou and many others have long accounted me to have barbarously let put to death; and I am thy husband, who loveth thee over all else, believing I may vaunt me that there is none else who can be so content of his wife as can I.’ So saying, he embraced her and kissed her; then, rising up, he betook himself with Griselda, who wept for joy, whereas the daughter, hearing these things, sat all stupeﬁed, and tenderly embracing her and her brother, undeceived her and many others who were there.
uz: Xo'sh, kelinim va uning akasi deb hisoblaganingni xursand yurak bilan o'zingning farzandlaring va mening farzandlarim uchun qabul qil; chunki bular sen va ko'pchilik meni uzoq vaqtdan beri shafqatsizlarcha o'ldirgan deb hisoblagan odamlardir; va men seni hamma narsadan ko'ra sevgan eringman, meni hech kim xotiniga shunchalik qoniqmasligi mumkin deb maqtanaman deb o'ylayman. Shunday qilib, u uni quchoqladi va o'pdi; keyin, o'rnidan turib, xursandchilikdan yig'lagan Griselda bilan uchrashdi. Qiz esa bularni eshitib, hayratda o'tirdi va uni va akasini mehr bilan quchoqladi, uni va u yerda bo'lgan ko'plab boshqalarni aldadi.

en: Thereupon the ladies arose from table, overjoyed, and withdrew with Griselda into a chamber, where, with happier augury, pulling off her mean attire, they clad her anew in a magniﬁcent dress of her own and brought her again to the saloon, as a gentlewoman, which indeed she appeared, even in rags.
uz: Shundan so'ng xonimlar stoldan turib, juda xursand bo'lishdi va Griselda bilan birga xonaga chiqishdi. U yerda, xursand bo'lib, o'zining o'rta kiyimini yechib, uni o'ziga xos ajoyib ko'ylakka yangi kiydirishdi va uni yana zalga, xuddi bir muloyim ayol kabi olib kelishdi, u haqiqatan ham lattalarda ko'rinardi.

en: There she rejoiced in her children with wonder-great joy, and all being overjoyed at this happy issue, they redoubled in feasting and merrymaking and prolonged the festiv- ities several days, accounting Gualtieri a very wise man, albeit they held the trials which he had made of his lady overharsh, nay, intolerable; but over all they held Griselda most sage.
uz: U yerda u o'z bolalaridan ajoyib quvonch bilan quvonardi va barcha bu baxtli masalani ko'rib juda xursand bo'lishdi, ziyofat va xursandchilikni kuchaytirishdi va bayramni bir necha kun davom ettirishdi. Ular Gualtieri juda dono odam deb hisoblashdi, garchi u xonimiga nisbatan qilgan sinovlarini qattiq, yo'q, chidab bo'lmas deb hisoblashsa ham; lekin eng muhimi, ular Griselda eng dono deb hisoblashdi.

en: The Count of Panago returned, after some days, to Bologna, and Gualtieri, taking Giannucolo from his labour, placed him in such estate as beﬁtted his father-in-law, so that he lived in honour and great solace and so ended his days; whilst he himself, having nobly
uz: Panago graf bir necha kundan so'ng Bolonyaga qaytib keldi va Gualtieri, Giannucolini mehnatidan olib, uni qaynotasiga mos keladigan holatga joylashtirdi, shunda u sharaf va katta tasalli bilan yashadi va shu bilan kunlarini yakunladi; o'zi esa,

en: married his daughter, lived long and happily with Griselda, honouring her as most might be.
uz: Qizini turmushga chiqardi, Griselda bilan uzoq va baxtli yashadi, uni eng ko'p hurmat qildi.

en: What more can here be said save that even in poor cot- tages there rain down divine spirits from heaven, like as in princely palaces there be those who were worthier to tend swine than to have lordship over men?
uz: Bu yerda yana nima deyish mumkin, hatto kambag'al yotoqlarda ham osmondan ilohiy ruhlar yog'ishi mumkin, xuddi shahzoda saroylarida odamlarga hukmronlik qilishdan ko'ra cho'chqalarga g'amxo'rlik qilishga arziydiganlar borligi kabi?

en: Who but Griselda could, with a countenance, not only dry,485 but cheerful, have endured the barbarous and unheard proofs made by Gual- tieri?
uz: Griseldadan boshqa kim, nafaqat quruq, balki quvnoq ko'rinish bilan, Gual-tieri tomonidan taqdim etilgan vahshiy va eshitilmagan dalillarga bardosh bera olardi?

en: Which latter had not belike been ill requited, had he happened upon one who, when he turned her out of doors in her shift, had let jumble her furbelows of another to such purpose that a ﬁne gown had come of it.” Dioneo’s story being ﬁnished and the ladies having discoursed amain there- of, some inclining to one side and some to another, this blaming one thing and that commending it, the king, lifting his eyes to heaven and seeing that the sun was now low and the hour of vespers at hand, proceeded, without arising from session, to speak thus, “Charming ladies, as I doubt not you know, the understanding of mortals consisteth not only in having in memory things past and taking cognizance of things present; but in know- ing, by means of the one and the other of these, to forecast things future is reputed by men of mark to consist the greatest wisdom.
uz: Oxirgisi yomon jazoga tortilmagan bo'lsa kerak, agar u shunday holatda bo'lganida edi, agar u uni o'z navbatida eshikdan tashqariga burganida, uning pastki qismini boshqasining pastki qismi bilan shunday aralashtirib yuborgan bo'lsa, undan yaxshi ko'ylak paydo bo'lardi." Dioneo hikoyasi tugagandan so'ng va xonimlar u yerda hayrat bilan gapirgan bo'lsalar - ba'zilar bir tomonga, ba'zilar esa boshqa tomonga moyil bo'lishadi, bu bir narsani ayblash va uni maqtash, shoh, ko'zlarini osmonga ko'tarib, quyosh pastda va kechki kunlar yaqinlashayotganini ko'rganda, sessiyadan turib, shunday dedi: "Joyli xonimlar, men sizga shubhasiz, o'tmishdagi narsalarni eslash va hozirgi narsalarni bilishdan iborat emas, balki o'liklarni tushunish orqali, kelajakni bashorat qilishdan iboratdir."

en: Tomorrow, as you know, it will be ﬁfteen days since we departed Florence, to take some diver- sion for the preservation of our health and of our lives, eschewing the woes and dolours and miseries which, since this pestilential season began, are continually to be seen about our city.
uz: Ertaga, sizga ma'lumki, Florensiyadan ketganimizga o'n besh kun bo'ladi, sog'lig'imizni va hayotimizni saqlash uchun sayohatga boramiz, ushbu vabo mavsumi boshlanganidan beri shahar atrofida doimiy ravishda ko'rinadigan azob-uqubatlar va musibatlardan qochamiz.

en: This, to my judgment, we have well and honourably done; for that, an I have known to see aright, albeit merry stories and belike incentive to concupiscence have been told here and we have continually eaten and drunken well and danced and sung and made music, all things apt to incite weak minds to things less seemly, I have noted no act, no word, in ﬁne nothing blameworthy, either on your part or on that of us men; nay, meseemeth I have seen and felt here a continual de- cency, an unbroken concord and a constant fraternal familiarity; the which, at once for your honour and service and for mine own, is, certes, most pleasing to me.
uz: Bu, mening fikrimcha, biz yaxshi va sharafli tarzda amalga oshirdik; chunki, men bu yerda to'g'ri ko'rganman, garchi xursandchilik hikoyalari va shahvoniylikka bo'lgan rag'bat shu yerda aytilgan bo'lsa-da va biz doimiy ravishda yaxshi yeb-ichdik, raqsga tushdik, kuyladik va musiqa yaratdik, zaif onglarni kamroq ko'rinadigan narsalarga undashga moyil bo'lgan barcha narsalarni, men hech qanday harakat, hech qanday so'z, hech qanday aybga loyiq hech narsa qayd etmadim, na sizning tomondan, na bizning odamlarimiz tomondan; yo'q, men bu yerda doimiy hurmat, uzluksiz uyg'unlik va doimiy birodarlik tanishuvini ko'rganman va his qildim; bu, albatta, sizning sharafingiz va xizmatingiz uchun va o'zim uchun eng ko'p yoqtiradi.

en: Lest, however, for overlong usance aught should grow thereof that might issue in tediousness, and that none may avail to cavil at our overlong tarriance —each of us, moreover, having had his or her share of the honour that yet resideth in myself —I hold it meet, an it be your
uz: Lekin, haddan tashqari uzoq foydalanish zerikarli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan biror narsa o'smasligi uchun, va hech kim bizning haddan tashqari uzoq qolishimizdan foyda ko'rmasligi uchun  bundan tashqari, har birimiz o'zimda qolgan sharafning o'z ulushiga ega bo'lganimizdan  men buni munosib deb hisoblayman, va bu sizning

en: pleasure, that we now return whence we came; more by token that, if you consider aright, our company, already known to several others of the neigh- bourhood, may multiply after a fashion that will deprive us of our every commodity.
uz: Quvonch, endi kelgan joyimizga qaytayotganimizdan xursandmiz; ayniqsa, agar to'g'ri deb hisoblasangiz, qo'shnilar orasida bir necha kishiga allaqachon ma'lum bo'lgan kompaniyamiz bizni har bir tovarimizdan mahrum qiladigan uslubda ko'payishi mumkin.

en: Wherefore, if you approve my counsel, I will retain the crown conferred on me until our departure, which I purpose shall be tomorrow morning; but, should you determine otherwise, I have already in mind whom I shall invest withal for the ensuing day.” Much was the debate between the ladies and the young men; but ulti- mately they all took the king’s counsel for useful and seemly and determ- ined to do as he proposed; whereupon, calling the seneschal, he bespoke him of the manner which he should hold on the ensuing morning and after, having dismissed the company until suppertime, he rose to his feet.
uz: Shuning uchun, agar siz mening maslahatimga rozi bo'lsangiz, menga berilgan tojni ertaga ertalab jo'nab ketguncha saqlayman, men buni maqsad qilganman; lekin agar boshqacha qaror qilsangiz, men keyingi kun uchun kim bilan investitsiya qilishni allaqachon o'yladim. Xonimlar va yigitlar o'rtasida bahs ko'p edi; lekin oxir-oqibat ularning barchasi shohning maslahatini foydali va jozibali deb qabul qilishdi va u taklif qilganidek qilishga qaror qilishdi; shundan so'ng, senatorni chaqirib, u keyingi ertalab qanday o'tkazishi kerakligi haqida maslahat berdi va keyin, ovqatdan keyin, u o'rnidan turdi.

en: The ladies and the young men, following his example, gave themselves, this to one kind of diversion and that to another, no otherwise than of their wont; and suppertime come, they betook themselves to table with the utmost pleasure and after fell to singing and carolling and making music.
uz: Xonimlar va yigitlar uning misoliga ergashib, bir turdagi chalg'itish va boshqa turdagi chalg'itish uchun odatdagidan boshqa hech narsa qilmadilar; va kechki ovqat kelganda, ular o'zlarini juda xursandchilik bilan dasturxonga olib bordilar va keyin qo'shiq aytish, qo'shiq aytish va musiqa yaratishga tushdilar.

en: Presently, Lauretta leading up a dance, the king bade Fiammetta sing a song, whereupon she very blithely proceeded to sing thus: If love came but withouten jealousy,  I know no lady born  So blithe as I were, whosoe’er she be.
uz: Hozirda, Lauretta raqsga tushayotganda, qirol Fiammettaga qo'shiq aytdi, shundan so'ng u juda g'azab bilan shunday kuylashga kirishdi: Agar sevgi faqat rashksiz kelgan bo'lsa, men hech qanday xonimni bilmayman, men kabi go'zal, kim  u kim bo'lsa.

en: If gladsome youthfulness  In a fair lover might content a maid,  Virtue and worth discreet,  Valiance or gentilesse,  Wit and sweet speech and fashions all arrayed  In pleasantness complete,  Certes, I’m she for whose behoof these meet  In one; for, love-o’erborne,  All these in him who is my hope I see.
uz: Agar go'zal oshiqning yoshligi xizmatkorni qondirsa, fazilat va qadr-qimmat xotirjam, jasorat yoki mehribonlik, xushmuomalalik va shirin so'zlar va modalar hammasi go'zallik bilan to'ldirilgan bo'lsa, albatta, men shularning barchasi birda uchrashadigan odamman; chunki, sevgi - o'zgacha, Umid qilamanki, bularning hammasi u ichidandir.

en: But for that I perceive  That other women are as wise as I,  I tremble for affright  And tending to believe  The worst, in others the desire espy  Of him who steals my spright;
uz: Lekin shuning uchun men boshqa ayollar ham men kabi dono ekanligini anglayman, men qo'rquvdan titrayman va eng yomoniga ishonishga moyil bo'laman, boshqalarda mening nurimni o'g'irlagan odamdan xavotir.

en: Thus this that is my good and chief delight  Enforceth me, forlorn,  Sigh sore and live in dole and misery.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu mening yaxshiligim va eng katta lazzatimdir, meni, tashvishda, og'riqda va azobda yashaydi.

en: If I knew fealty such  In him my lord as I know merit there,  I were not jealous, I;  But here is seen so much  Lovers to tempt, how true they be soe’er,  I hold all false; whereby  I’m all disconsolate and fain would die,  Of each with doubting torn  Who eyes him, lest she bear him off from me.
uz: Agar men Udagi sadoqatni bilganimda, xo'jayinimda u yerda qanday fazilat borligini bilgan bo'lsam, men rashk qilmagan bo'lardim; Lekin mana, ko'plab oshiqlar vasvasaga tushadi, qanchalik rost bo'lishsa, men hammasini yolg'on deb bilaman; shu sababli hammasi taskinsiz va mayin o'lardi, har bir shubhalidan kim unga ko'z uzadi, toki u mendan uzoqlashtirmasin.

en: Be, then, each lady prayed  By God that she in this be not intent  ’Gainst me to do amiss;  For, sure, if any maid  Should or with words or becks or blandishment  My detriment in this  Seek or procure and if I know’t, ywis,  Be all my charms forsworn  But I will make her rue it bitterly.
uz: Shunday ekan, har bir xonim Xudoga ibodat qildi, shunda u bu ishda qasd qilmasin Menga xato qilish buyurmasin; Chunki, albatta, agar biron bir xizmatkor so'zlar, so'zlar yoki zerikishlar bilan Mening zararimni izlasa yoki ta'minlasa va men bilmasam  ywis, barcha jozibalarim qasamdan voz kechilsin, lekin men uni achchiq-achchiq afsuslantiraman.

en: No sooner had Fiammetta made an end of her song than Dioneo, who was beside her, said, laughing, “Madam, you would do a great courtesy to let all the ladies know who he is, lest you be ousted of his possession through ignorance, since you would be so sore incensed thereat.” After this divers other songs were sung and the night being now well nigh half spent, they all, by the king’s commandment, betook themselves to repose.
uz: Fiammetta o'z qo'shig'ini tugatgandan ko'p o'tmay, Dioneo uning yonida bo'lib, kuldi: "Xonim, siz barcha xonimlarga uning kimligini ma'lum qilishingizni juda yaxshi ko'rasiz, aks holda siz jaholat tufayli uning mulkidan haydalgan bo'lardingiz, chunki bundan juda achinar edingiz."

en: As the new day appeared, they arose and the seneschal having already despatched all their gear in advance, they returned, under the guidance of their discreet king, to Florence, where the three young men took leave of the seven ladies and leaving them in Santa Maria Novella, whence they had set out with them, went about their other pleasures, whilst the ladies, whenas it seemed to them time, returned to their houses.
uz: Yangi kun paydo bo'lishi bilan ular turdilar va kattalar allaqachon barcha jihozlarini oldindan jo'natgan holda, o'zlarining ehtiyotkor shohi rahbarligida Florensiyaga qaytdilar. U yerda uch yigit yetti xonim bilan xayrlashib, ularni Santa Maria Novellaga tashlab ketishdi va u yerdan boshqa lazzatlarga ketishdi, xonimlar esa, vaqt kelganda, o'z uylariga qaytishdi.

en: Here endeth the tenth and last day of the Decameron.
uz: Mana Dekameronning o'ninchi va oxirgi kuni tugaydi.

en: CONCLUSION OF THE AUTHOR Most noble damsels, for whose solace I have addressed myself to so long a labour, I have now, methinketh, with the aid of the Divine favour, (vouch- safed me, as I deem, for your pious prayers and not for my proper merits), throughly accomplished that which I engaged, at the beginning of this present work, to do; wherefore, returning thanks ﬁrst to God and after to you, it behoveth to give rest to my pen and to my tired hand.
uz: MUALLIF Xulosa Eng olijanob qizlar, men o'zimni shunchalik uzoq mehnatga murojaat qilganim uchun, endi, menimcha, Ilohiy marhamat yordamida (menimcha, meni sizning taqvodor ibodatlaringiz uchun saqlab qoldi, o'zimning munosib fazilatlarim uchun emas), hozirgi ishning boshida qilgan ishimni to'liq bajardim; shuning uchun, avvalo Xudoga va keyin sizga minnatdorchilik bildirgan holda, qalamimga va charchagan qo'limga dam berish kerak.

en: Which ere I accord them, I purpose brieﬂy to reply, as to objections tacitly broached, to certain small matters that may peradventure be alleged by some one of you or by others, since meseemeth very certain that these stories have no espe- cial privilege more than other things; nay, I mind me to have shown, at the beginning of the fourth day, that they have none such.
uz: Ularga ruxsat bermasimdan oldin, sizlardan kimdir yoki boshqalar da'vo qilishi mumkin bo'lgan ayrim mayda masalalarga bevosita bildirilgan e'tirozlarga qisqacha javob bermoqchiman, chunki bu hikoyalar boshqa narsalardan ko'ra hech qanday maxsus imtiyozga ega emasligiga juda aminman; yo'q, to'rtinchi kunning boshida ularning hech qanday xususiyati yo'qligini ko'rsatganimdan xafa bo'laman.

en: There are, peradven- ture, some of you who will say that I have used overmuch license in indit- ing these stories, as well as in making ladies whiles say and very often hearken to things not very seemly either to be said or heard of modest wo- men.
uz: Albatta, ba'zilaringiz aytishingiz mumkinki, men bu hikoyalarni aniqlashda juda ko'p litsenziyaga ega bo'lganman, shuningdek, ayollar kamtarin erkaklar haqida aytish yoki eshitish uchun unchalik ko'rinmaydigan narsalarni aytishga va juda ko'p eshitishga majbur qilganman.

en: This I deny, for that there is nothing so unseemly as to be forbidden unto anyone, so but he express it in seemly terms, as meseemeth indeed I have here very aptly done.
uz: Men buni rad etaman, chunki hech kimga taqiqlanadigan darajada bema'ni narsa yo'q, lekin u buni oddiy so'zlar bilan ifodalaydi, chunki men bu yerda juda mos ravishda qilganman.

en: But let us suppose that it is so (for that I mean not to plead with you, who would overcome me), I say that many reasons very readily offer themselves in answer why I have done this.
uz: Lekin shunday deb faraz qilaylik (shuning uchun men sizdan iltimos qilmoqchi emasman, siz meni yengib o'tishingiz mumkin edi), men buni nima uchun qilganim haqida ko'plab sabablar o'z-o'zini juda osonlik bilan taklif qiladi deb aytaman.

en: Firstly, if there be aught thereof486 in any of them, the nature of the stories required it, the which, an they be considered with the rational eye of a person of under- standing, it will be abundantly manifest that I could not have otherwise re- counted, an I would not altogether disfeature them.
uz: Birinchidan, agar ulardan birortasida 486 dan bir narsa bo'lsa, hikoyalarning mohiyati buni talab qilardi, bu esa, agar ular kambag'al odamning oqilona ko'zi bilan ko'rib chiqilsa, men boshqa yo'l bilan qayta hisoblay olmasligim va ularni umuman bekor qilmasligim aniq bo'ladi.

en: And if perchance there be therein some tittle, some wordlet or two freer, maybe, than liketh your squeamish hypocritical prudes, who weigh words rather than deeds and study more to appear, than to be, good, I say that it should no more be for- bidden me to write them than it is commonly forbidden unto men and wo-
uz: Va agar u yerda ba'zi bir mayda-chuyda, ba'zi bir so'zcha yoki ikki xil erkinroq narsa bo'lsa, ehtimol, sizning g'alati munofiq firibgarlaringiz, so'zlarni amallardan ko'ra ko'proq o'lchab, ko'rinish uchun ko'proq o'rganadiganlar, yaxshi bo'lishdan ko'ra, men aytamanki, ularni yozishga majbur bo'lmasligim kerak, chunki bu odatda odamlarga taqiqlanadi va...

en: men to say all day long hole and peg and mortar and pestle and sausage and polony and all manner like things; without reckoning that no less liberty should be accorded to my pen than is conceded to the brush of the limner, who, without any (or, at the least, any just) reprehension, maketh —let be St.
uz: Erkaklar butun kun davomida teshik, bolg'a, ohaktosh, pirog, kolbasa va poloniya va shunga o'xshash narsalarni aytishlari kerak; mening qalamimga hech qanday erkinlik berilishi kerak emasligini hisobga olmasdan, xuddi limnerning cho'tkasiga berilishidan kam bo'lmasligi kerak, u hech qanday (yoki hech bo'lmaganda, hech qanday adolatsiz) tanbehsiz, kelib tursin.

en: Michael smite the serpent with sword or spear and St.
uz: Mixail ilonni qilich yoki nayza bilan urdi va Avliyo...

en: George the dragon, whereas it pleaseth them —but Adam male and Eve female and af- ﬁxeth to the cross, whiles with one nail and whiles with two, the feet of Him Himself who willed for the salvation of the human race to die upon the rood.
uz: Jorj ajdaho, ularga yoqsa ham  lekin Odam Ato erkak va Momo Havo ayol va af- xochga mahkam o'rnashib, bir mix bilan va ikki mix bilan, insoniyatning najot uchun yo'lda o'lishni istagan O'zining oyoqlarini.

en: Moreover, it is eath enough to see that these things are spoken, not in the church, of the affairs whereof it behoveth to speak with a mind and in terms alike of the chastest (albeit among its histories there are tales enough to be found of anothergates fashion than those written by me), nor yet in the schools of philosophy, where decency is no less required than otherwhere, nor among churchmen or philosophers anywhere, but amidst gardens, in a place of pleasance and diversion and among men and women, though young, yet of mature wit and not to be led astray by stories, at a time when it was not forbidden to the most virtuous to go, for their own preservation, with their breeches on their heads.
uz: Qolaversa, bu narsalar cherkovda emas, balki aql bilan va eng odobli nuqtai nazardan gapirilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlar haqida gapirilishini ko'rish kifoya. (Agar uning tarixlarida men yozganidan ko'ra boshqa moda darvozalari haqida yetarli hikoyalar bo'lsa ham), na falsafa maktablarida, ularda odob boshqa joylardan kam talab qilinmaydi, na cherkovchilar yoki faylasuflar orasida, na bog'lar orasida, na ko'ngilochar joyda, na erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasida, yosh bo'lsa ham, yetuk aql va hikoyalar bilan yo'ldan ozdirmaslik kerak, o'zlarining asrashlari uchun eng fazilatli odamlarga, o'zlarining boshlarida,

en: Again, such as they are, these stories, like everything else, can both harm and proﬁt, according to the disposition of the listener.
uz: Yana, ular qanday bo'lsa, bu hikoyalar hammasi kabi, tinglovchining xohishiga ko'ra zarar yetkazishi va foyda keltirishi mumkin.

en: Who knoweth not that wine, though, according to Cincigli- one and Scolajo487 and many others, an excellent thing for people in health,488 is hurtful unto whoso hath the fever?
uz: Kim bilmaydi, lekin Cincigli, Scolajo487 va boshqa ko'plab ma'lumotlarga ko'ra, sog'lom odamlar uchun ajoyib narsa bo'lgan vino 488 isitma borlarga zarar keltiradi?

en: Shall we say, then, because it harmeth the fevered, that it is naught?
uz: Shunday ekan, isitma borlarga zarar yetkazgani uchun, hech narsa emas, deb aytaylikmi?

en: Who knoweth not that ﬁre is most useful, nay, necessary to mortals?
uz: Kim bilmaydi, olov o'lmaslar uchun eng foydali, aksincha, zarur ekanligini?

en: Shall we say, because it burneth houses and villages and cities, that it is naught?
uz: U uylar, qishloqlar va shaharlarni yoqib yuborganligi sababli, hech narsa emas, deb aytaymi?

en: Arms on like wise assure the wel- fare of those who desire to live in peace and yet oftentimes slay men, not of any malice of their own, but of the perversity of those who use them wrong- fully.
uz: Qurollar dono kabi tinchlikda yashashni istagan va ammo ko'pincha odamlarni o'ldiradiganlarning farovonligini ta'minlaydi, o'zlarining hech qanday yovuzligidan emas, balki ularni noto'g'ri ishlatadiganlarning buzuqligidan - to'liq.

en: Corrupt mind never understood word healthily, and even as seemly words proﬁt not depraved minds, so those which are not altogether seemly avail not to contaminate the well-disposed, any more than mire can sully the rays of the sun or earthly foulness the beauties of the sky.
uz: Buzuq aql hech qachon sog'lom so'zni tushunmagan, va hatto ko'rinmas so'zlar ham buzuq aqllarga foyda keltirmaganidek, yaxshi niyatlilarni ifloslantirmaslikka hech qanday foyda ko'rmaydiganlar, xuddi loy quyosh nurlarini yoki yer yuzidagi ifloslik osmon go'zalliklarini bulg'atgandek.

en: What books, what words, what letters are holier, worthier, more venerable than those of the Divine Scriptures?
uz: Qaysi kitoblar, qaysi so'zlar, qaysi harflar Ilohiy Muqaddas Kitoblardagidan muqaddasroq, munosibroq, hurmatliroqdir?

en: Yet many there be, who, interpreting them perversely, have brought themselves and others to perdition.
uz: Lekin ko'pchilik bor, ularni noto'g'ri talqin qilib, o'zlarini ham, boshqalarni ham halokatga olib keldilar.

en: Everything in itself is good unto somewhat and ill used, may be in many things harmful; and so say I of my stories.
uz: Har bir narsa o'z-o'zidan ma'lum darajada yaxshi va noto'g'ri ishlatilishi mumkin, ko'p narsalarda zararli bo'lishi mumkin; va men o'z hikoyalarim haqida shunday deyman.

en: If any be minded to draw therefrom ill counsel or ill practice, they will nowise forbid it him, if perchance they have it in them or
uz: Agar kimdir undan yomon maslahat yoki yomon amaliyot olishni niyat qilsa, ular buni o'zlarida bo'lsa ham, unga taqiqlashlarini so'raydilar.

en: be strained and twisted into having it; and who so will have proﬁt and util- ity thereof, they will not deny it him, nor will they be ever styled or accoun- ted other than useful and seemly, if they be read at those times and to those persons for which and for whom they have been recounted.
uz: zo'riqish va uni egallashga burilish; va kimda undan foyda va foyda bo'lsa, uni inkor etmaydi, va agar ular o'sha paytda va ular uchun va ular uchun hikoya qilingan shaxslarga o'qilgan bo'lsa, ular hech qachon foydali va ko'rinadigan boshqa uslubda yoki hisobda bo'lmaydilar.

en: Whoso hath to say paternosters or to make tarts and puddings for her spiritual director, let her leave them be; they will not run after any to make her read them; albeit your she-saints themselves now and again say and even do ﬁne things.
uz: Kimki o'zining ma'naviy direktori uchun "paternosters" yoki "tortlar va puddinglar" tayyorlashni xohlasa, ularni qo'yib yuborsin; ular uni o'qishga majburlash uchun hech kimga yugurishmaydi; garchi sizning azizlaringiz vaqti-vaqti bilan yaxshi gaplar aytishsa va hatto yaxshi ishlar qilishsa ham.

en: There be some ladies also who will say that there are some stories here, which had been better away.
uz: Ba'zi xonimlar ham bu yerda yaxshiroq bo'lgan ba'zi hikoyalar borligini aytishadi.

en: Granted; but I could not nor should write aught save those actually related, wherefore those who told them should have told them goodly and I would have written them goodly.
uz: Ruxsat etilgan; lekin men aslida aytib o'tilganlardan boshqa hech narsa yozishga qodir emasdim va yozmasam ham bo'lardi, shuning uchun ularga aytganlar ularga yaxshi gapirgan bo'lardi va men ularni yaxshi yozgan bo'lardim.

en: But, if folk will e’en pretend that I am both the inventor and writer thereof (which I am not), I say that I should not take shame to myself that they were not all alike goodly, for that there is no craftsman living (barring God) who doth everything alike well and completely; witness Charlemagne, who was the ﬁrst maker of the Paladins, but knew not to make so many thereof that he might avail to form an army of them alone.
uz: Lekin, agar odamlar meni ham ixtirochi, ham yozuvchi deb o'ylashsa (men unday emasman), men aytamanki, ularning hammasi yaxshi bir xil emasligidan o'zimga uyalmasligim kerak, chunki hamma narsani yaxshi va to'liq qiladigan (Xudodan tashqari) tirik hunarmand yo'q; guvohlik bering, Buyuk Charl, u Paladinlarning birinchi yaratuvchisi edi, lekin ulardan juda ko'p narsa yasashni bilmas edi, chunki u ulardan bir o'zi qo'shin tuzishi mumkin edi.

en: In the multitude of things, needs must divers qualities thereof be found.
uz: Narsalar ko'pligida ehtiyojlar ularning turli sifatlarini topishi kerak.

en: No ﬁeld was ever so well tilled but therein or nettles or thistles or somewhat of briers or other weeds might be found mingled with the better herbs.
uz: Hech qaysi dala bunchalik yaxshi dehqonchilik qilinmagan edi, lekin u yerda o'tilar, tikanlar yoki biroz ko'katlar yoki boshqa begona o'tlar yaxshiroq o'tlar bilan aralashgan holda topilishi mumkin edi.

en: Besides, having to speak to simple lasses, such as you are for the most part, it had been folly to go seeking and wearying myself to ﬁnd very choice and exquisite matters, and to use great pains to speak very measuredly.
uz: Qolaversa, siz kabi oddiy qizlarga gapirishga majbur bo'lish, ko'p hollarda, juda tanlov va nafis narsalarni topish uchun qidiruvga borish va o'zimni charchatib, juda o'lchovli gapirish uchun katta azob sarflash ahmoqlik edi.

en: Algates, whoso goeth reading among these, let him leave those which offend and read those which divert.
uz: Algetlar, kim bular orasida o'qisa, xafa qiladiganlarni tashlasin va chalg'ituvchilarni o'qisin.

en: They all, not to lead anyone into error, bear branded upon the forefront that which they hold hidden within their bosoms.
uz: Ularning hammasi, hech kimni adashtirmaslik uchun, o'z ko'kraklarida yashiringan narsani oldingi safga belgilaydilar.

en: Again, I doubt not but there be those who will say that some of them are overlong; to whom I say again that whoso hath overwhat to do doth folly to read these stories, even though they were brief.
uz: Yana bir bor shubham yo'q, lekin ularning ba'zilari ortiqcha umr ko'radi deydiganlar bor; ularga yana bir bor aytamanki, kimda ortiqcha ish bo'lsa, bu hikoyalarni o'qish ahmoqlikdir, garchi ular qisqa bo'lsa ham.

en: And albeit a great while is passed from the time when I began to write to this present hour whenas I come to the end of my toils, it hath not therefor escaped my memory that I proffered this my travail to idle women and not to others, and unto whoso readeth to pass away the time, nothing can be overlong, so but it do that for which he useth it.
uz: Va garchi mehnatimning oxiriga kelganimda, hozirgi soatga yozishni boshlagan vaqtimdan ancha vaqt o'tgan bo'lsa ham, men bu mehnatimni boshqalarga emas, balki bekorchi ayollarga topshirganimni esdan chiqarmadim. Va vaqtni o'tkazib yuborishni o'ylaganlarga hech narsa ortiqcha bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun u uni ishlatadigan narsani qiladi.

en: Things brief are far better suited unto students, who study, not to pass away, but usefully to employ time, than to you ladies, who have on your hands all the time that you spend not in the pleasures of love; more by token that, as none of you goeth to Athens or Bologna or Paris to
uz: Qisqa narsalar o'qish uchun emas, balki vaqtni foydali sarflash uchun o'qiydigan talabalarga, siz ayollarga qaraganda ancha mos keladi, chunki sizda sevgi lazzatlarida o'tkazmaydigan barcha vaqt bor; ayniqsa, hech biringiz Afinaga, Bolonyaga yoki Parijga bormayotganingiz kabi.

en: study, it behoveth to speak to you more at large than to those who have had their wits whetted by study.
uz: O'rganing, siz bilan kengroq gaplashish kerak, o'rganish orqali aqlini oqartirganlarga qaraganda.

en: Again, I doubt not a jot but there be yet some of you who will say that the things aforesaid are full of quips and cranks and quodlibets and that it ill beseemeth a man of weight and gravity to have written thus.
uz: Yana bir bor shubha qilmayman, lekin sizlardan ba'zilar yuqorida aytilgan narsalar g'ijir-g'ijir va quodlibetsga to'la, va og'irlik va og'irlikdagi odam bunday yozganiga to'g'ri kelmaydi, deb aytishadi.
