en: I felt a little strangely, and not a little frightened.
uz: O'zimni biroz g'alati his qildim, biroz qo'rqmadim.

en: I think had there been any alternative I should have taken it, instead of prosecuting that unknown night journey.
uz: O'ylaymanki, agar biron bir variant bo'lganida, ushbu noma'lum kechki sayohatni davom ettirishning o'rniga uni qabul qilishim kerak edi.

en: The carriage went at a hard pace straight along, then we made a complete turn and went along another straight road.
uz: Arabona qattiq tezlikda to'g'ri yo'lga tushdi, so'ngra biz to'liq burilish qildik va boshqa to'g'ri yo'l bo'ylab ketdik.

en: It seemed to me that we were simply going over and over the same ground again, and so I took note of some salient point, and found that this was so.
uz: O'zimga o'xshab, biz bir xil mavzuni qayta-qayta ko'rib chiqmoqdamiz, shuning uchun men bir muhim fikrga e'tibor qaratdim va buning aniqligini tushundim.

en: I would have liked to have asked the driver what this all meant, but I really feared to do so, for I thought that, placed as I was, any protest would have had no effect in case there had been an intention to delay.
uz: Men haydovchidan bularning barchasi nimani anglatishini so'rashni xohlardim, lekin men buni qilishdan qo'rqardim, chunki men o'yladimki, agar kechiktirish niyatida bo'lgan bo'lsa, hozirgi vaziyatda har qanday protest hech qanday samara bermaydi.

en: By-and-by, however, as I was curious to know how time was passing, I struck a match, and by its ﬂame looked at my watch.
uz: Biroq, vaqt qanday o'tishini bilmoqchi bo'lganimda, vaqt o'tib ketayotganini bilmoqchi bo'lganimda, bir o'yinchoqni urdim va uning olovidan soatimni ko'rdim.

en: It was within a few minutes of midnight.
uz: Bu tun yarimidan bir necha daqiqa oldin sodir bo'ldi.

en: This gave me a sort of shock, for I suppose the general
uz: Bu menga o'zgacha hayronlik keltirdi, chunki men generalning o'zi xayoliga tushdi deb o'ylayman.

en: superstition about midnight was increased by my recent experiences.
uz: So'nggi yillarda o'tgan tajribalarim tufayli kechasi haqida sehr-jodu ko'paydi.

en: I wait- ed with a sick feeling of suspense.
uz: Men sog'lom hissiyot bilan kutdim.

en: Then a dog began to howl somewhere in a farmhouse far down the road, a long, agonized wailing, as if from fear.
uz: So'ngra bir it yo'ldan uzoq bo'lgan fermada bir joyda qo'rqqancha, uzoq vaqt, azob chekib yig'lay boshladi.

en: The sound was taken up by anoth- er dog, and then another and another, till, borne on the wind which now sighed softly through the Pass, a wild howling began, which seemed to come from all over the country, as far as the imagination could grasp it through the gloom of the night.
uz: Tovushni har bir it, so'ngra yana bir it va yana bir it eshitdi, to o'tish yo'lidan past o'tadigan shamol ustiga olib ketilganda, butun mamlakatdan, hatto tunning qorong'iligidan ham tasavvurga ega bo'lgancha, yovvoyi qichqiriq boshlandi.

en: At the ﬁrst howl the horses began to strain and rear, but the driver spoke to them soothingly, and they quieted down, but shivered and sweated as though after a runaway from sudden fright.
uz: Birinchi qichqirishda otlar orqaga qochib ketishdi, ammo haydovchi ularga tinchlik bilan gapirdi va ular tinchlandilar, lekin qo'rqib, terib ketishdi, xuddi to'satdan qo'rquvdan qochib ketgan kishiga o'xshab.

en: Then, far off in the distance, from the mountains on each side of us began a louder and a sharper howl- ing, that of wolves, which affected both the horses and myself in the same way.
uz: Keyin, uzoq, uzoq, bizning har bir tomonimizdagi tog'lardan bo'lgan qurtlar ovozi balandroq va keskinroq bo'ldi, bu ham otlarga, ham menga o'xshash ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: For I was minded to jump from the caleche and run, whilst they reared again and plunged madly, so that the driver had to use all his great strength to keep them from bolting.
uz: Chunki men ko'krakdan tushib yugurishim kerak edi, ular yana ko'tarilib, aqldan ozgan holda qulab ketishganida, haydovchi ularni to'xtatish uchun butun kuchini ishlatishi kerak edi.

en: In a few minutes, however, my own ears got ac- customed to the sound, and the horses so far became quiet that the driver was able to descend and to stand before them.
uz: Biroq bir necha daqiqadan so'ng, o'z quloqlarim tovushga moslashdi va otlar shunchalik sukut bo'ldiki, haydovchi tushdi va ularning oldida turdi.

en: He petted and soothed them, and whispered something in their ears, as I have heard of horse-tamers doing, and with extraordinary effect, for under his caresses they became quite manageable again, though they still trem- bled.
uz: U ularni quchoqlab, tinchlantirardi va ularning quloqlariga biror narsa shovqirdi, xuddi ot o'ynashchilar qilayotganini eshitganimdek, ajoyib ta'sir bilan, chunki uning quchoqlari ostida ular hali ham qo'rqib ketayotgan bo'lsa-da, yana boshqariladigan bo'ldi.

en: The driver again took his seat, and shaking his reins, started off at a great pace.
uz: Haydovchi yana o'rinni egallab oldi va o'z quti-qonchasini silkitib, katta tezlikda yo'lga tushdi.

en: This time, after going to the far side or the Pass, he suddenly turned down a narrow roadway which ran sharply to the right.
uz: Bu safar u o'ng tomonga yoki o'tish yo'liga borganidan so'ng, to'satdan o'ng tomonga keskin o'tgan tor yo'ldan o'tib ketdi.

en: Soon we were hemmed in with trees, which in places arched right over the roadway till we passed as through a tunnel.
uz: Tez orada biz daraxtlar bilan qoplangan edik, ular joylarda yo'ldan o'tib, tuneldan o'tganday bo'lib o'tgan.

en: And again great frowning rocks guarded us boldly on either side.
uz: Yana bir bor buyuk burchakli toshlar bizni har ikki tomondan jasorat bilan himoya qilardi.

en: Though we were in shelter, we could hear the rising wind, for it moaned and whistled through the rocks, and the branches of the trees crashed together as we swept along.
uz: Garchi biz panohda bo'lsak-da, shamolning ko'tarilishini eshitardik, chunki u toshlar orasidan yig'lab, pishirdi va daryo shoxlari bir-biriga tushib ketayotganda bir-biriga urildi.

en: It grew colder and colder still, and ﬁne, powdery snow began to fall, so that soon we and all around us were covered with a white blanket.
uz: Soyuqroq va sovuqroq bo'lib, salqin, bug'doy bo'lgan qor tushishni boshladi, shuning uchun tez orada biz va atrofimiz oq cho'tka bilan qoplandi.

en: The keen wind still carried the howling of the dogs, though this grew fainter as we went on our way.
uz: O'tkir shamol hali ham itlarning qichqirishini ko'tarib turardi, lekin biz yo'lni davom ettirganimiz sayin bu kuchayib borardi.

en: The baying of the wolves sounded nearer and nearer, as though they were closing round on us from every side.
uz: Qurtlar qichqiriqlari har tomonlama yaqinlashib, atrofimizga yaqinlashayotganini his qilardik.

en: I grew dreadfully afraid, and the hors- es shared my fear.
uz: Men dahshatli qo'rqib ketdim va atlar ham mening qo'rquvimni o'zlariga qo'shdilar.

en: The driver, however, was not in the least disturbed.
uz: Biroq haydovchi hech qanday xavotirga tushmagan.

en: He kept turning his head to left and right, but I could not see anything through the darkness.
uz: U boshini chap va o'ng tomonga burib turardi, lekin qorong'ilikda men hech narsa ko'rmasdim.

en: Suddenly, away on our left I saw a fain ﬂickering blue ﬂame.
uz: Toʻsatdan, chap tomonimizdan oʻtib, men chiroyli bir koʻk olovni koʻrdim.

en: The driver saw it at the same moment.
uz: Haydovchi uni shu paytning o'zida ko'rdi.

en: He at once checked the horses, and, jumping to the ground, disappeared into the darkness.
uz: U darhol otlarni tekshirib ko'rdi va yerga yiqilib, qorong'ilikka tushib ketdi.

en: I did not know what to do, the less as the howling of the wolves grew closer.
uz: Men nima qilishim kerakligini bilmasdim, shunda bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari yaqinlashib borardi.

en: But while I wondered, the driver suddenly appeared again, and without a word took his seat, and we resumed our journey.
uz: Ammo men o'zimni o'ylayotganimda, haydovchi birdan yana paydo bo'ldi va so'zsiz o'rinni egallab oldi va biz sayohatni davom ettirdik.

en: I think I must have fallen asleep and kept dreaming of the incident, for it seemed to be repeated endlessly, and now looking back, it is like a sort of awful nightmare.
uz: O'ylaymanki, men uyquga tushib, hodisa haqida orzu qilib yurgan bo'lardim, chunki bu hodisa doimo takrorlanayotgandek tuyuladi va endi orqaga nazar solib ko'rib, bu qandaydir dahshatli orzuga o'xshaydi.

en: Once the ﬂame appeared so near the road, that even in the darkness around us I could watch the driver's motions.
uz: Bir marta olov yo'l yaqinida paydo bo'ldi, hatto atrofimizdagi qorong'ilikda ham haydovchining harakatlarini kuzatishim mumkin edi.

en: He went rapidly to where the blue ﬂame arose, it must have been very faint, for it did not seem to illumine the place around it at all, and gathering a few stones, formed them into some device.
uz: U tezda ko'k olovning paydo bo'lgan joyiga bordi, u juda zaif bo'lishi kerak edi, chunki u atrofdagi joyni hech qanday yorug'lik bilan yoritmaydi va bir nechta toshlarni to'plab, ularni biron bir qurilmaga aylantiradi.

en: Once there appeared a strange optical effect.
uz: Bir marta g'alati optik ta'sir paydo bo'ldi.

en: When he stood between me and the ﬂame he did not obstruct it, for I could see its ghostly ﬂicker all the same.
uz: U men bilan olov o'rtasida turganida, uni to'sib qo'ymagan, chunki men uning hayajonli parlashini hali ham ko'rardim.

en: This startled me, but as the effect was only momentary, I took it that my eyes deceived me straining through the darkness.
uz: Bu meni hayratda qoldirdi, lekin ta'sir o'z vaqtida bo'lgani uchun, ko'zlarim qorong'ilikda meni aldashganini angladim.

en: Then for a time there were no blue ﬂames, and we sped onwards through the gloom, with the howling of the wolves around us, as though they were following in a mov- ing circle.
uz: Keyin bir muncha vaqt davomida ko'k olovlar yo'q edi va biz qorong'ilik ichida o'zimizni kuzatib borayotgan bo'rilarning qichqirishini ko'rib, o'zimizni harakatlanayotgan to'plamda yugurib ketgandek harakat qildik.

en: At last there came a time when the driver went further aﬁeld than he had yet gone, and during his absence, the horses began to tremble worse than ever and to snort and scream with fright.
uz: Nihoyat, haydovchi hali ketmaganidan ham uzoqroq borgan vaqt keldi va uning yo'qligida otlar har qachongidan ham dahshatga tushdi va qo'rquvdan qichqirib qichqirib, qichqirib yurishdi.

en: I could not see any cause for it, for the howling of the wolves had ceased altogether.
uz: Men buning hech qanday sababini ko'rmadim, chunki bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari butunlay to'xtadi.

en: But just then the moon, sailing through the black clouds, appeared behind the jagged crest of a beetling, pine-clad rock, and by its light I saw around us a ring of wolves, with white teeth and lolling red tongues, with long, sinewy limbs and shag- gy hair.
uz: Ammo o'sha paytda qora bulutlar orasidan yelka o'tkazgan o'simlik o'sha cho'g'li, cho'g'li tosh qoplangan toshning bo'lak-bo'lak orqasidan paydo bo'ldi va uning yorug'ligida biz atrofimizda oq tishlar va qizil tillar, uzun, sinchli a'zolari va sochlari bilan o'ralgan qurtlar to'plami ko'rdim.

en: They were a hundred times more terrible in the grim silence which held them than even when they howled.
uz: Ularni ushlab turadigan soʻnggi soʻzsizlikda ular hatto qichqirishlaridan yuz baravar dahshatli edilar.

en: For myself, I felt a sort of paralysis of fear.
uz: O'zim uchun esa qo'rquvdan bir xil paralizni his qildim.

en: It is only when a man feels himself face to face with such horrors that he can understand their true import.
uz: Faqatgina odam o'zini bunday dahshatlarga yuzma-yuz ko'rganida ularning haqiqiy ahamiyatini tushunadi.

en: All at once the wolves began to howl as though the moonlight had had some peculiar effect on them.
uz: Toʻsatdan boʻrilar oy nurining ularga oʻzgacha taʼsir koʻrsatgani kabi qichqirishni boshladilar.

en: The horses jumped about and reared, and looked helplessly round with eyes that rolled in a way painful to see.
uz: Atlar o'z-o'zidan ko'tarilib, ko'rish uchun og'ir bo'lgan ko'zlar bilan yordamsiz atrofga qarab turishdi.

en: But the living ring of terror encompassed them on every side, and they had per- force to remain within it.
uz: Ammo qo'rqinchning tirik to'qnashuvi ularni har tomondan qamrab olgan va ular o'sha to'qnashuviga majbur bo'lishgan.

en: I called to the coachman to come, for it seemed to me that our only chance was to try to break out through the ring and to aid his approach, I shouted and beat the side of the caleche, hoping by the noise
uz: Men haydovchini chaqirtirib, kelishga chaqirdim, chunki menga ko'rinardiki, bizning yagona imkoniyatimiz ringdan chiqib ketishga harakat qilish va uning yoniga yaqinlashishiga ko'maklashish edi, deb baqirib, ko'ylakning yon tomonini urdim va shovqining shovqinidan umidvor bo'ldim

en: to scare the wolves from the side, so as to give him a chance of reaching the trap.
uz: Qurtlarni qo'rqitish uchun qo'rqitish uchun, shunda u tuzoqqa yetib borishi mumkin bo'ladi.

en: How he came there, I know not, but I heard his voice raised in a tone of imperious command, and looking towards the sound, saw him stand in the roadway.
uz: Qanday qilib u yerga yetib kelganini bilmayman, lekin uning ovozini imperiyaviy qo'mondonlik bilan tingladim va ovoz tomoniga qarab, uni yo'lda turganini ko'rdim.

en: As he swept his long arms, as though brushing aside some im- palpable obstacle, the wolves fell back and back further still.
uz: U o'zining uzun qo'llarini ko'targanida, xuddi biron-bir aniqlanmaydigan to'siqni chetga surib qo'ygan bo'lsa-da, bo'rilar orqaga va orqaga yana ko'proq tushdi.

en: Just then a heavy cloud passed across the face of the moon, so that we were again in darkness.
uz: O'sha paytda oy yuziga og'ir bulut o'tib ketdi va biz yana qorong'ilikka tushib qoldik.

en: When I could see again the driver was climbing into the caleche, and the wolves disappeared.
uz: Men haydovchini yana ko'rishim mumkin bo'lganida, u cho'ponga chiqib ketayotganini va bo'rilar yo'qolganini ko'rdim.

en: This was all so strange and uncanny that a dreadful fear came upon me, and I was afraid to speak or move.
uz: Bularning barchasi shunchalik g'alati va g'alati bo'lganki, qo'rqinchli qo'rquv menga tushdi va men gapirishdan yoki harakatlanishdan qo'rqardim.

en: The time seemed interminable as we swept on our way, now in almost complete darkness, for the rolling clouds obscured the moon.
uz: Biz yo'limizni to'ldirib borayotganda, hozir deyarli butun qorong'ilikda, to'kib turgan bulutlar oyni qorong'u qilib qo'ygan vaqt cheksiz ko'rinardi.

en: We kept on ascending, with occasional periods of quick descent, but in the main always ascending.
uz: Biz tez-tez tushadigan davrlar bilan ko'tarib borardik, lekin asosan har doim ko'tarib borardik.

en: Suddenly, I became conscious of the fact that the driver was in the act of pulling up the horses in the courtyard of a vast ruined castle, from whose tall black windows came no ray of light, and whose broken battlements showed a jagged line against the sky.
uz: Toʻsatdan haydovchi katta vayron qilingan qalʼaning hovlisida otlarni koʻtarib borayotganini bilardim, uning baland qora derazalaridan yorugʻlik nur nurlari chiqmagan va buzilgan qorovullari osmonga qarshi boʻgʻishlangan chiziq koʻrsatgan.

en: CHAPTER 2 JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL CONTINUED 5 May.—I must have been asleep, for certainly if I had been fully awake I must have noticed the approach of such a remarkable place.
uz: 2 - bob Jonathan Harkerning kun tartibini davom ettirmoqda 5 may.Men uxlab yotgan bo'lar edim, albatta, agar to'liq uyg'ongan bo'lsam, bunday ajoyib joy yaqinlashayotganini payqadim.

en: In the gloom the courtyard looked of considerable size, and as several dark ways led from it under great round arches, it perhaps seemed bigger than it really is.
uz: Qorong'ilikda hovli sezilarli darajada katta ko'rinardi va undan ko'p qorong'u yo'llar katta to'g'riroq qadoqlar ostida olib borilgan bo'lsa-da, ehtimol u aslida bo'lganidan kattaroq ko'rinardi.

en: I have not yet been able to see it by daylight.
uz: Men uni kun yorug'ligida ko'ra olmaganman.

en: When the caleche stopped, the driver jumped down and held out his hand to assist me to alight.
uz: Kellex to'xtasa, haydovchi pastga sakrab tushdi va menga tushishimga yordam berish uchun qo'lini uzatdi.

en: Again I could not but notice his prodigious strength.
uz: Yana bir bor uning ajoyib kuchini payqadim.

en: His hand actually seemed like a steel vice that could have crushed mine if he had chosen.
uz: Uning qo'li, aslida, po'latli bo'g'iga o'xshaydi va u tanlaganida mening qo'limni ezib tashlashi mumkin edi.

en: Then he took my traps, and placed them on the ground be- side me as I stood close to a great door, old and studded with large iron nails, and set in a projecting doorway of massive stone.
uz: Keyin u tuzoqlarimni olib, katta temir to'g'irlari bilan qoplangan, eski va katta eshik oldida turganimda, ularni yonimda yer ustiga qo'ydi va ulkan toshdan yasalgan eshikga qo'ydi.

en: I could see even in the dim light that the stone was massively carved, but that the carving had been much worn by time and weather.
uz: Hatto kam yorug'likda ham, toshning juda katta o'tkirlanganligini, lekin o'tkirlangan narsa vaqt va ob-havo tufayli ko'p o'tkirlanganini ko'rardim.

en: As I stood, the driver jumped again into his seat and shook the reins.
uz: Men turganimda haydovchi yana o'rinbosariga sakrab o'tirib, o'z terini silkitdi.

en: The horses started forward, and trap and all disappeared down one of the dark openings.
uz: Atlar oldinga borishdi, tuzoqqa tushishdi va hammalari qorong'i yoriqlar bo'ylab yo'q bo'lib ketishdi.

en: I stood in silence where I was, for I did not know what to do.
uz: Men nima qilishni bilmasligim sababli, o'zim turgan joyda sukutdan turardim.

en: Of bell or knocker there was no sign.
uz: Qo'ng'iroq yoki taqillatuvchining belgisi yo'q edi.

en: Through these frowning walls and dark window openings it was not likely that my voice could penetrate.
uz: Bu burun bo'lgan devorlar va qorong'i derazalar orqali ovozimni o'chirib o'tish ehtimoli yo'q edi.

en: The time I waited seemed endless, and I felt doubts and fears crowding upon me.
uz: Men kutgan vaqt cheksiz ko'rinardi va shubha va qo'rquvlar menga to'lib-toshganini his qilardim.

en: What sort of place had I come to, and among what kind of people?
uz: Men qanday joyga kelganman va qanday odamlar orasida?

en: What sort of grim ad- venture was it on which I had embarked?
uz: Men qanday qorong'i reklama ishini boshlaganman?

en: Was this a customary incident in the life of a solicitor's clerk sent out to explain the purchase of a London es- tate to a foreigner?
uz: Bu advokatning ishchisi Londondagi kreditni xorijiy shaxsga sotib olishni tushuntirish uchun yuborilgan hayotdagi odatdagi hodisa bo'lganmi?

en: Mina would not like that.
uz: Mina bunga rozi bo'lmaydi.

en: Solicitor, for just before leaving London I got word that my examination was successful, and I am now a full-blown solicitor!
uz: Solicitor, Londonni tark etishdan oldin imtihonim muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazilganligi haqida xabar oldim va endi to'liq advokat bo'ldim!

en: I began to rub my eyes and pinch my-
uz: Men ko'zlarimni silkitib, o'zimni teshishga kirdim.

en: self to see if I were awake.
uz: O'zim uyg'ondimmi yoki yo'qmi ko'rish uchun.

en: It all seemed like a horrible nightmare to me, and I expected that I should suddenly awake, and ﬁnd myself at home, with the dawn struggling in through the windows, as I had now and again felt in the morning after a day of overwork.
uz: Hammasi menga dahshatli orzu kabi ko'rindi va men to'satdan uyg'onishimni va o'zimni uyda topishimni kutardim, tong chiroqlari darvozalar orqali o'tib ketayotganini ko'rdim, chunki men ba'zan ertalab o'zimni ortiqcha ishdan keyin his qilardim.

en: But my ﬂesh answered the pinching test, and my eyes were not to be deceived.
uz: Ammo tanam o'g'irlash sinovidan o'tdi va ko'zlarim aldanib qolmasligi kerak edi.

en: I was indeed awake and among the Carpathians.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, karpatlar orasida uyg'onib turardim.

en: All I could do now was to be patient, and to wait the com- ing of morning.
uz: Endi men faqat sabr-toqatli bo'lib, ertalabning kelishini kutardim.

en: Just as I had come to this conclusion I heard a heavy step approaching behind the great door, and saw through the chinks the gleam of a coming light.
uz: Shu xulosaga kelganimda, katta eshik orqasidan og'ir qadam yaqinlashayotganini eshitdim va o'sha cho'g'lar ichidan bir yorug'lik parlashini ko'rdim.

en: Then there was the sound of rattling chains and the clanking of mas- sive bolts drawn back.
uz: So'ngra zanjirlarning qichqirishining ovozi va orqaga surilgan katta boltlarning qichqirishlari eshitildi.

en: A key was turned with the loud grating noise of long disuse, and the great door swung back.
uz: Uzoq vaqtdan beri foydalanilmayotgan kuchli shovqin tovushi bilan kalit o'girildi va katta eshik qaytib ketdi.

en: Within, stood a tall old man, clean shaven save for a long white mous- tache, and clad in black from head to foot, without a single speck of colour about him anywhere.
uz: Ichkarisida baland, toza sochli, uzun oq burchakni qo'yib, boshidan oyoqqacha qora kiyim kiygan bir keksa kishi turgan edi, uning atrofida hech qanday rang bo'lmagan edi.

en: He held in his hand an antique silver lamp, in which the ﬂame burned without a chimney or globe of any kind, throwing long quivering shadows as it ﬂickered in the draught of the open door.
uz: U qo'lida qadimgi kumush chiroqni tutgan edi, unda olov olov olovsiz yoki dunyosiz yonardi va u ochiq eshikning cho'qqisida parcha-parcha bo'lganda, uzoq va titragan soyalarni atardi.

en: The old man motioned me in with his right hand with a courtly gesture, saying in excellent English, but with a strange intonation.
uz: Keksa kishi menga o'ng qo'li bilan mehribonlik bilan ishora qildi va ajoyib ingliz tilida so'zladi, ammo g'alati intonatsiya bilan.

en: Welcome to my house!
uz: O'z uyimga xush kelibsiz!

en: Enter freely and of your own free will! He made no motion of stepping to meet me, but stood like a statue, as though his gesture of welcome had ﬁxed him into stone.
uz: Xalos bo'lib va o'z xohishingiz bilan kiringlar! - dedi u, menga qarshi chiqish uchun hech qanday harakat qilmay, haykal kabi turdi, xuddi uning xush kelibsiz muomalasi uni toshga urib qo'ygan bo'lsa kerak.

en: The instant, however, that I had stepped over the threshold, he moved impulsively forward, and hold- ing out his hand grasped mine with a strength which made me wince, an ef- fect which was not lessened by the fact that it seemed cold as ice, more like the hand of a dead than a living man.
uz: Biroq, men chegara ustida bo'lgan paytimda u tez-tez oldinga harakat qildi va qo'lini uzatganida, mening qo'limni o'zimni qichqiradigan kuch bilan ushlab oldi, bu esa muz kabi sovuq, tirik odamdan ko'ra o'lik qo'liga o'xshaydigan holatga o'xshaydigan ta'sir bilan kam bo'lmadi.

en: Go safely, and leave something of the happiness you bring! The strength of the handshake was so much akin to that which I had noticed in the driver, whose face I had not seen, that for a moment I doubted if it were not the same person to whom I was speaking.
uz: Xavfsizlik bilan keting va o'zingizga keltiradigan baxtning bir qismini qoldiring! - deb qo'l urishning kuchi haydovchida ko'rganimga shunchalik o'xshardiki, uning yuzini ko'rmagan edimki, bir daqiqaga u men gapirayotgan odam emasmikin deb shubha qildim.

en: So to make sure, I said interrogatively, Count Dracula? He bowed in a courtly was as he replied, I am Dracula, and I bid you welcome, Mr.
uz: Shunday qilib, ishonch hosil qilish uchun men so'rovlar bilan: Drakula Count? - deb so'radim. U: Men Drakulaman va sizga xush kelibsiz, Mr. deb javob berganda, hovlidagi o'rinni egalladi.

en: Harker, to my house.
uz: Harker, mening uyimga.

en: Come in, the night air is chill, and you must need to eat and rest.As he was speaking, he put the lamp on a bracket on the wall, and stepping out, took my luggage.
uz: Kiringlar, kechasi havo sovuq va siz ovqatlanishga va dam olishga muhtoj bo'lishingiz kerak.U gapirganida, u chiroqni devorga qo'ydi va tashqariga chiqib, mening yuklarimni olib chiqdi.

en: He had carried it in before I could forestall him.
uz: Men uni oldini olishdan oldin u uni olib kirgan edi.

en: I protested, but he insisted.
uz: Men bunga qarshilik ko'rsatdim, lekin u istaydi.

en: Nay, sir, you are my guest.
uz: Yo'q, xo'jayinim, siz mening mehmonimsiz.

en: It is late, and my people are not available.
uz: Kech bo'ldi va odamlarim ham yo'q.

en: Let me see to your comfort myself.He insisted on carrying my traps along the passage, and then up a great winding stair, and along another great pas- sage, on whose stone ﬂoor our steps rang heavily.
uz: O'zim tasalli beraman, - dedi u. U o'zimning tuzoqlarimni yo'l bo'ylab ko'tarishga, so'ngra katta burchakli mertaga ko'tarishga va yana bir katta yo'l bo'yi bo'ylab ketishga rag'batlandi.

en: At the end of this he threw open a heavy door, and I rejoiced to see within a well-lit room in which a table was spread for supper, and on whose mighty hearth a great ﬁre of logs, freshly replenished, ﬂamed and ﬂared.
uz: So'ng u og'ir eshikni ochdi va men yaxshi yoritilgan xona ichida kechki ovqat uchun stol ochilganini va kuchli cho'g'ida yangi to'ldirilgan, yonib turgan va o'chib ketgan katta o'tni ko'rishdan xursand bo'ldim.

en: The Count halted, putting down my bags, closed the door, and crossing the room, opened another door, which led into a small octagonal room lit by a single lamp, and seemingly without a window of any sort.
uz: Count to'xtadi, mening sumkalarimni joylashtirdi, eshikni yopdi va xonani kesib o'tib, yana bir eshikni ochdi, bu esa bitta chiroq bilan yoritilgan kichik sakkizburchak xonaga olib keldi va ko'rinishicha hech qanday deraza yo'q edi.

en: Passing through this, he opened another door, and motioned me to enter.
uz: U shu yoqqa o'tib, yana bir eshikni ochib, menga kirishga ishora qildi.

en: It was a welcome sight.
uz: Bu yaxshi ko'rinish edi.

en: For here was a great bedroom well lighted and warmed with another log ﬁre, also added to but lately, for the top logs were fresh, which sent a hollow roar up the wide chimney.
uz: Chunki bu yerda yaxshi yoritilgan va yana bir o't o't bilan ishlangan katta yotoqxona bor edi, bu ham qo'shimcha edi, lekin yaqinda, yuqori o'tlar yangi edi, bu keng cho'mirni o'z ichiga oladigan holsiz qichqiriq yubordi.

en: The Count himself left my luggage inside and withdrew, saying, before he closed the door.
uz: Countning o'zi mening bagajimni ichkariga qoldirib, eshikni yopishdan oldin, so'zlab, ketib ketdi.

en: You will need, after your journey, to refresh yourself by making your toilet.
uz: Sayohatdan keyin ham o'zingizning to'shangizni tayyorlab, o'zingizni ta'minlashga to'g'ri keladi.

en: I trust you will ﬁnd all you wish.
uz: Umid qilamanki, siz xohlaganingizni topasiz.

en: When you are ready, come into the other room, where you will ﬁnd your supper prepared. The light and warmth and the Count's courteous welcome seemed to have dissipated all my doubts and fears.
uz: Tayyor bo'lganingizda, boshqa xonaniga kiringlar, u yerda kechki ovqatingiz tayyorlab qo'yilgan bo'ladi. Yorug'lik, iliqlik va Countning xushmuomalalik bilan kutib olishi mening barcha shubhalarim va qo'rquvlarimni yo'q qildi.

en: Having then reached my normal state, I discovered that I was half famished with hunger.
uz: O'shanda normal holatga yetib, o'zim yarim och ekanligimni payqadim.

en: So making a hasty toilet, I went into the other room.
uz: Shunday qilib, shoshilinch choyxona tayyorlab, boshqa xonaniga kirdim.

en: I found supper already laid out.
uz: Men kechki ovqatni allaqachon tayyorlab qo'yganimni topdim.

en: My host, who stood on one side of the great ﬁreplace, leaning against the stonework, made a graceful wave of his hand to the table, and said, I pray you, be seated and sup how you please.
uz: Ulkan cho'g'ning bir tomonida turgan mehmonim toshbo'ylarga tayanayotganda, o'z qo'lini stolga qo'yib, shunday dedi: O'tirib, xohlagancha ovqatlaning.

en: You will I trust, excuse me that I do not join you, but I have dined already, and I do not sup. I handed to him the sealed letter which Mr.
uz: Sizlarga ishonaman, kelmasligim uchun kechirim so'raysiz, lekin men allaqachon ovqatlandim va kechki ovqat yemayman, - deb aytganman.

en: Hawkins had entrusted to me.
uz: Hawkins menga ishonib topshirgan edi.

en: He opened it and read it gravely.
uz: U kitobni ochib, jiddiy o'qib berdi.

en: Then, with a charming smile, he handed it to me to read.
uz: Keyin u yoqimli tabassum bilan o'qib berishni so'radi.

en: One passage of it, at least, gave me a thrill of pleasure.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda uning bir qismida menga zavq-shafqat baxsh etardi.

en: I must regret that an attack of gout, from which malady I am a constant sufferer, forbids absolutely any travelling on my part for some time to come.
uz: Men gʻisht hujumi, men doimiy ravishda azob chekayotgan kasallikdan azob chekayotganim uchun afsuslanaman, chunki bu mening uzoq vaqt davomida sayohat qilishimga toʻsqinlik qiladi.

en: But I am happy to say I can send a sufﬁcient substitute, one in whom I have every possible conﬁdence.
uz: Ammo men yetarlicha o'rnini bosuvchi yuborishim mumkinligini aytishdan mamnunman, unga ishonchim komil.

en: He is a young man, full of energy and tal- ent in his own way, and of a very faithful disposition.
uz: U o'z kuchi va talantiga to'la, o'ziga xos yosh yigit va juda sadoqatli bo'lgan.

en: He is discreet and silent, and has grown into manhood in my service.
uz: U nafsli va xotirjam va mening xizmatim uchun o'sib-ulg'aygan.

en: He shall be ready to at-
uz: U tayyor bo'lishi kerak-

en: tend on you when you will during his stay, and shall take your instructions in all matters. The count himself came forward and took off the cover of a dish, and I fell to at once on an excellent roast chicken.
uz: Siz uning qolish paytida xohlaganingizda sizga g'amxo'rlik qilasiz va barcha ishlarda sizning yo'l-yo'riqlaringizni qabul qilaman. - degan so'zlarni aytdi. - Count o'zi kelib, bir taomning qopqog'ini olib tashladi va men darhol ajoyib to'kilgan tovuqga tushdim.

en: This, with some cheese and a salad and a bottle of old tokay, of which I had two glasses, was my supper.
uz: Bu, bir oz pishloq, salat va eski tokay shisha bilan birga, men ikkita shisha ichganimda, mening kechki ovqatim edi.

en: During the time I was eating it the Count asked me many question as to my journey, and I told him by degrees all I had experienced.
uz: Men uni yeb yurganimda, Count menga sayohatim haqida ko'p savollar berdi va men unga tajribalarimning barchasini bosqichma-bosqich aytib berdim.

en: By this time I had ﬁnished my supper, and by my host's desire had drawn up a chair by the ﬁre and begun to smoke a cigar which he offered me, at the same time excusing himself that he did not smoke.
uz: O'sha paytgacha men kechki ovqatimni tugatgan edim va uy egasining xohishi bilan olov yonib turgan o'rinni o'rnatgan edim va u menga taklif qilgan sigaretni chekishni boshlagan edim, ammo u chekmaganligi uchun uzr so'ragan edi.

en: I had now an oppor- tunity of observing him, and found him of a very marked physiognomy.
uz: Men uni kuzatish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldim va uni juda ko'p ko'rinadigan fiziognomik shaxs deb topdim.

en: His face was a strong, a very strong, aquiline, with high bridge of the thin nose and peculiarly arched nostrils, with lofty domed forehead, and hair growing scantily round the temples but profusely elsewhere.
uz: Uning yuzi kuchli, juda kuchli, akvilin bo'lgan, uchta burun ko'prisi va o'ziga xos bo'g'ishlangan burun g'orlari, baland qumboq bo'lgan oyoq boshi va sochlari ma'bad atrofida kam o'sib, ammo boshqa joylarda ko'p bo'lmagan.

en: His eyebrows were very massive, almost meeting over the nose, and with bushy hair that seemed to curl in its own profusion.
uz: Uning ko'z burchaklari juda katta edi, deyarli burun ustiga to'lib-toshdi va sochlari o'z ko'pligi bilan o'ziga xos bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: The mouth, so far as I could see it un- der the heavy moustache, was ﬁxed and rather cruel-looking, with peculiar- ly sharp white teeth.
uz: Og'iz, men uni og'ir bo'g'izsiz ko'rganimcha, qattiq va shafqatsiz ko'rinishga ega edi va o'ziga xos o'tkir oq tishlarga ega edi.

en: These protruded over the lips, whose remarkable rud- diness showed astonishing vitality in a man of his years.
uz: Bular og'izlar ustiga ko'tarilgan edi, ularning ajoyib qo'polligi o'z yoshidagi odamda hayratlanarli kuchni ko'rsatgan.

en: For the rest, his ears were pale, and at the tops extremely pointed.
uz: Qolganlari uchun uning quloqlari o'tkir, boshlari esa juda o'tkir edi.

en: The chin was broad and strong, and the cheeks ﬁrm though thin.
uz: Qana keng va kuchli edi, ammo yiqilgan bo'lsa-da, yig'inlari qattiq edi.

en: The general effect was one of ex- traordinary pallor.
uz: Umumiy ta'sir esa o'zgacha bo'shliqdan iborat edi.

en: Hitherto I had noticed the backs of his hands as they lay on his knees in the ﬁrelight, and they had seemed rather white and ﬁne.
uz: O'sha paytgacha men uning qo'llarining orqa tomonlarini olov nurida tiz cho'kkanlarida ko'rdim va ular oq va yaxshi ko'rinardi.

en: But seeing them now close to me, I could not but notice that they were rather coarse, broad, with squat ﬁngers.
uz: Ammo ularni yaqin ko'rib, ular juda yirik, keng va qo'pol bo'lganini payqadim.

en: Strange to say, there were hairs in the centre of the palm.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, palma markazida sochlar bor edi.

en: The nails were long and ﬁne, and cut to a sharp point.
uz: Tushlar uzun va chiroyli va keskin kesilgan edi.

en: As the Count leaned over me and his hands touched me, I could not repress a shudder.
uz: Count menga tiklanib, qo'llari menga tegganida, shovqinni yo'q qila olmadim.

en: It may have been that his breath was rank, but a horrible feeling of nausea came over me, which, do what I would, I could not conceal.
uz: Uning nafas olish usuli yomon bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men o'zimni qo'rqinchli his qilgan bo'lsam ham, bu men xohlagan ishni qilsam ham, yashira olmasdim.

en: The Count, evidently noticing it, drew back.
uz: Count buni ko'rib, orqaga chiqdi.

en: And with a grim sort of smile, which showed more than he had yet done his protruberant teeth, sat himself down again on his own side of the ﬁreplace.
uz: O'zining ko'tarilgan tishlarini ko'proq ko'rsatgan ko'ngilsiz tabassum bilan yana o'z tomoniga o'tirdi.

en: We were both silent for a while, and as I looked towards the window I saw the ﬁrst dim streak of the coming dawn.
uz: Ikkalasi ham bir muncha vaqt sukut saqlashdi va men darchaga qarab turganimda, ertangi tongning birinchi ko'rinmas ko'rinishini ko'rdim.

en: There seemed a strange stillness over everything.
uz: Hamma narsa ustida g'ayritabiiy tinchlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: But as I listened, I heard as if from down below in the valley the howling of many wolves.
uz: Lekin tinglayotganimda, vodiydan pastga qarab ko'plab qurtlarning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: The Count's eyes gleamed, and he said.
uz: Countning ko'zlari yorqin bo'lib, u shunday dedi:

en: Listen to them, the children of the night.
uz: Ularni tinglang, kecha bolalari.

en: What music they make! See- ing, I suppose, some expression in my face strange to him, he added,Ah, sir, you dwellers in the city cannot enter into the feelings of the hunter. Then he rose and said.
uz: Ular qanday musiqa yaratishadi! - deb aytdi u. O'zimning yuzimda g'alati ifodani ko'rib, qo'shimcha qilib dedi: Aha, xo'jayinim, siz shahar aholisi ovchining his-tuyg'ularini o'z ichiga ololmayapsizlar. Keyin u o'rnidan turib dedi.

en: But you must be tired.
uz: Ammo siz charchagan bo'lishingiz kerak.

en: Your bedroom is all ready, and tomorrow you shall sleep as late as you will.
uz: Yotoqxonangiz tayyor va ertaga siz xohlagancha uxlaysiz.

en: I have to be away till the afternoon, so sleep well and dream well! With a courteous bow, he opened for me himself the door to the octagonal room, and I entered my bedroom.
uz: Men kechgacha ketishim kerak, shuning uchun yaxshi uxlang va yaxshi orzu qiling! - degan so'z bilan u o'zi menga sakkizburchak xonaning eshigini ochdi va men yotoqxonamga kirdim.

en: I am all in a sea of wonders.
uz: Men o'zimni mo'jizalar dengizida his qilyapman.

en: I think strange things, which I dare not confess to my own soul.
uz: O'zimning ruhimga aytishga jur'at etmagan g'alati narsalarni o'ylayman.

en: God keep me, if only for the sake of those dear to me!
uz: Xudo meni saqlasin, agar faqat men o'zimni yaxshi ko'radiganlar uchun bo'lsa ham!

en: 7 May.—It is again early morning, but I have rested and enjoyed the last twenty-four hours.
uz: 7 may. Yana erta tong, lekin men oxirgi yigirma to'rt soat davomida dam olib, zavqlanib yurdim.

en: I slept till late in the day, and awoke of my own accord.
uz: Kechagacha uxlab, o'zim o'zim uyg'onganman.

en: When I had dressed myself I went into the room where we had supped, and found a cold breakfast laid out, with coffee kept hot by the pot being placed on the hearth.
uz: Kiyim-kechakimni kiyganimdan so'ng, biz ovqatlanayotgan xonaga kirdim va sovuq tushlik tayyorlab qo'yilganini ko'rdim.

en: There was a card on the table, on which was written— I have to be absent for a while.
uz: Soxtaxonada bir karta bor edi, unda Men bir muncha vaqt yo'q bo'lishim kerak.

en: D. I set to and en- joyed a hearty meal.
uz: D.  Men o'zimni tayyorlab, yaxshi ovqatga bag'ishladim.

en: When I had done, I looked for a bell, so that I might let the servants know I had ﬁnished, but I could not ﬁnd one.
uz: Ishni tugatganimdan so'ng, xizmatkorlarga aytishim uchun qo'ng'iroqni qidirdim, lekin topolmadim.

en: There are certain- ly odd deﬁciencies in the house, considering the extraordinary evidences of wealth which are round me.
uz: Men atrofimda bor bo'lgan boyliklarning ajoyib dalillarini inobatga olgan holda, uyda g'alati kamchiliklar bor.

en: The table service is of gold, and so beautifully wrought that it must be of immense value.
uz: O'sha stolning usuli oltin va shu qadar chiroyli tayyorlanganki, u juda qimmatga ega bo'lishi kerak.

en: The curtains and upholstery of the chairs and sofas and the hangings of my bed are of the costliest and most beautiful fabrics, and must have been of fabulous value when they were made, for they are centuries old, though in excellent order.
uz: Kilshalar va sofalarning pardalari va ustunlari va yotoqlarimning ustunlari eng qimmat va eng chiroyli matolardan bo'lib, ular yaratilganida ajoyib qiymatga ega bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki ular asrlar davomida mavjud, ammo mukammal darajada.

en: I saw something like them in Hampton Court, but they were worn and frayed and moth-eaten.
uz: Men Hampton Courtda ularga o'xshash narsalarni ko'rdim, lekin ular kiyingan va qovurilgan va ko'kraklar yeydigan edi.

en: But still in none of the rooms is there a mirror.
uz: Ammo hali ham hech bir xonada ko'zgulik yo'q.

en: There is not even a toilet glass on my table, and I had to get the little shaving glass from my bag before I could either shave or brush my hair.
uz: O'zimning stolimda hatto to'lxona shishalari ham yo'q va sochlarimni qirqish yoki yuvishdan oldin sumkamdan kichkina shaving shishalarini olib tashlashim kerak edi.

en: I have not yet seen a servant anywhere, or heard a sound near the castle except the howling of wolves.
uz: Men hali hech joyda xizmatkorni ko'rmaganman yoki qal'a yaqinida qurtlarning qichqirishidan boshqa ovoz eshitmaganman.

en: Some time after I had ﬁnished my meal, I do not know whether to call it breakfast of dinner, for it was between ﬁve and six o'clock when I had it, I looked about for something to read, for I did not like to go about the castle until I had asked the Count's permission.
uz: Ovqatni tamomlaganimdan keyin bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, uni kechki ovqatning kechki ovqat deb atashim kerakmi yoki yo'qmi, deb bilmayman, chunki uni yediganimda soat beshdan oltigacha bo'lgan edi va men o'qishga bir narsa izlab o'tirardim, chunki men Countning ruxsatini so'ramagimcha qal'a atrofida yurishni yoqtirmadim.

en: There was absolutely noth- ing in the room, book, newspaper, or even writing materials, so I opened another door in the room and found a sort of library.
uz: Xonada hech narsa yo'q edi, kitob, gazeta yoki hatto yozish materiallari yo'q edi, shuning uchun xonada yana bir eshikni ochdim va bir xil kutubxona topdim.

en: The door opposite mine I tried, but found locked.
uz: Men minaning qarshisidagi eshikni sinab ko'rdim, lekin qulflab qo'yilganini ko'rdim.

en: In the library I found, to my great delight, a vast number of English books, whole shelves full of them, and bound volumes of magazines and newspapers.
uz: Kitobxonada men katta quvonchga toʻlib-toshgan koʻplab inglizcha kitoblarni, ular bilan toʻla shelflarni va jurnal va gazetalarning toʻliq hajmlarini topdim.

en: A table in the center was littered with English magazines and newspapers, though none of them were of very recent date.
uz: O'rtadagi stol ingliz tilidagi jurnallar va gazetalar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, ammo ularning hech biri juda yaqindagi emas edi.

en: The books were of the most varied kind, history, geography, politics, political economy, botany, geology, law, all relating to England and English life and customs and manners.
uz: Kitoblar tarixi, geografiyasi, siyosati, siyosiy iqtisodiyoti, botanika, geologiya, huquq kabi turli xil bo'lib, barchasi Angliya va ingliz hayotini, urf-odatlarini va xulq-atvorlarini o'z ichiga olgan.

en: There were even such books of reference as the London Di- rectory, the Red and Blue books, Whitaker's Almanac, the Army and Navy Lists, and it somehow gladdened my heart to see it, the Law List.
uz: Hatto London Di-rectory, Qizil va Kunga kitoblar, Uitakerning Almanaq, Armiya va dengiz dengizlari ro'yxatlari kabi ma'lumotnomalar ham bor edi va uni ko'rish yuragimni quvontirdi, qonun ro'yxati.

en: Whilst I was looking at the books, the door opened, and the Count en- tered.
uz: Men kitoblarga qaraganimda eshik ochildi va Count kirdi.

en: He saluted me in a hearty way, and hoped that I had had a good night's rest.
uz: U meni samimiy salomlab, yaxshi uxlab ketishimga umid qildi.

en: I am glad you found your way in here, for I am sure there is much that will interest you.
uz: Bu yerga kirishingizga quvonaman, chunki sizga qiziqadigan ko'p narsalar borligiga aminman.

en: These companions, and he laid his hand on some of the books, have been good friends to me, and for some years past, ever since I had the idea of going to London, have given me many, many hours of plea- sure.
uz: Bu hamrohlar, - deb qo'lini ko'tardi u ba'zi kitoblarga, men uchun yaxshi do'stlar bo'lib, bir necha yil davomida, men Londonga borishni o'ylagandan beri, menga ko'p soatlik iltijolar qildilar.

en: Through them I have come to know your great England, and to know her is to love her.
uz: Ular orqali men sizning buyuk Angliyaingizni tanib-bildim va uni tanib-bilish - uni sevishdir.

en: I long to go through the crowded streets of your mighty London, to be in the midst of the whirl and rush of humanity, to share its life, its change, its death, and all that makes it what it is.
uz: Men sizning qudratli Londoningizning to'liq ko'chalarida o'tishni, insoniyatning g'alati va g'alati orasida bo'lishni, uning hayoti, o'zgarishi, o'limi va uni bo'lgan narsalarga aylantiradigan hamma narsani baham ko'rishni orzu qilaman.

en: As yet I only know your tongue through books.
uz: Hozircha tilingizni faqat kitoblar orqali bilaman.

en: To you, my friend, I look that I know it to speak. But, Count, I said, You know and speak English thoroughly! He bowed gravely.
uz: Siz uchun, do'stim, men buni gapirishni bilishimga o'xshayman. - Ammo, Count, - dedim men, - Siz ingliz tilini yaxshi bilasiz va yaxshi gapirasiz! - deb u jiddiy sajda qildi.

en: I thank you, my friend, for your all too-ﬂattering estimate, but yet I fear that I am but a little way on the road I would travel.
uz: Sizga rahmat, do'stim, juda maqtanchli bahoingiz uchun, lekin men qo'rqamanki, men sayohat qilishim kerak bo'lgan yo'lning bir oz yo'li bor.

en: True, I know the gram- mar and the words, but yet I know not how to speak them.
uz: To'g'ri, grammatika va so'zlarni bilaman, ammo ularni qanday gapirishni bilmayman.

en: Indeed, I said, You speak excellently. Not so, he answered.
uz: Ha, - dedim men, - sen juda yaxshi gapirasan. - Yo'q, - deb javob berdi u.

en: Well, I know that, did I move and speak in your London, none there are who would not know me for a stranger.
uz: Men buni bilaman, agar men sizning Londonda ko'chib o'tgan bo'lsam va gapirgan bo'lsam, meni begona deb bilmaydigan hech kim yo'q.

en: That is not enough for me.
uz: Bu men uchun yetarli emas.

en: The common people know me, and I am master.
uz: Oddiy odamlar meni tanishadi va men o'zimning ustamman.

en: But a stranger in a strange land, he is no one.
uz: Ammo chet eldagi musofir, u hech kim emas.

en: Men know him not, and to know not is to care not for.
uz: Odamlar uni tanimaydilar, bilmaslik esa g'amxo'rlik qilmaslikni anglatadi.

en: I am content if I am like the rest, so that no man stops if he sees me, or pauses in his speaking if he hears my words, `Ha, ha!
uz: Agar men ham boshqalarga o'xshab bo'lsam, mamnunman, shuning uchun hech kim meni ko'rganida to'xtamaydi yoki mening so'zlarimni eshitganida gapini to'xtatmaydi. `Ha, ha!

en: A stranger!' I have been so long master that I would be master still, or at least that none other should be master of me.
uz: Begona odam! Men shunchalik uzoq vaqtdan beri xo'jayinim bo'lganmanki, hali ham xo'jayinim bo'laman yoki hech bo'lmaganda, boshqa hech kim mening xo'jayinim bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: You come to me not alone as agent of my friend Peter Hawkins, of Exeter,
uz: Siz mening oldimga Exeterlik do'stim Peter Hawkinsning agenti sifatida yolg'iz kelmaysiz.

en: to tell me all about my new estate in London.
uz: Londondagi yangi mulkim haqida menga hamma narsani aytib bering.

en: You shall, I trust, rest here with me a while, so that by our talking I may learn the English intonation.
uz: Umid qilamanki, siz men bilan bir muncha vaqt bu yerda dam olasiz, shunda biz gapirgan so'zlar bilan inglizcha intonatsiyani o'rganishim mumkin.

en: And I would that you tell me when I make error, even of the smallest, in my speaking.
uz: Va men gapirishimda hatto eng kichik xatolar qilganimda, menga xabar berishingizni xohlayman.

en: I am sorry that I had to be away so long today, but you will, I know forgive one who has so many important affairs in hand. Of course I said all I could about being willing, and asked if I might come into that room when I chose.
uz: Bugun shuncha vaqt yo'q bo'lganim uchun afsusdaman, lekin siz shunday qilasiz, men juda ko'p muhim ishlarni o'z qo'limda tutgan odamni kechirimli qilaman. Albatta, men xohish-irodasim borligini aytdim va o'zim xohlaganimda u xonada kelishimni so'radim.

en: He answered, Yes, certainly, and added.
uz: U: Ha, albatta, - deb javob berdi va qo'shimcha qildi.

en: You may go anywhere you wish in the castle, except where the doors are locked, where of course you will not wish to go.
uz: Qalaxonada xohlagan har bir joyga borishingiz mumkin, eshiklar qulflangan joylardan tashqari, albatta, siz xohlamagan joylarga borishingiz mumkin.

en: There is reason that all things are as they are, and did you see with my eyes and know with my knowledge, you would perhaps better understand. I said I was sure of this, and then he went on.
uz: Hamma narsa shunday bo'lishiga sabab bor va agar siz mening ko'zlarim bilan ko'rgan va bilimim bilan bilgan bo'lsangiz, ehtimol yaxshiroq tushunar edingiz. Men bunga amin bo'lganimni aytdim va u davom etdi.

en: We are in Transylvania, and Transylvania is not England.
uz: Biz Transilvaniyada yashayapmiz va Transilvaniya - bu Angliya emas.

en: Our ways are not your ways, and there shall be to you many strange things.
uz: Bizning yo'llarimiz sizning yo'llaringiz emas va siz uchun juda ko'p g'alati narsalar bo'ladi.

en: Nay, from what you have told me of your experiences already, you know something of what strange things there may be. This led to much conversation, and as it was evident that he wanted to talk, if only for talking's sake, I asked him many questions regarding things that had already happened to me or come within my notice.
uz: Yo'q, o'zingizning tajribalaringiz haqida menga aytib bergan narsangizdan, qanday g'alati voqealar sodir bo'lishi mumkinligini bilasan. Bu ko'p suhbatga sabab bo'ldi va u gapirishni xohlaganini, hatto gapirish uchun ham, ko'p savollar berdim.

en: Sometimes he sheered off the subject, or turned the conversation by pretending not to un- derstand, but generally he answered all I asked most frankly.
uz: Ba'zan u mavzuni o'zgartirardi yoki suhbatni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa-da, uni tushunmaganidek ko'rsatardi, lekin odatda men so'ragan barcha savollarga eng ochiqchasiga javob berardi.

en: Then as time went on, and I had got somewhat bolder, I asked him of some of the strange things of the preceding night, as for instance, why the coachman went to the places where he had seen the blue ﬂames.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, men biroz jasoratli bo'lganimda, undan o'tgan kechaning g'alati narsalari haqida so'radim, masalan, nega avtoulovchi ko'k olovlarni ko'rgan joylarga borgan.

en: He then explained to me that it was commonly believed that on a certain night of the year, last night, in fact, when all evil spirits are supposed to have unchecked sway, a blue ﬂame is seen over any place where treasure has been concealed.
uz: Keyin u menga, yilning muayyan kechasida, ya'ni o'tgan kecha, barcha yovuz ruhlar nazorat qilinmagan holda hukmronlik qilganida, xazina yashirilgan har qanday joyda ko'k olov ko'rinishini tushuntirdi.

en: That treasure has been hidden, he went on, in the region through which you came last night, there can be but little doubt.
uz: U davom etdi: O'sha xazina o'tgan kecha o'tgan hududda yashirilgan, shubhasiz.

en: For it was the ground fought over for centuries by the Wallachian, the Saxon, and the Turk.
uz: Chunki bu yer valaklar, saksonlar va turklar tomonidan asrlar davomida kurashilgan yer edi.

en: Why, there is hardly a foot of soil in all this region that has not been enriched by the blood of men, patriots or invaders.
uz: Axir, bu hududda insonlar, vatanparvarlar yoki bosqinchilar qonidan boyitilmagan tuproqning bir foizi ham yo'q.

en: In the old days there were stirring times, when the Austrian and the Hungarian came up in hordes, and the patriots went out to meet them, men and women, the aged and the children too, and waited their coming on the rocks above the passes, that they might sweep destruction on them with their artiﬁcial avalanches.
uz: O'tmishda avstriyalik va ungarliklar qo'shinlar bo'lib kelib, vatanparvarlar, erkaklar va ayollar, keksalar va bolalar ularni kutib olishardi va ularni o'zlarining sun'iy avlovanlari bilan halokatga yo'liqtirishlari uchun, yo'ldan o'tadigan toshlar ustida ularning kelishini kutishardi.

en: When the invader was triumphant he found but little, for whatever there was had been sheltered in the friendly soil. But how, said I, can it have remained so long undiscovered, when there is a sure index to it if men will but take the trouble to look?
uz: Jabrlovchi g'alaba qozonganida, u juda oz narsani topdi, chunki u erda nima bo'lgan bo'lsa, do'stlik tuproqida panoh topgan edi.  Ammo men: Agar insonlar o'zlarining tashvishlarini ko'rish uchun harakat qilsalar, aniq ko'rsatkich mavjud bo'lganda, qanday qilib u shuncha vaqt davomida kashf etilmagan bo'lishi mumkin?

en: The Count smiled, and as his lips ran back over his gums, the long, sharp, ca- nine teeth showed out strangely.
uz: Count tabassum qildi va og'izlari g'izlari ustiga yugurib ketganda, uzun, keskin, taxminan to'qqizta tish g'ayritabiiy tarzda ko'rindi.

en: Because your peasant is at heart a coward and a fool!
uz: Sening dehqoningiz qalbida qo'rqoq va ahmoq ekanligi uchun!

en: Those ﬂames only appear on one night, and on that night no man of this land will, if he can help it, stir without his doors.
uz: O'sha yong'inlar faqat bir kecha paydo bo'ladi va o'sha kecha bu yurtning hech bir a'zosi, agar u yordam bera olsa, eshiklaridan tashqariga chiqmaydi.

en: And, dear sir, even if he did he would not know what to do.
uz: Garchi shunday bo'lsa ham, u nima qilishni bilmasdi.

en: Why, even the peasant that you tell me of who marked the place of the ﬂame would not know where to look in daylight even for his own work.
uz: Hatto siz aytgandek, olovning joyini belgilagan dehqon ham kun yorug'ligida qaerga qarashini bilmas edi, hatto o'z ishi uchun ham.

en: Even you would not, I dare be sworn, be able to ﬁnd these places again? There you are right, I said.
uz: Hatto sen ham bu joylarni yana topolmaysanmi, deb qasam ichaman, - dedim men.

en: I know no more than the dead where even to look for them. Then we drifted into other matters.
uz: Men o'liklardan boshqa hech narsani bilmayman, hatto ularni qayerdan qidirib topishim kerakligini ham bilaman, - deb so'radi.

en: Come, he said at last, tell me of London and of the house which you have procured for me. With an apology for my remissness, I went into my own room to get the papers from my bag.
uz: Kelin, dedi u oxir-oqibat, Londondan va menga sotib olgan uyingizdan xabar bering. Men beparvoligim uchun kechirim so'rab, o'z xonamga borib sumkamdan qog'ozlarni oldim.

en: Whilst I was placing them in or- der I heard a rattling of china and silver in the next room, and as I passed through, noticed that the table had been cleared and the lamp lit, for it was by this time deep into the dark.
uz: Men ularni or-derga joylashtirganimda, yonma-yon xonada pornay va kumushning shov-shuvini eshitdim va o'tganimda, stol tozalab qo'yilganini va chiroq yoqilganini payqadim, chunki o'sha paytga qadar qorong'ilik juda chuqur edi.

en: The lamps were also lit in the study or li- brary, and I found the Count lying on the sofa, reading, of all things in the world, and English Bradshaw's Guide.
uz: Shuningdek, o'quvxonada yoki kutubxonada chiroqlar yoqilgan edi va men Countni kanepada yotganini va dunyodagi barcha narsalarni o'qiganini va ingliz Bradshaw'ning qo'llanmasini topdim.

en: When I came in he cleared the books and papers from the table, and with him I went into plans and deeds and ﬁg- ures of all sorts.
uz: Men kirganimda, u o'sha dasturxondan kitoblar va qog'ozlarni olib tashladi va men u bilan har qanday reja, harakat va fikrni muhokama qildim.

en: He was interested in everything, and asked me a myriad questions about the place and its surroundings.
uz: U hamma narsaga qiziqardi va menga bu joy va atrof-muhit haqida ko'plab savollar berdi.

en: He clearly had studied be- forehand all he could get on the subject of the neighborhood, for he evident- ly at the end knew very much more than I did.
uz: O'sha paytda u mehmonxona mavzusini oldindan o'rganib olgan edi, chunki oxir-oqibat u mendan ko'ra ko'proq narsani bilgan.

en: When I remarked this, he answered.
uz: Men buni ta'kidlaganimda, u javob berdi.

en: Well, but, my friend, is it not needful that I should?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, do'stim, men buni qilishim kerak emasmi?

en: When I go there I shall be all alone, and my friend Harker Jonathan, nay, pardon me.
uz: Men u yerga borganimda, yolg'iz bo'laman va do'stim Harker Jonatan meni kechiring.

en: I fall into my country's habit of putting your patronymic ﬁrst, my friend Jonathan Harker will not be by my side to correct and aid me.
uz: Men o'z mamlakatimning odatiga aylanib, o'zingizning patronimingizni birinchi o'ringa qo'yaman, do'stim Jonatan Xarker meni tuzatish va yordam berish uchun yonimda bo'lmaydi.

en: He will be in Exeter, miles away, probably working at papers of the law with my other friend, Pe- ter Hawkins.
uz: U kilometrlar uzoqda joylashgan Ekzeterde bo'lib, ehtimol mening boshqa do'stim Piter Xokins bilan qonun hujjatlarini ishlab chiqmoqda.

en: So! We went thoroughly into the business of the purchase of the estate at Pur- ﬂeet.
uz: Shunday ekan! - deb, Pur-flotdagi mulkni sotib olish ishini puxta boshladik.

en: When I had told him the facts and got his signature to the necessary
uz: Men unga faktlarni aytib, zarur bo'lgan hujjatlarni imzolaganimdan so'ng

en: papers, and had written a letter with them ready to post to Mr.
uz: qog'ozlar, ular bilan Mr.ga jo'natish uchun tayyor bo'lgan xat yozgan edi.

en: Hawkins, he began to ask me how I had come across so suitable a place.
uz: Xokins menga qanday qilib bunday qulay joyga uchrashganimni so'rashni boshladi.

en: I read to him the notes which I had made at the time, and which I inscribe here.
uz: Men unga o'sha paytda yozib qo'ygan yozuvlarimni o'qib berdim va ularni shu yerda yozib qo'yaman.

en: At Purﬂeet, on a by-road, I came across just such a place as seemed to be required, and where was displayed a dilapidated notice that the place was for sale.
uz: Purfleetda, yon yo'lda, men kerak bo'lgan joyga duch keldim va u erda joy sotuv uchun ekanligi haqidagi buzilgan xabarnoma ko'rsatilgan edi.

en: It was surrounded by a high wall, of ancient structure, built of heavy stones, and has not been repaired for a large number of years.
uz: Bu shahar baland devor bilan o'ralgan, qadimgi qurilmadan, og'ir toshlardan qurilgan va ko'p yillar davomida ta'mirlanmagan.

en: The closed gates are of heavy old oak and iron, all eaten with rust.
uz: Yopiq darvozalar og'ir eski o'q va temirdan yasalgan bo'lib, ularning barchasi ro'za bilan yemagan.

en: The estate is called Carfax, no doubt a corruption of the old Quatre Face, as the house is four sided, agreeing with the cardinal points of the compass.
uz: Bu uy Carfax deb nomlanadi, bu esa eski Quatre Face-ning buzilishidir, chunki uy to'rt tomonli bo'lib, kompasning asosiy nuqtalariga mos keladi.

en: It contains in all some twenty acres, quite surrounded by the solid stone wall above mentioned.
uz: Bu yerning barchasi taxminan yigirma hektarlik bo'lib, yuqorida aytib o'tilgan qattiq tosh devorlari bilan o'ralgan.

en: There are many trees on it, which make it in places gloomy, and there is a deep, dark-looking pond or small lake, evi- dently fed by some springs, as the water is clear and ﬂows away in a fair- sized stream.
uz: Uning ustida ko'plab daraxtlar bor, bu esa qorong'i joylarda joylashadi va chuqur, qorong'i ko'rinishdagi hovuz yoki kichik ko'l bor, suv aniq bo'lib, oqimsiz oqimda oqib ketgani sababli, uni ba'zi buloqlar oziqlantiradi.

en: The house is very large and of all periods back, I should say, to mediaeval times, for one part is of stone immensely thick, with only a few windows high up and heavily barred with iron.
uz: Uy juda katta va barcha davrlardan, men aytishim kerak, o'rta asrlarga, chunki bir qismi nihoyatda qalin toshdan, faqat bir necha derazalari yuqoriga va temir bilan katta barvarlangan.

en: It looks like part of a keep, and is close to an old chapel or church.
uz: Bu qal'onning bir qismiga o'xshaydi va eski chapel yoki cherkovga yaqin.

en: I could not enter it, as I had not the key of the door leading to it from the house, but I have taken with my Kodak views of it from various points.
uz: Men uyiga kirolmadim, chunki uyimdan uyiga olib boradigan eshikning kalitim yo'q edi, lekin Kodakning ko'rinishi bilan uni turli nuqtai nazarlardan ko'rdim.

en: The house had been added to, but in a very straggling way, and I can only guess at the amount of ground it covers, which must be very great.
uz: Uyning o'zi qo'shimcha qilib qo'yilgan edi, lekin juda ko'p o'zgarishlar sodir bo'ldi va men faqat uning katta maydoni haqida taxmin qila olaman, bu juda katta bo'lishi kerak.

en: There are but few houses close at hand, one being a very large house only recently added to and formed into a pri- vate lunatic asylum.
uz: Bu yerda juda oz uylar mavjud, ulardan biri esa yaqinda qo'shilgan juda katta uy bo'lib, xususiy aqldan ozganlar uyasiga aylandi.

en: It is not, however, visible from the grounds. When I had ﬁnished, he said, I am glad that it is old and big.
uz: Biroq, u yerdan ko'rinmaydi. Men uni tugatganimda, u: U eski va katta ekanidan xursandman.

en: I myself am of an old family, and to live in a new house would kill me.
uz: O'zim ham eski oiladanman va yangi uyda yashash meni o'ldiradi.

en: A house can- not be made habitable in a day, and after all, how few days go to make up a century.
uz: Uy bir kunda yashash uchun qulay bo'lishi mumkin emas va asrni tashkil etish uchun bir necha kun ketadi.

en: I rejoice also that there is a chapel of old times.
uz: Shuningdek, qadimgi davrdagi chapel borligidan xursandman.

en: We Transylvanian nobles love not to think that our bones may lie amongst the common dead.
uz: Biz, Transilvaniya azizlari, bizning suyaklarimiz oddiy o'liklar orasida bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'ylamaslikni yaxshi ko'ramiz.

en: I seek not gaiety nor mirth, not the bright voluptuousness of much sunshine and sparkling waters which please the young and gay.
uz: Men ne quvonch, ne quvonch, ne yosh va geylarni mamnun qiladigan ko'p quyosh va parcha-parcha suvlarning chiroyli begonaligini izlamayman.

en: I am no longer young, and my heart, through weary years of mourning over the dead, is at- tuned to mirth.
uz: Men endi yosh emasman va o'lganlar uchun yig'lab o'tirgan yillar davomida yuragim quvonchga to'lib-toshgan.

en: Moreover, the walls of my castle are broken.
uz: Bundan tashqari, qal'amning devorlari buzilgan.

en: The shadows are many, and the wind breathes cold through the broken battlements and casements.
uz: Soyalar ko'p, shamol esa buzilgan qo'rqinchlar va kasmentlar orqali sovuq nafas oladi.

en: I love the shade and the shadow, and would be alone with my thoughts when I may. Somehow his words and his look did not seem to ac-
uz: Men soya va soyani yaxshi ko'raman va imkon bo'lganda o'zimni o'zim bilan o'ylayman.

en: cord, or else it was that his cast of face made his smile look malignant and saturnine.
uz: Yo'q, balki uning yuzi tabassumini yovuz va Saturnin ko'rinishiga sabab bo'lgan.

en: Presently, with an excuse, he left me, asking me to pull my papers togeth- er.
uz: Hozirda u uzr so'rab meni qoldirib, qog'ozlarimni yig'ib olishimni so'rab ketdi.

en: He was some little time away, and I began to look at some of the books around me.
uz: U biroz vaqt yo'q edi va men atrofimda joylashgan ba'zi kitoblarga qaray boshladim.

en: One was an atlas, which I found opened naturally to England, as if that map had been much used.
uz: Birinchisi esa atlas edi, men uni tabiiy ravishda Angliyaga ochganimni ko'rdim, xuddi o'sha xaritadan ko'p foydalanilgan bo'lgandek.

en: On looking at it I found in certain places little rings marked, and on examining these I noticed that one was near Lon- don on the east side, manifestly where his new estate was situated.
uz: Uni ko'rib chiqib, ba'zi joylarda belgilab qo'yilgan kichik do'zaqlar topdim va ularni tekshirganimda, ulardan biri Lon-donning sharqiy tomoniga yaqin joylashganini payqadim.

en: The oth- er two were Exeter, and Whitby on the Yorkshire coast.
uz: Ikkalasi esa Ekser va Yorkshir sohilidagi Uitbi edi.

en: It was the better part of an hour when the Count returned.
uz: Count qaytib kelganida bir soatning eng yaxshi qismi bo'ldi.

en: Still at your books?
uz: O'zingizning kitoblaringizda hali ham?

en: But you must not work always.
uz: Ammo siz har doim ham ishlamasligingiz kerak.

en: I am in- formed that your supper is ready. He took my arm, and we went into the next room, where I found an excellent supper ready on the table.
uz: Men sizning kechki ovqatingiz tayyor ekanligiga ishonch hosil qildim. U mening qo'limni olib, yonma-yon xonadonga kirdik va men stol ustida ajoyib ovqat tayyor topdim.

en: The Count again excused himself, as he had dined out on his being away from home.
uz: Count yana kechki ovqatni kechki ovqatda o'tkazgani uchun uzr so'radi.

en: But he sat as on the previous night, and chatted whilst I ate.
uz: Ammo u o'tgan kechaga o'xshab o'tirib, men ovqatlanayotganimda suhbatlashdi.

en: After supper I smoked, as on the last evening, and the Count stayed with me, chatting and asking questions on every conceivable subject, hour after hour.
uz: Ovqatdan so'ng, men o'tgan kecha kabi chekardim va Count men bilan suhbatlashdi va soatlab har qanday mavzuda savollar berdi.

en: I felt that it was getting very late indeed, but I did not say anything, for I felt under obligation to meet my host's wishes in every way.
uz: Haqiqatan ham juda kech bo'layotganini his qildim, lekin hech narsa aytmadim, chunki o'zimni mehmonimning istaklarini har jihatdan bajarishga majbur his qildim.

en: I was not sleepy, as the long sleep yesterday had fortiﬁed me, but I could not help experiencing that chill which comes over one at the coming of the dawn, which is like, in its way, the turn of the tide.
uz: Men uxlamagan edim, chunki kechagi uzoq uyqu meni mustahkamlagan edi, lekin tong boshi bilan boshimizga tushadigan sovuqni his qilishdan bosh tortolmadim, bu esa o'z yo'lida to'lqinning o'zgarishiga o'xshaydi.

en: They say that people who are near death die gener- ally at the change to dawn or at the turn of the tide.
uz: Ular o'limga yaqin bo'lgan odamlar, odatda, tong boshi yoki to'lqin o'zgarganda o'lishadi, deydilar.

en: Anyone who has when tired, and tied as it were to his post, experienced this change in the at- mosphere can well believe it.
uz: Charchagan va o'z vazifasini bajarishga bog'liq bo'lgan har bir kishi atmosferadagi bu o'zgarishni boshdan kechirgan bo'lsa, unga ishonishi mumkin.

en: All at once we heard the crow of the cock coming up with preternatural shrillness through the clear morning air.
uz: To'satdan ertalabgi toza havo orqali g'alati shrillness bilan chivining qichqiriqini eshitdik.

en: Count Dracula, jumping to his feet, said, Why there is the morning again!
uz: Count Dracula oyoqlaridan turib: Nima uchun yana tong bor?

en: How remiss I am to let you stay up so long.
uz: Sizni shuncha vaqt uxlab qolishingizga qanday beparvo bo'ldim.

en: You must make your conversation regarding my dear new country of England less interesting, so that I may not forget how time ﬂies by us, and with a courtly bow, he quickly left me.
uz: Siz mening engilandiyalik yangi mamlakatim haqidagi suhbatingizni kamroq qiziqarli qilishingiz kerak, shunda vaqt o'tib ketayotganini unutmayman, - dedi va u meni tezda tashlab ketdi.

en: I went into my room and drew the curtains, but there was little to notice.
uz: O'zimning xonamga kirib, pardalarni chizdim, lekin ko'rish uchun hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: My window opened into the courtyard, all I could see was the warm grey of quickening sky.
uz: Oynam hovli tomon ochildi va men faqat samoviy kuchning issiq sariq rangini ko'rdim.

en: So I pulled the curtains again, and have written of this day.
uz: Shunday qilib, men yana pardalarni ko'tarib, bu kun haqida yozganman.

en: 8 May.—I began to fear as I wrote in this book that I was getting too dif- fuse.
uz: 8 may.Men bu kitobda yozganimda, men o'zimni haddan tashqari qat'iy his qilyapman deb qo'rqishga tushdim.

en: But now I am glad that I went into detail from the ﬁrst, for there is something so strange about this place and all in it that I cannot but feel un-
uz: Ammo endi men birinchi bo'lib batafsillik bilan o'tganimdan xursandman, chunki bu joy va udagi hamma narsa o'ta g'alati bo'lganligi uchun men o'zimni o'ylamayman.

en: I wish I were safe out of it, or that I had never come.
uz: O'zimni xavfsiz his qilgan bo'lardim yoki hech qachon kelmagan bo'lardim.

en: It may be that this strange night existence is telling on me, but would that that were all!
uz: Ehtimol, bu g'alati kechki mavjudot menga ta'sir qilyapti, lekin bu hammasi bo'lsa kerak!

en: If there were any one to talk to I could bear it, but there is no one.
uz: Agar biror kishi bilan gaplashish kerak bo'lganida, men uni ko'tarar edim, lekin u yerda hech kim yo'q.

en: I have only the Count to speak with, and he— I fear I am myself the only living soul within the place.
uz: Men faqat Count bilan gaplashishim kerak va u bilan qo'rqamanki, men o'zim o'sha joydagi yagona tirik ruhman.

en: Let me be prosaiac so far as facts can be.
uz: Keling, faktlar mumkin bo'lgancha, meni ko'nglimdan kechirib ko'raylik.

en: It will help me to bear up, and imagination must not run riot with me.
uz: Bu menga chidamli bo'lishga yordam beradi va tasavvurim men bilan to'xtamasligi kerak.

en: If it does I am lost.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, men yo'qolgan bo'laman.

en: Let me say at once how I stand, or seem to.
uz: Keling, o'zimni qanday tutganimni yoki o'zimni qanday ko'rsatayotganimni aytaman.

en: I only slept a few hours when I went to bed, and feeling that I could not sleep any more, got up.
uz: Yotganimda faqat bir necha soat uxladim va yana uxlay olmasligimni his etib, turdim.

en: I had hung my shaving glass by the window, and was just beginning to shave.
uz: O'zimning shaving shkafimni derazaga osib qo'ydim va hozir shavingni boshlagan edim.

en: Suddenly I felt a hand on my shoulder, and heard the Count's voice saying to me, Good morning. I started, for it amazed me that I had not seen him, since the reﬂection of the glass covered the whole room behind me.
uz: Toʻsatdan omonimga qoʻl tikilganini his qildim va Countning ovozini menga: Xayrli kunlar! - deb soʻzlashini eshitdim. Men boshladim, chunki uni koʻrmaganimdan hayron qoldim, chunki shisha oʻz aksini koʻrsatdi.

en: In starting I had cut myself slightly, but did not notice it at the moment.
uz: Boshlanishda o'zimni biroz kesib qo'ydim, lekin hozircha buni sezmaganman.

en: Having answered the Count's salutation, I turned to the glass again to see how I had been mistaken.
uz: Countning salomlashiga javob berib, men qanday xatoga yo'l qo'yganimni ko'rish uchun yana shishaga qaradim.

en: This time there could be no error, for the man was close to me, and I could see him over my shoulder.
uz: Bu safar hech qanday xato bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki u odam menga yaqin edi va men uni yelkamdan ko'rardim.

en: But there was no reﬂection of him in the mirror!
uz: Ammo ko'rinishda uning aks ettirilishi yo'q edi!

en: The whole room behind me was displayed, but there was no sign of a man in it, except myself.
uz: Ortimdagi butun xona ko'rinardi, lekin o'zimdan boshqa hech qanday odamning izlari yo'q edi.

en: This was startling, and coming on the top of so many strange things, was beginning to increase that vague feeling of uneasiness which I always have when the Count is near.
uz: Bu juda dahshatli edi va ko'pgina g'alati narsalar ustida bo'lib, Count yaqinida bo'lganimda har doim his qilgan noqulay hissiyotimni kuchaytirishni boshladi.

en: But at the instant I saw the the cut had bled a little, and the blood was trickling over my chin.
uz: Ammo o'rning biroz qon ketayotganini ko'rgach, qon mening qani ustidan oqib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I laid down the razor, turning as I did so half round to look for some sticking plaster.
uz: O'g'limni tashlab qo'ydim va yarim atrofga aylanib, biroz yopishqoq gipsni izladim.

en: When the Count saw my face, his eyes blazed with a sort of demoniac fury, and he suddenly made a grab at my throat.
uz: Count mening yuzimni ko'rganida, uning ko'zlari bir xil jinlik g'azabga to'lib-toshdi va u to'satdan mening bo'yniga urdi.

en: I drew away and his hand touched the string of beads which held the cruciﬁx.
uz: Men orqaga chiqdim va uning qo'li xochni ushlab turgan marvaridlar to'pasiga qo'shildi.

en: It made an instant change in him, for the fury passed so quickly that I could hardly believe that it was ever there.
uz: Bu uning o'z-o'zidan o'zgarib ketdi, chunki g'azab shunchalik tez o'tdiki, u hech qachon u erda bo'lganligiga ishonib bo'lmaydi.

en: Take care, he said, take care how you cut yourself.
uz: U shunday dedi: O'zingizni qanday kesayotganingizga e'tiborli bo'ling.

en: It is more danger- ous that you think in this country. Then seizing the shaving glass, he went on, And this is the wretched thing that has done the mischief.
uz: Bu mamlakatda siz o'ylayotganingiz yanada xavfliroq. Keyin u sochni qirqtiruvchi shishaga qo'l urib, davom etdi: Va bu yomonlik qilgan qashshoq narsa.

en: It is a foul bauble of man's vanity.
uz: Bu odamning behudaligi uchun yomon gap.

en: Away with it! And opening the window with one wrench of his terrible hand, he ﬂung out the glass, which was shattered into a thousand pieces on the stones of the courtyard far below.
uz: U dahshatli qo'li bilan oynani ochib, shishani tashladi va shisha mingga tarqaldi, u allaqachon pastdagi hovli toshlarida parchalanib ketdi.

en: Then he with- drew without a word.
uz: So'ngra u bir so'z aytmasdan ketib ketdi.

en: It is very annoying, for I do not see how I am to shave, unless in my watch-case or the bottom of the shaving pot, which is fortunately of metal.
uz: Bu juda g'alati, chunki men qanday shavqat qilishni bilmayman, faqat soatxonamda yoki metaldan bo'lgan shavqat idishining pastki qismida.

en: When I went into the dining room, breakfast was prepared, but I could not ﬁnd the Count anywhere.
uz: Ovqatxonaga kirganimda, ertalabki ovqat tayyorlangan edi, lekin Countni qayerda ham topolmadim.

en: So I breakfasted alone.
uz: Shunday qilib, men yolg'iz ovqatlanardim.

en: It is strange that as yet I have not seen the Count eat or drink.
uz: O'zgacha bo'lsa-da, men hidoyatchilarni hali ovqatlanayotgan yoki ichayotganini ko'rmaganman.

en: He must be a very peculiar man!
uz: U juda g'alati odam bo'lishi kerak!

en: Af- ter breakfast I did a little exploring in the castle.
uz: Ovqatlanishdan so'ng, men qal'ada biroz sayohat qildim.

en: I went out on the stairs, and found a room looking towards the South.
uz: Men daraxtga chiqdim va janubiy tomonga qarab turgan xonani topdim.

en: The view was magniﬁcent, and from where I stood there was every op- portunity of seeing it.
uz: Ko'rinish chiroyli edi va men turgan joyimdan uni ko'rish uchun barcha imkoniyatlar bor edi.

en: The castle is on the very edge of a terriﬁc precipice.
uz: Shahar ajoyib vodiyning chegaralarida joylashgan.

en: A stone falling from the window would fall a thousand feet without touch- ing anything!
uz: Do'stodan tushadigan tosh hech narsaga tegmasdan ming futga tushadi!

en: As far as the eye can reach is a sea of green tree tops, with occasionally a deep rift where there is a chasm.
uz: Ko'z yetib boradigan joyda yashil daraxtlar to'plari dengizidir, vaqti-vaqti bilan chuqur bo'g'rilik bo'lib, chuqurlik mavjud.

en: Here and there are silver threads where the rivers wind in deep gorges through the forests.
uz: Bu yerda va o'rmonlar orqali daryolar chuqur goronalar orqali o'tib ketadigan kumush iplar bor.

en: But I am not in heart to describe beauty, for when I had seen the view I explored further.
uz: Ammo go'zallikni tasvirlash uchun qalbimda hech narsa yo'q, chunki ko'rishni ko'rganimda, yanada ko'proq izlanish o'tkazdim.

en: Doors, doors, doors everywere, and all locked and bolted.
uz: Eshiklar, eshiklar, eshiklar har bir joyda, hamma narsa qulflab qo'yilgan va qulflab qo'yilgan.

en: In no place save from the windows in the castle walls is there an available exit.
uz: Qala devorlaridagi derazalardan tashqari hech qanday joyda chiqishga yo'l yo'q.

en: The castle is a veritable prison, and I am a prisoner!
uz: Shahar haqiqiy qamoqxona, men esa mahbusman!

en: CHAPTER 3 JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL CONTINUED When I found that I was a prisoner a sort of wild feeling came over me.
uz: 3 - bob Jonathan Harkerning kunlik hikoyasi davom etadi Men mahbus bo'lganimni bilib olgach, bir xil yovvoyi his-tuyg'u boshimga tushdi.

en: I rushed up and down the stairs, trying every door and peering out of every window I could ﬁnd, but after a little the conviction of my helplessness overpowered all other feelings.
uz: Men har bir eshikni sinab, topgan har bir deraza orqali ko'z o'ngimga qarab turardim, lekin birozdan keyin o'zimning kuchsizligim boshqa his-tuyg'ularimni yengib ketdi.

en: When I look back after a few hours I think I must have been mad for the time, for I behaved much as a rat does in a trap.
uz: Bir necha soat o'tgach, orqaga nazar solganimda, o'sha vaqt uchun g'azablangan bo'laman, chunki men tuzoqda bo'lgan tovuq kabi harakat qildim.

en: When, however, the conviction had come to me that I was helpless I sat down quietly, as quietly as I have ever done anything in my life, and began to think over what was best to be done.
uz: Biroq, o'zimning kuchsiz ekanligimga amin bo'lganimda, hayotimda hech qachon qilganimdek, o'tirib, nima qilish kerakligini o'ylay boshladim.

en: I am thinking still, and as yet have come to no deﬁnite conclusion.
uz: Men hali ham o'ylayotgandim va hozircha aniq xulosaga kelmadim.

en: Of one thing only am I certain.
uz: Faqat bitta narsaga aminman.

en: That it is no use making my ideas known to the Count.
uz: Mening g'oyalarimni Countga ma'lum qilishning foydasi yo'q.

en: He knows well that I am impris- oned, and as he has done it himself, and has doubtless his own motives for it, he would only deceive me if I trusted him fully with the facts.
uz: U mening qamoqda bo'lganimni yaxshi biladi va o'zi buni o'zi qilganligi sababli va shubhasizki, buning uchun o'z sabablari borligi sababli, agar men unga to'liq ishonib gapirsam, meni yolg'onchiga chiqaradi.

en: So far as I can see, my only plan will be to keep my knowledge and my fears to my- self, and my eyes open.
uz: Ko'rib turganimcha, mening yagona rejam bilim va qo'rquvlarimni o'zimga va ko'zimni ochiq saqlash bo'ladi.

en: I am, I know, either being deceived, like a baby, by my own fears, or else I am in desperate straits, and if the latter be so, I need, and shall need, all my brains to get through.
uz: Bilamanki, men o'z qo'rquvlarim bilan chaqaloq kabi aldanib ketyapman, yo bo'lmasa umidsizlikka tushibman va agar shunday bo'lsa, men o'zimning butun miyamga muhtojman va kerak bo'ladi.

en: I had hardly come to this conclusion when I heard the great door below shut, and knew that the Count had returned.
uz: Men katta eshikni yopiq bo'lganimda va Count qaytib kelganini bilganimda, bu xulosaga yetib yetmagan edim.

en: He did not come at once into the library, so I went cautiously to my own room and found him making the bed.
uz: U darhol kutubxonaga kirmadi, shuning uchun men ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'z xonamga bordim va uni to'shagini tayyorlayotganini ko'rdim.

en: This was odd, but only conﬁrmed what I had all along thought, that there are no servants in the house.
uz: Bu g'alati edi, lekin men butun vaqt davomida o'ylagandek, uyda xizmatkorlar yo'qligini tasdiqladi.

en: When later I saw him through the chink of the hinges of the door laying the table in the dining room, I was assured of it.
uz: Keyinroq uni oshxonada stolni o'rnatayotgan eshikning shkaflari orqali ko'rganimda, shubhalanmadim.

en: For if he does himself all these menial ofﬁces, surely it is proof that there is no one else in the castle, it must have been the Count himself who was the driver of the coach that brought me here.
uz: Agar u o'zi bu barcha kamchiliklarni bajarsa, bu, albatta, qal'ada boshqa hech kim yo'qligini isbotlaydi, chunki meni bu yerga olib kelgan vagon haydovchisi Count bo'lgan.

en: This is a terrible thought,
uz: Bu dahshatli fikr,

en: for if so, what does it mean that he could control the wolves, as he did, by only holding up his hand for silence?
