uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, unda u o'zi qilganidek, faqatgina o'z qo'lini ko'tarib, to'xtatish uchun bo'rilarni nazorat qila olishi nimani anglatadi?

en: How was it that all the people at Bistritz and on the coach had some terrible fear for me?
uz: Qanday qilib Bistritz va avtobusdagi barcha odamlar men uchun qo'rqishgan?

en: What meant the giving of the cruciﬁx, of the garlic, of the wild rose, of the mountain ash?
uz: Xoch, sarimush, yovvoyi gul va tog' ashini berish nimani anglatadi?

en: Bless that good, good woman who hung the cruciﬁx round my neck!
uz: Mening bo'yniga xoch bog'lagan yaxshi, yaxshi ayolga duo qil!

en: For it is a comfort and a strength to me whenever I touch it.
uz: Chunki u menga har safar uni qo'llab-quvvatlaganimda tasalli va kuch beradi.

en: It is odd that a thing which I have been taught to regard with disfavour and as idolatrous should in a time of loneliness and trouble be of help.
uz: O'zgacha bo'lsa-da, yolg'izlik va qayg'u davrida menga nafrat va butparastlik bilan qarashga o'rgatilgan narsa foydali bo'lishi ajablanarli emas.

en: Is it that there is something in the essence of the thing itself, or that it is a medium, a tangible help, in con- veying memories of sympathy and comfort?
uz: Bu narsa o'z mohiyatida biror narsa borligi yoki u hamdardlik va tasalli xotiralarini o'tkazishda vosita, aniq yordamchi bo'lishi kerakmi?

en: Some time, if it may be, I must examine this matter and try to make up my mind about it.
uz: Bir kuni, agar bo'lsa, bu masalaga nazar tashlab, qaror chiqarishga harakat qilishim kerak.

en: In the meantime I must ﬁnd out all I can about Count Dracula, as it may help me to under- stand.
uz: Shu paytgacha men Count Dracula haqida iloji boricha ko'proq bilib olishim kerak, chunki bu menga yordam berishi mumkin.

en: Tonight he may talk of himself, if I turn the conversation that way.
uz: Agar men suhbatni shu yo'l bilan o'zgartirsam, bugun kechqurun u o'zi haqida gapirish mumkin.

en: I must be very careful, however, not to awake his suspicion.
uz: Biroq, uning shubhalarini uyg'otmaslik uchun juda ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak.

en: Midnight.—I have had a long talk with the Count.
uz: Yoruq.Men Count bilan uzoq suhbatlashdim.

en: I asked him a few questions on Transylvania history, and he warmed up to the subject wonder- fully.
uz: Men unga Transilvaniya tarixi haqida bir necha savollar berdim va u mavzuga juda qiziqib ketdi.

en: In his speaking of things and people, and especially of battles, he spoke as if he had been present at them all.
uz: U narsalar va odamlar haqida, ayniqsa janglar haqida gapirganda, xuddi ularning barchasida bo'lgani kabi gapirgan.

en: This he afterwards explained by saying that to a Boyar the pride of his house and name is his own pride, that their glory is his glory, that their fate is his fate.
uz: Keyinchalik u buni Boyar uchun o'z uyining va ismining mag'rurligi o'z mag'rurligi, ularning shon-shuhratlari uning shon-shuhratlari, ularning taqdirlari uning taqdirlari ekanligini tushuntirib berdi.

en: Whenever he spoke of his house he always said we, and spoke almost in the plural, like a king speaking.
uz: U uyidan gapirganida biz deb aytgan va deyarli ko'pchilikda gapirgan, xuddi shoh gapirganidek.

en: I wish I could put down all he said exactly as he said it, for to me it was most fascinating.
uz: U aytganlarning barchasini aynan u aytganidek yozib qo'yishim kerak edi, chunki men uchun bu juda hayajonli edi.

en: It seemed to have in it a whole history of the coun- try.
uz: U yerda mamlakatning butun tarixi yozilgan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: He grew excited as he spoke, and walked about the room pulling his great white moustache and grasping anything on which he laid his hands as though he would crush it by main strength.
uz: U gapirganida hayajonlanib, katta oq mustasini tortib, qo'llarini qo'ygan har bir narsaga qo'l urib, uni asosiy kuch bilan ezib tashlagandek xona atrofida yurdi.

en: One thing he said which I shall put down as nearly as I can, for it tells in its way the story of his race.
uz: U aytgan bitta so'z, men uni imkon qadar yaqinroq yozib qo'yaman, chunki u o'z uslubida uning irqi haqidagi hikoyani aytib beradi.

en: We Szekelys have a right to be proud, for in our veins ﬂows the blood of many brave races who fought as the lion ﬁghts, for lordship.
uz: Biz, Szekelylar faxrlanishimizga haqlimiz, chunki bizning damarlarimizda shoir jang qilganidek jang qilgan ko'plab jasoratli irqlarning qoni oqib bormoqda.

en: Here, in the whirlpool of European races, the Ugric tribe bore down from Iceland the ﬁghting spirit which Thor and Wodin game them, which their Berserkers displayed to such fell intent on the seaboards of Europe, aye, and of Asia and Africa too, till the peoples thought that the werewolves themselves had come.
uz: Bu yerda, Yevropa musobaqalari davrasida, Ugric qabilasi Islandiyadan Thor va Wodin o'ynashgan jang ruhi, ularning Berserkerslari ularga ko'rsatgan jang ruhi, Yevropaning, ha, shuningdek, Osiyo va Afrikadagi dengiz sohillarida tushdi, hatto xalqlar o'zlari ayg'oqchilar kelgan deb o'ylashlariga qadar, Islandiyadan olib keldi.

en: Here, too, when they came, they found the Huns, whose warlike fury had swept the earth like a living ﬂame, till the dying peoples held that in their veins ran the blood of those old witches, who, expelled from Scythia had mated with the devils in the desert.
uz: Bu yerda ham, ular kelganida, hunlarni topdilar, ularning jangovar g'azablari yer yuzini jonli olov kabi o'rab olgan edi, o'tib ketayotgan xalqlar o'zlarining damarlarida eski sehrgarlarning qonlari oqib ketishini ta'kidlab, ular Skitiyadan quvg'in qilinganidan so'ng, sahroda shaytonlar bilan juftlashgan.

en: witch was ever so great as Attila, whose blood is in these veins? He held up his arms.
uz: Bu damarlarda qon bo'lgan Attila kabi buyuk sehrgar bo'lganmi? - deb qo'llarini ko'tarib so'radi u.

en: Is it a wonder that we were a conquering race, that we were proud, that when the Magyar, the Lombard, the Avar, the Bulgar, or the Turk poured his thousands on our frontiers, we drove them back?
uz: Biz g'alaba qozonadigan irq bo'lganimiz, mag'rur bo'lganimiz, agar mag'jarlar, longobardlar, avarlar, bulgarlar yoki turklar o'zlarining minglab qo'shinlarini chegaralarimizga to'kib yuborganlarida, biz ularni qaytarib yuborganimiz ajablanarli emasmi?

en: Is it strange that when Arpad and his legions swept through the Hungarian fa- therland he found us here when he reached the frontier, that the Honfoglalas was completed there?And when the Hungarian ﬂood swept eastward, the Szekelys were claimed as kindred by the victorious Magyars, and to us for centuries was trusted the guarding of the frontier of Turkeyland.
uz: Arpad va uning qo'shinlari Vengriya hududini o'rab olganida, bizni bu yerda topib, chegaraga yetib kelganida, Honfoglalaslar o'sha yerda tugashi ajablanarli emasmi?Vengriyaning to'lovlari sharqqa o'tib ketganda, Szekelylar g'olib mag'yarlar tomonidan qarindoshlari deb e'tirof etildi va asrlar davomida bizga Turkiyaning chegaralarini himoya qilish ishonib topshirildi.

en: Aye, and more than that, endless duty of the frontier guard, for as the Turks say, `wa- ter sleeps, and the enemy is sleepless.' Who more gladly than we throughout the Four Nations received the `bloody sword,' or at its warlike call ﬂocked quicker to the standard of the King?
uz: Ha, bundan ham ko'proq, chegara qo'riqchilarining tugamas vazifasi, chunki turklarning aytishicha, `wa-ter uxlaydi, dushman esa uxlamaydi. 'Bizdan ko'ra to'rt millat bo'ylab kim ko'proq quvonch bilan qilichni qabul qildi,' yoki uning jangovar da'vosiga ko'ra Shohning bayrog'iga tezroq to'plandi?

en: When was redeemed that great shame of my nation, the shame of Cassova, when the ﬂags of the Wallach and the Magyar went down beneath the Crescent?Who was it but one of my own race who as Voivode crossed the Danube and beat the Turk on his own ground?
uz: O'z millatimning, Cassovadagi sharmandaligi, Wallach va Magyar bayroqlari Yarim oy pastga tushganda qachon to'lov qilindi?Voivoda sifatida Donau daryosini kesib o'tgan va o'z yerida turkiyani mag'lub qilgan mening irchimdan boshqa kim edi?

en: This was a Dracula indeed!
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham Dracula edi!

en: Woe was it that his own unworthy brother, when he had fallen, sold his people to the Turk and brought the shame of slavery on them!
uz: O'zining noloyiq ukasi o'tib ketganidan so'ng, o'z xalqini turklarga sotib, ularga qullik sharmandaligini keltirib chiqarganidan naqadar achinarli bo'ldi!

en: Was it not this Dracula, indeed, who inspired that other of his race who in a later age again and again brought his forces over the great river into Turkeyland, who, when he was beaten back, came again, and again, though he had to come alone from the bloody ﬁeld where his troops were being slaughtered, since he knew that he alone could ulti- mately triumph!
uz: O'z irqidagi boshqa bir kishiga ilhom bergan Dracula emasmi, balki keyinchalik o'z qo'shinlarini buyuk daryo bo'ylab Turkiya yurtiga qayta-qayta olib borgan va o'zini mag'lub qilganida yana qaytgan edi, lekin qo'shinlari qatl qilinadigan qonli maydondan yolg'iz kelishi kerak edi, chunki faqat o'zi g'alaba qozonishi mumkinligini bilgan edi!

en: They said that he thought only of himself.
uz: Ular uning faqat o'zi haqida o'ylayotganini aytishdi.

en: What good are peasants without a leader?
uz: Yetakchisiz dehqonlar nimaga ega?

en: Where ends the war without a brain and heart to conduct it?
uz: Urushni o'tkazish uchun ong va yurak bo'lmasa, u qayerda tugadi?

en: Again, when, after the battle of Mohacs, we threw off the Hungarian yoke, we of the Dracula blood were amongst their leaders, for our spirit would not brook that we were not free.
uz: Mohax jangidan so'ng Vengriyaliklarning bo'yinturug'ini tashlaganimizda, Dracula qonlilar ularning yetakchilari orasida bo'lganmiz, chunki biz erkin emasligimizni ko'rish ruhimizga og'ir botmasdi.

en: Ah, young sir, the Szekelys, and the Dracula as their heart's blood, their brains, and their swords, can boast a record that mushroom growths like the Hapsburgs and the Romanoffs can never reach.
uz: Ah, yosh sir, Szekelylar va Drakulalar, ularning qalblari qonlari, miyasi va qilichlari kabi, Hapsburglar va Romanofflar kabi qo'zg'oqchiliklar hech qachon erishmaydigan rekordni saqlab qolishlari mumkin.

en: The warlike days are over.
uz: Urush davri tugagan.

en: Blood is too pre- cious a thing in these days of dishonourable peace, and the glories of the great races are as a tale that is told. It was by this time close on morning, and we went to bed.
uz: Bu kunlarda qon juda qadrli, bu kunlarda tinchlik o'rnatilmaydi va buyuk irqlarning shon-shuhratlari hikoya kabi bo'ladi. Ertalabning shu vaqtlari yaqin edi va biz uxlashga ketdik.

en: (Mem., this diary seems horribly like the beginning of the Arabian Nights, for every- thing has to break off at cockcrow, or like the ghost of Hamlet's father.)
uz: (Mem, bu jurnal Arab kechalarining boshlanishiga juda o'xshaydi, chunki hamma narsa qo'g'irchoqdan chiqib ketishi kerak, yoki Hamletning otasining ruhiga o'xshaydi.)

en: 12 May.—Let me begin with facts, bare, meager facts, veriﬁed by books and ﬁgures, and of which there can be no doubt.
uz: 12 may.Men faktlardan boshlasam bo'ladi, ular kitoblar va raqamlar orqali tasdiqlangan, behuda, kamchiliklarga to'la dalillardir.

en: I must not confuse them with experiences which will have to rest on my own observation, or my memory of them.
uz: Men ularni o'zim kuzatganimdan yoki ular haqidagi xotiralarimdan kelib chiqqan tajribalar bilan chalg'itmaslikka majburman.

en: Last evening when the Count came from his room he be- gan by asking me questions on legal matters and on the doing of certain kinds of business.
uz: O'tgan kuni kechqurun Count o'z xonasidan kelganida, u menga qonuniy masalalar va biznesning ba'zi turlari to'g'risida savollar berib javob berdi.

en: I had spent the day wearily over books, and, simply to keep my mind occupied, went over some of the matters I had been exam- ined in at Lincoln's Inn.
uz: Kunimni kitoblar bilan o'tkazganimdan charchagan edim va, shunchaki ongimni mashg'ul qilish uchun, Lincoln's Inn-da o'qigan bo'lgan ba'zi masalalarni ko'rib chiqdim.

en: There was a certain method in the Count's in- quiries, so I shall try to put them down in sequence.
uz: Countning so'rovlarida ma'lum bir usul bor edi, shuning uchun ularni tartib bilan yozib qo'yishga harakat qilaman.

en: The knowledge may somehow or some time be useful to me.
uz: Bu bilim men uchun qandaydir tarzda yoki bir vaqtning o'zida foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

en: First, he asked if a man in England might have two solicitors or more.
uz: Birinchidan, u Angliyada bir kishi ikki yoki undan ko'proq advokatga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini so'radi.

en: I told him he might have a dozen if he wished, but that it would not be wise to have more than one solicitor engaged in one transaction, as only one could act at a time, and that to change would be certain to militate against his interest.
uz: Men unga agar xohlasa, o'nlab kishini topishi mumkinligini aytdim, lekin bir vaqtning o'zida faqat bittasi harakat qilishi mumkin bo'lgan holda birdan ortiq advokatni bitta bitimda ishtirok etish oqilona bo'lmasligini va o'zgarish uning manfaatlariga zid bo'lishini aytdim.

en: He seemed thoroughly to understand, and went on to ask if there would be any practical difﬁculty in having one man to attend, say, to banking, and another to look after shipping, in case local help were needed in a place far from the home of the banking solicitor.
uz: U juda yaxshi tushunardi va bank advokatining uyidan uzoq joyda mahalliy yordam kerak bo'lgan taqdirda, bir kishining bank ishida, masalan, bank ishida qatnashishi va boshqa kishining dengiz jo'natishida g'alaba qozonishi mumkin bo'lgan biron bir amaliy qiyinchilik bo'ladimi deb so'ragan.

en: I asked to explain more fully, so that I might not by any chance mislead him, so he said, I shall illustrate.
uz: Men uni yo'ldan ozdirmaslik uchun batafsilroq tushuntirishni so'radim, u esa: Men tushuntirib beraman.

en: Your friend and mine, Mr.
uz: Sizning do'stingiz va mening do'stim, Mr.

en: Peter Hawkins, from under the shadow of your beautiful cathedral at Exeter, which is far from London, buys for me through your good self my place at London.
uz: Peter Hawkins, Londondan uzoq bo'lgan Ekseter shahridagi go'zal katedrali soyasidan, sizning yaxshi o'zligingiz orqali Londondagi joyimni sotib oladi.

en: Now here let me say frankly, lest you should think it strange that I have sought the services of one so far off from London instead of some one resident there, that my motive was that no local interest might be served save my wish only, and as one of London residence might, perhaps, have some purpose of himself or friend to serve, I went thus aﬁeld to seek my agent, whose labours should be only to my interest.
uz: Endi men sizlarga ochiqchasiga aytamanki, men Londonda yashaydigan bir kishiga emas, Londonda yashaydigan bir kishiga xizmat ko'rsatishimga g'alati tuyulmasligi uchun, mening niyatim faqat mening xohishimdan boshqa hech qanday mahalliy manfaatlarga xizmat qilish emasligi edi va Londonda yashaydigan kishi, ehtimol, o'ziga yoki do'stimga xizmat qilish uchun biron bir maqsadga ega bo'lishi mumkinligi sababli, men agentimni izlash uchun uzoq joyga bordim, uning ishi faqat mening manfaatim uchun bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Now, suppose I, who have much of affairs, wish to ship goods, say, to Newcastle, or Durham, or Harwich, or Dover, might it not be that it could with more ease be done by consigning to one in these ports? I answered that certainly it would be most easy, but that we solicitors had a system of agency one for the other, so that local work could be done local- ly on instruction from any solicitor, so that the client, simply placing him- self in the hands of one man, could have his wishes carried out by him with- out further trouble.
uz: Ayting-chi, agar men, ko'p ishlar bilan shug'ullanuvchi bo'lganim, Newcastle, Durham, Harwich yoki Doverga tovarlarni jo'natishni xohlasam, ehtimol bu portlardan biriga jo'natish osonroq bo'lishi mumkin emasmi? - deb so'radim, albatta bu osonroq bo'ladi, lekin biz advokatlar bir-birimiz uchun agentlik tizimiga ega edik, shuning uchun mahalliy ish har qanday advokatning ko'rsatmasiga ko'ra mahalliy ravishda amalga oshirilishi mumkin edi, shunda mijoz o'zini bir kishi qo'liga qo'yib, o'z xohish-istaklarini amalga oshirishi mumkin edi.

en: But, said he,I could be at liberty to direct myself.
uz: Ammo, dedi u, men o'zimni yo'naltirish uchun erkin bo'lishim mumkin.

en: Of course,  I replied, and Such is often done by men of business, who do not like the whole of their affairs to be known by any one person. Good! he said, and then went on to ask about the means of making con- signments and the forms to be gone through, and of all sorts of difﬁculties which might arise, but by forethought could be guarded against.
uz: Men: Agar shunday bo'lsa-da, - deb javob berdim va Bunday ishlarni ko'pincha biznesmenlar qiladilar, ular o'z ishlarining barchasini bitta odam bilishini xohlamaydilar. Yaxshi! dedi u, so'ngra belgilar yaratish vositalari va o'tishi kerak bo'lgan shakllar va paydo bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday qiyinchiliklar haqida so'rashdi, ammo oldindan o'ylab ko'rish orqali ulardan qochish mumkin.

en: I explained all these things to him to the best of my ability, and he certainly left me un- der the impression that he would have made a wonderful solicitor, for there was nothing that he did not think of or foresee.
uz: Men bularning barchasini imkon qadar unga tushuntirdim va u menga ajoyib advokat bo'lishini his qilmay qo'ydi, chunki u o'ylab ko'rmagan yoki oldindan ko'rmagan hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: For a man who was never in the country, and who did not evidently do much in the way of business, his knowledge and acumen were wonderful.
uz: Hech qachon qishloqda bo'lmagan va ishbilarmonlik bilan shug'ullanmagan odam uchun uning bilim va aql-idroklari ajoyib edi.

en: When he had satisﬁed himself on these points of which he had spoken, and I had veriﬁed all as well as I could by the books available, he suddenly stood up and said, Have you written since your ﬁrst letter to our friend Mr.
uz: U o'zidan so'ragan ushbu masalalarga qanoatlantirganida va men hamma narsani mavjud kitoblar orqali iloji boricha tekshirganimda, u to'satdan turib: Siz do'stimizga birinchi maktubingizdan beri M.ga yozganmisiz?

en: Peter Hawkins, or to any other? It was with some bitterness in my heart that I answered that I had not, that as yet I had not seen any opportunity of sending letters to anybody.
uz: Peter Xokinsga yoki boshqalarga? - deb javob berdim, ammo hali hech kimga xat yuborish imkoniyatini ko'rmagan edim.

en: Then write now, my young friend, he said, laying a heavy hand on my shoulder, write to our friend and to any other, and say, if it will please you, that you shall stay with me until a month from now. Do you wish me to stay so long? I asked, for my heart grew cold at the thought.
uz: Shunday qilib, endi yoz, yosh do'stim, - dedi u, omonimga og'ir qo'l qo'yib, do'stimizga va boshqalarga yozib, agar sizga yoqsa, bir oydan keyin men bilan qolishni xohlaysiz deb ayt. Men bu qadar vaqt qolishimni xohlaysizmi? - deb so'radim, chunki bu fikr yuragimni sovuq qilib qo'ydi.

en: I desire it much, nay I will take no refusal.
uz: Men uni juda xohlayman, lekin rad etmayman.

en: When your master, employer, what you will, engaged that someone should come on his behalf, it was un- derstood that my needs only were to be consulted.
uz: Xo'jayiningiz, ish beruvchiingiz, xohlaganingiz, xohlaganingiz, kimdir uning nomidan kelishini taklif qilganida, faqat mening ehtiyojlarimga e'tibor qaratish kerakligini tushunmagan.

en: Is it not so? What could I do but bow acceptance?
uz: Xo'sh, shunday emasmi? deb so'rashdan boshqa nima qilishim mumkin edi?

en: Hawkins' interest, not mine, and I had to think of him, not myself, and besides, while Count Drac- ula was speaking, there was that in his eyes and in his bearing which made me remember that I was a prisoner, and that if I wished it I could have no choice.
uz: Mening emas, Xokinsning manfaatini ko'zlab, o'zim emas, u haqida o'ylashim kerak edi. Bundan tashqari, Count Dracula gapirganida, uning ko'zlarida va xulq-atvorida men mahbus ekanimni eslatgan narsa bor edi va agar xohlasam, boshqa yo'l qo'ymayman.

en: The Count saw his victory in my bow, and his mastery in the trouble of my face, for he began at once to use them, but in his own smooth, resist- less way.
uz: Count o'zining g'alabasi mening bo'g'imimda va o'zining ustunligi mening yuzimdagi qiyinchiliklarda ko'rdi, chunki u darhol ulardan foydalanishni boshladi, ammo o'z usulida, moslashuvchan, kamroq qarshilik ko'rsatdi.

en: I pray you, my good young friend, that you will not discourse of things other than business in your letters.
uz: Senga iltijo qilaman, yaxshi yosh do'stim, maktublaringizda biznesdan boshqa narsalar haqida gapirmang.

en: It will doubtless please your friends to know that you are well, and that you look forward to getting home to them.
uz: Shubhasiz, do'stlaringiz siz sog'lom ekanligingizni va ular bilan uyga qaytishni intizorlik bilan kutayotganingizni bilishlarini yaxshi ko'rishadi.

en: Is it not so? As he spoke he handed me three sheets of note paper and three envelopes.
uz: O'zi gapirganida, menga uchta qog'oz qog'oz va uchta omborni berdi.

en: They were all of the thinnest foreign post, and looking at them, then at him, and noticing his quiet smile, with the sharp, canine teeth lying
uz: Ularning barchasi eng chiroyli chet el postidan bo'lgan va ularga, keyin unga qarab, o'zlarining o'ta keskin, itli tishlari bilan o'tirgan tinch tabassumini ko'rishgan.

en: over the red underlip, I understood as well as if he had spoken that I should be more careful what I wrote, for he would be able to read it.
uz: O'sha qizil chiziqdan o'tib, u gapirganidek, men ham yozganimda ehtiyot bo'lishim kerakligini tushunardim, chunki u o'qishi mumkin edi.

en: So I deter- mined to write only formal notes now, but to write fully to Mr.
uz: Shuning uchun men hozirda faqat rasmiy yozuvlarni yozishga qaror qildim, lekin butunlayin Mr.ga yozishga qaror qildim.

en: Hawkins in secret, and also to Mina, for to her I could write shorthand, which would puzzle the Count, if he did see it.
uz: Xokinsni yashirincha va Minani ham, chunki men unga qisqartma yozishim mumkin edi, agar Count uni ko'rsa, bu uni g'alati qiladi.

en: When I had written my two letters I sat quiet, reading a book whilst the Count wrote several notes, referring as he wrote them to some books on his table.
uz: Ikki maktubimni yozganimdan so'ng, men xotirjamlik bilan o'tirib, kitob o'qib o'tirdim, Count esa o'z dasturxonidagi kitoblarga ishora qilib, bir nechta yozuvlarni yozdi.

en: Then he took up my two and placed them with his own, and put by his writing materials, after which, the instant the door had closed behind him, I leaned over and looked at the letters, which were face down on the table.
uz: Keyin u mening ikkovimni olib, o'zidan joylashtirdi va o'z yozish materiallarini qo'ydi, keyin eshik uning orqasidan yopilganda, men yonimga tiklanib, stol ustida yuzma-yuz turgan xatlarga qaradim.

en: I felt no compunction in doing so for under the circumstances I felt that I should protect myself in every way I could.
uz: Men buni qilishda hech qanday qo'rqinch his qilmadim, chunki o'sha sharoitlarda o'zimni qo'limdan kelganicha himoya qilishim kerakligini his qildim.

en: One of the letters was directed to Samuel F.
uz: Xatlardan biri Samuel F.ga yo'naltirilgan edi.

en: 7, The Cres- cent, Whitby, another to Herr Leutner, Varna.
uz: 7, Crescent, Whitby, boshqalari Herr Leutner, Varna.

en: The third was to Coutts & Co., London, and the fourth to Herren Klopstock & Billreuth, bankers, Buda Pesth.
uz: Uchinchisi Coutts & Co., London, to'rtinchisi esa Herren Klopstock & Billreuth, bankchilar, Buda Pesthga berildi.

en: The second and fourth were unsealed.
uz: Ikkinchi va to'rtinchi qismlar muhrlanmagan edi.

en: I was just about to look at them when I saw the door handle move.
uz: Men ularni ko'rmoqchi edim, lekin eshik qo'lqovushi harakatlanayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I sank back in my seat, having just had time to resume my book before the Count, holding still another let- ter in his hand, entered the room.
uz: Men o'tirgan joyimga qaytdim va Count yana bir xatcho'pni qo'lida olib, xonaniga kirishdan oldin kitobimni davom ettirish uchun vaqt topgan edim.

en: He took up the letters on the table and stamped them carefully, and then turning to me, said, I trust you will forgive me, but I have much work to do in private this evening.
uz: U stoldagi xatlarni olib, ularni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bosdi va so'ng menga qarab: Meni kechirimli bo'lishingizga umid qilaman, lekin bu kechqurun shaxsiy ishim ko'p.

en: You will, I hope, ﬁnd all things as you wish. At the door he turned, and after a moment's pause said, Let me advise you, my dear young friend.
uz: Umid qilamanki, siz hamma narsani xohlaganingizdek topasiz. U eshikga burildi va bir muncha to'xtab, dedi: Menga maslahat beray, aziz yosh do'stim.

en: Nay, let me warn you with all seriousness, that should you leave these rooms you will not by any chance go to sleep in any other part of the castle.
uz: Yo'q, sizlarga jiddiy ogohlantirishim bor: agar siz bu xonalardan chiqib ketsangiz, siz hech qachon qalʼaning boshqa bir qismida uxlashga ketmaysiz.

en: It is old, and has many memories, and there are bad dreams for those who sleep unwisely.
uz: Bu eski va ko'p xotiralarga ega bo'lib, aqlsizlik bilan uxlayotganlar uchun yomon orzular bor.

en: Should sleep now or ever overcome you, or be like to do, then haste to your own chamber or to these rooms, for your rest will then be safe.
uz: Agar endi yoki keyinchalik sizni yutqazadigan yoki shunday qilishingiz kerak bo'lsa, o'zingizning xonangizga yoki ushbu xonalarga shoshiling, chunki dam olishingiz xavfsiz bo'ladi.

en: But if you be not careful in this respect, then, He ﬁn- ished his speech in a gruesome way, for he motioned with his hands as if he were washing them.
uz: Ammo agar siz bu borada ehtiyot bo'lmasangiz, - deb so'raganida, u qo'llarini yuvgandek ishora qilib qo'ydi.

en: My only doubt was as to whether any dream could be more terrible than the unnatural, horrible net of gloom and mystery which seemed closing around me.
uz: Mening yagona shubham, hech qanday orzu tabiiy emas, balki atrofimdagi qorong'ilik va sirlar to'pidan ham dahshatliroq bo'lishi mumkinmi, degan edi.

en: Later.—I endorse the last words written, but this time there is no doubt in question.
uz: Keyinroq.Men so'nggi yozma so'zlarni qo'llab-quvvatlayman, ammo bu safar hech qanday shubha yo'q.

en: I shall not fear to sleep in any place where he is not.
uz: U bo'lmagan joyda uxlashdan qo'rqmayman.

en: I have placed the cruciﬁx over the head of my bed, I imagine that my rest is thus freer from dreams, and there it shall remain.
uz: Men xochni o'z yotoq boshim ustiga qo'ydim, o'ylaymanki, dam olishim tushlardan ozod bo'ladi va u erda qoladi.

en: When he left me I went to my room.
uz: U meni tashlab ketgach, men o'z xonamga bordim.

en: After a little while, not hearing any sound, I came out and went up the stone stair to where I could look out to- wards the South.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, hech qanday tovushni eshitmay, tashqariga chiqib, tosh daraxtini ko'tarib, Janubiy tomon ko'rinishim mumkin bo'lgan joyga chiqdim.

en: There was some sense of freedom in the vast expanse, in- accessible though it was to me, as compared with the narrow darkness of the courtyard.
uz: O'ta keng va men uchun bu ochiq bo'lsa-da, hovlidagi tor zulmat bilan taqqoslaganda erkinlik hissi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Looking out on this, I felt that I was indeed in prison, and I seemed to want a breath of fresh air, though it were of the night.
uz: Buni ko'rib, men o'zimni albatta qamoqda ekanligimni his qildim va kechqurun bo'lsa-da, yangi havo nafas olishni istardim.

en: I am begin- ning to feel this nocturnal existence tell on me.
uz: Men bu kechki hayotning o'ziga xosligini his qila boshlayapman.

en: It is destroying my nerve.
uz: Bu mening g'azabimni yo'q qiladi.

en: I start at my own shadow, and am full of all sorts of horrible imaginings.
uz: Men o'z soyasimdan boshlayman va har xil dahshatli tasavvurlarga to'lib-toshaman.

en: God knows that there is ground for my terrible fear in this accursed place!I looked out over the beautiful expanse, bathed in soft yellow moonlight till it was almost as light as day.
uz: Xudo biladiki, bu la'natlangan joyda qo'rquvim uchun asos bor!Men chiroyli maydonga qarab turdim, oyning yumshoq sariq yorug'ligida cho'mib, kunning yorug'ligicha ko'proq yorug' bo'ldi.

en: In the soft light the distant hills became melted, and the shadows in the valleys and gorges of velvety blackness.
uz: Yumshoq yorug'likda uzoq tog'lar erib ketdi va vodiylar va gorillalardagi soyalar samimiy qoralikka to'lib-toshdi.

en: The mere beauty seemed to cheer me.
uz: Faqatgina go'zallik meni quvonchga soladi.

en: There was peace and comfort in every breath I drew.
uz: Har bir nafasimda xotirjamlik va tasalli bor edi.

en: As I leaned from the window my eye was caught by something mov- ing a storey below me, and somewhat to my left, where I imagined, from the order of the rooms, that the windows of the Count's own room would look out.
uz: Oynaga tiklanayotganimda, ko'zimni mendan bir qavat pastda, biroz chap tomonda, xonadonlarning tartibidan ko'ra, Countning o'z xonasining derazalari ko'rinishini tasavvur qilganimda, bir narsa ushlab qoldi.

en: The window at which I stood was tall and deep, stone-mullioned, and though weatherworn, was still complete.
uz: Men turgan deraza baland va chuqur, toshli va ob-havoga to'lgan bo'lsa-da, hali ham to'liq edi.

en: But it was evidently many a day since the case had been there.
uz: Ammo bu holat sodir bo'lganidan ko'p kun o'tgan edi.

en: I drew back behind the stonework, and looked carefully out.
uz: Men toshlar orqasidan qaytib, diqqat bilan tashqariga qaradim.

en: What I saw was the Count's head coming out from the window.
uz: O'zim ko'rganim shundaki, raftadan Countning boshi chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: I did not see the face, but I knew the man by the neck and the movement of his back and arms.
uz: Men uning yuzini ko'rmadim, lekin uni bo'yni va orqa va qo'llaridagi harakatlardan tanib-bildim.

en: In any case I could not mistake the hands which I had had some many opportunities of studying.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men o'rganish uchun ko'plab imkoniyatlar bo'lgan qo'llarimni noto'g'ri tushunib yetmaganman.

en: I was at ﬁrst interested and somewhat amused, for it is wonderful how small a matter will interest and amuse a man when he is a prisoner.
uz: Boshida men qiziqib qoldim va biroz zavqlandim, chunki bir odam qamoqda bo'lganida, kichik bir ish qanchalik qiziqishi va zavqlashi ajablanarli.

en: But my very feelings changed to repulsion and terror when I saw the whole man slowly emerge from the window and be- gin to crawl down the castle wall over the dreadful abyss, face down with his cloak spreading out around him like great wings.
uz: Ammo butun odamni asta-sekin darvozaxdan chiqib, katta qanotlarga o'xshaydigan qopqoqlari atrofida tarqalib, qo'rqinchli tubsizlikka o'tib, qorong'i qalʼaning devoridan pastga kirishini ko'rganimda, his-tuyg'ularim orzu va dahshatga aylandi.

en: At ﬁrst I could not be- lieve my eyes.
uz: Boshida ko'zlarim chiroyli bo'lmadi.

en: I thought it was some trick of the moonlight, some weird ef- fect of shadow, but I kept looking, and it could be no delusion.
uz: Men buni oy yorug'ligining hiyla-nayri, soyalarning g'alati ta'siri deb o'ylardim, lekin men ko'rishni davom ettirdim va bu hech qanday aldam bo'lmasdi.

en: I saw the ﬁn- gers and toes grasp the corners of the stones, worn clear of the mortar by the stress of years, and by thus using every projection and inequality move downwards with considerable speed, just as a lizard moves along a wall.
uz: Yillar og'irligi tufayli o'tkir-o'tkir bo'lgan toshlarning burchaklarini tutib olgan tuxumlar va barchalari har qanday proyeksiya va tengsizlikdan foydalanib, tikanlar devor bo'ylab harakatlanayotganidek, juda tez pastga harakatlanayotganini ko'rdim.

en: What manner of man is this, or what manner of creature, is it in the sem- blance of man?
uz: Bu qanday inson yoki qanday mavjudot, inson qiyofasida?

en: I feel the dread of this horrible place overpowering me.
uz: Bu dahshatli joydan qo'rqqanimni his qilaman.

en: in fear, in awful fear, and there is no escape for me.
uz: Qo'rquvda, qo'rquvda va men uchun hech qanday qochish yo'q.

en: I am encompassed about with terrors that I dare not think of.
uz: Men qo'rquvga to'lib-toshganman va hatto o'ylashga ham jur'at etmayman.

en: 15 May.—Once more I have seen the count go out in his lizard fashion.
uz: 15 may.Men yana bir bor countni o'zining tovuq uslubida chiqishini ko'rdim.

en: He moved downwards in a sidelong way, some hundred feet down, and a good deal to the left.
uz: U yonma-yon yo'l bilan pastga, taxminan yuz metr pastga, ko'p o'tib chapga o'tdi.

en: He vanished into some hole or window.
uz: U biron-bir cho'g'ga yoki derazaga yo'qolgan.

en: When his head had disappeared, I leaned out to try and see more, but without avail.
uz: Uning boshi yo'qolganida, men ko'proq ko'rishga harakat qildim, ammo hech qanday natija bo'lmadi.

en: The distance was too great to allow a proper angle of sight.
uz: Masofadagi masofa ko'rinish nuqtasini aniqlay olmaydigan darajada katta edi.

en: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.
uz: U endi qalʼani tark etganini bilardim va bu imkoniyatdan foydalanib, hozirgacha qilgandimdan koʻproq narsani kashf etishni oʻyladim.

en: I went back to the room, and taking a lamp, tried all the doors.
uz: Xonaniga qaytib borib, lampa olib, barcha eshiklarni sinab ko'rdim.

en: They were all locked, as I had expected, and the locks were comparatively new.
uz: Ularning barchasi, men kutilganidek, qulflab qo'yilgan edi va qulflar nisbatan yangi edi.

en: But I went down the stone stairs to the hall where I had entered originally.
uz: Ammo men tosh daraxtlaridan pastga tushib, dastlab kirgan zalga bordim.

en: I found I could pull back the bolts easily enough and un- hook the great chains.
uz: Men boltlarni osonlikcha tortib olib, katta zanjirlarni o'chirib qo'yishim mumkinligini tushundim.

en: But the door was locked, and the key was gone!
uz: Ammo eshik qulflab qo'yilgan edi va kalit yo'q edi!

en: That key must be in the Count's room.
uz: Ushbu kalit Countning xonasida bo'lishi kerak.

en: I must watch should his door be unlocked, so that I may get it and escape.
uz: Men uning eshikini ochib qo'yishsa-yu, uni olib qochib ketishim uchun kuzatib turishim kerak.

en: I went on to make a thorough examination of the various stairs and passages, and to try the doors that opened from them.
uz: Men har xil mertar va o'tish joylarini batafsil ko'rib chiqdim va ulardan ochilgan eshiklarni sinab ko'rdim.

en: One or two small rooms near the hall were open, but there was noth- ing to see in them except old furniture, dusty with age and moth-eaten.
uz: Zal yaqinidagi bir yoki ikkita kichik xona ochiq edi, lekin ularda eski mebeldan tashqari hech narsa ko'rinmas edi, yoshi va mol-qushlar bilan to'ldirilgan.

en: At last, however, I found one door at the top of the stairway which, though it seemed locked, gave a little under pressure.
uz: Biroq, oxir-oqibat, sinchkovning yuqori qismida bir eshik topdim, u qulflab qo'yilgan ko'rinishi bilan, biroz bosim ostida bo'ldi.

en: I tried it harder, and found that it was not really locked, but that the resistance came from the fact that the hinges had fallen somewhat, and the heavy door rested on the ﬂoor.
uz: Men uni yanada ko'proq sinab ko'rdim va aniqladimki, u aslida qulflanmagan edi, balki qarshilik biroz tushgan bo'lib, og'ir eshik yer ustida turganidan kelib chiqqan.

en: Here was an opportunity which I might not have again, so I exerted myself, and with many efforts forced it back so that I could enter.
uz: Bu men uchun yana hech qachon bo'lmasligi mumkin bo'lgan imkoniyat edi, shuning uchun men o'zimni ko'p harakat qilib, uni qaytarishga majbur qildim.

en: I was now in a wing of the castle further to the right than the rooms I knew and a storey lower down.
uz: Endi men o'ng tomonda, men tanigan xonalardan va bir qavat pastda joylashgan qal'aning qanotida edim.

en: From the windows I could see that the suite of rooms lay along to the south of the castle, the windows of the end room looking out both west and south.
uz: Oynalardan men qalʼaning janubiy tomonida xonalar boʻlinishini koʻrardim, oxirgi xonaning derazalari gʻarbiy va janubiy tomon koʻrinadi.

en: On the latter side, as well as to the former, there was a great precipice.
uz: Ikkinchi tomondan ham, avvalgi tomondan ham katta toshbo'ron bor edi.

en: The castle was built on the corner of a great rock, so that on three sides it was quite impregnable, and great windows were placed here where sling, or bow, or culverin could not reach, and consequently light and com- fort, impossible to a position which had to be guarded, were secured.
uz: Shahar katta toshning burchagida qurilgan bo'lib, uch tomondan o'z ichiga kirmaydigan edi va katta derazalar shu yerda o'rnatilgan edi, bu yerda sling, yoki bo'g'i, yoki kulverin yetib bo'lmasdi va shuning uchun qo'riqlanishi kerak bo'lgan joy uchun imkonsiz bo'lgan yorug'lik va mustahkamlik himoyalangan edi.

en: To the west was a great valley, and then, rising far away, great jagged mountain fastnesses, rising peak on peak, the sheer rock studded with mountain ash and thorn, whose roots clung in cracks and crevices and crannies of the stone.
uz: G'arbda katta vodiy bor edi, keyin esa uzoqdan ko'tarilgan, katta bo'lak-bo'lak tog'lar o'sib borardi, to'p-to'p bo'lib o'sib borardi, tog' ash va tikanlar bilan to'plangan, ildizlari tikanlar va tikanlar va tikanlar bilan bog'liq bo'lgan tikanlar tikanlar edi.

en: This was evidently the portion of the castle occupied by the ladies in
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, bu qalʼaning xonimlari tomonidan egallab olingan qismi edi.

en: bygone days, for the furniture had more an air of comfort than any I had seen.
uz: O'tmishdagi kunlar edi, chunki bu mebellar men ko'rgan har qanday mebeldan ko'ra ko'proq qulaylik bilan ta'minlangan edi.

en: The windows were curtainless, and the yellow moonlight, ﬂooding in through the diamond panes, enabled one to see even colours, whilst it soft- ened the wealth of dust which lay over all and disguised in some measure the ravages of time and moth.
uz: Oynalar pardasiz edi va almas panellari orqali to'lib-toshgan sariq oy nurlari hatto ranglarni ko'rish imkonini berardi, ammo bu hamma narsani qoplagan tozalik boyligini yumshatardi va vaqt va polizning halokatlarini bir darajada yashirib qo'ydi.

en: My lamp seemed to be of little effect in the brilliant moonlight, but I was glad to have it with me, for there was a dread loneliness in the place which chilled my heart and made my nerves tremble.
uz: Quyosh nurida chiroqim kamroq ta'sir ko'rsatardi, lekin uni o'zim bilan olib yurganimdan xursand bo'ldim, chunki bu joyda yuragimni sovutgan va g'azablarim titrayotgan dahshatli yolg'izlik bor edi.

en: Still, it was better than living alone in the rooms which I had come to hate from the presence of the Count, and after trying a little to school my nerves, I found a soft quietude come over me.
uz: Shunga qaramay, Countning hozirligi tufayli nafratlanayotgan xonadonlarda yolg'iz yashashdan ko'ra, bu yaxshiroq edi va biroz g'azablanishimni o'rgatishga harakat qilganimdan so'ng, meni yumshatadigan tinchlik o'rab oldi.

en: Here I am, sitting at a little oak table where in old times possibly some fair lady sat to pen, with much thought and many blushes, her ill-spelt love letter, and writing in my diary in short- hand all that has happened since I closed it last.
uz: Mana, men eski zamonda bir nechta chiroyli ayol o'tirgan kichkina o'q stolda o'tirib, o'zining yomon so'zlangan sevgi xatini ko'p o'ylab, ko'p o'qishni o'z ichiga olgan qalamga o'tirganman va kundaligimga qisqacha yozganman- oxirgi marta yopganimdan buyon sodir bo'lgan hamma narsa.

en: It is the nineteenth century up-to-date with a vengeance.
uz: Bu o'n to'qqizinchi asrning o'ziga xos va qasosli davridir.

en: And yet, unless my senses deceive me, the old centuries had, and have, powers of their own which mere modernity can- not kill.
uz: Ammo, agar his-tuyg'ularim meni aldamasa, qadimgi asrlar o'z kuchlariga ega edi va o'z kuchlariga ega bo'ladi, faqatgina moderniyat o'ldira olmaydi.

en: Later: The morning of 16 May.—God preserve my sanity, for to this I am reduced.
uz: Keyingi kuni: 16 may kuni ertalab.Alloh mening aqlimni saqlasin, chunki men shu maqsadda yashayman.

en: Safety and the assurance of safety are things of the past.
uz: Xavfsizlik va xavfsizlikni ta'minlash o'tmishda qolgan narsalardir.

en: Whilst I live on here there is but one thing to hope for, that I may not go mad, if, in- deed, I be not mad already.
uz: Men bu yerda yashayotganimda, faqat bir narsaga umid qilishim mumkin, agar men allaqachon g'azablanmagan bo'lsam, aqldan ozishim mumkin.

en: If I be sane, then surely it is maddening to think that of all the foul things that lurk in this hateful place the Count is the least dreadful to me, that to him alone I can look for safety, even though this be only whilst I can serve his purpose.
uz: Agar men aqlli bo'lsam, shubhasizki, bu nafratli joyda yashayotgan barcha iflos narsalardan Count men uchun eng kam qo'rqinchli ekanligini, faqatgina u uchun xavfsizlikni izlashim mumkinligini, garchi bu faqat uning maqsadiga xizmat qilishim mumkin bo'lsa ham, o'ylash g'alati.

en: Merciful God, let me be calm, for out of that way lies madness indeed.
uz: Rahmli Xudo, meni tinch tutgin, chunki bu yo'lda aqlsizlik bor.

en: I begin to get new lights on certain things which have puzzled me.
uz: Men o'zimni hayratda qoldirgan ba'zi narsalarga yangi yorug'lik ochib berishni boshladim.

en: Up to now I never quite knew what Shakespeare meant when he made Hamlet say, My tablets!
uz: Hozirgacha men Sheksperning Hamletni: Mening tabletkalarim!

en: `tis meet that I put it down, etc., For now, feeling as though my own brain were unhinged or as if the shock had come which must end in its undoing, I turn to my diary for repose.
uz: `tis meet that I put it down, va boshqalar, hozircha, o'z miyamning o'zgaruvchanligi yoki o'z yo'q bo'lib ketishi kerak bo'lgan shok kelib qolganini his etib, dam olish uchun kundaligimga murojaat qilaman.

en: The habit of entering accurately must help to soothe me.
uz: To'g'ri kirish odati meni tinchlantirishga yordam berishi kerak.

en: The Count's mysterious warning frightened me at the time.
uz: Countning sirli ogohlantirishi o'sha paytda meni qo'rqitdi.

en: It frightens me more not when I think of it, for in the future he has a fearful hold upon me.
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylagandan ko'proq qo'rqaman, chunki kelajakda u menga qo'rqinchli ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

en: I shall fear to doubt what he may say!
uz: U nima deyishini shubha ostiga qo'yaman!

en: When I had written in my diary and had fortunately replaced the book and pen in my pocket I felt sleepy.
uz: Men kundaligimga yozganimda va qut-baraka uchun kiyimdagi kitob va qalamni almashtirganimda, uyqusimni his qildim.

en: The Count's warning came into my mind, but I took pleasure in disobeying it.
uz: Countning ogohlantirishi mening ongimga keldi, lekin unga bo'ysunmaslikdan zavq oldim.

en: The sense of sleep was upon me,
uz: Men uyqu hissi ostida edim,

en: and with it the obstinacy which sleep brings as outrider.
uz: Va shu bilan birga, uyqu o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'z navbatida o'tkazadigan qat'iylik ham bor.

en: The soft moonlight soothed, and the wide expanse without gave a sense of freedom which re- freshed me.
uz: Yumshoq oy yorug'ligi yengillashdi va keng keng kenglik menga erkinlik hissi berdi.

en: I determined not to return tonight to the gloom-haunted rooms, but to sleep here, where, of old, ladies had sat and sung and lived sweet lives whilst their gentle breasts were sad for their menfolk away in the midst of remorseless wars.
uz: Men bu kecha qorong'i xonalarga qaytib bormaslikka qaror qildim, balki qadimda ayollar o'tirgan, kuylagan va go'zal hayot kechirayotgan bu yerda uxlashim kerak edi, o'sha paytda ularning mehribon ko'kraklari o'z odamlari uchun qayg'urgan edi.

en: I drew a great couch out of its place near the corner, so that as I lay, I could look at the lovely view to east and south, and unthinking of and uncaring for the dust, composed myself for sleep.
uz: Men burchadagi joyidan katta kanapni olib chiqdim, shunda yotganimda sharq va janubiy manzaralarni ko'rib turardim va tuproq haqida o'ylamagan va g'amxo'rlik qilmagan holda uyqu uchun o'zimni yig'dim.

en: I sup- pose I must have fallen asleep.
uz: O'ylaymanki, uyquga tushib qolganman.

en: I hope so, but I fear, for all that followed was startlingly real, so real that now sitting here in the broad, full sunlight of the morning, I cannot in the least believe that it was all sleep.
uz: Umid qilamanki, shunday bo'ladi, lekin qo'rqaman, chunki bundan keyin sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealar juda real edi, shunchalik realki, endi ertalabning keng, to'liq quyosh nurida o'tirganimda, hamma narsa uxlab ketganiga ishonolmayman.

en: The room was the same, unchanged in any way since I came into it.
uz: Xona bir xil edi, men u erga kirganimdan beri hech qanday o'zgarish bo'lmagan.

en: I could see along the ﬂoor, in the brilliant moonlight, my own footsteps marked where I had disturbed the long accumulation of dust.
uz: Men yopiq yer bo'ylab, yorug' oy yorug'ligida, tuproqning uzoq to'plamini buzgan joyimda o'z qadamlarim belgilab qo'yilganini ko'rardim.

en: In the moonlight opposite me were three young women, ladies by their dress and manner.
uz: Oʻzimning qarshimdagi oy yorugʻida uchta yosh ayol bor edi, ular kiyim-kechak va xulq-atvorlari bilan xonimlar edi.

en: I thought at the time that I must be dreaming when I saw them, they threw no shadow on the ﬂoor.
uz: O'shanda men ularni ko'rganimda, orzu qilayotgan bo'lishim kerak, deb o'yladim, ular yerga hech qanday soya tashlamadilar.

en: They came close to me, and looked at me for some time, and then whispered together.
uz: Ular yonimga yaqinlashib, bir muncha vaqt menga qarab, keyin bir-biriga shoshib ketishdi.

en: Two were dark, and had high aquiline noses, like the Count, and great dark, piercing eyes, that seemed to be almost red when contrasted with the pale yellow moon.
uz: Ikkitasi qorong'i va Count kabi baland akvilin burunlari va katta qorong'i, o'tkir ko'zlar bor edi, ular o'ta sariq oy bilan taqqoslaganda deyarli qizil ko'rinardi.

en: The other was fair, as fair as can be, with great masses of golden hair and eyes like pale sapphires.
uz: Ikkinchisi esa chiroyli, chiroyli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgancha chiroyli edi, uning sochlari oltin, ko'zlari esa rang-barang saffir kabi edi.

en: I seemed somehow to know her face, and to know it in connection with some dreamy fear, but I could not recollect at the moment how or where.
uz: Men uning yuzini qandaydir tarzda bilganim va uni tushdagi qo'rquv bilan tanishtirganim ko'rinardi, ammo hozirda qanday yoki qayerda ekanligini eslay olmayman.

en: All three had brilliant white teeth that shone like pearls against the ruby of their voluptuous lips.
uz: Uchtasining ham o'zlarining chiroyli og'izlarining ko'rinmas ko'rinishlariga o'xshash marvaridlar kabi parlashadigan chiroyli oq tishlari bor edi.

en: There was something about them that made me uneasy, some longing and at the same time some deadly fear.
uz: Ular haqida meni xavotirda qoldirgan narsa bor edi, ba'zi bir orzu va bir vaqtning o'zida ba'zi o'lim qo'rquvi.

en: I felt in my heart a wicked, burning desire that they would kiss me with those red lips.It is not good to note this down, lest some day it should meet Mina's eyes and cause her pain, but it is the truth.
uz: Men yuragimda o'sha qizil og'izlar bilan meni o'pish istagim bor edi.Buni yozib qo'yish yaxshi emas, bir kun Mina ko'zlariga tushib, uning og'rig'ini yetkazishi mumkin, lekin bu haqiqat.

en: They whispered together, and then they all three laughed, such a silvery, musical laugh, but as hard as though the sound never could have come through the softness of human lips.
uz: Ular bir-biriga shoshib ketishdi, so'ngra uchalari kulishdi, bu kumushli, musiqiy kulgi edi, lekin ovoz hech qachon inson og'zaki yumshatmasligidan kelib chiqmagandek qattiq edi.

en: It was like the intolerable, tingling sweetness of waterglasses when played on by a cunning hand.
uz: Bu, o'yinchi o'yinchi tomonidan o'ynashganda, suv shishalarining ko'tarilishsiz, qichqiriqli shirinligi singari edi.

en: The fair girl shook her head coquettishly, and the other two urged her on.
uz: Go'zal qiz boshini qo'zg'atdi, qolgan ikkalasi esa uni davom ettirishga undashdi.

en: You are ﬁrst, and we shall follow.
uz: Sen birinchi bo'lasan, biz esa ketamiz.

en: Yours' is the right to begin. The other added, He is young and strong.
uz: Sizlarning boshlanish huquqiga ega bo'lasiz, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi boshqasi: U yosh va kuchli.

en: There are kisses for us all.
uz: Hammamiz uchun o'g'illar bor.

en: I lay quiet, looking out from under my eyelashes in an agony of delight- ful anticipation.
uz: Men xotirjam o'tirib, ko'z burchaklarim ostida quvonchli kutib-ku, azob-uqubat chekib qaradim.

en: The fair girl advanced and bent over me till I could feel the movement of her breath upon me.
uz: Go'zal qiz oldimga o'tib, nafasining harakatini his qila olgunimcha yonimga o'girdi.

en: Sweet it was in one sense, honey-sweet, and sent the same tingling through the nerves as her voice, but with a bitter underlying the sweet, a bitter offensiveness, as one smells in blood.
uz: U bir ma'noda shirin edi, bal-tosh edi va uning ovozi kabi g'azabga to'lib-toshgan edi, ammo uning negizida shirin, qaynoq hujumlar bor edi, chunki bu qonga o'xshaydi.

en: I was afraid to raise my eyelids, but looked out and saw perfectly under the lashes.
uz: Ko'zimni ko'tarib ko'rishdan qo'rqardim, lekin ko'zimni ko'tarib ko'rdim va lashkarlar ostida mukammal ko'rdim.

en: The girl went on her knees, and bent over me, simply gloating.
uz: Qiz tiz cho'kib, yonimga yiqilib, shunchaki xursand bo'ldi.

en: There was a deliberate voluptuousness which was both thrilling and repul- sive, and as she arched her neck she actually licked her lips like an animal, till I could see in the moonlight the moisture shining on the scarlet lips and on the red tongue as it lapped the white sharp teeth.
uz: O'z bo'ynini bog'laganida, u hayvon kabi o'z og'izlarini yaltirdi, hatto oy yorug'ligida qizil og'izlar va qizil tildagi suyuqlikni ko'rdim, chunki u oq o'tkir tishlarni yaltiradi.

en: Lower and lower went her head as the lips went below the range of my mouth and chin and seemed to fasten on my throat.
uz: Og'zim og'zim va qani men uchun pastga tushganda, uning boshi pastga tushadi va og'zimni og'zimga bog'lab qo'yishga o'xshaydi.

en: Then she paused, and I could hear the churning sound of her tongue as it licked her teeth and lips, and I could feel the hot breath on my neck.
uz: So'ngra u to'xtadi va men uning tilining tishlarini va og'izlarini yulib ketayotganini eshitdim va bo'ynidagi issiq nafasni his qildim.

en: Then the skin of my throat began to tingle as one's ﬂesh does when the hand that is to tickle it approaches nearer, nearer.
uz: So'ngra qo'limning terisi o'zimning go'shtimga yaqinlashganda, go'shtning qo'li yaqinlashganda xuddi shunday bo'lib qichqirishni boshladi.

en: I could feel the soft, shivering touch of the lips on the super sensitive skin of my throat, and the hard dents of two sharp teeth, just touching and pausing there.
uz: Men og'zimning juda sezgir teri ustidagi yumshatgan, titraydigan og'izlar va ikki o'tkir tishning qattiq tishlarini his qilardim, ular bir-birlariga qo'shilishdi va to'xtashdi.

en: I closed my eyes in languorous ecstasy and waited, waited with beating heart.
uz: Men ko'zlarimni g'alati shovqin bilan yopib, yuragim urib kutdim.

en: But at that instant, another sensation swept through me as quick as light- ning.
uz: Ammo o'sha zahoti boshqa bir his-tuyg'u meni chaqmoqday tez o'rab oldi.

en: I was conscious of the presence of the Count, and of his being as if lapped in a storm of fury.
uz: Men Countning hozir bo'lishi va uning g'azab shovov-shuvida bo'lgani haqida o'yladim.

en: As my eyes opened involuntarily I saw his strong hand grasp the slender neck of the fair woman and with giant's power draw it back, the blue eyes transformed with fury, the white teeth champing with rage, and the fair cheeks blazing red with passion.
uz: Ko'zlarim ixtiyoriy ravishda ochilganida, uning kuchli qo'lini go'zal ayolning chiroyli bo'yni ushlab, ulkan kuchi bilan uni orqaga tortib olishini ko'rdim, ko'k ko'zlar g'azabdan o'zgarib ketdi, oq tishlar g'azabdan o'zgarib ketdi va go'zal yig'inlar ishtiyoqdan qizil qizil rangda yonib ketdi.

en: Never did I imagine such wrath and fury, even to the demons of the pit.
uz: Hatto chuqurlikdagi jinlarga nisbatan ham bunday g'azab va g'azabni hech qachon tasavvur ham qilmaganman.

en: His eyes were positively blazing.
uz: Uning ko'zlari chindan ham yorqin edi.

en: The red light in them was lurid, as if the ﬂames of hell ﬁre blazed behind them.
uz: Ularning qizil yorug'ligi qo'rqinchli edi, xuddi orqalaridan jahannam o'tlari yonayotgan bo'lsa.

en: His face was deathly pale, and the lines of it were hard like drawn wires.
uz: Uning yuzi o'limdan o'ta soya edi va uning chiziqlari simlar kabi qattiq edi.

en: The thick eyebrows that met over the nose now seemed like a heaving bar of white-hot metal.
uz: Burun ustida uchragan qalin ko'z burchaklari endi oq issiq metallning o'tkir baraga o'xshardi.

en: With a ﬁerce sweep of his arm, he hurled the woman from him, and then motioned to the others, as though he were beating them back.
uz: Qo'lini qattiq ko'tarib, ayolni o'zidan tashlab yubordi va boshqalarga ishora qilib, xuddi ularni o'ldirganga o'xshatdi.

en: It was the same imperious gesture that I had seen used to the wolves.
uz: Bu xuddi o'sha qurtlar bilan tanishtirgan imperiyaviy harakat edi.

en: In a voice which, though low and almost in a whisper seemed to cut through the air and then ring in the room he said, How dare you touch him, any of you?
uz: O'sha ovoz, hatto past va deyarli shov-shuv bilan havoni kesib o'tadigan va keyin xonada tovushlaydigan bo'lib tuyulgan, u shunday dedi: Sizlar unga qanday qo'l tegizishga jur'at qilasizlar?

en: How dare you cast eyes on him when I had forbidden it?
uz: Qanday qilib men unga taqiqlaganimda unga ko'z ochishga jur'at qilasiz?

en: Back, I tell you all!
uz: Men hammangizga aytaman!

en: This man belongs to me!
uz: Bu odam menga tegishli!

en: Be- ware how you meddle with him, or you'll have to deal with me.
uz: U bilan qanday aralashishingizga ehtiyot bo'ling yoki men bilan shug'ullanishingiz kerak.

en: The fair girl, with a laugh of ribald coquetry, turned to answer him.
uz: Go'zal qiz qo'shiq bilan unga javob bermoqchi bo'ldi.

en: You yourself never loved.
uz: Siz o'zingiz hech qachon sevmagansiz.

en: You never love! On this the other women joined, and such a mirthless,hard, soulless laughter rang through the room that it almost made me faint to hear.
uz: Sen hech qachon sevmaysan! - deb so'zlashganda, boshqa ayollar ham qo'shilishdi va o'z ko'nglimdan kechirgan bunday quvonchsiz, qattiq va ruhsiz kulgi xonadonni o'rab oldi, uni eshitish meni deyarli o'zimni chalg'itdi.

en: It seemed like the pleasure of ﬁends.
uz: Bu yovuz ruhlarning zavq-shafqlariga o'xshardi.

en: Then the Count turned, after looking at my face attentively, and said in a soft whisper, Yes, I too can love.
uz: Keyin Count yuzimga diqqat bilan qaraganidan so'ng o'girilib, salomli bir shoshib: Ha, men ham sevaman.

en: You yourselves can tell it from the past.
uz: O'tmishda o'tgan voqealardan o'zingiz buni aniqlay olasiz.

en: Well, now I promise you that when I am done with him you shall kiss him at your will.
uz: Endi men sizga va'da beramanki, men u bilan bo'lganimdan keyin siz uni o'zingiz xohlagancha o'pasiz.

en: I must awaken him, for there is work to be done. Are we to have nothing tonight?said one of them, with a low laugh, as she pointed to the bag which he had thrown upon the ﬂoor, and which moved as though there were some living thing within it.
uz: Men uni uyg'otishim kerak, chunki bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlar bor. Bu kechasi hech narsa yo'qmi? - dedi ulardan biri, uning yerga tashlagan sumkasini ko'rsatib, u ichida jonli mavjudot bo'lgani kabi harakatlanayotganini ko'rsatib, kamroq kulish bilan.

en: For answer he nod- ded his head.
uz: Javob uchun u boshini burib qo'ydi.

en: One of the women jumped forward and opened it.
uz: Ayollardan biri oldinga sakrab chiqib, uni ochdi.

en: If my ears did not deceive me there was a gasp and a low wail, as of a half smothered child.
uz: Agar quloqlarim meni aldamagan bo'lsa, o'zimni yarim cho'kgan bola kabi, ko'nglimni tishlab, ko'nglimni yig'lab yubordim.

en: The women closed round, whilst I was aghast with horror.
uz: Ayollar atrofini yopishdi, men esa dahshatga tushdim.

en: But as I looked, they disappeared, and with them the dreadful bag.
uz: Ammo men ko'z o'ngimda, ular yo'qolishdi va ular bilan birga dahshatli sumka ham bor edi.

en: There was no door near them, and they could not have passed me without my noticing.
uz: Ularning yonida eshik yo'q edi va ular men ko'rmasdan o'tib ketolmasdi.

en: They simply seemed to fade into the rays of the moonlight and pass out through the window, for I could see outside the dim, shadowy forms for a moment before they entirely faded away.
uz: Ular shunchaki oy nurining nurlariga o'tib, darcha orqali o'tib ketishardi, chunki men bir muncha vaqt davomida kamon, soyasidagi shakllarni ko'rib turardim, keyin ular butunlay o'tib ketdi.

en: Then the horror overcame me, and I sank down unconscious.
uz: Keyin dahshat meni yutib yubordi va o'zimni esdan chiqarmasdim.

en: CHAPTER 4 JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL CONTINUED I awoke in my own bed.
uz: 4 bob Jonathan Harkerning kunlik hikoyasi davom etadi Men o'z yotoqimda uyg'ondim.

en: If it be that I had not dreamt, the Count must have carried me here.
uz: Agar men tush ko'rmagan bo'lsam, Count meni bu yerga olib kelgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: I tried to satisfy myself on the subject, but could not arrive at any unquestionable result.
uz: Men bu mavzuda o'zimni qondirishga harakat qildim, lekin hech qanday shubha ostiga tushmadi.

en: To be sure, there were certain small evidences, such as that my clothes were folded and laid by in a manner which was not my habit.
uz: To'g'ri, ayrim kichik dalillar bor edi, masalan, kiyimlarim o'g'il-qizim bo'lmagan tarzda qatlamga olingan va joylashtirilgan.

en: My watch was still unwound, and I am rigorously accustomed to wind it the last thing before going to bed, and many such details.
uz: Mening soatim hali ham o'zgarib qolgan edi va men uni uxlashdan oldin so'nggi marta o'zgartirishga odatlanib qoldim va ko'plab shunga o'xshash tafsilotlarni o'zgartirdim.

en: But these things are no proof, for they may have been evidences that my mind was not as usual, and, for some cause or another, I had certainly been much up- set.
uz: Ammo bu narsalar hech qanday dalil emas, chunki ular mening ongim odatdagidek bo'lmaganligini va nima sababdan yoki nima sababdan juda xavotirlanganligimni tasdiqlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I must watch for proof.
uz: Men dalillarni kutishim kerak.

en: Of one thing I am glad.
uz: Bir narsadan mamnunman.

en: If it was that the Count carried me here and undressed me, he must have been hurried in his task, for my pockets are intact.
uz: Agar Count meni bu yerga olib kelib, kiyimimdan chiqarib qo'ygan bo'lsa, unda u o'z vazifasini juda tez bajargan bo'lishi kerak, chunki mening to'plarim bir xil emas.

en: I am sure this diary would have been a mystery to him which he would not have brooked.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, bu kundalik kitob u uchun sir bo'lgan bo'lardi va u bu haqda gapirmagan bo'lardi.

en: He would have taken or destroyed it.
uz: U uni olib qo'yadi yoki yo'q qiladi.

en: As I look round this room, although it has been to me so full of fear, it is now a sort of sanctuary, for nothing can be more dreadful than those awful women, who were, who are, waiting to suck my blood.
uz: Bu xonani ko'rib turganimda, u men uchun qo'rquvga to'lib-toshgan bo'lsa-da, hozir u o'ziga o'xshaydi, chunki o'sha dahshatli ayollardan dahshatli narsa yo'q, ular mening qonimni sug'urishni kutishgan va hozir ham kutmoqdalar.

en: 18 May.—I have been down to look at that room again in daylight, for I must know the truth.
uz: 18 may.Men yana bir bor o'sha xonani kunduz yorug'ligida ko'rib chiqishga tushdim, chunki men haqiqatni bilishim kerak.

en: When I got to the doorway at the top of the stairs I found it closed.
uz: Eshikning yuqori qismidagi eshikga yetib kelganimda, uni yopilgan holda topdim.

en: It had been so forcibly driven against the jamb that part of the woodwork was splintered.
uz: U shunchalik kuchga toʻlib, oʻtning bir qismi parchalanib ketdi.

en: I could see that the bolt of the lock had not been shot, but the door is fastened from the inside.
uz: Men qulfning bo'g'i tushmaganini ko'rdim, lekin eshik ichkaridan bog'langan.

en: I fear it was no dream, and must act on this surmise.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, bu tush emas edi va men bu taxminga asoslanib harakat qilishim kerak.

en: 19 May.—I am surely in the toils.
uz: 19 may.Men, shubhasiz, mehnatda bo'laman.

en: Last night the Count asked me in the sauvest tones to write three letters, one saying that my work here was nearly done, and that I should start for home within a few days, another that I was starting on the next morning from the time of the letter, and the third that I
uz: Kecha Count meni uchta maktub yozishni soʻradi, bittasi bu yerda ishim deyarli bitib ketgani va bir necha kun ichida uyga qaytishim kerakligini, ikkinchisi esa maktub yozilganidan keyingi ertalab boshlanishini va uchinchisi esa men uyga qaytishim kerakligini aytadi.

en: had left the castle and arrived at Bistritz.
uz: qalʼani tark etib, Bistritzga yetib keldi.

en: I would fain have rebelled, but felt that in the present state of things it would be madness to quarrel openly with the Count whilst I am so absolutely in his power.
uz: Men isyon ko'tarishni yoqtirardim, lekin hozirgi vaziyatda, men uning qo'lida bo'lganimda, Count bilan ochiq bahslashish aqlsizlik bo'lardi, deb o'yladim.

en: And to refuse would be to excite his suspicion and to arouse his anger.
uz: Va rad etish uning shubhalarini uyg'otish va g'azabini uyg'otish demakdir.

en: He knows that I know too much, and that I must not live, lest I be dangerous to him.
uz: U mening juda ko'p narsani bilishimni va men hayotdan ko'z yumishim kerak emasligini biladi, chunki men u uchun xavfli bo'laman.

en: My only chance is to prolong my opportunities.
uz: Mening yagona imkoniyatim - imkoniyatlarimni uzaytirishdir.

en: Something may occur which will give me a chance to escape.
uz: Biror narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa menga qochib ketish imkoniyatini beradi.

en: I saw in his eyes something of that gathering wrath which was manifest when he hurled that fair woman from him.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida o'sha go'zal ayolni undan tashlab ketish paytida ko'rinib turgan g'azabning bir qismini ko'rdim.

en: He explained to me that posts were few and uncertain, and that my writing now would en- sure ease of mind to my friends.
uz: U o'z navbatida, yangiliklar kam va aniq emasligini va mening yozishim do'stlarim uchun qulay bo'lishini tushuntirdi.

en: And he assured me with so much impres- siveness that he would countermand the later letters, which would be held over at Bistritz until due time in case chance would admit of my prolonging my stay, that to oppose him would have been to create new suspicion.
uz: Va u menga shunchalik taassurot qoldirdiki, agar men o'zimning qolishimni uzaytirishimni tan olsam, keyinchalik Bistritzda saqlanadigan maktublarga qarshilik ko'rsatadi, chunki unga qarshi turish yangi shubha tug'diradi.

en: I therefore pretended to fall in with his views, and asked him what dates I should put on the letters.
uz: Shuning uchun men uning fikrlariga qo'shilayotganimni ko'rsatdim va unga xatlarga qaysi sanalarni qo'yishim kerakligini so'radim.

en: He calculated a minute, and then said, The ﬁrst should be June 12,the second June 19,and the third June 29. I know now the span of my life.
uz: U bir daqiqani hisoblab chiqib, birinchisi 12 iyun, ikkinchisi 19 iyun va uchinchisi 29 iyun bo'lishi kerak dedi.

en: 28 May.—There is a chance of escape, or at any rate of being able to send word home.
uz: 28 may.Qutqaruv yoki hech bo'lmaganda uyga xabar yuborish imkoniyati mavjud.

en: A band of Szgany have come to the castle, and are en- camped in the courtyard.
uz: Szganylarning guruhlari qalʼaga kelib, hovlida joylashgan.

en: I have notes of them in my book.
uz: Ular haqida kitobimda yozuvlarim bor.

en: They are peculiar to this part of the world, though allied to the ordi- nary gipsies all the world over.
uz: Ular dunyoning bu qismida o'ziga xos, ammo butun dunyodagi odatdagi g'aymonlar bilan aloqada.

en: There are thousands of them in Hungary and Transylvania, who are almost outside all law.
uz: Vengriya va Transilvaniyada ularning minglablari bor, ular deyarli qonunsiz.

en: They attach themselves as a rule to some great noble or boyar, and call themselves by his name.
uz: Ular odatda buyuk aziz yoki boyarlar bilan bog'lanib, o'zlarini uning ismi bilan chaqirishadi.

en: They are fearless and without religion, save superstition, and they talk only their own varieties of the Romany tongue.
uz: Ular qo'rqmas va dinsiz, shubhasiz, sehr-jodulardan tashqari, faqat o'zlarining rom tilining turlichalarini gapiradi.

en: I shall write some letters home, and shall try to get them to have them posted.
uz: Men uyga xat yozaman va ularni jo'natishga harakat qilaman.

en: I have already spoken to them through my window to begin ac- quaintanceship.
uz: Men ular bilan o'z darvozam orqali suhbatlashdim va ular bilan tanishishni boshladim.

en: They took their hats off and made obeisance and many signs, which however, I could not understand any more than I could their spoken language … I have written the letters.
uz: Ular to'pkalarini olib, sajda qildilar va ko'plab belgilarni ko'rsatdilar, ammo men ularning gapirgan tilini o'zim tushunmaganimdan ko'ra ko'proq tushunib yetmagan edim.

en: Mina's is in shorthand, and I simply ask Mr.
uz: Mina's qisqartma bilan ishlatiladi va men shunchaki Mr.dan so'rayman.

en: Hawkins to communicate with her.
uz: Hawkins u bilan muloqot qilish uchun.

en: To her I have explained my situation, but without the horrors which I may only surmise.
uz: Unga vaziyatimni tushuntirib berdim, lekin qo'rqinchli voqealar bo'lmaganda.

en: It would shock and frighten her to death were I to expose my heart to her.
uz: Agar unga qalbimni ochib bersam, u hayratda qoladi va qo'rqib ketadi.

en: Should the letters not
uz: Harflar kerak emasmi

en: carry, then the Count shall not yet know my secret or the extent of my knowledge … I have given the letters.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, Count mening sirimni yoki bilimimni hali bilmaydi... Men xatlarni berganman.

en: I threw them through the bars of my window with a gold piece, and made what signs I could to have them posted.
uz: Men ularni o'zimning oyna qo'llamamda oltin to'plam bilan o'tkazib yubordim va ularni joylashtirish uchun qo'limdan kelganicha belgilar yaratdim.

en: The man who took them pressed them to his heart and bowed, and then put them in his cap.
uz: Ularni olib ketgan kishi ularni yuragida bosib qo'ydi va quvonch ila boshini egib, to'pasiga qo'ydi.

en: I stole back to the study, and began to read.
uz: Men studiyaga qaytib kelib, o'qishni boshladim.

en: As the Count did not come in, I have written here … The Count has come.
uz: Count kelmaganligi sababli, men bu yerga yozdim... Count keldi.

en: He sat down beside me, and said in his smoothest voice as he opened two letters, The Szgany has given me these, of which, though I know not whence they come, I shall, of course, take care.
uz: U yonimda o'tirib, ikki maktubni ochganida o'zining eng yaxshi ovozi bilan shunday dedi: Szgany menga bularni berdi, ular qayerdan kelganini bilmasam ham, albatta, ularga g'amxo'rlik qilaman.

en: See!— He must have looked at it.—One is from you, and to my friend Peter Hawkins.
uz: Ko'ring! U unga qaragan bo'lishi kerak.Birining o'zi sizdan va do'stim Piter Xokinsdan.

en: The other,—here he caught sight of the strange symbols as he opened the envelope, and the dark look came into his face, and his eyes blazed wickedly,—The other is a vile thing, an outrage upon friendship and hospitality!
uz: Boshqa biri: Bu yerda u qadoqchani ochayotganda g'alati belgilarni ko'rdi va uning yuziga qorong'i ko'rinish tushdi va uning ko'zlari yovuzlik bilan yonib ketdi, - deb aytdi.

en: So it cannot matter to us.And he calmly held letter and envelope in the ﬂame of the lamp till they were consumed.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu bizga ahamiyat bermaydi.O'zi esa yozuv va qadoqchani olov olov olovida yonib ketgunga qadar tinchlik bilan ushlab turdi.

en: Then he went on, The letter to Hawkins, that I shall, of course send on, since it is yours.
uz: Keyin u davom etdi: Hokinsga yozilgan maktubni, albatta, yuboraman, chunki u sizning maktubingizdir.

en: Your letters are sacred to me.
uz: Sizning maktublaringiz men uchun muqaddasdir.

en: Your pardon, my friend, that unknowingly I did break the seal.
uz: Kechirasiz, do'stim, bilmasdan muhrni buzganim uchun.

en: Will you not cover it again?He held out the letter to me, and with a courteous bow handed me a clean envelope.
uz: Siz uni yana ko'chirmaysizmi? - deb so'radi.U xatni menga uzatdi va xushmuomalalik bilan qo'l urib, menga toza zarba berdi.

en: I could only redirect it and hand it to him in silence.
uz: Men uni faqat o'zgartirib, uncha sukut saqlashim mumkin edi.

en: When he went out of the room I could hear the key turn softly.
uz: U xonadan chiqqanida, men kalitni sekin o'chirib ketayotganini eshitdim.

en: A minute later I went over and tried it, and the door was locked.
uz: Bir daqiqa o'tgach, men o'zimga yaqinlashib, uni sinab ko'rdim va eshik qulflab qo'yildi.

en: When, an hour or two after, the Count came quietly into the room, his coming awakened me, for I had gone to sleep on the sofa.
uz: Bir yoki ikki soat o'tgach, Count xonadonga sekin kirib kelganida, uning kelishi meni uyg'otdi, chunki men sofa ustiga uxlab ketdim.

en: He was very courteous and very cheery in his manner, and seeing that I had been sleep- ing, he said, So, my friend, you are tired?
uz: U juda xushmuomala va juda quvonchli edi va men uxlab ketayotganimni ko'rib, menga: Demak, do'stim, sen charchaganmisiz?

en: There is the surest rest.
uz: Bu erda eng ishonchli dam olish bor.

en: I may not have the pleasure of talk tonight, since there are many labours to me, but you will sleep, I pray. I passed to my room and went to bed, and, strange to say, slept without dreaming.
uz: Ehtimol, bu kecha men uchun gapirish zavqidan mahrum bo'lishim mumkin, chunki men uchun ko'p ishlar bor, lekin siz uxlaysiz, deb ibodat qilaman. Men o'z xonamga o'tib, uxlashga ketdim va, g'alati aytganda, tush ko'rmay uxladim.

en: Despair has its own calms.
uz: Charchaganlikning o'z tinchligi bor.

en: 31 May.—This morning when I woke I thought I would provide myself with some papers and envelopes from my bag and keep them in my pocket, so that I might write in case I should get an opportunity, but again a sur- prise, again a shock!
uz: 31 may.Bugun ertalab uyg'onganimda, sumkamdan ba'zi qog'ozlar va konvertlar olib, qopimda saqlab qo'yishimni o'yladim, shunda imkoniyat tug'ilganda yozishim mumkin edi, lekin yana bir tasavvur, yana bir shok!

en: Every scrap of paper was gone, and with it all my notes, my memoranda, relating to railways and travel, my letter of credit, in fact all that might be useful to me were I once outside the castle.
uz: Har bir qog'oz yo'qolgan edi va u bilan birga barcha yozuvlarim, yozuvlarim, temir yo'l va sayohatlar bilan bog'liq xatlarim, kredit xatim, aslida, men bir marta qal'a tashqarida bo'lganimda menga foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha narsalar yo'qolgan edi.

en: I sat and pondered awhile, and then some thought occurred to me, and I made search of my portmanteau and in the wardrobe where I had placed my clothes.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tirib o'ylab ko'rdim, keyin bir o'ylab ko'rdim va kiyim-kechakimni joylashtirgan kiyim-kechak do'konimni qidirib topdim.

en: The suit in which I had travelled was gone, and also my overcoat and rug.
uz: Men sayohat qilgan kostyum, kiyim va ko'ylakim yo'qolgan edi.

en: I could ﬁnd no trace of them anywhere.
uz: Men ularning izlarini qayerda ham topolmadim.

en: This looked like some new scheme of villainy … 17 June.—This morning, as I was sitting on the edge of my bed cud- gelling my brains, I heard without a crackling of whips and pounding and scraping of horses' feet up the rocky path beyond the courtyard.
uz: Bu yangi yovuzlik rejasi kabi ko'rinardi ... 17 iyun.Bugun ertalab, men o'zimning yotoq bo'yida o'tirib, o'zimning miyamni qovurib o'tirganimda, hovli tashqaridagi toshbo'ron yo'ldan otlarning cho'qqisi va oyoqlari urishidan eshitgan edim.

en: With joy I hurried to the window, and saw drive into the yard two great leiter-wagons, each drawn by eight sturdy horses, and at the head of each pair a Slovak, with his wide hat, great nail-studded belt, dirty sheepskin, and high boots.
uz: Men quvonch bilan derazaga yugurdim va saroyga ikkita katta ko'cha vagonlari kirayotganini ko'rdim, ularning har birini sakkiz kuchli ot olib borardi va ularning boshida keng qo'pagi, katta to'g'ri cho'qqisi, kirli qo'y terisi va baland poyabzalga ega bo'lgan slovak kishi bor edi.

en: They had also their long staves in hand.
uz: Shuningdek, qo'lida o'zlarining uzun tayoqlari bor edi.

en: I ran to the door, intending to de- scend and try and join them through the main hall, as I thought that way might be opened for them.
uz: Men eshik tomon yugurib, tushishga va asosiy zal orqali ularga qo'shilishga harakat qildim, chunki bu yo'l ular uchun ochilishi mumkin deb o'yladim.

en: Again a shock, my door was fastened on the outside.
uz: Yana bir sarosima, eshik tashqaridan o'rnatilgan edi.

en: Then I ran to the window and cried to them.
uz: So'ngra men darchaga yugurib, ularga baqirdi.

en: They looked up at me stu- pidly and pointed, but just then the hetman of the Szgany came out, and seeing them pointing to my window, said something, at which they laughed.
uz: Ular menga ko'z tikib, ko'z tikib ko'rsatishdi, lekin o'sha paytda Szganilarning hetmanlari chiqib, ularni derazmimga ko'rsatganini ko'rib, bir narsa aytdi va ular unga kulishdi.

en: Henceforth no effort of mine, no piteous cry or agonized entreaty, would make them even look at me.
uz: Bundan buyon hech qanday harakatlarim, qayg'uli ovozlarim yoki azob chekayotgan iltijolarim ularni menga hatto qarashga majbur qilmaydi.

en: They resolutely turned away.
uz: Ular qat'iylik bilan yuz o'girdilar.

en: The leiter-wag- ons contained great, square boxes, with handles of thick rope.
uz: Leiter-wag-ons katta, kvadratli qutilarni, qalin ipli qo'llanmalarni o'z ichiga olgan edi.

en: These were evidently empty by the ease with which the Slovaks handled them, and by their resonance as they were roughly moved.
uz: Slovaklar ularni osonlikcha ushlab turgani va ular taxminan harakatlanayotgani sababli ularning o'ziga xos maqomlari tufayli bular bo'sh edi.

en: When they were all unloaded and packed in a great heap in one corner of the yard, the Slovaks were given some money by the Szgany, and spitting on it for luck, lazily went each to his horse's head.
uz: Ularning barchasini yuklab olib, hovuzning bir burchagida katta to'plamga to'plaganida, slovaklarga Szganylar tomonidan pul berildi va omad uchun teshiklab, har biri o'z otining boshiga lazzat bilan bordi.

en: Shortly afterwards, I heard the crackling of their whips die away in the distance.
uz: Oradan bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, ularning qamchilari qichqirishini uzoqdan eshitdim.

en: 24 June.—Last night the Count left me early, and locked himself into his own room.
uz: 24 iyun.Kecha kechasi Count meni erta qoldirib, o'z xonasiga o'zini qulflab qo'ydi.

en: As soon as I dared I ran up the winding stair, and looked out of the window, which opened South.
uz: O'zimni jasoratli his qilganimdan so'ng, g'iybatli poyga ustiga yugurib, janubiy tomondan ochilgan derazaga qarab ko'rdim.

en: I thought I would watch for the Count, for there is something going on.
uz: Men Countni kuzatib turishni o'yladim, chunki biron narsa sodir bo'lmoqda.

en: The Szgany are quartered somewhere in the castle and are doing work of some kind.
uz: Szganylar qalʼaning bir joyida joylashgan va qandaydir ishni bajarmoqdalar.

en: I know it, for now and then, I hear a far-away mufﬂed sound as of mattock and spade, and, whatever it is, it must be the end of some ruthless villainy.
uz: Men buni bilaman, vaqti-vaqti bilan men uzoqdan mattoq va qilich kabi so'zlarni eshitaman va nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, bu bir nechta shafqatsiz yovuzlikning oxiri bo'lishi kerak.

en: I had been at the window somewhat less than half an hour, when I saw something coming out of the Count's window.
uz: Yarim soatdan kamroq vaqt davomida oynada bo'lganimda, Countning oynasidan bir narsa chiqib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I drew back and watched carefully, and saw the whole man emerge.
uz: Men orqaga qaytib, diqqat bilan ko'rdim va butun odamning chiqib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: It was a new shock to me to ﬁnd that he had on the suit of clothes which I had worn whilst travelling here, and slung over his shoulder the terrible bag which I had seen the women take away.
uz: Bu men uchun yangi ajablanarli bo'ldi, chunki u bu yerga sayohat qilib kelganimda kiygan kiyimim bilan kiyinib, ayollarning olib ketayotganini ko'rgan dahshatli sumkani yelkasiga tashlagan edi.

en: There could be no doubt as to his quest, and in my garb, too!
uz: Uning izlanishida va mening kiyimimda ham shubha yo'q edi!

en: This, then, is his new scheme of evil, that he will allow others to see me, as they think, so that he may both leave evidence that I have been seen in the towns or villages posting my own letters, and that any wickedness which he may do shall by the local people be attributed to me.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu uning yangi yovuzlik rejasi bo'lib, u boshqalarga meni ular o'ylagandek ko'rishlariga yo'l qo'yadi, shunda u shahar yoki qishloqda mening o'z maktublarimni jo'natganimni ko'rganimga dalil qoldiradi va u qilgan har qanday yomonlik mahalliy aholi tomonidan menga tegishli bo'ladi.

en: It makes me rage to think that this can go on, and whilst I am shut up here, a veritable prisoner, but without that protection of the law which is even a criminal's right and consolation.
uz: Bu holat davom etishi mumkin, deb o'ylash menga g'azablantiradi va men bu yerda qamoqda bo'lganimda, haqiqiy mahbus bo'laman, lekin qonun himoyasi bo'lmagan holda, bu hatto jinoyatchi huquq va tasallidir.
