en: I thought I would watch for the Count's return, and for a long time sat doggedly at the window.
uz: Men Countning qaytib kelishini kutishimni o'yladim va uzoq vaqt davomida darcha oldida qattiqqo'l o'tirdim.

en: Then I began to notice that there were some quaint little specks ﬂoating in the rays of the moonlight.
uz: Keyin esa oy yorug'ligi nurlarida ko'tarilayotgan ba'zi xilma-xil maydonchalar borligini payqadim.

en: They were like the tiniest grains of dust, and they whirled round and gathered in clusters in a nebu- lous sort of way.
uz: Ular toshlarning eng kichkina urug'lariga o'xshar edilar, ular to'p-to'p bo'lib, bulutli tarzda to'p-to'p bo'lib yig'ilishardilar.

en: I watched them with a sense of soothing, and a sort of calm stole over me.
uz: Men ularni tinchlik hissi bilan kuzatib turardim va bir xil xotirjamlik menga o'xshaydi.

en: I leaned back in the embrasure in a more comfortable position, so that I could enjoy more fully the aerial gambolling.
uz: Men havodagi qimor o'ynashdan to'laroq zavqlanish uchun, eng qulay holatda embrasuraga orqaga tiklandim.

en: Something made me start up, a low, piteous howling of dogs somewhere far below in the valley, which was hidden from my sight.
uz: Biror narsa meni boshlashga undagan, ko'zimdan yashirin bo'lgan, vodiyning pastidagi bir joyda itlarning past, achinarli qichqiriqlari.

en: Louder it seemed to ring in my ears, and the ﬂoating moats of dust to take new shapes to the sound as they danced in the moonlight.
uz: Quloqlarimda baland ovoz bilan qichqirib turardi va oy yorug'ligida raqs qilayotgan tovushlarga yangi shakllarni ko'rsatadigan changli cho'g'lar ko'tarildi.

en: I felt myself struggling to awake to some call of my instincts.
uz: Men o'zimni o'zimning istaklarimning biror chaqirichiga uyg'onishga qiynalayotganimni his qildim.

en: Nay, my very soul was struggling, and my half- remembered sensibilities were striving to answer the call.
uz: Yoʻq, oʻz ruhim kurashayotgan edi, va oʻzimning yarim esda qolgan hissiy hissiy hissiy obodligim qoʻngʻiroqga javob berishga harakat qilardi.

en: I was becoming hypnotised!
uz: Men hipnotizatsiyaga berilayotgan edim!

en: Quicker and quicker danced the dust.
uz: To'g'rilik tezroq va tezroq raqsga tushdi.

en: The moonbeams seemed to quiver as they went by me into the mass of gloom beyond.
uz: O'zimdan o'tib o'tgan oy nurlari o'sha yerdagi qorong'ilik to'plamiga kirib ketayotganida, titrab-tirib ketayotganday tuyuldi.

en: More and more they gathered till they seemed to take dim phantom shapes.
uz: Ular ko'proq va ko'proq to'planib, o'zlarining soxta hayajon shakllaridagi bo'lib ko'rinishga ega bo'lishdi.

en: And then I started, broad awake and in full possession of my senses, and ran screaming from the place.
uz: Keyin esa, o'zimni keng uyg'onib, his-tuyg'ularimning to'liq ta'sirida bo'lib, o'sha joydan qichqirib yugurib ketdim.

en: The phantom shapes, which were becoming gradually materialised from the moonbeams, were those three ghostly women to whom I was doomed.
uz: O'shanda oy nurlari orqali asta-sekin paydo bo'layotgan hayajonli shakllar, men o'zimga o'xshab qolgan uchta hayajonli ayol edi.

en: I ﬂed, and felt somewhat safer in my own room, where there was no moonlight, and where the lamp was burning brightly.
uz: Men qochib ketdim va o'zimni o'zimning xonamda, oy yorug'ligi yo'q va chiroq chiroqli joyda biroz xavfsizroq his qildim.

en: When a couple of hours had passed I heard something stirring in the Count's room, something like a sharp wail quickly suppressed.
uz: Bir necha soat o'tgach, Countning xonasida biror narsa harakatlanayotganini eshitdim.

en: And then there was silence, deep, awful silence, which chilled me.
uz: So'ngra meni sovutgan chuqur va dahshatli xotirjamlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: With a beating heart, I tried the door, but I was locked in my prison, and could do nothing.
uz: Qalbim urib, eshikni sinab ko'rdim, lekin men qamoqda qulflab qoldim va hech narsa qila olmadim.

en: I sat down and simply cried.
uz: Men o'tirib, shunchaki yig'ladim.

en: As I sat I heard a sound in the courtyard without, the agonised cry of a woman.
uz: O'tirganimda, tashqi hovlida bir ovozni eshitdim, bu ayolning azob chekayotgan baqiriqidir.

en: I rushed to the window, and throwing it up, peered between the bars.
uz: Men darcha tomon shovqin qildim va uni ko'tarib, barlar o'rtasida ko'z tikdim.

en: There, indeed, was a woman with dishevelled hair, holding her hands over her heart as one distressed with running.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, u yerda sochlari bo'sh bo'lgan bir ayol bor edi, u qo'llarini yuragi ustida ushlab, yugurib ketayotganidan xafa bo'lgan edi.

en: She was leaning against the corner of the gateway.
uz: U eshikning burchasiga tiklanayotgan edi.

en: When she saw my face at the window she threw her- self forward, and shouted in a voice laden with menace, Monster, give me my child! She threw herself on her knees, and raising up her hands, cried the same words in tones which wrung my heart.
uz: Oynaning oldida yuzimni ko'rgach, o'zini oldinga tashladi va qo'rqinch bilan to'lgan ovoz bilan: Monster, menga bolamni ber! - deb baqirdi. U o'zini tiz cho'kib, qo'llarini ko'tarib, qalbimni silkitgan o'sha o'sha so'zlarni baland ovoz bilan aytdi.

en: Then she tore her hair and beat her breast, and abandoned herself to all the violences of extravagant emotion.
uz: Keyin u sochlarini yirtib, ko'kraklarini urdi va o'zini o'ziga xos tuyg'ularning zo'ravonligiga berardi.

en: Finally, she threw herself forward, and though I could not see her, I could hear the beating of her naked hands against the door.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'zini oldinga tashladi va men uni ko'rmasdim, lekin uning yalang'och qo'llarining eshikga urishini eshitardim.

en: Somewhere high overhead, probably on the tower, I heard the voice of the Count calling in his harsh, metallic whisper.
uz: Bir joyda yuqoriga, ehtimol, minoraga, men Countning qattiq, metall shovqinini eshitdim.

en: His call seemed to be an- swered from far and wide by the howling of wolves.
uz: Uning chaqirig'i uzoqdan bo'lgan qurtlarning qichqiriqlari bilan o'zgartirilgan edi.

en: Before many minutes had passed a pack of them poured, like a pent-up dam when liberated, through the wide entrance into the courtyard.
uz: Ko'p daqiqalar o'tmay, bir to'plam ichimliklar hovlidagi keng kirish yo'li bo'ylab to'kilib ketdi.

en: There was no cry from the woman, and the howling of the wolves was but short.
uz: Ayolning yig'i-sig'i yo'q edi va bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari qisqagina bo'lgan.

en: Before long they streamed away singly, licking their lips.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay ular yolg'iz o'z tiliga tushib, og'izlarini yulib ketishdi.

en: I could not pity her, for I knew now what had become of her child, and she was better dead.
uz: Men unga rahm qilolmasdim, chunki endi uning bolasiga nima bo'lganini bilardim va u o'lganidan ko'ra yaxshiroq edi.

en: How can I escape from this dreadful thing of night, gloom, and fear?
uz: Qanday qilib kechasi, qorong'iligi va qo'rquvidan qochib qutulishim mumkin?

en: 25 June.—No man knows till he has suffered from the night how sweet and dear to his heart and eye the morning can be.
uz: 25 iyun.Har kim kechadan azob chekmaguncha, uning yuragi va ko'zi uchun ertalab qanchalik shirin va sevimli bo'lishi mumkinligini bilmaydi.

en: When the sun grew so high this morning that it struck the top of the great gateway opposite my window, the high spot which it touched seemed to me as if the dove from the ark had lighted there.
uz: Bugun ertalab quyosh shunchalik baland ko'tarilganki, oynamning o'zi oldida turgan buyuk darvoza tomonini urganida, u tutgan baland joy menga xuddi kemadagi kaptar yonib ketganidek ko'rindi.

en: My fear fell from me as if it had been a vaporous garment which dissolved in the warmth.
uz: Qo'rquvim o'zimdan yog'ib ketdi, xuddi issiqlikda erib ketgan bug'lik kiyim kabi.

en: I must take action of some sort whilst the courage of the day is upon me.
uz: Kunning jasorati boshimga tushguncha, biror chora ko'rishim kerak.

en: Last night one of my post-dated letters went to post, the ﬁrst of that fatal
uz: Kecha kechasi mening post-datlangan xatlarimdan biri jo'natildi, bu birinchi fatal xat edi

en: series which is to blot out the very traces of my existence from the earth.
uz: Bu qator mening mavjudligimning izlarini yer yuzidan o'chirib tashlaydi.

en: Let me not think of it.
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylamayman.

en: It has always been at night-time that I have been molested or threatened, or in some way in danger or in fear.
uz: Men har doim kechasi zo'ravonlik yoki tahdidga duchor bo'lganman yoki qandaydir xavf yoki qo'rquv ostida bo'lganman.

en: I have not yet seen the Count in the daylight.
uz: Men hidoyatni kun yorug'ligida ko'rmaganman.

en: Can it be that he sleeps when others wake, that he may be awake whilst they sleep?
uz: Boshqalar uyg'ongan paytda u uxlab ketishi mumkinmi, ular uxlayotganda u uyg'onishi mumkinmi?

en: If I could only get into his room!
uz: Agar men uning xonasiga kirishim mumkin bo'lsa!

en: But there is no possible way.
uz: Ammo buning iloji yo'q.

en: The door is always locked, no way for me.
uz: Eshik doimo qulflab turadi, men uchun hech qanday yo'l yo'q.

en: Yes, there is a way, if one dares to take it.
uz: Ha, yo'l bor, agar u yo'ldan yurishga jur'at qilsa.

en: Where his body has gone why may not another body go?
uz: Uning tanasi qayerda bo'lgan bo'lsa, nega boshqa bir tanasi bormaydi?

en: I have seen him myself crawl from his window.
uz: O'zim uni o'zining darvozasidan o'rab o'tirib ko'rdim.

en: Why should not I imitate him, and go in by his window?
uz: Nima uchun uning o'rnagiga ergashib, uning oynalaridan kirib kirmasam bo'ladi?

en: The chances are desperate, but my need is more desperate still.
uz: Ehtimol, bu umidsizlikka uchraydi, lekin mening ehtiyojim bundan ham ko'proq umidsizlikka uchraydi.

en: At the worst it can only be death, and a man's death is not a calf's, and the dreaded Here- after may still be open to me.
uz: Eng yomon holatda esa, bu faqat o'lim bo'lishi mumkin va odamning o'limi buzoqning o'limi emas va qo'rqinchli Ushbu - keyin hali ham menga ochiq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: God help me in my task!
uz: Xudo menga vazifamda yordam bersin!

en: Goodbye, Mina, if I fail.
uz: Xo'sh, Mina, agar men muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasam.

en: Goodbye, my faithful friend and second father.
uz: Xo'sh, sodiq do'stim va ikkinchi otam.

en: Goodbye, all, and last of all Mina!
uz: Barchaga va nihoyat, barchaga salom, Mina!

en: Same day, later.—I have made the effort, and God helping me, have come safely back to this room.
uz: O'sha kuni, keyinroq.Men harakat qildim va Xudo menga yordam berib, bu xonada omon-omon qaytdim.

en: I must put down every detail in order.
uz: Har bir tafsilotni tartib bilan yozib qo'yishim kerak.

en: I went whilst my courage was fresh straight to the window on the south side, and at once got outside on this side.
uz: Men jasoratim chiroyli bo'lganida, janubiy tomondagi derazaga bordim va darhol shu tomonda chiqdim.

en: The stones are big and roughly cut, and the mortar has by process of time been washed away between them.
uz: Toshlar katta va taxminan kesilgan va vaqt o'tishi bilan ularning orasidagi mortar yuvildi.

en: I took off my boots, and ventured out on the desperate way.
uz: Choʻplarimni olib tashlab, umidsizlikka tushib ketdim.

en: I looked down once, so as to make sure that a sudden glimpse of the awful depth would not overcome me, but after that kept my eyes away from it.
uz: Men bir marta ko'zimni pastga ko'rdim, agar dahshatli chuqurlikning to'satdan ko'rinishi meni bosib o'tmasin deb, lekin keyinchalik ko'zimni undan uzoqlashtirdim.

en: I know pretty well the direc- tion and distance of the Count's window, and made for it as well as I could, having regard to the opportunities available.
uz: Men Countning oynasining yo'nalishi va masofasini yaxshi bilaman va imkoniyatlarni hisobga olgan holda imkon qadar yaxshi tayyorladim.

en: I did not feel dizzy, I suppose I was too excited, and the time seemed ridiculously short till I found myself standing on the window sill and trying to raise up the sash.
uz: O'zimni burchli his qilmasdim, balki juda hayajonlangan edim va vaqt o'ta qisqa tuyulgan edi, hatto o'zimni deraza ustunida turib, pishirmani ko'tarishga harakat qilgandim.

en: I was ﬁlled with agitation, however, when I bent down and slid feet foremost in through the window.
uz: Biroq, o'zimni egib, o'zimning oyoqlarimni birinchi bo'lib oynadan past olib kirganimda, juda hayajonlangan edim.

en: Then I looked around for the Count, but with surprise and glad- ness, made a discovery.
uz: So'ngra men Countni qidirib topdim, lekin hayronlik va quvonch bilan bir kashfiyot qildim.

en: It was barely furnished with odd things, which seemed to have never been used.
uz: U hech qachon ishlatilmagan ko'rinadigan g'ayritabiiy narsalar bilan ta'minlangan edi.

en: The furniture was something the same style as that in the south rooms, and was covered with dust.
uz: Mebellar janubiy xonalar uslubidagi uslubga o'xshash edi va tuproq bilan qoplangan edi.

en: I looked for the key, but it was not in the lock, and I could not ﬁnd it anywhere.
uz: Men kalitni qidirdim, lekin u qulfda yo'q edi va hech qayerda topolmadim.

en: The only thing I found was a great heap of gold in one corner, gold of all kinds, Roman, and British, and Austrian, and Hungarian,and Greek and Turkish money, covered with a ﬁlm of dust, as though it had lain long in the ground.
uz: Faqatgina bir burchada katta oltin to'plami topdim, bu turli xil oltin, Rim, Britaniya, Avstriya, Vengriya, Yunon va Turkiya pullari, xuddi tuproq bilan qoplangan bo'lgani kabi, yer ostida uzoq vaqt yotgan edi.

en: None of it that I noticed was less than
uz: Men ko'rdimki, bularning hech biridan kam emas edi.

en: three hundred years old.
uz: U uch yuz yoshga to'lgan.

en: There were also chains and ornaments, some jew- elled, but all of them old and stained.
uz: Shuningdek, zanjirlar va bezaklar ham bor edi, ba'zilari yahudiy bo'lgan, ammo ularning barchasi eski va qora.

en: At one corner of the room was a heavy door.
uz: Xonaning bir burchagida og'ir eshik bor edi.

en: I tried it, for, since I could not ﬁnd the key of the room or the key of the outer door, which was the main object of my search, I must make further examination, or all my ef- forts would be in vain.
uz: Men uni sinab ko'rdim, chunki xonaning kalitini yoki tashki eshikning kalitini topolmadim, chunki bu qidiruvimning asosiy maqsadi edi, shuning uchun yanada ko'proq tekshirib ko'rishim kerak, aks holda barcha harakatlarim behuda bo'ladi.

en: It was open, and led through a stone passage to a cir- cular stairway, which went steeply down.
uz: U ochiq edi va toshdan o'tib, to'rtburchakdagi sinchkovga yetib borardi.

en: I descended, minding carefully where I went for the stairs were dark, be- ing only lit by loopholes in the heavy masonry.
uz: Men pastga tushdim va qayerga borishimga diqqat bilan e'tibor berdim, chunki poygalar qorong'i edi va faqat og'ir masonlikdagi bo'shliqlar bilan yoritilgan edi.

en: At the bottom there was a dark, tunnel-like passage, through which came a deathly, sickly odour, the odour of old earth newly turned.
uz: Quyida tunel kabi qorong'u bir yo'l bor edi, undan o'limga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan, kasallik keltiradigan hid, yangi o'zgargan eski yerning hidini o'tkazadi.

en: As I went through the passage the smell grew closer and heavier.
uz: O'sha yo'ldan o'tganimda, bu hid yanada yaqinlashib, og'irlashdi.

en: At last I pulled open a heavy door which stood ajar, and found myself in an old ruined chapel, which had evidently been used as a graveyard.
uz: Nihoyat, men o'zimni oldingi vayron qilingan kapellaga olib kirdim va u qabriston sifatida ishlatilgan edi.

en: The roof was broken, and in two places were steps leading to vaults, but the ground had recently been dug over, and the earth placed in great wooden boxes, manifestly those which had been brought by the Slovaks.
uz: Tovush buzilgan edi va ikkita joyda vaftlarga olib boradigan qadamlar bor edi, ammo yer yaqinda qazilgan edi va yer katta yog'och qutilarga joylashtirilgan edi, bu esa slovaklar tomonidan olib kelingan.

en: There was nobody about, and I made a search over every inch of the ground, so as not to lose a chance.
uz: U yerda hech kim yo'q edi va men hech qanday imkoniyatni yo'qotmaslik uchun yerning har bir santimetrini qidirib topdim.

en: I went down even into the vaults, where the dim light struggled, although to do so was a dread to my very soul.
uz: Hatto vaftlarga ham tushdim, u yerda kam nurlar ko'tarildi, ammo bu ruhim uchun qo'rquv edi.

en: Into two of these I went, but saw nothing except fragments of old cofﬁns and piles of dust.
uz: Ikkitasiga kirdim, lekin eski qovushlar va chang to'plamlaridan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmadim.

en: In the third, however, I made a discovery.
uz: Biroq, uchinchi bosqichda men kashfiyot qildim.

en: There, in one of the great boxes, of which there were ﬁfty in all, on a pile of newly dug earth, lay the Count!
uz: U erda, katta qutilardan birida, ularning hammasi yigirma bo'lgan, yangi qazilgan tuproq to'plami ustida Count o'tirgan!

en: He was either dead or asleep.
uz: U yoki o'lgan, yoki uxlab qolgan edi.

en: I could not say which, for eyes were open and stony, but without the glassiness of death, and the cheeks had the warmth of life through all their pallor.
uz: Qaysilarini aytolmadim, chunki ko'zlar ochiq va toshli edi, lekin o'limning shishaligi bo'lmagan va yig'inlar butun ko'rinishlarida hayotning issiqligiga ega edi.

en: The lips were as red as ever.
uz: Og'izlar har doimgidek qizil edi.

en: But there was no sign of movement, no pulse, no breath, no beating of the heart.
uz: Ammo harakatlanish, urish, nafas olish, yurak urish ko'rinishi yo'q edi.

en: I bent over him, and tried to ﬁnd any sign of life, but in vain.
uz: Men uning ustiga o'girib, hayot izlarini topishga harakat qildim, lekin befoyda.

en: He could not have lain there long, for the earthy smell would have passed away in a few hours.
uz: U yerda uzoq o'tirolmasdi, chunki yerning buzi bir necha soat ichida o'tib ketardi.

en: By the side of the box was its cover, pierced with holes here and there.
uz: Qutuqning yonida uning qopqog'i bor edi, bu yerda va u yerda teshiklar bor edi.

en: I thought he might have the keys on him, but when I went to search I saw the dead eyes, and in them dead though they were, such a look of hate, though unconscious of me or my presence, that I ﬂed from the place, and leaving the Count's room by the window, crawled again up the castle wall.
uz: Men uning ustida kalitlar bor deb o'yladim, lekin qidirishga borganimda, o'lik ko'zlar ko'rdim, ular o'lgan bo'lsa-da, shunchalik nafratga to'lib, hatto men yoki mening hozirligimdan bexabar bo'lishgani uchun, men u yerdan qochib ketdim va grafning xonasini deraza tomondan tashlab, yana qal'a devoriga chiqib ketdim.

en: Regaining my room, I threw myself panting upon the bed and tried to think.
uz: Xonamga qaytish uchun o'zimni yotoq ustiga tashlab, o'ylashga harakat qildim.

en: 29 June.—Today is the date of my last letter, and the Count has taken steps to prove that it was genuine, for again I saw him leave the castle by the same window, and in my clothes.
uz: 29 iyun.Bugun mening so'nggi maktubimning sanasi va Count uning haqiqiyligini isbotlash uchun qadamlar qo'ydi, chunki men uni yana o'sha oyna orqali, mening kiyimim bilan qal'ani tark etishini ko'rdim.

en: As he went down the wall, lizard fash- ion, I wished I had a gun or some lethal weapon, that I might destroy him.
uz: U devorga tushganda, tovuq-mash-ion, uni yo'q qilish uchun o'zimda qurol yoki biron o'ldiruvchi qurol bo'lishini istardim.

en: But I fear that no weapon wrought along by man's hand would have any ef- fect on him.
uz: Ammo qo'rqamanki, inson qo'li bilan yaratilgan hech qanday qurol unga hech qanday ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi.

en: I dared not wait to see him return, for I feared to see those weird sisters.
uz: U qaytib kelishini kutishga jur'at qilmadim, chunki men o'sha g'alati singillarni ko'rishdan qo'rqardim.

en: I came back to the library, and read there till I fell asleep.
uz: Men kutubxonaga qaytib kelib, uyquga tushgunimcha o'qib chiqdim.

en: I was awakened by the Count, who looked at me as grimly as a man could look as he said,Tomorrow, my friend, we must part.
uz: Meni Count uyg'otdi, u menga odam ko'rinishi mumkin bo'lgan qadar qorong'u ko'rinishni ko'rib: Ertaga, do'stim, ajrashishimiz kerak.

en: You return to your beautiful England, I to some work which may have such an end that we may never meet.
uz: Siz o'zingizning go'zal Angliyaga, men esa hech qachon uchrashmasligimiz mumkin bo'lgan ishlarga qaytasiz.

en: Your letter home has been despatched.
uz: Sizning uyingizga xat yuborilgan.

en: Tomorrow I shall not be here, but all shall be ready for your journey.
uz: Ertaga men bu yerda bo'lmayman, lekin hamma sizning sayohatingizga tayyor bo'ladi.

en: In the morning come the Szgany, who have some labours of their own here, and also come some Slovaks.
uz: Ertalab Szganylar keladi, ular bu yerda o'z ishlarida ishtirok etadilar, shuningdek, Slovakiyaliklar ham keladilar.

en: When they have gone, my carriage shall come for you, and shall bear you to the Borgo Pass to meet the diligence from Bukovina to Bistritz.
uz: Ular ketgach, mening arabam siz uchun kelib, sizni Bukovinadan Bistritzgacha boradigan sayohatga Borgo o'tishidan olib boradi.

en: But I am in hopes that I shall see more of you at Castle Dracula. I suspected him, and determined to test his sincerity.
uz: Lekin men sizlarni Dracula qalʼasida koʻrishingizni umid qilaman. - deb uni shubha ostiga oldim va uning samimiyligini sinashga qaror qildim.

en: It seems like a profanation of the word to write it in connection with such a monster, so I asked him pointblank, Why may I not go tonight? Because, dear sir, my coachman and horses are away on a mission. But I would walk with pleasure.
uz: Bu so'zni bunday qudratli hayvon bilan bog'liq qilib yozish, bu so'zning ifloslanishiga o'xshaydi, shuning uchun men unga aniq so'radim: Nima uchun men bugun kechqurun bormasam bo'ladi?

en: I want to get away at once. He smiled, such a soft, smooth, diabolical smile that I knew there was some trick behind his smoothness.
uz: Men darhol qochib ketmoqchiman. - deb tabassum qildi u, shunchalik yumshoq, sekin, yovuz tabassum bilan, uning sekinligi ortida biron bir hiyla borligini bilardim.

en: He said, And your baggage? I do not care about it.
uz: U: Sizning bagajingiz nima? - deb so'radi.

en: I can send for it some other time. The Count stood up, and said, with a sweet courtesy which made me rub my eyes, it seemed so real, You English have a saying which is close to my heart, for its spirit is that which rules our boyars, `Welcome the coming, speed the parting guest.' Come with me, my dear young friend.
uz: Men uni boshqa bir marta yuboraman. - deb so'ragan Count o'rnidan turib, ko'zlarimni o'chirib ko'rishimga sabab bo'lgan mehribonlik bilan shunday dedi: Siz inglizlarning yuragimga yaqin bo'lgan bir gapingiz bor, chunki uning ruhi bizning boyarlarimizni boshqaradi, ` Welcome the coming, speed the departing guest.

en: Not an hour shall you wait in my house against your will, though sad am I at your going, and that you so suddenly desire it.
uz: Siz ketayotganingizda men xafa bo'lsam-da, bir soat ham o'zingizning xohishingizga qarshi uyimda kutmaysiz, chunki siz buni to'satdan xohlaysiz.

en: Come! With a stately gravity, he, with the lamp, preceded me down the stairs and along the hall.
uz: Kel! - deb qo'l urib, u chiroq bilan mendan oldingicha mertaga tushib, chodir bo'ylab yurdi.

en: Suddenly he stopped.
uz: Toʻsatdan u toʻxtadi.

en: Hark! Close at hand came the howling of many wolves.
uz: Hark! - deb yaqin orada ko'plab bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari eshitildi.

en: It was almost as if the sound sprang up at the rising of his hand, just as the music of a great or- chestra seems to leap under the baton of the conductor.
uz: Uning qo'li ko'tarilganida ovoz paydo bo'lgani kabi, katta orkestr musiqasi dirijordan qo'lga olingan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: After a pause of a moment, he proceeded, in his stately way, to the door, drew back the pon- derous bolts, unhooked the heavy chains, and began to draw it open.
uz: Bir muncha to'xtab o'tgach, u o'zining ulug'vor yo'lida eshikga bordi, o'tkir boltlarni orqaga tortib, og'ir zanjirlarni ajratib, eshikni ochishni boshladi.

en: To my intense astonishment I saw that it was unlocked.
uz: O'zimni juda hayratda qoldirganimda, uni ochib qo'yganimni ko'rdim.

en: Suspiciously, I looked all round, but could see no key of any kind.
uz: Shubhasiz, men atrofga qarab ko'rdim, lekin hech qanday kalit ko'rmadim.

en: As the door began to open, the howling of the wolves without grew loud- er and angrier.
uz: Eshik ochilgani sayin, boʻgʻrilarning qichqiriqlari baland va gʻazabga toʻlib-toshdi.

en: Their red jaws, with champing teeth, and their blunt-clawed feet as they leaped, came in through the opening door.
uz: Qizil chehralari, chempioncha tishlari va qochib o'tish paytida to'plamli oyoqlari eshikdan kirib keldi.

en: I knew than that to struggle at the moment against the Count was useless.
uz: Men o'zim bilganimcha, hozir Count bilan kurashish foydasiz.

en: With such allies as these at his command, I could do nothing.
uz: Uning amrida bo'lgan bunday ittifoqchilar bilan men hech narsa qila olmasdim.

en: But still the door continued slowly to open, and only the Count's body stood in the gap.
uz: Ammo eshik asta-sekin ochilishiga to'g'ri keldi va faqat Countning jasadi bo'shliq ichida qoldi.

en: Suddenly it struck me that this might be the moment and means of my doom.
uz: Toʻsatdan, bu mening halokatimning vaqti va yoʻli boʻlishi mumkinligi haqida oʻyladim.

en: I was to be given to the wolves, and at my own instiga- tion.
uz: Men o'z xohishim bilan bo'rilarga berilishim kerak edi.

en: There was a diabolical wickedness in the idea great enough for the Count, and as the last chance I cried out, Shut the door!
uz: Count uchun yetarlicha katta fikrda yovuzlik bor edi va men so'nggi imkoniyat sifatida: Kapi yoping!

en: I shall wait till morning. And I covered my face with my hands to hide my tears of bitter disappointment.
uz: Men ertagacha kutaman. - deb qo'llarim bilan yuzimni qopladim va o'zimning achchiq umidsizlikdan yig'lagan ko'z yoshlarimni yashirdim.

en: With one sweep of his powerful arm, the Count threw the door shut, and the great bolts clanged and echoed through the hall as they shot back into their places.
uz: Count kuchli qo'li bilan eshikni yopib qo'ydi va katta boltlar o'z o'rinlariga qaytib kelganlarida, zalda o'z ovozlarini to'qnashtirdi.

en: In silence we returned to the library, and after a minute or two I went to my own room.
uz: Biz sukut saqlashda kutubxonaga qaytdik va bir-ikki daqiqadan so'ng men o'z xonamga bordim.

en: The last I saw of Count Dracula was his kissing his hand to me, with a red light of triumph in his eyes, and with a smile that Judas in hell might be proud of.
uz: Count Draculani oxirgi bor ko'rganimda, u menga qo'lini o'qib, ko'zlarida g'alaba qizil nurini ko'rib, jahannamdagi Yahudo faxrlanadigan tabassum bilan o'ldirgan edi.

en: When I was in my room and about to lie down, I thought I heard a whis- pering at my door.
uz: Xonamda yotganimda, eshikda shovqin eshitganimni his qildim.

en: I went to it softly and listened.
uz: Men unga sekinlik bilan borib tingladim.

en: Unless my ears deceived me, I heard the voice of the Count.
uz: Quloqlarim meni aldamagan bo'lsa-da, Countning ovozini eshitdim.

en: Back to your own place!
uz: O'z joyingizga qayting!

en: Your time is not yet come.
uz: Sizning vaqtingiz hali kelmagan.

en: Tomorrow night is yours! There was a low, sweet ripple of laughter, and in a rage I threw open the door, and saw without the three terrible women licking their lips.
uz: Ertaga kechasi sening! - deb o'ylashim mumkin edi. Qichqiriqning salqin, shirin surʼati bo'lib, g'azabga to'lib eshikni ochdim va uchta dahshatli ayolni ko'rdim. Ular o'z og'izlarini yaltirishgan.

en: As I ap- peared, they all joined in a horrible laugh, and ran away.
uz: Men ko'z o'ngimda bo'lganimda, hamma qo'shilib kulishdi va qochib ketishdi.

en: I came back to my room and threw myself on my knees.
uz: O'zimning xonamga qaytib kelib, tiz cho'kdim.

en: It is then so near the end?
uz: Shunday qilib, oxirat shunchalik yaqinmi?

en: Lord, help me, and those to whom I am dear!
uz: Rabbim, menga va yaqinlarimga yordam bergin!

en: 30 June.—These may be the last words I ever write in this diary.
uz: 30 iyun.Bu mening ushbu kundalik kitobimda yozgan oxirgi so'zlarim bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I slept till just before the dawn, and when I woke threw myself on my knees, for I determined that if Death came he should ﬁnd me ready.
uz: Men tonggacha uxladim va uyg'onganimda, o'zimni tiz cho'ktirib yubordim, chunki o'lim kelsa, u meni tayyor holda topadi, deb qaror qildim.

en: At last I felt that subtle change in the air, and knew that the morning had come.
uz: Oxir-oqibat havodagi o'zgarishlarni his etib, ertalabning kelishini bilardim.

en: Then came the welcome cock-crow, and I felt that I was safe.
uz: So'ngra xush kelibsiz qo'zilar qo'rqoqlari keldi va men o'zimni xavfsiz his qildim.

en: glad heart, I opened the door and ran down the hall.
uz: Men quvonch bilan eshikni ochib, koridordan yorilib ketdim.

en: I had seen that the door was unlocked, and now escape was before me.
uz: Men eshikning qulfsiz ekanini ko'rdim va endi qochishim kerak edi.

en: With hands that trembled with eagerness, I unhooked the chains and threw back the massive bolts.
uz: Ishq-idrok bilan titrab turgan qo'llarim bilan zanjirlarni bo'shatdim va ulkan boltlarni qaytarib yubordim.

en: But the door would not move.
uz: Ammo eshik harakatlanmadi.

en: I pulled and pulled at the door, and shook it till, massive as it was, it rattled in its casement.
uz: Men eshikni tortdim va tortdim va uni qattiq bo'lganidan keyin, o'z qopqog'ida shovqin qildi.

en: I could see the bolt shot.
uz: O'qishni ko'rardim.

en: It had been locked after I left the Count.
uz: Men Countni tark etganimdan keyin u qulflab qo'yilgan edi.

en: Then a wild desire took me to obtain the key at any risk, and I deter- mined then and there to scale the wall again, and gain the Count's room.
uz: Keyin bir yovvoyi istak meni kalitni har qanday xavf bilan olishimga olib keldi va men yana devorni ko'tarishga va Count xonasiga ega bo'lishga qaror qildim.

en: He might kill me, but death now seemed the happier choice of evils.
uz: U meni o'ldirishi mumkin edi, lekin o'lim endi yomonliklarning eng baxtli tanlovi bo'lib tuyulgan.

en: Without a pause I rushed up to the east window, and scrambled down the wall, as be- fore, into the Count's room.
uz: Men biroz to'xtamasdan sharqiy darchaga bordim va devorni pastga surib, Count xonasiga kirdim.

en: It was empty, but that was as I expected.
uz: U bo'sh edi, ammo bu men kutganimdek bo'ldi.

en: I could not see a key anywhere, but the heap of gold remained.
uz: Men hech joyda kalitni ko'rmadim, lekin oltin to'plami qoldi.

en: I went through the door in the corner and down the winding stair and along the dark passage to the old chapel.
uz: Men burchakdagi eshikdan o'tib, burchakli poyabzaldan pastga tushib, qorong'u yo'ldan o'tib, eski chapelga bordim.

en: I knew now well enough where to ﬁnd the monster I sought.
uz: Endi men qidirayotgan haykalni qayerdan topish kerakligini yaxshi bilardim.

en: The great box was in the same place, close against the wall, but the lid was laid on it, not fastened down, but with the nails ready in their places to be hammered home.
uz: Buyuk quti shu joyda, devorga yaqin edi, lekin uning ustiga qopqoq qo'yilgan edi, u yerda qutilib ketmagan, balki qutilar joyida o'z joylarida o'rnatilgan edi.

en: I knew I must reach the body for the key, so I raised the lid, and laid it back against the wall.
uz: Men o'zimning tanamga qo'l tegizishim kerakligini bilardim, shuning uchun men qopqog'imni ko'tarib, devorga qo'ydim.

en: And then I saw something which ﬁlled my very soul with horror.
uz: So'ngra ruhimni dahshat bilan to'ldirgan narsani ko'rdim.

en: There lay the Count, but looking as if his youth had been half restored.
uz: Bu yerda Count yotgan edi, ammo yoshligi yarim tiklangan bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi.

en: For the white hair and moustache were changed to dark irongrey.
uz: Chunki oq sochlar va mustashlari qorong'i rangga o'zgartirilgan.

en: The cheeks were fuller, and the white skin seemed ruby-red underneath.
uz: Tangilar to'laroq edi va oq teri ostida qizil rangda ko'rinardi.

en: The mouth was redder than ever, for on the lips were gouts of fresh blood, which trickled from the corners of the mouth and ran down over the chin and neck.
uz: Og'iz har qachongidan ko'ra qizilroq edi, chunki og'izlarda yangi qon qo'rqinchlari bor edi, u og'izning burchaklaridan oqib, burun va bo'yni ustiga tushdi.

en: Even the deep, burning eyes seemed set amongst swollen ﬂesh, for the lids and pouches underneath were bloated.
uz: Hatto chuqur, yonayotgan ko'zlar ham yuvilgan go'shtning o'rtasida o'tirgan bo'lib ko'rinardi, chunki pastdagi qopqog'lar va sumkalar puflab ketgan edi.

en: It seemed as if the whole awful creature were simply gorged with blood.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, butun dahshatli mavjudot shunchaki qon bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: He lay like a ﬁlthy leech, exhausted with his repletion.
uz: U o'zining to'qnashuvi bilan charchagan, kirgiz cho'chqa kabi yotgan edi.

en: I shuddered as I bent over to touch him, and every sense in me revolted at the contact, but I had to search, or I was lost.
uz: Men unga tegish uchun egri bo'lganimda titrardim va ichimda bo'lgan har bir his-tuyg'u u bilan bog'lanishdan qaytib ketdi, lekin men qidirishim kerak edi, aks holda yo'qolgan edim.

en: The coming night might see my own body a banquet in a similar war to those horrid three.
uz: Kelgusi kecha o'z badanimni o'sha dahshatli uch kishiga o'xshash urushda tantana sifatida ko'rish mumkin.

en: I felt all over the body, but no sign could I ﬁnd of the key.
uz: O'zimni butun tanamda his qildim, lekin kalitning hech qanday belgisini topolmadim.

en: Then I stopped and looked at the Count.
uz: Keyin to'xtadim va Countga qaradim.

en: There was a mocking smile on the bloated face which seemed to drive me mad.
uz: O'z ko'zidan ko'tarilgan tabassum meni g'alati qilib qo'ygan edi.

en: This was the being I was helping to transfer to London, where, perhaps, for centuries to come he might, amongst its teeming mil- lions, satiate his lust for blood, and create a new and ever-widening circle of semi-demons to batten on the helpless.
uz: Bu men Londonga o'tkazishga yordam berayotgan mavjudot edi, u erda, ehtimol, kelgusi asrlar davomida, uning millionlab odamlari orasida, qonga bo'lgan istakini to'ldirishi va yordamsizlarga urish uchun yarim jinlarning yangi va kenglashib borayotgan doirasini yaratishi mumkin.

en: The very thought drove me mad.
uz: O'sha fikr meni aqldan ozdirdi.

en: A terrible desire came upon me to rid the world of such a monster.
uz: Dunyoda bunday qudratli hayvonlardan xalos bo'lish istagi paydo bo'ldi.

en: There was no lethal weapon at hand, but I seized a shovel which the workmen had been using to ﬁll the cases, and lift- ing it high, struck, with the edge downward, at the hateful face.
uz: Qo'limda o'ldiruvchi qurol yo'q edi, lekin men ishchilar kassalarni to'ldirish uchun ishlatgan lopani ushlab, uni baland ko'tarib, o'ng tomoni pastga, nafratga to'lgan yuziga urdim.

en: But as I did so the head turned, and the eyes fell upon me, with all their blaze of basilisk horror.
uz: Ammo shunday qilib, boshim o'girilib, ko'zlarim o'zimga tushib qoldi, bularning barchasi basiliska dahshatining o'tkirligi bilan.

en: The sight seemed to paralyze me, and the shovel turned in my hand and glanced from the face, merely making a deep gash above the forehead.
uz: Bu ko'rinish meni to'sqinlikka tushirdi va qo'limdagi lopadani o'zgartirib, yuzimdan ko'z o'ngimga qarab, faqat oldimdan chuqur cho'g'rilik qildi.

en: The shovel fell from my hand across the box, and as I pulled it away the ﬂange of the blade caught the edge of the lid which fell over again, and hid the horrid thing from my sight.
uz: Qo'limdan qo'ldan qo'ldan pastga tushdi va uni olib ketayotganimda, o'qning flensi qopqog'ining bo'g'ini ushlab, yana pastga tushdi va dahshatli narsani ko'zimdan yashirdi.

en: The last glimpse I had was of the bloated face, blood-stained and ﬁxed with a grin of malice which would have held its own in the nethermost hell.
uz: So'nggi ko'zimda u qanli, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'tarilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'rilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'rilgan, ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli ko'ngli.

en: I thought and thought what should be my next move, but my brain seemed on ﬁre, and I waited with a despairing feeling growing over me.
uz: Men keyingi harakatimni o'ylab ko'rardim, lekin miyam yonayotgan bo'lib ko'rindi va umidsizlik hissi o'sib borayotganini kutardim.

en: As I waited I heard in the distance a gipsy song sung by merry voices coming closer, and through their song the rolling of heavy wheels and the cracking of whips.
uz: Men kutganimda, uzoqlikda quvonchli ovozlar yaqinlashib, ularning qo'shiqidan og'ir g'ildiraklarning aylanishi va qamchilaqlarning yirtilib ketishi bilan kuylanayotgan g'iybatli qo'shiqni eshitdim.

en: The Szgany and the Slovaks of whom the Count had spoken were coming.
uz: Szganylar va Count aytib o'tgan slovaklar kelmoqda.

en: With a last look around and at the box which contained the vile body, I ran from the place and gained the Count's room, determined to rush out at the moment the door should be opened.
uz: Oxirgi marta atrofimga va qo'rqinchli jasadni o'z ichiga olgan qutisiga nazar tashlab, men u yerdan yugurib, Countning xonasiga yetib keldim va eshik ochilishi kerak bo'lgan paytda darrov chiqib ketishga qaror qildim.

en: With strained ears, I listened, and heard downstairs the grinding of the key in the great lock and the falling back of the heavy door.
uz: Quloqlarim og'ir bo'lib, tingladim va quyi qadoqdagi kalitning qichqirishini va og'ir eshikning orqaga tushib ketayotganini eshitdim.

en: There must have been some other means of entry, or some one had a key for one of the locked doors.
uz: Kirishning boshqa yo'li bo'lishi kerak edi, yoki kimdir qulflangan eshiklarning birida kalitga ega bo'lgan.

en: Then there came the sound of many feet tramping and dying away in some passage which sent up a clanging echo.
uz: So'ngra ba'zi bir yo'nalishlarda ko'p qadamlar to'sib, o'lib ketayotganining ovozi paydo bo'ldi va bu ovoz o'ziga xos o'z-o'zidan so'z o'tkazdi.

en: I turned to run down again to- wards the vault, where I might ﬁnd the new entrance, but at the moment there seemed to come a violent puff of wind, and the door to the winding stair blew to with a shock that set the dust from the lintels ﬂying.
uz: Men yana g'olibxona tomon yugurib, yangi kirish joyini topishim mumkin edi, lekin shu paytdan boshlab kuchli shamol puflashdi va burishqoq turg'a eshik shok bilan o'tadi va bu esa to'stni uchirib yuboradi.

en: When I ran to push it open, I found that it was hopelessly fast.
uz: Uni ochish uchun yugurganimda, u juda tezligini ko'rdim.

en: I was again a prison- er, and the net of doom was closing round me more closely.
uz: Men yana bir marta mahbus bo'ldim va o'lim to'pasi atrofimda yanada yaqinlashib borardi.

en: As I write there is in the passage below a sound of many tramping feet and the crash of weights being set down heavily, doubtless the boxes, with their freight of earth.
uz: Men yozayotganimda, pastki qismda ko'plab qo'zg'olon va og'irliklarning tovushi eshitilmoqda, shubhasizki, qutilar, ularning yer yuklari bilan og'ir joyga tushadi.

en: There was a sound of hammering.
uz: Bir marta martalovning ovozi eshitildi.

en: It is the box being nailed down.
uz: Bu quti qutilab qo'yilgan.

en: Now I can hear the heavy feet tramping again along the hall, with with many other idle feet coming behind them.
uz: Endi men yana ko'p og'ir oyoqlarni xonadon bo'ylab, orqalaridan ko'pgina o'zboshimchalik qilmaydigan oyog'lar bilan quloq solganini eshityapman.

en: The door is shut, the chains rattle.
uz: Eshik yopilgan, zanjirlar qaltirgan.

en: There is a grinding of the key in the lock.
uz: Qadoqning kalitini silkitish holatini ko'rish mumkin.

en: I can hear the key withdrawn, then another door opens and shuts.
uz: Men kalitni olib tashlayotganini eshitaman, keyin yana bir eshik ochiladi va yopiladi.

en: hear the creaking of lock and bolt.
uz: Qopish va bo'g'ishning qichqirishini eshitish.

en: In the courtyard and down the rocky way the roll of heavy wheels, the crack of whips, and the chorus of the Szgany as they pass into the distance.
uz: hovlida va toshbo'y yo'lda og'ir g'ildiraklar to'plami, qamchilashlarning yorilib ketishi va Szganylarning choruslari uzoqdan o'tishmoqda.

en: I am alone in the castle with those horrible women.
uz: Men o'sha dahshatli ayollar bilan qal'ada yolg'izman.

en: Mina is a woman, and there is nought in common.
uz: Mina ayol va hech qanday umumiy narsa yo'q.

en: They are devils of the Pit!
uz: Bular Yovuzlik shaytonlari!

en: I shall not remain alone with them.
uz: Men ular bilan yolg'iz qolmayman.

en: I shall try to scale the castle wall far- ther than I have yet attempted.
uz: Qala devorini hali ham harakat qilmaganimdan ko'ra ko'proq ko'tarishga harakat qilaman.

en: I shall take some of the gold with me, lest I want it later.
uz: Oltinning ba'zi qismini o'zim bilan olib ketaman, agar keyinchalik uni istamasam.

en: I may ﬁnd a way from this dreadful place.
uz: Ehtimol, men bu dahshatli joydan chiqib ketishim mumkin.

en: And then away for home!
uz: Keyin uyga ketamiz!

en: Away to the quickest and nearest train!
uz: Eng tezkor va eng yaqin poezdga yo'l!

en: Away from the cursed spot, from this cursed land, where the devil and his children still walk with earthly feet!
uz: Bu la'natlangan yerdan, shayton va uning bolalari hali ham yer yuzidagi oyoqlari bilan yurayotgan bu la'natlangan yerdan uzoqlashinglar!

en: At least God's mercy is better than that of those monsters, and the precipice is steep and high.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda Xudoning rahm-shafqati o'sha g'ayritabiiy hayvonlardan yaxshiroqdir va bu vodiy baland va baland.

en: At its foot a man may sleep, as a man.
uz: Uning oyoqlarida inson uxlab qolishi mumkin.

en: CHAPTER 5 LETTER FROM MISS MINA MURRAY TO MISS LUCY WESTENRA 9 May.
uz: 5 bob Mis MINA MURRAYdan Mis Lusi Vestenradan 9 may kuni kelgan maktub.

en: My dearest Lucy, Forgive my long delay in writing, but I have been simply overwhelmed with work.
uz: Aziz Lucy, yozish uchun uzoq kechiktirganimdan kechirim so'raysiz, lekin men shunchaki ish bilan ovora bo'ldim.

en: The life of an assistant schoolmistress is sometimes trying.
uz: Maktab o'qituvchisi yordamchisining hayoti ba'zan qiyin kechadi.

en: I am longing to be with you, and by the sea, where we can talk together freely and build our castles in the air.
uz: Men siz bilan birga bo'lishni va dengiz bo'yida erkin suhbatlashishni va havodagi qal'alarimizni qurishni orzu qilaman.

en: I have been working very hard lately, be- cause I want to keep up with Jonathan's studies, and I have been practicing shorthand very assiduously.
uz: Oxirgi paytlarda jonatanning o'qishini o'rganishni xohlaganim uchun juda ko'p mehnat qilib kelaman va qisqartmalarni juda qunt bilan o'rgandim.

en: When we are married I shall be able to be use- ful to Jonathan, and if I can stenograph well enough I can take down what he wants to say in this way and write it out for him on the typewriter, at which also I am practicing very hard.
uz: Turmush qurganimizda, Jonatan uchun foydali bo'lishim mumkin va agar men stenografiyani yaxshi bilsam, uning aytmoqchi bo'lganlarini shu tarzda yozib olib, uning uchun matbaa mashinasiga yozishim mumkin, bu erda men ham juda ko'p mashq qilyapman.

en: He and I sometimes write letters in shorthand, and he is keeping a steno- graphic journal of his travels abroad.
uz: U va men ba'zan qisqacha xatlar yozamiz va u chet el sayohatlari to'g'risidagi steno-grafik jurnalni o'zi yuritadi.

en: When I am with you I shall keep a di- ary in the same way.
uz: Sizlar bilan bo'lganimda, men ham xuddi shunday yo'l tutaman.

en: I don't mean one of those two-pages-to-the-week-with- Sunday-squeezed-in-a-corner diaries, but a sort of journal which I can write in whenever I feel inclined.
uz: Men o'sha ikki sahifalik haftadan-kun, yakshanba-o'rinbosarlikdagi kundalik kitoblardan birini nazarda tutmayman, balki o'zim xohlagan vaqtda yozishim mumkin bo'lgan jurnalni nazarda tutyapman.

en: I do not suppose there will be much of interest to other people, but it is not intended for them.
uz: O'ylaymanki, boshqa odamlarga qiziqish ko'p bo'lmaydi, lekin bu ular uchun mo'ljallangan emas.

en: I may show it to Jonathan some day if there is in it anything worth sharing, but it is really an exercise book.
uz: Agar ularda baham ko'rishga arziydigan biron-bir narsa bo'lsa, men uni bir kuni Jonatanga ko'rsata olaman, lekin bu aslida mashq kitobi.

en: I shall try to do what I see lady journalists do, interviewing and writing descriptions and trying to remember conversations.
uz: Xotin-qiz jurnalistlar nima qilayotganini ko'rishga harakat qilaman, intervyu o'tkazaman, sharhlar yozaman va suhbatlarni eslab qolishga harakat qilaman.

en: I am told that, with a little practice, one can remember all that goes on or that one hears said during a day.
uz: Menga aytilishicha, bir oz mashq qilish bilan bir kun davomida sodir bo'lgan yoki eshitilgan barcha narsalarni eslab qolish mumkin.

en: However, we shall see.
uz: Biroq, bilib olamiz.

en: I will tell you of my little plans when we meet.
uz: Uchrashganimizda ozgina rejalarim haqida aytib beraman.

en: I have just had a few hurried lines from Jonathan from Transylvania.
uz: Transilvaniyalik Jonatanning bir necha tezkor so'zlarini eshitdim.

en: He is well, and will be returning in about a week.
uz: U sog'lom va bir hafta ichida qaytib keladi.

en: I am longing to hear all his
uz: Men uning barcha gaplarini eshitishni juda istayman.

en: It must be nice to see strange countries.
uz: O'zgacha mamlakatlarni ko'rish juda yoqimli bo'lishi kerak.

en: I wonder if we, I mean Jonathan and I, shall ever see them together.
uz: O'ylaymanki, biz, Jonatan va men, ularni birga ko'rmaymizmi?

en: There is the ten o'clock bell ringing.
uz: U yerda o'n soatdagi qo'ng'iroq quloq soladi.

en: Your loving Mina Tell me all the news when you write.
uz: Sening sevadigan Mina yozganingizda menga barcha yangiliklarni aytib bering.

en: You have not told me anything for a long time.
uz: Siz menga uzoq vaqtdan beri hech narsa aytmadingiz.

en: I hear rumours, and especially of a tall, handsome, curly-haired man.???
uz: Men baland, chiroyli, qirg'oq sochli erkak haqida mish-mishlar eshitaman.???

en: LETTER, LUCY WESTENRA TO MINA MURRAY 17, Chatham Street Wednesday My dearest Mina, I must say you tax me very unfairly with being a bad correspondent.
uz: Letter, LUCY WESTENRA to MINA MURRAY 17, Chatham Street chorshanba nomli maktub Mening aziz Mina, men aytishim kerakki, siz meni yomon muxbir bo'lganim uchun juda adolatsiz ravishda soliq solgansiz.

en: I wrote you twice since we parted, and your last letter was only your second.
uz: Ayrilganimizdan beri sizga ikki marta yozganman va oxirgi maktubingiz ikkinchi maktubingiz edi.

en: Besides, I have nothing to tell you.
uz: Bundan tashqari, sizga aytadigan hech narsaim yo'q.

en: There is really nothing to interest you.
uz: Sizni qiziqtiradigan hech narsa yo'q.

en: Town is very pleasant just now, and we go a great deal to picture-gal- leries and for walks and rides in the park.
uz: Shahar hozirda juda yoqimli va biz ko'plab rasm-galereyalarga, parkda yurish va sayohatga boramiz.

en: As to the tall, curly-haired man, I suppose it was the one who was with me at the last Pop.
uz: Uzoq, qurtosh sochli kishiga kelsak, men o'ylaymanki, u men bilan oxirgi Popda birga bo'lgan kishi edi.

en: Someone has evi- dently been telling tales.
uz: Kimdir hikoyalar aytib yuribdi.

en: He often comes to see us, and he and Mamma get on very well together, they have so many things to talk about in common.
uz: U bizni ko'pincha ko'rishga keladi va u va onam juda yaxshi munosabatda bo'lishadi, ular uchun juda ko'p umumiy narsalar bor.

en: We met some time ago a man that would just do for you, if you were not already engaged to Jonathan.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt oldin biz Jonatan bilan bog'lanishmagan bo'lsangiz, bu siz uchun yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: He is an excellant parti, being handsome, well off, and of good birth.
uz: U juda yaxshi partiyachi, chiroyli, boy va yaxshi tug'ilgan.

en: He is a doctor and really clever.
uz: U shifokor va juda aqlli.

en: He is only nine-and twenty, and he has an immense lunatic asylum all under his own care.
uz: U atigi to'qqiz va yigirma yoshda va uning o'zi uchun ulkan aqldan ozgan uylari bor.

en: Holmwood introduced him to me, and he called here to see us, and often comes now.
uz: Holmwood uni menga tanishtirdi va u bizni ko'rish uchun bu yerga qo'ng'iroq qildi va ko'pincha hozir kelib turadi.

en: I think he is one of the most resolute men I ever saw, and yet the most calm.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u men ko'rgan eng qat'iy va ammo eng xotirjam odamlardan biridir.

en: He seems absolutely imperturbable.
uz: U mutlaqo uzilmasdek ko'rinadi.

en: I can fancy what a wonderful power he must have over his patients.
uz: U bemorlari ustidan qanday ajoyib kuchga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini tasavvur qila olaman.

en: He has a curious habit of looking one straight in the face, as if trying to read one's thoughts.
uz: Uning o'ziga xos odati bor, xuddi odamning fikrlarini o'qishga intilgandek, uning yuziga to'g'ri qarab turadi.

en: He tries this on very much with me, but I ﬂatter myself he has got a tough nut to crack.
uz: U men bilan buni juda ko'p sinab ko'radi, lekin men o'zimni maqtanaman, chunki u og'ir og'ir og'irligi bilan kurashadi.

en: I know that from my glass.
uz: Buni shishalarimdan bilaman.

en: Do you ever try to read your own face?
uz: O'zingizning yuzingizni o'qishga harakat qilyapsizmi?

en: I do, and I can tell you it is not a bad study, and gives you more trouble than you can well fancy if you have never tried it.
uz: O'ylayman va sizga aytamanki, bu yomon tadqiqot emas va siz hech qachon sinab ko'rmagan bo'lsangiz, tasavvur qilganingizdan ko'ra ko'proq muammolar tug'diradi.

en: He says that I afford him a curious psychological study, and I humbly think I do.
uz: U menga g'alati psixologik tadqiqot o'tkazishni taklif qilyapman, deb aytadi va men buni kamtarlik bilan o'ylayman.

en: I do not, as you know, take sufﬁcient interest in dress to be able
uz: Bilganingizdek, kiyim-kechakga bo'lgan qiziqishim yetarli emas.

en: to describe the new fashions.
uz: yangi modalarni tavsiflash uchun.

en: That is slang again, but never mind.
uz: Bu yana slang, lekin hech qanday muammo yo'q.

en: Arthur says that every day.
uz: Artur buni har kuni aytadi.

en: There, it is all out, Mina, we have told all our secrets to each other since we were children.
uz: Mana, bu bor, Mina, biz bolaligimizdan beri bir-birimizga barcha sirlarimizni aytib kelyapmiz.

en: We have slept together and eaten together, and laughed and cried together, and now, though I have spoken, I would like to speak more.
uz: Biz birga uxlab, birga ovqatlanardik, birga kulgan va birga yig'laganmiz va endi gapirgan bo'lsam ham, ko'proq gapirishni xohlayman.

en: Oh, Mina, couldn't you guess?
uz: Oh, Mina, buni tasavvur qila olamanmi?

en: I am blushing as I write, for although I think he loves me, he has not told me so in words.
uz: Men yozayotganimda qizg'inib ketaman, chunki u meni yaxshi ko'radi deb o'ylasam-da, u buni so'zlar bilan aytmagan.

en: But, oh, Mina, I love him.
uz: Lekin, Mina, men uni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: There, that does me good.
uz: Mana, bu menga yaxshilik qiladi.

en: I wish I were with you, dear, sitting by the ﬁre undressing, as we used to sit, and I would try to tell you what I feel.
uz: Qizim, siz bilan birga o'tirganimda, biz o'tirganidek, olov yonida o'tirib, kiyimlarini yechib o'tirganimda, o'zimni qanday his qilayotganimni aytishga harakat qilaman.

en: I do not know how I am writing this even to you.
uz: Hatto sizga ham buni qanday yozayotganimni bilmayman.

en: I am afraid to stop, or I should tear up the letter, and I don't want to stop, for I do so want to tell you all.
uz: Men to'xtatishdan qo'rqaman yoki xatni parchalatib yuborishim kerak, va to'xtatishni istamayman, chunki buni hammangizga aytmoqchiman.

en: Let me hear from you at once, and tell me all that you think about it.
uz: O'zingizdan so'ng xabar topib, bu haqda nima deb o'ylayotganingizni aytib bering.

en: Mina, pray for my happiness.
uz: Mina, mening baxtim uchun ibodat qiling.

en: S.—I need not tell you this is a secret.
uz: S. Bu sir ekanligini sizga aytishim shart emas.

en: LETTER, LUCY WESTENRA TO MINA MURRAY 24 May My dearest Mina, Thanks, and thanks, and thanks again for your sweet letter.
uz: MINA MURRAY ga yozuv, LUCY WESTENRA 24 may, aziz Mina, rahmat va rahmat, yana bir bor shirin maktubingiz uchun rahmat.

en: It was so nice to be able to tell you and to have your sympathy.
uz: Sizga aytish va sizning hamdardligingizni ko'rish juda yaxshi edi.

en: My dear, it never rains but it pours.
uz: Qizim, hech qachon yomg'ir yog'maydi, lekin yomg'ir yog'adi.

en: How true the old proverbs are.
uz: Qadimgi masallar qanchalik haq.

en: Here am I, who shall be twenty in September, and yet I never had a proposal till today, not a real proposal, and today I had three.
uz: Mana men, sentyabr oyida yigirma yoshga to'laman, lekin bugungacha hech qachon taklifga ega bo'lmaganman, haqiqiy taklif emas, bugun esa uchta taklifga ega bo'ldim.

en: Three proposals in one day!
uz: Bir kunda uchta taklif!

en: I feel sorry, really and truly sorry, for two of the poor fellows.
uz: Ikkita kambag'al odam uchun juda achinaman, haqiqatan ham.

en: Oh, Mina, I am so happy that I don't know what to do with myself.
uz: Oh, Mina, men o'zim bilan nima qilishim kerakligini bilmaydigan darajada baxtliman.

en: And three proposals!
uz: Va uchta taklif!

en: But, for goodness' sake, don't tell any of the girls, or they would be getting all sorts of extravagant ideas, and imagining themselves injured and slight- ed if in their very ﬁrst day at home they did not get six at least.
uz: Ammo, xudo uchun, qizlarga hech qachon aytmang, aks holda ular har xil g'alati g'oyalarga ega bo'lib, agar uyda birinchi kunlarida kamida oltita bo'lmasa, o'zlarini jarohatlangan va yengilroq deb tasavvur qilishadi.

en: Some girls are so vain!
uz: Ba'zi qizlar juda behuda!

en: You and I, Mina dear, who are engaged and are going to settle down soon soberly into old married women, can despise vanity.
uz: Sen va men, mening sevimli Mina, siz va men nikoh qurganmiz va tez orada eski turmush qurgan ayollarga aylanamiz, ammo bu behudalikni rad etishimiz mumkin.

en: Well, I must tell you about the three, but you must keep it a secret, dear, from every one except, of course, Jonathan.
uz: Men sizga uchta narsa haqida gapirishim kerak, lekin siz buni hammalardan sir saqlab qolishingiz kerak, azizim, albatta, Jonatandan tashqari.

en: You will tell him, because I would, if I were in your place, certainly tell Arthur.
uz: Siz unga aytasiz, chunki men sizning joyingizda bo'lsam, albatta Arturga aytaman.

en: A woman ought to tell her husband everything.
uz: Ayol eriga hamma narsani aytishi kerak.

en: Don't you think so, dear?
uz: Siz ham shunday deb o'ylamayapsizmi, azizim?

en: Men like women, certainly their wives, to be quite as fair as they are.
uz: Erkaklar xotinlarni, ayniqsa xotinlarini yaxshi ko'radilar, chunki ular o'zlari kabi chiroyli bo'lishadi.

en: And women, I am afraid, are not always quite as fair as they should be.
uz: Va men qo'rqamanki, ayollar har doim ham bo'lishi kerak bo'lgancha adolatli emaslar.

en: Well, my dear, number One came just before lunch.
uz: Xo'sh, azizim, birinchi raqam kechki ovqatdan oldin keldi.

en: I told you of him, Dr.
uz: Men sizga u haqida gapirganman, doktor.

en: John Seward, the lunatic asylum man, with the strong jaw and the good forehead.
uz: John Seward, aqlli kasallar uyidagi odam, kuchli cho'g'i va chiroyli oyoq bilan.

en: He was very cool outwardly, but was nervous all the same.
uz: U tashqi ko'rinishda juda salqin edi, ammo hali ham g'alati edi.

en: He had evidently been schooling himself as to all sorts of little things, and re- membered them, but he almost managed to sit down on his silk hat, which men don't generally do when they are cool, and then when he wanted to ap- pear at ease he kept playing with a lancet in a way that made me nearly scream.
uz: U o'zini har qanday kichik ishlarga o'rgatgan va ularni qayta o'zlashtirgan bo'lsa kerak, lekin u deyarli ipka to'pasiga o'tirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi, bu odatda erkaklar sovuq bo'lganda qilmaydilar, so'ngra u o'zini qulay his qilmoqchi bo'lganida esa, o'zimni deyarli qichqirishim mumkin bo'lgan tarzda lancet bilan o'ynashni davom ettirdi.

en: He spoke to me, Mina, very straightfordwardly.
uz: U men bilan, Mina, juda aniq gapirdi.

en: He told me how dear I was to him, though he had known me so little, and what his life would be with me to help and cheer him.
uz: U meni ozgina bilgan bo'lsa-da, men unga qanchalik aziz ekanimni va unga yordam va dalda berish uchun men bilan qanday hayot kechirishini aytdi.

en: He was going to tell me how un- happy he would be if I did not care for him, but when he saw me cry he said he was a brute and would not add to my present trouble.
uz: U menga unga g'amxo'rlik qilmasam, qanchalik baxtsiz bo'lishini aytmoqchi edi, lekin meni yig'layotganimni ko'rganida, u o'zi vahshiy va hozirgi muammolarimga qo'shimcha qilmasligini aytdi.

en: Then he broke off and asked if I could love him in time, and when I shook my head his hands trembled, and then with some hesitation he asked me if I cared already for any one else.
uz: So'ngra u uzildi va men uni o'z vaqtida sevishim mumkinligini so'radi va men boshimni silkitganimda qo'llari titrab ketdi va keyin biroz shubha ostiga, boshqa hech kimga g'amxo'rlik qilyapmanmi deb so'radi.

en: He put it very nicely, saying that he did not want to wring my conﬁdence from me, but only to know, because if a woman's heart was free a man might have hope.
uz: U buni juda yaxshi so'zlab, ishonchimni yo'qotmoqchi emasligini, balki bilmoqchiligini aytdi, chunki ayolning yuragi erkin bo'lganda, erkak kishi umidga ega bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And then, Mina, I felt a sort of duty to tell him that there was some one.
uz: Va keyin, Mina, men unga kimdir borligini aytish vazifasini his qildim.

en: I only told him that much, and then he stood up, and he looked very strong and very grave as he took both my hands in his and said he hoped I would be happy, and that If I ever wanted a friend I must count him one of my best.
uz: Men unga faqat shu narsani aytdim, so'ngra u turib ketdi va mening qo'llarimni o'ziga qo'yib, baxtli bo'lishimni va agar do'stim bo'lsa, uni eng yaxshilarimdan biri deb hisoblashni umid qilganini aytdi.

en: Oh, Mina dear, I can't help crying, and you must excuse this letter being all blotted.
uz: Oh, Mina, men yig'lab o'tirmayapman va bu xat o'chirilganidan kechirim so'rasang kerak.

en: Being proposed to is all very nice and all that sort of thing, but it isn't at all a happy thing when you have to see a poor fellow, whom you know loves you honestly, going away and looking all broken hearted, and to know that, no matter what he may say at the moment, you are passing out of his life.
uz: O'zgalarga taklif qilish juda yoqimli va shunga o'xshash narsalar, lekin sizni chin dildan sevgan kambag'al odamni ketayotganini ko'rib, yuragini og'ir ko'rib ketayotganini va u hozir nima desin, siz uning hayotidan o'tib ketayotganingizni bilganingizda, bu umuman baxtli bo'lmaydi.

en: My dear, I must stop here at present, I feel so miserable, though I am so happy.
uz: Qizim, men hozir bu yerda to'xtatishim kerak, o'zimni juda baxtsiz his qilyapman, garchi juda baxtli bo'lsam ham.

en: Arthur has just gone, and I feel in better spirits than when I left off, so I can go on telling you about the day.
uz: Artur o'tib ketdi va men o'zimni to'xtatgandan ko'ra yaxshiroq his qilaman, shuning uchun o'sha kun haqida hikoya qilishni davom ettira olaman.

en: Well, my dear, number Two came after lunch.
uz: Xo'sh, azizim, ikkinchi raqam tushdan keyin keldi.

en: He is such a nice fellow, and American from Texas, and he looks so young and so fresh that it seems almost impossible that he has been to so many places and has such adven- tures.
uz: U juda mehribon odam va Texasdan kelgan amerikalik, u shunchalik yosh va yangi ko'rinadiki, u shuncha joylarga borishi va bunday hodisalarga ega bo'lishi deyarli imkonsiz.

en: I sympathize with poor Desdemona when she had such a stream poured in her ear, even by a black man.
uz: Men kambag'al Desdemonaning quloqlariga, hatto qora tanli kishi tomonidan ham shunday oq oq oq oqib ketayotganida, uning his-tuyg'ularini his qilaman.

en: I suppose that we women are such cowards that we think a man will save us from fears, and we marry him.
uz: O'ylaymanki, biz ayollar shunchalik qo'rqoqmizki, erkak kishi bizni qo'rquvdan qutqaradi deb o'ylaylik va unga turmush quramiz.

en: know now what I would do if I were a man and wanted to make a girl love me.
uz: Agar men erkak bo'lganimda va qizni menga muhabbat ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsam, nima qilishimni endi bilaman.

en: No, I don't, for there was Mr.
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, chunki Mr. bor edi.

en: Morris telling us his stories, and Arthur never told any, and yet … My dear, I am somewhat previous.
uz: Morris bizga o'z hikoyalarini aytib berardi, Artur esa hech qachon hech qanday hikoya qilmagan va hali ham...

en: Morris found me alone.
uz: Morris meni yolg'iz topdi.

en: It seems that a man always does ﬁnd a girl alone.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, erkaklar har doim yolg'iz qizni topishadi.

en: No, he doesn't, for Arthur tried twice to make a chance, and I helping him all I could, I am not ashamed to say it now.
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, chunki Artur imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritish uchun ikki marta urinib ko'rdi va men unga qo'limdan kelgancha yordam berishga harakat qilaman, endi buni aytishdan uyalmayman.

en: I must tell you beforehand that Mr.
uz: Sizlarga oldindan aytishim kerakki, Mr.

en: Morris doesn't always speak slang, that is to say, he never does so to strangers or before them, for he is really well educated and has exquisite manners, but he found out that it amused me to hear him talk American slang, and whenever I was present, and there was no one to be shocked, he said such funny things.
uz: Morris har doim ham jargon gapirmaydi, ya'ni, u hech qachon begonalarga yoki ularning oldida bunday qilmaydi, chunki u juda yaxshi ta'lim olgan va ajoyib odobga ega, lekin u uni amerikalik jargon gapirganini eshitish meni zavqlantirganini bilib oldi va men u yerda bo'lganimda va hech kim hayratda qolmasligi uchun, u shunday qiziqarli narsalarni aytadi.

en: I am afraid, my dear, he has to invent it all, for it ﬁts exactly into whatever else he has to say.
uz: Qo'rqaman, azizim, u hamma narsani o'ylab topishi kerak, chunki bu uning aytishi kerak bo'lgan har qanday narsaga to'g'ri mos keladi.

en: But this is a way slang has.
uz: Ammo bu slangning o'ziga xos usuli.

en: I do not know myself if I shall ever speak slang.
uz: O'zimni bilmayman, agar men hech qachon slangni gapira olamanmi.

en: I do not know if Arthur likes it, as I have never heard him use any as yet.
uz: Arturga bu yoqadimi, bilmayman, chunki men uni hech qachon hech qanday qo'llashni eshitmaganman.

en: Morris sat down beside me and looked as happy and jolly as he could, but I could see all the same that he was very nervous.
uz: Morris yonimda o'tirib, iloji boricha baxtli va quvonchli ko'rinishga ega edi, ammo men uning juda g'ayratli ekanligini ko'rdim.

en: He took my hand in his, and said ever so sweetly … Miss Lucy, I know I ain't good enough to regulate the ﬁxin's of your lit- tle shoes, but I guess if you wait till you ﬁnd a man that is you will go join them seven young women with the lamps when you quit.
uz: U mening qo'limni uning qo'lidan ushlab, go'zallik bilan shunday dedi... Lusi xonim, men sizning yoritilgan poyabzallaringizning o'lchamlarini tartibga solishga yetarlicha yaxshi emasligimni bilaman, lekin agar siz o'sha odamni topmaguningizcha kutsangiz, ishdan bo'shatganingizda ularga qo'shilgan yetti yosh ayolga qo'shiling.

en: Won't you just hitch up along-side of me and let us go down the long road together, driving in double harness? Well, he did look so hood humoured and so jolly that it didn't seem half so hard to refuse him as it did poor Dr.
uz: Mening yonimga tushib, uzoq yo'lni birga bosib o'tamizmi? - deb so'rashdi. - Ha, u shunchalik humorli va quvonchli ko'rinardiki, uni rad etish ham kambag'al doktorning o'zi kabi qiyin emas edi.

en: So I said, as lightly as I could, that I did not know anything of hitching, and that I wasn't broken to harness at all yet.
uz: Shunday qilib, men imkon qadar yengillik bilan to'qnashuv haqida hech narsa bilmasligimni va hali hech qanday o'zimni o'chirmaganimni aytdim.

en: Then he said that he had spoken in a light manner, and he hoped that if he had made a mistake in doing so on so grave, so momentous, and occasion for him, I would forgive him.
uz: Keyin u yengil tarzda gapirganini aytdi va agar u uchun bunday jiddiy, muhim va muhim vaziyatda xato qilgan bo'lsa, uni kechiraman, deb umid qildi.

en: He really did look serious when he was saying it, and I couldn't help feeling a sort of exultation that he was number Two in one day.
uz: U buni aytganida juda jiddiy ko'rinardi va men bir kun ichida ikkinchi o'rinni egallaganidan xursand bo'ldim.

en: And then, my dear, before I could say a word he began pouring out a perfect torrent of lovemaking, laying his very heart and soul at my feet.
uz: Keyin, azizim, men bir so'z ayta olmagunimcha, u mening oyoqlarimga o'z yuragini va jonini to'kib, mukammal ko'ngil-ko'nglini to'kib yuborishni boshladi.

en: He looked so earnest over it that I shall never again think that a man must be playful always, and never earnest, because he is merry at times.
uz: U shunchalik g'ayrat bilan o'ylab ko'rdiki, men hech qachon o'ylamaymanki, odam har doim o'yinchi bo'lishi kerak, hech qachon g'ayratli bo'lmasligi kerak, chunki u ba'zan quvonchli bo'ladi.

en: I suppose he saw something in my face which checked him, for he suddenly stopped, and said with a sort of manly fervour that I could have loved him for if I had been free …
uz: Ehtimol, u yuzimda bir narsani ko'rgan bo'lsa kerak, bu uni hayratda qoldirdi, chunki u to'xtab, erkaklik g'ayrati bilan aytdiki, agar men ozod bo'lganimda uni sevardim ...

en: Lucy, you are an honest hearted girl, I know.
uz: Lusi, sen rostgo'y qizsan, bilaman.

en: I should not be here speak- ing to you as I am now if I did not believe you clean grit, right through to the very depths of your soul.
uz: Agar sizda pok g'ayrat, joningizning chuqurligiga qadar ishonmaganimda, men siz bilan hozir shunday gaplashib kelmasdim.

en: Tell me, like one good fellow to another, is there any one else that you care for?
uz: Ayting-chi, birovga yaxshilik qilgan kishi kabi, boshqalarga ham g'amxo'rlik qilishing kerakmi?

en: And if there is I'll never trouble you a hair's breadth again, but will be, if you will let me, a very faithful friend. My dear Mina, why are men so noble when we women are so little wor- thy of them?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, men senga yana hech qachon soch kengligi kabi muammo tug'dirmayman, lekin agar menga ruxsat bersang, juda sodiq do'stim bo'laman. - Aziz Mina, nega erkaklar shunchalik noyob bo'lishadi, lekin biz ayollar ularga shunchalik ahamiyatsizmiz?

en: Here was I almost making fun of this great hearted, true gen- tleman.
uz: Mana, men deyarli bu katta yurakli, haqiqiy kishi ustidan kulishni boshlagan edim.

en: I burst into tears, I am afraid, my dear, you will think this a very sloppy letter in more ways than one, and I really felt very badly.
uz: Men ko'z yoshlarimga tushib yubordim, chunki qo'rqaman, azizim, siz buni birdan ko'proq jihatdan juda beparvo maktub deb o'ylaysiz va men o'zimni juda yomon his qildim.

en: Why can't they let a girl marry three men, or as many as want her, and save all this trouble?
uz: Nega qiz uchta kishiga yoki uni xohlagan kishilarga uylanishiga yo'l qo'ymaydilar va bu barcha muammolarni qutqara olmaydilar?

en: But this is heresy, and I must not say it.
uz: Ammo bu ereksiya va men buni aytmasligim kerak.

en: I am glad to say that, though I was crying, I was able to look into Mr.
uz: Men xursandmanki, yig'lab yurganimda ham, Mr.

en: Morris' brave eyes, and I told him out straight … Yes, there is some one I love, though he has not told me yet that he even loves me. I was right to speak to him so frankly, for quite a light came into his face, and he put out both his hands and took mine, I think I put them into his, and said in a hearty way … That's my brave girl.
uz: Morrisning jasoratli ko'zlari, men unga to'g'ri aytdim... Ha, men sevgan odam bor, lekin u menga hali meni sevib qo'yganini aytmagan bo'lsa-da. Men unga shunday ochiqchasiga gapirganim to'g'ri edi, chunki uning yuziga chiroyli nur tushdi va u qo'llarini uzatdi va mening qo'llarimni oldi, deb o'ylayman, men ularni uning qo'liga qo'ydim va samimiy tarzda aytdim... Bu mening jasoratli qizim.

en: It's better worth being late for a chance of winning you than being in time for any other girl in the world.
uz: Dunyodagi har qanday qiz uchun o'z vaqtida bo'lishdan ko'ra, sizni g'alaba qozonish imkoniyati uchun kech qolish afzalroq.

en: If it's for me, I'm a hard nut to crack, and I take it standing up.
uz: Agar bu men uchun bo'lsa, men qattiq og'ir bo'laman va uni to'g'ri turib qabul qilaman.

en: If that other fel- low doesn't know his happiness, well, he'd better look for it soon, or he'll have to deal with me.
uz: Agar o'sha odam o'z baxtini bilmasa, u buni tezda qidirsa yaxshi bo'lardi, aks holda u men bilan shug'ullanishi kerak bo'lardi.

en: Little girl, your honesty and pluck have made me a friend, and that's rarer than a lover, it's more selﬁsh anyhow.
uz: Kichik qizim, sizning rostgo'ylik va g'ayratingiz meni do'st qilib oldi va bu sevgan kishidan kam uchraydi.

en: My dear, I'm going to have a pretty lonely walk between this and Kingdom Come.
uz: Qizim, bu va Kingdom Come o'rtasida juda yolg'iz yurishim kerak.

en: Won't you give me one kiss?
uz: Menga birgina o'pishni bermaysanmi?

en: It'll be something to keep off the darkness now and then.
uz: Bu vaqti-vaqti bilan qorong'ilikdan saqlanadigan narsa bo'ladi.

en: You can, you know, if you like, for that other good fellow, or you could not love him, hasn't spoken yet. That quite won me, Mina, for it was brave and sweet of him, and noble too, to a rival, wasn't it?
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, o'sha boshqa yaxshi odam uchun, yoki siz uni sevolmasangiz, u hali gapirmagan. Bu menga juda foyda keltirdi, Mina, chunki bu uning jasorati va shirinligi edi, shuningdek, raqibga nisbatan ham buyuk edi, shunday emasmi?

en: And he so sad, so I leant over and kissed him.
uz: U juda xafa edi, shuning uchun men unga yaqinlashib o'zimni o'pdim.

en: He stood up with my two hands in his, and as he looked down into my face, I am afraid I was blushing very much, he said, Little girl, I hold your hand, and you've kissed me, and if these things don't make us friends noth- ing ever will.
uz: U mening qo'llarimni o'ziga tikib turdi va yuzimga qarab, qo'rqamanki, juda qizg'inlab ketayotgan edim, u shunday dedi: O'g'lim, men qo'lingni ushlab turaman va sen meni o'pding, agar bu narsalar bizni do'st qilmasa, hech qachon do'st qilmas.

en: Thank you for your sweet honesty to me, and goodbye. He wrung my hand, and taking up his hat, went straight out of the room with- out looking back, without a tear or a quiver or a pause, and I am crying like a baby.
uz: Menga nisbatan xushmuomalalik va halolligingiz uchun rahmat va salom. - deb qo'limni o'chirib qo'ydi u, to'pini ko'tarib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: Oh, why must a man like that be made unhappy when there are lots of girls about who would worship the very ground he trod on?
uz: Nima uchun bunday odam baxtsiz bo'lishi kerak, agar u qadam bosgan joyga sajda qiladigan qizlar ko'p bo'lsa?

en: I know I would if I were free, only I don't want to be free My dear, this quite upset me, and I feel I cannot write of happiness just at once, after telling you of it, and I don't wish to tell of the number Three until it can be all happy.
uz: Bilsam, ozod bo'lardim, lekin ozod bo'lishni istamayman, azizim, bu meni juda xafa qiladi va men sizga aytgandan so'ng, birdan baxt haqida yozolmasligimni his qilaman va uchinchi sonni hamma baxtli bo'lgunga qadar aytishni istamayman.

en: Ever your loving … Lucy P.
uz: Har doim sevgan ... Lucy P.

en: S.—Oh, about number Three, I needn't tell you of number Three, need I?
uz: S.Oh, uchinchi raqam haqida sizga uchinchi raqam haqida gapirishim shart emas, shundaymi?

en: Besides, it was all so confused.
uz: Bundan tashqari, hamma narsa juda chalkash edi.

en: It seemed only a moment from his com- ing into the room till both his arms were round me, and he was kissing me.
uz: Xonaga kirganidan bir muncha vaqt o'tib, o'z qo'llari menga o'xshaydi va u meni o'padi.

en: I am very, very happy, and I don't know what I have done to deserve it.
uz: Men juda, juda baxtliman va bunga loyiq bo'lish uchun nima qilganimni bilmayman.

en: I must only try in the future to show that I am not ungrateful to God for all His goodness to me in sending to me such a lover, such a husband, and such a friend.
uz: Kelajakda faqatgina Alloh menga bunday sevgini, erini va do'stini yuborganida, menga qilgan barcha yaxshiliklari uchun Unga minnatdor emasligimni ko'rsatishga harakat qilishim kerak.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY (Kept in phonograph) 25 May.—Ebb tide in appetite today.
uz: SEWARDning kundaligi (fonografda saqlangan) 25 may.Bugun ochko'zlik bosqichi bo'ldi.

en: Cannot eat, cannot rest, so diary in- stead.
uz: Yemey olmaydi, dam olmaydi, shuning uchun kunlik kitob o'rniga.

en: since my rebuff of yesterday I have a sort of empty feeling.
uz: Kechagidan buyon men o'zimni bir xil bo'sh his qilaman.

en: Nothing in the world seems of sufﬁcient importance to be worth the doing.
uz: Dunyodagi hech narsa qilmishga arziydigan darajada muhim emas.

en: As I knew that the only cure for this sort of thing was work, I went amongst the patients.
uz: Bunday holatning yagona davolanishi ish ekanligini bilardim, shuning uchun bemorlar orasiga bordim.

en: I picked out one who has afforded me a study of much interest.
uz: Men juda qiziqarli tadqiqot o'tkazishga imkon beradigan bir tanli tanladim.

en: He is so quaint that I am determined to understand him as well as I can.
uz: U shunchalik chiroyli, men uni iloji boricha yaxshiroq tushunishga qat'iy qaror qildim.

en: Today I seemed to get nearer than ever before to the heart of his mystery.
uz: Bugun men uning sirining negiziga har qachongidan ko'ra yaqinlashdim.

en: I questioned him more fully than I had ever done, with a view to making myself master of the facts of his hallucination.
uz: O'zimni uning hallucinatsiya faktlarining egasi qilish maqsadida, men uni har qachongidan ham to'liqroq so'roq qildim.

en: In my manner of doing it there was, I now see, something of cruelty.
uz: Hozir ko'rib turganimcha, buni qilish uslubimda shafqatsizlik bor edi.

en: I seemed to wish to keep him to the point of his madness, a thing which I avoid with the patients as I would the mouth of hell.
uz: Men uni aqldan ozganligiga qadar saqlab qolishni xohlagan edim, bu esa kasallar bilan do'zax og'zini o'rab olganim kabi, undan qochaman.

en: (Mem., Under what circumstances would I not avoid the pit of hell?) Omnia Romae venalia sunt.
uz: (Mem., Men qanday sharoitlarda do'zax chuquridan qochmayman?) Omnia Romae venalia sunt.

en: If there be anything behind this instinct it will be valuable to trace it afterwards accurately, so I had bet- ter commence to do so, therefore … R.
uz: Agar bu hissiyotning orqasida biror narsa bo'lsa, keyinchalik uni aniq izlash foydali bo'ladi, shuning uchun men buni boshlashni xohlagan edim, shuning uchun ... R..

en: Sanguine temperament, great physical strength, morbidly excitable, periods of gloom, ending in some ﬁxed idea which I cannot make out.
uz: Qonli temperament, katta jismoniy kuch, kasallik bilan hayajonlanadigan, qorong'ilik davrlari, men aniqlay olmaydigan, ba'zi bir fikrdan tugadi.

en: I presume that the sanguine temperament itself and the disturbing inﬂuence end in a mentally-accomplished ﬁnish, a possibly dan- gerous man, probably dangerous if unselﬁsh.
uz: O'ylaymanki, o'zidan-o'zidan bu g'ayrat va bu dahshatli ta'sir aqliy jihatdan amalga oshirilgan yakun bilan yakunlanadi, ehtimol bu zo'ravon, ehtimol xavfli, lekin xudbin odam.

en: In selﬁsh men caution is as secure an armour for their foes as for themselves.
uz: O'zboshimchalik bilan harakat qilayotgan odamlarda ehtiyotkorlik dushmanlari uchun o'zlari uchun bo'lganidek, o'z himoyasi uchun ham xavfsiz qurol hisoblanadi.

en: What I think of on this
uz: Bu haqda o'zim nima deb o'ylayman

en: point is, when self is the ﬁxed point the centripetal force is balanced with the centrifugal.
uz: O'zim to'g'ri bo'lganda, sentripetal kuch sentrifugal bilan muvozanatlanadi.

en: When duty, a cause, etc., is the ﬁxed point, the latter force is paramount, and only accident of a series of accidents can balance it.
uz: Agar vazifadan, sababdan va hokazolardan iborat bo'lsa, bu kuch muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'ladi va uni faqatgina hodisalar ro'yxati bilan bog'liq hodisalar muvozanatni saqlab qolishi mumkin.

en: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 25 May.
uz: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 25 may kuni.

en: My dear Art, We've told yarns by the campﬁre in the prairies, and dressed one anoth- er's wounds after trying a landing at the Marquesas, and drunk healths on the shore of Titicaca.
uz: Aziz san'atkorim, Biz preriyalar atrofidagi o't yoniga o'qilgan iplar bilan suhbatlashdik, Markesada qayiqlanishga uringanimizdan keyin bir kishi jarohatlarini kiydik va Titicaca qirg'og'ida ichkilikboz sog'liqni saqladik.

en: There are more yarns to be told, and other wounds to be healed, and another health to be drunk.
uz: Boshqa yarnlarni aytish kerak, boshqa yaralarni davolash kerak va boshqa sog'liqni saqlash kerak.

en: Won't you let this be at my camp- ﬁre tomorrow night?
uz: Buni ertaga kechqurun o'zimning yong'inimda qoldirmaysanmi?

en: I have no hesitation in asking you, as I know a certain lady is engaged to a certain dinner party, and that you are free.
uz: Sizdan so'rashdan hech shubha qilmayman, chunki men bilamanki, muayyan bir ayol muayyan bir kechki ovqat partiyasida band bo'lib, siz erkinsiz.

en: There will only be one other, our old pal at the Korea, Jack Seward.
uz: Yana bir kishi bo'ladi, u Koreyadagi eski do'stimiz Jek Seward.
