en: He's coming, too, and we both want to mingle our weeps over the wine cup, and to drink a health with all our hearts to the happiest man in all the wide world, who has won the noblest heart that God has made and best worth winning.
uz: U ham keladi va ikkovimiz ham sharob kosasi ustida yig'larimizni aralashtirib, butun qalbimiz bilan dunyodagi eng baxtli odamga salomatlikni ichishni istaymiz, u Xudo yaratgan eng buyuk yurakni qo'lga kiritdi va qo'lga kiritishga arziydi.

en: We prom- ise you a hearty welcome, and a loving greeting, and a health as true as your own right hand.
uz: Sizga samimiy xush kelibsiz, sevgi bilan salom beramiz va o'ng qo'ling kabi sog'lomlikni va'da beramiz.

en: We shall both swear to leave you at home if you drink too deep to a certain pair of eyes.
uz: Agar siz ko'zlaringiz ko'p bo'lsa, sizni uyda qoldirishga qasam ichamiz.

en: Yours, as ever and always, Quincey P.
uz: Sening, har doimgidek, Quincey P..

en: Morris TELEGRAM FROM ARTHUR HOLMWOOD TO QUINCEY P.
uz: Morrisning ARTHUR HOLMWOODdan QUINCEY P.ga yuborilgan telegramasi.

en: MORRIS 26 May Count me in every time.
uz: MORRIS 26 May Meni har safar sanab turing.

en: I bear messages which will make both your ears tingle.
uz: Men sizning quloqlaringiz qichqirishiga sabab bo'ladigan xabarlarni olib boraman.

en: CHAPTER 6 MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL 24 July.
uz: 6 - bob MURRAYning jurnalida 24 - iyul.

en: Whitby.—Lucy met me at the station, looking sweeter and lovlier than ever, and we drove up to the house at the Crescent in which they have rooms.
uz: Whitby.Lucy men bilan stantsiyada uchrashdi, u har qachongidan ham shirin va chiroyli ko'rinardi va biz o'sha uyga bordik.

en: This is a lovely place.
uz: Bu joy chiroyli.

en: The little river, the Esk, runs through a deep valley, which broadens out as it comes near the harbour.
uz: Esk nomli kichik daryo chuqur vodiy orqali o'tadi va u portga yaqinlashganda kenglashib boradi.

en: A great viaduct runs across, with high piers, through which the view seems somehow fur- ther away than it really is.
uz: Yuqori pilarlar bilan katta viyadekt o'tib o'tadi, u orqali ko'rinish aslida bo'lganidan ancha uzoqroq ko'rinadi.

en: The valley is beautifully green, and it is so steep that when you are on the high land on either side you look right across it, unless you are near enough to see down.
uz: vodiy chiroyli yashil va shunchalik baland bo'lganki, har ikki tomondan baland joyda bo'lganingizda, agar pastga ko'rish uchun etarlicha yaqin bo'lmasangiz, to'g'ri tomondan ko'rasiz.

en: The houses of the old town—the side away from us, are all red-roofed, and seem piled up one over the other anyhow, like the pictures we see of Nuremberg.
uz: Oldin shaharning uylari bizdan uzoq bo'lgan tomonda, barchasi qizil tomlarga o'rnatilgan va bir-biri ustida to'plangan bo'lib ko'rinadi, xuddi Nurembergdagi rasmlarga o'xshaydi.

en: Right over the town is the ruin of Whitby Abbey, which was sacked by the Danes, and which is the scene of part of Marmion, where the girl was built up in the wall.
uz: Shaharning o'ng tomonida danlar tomonidan talon-toroj qilingan Uitbi abbeyning vayron bo'lishi bor va bu Marmionning bir qismiga aylangan, qiz devorda qurilgan joy.

en: It is a most noble ruin, of immense size, and full of beautiful and romantic bits.
uz: Bu juda buyuk, ulkan va go'zal va romantik qismlarga to'lgan eng buyuk vayronatdir.

en: There is a legend that a white lady is seen in one of the windows.
uz: Bir afsonaga ko'ra, derazalardan birida oq ayol ko'rinadi.

en: Between it and the town there is another church, the parish one, round which is a big graveyard, all full of tombstones.
uz: U bilan shahar o'rtasida yana bir cherkov bor, bu esa farishta cherkovidir, uning atrofida katta qabriston bor, ularning barchasi qabr toshlari bilan to'ldirilgan.

en: This is to my mind the nicest spot in Whitby, for it lies right over the town, and has a full view of the harbour and all up the bay to where the headland called Kettleness stretches out into the sea.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, bu Uitbidagi eng yoqimli joy, chunki u shaharning o'zida joylashgan va port va ko'chadan to'liq ko'rinishga ega bo'lib, Kettleness deb nomlangan bosh joy dengizga cho'zilgan.

en: It descends so steeply over the harbour that part of the bank has fallen away, and some of the graves have been destroyed.
uz: U ko'chadan shunchalik baland tushadiki, qirg'og'ining bir qismi tushib ketgan va ba'zi qabrlar vayron qilingan.

en: In one place part of the stonework of the graves stretches out over the sandy pathway far below.
uz: Bir joyda qabrlarning toshbo'y qismlari pastdagi qumli yo'ldan o'tadi.

en: There are walks, with seats beside them, through the churchyard, and people go and sit there all day long looking at the beau- tiful view and enjoying the breeze.
uz: Kirish hovlisida o'rindiqlar bilan o'tish joylari bor va odamlar butun kun davomida chiroyli manzaralarga qarab va shamoldan zavqlanib o'tirishadi.

en: I shall come and sit here often myself and work.
uz: O'zim ham tez-tez bu yerga kelib, o'tirib ishlayman.

en: Indeed, I am writing now, with my book on my knee, and listening to the talk of three old men
uz: Darhaqiqat, men endi kitobimni tiz cho'kib yozyapman va uchta keksa odamning suhbatini tinglayman.

en: who are sitting beside me.
uz: Mening yonimda o'tirganlar.

en: They seem to do nothing all day but sit here and talk.
uz: Ular kun bo'yi hech narsa qilmaydilar, faqat bu yerda o'tirib suhbatlashadi.

en: The harbour lies below me, with, on the far side, one long granite wall stretching out into the sea, with a curve outwards at the end of it, in the middle of which is a lighthouse.
uz: Port mendan pastda joylashgan bo'lib, yon tomonida dengizga cho'zilgan uzun granit devor bor, uning oxirida tashqi egrilik bor va uning o'rtasida chiroq bor.

en: A heavy seawall runs along outside of it.
uz: Uning tashqarisida og'ir dengiz devori davom etadi.

en: On the near side, the seawall makes an elbow crooked inversely, and its end too has a lighthouse.
uz: Yaqin tomondan, dengiz bo'g'i qo'lqusini o'z o'rniga buzib qo'yadi va uning oxiri ham chiroqga ega.

en: Between the two piers there is a narrow opening into the harbour, which then suddenly widens.
uz: Ikkala pilar o'rtasida portga yopilgan eng siqilgan eshik bor va u to'satdan kengroq bo'ladi.

en: It is nice at high water, but when the tide is out it shoals away to nothing, and there is merely the stream of the Esk, running between banks of sand, with rocks here and there.
uz: Yuqori suvlarda yaxshi, ammo to'lqin chiqib ketganda, u hech narsa bo'lib ketmaydi va Esk daryosining oqimi ham bor, u qum qirg'oqlari o'rtasida, bu erda va u erda toshlar bilan o'tadi.

en: Outside the harbour on this side there rises for about half a mile a great reef, the sharp of which runs straight out from be- hind the south lighthouse.
uz: Ushbu tomondan port tashqarisida taxminan yarim mil uzoqlikda katta shkaf ko'tariladi, uning keskinligi janubiy chiroqning orqasidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqib ketadi.

en: At the end of it is a buoy with a bell, which swings in bad weather, and sends in a mournful sound on the wind.
uz: Uning oxirida yomon havo sharoitida o'z vaqtida o'tadigan va shamolga qayg'u tovushini yuboradigan qo'ng'iroqli bo'lak bor.

en: They have a legend here that when a ship is lost bells are heard out at sea.
uz: Bu yerda bir afsona borki, kema yo'qolganda, dengizda qo'ng'iroqlar eshitiladi.

en: I must ask the old man about this.
uz: Bu haqda keksa odamdan so'rashim kerak.

en: He is coming this way … He is a funny old man.
uz: U shu yo'ldan kelayotgan bo'lsa-da, u juda qiziqarli keksa odam.

en: He must be awfully old, for his face is gnarled and twisted like the bark of a tree.
uz: U juda keksa bo'lishi kerak, chunki uning yuzi daraxt qovoqlari singari bo'g'ib-bo'g'ib ketgan.

en: He tells me that he is nearly a hundred, and that he was a sailor in the Greenland ﬁshing ﬂeet when Waterloo was fought.
uz: U menga o'zining qariyb yuz yoshliligini va Waterloo jangida Groenlandiya baliqchilik flotida dengizchi bo'lganini aytadi.

en: He is, I am afraid, a very sceptical person, for when I asked him about the bells at sea and the White Lady at the abbey he said very brusquely, I wouldn't fash masel' about them, miss.
uz: U juda shubhali odam, deb qo'rqaman, chunki men unga dengizdagi qo'ng'iroqlar va abadiyadagi Oq Xonim haqida so'raganimda, u juda qattiq javob berdi: Men ular haqida gapirishni xohlamayman, xonim.

en: Them things be all wore out.
uz: Ularning barchasi eskirgan bo'ladi.

en: Mind, I don't say that they never was, but I do say that they wasn't in my time.
uz: E'tibor bering, ular hech qachon bo'lmagan, deb aytmayman, lekin ular mening davrimda bo'lmagan, deb aytaman.

en: They be all very well for comers and trippers, an' the like, but not for a nice young lady like you.
uz: Ular sayohatchilar va sayohatchilar uchun juda yaxshi, ammo siz kabi go'zal yosh ayol uchun emas.

en: Them feet-folks from York and Leeds that be always eatin'cured herrin's and drinkin' tea an' lookin' out to buy cheap jet would creed aught.
uz: York va Leeds shahridan kelgan, har doim shifoxonada ovqatlanadigan va choy ichadigan va arzon jet sotib olishni istagan kishilar hech narsaga ishonmaydilar.

en: I wonder masel' who'd be bothered tellin' lies to them, even the newspapers, which is full of fool-talk. I thought he would be a good person to learn interesting things from, so I asked him if he would mind telling me something about the whale ﬁshing in the old days.
uz: O'zimni o'yladimki, u qiziqarli narsalarni o'rganish uchun yaxshi odam bo'ladi, shuning uchun men undan eski kunlarda baliq ovlash haqida bir narsa aytib berishni istamasligini so'radim.

en: He was just settling himself to begin when the clock struck six, whereupon he laboured to get up, and said, I must gang ageeanwards home now, miss.
uz: U soat olti o'tgach, boshlanishni boshlash uchun o'zini o'zgartirgan edi, so'ng u turib, shunday dedi: Men endi uyga qaytishim kerak, xonim.

en: My granddaughter doesn't like to be kept waitin' when the tea is ready, for it takes me time to crammle aboon the grees, for there be a many of `em, and miss, I lack belly-timber sairly by the clock.
uz: O'g'lim choy tayyor bo'lganda uni kutishga majbur qilishni yoqtirmaydi, chunki men o'zimga ko'p o'tkirlarni to'plash uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi, chunki juda ko'p `em bor va xotinim, men soatga qarab qorim-quruqsizligimni yo'qotaman.

en: He hobbled away, and I could see him hurrying, as well as he could, down the steps.
uz: U qochib ketdi va men uni tezlab, imkon qadar pastga tushayotganini ko'rardim.

en: The steps are a great feature on the place.
uz: Sotoqlar joydagi ajoyib xususiyatdir.

en: They lead from the town to the church, there are hundreds of them, I do not know how many, and they wind up in a delicate curve.
uz: Ular shahardan cherkovga olib boradi, ularning yuzlablari bor, ularning soni qanchaligini bilmayman, lekin ular murakkab bo'g'iqqa tushib ketadi.

en: The slope is so gentle that a horse could easily walk up and down them.
uz: Bu yo'laklar shunchalik yumshoqki, ot ularni osongina ko'tarishi va pastga tushishi mumkin.

en: I think they must originally have had something to do with the abbey.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ular dastlab abbay bilan bog'liq bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: I shall go home too.
uz: Men ham uyga boraman.

en: Lucy went out, visiting with her mother, and as they were only duty calls, I did not go.
uz: Lusi onasi bilan ziyoratga chiqdi va ular faqat xizmatga chaqiriladigan bo'lgani uchun men bormadim.

en: 1 August.—I came up here an hour ago with Lucy, and we had a most interesting talk with my old friend and the two others who always come and join him.
uz: 1 avgust.Men Luisi bilan bir soat oldin bu yerga keldim va eski do'stim va do'stim bilan qiziqarli suhbatlashdik.

en: He is evidently the Sir Oracle of them, and I should think must have been in his time a most dictatorial person.
uz: U ulardan sir Oracle bo'lgani aniq, va men o'ylaymanki, u o'z davrida eng diktator odam bo'lgan.

en: He will not admit anything, and down faces everybody.
uz: U hech narsani tan olmaydi va hamma bilan yuzma-yuz gapiradi.

en: If he can't out- argue them he bullies them, and then takes their silence for agreement with his views.
uz: Agar ular bilan bahslasholmasa, u ularni zorlaydi va keyin o'z nuqtai nazarlari bilan rozilik uchun ularning sukutini oladi.

en: Lucy was looking sweetly pretty in her white lawn frock.
uz: Lucy o'zining oq ko'ylak kiyimida chiroyli ko'rinardi.

en: She has got a beautiful colour since she has been here.
uz: U bu yerda bo'lganidan beri chiroyli rangga ega bo'ldi.

en: I noticed that the old men did not lose any time in coming and sitting near her when we sat down.
uz: Qariyalar biz o'tirganimizda uning yonida o'tirishga kelishib, vaqt o'tkazmasligini payqadim.

en: She is so sweet with old people, I think they all fell in love with her on the spot.
uz: U keksalarga shunchalik mehribon bo'lganki, ularning hammasi unga darhol muhabbat qozonishgan.

en: Even my old man succumbed and did not contradict her, but gave me double share instead.
uz: Hatto dadam ham bo'shashdi va unga qarshilik ko'rsatmadi, aksincha menga ikki baravar nasib etdi.

en: I got him on the subject of the legends , and he went off at once into a sort of sermon.
uz: Men unga afsonalar mavzusida maslahat berdim va u darhol bir xil va'z qilishga kirdi.

en: I must try to re- member it and put it down.
uz: Men uni qayta o'rnatishga va yozib qo'yishga harakat qilishim kerak.

en: It be all fool-talk, lock, stock, and barrel, that's what it be and nowt else.
uz: Butun gap-so'z, qulf, aktsiya va barrel bo'lsin, bu o'zi va boshqa hech narsa emas.

en: These bans an' wafts an' boh-ghosts an' bar-guests an' bogles an' all anent them is only ﬁt to set bairns an' dizzy women a'belderin'.
uz: Ushbu taqiqlar an' o'lchovlar an' boh-ghosts an' bar mehmonlari an' bogles an' all an'ent them faqat bolalar o'rnatish uchun mos keladi an' qahramon ayollar a' belderin.

en: They be nowt but air-blebs.
uz: Ular endi faqat havoga o'xshaydi.

en: They, an' all grims an' signs an' warnin's, be all invented by par- sons an' illsome berk-bodies an' railway touters to skeer an' scunner haf- ﬂin's, an' to get folks to do somethin' that they don't other incline to.
uz: Ular, hammalari g'alati va ogohlantiruvchi belgilar, odamlar o'zlariga yoqmaydigan narsalarni qilish uchun, bir-birlari bilan bog'liq bo'lgan yovuz berk-jildlar va temir yo'l reklamachilari tomonidan yaratilgan.

en: It makes me ireful to think o' them.
uz: O'zlarini o'ylash meni g'azablantiradi.

en: Why, it's them that, not content with print- in' lies on paper an' preachin' them ou t of pulpits, does want to be cuttin' them on the tombstones.
uz: Axir, ular qog'ozda yozilgan yolg'onlarga, ularni va'z qilishga yoki o'sha-o'sha quloqlarda o'qish bilan qanoatlanmay, ularni qabr toshlarida kesishni istaydilar.

en: Look here all around you in what airt ye will.
uz: Bu yerda atrofingizga nima bo'lganini ko'ring.

en: All them steans, holdin' up their heads as well as they can out of their pride, is acant, simply tumblin' down with the weight o' the lies wrote on them, `Here lies the body' or `Sacred to the memory' wrote on all of them, an' yet in nigh half of them there bean't no bodies at all, an' the memories of them bean't cared a pinch of snuff about, much less sacred.
uz: Ularning barchasi mag'rurlikdan boshlarini ko'tarib, o'zlarining kuchlari boricha ko'proq ko'tarib, o'zlariga yozilgan yolg'onlarning og'irligi bilan qulab tushishdi, ` Mana, ularning barchasida o'tirgan badan yoki ` Xotiraga bag'ishlangan badan yozib qo'yildi, lekin ularning deyarli yarmida hech qanday badan yo'q edi, ularning xotiralari bir qichqiriq sigir haqida g'amxo'rlik qilmadi, shunchalik ham muqaddas emas edi.

en: Lies all of them, noth- in' but lies of one kind or another!
uz: Ularning barchasida yolg'on gapiradi, lekin bu yolg'onlardan boshqa hech narsa emas!

en: My gog, but it'll be a quare scowderment
uz: Mening gogim, lekin bu quare-skudderment bo'ladi

en: at the Day of Judgment when they come tumblin' up in their death-sarks, all jouped together an' trying' to drag their tombsteans with them to prove how good they was, some of them trimmlin' an' dithering, with their hands that dozzened an' slippery from lyin' in the sea that they can't even keep their gurp o' them. I could see from the old fellow's self-satisﬁed air and the way in which he looked round for the approval of his cronies that he was showing off, so I put in a word to keep him going.
uz: Qiyomat kunida ular o'zlarining o'lim sarklarida o'tirib, o'zlarining qabrlarini o'zlari bilan olib ketishga harakat qilishganida, ba'zilari qanchalik yaxshi ekanliklarini isbotlash uchun, ba'zilari o'zlarining qo'llari bilan dengizda o'tirib, hatto o'zlarining gurplarini saqlay olmaydigan qilib qo'yilgan qo'llari bilan o'zlarining qabrlarini olib ketishga harakat qilishgan edi. Men keksa odamning o'z-o'zidan mamnun bo'lgan havoda va u ko'rsatayotgan do'stlarining roziligini izlayotganidan ko'ra, atrofini ko'rardim, shuning uchun uni davom ettirish uchun so'z qo'ydim.

en: Swales, you can't be serious.
uz: Swales, siz jiddiy gapirmayapsiz.

en: Surely these tombstones are not all wrong? Yabblins!
uz: Shubhasiz, bu qabr toshlarining hammasi ham noto'g'ri emasmi? - deb so'rashdi.

en: There may be a poorish few not wrong, savin' where they make out the people too good, for there be folk that do think a balm-bowl be like the sea, if only it be their own.
uz: Ehtimol, kambag'allarning bir nechtasi noto'g'ri yo'l tutmaydi, chunki ular odamlarni juda yaxshi ko'rishadi, chunki odamlarning ba'zilari o'zlariga xos bo'lsa-da, balsamli idish dengizga o'xshaydi deb o'ylashadi.

en: The whole thing be only lies.
uz: Butun narsa yolg'on bo'lishi mumkin.

en: You come here a stranger, an' you see this kirkgarth. I nodded, for I thought it better to assent, though I did not quite under- stand his dialect.
uz: Siz bu yerga begona odam sifatida kelgansiz va bu kirkgarthni ko'rgansiz. Men boshimni yumdim, chunki uning dialektini tushunmagan bo'lsam-da, rozi bo'lish yaxshiroq deb o'yladim.

en: I knew it had something to do with the church.
uz: Bularning cherkov bilan aloqasi borligini bilardim.

en: He went on, And you consate that all these steans be aboon folk that be haped here, snod an' snog? I assented again.
uz: U davom etdi: Va siz bu ko'pchilikning bu yerda bo'lgan ahvolga to'g'ri kelishini bilasizmi, snod an' snog? - Men yana rozi bo'ldim.

en: Then that be just where the lie comes in.
uz: O'shanda yolg'on gapiradigan joy aynan shu bo'ladi.

en: Why, there be scores of these laybeds that be toom as old Dun's `baccabox on Friday night. He nudged one of his companions, and they all laughed.
uz: Ehtimol, juma kuni kechqurun Dunning eski `baccabox kabi bo'lgan ko'pgina o'rindiqlari bor. - deb qo'shib qo'ydi.

en: How could they be otherwise?
uz: Qanday qilib ular boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Look at that one, the aftest abaft the bier- bank, read it! I went over and read, Edward Spencelagh, master mariner, murdered by pirates off the coast of Andres, April, 1854, age 30. When I came back Mr.
uz: Mana, bu bir odamni ko'ring, uni o'qing! - deb o'qib chiqdim. Edward Spencelagh, ustun dengizchi, Andres qirg'og'ida, 1854 yil aprel oyida, qaroqchilar tomonidan o'ldirilgan, 30 yoshda.

en: Swales went on, Who brought him home, I wonder, to hap him here?
uz: Svalis davom etdi: Qani uni uyga olib keldi, deb o'ylayman, uni bu yerga qo'yib yuborish uchun?

en: Murdered off the coast of Andres!
uz: Andres qirg'og'ida o'ldirilgan!

en: An' you consated his body lay under!
uz: Uning tanasi ostida o'tirib qolgan edi!

en: Why, I could name ye a dozen whose bones lie in the Greenland seas above, he pointed north- wards, or where the currants may have drifted them.
uz: Men sizlarning o'nlabgina suyaklarini Greenlandiya dengizlari ustida joylashgan o'nlab ismlar bilan ata olaman, - dedi u, shimoliy bo'laklarni ko'rsatdi, - yoki ularni oqovlar qayerga olib borgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: There be the steans around ye.
uz: Sizlarning atrofingizdagilar ko'p bo'ladi.

en: Ye can, with your young eyes, read the small print of the lies from here.
uz: Siz yosh ko'zlaringiz bilan yolg'onlarning kichik nusxasini shu yerdan o'qiy olasiz.

en: This Braithwaite Lowery, I knew his father, lost in the Lively off Greenland in `20, or Andrew Woodhouse, drowned in the same seas in 1777, or John Paxton, drowned off Cape Farewell a year later, or old John Rawlings, whose grandfather sailed with me, drowned in the Gulf of Fin- land in `50.
uz: Bu Braithwaite Lowery, men otasini bilardim, Greenlandiyaning Lively dengizida `20 da yo'qolgan, yoki 1777 yilda shu dengizlarda cho'kkan Andrew Woodhouse, yoki bir yil o'tgach Cape Farewellda cho'kkan John Paxton, yoki keksa Jon Rawlings, uning buvisi men bilan birga yelka yurgan, `50 da Finlandiya qirg'og'ida cho'kgan.

en: Do ye think that all these men will have to make a rush to Whit- by when the trumpet sounds?
uz: Sizningcha, bu odamlarning hammasi qahva tovushini eshitganida, Whitning oldiga shoshilishi kerakmi?

en: I have me antherums aboot it!
uz: Men o'zimning anterumlarim bor!

en: when they got here they'd be jommlin' and jostlin' one another that way that it `ud be like a ﬁght up on the ice in the old days, when we'd be at one an- other from daylight to dark, an' tryin' to tie up our cuts by the aurora bore- alis. This was evidently local pleasantry, for the old man cackled over it, and his cronies joined in with gusto.
uz: Ular bu yerga kelganlarida bir-birlarini shunday qo'rqib-qo'rqib o'ynashardiki, bu eski kunlarda buz ustida jangga o'xshaydi, kun yorug'ligidan qorong'igacha bir-birimiz bilan bo'lganimizda, yorug' quyoshga o'xshaydigan o'simliklar bilan o'zimizni bog'lashga harakat qilardik. Bu, albatta, mahalliy mehribonlik edi, chunki keksa bu haqda o'ylashardi, uning do'stlari esa xursandchilik bilan qo'shilishdi.

en: But, I said, surely you are not quite correct, for you start on the as- sumption that all the poor people, or their spirits, will have to take their tombstones with them on the Day of Judgment.
uz: Ammo, dedim men, siz, albatta, to'g'ri emassiz, chunki siz qiyomat kunida barcha kambag'al odamlar yoki ularning ruhi qabr toshlarini o'zlari bilan olib ketishi kerak deb taxmin qilasiz.

en: Do you think that will be really necessary? Well, what else be they tombstones for?
uz: Siz buni albatta kerak deb o'ylaysizmi? - deb so'ragan. - Xo'sh, bu qabr toshlari yana nima uchun?

en: Answer me that, miss! To please their relatives, I suppose. To please their relatives, you suppose! This he said with intense scorn.
uz: Menga javob bering, xotinim! O'z qarindoshlarini mamnun qilish uchun, deb o'ylayman. O'z qarindoshlarini mamnun qilish uchun, deb o'ylayman! - dedi u qattiq haqorat bilan.

en: How will it pleasure their relatives to know that lies is wrote over them, and that everybody in the place knows that they be lies? He pointed to a stone at our feet which had been laid down as a slab, on which the seat was rested, close to the edge of the cliff.
uz: O'z qarindoshlari ularning ustiga yolg'on yozilganini va ularning yolg'on ekanligini hamma biladiganini bilganda qanday xursand bo'lishadi? - deb so'radi u. U oyoqlarimizga toshni ko'rsatdi.

en: Read the lies on that thruff-stone, he said.
uz: O'sha toshdagi yolg'onlarni o'qing, dedi u.

en: The letters were upside down to me from where I sat, but Lucy was more opposite to them, so she leant over and read, Sacred to the memory of George Canon, who died, in the hope of a glorious resurrection, on July 29,1873,falling from the rocks at Kettleness.
uz: Men o'tirgan joydan xatlar menga burun ko'tarilib turardi, lekin Lusi ularga qarama-qarshi edi, shuning uchun u o'zini ko'tardi va o'qib berdi: Kettlenes shahridagi toshlardan tushib, 29 iyul 1873-da ulug'vor tirilish umidida vafot etgan Jorj Kanon xotirasiga bag'ishlangan.

en: This tomb was erected by his sorrowing mother to her dearly beloved son.`He was the only son of his mother, and she was a widow.' Really, Mr.
uz: Bu qabr uning qayg'uli onasi tomonidan o'zining sevikli o'g'li uchun qurilgan edi.

en: Swales, I don't see anything very funny in that! She spoke her comment very gravely and somewhat severely.
uz: Swales, men bunda juda kulgili hech narsa ko'rmayman! - deb aytdi u o'z sharhini juda jiddiy va biroz qattiq aytdi.

en: Ye don't see aught funny!
uz: Siz hech qanday qiziqarli narsani ko'rmayapsizlar!

en: But that's because ye don't gawm the sorrowin'mother was a hell-cat that hated him because he was acrewk'd, a regular lamiter he was, an' he hated her so that he committed suicide in or- der that she mightn't get an insurance she put on his life.
uz: Ammo buning sababi shundaki, qayg'uvaning onasi undan nafratlangan jahannam mushuk bo'lgan, chunki u o'g'il bo'lgan, u odatdagidek o'g'il bo'lgan va uni nafratlagan, shuning uchun u o'z joniga qasd qildi yoki u o'z hayotini sug'urtalamaydi.

en: He blew nigh the top of his head off with an old musket that they had for scarin' crows with.
uz: U qo'rqinchlarni qo'rqitish uchun qo'llaniladigan eski musket bilan boshining yuqori qismini o'tkazdi.

en: `twarn't for crows then, for it brought the clegs and the dowps to him.
uz: O'shanda qo'rqoqlar haqida ogohlantirmang, chunki bu unga cho'g'lar va cho'g'lar keltirdi.

en: That's the way he fell off the rocks.
uz: Shu yo'sin u toshlardan tushib tushdi.

en: And, as to hopes of a glorious resurrection, I've often heard him say masel' that he hoped he'd go to hell, for his mother was so pious that she'd be sure to go to heaven, an' he didn't want to addle where she was.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, ulug'vor tirilish umidiga kelsak, men uni ko'pincha o'zi jahannamga borishini umid qilayotganini aytishini eshitganman, chunki onasi juda xudojo'y bo'lib, u osmonga borishi shubhasizdir, lekin u uning qayerda bo'lganini aytishni istamagan.

en: Now isn't that stean at any rate,he hammered it with his stick as he spoke, a pack of lies?
uz: Endi bu hech bo'lmaganda, - dedi u, gapirganida, cho'qqisi bilan urib, - yolg'on to'plami emasmi?

en: And won't it make Gabriel keckle when
uz: Va bu Gabrielni qichqirib qo'ymasmi?

en: Geordie comes pantin' ut the grees with the tompstean balanced on his hump, and asks to be took as evidence! I did not know what to say, but Lucy turned the conversation as she said, rising up, Oh, why did you tell us of this?
uz: Geordie o'zining qo'llari ustida tompstean bilan o'g'illarni o'g'irlab, guvohlik sifatida qabul qilishni so'radi! - deb so'raganida, men nima deb aytishni bilmasdim, lekin Lusi suhbatni o'zgartirib, o'zini baland ko'tardi va: Oh, nega bu haqda bizga aytding?

en: It is my favorite seat, and I can- not leave it, and now I ﬁnd I must go on sitting over the grave of a suicide. That won't harm ye, my pretty, an' it may make poor Geordie gladsome to have so trim a lass sittin' on his lap.
uz: Bu mening sevimli o'rinchim va men uni tashlab ketolmayman va endi o'z-o'lim qabrida o'tirishga majbur bo'laman.

en: Why, I've sat here off an' on for nigh twenty years past, an' it hasn't done me no harm.
uz: Men bu yerda yigirma yil davomida o'tirganman, lekin bu menga hech qanday zarar yetkazmagan.

en: Don't ye fash about them as lies under ye, or that doesn' lie there either!
uz: Ular haqida yolg'on gapirmanglar, yoki bu ham yolg'on gapirmaydi!

en: It'll be time for ye to be getting scart when ye see the tombsteans all run away with, and the place as bare as a stubble-ﬁeld.
uz: Qobillar qochib ketayotganini va yerni cho'g'lar maydoni kabi yalang'och ko'rayotib, sizlarning ko'nglingiz tushishi vaqti keldi.

en: There's the clock, and'I must gang.
uz: Soat o'tib ketdi va men to'planib turishim kerak.

en: My service to ye, ladies! And off he hobbled.
uz: Sizlarga xizmatim, xonimlar! - dedi va o'zini qo'zg'atdi.

en: Lucy and I sat awhile, and it was all so beautiful before us that we took hands as we sat, and she told me all over again about Arthur and their com- ing marriage.
uz: Luisi bilan bir muncha vaqt o'tirdik va o'zimiz oldida hamma narsa shunchalik chiroyli ediki, o'tirganimiz sayin qo'ldan tutdik va u menga Artur va ularning yaqinlashib kelayotgan nikohi haqida yana bir bor aytib berdi.

en: That made me just a little heart-sick, for I haven't heard from Jonathan for a whole month.
uz: Bu meni biroz og'irlashtirdi, chunki men Jonatanning xabarini bir oy davomida eshitmagan edim.

en: I came up here alone, for I am very sad.
uz: Men bu yerga yolg'iz keldim, chunki men juda xafaman.

en: There was no let- ter for me.
uz: Men uchun hech qanday xat yo'q edi.

en: I hope there cannot be anything the matter with Jonathan.
uz: Umid qilamanki, Jonatan bilan hech qanday muammo bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: The clock has just struck nine.
uz: Soat endi to'qqizga yetdi.

en: I see the lights scattered all over the town, some- times in rows where the streets are, and sometimes singly.
uz: Shaharning har bir tomonida chiroqlar tarqalib turishini ko'ryapman, ba'zan ko'chalar bo'lgan joylarda qatorda, ba'zan esa yakka tartibda.

en: They run right up the Esk and die away in the curve of the valley.
uz: Ular Esk daryosini ko'tarib, vodiyning burchakida o'lib ketishadi.

en: To my left the view is cut off by a black line of roof of the old house next to the abbey.
uz: Mening chap tomonimda ko'rinish abbayning yonidagi eski uyning qora tomli tomidan kesilgan.

en: The sheep and lambs are bleating in the ﬁelds away behind me, and there is a clatter of donkeys' hoofs up the paved road below.
uz: Qo'ylar va qo'zilar ortimdan uzoq bo'lgan dalalarda so'zlab o'tirmoqdalar va pastdagi paxtalashtirilgan yo'ldan burun burchaklarning cho'qqisi eshitilmoqda.

en: The band on the pier is playing a harsh waltz in good time, and further along the quay there is a Salvation Army meeting in a back street.
uz: Qirg'oqxonadagi guruh vaqt o'tib qattiq valits o'ynaydi va qirg'oq bo'yi bo'ylab Qutqaruv armiyasi to'plami bo'lib o'tadi.

en: Neither of the bands hears the other, but up here I hear and see them both.
uz: Ikki guruh ham bir-birini eshitmaydi, lekin men bu yerda ikkovini ham eshitaman va ko'raman.

en: I wonder where Jonathan is and if he is thinking of me!
uz: Jonatan qayerda va u mendan o'ylayaptimi, deb o'ylayman!

en: I wish he were here.
uz: U bu yerda bo'lganida yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 5 June.—The case of Renﬁeld grows more interesting the more I get to understand the man.
uz: SEWARDning 5 iyun kunligi.Renfild da'vosi men odamni qanchalik yaxshi tushunsam, shunchalik qiziqarli bo'ladi.

en: He has certain qualities very largely developed, selﬁsh- ness, secrecy, and purpose.
uz: Uning ba'zi fazilatlari juda ko'p rivojlangan: xudbinlik, sirlilik va maqsad.

en: I wish I could get at what is the object of the latter.
uz: Qani endi nima maqsadda gap ketayotganini bilib olishim mumkin.

en: He seems to have some settled scheme of his own, but what it is I do not know.
uz: Uning o'zidan-o'zi shakllangan rejasi bor, lekin nima ekanligini bilmayman.

en: His redeeming quality is a love of animals, though, indeed, he has such curious turns in it that I sometimes imagine he is only abnormally cruel.
uz: Uning qutqaruvchisi hayvonlarga bo'lgan sevgisi bo'lsa-da, uning o'ziga xos o'zgarishlari borligi sababli, ba'zan uning faqat g'alati shafqatsiz ekani haqida o'ylayman.

en: His pets are of odd sorts.
uz: Uning uy hayvonlari g'ayritabiiy turdagi.

en: Just now his hobby is catching ﬂies.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda uning hobisi uchuqlarni ushlab turishdir.

en: He has at present such a quantity that I have had myself to expostulate.
uz: Hozirda u shunchalik ko'p bo'lganki, men o'zim uni ko'rib chiqishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: To my astonishment, he did not break out into a fury, as I expected, but took the matter in simple seriousness.
uz: Meni hayratda qoldirgan narsa shundaki, u o'zim kutgandek g'azabga tushmadi, balki bu ishni jiddiy qabul qildi.

en: He thought for a moment, and then said, May I have three days?
uz: U bir muncha o'ylab ko'rdi va so'ng dedi: Menga uch kun vaqt berishim mumkinmi?

en: I shall clear them away. Of course, I said that would do.
uz: Men ularni tozalab yuboraman. Albatta, men shunday qilishim kerak, deb aytdim.

en: 18 June.—He has turned his mind now to spiders, and has got several very big fellows in a box.
uz: 18 iyun.U endi o'z fikrini o'zlariga o'zgartirgan va bir qutuqqa bir nechta katta yigitlar kirdi.

en: He keeps feeding them his ﬂies, and the number of the latter is becoming sensibly diminished, although he has used half his food in attracting more ﬂies from outside to his room.
uz: U o'z ozuqalarining yarmini tashqariga chiqib, xonaga ko'proq ozuqalarni jalb qilish uchun sarflagan bo'lsa-da, o'z ozuqalarining sonini sezilarli darajada kamaytirib bormoqda.

en: 1 July.—His spiders are now becoming as great a nuisance as his ﬂies, and today I told him that he must get rid of them.
uz: 1 iyul.Uning o'g'irchoqlari endi uning o'qlari kabi zararli bo'lib ketmoqda va bugun men unga ulardan qutulishi kerakligini aytdim.

en: He looked very sad at this, so I said that he must some of them, at all events.
uz: U juda xafa ko'rinardi, shuning uchun men unga ba'zilari kerakligini aytdim.

en: He cheerfully acquiesced in this, and I gave him the same time as before for reduction.
uz: U bunga rozi bo'ldi va men unga avvalgidek kamaytirish uchun vaqt berdim.

en: He disgusted me much while with him, for when a horrid blowﬂy, bloat- ed with some carrion food, buzzed into the room, he caught it, held it exul- tantly for a few moments between his ﬁnger and thumb, and before I knew what he was going to do, put it in his mouth and ate it.
uz: U bilan birga bo'lganimda, meni juda jirkanch his qilar edi, chunki qo'rqinchli o't qo'zg'atadi, u o'z xonasiga kirib, uni ushlab qo'ydi, bir necha daqiqa barmoq va bosh barmog'i o'rtasida qo'ydi va men nima qilishni bilmasimdan oldin, uni og'ziga qo'yib yedi.

en: I scolded him for it, but he argued quietly that it was very good and very wholesome, that it was life, strong life, and gave life to him.
uz: Men uni bu uchun tanqid qildim, lekin u juda yaxshi va juda sog'lom, bu hayot, kuchli hayot va unga hayot berganligini sukutdan aytdi.

en: This gave me an idea, or the rudiment of one.
uz: Bu menga bir g'oya yoki uning asosini berdi.

en: I must watch how he gets rid of his spiders.
uz: U o'z o'g'irchoqlaridan qanday qutulishini kuzatishim kerak.

en: He has evidently some deep problem in his mind, for he keeps a little notebook in which he is always jotting down something.
uz: Uning ongida chuqur muammo bor, chunki u har doim biron bir narsani yozib yuradigan kichik yozuv daftarini saqlaydi.

en: whole pages of it are ﬁlled with masses of ﬁgures, generally single numbers added up in batches, and then the totals added in batches again, as though he were fo- cussing some account, as the auditors put it.
uz: Uning to'liq sahifalari ko'p raqamlar bilan to'ldirilgan, odatda bitta raqamlar guruhlar bo'lib qo'shilgan, keyin esa to'plamlar guruhlar bo'lib qo'shilgan, xuddi auditorlar aytganidek, u biron bir hisobni muhokama qilgandek.

en: 8 July.—There is a method in his madness, and the rudimentary idea in my mind is growing.
uz: 8 iyul.Uning aqldan ozganida usul bor va mening ongimdagi ashaddiy g'oya o'sib bormoqda.

en: It will be a whole idea soon, and then, oh, unconscious cerebration, you will have to give the wall to your conscious brother.
uz: Tez orada bu butun g'oya bo'ladi va keyin, ey, ongsiz miya, siz o'z ongli birodaringizga devorni berishingiz kerak bo'ladi.

en: I kept away from my friend for a few days, so that I might notice if there were any change.
uz: Bir necha kun do'stimdan uzoqlashdim, agar biron bir o'zgarish yuz bersa, uni payqadim.

en: Things remain as they were except that he has parted with some of his pets and got a new one.
uz: Hamma narsa avvalgidek qoladi, faqat u ba'zi uy hayvonlaridan ajralib, yangi uy hayvonini sotib olgan.

en: He has managed to get a sparrow, and has already partially tamed it.
uz: U qo'zg'onani topishga muvaffaq bo'ldi va uni qisman o'zlashtirdi.

en: His means of taming is simple, for already the spiders have diminshed.
uz: Uning o'zlashtirishi oddiy, chunki o'g'irchoqlar allaqachon kamaygan.

en: Those that do remain, however, are well fed, for he still brings in the ﬂies by tempting them with his food.
uz: Biroq, qolganlar yaxshi ovqatlanmoqda, chunki u o'z taomlari bilan ularni vasvasaga solib, o'tlarni olib keladi.

en: 19 July—We are progressing.
uz: 19 iyulBiz rivojlanayotganmiz.

en: My friend has now a whole colony of spar- rows, and his ﬂies and spiders are almost obliterated.
uz: Do'stimning endi butun qo'rqinchlar koloniyasi bor va uning o'tlari va qo'rg'oqlari deyarli yo'q qilinadi.

en: When I came in he ran to me and said he wanted to ask me a great favour, a very, very great favour.
uz: Men kirganimda, u yugurib kelib, menga katta, juda katta yordam so'rashini aytdi.

en: And as he spoke, he fawned on me like a dog.
uz: U gapirganida esa, it kabi menga koʻz tikdi.

en: I asked him what it was, and he said, with a sort of rapture in his voice and bearing, A kitten, a nice, little, sleek playful kitten, that I can play with, and teach, and feed, and feed, and feed! I was not unprepared for this request, for I had noticed how his pets went on increasing in size and vivacity, but I did not care that his pretty family of tame sparrows should be wiped out in the same manner as the ﬂies and spi- ders.
uz: Men undan nima ekanligini so'radim va u o'z ovozi va hissi bilan: Bir kichkina, go'zal, kichik, chiroyli o'yinli kichkina, men o'ynash, o'rgatish, ovqatlantirish, ovqatlantirish va ovqatlantirishim mumkin! - deb javob berdi.Men bu iltimosga tayyor emas edim, chunki uning uy hayvonlari o'lcham va jonlilikda o'sib borayotganini payqadim, lekin uning o'g'il va o'g'il cho'ponlar oilasi suyaklar va o'g'illar kabi yo'q qilinishi menga qiziqmadi.

en: So I said I would see about it, and asked him if he would not rather have a cat than a kitten.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu haqda ko'rib chiqaman deb aytdim va undan mushukdan ko'ra mushuk olishini afzal ko'rmaysizmi deb so'radim.

en: His eagerness betrayed him as he answered, Oh, yes, I would like a cat!
uz: Uning g'ayrati unga: O, ha, men mushukni xohlayman!

en: I only asked for a kitten lest you should refuse me a cat.
uz: Men faqat bir qushni so'radim, chunki siz menga mushukni rad etishingiz kerak.

en: No one would refuse me a kitten, would they? I shook my head, and said that at present I feared it would not be possi- ble, but that I would see about it.
uz: Hech kim menga mushuk berishni rad etmaydi, shundaymi? - deb boshimni silkitdim va hozir bu mumkin bo'lmasidan qo'rqaman, lekin bu haqda o'ylayman, dedim.

en: His face fell, and I could see a warning of danger in it, for there was a sudden ﬁerce, sidelong look which meant killing.
uz: Uning yuzi qulab ketdi va men u yerda xavf haqida ogohlantirishni ko'rardim, chunki to'satdan qo'pol va qo'pol ko'rinish paydo bo'ldi, bu esa o'ldirishni anglatadi.

en: The man is an undeveloped homicidal maniac.
uz: Bu odam rivojlanmagan o'ldiruvchi maniac.

en: I shall test him with his present craving and see how it will work out, then I shall know more.
uz: Men uni hozirgi istaklari bilan sinab ko'raman va qanday natijalarga erishishini ko'raman, keyinroq ko'proq bilib olaman.

en: 10 pm.—I have visited him again and found him sitting in a corner brooding.
uz: 10 da.Men uni yana ko'rib chiqdim va uni burchada o'tirganini ko'rdim.

en: When I came in he threw himself on his knees before me and im- plored me to let him have a cat, that his salvation depended upon it.
uz: Men kirganimda, u mendan oldin tiz cho'kib, uning qutqarilishiga bog'liq bo'lgan qushga ega bo'lishimni so'radi.

en: I was ﬁrm, however, and told him that he could not have it, whereupon he went without a word, and sat down, gnawing his ﬁngers, in the corner where I had found him.
uz: Men qat'iy bo'lib, unga bu borada hech narsa aytolmasligini aytdim va u so'zsiz ketdi va men uni topgan burchada o'tirib, o'z barmoqlarini teshiklab o'tirdi.

en: I shall see him in the morning early.
uz: Men uni ertalab ertalab ko'raman.

en: 20 July.—Visited Renﬁeld very early, before attendant went his rounds.
uz: 20 iyul.Renfieldni juda erta tashrif buyurdi, xizmatkor o'z turlariga borishdan oldin.

en: Found him up and humming a tune.
uz: Uni topib, qo'shiq qo'shib o'tirdi.

en: He was spreading out his sugar, which he had saved, in the window, and was manifestly beginning his ﬂy catching again, and beginning it cheerfully and with a good grace.
uz: U o'zi saqlagan shakarini darchaga tarqatib, o'zining o't qo'yib qo'ygan shakarini yana qo'lga kiritishni boshlagan edi va uni quvonchli va rahm-shafqat bilan boshlagan edi.

en: I looked around for his birds, and not seeing them,asked him where they were.
uz: Men uning qushlarini ko'rdim va ularni ko'rmay, ulardan qaerdaligini so'radim.

en: He replied, without turning round, that they had all ﬂown away.
uz: U o'girilib o'tirmasdan, ularning hammasi uchib ketganini aytdi.

en: There were a few feathers about the room and on his pillow a drop of blood.
uz: Xonaning atrofida bir necha tovuq bor edi va uning yostigi ustida qon tomchiligi bor edi.

en: I said nothing, but went and told the keeper to report to me if there were anything odd about him during the day.
uz: Men hech narsa aytmadim, lekin borib, soqchiga kun davomida u haqida biron bir g'alati narsa bo'lsa, menga xabar berishini aytdim.

en: 11 am.—The attendant has just been to see me to say that Renﬁeld has been very sick and has disgorged a whole lot of feathers.
uz: 11 da.Kofir meni ko'rib, Renfield og'ir kasal bo'lib, ko'p tovuqlarni tashladi, deb aytmoqchi bo'ldi.

en: tor, he said, that he has eaten his birds, and that he just took and ate them raw! 11 pm.—I gave Renﬁeld a strong opiate tonight, enough to make even him sleep, and took away his pocketbook to look at it.
uz: U qushlarini yeb yubordi va shunchaki ularni xom yeydi! - dedi u. 11 da.Men Renfieldga bugun uyquga yetarli darajada kuchli opiat berdim va uni ko'rib chiqish uchun qopqoqxonasini olib ketdim.

en: The thought that has been buzzing about my brain lately is complete, and the theory proved.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda miyam haqida o'ylaydigan fikr to'liq va nazariya isbotlangan.

en: My homicidal maniac is of a peculiar kind.
uz: Mening o'ldiruvchi maniacim o'zgacha turdagi.

en: I shall have to invent a new classiﬁcation for him, and call him a zoophagous (life-eating) maniac.
uz: U uchun yangi klassifikatsiyani topib, uni zoofag maniaqi deb atashim kerak bo'ladi.

en: What he desires is to absorb as many lives as he can, and he has laid himself out to achieve it in a cumulative way.
uz: U iloji boricha ko'proq hayotni o'z ichiga olishni istaydi va uni to'liq amalga oshirish uchun o'zini tayyorladi.

en: He gave many ﬂies to one spider and many spiders to one bird, and then wanted a cat to eat the many birds.
uz: U bitta o'g'irchoqqa ko'plab o'tlar va bitta qushga ko'plab o'tlar berdi va keyin ko'plab qushlarni yeydigan mushukni xohladi.

en: What would have been his later steps?
uz: Uning keyingi qadamlari qanday bo'lgan?

en: It would almost be worth while to complete the experiment.
uz: Tajribani tugatish deyarli vaqtga arziydi.

en: It might be done if there were only a sufﬁcient cause.
uz: Agar faqat yetarli sabab bo'lsa, bu amalga oshirilishi mumkin.

en: Men sneered at vivisection, and yet look at its results today!
uz: Erkaklar vivisectionni masxara qilishgan, ammo bugungi kunda uning natijalariga e'tibor bering!

en: Why not advance science in its most difﬁcult and vital aspect, the knowledge of the brain?
uz: Nima uchun ilm-fanning eng qiyin va muhim jihatida, miyaning bilimida rivojlanmaymiz?

en: Had I even the secret of one such mind, did I hold the key to the fancy of even one lunatic, I might advance my own branch of science to a pitch com- pared with which Burdon-Sanderson's physiology or Ferrier's brain knowl- edge would be as nothing.
uz: Agarda men bunday ongning sirini bilganimda, hatto birgina aqldan ozgan odamning xayollariga eshikni qo'yganimda, o'z fan tarmog'imni Burdon-Sandersonning fiziologiyasi yoki Ferrierning miyasi haqida bilimlari hech narsa bo'lmagan darajada rivojlantirgan bo'lardim.

en: If only there were a sufﬁcient cause!
uz: Agarda yetarlicha sabab bo'lganida edi!

en: I must not think too much of this, or I may be tempted.
uz: Men bu haqda juda ko'p o'ylamasligim kerak, aks holda men vasvasaga tushishim mumkin.

en: A good cause might turn the scale with me, for may not I too be of an exceptional brain, congenitally?
uz: Yaxshi sabab menga o'lchovni o'zgartirishi mumkin, chunki men ham tug'ilganda ajoyib miyam bo'lmasam bo'ladimi?

en: How well the man reasoned.
uz: Bu odam qanchalik yaxshi fikr yuritgan.

en: Lunatics always do within their own scope.
uz: Aqlsizlar har doim o'z imkoniyatlari doirasida harakat qilishadi.

en: I wonder at how many lives he values a man, or if at only one.
uz: O'zimni qancha hayotga ega bo'lgan odamni qadrlaydi yoki faqat bitta hayotga ega bo'ladimi, deb o'ylayman.

en: He has closed the account most accurately, and today begun a new record.
uz: U hisobni eng aniq tarzda yopdi va bugun yangi rekordni qo'lga kiritdi.

en: How many of us begin a new record with each day of our lives?
uz: Hayotimizdagi har bir kun bilan qanchalar yangi rekordni boshlaymiz?

en: To me it seems only yesterday that my whole life ended with my new hope, and that truly I began a new record.
uz: O'shanda butun hayotim yangi umid bilan tugagandek tuyuladi va men yangi rekordni boshladim.

en: So it shall be until the Great Recorder sums me up and closes my ledger account with a balance to proﬁt or loss.
uz: Shunday qilib, Buyuk yozuvchi meni to'plab, hisob raqamimni foyda yoki zarar bilan yopmaguncha bo'ladi.

en: Oh, Lucy, Lucy, I cannot be angry with you, nor can I be angry with my friend whose happiness is yours, but I must only wait on hopeless and work.
uz: Oh, Luisi, Luisi, men sizga g'azablanolmayman va sizning baxtingiz bo'lgan do'stimga ham g'azablanolmayman, lekin umidsizlikni kutib, ishlashim kerak.

en: If I could have as strong a cause as my poor mad friend there, a good, un- selﬁsh cause to make me work, that would be indeed happiness.
uz: Agar mening o'zimni ishontirish uchun g'ayri xudbin, yaxshi sababga ega bo'lganim uchun, u erda bo'lgan bechora aqldan ozgan do'stim kabi kuchli sababga ega bo'lsam, bu, albatta, baxt bo'lardi.

en: MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL 26 July.—I am anxious, and it soothes me to express myself here.
uz: MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL 26 iyul.Men tashvishlanaman va bu erda o'zimni ifoda etish meni tinchlantiradi.

en: It is like whispering to one's self and listening at the same time.
uz: Bu o'z-o'zingizga shoshib, bir vaqtning o'zida tinglash kabi.

en: something about the shorthand symbols that makes it different from writing.
uz: Shortand belgilari haqida gap ketganda, uni yozishdan ajratib turadigan bir narsa bor.

en: I am unhappy about Lucy and about Jonathan.
uz: Lucy va Jonatan bilan baxtsizman.

en: I had not heard from Jonathan for some time, and was very concerned, but yesterday dear Mr.
uz: Bir muncha vaqtdan beri Jonatanning xabarini eshitmagan edim va juda xavotirda edim, lekin kecha aziz Mr.

en: Hawkins, who is always so kind, sent me a letter from him.
uz: Har doim mehribon bo'lgan Xokins menga o'zining maktubini yubordi.

en: I had written asking him if he had heard, and he said the enclosed had just been received.
uz: Men unga yozgan edim va eshitganini so'ragan edim, u esa qo'shimcha ma'lumotni yaqinda qabul qilganini aytdi.

en: It is only a line dated from Castle Dracula, and says that he is just starting for home.
uz: Bu faqat Dracula qalʼasidan olingan bir satr va u oʻz uyidan boshlanayotganini aytadi.

en: That is not like Jonathan.
uz: Bu Yoʻnatan kabi emas.

en: I do not understand it, and it makes me uneasy.
uz: Men buni tushunmayapman va bu meni noqulay qiladi.

en: Then, too, Lucy , although she is so well, has lately taken to her old habit of walking in her sleep.
uz: Shunga qaramay, Lucy ham o'zining sog'lig'i yaxshi bo'lsa-da, so'nggi paytlarda uyqusida yurish odatini o'z ichiga olgan.

en: Her mother has spoken to me about it, and we have decided that I am to lock the door of our room every night.
uz: Uning onasi menga bu haqda gapirdi va biz har kuni kechqurun xonamizning eshigini qulflashimga qaror qildik.

en: Westenra has got an idea that sleep-walkers always go out on roofs of houses and along the edges of cliffs and then get suddenly wakened and fall over with a despairing cry that echoes all over the place.
uz: Vestenraga koʻra, uyquchilar uylarning tomlariga va toshlar boʻylab ketishadi, keyin toʻsatdan uygʻonib, har joyda eshitilgan umidsiz qichqiriq bilan qulab ketishadi.

en: Poor dear, she is naturally anxious about Lucy, and she tells me that her husband, Lucy's father, had the same habit, that he would get up in the night and dress himself and go out, if he were not stopped.
uz: Darhaqiqat, kambag'al, u Luzi uchun tabiiy ravishda tashvishlanadi va u menga uning eri Luziyning otasi ham xuddi shunday odatga ega ekanligini aytadi: agar uni to'xtatmasangiz, u kechasi turib, kiyimlarini kiyib, tashqariga chiqardi.

en: Lucy is to be married in the autumn, and she is already planning out her dresses and how her house is to be arranged.
uz: Lucy kuzda turmushga chiqishi kerak va u allaqachon kiyim-bosh va uyini qanday jihozlashni rejalashtirmoqda.

en: I sympathise with her, for I do the same, only Jonathan and I will start in life in a very simple way, and shall have to try to make both ends meet.
uz: Men unga hamdardman, chunki men ham shunday qilaman, faqat Jonatan va men hayotdan juda sodda tarzda boshlanamiz va har ikki nuqtani birlashtirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: Holmwood, he is the Hon.
uz: Holmwood, bu Xonim.

en: Arthur Holmwood, only son of Lord Go- dalming, is coming up here very shortly, as soon as he can leave town, for his father is not very well, and I think dear Lucy is counting the moments till he comes.
uz: Lord Go-dalmingning yagona o'g'li Artur Holmwood shaharni tark etishi mumkin bo'lganda, yaqin orada bu yerga keladi, chunki otasi juda yaxshi emas va men o'ylaymanki, aziz Lusi u kelguncha vaqtni sanab yuribdi.

en: She wants to take him up in the seat on the churchyard cliff and show him the beauty of Whitby.
uz: U uni cherkov hovlisidagi toshbo'g'ida o'tirgan joyga olib borib, unga Uitbining go'zalligini ko'rsatishni xohlaydi.

en: I daresay it is the waiting which disturbs her.
uz: O'zim aytamanki, uni xavotirga solgan narsa kutib turishdir.

en: She will be all right when he arrives.
uz: U kelganida u yaxshi bo'ladi.

en: 27 July.—No news from Jonathan.
uz: 27 iyul.Jonatanning hech qanday xabari yo'q.

en: I am getting quite uneasy about him, though why I should I do not know, but I do wish that he would write, if it were only a single line.
uz: Men u haqida juda xavotirlanyapman, ammo nima uchun buni qilishim kerakligini bilmayman, lekin agar u faqat bitta satr bo'lsa, yozishini xohlayman.

en: Lucy walks more than ever, and each night I am awakened by her mov- ing about the room.
uz: Lucy har qachongidan ko'proq yuradi va har kecha men uning xonadon atrofidagi harakatlari bilan uyg'onaman.

en: Fortunately, the weather is so hot that she cannot get cold.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, havo shunchalik issiq bo'lib, u sovuq bo'lib qololmaydi.

en: But still, the anxiety and the perpetually being awakened is beginning to tell on me, and I am getting nervous and wakeful myself.
uz: Ammo shunga qaramay, tashvish va doimo uyg'onib turish menga ko'rinishni boshlaydi va o'zim ham xavotirga tushyapman va uyg'onib ketyapman.

en: Thank God, Lucy's health keeps up.
uz: Xudoga shukr, Lusiyaning sog'ligi saqlanib qoldi.

en: Holmwood has been suddenly called to Ring to see his father, who has been taken seriously ill.
uz: Holmwoodning otasi og'ir kasal bo'lib qolganini ko'rish uchun to'satdan Ringga chaqirildi.

en: Lucy frets at the postpone-
uz: Lucy postpone-da ro'za tutadi.

en: ment of seeing him, but it does not touch her looks.
uz: Uni ko'rishni istadi, lekin bu uning tashqi ko'rinishiga ta'sir qilmaydi.

en: She is a triﬂe stouter, and her cheeks are a lovely rose-pink.
uz: U biroz ko'p bo'lgan va uning yig'inlari go'zal gullab-qizil rangda.

en: She has lost the anemic look which she had.
uz: U o'zidan oldingi anemik ko'rinishni yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: I pray it will all last.
uz: Men ibodat qilamanki, bularning barchasi davom etadi.

en: 3 August.—Another week gone by, and no news from Jonathan, not even to Mr.
uz: 3 avgust.Boshqa bir hafta o'tdi va Jonatanning, hatto Mr.ga ham hech qanday xabar yo'q edi.

en: Hawkins, from whom I have heard.
uz: Hawkins, men uning xabarini eshitganman.

en: Oh, I do hope he is not ill.
uz: Oh, umid qilamanki, u kasal emas.

en: He surely would have written.
uz: Shubhasiz, u yozgan bo'lardi.

en: I look at that last letter of his, but somehow it does not satisfy me.
uz: Uning so'nggi maktubini ko'rib chiqdim, lekin u meni qoniqtirmayapti.

en: It does not read like him, and yet it is his writing.
uz: Bu uning o'qishi kabi o'qilmaydi, ammo bu uning yozishi.

en: There is no mistake of that.
uz: Bunda hech qanday xato yo'q.

en: Lucy has not walked much in her sleep the last week, but there is an odd concentration about her which I do not understand, even in her sleep she seems to be watching me.
uz: Lusi so'nggi haftada uxlab ko'p yurmagan, ammo uning atrofida g'alati bir konsentratsiya bor, men buni tushunmayapman, hatto uxlab qolganda ham u menga qarab turadi.

en: She tries the door, and ﬁnding it locked, goes about the room searching for the key.
uz: U eshikni sinab ko'rdi va eshikni qulflab qo'yganini ko'rib, o'rinni o'rab, kalitni qidirdi.

en: 6 August.—Another three days, and no news.
uz: 6 avgust.Ba'zi uch kun va hech qanday yangilik yo'q.

en: This suspense is getting dreadful.
uz: Ushbu g'alati holat dahshatli bo'lib bormoqda.

en: If I only knew where to write to or where to go to, I should feel easier.
uz: Agar men qayerga yozishni yoki qayerga borishni bilsam, o'zimni osonroq his qilardim.

en: But no one has heard a word of Jonathan since that last letter.
uz: Ammo o'sha so'nggi maktubdan beri Jonatan haqida hech kim eshitmagan.

en: I must only pray to God for patience.
uz: Faqat sabr-toqat so'rashim kerak.

en: Lucy is more excitable than ever, but is otherwise well.
uz: Lucy har qachongidan ham hayajonli, ammo boshqa holatda ham sog'lom.

en: Last night was very threatening, and the ﬁshermen say that we are in for a storm.
uz: Kecha kechasi juda xavfli edi va baliqchilar shuni aytishdiki, biz shiddatli bo'ron kutyapmiz.

en: I must try to watch it and learn the weather signs.
uz: Men uni kuzatishga va havo belgilarini o'rganishga harakat qilishim kerak.

en: Today is a gray day, and the sun as I write is hidden in thick clouds, high over Kettleness.
uz: Bugun oq kun va quyosh, men yozayotganimda, qalin bulutlar ichida, Kettlenessning yuqorida yashirilgan.

en: Everything is gray except the green grass, which seems like emerald amongst it, gray earthy rock, gray clouds, tinged with the sun- burst at the far edge, hang over the gray sea, into which the sandpoints stretch like gray ﬁgures.
uz: Hamma narsa sariq rangda bo'ladi, faqat yashil o't, uning o'rtasida zamarad kabi ko'rinadi, sariq yerli tosh, sariq bulutlar, uzoq kenarda quyosh shovqin qilgan, sariq dengizning ustida o'tirgan sariq bulutlar, qirg'oqqa o'xshaydigan qum nuqtalari.

en: The sea is tumbling in over the shallows and the sandy ﬂats with a roar, mufﬂed in the sea-mists drifting inland.
uz: Dengiz o'tkir va qumli maydonlar ustida qirg'oqqa tushib, qirg'oqqa to'lib-toshgan dengiz g'ovurlari bilan qirg'oqqa tushib bormoqda.

en: The horizon is lost in a gray mist.
uz: Ko'rinish griy bulutda yo'qolgan.

en: All vastness, the clouds are piled up like giant rocks, and there is a `brool' over the sea that sounds like some passage of doom.
uz: Toʻliq kenglik, bulutlar ulkan toshlar kabi toʻplanib, dengiz ustida `brool' boʻlib oʻtadi, bu esa oʻlimning oʻtishi kabi tuyuladi.

en: Dark ﬁgures are on the beach here and there, sometimes half shrouded in the mist, and seem `men like trees walking'.
uz: Qorong'i suratlar plyajda bu yerda-bu yerda, ba'zan qorong'ilikda yarim ko'rinadi va ular o'tadigan daraxtlarga o'xshaydi.

en: The ﬁshing boats are racing for home, and rise and dip in the ground swell as they sweep into the harbour, bending to the scuppers.
uz: Baliqchi kemalari uy uchun musobaqa qilmoqdalar va ko'tarilish va ko'tarilish jarayonida ko'tarilgan yer yuzini ko'tarishadi, chunki ular portga kirib, ko'tarilishlarga qo'shilib ketishadi.

en: He is making straight for me, and I can see, by the way he lifts his hat, that he wants to talk.
uz: U menga to'g'ri yo'l tutmoqda va men uning to'pqini ko'targanidan gapirishni xohlayotganini ko'ryapman.

en: I have been quite touched by the change in the poor old man.
uz: Yomon keksa odamning o'zgarishi menga juda ta'sir qildi.

en: When he sat down beside me, he said in a very gentle way, I want to say something to you, miss. I could see he was not at ease, so I took his poor old wrinkled hand in mine and asked him to speak fully.
uz: U yonimda o'tirganida, u juda muloyim tarzda: Men sizga bir narsa aytmoqchiman, xonim. Men uning o'zini noqulay his qilayotganini ko'rardim, shuning uchun men uning kambag'al keksa tupurgan qo'lini o'zimning qo'limga oldim va undan to'liq gapirishini so'radim.

en: So he said, leaving his hand in mine, I'm afraid, my deary, that I must have shocked you by all the wicked things I've been sayin' about the dead, and such like, for weeks past, but I didn't mean them, and I want ye to re- member that when I'm gone.
uz: Shunda u qo'lini mening qo'limga qo'yib, shunday dedi: Qizim, men o'tgan haftalar davomida o'liklar haqida aytgan barcha yovuz so'zlarim va shunga o'xshash so'zlarim bilan sizni hayratda qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak, lekin men buni nazarda tutmaganman va men ketganimda buni yana aytishni xohlayman.

en: We aud folks that be dafﬂed, and with one foot abaft the krok-hooal, don't altogether like to think of it, and we don't want to feel scart of it, and that's why I've took to makin' light of it, so that I'd cheer up my own heart a bit.
uz: Biz o'zimiz ham o'zimiz ham bu haqda o'ylashni yoqtirmaymiz va o'zim ham o'z yuragimni biroz quvonchlantiradigan bo'lishim uchun, bu borada yengilroq bo'lishga qaror qildim.

en: But, Lord love ye, miss, I ain't afraid of dyin', not a bit, only I don't want to die if I can help it.
uz: Lekin, Rabbim seni sevadi, xonim, men o'lishdan qo'rqmayman, faqat o'lishni istamayman, agar buni qila olsam.

en: My time must be nigh at hand now, for I be aud, and a hundred years is too much for any man to ex- pect.
uz: Mening vaqtim hozir yaqin bo'lishi kerak, chunki men juda yoshman va yuz yil har bir inson uchun ko'p vaqtdir.

en: And I'm so nigh it that the Aud Man is already whettin' his scythe.
uz: Va men shu qadar yaqinmanki, Aud Man allaqachon o'z qilichini oqlay boshladi.

en: Ye see, I can't get out o' the habit of cafﬁn' about it all at once.
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, men bu haqda bir vaqtning o'zida o'ylash odatidan chiqib ketolmayman.

en: The chafts will wag as they be used to.
uz: O'simliklar o'zlariga mo'ljallanganidek silkitadi.

en: Some day soon the Angel of Death will sound his trumpet for me.
uz: Yaqinda bir kuni o'lim farishtasi men uchun karnayini chaqiradi.

en: But don't ye dooal an' greet, my deary!—for he saw that I was crying— if he should come this very night I'd not refuse to answer his call.
uz: Ammo siz salom bermang, azizim! chunki u men yig'layotganimni ko'rdi Agar u bugun kechqurun kelsa, men uning qo'ng'iroqidan voz kechmayman.

en: For life be, after all, only a waitin' for somethin' else than what we're doin', and death be all that we can rightly depend on.
uz: Axir, hayot biz qilayotgan ishdan boshqa narsani kutishdan boshqa narsa emas, o'lim esa biz haqli ravishda bog'lanishimiz mumkin bo'lgan yagona narsa.

en: But I'm content, for it's comin' to me, my deary, and comin' quick.
uz: Ammo men mamnunman, chunki bu menga yaqinlashib kelmoqda, azizim, va tezda keladi.

en: It may be comin' while we be lookin' and wonderin'.
uz: Ehtimol, biz o'zimizni ko'rib, hayratda bo'lganimizda, u keladi.

en: Maybe it's in that wind out over the sea that's bringin' with it loss and wreck, and sore distress, and sad hearts.
uz: Ehtimol, dengizning ustida bo'lgan shamol o'z bilan birga yo'qotish va vayron bo'lish, og'ir qayg'u va qayg'uli yuraklarni olib keladi.

en: Look! he cried suddenly.
uz: Qaranglar! - dedi u to'satdan.

en: There's something in that wind and in the hoast beyont that sounds, and looks, and tastes, and smells like death.
uz: Bu shamol va toast beyontda ovoz, ko'rinish, taom va o'limga o'xshaydigan bir narsa bor.

en: Lord, make me answer cheerful, when my call comes! He held up his arms devoutly, and raised his hat.
uz: Rabbim, chaqirig'im kelganda meni quvonch bilan javob bergin! - dedi u qo'llarini sadoqat ila ko'tarib, to'pini ko'tardi.

en: His mouth moved as though he were praying.
uz: Uning og'zi xuddi ibodat qilayotganidek harakatlanardi.

en: After a few minutes' silence, he got up, shook hands with me, and blessed me, and said good-bye, and hobbled off.
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng u turib, menga qo'l urdi va menga duo qildi, salom berdi va ketib ketdi.

en: It all touched me, and up- set me very much.
uz: Bularning barchasi menga ta'sir qildi va meni juda hayajonlantirdi.

en: I was glad when the coastguard came along, with his spyglass under his arm.
uz: Men quvonchga toʻldim, chunki sahro xodimi qoʻli ostida oʻz shloglasi bilan keldi.

en: He stopped to talk with me, as he always does, but all the time kept looking at a strange ship.
uz: U har doimgidek men bilan suhbatlashishni to'xtatdi, lekin har doim g'alati kemaga qarab turardi.

en: I can't make her out, he said.
uz: U: Men uni ko'rishni istamayman.

en: She's a Russian, by the look of her.
uz: O'zining ko'rinishiga ko'ra, u rus.

en: But she's knocking about in the queerest way.
uz: Ammo u juda g'ayritabiiy tarzda qichqiriq qilmoqda.

en: She doesn't know her mind a bit.
uz: U o'z fikrini biroz ham bilmaydi.

en: She seems to see the storm coming, but can't decide whether to run up north in the open, or to put in here.
uz: U bo'ronning kelishini ko'radi, ammo u ochiq joyda shimoliga chopish yoki bu yerga kirishni hal qila olmaydi.

en: She is steered mighty strangely, for she doesn't mind the hand on the wheel, changes about with every puff of wind.
uz: U juda g'alati tarzda yo'naltiriladi, chunki u velosipeddagi qo'lning o'rniga o'zgarmaydi, har bir shamol puflashi bilan o'zgarib boradi.

en: We'll hear more of her before this time tomorrow.
uz: Ertaga shu vaqtdan oldin u haqida ko'proq eshitamiz.

en: CHAPTER 7 CUTTING FROM THE DAILYGRAPH, 8 AUGUST (PASTED IN MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL) From a correspondent.
uz: 7 bob DAILYGRAPH dan kesilgan, 8 avgust (MINA MURRAY'S JOURNALda o'qilgan) Muhbirdan.

en: One of the greatest and suddenest storms on record has just been experi- enced here, with results both strange and unique.
uz: Bu yerda allaqachon ro'yxatdan o'tgan eng katta va eng to'satdan bo'lgan bo'ronlardan biri sodir bo'ldi, uning natijasi ham g'alati, ham noyob bo'ldi.

en: The weather had been somewhat sultry, but not to any degree uncommon in the month of August.
uz: Havo biroz sovuq bo'lgan, ammo avgust oyida hech qanday darajada noyob emas edi.

en: Saturday evening was as ﬁne as was ever known, and the great body of hol- iday-makers laid out yesterday for visits to Mulgrave Woods, Robin Hood's Bay, Rig Mill, Runswick, Staithes, and the various trips in the neighbor- hood of Whitby.
uz: Shanba kuni kechasi hech qachon o'z vaqtida bo'lmagan darajada yaxshi o'tdi va katta guruh o'yinchilar kecha Mulgrave Woods, Robin Hood's Bay, Rig Mill, Runswick, Staithes va Whitbyning qo'shni hududidagi turli sayohatlarga tashrif buyurishdi.

en: The steamers Emma and Scarborough made trips up and down the coast, and there was an unusual amount of `tripping' both to and from Whitby.
uz: Emma va Scarborough buxar kemalari qirg'oqqa ko'tarilgan va ko'tarilgan sayohatlarni amalga oshirdilar va Whitbyga va undan ham o'zgacha bo'lgan sayohatlar sodir bo'ldi.

en: The day was unusually ﬁne till the afternoon, when some of the gossips who frequent the East Cliff churchyard, and from the command- ing eminence watch the wide sweep of sea visible to the north and east, called attention to a sudden show of `mares tails' high in the sky to the northwest.
uz: Kun kechgacha odatdagidan yaxshi o'tdi, chunki East Cliff ma'badxonasiga tez-tez tashrif buyuradigan va qo'mondonlik bilan shimol va sharqdan ko'rinadigan keng dengiz ko'rinishini kuzatib turadigan ba'zi g'iybatchilar, shimoliy-g'arbiy tarafdan ko'rinadigan havo havoda `mares quyruqlarining to'satdan ko'rinishiga e'tibor qaratishdi.

en: The wind was then blowing from the southwest in the mild de- gree which in barometrical language is ranked `No.
uz: Shundan so'ng shamol janubi-g'arbiy tomonidan yengil de-gri bilan shamol so'rab turardi, bu barometrik tilda `No. deb nomlanadi.

en: 2, light breeze.' The coastguard on duty at once made report, and one old ﬁsherman, who for more than half a century has kept watch on weather signs from the East Cliff, foretold in an emphatic manner the coming of a sudden storm.
uz: Dasturdagi qirg'oqchilar darhol xabar berishdi va bir qariya baliqchi, u yarim asrdan ortiq vaqt davomida Sharqiy qirg'oqning havo belgilarini kuzatib kelgan, to'satdan bo'ron kelishini ta'kidlab o'tdi.

en: The approach of sunset was so very beautiful, so grand in its masses of splen- didly coloured clouds, that there was quite an assemblage on the walk along the cliff in the old churchyard to enjoy the beauty.
uz: Quyosh botishning yaqinlashishi shunchalik chiroyli edi, ko'p rangli bulutlar bilan shunchalik ajoyib ediki, qadimgi qabristondagi toshbo'ron bo'ylab yurish uchun chiroyli ko'rinishga ega bo'lganlar ko'p edi.

en: Before the sun dipped below the black mass of Kettleness, standing boldly athwart the western sky, its downward was was marked by myriad clouds of every sunset
uz: Quyosh Kettlenessning qora massasi pastga tushib, g'arbiy osmonni jasorat bilan bosib o'tishdan oldin, uning pastga tushib ketishi har bir quyosh botishining ko'plab bulutlari bilan belgilab qo'yilgan.

en: colour, ﬂame, purple, pink, green, violet, and all the tints of gold, with here and there masses not large, but of seemingly absolute blackness, in all sorts of shapes, as well outlined as colossal silhouettes.
uz: Rang, olov, bo'yoq, roz, yashil, violet va barcha oltin ranglar, shu va shu yerda katta emas, balki mutlaqo mutlaq qoralikdagi massasi bor, har xil shakllarda, shuningdek, ulkan silhuetlar sifatida tasvirlangan.

en: The experience was not lost on the painters, and doubtless some of the sketches of the `Prelude to the Great Storm' will grace the R.
uz: San'atkorlar tajribadan mahrum bo'lmadilar va shubhasiz, Buyuk Shamolning Prelude to the Great Storm skizlarining ba'zilari R.

en: More than one captain made up his mind then and there that his `cobble' or his `mule', as they term the different classes of boats, would remain in the harbour till the storm had passed.
uz: Birdan ortiq kapitan o'shanda `cobble' yoki `mule' deb nomlangan turli qayiq sinflari bo'lmaguncha portda qolishga qaror qildi.

en: The wind fell away entirely during the evening, and at midnight there was a dead calm, a sultry heat, and that pre- vailing intensity which, on the approach of thunder, affects persons of a sensitive nature.
uz: Shamol kechqurun butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketdi va yarim kechada o'lim xotirjamligi, qaynoq issiqlik va toshqin yaqinlashganda sezgir tabiatdagi odamlarga ta'sir qiladigan o'simlikdan oldingi kuch-qudrat paydo bo'ldi.

en: There were but few lights in sight at sea, for even the coasting steamers, which usually hug the shore so closely, kept well to seaward, and but few ﬁshing boats were in sight.
uz: Dengizda ko'rinadigan chiroqlar kam edi, chunki deyarli qirg'oqqa shunchalik yaqin bo'lgan qirg'oqchilar ham dengizga yaqinlashdilar va ko'rinadigan baliqchi kemalari kam edi.

en: The only sail noticeable was a foreign schooner with all sails set, which was seemingly going westwards.
uz: Faqatgina ko'rinadigan yelkasi barcha yelkalar o'rnatilgan chet ellik schooner edi, u g'arbga borayotgan edi.

en: The foolhardiness or ignorance of her ofﬁcers was a proliﬁc theme for comment whilst she re- mained in sight, and efforts were made to signal her to reduce sail in the face of her danger.
uz: Uning ofitserlarining ahmoqligi yoki jaholatligi u ko'rinishda yana ko'rinishda bo'lganida, sharh berish uchun ko'p mavzu bo'lgan va u xavf ostida bo'lganida yelkalarni kamaytirish uchun unga signal berish uchun harakatlar qilindi.

en: Before the night shut down she was seen with sails idly ﬂapping as she gently rolled on the undulating swell of the sea.
uz: Kechasi to'xtashdan oldin u dengizning to'lqinli to'lqinlarida yengillik bilan o'tib ketayotganida, yelkalar bepul o'tkazib ketayotganini ko'rishdi.

en: As idle as a painted ship upon a painted ocean. Shortly before ten o'clock the stillness of the air grew quite oppressive, and the silence was so marked that the bleating of a sheep inland or the barking of a dog in the town was distinctly heard, and the band on the pier, with its lively French air, was like a dischord in the great harmony of na- ture's silence.
uz: Bo'yilgan dengiz ustida bo'yilgan kema singari bepullik. Soat o'n soatdan oldin havo xotirjamligi juda og'irlashdi, va xotirjamlik shunchalik ko'p bo'lganki, dengizda qo'ylarning o'qishini yoki shaharda itning qichqirishini aniq eshitish mumkin edi.

en: A little after midnight came a strange sound from over the sea, and high overhead the air began to carry a strange, faint, hollow booming.
uz: Tushdan biroz o'tgach, dengizning ustida g'alati tovush keldi va havo yuqoriga chiqib, g'alati, yorqin, tuxumli bir ovoz bilan ko'tarilishni boshladi.

en: Then without warning the tempest broke.
uz: So'ngra ogohlantirishsiz bo'ron boshlangan.

en: With a rapidity which, at the time, seemed incredible, and even afterwards is impossible to realize, the whole aspect of nature at once became convulsed.
uz: O'shanda bu g'ayritabiiy tuyulgan va hatto keyinchalik ham amalga oshira olmaydigan tezlikda tabiatning butun jihatlari birdan sarosimaga tushdi.

en: The waves rose in grow- ing fury, each overtopping its fellow, till in a very few minutes the lately glassy sea was like a roaring and devouring monster.
uz: To'lqinlar g'azabga to'lib-toshdi, har biri o'z birodarini o'rab oldi, hatto bir necha daqiqadan so'ng shishali dengiz bir qichqiriq va yirtqich qudratga o'xshaydi.

en: Whitecrested waves beat madly on the level sands and rushed up the shelving cliffs.
uz: To'lqinlar to'y qumlar ustida aqldan ozgan holda urib, shelfning toshbo'yiga ko'tarildi.

en: Others broke over the piers, and with their spume swept the lanthorns of the light- houses which rise from the end of either pier of Whitby Harbour.
uz: Boshqalar pivolarni buzdi va o'zlarining ko'piklari bilan Whitby Harborning har bir pivolarining so'ngidan ko'tarilgan yorug'lik uylarining chiroqlarini ko'tardi.

en: The wind roared like thunder, and blew with such force that it was with difﬁculty that even strong men kept their feet, or clung with grim clasp to
uz: Shamol momaqaldiroq bo'lib, shunchalik kuchli bo'lganki, hatto kuchli kishilar ham oyoqlarini to'xtatish qiyin edi.

en: the iron stanchions.
uz: temir stanchions.

en: It was found necessary to clear the entire pier from the mass of onlookers, or else the fatalities of the night would have increased manifold.
uz: To'liq qirg'ozni ko'z o'ngidan ko'rish kerak bo'lgan, aks holda kechasi o'lganlarning soni ko'payib borardi.

en: To add to the difﬁculties and dangers of the time, masses of sea- fog came drifting inland.
uz: O'sha davrdagi qiyinchiliklar va xavf-xatarlarni qo'shimcha qilib aytganda, dengizdagi bulutlarning ko'pligi qirg'oqqa suzib borardi.

en: White, wet clouds, which swept by in ghostly fashion, so dank and damp and cold that it needed but little effort of imagi- nation to think that the spirits of those lost at sea were touching their living brethren with the clammy hands of death, and many a one shuddered at the wreaths of sea-mist swept by.
uz: Oq, boshoq bulutlar, ular hayajonli tarzda, shunchalik nam va nam va sovuq bo'lganki, dengizda yo'qolganlarning ruhi tirik birodarlariga o'lim qo'llari bilan tegganini o'ylash uchun o'ziga yarasha harakat qilish kerak edi.

en: At times the mist cleared, and the sea for some distance could be seen in the glare of the lightning, which came thick and fast, followed by such peals of thunder that the whole sky overhead seemed trembling under the shock of the footsteps of the storm.
uz: Ba'zan bulut o'tib ketadi va dengizning biroz uzoqlikda yashirinligi chaqmoqning shovqinida ko'rinadi, shundan so'ng esa momaqaldiroqning o'tishi shunday kuchli bo'lganki, to'satdan to'satdan osmon bo'ylab bo'lgan bo'ronning izlaridan titrab turardi.

en: Some of the scenes thus revealed were of immeasurable grandeur and of absorbing interest.
uz: Shunday qilib ko'rsatilgan ba'zi sahnalar o'lchab bo'lmaydigan ulkanlik va qiziqish uyg'otadi.

en: The sea, running mountains high, threw skywards with each wave mighty masses of white foam, which the tempest seemed to snatch at and whirl away into space.
uz: Dengiz baland tog'lar bilan osmonga o'tadi va har bir to'lqin bilan oq cho'g'ning kuchli ko'pchilikini osmonga tashlaydi.

en: Here and there a ﬁshing boat, with a rag of sail, running madly for shelter before the blast, now and again the white wings of a storm-tossed seabird.
uz: Bu erda va u erda baliqchi kemasi, yelkalar to'plami bilan, portlashdan oldin shubha bilan panoh izlaydi, vaqti-vaqti bilan buzg'unchilikdan tashlangan dengiz quchasining oq qanotlari.

en: On the summit of the East Cliff the new searchlight was ready for experiment, but had not yet been tried.
uz: Sharqiy qirg'oqning tepalig'ida yangi qidiruv chiroqlari tajriba uchun tayyor edi, ammo hali sinovdan o'tkazilmagan.

en: The ofﬁcers in charge of it got it into working order, and in the pauses of on- rushing mist swept with it the surface of the sea.
uz: Uning ustidan nazorat qiluvchi ofitserlar uni ishga tushirdilar va shoshilinch tumanlar arafasida dengiz yuzini o'rab oldilar.

en: Once or twice its service was most effective, as when a ﬁshing boat, with gunwale under water, rushed into the harbour, able, by the guidance of the sheltering light, to avoid the danger of dashing against the piers.
uz: Bir-ikki marta uning xizmati eng samarali bo'lgan, chunki suv ostida qo'zg'atilgan baliqchi kemasi portga shoshilsa, u qorong'ulik nurining yo'l-yo'rig'i bilan portlarga urish xavfini oldini oladi.

en: As each boat achieved the safety of the port there was a shout of joy from the mass of people on the shore, a shout which for a moment seemed to cleave the gale and was then swept away in its rush.
uz: Har bir qayiq port xavfsizligiga erishganida, qirg'oqdagi ko'pchilikning shodlik ovozi eshitildi, bu ovoz bir daqiqa davomida shamolni bo'g'ib qo'ygani kabi ko'rindi, so'ng esa u shoshilinch ravishda o'tib ketdi.

en: Before long the searchlight discovered some distance away a schooner with all sails set, apparently the same vessel which had been noticed earlier in the evening.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, qidiruv chiroqlari biroz uzoqlikda barcha yelkalar o'rnatilgan, ko'rinishicha, kechqurun ko'rgan kemaga o'xshaydigan bir ko'pikni topdi.

en: The wind had by this time backed to the east, and there was a shudder amongst the watchers on the cliff as they realized the terrible dan- ger in which she now was.
uz: Bu vaqtgacha shamol sharqqa qarab ketardi va qirg'oqda turgan kuzatuvchilar u qanday dahshatli raqsga tushganini anglab, titrashdi.

en: Between her and the port lay the great ﬂat reef on which so many good ships have from time to time suffered, and, with the wind blowing from its present quarter, it would be quite impossible that she should fetch the en- trance of the harbour.
uz: U bilan port o'rtasida ko'pgina yaxshi kemalar vaqti-vaqti bilan azob chekkan katta tekis shov-shuv joylashgan va hozirgi hududdan shamol o'tib ketayotganligi sababli, u portga kirish imkoniga ega bo'lmasligi mumkin emas.

en: It was now nearly the hour of high tide, but the waves were so great that in their troughs the shallows of the shore were almost visible, and the schooner, with all sails set, was rushing with such speed that, in the words of one old salt, she must fetch up somewhere, if it was only in hell.
uz: Endi deyarli bosqin vaqti keldi, ammo to'lqinlar shunchalik kuchli ediki, o'z qo'llarida qirg'oqning sirtli joylari deyarli ko'rinardi va barcha yelkalar o'rnatilgan cho'tka shunchalik tez harakatlanayotgan ediki, bir qadimgi tuzning so'zlariga ko'ra, o'zi faqat jahannamda bo'lsa, bir joyga olib borishi kerak.

en: Then came another rush of sea-fog, greater than any hitherto, a mass of dank mist, which seemed to close on all things like a gray pall, and left available to men only the organ of hearing, for the roar of the tempest, and the crash of the thunder, and the booming of the mighty billows came through the damp oblivion even louder than before.
uz: So'ngra yana bir dengiz g'ushuvi paydo bo'ldi, bu o'z vaqtida bo'lganidan ham ko'ra ko'proq bo'ldi, bug'lik g'ushuning to'plamidir, u hamma narsani griz palla kabi yopib qo'yganiga o'xshaydi va odamlarga faqatgina eshitish organini qo'yib beradi, shunda shamolning shov-shuvlari va chaqmoqning shov-shuvlari va kuchli to'lqinlarning shov-shuvlari bug'lik yoddan chiqarilganidan ko'ra ko'proq ovoz bilan o'tadi.

en: The rays of the searchlight were kept ﬁxed on the harbour mouth across the East Pier, where the shock was expected, and men waited breathless.
uz: Qidiruv yorug'ligi nurlari Sharq qirg'og'idan o'tgan port og'izida to'g'ri saqlanib, shok kutilgan edi va erkaklar nafassiz kutishardi.

en: The wind suddenly shifted to the northeast, and the remnant of the sea fog melted in the blast.
uz: Shamol toʻsatdan shimoli-sharqqa oʻtib ketdi va dengiz gʻolamining qolgan qismi portlaganda erib ketdi.

en: And then, mirabile dictu, between the piers, leaping from wave to wave as it rushed at headlong speed, swept the strange schooner before the blast, with all sail set, and gained the safety of the har- bour.
uz: Va keyin, mirabile dictu, quyonlar o'rtasida, to'lqinlardan to'lqinlarga o'tadi, chunki u juda tez harakatlanardi, portlashdan oldin, barcha yelkalar o'rnatilgan holda, g'alati schoonerni olib tashladi va portning xavfsizligini qo'lga kiritdi.

en: The searchlight followed her, and a shudder ran through all who saw her, for lashed to the helm was a corpse, with drooping head, which swung horribly to and fro at each motion of the ship.
uz: Qidiruv chiroqlari uning orqasidan ergashib ketishdi va uni ko'rganlarning hammasi titrishga duchor bo'ldilar, chunki qo'lga qo'yilgan bo'lsa, boshlari qulab ketgan va kemaning har bir harakatida orqaga va orqaga dahshatli ravishda o'zgarib ketgan jasad bor edi.

en: No other form could be seen on the deck at all.
uz: Dekkda boshqa hech qanday shakl ko'rinmadi.

en: A great awe came on all as they realised that the ship, as if by a miracle, had found the harbour, unsteered save by the hand of a dead man!
