uz: Hamma g'oyat dahshatga tushdi, chunki ular kemaning mo'ʼjizaviy tarzda portni topganini va oʻlik odamning qoʻli bilan oʻz yoʻlini oʻtkazmaganini tushundik!

en: However, all took place more quickly than it takes to write these words.
uz: Biroq, bularning barchasi bu so'zlarni yozish uchun kerak bo'lganidan tezroq sodir bo'ldi.

en: The schooner paused not, but rushing across the harbour, pitched herself on that accumu- lation of sand and gravel washed by many tides and many storms into the southeast corner of the pier jutting under the East Cliff, known locally as Tate Hill Pier.
uz: Ko'p to'lqinlar va ko'p bo'ronlar tomonidan ko'tarilgan qum va qirg'oq to'plamiga o'zini tashlab, Sharqiy qirg'oq ostida joylashgan, mahalliy Tate Hill Pier deb nomlangan qirg'oqning janubi-sharqiy burchasiga tushdi.

en: There was of course a considerable concussion as the vessel drove up on the sand heap.
uz: Albatta, kema qum to'plamini bosib o'tganda, uning miya sarosimi sezilarli darajada ko'paydi.

en: Every spar, rope, and stay was strained, and some of the `top-hammer' came crashing down.
uz: Har bir spar, ip va qolish kuchsiz edi va `top-hammer'ning ba'zilari qulab tushdi.

en: But, strangest of all, the very instant the shore was touched, an immense dog sprang up on deck from below, as if shot up by the concussion, and running forward, jumped from the bow on the sand.
uz: Ammo eng g'alati shundaki, qirg'oqqa qo'ng'iroq qilgandan so'ng, katta it pastdan, xuddi shovqin tufayli o'ldirilgan bo'lsa-da, qayiqdan pastga ko'tarildi.

en: Making straight for the steep cliff, where the churchyard hangs over the laneway to the East Pier so steeply that some of the ﬂat tombstones, thruff- steans or through-stones, as they call them in Whitby vernacular, actually project over where the sustaining cliff has fallen away, it disappeared in the darkness, which seemed intensiﬁed just beyond the focus of the searchlight.
uz: O'tkir qirg'og'iga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'l tutgan cho'qqiz, u yerda chiroyli qabrlar yo'nalishida chiroyli bo'lgan cho'qqiz cho'qqiz so'ngida, ba'zi to'g'ri qabr toshlari, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri toshlar yoki to'g'ri toshlar, ular ularni Whitby xalqida nima deb ataydilar, aslida qo'llab-quvvatlovchi qirg'og'i yo'qolgan joyga ko'tariladi, u qorong'ilikda yo'qoldi, u qidiruv yorug'ining diqqat markazidan biroz tashqarida kuchayib borganidek ko'rindi.

en: It so happened that there was no one at the moment on Tate Hill Pier, as all those whose houses are in close proximity were either in bed or were out on the heights above.
uz: O'shanda Tate Hill Pier-da hech kim yo'q edi, chunki uylari yaqin atrofda bo'lganlarning hammasi yotoqda yoki yuqoridagi balandliklarda edi.

en: Thus the coastguard on duty on the eastern side of the harbour, who at once ran down to the little pier, was the ﬁrst to climb aboard.
uz: Shunday qilib, portning sharqiy tomonida xizmatda bo'lgan qirg'oqchilar birinchi bo'lib portga chiqishgan.

en: The men working the searchlight, after scouring the entrance of the harbour without seeing anything, then turned the light on the derelict and kept it there.
uz: Qidiruv chiroqida ishlaydigan erkaklar hech narsa ko'rmasdan, portga kirish yo'lini tarqatib, chiroqni yoqib, uni o'sha yerda saqlab qolishdi.

en: The coastguard ran aft, and when he came beside the wheel, bent over to examine it, and recoiled at once as though under some sudden emotion.
uz: Sahl xodimi orqaga yugurdi va velosipedning yonida bo'lganida, uni tekshirish uchun egrilib, xuddi to'satdan tuyg'u ostida bo'lganidek, darhol orqaga qaytdi.

en: This seemed to pique general curiosity, and quite a number of peo- ple began to run.
uz: Bu umumiy qiziqish uyg'otganga o'xshaydi va ko'pchilik yig'ilishni boshlaydi.

en: It is a good way round from the West Cliff by the Drawbridge to Tate Hill Pier, but your correspondent is a fairly good runner, and came well ahead of the crowd.
uz: G'arbiy qirg'oydan Drawbridge orqali Tate Hill Piergacha bu erda yaxshi yo'l bor, ammo sizning muxbiringiz juda yaxshi yuguradi va ko'pchilikdan ancha oldinga chiqdi.

en: When I arrived, however, I found already assembled on the pier a crowd, whom the coastguard and police refused to allow to come on board.
uz: Biroq, u yerga yetib kelganimda, ko'pchilikni ko'rdim, lekin qirg'oqchilar va politsiya ularga kemaga kirishga ruxsat bermadi.

en: By the courtesy of the chief boatman, I was, as your correspondent, permitted to climb on deck, and was one of a small group who saw the dead seaman whilst actually lashed to the wheel.
uz: Bosh kemachi mehribonligi tufayli men sizning muxbiringiz sifatida qadoqqa chiqib ketishga ruxsat oldim va o'lgan kemachi haydovchini, aslida, haydovchining haydovchisiga bog'langan holda ko'rgan kichik guruhdan biri edim.

en: It was no wonder that the coastguard was surprised, or even awed, for not often can such a sight have been seen.
uz: Qirg'oqchilar hayratda qolishlariga va hatto qo'rqib qolishlariga hech qanday ajablanarli narsa yo'q, chunki bunday ko'rinish ko'pincha ko'rinmaydi.

en: The man was simply fastened by his hands, tied one over the other, to a spoke of the wheel.
uz: Bu kishi shunchaki qo'llari bilan bog'langan, bir-biriga bog'langan bo'lib, haydovchining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'rilab qo'yilgan edi.

en: Between the inner hand and the wood was a cruciﬁx, the set of beads on which it was fastened being around both wrists and wheel, and all kept fast by the binding cords.
uz: Ichki qo'l va yog'och o'rtasida xoch bor edi, u o'rnatilgan marvaridlar to'plami ham qo'lqoplar, ham g'ildirak atrofida bo'lib, barchasini bog'lovchi iplar qattiq ushlab turardi.

en: The poor fellow may have been seated at one time, but the ﬂapping and buf- feting of the sails had worked through the rudder of the wheel and had dragged him to and fro, so that the cords with which he was tied had cut the ﬂesh to the bone.
uz: Yomon yigit bir vaqtlar o'tirgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin yelkalarning toshqinligi va buf-buf qilishlari velosipedning timiri orqali harakatlanib, uni bu yerga-bu yerga olib borgan, shuning uchun uni bog'lagan iplar go'shtini suyakgacha kesib tashlagan.

en: Accurate note was made of the state of things, and a doctor, Surgeon J.
uz: Bu holat haqida aniq ma'lumot berildi va shifokor J.

en: Caffyn, of 33, East Elliot Place, who came immediately after me, de- clared, after making examination, that the man must have been dead for quite two days.
uz: Mening orqamdan darhol kelgan 33 yoshli East Elliot Placelik Kaffyn tekshiruvdan so'ng, o'sha odam ikki kun o'lganini aniqladi.

en: In his pocket was a bottle, carefully corked, empty save for a little roll of paper, which proved to be the addendum to the log.
uz: Uning qoshiqida bir shisha bor edi, u ehtiyotkorlik bilan qoplangan va qog'ozning kichkina rulosasi uchun bo'sh edi. Bu esa jurnalga qo'shimcha bo'lgan.

en: The coastguard said the man must have tied up his own hands, fastening the knots with his teeth.
uz: Qo'riqchilarning aytishicha, u o'z qo'llarini bog'lab, tishlari bilan bog'lagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The fact that a coastguard was the ﬁrst on board may save some complications later on, in the Admiralty Court, for coast- guards cannot claim the salvage which is the right of the ﬁrst civilian enter- ing on a derelict.
uz: Sayohatchi birinchi bo'lganligi keyinchalik, Admiralty sudi bo'yicha, ba'zi qiyinchiliklarni xalos etishi mumkin, chunki Sayohatchilar birinchi fuqarolar qoldirgan joyga kirish huquqi bo'lgan qutqaruvni talab qila olmaydilar.

en: Already, however, the legal tongues are wagging, and one
uz: Biroq, allaqachon qonuniy tillar shovqin qilmoqda va bir

en: young law student is loudly asserting that the rights of the owner are al- ready completely sacriﬁced, his property being held in contravention of the statues of mortmain, since the tiller, as emblemship, if not proof, of delegat- ed possession, is held in a dead hand.
uz: Yosh huquqshunosning so'zlariga ko'ra, mulkdorning huquqlari butunlay qurbon qilingan, uning mol-mulki mortmainning haykallariga zid ravishda saqlanib qolingan, chunki ekin egasi delegat egaligining belgisi bo'lsa-da, dalil bo'lsa-da, o'lik qo'lida saqlanib qolingan.

en: It is needless to say that the dead steersman has been reverently removed from the place where he held his honourable watch and ward till death, a steadfastness as noble as that of the young Casabianca, and placed in the mortuary to await inquest.
uz: Aytishning hojati yo'qki, o'lgan haydovchining o'limigacha o'z sharafli soqchiligini saqlagan joyidan hurmat ila olib tashlab, yosh Kasabiancanka kabi obro'li qat'iylik bilan o'limgacha o'tgani va so'rovni kutish uchun o'likxonaga joylashtirildi.

en: Already the sudden storm is passing, and its ﬁerceness is abating.
uz: Toʻsatdan boʻron oʻtib ketmoqda va uning dahshatliligi kamayib bormoqda.

en: Crowds are scattering backward, and the sky is beginning to redden over the York- shire wolds.
uz: Xaloyiq orqaga tarqalib ketmoqda va York-shayr o'rmonlari ustida osmon qizillashmoqda.

en: I shall send, in time for your next issue, further details of the derelict ship which found her way so miraculously into harbour in the storm.
uz: Keyingi nashringizga tayyorgarlik ko'rgach, to'fon ichida mo'ʼjizaviy tarzda portga kirib kelgan tashqarida qoldirilgan kema haqida batafsil ma'lumot beraman.

en: 9 August.—The sequel to the strange arrival of the derelict in the storm last night is almost more startling than the thing itself.
uz: 9 avgust.Kecha bo'ron ichida tashlab ketilganlarning g'ayrioddiy kelishining davomchisi o'sha narsa o'zidan ham ko'ra deyarli ko'proq dahshatli.

en: It turns out that the schooner is Russian from Varna, and is called the Demeter.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, bu shkuner Varnalik rus va Demeter deb nomlangan.

en: She is almost entirely in ballast of silver sand, with only a small amount of cargo, a num- ber of great wooden boxes ﬁlled with mould.
uz: U deyarli toʻliq kumli ballastda, faqat kichik miqdordagi yuk bilan, oʻgʻir yogʻoch qutilar bilan toʻlib-toshgan.

en: This cargo was consigned to a Whitby solicitor, Mr.
uz: Ushbu yuk Whitbyning advokatidan bir kishiga yuborilgan edi.

en: Billington, of 7, The Crescent, who this morning went aboard and took formal possession of the goods consigned to him.
uz: Billington, 7 yoshda bo'lgan, bu ertalab kemaga chiqib, unga yuborilgan tovarlarni rasmiy ravishda olg'a oldi.

en: The Russian consul, too, acting for the charter-party, took formal posses- sion of the ship, and paid all harbour dues, etc.
uz: Rossiya konsullari ham charter-partiyasi nomidan harakat qilib, kemaga rasmiy ravishda egalik qilishdi va barcha port to'lovlarini to'lashdi.

en: Nothing is talked about here today except the strange coincidence.
uz: Bugun bu yerda g'alati hodisalardan boshqa hech narsa haqida gap ketmaydi.

en: The ofﬁcials of the Board of Trade have been most exacting in seeing that every compliance has been made with existing regulations.
uz: Savdo kengashi rasmiylari mavjud qoidalarga rioya qilinishini ta'minlashda eng qat'iy chora ko'rishgan.

en: As the matter is to be a `nine days wonder', they are evidently determined that there shall be no cause of other complaint.
uz: Bu voqea to'qqiz kunlik hayratlanarli voqea bo'lishi kerak bo'lganligi sababli, ular boshqa shikoyat qilish uchun sabab yo'qligiga qat'iy ishonishadi.

en: A good deal of interest was abroad concerning the dog which landed when the ship struck, and more than a few of the members of the S.
uz: Kema cho'qqanda u yerga tushgan it va S-ning bir nechta a'zolari haqida chet elda katta qiziqish uyg'otildi.

en: P.C.A., which is very strong in Whitby, have tried to befriend the animal.
uz: Whitbyda kuchli bo'lgan P.C.A. hayvon bilan do'stlashishga harakat qildi.

en: To the general disappointment, however, it was not to be found.
uz: Biroq, bu butunlayin hayron qoldirgan narsa edi.

en: It seems to have disappeared entirely from the town.
uz: Bu shahardan butunlay yo'qolgan ko'rinadi.

en: It may be that it was frightened and made its way on to the moors, where it is still hiding in terror.
uz: Ehtimol, u qo'rqib, o'z yo'lini o'tkazib, hali ham qo'rquvda yashirinib yurgan mo'rlarga yetib borgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: There are some who look with dread on such a possibility, lest later on it should in itself become a danger, for it is evidently a ﬁerce brute.
uz: Ba'zilar bunday imkoniyatni qo'rquv bilan ko'rishadi, ehtimol keyinchalik u o'z-o'zidan xavfga aylanadi, chunki u, albatta, shafqatsiz vahshiy.

en: Early this morning a large dog, a half-bred mastiff belonging to a coal merchant close
uz: Erta tongda ko'mir savdosiga tegishli katta it, yarim zotli mastiff yaqinlashdi.

en: to Tate Hill Pier, was found dead in the roadway opposite its master's yard.
uz: Tate Hill Pier-ga yaqin, u o'z egasining hovlisining qarshisidagi yo'lda o'lik topildi.

en: It had been ﬁghting, and manifestly had had a savage opponent, for its throat was torn away, and its belly was slit open as if with a savage claw.
uz: U jang qilib yurgan edi va, aniqki, yovvoyi raqibga ega edi, chunki uning bo'yni yirtilgan edi va qorinini yovvoyi qulog'i bilan o'chirgandek ochib yuborgan edi.

en: Later.—By the kindness of the Board of Trade inspector, I have been per- mitted to look over the log book of the Demeter, which was in order up to within three days, but contained nothing of special interest except as to facts of missing men.
uz: Keyinroq.Shandislik kengashi inspektorining mehribonligi tufayli men Demeterning jurnalini ko'rib chiqishga ruxsat oldim, bu kitob uch kun ichida tuzatilgan edi, ammo ularda yo'qolgan kishilar haqidagi faktlardan boshqa hech qanday qiziqish yo'q edi.

en: The greatest interest, however, is with regard to the paper found in the bottle, which was today produced at the inquest.
uz: Biroq, eng katta qiziqish, bugun so'rovda ishlab chiqarilgan shisha ichida topilgan qog'oz bilan bog'liq.

en: And a more strange narrative than the two between them unfold it has not been my lot to come across.
uz: Va ularning o'rtasidagi ikkitadan ham g'alatiroq hikoya o'tkaziladi, bu mening taqdirim emas edi.

en: As there is no motive for concealment, I am permitted to use them, and accordingly send you a transcript, simply omitting technical details of sea- manship and supercargo.
uz: Yashirinlik uchun sabab yo'q bo'lgani uchun, ulardan foydalanishga va sizga transkripsiya yuborishga ruxsat beraman, shunchaki dengizda xizmat qiladigan odam va superkargolarning texnik tafsilotlarini qoldiraman.

en: It almost seems as though the captain had been seized with some kind of mania before he had got well into blue water, and that this had developed persistently throughout the voyage.
uz: Ko'rinishicha, kapitan ko'k suvga tushib qolishidan oldin bir xil mansiyaga chalingan va bu sayohat davomida doimiy rivojlangan.

en: Of course my statement must be taken cum grano, since I am writing from the dictation of a clerk of the Russian consul, who kindly translated for me, time being short.
uz: Albatta, mening so'zlarimni cum grano deb qabul qilish kerak, chunki men Rossiya konsulining ishchisi tomonidan yozganman, u menga vaqt qisqagina bo'lganida, menga mehribonlik ila tarjima qildi.

en: LOG OF THE DEMETER Varna to Whitby Written 18 July, things so strange happening, that I shall keep accurate note henceforth till we land.
uz: DEMETER LOGASI Varna to Whitby 18 iyul kuni yozilgan, shunchalik g'alati voqealar sodir bo'lmoqdaki, bundan buyon deyarli yerga tushgunimizcha aniq yozuvlarni saqlayman.

en: On 6 July we ﬁnished taking in cargo, silver sand and boxes of earth.
uz: 6 iyul kuni biz yuk, kum va tuproq qutilarni olib kelishni tugatdik.

en: Crew, ﬁve hands … two mates, cook, and myself, (captain).
uz: Ekipaj, besh qo'l... ikki do'st, oshpaz va o'zim, (kapitan) .

en: On 11 July at dawn entered Bosphorus.
uz: 11 iyul kuni tongda Bosphorusga kirdi.

en: Boarded by Turkish Customs of- ﬁcers.
uz: Turkiya bojxona xodimlari tomonidan bord qilingan.

en: On 12 July through Dardanelles.
uz: 12 iyul kuni Dardanellalardan o'tadi.

en: More Customs ofﬁcers and ﬂagboat of guarding squadron.
uz: Ko'proq bojxona xodimlari va qo'riqchi eskadroning bayrog'i.

en: Work of ofﬁcers thorough, but quick.
uz: Xizmatchilarning ishi puxta, lekin tez.

en: At dark passed into Archipelago.
uz: Qorong'ilikda arxipelag'ga o'tdi.

en: On 13 July passed Cape Matapan.
uz: 13 iyul kuni u Matapan burchasiga o'tdi.

en: Crew dissatisﬁed about something.
uz: Xodimlar bir narsadan mamnun emas edilar.

en: Seemed scared, but would not speak out.
uz: Qo'rqqan ko'rinardi, lekin gapirmasdi.

en: On 14 July was somewhat anxious about crew.
uz: 14 iyul kuni xonadonga nisbatan biroz tashvishlanardi.

en: Men all steady fellows, who sailed with me before.
uz: Barcha erkaklar men bilan ilgari sayohat qilgan barqaror yigitlardir.

en: Mate could not make out what was wrong.
uz: Mate nima noto'g'ri ekanini aniqlay olmagan.

en: They only told him there was SOME- THING, and crossed themselves.
uz: Ular unga faqat bir narsa borligini aytishdi va o'zlarini o'zlariga o'tkazdilar.

en: Mate lost temper with one of them that day and struck him.
uz: Mate o'sha kuni ulardan biriga g'azabga tushdi va uni urdi.

en: Expected ﬁerce quarrel, but all was quiet.
uz: O'yin-kulg'a bo'lishini kutganman, ammo hamma narsa tinch edi.

en: On 16 July mate reported in the morning that one of the crew, Petrofsky, was missing.
uz: 16 iyul kuni ertalab, yigit bemorlardan biri Petrofskiy yo'qolganini xabar qildi.

en: Could not account for it.
uz: Buni tushuntirib bo'lmadi.

en: Took larboard watch eight bells last night, was relieved by Amramoff, but did not go to bunk.
uz: Kecha sakkiz qo'ng'iroqni ko'rishni olib, Amramoff tomonidan yengillashtirildi, ammo u yotoqxonaga bormadi.

en: Men more down- cast than ever.
uz: Erkaklar har qachongidan ko'proq tushkunlikka tushdilar.

en: All said they expected something of the kind, but would not say more than there was SOMETHING aboard.
uz: Ularning barchasi shunday narsani kutishlarini aytishdi, lekin kemada biror narsa borligidan ko'ra ko'proq narsani aytishmaydi.

en: Mate getting very impatient with them.
uz: Mate ular bilan juda sabr-toqat qilmayapti.

en: Feared some trouble ahead.
uz: Oldinda muammolardan qo'rqardim.

en: On 17 July, yesterday, one of the men, Olgaren, came to my cabin, and in an awestruck way conﬁded to me that he thought there was a strange man aboard the ship.
uz: Kecha, 17 iyul kuni, erkaklardan Olgaren ismli kishi mening kabinamga keldi va qo'rqinchli tarzda menga g'alati odam bor deb o'ylaganini aytdi.

en: He said that in his watch he had been sheltering behind the deckhouse, as there was a rain storm, when he saw a tall, thin man, who was not like any of the crew, come up the companionway, and go along the deck forward and disappear.
uz: U o'z soatida yomg'ir bo'lganida, u qudratli va uzun bo'lgan bir odamni, u boshqa hech kimga o'xshamasini ko'rib, qo'shni yo'ldan chiqib, kema bo'ylab oldinga chiqib, yo'qolganini aytdi.

en: He followed cautiously, but when he got to bows found no one, and the hatchways were all closed.
uz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatib bordi, lekin qo'rg'onlarga yetgach, hech kimni topmadi va eshiklar yopildi.

en: He was in a panic of superstitious fear, and I am afraid the panic may spread.
uz: U sehrgarlik qo'rquvidan qo'rqib ketgan edi va men qo'rqamanki, qo'rquv tarqalishi mumkin.

en: To allay it, I shall today search the entire ship carefully from stem to stern.
uz: Buni yengish uchun men bugun butun kemani quti-qonchidan cho'qqisigacha sinchkovlik bilan tekshiraman.

en: Later in the day I got together the whole crew, and told them, as they evi- dently thought there was some one in the ship, we would search from stem to stern.
uz: Keyingi kuni men butun ekipajni to'plab, ularga aytdimki, ular kemada kimdir bor deb o'ylashganlari uchun, biz qudratdan qudratgacha qidirib topamiz.

en: First mate angry, said it was folly, and to yield to such foolish ideas would demoralise the men, said he would engage to keep them out of trou- ble with the handspike.
uz: Birinchi qo'shni g'azabga to'lib, bu aqlsizlik ekanligini va bunday ahmoqona g'oyalarga berilsa, erkaklarni ruhdan chiqarishini aytdi va qo'l cho'qqisi bilan ularni muammolardan saqlab qolish uchun harakat qilishini aytdi.

en: I let him take the helm, while the rest began a thor- ough search, all keeping abreast, with lanterns.
uz: Men unga to'lovni o'tkazishga ruxsat berdim, qolganlar esa yorug'lik bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri izlanish olib borishdi.

en: We left no corner un- searched.
uz: Biz hech qanday joyni qidirilmagan holda qoldirmadik.

en: As there were only the big wooden boxes, there were no odd cor- ners where a man could hide.
uz: Faqat katta yogʻoch qutilar boʻlgani uchun, odam yashira oladigan hech qanday oʻzgacha burchaklar yoʻq edi.

en: Men much relieved when search over, and went back to work cheerfully.
uz: Erkaklar qidiruvdan ko'p xalos bo'lib, quvonch bilan ishga qaytishdi.

en: First mate scowled, but said nothing.
uz: Birinchi hamkasb qichqirdi, lekin hech narsa aytmadi.

en: 22 July.—Rough weather last three days, and all hands busy with sails, no time to be frightened.
uz: 22 iyul.Qattiq havo uch kun davom etdi va hamma qo'llari yelka bilan band edi, qo'rqishga vaqt yo'q.

en: Men seem to have forgotten their dread.
uz: Erkaklar qo'rquvni unutib qo'ygan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: Mate cheerful again, and all on good terms.
uz: Yana bir bor baxtli bo'lib, barchasi yaxshi munosabatda.

en: Praised men for work in bad weather.
uz: Yomon havo sharoitida ishlash uchun maqtalgan erkaklar.

en: Passed Gibraltar and out through Straits.
uz: Gibraltarni o'tib, daryolar orqali chiqdi.

en: 24 July.—There seems some doom over this ship.
uz: 24 iyul.Bu kemada ba'zi halokat paydo bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: Already a hand short, and entering the Bay of Biscay with wild weather ahead, and yet last night another man lost, disappeared.
uz: Bir qo'l yetarli emas, biz Bizkaya ko'rg'oniga kirib, yovvoyi havo oldimizda edi, ammo o'tgan kechasi yana bir kishi yo'qoldi va yo'qoldi.

en: Like the ﬁrst, he came off his watch and was not seen again.
uz: Birinchisi kabi u ham soatidan chiqib, boshqa ko'rinmadi.

en: Men all in a panic of fear, sent a round robin, asking to have double watch, as they fear to be alone.
uz: Odamlar qo'rquvdan qo'rqib, ikki marta qo'riqlanishlarini so'rab, qo'rqinchga to'lib-toshgan odam yuborishdi, chunki ular yolg'iz qolishdan qo'rqishgan.

en: Fear there will be some trouble, as either he or the men will do some violence.
uz: U yoki uning odamlari biron-bir zo'ravonlik qilishidan qo'rqishadi.

en: 28 July.—Four days in hell, knocking about in a sort of malestrom, and the wind a tempest.
uz: 28 iyul.To'rt kun jahannamda, bir xil bo'ron bilan to'qnashib, shamol bo'lib turadi.

en: No sleep for any one.
uz: Hech kim uchun uyqu yo'q.

en: Hardly know how to set a watch, since no one ﬁt to go on.
uz: Hech kim o'tish uchun mos bo'lmaganligi sababli, soatni qanday o'rnatishni juda ham bilmayman.

en: Second mate volunteered to
uz: Ikkinchi sherigi o'z ixtiyori bilan

en: steer and watch, and let men snatch a few hours sleep.
uz: Qo'riqchi va kuzatuvchi bo'ling, erkaklar bir necha soat uxlab qolsinlar.

en: Wind abating, seas still terriﬁc, but feel them less, as ship is steadier.
uz: Shamol kamayib, dengizlar hali ham ajoyib, lekin kemaning barqarorligi sababli ularni kamroq his qilish kerak.

en: 29 July.—Another tragedy.
uz: 29 iyul.Boshqa bir fojia.

en: Had single watch tonight, as crew too tired to double.
uz: Bu kechasi ekipaj ikki baravar ko'rish uchun juda charchagan bo'lib, yakkalik soatlari bor edi.

en: When morning watch came on deck could ﬁnd no one except steersman.
uz: Ertalab qo'riqchi deckda bo'lganida, u steersmandan boshqa hech kimni topolmadi.

en: Raised outcry, and all came on deck.
uz: Qo'zg'oqchilik ko'tarildi va hamma qayiqqa tushdi.

en: Thorough search, but no one found.
uz: To'liq qidirib topilgan, ammo hech kim topilmagan.

en: Are now without second mate, and crew in a panic.
uz: Endi ikkinchi qo'shni yo'q va ekipaj qo'rqib ketgan.

en: Mate and I agreed to go armed henceforth and wait for any sign of cause.
uz: Mate va men bundan buyon qurol bilan ketishga va biron bir sababni ko'rishni kutishga rozi bo'ldik.

en: 30 July.—Last night.
uz: 30 iyul.O'tgan kechasi.

en: Rejoiced we are nearing England.
uz: Angliyaga yaqinlashayotganimizdan xursandman.

en: Weather ﬁne, all sails set.
uz: Havo yaxshi, barcha yelkalar o'rnatilgan.

en: Retired worn out, slept soundly, awakened by mate telling me that both man of watch and steersman missing.
uz: Ishdan tashqari ishlagan, yaxshi uxlagan, o'zini o'zi uyg'otgan kishi menga ham, soatchi ham, ustoz ham yo'qolganini aytadi.

en: Only self and mate and two hands left to work ship.
uz: Faqat o'z-o'zidan va o'g'il-qizidan va ikkita qo'ldan ishlaydigan kemadan boshqa narsa qolmadi.

en: 1 August.—Two days of fog, and not a sail sighted.
uz: 1 avgust.Ikkita kun davomida tuman bo'lib, hech bir yelka ko'rinmagan.

en: Had hoped when in the English Channel to be able to signal for help or get in somewhere.
uz: Angliya kanalida yordam so'rash yoki biror joyga kirishni umid qilgan edi.

en: Not having power to work sails, have to run before wind.
uz: Sayllarni ishlash uchun kuchga ega bo'lmay, shamoldan oldin yurish kerak.

en: Dare not lower, as could not raise them again.
uz: O'zingizni pastga tushirishga jur'at etmang, chunki ularni yana ko'tarishga qodir emasman.

en: We seem to be drifting to some terrible doom.
uz: Biz dahshatli halokatga yo'liqib ketayotganimiz ko'rinadi.

en: Mate now more demoralised than either of men.
uz: Endi er-xotinlarning har biriga qaraganda ko'proq axloqiy ahvolga tushdi.

en: His stronger nature seems to have worked inwardly against himself.
uz: Uning kuchli tabiati o'ziga qarshi ichki ishlar qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Men are beyond fear, working stolidly and patiently, with minds made up to worst.
uz: Odamlar qo'rquvdan ustun, qattiq va sabr-toqatli bo'lib, onglari eng yomon narsalarga tayyorlangan.

en: They are Russian, he Roumanian.
uz: Ular ruslar, u rumoniylar.

en: 2 August, midnight.—Woke up from few minutes sleep by hearing a cry, seemingly outside my port.
uz: 2 avgust, yarim tun.Bir necha daqiqa uxlaganimdan so'ng, ko'rinishicha, portimdan tashqarida bir yig'ish eshitib uyg'ondim.

en: Could see nothing in fog.
uz: To'g'rimda hech narsa ko'rmasdim.

en: Rushed on deck, and ran against mate.
uz: G'alaba qozonib, qayiqqa tushdi va matga qarshi yugurdi.

en: Tells me he heard cry and ran, but no sign of man on watch.
uz: U menga o'zi yig'layotganini eshitib, yugurganini aytadi, lekin qo'riqchi bo'lgan odamning hech qanday izlari yo'q.

en: Mate says we must be past Straits of Dover, as in a moment of fog lifting he saw North Foreland, just as he heard the man cry out.
uz: Mate aytishicha, biz Dover daryosidan o'tib ketishimiz kerak, chunki bulut ko'tarilgan paytda u Shimoliy Forelandni ko'rdi, xuddi odamning qichqirishini eshitganidek.

en: If so we are now off in the North Sea, and only God can guide us in the fog, which seems to move with us, and God seems to have deserted us.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, biz endi Shimoliy dengizda bo'lib qoldik va faqat Xudo bizni bulut ichida yo'naltira oladi, chunki bulut biz bilan birga harakatlanayotgandek tuyuladi va Xudo bizni tashlab ketgandek tuyuladi.

en: 3 August.—At midnight I went to relieve the man at the wheel and when I got to it found no one there.
uz: 3 avgust.Tun yarimida men haydovchini tashlab ketdim va unga yetib borganimda, u yerda hech kimni topmadim.

en: The wind was steady, and as we ran before it there was no yawing.
uz: Shamol barqaror edi va biz uning oldidan yugurganimizda, hech qanday shovqin bo'lmadi.

en: I dared not leave it, so shouted for the mate.
uz: Men uni tashlab ketishga jur'at qilmadim, shunda hamkorimni chaqirtirdim.

en: After a few seconds, he rushed up on deck in his ﬂannels.
uz: Bir necha soniya o'tgach, u o'z flanellarini kiygan holda deckga yugurdi.

en: He looked wild-eyed and haggard, and I greatly fear his reason has given way.
uz: U yovvoyi ko'z va qo'pol ko'rinishga ega edi va men juda xavotirlanamanki, uning aql-idrokidan voz kechgan.

en: He came close to me and whispered hoarsely, with his mouth to my ear, as though fearing the very air might hear.
uz: U menga yaqinlashib, og'zini qulog'imga yaqinlashtirib, qichqiriq qildi, xuddi havo eshitishi mumkin bo'lganidan qo'rqqanidek.

en: On the watch last night I saw It, like a man, tall and thin, and ghastly pale.
uz: O'tgan kecha qo'riqxonada Men Uni ko'rdim, u odam kabi baland va chiroyli, qo'rqinchli bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: It was in the bows, and look- ing out.
uz: Bu bo'g'inlar ichida edi va u tashqariga qarab turardi.

en: I crept behind It, and gave it my knife, but the knife went through It, empty as the air. And as he spoke he took the knife and drove it savage-
uz: Men uning orqasidan kirib, o'z pichimni unga berdim, ammo pichim O'sha pichaning orqasidan o'tdi, havo kabi bo'sh edi.

en: Then he went on, But It is here, and I'll ﬁnd It.
uz: Keyin davom etdi: Ammo U bu yerda, Men Uni topaman.

en: It is in the hold, perhaps in one of those boxes.
uz: U qo'riqxonada, ehtimol, o'sha qutuqlardan birida.

en: I'll unscrew them one by one and see.
uz: Men ularni birma-bir ko'rib chiqaman.

en: You work the helm. And with a warning look and his ﬁnger on his lip, he went below.
uz: Sen qo'lni o'chirib qo'ying. U ogohlantiruvchi ko'rinish va o'z tilidagi barmog'i bilan pastga tushdi.

en: There was springing up a choppy wind, and I could not leave the helm.
uz: Yovuz shamol o'sib borayotgan edi va men qo'mirni tashlab ketolmadim.

en: I saw him come out on deck again with a tool chest and lantern, and go down the forward hatchway.
uz: U yana qurol qutisi va lantern bilan qadoqdan chiqib, oldingi hatchwaydan tushayotganini ko'rdim.

en: He is mad, stark, raving mad, and it's no use my trying to stop him.
uz: U g'alati, kuchli, g'alati, va uni to'xtatishga harakat qilishimning foydasi yo'q.

en: He can't hurt those big boxes, they are in- voiced as clay, and to pull them about is as harmless a thing as he can do.
uz: U o'sha katta qutilarga zarar yetkaza olmaydi, ular to'g'ri tuproq kabi so'zlanadi va ularni olib tashlash u qila oladigan darajada zararsiz bo'ladi.

en: So here I stay and mind the helm, and write these notes.
uz: Shunday qilib, men shu yerda qoldim va qo'mirni nazorat qilib, ushbu yozuvlarni yozaman.

en: I can only trust in God and wait till the fog clears.
uz: Men faqat Xudoga ishonib, bulut o'tib ketishini kutishim mumkin.

en: Then, if I can't steer to any harbour with the wind that is, I shall cut down sails, and lie by, and signal for help … It is nearly all over now.
uz: Keyin, agar shamol bilan biron-bir portga borolmasam, men yelkalarni kesib, yonma-yon o'tirib, yordam so'rab signal beraman... Endi deyarli hamma narsa tugagan.

en: Just as I was beginning to hope that the mate would come out calmer, for I heard him knocking away at something in the hold, and work is good for him, there came up the hatchway a sudden, star- tled scream, which made my blood run cold, and up on the deck he came as if shot from a gun, a raging madman, with his eyes rolling and his face con- vulsed with fear.
uz: O'shanda men o'rtog'im tinchroq chiqib ketishini umid qila boshlagan edim, chunki men uni hovuzdagi biron bir narsaga urib ketayotganini eshitgan edim va ish uning uchun yaxshi edi, u erda to'satdan, yulduz bilan o'ralgan qichqiriq paydo bo'ldi, bu esa mening qonimni sovuq qilib qo'ydi va u qorong'idan o'tilgandek, g'azablanuvchi g'alati, ko'zlari aylanib, yuzida qo'rquv paydo bo'ldi.

en: Save me! he cried, and then looked round on the blanket of fog.
uz: Meni qutqar! - deb baqirdi u, so'ngra atrofini bulut qopqog'iga qarab ko'rdi.

en: His horror turned to despair, and in a steady voice he said,You had better come too, captain, before it is too late.
uz: Uning dahshatlari umidsizlikka aylandi va u o'z ovozini to'xtatib: Siz ham kelishingiz kerak, kapitan, kech bo'lmasdan oldin.

en: I know the secret now.
uz: Endi sirni bilaman.

en: The sea will save me from Him, and it is all that is left! Before I could say a word, or move forward to seize him, he sprang on the bulwark and deliberately threw himself into the sea.
uz: O'sha dengiz meni Undan qutqaradi va bu mening qolganimdir! - deb so'zlasam ham, uni ushlab qolish uchun qadam qo'ymayman ham, u qoqilib qolib, o'zini dengizga tashladi.

en: I suppose I know the secret too, now.
uz: O'ylaymanki, hozir sirni ham bilaman.

en: It was this madman who had got rid of the men one by one, and now he has followed them himself.
uz: Bu aqldan ozgan odam odam odamlarni bir-biridan qutulgan edi, endi esa u o'zi ularga ergashdi.

en: How am I to account for all these horrors when I get to port?
uz: Men portga yetib borganimda, bu dahshatlarni qanday tushuntirishim kerak?

en: 4 August.—Still fog, which the sunrise cannot pierce, I know there is sunrise because I am a sailor, why else I know not.
uz: 4 avgust.Hamma kun quyosh chiqishi o'tkazib bo'lmaydigan qirg'oq borligini bilaman, chunki men dengizchi bo'lganim uchun, boshqa nima uchun bilmayman.

en: I dared not go below, I dared not leave the helm, so here all night I stayed, and in the dimness of the night I saw it, Him!
uz: Men pastga tushishga va qo'lni qo'yib ketishga jur'at qilmadim, shuning uchun men butun kecha shu yerda qoldim va kechasi soʻnggi paytda Uni ko'rdim!

en: God, forgive me, but the mate was right to jump overboard.
uz: Xudovand, meni kechiring, lekin hamkorim dengizdan o'tishga haqli edi.

en: It was better to die like a man.
uz: Erkak bo'lib o'lish yaxshiroq edi.

en: To die like a sailor in blue water, no man can object.
uz: Ko'k suvda dengizchi kabi o'lishga hech kim qarshilik ko'rsatolmaydi.

en: But I am captain, and I must not leave my ship.
uz: Lekin men kapitanman va kemamni tashlab ketmasligim kerak.

en: But I shall bafﬂe this ﬁend or monster, for I shall tie my hands to the wheel when my strength begins to fail, and along with them I shall tie that which He, It, dare not touch.
uz: Lekin men bu yovuz shayton yoki jondorni hayron qoldiraman, chunki kuchim susayib ketayotganda qo'llarimni haydovchisiga bog'layman va ular bilan birga U qo'l urishga jur'at etmaydigan narsalarni bog'layman.

en: And then, come good wind or foul, I shall save my soul, and my honour as a captain.
uz: Va keyin, yaxshi shamol yoki yomon shamol kelmasin, men o'z jonimni va kapitanlik sharafini saqlayman.

en: I am growing weaker, and the night is coming on.
uz: Men zaiflashib ketyapman va kechasi yaqinlashib kelmoqda.

en: If He can look me in the face again, I may not have time to act … If we are
uz: Agar U yana menga yuzma-yuz ko'rinsa, unda harakat qilishga vaqtim bo'lmasligi mumkin... Agar shunday bo'lsa...

en: wrecked, mayhap this bottle may be found, and those who ﬁnd it may un- derstand.
uz: Bu shisha vayron bo'lganida topilishi mumkin va uni topganlar uni ko'rmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: If not … well, then all men shall know that I have been true to my trust.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lmasa... barcha odamlar mening ishonchimga sodiq bo'lganimni bilib olishadi.

en: God and the Blessed Virgin and the Saints help a poor ignorant soul trying to do his duty … Of course the verdict was an open one.
uz: Xudo va aziz Qiz va azizlar kambag'al jaholatli ruhga o'z vazifasini bajarishga harakat qilayotganda yordam berishadi ... Albatta, hukm ochiq edi.

en: There is no evidence to adduce, and whether or not the man himself committed the murders there is now none to say.
uz: Hech qanday dalil yo'q va o'sha odam o'zi o'ldirgan yoki yo'qligini aytish uchun hech kim yo'q.

en: The folk here hold almost universally that the captain is simply a hero, and he is to be given a public funeral.
uz: Bu yerdagi odamlar deyarli hamma tomonda kapitan shunchaki qahramon deb hisoblashadi va unga ommaviy dafn marosimi beriladi.

en: Already it is arranged that his body is to be taken with a train of boats up the Esk for a piece and then brought back to Tate Hill Pier and up the abbey steps, for he is to be buried in the churchyard on the cliff.
uz: Uning jasadi Esk ko'chasiga ko'tarilgan qayiqlar bilan olib ketilishi, keyin esa Tate Hill Pier-ga va abadiylik qadamlariga olib ketilishi rejalashtirilgan, chunki u qirg'oqdagi cherkov hovlisida dafn qilinadi.

en: The owners of more than a hundred boats have already given in their names as wishing to follow him to the grave.
uz: Yuzdan ortiq qayiq egalari uni qabrgacha kuzatib borishni istayotganlari haqida o'zlarining nomlarini ko'rsatgan.

en: No trace has ever been found of the great dog, at which there is much mourning, for, with public opinion in its present state, he would, I believe, be adopted by the town.
uz: O'sha katta itning izlari hali topilmagan, u uchun katta qayg'u bor, chunki hozirgi holatda jamoatchilik fikri bo'lsa, uni shahar o'zi qabul qiladi deb o'ylayman.

en: Tomorrow will see the funeral, and so will end this one more `mystery of the sea'.
uz: Ertaga dafn marosimi bo'lib o'tadi va bu dengizning yana bir ` sirini tugatadi'.

en: MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL 8 August.—Lucy was very restless all night, and I too, could not sleep.
uz: 8 avgust kuni mening MURRAY jurnalim.Lusi butun kecha bezovta edi va men ham uxlay olmadim.

en: The storm was fearful, and as it boomed loudly among the chimney pots, it made me shudder.
uz: To'fon qo'rqinchli edi va u cho'g'lar ichida baland ovoz bilan ko'tarilganida, meni dahshatga tushirdi.

en: When a sharp puff came it seemed to be like a distant gun.
uz: O'tkir puff kelganida, u uzoqdan o'tadigan qurol kabi ko'rinardi.

en: Strangely enough, Lucy did not wake, but she got up twice and dressed herself.
uz: Ajablanarlisi shundaki, Luisi uyg'onmadi, lekin ikki marta turib, o'zini kiydirdi.

en: Fortunately, each time I awoke in time and managed to undress her without waking her, and got her back to bed.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, har safar o'zimni o'z vaqtida uyg'otdim va uni uyg'otmasdan kiyimidan chiqarib, uni yana uxlatdim.

en: It is a very strange thing, this sleep-walking, for as soon as her will is thwarted in any physical way, her intention, if there be any, disappears, and she yields herself almost exactly to the routine of her life.
uz: Bu juda g'alati narsa, bu uyqusida yurish, chunki uning irodasi biron bir jismoniy yo'l bilan buzilganda, uning niyati, agar biron-bir niyati bo'lsa, yo'qoladi va u o'zini hayotining odat tusiga kirishiga to'g'ri keladi.

en: Early in the morning we both got up and went down to the harbour to see if anything had happened in the night.
uz: Ertalab ertalab ikkovimiz ham turdik va kechasi biron narsa sodir bo'lganmi yoki yo'qmi deb, portga tushdik.

en: There were very few people about, and though the sun was bright, and the air clear and fresh, the big, grim- looking waves, that seemed dark themselves because the foam that topped them was like snow, forced themselves in through the mouth of the harbour, like a bullying man going through a crowd.
uz: Bu yerda juda oz odamlar bor edi va quyosh yorqin, havo toza va toza bo'lsa-da, katta, qorong'i ko'rinadigan to'lqinlar, ularning ustida yog'gan chang qor kabi bo'lgani uchun qorong'i bo'lib ko'rinardi, ko'pchilikni haydab o'tgan zo'ravon odam kabi, ko'pchilikni orqaga surib o'zlarini port og'izidan o'tkazishga majbur qildilar.

en: Somehow I felt glad that Jonathan was not on the sea last night, but on land.
uz: Jonatan o'tgan kecha dengizda emas, quruqlikda bo'lgani uchun xursand bo'ldim.

en: But, oh, is he on land or sea?
uz: Ammo, oh, u quruqlikdami yoki dengizdami?

en: Where is he, and how?
uz: U qayerda va qanday qilib?

en: I am getting fearfully anxious about him.
uz: Men u uchun qo'rquvdan bezovta bo'lib ketyapman.

en: If I only knew what to do, and could do anything!
uz: Agar men nima qilishni bilsam va hamma narsani qila olsam!

en: 10 August.—The funeral of the poor sea captain today was most touch- ing.
uz: 10 avgust.Bugun kambag'al dengiz kapitanining dafn marosimi juda hayajonli bo'ldi.

en: Every boat in the harbour seemed to be there, and the cofﬁn was car-
uz: Portdagi har bir qayiq u yerda bo'lib ko'rinardi va ko'krak mashina edi.

en: ried by captains all the way from Tate Hill Pier up to the churchyard.
uz: Tate Hill Pierdan boshlab cherkov hovlisigacha kapitanlar tomonidan kulishardi.

en: Lucy came with me, and we went early to our old seat, whilst the cortege of boats went up the river to the Viaduct and came down again.
uz: Luisi men bilan birga keldi va biz erta o'z eski o'rinimizga bordik, qayiqlarning kortegasi esa daryo bo'ylab Viaduktga bordi va yana tushdi.

en: We had a lovely view, and saw the procession nearly all the way.
uz: Biz chiroyli ko'rinishga ega bo'ldik va marosimni deyarli butun yo'lda ko'rdik.

en: The poor fellow was laid to rest near our seat so that we stood on it, when the time came and saw everything.
uz: Zavqsiz yigit o'tirgan joyimiz yaqinida o'rnagan edi va biz o'tirgan joyda o'tirgan edik, o'sha vaqtda hamma narsani ko'rardik.

en: Poor Lucy seemed much upset.
uz: kambag'al Lusi ko'p xafa bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: She was restless and uneasy all the time, and I cannot but think that her dreaming at night is telling on her.
uz: U har doim bezovta va qayg'urgan edi va kechqurun tush ko'rgan orzulari unga o'xshaydi deb o'ylayman.

en: She is quite odd in one thing.
uz: U bir narsada juda g'alati.

en: She will not admit to me that there is any cause for restlessness, or if there be, she does not understand it herself.
uz: U menga tashvishlanishning sabablari borligini tan olmaydi yoki, agar shunday bo'lsa, u buni o'zi tushunmaydi.

en: There is an additional cause in that poor Mr.
uz: Bu kambag'al Mr.da qo'shimcha sabab bor.

en: Swales was found dead this morning on our seat, his neck being broken.
uz: Swales bugun ertalab bizning o'rindiqimizda o'lgan holda, bo'yni sindirilgan holda topildi.

en: He had evidently, as the doctor said, fallen back in the seat in some sort of fright, for there was a look of fear and horror on his face that the men said made them shudder.
uz: Shifokor aytganidek, u qo'rqib o'tirganidan keyin o'ziga qaytdi, chunki uning yuzida qo'rquv va dahshat ko'rinishi paydo bo'lgan va erkaklarning aytishicha, ularni dahshatga solgan.

en: Lucy is so sweet and sensitive that she feels inﬂuences more acutely than other people do.
uz: Lucy shunchalik shirin va sezgirki, u ta'sirni boshqa odamlarga qaraganda ko'proq his qiladi.

en: Just now she was quite upset by a little thing which I did not much heed, though I am myself very fond of animals.
uz: O'sha paytda u kichik bir narsadan juda xafa edi, men bunga juda e'tibor bermasdim, garchi men ham hayvonlarni juda yaxshi ko'rsam ham.

en: One of the men who came up here often to look for the boats was fol- lowed by his dog.
uz: Ko'pincha bu yerga qayg'ularni qidirib kelgan odamlardan biri itining orqasidan ergashib ketgan edi.

en: The dog is always with him.
uz: It har doim u bilan birga.

en: They are both quiet persons, and I never saw the man angry, nor heard the dog bark.
uz: Ikkalasi ham xotirjam insonlar va men hech qachon odamni g'azablanayotganini ko'rmaganman, itning la'qib quloq solganini ham eshitmaganman.

en: During the service the dog would not come to its master, who was on the seat with us, but kept a few yards off, barking and howling.
uz: Xizmat paytida it biz bilan birga o'tirgan xo'jayinining oldiga kelmasdi, balki bir necha metr uzoqlikda bo'lib, la'qib, qichqirishardi.

en: Its master spoke to it gently, and then harshly, and then angrily.
uz: Xo'jayini unga muloyimlik bilan, so'ngra qattiq, so'ngra g'azab bilan gapirdi.

en: But it would neither come nor cease to make a noise.
uz: Ammo u kelmasdi va ovoz chiqarishni to'xtamasdi.

en: It was in a fury, with its eyes savage, and all its hair bristling out like a cat's tail when puss is on the war path.
uz: U g'azabda edi, ko'zlari yovvoyi va sochlari urush yo'lida bo'lganida, mushukning quti kabi ko'tarilgan edi.

en: Finally the man too got angry, and jumped down and kicked the dog, and then took it by the scruff of the neck and half dragged and half threw it on the tombstone on which the seat is ﬁxed.
uz: Nihoyat, bu kishi ham g'azablanib, pastga cho'kib, itni urdi va so'ngra uni bo'yniga urib, yarmi tortib, yarmi qabr toshida tashladi.

en: The moment it touched the stone the poor thing began to tremble.
uz: Toshga qo'l tegizgan paytda, kambag'al narsa titra boshladi.

en: It did not try to get away, but crouched down, quivering and cowering, and was in such a pitiable state of terror that I tried, though without effect, to comfort it.
uz: U qochib ketishga harakat qilmadi, balki titrab-tirtirib, qo'rqib-tirtirib, qo'rqinchli holatda edi va men uni tasalli berishga harakat qildim, ammo hech qanday natija bo'lmadi.

en: Lucy was full of pity, too, but she did not attempt to touch the dog, but looked at it in an agonised sort of way.
uz: Lucy ham rahm-shafqatga toʻlib-toshgan edi, lekin u itga qoʻl tegizishga urinmagan, balki unga qaygʻuli tarzda qaragan.

en: I greatly fear that she is of too super sensitive a nature to go through the world without trouble.
uz: Men juda xavotirlanamanki, u dunyoni bezovta o'tkazish uchun juda haddan tashqari sezgir tabiatga ega.

en: She will be dreaming of this tonight, I am sure.
uz: Bu kecha u bu haqda orzu qiladi, shubhasiz.

en: The whole agglomeration of things, the ship steered into port by a dead man, his attitude, tied to the wheel with a
uz: Bularning barchasi, kema o'lik kishi tomonidan portga olib ketilgan, uning munosabati, u velosiped bilan to'g'rilashga bog'langan.

en: cruciﬁx and beads, the touching funeral, the dog, now furious and now in terror, will all afford material for her dreams.
uz: Xoch va marvaridlar, qo'rqinchli dafn marosimi, hozir g'azablangan va endi dahshatga tushayotgan it uning orzularini amalga oshirish uchun moddiy mablag'lar bilan ta'minlaydi.

en: I think it will be best for her to go to bed tired out physically, so I shall take her for a long walk by the cliffs to Robin Hood's Bay and back.
uz: O'ylaymanki, uning uchun jismoniy jihatdan charchagan holda uxlash yaxshiroq bo'ladi, shuning uchun men uni Robin Hood ko'chasiga va qaytib ketadigan qirg'oqlar bo'ylab uzoq yurishga olib boraman.

en: She ought not to have much inclination for sleep-walking then.
uz: O'shanda u uyqudan yurishga moyil bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: CHAPTER 8 MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL Same day, 11 o'clock p.
uz: 8 - bob MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL O'sha kuni soat 11 da.

en: m..—Oh, but I am tired!
uz: M..Oh, lekin men charchadim!

en: If it were not that I had made my diary a duty I should not open it tonight.
uz: Agar mening kundaligimni vazifamga aylantirmaganimda edi, uni bugun ochmasdim.

en: We had a lovely walk.
uz: Biz chiroyli yurib o'tdik.

en: Lucy, after a while, was in gay spirits, owing, I think, to some dear cows who came nosing towards us in a ﬁeld close to the lighthouse, and fright- ened the wits out of us.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, Luisi gey ruhda bo'ldi, bu, menimcha, bizdan bir nechta yaxshi sigirlar tufayli bo'ldi, ular chiroqning yonidagi dalaga kelib, bizlarni qo'rqitishdi.

en: I believe we forgot everything, except of course, personal fear, and it seemed to wipe the slate clean and give us a fresh start.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, biz hamma narsani unutganmiz, albatta, shaxsiy qo'rquvdan tashqari, va bu bizga yangi boshlanishni berishga yordam beradi.

en: We had a capital `severe tea' at Robin Hood's Bay in a sweet little oldfash- ioned inn, with a bow window right over the seaweedcovered rocks of the strand.
uz: Robin Hood ko'chasida oldindan o'rnatilgan, go'zal, kichkina mehmonxonada, dengiz yoshlari bilan qoplangan toshlar ustida o'z o'rinbosari bo'lib, katta `severe tea'ni o'tkazdik.

en: I believe we should have shocked the `New Woman' with our ap- petites.
uz: O'ylaymanki, biz `New Woman'ni o'z ap- petiteslarimiz bilan hayratda qoldirishimiz kerak edi.

en: Men are more tolerant, bless them!
uz: Erkaklar ko'proq tolerant, ularni duo qiling!

en: Then we walked home with some, or rather many, stoppages to rest, and with our hearts full of a con- stant dread of wild bulls.
uz: So'ngra uyga qaytib ketdik, ba'zi yoki ko'pgina to'xtatishlar bilan dam oldik va yuraklarimiz yovvoyi bo'yashlardan doimiy qo'rquvga to'lib-toshdi.

en: Lucy was really tired, and we intended to creep off to bed as soon as we could.
uz: Lucy charchagan edi va biz imkon qadar tezroq uxlashga ketishga qaror qildik.

en: The young curate came in, however, and Mrs.
uz: Biroq, yosh ruhoniy kirdi va xonim Xalifa ham kirdi.

en: Westenra asked him to stay for supper.
uz: Vestenra uni kechki ovqatga qolishga taklif qildi.

en: Lucy and I had both a ﬁght for it with the dusty miller.
uz: Lucy bilan o'zim ham bug'doy molchi bilan kurashdik.

en: I know it was a hard ﬁght on my part, and I am quite heroic.
uz: Bilaman, bu men uchun qiyin kurash edi va men juda qahramonman.

en: I think that some day the bishops must get together and see about breeding up a new class of curates, who don't take supper, no matter how hard they may be pressed to, and who will know when girls are tired.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bir kuni episkoplar yig'ilib, qizlar qachon charchaganini biladigan va kechki ovqatni kechki ovqatga qabul qilmaydigan, qancha bosim o'tkazilmasin, kechki ovqatni kechki ovqatga qabul qilmaydigan, ruhoniylarning yangi sinfini yaratishga qaror qilishlari kerak.

en: Lucy is asleep and breathing softly.
uz: Lucy uxlab, lazzat bilan nafas oladi.

en: She has more color in her cheeks than usual, and looks, oh so sweet.
uz: Uning yig'inlarida odatdagidan ko'proq rang bor va u juda shirin ko'rinadi.

en: Holmwood fell in love with her seeing her only in the drawing room, I wonder what he would say if he saw her now.
uz: Holmwood uni faqat salonda ko'rib, unga muhabbat ko'rdi, endi uni ko'rganida nima deyishini o'ylayman.

en: Some of the `New Women' writers will some day start an idea that men and women should be allowed to see each other asleep before propos- ing or accepting.
uz: Yangi ayollar yozuvchilaridan ba'zilari bir kun kelib, erkaklar va ayollar taklif qilishdan yoki qabul qilishdan oldin bir-birlarini uxlab ko'rishlariga ruxsat berishlari kerak degan g'oyaga ega bo'lishadi.

en: But I suppose the `New Woman' won't condescend in fu- ture to accept.
uz: Ammo men o'ylaymanki, `Yangi ayol qabul qilish uchun o'zini past tutmaydi.

en: She will do the proposing herself.
uz: O'zi taklifni o'zi qiladi.

en: And a nice job she will make of it too!
uz: Va u ham bu ishni yaxshi bajaradi!

en: There's some consolation in that.
uz: Bunda tasalli bor.

en: I am so happy tonight, be-
uz: Men bugun juda xursandman, be-

en: cause dear Lucy seems better.
uz: Sababi, aziz Lusi yaxshiroq ko'rinadi.

en: I really believe she has turned the corner, and that we are over her troubles with dreaming.
uz: Men o'zimga ishonamanki, u burchakni burib qo'ydi va biz uning tushlar bilan bog'liq muammolarini bartaraf etdik.

en: I should be quite happy if I only knew if Jonathan … God bless and keep him.
uz: Bordiyu Jonatanning... Xudo qut-baraka qilsin va saqlasin, deb bilsam, juda xursand bo'lar edim.

en: 11 August.—Diary again.
uz: 11 avgust.Yekin kundalik.

en: No sleep now, so I may as well write.
uz: Endi uxlamayman, shuning uchun men ham yozishim mumkin.

en: I am too agitated to sleep.
uz: Men uxlash uchun juda hayajonlanaman.

en: We have had such an adventure, such an agonizing experi- ence.
uz: Bizda bunday sayohat, bunday og'ir tajriba bo'ldi.

en: I fell asleep as soon as I had closed my diary … Suddenly I became broad awake, and sat up, with a horrible sense of fear upon me, and of some feeling of emptiness around me.
uz: Dunyomimni yopgandan so'ng uxlab ketdim... To'satdan uyg'onib, qo'rquv va atrofimda bo'shlik tuyg'usi bilan o'tirdim.

en: The room was dark, so I could not see Lucy's bed.
uz: Xona qorong'i edi, shuning uchun men Lusiyning yotoqini ko'rmasdim.

en: I stole across and felt for her.
uz: Men o'g'rilik qildim va uning uchun his qildim.

en: I lit a match and found that she was not in the room.
uz: Men chaqmoq yoqdim va u xonada yo'qligini ko'rdim.

en: The door was shut, but not locked, as I had left it.
uz: Eshik yopilgan edi, lekin men uni qoldirganim uchun qulflanmagan edi.

en: I feared to wake her mother, who has been more than usually ill lately, so threw on some clothes and got ready to look for her.
uz: Uning onasini uyg'otishdan qo'rqardim, chunki u so'nggi paytlarda odatdagidan ko'proq kasal bo'lgan, shuning uchun kiyim-kechakni kiyib, uni qidirishga tayyor bo'ldim.

en: As I was leaving the room it struck me that the clothes she wore might give me some clue to her dreaming intention.
uz: Xonadan chiqib ketayotganimda, uning kiyim-kechaklari uning orzu niyati haqida ma'lumot berishi mumkinligi haqida o'yladim.

en: Dressing-gown would mean house, dress outside.
uz: Ko'ylak kiyim uy, tashqi kiyimni anglatadi.

en: Dressing-gown and dress were both in their places.
uz: Ko'ylak va kiyim ham o'z joylarida edi.

en: Thank God, I said to myself, she cannot be far, as she is only in her nightdress. I ran downstairs and looked in the sitting room.
uz: Allohga shukr, deb o'zimga aytdim, u juda uzoq bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki u faqat kechki kiyimida. Men pastga yugurib, xonani ko'rdim.

en: Then I looked in all the other rooms of the house, with an ever-growing fear chilling my heart.
uz: Keyin men uyning boshqa xonalarini ko'rdim, yuragimni qo'rqinchli qo'rquv qo'zg'atdi.

en: Finally, I came to the hall door and found it open.
uz: Nihoyat, men zal eshiklariga yetib kelib, uni ochiq topdim.

en: It was not wide open, but the catch of the lock had not caught.
uz: U keng ochilmagan edi, ammo qulfning tutishi tutmagan edi.

en: The people of the house are careful to lock the door every night, so I feared that Lucy must have gone out as she was.
uz: Uy egalari har kuni kechasi eshikni qulflab turishga harakat qilishadi, shuning uchun men Lutsining o'zi bo'lgani kabi tashqariga chiqishi mumkin deb qo'rqardim.

en: There was no time to think of what might happen.
uz: Nima bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida o'ylashga vaqt bo'lmadi.

en: A vague over-mastering fear obscured all details.
uz: O'ta ustunlik qo'rquvi barcha tafsilotlarni ko'rmay qo'ydi.

en: I took a big, heavy shawl and ran out.
uz: Men katta va og'ir shalni olib chiqib ketdim.

en: The clock was striking one as I was in the Crescent, and there was not a soul in sight.
uz: Men Yarim oyda bo'lganimda, soat o'qidi va ko'rinishda hech qanday jon yo'q edi.

en: I ran along the North Terrace, but could see no sign of the white ﬁgure which I expected.
uz: Men Shimoliy terasa bo'ylab yugurdim, lekin umid qilganimdek oq suratning hech qanday izini ko'rmadim.

en: At the edge of the West Cliff above the pier I looked across the harbour to the East Cliff, in the hope or fear, I don't know which, of seeing Lucy in our favorite seat.
uz: G'arbiy qirg'og'ining chegaralarida, qirg'og'ining ustida, men ko'chadan o'tib, Sharq qirg'og'iga qarab ko'rdim, umid bilan yoki qo'rqib, qaysi birini bilmayman, Lucyni sevimli o'rinchamizda ko'rish uchun.

en: There was a bright full moon, with heavy black, driving clouds, which threw the whole scene into a ﬂeeting diorama of light and shade as they sailed across.
uz: U yerda yorqin to'liq oy, og'ir qora bulutlar bor edi, ular butun voqeani yorug'lik va soyalarning o'tkinchi dioramalariga aylantirdilar.

en: For a moment or two I could see nothing, as the shadow of a cloud obscured St.
uz: Bir-ikki daqiqa davomida men hech narsa ko'rmadim, chunki bulutning soyasi St.

en: Mary's Church and all around it.
uz: Maryamning cherkovlari va atrofidagi barcha joylar.

en: Then as the cloud passed I could see the ruins of the abbey coming into view, and as the edge of a narrow band of light as sharp as a sword-cut moved along, the church and churchyard became gradually visible.
uz: Keyin bulut o'tib borganida, abadiylikning vayronchiligi ko'rinadi va qilichdan kesilgan o'tkir yorug'lik bo'lakining o'tishi o'tib borganda, cherkov va qabriston asta-sekin ko'rinadi.

en: Whatever my expectation was, it was not disappointed, for there, on our favorite seat, the silver light of the
uz: Qanday umidim bo'lmasin, u umidsizlikka tushmadi, chunki o'sha yerda, sevimli o'rinchamizda, o'yinning kumush yorug'ligi ko'rinadi.

en: moon struck a half-reclining ﬁgure, snowy white.
uz: Oy yarim yotgan, qar oq bo'lgan suratga tushibdi.

en: The coming of the cloud was too quick for me to see much, for shadow shut down on light almost immediately, but it seemed to me as though something dark stood behind the seat where the white ﬁgure shone, and bent over it.
uz: Bulutning kelishi men uchun ko'p narsani ko'rish uchun juda tez edi, chunki soya deyarli darhol yorug'likka to'xtab qo'ydi, lekin menga xuddi oq surat parvarish qiladigan o'rindiq ortida qorong'i narsa turgan va uning ustiga egilgan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: What it was, whether man or beast, I could not tell.
uz: Bu odam yoki hayvon bo'ladimi, nima bo'lganini bilmasdim.

en: I did not wait to catch another glance, but ﬂew down the steep steps to the pier and along by the ﬁsh-market to the bridge, which was the only way to reach the East Cliff.
uz: Men yana bir bor ko'rishni kutmaganman, balki qirg'oqqa boradigan tepa qadamlar bo'ylab uchib, baliq bozori bo'ylab ko'prikgacha bordim, bu esa Sharq qirg'og'iga yetib borishning yagona yo'li edi.

en: The town seemed as dead, for not a soul did I see.
uz: Shahar o'lik ko'rinardi, chunki men hech qanday ruhni ko'rmadim.

en: I rejoiced that it was so, for I wanted no witness of poor Lucy's condition.
uz: Men bunga quvonardim, chunki kambag'al Lusiyning kasalligiga guvoh bo'lishni istamasdim.

en: The time and distance seemed endless, and my knees trembled and my breath came laboured as I toiled up the endless steps to the abbey.
uz: Vaqt va masofa cheksiz ko'rinardi, tiz cho'kib, abbayga boradigan cheksiz qadamlarni ko'targanimda nafasim og'irlashib ketdi.

en: I must have gone fast, and yet it seemed to me as if my feet were weighted with lead, and as though every joint in my body were rusty.
uz: Tez yurgan bo'lsam kerak, lekin o'zimga oyoqlarim olov bilan og'irlangan va tanamdagi har bir qo'shni rang-barang bo'lgan kabi ko'rindi.

en: When I got almost to the top I could see the seat and the white ﬁgure, for I was now close enough to distinguish it even through the spells of shadow.
uz: Yuqoriga yetib borganimda, o'rinni va oq suratni ko'rardim, chunki hozir uni hatto soya sehrlari orqali ham ajratib olishim uchun yetarlicha yaqin edim.

en: There was undoubtedly something, long and black, bending over the half- reclining white ﬁgure.
uz: Shak-shubhasiz, yarim tiklangan oq figuraning ustida uzun va qora bir narsa bo'lib o'tirgan.

en: I called in fright, Lucy!
uz: Men qo'rqib: Lusi!

en: Lucy! and something raised a head, and from where I was I could see a white face and red, gleaming eyes.
uz: Lucy! - dedi va bir narsa boshini ko'tardi va men o'zim turgan joyimdan oq yuz va qizil ko'zlarni ko'rardim.

en: Lucy did not answer, and I ran on to the entrance of the churchyard.
uz: Lusi javob bermadi, shuning uchun men cherkov hovlisining kirishi tomon yugurdim.

en: As I entered, the church was between me and the seat, and for a minute or so I lost sight of her.
uz: Kirganimda, cherkov men bilan o'rindiq o'rtasida edi va bir daqiqa davomida uni ko'rmay qoldim.

en: When I came in view again the cloud had passed, and the moonlight struck so brilliantly that I could see Lucy half reclining with her head lying over the back of the seat.
uz: Men yana ko'rinishga kelganimda, bulut o'tib ketdi va oy nuri shunchalik yorqin bo'ldiki, Lusiyani o'rtacha yonboshlagan va boshini o'rindiqning orqasida yotganini ko'rardim.

en: She was quite alone, and there was not a sign of any living thing about.
uz: U juda yolg'iz edi va bu yerda hech qanday tirik mavjudotning izlari yo'q edi.

en: When I bent over her I could see that she was still asleep.
uz: Uning ustiga egilganimda, u hali ham uxlayotganini ko'rardim.

en: Her lips were parted, and she was breathing, not softly as usual with her, but in long, heavy gasps, as though striving to get her lungs full at every breath.
uz: Uning og'izlari ajralgan edi va u odatdagidek yengillik bilan emas, balki uzun va og'ir nafaslar bilan nafas olib, xuddi o'z samarasini har bir nafas bilan to'ldirish uchun harakat qilgandek edi.

en: As I came close, she put up her hand in her sleep and pulled the collar of her nightdress close around her, as though she felt the cold.
uz: Men yaqinlashayotganimda, u uyqusida qo'lini ko'tarib, sovuqni his qilganidek, kechki kiyimining bo'yinini atrofidan o'rab oldi.

en: I ﬂung the warm shawl over her, and drew the edges tight around her neck, for I dreaded lest she should get some deadly chill from the night air, unclad as she was.
uz: Men issiq shaolni uning ustiga tashlab, uning bo'yni atrofidagi bo'laklarni qattiq tortdim, chunki u kechasi havo ustida o'zi kabi kiyimsiz bo'lganidan qo'rqardim.

en: I feared to wake her all at once, so, in order to have my hands free to help her, I fastened the shawl at her throat with a big safety pin.
uz: Men uni bir vaqtning o'zida uyg'otishdan qo'rqardim, shuning uchun unga yordam berish uchun qo'llarim erkin bo'lishi uchun, men shallni uning bo'yniga katta xavfsizlik pin bilan bog'ladim.

en: But I must have been clumsy in my anxiety and pinched or pricked her with it, for by-and- by, when her breathing became quieter, she put her hand to her throat again
uz: Ammo men tashvishlanayotganimda o'zimni noqulay his etib, uni o'z qo'lim bilan urgan bo'lardim, chunki uning nafas olish jarayoni susayganida, u qo'lini yana qo'liga qo'ydi

en: When I had her carefully wrapped up I put my shoes on her feet, and then began very gently to wake her.
uz: Uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'rab olganimdan so'ng, poyabzallarimni uning oyoqlariga qo'ydim, keyin esa uni juda muloyimlik bilan uyg'otdim.

en: At ﬁrst she did not respond, but gradually she became more and more un- easy in her sleep, moaning and sighing occasionally.
uz: Boshida u javob bermadi, lekin asta-sekin uyqusida o'zidan-o'zi ko'proq qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi, vaqti-vaqti bilan g'azablanardi va g'azablanardi.

en: At last, as time was passing fast, and for many other reasons, I wished to get her home at once, I shook her forcibly, till ﬁnally she opened her eyes and awoke.
uz: Nihoyat, vaqt tez o'tgani sababli va boshqa ko'plab sabablarga ko'ra, men uni darhol uyga olib borishni istardim, uni kuch bilan silkitdim, nihoyat u ko'zlarini ochib uyg'onadi.

en: She did not seem surprised to see me, as, of course, she did not realize all at once where she was.
uz: U meni ko'rib hayron bo'lmagandi, chunki, albatta, u qaerda ekanligini birdan anglamagan.

en: Lucy always wakes prettily, and even at such a time,when her body must have been chilled with cold, and her mind somewhat appalled at waking un- clad in a churchyard at night, she did not lose her grace.
uz: Lucy har doim chiroyli uyg'onadi va hatto shunday vaqtda ham, uning tanasi sovuqdan sovunib qolgan bo'lishi kerak va uning fikri kechasi chiroyxonada kiyimsiz uyg'onishdan qo'rqinchga tushganda, u o'z nafsini yo'qotmadi.

en: She trembled a lit- tle, and clung to me.
uz: U juda titranib, menga yopishib qoldi.

en: When I told her to come at once with me home, she rose without a word, with the obedience of a child.
uz: Men unga darhol uyga men bilan kelishini aytganimda, u bir so'z aytmasdan, bola kabi itoatkor bo'lib turdi.

en: As we passed along, the gravel hurt my feet, and Lucy noticed me wince.
uz: O'tayotganimizda, tosh oyoqlarimni og'irlab qo'ydi va Lusi menga qichqirishimni ko'rdi.

en: She stopped and wanted to insist upon my taking my shoes, but I would not.
uz: U to'xtadi va o'zimning poyabzallarimni olib ketishimni istaydi, lekin men bunga rozi bo'lmadim.

en: However, when we got to the pathway outside the chruchyard, where there was a puddle of water, re- maining from the storm, I daubed my feet with mud, using each foot in turn on the other, so that as we went home, no one, in case we should meet any one, should notice my bare feet.
uz: Biroq, qabriston tashqarisidagi yo'lga yetib borganimizda, bu shamoldan qaytgan suv quti bor edi, men oyoqlarimni loy bilan to'ldirib, har bir oyoqni o'z navbatida bir-biriga qo'ydim, shuning uchun uyga qaytib borganimizda hech kim, agar biz hech kim bilan uchrasak, go'yo oyoqlarimni ko'rmasdi.

en: Fortune favoured us, and we got home without meeting a soul.
uz: Yaxshilik bizga ko'maklashdi va biz hech kim bilan uchrashmasdan uyga keldik.

en: Once we saw a man, who seemed not quite sober, passing along a street in front of us.
uz: Bir marta biz oldimizda ko'cha bo'ylab o'tib ketayotgan bir odamni ko'rdik, u juda ham o'zidan chetda ko'rinmagan.

en: But we hid in a door till he had disappeared up an opening such as there are here, steep little closes, or `wynds', as they call them in Scotland.
uz: Ammo biz u yo'qolguncha eshikda yashirinib qoldik, chunki bu erda, tepa kichik yopishmalar yoki Shotlandiyada ularni `wynds deb atashadi.

en: My heart beat so loud all the time sometimes I thought I should faint.
uz: Qalbim doimo qattiq urib turardi, ba'zan men uncha ko'nglim ketmasligi kerak deb o'ylardim.

en: I was ﬁlled with anxiety about Lucy, not only for her health, lest she should suffer from the exposure, but for her reputation in case the story should get wind.
uz: Men Luzi haqida tashvishlanardim, nafaqat uning sog'lig'i uchun, balki uning ifloslanishidan azob chekishi uchun, balki hikoya o'zgarishi uchun uning obro'i uchun ham.

en: When we got in, and had washed our feet, and had said a prayer of thank- fulness together, I tucked her into bed.
uz: Kirganimizda, oyoqlarimizni yuvganimizda va birgalikda shukrona duosini aytganimizda, uni yotoqqa joylashtirdim.

en: Before falling asleep she asked, even implored, me not to say a word to any one, even her mother, about her sleepwalking adventure.
uz: U uxlashdan oldin menga hech kimga, hatto onasiga ham, uning uyqusizlik sayohatidan so'z aytmasligimni so'radi, hatto iltijo qildi.

en: I hesitated at ﬁrst, to promise, but on thinking of the state of her mother's health, and how the knowledge of such a thing would fret her, and think too, of how such a story might become distorted, nay, infallibly would, in case it should leak out, I thought it wiser to do so.
uz: Avval va'da berishga ikkilanardim, lekin onasining sog'lig'i qanday bo'lgani va bu haqda bilishi uni qayg'urishi haqida o'ylagandan so'ng, qanday qilib bunday hikoya noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida o'yladim.

en: I have locked the door, and the key is tied to my wrist, so perhaps I shall not be again disturbed.
uz: Men eshikni qulflab qo'ydim va kalit qo'limga bog'langan edi, shuning uchun, ehtimol, men yana bir bor tashvishlanmayman.

en: Lucy is sleeping soundly.
uz: Luisi yaxshi uxlaydi.

en: The reﬂex of the dawn is high and far over the sea …
uz: Tongning refleksi dengizning yuqori va uzoq tomonida ...

en: Same day, noon.—All goes well.
uz: O'sha kuni tush.Har narsa yaxshi o'tadi.

en: Lucy slept till I woke her and seemed not to have even changed her side.
uz: Luisi men uni uyg'otgunga qadar uxlab qoldi va hatto yonini ham o'zgartirmagan ko'rinardi.

en: The adventure of the night does not seem to have harmed her, on the contrary, it has beneﬁted her, for she looks better this morning than she has done for weeks.
uz: Kechagi mashhurlik unga zarar yetkazmagan, aksincha, bu unga foyda keltirdi, chunki u bu ertalab haftalar davomida qilgan ishidan ko'ra yaxshiroq ko'rinadi.

en: I was sorry to notice that my clumsiness with the safety-pin hurt her.
uz: Xavfsizlik pinim bilan o'zimning befarqligim uni xafa qilganini ko'rib, xafa bo'ldim.

en: Indeed, it might have been seri- ous, for the skin of her throat was pierced.
uz: Darhaqiqat, bu jiddiy bo'lishi mumkin edi, chunki uning bo'yni teshiklangan edi.

en: I must have pinched up a piece of loose skin and have transﬁxed it, for there are two little red points like pin-pricks, and on the band of her nightdress was a drop of blood.
uz: Shubhasizki, men bir bo'sh teri bo'g'ini olib, uni o'tkazgan bo'lardim, chunki ikkita qizil nuqta bor va uning kechki kiyimida qon tomiri bor edi.

en: When I apologised and was concerned about it, she laughed and petted me, and said she did not even feel it.
uz: Men kechirim so'raganimda va bu haqda xavotirda bo'lganimda, u kuldi va meni quchoqlab, hatto his qilmaganini aytdi.

en: Fortunately it cannot leave a scar, as it is so tiny.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, u juda kichkina bo'lgani uchun, bu orzni qoldira olmaydi.

en: Same day, night.—We passed a happy day.
uz: O'sha kuni, kechasi.Biz baxtli kun o'tkazdik.

en: The air was clear, and the sun bright, and there was a cool breeze.
uz: Havo toza, quyosh yorqin va sovuq shamol bor edi.

en: We took our lunch to Mulgrave Woods, Mrs.
uz: Ovqatlanishni Mulgrave Woodsga olib ketdik, xonim.

en: Westenra driving by the road and Lucy and I walking by the cliff-path and joining her at the gate.
uz: Westenra yo'l bo'ylab haydashgan, Lucy bilan men esa qirg'oq yo'lidan o'tib, darvoza oldida unga qo'shilgan edik.

en: I felt a little sad myself, for I could not but feel how absolutely happy it would have been had Jonathan been with me.
uz: O'zim ham biroz xafa bo'ldim, chunki Jonatan men bilan bo'lganida qanchalik baxtli bo'lar edi, deb o'yladim.

en: I must only be patient.
uz: Men faqat sabrli bo'lishim kerak.

en: In the evening we strolled in the Casino Ter- race, and heard some good music by Spohr and Mackenzie, and went to bed early.
uz: Kechqurun biz Casino Ter- musobaqasida yurib, Spohr va Mackenzielarning yaxshi musiqasini eshitdik va erta uxlashga ketdik.

en: Lucy seems more restful than she has been for some time, and fell asleep at once.
uz: Luisi bir muncha vaqtdan beri bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq dam olganday tuyuladi va u darhol uxlab qoldi.

en: I shall lock the door and secure the key the same as before, though I do not expect any trouble tonight.
uz: Eshikni qulflab, kalitni avvalgiday qulflab qo'yaman, lekin bu kecha hech qanday muammoning bo'lishini kutmayman.

en: 12 August.—My expectations were wrong, for twice during the night I was wakened by Lucy trying to get out.
uz: 12 avgust.Men to'g'ri yo'l tutmagan edim, chunki kechasi ikki marta Lucy meni uyga chiqishga harakat qilganida uyg'otdi.

en: She seemed, even in her sleep, to be a little impatient at ﬁnding the door shut, and went back to bed under a sort of protest.
uz: Hatto uyqusida ham u eshikni yopish uchun biroz sabr-toqat qilmay uyqusiga qaytib ketdi.

en: I woke with the dawn, and heard the birds chirping outside of the window.
uz: Men tongda uyg'onib, deraza tashqarisida qushlarning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: Lucy woke, too, and I was glad to see, was even better than on the previous morning.
uz: Lucy ham uyg'onib, o'tgan ertalabga qaraganda hali yaxshiroq edi.

en: All her old gaiety of manner seemed to have come back, and she came and snuggled in beside me and told me all about Arthur.
uz: O'zining eski quvonchli xulq-atvori qaytib keldi va u kelib, yonimga qo'shilib, Artur haqida hamma narsani aytib berdi.

en: I told her how anxious I was about Jonathan, and then she tried to comfort me.
uz: Men unga Jonatan uchun qanchalik tashvishlanayotganimni aytdim va u meni tasalli berishga harakat qildi.

en: Well, she succeeded somewhat, for, though sympathy can't alter facts, it can make them more bearable.
uz: Ha, u ba'zi darajada muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi, chunki hamdardlik faktlarni o'zgartirmasa-da, ularni ko'proq yengillashtirishi mumkin.

en: 13 August.—Another quiet day, and to bed with the key on my wrist as before.
uz: 13 avgust.Boshqa tinch kun, va oldingi kabi qo'limda kalit bilan uxlashga boraman.

en: Again I awoke in the night, and found Lucy sitting up in bed, still asleep, pointing to the window.
uz: Kechqurun yana uyg'onib, Lusiyani yana uxlab, oyog'ida o'tirib, darchaga ko'rsatgan holda ko'rdim.

en: I got up quietly, and pulling aside the blind, looked out.
uz: Men xotirjam turib, ko'rni chetga surib, tashqariga qaradim.

en: It was brilliant moonlight, and the soft effect of the light over the sea and sky, merged together in one great silent mystery, was beautiful beyond words.
uz: Bu yorug' oy yorug'ligi edi va dengiz va osmon ustidan nurning yumshatli ta'siri, bitta katta va jim sirga qo'shilib, so'zlardan tashqari chiroyli edi.

en: Between me and the moonlight ﬂitted a great bat, coming and going in great whirling circles.
uz: Men bilan oy yorug'ligi o'rtasida katta urib, katta aylanuvchi aylanmalar bilan kelib-kelmoqda.

en: Once or twice it came quite close, but
uz: Bir-ikki marta u juda yaqinlashdi, lekin

en: was, I suppose, frightened at seeing me, and ﬂitted away across the harbour towards the abbey.
uz: O'ylaymanki, meni ko'rib qo'rqib, ko'chadan o'tib, abbayga qarab o'tib ketdi.

en: When I came back from the window Lucy had lain down again, and was sleeping peacefully.
uz: Oynadan qaytib kelganimda, Lusi yana o'tirib, tinch uyqusida edi.

en: She did not stir again all night.
uz: U butun kecha uni yana aralashtirmadi.

en: 14 August.—On the East Cliff, reading and writing all day.
uz: 14 avgust.Sharqiy qirg'og'ida kun bo'yi o'qish va yozish.

en: Lucy seems to have become as much in love with the spot as I am, and it is hard to get her away from it when it is time to come home for lunch or tea or dinner.
uz: Luisi ham men kabi bu joyga juda muhabbat ko'rsatgan bo'lib ko'rinadi va u yerga tushlik yoki choy yoki kechki ovqat uchun kelish vaqti kelganida uni undan olib ketish qiyin.

en: This afternoon she made a funny remark.
uz: Bugun kechqurun u qiziqarli fikr bildirdi.

en: We were coming home for dinner, and had come to the top of the steps up from the West Pier and stopped to look at the view, as we generally do.
uz: Biz kechki ovqat uchun uyga qaytib kelayotgan edik va G'arbiy Pierdan turadigan qadamlar to'pasiga yetib, odatda ko'rinishga qarab turardik.

en: The setting sun, low down in the sky, was just dropping behind Kettleness.
uz: Osmonda pastga tushayotgan quyosh Kettleness orqasidan tushayotgan edi.

en: The red light was thrown over on the East Cliff and the old abbey, and seemed to bathe everything in a beautiful rosy glow.
uz: Qizil yorug'lik Sharq qirg'og'i va eski abbayni o'rab oldi va hamma narsani go'zal gullab-yashnaydigan chiroq bilan yuvgan ko'rinardi.

en: We were silent for a while, and suddenly Lucy murmured as if to herself … His red eyes again!
uz: Biz bir muncha vaqt sukut saqladik va to'satdan Luisi o'zicha g'iybat qildi: Uning qizil ko'zlari yana!

en: They are just the same. It was such an odd expres- sion, coming apropos of nothing, that it quite startled me.
uz: Ular bir xil. Bu so'z o'ta g'alati edi, hech narsa haqida gapirmay, meni juda hayratda qoldirdi.

en: I slewed round a little, so as to see Lucy well without seeming to stare at her, and saw that she was in a half dreamy state, with an odd look on her face that I could not quite make out, so I said nothing, but followed her eyes.
uz: Lucyga qaramasdan yaxshi ko'rish uchun biroz o'girib ketdim va u yarim orzu holatida, yuzidagi g'alati ko'rinish bilan, men aniq ko'rmaganimni ko'rdim, shuning uchun hech narsa demadim, faqat uning ko'zlarini kuzatib turdim.

en: She appeared to be looking over at our own seat, whereon was a dark ﬁgure seated alone.
uz: U o'z o'rinchamizga qarab turardi, uning ustida yolg'iz o'tirgan qorong'i bir kishi o'tirardi.

en: I was quite a little startled myself, for it seemed for an instant as if the stranger had great eyes like burning ﬂames, but a second look dispelled the illusion.
uz: O'zim ham biroz qo'rqib qoldim, chunki bir zumga begona odamning olovga o'xshash katta ko'zlari ko'rindi, ammo ikkinchi ko'z o'sha illuziyani yo'q qildi.

en: The red sunlight was shining on the windows of St.
uz: Qizil quyosh nurlari St.

en: Mary's Church behind our seat, and as the sun dipped there was just sufﬁcient change in the refrac- tion and reﬂection to make it appear as if the light moved.
uz: Bizning o'rindiqimiz ortida Maryamning cherkovini ko'rish kerak edi va quyosh botganida nur harakatlanayotgandek ko'rinishi uchun o'zgarish va aks ettirishda etarlicha o'zgarish bo'ldi.

en: I called Lucy's attention to the peculiar effect, and she became herself with a start, but she looked sad all the same.
uz: Men Lusiyaning e'tiborini o'ziga xos ta'sirga qaratdim va u boshida o'zi bo'ldi, ammo u hali ham xafa bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: It may have been that she was thinking of that terri- ble night up there.
uz: Ehtimol, u o'sha dahshatli kecha haqida o'ylagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: We never refer to it, so I said nothing, and we went home to dinner.
uz: Biz hech qachon bu haqda gapirmaymiz, shuning uchun men hech narsa aytmadim va uyga kechki ovqatga bordik.

en: Lucy had a headache and went early to bed.
uz: Lucy bosh og'rig'i bo'lib, erta yotgan edi.

en: I saw her asleep, and went out for a little stroll myself.
uz: Men uni uxlab yotganini ko'rdim va o'zim ham biroz yurishga chiqdim.

en: I walked along the cliffs to the westward, and was full of sweet sadness, for I was thinking of Jonathan.
uz: Men g'arbga qarab qirg'oqlar bo'ylab yurganimda, Yonatan haqida o'ylagani uchun, yoqimli qayg'u bilan to'ldim.

en: When coming home, it was then bright moonlight, so bright that, though the front of our part of the Crescent was in shadow, everything could be well seen, I threw a glance up at our window, and saw Lucy's head leaning out.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelganimda, o'sha paytda oy yorug' edi, o'sha qadar yorqinki, o'rta oyning old tomonimiz soyasida bo'lsa-da, hamma narsa yaxshi ko'rinardi, shuning uchun men darchaga qarab, Lusiyning boshini ko'rdim.

en: I opened my handkerchief and waved it.
uz: Men to'qimachni ochib, uni o'girdim.

en: She did not notice or make any movement whatever.
uz: U hech qanday harakatni ko'rmadi yoki ko'rmadi.

en: Just then, the moon- light crept round an angle of the building, and the light fell on the window.
uz: O'sha paytda oy nuri binoning bir burchagida aylanib chiqdi va nur darchaga tushib qoldi.

en: There distinctly was Lucy with her head lying up against the side of the
uz: U yerda Lucy boshini qo'lning yon tomonida tikib turganini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: window sill and her eyes shut.
uz: Oynaning chekkasi va ko'zlari yopilgan.

en: She was fast asleep, and by her, seated on the window sill, was something that looked like a good-sized bird.
uz: U juda uxlab yotgan edi va uning yonida, deraza ustunida o'tirganida, yaxshi o'lchamli qushga o'xshaydigan narsa bor edi.

en: I was afraid she might get a chill, so I ran upstairs, but as I came into the room she was moving back to her bed, fast asleep, and breathing heavily.
uz: U sovuq bo'lishi mumkin deb qo'rqardim, shuning uchun ustiga yugurib bordim, lekin xonasiga kirganimda u o'z yotoqxonasiga qaytib ketayotgan edi, u juda uxlab, og'ir nafas olgan edi.

en: She was holding her hand to her throat, as though to protect if from the cold.
uz: U qo'lini qo'liga tutib, xuddi sovuqdan himoyalanganidek, qo'lini qo'yib qo'ydi.

en: I did not wake her, but tucked her up warmly.
uz: Men uni uyg'otmadim, lekin uni iliqlik bilan o'chirib qo'ydim.

en: I have taken care that the door is locked and the window securely fastened.
uz: Men eshikni qulflab, darchalarni qat'iy o'rnatishga harakat qildim.

en: She looks so sweet as she sleeps, but she is paler than is her wont, and there is a drawn, haggard look under her eyes which I do not like.
