uz: U uxlayotganda juda shirin ko'rinadi, ammo odatidan ko'ra yorqinroq va ko'z ostidagi ko'z o'ngida ko'rinadigan, ko'ngilsiz ko'rinish bor, bu menga yoqmaydi.

en: I fear she is fretting about something.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, u biror narsa haqida qayg'urmoqda.

en: I wish I could ﬁnd out what it is.
uz: Kechki, bu nima ekanligini bilib olishim mumkin bo'lgan bo'lsa.

en: 15 August.—Rose later than usual.
uz: 15 avgust.Rose odatdagidan kechikdi.

en: Lucy was languid and tired, and slept on after we had been called.
uz: Luisi charchagan va charchagan edi va biz chaqirilgandan keyin ham uxlab qoldi.

en: We had a happy surprise at breakfast.
uz: Bizda kechki ovqatda baxtli kutilmagani bor edi.

en: Arthur's father is better, and wants the marriage to come off soon.
uz: Arturning otasi yaxshilandi va u nikoh tez orada bo'lishini xohlaydi.

en: Lucy is full of quiet joy, and her mother is glad and sorry at once.
uz: Lusi xotirjam quvonchga toʻlib-toshgan, onasi esa bir vaqtning oʻzida xursand va afsuslanmoqda.

en: Later on in the day she told me the cause.
uz: Keyingi kuni u menga sababini aytib berdi.

en: She is grieved to lose Lucy as her very own, but she is rejoiced that she is soon to have some one to protect her.
uz: U Lucyni o'zidan ayrilib qolishidan xafa bo'ladi, ammo u yaqinda uni himoya qiladigan odamga ega bo'lishiga quvonadi.

en: Poor dear, sweet lady!
uz: Yomon, sevimli xonim!

en: She conﬁded to me that she has got her death warrant.
uz: U o'lim hukmini olganini menga aytdi.

en: She has not told Lucy, and made me promise secrecy.
uz: Lucyga buni aytmadi va meni maxfiylikni va'da qilishga majbur qildi.

en: Her doctor told her that within a few months, at most, she must die, for her heart is weakening.
uz: Shifokor unga bir necha oy ichida, eng ko'pida, o'lishi kerakligini aytdi, chunki uning yuragi zaiflashib bormoqda.

en: At any time, even now, a sudden shock would be almost sure to kill her.
uz: Har qanday vaqtda, hatto hozir ham, to'satdan shok uni o'ldirishni taxmin qiladi.

en: Ah, we were wise to keep from her the affair of the dreadful night of Lucy's sleep- walking.
uz: Ah, biz Lusiyning uxlab yurgan dahshatli kechasi haqidagi masalani undan yashirishni oqilona ko'rdik.

en: 17 August.—No diary for two whole days.
uz: 17 avgust.Ikkita kun davomida kundalik yo'q.

en: I have not had the heart to write.
uz: Men yozish uchun yuragim yetmagan.

en: Some sort of shadowy pall seems to be coming over our happiness.
uz: Baxtimizni ko'rinmas ko'rinishda ko'rinadi.

en: No news from Jonathan, and Lucy seems to be growing weaker, whilst her mother's hours are numbering to a close.
uz: Jonatanning hech qanday xabari yo'q va Lusiyaning soni kamayib borayotganiga qaramay, onasining soatlari oxiriga yetib bormoqda.

en: I do not understand Lucy's fading away as she is doing.
uz: Men Luziyning o'z vaqtida yo'q bo'lib ketayotganini tushunmayman.

en: She eats well and sleeps well, and enjoys the fresh air, but all the time the roses in her cheeks are fading, and she gets weaker and more languid day by day.
uz: U yaxshi ovqatlanadi, yaxshi uxlaydi va toza havodan zavqlanadi, lekin har doim uning yig'ichidagi gullar o'sib bormoqda va u kundan-kunga kuchsiz va yorqinlashadi.

en: At night I hear her gasping as if for air.
uz: Kechasi uning havo kabi nafas olishini eshitaman.

en: I keep the key of our door always fastened to my wrist at night, but she gets up and walks about the room, and sits at the open window.
uz: Kechasi eshikning kalitini har doim qo'limga bog'lab turaman, lekin u turadi va xonadon atrofida yuradi va ochiq deraza oldida o'tiradi.

en: Last night I found her leaning out when I woke up, and when I tried to wake her I could not.
uz: Kecha uyg'onganimda, uni yonida yonboshlagan holda topdim va uni uyg'otishga harakat qilganimda, qila olmadim.

en: When I managed to restore her, she was weak as wa- ter, and cried silently between long, painful struggles for breath.
uz: Men uni tiklashga muvaffaq bo'lganimda, u o'z navbatida zaif bo'lib, uzoq va og'ir nafas olish uchun kurashlar o'rtasida sukutdan yig'lardi.

en: When I asked her how she came to be at the window she shook her head and turned away.
uz: U darcha oldida qanday bo'lganini so'raganimda, u boshini silkitdi va yuz o'girdi.

en: I trust her feeling ill may not be from that unlucky prick of the safety-pin.
uz: Men uning kasal bo'lib qolganini xavfsizlik pinining o'zidan emas, balki o'zidan-o'zini yomon his qilishiga ishonaman.

en: I looked at her throat just now as she lay asleep, and the tiny wounds seem not to have healed.
uz: U uxlab yotgan paytda men uning bo'yniga qaradim va kichik yaralar sog'ayib ketmagan ko'rinadi.

en: They are still open, and, if anything, larger than before, and the edges of them are faintly white.
uz: Ular hali ham ochiq va, agar shunday bo'lsa, avvalgilaridan kattaroq va chiroyli oq bo'lgan bo'laklar bor.

en: They are like little white dots with red centres.
uz: Ular qizil markazli kichik oq nuqtalarga o'xshaydi.

en: Unless they heal within a day or two, I shall insist on the doctor seeing about them.
uz: Agar ular bir-ikki kun ichida sog'aymasalar, shifokor ularga g'amxo'rlik qilishi kerakligini istayman.

en: BILLINGTON & SON, SOLICITORS WHITBY, TO MESSRS.
uz: BILLINGTON va O'G'LAR, Solicitorlar UITBY, Xonimlarga.

en: CARTER, PATERSON & CO., LONDON.
uz: Carter, Patterson & Co., London.

en: 17 August Dear Sirs, — Herewith please receive invoice of goods sent by Great Northern Rail- way.
uz: 17 avgust Horim sirlar,  Herewith, iltimos, Buyuk Shimoliy temir yo'l tomonidan jo'natilgan tovarning fakturasini oling.

en: Same are to be delivered at Carfax, near Purﬂeet, immediately on re- ceipt at goods station King's Cross.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, ular Carfaxda, Purfleet yaqinida, King's Cross tovar stansiyasida qabul qilinganidan so'ng, darhol yetkazib beriladi.

en: The house is at present empty, but en- closed please ﬁnd keys, all of which are labelled.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda uy bo'sh, lekin u yopilgan, iltimos, kalitlarni toping, ularning barchasi belgilab qo'yilgan.

en: You will please deposit the boxes, ﬁfty in number, which form the con- signment, in the partially ruined building forming part of the house and marked `A' on rough diagrams enclosed.
uz: Iltimos, qo'riqnomani tashkil etuvchi yigirma san'atli qutilarni uyning bir qismini tashkil etuvchi qisman vayron qilingan binodan joylashtiring va qo'shilgan taxminiy diagrammalarda `A' belgisini qo'ying.

en: Your agent will easily recognize the locality, as it is the ancient chapel of the mansion.
uz: Agentingiz bu joyni osonlikcha tan oladi, chunki u uyning qadimgi kapelini tashkil etadi.

en: The goods leave by the train at 9:30 tonight, and will be due at King's Cross at 4:30 tomorrow afternoon.
uz: Tovarlar bugun soat 9:30 da poyezdda ketadi va ertaga kechqurun soat 4:30 da King's Crossda jo'natiladi.

en: As our client wishes the delivery made as soon as possible, we shall be obliged by your having teams ready at King's Cross at the time named and forthwith conveying the goods to destination.
uz: Mijozimiz imkon qadar tezroq etkazib berishni istaydi, shuning uchun biz King's Crossda belgilangan vaqtda guruhlar tayyor bo'lib, tovarlarni darhol joyiga yetkazishga majbur bo'lamiz.

en: In order to obviate any delays possible through any routine requirements as to payment in your departments, we enclose cheque herewith for ten pounds, receipt of which please acknowledge.
uz: Idoralaringizda to'lovlarni to'lash bo'yicha odatdagi talablar bo'yicha kechikishlarni bartaraf etish uchun biz bu bilan o'n funtlik chekni qo'shamiz, uning qabul qilinganligini tasdiqlang.

en: Should the charge be less than this amount, you can return balance, if greater, we shall at once send cheque for difference on hearing from you.
uz: Agar to'lov ushbu miqdordan kam bo'lsa, balansni qaytarib berishingiz mumkin, agar ko'p bo'lsa, sizdan eshitganimizda farqni aniqlash uchun biz darhol chek yuboramiz.

en: You are to leave the keys on coming away in the main hall of the house, where the proprietor may get them on his entering the house by means of his duplicate key.
uz: Uyga kirganingizda kalitlarni uyning asosiy zalida qoldiring, u erda uy egasi ularni uyga kirganida o'zining nusxali kalitini qo'llashi mumkin.

en: Pray do not take us as exceeding the bounds of business courtesy in pressing you in all ways to use the utmost expedition.
uz: Bizni har qanday yo'l bilan sizdan maksimal darajada foydalanishga majburlab, biznesning odobini o'tkazib yuborganimizdek ko'rmang.

en: We are, dear Sirs, Faithfully yours, SAMUEL F.
uz: Biz, aziz azizlar, sizlarning sodiq bo'lganmiz, SAMUEL F..

en: BILLINGTON & SON LETTER, MESSRS.
uz: BILLINGTON & SON LETTER, xonimlar.

en: CARTER, PATERSON & CO., LONDON, TO MESSRS.
uz: Carter, Patterson & Co., LONDON, MESSRSlarga.

en: BILLINGTON & SON, WHITBY.
uz: BILLINGTON & SON, VITBY.

en: We beg to acknowledge 10 pounds received and to return cheque of 1 pound, 17s, 9d, amount of overplus, as shown in receipted account here- with.
uz: Qutulgan 10 funtni tan olishingizni va 1 funt, 17 funt, 9 funt, ortiqcha miqdordagi chekni qaytarib berishni iltimos qilamiz, bu erda qabul qilingan hisobda ko'rsatilganidek.

en: Goods are delivered in exact accordance with instructions, and keys left in parcel in main hall, as directed.
uz: Tovarlar to'g'ri yo'l-yo'riqlarga muvofiq yetkazib beriladi va kalitlar yo'l-yo'riqlarga muvofiq, asosiy zalda paketda qoldiriladi.

en: We are, dear Sirs, Yours respectful- ly, Pro CARTER, PATERSON & CO. MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL.
uz: Biz, azizlar, sizlarning hurmatingiz, Pro CARTER, PATERSON & CO.  MINA MURRAY'S JOURNAL.

en: 18 August.—I am happy today, and write sitting on the seat in the churchyard.
uz: 18 avgust.Men bugun baxtliman va cherkov hovlisidagi o'rindiqda o'tirib yozaman.

en: Lucy is ever so much better.
uz: Lucy har doim shunchalik yaxshi.

en: Last night she slept well all night, and did not disturb me once.
uz: Kechasi u butun kecha yaxshi uxladi va meni bir marta ham bezovta qilmadi.

en: The roses seem coming back already to her cheeks, though she is still sadly pale and wan-looking.
uz: Rozalar allaqachon uning burchaklariga qaytib kelyapti, ammo u hali ham achchiq va chiroyli ko'rinadi.

en: If she were in any way anemic I could under- stand it, but she is not.
uz: Agar u biron bir tarzda anemik bo'lsa, men buni ko'rishim mumkin, lekin u bunday emas.

en: She is in gay spirits and full of life and cheerfulness.
uz: U gey ruhda va hayot va shodlik bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: All the morbid reticence seems to have passed from her, and she has just reminded me, as if I needed any reminding, of that night, and that it was here, on this very seat, I found her asleep.
uz: O'sha kecha o'zidan o'tib ketgan bo'lib ko'rinadi va u menga o'sha kecha haqida eslatma kerak bo'lganidek eslatdi va men uni uxlab yotganini shu o'rindiqda topdim.

en: As she told me she tapped playfully with the heel of her boot on the stone slab and said, My poor little feet didn't make much noise then!
uz: U menga aytib berayotganidek, o'yincha cho'ntakining to'pasiga teshik qo'ydi va shunday dedi: O'sha paytda kamtar oyoqlarim juda ham shovqinli emas edi!

en: I daresay poor old Mr.
uz: Men kambag'al keksa Mr. deb aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: Swales would have told me that it was because I didn't want to wake up Geordie. As she was in such a communicative humour, I asked her if she had dreamed at all that night.
uz: Swales menga gapirgan bo'lardi, chunki men G'ordini uyg'otmoqchi emasdim. U shunday muloqotchan xarakterda bo'lgani uchun, men undan o'sha kecha tush ko'rganmi yoki yo'qmi deb so'radim.

en: Before she answered, that sweet, puckered look came into her forehead, which Arthur, I call him Arthur from her habit, says he loves, and indeed, I don't wonder that he does.
uz: U javob bermasidan oldin, uning peshanasiga o'sha shirin, chiroyli ko'rinish tushdi, bu ko'rinish Artur, men uni odatidan Artur deb atashdim, u sevadi, deb aytadi va aslida, uning sevganidan ajablanmayman.

en: Then she went on in a half-dreaming kind of way, as if trying to recall it to herself.
uz: So'ngra u o'ziga eslatishga harakat qilgandek, yarim orzu qilib davom etdi.

en: I didn't quite dream, but it all seemed to be real.
uz: Men tush ko'rmagan edim, lekin bularning barchasi haqiqiy bo'lib tuyulgan.

en: I only wanted to be here in this spot.
uz: Men faqat shu joyda bo'lishni istardim.

en: I don't know why, for I was afraid of something, I don't know what.
uz: Nima uchun, bilmayman, chunki men bir narsadan qo'rqardim, nimalardan qo'rqardim.

en: I remember, though I suppose I was asleep, passing through the streets and over the bridge.
uz: Eslaymanki, men uyqudan o'tib, ko'chalar va ko'prikdan o'tgan edim.

en: A ﬁsh leaped as I went by, and I leaned over to look at it, and I heard a lot of dogs howling.
uz: Men o'sha yo'ldan o'tib ketayotganimda, baliq o'tardi va men uni ko'rib turish uchun o'girildim va ko'plab itlarning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: The whole town seemed as if it must be full of dogs all howling at once, as I went up the steps.
uz: Men qadam bosganimda, butun shahar bir vaqtning o'zida itlar bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: Then I had a vague memory of something long and dark with red eyes, just as we saw in the sunset, and something very sweet and very bitter all around me at once.
uz: So'ngra quyosh botganida ko'rganimizdek, qizil ko'zlar bilan uzoq va qorong'i bir narsani va atrofimda bir vaqtning o'zida juda shirin va juda achchiq bir narsani ko'rib, o'zimni yorqin esladim.

en: And then I seemed sinking into deep green water, and there was a singing in my ears, as I have heard there is to drowning men, and then everything seemed passing away from me.
uz: Va keyin men chuqur yashil suvga cho'kkan bo'ldim va quloqlarimda bo'lgan bir qo'shiq, men eshitganidek, cho'kib ketayotgan odamlarga o'xshardi va keyin hamma narsa mendan o'tib ketayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: My soul seemed to go out from my body
uz: Ruhim tanamdan chiqib ketayotganday tuyuldi.

en: and ﬂoat about the air.
uz: va havoda suzish.

en: I seem to remember that once the West Lighthouse was right under me, and then there was a sort of agonizing feeling, as if I were in an earthquake, and I came back and found you shaking my body.
uz: O'shanda G'arbiy Lighthouse men ostida edi va keyin men zilzilada bo'lganim kabi azobli hissiyot paydo bo'ldi va men qaytib kelganimda, siz tanamni silkitayotganingizni ko'rdim.

en: I saw you do it before I felt you. Then she began to laugh.
uz: Sizni sezishdan oldin buni qilayotganingizni ko'rdim. Keyin u kulishni boshladi.

en: It seemed a little uncanny to me, and I listened to her breathlessly.
uz: Bu menga biroz g'alati tuyuldi va men uni nafassiz tingladim.

en: I did not quite like it, and thought it better not to keep her mind on the subject, so we drifted on to another subject, and Lucy was like her old self again.
uz: Menga bu juda yoqmadi va uning bu mavzuga e'tiborini qaratmaslikni yaxshiroq deb o'yladim, shuning uchun biz boshqa mavzuga o'tdik va Lucy yana eski o'ziga o'xshardi.

en: When we got home the fresh breeze had braced her up, and her pale cheeks were really more rosy.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelganimizda, yangi shamol uni ko'targan edi va uning soyuq yig'inlari rosaroq edi.

en: Her mother rejoiced when she saw her, and we all spent a very happy evening together.
uz: Uning onasi uni ko'rganidan xursand bo'ldi va biz hammamiz birga juda baxtli kechani o'tkazdik.

en: 19 August.—Joy, joy, joy!
uz: 19 avgust.Xursandchilik, quvonch, quvonch!

en: Although not all joy.
uz: Garchi barcha quvonch emas.

en: At last, news of Jonathan.
uz: Oxir-oqibat Jonatan haqidagi xabarlar.

en: The dear fellow has been ill, that is why he did not write.
uz: Qizim kasal bo'lib qoldi, shuning uchun u yozmadi.

en: I am not afraid to think it or to say it, now that I know.
uz: Endi bilganim uchun o'ylashdan yoki aytishdan qo'rqmayman.

en: Hawkins sent me on the letter, and wrote himself, oh so kindly.
uz: Hawkins menga maktubni yubordi va o'zi shunday yozdi: Oh, juda mehribon.

en: I am to leave in the morning and go over to Jonathan, and to help to nurse him if necessary, and to bring him home.
uz: Men ertalab ketib, Jonatanning oldiga boraman va kerak bo'lsa, uni parvarishlab, uyga olib kelishga yordam beraman.

en: Hawkins says it would not be a bad thing if we were to be mar- ried out there.
uz: Xokins, agar bizni u yerda o'rab olishsa, yomon bo'lmasligini aytadi.

en: I have cried over the good Sister's letter till I can feel it wet against my bosom, where it lies.
uz: Yaxshi singlimizning maktubi uchun yig'ladim va uni ko'nglimga qo'yib, qayerda yotganini his qila boshladim.

en: It is of Jonathan, and must be near my heart, for he is in my heart.
uz: Bu Jonatanning so'zidir va u qalbimga yaqin bo'lishi kerak, chunki u qalbimda.

en: My journey is all mapped out, and my luggage ready.
uz: Mening sayohatim rejalashtirilgan va bagajim tayyor.

en: I am only taking one change of dress.
uz: Men faqat bir marta kiyim o'zgartiraman.

en: Lucy will bring my trunk to London and keep it till I send for it, for it may be that … I must write no more.
uz: Lucy mening bagazimni Londonga olib kelib, men uni olib ketmagunimcha saqlaydi, chunki ehtimol ... men boshqa yozishim kerak emas.

en: I must keep it to say to Jonathan, my husband.
uz: Buni erim Jonatanga aytish uchun saqlab qolishim kerak.

en: The letter that he has seen and touched must comfort me till we meet.
uz: U ko'rgan va qo'shgan maktub, biz uchrashuvimizgacha meni tasalli berishi kerak.

en: LETTER, SISTER AGATHA, HOSPITAL OF ST.
uz: LETTER, SISTER AGATHA, ST HOSPITAL.

en: MARY BUDA-PESTH, TO MISS WILLHELMINA MURRAY 12 August, Dear Madam.
uz: MARY BUDA-PESTH, Miss WILLHELMINA MURRAY uchun 12 avgust kuni, Qizil xonim.

en: I write by desire of Mr.
uz: Men Mr.ning xohishi bilan yozyapman.

en: Jonathan Harker, who is himself not strong enough to write, though progressing well, thanks to God and St.
uz: Jonatan Harker, u o'zi yozish uchun yetarlicha kuchli emas, ammo Xudo va Aziz Yuhanno tufayli yaxshi rivojlanmoqda.

en: He has been under our care for nearly six weeks, suffering from a violent brain fever.
uz: U deyarli olti hafta davomida bizning g'amxo'rligimizda bo'lib, og'ir miya issiqligidan azob chekmoqda.

en: He wishes me to convey his love, and to say that by this post I write for him to Mr.
uz: U o'z sevgisini bildirishimni va ushbu xabar orqali uning uchun Mr.ga yozayotganimni aytishni istaydi.

en: Peter Hawkins, Exeter, to say, with his duti- ful respects, that he is sorry for his delay, and that all of his work is com- pleted.
uz: Peter Xokins, Ekseter, o'z hurmatini joyiga qo'yib, kechiktirganidan afsuslanishini va barcha ishlari yakunlanganligini aytish uchun.

en: He will require some few weeks' rest in our sanatorium in the hills, but will then return.
uz: U tog'lardagi sanatoriyamizda bir necha hafta dam olishni talab qiladi, lekin keyin qaytib keladi.

en: He wishes me to say that he has not sufﬁcient money with him, and that he would like to pay for his staying here, so that others who need shall not be wanting for belp.
uz: U menga o'zida yetarlicha pul yo'qligini va u bu yerda qolish uchun pul to'lashni xohlayotganini aytishni xohlaydi, shunda muhtoj bo'lganlar belpdan mahrum bo'lmasliklari kerak.

en: Believe me, Yours, with sympathy and all blessings.
uz: Menga ishoning, Seningki, hamdardlik va barcha barakalar bilan.

en: S.—My patient being asleep, I open this to let you know something more.
uz: S.Mening bemorim uxlab yotgan ekan, men buni ochib, sizga ko'proq ma'lumot berishim uchun ochaman.

en: He has told me all about you, and that you are shortly to be his wife.
uz: U menga siz haqingizda hamma narsani aytib berdi va siz tez orada uning xotini bo'lasiz.

en: All blessings to you both!
uz: Ikkalaingizga ham barakalar bo'lsin!

en: He has had some fearful shock, so says our doc- tor, and in his delirium his ravings have been dreadful, of wolves and poi- son and blood, of ghosts and demons, and I fear to say of what.
uz: Doktorimiz shunday deydi: U qo'rqinchli shokga duchor bo'ldi va uning deliriyasida qurtlar va o'g'illar va qon, jinlar va jinlar, va men nima haqida aytishdan qo'rqaman.

en: Be careful of him always that there may be nothing to excite him of this kind for a long time to come.
uz: U bilan doimo ehtiyot bo'ling, chunki uzoq vaqt davomida uni bunday hayajonlantiradigan hech narsa bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: The traces of such an illness as his do not lightly die away.
uz: Uning kasalligi kabi kasallikning izlari yengil yo'q bo'lib ketmaydi.

en: We should have written long ago, but we knew nothing of his friends, and there was nothing on him, nothing that anyone could understand.
uz: Biz uzoq vaqt oldin yozishimiz kerak edi, ammo uning do'stlari haqida hech narsa bilmas edik va u haqida hech narsa yo'q edi, hech kim tushunmaydigan narsa.

en: He came in the train from Klausenburg, and the guard was told by the station master there that he rushed into the station shouting for a ticket for home.
uz: U Klausenburgdan poyezdda keldi va soqchiga u yerdagi stantsiya boshligʻi u yerdagi stantsiyaga shoshilib kirib, uyga chipta soʻrayotganini aytdi.

en: Seeing from his violent demeanor that he was English, they gave him a ticket for the furthest station on the way thither that the train reached.
uz: Uning zo'ravon xulq-atvoridan ko'rinib turibdiki, u ingliz bo'lgan, shuning uchun ular unga poezd yetib boradigan eng uzoq stantsiyaga chipta berishdi.

en: Be assured that he is well cared for.
uz: O'ziga g'amxo'rlik ko'rsatilayotganidan ishonch hosil qiling.

en: He has won all hearts by his sweet- ness and gentleness.
uz: U o'z mehribonligi va mehribonligi bilan barcha qalblarni qo'lga kiritdi.

en: He is truly getting on well, and I have no doubt will in a few weeks be all himself.
uz: U haqiqatan ham yaxshi munosabatda bo'lib, bir necha hafta ichida o'zi bo'lishiga shubhalanmayman.

en: But be careful of him for safety's sake.
uz: Ammo xavfsizlik uchun undan ehtiyot bo'ling.

en: There are, I pray God and St.
uz: Xudodan va aziz Azizning o'zi bor, deb ibodat qilaman.

en: Joseph and Ste.Mary, many, many, happy years for you both. DR.
uz: Joseph va Ste.Mary, ikkalasi uchun ham ko'p, ko'p, baxtli yillar.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 19 Agust.—Strange and sudden change in Renﬁeld last night.
uz: 19 avgust kuni kechqurun Renfildda g'alati va kutilmagan o'zgarish yuz berdi.

en: About eight o'clock he began to get excited and sniff about as a dog does when set- ting.
uz: Taxminan sakkiz soatdan so'ng u hayajonlanib, itning o'rnatishida o'tirgan o'rinini ko'rishni boshladi.

en: The attendant was struck by his manner, and knowing my interest in him, encouraged him to talk.
uz: Xizmatkor uning xatti-harakatidan hayratda qoldi va menga qiziqish ko'rsatayotganini bilib, uni gapirishga undadi.

en: He is usually respectful to the attendant and at times servile, but tonight, the man tells me, he was quite haughty.
uz: Odatda u xizmatkorga hurmat ko'rsatadi va ba'zan qul bo'ladi, lekin bu kechasi, bu kishi menga aytadi, u juda mag'rur edi.

en: Would not condescend to talk with him at all.
uz: U bilan gaplashish uchun hech qanday kamchiliklarga ega bo'lmayman.

en: All he would say was, I don't want to talk to you.
uz: U shunchaki: Men siz bilan gaplashishni istamayman.

en: You don't count now.
uz: Endi sen hisoblamasan.

en: The master is at hand. The attendant thinks it is some sudden form of religious mania which has seized him.
uz: Xo'jayini yaqin orada. Xizmatchi uni o'zidan o'tkazgan diniy mashg'ulotlar deb o'ylaydi.

en: If so, we must look out for squalls, for a strong man with homi- cidal and religious mania at once might be dangerous.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, shov-shuvdan ehtiyot bo'lishimiz kerak, chunki kuchli odamning bir vaqtning o'zida o'ziga xos va diniy mansiyaga ega bo'lishi xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The combination is a dreadful one.
uz: Ushbu kombinatsiya juda dahshatli.

en: At Nine o'clock I visited him myself.
uz: To'qqizlarda men o'zim unga tashrif buyurdim.

en: His attitude to me was the same as that to the attendant.
uz: Uning menga nisbatan munosabati ham, xizmatkorga nisbatan munosabati ham xuddi shunday edi.

en: In his sublime selffeeling the difference between my-
uz: Uning yuksak o'z-o'zidan ko'rinib turibdiki, mening...

en: self and the attendant seemed to him as nothing.
uz: O'zi va xizmatkor unga hech narsa deb o'xshaydi.

en: It looks like religious ma- nia, and he will soon think that he himself is God.
uz: Bu diniy ma'noga o'xshaydi va u tez orada o'zini Xudo deb o'ylaydi.

en: These inﬁnitesimal distinctions between man and man are too paltry for an Omnipotent Being.
uz: Inson bilan inson o'rtasidagi bu cheksiz farqlar har narsaga qodir bo'lgan shaxs uchun juda kamdir.

en: How these madmen give themselves away!
uz: Bu aqldan ozganlar o'zlarini qanday bermoqdalar!

en: The real God taketh heed lest a sparrow fall.
uz: Haqiqiy Xudovand bir burchak tushib qolmasligi uchun e'tibor beradi.

en: But the God created from human vanity sees no difference between an eagle and a sparrow.
uz: Ammo insonning behudaligidan yaratilgan Xudo qarnog'u va burchak o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rmaydi.

en: Oh, if men only knew!
uz: Agar erkaklar bilsalar edi!

en: For half an hour or more Renﬁeld kept getting excited in greater and greater degree.
uz: Yarim soat yoki undan ko'proq vaqt davomida Renfield har doim g'ayratga tushadi.

en: I did not pretend to be watching him, but I kept strict obser- vation all the same.
uz: Men uni kuzatib turaman deb o'ylamaganman, lekin qat'iy kuzatuvga rioya qildim.

en: All at once that shifty look came into his eyes which we always see when a madman has seized an idea, and with it the shifty move- ment of the head and back which asylum attendants come to know so well.
uz: Birdan uning ko'zlariga o'zgaruvchan ko'rinish paydo bo'ldi, bu biz har doim aqldan ozgan kishi g'oyaga ega bo'lganida ko'rishimiz mumkin, shu bilan birga, bosh va orqaga o'zgaruvchan harakatlar ham boshpana xizmatkorlarining juda yaxshi tanishlari mumkin.

en: He became quite quiet, and went and sat on the edge of his bed resignedly, and looked into space with lack-luster eyes.
uz: U juda xotirjam bo'lib, ketib, o'z yotoqining chetida o'tirdi va o'z ko'zlari bilan ko'zga ko'rinmadi.

en: I thought I would ﬁnd out if his apathy were real or only assumed, and tried to lead him to talk of his pets, a theme which had never failed to excite his attention.
uz: Men uning befarqligi haqiqiymi yoki shunchaki taxmin qilinganmi, deb bilib olishimni o'yladim va uni uy hayvonlari haqida gapirishga undashga harakat qildim, bu mavzu uning e'tiborini jalb qilishiga hech qachon to'sqinlik qilmagan.

en: At ﬁrst he made no reply, but at length said testily, Bother them all!
uz: Boshida u hech qanday javob bermadi, oxir-oqibat esa: Barchasini tashlab qo'yinglar!

en: I don't care a pin about them. What I said.
uz: Ular haqida menga hech qanday g'amxo'rlik qilmaydi. - Nima dedim men.

en: You don't mean to tell me you don't care about spiders? (Spiders at present are his hobby and the notebook is ﬁlling up with col- umns of small ﬁgures.) To this he answered enigmatically, The Bride maidens rejoice the eyes that wait the coming of the bride.
uz: Siz menga o'g'irchoqlar haqida g'amxo'rlik qilmayapsizmi? - deb aytmoqchimisiz? - deb so'radi u. - Kelin qizlari kelinning kelishini kutayotgan ko'zlar bilan quvonishadi.

en: But when the bride draweth nigh, then the maidens shine not to the eyes that are ﬁlled. He would not explain himself, but remained obstinately seated on his bed all the time I remained with him.
uz: Ammo kelin yaqinlashganda, qizlar to'ldirilgan ko'zlar uchun yorqin bo'lmaydi. U o'zini tushuntirib bermasdi, lekin men u bilan birga bo'lganimcha o'z yotoqida o'tirgan.

en: I am weary tonight and low in spirits.
uz: Bugun men charchadim va ruhim tushdi.

en: I cannot but think of Lucy, and how different things might have been.
uz: Lucy haqida o'ylashdan boshqa narsa yo'q, bular qanchalik turlicha bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: If I don't sleep at once, chloral, the modern Morpheus!
uz: Agar men bir vaqtning o'zida uxlamasam, xloral, zamonaviy Morfeus!

en: I must be careful not to let it grow into a habit.
uz: Bu odatga aylanishiga yo'l qo'ymaslikka ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak.

en: No, I shall take none tonight!
uz: Yo'q, men bu kecha hech birini qabul qilmayman!

en: I have thought of Lucy, and I shall not dishonour her by mixing the two.
uz: Men Luzi haqida o'yladim va ikkalasi ham o'zaro aralashtirib, uni sharmanda qilmayman.

en: If need by, tonight shall be sleepless.
uz: Agar kerak bo'lsa, bu kecha uxlamaydi.

en: Later.—Glad I made the resolution, gladder that I kept to it.
uz: Keyinroq.Qutlug' Kechlik qarorini qabul qilganimdan mamnunman, uni bajarganimdan mamnunman.

en: I had lain tossing about, and had heard the clock strike only twice, when the night watchman came to me, sent up from the ward, to say that Renﬁeld had es- caped.
uz: Men o'zimni ko'targan edim va soat ikki marta o'qiganimni eshitgan edim, lekin kechasi qo'riqchi meni Renfieldning qochib ketgani haqida xabar berish uchun shahardan jo'natilgan bo'lib keldi.

en: I threw on my clothes and ran down at once.
uz: Kiyim-kechakimni tashlab, darhol pastga yugurdim.

en: My patient is too dan- gerous a person to be roaming about.
uz: Mening bemorim atrofida yurish uchun juda dahshatli odam.

en: Those ideas of his might work out dangerously with strangers.
uz: Uning bu g'oyalari begonalar bilan xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The attendant was waiting for me.
uz: Xizmatchi meni kutib turardi.

en: He said he had seen him not ten min- utes before, seemingly asleep in his bed, when he had looked through the observation trap in the door.
uz: U o'n daqiqadan kamroq vaqt o'tgach, uni eshikdagi kuzatuv tuzoqidan ko'rganida o'z yotoqida uxlab qolganini ko'rganini aytdi.

en: His attention was called by the sound of the window being wrenched out.
uz: Uning e'tiborini darcha ochilishining ovozi jalb qildi.

en: He ran back and saw his feet disappear through the window, and had at once sent up for me.
uz: U qaytib yugurib, oyoqlari darcha orqali yo'qolganini ko'rdi va darhol meni chaqirtirib yubordi.

en: He was only in his night gear, and cannot be far off.
uz: U faqat kechki kiyimida edi va uzoq bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: The attendant thought it would be more useful to watch where he should go than to follow him, as he might lose sight of him whilst getting out of the building by the door.
uz: Xizmatchi uning orqasidan ergashishdan ko'ra, qayerga borishini kuzatish yaxshiroq bo'lishini o'yladi, chunki u eshikdan chiqib ketayotganda uni ko'rishni yo'qotishi mumkin edi.

en: He is a bulky man, and couldn't get through the window.
uz: U katta odam va darcha orqali o'tolmayapti.

en: I am thin, so, with his aid, I got out, but feet foremost, and as we were only a few feet above ground landed unhurt.
uz: Men kam bo'ldim, shuning uchun uning yordami bilan, men undan chiqib ketdim, lekin oyoqlar oldindan, va biz faqat bir necha metr balandlikda bo'lganimiz uchun zararsiz yerga tushdim.

en: The attendant told me the patient had gone to the left, and had taken a straight line, so I ran as quickly as I could.
uz: Xizmatchi bemor chap tomonga o'tib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'l tutganini aytdi, shuning uchun men imkon qadar tezroq yugurdim.

en: As I got through the belt of trees I saw a white ﬁgure scale the high wall which separates our grounds from those of the deserted house.
uz: O'simliklar bo'limidan o'tganimda, bizning hududimizni bo'lak uyidan ajratib turgan baland devorga o'tadigan oq suratni ko'rdim.

en: I ran back at once, told the watchman to get three or four men immediate- ly and follow me into the grounds of Carfax, in case our friend might be dangerous.
uz: Men darhol yugurib qaytib keldim va qo'riqchiga uch yoki to'rtta kishini darhol chaqirib, do'stimiz xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa, Carfax hududiga ketish uchun menga ergashishni aytdim.

en: I got a ladder myself, and crossing the wall, dropped down on the other side.
uz: O'zim daraxtga o'tdim va devorni kesib o'tib, boshqa tomondan tushdim.

en: I could see Renﬁeld's ﬁgure just disappearing behind the an- gle of the house, so I ran after him.
uz: Men Renfieldning xarakteri uyning orqasida yo'qolganini ko'rardim, shuning uchun uning orqasidan yugurdim.

en: On the far side of the house I found him pressed close against the old ironbound oak door of the chapel.
uz: Uyning chet tomonida men uni kapelning eski temir bog'langan tamir eshigidan yaqin ushlab ko'rdim.

en: He was talking, apparently to some one, but I was afraid to go near enough to hear what he was saying, les t I might frighten him, and he should run off.
uz: U gapirayotgan edi, ko'rinib turibdi, lekin men uning gapini eshitish uchun yetarlicha yaqinlashishdan qo'rqardim, agar uni qo'rqitmasam, u qochib ketishi kerak edi.

en: Chasing an errant swarm of bees is nothing to following a naked lunatic, when the ﬁt of escaping is upon him!
uz: Aylar to'plamini yutib yuborish, o'zidan qochib ketishning o'rniga, to'q bo'lak aqldan ozgan odamga ergashish bilan bir xil emas!

en: After a few minutes, however, I could see that he did not take note of anything around him, and so ventured to draw nearer to him, the more so as my men had now crossed the wall and were closing him in.
uz: Biroq bir necha daqiqadan so'ng, uning atrofidagi hech narsa haqida hech narsa bilmaganini ko'rdim va odamlarim devorni o'tib, uni yaqinlashtirishga jur'at qildilar.

en: I heard him say … I am here to do your bidding, Master.
uz: U shunday deganini eshitdim: Men sizning taklifingizni bajarishga keldim, usta.

en: I am your slave, and you will re- ward me, for I shall be faithful.
uz: Men sening qulingman va sen meni himoya qilasan, chunki men sodiq bo'laman.

en: I have worshipped you long and afar off.
uz: Senga uzoq vaqtdan beri sajda qilganman.

en: Now that you are near, I await your commands, and you will not pass me by, will you, dear Master, in your distribution of good things? He is a selﬁsh old beggar anyhow.
uz: Endi siz yaqin ekansiz, men sizning buyruqlaringizni kutyapman va siz meni o'tkazib yubormaysizmi, aziz usta, yaxshi narsalaringizni taqsimlashda? - deb so'rashdi.

en: He thinks of the loaves and ﬁshes even when he believes his is in a real Presence.
uz: U non va baliq haqida o'ylaydi, hatto o'zining haqiqiy hozir bo'lishiga ishonsa ham.

en: His manias make a startling com-
uz: Uning mansiyalari hayratlanarli darajada kom-

en: When we closed in on him he fought like a tiger.
uz: Biz unga yaqinlashganimizda, u o'z-o'zidan tigr kabi jang qilardi.

en: He is immensely strong, for he was more like a wild beast than a man.
uz: U nihoyatda kuchli, chunki u odamdan ko'ra yovvoyi hayvonga o'xshar edi.

en: I never saw a lunatic in such a paroxysm of rage before, and I hope I shall not again.
uz: Men hech qachon g'azabning bunday paroxizmida bo'lgan aqldan ozgan odamni ko'rmaganman va umid qilamanki, yana shunday bo'lmaydi.

en: It is a mercy that we have found out his strength and his danger in good time.
uz: Uning kuch-quvvatini va xavf-xatarini o'z vaqtida bilib olganimiz uchun juda minnatdormiz.

en: With strength and determination like his, he might have done wild work before he was caged.
uz: Uning o'zi kabi kuch va qat'iy qarorga ega bo'lganida, u qamoqqa tashlanishidan oldin yovvoyi ish qilgan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: He is safe now, at any rate.
uz: Hozir u xotirjam, hech bo'lmaganda.

en: Jack Sheppard himself couldn't get free from the strait waistcoat that keeps him restrained, and he's chained to the wall in the padded room.
uz: Jack Sheppardning o'zi uni to'xtatib turadigan chekkadan ozod bo'lmadi va u to'ldirilgan xonada devorga zanjirlangan edi.

en: His cries are at times awful, but the silences that follow are more deadly still, for he means murder in every turn and movement.
uz: Uning baqiriqlari ba'zan dahshatli bo'ladi, lekin keyinchalik sodir bo'ladigan xotirjamlik bundan ham o'ta dahshatli bo'ladi, chunki u har bir o'zgarish va harakatda o'ldirishni nazarda tutadi.

en: Just now he spoke coherent words for the ﬁrst time.
uz: Mana endi u birinchi marta aniq so'zlarni aytdi.

en: I shall be patient, Master.
uz: Men sabrli bo'laman, usta.

en: It is coming, coming, coming! So I took the hint, and came too.
uz: Kelayotgan, kelayotgan, kelayotgan! - dedim va men ham kelib qoldim.

en: I was too excited to sleep, but this diary has quieted me, and I feel I shall get some sleep tonight.
uz: Men uxlash uchun juda hayajonlangan edim, lekin bu kundalik meni tinchlantirgan va bu kecha biroz uxlashim kerakligini his qilaman.

en: CHAPTER 9 LETTER, MINA HARKER TO LUCY WESTENRA Buda-Pesth, 24 August.
uz: 9 - bob XATIR, MINA HARKER LUCY WESTENRA Buda-Pesthga, 24 avgust kuni.

en: My dearest Lucy, I know you will be anxious to hear all that has happened since we parted at the railway station at Whitby.
uz: Mening aziz Luisi, Whitbydagi temir yo'l stantsiyasida ajralib ketgandan beri sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealarni eshitishni xohlaysiz, deb bilaman.

en: Well, my dear, I got to Hull all right, and caught the boat to Hamburg, and then the train on here.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, azizim, men Hullga yetib keldim va Hamburgga qayg'uga tushib, keyin bu yerga poezd tushdim.

en: I feel that I can hardly recall anything of the jour- ney, except that I knew I was coming to Jonathan, and that as I should have to do some nursing, I had better get all the sleep I could.
uz: O'zimni kunning hech bir qismini eslay olmayman, faqat Jonatanning uyiga borayotganimni bilardim va biroz hammaslikka muhtoj bo'lganim uchun, imkon qadar ko'proq uxlashim kerakligini bilardim.

en: I found my dear one, oh, so thin and pale and weaklooking.
uz: Men o'zimning azizimni, oh, shunchalik chiroyli va yorqin va zaif ko'rinishni topdim.

en: All the resolution has gone out of his dear eyes, and that quiet dignity which I told you was in his face has vanished.
uz: Uning ko'zidan butun qarorlar chiqib ketdi va uning yuzida bo'lgan xotirjam qadr-qimmat yo'q bo'ldi.

en: He is only a wreck of himself, and he does not remember any- thing that has happened to him for a long time past.
uz: U o'z-o'zining vayron bo'lgani uchun, uzoq vaqt o'tgach, unga sodir bo'lgan hech qanday narsani eslay olmaydi.

en: At least, he wants me to believe so, and I shall never ask.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, u meni shunday ishonishimni xohlaydi va men hech qachon so'ramayman.

en: He has had some terrible shock, and I fear it might tax his poor brain if he were to try to recall it.
uz: U juda dahshatli shokga duch keldi va qo'rqamanki, agar u buni eslashga harakat qilsa, bu uning kambag'al miyasiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

en: Sister Agatha, who is a good creature and a born nurse, tells me that he wanted her to tell me what they were, but she would only cross herself, and say she would never tell.
uz: Yaxshi yaratilish va tug'ilgan hamshira bo'lgan Agata singlimiz, u menga ular nima ekanligini aytishini xohlaganini aytadi, lekin u faqat o'zini o'zi o'ylab, hech qachon aytmasligini aytadi.

en: That the ravings of the sick were the secrets of God, and that if a nurse through her vocation should hear them, she should respect her trust..
uz: Bemorlarning dardlari Xudoning sirlari ekanligi va agar hamshira ularni tinglasa, unga ishonishini hurmat qilishi kerakligi haqida.

en: She is a sweet, good soul, and the next day, when she saw I was trou- bled, she opened up the subject my poor dear raved about, added, `I can tell you this much, my dear.
uz: O'sha qiz sevimli va yaxshi ruhdir va ertasi kuni, mening xafa bo'lganimni ko'rganida, mening kambag'al azizim juda hayajonlangan mavzuni ochdi va qo'shimcha qildi, `Men sizga shuncha narsani aytishim mumkin, azizim.

en: That it was not about anything which he has done wrong himself, and you, as his wife to be, have no cause to be concerned.
uz: Bu uning o'zi qilgan biron bir yomonlik haqida emasligini va siz uning xotini sifatida tashvishlanishingiz kerak emasligini aytadi.

en: He has not forgotten you or what he owes to you.
uz: U sizni yoki sizga qarzdor bo'lgan narsani unutmagan.

en: His fear was of great and terrible things, which no mortal can treat of.'
uz: Uning qo'rquvi hech bir insoniyatni davolay olmaydigan ulkan va dahshatli narsalardan edi.

en: I do believe the dear soul thought I might be jealous lest my poor dear should have fallen in love with any other girl.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, aziz ruhim boshqa bir qizga muhabbat qozonishi kerak bo'lgan kambag'al azizimga hasad qilishim mumkinligini o'yladi.

en: The idea of my being jealous about Jonathan!
uz: Jonatanga hasad qilishim haqida o'ylash!

en: And yet, my dear, let me whisper, I felt a thrill of joy through me when I knew that no other woman was a cause for trouble.
uz: Shunga qaramay, azizim, men shoshib ketishimga ruxsat bering, boshqa hech bir ayol muammolarga sabab bo'lmasligini bilganimda, o'zim orqali quvonch his qildim.

en: I am now sitting by his bedside, where I can see his face while he sleeps.
uz: Hozir men uning yotoq yonida o'tiribman, u uxlayotganda uning yuzini ko'rib chiqaman.

en: When he woke he asked me for his coat, as he wanted to get something from the pocket.
uz: U uyg'onganidan so'ng, kiyimini so'radi, chunki o'zi sumkadan biror narsa olishni xohlagan.

en: I asked Sister Agatha, and she brought all his things.
uz: Men Agata singlimizdan so'radim va u uning barcha narsalarini olib keldi.

en: I saw amongst them was his notebook, and was was going to ask him to let me look at it, for I knew that I might ﬁnd some clue to his trouble, but I sup- pose he must have seen my wish in my eyes, for he sent me over to the win- dow, saying he wanted to be quite alone for a moment.
uz: Ularning orasida uning yozuv daftarini ko'rdim va undan uni ko'rishimni so'rashni rejalashtirgan edim, chunki men uning muammosiga biron bir izni topishim mumkinligini bilardim, lekin men o'ylaymanki, u mening xohishimni ko'zimdan ko'rgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki u meni biroz yolg'iz qolishni xohlaganini aytib, meni o'ziga yuboradi.

en: Then he called me back, and he said to me very solemnly, `Wilhelmina', I knew then that he was in deadly earnest, for he has never called me by that name since he asked me to marry him, `You know, dear, my ideas of the trust between husband and wife.
uz: Keyin meni chaqirib, juda tantanali so'zlarni aytdi: `Wilhelmina', o'shanda men uning o'limga tayyor ekanini bilardim, chunki u menga u bilan turmush qurishni so'raganidan beri hech qachon o'sha ism bilan chaqirmagan, `Qarang, azizim, er va xotin o'rtasidagi ishonch haqidagi mening tasavvurlarim.

en: There should be no secret, no concealment.
uz: Hech qanday sir yoki yashirinlik bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: I have had a great shock, and when I try to think of what it is I feel my head spin round, and I do not know if it was real of the dreaming of a madman.
uz: Men katta shokga duch keldim va bu nima ekanligini o'ylashga harakat qilsam, boshim aylanib borayotganini his qilaman va aqldan ozgan odamning orzulari haqiqiymi yoki yo'qmi, bilmayman.

en: You know I had brain fever, and that is to be mad.
uz: O'zingiz bilasizki, mening miyamda issiqlik bor edi va bu aqldan ozgan narsa.

en: The secret is here, and I do not want to know it.
uz: Sir bu yerda, men buni bilishni istamayman.

en: I want to take up my life here, with our marriage.' For, my dear, we had decided to be married as soon as the formalities are complete.
uz: Men bu yerda, nikohimiz bilan hayotimni boshlashni istayman, - deb aytdi, chunki, azizim, rasmiy ishlar tugagandan so'ng turmush qurishga qaror qildik.

en: `Are you willing, Wilhelmina, to share my ignorance?
uz: `Wilhelmina, mening jaholatim bilan bo'lishishga tayyormisiz?

en: Take it and keep it, read it if you will,but never let me know unless, indeed, some solemn duty should come upon me to go back to the bitter hours, asleep or awake, sane or mad, recorded here.' He fell back exhausted, and I put the book under his pillow, and kissed him.
uz: Uni oling va saqlang, xohlasangiz o'qing, lekin menga hech qachon xabar bermang, agar, albatta, men qayg'u soatlarga, uyqu yoki uyg'oq, sog'lom yoki aqldan ozgan, bu erda yozib olingan vaqtlarga qaytishim kerak bo'lmasa. U charchagan holda qaytdi va men kitobni yostig'iga qo'ydim va uni o'pdim.

en: have asked Sister Agatha to beg the Superior to let our wedding be this afternoon, and am waiting her reply …  She has come and told me that the Chaplain of the English mission church has been sent for.
uz: Agata opamizdan to'yimiz kechqurun bo'lishi uchun ustunidan iltijo qilishni so'rashdi va uning javobini kutyapman ...   U kelib, menga ingliz missionerlar cherkovining kaprisining chaqirilgani haqida aytdi.

en: We are to be married in an hour, or as soon after as Jonathan awakes. Lucy, the time has come and gone.
uz: Bir soatdan keyin yoki Jonatan uyg'onganidan so'ng turmush quramiz. Lusi, vaqt keldi va ketdi.

en: I feel very solemn, but very, very happy.
uz: Men o'zimni juda tantanali, lekin juda, juda baxtli his qilaman.

en: Jonathan woke a little after the hour, and all was ready, and he sat up in bed, propped up with pillows.
uz: Jonatan soatdan keyin biroz uyg'onib, hamma narsa tayyor edi va o'zini yotoqda o'tirib, yostiqlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: He answered his `I will' ﬁrmly and strong.
uz: U o'z `I will'-ga qat'iy va kuchli javob berdi.

en: I could hardly speak.
uz: Men deyarli gapira olmasdim.

en: My heart was so full that even those words seemed to choke me.
uz: Qalbim shunchalik to'ldiki, hatto o'sha so'zlar meni charchatib qo'ydi.

en: The dear sisters were so kind.
uz: Qiziq singillar juda mehribon edilar.

en: Please, God, I shall never, never forget them, nor the grave and sweet responsibilities I have taken upon me.
uz: Iltimos, Xudoyim, men ularni hech qachon, hech qachon unutmayman, shuningdek, o'z zimmamga olgan jiddiy va mazali mas'uliyatlarni ham unutmayman.

en: I must tell you of my wedding present.
uz: Sizga to'y sovg'am haqida aytib berishim kerak.

en: When the chaplain and the sisters had left me alone with my husband—oh, Lucy, it is the ﬁrst time I have written the words `my husband'—left me alone with my husband, I took the book from under his pillow, and wrapped it up in white paper, and tied it with a little bit of pale blue ribbon which was round my neck, and sealed it over the knot with sealing wax, and for my seal I used my wedding ring.
uz: Kaplan va opa-singillar meni erim Lusi bilan yolg'iz qoldirganida, men birinchi marta erim meni erim bilan yolg'iz qoldirdi degan so'zlarni yozganimda, kitobni uning yostig'i ostidan olib, oq qog'ozga o'rab olib, bo'yniga o'girilgan biroz ko'k ko'k lentga bog'ladim va uni to'plamning ustiga muhrlangan sham bilan muhrladim.

en: Then I kissed it and showed it to my husband, and told him that I would keep it so, and then it would be an outward and visible sign for us all our lives that we trusted each other, that I would never open it unless it were for his own dear sake or for the sake of some stern duty.
uz: Keyin uni o'pdim va erimga ko'rsatdim va uni shunday saqlab qo'yishimni aytdim, keyin esa bu biz bir-birimizga butun hayotimiz davomida ishonayotganimizni ko'rsatadigan tashqi va ko'rinadigan belgi bo'lib qoladi, agar u o'zining yaxshiligi yoki jiddiy majburiyatlari uchun bo'lmasa, men uni hech qachon ochmayman.

en: Then he took my hand in his, and oh, Lucy, it was the ﬁrst time he took his wifes' hand, and said that it was the dearest thing in all the wide world, and that he would go through all the past again to win it, if need be.
uz: Keyin u mening qo'limni o'zining qo'lidan oldi va, ey Lucy, bu birinchi marta xotinining qo'lidan oldi va bu dunyodagi eng sevimli narsa ekanligini va agar kerak bo'lsa, uni qo'lga kiritish uchun o'tmishni qayta ko'rib chiqishini aytdi.

en: The poor dear meant to have said a part of the past, but he cannot think of time yet, and I shall not wonder if at ﬁrst he mixes up not only the month, but the year.
uz: Yomon aziz kishi o'tmishda bir qismini aytmoqchi edi, ammo u hali vaqtni o'ylay olmaydi va men o'zimni o'ylamasmanki, boshida u nafaqat oyni, balki yilni ham chalg'itadi.

en: Well, my dear, could I say?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, azizim, aytsam bo'ladimi?

en: I could only tell him that I was the happiest woman in all the wide world, and that I had nothing to give him except my- self, my life, and my trust, and that with these went my love and duty for all the days of my life.
uz: Men unga faqatgina dunyodagi eng baxtli ayol ekanligimni va o'zim, hayotim va ishonchimdan boshqa unga berishga hech narsa yo'qligimni va hayotimning barcha kunlari uchun sevgim va vazifam shular bilan bog'liqligini aytishim mumkin edi.

en: And, my dear, when he kissed me, and drew me to him with his poor weak hands, it was like a solemn pledge between us.
uz: Qizim, u meni o'pib, o'z zaif qo'llari bilan o'ziga jalb qilganida, bu biz o'rtasida jiddiy ahdga o'xshardi.

en: Lucy dear, do you know why I tell you all this?
uz: Dor Lucy, nega men bularning barchasini aytib berayotganimni bilasizmi?

en: It is not only because it is all sweet to me, but because you have been, and are, very dear to me.
uz: Buning sababi faqatgina men uchun yoqimli emas, balki siz men uchun juda aziz bo'lganingiz va bo'lasiz.

en: It was my privilege to be your friend and guide when you came from the schoolroom to prepare for the world of life.
uz: Siz hayotga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun maktabdan kelganingizda do'stingiz va yo'lboshchingiz bo'lish men uchun sharaf edi.

en: I want you to see now, and with the eyes of a very happy wife, whither duty has led me, so that in your own married life you too may be all happy, as I am.
uz: Endi va juda baxtli xotinning ko'zlari bilan, vazifamiz meni qayerga olib borganini ko'rishingizni xohlayman, shunda siz ham o'zingizning oilaviy hayotingizda men kabi baxtli bo'la olasiz.

en: My dear, please Almighty God, your life may be all it promises, a long day of sunshine, with no harsh wind, no forgetting duty, no distrust.
uz: Aziz, aziz Xudoyim, hayotingiz va'da qilingan hamma narsa bo'lishi mumkin, uzoq kun quyosh nurli, qattiq shamolsiz, vazifani unutmagan, ishonchsizliksiz.

en: I must not wish you no pain, for that can never be, but I do hope you will be always as happy as I am now.
uz: Sizga hech qanday og'riq tilamayman, chunki bu hech qachon bo'lmaydi, lekin umid qilamanki, siz hamisha men kabi baxtli bo'lasiz.

en: I shall post this at once, and perhaps, write you very soon again.
uz: Buni darhol yozib yuboraman va ehtimol, tez orada sizga yana yozaman.

en: I must stop, for Jonathan is waking.
uz: Men to'xtatishim kerak, chunki Jonatan uyg'onmoqda.

en: I must attend my husband!
uz: Men erimga tashrif buyurishim kerak!

en: Your ever-loving Mina Harker. LETTER, LUCY WESTENRA TO MINA HARKER.
uz: Sizning doimo sevadigan Mina Harker yozuvingiz, LUCY WESTENRA MINA HARKERga.

en: Oceans of love and millions of kisses, and may you soon be in your own home with your husband.
uz: Sevgi dengizlari va millionlab o'qishlar va tez orada eringiz bilan o'z uyingizda bo'lishingiz mumkin.

en: I wish you were coming home soon enough to stay with us here.
uz: Kechki, biz bilan birga qolish uchun tezda uyga qaytib kelishingni xohlayman.

en: The strong air would soon restore Jonathan.
uz: Kuchli havo tez orada Jonatanni tiklaydi.

en: It has quite restored me.
uz: Bu meni to'g'ri tikladi.

en: I have an appetite like a cormorant, am full of life, and sleep well.
uz: Mening ochko'zim kormorant kabi, hayotga to'la va yaxshi uxlayman.

en: You will be glad to know that I have quite given up walking in my sleep.
uz: Sizlar bilganingizdan xursand bo'lasizki, uyqusimda yurishni butunlay tashlab qo'ydim.

en: I think I have not stirred out of my bed for a week, that is when I once got into it at night.
uz: O'ylaymanki, men bir hafta davomida yotoqdan ko'tarilmadim, ya'ni bir marta kechasi u erga tushdim.

en: Arthur says I am getting fat.
uz: Artur mening shovqinlashib ketayotganimni aytadi.

en: By the way, I forgot to tell you that Arthur is here.
uz: Aytgancha, sizga aytishni unutib qoldimki, Artur bu yerda.

en: We have such walks and drives, and rides, and rowing, and tennis, and ﬁshing together, and I love him more than ever.
uz: Biz birgalikdagi sayohat, haydash, sayohat, qayiq, tennis va baliq ovlash kabi mashg'ulotlarimiz bor va men uni har qachongidan ham ko'proq sevaman.

en: He tells me that he loves me more, but I doubt that, for at ﬁrst he told me that he couldn't love me more than he did then.
uz: U meni ko'proq sevishini aytadi, lekin shunga shubha qilaman, chunki dastlab u menga o'sha paytdan ko'ra ko'proq sevish mumkin emasligini aytdi.

en: But this is nonsense.
uz: Ammo bu behuda gap.

en: There he is, calling to me.
uz: Mana, u menga chaqirmoqda.

en: So no more just at present from your loving, Lucy.
uz: Shunday qilib, hozirgi paytda sizning sevuvchi Lusi.

en: S.—Mother sends her love.
uz: S.Mother o'z sevgisini jo'natadi.

en: She seems better, poor dear.
uz: U yaxshiroq ko'rinadi, kambag'al.

en: P.S.—We are to be married on 28 September. DR.
uz: P.S.Biz 28 sentabr kuni turmushga chiqamiz.

en: SEWARDS DIARY 20 August.—The case of Renﬁeld grows even more interesting.
uz: 20 avgust kuni Sewardlar kundaligi.Renfild da'vosi yanada qiziqarli bo'lib bormoqda.

en: He has now so far quieted that there are spells of cessation from his passion.
uz: U hozircha shunchalik tinchlandiki, o'z ishtiyoqidan voz kechish holatlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: For the ﬁrst week after his attack he was perpetually violent.
uz: Hujumdan keyingi birinchi haftada u doimiy ravishda zo'ravonlik bilan shug'ullandi.

en: Then one night, just as the moon rose, he grew quiet, and kept murmuring to himself.
uz: Keyin bir kecha, oy ko'tarilganida, u tinchlanib, o'zi uchun g'iybat qilib yurdi.

en: Now I can wait. The attendant came to tell me, so I ran down at once to have a look at him.
uz: Endi men kutishim mumkin. - dedi xizmatkor menga aytib berishga keldi, shuning uchun uni ko'rib chiqish uchun darhol pastga yugurdim.

en: He was still in the strait waistcoat and in the padded room, but the suf- fused look had gone from his face, and his eyes had something of their old pleading.
uz: U hali ham chiroyli kiyimda va to'plamli xonada edi, lekin uning yuzidagi ko'rinish o'tib ketdi va ko'zlarida eski iltijolari bor edi.

en: I might almost say, cringing, softness.
uz: Deyman, qo'rqinchli, yumshoqlik.

en: I was satisﬁed with his present condition, and directed him to be relieved.
uz: Men uning hozirgi holatidan mamnun bo'lib, unga tasalli berishni buyurdim.

en: The attendants hesitated, but ﬁnally carried out my wishes without protest.
uz: O'tirganlar shubha ostiga qo'yishdi, ammo nihoyat, norozilik bildirmasdan, xohish-istaklarimga amal qilishdi.

en: It was a strange thing that the patient had humour enough to see their dis- trust, for, coming close to me, he said in a whisper, all the while looking furtively at them, They think I could hurt you!
uz: Bemorning o'z ishonchsizliklarini ko'rish uchun o'ziga xos humor bo'lgani g'alati edi, chunki menga yaqinlashib, u g'ayrat bilan qarab: Men sizga zarar etkazishim mumkin, deb o'ylaydilar!

en: Fancy me hurting you!
uz: Sizga zarar etkazishimni tasavvur qiling!

en: The fools! It was soothing, somehow, to the feelings to ﬁnd myself disassociated even in the mind of this poor madman from the others, but all the same I do not follow his thought.
uz: Bu ahmoqlar! - deb o'ylashim, o'zimni bu kambag'al aqldan ozgan odamning fikridan ajralib qo'yishim his-tuyg'ularimni yengillashtirdi, ammo men uning fikrini qo'llamasdim.

en: Am I to take it that I have anything in common with him, so that we are, as it were, to stand together.
uz: Men u bilan umumiy narsalarim borligini anglayman, shuning uchun biz bir-birimizga qo'shilishimiz kerak.

en: Or has he to gain from me some good so stupendous that my well being is needful to Him?
uz: Yoki U mening sog'lig'imga muhtoj bo'lgan darajada ajoyib yaxshiliklardan bahramand bo'lishi kerakmi?

en: I must ﬁnd out later on.
uz: Keyinroq bilishim kerak.

en: Tonight he will not speak.
uz: Bu kecha u gapirmaydi.

en: Even the offer of a kitten or even a full-grown cat will not tempt him.
uz: Hatto kichkinagina yoki hatto katta bo'lgan mushukning takliflari ham uni vasvasaga solmaydi.

en: He will only say, I don't take any stock in cats.
uz: U faqat shunday deydi: Men mushuklar bilan hech qanday aloqa qilmayman.

en: I have more to think of now, and I can wait.
uz: Endi men ko'proq o'ylashim kerak va men kutishim mumkin.

en: I can wait. After a while I left him.
uz: Men kutishim mumkin. Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, men uni tashlab ketdim.

en: The attendant tells me that he was quiet until just before dawn, and that then he began to get uneasy, and at length violent, un- til at last he fell into a paroxysm which exhausted him so that he swooned into a sort of coma.
uz: Xizmatchi menga quyosh chiqishidan oldin o'zini tinch tutganini va keyin u noqulay, oxir-oqibat zo'ravon bo'lib, oxir-oqibat o'zini kamsitgan paroxizmga tushgani haqida aytadi.

en: … Three nights has the same thing happened, violent all day then quiet from moonrise to sunrise.
uz: Uch kecha davomida xuddi shunday voqea sodir bo'ldi: kun bo'yi zo'ravonlik, quyosh chiqishidan quyosh chiqishgacha tinchlik.

en: I wish I could get some clue to the cause.
uz: Kechki, men sababni aniqlab olishim mumkin bo'lsa.

en: It would almost seem as if there was some inﬂuence which came and went.
uz: Deyarli shunday ko'rinadiki, kelib-ketadigan va ketadigan ta'sir bor.

en: We shall tonight play sane wits against mad ones.
uz: Bugun oqsoqollar bilan aqldan ozganlarga qarshi o'ynashimiz kerak.

en: He es- caped before without our help.
uz: U bizning yordamimizsiz o'tgan.

en: Tonight he shall escape with it.
uz: Bugun kechasi u bilan qochib ketadi.

en: We shall give him a chance, and have the men ready to follow in case they are required.
uz: Biz unga bir imkoniyat beramiz va agar ular kerak bo'lsa, odamlarni kuzatib borishga tayyormiz.

en: 23 August.—The expected always happens. How well Disraeli knew life.
uz: 23 avgust.Tasavvur qilingan narsa doimo sodir bo'ladi.Disraeli hayotni qanchalik yaxshi bilgan.

en: Our bird when he found the cage open would not ﬂy, so all our subtle arrangements were for nought.
uz: Qo'shqorimiz qovusini ochganida uchmasdi, shuning uchun bizning barcha nozik tadbirlarimiz hech narsa emas edi.

en: At any rate, we have proved one thing, that the spells of quietness last a reasonable time.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, biz bir narsani isbotladik: tinchlik sehrlari uzoq davom etadi.

en: We shall in future be able to ease his bonds for a few hours each day.
uz: Kelajakda biz har kuni bir necha soat davomida uning bog'larini yengillashtirishga qodir bo'lamiz.

en: I have given orders to the night at- tendant merely to shut him in the padded room, when once he is quiet, until the hour before sunrise.
uz: Men kechasi uni to'ldirilgan xonada, agar u tinch bo'lsa, quyosh chiqishidan bir soat oldin yopiq qo'yib qo'yishni amr qildim.

en: The poor soul's body will enjoy the relief even if his mind cannot appreciate it.
uz: Kambag'al ruhning tanasi uning ongini qadrlay olmasligidan qat'i nazar, tasallidan bahramand bo'ladi.

en: The unexpected again!
uz: Yana kutilmagan holat!

en: The patient has once more escaped.
uz: Bemor yana bir bor qochdi.

en: Later.—Another night adventure.
uz: Keyinroq.Boshqa bir kecha mashg'ulot.

en: Renﬁeld artfully waited until the atten- dant was entering the room to inspect.
uz: Renfield o'yinchixonaga kirganidan so'ng, uni tekshirish uchun ustalik bilan kutdi.

en: Then he dashed out past him and ﬂew down the passage.
uz: Keyin u undan o'tib, yo'ldan o'tib ketdi.

en: I sent word for the attendants to follow.
uz: Men xizmatkorlarga xabar yubordim.

en: Again he went into the grounds of the deserted house, and we found him in the same place, pressed against the old chapel door.
uz: U yana bo'lak qolgan uyga kirdi va biz uni xuddi shu joyda, eski kapella eshigini bosgan holda topdik.

en: When he saw me he became furi- ous, and had not the attendants seized him in time, he would have tried to kill me.
uz: Meni ko'rganida g'azabga to'ldi va agar xizmatkorlar uni o'z vaqtida ushlab qolmaganida, meni o'ldirmoqchi bo'lgan bo'lar edi.

en: As we sere holding him a strange thing happened.
uz: Biz uni ushlab turar ekanmiz, g'alati narsa sodir bo'ldi.

en: He suddenly re- doubled his efforts, and then as suddenly grew calm.
uz: U birdan harakatlarini ikki baravar ko'paytirdi va keyin birdan tinchlikka erishdi.

en: I looked round instinc- tively, but could see nothing.
uz: Men instinktli ravishda atrofga qaradim, lekin hech narsa ko'rmadim.

en: Then I caught the patient's eye and followed it, but could trace nothing as it looked into the moonlight sky, except a big bat, which was ﬂapping its silent and ghostly way to the west.
uz: So'ngra bemorning ko'zini ushlab, uning orqasidan ergashdim, lekin u oy yorug'i osmonga qarab turganida hech narsa ko'rmasdim, faqat g'arbga qarab o'z xotirjam va hayajonli yo'lini bosib o'tgan katta urib-ko'tarib o'tirgan.

en: Bats usually wheel about, but this one seemed to go straight on, as if it knew where it was bound for or had some intention of its own.
uz: Ko'pincha bo'g'inlar o'z atrofida aylanib yurishadi, ammo bu biri to'g'ri yo'lga o'tganiga o'xshaydi, xuddi qayerga ketayotganini biladi yoki o'z niyatiga ega bo'lgani kabi.

en: The patient grew calmer every instant, and presently said, You needn't tie me.
uz: Bemor kun sayin tinchlanib, Meni bog'lashning hojati yo'q.

en: I shall go quietly! Without trouble, we came back to the house.
uz: Men xotirjamlik bilan ketaman! - deb, bezovtaliksiz uyga qaytib keldik.

en: feel there is something ominous in his calm, and shall not forget this night.
uz: Uning xotirjamligida bir yomon narsa borligini his qiladi va bu kechani unutib bo'lmaydi.

en: LUCY WESTENRA'S DIARY Hillingham, 24 August.—I must imitate Mina, and keep writing things down.
uz: LUCY WESTENRA'NING DYAYRI Hillingham, 24 avgust.Men Minaga taqlid qilib, narsalarni yozib turishim kerak.

en: Then we can have long talks when we do meet.
uz: Keyin uchrashganimizda uzoq suhbatlar o'tkazamiz.

en: I wonder when it will be.
uz: Qachon bo'lishini o'ylayman.

en: I wish she were with me again, for I feel so unhappy.
uz: U yana men bilan bo'lishini istardim, chunki men o'zimni juda baxtsiz his qilaman.

en: Last night I seemed to be dreaming again just as I was at Whitby.
uz: Kecha kechqurun men yana bir bor Whitbyda bo'lganimda orzu qilib yurganman.

en: Perhaps it is the change of air, or getting home again.
uz: Ehtimol, bu havo o'zgarishi yoki uyga qaytish bilan bog'liq.

en: It is all dark and horrid to me, for I can remember nothing.
uz: Men uchun bu hamma narsa qorong'u dahshatli, chunki men hech narsani eslay olmayman.

en: But I am full of vague fear, and I feel so weak and worn out.
uz: Ammo men ko'p qo'rquvga to'lib-toshganman va o'zimni juda zaif va charchagan his qilaman.

en: When Arthur came to lunch he looked quite grieved when he saw me, and I hadn't the spirit to try to be cheerful.
uz: Artur tushlikka kelganida, meni ko'rganida juda xafa bo'lib ko'rindi va men quvonchli bo'lishga harakat qilish uchun ruhim yo'q edi.

en: I wonder if I could sleep in mother's room tonight.
uz: Bu kecha onamning xonasida uxlashim mumkinmi, deb o'ylayman.

en: I shall make an excuse to try.
uz: Men harakat qilish uchun uzr topaman.

en: 25 August.—Another bad night.
uz: 25 avgust.Boshqa yomon kecha.

en: Mother did not seem to take to my pro- posal.
uz: Onam mening taklifimni qabul qilmayotganga o'xshaydi.

en: She seems not too well herself, and doubtless she fears to worry me.
uz: U o'zi ham yaxshi ko'rinmayapti va, shubhasiz, meni tashvishlantirishdan qo'rqadi.

en: I tried to keep awake, and succeeded for a while, but when the clock struck twelve it waked me from a doze, so I must have been falling asleep.
uz: Uygʻonmaslikka harakat qildim va bir muncha vaqt davomida muvaffaqiyatga erishdim, lekin soat oʻn ikki boʻlganida, u menga bir dozalik uyqudan uygʻotib qoʻydi, shuning uchun uyquga tushib ketishim kerak edi.

en: There was a sort of scratching or ﬂapping at the window, but I did not mind it, and as I remember no more, I suppose I must have fallen asleep.
uz: Oynaning o'zida bir xil qirg'inish yoki to'qnashish sodir bo'ldi, lekin men bunga xalaqit bermadim va endi eslay olmayotganim sababli, men uxlab ketishim kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: I wish I could remember them.
uz: Qani endi ularni eslab qolsam bo'lardi.

en: This morning I am horribly weak.
uz: Bugun ertalab men juda zaifman.

en: My face is ghastly pale, and my throat pains me.
uz: Yuzim dahshatli rang-barang va qo'limda og'riq bor.

en: It must be something wrong with my lungs, for I don't seem to be getting air enough.
uz: Samsamlarimda muammo bor, chunki men etarlicha havoga ega bo'lmayapman.

en: I shall try to cheer up when Arthur comes, or else I know he will be miserable to see me so.
uz: Artur kelganida, men uni xursand qilishga harakat qilaman, aks holda u meni shunday ko'rishidan xafa bo'lishini bilaman.

en: LETTER, ARTHUR TO DR.
uz: XATIR, ARTHUR DR.

en: SEWARD Albemarle Hotel, 31 August My dear Jack, I want you to do me a favour.
uz: SEWARD Albemarle mehmonxonasi, 31 avgust Mening aziz Jek, menga bir iltifot qilishingizni xohlayman.

en: Lucy is ill, that is she has no special dis- ease, but she looks awful, and is getting worse every day.
uz: Luisi kasal, ya'ni u hech qanday kasallikka chalingan emas, lekin u juda yomon ko'rinadi va kundan-kunga yomonlashib bormoqda.

en: I have asked her if there is any cause, I not dare to ask her mother, for to disturb the poor lady's mind about her daughter in her present state of health would be fatal.
uz: Undan biron sabab bor-yo'qligini so'radim, onasidan so'rashga jur'at etmayman, chunki kambag'al ayolning qizini hozirgi sog'lig'i holatida bezovta qilish dahshatli bo'ladi.

en: Westenra has conﬁded to me that her doom is spoken, disease of the heart, though poor Lucy does not know it yet.
uz: Westenra menga uning halokatini, yurak kasalligini aytganini aytdi, ammo kambag'al Luzi buni hali bilmaydi.

en: I am sure that there is some- thing preying on my dear girl's mind.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, mening sevimli qizimning ongida biror narsa bor.

en: I am almost distracted when I think of her.
uz: U haqida o'ylagandan so'ng men deyarli chalg'ib ketaman.

en: To look at her gives me a pang.
uz: Unga qarab ko'rishim menga ko'nglim tushadi.

en: I told her I should ask you to see her, and though she demurred at ﬁrst, I know why, old fellow, she ﬁnally con- sented.
uz: Men unga uni ko'rishingizni so'rashim kerakligini aytdim va agar u boshida kechiksa ham, nima uchun, keksa, oxir-oqibat rozi bo'lganini bilaman.

en: It will be a painful task for you, I know, old friend, but it is for her sake, and I must not hesitate to ask, or you to act.
uz: Bu siz uchun og'ir ish bo'lishi mumkin, men bilaman, eski do'stim, lekin bu uning manfaatini ko'zlab bo'ladi va men so'rashdan yoki siz harakat qilishdan bosh tortmasligim kerak.

en: You are to come to lunch at Hillingham tomorrow, two o'clock, so as not to arouse any suspicion in Mrs.
uz: Siz ertaga soat ikkida Hillinghamda tushlikka kelishingiz kerak, shuning uchun Mrs.da hech qanday shubha uyg'otmaslik kerak.

en: Westenra, and after lunch Lucy will take an opportunity of being alone
uz: Westenra, va kechki ovqatdan so'ng Lucy yolg'iz qolish imkoniyatini qo'lga kiritadi.

en: I am ﬁlled with anxiety, and want to consult with you alone as soon as I can after you have seen her.
uz: Men xavotirga toʻlib-toshganman va uni koʻrganingizdan soʻng, imkon qadar tezroq siz bilan yolgʻiz maslahatlashishni xohlayman.

en: Arthur. TELEGRAM, ARTHUR HOLMWOOD TO SEWARD 1 September Am summoned to see my father, who is worse.
uz: Arthur. Telogram, ARTHUR HOLMWOOD SEWARD 1 sentabr Otamni ko'rish uchun chaqirilganman, u bundan ham yomon.

en: Write me fully by tonight's post to Ring.
uz: Meni to'liq yozing, bu kecha Ringga yuborilgan xabar orqali.

en: Wire me if necessary. LETTER FROM DR.
uz: Agar kerak bo'lsa, menga xabar bering. - deb yozgan.

en: SEWARD TO ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 2 September My dear old fellow, With regard to Miss Westenra's health I hasten to let you know at once that in my opinion there is not any functal disturbance or any malady that I know of.
uz: ARTHUR HOLMWOODga 2 sentabr kuni Sevgili keksa birodarim, Miss Westenraning sog'lig'i to'g'risida shoshilinch xabar berishga shoshilyapmanki, mening fikrimcha, menga ma'lum bo'lgan hech qanday funktual kasallik yoki kasallik yo'q.

en: At the same time, I am not by any means satisﬁed with her appear- ance.
uz: Shu bilan birga, men uning tashqi ko'rinishi bilan hech qanday qoniqarli emasman.

en: She is woefully different from what she was when I saw her last.
uz: U men uni oxirgi marta ko'rganimda bo'lganidan juda farq qiladi.

en: Of course you must bear in mind that I did not have full opportunity of exami- nation such as I should wish.
uz: Albatta, siz esingizda bo'lishi kerakki, men o'ylaganday imtihon olish uchun to'liq imkoniyatim bo'lmagan.

en: Our very friendship makes a little difﬁculty which not even medical science or custom can bridge over.
uz: Bizning do'stligimiz hatto tibbiy fan yoki urf-odat ham o'tkazib yuborolmaydigan kichik qiyinchilikni yaratadi.

en: I had better tell you exactly what happened, leaving you to draw, in a measure, your own conclusions.
uz: Men sizga nima sodir bo'lganini aniq aytib, siz o'zingizning xulosalaringizni chiqarishga ruxsat bersam yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: I shall then say what I have done and propose doing.
uz: Keyin nima qilganimni aytib, nima qilishni taklif qilaman.

en: I found Miss Westenra in seemingly gay spirits.
uz: Men Miss Westenraning gʻay ruhlarida topdim.

en: Her mother was present, and in a few seconds I made up my mind that she was trying all she knew to mislead her mother and prevent her from being anxious.
uz: Uning onasi ham bor edi va bir necha soniya o'tgach, u onasini yo'ldan ozdirish va tashvishlanmasligini to'xtatish uchun o'zi bilgan hamma narsaga harakat qilayotganini tushundim.

en: I have no doubt she guesses, if she does not know, what need of caution there is.
uz: Shubhasizki, u, agar bilmasa, ehtiyotkorlik kerakligini tasavvur qiladi.

en: We lunched alone, and as we all exerted ourselves to be cheerful, we got, as some kind of reward for our labours, some real cheerfulness amongst us.
uz: Biz yolg'iz ovqatlanardik va barchamiz quvonchli bo'lish uchun harakat qilganimizda, mehnatimiz uchun qandaydir mukofot sifatida o'zimiz orasida haqiqiy quvonch paydo bo'ldi.

en: Westenra went to lie down, and Lucy was left with me.
uz: Westenra uxlashga ketdi va Lusi men bilan qoldi.

en: We went into her boudoir, and till we got there her gaiety remained, for the servants were coming and going.
uz: Biz uning bodoriga kirdik va u yerga yetguncha uning quvonchi davom etdi, chunki xizmatkorlar kelib-ketardi.

en: As soon as the door was closed, however, the mask fell from her face, and she sank down into a chair with a great sigh, and hid her eyes with her hand.
uz: Biroq eshik yopilganidan so'ng, uning yuzidan maska tushdi va u o'tirgan joyga o'tirib, ko'zlarini qo'li bilan yashirib qo'ydi.

en: When I saw that her high spirits had failed, I at once took advantage of her reaction to make a diagnosis.
uz: Uning ruhini yaxshi ko'rmaganini ko'rgach, men darhol uning reaktsiyasidan foydalanib, tashxis qo'ydim.

en: She said to me very sweetly, `I cannot tell you how I loathe talking about myself.' I reminded her that a doctor's conﬁdence was sacred, but that you were grievously anxious about her.
uz: U menga juda shirinlik bilan aytdi, `Men o'zim haqida gapirishdan qanchalik nafratlanayotganimni aytolmayman. ' Men unga shifokorning ishonchi muqaddas ekanligini, lekin siz uning uchun juda tashvishlanayotganingizni eslatdim.

en: She caught on to my meaning at once, and settled that matter in a word.
uz: O'sha zahoti u mening ma'noni tushundi va bu masala bir so'z bilan hal qilindi.

en: `Tell Arthur everything you choose.
uz: ` Arturga o'zingiz tanlagan hamma narsani ayting.

en: I do not care for myself, but for him!' So I am quite free.
uz: Men o'zim uchun emas, balki u uchun g'amxo'rlik qilaman! Demak, men butunlay erkinman.

en: I could easily see that she was somewhat bloodless, but I could not see the usual anemic signs, and by the chance ,I was able to test the actual qual- ity of her blood, for in opening a window which was stiff a cord gave way, and she cut her hand slightly with broken glass.
uz: Men uning biroz qonsizligini osonlikcha ko'rardim, ammo odatdagi anemiya belgilarini ko'rmadim va tasodifan uning qonining haqiqiy sifatini sinab ko'rardim, chunki qattiq bo'lgan oynani ochganimda, u qo'lini qisqacha kesib yubordi.

en: It was a slight matter in it- self, but it gave me an evident chance, and I secured a few drops of the blood and have analysed them.
uz: Bu o'z-o'zidan kichik masala edi, lekin bu menga aniq imkoniyat berdi va men bir necha tomchi qonni olib, tahlil qildim.

en: The qualitative analysis give a quite normal condition, and shows, I should infer, in itself a vigorous state of health.
uz: Sifatli tahlillar juda normal holatni beradi va shuni ko'rsatadiki, mening fikrimcha, o'z-o'zidan kuchli sog'liq holatini ko'rsatadi.

en: In other physical matters I was quite satisﬁed that there is no need for anxiety, but as there must be a cause somewhere, I have come to the conclusion that it must be something mental.
uz: Boshqa jismoniy masalalarda tashvishlanishning hojati yo'qligiga amin edim, ammo qayerda bo'lish kerakligi sababli, bu psixologik holat bo'lishi kerak degan xulosaga keldim.

en: She complains of difﬁculty breathing satisfactorily at times, and of heavy, lethargic sleep, with dreams that frighten her, but regarding which she can remember nothing.
uz: U ba'zan qoniqarli nafas olishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishi va og'ir, charchagan uyquga, uni qo'rqitadigan, ammo hech narsani eslay olmaydigan tushlarga shikoyat qiladi.

en: She says that as a child, she used to walk in her sleep, and that when in Whitby the habit came back, and that once she walked out in the night and went to East Cliff, where Miss Murray found her.
uz: U bolaligida uxlab yurganini, Uitbida bu odat qaytganini va bir marta kechasi chiqib, Sharqiy Klipga borganini aytib berdi.

en: But she assures me that of late the habit has not returned.
uz: Ammo u menga oxirgi paytlarda bu odat qaytmaganini ishontirdi.

en: I am in doubt, and so have done the best thing I know of.
uz: Menda shubha bor va men o'zim bilgan eng yaxshi ishni qildim.

en: I have written to my old friend and master, Professor Van Helsing, of Amsterdam, who knows as much about obscure diseases as any one in the world.
uz: Men eski do'stim va ustam, Amsterdamlik professor Van Helsingga yozganman, u dunyodagi har kim kabi noma'lum kasalliklar haqida ko'p narsani biladi.

en: I have asked him to come over, and as you told me that all things were to be at your charge, I have mentioned to him who you are and your relations to Miss Westenra.
uz: Men unga kelishini aytdim va siz menga hamma narsa sizning zimmangizda bo'lishi kerakligini aytganingizdek, men unga kimligingizni va Miss Westenra bilan munosabatlaringizni aytib berdim.

en: This, my dear fellow, is in obedience to your wishes, for I am only too proud and happy to do anything I can for her.
uz: Bu, aziz do'stim, sizning xohishingizga bo'ysunishdir, chunki men u uchun qo'limdan kelganini qilishdan juda faxrlanaman va xursandman.

en: Van Helsing would, I know, do anything for me for a personal reason, so no matter on what ground he comes, we must accept his wishes.
uz: Van Helsing shaxsiy sabablarga ko'ra men uchun hamma narsani qiladi, shuning uchun u qanday sababga ko'ra kelsa ham, biz uning xohish-irodasini qabul qilishimiz kerak.

en: He is a seemingly arbitrary man, this is because he knows what he is talking about better than any one else.
uz: U ko'rinishicha o'zboshimchalik bilan harakat qiladigan odam, chunki u nima haqida gapirayotganini har kimdan yaxshiroq biladi.

en: He is a philosopher and a metaphysician, and one of the most advanced scientists of his day, and he has, I believe, an abso- lutely open mind.
uz: U falsafachi va metafizik va o'z davridagi eng ilg'or olimlardan biri bo'lib, o'z fikrlash tarziga mutlaqo ochiq bo'lgan.

en: This, with an iron nerve, a temper of the ice-brook, and indomitable resolution, self-command, and toleration exalted from virtues to blessings, and the kindliest and truest heart that beats, these form his equipment for the noble work that he is doing for mankind, work both in theory and practice, for his views are as wide as his all-embracing sympa- thy.
uz: Bu, temir g'azab, muz daryosining ruhi, va o'z-o'zidan ustun bo'lmaydigan qaror, o'z-o'zini boshqarish va barakalar uchun fazilatlardan yuqori ko'tarilgan tolerantlik, va uradigan eng mehribon va eng sodiq yurak bilan, u insoniyat uchun qilayotgan noyob ish uchun uning jihozlarini tashkil etadi, nazariya va amaliyotda ham ishlaydi, chunki uning nuqtai nazarlari uning hamma narsani qamrab oluvchi mehribonligi kabi kengdir.

en: I tell you these facts that you may know why I have such conﬁdence in him.
uz: Men sizga bu faktlarni aytib beraman, shunda nima uchun Unga ishonchim komilligini bilib olasiz.

en: I have asked him to come at once.
uz: Men unga darhol kelishini so'radim.

en: I shall see Miss Westenra tomorrow
uz: Ertaga Miss Westenra bilan uchrashaman.

en: She is to meet me at the Stores, so that I may not alarm her mother by too early a repetition of my call.
uz: U meni do'konlarda uchratishi kerak, shunda mening qo'ng'iroqimni takrorlash orqali onasini juda erta qo'rqitmayman.

en: Yours always. John Seward LETTER, ABRAHAM VAN HELSING, MD, DPh, D.
uz: Yours always.  John Seward LETTER, ABRAHAM VAN HELSING, MD, DPh, D.

en: LiT, ETC, ETC, TO DR.
uz: LiT, ETC, ETC, DRga.

en: My good Friend, When I received your letter I am already coming to you.
uz: Yaxshi do'stim, men sizning maktubingizni olganimda, oldingizga borganman.

en: By good for- tune I can leave just at once, without wrong to any of those who have trust- ed me.
uz: Yaxshilik uchun men o'zimga ishonadiganlarning hech biriga yomonlik qilmasdan, darhol ketishim mumkin.

en: Were fortune other, then it were bad for those who have trusted, for I come to my friend when he call me to aid those he holds dear.
uz: Bordi-yu, boshqa omad bo'lsa, bu ishonch hosil qilganlar uchun yomon bo'lardi, chunki do'stim menga yaqinlariga yordam berish uchun chaqirganda, men uning yoniga boraman.

en: Tell your friend that when that time you suck from my wound so swiftly the poison of the gangrene from that knife that our other friend, too nervous, let slip, you did more for him when he wants my aids and you call for them than all his great fortune could do.
uz: Do'stingizga aytingki, o'sha payt siz mening yaralarimdan gangren zaharini o'sha pichoqdan shunchalik tez sug'urgan edingizki, boshqa do'stimiz juda g'ayratli bo'lib, qochib ketadi.

en: But it is pleasure added to do for him, your friend, it is to you that I come.
uz: Ammo u uchun, do'stingiz uchun qilish katta zavqdir, chunki men sizga keldim.

en: Have near at hand, and please it so arrange that we may see the young lady not too late on tomorrow, for it is likely that I may have to return here that night.
