uz: Yaxshi bo'ling va keling, bu qizni ertaga kechroq ko'rmasligimiz uchun tartibga soling, chunki men shu kecha bu yerga qaytishim kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But if need be I shall come again in three days, and stay longer if it must.
uz: Ammo agar kerak bo'lsa, uch kundan keyin qaytib kelaman va agar kerak bo'lsa, ko'proq qolaman.

en: Till then goodbye, my friend John.
uz: O'shanda salom, do'stim Jon.

en: Van Helsing. LETTER, DR.
uz: Van Helsing.  LETTER, DR.

en: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 3 September My dear Art, Van Helsing has come and gone.
uz: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 3 sentabr My dear Art, Van Helsing keldi va ketdi.

en: He came on with me to Hillingham, and found that, by Lucy's discretion, her mother was lunching out, so that we were alone with her.
uz: U men bilan Hillinghamga bordi va Luisaning o'ylashicha, uning onasi kechki ovqatga ketayotganini bilib, biz u bilan yolg'iz qoldik.

en: Van Helsing made a very careful examination of the patient.
uz: Van Helsing bemorni juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

en: He is to re- port to me, and I shall advise you, for of course I was not present all the time.
uz: U menga hisobot beradi va men sizga maslahat beraman, chunki men, albatta, har doim ham u yerda bo'lmaganman.

en: He is, I fear, much concerned, but says he must think.
uz: Afsuski, u juda xavotirda, lekin o'ylash kerakligini aytadi.

en: When I told him of our friendship and how you trust to me in the matter, he said, `You must tell him all you think.
uz: Do'stligimiz va bu borada menga ishonishingizni aytib bersam, u: Siz unga o'zingizning fikringizni aytishingiz kerak, - dedi.

en: Tell him him what I think, if you can guess it, if you will.
uz: Agar bilsangiz, mening fikrimni unga ayting.

en: Nay, I am not jesting.
uz: Yo'q, men o'yin qilmayapman.

en: This is no jest, but life and death, perhaps more.' I asked what he meant by that, for he was very serious.
uz: Bu hazil emas, balki hayot va o'lim, ehtimol bundan ham ko'proqdir, deb so'radim, chunki u juda jiddiy edi.

en: This was when we had come back to town, and he was having a cup of tea before starting on his return to Amsterdam.
uz: Bu biz shaharga qaytib kelganimizda edi va u Amsterdamga qaytishdan oldin choy ichib o'tirgan edi.

en: He would not give me any further clue.
uz: U menga boshqa hech qanday izoh bermadi.

en: You must not be angry with me, Art, because his very reticence means that
uz: Menga g'azablanib qolmasliging kerak, Art, chunki uning o'ziga xos ehtiyotkorligi shuni anglatadiki

en: all his brains are working for her good.
uz: Uning barcha miyasi uning manfaatini ko'zlab ishlamoqda.

en: He will speak plainly enough when the time comes, be sure.
uz: Vaqt kelganda, u aniq gapiradi, shubhasiz.

en: So I told him I would simply write an account of our visit, just as if I were doing a descriptive special article for THE DAILY TELEGRAPH.
uz: Shunday qilib, men unga tashrifimiz haqida shunchaki hikoya yozishni aytdim, xuddi DAILY TELEGRAPH uchun maxsus maqola yozganim kabi.

en: He seemed not to notice, but remarked that the smuts of London were not quite so bad as they used to be when he was a student here.
uz: U buni payqamayotgandek tuyuldi, lekin Londondagi maydonlar u yerda talaba bo'lganida bo'lgani kabi yomon emasligini ta'kidladi.

en: I am to get his report tomorrow if he can possibly make it.
uz: Bordi-yu, agar u kelsa, ertaga uning hisobotiga ega bo'lishim kerak.

en: In any case I am to have a letter.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men xatga ega bo'lishim kerak.

en: Well, as to the visit, Lucy was more cheerful than on the day I ﬁrst saw her, and certainly looked better.
uz: Lusi tashrif haqida gap ketganda, men uni birinchi marta ko'rgan kunimdan ko'ra ko'proq quvonchli edi va albatta yaxshiroq ko'rinardi.

en: She had lost something of the ghastly look that so upset you, and her breathing was normal.
uz: U sizni juda xafa qilgan dahshatli ko'rinishning bir qismini yo'qotgan edi va uning nafas olish holati normal edi.

en: She was very sweet to the Professor (as she always is),and tried to make him feel at ease, though I could see the poor girl was making a hard struggle for it.
uz: U professorga juda mehribon bo'lgan (har doimgidek) va uni o'zini qulay his etishga harakat qilgan, garchi bu kambag'al qizning bu uchun juda ko'p kurashayotganini ko'rardim.

en: I believe Van Helsing saw it, too, for I saw the quick look under his bushy brows that I knew of old.
uz: Van Helsing ham buni ko'rgan deb o'ylayman, chunki men qadimda bilgan o'tkir ko'zlaridagi tezkor ko'rinishni ko'rdim.

en: Then he began to chat of all things except ourselves and diseases and with such an inﬁnite geniality that I could see poor Lucy's pretense of animation merge into reality.
uz: Keyin u o'zimiz va kasalliklardan tashqari barcha narsalar haqida suhbatlashishni boshladi va shu qadar cheksiz aql-idrok bilan, men kambag'al Lusiyning animatsiyaning haqiqatga aylanishini ko'rardim.

en: Then, without any seeming change, he brought the conversation gently round to his visit, and sauvely said, `My dear young miss, I have the so great pleasure because you are so much beloved.
uz: Keyin, hech qanday o'zgarishsiz, u suhbatni muloyimlik bilan o'z tashrifiga olib bordi va xotirjamlik bilan shunday dedi: Qizim, qizim, men sizdan juda ko'p mamnunman, chunki siz juda seviklisiz.

en: That is much, my dear, even were there that which I do not see.
uz: Bu juda ko'p, azizim, hatto men ko'rmagan narsa ham bor edi.

en: They told me you were down in the spirit, and that you were of a ghast- ly pale.
uz: Menga ruhingiz tushkunligi va qo'rqinchli bo'lishingiz haqida aytishdi.

en: To them I say Pouf! ' And he snapped his ﬁngers at me and went on.
uz: Men ularga Pouf! deb javob berdim va u menga barmoqlarini urib, davom etdi.

en: `But you and I shall show them how wrong they are.
uz: Ammo biz ikkovimiz ularga qanchalik noto'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatamiz.

en: How can he', and he pointed at me with the same look and gesture as that with which he pointed me out in his class, on, or rather after, a particular occasion which he never fails to remind me of, `know anything of a young ladies?
uz: Qanday qilib u menga o'z sinfida, yoki aniqrog'i, menga eslatishni hech qachon unutmagan muayyan bir hodisa paytida, o'zining ko'z va ishtiyoq bilan ko'rsatgan o'sha o'ziga o'xshash ko'rinish va ishtiyoq bilan ko'rsatadi?

en: He has his madmen to play with, and to bring them back to happiness, and to those that love them.
uz: U o'z aqldan ozganlari bilan o'ynash va ularni baxtga va ularni sevganlarga qaytarish uchun bor.

en: It is much to do, and, oh, but there are rewards in that we can bestow such happiness.
uz: Bu juda ko'p ish va, oh, lekin bunday baxtni berishda mukofotlar bor.

en: But the young ladies!
uz: Ammo yosh xonimlar!

en: He has no wife nor daughter, and the young do not tell themselves to the young, but to the old, like me, who have known so many sorrows and the causes of them.
uz: Uning xotini ham, qizi ham yo'q va yoshlar o'zlarini yoshlarga emas, balki men kabi ko'plab qayg'ularni va ularning sabablarini bilgan keksalarga aytishadi.

en: So, my dear, we will send him away to smoke the cigarette in the garden, whiles you and I have little talk all to ourselves.' I took the hint, and strolled about, and presently the professor came to the window and called me in.
uz: Shunday qilib, azizim, biz uni bog'da sigaret chekishga yuboramiz, siz va men faqat o'zimiz bilan gaplashmaymiz, - deb aytdim.

en: He looked grave, but said, ` I have made careful examination, but there is no functional cause.
uz: U jiddiy ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan, ammo: Men buni sinchkovlik bilan tekshirganman, ammo bu holatning hech qanday funksional sababi yo'q, - deb aytdi.

en: With you I agree that there has been much blood lost, it has been but is not.
uz: Men siz bilan rozi bo'lamanki, ko'p qon yo'qolgan, bo'lgan, lekin bo'lmagan.

en: But the conditions of her are in no way anemic.
uz: Ammo uning sharoitlari hech qachon anemik emas.

en: asked her to send me her maid, that I may ask just one or two questions, that so I may not chance to miss nothing.
uz: U menga xizmatkorini yuborishni so'radi, shunda men bir yoki ikkita savol berishim mumkin, shuning uchun hech narsa o'zimdan chetda qolmasligim mumkin.

en: I know well what she will say.
uz: Men uning nima deyishini yaxshi bilaman.

en: And yet there is cause.
uz: Shunga qaramay, sabab bor.

en: There is always cause for everything.
uz: Har bir narsaga doim sabab bor.

en: I must go back home and think.
uz: Uyga borib o'ylashim kerak.

en: You must send me the telegram every day, and if there be cause I shall come again.
uz: Siz menga har kuni telegramani yuborishingiz kerak va agar biron sabab bo'lsa, men qaytib kelaman.

en: The disease, for not to be well is a disease, inter- est me, and the sweet, young dear, she interest me too.
uz: Bemor bo'lish uchun kasallik - bu kasallik, deb o'ylayman men va sevimli, yosh sevganim meni ham qiziqtiradi.

en: She charm me, and for her, if not for you or disease, I come.' As I tell you, he would not say a word more, even when we were alone.
uz: U meni yoqtiradi va agar sen yoki kasallik bo'lmasa, men u uchun keldim. Senga aytamanki, u yolg'iz bo'lganimizda ham, bir so'z ham aytmasdi.

en: And so now, Art, you know all I know.
uz: Shunday qilib, endi, Art, sen men bilgan hamma narsani bilasan.

en: I shall keep stern watch.
uz: Men qattiq qo'riqchini saqlayman.

en: I trust your poor father is rallying.
uz: Sizning kambag'al otangiz ham yig'ilishlarga borishiga ishonaman.

en: It must be a terrible thing to you, my dear old fellow, to be placed in such a position between two people who are both so dear to you.
uz: Siz uchun juda dahshatli bo'lishi kerak, aziz keksa do'stim, siz uchun juda qadrli bo'lgan ikki kishi o'rtasida bunday vaziyatga tushib qolish.

en: I know your idea of duty to your father, and you are right to stick to it.
uz: Otamga bo'lgan burchingiz haqidagi tasavvuringizni bilaman va unga amal qilishingiz to'g'ri.

en: But if need be, I shall send you word to come at once to Lucy, so do not be over-anxious unless you hear from me. DR.
uz: Ammo agar kerak bo'lsa, men sizga darhol Lusiga kelishga xabar yuboraman, shuning uchun men xabar bermaguncha ortiqcha tashvishlanmang.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 4 September.—Zoophagous patient still keeps up our interest in him.
uz: SEWARDning 4 sentabrdagi kundaligi.Zoofag kasalligi bo'lgan bemor hali ham unga qiziqish ko'rsatmoqda.

en: He had only one outburst and that was yesterday at an unusual time.
uz: U faqatgina bir marta ko'tarildi va bu kecha noyob vaqtda bo'ldi.

en: Just before the stroke of noon he began to grow restless.
uz: Tushdan oldin u bezovta bo'lib o'sishni boshladi.

en: The attendant knew the symp- toms, and at once summoned aid.
uz: Xizmatchi simptomlarni biladi va darhol yordam so'radi.

en: Fortunately the men came at a run, and were just in time, for at the stroke of noon he became so violent that it took all their strength to hold him.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, bu kishilar tezroq kelib, o'z vaqtida kelishdi, chunki tush tushida u shunchalik zo'ravon bo'ldiki, uni ushlab turish uchun butun kuchlarini sarfladilar.

en: In about ﬁve minutes, however, he began to get more quiet,and ﬁnally sank into a sort of melancholy, in which state he has remained up to now.
uz: Ammo besh daqiqadan so'ng u yanada xotirjam bo'lib, nihoyat o'zining hozirgacha bo'lgan ahvolini o'zgartirgan melankoliyaga aylandi.

en: The attendant tells me that his screams whilst in the paroxysm were really appalling.
uz: Xizmatchi menga paroxizmda uning qichqiriqlari juda dahshatli ekanligini aytdi.

en: I found my hands full when I got in, attending to some of the other patients who were frightened by him.
uz: Men u yerga kirganimda, qo'llarim to'liq bo'lib, boshqa bemorlarga g'amxo'rlik qilardim, chunki ular undan qo'rqishgan edi.

en: Indeed, I can quite understand the effect, for the sounds disturbed even me, though I was some distance away.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men bu ta'sirni yaxshi tushunaman, chunki ovozlar biroz uzoqlikda bo'lganimda ham meni bezovta qildi.

en: It is now after the dinner hour of the asylum, and as yet my patient sits in a corner brooding, with a dull, sullen, woe-begone look in his face, which seems rather to indicate than to show something di- rectly.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda kasalxona ovqatlanish soatidan so'ng, bemorim bir burchada o'tirib, o'ylaydi, yuzida chiroyli, qayg'uli, qayg'u boshlangan ko'rinish bor, bu esa bir narsani aniq ko'rsatishdan ko'ra ko'proq ko'rsatadi.

en: I cannot quite understand it.
uz: Men buni to'liq tushunolmayman.

en: Later.—Another change in my patient.
uz: Keyinroq.Mening bemorimda yana bir o'zgarish.

en: At ﬁve o'clock I looked in on him, and found him seemingly as happy and contented as he used to be.
uz: Soat beshlarda men uni ko'rdim va u avvalgidek baxtli va qoniqarli bo'lganini ko'rdim.

en: He was catching ﬂies and eating them, and was keeping note of his capture by mak- ing nailmarks on the edge of the door between the ridges of padding.
uz: U o'z qo'lga olinganini eslab, tovuqlarni yeb yurgan va o'z qo'lga olinganini eshik chekkasida to'plamlar o'rtasidagi eshikning chekkasida to'plam belgilarini qo'yib kuzatgan.

en: When he saw me, he came over and apologized for his bad conduct, and asked me in a very humble, cringing way to be led back to his own room, and to have his notebook again.
uz: U meni ko'rganida, yaqinlashib, yomon xulq-atvori uchun kechirim so'radi va juda kamtarin, kamtarinlik ila o'z xonasiga qaytib borishni va yana yozuvchisiga ega bo'lishimni so'radi.

en: I thought it well to humour him, so he is back in his
uz: Men uni o'yin-kulgi bilan ta'minlash uchun yaxshi deb o'yladim, shuning uchun u o'z vazifasini bajarishga qaytdi.

en: room with the window open.
uz: Oyna ochilgan xonadir.

en: He has the sugar of his tea spread out on the window sill, and is reaping quite a harvest of ﬂies.
uz: U o'z choyining shakarini deraza ustunida tarqatadi va u juda ko'p o't o'rim-yig'im o'tkazib kelmoqda.

en: He is not now eating them, but putting them into a box, as of old, and is already examining the corners of his room to ﬁnd a spider.
uz: U endi ularni yemaydi, balki qadimgi kabi ularni qutiqqa joylashtiradi va o'z xonasi burchaklarini ko'rib, o'z ustiga o'rinbosar topmoqda.

en: I tried to get him to talk about the past few days, for any clue to his thoughts would be of immense help to me, but he would not rise.
uz: Men uni so'nggi kunlar haqida gapirishga harakat qildim, chunki uning fikrlari haqida biron bir iz iz qo'shilgan bo'lsa, menga katta yordam beradi, lekin u o'rnidan turmaydi.

en: For a moment or two he looked very sad, and said in a sort of far away voice, as though saying it rather to himself than to me.
uz: Bir-ikki daqiqa davomida u juda xafa bo'lib, o'ziga emas, balki menga aytgandek, uzoqroq ovoz bilan gapirdi.

en: No hope for me now unless I do it myself! Then suddenly turning to me in a resolute way, he said,Doctor, won't you be very good to me and let me have a little more sugar?
uz: O'zim uni o'zim qilmagunimcha, men uchun hech qanday umid yo'q! - dedi u, birdan menga qat'iylik bilan qarab: Doktor, menga juda yaxshilik qilib, biroz ko'proq shakar ichishga ruxsat bermayapsizmi?

en: I think it would be very good for me. And the ﬂies? I said.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu men uchun juda yaxshi bo'ladi. - Va uchuqlar? - dedim men.

en: The ﬂies like it, too, and I like the ﬂies, therefore I like it.And there are people who know so little as to think that madmen do not argue.
uz: Ularga ham yoqadi va men ularni yaxshi ko'raman, shuning uchun ham yaxshi ko'raman.Va odamlarning ba'zilari juda kam bilimga ega bo'lib, g'alatilar bahslashmaydi deb o'ylashadi.

en: I procured him a double supply, and left him as happy a man as, I suppose, any in the world.
uz: Men unga ikki marta ta'minot to'ldirib, uni dunyodagi eng baxtli odamga aylantirdim.

en: I wish I could fathom his mind.
uz: O'zim uning fikrini tushuna olaman.

en: Midnight.—Another change in him.
uz: Yoruq.Unda yana bir o'zgarish bor.

en: I had been to see Miss Westenra, whom I found much better, and had just returned, and was standing at our own gate looking at the sunset, when once more I heard him yelling.
uz: Men ancha yaxshi ko'rgan Miss Westenra bilan uchrashgan edim va u yaqinda qaytib kelgan edi va o'z darvozalarimiz oldida quyosh botishayotganini ko'rib turgan edi, ammo yana bir bor uning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: As his room is on this side of the house, I could hear it better than in the morning.
uz: Uning xonasi uyning shu tomonida bo'lgani uchun, men uni ertalabki paytlardan yaxshiroq eshitardim.

en: It was a shock to me to turn from the wonderful smoky beauty of a sunset over London, with its lurid lights and inky shadows and all the marvellous tints that come on foul clouds even as on foul water, and to realize all the grim sternness of my own cold stone building, with its wealth of breathing misery, and my own desolate heart to endure it all.
uz: Londonda quyosh botishining ajoyib tutli go'zalligidan, uning qo'rqinchli nurlari va qora qora ko'klari bilan va hatto yomon suvda bo'lgan yomon bulutlarda paydo bo'lgan barcha ajoyib ranglardan voz kechib, o'zimning sovuq tosh binosining, nafas oladigan qashshoqlikning boyligi va bularning barchasini chidash uchun o'zimning chiroyli yuragimning qattiqligini anglab qolish men uchun ajablanarli edi.

en: I reached him just as the sun was going down, and from his window saw the red disc sink.
uz: Quyosh botayotgan paytda men unga yetib keldim va uning derazasidan qizil diskni ko'rdim.

en: As it sank he became less and less frenzied, and just as it dipped he slid from the hands that held him, an inert mass, on the ﬂoor.
uz: U qulab ketayotganda, u o'z-o'zidan kamroq g'azablanardi va qulab ketayotganda uni ushlab turgan qo'llardan, yer ustida yonib ketayotgan inert massadan qulab ketdi.

en: It is wonderful, however, what intellectual recuperative power lunatics have, for within a few minutes he stood up quite calmly and looked around him.
uz: Biroq, aqldan ozganlarning aqliy tiklanish kuchi ajoyib, chunki bir necha daqiqadan so'ng u juda tinch turib, atrofini ko'rdi.

en: I signalled to the atten- dants not to hold him, for I was anxious to see what he would do.
uz: Men uni ushlab qolmaslik uchun o'z navbatida o'qituvchilarga ishora qildim, chunki u nima qilishini ko'rishni xohlardim.

en: He went straight over to the window and brushed out the crumbs of sugar.
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri derazaga borib, mayda shakarlarni chiqarib tashladi.

en: Then he took his ﬂy box, and emptied it outside, and threw away the box.
uz: Keyin u o'zining uchuvchi qutisini olib, tashqariga chiqardi va qutisini tashladi.

en: Then he shut the window, and crossing over, sat down on his bed.
uz: Keyin u darcha yopib, o'tib o'tirdi va o'z yotoqxonasiga o'tirdi.

en: All this surprised me, so I asked him,Are you going to keep ﬂies any more? No, said he.
uz: Bularning barchasi meni hayratda qoldirdi, shuning uchun men undan so'radim: Siz endi o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz

en: I am sick of all that rubbish! He certainly is a wonderful- ly interesting study.
uz: Men bu axlatdan bezovta bo'ldim! - bu, albatta, ajoyib va qiziqarli tadqiqot.

en: I wish I could get some glimpse of his mind or of the
uz: O'zim uning ongini yoki o'z fikrini bir tasavvur qilib ko'rishni istardim.

en: cause of his sudden passion.
uz: O'zining to'satdan o'ziga xos ishtiyoqining sababi.

en: There may be a clue after all, if we can ﬁnd why today his paroxysms came on at high noon and at sunset.
uz: Axir, agar bugungi kunda uning paroxizmlari kunning eng yuqori tushida va quyosh botganda qandaydir sababga ega bo'lsa, bu haqda aniq ma'lumotga ega bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: Can it be that there is a malign inﬂuence of the sun at periods which affects certain natures, as at times the moon does others?
uz: Ba'zi vaqtlarda quyoshning zararli ta'siri, ba'zi tabiatlarga ta'sir qiladigan davrlar bo'lishi mumkinmi, ba'zida oy boshqalarga ta'sir qilishi mumkinmi?

en: SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 4 September.—Patient still better today. TELEGRAM, SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 5 September.—Patient greatly improved.
uz: SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 4 sentabr.Patient hali ham bugun yaxshiroq. Telogram, SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 5 sentabr.Patient sezilarli darajada yaxshilandi.

en: Good appetite, sleeps natural- ly, good spirits, color coming back. TELEGRAM, SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 6 September.—Terrible change for the worse.
uz: Yaxshi ochko'zlik, tabiiy uyqu, yaxshi ruh, rang qaytib keladi. - TELEGRAM, SEWARD, LONDON, TO VAN HELSING, AMSTERDAM 6 sentabr.Xarobat uchun dahshatli o'zgarishlar.

en: Do not lose an hour.
uz: Bir soat ham yo'qotmang.

en: I hold over telegram to Holmwood till have seen you.
uz: Sizni ko'rmagunimcha Holmvudga telegram saqlayman.

en: CHAPTER 10 LETTER, DR.
uz: 10 - bob XATIR, DR.

en: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 6 September My dear Art, My news today is not so good.
uz: ARTHUR HOLMWOOD 6 sentabr Mening aziz san'atkorim, Bugungi yangiliklarim shunchalik yaxshi emas.

en: Lucy this morning had gone back a bit.
uz: Lucy bu ertalab biroz orqaga qaytdi.

en: There is, however, one good thing which has arisen from it.
uz: Biroq, undan bir yaxshi narsa kelib chiqqan.

en: Westenra was naturally anxious concerning Lucy, and has consulted me professional- ly about her.
uz: Vestenra Luzi haqida g'amxo'rlik qilib, professional ravishda menga bu haqda maslahat berdi.

en: I took advantage of the opportunity, and told her that my old master, Van Helsing, the great specialist, was coming to stay with me, and that I would put her in his charge conjointly with myself.
uz: Men fursatdan foydalanib, eski ustaim, buyuk mutaxassis Van Helsingning o'zim bilan birga uning qaramog'iga o'tirishga kelishini va uni o'zim bilan birga uning qaramog'iga qo'yishimni aytdim.

en: So now we can come and go without alarming her unduly, for a shock to her would mean sudden death, and this, in Lucy's weak condition, might be disastrous to her.
uz: Shunday qilib, hozir biz uni ortiqcha xavotirga solmasdan kelib-ketishimiz mumkin, chunki uning uchun shok toʻsatdan oʻlimni anglatadi va bu, Lusiyaning zaif ahvolida, u uchun halokatli boʻlishi mumkin.

en: We are hedged in with difﬁculties, all of us, my poor fellow, but, please God, we shall come through them all right.
uz: Biz hammamiz qiyinchiliklarga duchormiz, ey kambag'al birodarim, lekin, Xudo xohlasa, biz ularni yengamiz.

en: If any need I shall write, so that, if you do not hear from me, take it for granted that I am simply waiting for news, In haste, Yours ever, John Seward DR.
uz: Agar biror narsa kerak bo'lsa, men yozaman, agar siz mendan xabar olmagan bo'lsangiz, men shunchaki yangiliklarni kutyapman, deb o'ylashingiz kerak, Yours ever, John Seward DR.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 7 September.—The ﬁrst thing Van Helsing said to me when we met at Liverpool Street was, Have you said anything to our young friend, to lover of her? No, I said.
uz: Sewardning 7 sentabrdagi kundaligi.Liverpul ko'chasida uchrashganimizda Van Helsing menga birinchi bo'lib: Siz yosh do'stimizga, uning sevgilisiga biron narsa aytdingizmi? - deb aytdi. Men: Yo'q, - dedim.

en: I waited till I had seen you, as I said in my telegram.
uz: Men telegrammimda aytganimdek, sizni ko'rmaguncha kutdim.

en: I wrote him a letter simply telling him that you were coming, as Miss West- enra was not so well, and that I should let him know if need be. Right, my friend, he said.
uz: Men unga xat yozganimda, siz kelyapsiz, chunki Miss West-enra shunchalik sog'lom emas va agar kerak bo'lsa, unga xabar berishim kerakligini aytdim.

en: Better he not know as yet.
uz: U hali bilmasligi yaxshiroqdir.

en: Per- haps he will never know.
uz: Ehtimol, u hech qachon bilmaydi.

en: I pray so, but if it be needed, then he shall know
uz: Men shunday ibodat qilaman, lekin agar kerak bo'lsa, u buni bilib oladi.

en: And, my good friend John, let me caution you.
uz: Yaxshi do'stim Jon, sizga ogohlantirish beraman.

en: You deal with the mad- men.
uz: Siz aqldan ozgan kishilar bilan shug'ullanasiz.

en: All men are mad in some way or the other, and inasmuch as you deal discreetly with your madmen, so deal with God's madmen too, the rest of the world.
uz: Barcha odamlar bir yo'l bilan yoki boshqacha tarzda aqldan ozgan, va agar siz o'z aqldan ozgan odamlaringiz bilan noaniq munosabatda bo'lsangiz, Xudoning aqldan ozgan odamlari bilan ham munosabatda bo'ling.

en: You tell not your madmen what you do nor why you do it.
uz: Siz o'z aqldan ozgan odamlarga nima qilayotganingizni va nima uchun qilayotganingizni aytmaysiz.

en: You tell them not what you think.
uz: Siz ularga o'zingizning fikringizni aytmaysiz.

en: So you shall keep knowledge in its place, where it may rest, where it may gather its kind around it and breed.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz bilimni o'z joyida saqlaysiz, u o'rinli joyda dam oladi, atrofida o'z turini to'plab, ko'payishi mumkin.

en: You and I shall keep as yet what we know here, and here. He touched me on the heart and on the forehead, and then touched himself the same way.
uz: Siz va men bu yerda ham, bu yerda ham bilganlarimizni saqlab turamiz, - dedi u menga yurak va oldinga qo'l tegizdi va o'ziga ham xuddi shunday qo'l tegizdi.

en: I have for myself thoughts at the present.
uz: Men hozirda o'zim uchun o'ylayman.

en: Later I shall unfold to you. Why not now? I asked.
uz: Keyinroq sizga tushuntiraman. - Nega endi emas? - deb so'radim men.

en: It may do some good.
uz: Bu yaxshi samara keltirishi mumkin.

en: We may arrive at some decision.He looked at me and said,My friend John, when the corn is grown, even before it has ripened, while the milk of its mother earth is in him, and the sunshine has not yet begun to paint him with his gold, the hus- bandman he pull the ear and rub him between his rough hands, and blow away the green chaff, and say to you, 'Look!
uz: U menga qarab dedi: Dostim Jon, bug'doy o'sib, hatto o'sib kelmasidan oldin, ona yerning sutini o'z ichiga olganida va quyosh nurlari hali uni oltin bilan bo'yashni boshlamaganida, u qulog'ini tortib, qo'llari o'rtog'iga aralashtirib, yashil cho'pni puflaydi va sizga: Qarang!

en: He's good corn, he will make a good crop when the time comes.'  I did not see the application and told him so.
uz: U yaxshi momaqaldir, o'z vaqtida yaxshi hosil beradi.'  Men ilovani ko'rmadim va unga shunday aytdim.

en: For reply he reached over and took my ear in his hand and pulled it playfully, as he used long ago to do at lectures, and said, The good husbandman tell you so then because he knows, but not till then.
uz: Javob uchun u qo'lidan quloqimni olib, o'yinchilik bilan o'ynashdi va uzoq vaqt oldin o'qishda qilganidek: Yaxshi dehqon sizga buni aytadi, chunki u biladir, lekin o'sha paytgacha emas.

en: But you do not ﬁnd the good husbandman dig up his planted corn to see if he grow.
uz: Ammo yaxshi dehqon o'z ekilgan donini qazib, o'sishini ko'rish uchun topolmaydi.

en: That is for the children who play at hus- bandry, and not for those who take it as of the work of their life.
uz: Bu hus-bandry o'ynaydigan bolalar uchun va uni o'z hayotining ishi deb bilganlar uchun emas.

en: See you now, friend John?
uz: Endi uchrashamizmi, do'stim Jon?

en: I have sown my corn, and Nature has her work to do in making it sprout, if he sprout at all, there's some promise, and I wait till the ear begins to swell. He broke off, for he evidently saw that I understood.
uz: Men donimni ekdim va tabiat uni ko'paytirishda o'z ishini bajarishi kerak, agar u hech qachon ko'paysa, ba'zi va'dalar bor va men quloq puchga tushguncha kutaman.

en: Then he went on gravely, You were always a careful student, and your case book was ever more full than the rest.
uz: Keyin u jiddiy davom etdi: Siz har doim diqqatli o'quvchi bo'lgansiz va sizning ish daftaringiz har doim boshqalardan ko'ra to'laroq edi.

en: And I trust that good habit have not fail.
uz: Shu kabi yaxshi odatlar ham muvaffaqiyatsiz qolmaganligiga ishonaman.

en: Remember, my friend, that knowledge is stronger than memory, and we should not trust the weaker.
uz: Yodingizda bo'lsin, do'stim, bilim xotiraga qaraganda kuchliroq va biz zaiflarga ishonmasligimiz kerak.

en: Even if you have not kept the good practice, let me tell you that this case of our dear miss is one that may be, mind, I say may be, of such interest to us and others that all the rest may not make him kick the beam, as your people say.
uz: Agar siz yaxshi amaliyotga rioya qilmagan bo'lsangiz ham, sizga aytamanki, aziz xotinimizning bu ishi biz va boshqalarni qiziqtirishi mumkin bo'lgan, deb aytaman, chunki qolgan narsalar uni o'zingizning xalqingiz aytgandek o'ldirmasligi mumkin.

en: Take then good note of it.
uz: Keyin buni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqing.

en: Nothing is too small.
uz: Hech narsa juda kichik emas.

en: I counsel you, put down in record even your doubts and surmises.
uz: Sizga maslahat beraman, hatto shubha va gumonlaringizni yozib qo'ying.

en: Hereafter it may be of interest to you to see how true you guess.
uz: Bundan keyin sizning tasavvurlaringiz qanchalik to'g'ri ekanligini ko'rish sizni qiziqtirishi mumkin.

en: We learn from failure, not from success! When I described Lucy's symptoms, the same as before, but inﬁnitely more marked, he looked very grave, but said nothing.
uz: Muvaffaqiyatdan emas, muvaffaqiyatdan o'rganamiz! - deb aytganimda, Lusiyaning alomatlari avvalgidek, lekin cheksiz darajada aniqroq edi, u juda jiddiy ko'rinardi, lekin hech narsa aytmadi.

en: bag in which were many instruments and drugs, the ghastly paraphernalia of our beneﬁcial trade, as he once called, in one of his lectures, the equip- ment of a professor of the healing craft.
uz: Uning ichida ko'plab asbob-uskunalar va dori-darmonlar bor edi, bu bizning foydali savdogarligimizning dahshatli jihozlari edi, chunki u bir marta o'z ma'ruzalarida shifo kasblarining professori jihozlarini chaqirgan.

en: When we were shown in, Mrs.
uz: Bizni ko'rsatganida, xonim Xalifa

en: She was alarmed, but not nearly so much as I expected to ﬁnd her.
uz: U xavotirga tushdi, lekin men uni topishni kutganimdek emas edi.

en: Nature in one of her beneﬁ- cient moods has ordained that even death has some antidote to its own ter- rors.
uz: Tabiat o'z manfaatli ruhlaridan birida hatto o'limning o'z terrorlariga qarshi bir xil dori borligini belgilab qo'ygan.

en: Here, in a case where any shock may prove fatal, matters are so or- dered that, from some cause or other, the things not personal, even the terri- ble change in her daughter to whom she is so attached, do not seem to reach her.
uz: Bu erda, har qanday shok o'ta halokatli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holatda, vaziyat shunday tartibga solinadiki, biron-bir sababga ko'ra, shaxsiy bo'lmagan narsalar, hatto u juda yaqin bo'lgan qizidagi katta o'zgarish ham unga yetib kelmaydi.

en: It is something like the way dame Nature gathers round a foreign body an envelope of some insensitive tissue which can protect from evil that which it would otherwise harm by contact.
uz: Bu tabiat xonimning o'zga tanani o'rab olib, zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan zararni yomonlikdan himoya qiladigan tuxumsiz to'qimalarni to'plashi bilan o'xshaydi.

en: If this be an ordered selﬁshness, then we should pause before we condemn any one for the vice of egoism, for there may be deeper root for its causes than we have knowledge of.
uz: Agar bu tartibdagi xudbinlik bo'lsa, unda biz hech kimni xudbinlik yomonliklari uchun hukm qilishdan oldin to'xtab turishimiz kerak, chunki uning sabablari biz bilmaganidan chuqurroq ildiz bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I used my knowledge of this phase of spiritual pathology, and set down a rule that she should not be present with Lucy, or think of her illness more than was absolutely required.
uz: Ruhiy patologiya jarayonining ushbu bosqichini bilib olganimdan foydalanib, u Luisi bilan birga bo'lmasligi yoki kasalligi haqida zarur bo'lganidan ko'proq o'ylamasligi kerak bo'lgan qoidani belgiladim.

en: She assented readily, so readily that I saw again the hand of Nature ﬁghting for life.
uz: O'zi rozi bo'ldi, shunchalik rozi bo'ldiki, tabiatning hayot uchun kurashayotgan qo'lini yana ko'rdim.

en: Van Helsing and I were shown up to Lucy's room.
uz: Van Helsing va men Lucy xonasiga yetib bordik.

en: If I was shocked when I saw her yesterday, I was horriﬁed when I saw her today.
uz: Agar men uni kecha ko'rganimda hayron bo'lgan bo'lsam, bugun uni ko'rganimda qo'rqdim.

en: She was ghastly, chalkily pale.
uz: U dahshatli, chalkily pal edi.

en: The red seemed to have gone even from her lips and gums, and the bones of her face stood out prominently.
uz: Qizilligi hatto uning og'izlari va g'izlaridan ham chiqib ketganiga o'xshaydi va yuzidagi suyaklar alohida ko'rinadi.

en: Her breathing was painful to see or hear.
uz: Uning nafas olishini ko'rish yoki eshitish og'riqli edi.

en: Van Helsing's face grew set as marble, and his eyebrows converged till they almost touched over his nose.
uz: Van Helsingning yuzi marmorga o'xshaydigan bo'lib o'sdi va uning ko'z burchaklari uning burchasiga yaqinlashishiga qadar yaqinlashdi.

en: Lucy lay motionless, and did not seem to have strength to speak, so for a while we were all silent.
uz: Lusi harakatsiz yotgan edi va gapirish uchun kuchga ega bo'lmagandek ko'rinardi, shuning uchun bir muncha vaqt hammamiz sukut saqladik.

en: Then Van Helsing beckoned to me, and we went gently out of the room.
uz: Keyin Van Helsing menga imo-ishora qildi va biz xonadan asta-sekin chiqib ketdik.

en: The instant we had closed the door he stepped quickly along the passage to the next door, which was open.
uz: Biz eshikni yopganimizdan so'ng, u tezda yonidagi eshikga o'tadi, u ochiq edi.

en: Then he pulled me quickly in with him and closed the door.
uz: Keyin meni tezda o'zi bilan birga olib kirdi va eshikni yopdi.

en: This is dread- ful.
uz: Bu juda dahshatli.

en: There is not time to be lost.
uz: Yo'qolish uchun vaqt yo'q.

en: She will die for sheer want of blood to keep the heart's action as it should be.
uz: U yurak harakatini to'g'ri saqlab qolish uchun qon yetishmasligi tufayli o'ladi.

en: There must be a transfusion of blood at once.
uz: Qon transfutsiyasi darhol amalga oshirilishi kerak.

en: Is it you or me? I am younger and stronger, Professor.
uz: Sizmi yoki menmi? - Men yoshroq va kuchliroqman, professor.

en: It must be me. Then get ready at once.
uz: O'zim bo'lishi kerak. O'shanda darhol tayyorlaning.

en: I will bring up my bag.
uz: Men sumkamni ko'taraman.

en: I am prepared. I went downstairs with him, and as we were going there was a knock at the hall door.
uz: Men tayyorman. Men u bilan pastga tushdim va ketayotganimizda, chodir eshigini taqillatdi.

en: When we reached the hall, the maid had just opened the door,
uz: Zalga yetib kelganimizda, xizmatkor ayol eshikni ochgan edi.

en: and Arthur was stepping quickly in.
uz: Artur tezda kirib keldi.

en: He rushed up to me, saying in an eager whisper, Jack, I was so anxious.
uz: U menga yaqinlashib, g'ayrat bilan shoshib: Jack, men juda tashvishlanardim.

en: I read between the lines of your letter, and have been in an agony.
uz: Men sizning maktubingizning satrlari orasidan o'qib, azob chekdim.

en: The dad was better, so I ran down here to see for myself.
uz: O'g'lim yaxshiroq edi, shuning uchun o'zim ko'rib chiqish uchun bu yerga yugurdim.

en: Is not that gentleman Dr.
uz: Bu gentleman Dr. emasmi?

en: I am so thankful to you, sir, for coming. When ﬁrst the Professor's eye had lit upon him, he had been angry at his interruption at such a time, but now, as he took in his stalwart proportions and recognized the strong young manhood which seemed to emanate from him, his eyes gleamed.
uz: Sizga kelganingiz uchun juda minnatdorman, xonim.Professorning ko'zi unga birinchi bor yorqin ko'ringanda, u bunday vaqtda uning keskin keskinligi uchun g'azablangan edi, ammo endi u o'z mustahkam proporsiyalarini qabul qilib, o'zidan paydo bo'lgan kuchli yoshlikni taniganida, uning ko'zlari yorqin ko'rindi.

en: Without a pause he said to him as he held out his hand, Sir, you have come in time.
uz: U biroz to'xtamasdan unga qo'lini uzatgan holda: Agar shunday bo'lsa, Hazrat, o'z vaqtida keldingiz.

en: You are the lover of our dear miss.
uz: Siz aziz xonimimizning seviklisiz.

en: She is bad, very, very bad.
uz: U yomon, juda, juda yomon.

en: Nay, my child, do not go like that.For he suddenly grew pale and sat down in a chair almost fainting.
uz: Yo'q, farzandim, bunday yo'l tutma.U birdan o'zidan oqib, o'tirgan o'rindiqga o'tirdi va deyarli baytildi.

en: You are to help her.
uz: Siz unga yordam berishingiz kerak.

en: You can do more than any that live, and your courage is your best help. What can I do? asked Arthur hoarsely.
uz: Siz hayotda yashaydigan har kimdan ko'ra ko'proq narsani qila olasiz va sizning jasoratingiz eng yaxshi yordamchingizdir. - Men nima qilishim mumkin? - deb so'radi Artur qichqirgancha.

en: Tell me, and I shall do it.
uz: Menga ayting, men buni qilaman.

en: My life is hers' and I would give the last drop of blood in my body for her. The Professor has a strongly humorous side, and I could from old knowl- edge detect a trace of its origin in his answer.
uz: Mening hayotim uning hayotidir va men uning uchun tanamning so'nggi tomchi qonini berardim.Professorning juda kulgili tomoni bor va men uning javobida uning kelib chiqishi izini eski bilimdan aniqlay olaman.

en: My young sir, I do not ask so much as that, not the last! What shall I do? There was ﬁre in his eyes, and his open nostrils quiv- ered with intent.
uz: Yigit sir, men bu qadar so'ramayman, so'nggi emas! Men nima qilaman? - deb so'raganida uning ko'zlarida olov bor edi va uning ochilgan burun g'ovurlari niyat bilan qichqirgan edi.

en: Van Helsing slapped him on the shoulder.
uz: Van Helsing uni yelkasiga urdi.

en: You are a man, and it is a man we want.
uz: Siz erkaksiz va biz uni xohlaymiz.

en: You are better than me, better than my friend John. Arthur looked bewildered, and the Professor went on by explaining in a kindly way.
uz: Sen mendan yaxshiroqsan, do'stim Jondan ham yaxshiroqsan. Artur g'alati ko'rinishga ega edi, professor esa o'z so'zlariga mehr ila javob berdi.

en: Young miss is bad, very bad.
uz: Young miss is bad, very bad.

en: She wants blood, and blood she must have or die.
uz: U qonni xohlaydi va qon bo'lishi kerak yoki o'lishi kerak.

en: My friend John and I have consulted, and we are about to perform what we call transfusion of blood, to transfer from full veins of one to the empty veins which pine for him.
uz: Do'stim Jon bilan maslahatlashib oldik va biz qon transfuziyasi deb ataladigan ishni amalga oshirishni rejalashtiryapmiz, ya'ni uning to'liq damarlaridan uni orzu qiladigan bo'sh damarlarga o'tkazish.

en: John was to give his blood, as he is the more young and strong than me.—Here Arthur took my hand and wrung it hard in silence.—But now you are here, you are more good than us, old or young, who toil much in the world of thought.
uz: Jon o'z qonini berishi kerak edi, chunki u mendan yoshroq va kuchliroqdir.Mana Artur qo'limdan ushlab, sukut saqlashda qattiq urdi.Ammo endi siz bu yerdasiz, siz bizga qaraganda ko'proq yaxshisiz, yosh yoki keksa, biz fikrlash dunyosida ko'p mehnat qilamiz.

en: Our nerves are not so calm and our blood so bright than yours! Arthur turned to him and said, If you only knew how gladly I would die for her you would understand …  He stopped with a sort of choke in his voice.
uz: Bizning g'azablarimiz sizning qoningizdan ham ko'ra tinch emas va qonimiz sizning qoningizdan ham ko'ra yorqin emas! - dedi Artur unga qarab: Agar siz uning uchun o'lishga qanchalik tayyor ekanimni bilsangiz, tushunarsiz... - dedi u so'zidagi qo'rqinch bilan to'xtadi.

en: Good boy! said Van Helsing.
uz: Yaxshi yigit! - dedi Van Helsing.

en: In the not-so-far-off you will be happy that you have done all for her you love.
uz: O'sha paytlarda siz sevgan ayol uchun hamma narsani qilganingizdan xursand bo'lasiz.

en: Come now and be silent.
uz: Endi kelinglar va sukut saqlanglar.

en: You shall kiss her once before it is done, but then you must go, and you must leave at my sign.
uz: Bu ishdan oldin uni bir marta o'pishingiz kerak, lekin keyin siz ketishingiz kerak va mening ko'rsatishimga ko'ra ketishingiz kerak.

en: Say no word to Madame.
uz: Xonimga hech narsa aytmang.

en: You know how it is with her.
uz: U bilan nima sodir bo'layotganini bilasiz.

en: There must be no shock, any knowledge of this would be one.
uz: Shok bo'lmasligi kerak, bu haqda har qanday ma'lumot bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Come! We all went up to Lucy's room.
uz: Kelinglar! - deb, barchamiz Lusiyning xonasiga bordik.

en: Arthur by direction remained outside.
uz: Arthur yo'nalishda tashqariga chiqdi.

en: Lucy turned her head and looked at us, but said nothing.
uz: Lusi boshini o'zgartirib, bizga qaradi, lekin hech narsa aytmaydi.

en: She was not asleep, but she was simply too weak to make the effort.
uz: U uxlamagan, lekin u harakat qilish uchun juda zaif edi.

en: Her eyes spoke to us, that was all.
uz: Uning ko'zlari bizga gapirdi, shu hammasi.

en: Van Helsing took some things from his bag and laid them on a little table out of sight.
uz: Van Helsing sumkasidan ba'zi narsalarni olib, ko'rinmas bir stol ustiga qo'ydi.

en: Then he mixed a narcotic, and coming over to the bed, said cheerily, Now, little miss, here is your medicine.
uz: Keyin u narkotik moddalarni aralashtirib, yotoqqa yaqinlashib, xursandchilik bilan dedi: Hndi, kichik xonim, bu sizning dori-darmoningiz.

en: Drink it off, like a good child.
uz: Yaxshi bola kabi iching.

en: See, I lift you so that to swallow is easy.
uz: Mana, men seni yutib yuborish oson bo'lishi uchun ko'tarib turaman.

en: Yes. She had made the ef- fort with success.
uz: Ha.  - deb so'zlagan edi u. U ef-fortni muvaffaqiyatli bosib o'tgan edi.

en: It astonished me how long the drug took to act.
uz: Bu dori qancha vaqt ishlaydi, deb hayron qoldim.

en: This, in fact, marked the extent of her weakness.
uz: Aslida, bu uning zaifligini ko'rsatdi.

en: The time seemed endless until sleep began to ﬂicker in her eyelids.
uz: Uning ko'z o'nglarida uyqu ko'tarilguncha vaqt uzluksiz ko'rinardi.

en: At last, however, the narcotic began to manifest its potency, and she fell into a deep sleep.
uz: Biroq, nihoyat narkotik o'z kuchini namoyon qila boshladi va u chuqur uyquga tushdi.

en: When the Professor was satisﬁed, he called Arthur into the room, and bade him strip off his coat.
uz: Professor rozi bo'lganida, Arturni xonaniga chaqirib, kiyimini yechib tashlashni buyurdi.

en: Then he added, You may take that one little kiss whiles I bring over the table.
uz: Keyin u qo'shimcha qilib dedi: Men stol ustiga olib keladigan birgina o'pishni qabul qila olasiz.

en: Friend John, help to me! So neither of us looked whilst he bent over her.
uz: Do'st John, menga yordam ber! - deb so'raganida, hech birimiz uning ustiga qarab turmadik.

en: Van Helsing, turning to me, said, He is so young and strong, and of blood so pure that we need not deﬁbrinate it. Then with swiftness, but with absolute method, Van Helsing performed the operation.
uz: Van Helsing menga qarab: U shunchalik yosh va kuchli, qonlari shunchalik toza, uni defibrinatsiya qilishning hojati yo'q, - dedi.

en: As the transfusion went on, something like life seemed to come back to poor Lucy's cheeks, and through Arthur's growing pallor the joy of his face seemed absolutely to shine.
uz: Transfutsiyaning davom etishi bilan kambag'al Lusiyning yig'inlariga hayotga o'xshash narsa qaytdi va Arturning ko'payib borayotgan bo'shashligi tufayli uning yuzidagi quvonch mutlaqo yorqin ko'rindi.

en: After a bit I began to grow anx- ious, for the loss of blood was telling on Arthur, strong man as he was.
uz: Bir ozdan keyin men g'alati bo'lib ketdim, chunki qon yo'qotib ketish Arturga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi, chunki u kuchli odam edi.

en: It gave me an idea of what a terrible strain Lucy's system must have under- gone that what weakened Arthur only partially restored her.
uz: Bu menga Lusiyaning tizimida qanday dahshatli muammolar borligini tushunishga yordam berdi, chunki Arturni zaiflashtirgan narsa uni qisman tikladi.

en: But the Professor's face was set, and he stood watch in hand, and with his eyes ﬁxed now on the patient and now on Arthur.
uz: Ammo professorning yuzi o'rnagan edi va u qo'lida qo'riqchi bo'lib, ko'zlari hozir bemorga, endi esa Arturga qaratilgan edi.

en: I could hear my own heart beat.
uz: O'z yuragim urishini eshitardim.

en: Presently, he said in a soft voice, Do not stir an instant.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda u yengil ovoz bilan shunday dedi: Bir daqiqaga harakat qilmang.

en: I will look to her. When all was over, I could see how much Arthur was weakened.
uz: Men unga qarab turaman. Bularning hammasi tugaganida, Arturning qanchalik zaiflashganini ko'rardim.

en: I dressed the wound and took his arm to bring him away, when Van Helsing spoke without turning round, the man seems to have eyes in the back of his
uz: Men jarohatni kiyib, uni olib ketish uchun uning qo'lini ushlab oldim, Van Helsing aylanmasdan gapirganida, odamning ko'zlari uning orqasida ko'rinadi.

en: head,The brave lover, I think, deserve another kiss, which he shall have presently. And as he had now ﬁnished his operation, he adjusted the pillow to the patient's head.
uz: Dabarli sevgan kishi, menimcha, boshqa bir o'pishga loyiq, hozirda u o'zi bilan bo'ladi. Endi operatsiyani tugatganida, u yostiqni bemorning boshiga moslashtirdi.

en: As he did so the narrow black velvet band which she seems always to wear round her throat, buckled with an old diamond buckle which her lover had given her, was dragged a little up, and showed a red mark on her throat.
uz: U shunday qilib, uning bo'yni atrofida doimo kiyib turadigan, sevgilisi unga bergan eski olmos qo'lqop bilan bog'langan, biroz ko'tarilgan va bo'yniga qizil iz ko'rsatadigan tor qora samutli bandni ko'tardi.

en: Arthur did not notice it, but I could hear the deep hiss of indrawn breath which is one of Van Helsing's ways of betraying emotion.
uz: Artur buni sezmadi, lekin men Van Helsingning his-tuyg'ularini o'zgartiradigan chuqur nafasni eshitardim.

en: He said nothing at the moment, but turned to me, saying, Now take down our brave young lover, give him of the port wine, and let him lie down a while.
uz: O'sha paytda u hech narsa aytmadi, lekin menga qarab: Hndi jasoratli yosh sevgini olib, unga port sharobini berib, biroz uxlashiga yo'l qo'ying.

en: He must then go home and rest, sleep much and eat much, that he may be recruited of what he has so given to his love.
uz: Keyin u uyga borib, dam olishi, ko'p uxlashi va ko'p ovqatlanishi kerak, shunda u o'z sevgisiga bergan narsalaridan bir qismini o'ziga jalb qilishi mumkin.

en: He must not stay here.
uz: U bu yerda qolmasligi kerak.

en: I may take it, sir, that you are anxious of result.
uz: O'ylaymanki, sir, siz natijalarga e'tibor qaratyapsiz.

en: Then bring it with you, that in all ways the operation is successful.
uz: Keyin uni o'zingiz bilan olib keling, har jihatdan operatsiya muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi kerak.

en: You have saved her life this time, and you can go home and rest easy in mind that all that can be is.
uz: Bu safar siz uning hayotini qutqardingiz va uyga borib, faqatgina o'sha narsa bo'lishi mumkinligini xotirjamlik bilan eslay olasiz.

en: I shall tell her all when she is well.
uz: U sog'lom bo'lganda, men unga hamma narsani aytaman.

en: She shall love you none the less for what you have done.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, u siz qilgan ishlaringiz uchun sizni shunchalik yaxshi ko'radi.

en: Goodbye. When Arthur had gone I went back to the room.
uz: Artur ketib ketgach, men o'zimning xonasiga qaytdim.

en: Lucy was sleeping gen- tly, but her breathing was stronger.
uz: Luisi ko'p uxlagan, ammo nafas olish kuchliroq edi.

en: I could see the counterpane move as her breast heaved.
uz: Men uning ko'kraklari ko'tarilganda, kontrepaning harakatlanishini ko'rardim.

en: By the bedside sat Van Helsing, looking at her intently.
uz: Yotoq yonida Van Helsing o'tirib, unga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: The velvet band again covered the red mark.
uz: Velvet to'plami yana qizil belgini qopladi.

en: I asked the Professor in a whisper, What do you make of that mark on her throat? What do you make of it? I have not examined it yet, I answered, and then and there proceeded to loose the band.
uz: Men professordan shoshib so'radim: O'zining bo'ynidagi bu izni qanday ko'rasiz? - O'zingizga qanday ko'rinadi? - Men javob berdim: Men uni hali ko'rmaganman, - va keyin u erda to'plamni yo'q qilishga harakat qildim.

en: Just over the external jugular vein there were two punctures, not large, but not wholesome looking.
uz: Tashqi jugular damarining o'zida ikki ta'sir, katta emas, lekin sog'lom ko'rinmas edi.

en: There was no sign of disease, but the edges were white and worn looking, as if by some trituration.
uz: Kasallikning hech qanday izlari yo'q edi, lekin chegaralar oq va mayda-mayda, xuddi bir xil trituratsiya tufayli ko'rinardi.

en: It at once oc- curred to me that that this wound, or whatever it was, might be the means of that manifest loss of blood.
uz: O'shanda bu jarohat yoki nima bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, qon yo'qotishning sababchisi bo'lishi mumkinligi o'ylandi.

en: But I abandoned the idea as soon as it formed, for such a thing could not be.
uz: Ammo men fikr paydo bo'lganidan so'ng uni tashlab yubordim, chunki bunday narsa bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: The whole bed would have been drenched to a scarlet with the blood which the girl must have lost to leave such a pallor as she had before the transfusion.
uz: Butun yotoq qizil qonga to'lib, qizning qonidan o'tgan bo'lishi kerak edi, chunki u transfutsiyadan oldinki kabi ko'rinmas edi.

en: Well? said Van Helsing.
uz: - Xo'sh, - dedi Van Helsing.

en: I can make nothing of it. The Professor stood up.
uz: Men bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman, - dedi professor.

en: I must go back to Amsterdam tonight, he said There are books and things there which I want.
uz: Men bugun Amsterdamga qaytishim kerak, - dedi u. - Men xohlagan kitoblar va narsalar bor.

en: You must remain here all night, and you must not let your sight pass from her.
uz: Siz bu yerda butun kecha qolishingiz kerak va uning ko'zidan o'tib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymang.

en: Shall I have a nurse? I asked.
uz: Menga hamshira kerakmi? deb so'radim.

en: We are the best nurses, you and I.
uz: Biz eng yaxshi hamshiralarmiz, sen va men.

en: You keep watch all night.
uz: Siz butun kecha kuzatib turasiz.

en: See that she is well fed, and that nothing disturbs her.
uz: U yaxshi ovqatlanishini va hech narsa uni bezovta qilmasligini ta'minlang.

en: You must not sleep all the night.Later on we can sleep, you and I.
uz: Siz butun kecha uxlamasligingiz kerak.Keyin biz ikkovimiz uxlay olamiz.

en: I shall be back as soon as possible.
uz: Men imkon qadar tezroq qaytaman.

en: And then we may begin. May begin? I said.
uz: Keyin biz boshlashimiz mumkin. - Men: Bola boshlashimiz mumkinmi? - dedim.

en: What on earth do you mean? We shall see! he answered, as he hurried out.
uz: Siz nima demoqchisiz? - deb javob berdi u, shoshilib chiqib: Biz ko'ramiz! - deb javob berdi.

en: He came back a moment later and put his head inside the door and said with a warning ﬁnger held up, Remember, she is your charge.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, u qaytib kelib, boshini eshik ichiga qo'ydi va ogohlantirish barmog'i ko'tarilgan holda shunday dedi: Yodingizda bo'lsin, u sizning javobgarligingizdir.

en: If you leave her, and harm befall, you shall not sleep easy hereafter! DR.
uz: Agar siz uni tashlab ketsangiz va sizga zarar yetsa, bundan keyin yaxshi uxlamaysiz! - dedi doktor.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY—CONTINUED 8 September.—I sat up all night with Lucy.
uz: SEWARDning kundaligi 8 sentabr kuni davom etadi.Men butun kecha Luisi bilan birga o'tirdim.

en: The opiate worked itself off towards dusk, and she waked naturally.
uz: Opiyat qorong'ilikkacha o'zini o'zi ishlatib ketdi va u tabiiy ravishda uyg'onadi.

en: She looked a different being from what she had been before the operation.
uz: U operatsiyadan oldin qanday bo'lganidan boshqacha ko'rinardi.

en: Her spirits even were good, and she was full of a happy vivacity, but I could see evidences of the absolute pros- tration which she had undergone.
uz: Hatto uning ruhi yaxshi edi va u quvonchli jonli edi, lekin men uning boshdan kechirgan mutlaq kasbi borligini ko'rardim.

en: Van Helsing had directed that I should sit up with her, she almost pooh-poohed the idea, pointing out her daughter's renewed strength and excellent spirits.
uz: Van Helsing menga u bilan birga o'tirishni buyurgan edi, u deyarli o'sha fikrga qo'shilib, qizining yangilanayotgan kuch-quvvatini va ajoyib ruhini ta'kidlagan.

en: I was ﬁrm, however, and made preparations for my long vigil.
uz: Biroq, qat'iy bo'lib, uzoq vaqt turish uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rdim.

en: When her maid had prepared her for the night I came in, having in the meantime had supper, and took a seat by the bedside.
uz: Uning xizmatkori uni kechasi uchun tayyorlab qo'yganidan so'ng, men kirdim va o'sha paytda kechki ovqatni yeb, yotoq yonida o'tirdim.

en: She did not in any way make objection, but looked at me gratefully whenever I caught her eye.
uz: U hech qanday qarshilik ko'rsatmadi, lekin har safar uning ko'zlariga tushganimda, menga minnatdorchilik ila qarab turardi.

en: After a long spell she seemed sinking off to sleep, but with an effort seemed to pull herself together and shook it off.
uz: Uzoq vaqtdan so'ng u uxlab ketayotgandek tuyuldi, lekin harakat bilan o'zini to'xtatib, uni silkitib yubordi.

en: It was apparent that she did not want to sleep, so I tackled the subject at once.
uz: Uning uxlashni istamaganligi aniq edi, shuning uchun men darhol mavzuni muhokama qildim.

en: You do not want to sleep? No.
uz: Uchishni istamaysizmi? - Yo'q.

en: I am afraid. Afraid to go to sleep!
uz: Men qo'rqaman.  Uyishga borishdan qo'rqaman!

en: It is the boon we all crave for. Ah, not if you were like me, if sleep was to you a presage of horror! A presage of horror!
uz: Bu barchamiz istagan baraka. Aha, agar siz men kabi bo'lsangiz, uxlash siz uchun dahshatli bashorat bo'lsa, yo'q! Dahshatli bashorat!

en: What on earth do you mean? I don't know.
uz: Nima demoqchi bo'ldingiz? - Bila olmayman.

en: And that is what is so terrible.
uz: Va bu juda dahshatli narsa.

en: All this weakness comes to me in sleep, until I dread the very thought. But, my dear girl, you may sleep tonight.
uz: Bu barcha zaifliklar uyquda menga keladi, hatto o'ylashdan qo'rqaman.

en: I am here watching you, and I can promise that nothing will happen. Ah, I can trust you! she said.
uz: Men bu yerda seni kuzatib turaman va hech narsa sodir bo'lmasligiga va'da beraman, - dedi u.

en: I seized the opportunity, and said, I promise that if I see any evidence of bad dreams I will wake you at once.
uz: Men imkoniyatdan foydalanib: Agar yomon orzularni ko'rsam, sizni darhol uyg'otishga va'da beraman, - dedim.

en: Oh, will you really?
uz: Haqiqatan ham shunday qilasizmi?

en: How good you are to me.
uz: Siz menga qanchalik yaxshi ekansiz.

en: Then I will sleep! And almost at the word she gave a deep sigh of relief, and sank back, asleep.
uz: Keyin uyquga boraman! - degan so'z bilan u chuqur taskin his qildi va uxlab, yana o'tib ketdi.

en: All night long I watched by her.
uz: Kechasi uni kuzatib turardim.

en: She never stirred, but slept on and on in a deep, tranquil, life-giving, healthgiving sleep.
uz: U hech qachon harakatlanmagan, lekin chuqur, tinch, hayot baxsh etuvchi va sog'lom uyquda uxlagan.

en: Her lips were slightly part- ed, and her breast rose and fell with the regularity of a pendulum.
uz: Uning og'izlari biroz bo'lindi va ko'kraklari pendul kabi tez-tez ko'tarilib tushdi.

en: There was a smile on her face, and it was evident that no bad dreams had come to disturb her peace of mind.
uz: Uning yuzida tabassum bor edi va hech qanday yomon orzular uning tinchligini buzmaganini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: In the early morning her maid came, and I left her in her care and took myself back home, for I was anxious about many things.
uz: Erta tongda uning xizmatkori keldi va men uni uning qaramog'ida qoldirib, uyga qaytdim, chunki men ko'p narsalar haqida tashvishlanardim.

en: I sent a short wire to Van Helsing and to Arthur, telling them of the excellent result of the op- eration.
uz: Men Van Helsinga va Arturga qisqa telegram yuborib, operatsiyaning ajoyib natijasi to'g'risida aytib berdim.

en: My own work, with its manifold arrears, took me all day to clear off.
uz: O'z ishim, uning ko'p miqdordagi kechikishlari bilan, meni butun kun davomida tozalashga majbur qildi.

en: It was dark when I was able to inquire about my zoophagous patient.
uz: Zoofagasi bo'lgan bemorimni so'rash uchun qorong'ilik edi.

en: The report was good.
uz: Hisobot yaxshi edi.

en: He had been quite quiet for the past day and night.
uz: U o'tgan kun va kechasi juda tinch edi.

en: A telegram came from Van Helsing at Amsterdam whilst I was at dinner, sug- gesting that I should be at Hillingham tonight, as it might be well to be at hand, and stating that he was leaving by the night mail and would join me early in the morning.
uz: Men kechki ovqatda bo'lganimda, Amsterdamdagi Van Helsingdan telegram kelib, men bugun Hillinghamda bo'lishim kerakligini aytdi, chunki u erda bo'lish yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin edi va u kechasi pochta orqali ketishini va ertalab meni qo'shishini aytdi.

en: 9 September.—I was pretty tired and worn out when I got to Hillingham.
uz: 9 sentabr.Hillinghemga yetib kelganimda juda charchagan va charchagan edim.

en: For two nights I had hardly had a wink of sleep, and my brain was begin- ning to feel that numbness which marks cerebral exhaustion.
uz: Ikki kecha davomida men deyarli uxlamagan edim va miyam o'zimni bechora his qila boshladi.

en: Lucy was up and in cheerful spirits.
uz: Luisi uyg'onib, quvonchli ruhda edi.

en: When she shook hands with me she looked sharply in my face and said, No sitting up tonight for you.
uz: U menga qo'l urganida, o'z ko'zi bilan yuzimga qarab: Bu kecha sen uchun o'tirmay qo'y.

en: I am quite well again.
uz: Men yana juda sog'lomman.

en: Indeed, I am, and if there is to be any sitting up, it is I who will sit up with you. I would not argue the point, but went and had my supper.
uz: To'g'ri, men shundayman va agar biror kishi o'tirishi kerak bo'lsa, men siz bilan o'tiraman, - deb aytdim.

en: Lucy came with me, and, enlivened by her charming presence, I made an excellent meal, and had a couple of glasses of the more than excellent port.
uz: Lusi men bilan birga keldi va uning jozibali hozirligi meni hayajonlantirib, men ajoyib ovqat tayyorladim va bir necha stakan ajoyib portdan ichdim.

en: Then Lucy took me upstairs, and showed me a room next her own, where a cozy ﬁre was burning.
uz: Keyin Luisi meni yuqoriga olib chiqib, yonida yonayotgan yoqilg'isi yoqadigan xonani ko'rsatdi.

en: You must stay here.
uz: Siz bu yerda qolishingiz kerak.

en: I shall leave this door open and my door too.
uz: Men bu eshikni ham, eshikni ham ochiq qoldiraman.

en: You can lie on the sofa for I know that nothing would induce any of you doctors to go to bed whilst there is a patient above the horizon.
uz: Sizlar sofaga yotishingiz mumkin, chunki men bilamanki, sizlarning hech biringiz horisontdan yuqorida bemor bo'lganida, siz shifokorlardan hech kimni uxlashga undamaysiz.

en: If I want anything I shall call out, and you can come to me at once. I could not but acquiesce, for I was dog tired, and could not have sat up had I tried.
uz: Agar biror narsa kerak bo'lsa, shuni aytaman va siz darhol mendan oldinga kelishingiz mumkin. Men rozi bo'lishdan boshqa narsani qila olmadim, chunki men itdan charchagan edim va harakat qilganimda o'tirolmas edim.

en: So, on her renewing her promise to call me if she should want
uz: Shunday qilib, agar u xohlasa, menga qo'ng'iroq qilish va'dasini yangilashda.

en: anything, I lay on the sofa, and forgot all about everything.
uz: Sofaga yotdim va hamma narsani unutib qo'ydim.

en: LUCY WESTENRA'S DIARY 9 September.—I feel so happy tonight.
uz: LUCY WESTENRA DYAYRI 9 sentabr kuni.Men bu kechada juda baxtli his qilaman.

en: I have been so miserably weak, that to be able to think and move about is like feeling sunshine after a long spell of east wind out of a steel sky.
uz: Men shunchalik zaifmanki, o'ylash va harakat qilish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish, uzoq vaqt davomida sharq shamolining poydevoridan quyosh nurini his qilish bilan bir xil.

en: Somehow Arthur feels very, very close to me.
uz: Arthur o'zini menga juda, juda yaqin his qiladi.

en: I seem to feel his presence warm about me.
uz: Uning hozir bo'lishi men uchun iliq bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: I suppose it is that sick- ness and weakness are selﬁsh things and turn our inner eyes and sympathy on ourselves, whilst health and strength give love rein, and in thought and feeling he can wander where he wills.
uz: O'ylaymanki, kasallik va zaiflik xudbin narsalar va ichki ko'z va hamdardlikni o'zimizga qaratadi, sog'lik va kuch esa sevgiga bosim o'tkazadi va fikr va his-tuyg'ularda u xohlagan joyda yurishi mumkin.

en: I know where my thoughts are.
uz: O'y-fikrlarim qaerdaligini bilaman.

en: If only Arthur knew!
uz: Agar Artur bilganida edi!

en: My dear, my dear, your ears must tingle as you sleep, as mine do waking.
uz: Qizim, qizim, sen uxlayotganda quloqlaring qichqirishi kerak, mening quloqlarim uyg'onayotganda quloqlarim qichqirishi kerak.

en: Oh, the blissful rest of last night!
uz: Oh, o'tgan kechaning baxtli qolganlari!

en: How I slept, with that dear, good Dr.
uz: O'sha aziz, yaxshi doktor bilan qanday uxladim?

en: And tonight I shall not fear to sleep, since he is close at hand and within call.
uz: Va bu kechasi men uxlashdan qo'rqmayman, chunki u juda yaqin va qo'lda.

en: Thank everybody for being so good to me.
uz: Menga shunchalik mehribon bo'lganingiz uchun hammaga minnatdorchilik bildiraman.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 10 September.—I was conscious of the Professor's hand on my head, and started awake all in a second.
uz: Sewardning 10 sentabrdagi kundaligi.Professorning boshimga qo'lini qo'yganidan xabardor edim va bir soniyada uyg'ona boshladim.

en: That is one of the things that we learn in an asylum, at any rate.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, bu g'alati joyda o'rganadigan narsalardan biridir.

en: And how is our patient? Well, when I left her, or rather when she left me, I answered.
uz: Va bemorimiz qanday? - deb so'radim. - Men uni tashlab ketganimda yoki, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytganda, u meni tashlab ketganda.

en: Come, let us see, he said.
uz: U: Kelin, ko'raylik, dedi.

en: And together we went into the room.
uz: Va biz birgalikda xonaniga kirdik.

en: The blind was down, and I went over to raise it gently, whilst Van Hels- ing stepped, with his soft, cat-like tread, over to the bed.
uz: Ko'rni tushirib qo'ydim va men uni muloyimlik bilan ko'tarishga bordim, Van Helsing esa o'zining yumshoq, qush kabi bo'lgan yo'lni ko'tarib, to'shagga chiqdi.

en: As I raised the blind, and the morning sunlight ﬂooded the room, I heard the Professor's low hiss of inspiration, and knowing its rarity, a deadly fear shot through my heart.
uz: Ko'r odamni ko'targanimda, ertalab quyosh nurlari xonani to'ldirib yuborganida, professorning ilhomlantiruvchi ovozini eshitdim va uning kamyobligini bilib, yuragimga o'lim qo'rquvi tushib ketdi.

en: As I passed over he moved back, and his exclama- tion of horror, Gott in Himmel! needed no enforcement from his agonized face.
uz: Men o'tib ketayotganimda, u orqaga qaytib ketdi va uning dahshatli Gott in Himmel! deb hayqirishi uning azob chekkan yuzidan hech qanday kuchga muhtoj emas edi.

en: He raised his hand and pointed to the bed, and his iron face was drawn and ashen white.
uz: U qo'lini ko'tarib, to'shagini ko'rsatdi va uning temir yuzi to'qilgan va oq ko'rilgan edi.

en: I felt my knees begin to tremble.
uz: Tushlarim titra boshlaganini his qildim.

en: There on the bed, seemingly in a swoon, lay poor Lucy, more horribly white and wan-looking than ever.
uz: Yotoq ustida, ko'rinishicha, o'z ko'rinishi bilan, kambag'al Lusi, o'ta dahshatli oq va past ko'rinishda, har qachongidan ham ko'proq o'tirgan edi.

en: Even the lips were white, and the gums seemed to have shrunken back from the teeth, as we sometimes see in a corpse after a prolonged illness.
uz: Hatto og'izlar oq edi va tishlar tishlardan tortib ketganiga o'xshaydi, chunki ba'zan uzoq vaqt kasal bo'lganidan so'ng jasadda ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: Van Helsing raised his foot to stamp in anger, but the instinct of his life and all the long years of habit stood to him, and he put it down again softly.
uz: Van Helsing g'azabga tushish uchun oyoqlarini ko'tardi, lekin uning hayoti va uzoq yillar davomida o'z odatlari unga qattiq ta'sir qildi va u yana bir bor o'zini yumshatdi.

en: I ﬂew to the dining room, and returned with the decanter.
uz: Men ovqatxonaga uchib, dekanter bilan qaytib keldim.

en: He wetted the poor white lips with it, and together we rubbed palm and wrist and heart.
uz: U kambag'al oq og'izlarni u bilan to'ldirgan va birgalikda qo'limizni, qo'limizni va yuragimizni silkitgan edik.

en: He felt her heart, and after a few moments of agonizing suspense said, It is not too late.
uz: U uning qalbini sezdi va bir necha daqiqa azob chekkan tashvishdan so'ng: Ha, hali kech emas.

en: It beats, though but feebly.
uz: Bu urish, lekin zaif.

en: All our work is undone.
uz: Barcha ishlarimiz bekor qilindi.

en: We must begin again.
uz: Biz yana boshlanishimiz kerak.

en: There is no young Arthur here now.
uz: Hozirda bu yerda yosh Artur yo'q.

en: I have to call on you yourself this time, friend John. As he spoke, he was dipping into his bag, and producing the instruments of transfusion.
uz: Men bu safar o'zingga murojaat qilishim kerak, do'stim Jon. U gapirganida, o'z sumkasini to'kib, qon to'shash vositalarini ishlab chiqardi.

en: I had taken off my coat and rolled up my shirt sleeve.
uz: Men kiyimimni olib, ko'ylak qo'lqovusimni yig'dim.

en: There was no possibility of an opiate just at present, and no need of one.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda opiyadan foydalanish imkoniyati yo'q edi va bu kerak emas edi.

en: and so, without a moment's delay, we began the operation.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz bir daqiqa ham kechiktirmasdan operatsiyani boshladik.

en: After a time, it did not seem a short time either, for the draining away of one's blood, no matter how willingly it be given, is a terrible feeling, Van Helsing held up a warning ﬁnger.
uz: Vaqt o'tgach, bu ham qisqa vaqtga o'xshamaydi, chunki odamning qonini oqib tashlash, qanchalik xohish-irodasidan berilmasin, dahshatli tuyg'u bo'ladi, deb Van Helsing ogohlantirish barmog'ini ko'tardi.

en: Do not stir, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: O'zingizni qo'zg'atmang.

en: But I fear that with growing strength she may wake, and that would make danger, oh, so much danger.
uz: Ammo qo'rqamanki, o'sib borayotgan kuch bilan u uyg'onishi mumkin va bu xavf-xatarni, oh, juda katta xavf-xatarni keltirib chiqaradi.

en: But I shall precaution take.
uz: Lekin ehtiyotkorlikni ko'rsataman.

en: I shall give hypodermic injection of morphia. He proceeded then, swiftly and deftly, to carry out his intent.
uz: Morfiyaning ipodermik injeksiyasini beraman, - deb aytdi u. Shundan so'ng u tez va mahorat bilan o'z niyatini amalga oshirishga harakat qildi.

en: The effect on Lucy was not bad, for the faint seemed to merge subtly into the narcotic sleep.
uz: Lucisiga bu yomon ta'sir qilmadi, chunki o'z vaqtida o'z vaqtida uyquga o'tirganlar o'zlarini o'zlari ham o'zlari bilan birlashtirib olishardi.

en: It was with a feeling of personal pride that I could see a faint tinge of color steal back into the pallid cheeks and lips.
uz: Shaxsiy faxrlanish hissi bilan o'zimga ko'rindi, o'zimning ko'nglim va og'zimning bo'sh bo'lib qolgan burchaklariga bir xil ranglar qaytib keladi.

en: No man knows, till he experiences it, what it is to feel his own lifeblood drawn away into the veins of the woman he loves.
uz: Erkak o'z hayot qonini sevgan ayolning damarlariga olib ketayotganini his qilish nimani anglatishini o'z tajribasiga erishmaguncha hech kim bilmaydi.

en: The Professor watched me critically.
uz: Professor meni tanqidiy kuzatdi.

en: That will do, he said.
uz: U: Bu yetarli bo'ladi, - dedi.

en: Already? I remonstrated.
uz: Already? deb javob berdim.

en: You took a great deal more from Art. To which he smiled a sad sort of smile as he replied, He is her lover, her ﬁance.
uz: Sen Artdan ancha ko'proq narsani olib qo'yding, - deb javob berdi u. U: U uning muhabbatiyidir, u uning nişanchisidir.

en: You have work, much work to do for her and for others, and the present will sufﬁce.
uz: Sizda ish bor, u va boshqalar uchun ko'p ishlar qilishingiz kerak, hozirgi vaqt esa yetarli.

en: When we stopped the operation, he attended to Lucy, whilst I applied digital pressure to my own incision.
uz: Operatsiyani to'xtatganimizda, u Lusiga g'amxo'rlik qilardi, men esa o'z bo'limga raqamli bosim o'tkazardim.

en: I laid down, while I waited his leisure to attend to me, for I felt faint and a little sick.
uz: Men o'tirib, uning menga g'amxo'rlik qilishini kutdim, chunki men o'zimni charchagan va biroz kasal his qilardim.

en: By and by he bound up my wound, and sent me downstairs to get a glass of wine for myself.
uz: O'tib-o'tib, u yaramni bog'lab, o'zim uchun bir stakan sharob olish uchun meni pastga yubordi.

en: As I was leaving the room, he came after me, and half whispered.
uz: Xonadan chiqib ketayotganimda, u ortimdan kelib, yarim xotirjamlik qildi.

en: Mind, nothing must be said of this.
uz: Mind, bu haqda hech narsa aytish kerak emas.

en: If our young lover should turn up unexpected, as before, no word to him.
uz: Agar yosh sevganimiz oldingi kabi kutilmagan tarzda paydo bo'lsa, unga hech qanday xabar berishimiz mumkin emas.

en: It would at once frighten him and enjealous him, too.
uz: Bu uni bir vaqtning o'zida qo'rqitadi va unga ham rashk qiladi.

en: So! When I came back he looked at me carefully, and then said, You are not much the worse.
uz: Men qaytib kelganimda, u menga diqqat bilan qaradi va keyin: Siz shunchalik yomon emassiz.

en: Go into the room, and lie on your sofa, and rest awhile, then have much breakfast and come here to me.
uz: Xonangizga kiring, o'zingizning sofaningizda yotgan bo'ling, biroz dam oling, so'ngra ko'pdan-ko'p ovqatlaning va menga keling.

en: I followed out his orders, for I knew how right and wise they were.
uz: Uning buyruqlariga rioya qildim, chunki ular qanchalik to'g'ri va dono ekanligini bilardim.

en: I had done my part, and now my next duty was to keep up my strength.
uz: Men o'z hissamni bajargan edim va endi mening keyingi vazifam kuchimni saqlab qolish edi.

en: I felt very weak, and in the weakness lost something of the amazement at what had occurred.
uz: Men o'zimni juda zaif his qildim va zaiflikda sodir bo'lgan hodisalarga hayron bo'lishning bir qismini yo'qotdim.

en: I fell asleep on the sofa, however, wondering over and over again how Lucy had made such a retrograde movement, and how she could have been drained of so much blood with no sign any where to show for it.
uz: Biroq, men sofa ustida uxlab ketdim va qayta-qayta o'zimni o'yladimki, qanday qilib Lusi bunday retrograd harakatni amalga oshirdi va qanday qilib unga shuncha qon to'kib ketgan bo'lishi mumkin edi va buning uchun biron bir joy ko'rsatilmagan.

en: I think I must have continued my wonder in my dreams, for, sleeping and waking my thoughts always came back to the little punctures in her throat and the ragged, exhausted appearance of their edges, tiny though they were.
uz: O'ylaymanki, tushlarimda hayratlanishimni davom ettirgan bo'lardim, chunki uyquda va uyg'onishda fikrlarim doimo uning bo'ynidagi kichkina burchaklar va ularning qirqlari, hatto kichkina bo'lsa-da, charchagan, charchagan ko'rinishga qaytadi.

en: Lucy slept well into the day, and when she woke she was fairly well and strong, though not nearly so much so as the day before.
uz: Lucy kun davomida yaxshi uxladi va uyg'onganida u juda yaxshi va kuchli edi, ammo o'tgan kunga o'xshamaydi.

en: When Van Helsing had seen her, he went out for a walk, leaving me in charge, with strict in- junctions that I was not to leave her for a moment.
uz: Van Helsing uni ko'rganidan so'ng, uni bir zumga tashlab ketmasligimni qat'iy buyurgan holda, meni mas'ul qilib qoldirib, uyiga chiqdi.

en: I could hear his voice in the hall, asking the way to the nearest telegraph ofﬁce.
uz: Men uning salondagi ovozini eshitib, eng yaqin telegraf ofisidan yo'l so'rayotgan edim.

en: Lucy chatted with me freely, and seemed quite unconscious that anything had happened.
uz: Lusi men bilan erkin suhbatlashdi va biron narsa sodir bo'lganini juda bexabar ko'rinardi.

en: I tried to keep her amused and interested.
uz: Men uni qiziqarli va qiziqarli qilib qo'yishga harakat qildim.

en: When her mother came up to see her, she did not seem to notice any change whatever, but said to me gratefully, We owe you so much, Dr.
uz: Onasi uni ko'rishga kelganida, u hech qanday o'zgarishni sezmay, minnatdorchilik bilan menga shunday dedi: Biz sizga juda ko'p qarzdormiz, doktor.

en: Seward, for all you have done, but you really must now take care not to overwork yourself.
uz: Seward, qilgan barcha ishlaringiz uchun, lekin siz o'zingizni haddan tashqari ishlamayotganingizga e'tiborli bo'lishingiz kerak.

en: You are looking pale yourself.
uz: O'zingiz ham o'zingizni ko'ryapsiz.

en: You want a wife to nurse and look after you a bit, that you do! As she spoke, Lucy turned crimson, though it was only momentarily, for her poor wasted veins could not stand for long an unwonted drain to the head.
uz: Siz xotin bilan birga bo'lib, sizga g'amxo'rlik qilishni xohlaysiz, shunday bo'ladi! - deb so'zlashganda, Lusi o'z ko'ngli bilan qizil ko'rindi, ammo bu faqat bir muncha vaqtga teng bo'ldi, chunki uning kambag'al qonlari boshidan oqib ketayotgan o'z-o'zidan ko'p vaqtgacha to'xtamaydi.

en: The reaction came in excessive pallor as she turned imploring eyes on me.
uz: U menga iltijo qilib ko'z o'girganida, o'z reaktsiyasi juda ko'p bo'sh bo'ldi.

en: I smiled and nodded, and laid my ﬁnger on my lips.
uz: Men tabassum qilib, boshimni tiyib, o'z og'zimga barmog'imni qo'ydim.

en: With a sigh, she sank back amid her pillows.
uz: Bir nafas olgach, o'z yostiqlari orasida qaytib o'tib ketdi.

en: Van Helsing returned in a couple of hours, and pres- ently said to me.
uz: Van Helsing bir necha soatdan so'ng qaytib keldi va menga:

en: Now you go home, and eat much and drink enough.
uz: Endi uyga borib, ko'p ovqat ye va yetarlicha ich.

en: Make yourself strong.
uz: O'zingizni kuchli qiling.

en: I stay here tonight, and I shall sit up with little miss myself.
uz: Men bu kecha bu yerda o'tirib, o'zimni ozgina sezmagan holda o'tiraman.

en: You and I must watch the case, and we must have none other to know.
uz: Siz va men bu ishni nazorat qilishimiz kerak va bizdan boshqa hech kim xabardor bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: I have grave reasons.
uz: Mening jiddiy sabablarim bor.

en: Think what you will.
uz: O'zingiz xohlagan narsani o'ylab ko'ring.

en: Do not fear to think even the most not-improbable.
uz: Hatto eng ehtimoldan yiroq bo'lmagan narsalarni o'ylashdan qo'rqmang.

en: Goodnight. In the hall two of the maids came to me, and asked if they or either of them might not sit up with Miss Lucy.
uz: Goodnight.  - deb so'raganida, ikkita xizmatkor menga kelib, ular yoki ularning biri Miss Lucy bilan birga o'tirmaydimi deb so'radilar.

en: They implored me to let them, and when I said it was Dr.
uz: Ular menga ruxsat berishni iltijo qilishdi va men bu doktor ekanligini aytganimda, dr.

en: Van Helsing's wish that either he or I should sit up, they asked me quite piteously to intercede with the`foreign gentleman'.
uz: Van Helsingning xohishi, ya'ni u yoki men o'tirsak, ular mendan juda achinarli tarzda chet ellik gentleman bilan shafoat qilishni so'radilar.

en: I was much touched by their kindness.
uz: Ularning mehribonligi menga qattiq ta'sir qildi.

en: Perhaps it is because I am weak at present, and perhaps because it was on Lucy's account, that their devotion
uz: Ehtimol, hozirda men zaifligim tufayli, va ehtimol, ularning sadoqati Lusi uchun edi.

en: For over and over again have I seen similar instances of woman's kindness.
uz: Men bir necha bor ayollarning mehribonligini ko'rganman.

en: I got back here in time for a late dinner, went my rounds, all well, and set this down whilst waiting for sleep.
uz: Men kechki ovqatlanish uchun o'z vaqtida qaytib keldim, o'zimni yaxshi ko'rdim va uxlashni kutganimda buni yozib qo'ydim.

en: 11 September.—This afternoon I went over to Hillingham.
uz: 11 sentabr kuni.Bugun kechqurun Hillinghamga bordim.

en: Found Van Helsing in excellent spirits, and Lucy much better.
uz: Van Helsingni mukammal ruhda topdi va Lusi esa ancha yaxshiroq edi.

en: Shortly after I had ar- rived, a big parcel from abroad came for the Professor.
uz: O'zimni ta'mirlaganimdan ko'p o'tmay, professor uchun chet eldan katta paket keldi.

en: He opened it with much impressment, assumed, of course, and showed a great bundle of white ﬂowers.
uz: U uni ko'p taassurot qoldirib ochdi, albatta, deb o'yladi va katta oq gullar to'plamini ko'rsatdi.

en: These are for you, Miss Lucy, he said.
uz: Bular siz uchun, Miss Lucy, dedi u.

en: Van Helsing! Yes, my dear, but not for you to play with.
uz: Van Helsing! Ha, azizim, lekin sen bilan o'ynash uchun emas.

en: These are medicines. Here Lucy made a wry face.
uz: Bu dorilardir. Bu yerda Lusiya g'alati surat ko'rsatdi.

en: Nay, but they are not to take in a decoction or in nauseous form, so you need not snub that so charming nose, or I shall point out to my friend Arthur what woes he may have to endure in seeing so much beauty that he so loves so much distort.
