uz: Yo'q, lekin ular o'lchovda yoki og'irlik shaklida qabul qilinmasligi kerak, shuning uchun siz o'sha chiroyli burunni inkor etmasligingiz kerak, aks holda men do'stim Arturga shuncha go'zallikni ko'rib, u shuncha yaxshi ko'rgan buzg'unchiliklarni ko'rish uchun qanday qayg'ularga duch kelishi mumkinligini ko'rsataman.

en: Aha, my pretty miss, that bring the so nice nose all straight again.
uz: Ah, go'zal xotinim, bu juda go'zal burchni yana to'g'rilashtiradi.

en: This is medicinal, but you do not know how.
uz: Bu shifokorlikdir, ammo qanday qilish kerakligini bilmaysiz.

en: I put him in your window, I make pretty wreath, and hang him round your neck, so you sleep well.
uz: Men uni oynangizga qo'ydim, chiroyli g'alabani tayyorladim va uni bo'yniga asardim, shunda yaxshi uxlaysiz.

en: They, like the lotus ﬂower, make your trouble forgotten.
uz: Ular, lotus gul singari, sizning muammolaringizni unutib yuboradi.

en: It smell so like the waters of Lethe, and of that fountain of youth that the Conquistadores sought for in the Floridas, and ﬁnd him all too late. Whilst he was speaking, Lucy had been examining the ﬂowers and smelling them.
uz: U Letning suvlariga va Conquistadoreslar Floridasda izlagan yoshlik manbaiga o'xshaydi va uni juda kech topadi. U gapirgan paytda Luisi gullarni ko'rib, ularni hidlab yurgan edi.

en: Now she threw them down saying, with half laughter, and half disgust, Oh, Professor, I believe you are only putting up a joke on me.
uz: Endi u ularni yerga tashlab qo'ydi va yarim kulgi va yarim jirkanchlik bilan: O, professor, siz menga faqat hazil qilyapsiz, deb o'ylayman.

en: Why, these ﬂowers are only common garlic. To my surprise, Van Helsing rose up and said with all his sternness, his iron jaw set and his bushy eyebrows meeting, No triﬂing with me!
uz: Bu gullar oddiy sarimushdan boshqa narsa emas. Meni hayratda qoldirgan holda, Van Helsing o'rnidan turib, qattiqqo'lligi, temir cho'g'i va o'tkir ko'z burchaklari bilan shunday dedi: Men bilan hech qanday g'alati ish qilmang!

en: There is grim purpose in what I do, and I warn you that you do not thwart me.
uz: Men qilayotgan ishlarimning maqsadi juda yomon, shuning uchun sizlarni ogohlantiramanki, menga toʻsqinlik qilmanglar.

en: Take care, for the sake of others if not for your own. Then seeing poor Lucy scared, as she might well be, he went on more gently, Oh, little miss, my dear, do not fear me.
uz: Boshqalar uchun, agar o'zingiz uchun bo'lmasa, ehtiyot bo'ling. Keyin esa kambag'al Lusi qo'rqib ketganini ko'rib, u yanada muloyimlik bilan davom etdi: Oh, kichik xonim, azizim, mendan qo'rqma.

en: I only do for your good, but there is much virtue to you in those so common ﬂowers.
uz: Men buni faqatgina sizning manfaatingiz uchun qilaman, ammo sizning ushbu oddiy gullarda ko'p fazilatlaringiz bor.

en: See, I place them myself in your room.
uz: Mana, men ularni o'zim sizning xonangizga joylashtiraman.

en: I make myself the wreath that you are to wear.
uz: Men o'zimga siz kiyishi kerak bo'lgan bag'ishani tayyorlayman.

en: No telling to others that make so inquisitive questions.
uz: Bunday qiziqarli savollarni berayotgan boshqalarga aytmaslik.

en: We must obey, and silence is a part of obedience, and obedience is to bring you strong and well into loving arms that wait for you.
uz: Biz itoat qilishimiz kerak, va sukut saqlash itoatkorlikning bir qismidir, itoatkorlik esa sizni kuchli va yaxshi ko'rgan qo'llaringizga olib keladi.

en: Now sit still a while.
uz: Endi biroz o'tirib turing.

en: Come with me, friend John, and you shall help me deck the room with my garlic, which is all the war from Haarlem, where my friend Vanderpool raise herb in his glass houses all the year.
uz: Men bilan birga kel, do'stim Jon, va sen menga xonamni sarimushim bilan qoplashga yordam berasan, bu esa butun yil davomida do'stim Vanderpool o'zining shisha uylarida o'simliklarni o'stirgan Haarlem shahridagi urushdir.

en: I had to telegraph yesterday, or they would not have been here. We went into the room, taking the ﬂowers with us.
uz: Kecha men telegrafga borishim kerak edi, aks holda ular bu yerda bo'lmas edilar. Xonaga kirdik va gullarni o'zimiz bilan olib ketdik.

en: The Professor's ac- tions were certainly odd and not to be found in any pharmacopeia that I ever heard of.
uz: Professorning xatti-harakatlari, albatta, g'alati va hech qachon eshitgan farmakopeyalarda topilmagan.

en: First he fastened up the windows and latched them securely.
uz: Avval u oynalarni bog'lab, ularni qattiq qulflab qo'ydi.

en: Next, taking a handful of the ﬂowers, he rubbed them all over the sashes, as though to ensure that every whiff of air that might get in would be laden with the garlic smell.
uz: Keyingi safar u bir nechta gullarni olib, har bir nafasga sarimsoq xushbo'yligi to'lib-toshishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday havo issiqligini ta'minlash uchun ularni barcha bo'laklarga silkitdi.

en: Then with the wisp he rubbed all over the jamb of the door, above, below, and at each side, and round the ﬁreplace in the same way.
uz: So'ngra u o'z qo'llari bilan eshikning yonboshiga, yuqorida, pastida va har bir tomoniga silkitib, o'sha xil tarzda yong'inni aylantirdi.

en: It all seemed grotesque to me, and presently I said, Well, Professor, I know you always have a reason for what you do, but this certainly puzzles me.
uz: Bu menga g'alati tuyuldi va hozirda men shunday dedim: Professor, men bilaman, siz har doim qilgan ishingiz uchun sababingiz bor, ammo bu meni juda hayratda qoldiradi.

en: It is well we have no sceptic here, or he would say that you were work- ing some spell to keep out an evil spirit. Perhaps I am! He answered quietly as he began to make the wreath which Lucy was to wear round her neck.
uz: Bizda bu yerda shubha oshuvchi yo'q, aks holda u siz yovuz ruhni qo'yib yuborish uchun biron bir sehrni yaratayotganingizni aytadi, - dedi u. Ehtimol, men! - dedi u xotirjamlik bilan javob berib, Lusiyning bo'yni atrofida kiyishi kerak bo'lgan g'alabani tayyorlay boshlaganida.

en: We then waited whilst Lucy made her toilet for the night, and when she was in bed he came and himself ﬁxed the wreath of garlic round her neck.
uz: Keyin biz Lusi kechasi uchun to'lqin tayyorlaganini kutdik va u yotoqda bo'lganida, u kelib, uning bo'yniga sarlavhuning g'ayratini o'zi bog'ladi.

en: The last words he said to her were, Take care you do not disturb it, and even if the room feel close, do not tonight open the window or the door. I promise, said Lucy.
uz: U ayolga aytgan so'zlarining oxirgi so'zlari shunday edi: O'zingizni xavotirga solmang, xonadon yaqin deb tuyulsa ham, bu kechada darvoza yoki eshikni ochmang.

en: And thank you both a thousand times for all your kindness to me!
uz: Va menga qilgan barcha mehribonligingiz uchun ikkovingizga ming marta rahmat!

en: Oh, what have I done to be blessed with such friends? As we left the house in my ﬂy, which was waiting, Van Helsing said,Tonight I can sleep in peace, and sleep I want, two nights of travel, much reading in the day between, and much anxiety on the day to follow, and a night to sit up, without to wink.
uz: Oh, men bunday do'stlar bilan qutqarilish uchun nima qildim? - deb so'ragan Van Helsing: Bu kecha tinchlikda uxlay olaman va xohlagan uyquga boraman, ikki kecha sayohat, o'rtadagi kun juda ko'p o'qish, keyingi kun juda tashvishlanadi va bir kecha o'tirib, ko'z yummasdan turaman.

en: Tomorrow in the morning early you call for me, and we come together to see our pretty miss, so much more strong for my `spell' which I have work.
uz: Ertalab ertalab siz meni chaqirasiz va biz o'zimizdan ko'ra chiroyli xotinimni ko'rish uchun yig'ilamiz, bu mening `spell'im uchun juda kuchli, chunki men ish bilan shug'ullanaman.

en: Ho, ho! He seemed so conﬁdent that I, remembering my own conﬁdence two nights before and with the baneful result, felt awe and vague terror.
uz: Ho, ho! - deb o'ylaganicha, u o'zidan shu qadar ishonchga ega ediki, men ikki kecha oldin o'z ishonchimni va ayanchli natijani eslab, qo'rquv va qo'rquvni his qildim.

en: It must have been my weakness that made me hesitate to tell it to my friend, but I felt it all the more, like unshed tears.
uz: Bu mening zaifligim tufayli do'stimga aytishga ikkilanishim kerak edi, ammo men uni ko'proq his qildim, xuddi ko'z yoshlari to'kkanidek.

en: CHAPTER 11 LUCY WESTENRA'S DIARY 12 September.—How good they all are to me.
uz: 11 - bob LUCY WESTENRA'NING KUNIYKTASI 12 - sentabr.Qanday yaxshilar meni ko'radilar.

en: I quite love that dear Dr.
uz: Men o'sha aziz doktorni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

en: I wonder why he was so anxious about these ﬂowers.
uz: Nima uchun u bu gullar uchun shunchalik tashvishlanganini o'ylayman.

en: He positively frightened me, he was so ﬁerce.
uz: U meni qo'rqitib qo'ydi, juda qattiqqo'l edi.

en: And yet he must have been right, for I feel comfort from them already.
uz: Ammo u to'g'ri bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki men allaqachon ulardan tasalli his qilyapman.

en: Somehow, I do not dread being alone tonight, and I can go to sleep without fear.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men bugun yolg'iz qolishdan qo'rqmayman va qo'rqmasdan uxlay olaman.

en: I shall not mind any ﬂapping outside the window.
uz: Oynaning tashqarisida gapirish menga hech qanday xalaqit bermaydi.

en: Oh, the terrible struggle that I have had against sleep so often of late, the pain of sleeplessness, or the pain of the fear of sleep, and with such unknown horrors as it has for me!
uz: Oh, men oxirgi kunlarda ko'pincha uyquga qarshi kurashayotgan dahshatli kurash, uyqusizlik og'riqi yoki uyqudan qo'rqish og'riqi va men uchun sodir bo'lgan bunday noma'lum dahshatlar bilan!

en: How blessed are some people, whose lives have no fears, no dreads, to whom sleep is a blessing that comes night- ly, and brings nothing but sweet dreams.
uz: Hayotlarida qo'rquv, qo'rquv yo'q bo'lgan, uyqu kechasi keladigan va shirin tushlardan boshqa hech narsa keltirmaydigan odamlar qanday baxtlidir!

en: Well, here I am tonight, hoping for sleep, and lying like Ophelia in the play, with`virgin crants and maiden strewments.' I never liked garlic before, but tonight it is delightful!
uz: Mana, men bugun uyquga umidvor bo'lib, Ofeliya kabi o'yinda yotgan bo'lib, qiz qizlar va qiz qizlar bilan quvonchga to'lib-toshganman.

en: There is peace in its smell.
uz: Uning hidida tinchlik bor.

en: I feel sleep coming already.
uz: O'zimni uyqusiz his qilyapman.

en: Goodnight, everybody.
uz: Go'zal kechasi, barchangiz.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 13 September.—Called at the Berkeley and found Van Helsing, as usual, up to time.
uz: SEWARDning DYARI 13 sentabr.Berkeleyda qo'ng'iroq qildi va Van Helsingni odatdagidek, hozirgi vaqtda topdi.

en: The carriage ordered from the hotel was waiting.
uz: Mehmonxonadan buyurtma qilingan vagon sizni kutib turardi.

en: The Professor took his bag, which he always brings with him now.
uz: Professor o'z sumkasini olib ketdi, uni endi har doim o'zi bilan olib ketadi.

en: Let all be put down exactly.
uz: Hamma narsa aniq yozib qo'yilsin.

en: Van Helsing and I arrived at Hillingham at eight o'clock.
uz: Van Helsing va men Hillinghamga soat sakkizlarda yetib keldik.

en: It was a lovely morning.
uz: Bu go'zal ertalab edi.

en: The bright sunshine and all the fresh feeling of early autumn seemed like the completion of nature's annual work.
uz: Quyoshning yorqin nurlari va kuzning boshidagi yangi his-tuyg'ular tabiatning yillik ishini yakunlagani kabi ko'rinardi.

en: The leaves were turning to all kinds of beautiful colors, but had not yet be- gun to drop from the trees.
uz: Barglar turli xil chiroyli ranglarga aylanayotgan edi, ammo daraxtlardan tushib ketish uchun hali qurol yo'q edi.

en: When we entered we met Mrs.
uz: Kirganimizda, xonim bilan uchrashdik.

en: Westenra coming out of the morning room.
uz: Ertalabki xonadan Westenra chiqib kelmoqda.

en: She is always an early riser.
uz: U har doim erta uyg'onadi.

en: She greeted us warm- ly and said, You will be glad to know that Lucy is better.
uz: U bizni iliq kutib oldi va shunday dedi: Lusi yaxshilanayotganini bilib xursand bo'lasiz.

en: The dear child is still asleep.
uz: Aziz bola hali ham uxlayapti.

en: I looked into her room and saw her, but did not go in, lest I should disturb her. The Professor smiled, and looked quite jubilant.
uz: Men uning xonasiga kirib ko'rdim, lekin uni bezovta qilmasligim uchun kirmadim.Professor tabassum qilib, juda xursand bo'lib ko'rindi.

en: hands together, and said, Aha!
uz: Qo'llarini qo'shib: Aha!

en: I thought I had diagnosed the case.
uz: Men o'zimni bu holatni aniqlaganimni his qildim.

en: My treatment is working. To which she replied, You must not take all the credit to yourself, doc- tor.
uz: Mening davolanishim yaxshi samara bermoqda. U shunday javob berdi: Siz o'zingizga barcha shon-shuhratni olmasligingiz kerak, doktor.

en: Lucy's state this morning is due in part to me. How do you mean, ma'am? asked the Professor.
uz: Bugun ertalab Luisiyning holati qisman menga bog'liq. - Qanday qilib, xonim? - deb so'radi professor.

en: Well, I was anxious about the dear child in the night, and went into her room.
uz: Men kechasi qizim haqida tashvishlanib, uning xonasiga kirdim.

en: She was sleeping soundly, so soundly that even my coming did not wake her.
uz: U shunchalik yaxshi uxlaganki, hatto mening kelishim ham uni uyg'otmadi.

en: But the room was awfully stuffy.
uz: Lekin xonadon juda to'liq edi.

en: There were a lot of those horri- ble, strongsmelling ﬂowers about everywhere, and she had actually a bunch of them round her neck.
uz: Har yerda juda ko'p dahshatli, xushbo'y gullar bor edi va uning bo'yni atrofida bir to'plab gullar bor edi.

en: I feared that the heavy odor would be too much for the dear child in her weak state, so I took them all away and opened a bit of the window to let in a little fresh air.
uz: Men bu og'ir xushbo'y tutun uning zaif holatida bo'lgan sevimli bola uchun juda ko'p bo'lishini qo'rqardim, shuning uchun barchasini olib ketdim va biroz toza havoga ruxsat berish uchun biroz darcha ochdim.

en: You will be pleased with her, I am sure. She moved off into her boudoir, where she usually breakfasted early.
uz: Siz undan mamnun bo'lasiz, shubhasiz. U odatda ertalab nonushta qiladigan boydorga ko'chib o'tdi.

en: As she had spoken, I watched the Professor's face, and saw it turn ashen gray.
uz: U gapirganida, professorning yuziga qaradim va uni ko'rdim.

en: He had been able to retain his self-command whilst the poor lady was present, for he knew her state and how mischievous a shock would be.
uz: U kambag'al ayol hozir bo'lganida o'z nazoratini saqlab qolgan edi, chunki u uning holatini va shokning qanchalik yomon bo'lishini bilgan edi.

en: He actually smiled on her as he held open the door for her to pass into her room.
uz: O'sha paytda u qizning xonasiga kirishi uchun eshikni ochib qo'yganida, unga tabassum qildi.

en: But the instant she had disappeared he pulled me, suddenly and forcibly, into the dining room and closed the door.
uz: Ammo u yo'qolgan paytida u meni to'satdan va zo'rlik bilan oshxonaga olib kirdi va eshikni yopdi.

en: Then, for the ﬁrst time in my life, I saw Van Helsing break down.
uz: Keyin, hayotimda birinchi marta, Van Helsingni vayron bo'lganini ko'rdim.

en: He raised his hands over his head in a sort of mute despair, and then beat his palms together in a helpless way.
uz: O'z qo'llarini o'z boshiga ko'tarib, so'zsiz umidsizlikka tushib, qo'l qo'llarini qo'ldan to'sqinlik bilan urdi.

en: Finally he sat down on a chair, and putting his hands before his face, began to sob, with loud, dry sobs that seemed to come from the very racking of his heart.
uz: Nihoyat, u o'tirdi va qo'llarini yuziga qo'yib, ko'nglida ko'tarilgan og'ir, quruq og'izlar bilan yig'la boshladi.

en: Then he raised his arms again, as though appealing to the whole universe.
uz: So'ngra u butun koinotga murojaat qilganidek, yana qo'llarini ko'tarib oldi.

en: What have we done, what has this poor thing done, that we are so sore beset?
uz: Biz nima qildik, bu kambag'al narsa nima qildi, biz shunchalik qayg'urib qolibmiz?

en: Is there fate amongst us still, send down from the pagan world of old, that such things must be, and in such way?
uz: Qadimgi butparast dunyodan kelib chiqqan taqdir o'zimizda hali ham mavjudmi, shunday bo'lishi kerakmi va shunday bo'lishi kerakmi?

en: This poor mother, all unknowing, and all for the best as she think, does such thing as lose her daughter body and soul, and we must not tell her, we must not even warn her, or she die, then both die.
uz: Bu kambag'al ona, hamma narsani bilmasdan va o'zi o'ylaganidek yaxshilik uchun, o'z qizi tanasini va ruhini yo'qotib qo'yadi va biz unga aytmasligimiz kerak, hatto ogohlantirmasligimiz kerak, yoki u o'lib ketadi, keyin ikkalasi ham o'ladi.

en: Oh, how we are beset!
uz: Oh, biz qanday ta'sirga tushdik!

en: How are all the powers of the devils against us! Suddenly he jumped to his feet.
uz: Qanday qilib shaytonlarning barcha kuchlari bizga qarshi! - deb birdan o'rnidan turibdi.

en: Come, he said.come, we must see and act.
uz: Kelin, dedi u. Kelin, biz ko'rib, harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: Devils or no devils, or all the devils at once, it matters not.
uz: Iblis yoki hech iblis yo'q, yoki barcha iblislar bir vaqtning o'zida, bu muhim emas.

en: We must ﬁght him all the same. He went to the hall door for his bag, and together we went up to Lucy's room.
uz: Biz unga qarshi kurashishimiz kerak. - deb so'raganida, u o'z sumkasini olish uchun chodir eshiklariga bordi va birgalikda Lusiyaning xonasiga bordik.

en: Once again I drew up the blind, whilst Van Helsing went towards the bed.
uz: Men yana ko'rni ko'tardim, Van Helsing esa yotoqqa qarab ketdi.

en: This time he did not start as he looked on the poor face with the same aw- ful, waxen pallor as before.
uz: Bu safar u kambag'alning yuziga avvalgidek o'tkir, shalgan ko'rinish bilan qaray boshladi.

en: He wore a look of stern sadness and inﬁnite pity.
uz: U qattiq qayg'u va cheksiz achinish ko'rinishini kiygan edi.

en: As I expected, he murmured, with that hissing inspiration of his which meant so much.
uz: Men kutganimdek, - dedi u, o'zining o'ziga xos ilhomlanib, ko'p narsani anglatadi.

en: Without a word he went and locked the door, and then be- gan to set out on the little table the instruments for yet another operation of transfusion of blood.
uz: U bir so'z aytmasdan borib eshikni qulflab qo'ydi va yana bir qon transfutsiyasi operatsiyasi uchun asbob-uskunalarni kichkina stol ustiga qo'ydi.

en: I had long ago recognized the necessity, and begun to take off my coat, but he stopped me with a warning hand.
uz: Men bu zaruratni ko'p vaqt oldin tushunib, kiyimimni olib tashlashni boshladim, lekin u meni ogohlantiruvchi qo'l bilan to'xtatdi.

en: Today you must operate.
uz: Bugun siz operatsiya qilishingiz kerak.

en: You are weakened already. As he spoke he took off his coat and rolled up his shirtsleeve.
uz: Siz allaqachon zaiflashgansiz. - deb so'zlashar ekan, u kiyimini olib, ko'ylakini o'rab oldi.

en: Again the operation.
uz: Yana bir bor operatsiya.

en: Again some return of color to the ashy cheeks, and the regular breathing of healthy sleep.
uz: Yana o'tkir yig'inlarga biroz rang qaytadi va sog'lom uyquni muntazam ravishda nafas oladi.

en: This time I watched whilst Van Helsing recruited himself and rested.
uz: Bu safar men Van Helsing o'zini ishga qabul qilib, dam olganini ko'rdim.

en: Presently he took an opportunity of telling Mrs.
uz: Hozirda u xonimga aytish uchun imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritdi.

en: Westenra that she must not remove anything from Lucy's room without consulting him.
uz: Vestenra, Lusiyning xonasidan unga maslahat bermasdan hech narsa olib tashlamasligi kerakligini aytdi.

en: That the ﬂowers were of medicinal value, and that the breathing of their odor was a part of the system of cure.
uz: Gullarning shifoy qadri borligi va ularning xushbo'yligini nafas olish davolanish tizimining bir qismi ekanligi.

en: Then he took over the care of the case himself, saying that he would watch this night and the next, and would send me word when to come.
uz: So'ngra u o'zi bu ishni o'zi hal qildi va bu va keyingi kechalarni kuzatib turishini va qachon kelishimni menga xabar yuborishini aytdi.

en: After another hour Lucy waked from her sleep, fresh and bright and seemingly not much the worse for her terrible ordeal.
uz: Yana bir soat o'tgach, Lusi uxlaganidan uyg'onib, o'zining dahshatli muammosi uchun yangi, yorqin va ko'rinishicha shunchalik yomon bo'lmagan edi.

en: What does it all mean?
uz: Bularning barchasi nimani anglatadi?

en: I am beginning to wonder if my long habit of life amongst the insane is beginning to tell upon my own brain.
uz: O'zimni o'ylay boshlayapmanki, aqldan ozganlar o'rtasida uzoq umr ko'rish odatim o'z miyamga o'xshamaydi.

en: LUCY WESTENRA'S DIARY 17 September.—Four days and nights of peace.
uz: LUCY WESTENRA DYAYRI 17 sentabr.To'rt kun va to'rt kecha tinchlik.

en: I am getting so strong again that I hardly know myself.
uz: Men yana shunchalik kuchli bo'lib kelamanki, o'zimni deyarli tanimayman.

en: It is as if I had passed through some long nightmare, and had just awakened to see the beautiful sunshine and feel the fresh air of the morning around me.
uz: O'zimni uzoq orzu-mulojdan o'tkazganimdek his qilaman va o'zimni quyoshning chiroyli nurini ko'rish va atrofimda ertalabgi toza havo sezish uchun uyg'onganimdek his qilaman.

en: I have a dim half remembrance of long, anxious times of waiting and fearing, darkness in which there was not even the pain of hope to make present distress more poignant.
uz: Uzoq, tashvishlangan vaqtlar, kutish va qo'rqish, hatto hozirgi qayg'ularni ko'proq o'chirib yuborish uchun umidning og'rig'i ham bo'lmagan zulmatlar haqida o'zimda kamroq eslatma bor.

en: And then long spells of oblivion, and the rising back to life as a diver coming up through a great press of water.
uz: Va keyin uzoq vaqtdan beri unutish va suv bosish orqali suvga cho'mgan bo'lib hayotga qaytish.

en: Van Helsing has been with me, all this bad dreaming seems to have passed away.
uz: Van Helsing men bilan birga bo'ldi, bu yomon orzular o'tib ketdi.

en: The noises that used to frighten me out of my wits, the ﬂapping against the windows, the distant voices which seemed so close to me, the harsh sounds that came from I know not where and commanded me to do I know not what, have all
uz: O'zimni qo'rqitadigan tovushlar, darchalarga toshbo'ron qilish, mendan juda yaqin tuyulgan uzoq ovozlar, qayerdan kelgan qattiq tovushlar, qayerdan kelganini bilmayman va menga nima qilishni bilmayman deb buyurganini bilmayman.

en: I go to bed now without any fear of sleep.
uz: Endi uxlashdan qo'rqmasdan uxlashga ketaman.

en: I do not even try to keep awake.
uz: Men hatto uyg'onishga harakat qilmayman.

en: I have grown quite fond of the garlic, and a boxful arrives for me every day from Haarlem.
uz: Men sarimsoqni juda yaxshi ko'raman va har kuni Haarlemdan menga bir quti keladi.

en: Van Helsing is going away, as he has to be for a day in Amsterdam.
uz: Van Helsing Amsterdamda bir kun bo'lishi kerak bo'lganidek, ketadi.

en: But I need not be watched.
uz: Ammo menga hech kim kuzatuvga muhtoj emasman.

en: I am well enough to be left alone.
uz: Men yolg'iz qolishim uchun yetarlicha sog'lomman.

en: Thank God for Mother's sake, and dear Arthur's, and for all our friends who have been so kind!
uz: Onam, aziz Artur va shuncha mehribon bo'lgan barcha do'stlarimiz uchun Xudoga shukr!

en: I shall not even feel the change, for last night Dr.
uz: Hatto o'zgarishni his qilmayman, chunki o'tgan kecha Dr.

en: Van Helsing slept in his chair a lot of the time.
uz: Van Helsing ko'p vaqt o'z kurashiga o'tirib uxlardi.

en: I found him asleep twice when I awoke.
uz: U uyg'onganimda uni ikki marta uxlab topdim.

en: But I did not fear to go to sleep again, although the boughs or bats or something ﬂapped almost angrily against the window panes.
uz: Ammo men yana uxlashdan qo'rqmadim, garchi bo'laklar yoki tuproqlar yoki boshqa narsa deyarli g'azabga to'lib-toshgan bo'lsa ham.

en: THE PALL MALL GAZETTE 18 September.
uz: THE PALL MALL GAZETTE 18 sentabr kuni.

en: THE ESCAPED WOLF PERILOUS ADVENTURE OF OUR INTERVIEWER INTERVIEW WITH THE KEEPER IN THE ZOOLOGICAL GARDENS After many inquiries and almost as many refusals, and perpetually using the words `PALL MALL GAZETTE ' as a sort of talisman, I managed to ﬁnd the keeper of the section of the Zoological Gardens in which the wold department is included.
uz: ZOOLOGIK BAG'DONDAGI MUQADDAS O'Z MUQADDASINING QARG'AMLI MUQADDAS HAVORIY QOLADI Ko'p so'rovlar va deyarli shuncha rad etishlardan so'ng va doimiy ravishda `PALL MALL GAZETTE ' so'zlarini bir xil talisman sifatida ishlatganimdan so'ng, men zoologik bog'lar bo'limining o'sha bo'limga kiritilgan bo'limning muqadichisini topishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: Thomas Bilder lives in one of the cottages in the enclosure behind the elephant house, and was just sitting down to his tea when I found him.
uz: Tomas Bilder fil xonasi orqasidagi uylarning birida yashaydi va men uni topganimda, u choy ichib o'tirgan edi.

en: Thomas and his wife are hospitable folk, elderly, and without children, and if the specimen I enjoyed of their hospitality be of the average kind, their lives must be pretty comfortable.
uz: Tomas va uning xotini mehmondo'st, keksa va bolasiz odamlardir va agar men ularning mehmondo'stligidan zavqlanayotganim o'rtacha bo'lsa, ularning hayoti juda qulay bo'lishi kerak.

en: The keeper would not enter on what he called business until the supper was over, and we were all satisﬁed.
uz: Qutqaruvchining o'zi biznes deb atagan ishini kechki ovqat tugaguncha davom ettirmasdi va biz hammamiz qoniqtirdik.

en: Then when the table was cleared, and he had lit his pipe, he said, Now, Sir, you can go on and arsk me what you want.
uz: So'ng stol tozalab, u pipoyasini yoqib qo'yganida, u: Hndi, xo'jayinim, menga nima xohlasangiz, so'rasangiz bo'ladi.

en: You'll excoose me refoosin' to talk of perfeshunal subjucts afore meals.
uz: Siz meni ovqatdan oldin perfeshunal subjucts haqida gapirishga majbur qilasiz.

en: I gives the wolves and the jackals and the hyenas in all our section their tea afore I begins to arsk them questions. How do you mean, ask them questions? I queried, wishful to get him into a talkative humor.
uz: Men ularga savollar berishni boshlashdan oldin, bizning barcha bo'limdagi bo'ri va shakal va hyenalarga choy beraman. Siz ularga savollar berishni qanday tushunasiz? deb so'radim va uni gapiradigan humorga tushirishni xohladim.

en: `Ittin' of them over the `ead with a pole is one way.
uz: `T'tin' ularning `ead ustiga ustun bilan bir yo'l.

en: Scratchin' of their ears in another, when gents as is ﬂush wants a bit of a show-orf to their gals.
uz: Boshqa birida quloqlarini qichqirib, erkaklar qizlariga ko'rinish orfini xohlaganida.

en: I don't so much mind the fust, the `ittin of the pole part afore I chucks in their dinner, but I waits till they've `ad their sherry and kawffee, so to speak,afore I tries on with the ear scratchin'.
uz: Men o'zlarining kechki ovqatlarida o'tirganidan oldin fust, `ittin pole qismini ko'proq yoqtirmayman, lekin ular sherri va kafelarini, shunday qilib aytish uchun, `ad qilishlarini kutaman, bundan oldin quloqlarini aralashtirishga harakat qilaman.

en: Mind you, he added philo- sophically, there's a deal of the same nature in us as in them theer animiles.
uz: O'ylab ko'ring, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u filo-sofifik jihatdan, - bizda xuddi o'sha hayvonlarda bo'lgani kabi ko'p narsa bor.

en: Here's you a-comin' and arskin' of me questions about my business, and I that grump-like that only for your bloomin' `arf-quid I'd `a' seen you blowed fust `fore I'd answer.
uz: Mana, siz mening biznesim haqida savollar berasiz va men faqat sizning gullab-yashgan `arf-quidingiz uchun sizni ko'rdim, oldin javob berardim.

en: Not even when you arsked me sarcastic like if I'd like you to arsk the Superintendent if you might arsk me questions.
uz: Hatto menga sarkastika bilan gapirganingizda ham, agar menga savollar berishingiz mumkin bo'lsa, nazoratchiga ham gapirishingizni xohlayman.

en: Without of- fence did I tell yer to go to `ell? You did. An' when you said you'd report me for usin' obscene language that was `ittin' me over the `ead.
uz: Men yerga `ellga borishni aytdimmi?  - debdi. - Siz aytdingiz.  An' - siz meni o'zingizning o'zingizdan so'zlab o'tganingiz uchun xabar berasiz, chunki o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingiz o'zingizning o'zingiz o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingiz o'zingizning o'zingizning o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'zingiz o'

en: But the `arfquid made that all right.
uz: Ammo `arfquid buni yaxshi qildi.

en: I weren't a-goin' to ﬁght, so I waited for the food, and did with my `owl as the wolves and lions and tigers does.
uz: Men jangga bormasdim, shuning uchun ovqatni kutdim va o'g'lim bilan qurtlar, sherlar va sherlar kabi qildim.

en: But, lor' love yer `art, now that the old `ooman has stuck a chunk of her tea-cake in me, an' rinsed me out with her bloomin' old teapot, and I've lit hup, you may scratch my ears for all you're worth, and won't even get a growl out of me.
uz: Lekin, lor' sevgi yer `art, endi bu qariya `ooman o'zining choy tortining bir qismini menga qo'yib qo'ygan, meni o'zining gullab-yashgan eski choy qadoqlari bilan yuvgan va men o'zimni yoqtirganimdan keyin, siz mening quloqlarimni o'zingizning qadr-qimmatingiz uchun qirib tashlashingiz mumkin va mendan hatto qichqiriq ham chiqmaydi.

en: Drive along with your questions.
uz: Savollaringizga javob bering.

en: I know what yer a-comin' at, that `ere escaped wolf. Exactly.
uz: Men nimaga kelayotganimni bilaman, o'sha o'g'il qurtadan qochib ketibdi.

en: I want you to give me your view of it.
uz: Menga bu borada o'zingizning fikringizni aytishingizni xohlayman.

en: Just tell me how it hap- pened, and when I know the facts I'll get you to say what you consider was the cause of it, and how you think the whole affair will end. All right, guv'nor.
uz: Faqat bu voqea qanday sodir bo'lganini aytib bering, haqiqatlarni bilganimda, siz bunga nima sabab bo'lganini va bu voqea qanday tugaydi deb o'ylayotganingizni aytishingiz mumkin.

en: This `ere is about the `ole story.
uz: Bu `ere `ole hikoyasi haqida.

en: That`ere wolf what we called Bersicker was one of three gray ones that came from Norway to Jamrach's, which we bought off him four years ago.
uz: Biz Bersicker deb nomlagan That`ere wolf Norvegiyadan Jamrachning uyidan kelgan uchta qora bo'lakdan biri edi, biz uni to'rt yil oldin sotib oldik.

en: He was a nice well-be- haved wolf, that never gave no trouble to talk of.
uz: U juda yaxshi va yaxshi bo'lgan, hech qachon gapirish uchun hech qanday muammoga duch kelmagan bo'lgan.

en: I'm more surprised at `im for wantin' to get out nor any other animile in the place.
uz: Men ko'proq `im uchun hayratda qoldim, chunki u chiqishni xohlaydi va o'sha joyda boshqa hech qanday hayvon yo'q.

en: But, there, you can't trust wolves no more nor women. Don't you mind him, Sir! broke in Mrs.
uz: Ammo, bu yerda endi qaygʻularga ham, ayollarga ham ishonib boʻlmaydi. - Undan xafa boʻlmang, xoʻjayini! - dedi xonim.

en: Tom, with a cheery laugh.
uz: Tom, quvonchli kulgi bilan.

en: `E's got mindin' the animiles so long that blest if he ain't like a old wolf `is- self!
uz: `E hayvonlarni shunchalik uzoq vaqt o'ylashi kerakki, agar u qariya o'zi o'zi bo'lmagan bo'lsa, qorong'i bo'lsin!

en: But there ain't no `arm in `im. Well, Sir, it was about two hours after feedin' yesterday when I ﬁrst hear my disturbance.
uz: Lekin `armda `im yo'q. Ushbu, xo'jayinim, kecha ovqatlanishdan ikki soat o'tgach, birinchi marta noqulayligimni eshitdim.

en: I was makin' up a litter in the monkey house for a young puma which is ill.
uz: Men maymunlar uyida kasal bo'lgan yosh puma uchun to'pka yig'ib yurgan edim.

en: But when I heard the yelpin' and `owlin' I kem away straight.
uz: Ammo yelpin va `owlin' so'zlarini eshitganimda, men to'g'ri yo'ldan ketdim.

en: There was Bersicker a-tearin' like a mad thing at the bars as if he wanted to get out.
uz: Bersicker barlarda g'ayritabiiy tarzda o'tirib, xuddi chiqib ketmoqchi bo'lganidek o'tirar edi.

en: There wasn't much people about that day, and close at hand was only one man, a tall, thin chap, with a `ook nose and a pointed beard, with a few white hairs runnin' through it.
uz: O'sha kuni atrofda ko'p odamlar bo'lmagan va yaqin atrofda faqat bitta kishi, uzun va chiroyli yigit, `ook burun va keskin sakki bilan bir nechta oq sochlari o'tib ketayotgan edi.

en: He had a `ard, cold look and red eyes, and I took a sort of mislike to him, for it seemed as if it was `im as they was hirritated at.
uz: Uning qahramon, sovuq ko'zi va qizil ko'zlari bor edi, men esa unga yoqmaganman, chunki ular g'azablanganida u `im kabi ko'rinardi.

en: He `ad white kid gloves on `is `ands, and he pointed out the animiles to me and says, `Keeper, these wolves seem upset at something.'
uz: U `is `andsda oq bola qo'lqoplarini qo'ydi va menga hayvonlarni ko'rsatdi va dedi, `Keeper, bu qurtlar bir narsaga g'azablangan ko'rinadi.'

en: `Maybe it's you,' says I, for I did not like the airs as he give `isself.
uz: Yoki sen bo'lgandir, - deb aytaman, chunki u o'zi bergan havolarni yoqtirmadim.

en: He didn't get angry, as I `oped he would, but he smiled a kind of insolent smile, with a mouth full of white, sharp teeth.
uz: U g'azablanmadi, men o'ylagandek, lekin u o'ziga o'xshaydigan tabassum bilan tabassum qildi, og'zi oq, o'ta o'tkir tishlarga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: `Oh no, they wouldn't like me,' `e says.
uz: `Oh yo'q, ular meni yoqtirmas edilar, deydi `e.

en: `Ow yes, they would,' says I, a-imitatin'of him.`They always like a bone or two to clean their teeth on about tea time, which you `as a bagful.' Well, it was a odd thing, but when the animiles see us a-talkin' they lay down, and when I went over to Bersicker he let me stroke his ears same as ever.
uz: `Ow ha, ular buni qilishadi, - deydi men, uning nusxasini o'qib. ` Ular har doim choy vaqti yaqinida tishlarini tozalash uchun bir yoki ikkita suyakni yaxshi ko'radilar, siz esa `as bagful.'  - Bu g'alati narsa edi, lekin hayvonlar bizni gapirganimizni ko'rganlarida, uxlashadi va men Bersickerning oldiga borganimda, u menga har doimgidek qulog'ini urishga ruxsat beradi.

en: That there man kem over, and blessed but if he didn't put in his hand and stroke the old wolf's ears too!
uz: O'sha odam kem bo'ldi va duo qildi, lekin agar u qo'lini qo'yib, qariya qurtning quloqlarini ham urmasa!

en: `Tyke care,' says I.
uz: Tyke care, deydi I..

en: `Bersicker is quick.'  `Never mind,' he says.
uz: `Bersicker tez ishlaydi.'  `Never mind,' deydi u.

en: I'm used to `em!'  `Are you in the business yourself?I says, tyking off my `at, for a man what trades in wolves, anceterer, is a good friend to keepers.
uz: Men `emga odatlanganman!'  `Sen ham bu ishda bo'lsangmi? - dedim men, o'zimning `atimni o'chirib qo'yib, o'g'lim uchun bo'rilar bilan shug'ullanadigan kishi, avlod, saqlovchilar uchun yaxshi do'stdir.

en: `Nom' says he, `not exactly in the business, but I `ave made pets of sev- eral.' and with that he lifts his `at as perlite as a lord, and walks away.
uz: `Nom' deydi u, `not to'g'ri biznesda, lekin men sev-eraldan uy hayvonlarini yaratdim.  va shu bilan u lord kabi qimmatbaho `atini ko'tarib, ketadi.

en: Old Bersicker kep' a-lookin' arter `im till `e was out of sight, and then went and lay down in a corner and wouldn't come hout the `ole hevening.
uz: Eski Bersicker kep' a-lookin arter `imgacha `e ko'rinmas edi, so'ngra borib burchada yotgan va `ole ko'rinmasligini so'zlamas edi.

en: Well, larst night, so soon as the moon was hup, the wolves here all began a-`owling.
uz: To'g'ri, kechasi, oy o'tib ketgandan so'ng, bu yerda bo'lgan bo'rilarning hammasi o'z-o'zidan qo'zg'ala boshladi.

en: There warn't nothing for them to `owl at.
uz: Ular uchun hech qanday ogohlantirish yo'q.

en: There warn't no one near, except some one that was evidently a-callin' a dog somewheres out back of the gardings in the Park road.
uz: Bu yerda hech kim ogohlantirmaydi, faqat Park yo'lidagi bog'lar orqasidan bir joyda itni chaqirayotgan kishi bo'lsa kerak.

en: Once or twice I went out to see that all was right, and it was, and then the `owling stopped.
uz: Bir-ikki marta hamma narsa to'g'ri kelayotganini ko'rish uchun tashqariga chiqdim va shunday bo'ldi va keyin `owling to'xtadi.

en: Just before twelve o'clock I just took a look round afore turnin' in, an', bust me, but when I kem opposite to old Bersicker's cage I see the rails broken and twisted about and the cage empty.
uz: Soat o'n ikkiga yaqin men o'zimni ko'rdim, lekin eski Bersicker qovoshiga qaraganda, railslar buzilgan va buzilgan va qovoshi bo'sh turganini ko'rdim.

en: And that's all I know for certing. Did any one else see anything? One of our gard`ners was a-comin' `ome about that time from a `armo- ny, when he sees a big gray dog comin' out through the garding `edges.
uz: Boshqa hech kim biror narsa ko'rganmi? - deb so'raganida, bog'bonlarimizdan biri o'sha vaqt haqida ``-yoman gapirgan edi. `armo-ny-dan katta o'rmonli itni bog'ning ` sohillaridan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rganida.

en: At least, so he says, but I don't give much for it myself, for if he did `e never said a word about it to his missis when `e got `ome, and it was only after the escape of the wolf was made known, and we had been up all night a-huntin' of the Park for Bersicker, that he remembered seein' anything.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, shunday deydi u, lekin men o'zim uchun bu haqda ko'p narsa bermayman, chunki agar u `e `e bo'lganida xotiniga bu haqda hech qachon so'z aytmagan bo'lsa, va faqat qurtning qochishi ma'lum bo'lgandan so'ng va biz Bersicker uchun Parkda butun kecha ov qilib turgandan so'ng, u hech narsa ko'rganini esladi.

en: My own be- lief was that the `armony `ad got into his `ead. Now, Mr.
uz: Mening o'zimning sevgim shundaki, `armoniya `ad o'z `eadga kirib keldi.

en: Bilder, can you account in any way for the escape of the wolf?
uz: Bilder, qurtning qochib ketishining sababini qanday qilib tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

en: Well, Sir,he said, with a suspicious sort of modesty, I think I can, but I don't know as `ow you'd be satisﬁed with the theory. Certainly I shall.
uz: - Xo'sh, xo'jayinim, - dedi u, shubhali kamtarlik bilan, - men buni qila olaman, lekin bilmayman, `ow siz nazariyadan mamnun bo'lasiz.

en: If a man like you, who knows the animals from experi- ence, can't hazard a good guess at any rate, who is even to try? well then, Sir, I accounts for it this way.
uz: Agar siz kabi, hayvonlarni tajribadan biladigan odam hech bo'lmaganda yaxshi tasavvurga ega bo'lmasa, kim uni sinab ko'rishi kerak?

en: It seems to me that `ere wolf escaped—simply because he wanted to get out. From the hearty way that both Thomas and his wife laughed at the joke I could see that it had done service before, and that the whole explanation was simply an elaborate sell.
uz: Menga o'xshaydiki, `ere bo'ri qochib ketib qochdisodiq u chiqmoqchi edi.Tomas va uning rafiqasi o'sha hazildan kulishganidan ko'rinib turibdiki, bu avval ham xizmat ko'rsatgan va butun tushuntirish shunchaki o'ziga xos sotilish edi.

en: I couldn't cope in badinage with the worthy Thomas, but I thought I knew a surer way to his heart, so I said,Now, Mr.
uz: Men munosib Tomas bilan badinage bilan kurasholmadim, lekin men uning yuragiga yaqinlashish uchun eng ishonchli yo'lni bilardim, deb o'yladim, shuning uchun men dedim, Hndi, Mr.

en: Bilder, we'll consider that ﬁrst half-sovereign worked off, and this brother of his is waiting to be claimed when you've told me what you think will happen. Right y`are, Sir, he said briskly.
uz: Bilder, biz birinchi yarim hukmdorning ishini bajarganini ko'rib chiqamiz va siz nima bo'lishini o'ylayotganingizni menga aytganingizda, uning aka-ukalari o'zlariga tegishli bo'lishini kutmoqdalar.

en: Ye`ll excoose me, I know, for a-chaf- ﬁn' of ye, but the old woman her winked at me, which was as much as telling me to go on. Well, I never! said the old lady.
uz: Siz meni o'zingizdan kechirishingizni bilaman, lekin keksa ayol menga ko'z yumdi, bu menga davom etishimni aytgandek edi. - Men hech qachon! - dedi keksa ayol.

en: My opinion is this.
uz: Mening fikrim shunday.

en: That `ere wolf is a`idin' of, somewheres.
uz: O'sha qurt o'zi qayerda bo'lsa, o'zini o'zi o'zi o'ldiradi.

en: The gard`ner wot didn't remember said he was a-gallopin' northward faster than a horse could go, but I don't believe him, for, yer see, Sir, wolves don't gal- lop no more nor dogs does, they not bein' built that way.
uz: Gardner wot o'zidan oldin otdan tezroq shimoliga ketayotganini aytganini eslay olmagan, lekin men unga ishonmayman, chunki, ey, xonim, bo'rilar endi galop qilmaydi, itlar ham qilmaydi, ular shunday qurilmagan.

en: Wolves is ﬁne things in a storybook, and I dessay when they gets in packs and does be chivyin' somethin' that's more afeared than they is they can make a devil of a noise and chop it up, whatever it is.
uz: Qurtlar hikoya kitobidagi ajoyib narsalardir va men ular to'plamga to'lganida va ular qo'rqqan narsadan qo'rqqanida, ular shovqincha ovoz chiqarib, uni parchalashlari mumkin.

en: But, Lor' bless you, in real life a wolf is only a low creature, not half so clever or bold as a good dog, and not half a quarter so much ﬁght in `im.
uz: Ammo, Xudo sizga baraka bersin, haqiqiy hayotda bo'ri faqat past mavjudot, yaxshi it kabi yarim aqlli yoki jasoratli emas, va `imda yarim chorakgacha ko'p jang qilmaydi.

en: This one ain't been used to ﬁghtin' or even to providin' for hisself, and more like he's somewhere round the Park a'hidin' an' a'shiverin' of, and if he thinks at all, wonderin' where he is to get his breakfast from.
uz: Bu kishi kurashishga yoki hatto o'zini ta'minlash uchun ishlatilmagan, aksincha, u Park atrofida bir joyda o'zini yashirgan va o'ylab ko'rgan bo'lsa, kechki ovqatni qayerdan olishni o'ylaydi.

en: Or maybe he's got down some area and is in a coal cellar.
uz: Yoki u bir joyga tushdi va ko'mir sotuvidan.

en: My eye, won't some cook get a rum start when she sees his green eyes a- shinin' at her out of the dark!
uz: Mening ko'zim, qandaydir oshpaz uning yashil ko'zlari qorong'ilikdan unga nur sochayotganini ko'rgach, rumni boshlaydi!

en: If he can't get food he's bound to look for it, and mayhap he may chance to light on a butcher's shop in time.
uz: Agar oziq-ovqat topolmasa, uni qidirishga majbur bo'ladi va ehtimol u o'z vaqtida buzoqxonani yoqishga muvaffaq bo'ladi.

en: If he doesn't, and some nursemaid goes out walkin' or orf with a soldier, leavin' of the hinfant in the perambulator—well, then I shouldn't be surprised if the census is one babby the less.
uz: Bordi-yu, u yo'q bo'lsa va ba'zi bog'bonlar bir askar bilan yurib ketishsa va o'g'il bolalarini ko'chma-ko'chma joyda qoldirishsa, agar ko'pchilik sonini ko'rib chiqayotgan bo'lsa, men hayron bo'lmasam kerak.

en: That's all. I was handing him the half-sovereign, when something came bobbing up against the window, and Mr.
uz: Mana shu.  Men unga yarim hukmronlikni berayotgan edim, ammo bir narsa oynaning o'ng tomonida o'tib ketayotgan edi va Mr.

en: Bilder's face doubled its natural length with
uz: Bilderning yuzi tabiiy uzunligini ikki baravar ko'paytirdi.

en: God bless me! he said.
uz: Alloh menga baraka bersin! - dedi u.

en: If there ain't old Bersicker come back by `isself! He went to the door and opened it, a most unnecessary proceeding it seemed to me.
uz: Agar eski Bersicker yo'q bo'lsa, o'zi qaytib kel! - dedi u eshikga borib, uni ochdi, bu menga juda zaruriy bo'lmagan ish ko'rindi.

en: I have always thought that a wild animal never looks so well as when some obstacle of pronounced durability is between us.
uz: Men har doim yovvoyi hayvon o'zimiz o'rtasida aniq barqarorlik to'siqlari bo'lganida yaxshi ko'rinmaydi deb o'yladim.

en: A personal experience has intensiﬁed rather than diminished that idea.
uz: Shaxsiy tajriba bu g'oyani kamaytirishning o'rniga kuchaytirdi.

en: After all, however, there is nothing like custom, for neither Bilder nor his wife thought any more of the wolf than I should of a dog.
uz: Axir, odatga o'xshash hech narsa yo'q, chunki Bilder ham, uning xotini ham bo'lsa ham, men it haqida o'ylamaganimdek, bo'ri haqida o'ylamagan.

en: The animal itself was a peaceful and well-behaved as that father of all picture-wolves, Red Riding Hood's quondam friend, whilst moving her conﬁdence in masquerade.
uz: Hayvonning o'zi tinch va yaxshi xulq-atvorli bo'lib, barcha suratli bo'rilarning otasi, Qizil Riding Hoodning quondam do'sti sifatida o'zini mashq qilishda ishonch hosil qildi.

en: The whole scene was a unutterable mixture of comedy and pathos.
uz: Butun sahna komediya va patosning o'ziga xos aralashuvidir.

en: The wicked wolf that for a half a day had paralyzed London and set all the chil- dren in town shivering in their shoes, was there in a sort of penitent mood, and was received and petted like a sort of vulpine prodigal son.
uz: Londonni yarim kun davomida toʻxtatgan va shahardagi barcha odamlarni titrab-tirib, oʻz poyabzallariga qoʻyib olgan yovuz qurt oʻsha yerda tavba ruhida edi va u bir xil vulpin oʻgʻil kabi qabul qilindi va quchoqlandi.

en: Old Bilder examined him all over with most tender solicitude, and when he had ﬁn- ished with his penitent said, There, I knew the poor old chap would get into some kind of trouble.
uz: Old Bilder uni hamma joyda juda mehribonlik bilan ko'rib chiqdi va tavba qilganidan so'ng: Men bu kambag'al keksa odamning qandaydir muammolarga tushib ketishini bilardim.

en: Didn't I say it all along?
uz: Men hamisha aytmaganmanmi?

en: Here's his head all cut and full of broken glass.
uz: Mana, uning boshini kesib tashladi va buzilgan shisha bilan to'ldirdi.

en: `E's been a-gettin' over some bloomin' wall or other.
It's a shyme that people are allowed to top their walls with broken bottles.
uz: Odamlarga o'z devorlarini buzilgan shishalar bilan to'plashga ruxsat berish uyatdir.

en: This `ere's what comes of it.
uz: Bu o'z navbatida o'zgaradi.

en: Come along, Bersicker. He took the wolf and locked him up in a cage, with a piece of meat that satisﬁed, in quantity at any rate, the elementary conditions of the fatted calf, and went off to report.
uz: Kel, Bersicker. U o'rtoqni olib, qovurga o'tkazdi va uning go'shti, hech bo'lmaganda miqdorda, yog'li buzoqni to'ldirgan bo'lsa-da, uning asosiy sharoitlarini qondirgan va xabar berish uchun jo'nab ketdi.

en: I came off too, to report the only exclusive information that is given to- day regarding the strange escapade at the Zoo.
uz: Men ham hayvonot bog'ida sodir bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy voqea haqida bugungi kunda berilgan yagona eksklyuziv ma'lumot haqida xabar berishga keldim.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 17 September.—I was engaged after dinner in my study posting up my books, which, through press of other work and the many visits to Lucy, had fallen sadly into arrear.
uz: SEWARDning DYARI 17 sentabr.Men o'z studiyamda kechki ovqatdan so'ng kitoblarimni yozib qo'ygan edim, ammo boshqa kitoblarning nashri va Lusiga ko'p marta tashriflar tufayli bu kitoblar orqaga surildi.

en: Suddenly the door was burst open, and in rushed my patient, with his face distorted with passion.
uz: Toʻsatdan eshik ochildi va mening bemorim gʻayrat bilan yuzidan buzilgan holda shoshilib kirdi.

en: I was thunderstruck, for such a thing as a patient getting of his own accord into the Superintendent's study is almost unknown.
uz: Men hayron qoldim, chunki bemor o'z ixtiyori bilan nazoratchining xonasiga kirishi deyarli noma'lum.

en: Without an instant's notice he made straight at me.
uz: O'sha paytning o'zida u menga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarab turdi.

en: He had a dinner knife in his hand, and as I saw he was dangerous, I tried to keep the table between
uz: Uning qo'lida kechki ovqat pichoqlari bor edi va men uning xavfli ekanini ko'rib, o'rtasida o'tirish uchun o'rinni saqlashga harakat qildim.

en: He was too quick and too strong for me, however, for before I could get my balance he had struck at me and cut my left wrist rather severely.
uz: Ammo u men uchun juda tez va kuchli edi, chunki men muvozanatni saqlab qolishimdan oldin u menga urib, chap qo'limni juda qattiq kesib yubordi.

en: Before he could strike again, however, I got in my right hand and he was sprawling on his back on the ﬂoor.
uz: Biroq, u yana urishidan oldin men o'ng qo'limga tushdim va u o'z orqasida yerga yiqilibdi.

en: My wrist bled freely, and quite a little pool trickled on to the carpet.
uz: Qo'limni erkin qon ketardi va kamdan-kam hovuz ko'ylakga tushib ketdi.

en: I saw that my friend was not intent on further effort, and occupied myself binding up my wrist, keeping a wary eye on the prostrate ﬁgure all the time.
uz: Do'stimning qo'limni bog'lab, o'zimni mashg'ul qildim va o'zimni qo'limni bog'lab qo'ydim va o'zimni o'zim bilan mashg'ul qildim.

en: When the attendants rushed in, and we turned our attention to him, his employment positively sickened me.
uz: Xizmatchilar shoshilib kelib, biz unga e'tiborimizni qaratganimizda, uning ishlashi meni chindan ham bezovta qildi.

en: He was lying on his belly on the ﬂoor licking up, like a dog, the blood which had fallen from my wounded wrist.
uz: U qorinida yerga yonib, o'zimning jarohatlangan qo'limdan tushgan qonni it kabi yutib o'tirgan edi.

en: He was easily secured, and to my surprise, went with the attendants quite placidly, simply repeating over and over again, The blood is the life!
uz: U osonlikcha himoyalangan edi va meni hayratda qoldirganida, u xizmatkorlar bilan juda tinchlik bilan birga edi, shunchaki qayta-qayta takrorlab: Qon hayotdir!

en: The blood is the life! I cannot afford to lose blood just at present.
uz: Qon hayotdir! - deb o'ylashim mumkin emas. Men hozirda qonni yo'qotishga haqim yo'q.

en: I have lost too much of late for my physical good, and then the prolonged strain of Lucy's illness and its horrible phases is telling on me.
uz: Oxirgi paytlarda jismoniy sog'lig'im uchun juda ko'p narsani yo'qotdim va keyin Luusiyning kasalligi va uning dahshatli bosqichlarining uzoq davom etishi menga ta'sir qilmoqda.

en: I am over excited and weary, and I need rest, rest, rest.
uz: Men juda g'ayratli va charchaganman va dam olishga, dam olishga, dam olishga muhtojman.

en: Happily Van Helsing has not summoned me, so I need not forego my sleep.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, Van Helsing meni chaqirmagan, shuning uchun uyquimdan voz kechishim shart emas.

en: Tonight I could not well do without it.
uz: Bu kecha men uni yo'q qilishim mumkin emas edi.

en: TELEGRAM, VAN HELSING, ANTWERP, TO SEWARD, CARFAX (Sent to Carfax, Sussex, as no county given, delivered late by twenty-two hours.) 17 September.—Do not fail to be at Hilllingham tonight.
uz: TELEGRAM, VAN HELSING, ANTWERP, SEWARD, CARFAX (Carfax, Sussexga jo'natilgan, hech qanday ma'muriyat berilmagan, yigirma ikki soatda kechiktirib yuborilgan) 17 sentabr.Bu kecha Hilllinghamda bo'lishga to'g'ri kelmang.

en: If not watching all the time, frequently visit and see that ﬂowers are as placed, very impor- tant, do not fail.
uz: Agar doim kuzatib turmasangiz, tez-tez tashrif buyurib, gullarning joylashtirilganini ko'rib chiqing, bu juda muhimdir.

en: Shall be with you as soon as possible after arrival.
uz: Kelgandan so'ng imkon qadar tezroq siz bilan birga bo'ladi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 18 September.—Just off train to London.
uz: SEWARD'S DIARY 18 sentabr.Londonga ketadigan poezddan o'tib ketyapman.

en: The arrival of Van Helsing's telegram ﬁlled me with dismay.
uz: Van Helsingning telegramasi kelganida men juda xavotirlandim.

en: A whole night lost, and I know by bitter ex- perience what may happen in a night.
uz: To'liq kecha yo'qolgan va men bir kecha ichida nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'zimning achchiq tajribamdan bilaman.

en: Of course it is possible that all may be well, but what may have happened?
uz: Albatta, hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin, lekin nima sodir bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Surely there is some horrible doom hanging over us that every possible accident should thwart us in all we try to do.
uz: Bizni bosib o'tgan dahshatli halokat, har qanday baxtsiz hodisa biz qilayotgan barcha harakatlarimizga to'sqinlik qilishi kerak.

en: I shall take this cylinder with me, and then I can complete my entry on Lucy's phonograph.
uz: Men bu silindrni o'zim bilan olib ketaman va keyin Lusiyaning fonografida yozishimni yakunlay olaman.

en: MEMORANDUM LEFT BY LUCY WESTENRA 17 September, Night.—I write this and leave it to be seen, so that no one may by any chance get into trouble through me.
uz: LUCY WESTENRA tomonidan qoldirilgan xat 17 sentabr kuni kechasi.Men buni yozaman va uni ko'rish uchun qoldiraman, shunda hech kim men orqali muammolarga duch kelmasligi mumkin.

en: This is an exact record of what took place tonight.
uz: Bu kecha sodir bo'lgan voqealarning aniq ro'yxati.

en: I feel I am dying of weakness, and have barely strength to write, but it must be done if I die in the doing.
uz: O'zimni zaiflikdan o'lib ketayotganimni his qilaman va yozish uchun kuchim oz, lekin agar o'lib ketsam, bu qilish kerak.

en: I went to bed as usual, taking care that the ﬂowers were placed as Dr.
uz: Men odatdagidek uxlashga ketdim va gullarni Dr. sifatida joylashtirishga g'amxo'rlik qildim.

en: Van Helsing directed, and soon fell asleep.
uz: Van Helsing rejissyorlik qildi va ko'p o'tmay uxladi.

en: I was waked by the ﬂapping at the window, which had begun after that sleep-walking on the cliff at Whitby when Mina saved me, and which now I know so well.
uz: Men o'zimni uyg'otdim, chunki men Mina meni qutqargan Whitbydagi qirg'oqqa o'tirganidan keyin boshlangan va endi men uni juda yaxshi bilaman.

en: I was not afraid, but I did wish that Dr.
uz: Men qo'rqmadim, lekin Dr.

en: Seward was in the next room, as Dr.
uz: Seward yonidagi xonada doktor sifatida o'tirgan.

en: Van Helsing said he would be, so that I might have called him.
uz: Van Helsing shunday deb aytdi, shuning uchun uni qo'ng'iroq qilishim mumkin edi.

en: I tried to sleep, but I could not.
uz: Men uxlashga harakat qildim, lekin qila olmadim.

en: Then there came to me the old fear of sleep, and I determined to keep awake.
uz: Keyin uyqudan qo'rqqanim paydo bo'ldi va men uyg'onmaslikka qaror qildim.

en: Perversely sleep would try to come then when I did not want it.
uz: Men xohlamagan paytda yomon uyqu kelishga harakat qilardi.

en: So, as I feared to be alone, I opened my door and called out.
uz: Shunday qilib, yolg'iz qolishdan qo'rqqanim uchun eshikni ochdim va baqirdim.

en: Is there anybody there? There was no answer.
uz: O'sha yerda kimdir bormi? deb so'raganida hech qanday javob yo'q edi.

en: I was afraid to wake mother, and so closed my door again.
uz: Onamni uyg'otishdan qo'rqardim, shuning uchun eshikni yana yopdim.

en: Then outside in the shrub- bery I heard a sort of howl like a dog's, but more ﬁerce and deeper.
uz: Keyin tashqarida, butalar ichida itning qichqirishini eshitdim, ammo bu qattiqroq va chuqurroq edi.

en: I went to the window and looked out, but could see nothing, except a big bat, which had evidently been buffeting its wings against the window.
uz: Oynaga borib ko'rdim, lekin katta tuxumdan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmadim, u, ko'rinib turib, o'z qanotlarini oynaga tikib qo'ygan edi.

en: So I went back to bed again, but determined not to go to sleep.
uz: Shunday qilib, yana uxlashga ketdim, lekin uxlamaslikka qat'iy qaror qildim.

en: Presently the door opened, and mother looked in.
uz: Darhol eshik ochildi va onam ichkariga qaradi.

en: Seeing by my moving that I was not asleep, she came in and sat by me.
uz: Mening harakatlarimdan uyquda emasligimni ko'rib, u kirib, yonimga o'tirdi.

en: She said to me even more sweetly and softly than her wont, I was uneasy about you, darling, and came in to see that you were all right. I feared she might catch cold sitting there, and asked her to come in and sleep with me, so she came into bed, and lay down beside me.
uz: U menga odatidan ko'ra yanada shirin va muloyim tarzda: Sening uchun xavotirda edim, azizim, va sen yaxshi ekanligingni ko'rishga keldim, - dedi. Men u yerda o'tirganidan qo'rqardim va u sovuq bo'lishi mumkinligini aytdim va men bilan birga yotishga kirishini so'radim, shuning uchun u yotoqqa kirib, yonimda o'tirdi.

en: She did not take off her dressing gown, for she said she would only stay a while and then go back to her own bed.
uz: U o'zining kiyimini olib tashlamadi, chunki u faqat bir muncha vaqt qolishini va keyin o'z yotoqxonasiga qaytishini aytdi.

en: As she lay there in my arms, and I in hers the ﬂapping and buffeting came to the window again.
uz: U mening qo'llarimda, men esa uning qo'llarida yotganimda, yana bir bor o'sha darchaga qo'l urish va shovqinlar keldi.

en: She was startled and a little frightened, and cried out, What is that? I tried to pacify her, and at last succeeded, and she lay quiet.
uz: U qo'rqib, biroz qo'rqqan va: Bu nima? - deb baqirdi. Men uni tinchlantirishga harakat qildim va nihoyat muvaffaqiyatga erishdim.

en: But I could hear her poor dear heart still beating terribly.
uz: Ammo men uning kambag'al qahrli yuragining hali ham dahshatli urishini eshitardim.

en: After a while there was the howl again out in the shrubbery, and shortly after there was a crash at the window, and a lot of broken glass was hurled on the ﬂoor.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgandan so'ng, o'rmonda yana yig'i-yig'i bo'ldi va biroz o'tgandan so'ng, darcha tushib ketdi va katta miqdorda shikastlangan shisha yerga tashlandi.

en: The window blind blew back with the wind that rushed in, and in the aperture of the bro- ken panes there was the head of a great, gaunt gray wolf.
uz: Shamol o'tib ketayotganda, darcha ko'rgich o'tib ketdi va ko'rinish panellari ochilmasida katta bo'lakning boshi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Mother cried out in a fright, and struggled up into a sitting posture, and clutched wildly at anything that would help her.
uz: Onam qo'rqib qichqirib, o'tirgan holatga tushdi va unga yordam beradigan har qanday narsaga qattiq qo'shildi.

en: Amongst other things, she clutched the wreath of ﬂowers that Dr.
uz: U, shu qatorda, Dr.

en: Van Helsing insisted on my wearing round my neck, and tore it away from me.
uz: Van Helsing mening bo'yni atrofida kiyinishimni istaydi va uni mendan ajratib yubordi.

en: For a second or two she sat up, pointing at the wolf, and there was a strange and horrible gurgling in her throat.
uz: Bir-ikki soniya davomida u o'rnidan turib, bo'riqqa ko'rsatdi va uning bo'yniga g'alati va dahshatli bir gurg'ullash paydo bo'ldi.

en: Then she fell over, as if struck with lightning, and her head hit my forehead and made me dizzy for a moment or two.
uz: So'ngra u chaqmoq bilan uringan bo'lib yiqildi va boshini oldimga urib, bir-ikki daqiqa boshimni burib qo'ydi.

en: The room and all round seemed to spin round.
uz: Xona va butun atrof aylanib borayotganga o'xshardi.

en: I kept my eyes ﬁxed on the window, but the wolf drew his head back, and a whole myriad of little specks seems to come blowing in through the broken window, and wheeling and circling round like the pillar of dust that travellers describe when there is a simoon in the desert.
uz: Ko'zlarimni darchaga qaratib turdim, lekin o'rtoq boshini orqaga tortdi va butunlay ko'plab kichik maydalar buzilgan darcha orqali puflab kirib, sahroda simon bo'lganda sayohatchilar tasvirlaydigan tuproq ustuni kabi aylanib-tiroflab borayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I tried to stir, but there was some spell upon me, and dear Mother's poor body, which seemed to grow cold already, for her dear heart had ceased to beat, weighed me down, and I remembered no more for a while.
uz: Qo'zg'atishga harakat qildim, lekin menga bir xil sehr keldi va aziz Onamning kambag'al tanasi, uning aziz yuragi urishni to'xtatgani uchun allaqachon sovuq bo'lib qolgan edi, meni og'irlab qo'ydi va men bir muncha vaqt davomida eslamagan edim.

en: The time did not seem long, but very, very awful, till I recovered con- sciousness again.
uz: Vaqt uzoq emas, lekin juda, juda dahshatli tuyuldi, chunki men yana ongimga qaytdim.

en: Somewhere near, a passing bell was tolling.
uz: Yaqinda bir joyda o'tib ketayotgan qo'ng'iroq to'lovni qo'zg'atardi.

en: The dogs all round the neighborhood were howling, and in our shrubbery, seemingly just outside, a nightingale was singing.
uz: Mahalla atrofidagi itlar qichqirishardi va bizning butalarimizda, ko'rinib turganidek, tashqariga bir kechkival qo'shiq kuylashardi.

en: I was dazed and stupid with pain and ter- ror and weakness, but the sound of the nightingale seemed like the voice of my dead mother come back to comfort me.
uz: Men og'riq, dahshat va zaiflikdan o'zimni ko'rmay, aqldan ozgan edim, lekin kechqurunning ovozi meni tasalli berishga o'lgan onamning ovozi qaytib kelganidek tuyuldi.

en: The sounds seemed to have awakened the maids, too, for I could hear their bare feet pattering outside my door.
uz: O'sha tovushlar xizmatkorlarni ham uyg'otgandek tuyuldi, chunki men ularning cho'cha-cho'chalarini eshikdan tashqarida eshitardim.

en: I called to them, and they came in, and when they saw what had happened, and what it was that lay over me on the bed, they screamed out.
uz: Men ularni chaqirdim, ular kirishdi va nima sodir bo'lganini va to'shagimda mening ustimda nima yotganini ko'rganlarida, ular qichqirishdi.

en: The wind rushed in through the broken window, and the door slammed to.
uz: Shamol bo'g'ilgan deraza orqali kirib keldi va eshik to'qnashdi.

en: They lifted off the body of my dear mother, and laid her, covered up with a sheet, on the bed after I had got up.
uz: Men turgandan so'ng, ular mening aziz onamning jasadini olib, uni to'qima bilan qoplab, to'shakda qo'ydilar.

en: They were all so frightened and nervous that I directed them to go to the dining room and each have a glass of wine.
uz: Ularning barchasi shunchalik qo'rqib, g'alati bo'lishganki, men ularga ovqatxonaga borishni va har biri bir stakan sharob ichishni buyurdim.

en: The door ﬂew open for an instant and closed again.
uz: Eshik bir zumga ochildi va yana yopildi.

en: The maids shrieked, and then went in a body to the dining room, and I laid what ﬂowers I had on my dear mother's breast.
uz: Xizmatchilar qichqirishdi, so'ngra o'z joniga kirib, oshxonaga kirdim va men yoqimli onamning ko'ksiga gullar qo'ydim.

en: When they were there I remembered what Dr.
uz: Ular u yerda bo'lganida, doktorning so'zlariga eslatib o'tdim.

en: Van Helsing had told me, but I didn't like to remove them, and besides, I would have some of the servants to sit up with me now.
uz: Van Helsing menga aytgan edi, lekin men ularni olib tashlashni yoqtirmadim va bundan tashqari, hozir menga xizmatkorlardan ba'zilari o'tirishi kerak edi.

en: I was surprised that the maids did not come back.
uz: Xizmatchilar qaytib kelmagani meni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: I called them, but got no answer, so I went to the dining room to look for them.
uz: Men ularga qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin hech qanday javob olmadi, shuning uchun ularni qidirish uchun oshxonaga bordim.

en: My heart sank when I saw what had happened.
uz: O'tgan voqeani ko'rgach, yuragim tushdi.

en: They all four lay helpless on the ﬂoor, breathing heavily.
uz: Ularning to'rtasi ham o'zlarining kuchini yo'qotmay, yerga yiqilib, og'ir nafas olishardi.

en: The decanter of sherry was on the table half full, but there was a queer, acrid smell about.
uz: Sherining dekanteri o'rtacha to'lgan stolda edi, ammo atrofida g'alati, achchiq hid paydo bo'ldi.

en: I was suspicious, and exam- ined the decanter.
uz: Men shubha ostiga qo'yib, dekanterni tekshirdim.

en: It smelt of laudanum, and looking on the sideboard, I found that the bottle which Mother's doctor uses for her—oh!
uz: U laudanumga xushbo'y edi va qo'shiqqa qarab, onamning shifokoridan foydalanilgan shifokorning shifokorlik shifokorligini ko'rdim!

en: I am back in the room with Mother.
uz: Men onam bilan o'z xonamga qaytib keldim.

en: I cannot leave her, and I am alone, save for the sleeping servants, whom some one has drugged.
uz: Men uni tashlab ketolmayman va u yerda yolg'izman, faqat uyqudan o'tgan xizmatkorlargina qoladi.

en: Alone with the dead!
uz: O'liklar bilan yolg'iz!

en: I dare not go out, for I can hear the low howl of the wolf through the broken window.
uz: Men tashqariga chiqishga jur'at qilmayman, chunki buzilgan deraza orqali qurtning past qichqirishini eshitaman.

en: The air seems full of specks, ﬂoating and circling in the draught from the window, and the lights burn blue and dim.
uz: Havo toshlar bilan to'lib-toshgan ko'rinadi, u oynadan ko'tarilib turadi va chiroqlar ko'k rangda yonadi.

en: God shield me from harm this night!
uz: Xudo bu kecha meni zarardan saqlasin!

en: I shall hide this paper in my breast, where they shall ﬁnd it when they come to lay me out.
uz: Men ushbu qog'ozni ko'zimga yashiraman, ular meni ko'tarishga kelganda uni topishadi.

en: My dear mother gone!
uz: Mening aziz onam yo'qoldi!

en: It is time that I go too.
uz: Men ham borishimning vaqti keldi.

en: Goodbye, dear Arthur, if I should not survive this night.
uz: Xo'sh, Artur, agar men bu kechaga omon qolmasam.

en: God keep you, dear, and God help me!
uz: Xudo seni saqlasin, aziz, Xudo menga yordam bersin!

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 18 September.—I drove at once to Hillingham and arrived early.
uz: SEWARDning 18 sentabrdagi kundaligi.Men darhol Hillinghamga bordim va erta keldim.

en: Keeping my cab at the gate, I went up the avenue alone.
uz: Taksimni darvoza oldida qoldirib, yo'lga yolg'iz chiqdim.

en: I knocked gently and rang as quietly as possible, for I feared to disturb Lucy or her mother, and hoped to only bring a servant to the door.
uz: Men Lucy yoki uning onasini bezovta qilishdan qo'rqqanim uchun, muloyimlik bilan taqillatdim va imkon qadar sekinroq qo'ng'iroq qildim va faqat xizmatkorni eshikga olib kelish umidida edim.

en: After a while, ﬁnding no response, I knocked and rang again, still no answer.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, hech qanday javob topmay, taqillatib, yana qo'ng'iroq qildim, ammo hali ham hech qanday javob yo'q edi.

en: I cursed the laziness of the servants that they should lie abed at such an hour, for it was now ten o'clock, and so rang and knocked again, but more impatiently, but still without response.
uz: Men xizmatkorlarning bunday soatda uxlab qolishlari kerak bo'lgan pichoqligini la'natladim, chunki endi soat o'n edi, shuning uchun yana qo'ng'iroq qildi va taqilladi, ammo yanada sabrsizlik bilan, ammo hali ham javobsiz.

en: Hitherto I had blamed only the servants, but now a terrible fear began to as- sail me.
uz: O'shanda men faqat xizmatkorlarni aybladim, lekin endi dahshatli qo'rquv meni kuzatib bordi.

en: Was this desolation but another link in the chain of doom which seemed drawing tight round us?
uz: Bu vayronlik biz atrofimizni to'sib turgandek tuyulgan halokat zanjirining yana bir bo'g'ini bo'lganmi?

en: Was it indeed a house of death to which I had come, too late?
uz: Haqiqatan ham men kech kelib qolgan o'lim uyi edi?

en: I know that minutes, even seconds of delay, might mean hours of danger to Lucy, if she had had again one of those frightful relapses, and I went round the house to try if I could ﬁnd by chance an entry any- where.
uz: Men bir necha daqiqa, hatto ikki soniya kechikish, Lusi uchun yana shunday dahshatli qaytishlarni boshdan kechirganida soatlab xavf tug'dirishi mumkinligini bilaman, shuning uchun uyni aylanib o'tdim va tasodifan biron bir kirish joyini topishga harakat qildim.

en: I could ﬁnd no means of ingress.
uz: Men kirish yo'lini topolmadim.

en: Every window and door was fas- tened and locked, and I returned bafﬂed to the porch.
uz: Har bir deraza va eshik qulflab qo'yilgan va qulflab qo'yilgan edi va men hayron xonadonga qaytib keldim.

en: As I did so, I heard the rapid pit-pat of a swiftly driven horse's feet.
uz: O'shanda tez haydalgan otning oyoqlarining tezlik bilan bo'lgan pit-patini eshitdim.

en: They stopped at the gate, and a few seconds later I met Van Helsing running up the avenue.
uz: Ular darvoza oldida to'xtadi va bir necha soniyadan so'ng men Van Helsingni yo'ldan yugurib borayotganda uchratdim.

en: When he saw me, he gasped out, Then it was you, and just arrived.
uz: Meni ko'rganida, u: Seni o'ldirgan bo'lsa kerak va hozirgina kelding.

en: Did you not get my telegram? I answered as quickly and coherently as I could that I had only got his telegram early in the morning, and had not a minute in coming here, and that I could not make any one in the house hear me.
uz: Mening telegramamni olmadingizmi? - deb, imkon qadar tez va aniq javob berdim. Men uning telegramasini ertalabgina olgan edim va bu yerga kelishga bir daqiqa ham yo'q edi, uydagi hech kimni eshitishga majbur qila olmasdim.

en: He paused and raised his hat as he said solemnly, Then I fear we are too late.
uz: U to'xtatib, to'pini ko'tarib, tantanali so'zlarni aytdi: Shunday bo'lsa, qo'rqamanki, biz juda kechmiz.

en: God's will be done! With his usual recuperative energy, he went on, Come.
uz: Xudoning irodasi bajo kelsin! - deb, odatdagi tiklanish energiyasi bilan davom etdi.

en: If there be no way open to get in, we must make one.
uz: Agar kirish yo'li ochilmasa, biz bir yo'l yaratishimiz kerak.

en: Time is all in all to us now.
uz: Vaqt hozir biz uchun hamma narsadir.

en: We went round to the back of the house, where there was a kitchen win- dow.
uz: Biz uyning orqasidan borib, oshxonada oshxona bor edi.

en: The Professor took a small surgical saw from his case, and handing it to me, pointed to the iron bars which guarded the window.
uz: Professor o'z holatidan kichik bir jarrohlik pichoqini olib, menga berdi va darvozani himoya qiladigan temir barlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: I attacked them at once and had very soon cut through three of them.
uz: Men ularni darhol hujum qildim va tez orada ulardan uchini kesib yubordim.

en: Then with a long, thin knife we pushed back the fastening of the sashes and opened the window.
uz: So'ngra biz uzun, chiroyli pichoq bilan sirtlarni o'rnatishni orqaga surib, darcha ochdik.

en: I helped the Professor in, and followed him.
uz: Professorga yordam berib, uning orqasidan ergashdim.

en: There was no one in the kitchen or in the servants' rooms, which were close at hand.
uz: oshxonada ham, yaqin atrofdagi xizmatkorlar xonalarida ham hech kim yo'q edi.

en: We tried all the rooms as we went along, and in the dining room, dimly lit by rays of light through the shutters, found four servant women lying on the ﬂoor.
uz: Yo'lda barcha xonalarni sinab ko'rdik va oshxonada, obloqalar orqali yorug'lik nurlari bilan chiroyli yoritilgan, yerda to'rtta xizmatkor ayolni topdik.

en: There was no need to think them dead, for their stertorous breathing and the acrid smell of laudanum in the room left no doubt as to their condition.
uz: Ularni o'lik deb o'ylashning hojati yo'q edi, chunki ularning tirik nafas olishlari va xonadagi laudanumning o'tkir hidlari ularning holati haqida hech qanday shubha qoldirmagan.

en: Van Helsing and I looked at each other, and as we moved away he said, We can attend to them later.Then we ascended to Lucy's room.
uz: Van Helsing va men bir-birimizga qarab turdik va ko'chib ketayotganimizda u: Ularga keyinroq g'amxo'rlik qilishimiz mumkin, - dedi.

en: For an in- stant or two we paused at the door to listen, but there was no sound that we could hear.
uz: Bir-ikki marta eshik oldida to'xtab, tingladik, lekin eshitadigan tovush yo'q edi.

en: With white faces and trembling hands, we opened the door gen- tly, and entered the room.
uz: Oq yuz va titrayotgan qo'llar bilan eshikni ochib, xonamizga kirdik.

en: How shall I describe what we saw?
uz: Biz ko'rgan narsalarni qanday tasvirlashim kerak?

en: On the bed lay two women, Lucy and her mother.
uz: Yotoq ustida ikkita ayol, Lusi va uning onasi yotgan edi.

en: The latter lay farthest in, and she was covered with a white sheet, the edge of which had been blown back by the drought through the broken window, showing the drawn, white, face, with a look of terror ﬁxed upon it.
uz: Qirg'iz eng uzoqda joylashgan edi va u oq varaqa bilan qoplangan edi, uning chegarasi qurg'oqchilik tomonidan buzilgan deraza orqali o'chib ketib, uning ustiga qo'rqinchli ko'rinish qo'yilgan suratni ko'rsatdi.

en: By her side lay Lucy, with face white and still more drawn.
uz: Uning yonida Lucy o'tirgan edi, yuzlari oq va yana ko'proq ko'rinadi.

en: The ﬂowers which had been round her neck we found upon her mother's bosom, and her throat was bare, showing the two little wounds which we had no- ticed before, but looking horribly white and mangled.
uz: Uning bo'yni atrofida bo'lgan gullarni onasining ko'krakida topdik va uning bo'yni yalang'och bo'lib, biz ilgari hech qanday jarohat ko'rmagan ikkita kichkina jarohatni ko'rsatdi, ammo u dahshatli oq va parchalangan ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: Without a word the Professor bent over the bed, his head almost touching poor Lucy's breast.
uz: Professor bir so'z aytmasdan, boshini to'xtatib, kashshof Lusiyaning ko'krasiga yaqinlashib qoldi.

en: Then he gave a quick turn of his head, as of one who listens, and leaping to his feet, he cried out to me, It is not yet too late!
uz: Keyin u boshini tez o'zgartirib, tinglovchi kabi bo'ldi va oyoqlariga ko'tarilib, menga: Hazr emas!

en: Bring the brandy! I ﬂew downstairs and returned with it, taking care to smell and taste it, lest it, too, were drugged like the decanter of sherry which I found on the table.
uz: Brandyni olib kelinglar! - deb, pastga o'tirib, uni olib qaytib keldim va uni hidlab, taomlashga ehtiyot bo'ldim, toki u ham stol ustida topgan sherry dekanterini o'xshatib, zaharlanmasin.

en: The maids were still breathing, but more restlessly, and I fancied that the narcotic was wearing off.
uz: Xizmatchilar hali ham nafas olishardi, lekin ko'proq qayg'urishardi, men esa narkotik moddalarning o'tib ketayotganini his qildim.

en: I did not stay to make sure, but returned to Van Helsing.
uz: Men ishonch hosil qilish uchun qolmadim, balki Van Helsinga qaytdim.

en: He rubbed the brandy, as on another occasion, on her lips and gums and on her wrists and the palms of her hands.
uz: Boshqa safargidek, u brendni uning og'zaki va ildizlariga, qo'llari va qo'l qo'llari ustiga aralashtirdi.

en: He said to me, I can do this, all that can be at the present.
uz: U menga shunday dedi: Men buni qila olaman, hozirda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsani.

en: You go wake those maids.
uz: Siz o'sha xizmatkorlarni uyg'oting.

en: Flick them in the face with a wet towel, and ﬂick them hard.
uz: Ularni issiq to'shak bilan yuzlariga tikib, qattiq tikib qo'ying.

en: Make them get heat and ﬁre
uz: Ular issiqlik va olovga ega bo'lishlariga yordam bering

en: This poor soul is nearly as cold as that beside her.
uz: Bu kambag'al ruh uning yonidagi kabi sovuqdir.

en: She will need be heated before we can do anything more. I went at once, and found little difﬁculty in waking three of the women.
uz: Biz boshqa hech narsa qila olmagunimiz uchun uni isitish kerak bo'ladi. Men darhol bordim va uchta ayolni uyg'otishda oz qiyinchiliklarga duch keldim.

en: The fourth was only a young girl, and the drug had evidently affected her more strongly so I lifted her on the sofa and let her sleep.
uz: To'rtinchi qiz atigi yosh qiz edi va giyohvand moddalar uni yanada kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatgani aniq edi, shuning uchun men uni kanepadan ko'tarib, uxlashga ruxsat berdim.

en: The others were dazed at ﬁrst, but as remembrance came back to them they cried and sobbed in a hysterical manner.
uz: Boshqalari boshida g'alati edilar, lekin eslatma qaytib kelganida, ular histerik tarzda yig'lab yig'lab yubordilar.

en: I was stern with them, howev- er, and would not let them talk.
uz: Men ularga qattiqqo'l bo'lib, gapirishlariga yo'l qo'ymaganman.

en: I told them that one life was bad enough to lose, and if they delayed they would sacriﬁce Miss Lucy.
uz: Men ularga bitta hayotni yo'qotish uchun etarlicha yomon ekanligini va agar ular kechiksalar, Miss Lucyni qurbon qilishlarini aytdim.

en: So, sobbing and crying they went about their way, half clad as they were, and prepared ﬁre and water.
uz: Shunday qilib, yig'lab-ichib, yarim kiyimda o'z yo'llariga borishdi va olov va suv tayyorlab qo'yishdi.

en: Fortunately, the kitchen and boiler ﬁres were still alive, and there was no lack of hot water.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, oshxonada va qozonlarda yong'inlar hali ham tirik edi va issiq suv yetishmas edi.

en: We got a bath and carried Lucy out as she was and placed her in it.
uz: Biz suvga cho'mdik va Lusiyani xuddi shunday olib chiqdik va unga joylashtirdik.

en: Whilst we were busy chaﬁng her limbs there was a knock at the hall door.
uz: Biz uning a'zolari bilan mashg'ul bo'lganimizda, chodir eshigida taqillash yuz berdi.

en: One of the maids ran off, hurried on some more clothes, and opened it.
uz: Xizmatkorlardan biri yugurib, ko'proq kiyim olib, uni ochdi.

en: Then she returned and whispered to us that there was a gentle- man who had come with a message from Mr.
uz: So'ngra u qaytib kelib, bizga bir odamning Mr.dan xabar olib kelganini xuloflantirdi.

en: I bade her simply tell him that he must wait, for we could see no one now.
uz: Men unga shunchaki kutib turishi kerakligini aytishni aytdim, chunki hozir hech kimni ko'rmaymiz.

en: She went away with the message, and, engrossed with our work, I clean forgot all about him.
uz: U xabarni olib ketib ketdi va ishimiz bilan band bo'lib, men u haqda butunlay unutib qoldim.

en: I never saw in all my experience the Professor work in such deadly earnest.
uz: O'z tajribam davomida hech qachon professorning bunday o'limga olib boradigan g'ayrat bilan ishlashini ko'rmaganman.

en: I knew, as he knew, that it was a stand-up ﬁght with death, and in a pause told him so.
uz: Men uning bilganidek, bu o'limga qarshi kurash ekanligini bilardim va biroz to'xtab, unga shunday aytdim.

en: He answered me in a way that I did not understand, but with the sternest look that his face could wear.
uz: U men tushunmagan tarzda javob berdi, lekin yuzidagi eng qatʼiy koʻrinish bilan.
