en: If that were all, I would stop here where we are now, and let her fade away into peace, for I see no light in life over her horizon. He went on with his work with, if possible, renewed and more frenzied vigour.
uz: Agar bularning barchasi bo'lganida, men hozirgi joyda to'xtab, uni tinchlik bilan yo'q qilishga ruxsat berardim, chunki men uning ko'rinishida hayotda hech qanday yorug'lik ko'rmayapman, - dedi u. U iloji bo'lsa, o'z ishini yangilangan va g'ayritabiiy kuch bilan davom ettirdi.

en: Presently we both began to be conscious that the heat was beginning to be of some effect.
uz: Shu paytdan boshlab ikkovimiz ham issiqlikning qandaydir ta'sir ko'rsatishni boshlaganimizni anglay boshladik.

en: Lucy's heart beat a triﬂe more audibly to the stethoscope, and her lungs had a perceptible movement.
uz: Lusiyning yuragi stetoskopga nisbatan biroz ko'proq ovoz bilan uradi va o'z samolyotlari sezilarli harakatlarga ega edi.

en: Van Helsing's face almost beamed, and as we lifted her from the bath and rolled her in a hot sheet to dry her he said to me, The ﬁrst gain is ours!
uz: Van Helsingning yuzi deyarli radial bo'lib qoldi va biz uni hammomdan ko'tarib, uni quritish uchun issiq pillaga aylantirib qo'yganimizda, u menga: Birinchi yutuq bizda!

en: Check to the King! We took Lucy into another room, which had by now been prepared, and laid her in bed and forced a few drops of brandy down her throat.
uz: Qirolga tekshirib ko'ringlar! - deb, biz Lusiyani tayyorlangan boshqa xonaga olib kirdik va uni yotoqqa qo'yib, bir necha tomchi brendni uning bo'yniga tushirib qo'ydik.

en: I noticed that Van Helsing tied a soft silk handkerchief round her throat.
uz: Men Van Helsingning uning bo'yni atrofida yumshoq ipka to'plamini bog'laganini payqadim.

en: She was still unconscious, and was quite as bad as, if not worse than, we had ever seen her.
uz: U hali ham ongidan ketmagan edi va biz uni ko'rganimizdan ham yomonroq edi.

en: Van Helsing called in one of the women, and told her to stay with her and not to take her eyes off her till we returned, and then beckoned me out of the room.
uz: Van Helsing ayollardan birini chaqirib, u bilan qolishni va biz qaytib kelmaguncha ko'zlarini ko'rmaslikni aytdi.

en: We must consult as to what is to be done, he said as we descended the stairs.
uz: Biz nima qilishimiz kerakligi haqida maslahatlashishimiz kerak, - dedi u, biz daraxtdan tushayotganimizda.

en: In the hall he opened the dining room door, and we passed in, he closing the door carefully behind him.
uz: Zalda u ovqatlanish xonasi eshigini ochdi va biz o'sha xonadan o'tib ketdik, u eshikni o'z orqasidan ehtiyotkorlik bilan yopdi.

en: The shutters had been opened, but the blinds were already down, with that obedience to the etiquette of death which the British woman of the lower classes always rigidly observes.
uz: O'lim etiqotiga bo'ysunish, eng past sinfdagi britaniyalik ayol har doim qat'iy amal qilganidek, pardalar ochilgan edi, ammo pardalar allaqachon tushdi.

en: The room was, therefore, dimly dark.
uz: Shuning uchun xonadon ko'p qorong'i edi.

en: It was, however, light enough for our pur- poses.
uz: Biroq, bu bizning maqsadlarimiz uchun etarlicha yengil edi.

en: Van Helsing's sternness was somewhat relieved by a look of perplex- ity.
uz: Van Helsingning qatʼiyligi biroz xotirjamlik bilan yengillashtirildi.

en: He was evidently torturing his mind about something, so I waited for an instant, and he spoke.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u biror narsa haqida o'z ongini qiynayotgan edi, shuning uchun men bir daqiqa kutdim va u gapirdi.

en: What are we to do now?
uz: Biz endi nima qilishimiz kerak?

en: Where are we to turn for help?
uz: Qayerdan yordam so'rashimiz mumkin?

en: We must have another transfusion of blood, and that soon, or that poor girl's life won't be worth an hour's purchase.
uz: Yana bir qon transfutsiyasi bo'lishi kerak va bu tez orada, yoki bu kambag'al qizning hayoti bir soatlik xaridga arziydigan bo'lmaydi.

en: You are exhausted already.
uz: Siz allaqachon charchagansiz.

en: I fear to trust those women, even if they would have courage to submit.
uz: Men o'sha ayollarga ishonishdan qo'rqaman, hatto ular bo'ysunish uchun jasoratli bo'lishsa ham.

en: What are we to do for some one who will open his veins for her? What's the matter with me, anyhow? The voice came from the sofa across the room, and its tones brought re- lief and joy to my heart, for they were those of Quincey Morris.
uz: Menga nima bo'ldi? - deb so'radi u. O'rinning boshqa tomonidagi sofasidan ovoz keldi va uning tovushlari yuragimga taskin va quvonch keltirdi, chunki u Quincey Morrisning tovushlari edi.

en: Van Helsing started angrily at the ﬁrst sound, but his face softened and a glad look came into his eyes as I cried out, Quincey Morris! and rushed towards him with outstretched hands.
uz: Van Helsing birinchi tovushdan g'azablanib boshladi, ammo uning yuzi yumshatildi va men Qinsey Morris! deb baqirganimda, uning ko'zlariga quvonchli ko'rinish tushdi va qo'llarini uzatgan holda unga yaqinlashdim.

en: What brought you her? I cried as our hands met.
uz: Uni senga nima keltirdi? - deb qo'llarimiz bir-biriga qo'shilganda yig'ladim.

en: I guess Art is the cause. He handed me a telegram.— `Have not heard from Seward for three days, and am terribly anxious.
uz: U menga telegramma berdi. ` Uch kun davomida Sewarddan xabarim yo'q va juda xavotirlanaman.

en: Father still in same condition.
uz: Ota hali ham xuddi shunday holatda.

en: Send me word how Lucy is.
uz: Lucy qanday holatda ekanligi haqida xabar bering.

en: Do not delay.—Holmwood.' I think I came just in the nick of time.
uz: Kechiktirmang.Holmwood.' Men o'ylaymanki, men o'z vaqtida keldim.

en: You know you have only to tell me what to do. Van Helsing strode forward, and took his hand, looking him straight in the eyes as he said, A brave man's blood is the best thing on this earth when a woman is in trouble.
uz: Sen faqat menga nima qilishim kerakligini aytishing kerakligini bilasan. Van Helsing oldinga qadam tashlab, uning qo'lini ushlab, uning ko'zlariga to'g'ri qaradi va shunday deydi: Agar ayol muammolarga duchor bo'lsa, jasoratli erkakning qoni dunyodagi eng yaxshi narsa.

en: You're a man and no mistake.
uz: Siz erkaksiz va hech qanday xato yo'q.

en: Well, the devil may work against us for all he's worth, but God sends us men when we want them. Once again we went through that ghastly operation.
uz: Demak, shayton bizga qarshi ishlaydi, lekin Xudo bizga kerak bo'lganda odamlarni yuboradi. Yana bir bor bu dahshatli operatsiyani o'tkazdik.

en: I have not the heart to go through with the details.
uz: Xususan, tafsilotlarni ko'rib chiqish uchun qalbimda kuch yo'q.

en: Lucy had got a terrible shock and it told on
uz: Lusi juda dahshatli shokga tushdi va u davom etdi.

en: her more than before, for though plenty of blood went into her veins, her body did not respond to the treatment as well as on the other occasions.
uz: U ilgari bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq ish tutgan, chunki ko'p qon damarlariga o'tgan bo'lsa-da, uning tanasi boshqa paytlarda bo'lgani kabi davolanishga javob bermagan.

en: Her struggle back into life was something frightful to see and hear.
uz: Uning hayotga qaytish kurashini ko'rish va eshitish dahshatli edi.

en: However, the action of both heart and lungs improved, and Van Helsing made a sub- cutaneous injection of morphia, as before, and with good effect.
uz: Biroq, yurak va o'pkalarning faoliyati yaxshilandi va Van Helsing avvalgidek morfiyani teriga tashlab, yaxshi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: Her faint became a profound slumber.
uz: Uning charchaganligi chuqur uyquga aylandi.

en: The Professor watched whilst I went down- stairs with Quincey Morris, and sent one of the maids to pay off one of the cabmen who were waiting.
uz: Professor men Quincey Morris bilan pastga tushayotganimda ko'z o'rab, xizmatkorlardan birini kutib turgan taksi xodimlaridan birini to'lash uchun yubordi.

en: I left Quincey lying down after having a glass of wine, and told the cook to get ready a good breakfast.
uz: Men Quinceyni bir stakan sharob ichib, uxlab qoldim va oshpazga yaxshi tushlik tayyorlashni aytdim.

en: Then a thought struck me, and I went back to the room where Lucy now was.
uz: Keyin bir fikr meni o'ziga jalb qildi va men Lusiyaning hozirgi xonasiga qaytib bordim.

en: When I came softly in, I found Van Helsing with a sheet or two of note paper in his hand.
uz: Xullas, ichkariga kirib kelganimda, Van Helsingni qo'lida bir-ikki varaq qog'oz bilan topdim.

en: He had evidently read it, and was thinking it over as he sat with his hand to his brow.
uz: U buni o'qigan va qo'lini burunlariga tikib o'tirganida o'ylayotgan edi.

en: There was a look of grim satisfaction in his face, as of one who has had a doubt solved.
uz: Uning yuzida biroz quvonchli ko'rinish ko'rinardi, xuddi shubhasi hal bo'lgan kishi kabi.

en: He handed me the paper saying only, It dropped from Lucy's breast when we carried her to the bath. When I had read it, I stook looking at the Professor, and after a pause asked him, In God's name, what does it all mean?
uz: U menga qog'ozni berib, faqat: Lusiyani hammomga olib borganimizda uning ko'krakidan tushdi, - deb aytdi.

en: Was she, or is she, mad, or what sort of horrible danger is it? I was so bewildered that I did not know what to say more.
uz: U g'azablanganmi yoki g'azablanganmi yoki bu qanday dahshatli xavf-xatar ekan? - deb so'raganimda, o'zimni juda xavotirda qoldim va yana nima deyishimni bilmasdim.

en: Van Helsing put out his hand and took the paper, saying, Do not trouble about it now.
uz: Van Helsing qo'lini ko'tarib, qog'ozni olib, shunday dedi: Bu haqda endi tashvishlanma.

en: Forget if for the present.
uz: Agar hozir bo'lsa, uni unuting.

en: You shall know and understand it all in good time, but it will be later.
uz: Siz hammasini o'z vaqtida bilib, tushunasiz, ammo bu keyinroq bo'ladi.

en: And now what is it that you came to me to say? This brought me back to fact, and I was all myself again.
uz: Va endi menga nima deyishga kelding? - degan so'zlarimni o'zimga qaytardi va men yana o'zim bo'ldim.

en: I came to speak about the certiﬁcate of death.
uz: Men o'lim guvohnomasi haqida gapirishga keldim.

en: If we do not act properly and wisely, there may be an inquest, and that paper would have to be pro- duced.
uz: Agar biz to'g'ri va aqlli yo'l tutmasak, tergov bo'lishi mumkin va ushbu qog'oz ishlab chiqilishi kerak bo'ladi.

en: I am in hopes that we need have no inquest, for if we had it would surely kill poor Lucy, if nothing else did.
uz: Umid qilamanki, biz hech qanday tekshiruvga muhtoj emasmiz, chunki agar shunday bo'lganida, boshqa hech narsa qilmagan bo'lsa, kambag'al Lusi albatta o'ldiriladi.

en: I know, and you know, and the other doctor who attended her knows, that Mrs.
uz: Men bilaman va siz ham bilaman, unga tibbiy yordam ko'rsatgan boshqa shifokor ham biladirki, bu xonim.

en: Westenra had disease of the heart, and we can certify that she died of it.
uz: Westenra yurak kasalligiga chalingan va uning o'limiga guvohlik bersak bo'ladi.

en: Let us ﬁll up the certiﬁcate at once, and I shall take it myself to the registrar and go on to the undertaker. Good, oh my friend John!
uz: Keling, guvohnomani darhol to'ldiraylik, keyin uni o'zim yozuvchining oldiga olib borib, o'z tashvishlarini ko'zlab o'taman.

en: Truly Miss Lucy, if she be sad in the foes that beset her, is at least happy in the friends thatlove her.
uz: Haqiqatan ham Miss Lucy, agar uni bosib olgan dushmanlar uchun xafa bo'lsa, hech bo'lmaganda uni sevadigan do'stlar uchun baxtli bo'ladi.

en: One, two, three, all open their veins for her, besides one old man.
uz: Bir, ikki, uch, barchasi unga jonlarini ochadi, bir keksa kishidan tashqari.

en: Ah, yes, I know, friend John.
uz: Ha, ha, bilaman, do'stim Jon.

en: I love you all the more for it!
uz: Men seni shuncha ko'proq sevaman!

en: In the hall I met Quincey Morris, with a telegram for Arthur telling him that Mrs.
uz: Zalda men Quincey Morrisni uchratdim, u Arturga telegramma bilan xabar berib, unga xonimning o'zi haqida xabar bergan edi.

en: Westenra was dead, that Lucy also had been ill, but was now go- ing on better, and that Van Helsing and I were with her.
uz: Vestenra o'lgan edi, Lusi ham kasal bo'lgan, lekin hozir hali yaxshilanayotgan edi va Van Helsing va men u bilan birga edik.

en: I told him where I was going, and he hurried me out, but as I was going said, When you come back, Jack, may I have two words with you all to ourselves? I nodded in reply and went out.
uz: Men unga qaerga borayotganimni aytdim va u meni darrov tashqariga chiqardi, lekin ketayotganimda: Jack, qaytib kelganingda, biz bilan ikki so'z gaplashsam bo'ladimi? - deb aytdim.

en: I found no difﬁculty about the registration, and arranged with the local undertaker to come up in the evening to measure for the cof- ﬁn and to make arrangements.
uz: Men ro'yxatdan o'tishda hech qanday qiyinchilikni ko'rmadim va mahalliy undertaker bilan kechqurun ko'pchilik uchun o'lchov o'tkazish va tadbirlar o'tkazish uchun kelishishni rejalashtirdim.

en: When I got back Quincey was waiting for me.
uz: Qaytib kelganimda, Quincey meni kutib turgan edi.

en: I told him I would see him as soon as I knew about Lucy, and went up to her room.
uz: Men unga Luisi haqida bilganimdan so'ng uni ko'rishimni aytdim va uning xonasiga bordim.

en: She was still sleep- ing, and the Professor seemingly had not moved from his seat at her side.
uz: U hali ham uxlab yotgan edi va professor uning yonida o'tirgan joyidan ko'rinmay qolgan edi.

en: From his putting his ﬁnger to his lips, I gathered that he expected her to wake before long and was afraid of fore-stalling nature.
uz: Uning o'z barmog'ini og'ziga qo'yganidan shuni tushundimki, u tezda uyg'onishini kutardi va tabiatning oldindan qo'zg'atishidan qo'rqardi.

en: So I went down to Quincey and took him into the breakfast room, where the blinds were not drawn down, and which was a little more cheerful, or rather less cheerless, than the other rooms.
uz: Shunday qilib, men Quinceyning oldiga borib, uni ovqatlanish xonasiga olib bordim, u yerda pardalar tushmagan edi va u boshqa xonalarga qaraganda biroz hayajonli yoki kamroq xafa bo'lgan edi.

en: When we were alone, he said to me, Jack Seward, I don't want to shove myself in anywhere where I've no right to be, but this is no ordinary case.
uz: Yolg'iz bo'lganimizda, u menga shunday dedi: Jack Seward, men o'zimni bo'lish huquqiga ega bo'lmagan joyga qo'shishni istamayman, lekin bu oddiy hol emas.

en: You know I loved that girl and wanted to marry her, but although that's all past and gone, I can't help feeling anxious about her all the same.
uz: O'sha qizni yaxshi ko'rardim va u bilan turmush qurmoqchi edim, ammo bularning hammasi o'tgan bo'lsa-da, men u uchun tashvishlanishimga to'sqinlik qila olmayman.

en: What is it that's wrong with her?
uz: Uning nima muammosi bor?

en: The Dutchman, and a ﬁne old fellow is is, I can see that, said that time you two came into the room, that you must have another transfusion of blood, and that both you and he were exhausted.
uz: Gollandiyalik va yaxshi keksa yigit, men buni ko'rib turibman, sizlar xonada kelganingizda yana bir qon to'ldirishingiz kerakligini va siz ham, u ham charchagan ekanligingizni aytdi.

en: Now I know well that you medical men speak in camera, and that a man must not expect to know what they consult about in private.
uz: Endi men siz shifokorlar kamerada gapirganingizni yaxshi bilaman va erkak kishi o'z vaqtida nima haqida maslahat berayotganini bilishini kutmasligi kerak.

en: But this is no common matter, and whatever it is, I have done my part.
uz: Ammo bu oddiy hol emas va nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, men o'z hissamni qo'shdim.

en: Is not that so? That's so, I said, and he went on.
uz: Ha, shunday emasmi? - dedim men va u davom etdi.

en: I take it that both you and Van Helsing had done already what I did to- day.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, siz ham, Van Helsing ham men bugun qilgan ishni bajargan edingiz.

en: Is not that so? That's so. And I guess Art was in it too.
uz: Ha, shunday emasmi? Ha, shunday.  Undan Art ham o'rin olgan, deb o'ylayman.

en: When I saw him four days ago down at his own place he looked queer.
uz: To'rt kun oldin uni o'z uyida ko'rganimda, o'ziga xos ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: I have not seen anything pulled down so quick since I was on the Pampas and had a mare that I was fond of go to grass all in a night.
uz: Pampas tog'ida bo'lganimdan beri, o'sha qadar tezroq tushirilgan hech narsa ko'rmadim va bir kecha ichida o'tga borishni yoqtirgan bir marvarid bo'ldim.

en: One of those big bats that they call vampires had got at her in the night, and what with his gorge and the vein left open, there wasn't enough blood in her to let her stand up, and I had to put a bullet through her
uz: Ular vampirlar deb atayotgan katta to'qnashuvlardan biri unga kechasi uribdi va uning toshbo'yi va idishi ochiq bo'lganida, uning ichidan turishiga imkon beradigan qon yetarli emas edi, shuning uchun men uning ichiga o'q urishim kerak edi

en: Jack, if you may tell me without betraying conﬁdence, Arthur was the ﬁrst, is not that so? As he spoke the poor fellow looked terribly anxious.
uz: Jek, agar ishonchingizni shubha ostiga qo'ymasangiz, menga aytishingiz mumkinki, Artur birinchi bo'ldi, shunday emasmi? - dedi.

en: He was in a torture of suspense regarding the woman he loved, and his utter ignorance of the terrible mystery which seemed to surround her intensiﬁed his pain.
uz: U sevgan ayolga nisbatan g'amginlik azobini boshdan kechirgan edi va uning atrofidagi dahshatli sirni bilmaslik uning og'rig'ini kuchaytirgan.

en: His very heart was bleeding, and it took all the manhood of him, and there was a roy- al lot of it, too, to keep him from breaking down.
uz: Uning yuragi qon ketayotgan edi va bu uning butun erkakligini talab qilgan edi va uni buzib ketishdan saqlash uchun juda ko'p narsa bor edi.

en: I paused before answer- ing, for I felt that I must not betray anything which the Professor wished kept secret, but already he knew so much, and guessed so much, that there could be no reason for not answering, so I answered in the same phrase.
uz: Javob berishdan oldin to'xtadim, chunki professor yashirmoqchi bo'lgan hech narsaga xiyonat qilmasligimni his qildim, ammo professor juda ko'p narsani bilardi va juda ko'p narsani tasavvur qilardi, shuning uchun javob bermaslik uchun hech qanday sabab bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, shuning uchun men xuddi shu jumla bilan javob berdim.

en: That's so. And how long has this been going on? About ten days. Ten days!
uz: - Ha, shunday. - Va bu qancha vaqt davom etmoqda? - Deyarli o'n kun. - O'n kun!

en: Then I guess, Jack Seward, that that poor pretty creature that we all love has had put into her veins within that time the blood of four strong men.
uz: O'shanda men, Jek Seward, biz hammamiz sevgan bu kambag'al chiroyli mavjudot o'sha vaqt ichida to'rtta kuchli odamning qonini o'z damarlariga qo'yib olgan deb o'ylayman.

en: Man alive, her whole body wouldn't hold it. Then coming close to me, he spoke in a ﬁerce half-whisper.
uz: Agar odam tirik bo'lsa, uning butun tanasi uni ushlab turolmaydi. Keyin menga yaqinlashib, u qattiq yarim shovqin bilan gapirdi.

en: What took it out? I shook my head.
uz: Nima uni olib chiqdi? - deb boshimni silkitdim.

en: That, I said, is the crux.
uz: Men: Bu muhim narsa.

en: Van Helsing is simply fran- tic about it, and I am at my wits' end.
uz: Van Helsing bu haqda shunchaki gapirishyapti va men aqldan ozganman.

en: I can't even hazard a guess.
uz: Men hatto taxmin qilish uchun xavf sololmayman.

en: There has been a series of little circumstances which have thrown out all our calcula- tions as to Lucy being properly watched.
uz: Luziyani to'g'ri kuzatib turish haqidagi barcha hisob-kitoblarimizni bekor qilgan bir qator kichik holatlar bo'ldi.

en: But these shall not occur again.
uz: Ammo bunday hodisalar yana sodir bo'lmaydi.

en: Here we stay until all be well, or ill. Quincey held out his hand.
uz: Hamma sog'lom yoki kasal bo'lgunga qadar bu yerda qolamiz, - deb qo'lini uzatdi Quincey.

en: Count me in, he said.
uz: Meni hisoblang, dedi u.

en: You and the Dutch- man will tell me what to do, and I'll do it. When she woke late in the afternoon, Lucy's ﬁrst movement was to feel in her breast, and to my surprise, produced the paper which Van Helsing had given me to read.
uz: Siz va hollandiyalik kishi menga nima qilishim kerakligini aytasiz va men buni qilaman.Lusi kechqurun uyg'onganida, uning birinchi harakatini ko'krakida his qilish edi va men hayron bo'lganim uchun Van Helsing menga o'qishga bergan qog'ozni ishlab chiqdi.

en: The careful Professor had replaced it where it had come from, lest on waking she should be alarmed.
uz: Mehnatli professor uni qayerdan kelganini o'zgartirgan, o'zini uyg'otgandan so'ng u xavotirga tushmasligi uchun.

en: Her eyes then lit on Van Helsing and on me too, and gladdened.
uz: Keyin uning ko'zlari Van Helsingga va menga ham yorqin ko'rindi va xursand bo'ldi.

en: Then she looked round the room, and seeing where she was, shuddered.
uz: Keyin u xonadon atrofini ko'rib, qayerda ekanini ko'rib, dahshatga tushdi.

en: She gave a loud cry, and put her poor thin hands before her pale face.
uz: U baland ovoz bilan yig'ladi va o'zining kamtar qo'llarini o'zining sochiq yuzidan ko'tarib qo'ydi.

en: We both understood what was meant, that she had realized to the full her mother's death.
uz: Ikkalasi ham nimani nazarda tutganini tushunardik, chunki u o'z onasining o'limini to'liq anglagan edi.

en: So we tried what we could to comfort her.
uz: Shunday qilib, uni tasalli berishga qo'limizdan kelganini qildik.

en: Doubtless sym- pathy eased her somewhat, but she was very low in thought and spirit, and wept silently and weakly for a long time.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu uni biroz yengillashtirdi, ammo u fikr va ruhda juda past edi va uzoq vaqt davomida sukut saqlash va zaiflik bilan yig'ladi.

en: We told her that either or both of us would now remain with her all the time, and that seemed to comfort her.
uz: Biz unga endi biz yoki ikkovimiz ham u bilan doimo birga bo'lishimizni aytdik va bu unga tasalli baxsh etardi.

en: Towards dusk she fell into a doze.
uz: Quyosh tushishi yaqinida u bir dozaga tushdi.

en: Here a very odd thing occurred.
uz: Bu erda juda g'alati narsa sodir bo'ldi.

en: still asleep she took the paper from her breast and tore it in two.
uz: U hali ham uxlab yotgan edi, u ko'krakidan qog'ozni olib, ikkiga yirtib yubordi.

en: Van Hels- ing stepped over and took the pieces from her.
uz: Van Helsing o'rnidan o'tib, uning qismlarini olib ketdi.

en: All the same, however, she went on with the action of tearing, as though the material were still in her hands.
uz: Biroq, u bu ishni davom ettirib, xuddi o'z qo'llarida bo'lganidek yig'ib yubordi.

en: Finally she lifted her hands and opened them as though scattering the fragments.
uz: Nihoyat u qo'llarini ko'tarib, ularni xuddi parchalari tarqatib yuborayotgandek ochdi.

en: Van Helsing seemed surprised, and his brows gathered as if in thought, but he said nothing.
uz: Van Helsing hayratda bo'lib, ko'z burchaklari o'ylab ko'ringanidek yig'ildi, lekin u hech narsa aytmadi.

en: 19 September.—All last night she slept ﬁtfully, being always afraid to sleep, and something weaker when she woke from it.
uz: 19 sentabr.Butun kecha u yaxshi uxlagan, doim uxlashdan qo'rqqan va u uyg'onganida biroz zaifroq edi.

en: The Professor and I took in turns to watch, and we never left her for a moment unattended.
uz: Professor va men navbatma-navbat kuzatib turardik va hech qachon uni bir daqiqa ham kuzatuvsiz qoldirmadik.

en: Quincey Morris said nothing about his intention, but I knew that all night long he patrolled round and round the house.
uz: Quincey Morris o'z niyatidan hech narsa aytmadi, lekin men bilganimcha, u butun kecha uyni aylanib chiqardi.

en: When the day came, its searching light showed the ravages in poor Lucy's strength.
uz: Kun kelganda, uning izlovchi nurlari kambag'al Lusiyaning kuch-qudratini ko'rsatdi.

en: She was hardly able to turn her head, and the little nourish- ment which she could take seemed to do her no good.
uz: U boshini o'zgartira olmagan va o'z ichiga oladigan oz miqdordagi oziq-ovqat unga hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi.

en: At times she slept, and both Van Helsing and I noticed the difference in her, between sleeping and waking.
uz: Ba'zan u uxlardi va Van Helsing va men uning uyqu va uyg'onish o'rtasidagi farqni payqardik.

en: Whilst asleep she looked stronger, although more haggard, and her breathing was softer.
uz: U uxlab yotganida u kuchli ko'rinardi, garchi ko'proq qahramon bo'lsa-da, nafas olish ham yengilroq edi.

en: Her open mouth showed the pale gums drawn back from the teeth, which looked positively longer and sharper than usual.
uz: O'z og'zini ochganida, tishlardan tortib olingan so'qilgan tishaklar ko'rinardi, ular odatdagidan ko'ra ko'proq va keskinroq ko'rinardi.

en: When she woke the softness of her eyes evidently changed the expression, for she looked her own self, although a dying one.
uz: U uyg'ongan paytda ko'zlarining yumushligi o'z ifodasini o'zgartirdi, chunki u o'z o'zi kabi ko'rinardi, garchi o'lib ketayotgan bo'lsa ham.

en: In the afternoon she asked for Arthur, and we telegraphed for him.
uz: Tunda u Arturni so'radi va biz u uchun telegraf yozdik.

en: Quincey went off to meet him at the station.
uz: Quincey uni poydevorda kutib olishga bordi.

en: When he arrived it was nearly six o'clock, and the sun was setting full and warm, and the red light streamed in through the window and gave more color to the pale cheeks.
uz: U yerga kelganida soat olti yaqin edi, quyosh to'liq va issiq tushayotgan edi, qizil yorug'lik deraza orqali kirib, sochiq chehralarga ko'proq rang berdi.

en: When he saw her, Arthur was simply choking with emotion, and none of us could speak.
uz: Artur uni ko'rganida, u shunchaki his-tuyg'ular bilan cho'kib ketgan edi va hech birimiz gapira olmasdik.

en: In the hours that had passed, the ﬁts of sleep, or the comatose condition that passed for it, had grown more fre- quent, so that the pauses when conversation was possible were shortened.
uz: O'tgan soatlarda uyqusizlik yoki u bilan birga bo'lgan koma holati tez-tez rivojlanib borardi, shuning uchun suhbatning imkoni bo'lgan damlar qisqartirildi.

en: Arthur's presence, however, seemed to act as a stimulant.
uz: Ammo Arturning hozir bo'lishi stimulant sifatida ish ko'rsatdi.

en: She rallied a little, and spoke to him more brightly than she had done since we arrived.
uz: U biroz ko'tarildi va biz kelganimizdan beri u bilan ko'proq gapirgan.

en: He too pulled himself together, and spoke as cheerily as he could, so that the best was made of everything.
uz: U ham o'zini yig'ib oldi va iloji boricha ko'proq xursandchilik bilan gapirdi, shu yo'sin hamma narsadan eng yaxshisini topdi.

en: It is now nearly one o'clock, and he and Van Helsing are sitting with her.
uz: Endi soat birga yaqin bo'ldi va u va Van Helsing u bilan birga o'tirmoqda.

en: I am to relieve them in a quarter of an hour, and I am entering this on Lucy's phonograph.
uz: Men ularni qirq soat ichida olib tashlayman va buni Lusiyning fonografida kiritaman.

en: Until six o'clock they are to try to rest.
uz: Soat oltigacha ular dam olishga harakat qilishlari kerak.

en: I fear that tomorrow will end our watching, for the shock has been too great.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, ertaga ko'rishimiz tugagan bo'ladi, chunki shok juda katta edi.

en: The poor child can- not rally.
uz: Zavqsiz bola yig'ilish qila olmaydi.

en: LETTER MINA HARKER TO LUCY WESTENRA (Unopened by her) 17 September My dearest Lucy, It seems an age since I heard from you, or indeed since I wrote.
uz: MINA HARKER XATIRLARI LUCY WESTENRAga (O'zidan ochilmagan) 17 Sentyabr Qizim Luzi, Sizdan eshitganimdan yoki yozganimdan beri bir yosh o'tdi.

en: You will pardon me, I know, for all my faults when you have read all my budget of news.
uz: Men bilgan barcha xatolarim uchun siz meni kechirasiz, chunki siz mening yangiliklar bilan bog'liq budjetimni o'qigan bo'lasiz.

en: Well, I got my husband back all right.
uz: Xo'sh, erimni qaytarib oldim.

en: When we arrived at Exeter there was a carriage waiting for us, and in it, though he had an attack of gout, Mr.
uz: Ekseterga yetib borganimizda, bizni kutib turgan arava bor edi va u aravachada, hatto gout hujumiga duch kelgan bo'lsa-da, Mr.

en: He took us to his house, where there were rooms for us all nice and comfortable, and we dined together.
uz: U bizni o'zining uyiga olib bordi, u yerda barchamiz uchun qulay va yoqimli xonalar bo'lib, birga ovqatlanardik.

en: Hawkins said,  `My dears, I want to drink your health and prosperity, and may every blessing attend you both.
uz: Xokins shunday dedi:  `My azizlar, men sizning sog'lig'ingiz va farovonligingizni ichmoqchiman va har bir baraka ikkovingizga ham tegsin.

en: I know you both from children, and have, with love and pride, seen you grow up.
uz: Men sizlarni bolaligimdan bilaman va sizlarni sevish va mag'rurlik bilan katta bo'lganingizda ko'rdim.

en: Now I want you to make your home here with me.
uz: Endi men bilan bu yerda o'z uyingizni qurishni istayman.

en: I have left to me neither chick nor child.
uz: Men o'zimga ne kichkina, na bola qoldirmadim.

en: All are gone, and in my will I have left you everything.' I cried, Lucy dear, as Jonathan and the old man clasped hands.
uz: Hammasi yo'qoldi va men senga hamma narsani vasiyat qilib qoldirdim, - deb yig'ladim, aziz Lucy, Jonatan va keksa qo'llarini bir-biriga qo'shganida.

en: Our evening was a very, very happy one.
uz: Kechamiz juda, juda quvonchli o'tdi.

en: So here we are, installed in this beautiful old house, and from both my bedroom and the drawing room I can see the great elms of the cathedral close, with their great black stems standing out against the old yellow stone of the cathedral, and I can hear the rooks overhead cawing and cawing and chattering and chattering and gossiping all day, after the manner of rooks— and humans.
uz: Mana, biz shu chiroyli eski uyda o'tiribmiz va o'tirgan xonamdan ham, o'tirgan xonamdan ham katedrali katta olmoqlarni, katta qora bo'laklarini katedrali eski sariq toshga qarshi ko'tarib, yaqinroq ko'rishim mumkin va men qo'rqinchlarni boshdan ko'tarib, qo'rqinchlarni eshitaman va qo'rqinchlarni eshitaman va kun bo'yi qo'rqinchlarni eshitaman, qo'rqinchlarni eshitaman va odamlar kabi gapirishadi.

en: I am busy, I need not tell you, arranging things and housekeep- ing.
uz: Men, sizga aytishim kerak emas, ishlar va uy-joylarni yig'ish bilan bandman.

en: Hawkins are busy all day, for now that Jonathan is a partner, Mr.
uz: Xokins kun bo'yi mashg'ul bo'ladi, hozircha Jonatan hamkor bo'lganidan so'ng, Mr.

en: Hawkins wants to tell him all about the clients.
uz: Hawkins unga mijozlar haqida hamma narsani aytishni xohlaydi.

en: How is your dear mother getting on?
uz: Qizig'ingiz onangiz qanday?

en: I wish I could run up to town for a day or two to see you, dear, but I, dare not go yet, with so much on my shoulders, and Jonathan wants looking after still.
uz: Sizni ko'rish uchun shaharga bir-ikki kun chopishimni xohlardim, aziz, lekin men hali ketishga jur'at qilmayman, shuncha narsani omon qoldirganman va Jonatan hali ham g'amxo'rlik qilishni xohlaydi.

en: He is beginning to put some ﬂesh on his bones again, but he was terribly weakened by the long ill- ness.
uz: U yana suyaklariga go'sht qo'yishni boshlaydi, ammo uzoq kasallik tufayli juda kuchsiz edi.

en: Even now he sometimes starts out of his sleep in a sudden way and awakes all trembling until I can coax him back to his usual placidity.
uz: Hatto hozir ham u ba'zan to'satdan uyqusidan turadi va men uni odatdagidek tinchlikka qaytarmagunimcha titrab uyg'onadi.

en: How- ever, thank God, these occasions grow less frequent as the days go on, and they will in time pass away altogether, I trust.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, Xudoga shukr, kunlar o'tib, bunday hodisalar kamroq bo'lib boradi va vaqt o'tib ular butunlay o'tib ketadi, deb umid qilaman.

en: And now I have told you my news, let me ask yours.
uz: Va endi men sizga o'z xabarimni aytib berdim, sizning xabaringizni so'rasam bo'ladi.

en: When are you to be married, and where, and who is to perform the ceremony, and what are you to wear, and is it to be a public or private wedding?
uz: To'y qachon, qayerda, kim o'tkazadi, nima kiyishi kerak va bu ommaviy yoki xususiy to'y bo'ladimi?

en: Tell me all about it, dear, tell me all about everything, for there is nothing which interests you which will not be dear to me.
uz: Menga bu haqda hamma narsani aytib bering, aziz, menga hamma narsani aytib bering, chunki sizga qiziqadigan hech narsa menga yoqmaydi.

en: Jonathan asks me to send his `respectful duty', but I do not think that is good enough from the junior partner of the important ﬁrm Hawkins & Harker.
uz: Jonatan mendan o'z `respectful duty'ini yuborishni so'raydi, lekin men buni muhim firma Hawkins & Harkerning kichik sherikidan yetarlicha yaxshi deb o'ylamayman.

en: And so, as you love me, and he loves me, and I love you with all the moods and tenses of the verb, I send you simply his `love' instead.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz meni sevganingiz uchun, u ham meni sevgan va men sizni barcha amaldagi ruh va vaqtlar bilan sevganim uchun, men sizga o'rniga shunchaki uning `love'ini yuboraman.

en: Good- bye, my dearest Lucy, and blessings on you. Yours, Mina Harker REPORT FROM PATRICK HENNESSEY, MD, MRCSLK, QCPI, ETC, ETC, TO JOHN SEWARD, MD 20 September My dear Sir: In accordance with your wishes, I enclose report of the conditions of everything left in my charge.
uz: Sizning, Mina Harkerning PATRICK HENNESSEY, MD, MRCSLK, QCPI, ETC, ETC, TO JOHN SEWARD, MD 20 sentabrdagi hisoboti.

en: With regard to patient, Renﬁeld, there is more to say.
uz: Bemorga nisbatan Renfield, aytish uchun ko'proq narsa bor.

en: He has had another outbreak, which might have had a dreadful end- ing, but which, as it fortunately happened, was unattended with any unhap- py results.
uz: U yana bir epidemiyaga duch keldi, uning oxiri dahshatli bo'lishi mumkin edi, ammo u baxtli bo'lib, hech qanday noxush natijalarga ega bo'lmagan.

en: This afternoon a carrier's cart with two men made a call at the empty house whose grounds abut on ours, the house to which, you will re- member, the patient twice ran away.
uz: Bugun kechqurun ikki kishini o'tkazadigan transport aravalari bizning uyimizga o'xshash bo'sh uyga qo'ng'iroq qildi, bu uyga siz qaytadan kirasiz, bemor ikki marta qochib ketgan.

en: The men stopped at our gate to ask the porter their way, as they were strangers.
uz: Qizlar bizning darvozalarimizda to'xtab, darvozabonlardan yo'l so'rashdi, chunki ular begona odamlar edi.

en: I was myself looking out of the study window, having a smoke after din- ner, and saw one of them come up to the house.
uz: Men o'zim o'quv oynasidan ko'rardim, kechki ovqatdan so'ng sigaret chekayotgan edim va ulardan biri uyga kelganini ko'rdim.

en: As he passed the window of Renﬁeld's room, the patient began to rate him from within, and called him all the foul names he could lay his tongue to.
uz: Renfieldning xonasi darvozasidan o'tib ketayotganda, bemor uni ichkaridan baholay boshladi va tilini qo'yishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha iflos nomlarni unga chaqirdi.

en: The man, who seemed a de- cent fellow enough, contented himself by telling him to `shut up for a foul- mouthed beggar',whereon our man accused him of robbing him and wanting to murder him and said that he would hinder him if he were to swing for it.
uz: O'ziga yetarlicha munosib odam ko'rinadigan kishi unga: Qo'ng'iroq qil, yomon og'izli so'roqchi, - deb aytishga qodir bo'ldi, ammo bizning odam uni talon-toroj qilib, o'ldirmoqchi bo'lganlikda aybladi va agar u bu ishni qilmoqchi bo'lsa, unga to'sqinlik qiladi, deb aytdi.

en: I opened the window and signed to the man not to notice, so he contented himself after looking the place over and making up his mind as to what kind of place he had got to by saying, `Lor' bless yer, sir, I wouldn't mind what was said to me in a bloomin' madhouse.
uz: Men darcha ochdim va odamga e'tibor bermaslik uchun imzo qo'ydim, shuning uchun u joyni ko'rib chiqib, qanday joyga borganini o'ylab, `Lor' bless yer, sir, men gullab-yashgan aqldan ozgan uyda menga nima aytilganiga ahamiyat bermayman, deb o'zini rozi qildi.

en: I pity ye and the guv'nor for havin' to live in the house with a wild beast like that.' Then he asked his way civilly enough, and I told him where the gate of the empty house was.
uz: Sizlar va gubernatorlar bunday yovvoyi hayvon bilan uyda yashashingizga achinaman.  Keyin u o'z yo'lini o'rinli tarzda so'radi va men unga bo'sh uyning darvozasi qaerda ekanligini aytdim.

en: He went away followed by threats and curses and re- vilings from our man.
uz: U ketib ketdi va o'zidan keyin bizning odamimiz tomonidan tahdidlar, la'natlar va qo'zg'olonlar keltirdi.

en: I went down to see if I could make out any cause for his anger, since he is usually such a well-behaved man, and except his vio- lent ﬁts nothing of the kind had ever occurred.
uz: Men uning g'azabiga biron sabab topa olamanmi, deb tushdim, chunki u odatda juda yaxshi xulq-atvorli odam bo'lib, uning zo'ravonligidan boshqa hech narsa sodir bo'lmagan.

en: I found him, to my astonish- ment, quite composed and most genial in his manner.
uz: Men uni hayratda qoldimki, u juda murakkab va o'z uslubida eng zo'r odam deb topdim.

en: I tried to get him to talk of the incident, but he blandly asked me questions as to what I meant, and led me to believe that he was completely oblivious of the affair.
uz: Men uni hodisa haqida gapirishga harakat qildim, lekin u menga nima demoqchi bo'lganimni so'rab, meni ishontirdi va u ishdan butunlay bexabar deb o'yladi.

en: I am sorry to say, however, only another instance of his cunning, for within half an hour I heard of him again.
uz: Biroq, uning hiyla-nayrangining yana bir misolini aytish uchun uzr so'rayman, chunki yarim soat ichida men u haqida yana eshitdim.

en: This time he had broken out through the window of his room, and was running down the avenue.
uz: Bu safar u o'z xonasi darvozasidan chiqib, yo'ldan yurgan edi.

en: I called to the at- tendants to follow me, and ran after him, for I feared he was intent on some mischief.
uz: Men o'zimni kuzatib borishga harakat qilgan odamlarni chaqirib, uning orqasidan ergashdim, chunki u biron bir yomon niyatda bo'lganidan qo'rqardim.

en: My fear was justiﬁed when I saw the same cart which had passed before coming down the road, having on it some great wooden boxes.
uz: Yo'ldan tushishdan oldin o'tib o'tgan xuddi shu aravazni ko'rganimda, qo'rquvim oqlangan edi, uning ustida katta yog'och qutilar bor edi.

en: The men were wiping their foreheads, and were ﬂushed in the face, as if with violent exercise.
uz: O'sha erkaklar o'z burunlarini yuvishardi va xuddi zo'ravon mashg'ulotlar bilan yuzlariga qizil o'tkirdi.

en: Before I could get up to him, the patient rushed at them, and pulling one of them off the cart, began to knock his head against the ground.
uz: Men unga yaqinlashishdan oldin, bemor ularga shoshildi va ulardan birini aravachadan olib chiqib, boshini yerga urishni boshladi.

en: If I had not seized him just at the moment, I believe he would have killed the man there and then.
uz: Agar men uni o'sha zahoti qo'lga olmasdim, u odamni o'sha zahoti o'ldirgan bo'lardi.

en: The other fellow jumped down and struck him over the head with the butt end of his heavy whip.
uz: Boshqa yigit pastga sakrab chiqib, og'ir qamchilag'i bilan uning boshiga urdi.

en: It was a horrible blow, but he did not seem to mind it, but seized him also, and struggled with the three of us, pulling us to and fro as if we were kittens.
uz: Bu dahshatli urish edi, lekin u bunga ahamiyat bermagan, lekin uni ham ushlab, uchimizni o'rab olib, bizni kichkina bolaga o'xshatgan.

en: You know I am no lightweight, and the others were both burly men.
uz: Bilasizmi, men yengilroq emasman va qolganlar ikkalasi ham chiroyli odamlar edi.

en: At ﬁrst he was silent in his ﬁghting, but as we began to master him, and the attendants were putting a strait waistcoat on him, he began to shout, `I'll frustrate them!
uz: Boshida u o'z jangida jim edi, lekin biz uni o'zlashtirishni boshlaganimizda va xizmatchilar uni qutiq kiyim kiyganida, u qichqirib: `I'll frustrate them! deb baqira boshladi.

en: They shan't rob me!They shan't murder me by inches!
uz: Ular meni o'g'irlamaydilar!Ular meni santimchalar bilan o'ldirmaydilar!

en: I'll ﬁght for my Lord and Master!'and all sorts of similar incoherent ravings.
uz: Men Rabbim va Otam uchun jang qilaman! va shunga o'xshash har xil noto'g'ri g'alabalar uchun kurashaman.

en: It was with very considerable difﬁculty that they got him back to the house and put him in the padded room.
uz: Uni uyga qaytarib, to'ldirilgan xonaga joylashtirish juda katta qiyinchilik bilan sodir bo'ldi.

en: One of the attendants, Hardy, had a ﬁnger broken.
uz: Xizmatchilardan biri Hardyning barmog'i buzilgan edi.

en: However, I set it all right, and he is going on well.
uz: Biroq, men uni to'g'rilashtirdim va u yaxshi ish qilmoqda.

en: The two carriers were at ﬁrst loud in their threats of actions for dam- ages, and promised to rain all the penalties of the law on us.
uz: Ikkala tashuvchi dastlab o'zlarining davrlar davomida harakat qilish to'g'risidagi tahdidlarida baland ovoz bilan gapirib, bizga qonunning barcha jazolarini yog'dirishga va'da berishdi.

en: Their threats were, however, mingled with some sort of indirect apology for the defeat of the two of them by a feeble madman.
uz: Biroq, ularning tahdidlari biroz bevosita bir xil kechirim so'rash bilan aralashdi, chunki ularning ikkalasi bir kamtar aqldan ozgan odam tomonidan mag'lubiyatga uchratilgan edi.

en: They said that if it had not been for the way their strength had been spent in carrying and raising the heavy box- es to the cart they would have made short work of him.
uz: Ular, agar kuch-quvvatlarini og'ir qutilarni aravachaga ko'tarib olib borishga sarflamasdilar, uni qisqa vaqtga aylantirgan bo'lishardi, deb aytishdi.

en: They gave as anoth- er reason for their defeat the extraordinary state of drouth to which they had been reduced by the dusty nature of their occupation and the reprehensible distance from the scene of their labors of any place of public entertainment.
uz: Ular g'alaba qozonishining sabablaridan biri sifatida o'z ishlarining changli xususiyati va ish joylarining har qanday ommaviy o'yin-kulgi joylaridan kamsitilmas masofadan iborat bo'lgan o'zgacha bo'shliq holatini ko'rsatdilar.

en: I quite understood their drift, and after a stiff glass of strong grog, or rather more of the same, and with each a sovereign in hand, they made light of the attack, and swore that they would encounter a worse madman any day for the pleasure of meeting so `bloomin' good a bloke' as your correspondent.
uz: Men ularning harakatini yaxshi tushunardim va kuchli qirg'oqning qattiq shishalaridan keyin, yoki ko'proq shunga o'xshash narsalardan keyin, har birining qo'lida hukmdor bo'lganida, ular hujumni kamsitdilar va sizning muxbiringiz sifatida shunchalik yaxshi yigit bilan uchrashish zavqidan keyin har kuni yomonroq aqldan ozgan odam bilan uchrashishlarini qasam ichdilar.

en: I took their names and addresses, in case they might be needed.
uz: Men ularning ismlari va manzillarini olib, kerak bo'lgan taqdirda ham, ularga murojaat qildim.

en: They are as follows: Jack Smollet, of Dudding's Rents, King George's Road, Great Wal-
uz: Ular quyidagicha: Jack Smollet, Dudding's Rents, King George's Road, Great Wal-

en: worth, and Thomas Snelling, Peter Farley's Row, Guide Court, Bethnal Green.
uz: va Tomas Snelling, Peter Farley's Row, Guide Court, Bethnal Green.

en: They are both in the employment of Harris & Sons, Moving and Shipment Company, Orange Master's Yard, Soho.
uz: Ikkalasi ham Harris & Sons, Ko'chirish va jo'natish kompaniyasi, Orange Master's Yard, Sohoda ishlaydi.

en: I shall report to you any matter of interest occurring here, and shall wire you at once if there is anything of importance.
uz: Men bu yerda sodir bo'layotgan har qanday qiziqish haqida xabar beraman va agar muhim narsa bo'lsa, darhol xabar beraman.

en: Believe me, dear Sir, Yours faithfully, Patrick Hennessey. LETTER, MINA HARKER TO LUCY WESTENRA (Unopened by her) 18 September My dearest Lucy, Such a sad blow has befallen us.
uz: Sizlarning sodiqligingizga ishoning, aziz sir, Patrick Hennessey.  XATIR, MINA HARKER LUCY WESTENRAga (o'zi tomonidan ochilmagan) 18 sentabr Mening aziz Lucy, Bizga bunday qayg'u to'plandi.

en: Hawkins has died very suddenly.
uz: Hawkins juda to'satdan vafot etdi.

en: Some may not think it so sad for us, but we had both come to so love him that it really seems as though we had lost a father.
uz: Ba'zilar buni biz uchun juda xafa deb o'ylamaydilar, lekin ikkovimiz ham uni shunchalik yaxshi ko'rgan edikki, o'zimizni otamizdan mahrum etganimizdek his qilamiz.

en: I never knew either father or mother, so that the dear old man's death is a real blow to me.
uz: Men hech qachon ota yoki onamni tanimaganman, shuning uchun aziz keksa odamning o'limi menga katta zarar yetkazdi.

en: Jonathan is greatly distressed.
uz: Jonatan juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: It is not only that he feels sorrow, deep sorrow, for the dear,good man who has befriended him all his life, and now at the end has treated him like his own son and left him a fortune which to people of our modest bringing up is wealth beyond the dream of avarice, but Jonathan feels it on another account.
uz: U nafaqat hayoti davomida unga do'st bo'lgan, endi oxiriga kelib unga o'z o'g'li kabi munosabatda bo'lgan va o'zimizning kamtarlik bilan tarbiyalangan odamlarimiz uchun ochko'zlik orzuidan ortiq boylik bo'lgan boylikni qoldirgan aziz va yaxshi odam uchun qayg'u chekadi, balki Jonatan buni boshqa sababdan his qiladi.

en: He says the amount of responsibility which it puts upon him makes him nervous.
uz: Uning aytishicha, bu uning zimmasiga yuklatilgan mas'uliyatning miqdori uni g'azabga soladi.

en: He begins to doubt himself.
uz: U o'zidan shubhalanishni boshlaydi.

en: I try to cheer him up, and my belief in him helps him to have a belief in himself.
uz: Men uni xursand qilishga harakat qilaman va unga bo'lgan ishonchim unga o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchni rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.

en: But it is here that the grave shock that he experienced tells upon him the most.
uz: Ammo u erda u boshdan kechirgan og'ir shok unga eng ko'p narsani aytadi.

en: Oh, it is too hard that a sweet, simple, noble, strong nature such as his, a nature which enabled him by our dear, good friend's aid to rise from clerk to master in a few years, should be so injured that the very essence of its strength is gone.
uz: Oh, uning kabi shirin, sodda, noyob, kuchli tabiati, uning bir necha yil ichida xizmatkordan ustunga ko'tarilishiga yaxshi do'stimiz yordamida imkon bergan tabiati, o'zining kuchining mohiyati yo'qolishiga qadar zarar yetkazishi juda qiyin.

en: Forgive me, dear, if I worry you with my troubles in the midst of your own happiness, but Lucy dear, I must tell someone, for the strain of keeping up a brave and cheerful appearance to Jonathan tries me, and I have no one here that I can conﬁde in.
uz: Meni kechiring, azizim, agar men sizni o'z baxtingiz o'rtasida muammolarim bilan tashvishlantirsam, lekin azizim Lusi, men kimgadir aytishim kerak, chunki Jonatanga jasoratli va quvonchli ko'rinishni saqlab qolish meni sinovdan o'tkazadi va bu yerda ishonishim mumkin bo'lgan hech kimim yo'q.

en: I dread coming up to London, as we must do that day after tomorrow, for poor Mr.
uz: Men Londonga borishdan qo'rqaman, chunki biz ertangi kundan keyin, kambag'al Mr. uchun shunday qilishimiz kerak.

en: Hawkins left in his will that he was to be buried in the grave with his father.
uz: Xokins o'z vasiyatxonasida otasi bilan birga qabrda dafn qilinishi kerakligini qoldirdi.

en: As there are no rela- tions at all, Jonathan will have to be chief mourner.
uz: Hech qanday munosabat yo'qligi sababli, Jonatan bosh qayg'uchi bo'lishi kerak.

en: I shall try to run over to see you, dearest, if only for a few minutes.
uz: Sizni ko'rish uchun yugurishga harakat qilaman, azizim, agar bir necha daqiqa bo'lsa ham.

en: Forgive me for troubling you.
uz: Sizni xafa qilganim uchun meni kechiring.

en: With all blessings, Your loving Mina Harker DR.
uz: Barcha barakalar bilan, Sening sevuvchi Mina Harker DR.

en: 20 September.—Only resolution and habit can let me make an entry tonight.
uz: 20 sentabr.Yegancha qaror va odat menga bu kecha yozib olishimga imkon beradi.

en: I am too miserable, too low spirited, too sick of the world and all in it, including life itself, that I would not care if I heard this moment the ﬂap- ping of the wings of the angel of death.
uz: Men juda baxtsizman, ruhim juda past, dunyo va unda bo'lgan hamma narsa, shu jumladan hayotning o'zi, men bu daqiqada o'lim farishtasining qanotlari qichqirishini eshitsam, menga hech qanday ahamiyat bermaydi.

en: And he has been ﬂapping those grim wings to some purpose of late, Lucy's mother and Arthur's father, and now … Let me get on with my work.
uz: Va u bu oxirgi vaqtlarda bu qahramon qanoqlarni Luisiyning onasi va Arturning otasi uchun biron bir maqsadga qo'ydi va endi ... ishimga davom ettirishimga ruxsat bering.

en: I duly relieved Van Helsing in his watch over Lucy.
uz: Men Van Helsingni Luzi ustidan nazorat qilish vazifasidan ozod qildim.

en: We wanted Arthur to go to rest also, but he refused at ﬁrst.
uz: Biz Artur ham dam olishini istardik, lekin u dastlab rad etdi.

en: It was only when I told him that we should want him to help us during the day, and that we must not all break down for want of rest, lest Lucy should suffer, that he agreed to go.
uz: Faqat unga kun davomida bizga yordam berishini xohlashimizni va dam olmaganimiz uchun hammamiz tushkunlikka tushmasligimizni aytganimda, u ketishga rozi bo'ldi.

en: Van Helsing was very kind to him.
uz: Van Helsing unga juda mehribon bo'lgan.

en: Come, my child, he said.
uz: U: Qo'ng kel, qizim, - dedi.

en: You are sick and weak, and have had much sorrow and much men- tal pain, as well as that tax on your strength that we know of.
uz: Sen kasal va zaifsan, ko'p qayg'u va ko'p insonlar og'rig'ini boshdan kechirding, shuningdek, biz bilamizki, o'z kuchingga soliq to'layotgansan.

en: You must not be alone, for to be alone is to be full of fears and alarms.
uz: Siz yolg'iz bo'lmasligingiz kerak, chunki yolg'iz bo'lish qo'rquv va qo'rquvlarga to'lib-toshgan.

en: Come to the draw- ing room, where there is a big ﬁre, and there are two sofas.
uz: O'yinxonada katta yong'in bo'lib, ikkita sofa mavjud.

en: You shall lie on one, and I on the other, and our sympathy will be comfort to each other, even though we do not speak, and even if we sleep. Arthur went off with him, casting back a longing look on Lucy's face, which lay in her pillow, almost whiter than the lawn.
uz: Sen bir tomonga, men esa boshqa tomonga yotasan, va bizning hamdardligimiz bir-birimizga tasalli beradi, hatto gapirmasak ham, hatto uxlasak ham. - dedi Artur u bilan birga ketib, Lusiyaning yuziga ko'z tikdi, u uning yostig'ida yotgan edi, deyarli o'tdan oqroq edi.

en: She lay quite still, and I looked around the room to see that all was as it should be.
uz: U o'rinsiz yotgan edi va men hamma narsa kerakli bo'lganidek bo'lganini ko'rish uchun xonani ko'rdim.

en: I could see that the Professor had carried out in this room, as in the other, his purpose of us- ing the garlic.
uz: Men professorning shu xonada ham, boshqa xonada ham sarimsoqni ishlatish maqsadini amalga oshirayotganini ko'rdim.

en: The whole of the window sashes reeked with it, and round Lucy's neck, over the silk handkerchief which Van Helsing made her keep on, was a rough chaplet of the same odorous ﬂowers.
uz: To'liq deraza bo'laklari bu bilan xushbo'y bo'lgan va Lusiyning bo'yni atrofida, Van Helsing uni ushlab turishga majbur qilgan ipak to'qima ustidan, xuddi shu xushbo'y gullarning qo'pol bo'laklari paydo bo'lgan.

en: Lucy was breathing somewhat stertorously, and her face was at its worst, for the open mouth showed the pale gums.
uz: Luisi biroz og'ir nafas olgan va yuzi eng yomon holatda edi, chunki og'zini ochganidan soyaq tuxumlar ko'rinardi.

en: Her teeth, in the dim, uncertain light, seemed longer and sharper than they had been in the morning.
uz: Uning tishlari, sochiq va noaniq yorug'likda, ertalabgi tishlardan ko'ra ko'proq va keskinroq ko'rinardi.

en: In par- ticular, by some trick of the light, the canine teeth looked longer and sharper than the rest.
uz: Ayniqsa, qandaydir yorug'lik hiylalari tufayli itlarning tishlari boshqalarga qaraganda uzoqroq va keskinroq ko'rinardi.

en: I sat down beside her, and presently she moved uneasily.
uz: Men uning yonida o'tirib qoldim va shu paytdan boshlab u noqulay harakatlanardi.

en: At the same mo- ment there came a sort of dull ﬂapping or buffeting at the window.
uz: Shu payt o'sha darchaga bir xil chiroyli qo'l urish yoki to'qnashish paydo bo'ldi.

en: I went over to it softly, and peeped out by the corner of the blind.
uz: Men uning yoniga sekin kirib, ko'rning burchagidan qarab chiqdim.

en: There was a full moonlight, and I could see that the noise was made by a great bat, which wheeled around, doubtless attracted by the light, although so dim, and every now and again struck the window with its wings.
uz: To'liq oy yorug'ligi bor edi va shuni ko'rardimki, bu shovqinni katta to'g'rilar tomonidan chiqarilgan edi, ular o'z atrofida aylanib yurishgan edilar, shubhasizki, yorug'lik tomonidan jalb qilingan edilar, garchi ular juda kam bo'lsa-da, va vaqti-vaqti bilan o'z qanotlari bilan oynani urishgan edi.

en: When I came back to my seat, I found that Lucy had moved slightly, and had torn away the garlic
uz: O'tirgan joyimga qaytib kelgach, Lucy biroz harakatlanib, sarimushni yirtib yuborganini ko'rdim.

en: ﬂowers from her throat.
uz: Uning bo'yniga gullar tushadi.

en: I replaced them as well as I could, and sat watching her.
uz: Men ularni imkon qadar yaxshiroq almashtirib, uni kuzatib o'tirdim.

en: Presently she woke, and I gave her food, as Van Helsing had prescribed.
uz: Oʻsha zahoti u uygʻonib qoldi va men unga Van Helsing buyurganidek ovqat berdim.

en: She took but a little, and that languidly.
uz: U faqat bir oz va bu oz-oz qilib oldi.

en: There did not seem to be with her now the unconscious struggle for life and strength that had hitherto so marked her illness.
uz: Hozirda uning kasalligiga shunchalik ta'sir ko'rsatgan hayot va kuch uchun bo'lgan ongsiz kurash u bilan birga bo'lmagandek ko'rinmadi.

en: It struck me as curious that the moment she became conscious she pressed the garlic ﬂowers close to her.
uz: O'zimni qiziqtirgan narsa shundaki, u o'zini his qilgan paytda o'ziga yaqin bo'lgan sarimush gullarini bosdi.

en: It was certainly odd that whenever she got into that lethargic state, with the stertorous breathing, she put the ﬂowers from her, but that when she waked she clutched them close, There was no possibility of making amy mistake about this, for in the long hours that followed, she had many spells of sleeping and waking and repeated both actions many times.
uz: Shubhasiz, u o'zidan o'tkazib yuborilgan gullarni o'zidan tashlab qo'yganida, o'zidan o'tkazib yuboradigan nafas bilan o'zidan o'tkir holatga kirganida, lekin uyg'onganida ularni o'ziga yaqin tutishi ajablanarli emas edi, chunki keyingi uzoq soatlarda u ko'pgina uyqu va uyg'onish mashg'ulotlarini boshdan kechirgan va har ikki harakatni ko'p marta takrorlagan.

en: At six o'clock Van Helsing came to relieve me.
uz: Soat oltilarda Van Helsing meni qutqarish uchun keldi.

en: Arthur had then fallen into a doze, and he mercifully let him sleep on.
uz: Artur o'sha paytda o'z uyquga tushdi va rahmdillik ila uni uxlashga qo'ydi.

en: When he saw Lucy's face I could hear the sissing indraw of breath, and he said to me in a sharp whis- per.Draw up the blind.
uz: U Lusiyaning yuzini ko'rganida, men uning nafas olishni eshitgan edim va u o'ta keskin so'z bilan menga shunday dedi: Ko'rlarni ko'tarib ko'ring.

en: I want light! Then he bent down, and, with his face almost touching Lucy's, examined her carefully.
uz: Men yorug'likni xohlayman! - deb so'ng o'zini egib, Lucyga yaqinlashib qolgan yuzini ko'rib, uni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

en: He removed the ﬂowers and lifted the silk handkerchief from her throat.
uz: U gullarni olib tashladi va uning bo'yniga ipka to'plamini olib tashladi.

en: As he did so he started back and I could hear his ejaculation, Mein Gott! as it was smothered in his throat.
uz: Shunday qilib, u yana boshladi va men uning qirg'og'iga tushib, Men Xudoyim! degan ejakulyatsiyasini eshitdim.

en: I bent over and looked, too, and as I noticed some queer chill came over me.
uz: Men ham o'zimni egib ko'rdim va ba'zi bir g'ayritabiiy sovuq menga o'xshab keldi.

en: The wounds on the throat had absolutely disappeared.
uz: Qo'ldagi yaralar butunlay yo'qolgan edi.

en: For fully ﬁve minutes Van Helsing stood looking at her, with his face at its sternest.
uz: To'liq besh daqiqa davomida Van Helsing yuzini og'ir ko'rib, unga qaradi.

en: Then he turned to me and said calmly, She is dying.
uz: So'ngra menga qarab, xotirjamlik bilan: U o'lib ketyapti.

en: It will not be long now.
uz: Hozir ko'p vaqt o'tmaydi.

en: It will be much difference, mark me, whether she dies con- scious or in her sleep.
uz: Bu juda katta farq qiladi, menga e'tibor bering, u o'zini ko'rishni xohlasa, xoh uyqusida.

en: Wake that poor boy, and let him come and see the last.
uz: Bu kambag'al o'g'ilni uyg'oting va uni oxirgi kishini ko'rishga kelishiga ruxsat bering.

en: He trusts us, and we have promised him. I went to the dining room and waked him.
uz: U bizga ishonadi va biz unga va'da berdik. Men ovqatxonasiga borib, uni uyg'otdim.

en: He was dazed for a moment, but when he saw the sunlight streaming in through the edges of the shutters he thought he was late, and expressed his fear.
uz: U bir muncha ko'ngilsizlikda edi, lekin quyosh nurining chiroqlar bo'ylab kirib kelishini ko'rganida, kech qolganini his etib, qo'rquvni izhor etdi.

en: I assured him that Lucy was still asleep, but told him as gently as i could that both Van Helsing and I feared that the end was near.
uz: Men unga Lusi hali ham uxlayotganini aytdim, lekin unga iloji boricha muloyimlik bilan aytdimki, Van Helsing va men oxirzamon yaqinlashib qolganidan qo'rqardik.

en: He covered his face with his hands, and slid down on his knees by the sofa, where he remained, perhaps a minute, with his head buried, praying, whilst his shoulders shook with grief.
uz: U yuzini qo'llari bilan qopladi va sofaning yonida tiz cho'kib, bir daqiqa, ehtimol boshini ko'mib, ibodat qilib qoldi.

en: I took him by the hand and raised him up.
uz: Men uni qo'lidan ushlab, ko'tardim.

en: Come, I said, my dear old fellow, sum- mon all your fortitude.
uz: Men: Ey, aziz keksa, kel, butun kuch-quvvatingizni yig'ib ol.

en: It will be best and easiest for her. When we came into Lucy's room I could see that Van Helsing had, with his usual forethought, been putting matters straight and making everything
uz: U uchun eng yaxshi va eng oson bo'ladi. - deb aytdi.Lusiyning xonasiga kirganimizda, Van Helsingning odatdagidek oldindan o'ylash bilan hamma narsani to'g'rilab, hamma narsani tuzatganini ko'rdim.

en: look as pleasing as possible.
uz: iloji boricha yoqimli ko'rinishga ega bo'ling.

en: He had even brushed Lucy's hair, so that it lay on the pillow in its usual sunny ripples.
uz: U hatto Lusiyning sochlarini cho'zib, uning odatdagi quyoshli to'lqinlarida yostiqqa yopishib qo'ydi.

en: When we came into the room she opened her eyes, and seeing him, whispered softly, Arthur!
uz: Xonaga kirganimizda, u ko'zlarini ochdi va uni ko'rib, salomatlik bilan: Arthur!

en: Oh, my love, I am so glad you have come! He was stooping to kiss her, when Van Helsing motioned him back.
uz: Oh, sevgilim, kelganing uchun juda xursandman! - deb o'zini yuvgan u ayolni o'pmoqchi bo'lganida, Van Helsing unga javob berishga ishora qildi.

en: No, he whispered, not yet!
uz: Yo'q, - deb shov-shuv qildi u, hozirgacha emas!

en: Hold her hand, it will comfort her more. So Arthur took her hand and knelt beside her, and she looked her best, with all the soft lines matching the angelic beauty of her eyes.
uz: Uning qo'lini ushlab turing, bu uni yanada ko'proq tasalli beradi.Demak, Artur uning qo'lini olib, uning yonida tiz cho'kdi va u o'zining eng yaxshi ko'rinishi bilan ko'rindi, barcha yumshoq chiziqlar uning ko'zlarining farishtalik go'zalligiga mos keladi.

en: Then gradu- ally her eyes closed, and she sank to sleep.
uz: Keyinchalik uning ko'zlari yopildi va u uxlab ketdi.

en: For a little bit her breast heaved softly, and her breath came and went like a tired child's.
uz: Bir oz vaqt davomida uning ko'kraklari sekin-sakin ko'tarildi va uning nafaslari charchagan bola nafasini o'tkazdi.

en: And then insensibly there came the strange change which I had noticed in the night.
uz: So'ngra kechqurun ko'rgan g'alati o'zgarish paydo bo'ldi.

en: Her breathing grew stertorous, the mouth opened, and the pale gums, drawn back, made the teeth look longer and sharper than ever.
uz: Uning nafas olish jarayoni o'sib borardi, og'zi ochildi va o'zidan pastga tortib olingan bo'laklar tishlarni har qachongidan ko'ra uzoqroq va keskinroq ko'rinishga qo'shardi.

en: In a sort of sleepwaking, vague, unconscious way she opened her eyes, which were now dull and hard at once, and said in a soft,voluptuous voice, such as I had never heard from her lips, Arthur!
uz: U o'z ko'zlarini, endi bir vaqtning o'zida chiroyli va qattiq bo'lgan, o'zini uyg'otgan, nodon va bexabar tarzda ochdi va men hech qachon uning og'zidan eshitmagan yumshoq, hirsli ovoz bilan: Arthur!

en: Oh, my love, I am so glad you have come!
uz: Oh, sevgilim, kelganing uchun juda xursandman!

en: Kiss me! Arthur bent eagerly over to kiss her, but at that instant Van Helsing, who, like me, had been startled by her voice, swooped upon him, and catching him by the neck with both hands, dragged him back with a fury of strength which I never thought he could have possessed, and actually hurled him al- most across the room.
uz: Artur uni o'pish uchun o'ziga iltijo qildi, lekin o'sha daqiqada Van Helsing, men kabi uning ovozi uni hayratda qoldirib, uning boshiga tushib, uni bo'yniga qo'yib, ikki qo'lim bilan ushlab, uni hech qachon egallab ololmasligini his qilgan kuchli g'azab bilan orqaga surib, uni xonadan tashqariga tashladi.

en: Not on your life! he said, not for your living soul and hers! And he stood between them like a lion at bay.
uz: O'z joningiz bilan emas! - dedi u, o'z joningiz va uning joningiz uchun emas! - dedi va ularning o'rtasida bir sher kabi uzoqlikda turdi.

en: Arthur was so taken aback that he did not for a moment know what to do or say, and before any impulse of violence could seize him he realized the place and the occasion, and stood silent, waiting.
uz: Artur shunchalik hayron ediki, nima qilishni yoki nima qilishni bir daqiqa ham bilmadi va zo'ravonlik urushi uni ushlab qolmasidan oldin u joy va vazifani anglab oldi va sukut saqlashda davom etdi.

en: I kept my eyes ﬁxed on Lucy, as did Van Helsing, and we saw a spasm as of rage ﬂit like a shadow over her face.
uz: Men va Van Helsingning ko'zlari Lusiga qaratilgan edi va biz uning yuziga g'azabning soyasi kabi ko'rinadigan bir sarosima ko'rdik.

en: The sharp teeth clamped together.
uz: O'tkir tishlar bir-biriga bog'langan edi.

en: Then her eyes closed, and she breathed heavily.
uz: Keyin uning ko'zlari yopildi va u og'ir nafas oldi.

en: Very shortly after she opened her eyes in all their softness, and putting out her poor, pale, thin hand, took Van Helsing's great brown one, drawing it close to her, she kissed it.
uz: Ko'zlarini yumushli qilib ochib, kambag'al, soyuq qo'lini ko'targanidan ko'p o'tmay, Van Helsingning ko'p qirmizi qo'lini olib, o'ziga yaqinlashtirib, o'pdi.

en: My true friend, she said, in a faint voice, but with untellable pathos, My true friend, and his!
uz: Mening haqiqiy do'stim, - dedi u, soʻnggi ovoz bilan, ammo soʻzlab boʻlmaydigan xatti-harakatlar bilan, Mening haqiqiy doʻstim va uning!

en: Oh, guard him, and give me peace! I swear it! he said solemnly, kneeling beside her and holding up his hand, as one who registers an oath.
uz: Oh, uni himoya qil va menga tinchlik ber! - deb qasam ichaman, - dedi u, qizning yonida tiz cho'kib, qo'lini ko'tarib, qasam ichgan kishi kabi.

en: Then he turned to Arthur, and said to
uz: Keyin u Arturning oldiga qarab, shunday dedi:

en: him, Come, my child, take her hand in yours, and kiss her on the forehead, and only once. Their eyes met instead of their lips, and so they parted.
uz: Qizim, kel, uning qo'lini o'zingning qo'lingdan olib, faqat bir marta shapasiga o'pgin, - deb aytdi.

en: Lucy's eyes closed, and Van Helsing, who had been watching closely, took Arthur's arm, and drew him away.
uz: Lusiyaning ko'zlari yopildi va diqqat bilan kuzatib turgan Van Helsing Arturning qo'lini olib, uni olib ketdi.

en: And then Lucy's breathing became stertorous again, and all at once it ceased.
uz: Keyin Lusiyaning nafas olish jarayoni yana ko'tarildi va u birdan to'xtadi.

en: It is all over, said Van Helsing.
uz: Van Helsing shunday dedi: Butun narsa tugadi.

en: She is dead! I took Arthur by the arm, and led him away to the drawing room, where he sat down, and covered his face with his hands, sobbing in a way that nearly broke me down to see.
uz: U o'ldi! - dedim men Arturning qo'lidan ushlab, uni o'tirishga olib bordim va u yerda o'tirib, yuzini qo'llari bilan o'rab, ko'rish uchun o'zimni deyarli tushirib yuboradigan tarzda yig'lab yubordim.

en: I went back to the room, and found Van Helsing looking at poor Lucy, and his face was sterner than eve.
uz: Xonaga qaytib borganimda, Van Helsing kambag'al Lusiga qarab turganini va uning yuzi evaga qaraganda qattiqroq ekanini ko'rdim.

en: Some change had come over her body.
uz: Uning tanasi ustida o'zgarishlar yuz berdi.

en: Death had given back part of her beauty, for her brow and cheeks had re- covered some of their ﬂowing lines.
uz: O'lim uning go'zalligini qaytarib bergan edi, chunki uning burunlari va yig'inlari o'zlarining oqib o'tgan qatorlarini qayta qoplagan edi.

en: Even the lips had lost their deadly pal- lor.
uz: Hatto dudlar o'z o'limli do'stlarini yo'qotib qo'ygan edi.

en: It was as if the blood, no longer needed for the working of the heart, had gone to make the harshness of death as little rude as might be.
uz: O'sha paytda yurak ishlashi uchun endi kerak bo'lmagan qon o'limning shafqatsizligini o'zgartirgan bo'lardi.

en: We thought her dying whilst she slept, And sleeping when she died. I stood beside Van Helsing, and said, Ah well, poor girl, there is peace for her at last.
uz: Biz uni uyquda o'lib ketayotganini, va u o'lganida uxlayotganini o'ylagan edik. Men Van Helsingning yonida turib, shunday dedim: Aha, qashshoq qiz, uning uchun nihoyat tinchlik bor.

en: It is the end! He turned to me, and said with grave solemnity,Not so, alas!
uz: U menga qarab, jiddiy tantanalilik bilan dedi: Yo'q, vayl!

en: It is only the beginning! When I asked him what he meant, he only shook his head and answered, We can do nothing as yet.
uz: Bu faqat boshlanishdir! - deb so'raganimda, u boshini shovqatib: Biz hali hech narsa qila olmaymiz.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY—CONT.
uz: SEWARDning kundalik hikoyasi.

en: The funeral was arranged for the next succeeding day, so that Lucy and her mother might be buried together.
uz: O'z navbatida, Lucy va uning onasi birgalikda dafn qilinishi uchun, uning dafn marosimi ertangi kunga tashkil etildi.

en: I attended to all the ghastly formalities, and the urbane undertaker proved that his staff was afﬂicted, or blessed, with something of his own obsequious suavity.
uz: Men barcha qo'rqinchli formaliyatlarga qatnashdim va shaharda o'tkazadigan undertaker o'z xodimiga o'z kamtarligi bilan ta'sir ko'rsatganini isbotladi.

en: Even the woman who per- formed the last ofﬁces for the dead remarked to me, in a conﬁdential, broth- er-professional way, when she had come out from the death chamber, She makes a very beautiful corpse, sir.
uz: Hatto o'liklar uchun oxirgi ofislarni tashkil etgan ayol o'lim xonasi xonadondan chiqqanida, menga maxfiy, professional tarzda shunday dedi: U juda chiroyli jasad yaratadi, xo'jayinim.

en: It's quite a privilege to attend on her.
uz: U bilan birga bo'lish katta sharafdir.

en: It's not too much to say that she will do credit to our establishment! I noticed that Van Helsing never kept far away.
uz: U o'z ishini o'z ichiga oladi, deb aytish juda ham ko'p emas! Men Van Helsingning hech qachon uzoqda qolmaganini payqadim.

en: This was possible from the disordered state of things in the household.
uz: Bu uydagi tartibsiz holat tufayli mumkin edi.

en: There were no relatives at hand, and as Arthur had to be back the next day to attend at his father's fu- neral, we were unable to notify any one who should have been bidden.
uz: O'sha yerda qarindoshlar yo'q edi va ertasi kuni Artur otasining marosimida qatnashishi kerak bo'lganligi sababli, biz taklif qilinishi kerak bo'lganlarni xabardor qila olmadik.

en: Un- der the circumstances, Van Helsing and I took it upon ourselves to examine papers, etc.
uz: O'z sharoitida, Van Helsing va men qog'ozlarni ko'rib chiqish vazifasini o'zimiz zimmasiga oldik.

en: He insisted upon looking over Lucy's papers himself.
uz: U Luiyaning hujjatlarini o'zi ko'rib chiqishga rag'batlantirgan.

en: I asked him why, for I feared that he, being a foreigner, might not be quite aware of English legal requirements, and so might in ignorance make some unneces- sary trouble.
uz: Men undan nima uchun so'radim, chunki u chet ellik bo'lgani uchun ingliz qonunlari talablarini yaxshi bilmasligi va jaholatdan foydalanib, keraksiz muammolar yuzaga kelishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardim.

en: He answered me, I know, I know.
uz: U menga shunday javob berdi: Bilaman, bilaman.

en: You forget that I am a lawyer as well as a doctor.
uz: Men advokat va shifokor ekanimni unutasiz.

en: But this is not altogether for the law.
uz: Ammo bu qonun uchun emas.

en: You knew that, when you avoided the coroner.
uz: Buni koronerdan qochganingizda bilar edingiz.

en: I have more than him to avoid.
uz: Men undan ko'ra ko'proq narsalardan qochishim kerak.

en: There may be papers more, such as this. As he spoke he took from his pocket book the memorandum which had been in Lucy's breast, and which she had torn in her sleep.
uz: Bu kabi qog'ozlar ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin. U gapirganida, Lucyning ko'krakida bo'lgan va u uxlab yotganida yirtirib tashlagan memorandumni qopqoq kitobidan oldi.

en: When you ﬁnd anything of the solicitor who is for the late Mrs.
uz: Agar siz marhum xonimning advokatidan biron bir narsani topganingizda

en: Westen- ra, seal all her papers, and write him tonight.
uz: Vesten-ra, uning barcha qog'ozlarini muhrlab, bu kecha unga yozadi.

en: For me, I watch here in the room and in Miss Lucy's old room all night, and I myself search for what may be.
uz: Men esa butun kecha bu xonada va Miss Lusiyaning eski xonadoniga qarab turaman va nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'zim qidiraman.

en: It is not well that her very thoughts go into the hands of strangers.
uz: Uning o'y-fikrlari begonalarning qo'liga o'tishi yaxshi emas.

en: I went on with my part of the work, and in another half hour had found the name and address of Mrs.
uz: Men o'z ishimni davom ettirdim va yana yarim soat ichida xonimning ismi va manzili topildi.

en: Westenra's solicitor and had written to him.
uz: U Vestenraning advokatidir va unga xat yozgan.

en: All the poor lady's papers were in order.
uz: Bu kambag'al ayolning barcha hujjatlari to'g'ri edi.

en: Explicit directions regarding the place of burial were given.
uz: Qabr qilish joyi to'g'risida aniq ko'rsatmalar berildi.

en: I had hardly sealed the letter, when, to my sur- prise, Van Helsing walked into the room, saying, Can I help you friend John?
uz: Men o'sha maktubni o'chirib bo'lmaganda, Van Helsing xonasiga kirib: Do'stim Jon, sizga yordam bersam bo'ladimi?

en: I am free, and if I may, my service is to you. Have you got what you looked for? I asked.
uz: Men erkinman va agar ruxsat berilsa, sizga xizmat qilaman. - Men: Siz izlagan narsangizni topdingizmi? - deb so'radim.

en: To which he replied, I did not look for any speciﬁc thing.
uz: U shunday javob berdi: Men hech qanday aniq narsani izlamaganman.

en: I only hoped to ﬁnd, and ﬁnd I have, all that there was, only some letters and a few mem- oranda, and a diary new begun.
uz: Men faqatgina bir nechta xat va xatlar va yangi boshlanayotgan jurnalni topishni umid qilardim.

en: But I have them here, and we shall for the present say nothing of them.
uz: Lekin bu yerda ular bor va hozircha ular haqida hech narsa aytmaymiz.

en: I shall see that poor lad tomorrow evening, and, with his sanction, I shall use some. When we had ﬁnished the work in hand, he said to me, And now, friend John, I think we may to bed.
uz: Ertaga kechqurun bu kambag'al yigit bilan uchrashaman va uning roziligi bilan birozdan foydalanaman. Ishni tugatgandan so'ng, u menga dedi: Va endi, do'stim Jon, men o'ylashga ketamiz deb o'ylayman.

en: We want sleep, both you and I, and rest to re- cuperate.
uz: Biz ham, siz ham uxlab, dam olish uchun dam olishni istaymiz.

en: Tomorrow we shall have much to do, but for the tonight there is no need of us.
uz: Ertaga ko'p ishlar bo'ladi, lekin bu kecha uchun bizga ehtiyoj yo'q.

en: Alas! Before turning in we went to look at poor Lucy.
uz: Afsus! - deb so'rashdan oldin kambag'al Lusiga qarab ketdik.

en: The undertaker had cer- tainly done his work well, for the room was turned into a small chapelle ar- dente.
uz: Qabriston o'z ishini yaxshi bajargan edi, chunki xonani kichkina chapella arentega aylantirgan edi.

en: There was a wilderness of beautiful white ﬂowers, and death was made as little repulsive as might be.
uz: Go'zal oq gullar bilan to'lib-toshgan sahro bor edi va o'lim imkon qadar yoqimsiz bo'lgan.

en: The end of the winding sheet was laid over the face.
uz: O'tkirlik varaqasining oxiri yuziga qo'yilgan edi.

en: When the Professor bent over and turned it gently back, we both started at the beauty before us.
uz: Professor egrilib o'zini pastga o'zgartirganida, ikkovimiz ham oldimizda turgan go'zallikka qaray boshladik.

en: The tall wax candles showing a sufﬁ- cient light to note it well.
uz: Uzoq shamol chiroqlari uni yaxshi ko'rish uchun etarlicha yorug'likni ko'rsatadi.

en: All Lucy's loveliness had come back to her in death, and the hours that had passed, instead of leaving traces of `decay's effacing ﬁngers', had but restored the beauty of life, till positively I could not believe my eyes that I was looking at a corpse.
uz: Lusiyaning go'zalligi o'limda unga qaytib keldi va o'tgan soatlar, `decayning o'chirib ketayotgan barmoqlari izlarini qoldirishning o'rniga, hayotning go'zalligini tikladi, hatto o'zimning ko'zimga o'zimning jasadga qarayotganimga ishonolmadim.

en: The Professor looked sternly grave.
uz: Professor qattiq o'tkir ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: He had not loved her as I had, and there was no need for tears in his eyes.
uz: U uni men kabi sevmagan edi va uning ko'zlarida yoshlar bo'lishi kerak emas edi.

en: He said to me, Remain till I return, and left the room.
uz: U menga: Men qaytib kelgunimcha qoling, - dedi va xonani tark etdi.

en: He came back with a handful of wild garlic from the box waiting in the hall, but which had not been opened, and placed the ﬂowers amongst the others on and around the bed.
uz: U salonda kutib turgan, lekin ochilmagan qutudan bir necha qoshiq yovvoyi sarimush bilan qaytib keldi va gullarni boshqalarning o'rtasida yotoq ustiga va uning atrofida joylashtirdi.

en: Then he took from his neck, in- side his collar, a little gold cruciﬁx, and placed it over the mouth.
uz: So'ngra u bo'yni, bo'yiga bo'lgan bo'yniga oltin xochni olib, og'ziga qo'ydi.

en: He restored the sheet to its place, and we came away.
uz: U varaqni o'z joyida tikladi va biz ketdik.

en: I was undressing in my own room, when, with a premonitory tap at the door, he entered, and at once began to speak.
uz: Men o'z xonamda kiyimlarini yechib o'tirganimda, u eshikga qo'ng'iroq qilib kirdi va darhol gapira boshladi.

en: Tomorrow I want you to bring me, before night, a set of post-mortem knives. Must we make an autopsy? I asked.
uz: Ertaga kechqurun menga post mortm qilichlari to'plamini olib kelishingni istayman. - deb so'radim.

en: I want to operate, but not what you think.
uz: Men operatsiya qilishni xohlayman, lekin siz o'ylaganidek emas.

en: Let me tell you now, but not a word to another.
uz: Endi sizga aytaman, lekin boshqalarga bir so'z aytmayman.

en: I want to cut off her head and take out her heart.
uz: Men uning boshini kesib, yuragini chiqarib olishni istayman.

en: You a surgeon, and so shocked!
uz: Siz jarrohsiz va juda hayratda qoldingiz!

en: You, whom I have seen with no tremble of hand or heart, do operations of life and death that make the rest shudder.
uz: Siz, qo'l yoki yurak titratmasdan ko'rganim, hayot va o'lim operatsiyalarini amalga oshirib, qolganlarni dahshatga solyapsiz.

en: Oh, but I must not forget, my dear friend John, that you loved her, and I have not forgotten it for is I that shall operate, and you must not help.
uz: Oh, lekin men uni yaxshi ko'rganingni unutmasligim kerak, aziz do'stim Jon, men ham unutmaganman, chunki operatsiya qilish uchun men borman va siz yordam bermasligingiz kerak.

en: I would like to do it tonight, but for Arthur I must not.
uz: Men buni bugun kechqurun qilishni xohlayman, ammo Artur uchun bunga yo'l qo'ymayman.

en: He will be free after his father's funeral tomorrow, and he will want to see her, to see it.
uz: Ertaga otasining dafnidan so'ng u ozod bo'ladi va u uni ko'rishni xohlaydi.

en: Then, when she is cofﬁned ready for the next day, you and I shall come when all sleep.
uz: Keyin, u ertangi kunga tayyor bo'lganida, biz ham, siz ham uxlaganimizda kelamiz.

en: We shall unscrew the cofﬁn lid, and shall do our operation, and then replace all, so that none know, save we alone. But why do it at all?
uz: Biz ko'krak qopqog'ini ochib, operatsiyamizni bajaramiz, so'ngra barchasini almashtiramiz, shunda bizdan boshqa hech kim bilmaydi.

en: Why mutilate her poor body with- out need?
uz: Nima uchun uning kambag'al tanasini ehtiyojsiz shikastlantirish kerak?

en: And if there is no necessity for a post-mortem and nothing to gain by it, no good to her, to us, to science, to human knowledge, why do it?
uz: Va agar post mortemga zarurat yo'q bo'lsa va undan hech qanday foyda yo'q bo'lsa, unga, bizga, ilm-fanga, inson bilimlariga hech qanday foyda yo'q bo'lsa, unda nega bunday qilish kerak?

en: Without such it is monstrous. For answer he put his hand on my shoulder, and said, with inﬁnite tender- ness, Friend John, I pity your poor bleeding heart, and I love you the more because it does so bleed.
uz: Bunday bo'lmasa, bu dahshatli bo'ladi. U javob sifatida qo'lini yelkamga qo'ydi va cheksiz mehr-shafqat bilan: Do'st Jon, sening kambag'al qon ketayotgan qalbingdan achinaman va seni shuncha ko'proq sevaman, chunki u shuncha qon ketadi.

en: If I could, I would take on myself the burden that you do bear.
