uz: Agar iloji bo'lganida, siz ko'targan og'irlikni o'z zimmamga oldim.

en: But there are things that you know not, but that you shall know, and bless me for knowing, though they are not pleasant things.
uz: Ammo siz bilmaydigan, lekin bilishingiz kerak bo'lgan narsalar bor va ular yoqimli bo'lmasa-da, bilishim uchun meni qutqaring.

en: John, my child, you have been my friend now many years, and yet did you ever know me to do any without good cause?
uz: Jon, bola, sen ko'p yillar davomida mening do'stim bo'lib kelganing, lekin hech qachon meni biron bir sababsiz ish qilishimni bilganingmi?

en: I may err, I am but man, but I be- lieve in all I do.
uz: Men xatoga yo'l qo'yishim mumkin, men faqatgina odamman, lekin hamma ishlarimda muloyimman.

en: Was it not for these causes that you send for me when the great trouble came?
uz: Buyuk qayg'u kelganida, siz meni shu sabablarga ko'ra chaqirtirganmisiz?

en: Were you not amazed, nay horriﬁed, when I would not let Arthur kiss his love, though she was dying, and snatched him away by all my strength?
uz: Artur o'lib ketayotgan bo'lsa-da, o'z sevgisini o'pishiga yo'l qo'ymaganimda, siz hayron bo'lmaganmisiz, balki qo'rqib ketganmisiz?

en: And yet you saw how she thanked me, with her so beautiful dying eyes, her voice, too, so weak, and she kiss my rough old hand and bless me?
uz: Ammo u menga shu qadar chiroyli ko'zlari bilan, shu qadar zaif ovozi bilan minnatdorchilik bildirganini ko'rdingizmi, qo'limni o'qib, duo qilganini ko'rdingizmi?

en: And did you not hear me swear promise to her, that so she closed her eyes grateful?
uz: Va men unga qasam ichganimni eshitmadingmi, shunday qilib, u minnatdorlik bilan ko'zlarini yopdi?

en: Well, I have good reason now for all I want to do.
uz: Hamma narsani qilishim uchun hozir yaxshi sabablarim bor.

en: You have for many years trust me.
uz: Siz ko'p yillar davomida menga ishonasiz.

en: You have believe me weeks past, when there be things so strange that you might have well doubt.
uz: Siz o'tgan haftalar davomida menga ishonasizki, shubhasiz, shubhalanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan g'alati narsalar bo'lgan.

en: Believe me yet a little, friend John.
uz: Menga biroz ishoning, do'stim Jon.

en: If you trust me not, then I must tell what I think, and that is not perhaps well.
uz: Agar siz menga ishonmasangiz, mening fikrimni aytishim kerak va bu yaxshi emas.

en: And if I work, as work I shall, no matter trust or no trust, without my
uz: Va agar men ishlasam, shu kabi ishlasam, ishonch yoki ishonchsiz ishlasam ham, o'zimsiz ishlasam ham.

en: friend trust in me, I work with heavy heart and feel, oh so lonely when I want all help and courage that may be! He paused a moment and went on solemnly, Friend John, there are strange and terrible days before us.
uz: Do'stim menga ishonadi, men og'ir yurak bilan ishlayman va o'zimni juda yolg'iz his qilaman, chunki men barcha yordam va jasoratni xohlayman!  U bir daqiqa to'xtatib, tantanali ravishda davom etdi: Do'stim Jon, oldimizda g'alati va dahshatli kunlar bor.

en: Let us not be two, but one, that so we work to a good end.
uz: Keling, ikki emas, bir bo'laylik, shunda yaxshi maqsadga erishamiz.

en: Will you not have faith in me? I took his hand, and promised him.
uz: Menga ishonmaysanmi? - deb qo'lidan ushlab, va'da berdim.

en: I held my door open as he went away, and watched him go to his room and close the door.
uz: U ketayotganda eshikni ochiq tutdim va uni o'z xonasiga kirib eshikni yopayotganini ko'rdim.

en: As I stood without moving, I saw one of the maids pass silently along the passage, she had her back to me, so did not see me, and go into the room where Lucy lay.
uz: Men harakatlanmay turganimda, xizmatkorlardan biri pastga o'tib ketayotganini ko'rdim, u mening orqamga orqaga o'tirib, meni ko'rmadi va Lusiyo yotgan xonaniga kirdi.

en: The sight touched me.
uz: Ko'rinish menga ta'sir qildi.

en: Devotion is so rare, and we are so grateful to those who show it unasked to those we love.
uz: Donolik juda kam uchraydi va biz uni biz sevganlarga so'ramagan holda ko'rsatganlarga minnatdormiz.

en: Here was a poor girl putting aside the ter- rors which she naturally had of death to go watch alone by the bier of the mistress whom she loved, so that the poor clay might not be lonely till laid to eternal rest.
uz: Mana, bir kambag'al qiz o'limdan kelib qolgan terorlarni chetga qo'yib, sevgan xonadonining pichasida yolg'iz kuzatib turar edi, shunda kambag'al loy abadiy dam olmaguncha yolg'iz qolmasligi mumkin edi.

en: I must have slept long and soundly, for it was broad daylight when Van Helsing waked me by coming into my room.
uz: Uzoq va yaxshi uxlagan bo'laman, chunki kun yorug' edi, va Van Helsing meni o'z xonamga kirib uyg'otdi.

en: He came over to my bedside and said, You need not trouble about the knives.
uz: U yonimga kelib, dedi: Sizning pichoqlar bilan muammo bo'lishingiz shart emas.

en: We shall not do it. Why not? I asked.
uz: Biz buni qilmaymiz. - Nega qilmaylik? deb so'radim.

en: For his solemnity of the night before had greatly im- pressed me.
uz: Chunki o'tgan kechagi uning tantanaliligi meni qattiq xavotirga solgan edi.

en: Because, he said sternly, it is too late, or too early.
uz: U qattiqqo'llik bilan: Agar kech bo'lsa yoki erta bo'lsa, - dedi.

en: See! Here he held up the little golden cruciﬁx.
uz: Mana! - dedi u, oltin xochni ko'tarib.

en: This was stolen in the night. How stolen,I asked in wonder,since you have it now? Because I get it back from the worthless wretch who stole it, from the woman who robbed the dead and the living.
uz: Bu kechasi o'g'irlangan edi.  Qanday qilib o'g'irlangan, - deb so'radim men hayron, agar sizda endi bor ekan? - deb so'radim men uni o'g'irlagan behuda kambag'aldan, tiriklar va o'liklarni o'g'irlagan ayoldan qaytarib oldim.

en: Her punishment will surely come, but not through me.
uz: Uning jazosi albatta keladi, lekin men orqali emas.

en: She knew not altogether what she did, and thus unknowing, she only stole.
uz: O'zi nima qilayotganini bilmagan, shuning uchun o'zi bilmasdan o'g'irlagan.

en: Now we must wait. He went away on the word, leaving me with a new mystery to think of, a new puzzle to grapple with.
uz: Endi kutishimiz kerak. - deb so'zlab ketib, meni yangi sir bilan haydab qo'ydi, yangi jumboq bilan kurashishga majbur qildi.

en: The forenoon was a dreary time, but at noon the solicitor came, Mr.
uz: So'nggi kun chiroyli vaqt edi, lekin tushda advokat keldi, Mr.

en: Mar- quand, of Wholeman, Sons, Marquand & Lidderdale.
uz: Mar- qachon, Wholeman, Sons, Marquand & Lidderdale.

en: He was very genial and very appreciative of what we had done, and took off our hands all cares as to details.
uz: U juda dahshatli va biz qilgan ishimizni juda qadrlagan va tafsilotlarga e'tiborimizni qaratmay qo'ydi.

en: During lunch he told us that Mrs.
uz: Ovqatlanayotgan paytimizda u bizga xonimning bu haqda gapirganini aytdi.

en: Westenra had for some time expected sudden death from her heart, and had put her affairs in absolute order.
uz: Vestenra bir muncha vaqt davomida yuragidan to'satdan o'limni kutgan va o'z ishlarini mutlaqo tartibga solgan.

en: He informed us that, with the exception of a certain entailed property of Lucy's father which now, in default of direct issue, went back to a distant branch of the family, the whole estate, real and personal, was left absolutely to Arthur Holmwood.
uz: U bizga ma'lum qildiki, Lucyning otasining muayyan mulkini o'z ichiga olgan bo'lsa-da, u endi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqarilmagan holda oilaning uzoq bo'limiga qaytib ketgan edi, butun mol-mulk, real va shaxsiy, Arthur Holmvudga to'liq qoldirilgan.

en: When he had told us so much he went on,
uz: U bizga shuncha narsalarni aytib bo'lgach, davom etdi,

en: Frankly we did our best to prevent such a testamentary disposition, and pointed out certain contingencies that might leave her daughter either pen- niless or not so free as she should be to act regarding a matrimonial al- liance.
uz: Agar rost bo'lsak, biz bunday vasiyatchilikni oldini olish uchun qo'limizdan kelganini qildik va qizini pensiyasiz yoki nikoh shartnomasi bo'yicha harakat qilish huquqiga ega bo'lmagan holda qoldirishi mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi halokatlarga e'tibor qaratdik.

en: Indeed, we pressed the matter so far that we almost came into colli- sion, for she asked us if we were or were not prepared to carry out her wish- es.
uz: Darhaqiqat, biz bu masalaga shunchacha bosim o'tkazdikki, deyarli to'qnashuvga tushib qoldik, chunki u bizdan uning xohishini bajarishga tayyormizmi yoki yo'qmi deb so'radi.

en: Of course, we had then no alternative but to accept.
uz: Albatta, o'shanda qabul qilishdan boshqa yo'q edi.

en: We were right in principle, and ninety-nine times out of a hundred we should have proved, by the logic of events, the accuracy of our judgment.
uz: Biz prinsipda to'g'ri bo'lganmiz va yuzdan to'qqiz marta o'z hukmimizning to'g'riligini voqealar mantiqidan isbotlashimiz kerak edi.

en: Frankly, however, I must admit that in this case any other form of dispo- sition would have rendered impossible the carrying out of her wishes.
uz: Biroq, rostini aytsam, bu holatda uning istaklarini amalga oshirish imkonsiz bo'lgan har qanday boshqa tartib-taomil bo'lishi mumkinligini tan oldim.

en: For by her predeceasing her daughter the latter would have come into posses- sion of the property, and, even had she only survived her mother by ﬁve minutes, her property would, in case there were no will, and a will was a practical impossibility in such a case, have been treated at her decease as under intestacy.
uz: Chunki uning o'limidan oldin o'z qizi mol-mulkga ega bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin edi va agar u onasini besh daqiqaga qoldirgan bo'lsa ham, uning mol-mulki, agar vasiyat yo'q bo'lsa va bunday holatda vasiyat imkonsiz bo'lsa, uning o'limidan so'ng o'z merosini o'zidan o'tkazgan bo'ladi.

en: In which case Lord Godalming, though so dear a friend, would have had no claim in the world.
uz: Shunday holatda Lord Godalming, garchi u aziz do'st bo'lsa-da, bu dunyoda hech qanday huquqga ega bo'lmagan.

en: And the inheritors, being remote, would not be likely to abandon their just rights, for sentimental reasons re- garding an entire stranger.
uz: Va merosxo'rlar, uzoq bo'lgani uchun, butunlay begona odamni qo'riqlash uchun hissiy sabablarga ko'ra, o'z adolatli huquqlaridan voz kechish ehtimoli yo'q.

en: I assure you, my dear sirs, I am rejoiced at the result,perfectly rejoiced. He was a good fellow, but his rejoicing at the one little part, in which he was ofﬁcially interested, of so great a tragedy, was an object-lesson in the limitations of sympathetic understanding.
uz: Sizlarga shuni aytaman, aziz rafiqamlar, natijaga quvonaman, to'liq quvonaman. U yaxshi odam edi, ammo uning bunday katta fojia bilan rasmiy qiziqish ko'rsatgan kichik qismidan quvonishi hamdardlik tushunchasining cheklovlarida saboq bo'ldi.

en: He did not remain long, but said he would look in later in the day and see Lord Godalming.
uz: U uzoq vaqt qolmadi, lekin kunning oxirida Lord Godalmingni ko'rishini aytdi.

en: His coming, however, had been a certain comfort to us, since it assured us that we should not have to dread hostile criticism as to any of our acts.
uz: Biroq, uning kelishi bizga tasalli baxsh etardi, chunki bu bizga hech qanday qilmishimiz haqida dushman tanqiddan qo'rqmasligimizni ishontirdi.

en: Arthur was expected at ﬁve o'clock, so a little before that time we visited the death chamber.
uz: Arturning beshda bo'lishi kutilmoqda edi, shuning uchun o'sha vaqtdan biroz oldin biz o'lim xonasiga tashrif buyurdik.

en: It was so in very truth, for now both mother and daughter lay in it.
uz: Haqiqatan ham shunday edi, hozircha ona ham, qizi ham u yerda yotgan edi.

en: The undertaker, true to his craft, had made the best display he could of his goods, and there was a mortuary air about the place that lowered our spirits at once.
uz: Qabriston o'z hunariga sodiq bo'lib, o'z mol-mulkini imkon qadar yaxshi ko'rsatdi va o'sha joy atrofida o'liklar xonasi paydo bo'ldi, bu esa bizning ruhimizni darhol pasaytirdi.

en: Van Helsing ordered the former arrangement to be adhered to, explaining that, as Lord Godalming was coming very soon, it would be less harrowing to his feelings to see all that was left of his ﬁancee quite alone.
uz: Van Helsing avvalgi tuzumga amal qilishni buyurdi va Lord Godalming tez orada kelishi sababli, uning kuyovidan qolgan hamma narsani yolg'iz ko'rish uning his-tuyg'ularini kamaytiradi, deb tushuntirdi.

en: The undertaker seemed shocked at his own stupidity and exerted himself to restore things to the condition in which we left them the night before, so that when Arthur came such shocks to his feelings as we could avoid were saved.
uz: O'zining o'z ahmoqligidan qabrxona egasi hayron bo'lib, o'zi uchun harakat qilib, narsalarni o'tgan kecha qoldirganimiz holatga qaytarishga harakat qildi, shunda Arturning his-tuyg'ularidan qochishimiz mumkin bo'lgan bunday hayronchiliklar saqlanib qolishi mumkin edi.

en: He looked desperately sad and broken.
uz: U juda qayg'urgan va buzilgan ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: Even his stalwart manhood seemed to have shrunk somewhat under the strain of his much- tried emotions.
uz: Hatto uning kuchli erkakligi ham ko'p sinovdan o'tgan his-tuyg'ularining bosimi ostida biroz qisqargan bo'ldi.

en: He had, I knew, been very genuinely and devotedly attached to his father, and to lose him, and at such a time, was a bitter blow to him.
uz: O'zim bilganimcha, u o'z otasiga samimiy va sadoqatli bo'lgan va uni yo'qotish unga qattiq zarba bo'lgan.

en: With me he was warm as ever, and to Van Helsing he was sweetly courte- ous.
uz: Men bilan u har doimgidek iliq edi, Van Helsing bilan esa mehribon va mehribon edi.

en: But I could not help seeing that there was some constraint with him.
uz: Ammo u bilan biroz cheklovlar borligini ko'rishga yordam berolmadim.

en: The professor noticed it too, and motioned me to bring him upstairs.
uz: Professor ham buni payqadi va uni yuqoriga olib kelishimga ishora qildi.

en: I did so, and left him at the door of the room, as I felt he would like to be quite alone with her, but he took my arm and led me in, saying huskily, You loved her too, old fellow.
uz: Men shunday qildim va uni xonaning eshigida qoldirdim, chunki u u bilan yolg'iz qolishni xohlaydi deb o'yladim, lekin u mening qo'limni olib, meni o'ziga jalb qildi va jasorat bilan: Sen ham uni yaxshi ko'rgan eding, keksa.

en: She told me all about it, and there was no friend had a closer place in her heart than you.
uz: U menga bu haqda hamma narsani aytib berdi va sizdan ko'ra uning yuragida yaqinroq joyga ega bo'lgan do'stim yo'q edi.

en: I don't know how to thank you for all you have done for her.
uz: U uchun qilgan barcha ishlaringiz uchun sizga qanday minnatdorchilik bildirishimni bilmayman.

en: I can't think yet …  Here he suddenly broke down, and threw his arms round my shoulders and laid his head on my breast, crying, Oh, Jack!
uz: Men hali o'ylay olmayman...  Bu yerda u to'satdan buzib, qo'llarini yelkamga tashlab, boshini ko'krakimga qo'ydi va: Oh, Jek!

en: The whole of life seems gone from me all at once, and there is nothing in the wide world for me to live for. I comforted him as well as I could.
uz: Hayotimning barchasi birdan yo'qolganiga o'xshaydi va bu keng dunyoda men uchun yashash uchun hech narsa yo'q. Men unga imkon qadar ko'nglimni yumshatdim.

en: In such cases men do not need much expression.
uz: Bunday holatlarda erkaklar ko'p ifodalanishga muhtoj emaslar.

en: A grip of the hand, the tightening of an arm over the shoulder, a sob in unison, are expressions of sympathy dear to a man's heart.
uz: Qo'lni qo'lga olish, yelkadan ko'tariladigan qo'lni qo'yib olish, bir ovozda yig'ish - bu inson yuragiga yoqadigan hamdardlik ifodasi.

en: I stood still and silent till his sobs died away, and then I said softly to him, Come and look at her. Together we moved over to the bed, and I lifted the lawn from her face.
uz: Men uning yig'lab-ichib o'lganidan so'ng o'zimni to'xtatib turdim, so'ngra unga salomatlik bilan: Kelin, unga qarang, - dedim.

en: How beautiful she was.
uz: U qanchalik chiroyli edi.

en: Every hour seemed to be enhancing her love- liness.
uz: Har bir soatda uning mehr-muhabbati yanada kuchayib borayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: It frightened and amazed me somewhat.
uz: Bu meni qo'rqitdi va biroz hayratda qoldirdi.

en: And as for Arthur, he fell to trembling, and ﬁnally was shaken with doubt as with an ague.
uz: Artur esa dahshatga tushdi va oxir-oqibat shak-shubhadan shov-shuvga tushdi.

en: At last, after a long pause, he said to me in a faint whisper,Jack, is she really dead? I assured him sadly that it was so, and went on to suggest, for I felt that such a horrible doubt should not have life for a moment longer than I could help, that it often happened that after death faces become softened and even resolved into their youthful beauty, that this was especially so when death had been preceded by any acute or prolonged suffering.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, uzoq to'xtatishdan so'ng, u menga bir so'z so'radi: Jack, u haqiqatan ham o'lganmi? Men uni xafa bo'lib shunday deb ishontirdim va yana aytdim, chunki men bunday dahshatli shubha men yordam bera olmasligimdan bir daqiqa ko'proq umr ko'rmasligi kerakligini his qilardim, ko'pincha o'limdan keyin yuzlar yumshatadi va hatto yoshlik go'zalligiga aylanadi, ayniqsa, o'limda biron bir keskin yoki uzoq vaqt davomida azob-uqubatlar bo'lganida.

en: I seemed to quite do away with any doubt, and after kneeling beside the couch for a while and looking at her lovingly and long, he turned aside.
uz: Men hech qanday shubhalarni yo'qotib qo'yganman va bir muncha vaqt sofaning yonida tiz cho'kib, unga sevgi ila va uzoq vaqtdan ko'z tikganidan so'ng, u yon o'girdi.

en: I told him that that must be goodbye, as the cofﬁn had to be prepared, so he went back and took her dead hand in his and kissed it, and bent over and kissed her forehead.
uz: Men unga bu xayrli ish bo'lishi kerakligini aytdim, chunki jasad tayyorlanishi kerak edi, shuning uchun u qaytib borib, uning o'lik qo'lini o'z qo'lidan oldi va o'zini o'pdi.

en: He came away, fondly looking back over his shoulder at her as he came.
uz: U qaytib kelib, qaytib kelayotganida, qizga yelkasiga qarab qarab qolibdi.

en: I left him in the drawing room, and told Van Helsing that he had said goodbye, so the latter went to the kitchen to tell the undertaker's men to pro- ceed with the preperations and to screw up the cofﬁn.
uz: Men uni salonga qoldirib, Van Helsingga salom aytganini aytdim, shuning uchun u oshxonaga borib, o'liklarxonasi odamlariga tayyorgarlik ko'rishni davom ettirishlarini va ko'mirni buzishlarini aytdi.

en: When he came out of the room again I told him of Arthur's question, and he replied, I am not surprised.
uz: U yana xonadan chiqqanida, men unga Arturning savolini aytib berdim va u: Men hayron emasman.

en: Just now I doubted for a moment myself! We all dined together, and I could see that poor Art was trying to make the best of things.
uz: O'zim ham bir zumda shubha qildim! - deb, hammamiz birga ovqatlanardik va men kambag'al Artning hamma narsadan foydalanishga harakat qilayotganini ko'rardim.

en: Van Helsing had been silent all dinner time, but when we had lit our cigars he said, Lord … , but Arthur interrupted him.
uz: Van Helsing kechki ovqat davomida sukut saqlagan edi, lekin biz sigarlarimizni yoqib qo'yganimizda, u: Rabbim... , ammo Artur uni aralashtirdi.

en: No, no, not that, for God's sake!
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, bu emas, xudo uchun!

en: Not yet at any rate.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda hali ham.

en: I did not mean to speak offensively.
uz: Men tanqid qilishni istamagan edim.

en: It is only because my loss is so recent. The Professor answered very sweetly, I only used that name because I was in doubt.
uz: Buning sababi faqatgina o'zimni yo'qotganimdan iborat, - deb javob berdi professor. Men bu ismni faqat shubha ostiga qo'yganim uchun ishlatganman.

en: I must not call you `Mr.' and I have grown to love you, yes, my dear boy, to love you, as Arthur. Arthur held out his hand, and took the old man's warmly.
uz: Men seni `Mr' deb atamaslikka majburman va men seni sevishga o'sib bordim, ha, aziz o'g'lim, seni Artur kabi sevishga.  Artur qo'lini uzatdi va keksa odamning qo'lini iliq ko'tarib oldi.

en: Call me what you will, he said.
uz: U: Meni qanday chaqirsangiz, shunday chaqirib ko'ring, dedi.

en: I hope I may always have the title of a friend.
uz: Umid qilamanki, do'stimning unvoni doim o'z zimmamda bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And let me say that I am at a loss for words to thank you for your goodness to my poor dear. He paused a moment, and went on, I know that she understood your goodness even better than I do.
uz: Qizim, sen menga yaxshilik qilganing uchun minnatdorchilik bildirishim uchun so'zlarim yo'q, - deb aytaman.U biroz to'xtadi va davom etdi: Men uning yaxshilik qilishingizni mendan ham yaxshiroq tushunishini bilaman.

en: And if I was rude or in any way wanti- ng at that time you acted so, you remember,— the Professor nodded —You must forgive me. He answered with a grave kindness, I know it was hard for you to quite trust me then, for to trust such violence needs to understand, and I take it that you do not, that you cannot, trust me now, for you do not yet under- stand.
uz: Va agar men o'sha paytda qo'pollik yoki biron bir yo'l bilan harakat qilgan bo'lsam, siz ham shunday yo'l tutganingizni eslaysiz, - deb o'ylaydi professor. Siz meni kechirishingiz kerak, - dedi professor.U juda mehribonlik bilan javob berdi: O'sha paytda menga ishonish siz uchun qiyin kechganini bilaman, chunki bunday zo'ravonlikka ishonish tushunish kerak, va men buni qila olmasligingizni, qila olmasligingizni, hozir ishonishingiz kerakligini bilaman, chunki siz hali ham o'zingizga ishonmayapsiz.

en: And there may be more times when I shall want you to trust when you cannot, and may not, and must not yet understand.
uz: Va siz hali tushunolmayotgan, tushunolmayotgan va tushunmasligi kerak bo'lgan paytlarda sizdan ishonch hosil qilishingizni so'ragan paytlar ham bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But the time will come when your trust shall be whole and complete in me, and when you shall understand as though the sunlight himself shone through.
uz: Ammo vaqt keladi, o'shanda menga bo'lgan ishonchingiz to'liq va to'liq bo'ladi va quyosh nurining o'zi o'z ichiga olayotganidek tushunasiz.

en: Then you shall bless me from ﬁrst to last for your own sake, and for the sake of oth- ers, and for her dear sake to whom I swore to protect. And indeed, indeed, sir, said Arthur warmly.
uz: Keyin o'zingiz uchun, boshqalar uchun va men himoya qilishga qasam ichgan sevimli ayol uchun o'zingizdan va oxirigacha meni duo qilasiz. - Haqiqatan ham, haqiqatan ham, sir, - dedi Artur samimiylik bilan.

en: I shall in all ways trust you.
uz: Senga ishonaman.

en: I know and believe you have a very noble heart, and you are Jack's friend, and you were hers.
uz: Men bilaman va ishonamanki, sizda juda buyuk yurak bor, siz Jekning do'sti va siz uning do'sti bo'lgansiz.

en: You shall do what you like. The Professor cleared his throat a couple of times, as though about to speak, and ﬁnally said, May I ask you something now? Certainly. You know that Mrs.
uz: O'zingiz xohlaganingizni qila olasiz. Professor bir necha marta gapirmoqchi bo'lib, qo'lini ochib, oxir-oqibat: Sizdan bir narsa so'rasam bo'ladimi? - deb so'radi.

en: Westenra left you all her property? No, poor dear.
uz: Westenra senga butun mol-mulkini qoldirdi? - Yo'q, kambag'al.

en: I never thought of it.
uz: Men bu haqda hech qachon o'ylamaganman.

en: And as it is all yours, you have a right to deal with it as you will.
uz: Ularning barchasi sizniki bo'lgani uchun, siz xohlaganingizcha ularga ega bo'lish huquqiga egasiz.

en: I want you to give me permission to read all Miss Lucy's papers and letters.
uz: Menga Miss Lusiyning barcha qog'ozlari va xatlarini o'qish uchun ruxsat bering.

en: Be- lieve me, it is no idle curiosity.
uz: Qizim, bu behuda qiziquvchanlik emas.

en: I have a motive of which, be sure, she would have approved.
uz: Mening motivim bor, shubhasiz, u rozi bo'lardi.

en: I have them all here.
uz: Ularning barchasi bu yerda.

en: I took them before we knew that all was yours, so that no strange hand might touch them, no strange eye look through words into her soul.
uz: Men ularni barcha narsa sening ekanligingni bilmasdan oldin olib qo'ydim, shunda hech qanday begona qo'l ularni qo'ymasin, hech qanday begona ko'z so'zlar orqali uning jonini ko'rmasin.

en: I shall keep them, if I may.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, ularni saqlayman.

en: Even you may not see them yet, but I shall keep them safe.
uz: Ehtimol siz ham ularni hali ko'rmayotgandirsiz, lekin Men ularni himoya qilaman.

en: No word shall be lost, and in the good time I shall give them back to you.
uz: Hech bir so'z yo'q bo'lmaydi va ularni o'z vaqtida sizga qaytarib beraman.

en: It is a hard thing that I ask, but you will do it, will you not, for Lucy's sake? Arthur spoke out heartily, like his old self, Dr.
uz: Bu men so'ragan qiyin narsa, lekin siz buni Luzi uchun qilasiz, shunday emasmi? - dedi Artur o'zining eski o'zi kabi samimiylik bilan: Dr.

en: Van Helsing, you may do what you will.
uz: Van Helsing, xohlaganingizni qila olasiz.

en: I feel that in saying this I am doing what my dear one would have approved.
uz: Men buni aytish orqali sevgan odamim rozi bo'lgan ishni qilayotganimni his qilaman.

en: I shall not trouble you with questions till the time comes. The old Professor stood up as he said solemnly,And you are right.
uz: O'sha vaqt kelmaguncha, men sizlarni savollar bilan bezovta qilmayman. - deb so'zlashganda, keksa professor o'rnidan turdi va so'zlab berdi: Siz haqsiz.

en: There will be pain for us all, but it will not be all pain, nor will this pain be the last.
uz: Hammamiz uchun azob bo'ladi, lekin bu barcha azob emas, bu azob ham oxirgi bo'lmaydi.

en: We and you too, you most of all, dear boy, will have to pass through the bitter water before we reach the sweet.
uz: Biz ham, siz ham, eng asosiysi, aziz o'g'lim, shirin suvga yetib kelishdan oldin, qaynoq suvdan o'tishimiz kerak bo'ladi.

en: But we must be brave of heart and unselﬁsh, and do our duty, and all will be well! I slept on a sofa in Arthur's room that night.
uz: Ammo biz jasoratli va begʻaraz boʻlib, oʻz vazifamizni bajarishimiz kerak va hamma narsa yaxshi boʻladi! - dedim.

en: Van Helsing did not go to bed at all.
uz: Van Helsing umuman uxlamagan.

en: He went to and fro, as if patroling the house, and was never out of sight of the room where Lucy lay in her cofﬁn, strewn with the wild gar- lic ﬂowers, which sent through the odor of lily and rose, a heavy, overpow- ering smell into the night.
uz: U uyni kuzatib borayotgandek, bu yerga-bu yerga borardi va Lucy jasadxonasida yotgan xonani ko'zdan hech qachon chetda qoldirmagan, u yovvoyi gullar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, ular lily va roza iltijosini, qattiq, ko'p bo'lgan hidni kechaga yuborgan edi.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 22 September.—In the train to Exeter.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 22 sentabr.Ekseterga ketadigan poezdda.

en: It seems only yesterday that the last entry was made, and yet how much between then, in Whitby and all the world before me, Jonathan away and no news of him, and now, married to Jonathan, Jonathan a solicitor, a partner, rich, master of his business, Mr.
uz: To'g'ri, faqat kecha so'nggi yozuv qilingan bo'lib tuyuladi, lekin o'sha paytgacha Whitbyda va mendan oldingi butun dunyoda Jonatan ketib, uning haqida hech qanday yangilik yo'q edi va endi Jonatan bilan turmush qurgan Jonatan advokat, sherik, boy, biznes egasi, Mr.

en: Hawkins dead and buried, and Jonathan with another at- tack that may harm him.
uz: Xokins o'lib, ko'milgan, Jonatan esa unga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan yana bir hujum bilan.

en: Some day he may ask me about it.
uz: Bir kuni u mendan bu haqda so'ragan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I am rusty in my shorthand, see what unexpected prosperity does for us, so it may be as well to freshen it up again with an exercise anyhow.
uz: Men qisqartma so'zimda rangsizman, ko'rib chiqaylik, kutilmagan farovonlik bizga nima qiladi, shuning uchun uni har holda mashq bilan qayta tiklash ham yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The service was very simple and very solemn.
uz: Xizmat juda sodda va juda tantanali edi.

en: There were only ourselves and the servants there, one or two old friends of his from Exeter, his Lon- don agent, and a gentleman representing Sir John Paxton, the President of the Incorporated Law Society.
uz: U yerda faqat biz va xizmatkorlar, uning Ekzeter shahridagi bir yoki ikki eski do'sti, uning Lon-don agenti va korporativ huquq jamiyati prezidenti sir Jon Pekstonni vakillik qiladigan bir janob bor edi.

en: Jonathan and I stood hand in hand, and we felt that our best and dearest friend was gone from us.
uz: Jonatan va men qo'l-qo'l tutgan edik va eng yaxshi va eng yaqin do'stimiz yo'qolganini his qildik.

en: We came back to town quietly, taking a bus to Hyde Park Corner.
uz: Biz shaharga xotirjamlik bilan qaytib keldik va Hyde Park burchasiga boradigan avtobusga bordik.

en: Jonathan thought it would interest me to go into the Row for a while, so we sat down.
uz: Jonatan meni bir muncha vaqt Saratqaga kirishga qiziqtiradi deb o'yladi, shuning uchun o'tirib qoldik.

en: But there were very few people there, and it was sad-looking and desolate to see so many empty chairs.
uz: Ammo u yerda juda kam odamlar bor edi va shuncha bo'sh o'rinni ko'rish juda qayg'uli va vayron edi.

en: It made us think of the empty chair at home.
uz: Bu bizni uyda bo'sh o'rinni o'ylashga undagan.

en: So we got up and walked down Piccadilly.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz turdik va Piccadillyga yurdik.

en: Jonathan was holding me by the arm, the way he used to in the old days before I went to school.
uz: Jonatan meni qo'limdan ushlab turardi, xuddi men maktabga borishdan avvalgi paytlarda qilganidek.

en: I felt it very improper, for you can't go on for some years teaching etiquette and decorum to other girls without the pedantry of it biting into yourself a bit.
uz: Men buni juda noto'g'ri deb o'yladim, chunki siz bir necha yil davomida boshqa qizlarga odob va munosiblikni o'rgatishingiz mumkin emas, agar bularning pedanturligi o'zingizga ozgina o'chirib ketmasa.

en: But it was Jonathan, and he was my husband, and we didn't know anybody who saw us, and we didn't care if they did, so on we walked.
uz: Lekin bu Jonatan va u mening erim edi va bizni ko'rgan hech kimni bilmasdik va ular bizni ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, biz buni umuman tashlab ketmasdik.

en: I was looking at a very beautiful girl, in a big cart-wheel hat, sitting in a victoria outside Guiliano's, when I felt Jonathan clutch my arm so tight that he hurt me, and he said under his breath, My God! I am always anxious about Jonathan, for I fear that some nervous ﬁt may upset him again.
uz: Guilanioning uyida katta arava to'pasi bilan o'tirgan juda chiroyli qizga qaraganimda, Jonatanning qo'limni shunchalik qattiq ushlab olganini his qildimki, meni jarohatlab qo'ydi va u nafas olgach: Allohim! - deb aytdi.

en: So I turned to him quickly, and asked him what it was that disturbed him.
uz: Shuning uchun men tezda uning oldiga borib, uni nima xavotirda qoldirganini so'radim.

en: He was very pale, and his eyes seemed bulging out as, half in terror and half in amazement, he gazed at a tall, thin man, with a beaky nose and black moustache and pointed beard, who was also observing the pretty girl.
uz: Uning ko'zlari juda oq edi va uning ko'zlari yarim qo'rquv va yarim hayratda bo'lib, o'zi ham go'zal qizni kuzatib turgan baland, chiroyli bir odamga qaraganida, ko'zlari ko'p bo'lak edi.

en: He was looking at her so hard that he did not see either of us, and so I had a good view of him.
uz: U qizga shunchalik qaraganki, ikkovimizni ham ko'rmadi, shuning uchun men unga yaxshi qarashga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: His face was not a good face.
uz: Uning yuzi yaxshi surat emas edi.

en: It was hard, and cruel, and sensual,and big white teeth, that looked all the whiter because his lips were so red, were pointed like an animal's.
uz: U qattiq va shafqatsiz, jinsiy va katta oq tishlar edi, chunki uning og'izlari juda qizil edi va hayvonning og'izlariga o'xshardi.

en: Jonathan kept staring at him, till I was afraid he would notice.
uz: Jonatan unga qarab turardi va men uning e'tiborini olishiga qo'rqardim.

en: I feared he might take it ill, he looked so ﬁerce and nasty.
uz: U kasal bo'lishi mumkin, deb qo'rqardim, u juda qattiq va yomon ko'rinardi.

en: I asked Jonathan why he was disturbed, and he answered, evidently thinking that I knew as much about it as he did, Do you see who it is? No, dear, I said.
uz: Jonatandan nima uchun xavotirlanganini so'radim va u, men ham uning o'zi kabi bu haqda ko'p narsani bilardim deb o'ylagan holda, javob berdi: Bilasizmi, kim? - dedim.

en: I don't know him, who is it? His answer seemed to shock and thrill me, for it was said as if he did not know that it was me, Mina, to whom he was speaking.
uz: Men uni tanimayman, u kim? - deb javobini eshitganimda, u meni hayratda qoldirgan va hayajonlantirgan bo'ldi, chunki u aytgan so'zlar xuddi uning men, Mina, bilan gapirayotganini bilmaganidek so'zlandi.

en: It is the man himself! The poor dear was evidently terriﬁed at something, very greatly terriﬁed.
uz: Bu odamning o'zi! - dedi kambag'al aziz kishi, ko'rinib turibdiki, biror narsadan qo'rqib, juda qo'rqib ketgan edi.

en: I do believe that if he had not had me to lean on and to support him he would have sunk down.
uz: Agar u menga tayanish va uni qo'llab-quvvatlashni xohlamaganida, u yerga tushib ketar edi, deb o'ylayman.

en: A man came out of the shop with a small parcel, and gave it to the lady, who then drove off.
uz: Do'kondan bir kishi kichkina paket bilan chiqib, uni ayolga berdi, ayol esa mashinadan chiqib ketdi.

en: Th e dark man kept his eyes ﬁxed on her, and when the carriage moved up Piccadilly he followed in the same direction, and hailed a hansom.
uz: Ko'ngilsiz odam uning ko'zlarini ko'tarib turardi va arava Piccadillyga ko'tarilganda, u xuddi shu yo'nalishda davom etdi va hansomni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: Jonathan kept looking after him, and said, as if to himself,
uz: Yoʻnatan unga qarab turardi va oʻz-oʻzidan shunday dedi:

en: I believe it is the Count, but he has grown young.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, bu Count, lekin u yoshga to'lgan.

en: My God, if this be so!
uz: Hy Xudoyim, agar shunday bo'lsa!

en: If only I knew! He was distressing himself so much that I feared to keep his mind on the subject by asking him any questions, so I remained silent.
uz: O'zini shunchalik bezovta qilar ediki, men unga biron bir savol berish orqali uning fikrini o'z zimmasida saqlashdan qo'rqardim, shuning uchun men sukut saqladim.

en: I drew away quietly, and he, holding my arm, came easily.
uz: Men xotirjamlik bilan ketdim va u qo'limni ushlab, osonlikcha keldi.

en: We walked a little further, and then went in and sat for a while in the Green Park.
uz: Biz biroz ko'proq yurdik, so'ngra kirdik va yashil parkda bir muncha vaqt o'tirdik.

en: It was a hot day for autumn, and there was a com- fortable seat in a shady place.
uz: Qish uchun issiq kun edi va soya joyida qulay o'rindiq bor edi.

en: After a few minutes' staring at nothing, Jonathan's eyes closed, and he went quickly into a sleep, with his head on my shoulder.
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng, Jonataning ko'zlari yopildi va u boshini omonimda ko'tarib, tezda uxladi.

en: I thought it was the best thing for him, so did not disturb him.
uz: Men bu uning uchun eng yaxshi narsa deb o'yladim, shuning uchun uni bezovta qilmadim.

en: In about twenty minutes he woke up, and said to me quite cheerfully, Why, Mina, have I been asleep!
uz: Taxminan yigirma daqiqadan so'ng u uyg'onib, juda xursand bo'lib: Mina, men uxlab qoldimmi?

en: Oh, do forgive me for being so rude.
uz: Oh, men shunchalik qo'pol bo'lganim uchun meni kechiringlar.

en: Come, and we'll have a cup of tea somewhere. He had evidently forgotten all about the dark stranger, as in his illness he had forgotten all that this episode had reminded him of.
uz: Keling, bir joyda choy ichamiz. U, ko'rinmas begona odam haqida hamma narsani unutgan edi, chunki kasalligida u ushbu hodisa unga eslatgan barcha narsalarni unutgan edi.

en: I don't like this lapsing into forgetfulness.
uz: Men bu holatni unutib yuborishni yoqtirmayman.

en: It may make or continue some injury to the brain.
uz: Bu miyaga zarar yetkazishi yoki davom ettirishlari mumkin.

en: I must not ask him, for fear I shall do more harm than good, but I must somehow learn the facts of his journey abroad.
uz: Undan so'rashim shart emas, chunki men yaxshilikdan ko'ra ko'proq zarar ko'rsataman deb qo'rqaman, lekin uning chet elga sayohatining faktlarini qandaydir tarzda o'rganishim kerak.

en: The time is come, I fear, when I must open the parcel, and know what is written.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, parolni ochib, nima yozilganini bilishim kerak bo'lgan vaqt keladi.

en: Oh, Jonathan, you will, I know, forgive me if I do wrong, but it is for your own dear sake.
uz: Jonatan, agar men xato qilsam, meni kechiring, lekin bu o'zingizning yaxshiligingiz uchun.

en: Later.—A sad home-coming in every way, the house empty of the dear soul who was so good to us.
uz: Keyinchalik.Har jihatdan qaytib kelganim qayg'uli edi, uyda bizga shunchalik mehribon bo'lgan sevikli ruh bo'lgan.

en: Jonathan still pale and dizzy under a slight re- lapse of his malady, and now a telegram from Van Helsing, whoever he may be.
uz: Jonatan hali ham kasalligining salqin o'zgarishi dastidan ko'ngli oqib, burchli bo'lib qoldi va endi u kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, Van Helsingning telegramasi keldi.

en: You will be grieved to hear that Mrs.
uz: Sen bu xonimning gapini eshitib, xafa bo'lasan.

en: Westenra died ﬁve days ago, and that Lucy died the day before yesterday.
uz: Vestenra besh kun oldin va Lusiy bir kun oldin vafot etdi.

en: They were both buried today. Oh, what a wealth of sorrow in a few words!
uz: Ularning ikkalasi ham bugun ko'milgan. Oh, bir necha so'z bilan qanday qayg'u boyligi!

en: Gone, gone, never to return to us!
uz: Yo'qolgan, yo'qolgan, hech qachon bizga qaytib kelmaydigan!

en: And poor, poor Arthur, to have lost such a sweetness out of his life!
uz: Va kambag'al, kambag'al Artur o'z hayotidan bunday shirinlikni yo'qotgani uchun!

en: God help us all to bear our troubles.
uz: Xudo hammamizga muammolarimizni yengishga yordam bersin.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY-CONT.
uz: SEWARDning kundalik hikoyasi.

en: 22 September.—It is all over.
uz: 22 sentabr.Bu hammasi tugagan.

en: Arthur has gone back to Ring, and has tak- en Quincey Morris with him.
uz: Artur Ringga qaytib keldi va Quincey Morrisni o'zi bilan birga oldi.

en: What a ﬁne fellow is Quincey!
uz: Quincey naqadar yaxshi odam!

en: I believe in my heart of hearts that he suffered as much about Lucy's death as any of us, but he bore himself through it like a moral Viking.
uz: O'zimning qalbimda ishonamanki, u Luisi o'limi tufayli biz kabi azob chekdi, ammo u axloqiy viking kabi o'zini o'zi azobdan o'tkazdi.

en: If America can go on breed- ing men like that, she will be a power in the world indeed.
uz: Agar Amerika bunday odamlarni tarbiyalashni davom ettira olsa, u dunyodagi qudratli davlat bo'ladi.

en: Van Helsing is lying down, having a rest preparatory to his journey.
uz: Van Helsing yo'lga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun o'tirib, dam oladi.

en: He goes to Amsterdam tonight, but says he returns tomorrow night, that he only wants to make some arrangements which can only be made personally.
uz: U bugun Amsterdamga ketadi, lekin ertaga kecha qaytib kelishini aytadi va faqat shaxsan tayyorgarlik ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi tadbirlarni o'tkazishni xohlaydi.

en: He is to stop with me then, if he can.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, u men bilan to'xtashi kerak.

en: He says he has work to do in London which may take
uz: U Londonda bajarishi kerak bo'lgan ish borligini aytadi, bu esa uni talab qilishi mumkin.

en: I fear that the strain of the past week has broken down even his iron strength.
uz: O'tgan haftaning og'irligi uning temir kuchini ham buzganidan qo'rqaman.

en: All the time of the burial he was, I could see, putting some terrible restraint on himself.
uz: Men ko'rganimcha, u o'zidan-o'zi o'zgacha cheklovlar o'rnatgan.

en: When it was all over, we were standing beside Arthur, who, poor fellow, was speaking of his part in the operation where his blood had been transfused to his Lucy's veins.
uz: Hamma narsa tugagach, biz Arturning yonida turardik, u esa kambag'al odam bo'lib, uning qonini Luiza damarlariga qo'yilgan operatsiyada o'z hissasini aytib o'tgan edi.

en: I could see Van Helsing's face grow white and purple by turns.
uz: Men Van Helsingning yuzini o'z navbatida oq va bo'yoq bo'lib ko'rishim mumkin edi.

en: Arthur was saying that he felt since then as if they two had been really married, and that she was his wife in the sight of God.
uz: Artur o'sha paytdan beri o'zini xuddi ular chindan ham turmush qurgan bo'lishgani kabi his qilganini va u Xudoning nazarida uning xotini ekanligini aytmoqchi edi.

en: None of us said a word of the other op- erations, and none of us ever shall.
uz: Bizlardan hech kim boshqa operatsiyalar haqida so'z aytmadi va hech birimiz aytmaymiz.

en: Arthur and Quincey went away together to the station, and Van Helsing and I came on here.
uz: Artur va Quincey birga stansiyaga borishdi va Van Helsing va men bu yerga keldik.

en: The moment we were alone in the carriage he gave way to a regular ﬁt of hysterics.
uz: Biz vagonda yolg'iz qolganimizdan so'ng, u histeriklarning odatdagi hujumlariga o'rnak ko'rsatdi.

en: He has denied to me since that it was hysterics, and insisted that it was only his sense of humor asserting itself under very terrible conditions.
uz: U o'sha paytdan beri bu histeriya ekanligini meni rad etib, faqatgina o'zining humor hissi o'zini juda dahshatli sharoitlarda tasdiqlayotganini ta'kidladi.

en: He laughed till he cried, and I had to draw down the blinds lest any one should see us and mis- judge.
uz: U o'zicha kulishdi va yig'lab yubordi, hech kim bizni ko'rmasligi va noto'g'ri hukm qilmasligi uchun men pardalarni olib tashlashim kerak edi.

en: And then he cried, till he laughed again, and laughed and cried to- gether, just as a woman does.
uz: So'ngra u yana kulgʻayib, kulgʻayib yigʻlab yubordi, xuddi ayolning o'zi kabi.

en: I tried to be stern with him, as one is to a woman under the circumstances, but it had no effect.
uz: Men u bilan qattiqqo'l bo'lishga harakat qildim, chunki bu vaziyatda ayollarga nisbatan qattiqqo'l bo'lish kerak, ammo bu hech qanday natija bermadi.

en: Men and women are so different in manifestations of nervous strength or weakness!
uz: Erkaklar va ayollar asabiy kuch yoki zaiflik ko'rinishlarida juda farq qiladilar!

en: Then when his face grew grave and stern again I asked him why his mirth, and why at such a time.
uz: Keyin uning yuzi yana og'ir va qattiq bo'lganida, men undan nima uchun bunday quvonch va nima uchun bunday paytda quvonishini so'radim.

en: His reply was in a way characteristic of him, for it was logical and forceful and mysterious.
uz: Uning javobi uning o'ziga xos edi, chunki u mantiqiy, kuchli va sirli edi.

en: He said, Ah, you don't comprehend, friend John.
uz: U: A, sen buni tushunmaysan, do'stim Jon.

en: Do not think that I am not sad, though I laugh.
uz: Garchi men kulsam ham, meni xafa emas deb o'ylamang.

en: See, I have cried even when the laugh did choke me.
uz: Qani, men hatto kulgi meni cho'ktirganida ham yig'ladim.

en: But no more think that I am all sorry when I cry, for the laugh he come just the same.
uz: Ammo yig'laganimda o'zimni afsus deb o'ylamang, chunki u o'sha paytda o'sha kulgiga o'xshaydi.

en: Keep it always with you that laughter who knock at your door and say, `May I come in?' is not true laughter.
uz: O'zingiz bilan birga bo'lib turing, eshikni taqillatib: Men kirsam bo'ladimi? - deb so'raganlarning kulgi haqiqiy kulgi emas.

en: He is a king, and he come when and how he like.
uz: U podshoh va qachon va qanday xohlasa keladi.

en: He ask no person, he choose no time of suitability.
uz: U hech kimdan so'ramaydi, hech qanday qulay vaqtni tanlamaydi.

en: He say, `I am here.' Behold, in example I grieve my heart out for that so sweet young girl.
uz: U: Men bu yerdaman, - deydi.Mening o'zimni o'sha go'zal qiz uchun xafa qilaman.

en: I give my blood for her, though I am old and worn.
uz: Garchi qariya va charchagan bo'lsam-da, uning uchun qonimni beraman.

en: I give my time, my skill, my sleep.
uz: Men o'z vaqtimni, mahoratimni, uyquimni beraman.

en: I let my other sufferers want that she may have all.
uz: Men boshqa bemorlarimning hammasi unga kerak bo'lishini istashlariga yo'l qo'ydim.

en: And yet I can laugh at her very grave, laugh when the clay from the spade of the sexton drop upon her cofﬁn and say `Thud, thud!' to my heart, till it send back the blood from my cheek.
uz: Shunga qaramay, men uning o'z qabrini ko'rib, kulol ko'krak ustiga sextonning cho'g'idan tushgan loy tushganda, ko'nglimga: Thud, thud! deb kulolaman, hatto bu menga shahardan qonni qaytaradi.

en: My heart bleed for that poor boy, that dear boy, so of the age of mine own boy had I been so blessed that he live, and with his hair and eyes the same.
uz: Oʻsha kambagʻal oʻgʻil, oʻsha aziz oʻgʻil uchun yuragim qon ketadi, shuning uchun oʻz oʻgʻlimning yoshida men uning tirik qolishiga va sochlari va koʻzlari bilan xuddi shunday barakalarga ega boʻlgan edim.

en: There, you know now why I love him so.
uz: O'sha yerda, men uni nima uchun shuncha sevganimni endi bilasiz.

en: And yet when he say things that touch my husband-heart to the quick, and make my father-heart yearn
uz: Ammo u erimning qalbiga tegadigan va otamning qalbini iltijo qilishga undaydigan so'zlarni aytganda.

en: to him as to no other man, not even you, friend John, for we are more level in experiences than father and son, yet even at such a moment King Laugh he come to me and shout and bellow in my ear,`Here I am!
uz: Unga boshqa hech bir inson, hatto sen ham, do'stim Jon, deb aytaman, chunki biz tajribalarda ota va o'g'limdan ko'ra ko'proq tengmiz, ammo hatto shunday paytlarda ham, Shoh Qichqiriq menga yaqinlashib, qichqiriq va quloqlarimga: Men shu yerdaman! - deb qichqirishadi.

en: Here I am!' till the blood come dance back and bring some of the sunshine that he carry with him to my cheek.
uz: Mana men borman! - deb, qon qaytib kelib raqsga tushadi va u o'zi bilan birga olib borayotgan quyosh nuridan ba'zilarini yig'imga olib keladi.

en: Oh, friend John, it is a strange world, a sad world, a world full of miseries, and woes, and troubles.
uz: Oh, do'stim Jon, bu g'alati dunyo, qayg'uli dunyo, azob-uqubat, qayg'u-alamlar bilan to'lgan dunyo.

en: And yet when King Laugh come, he make them all dance to the tune he play.
uz: Ammo Qahramon Qichqiriq kelganida, u hammalarini o'zi o'ynashga sazovor tarzda raqsga tushirdi.

en: Bleeding hearts, and dry bones of the churchyard, and tears that burn as they fall, all dance together to the music that he make with that smileless mouth of him.
uz: Qon to'kkan yuraklar, cho'ponning quruq suyaklari va tushib turgan ko'z yoshlari, barchasi o'zining tabassumsiz og'zi bilan yaratadigan musiqaga qo'shilib raqsga tushadi.

en: And believe me, friend John, that he is good to come, and kind.
uz: Menga ishoning, do'stim Jon, u juda mehribon va mehribon.

en: Ah, we men and women are like ropes drawn tight with strain that pull us different ways.
uz: Ah, biz erkaklar va ayollar bizni turli yo'llar bilan tortib oladigan og'irlik bilan qat'iy tortilgan iplarga o'xshamiz.

en: Then tears come, and like the rain on the ropes, they brace us up, until perhaps the strain become too great, and we break.
uz: So'ngra ko'z yoshlari keladi va shamollar ustida yog'adigan yomg'ir kabi bizni qo'llab-quvvatlaydilar, ehtimol, kuch juda ko'p bo'lib ketadi va biz buzib ketamiz.

en: But King Laugh he come like the sunshine, and he ease off the strain again, and we bear to go on with our la- bor, what it may be. I did not like to wound him by pretending not to see his idea, but as I did not yet understand the cause of his laughter, I asked him.
uz: Lekin Qirol Qichqiriq quyosh kabi keladi, yana og'irlikni yengillashtiradi va biz ishimizni davom ettiramiz, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar. Men uning g'oyasini ko'rmaganimdek ko'rsatib, uni ranjitishni istamaganman, lekin uning qichqirishining sababini hali tushunmaganim sababli, undan so'radim.

en: As he answered me his face grew stern, and he said in quite a different tone, Oh, it was the grim irony of it all,this so lovely lady garlanded with ﬂowers, that looked so fair as life, till one by one we wondered if she were truly dead, she laid in that so ﬁne marble house in that lonely churchyard, where rest so many of her kin, laid there with the mother who loved her, and whom she loved, and that sacred bell going Toll!
uz: U menga javob berganda yuzlari qattiqroq bo'lib ketdi va u butunlay boshqacha tomonda shunday dedi: Oh, bularning hammasi o'ta g'alati ironiyasi edi, bu go'zal gullar bilan qoplangan, hayot kabi go'zal ko'rinadigan, bir-birimizdan o'lgan-olmaganini so'raganimizcha, u o'sha yolg'iz cho'lda o'sha marmor uyda, o'sha yolg'iz cho'lda, uning ko'p qarindoshlari o'tirgan joyda, uni sevgan va sevgan onasi bilan o'tirgan va muqaddas qo'ng'iroq Toll!

en: Toll!' so sad and slow, and those holy men, with the white garments of the angel, pre- tending to read books, and yet all the time their eyes never on the page, and all of us with the bowed head.
uz: Toʻgʻri! - deb gʻamgin va sekin, farishtalarning oq kiyimlarini kiygan va kitoblarni oʻqishga moyil boʻlgan bu aziz kishilar, lekin ularning koʻzlari hech qachon sahifaga qaramasdi va barchamiz boshimizni egib turardik.

en: Is it not? Well, for the life of me, Professor, I said, I can't see anything to laugh at in all that.
uz: - O'z hayotim uchun, professor, - dedim men, - bularning barchasida kulishga hech narsa ko'rmayapman.

en: Why, your expression makes it a harder puzzle than before.
uz: Nega deganda, sizning ifodangiz uni avvalgidan ko'ra qiyinroq bo'lgan bulutga aylantiradi.

en: But even if the burial service was comic, what about poor Art and his trou- ble?
uz: Ammo hatto dafn marosimi komik bo'lsa ham, kambag'al Art va uning muammolari haqida nima deyish mumkin?

en: Why his heart was simply breaking. Just so.
uz: Nima uchun uning yuragi buzib ketayotgan edi?

en: Said he not that the transfusion of his blood to her veins had made her truly his bride? Yes, and it was a sweet and comforting idea for him. Quite so.
uz: Uning qonini uning damarlariga quyib, uni haqiqiy kuyovga aylantirganini aytmaganmi? - Ha, bu uning uchun yoqimli va tasalli beruvchi fikr edi.

en: But there was a difﬁculty, friend John.
uz: Ammo bir qiyinchilik bor edi, do'stim Jon.

en: If so that, then what about the others?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, qolganlari haqida nima deyish mumkin?

en: Then this so sweet maid is a polyandrist, and me,with my poor wife dead to me, but alive by Church's law, though no
uz: Shunday qilib, bu go'zal xizmatkor poliandrist, va men, kambag'al xotinim bilan birga, menga o'lim bo'ldi, lekin cherkov qonunlariga ko'ra tirik, lekin yo'q

en: wits, all gone, even I, who am faithful husband to this now-no-wife, am bigamist. I don't see where the joke comes in there either! I said, and I did not feel particularly pleased with him for saying such things.
uz: Bularning hammasi o'tib ketdi, hatto men ham, bu endi xotinim bo'lmagan kishiga sodiq er bo'lganim, bigamistman. - Men ham o'sha yerda o'yin-kulgining qayerdan kelib chiqishini tushunmayman! - dedim men va u bunday so'zlarni aytgani uchun o'zimni juda mamnun his qilmadim.

en: He laid his hand on my arm, and said, Friend John, forgive me if I pain.
uz: U qo'lini qo'limga qo'ydi va: Do'stim Jon, agar og'riq ko'rsatsam, meni kechiring.

en: I showed not my feeling to others when it would wound, but only to you, my old friend, whom I can trust.
uz: Men o'zimning his-tuyg'ularimni boshqalarga ko'rsatmaganman, lekin faqat senga, eski do'stimga, ishonishim mumkin bo'lganlarga ko'rsatdim.

en: If you could have looked into my heart then when I want to laugh, if you could have done so when the laugh arrived, if you could do so now, when King Laugh have pack up his crown, and all that is to him, for he go far, far away from me, and for a long, long time, maybe you would perhaps pity me the most of all. I was touched by the tenderness of his tone, and asked why.
uz: O'shanda men kulishimni istasangiz, o'shanda ko'nglimga qarab ko'rardingiz, kulishim kelganida, hozir, Qahramon Qahramon tojini to'plab olganida, bu uning uchun, chunki u mendan uzoq, uzoq uzoqroq ketadi va uzoq, uzoq vaqt davomida, ehtimol, siz menga eng ko'p marhamat qilishingiz mumkin edi.

en: Because I know! And now we are all scattered, and for many a long day loneliness will sit over our roofs with brooding wings.
uz: Men bilganim uchun! Endi hammamiz tarqalib ketdik va ko'p yillar davomida yolg'izlik ko'p qanotli xonadonlarimiz ustida o'tiradi.

en: Lucy lies in the tomb of her kin, a lord- ly death house in a lonely churchyard, away from teeming London, where the air is fresh, and the sun rises over Hampstead Hill, and where wild ﬂow- ers grow of their own accord.
uz: Lucy qarindoshlari qabrida, yolg'iz cherkov hovlisida o'lim uyida, to'lib-toshgan Londondan uzoqda joylashgan, u yerda havo toza, quyosh Hampstead tepalig'i ustida ko'tarilgan va yovvoyi oqimlar o'z-o'zidan o'sib boradigan joy.

en: So I can ﬁnish this diary, and God only knows if I shall ever begin anoth- er.
uz: Shunday qilib, men ushbu kundalik kitobni tugatishim mumkin va faqat Xudo biladi, agar men hech qachon yozishni boshlashim mumkinmi.

en: If I do, or if I even open this again, it will be to deal with different peo- ple and different themes, for here at the end, where the romance of my life is told, ere I go back to take up the thread of my life-work, I say sadly and without hope, FINIS.
uz: Agar shunday qilsam yoki uni yana ochsam, u turli musiqa va mavzular bilan bog'liq bo'ladi, chunki oxirida, hayotimning romantikasi hikoya qilingan joyda, hayotimning ishini davom ettirish uchun qaytib borishdan oldin, men qayg'u va umidsiz FINIS deb aytaman.

en: THE WESTMINSTER GAZETTE, 25 SEPTEMBER A HAMPSTEAD MYSTERY The neighborhood of Hampstead is just at present exercised with a series of events which seem to run on lines parallel to those of what was known to the writers of headlines and The Kensington Horror, or The Stabbing Woman, or The Woman in Black. During the past two or three days sev- eral cases have occurred of young children straying from home or neglect- ing to return from their playing on the Heath.
uz: WESTMINSTER GAZETTE, 25 SEPTEMBER A HAMPSTEAD MYSTERY Hampstead qishlog'i hozirda bir qator voqealar bilan mashg'ul bo'lib kelmoqda, bu voqealar Kensington Horror va The Kensington Horror, The Stabbing Woman yoki The Woman in Black gazetasining bosh sahifalari tomonidan ma'lum bo'lgan voqealarga o'xshaydi.

en: In all these cases the children were too young to give any properly intelligible account of themselves, but the consensus of their excuses is that they had been with a bloofer lady. It has always been late in the evening when they have been missed, and on two occasions the children have not been found until early in the following morning.
uz: Ushbu holatlarning barchasida bolalar o'zlarini tushunarli tarzda tushuntirish uchun juda kichik edilar, ammo ularning uzrlari bir xil bo'lib, ular bloofer xonim bilan birga bo'lgan edilar.

en: It is generally supposed in the neighborhood that, as the ﬁrst child
uz: Umuman olganda, mahallada birinchi bola sifatida

en: missed gave as his reason for being away that a bloofer lady had asked him to come for a walk, the others had picked up the phrase and used it as occasion served.
uz: U yo'q qolishining sababini bloofer xonim uni o'tishga taklif qilganini eslatdi, qolganlar esa bu iborani o'zlariga olishdi va uni imkoniyat sifatida qo'llashdi.

en: This is the more natural as the favorite game of the little ones at present is luring each other away by wiles.
uz: Bu shunchalik tabiiyki, chunki hozirgi kunda kichiklarning sevimli o'yinlari bir-birlarini hiylalar bilan yo'ldan ozdirmoqda.

en: A correspondent writes us that to see some of the tiny tots pretending to be the bloofer lady is supremely funny.
uz: Xabarchi bizga yozadiki, bloofer xonim bo'lib o'zlarini ko'rsatadigan kichkina bolalarni ko'rish juda qiziqarli.

en: Some of our caricaturists might, he says, take a lesson in the irony of grotesque by comparing the reality and the picture.
uz: Uning aytishicha, ba'zi karikaturistlarimiz haqiqat va rasmni solishtirib, grotesklikning ironikasidan saboq olishlari mumkin.

en: It is only in accordance with general principles of human nature that the bloofer lady should be the popular role at these al fresco performances.
uz: Faqatgina insoniy tabiatning umumiy tamoyillariga muvofiq, ushbu al-fresco namoyishlarida bloofer xonim mashhur rol bo'lishi kerak.

en: Our correspon- dent naively says that even Ellen Terry could not be so winningly attractive as some of these grubby-faced little children pretend, and even imagine themselves, to be.
uz: Muallifimiz naiflik bilan aytadiki, hatto Ellen Terri ham ba'zi bu yumshoq ko'rinishli bolalar o'zlarini shunday ko'rinishsiz ko'rinishi mumkin emas.

en: There is, however, possibly a serious side to the question, for some of the children, indeed all who have been missed at night, have been slightly torn or wounded in the throat.
uz: Biroq, bu savolning jiddiy tomoni bo'lishi mumkin, chunki ba'zi bolalar, haqiqatan ham, kechasi yo'qolganlarning hammasi, go'rozda biroz yirtilgan yoki jarohatlangan.

en: The wounds seem such as might be made by a rat or a small dog, and although of not much importance individually, would tend to show that whatever animal inﬂicts them has a system or method of its own.
uz: Yuraklar tovuq yoki kichik it tomonidan sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidek tuyuladi va alohida ahamiyatga ega bo'lmasa-da, ular qandaydir hayvonning o'ziga xos tizimi yoki usuli borligini ko'rsatadi.

en: The police of the division have been instructed to keep a sharp lookout for straying children, especially when very young, in and around Hampstead Heath, and for any stray dog which may be about.
uz: Bo'limdagi politsiya xodimlariga yo'qolgan bolalar, ayniqsa, juda kichik bo'lganlarida, Hampstead Heath va uning atrofida va atrofida bo'lgan har qanday yo'qolgan itni diqqat bilan kuzatib turishga buyurilgan.

en: THE WESTMINSTER GAZETTE, 25 SEPTEMBER EXTRA SPECIAL THE HAMPSTEAD HORROR ANOTHER CHILD INJURED THE BLOOFER LADY We have just received intelligence that another child, missed last night, was only discovered late in the morning under a furze bush at the Shooter's Hill side of Hampstead Heath, which is perhaps, less frequented than the other parts.
uz: WESTMINSTER GAZETTE, 25 SEPTEMBER EXTRA SPECIAL THE HAMPSTEAD HORROR ANOTHER CHILD INJURED THE BLOOFER LADY O'tgan kechasi yo'qolgan yana bir bola kechqurun Hampstead Heathning Shooter's Hill tomonida bir furze buta ostida topilganligi haqida ma'lumot oldik.

en: It has the same tiny wound in the throat as has been noticed in other cases.
uz: Uning bo'yniga boshqa holatlarda ko'rsatilgan o'sha kichkina yara tushadi.

en: It was terribly weak, and looked quite emaciated.
uz: U juda zaif edi va juda charchagan ko'rinardi.

en: It too, when partially restored, had the common story to tell of being lured away by the bloofer lady.
uz: U ham qisman tiklanganida, bloofer xonim tomonidan aldanib ketish haqidagi umumiy hikoyani aytib o'tdi.

en: CHAPTER 14 MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 23 September.—Jonathan is better after a bad night.
uz: 14 - bob MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 23 - sentabr.Jonatan yomon kechadan keyin yaxshiroqdir.

en: I am so glad that he has plenty of work to do, for that keeps his mind off the terrible things, and oh, I am rejoiced that he is not now weighed down with the responsibility of his new position.
uz: Uning ko'p ishlashi uchun juda xursandman, chunki bu uning ongini dahshatli ishlardan uzoqlashtiradi va oh, xursandmanki, u endi yangi lavozimining mas'uliyati bilan og'irlanmaydi.

en: I knew he would be true to himself, and now how proud I am to see my Jonathan rising to the height of his advancement and keeping pace in all ways with the duties that come upon him.
uz: U o'ziga sodiq bo'lishini bilardim va endi Jonatanim o'zining yutuqlarining yuksak darajasiga yetib borayotganini va o'z zimmasiga yuklangan vazifalar bilan har tomonlama hammuomala bo'lganini ko'rishdan qanchalik faxrlanaman.

en: He will be away all day till late, for he said he could not lunch at home.
uz: U kun bo'yi kechgacha ketmaydi, chunki u uyda tushlik qila olmaydi, deb aytdi.

en: My household work is done, so I shall take his foreign journal, and lock myself up in my room and read it.
uz: Uy ishim tugagach, uning chet ellik jurnalini olib, o'z xonamga o'tirib o'qib beraman.

en: 24 September.—I hadn't the heart to write last night, that terrible record of Jonathan's upset me so.
uz: 24 sentabr.Kecha kechasi yozishga yuragim yetmadi, Jonatanning dahshatli yozuvi meni juda xafa qildi.

en: How he must have suffered, whether it be true or only imagination.
uz: U qanday azob chekgan bo'lishi kerak, bu haqiqatmi yoki shunchaki tasavvurmi?

en: I wonder if there is any truth in it at all.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bunda haqiqat bormi?

en: Did he get his brain fever, and then write all those terrible things, or had he some cause for it all?
uz: U miya issiqligiga tushib, keyin hammasi yomon bo'lgan narsalarni yozganmi yoki buning sabablari bormi?

en: I suppose I shall never know, for I dare not open the subject to him.
uz: O'ylaymanki, hech qachon bilmayman, chunki men bu mavzuni unga ochishga jur'at qilmayman.

en: And yet that man we saw yesterday!
uz: Ammo kecha ko'rgan odam!

en: He seemed quite cer- tain of him, poor fellow!
uz: U o'zidan juda o'ta ishonchli ko'rinardi, kambag'al!

en: I suppose it was the funeral upset him and sent his mind back on some train of thought.
uz: O'ylaymanki, uni ko'ngildan kechirgan marosim uni fikrlash tarziga qaytardi.

en: He believes it all himself.
uz: U o'zi ham bunga ishonadi.

en: I remember how on our wedding day he said Unless some solemn duty come upon me to go back to the bitter hours, asleep or awake, mad or sane …  There seems to be through it all some thread of continuity.
uz: To'y kunimizda u shunday deganini eslayman: Menga qayg'u soatlarga, uyqu yoki uyg'onish, aqldan ozish yoki aqlli bo'lish vazifasi yuklanmasa, o'zimga qaytib boraman... Bularning barchasida biroz uzluk borligi ayon bo'lib turibdi.

en: That fearful Count was coming to London.
uz: O'sha qo'rqinchli Count Londonga kelayotgan edi.

en: If it should be, and he came to London, with its teeming millions … There may be a solemn duty, and if it come we must not shrink from it.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa va u millionlab odamlari bilan Londonga kelgan bo'lsa, unda jiddiy burch bo'lishi mumkin va agar shunday bo'lsa, biz undan yuz o'girib ketmasligimiz kerak.

en: I shall be prepared.
uz: Men tayyor bo'laman.

en: I shall get my typewriter this very hour and begin transcribing.
uz: Men o'sha soatlarda matbaa mashinamni olib, yozib olishni boshlayman.

en: Then we shall be ready for other eyes if required.
uz: Keyin, agar kerak bo'lsa, boshqa ko'zlar uchun tayyor bo'lamiz.

en: And if it be wanted, then, perhaps, if I am ready, poor Jonathan may not be upset, for I can speak for him and nev- er let him be troubled or worried with it at all.
uz: Va agar xohlasa, ehtimol, agar men tayyor bo'lsam, kambag'al Jonatan xafa bo'lmasligi mumkin, chunki men uning nomidan gapira olaman va uning xavotirlanishiga yoki xavotirlanishiga yo'l qo'ymayman.

en: If ever Jonathan quite gets
uz: Agar Jonatan juda yaxshi bo'lsa

en: over the nervousness he may want to tell me of it all, and I can ask him questions and ﬁnd out things, and see how I may comfort him.
uz: U menga bularning barchasini aytmoqchi bo'lgan xavotirdan tashqari, men unga savollar berib, o'zimni o'ylab ko'rishim va unga qanday tasalli berishim mumkinligini ko'rishim mumkin.

en: LETTER, VAN HELSING TO MRS.
uz: XATIR, VAN HELSING Xonimga.

en: HARKER 24 September (Conﬁdence) Dear Madam, I pray you to pardon my writing, in that I am so far friend as that I sent to you sad news of Miss Lucy Westenra's death.
uz: HARKER 24 sentabr (Istiyof) Sevgili xonim, yozishim uchun kechirim so'rayman, chunki men sizga Miss Lucy Westenra o'limining ayanchli xabarini yuborganimdek do'stman.

en: By the kindness of Lord Godalming, I am empowered to read her letters and papers, for I am deeply concerned about certain matters vitally important.
uz: Lord Godalmingning rahm-shafqati tufayli men uning maktublari va maqolalarini o'qishga qodirman, chunki men hayotiy jihatdan muhim bo'lgan ba'zi masalalarni chuqur qiziqtiraman.

en: In them I ﬁnd some let- ters from you, which show how great friends you were and how you love her.
uz: Ularda sizdan qanchalar yaxshi do'st bo'lganingizni va uni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rganingizni ko'rsatadigan maktublar topdim.

en: Oh, Madam Mina, by that love, I implore you, help me.
uz: Oh, Xonim Mina, bu sevgi bilan sizga yordam berishni iltimos qilaman.

en: It is for others' good that I ask, to redress great wrong, and to lift much and terrible trou- bles, that may be more great than you can know.
uz: Men boshqalarning manfaatini ko'zlab, katta xatolarni tuzatish va siz tasavvur qila olmagan darajada katta bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ko'p va dahshatli muammolarni bartaraf etishni so'rayman.

en: May it be that I see you?
uz: Sizni ko'rishim mumkinmi?

en: John Seward and of Lord Godalming (that was Arthur of Miss Lucy).
uz: John Seward va Lord Godalmingning (bu esa Miss Lucyning Artur edi).

en: I must keep it private for the present from all.
uz: Hozircha buni hammalardan maxfiy saqlashim kerak.

en: I should come to Exeter to see you at once if you tell me I am privilege to come, and where and when.
uz: Agar siz menga tashrif buyurish sharafiga egaligimni, qayerda va qachon kelishimni aytsangiz, men sizni tezda ko'rish uchun Ekseterga kelishim kerak.

en: I implore your pardon, Madam.
uz: Sizdan kechirim so'rayman, xonim.

en: I have read your letters to poor Lucy, and know how good you are and how your hus- band suffer.
uz: Kambag'al Lusiga yozgan maktublaringizni o'qib, sizning qanchalik yaxshiligingizni va er-xotiningiz azob chekayotganini bilaman.

en: So I pray you, if it may be, enlighten him not, least it may harm.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar shunday bo'lsa, unda uni o'rgatmang, chunki bu unga zarar keltirishi mumkin.

en: Again your pardon, and forgive me.
uz: Yana bir bor kechirim so'rab, meni kechiring.

en: VAN HELSING TELEGRAM, MRS.
uz: VAN HELSING telegramasi, xonim.

en: HARKER TO VAN HELSING 25 September.—Come today by quarter past ten train if you can catch it.
uz: HARKER TO VAN HELSING 25 Sentyabr.Agar uni ushlab qolsangiz, bugun o'n beshdan keyin poezdda keling.

en: Can see you any time you call.
uz: Sizni har safar qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz mumkin.

en: WILHELMINA HARKER MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 25 September.—I cannot help feeling terribly excited as the time draws near for the visit of Dr.
uz: WILHELMINA HARKER MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 25 sentabr.Men doktorning tashrif vaqti yaqinlashgani sayin juda hayajonlanaman.

en: Van Helsing, for somehow I expect that it will throw some light upon Jonathan's sad experience, and as he attended poor dear Lucy in her last illness, he can tell me all about her.
uz: Van Helsing, chunki bu Jonatanning qayg'uli tajribasiga biroz yorug'lik ato etadi deb o'ylayman va u kambag'al aziz Luziga uning so'nggi kasalligida g'amxo'rlik qilganida, u menga u haqida hamma narsani aytib berishi mumkin.

en: That is the reason of his coming.
uz: Uning kelishining sababi ham shu.

en: It is concerning Lucy and her sleepwalking, and not about Jonathan.
uz: Bu Luzi va uning uyqu yurishi haqida, Jonatan haqida emas.

en: Then I shall never know the real truth now!
uz: O'shanda men endi hech qachon haqiqiy haqiqatni bilmayman!

en: That awful journal gets hold of my imagination and tinges everything with some- thing of its own color.
uz: O'sha dahshatli jurnal mening tasavvurimga ega bo'lib, hamma narsani o'z rangidagi biron bir narsa bilan to'ldiradi.

en: Of course it is about Lucy.
uz: Albatta, bu Luzi haqida.

en: That habit came back to the poor dear, and that awful night on the cliff must have made her ill.
uz: Bu odat kambag'al ayolga qaytib keldi va qirg'oqdagi o'sha dahshatli kechasi uni kasal qilib qo'ygan bo'lishi kerak.

en: I had almost forgotten in my own affairs how ill she was afterwards.
uz: O'z ishlarimda u keyinchalik qanchalik kasal bo'lganini deyarli unutib qo'ydim.

en: She must have told him of her sleep-walking adventure on the cliff, and that I knew
uz: U unga o'z uyqu sayohatining toshbo'yi bo'ylab sodir bo'lganini va men buni bilardim, deb aytishi kerak edi.

en: all about it, and now he wants me to tell him what I know, so that he may understand.
uz: Bu haqda hammasi bor, endi esa u menga nimalarni bilishimni aytishimni xohlaydi, toki u buni tushunsin.

en: I hope I did right in not saying anything of it to Mrs.
uz: Umid qilamanki, bu haqda xonimga hech narsa aytmaganimda to'g'ri yo'l tutdim.

en: I should never forgive myself if any act of mine, were it even a negative one, brought harm on poor dear Lucy.
uz: Agar biron bir harakatim, hatto salbiy bo'lsa ham, kambag'al Lucyga zarar yetkazgan bo'lsa, men hech qachon o'zimni kechirmayman.

en: Van Helsing will not blame me.
uz: Van Helsing meni ayblamaydi.

en: I have had so much trouble and anxiety of late that I feel I cannot bear more just at present.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda shunchalik ko'p muammo va tashvishlarga duch keldimki, hozirgi paytda undan ko'proq narsani ko'tarolmasligimni his qilaman.

en: I suppose a cry does us all good at times, clears the air as other rain does.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ba'zan yig'lash hammamizga yaxshilik qiladi, boshqa yomg'irlar kabi havoni tozalaydi.

en: Perhaps it was reading the journal yesterday that upset me, and then Jonathan went away this morning to stay away from me a whole day and night, the ﬁrst time we have been parted since our marriage.
uz: Ehtimol, meni kecha jurnalni o'qish xafa qilgan bo'lsa kerak, keyin Jonatan ertalab men bilan bir kun va bir kecha uzoqda qolish uchun ketib ketdi, bu nikohimizdan beri birinchi marta ajralganmiz.

en: I do hope the dear fellow will take care of himself, and that nothing will occur to upset him.
uz: Umid qilamanki, aziz yigit o'zi haqida o'ylab ko'radi va uni xafa qiladigan hech narsa sodir bo'lmaydi.

en: It is two o'clock, and the doctor will be here soon now.
uz: Soat ikki va shifokor tez orada keladi.

en: I shall say nothing of Jonathan's journal unless he asks me.
uz: Jonatanning jurnalidan so'ramagan bo'lsam, hech narsa aytmayman.

en: I am so glad I have type- written out my own journal, so that, in case he asks about Lucy, I can hand it to him.
uz: O'zimning jurnalimni yozganimdan juda xursandman, shuning uchun u Luzi haqida so'rasa, unga beraman.

en: It will save much questioning.
uz: Bu juda ko'p savollar berishdan saqlaydi.

en: Later.—He has come and gone.
uz: Keyinroq.U kelib ketibdi.

en: Oh, what a strange meeting, and how it all makes my head whirl round.
uz: Oh, bu qanday g'alati uchrashuv va bularning barchasi mening boshimni aylantirib qo'yadi.

en: I feel like one in a dream.
uz: Men o'zimni tushdagi odamdek his qilaman.

en: Can it be all pos- sible, or even a part of it?
uz: Bularning hammasi yoki hatto bir qismi ham mumkinmi?

en: If I had not read Jonathan's journal ﬁrst, I should never have accepted even a possibility.
uz: Agar Jonatanning jurnalini avval o'qimagan bo'lsam, hech qachon imkoniyatni qabul qilmasdim.

en: Poor, poor, dear Jonathan!
uz: Yomon, kambag'al, aziz Jonatan!

en: How he must have suffered.
uz: U qanday azob chekgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Please the good God, all this may not upset him again.
uz: Yaxshi Xudodan iltijo qilaman, bularning barchasi uni yana xafa qilmasligi mumkin.

en: I shall try to save him from it.
uz: Men uni undan qutqarishga harakat qilaman.

en: But it may be even a consolation and a help to him, terrible though it be and awful in its consequences, to know for certain that his eyes and ears and brain did not deceive him, and that it is all true.
uz: Ammo uning ko'zlari, quloqlari va miyasi uni aldamaganligini va bularning barchasi haqiqat ekanini bilish, hatto qo'rqinchli bo'lishi va oqibatlari ham qo'rqinchli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It may be that it is the doubt which haunts him, that when the doubt is re- moved, no matter which, waking or dreaming, may prove the truth, he will be more satisﬁed and better able to bear the shock.
uz: Ehtimol, uni shubha bosgan bo'lishi mumkin, chunki shubha yana ko'tarilganda, u uyg'oq bo'lganda yoki orzu qilganida haqiqatni isbotlagan bo'lsa ham, u ko'proq qoniqarli bo'ladi va shokni ko'proq yengishga qodir bo'ladi.

en: Van Helsing must be a good man as well as a clever one if he is Arthur's friend and Dr.
uz: Van Helsing Arturning do'sti va doktor bo'lsa, yaxshi odam va aqlli odam bo'lishi kerak.

en: Seward's, and if they brought him all the way from Holland to look after Lucy.
uz: Sewardning uyida, va agar uni Gollandiyadan olib kelishgan bo'lsa, Lucyga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun.

en: I feel from having seen him that he is good and kind and of a noble nature.
uz: Uni ko'rib, yaxshi, mehribon va noyob inson ekanligidan xabardorman.

en: When he comes tomorrow I shall ask him about Jonathan.
uz: Ertaga u kelganida unga Jonatan haqida so'rayman.

en: And then, please God, all this sorrow and anxiety may lead to a good end.
uz: Keyin, Xudo xohlasa, bu barcha qayg'u va tashvishlar yaxshi yakun topishi mumkin.

en: I used to think I would like to practice interviewing.
uz: Men intervyu o'tkazishni mashq qilishni xohlardim deb o'ylardim.

en: Jonathan's friend on The Exeter News told him that memory is everything in such work, that you must be able to put down exactly almost every word spoken, even if you had to reﬁne some of it afterwards.
uz: The Exeter Newsda Jonatanning do'sti unga bunday ishda xotira hamma narsadir, deyarli har bir so'zni yozib qo'yishingiz kerakligini, hatto keyinchalik ba'zilarini o'zgartirishingiz kerakligini aytdi.

en: Here was a rare interview.
uz: Mana bir noyob intervyu.

en: I shall try to record it verbatim.
uz: Men uni so'z-so'z yozishga harakat qilaman.

en: It was half-past two o'clock when the knock came.
uz: Keltirilganda soat ikki yarim o'tdi.

en: I took my courage a deux mains and waited.
uz: Men jasoratimni ikki qo'lim bilan ko'tarib, kutdim.

en: In a few minutes Mary opened the door, and an-
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng Meri eshikni ochdi va u...

en: I rose and bowed, and he came towards me, a man of medium weight, strongly built, with his shoulders set back over a broad, deep chest and a neck well balanced on the trunk as the head is on the neck.
uz: Men turdim va o'zimni egdim, u esa o'rtacha vaznli, mustahkam qurilgan, ko'ksiga keng, chuqur ko'krak ustida qo'yib qo'yilgan, bo'yni bosh bo'yi bo'yi bo'yi bo'lgan, bo'yi esa bo'yi bo'yi bo'yi bo'yi bo'yi bilan yonimga keldi.

en: The poise of the head strikes me at once as indicative of thought and power.
uz: Boshimning tiklanishi birdan fikr va kuchni ko'rsatadi.

en: The head is no- ble, well-sized, broad, and large behind the ears.
uz: Boshni ko'p, katta, keng va quloq orqasida katta ko'rinadi.

en: The face, cleanshaven, shows a hard, square chin, a large resolute, mobile mouth, a good-sized nose, rather straight, but with quick, sensitive nostrils, that seem to broaden as the big bushy brows come down and the mouth tightens.
uz: O'z yuzini tozalab, qattiq, kvadrat burun, katta qat'iy, harakatlanuvchi og'iz, yaxshi o'lchamli burun, biroz to'g'ri, ammo tezkor, sezgir burun toshlari bilan, katta butalar tushganda va og'iz siqilganda kenglashib ketayotganini ko'rsatadi.

en: The forehead is broad and ﬁne, rising at ﬁrst almost straight and then sloping back above two bumps or ridges wide apart, such a forehead that the reddish hair can- not possibly tumble over it, but falls naturally back and to the sides.
uz: Qani keng va chiroyli, boshida deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'tarilib, so'ngra ikki bo'g'in yoki bo'g'inning orqasidan orqaga surib boradi, shunday qani, qizil sochlar uning ustiga tushishi mumkin emas, balki tabiiy ravishda orqaga va yonlariga tushadi.

en: Big, dark blue eyes are set widely apart, and are quick and tender or stern with the man's moods.
uz: Katta, qorong'i ko'k ko'z ko'zlari katta bo'lib, tez va tender yoki odamning ruhini qattiq o'tkazadi.

en: He said to me, Mrs.
uz: U menga shunday dedi: Xonim.

en: Harker, is it not? I bowed assent.
uz: Harker, shunday emasmi? - dedim va men rozi bo'ldim.

en: That was Miss Mina Murray? Again I assented.
uz: Bu Miss Mina Murraymi? - deb yana rozi bo'ldim.

en: It is Mina Murray that I came to see that was friend of that poor dear child Lucy Westenra.
uz: Men bu kambag'al qiz Lusi Vestenraning do'sti bo'lgan Mina Murrayni ko'rishga keldim.

en: Madam Mina, it is on account of the dead that I come. Sir, I said, you could have no better claim on me than that you were a friend and helper of Lucy Westenra.And I held out my hand.
uz: Madam Mina, men o'lganlar uchun keldim. - Men: Agar siz Lucy Westenraning do'sti va yordamchisi bo'lsangiz, menga nisbatan eng yaxshi da'voingiz yo'q, - dedim. Men qo'limni uzatdim.

en: He took it and said tenderly, Oh, Madam Mina, I know that the friend of that poor little girl must be good, but I had yet to learn …  He ﬁnished his speech with a courtly bow.
uz: U uni olib, samimiylik bilan shunday dedi: Oh, xonim Mina, bu kambag'al qizchaning do'sti yaxshi bo'lishi kerakligini bilaman, lekin men hali o'rganmagan edim... U nutqini hovuzcha qo'zg'olon bilan yakunladi.

en: I asked him what it was that he wanted to see me about, so he at once began.
uz: Men undan nima uchun meni ko'rishni xohlayotganini so'radim va u darhol boshladi.

en: I have read your letters to Miss Lucy.
uz: Lusi xonimga yozgan maktublaringizni o'qib berdim.

en: Forgive me, but I had to begin to inquire somewhere, and there was none to ask.
uz: Kechirasizlar, lekin men bir joyda so'rashni boshladim va so'rash uchun hech kim yo'q edi.

en: I know that you were with her at Whitby.
uz: Men bilsam, siz u bilan Whitbyda bo'lganingizni bilaman.

en: She sometimes kept a diary, you need not look surprised, Madam Mina.
uz: Ba'zan u kundalik yozuvlarini yozib turardi, siz hayron bo'lishingiz shart emas, xonim Mina.

en: It was begun after you had left, and was an imitation of you, and in that diary she traces by inference certain things to a sleep-walking in which she puts down that you saved her.
uz: U siz ketgandan so'ng boshlangan va sizning nusxangiz bo'lgan va u ushbu kundalik kitobda ba'zi narsalarni uyqudan yurish bilan bog'liq deb xulosa qiladi.

en: In great perplexity then I come to you, and ask you out of your so much kindness to tell me all of it that you can remember. I can tell you, I think, Dr.
uz: O'zimni juda xavotirda his etib, oldingizga kelib, menga eslab qolishingiz mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsani aytib berishni so'rayman.

en: Van Helsing, all about it. Ah, then you have good memory for facts, for details?
