uz: Ah, demak, sizda faktlar, tafsilotlar uchun yaxshi xotira bormi?

en: It is not always so with young ladies.
uz: Yosh ayollar bilan hamisha shunday bo'lmaydi.

en: No, doctor, but I wrote it all down at the time.
uz: Yo'q, doktor, lekin men o'sha paytda hamma narsani yozib qoldim.

en: I can show it to you if you like. Oh, Madam Mina, I well be grateful.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, sizga ko'rsata olaman. Oh, Madam Mina, men sizga minnatdorman.

en: You will do me much favor. I could not resist the temptation of mystifying him a bit, I suppose it is some taste of the original apple that remains still in our mouths, so I handed him the shorthand diary.
uz: Siz menga ko'p yaxshilik qilasiz. Men uni biroz g'ayratga solib, o'ylash vasvasasiga qarshi tura olmadim, bu bizning og'zimizda hali ham qolmagan asl olma tadmi, deb o'ylayman, shuning uchun men unga qisqartma jurnalini berdim.

en: He took it with a grateful bow, and said, May I read it? If you wish, I answered as demurely as I could.
uz: U minnatdorlik bilan quvonch bilan o'qib oldi va: O'qib bersam bo'ladimi? - deb so'radi.

en: He opened it, and for an instant his face fell.
uz: U uni ochdi va bir zum uchun yuzi tushdi.

en: Then he stood up and bowed.
uz: So'ngra o'rnidan turib, sajda qildi.

en: Oh, you so clever woman! he said.
uz: Oh, siz juda aqlli ayolsiz! - dedi u.

en: I knew long that Mr.
uz: Men uzoq vaqtdan beri bilgan edimki, Mr.

en: Jonathan was a man of much thankfulness, but see, his wife have all the good things.
uz: Yoʻnatan katta minnatdorchilik bildirgan odam edi, ammo uning xotiniga barcha yaxshiliklar bor.

en: And will you not so much honor me and so help me as to read it for me?
uz: Va siz menga shunchalik hurmat ko'rsatib, menga yordam bermayapsizmi, uni o'qib bermayapsizmi?

en: I know not the shorthand. By this time my little joke was over, and I was almost ashamed.
uz: Men qisqartma so'zini bilmayman. Bu vaqtga kelib, kichik hazillarim tugagachdi va men deyarli uyalgan edim.

en: So I took the typewritten copy from my work basket and handed it to him.
uz: Shunday qilib, men ish kostimdan matbaa nusxasini olib, unga berdim.

en: Forgive me, I said.
uz: Men: Meni kechiring, - dedim.

en: I could not help it, but I had been thinking that it was of dear Lucy that you wished to ask, and so that you might not have time to wait, not on my account, but because I know your time must be pre- cious, I have written it out on the typewriter for you. He took it and his eyes glistened.
uz: Men buni qilolmasdim, lekin siz so'rashni istagan kishi aziz Luziga bo'lganini o'yladim va sizda vaqt bo'lmasligi uchun, men uchun emas, balki vaqtingiz qimmatli ekanini bilaman, shuning uchun men uni matbaa mashinasiga yozdim, - dedi u.

en: You are so good, he said.
uz: Sen juda yaxshisan, dedi u.

en: And may I read it now?
uz: Uni endi o'qib bersam bo'ladimi?

en: I may want to ask you some things when I have read. By all means, I said.
uz: O'qiganimdan so'ng senga ba'zi savollar berishim mumkin, - dedim men.

en: read it over whilst I order lunch, and then you can ask me questions whilst we eat. He bowed and settled himself in a chair with his back to the light, and became so absorbed in the papers, whilst I went to see after lunch chieﬂy in order that he might not be disturbed.
uz: Men kechki ovqatni buyurtma qilganimda o'qib ko'ring, keyin biz ovqatlanayotganda menga savollar berishingiz mumkin. U tiz cho'kib, o'zini yorug'likka orqaga tikib o'tirdi va gazetalarga ko'proq qiziqdi.

en: When I came back, I found him walk- ing hurriedly up and down the room, his face all ablaze with excitement.
uz: Qaytib kelganimda, uni yig'ib-yig'ib o'tirgan edim, uning yuzi hayajonga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: He rushed up to me and took me by both hands.
uz: U menga yaqinlashib, qo'limdan ushlab oldi.

en: Oh, Madam Mina, he said, how can I say what I owe to you?
uz: U shunday dedi: Oh, xonim Mina, sizga qancha qarzdor ekanimni qanday aytsam bo'ladi?

en: This pa- per is as sunshine.
uz: Ushbu pa- per quyosh nuridir.

en: It opens the gate to me.
uz: Bu menga eshikni ochadi.

en: I am dazed, I am dazzled, with so much light, and yet clouds roll in behind the light every time.
uz: Men juda ko'p yorug'lik bilan ko'nglimni cho'ktirdim, lekin har safar nur orqasidan bulutlar o'girib keladi.

en: But that you do not, cannot comprehend.
uz: Ammo siz buni tushunmayotganingizni tushunolmaysiz.

en: Oh, but I am grateful to you, you so clever woman.
uz: Oh, lekin men sizga minnatdorman, siz juda aqlli ayol.

en: Madame, he said this very solemnly, if ever Abraham Van Hels- ing can do anything for you or yours, I trust you will let me know.
uz: - Xonim, - dedi u, - agar Ibrohim Van Helsing siz yoki sizning foydangiz uchun biror narsa qila olsa, menga xabar berishga umid qilaman.

en: It will be pleasure and delight if I may serve you as a friend, as a friend, but all I have ever learned, all I can ever do, shall be for you and those you love.
uz: Sizga do'st, do'st sifatida xizmat qilish men uchun zavq va zavqdir, lekin men hech qachon o'rganganim, qila olmaganim faqat siz va siz sevganlar uchun bo'ladi.

en: There are darknesses in life, and there are lights.
uz: Hayotda zulmatlar ham, nurlar ham bor.

en: You are one of the lights.
uz: Siz nurlardan birisiz.

en: will have a happy life and a good life, and your husband will be blessed in you. But, doctor, you praise me too much, and you do not know me. Not know you, I, who am old, and who have studied all my life men and women, I who have made my specialty the brain and all that belongs to him and all that follow from him!
uz: Siz baxtli va yaxshi hayotga ega bo'lasiz va eringiz sizda baraka topadi. - Ammo, shifokor, siz meni ko'p maqtayapsiz, lekin siz meni tanimaysiz. - Seni bilmayman, men, keksa odam, men butun hayotim davomida erkak va ayollarni o'rgangan, men o'z mutaxassisligimni miyam va unga tegishli bo'lgan hamma narsa va undan keyingi barcha narsalarni o'rgangan odam!

en: And I have read your diary that you have so goodly written for me, and which breathes out truth in every line.
uz: Va men sizning kundalik kitobingizni o'qib chiqdim, siz men uchun juda yaxshi yozgan va har bir satrda haqiqatni o'stirayotgan.

en: I, who have read your so sweet letter to poor Lucy of your marriage and your trust, not know you!
uz: Men sizning turmushingiz va ishonchingiz haqida kambag'al Lusiga yozgan shirin maktubingizni o'qigan bo'lsam-da, sizni tanimayman!

en: Oh, Madam Mina, good women tell all their lives, and by day and by hour and by minute, such things that angels can read.
uz: Oh, Mina xonim, yaxshi ayollar o'z hayoti davomida, kun, soat va daqiqada farishtalar o'qishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalarni aytib berishadi.

en: And we men who wish to know have in us something of angels' eyes.
uz: Va biz, bilmoqchi bo'lgan odamlar, o'zimizda farishtalarning ko'zlari bor.

en: Your husband is noble nature, and you are noble too, for you trust, and trust cannot be where there is mean nature.
uz: Eringiz - noyob tabiat, siz ham noyobsiz, chunki siz ishonasiz va ishonch yovuz tabiat bo'lgan joyda bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: And your husband, tell me of him.
uz: Va eringiz, menga u haqida aytib bering.

en: Is all that fever gone, and is he strong and hearty? I saw here an opening to ask him about Jonathan, so I said,He was al- most recovered, but he has been greatly upset by Mr.
uz: Bu issiqlik yo'q bo'ldimi va u kuchli va kuchlimi? - deb so'rash uchun men bu yerda Jonatan haqida so'rash imkoniyatini ko'rdim va shunday dedim: U sog'aygan edi, lekin u Mr. tomonidan juda xafa bo'lgan.

en: Hawkins death. He interrupted, Oh, yes.
uz: Hawkinsning o'limi.  - deb o'zi to'xtatdi. - Ha, ha.

en: I have read your last two letters. I went on, I suppose this upset him, for when we were in town on Thurs- day last he had a sort of shock. A shock, and after brain fever so soon!
uz: So'nggi ikki maktubingizni o'qib chiqdim, - deb davom ettirdim men. Bu uni xafa qilgan bo'lishi mumkin, chunki biz o'tgan kun shaharda bo'lganimizda, u bir xil shokga duch keldi.

en: What kind of shock was it? He thought he saw some one who recalled something terrible, some- thing which led to his brain fever. And here the whole thing seemed to overwhelm me in a rush.
uz: Bu qanday ajablantirish edi? - deb o'yladi u, kimdir dahshatli bir narsani eslab qolganini ko'rdi, bu esa uning miya issiqligiga sabab bo'ldi.

en: The pity for Jonathan, the horror which he experi- enced, the whole fearful mystery of his diary, and the fear that has been brooding over me ever since, all came in a tumult.
uz: Jonatan uchun achinish, uning hayotida sodir bo'lgan dahshat, uning kundalik kitobining butun dahshatli sirlari va o'sha paytdan beri meni bezovta qilayotgan qo'rquvlarning hammasi g'alati holga tushdi.

en: I suppose I was hysteri- cal, for I threw myself on my knees and held up my hands to him, and im- plored him to make my husband well again.
uz: O'zimni tiz cho'kib, unga qo'llarimni ko'tarib, erimni sog'aytirishga harakat qildim.

en: He took my hands and raised me up, and made me sit on the sofa, and sat by me.
uz: U qo'llarimni ushlab, meni ko'tardi, sofaga o'tirtirtirdi va yonimda o'tirdi.

en: He held my hand in his, and said to me with, oh, such inﬁnite sweetness, My life is a barren and lonely one, and so full of work that I have not had much time for friendships, but since I have been summoned to here by my friend John Seward I have known so many good people and seen such nobility that I feel more than ever, and it has grown with my advancing years, the loneliness of my life.
uz: U mening qo'limni o'zidan ushlab, menga cheksiz shirinlik bilan shunday dedi: Mening hayotim bepul va yolg'iz, ish bilan band bo'lib, do'stlik qilishga vaqtim yetmagan, ammo do'stim Jon Seward meni bu yerga chaqirganidan beri men shuncha yaxshi odamlarni tanigan va bunday azizlikni ko'rganmanki, men buni har qachongidan ko'proq his qilaman va bu yoshim o'tgan sari o'sib bormoqda, hayotimning yolg'izligi.

en: Believe me, then, that I come here full of respect for you, and you have given me hope, hope, not in what I am seek-
uz: Shunday qilib, menga ishoningki, men bu yerga sizlarni hurmat bilan kelaman va siz menga umid, umid ato etdingiz, lekin men orzu qilayotgan narsada emas.

en: ing of, but that there are good women still left to make life happy, good women, whose lives and whose truths may make good lesson for the chil- dren that are to be.
uz: Ammo hayotni baxtli qilish uchun hali ham yaxshi ayollar bor, ularning hayoti va haqiqatlari kelajakdagi bolalarga yaxshi saboq berishi mumkin.

en: I am glad, glad, that I may here be of some use to you.
uz: Men bu yerda sizga foydali bo'lganimdan xursandman.

en: For if your husband suffer, he suffer within the range of my study and expe- rience.
uz: Chunki agar sizning eringiz azob cheksa, u mening o'quv va tajribam doirasida azob chekadi.

en: I promise you that I will gladly do all for him that I can, all to make his life strong and manly, and your life a happy one.
uz: Sizga va'da beramanki, uning uchun qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qilaman, uning hayoti kuchli va erkak bo'lib, sizning ham hayotingiz baxtli bo'lishi uchun.

en: You are over-wrought and perhaps over-anxious.
uz: Siz ortiqcha kuchga to'lgansiz va ehtimol ortiqcha tashvishlangansiz.

en: Husband Jonathan would not like to see you so pale, and what he like not where he love, is not to his good.
uz: Eringiz Jonatan sizni o'zingizning ko'rinishingizdan xafa bo'lishni xohlamaydi va u sevgan joyda yoqtirmagan narsalarni o'zi uchun yaxshi ko'rishmaydi.

en: Therefore for his sake you must eat and smile.
uz: Shuning uchun uning uchun siz ovqatlanishingiz va tabassum qilishingiz kerak.

en: You have told me about Lucy, and so now we shall not speak of it, lest it distress.
uz: Siz menga Lusi haqida gapirgan edingiz, endi esa bu haqda gapirmaymiz, chunki bu bizni xafa qiladi.

en: I shall stay in Exeter tonight, for I want to think much over what you have told me, and when I have thought I will ask you questions, if I may.
uz: Men bugun kechqurun Ekzetorda qolaman, chunki siz menga aytganlar haqida ko'p o'ylashni xohlayman va o'ylaganimda, agar ruxsat berilsa, sizga savollar beraman.

en: And then too, you will tell me of husband Jonathan's trouble so far as you can, but not yet.
uz: Keyin ham eringiz Jonatanning muammolari haqida imkoningiz boricha aytib bering, lekin hali emas.

en: You must eat now, afterwards you shall tell me all. After lunch, when we went back to the drawing room, he said to me, And now tell me all about him. When it came to speaking to this great learned man, I began to fear that he would think me a weak fool, and Jonathan a madman, that journal is all so strange, and I hesitated to go on.
uz: Endi ovqatlaning, keyin hammasini aytasan. Ovqatdan so'ng, biz o'tirishga qaytib borganimizda, u menga: Va endi u haqida menga hamma narsani ayting, - dedi.Bu buyuk bilimdon kishi bilan suhbatlashishga kelganda, u meni zaif ahmoq, Jonatan esa aqldan ozgan, deb o'ylashidan qo'rqardim.

en: But he was so sweet and kind, and he had promised to help, and I trusted him, so I said, Dr.
uz: Ammo u juda mehribon va mehribon edi va yordam berishga va'da bergan edi, men unga ishonardim va shunday dedim: Dr.

en: Van Helsing, what I have to tell you is so queer that you must not laugh at me or at my husband.
uz: Van Helsing, sizga aytishim kerak bo'lgan narsa shunchalik g'alatiki, siz menga yoki erimga kulmaysiz.

en: I have been since yesterday in a sort of fever of doubt.
uz: Kechadan beri bir xil shubhalar og'rig'ida edim.

en: You must be kind to me, and not think me foolish that I have even half believed some very strange things. He reassured me by his manner as well as his words when he said, Oh, my dear, if you only know how strange is the matter regarding which I am here, it is you who would laugh.
uz: Menga mehribon bo'lishingiz kerak va men yarim o'ta g'alati narsaga ishonishim uchun meni ahmoq deb hisoblamasligingiz kerak. U meni o'z xulq-atvori bilan ham, so'zlari bilan ham tasalli berdi: Ey, azizim, agar men bu yerda bo'lgan bu masala qanchalik g'alati ekanini bilsangiz, siz kulishasiz.

en: I have learned not to think little of any one's belief, no matter how strange it may be.
uz: Men hech kimning e'tiqodi haqida kamroq o'ylamagan bo'lishni o'rgandim, bu qanchalik g'alati bo'lmasin.

en: I have tried to keep an open mind, and it is not the ordinary things of life that could close it, but the strange things, the extraordinary things, the things that make one doubt if they be mad or sane. Thank you, thank you a thousand times!
uz: Men ochiq ongni saqlab qolishga harakat qildim va hayotdagi odatdagi narsalar emas, balki g'alati narsalar, g'alati narsalar, aqldan ozgan yoki aqlli bo'lishidan shubhalanadigan narsalar uni yopib qo'yadi.

en: You have taken a weight off my mind.
uz: Siz mening ongimdan og'irlikni olib tashladingiz.

en: If you will let me, I shall give you a paper to read.
uz: Agar menga ruxsat bersangiz, sizga o'qish uchun qog'oz beraman.

en: It is long, but I have typewritten it out.
uz: Uzoq, lekin men uni matbuot mashinasiga yozib qo'ydim.

en: It will tell you my trouble and Jonathan's.
uz: Bu sizga mening va Jonatanning muammolarini aytadi.

en: It is the copy of his journal when abroad, and all that happened.
uz: Bu chet elda bo'lganida, uning jurnalining nusxasi va sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealar.

en: I dare not say any- thing of it.
uz: Men hech narsa aytishga jur'at qilmayman.

en: You will read for yourself and judge.
uz: O'zingiz o'qib, hukm qilasiz.

en: And then when I see you, perhaps, you will be very kind and tell me what you think.
uz: Keyin sizni ko'rganimda, ehtimol, siz juda mehribon bo'lib, o'zingizning fikringizni aytasiz.

en: I promise, he said as I gave him the papers.
uz: Men va'da beraman, - dedi u, men unga qog'ozlarni berayotganimda.

en: I shall in the morning, as soon as I can, come to see you and your husband, if I may. Jonathan will be here at half-past eleven, and you must come to lunch with us and see him then.
uz: Ertalab ertalab, imkonim boricha tezroq siz va eringizni ko'rishga kelaman, agar imkonim bo'lsa.Jonatan soat uch yarimdan o'n birda bu yerda bo'ladi va siz biz bilan birga tushlikka kelishingiz kerak va uni o'sha payt ko'rishingiz kerak.

en: You could catch the quick 3:34 train, which will leave you at Paddington before eight. He was surprised at my knowledge of the trains offhand, but he does not know that I have made up all the trains to and from Exeter, so that I may help Jonathan in case he is in a hurry.
uz: Siz tezkor 3:34 poezdini uchratishingiz mumkin, u sizni sakkiz soatdan oldin Paddingtonda qoldiradi.U poyezdlar to'g'risida bilishimdan hayratda qoldi, ammo u Egzeterga va undan ketadigan barcha poyezdlarni yaratganimni bilmaydi, shuning uchun u terishqoq bo'lsa, Jonatanga yordam berishim mumkin.

en: So he took the papers with him and went away, and I sit here thinking, thinking I don't know what.
uz: So'ng u qog'ozlarni o'zi bilan olib ketib ketdi va men bu yerda o'tirib, nima bo'lishini bilmayman deb o'ylayman.

en: LETTER (by hand), VAN HELSING TO MRS.
uz: XATIR (qo'lda), VAN HELSING TO MS..

en: HARKER 25 September, 6 o'clock Dear Madam Mina, I have read your husband's so wonderful diary.
uz: HARKER 25 sentabr soat 6 da Sevgili xonim Mina, eringizning ajoyib kundalik kitobini o'qib chiqdim.

en: You may sleep without doubt.
uz: Shubhasiz, siz uxlay olasiz.

en: Strange and terrible as it is, it is true!
uz: Garchi bu g'alati va dahshatli bo'lsa-da, u haqiqatdir!

en: I will pledge my life on it.
uz: O'z hayotimni unga bag'ishlayman.

en: It may be worse for others, but for him and you there is no dread.
uz: Boshqalar uchun bu yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u va siz uchun qo'rquv yo'q.

en: He is a no- ble fellow, and let me tell you from experience of men, that one who would do as he did in going down that wall and to that room, aye, and going a sec- ond time, is not one to be injured in permanence by a shock.
uz: U yaxshi odam, men sizga odamlarning tajribasiga ko'ra aytamanki, o'sha devorni pastga tushish va o'sha xonada, ha, bir soniya o'tish bilan o'zi qilganidek qilgan kishi shoka tufayli doimiy ravishda jarohatlanmaydi.

en: His brain and his heart are all right, this I swear, before I have even seen him, so be at rest.
uz: Uning miyasi va yuragi yaxshi, men uni hatto ko'rmagunimdan oldin qasam ichaman, shuning uchun dam oling.

en: I shall have much to ask him of other things.
uz: Boshqa narsalar haqida ham undan ko'p so'rashim kerak.

en: I am blessed that today I come to see you, for I have learn all at once so much that again I am daz- zled, dazzled more than ever, and I must think.
uz: Bugun sizlarni ko'rishga kelganim uchun baxtiyorman, chunki men bir vaqtning o'zida shunchalik ko'p narsalarni o'rgandimki, yana bir bor har qachongidan ko'ra dahshatga tushdim va o'ylashim kerak.

en: Yours the most faithful, Abraham Van Helsing. LETTER, MRS.
uz: Sizning eng sodiq kishilaringiz, Abraham Van Helsing.

en: HARKER TO VAN HELSING 25 September, 6:30 p.
uz: HARKER TO VAN HELSING 25 sentabr kuni soat 6:30 da.

en: Van Helsing, A thousand thanks for your kind letter, which has taken a great weight off my mind.
uz: Van Helsing: Yaxshi maktubingiz uchun minglab rahmat, bu mening ongimdan katta og'irlikni olib tashladi.

en: And yet, if it be true, what terrible things there are in the world, and what an awful thing if that man, that monster, be really in Lon- don!
uz: Ammo agar bu haqiqat bo'lsa, dunyoda juda dahshatli narsalar bor va agar bu odam, bu jondor chindan ham Lon-donda bo'lsa, bu juda dahshatli narsa!

en: I have this moment, whilst writing, had a wire from Jonathan, saying that he leaves by the 6:25 tonight from Launceston and will be here at 10:18,so that I shall have no fear tonight.
uz: Men yozayotganimda, Jonatanning xabarini eshitib, uning Launcestondan 6:25 da ketishi va 10:18 da bu yerda bo'lishi haqida yozgan edim, shuning uchun men bugun qo'rqmayman.

en: Will you, therefore, instead of lunching with us, please come to breakfast at eight o'clock, if this be not too early for you?
uz: Shuning uchun, kechki ovqatni biz bilan birga yeyishning o'rniga, kechki ovqatga sakkizda keling, agar bu siz uchun juda erta bo'lmasa?

en: You can get away, if you are in a hurry, by the 10:30 train, which will bring you to Paddington by 2:35.
uz: Agar shoshilinch bo'lsangiz, Paddingtonga 2:35 gacha yetib boradigan 10:30 poezdida qochib ketishingiz mumkin.

en: Do not answer this, as I shall take it that, if I do not hear, you will come to breakfast.
uz: Bu savolga javob berma, chunki men buni eshitmasam, siz ham kechki ovqatga kelishingiz kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: Believe me, Your faithful and grateful friend, Mina Harker. JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 26 September.—I thought never to write in this diary again, but the time has come.
uz: Ishoning, sodiq va minnatdor do'stingiz Mina Harker.JONATHAN HARKERning 26 sentabr kunlik hayoti.Men bu kundalik kitobda boshqa hech qachon yozmayman deb o'yladim, lekin vaqt keldi.

en: When I got home last night Mina had supper ready, and when we had supped she told me of Van Helsing's visit, and of her having given him the two diaries copied out, and of how anxious she has been about me.
uz: Kecha uyga qaytganimda Mina kechki ovqatni tayyorlab qo'ygan edi va kechki ovqatni yeganimizda, u menga Van Helsingning tashrifini, unga ikkita kundalik kitobni nusxa qilib berganini va men uchun qanchalik tashvishlanayotganini aytib berdi.

en: She showed me in the doctor's letter that all I wrote down was true.
uz: U menga shifokorning maktubida yozganlarimning hammasi haqiqat ekanini ko'rsatdi.

en: It seems to have made a new man of me.
uz: Bu meni yangi odamga aylantirgan.

en: It was the doubt as to the reality of the whole thing that knocked me over.
uz: Bularning barchasining haqiqiyligiga bo'lgan shubha meni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: I felt impotent, and in the dark, and distrustful.
uz: Men o'zimni kuchsiz, qorong'i va ishonchsiz his qildim.

en: But, now that I know, I am not afraid, even of the Count.
uz: Ammo, endi bilganimdan so'ng, hatto Countdan ham qo'rqmayman.

en: He has succeeded after all, then, in his design in getting to London, and it was he I saw.
uz: Shunday qilib, u Londonga kelish uchun o'z dizaynida muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi va men uni ko'rdim.

en: He has got younger, and how?
uz: U yoshroq bo'ldi va qanday qilib?

en: Van Helsing is the man to unmask him and hunt him out, if he is anything like what Mina says.
uz: Van Helsing, agar u Mina aytganlarga o'xshash bo'lsa, uni ko'rishga va o'ldirishga qodir.

en: We sat late, and talked it over.
uz: Biz kechgacha o'tirib, bu haqda suhbatlashdik.

en: Mina is dressing, and I shall call at the hotel in a few minutes and bring him over.
uz: Mina kiyinadi va men bir necha daqiqadan keyin mehmonxonani chaqirib, uni olib kelishim kerak.

en: He was, I think, surprised to see me.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u meni ko'rib hayron qoldi.

en: When I came into the room whee he was, and introduced myself, he took me by the shoulder, and turned my face round to the light, and said, after a sharp scrutiny, But Madam Mina told me you were ill, that you had had a shock. It was so funny to hear my wife called `Madam Mina' by this kindly, strong-faced old man.
uz: Men u bilan o'zimni tanishtirganimda, u mening yelkamdan ushlab, yuzimni yorug'likka qaratdi va o'z vaqtida: Ammo Mina xonim sizga kasalligingizni, shokni boshdan kechirganingizni aytdi, - dedi.

en: I smiled, and said, I was ill, I have had a shock, but you have cured me already. And how? By your letter to Mina last night.
uz: Men tabassum qilib: Men kasal edim, shokga duch keldim, lekin siz meni allaqachon sog'aytirgansiz, - dedim.

en: I was in doubt, and then everything took a hue of unreality, and I did not know what to trust, even the evidence of my own senses.
uz: Shubhalanayotgan edim va keyin hamma narsa haqiqiy emaslik rangini egallab oldi va men nimaga ishonishni bilmasdim, hatto o'z his-tuyg'ularimning dalillarini ham.

en: Not knowing what to trust, I did not know what to do, and so had only to keep on working in what had hitherto been the groove of my life.
uz: Nimaga ishonish kerakligini bilmay, nima qilish kerakligini bilmasdim va shuning uchun hayotimning ilgari o'tgan yo'nalishida ishlashni davom ettirishim kerak edi.

en: The groove ceased to avail me, and I mistrusted myself.
uz: O'zimga ishonchim sust bo'lib, o'zimga ishonchim sust bo'ldi.

en: Doctor, you don't know what it is to doubt everything, even yourself.
uz: Doktor, siz hamma narsaga, hatto o'zingizga ham shubha ostiga qo'yishning nima ekanligini bilmaysiz.

en: No, you don't, you couldn't with eyebrows like yours. He seemed pleased, and laughed as he said, So!
uz: Yo'q, siz buni qila olmaysiz, sizda o'zingiz kabi ko'z burchaklari bo'lishi mumkin emas. U xursand bo'lib ko'rindi va o'zi shunday dedi: Ha, shunday!

en: You are a physiogno- mist.
uz: Siz fizyogno-bulutsiz.

en: I learn more here with each hour.
uz: Bu yerda har bir soatda ko'proq narsani o'rganaman.

en: I am with so much pleasure coming to you to breakfast, and, oh, sir, you will pardon praise from an old man, but you are blessed in your wife.
uz: Men sizlarning huzuringizga kechki ovqatga kelishdan juda zavqlanaman va, ey, xonim, siz keksa kishining maqtovini kechasiz, lekin siz xotiningizda muboraksiz.

en: I would listen to him go on praising Mina for a day, so I simply nodded and stood silent.
uz: Men uni bir kun davomida Minani maqtashni davom ettirganini tinglardim, shuning uchun men shunchaki boshimni tiyib, sukut tutdim.

en: She is one of God's women, fashioned by His own hand to show us men and other women that there is a heaven where we can enter, and that its light can be here on earth.
uz: U Xudoning xotinlaridan biri, Uning qo'li bizga, erkaklar va boshqa ayollar, biz kirishimiz mumkin bo'lgan osmon borligini va uning nuri yer yuzida bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatish uchun yaratilgan.

en: So true, so sweet, so noble, so little an egoist, and that, let me tell you, is much in this age, so sceptical and selﬁsh.
uz: Shunday haqiqat, shu qadar shirin, shu qadar noyob, shu qadar kam o'z-o'zidan mahrum, va bu, sizga aytaman, bu davrda juda ko'p narsa, shu qadar shubhali va xudbin.

en: And you, sir… I have read all the letters to poor Miss Lucy, and some of them speak of you, so I know you since some days from the knowing of others, but I have seen your true self since last night.
uz: Siz esa, xo'jayinim, men kambag'al Miss Lusiga yozilgan barcha xatlarni o'qib chiqdim va ulardan ba'zilari siz haqingizda gapiradi, shuning uchun men sizni boshqalarni bilishdan bir necha kundan beri bilaman, lekin o'tgan kechadan beri sizning haqiqiy o'zingizni ko'rdim.

en: You will give me your hand, will you not?
uz: Siz menga qo'lingizni berasiz, shunday emasmi?

en: And let us be friends for all our lives. We shook hands, and he was so earnest and so kind that it made me quite choky.
uz: Va hayotimiz davomida do'st bo'laylik. - deb qo'limizdan urdik va u shunchalik samimiy va mehribon bo'lganki, bu meni juda cho'kib qo'ydi.

en: and now, he said, may I ask you for some more help?
uz: Va endi, dedi u, Sizdan ko'proq yordam so'rasam bo'ladimi?

en: I have a great task to do, and at the beginning it is to know.
uz: Mening bajarishim kerak bo'lgan katta vazifam bor va boshida uni bilish kerak.

en: You can help me here.
uz: Siz menga bu yerda yordam bera olasiz.

en: Can you tell me what went before your going to Transylvania?
uz: Transilvaniyaga ko'chib o'tishdan oldin nimalar sodir bo'lganini aytib bera olasizmi?

en: Later on I may ask more help, and of a different kind, but at ﬁrst this will do. Look here, Sir, I said, does what you have to do concern the Count? It does, he said solemnly. Then I am with you heart and soul.
uz: Keyinchalik men boshqa yordam so'rashim mumkin, lekin boshida bu yordam beradi.  Bilasizmi, xo'jayinim, dedim men, Sizning qilishingiz kerak bo'lgan ish Countni qiziqtiradimi? Biladi, dedi u tantanali ravishda. Shuning uchun Men siz bilan bo'laman.

en: As you go by the 10:30 train, you will not have time to read them, but I shall get the bundle of papers.
uz: Siz 10:30 da poyezdda ketayotganingizda, ularni o'qish uchun vaqtingiz bo'lmaydi, lekin men qog'ozlar to'plamini oldim.

en: You can take them with you and read them in the train. After breakfast I saw him to the station.
uz: Siz ularni o'zingiz bilan olib, poezdda o'qib ko'rishingiz mumkin.

en: When we were parting he said, Perhaps you will come to town if I send for you, and take Madam Mina too. We shall both come when you will, I said.
uz: Ayrilish paytida u: Agar men seni chaqirsam, ehtimol sen shaharga kelasan va Mina xonimni ham olib ketasan, - deb aytdi.

en: I had got him the morning papers and the London papers of the previous night, and while we were talking at the carriage window, waiting for the train to start, he was turning them over.
uz: Men unga ertalabgi va o'tgan kechaning London gazetalarini olib keldim va biz vagon oynasida suhbatlashayotganimizda, poyezdni boshlashni kutganimizda, u ularni o'zgartirgan.

en: His eyes suddenly seemed to catch something in one of them, The Westminster Gazette, I knew it by the col- or, and he grew quite white.
uz: Uning ko'zlari birdan ulardan birida, Westminster gazeta da biron bir narsani ushlab turgandek ko'rindi, men uni kol-ordan bilardim va u juda oq bo'ldi.

en: He read something intently, groaning to him- self, Mein Gott!
uz: U diqqat bilan bir narsani o'qib, o'ziga-o'ziga: Men Xudoyim!

en: So soon! I do not think he remem- bered me at the moment.
uz: Shunday tezda! deb o'ylamayman, hozirda u meni eslatgani yo'q.

en: Just then the whistle blew, and the train moved off.
uz: O'shanda pishiriq o'qildi va poyezd o'tib ketdi.

en: This recalled him to himself, and he leaned out of the window and waved his hand, calling out, Love to Madam Mina.
uz: Bu unga o'zini eslatdi va u o'ziga o'xshab oynadan chiqib, qo'lini o'qib: Madam Minaga muhabbat!

en: I shall write so soon as ever I can. DR.
uz: Men iloji boricha tezroq yozaman. - deydi DR..

en: 26 September.—Truly there is no such thing as ﬁnality.
uz: 26 sentyabr.Haqiqatan ham, yakuniylik deb nomlanmaydigan narsa yo'q.

en: Not a week since I said Finis, and yet here I am starting fresh again, or rather going on with the record.
uz: Finisni aytganimdan bir hafta o'tib ham bo'lmadi, ammo men yana yangi boshladim, yoki aniqrog'i, rekord bilan davom etaman.

en: Until this afternoon I had no cause to think of what is done.
uz: Bu kechgacha nima qilinganligi haqida o'ylashga hech qanday sababim yo'q edi.

en: Ren- ﬁeld had become, to all intents, as sane as he ever was.
uz: Ren-Feld har doimgidek sog'lom bo'lib qolgan edi.

en: He was already well ahead with his ﬂy business, and he had just started in the spider line also, so he had not been of any trouble to me.
uz: U o'zining uchuvchi biznesida allaqachon juda yaxshi o'z faoliyatini boshlagan edi va u o'zining o'g'ir cho'qqisida ham boshlanardi, shuning uchun u menga hech qanday muammo tug'dirmagan edi.

en: I had a letter from Arthur, written on Sunday, and from it I gather that he is bearing up wonderfully well.
uz: Arturning yakshanba kuni yozgan maktubi meni kutib oldi va undan uning juda yaxshi munosabatda bo'lganini tushundim.

en: Quincey Morris is with him, and that is much of a help, for he himself is a bubbling well of good spirits.
uz: Quincey Morris u bilan birga, bu esa katta yordam beradi, chunki u o'zi yaxshi ruhiy ruhlar qudratli qudratli qudratdir.

en: Quincey wrote me a line too, and from him I hear that Arthur is beginning to recover something of his old buoyancy, so as to them all my mind is at rest.
uz: Quincey menga ham bir satr yozdi va undan eshitamanki, Artur o'zining eski ko'tarishchanligidan qaytarib olishi boshlaydi, shuning uchun ularning barchasi mening ongimning xotirjamligiga olib keladi.

en: As for myself, I was settling down to my work with the enthusiasm which I used to have for it, so that I might fairly have said that the wound which poor Lucy left on me was becoming cicatrised.
uz: O'zim uchun esa, men o'z ishimga avvalgi g'ayratim bilan qaytardim, shuning uchun esa bemalol aytishim mumkinki, kambag'al Luzi menga qoldirgan yara o'chirib ketyapti.

en: Everything is, however, now reopened, and what is to be the end God only knows.
uz: Biroq, hozir hamma narsa qayta ochildi va oxirat nima bo'lishini faqat Xudo biladi.

en: I have an idea that Van Helsing thinks he knows, too, but he will only let out enough at a time to whet curiosity.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, Van Helsing ham buni biladi deb o'ylaydi, lekin u bir vaqtning o'zida faqat qiziqish uyg'otish uchun etarlicha chiqarib beradi.

en: He went to Exeter yes- terday, and stayed there all night.
uz: U Egzeter shahriga bordi va butun kecha u yerda qoldi.

en: Today he came back, and almost bounded into the room at about half-past ﬁve o'clock, and thrust last night's West- minster Gazette into my hand.
uz: Bugun u qaytib kelib, soat besh yarim atrofida xonani deyarli o'rab oldi va o'tgan kechaning West-minster Gazetasi ni qo'limga urdi.

en: What do you think of that? he asked as he stood back and folded his arms.
uz: Bu haqda nima deb o'ylaysiz? - deb so'radi u orqaga qarab qo'llarini yopib.

en: I looked over the paper, for I really did not know what he meant, but he took it from me and pointed out a paragraph about children being decoyed away at Hampstead.
uz: Men qog'ozni ko'rib chiqdim, chunki uning nimani nazarda tutganini bilmasdim, lekin u menga uni olib, Hampsteadda bolalar aldanib ketishi haqidagi xatboshini ko'rsatdi.

en: It did not convey much to me, until I reached a passage where it described small puncture wounds on their throats.
uz: Bu men uchun katta ahamiyatga ega emas edi, faqatgina ularning bo'ynidagi kichik yaralarni tasvirlaydigan bir yozuvga yetib keldim.

en: An idea struck me, and I looked up.
uz: O'zimga bir g'oya keldi va men ko'zimni ko'tardim.

en: It is like poor Lucy's. And what do you make of it? Simply that there is some cause in common.
uz: Bu kambag'al Lusiyningkiga o'xshaydi. Undan nima deb o'ylaysiz? Agar biron bir umumiy sabab bo'lsa.

en: Whatever it was that in- jured her has injured them. I did not quite understand his answer.
uz: Unga juramentni topshirgan kishi nima bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, ularni jarohatlagan. Men uning javobini to'liq tushunmadim.

en: That is true indirectly, but not directly. How do you mean, Professor? I asked.
uz: Bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, balki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri haqiqat, - deb so'radim.

en: I was a little inclined to take his seriousness lightly, for, after all, four days of rest and freedom from burn- ing, harrowing, anxiety does help to restore one's spirits, but when I saw his
uz: Men uning jiddiyligini yengilroq ko'rishga moyil edim, chunki, oxir-oqibat, to'rt kunlik dam olish va yonish, qayg'urish va tashvishlardan ozod bo'lish odamning ruhini tiklashga yordam beradi, lekin uning ruhini ko'rganimda, u o'z ruhini tikladi.

en: face, it sobered me.
uz: O'zimni to'g'ri tutdim.

en: Never, even in the midst of our despair about poor Lucy, had he looked more stern.
uz: Hech qachon, hatto kambag'al Lusi haqida umidsizlikka tushib qolganimizda ham, u yanada qattiqqo'l ko'rinishga ega bo'lmagan.

en: I can hazard no opinion.
uz: Men hech qanday fikrga xavf sololmayman.

en: I do not know what to think, and I have no data on which to found a conjecture. Do you mean to tell me, friend John, that you have no suspicion as to what poor Lucy died of, not after all the hints given, not only by events, but by me? Of nervous prostration following a great loss or waste of blood. And how was the blood lost or wasted? I shook my head.
uz: Men nima deb o'ylashni bilmayman va hech qanday ma'lumotlarim yo'q. Siz menga aytmoqchimisiz, do'stim Jon, kambag'al Luzi nafaqat voqealar, balki men bergan barcha izohlardan keyin, balki men bergan barcha izohlardan keyin nima tufayli vafot etganini hech qanday shubha yo'qligini aytmoqchimisiz?  Yog'i qon yo'qotish yoki qon yo'qotib yuborish natijasida bo'lgan g'ayratli sajdalardan.  Qanday qilib qon yo'qotib yuborildi yoki yo'qotib yuborildi? - deb boshimni silkitdim.

en: He stepped over and sat down beside me, and went on,You are a clever man, friend John.
uz: U yonimga kelib, yonimga o'tirdi va davom etib: Sen aqlli odamsan, do'stim Jon.

en: You reason well, and your wit is bold, but you are too prejudiced.
uz: Siz yaxshi fikr yuritasiz va aql-idrokingiz jasoratli, ammo siz juda oldindan tanqid qilyapsiz.

en: You do not let your eyes see nor your ears hear, and that which is outside your daily life is not of account to you.
uz: Siz ko'zlaringiz ko'rmaydi, quloqlaringiz eshitmaydi va kundalik hayotingiz tashqarisida bo'lgan narsalar siz uchun ahamiyatsiz.

en: Do you not think that there are things which you cannot understand, and yet which are,that some people see things that others cannot?
uz: Ba'zi odamlar boshqalarning tushunmaydigan narsalarni ko'rishadi, deb o'ylamayapsizmi?

en: But there are things old and new which must not be contemplated by men's eyes, because they know, or think they know, some things which other men have told them.
uz: Ammo odamlar ko'zlari bilan ko'rib chiqishi kerak bo'lmagan eski va yangi narsalar bor, chunki ular boshqa odamlar ularga aytgan narsalarni bilishadi yoki bilishadi deb o'ylashadi.

en: Ah, it is the fault of our science that it wants to explain all, and if it explain not, then it says there is nothing to explain.
uz: Ah, bu bizning ilm-fanimizning aybidir, chunki u hamma narsani tushuntirishni xohlaydi va agar tushuntirmasa, unda tushuntirish uchun hech narsa yo'q deb aytadi.

en: But yet we see around us every day the growth of new beliefs, which think themselves new, and which are yet but the old, which pretend to be young, like the ﬁne ladies at the opera.
uz: Ammo biz atrofimizda har kuni yangi e'tiqodlarning o'sib borishini ko'ramiz, ular o'zlarini yangi deb hisoblaydilar, ammo ular hali ham eski, ular yosh bo'lib ko'rinadi, xuddi operadagi go'zal xonimlar kabi.

en: I suppose now you do not believe in corporeal transference.
uz: Ehtimol, hozir siz jismoniy o'tkazilishga ishonmayapsiz.

en: Nor in materialization.
uz: Shuningdek, bu materiallashtirishda ham bo'lmadi.

en: Nor in astral bodies.
uz: Shuningdek, astral jismlarda ham.

en: Nor in the reading of thought.
uz: Shuningdek, fikrlarni o'qishda ham.

en: Nor in hypnotism …  Yes, I said.
uz: Shuningdek, hipnotizmda ham...  Ha, - dedim men.

en: Charcot has proved that pretty well. He smiled as he went on, Then you are satisﬁed as to it.
uz: Charcot buni juda yaxshi isbotladi. - dedi u, davom etib, tabassum bilan: O'shanda siz bunga rozi bo'lasiz.

en: And of course then you understand how it act, and can follow the mind of the great Charcot, alas that he is no more, into the very soul of the patient that he in- ﬂuence.
uz: Va albatta, o'shanda siz uning qanday faoliyat ko'rsatishini tushunasiz va buyuk Charcotning fikrini, afsuski, u hozir yo'q, u ta'sir qiladigan bemorning ruhiga ham qo'shishingiz mumkin.

en: Then, friend John, am I to take it that you simply accept fact, and are satisﬁed to let from premise to conclusion be a blank?
uz: Xo'sh, do'stim Jon, siz shunchaki faktlarni qabul qilib, shuni tushunasizki, oldindan xulosaga kelishdan keyin, siz o'zingizni befoyda qoldirishdan mamnunmisiz?

en: Then tell me, for I am a student of the brain, how you accept hypnotism and reject the thought reading.
uz: Keyin menga, men miyaning o'quvchi bo'lganim uchun, qanday qilib siz hipnotizmni qabul qilib, fikr o'qishni rad etasiz, deb ayting.

en: Let me tell you, my friend, that there are things done today in electrical science which would have been deemed unholy by the very man who discovered electricity, who would themselves not so long before been burned as wizards.
uz: Sizga aytaman, do'stim, bugun elektr fanida elektrni kashf etgan kishi tomonidan muqaddas deb hisoblanmaydigan ishlar amalga oshirilmoqda, ular o'zlari ham o'tmishda sehrgarlar kabi yondirib yuborilgan bo'lishadi.

en: There are always mysteries in life.
uz: Hayotda doimo sirlar bor.

en: Why was it that Methuselah lived nine hundred years, and `Old Parr'one hundred and sixty- nine, and yet that poor Lucy, with four men's blood in her poor veins, could
uz: Nega Metusela to'qqiz yuz yil va `Old Parr'one yuz oltmish to'qqiz yil yashashi mumkin edi, ammo kambag'al Luziya, uning qonlarida to'rtta erkak qon to'kib ketgan bo'lsa-da, bu kambag'al Luziyasiga ega bo'lishi mumkin edi?

en: not live even one day?
uz: Bir kun ham yashamasligingiz kerakmi?

en: For, had she live one more day, we could save her.
uz: Agar u yana bir kun yashasa, biz uni qutqarishimiz mumkin.

en: Do you know all the mystery of life and death?
uz: Hayot va o'lim sirini bilasizmi?

en: Do you know the altogether of comparative anatomy and can say wherefore the qualities of brutes are in some men, and not in others?
uz: Qarshilik anatomiyasini to'liq bilasizmi va nega ba'zi erkaklarda hayvonlarning xususiyatlari bor, boshqalarda yo'qligini aytishingiz mumkinmi?

en: Can you tell me why, when other spiders die small and soon, that one great spider lived for centuries in the tower of the old Spanish church and grew and grew, till, on descending, he could drink the oil of all the church lamps?
uz: Nima uchun boshqa o'g'irchoqlar kichik va tezda o'lishganida, bitta buyuk o'g'irchoq asrlar davomida eski Ispaniya cherkovining minorasida yashagan va o'sib borgan va o'sib borgan, hatto tushganda u barcha cherkov chiroqlarining yog'ini ichib oladigan bo'ladi?

en: Can you tell me why in the Pampas, ay and elsewhere, there are bats that come out at night and open the veins of cattle and horses and suck dry their veins, how in some islands of the Western seas there are bats which hang on the trees all day, and those who have seen describe as like giant nuts or pods, and that when the sailors sleep on the deck, because that it is hot, ﬂit down on them and then, and then in the morning are found dead men, white as even Miss Lucy was? Good God, Professor! I said, starting up.
uz: Menga nima uchun Pampas, ay va boshqa joylarda kechasi ko'kraklar paydo bo'lib, chorva hayvonlari va otlarning idishlarini ochib, idishlarini quritishni sug'uradi, G'arbiy dengizlarning ba'zi orollarida qanday qilib butun kun daraxtlarda bog'liq bo'lgan idishlar borligini va ko'rgan kishilar ularni ulkan yong'oq yoki podlarga o'xshatganini va kemachilar issiqligi sababli qirg'oq ustida uxlayotganlarida, ular ustiga o'tib ketishlarini, keyin ertalab esa Miss Lusi kabi oq erkaklar topilganini aytib bera olasizmi?

en: Do you mean to tell me that Lucy was bitten by such a bat, and that such a thing is here in London in the nineteenth century? He waved his hand for silence, and went on,Can you tell me why the tortoise lives more long than generations of men, why the elephant goes on and on till he have sees dynasties, and why the parrot never die only of bite of cat of dog or other complaint?
uz: Lusiyani bunday urib o'tgani va XIX asrda Londonda bunday narsa borligini aytmoqchimisiz? - deb so'radi u. U xotirjamlikni so'rab qo'lini cho'zdi va davom etdi: Menga nima uchun qorin odamlardan ko'ra ko'proq umr ko'radi, nima uchun fil dinastiyalarni ko'rmaguncha davom etadi va nega papuqoy hech qachon faqat itning kisog'i yoki boshqa shikoyat tufayli o'lmaydi?

en: Can you tell me why men believe in all ages and places that there are men and women who cannot die?
uz: Nima uchun erkaklar har qanday yoshda va har qanday joyda o'lmas erkaklar va ayollar borligiga ishonishadi?

en: We all know, because science has vouched for the fact, that there have been toads shut up in rocks for thousands of years, shut in one so small hole that only hold him since the youth of the world.
uz: Biz hammamiz bilamiz, chunki ilm-fan shu haqiqatni tasdiqladi, minglab yillar davomida toshlar toshlar ichida o'tirib, uni dunyo yoshligidan beri ushlab turadigan kichkina cho'lda tuzilgan.

en: Can you tell me how the Indian fakir can make himself to die and have been buried, and his grave sealed and corn sowed on it, and the corn reaped and be cut and sown and reaped and cut again, and then men come and take away the unbroken seal and that there lie the Indian fakir, not dead, but that rise up and walk amongst them as before? Here I interrupted him.
uz: Qanday qilib hind fakiri o'lib, ko'milgan, qabrini muhrlab, unga bug'doy ekilgan, bug'doy o'rib, kesib, ekilgan, o'rib-o'rib, yana kesib ketayotganini aytsa bo'ladi?

en: I was getting bewildered.
uz: Men hayron bo'ldim.

en: He so crowded on my mind his list of nature's eccentricities and possible impossibilities that my imagination was getting ﬁred.
uz: Uning tabiatning g'ayritabiiyliklari va mumkin bo'lgan imkonsizliklari ro'yxati mening ongimga shunchalik to'lib-toshganki, tasavvurim o'z-o'zidan chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: I had a dim idea that he was teaching me some lesson, as long ago he used to do in his study at Amsterdam.
uz: Men uning menga bir saboq berayotganini tushunmadim, chunki u ancha vaqt oldin Amsterdamdagi o'quvxonasida buni qilgan edi.

en: But he used them to tell me the thing, so that I could have the object of thought in mind all the time.
uz: Ammo u ularni menga gapirish uchun ishlatdi, shunda men har doim fikr ob'ektini yodda tutishim mumkin edi.

en: But now I was without his help, yet I wanted to follow him, so I said,
uz: Ammo endi uning yordami yo'q edim, ammo unga ergashishni istardim, shuning uchun:

en: Professor, let me be your pet student again.
uz: Professor, menga yana sizning sevimli o'quvchingiz bo'lishga ruxsat bering.

en: Tell me the thesis, so that I may apply your knowledge as you go on.
uz: Menga tezingizni ayting, shunda sizning bilimlaringizni amalda qo'llasam bo'ladi.

en: At present I am going in my mind from point to point as a madman, and not a sane one, follows an idea.
uz: Hozirda men aqldan ozgan odam emas, balki aqldan ozgan odam bir g'oyaga ergashib ketayotganini ko'rib, fikr-mulohazalarimni o'zgartiryapman.

en: I feel like a novice lumbering through a bog in a midst, jumping from one tussock to another in the mere blind effort to move on without knowing where I am going. That is a good image, he said.
uz: Men o'zimni o'zimni qayerga borayotganimni bilmay, o'zimni ko'r-ko'r harakatda bo'lib, bir bog'ning o'rtasida o'simlik o'tkazayotgan yangilikdek his qilaman. Bu yaxshi tasvir, - dedi u.

en: Well, I shall tell you.
uz: Men sizga aytaman.

en: My thesis is this, I want you to believe. To believe what? To believe in things that you cannot.
uz: Mening tezim shuki, siz ishonishingizni xohlayman. Nimaga ishonish? Siz ishonolmaydigan narsalarga ishonish.

en: I heard once of an American who so deﬁned faith, `that fac ulty which enables us to believe things which we know to be untrue.' For one, I follow that man.
uz: Men bir marta bir amerikalik kishining imonni shunday belgilaganini eshitgan edim, ` bu biz yolg'on deb bilgan narsalarga ishonishga imkon beradigan ultijoqlik. ' Birinchidan, men bu odamga ergashaman.

en: He meant that we shall have an open mind, and not let a little bit of truth check the rush of the big truth, like a small rock does a railway truck.
uz: Uning aytishicha, biz ochiq ongga ega bo'lishimiz kerak va bir oz haqiqat katta haqiqatning shovqinini to'xtatishiga yo'l qo'ymasligimiz kerak, xuddi kichik tosh temir yo'l yuk mashinasini to'xtatganidek.

en: We get the small truth ﬁrst.
uz: Avval biz kichik haqiqatni bilib olamiz.

en: We keep him, and we value him, but all the same we must not let him think himself all the truth in the universe. Then you want me not to let some previous conviction inure the recep- tivity of my mind with regard to some strange matter.
uz: Biz uni saqlaymiz va qadrlaymiz, lekin biz unga koinotdagi barcha haqiqatlarni o'zi o'ylab topishiga yo'l qo'ymasligimiz kerak.

en: Do I read your lesson aright? Ah, you are my favorite pupil still.
uz: Darsingizni to'g'ri o'qidimmi? - A, siz hali ham mening sevimli o'quvchimsiz.

en: It is worth to teach you.
uz: Bu sizga o'rgatishga arziydi.

en: Now that you are willing to understand, you have taken the ﬁrst step to understand.
uz: Endi siz tushunishga tayyor ekansiz, siz tushunish uchun birinchi qadam qo'ygansiz.

en: You think then that those so small holes in the children's throats were made by the same that made the holes in Miss Lucy? I suppose so. He stood up and said solemnly, Then you are wrong.
uz: Shunday qilib, bolalarning bo'ynidagi o'sha kichkina teshiklar Miss Lusiyaning teshiklarini qilganlar tomonidan yaratilgan deb o'ylaysizmi? - deb o'ylaysiz. - O'ylayman. - O'rnidan turib, tantanali ravishda dedi: O'shanda siz noto'g'ri.

en: Oh, would it were so!
uz: Oh, shunday bo'lsa edi!

en: It is worse, far, far worse. In God's name, Professor Van Helsing, what do you mean? I cried.
uz: Bu yanada og'irroq, ancha og'irroq. - Alloh nomiga qasam, professor Van Helsing, nima demoqchisiz? - deb yig'ladim.

en: He threw himself with a despairing gesture into a chair, and placed his elbows on the table, covering his face with his hands as he spoke.
uz: U o'zini tushkunlik bilan o'rinbosarga tashladi va qo'lboshlarini stol ustiga qo'yib, yuzini qo'llari bilan qopladi.

en: They were made by Miss Lucy!
uz: Ularni Miss Lucy yaratgan!

en: For a while sheer anger mastered me.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida g'azab meni boshqardi.

en: It was as if he had during her life struck Lucy on the face.
uz: O'sha paytda u Luziyning yuziga urgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: I smote the table hard and rose up as I said to him, Dr.
uz: Men stolni qattiq urdim va unga: Dr.

en: Van Helsing, are you mad? He raised his head and looked at me, and somehow the tenderness of his face calmed me at once.
uz: U boshini ko'tarib menga qaradi va bir yo'l bilan uning yuzining sezgirligi meni darhol tinchlantiradi.

en: Would I were! he said.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lardim! - dedi u.

en: Madness were easy to bear compared with truth like this.
uz: Bu kabi haqiqat bilan taqqoslaganda, aqlsizlikni ko'tarish oson edi.

en: Oh, my friend, whey, think you, did I go so far round, why take so long to tell so simple a thing?
uz: Oh, do'stim, sovg'a, o'zing o'ylaysanmi, men shuncha uzoq borganmanmi, nega shuncha vaqt o'tkazib, bunday sodda narsani aytishga majbur bo'ldim?

en: Was it because I hate you and have hated you all my life?
uz: Sizdan nafratlanganim va butun hayotim davomida nafratlanganim uchunmi?

en: Was it because I wished to give you pain?
uz: Men sizga og'riq berishni xohlaganim uchunmi?

en: Was it that I wanted, no so late, revenge for that time when you saved my life, and from a fearful death?
uz: Axir men o'sha payt uchun qasos olishni xohlagan edim-ku, chunki siz mening hayotimni va qo'rqinchli o'limdan qutqardingiz?

en: Ah no! Forgive me, said I.
uz: Ah, yo'q! - dedim men.

en: He went on, My friend, it was because I wished to be gentle in the breaking to you, for I know you have loved that so sweet lady.
uz: U davom etdi: Dostim, bu men sen bilan bo'lishda muloyim bo'lishni istaganim uchun edi, chunki men bilamanki, sen o'sha sevimli xotinni sevgan eding.

en: But even yet I do not expect you to believe.
uz: Ammo shunga qaramay, siz ishonishingizni kutmayman.

en: It is so hard to accept at once any abstract truth, that we may doubt such to be possible when we have always believed the `no' of it.
uz: Hech qanday ma'lum haqiqatni birdan qabul qilish shunchalik qiyinki, biz har doim uning yo'qligiga ishonib kelganimizda, bunday haqiqatning iloji yo'qligiga shubha qilishimiz mumkin.

en: It is more hard still to accept so sad a concrete truth, and of such a one as Miss Lucy.
uz: Bunday qayg'uli aniq haqiqatni va Miss Lucy kabi haqiqatni qabul qilish hali ham qiyinroq.

en: Tonight I go to prove it.
uz: Bugun uni isbotlash uchun boraman.

en: Dare you come with me? This staggered me.
uz: Men bilan birga kelishga jur'at qilasanmi? - degan savol meni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: A man does not like to prove such a truth, Byron ex- cepted from the catagory, jealousy.
uz: Odam bunday haqiqatni isbotlashni yoqtirmaydi, Byron katagoriyadan ozod bo'lgan, hasad.

en: And prove the very truth he most abhorred. He saw my hesitation, and spoke, The logic is simple, no madman's log- ic this time, jumping from tussock to tussock in a misty bog.
uz: U mening shubhaimni ko'rib, shunday dedi: Logika sodda, bu safar aqldan ozgan odamning logisi yo'q.

en: If it not be true, then proof will be relief.
uz: Agar bu haqiqat bo'lmasa, demak, dalil yengillik bo'ladi.

en: At worst it will not harm.
uz: Eng yomon holatda esa bu zarar keltirmaydi.

en: Ah, there is the dread.
uz: Ah, qo'rquv bor.

en: Yet every dread should help my cause, for in it is some need of belief.
uz: Biroq, har bir qo'rquv mening maqsadimga yordam berishi kerak, chunki unga ishonish kerak.

en: Come, I tell you what I propose.
uz: Keling, men sizga nima taklif qilayotganimni aytaman.

en: First, that we go off now and see that child in the hospital.
uz: Birinchidan, hozir borib, kasalxonada o'sha bolani ko'ramiz.

en: Vincent, of the North Hospital, where the papers say the child is, is a friend of mine, and I think of yours since
uz: North kasalxonasining Vinsent ismli do'sti mening do'stimdir va men sizning do'stingiz haqida o'ylayman.

en: you were in class at Amsterdam.
uz: Siz Amsterdamda sinfda o'qigansiz.

en: He will let two scientists see his case, if he will not let two friends.
uz: Agar ikki do'stiga yo'l qo'ymasa, u ikki olimga o'z da'volarini ko'rishga ruxsat beradi.

en: We shall tell him nothing, but only that we wish to learn.
uz: Biz unga hech narsa aytmaymiz, faqat o'rganishni istagan narsamizni aytamiz.

en: And then …  And then? He took a key from his pocket and held it up.
uz: Va keyin... Undan keyin? deb javob berdi.

en: And then we spend the night, you and I, in the churchyard where Lucy lies.
uz: Shuning o'rniga, biz o'zimiz bilan Lutsining yotgan qabristonida kechani o'tkazamiz.

en: This is the key that lock the tomb.
uz: Bu qabrning kaliti.

en: I had it from the cofﬁn man to give to Arthur. My heart sank within me, for I felt that there was some fearful ordeal be- fore us.
uz: Men uni Arturga berish uchun jasad odamidan olgan edim. Qalbim ichimda g'alaba qozondi, chunki oldimizda qo'rqinchli bir sinov borligini his qildim.

en: I could do nothing, however, so I plucked up what heart I could and said that we had better hasten, as the afternoon was passing.
uz: Biroq, men hech narsa qila olmasdim, shuning uchun qo'limdan kelganicha ko'nglimni yig'ib, kechki payt o'tib ketayotgan ekan, shoshilib ketishimiz kerakligini aytdim.

en: We found the child awake.
uz: Bola uyg'onib qolganini topdik.

en: It had had a sleep and taken some food, and altogether was going on well.
uz: U uxlab, ovqat oldi va umuman yaxshi o'tdi.

en: Dr, Vincent took the bandage from its throat, and showed us the punctures.
uz: Doktor Vinsent uning bo'ynidagi bandajni olib, buzilishlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: There was no mistaking the similarity to those which had been on Lucy's throat.
uz: Luusiyning bo'yniga tushirilganlar bilan o'xshashligi aniq edi.

en: They were smaller, and the edges looked fresher, that was all.
uz: Ular kichikroq edi va chekkasi yangi ko'rinardi.

en: We asked Vincent to what he attributed them, and he replied that it must have been a bite of some animal, perhaps a rat, but for his own part, he was inclined to think it was one of the bats which are so numerous on the northern heights of London.
uz: Biz Vinsentdan ularga nima sababini so'rashganimizda, u bu hayvonning, ehtimol, podshohning urishi bo'lishi kerakligini aytdi, ammo u o'zi uchun Londondagi shimoliy tog'larda juda ko'p bo'lgan to'qnashuvlardan biri deb o'ylashga moyil edi.

en: Out of so many harmless ones, he said, there may be some wild specimen from the South of a more malignant species.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bu ko'pgina zararsiz hayvonlardan, Janubiy Afrikadan bir nechta yovvoyi namuna paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Some sailor may have brought one home, and it man- aged to escape, or even from the Zoological Gardens a young one may have got loose, or one be bred there from a vampire.
uz: Ehtimol, bir dengizchi uni uyga olib kelgan bo'lsa, u qochib ketish uchun odam bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin, yoki hatto Zoologik bog'lardan yosh bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin, yoki u erda bir vampir tomonidan o'stirilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: These things do occur, you, know.
uz: Bunday narsalar sodir bo'ladi.

en: Only ten days ago a wolf got out, and was, I believe, traced up in this direction.
uz: Faqat o'n kun oldin bir bo'ri chiqib, shu yo'nalishda izlangan deb o'ylayman.

en: For a week after, the children were playing nothing but Red Rid- ing Hood on the Heath and in every alley in the place until this `bloofer lady' scare came along, since then it has been quite a gala time with them.
uz: Bir hafta davomida bolalar Heathda va u yerdagi har bir ko'chada Qizil qo'riqchi kabutdan boshqa hech narsa o'ynamaydilar, o'sha paytdan beri ular bilan juda katta bayram bo'lib kelgan bu `bloofer xonimning qo'rquvi paydo bo'lgunga qadar.

en: Even this poor little mite, when he woke up today, asked the nurse if he might go away.
uz: Hatto bu kambag'al kichkinagina maydonchi ham bugun uyg'onganida, hamshiraga ketish mumkinligini so'radi.

en: When she asked him why he wanted to go, he said he want- ed to play with the `bloofer lady'. I hope, said Van Helsing, that when you are sending the child home you will caution its parents to keep strict watch over it.
uz: U undan nima uchun borishni xohlayotganini so'raganida, u `bloofer xonim bilan o'ynashni xohlayotganini aytdi. Umid qilamanki, - dedi Van Helsing, - bolani uyga yuborganingizda uning ota-onasini qattiq kuzatib turishga ogohlantirasiz.

en: These fancies to stray are most dangerous, and if the child were to remain out another night, it would probably be fatal.
uz: Bu yo'ldan adashishning o'ziga xos xususiyatlari juda xavfli va agar bola yana bir kecha tashqarida qolsa, bu o'limga olib kelishi mumkin.

en: But in any case I suppose you will not let it away for some days? Certainly not, not for a week at least, longer if the wound is not healed. Our visit to the hospital took more time than we had reckoned on, and the sun had dipped before we came out.
uz: Ammo hech bo'lmaganda, bir necha kun davomida uni qo'yib yubormaysiz deb o'ylaymanmi? - Agar yarasi sog'aymasa, hech bo'lmaganda bir hafta davomida emas, balki ko'proq vaqt davom etadi. Shifoxonaga tashrif buyurish biz o'ylagandan ko'ra ko'proq vaqtni talab qildi va quyosh chiqishdan oldin botgan edi.

en: When Van Helsing saw how dark it
uz: Van Helsing qanday qorong'i bo'lganini ko'rganida

en: was, he said, There is not hurry.
uz: U shunday dedi: Biror shoshilmang.

en: It is more late than I thought.
uz: Men o'ylagandan ko'ra kechroq.

en: Come, let us seek somewhere that we may eat, and then we shall go on our way. We dined at `Jack Straw's Castle' along with a little crowd of bicyclists and others who were genially noisy.
uz: Kelinglar, ovqatlanish uchun biron joy izlaylik, so'ngra yo'limizni davom ettiramiz. Biz `Jack Straw's Castle'da kichkina velosipedchilar va aql bovar qilmaydigan boshqa shovqinlar bilan birga ovqatlandik.

en: About ten o'clock we started from the inn.
uz: Taxminan o'n soatdan keyin mehmonxonadan boshladik.

en: It was then very dark, and the scattered lamps made the darkness greater when we were once outside their individual radius.
uz: O'sha paytda juda qorong'i edi va tarqalgan chiroqlar biz ularning individual radiusidan tashqarida bo'lganimizda qorong'ilikni yanada kuchaytirardi.

en: The Professor had evidently noted the road we were to go, for he went on unhesitatingly, but, as for me, I was in quite a mixup as to locality.
uz: Professor biz boradigan yo'lni aniq ko'rib qo'ygan edi, chunki u hech ikkilanmasdan davom etdi, lekin men joy haqida juda chalg'ib qoldim.

en: As we went further, we met fewer and fewer people, till at last we were somewhat surprised when we met even the patrol of horse police going their usual suburban round.
uz: Keyinroq borganimiz sayin, ko'proq odamlar bilan uchrashdik, oxir-oqibat, hatto shahar atrofidagi odatdagi turlarini o'tayotgan ot policiyasi bilan uchrashganimizda biroz hayron qoldik.

en: At last we reached the wall of the churchyard, which we climbed over.
uz: Nihoyat, cherkov hovlisining devorlariga yetib keldik va undan o'tar edik.

en: With some little difﬁculty, for it was very dark, and the whole place seemed so strange to us, we found the Westenra tomb.
uz: Ko'p qorong'ilik va butun joy bizga shunchalik g'alati tuyulgani uchun, oz og'irlik bilan Vestenra qabrini topdik.

en: The Professor took the key, opened the creaky door, and standing back, politely, but quite unconscious- ly, motioned me to precede him.
uz: Professor kalitni olib, eshikni ochdi va o'zini pastga qo'yib, xushmuomala bo'lib, ammo o'z hissiyotini yo'qotmay, o'ziga oldindan ketishimni isbotladi.

en: There was a delicious irony in the offer, in the courtliness of giving preference on such a ghastly occasion.
uz: Taklifda mazali ironika bor edi, bunday dahshatli hodisalarda afzallikni berishning xushmuomalaligi.

en: My com- panion followed me quickly, and cautiously drew the door to, after carefully ascertaining that the lock was a falling, and not a spring one.
uz: Kompaniyam tezda menga ergashib, eshikni ehtiyotkorlik bilan olib chiqdi va qulfning bosqichi emas, tushayotganini aniqladi.

en: In the latter case we should have been in a bad plight.
uz: Ikkinchi holatda biz yomon ahvolda bo'lishimiz kerak edi.

en: Then he fumbled in his bag, and taking out a matchbox and a piece of candle, proceeded to make a light.
uz: So'ngra u sumkasida o'tirib, chiroqlar qutisini va chiroqni olib chiqib, yorug'likni yaratdi.

en: The tomb in the daytime, and when wreathed with fresh ﬂowers, had looked grim and gruesome enough, but now, some days afterwards, when the ﬂow- ers hung lank and dead, their whites turning to rust and their greens to browns, when the spider and the beetle had resumed their accustomed dom- inance, when the time-discolored stone, and dust-encrusted mortar, and rusty, dank iron, and tarnished brass, and clouded silver-plating gave back the feeble glimmer of a candle, the effect was more miserable and sordid than could have been imagined.
uz: Quyosh paytida va yangi gullar bilan to'ldirilganda qabr juda qorong'i va dahshatli ko'rinardi, lekin endi bir necha kun o'tgach, daraxtlar ko'tarilganda, oqlari rangga aylanib, yashillari rangga aylanganida, o'g'irlari rangga aylanganida, o'zlarining odatdagi mavqeyini qo'lga kiritganida, zamonning rangini o'zgartirgan tosh va chang bilan o'zgartirilgan mortar, rangga aylangan, suyuq temir, qora mis va bulutli kumush qoplamalar shamolning samarasi bilan qaytarilganida, ta'sir o'ylagandan ko'ra ko'proq qashshoq va nopok bo'ldi.

en: It conveyed irresistibly the idea that life, animal life, was not the only thing which could pass away.
uz: Bu hayvonni, hayvonot hayotni, o'tish mumkin bo'lgan yagona narsa emas degan g'oyani o'z ichiga olgan.

en: Van Helsing went about his work systematically.
uz: Van Helsing o'z ishini muntazam ravishda amalga oshirdi.

en: Holding his candle so that he could read the cofﬁn plates, and so holding it that the sperm dropped in white patches which congealed as they touched the metal, he made assur- ance of Lucy's cofﬁn.
uz: Uning shamolini ushlab, ko'krak plakatlarini o'qishi mumkin bo'lgan holda ushlab, spermatozoidlar metallga qo'ng'iroq qilganida to'qnashgan oq maydalar bo'lib tushishi mumkin bo'lgan tarzda ushlab, u Lusiyning ko'krakidan shubhalandi.

en: Another search in his bag, and he took out a turnscrew.
uz: Uning sumkasida yana bir marta qidiruv bo'lib, u bir to'ntarma qudratni olib chiqdi.

en: What are you going to do? I asked.
uz: Men: Siz nima qilmoqchisiz? - deb so'radim.

en: You shall yet be convinced.
uz: Siz hali ham shubhalanasiz.

en: Straightway he began taking out the screws, and ﬁnally lifted off the lid, showing the casing of lead beneath.
uz: To'g'ri yo'l bilan u burchaklarni olib chiqishni boshladi va nihoyat qopqog'ini ko'tardi va uning pastidagi oltin qoplamasini ko'rsatdi.

en: The sight was almost too much for me.
uz: Bu ko'rinish men uchun juda ko'p edi.

en: It seemed to be as much an affront to the dead as it would have been to have stripped off her clothing in her sleep whilst living.
uz: O'lganlarga nisbatan bu xuddi o'zidan o'g'ri, tirik bo'lganida uyqusida kiyim-kechaklarini yo'q qilib qo'yish kabi haqoratdek tuyulardi.

en: I actually took hold of his hand to stop him.
uz: Aslida men uni to'xtatish uchun qo'lidan ushlab qoldim.

en: He only said, You shall see,and again fumbling in his bag took out a tiny fret saw.
uz: U faqat: Ko'rasiz, - deb aytdi va yana sumkasida o'tirib, kichkina fret pichoqini chiqardi.

en: Striking the turnscrew through the lead with a swift downward stab, which made me wince, he made a small hole, which was, however, big enough to admit the point of the saw.
uz: O'g'lim o'g'irlab, o'g'irlab o'tadigan bo'g'irni tezlik bilan pastga tashlab, u o'ziga o'g'ir bo'lgan kichik cho'g'ni yaratdi, ammo u o'g'ir bo'lib, pichoqning nuqtasini ko'rsatishga qodir edi.

en: I had expected a rush of gas from the week-old corpse.
uz: Men bir haftalik jasaddan gaz to'kilishini kutgan edim.

en: We doctors, who have had to study our dangers, have to become accustomed to such things, and I drew back towards the door.
uz: Biz, shifokorlar, xavf-xatarlarni o'rganishga majbur bo'lganmiz, bu kabi narsalarga odatlanib qolishimiz kerak, shuning uchun men eshik tomon orqaga qaytdim.

en: But the Professor never stopped for a moment.
uz: Ammo professor bir zum ham to'xtamaydi.

en: He sawed down a couple of feet along one side of the lead cofﬁn, and then across, and down the other side.
uz: U bir tomondan bir necha metr pichoq quti, so'ngra boshqa tomondan o'tib, boshqa tomondan o'tib ketadi.

en: Taking the edge of the loose ﬂange, he bent it back towards the foot of the cofﬁn, and holding up the candle into the aperture, motioned to me to look.
uz: U bo'sh flansning chegaralarini olib, jasad quti oyoqlariga qaytarib qo'ydi va shamolni ochkoqqa ko'tarib, menga ko'rishga ishora qildi.

en: I drew near and looked.
uz: Men yaqinlashdim va ko'rdim.

en: The cofﬁn was empty.
uz: Qovus bo'sh edi.

en: It was certainly a surprise to me, and gave me a considerable shock, but Van Helsing was unmoved.
uz: Bu men uchun ajablantiruvchi voqea bo'ldi va meni sezilarli darajada hayratda qoldirdi, ammo Van Helsing o'zini qo'zg'atmadi.

en: He was now more sure than ever of his ground, and so emboldened to pro- ceed in his task.Are you satisﬁed now, friend John? he asked.
uz: Endi u o'z mavqeidan har qachongidan ko'ra ko'proq ishonch hosil qildi va o'z vazifasini davom ettirish uchun jasoratga ega edi. Siz endi mamnunmisiz, do'stim Jon? - deb so'radi u.

en: I felt all the dogged argumentativeness of my nature awake within me as I answered him, I am satisﬁed that Lucy's body is not in that cofﬁn, but that only proves one thing. And what is that, friend John? That it is not there. That is good logic, he said, so far as it goes.
uz: Lusiyning jasadi shu ko'krak ichida emasligiga ishonaman, lekin bu faqat bir narsani isbotlaydi, deb javob berganimda, o'zimda o'z tabiatimning barcha qat'iy bahslashadiganligini his qildim. Va bu nima, do'stim Jon? U erda emasligi. Bu yaxshi mantiqaning bir qismi, dedi u, bu borgan sari.

en: But how do you, how can you, account for it not being there? Perhaps a body-snatcher, I suggested.
uz: Ammo qanday qilib siz uning u erda bo'lmasligini tushuntira olasiz? - deb aytdim men.

en: Some of the undertaker's people may have stolen it. I felt that I was speaking folly, and yet it was the only real cause which I could suggest.
uz: Ba'zilar uni o'g'irlagan bo'lishi mumkin. Men aqlsizlik qilyapman deb o'ylardim, ammo bu men taklif qila oladigan yagona haqiqiy sabab edi.

en: The Professor sighed.
uz: Professor nafas oldi.

en: Ah well! he said, we must have more proof.
uz: A, yaxshi! - dedi u, - bizda ko'proq dalillar bo'lishi kerak.

en: Come with me. He put on the cofﬁn lid again, gathered up all his things and placed them in the bag, blew out the light, and placed the candle also in the bag.
uz: Men bilan kel! - deb so'raganida, u yana qabrni o'rnatdi, hamma narsalarini to'pladi va sumkaga qo'ydi, yorug'likni o'chirib qo'ydi va shamolni ham sumkaga qo'ydi.

en: We opened the door, and went out.
uz: Biz eshikni ochib, tashqariga chiqdik.

en: Behind us he closed the door and locked it.
uz: U ortimizdan eshikni yopib, qulflab qo'ydi.

en: He handed me the key, saying, Will you keep it?
uz: U menga kalitni berdi va: O'zingda saqlay olasizmi?

en: You had better be assured.
uz: Sizga ishonch hosil qilish yaxshidir.

en: I laughed, it was not a very cheerful laugh, I am bound to say, as I mo- tioned him to keep it.
uz: Men kulganman, bu juda quvonchli kulgi emas edi, albatta aytaman, chunki men unga uni saqlab qolishni maslahat berdim.

en: A key is nothing, I said, thee are many duplicates, and anyhow it is not difﬁcult to pick a lock of this kind. He said nothing, but put the key in his pocket.
uz: Kilt hech narsa emas, dedim men, bu ko'plab nusxadir va shunga o'xshab qulfni tanlash qiyin emas. U hech narsa aytmadi, lekin kalitni qopqoqlariga qo'ydi.

en: Then he told me to watch at one side of the churchyard whilst he would watch at the other.
uz: Keyin u menga cherkov hovlisining bir tomoniga qarab turishimni, u esa boshqa tomonga qarab turishini aytdi.

en: I took up my place behind a yew tree, and I saw his dark ﬁgure move un- til the intervening headstones and trees hid it from my sight.
uz: O'z o'rnimni bir o'simlik orqasidan oldim va uning qorong'i figurasini ko'rdim, hatto o'zaro bog'langan qabr toshlari va daraxtlar uni ko'zimdan yashirib qo'ydi.

en: It was a lonely vigil.
uz: Bu yolg'izlik paytida edi.

en: Just after I had taken my place I heard a distant clock strike twelve, and in time came one and two.
uz: O'zimning o'rnimni egallab olganimdan so'ng, uzoqdagi soat o'n ikkiga o'tishini eshitdim va vaqt o'tib, bir va ikkiga o'tdi.

en: I was chilled and unnerved, and angry with the Professor for taking me on such an errand and with myself for coming.
uz: Men sovuq va g'azabga to'ldim va professor meni bunday topshiriqlarga olib ketgani uchun va kelgani uchun o'zimdan g'azablandim.

en: I was too cold and too sleepy to be keenly observant, and not sleepy enough to betray my trust, so altogether I had a dreary, miserable time.
uz: Men juda sovuq va uyqusiz edim, shuning uchun diqqat bilan kuzatib turish uchun, ishonchimga xiyonat qilish uchun yetarlicha uyqusiz emas edim, shuning uchun men umuman noxush, ayanchli vaqtni o'tkazdim.

en: Suddenly, as I turned round, I thought I saw something like a white streak, moving between two dark yew trees at the side of the churchyard farthest from the tomb.
uz: Birdan o'zimni aylantirganimda, qabrdan eng uzoqda joylashgan cherkov hovlisining yonida joylashgan ikkita qorong'i g'iybat daraxtlari o'rtasida o'tgan oq chiziqga o'xshaydigan narsani ko'rganimni his qildim.

en: At the same time a dark mass moved from the Pro- fessor's side of the ground, and hurriedly went towards it.
uz: Shu bilan birga, qorong'i bir massasi Pro-fessorning yer tomoniga ko'tarildi va shoshilinch ravishda unga yo'naltirdi.

en: Then I too moved, but I had to go round headstones and railed-off tombs, and I stum- bled over graves.
uz: Keyin men ham ko'chib o'tdim, lekin qabr toshlari va ko'tarilgan qabrlar atrofida o'tishim kerak edi va qabrlar ustida to'xtab qoldim.

en: The sky was overcast, and somewhere far off an early cock crew.
uz: Osmon bulutli edi va bir joyda erta pichoq ekipajidan uzoqda edi.

en: A little ways off, beyond a line of scattered juniper trees, which marked the pathway to the church, a white dim ﬁgure ﬂitted in the direction of the tomb.
uz: Bir oz uzoqlikda, cherkovga yo'lni belgilagan tarqalgan juniper daraxtlari qatoridan o'tgach, oq rangli figura qabr tomon o'zboshdi.

en: The tomb itself was hidden by trees, and I could not see where the ﬁgure had disappeared.
uz: Qabrning o'zi daraxtlar tomonidan yashirilgan edi va men suratning qaerda yo'qolganini ko'rmadim.

en: I heard the rustle of actual movement where I had ﬁrst seen the white ﬁgure, and coming over, found the Professor hold- ing in his arms a tiny child.
uz: O'sha oq shaxsni birinchi marta ko'rganimda, haqiqiy harakatning shov-shuvini eshitdim va yaqinlashganda, professorning qo'llarida kichkina bola ko'targanini ko'rdim.

en: When he saw me he held it out to me, and said, Are you satisﬁed now? No, I said, in a way that I felt was aggressive.
uz: U meni ko'rganida, menga ko'tarib: Siz endi mamnunmisiz? - deb so'radi.

en: Do you not see the child? Yes, it is a child, but who brought it here?
uz: - Bolani ko'rmayapsanmi? - deb so'radi. - Ha, bola, lekin uni bu yerga kim olib keldi?

en: And is it wounded? We shall see,said the Professor, and with one impulse we took our way out of the churchyard, he carrying the sleeping child.
uz: Va u jarohatlanganmi? - Biz ko'ramiz, - dedi professor va bir qadam qo'yib, u uxlayotgan bolani ko'tarib, cho'ponxonadan chiqdik.

en: When we had got some little distance away, we went into a clump of trees, and struck a match, and looked at the child's throat.
uz: Bir oz uzoqda bo'lganimizdan so'ng, daraxtlar to'pasiga tushib, o'q o'yinchoq ushlab, bolaning bo'yniga qaradik.

en: It was without a scratch or scar of any kind.
uz: U hech qanday jarohat yoki jarohatsiz edi.

en: Was I right? I asked triumphantly.
uz: Men to'g'ri edimmi? - deb so'radim men g'alaba qozonib.

en: We were just in time, said the Professor thankfully.
uz: Biz o'z vaqtida keldik, - dedi professor minnatdorchilik bilan.

en: We had now to decide what we were to do with the child, and so consult- ed about it.
uz: Endi bola bilan nima qilishimiz kerakligini hal qilishimiz kerak edi va bu haqda maslahatlashishimiz kerak edi.

en: If we were to take it to a police station we should have to give
uz: Agar uni politsiya bo'limlariga olib ketish kerak bo'lsa, uni berishimiz kerak.

en: some account of our movements during the night.
uz: Kechasi harakatlarimiz haqida ba'zi ma'lumotlar mavjud.

en: At least, we should have had to make some statement as to how we had come to ﬁnd the child.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, bolani qanday topganimiz to'g'risida ba'zi bir ma'lumot berishimiz kerak edi.

en: So ﬁnally we decided that we would take it to the Heath, and when we heard a policeman coming, would leave it where he could not fail to ﬁnd it.
uz: Shunday qilib, nihoyat biz uni Heathga olib borishga qaror qildik va politsiyachi kelayotganini eshitganimizda uni topib bo'lmaydigan joyga qoldirardik.

en: We would then seek our way home as quickly as we could.
uz: Keyin biz imkon qadar tezroq uyga boramiz.

en: At the edge of Hampstead Heath we heard a policeman's heavy tramp, and lay- ing the child on the pathway, we waited and watched until he saw it as he ﬂashed his lantern to and fro.
uz: Hampstead heytining chegaralarida bir politsiyachining og'ir qichqiriqlarini eshitdik va bola yo'lda yotganini ko'rib, uni ko'rmaguncha, o'z lanternini yonib-yotganini kutdik va kuzatib turdik.

en: We heard his exclamation of astonishment, and then we went away silently.
uz: Biz uning hayratda qolgan ovozini eshitdik va so'ngra xotirjamlik bilan ketdik.

en: By good chance we got a cab near the `Spainiards,' and drove to town.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, biz `Spainiards yaqinida taksiga tushib, shaharga bordik.

en: I cannot sleep, so I make this entry.
uz: Men uxlay olmayman, shuning uchun ushbu yozuvni kiritaman.

en: But I must try to get a few hours' sleep, as Van Helsing is to call for me at noon.
uz: Ammo men bir necha soat uxlashga harakat qilishim kerak, chunki Van Helsing meni tushda chaqiradi.

en: He insists that I go with him on another expedition.
uz: U yana bir safar u bilan birga ketishimni istaydi.

en: 27 September.—It was two o'clock before we found a suitable opportuni- ty for our attempt.
uz: 27 sentabr.Biz o'z urinishimiz uchun qulay fursatni topishdan oldin soat ikki edi.

en: The funeral held at noon was all completed, and the last stragglers of the mourners had taken themselves lazily away, when, looking carefully from behind a clump of alder trees, we saw the sexton lock the gate after him.
uz: Tush paytida o'tkazilgan dafn marosimi to'liq yakunlangan edi va qayg'u chekayotganlarning oxirgi to'xtovchilari o'zlarini kemagan holda olib ketishgan edilar, lekin biz bir to'plam o'simliklar orqasidan diqqat bilan qaraganimizda, sextonning uning orqasidan darvozani qulflab qo'yganini ko'rdik.

en: We knew that we were safe till morning did we desire it, but the Professor told me that we should not want more than an hour at most.
uz: Agar xohlasak, ertagacha xavfsiz bo'lishimizni bilardik, lekin professor menga eng ko'p bir soatdan ko'proq vaqtni xohlamasligimizni aytdi.

en: Again I felt that horrid sense of the reality of things, in which any effort of imagination seemed out of place, and I realized distinctly the perils of the law which we were incurring in our unhallowed work.
uz: Men yana o'sha dahshatli holni his qildim, chunki har qanday tasavvur qilishning o'rni yo'q edi va biz muqaddas bo'lmagan ishlarimizda duch kelayotgan qonunning xavf-xatarlarini aniq angladim.

en: Besides, I felt it was all so useless.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bularning hammasi menga befoyda edi.

en: Outrageous as it was to open a leaden cofﬁn, to see if a woman dead nearly a week were really dead, it now seemed the height of folly to open the tomb again, when we knew, from the evidence of our own eyesight, that the cofﬁn was empty.
uz: Tushdan yasalgan qovonni ochish, deyarli bir haftadan beri o'lgan ayolning o'limi yoki yo'qmiligini tekshirish naqadar dahshatli bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, endi qabrni yana ochish aqlsizlikning yuksakligi kabi ko'rinardi, chunki qovurning bo'shligini o'z ko'zimiz bilan ko'rganimiz sababli bilardik.

en: I shrugged my shoulders, however, and rested silent, for Van Helsing had a way of going on his own road, no matter who remonstrated.
uz: Biroq, men omon qoldim va sukut saqladim, chunki Van Helsingning o'z yo'lidan yurish usuli bor edi, kim qarshilik ko'rsatsa ham.

en: He took the key, opened the vault, and again courteously motioned me to precede.
uz: U kalitni olib, omborni ochdi va yana xushmuomalalik bilan oldindan ketishimga ishora qildi.

en: The place was not so gruesome as last night, but oh, how unutterably mean looking when the sunshine streamed in.
uz: Bu joy o'tgan kecha kabi dahshatli emas edi, lekin quyosh nurlari kirib kelganida, qahramonlik bilan ko'rish naqadar achinarli edi.

en: Van Helsing walked over to Lucy's cofﬁn, and I followed.
uz: Van Helsing Lusiyning qovoshiga yaqinlashdi va men uning orqasidan ergashdim.

en: He bent over and again forced back the leaden ﬂange, and a shock of surprise and dismay shot through me.
uz: U bir necha marta o'zini egib, o'tkir flensni qaytarib yubordi va meni hayronlik va qo'rqinch bilan hayratda qoldirdi.

en: There lay Lucy, seemingly just as we had seen her the night before her funeral.
uz: Shu yerda Luisi yotgan edi, xuddi uning dafnidan oldingi kecha uni ko'rganimizdek.

en: She was, if possible, more radiantly beautiful than ever, and I could not believe that she was dead.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, u har qachongidan ham chiroyli edi va men uning o'lganligiga ishonolmadim.

en: The lips were red, nay redder than before, and on the cheeks was a delicate bloom.
