uz: Og'izlar qizil, lekin avvalgidek qizilroq edi va yig'inlarida lazzatli gul bor edi.

en: Is this a juggle? I said to him.
uz: Men unga: Bular bir-biriga o'xshaydi, - deb aytdim.

en: Are you convinced now? said the Professor, in response, and as he spoke he put over his hand, and in a way that made me shudder, pulled back the dead lips and showed the white teeth.
uz: Professor javob qilib: Seni endi ishontiryapmanmi? - dedi va gapirganida qo'lini qo'ydi va meni titraydigan tarzda o'lik dudlarni orqaga tortib, oq tishlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: See, he went on,they are even sharper than before.
uz: Qaranglar, dedi u davom etib, ular avvalgidan ham keskinroq.

en: With this and this, and he touched one of the canine teeth and that below it, the little children can be bitten.
uz: Bu va bu bilan, - dedi u va itlarning bir tanasiga qo'l tegizdi va uning pastidagi kichik bolalarni urish mumkin.

en: Are you of belief now, friend John? Once more argumentative hostility woke within me.
uz: Endi ishonyapsanmi, do'stim Jon? - deb so'raganimda, ichimda yana bir bor bahsli dushmanlik uyg'ondi.

en: I could not accept such an overwhelming idea as he suggested.
uz: Men uning taklif qilgan g'oyalarini qabul qila olmasdim.

en: So, with an attempt to argue of which I was even at the moment ashamed, I said, She may have been placed here since last night. Indeed?
uz: Shunday qilib, men hozirda uyatga tushgan bahslashishga harakat qilib: Uni kechadan beri bu yerga joylashtirgan bo'lishi mumkin, - dedim.

en: That is so, and by whom? I do not know.
uz: Haqiqatan ham shunday va kim tomonidan? - Bila olmayman.

en: Someone has done it. And yet she has been dead one week.
uz: Kimdir buni qildi. Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, u bir hafta o'lgan.

en: Most peoples in that time would not look so. I had no answer for this, so was silent.
uz: O'sha davrdagi aksariyat odamlar bunday ko'rinmasdi. Men bunga javobim yo'q edi, shuning uchun men sukut tutdim.

en: Van Helsing did not seem to no- tice my silence.
uz: Van Helsing mening xotirjamligimni qabul qilmagandek tuyuldi.

en: At any rate, he showed neither chagrin nor triumph.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, u qayg'u ham, g'alaba ham ko'rsatmadi.

en: He was looking intently at the face of the dead woman, raising the eyelids and look- ing at the eyes, and once more opening the lips and examining the teeth.
uz: U o'lik ayolning yuziga diqqat bilan qaradi, ko'z toklarini ko'tarib, ko'zlarini ko'rib, yana bir bor og'izlarini ochadi va tishlarini tekshiradi.

en: Then he turned to me and said, Here, there is one thing which is different from all recorded.
uz: Keyin menga qarab: Mana, bir narsa bor, u barcha yozib olinganlardan farq qiladi.

en: Here is some dual life that is not as the common.
uz: Mana, ikki xil hayot, odatdagidek emas.

en: She was bitten by the vampire when she was in a trance, sleep-walking, oh, you start.
uz: U transda, uyqusida yurganida, vampir uni o'g'irlagan.

en: You do not know that, friend John, but you shall know it later, and in trance could he best come to take more blood.
uz: Siz buni bilmaysiz, do'stim Jon, lekin keyinroq bilib olasiz va transda u yana ko'proq qon olish uchun kelishi mumkin.

en: In trance she dies, and in trance she is Un-Dead, too.
uz: Transda u o'lib ketadi va transda u ham Un-Deaddir.

en: So it is that she differ from all other.
uz: Shunday qilib, u boshqalardan farq qiladi.

en: Usually when the Un-Dead sleep at home, as he spoke he made a comprehensive sweep of his arm to desig- nate what to a vampire was `home', their face show what they are, but this so sweet that was when she not Un-Dead she go back to the nothings of the common dead.
uz: Odatda, Un-Dead uyda uxlayotganda, - dedi u gapirganida, qo'lini to'liq ko'tardi va vampir uchun nima `home' ekanligini aniqladi, ularning yuzi nima ekanligini ko'rsatadi, ammo bu juda shirin edi, chunki u Un-Dead bo'lmaganida u oddiy o'liklarning hech narsalariga qaytadi.

en: There is no malign there, see, and so it make hard that I must kill her in her sleep. This turned my blood cold, and it began to dawn upon me that I was ac- cepting Van Helsing's theories.
uz: U yerda hech qanday zararli narsa yo'q, ko'ring, shuning uchun uni uyqusida o'ldirishim qiyin.  Bu mening qonimni sovuq qilib qo'ydi va men Van Helsing nazariyasini qabul qilayotganimni anglab yetdim.

en: But if she were really dead, what was there of terror in the idea of killing her?
uz: Ammo u haqiqatan ham o'lgan bo'lsa, uni o'ldirish g'oyasida nima qo'rqinch bor edi?

en: He looked up at me, and evidently saw the change in my face, for he said almost joyously, Ah, you believe now?
uz: U menga ko'z tikdi va ko'rinib turibdiki, yuzimda o'zgarishlar yuz berdi, chunki u deyarli quvonch bilan: Ah, endi ishonyapsanmi? - dedi.

en: I answered, Do not press me too hard all at once.
uz: Men unga: Menga bir vaqtning o'zida qattiq bosim o'tkazma.

en: I am willing to accept.
uz: Men qabul qilishga tayyorman.

en: How will you do this bloody work? I shall cut off her head and ﬁll her mouth with garlic, and I shall drive a stake through her body. It made me shudder to think of so mutilating the body of the woman whom I had loved.
uz: Men uning boshini kesib, og'zini sarimush bilan to'ldiraman va uning tanasiga cho'g'ini o'tkazaman, - deb aytdi.Men sevgan ayolning tanasini shunday jarohatlash haqida o'ylash meni dahshatga solgan.

en: And yet the feeling was not so strong as I had expected.
uz: Ammo bu his-tuyg'ular men kutib o'tganidek kuchli bo'lmagan.

en: I was, in fact, beginning to shudder at the presence of this being, this Un- Dead, as Van Helsing called it, and to loathe it.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men bu mavjudot, bu Van Helsing aytganidek, bu O'lmaydigan o'likning hozir bo'lishidan qo'rqib, undan nafratlanishni boshlagan edim.

en: Is it possible that love is all subjective, or all objective?
uz: Sevgining barchasi subyektiv yoki barchasi ob'ektiv bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: I waited a considerable time for Van Helsing to begin, but he stood as if wrapped in thought.
uz: Van Helsingni boshlashni ko'p vaqt kutdim, lekin u o'ylab ko'rmay turibdi.

en: Presently he closed the catch of his bag with a snap, and said, I have been thinking, and have made up my mind as to what is best.
uz: O'sha paytda u sumkasining to'plamini bir marta yopib, shunday dedi: Men o'yladim va nima eng yaxshi bo'lishi haqida qaror qildim.

en: If I did simply follow my inclining I would do now, at this moment, what is to be done.
uz: Agar men shunchaki o'z xohishimga amal qilsam, hozir, shu paytda nima qilish kerakligini bajarardim.

en: But there are other things to follow, and things that are thousand times more difﬁcult in that them we do not know.
uz: Ammo kuzatib boriladigan boshqa narsalar ham bor va ular biz bilmaganimiz sababli ming barobar qiyinroq.

en: She have yet no life taken, though that is of time, and to act now would be to take danger from her forever.
uz: Garchi bu vaqtning o'zi bo'lsa-da, u hali o'z hayotini yo'qotgan bo'lsa-da, hozir harakat qilish uning xavfini abadiy yo'q qilish demakdir.

en: But then we may have to want Arthur, and how shall we tell him of this?
uz: Ammo keyin Arturni xohlashimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin va unga buni qanday aytishimiz mumkin?

en: If you, who saw the wounds on Lucy's throat, and saw the wounds so similar on the child's at the hospital, if you, who saw the cofﬁn empty last night and full today with a woman who have not change only to be more rose and more beautiful in a whole week, after she die, if you know of this and know of the white ﬁgure last night that brought the child to the churchyard, and yet of your own senses you did not believe, how then, can I expect Arthur, who know none of those things, to believe?
uz: Agar siz, Lusiyaning bo'ynidagi yaralarni ko'rgan va kasalxonadagi bolaning yaralariga juda o'xshash yaralarni ko'rgan, agar siz, kecha shahardan bo'sh va bugun to'liq bo'lgan, o'limidan keyin bir hafta ichida o'zgarmagan ayol bilan o'zgargan bo'lsangiz, agar siz buni bilsangiz va o'tgan kecha bolaning qabriga olib kelgan oq suratni bilsangiz, ammo o'zingizning his-tuyg'ularingiz bilan ishonmagan bo'lsangiz, qanday qilib men bularning hech birini bilmaydigan Arturning ishonishini kutishim mumkin?

en: He doubted me when I took him from her kiss when she was dying.
uz: U o'lib ketayotganida, men uni o'g'limdan o'qib olganimda, u mendan shubhalanardi.

en: I know he has forgiven me because in some mistaken idea I have done things that prevent him say goodbye as he ought, and he may think that in some more mistaken idea this woman was buried alive, and that in most mistake of all we have killed her.
uz: U meni kechirganini bilaman, chunki men biron bir noto'g'ri fikrda unga salom bermaslikka to'sqinlik qilganim sababli, u yana bir noto'g'ri fikrda bu ayol tirik qilib ko'milgan deb o'ylashi mumkin va biz uni o'ldirib yubordik deb o'ylashi mumkin.

en: He will then argue back that it is we, mistaken ones, that have killed her by our ideas, and so he will be much unhappy al- ways.
uz: Keyin u, o'z fikrlarimiz bilan uni o'ldirganlar biz, noto'g'ri odamlar ekanmiz, deb javob beradi va shuning uchun u juda baxtsiz bo'ladi.

en: Yet he never can be sure, and that is the worst of all.
uz: Ammo u hech qachon aniq bo'lmaydi va bu eng yomon narsa.

en: And he will sometimes think that she he loved was buried alive, and that will paint his dreams with horrors of what she must have suffered, and again, he will think that we may be right, and that his so beloved was, after all, an Un- Dead.
uz: Va u ba'zan u sevgan ayol tirik ko'milgan deb o'ylaydi va bu uning tushlarini uning azob chekishi kerak bo'lgan dahshatlar bilan tasvirlaydi va yana, u biz haqimizda bo'lishimiz mumkinligini va uning sevikli bo'lganini o'ylaydi.

en: I told him once, and since then I learn much.
uz: Men unga bir marta aytdim va o'shandan beri ko'p narsalarni o'rgandim.

en: Now, since I know it is all true, a hundred thousand times more do I know that he must pass
uz: Endi, bularning barchasi haqiqat ekanligini bilaman, shuning uchun u o'tishi kerakligini yuz ming marta ko'proq bilaman.

en: through the bitter waters to reach the sweet.
uz: Qizil suvlardan o'tib, shirin suvga yetib borish uchun.

en: He, poor fellow, must have one hour that will make the very face of heaven grow black to him, then we can act for good all round and send him peace.
uz: U, kambag'al, osmonning o'ziga qarata qora bo'ladigan bir soatga ega bo'lishi kerak, shunda biz hamma joyda yaxshilik qilishimiz va unga tinchlik yuborishimiz mumkin.

en: You return home for tonight to your asylum, and see that all be well.
uz: Bugun kechqurun uyingizga qaytib, hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

en: As for me, I shall spend the night here in this churchyard in my own way.
uz: Men o'z yo'limda bu qabrda kecha o'tkazaman.

en: Tomor- row night you will come to me to the Berkeley Hotel at ten of the clock.
uz: Ertasi kecha soat o'nlarda Berkli mehmonxonasida mendan so'rashingiz mumkin.

en: I shall send for Arthur to come too, and also that so ﬁne young man of Amer- ica that gave his blood.
uz: Arturni ham, qonini bergani uchun Amerikaning o'sha go'zal yigitini ham chaqirtirib yuboraman.

en: Later we shall all have work to do.
uz: Keyinchalik hammamiz ish bilan band bo'lamiz.

en: I come with you so far as Piccadilly and there dine, for I must be back here before the sun set. So we locked the tomb and came away, and got over the wall of the churchyard, which was not much of a task, and drove back to Piccadilly.
uz: Men siz bilan Piccadillygacha boraman va u erda ovqatlanaman, chunki quyosh botishdan oldin bu yerga qaytishim kerak. Shunday qilib, qabrni qulflab, ketdik va chindan ham qiyin bo'lmagan cherkov hovlisi devoridan o'tib, Piccadillyga qaytib keldik.

en: NOTE LEFT BY VAN HELSING IN HIS PORTMANTEAU, BERKE- LEY HOTEL DIRECTED TO JOHN SEWARD, M.
uz: VAN HELSINGning portmanteauga qo'yilgan notasi, BERKE-Ley mehmonxonasida Jon Sewardga yo'naltirilgan.

en: (Not Delivered) 27 September Friend John, I write this in case anything should happen.
uz: 27 sentabr Do'stim Jon: Biror narsa bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan taqdirda ham, men buni yozyapman.

en: I go alone to watch in that churchyard.
uz: Men o'zim o'sha cho'riyning ichida kuzatib turishga boraman.

en: It pleases me that the Un-Dead, Miss Lucy, shall not leave tonight, that so on the morrow night she may be more eager.
uz: O'limsiz Miss Lucy bugun ketmasligi meni quvontiradi, ertangi kechada esa u yanada g'ayratli bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Therefore I shall ﬁx some things she like not, garlic and a cruciﬁx, and so seal up the door of the tomb.
uz: Shuning uchun men unga yoqmaydigan ba'zi narsalarni, jumladan, sarimush va xochni tuzataman va qabr eshikini muhrlayman.

en: She is young as Un-Dead, and will heed.
uz: U Un-Dead kabi yosh va diqqatli bo'ladi.

en: Moreover, these are only to prevent her coming out.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bular faqatgina uning tashqariga chiqishiga to'sqinlik qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

en: They may not prevail on her wanting to get in, for then the Un-Dead is desperate, and must ﬁnd the line of least re- sistance, whatsoever it may be.
uz: Ehtimol, ular uning kirishni istashida g'olib bo'lmaslar, chunki o'sha paytda Un-Dead umidsiz bo'ladi va eng kam bo'lgan cheklovni topishi kerak.

en: I shall be at hand all the night from sunset till after sunrise, and if there be aught that may be learned I shall learn it.
uz: Men quyosh botishidan quyosh chiqishgacha butun kecha yonimda bo'laman va agar biror narsa o'rganish mumkin bo'lsa, uni o'rganaman.

en: For Miss Lucy or from her, I have no fear, but that other to whom is there that she is Un-Dead, he have not the power to seek her tomb and ﬁnd shel- ter.
uz: Miss Lucy uchun ham, undan ham qo'rqmayman, lekin uning o'limidan qo'rqmagan kishi uning qabrini qidirib topishga va panoh topishga qodir emas.

en: He is cunning, as I know from Mr.
uz: Uning hiyla-nayranglari bor, men buni Mr.dan bilaman.

en: Jonathan and from the way that all along he have fooled us when he played with us for Miss Lucy's life, and we lost, and in many ways the Un-Dead are strong.
uz: Jonatan va Miss Lusi hayotini o'ynashda bizni aldashidan ko'ra, biz yo'qotdik va ko'p jihatdan Un-Dead kuchli.

en: He have always the strength in his hand of twenty men, even we four who gave our strength to Miss Lucy it also is all to him.
uz: U har doim yigirma kishining qo'lida kuchga ega bo'ladi, hatto biz to'rtta qiz Lusiga kuchimizni berganimizda ham, u uchun ham hamma narsa bor.

en: Besides, he can summon his wolf and I know not what.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u o'z bo'rilarini chaqirishi mumkin va nima ekanligini bilmayman.

en: So if it be that he came thither on this night he shall ﬁnd me.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar u bu kechada u yerga kelgan bo'lsa, meni topadi.

en: But none other shall, until it be too late.
uz: Ammo boshqa hech kim, agar kech bo'lmaguncha, bunday qilmaydi.

en: But it may be that he will not attempt the place.
uz: Ammo u o'sha joyni sinab ko'rmasligi mumkin.

en: There is no reason why he should.
uz: Buning uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q.

en: His hunting ground is more full of game than the churchyard where the Un-Dead woman sleeps, and the one old man watch.
uz: Uning ov qilish maydoni, Un-Dead ayol uxlayotgan va bitta keksa odam kuzatib turgan cho'rixonaga qaraganda ko'proq ovga to'lib-toshgan.

en: Therefore I write this in case … Take the papers that are with this, the diaries of Harker and the rest, and read them, and then ﬁnd this great Un- Dead, and cut off his head and burn his heart or drive a stake through it, so that the world may rest from him.
uz: Shu sababli men buni yozaman, agar... Harker va boshqalarning kundalik hayoti bilan bog'liq qog'ozlarni olib o'qinglar va ularni o'qinglar, keyin bu buyuk O'lmayotganni topinglar va uning boshini kesib, yuragini yondirib yuboringlar yoki o'z ichiga cho'g'ni o'tkazinglar, toki dunyo undan xotirjam bo'lsin.

en: If it be so, farewell.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, salom.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 28 September.—It is wonderful what a good night's sleep will do for one.
uz: SEWARDning 28 sentabr kuni yorlig'i.Bu yaxshi bir kecha uxlash uchun nima qilish mumkin ajoyib.

en: Yesterday I was almost willing to accept Van Helsing's monstrous ideas, but now they seem to start out lurid before me as outrages on common sense.
uz: Kecha men Van Helsingning dahshatli g'oyalarini qabul qilishga deyarli tayyor edim, lekin endi ular men uchun odat tusiga kirgan g'azablar sifatida dahshatli bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: I have no doubt that he believes it all.
uz: U hamma narsaga ishonishiga shubha yo'q.

en: I wonder if his mind can have become in any way unhinged.
uz: O'ylaymanki, uning ongini hech qanday tarzda o'zgartirmagan bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: Surely there must be some rational explanation of all these mysterious things.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu sirli narsalarning hammasi uchun biron bir oqilona tushuntirish bo'lishi kerak.

en: Is it possible that the Professor can have done it himself?
uz: Professor buni o'zi qilgan bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: He is so abnormally clever that if he went off his head he would carry out his intent with regard to some ﬁxed idea in a wonderful way.
uz: U shunchalik aqlliki, agar o'z ko'zidan ketsa, muayyan fikrni ajoyib tarzda amalga oshiradi.

en: I am loathe to think it, and indeed it would be almost as great a marvel as the other to ﬁnd that Van Helsing was mad, but anyhow I shall watch him care- fully.
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylashdan nafratlanaman va, albatta, Van Helsingning aqldan ozganini aniqlash boshqa bir ajoyibotdek ajoyib bo'lardi, lekin men uni qaysidir jihatdan diqqat bilan kuzatib turaman.

en: I may get some light on the mystery.
uz: Ehtimol, bu sirni tushunishga yordam beradi.

en: 29 September.—Last night, at a little before ten o'clock, Arthur and Quincey came into Van Helsing's room.
uz: 29 sentabr.Kechki kechasi soat o'ndan bir oz oldin Artur va Quincey Van Helsingning xonasiga kirishdi.

en: He told us all what he wanted us to do, but especially addressing himself to Arthur, as if all our wills were cen- tered in his.
uz: U bizdan nima qilishni xohlayotganini hammamizga aytib berdi, ayniqsa Arturga murojaat qilib, xuddi bizning barcha xohish-irodamiz uning o'zida bog'liq bo'lgani kabi.

en: He began by saying that he hoped we would all come with him too, for, he said, there is a grave duty to be done there.
uz: U boshida, biz ham o'zimiz bilan boramiz, deb umid qilgan, chunki u yerda jiddiy vazifalar bajarilishi kerakligini aytdi.

en: You were doubt- less surprised at my letter? This query was directly addressed to Lord Go- dalming.
uz: Siz mening maktubimdan shubhalanasizmi? deb so'raganida, bu savol to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Lord Go-dalmingga qaratilgan edi.

en: It rather upset me for a bit.
uz: Bu meni biroz xafa qildi.

en: There has been so much trouble around my house of late that I could do without any more.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda uyimda shunchalik ko'p muammolar bo'lganki, bundan buyon yo'q bo'lib ketishim mumkin edi.

en: I have been curi- ous, too, as to what you mean.
uz: Men ham nima demoqchi ekanligingizni bilardim.

en: Quincey and I talked it over, but the more we talked, the more puzzled we got, till now I can say for myself that I'm about up a tree as to any mean- ing about anything. Me too, said Quincey Morris laconically.
uz: Kvinsey va men bu haqda suhbatlashdik, ammo qancha ko'proq gapirsak, shuncha ko'proq g'alati bo'ldik, hozirgacha men o'zim uchun biror narsa haqida biron-bir ma'noga ega bo'lishim haqida o'ylayman deb ayta olaman. - Men ham shunday deb aytdim, - dedi Quincey Morris lakonik tarzda.

en: Oh, said the Professor, then you are nearer the beginning, both of you, than friend John here, who has to go a long way back before he can even get so far as to begin. It was evident that he recognized my return to my old doubting frame of mind without my saying a word.
uz: O, - dedi professor, - o'shanda siz ikkovingiz ham boshlanishga yaqinroqsiz, xolos, bu yerda do'stim Jon hali boshlanishiga qadar uzoq vaqt orqaga borishi kerak.

en: Then, turning to the other two, he said with intense gravity,
uz: So'ngra qolgan ikkitasiga qarab, u kuchli og'irlik bilan shunday dedi:

en: I want your permission to do what I think good this night.
uz: Bu kecha men yaxshi deb o'ylayotgan ishni bajarishga izningizni so'rayman.

en: It is, I know, much to ask, and when you know what it is I propose to do you will know, and only then how much.
uz: Bilaman, bu juda ko'p narsani so'rash kerak, va men nima qilishni taklif qilayotganimni bilganingizda, siz bilasiz va faqat o'shanda qancha.

en: Therefore may I ask that you promise me in the dark, so that afterwards, though you may be angry with me for a time, I must not disguise from myself the possibility that such may be, you shall not blame yourselves for anything. That's frank anyhow, broke in Quincey.
uz: Shunday qilib, sizdan so'rayman, menga zulmatda va'da beringlar, shunda keyinchalik menga biroz g'azablangan bo'lsangiz ham, bunday bo'lishi mumkinligini o'zimdan yashirmasligim kerak, siz hech narsada o'zingizni ayblamasligingiz kerak. - Hamma nima bo'lganda ham, bu rost, - dedi Quincey.

en: I'll answer for the Professor.
uz: Professor uchun javob beraman.

en: I don't quite see his drift, but I swear he's honest, and that's good enough for me. I thank you, Sir, said Van Helsing proudly.
uz: Men uning harakatini aniq tushunmayapman, lekin u rostgo'y bo'lishiga qasam ichaman va bu men uchun yetarlicha yaxshi. - Rahmat, efendim, dedi Van Helsing faxr bilan.

en: I have done myself the honor of counting you one trusting friend, and such endorsement is dear to me. He held out a hand, which Quincey took.
uz: Seni ishonchli do'st deb hisoblash sharafiga ega bo'ldim va bunday qo'llab-quvvatlash men uchun juda qadrlidir, - dedi u qo'lini uzatdi va Quincey uni oldi.

en: Then Arthur spoke out, Dr.
uz: Keyin Artur baland ovoz bilan: Dr.

en: Van Helsing, I don't quite like to `buy a pig in a poke', as they say in Scotland, and if it be anything in which my honour as a gentleman or my faith as a Christian is concerned, I cannot make such a promise.
uz: Van Helsing, men Shotlandiyada aytilishicha, to'qimaga cho'chqa sotib olishni yoqtirmayman va agar bu gentlemanlik sharafim yoki masihiylik e'tiqodim bilan bog'liq bo'lsa, men bunday va'da bera olmayman.

en: If you can assure me that what you intend does not violate either of these two, then I give my consent at once, though for the life of me, I cannot understand what you are driving at. I accept your limitation, said Van Helsing, and all I ask of you is that if you feel it necessary to condemn any act of mine, you will ﬁrst consider it well and be satisﬁed that it does not violate your reservations. Agreed! said Arthur.
uz: Agar siz menga bu ikkovidan hech birini buzmaganligingizni ta'kidlasangiz, men darhol rozi bo'laman, garchi hayotim uchun nimaga harakat qilayotganingizni tushunolmayman. Men sizning cheklovingizni qabul qilaman, dedi Van Helsing, va men sizdan so'raymanki, agar siz mening biron bir harakatimni hukm qilish kerakligini his qilsangiz, avval buni yaxshi o'ylab ko'ring va bu sizning ehtiyojilaringizni buzmasligiga ishonch hosil qiling. Men rozi bo'laman! - dedi Artur.

en: And now that the pourparlers are over, may I ask what it is we are to do? I want you to come with me, and to come in secret, to the churchyard at Kingstead. Arthur's face fell as he said in an amazed sort of way, Where poor Lucy is buried? The Professor bowed.
uz: Va endi suhbatlar tugagach, nima qilishimiz kerakligini so'rasam bo'ladimi? - Men bilan birga, Kingstead shahridagi cho'riqqa yashirincha kelishingni xohlayman. Arturning yuzi qochib ketdi va u o'ziga o'xshab shunday dedi: Fayqaloq Luzi qayerda ko'milgan? Professor sajda qildi.

en: Arthur went on, And when there? To enter the tomb! Arthur stood up.
uz: Artur davom etdi: Va qachon? - Qobilga kirish uchun! - Artur o'rnidan turibdi.

en: Professor, are you in earnest, or is it some monstrous joke?
uz: Professor, siz rostgo'ymisiz, yoki bu bir munozarali hazilmi?

en: Pardon me, I see that you are in earnest. He sat down again, but I could see that he sat ﬁrmly and proudly, as one who is on his dignity.
uz: Kechirasiz, men sizning jiddiy ekanligingizni ko'ryapman. U yana o'tirdi, lekin men uning o'tirganini ko'rardim, u qat'iy va faxrli edi, chunki u o'z qadr-qimmatini saqlagan kishi edi.

en: There was silence until he asked again, And when in the tomb? To open the cofﬁn. This is too much! he said, angrily rising again.
uz: U yana: Qachon qabrda? - deb so'raganidan so'ng, xotirjamlik so'radi. Bu juda ko'p! - dedi u, yana g'azab bilan ko'tarildi.

en: I am willing to be pa- tient in all things that are reasonable, but in this, this desecration of the
uz: Men barcha oqilona narsalarda qat'iy bo'lishga tayyorman, lekin bu, Xudoning muqaddasligini buzish.

en: grave, of one who …  He fairly choked with indignation.
uz: O'sha odamning ...  U g'azablanganidan ozgina cho'kdi.

en: The Professor looked pityingly at him.If I could spare you one pang, my poor friend, he said, God knows I would.
uz: Professor unga rahm-shafqat bilan qarab: Agar men senga bir marta ham yordam bersam, kambag'al, - dedi u, Alloh biladi.

en: But this night our feet must tread in thorny paths, or later, and for ever, the feet you love must walk in paths of ﬂame! Arthur looked up with set white face and said, Take care, sir, take care! Would it not be well to hear what I have to say? said Van Helsing.
uz: Ammo bu kechada oyoqlarimiz tiklangan yo'llar bilan to'sishi kerak, yoki keyinroq, abadiy, siz sevgan oyoqlar olov yo'llar bilan to'sishi kerak! - dedi Artur oq yuz bilan ko'tarilib, Havf qiling, xonim, ehtiyot bo'ling! - dedi Van Helsing.

en: And then you will at least know the limit of my purpose.
uz: O'shanda hech bo'lmaganda maqsadim chegarasini bilib olasiz.

en: Shall I go on? That's fair enough, broke in Morris.
uz: Men davom etsam bo'ladimi? - dedi Morris.

en: After a pause Van Helsing went on, evidently with an effort, Miss Lucy is dead, is it not so?
uz: Vaqt o'tgach, Van Helsing davom etdi, ko'rinib turibdiki, harakat bilan: Lusi xonim o'ldi, shunday emasmi?

en: Then there can be no wrong to her.
uz: Unda unga hech qanday yomonlik yo'q.

en: But if she be not dead…  Arthur jumped to his feet, Good God! he cried.
uz: Ammo agar u o'limda bo'lmasa... Artur o'z oyoqlariga o'tib: Yaxshi Xudo! - deb baqirdi.

en: Has there been any mistake, has she been buried alive?He groaned in an- guish that not even hope could soften.
uz: U tirik ko'milganmi yoki biron bir xato sodir bo'lganmi? - deb qayg'urdi u. Hatto umid ham uni yumshatolmasdi.

en: I did not say she was alive, my child.
uz: Men uning tirikligini aytmadim, qizim.

en: I go no further than to say that she might be Un-Dead. Un-Dead!
uz: Men faqat uning o'limsiz bo'lishi mumkinligini aytaman.

en: Is this all a nightmare, or what is it? There are mysteries which men can only guess at, which age by age they may solve only in part.
uz: Bularning barchasi nobusmi yoki nima?  Insonlar faqat tasavvur qila oladigan sirlar bor, qaysi yoshdan yoshga qarab ular faqat qisman hal qilishlari mumkin.

en: Believe me, we are now on the verge of one.
uz: Ishoninglar, biz endi bir kunning chegarasidamiz.

en: But I have not done.
uz: Ammo men buni qilmaganman.

en: May I cut off the head of dead Miss Lucy? Heavens and earth, no! cried Arthur in a storm of passion.
uz: O'lgan Miss Lusiyaning boshini kesib tashlasam bo'ladimi? - Osmon va yer, yo'q! - dedi Artur og'ir ishtiyoq bilan.

en: Not for the wide world will I consent to any mutilation of her dead body.
uz: Men butun dunyo uchun uning o'lik jasadi jarohatlanishiga rozi bo'lmayman.

en: Van Hels- ing, you try me too far.
uz: Van Helsing, siz meni juda ko'p harakat qilyapsiz.

en: What have I done to you that you should torture me so?
uz: Men senga nima qildimki, meni shunday qiynashing kerak?

en: What did that poor, sweet girl do that you should want to cast such dis- honor on her grave?
uz: O'sha kambag'al, sevimli qiz nima qildi, siz uning qabriga bunday hurmatsizlikni ko'rsatishni istashingiz kerak?

en: Are you mad, that you speak of such things, or am I mad to listen to them?
uz: Siz bunday narsalar haqida gapirganingiz uchun g'azablanganmisiz, yoki men ularni tinglash uchun g'azablanganmanmi?

en: Don't dare think more of such a desecration.
uz: Bunday haqorat haqida ko'proq o'ylashga jur'at etmang.

en: I shall not give my consent to anything you do.
uz: Men sizning hech qanday ishingizga rozilik bermayman.

en: I have a duty to do in protecting her grave from outrage, and by God, I shall do it! Van Helsing rose up from where he had all the time been seated, and said, gravely and sternly, My Lord Godalming, I too, have a duty to do, a duty to others, a duty to you, a duty to the dead, and by God, I shall do it!
uz: Men uning qabrini g'azabdan himoya qilish vazifasini bajaraman va Xudo haqi, men buni bajaraman! - dedi Van Helsing o'tirgan joyidan turib, jiddiy va qat'iylik bilan: Mening ham vazifam bor, xudoim Godalming, boshqalarga nisbatan vazifam bor, sizga nisbatan vazifam bor, o'lganlarga nisbatan vazifam bor va Xudo haqi, men buni bajaraman!

en: All I ask you now is that you come with me, that you look and listen, and if when later I make the same request you do not be more eager for its fulﬁll- ment even than I am, then, I shall do my duty, whatever it may seem to me.
uz: Sizdan endi faqat men bilan birga kelishni, ko'rishni va tinglashni so'rayman va agar keyinchalik men o'sha so'rovni qo'yganimda, siz uni bajarishga hatto mendan ham ko'ra ko'proq tayyor bo'lmasangiz, men o'z vazifamni bajaraman.

en: And then, to follow your Lordship's wishes I shall hold myself at your dis-
uz: Keyin esa, Lordligingizning xohishiga rioya qilish uchun o'zimni sizning so'zlaringizga sodiq qolaman.

en: posal to render an account to you, when and where you will. His voice broke a little, and he went on with a voice full of pity.
uz: Qachon va qayerda bo'lishingiz kerak bo'lsa, sizga hisobot berish uchun o'zimni chaqiraman. Uning ovozi biroz bo'g'ib ketdi va u rahm-shafqat bilan davom etdi.

en: But I beseech you, do not go forth in anger with me.
uz: Lekin iltimos, menga qarshi g'azablangan holda chiqib ketmang.

en: In a long life of acts which were often not pleasant to do, and which sometimes did wring my heart, I have never had so heavy a task as now.
uz: Ko'pincha yoqimli bo'lmagan va ba'zan yuragimni og'irlab qo'ygan harakatlar bilan uzoq umr davomida men hech qachon hozirgidek og'ir vazifani boshdan kechirmaganman.

en: Believe me that if the time comes for you to change your mind towards me, one look from you will wipe away all this so sad hour, for I would do what a man can to save you from sorrow.
uz: Menga ishoningki, agar menga nisbatan fikringizni o'zgartirish vaqti kelsa, bir qarashda bu qayg'uli soatni o'chirib tashlayman, chunki men sizni qayg'udan qutqarish uchun odamning qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilaman.

en: For why should I give myself so much labor and so much of sorrow?
uz: Nima uchun o'zimga shuncha mehnat va qayg'u qilishim kerak?

en: I have come here from my own land to do what I can of good, at the ﬁrst to please my friend John, and then to help a sweet young lady, whom too, I come to love.
uz: Men o'z yurtimdan bu yerga yaxshilik qilish uchun kelganman, boshida do'stim Jonni mamnun qilish uchun, so'ngra sevimli bir qizga yordam berish uchun, men ham uni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: For her, I am ashamed to say so much, but I say it in kindness, I gave what you gave, the blood of my veins.
uz: U uchun men shuncha narsani aytishdan uyalmayman, lekin buni mehribonlik ila aytaman, men siz bergan narsani, jonimning qonini berdim.

en: I gave it, I who was not, like you, her lover, but only her physician and her friend.
uz: Men uni sen kabi uning sevgilisi emas, balki faqat shifokor va do'sti bo'lgan o'zim berdim.

en: I gave her my nights and days, before death, after death, and if my death can do her good even now, when she is the dead Un-Dead, she shall have it freely. He said this with a very grave, sweet pride, and Arthur was much affected by it.
uz: Men o'limdan oldin ham, o'limdan keyin ham kechalari va kunlarimni unga berdim va agar o'lim hozir ham, o'lib ketgan Un-Dead bo'lganida ham, unga yaxshilik qila olsam, u erkinlik bilan uni oladi. - dedi u bu so'zlarni juda jiddiy, shirin mag'rurlik bilan aytdi va Artur bundan juda ta'sirlangan.

en: He took the old man's hand and said in a broken voice, Oh, it is hard to think of it, and I cannot understand, but at least I shall go with you and wait.
uz: U keksa kishining qo'lidan ushlab, bir ovozda: Oh, bu haqida o'ylash qiyin va men buni tushunolmayman, lekin hech bo'lmaganda men siz bilan birga borib kutaman, - dedi.

en: It was just a quarter before twelve o'clock when we got into the churchyard over the low wall.
uz: Biz past devordan cho'zilgan cho'ponga kirganimizda soat o'n ikkiga yaqin bo'lgan edi.

en: The night was dark with occasional gleams of moonlight between the dents of the heavy clouds that scudded across the sky.
uz: Kechasi qorong'i bo'lib, osmon bo'ylab ko'tarilgan og'ir bulutlar o'rtasida oy nurining vaqti-vaqti bilan shovqinlari paydo bo'lgan.

en: We all kept somehow close together, with Van Helsing slightly in front as he led the way.
uz: Biz hammamiz bir-birimizga yaqin bo'ldik, va Van Helsing yo'lni boshlaganida biroz oldinda edi.

en: When we had come close to the tomb I looked well at Arthur, for I feared the proximity to a place laden with so sorrowful a memory would upset him, but he bore himself well.
uz: Qabrga yaqinlashganimizda, Arturga diqqat bilan qaradim, chunki men juda qayg'uli xotira bilan to'lgan joyga yaqinlik uni xafa qiladi deb qo'rqardim, ammo u o'zini yaxshi ko'rdi.

en: I took it that the very mystery of the proceeding was in some way a counteractant to his grief.
uz: O'zim bu jarayonning o'ziga xos sirini uning qayg'uga qarshilik ko'rsatganiga ishonardim.

en: The Professor un- locked the door, and seeing a natural hesitation amongst us for various rea- sons, solved the difﬁculty by entering ﬁrst himself.
uz: Professor eshikni qulflab qo'ydi va biz o'zimizda turli reaktsiyalar uchun tabiiy shubhalarni ko'rib, avval o'zi kirib, qiyinchilikni hal qildi.

en: The rest of us followed, and he closed the door.
uz: Qolganlarimiz uning orqasidan ergashib ketishdi va u eshikni yopdi.

en: He then lit a dark lantern and pointed to a cofﬁn.
uz: Keyin u qorong'i lantern yoqib, ko'kka ko'rsatdi.

en: Arthur stepped forward hesitatingly.
uz: Artur ikkilanayotgan holda oldinga qadam bosdi.

en: Van Helsing said to me, You were with me here yesterday.
uz: Van Helsing menga shunday dedi: Sen kecha men bilan birga bo'lgan eding.

en: Was the body of Miss Lucy in that cofﬁn? It was. The Professor turned to the rest saying, You hear, and yet there is no one who does not believe with me.' He took his screwdriver and again took off the lid of the cofﬁn.
uz: O'sha kishanada Miss Lusiyning jasadi bo'lganmi? - deb so'radi. O'shanda bo'lgan.Professor qolganlarga qarab: Sizlar eshitasizlar, lekin men bilan birga ishonmaydigan hech kim yo'q, - dedi.U o'z maydonchini olib, yana kishanning qopqog'ini olib tashladi.

en: Arthur looked on, very pale but silent.
uz: Artur ko'z o'ngida ko'rinardi, juda yorqin, ammo sukut saqlashdi.

en: When the lid was removed he stepped for- ward.
uz: Qo'lni olib tashlaganida, u oldinga qadam bosdi.

en: He evidently did not know that there was a leaden cofﬁn, or at any rate, had not thought of it.
uz: O'sha paytda u bir idish quti borligini bilmasdi yoki hech bo'lmaganda bu haqda o'ylamagan edi.

en: When he saw the rent in the lead, the blood rushed to his face for an instant, but as quickly fell away again, so that he remained of a ghastly whiteness.
uz: U oltindagi parchalani ko'rganida, qon bir zumga yuzida yugurib ketdi, lekin tezda yana o'tib ketdi va u dahshatli oq bo'lib qoldi.

en: He was still silent.
uz: U hali ham sukut saqlashgan.

en: Van Helsing forced back the leaden ﬂange, and we all looked in and recoiled.
uz: Van Helsing o'tkir flangeni orqaga qaytarishga majbur qildi va biz hammamiz o'zimizni ko'rib, orqaga qaytdik.

en: The cofﬁn was empty!
uz: Qutquni bo'sh edi!

en: For several minutes no one spoke a word.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida hech kim bir so'z aytmadi.

en: The silence was broken by Quincey Morris, Professor, I answered for you.
uz: Shoshilinch Quincey Morris tomonidan buzildi: Professor, men siz uchun javob berdim.

en: Your word is all I want.
uz: Sizning so'zlaringiz - bu men xohlagan yagona narsa.

en: I wouldn't ask such a thing ordinarily, I wouldn't so dishonor you as to imply
uz: Men odatda bunday narsani so'ramayman, sizni shu qadar sharmanda qilmaymanki, buni ma'nosuz ko'rsataman.

en: a doubt, but this is a mystery that goes beyond any honor or dishonor.
uz: Shubhasiz, lekin bu sir har qanday sharaf yoki sharmandalikdan oshadi.

en: Is this your doing? I swear to you by all that I hold sacred that I have not removed or touched her.
uz: Bu sizning ishingizmi? - deb so'radi. - Men uni olib tashlab qo'ymagan va unga qo'l tegizmaganim uchun, men muqaddas deb hisoblagan hamma narsa bilan qasam ichaman.

en: What happened was this.
uz: Bu sodir bo'lgan voqea.

en: Two nights ago my friend Seward and I came here, with good purpose, believe me.
uz: Ikki kecha oldin do'stim Seward bilan bu yerga yaxshi niyat bilan keldik, ishoning.

en: I opened that cofﬁn, which was then sealed up, and we found it as now, empty.
uz: O'sha paytda muhrlangan sovutni ochdim va biz uni hozirgi kabi bo'sh holda topdik.

en: We then waited, and saw something white come through the trees.
uz: Keyin biz kutdik va daraxtlar orasidan oq bir narsa kelayotganini ko'rdik.

en: The next day we came here in daytime and she lay there.
uz: Ertasi kuni biz kunduzdan bu yerga keldik va u o'sha yerda yotgan edi.

en: Did she not, friend John?
uz: Yo'qmi, do'stim Jon?

en: Yes. That night we were just in time.
uz: Ha.  O'sha kecha biz o'z vaqtida keldik.

en: One more so small child was missing, and we ﬁnd it, thank God,unharmed amongst the graves.
uz: Yana bir kichkina bola yo'qolgan edi va biz uni, Xudoga shukr, qabrlar orasida zararsiz topdik.

en: Yesterday I came here before sundown, for at sundown the Un-Dead can move.
uz: Kecha men quyosh botishidan oldin bu yerga keldim, chunki quyosh botganida Un-Dead harakatlanishi mumkin.

en: I waited here all night till the sun rose, but I saw nothing.
uz: Men shu yerda butun kecha quyosh ko'tarilishini kutdim, lekin hech narsa ko'rmadim.

en: It was most probable that it was because I had laid over the clamps of those doors garlic, which the Un- Dead cannot bear, and other things which they shun.
uz: Ehtimol, buning sababi shundaki, men o'sha eshiklar qulflariga sarimsoq qo'ydim, ular ko'tarolmaydi va ular qochadigan boshqa narsalar ham bor edi.

en: Last night there was no exodus, so tonight before the sundown I took away my garlic and other things.
uz: Kecha hech qanday chiqish bo'lmagan, shuning uchun bugun quyosh botishidan oldin sarimush va boshqa narsalarni olib ketdim.

en: And so it is we ﬁnd this cofﬁn empty.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz ushbu ko'krakni bo'sh topdik.

en: So far there is much that is strange.
uz: Hozircha ko'p narsa g'alati.

en: Wait you with me outside, unseen and unheard, and things much stranger are yet to be.
uz: Sizni men bilan tashqarida, ko'rinmas va eshitilmagan holda kutyapman, ammo bundan ko'proq g'alati narsalar hali bo'lishi kerak.

en: So, here he shut the dark slide of his lantern,now to the outside. He opened the door, and we ﬁled out, he com- ing last and locking the door behind him.
uz: Shunday qilib, - dedi u lampanasining qorong'i slaydini yopib, hozir tashqariga chiqdi. U eshikni ochdi va biz chiqib ketdik, u oxirgi kelib, eshikni o'z orqasidan qulflab qo'ydi.

en: But it seemed fresh and pure in the night air after the terror of that vault.
uz: Ammo u qorong'ilik dahshatidan keyin kechasi havoda yangi va sof ko'rinardi.

en: How sweet it was to see the clouds race by, and the passing gleams of the moonlight between the scudding clouds crossing and passing, like the gladness and sorrow of a man's life.
uz: Bulutlar o'tib ketayotganini va bulutlar o'tib ketayotganini ko'rish naqadar yoqimli edi, xuddi inson hayotidagi quvonch va qayg'u kabi.

en: How sweet it was to breathe the fresh air, that had no taint of death and decay.
uz: O'lim va buzuqlikning hech qanday ta'siri bo'lmagan toza havoga nafas olish qanchalik yoqimli edi.

en: How humanizing to see the red lighting of the sky beyond the hill, and to hear far away the mufﬂed roar that marks the life of a great city.
uz: Tog'ning orqasidan osmonning qizil yorug'ligini ko'rish va katta shaharning hayotini belgilab beradigan o'z-o'zidan ko'ngilsiz qichqirishni uzoqdan eshitish naqadar insonparvarlik qiladi.

en: Each in his own way was solemn and overcome.
uz: Har bir kishi o'z usuli bilan tantanali va g'alaba qozondi.

en: Arthur was silent, and was, I could see, striving to grasp the pur- pose and the inner meaning of the mystery.
uz: Artur sukut saqlab, sirning mazmunini va mazmunini tushunishga harakat qilib yurganini ko'rdim.

en: I was myself tolerably patient, and half inclined again to throw aside doubt and to accept Van Helsing's conclusions.
uz: O'zim ham sabrli edim va yana ikkilanishni chetga surib, Van Helsingning xulosalarini qabul qilishga o'zim ham moyil edim.

en: Quincey Morris was phlegmatic in the way of a man who ac- cepts all things, and accepts them in the spirit of cool bravery, with hazard of all he has at stake.
uz: Quincey Morris hamma narsani qabul qiladigan va o'ziga xos jasorat ruhida qabul qiladigan odam kabi flegmatik bo'lgan.

en: Not being able to smoke, he cut himself a good-sized plug of tobacco and began to chew.
uz: Sigaret chekolmay, o'zi uchun katta tamaki to'plamini kesib tashladi va teshishni boshladi.

en: As to Van Helsing, he was employed in a deﬁnite way.
uz: Van Helsinga kelsak, u aniq tarzda ish bilan ta'minlangan.

en: First he took from his bag a mass of what looked like thin, wafer-like biscuit, which was carefully rolled up in a white napkin.
uz: Avval u sumkasidan oq cho'tka bilan ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'rab olingan, shunga o'xshab, chiroyli keksiyaga o'xshaydigan bir massani olibdi.

en: took out a double handful of some whitish stuff, like dough or putty.
uz: U ikki marta qo'l urib, xamir yoki maydon kabi oq narsalarni olib chiqdi.

en: He crumbled the wafer up ﬁne and worked it into the mass between his hands.
uz: U o'z qo'llari o'rtasida bo'lgan to'plamga o'qib, to'plamni mukammal qilib bo'g'ib qo'ydi.

en: This he then took, and rolling it into thin strips, began to lay them into the crevices between the door and its setting in the tomb.
uz: Keyin uni olib, kamroq parchalarga aylantirib, qabrdagi eshik va uning joylashishi o'rtasidagi bo'g'riliklarga qo'yishni boshladi.

en: I was somewhat puz- zled at this, and being close, asked him what it was that he was doing.
uz: Men bu haqda biroz xafa bo'ldim va undan nima qilayotganini so'radim.

en: Arthur and Quincey drew near also, as they too were curious.
uz: Arthur va Quincey ham yaqinlashishdi, chunki ular ham qiziqish ko'rsatishdi.

en: He answered, I am closing the tomb so that the Un-Dead may not enter. And is that stuff you have there going to do it? It Is. What is that which you are using? This time the question was by Arthur.
uz: U shunday javob berdi: Men qabrni yopiq qilib qo'yyapman, shunda o'limsizlar kirmaydi. U erda sizda bo'lgan bu narsalar buni qiladimi? Ha, shundaymi? Undan nima foydalanyapsiz? - Bu safar savol Artur tomonidan berilgan edi.

en: Van Helsing reverently lifted his hat as he answered.
uz: Van Helsing javob berayotganda, qo'rqinchli ravishda to'pini ko'tardi.

en: I brought it from Amsterdam.
uz: Men uni Amsterdamdan olib keldim.

en: I have an Indulgence. It was an answer that appalled the most sceptical of us, and we felt indi- vidually that in the presence of such earnest purpose as the Professor's, a purpose which could thus use the to him most sacred of things, it was im- possible to distrust.
uz: Bu javob bizdan eng shubhalilarni hayratda qoldirdi va biz o'zimiz ham professorning maqsadi kabi jiddiy maqsadga ega bo'lganimizda, unga eng muqaddas narsalarni qo'llash mumkin bo'lgan maqsadga ega bo'lganimizda, ishonchsizlik qilish mumkin emasligini his qildik.

en: In respectful silence we took the places assigned to us close round the tomb, but hidden from the sight of any one approaching.
uz: Hurmatli xotirjamlik bilan biz qabr atrofida bizga tayinlangan joylarni tutdik, ammo yaqinlashayotganlarning ko'zidan yashirinib qoldik.

en: I pitied the others, especially Arthur.
uz: Men boshqalarga, ayniqsa Arturga achinardim.

en: I had myself been apprenticed by my former visits to this watching horror, and yet I, who had up to an hour ago repudiated the proofs, felt my heart sink within me.
uz: O'zim ham bu dahshatni ko'rishga oldingi tashriflarimdan o'qigan edim, ammo bir soat oldin dalillarni rad etganimda, yuragim ichimda o'tib ketayotganini his qildim.

en: Never did tombs look so ghastly white.
uz: Qabrlar hech qachon bunday dahshatli oq ko'rinishga ega bo'lmagan.

en: Never did cypress, or yew, or juniper so seem the embodi- ment of funeral gloom.
uz: Hech qachon kisr, yiq yoki juniper o'zidan-o'zidan o'zgacha ko'rinmas edi.

en: Never did tree or grass wave or rustle so ominously.
uz: Hech qachon daraxt yoki o't o'simliklari bu qadar dahshatli darajada bo'lmagandi.

en: Never did bough creak so mysteriously, and never did the far-away howling of dogs send such a woeful presage through the night.
uz: Hech qachon shoxlar bu qadar sirli tarzda qichqirdi va itlarning uzoqdagi qichqiriqlari hech qachon kecha davomida bunday qayg'uli xabarni yubordi.

en: There was a long spell of silence, big, aching, void, and then from the Professor a keen S-s-s-s! He pointed, and far down the avenue of yews we saw a white ﬁgure advance, a dim white ﬁgure, which held something dark at its breast.
uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida xotirjamlik, katta, og'riq va bo'shlik bo'lgan, keyin professorning S-s-s-s! degan so'zlaridan so'ng, u ko'rsatdi va yo'lning uzoq tomonida biz bir oq suratni ko'rdik, uning ko'ksiga qorong'u bir narsani ushlab turadigan soya oq surat.

en: The ﬁgure stopped, and at the moment a ray of moonlight fell upon the masses of driving clouds, and showed in startling prominence a dark-haired woman, dressed in the cerements of the grave.
uz: Raqam to'xtadi va shu zahoti oy yorug'ligi bulutlar ustiga tushib, qorong'i sochli ayol qabrning o'rinboshlariga kiyinayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: We could not see the face, for it was bent down over what we saw to be a fair-haired child.
uz: Uning yuzini ko'rmadik, chunki u oq sochli bola deb ko'rganimiz ustida egrilib turardi.

en: There was a pause and a sharp little cry, such as a child gives in sleep, or a dog as it lies before the ﬁre and dreams.
uz: To'xtatish va o'ta qichqiriq bo'ldi, masalan, bola uxlab ketayotganda yiqilib qolibdi yoki it olov va orzu oldida yotganida.

en: We were starting forward, but the Professor's warning hand, seen by us as he stood behind a yew tree, kept us back.
uz: Biz oldinga qadam bosayotgan edik, lekin professorning ogohlantiruvchi qo'li, u yiv daraxtining orqasida turganini ko'rib, bizni orqaga qaytardi.

en: And then as we looked the white ﬁgure moved forwards again.
uz: So'ngra biz ko'z oldimizga qaraganimizda, oq surat yana oldinga ko'tarildi.

en: It was now near enough for us to see clearly, and the moonlight still held.
uz: Endi biz aniq ko'rishimiz mumkin bo'lgan darajada yaqin edi va oy yorug'ligi hali ham ushlab turardi.

en: My own heart grew cold as ice, and I could hear the gasp of Arthur, as we recog-
uz: O'z yuragim muz kabi sovuq bo'lib qoldi va Arturning nafasini eshitardim, chunki biz uni tanib-bildik.

en: nized the features of Lucy Westenra.
uz: Lucy Westenra ning xususiyatlariga ega bo'lgan.

en: Lucy Westenra, but yet how changed.
uz: Lucy Westenra, ammo u qanchalik o'zgargan.

en: The sweetness was turned to adamantine, heartless cruelty, and the purity to voluptuous wantonness.
uz: Go'zallik adamantin, yuraksiz shafqatsizlikka, soflik esa zo'rlikka aylandi.

en: Van Helsing stepped out, and obedient to his gesture, we all advanced too.
uz: Van Helsing chiqdi va uning ishiga bo'ysunib, biz hammamiz oldinga qadam qo'ydik.

en: The four of us ranged in a line before the door of the tomb.
uz: To'rttalamiz qabr eshigidan oldin qatorda turdik.

en: Van Hels- ing raised his lantern and drew the slide.
uz: Van Helsing lanternini ko'tarib, slaydni chizdi.

en: By the concentrated light that fell on Lucy's face we could see that the lips were crimson with fresh blood, and that the stream had trickled over her chin and stained the purity of her lawn death robe.
uz: Luusiyaning yuziga tushayotgan nurdan ko'rinib turibdiki, uning og'zaki yangi qon bilan qizil, oq uning burunidan oqib, o'z o'lim kiyimining sofligini buzgan.

en: We shuddered with horror.
uz: Biz dahshatdan titrab qoldik.

en: I could see by the tremulous light that even Van Helsing's iron nerve had failed.
uz: Men shiddatli yorug'likdan hatto Van Helsingning temir nervining ham ishlamay qolganini ko'rardim.

en: Arthur was next to me, and if I had not seized his arm and held him up, he would have fallen.
uz: Artur yonimda edi va agar men uning qo'lini ushlab, uni ko'tarmasam, u yiqilib ketar edi.

en: When Lucy, I call the thing that was before us Lucy because it bore her shape, saw us she drew back with an angry snarl, such as a cat gives when taken unawares, then her eyes ranged over us.
uz: Lucy, biz oldimizda turgan narsani Lucy deb ataganimda, chunki u o'z shaklini ko'rgan edi, bizni ko'rganida, u g'azabli qichqiriq bilan orqaga chiqdi, xuddi mushukning o'zi kabi, bizdan ko'z o'rab, ko'z o'ngimizga qarab turardi.

en: Lucy's eyes in form and col- or, but Lucy's eyes unclean and full of hell ﬁre, instead of the pure, gentle orbs we knew.
uz: Lusiyaning ko'zlari shaklda va rangda, ammo Lusiyaning ko'zlari biz bilgan sof, yumshoq orblar o'rniga, nopok va do'zax otasi bilan to'ldirilgan.

en: At that moment the remnant of my love passed into hate and loathing.
uz: O'sha paytda sevgimning qolgan qismi nafrat va nafratga aylandi.

en: Had she then to be killed, I could have done it with savage delight.
uz: Agar u o'ldirilgan bo'lsa, men buni vahshiy zavq bilan qilishim mumkin edi.

en: As she looked, her eyes blazed with unholy light, and the face became wreathed with a voluptuous smile.
uz: Qarang, uning ko'zlari muqaddas bo'lmagan nur bilan yorqin bo'ldi va yuzida o'ziga xos tabassum paydo bo'ldi.

en: Oh, God, how it made me shudder to see it!
uz: Oh, Xudoyim, buni ko'rib, men qanchalik titrardim!

en: With a careless motion, she ﬂung to the ground, callous as a devil, the child that up to now she had clutched strenuously to her breast, growling over it as a dog growls over a bone.
uz: U beparvo harakat bilan, iblis kabi shafqatsiz bo'lib, allaqachon ko'kraklariga qattiq bog'langan bolani yerga tashladi va it suyaklarini ko'kraklaridek g'azablanadi.

en: The child gave a sharp cry, and lay there moaning.
uz: Bola qattiq baqirib, o'sha yerda yig'lab yotgan edi.

en: There was a cold-bloodedness in the act which wrung a groan from Arthur.
uz: Bu aktda sovuq qonli bo'lib, Arturning g'azabini uyg'otdi.

en: When she advanced to him with outstretched arms and a wanton smile he fell back and hid his face in his hands.
uz: U qo'llarini ko'tarib, o'z tabassumini ko'rsatganida, u orqaga tushib, yuzini qo'llariga yashirdi.

en: She still advanced, however, and with a languorous, voluptuous grace, said, Come to me, Arthur.
uz: Biroq u hali ham o'z yo'lidan bordi va o'ziga yarasha, o'ziga yarasha iltijo bilan: Menga kel, Artur.

en: Leave these others and come to me.
uz: Boshqalarni qoldirib, menga kelinglar.

en: My arms are hungry for you.
uz: Qo'llarim siz uchun och.

en: Come, and we can rest together.
uz: Keling, birga dam olsak bo'ladi.

en: Come, my husband, come! There was something diabolically sweet in her tones, something of the tinkling of glass when struck, which rang through the brains even of us who heard the words addressed to another.
uz: Keling, erim, kel! - degan so'zlarida shaytonlikcha shirin bir narsa bor edi, hatto boshqa kishiga murojaat qilingan so'zlarni eshitganlarning o'z miyasidan o'tib ketadigan, to'qilganda shisha qichqirishidan iborat.

en: As for Arthur, he seemed under a spell, moving his hands from his face, he opened wide his arms.
uz: Arturning o'zi esa o'ziga o'xshaydi, qo'llarini yuzidan ko'chirib, qo'llarini keng ochadi.

en: She was leaping for them, when Van Helsing sprang forward and held between them his little golden cruciﬁx.
uz: Van Helsing oldinga tushib, o'zlarining o'rtasida o'zining oltin xochini ushlab turganda, u ularning orqasidan o'tardi.

en: coiled from it, and, with a suddenly distorted face, full of rage, dashed past him as if to enter the tomb.
uz: Undan o'girildi va g'azabga to'lib-toshgan yuzi bilan qabrga kirayotgandek uning yonidan o'tib ketdi.

en: When within a foot or two of the door, however,she stopped, as if arrest- ed by some irresistible force.
uz: Biroq, eshikdan bir-ikki metr uzoqlikda bo'lganida, u to'xtadi, xuddi qandaydir qarshi tura olmaydigan kuch tomonidan hibsga olingan bo'lsa.

en: Then she turned, and her face was shown in the clear burst of moonlight and by the lamp, which had now no quiver from Van Helsing's nerves.
uz: So'ngra u o'girilib, yuzini oy yorug'ligi va lampa ko'rsatdi, endi Van Helsingning tuyg'ularidan hech qanday kuchsizlik qolmadi.

en: Never did I see such bafﬂed malice on a face, and never, I trust, shall such ever be seen again by mortal eyes.
uz: Hech qachon yuzimda bunday dahshatli yovuzlikni ko'rmaganman va hech qachon, umid qilamanki, boshqa hech qachon o'lik ko'zlar tomonidan ko'rilmaydi.

en: The beauti- ful color became livid, the eyes seemed to throw out sparks of hell ﬁre, the brows were wrinkled as though the folds of ﬂesh were the coils of Medusa's snakes, and the lovely, blood-stained mouth grew to an open square, as in the passion masks of the Greeks and Japanese.
uz: Go'zal rang qizil rangga aylandi, ko'zlar jahannam o'tining chiroqlarini o'chirg'ayardi, ko'z burchaklari go'sht qo'llari Medusaning ilonlarining ko'rinishlari kabi burchli edi va go'zal, qon bilan to'ldirilgan og'iz yunonlar va yaponiyaliklarning ishtiyoq masklarida bo'lgani kabi ochiq kvadratga aylandi.

en: If ever a face meant death, if looks could kill, we saw it at that moment.
uz: Agar yuz o'limni anglatsa, agar ko'z o'ldirsa, biz uni o'sha paytda ko'rdik.

en: And so for full half a minute, which seemed an eternity, se remained be- tween the lifted cruciﬁx and the sacred closing of her means of entry.
uz: Shunday qilib, butun yarim daqiqa davomida, bu abadiylik kabi ko'rinardi, ko'tarilgan xoch va kirish yo'llarining muqaddas yopilishi o'rtasida qoladi.

en: Van Helsing broke the silence by asking Arthur, Answer me, oh my friend!
uz: Van Helsing Arthurdan: Menga javob ber, ey do'stim!

en: Am I to proceed in my work? Do as you will, friend.
uz: Ishimni davom ettirishim kerakmi? - Siz xohlaganingizni qiling, do'stim.

en: There can be no horror like this ever any more. And he groaned in spirit.
uz: Bundan keyin hech qachon bunday dahshatli voqealar bo'lmaydi, - deb so'zlabdi u.

en: Quincey and I simultaneously moved towards him, and took his arms.
uz: Quincey va men bir vaqtning o'zida unga yaqinlashdik va qo'llarini qo'lga oldik.

en: We could hear the click of the closing lantern as Van Helsing held it down.
uz: Van Helsing uni quvib qo'yganida, yopish lanternining toshqini eshitish mumkin edi.

en: Coming close to the tomb, he began to remove from the chinks some of the sacred emblem which he had placed there.
uz: Qabrga yaqinlashganda, u o'sha qabrga qo'ygan muqaddas timsolning ba'zi qismini qabrlardan olib tashlashni boshladi.

en: We all looked on with horriﬁed amazement as we saw, when he stood back, the woman, with a corporeal body as real at that moment as our own, pass through the interstice where scarce a knife blade could have gone.
uz: Biz hammamiz qo'rqinchli hayratda qoldik, chunki u orqaga qarab turganida, o'sha paytda bizning o'zimiz kabi jismoniy tanamiz bo'lgan ayolni ko'rdik, qayiq qilichi kamdan-kam o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan oraliqdan o'tadi.

en: We all felt a glad sense of relief when we saw the Professor calmly restoring the strings of putty to the edges of the door.
uz: Professorning eshik bo'yiga qo'yib qo'yilgan qo'shiqlarni xotirjamlik bilan tiklayotganini ko'rib, hammamiz quvonch va tasalli his qildik.

en: When this was done, he lifted the child and said, Come now, my friends.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, u bolani ko'tarib, dedi: Ey do'stlarim, kelinglar.

en: We can do no more till tomorrow.
uz: Ertagacha boshqa hech narsa qila olmaymiz.

en: There is a funeral at noon, so here we shall all come before long after that.
uz: Tush paytida dafn marosimi bo'ladi, shuning uchun biz hammamiz bundan ko'p o'tmay kelamiz.

en: The friends of the dead will all be gone by two, and when the sexton locks the gate we shall remain.
uz: O'liklarning do'stlari hammasi ikkiga ketadi va sexton eshikni qulflaganida biz qolamiz.

en: Then there is more to do, but not like this of tonight.
uz: Keyin ko'proq ish bor, lekin bu kechaga o'xshamaydi.

en: As for this little one, he is not much harmed, and by tomorrow night he shall be well.
uz: Bu kichkina bolaga esa hech qanday zarar yetmagan va ertaga kechqurun sog'ayib ketadi.

en: We shall leave him where the police will ﬁnd him, as on the other night, and then to home. Coming close to Arthur, he said, My friend Arthur, you have had a sore trial, but after, when you look back, you will see how it was necessary.
uz: Uni o'tgan kecha bo'lgani kabi politsiya topgan joyda qoldirib, uyga qaytarib ketamiz, - dedi u Arturga yaqinlashib: Artur, do'stim, sen og'ir sinovdan o'tgan eding, lekin keyin, orqaga nazar solib ko'rganingda, bu qanchalik zarur bo'lganini ko'rasiz.

en: You are now in the bitter waters, my child.
uz: Endi sen qaynoq suvda bo'lsang, qizim.

en: By this time tomorrow you will,
uz: Ertaga shu vaqtga kelib siz,

en: please God, have passed them, and have drunk of the sweet waters.
uz: Iltijo qilaman, Xudoyim, ulardan o'tib, shirin suvlarni ichgin.

en: So do not mourn over-much.
uz: Shunday qilib, juda ko'p yig'lamang.

en: Till then I shall not ask you to forgive me. Arthur and Quincey came home with me, and we tried to cheer each oth- er on the way.
uz: O'shanda men sizdan kechirim so'ramayman.Artur va Quincey men bilan birga uyga keldilar va yo'lda bir-birimizni quvonchga soladilar.

en: We had left behind the child in safety, and were tired.
uz: Biz bolani tashlab ketdik va biz charchagan edik.

en: So we all slept with more or less reality of sleep.
uz: Shunday qilib, barchamiz ko'proq yoki kamroq uyqu holati bilan uxladik.

en: 29 September, night.—A little before twelve o'clock we three, Arthur, Quincey Morris, and myself, called for the Professor.
uz: 29 sentabr kuni kechasi.Bir oz o'n ikki soatdan oldin biz uchimiz, Artur, Quincey Morris va men professorni chaqirtirdik.

en: It was odd to notice that by common consent we had all put on black clothes.
uz: Biz hammamiz umumiy rozilik bilan qora kiyim kiyganimizni ko'rish g'alati edi.

en: Of course, Arthur wore black, for he was in deep mourning, but the rest of us wore it by in- stinct.
uz: Albatta, Artur qora kiyim kiygan edi, chunki u chuqur qayg'uda edi, ammo qolganlarimiz uni istisno bilan kiygan edik.

en: We got to the graveyard by half-past one, and strolled about, keeping out of ofﬁcial observation, so that when the gravediggers had completed their task and the sexton under the belief that every one had gone, had locked the gate, we had the place all to ourselves.
uz: Biz soat uchdan yarimgacha qabristonga yetib, rasmiy kuzatuvdan uzoqlashib yurardik, shuning uchun qabristonlar o'z vazifasini tugatganida va har bir kishi ketganiga amin bo'lgan sektonlar eshikni qulflab qo'yganida, o'zimiz uchun joy bo'lgan.

en: Van Helsing, instead of his little black bag, had with him a long leather one,something like a crick- eting bag.
uz: Van Helsing o'zining kichik qora sumkasidan ko'ra, yonida uzun charmli sumka bor edi.

en: It was manifestly of fair weight.
uz: O'rinli o'lchamda bo'lgan.

en: When we were alone and had heard the last of the footsteps die out up the road, we silently, and as if by ordered intention, followed the Professor to the tomb.
uz: Yolg'iz qolganimizda va yo'ldan o'tib ketayotgan oxirgi qadamlarni eshitganimizda, biz xotirjamlik bilan, xuddi buyurilgan niyat bilan professorni qabrga yetaklab bordik.

en: He unlocked the door, and we entered, closing it behind us.
uz: U eshikni ochdi va biz o'z ortimizdan yopiq eshikni yopib, kirdik.

en: Then he took from his bag the lantern, which he lit, and also two wax candles, which, when lighted, he stuck by melting their own ends, on other cofﬁns, so that they might give light sufﬁcient to work by.
uz: So'ngra u sumkasidan chiroqni olib, uni yoqdi va ikkita shamol chiroqni ham olib, chiroq yoqilg'isi kelganda, uni boshqa qovushlarga qo'yib qo'ydi, chunki ularda ishlashi uchun etarlicha yorug'lik bor edi.

en: When he again lifted the lid off Lucy's cofﬁn we all looked, Arthur trembling like an aspen, and saw that the corpse lay there in all its death beauty.
uz: U yana Lusiyaning qovusidan qopqog'ini ko'targanida, Artur o'simlik kabi titrab, barchamiz ko'rdik va o'lim go'zalligi bilan jasad o'sha yerda yotganini ko'rdik.

en: But there was no love in my own heart, nothing but loathing for the foul Thing which had taken Lucy's shape without her soul.
uz: Ammo yuragimda sevgi yo'q edi, faqat ruhi yo'qligida Lusiyaning shaklini olgan iflos narsa uchun nafratlanishdan boshqa narsa yo'q edi.

en: I could see even Arthur's face grow hard as he looked.
uz: Hatto Arturning yuzi qattiq o'sib borayotganini ko'rardim.

en: Presently he said to Van Helsing, Is this really Lucy's body, or only a demon in her shape? It is her body, and yet not it.
uz: Shu payt u Van Helsingga: Bu haqiqatan ham Lusiyaning tanasimi yoki uning shaklidagi jinmi? - deb so'radi.

en: But wait a while, and you shall see her as she was, and is. She seemed like a nightmare of Lucy as she lay there, the pointed teeth, the blood stained, voluptuous mouth, which made one shudder to see, the whole carnal and unspirited appearance, seeming like a devilish mockery of Lucy's sweet purity.
uz: Lekin bir muncha vaqt kuting, u qanday bo'lganini ko'rasiz, shunday ham bo'ladi. U o'sha yerda yotganda Luziyaning orzu-mashqasiga o'xshardi, o'zlarining o'ng tishlari, qon bilan to'liq bo'lgan, o'ziga xos og'izlari, bu esa odamni titrab ko'rishga undadi, butun tana va ruhsiz ko'rinishlari Luziyaning shirin sofligidan shaytonlik bilan masxara qilish kabi ko'rinardi.

en: Van Helsing, with his usual methodicalness, began tak- ing the various contents from his bag and placing them ready for use.
uz: Van Helsing odatdagi usulchanligi bilan turli tarkiblarni sumkasidan olib, foydalanishga tayyorlab qo'yishni boshladi.

en: First he took out a soldering iron and some plumbing solder, and then small oil lamp, which gave out, when lit in a corner of the tomb, gas which burned at a ﬁerce heat with a blue ﬂame, then his operating knives, which he placed
uz: Avval u soldiruvchini va plumbing soldiruvchini olib chiqdi, so'ngra qabrning bir burchagida yonib turganida, kuchli issiqlikda ko'k olov bilan yonayotgan gazni chiqargan kichik moy chiroqini olib chiqdi, so'ngra o'zlarining ishlashi mumkin bo'lgan pichoqlarini joylashtirdi

en: to hand, and last a round wooden stake, some two and a half or three inches thick and about three feet long.
uz: Qo'ldan-qo'lga, taxminan ikki yarim yoki uch dyuym qalin va qariyb uch fut uzun bo'lgan to'g'ri yog'och ustunini davom ettiring.

en: One end of it was hardened by charring in the ﬁre, and was sharpened to a ﬁne point.
uz: Uning bir tomoni olovda o't qo'yib qattiqlashdi va o'sha paytgacha o't qo'zg'atildi.

en: With this stake came a heavy hammer, such as in households is used in the coal cellar for breaking the lumps.
uz: Ushbu o't bilan birga uylarda ko'mir qutidagi qo'pollarni buzish uchun ishlatiladigan og'ir martaba ham keldi.

en: To me, a doctor's preperations for work of any kind are stimulating and bracing, but the effect of these things on both Arthur and Quincey was to cause them a sort of consternation.
uz: Men uchun shifokorning har qanday ish uchun tayyorgarligi rag'batlantiruvchi va mustahkamlaydi, lekin bu narsalar Artura va Quinceyga qanday ta'sir qilganini ko'rib, ular bir xil xavotirga tushishdi.

en: They both, however, kept their courage, and remained silent and quiet.
uz: Biroq, ikkalasi ham jasoratini saqlab, soʻzsiz va xotirjam boʻlishdi.

en: When all was ready, Van Helsing said,Before we do anything, let me tell you this.
uz: Hamma narsa tayyor bo'lganda, Van Helsing shunday dedi: Biz biron narsa qilmasdan oldin, sizga buni aytib beray.

en: It is out of the lore and experience of the ancients and of all those who have studied the powers of the Un-Dead.
uz: Bu qadimgilarning va o'liklarning kuchlarini o'rganganlarning ta'limotlari va tajribasi emas.

en: When they become such, there comes with the change the curse of immortality.
uz: Ular shunday bo'lganda, o'zgarish bilan birga o'lmaslikning la'nati ham keladi.

en: They cannot die, but must go on age after age adding new victims and multiplying the evils of the world.
uz: Ular o'lishga qodir emaslar, lekin yoshlar o'tib, yangi qurbonlar qo'shib, dunyodagi yovuzliklarni ko'paytirishlari kerak.

en: For all that die from the preying of the Un-dead become them- selves Un-dead, and prey on their kind.
uz: O'liklarning ovidan o'lganlarning barchasi o'z-o'zidan o'lik bo'lib, o'z turlarini ovlaydilar.

en: And so the circle goes on ever widening, like as the ripples from a stone thrown in the water.
uz: Shunday qilib, to'rka suvga tashlangan toshning to'lqinlariga o'xshaydi.

en: Friend Arthur, if you had met that kiss which you know of before poor Lucy die, or again, last night when you open your arms to her, you would in time, when you had died, have become nosferatu, as they call it in Eastern europe, and would for all time make more of those Un-Deads that so have ﬁlled us with horror.
uz: Do'stim Artur, agar sen kambag'al Luzi o'lishidan oldin yoki kechasi qo'llaringni unga ochganingda bilgan o'sha o'pimni uchratgan bo'lsang, o'lganingda, Sharqiy Evropada nomlangan nosferatuga aylanar eding va bizni dahshatga to'ldirgan o'sha o'liklardan ko'proq odamlarni abadiy yaratar eding.

en: The career of this so unhappy dear lady is but just begun.
uz: Ushbu baxtsiz ayolning hayoti hali boshlanmagan.

en: Those children whose blood she sucked are not as yet so much the worse, but if she lives on, Un-Dead, more and more they lose their blood and by her power over them they come to her, and so she draw their blood with that so wicked mouth.
uz: Uning qonini sug'organ bolalar hali shunchalik yomon emas, lekin agar u tirik bo'lsa, Un-Dead, ular ko'proq qonlarini yo'qotadilar va uning ularga bo'lgan qudrati tufayli unga yaqinlashadilar, shuning uchun u o'z qonlarini o'sha yovuz og'iz bilan to'laydi.

en: But if she die in truth, then all cease.
uz: Ammo agar u haqiqatda o'lsa, u holda hamma narsa to'xtadi.

en: The tiny wounds of the throats disappear, and they go back to their play unknowing ever of what has been.
uz: Qo'ldagi kichkina yaralar yo'q bo'lib ketadi va ular nima bo'lganini bilmasdan o'z o'yinlariga qaytishadi.

en: But of the most blessed of all, when this now Un-Dead be made to rest as true dead, then the soul of the poor lady whom we love shall again be free.
uz: Ammo eng muboraklaridan, bu hozirgi O'lmaydigan o'lik haqiqiy o'lik sifatida dam olganda, biz sevgan kambag'al ayolning ruhi yana ozod bo'ladi.

en: Instead of working wickedness by night and growing more debased in the assimilating of it by day, she shall take her place with the other An- gels.
uz: Kechasi yovuzlik bilan shug'ullanish va kunduzda uni qabul qilishda kamtar bo'lishning o'rniga, u boshqa farishtalar bilan o'z o'rnini egallaydi.

en: So that, my friend, it will be a blessed hand for her that shall strike the blow that sets her free.
uz: Shunday qilib, do'stim, uni ozod qiladigan urish unga qutlug' qo'l bo'ladi.

en: To this I am willing, but is there none amongst us who has a better right?
uz: Men bunga tayyorman, lekin o'zimizdan ko'ra ko'proq huquqga ega bo'lgan hech kim yo'qmi?

en: Will it be no joy to think of hereafter in the silence of the night when sleep is not, `It was my hand that sent her to the stars.
uz: U uxlamaydigan kechasi sukunatida kelajak haqida o'ylash quvonchli bo'lmasmidi? `Uni yulduzlarga yuborgan qo'lim edi.

en: It was the hand of him that loved her best, the hand that of all she would her- self have chosen, had it been to her to choose?' Tell me if there be such a one amongst us?
uz: Uni eng yaxshi ko'radigan kishi qo'li edi, agar u tanlagan bo'lsa, o'zi tanlagan barcha qo'llaridan biri edi.

en: We all looked at Arthur.
uz: Hammamiz Arturga qarab turdik.

en: He saw too, what we all did, the inﬁnite kind- ness which suggested that his should be the hand which would restore Lucy to us as a holy, and not an unholy, memory.
uz: U ham, hammamiz qilgan ishlarni ko'rdi, cheksiz mehribonlik uning qo'li bo'lishi kerakligini ko'rdi, bu qo'l Lusiyani bizga muqaddas emas, balki muqaddas xotira sifatida qaytaradi.

en: He stepped forward and said bravely, though his hand trembled, and his face was as pale as snow, My true friend, from the bottom of my broken heart I thank you.
uz: U qadam qo'yib, qo'li titrab, yuzi qor kabi oq bo'lsa-da, jasorat bilan shunday dedi: Haqiqiy do'stim, yuragimning cho'qqisidan senga rahmat aytaman.

en: Tell me what I am to do, and I shall not falter! Van Helsing laid a hand on his shoulder, and said,Brave lad!
uz: Menga nima qilishim kerakligini aytinglar, shunda to'xtamayman! - dedi Van Helsing qo'lini yelkasiga qo'yib, shunday dedi: Jigarband!

en: A mo- ment's courage, and it is done.
uz: Vaziyatning jasorati, va bu amalga oshdi.

en: This stake must be driven through her.
uz: Ushbu daraxt o'zidan o'tishi kerak.

en: It well be a fearful ordeal, be not deceived in that, but it will be only a short time, and you will then rejoice more than your pain was great.
uz: Bu juda dahshatli sinov bo'lishi kerak, bu bilan aldamang, lekin bu faqat qisqa vaqt bo'ladi va o'shanda siz og'rig'ingiz katta bo'lganidan ko'proq xursand bo'lasiz.

en: From this grim tomb you will emerge as though you tread on air.
uz: Ushbu qorong'i qabrdan xuddi havoga qadam tashlaganingizdek chiqib ketasiz.

en: But you must not falter when once you have begun.
uz: Ammo boshlaganingizdan so'ng qochib ketmasligingiz kerak.

en: Only think that we, your true friends, are round you, and that we pray for you all the time. Go on,said Arthur hoarsely.Tell me what I am to do. Take this stake in your left hand, ready to place to the point over the heart, and the hammer in your right.
uz: Faqatgina biz, haqiqiy do'stlaringiz, siz atrofingizda ekanimizni va siz uchun doimo ibodat qilayotganimizni tasavvur qiling. O'zingizni davom ettiring, - dedi Artur qichqirib. Menga nima qilishim kerakligini ayting.  Bu o'tni chap qo'lingizda olib, yurak ustiga to'g'ri qo'yishga tayyor bo'ling, o'ng qo'lingizda esa pilla.

en: Then when we begin our prayer for the dead, I shall read him, I have here the book, and the others shall follow, strike in God's name, that so all may be well with the dead that we love and that the Un-Dead pass away. Arthur took the stake and the hammer, and when once his mind was set on action his hands never trembled nor even quivered.
uz: So'ngra biz o'liklar uchun ibodatni boshlaganimizda, men uni o'qib beraman, bu kitob mening qo'limda, qolganlar esa Xudoning nomi bilan urishadi, toki biz sevgan o'liklar bilan hammasi yaxshi bo'lsin va O'lmaslar o'tib ketsin. - dedi Artur, o'g'illarini o'ldirganida, o'z qo'llarini titratmadi va qo'llarini titratmadi.

en: Van Helsing opened his missal and began to read, and Quincey and I followed as well as we could.
uz: Van Helsing misalini ochib o'qishni boshladi va Quincey va men uni qo'limizdan kelgancha kuzatdik.

en: Arthur placed the point over the heart, and as I looked I could see its dint in the white ﬂesh.
uz: Artur nuqtani yurak ustiga qo'ydi va ko'z oldimdan ko'rib turganimda, uning oq tanadagi bo'g'ini ko'rdim.

en: Then he struck with all his might.
uz: So'ngra u butun kuchini ishga soladi.

en: The thing in the cofﬁn writhed, and a hideous, bloodcurdling screech came from the opened red lips.
uz: Qovushdagi narsa buzib ketdi va ochilgan qizil og'izlardan qo'rqinchli, qon to'kib ketgan qichqiriq chiqdi.

en: The body shook and quivered and twisted in wild contortions.
uz: Tanasi titrab, titrab, yovvoyi contorsionlarda burib ketdi.

en: The sharp white champed together till the lips were cut, and the mouth was smeared with a crimson foam.
uz: O'ta oq bo'lib, dudaklar kesilguncha bir-biriga qo'shilib, og'ziga qizil cho'g' bilan to'plandi.

en: But Arthur never faltered.
uz: Ammo Artur hech qachon shubha ostiga qo'ymadi.

en: He looked like a ﬁgure of Thor as his untrembling arm rose and fell, driving deeper and deeper the mercybearing stake, whilst the blood from the pierced heart welled and spurted up around it.
uz: U Thorning shakliga o'xshardi, chunki uning titragan qo'li baland va pastga tushib, rahm-shafqat daraxtini yanada chuqurroq va chuqurroq yo'naltirgan edi, o'tkirgan yurak qonlari esa atrofida to'kib-toshgan edi.

en: His face was set, and high duty seemed to shine through it.
uz: Uning yuzi o'rnatilgan edi va yuksak majburiyat uning ichida shinam ko'rinardi.

en: The sight of it gave us courage so that our voices seemed to ring through the little vault.
uz: Uning ko'rinishi bizga jasorat baxsh etdi, shuning uchun bizning ovozlarimiz kichkina ombor orqali tovushlashdi.

en: And then the writhing and quivering of the body became less, and the teeth seemed to champ, and the face to quiver.
uz: So'ngra tanadagi burilish va titrash kamaydi, tishlar chempion bo'lib, yuz ham titrab ketdi.

en: Finally it lay still.
uz: Nihoyat u to'xtadi.

en: The terri- ble task was over.
uz: O'tmishdagi vazifa tugadi.

en: The hammer fell from Arthur's hand.
uz: O'g'li Arturning qo'lidan qamchi tushdi.

en: He reeled and would have fallen had we not caught him.
uz: Agar uni tutib olmaganimizda, u o'z-o'zidan burib, yiqilib ketgan bo'lar edi.

en: The great drops of sweat sprang from his forehead, and his breath came in broken gasps.
uz: Uning peshanasidan katta ter tomchilari chiqdi va uning nafaslari o'chirib ketdi.

en: It had indeed been an awful strain on him, and had he not been forced to his task by more than human considera- tions he could never have gone through with it.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, bu unga juda og'ir bosim o'tkazgan edi va agar u insoniy nuqtai nazardan tashqari o'z vazifasini bajarishga majbur bo'lmaganida, u hech qachon uni bajarolmasdi.

en: For a few minutes we were so taken up with him that we did not look towards the cofﬁn.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida biz u bilan shunchalik band edikki, ko'krak tomon nazar solib ko'rmadik.

en: When we did, however, a murmur of startled surprise ran from one to the other of us.
uz: Biroq, buni qilgach, bir-birimizdan qo'rqinchli hayratda qolgan bir g'iybat keldi.

en: We gazed so eagerly that Arthur rose, for he had been seated on the ground, and came and looked too, and then a glad strange light broke over his face and dispelled altogether the gloom of horror that lay upon it.
uz: O'sha payt Artur o'tirgan yerdan turib, o'ziga qarab turardi, keyin uning yuziga quvonchli, g'ayrioddiy nur tushib, qo'rqinchning qorong'ini butunlay yo'q qildi.

en: There, in the cofﬁn lay no longer the foul Thing that we has so dreaded and grown to hate that the work of her destruction was yielded as a privi- lege to the one best entitled to it, but Lucy as we had seen her in life, with her face of unequalled sweetness and purity.
uz: O'sha ko'krak ichida biz shunchalik qo'rqqan va nafratlanishga o'sib borgan, uni yo'q qilish ishi eng yaxshi huquqli kishiga imtiyoz sifatida berilgan, balki biz uni hayotda ko'rgan Lucyga, uning tengsiz shirinlik va soflik yuziga ega bo'lgan yomon narsa emas edi.

en: True that there were there, as we had seen them in life, the traces of care and pain and waste.
uz: To'g'ri, biz hayotimizda ko'rganimizdek, qayg'u, og'riq va ziyon izlari bor edi.

en: But these were all dear to us, for they marked her truth to what we knew.
uz: Ammo bularning barchasi biz uchun juda qadrli edi, chunki ular biz bilgan narsalarga uning haqiqatini belgilab qo'yishdi.

en: One and all we felt that the holy calm that lay like sunshine over the wasted face and form was only an earthly token and symbol of the calm that was to reign for ever.
uz: Birinchidan, o'zimiz ham o'yladikki, o'z yuzi va shakli ustidan quyosh nuri kabi yotgan muqaddas tinchlik abadiy hukm suradigan tinchlikning yer yuzidagi ramzi va ramzi edi.

en: Van Helsing came and laid his hand on Arthur's shoulder, and said to him, And now, Arthur my friend, dear lad, am I not forgiven? The reaction of the terrible strain came as he took the old man's hand in his, and raising it to his lips, pressed it, and said, Forgiven!
uz: Van Helsing kelib, Arturning yelkasiga qo'lini qo'ydi va unga dedi: O'sha paytda, Artur do'stim, aziz yigit, meni kechirmadi? - Bu dahshatli bosimning reaktsiyasi, u keksa odamning qo'lini o'zidan olib, og'ziga ko'tarib, uni bosdi va dedi: Kechirildi!

en: God bless you that you have given my dear one her soul again, and me peace. He put his hands on the Professor's shoulder, and laying his head on his breast, cried for a while silently, whilst we stood unmoving.
uz: Sen mening azizimning ruhini qaytarib berganing uchun Xudo seni qutqarsin va menga tinchlik ato qilsin, - deb qo'llarini professorning yelkasiga qo'ydi va boshini ko'krakga qo'yib, biz biroz sukut saqlashimiz uchun biroz sukut bo'lib yig'ladi.

en: When he raised his head Van Helsing said to him, And now, my child, you may kiss her.
uz: Boshini ko'targanida, Van Helsing unga: Va endi, qizim, sen uni o'pishing mumkin.

en: Kiss her dead lips if you will, as she would have you to, if for her to choose.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, uning o'lik dudaklarini o'pishingiz kerak, chunki u sizdan xohlaydi, agar u xohlasa.

en: For she is not a grinning devil now, not any more a foul Thing for all eternity.
uz: Chunki u endi tabassum qiluvchi shayton emas, endi esa abadiylik uchun yomon narsa emas.

en: No longer she is the devil's Un-Dead.
uz: Endi u shaytonning o'limsiz o'limi emas.

en: She is God's true dead, whose soul is with Him! Arthur bent and kissed her, and then we sent him and Quincey out of the tomb.
uz: U Xudoning haqiqiy o'likidir, uning ruhi U bilan birga! - deb o'zini egib, Artur uni o'pdi, so'ngra biz uni va Kvinseyni qabrdan chiqarib yubordik.

en: The Professor and I sawed the top off the stake, leaving the point of it in the body.
uz: Professor va men o'tning yuqori qismini o'g'irlab tashladik va uning nuqtasi tanangizda saqlanib qoldi.

en: Then we cut off the head and ﬁlled the mouth with garlic.
uz: So'ngra boshni kesib, og'zimizni sarimush bilan to'ldirib qo'ydik.

en: We soldered up the leaden cofﬁn, screwed on the cofﬁn lid, and gathering up our belongings, came away.
uz: Biz lavha qovusini to'ldirib, qovusining qopqog'ini to'ldirib, mol-mulkimizni yig'ib, ketdik.
