en: When the Professor locked the door he gave the key to Arthur.
uz: Professor eshikni qulflab qo'yganida, u arturga kalitni berdi.

en: Outside the air was sweet, the sun shone, and the birds sang, and it seemed as if all nature were tuned to a different pitch.
uz: Tashqi havo shirin edi, quyosh parlashardi, qushlar kuylashardi va butun tabiat o'ziga xos nufuzga mos kelayotganidek tuyuldi.

en: There was gladness and mirth and peace everywhere, for we were at rest ourselves on one ac- count, and we were glad, though it was with a tempered joy.
uz: Har yerda quvonch, quvonch va tinchlik bor edi, chunki biz o'zimizni bir o'yinda dam oldik va xursand edik, garchi bu o'rtacha quvonch bilan bo'lsa-da.

en: Before we moved away Van Helsing said,Now, my friends, one step or our work is done, one the most harrowing to ourselves.
uz: Ko'chib o'tishdan oldin Van Helsing shunday degan edi: Hndi, do'stlarim, bir qadam yoki bizning ishimiz bajarildi, bu o'zimizga eng og'ir bo'ladi.

en: But there remains a greater task, to ﬁnd out the author of all this or sorrow and to stamp him out.
uz: Ammo bularning barchasining yoki qaygʻularning muallifini topish va uni yoʻq qilishdan iborat eng katta vazifa bor.

en: I have clues which we can follow, but it is a long task, and a difﬁcult one, and there is danger in it, and pain.
uz: Biz kuzatib borishimiz mumkin bo'lgan izlarim bor, lekin bu uzoq va qiyin ish, bu xavf va og'riq bilan bog'liq.

en: Shall you not all help me?
uz: Hammangiz menga yordam bermayapsizmi?

en: We have learned to believe, all of us, is it not so?
uz: Biz hammamiz ishonishni o'rganganmiz, shunday emasmi?

en: And since so, do we not see our duty?
uz: Shunday qilib, biz o'z burchimizni ko'rmayapmizmi?

en: And do we not promise to go on to the bitter end? Each in turn, we took his hand, and the promise was made.
uz: Va biz qaynoq oxirigacha davom etamiz, deb va'da qilmayapmizmi? - deb so'rashdi. Har birimiz uning qo'lidan ushlab turdik va va'da amalga oshdi.

en: Then said the Professor as we moved off, Two nights hence you shall meet with me and dine together at seven of the clock with friend John.
uz: Keyin professor ketayotganimizda shunday dedi: Ikkita kechadan keyin siz men bilan uchrashasiz va soat yettida do'stim Jon bilan birga ovqatlanasiz.

en: I shall entreat two oth- ers, two that you know not as yet, and I shall be ready to all our work show and our plans unfold.
uz: Ikkita boshqalarini, siz hali bilmagan ikkitani, taklif qilaman va barcha ishlarimiz va rejalarimizning namoyish etilishiga tayyorman.

en: Friend John, you come with me home, for I have much to consult you about, and you can help me.
uz: Do'stim Jon, uyga men bilan birga keling, chunki men sizga maslahat berishim kerak bo'lgan ko'p narsalar bor va siz menga yordam bera olasiz.

en: Tonight I leave for Ams- terdam, but shall return tomorrow night.
uz: Bugun kechqurun Ams-terdamga ketaman, lekin ertaga kecha qaytib kelaman.

en: And then begins our great quest.
uz: Va nihoyat bizning buyuk izlanishimiz boshlanadi.

en: But ﬁrst I shall have much to say, so that you may know what to do and to dread.
uz: Ammo avvalambor nima qilish kerakligini va nimalardan qo'rqish kerakligini bilishingiz uchun sizga aytadigan ko'p narsalarim bor.

en: Then our promise shall be made to each other anew.
uz: Keyin bir-birimizga yangi va'da beramiz.

en: For there is a terrible task before us, and once our feet are on the ploughshare we must not draw back.
uz: Chunki oldimizda dahshatli ish bor va oyoqlarimiz pichoqqa tushib qolsa, orqaga qaytmasligimiz kerak.

en: When we arrived at the Berkely Hotel, Van Helsing found a telegram wait- ing for him.
uz: Berkely mehmonxonasida kelganimizda, Van Helsing uni kutib turgan telegramni topdi.

en: Am coming up by train.
uz: O'zim poyezdda boryapman.

en: Mina Harker. The Professor was delighted.
uz: Mina Harker. Professor juda xursand bo'ldi.

en: Ah, that wonderful Madam Mina, he said, pearl among women!
uz: U: Aha, bu go'zal Madam Mina, ayollar orasidagi marvarid!

en: She arrive, but I cannot stay.
uz: U keladi, lekin men qololmayman.

en: She must go to your house, friend John.
uz: U sizning uyingizga borishi kerak, do'stim Jon.

en: You must meet her at the station.
uz: U bilan stantsiyada uchrashishingiz kerak.

en: Telegraph her en route so that she may be prepared. When the wire was dispatched he had a cup of tea.
uz: U yo'lda bo'lganida uni telegraf qiling, shunda u tayyor bo'ladi. U telefonni jo'natganida, u bir qadah choy ichgan edi.

en: Over it he told me of a diary kept by Jonathan Harker when abroad, and gave me a typewritten copy of it, as also of Mrs.
uz: U menga chet elda bo'lganida Jonatan Xarkning kundalik kitobini aytib berdi va menga uning matbuot nusxasini berdi.

en: Harker's diary at Whitby.
uz: Harkerning Whitbydagi kundaligi.

en: Take these, he said,and study them well.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bularni olib, yaxshilab o'rganing.

en: When I have returned you will be master of all the facts, and we can then better enter on our inquisition.
uz: Men qaytib kelganimda, siz barcha faktlarning egasi bo'lasiz va biz inkvizitsiyamizga yaxshiroq kirishimiz mumkin.

en: Keep them safe, for there is in them much of treasure.
uz: Ularni xavfsiz saqlang, chunki ularda ko'p xazinalar mavjud.

en: You will need all your faith, even you who have had such an experience as that of today.
uz: Sizda butun imoningiz kerak bo'ladi, hatto bugungidek tajribalarga ega bo'lganlar ham.

en: What is here told, he laid his hand heavily and gravely on the packet of papers as he spoke, may be the beginning of the end to you and me and many another, or it may sound the knell of the Un-Dead who walk the earth.
uz: Bu yerda aytilganlar, - dedi u gapirganida, qo'lini qog'ozlar to'pasiga og'ir va jiddiy qilib qo'ydi, - siz va men va boshqa ko'plab odamlar uchun oxiratning boshlanishi bo'lishi mumkin, yoki bu yer yuzida yuradigan O'lmaydiganlar qo'ng'iroqini eshitishi mumkin.

en: Read all, I pray you, with the open mind, and if you can add in any way to the story here told do so, for it is all important.
uz: Iltimos, barchasini ochiq ong bilan o'qing va agar siz bu erda aytib o'tilgan hikoyaga biror narsa qo'shishingiz mumkin bo'lsa, shunday qiling, chunki bularning barchasi muhimdir.

en: You have kept a diary of all these so strange things, is it not so?
uz: Siz bu g'alati narsalarning hammasini yozuvda qoldirdingiz, shunday emasmi?

en: Then we shall go through all these together when we meet. He then made ready for his departure and shortly drove off to Liverpool Street.
uz: Keyin uchrashganimizda bularning barchasini birgalikda o'tkazib yuboramiz. Keyin u ketish uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rdi va birozdan keyin Liverpul ko'chasini bosib o'tdi.

en: I took my way to Paddington, where I arrived about ﬁf- teen minutes before the train came in.
uz: Men Paddingtonga bordim va poyezd kelishidan taxminan besh daqiqa oldin u yerga yetib keldim.

en: The crowd melted away, after the bustling fashion common to arrival platforms, and I was beginning to feel uneasy, lest I might miss my guest,
uz: Ko'pchilik, kelish platformasiga o'xshaydigan mashg'ulotlardan so'ng, yig'ilib ketdi va men o'zimni noqulay his qila boshladim, ehtimol mehmonimni yo'qotib qolaman.

en: when a sweet-faced, dainty looking girl stepped up to me, and after a quick glance said, Dr.
uz: O'shanda bir qizning yuzidagi go'zal, chiroyli ko'rinishi menga yaqinlashdi va tezroq ko'z ochib: Dr.

en: Seward, is it not? And you are Mrs.
uz: Seward, shunday emasmi? - deb so'radi.

en: Harker! I answered at once, whereupon she held out her hand.
uz: Harker! deb javob berdim va u qo'lini ko'tardi.

en: I knew you from the description of poor dear Lucy, but…  She stopped suddenly, and a quick blush overspread her face.
uz: Men seni kambag'al sevimli Luzi tasviridan bilardim, lekin... U to'xtab qoldi va tezda yuzini qizg'inlatdi.

en: The blush that rose to my own cheeks somehow set us both at ease, for it was a tacit answer to her own.
uz: O'z yigimlarimga ko'tarilgan qizillik ikkovimizni ham xotirjamlashtirdi, chunki bu uning o'zlariga so'zsiz javob edi.

en: I got her luggage, which included a type- writer, and we took the Underground to Fenchurch Street, after I had sent a wire to my housekeeper to have a sitting room and a bedroom prepared at once for Mrs.
uz: Men uning bagajlarini olib, ularda matbaa yozuvchisi ham bo'lgan va men uy xodimiga bir vaqtning o'zida xonim uchun turar joy va yotoq xonasi tayyorlanishi uchun telegram yuborganimdan so'ng, metroda Fenchurch ko'chasiga bordik.

en: In due time we arrived.
uz: Vaqt o'tib biz keldik.

en: She knew, of course, that the place was a lunatic asylum, but I could see that she was unable to repress a shudder when we entered.
uz: Albatta, u bu joyning aqldan ozganlar uyasi ekanligini bilardi, lekin biz kirganimizda u titrishni to'xtata olmaganini ko'rdim.

en: She told me that, if she might, she would come presently to my study, as she had much to say.
uz: U menga, agar imkon bo'lsa, tezda mening tadqiqimga kelishini aytdi, chunki aytadigan so'zlari ko'p edi.

en: So here I am ﬁnishing my entry in my phonograph di- ary whilst I await her.
uz: Shunday qilib, men uni kutib turganimda, fonografimga kirishimni yakunlayapman.

en: As yet I have not had the chance of looking at the pa- pers which Van Helsing left with me, though they lie open before me.
uz: Van Helsing menga qoldirgan qog'ozlarni ko'rishga hali imkoniyatim bo'lmagandi, lekin ular ko'zimda ochiq.

en: I must get her interested in something, so that I may have an opportunity of reading them.
uz: Men uni biror narsa bilan qiziqtirishim kerak, shunda men ularni o'qish imkoniyatiga ega bo'laman.

en: She does not know how precious time is, or what a task we have in hand.
uz: U vaqt qanchalik qimmatbaho ekanligini yoki bizda qanday vazifa borligini bilmaydi.

en: I must be careful not to frighten her.
uz: Men uni qo'rqitmaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 29 September.—After I had tidied myself, I went down to Dr.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 29 Sentyabr.O'zimni yaxshi tiklaganimdan so'ng, doktorning huzuriga bordim.

en: At the door I paused a moment, for I thought I heard him talking with some one.
uz: Eshik oldida biroz to'xtab qoldim, chunki uning kimnidir gapirayotganini eshitganimni his qildim.

en: As, however, he had pressed me to be quick, I knocked at the door, and on his calling out, Come in, I entered.
uz: Biroq, u menga tezroq borishga majbur bo'lganida, eshikni taqillatdim va u uyga kir deb baqirganida, men kirdim.

en: To my intense surprise, there was no one with him.
uz: O'zimni juda hayratda qoldirganimcha, u bilan hech kim yo'q edi.

en: He was quite alone, and on the table opposite him was what I knew at once from the description to be a phonograph.
uz: U juda yolg'iz edi va o'zi oldida o'tirgan dasturxonda fonograf deb bilganim bor edi.

en: I had never seen one, and was much interested.
uz: Men hech qachon uni ko'rmagan edim va juda qiziqdim.

en: I hope I did not keep you waiting, I said, but I stayed at the door as I heard you talking, and thought there was someone with you. Oh, he replied with a smile, I was only entering my diary. Your diary? I asked him in surprise.
uz: Seni kutmagan bo'lsam yaxshi bo'lardi, dedim men,  lekin gapirganingni eshitib, eshik oldida turib, kimdir bor deb o'yladim. Oh, - dedi u tabassum bilan. - Men faqat o'z kundaligimni yozib yurgan edim. - Sizning kundaligingizmi? deb so'radim.

en: I keep it in this. As he spoke he laid his hand on the phonograph.
uz: Men uni shuda saqlayman. U gapirganida qo'lini fonografga qo'ydi.

en: I felt quite excited over it, and blurted out, Why, this beats even shorthand!
uz: Men bu haqda juda hayajonlanib: Bu hatto qisqartma so'zlardan ham ustundir!

en: May I hear it say something?
uz: Uni biror narsa aytishini eshitishim mumkinmi?

en: Certainly, he replied with alacrity, and stood up to put it in train for speaking.
uz: - Albatta, - deb javob qaytardi u, so'zlash uchun to'xtashib turdi.

en: Then he paused, and a troubled look overspread his face.
uz: Keyin u to'xtadi va qayg'urgan ko'z yuzini qopladi.

en: The fact is, he began awkwardly.I only keep my diary in it, and as it is entirely, almost entirely, about my cases it may be awkward, that is, I mean …  He stopped, and I tried to help him out of his embarrassment.
uz: Aqiqat shundaki, - dedi u noqulay boshladi u. - Men faqat o'z kundaligimni o'zimda saqlayman, va bu butunlay, deyarli butunlay, mening holatlarim haqida bo'lgani uchun, bu noqulay bo'lishi mumkin, ya'ni, men...  U to'xtadi va men unga o'z og'irligidan xalos bo'lishga yordam berishga harakat qildim.

en: You helped to attend dear Lucy at the end.
uz: Oxirida sen aziz Lusiga tashrif buyurishga ko'maklashding.

en: Let me hear how she died, for all that I know of her, I shall be very grateful.
uz: Uning o'limi haqida bilganlarim uchun juda minnatdor bo'laman.

en: She was very, very dear to me. To my surprise, he answered, with a horrorstruck look in his face, Tell you of her death?
uz: U menga juda, juda aziz edi. - deb hayratda qoldim, u qo'rqinchli ko'z bilan javob berdi: Uning o'limi to'g'risida sizga aytsam bo'ladimi?

en: Not for the wide world! Why not? I asked, for some grave, terrible feeling was coming over me.
uz: Dunyo uchun emas! - deb so'radim, chunki menga jiddiy va dahshatli his-tuyg'u tushdi.

en: Again he paused, and I could see that he was trying to invent an excuse.
uz: U yana to'xtadi va men uning uzr topishga harakat qilayotganini ko'rdim.

en: At length, he stammered out, You see, I do not know how to pick out any particular part of the diary. Even while he was speaking an idea dawned upon him, and he said with unconscious simplicity, in a different voice, and with the naivete of a child, that's quite true, upon my honor.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, u: Bilasizmi, men kundalikdagi biron-bir qismni qanday tanlashni bilmayman, - deb gapirgan.Hattoki u gapirgan paytda unga bir fikr keldi va u bexabar soddalik bilan, boshqa ovoz bilan va bola kabi naiflik bilan shunday dedi: Bu mening sharafim uchun to'g'ri.

en: Honest Indian! I could not but smile, at which he grimaced.I gave myself away that time! he said.
uz: Dono hindistonlik! - deb tabassum qilib qo'ydim va u o'ziga qarab: O'zimni o'sha paytdan beri berardim! - dedi.

en: But do you know that, although I have kept the diary for months past, it never once struck me how I was going to ﬁnd any particular part of it in case I wanted to look it up? By this time my mind was made up that the diary of a doctor who attend- ed Lucy might have something to add to the sum of our knowledge of that terrible Being, and I said boldly, Then, Dr.
uz: O'tgan oylar davomida jurnalni saqlagan bo'lsam-da, agar uni qidirmoqchi bo'lsam, uning biron bir qismini qanday topishim mumkinligini hech qachon tasavvur qilmaganimni bilasizmi? - deb so'radi. O'sha paytga kelib, Luziyaga tashrif buyurgan shifokorning jurnalida bu dahshatli mavjudot haqidagi bilimlarimizning umumiy summasiga qo'shilishi mumkinligi haqida o'yladim.

en: Seward, you had better let me copy it out for you on my typewriter. He grew to a positively deathly pallor as he said, No!
uz: Seward, men uni o'z yozma mashinamga nusxa qilib bersam yaxshi bo'lardi. - dedi u, Yo'q!

en: I wouldn't let you know that terrible story.! Then it was terrible.
uz: Men sizga bu dahshatli hikoyani aytishga ruxsat bermayman! - dedi.

en: My intuition was right!
uz: Mening his-tuyg'ularim to'g'ri edi!

en: For a moment, I thought, and as my eyes ranged the room, unconsciously looking for something or some opportunity to aid me, they lit on a great batch of typewriting on the table.
uz: Bir zum o'yladim, ko'zlarim xonani ko'rib, menga yordam berish uchun biron bir narsa yoki imkoniyat izlayotganda, stol ustida katta bir matbaa parchasi yoritildi.

en: His eyes caught the look in mine, and without his thinking, followed their direction.
uz: Uning ko'zlari mening ko'zimga o'xshaydi va o'ylamasdan ularning yo'l-yo'riqlariga ergashadi.

en: As they saw the parcel he realized my meaning.
uz: Ular paketni ko'rganlarida, mening ma'noni tushundi.

en: You do not know me, I said.
uz: Men: Sen meni tanimaysan, - dedim.

en: When you have read those papers, my own diary and my husband's also, which I have typed, you will know me better.
uz: O'sha qog'ozlarni, o'z kundaligimni va erimning ham yozganimni o'qiganingizdan so'ng, siz meni yaxshiroq bilib olasiz.

en: I have not faltered in giving every thought of my own heart in this
uz: Men bu borada yuragimdagi har bir fikrni berishga to'sqinlik qilmadim

en: But, of course, you do not know me, yet, and I must not expect you to trust me so far. He is certainly a man of noble nature.
uz: Ammo, albatta, siz meni hali tanimaysiz va men sizdan hozirgacha menga ishonishingizni kutmasligim kerak. U, albatta, buyuk tabiatning odamidir.

en: Poor dear Lucy was right about him.
uz: Darhaqiqat, kambag'al Lucy u haqida to'g'ri fikrda edi.

en: He stood up and opened a large drawer, in which were arranged in or- der a number of hollow cylinders of metal covered with dark wax, and said, You are quite right.
uz: U o'rnidan turib, katta sovg'ani ochdi, unda bir nechta qora sham bilan qoplangan metall bo'sh cylindrlar joylashtirilgan edi va shunday dedi: Siz to'g'ri aytdingiz.

en: I did not trust you because I did not know you.
uz: Men sizni tanimaganim uchun sizga ishonmadim.

en: But I know you now, and let me say that I should have known you long ago.
uz: Ammo men sizlarni hozir taniganman va oldindan tanishib olishim kerakligini aytaman.

en: I know that Lucy told you of me.
uz: Men bilamanki, Lusi men haqimda sizga gapirgan.

en: She told me of you too.
uz: U menga siz haqingizda ham aytib berdi.

en: May I make the only atonement in my power?
uz: Mening qo'limda bo'lgan yagona gunohni kechirishim mumkinmi?

en: Take the cylinders and hear them.
uz: Silindrlarni olib, ularni tinglang.

en: The ﬁrst half-dozen of them are personal to me, and they will not horrify you.
uz: Ularning birinchi yarim dozini men uchun shaxsiydir va ular sizni qo'rqitmaydi.

en: Then you will know me better.
uz: Shunda siz meni yaxshiroq bilib olasiz.

en: Dinner will by then be ready.
uz: O'sha paytgacha kechki ovqat tayyor bo'ladi.

en: In the meantime I shall read over some of these documents, and shall be better able to under- stand certain things. He carried the phonograph himself up to my sitting room and adjusted it for me.
uz: Shu paytgacha men ushbu hujjatlarning ba'zilarini o'qib, ba'zi narsalarni yaxshiroq tushunishga qodir bo'laman. U fonografni o'zi o'zi xonadonga olib kelib, menga moslashtirdi.

en: Now I shall learn something pleasant, I am sure.
uz: Endi men yoqimli narsani o'rganaman, shubhasiz.

en: For it will tell me the other side of a true love episode of which I know one side already.
uz: Chunki bu menga haqiqiy sevgi epizodining boshqa tomonini aytadi, uning bir tomonini allaqachon bilaman.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 29 September.—I was so absorbed in that wonderful diary of Jonathan Harker and that other of his wife that I let the time run on without thinking.
uz: SEWARDning 29 sentabr kuni yorlig'i.Men Jonatan Xarker va uning xotini bilan o'sha ajoyib yorlig'iga shunchalik aralashib ketdimki, vaqtni o'ylab ko'rmay o'tishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: Harker was not down when the maid came to announce dinner, so I said, She is possibly tired.
uz: Xizmatkor kechki ovqatni e'lon qilish uchun kelganida Harker uxlamagan edi, shuning uchun men: U, ehtimol, charchagan.

en: Let dinner wait an hour, and I went on with my work.
uz: O'sha kuni kechki ovqat bir soat kutadi, - deb so'rab, ishimni davom ettirdim.

en: I had just ﬁnished Mrs.
uz: Men xonimning so'nggi ishini tugatgan edim.

en: Harker's diary, when she came in.
uz: Harkerning kundaligi, u kelganida.

en: She looked sweetly pretty, but very sad, and her eyes were ﬂushed with crying.
uz: U yoqimli va chiroyli ko'rinardi, lekin juda xafa edi va ko'zlari yig'lashdan to'lib-toshdi.

en: This somehow moved me much.
uz: Bu meni juda hayajonlantirdi.

en: Of late I have had cause for tears, God knows!
uz: Oxirgi paytlarda ko'z yoshlarimga sabab bo'ldi, Xudo biladi!

en: But the relief of them was denied me, and now the sight of those sweet eyes, brightened by recent tears, went straight to my heart.
uz: Ammo ular meni yengillashtirmadi va endi o'sha shirin ko'zlarimni ko'rish, so'nggi oyog'im bilan yorqinlash, qalbimga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tushdi.

en: So I said as gen- tly as I could, I greatly fear I have distressed you. Oh, no, not distressed me, she replied.
uz: Shunday qilib, men imkon qadar ko'proq hushyorlik bilan: Sizni xafa qilganimdan juda xafa bo'laman, - dedim.

en: But I have been more touched than I can say by your grief.
uz: Ammo men sizning qayg'ularingizdan ko'ra ko'proq ta'sir oldim.

en: That is a wonderful machine, but it is cruelly true.
uz: Bu ajoyib mashina, lekin bu shafqatsiz haqiqat.

en: It told me, in its very tones, the anguish of your heart.
uz: Bu menga o'z o'z so'zlari bilan yuragingizdagi qayg'ularni aytdi.

en: It was like a soul crying out to Almighty God.
uz: O'shanda bu xuddi Xudoyi Taoloning huzurida faryod chekayotgan ruh kabi edi.

en: No one must hear them spoken ever again!
uz: Hech kim ularni yana eshitmasligi kerak!

en: See, I have tried to be useful.
uz: Mana, men foydali bo'lishga harakat qildim.

en: I have copied out the words on my typewriter, and none other need now hear your heart beat, as I did. No one need ever know, shall ever know, I said in a low voice.
uz: Men matbaa mashinamdagi so'zlarni nusxa qilib oldim va boshqa hech kim endi sizning yuragingiz urib ketayotganini eshitishga muhtoj emas. - Hech kim hech qachon bilmasligi kerak, hech qachon bilmasligi kerak, - dedim men kam ovoz bilan.

en: She laid her hand on mine and said very gravely, Ah, but they must! Must!
uz: U qo'lini mening qo'limga qo'ydi va juda jiddiy javob berdi: A, lekin ular kerak!

en: Because it is a part of the terrible story, a part of poor Lucy's death and all that led to it.
uz: Chunki bu dahshatli hikoyaning bir qismi, kambag'al Luzining o'limi va unga olib kelgan barcha narsalar.

en: Because in the struggle which we have before us to rid the earth of this terrible monster we must have all the knowledge and all the help which we can get.
uz: Chunki yer yuzini bu dahshatli jondordan xalos etish uchun kurashda biz barcha bilim va yordamga ega bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: I think that the cylinders which you gave me con- tained more than you intended me to know.
uz: O'ylaymanki, siz menga bergan silindrlar siz bilmoqchi bo'lganimdan ko'ra ko'proq narsani o'z ichiga olgan.

en: But I can see that there are in your record many lights to this dark mystery.
uz: Ammo men sizning yozuvingizda bu qorong'i sirga ko'plab yorug'liklar borligini ko'rib turibman.

en: You will let me help, will you not?
uz: Siz menga yordam berishga ruxsat berasiz, shunday emasmi?

en: I know all up to a certain point, and I see already, though your diary only took me to 7 September, how poor Lucy was beset, and how her terri- ble doom was being wrought out.
uz: Men hamma narsani ma'lum bir nuqtagacha bilaman, va sizning kundaligingiz meni faqat 7 sentabrgacha olib borgan bo'lsa ham, kambag'al Lusi qanday muammon bo'lganini va uning dahshatli halok bo'lishi qanday amalga oshayotganini allaqachon ko'rib turibman.

en: Jonathan and I have been working day and night since Professor Van Helsing saw us.
uz: Professor Van Helsing bizni ko'rganidan beri Jonatan va men kechayu kunduz ishlayapmiz.

en: He is gone to Whitby to get more information, and he will be here tomorrow to help us.
uz: U ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun Uitbiga bordi va ertaga bizga yordam berish uchun bu yerda bo'ladi.

en: We need have no secrets amongst us.
uz: Biz o'z aramizda hech qanday sirlarga muhtoj emasmiz.

en: Working together and with absolute trust, we can surely be stronger than if some of us were in the dark. She looked at me so appealingly, and at the same time manifested such courage and resolution in her bearing, that I gave in at once to her wishes.
uz: Birgalikda va mutlaqo ishonch bilan ishlayotganimizda, ba'zilarimiz qorong'ilikda bo'lganimizda bo'lganidan ham kuchliroq bo'lishimiz mumkin.U menga juda yoqimli qarab, bir vaqtning o'zida o'z yurish-turishi bilan shunchalik jasoratli va qat'iy bo'lganini ko'rsatdiki, men darhol uning xohishlariga bo'ysundim.

en: You shall, I said, do as you like in the matter.
uz: Men: Siz bu masalada o'zingiz xohlaganingizni qilasiz.

en: God forgive me if I do wrong!
uz: Agar xato qilsam, Xudo meni kechirsin!

en: There are terrible things yet to learn of.
uz: Hattoki o'rganish uchun dahshatli narsalar bor.

en: But if you have so far trav- eled on the road to poor Lucy's death, you will not be content, I know, to remain in the dark.
uz: Ammo agar siz bu qadar kambag'al Lusiyning o'limi yo'lida sayohat qilgan bo'lsangiz, bilganimcha, qorong'ilikda qolishga rozi bo'lmaysiz.

en: Nay, the end, the very end, may give you a gleam of peace.
uz: Aksincha, oxirgi kun, ya'ni oxirgi kun, sizga tinchlik nurini ato etishi mumkin.

en: Come, there is dinner.
uz: Keling, kechki ovqat bo'ladi.

en: We must keep one another strong for what is before us.
uz: Biz oldimizda turgan narsa uchun bir-birimizni mustahkam saqlashimiz kerak.

en: We have a cruel and dreadful task.
uz: Bizda shafqatsiz va dahshatli vazifa bor.

en: When you have eaten you shall learn the rest, and I shall answer any questions you ask, if there be anything which you do not understand, though it was apparent to us who were present. MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 29 September.—After dinner I came with Dr.
uz: Ovqat yeganingizdan so'ng, qolgan narsalarni bilib olasiz va agar siz biron bir narsani tushunmayotgan bo'lsangiz, men sizga javob beraman, - dedi MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 29 sentabr kuni.

en: Seward to his study.
uz: Seward o'z studiyasiga boradi.

en: He brought back the phonograph from my room, and I took a chair, and arranged the phonograph so that I could touch it without getting up, and showed me how to stop it in case I should want to pause.
uz: U o'zimning xonamdan fonografni qaytarib olib keldi, men o'rindiqga o'tirdim va fonografni turmasdan ushlab turishim uchun joylashtirdim va agar to'xtatmoqchi bo'lsam, uni qanday to'xtatishni ko'rsatdim.

en: Then he very thoughtfully took a chair, with his back to me, so that I might be as free as possible, and began to read.
uz: So'ngra u o'tirgan o'rinni o'zi o'ylab oldi va men iloji boricha erkin bo'lishim uchun orqaga qarab o'qishni boshladi.

en: I put the forked metal to my ears and listened.
uz: Men qulog'imga kirgizilgan metallni qo'ydim va tingladim.

en: When the terrible story of Lucy's death, and all that followed, was done, I lay back in my chair powerless.
uz: Lusiyning o'limi haqidagi dahshatli hikoya va undan keyin sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealar tugagandan so'ng, men o'zimning o'rinchimda hech qanday kuchim yo'q edi.

en: Fortunately I am not of a fainting disposi- tion.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, o'zimni chalg'itadigan ruhim yo'q.

en: Seward saw me he jumped up with a horriﬁed exclamation, and hurriedly taking a case bottle from the cupboard, gave me some brandy, which in a few minutes somewhat restored me.
uz: Seward meni ko'rib, qo'rqinchli ovozda ko'tarildi va darhol omboridan shisha botilini olib, menga brendi berdi, bu esa bir necha daqiqadan keyin meni qaytarib berdi.

en: My brain was all in a whirl, and only that there came through all the multitude of horrors, the holy ray
uz: Mening miyam butunlay to'qnashuvda edi va faqatgina bu qo'rqinchlarning ko'pligi orqali muqaddas nur paydo bo'ldi.

en: of light that my dear Lucy was at last at peace, I do not think I could have borne it without making a scene.
uz: Qizim Lusi oxir-oqibat tinchlikka erishganini ko'rib, o'ylaymanki, men o'ylamagan holda uni ko'tarishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: It is all so wild and mysterious, and strange that if I had not known Jonathan's experience in Transylvania I could not have believed.
uz: Bularning barchasi shunchalik yovvoyi va sirli va g'ayrioddiyki, agar Jonatanning Transilvaniyadagi tajribasi haqida bilmaganimda, ishonolmasdim.

en: As it was, I didn't know what to believe, and so got out of my difﬁculty by attending to something else.
uz: Shunday qilib, nimaga ishonishni bilmasdim va boshqa narsa bilan qiyinchiliklardan xalos bo'ldim.

en: I took the cover off my typewriter, and said to Dr.
uz: Men matbaa mashinamning qopqog'ini olib tashlab, doktorga aytdim:

en: Seward, Let me write this all out now.
uz: Seward: Buni hozir yozishga ruxsat bering.

en: We must be ready for Dr.
uz: Biz Dr. uchun tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: Van Helsing when he comes.
uz: Van Helsing kelganda.

en: I have sent a telegram to Jonathan to come on here when he arrives in London from Whitby.
uz: Jonatanni Uitbidan Londonga kelganida bu yerga kelishi uchun telegramma yubordim.

en: In this matter dates are everything, and I think that if we get all of our material ready, and have every item put in chronological order, we shall have done much.
uz: Bu masalada sanalar hamma narsani o'z ichiga oladi va men o'ylaymanki, agar biz barcha materiallarimizni tayyorlab, har bir elementni xronologik tartibda joylashtirsak, biz ko'p ishlarni amalga oshirgan bo'lamiz.

en: You tell me that Lord Godalming and Mr.
uz: Siz menga Lord Godalming va Mr.

en: Morris are coming too.
uz: Morris ham kelmoqda.

en: Let us be able to tell them when they come. He accordingly set the phonograph at a slow pace, and I began to type- write from the beginning of the seventeenth cylinder.
uz: Ular qachon kelishini ularga aytib berishimiz mumkin. U fonografni sekin o'rnatdi va men o'n yettinchi silinderning boshidan boshlanganda yozishni boshladim.

en: I used manifold, and so took three copies of the diary, just as I had done with the rest.
uz: Men ko'paytuvchadan foydalanganman va shu sababli, qolganlar bilan qilganimdek, kundalik kitobning uch nusxasini oldim.

en: It was late when I got through, but Dr.
uz: Men o'tgach, kech edi, lekin doktor

en: Seward went about his work of going his round of the patients.
uz: Seward o'z ishini davom ettirib, bemorlarning atrofini o'tkazdi.

en: When he had ﬁnished he came back and sat near me, read- ing, so that I did not feel too lonely whilst I worked.
uz: Ishni tugatgandan so'ng, u qaytib kelib, yonimda o'tirib, o'qishni boshladi, shunda men ishda yolg'izlik hissiyotini his qilmasdim.

en: How good and thoughtful he is.
uz: U qanchalik mehribon va mulohazakor ekan.

en: The world seems full of good men, even if there are mon- sters in it.
uz: Dunyo yaxshi odamlar bilan to'lib-toshgan ko'rinadi, hatto unda sehrgarlar bo'lsa ham.

en: Before I left him I remembered what Jonathan put in his diary of the Pro- fessor's perturbation at reading something in an evening paper at the station at Exeter, so, seeing that Dr.
uz: Undan ketishdan oldin, Jonatan o'zining kundalik kitobida professorning kechki gazetaga chiqqan biron bir narsani o'qiganidan xavotirlanganini eslab qoldim.

en: Seward keeps his newspapers, I borrowed the ﬁles of `The Westminster Gazette' and `The Pall Mall Gazette' and took them to my room.
uz: Seward o'z gazetalarini saqlaydi, men `The Westminster Gazette' va `The Pall Mall Gazette' fayllarini qarz oldim va ularni xonamga olib bordim.

en: I remember how much the `Dailygraph' and `The Whitby Gazette', of which I had made cuttings, had helped us to understand the ter- rible events at Whitby when Count Dracula landed, so I shall look through the evening papers since then, and perhaps I shall get some new light.
uz: `Dailygraph' va `The Whitby Gazette'da chop etilgan bo'limlar, Count Dracula jo'natgan paytda Whitbyda sodir bo'lgan dahshatli voqealarni tushunishga qanchalik yordam berganini eslayman, shuning uchun men o'sha paytdan boshlab kechki gazetalarni ko'rib chiqaman va ehtimol yangi yorug'lik topa olaman.

en: I am not sleepy, and the work will help to keep me quiet.
uz: Men uxlamayman va ish meni uxlatishga yordam beradi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 30 September.—Mr.
uz: SEWARD'S DIARY 30 sentabr kuni.Mr.

en: Harker arrived at nine o'clock.
uz: Harker soat to'qqizda keldi.

en: He got his wife's wire just before starting.
uz: U dam olishdan oldin xotini simini oldi.

en: He is uncommonly clever, if one can judge from his face, and full of energy.
uz: Agar yuzidan o'ylab ko'rsak, u o'ta aqlli va kuch-quvvatga to'la.

en: If this journal be true, and judging by one's own wonderful experiences, it must be, he is also a man of great nerve.
uz: Agar bu jurnal haqiqat bo'lsa va o'z tajribasiga qarab, albatta shunday bo'lishi kerak, u ham katta g'ayratli odam.

en: That go- ing down to the vault a second time was a remarkable piece of daring.
uz: O'sha vaftga ikkinchi marta tushish katta jasoratni ko'rsatdi.

en: reading his account of it I was prepared to meet a good specimen of man- hood, but hardly the quiet, business-like gentleman who came here today.
uz: Uning hikoyasini o'qiganimda, men yaxshi odamning namunasini uchratishga tayyor edim, lekin bugun bu yerga kelgan tinch, ishbilarmon xonimga hech qachon duch kelmasdim.

en: LATER.—After lunch Harker and his wife went back to their own room, and as I passed a while ago I heard the click of the typewriter.
uz: KUNChI.Tunchdan so'ng Harker va uning xotini o'z xonasiga qaytib borishdi va men bir muncha vaqt oldin o'tib ketayotganimda, matbaa mashinasining bosilishini eshitdim.

en: They are hard at it.
uz: Ular juda qiyin.

en: Harker says that knitting together in chronological order every scrap of evidence they have.
uz: Harkerning aytishicha, ular mavjud bo'lgan har bir dalilni xronologik tartib bilan bog'lab qo'yishgan.

en: Harker has got the letters between the con- signee of the boxes at Whitby and the carriers in London who took charge of them.
uz: Harkerning oldiga Whitbydagi qutilarning muallifi va ular ustidan nazoratni o'z zimmasiga olgan Londondagi tashuvchilar o'rtasidagi xatlar keldi.

en: He is now reading his wife's transcript of my diary.
uz: Hozir u rafiqasining mening kundaligimdagi transkriptini o'qiyotgan.

en: I wonder what they make out of it.
uz: O'zimni o'ylaymanki, ular undan nima qilishadi.

en: Here it is … Strange that it never struck me that the very next house might be the Count's hiding place!
uz: Mana, bu... ajablanarli narsa, men o'ylamaymanki, keyingi uy Countning yashirin joyidir!

en: Goodness knows that we had enough clues from the conduct of the patient Renﬁeld!
uz: Xudo biladiki, bemor Renfieldning xulq-atvoridan yetarlicha dalillar topdik!

en: The bundle of letters relating to the pur- chase of the house were with the transcript.
uz: Uyning ta'qiblari bilan bog'liq maktublar to'plami transkripsiya bilan birga edi.

en: Oh, if we had only had them earlier we might have saved poor Lucy!
uz: Oh, agar biz ularni ilgari olgan bo'lsak, kambag'al Lusiyani qutqargan bo'lar edik!

en: That way madness lies!
uz: Shunday qilib, aqlsizlik yolg'on gapiradi!

en: Harker has gone back, and is again collecting material.
uz: Harker qaytib ketdi va yana material to'plamoqda.

en: He says that by din- ner time they will be able to show a whole connected narrative.
uz: Uning aytishicha, vaqt o'tib ular butun bog'liq hikoyani namoyish etishlari mumkin.

en: He thinks that in the meantime I should see Renﬁeld, as hitherto he has been a sort of index to the coming and going of the Count.
uz: Uning fikricha, bu vaqtgacha men Renfieldni ko'rishim kerak, chunki u allaqachon Countning kelishi va ketishi uchun bir xil ko'rsatkich bo'lgan.

en: I hardly see this yet, but when I get at the dates I suppose I shall.
uz: Men buni hali ko'rmayapman, lekin kunlarga yetib kelganimda, ehtimol ko'rasiz.

en: What a good thing that Mrs.
uz: Xoʻsh, bu xonimning yaxshilik qilganini koʻrish juda yaxshi.

en: Harker put my cylinders into type!
uz: Harker mening silindrlarimni tipga qo'ydi!

en: We never could have found the dates otherwise.
uz: Aks holda biz hech qachon sanalarni topolmas edik.

en: I found Renﬁeld sitting placidly in his room with his hands folded, smil- ing benignly.
uz: Men Renfieldni o'z xonasida qo'llarini qo'yib, tinchlik bilan o'tirgan holda ko'rdim.

en: At the moment he seemed as sane as any one I ever saw.
uz: O'sha paytda u men ko'rgan har bir odamdek aqlli ko'rinardi.

en: I sat down and talked with him on a lot of subjects, all of which he treated natu- rally.
uz: Men o'tirib, u bilan ko'plab mavzularda suhbatlashdim, ularning barchasi natiy-rally bilan bog'liq edi.

en: He then, of his own accord, spoke of going home, a subject he has never mentioned to my knowledge during his sojourn here.
uz: Keyin u o'z-o'zidan uyga qaytish haqida gapirdi, bu borada u bu yerda bo'lganida, men bilganimcha, hech qachon bu mavzuga e'tibor bermagan.

en: In fact, he spoke quite conﬁdently of getting his discharge at once.
uz: Aslida, u darhol ishdan chiqarilishi haqida o'ziga ishonib gapirgan.

en: I believe that, had I not had the chat with Harker and read the letters and the dates of his outbursts, I should have been prepared to sign for him after a brief time of observation.
uz: Agar Harker bilan suhbatlashmaganimda va uning xatlari va portlashlari sanalarini o'qmaganimda, u uchun qisqa kuzatuvdan keyin imzolashga tayyor bo'lar edim, deb o'ylayman.

en: As it is, I am darkly suspicious.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, men qorong'i shubha ostiga qo'yganman.

en: All those outbreaks were in some way linked with the proximity of the Count.
uz: Bularning barchasi Countning yaqinligi bilan bog'liq edi.

en: What then does this absolute con- tent mean?
uz: Xo'sh, bu mutlaq cheklov nimani anglatadi?

en: Can it be that his instinct is satisﬁed as to the vampire's ultimate triumph?
uz: Ehtimol, uning hujayralari vampirning yakuniy g'alaba qozonishiga qanoatlantirgan bo'lishi mumkinmi?

en: He is himself zoophagous, and in his wild ravings outside the chapel door of the deserted house he always spoke of `master'.
uz: U o'zi zoofag bo'lib, chindan ham charchagan uyning kapella eshikidan tashqarida o'zining yovvoyi o'tlarida doim `master' haqida gapirgan.

en: This all seems conﬁrmation of our idea.
uz: Bularning barchasi bizning g'oyamizni tasdiqlaydi.

en: However, after a while I came away.
uz: Biroq, bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, men ketib ketdim.

en: My friend is just a little too sane at present to make it safe to probe him too deep with questions.
uz: Do'stim hozirgi vaqtda juda sog'lom bo'lib, uni savollar bilan chuqurroq tekshirib ko'rishga qodir emas.

en: He might begin to think, and then … So I came away.
uz: U o'ylab ko'rishni boshlaydi va keyin... men ketdim.

en: I mistrust these quiet moods of of his, so I have given the attendant a hint to look closely after him, and to have a strait waistcoat ready in case of need.
uz: Men uning tinchlik ruhidan nafratlanaman, shuning uchun xizmatkorga uning ustidan diqqat bilan qarash va kerak bo'lganda, uni tayyorlab qo'yishga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun maslahat berdim.

en: JOHNATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 29 September, in train to London.—When I received Mr.
uz: 29 sentabr kuni Londonga poyezdda borgan Jonatan Xarkerning jurnalini ko'rdim.

en: Billington's courteous message that he would give me any information in his power I thought it best to go down to Whitby and make, on the spot, such inquiries as I wanted.
uz: Billingtonning o'z qo'lida bo'lgan har qanday ma'lumotni menga beradi degan xushmuomala so'zlariga ko'ra, men Uitbiga borib, o'zim xohlagan so'rovlarni o'z vaqtida berishni afzal ko'rdim.

en: It was now my object to trace that horrid cargo of the Count's to its place in London.
uz: Endi mening maqsadim Countning bu dahshatli yukini Londondagi joyiga yetkazish edi.

en: Later, we may be able to deal with it.
uz: Keyinchalik biz bunga duch kelishimiz mumkin.

en: Billington ju- nior, a nice lad, met me at the station, and brought me to his father's house, where they had decided that I must spend the night.
uz: Billington kichik, yaxshi yigit, meni stansiyada uchratdi va meni otasining uyiga olib keldi, u erda ular kechani o'tkazishga qaror qilishdi.

en: They are hospitable, with true Yorkshire hospitality, give a guest everything and leave him to do as he likes.
uz: Ular mehmondo'st, haqiqiy Yorkshir mehmondo'stligi bilan mehmondo'st bo'lishadi, mehmonga hamma narsani berishadi va o'zi xohlaganini qilishadi.

en: They all knew that I was busy, and that my stay was short, and Mr.
uz: Ular mening mashg'ul bo'lganimni va vaqtim qisqa ekanini hammamiz bilardik.

en: Billington had ready in his ofﬁce all the papers concerning the consign- ment of boxes.
uz: Billingtonning ofisida qutilarni jo'natish to'g'risidagi barcha hujjatlar tayyor edi.

en: It gave me almost a turn to see again one of the letters which I had seen on the Count's table before I knew of his diabolical plans.
uz: Bu menga Countning dasturxonida ko'rgan xatlaridan birini yana ko'rish uchun deyarli o'zgarishga sabab bo'ldi. Uning yovuz rejalari haqida bilishdan oldin.

en: Every- thing had been carefully thought out, and done systematically and with pre- cision.
uz: Hamma narsa diqqat bilan o'ylab, muntazam va aniq tarzda amalga oshirilgan edi.

en: He seemed to have been prepared for every obstacle which might be placed by accident in the way of his intentions being carried out.
uz: U o'z niyatlarini amalga oshirishga to'sqinlik qiladigan har qanday to'siqga tayyor bo'lgan ko'rinardi.

en: To use an Americanism, he had `taken no chances', and the absolute accuracy with which his instructions were fulﬁlled was simply the logical result of his care.
uz: Amerikalik so'zini qo'llash uchun, u hech qanday imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritmagan va uning yo'l-yo'riqlari to'liq aniq bajarilganligi uning g'amxo'rligi natijasida paydo bo'lgan.

en: I saw the invoice, and took note of it.`Fifty cases of common earth, to be used for experimental purposes'.
uz: Men hisobvaraqni ko'rdim va uni qayd etdim.

en: Also the copy of the letter to Carter Pa- terson, and their reply.
uz: Shuningdek, Karter Patersonga yo'llangan maktubning nusxasi va ularning javobi.

en: Of both these I got copies.
uz: Ikkalasi ham men uchun nusxadir.

en: This was all the informa- tion Mr.
uz: Bu barcha ma'lumotlar Mr. haqida edi.

en: Billington could give me, so I went down to the port and saw the coastguards, the Customs Ofﬁcers and the harbor master, who kindly put me in communication with the men who had actually received the boxes.
uz: Billington menga berishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun men portga tushdim va sohil qo'riqchilari, bojxona xodimlari va port boshlig'ini ko'rdim, ular meni qutilarni qabul qilgan odamlar bilan muloqotga qo'yishdi.

en: Their tally was exact with the list, and they had nothing to add to the simple description `ﬁfty cases of common earth', except that the boxes were `main and mortal heavy', and that shifting them was dry work.
uz: Ularning hisob-kitoblari ro'yxatga to'g'ri kelgan va oddiy tavsifaga qo'shishga hech narsa yo'q edi, faqatgina qutilar yordamchi va o'limli og'ir edi va ularni ko'chirish quruq ish edi.

en: One of them added that it was hard lines that there wasn't any gentleman `such like as like yourself, squire', to show some sort of appreciation of their efforts in a liq- uid form.
uz: Ulardan biri qo'shimcha qilib aytdiki, siz kabi hech qanday gentleman yo'qligi uchun ularning harakatlariga liq-uid shaklida minnatdorchilik bildirish qiyin edi.

en: Another put in a rider that the thirst then generated was such that even the time which had elapsed had not completely allayed it.
uz: Boshqa bir kishi otliqni o'tkazib yubordi va u suvga chanqoq bo'lgani uchun, hatto o'tgan vaqt ham uni to'liq yo'q qildi.

en: Needless to add, I took care before leaving to lift, forever and adequately, this source of reproach.
uz: Darhaqiqat, ketishdan oldin bu ayb manbasini abadiy va to'g'ri olib tashlashga harakat qildim.

en: 30 September.—The station master was good enough to give me a line to his old companion the station master at King's Cross, so that when I arrived
uz: 30 sentabr.Stantsiyaning boshlig'i menga oldingi hamkori, King's Crossdagi stantsiyaning boshlig'i bilan bog'liq so'zlarni aytishga qodir edi, shuning uchun men kelganimda

en: there in the morning I was able to ask him about the arrival of the boxes.
uz: O'sha kuni ertalab men unga qutilar kelib qolgani haqida so'rashim mumkin edi.

en: He, too put me at once in communication with the proper ofﬁcials, and I saw that their tally was correct with the original invoice.
uz: U ham meni darhol tegishli rasmiylar bilan aloqaga qo'ydi va ularning hisob-kitoblari asl faktura bilan to'g'ri ekanligini ko'rdim.

en: The opportunities of acquiring an abnormal thirst had been here limited.
uz: Bu yerda anormal chanqog'i paydo bo'lish imkoniyati cheklangan edi.

en: A noble use of them had, however, been made, and again I was compelled to deal with the result in ex post facto manner.
uz: Biroq, ulardan buyuk foydalanish amalga oshirildi va yana men natijani ex post facto yo'l bilan hal etishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: From thence I went to Carter Paterson's central ofﬁce, where I met with the utmost courtesy.
uz: U yerdan Carter Patersonning markaziy ofisida bo'lganimda, u yerda men katta xushmuomalalik bilan uchrashdim.

en: They looked up the transaction in their day book and letter book, and at once telephoned to their King's Cross ofﬁce for more de- tails.
uz: Ular o'zlarining kunlik va xatlar daftarlarida bitimlarni ko'rib chiqdilar va ko'proq tafsilotlar so'rash uchun darhol King's Cross ofislariga qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.

en: By good fortune, the men who did the teaming were waiting for work, and the ofﬁcial at once sent them over, sending also by one of them the way-bill and all the papers connected with the delivery of the boxes at Car- fax.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, jamoaviy ishchilar ishni kutishardi va rasmiy ularni darhol yuborib, ulardan biri tomonidan yo'l hisobvarag'i va kartonlarni Car-faxga yetkazib berish bilan bog'liq barcha hujjatlar yuborildi.

en: Here again I found the tally agreeing exactly.
uz: Bu yerda ham hisob-kitoblar to'g'ri kelishganini ko'rdim.

en: The carriers' men were able to supplement the paucity of the written words with a few more details.
uz: Tushkunlarning odamlari yozma so'zlarning kamligini bir necha tafsilotlar bilan to'ldirishlari mumkin edi.

en: These were, I shortly found, connected almost solely with the dusty nature of the job, and the consequent thirst engendered in the operators.
uz: Bular, men yaqinda aniqladimki, deyarli faqat ishning changli xususiyati va operatorlarda paydo bo'lgan chanqog'i bilan bog'liq edi.

en: On my af- fording an opportunity, through the medium of the currency of the realm, of the allaying, at a later period, this beneﬁcial evil, one of the men remarked, That `ere `ouse, guv'nor, is the rummiest I ever was in.
uz: O'zim imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritganimda, shohlikning valyutasida, keyinchalik bu foydali yovuzlikni yo'q qilish orqali, erkaklardan biri shunday dedi: Bu `ere `ouse, guv'nor, men allaqachon bo'lgan eng yaxshi holat.

en: But it ain't been touched sence a hundred years.
uz: Ammo bu bir yuz yildan beri qo'llanilmagan.

en: There was dust that thick in the place that you might have slep' on it without `urtin' of yer bones.
uz: Bu yerda tuproq shunchalik katta bo'lganki, uning suyaklarini o'g'irlatmasdan ushlab turish mumkin edi.

en: An' the place was that neglected that yer might `ave smelled ole Jerusalem in it.
uz: Bu joyda Yerusalaymning xushbo'y tuyg'usi bo'lishi mumkinligini unutib qo'ygan edi.

en: But the old chapel, that took the cike, that did!Me and my mate, we thort we wouldn't never git out quick enough.
uz: Ammo eski chapel, bu o'z vaqtida o'tadi!Men va do'stim, biz hech qachon etarlicha tez chiqmaymiz, deb o'yladik.

en: Lor', I wouldn't take less nor a quid a moment to stay there arter dark. Having been in the house, I could well believe him, but if he knew what I know, he would, I think have raised his terms.
uz: Men uyda bo'lganimdan so'ng unga ishonardim, lekin u men bilgan narsani bilsa, o'zi ko'taradi, deb o'ylayman. O'z shartlarini ko'targan.

en: Of one thing I am now satisﬁed.
uz: Hozirda bitta narsadan mamnunman.

en: That all those boxes which arrived at Whitby from Varna in the Demeter were safely deposited in the old chapel at Carfax.
uz: Demeterdagi Varna shahridan Whitbi shahriga kelgan barcha qutilar Carfaxdagi eski chapelga xavfsiz joylashtirildi.

en: There should be ﬁfty of them there, unless any have since been removed, as from Dr.
uz: U yerda ellik nafar bo'lishi kerak, agar hech biri o'sha paytdan beri olib tashlanmagan bo'lsa, Dr.

en: Seward's diary I fear.
uz: Men qo'rqaman, Sewardning kundaligi.

en: Later.—Mina and I have worked all day, and we have put all the papers into order.
uz: Keyinroq.Men va men kun bo'yi ishladik va barcha hujjatlarni tartibga soldik.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 September.—I am so glad that I hardly know how to contain myself.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 Sentyabr.Men shunchalik xursandmanki, o'zimni to'xtatishni ham bilmayman.

en: It is, I suppose, the reaction from the haunting fear which I have had, that this terrible affair and the reopening of his old wound might act detrimentally on
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu men boshdan kechirgan dahshatli qo'rquvning reaktsiyasi bo'lib, bu dahshatli hodisa va uning eski yaralarining qayta ochilishi unga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

en: I saw him leave for Whitby with as brave a face as could, but I was sick with apprehension.
uz: U imkon qadar jasoratli va jasoratli surat bilan Uitbi shahriga ketayotganini ko'rdim, lekin men qo'rquvdan bezovta edim.

en: The effort has, however, done him good.
uz: Biroq, harakatlar unga yaxshilik qildi.

en: He was never so resolute, never so strong, never so full of volcanic energy, as at present.
uz: U hech qachon hozirgidek qat'iy, kuchli va volkanik energiya bilan to'lgan bo'lmagan.

en: It is just as that dear, good Professor Van Helsing said, he is true grit, and he improves under strain that would kill a weaker nature.
uz: Mana shu aziz va yaxshi professor Van Helsing aytganidek, u haqiqiy jasoratli va u zaif tabiatni o'ldiradigan bosim ostida yaxshilanadi.

en: He came back full of life and hope and determination.
uz: U hayot, umid va qat'iy qaror bilan qaytdi.

en: We have got everything in or- der for tonight.
uz: Bu kecha uchun hamma narsa tayyorlangan.

en: I feel myself quite wild with excitement.
uz: O'zimni hayajon bilan juda yovvoyi his qilaman.

en: I suppose one ought to pity anything so hunted as the Count.
uz: O'ylaymanki, Count kabi ovlanadigan har bir narsaga rahmdil bo'lish kerak.

en: This thing is not human, not even a beast.
uz: Bu narsa inson emas, hatto hayvon ham emas.

en: Seward's account of poor Lucy's death, and what followed, is enough to dry up the springs of pity in one's heart.
uz: Sewardning kambag'al Lusiyning o'limi va undan keyin sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqidagi hikoyasi yurakdagi rahm-shafqat manbalarini quritish uchun etarli.

en: Later.—Lord Godalming and Mr.
uz: Keyinroq.Lord Godalming va Mr.

en: Morris arrived earlier than we expect- ed.
uz: Morris biz kutgandan ham tezroq keldi.

en: Seward was out on business, and had taken Jonathan with him, so I had to see them.
uz: Seward ishda edi va Jonatanni o'zi bilan birga olib borgan edi, shuning uchun men ularni ko'rishim kerak edi.

en: It was to me a painful meeting, for it brought back all poor dear Lucy's hopes of only a few months ago.
uz: Bu men uchun og'riqli uchrashuv edi, chunki u kambag'al Lucyning bir necha oy oldin ko'rgan barcha umidlarini qaytadan keltirdi.

en: Of course they had heard Lucy speak of me, and it seemed that Dr.
uz: Albatta, ular Lusiyamni men haqimda gapirganini eshitishgan va bu D.

en: Van Helsing, too, had been quite `blow- ing my trumpet', as Mr.
uz: Van Helsing ham o'zimning qo'ng'iroqimni o'chirib qo'ygan edi.

en: Morris expressed it.
uz: Morris buni ifodaladi.

en: Poor fellows, neither of them is aware that I know all about the proposals they made to Lucy.
uz: Yomon odamlar, ularning ikkalasi ham ularning Lusiga bergan takliflari haqida men hamma narsani bilaman, deb o'ylamaydilar.

en: They did not quite know what to say or do, as they were ignorant of the amount of my knowledge.
uz: Ular nima deyishlarini yoki nima qilishlarini bilmas edilar, chunki ular mening bilimlarimni bilmas edilar.

en: So they had to keep on neutral subjects.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular neytral mavzularda qolishlari kerak edi.

en: However, I thought the matter over, and came to the conclusion that the best thing I could do would be to post them on affairs right up to date.
uz: Biroq, men bu haqda o'ylab ko'rdim va eng yaxshi xulosaga keldimki, ularni yangiliklarga yozib qo'yish mumkin.

en: Seward's diary that they had been at Lucy's death, her real death, and that I need not fear to betray any secret before the time.
uz: Sewardning kundalik kitobi shuni ko'rsatadiki, ular Lusiyning o'limida, uning haqiqiy o'limida bo'lishgan va bu vaqtgacha hech qanday sirni aytishdan qo'rqmasligim kerak.

en: So I told them, as well as I could, that I had read all the papers and diaries, and that my husband and I, having type- written them, had just ﬁnished putting them in order.
uz: Shunday qilib, men ularga barcha qog'ozlar va kundaliklarni o'qiganimni va erim bilan ularni yozganimizdan so'ng ularni tuzatishni tugatganimni aytdim.

en: I gave them each a copy to read in the library.
uz: Men ularga har biriga kutubxonada o'qish uchun nusxa berdim.

en: When Lord Godalming got his and turned it over, it does make a pretty good pile, he said, Did you write all this, Mrs.
uz: Lord Godalming o'zini olib, uni o'zgartirganida, u juda yaxshi to'plamga aylangan edi, u shunday dedi: Buning barchasini siz yozganmisiz, xonim?

en: Harker? I nodded, and he went on.
uz: Harker? - deb boshimni yumdim va u davom etdi.

en: I don't quite see the drift of it, but you people are all so good and kind, and have been working so earnestly and so energetically, that all I can do is to accept your ideas blindfold and try to help you.
uz: Men bularning qanday bo'lishini aniq tushunmayapman, lekin sizlarning hammangiz juda yaxshi va mehribon va juda g'ayratli va jonli bo'lib ishlaysizlar, shuning uchun men faqat sizning g'oyalaringizni ko'zlarimni bog'lab qabul qilib, sizga yordam berishga harakat qilaman.

en: I have had one lesson al- ready in accepting facts that should make a man humble to the last hour of his life.
uz: Men o'zimning hayotimning oxirgi soatiga qadar insonni kamtarin qilish kerak bo'lgan faktlarni qabul qilish borasida bir saboq oldim.

en: Besides, I know you loved my Lucy …  Here he turned away and covered his face with his hands.
uz: Bundan tashqari, men bilamanki, siz mening Lusiyamni yaxshi ko'rdingiz...  Bu yerda u yuz o'girib, yuzini qo'llari bilan qopladi.

en: I could hear the tears in his voice.
uz: Men uning ovozidagi yoshlarni eshitardim.

en: Morris, with instinctive delicacy, just laid a hand for
uz: Morris instinktli mehribonlik bilan qo'lini qo'yib berdi.

en: a moment on his shoulder, and then walked quietly out of the room.
uz: O'zining yelkasida bir zum turib, xonadan xotirjamlik bilan chiqib ketdi.

en: I sup- pose there is something in a woman's nature that makes a man free to break down before her and express his feelings on the tender or emotional side without feeling it derogatory to his manhood.
uz: Ayolning tabiatida erkak kishiga uning oldida o'z his-tuyg'ularini izchil yoki hissiy tomondan ifoda etish va o'z erkakligiga haqorat ko'rsatishni istamagan holda erkinlik beradigan bir narsa borligini tasavvur qilaman.

en: For when Lord Godalming found himself alone with me he sat down on the sofa and gave way utterly and openly.
uz: Chunki Lord Godalming men bilan yolg'iz qolganda, sofaga o'tirib, butunlay va ochiqchasiga yo'l qo'ydi.

en: I sat down beside him and took his hand.
uz: Men uning yonida o'tirib, qo'lidan ushlab qoldim.

en: I hope he didn't think it forward of me, and that if her ever thinks of it afterwards he never will have such a thought.
uz: Umid qilamanki, u bu haqda oldindan o'ylamagan va agar u keyinchalik bu haqda o'ylab ko'rsa, u hech qachon bunday fikrga ega bo'lmaydi.

en: I know he never will.
uz: O'zim bilsam, u hech qachon bunday qilmaydi.

en: He is too true a gentleman.
uz: U juda sodiq gentleman.

en: I said to him, for I could see that his heart was breaking, I loved dear Lucy, and I know what she was to you, and what you were to her.
uz: Uning yuragini ko'rishim uchun unga shunday dedim: Men aziz Lusiyoni yaxshi ko'rardim va uning sen uchun nimani anglatishini bilaman.

en: She and I were like sisters, and now she is gone, will you not let me be like a sister to you in your trouble?
uz: U bilan men singillardek edik, endi u yo'qolgan ekan, muammolaringizda menga singil bo'lishimga yo'l qo'ymaysizmi?

en: I know what sorrows you have had, though I cannot measure the depth of them.
uz: Men sizning qayg'ularingizni bilaman, ammo ularning chuqurligini o'lchay olmayman.

en: If sympathy and pity can help in your afﬂiction, won't you let me be of some little service, for Lucy's sake? In an instant the poor dear fellow was overwhelmed with grief.
uz: Agar hamdardlik va rahm-shafqat sizning qayg'uingizga yordam berishi mumkin bo'lsa, Lucy uchun menga yordam bermaysizmi? - deb so'rashdi.

en: It seemed to me that all that he had of late been suffering in silence found a vent at once.
uz: O'shanda uning so'nggi paytlarda sessizlikda azob chekayotgan barcha narsalari darhol nafas olish imkoniga ega bo'lgan deb o'yladim.

en: He grew quite hysterical, and raising his open hands, beat his palms together in a perfect agony of grief.
uz: U juda histerik bo'lib, ochiq qo'llarini ko'tarib, mukammal qayg'u azobida qo'l qo'llarini urdi.

en: He stood up and then sat down again, and the tears rained down his cheeks.
uz: U o'rnidan turib, yana o'tirdi va ko'z yoshlari uning yig'ini yog'di.

en: I felt an inﬁnite pity for him, and opened my arms unthinkingly.
uz: Men unga cheksiz rahm-shafqat ko'rsatib, o'ylamasdan qo'llarimni ochdim.

en: With a sob he laid his head on my shoulder and cried like a wearied child, whilst he shook with emotion.
uz: U boshini yelkamga qo'yib, charchagan bola kabi yig'ladi.

en: We women have something of the mother in us that makes us rise above smaller matters when the mother spirit is invoked.
uz: Ayollar, bizda ona ruhining bir qismi bo'lib, ona ruhi chaqirilayotganda, kichikroq masalalardan ustun qo'yishga yordam beradi.

en: I felt this big sorrowing man's head resting on me, as though it were that of a baby that some day may lie on my bosom, and I stroked his hair as though he were my own child.
uz: Men bu katta qayg'uli odamning boshini o'zim ustimda tutayotganini his qildim, xuddi bir kun mening ko'nglimda yotgan chaqaloqning boshini his qilganimdek, sochlarini o'zimning o'g'lim kabi sochirdim.

en: I never thought at the time how strange it all was.
uz: O'shanda bularning barchasi qanchalik g'alati ekanligi haqida hech qachon o'ylamagan edim.

en: After a little bit his sobs ceased, and he raised himself with an apology, though he made no disguise of his emotion.
uz: Bir oz vaqt o'tgach, uning yig'lashlari to'xtadi va u o'zini kechirim so'rab o'zini ko'tardi, ammo his-tuyg'ularini ko'rsatmadi.

en: He told me that for days and nights past, weary days and sleepless nights, he had been unable to speak with any one, as a man must speak in his time of sorrow.
uz: U menga o'tgan kunlar va kechalar, charchagan kunlar va uxlamaydigan kechalar davomida hech kim bilan gaplasholmagani haqida aytdi, chunki inson qayg'u paytida gapirish kerak.

en: There was no woman whose sympathy could be given to him, or with whom, owing to the terrible circumstance with which his sorrow was surrounded, he could speak freely.
uz: Unga hissa qo'shadigan ayol yo'q edi yoki uning qayg'usi atrofidagi dahshatli vaziyat tufayli erkin gapira oladigan ayol yo'q edi.

en: I know now how I suffered, he said, as he dried his eyes, but I do not know even yet, and none other can ever know, how much your sweet sym- pathy has been to me today.
uz: Hndi men qanday azob chekganimni bilaman, - dedi u ko'zlarini quritgan holda, lekin men hali ham bilmayman va boshqa hech kim hech qachon bilmaydi, sizning shirin hamdardligingiz bugun men uchun qanchalik muhim edi.

en: I shall know better in time, and believe me that,
uz: Vaqt o'tib yaxshiroq bilib olaman va ishoning,

en: though I am not ungrateful now, my gratitude will grow with my under- standing.
uz: Garchi hozir men minnatdorchilik bildirmagan bo'lsam-da, minnatdorligim o'sib boradi.

en: You will let me be like a brother, will you not, for all our lives, for dear Lucy's sake? For dear Lucy's sake, I said as we clasped hands.Ay, and for your own sake, he added, for if a man's esteem and gratitude are ever worth the winning, you have won mine today.
uz: Siz meni butun hayotimiz davomida qarindosh bo'lishimga yo'l qo'yursiz, shunday emasmi? - dedim men qo'llarimni bir-biriga qo'shganimizda. - Ha, o'zingiz uchun ham, - dedi u qo'shimcha qilib. - Agar bir odamning hurmat va minnatdorligi g'alaba qozonishga arziydigan bo'lsa, bugun siz mening g'alaba qozongandirsiz.

en: If ever the future should bring to you a time when you need a man's help, believe me, you will not call in vain.
uz: Agar kelajakda sizga birovning yordami kerak bo'lgan payt kelsa, ishoning, siz bekorga qo'ng'iroq qilmaysiz.

en: God grant that no such time may ever come to you to break the sunshine of your life, but if it should ever come, promise me that you will let me know. He was so earnest, and his sorrow was so fresh, that I felt it would com- fort him, so I said, I promise. As I came along the corridor I say Mr.
uz: Xudo sizga hayotingizning quyosh nurini sindirish uchun hech qachon bunday vaqt kelmasligi kerak, lekin agar shunday bo'lsa, menga xabar berishga va'da bering. U shunchalik jiddiy edi va uning qayg'usi shunchalik yangi ediki, uni tasalli berishini his qildim, shuning uchun men: Men va'da beraman.

en: Morris looking out of a window.
uz: Morris o'rindiqdan ko'rinadi.

en: He turned as he heard my footsteps.
uz: O'z qadamlarimni eshitib, o'girilib ketdi.

en: How is Art? he said.
uz: Art qanday? - dedi u.

en: Then noticing my red eyes, he went on,Ah, I see you have been comforting him.
uz: Keyin mening qizil ko'zlarimni ko'rib, u davom etdi: A, ko'rib turibmanki, siz uni tasalli beryapsiz.

en: No one but a woman can help a man when he is in trou- ble of the heart, and he had no one to comfort him. He bore his own trouble so bravely that my heart bled for him.
uz: Yurak qayg'usi bo'lganda, ayoldan boshqa hech kim erkakka yordam bera olmaydi va uni tasalli beradigan hech kim yo'q edi. U o'z muammolarini shunchalik jasorat bilan boshdan kechirdiki, yuragim uning uchun qon to'kdi.

en: I saw the manuscript in his hand, and I knew that when he read it he would realize how much I knew, so I said to him,I wish I could comfort all who suffer from the heart.
uz: Qo'lida qo'lyozma borligini ko'rdim va uni o'qiganida men qanchalik yaxshi bilganimni tushunishini bilardim, shuning uchun unga: Agar yurakdan azob chekayotganlarni tasalli bersam bo'lar edi, - dedim.

en: Will you let me be your friend, and will you come to me for comfort if you need it?
uz: Siz menga do'st bo'lishimga yo'l qo'yurmisiz va kerak bo'lganda tasalli olish uchun menga murojaat qilasizmi?

en: You will know later why I speak. He saw that I was in earnest, and stooping, took my hand, and raising it to his lips, kissed it.
uz: Nima uchun gapirayotganimni keyinroq bilib olasiz.U mening chin dildan gapirayotganimni ko'rib, tiz cho'kdi, qo'limdan ushlab, og'ziga ko'tardi va o'pdi.

en: It seemed but poor comfort to so brave and unselﬁsh a soul, and impulsively I bent over and kissed him.
uz: Bunday jasoratli va begʻaraz ruhga bu kamroq tasallidek tuyuldi va men uni oʻzimni oʻzim bilan oʻgʻillab oʻgʻlim bilan oʻpdim.

en: The tears rose in his eyes, and there was a momentary choking in his throat.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida ko'z yoshlari ko'tarildi va qo'l boshi biroz cho'kkan edi.

en: He said quite calmly,Lit- tle girl, you will never forget that true hearted kindness, so long as ever you live! Then he went into the study to his friend.
uz: U juda xotirjamlik bilan dedi: Qizim, sen umrbod o'sha samimiy mehribonlikni hech qachon unutmaysan! Keyin u do'stiga studiyaga kirdi.

en: Little girl! The very words he had used to Lucy, and, oh, but he proved himself a friend.
uz: O'g'lim! - degan so'zlarni u Lusiga aytgan edi, lekin u o'zini do'st deb isbotlagan.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 30 September.—I got home at ﬁve o'clock, and found that Godalming and Morris had not only arrived, but had already studied the transcript of the various diaries and letters which Harker had not yet returned from his visit to the carriers' men, of whom Dr.
uz: SEWARDning DYARY 30 sentabr.Men beshlarda uyga kelganimda, Godalming va Morris nafaqat kelgan, balki Harker hali tashuvchilarga tashrif buyurganidan qaytib kelmagan har xil kundalik va maktublarning transkripti haqida o'rganganini va ulardan Dr.

en: Hennessey had written to me.
uz: Hennessey menga yozgan edi.

en: Harker gave us a cup of tea, and I can honestly say that, for the ﬁrst time since I have lived in it, this old house seemed like home.
uz: Harker bizga bir qadah choy berdi va men rostdan aytamanki, u yerda yashaganimdan beri birinchi marta bu eski uy o'z uyimdek ko'rindi.

en: When we had ﬁnished, Mrs.
uz: Biz tugatganimizda, xonim

en: Seward, may I ask a favor?
uz: Seward, men sizdan bir iltifot so'rasam bo'ladimi?

en: I want to see your patient, Mr.
uz: Men sizning bemoringizni ko'rmoqchiman, Mr.

en: What you have said of him in your diary interests me so much! She looked so appealing and so pretty that I could not refuse her, and there was no possible reason why I should, so I took her with me.
uz: U juda yoqimli va chiroyli ko'rinardi, men uni rad qila olmasdim va buning hech qanday sababi yo'q edi, shuning uchun men uni o'zim bilan olib ketdim.

en: When I went into the room, I told the man that a lady would like to see him, to which he simply answered, Why? She is going through the house, and wants to see every one in it, I answered.
uz: Xonaga kirganimda, odamga bir ayol uni ko'rishni xohlayotganini aytdim, u shunchaki: Nima uchun? deb javob berdi.

en: Oh, very well, he said,let her come in, by all means, but just wait a minute till I tidy up the place. His method of tidying was peculiar, he simply swallowed all the ﬂies and spiders in the boxes before I could stop him.
uz: Oh, juda yaxshi, dedi u, o'zini olib kirishga ruxsat bering, lekin men bu joyni tozalashimga bir daqiqa turing. Uning tozalash usuli o'ziga xos edi, uni to'xtata olmasimdan oldin, u qutilardagi barcha o'qlarni va o'qlarni yutib yubordi.

en: It was quite evident that he feared, or was jealous of, some interference.
uz: U qo'rqqan, yoki ba'zi bir aralashuvlardan hasad qilganligi aniq edi.

en: When he had got through his disgusting task, he said cheerfully, Let the lady come in, and sat down on the edge of his bed with his head down, but with his eyelids raised so that he could see her as she entered.
uz: U o'zining jirkanch vazifasini o'tkazganida, quvonch ila: Xonim kirsin, - deb aytdi va boshini pastga olib, lekin ko'z qo'llarini ko'tarib, uning kirayotganini ko'rish uchun to'sqinlik bilan o'tirdi.

en: For a moment I thought that he might have some homicidal intent.
uz: Bir zum o'yladimki, u o'ldirmoqchi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I remembered how quiet he had been just before he attacked me in my own study, and I took care to stand where I could seize him at once if he attempted to make a spring at her.
uz: O'zimning studiyamda menga hujum qilishdan oldin u qanchalik hushyor bo'lganini esladim va agar u ayolga qo'l urmoqchi bo'lsa, uni darhol qo'lga olishim mumkin bo'lgan joyda turishga g'amxo'rlik qildim.

en: She came into the room with an easy gracefulness which would at once command the respect of any lunatic, for easiness is one of the qualities mad people most respect.
uz: U xonaga osonlikcha xushmuomalalik bilan kirdi, bu esa har qanday aqldan ozgan kishining hurmatini qozonadi, chunki aqldan ozgan odamlar eng ko'p hurmat qiladigan fazilatlardan biridir.

en: She walked over to him, smiling pleasantly, and held out her hand.
uz: U mehribon tabassum bilan uning yoniga kelib, qo'lini uzatdi.

en: You see, I know you, for Dr.
uz: Bilasizmi, men sizni taniyman, doktor uchun.

en: Seward has told me of you. He made no immediate reply, but eyed her all over intently with a set frown on his face.
uz: Seward menga siz haqingizda gapirgan. - deb aytdi u. U darhol javob bermadi, balki qizga ko'z tikib, yuziga ko'z tikdi.

en: This look gave way to one of wonder, which merged in doubt, then to my intense astonishment he said, You're not the girl the doctor wanted to marry, are you?
uz: Bu ko'rinish, shubhaga to'lib ketgan hayratga to'lib, so'ng meni qattiq hayratda qoldirganidan so'ng, u: Siz shifokorning turmushga chiqmoqchi bo'lgan qiz emassiz, shundaymi?

en: You can't be, you know, for she's dead. Mrs.
uz: Siz bo'lmasligingiz mumkin, chunki u o'lgan.

en: Harker smiled sweetly as she replied, Oh no!
uz: Harker qizcha tabassum bilan javob berdi: Yo'q!

en: I have a husband of my own, to whom I was married before I ever saw Dr.
uz: O'zimning erim bor, u bilan uylanganman, lekin doktorni hech qachon ko'rmaganman.

en: Harker. Then what are you doing here? My husband and I are staying on a visit with Dr.
uz: Harker. Sho'ngra siz bu yerda nima qilyapsiz? Erim va men doktor Harkerning huzuriga tashrif buyuryapmiz.

en: Seward. Then don't stay. But why not? I thought that this style of conversation might not be pleasant to Mrs.
uz: Seward.  Shunday bo'lsa, qolmang.  Agar qolmasangiz, nima uchun? - deb so'raganimda, bu suhbat usuli xonim uchun yoqimli bo'lmasligi mumkin deb o'yladim.

en: Harker, any more than it was to me, so I joined in, How did you know I wanted to marry anyone? His reply was simply contemptuous, given in a pause in which he turned his eyes from Mrs.
uz: Harker, men uchun ham shunday edi, shuning uchun men unga qo'shildim: Men kim bilan turmush qurmoqchi ekanimni qanday bilding? - deb so'radim.

en: Harker to me, instantly turning them back again, What an asinine question! I don't see that at all, Mr.
uz: Harker menga qarab, ularni darhol yana orqaga burib: Bu qanday ahmoqona savol! - deb aytdi.

en: Harker, at once champi- oning me.
uz: Harker, birdan meni qo'lga oldim.

en: He replied to her with as much courtesy and respect as he had shown contempt to me, You will, of course, understand, Mrs.
uz: U menga hurmatsizlik ko'rsatgani kabi, unga ham xushmuomalalik va hurmat bilan javob berib: Siz, albatta, tushunasiz, xonim.

en: Harker, that when a man is so loved and honored as our host is, everything regarding him is of interest in our little community.
uz: Harker, agar bir odam mehmonimiz kabi sevilsa va hurmat qilinsa, u bilan bog'liq hamma narsa bizning kichik jamoamizda qiziqish uyg'otadi.

en: Seward is loved not only by his house- hold and his friends, but even by his patients, who, being some of them hardly in mental equilibrium, are apt to distort causes and effects.
uz: Sewardni nafaqat uy egasi va do'stlari, balki hatto bemorlari ham yaxshi ko'rishadi, chunki ularning ba'zilari aqliy muvozanatda emas, sababi va oqibatlarini buzishga moyil.

en: Since I myself have been an inmate of a lunatic asylum, I cannot but notice that the sophistic tendencies of some of its inmates lean towards the errors of non causa and ignoratio elenche. I positively opened my eyes at this new development.
uz: O'zim aqldan ozganlar uyidagi mahbus bo'lganim sababli, ayrim mahbuslarning murakkab tendentsiyalari non causa va ignoratio elenche xatolariga moyilligini payqadim. Men bu yangi rivojlanishga ko'zlarimni ijobiy tarzda ochdim.

en: Here was my own pet lunatic, the most pronounced of his type that I had ever met with, talk- ing elemental philosophy, and with the manner of a polished gentleman.
uz: Bu mening o'z uy hayvonim edi, bu mening hech qachon uchratgan o'z turiga ega bo'lgan, elemental falsafa haqida gapirgan va puxta janob kabi xulq-atvorli odam edi.

en: wonder if it was Mrs.
uz: O'ylab ko'ring, bu Xonimning o'zi bo'lganmi?

en: Harker's presence which had touched some chord in his memory.
uz: Harkerning xotirasida o'ziga xos tuyg'ularni uyg'otgan hozirligi.

en: If this new phase was spontaneous, or in any way due to her unconscious inﬂuence, she must have some rare gift or power.
uz: Agar ushbu yangi bosqich o'z-o'zidan yoki bexabar ta'siridan bo'lgan bo'lsa, unda u noyob sovg'a yoki kuchga ega bo'lishi kerak.

en: We continued to talk for some time, and seeing that he was seemingly quite reasonable, she ventured, looking at me questioningly as she began, to lead him to his favorite topic.
uz: Biz bir muncha vaqt suhbatni davom ettirdik va u, u juda oqilona ko'rinishini ko'rib, menga savollar berib qaray boshlaganida, uni sevimli mavzuga olib borishga jur'at qildi.

en: I was again astonished, for he addressed him- self to the question with the impartiality of the completest sanity.
uz: Men yana hayron qoldim, chunki u savolga o'zicha javob berdi va bu savolni to'liq aqli rasolik bilan javob berdi.

en: He even took himself as an example when he mentioned certain things.
uz: U hatto muayyan narsalarni aytib o'tganida o'zini o'ziga o'rnak ko'rsatgan.

en: Why, I myself am an instance of a man who had a strange belief.
uz: Men o'zim g'ayrioddiy e'tiqodga ega bo'lgan odamning misolim.

en: Indeed, it was no wonder that my friends were alarmed, and insisted on my being put under control.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, do'stlarim qo'rqib, meni nazoratga olishimni istaydiganida ajablanarli emas edi.

en: I used to fancy that life was a positive and perpetual enti- ty, and that by consuming a multitude of live things, no matter how low in the scale of creation, one might indeﬁnitely prolong life.
uz: O'zim hayot ijobiy va abadiy mavjudot deb o'ylagandim va ko'plab jonli mavjudotlarni iste'mol qilish orqali, yaratilish miqyosida qanchalik past bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, inson hayoti cheksiz ravishda uzaytirilishi mumkin.

en: At times I held the belief so strongly that I actually tried to take human life.
uz: Ba'zan men bu e'tiqodni shunchalik qattiq ushlab turardimki, hatto inson hayotini o'ldirishga harakat qildim.

en: The doctor here will bear me out that on one occasion I tried to kill him for the purpose of strengthening my vital powers by the assimilation with my own body of his life through the medium of his blood, relying of course, upon the Scriptural phrase, `For the blood is the life.' Though, indeed, the vendor of a certain nostrum has vulgarized the truism to the very point of contempt.
uz: Bu shifokor menga bir marta uni o'ldirishga uringanimni tasdiqlaydi, chunki men uning qonidan uning hayoti mening tanam bilan birlashtirib, uning hayotini o'z qobiliyatlarimga qo'llab-quvvatlash maqsadida uni o'ldirishga harakat qildim, albatta, Muqaddas Kitobning Qan hayotdir degan so'ziga asoslanib.

en: Isn't that true, doctor? I nodded assent, for I was so amazed that I hardly knew what to either think or say, it was hard to imagine that I had seen him eat up his spiders and ﬂies not ﬁve minutes before.
uz: To'g'ri emasmi, shifokor? - deb qo'shib qo'ydim, chunki men shunchalik hayron edimki, nima deb o'ylashimni ham, nima deb aytishni ham bilmasdim, undan besh daqiqa oldin uning o'zining o'z palaklarini yeydiganini va uchib ketayotganini ko'rganimni tasavvur qilish qiyin edi.

en: Looking at my watch, I saw that I should go to the station to meet Van Helsing, so I told Mrs.
uz: Soattimga qarab, Van Helsing bilan uchrashish uchun stantsiyaga borishim kerakligini ko'rdim, shuning uchun xonimga aytdim.

en: Harker that it was time to leave.
uz: Harker, ketish vaqti keldi, deb aytdi.

en: She came at once, after saying pleasantly to Mr.
uz: O'sha zahoti u Mr.ga xushmuomalalik bilan gapirganidan so'ng keldi.

en: Renﬁeld, Goodbye, and I hope I may see you often, under auspices pleasanter to yourself. To which, to my astonishment, he replied, Goodbye, my dear.
uz: Renfield: Xudojo'y bo'ling, tez-tez ko'rishishimga umid qilaman, o'zingizga yoqimli bo'lishingiz mumkin, - deb aytdi.

en: I pray God I may never see your sweet face again.
uz: Xudoga ibodat qilamanki, men boshqa hech qachon sizning go'zal yuzingizni ko'rmayman.

en: May He bless and keep you! When I went to the station to meet Van Helsing I left the boys behind me.
uz: U sizni qutqarsin va saqlasin! - deb aytdi.Men Van Helsing bilan uchrashish uchun stantsiyaga borganimda, o'g'illarni orqamda qoldirdim.

en: Poor Art seemed more cheerful than he has been since Lucy ﬁrst took ill, and Quincey is more like his own bright self than he has been for many a long day.
uz: Kambag'al San'at Lucy kasal bo'lganidan buyon ko'ra ko'proq quvonchli va Quincey ko'p yillar davomida bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq o'zining yorqin o'ziga o'xshaydi.

en: Van Helsing stepped from the carriage with the eager nimbleness of a boy.
uz: Van Helsing o'g'ilning g'ayratli o'rnagiga ega bo'lib, aravachadan chiqdi.

en: He saw me at once, and rushed up to me, saying, Ah, friend John, how goes all?
uz: U darhol meni ko'rib, yonimga yugurib kelib: A, do'stim Jon, qanday ishlar bor?

en: I have been busy, for I come here to stay if need be.
uz: Men juda mashg'ul bo'lganman, chunki agar kerak bo'lsa, bu yerga qolish uchun keldim.

en: All affairs are settled with me, and I have much to tell.
uz: Barcha ishlar men bilan tuzilgan va aytish uchun ko'p narsa bor.

en: And her so ﬁne husband?
uz: Va uning chiroyli eri?

en: And Arthur and my friend Quincey, they are with you, too?
uz: Artur va do'stim Quincey ham siz bilan birgami?

en: Good! As I drove to the house I told him of what had passed, and of how my own diary had come to be of some use through Mrs.
uz: Yaxshi! - deb uyga borganimda, men unga o'tgan voqealarni va Mrs. orqali o'z kundaligim qanday qilib foydali bo'lganini aytib berdim.

en: Harker's suggestion, at which the Professor interrupted me.
uz: Harkerning taklifiga javoban professor meni kesib qo'ydi.

en: Ah, that wonderful Madam Mina!
uz: Ah, bu ajoyib Madam Mina!

en: She has man's brain, a brain that a man should have were he much gifted, and a woman's heart.
uz: U erkakning miyasiga ega, agar u juda iqtidorli bo'lsa, erkakning miyasiga ega bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan miyasiga ega va ayolning yuragiga ega.

en: The good God fashioned her for a purpose, believe me, when He made that so good combi- nation.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo uni bir maqsad uchun yaratgan, ishoning, U shunday yaxshi bir millatni yaratganida.

en: Friend John, up to now fortune has made that woman of help to us, after tonight she must not have to do with this so terrible affair.
uz: Do'st Jon, hozirgacha bu ayolga omad yordam bergan, chunki bu kechadan keyin u bunday dahshatli ish bilan aloqasi bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: It is not good that she run a risk so great.
uz: U bunday katta xavf-xatarni boshdan kechirishi yaxshi emas.

en: We men are determined, nay, are we not pledged, to destroy this monster?
uz: Biz odamlar bu jondorni yo'q qilishga qaror qildik, yo'qmi?

en: But it is no part for a woman.
uz: Ammo bu ayol uchun o'rinli emas.

en: Even if she be not harmed, her heart may fail her in so much and so many horrors and hereafter she may suffer, both in waking,from her nerves, and in sleep,from her dreams.
