uz: Hatto unga zarar yetmasa ham, uning yuragi unga shuncha va shuncha dahshatli hodisalarda zaiflik qilishi mumkin va bundan keyin u uyg'onishda, hissiyotlarida va uxlayotganda tushlarida azob chekishi mumkin.

en: And, besides, she is young woman and not so long married, there may be other things to think of some time, if not now.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u yosh ayol va u hali turmush qurmagan, boshqa narsalar haqida o'ylash kerak bo'lishi mumkin, agar hozir bo'lmasa.

en: You tell me she has wrote all, then she must consult with us, but tomorrow she say goodbye to this work, and we go alone. I agreed heartily with him, and then I told him what we had found in his absence, that the house which Dracula had bought was the very next one to my own.
uz: Siz menga aytasizki, u hamma narsani yozgan, so'ngra biz bilan maslahatlashishi kerak, lekin ertaga u bu ish bilan xayrlashadi va biz yolg'iz ketamiz. Men u bilan chin dildan rozi bo'ldim va keyin unga uning yo'qligida topganimizni, Dracula sotib olgan uy mening o'zimnikiga yaqin ekani haqida aytdim.

en: He was amazed, and a great concern seemed to come on him.
uz: U hayratda qoldi va katta tashvishga tushdi.

en: Oh that we had known it before! he said, for then we might have reached him in time to save poor Lucy.
uz: Agar biz buni ilgari bilgan bo'lar edik! - dedi u, - chunki o'shanda kambag'al Lusiyani qutqarish uchun biz unga o'z vaqtida murojaat qilgan bo'lar edik.

en: However, `the milk that is spilt cries not out afterwards,'as you say.
uz: Biroq, siz aytganingizdek, quyilgan sut keyinchalik yig'maydi.

en: We shall not think of that, but go on our way to the end. Then he fell into a silence that lasted till we entered my own gateway.
uz: Biz bu haqda o'ylamaymiz, lekin oxirigacha davom etamiz. Keyin u o'zimning darvozimga kirgunga qadar davom etgan xotirjamlikka tushib qoldi.

en: Before we went to prepare for dinner he said to Mrs.
uz: Biz kechki ovqatga tayyorgarlik ko'rishdan oldin u xonimga:

en: Harker, I am told, Madam Mina, by my friend John that you and your husband have put up in exact order all things that have been, up to this moment. Not up to this moment, Professor,she said impulsively, but up to this morning. But why not up to now?
uz: Harker: Monim Mina, do'stim Jon menga sizning eringiz bilan hozirgacha bo'lgan barcha narsalarni to'g'ri tartibga solganingizni aytdi.

en: We have seen hitherto how good light all the little things have made.
uz: Hozircha biz barcha kichik narsalar qanday yaxshi yorug'lik yaratganini ko'rdik.

en: We have told our secrets, and yet no one who has told is the worse for it. Mrs.
uz: Biz o'z sirlarimizni oshkor qildik, ammo buni oshkor qilgan hech kim bundan og'irroq emas.

en: Harker began to blush, and taking a paper from her pockets, she said, Dr.
uz: Harker qizillashdi va o'z qoplaridan qog'oz olib: Dr.

en: Van Helsing, will you read this, and tell me if it must go in.
uz: Van Helsing, buni o'qib, u kirib borishi kerakmi yoki yo'qmi ayting.

en: It is my record of today.
uz: Bu mening bugungi rekordimdir.

en: I too have seen the need of putting down at present
uz: Men ham hozirgi vaqtda o'zimni qo'yib yuborish kerakligini ko'rdim.

en: everything, however trivial, but there is little in this except what is personal.
uz: Har bir narsa, qanchalik ahamiyatsiz bo'lmasin, lekin bu erda shaxsiy narsalardan tashqari juda kam narsa bor.

en: Must it go in? The Professor read it over gravely, and handed it back, saying, It need not go in if you do not wish it, but I pray that it may.
uz: Bu kirishi kerakmi? - deb o'qib berdi professor va uni qaytarib berdi. Agar siz xohlamasangiz, kirishi shart emas, lekin bu bo'lishi uchun ibodat qilaman.

en: It can but make your husband love you the more, and all us, your friends, more honor you, as well as more esteem and love. She took it back with another blush and a bright smile.
uz: Bu sizning eringizni sizni ko'proq sevishga, biz do'stlaringiz sizni ko'proq hurmat qilishga, hurmat va mehr-muhabbatga sazovor qilishga undaydi. - deb javob berdi u yana bir qizil va yorqin tabassum bilan.

en: And so now, up to this very hour, all the records we have are complete and in order.
uz: Shunday qilib, hozirgi kungacha bizda mavjud bo'lgan barcha yozuvlar to'liq va tartibli.

en: The Professor took away one copy to study after dinner, and before our meeting, which is ﬁxed for nine o'clock.
uz: Professor kechki ovqatdan keyin va to'qqizlarda o'tkazilgan uchrashuvdan oldin o'rganish uchun bir nusxani olib ketdi.

en: The rest of us have al- ready read everything, so when we meet in the study we shall all be in- formed as to facts, and can arrange our plan of battle with this terrible and mysterious enemy.
uz: Qolganlarimiz hamma narsani o'qishga tayyormiz, shuning uchun tadqiqotda uchrashib ko'rganimizda, hammamiz faktlar haqida bilimga ega bo'lib, ushbu dahshatli va sirli dushman bilan jang rejasini tuzishimiz mumkin.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 September.—When we met in Dr.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 Sentyabr.Dektor Harker bilan uchrashganimizda.

en: Seward's study two hours after din- ner, which had been at six o'clock, we unconsciously formed a sort of board or committee.
uz: Sewardning studiyasi kechki ovqatdan ikki soat o'tib, soat oltilarda bo'lgan edi, biz bexabar bir xil kengash yoki qo'mita tashkil qildik.

en: Professor Van Helsing took the head of the table, to which Dr.
uz: Professor Van Helsing stolning boshini oldi, unga dr.

en: Seward motioned him as he came into the room.
uz: Seward xonadonga kirganida unga ishora qildi.

en: He made me sit next to him on his right, and asked me to act as secretary.
uz: U meni o'ng tomonida o'tirtirishga majbur qildi va menga kotibi vazifasini bajarishni so'radi.

en: Jonathan sat next to me.
uz: Jonatan yonimda o'tirdi.

en: Opposite us were Lord Godalming, Dr.
uz: Orqa tomonimizda Lord Godalming, doktor

en: Morris, Lord Go- dalming being next the Professor, and Dr.
uz: Lord Go-dalming professorning yonida va doktor Morrisning yonida bo'ladi.

en: Seward in the center.
uz: Seward markazda.

en: The Professor said, I may, I suppose, take it that we are all acquainted with the facts that are in these papers. We all expressed assent, and he went on, Then it were, I think, good that I tell you something of the kind of ene- my with which we have to deal.
uz: Professor dedi: Mening fikrimcha, biz hammamiz ushbu maqolalardagi faktlar bilan tanishmiz, - deb o'ylayman. Biz hammamiz rozilik bildirdik va u davom etdi: O'shanda men o'ylaymanki, sizga muammoni hal qilishimiz kerak bo'lgan bir narsani aytib berishim yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: I shall then make known to you something of the history of this man, which has been ascertained for me.
uz: O'shanda men sizga ushbu odamning tarixidan bir narsani aytib beraman, bu men uchun aniqlandi.

en: So we then can discuss how we shall act, and can take our measure according.
uz: Shunday qilib, qanday yo'l tutish kerakligini muhokama qilib, o'z me'yorimizni o'zlashtirishimiz mumkin.

en: There are such beings as vampires, some of us have evidence that they exist.
uz: Vampirlar kabi mavjudotlar bor, ba'zilarimiz ularning borligiga dalillarga ega.

en: Even had we not the proof of our own unhappy experience, the teach- ings and the records of the past give proof enough for sane peoples.
uz: Hatto biz o'z baxtsiz tajribamizni tasdiqlamasak ham, o'tmishdagi ta'limotlar va yozuvlar sog'lom odamlar uchun etarlicha dalillar beradi.

en: I admit that at the ﬁrst I was sceptic.
uz: Shuni tan olishim kerakki, men dastlabda shubhali edim.

en: Were it not that through long years I have trained myself to keep an open mind, I could not have believed until such time as that fact thunder on my ear.`See!
uz: Agar uzoq yillar davomida o'zimni ochiq ongli bo'lishga o'rgatmaganimda edi, o'sha vaqtgacha bu haqiqatni quloqlarimga toshqin qilmagunimcha ishonolmasdim.

en: I prove, I prove.' Alas!
uz: Men isbotlayman, men isbotlayman.

en: Had I known at ﬁrst what now I know, nay, had I even guess at him, one so pre- cious life had been spared to many of us who did love her.
uz: Avval men hozir bilgan narsani bilganimda edi, balki, hatto uning o'zi haqida o'ylasam ham, uni yaxshi ko'rgan ko'pchiligimiz uchun shunchalik qimmatbaho hayot saqlanib qolgan bo'lardi.

en: But that is gone, and we must so work, that other poor souls perish not, whilst we can save.
uz: Ammo bu yo'qolgan va biz boshqa kambag'al jonlar qutqarilsa ham, ular halok bo'lmasligi uchun mehnat qilishimiz kerak.

en: The nosferatu do not die like the bee when he sting once.
uz: Nosferatular bir marta urib o'lishgan asali kabi o'lmaydi.

en: stronger, and being stronger, have yet more power to work evil.
uz: Kuchliroq va kuchliroq bo'lib, yomonlik qilish uchun yana ko'proq kuchga ega.

en: This vam- pire which is amongst us is of himself so strong in person as twenty men, he is of cunning more than mortal, for his cunning be the growth of ages, he have still the aids of necromancy, which is, as his etymology imply, the div- ination by the dead, and all the dead that he can come nigh to are for him at command, he is brute, and more than brute, he is devil in callous, and the heart of him is not, he can, within his range, direct the elements, the storm, the fog, the thunder, he can command all the meaner things, the rat, and the owl, and the bat, the moth, and the fox, and the wolf, he can grow and be- come small, and he can at times vanish and come unknown.
uz: Bu odam o'z-o'zidan yigirma kishidan ko'ra shaxsan kuchli, u o'ta hiylalidir, chunki uning hiyla-nayrangligi zamonlarning o'sishi, u hali ham necromancy vositalariga ega, ya'ni, uning etimologiyasi ko'rsatishicha, o'liklar tomonidan bo'linish, va u uchun qo'mondon bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha o'liklar, u vahshiy, va vahshiydan ko'ra vahshiy, u yovuz shayton, va uning yuragi emas, u o'z doirasidagi elementlarni, shovqin, tuman, g'azabni boshqarishi mumkin, u barcha yovuz narsalarni, shovqin, qo'r, tuxum, poliz, tilkash va o'rni boshqarishi mumkin, u o'sib-o'sib, kichik bo'lishi mumkin, va u noma'lum va behuda vaqtlarda keladi.

en: How then are we to begin our strike to destroy him?
uz: Unda uni yo'q qilish uchun hujumni qanday boshlaymiz?

en: How shall we ﬁnd his where, and having found it, how can we destroy?
uz: Uni qayerda topishimiz mumkin va uni topganimizda qanday yo'q qilishimiz mumkin?

en: My friends, this is much, it is a terri- ble task that we undertake, and there may be consequence to make the brave shudder.
uz: Do'stlarim, bu juda ko'p, biz o'zimiz bajarayotgan juda muhim vazifa va buning oqibatlari jasoratlilarni titratish bo'lishi mumkin.

en: For if we fail in this our ﬁght he must surely win, and then where end we?
uz: Chunki agar biz bu kurashda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasak, u albatta g'alaba qozonishi kerak, va keyin biz qayerga ketamiz?

en: Life is nothings, I heed him not.
uz: Hayot hech narsa emas, men unga e'tibor bermayman.

en: But to fail here, is not mere life or death.
uz: Ammo bu yerda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash shunchaki hayot yoki o'lim emas.

en: It is that we become as him, that we henceforward become foul things of the night like him, without heart or conscience, preying on the bodies and the souls of those we love best.
uz: Bu, biz unga o'xshagan bo'lishimiz, bundan buyon biz ham unga o'xshagan, yuragimiz va vijdonimiz bo'lmagan, eng yaxshi ko'radigan odamlarimizning tanasi va ruhi ustidan g'alaba qozonadigan, kechadagi nopok narsalarga aylanishimizdir.

en: To us forever are the gates of heaven shut, for who shall open them to us again?
uz: Osmon darvozalari biz uchun abadiy yopilgan, chunki ularni bizga yana kim ochadi?

en: We go on for all time ab- horred by all, a blot on the face of God's sunshine, an arrow in the side of Him who died for man.
uz: Biz hammaning jirkanchligi, Xudoning quyosh nuri yuzidagi lekasi, insoniyat uchun o'lgan Xudoning yonidagi o'q bo'lib, abadiy yashaymiz.

en: But we are face to face with duty, and in such case must we shrink?
uz: Ammo biz burchimiz bilan yuzma-yuz turamiz va bunday holatda kamroq bo'lishimiz kerakmi?

en: For me, I say no, but then I am old, and life, with his sun- shine, his fair places, his song of birds, his music and his love, lie far be- hind.
uz: Men uchun yo'q deyman, lekin o'shanda men keksa bo'lib, hayot, uning quyosh nuri, go'zal joylari, qushlarning qo'shigi, musiqa va sevgisi juda uzoq.

en: You others are young.
uz: Sizlar yoshlarsiz.

en: Some have seen sorrow, but there are fair days yet in store.
uz: Ba'zilar qayg'ularni ko'rishgan, ammo hali ham yaxshi kunlar kutib turibdi.

en: What say you? Whilst he was speaking, Jonathan had taken my hand.
uz: Sen nima deyasan? - deb so'zlay boshlaganida, Jonatan qo'limdan ushlab qoldi.

en: I feared, oh so much, that the appalling nature of our danger was overcoming him when I saw his hand stretch out, but it was life to me to feel its touch, so strong, so self reliant, so resolute.
uz: Men uning qo'lini uzatganini ko'rganimda, xavfning dahshatli xususiyati uni yengib ketayotganidan juda qo'rqardim, lekin uning ta'sirini his qilish men uchun hayot edi, chunki u juda kuchli, o'z-o'zidan asrashgan va qat'iy edi.

en: A brave man's hand can speak for itself, it does not even need a woman's love to hear its music.
uz: Jasoratli erning qo'li o'zi uchun gapira oladi, hatto musiqasini eshitish uchun ayolning sevgisiga ham muhtoj emas.

en: When the Professor had done speaking my husband looked in my eyes, and I in his, there was no need for speaking between us.
uz: Professor gapirganidan so'ng, erim mening ko'zimga, men esa uning ko'zlariga qaradi, biz o'rtasida gapirishning hojati yo'q edi.

en: I answer for Mina and myself, he said.
uz: Men Mina va o'zim uchun javob beraman, dedi u.

en: Count me in, Professor, said Mr.
uz: Meni hisoblang, professor, dedi Mr..

en: Quincey Morris, laconically as usual.
uz: Quincey Morris, odatdagidek lakonik.

en: I am with you, said Lord Godalming, for Lucy's sake, if for no other reason. Dr.
uz: Lord Godalming shunday dedi: Men siz bilan birga bo'laman, agar boshqa sabab bo'lmasa, Lusi uchun.

en: Seward simply nodded.
uz: Seward shunchaki bosh ko'tardi.

en: The Professor stood up and, after laying his golden cruciﬁx on the table, held out his hand on either side.
uz: Professor o'rnidan turib, oltin xochini stol ustiga qo'yganidan so'ng, qo'lini har ikki tomonga uzatdi.

en: I took his right hand, and Lord Godalming his left, Jonathan held my right with his left and stretched across to Mr.
uz: Men uning o'ng qo'lini oldim va Lord Godalming o'ng qo'lini qo'lga oldim, Jonatan o'ng qo'limni o'ng qo'lim bilan ushlab, Mr.

en: So as we all took hands our solemn compact was made.
uz: Shunday qilib, hamma qo'llarini qo'shganimizda, biz o'zimizni so'nggi martabali ahdga qo'shdik.

en: I felt my heart icy cold, but it did not even occur to me to draw back.
uz: Qalbim sovuq bo'lganini his qildim, lekin orqamga hech narsa kelmadi.

en: We resumed our places, and Dr.
uz: Biz o'z o'rinlarimizga qaytdik va dr.

en: Van Helsing went on with a sort of cheerfulness which showed that the serious work had begun.
uz: Van Helsing o'z ishini davom ettirib, jiddiy ish boshlanayotganini ko'rsatadigan bir xil quvonch bilan davom etdi.

en: It was to be taken as gravely, and in as businesslike a way, as any other transaction of life.
uz: Bu hayotning boshqa har qanday muomalasi kabi jiddiy va ishbilarmon tarzda qabul qilinishi kerak edi.

en: Well, you know what we have to contend against, but we too, are not without strength.
uz: Bilasizmi, nima bilan kurashishimiz kerak, lekin biz ham kuchsiz emasmiz.

en: We have on our side power of combination, a power de- nied to the vampire kind, we have sources of science, we are free to act and think, and the hours of the day and the night are ours equally.
uz: Bizda kombinatsiya kuchlari, vampirlar turidagi kuchlar, ilmiy manbalar, harakat va fikr yuritish erkinligi bor va kun va tun soatlari bir xil.

en: In fact, so far as our powers extend, they are unfettered, and we are free to use them.
uz: Darhaqiqat, bizning kuch-qudratlarimiz keng tarqalgan bo'lsa-da, ular cheklanmagan va biz ulardan erkin foydalanamiz.

en: We have self devotion in a cause and an end to achieve which is not a selﬁsh one.
uz: Bizda maqsad va maqsad uchun o'zimizga bag'ishlanish bor, bu esa xudbin emas.

en: These things are much.
uz: Bu narsalar juda ko'p.

en: Now let us see how far the general powers arrayed against us are re- strict, and how the individual cannot.
uz: Endi keling, bizga qarshi qo'yilgan umumiy kuchlar qay darajada qat'iy va qanday qilib yakka tartibdagi kuchlar qay darajada qat'iy bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: In ﬁne, let us consider the limitations of the vampire in general, and of this one in particular.
uz: Xullas, biz vampyrning umuman va ayniqsa uning cheklovlarini ko'rib chiqaylik.

en: All we have to go upon are traditions and superstitions.
uz: Biz faqat an'analar va shuhratlarga duch kelyapmiz.

en: These do not at the ﬁrst appear much, when the matter is one of life and death, nay of more than either life or death.
uz: Bular hayot va o'lim masalasi bo'lganda, hayot va o'lim masalasi bo'lganda, birinchi navbatda ko'p ko'rinmaydi.

en: Yet must we be satisﬁed, in the ﬁrst place because we have to be, no other means is at our control, and secondly, because, after all these things, tradition and superstition, are everything.
uz: Ammo biz qanoat hosil qilishimiz kerak, birinchidan, biz bo'lishimiz kerak, boshqa hech qanday vosita bizning nazoratimizda emas va ikkinchidan, bularning barchasidan so'ng, an'ana va shubhasiz hamma narsa.

en: Does not the be- lief in vampires rest for others, though not, alas!
uz: Vampirlar orasidagi sevgi boshqalar uchun dam olmaydi-ku, vay bo'lsin!

en: A year ago which of us would have received such a possibility, in the midst of our scientiﬁc, sceptical, matter-of-fact nineteenth century?
uz: Bir yil oldin, o'n to'qqizinchi asrdagi ilmiy, shubhali va haqiqatdan ham muhim bo'lgan davrda, bizlardan kim bunday imkoniyatni olgan bo'lardi?

en: We even scouted a belief that we saw justiﬁed under our very eyes.
uz: Hatto o'z ko'zimiz oldida oqlangan e'tiqodni ko'rdik.

en: Take it, then, that the vam- pire, and the belief in his limitations and his cure, rest for the moment on the same base.
uz: Demak, vam- pire va uning cheklovlariga va shifolariga bo'lgan ishonch hozirgi vaqtda bir xil asosda tiklanishini tasavvur qiling.

en: For, let me tell you, he is known everywhere that men have been.
uz: Sizlarga aytamanki, odamlarning har bir joyida u tanilgan.

en: In old Greece, in old Rome, he ﬂourish in Germany all over, in France, in India, even in the Chermosese, and in China, so far from us in all ways, there even is he, and the peoples for him at this day.
uz: Qadimgi Gretsiyada, qadimgi Rimda, u Germaniyada, Fransiyada, Hindistonda, hatto Chermosida va Xitoyda, bizdan har jihatdan uzoq bo'lganda, u ham bor va bugungi kunda u uchun xalqlar ham bor.

en: He have follow the wake of the berserker Icelander, the devil-begotten Hun, the Slav, the Saxon, the Magyar.
uz: U berserker Islandiyalik, iblis tomonidan tug'ilgan Hun, Slav, Sakson, Majarlarning izidan yurgan.

en: So far, then, we have all we may act upon, and let me tell you that very much of the beliefs are justiﬁed by what we have seen in our own so unhap- py experience.
uz: Shunday qilib, hozircha bizda barcha choralar ko'rishimiz mumkin va sizga aytamanki, e'tiqodlarning ko'pchiligi o'z tajribamizda ko'rganlarimiz bilan asoslangan.

en: The vampire live on, and cannot die by mere passing of the
uz: Vampirlar tirik qolishadi va o'lishlari mumkin emas.

en: time, he can ﬂourish when that he can fatten on the blood of the living.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, u tiriklarning qoni bilan o'sib-ulg'ayishi mumkin.

en: Even more, we have seen amongst us that he can even grow younger, that his vital faculties grow strenuous, and seem as though they refresh them- selves when his special pabulum is plenty.
uz: Bundan tashqari, biz o'zimiz o'zimizda uning yoshga yetishini, hayot qobiliyatlarining kuch-quvvatini o'z ichiga olganini va o'zining maxsus pabulumi ko'p bo'lganda o'zini ta'mirlaydigan bo'lib ko'rinishini ko'rdik.

en: But he cannot ﬂourish without this diet, he eat not as others.
uz: Ammo u ushbu ovqatlanishsiz rivojlanolmaydi, u boshqalarga o'xshab ovqatlanmaydi.

en: Even friend Jonathan, who lived with him for weeks, did never see him eat, never!
uz: Hatto haftalar davomida u bilan birga yashagan do'sti Jonatan ham uni hech qachon ovqatlanayotganini ko'rmagan!

en: He throws no shadow, he make in the mirror no reﬂect, as again Jonathan ob- serve.
uz: U hech qanday soyani tashlamaydi, ko'zguda hech qanday o'rinni ko'rsatmaydi, chunki yana bir bor Jonatan xizmat qiladi.

en: He has the strength of many of his hand, witness again Jonathan when he shut the door against the wolves, and when he help him from the diligence too.
uz: U ko'pchilikning qo'li kuchiga ega bo'lib, Jonatan qurtlarga qarshi eshikni yopganida va g'ayratli bo'lishda unga yordam berganida yana bir bor guvoh bo'ladi.

en: He can transform himself to wolf, as we gather from the ship arrival in Whitby, when he tear open the dog, he can be as bat, as Madam Mina saw him on the window at Whitby, and as friend John saw him ﬂy from this so near house, and as my friend Quincey saw him at the window of Miss Lucy.
uz: U o'zini qurtga aylantirishi mumkin, chunki biz Whitbyga kemada yetib kelganimizda, u itni yirtib yuborganida, u uchuvchi kabi bo'lishi mumkin, chunki Madam Mina uni Whitbydagi oynada ko'rgan va do'stim Jon uni shu qadar yaqin uydan uchib ketayotganini ko'rgan va do'stim Quincey uni Miss Lucyning oynasida ko'rgan.

en: He can come in mist which he create, that noble ship's captain proved him of this, but, from what we know, the distance he can make this mist is limited, and it can only be round himself.
uz: U o'zi yaratgan bulut ichida kelishi mumkin, bu buyuk kemaning kapitanlari unga buni isbotladilar, ammo biz bilganimizcha, u bu bulutdan uzoqroq bo'lishi mumkin va u faqat o'zi atrofida bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He come on moonlight rays as elemental dust, as again Jonathan saw those sisters in the castle of Dracula.
uz: U oy nurlari nurlari bilan elemental tuproq sifatida paydo bo'ldi, chunki yana Jonatan Drakulaning qal'asida o'sha singillarni ko'rdi.

en: He become so small, we ourselves saw Miss Lucy, ere she was at peace, slip through a hairbreadth space at the tomb door.
uz: U shunchalik kichik bo'ldiki, biz o'zimiz Miss Lusiyni, uning tinchligidan oldin, qabr eshigidagi sochlar kengligi bo'lgan bo'lakdan o'tib ketayotganini ko'rdik.

en: He can, when once he ﬁnd his way, come out from anything or into anything, no matter how close it be bound or even fused up with ﬁre, solder you call it.
uz: U o'z yo'lini topganidan so'ng, biron narsadan yoki biron narsaga, qanchalik yaqin bog'langan bo'lmasin yoki hatto olov bilan birlashtirilgan bo'lmasin, chiqishi mumkin, siz uni solder deb ataysiz.

en: He can see in the dark, no small power this, in a world which is one half shut from the light.
uz: U qorong'ilikda ko'ra oladi, bu juda katta kuchdir, yarim yorug'likdan yopilgan dunyoda.

en: Ah, but hear me through.
uz: Ah, lekin menga quloq soling.

en: He can do all these things, yet he is not free.
uz: U bularning barchasini qila oladi, ammo u erkin emas.

en: Nay, he is even more pris- oner than the slave of the galley, than the madman in his cell.
uz: Aksincha, u qamoqda bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy odamdan, qamoqda bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy odamdan ham ko'ra ko'proq qul bo'ladi.

en: He cannot go where he lists, he who is not of nature has yet to obey some of nature's laws, why we know not.
uz: U o'zi ko'rsatgan joyga borolmaydi, tabiatga tegishli bo'lmagan kishi hali tabiat qonunlarining ba'zilariga bo'ysunishi kerak, nima uchun biz buni bilmaymiz.

en: He may not enter anywhere at the ﬁrst, unless there be some one of the household who bid him to come, though afterwards he can come as he please.
uz: U birinchi marta hech joyga kirishi mumkin emas, agar uyning a'zosi uni taklif qilmasa, lekin keyinchalik u xohlagancha kelishi mumkin.

en: His power ceases, as does that of all evil things, at the coming of the day.
uz: Uning qudrati, barcha yovuzliklarning qudrati, kun kelganda tugadi.

en: Only at certain times can he have limited freedom.
uz: Faqatgina muayyan vaqtlarda u cheklangan erkinlikka ega bo'lishi mumkin.

en: If he be not at the place whither he is bound, he can only change himself at noon or at exact sunrise or sunset.
uz: Agar u bog'langan joyda bo'lmasa, u faqat kunduzi yoki quyosh chiqish yoki botish paytida o'zini o'zgartirishi mumkin.

en: These things we are told, and in this record of ours we have proof by inference.
uz: Bu narsalar bizga aytilmoqda va bizning ushbu yozuvlarimizda bizda xulosa orqali dalil bor.

en: Thus, whereas he can do as he will within his lim- it, when he have his earth-home,his cofﬁn-home, his hellhome, the place unhallowed, as we saw when he went to the grave of the suicide at Whitby,
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'z cheklovlari doirasida xohlaganini qila oladigan bo'lsa-da, u yerdagi uyini, ko'krakdagi uyini, do'zaxdagi uyini, muqaddas bo'lmagan joyni egallaganida, xuddi Whitbyda o'z joniga qasd qilganida ko'rganimizdek,

en: still at other time he can only change when the time come.
uz: Ammo boshqa vaqtlarda u faqat o'z vaqti kelganida o'zgarishi mumkin.

en: It is said, too, that he can only pass running water at the slack or the ﬂood of the tide.
uz: Shuningdek, u faqat o'tkir suvni o'tkazib yuborishi mumkin, deb aytilmoqda.

en: Then there are things which so afﬂict him that he has no power, as the garlic that we know of, and as for things sacred, as this symbol, my cruciﬁx, that was amongst us even now when we resolve, to them he is nothing, but in their presence he take his place far off and silent with respect.
uz: Keyin unga shunchalik ta'sir qiladigan narsalar borki, u hech qanday kuchga ega emas, biz bilgan sarimush kabi, muqaddas narsalarga nisbatan esa, xuddi shu ramz, mening xochim kabi, biz qaror qabul qilganimizda, hozir ham o'zimizda bo'lgan, ular uchun u hech narsa emas, lekin ularning oldida u o'z o'rniga uzoq va hurmat bilan xotirjamlik bilan o'tiradi.

en: There are others, too, which I shall tell you of, lest in our seeking we may need them.
uz: Boshqalar ham bor, ular haqida sizlarga aytib beraman, toki ularni izlash paytida ularga muhtoj bo'lmasak.

en: The branch of wild rose on his cofﬁn keep him that he move not from it, a sacred bullet ﬁred into the cofﬁn kill him so that he be true dead, and as for the stake through him, we know already of its peace, or the cut off head that giveth rest.
uz: Uning ko'krakidagi yovvoyi rosa shohi uni undan uzoqlashmasligi uchun saqlaydi, ko'krakga o'tilgan muqaddas qorovul uni o'ldiradi va u o'lgan bo'lishi uchun o'ldiradi.

en: We have seen it with our eyes.
uz: Biz buni o'z ko'zimiz bilan ko'rdik.

en: Thus when we ﬁnd the habitation of this man-that-was, we can conﬁne him to his cofﬁn and destroy him, if we obey what we know.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar biz bilganimizga amal qilsak, bu odamning uy-joyini topganimizda, uni uning ko'krakida bog'lab, uni yo'q qilishimiz mumkin.

en: I have asked my friend Arminius, of Buda-Pesth University, to make his record, and from all the means that are, he tell me of what he has been.
uz: Buda-Pest universitetidan do'stim Arminiusdan o'zining yozuvini yozib olishni so'radim va barcha imkoniyatlardan foydalanib, o'zi qanday inson bo'lganini aytadi.

en: He must, indeed, have been that Voivode Dracula who won his name against the Turk, over the great river on the very frontier of Turkey-land.
uz: Darhaqiqat, u Turkiyaning chegarasidagi buyuk daryo bo'ylab turkiylarga qarshi o'z nomini qozongan Voivod Dracula bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: If it be so, then was he no common man, for in that time, and for centuries af- ter, he was spoken of as the cleverest and the most cunning, as well as the bravest of the sons of the `land beyond the forest.' That mighty brain and that iron resolution went with him to his grave, and are even now arrayed against us.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, unda u oddiy odam bo'lmagan, chunki o'sha paytda va keyingi asrlarda u eng aqlli va eng hiylasiz, shuningdek, o'rmon tashqaridagi `land o'g'illarining eng jasorati sifatida tilga olingan edi.

en: The Draculas were, says Arminius, a great and noble race, though now and again were scions who were held by their coevals to have had dealings with the Evil One.
uz: Arminiyning aytishicha, Draculalar buyuk va aziz irq bo'lgan, ammo vaqti-vaqti bilan ular o'z tengdoshlari tomonidan yovuz Tangri bilan muomala qilgan deb hisoblangan o'g'illar edi.

en: They learned his secrets in the Scholo- mance, amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt, where the devil claims the tenth scholar as his due.
uz: Ular uning sirlarini Hermanstadt ko'li ustidagi tog'lar orasidagi Scholo-mance-da bilib olishdi, u yerda shayton o'ninchi olimni o'z huquqi deb e'tirof etadi.

en: In the records are such words as `stre- goica' witch, `ordog' and `pokol' Satan and hell, and in one manuscript this very Dracula is spoken of as `wampyr,'which we all understand too well.
uz: Yozuvlarda `stre-goica' sehrgar, `ordog' va `pokol' shayton va do'zax kabi so'zlar mavjud va bitta qo'lyozma bu Dracula haqida `wampyr deb gapiradi, bu so'zlarni hammamiz juda yaxshi tushunamiz.

en: There have been from the loins of this very one great men and good women, and their graves make sacred the earth where alone this foulness can dwell.
uz: Bu birgina ulug' erkaklar va yaxshi ayollar uning bellaridan kelib chiqqan va ularning qabrlari bu yovuzlik yashashi mumkin bo'lgan yerni muqaddas qiladi.

en: For it is not the least of its terrors that this evil thing is rooted deep in all good, in soil barren of holy memories it cannot rest. Whilst they were talking Mr.
uz: Chunki bu yovuz narsa barcha yaxshiliklarning chuqurida, muqaddas xotiralarsiz yerda ildiz otgani uning qo'rqinchlaridan hech biri emas.

en: Morris was looking steadily at the window, and he now got up quietly, and went out of the room.
uz: Morris o'rindiqdan ko'z tikib, xonadan chiqib ketdi.

en: There was a little pause, and then the Professor went on.
uz: Ozgina to'xtatish bo'lib, professor davom etdi.

en: And now we must settle what we do.
uz: Va endi nima qilishimiz kerakligini hal qilishimiz kerak.

en: We have here much data, and we must proceed to lay out our campaign.
uz: Bu yerda ko'plab ma'lumotlar mavjud va biz kampaniyalarimizni rejalashtirishda davom etishimiz kerak.

en: We know from the inquiry of
uz: Biz bu haqda -ning so'rovidan bilamiz.

en: Jonathan that from the castle to Whitby came ﬁfty boxes of earth, all of which were delivered at Carfax, we also know that at least some of these boxes have been removed.
uz: Jonatan, qishlog'idan Uitbiga ellik quti tuproq kelib, ularning barchasi Karfaksda yetkazib berilganini bilamiz, shuningdek, bu qutilarning hech bo'lmaganda ba'zilari olib tashlanganligini bilamiz.

en: It seems to me, that our ﬁrst step should be to ascertain whether all the rest remain in the house beyond that wall where we look today, or whether any more have been removed.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bizning birinchi qadamimiz, qolgan narsalar bugungi kunda ko'rib turgan tomondan uyda qolish-olmasligini yoki boshqa narsalar olib tashlanganligini aniqlashdir.

en: If the latter, we must trace …  Here we were interrupted in a very startling way.
uz: Agar ikkinchisi bo'lsa, biz izlashimiz kerak ...  Bu erda biz juda dahshatli tarzda kesib qoldik.

en: Outside the house came the sound of a pistol shot, the glass of the window was shattered with a bul- let, which ricochetting from the top of the embrasure, struck the far wall of the room.
uz: Uyning tashqarisida o'q otishining ovozi eshitildi, oyna shishalari bullet bilan parchalandi, bu esa embrasurning yuqori qismidan bo'lib, xonaning olis devorini urdi.

en: I am afraid I am at heart a coward, for I shrieked out.
uz: Men yuragimda qo'rqoqman, deb qo'rqaman.

en: The men all jumped to their feet, Lord Godalming ﬂew over to the window and threw up the sash.
uz: Barcha erkaklar o'z oyoqlariga ko'tarildilar, Lord Godalming esa darchaga o'tib o'tib, kamarni tashladi.

en: As he did so we heard Mr.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz Mr.ni eshitdik.

en: Morris' voice without, Sorry!
uz: Morrisning ovozi: Kechirasiz!

en: I fear I have alarmed you.
uz: Afsuski, men sizni xavotirga solganman.

en: I shall come in and tell you about it. A minute later he came in and said, It was an idiotic thing of me to do, and I ask your pardon, Mrs.
uz: Men kelib sizga gapirib beraman. Bir daqiqa o'tgach, u kelib, dedi: Men bu axmoqona ish qildim va kechirim so'rayman, xonim.

en: Harker, most sincerely, I fear I must have frightened you terribly.
uz: Harker, chin dildan aytganda, qo'rqamanki, men sizni juda qo'rqitgan bo'laman.

en: But the fact is that whilst the Professor was talking there came a big bat and sat on the window sill.
uz: Ammo haqiqat shundaki, professor gapirgan paytda katta to'qnashuvchi paydo bo'lib, deraza ustunida o'tirdi.

en: I have got such a horror of the damned brutes from recent events that I cannot stand them, and I went out to have a shot, as I have been doing of late of evenings, whenever I have seen one.
uz: So'nggi hodisalardan kelib chiqqan yovvoyi hayvonlardan shunchalik qo'rqdimki, ularga chiday olmayman, shuning uchun kechki paytlarda, qachon ko'rganimda, bir marta o'ynash uchun tashqariga chiqdim.

en: You used to laugh at me for it then, Art. Did you hit it? asked Dr.
uz: O'shanda sen menga kulgan eding, Art. - Sening urganingmi? deb so'radi doktor.

en: I don't know, I fancy not, for it ﬂew away into the wood. Without say- ing any more he took his seat, and the Professor began to resume his statement.
uz: Bilmayman, o'ylaymanki, yo'q, chunki u o'rmonga uchib ketdi, - dedi u yana so'zlamagan holda o'rinni oldi va professor o'z so'zlarini davom ettirishni boshladi.

en: We must trace each of these boxes, and when we are ready, we must ei- ther capture or kill this monster in his lair, or we must, so to speak, sterilize the earth, so that no more he can seek safety in it.
uz: Biz ushbu qutilarning har birini izlashimiz kerak va biz tayyor bo'lganimizda, bu haykalni uning g'ayrasida ushlab olishimiz yoki o'ldirishimiz kerak yoki biz, shunday qilib aytish kerak, yerni sterilizatsiya qilishimiz kerak, shunda u endi u erda xavfsizlikni izlay olmaydi.

en: Thus in the end we may ﬁnd him in his form of man between the hours of noon and sunset, and so engage with him when he is at his most weak.
uz: Shunday qilib, oxir-oqibat biz uni tushdan quyosh botishgacha inson qiyofasida topishimiz mumkin va u eng zaif holatda bo'lganida u bilan muloqot qilishimiz mumkin.

en: And now for you, Madam Mina,this night is the end until all be well.
uz: Va endi siz uchun, Xonim Mina, hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lgunga qadar bu kechasi oxiri.

en: You are too precious to us to have such risk.
uz: Siz biz uchun shunchalik qimmatbaho bo'ldingizki, bunday xavf-xatarga duch kelmaysiz.

en: When we part tonight, you no more must question.
uz: Bugun kechqurun ajrashganimizda, siz boshqa savol bermasligingiz kerak.

en: We shall tell you all in good time.
uz: Biz hammamizga o'z vaqtida xabar beramiz.

en: We are men and are able to bear, but you must be our star and our hope, and we shall act all the more free that you are not in the danger, such as we are. All the men, even Jonathan, seemed relieved, but it did not seem to me good that they should brave danger and, perhaps lessen their safety, strength being the best safety, through care of me, but their minds were made up,
uz: Biz odamlarmiz va biz chidashimiz mumkin, lekin siz bizning yulduzimiz va umidimiz bo'lishingiz kerak va biz siz kabi xavf-xatarda bo'lmasligingiz uchun yanada erkinroq harakat qilamiz. Barcha odamlar, hatto Jonatan ham yengillab ketganga o'xshardi, lekin ular xavf-xatarga qarshi turishlari va, ehtimol, xavfsizlikni kamaytirishlari kerak, chunki kuch eng yaxshi xavf-xatar bo'lgan, deb o'ylayman.

en: and though it was a bitter pill for me to swallow, I could say nothing, save to accept their chivalrous care of me.
uz: Garchi bu men uchun og'ir dori edi, lekin men ularning meni yaxshi ko'rishlarini qabul qilishdan boshqa hech narsa aytolmadim.

en: Morris resumed the discussion, As there is no time to lose, I vote we have a look at his house right now.
uz: Morris suhbatni davom ettirib, shunday dedi: O'tish uchun vaqt yo'q ekan, men ovoz beraman, hozir uning uyini ko'rib chiqamiz.

en: Time is everything with him, and swift action on our part may save another victim. I own that my heart began to fail me when the time for action came so close, but I did not say anything, for I had a greater fear that if I appeared as a drag or a hindrance to their work, they might even leave me out of their counsels altogether.
uz: Vaqt u uchun hamma narsa, biz tezkor harakat boshqa qurbonni qutqarishi mumkin.  Men yuragim meni harakat qilish vaqti shu qadar yaqinlashganda tushkunlikka tushirganini bilaman, lekin men hech narsa aytmadim, chunki agar men ularning ishiga toʻsqinlik yoki toʻsqinlik sifatida koʻrinsam, ular meni hatto maslahatlaridan butunlay chetda qoldirishlaridan qoʻrqardim.

en: They have now gone off to Carfax, with means to get into the house.
uz: Ular endi uyga kirishga yo'l qo'yib, Karfaksga ketishdi.

en: Manlike, they had told me to go to bed and sleep, as if a woman can sleep when those she loves are in danger!I shall lie down, and pretend to sleep, lest Jonathan have added anxiety about me when he returns.
uz: Erkak bo'lganimcha, menga yotishga va uxlashga buyurishgan edilar, xuddi ayol o'z yaqinlari xavf ostida bo'lganda uxlashi mumkin bo'lganidek!Men uxlab, uxlayotganimni ko'rsataman, chunki Yo'natan qaytib kelganida men uchun tashvishlanishni qo'shib qo'ymaydi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 1 October, 4 a.
uz: SEWARDning kundaligi 1 oktyabr, 4 a.

en: m.—Just as we were about to leave the house, an urgent message was brought to me from Renﬁeld to know if I would see him at once, as he had something of the utmost importance to say to me.
uz: Uydan chiqib ketmoqchi bo'lganimizda, Renfielddan menga tezkor xabar keldi, u menga juda muhim bir gapni aytmoqchi bo'lgani uchun, uni darhol ko'rishim kerakmi, deb so'radi.

en: I told the messenger to say that I would attend to his wishes in the morning, I was busy just at the moment.
uz: Men elchiga ertalab uning istaklariga javob berishni aytdim, chunki hozirda men juda band edim.

en: The attendant added, He seems very importunate, sir.
uz: Xizmatchi qo'shimcha qilib: U juda g'alati ko'rinadi, xo'jayinim.

en: I have never seen him so eager.
uz: Men uni hech qachon bunday g'ayratli ko'rmaganman.

en: I don't know but what, if you don't see him soon, he will have one of his violent ﬁts. I knew the man would not have said this without some cause, so I said, All right, I'll go now, and I asked the others to wait a few minutes for me, as I had to go and see my patient.
uz: Bilmayman, lekin nima bo'ladi, agar siz uni tezda ko'rmasangiz, u o'zining zo'ravon hujumlaridan biriga duchor bo'ladi.Men odamning bu gapni biron sababsiz aytmasligini bilardim, shuning uchun men: To'g'ri, endi ketaman, - dedim va boshqalardan menga bir necha daqiqa kutishlarini so'radim, chunki men bemorimni ko'rish uchun borishim kerak edi.

en: Take me with you, friend John, said the Professor.His case in your di- ary interest me much, and it had bearing, too, now and again on our case.
uz: Meni o'zingiz bilan olib keting, do'stim Jon, - dedi professor. - Sizning jurnalingizdagi uning da'vosi meni juda qiziqtiradi va vaqti-vaqti bilan bizning da'volarimizga ham ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

en: I should much like to see him, and especial when his mind is disturbed. May I come also? asked Lord Godalming.
uz: Men uni ko'rishni juda istayman, ayniqsa, uning ongi xavotirda bo'lganida. - Men ham kelishim mumkinmi? - deb so'radi Lord Godalming.

en: Me too? said Quincey Morris.
uz: Men ham? dedi Quincey Morris.

en: May I come? said Harker.
uz: Men kelishim mumkinmi? dedi Harker.

en: I nodded, and we all went down the passage together.
uz: Men boshimni tiydim va barchamiz birgalikda yo'lni bosib o'tdik.

en: We found him in a state of considerable excitement, but far more rational in his speech and manner than I had ever seen him.
uz: Biz uni sezilarli darajada hayajonlangan holatda topdik, ammo uning nutqi va xulq-atvorida men uni ko'rganimdan ko'ra ancha oqilonaroq edi.

en: There was an unusual understanding of himself, which was unlike anything I had ever met with in a lunatic, and he took it for granted that his reasons would prevail with oth- ers entirely sane.
uz: O'zi haqida o'zgacha tushuncha bor edi, bu men hech qachon aqldan ozgan odamda ko'rganimdan farq qilardi va u o'z sabablari butunlay aqlli boshqalarga nisbatan ustun bo'lishini tabiiy hol deb bilgan.

en: We all ﬁve went into the room, but none of the others at ﬁrst said anything.
uz: Beshimiz ham xonani tark etdik, lekin boshqalari hech narsa aytmadi.

en: His request was that I would at once release him from
uz: Uning iltimosi shundaki, uni darhol ozod qilishim kerak edi.

en: the asylum and send him home.
uz: shifoxonaga kirib, uyiga jo'natish.

en: This he backed up with arguments regard- ing his complete recovery, and adduced his own existing sanity.
uz: Buni u o'zining to'liq sog'ayganligi haqidagi dalillar bilan tasdiqladi va o'zining hozirgi aql-idrokini keltirdi.

en: I appeal to your friends,he said,they will, perhaps, not mind sitting in judgement on my case.
uz: Men do'stlaringizga murojaat qilaman, - dedi u, - ular, ehtimol, mening ishimni hukm qilishdan bosh tortmaydilar.

en: By the way, you have not introduced me. I was so much astonished, that the oddness of introducing a madman in an asylum did not strike me at the moment, and besides, there was a certain dignity in the man's manner, so much of the habit of equality, that I at once made the introduction, Lord Godalming, Professor Van Helsing, Mr.
uz: Men shunchalik hayron edimki, aqldan ozgan kishini shahzoga kiritishning g'alatiligi o'sha paytda menga yoqmadi, bundan tashqari, odamning xatti-harakatida muayyan qadr-qimmat, tenglik odati bor edi, shuning uchun men darhol Lord Godalming, professor Van Helsing, Mr.

en: Quincey Morris, of Texas, Mr.
uz: Texastlik Quincey Morris, Mr.

en: Jonathan Harker, Mr.
uz: Jonathan Harker, Mr. Jonatan Harker

en: Renﬁeld. He shook hands with each of them, saying in turn, Lord Godalming, I had the honor of seconding your father at the Windham, I grieve to know, by your holding the title, that he is no more.
uz: Renfield.  U har bir kishiga qo'l urdi va o'z navbatida shunday dedi: Lord Godalming, men otangizni Windhamda qo'llab-quvvatlash sharafiga muyassar bo'ldim.

en: He was a man loved and hon- ored by all who knew him, and in his youth was, I have heard, the inventor of a burnt rum punch, much patronized on Derby night.
uz: U uni taniyotganlarning hammasi tomonidan sevilgan va hurmatga sazovor bo'lgan odam edi va yoshligida, men eshitganimcha, yondirilgan rum punchning ixtirochisi edi.

en: Morris, you should be proud of your great state.
uz: Morris, siz o'zingizning ulkan davlatingiz bilan faxrlanishingiz kerak.

en: Its reception into the Union was a precedent which may have farreaching effects hereafter, when the Pole and the Tropics may hold alliance to the Stars and Stripes.
uz: Uni Ittifoqqa qabul qilish, keyinchalik uzoq muddatli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin bo'lgan precedent bo'ldi, chunki Polar va Tropiklar Yulduzlar va Stripes bilan ittifoq qilishlari mumkin.

en: The power of Treaty may yet prove a vast engine of enlargement, when the Monroe doctrine takes its true place as a political fable.
uz: Monro doktrinasi siyosiy afsona sifatida o'z o'rinini egallagandan so'ng, shartnoma kuchi keng ko'payishning ulkan vositasi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: What shall any man say of his plea- sure at meeting Van Helsing?
uz: Van Helsing bilan uchrashganida o'z tanlovi haqida qanday fikrda bo'lish kerak?

en: Sir, I make no apology for dropping all forms of conventional preﬁx.
uz: Xo'jayinim, barcha odatdagi prefikslarni tashlaganim uchun uzr so'ramayman.

en: When an individual has revolutionized therapeutics by his discovery of the continuous evolution of brain matter, conventional forms are unﬁtting, since they would seem to limit him to one of a class.
uz: Agar bir kishi miya masalasining doimiy rivojlanishini kashf etib, terapevtika sohasida inqilobiy inqilobiy o'zgarishlar kiritgan bo'lsa, an'anaviy shakllar mos kelmaydi, chunki ular uni sinfning bir qismiga cheklaydi.

en: You, gentlemen, who by nationality, by heredity, or by the possession of natural gifts, are ﬁtted to hold your respective places in the moving world, I take to witness that I am as sane as at least the majority of men who are in full possession of their liberties.
uz: Sizlar, xonimlar, millati, meros yoki tabiiy sovg'alarga ega bo'lganingiz tufayli harakatlanayotgan dunyoda o'z o'rinlaringizni egallab olishingiz uchun moslasangiz, men hech bo'lmaganda erkinliklarini to'liq egallab turgan ko'pchilik odamlarning aqli bilan teng ekanligimga guvohlik beraman.

en: And I am sure that you, Dr.
uz: Siz ham shubhalanaman, doktor.

en: Seward, hu- manitarian and medico-jurist as well as scientist, will deem it a moral duty to deal with me as one to be considered as under exceptional circumstances.He made this last appeal with a courtly air of conviction which was not without its own charm.
uz: Hu-manitarian va mediku-yurist, shuningdek, olim Seward meni alohida holatlarda ko'rib chiqilishi kerak bo'lgan shaxs sifatida ko'rish uchun axloqiy burch deb hisoblaydi. U ushbu oxirgi murojaatni o'z xarakteriga ega bo'lmagan sudyalik ishonch bilan qildi.

en: I think we were all staggered.
uz: O'ylaymanki, hammamiz hayron qoldik.

en: For my own part, I was under the convic- tion, despite my knowledge of the man's character and history, that his rea- son had been restored, and I felt under a strong impulse to tell him that I was satisﬁed as to his sanity, and would see about the necessary formalities for his release in the morning.
uz: Men o'zim ham, uning shaxsiyati va tarixi haqida bilishimga qaramay, uning o'g'li o'z xatti-harakatini tiklaganini bilardim va uning aqli to'g'risida mamnun ekanimni va ertalab uni ozod qilish uchun zarur formaliyatlarni ko'rib chiqaman, deb aytish uchun kuchli istakga ega bo'ldim.

en: I thought it better to wait, however, before making so grave a statement, for of old I knew the sudden changes to which
uz: Biroq, bunday jiddiy gapirishdan oldin kutish yaxshiroq deb o'yladim, chunki qadimgi davrlarda o'zgarishlar yuz berishini bilardim.

en: this particular patient was liable.
uz: Ushbu bemor javobgar bo'lgan.

en: So I contented myself with making a gen- eral statement that he appeared to be improving very rapidly, that I would have a longer chat with him in the morning, and would then see what I could do in the direction of meeting his wishes.
uz: Shunday qilib, u juda tez yaxshilanayotganini, ertalab u bilan uzoqroq suhbatlashishimni va keyinchalik uning xohish-irodasini bajarishga nima qilishim mumkinligini ko'rib chiqishimni umumiy so'z bilan ta'minladim.

en: This did not at all satisfy him, for he said quickly, But I fear, Dr.
uz: Bu unga hech qanday qoniqtirmadi, chunki u tezda shunday dedi: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, doktor.

en: Se- ward, that you hardly apprehend my wish.
uz: O'zing mening xohishimni tushunmayapsan.

en: I desire to go at once, here, now, this very hour, this very moment, if I may.
uz: Agar iloji bo'lsa, hozir, shu soat, shu daqiqada borishni istayman.

en: Time presses, and in our implied agreement with the old scytheman it is of the essence of the contract.
uz: Vaqti juda tez keladi va eski qilichboz bilan tuzilgan kelishuvimizda bu shartnoma mohiyatidan iborat.

en: I am sure it is only necessary to put before so admirable a practitioner as Dr.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, faqatgina doktor kabi maqtanarli shifokorni ko'rishga to'g'ri keladi.

en: Se- ward so simple, yet so momentous a wish, to ensure its fulﬁlment. He looked at me keenly, and seeing the negative in my face, turned to the others, and scrutinized them closely.
uz: U menga diqqat bilan qaradi va yuzimda salbiylikni ko'rib, boshqalarga qarab, ularni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqadi.

en: Not meeting any sufﬁcient response, he went on, Is it possible that I have erred in my supposition? You have, I said frankly, but at the same time, as I felt, brutally.
uz: To'g'ri javobni topmay, u davom etdi: Mening taxminimda xato qilganim mumkinmi? Agar shunday bo'lsa-da, - dedim men ochiqchasiga, lekin o'zimni vahshiy his qilganimdek, bir vaqtning o'zida.

en: There was a considerable pause, and then he said slowly, Then I suppose I must only shift my ground of request.
uz: Ko'p vaqt o'tgach, u sekin-sekin dedi: O'sha paytda men faqat so'rov sababimni o'zgartirishim kerak, deb o'ylayman.

en: Let me ask for this concession, boon, privilege, what you will.
uz: Sizga bu imtiyoz, ne'mat, imtiyoz, xohlaganingizcha so'rayman.

en: I am content to implore in such a case, not on personal grounds, but for the sake of others.
uz: Bunday holatda shaxsiy sabablarga ko'ra emas, balki boshqalarning manfaatini ko'zlab iltijo qilishdan mamnunman.

en: I am not at liberty to give you the whole of my reasons, but you may, I assure you, take it from me that they are good ones, sound and unselﬁsh, and spring from the highest sense of duty.
uz: Men sizga barcha sabablarimni aytib berishga haqli emasman, lekin siz, sizga shuni aytamanki, ular yaxshi, sog'lom va begʻaraz, deb o'ylashingiz mumkin va bu mas'uliyatning eng yuqori hissiyotidan kelib chiqadi.

en: Could you look, sir, into my heart, you would approve to the full the sentiments which animate me.
uz: Mening qalbimga qarasangiz, xudoim, meni hayajonlantiradigan his-tuyg'ularga to'liq rozi bo'lasiz.

en: Nay, more, you would count me amongst the best and truest of your friends. Again he looked at us all keenly.
uz: Yo'q, bundan ham ko'proq, siz meni do'stlaringiz orasida eng yaxshi va eng sodiq kishilar qatorida hisoblaysiz. - dedi u yana hammamizga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: I had a growing conviction that this sud- den change of his entire intellectual method was but yet another phase of his madness, and so determined to let him go on a little longer, knowing from experience that he would, like all lunatics, give himself away in the end.
uz: Uning butun intellektual usulidagi bu to'satdan o'zgarish uning aqlsizlikining yana bir bosqichidan iborat ekanligiga ishonchim oshdi va uni biroz ko'proq davom ettirishga qat'iy qaror qildim, chunki u, barcha aqlsizlar singari, oxir-oqibat o'zini tashlab ketishini bilib, tajribadan bilib oldim.

en: Van Helsing was gazing at him with a look of utmost intensity, his bushy eyebrows almost meeting with the ﬁxed concentration of his look.
uz: Van Helsing unga juda kuchli ko'rinish bilan qarayotgan edi, uning ko'zlangan ko'kraklari uning ko'rinishining qat'iy konsentratsiyasiga to'g'ri keladi.

en: He said to Renﬁeld in a tone which did not surprise me at the time, but only when I thought of it afterwards, for it was as of one addressing an equal, Can you not tell frankly your real reason for wishing to be free tonight?
uz: U Renfildga o'sha paytda meni hayratda qoldirmagan so'z bilan: Bu kechqurun erkin bo'lishni istashingizning asl sababini aniq ayta olasizmi?

en: I will undertake that if you will satisfy even me, a stranger, without prejudice, and with the habit of keeping an open mind, Dr.
uz: Agar siz hatto meni ham, begona odamni, yuzxotirchilik qilmasdan va ochiq ongni saqlash odati bilan qondirishni istasangiz, dr.

en: Seward will give you, at his own risk and on his own responsibility, the privilege you seek.
uz: Seward sizga siz izlayotgan imtiyozni o'z xavf-xatarida va o'z javobgarligida beradi.

en: He shook his head sadly, and with a look of poignant regret on his face.
uz: U boshini qayg'uli tarzda va yuzida qattiq afsus ko'rinishi bilan silkitdi.

en: The Professor went on, Come, sir, bethink yourself.
uz: Professor davom etdi: Kosh, xo'jayinim, o'zingizni o'ylab ko'ring.

en: You claim the privi- lege of reason in the highest degree, since you seek to impress us with your complete reasonableness.
uz: Siz aql-idrokning ustuvorligini yuqori darajaga ko'tarmoqdasiz, chunki siz o'zingizning to'liq aql-idrokingiz bilan bizni ta'sirga solmoqchisiz.

en: You do this, whose sanity we have reason to doubt, since you are not yet released from medical treatment for this very defect.
uz: Siz buni qilasiz, chunki bizda bu nuqson uchun siz hali tibbiy yordamdan ozod bo'lmaganingiz uchun aql-idrokidan shubha ostiga qo'yish uchun asos bor.

en: If you will not help us in our effort to choose the wisest course, how can we perform the duty which you yourself put upon us?
uz: Agar siz eng dono yo'lni tanlashga harakat qilishimizda bizga yordam bermasangiz, unda siz o'zingiz bizga topshirgan vazifani qanday bajarishimiz mumkin?

en: Be wise, and help us, and if we can we shall aid you to achieve your wish. He still shook his head as he said, Dr.
uz: Dono bo'lib, bizga yordam ber, biz esa iloji bo'lsa, sizning xohishingizga erishishingizga yordam beramiz. U hali ham boshini silkitib: Droktor.

en: Van Helsing, I have nothing to say.
uz: Van Helsing, aytadigan hech narsaim yo'q.

en: Your argument is complete, and if I were free to speak I should not hes- itate a moment, but I am not my own master in the matter.
uz: Sizning dalilingiz to'liq va agar men so'zlash erkinligim bo'lganida, bir daqiqa ham qo'rqmasdim, lekin men bu masalada o'zimning ustam emasman.

en: I can only ask you to trust me.
uz: Sizdan faqat menga ishonishingizni so'rasam bo'ladi.

en: If I am refused, the responsibility does not rest with me. I thought it was now time to end the scene, which was becoming too comically grave, so I went towards the door, simply saying, Come, my friends, we have work to do.
uz: Agar meni rad etishsa, bu mening zimmamda emas. Men juda jiddiy bo'layotgan voqeani tugatish vaqti keldi deb o'yladim, shuning uchun eshik tomon bordim va shunchaki shunday deb aytdim: Ey do'stlarim, kelinglar, ishimiz bor.

en: Goodnight. As, however, I got near the door, a new change came over the patient.
uz: Goodnight.  Biroq, eshikga yaqinlashganda, bemorga yangi o'zgarish yuz berdi.

en: He moved towards me so quickly that for the moment I feared that he was about to make another homicidal attack.
uz: U shunchalik tez menga yaqinlashdiki, o'shanda yana bir qotil hujum qilishidan qo'rqardim.

en: My fears, however, were ground- less, for he held up his two hands imploringly, and made his petition in a moving manner.
uz: Biroq, mening qo'rquvlarim asossiz edi, chunki u ikki qo'lini ko'tarib iltijo qildi va iltijoini hayajonli tarzda qildi.

en: As he saw that the very excess of his emotion was militat- ing against him, by restoring us more to our old relations, he became still more demonstrative.
uz: U o'z his-tuyg'ularining o'ta ortiqcha bo'lganini ko'rganida, bizni eski munosabatlarimizga qayta tiklab, o'ziga qarshi kurashayotganini ko'rganida, u yanada namoyishchan bo'ldi.

en: I glanced at Van Helsing, and saw my conviction re- ﬂected in his eyes, so I became a little more ﬁxed in my manner, if not more stern, and motioned to him that his efforts were unavailing.
uz: Men Van Helsinga ko'z tikdim va uning ko'zlarida mening e'tiqodim o'zgarib borayotganini ko'rdim, shuning uchun men ozgina qat'iyroq, agar qattiqroq bo'lmasam, o'z xatti-harakatlarimda qat'iyroq bo'ldim va uning harakatlari befoyda ekanini unga ishora qildim.

en: I had previously seen something of the same constantly growing excitement in him when he had to make some request of which at the time he had thought much, such for instance, as when he wanted a cat, and I was prepared to see the collapse into the same sullen acquiescence on this occasion.
uz: O'sha paytlarda u juda ko'p o'ylaganicha, masalan, u mushukni xohlagani kabi, unga bir necha so'rov berish kerak bo'lganida, men ularda xuddi shunday g'ayratni ko'rgan edim va men bu borada ham xuddi shunday g'ayratli rozilik bildirishga tayyor edim.

en: My expectation was not realized, for when he found that his appeal would not be successful, he got into quite a frantic condition.
uz: Umidlarim amalga oshmadi, chunki u o'z da'volarining muvaffaqiyatli bo'lmasligini bilganida, u juda g'alati holatga tushdi.

en: He threw him- self on his knees, and held up his hands, wringing them in plaintive suppli- cation, and poured forth a torrent of entreaty, with the tears rolling down his cheeks, and his whole face and form expressive of the deepest emotion.
uz: U o'zini tiz cho'kib, qo'llarini ko'tarib, shikoyat so'zlarini so'zlab, iltijolar oqishini so'zlab yubordi, ko'z yoshlari uning burchaklariga tushib, butun yuzi va shakli o'zining eng chuqur his-tuyg'usini ifodalaydi.

en: Let me entreat you, Dr.
uz: Sizdan iltimos qilaman, doktor.

en: Seward, oh, let me implore you, to let me out of this house at once.
uz: Seward, oh, senga iltijo qilaman, meni darhol shu uydan chiqarib yubor.

en: Send me away how you will and where you will, send keepers with me with whips and chains, let them take me in a strait waist- coat, manacled and leg-ironed, even to gaol, but let me go out of this.
uz: Meni xohlaganingizcha, xohlagan joyingizga yuboringlar, maydon va zanjirlar bilan qo'riqchilarni men bilan birga yuboringlar, meni maydoncha kiyimda, qo'l va oyoqlar bilan qo'yib, hatto qamoqqa ham olib ketishlariga ruxsat beringlar, lekin menga bu ishdan chiqishimga ruxsat beringlar.

en: don't know what you do by keeping me here.
uz: Meni bu yerda saqlab qolish bilan nima qilayotganingizni bilmayman.

en: I am speaking from the depths of my heart, of my very soul.
uz: Men yuragimning chuqurligidan, o'z ruhimdan gapiryapman.

en: You don't know whom you wrong, or how, and I may not tell.
uz: Siz kimni yoki qanday qilib xato qilganingizni bilmaysiz va men aytmayman.

en: By all you hold sacred, by all you hold dear, by your love that is lost, by your hope that lives, for the sake of the Almighty, take me out of this and save my soul from guilt!
uz: Sening muqaddas deb bilgan hamma narsang, sening aziz deb bilgan hamma narsang, yo'qolgan sevgining, tirik umiding tufayli, Qodir Tangrining marhamati uchun meni bundan qutqar va ruhimni aybdorlikdan saqla!

en: Can't you hear me, man?
uz: Meni eshitmaysanmi, yigit?

en: Can't you understand?
uz: Siz buni tushunmayapsizmi?

en: Will you never learn?
uz: Hech qachon o'rganmaysanmi?

en: Don't you know that I am sane and earnest now, that I am no lunatic in a mad ﬁt, but a sane man ﬁghting for his soul?
uz: Men hozir sog'lom va jiddiy ekanimni, aqldan ozgan odam emasman, balki o'z jonim uchun kurashayotgan sog'lom odam ekanimni bilmayapsizmi?

en: Let me go, let me go, let me go! I thought that the longer this went on the wilder he would get, and so would bring on a ﬁt, so I took him by the hand and raised him up.
uz: Meni qo'yib yuboring, meni qo'yib yuboring! - deb o'yladim, bu qancha davom etsa, shuncha ko'proq o'zidan-o'zidan tushib ketadi, shu bilan birga, fitna ham keltirib chiqaradi, shuning uchun men uni qo'lidan ushlab, ko'tarib oldim.

en: Come, I said sternly, no more of this, we have had quite enough al- ready.
uz: Men qat'iylik bilan aytdim: Qo'sh, bundan keyin bularning hammasi bo'lmaydi, bizda yetarlicha tayyorlik bor.

en: Get to your bed and try to behave more discreetly. He suddenly stopped and looked at me intently for several moments.
uz: Yotoqxonangizga borib, o'zingizni ko'proq xotirjam tutishga harakat qiling. U to'satdan to'xtadi va bir necha daqiqa davomida menga diqqat bilan qaradi.

en: Then, without a word, he rose and moving over, sat down on the side of the bed.
uz: So'ngra, so'zsiz turib, o'zini ko'tarib, to'shaning yonida o'tirdi.

en: The collapse had come, as on former occasions, just as I had expected.
uz: Oldingi paytlarda bo'lgani kabi, bu tuzum ham men kutib o'tganidek sodir bo'ldi.

en: When I was leaving the room, last of our party, he said to me in a quiet, well-bred voice, You will, I trust, Dr.
uz: Xonadan chiqib ketayotganimda, o'z partiyamizning so'nggi o'yinida, u meni tinch, yaxshi tarbiyalangan ovoz bilan: Siz shunday qilasiz, ishonaman, doktor.

en: Seward, do me the justice to bear in mind, later on, that I did what I could to convince you tonight.
uz: Seward, keyinroq eslab qolish uchun menga adolat qiling, men bugun sizni ishontirish uchun qo'limdan kelganini qildim.

en: CHAPTER 19 JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 October, 5 a.
uz: 19 bob Jonathan Harker jurnalining 1 oktyabr, 5 a.

en: m.—I went with the party to the search with an easy mind, for I think I never saw Mina so absolutely strong and well.
uz: Men o'zimni osonlikcha qidirishga partiyam bilan birga bordim, chunki men Minani hech qachon bunday kuchli va sog'lom ko'rmaganimni bilaman.

en: I am so glad that she consented to hold back and let us men do the work.
uz: Men juda xursandmanki, u to'xtatishga rozi bo'ldi va ishni biz erkaklar bajarishga ruxsat berdi.

en: Somehow, it was a dread to me that she was in this fearful business at all, but now that her work is done, and that it is due to her energy and brains and foresight that the whole story is put together in such a way that every point tells, she may well feel that her part is ﬁnished, and that she can henceforth leave the rest to us.
uz: O'sha dahshatli ishda ishtirok etgani menga qo'rqinch keltirdi, lekin endi uning ishi tugagandan so'ng, butun hikoyani har bir nuqta aytib o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan tarzda yig'ish uning energiyasi, miyasi va oldindan ko'rishni o'z ichiga olganligi sababli, u o'z o'z hissasini tugatganini his qilishi mumkin va bundan buyon ham qolganini bizga qoldira oladi.

en: We were, I think, all a little upset by the scene with Mr.
uz: O'ylaymanki, biz hammamiz Mr. bilan sodir bo'lgan voqeadan biroz xafa edik.

en: When we came away from his room we were silent till we got back to the study.
uz: Xonadonidan chiqib ketgach, studiyaga qaytmagunimizcha sukut saqladik.

en: Seward, Say, Jack, if that man wasn't at- tempting a bluff, he is about the sanest lunatic I ever saw.
uz: Seward: Agar bu odam blof qilmoqchi bo'lmagan bo'lsa, u men ko'rgan eng aqlli aqldan ozgan odam.

en: I'm not sure, but I believe that he had some serious purpose, and if he had, it was pretty rough on him not to get a chance. Lord Godalming and I were silent, but Dr.
uz: Bilmayman, lekin uning jiddiy maqsadi borligiga ishonaman va agar shunday bo'lsa, fursatdan mahrum bo'lish u uchun juda og'ir bo'lgan. Lord Godalming va men sukut saqladik, lekin doktor

en: Van Helsing added, Friend John, you know more lunatics than I do, and I'm glad of it, for I fear that if it had been to me to decide I would before that last hysterical outburst have given him free.
uz: Van Helsing qo'shimcha qildi: Dost Jon, siz mendan ko'ra ko'proq aqldan ozganlarni bilasiz va men bundan xursandman, chunki qo'rqamanki, agar bu mening qarorim bo'lganida, uni oxirgi histerik portlashdan oldin ozod qilgan bo'lardim.

en: But we live and learn, and in our present task we must take no chance, as my friend Quincey would say.
uz: Ammo biz yashayapmiz va o'rganyapmiz va hozirgi vazifamizda hech qanday xavf-xatarni qo'ldan boy bermaslik kerak, deb do'stim Quincey aytgan edi.

en: All is best as they are. Dr.
uz: Hamma narsa o'z-o'zidan yaxshi. - deydi doktor.

en: Seward seemed to answer them both in a dreamy kind of way, I don't know but that I agree with you.
uz: Seward ikkalasiga ham tushlikcha javob berib: Bila olmayman, lekin men siz bilan rozi bo'laman.

en: If that man had been an ordinary lunatic I would have taken my chance of trusting him, but he seems so mixed up with the Count in an indexy kind of way that I am afraid of doing anything wrong by helping his fads.
uz: Agar bu odam odatdagi aqldan ozgan odam bo'lganida, unga ishonish uchun imkoniyatimni qo'lga kiritardim, lekin u Count bilan shu qadar aralashib qolgan bo'lib ko'rinadi, men uning modalariga yordam berish orqali biron bir noto'g'ri ish qilishdan qo'rqaman.

en: I can't forget how he prayed with almost equal fervor for a cat, and then tried to tear my throat out with his teeth.
uz: Men uning mushuk uchun deyarli xuddi shunday g'ayrat bilan ibodat qilganini va keyin o'z tishlari bilan qo'limni o'chirib tashlashga harakat qilganini unutolmayman.

en: Besides, he called the Count `lord and master', and he may want to get out to help him in some diabolical way.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u Countni `lord va master deb atagan va u unga yovuz tarzda yordam berishni xohlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: That horrid thing has the wolves and the rats
uz: Bu dahshatli narsa qurtlar va tovuqlarni o'z ichiga oladi.

en: and his own kind to help him, so I suppose he isn't above trying to use a re- spectable lunatic.
uz: Unga yordam berish uchun o'z turidagi odamlarni ham qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, shuning uchun u yana ko'rinarli bir aqldan ozgan odamdan foydalanishga harakat qilyapti deb o'ylayman.

en: He certainly did seem earnest, though.
uz: Ammo u chindan ham g'ayratli ko'rinardi.

en: I only hope we have done what is best.
uz: Umid qilamanki, biz eng yaxshisini qildik.

en: These things, in conjunction with the wild work we have in hand, help to unnerve a man. The Professor stepped over, and laying his hand on his shoulder, said in his grave, kindly way, Friend John, have no fear.
uz: Bu narsalar, qo'limizda bo'lgan yovvoyi ish bilan birgalikda, odamni g'azabga solib qo'yadi.Professor o'rnidan o'tib, qo'lini yelkasiga qo'yib, qabriga kirib, mehribonlik ila shunday dedi: Do'stim Jon, qo'rqma.

en: We are trying to do our duty in a very sad and terrible case, we can only do as we deem best.
uz: Biz juda ayanchli va dahshatli holatda o'z vazifamizni bajarishga harakat qilyapmiz, biz faqat o'z xohish-irodasimizni bajarishimiz mumkin.

en: What else have we to hope for, except the pity of the good God? Lord Godalming had slipped away for a few minutes, but now he re- turned.
uz: Yaxshi Xudo rahm-shafqatidan boshqa nimaga umid qilishimiz mumkin? - deb so'ragan Lord Godalming bir necha daqiqaga qochib ketgan edi, lekin endi yana o'girilibdi.

en: He held up a little silver whistle, as he remarked, That old place may be full of rats, and if so, I've got an antidote on call. Having passed the wall, we took our way to the house, taking care to keep in the shadows of the trees on the lawn when the moonlight shone out.
uz: U: O'sha eski joy tovuqlarga to'lib-toshgan bo'lishi mumkin va agar shunday bo'lsa, menga qarshi dori kerak, - deb aytdi.

en: When we got to the porch the Professor opened his bag and took out a lot of things, which he laid on the step, sorting them into four little groups, evi- dently one for each.
uz: Verandaga yetib kelganimizda, professor sumkasini ochib, ko'plab narsalarni olib chiqdi va ularni to'rtta kichik guruhga, har biri uchun bittadan ajratdi.

en: My friends, we are going into a terrible danger, and we need arms of many kinds.
uz: Do'stlarim, biz dahshatli xavf ostidamiz va bizga turli xil qurollar kerak.

en: Our enemy is not merely spiritual.
uz: Dushmanimiz shunchaki ma'naviy emas.

en: Remember that he has the strength of twenty men, and that, though our necks or our windpipes are of the common kind, and therefore breakable or crushable, his are not amenable to mere strength.
uz: Shuni yodda tutingki, u yigirma kishining kuchiga ega va garchi bizning bo'yinlarimiz yoki shamol quvurlarimiz umumiy turdagi bo'lsa-da, shuning uchun buzilishi yoki cho'kishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, uning kuchi shunchaki kuchga ega emas.

en: A stronger man, or a body of men more strong in all than him, can at certain times hold him, but they cannot hurt him as we can be hurt by him.
uz: Undan kuchliroq odam yoki undan hamma narsada kuchliroq bir guruh odamlar uni ba'zi paytlarda ushlab turishi mumkin, ammo ular unga zarar yetkaza olmaydilar, chunki biz unga zarar yetkaza olamiz.

en: We must, therefore, guard ourselves from his touch.
uz: Shuning uchun biz o'zimizni uning qo'lidan asrashdan ehtiyot qilishimiz kerak.

en: Keep this near your heart. As he spoke he lifted a little silver cruciﬁx and held it out to me, I being nearest to him, put these ﬂowers round your neck, here he handed to me a wreath of withered garlic blossoms, for oth- er enemies more mundane, this revolver and this knife, and for aid in all, these so small electric lamps, which you can fasten to your breast, and for all, and above all at the last, this, which we must not desecrate needless. This was a portion of Sacred Wafer, which he put in an envelope and handed to me.
uz: Buni yuragingiz yaqinida saqlang. U gapirganida, ozgina kumush xochni ko'tarib menga ko'tarib berdi va men unga eng yaqin bo'lganimda, bu gullarni bo'yning atrofida qo'yib qo'y, - dedi u. Bu yerda u menga quruq sarimsoq gullar to'pini berdi, bu oddiy dushmanlar uchun, bu revolver va bu pichoq, va yordam uchun hamma narsada, siz ko'nglingizga bog'lab qo'yishingiz mumkin bo'lgan bu kichik elektr chiroqlari, va hamma uchun, eng muhimi esa, biz keraksiz ravishda ifloslamasligimiz kerak bo'lgan bu. Bu muqaddas g'ildirakning bir qismi edi, uni o'ziga sovg'a qilib, menga berdi.

en: Each of the others was similarly equipped.
uz: Qolganlarning har biri o'xshash jihozlarga ega edi.

en: Now,he said,friend John, where are the skeleton keys?
uz: Hndi, dedi u, do'stim Jon, bu ishlovchilar kalitlari qayerda?

en: If so that we can open the door, we need not break house by the window, as before at Miss Lucy's. Dr.
uz: Agar biz eshikni ochsak, avval Miss Lucy'da bo'lgani kabi, uyni darchaga bo'g'ib yuborishning hojati yo'q.

en: Seward tried one or two skeleton keys, his mechanical dexterity as a surgeon standing him in good stead.
uz: Seward bir yoki ikkita skelet kalitini sinab ko'rdi, shifokor sifatida uning mexanik ustunligi uni yaxshi joyga qo'ydi.

en: Presently he got one to suit, after a lit- tle play back and forward the bolt yielded, and with a rusty clang, shot
uz: Hozirda u o'ziga mos bo'lgan bir tanani topdi, bir marta o'ynaganidan so'ng, bolt o'tkazib yubordi va o'g'irlab ketgan qichqiriq bilan o'qildi.

en: We pressed on the door, the rusty hinges creaked, and it slowly opened.
uz: Biz eshikni bosdik, eshikning eshiklari o'chirib ketdi va u sekin-sakin ochildi.

en: It was startlingly like the image conveyed to me in Dr.
uz: Bu menga Dr.da keltirilgan tasvirga o'xshaydi.

en: Seward's di- ary of the opening of Miss Westenra's tomb, I fancy that the same idea seemed to strike the others, for with one accord they shrank back.
uz: Sewardning Mis Westenra qabrini ochish haqidagi yorlig'i, men o'ylaymanki, xuddi shu g'oya boshqalarga ham ta'sir ko'rsatdi, chunki ular bir xilda orqaga surishdi.

en: The Pro- fessor was the ﬁrst to move forward, and stepped into the open door.
uz: Professor birinchi bo'lib oldinga qadam qo'yib, ochiq eshikga kirdi.

en: In manus tuas, Domine!he said, crossing himself as he passed over the threshold.
uz: Manus tuas, Domine! - dedi u, o'zidan o'zini pastga o'tkazdi.

en: We closed the door behind us, lest when we should have lit our lamps we should possibly attract attention from the road.
uz: Biz eshikni orqaga yopdik, ehtimol, chiroqlarimizni yoqishimiz kerak bo'lganda, yo'ldan e'tiborni jalb qilishimiz mumkin.

en: The Professor carefully tried the lock, lest we might not be able to open it from within should we be in a hurry making our exit.
uz: Professor qulfini ehtiyotkorlik bilan sinab ko'rdi, agar biz darrov chiqishga shoshilsak, uni ichimizdan ocholmay qo'yishimiz mumkin.

en: Then we all lit our lamps and pro- ceeded on our search.
uz: Keyin hammamiz lampalarimizni yoqib, qidiruvimizni davom ettirdik.

en: The light from the tiny lamps fell in all sorts of odd forms, as the rays crossed each other, or the opacity of our bodies threw great shadows.
uz: Kichik chiroqlarning nurlari har xil g'alati shakllarda tushib, nurlar o'zaro kesib o'tganda yoki tanamizning shaffofligi katta soyalar yuzaga chiqarganda.

en: I could not for my life get away from the feeling that there was someone else amongst us.
uz: Hayotim davomida o'zimiz orasida boshqa birov bor degan his-tuyg'udan qochib ketolmadim.

en: I suppose it was the recollection, so powerfully brought home to me by the grim surroundings, of that terrible experience in Transylvania.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu Transilvaniyadagi o'sha dahshatli tajribadan iborat xotira edi, bu qorong'i muhit meni o'z yurtimga shunchalik qudrat bilan olib keldi.

en: I think the feeling was common to us all, for I noticed that the others kept looking over their shoulders at every sound and every new shadow, just as I felt myself doing.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu his-tuyg'u hammamiz uchun umumiy edi, chunki men boshqalarning har bir tovush va har bir yangi soyaga o'z ko'z o'nglarida qarab turganini payqadim, xuddi o'zim ham o'zimni shunday his qilardim.

en: The whole place was thick with dust.
uz: Butun joy chang bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: The ﬂoor was seemingly inches deep, except where there were recent footsteps, in which on holding down my lamp I could see marks of hobnails where the dust was cracked.
uz: Yotoqning chuqurligi bir necha santimetr bo'lgan edi, faqatgina yaqindagi qadamlar bo'lgan joylar bo'lsa-da, chiroqni qo'yib turganda, tuproq yirtilgan cho'g'lar belgilarini ko'rardim.

en: The walls were ﬂuffy and heavy with dust, and in the corners were masses of spider's webs, whereon the dust had gathered till they looked like old tat- tered rags as the weight had torn them partly down.
uz: Devorlar pufli va changdan to'liq edi, burchaklarda esa ko'pgina o'tlar to'plamlari bo'lib, ularning ustiga tuproq to'planib, og'irligi ularni qisman yirtirib tashlaganidan keyin eski o'tlar kabi ko'rinardi.

en: On a table in the hall was a great bunch of keys, with a timeyellowed label on each.
uz: Zaldagi stol ustida juda katta kalitlar bor edi, ularning har birida vaqt sariqlab yozilgan etiket bor edi.

en: They had been used several times, for on the table were several similar rents in the blanket of dust, similar to that exposed when the Professor lifted them.
uz: Ular bir necha marta ishlatilgan edi, chunki stolda professor ularni ko'targanida ko'rsatilganga o'xshash bir nechta o'xshash ijaralar to'plamda edi.

en: He turned to me and said,You know this place, Jonathan.
uz: U menga qarab: Sen bu joyni bilasan, Jonatan.

en: You have copied maps of it, and you know it at least more than we do.
uz: Siz uning xaritalarini nusxaladingiz va bizdan ham ko'ra uni ko'proq bilasiz.

en: Which is the way to the chapel? I had an idea of its direction, though on my former visit I had not been able to get admission to it, so I led the way, and after a few wrong turnings found myself opposite a low, arched oaken door, ribbed with iron bands.
uz: Kapelga boradigan yo'l qayerda? degan fikrga ega edim, ammo avvalgi tashrifimda unga kirish imkoni bo'lmagan edi, shuning uchun men yo'lni boshladim va bir necha noto'g'ri burchakdan keyin temir qo'riqlar bilan qoplangan past bo'lakli bo'lak eshik oldida o'zimni topdim.

en: This is the spot, said the Professor as he turned his lamp on a small map of the house, copied from the ﬁle of my original correspondence re- garding the purchase.
uz: Bu joy, - dedi professor, uyning kichik xaritasi bo'yicha chiroqini o'chirib, sotib olishni qayta ko'rib chiqadigan asl xatlarimni nusxa qilib olgan.

en: With a little trouble we found the key on the bunch
uz: Biz biroz qiyinchilikka duch kelganimizda, guruhning kalitini topdik

en: and opened the door.
uz: va eshikni ochdi.

en: We were prepared for some unpleasantness, for as we were opening the door a faint, malodorous air seemed to exhale through the gaps, but none of us ever expected such an odor as we encountered.
uz: Biz biroz noqulaylikka tayyorgarlik ko'rdik, chunki eshikni ochayotganimizda, bo'shliqlar orqali kam, yomon hidli havo nafas olganiga o'xshardi, ammo hech birimiz duch kelgan bunday hidni kutmagan edik.

en: None of the others had met the Count at all at close quarters, and when I had seen him he was either in the fasting stage of his existence in his rooms or, when he was bloated with fresh blood, in a ruined building open to the air, but here the place was small and close, and the long disuse had made the air stagnant and foul.
uz: Boshqalarning hech biri Countni yaqin atrofda uchratmagan edi va men uni ko'rganimda, u o'z xonadonlarida ro'za tutganida yoki yangi qon bilan puflanganida, havoga ochiq vayron qilingan binoda edi, lekin bu yerda joy kichik va yaqin edi va uzoq vaqtdan beri foydalanilmaganligi tufayli havo susayib, iflos bo'lgan edi.

en: There was an earthy smell, as of some dry miasma, which came through the fouler air.
uz: Bu yerda quruq miasmaga o'xshaydigan, toza havo orqali paydo bo'lgan yerning hidini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: But as to the odor itself, how shall I de- scribe it?
uz: Ammo bu hidning o'zi haqida gap ketganda, uni qanday yozib qo'yishim kerak?

en: It was not alone that it was composed of all the ills of mortality and with the pungent, acrid smell of blood, but it seemed as though corrup- tion had become itself corrupt.
uz: U nafaqat o'lim kasalliklari va qonning o'tkir, achchiq hididan iborat edi, balki o'z-o'zidan buzg'unchilik ham buzg'unchilikka aylangan edi.

en: It sickens me to think of it.
uz: Bu haqda o'ylash meni bezovta qiladi.

en: Every breath exhaled by that monster seemed to have clung to the place and inten- siﬁed its loathsomeness.
uz: Bu hayvon nafas olgan har bir nafas o'sha joyga bog'lanib, uning jirkanchligini kuchaytirgan bo'ldi.

en: Under ordinary circumstances such a stench would have brought our en- terprise to an end, but this was no ordinary case, and the high and terrible purpose in which we were involved gave us a strength which rose above merely physical considerations.
uz: Oddiy sharoitlarda bunday buzuqlik bizning biznesimizni tugatardi, ammo bu oddiy holat emas edi va biz ishtirok etgan yuksak va dahshatli maqsad bizga faqat jismoniy nuqtai nazardan ustun turgan kuch berdi.

en: After the involuntary shrinking consequent on the ﬁrst nauseous whiff, we one and all set about our work as though that loathsome place were a garden of roses.
uz: Birinchi og'ir hiddan keyin bo'lmagan qisqartirishdan so'ng, biz hammamiz o'z ishimizni xuddi o'sha jirkanch joy gul bog'i kabi boshladik.

en: We made an accurate examination of the place, the Professor saying as we began, The ﬁrst thing is to see how many of the boxes are left, we must then examine every hole and corner and cranny and see if we cannot get some clue as to what has become of the rest. A glance was sufﬁcient to show how many remained, for the great earth chests were bulky, and there was no mistaking them.
uz: Biz joyni aniq tekshirdik va professor boshlaganimizda: Birinchi narsa, kutublarning qanchaligi qolganini ko'rishdir, keyin har bir teshik, burch va burchakni tekshirib, qolgan narsalarga nima bo'lganini aniqlay olmaymizmi, deb ko'rishimiz kerak, - deb aytdi.

en: There were only twenty-nine left out of the ﬁfty!
uz: Ellik kishidan atigi yigirma to'qqizta kishi qolgan!

en: Once I got a fright, for, seeing Lord Godalming suddenly turn and look out of the vaulted door into the dark passage beyond, I looked too, and for an instant my heart stood still.
uz: Bir marta qo'rqdim, chunki Lord Godalmingning to'satdan o'z o'rniga burilishini ko'rib, qo'rqinchli eshikdan tashqariga qaraganimda, men ham ko'rdim va yuragim bir daqiqaga to'xtadi.
