en: Somewhere, looking out from the shadow, I seemed to see the high lights of the Count's evil face, the ridge of the nose, the red eyes, the red lips, the awful pallor.
uz: Bir joyda, soyasidan ko'z o'ngga qarab, Countning yovuz yuzining yoritilgan yorug'liklarini, burunning bo'laklarini, qizil ko'zlarini, qizil og'izlarini, dahshatli o'tkirligini ko'rardim.

en: It was only for a moment, for, as Lord Godalming said,I thought I saw a face, but it was only the shadows, and resumed his inquiry, I turned my lamp in the direction, and stepped into the passage.
uz: Bu faqat bir muncha vaqt edi, chunki Lord Godalming aytganidek, Men yuz ko'rganimni his qildim, lekin bu faqat soyalar edi va uning so'rovini davom ettirganimdan so'ng, men chiroqimni yo'nalishdagi yo'lga o'zgartirib, yo'ldan o'tdim.

en: There was no sign of anyone, and as there were no corners, no doors, no aperture of any kind, but only the solid walls of the passage, there could be
uz: Hech kimning izlari yo'q edi va burchaklar, eshiklar, hech qanday ochko'zlik bo'lmaganligi sababli, faqat o'tishning mustahkam devorlari bo'lganligi sababli, bu yerda bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: no hiding place even for him.
uz: U uchun hatto yashirinib qolish uchun joy yo'q.

en: I took it that fear had helped imagination, and said nothing.
uz: Men qo'rquv tasavvurga yordam berganini anglab, hech narsa aytmadim.

en: A few minutes later I saw Morris step suddenly back from a corner, which he was examining.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, Morris bir burchadan, uni o'rganayotgan joydan to'satdan qaytganini ko'rdim.

en: We all followed his movements with our eyes, for undoubtedly some nervousness was growing on us, and we saw a whole mass of phosphorescence, which twinkled like stars.
uz: Hammamiz uning harakatlarini ko'zimiz bilan kuzatib turardik, chunki, shubhasiz, bizda g'alati g'alati paydo bo'ldi va biz yulduzlar kabi chiroqlashadigan fosforesentsiya to'plamini ko'rdik.

en: We all instinctively drew back.
uz: Biz hammamiz instinktli ravishda orqaga qaytdik.

en: The whole place was becoming alive with rats.
uz: Butun joy tovuqlarga to'lib-toshdi.

en: For a moment or two we stood appalled, all save Lord Godalming, who was seemingly prepared for such an emergency.
uz: Bir-ikki daqiqa biz qo'rqib turdik, faqat Lord Godalming bunday favqulodda vaziyatga tayyor turgan edi.

en: Rushing over to the great iron-bound oaken door, which Dr.
uz: Dastlab, Dr. tomonidan qo'llaniladigan temir bilan bog'langan katta bo'ron eshigini ko'tarib o'tishdi.

en: Seward had described from the outside, and which I had seen myself, he turned the key in the lock, drew the huge bolts, and swung the door open.
uz: Seward tashqi tomondan tasvirlagan va men o'zim ko'rgan narsani, u qulfdagi kalitni o'zgartirib, ulkan boltlarni tortib, eshikni ochdi.

en: Then, taking his little silver whistle from his pocket, he blew a low, shrill call.
uz: So'ngra o'zining kichkina kumush pishirganini qopqoqidan olib, past, shrill qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: It was answered from behind Dr.
uz: Bu savolga Dr.ning orqasidan javob topildi.

en: Se- ward's house by the yelping of dogs, and after about a minute three terriers came dashing round the corner of the house.
uz: S-warning uyi itlarning qichqiriqidan o'tib ketdi va bir daqiqa o'tgach, uy burchagidan uchta teriyer o'tib keldi.

en: Unconsciously we had all moved towards the door, and as we moved I noticed that the dust had been much disturbed.
uz: O'zimiz bilmasdan hammamiz eshik tomon harakatlanib ketdik va harakatlanayotganimizda tuproqning juda ko'p buzilganini payqadim.

en: The boxes which had been taken out had been brought this way.
uz: Chiqarilgan qutilar shu yo'l bilan olib kelingan edi.

en: But even in the minute that had elapsed the number of the rats had vastly increased.
uz: Ammo hatto o'tgan bir daqiqada tovuqlarning soni keskin oshdi.

en: They seemed to swarm over the place all at once, till the lamplight, shining on their moving dark bodies and glittering, baleful eyes, made the place look like a bank of earth set with ﬁreﬂies.
uz: Ular bir vaqtning o'zida joyni to'playotganga o'xshardilar, hatto chiroq chiroqlari ularning harakatlanayotgan qorong'i tanasi va parcha-parcha ko'zlari ustida shinam bo'lib, o'sha joyni yong'inlar bilan to'ldirilgan tuproqga o'xshatdi.

en: The dogs dashed on, but at the threshold suddenly stopped and snarled, and then,simultane- ously lifting their noses, began to howl in most lugubrious fashion.
uz: Itlar yugurib ketishdi, lekin chegaraga yetib kelib, to'xtab, qichqirishdi va keyin bir vaqtning o'zida burunlarini ko'tarib, juda dahshatli tarzda qichqirishdi.

en: The rats were multiplying in thousands, and we moved out.
uz: Tushlar minglab ko'payib borayotgan edi va biz ko'chib o'tdik.

en: Lord Godalming lifted one of the dogs, and carrying him in, placed him on the ﬂoor.
uz: Lord Godalming itlardan birini ko'tarib olib, uni yerga qo'ydi.

en: The instant his feet touched the ground he seemed to recover his courage, and rushed at his natural enemies.
uz: Uning oyoqlari yerga teggan paytida u jasoratini tiklab, tabiiy dushmanlariga hujum qildi.

en: They ﬂed before him so fast that before he had shaken the life out of a score, the other dogs, who had by now been lifted in the same manner, had but small prey ere the whole mass had vanished.
uz: Ular undan shunchalik tez qochib ketishdiki, u o'z hayotini to'xtatishdan oldin, boshqa itlar ham xuddi shunday yo'l bilan ko'tarilgan edilar, lekin butun to'plam yo'qolishdan oldin ular kichik ovlarga ega edilar.

en: With their going it seemed as if some evil presence had departed, for the dogs frisked about and barked merrily as they made sudden darts at their prostrate foes, and turned them over and over and tossed them in the air with vicious shakes.
uz: Ular ketayotganda, xuddi qandaydir yovuzlik ko'tarilgan bo'lgandek tuyuldi, chunki itlar o'z yuziga tushgan dushmanlariga to'satdan o'qlar qo'yib, ularni qayta-qayta burib, g'azablangan titrashlar bilan havoga tashlab ketishdi.

en: We all seemed to ﬁnd our spirits rise.
uz: Biz hammamiz ruhimizni ko'targan edik.

en: Whether it was the purifying of the deadly atmosphere by the opening of the chapel door, or the relief which we experienced by ﬁnding ourselves in the open I know not, but most certainly the shadow of dread seemed to slip from us like a
uz: Bu o'limga olib keladigan muhitni chapelning eshiklarini ochib tozalash bo'ladimi yoki ochiq joyda o'zimizni topganimizda ko'rgan yengillik bo'ladimi, bilmayman, lekin qo'rqinchning soyasi bizdan xuddi qo'rqinchli o'rnak kabi o'tib ketayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: robe, and the occasion of our coming lost something of its grim signiﬁ- cance, though we did not slacken a whit in our resolution.
uz: va kelish marosimi o'z ahamiyatidan mahrum bo'ldi, ammo biz qarorimizda hech qanday kamchilikni ko'rsatmadik.

en: We closed the outer door and barred and locked it, and bringing the dogs with us, began our search of the house.
uz: Biz tashqi eshikni yopdik va eshikni yopdik va qulflab qo'ydik va itlarni o'zimiz bilan birga olib, uyni qidirishni boshladik.

en: We found nothing throughout except dust in ex- traordinary proportions, and all untouched save for my own footsteps when I had made my ﬁrst visit.
uz: Biz butun joyda faqat gʻalati miqdordagi changni topdik va birinchi marta tashrif buyurganimda oʻz qadamlarimdan tashqari hamma narsa toʻxtamaydi.

en: Never once did the dogs exhibit any symptom of uneasiness, and even when we returned to the chapel they frisked about as though they had been rabbit hunting in a summer wood.
uz: Bir marta ham itlar noqulaylik alomatlarini ko'rsatmagan va biz chaplaga qaytib kelganimizda ham, ular yozgi o'rmonda tovuq ovlab yurgandek o'z-o'zlariga o'xshatishardi.

en: The morning was quickening in the east when we emerged from the front.
uz: Shaharning sharq tomonida ertalab kun o'sib borar ekan, biz oldindan chiqib ketdik.

en: Van Helsing had taken the key of the hall door from the bunch, and locked the door in orthodox fashion, putting the key into his pocket when he had done.
uz: Van Helsing xonadon eshikining kalitini guruhdan olib, eshikni ortodoksiy usulda qulflab qo'ygan edi.

en: So far, he said, our night has been eminently successful.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bugunga qadar kechasi juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

en: No harm has come to us such as I feared might be and yet we have ascertained how many boxes are missing.
uz: Bizga o'zim qo'rqqanimcha zarar yetkazilmagan va ammo qancha qutilar yo'qolganini aniqladik.

en: More than all do I rejoice that this, our ﬁrst, and perhaps our most difﬁcult and dangerous, step has been accomplished without the bringing thereinto our most sweet Madam Mina or troubling her waking or sleeping thoughts with sights and sounds and smells of horror which she might never forget.
uz: Eng asosiysi, bu birinchi va, ehtimol, eng qiyin va xavfli qadamni, eng sevimli Mina xonimni olib kelmasdan yoki uning uyg'onayotgan yoki uxlayotgan fikrlarini hech qachon unutmasligi mumkin bo'lgan dahshatli ko'rinishlar, tovushlar va hidlar bilan bezovta qilmasdan amalga oshirilganidan xursandman.

en: One lesson, too, we have learned, if it be allowable to argue a particulari, that the brute beasts which are to the Count's command are yet themselves not amenable to his spiritual power, for look, these rats that would come to his call, just as from his castle top he summon the wolves to your going and to that poor mother's cry, though they come to him, they run pell-mell from the so little dogs of my friend Arthur.
uz: Biz bir saboqni ham o'rgandik, agar partikulari deb aytish mumkin bo'lsa, Countning qo'mondonligi ostida bo'lgan yovvoyi hayvonlar uning ma'naviy kuchlariga hali ham qarshi emas, chunki bu tovuqlar uning chaqirig'iga javob beradi, xuddi o'z qal'asining ustidan u qurtlarni sizning ketishingiz va bu kambag'al ona qichqiriqingizga chaqirgani kabi, do'stim Arturning o'sha kichkina itlaridan g'alati-g'alati chiqib ketadi.

en: We have other matters before us, other dangers, other fears, and that monster … He has not used his power over the brute world for the only or the last time tonight.
uz: Oldimizda boshqa masalalar, boshqa xavf-xatarlar, boshqa qo'rquvlar bor va bu jondor... U o'z kuchidan faqatgina bir marta yoki so'nggi marta bu kechada yovuz dunyo ustidan foydalanmagan.

en: So be it that he has gone elsewhere.
uz: Shunday qilib, u boshqa joyga ketgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It has given us opportu- nity to cry `check'in some ways in this chess game, which we play for the stake of human souls.
uz: Bu bizga shaxmat o'yinida ba'zi yo'llar bilan yig'lash imkoniyatini berdi, chunki biz odamlarning jonlari uchun o'ynayapmiz.

en: And now let us go home.
uz: Endi uyga qaytaylik.

en: The dawn is close at hand, and we have reason to be content with our ﬁrst night's work.
uz: Tong yaqinlashib qoldi va biz birinchi kechaning ishidan mamnun bo'lishimiz uchun sabablarimiz bor.

en: It may be or- dained that we have many nights and days to follow, if full of peril, but we must go on, and from no danger shall we shrink. The house was silent when we got back, save for some poor creature who was screaming away in one of the distant wards, and a low, moaning sound from Renﬁeld's room.
uz: Garchi xavf ostida bo'lsa-da, ko'p kecha-kunlar bo'lishi mumkin, lekin biz davom etishimiz kerak va hech qanday xavfdan quvib ketmaymiz. - deb so'zlagan.Qayta qaytganimizda uy bechora edi, faqat bir nechta uzoq bo'shliqlarda qichqiriq qilayotgan bir kambag'al mavjudot va Renfieldning xonasidan past, g'ayratli ovoz chiqardi.

en: The poor wretch was doubtless torturing himself, af- ter the manner of the insane, with needless thoughts of pain.
uz: Yomon kambag'al, shubhasiz, o'zini azoblab, aqldan ozganlarning uslubini o'ylab, ortiqcha og'riq fikrlari bilan azob chekayotgan edi.

en: I came tiptoe into our own room, and found Mina asleep, breathing so softly that I had to put my ear down to hear it.
uz: O'z xonamizga kirdim va Minani uxlab yotgan holda ko'rdim, u shunchalik yengil nafas olganki, uni eshitish uchun quloqimni pastga tushirdim.

en: She looks paler than usual.
uz: U odatdagidan ko'proq bo'lak ko'rinadi.

en: I hope the meeting tonight has not upset her.
uz: Umid qilamanki, bu kecha bo'lib o'tgan uchrashuv uni xafa qilmagan.

en: I am truly thankful that she is to be left out of our future work, and even of our deliberations.
uz: U kelajakdagi ishimizdan, hatto fikrlashlarimizdan chetda qolgani uchun chinakam minnatdorman.

en: It is too great a strain for a woman to bear.
uz: Bu ayol uchun ko'proq og'ir yuk bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I did not think so at ﬁrst, but I know better now.
uz: Boshida men shunday o'ylamagan edim, lekin hozir yaxshiroq bilaman.

en: Therefore I am glad that it is settled.
uz: Shuning uchun bu masala hal qilinganidan xursandman.

en: There may be things which would frighten her to hear, and yet to conceal them from her might be worse than to tell her if once she suspected that there was any concealment.
uz: U eshitganidan qo'rqadigan narsalar bo'lishi mumkin, ammo ularni undan yashirish, agar u yashirish borligini shubha qilgan bo'lsa, unga aytishdan ham yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Henceforth our work is to be a sealed book to her, till at least such time as we can tell her that all is ﬁnished, and the earth free from a monster of the nether world.
uz: Bundan buyon bizning ishimiz, hech bo'lmaganda, biz unga hamma narsa tugagani va yer yuzi yer osti dunyosidagi haykaldan ozod bo'lganini aytadigan paytgacha, uning uchun muhrlangan kitob bo'lishdir.

en: I daresay it will be difﬁcult to begin to keep silence after such conﬁ- dence as ours, but I must be resolute, and tomorrow I shall keep dark over tonight's doings, and shall refuse to speak of anything that has happened.
uz: O'zimizga o'xshaydigan ishonchdan keyin so'zsiz qolishni boshlash qiyin bo'ladi, deb aytaman, lekin qat'iy bo'lishim kerak va ertaga bu kecha bo'lgan voqealar meni qorong'ilikka tushiradi va sodir bo'lgan har qanday voqea haqida gapirishdan bosh tortaman.

en: I rest on the sofa, so as not to disturb her.
uz: Men uni bezovta qilmaslik uchun sofa ustida dam olyapman.

en: 1 October, later.—I suppose it was natural that we should have all over- slept ourselves, for the day was a busy one, and the night had no rest at all.
uz: Oktyabrning 1-i keyinroq.Menimcha, biz hammamiz o'zimizdan ortiq uxlashimiz tabiiy edi, chunki kun juda mashg'ul bo'lgan va kechasi umuman dam olmagan.

en: Even Mina must have felt its exhaustion, for though I slept till the sun was high, I was awake before her, and had to call two or three times before she awoke.
uz: Hatto Mina ham o'zini charchagan his qilgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki men quyosh chiqmaguncha uxlagan bo'lsam-da, undan oldin uyg'onardim va u uyg'onishdan oldin ikki yoki uch marta qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi.

en: Indeed, she was so sound asleep that for a few seconds she did not recognize me, but looked at me with a sort of blank terror, as one looks who has been waked out of a bad dream.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, u shunchalik uxlaganki, bir necha soniya davomida meni tanimadi, lekin yomon orzudan uyg'otilgan kishiga o'xshaydigan, o'zgacha qo'rqinchli ko'rinish bilan menga qaradi.

en: She complained a little of being tired, and I let her rest till later in the day.
uz: U biroz charchaganligidan shikoyat qildi va men unga kunning oxirida dam olishga ruxsat berdim.

en: We now know of twenty-one boxes having been removed, and if it be that several were taken in any of these removals we may be able to trace them all.
uz: Hozirda yigirma bir quti olib tashlanganini bilamiz va agar bir nechta quti olib tashlangan bo'lsa, ularning barchasini izlab topishimiz mumkin.

en: Such will, of course, immensely simplify our labor, and the sooner the matter is attended to the better.
uz: Albatta, bunday ish bizning mehnatimizni sezilarli darajada soddalashtiradi va bu masala qanchalik tezroq hal qilinsa, shunchalik yaxshi.

en: I shall look up Thomas Snelling today.
uz: Bugun Tomas Snellingni qidiraman.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 1 October.—It was towards noon when I was awakened by the Professor walking into my room.
uz: SEWARD'S DIARY 1 oktyabr.Men o'tmishga yaqin bo'lganimda, professor xonamga kirganida uyg'onib qoldim.

en: He was more jolly and cheerful than usual, and it is quite evident that last night's work has helped to take some of the brooding weight off his mind.
uz: U odatdagidan ko'proq quvonchli va quvonchli edi va o'tgan kechaning ishi uning ongidan biroz og'irlikni olib tashlashga yordam berganligi aniq.

en: After going over the adventure of the night he suddenly said, Your pa- tient interests me much.
uz: Kechagi mashg'ulotlarni ko'rib chiqqandan so'ng, u to'satdan shunday dedi: Sizning hikoyangiz meni juda qiziqtiradi.

en: May it be that with you I visit him this morning?
uz: Bugun ertalab siz bilan birga unga tashrif buyurishim mumkinmi?

en: Or if that you are too occupy, I can go alone if it may be.
uz: Yoki agar siz juda mashg'ul bo'lsangiz, agar kerak bo'lsa, men yolg'iz borishim mumkin.

en: It is a new experi- ence to me to ﬁnd a lunatic who talk philosophy, and reason so sound. I had some work to do which pressed, so I told him that if he would go alone I would be glad, as then I should not have to keep him waiting, so I
uz: Filosofiya gapiradigan va asosli fikr yuritadigan aqldan ozgan odamni topish men uchun yangi tajriba edi. Men juda muhim ishni bajarishim kerak edi, shuning uchun uni yolg'iz ketishiga rozi bo'lishim kerakligini aytdim, chunki uni kutishga majbur qilmasdim, shuning uchun men unga xursand bo'laman, deb aytdim.

en: called an attendant and gave him the necessary instructions.
uz: U bir xizmatkorni chaqirib, unga kerakli ko'rsatmalarni berdi.

en: Before the Pro- fessor left the room I cautioned him against getting any false impression from my patient.
uz: Professor xonani tark etishdan oldin men uni bemorimdan noto'g'ri taassurot qoldirmaslik haqida ogohlantirdim.

en: But, he answered, I want him to talk of himself and of his delusion as to consuming live things.
uz: - Lekin, - dedi u, - men uning o'zi haqida va tirik narsalarni iste'mol qilish haqidagi aldamchiligi haqida gapirishini xohlayman.

en: He said to Madam Mina, as I see in your diary of yesterday, that he had once had such a belief.
uz: O'sha kuni sizning kundaligingizda ko'rganimdek, u Madam Minaga bir vaqtlar bunday e'tiqodga ega bo'lganini aytdi.

en: Why do you smile, friend John? Excuse me, I said, but the answer is here. I laid my hand on the type- written matter.When our sane and learned lunatic made that very statement of how he used to consume life, his mouth was actually nauseous with the ﬂies and spiders which he had eaten just before Mrs.
uz: Nima uchun tabassum qilyapsan, do'st Jon? - dedim men, - Kechirasiz, lekin javob shu erda. - Men matn matnida qo'limni qo'ydim. - Bizning aqlli va bilimdon aqldan ozgan odam o'z hayotini qanday yo'qotish to'g'risida aynan shunday so'zlarni aytganida, og'zidan tovuq va o'rgimchanlar og'zidan g'amgin edi.

en: Harker entered the room. Van Helsing smiled in turn.
uz: Harker xonaga kirdi. - dedi Van Helsing o'z navbatida tabassum bilan.

en: Your memory is true, friend John.
uz: Sening xotirasing haqiqiy, do'stim Jon.

en: I should have remembered.
uz: Esga olishim kerak edi.

en: And yet it is this very obliquity of thought and memory which makes mental disease such a fascinating study.
uz: Shunga qaramay, bu fikr va xotiralarning o'ziga xos bo'shligi, ruhiy kasallikni o'ta qiziqarli o'rganishga aylantiradi.

en: Perhaps I may gain more knowledge out of the folly of this madman than I shall from the teaching of the most wise.
uz: Ehtimol, men bu aqlsizning aqlsizlikidan donolarning ta'limotlaridan ko'ra ko'proq bilimga ega bo'laman.

en: Who knows? I went on with my work, and before long was through that in hand.
uz: Kim biladi? - deb so'zlarni davom ettirdim va ko'p o'tmay bu ishni tugatdim.

en: It seemed that the time had been very short indeed, but there was Van Helsing back in the study.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, vaqt juda qisqa edi, lekin tadqiqotda Van Helsing yana bor edi.

en: Do I interrupt? he asked politely as he stood at the door.
uz: Menga aralashyapmanmi? - deb so'radi u xushmuomalalik bilan eshik oldida turib.

en: Not at all,I answered.
uz: Men javob berdim: Agar yo'q.

en: My work is ﬁnished, and I am free.
uz: Ishim tugadi va men ozodman.

en: I can go with you now, if you like. It is needless, I have seen him! Well? I fear that he does not appraise me at much.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, men endi siz bilan birga borishim mumkin. Bu keraksiz, men uni ko'rdim! Ha? Men qo'rqamanki, u meni ko'p baholamaydi.

en: Our interview was short.
uz: Suhbatimiz qisqa bo'ldi.

en: When I entered his room he was sitting on a stool in the center, with his el- bows on his knees, and his face was the picture of sullen discontent.
uz: Xonasiga kirganimda, u o'rtada bir stolda o'tirgan edi, o'z qo'llarini tiz cho'kkan, yuzida esa o'ziga xos norozilik ko'rinardi.

en: I spoke to him as cheerfully as I could, and with such a measure of respect as I could assume.
uz: Men unga iloji boricha ko'p quvonch va hurmat bilan gapirardim.

en: He made no reply whatever.
uz: U hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: 'Don't you know me?' I asked.
uz: Men: Sen meni tanimaysanmi? - deb so'radim.

en: His answer was not reassuring.
uz: Uning javobi tasalli bermadi.

en: I know you well enough, you are the old fool Van Helsing.
uz: Seni yaxshi bilaman, sen Van Helsingning keksa o'g'li bo'lasan.

en: I wish you would take yourself and your idiotic brain the- ories somewhere else.
uz: O'zingizni va o'zingizning aqlsiz miyangizni boshqa joyga olib ketishingizni xohlayman.

en: Damn all thick-headed Dutchmen!' Not a word more would he say, but sat in his implacable sullenness as indifferent to me as though I had not been in the room at all.
uz: Qani, barcha qalin boshli oltinchalar! - dedi u, bir so'z ham aytmadi, lekin o'zining shafqatsiz yolg'izligida o'tirdi va men uchun xuddi xonada bo'lmaganim kabi befarq bo'ldi.

en: Thus departed for this time my chance of much learning from this so clever lunatic, so I shall go, if I may, and cheer myself with a few happy words with that sweet soul Madam
uz: Shunday qilib, bu safar bu aqlli aqlsizdan ko'p narsani o'rganish imkoniyatim yo'qoldi, shuning uchun men boraman, agar ilojim bo'lsa, va o'zimni bir necha quvonchli so'zlar bilan o'sha shirin ruh bilan xursand qilaman Madam

en: Friend John, it does rejoice me unspeakable that she is no more to be pained, no more to be worried with our terrible things.
uz: Do'stim Jon, u endi og'riqli bo'lmasligi, qo'rqinchli narsalarimiz haqida tashvishlanmasligi uchun menga quvonch baxsh etadi.

en: Though we shall much miss her help, it is better so. I agree with you with all my heart, I answered earnestly, for I did not want him to weaken in this matter.
uz: Garchi uning yordamini juda sog'inib ko'rsak-da, bu yaxshiroqdir. - Men butun qalbim bilan sen bilan qo'shildim, deb javob berdim, chunki men uning bu masalada zaiflanishini istamagan edim.

en: Harker is better out of it.
uz: Harker bundan yaxshiroq.

en: Things are quite bad enough for us, all men of the world, and who have been in many tight places in our time, but it is no place for a woman, and if she had remained in touch with the affair, it would in time infallibly have wrecked her. So Van Helsing has gone to confer with Mrs.
uz: Dunyodagi barcha erkaklar uchun bu juda yomon holatdir va biz o'z davrimizda ko'plab qiyin joylarda bo'lganmiz, lekin bu yerda ayol uchun joy yo'q va agar u ish bilan aloqada bo'lganida edi, vaqt o'tib uni halok qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Harker and Harker, Quincey and Art are all out following up the clues as to the earth boxes.
uz: Harker va Harker, Quincey va Art yer qutisi haqidagi izlarni izlashmoqda.

en: I shall ﬁnish my round of work and we shall meet tonight.
uz: Men o'z ish turimni tugataman va bugun kechqurun uchrashamiz.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 October.—It is strange to me to be kept in the dark as I am today, after Jonathan's full conﬁdence for so many years, to see him manifestly avoid certain matters, and those the most vital of all.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 oktyabr.Men uchun Jonatanning ko'p yillardan beri o'z ishonchi bilan ishonganidan keyin, hozirgi holatda qorong'ilikda qolish va uni aniq ravishda ba'zi va eng muhim masalalardan qochishini ko'rish g'alati.

en: This morning I slept late af- ter the fatigues of yesterday, and though Jonathan was late too, he was the earlier.
uz: Bugun ertalab kech uyquga ketdim, chunki o'tgan kunning yorug'ligi tufayli, Jonatan ham kechikgan bo'lsa-da, u erta edi.

en: He spoke to me before he went out, never more sweetly or tenderly, but he never mentioned a word of what had happened in the visit to the Count's house.
uz: U men bilan ketishdan oldin, hech qachon ko'proq shirinlik va mehribonlik bilan gapirgan, lekin Countning uyiga tashrif paytida sodir bo'lgan voqealardan hech qachon bir so'z aytmagan.

en: And yet he must have known how terribly anxious I was.
uz: Ammo u men qanchalik tashvishlanayotganimni bilgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: I suppose it must have distressed him even more than it did me.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu unga mendan ko'ra ko'proq xafa bo'lgan.

en: They all agreed that it was best that I should not be drawn further into this awful work, and I acquiesced.
uz: Hamma bu dahshatli ishda davom etmasligim kerakligiga rozi bo'ldi va men rozi bo'ldim.

en: But to think that he keeps anything from me!
uz: Ammo u mendan biror narsani yashiryapti deb o'ylashim mumkin!

en: And now I am crying like a silly fool, when I know it comes from my husband's great love and from the good, good wishes of those other strong men.
uz: Endi esa erimning katta muhabbati va boshqa kuchli odamlarning yaxshilik va yaxshilik tilaklaridan kelib chiqqanini bilganimda, ahmoq kabi yig'layapman.

en: That has done me good.
uz: Bu menga yaxshilik qildi.

en: Well, some day Jonathan will tell me all.
uz: Bir kuni Jonatan menga hamma narsani aytib beradi.

en: And lest it should ever be that he should think for a moment that I kept anything from him, I still keep my journal as usual.
uz: Va men undan biron narsa yashirganimni bir zumda ham o'ylamasligi uchun, men hali ham odatdagidek jurnalimni saqlayman.

en: Then if he has feared of my trust I shall show it to him, with every thought of my heart put down for his dear eyes to read.
uz: Keyin, agar u mening ishonchimdan qo'rqsa, men unga ishonchimni ko'rsataman, yuragimdagi har bir fikr uning sevimli ko'zlari uchun o'qib chiqariladi.

en: I feel strangely sad and low-spirited today.
uz: Bugun o'zimni g'alati darajada xafa va tushkun his qilyapman.

en: I suppose it is the reaction from the terrible excitement.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu dahshatli hayajonning reaktsiyasi.

en: Last night I went to bed when the men had gone, simply because they told me to.
uz: Kecha men erkaklar ketayotgan paytda uxlashga ketdim, shunchaki ular aytgani uchun.

en: I didn't feel sleepy, and I did feel full of devouring anxiety.
uz: Men o'zimni uyqusiz his qilmadim va o'zimni o'zimni to'la-to'kis xavotirga to'ldirib his qildim.

en: I kept thinking over everything that has been ever since Jonathan came to see me in London, and it all seems like a horrible tragedy, with fate pressing on relentlessly to some destined end.
uz: Jonatan meni Londonda ko'rishga kelganidan beri sodir bo'lgan barcha narsalar haqida o'ylayman va bularning barchasi dahshatli fojiaga o'xshaydi, taqdir esa o'z nihoyasiga yetib bormoqda.

en: Everything that one does seems, no mat-
uz: Biror kishi qilgan hamma narsa ko'rinadi, hech narsa yo'q.

en: ter how right it me be, to bring on the very thing which is most to be de- plored.
uz: Men eng katta qo'rquvga loyiq bo'lgan narsani o'z ichiga oldim.

en: If I hadn't gone to Whitby, perhaps poor dear Lucy would be with us now.
uz: Agar men Uitbiga bormaganimda edi, ehtimol kambag'al aziz Lusi hozir biz bilan birga bo'lar edi.

en: She hadn't taken to visiting the churchyard till I came, and if she hadn't come there in the day time with me she wouldn't have walked in her sleep.
uz: Men kelmagunimcha u cherkov hovlisini ko'rishga bormagan edi va agar u kunduzda men bilan birga bo'lmaganida, u uxlab yurmagan bo'lardi.

en: And if she hadn't gone there at night and asleep, that monster couldn't have destroyed her as he did.
uz: Va agar u kechasi u yerga borib uxlamasa, bu haykal uni o'zi kabi yo'q qila olmagan bo'lardi.

en: Oh, why did I ever go to Whitby?
uz: Nima uchun men Uitbiga borganman?

en: There now, crying again!
uz: Mana endi, yana yig'layapman!

en: I wonder what has come over me today.
uz: Bugun menga nima yuz berdi, deb o'ylayman.

en: I must hide it from Jonathan, for if he knew that I had been crying twice in one morning … I, who never cried on my own account, and whom he has never caused to shed a tear, the dear fellow would fret his heart out.
uz: Men buni Jonatanning oldiga yashirishim kerak, chunki agar u mening bir kunda ikki marta yig'laganimni bilsa ... men hech qachon o'zim uchun yig'lamagan va u hech qachon ko'z yoshini to'kib solmagan bo'lsam, aziz yigit o'z yuragini tashlab ketadi.

en: I shall put a bold face on, and if I do feel weepy, he shall never see it.
uz: Men jasoratli yuzaga kelaman va agar yig'layotgan bo'lsam, u buni hech qachon ko'rmaydi.

en: I suppose it is just one of the lessons that we poor women have to learn … I can't quite remember how I fell asleep last night.
uz: Ehtimol, bu biz kambag'al ayollar o'rganishimiz kerak bo'lgan saboqlardan biridir ... Men o'tgan kecha qanday qilib uxlab qolganimni to'liq eslay olmayman.

en: I remember hearing the sudden barking of the dogs and a lot of queer sounds, like praying on a very tumultuous scale, from Mr.
uz: Men itlarning to'satdan qichqirishini va ko'plab g'alati tovushlarni, masalan, juda g'alati miqyosda ibodat qilishni eshitganimni eslayman.

en: Renﬁeld's room, which is somewhere un- der this.
uz: Renfieldning xonasi, bu bir joyda joylashgan.

en: And then there was silence over everything, silence so profound that it startled me, and I got up and looked out of the window.
uz: So'ngra hamma narsa ushlab turdi, shunchalik chuqur bir sukut bo'ldiki, meni qo'rqitdi va men o'rnidan turib, darchaga qaradim.

en: All was dark and silent, the black shadows thrown by the moonlight seeming full of a silent mystery of their own.
uz: Hamma narsa qorong'i va sukut bo'lgan, oy yorug'ligi tomonidan tashlangan qora soyalar o'zlarining sukutsiz sirlari bilan to'la ko'rinardi.

en: Not a thing seemed to be stirring, but all to be grim and ﬁxed as death or fate, so that a thin streak of white mist,that crept with almost imperceptible slowness across the grass towards the house, seemed to have a sentience and a vitality of its own.
uz: Hech bir narsa hayratlanmayotgandek tuyuldi, lekin hamma narsa qorong'i va o'lim yoki taqdir kabi o'rnatilgan edi, shuning uchun o'zidan-o'zidan o'zgacha his-tuyg'u va jon-jahd bo'lib, uyga qarab o'tkir o'tlar bo'ylab deyarli ko'rinmas sekinlik bilan o'tkirgan oq bulutning kam bo'lak qismi o'ziga xos his-tuyg'u va jonlilikka ega bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: I think that the digres- sion of my thoughts must have done me good, for when I got back to bed I found a lethargy creeping over me.
uz: O'ylaymanki, fikrlarimni o'zgartirish menga yaxshi ko'rsatgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki yana uxlab yotganimda, o'zimning ustimdan bir letargiya o'tib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I lay a while, but could not quite sleep, so I got out and looked out of the window again.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt uxlab qoldim, lekin to'liq uxlay olmadim, shuning uchun tashqariga chiqib, yana bir bor oynadan ko'rdim.

en: The mist was spreading, and was now close up to the house, so that I could see it lying thick against the wall, as though it were stealing up to the windows.
uz: To'fon tarqalgan edi va u uyga yaqinlashib qoldi, shuning uchun uni devorga to'qnashganini ko'rardim, xuddi darchalargacha o'g'irlab ketgandek.

en: The poor man was more loud than ever, and though I could not distinguish a word he said, I could in some way recognize in his tones some passionate entreaty on his part.
uz: Zavqsiz odam har qachongidan ham baland ovoz bilan gapirgan va men uning so'zini ajratib bo'lmaganda ham, uning so'zlaridan qaysidir jihatdan uning iltijolarini tan olishim mumkin edi.

en: Then there was the sound of a struggle, and I knew that the attendants were dealing with him.
uz: So'ngra kurashning ovozi eshitildi va men xizmatkorlarning u bilan shug'ullanayotganini bilardim.

en: I was so frightened that I crept into bed, and pulled the clothes over my head, putting my ﬁngers in my ears.
uz: Men shunchalik qo'rqdimki, yotoqqa yiqilib, kiyimni boshimga surib qo'ydim va barmoqlarimni qulog'imga qo'ydim.

en: I was not then a bit sleepy, at least so I thought, but I must have fallen asleep, for except dreams, I do not remember anything until the morning, when Jonathan woke me.
uz: O'shanda biroz uxlamagan edim, hech bo'lmaganda shunday deb o'yladim, lekin uxlagan bo'laman, chunki tushlardan tashqari, ertalab Jonatan meni uyg'otguniga qadar hech narsa eslay olmayman.

en: I think that it took me an effort and a little time to realize where I was, and that it was Jonathan who was bending over me.
uz: O'ylaymanki, qaerda ekanligimni anglash uchun biroz vaqt va harakat kerak bo'ldi va Jonatan menga yonboshlagan edi.

en: very peculiar, and was almost typical of the way that waking thoughts be- come merged in, or continued in, dreams.
uz: Bu juda g'alati va uyg'onayotgan fikrlar orzularga qo'shilib, davom etishi uchun deyarli o'ziga xos edi.

en: I thought that I was asleep, and waiting for Jonathan to come back.
uz: O'zimni uyquda, Jonatan qaytib kelishini kutayotgan deb o'ylardim.

en: I was very anxious about him, and I was powerless to act, my feet, and my hands, and my brain were weighted, so that nothing could proceed at the usual pace.
uz: Men u uchun juda tashvishlanardim va harakat qilish uchun kuchim yo'q edi, oyoqlarim, qo'llarim va miyam og'ir edi, shuning uchun hech narsa odatdagidek davom eta olmaydi.

en: And so I slept uneasily and thought.
uz: Shunday qilib, men uxlab, o'yladim.

en: Then it began to dawn upon me that the air was heavy, and dank, and cold.
uz: Keyin men havo og'ir, nam va sovuq ekanini anglay boshladim.

en: I put back the clothes from my face, and found, to my surprise, that all was dim around.
uz: O'zimning yuzimdagi kiyimlarni o'chirib qo'ydim, lekin men hayron bo'lganimcha, atrofdagi narsalar ko'rinmas edi.

en: The gaslight which I had left lit for Jonathan, but turned down, came only like a tiny red spark through the fog, which had evidently grown thicker and poured into the room.
uz: Jonatan uchun yoqilg'isi yoqilgan, lekin yoqilg'isi yoqilmagan gaz chiroqini, billurki, qorong'i bo'lib, xonaga to'kkan kichkina qizil chiroq kabi, bulutdan o'tkazib yuborganman.

en: Then it occurred to me that I had shut the window before I had come to bed.
uz: Keyin eslaymanki, uxlashdan oldin derazni yopdim.

en: I would have got out to make certain on the point, but some leaden lethargy seemed to chain my limbs and even my will.
uz: Men bu mavzuga ishonch hosil qilish uchun chiqib ketardim, lekin ba'zi bir qo'llanma xafagarligi qo'llarimni va hatto irodamni bog'lab qo'ygan bo'ldi.

en: I lay still and en- dured, that was all.
uz: Men to'xtamay, to'xtamay yotgan edim.

en: I closed my eyes, but could still see through my eyelids.
uz: Ko'zlarimni yopdim, lekin hali ham ko'z qo'lqoplarim orqali ko'rishim mumkin edi.

en: (It is wonderful what tricks our dreams play us, and how conveniently we can imagine.) The mist grew thicker and thicker and I could see now how it came in, for I could see it like smoke, or with the white energy of boiling water, pouring in, not through the window, but through the joinings of the door.
uz: (Hox ajoyib, orzularimiz bizga qanday hiyla-nayranglar o'ynaydi va biz buni qanchalik qulay tasavvur qila olamiz.) Bu bulut tobora tobora kengayib borardi va men uni qanday kirib kelganini endi ko'rardim, chunki uni tutun kabi yoki qaynoq suvning oq energiyasi bilan ko'rardim.

en: It got thicker and thicker, till it seemed as if it became concentrated into a sort of pillar of cloud in the room, through the top of which I could see the light of the gas shining like a red eye.
uz: U qalinroq va qalinroq bo'lib borardi, hatto u xonada bulut ustuni bo'lib o'tirganidek tuyuldi, uning ustida men gazning nurini qizil ko'z kabi porlab turganini ko'rardim.

en: Things began to whirl through my brain just as the cloudy column was now whirling in the room, and through it all came the scriptural words a pillar of cloud by day and of ﬁre by night. Was it indeed such spiritual guidance that was coming to me in my sleep?
uz: O'zimning miyamda hamma narsa to'p-to'p bo'lib o'tdi, xuddi bulutli ustun xonada to'p-to'p bo'lib o'tganidek, u hammaning ichida kun davomida bulut ustuni, kechasi esa olov ustuni degan Muqaddas Kitob so'zlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: But the pillar was composed of both the day and the night guid- ing, for the ﬁre was in the red eye, which at the thought gat a new fascina- tion for me, till, as I looked, the ﬁre divided, and seemed to shine on me through the fog like two red eyes, such as Lucy told me of in her momen- tary mental wandering when, on the cliff, the dying sunlight struck the win- dows of St.
uz: Ammo ustun kun va kechani boshqarishdan iborat edi, chunki o't qizil ko'zda edi, bu fikr men uchun yangi qiziqish uyg'otdi, hatto ko'z oldimdan ko'rib turganimda, olov bo'lindi va toshda ikkita qizil ko'z kabi menga nur sochdi, xuddi Luzi o'z aql-idrokida o'tirgan vaqtlarida menga aytib berganidek, qirg'oqda o'tib ketayotgan quyosh nurlari St.

en: Suddenly the horror burst upon me that it was thus that Jonathan had seen those awful women growing into reality through the whirling mist in the moonlight, and in my dream I must have fainted, for all became black darkness.
uz: Toʻsatdan qoʻrqinch meni toʻsib yubordi, chunki Jonatan oʻsha dahshatli ayollar oy nurida aylanayotgan bulut orqali haqiqatga aylanib borayotganini koʻrgan edi va orzuimda men unutib ketishim kerak edi, chunki hamma narsa qora zulmatga aylandi.

en: The last conscious effort which imagination made was to show me a livid white face bending over me out of the mist.
uz: Fikrning so'nggi tasodifiy urinishi, meni bulutdan o'girib turgan oq ko'rinishdagi yuzimni ko'rsatishdan iborat edi.

en: I must be careful of such dreams, for they would unseat one's reason if there were too much of them.
uz: Bunday orzularga ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak, chunki ular juda ko'p bo'lganda, insonning fikrini buzadi.

en: prescribe something for me which would make me sleep, only that I fear to alarm them.
uz: Menga uyquga tushadigan biron bir narsani tayinlang, lekin men ularni qo'rqitishdan qo'rqaman.

en: Such a dream at the present time would become woven into their fears for me.
uz: Hozirgi paytda bunday orzu ular men uchun qo'rqishlariga bog'liq bo'ladi.

en: Tonight I shall strive hard to sleep naturally.
uz: Bu kecha tabiiy ravishda uxlashga harakat qilaman.

en: If I do not, I shall tomorrow night get them to give me a dose of chloral, that cannot hurt me for once, and it will give me a good night's sleep.
uz: Agar yo'q bo'lsa, ertaga kechqurun ularga chloral dozasini berishlarini aytaman, bu menga bir marta ham zarar bera olmaydi va bu menga yaxshi uyqu beradi.

en: Last night tired me more than if I had not slept at all.
uz: Kecha kechqurun uxlamaganimdan ko'ra ko'proq charchadim.

en: m.—Last night I slept, but did not dream.
uz: M.Kecha uxladim, lekin orzu qilmadim.

en: I must have slept soundly, for I was not waked by Jonathan coming to bed, but the sleep has not refreshed me, for today I feel terribly weak and spiritless.
uz: To'g'ri, yaxshi uxladim, chunki Jonatan uxlab ketgani meni uyg'otmadi, lekin uyqu menga tasalli bermadi, chunki bugun men o'zimni juda zaif va ruhsiz his qilaman.

en: I spent all yesterday trying to read, or lying down dozing.
uz: Kecha butun kunimni o'qishga harakat qilib yoki uxlab yotganimda o'tkazdim.

en: In the afternon, Mr.
uz: Afternonda, Mr.

en: Renﬁeld asked if he might see me.Poor man, he was very gentle, and when I came away he kissed my hand and bade God bless me.
uz: Renfield meni ko'rishni so'radi.Yomon odam, u juda mehribon edi va men chiqib ketayotganimda, u qo'limni o'qib, Xudo menga baraka berishini so'radi.

en: Some way it affected me much.
uz: Bu menga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

en: I am crying when I think of him.
uz: U haqda o'ylaganimda yig'layman.

en: This is a new weakness, of which I must be careful.
uz: Bu yangi zaiflik, undan ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak.

en: Jonathan would be miserable if he knew I had been crying.
uz: Agar Jonatan mening yig'laganimni bilsa, juda xafa bo'lardi.

en: He and the others were out till dinner time, and they all came in tired.
uz: U va boshqalar kechki ovqat paytigacha tashqarida bo'lishdi va hammalari charchagan holda kirib kelishdi.

en: I did what I could to brighten them up, and I suppose that the effort did me good, for I forgot how tired I was.
uz: Men ularni yorug'lantirish uchun qo'limdan kelganini qildim va shubhasiz, harakat menga yaxshi foyda keltirdi, chunki men qanchalik charchaganimni unutib qo'ydim.

en: After dinner they sent me to bed, and all went off to smoke together, as they said, but I knew that they wanted to tell each other of what had occurred to each during the day.
uz: Ovqatdan so'ng meni uxlashga yubordilar va hammalari aytgandek birga chekishga ketishdi, lekin ular bir-biriga kun davomida o'tgan voqealarni aytib berishni xohlashlarini bilardim.

en: I could see from Jonathan's manner that he had something important to communicate.
uz: Jonatanning xulq-atvoridan ko'rinib turibdiki, u muhim bir gapni aytmoqchi edi.

en: I was not so sleepy as I should have been, so before they went I asked Dr.
uz: Men kerakli darajada uxlamagan edim, shuning uchun ular ketishdan oldin doktordan maslahat so'radim.

en: Seward to give me a little opiate of some kind, as I had not slept well the night be- fore.
uz: Kecha yaxshi uxlamaganim sababli, Seward menga biroz opiat berishga harakat qildi.

en: He very kindly made me up a sleeping draught, which he gave to me, telling me that it would do me no harm, as it was very mild … I have taken it, and am waiting for sleep, which still keeps aloof.
uz: U menga juda mehribonlik bilan uyqu usti yaratdi va uni menga berdi, u menga hech qanday zarar bermasligini aytdi, chunki u juda yengil edi ... Men uni qabul qildim va hali ham uzoqda turadigan uyquni kutyapman.

en: I hope I have not done wrong, for as sleep begins to ﬂirt with me, a new fear comes, that I may have been foolish in thus depriving myself of the power of waking.
uz: Umid qilamanki, men noto'g'ri ish qilmaganman, chunki uyqu menga dalda berishni boshlaganida, o'zimni uyg'otish qobiliyatidan mahrum qilishda ahmoqona bo'lganimdan qo'rqaman.

en: CHAPTER 20 JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 October, evening.—I found Thomas Snelling in his house at Bethnal Green, but unhappily he was not in a condition to remember anything.
uz: 20 - bob Jonatan Harkerning jurnalining 1 - oktabr kuni kechasi.Men Tomas Snellingni Baytnal Grindagi uyiga topdim, ammo u, afsuski, hech narsani eslay olmaydigan holatda edi.

en: The very prospect of beer which my expected coming had opened to him had proved too much, and he had begun too early on his expected debauch.
uz: O'shanda men kutilgan pivonga ega bo'lish imkoniyati unga juda ko'p bo'lgan va u o'zining kutilgan g'alati ishini juda erta boshlagan edi.

en: I learned, however, from his wife, who seemed a decent, poor soul, that he was only the assistant of Smollet, who of the two mates was the responsible person.
uz: Biroq, uning xotini menga yaxshi va kambag'al ruhdek tuyuladi, uni faqat Smolletning yordamchisi deb bilib oldim.

en: So off I drove to Walworth, and found Mr.
uz: Shunday qilib, men Walworthga bordim va Mr.ni topdim.

en: Joseph Smollet at home and in his shirtsleeves, taking a late tea out of a saucer.
uz: Joseph Smollet uyda va ko'ylaklarini kiyib, pishiruvchidan kechlab choy ichibdi.

en: He is a decent, intel- ligent fellow, distinctly a good, reliable type of workman, and with a head- piece of his own.
uz: U munosib, aqlli odam, aniq qilib, yaxshi, ishonchli ishchi va o'z o'ziga xos boshli odam.

en: He remembered all about the incident of the boxes, and from a wonderful dog-eared notebook, which he produced from some mys- terious receptacle about the seat of his trousers, and which had hieroglyphi- cal entries in thick, half-obliterated pencil, he gave me the destinations of the boxes.
uz: U qutilarning hodisasi to'g'risida hamma narsani esladi va o'z piyozlarining o'rinbosari atrofidagi sirli idishdan ishlab chiqargan ajoyib it quloqlari bilan yozilgan yozuvdan, katta, yarim yo'q bo'lgan qalamda giyerogliflar bilan yozilgan qutilarning manzillarini menga berdi.

en: There were, he said, six in the cartload which he took from Car- fax and left at 197 Chicksand Street, Mile End New Town, and another six which he deposited at Jamaica Lane, Bermondsey.
uz: Uning aytishicha, mashinada oltita narsa bor edi, uni avtofaxdan olib 197 Chicksand Street, Mile End New Town-da qoldirdi va yana oltita narsani Jamaika Lane, Bermondseyda joylashtirdi.

en: If then the Count meant to scatter these ghastly refuges of his over London, these places were cho- sen as the ﬁrst of delivery, so that later he might distribute more fully.
uz: Agar Count o'zining qo'rqinchli o'rinlarini Londonda tarqatmoqchi bo'lsa, keyinchalik u yanada to'liq tarqatishi uchun bu joylar birinchi bo'lib yetkazib berilishi kerak edi.

en: The systematic manner in which this was done made me think that he could not mean to conﬁne himself to two sides of London.
uz: Bularning muntazam ravishda amalga oshirilishi meni u Londondagi ikki tomonga cheklanishni istamaydi deb o'ylashga undagan.

en: He was now ﬁxed on the far east on the northern shore, on the east of the southern shore, and on the south.
uz: Endi u shimoliy sohilda, janubiy sohilning sharqida va janubiy sohilda uzoq sharqda joylashgan edi.

en: The north and west were surely never meant to be left out of his dia- bolical scheme, let alone the City itself and the very heart of fashionable London in the south-west and west.
uz: Shimoliy va g'arbiy mamlakatlar uning yovuz rejasi ostida qolmasligi kerak edi, bundan tashqari, shaharning o'zi va janubi-g'arbiy va g'arbiy Londondagi moddiy Londonning yuragi ham bundan mustasno.

en: I went back to Smollet, and asked him if he could tell us if any other boxes had been taken from Carfax.
uz: Men Smolletga qaytib borib, unga boshqa qutilar Carfaxdan olib ketilganmi, deb so'radim.

en: He replied, Well guv'nor, you've treated me very 'an'some, I had given him half a sovereign, an I'll tell yer all I know.
uz: U shunday javob berdi: Hokim, siz menga juda yaxshi munosabatda bo'ldingiz, men unga yarim sovern berdim, men sizga hamma narsani aytib beraman.

en: I heard a man by the name
uz: Men ismli bir odamni eshitgan edim

en: of Bloxam say four nights ago in the 'Are an' 'Ounds, in Pincher's Alley, as 'ow he an' his mate 'ad 'ad a rare dusty job in a old 'ouse at Purﬂeet.
uz: Bloxamning aytishicha, to'rt kecha oldin Pincherning ko'chmasida joylashgan Are an Ounds-da ow he his mate ad ad nomli Purfleetdagi eski ouse-da kam uchraydigan changli ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lgan.

en: There ain't a many such jobs as this 'ere, an' I'm thinkin' that maybe Sam Bloxam could tell ye summut. I asked if he could tell me where to ﬁnd him.
uz: Bu ay, men o'ylayman kabi ko'plab ishlar yo'q, ehtimol Sam Bloxam sizga summutni aytishi mumkin.  Men undan uni qayerda topishimni aytish mumkinligini so'radim.

en: I told him that if he could get me the address it would be worth another half sovereign to him.
uz: Men unga agar u menga manzilni bersa, bu unga yana yarim sovernga teng bo'lishini aytdim.

en: So he gulped down the rest of his tea and stood up, saying that he was going to begin the search then and there.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'zining qolgan choynini yutib, o'rnidan turib, o'sha paytdan boshlab qidiruvni boshlashni aytdi.

en: At the door he stopped, and said, Look 'ere, guv'nor, there ain't no sense in me a keepin' you 'ere.
uz: U eshik oldida to'xtab, dedi: Buningga qarang, gubernator, men bu yerda sizni saqlab qolishimga hech qanday asos yo'q.

en: I may ﬁnd Sam soon, or I mayn't, but anyhow he ain't like to be in a way to tell ye much tonight.
uz: Samni tezda topishim mumkin yoki topolmayman, lekin u bugun sizlarga ko'p narsalarni aytishga majbur bo'lishni yoqtirmaydi.

en: Sam is a rare one when he starts on the booze.
uz: Sam spirtli ichimliklarni iste'mol qilishni boshlaganida kamdan-kam uchraydi.

en: If you can give me a envelope with a stamp on it, and put yer address on it, I'll ﬁnd out where Sam is to be found and post it ye tonight.
uz: Agar siz menga muhrlangan xovonni berib, uning manzilini ko'rsatsangiz, men Samni qayerda topish mumkinligini bilib, uni bu kecha joylashtiraman.

en: But ye'd better be up arter 'im soon in the mornin', never mind the booze the night afore. This was all practical, so one of the children went off with a penny to buy an envelope and a sheet of paper, and to keep the change.
uz: Ammo siz ertalab ertalab tursangiz yaxshi bo'lardi, o'tgan kecha ichgan ichimlikni unutmang. Bu hammasi amaliy edi, shuning uchun bolalardan biri zarf va qog'oz sotib olish uchun bir tangaga borib, o'z pulini saqlab qoldi.

en: When she came back, I addressed the envelope and stamped it, and when Smollet had again faithfully promised to post the address when found, I took my way to home.
uz: U qaytib kelganida, men xotiraga murojaat qilib, uni bosdim va Smollet yana topilganida manzilni jo'natishga sodiqlik bilan va'da berganida, uyga qaytdim.

en: We're on the track anyhow.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, biz yo'lga chiqdik.

en: I am tired tonight, and I want to sleep.
uz: Men bugun charchadim va uxlashni istayman.

en: Mina is fast asleep, and looks a little too pale.
uz: Mina tez uxlab ketadi va biroz yorqin ko'rinadi.

en: Her eyes look as though she had been crying.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida xuddi yig'lagan bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi.

en: Poor dear, I've no doubt it frets her to be kept in the dark, and it may make her doubly anxious about me and the others.
uz: Kambag'al qizim, shubhasiz, qorong'ilikda qolish uni xavotirga solmoqda va bu uni men va boshqalar uchun ikki baravar tashvishlantirishi mumkin.

en: But it is best as it is.
uz: Ammo hozirgi holat yaxshidir.

en: It is better to be disappointed and worried in such a way now than to have her nerve broken.
uz: Endi uning g'azabini buzishdan ko'ra, u shunday xavotirga tushishi va xavotirga tushishi yaxshiroqdir.

en: The doctors were quite right to insist on her being kept out of this dreadful business.
uz: Shifokorlar uni bu dahshatli ishdan chetda qoldirishni istashganida to'g'ri bo'lgan.

en: I must be ﬁrm, for on me this particular burden of silence must rest.
uz: Men qat'iy bo'lishim kerak, chunki men o'zimga bu xotirjamlik yukini yuklashim kerak.

en: I shall not ever enter on the subject with her under any circumstances.
uz: Men hech qachon bu mavzuda u bilan hech qanday vaziyatda gaplashmayman.

en: Indeed, It may not be a hard task, after all, for she herself has become reticent on the subject, and has not spoken of the Count or his doings ever since we told her of our decision.
uz: Darhaqiqat, bu qiyin ish bo'lmasligi mumkin, chunki u o'zi bu mavzuda o'zini saqlab qolgan va biz unga qarorimizni aytganimizdan beri Count yoki uning harakatlari haqida gapirmagan.

en: 2 October, evening—A long and trying and exciting day.
uz: 2 oktyabr kuni kechqurun uzoq, qiyin va hayajonli kun.

en: By the ﬁrst post I got my directed envelope with a dirty scrap of paper enclosed, on which was written with a carpenter's pencil in a sprawling hand, Sam Bloxam, Korkrans, 4 Poters Cort, Bartel Street, Walworth.
uz: Birinchi xabarga yetgach, qog'ozning kirli qismi bilan yozib qo'yilgan yozib qo'yilgan zarbamga: Sam Bloxam, Korkrans, 4 Poters Cort, Bartel Street, Walworth.

en: Arsk for the depite. I got the letter in bed, and rose without waking Mina.
uz: Men xatni yotoqda olganman va Minani uyg'otmasdan o'sdim.

en: She looked heavy and sleepy and pale, and far from well.
uz: U og'ir, uyquli va soyaq ko'rinishga ega edi va ko'rinmas edi.

en: I determined not to wake her, but that when I should return from this new search, I would arrange for her go-
uz: Men uni uyg'otmaslikka qaror qildim, lekin bu yangi qidiruvdan qaytib kelsam, uning ketishini ta'minlayman.

en: I think she would be happier in our own home, with her daily tasks to interest her, than in being here amongst us and in ignorance.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u o'z uyimizda, kundalik vazifalari bilan qiziqish ko'rsatib, biz bilan birga bo'lib, jaholatda bo'lishdan ko'ra ko'proq baxtli bo'lardi.

en: Seward for a moment, and told him where I was off to, promising to come back and tell the rest so soon as I should have found out anything.
uz: Seward bir daqiqa davom etib, qayerga ketayotganimni aytdim va biror narsa bilsam, qaytib kelib qolganlarga aytaman, deb va'da berdim.

en: I drove to Walworth and found, with some difﬁculty, Potter's Court.
uz: Men Walworthga bordim va Potterning hovlisini qiyinchilik bilan topdim.

en: Smollet's spelling misled me, as I asked for Poter's Court instead of Potter's Court.
uz: Smolletning so'zlash usuli meni yo'ldan ozdirdi, chunki men Potterning hovlisi o'rniga Poterning hovlisini so'radim.

en: However, when I had found the court, I had no difﬁculty in discovering Corcoran's lodging house.
uz: Biroq, sudni topganimdan so'ng, Corcoranning uyini topish men uchun qiyin bo'lmadi.

en: When I asked the man who came to the door for the depite, he shook his head, and said, I dunno 'im.
uz: Eshikga kelgan kishidan depite so'raganimda, u boshini silkitib: Men buni bilmayman.

en: There ain't no such a person 'ere.
uz: Bu yerda bunday odam yo'q.

en: I never 'eard of 'im in all my bloomin' days.
uz: Men o'zimning gullab-yashgan kunlarimda hech qachon ularni eshitmaganman.

en: Don't believe there ain't nobody of that kind livin' 'ere or anywheres. I took out Smollet's letter, and as I read it it seemed to me that the lesson of the spelling of the name of the court might guide me.
uz: Bu yerda yoki boshqa joylarda bunday kishilar yo'qligiga ishonmang. Men Smolletning maktubini olib chiqdim va uni o'qiganimda, meni sudning ismini yozish darsidan o'rganish yo'l-yo'riq berishi mumkin deb o'ylardim.

en: What are you? I asked.
uz: Men: Siz nimasiz? - deb so'radim.

en: I'm the depity, he answered.
uz: U: Men xudojo'y odamman, - deb javob berdi.

en: I saw at once that I was on the right track.
uz: Men darhol to'g'ri yo'lda ekanligimni angladim.

en: Phonetic spelling had again misled me.
uz: Fonetik so'zlash yana meni aldadi.

en: A half crown tip put the deputy's knowledge at my disposal, and I learned that Mr.
uz: Yarim toj tikmasi deputatning bilimini menga taqdim etdi va men Mr.ning bu bilimga ega ekanini bilib oldim.

en: Bloxam, who had slept off the remains of his beer on the previous night at Corcoran's, had left for his work at Poplar at ﬁve o'clock that morning.
uz: O'tgan kecha Corcoran'da pivoni qolganidan uxlagan Bloxam o'sha kuni ertalab beshlarda Poplarda ishlash uchun jo'nab ketgan edi.

en: He could not tell me where the place of work was situated, but he had a vague idea that it was some kind of a new-fangled ware'us, and with this slender clue I had to start for Poplar.
uz: U ish joyining qaerda joylashganligini aytolmadi, lekin u bu yangi o'zgarishlarga ega bo'lgan tovar deb o'ylagani aniq emas edi va men Poplar uchun bu mayda ma'lumotdan boshlashim kerak edi.

en: It was twelve o'clock be- fore I got any satisfactory hint of such a building, and this I got at a coffee shop, where some workmen were having their dinner.
uz: O'n ikki soat bo'lganidan oldin men bunday bino haqida qoniqarli ma'lumot oldim va buni bir kofexonada, ishchilar ovqatlanayotgan joyda oldim.

en: One of them suggest- ed that there was being erected at Cross Angel Street a new cold storage building, and as this suited the condition of a new-fangled ware'us, I at once drove to it.
uz: Ulardan biri Cross Angel ko'chasida yangi soyuq omborxona binosi barpo etilayotganini aytdi va bu yangi o'simlikdagi tovarxona holatiga mos kelgani uchun men unga tezda bordim.

en: An interview with a surly gatekeeper and a surlier fore- man, both of whom were appeased with the coin of the realm, put me on the track of Bloxam.
uz: O'ylanarli darvozabon va o'ylanarli tashqi odam bilan suhbatlashish, ularning ikkalasi ham shohlikning tangalaridan mamnun bo'lishgan, meni Bloxam yo'liga qo'ydi.

en: He was sent for on my suggestion that I was willing to pay his days wages to his foreman for the privilege of asking him a few ques- tions on a private matter.
uz: U mening ish haqiga uning boshlig'iga bir necha savol berishga rozi bo'lishimni taklif qilganimda, uni yuborishdi.

en: He was a smart enough fellow, though rough of speech and bearing.
uz: U juda aqlli odam edi, ammo gapida va xulq-atvorida qattiqqo'l edi.

en: When I had promised to pay for his information and given him an earnest, he told me that he had made two journeys between Carfax and a house in Piccadilly, and had taken from this house to the latter nine great boxes, main heavy ones, with a horse and cart hired by him for this purpose.
uz: Men uning ma'lumotlari uchun pul to'lashga va jiddiy pul berishga va'da bersam, u menga Carfax va Piccadillydagi uy o'rtasida ikki marta sayohat qilganini va bu uydan asosiy og'ir to'qqizta katta qutilarga, shu maqsadda ijaraga olgan ot va arava bilan ketgani haqida aytdi.

en: I asked him if he could tell me the number of the house in Piccadilly, to which he replied, Well, guv'nor, I forgits the number, but it was only a few door from a big white church, or somethink of the kind, not long built.
uz: Undan Piccadillydagi uyning raqamini aytish mumkinligini so'radim va u shunday javob berdi: Ham, gubernator, men raqamni unutganman, lekin u katta oq cherkovdan yoki yaqinda qurilgan o'xshash narsalardan bir nechta eshikdan iborat edi.

en: It was a dusty old 'ouse, too, though nothin' to the dustiness of the 'ouse we tooked the bloomin' boxes from. How did you get in if both houses were empty? There was the old party what engaged me a waitin' in the 'ouse at Pur- ﬂeet.
uz: Bu esa tuproqli eski o'z edi, ammo o'zimiz gullab-yashgan qutilaridagi tuproqga hech narsa emas edi. Agar ikkala uy ham bo'sh bo'lsa, qanday kirgansiz? Pur-flotdagi o'zda meni kutib turgan eski partiya bor edi.

en: He 'elped me to lift the boxes and put them in the dray.
uz: U menga qutilarni ko'tarib, ularni quritishga yordam berdi.

en: Curse me, but he was the strongest chap I ever struck, an' him a old feller, with a white moustache, one that thin you would think he couldn't throw a shadder. How this phrase thrilled through me!
uz: Meni la'natlang, lekin u men o'tkazgan eng kuchli yigit edi, u oq ko'krakli keksa yigit edi, u o'zi shadderni tashlay olmaydi deb o'ylaydigan shunchalik chiroyli edi. Bu so'z meni qanchalik hayajonlantirganini ko'ring!

en: Why, 'e took up 'is end o' the boxes like they was pounds of tea, and me a pufﬁn' an' a blowin' afore I could upend mine anyhow, an' I'm no chicken, neither. How did you get into the house in Piccadilly? I asked.
uz: Nima uchun, u qutuqlarni o'z ichiga oldi is end o', xuddi ular bir tonna choy kabi edi, va men o'zimni qaytarib berishga muvaffaq bo'lganimdan oldin, men mening qo'ng'iroqimni qaytarib berardim, men ham toyuq emasman.  Piccadillydagi uyga qanday kirdingiz? deb so'radim.

en: He must 'a started off and got there afore me, for when I rung of the bell he kem an' opened the door 'isself an' 'elped me carry the boxes into the 'all. The whole nine? I asked.
uz: U o'zimdan oldin boshlangan bo'lishi kerak va mendan oldingiga yetib kelgan, chunki men qo'ng'iroqni chaqirganimda u o'zi eshikni ochdi va menga qutilarni barcha ga olib kirishga yordam berdi. To'liq to'qqizta? - deb so'radim men.

en: Yus, there was ﬁve in the ﬁrst load an' four in the second.
uz: Yus, birinchi yukda besh kishi, ikkinchi yukda to'rt kishi bor edi.

en: It was main dry work, an' I don't so well remember 'ow I got 'ome. I interrupted him, Were the boxes left in the hall? Yus, it was a big 'all, an' there was nothin' else in it. I made one more attempt to further matters.
uz: Bu asosiy quruqlik ishi edi, men buni yaxshi eslay olmayman, ow, men om oldim. Men uni to'xtatib qo'ydim: Qutxonalar koridorda qoldirilganmi? Yus, bu katta barchasi, bir boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi.  Men yana bir bor ishni davom ettirishga harakat qildim.

en: You didn't have any key? Never used no key nor nothink.
uz: Sizda hech qanday kalit yo'qmidi? Agar hech qachon hech qanday kalitdan foydalanmaganman yoki o'ylamaganman.

en: The old gent, he opened the door 'isself an' shut it again when I druv off.
uz: Keksa yigit eshikni o'zi ochib, men o'tib ketganimda yana yopdi.

en: I don't remember the last time, but that was the beer. And you can't remember the number of the house? No, sir.
uz: So'nggi marta qachon bo'lganini eslay olmayman, lekin bu pivo edi. - Va siz uy raqamini eslay olmaysizmi? - Yo'q, xo'jayinim.

en: But ye needn't have no difﬁculty about that.
uz: Ammo bu borada hech qanday qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmasligingiz kerak.

en: It's a 'igh 'un with a stone front with a bow on it, an' 'igh steps up to the door.
uz: Bu toshning old tomonida bo'lib, uning ustida qo'zg'olon bo'lib, eshikga qadam qo'yilgan 'igh' un.

en: I know them steps, 'avin' 'ad to carry the boxes up with three loafers what come round to earn a copper.
uz: Men o'sha qadamlarni bilaman, avin' ad deb uchta quti bilan qutilarni ko'tarib borishni aytaman, ular bir kumush pul ishlash uchun qaytib kelishadi.

en: The old gent give them shillin's, an' they seein' they got so much, they wanted more.
uz: Keksalar ularga shillin berishdi va ular ko'rishdiki, ular shunchalik ko'p pulga ega bo'lishganki, ko'proq narsani xohlashgan.

en: But 'e took one of them by the shoulder and was like to throw 'im down the steps, till the lot of them went away cussin'. I thought that with this description I could ﬁnd the house, so having paid my friend for his information, I started off for Piccadilly.
uz: Lekin ulardan birini yelkasiga qo'yib, ularni sinchkovlardan pastga tashlab ketganday bo'ldi, ularning ko'pchiligi o'z yo'lidan ketmaguncha. Men bu tavsif bilan uyni topishim mumkin deb o'yladim, shuning uchun do'stimga uning ma'lumotlari uchun pul to'laganimdan so'ng, Piccadilly shahriga bordim.

en: I had gained a new painful experience.
uz: Men yangi og'ir tajribalarga ega bo'ldim.

en: The Count could, it was evident, handle the earth boxes
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, Count yer qutisi bilan shug'ullanishi mumkin edi.

en: If so, time was precious, for now that he had achieved a certain amount of distribution, he could, by choosing his own time, complete the task unobserved.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, vaqt qimmatli edi, chunki hozir u muayyan miqdorda taqsimlanishini qo'lga kiritganidan so'ng, o'z vaqtini o'zi tanlash orqali vazifani kuzatilmasdan bajarishi mumkin edi.

en: At Piccadilly Circus I discharged my cab, and walked westward.
uz: Piccadilly Circus-da men taksiyamni tashlab, g'arb tomon yurdim.

en: Beyond the Junior Constitutional I came across the house de- scribed and was satisﬁed that this was the next of the lairs arranged by Dracula.
uz: Junior Konstitutsionaldan tashqarida, men de-skrib qilingan uyni ko'rdim va bu Dracula tomonidan tashkil etilgan o'yinlarning keyingilari ekanligiga ishonch hosil qildim.

en: The house looked as though it had been long untenanted.
uz: Uy uzoq vaqtdan beri buzilgan bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi.

en: The win- dows were encrusted with dust, and the shutters were up.
uz: Win-dowslar tuproq bilan qoplangan edi va shutterlar yuqori edi.

en: All the framework was black with time, and from the iron the paint had mostly scaled away.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, butun ramka qora bo'lib ketdi va temirdan bo'lak asosan o'zgarib ketdi.

en: It was evident that up to lately there had been a large notice board in front of the balcony.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, yaqindagacha balkon oldida katta ogohlantirish panohi bor edi.

en: It had, however, been roughly torn away, the uprights which had supported it still remaining.
uz: Biroq, u taxminan yirtilgan edi, uni qo'llab-quvvatlagan toshlar hali ham saqlanib qolgan edi.

en: Behind the rails of the balcony I saw there were some loose boards, whose raw edges looked white.
uz: Men ko'rgan balkonning raillari ortida bir nechta bo'sh taxtalar bor edi, ularning xom chegaralari oq ko'rinishga ega edi.

en: I would have giv- en a good deal to have been able to see the notice board intact, as it would, perhaps, have given some clue to the ownership of the house.
uz: Xatchoʻpni toʻliq koʻrish uchun men yaxshi baho berardim, chunki bu, ehtimol, uy egaligi toʻgʻrisida maʼlumot berardi.

en: I remembered my experience of the investigation and purchase of Carfax, and I could not but feel that I could ﬁnd the former owner there might be some means dis- covered of gaining access to the house.
uz: Men Carfaxni tekshirish va sotib olish tajribamni esladim va sobiq egasini topishim mumkinligini his qilmasdim, ehtimol uyga kirishning biron bir yo'li mavjud bo'lishi mumkin.

en: There was at present nothing to be learned from the Piccadilly side, and nothing could be done, so I went around to the back to see if anything could be gathered from this quarter.
uz: Ayni paytda Piccadilly tomondan hech narsa o'rganish mumkin emas edi va hech narsa qilish mumkin emas edi, shuning uchun men orqa tomonga borib, bu kvartaldan biror narsa to'planishi mumkinmi yoki yo'qligini ko'rdim.

en: The mews were active, the Piccadilly houses being mostly in occupation.
uz: Mews faol edi, Piccadilly uylari asosan ish bilan band edi.

en: I asked one or two of the grooms and helpers whom I saw around if they could tell me anything about the empty house.
uz: Men atrofida ko'rgan bir-ikki kelin-qiz va yordamchilardan bo'sh uy haqida biror narsa aytishlarini so'radim.

en: One of them said that he heard it had lately been taken, but he couldn't say from whom.
uz: Ulardan biri so'nggi paytlarda uni olib ketishganini eshitganini aytdi, ammo kimdan olganini aytolmadi.

en: He told me, however, that up to very lately there had been a notice board of For Sale up, and that perhaps Mitchell, Sons, & Candy the house agents could tell me something, as he thought he remembered seeing the name of that ﬁrm on the board.
uz: Biroq, u, yaqindagacha Sotish uchun deb nomlangan xabarlar panohi borligini va ehtimol Mitchell, Sons, & Candy uy agentlari menga biror narsa aytishlari mumkinligini aytdi, chunki u o'sha firma nomini panohda ko'rganini esladi.

en: I did not wish to seem too eager, or to let my informant know or guess too much, so thanking him in the usual man- ner,I strolled away.
uz: Men juda g'ayratli bo'lib ko'rinishni xohlamaganman yoki xabardorimni ko'p narsa bilishga yoki taxmin qilishga undamaganman, shuning uchun unga odatdagidek minnatdorchilik bildirganimdan so'ng, men ketib ketdim.

en: It was now growing dusk, and the autumn night was closing in, so I did not lose any time.
uz: Hozirgi paytda tongni ko'tarib, kuz kechasi yaqinlashayotgan edi, shuning uchun men hech qanday vaqtni yo'qotmadim.

en: Having learned the address of Mitchell, Sons, & Candy from a directory at the Berkeley, I was soon at their ofﬁce in Sackville Street.
uz: Bir marta Berkli universitetining direktoriyasidan Mitchell, Sons va Candy-ning manzilini bilib olgach, tez orada ularning Sackville ko'chasidagi ofisida bo'ldim.

en: The gentleman who saw me was particularly suave in manner, but un- communicative in equal proportion.
uz: Meni ko'rgan xonim juda mehribon edi, ammo teng darajada muloqot qilmaydigan edi.

en: Having once told me that the Piccadilly house, which throughout our interview he called a mansion, was sold, he considered my business as concluded.
uz: U bir marta Piccadilly uyini, biz bilan suhbatlashayotganda uni mansion deb atashganini sotilganini aytdi va mening ishimni yakunlangan deb hisobladi.

en: When I asked who had purchased it,
uz: Uni kim sotib olganini so'raganimda,

en: he opened his eyes a thought wider, and paused a few seconds before reply- ing, It is sold, sir. Pardon me, I said, with equal politeness, but I have a special reason for wishing to know who purchased it. Again he paused longer, and raised his eyebrows still more.
uz: U ko'zlarini ko'proq ochib, bir necha soniya to'xtadi va javob berib: Sotdi, xo'jayinim. - Men ham shunday xushmuomalalik bilan aytdim: Kechirasiz, lekin uni kim sotib olganini bilmoqchi bo'lishim uchun alohida sababim bor. - Yana bir bor uzoqroq to'xtadi va ko'z burchaklarini yanada ko'proq ko'tardi.

en: It is sold, sir, was again his laconic reply.
uz: Bu sotilgan, xo'jayinim, - deb yana bir bor uning lakonik javobini berdi.

en: Surely, I said, you do not mind letting me know so much. But I do mind, he answered.
uz: Men: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, menga buni aytishga xalaqit bermayapsiz, - dedim.

en: The affairs of their clients are absolutely safe in the hands of Mitchell, Sons, & Candy. This was manifestly a prig of the ﬁrst water, and there was no use arguing with him.
uz: O'z mijozlarining ishlari Mitchell, Sons va Candy tomonidan mutlaqo xavfsiz. Bu, aniqki, birinchi o'rinni egallagan va u bilan bahslashishning foydasi yo'q edi.

en: I thought I had best meet him on his own ground, so I said, Your clients, sir, are happy in having so resolute a guardian of their conﬁdence.
uz: Men uni o'z hududida uchratishim kerak deb o'yladim, shuning uchun: Mukabinlaringiz, xo'jayinim, o'zlarining ishonchlarini himoya qiladigan bunday qat'iy vakilga ega bo'lishdan xursandlar.

en: I am myself a professional man. Here I handed him my card.
uz: Men o'zim professional odamman. Bu yerda men unga kartamni berdim.

en: In this instance I am not prompted by cu- riosity, I act on the part of Lord Godalming, who wishes to know something of the property which was, he understood, lately for sale. These words put a different complexion on affairs.
uz: Bu holatda men g'ayratli emasman, balki Lord Godalmingning o'rniga harakat qilaman, u oxirgi paytlarda sotilish uchun bo'lgan mulkni bilishni istaydi. Bu so'zlar ishlarga boshqacha ko'rinish beradi.

en: He said, I would like to oblige you if I could, Mr.
uz: U shunday dedi: Agar iloji bo'lsa, sizga minnatdorchilik bildiraman, Mr..

en: Harker, and especially would I like to oblige his lordship.
uz: Harker va ayniqsa, uning xonadoniga minnatdorchilik bildiraman.

en: We once carried out a small matter of renting some chambers for him when he was the Honorable Arthur Holmwood.
uz: Bir marta, u Marangli Artur Holmwood bo'lganida, biz unga bir nechta xona ijaraga berishga harakat qildik.

en: If you will let me have his lordship's address I will consult the House on the subject, and will, in any case, communicate with his lordship by tonight's post.
uz: Agar siz menga lordlik manzili berishni xohlasangiz, men bu borada Oliy Majlisga murojaat qilaman va hech bo'lmaganda bu kechagi xabar orqali lordlik bilan muloqot qilaman.

en: It will be a pleasure if we can so far deviate from our rules as to give the required infor- mation to his lordship. I wanted to secure a friend, and not to make an enemy, so I thanked him, gave the address at Dr.
uz: Agar biz o'z qoidalarimizdan shunchalik uzoqroq bo'lsak, uning xonadoniga kerakli ma'lumotni bersak, xursand bo'lamiz. Men do'stimni o'rnatishni va dushman qilmaslikni xohladim, shuning uchun unga rahmat aytdim va doktorning manzilini berdim.

en: Seward's and came away.
uz: Sewardning va undan chiqib ketdi.

en: It was now dark, and I was tired and hungry.
uz: Endi qorong'ilik bo'ldi va men charchagan va och edim.

en: I got a cup of tea at the Aerated Bread Company and came down to Purﬂeet by the next train.
uz: Aerated Bread Company-da choy ichib, keyingi poezdda Purfleetga tushdim.

en: I found all the others at home.
uz: Qolganlarini uyda topdim.

en: Mina was looking tired and pale, but she made a gallant effort to be bright and cheerful.
uz: Mina charchagan va yorqin ko'rinardi, ammo u chiroq va quvonchli bo'lish uchun jasoratli harakat qildi.

en: It wrung my heart to think that I had had to keep anything from her and so caused her inquietude.
uz: Undan biror narsani yashirishim kerakligini o'ylash yuragimni og'irlab qo'ydi va bu uning xavotirini uyg'otdi.

en: Thank God, this will be the last night of her looking on at our conferences, and feeling the sting of our not showing our conﬁdence.
uz: Xudoga shukr, bu uning konferentsiyalarimizga qarab, o'zimizga ishonmayotganimiz uchun azob chekayotgan oxirgi kechasi bo'ladi.

en: It took all my courage to hold to the wise resolution of keeping her out of our grim task.
uz: Uni og'ir vazifamizdan chetda qoldirish haqidagi dono qarorimga rioya qilish uchun butun jasoratim kerak edi.

en: She seems somehow more reconciled, or else the very subject seems to have become repugnant to her, for when any accidental allusion is made she
uz: U qaysidir jihatdan ko'proq yarashgan ko'rinadi yoki mavzu o'zidan jirkanch bo'lib qoldi, chunki biron bir tasodifiy izoh berilganda u o'zini yomon his qiladi.

en: I am glad we made our resolution in time, as with such a feeling as this,our growing knowledge would be torture to her.
uz: Vaqt o'tib qaror qabul qilganimiz uchun xursandman, chunki bunday his-tuyg'u bilan, bizning o'sib borayotgan bilimimiz unga azob-uqubat bo'lardi.

en: I could not tell the others of the day's discovery till we were alone, so af- ter dinner, followed by a little music to save appearances even amongst our- selves, I took Mina to her room and left her to go to bed.
uz: Biz yolg'iz qolmagunimizcha, boshqalarga kunning kashfiyotini aytib berolmadim, shuning uchun kechki ovqatdan so'ng, hatto o'zimiz o'rtasida ham ko'rinishni saqlab qolish uchun biroz musiqa qo'shilib, Men Minani o'z xonasiga olib borib, uxlashga qoldirdim.

en: The dear girl was more affectionate with me than ever, and clung to me as though she would detain me, but there was much to be talked of and I came away.
uz: Qizim menga har qachongidan ham mehr ila munosabatda bo'lib, meni ushlab turmoqchi bo'lganidek menga yopishibdi, lekin ko'p gapirish kerak edi va men ketdim.

en: Thank God, the ceasing of telling things has made no difference between us.
uz: Xudoga shukr, gapirishni to'xtatish biz o'rtasida hech qanday farq qilmadi.

en: When I came down again I found the others all gathered round the ﬁre in the study.
uz: Yana pastga tushganimda, boshqalarni o'quvxonadagi olov atrofida to'plab topdim.

en: In the train I had written my diary so far, and simply read it off to them as the best means of letting them get abreast of my own information.
uz: Poyezdda men o'z kundaligimni yozgan edim va uni ularga o'qib berdim, chunki bu mening shaxsiy ma'lumotlarimni ularga yetkazishning eng yaxshi usuli edi.

en: When I had ﬁnished Van Helsing said, This has been a great day's work, friend Jonathan.
uz: Van Helsing so'zlarni tugatganimda: Bu juda yaxshi kunlik ish edi, do'stim Jonatan.

en: Doubtless we are on the track of the missing boxes.
uz: Shubhasizki, biz yo'qolgan qutilar yo'lida turibmiz.

en: If we ﬁnd them all in that house, then our work is near the end.
uz: Agar ularning barchasini u uyda topsak, unda bizning ishimiz tugashga yaqin.

en: But if there be some missing, we must search until we ﬁnd them.
uz: Ammo agar yo'qolgan bo'lsa, ularni topmagunimizcha qidirishimiz kerak.

en: Then shall we make our ﬁnal coup, and hunt the wretch to his real death. We all sat silent awhile and all at once Mr.
uz: So'ngra biz so'nggi to'qnashuvni o'tkazamiz va kambag'alni uning haqiqiy o'limiga qadar ov qilamiz. - deb so'rashdi.

en: How are we going to get into that house? We got into the other,answered Lord Godalming quickly.
uz: O'sha uyga qanday kiramiz? - deb so'radi Godalming.

en: But, Art, this is different.
uz: Ammo, Art, bu boshqacha.

en: We broke house at Carfax, but we had night and a walled park to protect us.
uz: Karfaksda uyni buzganmiz, ammo bizni himoya qilish uchun kechasi va devorli bog' bor edi.

en: It will be a mighty different thing to commit burglary in Piccadilly, either by day or night.
uz: Piccadillyda, kun yoki kechasi, talon-toroj qilish juda boshqacha bo'ladi.

en: I confess I don't see how we are going to get in unless that agency duck can ﬁnd us a key of some sort. Lord Godalming's brows contracted, and he stood up and walked about the room.
uz: Shuni aytamanki, agar bu agentlik qo'g'ri bizga bir xil kalit topmasa, qanday qilib kirishimiz mumkinligini tushunmayapman. Lord Godalmingning burunlari qisqartirildi va u o'rnidan turib, xonani aylanib chiqdi.

en: By-and-by he stopped and said, turning from one to another of us, Quincey's head is level.
uz: Bir-birimizdan o'zgaga qarab, u to'xtadi va dedi: Qinseyning boshi tekis.

en: This burglary business is getting serious.
uz: Bu burg'inchilik ishi jiddiylashib bormoqda.

en: We got off once all right, but we have now a rare job on hand.
uz: Biz bir marta yaxshi ish qildik, ammo hozirda bizda kamdan-kam ish bor.

en: Unless we can ﬁnd the Count's key basket. As nothing could well be done before morning, and as it would be at least advisable to wait till Lord Godalming should hear from Mitchell's, we de- cided not to take any active step before breakfast time.
uz: Agar biz Countning kalitini topmasak. Ertalabgacha hech narsa qilolmaydi va hech bo'lmaganda Lord Godalming Mitchelning xabarini eshitmaguncha kutish tavsiya etiladi, shuning uchun biz kechki ovqatdan oldin hech qanday faol qadam qo'ymaslikka qaror qildik.

en: For a good while we sat and smoked, discussing the matter in its various lights and bearings.
uz: Biz bir muncha vaqt o'tirib, chekardik va turli xil yorug'lik va ko'rinishlarda muhokama qildik.

en: I took the opportunity of bringing this diary right up to the moment.
uz: Men bu jurnalni hozirgi kunga keltirish uchun imkoniyatdan foydalandim.

en: I am very sleepy and shall go to bed … Just a line.
uz: Men juda uxlayman va uxlashga ketaman ... faqat bir satr.

en: Mina sleeps soundly and her breathing is regular.
uz: Mina yaxshi uxlaydi va o'z nafasini muntazam o'tkazadi.

en: Her fore- head is puckered up into little wrinkles, as though she thinks even in her sleep.
uz: Uning old boshi hatto uxlayotganda ham o'ylaydi deb, kichik burchaklarga aylangan.

en: She is still too pale, but does not look so haggard as she did this
uz: U hali ham ko'rinmas edi, lekin u bunday qilgani uchun o'sha qadar chiroyli ko'rinmaydi.

en: Tomorrow will, I hope, mend all this.
uz: Umid qilamanki, ertaga bularning barchasini tuzatamiz.

en: She will be herself at home in Exeter.
uz: U o'zi Ekserdagi uyida bo'ladi.

en: Oh, but I am sleepy!
uz: Oh, lekin men uxlayman!

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 1 October.—I am puzzled afresh about Renﬁeld.
uz: SEWARDning 1 oktyabr kunlik kundaligi.Men Renfield haqida yangidan g'alati bo'ldim.

en: His moods change so rapidly that I ﬁnd it difﬁcult to keep touch of them, and as they always mean something more than his own well-being, they form a more than in- teresting study.
uz: Uning ruhi shunchalik tez o'zgarib boradiki, ular bilan muloqot qilish men uchun qiyin bo'ladi va ular har doim uning farovonligidan ko'ra ko'proq narsani anglatadi, shuning uchun ular qiziqarli tadqiqotdan ko'ra ko'proq narsani tashkil etadi.
