en: This morning, when I went to see him after his repulse of Van Helsing, his manner was that of a man commanding destiny.
uz: Bugun ertalab men uni Van Helsingdan nafratlanganidan so'ng ko'rish uchun borganimda, uning xulq-atvori taqdirga hukmronlik qiladigan odam kabi edi.

en: He was, in fact, commanding destiny, subjectively.
uz: Aslida, u taqdirni subyektiv ravishda boshqargan.

en: He did not really care for any of the things of mere earth, he was in the clouds and looked down on all the weak- nesses and wants of us poor mortals.
uz: U yer yuzidagi hech qanday narsa bilan qiziqmagan edi, u bulutlar ichida edi va biz kambag'al o'liklarning barcha zaifliklari va ehtiyojlarini pastga qarab ko'rdi.

en: I thought I would improve the occasion and learn something, so I asked him, What about the ﬂies these times? He smiled on me in quite a superior sort of way, such a smile as would have become the face of Malvolio, as he answered me, The ﬂy, my dear sir, has one striking feature.
uz: O'yladimki, bu vaziyatni yaxshilab, biror narsani o'rganishim mumkin, shuning uchun undan: Bu vaqtlarda uchuqlar haqida nima deyish mumkin? - deb so'radim.U menga juda ustun tarzda tabassum qildi, shunday tabassum Malvolioning yuziga aylandi, u menga shunday javob berdi: Uchuqlar, azizim, bitta ajoyib xususiyatga ega.

en: It's wings are typical of the aerial powers of the psychic faculties.
uz: Uning qanotlari ruhiy kuchlarning havo kuchlariga xosdir.

en: The ancients did well when they typiﬁed the soul as a butterﬂy! I thought I would push his analogy to its utmost logically, so I said quick- ly, Oh, it is a soul you are after now, is it? His madness foiled his reason, and a puzzled look spread over his face as, shaking his head with a decision which I had but seldom seen in him.
uz: Qadimgilar ruhni ko'krak deb tasvirlaganlarida yaxshi o'tdilar! - deb o'yladim, uning o'xshashligini eng mantiqiy tomonga ko'taraman, shuning uchun tezda: Oh, bu siz allaqachon izlayotgan ruh, shundaymi? - deb aytdim.

en: He said, Oh, no, oh no!
uz: U: Yo'q, yo'q, yo'q!

en: Life is all I want. Here he brightened up.
uz: Hayot - bu men xohlagan yagona narsa. Bu yerda u ko'proq ko'ngilni ochdi.

en: I am pretty indifferent about it at present.
uz: Men hozircha bu haqda juda befarqman.

en: You must get a new patient, doctor, if you wish to study zoophagy! This puzzled me a little, so I drew him on.
uz: Agar zoofagiyani o'rganmoqchi bo'lsangiz, siz yangi bemor topishingiz kerak, shifokor! - degan so'z meni biroz xafa qildi, shuning uchun uni jalb qildim.

en: Then you command life.
uz: O'shanda siz hayotga hukmronlik qilasiz.

en: You are a god, I suppose? He smiled with an ineffably benign superiority.
uz: Sen xudo ekansan, deb o'ylayman, deb tabassum qilib, so'zlab bo'lmaydigan darajada yaxshilik bilan ko'rindi.

en: Far be it from me to arrogate to myself the attributes of the Deity.
uz: Xudovandning xususiyatlarini o'zimga ko'tarish men uchun uzoq bo'lsin.

en: I am not even concerned in His especially spiritual doings.
uz: Hatto Uning ayniqsa ma'naviy ishlarida ham g'amxo'rlik qilmayman.

en: If I may state my intellectual position I am, so far as concerns things purely terrestrial, somewhat in the position which Enoch occupied spiritually! This was a poser to me.
uz: Agar men o'z intellektual pozitsiyamni aytishim mumkin bo'lsa, to'g'ri yerdagi narsalar bilan bog'liq bo'lganimda, men Henokning ma'naviy jihatdan egallab turgan o'rnagimday bo'laman!

en: I could not at the moment recall Enoch's appo- siteness, so I had to ask a simple question, though I felt that by so doing I was lowering myself in the eyes of the lunatic.
uz: O'sha paytda Xanoqning o'zi haqida hech narsa eslay olmagan edim, shuning uchun men oddiy savol berishga majbur bo'ldim, garchi bu bilan o'zimni aqldan ozgan odamning ko'zida pastga tushirayotganimni his qilgandim.

en: And why with Enoch? Because he walked with God.
uz: Va nega Henoq bilan? - U Xudo bilan yurganligi uchun.

en: I could not see the analogy, but did not like to admit it, so I harked back to what he had denied.
uz: Men analogiyani ko'rmadim, lekin buni tan olishni istamadim, shuning uchun u inkor etgan narsalarga qaytdim.

en: So you don't care about life and you don't want souls.
uz: Shunday qilib, siz hayotga g'amxo'rlik qilmaysiz va ruhlarni xohlamaysiz.

en: Why not? I put my question quickly and somewhat sternly, on pur- pose to disconcert him.
uz: Nima uchun yo'q? deb savolimni tez va biroz qat'iy so'radim.

en: The effort succeeded, for an instant he unconsciously relapsed into his old servile manner, bent low before me, and actually fawned upon me as he replied.
uz: Bu harakat muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi, bir daqiqa davomida u o'z eski qullik uslublariga o'zini tikladi, mendan yuz o'girdi va javob berayotganda menga qo'shilib qo'ydi.

en: I don't want any souls, indeed, indeed!
uz: Men hech qanday ruhni xohlamayman, haqiqatan ham!

en: I couldn't use them if I had them.
uz: Agar bor bo'lsa, ulardan foydalanolmasdim.

en: They would be no manner of use to me.
uz: Ular menga hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi.

en: I couldn't eat them or …  He suddenly stopped and the old cunning look spread over his face, like a wind sweep on the surface of the water.
uz: Men ularni yeyolmadim yoki... U to'xtadi va oldingi hiyla-nayrang ko'rinishi yuzidagi shamol kabi suvning yuziga tarqalib ketdi.

en: And doctor, as to life, what is it after all?
uz: Doktor, hayot haqida gap ketganda, nima degani?

en: When you've got all you re- quire, and you know that you will never want, that is all.
uz: Agar xohlagan hamma narsangiz bo'lsa va siz hech qachon xohlamasligingizni bilsangiz, shu ham bo'ladi.

en: I have friends, good friends, like you, Dr.
uz: Mening do'stlarim, siz kabi yaxshi do'stlarim bor, doktor.

en: Seward.This was said with a leer of inexpress- ible cunning.
uz: Seward. Bu so'zlarni so'zlab bo'lmaydigan hiyla bilan aytishdi.

en: I know that I shall never lack the means of life! I think that through the cloudiness of his insanity he saw some antago- nism in me, for he at once fell back on the last refuge of such as he, a dogged silence.
uz: Men o'zimga hech qachon hayot uchun kerak bo'lmagan narsani bilaman! deb o'ylaymanki, uning aqlsizlikining bulutliligi tufayli u mendan ba'zi bir o'ziga xoslikni ko'rdi, chunki u darhol o'zi kabi odamlarning oxirgi panohida, qattiq sukutga qaytdi.

en: After a short time I saw that for the present it was useless to speak to him.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, hozircha u bilan gaplashishning foydasi yo'qligini tushundim.

en: He was sulky, and so I came away.
uz: U o'z-o'zidan xafa edi, shuning uchun men ketdim.

en: Later in the day he sent for me.
uz: Keyingi kuni u meni chaqirib yubordi.

en: Ordinarily I would not have come with- out special reason, but just at present I am so interested in him that I would gladly make an effort.
uz: Odatda men maxsus sababsiz kelmasdim, lekin hozirda men u bilan shunchalik qiziqamanki, harakat qilishni xohlayman.

en: Besides, I am glad to have anything to help pass the time.
uz: Bundan tashqari, vaqtni o'tkazishga yordam beradigan biron bir narsam bo'lganiga quvonaman.

en: Harker is out, following up clues, and so are Lord Godalming and Quincey.
uz: Harker tashqariga chiqib, ko'rsatkichlarni izlaydi, Lord Godalming va Quincey ham shunday.

en: Van Helsing sits in my study poring over the record prepared by the Harkers.
uz: Van Helsing Harkerlar tomonidan tayyorlangan rekordni ko'rib, o'zimning studiyamda o'tiradi.

en: He seems to think that by accurate knowledge of all details he will light up on some clue.
uz: U barcha tafsilotlarni aniq bilishi bilan biron bir izni yoritadi, deb o'ylaydi.

en: He does not wish to be disturbed in the work, without cause.
uz: U ishda hech qanday sababsiz aralashuvni istamaydi.

en: I would have taken him with me to see the patient, only I thought that after his last repulse he might not care to go again.
uz: Men uni o'zim bilan birga kasalni ko'rishga olib borardim, faqat uning oxirgi nafratlanishidan so'ng yana borishni istamaydi deb o'yladim.

en: There was also another reason.
uz: Boshqa sabab ham bor edi.

en: Renﬁeld might not speak so freely before a third person as when he and I were alone.
uz: Renfield uchinchi shaxs oldida biz yolg'iz bo'lganimizda bo'lgani kabi erkin gapirmasligi mumkin.

en: I found him sitting in the middle of the ﬂoor on his stool, a pose which is generally indicative of some mental energy on his part.
uz: Men uni o'rtada, stolda, yerga o'tirgan holda topdim, bu odatda uning aqliy kuchini ko'rsatadi.

en: When I came in, he said at once, as though the question had been waiting on his lips.
uz: Men kirganimda, u darhol so'radi, xuddi savol uning og'zida kutib turgandek.

en: What about souls? It was evident then that my surmise had been correct.
uz: Janoʻylar haqida nima deyish mumkin? - deb soʻrashdi. Oʻshanda mening taxminim toʻgʻri boʻlganligi aniq edi.

en: Unconscious cere- bration was doing its work, even with the lunatic.
uz: Beoydinlik o'z ishini bajarayotgan edi, hatto aqldan ozgan kishi bilan ham.

en: I determined to have the matter out.
uz: Men bu ishni hal qilishga qaror qildim.

en: What about them yourself? I asked.
uz: Men: O'zing nima deysan? - deb so'radim.

en: He did not reply for a moment but looked all around him, and up and down, as though he expected to ﬁnd some inspiration for an answer.
uz: U bir daqiqa javob bermadi, balki atrofini ko'rib, xuddi javob uchun ilhom olishni kutgandek ko'tardi.

en: I don't want any souls! He said in a feeble, apologetic way.
uz: Men hech qanday jonni xohlamayman! - dedi u zaif, uzr soʻrab.

en: The matter seemed preying on his mind, and so I determined to use it, to be cruel only to be kind. So I said, You like life, and you want life? Oh yes!
uz: Bu masala uning ongini o'rab olgan bo'lib tuyuldi, shuning uchun men undan foydalanishga qaror qildim: Yaxshi bo'lish uchun shafqatsiz bo'ling.

en: But that is all right.
uz: Ammo bu yaxshi.

en: You needn't worry about that! But, I asked,how are we to get the life without getting the soul also? This seemed to puzzle him, so I followed it up, A nice time you'll have some time when you're ﬂying out here, with the souls of thousands of ﬂies and spiders and birds and cats buzzing and twittering and moaning all around you.
uz: Siz bu haqda tashvishlanmasligingiz kerak! - deb so'radim men, Biz ruhni ham olmagan holda qanday qilib hayotga ega bo'lamiz? Bu unga g'alati tuyuldi, shuning uchun men uni davom ettirdim: Bu erda uchib borayotganingizda minglab o'qlarning, o'qlarning, qushlarning va mushuklarning jonlari siz atrofingizda g'azab-tvitirlab, g'azab-g'azab yurgan holda, yaxshi vaqt o'tkazasiz.

en: You've got their lives, you know, and you must put up with their souls! Something seemed to affect his imagination, for he put his ﬁngers to his ears and shut his eyes, screwing them up tightly just as a small boy does when his face is being soaped.
uz: Ularning hayoti bor, bilasiz, va ularning jonlariga chidashingiz kerak! - deb o'ylaydi u, chunki u o'z barmoqlarini quloqlariga qo'yib, ko'zlarini yopib, ularni xuddi kichkina o'g'il suratini sabonlashda qilganidek qattiq buzadi.

en: There was something pathetic in it that touched me.
uz: Unda menga ta'sir qilgan bir og'ir narsa bor edi.

en: It also gave me a lesson, for it seemed that before me was a child, only a child, though the features were worn, and the stubble on the jaws was white.
uz: Shuningdek, bu menga dars berdi, chunki oldimda bir bola bor edi, faqat bir bola edi, garchi ko'rinishlari kiyingan bo'lsa-da, og'zaki cho'g'lar oq edi.

en: It was evident that he was undergoing some process of mental disturbance, and knowing how his past moods had interpreted things seemingly foreign to himself, I thought I would enter into his mind as well as I could and go with him The ﬁrst step was to restore conﬁdence, so I asked him, speaking pretty loud so that he would hear me through his closed ears,Would you like some sugar to get your ﬂies around again? He seemed to wake up all at once, and shook his head.
uz: U ruhiy kasallikka chalinganligi aniq edi va uning o'tmishdagi ruh holati o'ziga noma'lum bo'lgan narsalarni qanday ta'riflaganini bilganim uchun, men uning ongiga imkon qadar kirib, unga ergashishimni o'ylardim. Birinchi qadam o'zimga ishonishni tiklash edi, shuning uchun men undan: O'z qulog'i bilan meni eshitishi uchun juda baland ovoz bilan gapirganimda, biroz shakarni xohlaysizmi? - deb so'radim.

en: With a laugh he replied, Not much!
uz: U kulish bilan javob berdi: Ko'p emas!

en: Flies are poor things, after all! After a pause he added, But I don't want their souls buzzing round me, all the same. Or spiders? I went on.
uz: Qolaversa, tovuqlar kambag'al narsalardir! - deb to'xtatgandan so'ng qo'shimcha qilib qo'ydi: Ammo ularning ruhlari men atrofimda qichqirishni istamayman, shunday bo'lsa ham. - Yo'qki o'simliklarmi? - deb davom ettirdim.

en: What's the use of spiders?
uz: Oʻgʻirchoqlarning foydasi nimada?

en: There isn't anything in them to eat or …  He stopped suddenly as though reminded of a forbidden topic.
uz: Ularda ovqatlanish uchun hech narsa yo'q yoki... U to'xtab qo'ydi, xuddi taqiqlangan mavzuni eslatgandek.

en: So, so! I thought to myself, this is the second time he has suddenly stopped at the word `drink'.
uz: Ha, shunday! deb o'yladim men o'zimga, bu ikkinchi marta u to'satdan `drink' so'ziga to'xtadi.

en: What does it mean? Renﬁeld seemed himself aware of having made a lapse, for he hurried on, as though to distract my attention from it, I don't take any stock at all in such matters.
uz: Bu nimani anglatadi? - degan savolga Renfield o'zini o'zi javob bermay qo'yganidan xabardor bo'lib ko'rindi, chunki u mening e'tiborimni chalg'itmoqchi bo'lib, shunday dedi: Men bunday masalalarda hech qanday nuqtai nazarga ega emasman.

en: `Rats and mice and such small deer,' as Shakespeare has it, `chicken feed of the larder' they might be called.
uz: `Tushlar, tovuqlar va shunday kichkina g'izlar,' - deb aytdi Sheksper, `Tushlar do'konni oziqlantiradi' deb atalishi mumkin.

en: I'm past all that sort of
uz: Men bularning barchasidan o'tganman

en: You might as well ask a man to eat molecules with a pair of chopsticks, as to try to interest me about the less carnivora, when I know of what is before me. I see, I said.You want big things that you can make your teeth meet in?
uz: Bir kishiga bir juft chopstick bilan molekulalarni yeyishini so'rashingiz mumkin, ammo men oldimda nima borligini bilganimda, meni kamroq go'shtli hayvonlar haqida qiziqtirishga undashingiz mumkin.  Biladim, - dedim men. Siz o'zingizning tishlaringizni to'plashingiz mumkin bo'lgan katta narsalarni xohlaysizmi?

en: How would you like to breakfast on an elephant? What ridiculous nonsense you are talking? He was getting too wide awake, so I thought I would press him hard.
uz: Siz qanday g'alati gapiryapsiz? - deb so'radi u. U juda uyg'onib qoldi, shuning uchun unga qattiq bosim o'tkazishni o'yladim.

en: I wonder, I said reﬂectively, what an elephant's soul is like! The effect I desired was obtained, for he at once fell from his high-horse and became a child again.
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, filning ruhi qanday bo'ladi! - dedim men o'ylab. - Men xohlagan ta'sirga ega bo'ldim, chunki u darhol otidan tushib, yana bola bo'ldi.

en: I don't want an elephant's soul, or any soul at all! he said.
uz: Men filning ruhini yoki boshqa ruhni istamayman! - dedi u.

en: For a few moments he sat despondently.
uz: Bir necha daqiqalar u tushkunlikka tushib o'tirdi.

en: Suddenly he jumped to his feet, with his eyes blazing and all the signs of intense cerebral excitement.
uz: Toʻsatdan u koʻzlari yonib turgan va kuchli miya hayajonining barcha belgilari bilan oyoqlariga koʻtarildi.

en: To hell with you and your souls! he shouted.
uz: Sizlar va jonlaringiz jahannamga ketsin! - deb baqirib yubordi u.

en: Why do you plague me about souls?
uz: Nima uchun meni ruhlar haqida tortishasiz?

en: Haven't I got enough to worry, and pain, to distract me already, without thinking of souls? He looked so hostile that I thought he was in for another homicidal ﬁt, so I blew my whistle.
uz: Endi o'zimni chalg'itadigan tashvish va og'riq yetarli emasmi? - deb so'radi.U shunchalik dushman ko'rinardiki, men uni yana bir qotillik uchun kutaman deb o'yladim, shuning uchun o'zimni o'ldirib yubordim.

en: The instant, however, that I did so he became calm, and said apologeti- cally, Forgive me, Doctor.
uz: Biroq, men buni qilgan paytimda u tinchlanib, uzr so'radi: Kechirasiz, doktor.

en: You do not need any help.
uz: Sizga hech qanday yordam kerak emas.

en: I am so worried in my mind that I am apt to be irritable.
uz: O'zimni juda tashvishlantiraman, shuning uchun tez-tez g'azablanishga moyilman.

en: If you only knew the problem I have to face, and that I am working out, you would pity, and tol- erate, and pardon me.
uz: Agar siz men duch kelayotgan muammoni va o'zimni mashq qilayotganimni bilganingizda edi, menga rahm-shafqat ko'rsatib, sabr-toqat qilib, kechirimli bo'lar edingiz.

en: Pray do not put me in a strait waistcoat.
uz: Menga chiroyli kiyim qo'ymanglar, deb ibodat qilinglar.

en: I want to think and I cannot think freely when my body is conﬁned.
uz: O'ylashni xohlayman va tanam cheklangan bo'lganda erkin o'ylay olmayman.

en: I am sure you will understand! He had evidently self-control, so when the attendants came I told them not to mind, and they withdrew.
uz: Ishonchim borki, siz buni tushunasiz! - deb o'zini tuta olgan edi, shuning uchun xizmatkorlar kelganida, ularga g'alati bo'lmaslikni aytdim va ular orqaga chiqdilar.

en: Renﬁeld watched them go.
uz: Renfield ularni ketayotganini kuzatdi.

en: When the door was closed he said with considerable dignity and sweetness, Dr.
uz: Eshik yopilganda u katta qadr-qimmat va shirinlik bilan shunday dedi: Dr.

en: Seward, you have been very considerate towards me.
uz: Seward, siz menga nisbatan juda mehribon bo'lgansiz.

en: Believe me that I am very, very grateful to you! I thought it well to leave him in this mood, and so I came away.
uz: Menga ishoningki, men sizga juda, juda minnatdorman! deb aytdim. Men uni shu ruhda qoldirishni yaxshi deb o'yladim va shuning uchun ketdim.

en: There is certainly something to ponder over in this man's state.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu odamning holatida o'ylash kerak bo'lgan narsa bor.

en: Several points seem to make what the American interviewer calls a story, if one could only get them in proper order.
uz: Bir nechta nuqtalarni amerikalik intervyuser qizig'i, deb ataydigan narsalarga aylantiradi, agar ularni faqat to'g'ri tartibda olish mumkin bo'lsa.

en: Here they are: Will not mention drinking. Fears the thought of being burdened with the soul of anything.
uz: Mana ular: ochlik haqida hech narsa aytmaydi. Jana bilan og'ir tushish fikridan qo'rqadi.

en: Has no dread of wanting life in the future.
uz: Kelajakda hayotni istashdan qo'rqmaydi.

en: Despises the meaner forms of life altogether, though he dreads being haunted by their souls.
uz: Hayotning ko'proq yomon shakllarini umuman e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, garchi ularning ruhlari uni qiynashidan qo'rqsa ham.

en: Logically all these things point one way!
uz: Mantiqcha, bularning barchasi bitta yo'lni ko'rsatadi!

en: He has assurance of some kind that he will acquire some higher life.
uz: U o'zining yuqori hayot tarziga ega bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qiladi.

en: He dreads the consequence, the burden of a soul.
uz: U oqibatlardan, ruhning og'irligidan qo'rqadi.

en: Then it is a human life he looks to!
uz: Shunday qilib, u odam hayotini izlaydi!

en: And the assurance …  ?
uz: Xoʻsh, sugʻurta ... ?

en: The Count has been to him, and there is some new scheme of terror afoot!
uz: Count unga tashrif buyurgan va qo'rquvning yangi rejasi bor!

en: Later.—I went after my round to Van Helsing and told him my suspicion.
uz: Keyinroq.Men o'z turimdan keyin Van Helsingga borib, unga shubhamni aytdim.

en: He grew very grave, and after thinking the matter over for a while asked me to take him to Renﬁeld.
uz: U juda jiddiy bo'ldi va bir muncha vaqt o'ylab ko'rganidan so'ng, uni Renfieldga olib borishimni so'radi.

en: As we came to the door we heard the lu- natic within singing gaily, as he used to do in the time which now seems so long ago.
uz: Eshikga yetib borganimizda, yurtimizdagi lu-natiqning o'sha paytlarda qilganidek, o'sha paytlarda juda uzoq vaqt oldin kuylaganini eshitdik.

en: When we entered we saw with amazement that he had spread out his sug- ar as of old.
uz: Biz kirganimizda, u qadimgi kabi o'z so'zlarini tarqatganini hayronlik bilan ko'rdik.

en: The ﬂies, lethargic with the autumn, were beginning to buzz into the room.
uz: Koʻkgulik bilan chiroyli boʻlgan uchuqlar xonaga kirishni boshlashdi.

en: We tried to make him talk of the subject of our previous con- versation, but he would not attend.
uz: Biz uni o'tgan suhbatimiz mavzusida gapirishga urdik, lekin u qatnashmadi.

en: He went on with his singing, just as though we had not been present.
uz: U o'z qo'shiqlarini davom ettirdi, xuddi biz hozir bo'lmaganimizdek.

en: He had got a scrap of paper and was fold- ing it into a notebook.
uz: U qog'ozni olib, uni yozuvchisiga qo'yib qo'ygan edi.

en: We had to come away as ignorant as we went in.
uz: Biz kirganimizdek, o'zimizni ham jaholatsiz qoldirishimiz kerak edi.

en: His is a curious case indeed.
uz: Darhaqiqat, uning davosi g'alati.

en: We must watch him tonight.
uz: Biz uni bu kechqurun kuzatib turishimiz kerak.

en: LETTER, MITCHELL, SONS & CANDY TO LORD GODALMING.
uz: LETTER, MITCHELL, SONS & CANDY LORD GODALMING uchun.

en: My Lord, We are at all times only too happy to meet your wishes.
uz: - Rabbim, biz har doim sizning xohish-irodasingizni bajarishga juda xursandmiz.

en: We beg, with regard to the desire of your Lordship, expressed by Mr.
uz: Sizlarning xudojo'yingizning iltimosiga e'tibor qaratsak, biz sizlarni Mr. tomonidan bildirilgan iltimosiga e'tirof qilamiz.

en: Harker on your be- half, to supply the following information concerning the sale and purchase of No.347,Piccadilly.
uz: Harker sizning hisobingizda, No.347, Piccadilly sotilishi va sotib olinishi to'g'risida quyidagi ma'lumotlarni taqdim etish uchun.

en: The original vendors are the executors of the late Mr.
uz: Asl sotuvchilar - marhum Mr.ning ijrochilari.

en: Archibald Winter-Sufﬁeld.
uz: Archibald Winter-Suffield.

en: The purchaser is a foreign nobleman, Count de Ville, who effected the purchase himself paying the purchase money in notes `over the counter,' if your Lordship will pardon us using so vulgar an expression.
uz: Xaridor chet ellik ardoz, Count de Ville, sotib olishni o'zi amalga oshirgan va sotib olish pulini notalarda `over the counter' deb to'lagan, agar Lordligingiz bizni bunday vulgar ibora bilan kechirsa.

en: Beyond this we know nothing whatever of him.
uz: Bundan tashqari, biz u haqida hech narsa bilmaymiz.

en: We are, my Lord, Your Lordship's humble servants, MITCHELL, SONS & CANDY. DR.
uz: Biz, rahim, sizlarning Lordligingizning kamtarin xizmatkorlari, MITCHELL, SONS & CANDY.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 2 October.—I placed a man in the corridor last night, and told him to make an accurate note of any sound he might hear from Renﬁeld's room,
uz: Kecha kechasi men bir odamni koridorda joylashtirdim va unga Renfieldning xonasidan eshitadigan har qanday tovushni aniq yozib qo'yishni aytdim.

en: and gave him instructions that if there should be anything strange he was to call me.
uz: Unga biron bir g'alati narsa bo'lsa, menga qo'ng'iroq qilish kerakligini aytdim.

en: After dinner, when we had all gathered round the ﬁre in the study, Mrs.
uz: Ovqatdan so'ng, o'quvxonadagi yong'in atrofida to'planganimizda, xonim Xalilulloh Xalilulloh bilan suhbatlashdik.

en: Harker having gone to bed, we discussed the attempts and discoveries of the day.
uz: Harker uxlab ketgach, biz o'sha kunning tajribalari va kashfiyotlari haqida suhbatlashdik.

en: Harker was the only one who had any result, and we are in great hopes that his clue may be an important one.
uz: Harkerning o'zi faqatgina natijalarga erishgan va biz uning izlanishining muhim bo'lishiga umid qilamiz.

en: Before going to bed I went round to the patient's room and looked in through the observation trap.
uz: Yotoqdan oldin bemor xonasiga borib, kuzatuv tuzoqidan ko'rdim.

en: He was sleeping soundly, his heart rose and fell with regular respiration.
uz: U yaxshi uxlagan, yuragi ko'tarilgan va pastga tushgan.

en: This morning the man on duty reported to me that a little after midnight he was restless and kept saying his prayers somewhat loudly.
uz: Bugun ertalab xizmatda bo'lgan kishi menga yarim tun o'tib biroz tashvishlanib, biroz baland ovoz bilan ibodat qilishni davom ettirganini aytdi.

en: I asked him if that was all.
uz: Men undan bularning hammasi bor-yo'qligini so'radim.

en: He replied that it was all he heard.
uz: U shunchaki eshitganini aytdi.

en: There was something about his manner, so suspicious that I asked him point blank if he had been asleep.
uz: Uning xulq-atvorida shu qadar shubhali bir narsa bor ediki, u uxlagan-olmaganini so'radim.

en: He denied sleep, but admitted to having dozed for a while.
uz: U uxlashni rad etdi, lekin bir muncha vaqt davomida doza qilganligini tan oldi.

en: It is too bad that men cannot be trusted unless they are watched.
uz: Odamlarga e'tiborsiz qaramasdan, ularga ishonish mumkin emasligi juda yomon.

en: Today Harker is out following up his clue, and Art and Quincey are look- ing after horses.
uz: Bugungi kunda Harker uning izini izlamoqda, Art va Quincey esa otlarni qidirmoqda.

en: Godalming thinks that it will be well to have horses always in readiness, for when we get the information which we seek there will be no time to lose.
uz: Godalming o'ylaydiki, otlar doimo tayyor bo'lishi yaxshi bo'ladi, chunki biz qidirayotgan ma'lumotlarga ega bo'lganimizda, yo'qotish uchun vaqt yo'q.

en: We must sterilize all the imported earth between sunrise and sunset.
uz: Biz quyosh chiqish va quyosh botish paytida import qilingan butun yerni sterilizatsiya qilishimiz kerak.

en: We shall thus catch the Count at his weakest, and without a refuge to ﬂy to.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz Countni eng zaif holatda va uchish uchun boshpanasiz tutamiz.

en: Van Helsing is off to the British Museum looking up some authorities on ancient medicine.
uz: Van Helsing Buyuk Britaniya muzeyiga borib, qadimgi tibbiyot bo'yicha ba'zi mutaxassislarni qidirmoqda.

en: The old physicians took account of things which their followers do not accept, and the Professor is searching for witch and demon cures which may be useful to us later.
uz: Qadimgi shifokorlar o'z izdoshlarining qabul qilmaydigan narsalarini hisobga olishdi va professor keyinchalik bizga foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan sehrgarlik va jinlar shifolarini izlamoqda.

en: I sometimes think we must be all mad and that we shall wake to sanity in strait waistcoats.
uz: Ba'zan biz hammamiz aqldan ozganmiz va kamroq kiyimda aqldan o'tamiz deb o'ylayman.

en: Later.—We have met again.
uz: Keyinroq.Biz yana uchrashdik.

en: We seem at last to be on the track, and our work of tomorrow may be the beginning of the end.
uz: Oxir-oqibat biz yo'lga chiqdik va ertangi ishimiz oxiratning boshlanishi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I wonder if Renﬁeld's quiet has anything to do with this.
uz: O'ylaymanki, Renfieldning xotirjamligi bunga aloqasi bormi?

en: His moods have so followed the doings of the Count, that the coming destruction of the monster may be carried to him some subtle way.
uz: Uning his-tuyg'ulari Countning harakatlariga shunchalik ergashib ketganki, uning o'zi uchun dahshatning yaqinlashib kelayotgan yo'q qilinishi noaniq tarzda o'tkazilishi mumkin.

en: If we could only get some hint as to what passed in his mind, between the time of my argument with him today and his resump- tion of ﬂy-catching, it might afford us a valuable clue.
uz: Agar bugun men u bilan bahslashgan paytdan boshlab, u o'g'ilni qo'lga olishni davom ettirgan paytgacha uning ongida nimalar o'tganini aniqlab olsa, bu bizga qimmatli ma'lumotni beradi.

en: He is now seemingly quiet for a spell … Is he?
uz: Endi u bir muncha vaqtdan beri sekin-sakin bo'lib qolgan...

en: That wild yell seemed to come from his room … The attendant came bursting into my room and told me that Renﬁeld had somehow met with some accident.
uz: O'sha yovvoyi qichqiriq uning xonasidan kelib turar edi... Xizmatchi xonamga burib kirib, Renfieldning qandaydir bir baxtsiz hodisa yuz berganini aytdi.

en: He had heard him yell, and when he went to him found him lying on his face on the ﬂoor, all covered with blood.
uz: U uning qichqirishini eshitgan edi va uning yoniga borgach, uni yerga yuzma-yuz o'tirib, butunlay qon bilan to'lgan holda topdi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 3 October.—Let me put down with exactness all that happened, as well as I can remember, since last I made an entry.
uz: SEWARDning 3 oktyabrdagi kundalig'i.Menga sodir bo'lgan voqealarning barchasini aniqlik bilan yozib qo'yishim kerak, chunki men oxirgi marta yozuv yozganimdan buyon eslayman.

en: Not a detail that I can recall must be forgotten.
uz: Hatto eslab qolishim mumkin bo'lgan hech bir tafsilot unutilmasligi kerak.

en: In all calmness I must proceed.
uz: Butun xotirjamlik bilan davom etishim kerak.

en: When I came to Renﬁeld's room I found him lying on the ﬂoor on his left side in a glittering pool of blood.
uz: Renfieldning xonasiga yetib kelganimda, uni o'ng tomonidagi qavatda, qan bilan to'lib-toshgan hovuzda yotgan holda ko'rdim.

en: When I went to move him, it became at once apparent that he had received some terrible injuries.
uz: Men uni ko'chirib yuborishga borganimda, u dahshatli jarohatlarga duch kelganini darhol ko'rdim.

en: There seemed none of the unity of purpose between the parts of the body which marks even lethargic sanity.
uz: Jismoniy qismlar o'rtasidagi maqsad birligi yo'qdek tuyuldi, bu hatto sog'lom aql-idrokni belgilaydi.

en: As the face was exposed I could see that it was horri- bly bruised, as though it had been beaten against the ﬂoor.
uz: Uning yuzi ko'rilganida, u yerga urilgan kabi dahshatli shikastlanganini ko'rdim.

en: Indeed it was from the face wounds that the pool of blood originated.
uz: Darhaqiqat, qon hovlisi yuzdagi yaralardan paydo bo'lgan.

en: The attendant who was kneeling beside the body said to me as we turned him over, I think, sir, his back is broken.
uz: O'lim jasadi yonida tiz cho'kkan xizmatkor unga qarab: Mening fikrimcha, xo'jayinim, uning orqa qismi sindirib ketgan.

en: See, both his right arm and leg and the whole side of his face are paralysed. How such a thing could have happened puzzled the attendant beyond measure.
uz: Mana, uning o'ng qo'li, oyoq va yuzining butun tomonlari chalg'ib qolgan. Qanday qilib bunday narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkinligi xizmatkorni o'lchovsiz hayron qoldirdi.

en: He seemed quite bewil- dered, and his brows were gathered in as he said, I can't understand the two things.
uz: U juda g'alati ko'rinardi va ko'z o'nglari bir-biriga to'lib: Men bu ikki narsani tushunolmayman.

en: He could mark his face like that by beating his own head on the ﬂoor.
uz: U o'z boshini yerga urib yuzini shunday belgilab qo'yish mumkin edi.

en: I saw a young woman do it once at the Eversﬁeld Asylum before any- one could lay hands on her.
uz: Men bir marta Eversfield Asylumida bir yosh ayolni uni qo'ldan ozdirishdan oldin ko'rdim.

en: And I suppose he might have broken his neck by falling out of bed, if he got in an awkward kink.
uz: Agar u noqulay holatda bo'lsa, o'z bo'yinini to'xtatib, yotoqdan tushib buzgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But for the life of me I can't imagine how the two things occurred.
uz: Ammo hayotim uchun bu ikki narsa qanday sodir bo'lganini tasavvur ham qila olmayman.

en: If his back was broke, he couldn't beat his head, and if his face was like that before the fall out of bed, there would be marks of it. I said to him, Go to Dr.
uz: Agar uning orqa qismi buzilgan bo'lsa, boshini urishi mumkin emas, agar uning yuzi esa yotoqdan tushib qolishdan oldin shunday bo'lgan bo'lsa, uning belgilari bo'ladi, - dedim men unga, Doktorning oldiga bor dedim.

en: Van Helsing, and ask him to kindly come here at once.
uz: Van Helsing va undan darhol bu yerga kelishini so'rang.

en: I want him without an instant's delay. The man ran off, and within a few minutes the Professor, in his dressing gown and slippers, appeared.
uz: Men uni bir daqiqalik kechiktirmasdan xohlayman. - deb qochib ketdi u kishi, bir necha daqiqadan so'ng esa professor o'zining kiyim-bosh va paltarlar bilan paydo bo'ldi.

en: When he saw Renﬁeld on the ground, he looked keenly at him a moment, and then turned to me.
uz: Renfieldni yerga ko'rganida, u bir muncha vaqt unga diqqat bilan qaradi va so'ngra menga qarab turadi.

en: nized my thought in my eyes, for he said very quietly, manifestly for the ears of the attendant, Ah, a sad accident!
uz: O'zimning ko'zimga g'oyib bo'lganim uchun, u juda xotirjamlik bilan, xizmatkorning quloqlariga ko'rinib turib, shunday dedi: A, bu juda ayanchli hodisa!

en: He will need very careful watch- ing, and much attention.
uz: Unga juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatuv va katta e'tibor kerak bo'ladi.

en: I shall stay with you myself, but I shall ﬁrst dress myself.
uz: Men o'zim siz bilan birga bo'laman, lekin avval o'zim kiyindim.

en: If you will remain I shall in a few minutes join you. The patient was now breathing stertorously and it was easy to see that he had suffered some terrible injury.
uz: Agar siz qolsangiz, men bir necha daqiqadan keyin sizga qo'shilishaman. Bemor endi og'ir nafas olgan va u dahshatli jarohat olganini ko'rish oson edi.

en: Van Helsing returned with extraordinary celerity, bearing with him a sur- gical case.
uz: Van Helsing o'zgacha tezlik bilan qaytib keldi va o'zi bilan birga jarrohlik holatini olib keldi.

en: He had evidently been thinking and had his mind made up, for almost before he looked at the patient, he whispered to me, Send the atten- dant away.
uz: U o'ylab ko'rgan va o'z qarorini chiqargan bo'lsa kerak, chunki bemorni ko'rmasdan oldin menga: Agentni jo'nating.

en: We must be alone with him when he becomes conscious, after the operation. I said, I think that will do now, Simmons.
uz: Operatsiyadan so'ng u ongga kelganda biz u bilan yolg'iz bo'lishimiz kerak, - dedim men: Men o'ylaymanki, bu endi to'g'ri keladi, Simmons.

en: We have done all that we can at present.
uz: Hozircha qo'limizdan kelganini qildik.

en: You had better go your round, and Dr.
uz: Siz o'zingizning turingizga borib, dr.

en: Van Helsing will operate.
uz: Van Helsing faoliyat ko'rsatadi.

en: Let me know instantly if there be anything unusual anywhere. The man withdrew, and we went into a strict examination of the patient.
uz: Agar biron bir joyda biron bir noyob narsa bo'lsa, darhol xabar bering. - deb so'radi u kishi.U kishi orqaga chiqdi va biz bemorni qat'iy tekshirib ko'rdik.

en: The wounds of the face were superﬁcial.
uz: Yuzdagi yaralar yuzaki edi.

en: The real injury was a depressed fracture of the skull, extending right up through the motor area.
uz: Haqiqiy jarohat - bu tengkachasining tushkunligi ostida bo'lib, motorali hududdan to'g'ri cho'kkan jarohat edi.

en: The Professor thought a moment and said,We must reduce the pressure and get back to normal conditions, as far as can be.
uz: Professor bir daqiqa o'ylab, shunday dedi: Biz bosimni kamaytirib, iloji boricha odatdagi sharoitlarga qaytishimiz kerak.

en: The rapidity of the suf- fusion shows the terrible nature of his injury.
uz: Suffusionning tezligi uning jarohatining dahshatli xususiyatini ko'rsatadi.

en: The whole motor area seems affected.
uz: Butun motor maydoni ta'sirlangan ko'rinadi.

en: The suffusion of the brain will increase quickly, so we must trephine at once or it may be too late. As he was speaking there was a soft tapping at the door.
uz: Miyaning to'kib-ichishi tez o'sadi, shuning uchun biz darhol trefin qilishimiz kerak yoki juda kech bo'lishi mumkin. U gapirgan paytda eshikda yumshoq taqillatish bo'ldi.

en: I went over and opened it and found in the corridor without, Arthur and Quincey in pajamas and slippers, the former spoke, I heard your man call up Dr.
uz: Men borib, uni ochdim va yo'lda Arthur va Quincey pijama va choriq kiygan, avvalgilar gapirganini ko'rdim.

en: Van Helsing and tell him of an accident.
uz: Van Helsing va unga baxtsiz hodisa haqida ayting.

en: So I woke Quincey or rather called for him as he was not asleep.
uz: Shunday qilib, men Quinceyni uyg'otdim yoki, aniqrog'i, uni uyquda bo'lmaganligi uchun chaqirtirdim.

en: Things are moving too quickly and too strangely for sound sleep for any of us these times.
uz: Bu vaqtlarda hamma uchun uyqusiz uyqu uchun narsalar juda tez va juda g'alati tarzda o'tmoqda.

en: I've been thinking that tomorrow night will not see things as they have been.
uz: Men ertaga kechqurun hamma narsa avvalgidek ko'rinmaydi deb o'yladim.

en: We'll have to look back, and for- ward a little more than we have done.
uz: Biz orqaga qarab, ilgari qilganimizdan biroz ko'proq harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: May we come in? I nodded, and held the door open till they had entered, then I closed it again.
uz: Ichkariga kirishimiz mumkinmi? - deb boshimni og'ritdim va ular kirguniga qadar eshikni ochiq tutdim, so'ngra uni yana yopdim.

en: When Quincey saw the attitude and state of the patient, and noted the horrible pool on the ﬂoor, he said softly, My God!
uz: Quincey bemorning munosabati va holatini ko'rib, yerda qo'rqinchli hovuzni ko'rganida, jismonan: Allohim!

en: What has happened to him?
uz: Unga nima bo'ldi?

en: Poor, poor devil! I told him brieﬂy, and added that we expected he would recover con- sciousness after the operation, for a short time, at all events.
uz: Yomon, qashshoq shayton! - dedim men unga qisqacha va shu bilan birga, operatsiyadan keyin u qisqa vaqt davomida, hech bo'lmaganda, ongga qaytishini kutganimizni aytdim.

en: once and sat down on the edge of the bed, with Godalming beside him.
uz: Bir marta Godalming o'z yonida to'shaning chetida o'tirdi.

en: We all watched in patience.
uz: Hammamiz sabr-toqat bilan kuzatib turardik.

en: We shall wait, said Van Helsing, just long enough to ﬁx the best spot for trephining, so that we may most quickly and perfectly remove the blood clot, for it is evident that the haemorrhage is increasing. The minutes during which we waited passed with fearful slowness.
uz: Van Helsing shunday dedi: Biz to'xtatamiz, faqat trefining uchun eng yaxshi joyni to'g'rilash uchun, qon to'plamini eng tez va mukammal tarzda olib tashlashimiz mumkin, chunki qon ketishining ko'payishi aniq.

en: I had a horrible sinking in my heart, and from Van Helsing's face I gathered that he felt some fear or apprehension as to what was to come.
uz: Qalbimda dahshatli bir cho'kish bo'ldi va Van Helsingning yuzidan uning kelajakka nisbatan qo'rquv yoki qo'rquv his etganini tushundim.

en: I dreaded the words Renﬁeld might speak.
uz: Men Renfield aytgan so'zlardan qo'rqardim.

en: I was positively afraid to think.
uz: Men o'ylashdan qo'rqardim.

en: But the con- viction of what was coming was on me, as I have read of men who have heard the death watch.
uz: Ammo o'lim qo'riqchilarini eshitgan kishilar haqida o'qiganimda, kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan voqealar haqida o'yladim.

en: The poor man's breathing came in uncertain gasp- s.Each instant he seemed as though he would open his eyes and speak, but then would follow a prolonged stertorous breath, and he would relapse into a more ﬁxed insensibility.
uz: Yomon odamning nafaslari shubhasiz tushib turardi.Har bir daqiqada u ko'zlarini ochib gapirayotgandek ko'rinardi, lekin keyin uzoq vaqt davomida nafas olishdan so'ng, u yanada qattiq hissiyotsizlikka qaytadi.

en: Inured as I was to sick beds and death, this sus- pense grew and grew upon me.
uz: Kasallik to'shagim va o'limdan bezovta bo'lganimda, bu fikr menga o'sdi va o'sdi.

en: I could almost hear the beating of my own heart, and the blood surging through my temples sounded like blows from a hammer.
uz: O'z yuragim urishini deyarli eshitardim va qulog'imdan to'lib-toshgan qon martalovdan urilgan tovush kabi eshitilardi.

en: The silence ﬁnally became agonizing.
uz: Oxir-oqibat xotirjamlik og'irlikka aylandi.

en: I looked at my companions, one after another, and saw from their ﬂushed faces and damp brows that they were enduring equal torture.
uz: Men hamrohimga bir-biridan ko'z ochib, ularning qizil yuzlari va suyuq burunlaridan ular teng azob chekayotganini ko'rdim.

en: There was a nervous suspense over us all, as though overhead some dread bell would peal out powerfully when we should least expect it.
uz: Hammamizning ustimizda g'alati g'alati paydo bo'ldi, xuddi boshimizdan qo'rqinchli bir qo'ng'iroq biz hech qachon kutmagan paytda kuchli ovoz bilan chaqirgandek edi.

en: At last there came a time when it was evident that the patient was sinking fast.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, bemor tezda qulab ketayotgani aniq bo'lgan vaqt keldi.

en: He might die at any moment.
uz: U istalgan vaqtda o'lishi mumkin.

en: I looked up at the Professor and caught his eyes ﬁxed on mine.
uz: Professorga ko'zimni ko'tarib, uning ko'zlari mening ko'zimga qaraganini ko'rdim.

en: His face was sternly set as he spoke, There is no time to lose.
uz: Uning yuzi qattiqqo'l bo'lib, u shunday dedi: Yitirish uchun vaqt yo'q.

en: His words may be worth many lives.
uz: Uning so'zlari ko'plab jonlarga arziydigan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I have been thinking so, as I stood here.
uz: Men bu yerda turganimda o'zim ham shunday o'yladim.

en: It may be there is a soul at stake!
uz: Ehtimol, o'z joningiz xavf ostida bo'lishi mumkin!

en: We shall operate just above the ear. Without another word he made the operation.
uz: Biz quloqning o'ng tomonida operatsiya qilamiz. - degan so'zlarni aytmay, u operatsiyani amalga oshirdi.

en: For a few moments the breathing continued to be stertorous.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida nafas olish stertorous davom etdi.

en: Then there came a breath so prolonged that it seemed as though it would tear open his chest.
uz: So'ngra u shunchalik uzoq nafas oldiki, xuddi ko'krakni ochib yuborayotgandek bo'ldi.

en: Suddenly his eyes opened, and became ﬁxed in a wild, helpless stare.
uz: Toʻsatdan uning koʻzlari ochildi va vahshiy, yordamsiz koʻz oʻngida turdi.

en: This was continued for a few moments, then it was softened into a glad surprise, and from his lips came a sigh of relief.
uz: Bu bir necha daqiqa davom etdi, so'ngra bu quvonchli kutilmaganga aylandi va uning og'izlaridan taskin hissi chiqdi.

en: He moved convulsively, and as he did so, said, I'll be quiet, Doctor.
uz: U shovqinli harakat qildi va shunday qilib: Men tinch bo'laman, Doktor.

en: Tell them to take off the strait waistcoat.
uz: Ularga bo'sh kiyimlarini olib tashlashlarini ayt.

en: I have had a terrible dream, and it has left me so weak that I cannot move.
uz: Men dahshatli tush ko'rdim va bu meni juda zaif qoldirdi, hatto harakatlanishga ham ojiz qoldirdim.

en: What's wrong with my face?
uz: Mening yuzimda nima muammo bor?

en: It feels all swollen, and it smarts dreadfully.
uz: Bu butunlay puchgan hissiyot va dahshatli og'irlikdir.

en: He tried to turn his head, but even with the effort his eyes seemed to grow glassy again so I gently put it back.
uz: U boshini burishga harakat qildi, lekin hatto harakat bilan uning ko'zlari yana shishaga aylandi, shuning uchun men uni muloyimlik bilan qo'ydim.

en: Then Van Helsing said in a quiet grave tone, Tell us your dream, Mr.
uz: Keyin Van Helsing xotirjam o'z o'rnida shunday dedi: Bizga orzuingizni aytib bering, Mr..

en: Renﬁeld. As he heard the voice his face brightened, through its mutilation, and he said, That is Dr.
uz: Renfield.  So'zni eshitganida, uning yuzi o'chirib ketadi va u shunday dedi: Bu doktor.

en: How good it is of you to be here.
uz: Bu erda bo'lishingiz juda yaxshi.

en: Give me some water, my lips are dry, and I shall try to tell you.
uz: Menga suv bering, og'zim quruq bo'lib qoldi va sizga aytishga harakat qilaman.

en: I dreamed … He stopped and seemed fainting.
uz: U to'xtadi va o'zidan ketayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: I called quietly to Quincey, The brandy, it is in my study, quick! He ﬂew and returned with a glass, the de- canter of brandy and a carafe of water.
uz: Men Quinceyga xotirjamlik bilan: Brandy, u o'zimning ishxonamda, tezroq! - deb qo'ng'iroq qildim.

en: We moistened the parched lips, and the patient quickly revived.
uz: Biz quruq bo'lgan og'izlarni namlashtirdik va bemor tezda tiriklandi.

en: It seemed, however, that his poor injured brain had been working in the interval, for when he was quite conscious, he looked at me piercingly with an agonized confusion which I shall never forget, and said, I must not de- ceive myself.
uz: Biroq, uning yaralangan miyasi o'sha vaqt ichida ishlamoqchi bo'lib tuyuldi, chunki u o'z ongida bo'lganida, u menga hech qachon unutmasligim kerak bo'lgan azob chekkan chalg'ilish bilan qaradi va shunday deydi: O'zimni yo'q qilmayman.

en: It was no dream, but all a grim reality. Then his eyes roved round the room.
uz: Bu orzu emas, balki chiroyli haqiqat edi. Keyin uning ko'zlari xonadon atrofida aylanib bordi.

en: As they caught sight of the two ﬁgures sitting patiently on the edge of the bed he went on, If I were not sure already, I would know from them. For an instant his eyes closed, not with pain or sleep but voluntarily, as though he were bringing all his faculties to bear.
uz: Ikkala kishi o'z yotoq yonida sabr-toqat bilan o'tirganini ko'rganlarida, u davom etib: Agar hozirdan bilmasam, ulardan bilib olardim, - dedi.Bir zum davomida uning ko'zlari og'riq yoki uyqudan emas, balki o'z xohishi bilan yopildi.

en: When he opened them he said, hurriedly, and with more energy than he had yet displayed, Quick, Doctor, quick, I am dying!
uz: U ularni ochganida, shoshilinch va ko'rsatganidan ko'proq kuch bilan: Shoshilinch, shifokor, shoshilinch, o'laman!

en: I feel that I have but a few minutes, and then I must go back to death, or worse!
uz: O'zimni faqat bir necha daqiqaga qolganman va keyin o'limga qaytishim kerak, yoki bundan ham yomonroq!

en: Wet my lips with brandy again.
uz: O'zimni yana brendi bilan cho'ktiraman.

en: I have something that I must say before I die.
uz: O'limdan oldin aytishim kerak bo'lgan bir narsa bor.

en: Or before my poor crushed brain dies anyhow.
uz: Yoki mening kambag'al buzilgan miyam o'lib ketishdan oldin.

en: It was that night after you left me, when I im- plored you to let me go away.
uz: O'sha kecha siz meni tashlab ketgandan so'ng, men sizdan meni tark etishingizni iltimos qilgan edim.

en: I couldn't speak then, for I felt my tongue was tied.
uz: O'shanda men tilimni bog'lab qo'yganimni his qilganim uchun gapira olmasdim.

en: But I was as sane then, except in that way, as I am now.
uz: Ammo men o'shanda, hozirgi kabi sog'lom edim, faqatgina o'sha yo'l bilan.

en: I was in an agony of despair for a long time after you left me, it seemed hours.
uz: Siz meni tashlab ketgandan so'ng men uzoq vaqt umidsizlik azobida edim, bu soatlar ko'rinardi.

en: Then there came a sudden peace to me.
uz: So'ngra men uchun to'satdan tinchlik keldi.

en: My brain seemed to become cool again, and I realized where I was.
uz: O'ylaymanki, miyam yana sovuq bo'ldi va men qayerda ekanligimni angladim.

en: I heard the dogs bark behind our house, but not where He was! As he spoke, Van Helsing's eyes never blinked, but his hand came out and met mine and gripped it hard.
uz: Men uyimiz orqasida itlar qichqirganini eshitdim, lekin U qayerda bo'lganini eshitmadim! - deb so'zlashganda, Van Helsingning ko'zlari hech qachon cho'kib ketmadi, lekin qo'li mening qo'limga tushib, uni qattiq ushlab qoldi.

en: He did not, however, betray himself.
uz: Biroq, u o'ziga xiyonat qilmadi.

en: He nodded slightly and said, Go on, in a low voice.
uz: U biroz bosh ko'tardi va past ovoz bilan: O'shanda, - dedi.

en: He came up to the window in the mist, as I had seen him often before, but he was solid then, not a ghost, and his eyes were ﬁerce like a man's when angry.
uz: Men uni ko'p marta ko'rganimdek, u tundagi darchaga yaqinlashdi, lekin u o'sha paytda kuchli edi, hayajon emas edi va uning ko'zlari g'azabda bo'lgan odamning ko'zlariga o'xshardi.

en: He was laughing with his red mouth, the sharp white teeth glinted in the moonlight when he turned to look back over
uz: O'zining qizil og'zi va oy nurida chiroqlab turgan oq tishlari bilan kulgan edi.

en: the belt of trees, to where the dogs were barking.
uz: Daraxtlar quti, itlar qaynayotgan joyga.

en: I wouldn't ask him to come in at ﬁrst, though I knew he wanted to, just as he had wanted all along.
uz: Boshida men unga kirishni so'ramagan edim, ammo uning xohlaganini bilardim, xuddi u hamisha xohlaganidek.

en: Then he began promising me things, not in words but by doing them. He was interrupted by a word from the Professor, How? By making them happen.
uz: Keyin u menga so'zlar bilan emas, balki amalda va'dalar berishni boshladi. U professorning Qanday? degan so'zi bilan to'xtatildi.

en: Just as he used to send in the ﬂies when the sun was shining.
uz: Xuddi quyosh porlaganda u tovuqlarni jo'natganidek.

en: Great big fat ones with steel and sapphire on their wings.
uz: Ulug' katta yog'liqlar, qanotlarida po'lat va safpir bor.

en: And big moths, in the night, with skull and cross-bones on their backs. Van Helsing nodded to him as he whispered to me unconsciously, The Acherontia Atropos of the Sphinges, what you call the `Death's-head Moth'? The patient went on without stopping, Then he began to whisper.`Rats, rats, rats!
uz: Va kechasi katta ko'kraklar, ularning orqasida qovurg'i va to'qnashuvi bor. - dedi Van Helsing unga bosh ko'tardi va u menga bexabarlik bilan: Sfingelarning Acherontia Atropos, siz o'lim boshli ko'krak deb ataysizmi? - deb shov-shuv qildi.

en: Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life.
uz: Ularning yuzlari, minglari, millionlari va har biri o'z hayotini o'tkazadi.

en: And dogs to eat them, and cats too.
uz: Va ularni yeyish uchun itlar va mushuklar.

en: All red blood, with years of life in it, and not merely buzzing ﬂies!' I laughed at him, for I wanted to see what he could do.
uz: Qizil qon, o'nlab yillar davomida yashaydigan, shunchaki o't qo'zg'atadigan cho'g'lar emas! - deb unga kulganman, chunki u nima qila olishini ko'rmoqchi edim.

en: Then the dogs howled, away beyond the dark trees in His house.
uz: Keyin itlar uyidagi qorong'i daraxtlar orqasidan uzoqroq qichqirishdi.

en: He beckoned me to the window.
uz: U meni derazaga chaqirdi.

en: I got up and looked out, and He raised his hands,and seemed to call out without using any words.
uz: Men turib, ko'zimni ko'rdim va U qo'llarini ko'tarib, so'zsiz qo'rqqanidek ko'rindi.

en: A dark mass spread over the grass, coming on like the shape of a ﬂame of ﬁre.
uz: O't o'tlari ustida qorong'i bir to'plam tarqalib, olov alangasi shaklida paydo bo'ldi.

en: And then He moved the mist to the right and left, and I could see that there were thousands of rats with their eyes blazing red, like His only smaller.
uz: So'ngra U bulutni o'ng va chap tomonga ko'chirdi va men minglab tovuqlarni ko'rdim, ularning ko'zlari qizil rangga to'lib, faqat Uning kichikligidan o'zgacha edi.

en: He held up his hand, and they all stopped, and I thought he seemed to be saying, `All these lives will I give you, ay, and many more and greater, through countless ages, if you will fall down and worship me!' And then a red cloud, like the color of blood, seemed to close over my eyes, and before I knew what I was doing, I found myself opening the sash and saying to Him, `Come in, Lord and Master!' The rats were all gone, but He slid into the room through the sash, though it was only open an inch wide, just as the Moon herself has often come in through the tiniest crack and has stood be- fore me in all her size and splendor. His voice was weaker, so I moistened his lips with the brandy again, and he continued, but it seemed as though his memory had gone on working in the interval for his story was further advanced.
uz: U qo'lini ko'tarib, ular hammasi to'xtadi va men o'yladimki, u: ` Bularning barchasini senga beraman, ey, ko'p va ko'proq, ko'p yillar davomida, agar sen yerga yiqilib menga sajda qilsang!' deb aytyapti, deb o'yladim. Keyin ko'zlarim ustidan qon rangidagi qizil bulut yopilganidek tuyuldi va nima qilayotganimni bilmasdan oldin, men o'zimni kamarni ochib, Unga: ` Kel, Rabbim va Ustoz! ' deb aytdim.

en: I was about to call him back to the point, but Van Helsing whispered to me, Let him go on.
uz: Men uni gapga chaqirmoqchi edim, lekin Van Helsing menga: O'zini davom ettirsin.

en: Do not in- terrupt him.
uz: Uni qo'rqitmanglar.

en: He cannot go back, and maybe could not proceed at all if once he lost the thread of his thought.
uz: U qaytib ketolmaydi va agar bir marta fikrlash tarzini yo'qotgan bo'lsa, hech qachon davom eta olmaydi.

en: He proceeded, All day I waited to hear from him, but he did not send me anything, not even a blowﬂy, and when the moon got up I was pretty angry with him.
uz: U davom etdi: Men butun kun davomida uning so'zlarini eshitishni kutdim, lekin u menga hech narsa yuborgan emas, hatto uzib yuboradigan ko'pik ham yo'q edi, oy ko'tarilganda esa men unga juda g'azablanardim.

en: When he did slide in through the window, though it was shut, and did not even knock, I got mad with him.
uz: U o'rindiqni yopib qo'ygan bo'lsa-da, hatto taqillatmaganida, men unga g'azablandim.

en: He sneered at me, and his white face looked out of the mist with his red eyes gleaming, and he went on as though he owned the whole place, and I was no one.
uz: U menga masxara qildi, oq ko'zlari bulutdan, qizil ko'zlari parcha-parcha ko'rindi va u hamma joyga ega bo'lgan kabi davom etdi va men hech kim emas edim.

en: He didn't even smell the same as he went by me.
uz: U hatto mendan o'tib ketayotganida ham xuddi shu hidni ko'rmagan.

en: I couldn't hold him.
uz: Men uni ushlab turolmadim.

en: I thought that, somehow, Mrs.
uz: O'zim ham shunday deb o'yladim, xonim.

en: Harker had come into the room. The two men sitting on the bed stood up and came over, standing behind him so that he could not see them, but where they could hear better.
uz: Harker xonaga kirgan edi. Yotoq ustida o'tirgan ikki kishi o'rnidan turib, uning orqasidan kelib, ularni ko'rmasligi uchun, balki eshitishi mumkin bo'lgan joyda turishdi.

en: They were both silent, but the Professor started and quivered.
uz: Ikkalasi ham sukut saqlashdi, lekin professor boshladi va titrab ketdi.

en: His face, however, grew grimmer and sterner still.
uz: Biroq, uning yuzi hali ham ko'p bo'lib, ko'p o'sib borardi.

en: Renﬁeld went on without noticing, When Mrs.
uz: Renfield buni payqamasdan davom etdi: Mrs.

en: Harker came in to see me this afternoon she wasn't the same.
uz: Harker bugun kechqurun meni ko'rishga kelganida, u o'sha-o'sha emas edi.

en: It was like tea after the teapot has been watered. Here we all moved, but no one said a word.
uz: Bu qadoq suvga cho'mgan choy kabi edi. Bu yerda hammamiz harakat qildik, lekin hech kim bir so'z aytmadi.

en: He went on, I didn't know that she was here till she spoke, and she didn't look the same.
uz: U davom etdi: U gapirmaguncha, uning bu yerda ekanligini bilmasdim va u bir xil ko'rinishga ega emas edi.

en: I don't care for the pale people.
uz: Men o'g'ilsiz odamlarga g'amxo'rlik qilmayman.

en: I like them with lots of blood in them, and hers all seemed to have run out.
uz: Menga ular ko'p qon bilan yoqadi va ularning hammasi oxiriga yetgan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: I didn't think of it at the time, but when she went away I began to think, and it made me mad to know that He had been taking the life out of her. I could feel that the rest quivered, as I did.
uz: O'shanda bu haqda o'ylamagan edim, lekin u ketgach, o'ylay boshladim va U undan hayotini olib ketayotganini bilish meni g'azablantirdi.

en: But we remained otherwise still.
uz: Ammo biz boshqa holatlarda ham to'xtab qoldik.

en: So when He came tonight I was ready for Him.
uz: Shunday qilib, U kechasi kelganida, Men U uchun tayyor edim.

en: I saw the mist stealing in, and I grabbed it tight.
uz: Men bulutning kirib kelishini ko'rdim va uni qattiq ushlab qoldim.

en: I had heard that madmen have unnatural strength.
uz: Men aqldan ozganlarning tabiiy kuchga ega emasligini eshitgan edim.

en: And as I knew I was a madman, at times anyhow, I resolved to use my power.
uz: Va men aqldan ozganimni bilardim, shuning uchun ba'zida o'z kuchimdan foydalanishga qaror qildim.

en: Ay, and He felt it too, for He had to come out of the mist to struggle with me.
uz: Ha, U ham buni his qilgan, chunki U men bilan kurashish uchun bulutdan chiqib kelishi kerak edi.

en: I held tight, and I thought I was going to win, for I didn't mean Him to take any more of her life, till I saw His eyes.
uz: Men uni qattiq ushlab turdim va men g'alaba qozonishimni his qildim, chunki Uning ko'zlarini ko'rmagunimcha, Uning hayotidan boshqa hech kimni olib ketishini istamagan edim.

en: They burned into me, and my strength became like water.
uz: Ular ichimda yonib ketdi va kuchim suv kabi bo'ldi.

en: He slipped through it, and when I tried to cling to Him, He raised me up and ﬂung me down.
uz: U o'sha yo'ldan o'tdi va men Unga yopishib turishga harakat qilsam, U meni ko'tarib, yerga tashladi.

en: There was a red cloud before me, and a noise like thunder,and the mist seemed to steal away under the door. His voice was becoming fainter and his breath more stertorous.
uz: Oldimda qizil bulut, momaqaldiroq tovush va eshik ostidagi bulut o'tib ketayotganday tuyuldi. Uning ovozi susayib borayotgandi, nafaslari esa og'irlashib borayotgandi.

en: Van Hels- ing stood up instinctively.
uz: Van Helsing instinktli ravishda turdi.

en: We know the worst now, he said.
uz: Biz endi eng yomonini bilamiz, dedi u.

en: He is here, and we know his pur- pose.
uz: U bu yerda va biz uning maqsadini bilamiz.

en: It may not be too late.
uz: Ehtimol, hali kech emas.

en: Let us be armed, the same as we were the other night, but lose no time, there is not an instant to spare. There was no need to put our fear, nay our conviction, into words, we shared them in common.
uz: O'tgan kechqurun qilganimizdek, qurol-yarog'imizni saqlaylik, lekin vaqtimizni yo'qotmaylik, hech bir daqiqa qolmaydi. Qo'rquvimizni, balki ishonchimizni so'zlarga aylantirishning hojati yo'q edi, biz ularni baham ko'rdik.

en: We all hurried and took from our rooms the same
uz: Hammamiz shoshilib, xonalarimizdan bir xil narsalarni olib qo'ydik.

en: things that we had when we entered the Count's house.
uz: Countning uyiga kirganimizda borgan narsalarimiz.

en: The Professor had his ready, and as we met in the corridor he pointed to them signiﬁcantly as he said, They never leave me, and they shall not till this unhappy business is over.
uz: Professor o'z tayyorligini ko'rsatdi va biz koridorda uchrashganimizda, Ular meni hech qachon tashlab ketmaydilar va bu baxtsiz ish tugaguncha tashlab ketmaydilar.

en: Be wise also, my friends.
uz: Shuningdek, do'stlarim, dono bo'linglar.

en: It is no common enemy that we deal with Alas!
uz: Afsuski, biz Afsus bilan shug'ullanishimiz umumiy dushman emas!

en: That dear Madam Mina should suffer! He stopped, his voice was breaking, and I do not know if rage or terror predominated in my own heart.
uz: Qizim Mina azob chekishi kerak! - dedi u, so'zi buzib, to'xtadi va yuragimda g'azab yoki dahshat hukmronlik qilganini bilmayman.

en: Outside the Harkers' door we paused.
uz: Harkerlar eshigidan tashqari biz to'xtab qoldik.

en: Art and Quincey held back, and the latter said, Should we disturb her? We must, said Van Helsing grimly.
uz: Art va Quincey o'zlarini tiyib, keyinchalik: Biz uni bezovta qilishimiz kerakmi? - deb so'radilar.

en: If the door be locked, I shall break it in. May it not frighten her terribly?
uz: Agar eshik qulflab qo'yilgan bo'lsa, men uni yutqazaman.

en: It is unusual to break into a lady's room! Van Helsing said solemnly, You are always right.
uz: Xotin-qizlarning xonasiga kirish odatiy emas! - dedi Van Helsing tantanali ravishda, Siz har doim to'g'ri.

en: But this is life and death.
uz: Ammo bu hayot va o'lim masalasi.

en: All chambers are alike to the doctor.
uz: Barcha xonalar shifokorga o'xshaydi.

en: And even were they not they are all as one to me tonight.
uz: Va hatto ular bo'lmasa ham, bu kechqurun ular men uchun bir bo'lib qolishadi.

en: Friend John, when I turn the handle, if the door does not open, do you put your shoulder down and shove.
uz: Jon, agar men qo'lni o'chirib, eshik ochilmasa, omoningizni pastga qo'yib, shovqin qiling.

en: And you too, my friends.
uz: Sizlar ham, do'stlarim.

en: Now! He turned the handle as he spoke, but the door did not yield.
uz: Endi! - deb gapirganida, u qo'lni o'zgartirdi, lekin eshik qo'shilib ketmadi.

en: We threw ourselves against it.
uz: Biz unga qarshi o'zimizni tashladik.

en: With a crash it burst open, and we almost fell headlong into the room.
uz: Bir marta u o'zini ochib yubordi va biz deyarli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xonaga tushdik.

en: The Professor did actually fall, and I saw across him as he gathered himself up from hands and knees.
uz: Professor chindan ham yiqildi va men uni ko'rdim, u o'zini qo'l va dizlaridan tiklab turganida.

en: What I saw appalled me.
uz: Ko'rganlarim meni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: I felt my hair rise like bristles on the back of my neck, and my heart seemed to stand still.
uz: Men sochlarimni bo'yniga tosh kabi ko'targanimni his qildim va yuragim to'xtab turgandek tuyuldi.

en: The moonlight was so bright that through the thick yellow blind the room was light enough to see.
uz: Oy yorug'ligi shunchalik yorqin ediki, qalin sariq ko'rgich orqali xona ko'rish uchun etarlicha yorug' edi.

en: On the bed beside the window lay Jonathan Hark- er, his face ﬂushed and breathing heavily as though in a stupor.
uz: Jonatan Harker o'rindiq yonidagi yotoqda, yuzi qizg'inlab, qattiq nafas olib, xuddi g'alati holatda bo'lgani kabi o'tirgan edi.

en: Kneeling on the near edge of the bed facing outwards was the white-clad ﬁgure of his wife.
uz: Yotoqning yaqin chegaralarida tashqi tomonga qaragan bo'lib, uning xotinining oq kiyimli shaxsiyasi tiz cho'kkan edi.

en: By her side stood a tall, thin man, clad in black.
uz: Uning yonida qora kiyim kiygan uzun va chiroyli bir kishi turgan edi.

en: His face was turned from us, but the instant we saw we all recognized the Count, in every way, even to the scar on his forehead.
uz: Uning yuzi bizdan yuz o'girgan edi, lekin biz uni ko'rgan paytimizda hammamiz Countni har tomonlama tan oldik, hatto oldidagi yaragacha.

en: With his left hand he held both Mrs.
uz: O'zining chap qo'li bilan u ikkala xonimni ham ushlab turardi.

en: Hark- er's hands, keeping them away with her arms at full tension.
uz: Hark-erning qo'llarini to'liq g'ayratli qo'llari bilan uzoqlashtiradi.

en: His right hand gripped her by the back of the neck, forcing her face down on his bosom.
uz: Uning o'ng qo'li qizning bo'yni orqasidan ushlab, uning yuzini ko'kraklariga tushirdi.

en: Her white night-dress was smeared with blood, and a thin stream trickled down the man's bare chest which was shown by his torn-open dress.
uz: Uning oq kechki kiyimlari qon bilan to'ldirilgan edi va uning cho'zilib ketgan kiyimidan ko'rinib turgan bechora ko'krakidan kam oq oq oq oq oqib ketdi.

en: The attitude of the two had a terrible resemblance to a child forcing a kitten's nose into a saucer of milk to compel it to drink.
uz: Ikkalasi ham o'z nuqtai nazarini bir bola qushni ichishga majburlash uchun uning burunini sut pishirishiga majburlagan bolaga o'xshatgan.

en: As we burst into the room,
uz: Xonaga kirganimizda,

en: the Count turned his face, and the hellish look that I had heard described seemed to leap into it.
uz: Count yuz o'girdi va men eshitgan jahannam ko'rinishi unga o'xshaydi.

en: His eyes ﬂamed red with devilish passion.
uz: Uning ko'zlari yovuz ishtiyoq bilan qizil rangga to'lgan edi.

en: The great nostrils of the white aquiline nose opened wide and quivered at the edge, and the white sharp teeth, behind the full lips of the blood dripping mouth, clamped together like those of a wild beast.
uz: Oq akvilin burunining katta burunlari keng ochildi va chekkada titrab qoldi, oq o'tkir tishlar esa qon tomiradigan og'izning to'liq og'izlari orqasida yovvoyi hayvonning tishlariga o'xshab bir-biriga yopishib qoldi.

en: With a wrench, which threw his victim back upon the bed as though hurled from a height, he turned and sprang at us.
uz: O'z qurbonini balandlikdan tashlab yuborganidek, uni yotoq ustiga qaytarib qo'ygan kalit bilan u o'zini o'zgartirib, biz tomon o'tib ketdi.

en: But by this time the Professor had gained his feet, and was holding towards him the envelope which contained the Sacred Wafer.
uz: Ammo o'sha paytgacha professor oyoqlarini tiklab, muqaddas vaferni o'ziga olib kelgan qadoqni ushlab turardi.

en: The Count suddenly stopped, just as poor Lucy had done outside the tomb, and cowered back.
uz: Count toʻxtadi, xuddi kambagʻal Luziyning qabrdan tashqariga chiqishi bilan, u orqaga qochib ketdi.

en: Further and further back he cowered, as we, lifting our cruci- ﬁxes, advanced.
uz: U orqaga qaytib, orqaga qolib, biz o'z xochlarimizni ko'tarib, oldinga qadam qo'ygan edik.

en: The moonlight suddenly failed, as a great black cloud sailed across the sky.
uz: Ay nurlari to'satdan to'xtadi, chunki katta qora bulut osmonni bosib o'tdi.

en: And when the gaslight sprang up under Quincey's match, we saw nothing but a faint vapor.
uz: Quinceyning o'yinchisi ostida gaz chiroqlari paydo bo'lganida, biz bir oz buvordan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmadik.

en: This, as we looked, trailed under the door, which with the recoil from its bursting open, had swung back to its old position.
uz: Bu, biz ko'z o'ngimizda turganimizdek, eshikning ostiga tushib ketdi, eshikni ochib yuborganidan keyin u eski joyga qaytdi.

en: Van Helsing, Art, and I moved forward to Mrs.
uz: Van Helsing, Art va men Xonim Van Helsingga murojaat qildik.

en: Harker, who by this time had drawn her breath and with it had given a scream so wild, so ear-piercing, so despairing that it seems to me now that it will ring in my ears till my dying day.
uz: Harker, bu vaqtgacha nafasini chiqarib, o'lim kuniga qadar quloqlarimda o'chirib ketadigan, quloqlarini ochadigan, umidsizlikka tushadigan bir qichqiriq chiqardi.

en: For a few seconds she lay in her helpless attitude and disarray.
uz: Bir necha soniya davomida u o'zining yordamsiz munosabatida va tartibsizlikda yotgan edi.

en: Her face was ghastly, with a pallor which was accentuated by the blood which smeared her lips and cheeks and chin.
uz: Uning yuzi dahshatli edi, uning og'izlari, shavallari va burunlari bo'lgan qon tufayli ko'payib ketgan.

en: From her throat trickled a thin stream of blood.
uz: Uning bo'yniga qon oqib chiqdi.

en: Her eyes were mad with terror.
uz: Uning ko'zlari dahshatga to'lgan edi.

en: Then she put before her face her poor crushed hands, which bore on their whiteness the red mark of the Count's terrible grip, and from behind them came a low deso- late wail which made the terrible scream seem only the quick expression of an endless grief.
uz: So'ngra o'z ko'z oldidan Countning dahshatli qo'li bilan qoplangan qo'llarini qo'ydi va ularning oqligi bilan Countning qo'pol qo'llashining qizil belgisini ko'rsatdi va ularning orqasidan o'sha dahshatli qichqiriq cheksiz qayg'uning tezkor ifodasini ko'rsatdi.

en: Van Helsing stepped forward and drew the coverlet gently over her body, whilst Art, after looking at her face for an instant despairing- ly, ran out of the room.
uz: Van Helsing oldinga qadam qo'yib, qopqoqni jismining ustiga muloyimlik bilan chizib qo'ydi, Art esa bir lahzacha umidsizlikka tushib, uning yuziga qaraganidan so'ng xonadan tashqariga yugurdi.

en: Van Helsing whispered to me, Jonathan is in a stupor such as we know the Vampire can produce.
uz: Van Helsing menga: Jonatan Vampirni ishlab chiqarishi mumkinligini bilamiz, chunki u o'ziga xos hayratda.

en: We can do nothing with poor Madam Mina for a few moments till she recovers herself.
uz: Xotin Mina o'zini sog'aytirmaguncha, bir necha daqiqa davomida biz unga hech narsa qila olmaymiz.

en: I must wake him! He dipped the end of a towel in cold water and with it began to ﬂick him on the face, his wife all the while holding her face between her hands and sobbing in a way that was heart breaking to hear.
uz: Men uni uyg'otishim kerak! - deb toʻlqinni sovuq suvga choʻmdirdi va u bilan uning yuziga teshik qoʻyib, xotini qoʻllari oʻrtasida yuzini ushlab, eshitish uchun yurakni choʻkkan tarzda yigʻlab yubordi.

en: I raised the blind, and looked out of the window.
uz: Ko'rni ko'tarib, darchaga qaradim.

en: There was much moonshine, and as I looked I could see Quincey Morris run across the lawn and hide himself in the shad- ow of a great yew tree.
uz: Ko'p oylar ko'p edi va men Quincey Morrisni ko'rib, o't o't o'rmonidan yugurib, katta bir yva daraxtining soyasida yashiringanini ko'rardim.

en: It puzzled me to think why he was doing this.
uz: Nima uchun u buni qilyapti deb o'ylash meni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: But at the instant I heard Harker's quick exclamation as he woke to partial con-
uz: Ammo o'sha zahoti men Harkerning qisman o'zidan uyg'onayotgan tezkor ovozini eshitdim.

en: sciousness, and turned to the bed.
uz: O'z xatti-harakatini ko'rsatib, o'ziga qarab ketdi.

en: On his face, as there might well be, was a look of wild amazement.
uz: Uning yuzida, ehtimol, vahshiy hayratlanish ko'rinishi bor edi.

en: He seemed dazed for a few seconds, and then full consciousness seemed to burst upon him all at once, and he started up.
uz: U bir necha soniya cho'kkan ko'rinardi, so'ngra to'liq ong birdan uning ustiga burildi va u o'zini qo'lga kiritdi.

en: His wife was aroused by the quick movement, and turned to him with her arms stretched out, as though to embrace him.
uz: Uning xotini tez harakatlanayotganidan hayratda qoldi va uni quchoqlab o'tirgan qo'llarini ko'tarib, unga yaqinlashdi.

en: Instantly, however, she drew them in again, and putting her elbows together, held her hands before her face,and shuddered till the bed beneath her shook.
uz: Biroq, u darhol ularni yana olib kirdi va qo'lqoplarini bir-biriga qo'yib, qo'llarini yuziga qo'yib, yotoq ostidagi yotoq titraguncha titradi.

en: In God's name what does this mean? Harker cried out.
uz: Harker: Alloh nomi bilan bu nimani anglatadi? - deb baqirdi.

en: Van Helsing, what is it?
uz: Van Helsing, nima bo'ldi?

en: Mina, dear what is it?
uz: Mina, azizim, nima bo'ldi?

en: What does that blood mean?
uz: Bu qon nimani anglatadi?

en: Has it come to this! And, raising himself to his knees, he beat his hands wildly together.Good God help us!
uz: Bu shunday bo'ldi-ku! - dedi va tiz cho'kkancha qo'llarini qattiq urdi. Yaxshi Xudo bizga yordam bersin!

en: Oh, help her! With a quick movement he jumped from bed, and began to pull on his clothes, all the man in him awake at the need for instant exertion.
uz: Oh, unga yordam ber! - deb tez harakat qilib, u yotoqdan tushib, kiyimlarini ko'tarib olishiga to'g'ri keldi.

en: Tell me all about it! he cried without pausing.
uz: Bu haqda menga hamma narsani ayting! - deb baqirdi u to'xtamasdan.

en: Van Helsing you love Mina, I know.
uz: Van Helsing, men bilamanki, siz Minani yaxshi ko'rasiz.

en: Oh, do something to save her.
uz: Oh, uni qutqarish uchun biror narsa qiling.

en: It cannot have gone too far yet.
uz: Bu hali juda uzoq bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Guard her while I look for him! His wife, through her terror and horror and distress, saw some sure dan- ger to him.
uz: Men uni qidirayotganimda, uni himoya qiling! xotini uning qo'rquvi, dahshat va qayg'usi tufayli unga xavf solishini ko'rdi.

en: Instantly forgetting her own grief, she seized hold of him and cried out.
uz: O'z qayg'usini darhol unutib, uni qo'lga olib, baqirib yubordi.

en: Jonathan, you must not leave me.
uz: Jonatan, meni tashlab ketmasliging kerak.

en: I have suffered enough tonight, God knows, without the dread of his harming you.
uz: Xudo biladi, bugun kechqurun men etarlicha azob chekdim, lekin u sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan qo'rquvga duch kelmadim.

en: You must stay with me.
uz: Siz men bilan qolishingiz kerak.

en: Stay with these friends who will watch over you! Her expression became frantic as she spoke.
uz: Bu do'stlar bilan qolinglar, ular sizni kuzatib turadilar! - deb gapirganida uning ko'z ko'rinishi g'alati bo'ldi.

en: And, he yielding to her, she pulled him down sitting on the bedside, and clung to him ﬁercely.
uz: U ayolga bo'ysunib, uni to'shagida o'tirgan holda pastga tortib, qattiq ushlab qoldi.

en: Van Helsing and I tried to calm them both.
uz: Van Helsing va men ikkovini ham tinchlantirishga harakat qildik.

en: The Professor held up his golden cruciﬁx, and said with wonderful calmness, Do not fear, my dear.
uz: Professor o'zining oltin xochini ko'tarib, ajoyib xotirjamlik bilan shunday dedi: Xotira qilma, azizim.

en: We are here, and whilst this is close to you no foul thing can approach.
uz: Biz bu yerdamiz va bu sizga yaqin bo'lsa ham, hech qanday yomon narsa unga yaqinlasholmaydi.

en: You are safe for tonight, and we must be calm and take counsel together. She shuddered and was silent, holding down her head on her husband's breast.
uz: Siz bugun kechqurun xavfsizsiz va biz tinch bo'lib, birgalikda maslahatlashishimiz kerak, - deb qo'rqitdi u, boshini erining ko'ksiga qo'yib.

en: When she raised it, his white nightrobe was stained with blood where her lips had touched, and where the thin open wound in the neck had sent forth drops.
uz: U uni ko'targanida, uning oq ko'ylak kiyimlari uning og'izlari tutgan joyda qon bilan to'plandi va bo'ynidagi yomg'ir ochiq yarasi tomchilatib ketdi.

en: The instant she saw it she drew back, with a low wail, and whispered, amidst choking sobs.
uz: Uni ko'rgan zahoti u pastga surib, o'zini qo'zg'atib qo'ydi va qo'ng'iroq qilib yig'ladi.

en: I must touch him or kiss him no more.
uz: Men unga qo'l tegizishim kerak yoki uni yana o'pishmasligim kerak.

en: Oh, that it should be that it is I who am now his worst enemy, and whom he may have most cause to fear.
uz: Oh, hozir uning eng og'ir dushmani men bo'lsam kerak va undan qo'rqishga eng katta sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

en: To this he spoke out resolutely, Nonsense, Mina.
uz: Unga qat'iy javob berib: Bu g'alati gap, Mina.

en: It is a shame to me to hear such a word.
uz: Bunday so'zni eshitish men uchun juda achinarli.

en: I would not hear it of you.
uz: Sizdan buni eshitmayman.

en: And I shall not hear it from you.
uz: Va men buni sizdan eshitmayman.

en: May God judge me by my deserts, and punish me with more bitter suf- fering than even this hour, if by any act or will of mine anything ever come between us! He put out his arms and folded her to his breast.
uz: Xudo meni o'z kamchiliklarimga qarab hukm qilsin va agar mening harakatim yoki irodam tufayli aramizga biror narsa tushsa, meni hatto shu soatda bo'lganidan ham og'irroq azob bilan jazolasin! - deb qo'llarini uzatdi va qizni ko'kraklariga tikdi.

en: And for a while she lay there sobbing.
uz: Va bir muncha vaqt davomida u o'sha yerda yig'lab yotgan edi.

en: He looked at us over her bowed head, with eyes that blinked damply above his quivering nostrils.

uz: Xudo biladi, bugungi kunda eng yaxshisi kerak bo'ladi.

en: I must keep writing at every chance, for I dare not stop to think.
uz: Men har fursatda yozishni davom ettirishim kerak, chunki men o'ylashni to'xtatishga jur'at qilmayman.

en: All, big and little, must go down.
uz: Hammasi, katta va kichik, yerga tushishi kerak.

en: Perhaps at the end the little things may teach us most.
uz: Ehtimol, oxir-oqibat kichik narsalar bizga ko'proq saboq beradi.

en: The teaching, big or little, could not have landed Mina or me anywhere worse than we are today.
uz: O'rgatish, katta yoki kichik bo'lsa-da, Mina yoki meni bugungi kunimizdan yomonroq joyga olib kelishi mumkin emas edi.

en: However, we must trust and hope.
uz: Biroq, biz ishonch va umidga ega bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: Poor Mina told me just now, with the tears running down her dear cheeks, that it is in trou- ble and trial that our faith is tested.
uz: Fosiq Mina menga yaqinda, koʻz yoshlari uning yoqimli yigʻinlaridan oqib, imonimiz sinovdan oʻtishi kerakligini aytdi.

en: That we must keep on trusting, and that God will aid us up to the end.
uz: Biz ishonchimizni saqlab qolishimiz kerak va Xudo bizga oxirigacha yordam beradi.

en: Seward had come back from seeing poor Renﬁeld, we went gravely into what was to be done.
uz: Seward kambag'al Renfieldni ko'rishdan qaytib kelganida, biz nima qilish kerakligini jiddiy muhokama qildik.

en: Seward told us that when he and Dr.
uz: Seward bizga buni o'zi va Drt.

en: Van Helsing had gone down to the room below they had found Renﬁeld lying on the ﬂoor, all in a heap.
uz: Van Helsing pastdagi xonani ko'rganida, Renfieldni yonida to'plamda yotgan holda topdilar.

en: His face was all bruised and crushed in, and the bones of the neck were broken.
uz: Uning yuzi butunlay shikastlangan va cho'kkan edi, bo'yni suyaklari ham sindirib yuborilgan edi.

en: Seward asked the attendant who was on duty in the passage if he had heard anything.
uz: Seward o'tish joyida xizmatda bo'lgan xizmatchilardan biron bir narsa eshitganmi deb so'radi.

en: He said that he had been sitting down, he confessed to half dozing, when he heard loud voices in the room, and then Renﬁeld had called out loudly several times, God!
uz: U o'tirganini aytdi, o'tirganini aytdi, xonada baland ovozlarni eshitganida yarim uyqusini tan oldi va keyin Renfield bir necha marta baland ovoz bilan: Xudo!

en: God! After that there was a sound of falling, and when he entered the room he found him lying on the ﬂoor, face down, just as the doctors had seen him.
uz: Ilohim! - deb so'zlaganidan so'ng, qulab tushish ovozi eshitildi va u xonasiga kirgach, shifokorlar uni ko'rganidek, yuzma-yuz yerga yotgan holda uni topdi.

en: Van Helsing asked if he had heard voices or a voice, and he said he could not say.
uz: Van Helsing sovlar yoki sovni eshitganini so'raganida, u aytishi mumkin emasligini aytdi.

en: That at ﬁrst it had seemed to him as if there were two, but as there was no one in the room it could have been only one.
uz: Boshida unga ikki kishi kabi ko'rindi, lekin xonada hech kim bo'lmaganligi sababli, faqat bittasi bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: He could swear to it, if required, that the word God was spoken by the patient.
uz: Agar kerak bo'lsa, Iloh so'zini bemor aytganini qasam ichishi mumkin edi.

en: Seward said to us, when we were alone, that he did not wish to go into the matter.
uz: Seward biz yolg'iz bo'lganimizda, bu mavzuga aralashishni istamaganini aytdi.

en: The question of an inquest had to be considered, and it would never do to put forward the truth, as no one would believe it.
uz: Tergov masalasi ko'rib chiqilishi kerak edi va hech kim unga ishonmaydigan bo'lgani uchun haqiqatni aytish hech qachon yaroqsiz bo'lmaydi.

en: As it was, he thought that on the attendant's evidence he could give a certiﬁcate of death by misadventure in falling from bed.
uz: O'shanda u, xizmatkorning guvohnomasiga ko'ra, o'lim guvohnomasi berish mumkinligini o'ylagan, chunki u to'sadan tushib o'lgan.

en: In case the coroner should de- mand it, there would be a formal inquest, necessarily to the same result.
