uz: Agar koroner bu ishni bekor qilsa, rasmiy tekshiruv o'tkazilishi kerak bo'ladi, bu esa aynan shu natijaga olib keladi.

en: When the question began to be discussed as to what should be our next step, the very ﬁrst thing we decided was that Mina should be in full conﬁ- dence.
uz: Keyingi qadamimiz nima bo'lishi kerakligi haqida so'rov boshlanganida, biz birinchi navbatda Minaga to'liq ishonch bildirishga qaror qildik.

en: That nothing of any sort, no matter how painful, should be kept from her.
uz: Undan hech narsa, qanchalik og'ir bo'lmasin, yashirilmasligi kerak.

en: She herself agreed as to its wisdom, and it was pitiful to see her so brave and yet so sorrowful, and in such a depth of despair.
uz: Uning donoligiga u o'zi ham rozi bo'ldi va uni shu qadar jasoratli va ammo shu qadar qayg'uli va umidsizlikda ko'rish achinarli edi.

en: There must be no concealment, she said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Qarshilik yo'q bo'lishi kerak.

en: We have had too much already.
uz: Biz allaqachon juda ko'p ichganmiz.

en: And besides there is nothing in all the world that can give me more pain than I have already endured, than I suffer now!
uz: Bundan tashqari, dunyodagi hech narsa menga allaqachon boshdan kechirganimdan ko'ra ko'proq og'riq keltira olmaydigan, hozir azob chekayotganimdan ko'ra ko'proq og'riq keltira olmaydigan narsa emas!

en: Whatever may happen, it must be of new hope or of new courage to me! Van Helsing was looking at her ﬁxedly as she spoke, and said, suddenly but quietly, But dear Madam Mina, are you not afraid.
uz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, bu menga yangi umid yoki yangi jasorat ato etadi! - dedi Van Helsing gapirganida unga tikilib qarab, to'satdan, lekin xotirjamlik bilan: Ammo aziz Xonim Mina, qo'rqmayapsanmi?

en: Not for yourself, but for others from yourself, after what has happened? Her face grew set in its lines, but her eyes shone with the devotion of a martyr as she answered, Ah no!
uz: O'zingiz uchun emas, o'zingizdan boshqalarga, nima bo'lganidan so'ng? - deb o'yladi u. Uning yuzi o'z yo'nalishlarida o'sib bordi, ammo uning ko'zlari shahidning sadoqatidan yorqin bo'lib, u javob berdi: Aha, yo'q!

en: For my mind is made up! To what? he asked gently, whilst we were all very still, for each in our own way we had a sort of vague idea of what she meant.
uz: Chunki mening qarorim tuzilgan! - deb so'radi u xushmuomalalik bilan, biz hammamiz juda tinch edik, chunki har birimiz o'z yo'limizda u nimani nazarda tutayotganini bir xil noaniq tasavvurga ega edik.

en: Her answer came with direct simplicity, as though she was simply stating a fact, Because if I ﬁnd in myself, and I shall watch keenly for it, a sign of harm to any that I love, I shall die! You would not kill yourself? he asked, hoarsely.
uz: Uning javobi soddalik bilan keldi, xuddi u shunchaki bir faktni aytgandek: Agar o'zimda sevganlarimga zarar yetkazadigan belgi topsam, o'laman! - deb so'radi.

en: If there were no friend who loved me, who would save me such a pain, and so desperate an effort! She looked at him meaningly as she spoke.
uz: Agar meni sevadigan do'stim bo'lmaganida, menga shuncha og'riq va shuncha kuch-qudratni qutqargan bo'lar edi! - deb gapirganida u unga mazmunli qarab qo'ydi.

en: He was sitting down, but now he rose and came close to her and put his hand on her head as he said solemnly.
uz: U o'tirgan edi, lekin endi u o'rnidan turib, ayolga yaqinlashib, qo'lini uning boshiga qo'ydi.

en: My child, there is such an one if it were for your good.
uz: O'g'lim, agar bu sen uchun bo'lsa, shunday bir narsa bor.

en: For myself I could hold it in my account with God to ﬁnd such an euthanasia for you, even at this moment if it were best.
uz: O'zim uchun, agar eng yaxshi bo'lgan bo'lsa, hozir ham siz uchun bunday eutanasiya topishni Xudo oldida hisob-kitob qilishim mumkin edi.

en: But my child …  For a moment he seemed choked, and a great sob rose in his throat.
uz: Lekin mening bola...  Bir zumda u cho'kkan ko'rindi va uning bo'yniga katta yig'ish ko'tarildi.

en: He gulped it down and went on, There are here some who would stand be- tween you and death.
uz: U uni yutib qo'ydi va davom etdi: Bu yerda siz bilan o'lim o'rtasida turadiganlar bor.

en: You must not die by any hand, but
uz: Siz hech qanday qo'lda o'lishingiz mumkin emas, lekin

en: least of all your own.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda o'zingizning o'zingizning.

en: Until the other, who has fouled your sweet life, is true dead you must not die.
uz: Sizning go'zal hayotingizni buzgan boshqa kishi o'lgunga qadar siz o'lmasligingiz kerak.

en: For if he is still with the quick Undead, your death would make you even as he is.
uz: Agar u hali ham tez o'lganlar bilan birga bo'lsa, o'limingiz sizni o'zi kabi qiladi.

en: You must struggle and strive to live, though death would seem a boon unspeakable.
uz: Hayot uchun kurashish va kurashish kerak, ammo o'lim so'zlab bo'lmaydigan baraka kabi tuyuladi.

en: You must ﬁght Death himself, though he come to you in pain or in joy.
uz: Siz o'limga qarshi kurashishingiz kerak, garchi u sizga og'riq yoki quvonch bilan kelsa ham.

en: By the day, or the night, in safety or in peril!
uz: Kun yoki kechasi, xavfsizlikda yoki xavfsizlikda!

en: On your living soul I charge you that you do not die.
uz: Hayotli joningiz haqi, siz o'lmasligingizni buyuraman.

en: Nay, nor think of death, till this great evil be past. The poor dear grew white as death, and shook and shivered, as I have seen a quicksand shake and shiver at the incoming of the tide.
uz: Yo'q, bu buyuk yovuzlik o'tmaguncha o'lim haqida o'ylamang, - deb aytdi. Bu kambag'al kishi o'limga o'xshaydigan oq bo'lib, shovqin va titrashga to'g'ri keldi, chunki men quvib turgan qumni to'lqin kelganda shovqin va titrashga to'g'ri kelayotganini ko'rdim.

en: We could do nothing.
uz: Biz hech narsa qila olmadik.

en: At length she grew more calm and turning to him said sweetly, but oh so sorrowfully, as she held out her hand, I promise you, my dear friend, that if God will let me live, I shall strive to do so.
uz: Oxir oqibat u tinchlanib, uning yoniga qaytib: Agar Xudo meni tirik qoldirsa, shunday qilishga harakat qilaman, - deb vaʼda beraman, aziz doʻstim, - dedi.

en: Till, if it may be in His good time, this horror may have passed away from me. She was so good and brave that we all felt that our hearts were strength- ened to work and endure for her, and we began to discuss what we were to do.
uz: U shunchalik yaxshi va jasoratli bo'lganki, hammamiz o'z yuraklarimiz uning uchun mehnat qilish va chidash uchun kuch topganini his qildik va nima qilishimiz kerakligini muhokama qila boshladik.

en: I told her that she was to have all the papers in the safe, and all the pa- pers or diaries and phonographs we might hereafter use, and was to keep the record as she had done before.
uz: Men unga barcha qog'ozlarni, keyinchalik ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha qog'ozlarni, kundalik kitoblarni va fonograflarni saqlab qolishi kerakligini va avvalgidek yozuvlarni saqlashi kerakligini aytdim.

en: She was pleased with the prospect of anything to do, if pleased could be used in connection with so grim an interest.
uz: U biron bir ish qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganidan mamnun edi, agar mamnun so'zini bunday ayanchli qiziqish bilan bog'liq holda qo'llash mumkin bo'lsa.

en: As usual Van Helsing had thought ahead of everyone else, and was pre- pared with an exact ordering of our work.
uz: Odatdagidek, Van Helsing hammadan ilgari fikr yuritib, bizning ishimizning aniq tartibiga ega bo'ldi.

en: It is perhaps well, he said, that at our meeting after our visit to Carfax we decided not to do anything with the earth boxes that lay there.
uz: U shunday dedi: Agar shunday bo'lsa-da, Carfaksga tashrif buyurganimizdan keyin o'tkazilgan uchrashuvimizda u yerda joylashgan tuproq qutilarga hech narsa qilmaslikka qaror qildik.

en: Had we done so, the Count must have guessed our purpose, and would doubtless have taken measures in advance to frustrate such an effort with regard to the others.
uz: Agar shunday qilgan bo'lsak, Count bizning maqsadimizni bilgan bo'lishi kerak va shubhasiz, boshqalarga nisbatan bunday harakatni to'xtatish uchun oldindan choralar ko'rgan bo'lardi.

en: But now he does not know our intentions.
uz: Ammo hozir u bizning niyatlarimizni bilmaydi.

en: Nay, more, in all probabil- ity, he does not know that such a power exists to us as can sterilize his lairs, so that he cannot use them as of old.
uz: Aksincha, u, ehtimol, o'z qo'riqxonalarini sterillashtiradigan kuch borligini bilmaydi, shuning uchun u ularni qadimgi kabi ishlatishi mumkin emas.

en: We are now so much further advanced in our knowledge as to their dis- position that, when we have examined the house in Piccadilly, we may track the very last of them.
uz: Biz hozir ularning nuqtai nazarini bilishda shunchalik ilg'ormizki, Piccadillydagi uyni ko'rib chiqqanimizda, ularning oxirgilarini izlashimiz mumkin.

en: Today then, is ours, and in it rests our hope.
uz: Shunday qilib, bugun bizning kunimiz va umidimiz shu kunda.

en: The sun that rose on our sorrow this morning guards us in its course.
uz: Bugun ertalab qayg'ularimiz ustida ko'tarilgan quyosh bizni o'z yo'lida himoya qiladi.

en: Until it sets tonight, that monster must retain whatever form he now has.
uz: Bugun kechki kun boshlangunga qadar, bu jondor hozirgi shaklini saqlab qolishi kerak.

en: He is conﬁned within the limitations of his earthly envelope.
uz: U yer yuzidagi o'z qadoqining cheklovlari doirasida cheklangan.

en: He cannot melt into thin air nor disappear through cracks or chinks or crannies.
uz: U havoga erishi mumkin emas, buzilib ketishi ham mumkin emas, buzilib ketishi ham mumkin emas, buzilib ketishi ham mumkin emas.

en: If he go through a door- way, he must open the door like a mortal.
uz: Agar u eshikdan o'tsa, u eshikni o'lik kabi ochishi kerak.

en: And so we have this day to hunt
uz: Shunday qilib, ov qilish uchun bu kun bor.

en: out all his lairs and sterilize them.
uz: barcha o'rindiqlarini chiqarib, sterillashtiring.

en: So we shall, if we have not yet catch him and destroy him, drive him to bay in some place where the catching and the destroying shall be, in time, sure. Here I started up for I could not contain myself at the thought that the minutes and seconds so preciously laden with Mina's life and happiness were ﬂying from us, since whilst we talked action was impossible.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar hali uni tutib, yo'q qilmasak, uni vaqt o'tib tutib olish va yo'q qilish aniq bo'ladigan joyga olib ketamiz. Men bu erda boshladim, chunki Minaning hayoti va baxt bilan to'ldirilgan o'zimni o'zimning o'ylaymanki, o'zimni o'zimdan ushlab turolmayman, chunki biz gapirganimizda harakat imkonsiz edi.

en: But Van Helsing held up his hand warningly.
uz: Ammo Van Helsing qo'lini ogohlantiruvchi tarzda ko'tardi.

en: Nay, friend Jonathan, he said, in this, the quickest way home is the longest way, so your proverb say.
uz: - Yo'q, do'stim Jonatan, - dedi u, - bu yerda uyga eng tez yo'l - eng uzoq yo'l, deyish mumkin.

en: We shall all act and act with desperate quick, when the time has come.
uz: Vaqt kelganda, barchamiz harakat qilamiz va juda tez harakat qilamiz.

en: But think, in all probable the key of the sit- uation is in that house in Piccadilly.
uz: Ammo bir o'ylab ko'ring, vaziyatning kaliti Piccadillydagi uyda bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The Count may have many houses which he has bought.
uz: Countning o'zi sotib olgan ko'plab uylari bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Of them he will have deeds of purchase, keys and oth- er things.
uz: Ulardan sotib olish hujjatlari, kalitlar va boshqa narsalar bor.

en: He will have paper that he write on.
uz: U yozadigan qog'ozga ega bo'ladi.

en: He will have his book of cheques.
uz: Uning cheklar kitobi bor.

en: There are many belongings that he must have somewhere.
uz: Uning bir joyda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan ko'plab mol-mulki bor.

en: Why not in this place so central, so quiet, where he come and go by the front or the back at all hours, when in the very vast of the trafﬁc there is none to no- tice.
uz: Nima uchun bu o'ta markazda, shu qadar xotirjam joyda, u har soat ichida oldidan yoki orqa tomondan o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan joyda, juda keng trafikda hech narsa yo'q bo'lganida.

en: We shall go there and search that house.
uz: Biz u yerga borib, u uyni qidiramiz.

en: And when we learn what it holds, then we do what our friend Arthur call, in his phrases of hunt `stop the earths' and so we run down our old fox, so?
uz: Va biz u nimaga ega ekanini bilib olgach, do'stimiz Artur o'zining ovlash `stop the earth' degan iborasida nima deb ataganini qilamiz va shu sababli biz eski tilkamizni bosib o'tamiz, shundaymi?

en: Is it not? Then let us come at once, I cried, we are wasting the precious, pre- cious time! The Professor did not move, but simply said, And how are we to get into that house in Piccadilly? Any way! I cried.
uz: O'shanda kelinglar, darhol kelinglar, - dedim men, biz qimmatbaho, qimmatbaho vaqtni isrof qilyapmiz! - Professor harakatlanmadi, balki shunchaki: Pikadillidagi uyiga qanday kiramiz? - deb so'radi.

en: We shall break in if need be. And your police?
uz: Agar kerak bo'lsa, biz kiramiz.Va sizning politsiya?

en: Where will they be, and what will they say? I was staggered, but I knew that if he wished to delay he had a good rea- son for it.
uz: Ular qayerda bo'ladilar va nima deyishadi? - deb hayron qoldim, ammo agar u kechiktirishni istasa, buning yaxshi natijasi borligini bilardim.

en: So I said, as quietly as I could, Don't wait more than need be.
uz: Shunday qilib, men imkon qadar xotirjamlik bilan: Munofiq bo'lganidan ko'proq kutmang.

en: You know, I am sure, what torture I am in. Ah, my child, that I do.
uz: Bilasizmi, men qanday azob chekayotganimdan shubhalanaman.

en: And indeed there is no wish of me to add to your anguish.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, men sizlarning qayg'u-alamlaringizni ko'paytirishni istamayman.

en: But just think, what can we do, until all the world be at move- ment.
uz: Ammo butun dunyo harakatlanmaguncha, nima qilishimiz mumkinligini o'ylab ko'ring.

en: Then will come our time.
uz: Keyin bizning vaqtimiz keladi.

en: I have thought and thought, and it seems to me that the simplest way is the best of all.
uz: Men o'yladim va o'yladim va menga eng sodda yo'l eng yaxshi yo'l deb o'xshaydi.

en: Now we wish to get into the house, but we have no key.
uz: Endi biz uyga kirishni xohlaymiz, ammo kalitimiz yo'q.

en: Is it not so?I nodded.
uz: Shunday emasmi? - dedim men boshimni egib.

en: Now suppose that you were, in truth, the owner of that house, and could not still get in.
uz: Agar siz o'sha uyning egasi bo'lsangiz-da, lekin hali ham kirolmayapsiz.

en: And think there was to you no conscience of the housebreak- er, what would you do?
uz: Va sizda uyni buzganlarning vijdoni yo'q deb o'ylaysiz, nima qilasiz?

en: I should get a respectable locksmith, and set him to work to pick the lock for me. And your police, they would interfere, would they not? Oh no!
uz: Men hurmatli qulluqchini topib, u menga qulluqni olish uchun ishlashi kerak edi. Va sizning politsiyangiz, ular aralashib ketishardi, shunday emasmi? O'h, yo'q!

en: Not if they knew the man was properly employed. Then, he looked at me as keenly as he spoke, all that is in doubt is the conscience of the employer, and the belief of your policemen as to whether or not that employer has a good conscience or a bad one.
uz: Agar ular bu odamning to'g'ri ishlashi haqida bilsalar, yo'q. Shuning uchun, - dedi u menga gapirganida, barchasi ish beruvchining vijdoni va sizning politsiyachilaringizning vijdoni yaxshi yoki yomon bo'lishiga ishonishidir.

en: Your police must indeed be zealous men and clever, oh so clever, in reading the heart, that they trouble themselves in such matter.
uz: Sizning politsiyachilaringiz chindan ham g'ayratli va aqlli odamlar bo'lishi kerak, qalbni o'rganishda juda aqlli bo'lishlari kerak, shuning uchun ular bunday masalalarda o'zlarini bezovta qilishadi.

en: No, no, my friend Jonathan, you go take the lock off a hundred empty houses in this your London, or of any city in the world, and if you do it as such things are rightly done, and at the time such things are rightly done, no one will interfere.
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, do'stim Jonatan, siz borib, bu sizning Londondagi yoki dunyoning boshqa shaharidagi yuzlab bo'sh uylarning qulfini olib tashlang va agar bunday ishlar to'g'ri bajarilgan bo'lsa, va bunday ishlar to'g'ri bajarilgan paytda hech kim aralasha olmaydi.

en: I have read of a gentle- man who owned a so ﬁne house in London, and when he went for months of summer to Switzerland and lock up his house, some burglar come and broke window at back and got in.
uz: Londondagi bunday chiroyli uyga ega bo'lgan bir odam haqida o'qigan edim va u yozgi oylar davomida Shveytsariyaga borganida va uyini qulflab qo'yganida, bir qaroqchi kelib, orqa tomonidagi derazni buzdi va kirdi.

en: Then he went and made open the shutters in front and walk out and in through the door, before the very eyes of the police.
uz: So'ngra u borib, oldingi choriqlarni ochib, politsiya ko'z o'ngida eshikdan chiqib kirdi.

en: Then he have an auction in that house, and advertise it, and put up big notice.
uz: Keyin u uyda savdo o'tkazadi, reklama qiladi va katta e'lon qiladi.

en: And when the day come he sell off by a great auctioneer all the goods of that other man who own them.
uz: Va kun kelganda, u boshqa odamning barcha mol-mulkini katta auksionchi tomonidan sotadi.

en: Then he go to a builder, and he sell him that house, making an agreement that he pull it down and take all away within a certain time.
uz: Keyin u quruvchiga borib, u uyni unga sotadi va u uyni yo'q qilib, muayyan vaqt ichida olib ketishi to'g'risida kelishuvga erishadi.

en: And your police and other authority help him all they can.
uz: Va sizning politsiya va boshqa hukumatlar unga qo'lidan kelganicha yordam berishadi.

en: And when that owner come back from his holiday in Switzerland he ﬁnd only an empty hole where his house had been.
uz: O'sha mulkdor Shveytsariyada ta'tildan qaytganida, u uyida faqatgina bo'sh bo'lgan cho'g'ni topdi.

en: This was all done en re- gle, and in our work we shall be en regle too.
uz: Bularning barchasi diqqat bilan amalga oshirildi va bizning ishimizda ham tartibga solinadi.

en: We shall not go so early that the policemen who have then little to think of, shall deem it strange.
uz: Biz shunchalik erta ketmaymizki, o'sha paytda o'ylashga kam vaqt bo'lgan politsiyachilar buni g'alati deb bilishadi.

en: But we shall go after ten o'clock, when there are many about, and such things would be done were we indeed owners of the house. I could not but see how right he was and the terrible despair of Mina's face became relaxed in thought.
uz: Lekin biz o'n soatdan keyin ketamiz, chunki bu erda ko'p odamlar bor va agar biz uy egasi bo'lsak, bunday ishlar amalga oshiriladi. Men uning qanchalik to'g'ri ekanligini ko'rmas edim va Mina yuzidagi dahshatli umidsizlik fikrda xotirjam bo'ldi.

en: There was hope in such good counsel.
uz: Bunday yaxshi maslahatda umid bor edi.

en: Van Helsing went on, When once within that house we may ﬁnd more clues.
uz: Van Helsing davom etdi: O'sha uy ichida bo'lganimizda, biz ko'proq izlarni topishimiz mumkin.

en: At any rate some of us can remain there whilst the rest ﬁnd the other places where there be more earth boxes, at Bermondsey and Mile End. Lord Godalming stood up.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, ba'zilarimiz u yerda qolishimiz mumkin, qolganlari esa Bermondsey va Mile Endda yer qutisi ko'proq bo'lgan boshqa joylarni topishlari mumkin. - dedi Lord Godalming.

en: I can be of some use here, he said.
uz: Men bu yerda foydali bo'lishim mumkin, dedi u.

en: I shall wire to my people to have horses and carriages where they will be most convenient. Look here, old fellow, said Morris, it is a capital idea to have all ready in case we want to go horse backing, but don't you think that one of your
uz: Men odamlarimga ot va aravalarga eng qulay joyda ega bo'lishlarini xabar beraman. - dedi Morris. - Qarang, keksa, agar biz otni qo'llab-quvvatlashni istasak, hamma narsani tayyorlab qo'yish juda yaxshi fikr, lekin siz o'ylamayapsizmi?

en: snappy carriages with its heraldic adornments in a byway of Walworth or Mile End would attract too much attention for our purpose?
uz: Walworth yoki Mile End yo'nalishida o'zlarining heraldik ziynatlari bo'lgan chiroyli vagonlar bizning maqsadimiz uchun juda ko'p e'tiborni jalb qiladimi?

en: It seems to me that we ought to take cabs when we go south or east.
uz: O'ylaymanki, janubiy yoki sharqiy yo'lga borganimizda taksiga o'tishimiz kerak.

en: And even leave them somewhere near the neighborhood we are going to. Friend Quincey is right! said the Professor.
uz: Hatto biz borayotgan mehmonxona yaqinida ularni qoldiring. - Dost Quincey haqli! dedi professor.

en: His head is what you call in plane with the horizon.
uz: Uning boshi siz horizont bilan samolyotda nima deb ataysiz.

en: It is a difﬁcult thing that we go to do, and we do not want no peoples to watch us if so it may. Mina took a growing interest in everything and I was rejoiced to see that the exigency of affairs was helping her to forget for a time the terrible expe- rience of the night.
uz: Bu biz qilayotgan qiyin ishdir va biz hech kim bizni kuzatib turishini istamaymiz. Mina har bir narsaga katta qiziqish ko'rsatdi va men ishlarning og'irligi uning kechaning dahshatli tajribasini biroz unutishiga yordam berayotganini ko'rib xursand bo'ldim.

en: She was very, very pale, almost ghastly, and so thin that her lips were drawn away, showing her teeth in somewhat of prominence.
uz: U juda, juda soya edi, deyarli dahshatli va shunchalik chiroyli ediki, uning og'izlari o'ziga jalb bo'lib, o'z tishlarini ko'rsatdi.

en: I did not mention this last, lest it should give her needless pain, but it made my blood run cold in my veins to think of what had occurred with poor Lucy when the Count had sucked her blood.
uz: Men bu so'nggi gapni aytmadim, chunki bu unga keraksiz og'riq keltirishi mumkin edi, lekin Count uning qonini sug'organida kambag'al Lucy bilan nima sodir bo'lganini o'ylash menga jonimdan sovuq chiqardi.

en: As yet there was no sign of the teeth growing sharper, but the time as yet was short, and there was time for fear.
uz: Hattoki tishlar keskinlashib borayotganidan hech qanday alomat yo'q edi, ammo vaqt hali qisqa edi va qo'rquv uchun vaqt bor edi.

en: When we came to the discussion of the sequence of our efforts and of the disposition of our forces, there were new sources of doubt.
uz: Bizning harakatlarimizning ketma-ketligi va kuchlarimizning joylashuvi to'g'risida suhbatga kelganimizda, yangi shubha manbai paydo bo'ldi.

en: It was ﬁnally agreed that before starting for Piccadilly we should destroy the Count's lair close at hand.
uz: Nihoyat, Piccadillyga yo'l olishdan oldin, Countning yashirovchasini yaqin atrofda yo'q qilish kerakligi to'g'risida kelishuvga erishildi.

en: In case he should ﬁnd it out too soon, we should thus be still ahead of him in our work of destruction.
uz: Agar U buni juda tezda bilsa, biz ham o'zimizdan o'zimiz oldinda bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: And his presence in his purely ma- terial shape, and at his weakest, might give us some new clue.
uz: Va uning chindan ham moddiy shaklida va eng zaif holatda hozir bo'lishi bizga yangi iz izoh berishi mumkin.

en: As to the disposal of forces, it was suggested by the Professor that, after our visit to Carfax, we should all enter the house in Piccadilly.
uz: Kuchlarni yo'q qilish masalasiga kelsak, professor Carfaksga tashrif buyurganimizdan so'ng, Piccadillydagi uyga kirishimiz kerakligini aytdi.

en: That the two doctors and I should remain there, whilst Lord Godalming and Quincey found the lairs at Walworth and Mile End and destroyed them.
uz: Ikki shifokor va men o'sha yerda qolishimiz kerak, Lord Godalming va Quincey esa Walworth va Mile Endda yashayotgan maydonlarni topib, ularni yo'q qilishlari kerak.

en: It was possi- ble, if not likely, the Professor urged, that the Count might appear in Pic- cadilly during the day, and that if so we might be able to cope with him then and there.
uz: Professorning aytishicha, ehtimol, agar ehtimol bo'lmasa, Count kun davomida Pic-cadilly-da paydo bo'lishi mumkin va agar shunday bo'lsa, biz u erda va u erda u bilan shug'ullanishimiz mumkin.

en: At any rate, we might be able to follow him in force.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, biz uni kuzatib borishga qodir bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: To this plan I strenuously objected, and so far as my going was concerned, for I said that I intended to stay and protect Mina.
uz: Men bu rejasiga qat'iy qarshilik ko'rdim va o'tishimga qaramay, Men o'zimni o'sha yerda qoldirib, Minani himoya qilishni rejalashtirganimni aytdim.

en: I thought that my mind was made up on the subject, but Mina would not listen to my objection.
uz: Men bu mavzuda qarorimni chiqarganimni his qildim, lekin Mina mening e'tirozimni eshitmadi.

en: She said that there might be some law matter in which I could be useful.
uz: U, men foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan qonuniy masalalar bo'lishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: That amongst the Count's papers might be some clue which I could understand out of my ex- perience in Transylvania.
uz: Countning hujjatlari orasida Transilvaniyadagi o'tmish tajribamdan tushunib yetadigan ba'zi bir iz izohlar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And that, as it was, all the strength we could muster was required to cope with the Count's extraordinary power.
uz: Va shunga o'xshab, Countning ajoyib qudratiga qarshi turish uchun biz qo'limizdan kelgan barcha kuch kerak edi.

en: give in, for Mina's resolution was ﬁxed.
uz: Menga qo'shiling, chunki Minaning qarorini hal qildim.

en: She said that it was the last hope for her that we should all work together.
uz: Uning aytishicha, barchamiz birgalikda ishlasak, bu uning so'nggi umidi edi.

en: As for me, she said, I have no fear.
uz: Men esa qo'rqmayman.

en: Things have been as bad as they can be.
uz: Vaziyatlar imkon qadar yomon bo'lgan.

en: And whatever may happen must have in it some element of hope or comfort.
uz: Va nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u erda umid yoki tasalli elementlari bo'lishi kerak.

en: God can, if He wishes it, guard me as well alone as with any one present. So I started up crying out, Then in God's name let us come at once, for we are losing time.
uz: Agar U xohlasa, Xudo meni yolg'iz ham, hozir bo'lgan har bir kishi bilan ham himoya qila oladi. Shunday qilib, men: Albatta, Xudoning ismi bilan kelinglar, chunki biz vaqtni yo'qotmoqdamiz.

en: The Count may come to Piccadilly earlier than we think. Not so! said Van Helsing, holding up his hand.
uz: Count biz o'ylagandan ham tezroq Piccadillyga kelishi mumkin. - Yo'q! - dedi Van Helsing qo'lini ko'tarib.

en: Do you forget, he said, with actually a smile, that last night he ban- queted heavily, and will sleep late? Did I forget!
uz: O'sha kecha u juda ko'p o'tirganini va kechagacha uxlayotganini unutib qo'ydingmi? - dedi u tabassum bilan.

en: Shall I ever … can I ever!
uz: Men hech qachon... men hech qachon qila olamanmi!

en: Can any of us ever forget that ter- rible scene!
uz: O'sha dahshatli voqeani hech birimiz unutib o'tmaymizmi?

en: Mina struggled hard to keep her brave countenance, but the pain overmastered her and she put her hands before her face, and shuddered whilst she moaned.
uz: Mina jasoratli ko'rinishini saqlab qolish uchun kurashdi, lekin og'riq uni yengib, qo'llarini yuziga ko'tardi va o'z ko'nglini tishlab, g'azablanayotganda titragan.

en: Van Helsing had not intended to recall her frightful ex- perience.
uz: Van Helsing o'zining dahshatli o'tmish tajribasini esga olishni xohlamagan edi.

en: He had simply lost sight of her and her part in the affair in his in- tellectual effort.
uz: U shunchaki uni va uning bu ishda ishtirok etishini ko'zdan kechirdi.

en: When it struck him what he said, he was horriﬁed at his thoughtlessness and tried to comfort her.
uz: Uning so'zlari unga qattiq ta'sir qilganda, uning befarqligidan qo'rqib, uni tasalli berishga harakat qildi.

en: Oh, Madam Mina, he said,dear, dear, Madam Mina, alas!
uz: Oh, Xonim Mina, dedi u, qizim, qizim, Xonim Mina, vay bo'lsin!

en: That I of all who so reverence you should have said anything so forgetful.
uz: Sizni juda hurmat qiladigan barcha odamlardan men bunday unutgan gapni aytishim kerak edi.

en: These stupid old lips of mine and this stupid old head do not deserve so, but you will for- get it, will you not? He bent low beside her as he spoke.
uz: Mening bu ahmoqona eski dudam va bu ahmoqona eski boshim bunga loyiq emas, lekin siz buni o'zingizga topsangiz bo'ladi, shunday emasmi? - deb so'zlaganida u ayolning yonida tiz cho'kdi.

en: She took his hand, and looking at him through her tears, said hoarsely, No, I shall not forget, for it is well that I remember.
uz: Uning qo'lidan ushlab, ko'z yoshlari bilan unga qaragan ayol: Yo'q, men unutmayman, chunki men yaxshi eslayman.

en: And with it I have so much in memory of you that is sweet, that I take it all together.
uz: Va men siz haqingizda juda ko'p yaxshi xotiralarga ega bo'lganim uchun, bularning barchasini birlashtiraman.

en: Now, you must all be going soon.
uz: Endi hammangiz yaqinda ketishingiz kerak.

en: Breakfast is ready, and we must all eat that we may be strong. Breakfast was a strange meal to us all.
uz: Ertalabki ovqat tayyor bo'ldi va barchamiz kuchli bo'lish uchun ovqatlanishimiz kerak. Ertalabki ovqat barchamiz uchun g'alati ovqat edi.

en: We tried to be cheerful and en- courage each other, and Mina was the brightest and most cheerful of us.
uz: Biz bir-birimizga quvonch va dalda berishga harakat qilardik va Mina bizlardan eng aqlli va quvonchli edi.

en: When it was over, Van Helsing stood up and said, Now, my dear friends, we go forth to our terrible enterprise.
uz: Ish tugagach, Van Helsing o'rnidan turib dedi: Hndi, aziz do'stlarim, biz o'z dahshatli ishimizga qadam bosamiz.

en: Are we all armed, as we were on that night when ﬁrst we visited our enemy's lair.
uz: Biz hammamiz dushmanimizning g'oyibasiga ilk bor tashrif buyurgan kecha bo'lganimizdek qurol-yarog'li bo'lyapmizmi?

en: Armed against ghostly as well as carnal attack? We all assured him.
uz: Havo va tana hujumlariga qarshi qurollanganmi? - deb ta'kidladik. Hammamiz unga ishontirdik.

en: Now, Madam Mina, you are in any case quite safe here until the sunset.
uz: Mana, xonim Mina, quyosh botguncha siz bu yerda xavfsizsiz.

en: And before then we shall return … if … We shall return!
uz: Va undan oldin biz qaytib boramiz... agar... qaytib boramiz!

en: But before we go let me see you armed against personal attack.
uz: Ammo ketishdan oldin, sizni shaxsiy hujumga qarshi qurol bilan qurollangan holda ko'rishimga ruxsat bering.

en: I have my- self, since you came down, prepared your chamber by the placing of things of which we know, so that He may not enter.
uz: Sen tushgandan beri, biz bilgan narsalarni joylashtirish orqali xonadoningni tayyorlab qo'yganman, shuning uchun U kirmaydi.

en: Now let me guard yourself.
uz: Endi o'zingni qo'riqlayman.

en: On your forehead I touch this piece of Sacred Wafer in the name of the Fa- ther, the Son, and … There was a fearful scream which almost froze our hearts to hear.
uz: Sening oldingda Men Otamiz, Oʻgʻil nomidan muqaddas vaferning bu qismiga qoʻl tegizyapman va... eshitish uchun qalblarimizni deyarli toʻgʻrilaydigan qoʻrqinchli qichqiriq eshitildi.

en: As he had placed the Wafer on Mina's forehead, it had seared it … had burned into the ﬂesh as though it had been a piece of whitehot metal.
uz: U Waferni Minaning maʼbadining old tomonida qoʻyganida, u oʻzidan-oʻzidan yondirildi... xuddi oq metall boʻlgani kabi goʻshtga oʻxshaydi.

en: My poor darling's brain had told her the signiﬁcance of the fact as quickly as her nerves re- ceived the pain of it, and the two so overwhelmed her that her overwrought nature had its voice in that dreadful scream.
uz: Qizimning miyasi uning og'ir og'rig'ini tan olganida, uning miyasi bu gapning ahamiyatini tezda o'z ichiga olganini aytdi va ikkalasi uni shunchalik ovora qildilarki, uning o'ziga xos qiynalgan tabiati o'sha dahshatli qichqirishda o'z ovozini qo'zg'atdi.

en: But the words to her thought came quickly.
uz: Ammo uning fikrlariga javoblar tez kelib qoldi.

en: The echo of the scream had not ceased to ring on the air when there came the reaction, and she sank on her knees on the ﬂoor in an agony of abasement.
uz: Qichqiriqning o'z-o'zidan so'ng havonda tovushni to'xtatmagan edi va u yerga tiz cho'kib, kamtarlik azobidan azob chekdi.

en: Pulling her beautiful hair over her face, as the leper of old his mantle, she wailed out.
uz: O'zining go'zal sochlarini yuziga ko'tarib, o'zining eski ko'ylagini ko'tarib, u yig'lab yubordi.

en: Even the Almighty shuns my polluted ﬂesh!
uz: Hatto Qodir Tangri mening ifloslanayotgan tanamdan qochadi!

en: I must bear this mark of shame upon my forehead until the Judgement Day. They all paused.
uz: Qiyomat kunigacha peshanamda bu sharmandalik belgisini ko'tarib turishim kerak, - deb so'radilar.

en: I had thrown myself beside her in an agony of helpless grief, and putting my arms around held her tight.
uz: Men o'zimni yordamsiz qayg'u azobida uning yonida tashlab qo'ydim va qo'llarimni o'girib, uni qattiq ushlab turdim.

en: For a few minutes our sor- rowful hearts beat together, whilst the friends around us turned away their eyes that ran tears silently.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida qayg'urgan yuraklarimiz bir-biriga urib, atrofdagi do'stlarimiz ko'zlarini chalg'itib, ko'z yoshlarini sukut saqlashdi.

en: Then Van Helsing turned and said gravely.
uz: Keyin Van Helsing yuz o'girib, jiddiy javob berdi.

en: So gravely that I could not help feeling that he was in some way inspired, and was stating things outside himself.
uz: O'zimni juda jiddiy his qilganim uchun, u bir yo'l bilan ilhomlantirilgan va o'zidan tashqarida gapirganini his qila oldim.

en: It may be that you may have to bear that mark till God himself see ﬁt, as He most surely shall, on the Judgement Day, to redress all wrongs of the earth and of His children that He has placed thereon.
uz: Ehtimol, Alloh O'zi qiyomat kunida yer yuzidagi barcha adolatsizliklarni va U yer yuzida o'rnatgan farzandlarining barcha yomonliklarini bartaraf etadigan bo'lgani kabi, siz ham bu belgiga ega bo'lishingiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And oh, Madam Mina, my dear, my dear, may we who love you be there to see, when that red scar, the sign of God's knowledge of what has been, shall pass away, and leave your forehead as pure as the heart we know.
uz: Oh, Mina xonim, azizim, azizim, biz sizni sevganlar, o'sha qizil yara o'tib ketayotganini ko'rish uchun boraylik, chunki bu Xudoning o'tmishni bilish belgisi bo'lib, oldingiz biz bilgan yurak kabi sof bo'lib qoladi.

en: For so surely as we live, that scar shall pass away when God sees right to lift the burden that is hard upon us.
uz: Chunki biz yashayotganda, Xudo biz uchun og'ir bo'lgan og'irlikni olib tashlashni haqli deb bilganda, bu yara o'tib ketadi.

en: Till then we bear our Cross, as His Son did in obedience to His Will.
uz: O'sha paytgacha biz o'z Xochimizni, Uning O'g'li O'z irodasini bajarganidek, ko'tarib turamiz.

en: It may be that we are chosen instruments of His good pleasure, and that we ascend to His bidding as that other through stripes and shame.
uz: Ehtimol, biz Uning roziligi uchun tanlangan asboblar bo'lib, azob-uqubat va sharmandalik orqali Uning amrlariga o'zimiz kabi ko'tarilishimiz mumkin.

en: Through tears and blood.
uz: Ko'z yoshlari va qon orqali.

en: Through doubts and fear, and all that makes the difference between God and man.
uz: Shubhasizlik va qo'rquv orqali va Xudo va inson o'rtasidagi farqni yaratadigan hamma narsa orqali.

en: There was hope in his words, and comfort.
uz: Uning so'zlarida umid va tasalli bor edi.

en: And they made for resigna- tion.
uz: Va ular iste'foga chiqishni talab qilishdi.

en: Mina and I both felt so, and simultaneously we each took one of the old man's hands and bent over and kissed it.
uz: Mina va men ikkovimiz ham shunday his qildik va bir vaqtning o'zida biz har birimiz keksa odamning qo'lidan birini olib, egib o'pdik.

en: Then without a word we all knelt down together, and all holding hands, swore to be true to each other.
uz: So'ngra so'zsiz hammamiz tiz cho'kib, qo'l tutdik va bir-birimizga sodiq qolishga qasam ichdik.

en: We men pledged ourselves to raise the veil of sorrow from the head of her whom, each in his own way, we loved.
uz: Biz erkaklar o'z yo'limizda sevgan ayolning boshidan qayg'u qoplamasini olib tashlashga va'da berdik.

en: And we prayed for help and guid- ance in the terrible task which lay before us.
uz: Va biz oldimizda turgan dahshatli ishda yordam va yo'l-yo'riq so'rab ibodat qildik.

en: It was then time to start.
uz: O'shanda boshlash vaqti keldi.

en: So I said farewell to Mina, a parting which neither of us shall forget to our dying day, and we set out.
uz: Shunday qilib, men Mina bilan xayrlashdim va o'lim kunimizgacha hech birimiz unutib qo'ymaymiz.

en: To one thing I have made up my mind.
uz: Bir narsa haqida o'yladim.

en: If we ﬁnd out that Mina must be a vampire in the end, then she shall not go into that unknown and terrible land alone.
uz: Agar Mina oxir-oqibat vampir bo'lishi kerakligini bilsak, u yolg'iz o'sha noma'lum va dahshatli yurtga bormaydi.

en: I suppose it is thus that in old times one vampire meant many.
uz: Ehtimol, qadimda bitta vampir ko'pchilikni anglatardi.

en: Just as their hideous bodies could only rest in sacred earth, so the holiest love was the recruiting sergeant for their ghastly ranks.
uz: Ularning dahshatli tanasi faqat muqaddas yerda dam olishlari mumkin bo'lganidek, eng muqaddas sevgi ularning dahshatli darajalari uchun harbiy xizmatni o'tkazgan serjant edi.

en: We entered Carfax without trouble and found all things the same as on the ﬁrst occasion.
uz: Biz Carfaksga bezovta kirdik va hamma narsa birinchi martagidek topdik.

en: It was hard to believe that amongst so prosaic surround- ings of neglect and dust and decay there was any ground for such fear as already we knew.
uz: Biz allaqachon bilganidek, beparvolik, tuproq va buzuqlikning shu qadar ko'ngilsizlikli muhitida bunday qo'rquvga asos borligiga ishonish qiyin edi.

en: Had not our minds been made up, and had there not been terrible memories to spur us on, we could hardly have proceeded with our task.
uz: Agar qarorimiz qabul qilinmagan bo'lganida va bizni rag'batlantiradigan dahshatli xotiralar bo'lmaganida, biz o'z vazifamizni bajarishga imkonimiz bo'lmagan bo'lardi.

en: We found no papers, or any sign of use in the house.
uz: Uyda hech qanday qog'oz yoki foydalanish belgisi topilmadi.

en: And in the old chapel the great boxes looked just as we had seen them last.
uz: Eski chapelda katta qutilar biz ularni oxirgi marta ko'rganimizdek ko'rinardi.

en: Van Helsing said to us solemnly as we stood before him, And now, my friends, we have a duty here to do.
uz: Biz uning oldida turganimizda, Van Helsing bizga tantanali ravishda shunday dedi: Va endi, do'stlarim, bu yerda bajarishimiz kerak bo'lgan vazifamiz bor.

en: We must sterilize this earth, so sa- cred of holy memories, that he has brought from a far distant land for such fell use.
uz: Biz bu yerni, u uzoq yurtdan olib kelgan muqaddas xotiralar kabi, sterillashtirishimiz kerak.

en: He has chosen this earth because it has been holy.
uz: U bu yerni muqaddas bo'lgani uchun tanladi.

en: Thus we defeat him with his own weapon, for we make it more holy still.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz uni o'z qurollari bilan mag'lub qilamiz, chunki biz uni yanada muqaddas qilamiz.

en: It was sanctiﬁed to such use of man, now we sanctify it to God. As he spoke he took from his bag a screwdriver and a wrench, and very soon the top of one of the cases was thrown open.
uz: Bu insonlar uchun muqaddas bo'lgan, endi biz uni Xudoga muqaddas qilamiz. U gapirganida, sumkasidan burchak aylanuvchisi va kalitini olib ketdi va tez orada bir qadoqning yuqori qismini ochib tashladi.

en: The earth smelled musty and close, but we did not somehow seem to mind, for our attention was concentrated on the Professor.
uz: Yerning hidini ko'targan va yaqinlashgan, ammo biz hech qanday muammon bo'lmagan edik, chunki diqqatimiz professorga qaratilgan edi.

en: Taking from his box a piece of the Scared Wafer he laid it reverently on the earth, and then shutting down the lid be- gan to screw it home, we aiding him as he worked.
uz: O'zining qutisidan qo'rqqan vaferning bir qismini olib, u hurmat ila yerga qo'ydi, so'ngra qopqoqni yopib, uyga to'xtab yuboradi, biz esa unga yordam beramiz, chunki u ishlaydi.

en: One by one we treated in the same way each of the great boxes, and left them as we had found them to all appearance.
uz: Biz katta qutilarni bir-birimiz bilan bir xil tarzda ko'rib chiqardik va ularni qanday topgan bo'lsak, shunday qoldirardik.

en: But in each was a portion of the Host.
uz: Ammo har birida uy egasining bir qismi bor edi.

en: When we closed the door behind us, the Professor said solemnly, So much is already done.
uz: Biz orqaga eshikni yopganimizda, professor tantanali ravishda shunday dedi: O'sha qadar ishlar allaqachon amalga oshirilgan.

en: It may be that with all the others we can be so
uz: Ehtimol, boshqalarning hammasi bilan birga biz ham shunday bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: successful, then the sunset of this evening may shine of Madam Mina's forehead all white as ivory and with no stain! As we passed across the lawn on our way to the station to catch our train we could see the front of the asylum.
uz: Agar bu kechqurun quyosh botishi muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa, Mina xonimning peshanasi ko'ylak kabi oq va hech qanday leksiz bo'lishi mumkin! Biz poyezdga o'tish uchun poyezdga borayotganda gazondan o'tib ketayotganimizda, biz boshpana oldini ko'rishimiz mumkin edi.

en: I looked eagerly, and in the window of my own room saw Mina.
uz: O'zimning xonamning derazasida Mina ko'rganimni juda xohladim.

en: I waved my hand to her, and nodded to tell that our work there was successfully accomplished.
uz: Men unga qo'limni tikib, o'sha yerda qilgan ishimiz muvaffaqiyatli bajarilganini aytish uchun boshimni tiydim.

en: She nodded in reply to show that she understood.
uz: O'zi tushunayotganini ko'rsatish uchun u javobda bosh ko'tardi.

en: The last I saw, she was waving her hand in farewell.
uz: So'nggi bor ko'rganimda, u qo'lidan salom so'rab, qo'lini o'chirib qo'ydi.

en: It was with a heavy heart that we sought the station and just caught the train, which was steaming in as we reached the platform.
uz: Biz cho'qqizga yetib borganimizda, poyezdni o'rab olish uchun og'ir yurak bilan poyezdni qidirdik.

en: I have written this in the train.
uz: Men buni poezdda yozganman.

en: Piccadilly, 12:30 o'clock.—Just before we reached Fenchurch Street Lord Godalming said to me, Quincey and I will ﬁnd a locksmith.
uz: Piccadilly, 12:30 da.Fenchurch ko'chasiga yetib kelishdan oldin Lord Godalming menga shunday dedi: Qinsey va men qulfchi topamiz.

en: You had better not come with us in case there should be any difﬁculty.
uz: Qiyinchiliklar bo'lmasligi uchun biz bilan kelmasangiz yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: For under the cir- cumstances it wouldn't seem so bad for us to break into an empty house.
uz: Chunki bunday sharoitlarda bo'sh uyga kirish shunchalik yomon ko'rinmaydi.

en: But you are a solicitor and the Incorporated Law Society might tell you that you should have known better. I demurred as to my not sharing any danger even of odium, but he went on, Besides, it will attract less attention if there are not too many of us.
uz: Ammo siz advokatsiz va korporativ huquq jamiyati sizga yaxshiroq bilishingiz kerakligini aytishi mumkin.Men hatto nafrat xavfini ham o'z ichiga olmaganligimni aytdim, ammo u davom etdi: Agar biz ko'p bo'lmasak, bu kamroq e'tiborni jalb qiladi.

en: My title will make it all right with the locksmith, and with any policeman that may come along.
uz: Mening unvonim qulog'chiga va kelishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday politsiyachiga yaxshilik qiladi.

en: You had better go with Jack and the Professor and stay in the Green Park.
uz: Siz Jek va professor bilan birga borib, yashil bog'da qolsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi.

en: Somewhere in sight of the house, and when you see the door opened and the smith has gone away, do you all come across.
uz: Uyning ko'rinmas joyida, eshik ochilganini ko'rib, quruvchi yo'qolganini ko'rsangiz, hammangiz uchrashasizmi?

en: We shall be on the lookout for you, and shall let you in. The advice is good! said Van Helsing, so we said no more.
uz: Biz sizlarni kuzatib turamiz va sizlarni ichkariga qo'yib yuboramiz. - Bo'ysunish yaxshi! - dedi Van Helsing, shuning uchun biz boshqa hech narsa aytmadik.

en: Godalming and Morris hurried off in a cab, we following in another.
uz: Godalming va Morris bir taksiga tushdi, biz boshqa taksiga tushdik.

en: At the corner of Arlington Street our contingent got out and strolled into the Green Park.
uz: Arlington ko'chasining burchagida bizning kontingentimiz chiqib, Green Parkga yurdi.

en: My heart beat as I saw the house on which so much of our hope was centered, looming up grim and silent in its deserted condition amongst its more lively and spruce-looking neighbors.
uz: Umidimizning ko'p qismini o'z ichiga olgan uyni ko'rib, yuragim urib ketdi, u o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq jonli va chiroyli ko'rinadigan qo'shnilar orasida chiroyli va xotirjamliksiz holda ko'rinardi.

en: We sat down on a bench within good view , and began to smoke cigars so as to attract as little attention as possible.
uz: Biz yaxshi ko'rinishda bo'lgan bankda o'tirib, iloji boricha kamroq e'tiborni jalb qilish uchun sigaretalar chekishni boshladik.

en: The minutes seemed to pass with leaden feet as we waited for the coming of the others.
uz: Boshqalar kelishini kutganimizda, minutlar o'tib ketayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: At length we saw a four-wheeler drive up.
uz: Vaqt o'tib biz to'rtta g'ildirakli mashinani ko'rdik.

en: Out of it, in leisurely fashion, got Lord Godalming and Morris.
uz: Undan Lord Godalming va Morris o'zlarini qulay tarzda olib chiqdilar.

en: And down from the box descended a thick-set working man with his rush-woven basket of tools.
uz: Qutuqdan pastga o'zining shov-shuv bilan to'qilgan asbob-uskunalar koshi bilan to'liq ishlab chiqaradigan ishchi tushdi.

en: Morris paid the cabman, who touched his hat and drove away.
uz: Morris taksi haydovchisiga pul to'ladi, u uning to'pasiga qo'l tegizib, mashinadan ketadi.

en: Together the two ascended the steps, and Lord Godalming pointed out what he wanted done.
uz: Ikkalasi ham qo'shiqlarni ko'tarishdi va Lord Godalming o'zi nima qilishni xohlayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: workman took off his coat leisurely and hung it on one of the spikes of the rail, saying something to a policeman who just then sauntered along.
uz: Ishchi o'z ko'ylagini sekin-sakin olib, temir yo'lning bir bo'g'iga osib qo'ydi va politsiyachiga biror narsa aytdi.

en: The policeman nodded acquiescence, and the man kneeling down placed his bag beside him.
uz: Politsiya boshligʻi oʻzini qoʻzgʻatdi va erkak kishi tiz choʻkkancha sumkasini yonida qoʻydi.

en: After searching through it, he took out a selection of tools which he proceeded to lay beside him in orderly fashion.
uz: Uni o'rgangandan so'ng, u o'z yonida to'g'ri tartib bilan qo'yilgan asbob-uskunalar to'plamini olib chiqdi.

en: Then he stood up, looked in the keyhole, blew into it, and turning to his employers, made some remark.
uz: So'ngra o'rnidan turib, eshikni ko'rdi, unga pufladi va ish beruvchilariga murojaat qilib, ba'zi fikrlarni aytdi.

en: Lord Godalming smiled, and the man lifted a good sized bunch of keys.
uz: Lord Godalming tabassum qildi va u yaxshi o'lchamli kalitlarni ko'tardi.

en: Selecting one of them, he began to probe the lock, as if feel- ing his way with it.
uz: Ulardan birini tanlab, qulfni o'rganishni boshladi, xuddi u bilan o'z yo'lini o'tkazgandek.

en: After fumbling about for a bit he tried a second, and then a third.
uz: Bir oz o'tirganidan so'ng, u ikkinchi, so'ngra uchinchi marta sinab ko'rdi.

en: All at once the door opened under a slight push from him, and he and the two others entered the hall.
uz: Darhol uning qo'lidan biroz quvg'in tushib, eshik ochildi va u boshqa ikki kishi bilan birga zalga kirdi.

en: My own cigar burnt furi- ously, but Van Helsing's went cold altogether.
uz: Mening o'zimning sigaram g'azabga to'lgan, lekin Van Helsingning sigarasi butunlay sovuq bo'ldi.

en: We waited patiently as we saw the workman come out and bring his bag.
uz: Biz ishchi o'z sumkasini olib chiqishini ko'rib, sabr-toqat bilan kutdik.

en: Then he held the door partly open, steadying it with his knees, whilst he ﬁtted a key to the lock.
uz: Keyin u eshikni qisman ochib, tiz cho'kib qo'ydi va qulfga kalit qo'ydi.

en: This he ﬁnally handed to Lord Godalming, who took out his purse and gave him something.
uz: Nihoyat, u buni Lord Godalmingga berdi, Lord esa uning sumkasini olib, unga bir narsa berdi.

en: The man touched his hat, took his bag, put on his coat and de- parted.
uz: O'sha kishi uning to'pasiga qo'l tegizdi, sumkasini olib, kiyimini kiydirdi va ketib ketdi.

en: Not a soul took the slightest notice of the whole transaction.
uz: Hech bir jon butun operatsiya haqida hech qanday g'amxo'rlik qilmadi.

en: When the man had fairly gone, we three crossed the street and knocked at the door.
uz: O'sha kishi o'tib ketgach, uchimiz ko'chadan o'tib, eshikni taqillatdik.

en: It was immediately opened by Quincey Morris, beside whom stood Lord Godalming lighting a cigar.
uz: U darhol Quincey Morris tomonidan ochildi, uning yonida Lord Godalming sigari yonayotgan edi.

en: The place smells so vilely, said the latter as we came in.
uz: Bu joy juda yomon hidlaydi, - dedi u, biz kirganimizda.

en: It did indeed smell vilely.
uz: Haqiqatan ham bu yomon hidni his qilgan.

en: Like the old chapel at Carfax.
uz: Karfaksdagi eski kapella kabi.

en: And with our previous experi- ence it was plain to us that the Count had been using the place pretty freely.
uz: O'tgan tajribamizga ko'ra, hidoyatchi o'sha joydan juda erkin foydalanayotganini aniq ko'rdik.

en: We moved to explore the house, all keeping together in case of attack, for we knew we had a strong and wily enemy to deal with, and as yet we did not know whether the Count might not be in the house.
uz: Uyni o'rganish uchun ko'chib o'tdik, hujum bo'lsa ham, hammamiz bir joyda turdik, chunki biz kuchli va hiylasiz dushman borligini bilardik va hidoyatchi uyda bo'lmasligini hali bilmas edik.

en: In the dining room, which lay at the back of the hall, we found eight box- es of earth.
uz: Zalning orqasida joylashgan oshxonada sakkiz quti yerni topdik.

en: Eight boxes only out of the nine which we sought!
uz: Biz qidirgan to'qqizta qutidan faqat sakkiz quti!

en: Our work was not over, and would never be until we should have found the missing box.
uz: Bizning ishimiz tugamaydi va hech qachon tugamaydi, chunki yo'qolgan qutini topishimiz kerak edi.

en: First we opened the shutters of the window which looked out across a narrow stone ﬂagged yard at the blank face of a stable, pointed to look like the front of a miniature house.
uz: Avval biz darcha chiroqlarini ochdik, u kichkina toshga mo'ljallangan hovli orqali cho'ponning bo'sh yuzida ko'rinadi, bu esa miniatur uyning old tomonini ko'rsatadi.

en: There were no windows in it, so we were not afraid of being overlooked.
uz: U yerda derazalar yo'q edi, shuning uchun biz e'tiborsiz qolishdan qo'rqmadik.

en: We did not lose any time in examining the chests.
uz: Biz ko'kraklarni tekshirishda hech qanday vaqtni yo'qotmadik.

en: With the tools which we had brought with us we opened them, one by one, and treated them as we had treated those others in the old chapel.
uz: Biz o'zimiz bilan olib kelgan asboblar bilan ularni bittadan ochib, eski chapeldagi boshqalarga qanday munosabatda bo'lgan bo'lsak, ularga ham shunday munosabatda bo'ldik.

en: was evident to us that the Count was not at present in the house, and we proceeded to search for any of his effects.
uz: Konti uyda yo'qligi bizga aniq ko'rindi va biz uning ta'sirini qidirishga kirdik.

en: After a cursory glance at the rest of the rooms, from basement to attic, we came to the conclusion that the dining room contained any effects which might belong to the Count.
uz: Bodrumdan ustungacha bo'lgan xonadonlarning qolgan qismini ko'rib chiqqanimizdan so'ng, ovqatxonada Countga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ta'sirlar mavjudligi to'g'risida xulosaga keldik.

en: And so we proceeded to minutely examine them.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz ularni sinchkovlik bilan ko'rib chiqdik.

en: They lay in a sort of orderly disorder on the great dining room table.
uz: Ular katta oshxonadagi stolda tartibsiz holatda o'tirgan.

en: There were title deeds of the Piccadilly house in a great bundle, deeds of the purchase of the houses at Mile End and Bermondsey, notepaper, en- velopes, and pens and ink.
uz: U yerda Piccadilly uyining katta to'plamdagi mulk hujjatlari, Mile End va Bermondseydagi uylarni sotib olish hujjatlari, qog'oz, shkaflar, qalam va momaqaldir.

en: All were covered up in thin wrapping paper to keep them from the dust.
uz: Ularning barchasi changdan saqlanishi uchun kamroq qadoq qog'oz bilan qoplangan edi.

en: There were also a clothes brush, a brush and comb, and a jug and basin.
uz: Bundan tashqari, kiyimlar pinchasi, pinch va kamir, qozon va idish bor edi.

en: The latter containing dirty water which was red- dened as if with blood.
uz: Bu suvda qon kabi qizil suv bor edi.

en: Last of all was a little heap of keys of all sorts and sizes, probably those belonging to the other houses.
uz: Va nihoyat, turli xil va o'lchamli kalitlar to'plami bor edi, ehtimol boshqa uylarga tegishli bo'lgan kalitlar.

en: When we had examined this last ﬁnd, Lord Godalming and Quincey Morris taking accurate notes of the various addresses of the houses in the East and the South, took with them the keys in a great bunch, and set out to destroy the boxes in these places.
uz: Ushbu so'nggi topinishni o'rganib chiqqanimizda, Lord Godalming va Quincey Morris Sharq va Janubiy hududlardagi uylarning turli manzillarini aniq yozib olishdi, kalitlarni ko'plab olib, bu joylardagi qutilarni yo'q qilishga harakat qilishdi.

en: The rest of us are, with what patience we can, waiting their return, or the coming of the Count.
uz: Qolganlarimiz qancha sabr-toqat qilsak, ularning qaytib kelishini yoki Countning kelishini kutyapmiz.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 3 October.—The time seemed teribly long whilst we were waiting for the coming of Godalming and Quincey Morris.
uz: Godalming va Quincey Morrisning kelishini kutganimizda vaqt juda uzoq ko'rinardi.

en: The Professor tried to keep our minds active by using them all the time.
uz: Professor ongimizni har doim ishlatish orqali faol saqlashga harakat qildi.

en: I could see his beneﬁcent purpose, by the side glances which he threw from time to time at Harker.
uz: Harkerga vaqti-vaqti bilan ko'rsatgan ko'z ko'rinishlaridan uning mehribon niyatini ko'rardim.

en: The poor fellow is overwhelmed in a misery that is appalling to see.
uz: Bu kambag'al odam ko'rish uchun dahshatli bo'lgan azob-uqubatlarga duchor bo'ldi.

en: Last night he was a frank, happy-looking man, with strong, youthful face, full of energy, and with dark brown hair.
uz: O'tgan kecha u ochiq, baxtli ko'rinadigan, kuchli, yoshlik yuzi, kuch-quvvatga to'la va qorong'u qora qora sochli odam edi.

en: Today he is a drawn, haggard old man, whose white hair matches well with the hollow burning eyes and griefwritten lines of his face.
uz: Bugungi kunda u rasm chizgan, ko'ngilli keksa odam bo'lib, oq sochlari yuzidagi yoritilgan ko'zlar va qayg'u chiziqlariga to'g'ri keladi.

en: His energy is still intact.
uz: Uning energiyasi hali ham mustahkam.

en: In fact, he is like a living ﬂame.
uz: Darhaqiqat, u tirik olovga o'xshaydi.

en: This may yet be his salvation, for if all go well, it will tide him over the despair- ing period.
uz: Ehtimol, bu uning qutqaruvchisi bo'lishi mumkin, chunki agar hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lsa, bu umidsizlik davrida uni to'ldiradi.

en: He will then, in a kind of way, wake again to the realities of life.
uz: Shunda u qaysidir ma'noda hayotning haqiqatlariga qaytadi.

en: Poor fellow, I thought my own trouble was bad enough, but his … !
uz: Yomon odam, men o'zimning muammolarim yetarlicha yomon deb o'ylardim, lekin uning ... !

en: The Professor knows this well enough, and is doing his best to keep his mind active.
uz: Professor buni yaxshi biladi va ongini faol saqlash uchun qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilmoqda.

en: What he has been saying was, under the circumstances, of ab- sorbing interest.
uz: Uning aytganlari, hozirgi sharoitlarda, qiziqish uyg'otadi.

en: So well as I can remember, here it is: I have studied, over and over again since they came into my hands, all the papers relating to this monster, and the more I have studied, the greater seems the necessity to utterly stamp him out.
uz: Xotiralarimdan ko'rinib turganidek, bu yerda shunday yozilgan: Men bu jondor bilan bog'liq barcha hujjatlarni o'rganib chiqdim, ular qo'limga kelganidan beri qayta-qayta o'rganib chiqdim va qancha ko'proq o'rgansam, uni butunlay yo'q qilish zarurligi shunchalik katta bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: All through there are signs of his advance.
uz: Har tarafda uning oldinga borayotganining belgilari bor.

en: Not only of his power, but of his knowledge of it.
uz: Faqatgina uning qudrati emas, balki uning bilimidir.

en: As I learned from the researches of my friend Arminius of Buda-Pesth, he was in life a most wonderful man.
uz: Do'stim Buda-Pestdan bo'lgan Arminiusning izlanishlaridan bilib oldimki, u hayotda juda ajoyib odam edi.

en: Soldier, statesman, and alchemist.
uz: Askar, davlatshunos va alkimyachi.

en: Which latter was the highest development of the science knowledge of his time.
uz: Bu o'z davridagi ilm-fan bilimlarining eng yuqori rivojlanishi edi.

en: He had a mighty brain, a learning beyond compare, and a heart that knew no fear and no remorse.
uz: U kuchli miyaga, o'rganish kuchiga ega bo'lib, qo'rquv va afsus-nadomatni bilmaydigan yurakga ega edi.

en: He dared even to attend the Scholomance, and there was no branch of knowledge of his time that he did not essay.
uz: U hatto Scholomancega borishga ham jur'at etgan va o'z davridagi bilimlarning hech bir shoxidan u o'qimasdi.

en: Well, in him the brain powers survived the physical death.
uz: Unda miyaning kuchlari jismoniy o'limdan omon qolgan.

en: Though it would seem that memory was not all complete.
uz: Garchi bu xotira butunlay to'liq bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da.

en: In some faculties of mind
uz: Ba'zi fikrlash fakultetlarida

en: he has been, and is, only a child.
uz: U bola edi va hozir ham bola.

en: But he is growing, and some things that were childish at the ﬁrst are now of man's stature.
uz: Ammo u o'sib bormoqda va boshida bolalik bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar endi insonning o'rnagiga aylandi.

en: He is experimenting, and doing it well.
uz: U tajriba o'tkazmoqda va buni yaxshi o'tkazmoqda.

en: And if it had not been that we have crossed his path he would be yet, he may be yet if we fail, the father or furtherer of a new order of be- ings, whose road must lead through Death, not Life. Harker groaned and said, And this is all arrayed against my darling!
uz: Agar biz uning yo'lidan o'tmagan bo'lsak, u hali ham, agar biz muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasak ham, o'z yo'li hayot emas, balki o'lim orqali o'tishi kerak bo'lgan yangi mavjudotlarning otasi yoki qo'shnovi bo'lishi mumkin.

en: But how is he experimenting?
uz: Ammo u qanday tajriba o'tkazmoqda?

en: The knowledge may help us to defeat him! He has all along, since his coming, been trying his power, slowly but surely.
uz: Bilim unga g'alaba qozonishga yordam berishi mumkin! U kelganidan beri, asta-sekin, lekin qat'iy ravishda o'z kuchini sinab ko'rmoqda.

en: That big child-brain of his is working.
uz: Uning katta bola miyasi ishlayapti.

en: Well for us, it is as yet, a child-brain.
uz: Biz uchun bu hali ham bola miyasi.

en: For had he dared, at the ﬁrst, to attempt certain things he would long ago have been beyond our power.
uz: Chunki agar u boshida ba'zi narsalarni sinab ko'rishga jur'at qilganida, u ancha vaqt oldin bizning kuchimizdan o'tgan bo'lar edi.

en: However, he means to succeed, and a man who has centuries before him can afford to wait and to go slow.
uz: Biroq, u muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishni xohlaydi va undan asrlar oldingi odam kutishga va sekin harakat qilishga qodir.

en: Fes- tina lente may well be his motto. I fail to understand, said Harker wearily.
uz: Shuni aytish joizki, shuni aytish mumkinki, shunda uning mottolari bor. Men buni tushunmayapman, - dedi Harker charchagan holda.

en: Oh, do be more plain to me!
uz: Oh, menga aniqroq aytgin!

en: Perhaps grief and trouble are dulling my brain. The Professor laid his hand tenderly on his shoulder as he spoke, Ah, my child, I will be plain.
uz: Ehtimol, qayg'u va muammolar mening miyamni so'ndirmoqda.Professor o'z qo'lini yelkasiga qo'yib, gapirganida: A, bola, men aniq bo'laman.

en: Do you not see how, of late, this monster has been creeping into knowledge experimentally.
uz: Ko'ryapsizmi, oxirgi kunlarda bu haykal bilimga tajriba bilan kirib bormoqda.

en: How he has been making use of the zoophagous patient to effect his entry into friend John's home.
uz: Qanday qilib u zoofag kasalligidan foydalanib, do'sti Jonning uyiga kirishni amalga oshirgan.

en: For your Vampire, though in all afterwards he can come when and how he will, must at the ﬁrst make entry only when asked thereto by an inmate.
uz: Sizning Vampiringiz uchun, keyinchalik u qachon va qanday kelishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, birinchi navbatda faqat mahbus tomonidan so'rashganida kirishi kerak.

en: But these are not his most important experiments.
uz: Ammo bu uning eng muhim tajribalari emas.

en: Do we not see how at the ﬁrst all these so great boxes were moved by others.
uz: Birinchidan, bu katta qutilarni boshqalar qanday o'tkazganini ko'rmayapmizmi?

en: He knew not then but that must be so.
uz: O'shanda u buni bilmasdi, ammo bu shunday bo'lishi kerak.

en: But all the time that so great child-brain of his was growing, and he began to consider whether he might not himself move the box.
uz: Ammo o'sha vaqt davomida uning o'ta buyuk bola-mohiyasi o'sib borayotgan edi va u o'zi qutini o'zi ko'chirib o'tishi mumkinmi deb o'ylay boshladi.

en: So he began to help.
uz: Shunday qilib, u yordam berishni boshladi.

en: And then, when he found that this be all right, he try to move them all alone.
uz: Keyin, bu yaxshi ekanligini bilganida, ularni yolg'iz o'tkazishga harakat qiladi.

en: And so he progress, and he scatter these graves of him.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'zidan oldingi qadamlar qo'yib, o'z qabrini tarqatadi.

en: And none but he know where they are hidden.
uz: Ular qayerda yashirilganini Undan boshqa hech kim bilmaydi.

en: He may have intend to bury them deep in the ground.
uz: Ehtimol, u ularni chuqur yerga ko'mishni niyat qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: So that only he use them in the night, or at such time as he can change his form, they do him equal well, and none may know these are his hiding place!
uz: Ular uni faqat kechasi yoki shaklini o'zgartiradigan vaqtda ishlatishi uchun, ular unga teng darajada yaxshi ish qiladi va hech kim bularning uning yashirin joyini bilmasligi mumkin!

en: But, my child, do not despair, this knowledge came to him just too late!
uz: Ammo, farzandim, umidsizlikka tushmang, bu bilim unga juda kech keldi!

en: Already all of his lairs but one be sterilize as for him.
uz: Uning barcha qovushlari, biridan tashqari, u uchun sterilizatsiya qilingan.

en: And before the sunset this shall be so.
uz: Quyosh botishidan oldin bu shunday bo'ladi.

en: Then he have no place where he can move and hide.
uz: Shunday qilib, uning ko'chib o'tishi va yashira olishi mumkin bo'lgan joyi yo'q.

en: I delayed this morning that so we might be sure.
uz: Men buni bugun ertalab qoldirdim, shuning uchun biz shubhalanishimiz mumkin.

en: Is there not more at stake for us than for him?
uz: Biz uchun u uchun emas, balki biz uchun ko'proq xavf tug'dirilmaydimi?

en: Then why not be more careful than him?
uz: Xo'sh, nima uchun undan ko'ra ehtiyotkor bo'lmasligingiz kerak?

en: By my clock it is one hour and already, if all be well, friend Arthur and Quincey are on their way to us.
uz: Mening soatimga ko'ra, bir soat o'tdi va agar hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lsa, do'stim Artur va Quincey biz tomon yo'lda.

en: Today is our day, and we must go sure, if slow, and lose no chance.
uz: Bugun bizning kunimizdir va biz qat'iy va sekin harakat qilib, hech qanday imkoniyatni yo'qotmasligimiz kerak.

en: There are ﬁve of us when those absent ones return. Whilst we were speaking we were startled by a knock at the hall door, the double postman's knock of the telegraph boy.
uz: O'sha yo'q kishilar qaytib kelganda, biz besh kishiga aylanamiz. Biz gapirganimizda, chodir eshikini taqillatgan, telegraf yigitining ikki martalik pochtachi taqillatganidan hayratda qoldik.

en: We all moved out to the hall with one impulse, and Van Helsing, holding up his hand to us to keep si- lence, stepped to the door and opened it.
uz: Hammamiz bitta impuls bilan zalga chiqdik va Van Helsing, tinchlikni saqlash uchun qo'lini ko'tarib, eshikga qadam bosdi va eshikni ochdi.

en: The boy handed in a dispatch.
uz: O'g'il despatchni berdi.

en: The Professor closed the door again, and after looking at the direction, opened it and read aloud.
uz: Professor eshikni yana yopdi va yo'nalishga qaraganidan so'ng uni ochdi va baland ovoz bilan o'qidi.

en: He has just now, 12:45, come from Carfax hurriedly and hastened towards the South.
uz: U yaqinda, 12:45 da, Carfaxdan shoshilinch kelib, Janubiy tomonga bordi.

en: He seems to be going the round and may want to see you: Mina. There was a pause, broken by Jonathan Harker's voice, Now, God be thanked, we shall soon meet! Van Helsing turned to him quickly and said, God will act in His own way and time.
uz: U atrofga borayotganga o'xshaydi va sizni ko'rmoqchi bo'lishi mumkin: Mina. Jonatan Harkerning ovozi bilan kesilgan to'xtatish bo'lib o'tdi: Hndi Xudoga shukr, yaqinda uchrashamiz! Van Helsing unga tezda qarab: Xudo O'z yo'lida va O'z vaqtida harakat qiladi.

en: Do not fear, and do not rejoice as yet.
uz: Hndi qo'rqmanglar, xursand bo'lmanglar.

en: For what we wish for at the moment may be our own undoings. I care for nothing now, he answered hotly, except to wipe out this brute from the face of creation.
uz: Chunki biz hozirgi paytda o'z halokatimizni xohlashimiz mumkin. Men hozir hech narsa bilan qiziqmayman, - dedi u qizg'in javob berib, - faqat bu yovuzni yaratilish yuzidan yo'q qilish.

en: I would sell my soul to do it! Oh, hush, hush, my child! said Van Helsing.
uz: Men buni qilish uchun jonimni sotardim! - dedi Van Helsing.

en: God does not purchase souls in this wise, and the Devil, though he may purchase, does not keep faith.
uz: Alloh jonlarni shunday sotib olmaydi va Iblis, sotib olishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, imonini saqlamaydi.

en: But God is merciful and just, and knows your pain and your devotion to that dear Madam Mina.
uz: Ammo Xudo rahmdil va adolatli, va u sizning og'rig'ingizni va o'sha aziz Madam Minaga bo'lgan sadoqatingizni biladi.

en: Think you, how her pain would be doubled, did she but hear your wild words.
uz: O'ylaymanki, uning og'riqi ikki baravar ko'payishi mumkin edi, lekin u sizning yovvoyi so'zlaringizni eshitgan.

en: Do not fear any of us, we are all devoted to this cause, and today shall see the end.
uz: Bizlardan hech kimdan qo'rqmanglar, biz hammamiz bu ishga bag'ishlanamiz va bugun oxiri keladi.

en: The time is coming for action.
uz: Harakat qilish vaqti yaqinlashmoqda.

en: Today this Vampire is limit to the powers of man, and till sunset he may not change.
uz: Bugungi kunda bu Vampir inson qobiliyati bilan cheklangan va quyosh botgunga qadar o'zgarmasligi mumkin.

en: It will take him time to arrive here, see it is twenty minutes past one, and there are yet some times before he can hither come, be he never so quick.
uz: Bu yerga yetib kelish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi, uni ko'rish uchun soat birdan yigirma daqiqa o'tibdi va u hech qachon shoshilmagan bo'lsa-da, bu yerga kelishi uchun hali ba'zi vaqtlar bor.

en: What we must hope for is that my Lord Arthur and Quincey arrive ﬁrst. About half an hour after we had received Mrs.
uz: Umid qilamizki, Lordim Artur va Quincey birinchi bo'lib kelishadi. - deb so'rashdi.

en: Harker's telegram, there came a quiet, resolute knock at the hall door.
uz: Harkerning telegramasi, xonadon eshigida xotirjam va qat'iy taqillat keldi.

en: It was just an ordinary knock, such as is given hourly by thousands of gentlemen, but it made the Profes- sor's heart and mine beat loudly.
uz: Bu shunchaki oddiy bir taqillati edi, minglab gentlemenlar soatlab shunday taqillati qiladi, lekin bu professorning va mening yuragimni baland ovoz bilan urishga majbur qildi.

en: We looked at each other, and together moved out into the hall.
uz: Biz bir-birimizga qarab, birgalikda zalga chiqdik.

en: We each held ready to use our various armaments, the spiritual in the left hand, the mortal in the right.
uz: Har birimiz o'z turli qurol-yarog'imizdan foydalanishga tayyor bo'ldik, chap qo'limizda ma'naviy qurol-yarog'imiz, o'ng qo'limizda o'lchovli qurol-yarog'imiz bor edi.

en: Van Helsing pulled back the latch, and holding the door half open, stood back, having both hands ready for action.
uz: Van Helsing qulfini o'chirib, eshikni yarim ochib qo'yib, orqaga qarab turdi va qo'llari harakatga tayyor edi.

en: The gladness of our hearts must have shown upon
uz: Qalbimizdagi quvonch o'z vaqtida namoyon bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: our faces when on the step, close to the door, we saw Lord Godalming and Quincey Morris.
uz: O'zimizning ko'zlarimizga ko'z tikib, eshikdan yaqin qadamda Lord Godalming va Quincey Morrisni ko'rdik.

en: They came quickly in and closed the door behind them, the former saying, as they moved along the hall.
uz: Ular darhol kirib, orqalaridan eshikni yopishdi, bu qadimgi so'z edi.

en: We found both places.
uz: Biz ikkala joyni ham topdik.

en: Six boxes in each and we destroyed them all. Destroyed? asked the Professor.
uz: Har birida olti quti bor va biz barchasini yo'q qildik. - Yo'q qilinganmi? deb so'radi professor.

en: For him! We were silent for a minute, and then Quincey said, There's nothing to do but to wait here.
uz: U uchun! - deb bir daqiqacha sukut saqladik va keyin Quincey dedi: Bu yerda kutishdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q.

en: If, however, he doesn't turn up by ﬁve o'clock, we must start off.
uz: Biroq, agar u besh gacha kelmasa, biz boshlashimiz kerak.

en: For it won't do to leave Mrs.
uz: Chunki bu xonimni tashlab ketishga yordam bermaydi.

en: Harker alone after sunset. He will be here before long now,' said Van Helsing, who had been con- sulting his pocketbook.
uz: Harker quyosh botgandan keyin yolg'iz. U tez orada bu yerda bo'ladi, - dedi Van Helsing, u pul quti bilan maslahatlashib yurgan edi.

en: Nota bene, in Madam's telegram he went south from Carfax.
uz: Yaxshi, Madamning telegramasida u Carfaxdan janubiga borgan.

en: That means he went to cross the river, and he could only do so at slack of tide, which should be something before one o'clock.
uz: Bu degani, u daryo bo'ylab o'tishga borgan va uni faqat bir soatdan oldin bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan to'lqin bo'shash paytida o'tishga muvaffaq bo'lgan.

en: That he went south has a meaning for us.
uz: Uning janubiga ketishi biz uchun muhim ahamiyatga ega.

en: He is as yet only suspicious, and he went from Carfax ﬁrst to the place where he would suspect interference least.
uz: U hozircha faqat shubhali va u Carfaxdan birinchi bo'lib hech qanday aralashuvni shubha qilmaydigan joyga bordi.

en: You must have been at Bermondsey only a short time before him.
uz: Siz Bermondseyda undan oz oldin bo'lgan bo'lsangiz kerak.

en: That he is not here already shows that he went to Mile End next.
uz: Uning bu yerda yo'qligi uning keyingi safar Mile Endga borganligini ko'rsatadi.

en: This took him some time, for he would then have to be carried over the river in some way.
uz: Bu unga bir muncha vaqtni talab qildi, chunki uni qaysidir tarzda daryo bo'ylab ko'tarib olish kerak edi.

en: Be- lieve me, my friends, we shall not have long to wait now.
uz: Do'stlarim, meni yaxshi ko'ringlar, endi uzoq kutishga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

en: We should have ready some plan of attack, so that we may throw away no chance.
uz: Bizda hujum rejasi bo'lishi kerak edi, shuning uchun hech qanday imkoniyatni rad etmaymiz.

en: Hush, there is no time now.
uz: Hush, hozir vaqt yo'q.

en: Be ready! He held up a warning hand as he spoke, for we all could hear a key softly inserted in the lock of the hall door.
uz: Tayyor bo'linglar! - deb gapirganida, u ogohlantirish qo'lini ko'taribdi, chunki hammamiz salondagi eshik qulfasiga sekinlik bilan o'rnatilgan kalitni eshitardik.

en: I could not but admire, even at such a moment, the way in which a domi- nant spirit asserted itself.
uz: Hatto bunday paytda ham dominant ruhning o'zini qanday namoyon etishini hayratda qoldirmasdim.

en: In all our hunting parties and adventures in differ- ent parts of the world, Quincey Morris had always been the one to arrange the plan of action, and Arthur and I had been accustomed to obey him im- plicitly.
uz: Dunyoning turli joylarida o'tkazilgan barcha ovchilik va sarguzashtlarda Quincey Morris har doim harakat rejasini tuzgan va Artur va men unga to'g'ri itoat qilishga odatlangan edik.

en: Now, the old habit seemed to be renewed instinctively.
uz: Endi, eski odat instinktli ravishda yangilab borayotgandek tuyuldi.

en: With a swift glance around the room, he at once laid out our plan of attack, and without speaking a word, with a gesture, placed us each in position.
uz: Xonani tezda ko'rib, u darhol hujum rejasini belgilab berdi va bir so'z aytmasdan, imo-ishora bilan har birimizni o'rnimizga qo'ydi.

en: Van Helsing, Harker, and I were just behind the door, so that when it was opened the Pro- fessor could guard it whilst we two stepped between the incomer and the door.
uz: Van Helsing, Harker va men eshik orqasida turardik, shuning uchun u ochilganda professor uni himoya qila oladi va biz ikkovimiz o'rtacha eshikni ochib beramiz.

en: Godalming behind and Quincey in front stood just out of sight ready to move in front of the window.
uz: Godalming orqa tomonda, Quincey esa oldinda, darcha oldida harakatlanishga tayyor turgan.

en: We waited in a suspense that made the sec- onds pass with nightmare slowness.
uz: Biz o'tmishni orzu qilib, sekundlar orzu xayoli bilan o'tib ketishiga sabab bo'ldi.

en: The slow, careful steps came along the
uz: Yo'lda sekin, ehtiyotkor qadamlar oshib bordi.

en: The Count was evidently prepared for some surprise, at least he feared it.
uz: Count, ehtimol, ba'zi bir kutilmagani uchun tayyor edi, hech bo'lmaganda, undan qo'rqardi.

en: Suddenly with a single bound he leaped into the room.
uz: Toʻsatdan u bitta bogʻ bilan xonaga oʻtardi.

en: Winning a way past us before any of us could raise a hand to stay him.
uz: Bizlardan hech kim uni to'xtatish uchun qo'l ko'tarishidan oldin o'zimizdan o'tish yo'lini yutib olish.

en: There was some- thing so pantherlike in the movement, something so unhuman, that it seemed to sober us all from the shock of his coming.
uz: Harakatda shunchalik panteralik narsa, shunchalik odamsiz narsa bor ediki, uning kelishi bizni hayratda qoldirganidek tuyuldi.

en: The ﬁrst to act was Harker, who with a quick movement, threw himself before the door leading into the room in the front of the house.
uz: Harker birinchi bo'lib harakat qildi, u tez harakat qilib, uy oldidagi xonaga olib boradigan eshik oldida o'zini tashladi.

en: As the Count saw us, a horrible sort of snarl passed over his face, showing the eyeteeth long and pointed.
uz: Count bizni ko'rib turganida, uning yuziga dahshatli qichqiriq o'tdi va uzoq va o'tkir ko'zlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: But the evil smile as quickly passed into a cold stare of lion-like disdain.
uz: Ammo yovuz tabassum tezda sher kabi nojo'ya nazarga aylandi.

en: His expression again changed as, with a single impulse, we all advanced upon him.
uz: Uning ifodasini yana o'zgartirib, biz hammamiz bir tekislik bilan uning ustiga qadam bosdik.

en: It was a pity that we had not some better organized plan of attack, for even at the moment I wondered what we were to do.
uz: Afsuski, bizda yanada yaxshi tashkillashtirilgan hujum rejasi yo'q edi, chunki hozirda ham nima qilishimiz kerakligini o'yladim.

en: I did not myself know whether our lethal weapons would avail us anything.
uz: O'zim ham o'z o'lim qurollarimiz bizga biror foyda keltirishini bilmasdim.

en: Harker evidently meant to try the matter, for he had ready his great Kukri knife and made a ﬁerce and sudden cut at him.
uz: Harker bu ishni hal qilishni xohlagan bo'lsa kerak, chunki u katta Kukri qilichini tayyorlab, unga qattiq va to'satdan kesib qo'ydi.

en: The blow was a powerful one.
uz: Urish kuchli bo'ldi.

en: Only the diabolical quickness of the Count's leap back saved him.
uz: Faqat Countning qaytib o'tish tezligi uni qutqardi.

en: A second less and the trenchant blade had shorn through his coat, making a wide gap whence a bundle of bank notes and a stream of gold fell out.
uz: Bir soniyaga kamroq bo'lganda, uning kiyimidan keskin qilich kesib, keng bo'lakni yaratdi va undan bank banknotlar to'plami va oltin oqimi tushib ketdi.

en: The expression of the Count's face was so hellish, that for a moment I feared for Harker, though I saw him throw the terrible knife aloft again for another stroke.
uz: Countning yuzidagi ifodasi shunchalik dahshatli bo'lganki, men bir daqiqa uchun Harker uchun qo'rqardim, ammo uni yana bir marta qo'rqinchli pichoqni yuqoriga tashlaganini ko'rdim.

en: Instinctively I moved forward with a protective impulse, holding the Cruciﬁx and Wafer in my left hand.
uz: Instinktli ravishda men o'zimning chap qo'limda Xoch va Waferni ushlab, himoyalovchi impuls bilan oldinga harakat qildim.

en: I felt a mighty power ﬂy along my arm, and it was without surprise that I saw the monster cower back before a simi- lar movement made spontaneously by each one of us.
uz: Qo'limda kuchli kuch o'sayotganini his qildim va har birimiz o'z-o'zimizdan qilgan harakatdan oldin qo'rqinchli hayvonning orqaga qaytganini ko'rib hayron qolmadim.

en: It would be impossi- ble to describe the expression of hate and bafﬂed malignity, of anger and hellish rage, which came over the Count's face.
uz: Countning yuziga tushgan nafrat va g'azab va g'azabni tasvirlash imkonsizdir.

en: His waxen hue became greenish-yellow by the contrast of his burning eyes, and the red scar on the forehead showed on the pallid skin like a palpitating wound.
uz: Uning shamli nufuzi yonayotgan ko'zlarining kontrastidan yashil sariq bo'lib ketdi va oldidagi qizil yara pallid terida palpitant yara kabi ko'rinardi.

en: The next in- stant, with a sinuous dive he swept under Harker's arm, ere his blow could fall, and grasping a handful of the money from the ﬂoor, dashed across the room, threw himself at the window.
