uz: Keyingi marta, u Harkerning qo'li ostida o'tirib, o'z urishi tushishi mumkin bo'lganidan oldin, sinchkovlik bilan suvga cho'kdi va yerdan bir qoshiq pulni ushlab, xonaning orqasidan urib, o'zini derazaga tashladi.

en: Amid the crash and glitter of the falling glass, he tumbled into the ﬂagged area below.
uz: Chiqayotgan shishalarning to'qnashishi va shishlashi orasida u pastdagi bayroqlangan joyga tushib tushdi.

en: Through the sound of the shivering glass I could hear the ting of the gold, as some of the sovereigns fell on the ﬂagging.
uz: Qovurib turgan shishalarning ovozi orqali oltinning tushini eshitardim, chunki ba'zi hukmdorlar bayroq ustiga tushib qolishdi.

en: We ran over and saw him spring unhurt from the ground.
uz: Biz orqaga yugurib kelib, uni yerdan jarohatsiz chiqayotganini ko'rdik.

en: He, rushing up the steps, crossed the ﬂagged yard, and pushed open the stable door.
uz: U qadamlar ustida yugurib, bayroqlangan hovlini kesib, hovuz eshigini ochdi.

en: he turned and spoke to us.
uz: U o'girilib, bizga gapirdi.

en: You think to bafﬂe me, you with your pale faces all in a row, like sheep in a butcher's.
uz: Sizni, o'zingizning o'tkir yuzlaringiz bilan, qilichbozxonadagi qo'y kabi, meni hayratda qoldirishni o'ylaysiz.

en: You shall be sorry yet, each one of you!
uz: Sizlarning har biringiz bundan keyin ham afsuslanasiz!

en: You think you have left me without a place to rest, but I have more.
uz: Siz meni dam olish uchun joysiz qoldirdingiz deb o'ylaysiz, lekin men bundan ko'proq bor.

en: My revenge is just begun!
uz: Mening qasosim endi boshlandi!

en: I spread it over centuries, and time is on my side.
uz: Men uni asrlar davomida tarqatganman va vaqt mening tarafimda.

en: Your girls that you all love are mine already.
uz: Hammangiz sevgan qizlaringiz allaqachon mening qizlarimdir.

en: And through them you and others shall yet be mine, my creatures, to do my bidding and to be my jackals when I want to feed.
uz: Va ular orqali siz va boshqalar mening yaratilishlarim bo'lasizlar, mening buyruqlarimni bajarasizlar va men ovqatlanmoqchi bo'lganimda, chaqallarim bo'lasiz.

en: Bah! With a contemptuous sneer, he passed quickly through the door, and we heard the rusty bolt creak as he fastened it behind him.
uz: Boh! - deb qo'rqitib, darvoza orqali tez o'tib o'tdi va biz uni orqasidan bog'lab turganida, o'sha qovurilgan bo'g'irning qichqiriqini eshitdik.

en: A door beyond opened and shut.
uz: Oroldan bir eshik ochildi va yopildi.

en: The ﬁrst of us to speak was the Professor.
uz: Bizlardan birinchi bo'lib gapirgan professor edi.

en: Realizing the difﬁculty of following him through the stable, we moved toward the hall.
uz: Uning orqasidan o'tish qiyinligini anglab, biz zalga qarab harakat qildik.

en: We have learnt something … much!
uz: Biz bir narsa o'rganganmiz ... ko'p!

en: Notwithstanding his brave words, he fears us.
uz: Jasoratli so'zlariga qaramay, u bizdan qo'rqadi.

en: He fears time, he fears want!
uz: U vaqtdan qo'rqadi, xohishdan qo'rqadi!

en: For if not, why he hurry so?
uz: Agar yo'q bo'lsa, nima uchun u shuncha shoshilmoqda?

en: His very tone betray him, or my ears deceive.
uz: Uning o'ziga xos so'zi unga xiyonat qiladi yoki mening quloqlarim uni aldaydi.

en: Why take that money?
uz: Nima uchun bu pulni olish kerak?

en: You are hunters of the wild beast, and understand it so.
uz: Sizlar yovvoyi hayvon ovchilari ekansiz, buni shunday tushuning.

en: For me, I make sure that nothing here may be of use to him, if so that he returns. As he spoke he put the money remaining in his pocket, took the title deeds in the bundle as Harker had left them, and swept the remaining things into the open ﬁreplace, where he set ﬁre to them with a match.
uz: O'zim uchun, agar u qaytib kelsa, bu yerda unga hech narsa foyda keltirmasligiga ishonch hosil qilaman. U gapirganida, qolgan pulni qopqoqida qo'ydi, Harker qoldirgan bo'lsa-da, qog'ozlarni to'plamga olib, qolgan narsalarni ochiq o'tga olib kirdi va o't qo'ydi.

en: Godalming and Morris had rushed out into the yard, and Harker had low- ered himself from the window to follow the Count.
uz: Godalming va Morris hovliga shoshilgani uchun, Harker esa Countning orqasidan ergashish uchun o'zini oynadan pastga tushirdi.

en: He had, however, bolted the stable door, and by the time they had forced it open there was no sign of him.
uz: Biroq, u o'rinbosarning eshigini qulflab qo'ygan edi va uni majburiy ravishda ochish paytida uning izlari yo'q edi.

en: Van Helsing and I tried to make inquiry at the back of the house.
uz: Van Helsing va men uyning orqasida tekshiruv o'tkazishga harakat qildik.

en: But the mews was deserted and no one had seen him depart.
uz: Ammo maylar tashqarida bo'lgan va uni ketayotganini hech kim ko'rmagan edi.

en: It was now late in the afternoon, and sunset was not far off.
uz: Endi kechki payt edi va quyosh botish uzoq bo'lmagan.

en: We had to recognize that our game was up.
uz: O'yinimiz o'tganini tan olishimiz kerak edi.

en: With heavy hearts we agreed with the Pro- fessor when he said, Let us go back to Madam Mina.
uz: Biz professor bilan og'ir yuraklar bilan, Madam Minaga qaytaylik.

en: Poor, poor dear Madam Mina.
uz: Yomon, kambag'al aziz Madam Mina.

en: All we can do just now is done, and we can there, at least, protect her.
uz: Hozircha qila oladiganimiz barcha narsa tugagandir va hech bo'lmaganda uni himoya qilishimiz mumkin.

en: But we need not despair.
uz: Ammo biz umidsizlikka tushishimiz shart emas.

en: There is but one more earth box, and we must try to ﬁnd it.
uz: Faqatgina bitta yer qutisi qolgan va biz uni topishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: When that is done all may yet be well. I could see that he spoke as bravely as he could to comfort Harker.
uz: Bu ish tugagach, hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. - dedi Harkerga tasalli berish uchun u qo'lidan kelgancha jasorat ila gapirganini ko'rdim.

en: The poor fellow was quite broken down, now and again he gave a low groan which he could not suppress.
uz: Zavqsiz odam juda yomon holatda edi, vaqti-vaqti bilan o'zidan kamroq qayg'urardi va uni to'xtata olmadi.

en: He was thinking of his wife.
uz: U o'z xotini haqida o'ylayotgan edi.

en: With sad hearts we came back to my house, where we found Mrs.
uz: Qahrli yuraklar bilan uyimga qaytib keldik, u yerda xonimni topdik.

en: Harker waiting us, with an appearance of cheerfulness which did honor to her brav- ery and unselﬁshness.
uz: Harker bizni kutib turardi, bu uning jasorati va begʻarazligiga hurmat koʻrsatgan quvonchli koʻrinishi bilan.

en: When she saw our faces, her own became as pale as
uz: U bizning yuzlarimizni ko'rganida, o'zlarining ko'zlari o'zgarib ketdi.

en: For a second or two her eyes were closed as if she were in secret prayer.
uz: Bir-ikki soniya davomida uning ko'zlari yashirin ibodat qilgandek yopildi.

en: And then she said cheerfully, I can never thank you all enough.
uz: Keyin u xursandchilik bilan shunday dedi: Men sizlarning hammaga yetarlicha rahmat ayta olmayman.

en: Oh, my poor darling! As she spoke, she took her husband's grey head in her hands and kissed it.
uz: Oh, kambag'al sevgilim! deb gapirganida, u erining oq boshini qo'llariga olib, o'pdi.

en: Lay your poor head here and rest it.
uz: Bu yerda o'z g'alati boshingizni qo'yib, dam oling.

en: All will yet be well, dear!
uz: Hamma narsa hali ham yaxshi bo'ladi, aziz!

en: God will protect us if He so will it in His good intent. The poor fellow groaned.
uz: Agar Xudo buni O'zining yaxshi niyatida xohlasa, bizni himoya qiladi. - deb qayg'urgan kambag'al kishi.

en: There was no place for words in his sublime misery.
uz: Uning buyuk qayg'ularida so'zlar uchun joy yo'q edi.

en: We had a sort of perfunctory supper together, and I think it cheered us all up somewhat.
uz: Biz o'zimiz bilan birga biroz xayrli kechki ovqatni o'tkazdik va bu hammamizni biroz hayajonlantirdi deb o'ylayman.

en: It was, perhaps, the mere animal heat of food to hungry peo- ple, for none of us had eaten anything since breakfast, or the sense of com- panionship may have helped us, but anyhow we were all less miserable, and saw the morrow as not altogether without hope.
uz: Ehtimol, bu och odamlarga ovqat berishning hayvonot issiqligi edi, chunki hech birimiz kechqurundan beri hech narsa yemagan edik, yoki mehribonlik hissi bizga yordam bergan bo'lishi mumkin, ammo har qanday holatda hammamiz kamroq baxtsiz edik va ertaga umidsiz bo'lmaganini ko'rdik.

en: True to our promise, we told Mrs.
uz: Va'dalarimizga sodiq bo'lib, biz bu haqda xonimga aytdik.

en: Harker everything which had passed.
uz: Harker o'tgan hamma narsani.

en: And although she grew snowy white at times when danger had seemed to threaten her husband, and red at others when his devotion to her was mani- fested she listened bravely and with calmness.
uz: Garchi u erini xavf ostiga qo'ygan bo'lgan paytlarda qor oq, unga bo'lgan sadoqati namoyon bo'lgan paytda boshqalarda esa qizil bo'lsa-da, u jasorat va xotirjamlik bilan tinglagan.

en: When we came to the part where Harker had rushed at the Count so recklessly, she clung to her hus- band's arm, and held it tight as though her clinging could protect him from any harm that might come.
uz: Harker Countga shunchalik beparvolik bilan bostirib kelgan joyga yetib borganimizda, u o'z erining qo'lini qattiq ushlab turardi, xuddi uning ushlab turishi uni har qanday zarardan himoya qilishi mumkin bo'lganidek.

en: She said nothing, however, till the narration was all done,and matters had been brought up to the present time.
uz: Biroq, u hikoya bitguniga qadar hech narsa aytmadi va bu masala hozirgi kungacha ko'tarildi.

en: Then without letting go her husband's hand she stood up amongst us and spoke.
uz: Keyin erining qo'lini qo'yib bermasdan, o'rtalarimizda turib gapirdi.

en: Oh, that I could give any idea of the scene.
uz: Oh, men ushbu voqeadan biror tasavvurga ega bo'lishim mumkin.

en: Of that sweet, sweet, good, good woman in all the radiant beauty of her youth and animation, with the red scar on her forehead, of which she was conscious, and which we saw with grinding of our teeth, remembering whence and how it came.
uz: O'sha go'zal, shirin, yaxshi, yaxshi ayolning yoshligi va jonliligi bilan chiroyli go'zalligi, ma'nosi bor bo'lgan, ma'lum bo'lgan, oldiga qizil yara qo'yilgan, biz esa uning qayerdan va qanday paydo bo'lganini eslab, uni tishlarimiz qimirlab ko'rdik.

en: Her loving kindness against our grim hate.
uz: Uning shafqatsizligi bizning shafqatsiz nafratimizga qarshi.

en: Her tender faith against all our fears and doubting.
uz: Bizning barcha qo'rquv va shubhalarimizga qarshi uning mehribon imoni.

en: And we, knowing that so far as symbols went, she with all her goodness and purity and faith, was outcast from God.
uz: Biz esa, ramziy ma'nolarga ko'ra, u o'zining butun yaxshiligi, pokligi va imoni bilan Xudodan ajralganini bilamiz.

en: Jonathan, she said, and the word sounded like music on her lips it was so full of love and tenderness, Jonathan dear, and you all my true, true friends, I want you to bear something in mind through all this dreadful time.
uz: Jonatan, - dedi u, og'zidagi so'z musiqaga o'xshaydigan bo'lib, u shunchalik sevgi va mehribonlik bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, - Dor Jonatan, sizlarning hammangiz, chin do'stlarim, bu dahshatli vaqt davomida bir narsani yodda tutishingizni xohlayman.

en: I know that you must ﬁght.
uz: Bilaman, siz kurashishingiz kerak.

en: That you must destroy even as you destroyed the false Lucy so that the true Lucy might live hereafter.
uz: Haqiqiy Luzi bundan keyin yashashi uchun siz soxta Luziyani yo'q qilganingizdek, siz ham uni yo'q qilishingiz kerak.

en: But it is not a work of hate.
uz: Ammo bu nafratning ishi emas.

en: That poor soul who has wrought all this misery is the saddest case of all.
uz: Bu barcha azob-uqubatlarga sabab bo'lgan kambag'al ruh, bularning hammasi uchun eng qayg'uli holatdir.

en: Just think what will be his joy when he, too, is destroyed in his wors-
uz: O'zi ham o'z ibodatlarida halok bo'lganida, uning qanday quvonchi borligini tasavvur qiling.

en: er part that his better part may have spiritual immortality.
uz: Uning eng yaxshi qismi ma'naviy o'lmaslikka ega bo'lishi mumkin.

en: You must be piti- ful to him, too,though it may not hold your hands from his destruction. As she spoke I could see her husband's face darken and draw together, as though the passion in him were shriveling his being to its core.
uz: Siz ham unga rahm-shafqat ko'rsatishingiz kerak, garchi u sizning qo'lingizni uning halokatidan ushlab qolmasligi mumkin.U gapirganida, erining yuzi qorong'ilashib, bir-biriga yaqinlashib ketayotganini ko'rardim, xuddi u ichidagi ishtiyoq uning qalbini tubdan qirib tashlagandek.

en: Instinctively the clasp on his wife's hand grew closer, till his knuckles looked white.
uz: O'z-o'zidan xotini qo'lida bo'lgan qulf yaqinlashdi, hatto qo'llari oq ko'rindi.

en: She did not ﬂinch from the pain which I knew she must have suffered, but looked at him with eyes that were more appealing than ever.
uz: O'zi azob chekayotganini bilardim, lekin uning og'rig'idan qochib o'tmadi, aksincha, unga har qachongidan ko'ra ko'proq yoqimli ko'zlar bilan qaradi.

en: As she stopped speaking he leaped to his feet, almost tearing his hand from hers as he spoke.
uz: U gapirishni to'xtatganida, u o'z oyoqlariga ko'tarildi va u gapirgan paytda qo'lini deyarli uning qo'lidan ajratib qo'ydi.

en: May God give him into my hand just for long enough to destroy that earthly life of him which we are aiming at.
uz: Xudo uni mening qo'limga topshirsin, faqat biz maqsad qilib qo'ygan uning yerdagi hayotini yo'q qilish uchun yetarlicha vaqt.

en: If beyond it I could send his soul forever and ever to burning hell I would do it! Oh, hush!
uz: Agar undan tashqari uning ruhini abadiy va abadiy do'zaxga yuborishim mumkin bo'lsa, men buni qilaman!

en: Oh, hush in the name of the good God.
uz: Oh, yaxshi Xudo nomi bilan sukut saqlang.

en: Don't say such things, Jonathan, my husband, or you will crush me with fear and horror.
uz: Bunday so'zlarni aytma, Jonatan, erim, agar yo'q bo'lsa, meni qo'rquv va dahshatga tushirasan.

en: Just think, my dear … I have been thinking all this long, long day of it … that … per- haps … some day … I, too, may need such pity, and that some other like you, and with equal cause for anger, may deny it to me!
uz: Bir o'ylab ko'ring, azizim, men bu uzoq, uzoq kun davomida o'yladimki, ehtimol bir kuni men ham bunday rahm-shafqatga muhtoj bo'lishim mumkin va siz kabi va g'azablanish uchun teng sababga ega bo'lgan boshqa birov menga buni rad etishi mumkin!

en: My husband, indeed I would have spared you such a thought had there been another way.
uz: Erim, agar boshqa yo'l bo'lganida, men sizga bunday fikrdan qochardim.

en: But I pray that God may not have treasured your wild words, except as the heart-broken wail of a very loving and sorely stricken man.
uz: Lekin ibodat qilamanki, Xudo sizning yovvoyi so'zlaringizni juda mehribon va og'ir azob chekkan odamning og'ir og'rig'i kabi qadrlamagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Oh, God, let these poor white hairs go in evidence of what he has suffered, who all his life has done no wrong, and on whom so many sorrows have come. We men were all in tears now.
uz: Oh, Xudoyim, bu kambag'al oq sochlar uning azob chekganini, butun hayoti davomida hech qanday yomonlik qilmaganini va ko'pgina qayg'ularga duchor bo'lganini ko'rsatsin.

en: There was no resisting them, and we wept openly.
uz: Ularga qarshi turishning iloji yo'q edi va biz ochiq-oydin yig'ladik.

en: She wept, too, to see that her sweeter counsels had prevailed.
uz: U ham o'zining sevimli maslahatchilarining g'alaba qozonishini ko'rish uchun yig'ladi.

en: Her husband ﬂung himself on his knees beside her, and putting his arms round her, hid his face in the folds of her dress.
uz: Uning eri uning yonida tiz cho'kib, qo'llarini uning atrofida qo'yib, yuzini uning kiyimining kataklariga o'girib qo'ydi.

en: Van Helsing beckoned to us and we stole out of the room, leaving the two loving hearts alone with their God.
uz: Van Helsing bizga ishora qildi va biz xonadan o'g'irlab chiqdik, ikki sevgan yuraklarni o'zlarining Xudosi bilan yolg'iz qoldirdik.

en: Before they retired the Professor ﬁxed up the room against any coming of the Vampire, and assured Mrs.
uz: Ular pensiyaga ketishdan oldin professor o'rinni vampirning kelishiga qarshi o'rnatdi va xonimga ishontirdi.

en: Harker that she might rest in peace.
uz: Harker unga tinchlikda dam olishini aytdi.

en: She tried to school herself to the belief, and manifestly for her husband's sake, tried to seem content.
uz: U o'zini bu e'tiqodga o'rgatishga harakat qildi va, ko'rinib turibdiki, erining manfaatini ko'zlab, mamnun ko'rinishga harakat qildi.

en: It was a brave struggle, and was, I think and believe, not without its reward.
uz: Bu jasoratli kurash edi va men o'ylaymanki, bu mukofotsiz bo'lmagan.

en: Van Helsing had placed at hand a bell which either of them was to sound in case of any emergency.
uz: Van Helsing qo'lida qo'ng'iroq qo'ygan edi, ularning ikkalasi ham favqulodda vaziyatda ovoz berishlari kerak edi.

en: When they had retired, Quincey, Godalming, and I arranged that we should sit up, dividing the night between us, and watch over the safety of the poor stricken lady.
uz: Ular, Quincey, Godalming va men pensionga ketishganida, o'tirib, o'zimiz bilan kechani bo'lishishga va kambag'al ayolning xavfsizligiga g'amxo'rlik qilishga qaror qildik.

en: ﬁrst watch falls to Quincey, so the rest of us shall be off to bed as soon as we can.
uz: Birinchi qo'riq Quinceyga tushadi, shuning uchun qolganlarimiz imkon qadar tezroq uxlashga ketamiz.

en: Godalming has already turned in, for his is the second watch.
uz: Godalming allaqachon o'zini o'ziga topshirgan, chunki uning ikkinchi qo'riqchisi.

en: Now that my work is done I, too, shall go to bed.
uz: Endi ishim tugagani uchun men ham uxlashga ketaman.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 3-4 October, close to midnight.—I thought yesterday would never end.
uz: Yonatan Harkerning jurnalining 3-4 oktyabr kunlari kechqurun yaqin.Men o'yladimki, kecha hech qachon tugamaydi.

en: There was over me a yearning for sleep, in some sort of blind belief that to wake would be to ﬁnd things changed, and that any change must now be for the better.
uz: Uyg'onish - bu o'zgarishlarni topish va har qanday o'zgarish endi yaxshi tomonga o'tishi kerak degan ko'r e'tiqod bilan uyquga intilayotgan edim.

en: Before we parted, we discussed what our next step was to be, but we could arrive at no result.
uz: Ajrashishdan oldin keyingi qadamlarimiz haqida muhokama qildik, ammo hech qanday natijalarga erisholmadik.

en: All we knew was that one earth box remained, and that the Count alone knew where it was.
uz: Biz faqat bitta yer qutisi qolganini va faqat Count uning qaerda ekanligini bilganini bilardik.

en: If he chooses to lie hidden, he may bafﬂe us for years.
uz: Agar u yashirincha yashirinib qolishni tanlasa, yillar davomida bizni g'alati qilib qo'yishi mumkin.

en: And in the meantime, the thought is too horrible, I dare not think of it even now.
uz: Va shu vaqtgacha, bu fikr juda dahshatli, hatto hozir ham bu haqda o'ylashga jur'at etmayman.

en: This I know, that if ever there was a woman who was all perfection, that one is my poor wronged darling.
uz: Buni bilaman, agar mukammal ayol bo'lgan bo'lsa, u mening kambag'al zulm qilgan azizimdir.

en: I loved her a thousand times more for her sweet pity of last night, a pity that made my own hate of the monster seem despicable.
uz: Men uni o'tgan kechaning salomli rahm-shafqati uchun ming barobar ko'proq sevdim, bu esa o'zimning qo'rqinchga bo'lgan nafratimdan nafratlanishga sabab bo'ldi.

en: Surely God will not permit the world to be the poorer by the loss of such a creature.
uz: Shubhasizki, Xudo dunyoga bunday jonzotni yo'qotib, kambag'allikka yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: We are all drifting reefwards now, and faith is our only anchor.
uz: Hozir biz barchamiz qirg'oqqa suzib ketmoqdamiz va imon bizning yagona ankorimizdir.

en: Mina is sleeping, and sleeping without dreams.
uz: Mina uxlaydi va tushlarsiz uxlaydi.

en: I fear what her dreams might be like, with such terrible memories to ground them in.
uz: Men uning orzulari qanday bo'lishi mumkinligidan qo'rqaman, chunki ular o'z ichiga o'rnatadigan dahshatli xotiralar bor.

en: She has not been so calm, within my seeing, since the sunset.
uz: U quyosh botganidan beri, mening ko'zimga ko'ra, bunday xotirjam bo'lmagan.

en: Then, for a while, there came over her face a repose which was like spring after the blasts of March.
uz: Keyin, bir muncha vaqt davomida uning yuzida mart oyidagi portlashlardan keyin bahor kabi dam olish paydo bo'ldi.

en: I thought at the time that it was the softness of the red sunset on her face, but somehow now I think it has a deeper meaning.
uz: O'shanda men uning yuzidagi qizil quyosh botishining yumshoqligi deb o'yladim, ammo hozir bu chuqurroq ma'noga ega deb o'ylayman.

en: I am not sleepy myself, though I am weary … weary to death.
uz: O'zim ham uxlamayman, lekin men charchaganman... o'limdan charchaganman.

en: However, I must try to sleep.
uz: Biroq, men uxlashga harakat qilishim kerak.

en: For there is tomorrow to think of, and there is no rest for me until … Later—I must have fallen asleep, for I was awakened by Mina, who was sitting up in bed, with a startled look on her face.
uz: Chunki ertaga o'ylashim kerak va men uchun faqat... Keyinroq men uxlab ketishim kerak edi, chunki meni o'tda o'tirgan Mina uyg'otdi, uning yuzida qo'rqinchli ko'rinish bor edi.

en: I could see easily, for we did not leave the room in darkness.
uz: Men osonlikcha ko'rardim, chunki biz xonani qorong'ilikda tark etmadik.

en: She had placed a warning hand over my mouth, and now she whispered in my ear, Hush!
uz: O'zimning og'zimga ogohlantirish qo'lini qo'ydi va endi quloqimga: Hush!

en: There is someone in the corridor! I got up softly, and crossing the room, gently opened the door.
uz: Koridorda kimdir bor! - deb soʻzlab oʻtirdim va xonani kesib oʻtib, eshikni yumshoq ochdim.

en: Just outside, stretched on a mattress, lay Mr.
uz: Chetdan tashqariga, matrasda uzilgan Mr. o'tirgan.

en: He raised a warning hand for silence as he whispered to me, Hush!
uz: U menga shoshib: Xush bo'l!

en: One of us will be here all night.
uz: Bizlardan biri butun kecha bu yerda bo'ladi.

en: We don't mean to take any chances! His look and gesture forbade discussion, so I came back and told Mina.
uz: Biz hech qanday xavf-xatarni qo'lga olishni xohlamaymiz! - degan uning ko'rinishi va imo-ishoralari suhbatni taqiqlab qo'ydi, shuning uchun men qaytib kelib, Minaga aytdim.

en: She sighed and positively a shadow of a smile stole over her poor, pale face
uz: U nafratlandi va o'zining kambag'al, soyaq yuzidan tabassum soyasi o'g'irlandi.

en: as she put her arms round me and said softly, Oh, thank God for good brave men! With a sigh she sank back again to sleep.
uz: U qo'llarini menga o'girib, salomatlik bilan: Oh, Xudoga shukr, yaxshi jasoratli odamlar bor! - dedi.

en: I write this now as I am not sleepy, though I must try again.
uz: Men buni hozir yozyapman, chunki uyqusiz emasman, ammo yana sinab ko'rishim kerak.

en: 4 October, morning.—Once again during the night I was wakened by Mina.
uz: 4 oktyabr kuni ertalab.Kechasi yana bir bor Mina meni uyg'otdi.

en: This time we had all had a good sleep, for the grey of the coming dawn was making the windows into sharp oblongs, and the gas ﬂame was like a speck rather than a disc of light.
uz: Bu safar hammamiz yaxshi uxlab qoldik, chunki ertangi tongning grizi derazalarni o'tkir oblonglarga aylantirgan edi va gaz alangasi nur diskidan ko'ra ko'proq to'plamga o'xshaydigan edi.

en: She said to me hurriedly, Go, call the Professor.
uz: U menga shoshilinchlik bilan: O'shanda borib, professorni chaqirib ko'ring.

en: I want to see him at once. Why? I asked.
uz: Men uni darhol ko'rmoqchiman. - Nima uchun? deb so'radim.

en: I suppose it must have come in the night, and matured without my knowing it.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u kechasi kelib, men bilmasdan o'sib chiqdi.

en: He must hypnotize me before the dawn, and then I shall be able to speak.
uz: U kunduzdan oldin meni hipnotizatsiya qilishi kerak, so'ngra men gapira olaman.

en: Go quick, dearest, the time is getting close. I went to the door.
uz: Tez bor, azizim, vaqt yaqinlashmoqda. - deb eshikga bordim.

en: Seward was resting on the mattress, and seeing me, he sprang to his feet.
uz: Seward matrasda uxlagan edi va meni ko'rib, oyoqlariga tushib ketdi.

en: Is anything wrong? he asked, in alarm.
uz: Biror narsa noto'g'rimi? - deb so'radi u.

en: But Mina wants to see Dr.
uz: Ammo Mina doktorning oldiga borishni istaydi.

en: Van Helsing at once. I will go, he said, and hurried into the Professor's room.
uz: Men boraman, - dedi u va professorning xonasiga shoshildi.

en: Two or three minutes later Van Helsing was in the room in his dressing gown, and Mr.
uz: Ikki-uch daqiqa o'tgach, Van Helsing o'z libosida xonada bo'lib qoldi.

en: Morris and Lord Godalming were with Dr.
uz: Morris va Lord Godalming dr.

en: Seward at the door asking questions.
uz: Seward eshik oldida savollar bermoqda.

en: When the Professor saw Mina a smile, a positive smile ousted the anxiety of his face.
uz: Professor Minaning tabassumini ko'rganida, ijobiy tabassum uning yuzidagi tashvishlarni yo'q qildi.

en: He rubbed his hands as he said, Oh, my dear Madam Mina, this is in- deed a change.
uz: U qo'llarini silkitib, shunday dedi: Oh, aziz Madam Mina, bu amalda o'zgarishdir.

en: Friend Jonathan, we have got our dear Madam Mina, as of old, back to us today! Then turning to her, he said cheerfully, And what am I to do for you?
uz: Yonatan do'st, bizda qadimgi kabi, aziz Xonim Mina bugun bizga qaytib keldi! - dedi u ayolga qarab, quvonch ila: Sening uchun nima qilishim kerak?

en: For at this hour you do not want me for nothing. I want you to hypnotize me! she said.
uz: Chunki shu soatda siz meni behuda xohlamaysiz. - Men sizni hipnotizatsiya qilishingizni xohlayman! - dedi u.

en: Do it before the dawn, for I feel that then I can speak, and speak freely.
uz: Bu ishni tongdan oldin qiling, chunki men o'zimni erkin gapira olaman va erkin gapira olaman.

en: Be quick, for the time is short! Without a word he motioned her to sit up in bed.
uz: Tezroq bo'ling, vaqt oz qoldi! - deb, bir so'z aytmasdan, u ayolga o'tirishga ishora qildi.

en: Looking ﬁxedly at her, he commenced to make passes in front of her, from over the top of her head downward, with each hand in turn.
uz: U qizga qattiq qarab, uning oldidan, boshining yuqori qismidan pastga qarab, har bir qo'li o'z navbatida o'tishni boshladi.

en: Mina gazed at him ﬁxedly for a few minutes, during which my own heart beat like a trip hammer, for I felt that some crisis was at hand.
uz: Mina unga bir necha daqiqa to'xtamay qarab turdi va o'shanda yuragim safarga o'tirgan martal kabi urdi, chunki men biron bir inqiroz yaqinlashib qolganini his qildim.

en: Gradually her eyes closed, and she sat, stock still.
uz: Keyinchalik uning ko'zlari yopildi va u o'tirdi.

en: Only by the gentle heaving of her bo- som could one know that she was alive.
uz: Faqat uning bo'y-somini yumshak ko'tarish orqali uning tirikligini bilsa bo'ladi.

en: The Professor made a few more passes and then stopped, and I could see that his forehead was covered with great beads of perspiration.
uz: Professor yana bir necha marta o'tib, to'xtadi va men uning peshanasi katta ter juftlari bilan qoplanganini ko'rdim.

en: Mina opened her eyes, but she did not seem the
uz: Mina ko'zlarini ochdi, lekin u o'ziga o'xshamaydi.

en: There was a far-away look in her eyes, and her voice had a sad dreaminess which was new to me.
uz: Uning ko'zlarida uzoqdan ko'rinish bor edi va uning ovozi men uchun yangi bo'lgan g'amgin tushlarga ega edi.

en: Raising his hand to impose silence, the Professor motioned to me to bring the others in.
uz: Professor o'zini sust tutish uchun qo'lini ko'tarib, boshqalarni olib kelishimga ishora qildi.

en: They came on tiptoe, closing the door behind them, and stood at the foot of the bed, looking on.
uz: Ular to'ng'ich bo'lib, orqalaridan eshikni yopib, to'shaning oyoq ostiga turib, qarab turishdi.

en: Mina appeared not to see them.
uz: Mina ularni ko'rmagan ko'rinardi.

en: The stillness was broken by Van Helsing's voice speaking in a low level tone which would not break the current of her thoughts.
uz: Van Helsingning ovozi uning fikrlash oqimini buzmaydigan, past rangda gapirgan ovoz tufayli tinchlik buzildi.

en: Where are you? The answer came in a neutral way.
uz: Qayerda ekansiz? - deb so'rab javob neutral tarzda keldi.

en: Sleep has no place it can call its own. For several min- utes there was silence.
uz: Uyquga o'ziga xos joy yo'q. Bir necha daqiqa davomida xotirjamlik hukm surdi.

en: Mina sat rigid, and the Professor stood staring at her ﬁxedly.
uz: Mina qat'iy o'tirgan va professor unga qattiq qaragan.

en: The rest of us hardly dared to breathe.
uz: Qolganlarimiz nafas olishni qiyinlashtirganmiz.

en: The room was growing lighter.
uz: Xona yorugʻlashib borayotgan edi.

en: Without taking his eyes from Mina's face, Dr.
uz: Mina yuzidan ko'zlarini olib tashlamagan holda, Dr.

en: Van Helsing motioned me to pull up the blind.
uz: Van Helsing menga ko'rni ko'tarib olishga ishora qildi.

en: I did so, and the day seemed just upon us.
uz: Men shunday qildim va kun bizga yaqinlashdi.

en: A red streak shot up, and a rosy light seemed to diffuse itself through the room.
uz: Qizil bo'lak ko'tarildi va o'ziga xos rozay yorug'lik xonada tarqaldi.

en: On the instant the Professor spoke again.
uz: O'sha zahoti professor yana gapirdi.

en: Where are you now? The answer came dreamily, but with intention.
uz: Xullas, endi qaerda bo'lding? - deb so'rab javob keldi, lekin niyat bilan.

en: It were as though she were interpreting something.
uz: O'sha paytda u biror narsani tarjima qilgandek edi.

en: I have heard her use the same tone when read- ing her shorthand notes.
uz: O'zining qisqartma yozuvlarini o'qiganida ham xuddi shu so'zni qo'llaganini eshitganman.

en: It is all strange to me! What do you see? I can see nothing.
uz: Menga hamma narsa g'alati! - Siz nima ko'rasiz? - Men hech narsa ko'rmayman.

en: It is all dark. What do you hear? I could detect the strain in the Professor's patient voice.
uz: Hammasi qorong'i. Siz nima eshityapsiz? - deb so'rashdi. Men professorning bemor ovozidagi bosimni payqadim.

en: The lapping of water.
uz: Suvning ko'tarilishi.

en: It is gurgling by, and little waves leap.
uz: U qirg'oqlab ketmoqda va kichik to'lqinlar ko'tarilmoqda.

en: I can hear them on the outside. Then you are on a ship?' We all looked at each other, trying to glean something each from the oth- er.
uz: Men ularni tashqaridan eshitaman. Shunda sen kemaga bording-ku? - deb so'rashdi. Biz hammamiz bir-birimizga qarab, bir-birimizdan biror narsa o'rganishga harakat qildik.

en: We were afraid to think.
uz: Biz o'ylashdan qo'rqardik.

en: The answer came quick, Oh, yes! What else do you hear? The sound of men stamping overhead as they run about.
uz: Javob tez kelib qoldi: Ha! Siz boshqa nima eshitasiz? Agar ular yugurib ketayotganda, boshlarini toshgan erkaklarning ovozi.

en: There is the creaking of a chain, and the loud tinkle as the check of the capstan falls into the ratchet. What are you doing?
uz: Zilziyorning qichqiriqlari va capstanning cheki bo'lganda baland ovoz bilan qichqiriq.  Siz nima qilyapsiz?

en: I am still, oh so still.
uz: Men hali ham, oh, shunday ham bo'ldim.

en: It is like death! The voice faded away into a deep breath as of one sleeping, and the open eyes closed again.
uz: Bu o'limga o'xshaydi! - degan so'z o'tib ketdi va u o'tirgan odam kabi chuqur nafas oldi va ochiq ko'zlar yana yopildi.

en: By this time the sun had risen, and we were all in the full light of day.
uz: Shu vaqtgacha quyosh chiqdi va biz barchamiz kun yorug'ligida edik.

en: Van Helsing placed his hands on Mina's shoulders, and laid her head down softly on her pillow.
uz: Van Helsing qo'llarini Minaning yelkalariga qo'yib, uning boshini yostiga iliq holda qo'ydi.

en: She lay like a sleeping child for a few moments, and then, with a long sigh, awoke and stared in wonder to see us all around her.
uz: U bir necha daqiqa uxlab yotgan bola kabi yotgan edi, so'ngra uzoq nafas olib, uyg'onib, bizni atrofida ko'rish uchun hayratda qoldi.

en: Have I been talking in my sleep? was all she said.
uz: Ushimda gapirganmanmi? - deb so'ragan edi u.

en: She seemed, howev- er, to know the situation without telling,though she was eager to know what she had told.
uz: O'sha paytda u vaziyatni aytmasdan bilar edi, ammo nima aytganini bilishga intilardi.

en: The Professor repeated the conversation, and she said, Then there is not a moment to lose.
uz: Professor suhbatni takrorladi va u shunday dedi: O'shanda yo'qotish uchun hech qanday vaqt yo'q.

en: It may not be yet too late! Mr.
uz: Ehtimol, hali kech emas! - deb aytdi Mr..

en: Morris and Lord Godalming started for the door but the Professor's calm voice called them back.
uz: Morris va Lord Godalming eshik tomon ketishdi, ammo professorning tinch ovozi ularni chaqirib oldi.

en: That ship, wherever it was, was weighing anchor at the moment in your so great Port of London.
uz: Bu kema, qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, hozirda sizning buyuk London portingizda ankorni o'z ichiga olgan edi.

en: Which of them is it that you seek?
uz: Ulardan qaysi birini qidiryapsiz?

en: God be thanked that we have once again a clue, though whither it may lead us we know not.
uz: Xudoga shukurki, bizda yana bir bor izimiz bor, ammo bu bizni qayerga olib borishi mumkinligini bilmaymiz.

en: We have been blind somewhat.
uz: Biz biroz ko'r edik.

en: Blind after the manner of men, since we can look back we see what we might have seen looking for- ward if we had been able to see what we might have seen!
uz: Odamlar kabi ko'r bo'lsak, orqaga qarab ko'ra olsak, ko'rganimizni ko'ramiz - agar biz ko'rganimizni ko'rishga qodir bo'lgan bo'lsak!

en: Alas, but that sentence is a puddle, is it not?
uz: Afsuski, lekin bu gap - bu qovurma, shunday emasmi?

en: We can know now what was in the Count's mind, when he seize that money, though Jonathan's so ﬁerce knife put him in the danger that even he dread.
uz: Endi biz Konning pulni olganda, uning ongida nimalar borligini bilamiz, garchi Jonatanning o'tkir pichoqlari uni xavf ostiga qo'ygan bo'lsa-da, hatto u ham qo'rqadi.

en: He saw that with but one earth box left, and a pack of men following like dogs after a fox, this London was no place for him.
uz: U faqat bitta yer qutisi qolganini va bir toʻplangan odamlar tiloqqa oʻxshaydigan itlar orqasidan ergashib ketayotganini koʻrdi, bu London u uchun joy emas edi.

en: He have take his last earth box on board a ship, and he leave the land.
uz: U o'zining so'nggi yer qutisini kemaga o'tirib, quruqlikdan chiqib ketadi.

en: He think to escape, but no!
uz: U qochib ketishni o'ylaydi, lekin yo'q!

en: As friend Arthur would say when he put on his red frock!
uz: Arturning do'sti o'zining qizil kiyimini kiyganida aytganidek!

en: Our old fox is wily.
uz: Bizning keksa tilkimiz hiylalidir.

en: So wily, and we must follow with wile.
uz: Shunday hiyla-nayrang, biz ham hiyla-nayrang bilan ergashishimiz kerak.

en: I, too, am wily and I think his mind in a little while.
uz: Men ham hiylasizman va birozdan keyin uning fikri o'ylab ko'raman.

en: In meantime we may rest and in peace, for there are between us which he do not want to pass, and which he could not if he would.
uz: Shu paytgacha biz tinchlik va dam olsak bo'ladi, chunki o'zimiz o'rtasida u o'tishni istamaydigan va xohlasa ham, o'tishi mumkin bo'lmagan narsalar bor.

en: Unless the ship were to touch the land, and then only at full or slack tide.
uz: Agar kema quruqqa tegmasa va faqat to'liq yoki salqin bo'lgan vaqtda.

en: See, and the sun is just rose, and all day to sunset is us.
uz: Ko'ring, quyosh to'g'ri ko'tarilmoqda va quyosh botishidan oldin kun bo'yi bizmiz.

en: Let us take bath, and dress, and have breakfast which we all need, and which we can eat comfortably since he be not in the same land with us. Mina looked at him appealingly as she asked, But why need we seek him further, when he is gone away from us? He took her hand and patted it as he replied, Ask me nothing as yet.
uz: Kelinglar, hammamiz kerak bo'lgan suvga cho'kib, kiyinib, ertalabki ovqatni yeymiz, chunki u biz bilan bir xil yurtda emas. - deb so'ragan Mina unga yoqimli qarab, Agar u bizdan uzoq bo'lsa, nima uchun uni izlashimiz kerak? - deb so'radi.

en: When we have breakfast, then I answer all questions. He would say no
uz: Ovqatlanayotib, men barcha savollarga javob beraman. - deb javob berardi u.

en: more, and we separated to dress.
uz: ko'proq bo'lib, kiyinish uchun ajralib qo'ydik.

en: After breakfast Mina repeated her question.
uz: Ovqatdan keyin Mina o'z so'rovini takrorladi.

en: He looked at her gravely for a minute and then said sorrowfully, Because my dear, dear Madam Mina, now more than ever must we ﬁnd him even if we have to follow him to the jaws of Hell! She grew paler as she asked faintly, Why? Because, he answered solemnly, he can live for centuries, and you are but mortal woman.
uz: U bir daqiqa davomida unga jiddiy qarashdi va keyin qayg'u bilan: Qizim, aziz Mina xonim, hatto jahannam og'izlarigacha uning orqasidan ergashib ketish kerak bo'lsa-da, uni hozir har qachongidan ko'proq topishimiz kerak! - dedi.

en: Time is now to be dreaded, since once he put that mark upon your throat. I was just in time to catch her as she fell forward in a faint.
uz: Endi vaqt qo'rqinchli bo'lishi kerak, chunki bir marta u sizning bo'yniga bu belgi qo'ydi. Men uni to'g'ri vaqtga yetib, o'zini o'zi halok qilib, oldinga yiqilib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: SEWARD'S PHONOGRAPH DIARY SPOKEN BY VAN HELSING This to Jonathan Harker.
uz: SEWARDning fonografiya kundaligi bu Jonatan Harkerga gapirgan VAN HELSING tomonidan gapirildi.

en: You are to stay with your dear Madam Mina.
uz: Siz o'zingizning sevimli Madam Mina bilan qolishingiz kerak.

en: We shall go to make our search, if I can call it so, for it is not search but knowing, and we seek con- ﬁrmation only.
uz: Biz qidiruvni amalga oshirish uchun ketamiz, agar men buni shunday deb atay olsam, chunki bu qidiruv emas, balki bilimdir va biz faqat tasdiqni izlaymiz.

en: But do you stay and take care of her today.
uz: Ammo siz bugun qoling va unga g'amxo'rlik qiling.

en: This is your best and most holiest ofﬁce.
uz: Bu sizning eng yaxshi va eng muqaddas ofisingiz.

en: This day nothing can ﬁnd him here.
uz: Bugungi kunda hech narsa uni bu yerda topolmaydi.

en: Let me tell you that so you will know what we four know already, for I have tell them.
uz: Men buni sizga aytib beraman, shunda biz to'rtlamiz allaqachon bilgan narsalarni bilib olasiz, chunki men ularga aytib berdim.

en: He, our enemy, have gone away.
uz: Bizning dushmanimiz o'tib ketdi.

en: He have gone back to his Castle in Transylvania.
uz: U Transilvaniyadagi qal'asiga qaytdi.

en: I know it so well, as if a great hand of ﬁre wrote it on the wall.
uz: Men uni juda yaxshi bilaman, xuddi katta olov qo'li uni devorga yozgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: He have prepare for this in some way, and that last earth box was ready to ship somewheres.
uz: U bunga tayyorgarlik ko'rdi va oxirgi yer qutisi qayerda bo'lsa jo'natishga tayyor edi.

en: For this he took the money.
uz: Buning uchun u pulni oldi.

en: For this he hur- ry at the last, lest we catch him before the sun go down.
uz: Shuning uchun u oxirgi kunlarda shoshilmoqda, chunki quyosh botishidan oldin uni tutish mumkin.

en: It was his last hope, save that he might hide in the tomb that he think poor Miss Lucy, being as he thought like him, keep open to him.
uz: Uning oxirgi umidi, masalan, qabrda yashirinib qolishidan tashqari, kambag'al Miss Lusi unga ochiq bo'lishini o'ylashi edi.

en: But there was not of time.
uz: Ammo vaqt yo'q edi.

en: When that fail he make straight for his last resource, his last earthwork I might say did I wish double entente.
uz: Bu muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganda, u o'zining oxirgi resursini, oxirgi yerdagi ishini to'g'rilaydi.

en: He is clever, oh so clever!
uz: U aqlli, oh, juda aqlli!

en: He know that his game here was ﬁnish.
uz: U o'z o'yinining oxiri bo'lganini biladi.

en: And so he decide he go back home.
uz: Shunday qilib, u uyga qaytishga qaror qildi.

en: He ﬁnd ship going by the route he came, and he go in it.
uz: U kelgan yo'ldan o'tgan kemani topib, unga o'tiribdi.

en: We go off now to ﬁnd what ship, and whither bound.
uz: Endi biz qaysi kemani va qayerga borayotganini topish uchun jo'natamiz.

en: When we have dis- cover that, we come back and tell you all.
uz: Bizda bu haqda ma'lumot bo'lganda, qaytib kelib, hammaingizga xabar beramiz.

en: Then we will comfort you and poor Madam Mina with new hope.
uz: Shunda biz siz va kambag'al Madam Minaga yangi umid bilan tasalli beramiz.

en: For it will be hope when you think it over, that all is not lost.
uz: O'ylab ko'rganingizda, hamma narsa yo'qolganiga umid bo'ladi.

en: This very creature that we pursue, he take hundreds of years to get so far as London.
uz: Biz kuzatib borayotgan bu mavjudotga Londongacha yetib borish uchun yuzlab yillar kerak bo'ladi.

en: And yet in one day, when we know of the disposal of him we drive him out.
uz: Ammo bir kun kelib, uning yo'q qilinishini bilganimizda, uni quvib yuboramiz.

en: He is ﬁnite, though he is powerful to do much harm and suffers not as we do.
uz: U cheklangan, ammo ko'p zarar yetkazishga qodir va biz kabi azob chekmaydi.

en: But we are strong, each in our pur-
uz: Ammo biz kuchlimiz, har birimiz o'z kuchimiz bilan harakat qilamiz.

en: pose, and we are all more strong together.
uz: Va biz hammamiz birgalikda kuchliroq bo'lamiz.

en: Take heart afresh, dear husband of Madam Mina.
uz: O'zingizni yangi his qiling, Madam Minaning aziz eri.

en: This battle is but begun and in the end we shall win.
uz: Ushbu jang hali boshlandi va nihoyat biz g'alaba qozonamiz.

en: So sure as that God sits on high to watch over His children.
uz: Xudovand o'z farzandlarini boqish uchun yuqoriga o'tirganidan shu qadar ishonch hosil qiling.

en: Therefore be of much comfort till we return.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz qaytib kelguncha, juda ko'p tasalli toping.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 4 October.—When I read to Mina, Van Helsing's message in the phono- graph, the poor girl brightened up considerably.
uz: Jonatan Harkerning 4 oktyabr kunigi jurnalida.Men Minaga Van Helsingning telefon grafikidagi xabarini o'qib bersam, kambag'al qiz sezilarli darajada yorqinlashdi.

en: Already the certainty that the Count is out of the country has given her comfort.
uz: Countning mamlakatdan chiqib ketgani uning tasdig'ini bermoqda.

en: And comfort is strength to her.
uz: Va tasalli unga kuchdir.

en: For my own part, now that his horrible danger is not face to face with us, it seems almost impossible to believe in it.
uz: O'zim uchun esa, uning dahshatli xavfi biz bilan yuzma-yuz bo'lmaganidan keyin, unga ishonish deyarli imkonsiz bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: Even my own terri- ble experiences in Castle Dracula seem like a long forgotten dream.
uz: Hatto Dracula qalʼasidagi oʻzimning dahshatli tajribalarim ham uzoq vaqtdan beri unutilgan orzuga oʻxshaydi.

en: Here in the crisp autumn air in the bright sunlight.
uz: Bu yerda quyoshning yorug' yorug'ligi bilan toza kuz havosida.

en: How can I disbelieve!
uz: Qanday qilib kufr keltira olaman!

en: In the midst of my thought my eye fell on the red scar on my poor darling's white forehead.
uz: O'ylashimning o'rtasida, ko'zim kambag'al sevganimning oq mijasidagi qizil yaraga tushib qoldi.

en: Whilst that lasts, there can be no disbelief.
uz: Bu davom etayotgan bo'lsa-da, imonsizlik bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Mina and I fear to be idle, so we have been over all the di- aries again and again.
uz: Mina va men bepul bo'lishdan qo'rqamiz, shuning uchun biz barcha muammolarni qayta-qayta ko'rib chiqdik.

en: Somehow, although the reality seem greater each time, the pain and the fear seem less.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, haqiqat har safar kattaroq ko'rinsa-da, og'riq va qo'rquv kamroq ko'rinadi.

en: There is something of a guiding pur- pose manifest throughout, which is comforting.
uz: Butun joyda yo'lboshchi bo'lib ko'rinadigan bir narsa bor, bu esa tasalli baxsh etadi.

en: Mina says that perhaps we are the instruments of ultimate good.
uz: Mina aytishicha, biz, ehtimol, oxirgi yaxshilikning vositalarimiz.

en: I shall try to think as she does.
uz: Men u kabi o'ylashga harakat qilaman.

en: We have never spoken to each other yet of the future.
uz: Hozircha biz kelajak haqida hech qachon gaplashmaganmiz.

en: It is better to wait till we see the Professor and the others after their investigations.
uz: Professor va boshqalarni tekshirishdan so'ng ko'rmagunimizcha kutish yaxshiroqdir.

en: The day is running by more quickly than I ever thought a day could run for me again.
uz: Kun men uchun yana bir kun o'tishi mumkin deb o'ylagandan ham tezroq o'tmoqda.

en: It is now three o'clock.
uz: Hozir soat uch.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 5 October, 5 p.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 5 oktyabr, 5 sahifa.

en: m.—Our meeting for report.
uz: m.Report uchun bizning uchrashuvimiz.

en: Present: Professor Van Hels- ing, Lord Godalming, Dr.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda professor Van Helsing, Lord Godalming, dr.

en: Quincey Morris, Jonathan Harker, Mina Harker.
uz: Quincey Morris, Jonatan Harker, Mina Harker.

en: Van Helsing described what steps were taken during the day to dis- cover on what boat and whither bound Count Dracula made his escape.
uz: Van Helsing kun davomida Count Dracula qaysi qayiqda va qayerga qochib ketganini aniqlash uchun qanday qadamlar qo'yilganini tushuntirdi.

en: As I knew that he wanted to get back to Transylvania, I felt sure that he must go by the Danube mouth, or by somewhere in the Black Sea, since by that way he come.
uz: U Transilvaniyaga qaytishni xohlayotganini bilardim, shuning uchun uning Donau og'izidan yoki Qora dengizning bir joyidan o'tishi kerakligiga amin bo'ldim, chunki u o'sha yo'l bilan keladi.

en: It was a dreary blank that was before us.
uz: Biz oldimizda bo'lgan chiroyli bo'sh joy edi.

en: Omme Ignotum pro magniﬁco.
uz: Omme Ignotum pro magnifico.

en: And so with heavy hearts we start to ﬁnd what ships leave for the Black Sea last night.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'tgan kecha Qora dengizga ketayotgan kemalarni qayerdan ketayotganini og'ir yuraklar bilan aniqlay boshladik.

en: He was in sailing ship, since Madam Mina tell of sails being set.
uz: U yelka kemasida edi, chunki Madam Mina yelkalar o'rnatilgani haqida aytib berdi.

en: These not so important as to go in your list of the ship- ping in the Times, and so we go, by suggestion of Lord Godalming, to your
uz: Bular Timesda sizning kemalar ro'yxatingizga kirishga qadar muhim emas, shuning uchun biz Lord Godalmingning taklifiga ko'ra sizning sahifangizga boramiz.

en: Lloyd's, where are note of all ships that sail, however so small.
uz: Lloyd's, unda barcha kemalar, shunga qaramay, juda kichik bo'lgan sayyohlik bilan shug'ullanmoqda.

en: There we ﬁnd that only one Black Sea bound ship go out with the tide.
uz: U yerda Qora dengizga boradigan faqat bitta kema dengiz o'tishi bilan chiqib ketayotganini ko'ramiz.

en: She is the Cza- rina Catherine, and she sail from Doolittle's Wharf for Varna, and thence to other ports and up the Danube.
uz: U Qozasi Katrin bo'lib, Doolittl qadoqxonasidan Varnaga boradi va u yerdan boshqa portlarga va Donau daryosiga boradi.

en: `So!' said I, `this is the ship whereon is the Count.' So off we go to Doolittle's Wharf, and there we ﬁnd a man in an of- ﬁce.
uz: `So!' dedim men, `s bu Count bor kemada. ' Shunday qilib, Doolittle's Wharf-ga boramiz va u yerda bir odamni ko'rdik.

en: From him we inquire of the goings of the Czarina Catherine.
uz: Undan zarina Ketrinning ishi haqida so'raymiz.

en: He swear much, and he red face and loud of voice, but he good fellow all the same.
uz: U ko'p qasam ichadi, yuzi qizar va ovozi baland, ammo u hali ham yaxshi odam.

en: And when Quincey give him something from his pocket which crackle as he roll it up, and put it in a so small bag which he have hid deep in his clothing, he still better fellow and humble servant to us.
uz: Quincey esa uning kiyimidan o'zi o'rab olgan kichkina sumkaga bir narsa olib, uni kiyimlariga o'g'irlab qo'yganida, u biz uchun yanada yaxshiroq odam va kamtarin xizmatkor bo'ladi.

en: He come with us, and ask many men who are rough and hot.
uz: U biz bilan birga keladi va ko'plab qo'pol va issiq erkaklardan so'raydi.

en: These be better fellows too when they have been no more thirsty.
uz: Bular ham endi chanqoq bo'lmaganda yaxshiroq odam bo'lishadi.

en: They say much of blood and bloom, and of others which I comprehend not, though I guess what they mean.
uz: Ular qon, gul va boshqa narsalar haqida juda ko'p gapirishadi, men buni tushunmayapman, ammo ularning ma'nosini bilmayman.

en: But never- theless they tell us all things which we want to know.
uz: Ammo ular bizga bilmoqchi bo'lgan hamma narsani aytishmaydi.

en: They make known to us among them, how last afternoon at about ﬁve o'clock comes a man so hurry.
uz: Ular o'zlarining o'rtalarida bizga xabar berishadiki, o'tgan kechqurun soat beshlarda bir kishi shunday shoshilinch kelib qoldi.

en: A tall man, thin and pale, with high nose and teeth so white, and eyes that seem to be burning.
uz: U baland, chiroyli va rang-barang odam edi, o'ta baland burun, oq tishlar va yonayotgan ko'zlar bor edi.

en: That he be all in black, ex- cept that he have a hat of straw which suit not him or the time.
uz: U qora kiyimda bo'lishi kerak, faqat o'ziga va zamonga mos kelmaydigan cho'g'li to'pkasi bor.

en: That he scat- ter his money in making quick inquiry as to what ship sails for the Black Sea and for where.
uz: U o'z pulini qora dengizga qaysi kema va qayerga borayotgani haqida tezkor tekshiruv o'tkazishga sarflaganini aytadi.

en: Some took him to the ofﬁce and then to the ship, where he will not go aboard but halt at shore end of gangplank, and ask that the captain come to him.
uz: Ba'zilar uni ofisga, so'ngra kemaga olib borishdi, u yerda u kemaga o'tirmay, ko'chma yo'nalishning so'ngida to'xtadi va kapitanni uning oldiga kelishini so'raydi.

en: The captain come, when told that he will be pay well, and though he swear much at the ﬁrst he agree to term.
uz: Kapten kelganda, unga yaxshi pul to'lashlari haqida aytilgan va u birinchi marta ko'p qasam ichgan bo'lsa-da, muddatini o'tkazishga rozi bo'lgan.

en: Then the thin man go and some one tell him where horse and cart can be hired.
uz: So'ngra kamolchi borib, kimdir unga ot va arava qaerdan ijaraga olinishi mumkinligini aytadi.

en: He go there and soon he come again, himself driving cart on which a great box.
uz: U o'sha yerga boradi va tez orada yana qaytib keladi, u o'zi katta quti bilan arava haydashadi.

en: This he himself lift down, though it take several to put it on truck for the ship.
uz: Buni u o'zi tushirdi, garchi uni kemaning yuk mashinasiga joylashtirish uchun bir necha marta kerak bo'lsa-da.

en: He give much talk to captain as to how and where his box is to be place.
uz: U kapitan bilan uning quti qanday va qayerda joylashtirilishi haqida ko'p gapiradi.

en: But the captain like it not and swear at him in many tongues, and tell him that if he like he can come and see where it shall be.
uz: Lekin kapitan bunga rozi bo'lmadi va ko'p tillarda qasam ichib, agar xohlasa, qayerga borishini ko'rishga kelishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: But he say `no,' that he come not yet, for that he have much to do.
uz: Lekin u: Yo'q, - deb aytadi va hozircha kelmaganini aytadi, chunki u juda ko'p ish bilan band.

en: Whereupon the captain tell him that he had better be quick, with blood, for that his ship will leave the place, of blood, before the turn of the tide, with blood.
uz: Keyin kapitan unga tezroq, qon bilan ketish kerakligini aytadi, chunki uning kemasi qon bilan ketadi, to'lqin boshlanib ketmasidan oldin.

en: Then the thin man smile and say that of course he must go when he think ﬁt, but he will be surprise if he go quite so soon.
uz: So'ngra kamolotli kishi tabassum qilib, o'zi munosib deb hisoblagan vaqtda ketishi kerakligini aytadi, lekin agar u shuncha tez ketsa, hayron qoladi.

en: The captain swear again, polyglot, and the thin man make him bow, and thank him, and say that he will so far intrude on his kindness as to come aboard before the sailing.
uz: Kapten yana ko'p tilli bo'lib qasam ichadi va kamolchi uni egrilab, minnatdorchilik bildiradi va uning mehribonligiga shunchalik aralashib ketishi kerakligini aytadi.

en: Final the captain, more red than ever, and in more tongues, tell him that he doesn't want no Frenchmen, with
uz: Qizilroq va ko'proq tilda gapirgan kapitan unga hech qanday frantsuzlarni xohlamasligini aytadi.

en: bloom upon them and also with blood, in his ship, with blood on her also.
uz: Ular ustida, shuningdek, uning kemasida, uning ustida qon bilan gullaydi.

en: And so, after asking where he might purchase ship forms, he departed.
uz: Shunday qilib, u kema shaklini qaerdan sotib olish mumkinligini so'raganidan so'ng, jo'nab ketdi.

en: No one knew where he went `or bloomin' well cared' as they said, for they had something else to think of, well with blood again.
uz: U qayerga borganini hech kim bilmasdi `or gullab-yashlab, yaxshi g'amxo'rlik qilgan, deb aytishdi, chunki ular boshqa bir narsa haqida o'ylashlari kerak edi, yana qon bilan.

en: For it soon be- came apparent to all that the Czarina Catherine would not sail as was ex- pected.
uz: Chunki tez orada Charina Ketrin o'z rejalariga muvofiq sayohat qilmasligini hammaga ayon bo'ldi.

en: A thin mist began to creep up from the river, and it grew, and grew.
uz: Daryodan kamroq g'ildirak ko'tarilishni boshladi va u ko'paydi va ko'paydi.

en: Till soon a dense fog enveloped the ship and all around her.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay kemani va uning atrofini to'siq tuman qopladi.

en: The captain swore polyglot, very polyglot, polyglot with bloom and blood, but he could do nothing.
uz: Kapten ko'p tilli, juda ko'p tilli, ko'p tilli, gul va qonli, deb qasam ichdi, ammo u hech narsa qila olmadi.

en: The water rose and rose, and he began to fear that he would lose the tide altogether.
uz: Suv ko'tarilib, ko'tarilib borardi va u to'lqinni butunlay yo'qotishidan qo'rqishni boshladi.

en: He was in no friendly mood, when just at full tide, the thin man came up the gangplank again and asked to see where his box had been stowed.
uz: U do'stona ruhda emas edi, lekin to'liq to'lqin paytida kamolli kishi yana ko'chma qo'lga chiqib, uning quti qaerda qo'yilganini ko'rishni so'radi.

en: Then the captain replied that he wished that he and his box, old and with much bloom and blood, were in hell.
uz: Keyin kapitan o'zi ham, eski, ko'p gul va qonli quti ham jahannamda bo'lishini xohlaganini aytdi.

en: But the thin man did not be offend, and went down with the mate and saw where it was place, and came up and stood awhile on deck in fog.
uz: Lekin kamolchi xatti-harakat qilmay, qo'shnisi bilan pastga tushdi va u qaerda joylashganini ko'rdi va bir muncha vaqt davomida g'ishtda cho'lda turib oldi.

en: He must have come off by him- self, for none notice him.
uz: U o'z-o'zidan chiqib ketgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki hech kim uni ko'rmaydi.

en: Indeed they thought not of him, for soon the fog begin to melt away, and all was clear again.
uz: Darhaqiqat, ular u haqida o'ylamagan edilar, chunki ko'pincha bulut eriy boshladi va hamma narsa yana aniq bo'ldi.

en: My friends of the thirst and the language that was of bloom and blood laughed, as they told how the cap- tain's swears exceeded even his usual polyglot, and was more than ever full of picturesque, when on questioning other mariners who were on movement up and down the river that hour, he found that few of them had seen any of fog at all, except where it lay round the wharf.
uz: O'sha vaqtda daryoga ko'tarilgan va tushayotgan boshqa kemachilarni so'rovga berganda, u o'sha soatlarda ko'pchilikni bulutdan tashqari ko'rmaganini ko'rdi. Kaptenning qasamlari hatto uning odatdagi ko'p tilli so'zlaridan ham ustun bo'lganini va u har qachongidan ham ko'proq chiroyli so'zlar bilan to'lganini aytib berganda, uning do'stlari kulishdi.

en: However, the ship went out on the ebb tide, and was doubtless by morning far down the river mouth.
uz: Biroq, kemada dengiz o'tishi davom etdi va, shubhasiz, ertalabgacha daryo og'zidan pastga tushdi.

en: She was then, when they told us, well out to sea.
uz: Bizga aytganda, u o'sha paytda dengizdan chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: And so, my dear Madam Mina, it is that we have to rest for a time, for our enemy is on the sea, with the fog at his command, on his way to the Danube mouth.
uz: Shu sababli, aziz Madam Mina, biz biroz dam olishimiz kerak, chunki dushmanimiz dengizda, uning qo'lida tuman bo'lib, Donau og'ziga bormoqda.

en: To sail a ship takes time, go she never so quick.
uz: Kemaga sayohat qilish uchun vaqt kerak, u hech qachon bu qadar tez ketmaydi.

en: And when we start to go on land more quick, and we meet him there.
uz: Va biz tezroq qirg'oqqa chiqishni boshlaganimizda va u erda uchrashganimizda.

en: Our best hope is to come on him when in the box between sunrise and sunset.
uz: Bizning eng yaxshi umiddamiz quyosh chiqish va quyosh botish orasidagi kutilmaganda unga duch kelishdir.

en: For then he can make no struggle, and we may deal with him as we should.
uz: Chunki u holda u hech qanday kurash olib bormaydi va biz unga kerakli tarzda munosabatda bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: There are days for us, in which we can make ready our plan.
uz: Biz uchun o'z rejalarimizni tayyorlaydigan kunlar bor.

en: We know all about where he go.
uz: Uning qaerga borayotganini hammamiz bilamiz.

en: For we have seen the owner of the ship, who have shown us invoices and all papers that can be.
uz: Chunki biz kema egasini ko'rdik, u bizga faturalar va barcha hujjatlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: The box we seek is to be landed in Var- na, and to be given to an agent, one Ristics who will there present his cre- dentials.
uz: Biz izlayotgan quti Var-naga tushirilishi va u erda o'z guvohliklarini taqdim etayotgan bir agentga, ristiklarga berilishi kerak.

en: And so our merchant friend will have done his part.
uz: Shunday qilib, bizning savdogar do'stimiz o'z hissasini qo'shgan bo'ladi.

en: When he ask if there be any wrong, for that so, he can telegraph and have inquiry made at
uz: U biron bir xatolik bormi, deb so'raganda, u telegraf orqali xabar berishi va so'rovni o'tkazishi mumkin.

en: Varna, we say `no,' for what is to be done is not for police or of the customs.
uz: Varna, biz deyamiz `no,' chunki bu politsiya yoki bojxona uchun qilinmaydi.

en: It must be done by us alone and in our own way. When Dr.
uz: Bu faqat biz o'zimiz va o'z yo'limizda amalga oshirilishi kerak.

en: Van Helsing had done speaking, I asked him if he were certain that the Count had remained on board the ship.
uz: Van Helsing gapirganidan so'ng, men undan Count kemada qolganligiga aminligini so'radim.

en: He replied, We have the best proof of that, your own evidence, when in the hypnotic trance this morning. I asked him again if it were really necessary that they should pursue the Count, for oh!
uz: U shunday javob berdi: Bizda bu haqda eng yaxshi dalil bor, bu ertalabgi hipnotik transda bo'lganingizda, sizning o'zingizning dalilingiz bor. Men undan yana bir bor Countni quvg'in qilishlari kerakmi, deb so'radim, chunki oh!

en: I dread Jonathan leaving me, and I know that he would sure- ly go if the others went.
uz: Jonatan meni tashlab ketayotganidan qo'rqaman va boshqalar ketsa, albatta ketishini bilaman.

en: He answered in growing passion, at ﬁrst quietly.
uz: U o'sib borayotgan ishtiyoq bilan javob berdi, boshida esa xotirjamlik bilan.

en: As he went on, however, he grew more angry and more forceful, till in the end we could not but see wherein was at least some of that personal dominance which made him so long a master amongst men.
uz: Biroq, u davom etgani sayin, g'azablanib, kuchliroq bo'ldi va oxir-oqibat biz uni uzoq vaqtdan beri odamlar orasida ustun bo'lgan, hech bo'lmaganda, ba'zi bir shaxsiy ustunlik qayerda ekanligini ko'rishga muvaffaq bo'ldik.

en: Yes, it is necessary, necessary, necessary!
uz: Ha, kerak, kerak, kerak!

en: For your sake in the ﬁrst, and then for the sake of humanity.
uz: Avval o'zingiz uchun, so'ngra insoniyat uchun.

en: This monster has done much harm already, in the narrow scope where he ﬁnd himself, and in the short time when as yet he was only as a body groping his so small measure in darkness and not knowing.
uz: Bu jondor o'zini topgan eng chiroyli joyda va qisqa vaqt ichida juda ko'p zarar ko'rsatdi, hozircha u zulmatda o'zining juda kichik o'lchamini tutib o'tirgan va o'zini bilmagan bir tana edi.

en: All this have I told these others.
uz: Bularning barchasini boshqalarga aytdim.

en: You, my dear Madam Mina, will learn it in the phonograph of my friend John, or in that of your husband.
uz: Siz, mening aziz xonim Mina, buni do'stim Jonning fonografidan yoki eringizning fonografidan o'rganasiz.

en: I have told them how the measure of leaving his own barren land, barren of peoples,and coming to a new land where life of man teems till they are like the multitude of standing corn, was the work of centuries.
uz: Men ularga o'zlarining beva yerlarini, xalqlarning beva yerlarini tashlab, odamlarning hayoti to'lib-toshadigan yangi yurtga kelishining qadri qanday bo'lganini aytib berdim, bu asrlar davomida sodir bo'lgan.

en: Were another of the Undead, like him, to try to do what he has done, perhaps not all the cen- turies of the world that have been, or that will be, could aid him.
uz: Agar u kabi o'lganlardan biri ham o'zi qilgan ishni bajarishga harakat qilsa, ehtimol, dunyodagi barcha o'lgan yoki bo'lajak o'liklar unga yordam bera olmaydi.

en: With this one, all the forces of nature that are occult and deep and strong must have worked together in some wonderous way.
uz: Bu bilan tabiatning barcha sehrli, chuqur va kuchli kuchlari ajoyib tarzda hamkorlik qilgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: The very place, where he have been alive, Undead for all these centuries, is full of strangeness of the geo- logic and chemical world.
uz: U tirik bo'lgan, o'lgan o'liklar kabi bu asrlar davomida yashagan joy geo-logika va kimyoviy dunyoning g'ayritabiiyligi bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: There are deep caverns and ﬁssures that reach none know whither.
uz: Bu yerda chuqur g'orlar va bo'g'riliklar bor, ular qayerga borishini hech kim bilmaydi.

en: There have been volcanoes, some of whose openings still send out waters of strange properties, and gases that kill or make to viv- ify.
uz: Volkanlar paydo bo'ldi, ularning ba'zi ochilishlari hali ham g'alati xususiyatlarga ega suvlarni va o'ldiradigan yoki tiriklashtiradigan gazlarni yuboradi.

en: Doubtless, there is something magnetic or electric in some of these combinations of occult forces which work for physical life in strange way, and in himself were from the ﬁrst some great qualities.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu sehrli kuchlarning ba'zi kombinatsiyalarida jismoniy hayot uchun g'ayrioddiy tarzda ishlaydigan maqnit yoki elektr bir narsa bor va u o'zida dastlabkilardan boshlab ba'zi ajoyib fazilatlar bor edi.

en: In a hard and war- like time he was celebrate that he have more iron nerve, more subtle brain, more braver heart, than any man.
uz: Qattiq va urush kabi davrda u har qanday odamdan ko'ra ko'proq temir g'azabga, yanada nozik miyaga, jasoratli yurakga ega ekanligini nishonlagan.

en: In him some vital principle have in strange way found their utmost.
uz: Undan ba'zi muhim prinsiplar o'zlarining eng yuqori sifatini topishgan.

en: And as his body keep strong and grow and thrive, so his brain grow too.
uz: Va uning tanasi mustahkam bo'lib, o'sib-ulg'ayib, rivojlanayotgan bo'lsa, miyasi ham o'sib-ulg'ayadi.

en: All this without that diabolic aid which is surely to him.
uz: Bularning barchasi, albatta, unga kerak bo'lgan shayton yordami bo'lmaganda bo'ladi.

en: For it have to yield to the powers that come from, and are,
uz: Chunki u kelib chiqadigan va mavjud bo'lgan kuchlarga bo'ysunishi kerak,

en: And now this is what he is to us.
uz: Endi esa U biz uchun shunday.

en: He have infect you, oh forgive me, my dear, that I must say such, but it is for good of you that I speak.
uz: U sizni yuqtirgan, oh, kechiring, azizim, shunday aytishim kerak, lekin men siz uchun gapiryapman.

en: He infect you in such wise, that even if he do no more, you have only to live, to live in your own old, sweet way, and so in time, death, which is of man's common lot and with God's sanction, shall make you like to him.
uz: U sizni shunday yuqtiradiki, agar u boshqa bunday qilmasa ham, siz faqat o'zingizning eski, sevimli yo'lingizda yashashingiz kerak, va vaqt o'tib, odamning odatiy va Xudoning marhamatiga ega bo'lgan o'lim sizni Unga yoqtiradi.

en: We have sworn together that it must not.
uz: Biz birgalikda qasam ichdikki, bunday bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: Thus are we ministers of God's own wish.
uz: Shunday qilib, bizlar Xudoning irodasini bajaruvchi xizmatkorlarmiz.

en: That the world, and men for whom His Son die, will not be given over to monsters, whose very existence would defame Him.
uz: Dunyo va Uning O'g'li uchun o'lgan odamlar, o'zlarining mavjudligi bilan Uni haqoratlaydigan sehrgarlarga berilmasligi haqida.

en: He have allowed us to redeem one soul already, and we go out as the old knights of the Cross to redeem more.
uz: U bizga allaqachon bitta jonni sotib olishga ruxsat berdi va biz eski Xoch shohlari sifatida ko'proq jonni sotib olish uchun chiqamiz.

en: Like them we shall travel towards the sunrise.
uz: Ular kabi biz ham quyosh chiqish tomon sayohat qilamiz.

en: And like them, if we fall, we fall in good cause. He paused and I said, But will not the Count take his rebuff wisely?
uz: Va ular kabi, agar biz tushsak, yaxshi sabab bilan tushamiz. U to'xtadi va men: Ammo Count o'z radini oqilona qabul qilmaydi?

en: Since he has been driven from England, will he not avoid it, as a tiger does the village from which he has been hunted? Aha! he said, your simile of the tiger good, for me, and I shall adopt him.
uz: U Angliyadan quvg'in qilinganidan so'ng, o'z ov qilingan qishloqga bir o'g'il o'g'li kabi qochadi, deb o'ylamasmi? - Ha, - dedi u. - O'g'il haqidagi masalingiz menga yaxshi, men uni farzandlikka oldim.

en: Your maneater, as they of India call the tiger who has once tasted blood of the human, care no more for the other prey, but prowl unceasing till he get him.
uz: Hindistonliklar bir marta insoniyat qonini tatib ko'rgan sher deb atashgani kabi, sizning mashqchiingiz boshqa qotilga g'amxo'rlik qilmay, uni tutmaguncha to'xtamay yuradi.

en: This that we hunt from our village is a tiger, too, a maneater, and he never cease to prowl.
uz: O'z qishlog'imizdan ovlayotgan bu kishi ham bir sher, bir maneater va u hech qachon to'xtamaydi.

en: Nay, in himself he is not one to retire and stay afar.
uz: Yo'q, u o'z-o'zidan ketib, uzoqda qolishga o'xshamaydi.

en: In his life, his living life, he go over the Turkey frontier and attack his enemy on his own ground.
uz: O'z hayotida, o'z hayotida u Turkiyaning chegarasini o'tib, dushmanini o'z hududida hujum qiladi.

en: He be beaten back, but did he stay?
uz: U o'zini qaytardi, lekin u qoldimi?

en: He come again, and again, and again.
uz: U qayta-qayta, qayta-qayta, qayta-qayta keladi.

en: Look at his persistence and endurance.
uz: Uning sabr-toqat va chidamliligiga e'tibor bering.

en: With the child-brain that was to him he have long since conceive the idea of coming to a great city.
uz: Uning bolalik miyasi bilan u allaqachon buyuk shaharga kelish g'oyasiga ega bo'ldi.

en: He ﬁnd out the place of all the world most of promise for him.
uz: U butun dunyodagi eng va'da beruvchi o'rinni topadi.

en: Then he deliberately set himself down to prepare for the task.
uz: Keyin u o'zini tasodif uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun o'zini bila turib joylashtirdi.

en: He ﬁnd in patience just how is his strength, and what are his powers.
uz: U sabr-toqat bilan o'z kuch-quvvatini va kuch-qudratini topadi.

en: He study new tongues.
uz: U yangi tillarni o'rganadi.

en: He learn new social life, new envi- ronment of old ways, the politics, the law, the ﬁnance, the science, the habit of a new land and a new people who have come to be since he was.
uz: U yangi ijtimoiy hayotni, eski yo'llarning yangi muhitini, siyosat, qonun, moliya, fan, yangi yurt va yangi xalqning odatini o'rganadi.

en: His glimpse that he have had, whet his appetite only and enkeen his desire.
uz: U ko'rgan ko'rinish faqat uning istaklarini uyg'otadi va istaklarini to'ldiradi.

en: Nay, it help him to grow as to his brain.
uz: Aksincha, bu uning miyasi o'sishiga yordam beradi.

en: For it all prove to him how right he was at the ﬁrst in his surmises.
uz: Chunki bularning barchasi unga o'z taxminlarida birinchi bo'lib qanchalik to'g'ri bo'lganini isbotlaydi.

en: He have done this alone, all alone!
uz: U buni yolg'iz, yolg'iz qildi!

en: From a ruin tomb in a forgotten land.
uz: Unutilgan yurtdagi vayronliklar qabridan.

en: What more may he not do when the greater world of thought is open to him.
uz: U uchun katta fikrlash dunyosi ochiq bo'lganda, yana nima qilmasligi mumkin.

en: He that can smile at death, as we know him.
uz: O'limga tabassum qila oladigan, biz Uni tanib-bilganimiz kabi.

en: Who can ﬂourish in the midst of diseases that kill off whole peoples.
uz: Ular butun xalqlarni o'ldiradigan kasalliklar orasida gullab-yashnashlari mumkin.

en: If such an one was to come from God, and not the Devil, what a force for good might he not be in this old world of ours.
uz: Agar bunday kishi Iblis emas, balki Xudodan kelgan bo'lsa, unda u bizning eski dunyomizda qandaydir yaxshilik kuchi bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: But we are pledged to set the
uz: Ammo biz o'zimizni belgilashga va'da beramiz.

en: Our toil must be in silence, and our efforts all in secret.
uz: Bizning zahmatimiz va harakatlarimiz yashirin bo'lishi kerak.

en: For in this enlightened age, when men believe not even what they see, the doubt- ing of wise men would be his greatest strength.
uz: Chunki bu yorug'lik davrida, odamlar hatto ko'rganlariga ishonmaydigan paytda, donolarning shubhalari uning eng katta qudratidir.

en: It would be at once his sheath and his armor, and his weapons to destroy us, his enemies, who are willing to peril even our own souls for the safety of one we love.
uz: Bizni, hatto o'z jonlarimizni ham xavf ostiga qo'yishga tayyor bo'lgan dushmanlarini yo'q qilish uchun, uning qo'li, qurol-yarog'i va qurol-yarog'i bir vaqtning o'zida uning qovurishi kerak edi.

en: For the good of mankind, and for the honor and glory of God. After a general discussion it was determined that for tonight nothing be deﬁnitely settled.
uz: Insoniyatning foydasi uchun, shuningdek, Xudoning sharafi va ulug'vorligi uchun. Umumiy muhokamalardan so'ng, bu kecha uchun hech narsa aniq hal qilinmasligi aniq qaror qilindi.

en: That we should all sleep on the facts, and try to think out the proper conclusions.
uz: Biz hammamiz faktlar ustida uxlashimiz va kerakli xulosalarni o'ylab topishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: Tomorrow, at breakfast, we are to meet again, and after making our conclusions known to one another, we shall decide on some deﬁnite cause of action … I feel a wonderful peace and rest tonight.
uz: Ertaga, kechki ovqat paytida, biz yana uchrashamiz va xulosalarimizni bir-birimizga ma'lum qilgandan so'ng, harakatning aniq sababi haqida qaror qilamiz ... Men bu kecha ajoyib tinchlik va dam olishni his qilaman.

en: It is as if some haunting pres- ence were removed from me.
uz: O'zimdan ba'zi kulfatlar olib tashlangan bo'lsa kerak.

en: Perhaps … My surmise was not ﬁnished, could not be, for I caught sight in the mir- ror of the red mark upon my forehead, and I knew that I was still unclean.
uz: Ehtimol... Mening taxminim tugamay qolgan bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki oldimda o'rnatilgan qizil belgi ko'rinishida ko'rishim mumkin edi va men hali ham nopok ekanligimni bilardim.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 5 October.—We all arose early, and I think that sleep did much for each and all of us.
uz: SEWARDning 5 oktyabr kuni yorlig'i.Biz hammamiz erta uyg'ondik va uyqu hammamiz uchun katta ahamiyatga ega deb o'ylayman.

en: When we met at early breakfast there was more general cheer- fulness than any of us had ever expected to experience again.
uz: Erta tushlik paytida uchrashganimizda, biz hech kim o'ylaganidan ko'ra ko'proq quvonch paydo bo'ldi.

en: It is really wonderful how much resilience there is in human nature.
uz: Inson tabiati qanchalik chidamli ekanligi juda ajablanarli.

en: Let any obstructing cause, no matter what, be removed in any way, even by death, and we ﬂy back to ﬁrst principles of hope and enjoyment.
uz: Har qanday to'sqinlik qiluvchi sabab, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, har qanday yo'l bilan, hatto o'lim bilan ham bartaraf etilsin va biz umid va zavqning ilk prinsiplariga qaytamiz.

en: More than once as we sat around the table, my eyes opened in wonder whether the whole of the past days had not been a dream.
uz: Bir necha marta dasturxon atrofida o'tirganimizda, o'tgan kunlarning barchasi orzu bo'lmagan-ku, deb ko'zlarim ochildi.

en: It was only when I caught sight of the red blotch on Mrs.
uz: Bu faqat Mrs.ning qizil burchakini ko'rganimda sodir bo'ldi.

en: Harker's forehead that I was brought back to reality.
uz: Harkerning oldiga qarab, men haqiqatga qaytdim.

en: Even now, when I am gravely revolving the matter, it is almost im- possible to realize that the cause of all our trouble is still existent.
uz: Hatto hozir, men bu mavzuni jiddiy o'zgartirganimda ham, barcha muammolarimizning sababi hali ham mavjudligini anglash deyarli mumkin emas.

en: Harker seems to lose sight of her trouble for whole spells.
uz: Harker butun mashhurlik uchun o'z muammolarini ko'zdan kechirayotgandek tuyuladi.

en: It is only now and again, when something recalls it to her mind, that she thinks of her terrible scar.
uz: Faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan, biror narsa uni esga solganda, u o'zining dahshatli yara haqida o'ylaydi.

en: We are to meet here in my study in half an hour and decide on our course of action.
uz: Yarim soatdan keyin mening studiyamda uchrashamiz va o'z yo'limizni belgilab olamiz.

en: I see only one immediate difﬁculty, I know it by in- stinct rather than reason.
uz: Men faqat bir xil qiyinchilikni ko'ryapman, uni sababdan emas, o'z instinktim bilan bilaman.

en: We shall all have to speak frankly.
uz: Biz hammamiz ochiqchasiga gapirishimiz kerak.

en: And yet I fear that in some mysterious way poor Mrs.
uz: Lekin men qo'rqamanki, g'ayritabiiy tarzda kambag'al xonimning o'zi ham shunday bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Harker's tongue is tied.
uz: Harkerning tili bog'langan.

en: I know that she forms conclusions of her own, and from all that has been I can guess how brilliant and how true they must be.
uz: Men uning o'z xulosalarini chiqarishini bilaman va bularning barchasidan shuni bilamanki, ular qanchalik ajoyib va qanchalik haq bo'lishi kerak.

en: But she will not, or cannot, give them utterance.
uz: Ammo u ularga gapirishni istamaydi yoki qila olmaydi.

en: I have mentioned this to Van Helsing, and he and I are to talk it over when we are alone.
uz: Men bu haqda Van Helsinga aytib o'tgan edim va biz yolg'iz bo'lganimizda bu haqda gaplashamiz.

en: I suppose it is some of that horrid poison
uz: O'ylaymanki, bu o'sha dahshatli zaharning bir qismi.

en: which has got into her veins beginning to work.
uz: Bu uning damarlariga kirib, ish boshladi.

en: The Count had his own purposes when he gave her what Van Helsing called the Vampire's baptism of blood. Well, there may be a poison that distills itself out of good things.
uz: Count Van Helsing unga Vampirning qonli suvga cho'mish deb atagan narsasini berganida o'z maqsadi bor edi.

en: In an age when the existence of ptomaines is a mystery we should not won- der at anything!
uz: Ptomainlar mavjudligi sir bo'lgan davrda biz hech narsaga ishonmasligimiz kerak!

en: One thing I know, that if my instinct be true regarding poor Mrs.
uz: Bir narsani bilaman, agar men kambag'al Xonimga nisbatan istaklarim to'g'ri bo'lsa.

en: Harker's silences, then there is a terrible difﬁculty, an unknown dan- ger, in the work before us.
uz: Harkerning ovozi sust bo'lsa, unda oldimizdagi ishda dahshatli qiyinchilik, noma'lum bir mashhurlik bor.

en: The same power that compels her silence may compel her speech.
uz: O'zini sust tutishga majburlaydigan kuch uning nutqini ham majburlashi mumkin.

en: I dare not think further, for so I should in my thoughts dishonor a noble woman!
uz: Bundan tashqari o'ylashga jur'at qilmayman, chunki men o'ylaymanki, shunday qilib, bir nobel ayolga shahvatsizlik qilishim kerak!

en: Later.—When the Professor came in, we talked over the state of things.
uz: Keyinroq.Professor kirganida, biz vaziyatni muhokama qildik.

en: I could see that he had something on his mind, which he wanted to say, but felt some hesitancy about broaching the subject.
uz: Uning o'ylasida biror narsa borligini ko'rardim, u aytmoqchi edi, lekin mavzuni muhokama qilishdan umuman shubha qilardi.

en: After beating about the bush a little, he said,Friend John, there is something that you and I must talk of alone, just at the ﬁrst at any rate.
uz: Ozgina cho'qqisdan so'ng, u shunday dedi: Do'st Jon, siz va men alohida gapirishimiz kerak bo'lgan bir narsa bor, hech bo'lmaganda birinchi marta.

en: Later, we may have to take the oth- ers into our conﬁdence. Then he stopped, so I waited.
uz: Keyin esa boshqalarni o'zimizga ishonib topishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin. Keyin u to'xtadi, shuning uchun men kutdim.

en: He went on, Madam Mina, our poor, dear Madam Mina is changing. A cold shiver ran through me to ﬁnd my worst fears thus endorsed.
uz: U davom etdi: Madam Mina, kambag'al, aziz Madam Mina o'zgarib bormoqda. Mening eng yomon qo'rquvlarim shu tariqa tasdiqlanishini topish uchun meni sovuq titroq o'tkazdi.

en: Van Helsing continued.
uz: Van Helsing davom etdi. Van Helsing davom etdi.

en: With the sad experience of Miss Lucy, we must this time be warned be- fore things go too far.
uz: Lusi xonimning qayg'uli tajribasi bilan biz bu safar ogohlantirilgan bo'lishimiz kerak, chunki bu juda uzoq davom etadi.

en: Our task is now in reality more difﬁcult than ever, and this new trouble makes every hour of the direst importance.
uz: Bizning vazifamiz hozir har qachongidan ham qiyinroq va bu yangi muammo har bir soatni eng katta ahamiyatga ega qiladi.

en: I can see the characteristics of the vampire coming in her face.
uz: Uning yuziga vampirning xususiyatlarini ko'rishim mumkin.

en: It is now but very, very slight.
uz: Hozir esa u juda, juda kichik.

en: But it is to be seen if we have eyes to notice without prejudge.
uz: Ammo biz ko'zimiz bilan ko'rib, oldindan o'ylamasdan e'tibor bersak, bu ko'rinadi.

en: Her teeth are sharper, and at times her eyes are more hard.
uz: Uning tishlari keskinroq va ba'zan ko'zlari qattiqroq.

en: But these are not all, there is to her the silence now often, as so it was with Miss Lucy.
uz: Ammo bularning hammasi emas, hozir ko'pincha Miss Luzi bilan sodir bo'lganidek, uning uchun sukut saqlanadi.
