en: She did not speak, even when she wrote that which she wished to be known lat- er.
uz: Hatto oxirgi kunlarda o'zi mashhur bo'lishni istagan narsalarni yozganida ham u gapirmagan.

en: Now my fear is this.
uz: Endi mening qo'rquvim shu.

en: If it be that she can, by our hypnotic trance, tell what the Count see and hear, is it not more true that he who have hypnotize her ﬁrst, and who have drink of her very blood and make her drink of his, should if he will, compel her mind to disclose to him that which she know? I nodded acquiescence.
uz: Agar u bizning hipnotik transimiz orqali Countning ko'rgan va eshitganlarini aytishi mumkin bo'lsa, unda birinchi bo'lib uni hipnoz qilgan, uning qonidan ichgan va uni o'z qonidan ichtirgan kishi, agar xohlasa, uning ongini unga bilganini aytishga majbur qilishi kerak emasmi?

en: He went on, Then, what we must do is to pre- vent this.
uz: U davom etdi: O'shanda biz buni oldini olishimiz kerak.

en: We must keep her ignorant of our intent, and so she cannot tell what she know not.
uz: Biz uni niyatlarimizdan bexabar qoldirishimiz kerak, shuning uchun u bilmaganini aytishi mumkin emas.

en: This is a painful task!
uz: Bu og'ir ish!

en: Oh, so painful that it heartbreak me to think of it, but it must be.
uz: Oh, bu shunchalik og'riqlidirki, bu haqda o'ylash yuragimni og'irlaydi, lekin shunday bo'lishi kerak.

en: When today we meet, I must tell her that for reason which we will not to speak she must not more be of our council, but be simply guarded by us.
uz: Bugun uchrashganimizda, men unga aytishim kerakki, biz gapirishni xohlamagan sabablarga ko'ra, u endi bizning kengashimizdan bo'lmasligi kerak, balki shunchaki biz tomonidan qo'riqlanishi kerak.

en: He wiped his forehead, which had broken out in profuse perspiration at the thought of the pain which he might have to inﬂict upon the poor soul already so tortured.
uz: O'zining qahr-qahrini o'chirib tashladi, chunki u allaqachon azob chekkan kambag'al ruhga yetkazishi kerak bo'lgan og'riq haqida o'ylagani uchun juda ko'p ter bilan puchga chiqdi.

en: I knew that it would be some sort of comfort to him if I told him that I also had come to the same conclusion.
uz: O'zim ham xuddi shunday xulosaga kelganimni aytish unga tasalli baxsh etishini bilardim.

en: For at any rate it would take away the pain of doubt.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda, shubhaning og'rig'ini yo'q qiladi.

en: I told him, and the effect was as I expected.
uz: Men unga aytdim va natijasi kutilganimdek bo'ldi.

en: It is now close to the time of our general gathering.
uz: Endi umumiy yig'ilishimiz vaqti yaqinlashib qoldi.

en: Van Helsing has gone away to prepare for the meeting, and his painful part of it.
uz: Van Helsing uchrashuvga va uning og'ir qismiga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun ketib ketdi.

en: I really believe his purpose is to be able to pray alone.
uz: Men uning maqsadi yolg'iz ibodat qilish ekanligiga ishonaman.

en: Later.—At the very outset of our meeting a great personal relief was ex- perienced by both Van Helsing and myself.
uz: Keyinroq.Biz uchrashuvning boshida katta shaxsiy yengillik bor edi.Van Helsing ham, men ham.

en: Harker had sent a message by her husband to say that she would not join us at present, as she thought it better that we should be free to discuss our movements without her pres- ence to embarrass us.
uz: Harker eridan xabar yuborib, hozir u bizga qo'shilmasligini aytdi, chunki u o'zi uchun biz o'z harakatlarimizni erkin muhokama qilishimiz kerak deb o'ylagan edi.

en: The Professor and I looked at each other for an in- stant, and somehow we both seemed relieved.
uz: Professor bilan biroz bir-birimizga ko'z tikdik va ikkimiz ham xotirjam bo'ldik.

en: For my own part, I thought that if Mrs.
uz: O'zim uchun esa, agar xonimning o'zi ham shunday bo'lsa, deb o'yladim.

en: Harker realized the danger herself, it was much pain as well as much danger averted.
uz: Harker xavf-xatarni o'zi tushunib yetdi, bu juda ko'p og'riq edi va xavf-xatarning ko'pligi oldini olindi.

en: Under the circumstances we agreed, by a questioning look and answer, with ﬁnger on lip, to preserve silence in our suspicions, until we should have been able to confer alone again.
uz: Bunday sharoitlarda biz, savol-javob bilan, og'zaki barmoq bilan, yolg'iz gapirishimiz mumkin bo'lgunga qadar, shubhalarimizda xotirjamlikni saqlab qolishga rozi bo'ldik.

en: We went at once into our Plan of Campaign.
uz: Biz darhol kampaniya rejasini ishga tushirdik.

en: Van Helsing roughly put the facts before us ﬁrst,The Czarina Catherine left the Thames yesterday morning.
uz: Van Helsing taxminan haqiqatni bizga birinchi o'ringa qo'ydi: Czarina Ketrin kecha ertalab Temis daryosidan jo'nab ketdi.

en: It will take her at the quickest speed she has ever made at least three weeks to reach Varna.
uz: U Varnaga yetib borish uchun hech bo'lmaganda uch haftadan ortiq vaqtni sarflaydi.

en: But we can travel over- land to the same place in three days.
uz: Ammo uch kun ichida bir joyga ko'chishni va quruqlikdan sayohat qilishimiz mumkin.

en: Now, if we allow for two days less for the ship's voyage, owing to such weather inﬂuences as we know that the Count can bring to bear, and if we allow a whole day and night for any de- lays which may occur to us, then we have a margin of nearly two weeks.
uz: Endi, agar biz kema sayohatining ikki kunini kamaytirishga ruxsat bersak, chunki count o'z vaqtida amalga oshirishi mumkin bo'lgan ob-havo ta'sirlari tufayli, agar biz biz bilan sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday qiyinchiliklar uchun butun kun va kechaga ruxsat bersak, unda bizda deyarli ikki hafta qoldiq.

en: Thus, in order to be quite safe, we must leave here on 17th at latest.
uz: Shunday qilib, xavfsiz bo'lish uchun biz kamida 17-da bu yerdan ketishimiz kerak.

en: Then we shall at any rate be in Varna a day before the ship arrives, and able to make such preparations as may be necessary.
uz: Shunday bo'lsa-da, kemaning kelishidan bir kun oldin Varna shahrida bo'lamiz va kerakli tayyorgarlik ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: Of course we shall all go armed, armed against evil things, spiritual as well as physical. Here Quincey Morris added,I understand that the Count comes from a wolf country, and it may be that he shall get there before us.
uz: Albatta, biz hammamiz yovuzlik, ma'naviy va jismoniy narsalarga qarshi qurol bilan harakat qilamiz. Bu yerda Quincey Morris qo'shimcha qilib shunday dedi: Mening tushunchimchaga ko'ra, hidoyatchi bo'ri mamlakatidan kelib chiqqan va u bizdan ilgari o'sha yerga yetib borishi mumkin.

en: I propose that we add Winchesters to our armament.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, o'z qurollarimizga Winchesterlarni qo'shishimiz kerak.

en: I have a kind of belief in a Win- chester when there is any trouble of that sort around.
uz: Bu kabi muammolar bo'lganda Win-chesterga ishonaman.

en: Do you remember, Art, when we had the pack after us at Tobolsk?
uz: Art, Tobolskda o'zimizdan orqaga to'plangan to'plamni eslaysizmi?

en: What wouldn't we have giv- en then for a repeater apiece!
uz: O'sha paytda bizda har bir repeater uchun nima bo'lmas edi!

en: Good! said Van Helsing, Winchesters it shall be.
uz: Yaxshi! dedi Van Helsing, U Winchester bo'ladi.

en: Quincey's head is level at times, but most so when there is to hunt, metaphor be more dishon- or to science than wolves be of danger to man.
uz: Quinceyning boshi ba'zan tekis bo'ladi, lekin ov qilish uchun metaforalar odam uchun o'tlar xavfli bo'lganidan ko'ra, ilm-fan uchun ko'proq haqoratli yoki nafratli bo'lishi kerak.

en: In the meantime we can do nothing here.
uz: Shu paytgacha biz bu yerda hech narsa qila olmaymiz.

en: And as I think that Varna is not familiar to any of us, why not go there more soon?
uz: Va menimcha, Varna bizlardan hech kimga tanish emas, shuning uchun nima uchun tezroq u yerga bormasligimiz kerak?

en: It is as long to wait here as there.
uz: Bu erda ham, u erda ham uzoq vaqt kutish kerak.

en: Tonight and tomor- row we can get ready, and then if all be well, we four can set out on our journey. We four? said Harker interrogatively, looking from one to another of us.
uz: Bugun va ertaga tayyorgarlik ko'rishimiz mumkin va agar hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lsa, to'rttalamiz sayohatni boshlashimiz mumkin. - To'rttalamizmi? - dedi Harker so'rovchi qilib, bir-birimizga qarab.

en: Of course! answered the Professor quickly.
uz: Agar bo'lmasa! - deb javob berdi professor tezda.

en: You must remain to take care of your so sweet wife! Harker was silent for awhile and then said in a hollow voice, Let us talk of that part of it in the morning.
uz: Harker bir muncha vaqt sukut saqlashdi, so'ngra o'tkir ovoz bilan dedi: Shuning bu qismini ertalab muhokama qilaylik.

en: I want to consult with Mina. I thought that now was the time for Van Helsing to warn him not to dis- close our plan to her, but he took no notice.
uz: Men Mina bilan maslahatlashmoqchiman. Men Van Helsingning unga rejalarimizni aytmaslikka ogohlantirish vaqti keldi deb o'yladim, lekin u bunga e'tibor bermadi.

en: I looked at him signiﬁcantly and coughed.
uz: Men unga diqqat bilan qaratib, qo'shni tutdim.

en: For answer he put his ﬁnger to his lips and turned away.
uz: Javob uchun u o'z barmog'ini og'ziga qo'ydi va yuz o'girdi.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL October, afternoon.—For some time after our meeting this morning I could not think.
uz: Jonatan Harkerning oktyabr kuni yorug'lik kuni.Bugun ertalab uchrashuvimizdan keyin bir muncha vaqt davomida men o'ylay olmaganman.

en: The new phases of things leave my mind in a state of won- der which allows no room for active thought.
uz: Vaziyatlarning yangi bosqichlari ongimni faol o'ylashga imkon bermaydigan bir holatda qoldiradi.

en: Mina's determination not to take any part in the discussion set me thinking.
uz: Mina muhokamada hech qanday ishtirok etmaslik qarori meni o'ylashga undadi.

en: And as I could not argue the matter with her, I could only guess.
uz: Men u bilan bahslasholmasdim, shuning uchun faqat taxmin qilishim mumkin edi.

en: I am as far as ever from a solution now.
uz: Men hozir hech qachon echimdan uzoq emasman.

en: The way the others received it, too puzzled me.
uz: Boshqalar buni qanday qabul qilishgani meni ham hayratda qoldirdi.

en: The last time we talked of the subject we agreed that there was to be no more concealment of anything amongst us.
uz: So'nggi marta bu mavzu haqida gapirganimizda, o'zaro hech qanday narsani yashirmaslikka rozi bo'ldik.

en: Mina is sleeping now, calmly and sweetly like a little child.
uz: Mina endi uxlaydi, xotirjamlik va go'zallik bilan kichkina bola kabi.

en: Her lips are curved and her face beams with happiness.
uz: Uning og'izlari egri, yuzi baxtli.

en: Thank God, there are such moments still for her.
uz: Xudoga shukr, u uchun hali ham shunday paytlar bor.

en: Later.—How strange it all is.
uz: Keyinroq.Bularning barchasi qanchalik g'alati.

en: I sat watching Mina's happy sleep, and I came as near to being happy myself as I suppose I shall ever be.
uz: Men Minaning baxtli uyqusini kuzatib o'tirdim va o'zim ham baxtli bo'lishga juda yaqin bo'ldim, deb o'ylayman.

en: As the evening drew on, and the earth took its shadows from the sun sinking lower, the silence of the room grew more and more solemn to me.
uz: Kechqurun kechasi o'tib, quyosh botayotganidan ko'ngillari yerga tushgani sayin, xonaning sessizligi men uchun yanada jiddiyroq bo'ldi.

en: All at once Mina opened her eyes, and looking at me tenderly said, Jonathan, I want you to promise me something on your word of honor.
uz: O'sha zahoti Mina ko'zlarini ochdi va menga ko'z tikib: Jonatan, menga bir narsa va'da berishingni istayman.

en: A promise made to me, but made holily in God's hearing, and not to be broken though I should go down on my knees and implore you with bitter tears.
uz: Menga qilingan va'da, lekin Xudoning quloqida muqaddas bo'lgan va bu va'da buzilmasligi kerak edi, chunki men tiz cho'kib, achchiq ko'z yoshlar bilan Sendan iltijo qilaman.

en: Quick, you must make it to me at once.
uz: Tez, darhol menga yetkazishingiz kerak.

en: Mina, I said, a promise like that, I cannot make at once.
uz: Men, - dedim men, - shunday va'da berolmayman.

en: I may have no right to make it. But, dear one, she said, with such spiritual intensity that her eyes were like pole stars, it is I who wish it.
uz: Ehtimol, men buni qilishga haqim yo'qdir. - Ammo, aziz qizim, - dedi u, shunchalik ma'naviy kuch bilan, uning ko'zlari qutb yulduzlari kabi edi, - bu mening xohishim.

en: And it is not for myself.
uz: Va bu men uchun emas.

en: Van Helsing if I am not right.
uz: Men haqli bo'lmasam, Van Helsing.

en: If he disagrees you may do as you will.
uz: Agar u bunga rozi bo'lmasa, siz xohlaganingizni qila olasiz.

en: Nay, more if you all agree, later you are absolved from the promise. I promise! I said, and for a moment she looked supremely happy.
uz: Aksincha, agar hammangiz bunga rozi bo'lsangiz, keyinchalik va'daningizdan ozod bo'lasiz. - Men va'da beraman! - dedim men va bir zumda u nihoyatda baxtli ko'rindi.

en: Though to me all happiness for her was denied by the red scar on her forehead.
uz: Garchi mening fikrimcha, uning peshanasidagi qizil yara tufayli u baxtli bo'lmagan.

en: She said, Promise me that you will not tell me anything of the plans formed for the campaign against the Count.
uz: U shunday dedi: Menga Countga qarshi kampaniyani amalga oshirish bo'yicha tuzilgan rejalar haqida hech narsa aytmasligingizga va'da bering.

en: Not by word, or inference, or implication, not at any time whilst this remains to me! And she solemnly pointed to the scar.
uz: So'z, xulosa yoki ta'kidlash orqali emas, men bu haqda o'ylayotganimcha, hech qachon emas! - dedi va u marraga e'tiborli ravishda ishora qildi.

en: I saw that she was in earnest, and said solemnly, I promise! and as I said it I felt that from that instant a door had been shut between us.
uz: Uning chin dildan gapirganini ko'rib, Shubhasiz! deb so'zladim va gapirganimda, o'sha paytdan boshlab o'zimiz o'rtasida eshik yopilganini his qildim.

en: Later, midnight.—Mina has been bright and cheerful all the evening.
uz: Keyingi kecha, yarim kechada.Men butun kecha yorqin va quvonchli bo'lganman.

en: So much so that all the rest seemed to take courage, as if infected somewhat with her gaiety.
uz: Shunday qilib, qolganlarning hammasi jasoratga ega bo'lishdi, xuddi uning shodligi bilan biroz kasal bo'lib ketgandek.

en: As a result even I myself felt as if the pall of gloom which weighs us down were somewhat lifted.
uz: Natijada, hatto o'zim ham bizni og'irlab qo'ygan qorong'ilik ko'rinishi biroz ko'tarilganini his qildim.

en: We all retired early.
uz: Hammamiz erta nafaqaga chiqdik.

en: Mina is now sleeping like a little child.
uz: Mina endi kichkina bola kabi uxlaydi.

en: It is wonderful thing that her faculty of sleep re- mains to her in the midst of her terrible trouble.
uz: Uning uxlash qobiliyati uning dahshatli muammoga duchor bo'lganida unga qaytarib berilishi ajablanarli emas.

en: Thank God for it, for then at least she can forget her care.
uz: Xudoga shukr, u holda u hech bo'lmaganda qayg'urishni unutib qo'yishi mumkin.

en: Perhaps her example may affect me as her gaiety did tonight.
uz: Ehtimol, uning o'rnagi bu kechqurun o'z quvonchidan ko'rinib turganidek, menga ham ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

en: For a dreamless sleep.
uz: Hayotsiz uxlash uchun.

en: 6 October, morning.—Another surprise.
uz: 6 oktyabr kuni ertalab.Boshqa bir hayratlanarli voqea.

en: Mina woke me early, about the same time as yesterday, and asked me to bring Dr.
uz: Mina meni erta uyg'otdi, to'g'ri kechaga o'xshaydi va doktorni olib kelishimni so'radi.

en: I thought that it was another occassion for hypnotism, and without question went for the Professor.
uz: Men buni hipnotizm uchun yana bir imkoniyat deb o'yladim va shubhasiz, professorga murojaat qildim.

en: He had evidently expected some such call, for I found him dressed in his room.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u bunday qo'ng'iroqni kutardi, chunki uni o'z xonasida kiyingan holda topdim.

en: His door was ajar, so that he could hear the opening of the door of our room.
uz: Uning eshigini ochishardi, shuning uchun u bizning xonamizning eshigini ochayotganini eshitishi mumkin edi.

en: As he passed into the room, he asked Mina if the others might come, too.
uz: Xonaga kirganida, u Minadan boshqalarni ham taklif qilishlarini so'radi.

en: No, she said quite simply, it will not be necessary.
uz: Yo'q, - dedi u oddiy so'z bilan, - bu kerak bo'lmaydi.

en: You can tell them just as well.
uz: Siz ham ularga shunday aytishingiz mumkin.

en: I must go with you on your journey. Dr.
uz: Men sayohatingizda siz bilan birga bo'lishim kerak. - dedi doktor.

en: Van Helsing was as startled as I was.
uz: Van Helsing ham men kabi qo'rqib qolibdi.

en: After a moment's pause he asked, But why? You must take me with you.
uz: Bir muncha to'xtab bo'lgandan so'ng, u: Nega? - deb so'radi. Meni o'zingiz bilan olib ketishingiz kerak.

en: I am safer with you, and you shall be safer, too.
uz: Men sen bilan xavfsizroqman va sen ham xavfsizroq bo'lasan.

en: But why, dear Madam Mina?
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, nega, aziz Madam Mina?

en: You know that your safety is our solemnest duty.
uz: Sizning xavfsizligingiz bizning eng katta burchimiz ekanligini bilasiz.

en: We go into danger, to which you are, or may be, more liable than any of us from … from circumstances … things that have been. He paused embarrassed.
uz: Biz xavfli vaziyatga tushamiz, siz ham, ehtimol siz ham bizdan ko'ra ko'proq xavf ostida bo'lasiz, chunki biz o'tgan hodisalar va vaziyatlardan ko'proq javobgardirmiz, - deb o'yladi u.

en: As she replied, she raised her ﬁnger and pointed to her forehead.
uz: Javob berganda, u barmog'ini ko'tarib, oldinga ishora qildi.

en: That is why I must go.
uz: Shuning uchun ketishim kerak.

en: I can tell you now, whilst the sun is coming up.
uz: Endi quyosh chiqish paytida sizga aytaman.

en: I may not be able again.
uz: Ehtimol, yana qila olmasman.

en: I know that when the Count wills me I must go.
uz: Men bilsam, Count meni xohlasa, ketishim kerak.

en: I know that if he tells me to come in secret, I must by wile.
uz: Bilamanki, agar u menga yashirincha kelishimni aytsa, men buni bilmasdan qilishim kerak.

en: By any device to hoodwink, even Jonathan. God saw the look that she turned on me as she spoke, and if there be indeed a Recording Angel that look is noted to her ever-lasting honor.
uz: Hatto Jonatanni ham aldash uchun har qanday usul bilan. Xudo gapirganida menga qaragan ko'rinishini ko'rdi va agar chindan ham bir yozuvchisi bor bo'lsa, bu ko'rinish uning abadiy sharafiga e'tirof etiladi.

en: I could only clasp her hand.
uz: Men faqat uning qo'lini qo'yib olishim mumkin edi.

en: My emo- tion was too great for even the relief of tears.
uz: Mening his-tuygʻularim hatto koʻz yoshlarining yengilishi uchun ham juda katta edi.

en: You men are brave and strong.
uz: Sizlar jasoratli va kuchli insonlarsiz.

en: You are strong in your numbers, for you can defy that which would break down the human en- durance of one who had to guard alone.
uz: Sizlar ko'pligingiz bilan kuchli, chunki siz yolg'iz qo'riqchi bo'lgan odamning insonlikni buzadigan narsaga qarshi tura olasiz.

en: Besides, I may be of service, since you can hypnotize me and so learn that which even I myself do not know. Dr.
uz: Bundan tashqari, men sizga foydali bo'lishim mumkin, chunki siz meni hipnotizatsiya qila olasiz va hatto men ham bilmagan narsalarni o'rganishingiz mumkin.

en: Van Helsing said gravely, Madam Mina, you are, as always, most wise.
uz: Van Helsing jiddiy javob berdi: Madam Mina, siz har doimgidek aqllisiz.

en: You shall with us come.
uz: Siz biz bilan birga borasiz.

en: And together we shall do that which we go forth to achieve. When he had spoken, Mina's long spell of silence made me look at her.
uz: Va birgalikda biz erishish uchun harakat qilamiz. U gapirganida, Minaning uzoq ovozi meni unga qaratib qo'ydi.

en: She had fallen back on her pillow asleep.
uz: U yana yopiq yostigiga tushib uxlagan edi.

en: She did not even wake when I had pulled up the blind and let in the sunlight which ﬂooded the room.
uz: Men ko'rni ko'tarib, xonaga to'lib-toshgan quyosh nurini olib kirganimda, u hatto uyg'onmadi.

en: Van Helsing motioned to me to come with him quietly.
uz: Van Helsing meni unga sekinlik bilan ergashishimga ishora qildi.

en: We went to his room, and within a minute Lord Godalming, Dr.
uz: Biz uning xonasiga bordik va bir daqiqadan so'ng Lord Godalming, doktor

en: Morris were with us also.
uz: Morris ham biz bilan birga edi.

en: He told them what Mina had said, and went on.
uz: U ularga Minaning aytganlarini aytib berdi va davom etdi.

en: In the morning we shall leave for Varna.
uz: Ertalab Varnaga jo'nab ketamiz.

en: We have now to deal with a new factor, Madam Mina.
uz: Endi biz yangi omil bilan shug'ullanamiz, Madam Mina.

en: Oh, but her soul is true.
uz: Oh, lekin uning ruhi haqiqatdir.

en: It is to her an agony to tell us so much as she has done.
uz: O'zi qilgan ishlarni bizga aytib berish unga og'riq keltiradi.

en: But it is most right, and we are warned in time.
uz: Ammo bu juda to'g'ri va biz o'z vaqtida ogohlantirilganmiz.

en: There must be no chance lost, and in Varna we must be ready to act the instant when that ship arrives. What shall we do exactly? asked Mr.
uz: Hech qanday imkoniyat yo'qolmasligi kerak va Varna shahrida biz ushbu kema kelganidan so'ng harakat qilishga tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: The Professor paused before replying, We shall at the ﬁrst board that ship.
uz: Professor javob bermasdan oldin to'xtadi: Biz birinchi bo'limda o'sha kemaga boramiz.

en: Then, when we have identiﬁed the box, we shall place a branch of the wild rose on it.
uz: So'ngra, sandukni aniqlaganimizdan so'ng, unga yovvoyi gulning shoxini qo'yamiz.

en: This we shall fasten, for when it is there none can emerge, so that at least says the superstition.
uz: Biz buni mustahkamlaylik, chunki u erda bo'lganda hech kim paydo bo'lishi mumkin emas, shuning uchun hech bo'lmaganda bu sehr-jodu aytadi.

en: And to superstition must we trust at the ﬁrst.
uz: Va bid'oniyatga birinchi navbatda ishonishimiz kerak.

en: It was man's faith in the early, and it have its root in faith still.
uz: Bu qadimgi inson e'tiqodi edi va bu e'tiqodda ildiz otgani hali ham mavjud.

en: when we get the opportunity that we seek, when none are near to see, we shall open the box, and … and all will be well. I shall not wait for any opportunity, said Morris.
uz: Biz izlayotgan imkoniyatni topganimizda, hech kim ko'rishga yaqin bo'lmaganida, quti ochamiz va ... va hamma narsa yaxshi bo'ladi.  Men hech qanday imkoniyatni kutmayman, dedi Morris.

en: When I see the box I shall open it and destroy the monster, though there were a thousand men looking on, and if I am to be wiped out for it the next moment! I grasped his hand instinctively and found it as ﬁrm as a piece of steel.
uz: Qutuqni ko'rganimda uni ochaman va ming kishi ko'z o'ngida bo'lsa-da, mushrikni yo'q qilaman va agar men keyingi daqiqada bu uchun yo'q bo'lsam! - dedim. Men uning qo'lini instinkt bilan ushlab, uni po'lat kabi mustahkam topdim.

en: I think he un- derstood my look.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u mening ko'rinishimni tushunmadi.

en: Good boy, said Dr.
uz: Yaxshi o'g'il, dedi doktor.

en: God bless him for it.
uz: Xudo uni shu uchun duo qilsin.

en: My child, believe me none of us shall lag behind or pause from any fear.
uz: Bolalarim, ishoninglar, hech birimiz hech qanday qo'rquvdan orqada qolmaymiz yoki to'xtamaymiz.

en: I do but say what we may do … what we must do.
uz: Men faqat nima qilishimiz mumkinligini aytaman ... nima qilishimiz kerakligini aytaman.

en: But, in- deed, indeed we cannot say what we may do.
uz: Ammo, aslida, biz nima qilishimiz mumkinligini aytolmaymiz.

en: There are so many things which may happen, and their ways and their ends are so various that until the moment we may not say.
uz: Ko'p narsalar sodir bo'lishi mumkin va ularning yo'llari va maqsadlari shunchalik turlicha bo'lganki, hozirgacha biz buni aytolmaymiz.

en: We shall all be armed, in all ways.
uz: Biz barchamiz har jihatdan qurollanamiz.

en: And when the time for the end has come, our effort shall not be lack.
uz: Va oxirat vaqti kelganida, bizning harakatlarimiz kam bo'lmaydi.

en: Now let us today put all our affairs in order.
uz: Endi keling, bugun barcha ishlarimizni tartibga solaylik.

en: Let all things which touch on others dear to us, and who on us depend, be complete.
uz: Biz uchun aziz va bizdan bog'liq bo'lgan boshqalarga ta'sir qiladigan barcha narsalar to'liq bo'lsin.

en: For none of us can tell what, or when, or how, the end may be.
uz: Chunki hech birimiz oxirat nima, qachon yoki qanday bo'lishi mumkinligini ayta olmaymiz.

en: As for me, my own affairs are regulate, and as I have nothing else to do, I shall go make arrangements for the travel.
uz: Men o'z ishlarimni o'zim boshqaraman va boshqa ishim yo'q ekan, sayohatni o'tkazaman.

en: I shall have all tickets and so forth for our journey. There was nothing further to be said, and we parted.
uz: Yo'limiz uchun barcha chiptalar va hokazolar bor.  Yana aytish kerak bo'lgan narsa yo'q edi va biz ajralib ketdik.

en: I shall now settle up all my affairs of earth, and be ready for whatever may come.
uz: Endi men yer yuzidagi barcha ishlarimni hal qilaman va nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar tayyorman.

en: My will is made, and all complete.
uz: Mening irodasim amalga oshdi va butunlay to'liq bo'ldi.

en: Mina if she survive is my sole heir.
uz: Mina, agar u omon qolsa, mening yagona merosxo'rimdir.

en: If it should not be so, then the others who have been so good to us shall have remainder.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lmasa, bizga shunchalik yaxshi bo'lgan boshqalarga ham qoldiq bo'ladi.

en: It is now drawing towards the sunset.
uz: Endi u quyosh botish yo'liga yaqinlashib bormoqda.

en: Mina's uneasiness calls my atten- tion to it.
uz: Minaning noqulayligi mening e'tiborimni unga qaratadi.

en: I am sure that there is something on her mind which the time of exact sunset will reveal.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, uning ongida aniq quyosh botish vaqti aniq ko'rsatadigan bir narsa bor.

en: These occasions are becoming harrowing times for us all.
uz: Bu voqealar barchamiz uchun og'ir vaqtga aylanmoqda.

en: For each sunrise and sunset opens up some new danger, some new pain, which however, may in God's will be means to a good end.
uz: Har bir quyosh chiqish va botish yangi xavf, yangi og'riq ochadi, ammo Xudoning irodasiga ko'ra, bu yaxshi maqsadga erishish uchun vosita bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I write all these things in the diary since my darling must not hear them now.
uz: Men bularning barchasini kundalik kitobimga yozib qo'yaman, chunki azizim ularni hozir eshitmasligi kerak.

en: But if it may be that she can see them again, they shall be ready.
uz: Ammo agar u ularni yana ko'rsa, ular tayyor bo'lishlari mumkin.

en: She is calling to me.
uz: U menga qo'ng'iroq qilyapti.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 11 October, Evening.—Jonathan Harker has asked me to note this, as he says he is hardly equal to the task, and he wants an exact record kept.
uz: Sewardning 11 oktabr kuni kechasi.Jonathan Harker mendan buni qayd etishimni so'radi, chunki u o'zi vazifaga teng emasligini va to'g'ri yozuv saqlanishini xohlaydi.

en: I think that none of us were surprised when we were asked to see Mrs.
uz: O'ylaymanki, bizdan hech kim xonimni ko'rish uchun taklif qilinganida hayron qolmadi.

en: Harker a little before the time of sunset.
uz: Harker quyosh botishidan biroz oldin.

en: We have of late come to understand that sunrise and sunset are to her times of peculiar freedom.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda biz quyosh chiqish va quyosh botish uning o'ziga xos erkinlik davrlari ekanligini tushunib yetdik.

en: When her old self can be manifest without any controlling force subduing or restraining her, or inciting her to action.
uz: Qachonki, o'zining eski o'zini hech qanday ta'sir qiluvchi kuch uni boshqarmasdan yoki to'xtatmasdan yoki harakatga undashib, namoyon bo'lishi mumkin.

en: This mood or condition begins some half hour or more before actual sunrise or sunset, and lasts till either the sun is high, or whilst the clouds are still aglow with the rays streaming above the hori- zon.
uz: Ushbu ruh va holat quyosh chiqishidan yoki botishidan yarim soat oldin yoki undan ko'proq vaqt boshlanadi va quyosh yuqori bo'lgunga qadar yoki bulutlar hali ham quyosh o'tishi bilan nurlar o'sib bormaguncha davom etadi.

en: At ﬁrst there is a sort of negative condition, as if some tie were loos- ened, and then the absolute freedom quickly follows.
uz: Avval bir xil salbiy holat paydo bo'ladi, xuddi qandaydir bog'lanish bo'shashgan bo'lsa, keyin mutlaq erkinlik tezda ketadi.

en: When, however, the freedom ceases the change back or relapse comes quickly, preceeded only by a spell of warning silence.
uz: Biroq, erkinlik to'xtasa, o'zgarish yoki qaytish tez keladi, faqat ogohlantirish so'zsizligi davomiyligi bilan boshlanadi.

en: Tonight, when we met, she was somewhat constrained, and bore all the signs of an internal struggle.
uz: Bugun kechqurun uchrashganimizda, u biroz cheklangan edi va ichki kurashning barcha belgilarini ko'rsatgan edi.

en: I put it down myself to her making a violent effort at the earliest instant she could do so.
uz: O'zimni uning o'zi shunday harakat qilgani uchun aybladim, chunki u buni qila olishi mumkin bo'lgan eng tezda zo'ravon harakat qildi.

en: A very few minutes, however, gave her complete control of herself.
uz: Biroq, bir necha daqiqa ichida u o'zini to'liq nazorat qildi.

en: Then, motioning her husband to sit beside her on the sofa where she was half reclining, she made the rest of us bring chairs up close.
uz: Keyin, erini o'zi yarim o'tirgan sofaga o'tirishga ishora qilib, qolganlarimizni o'rindiqlarga yaqinroq olib kelishga majbur qildi.

en: Taking her husband's hand in hers, she began, We are all here together in freedom, for perhaps the last time!
uz: Erining qo'lidan o'z qo'lini olgach, u shunday dedi: Biz barchamiz bir joyda erkinlikda, ehtimol oxirgi marta birgamiz!

en: I know that you will always be with me to the end. This was to her husband whose hand had, as we could see, tightened upon her.
uz: Men bilamanki, sen har doim men bilan bo'lasan, oxirigacha. Bu so'zlar, ko'rib turganimizdek, qo'lini ushlab turgan eriga qaratilgan edi.

en: In the morning we go out upon our task, and God alone knows what may be in store for any of us.
uz: Ertalab biz o'z ishimizni bajarishga chiqamiz va faqat Xudo biladiki, har birimiz uchun nimalar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: You are going to be so good to me to take me with you.
uz: Siz menga juda yaxshi bo'lib, meni o'zingiz bilan olib ketasiz.

en: I know that all that brave earnest men can do for a poor weak woman, whose soul perhaps is lost, no, no, not yet, but is at any rate at stake, you will do.
uz: Men bilaman, jasoratli va g'ayratli erkaklar kambag'al zaif ayol uchun nima qilishlari mumkin bo'lsa, uning ruhi yo'qolgan, lekin hech bo'lmaganda xavf ostida bo'lgan, ehtimol, siz ham qilasiz.

en: But you must remember that I am not as you are.
uz: Ammo men siz kabi emasligimni unutmang.

en: There is a poison in my blood, in my soul, which may destroy me, which must destroy me, unless some relief comes to us.
uz: Qonimda, ruhimda menga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan zahar bor va uni yo'q qilish kerak, agar bizga biron bir yengillik kelmasa.

en: Oh, my friends, you know as well as I do, that my soul is at stake.
uz: Do'stlarim, siz ham o'zim kabi, ruhim xavf ostida ekanini bilasiz.

en: And though I know there is one way out for me, you must not and I must not take it! She looked appealingly to us all in turn, beginning and ending with her husband.
uz: Garchi men uchun birgina yo'l borligini bilsam-da, siz buni qilmasligingiz va men ham qilmasligim kerak! - dedi u, eridan boshlab, oxirida hammamizga o'z navbatida yoqimli ko'z bilan qaradi.

en: What is that way? asked Van Helsing in a hoarse voice.
uz: Bu qanday yo'l? - deb so'radi Van Helsing qo'pol ovoz bilan.

en: What is that way, which we must not, may not, take? That I may die now, either by my own hand or that of another, before the greater evil is entirely wrought.
uz: Biz qanday yo'l tutmasligimiz kerak, yo'l qo'ymasligimiz kerak? - deb so'rashimiz mumkin. Agar buyuk yomonlik butunlay sodir bo'lmasidan oldin, men hozir o'lib ketishim mumkin, xoh o'zimning qo'limdan, xoh boshqasining qo'limdan.

en: I know, and you know, that were I once dead you could and would set free my immortal spirit, even as you did my poor Lucy's.
uz: Bilaman va bilasiz, agar men bir marta o'lganimda, siz mening o'lmas ruhimni ozod qila olasiz va ozod qila olasiz, xuddi kambag'al Luziyamni ozod qilganingizdek.

en: Were death, or the fear of death, the only thing that stood in the way I would not shrink to die here now, amidst the friends who love me.
uz: Agar o'lim yoki o'limdan qo'rqish, mening yo'limda turgan yagona narsa bo'lganida, hozir meni sevgan do'stlarim orasida o'lishdan bosh tortmasdim.

en: But death is not all.
uz: Ammo o'lim hammasi emas.

en: I cannot believe that to die in such a case, when there is hope before us and a bitter task to be done, is God's will.
uz: Umid bor va bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan og'ir ish bor bo'lganda, bunday holatda o'lish Xudoning irodasi ekanligiga ishonolmayman.

en: Therefore, I on my part, give up here the certainty of eternal rest, and go out into the dark where may be the blackest things that the world or the nether world holds! We were all silent, for we knew instinctively that this was only a prelude.
uz: Shuning uchun men abadiy dam olishning ishonchidan voz kechib, dunyo yoki yer ostidagi eng qora narsalar mavjud bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan qorong'ulikka chiqaman! - deb so'z yuritdik.

en: The faces of the others were set, and Harker's grew ashen grey.
uz: Boshqalarning yuzlari o'zgarib ketdi va Harkerning yuzi esa o'g'irlab ketdi.

en: Perhaps, he guessed better than any of us what was coming.
uz: Ehtimol, u bizlardan ham yaxshiroq nima bo'lishini bilgan.

en: She continued, This is what I can give into the hotchpot. I could not but note the quaint legal phrase which she used in such a place, and with all se- riousness.
uz: U davom etdi: Bu men issiq joyga qo'shishim mumkin bo'lgan narsa. Men bunday joyda u ishlatgan o'ziga xos huquqiy iboraga diqqat qaratishdan bosh tortolmadim va bu juda jiddiy bo'ldi.

en: What will each of you give?
uz: Sizlarning har biringiz nima berasizlar?

en: Your lives I know, she went on quickly, that is easy for brave men.
uz: Sizning hayotingizni bilaman, - dedi u tezda davom etib, - bu jasoratli erkaklar uchun oson.

en: Your lives are God's, and you can give them back to Him, but what will you give to me? She looked again ques- tionly, but this time avoided her husband's face.
uz: Hayotlaringiz Xudoga tegishli va siz ularni Unga qaytarib berishingiz mumkin, lekin menga nima berasizlar? - deb so'zlabdi u yana bir bor savol-javob bilan ko'z o'ngida, ammo bu safar erining yuzidan qochdi.

en: Quincey seemed to under- stand, he nodded, and her face lit up.
uz: Quincey ko'rinishicha, o'z ko'zlarini tiydi va uning yuzi yorqin bo'ldi.

en: Then I shall tell you plainly what I want, for there must be no doubtful matter in this connection between us now.
uz: O'shanda men sizlarga nima istayotganimni aniq aytaman, chunki hozir biz o'rtasidagi munosabatda hech qanday shubhali masala bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: You must promise me, one and all, even you, my beloved husband, that should the time come, you will kill me. What is that time? The voice was Quincey's, but it was low and strained.
uz: Siz menga, bir-biringizga, hatto sen, sevikli erim, menga va'da berasizki, o'sha vaqt kelganda, meni o'ldirasiz. - Bu vaqt nima? - degan so'z Quinceyning ovozi edi, ammo u past va charchagan edi.

en: When you shall be convinced that I am so changed that it is better that I die that I may live.
uz: Men shunchalik o'zgarganmanki, yashash uchun o'lish yaxshiroqdir, deb o'ylagandan so'ng.

en: When I am thus dead in the ﬂesh, then you will, without a moment's delay, drive a stake through me and cut off my head, or do whatever else may be wanting to give me rest! Quincey was the ﬁrst to rise after the pause.
uz: Shunday qilib, men jismonan o'lganimda, sizlar bir zum ham kechikmay, menga o't qo'yib, boshimni kesib tashlaysizlar yoki menga dam berishni xohlagan har qanday ishni qilasizlar! - dedi Quincey, to'xtatishdan so'ng birinchi o'rnidan turib.

en: He knelt down before her and taking her hand in his said solemnly, I'm only a rough fellow, who
uz: U ayolning oldida tiz cho'kib, qo'lidan ushlab: Men faqat qo'pol odamman, kim o'z qo'lidan o'tadi, - dedi.

en: hasn't, perhaps, lived as a man should to win such a distinction, but I swear to you by all that I hold sacred and dear that, should the time ever come, I shall not ﬂinch from the duty that you have set us.
uz: Ehtimol, bunday sharafga ega bo'lish kerak bo'lgan odam kabi hayot kechirmagan, lekin men sizlarni muqaddas va aziz deb hisoblagan barcha narsalarim haqiga qasam ichamanki, agar vaqt kelsa, siz bizga qo'ygan vazifadan qochmayman.

en: And I promise you, too, that I shall make all certain, for if I am only doubtful I shall take it that the time has come! My true friend! was all she could say amid her fastfalling tears, as bending over, she kissed his hand.
uz: Men ham sizga va'da beramanki, men hamma narsani aniqlay olaman, chunki agar faqat shubha qilsam, vaqti keldi deb o'ylayman! - deb aytishi mumkin bo'lgan yagona narsa edi.

en: I swear the same, my dear Madam Mina!said Van Helsing.
uz: Men ham xuddi shunday qasam ichaman, aziz Madam Mina! - dedi Van Helsing.

en: And I! said Lord Godalming, each of them in turn kneeling to her to take the oath.
uz: Men ham! - dedi Lord Godalming, ularning har biri o'z navbatida qasam ichish uchun uning oldida tiz cho'kdi.

en: Then her husband turned to her wan-eyed and with a greenish pallor which subdued the snowy whiteness of his hair, and asked, And must I, too, make such a promise, oh, my wife? You too, my dearest,she said, with inﬁnite yearning of pity in her voice and eyes.
uz: Keyin erining ko'zlari so'nib, sochlarining qor oqligini o'chirib qo'ygan yashil rangli ko'rinishi bilan uning oldiga qarab: Men ham shunday va'da berishim kerakmi, ey xotinim? - deb so'radi. - Sen ham, azizim, - dedi u, so'zi va ko'zlarida shafqatning cheksiz orzu bilan.

en: You must not shrink.
uz: Siz qisqartirilmasligingiz kerak.

en: You are nearest and dearest and all the world to me.
uz: Siz menga eng yaqin, eng aziz va butun dunyosiz.

en: Our souls are knit into one, for all life and all time.
uz: Bizning ruhlarimiz butun hayot va zamon uchun birlashtirilgan.

en: Think, dear, that there have been times when brave men have killed their wives and their womenkind, to keep them from falling into the hands of the enemy.
uz: Bir o'ylab ko'ring, aziz, go'zal erkaklar xotinlarini va xotin-qizlarini dushman qo'liga tushmaslik uchun o'ldirgan paytlar bo'lgan.

en: Their hands did not falter any the more because those that they loved im- plored them to slay them.
uz: Ularning qo'llari bundan ham ko'proq bo'shashmadi, chunki ular sevgan kishilar ularni o'ldirish uchun qo'rqitishgan.

en: It is men's duty towards those whom they love, in such times of sore trial!
uz: Bunday og'ir sinovlar paytida insonlar o'z sevganlariga nisbatan o'z burchlarini bajarishlari kerak!

en: And oh, my dear, if it is to be that I must meet death at any hand, let it be at the hand of him that loves me best.
uz: Oh, azizim, agar o'limga duch kelishim kerak bo'lsa, uni meni eng yaxshi ko'radigan kishi qo'lida o'tkazaman.

en: Van Helsing, I have not forgotten your mercy in poor Lucy's case to him who loved. She stopped with a ﬂying blush, and changed her phrase, to him who had best right to give her peace.
uz: Van Helsing, men kambag'al Luzi bilan birga sevgan kishiga qilgan marhamatingizni unutmaganman. - deb so'zlarni o'zgartirgan ayol o'z so'zlarini o'zgartirdi.

en: If that time shall come again, I look to you to make it a happy memory of my husband's life that it was his loving hand which set me free from the awful thrall upon me. Again I swear! came the Professor's resonant voice.
uz: Agar o'sha vaqt yana kelsa, erimning hayotidagi baxtli xotiraga aylantirishingizni kutaman, chunki meni o'zimning qo'limdan ozod qilgan sevgi bilan. - Qayta qasam ichaman! - dedi professorning shiddatli ovozi.

en: Harker smiled, positively smiled, as with a sigh of relief she leaned back and said, And now one word of warning, a warning which you must never forget.
uz: Harker tabassum qildi, ijobiy tarzda tabassum qildi va tasalli hissi bilan orqaga qarab: Va endi bir ogohlantirish so'zi, siz hech qachon unutmasligingiz kerak bo'lgan ogohlantirish.

en: This time, if it ever come, may come quickly and unexpected- ly, and in such case you must lose no time in using your opportunity.
uz: Agar bu vaqt kelsa, tez va kutilmaganda bo'lishi mumkin va bunday holatda imkoniyatdan foydalanishda vaqtni yo'qotmaslik kerak.

en: At such a time I myself might be … nay!
uz: Bunday paytda men o'zim ham... yo'q!

en: If the time ever come, shall be, leagued with your enemy against you.
uz: Agar vaqt kelsa, dushman bilan birga sizga qarshi jang qiladi.

en: One more request, she became very solemn as she said this, it is not vital and necessary like the other, but I want you to do one thing for me, if you will.
uz: - Yana bir iltimos, - dedi u, - bu boshqa iltimos kabi muhim va zarur emas, lekin agar xohlasangiz, men uchun bir narsani qilishingizni xohlayman.

en: We all acquiesced, but no one spoke.
uz: Hammamiz rozi bo'ldik, lekin hech kim gapirmadi.

en: There was no need to speak.
uz: Gapirishning hojati yo'q edi.

en: I want you to read the Burial Service. She was interrupted by a deep groan from her husband.
uz: Men sizlarni dafn marosimini o'qishni xohlayman. U erining chuqur g'azabini eshitib o'tirdi.

en: Taking his hand in hers, she held it over her heart, and continued.
uz: Uning qo'lidan uning qo'lini olib, u uni yuragida saqlab qoldi va davom etdi.

en: You must read it over me some day.
uz: Bir kuni uni menga o'qib berishingiz kerak.

en: Whatever may be the issue of all this fearful state of things, it will be a sweet thought to all or some of us.
uz: Bu qo'rqinchli holatning sabablari qanday bo'lmasin, bu hammamiz yoki ba'zilarimiz uchun yoqimli fikr bo'ladi.

en: You, my dearest, will I hope read it, for then it will be in your voice in my memory forever, come what may! But oh, my dear one, he pleaded, death is afar off from you. Nay, she said, holding up a warning hand.
uz: Sen, azizim, uni o'qishni umid qilaman, chunki o'shanda u sening ovozingda mening xotiramda abadiy qoladi, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar! - deb iltijo qildi u. - Lekin, oh, azizim, o'lim sendan uzoqda. - Yo'q, - dedi u, ogohlantirish qo'lini ko'tarib.

en: I am deeper in death at this moment than if the weight of an earthly grave lay heavy upon me! Oh, my wife, must I read it?he said, before he began.
uz: Men hozirda yerdagi qabrning og'irligi menga og'ir bo'lsa, o'limdan ko'ra chuqurroq o'zimni his qilyapman! - deb aytdi u, boshlanishidan oldin.

en: It would comfort me, my husband! was all she said, and he began to read when she had got the book ready.
uz: Bu meni tasalli beradi, erim! - deb aytdi u va u kitobni tayyorlaganidan so'ng u o'qishni boshladi.

en: How can I, how could anyone, tell of that strange scene, its solemnity, its gloom,its sadness, its horror, and withal, its sweetness.
uz: Qanday qilib men, qanday qilib biror kishi, o'sha g'alati va g'ayritabiiy ko'rinishni, uning tantanaliligini, qorong'ini, qayg'ini, dahshatini va, albatta, uning shirinligini aytib bera oladi?

en: Even a sceptic, who can see nothing but a travesty of bitter truth in anything holy or emotional, would have been melted to the heart had he seen that little group of loving and devoted friends kneeling round that stricken and sorrowing lady.
uz: Hatto muqaddas yoki hissiy narsalarda achchiq haqiqatni masxara qilishdan boshqa hech narsani ko'rmaydigan sceptik kishi ham, agar u o'sha sevgi va sadoqatli do'stlar guruhining bu azob chekkan va qayg'urgan ayol atrofida tiz cho'kganini ko'rganida, yuragida erishi mumkin edi.

en: Or heard the tender passion of her husband's voice, as in tones so broken and emotional that often he had to pause, he read the simple and beautiful ser- vice from the Burial of the Dead.
uz: Yoki erining ovozini o'ziga xos ishtiyoq bilan tinglab, tez-tez to'xtatishga to'g'ri keladigan, o'lganlarning dafnidan oddiy va chiroyli ser-vizi o'qib chiqardi.

en: I cannot go on … words … and v- voices … f-fail m-me!
uz: Men davom eta olmayman ... so'zlar ... va v- ovozlar ... f-fail m-me!

en: She was right in her instinct.
uz: U o'z instinktida to'g'ri yo'l tutgan.

en: Strange as it was, bizarre as it may hereafter seem even to us who felt its potent inﬂuence at the time, it comforted us much.
uz: O'sha paytda uning kuchli ta'sirini his qilganlar uchun ham bu juda g'alati tuyulsa-da, bu bizga katta tasalli berdi.

en: And the silence, which showed Mrs.
uz: Va Mrs.ni ko'rsatadigan sukut saqlash.

en: Harker's coming relapse from her freedom of soul, did not seem so full of despair to any of us as we had dreaded.
uz: Harkerning ruhi erkinligidan qaytib kelishi, hech birimiz qo'rqqanimizdek umidsizlikka to'lib-toshmagan.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 15 October, Varna.—We left Charing Cross on the morning of the 12th, got to Paris the same night, and took the places secured for us in the Orient Express.
uz: JONATHAN HARKERning 15 oktyabr kuni Varna.Biz 12-kunning saharida Charing Xrosdan chiqib, o'sha kecha Parijga yetib keldik va Orient Expressda biz uchun belgilangan o'rinlarni o'tkazdik.

en: We traveled night and day, arriving here at about ﬁve o'clock.
uz: Kecha-kunduz sayohat qilib, soat beshlarda bu yerga yetib keldik.

en: Lord Godalming went to the Consulate to see if any telegram had arrived for him, whilst the rest of us came on to this hotel, the Odessus. The journey may have had incidents.
uz: Lord Godalming konsulxonaga borib, unga telegram kelib qolganini ko'rdi, qolganimiz esa Odessus degan mehmonxonaga bordik.

en: I was, however, too eager to get on, to care for them.
uz: Biroq, men ularga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun o'tishga charchagan edim.

en: Until the Czarina Catherine comes into port there will be no interest for me in anything in the wide world.
uz: Zarina Ketrin portga kelmaguncha, men uchun keng dunyodagi hech narsa qiziqmaydi.

en: Mina is well, and looks to be getting stronger.
uz: Mina sog'lom va kuchliroq bo'lib bormoqda.

en: Her color is coming back.
uz: Uning ranglari qaytib kelmoqda.

en: She sleeps a great deal.
uz: U juda ko'p uxlaydi.

en: Throughout the journey she slept nearly all the time.
uz: Yo'l davomida u deyarli har doim uxlab turardi.

en: Before sunrise and sunset, however, she is very wakeful and alert.
uz: Biroq quyosh chiqish va botishidan oldin u juda uyg'onadi va hushyor turadi.

en: And it has become a habit for Van Helsing to hypnotize her at such times.
uz: Va bunday paytlarda Van Helsing uchun uni hipnozlash odatiy holga aylandi.

en: At ﬁrst, some effort was needed, and he had to make many passes.
uz: Boshida, ba'zi harakatlar kerak edi va u ko'plab o'tishlarni o'tkazishi kerak edi.

en: But now, she seems to yield at once, as if by habit, and scarcely any action is needed.
uz: Ammo hozir u odat tusiga kirganday, darhol taslim bo'lib qoldi va hech qanday harakatning zaruriyati yo'q.

en: He seems to have power at these particular moments to simply will, and her thoughts obey him.
uz: O'sha paytlarda u shunchaki xohish-irodasini bajarishga kuchga ega bo'lib, uning fikrlari unga bo'ysunadi.

en: He always asks her what she can see and hear.
uz: U har doim unga nima ko'rish va eshitish mumkinligini so'raydi.

en: She answers to the ﬁrst, Nothing, all is dark. And to the second,I can hear the waves lapping against the ship, and the water rushing by.
uz: U birinchiga: Agar hech narsa bo'lmasa, hamma narsa qorong'i, - deb javob beradi, ikkinchisiga esa: Men kemaga qarshi to'lqinlar to'sib, suv o'tib ketayotganini eshitaman.

en: Canvas and cordage strain and masts and yards creak.
uz: To'qima va qo'llanma to'siqlari va mastlar va yardlar qirib tashlanadi.

en: The wind is high … I can hear it in the shrouds, and the bow throws back the foam. It is evident that the Czarina Catherine is still at sea, hastening on her way to Varna.
uz: Shamol kuchli bo'lib, uni qabrlardan eshitib olaman va qo'rg'on cho'g'ini qaytarib yuboradi, - deb aytdi.Czarina Ketrining hali ham dengizda bo'lgani aniq, u Varna shahriga borayotganda shoshilmoqda.

en: Lord Godalming has just returned.
uz: Lord Godalming yaqinda qaytdi.

en: He had four telegrams, one each day since we started, and all to the same effect.
uz: Biz boshlaganimizdan beri har kuni bitta telegramma bilan to'rtta telegramma o'tkazgan va ularning hammasi bir xil natijalarga erishgan.

en: That the Czarina Catherine had not been reported to Lloyd's from anywhere.
uz: Zarina Ketrin hech qanday joydan Lloyd's-ga xabar berilmaganligi haqida.

en: He had arranged before leaving London that his agent should send him every day a telegram saying if the ship had been reported.
uz: U Londondan ketishdan oldin o'z agentiga har kuni kema haqida xabar berilgan bo'lsa, unga telegramma yuborish to'g'risida kelishuv tuzgan edi.

en: He was to have a message even if she were not reported, so that he might be sure that there was a watch being kept at the other end of the wire.
uz: Hatto u xabar berilmasa ham, uning xabari bo'lishi kerak edi, shuning uchun u simning boshqa ucunda soat saqlanayotganidan ishonch hosil qilishi mumkin edi.

en: We had dinner and went to bed early.
uz: Biz kechki ovqatni yeb, erta uxlab ketdik.

en: Tomorrow we are to see the Vice Consul, and to arrange, if we can, about getting on board the ship as soon as she arrives.
uz: Ertaga biz Vitse-konsul bilan uchrashishimiz va agar iloji bo'lsa, u kelganidan so'ng kemaga o'tishni rejalashtirishimiz kerak.

en: Van Helsing says that our chance will be to get on the boat be- tween sunrise and sunset.
uz: Van Helsingning aytishicha, quyosh chiqish va botib ketish paytida qayiqqa tushish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lamiz.

en: The Count, even if he takes the form of a bat, cannot cross the running water of his own volition, and so cannot leave the ship.
uz: Count, hatto urib ko'rinishi mumkin bo'lganda ham, o'z xohishi bilan oqib o'tgan suvdan o'tishi mumkin emas, shuning uchun u kemadan chiqib ketishi mumkin emas.

en: As he dare not change to man's form without suspicion, which he evi- dently wishes to avoid, he must remain in the box.
uz: U o'zidan qochmoqchi bo'lgan inson qiyofasini o'zgartirishga jur'at qilmagani uchun, u quti ichida qolishi kerak.

en: If, then, we can come on board after sunrise, he is at our mercy, for we can open the box and make sure of him, as we did of poor Lucy, before he wakes.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar quyosh chiqishdan keyin u erga kirishga muvaffaq bo'lsak, u bizning rahm-shafqatimizga ega bo'ladi, chunki u uyg'onishdan oldin, kambag'al Luzi bilan qilganimizdek, qutuqni ochib, uni tekshirib ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: What mercy he shall get from us all will not count for much.
uz: U hammamizdan qanday rahm-shafqat olishini ko'p ko'rmaydi.

en: We think that we shall not have much trouble with ofﬁcials or the seamen.
uz: O'ylaymanki, rasmiylar yoki dengizchilar bilan ko'p muammolarga duch kelmaymiz.

en: This is the country where bribery can do anything, and we are well supplied with money.
uz: Bu mamlakatda ruxba hamma narsani qila oladi va biz pul bilan ta'minlanganmiz.

en: We have only to make sure that the ship cannot come into port between sunset and sunrise without our being warned, and we shall be safe.
uz: Biz faqatgina kemaning quyosh botish va quyosh chiqish paytida bizni ogohlantirmasdan portga kirishi mumkin emasligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak va biz xavfsiz bo'lamiz.

en: Judge Money- bag will settle this case, I think!
uz: Bu ishni sudya pul sumkasi hal qiladi, deb o'ylayman!

en: 16 October.—Mina's report still the same.
uz: 16 oktyabr.Minaning hisoboti hali ham xuddi shunday.

en: Lapping waves and rushing water, darkness and favoring winds.
uz: To'lqinlarni to'kib tashlash va suvning shovqinlari, qorong'ilik va shamollarni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

en: We are evidently in good time, and
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, biz o'z vaqtida kelganmiz va

en: when we hear of the Czarina Catherine we shall be ready.
uz: Zarina Ketrin haqida eshitganimizda, biz tayyor bo'lamiz.

en: As she must pass the Dardanelles we are sure to have some report.
uz: U Dardanelllarni o'tkazishi kerak bo'lganligi sababli, bizda ba'zi bir hisobot bo'lishi kerak.

en: 17 October.—Everything is pretty well ﬁxed now, I think, to welcome the Count on his return from his tour.
uz: 17 oktyabr.Menimcha, Countni sayrdan qaytganida kutib olish uchun hozir hamma narsa yaxshi tuzilgan.

en: Godalming told the shippers that he fan- cied that the box sent aboard might contain something stolen from a friend of his, and got a half consent that he might open it at his own risk.
uz: Godalming jo'natmachilarga u kemaga yuborilgan qutida uning do'stidan o'g'irlangan narsa bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylaganini aytdi va o'z ixtiyori bilan uni ochish uchun yarim rozilik oldi.

en: The own- er gave him a paper telling the Captain to give him every facility in doing whatever he chose on board the ship, and also a similar authorization to his agent at Varna.
uz: Xo'sh, xo'jayini unga kapitanga kema ichida o'zi xohlagan ishni qilish uchun barcha qulayliklarni berishni aytgan qog'ozni va Varnadagi agentiga o'xshash ruxsatni berdi.

en: We have seen the agent, who was much impressed with Go- dalming's kindly manner to him, and we are all satisﬁed that whatever he can do to aid our wishes will be done.
uz: Biz agentni ko'rdik, u Go-dalmingning unga nisbatan mehribonligi bilan juda taassurot qoldirdi va biz hammamiz uning xohishlarimizga yordam berish uchun nimaiki qilishi mumkinligiga ishonchimiz komil.

en: We have already arranged what to do in case we get the box open.
uz: Biz kutubni ochish holatida nima qilish kerakligini allaqachon hal qildik.

en: If the Count is there, Van Helsing and Seward will cut off his head at once and drive a stake through his heart.
uz: Agar Count u erda bo'lsa, Van Helsing va Seward uning boshini birdan kesib, yuragini ustun qo'yib o'tkazadilar.

en: Morris and Godalming and I shall prevent interference, even if we have to use the arms which we shall have ready.
uz: Morris, Godalming va men, hatto tayyor turgan qurollarimizdan foydalanishimiz kerak bo'lsa ham, aralashuvlarni oldini olamiz.

en: The Professor says that if we can so treat the Count's body, it will soon after fall into dust.
uz: Professorning so'zlariga ko'ra, agar biz Countning jasadini shunday davolay olsak, u tez orada tuproqga aylanadi.

en: In such case there would be no evidence against us, in case any suspicion of murder were aroused.
uz: Bunday holatda bizga qarshi hech qanday dalil yo'q, agar qotillik gumonlari uyg'ongan bo'lsa.

en: But even if it were not, we should stand or fall by our act, and perhaps some day this very script may be evi- dence to come between some of us and a rope.
uz: Ammo agar bunday bo'lmasa ham, harakatimiz bilan turishimiz yoki qulab ketishimiz kerak va ehtimol bir kunning o'zida ushbu ssenariy ba'zilarimiz va qo'lning o'rtasida paydo bo'lishi kerak.

en: For myself, I should take the chance only too thankfully if it were to come.
uz: O'zim uchun bu imkoniyatdan foydalanishim kerak, agar u bo'lsa, juda minnatdorman.

en: We mean to leave no stone unturned to carry out our intent.
uz: Biz niyatlarimizni amalga oshirish uchun hech qanday toshni o'zgartirmagan holda qoldirmoqchi emasmiz.

en: We have arranged with certain ofﬁcials that the instant the Czarina Catherine is seen, we are to be informed by a special messenger.
uz: Biz ba'zi rasmiylar bilan Zarina Katrinani ko'rish paytida maxsus elchi orqali xabardor qilish uchun kelishuvlar tuzganmiz.

en: 24 October.—A whole week of waiting.
uz: 24 oktyabr.To'liq bir hafta kutish.

en: Daily telegrams to Godalming, but only the same story.
uz: Godalmingga har kuni telegrammalar yuboriladi, ammo faqat bir xil hikoya.

en: Not yet reported. Mina's morning and evening hypnotic answer is unvaried.
uz: Havuz yetmagan. Minaning ertalabki va kechqurungi hipnotik javoblari o'zgarmagan.

en: Lapping waves, rushing water, and creaking masts.
uz: To'lqin to'lqinlari, shov-shuvli suv va sirtli mastlar.

en: TELEGRAM, OCTOBER 24TH RUFUS SMITH, LLOYD'S, LON- DON, TO LORD GODALMING, CARE OF H.
uz: TELEGRAM, 24 oktabr Rufus Smit, Lloyd's, LON-DON, LORD Godalmingga, H. H. G'amxo'rligiga murojaat qiling.

en: VICE CONSUL, VARNA Czarina Catherine reported this morning from Dardanelles. DR.
uz: VICE CONSUL, VARNA Czarina Catherine bu ertalab Dardanellardan xabar berdi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 25 October.—How I miss my phonograph!
uz: SEWARDning 25 oktyabr kunlik kundaligi.Men fonografimni qanchalik sog'inaman!

en: To write a diary with a pen is irksome to me!
uz: Kaltom bilan jurnal yozish men uchun og'irlikdir!

en: But Van Helsing says I must.
uz: Lekin Van Helsing aytishicha, men buni qilishim kerak.

en: We were all wild with excite- ment yesterday when Godalming got his telegram from Lloyd's.
uz: Kecha Godalmingning Lloyd's-dan telegramasi kelganida, biz hammamiz hayajonga to'ldik.

en: I know now what men feel in battle when the call to action is heard.
uz: Endi men jangda erkaklar nima his qilishlarini bilaman, harakatga chaqirishni eshitishganda.

en: alone of our party, did not show any signs of emotion.
uz: Bizning partiyamizdan yolg'iz, hech qanday his-tuyg'ular ko'rsatmadi.

en: After all, it is not strange that she did not, for we took special care not to let her know any- thing about it, and we all tried not to show any excitement when we were in her presence.
uz: Axir, u bunday qilmaganida ajablanarli emas, chunki biz unga bu haqda hech narsa aytmaslikka alohida e'tibor berardik va barchamiz uning huzurida hech qanday hayajonni ko'rsatmaslikka harakat qildik.

en: In old days she would, I am sure, have noticed, no matter how we might have tried to conceal it.
uz: O'tmishdagi kunlarda, shubhasiz, u buni payqagan bo'lardi, biz buni qanday qilib yashirmoqchi bo'lsak ham.

en: But in this way she is greatly changed during the past three weeks.
uz: Ammo shu yo'sin u so'nggi uch hafta davomida sezilarli darajada o'zgardi.

en: The lethargy grows upon her, and though she seems strong and well, and is getting back some of her color, Van Helsing and I are not satisﬁed.
uz: U o'z ko'rinishida o'sib bormoqda va u kuchli va sog'lom ko'rinishi va o'z rangiga qaytib kelishiga qaramay, Van Helsing va men mamnun emasmiz.

en: We talk of her often.
uz: Biz u haqida tez-tez gapiramiz.

en: We have not, however, said a word to the others.
uz: Biroq, biz boshqalarga bir so'z ham aytmadik.

en: It would break poor Harker's heart, certainly his nerve, if he knew that we had even a suspicion on the subject.
uz: Bu kambag'al Harkerning yuragini, albatta, g'azabini, agar u bizda bu borada hatto shubha borligini bilsa, buzadi.

en: Van Helsing exam- ines, he tells me, her teeth very carefully, whilst she is in the hypnotic con- dition, for he says that so long as they do not begin to sharpen there is no active danger of a change in her.
uz: U menga aytadi: Van Helsingning tishlarini juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan tekshirib turadi, chunki u o'zini hipnotik holatda tutadi, chunki u aytadiki, tishlar keskinlashmasa, unda o'zgarish xavfi yo'q.

en: If this change should come, it would be necessary to take steps!
uz: Agar bu o'zgarish yuz bersa, harakat qilish kerak bo'ladi!

en: We both know what those steps would have to be, though we do not mention our thoughts to each other.
uz: Bu qadamlar qanday bo'lishini ikkovimiz ham bilamiz, ammo o'z fikrlarimizni bir-birimizga aytmaymiz.

en: We should neither of us shrink from the task, awful though it be to contemplate.
uz: Hech birimiz bu vazifani o'ylab ko'rish juda dahshatli bo'lsa ham, undan voz kechmasligimiz kerak.

en: Euthanasia is an excellent and a comforting word!
uz: Euthanasiya - bu ajoyib va tasalli beruvchi so'z!

en: I am grateful to whoever invented it.
uz: Men uni ixtiro qilgan kishiga minnatdorman.

en: It is only about 24 hours' sail from the Dardanelles to here, at the rate the Czarina Catherine has come from London.
uz: Dardanelllardan bu yerga borish uchun faqat 24 soatlik sayohat, bu Londondan Charina Ketrin kelgan tezlikka teng.

en: She should therefore arrive some time in the morning, but as she cannot possibly get in before noon, we are all about to retire early.
uz: Shuning uchun u ertalab kelib qolishi kerak, lekin u tushdan oldin kirishi mumkin emasligi sababli, biz hammamiz erta nafaqaga ketmoqdamiz.

en: We shall get up at one o'clock, so as to be ready.
uz: Biz tayyor bo'lish uchun soat birda turamiz.

en: 25 October, Noon.—No news yet of the ship's arrival.
uz: 25 oktyabr, tush.Kofirning kelishi haqida hali hech qanday yangilik yo'q.

en: Harker's hyp- notic report this morning was the same as usual, so it is possible that we may get news at any moment.
uz: Harkerning bu ertalabgi hisoboti odatdagidek bo'ldi, shuning uchun istalgan vaqtda yangilik olishimiz mumkin.

en: We men are all in a fever of excitement, ex- cept Harker, who is calm.
uz: Erkaklar, biz hammamiz hayajonga to'lib-toshganmiz, faqatgina Xarkir xotirjam bo'lgan.

en: His hands are cold as ice, and an hour ago I found him whetting the edge of the great Ghoorka knife which he now always car- ries with him.
uz: Uning qo'llari muz kabi sovuq va bir soat oldin men uni buyuk Ghoorka qilichining bo'g'ini o'chirib turganini ko'rdim.

en: It will be a bad lookout for the Count if the edge of that Kukri ever touches his throat, driven by that stern, ice-cold hand!
uz: Agar Kukrining o'tlari uning bo'yniga tegsa, Count uchun yomon qarash bo'ladi, chunki bu qattiq, muzli qo'l uni boshqaradi!

en: Van Helsing and I were a little alarmed about Mrs.
uz: Van Helsing va men Xonim Van Helsing haqida biroz xavotirda edik.

en: About noon she got into a sort of lethargy which we did not like.
uz: Tush payti atrofida u o'z-o'zidan ko'ngil uzish holatiga tushib qoldi, bu bizga yoqmadi.

en: Although we kept silence to the others, we were neither of us happy about it.
uz: Garchi biz boshqalarga gapirmasligimiz kerak bo'lsa-da, biz ikkovimiz bunga rozi emasdik.

en: She had been restless all the morning, so that we were at ﬁrst glad to know that she was sleeping.
uz: U butun ertalab bezovta bo'lgan, shuning uchun u uxlayotganini bilganimizdan boshida xursand bo'ldik.

en: When, however, her husband mentioned casually that she was sleeping so soundly that he could not wake her, we went to her room to see for ourselves.
uz: Biroq, eri uning uyqusida shunchalik yaxshi uxlayotganini aytganda, uni uyg'otolmayotganini aytganda, biz o'z ko'zimiz bilan ko'rish uchun uning xonasiga bordik.

en: She was breathing naturally and looked so well and peaceful that we agreed that the sleep was better for her than anything else.
uz: U tabiiy ravishda nafas olib, shunchalik yaxshi va tinch ko'rinardiki, uyqu uning uchun hamma narsadan yaxshiroq ekanligiga rozi bo'ldik.

en: she has so much to forget that it is no wonder that sleep, if it brings oblivion to her, does her good.
uz: U shunchalik ko'p narsani unutishi kerakki, uyqu unga yaxshilik qiladi, deb o'ylash ajablanarli emas.

en: Later.—Our opinion was justiﬁed, for when after a refreshing sleep of some hours she woke up, she seemed brighter and better than she had been for days.
uz: Keyinchalik.Bizning fikrimiz oqlangan edi, chunki bir necha soatlik chiroyli uyqudan keyin u uyg'onib, kunlar davomida bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq yorug' va yaxshiroq ko'rindi.

en: At sunset she made the usual hypnotic report.
uz: Quyosh botganida u odatdagidek hipnotik hisobot berdi.

en: Wherever he may be in the Black Sea, the Count is hurrying to his destination.
uz: Qora dengizning qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, Count o'z yo'nalishlariga shoshilmoqda.

en: To his doom, I trust!
uz: Uning halokatga ishonaman!

en: 26 October.—Another day and no tidings of the Czarina Catherine.
uz: 26 oktyabr.Boshqa kun va Charina Ketrin haqida hech qanday xabar yo'q.

en: She ought to be here by now.
uz: Hozircha u bu yerda bo'lishi kerak.

en: That she is still journeying somewhere is apparent, for Mrs.
uz: U hali ham bir joyga sayohat qilmoqda, bu Mrs. uchun aniq.

en: Harker's hypnotic report at sunrise was still the same.
uz: Harkerning quyosh chiqish paytidagi hipnotik hisoboti hali ham xuddi shunday edi.

en: It is possible that the vessel may be lying by, at times, for fog.
uz: Ehtimol, kemada tuman paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Some of the steamers which came in last evening reported patches of fog both to north and south of the port.
uz: O'tgan kechqurun kelgan bug' kemalari ba'zilarida portning shimoli va janubiga qarab tumanlar paydo bo'lgan.

en: We must continue our watching, as the ship may now be sig- nalled any moment.
uz: Biz kuzatuvni davom ettirishimiz kerak, chunki kema endi istalgan vaqtda signallanishi mumkin.

en: 27 October, Noon.—Most strange.
uz: 27 oktyabr, tush.Ajoyib.

en: No news yet of the ship we wait for.
uz: Biz kutayotgan kema haqida hali hech qanday yangilik yo'q.

en: Harker reported last night and this morning as usual.
uz: Harker o'tgan kecha va bugun ertalab odatdagidek xabar berdi.

en: Lapping waves and rushing water, though she added that the waves were very faint. The telegrams from London have been the same, no further report. Van Hels- ing is terribly anxious, and told me just now that he fears the Count is es- caping us.
uz: To'lqinlar ko'tarilib, suv ko'tarildi, - deb aytdi u, ammo to'lqinlar juda zaif edi, deb qo'shib qo'ydi. Londondan kelgan telegrammalar xuddi shunday bo'ldi, boshqa xabar yo'q. Van Helsing dahshatli darajada xavotirga tushdi va hozirgina menga Countning bizni qo'yib ketayotganidan qo'rqishini aytdi.

en: He added signiﬁcantly, I did not like that lethargy of Madam Mina's.
uz: U sezilarli darajada qo'shimcha qildi: Madam Mina o'zining o'sha o'tkirligini yoqtirmadim.

en: Souls and memories can do strange things during trance. I was about to ask him more, but Harker just then came in, and he held up a warning hand.
uz: Trance paytida ruhlar va xotiralar g'alati ishlarni qila oladi. Men undan ko'proq so'rashni rejalashtirgan edim, ammo o'sha paytda Harker kirib keldi va ogohlantirish qo'lini ko'tardi.

en: We must try tonight at sunset to make her speak more fully when in her hypnot- ic state.
uz: Bugun quyosh botganida uni hipnoz holatida to'liqroq gapirish uchun harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: 28 October.—Telegram.
uz: 28 oktabr.Telegram.

en: Rufus Smith, London, to Lord Godalming, care H.
uz: Rufus Smit, London, Lord Godalmingga, H.

en: Vice Consul, Varna Czarina Catherine reported entering Galatz at one o'clock today. DR.
uz: Varnadagi vitse-konsul Czarina Katarina Galatzga bugun soat birda kirib kelgani haqida xabar berdi.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 28 October.—When the telegram came announcing the arrival in Galatz I do not think it was such a shock to any of us as might have been expected.
uz: SEWARDning 28 oktyabrdagi kundaligi.Galatzga kelganimizni e'lon qiluvchi telegram kelganida, bu biz uchun hech kim uchun kutilganidek ajablantirgan deb o'ylamayman.

en: True, we did not know whence, or how, or when, the bolt would come.
uz: To'g'ri, biz qayerdan, qanday yoki qachon bolt paydo bo'lishini bilmasdik.

en: But I think we all expected that something strange would happen.
uz: Ammo, menimcha, barchamiz g'alati narsa sodir bo'lishini kutganmiz.

en: The day of arrival at Varna made us individually satisﬁed that things would not be just as we had expected.
uz: Varnaga yetib kelgan kun, har birimizni ishontirdiki, narsalar biz kutganidek bo'lmaydi.

en: We only waited to learn where the change would occur.
uz: Biz faqat o'zgarish qayerda yuz berishini bilib olishni kutdik.

en: None the less, however, it was a surprise.
uz: Shunga qaramay, bu hayratlanarli bo'ldi.

en: I suppose that nature works on such a hopeful basis that we believe against ourselves that things will be as
uz: O'ylaymanki, tabiat shu qadar umidvor bo'lib ishlaydiki, biz o'zimizga qarama-qarshi ishonaveramizki, narsalar shunday bo'ladi.

en: they ought to be, not as we should know that they will be.
uz: Ular shunday bo'lishi kerak, biz bilishimiz kerak bo'lganidek emas.

en: Transcendental- ism is a beacon to the angels, even if it be a will-o'-the-wisp to man.
uz: Transendental ism farishtalar uchun yorug'likdir, hatto inson uchun ham.

en: Van Helsing raised his hand over his head for a moment, as though in remon- strance with the Almighty.
uz: Van Helsing qo'lini bir zum bosh ustiga ko'tardi, xuddi Qodir Tangri bilan muloqotda bo'lganidek.

en: But he said not a word, and in a few seconds stood up with his face sternly set.
uz: Ammo u bir so'z ham aytmadi va bir necha soniya ichida yuzini qat'iy ko'tarib turibdi.

en: Lord Godalming grew very pale, and sat breathing heavily.
uz: Lord Godalming juda soyalib, og'ir nafas olib o'tirdi.

en: I was myself half stunned and looked in wonder at one after another.
uz: Men o'zim yarim ta'sirlanib, bir-biridan hayratda qoldim.

en: Quincey Morris tightened his belt with that quick movement which I knew so well.
uz: Quincey Morris o'z kemasini o'sha tezkor harakat bilan teshirdi, men uni juda yaxshi bilardim.

en: In our old wandering days it meant action. Mrs.
uz: Qadimgi ko'chma kunlarimizda bu harakat degan ma'noni anglatadi.

en: Harker grew ghastly white, so that the scar on her forehead seemed to burn, but she folded her hands meekly and looked up in prayer.
uz: Harker dahshatli oq bo'lib ketdi va uning peshanasidagi yara yonib ketganidek tuyuldi, ammo u qo'llarini muloyimlik bilan yopib, ibodat qilib ko'zlarini ko'tarib oldi.

en: Harker smiled, actually smiled, the dark, bitter smile of one who is without hope, but at the same time his action be- lied his words, for his hands instinctively sought the hilt of the great Kukri knife and rested there.
uz: Harker tabassum qildi, haqiqatan ham tabassum qildi, umidsiz odamning qorong'i, achchiq tabassumidir, ammo shu bilan birga uning harakatlari so'zlariga yolg'on gapiradi, chunki uning qo'llari instinktli ravishda buyuk Kukri qilichining qo'lini qidirib, u erda o'tirgan.

en: When does the next train start for Galatz? said Van Helsing to us generally.
uz: Galatz uchun keyingi poezd qachon ketadi? - dedi Van Helsing bizga umuman.

en: At 6:30 tomorrow morning! We all started, for the answer came from Mrs.
uz: Ertaga ertalab soat 6:30 da! - deb hammamiz boshladik, chunki javob xonimdan keldi.

en: How on earth do you know? said Art.
uz: Sen qanday qilib bilasan? - dedi Art..

en: You forget, or perhaps you do not know, though Jonathan does and so does Dr.
uz: Siz unutasiz yoki bilmayapsiz, ammo Jonatan va Drt.

en: Van Helsing, that I am the train ﬁend.
uz: Van Helsing, men poyezd shaytoni ekanligimni.

en: At home in Exeter I always used to make up the time tables, so as to be helpful to my husband.
uz: Uyimda, Ekseterda, erimga yordam berish uchun men doimo vaqt jadvallarini tuzardim.

en: I found it so useful sometimes, that I always make a study of the time tables now.
uz: Ba'zan bu juda foydali bo'lgan, shuning uchun men endi vaqt jadvallarini har doim o'rganaman.

en: I knew that if anything were to take us to Castle Dracula we should go by Galatz, or at any rate through Bucharest, so I learned the times very careful- ly.
uz: Agar biror narsa bizni Drakula qalʼasiga olib ketsa, biz Galatsdan yoki hech boʻlmaganda Bukareştdan oʻtishimiz kerakligini bilardim, shuning uchun vaqtni juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan oʻrgandim.

en: Unhappily there are not many to learn, as the only train tomorrow leaves as I say. Wonderful woman! murmured the Professor.
uz: Afsuski, o'rganish uchun ko'p narsa yo'q, chunki ertaga faqat birgina poezd ketadi, deb aytaman. Qahramon ayol! - dedi professor.

en: Can't we get a special? asked Lord Godalming.
uz: Lord Godalming so'radi: Biz maxsus o'ynashimiz mumkinmi?

en: Van Helsing shook his head, I fear not.
uz: Van Helsing boshini silkitib: Men qo'rqmayman.

en: This land is very different from yours or mine.
uz: Bu yer sizning yoki mening yerimdan juda farq qiladi.

en: Even if we did have a special, it would probably not arrive as soon as our regular train.
uz: Hatto bizda maxsus mashg'ulot bo'lsa ham, u, ehtimol, odatdagi poyezdimiz bilan kelmaydi.

en: Moreover, we have something to prepare.
uz: Bundan tashqari, bizda tayyorlanadigan narsa bor.

en: Now let us organize.
uz: Endi keling, tashkillashtiramiz.

en: You, friend Arthur, go to the train and get the tickets and arrange that all be ready for us to go in the morning.
uz: Sen, do'stim Artur, poezdga borib, chiptalarni olgin va ertalab ketish uchun hamma narsa tayyor bo'lsin.

en: Do you, friend Jonathan, go to the agent of the ship and get from him letters to the agent in Galatz, with authority to make a search of the ship just as it was here.
uz: Siz, do'st Jonatan, kema agentiga borib, uning tomonidan Galatzdagi agentga xatlar oling va kema bu yerda bo'lgani kabi qidirib topishga vakolat oling.

en: Quincey Morris, you see the Vice Consul, and get his aid with his fel-
uz: Quincey Morris, siz vitse-konsul bilan uchrashing va uning yordamini so'rang.

en: low in Galatz and all he can do to make our way smooth, so that no times be lost when over the Danube.
uz: Galatsdagi past joylarda va uning yo'limizni tekis qilish uchun qo'lidan kelganicha, Donau daryosidan o'tib ketayotganda hech qanday vaqt yo'qotmaslik kerak.

en: John will stay with Madam Mina and me, and we shall consult.
uz: Jon Mina xonim va men bilan qolishi va maslahatlashishi mumkin.

en: For so if time be long you may be delayed.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar vaqt uzoq bo'lsa, siz kechikishingiz mumkin.

en: And it will not matter when the sun set, since I am here with Madam to make report. And I, said Mrs.
uz: Va quyosh botganida ahamiyat yo'q, chunki men bu yerda xonim bilan hisobot berishga hozirman.

en: Harker brightly, and more like her old self than she had been for many a long day, shall try to be of use in all ways, and shall think and write for you as I used to do.
uz: Harker ko'p yillar davomida o'zidan ko'ra ko'proq o'ziga o'xshash bo'lib, har jihatdan foydali bo'lishga harakat qiladi va men qilganimdek, siz uchun ham o'ylaydi va yozadi.

en: Something is shifting from me in some strange way, and I feel freer than I have been of late! The three younger men looked happier at the moment as they seemed to realize the signiﬁcance of her words.
uz: O'zimdan biror narsa o'zgarib bormoqda va men o'zimni oxirgi paytlardan ko'ra erkinroq his qilyapman! - deyishdi.Uch nafar yosh yigitlar uning so'zlarining ahamiyatini tushunib olgani uchun o'sha paytda baxtliroq ko'rinishardi.

en: But Van Helsing and I, turning to each other, met each a grave and troubled glance.
uz: Ammo Van Helsing va men bir-birimizga qarab, har birimizga jiddiy va xavotirga to'lgan ko'z tikdik.

en: We said nothing at the time, however.
uz: Biroq, biz o'sha paytda hech narsa aytmadik.

en: When the three men had gone out to their tasks Van Helsing asked Mrs.
uz: Uch kishi o'z vazifalariga chiqqanida, Van Helsing Xonimdan:

en: Harker to look up the copy of the diaries and ﬁnd him the part of Harker's journal at the Castle.
uz: Harker jurnallarning nusxasini qidirib topib, unga qal'ada Harkerning jurnalining qismini topishi kerak edi.

en: She went away to get it.
uz: U uni olish uchun ketib ketdi.

en: When the door was shut upon her he said to me, We mean the same!
uz: Eshik uning ustiga yopilganida, u menga: Biz bir xil ma'noni aytmoqdamiz!

en: Speak out! Here is some change.
uz: O'zingiz gapiring! Buni o'zgartirish kerak.

en: It is a hope that makes me sick, for it may deceive us. Quite so.
uz: Bu umid meni bezovta qiladi, chunki u bizni aldash mumkin.

en: Do you know why I asked her to get the manuscript? No! said I, unless it was to get an opportunity of seeing me alone. You are in part right, friend John, but only in part.
uz: Yo'q! - dedim men, agar bu menga yolg'iz ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmasin, - deb javob berdim. Siz qisman haqsiz, do'stim Jon, lekin qisman haqsiz.

en: I want to tell you something.
uz: Sizga bir narsa aytmoqchiman.

en: And oh, my friend, I am taking a great, a terrible, risk.
uz: Do'stim, men juda katta, juda dahshatli xavf-xatarni o'ylayman.

en: But I be- lieve it is right.
uz: Ammo men buni yaxshi bilaman.

en: In the moment when Madam Mina said those words that ar- rest both our understanding, an inspiration came to me.
uz: Xonim Mina o'z tushunchamizni mustahkamlaydigan so'zlarni aytganida, menga ilhom keldi.

en: In the trance of three days ago the Count sent her his spirit to read her mind.
uz: Uch kun oldin Count uning fikrini o'qish uchun ruhini unga yubordi.

en: Or more like he took her to see him in his earth box in the ship with water rushing, just as it go free at rise and set of sun.
uz: Yoki ko'proq aytganda, u uni o'zining tuproq qutidagi kemada, quyosh chiqish va botish paytida erkin bo'lgan suv bilan ko'rish uchun olib bordi.

en: He learn then that we are here, for she have more to tell in her open life with eyes to see ears to hear than he, shut as he is, in his cofﬁn box.
uz: U o'z hayotida ko'zlari ko'rinadigan, quloqlari eshitadigan, ko'zlari ko'rinadigan ko'zlar bilan gapirish uchun ko'proq narsa borligini bilib oladi.

en: Now he make his most effort to escape us.
uz: Endi u bizdan qochib ketish uchun qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilmoqda.

en: At present he want her not.
uz: Hozirda u uni xohlamaydi.

en: He is sure with his so great knowledge that she will come at his call.
uz: U o'zining katta bilimlari bilan shubhalanadiki, u uning da'vatiga javob beradi.

en: But he cut her off, take her, as he can do, out of his own power, that so she come not to him.
uz: Lekin u qizni kesib tashladi, uni o'z kuchi bilan olib ketadi, shuning uchun u o'z oldiga kelmasligi uchun.

en: There I have hope that our man brains that have been of man so long and that have not lost the grace of God, will come higher than his child-brain that lie in his tomb for centuries, that grow not yet to our stature, and that do only work selﬁsh and therefore small.
uz: U erda men odamning shuncha vaqtdan beri odam bo'lgan va Xudoning inoyati bilan tabriklanmagan miyamiz asrlar davomida uning qabrida yotgan, hali bizning o'rnagimizga yetmagan va faqat o'zboshimchalik bilan ishlaydigan va shuning uchun kichik bo'lgan bola miyasidan yuqoriga kelishiga umid qilaman.

en: Not a word to her of her trance!
uz: Uning transsi haqida unga bir so'z ham aytmaslik kerak!

en: She knows it not, and it would overwhelm her and make despair just when we want all her hope, all her courage, when most we want all her great brain which is trained like man's brain, but is of sweet woman and have a special power which the Count give her, and which he may not take away altogether, though he think not so.
