uz: U buni bilmaydi va biz uning butun umidini, butun jasoratini, eng ko'p o'zimiz xohlagan paytda uni ko'taradi va umidsizlikka tushadi, chunki biz uning erkak miyasi kabi mashg'ul bo'lgan, lekin go'zal ayoldan bo'lgan va Count unga ato etgan maxsus kuchga ega bo'lgan ajoyib miyasiga ega bo'lgan va u buni butunlay olib ketmasligi mumkin, garchi u buni o'ylamasa ham.

en: Let me speak, and you shall learn.
uz: Men gapirsam, o'rganasiz.

en: Oh, John, my friend, we are in awful straits.
uz: John, do'stim, biz juda yomon ahvoldamiz.

en: I fear, as I never feared before.
uz: Oldin hech qachon qo'rqmaganimdek qo'rqaman.

en: We can only trust the good God.
uz: Biz faqat yaxshi Xudoga tayanishimiz mumkin.

en: Here she comes! I thought that the Professor was going to break down and have hysterics, just as he had when Lucy died, but with a great effort he controlled himself and was at perfect nervous poise when Mrs.
uz: Mana u keladi! - deb o'yladim, professor Lucy vafot etganida o'lganida bo'lganidek, histerik holatga tushadi, lekin u juda ko'p harakat qilib, o'zini nazorat qildi va Mrs. Lucy vafot etganida juda tashvishlangan edi.

en: Harker tripped into the room, bright and happy looking and, in the doing of work, seemingly forgetful of her misery.
uz: Harker xonaga kirdi, yorqin va quvonchli ko'rinadi va ishini bajarayotganda o'zining azob-uqubatini unutgan ko'rinadi.

en: As she came in, she handed a number of sheets of typewriting to Van Helsing.
uz: Kirganida, u Van Helsinga bir nechta matbaa varaqasini berdi.

en: He looked over them gravely, his face brightening up as he read.
uz: U ularni jiddiy ko'rib, o'qiganida yuzi yorqinlashdi.

en: Then holding the pages between his ﬁnger and thumb he said, Friend John, to you with so much experience already, and you too, dear Madam Mina, that are young, here is a lesson.
uz: So'ngra barmog'i va bosh barmog'i o'rtasida sahifalarni ushlab, u shunday dedi: Dost Jon, sizga, allaqachon ko'p tajribaga ega bo'lganlarga va siz ham, aziz Madam Mina, yoshlarga, bir saboq bor.

en: Do not fear ever to think.
uz: Hech qachon o'ylashdan qo'rqmang.

en: A half thought has been buzzing often in my brain, but I fear to let him loose his wings.
uz: Yarim fikrim ko'pincha miyamda to'p-to'p bo'lib turadi, lekin uning qanotlarini qo'yib yuborishidan qo'rqaman.

en: Here now, with more knowledge, I go back to where that half thought come from and I ﬁnd that he be no half thought at all.
uz: Endi, ko'proq bilimga ega bo'lib, o'sha yarim fikr qayerdan kelib chiqqanini ko'rib, u yarim fikr emasligini aniqladim.

en: That be a whole thought, though so young that he is not yet strong to use his little wings.
uz: Garchi u shunchalik yosh bo'lsa-da, kichik qanotlaridan foydalanish uchun hali kuchsiz bo'lsa ham, bu juda yaxshi fikr.

en: Nay, like the `Ugly Duck' of my friend Hans Andersen, he be no duck thought at all, but a big swan thought that sail nobly on big wings, when the time come for him to try them.
uz: Yo'q, do'stim Xans Andersenning Qavg'al qurtak singari, u umuman qurtak deb o'ylamaydi, balki katta qanotlarga ega bo'lgan katta qurtak deb o'ylaydi, u ularni sinab ko'rish vaqti kelganida.

en: See I read here what Jonathan have written.
uz: Mana, Jonatan nima yozganini o'qib chiqdim.

en: That other of his race who, in a later age, again and again, brought his forces over The Great River into Turkey Land, who when he was beaten back, came again, and again, and again, though he had to come alone from the bloody ﬁeld where his troops were being slaughtered, since he knew that he alone could ultimately triumph.
uz: O'zining irqidan bo'lgan boshqa kishi, keyinchalik bir necha marta Buyuk daryo bo'ylab qo'shinlarini Turkiyaning yurtiga olib kelgan, o'zidan keyin mag'lub bo'lganida, qayta-qayta, qayta-qayta kelgan, garchi qo'shinlari qoniqtirilgan qonli maydondan yolg'iz kelishi kerak bo'lsa-da, chunki u faqat o'zi g'alaba qozonishi mumkinligini bilardi.

en: What does this tell us?
uz: Bu bizga nima deyish mumkin?

en: The Count's child thought see nothing, therefore he speak so free.
uz: Countning farzandi hech narsa ko'rmasligini o'yladi, shuning uchun u juda erkin gapiradi.

en: Your man thought see nothing.
uz: Sizning odamingiz hech narsa ko'rmaydi deb o'yladi.

en: My man thought see nothing, till just now.
uz: Erim hozirgacha hech narsa ko'rmagani haqida o'yladi.

en: But there comes another word from some one who speak without thought because she, too, know not what it mean, what it might mean.
uz: Ammo o'ylab ko'rmay gapirgan birovdan yana bir so'z keladi, chunki u ham uning ma'nosini bilmaydi, uning ma'nosini bilmaydi.

en: Just as there are elements which rest, yet when in nature's course they move on their way and they touch, the pouf!
uz: Ba'zi elementlar dam olgani kabi, lekin ular tabiat yo'lida harakatlanayotganda va qo'ng'iroq qilayotganda, ular pufga qo'shilishadi!

en: there comes a ﬂash of light, heaven wide, that blind and kill and destroy some.
uz: O'shanda keng osmon bo'lgan nurning bir chaqmoqlari ko'r bo'lib, ba'zilarni o'ldiradi va yo'q qiladi.

en: But that show up all earth below for leagues and leagues.
uz: Ammo bu yer yuzi bo'ylab ko'rinadi.

en: Well, I shall explain.
uz: Xo'sh, men tushuntirib beraman.

en: To begin, have you ever study the philosophy of crime?
uz: Avvalo, siz jinoyatchilik falsafasini o'rganganmisiz?

en: `Yes' and `No.' You, John, yes, for it is a study of insanity.
uz: Siz, Jon, ha, chunki bu aqlsizlikka oid tadqiqot.

en: You, no, Madam Mina, for crime touch you not, not but once.
uz: Siz, yo'q, Madam Mina, jinoyat uchun sizni bir marta emas, balki bir marta qo'ng'iroq qilmaysiz.

en: Still, your mind works true, and argues not a particulari ad universale.
uz: Biroq, ongingiz haqiqat bilan ishlaydi va partikular ad universale bilan bahslashmaydi.

en: There is this peculiarity in criminals.
uz: Jinoyatchilarda bu xususiyat bor.

en: It is so constant, in all countries and at all times, that even police, who know not much from philosophy, come to know it empirically, that it is.
uz: Bu har doim ham, har qanday mamlakatda va har doim ham shunday holatda bo'lib turadiki, hatto falsafaning ko'pligini bilmaydigan politsiya xodimlari ham bu haqda empirik ravishda bilib olishadi.

en: That is to be empiric.
uz: Bu tajribaviy bo'lishi kerak.

en: The criminal always work at one crime, that is the true criminal who seems predestinate to crime, and who will of none other.
uz: Jinoyatchi har doim bitta jinoyatda ishlaydi, ya'ni jinoyat uchun taqdirlangan bo'lib ko'rinadigan va boshqa hech qanday jinoyatda ishlamaydigan haqiqiy jinoyatchi.

en: This criminal has not full man brain.
uz: Ushbu jinoyatchining miyasi to'liq emas.

en: He is clever and cunning and resource- ful, but he be not of man stature as to brain.
uz: U aqlli, hiyla-nayrang va resurslarga to'la, ammo u miya kabi inson bo'lmagan.

en: He be of child brain in much.
uz: U ko'p jihatdan bolalik miyasiga ega.

en: Now this criminal of ours is pre-destinate to crime also.
uz: Endi bizning jinoyatchilarimiz ham jinoyatchilikka yo'naltirilgan.

en: He, too, have child brain, and it is of the child to do what he have done.
uz: U ham bola miyasiga ega va u qilgan ishni bola o'zi qiladi.

en: The little bird, the little ﬁsh, the little animal learn not by principle, but empirically.
uz: Kichik qush, kichkina baliq, kichkina hayvon prinsip bo'yicha emas, balki tajriba asosida o'rganadi.

en: And when he learn to do, then there is to him the ground to start from to do more.
uz: Va u qilishni o'rganganida, yana ko'proq qilish uchun boshlash uchun asos bor.

en: `Dos pou sto,' said Archimedes.
uz: `Dos pou sto,' dedi Arximed.

en: `Give me a fulcrum, and I shall move the world!' To do once, is the fulcrum whereby child brain become man brain.
uz: `Ma'lumot bering, men dunyoni harakatga keltiraman!' - deb aytish uchun bir marta, bola miyasi inson miyasiga aylanishi kerak.

en: And un- til he have the purpose to do more, he continue to do the same again every time, just as he have done before!
uz: Va u yana ko'proq ish qilish maqsadiga ega bo'lmaguncha, avvalgidek har safar aynan shunday qilishni davom ettiradi!

en: Oh, my dear, I see that your eyes are opened, and that to you the lightning ﬂash show all the leagues,for Mrs.
uz: Oh, azizim, ko'zimga ko'rinadi, ko'zlaring ochilgan va chaqmoq shovqinlari senga barcha yo'nalishlarni ko'rsatadi.

en: Harker began to clap her hands and her eyes sparkled.
uz: Harker qo'llarini tatib, ko'zlari parlashdi.

en: He went on, Now you shall speak.
uz: U davom etdi: Hndi sen gapirishing kerak.

en: Tell us two dry men of science what you see with those so bright eyes. He took her hand and held it whilst he spoke.
uz: Ikki quruq olimga nima ko'rganingizni o'sha yorqin ko'zlaringiz bilan aytinglar-chi, - dedi.U ayolning qo'lidan ushlab, gapirganida uni ushlab turdi.

en: His ﬁnger and thumb closed on her pulse, as I thought instinctively and unconsciously, as she spoke.
uz: Uning barmog'i va bosh barmog'i uning pulsiga yopildi, men uning gapirganida instinktli va bexabar o'yladim.

en: The Count is a criminal and of criminal type.
uz: Graf jinoyatchi va jinoyatchilik turiga ega.

en: Nordau and Lombroso would so classify him, and qua criminal he is of an imperfectly formed mind.
uz: Nordau va Lombroso uni shunday tanqid qilishadi va jinoyatchi sifatida u mukammal darajada rivojlanmagan ongga ega.

en: Thus, in a difﬁculty he has to seek resource in habit.
uz: Shunday qilib, qiyinchilikka duch kelganida, u odatda resurs izlashi kerak.

en: His past is a clue, and the one page of it that we know, and that from his own lips, tells that once before, when in what Mr.
uz: Uning o'tmishida bir eslatma bor va biz uning bitta sahifasini bilamiz va uning o'z og'zidan buni bir marta aytib o'tgan.

en: Morris would call a`tight place,' he went back to his own country from the land he had tried to invade, and thence, without losing purpose, prepared himself for a new effort.
uz: Morris a`tight place deb ataydi, - deb, o'z yurtiga o'z hujumini o'tkazmoqchi bo'lgan yerdan qaytib keldi va o'sha yerdan maqsadini yo'qotmay, o'zini yangi sa'y-harakatga tayyorladi.

en: He came again better equipped for his work, and won.
uz: U yana o'z ishi uchun yaxshiroq jihozlangan bo'lib, g'alaba qozondi.

en: So he came to London to invade a new land.
uz: Shunday qilib, u Londonga yangi yurtga bostirib kirishga kelgan.

en: He was beaten, and when all hope of success was lost, and his existence in danger, he ﬂed back over the sea to his home.
uz: U mag'lub bo'ldi va muvaffaqiyat qozonish umidi yo'qolganda va o'z hayoti xavf ostida bo'lganda, u dengizdan o'z uylariga qochib ketdi.

en: Just as formerly he had ﬂed back over the Danube from Turkey Land.
uz: O'tmishda u Turkiya yurtidan Donau daryosidan qochib o'tganidek.

en: Oh, you so clever lady! said Van Helsing, enthusiastically, as he stooped and kissed her hand.
uz: Oh, siz juda aqlli ayolsiz! - dedi Van Helsing, buzib, uning qo'lini o'pdi.

en: A moment later he said to me, as calmly as though we had been having a sick room consultation, Seventy-two only, and in all this excitement.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, u menga kasalxona konsultatsiyasi o'tkazilganday, tinchlik bilan: Yegan yetmish ikki kishi va bu qadar hayajon bilan.

en: I have hope. Turning to her again, he said with keen expectation, But go on.
uz: Umidim bor. U yana ayolga qarab, qattiq kutish bilan dedi: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, davom et.

en: There is more to tell if you will.
uz: Agar xohlasangiz, aytish uchun ko'proq narsa bor.

en: I do in any case, and shall tell you if you are right.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, men buni bilaman va agar siz haq bo'lsangiz, sizga aytaman.

en: Speak, without fear! I will try to.
uz: Qo'rqmasdan gapiring! - deb aytdi. - Men harakat qilaman.

en: But you will forgive me if I seem too egotistical. Nay!
uz: Ammo agar men juda xudbin bo'lib tuyulsam, meni kechirasiz.

en: Fear not, you must be egotist, for it is of you that we think. Then, as he is criminal he is selﬁsh.
uz: Qo'rqma, siz o'zingizni o'ylashingiz kerak, chunki biz siz haqingizda o'ylaymiz.

en: And as his intellect is small and his action is based on selﬁshness, he conﬁnes himself to one purpose.
uz: Uning aqli kichik va harakatlari xudbinlikka asoslangan ekan, u o'zini faqat bitta maqsadga bag'ishlaydi.

en: That pur- pose is remorseless.
uz: Ushbu holat rahmsizlikdir.

en: As he ﬂed back over the Danube, leaving his forces to be cut to pieces, so now he is intent on being safe, careless of all.
uz: U Donau daryosi ustidan qochib ketib, qo'shinlarini parchalatib tashlaganidek, hozir ham u xavfsizlikda bo'lishga intiladi.

en: So his own selﬁshness frees my soul somewhat from the terrible power which he acquired over me on that dreadful night.
uz: Shunday qilib, uning o'z xudbinligi o'sha dahshatli kechada menga qarshi olgan dahshatli kuchdan ruhimni biroz ozod qiladi.

en: Thank God, for His great mercy!
uz: Xudoga shukr, Uning buyuk rahm-shafqati uchun!

en: My soul is freer than it has been since that awful hour.
uz: O'sha dahshatli soatdan beri jonim erkinroq.

en: And all that haunts me is a fear lest in some trance or dream he may have used my knowledge for his ends. The Professor stood up, He has so used your mind, and by it he has left us here in Varna, whilst the ship that carried him rushed through enveloping fog up to Galatz, where, doubtless, he had made preparation for escaping from us.
uz: Va meni faqat qo'rqitadi, ehtimol u qandaydir transda yoki tushda mening bilimlarimdan o'z maqsadlari uchun foydalangan bo'lishi mumkin.Professor o'rnidan turib, shunday dedi: U sizning ongingizni shunday ishlatdi va bu tufayli bizni Varna shahrida qoldirdi, uni ko'tarib kelayotgan kemani esa o'z ichiga olgan bulut orqali Galatzga boradi, u erda, shubhasiz, u bizdan qochishga tayyorgarlik ko'rdi.

en: But his child mind only saw so far.
uz: Ammo uning bolalik ongi faqat shu qadar ko'rgan.

en: And it may be that as ever is in God's Providence, the very thing that the evil doer most reckoned on for his selﬁsh good, turns out to be his chiefest harm.
uz: Ehtimol, Xudoning O'zi ko'rsatganidek, yovuzlik qiluvchi o'z manfaatini ko'zlab, o'z manfaatini ko'zlaydi, ammo bu uning asosiy zararini ko'rsatadi.

en: The hunter is taken in his own snare, as the great Psalmist says.
uz: Buyuk sano bastakori aytganidek, ovchi o'z tuzog'iga tushadi.

en: For now that he think he is free from every trace of us all, and that he has escaped us with so many hours to him, then his selﬁsh child brain will whisper him to sleep.
uz: Endi u o'zini barchamizdan hech qanday iz qoldirmagan deb hisoblaydi va bizdan shuncha soat bilan qochib ketgani uchun, o'zining xudbin bola miyasi uni uxlashga shovqin qiladi.

en: He think, too, that as he cut himself off from knowing your mind, there can be no knowledge of him to you.
uz: U ham o'zini sizning fikringizni bilmaslikka chorlaganligi sababli, siz uchun u haqida hech qanday bilim bo'lmasligini o'ylaydi.

en: There is where he fail!
uz: U muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan joy bor!

en: That terrible baptism of blood which he give you makes you free to go to him in spirit, as you have as yet done in your times of freedom, when the sun rise and set.
uz: U sizga bergan dahshatli qonli suvga cho'mish sizni ruhda Uning oldiga borish uchun ozod qiladi, chunki siz hozirgacha erkinlik davringizda, quyosh chiqish va botish paytida shunday qildingiz.

en: At such times you go by my volition and not by his.
uz: Bunday paytlarda siz uning emas, balki mening xohishimga amal qilasiz.

en: And this power to good of you and others, you have won from your suffering at his hands.
uz: Va bu kuchni o'zingiz va boshqalarga yaxshilik qilish uchun, siz uning qo'lida azob chekishdan qo'lga kiritgansiz.

en: This is now all more precious that he know it not, and to guard himself have even cut himself off from his knowledge of our where.
uz: Hozir bu uning bilmasligidan ancha qimmatbaho, va o'zini himoya qilish uchun hatto bizning qaerda ekanligimizni bilmasligidan o'zini kesib qo'ydi.

en: We, however, are not selﬁsh, and we believe that God is with us through all this blackness, and these many dark hours.
uz: Biroq, biz xudbin emasmiz va Xudo bu qorong'ilik va ko'p qorong'i soatlar davomida biz bilan birga ekaniga ishonamiz.

en: We shall follow him, and we shall not ﬂinch.
uz: Biz unga ergashamiz va qo'rqmaymiz.

en: Even if we peril ourselves that we
uz: Hatto o'zimizni xavf ostiga qo'ysak ham, biz o'zimizni xavf ostiga qo'yamiz.

en: Friend John, this has been a great hour, and it have done much to advance us on our way.
uz: Do'st John, bu juda yaxshi soat bo'ldi va bu bizni yo'limizdan o'tishga ko'p yordam berdi.

en: You must be scribe and write him all down, so that when the others return from their work you can give it to them, then they shall know as we do. And so I have written it whilst we wait their return, and Mrs.
uz: Siz yozuvchi bo'lishingiz kerak va hamma narsani yozib olishingiz kerak, toki boshqalar ishdan qaytganida siz ularga bersangiz, ular ham biz kabi bilishadi.

en: Harker has written with the typewriter all since she brought the MS to us.
uz: Harker MS-ni bizga olib kelganidan beri matbaa mashinasi bilan yozgan.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 29 October.—This is written in the train from Varna to Galatz.
uz: SEWARDning 29 oktyabr kunlik kundaligi.Bu Varnadan Galatzga ketadigan poyezdda yozilgan.

en: Last night we all assembled a little before the time of sunset.
uz: Kecha kechasi hammamiz quyosh botishidan biroz oldin yig'ilgan edik.

en: Each of us had done his work as well as he could, so far as thought, and endeavor, and opportunity go, we are prepared for the whole of our journey, and for our work when we get to Galatz.
uz: Har birimiz o'z ishimizni qo'limizdan kelganicha yaxshi bajargan edik, fikr, harakat va imkoniyatlarga ko'ra, biz butun safarimiz va Galatzga yetib borganimizda o'z ishimiz uchun tayyormiz.

en: When the usual time came round Mrs.
uz: Odatdagi vaqt kelganida, xonim

en: Harker prepared her- self for her hypnotic effort, and after a longer and more serious effort on the part of Van Helsing than has been usually necessary, she sank into the trance.
uz: Harker o'zini hipnotik harakatlari uchun tayyorladi va Van Helsingning odatda kerakli bo'lganidan ko'proq va jiddiy harakatlaridan so'ng, u transga tushdi.

en: Usually she speaks on a hint, but this time the Professor had to ask her questions, and to ask them pretty resolutely, before we could learn any- thing.
uz: Odatda u g'oya asosida gapiradi, ammo bu safar professor biz biron narsa o'rganishdan oldin unga savollar berish va ularni qat'iylik bilan so'rash kerak edi.

en: At last her answer came.
uz: Nihoyat uning javobi keldi.

en: There are no waves lapping, but only a steady swirl of water softly running against the hawser.
uz: To'lqinlar ko'tarilmayapti, faqat suvning bir to'plamini ko'tarib, o'z-o'zidan o'tib ketadi.

en: I can hear men's voices calling, near and far, and the roll and creak of oars in the rowlocks.
uz: Men yaqin va uzoq bo'lgan erkaklarning ovozlarini eshitaman, shuningdek, qirg'oqlarda quviq va qichqiriqlarni eshitaman.

en: A gun is ﬁred somewhere, the echo of it seems far away.
uz: Bir joyda qurol o'qiladi va uning tovushi uzoqdan eshitilishi mumkin.

en: There is tramping of feet overhead, and ropes and chains are dragged along.
uz: Boshning ostidan oyoqlarning cho'kib ketishi, qo'llar va zanjirlar tortib olinishi kuzatilmoqda.

en: There is a gleam of light.
uz: Yorug'lik parvozi bor.

en: I can feel the air blowing upon me. Here she stopped.
uz: Havoning ustimda puflanayotganini his qilaman. Bu yerda u to'xtadi.

en: She had risen, as if impulsively, from where she lay on the sofa, and raised both her hands, palms upwards, as if lifting a weight.
uz: U o'tirgan sofasidan o'z qo'llarini, qo'llarini yuqoriga ko'tarib, xuddi og'irlikni ko'targan bo'lsa-da, o'z ko'targan joyidan tez-tez turdi.

en: Van Helsing and I looked at each other with understanding.
uz: Van Helsing va men bir-birimizga tushuncha bilan qarardik.

en: Quincey raised his eyebrows slightly and looked at her intently, whilst Harker's hand in- stinctively closed round the hilt of his Kukri.
uz: Quincey ko'z burchaklarini biroz ko'tarib, unga diqqat bilan qaradi, Harkerning qo'li esa Kukrining qo'lini o'z ichiga oladi.

en: There was a long pause.
uz: Uzoq to'xtatish bo'ldi.

en: We all knew that the time when she could speak was passing, but we felt that it was useless to say anything.
uz: Uning gapirish vaqti o'tib ketayotganini hammamiz bilardik, lekin biz hech narsa aytishning foydasi yo'q deb o'yladik.

en: Suddenly she sat up, and as she opened her eyes said sweetly, Would none of you like a cup of tea?
uz: Toʻsatdan u oʻrnidan turib, koʻzlarini ochib, shirinlik bilan dedi: Sizlardan hech kim bir qadah choy isteʼmol qilmaydimi?

en: You must all be so tired! We could only make her happy, and so acqueisced.
uz: Hammangiz juda charchagan bo'lishingiz kerak! - Biz uni faqat quvonchga to'ldira olardik va u shunchalik quvonchga to'lgan edi.

en: She bustled off to get tea.
uz: U choy olishga bordi.

en: When she had gone Van Helsing said, You see, my friends.
uz: U ketgach, Van Helsing shunday dedi: Qizlar, ko'ribsizlarmi?

en: He has left his earth chest.
uz: U yer yuzini tashlab ketgan.

en: But he has yet to get on shore.
uz: Ammo u hali qirg'oqqa yetib bormagan.

en: In the night he may lie hidden somewhere, but if he be not carried on shore, or if the ship do not touch it, he cannot achieve the land.
uz: Kechasi u qayerda yashirincha yotgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uni qirg'oqqa olib bormasa yoki kemasi unga tegmasa, u yerga yetib bo'lmaydi.

en: In such case he can, if it be in the night, change his form and jump or ﬂy on shore, then, unless he be carried he cannot escape.
uz: Bunday holatda u, agar kechasi bo'lsa, shaklini o'zgartirib, qirg'oqqa sakrash yoki uchib ketishi mumkin.

en: And if he be carried, then the customs men may discover what the box contain.
uz: Agar uni olib ketsa, bojxona xodimlari qutadagi narsalarni topishlari mumkin.

en: Thus, in ﬁne, if he escape not on shore tonight, or before dawn, there will be the whole day lost to him.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar u bugun kechqurun yoki tong chiqqach, qirg'oqqa chiqib ketmasa, butun kun unga yo'qoladi.

en: We may then arrive in time.
uz: Keyin biz o'z vaqtida etib borishimiz mumkin.

en: For if he escape not at night we shall come on him in daytime, boxed up and at our mercy.
uz: Agar u kechasi qochib ketmasa, biz unga kunduzda, qadoqlangan holda va rahm-shafqatimiz bilan hujum qilamiz.

en: For he dare not be his true self, awake and visible, lest he be discovered. There was no more to be said, so we waited in patience until the dawn, at which time we might learn more from Mrs.
uz: Chunki u o'zining haqiqiy o'zi bo'lishga jur'at qilmaydi, u uyg'onadi va ko'rinadi, agar u aniqlanmasa.

en: Early this morning we listened, with breathless anxiety, for her response in her trance.
uz: Bugun ertalab ertalab biz uning transdagi javobini nafassiz tashvish bilan tingladik.

en: The hypnotic stage was even longer in coming than before, and when it came the time remaining until full sunrise was so short that we began to despair.
uz: Hipnotik bosqich oldingiga qaraganda ko'proq davom etdi va to'liq quyosh chiqishgacha qolgan vaqt shunchalik qisqa bo'ldiki, umidsizlikka tushdik.

en: Van Helsing seemed to throw his whole soul into the ef- fort.
uz: Van Helsing o'z ruhini butunlay qo'lga kiritdi.

en: At last, in obedience to his will she made reply.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, uning irodasini bajargan ayol javob berdi.

en: I hear lapping water, level with me, and some creaking as of wood on wood. She paused, and the red sun shot up.
uz: Suv g'ayratli bo'lib, men bilan to'g'rilashayotganini, ba'zilari yog'och ustida yog'och kabi qichqirishayotganini eshityapman. U to'xtadi va qizil quyosh ko'tarildi.

en: We must wait till tonight.
uz: Bugun kechgacha kutishimiz kerak.

en: And so it is that we are travelling towards Galatz in an agony of expecta- tion.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz o'zimizni kutish azobida Galatzga yo'llamoqdamiz.

en: We are due to arrive between two and three in the morning.
uz: Biz ertalab soat ikkiyu uch o'rtasida kelishimiz kerak.

en: But al- ready, at Bucharest, we are three hours late, so we cannot possibly get in till well after sunup.
uz: Ammo tayyor bo'ling, Bukareştda uch soat kechikib qoldik, shuning uchun quyosh chiqishdan keyin ham kirishga imkon yo'q.

en: Thus we shall have two more hypnotic messages from Mrs.
uz: Shunday qilib, bizda xonimning yana ikkita hipnotik xabarlari bo'ladi.

en: Either or both may possibly throw more light on what is happening.
uz: Yoki ikkalasi ham sodir bo'layotgan hodisalarga ko'proq yorug'lik ko'rsatishi mumkin.

en: Later.—Sunset has come and gone.
uz: Keyinroq. Quyosh botishi kelib ketadi.

en: Fortunately it came at a time when there was no distraction.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, bu hech qanday chalg'itish yo'q bo'lgan vaqtda sodir bo'ldi.

en: For had it occurred whilst we were at a station, we might not have secured the necessary calm and isolation.
uz: Agar biz stantsiyada bo'lganimizda sodir bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, biz kerakli xotirjamlik va izolyatsiyaga erishmagan bo'lar edik.

en: Harker yield- ed to the hypnotic inﬂuence even less readily than this morning.
uz: Harker hipnotik ta'sirga bugun ertalabkiga qaraganda ham kamroq mos keladi.

en: I am in fear that her power of reading the Count's sensations may die away, just when we want it most.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, uning Countning his-tuyg'ularini o'qish qobiliyati, biz uni eng ko'p xohlagan paytda o'lib ketishi mumkin.

en: It seems to me that her imagination is beginning to work.
uz: Menga o'xshaydiki, uning tasavvur qilish tarzi ishlamoqda.

en: Whilst she has been in the trance hitherto she has conﬁned herself to the simplest of facts.
uz: Hozirgacha u transda bo'lganida, o'zini sodda faktlarga cheklagan.

en: If this goes on it may ultimately mislead us.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, oxir-oqibat bizni yo'ldan ozdirishi mumkin.

en: If I thought that the Count's power over her would die away equally with her power of knowledge it would be a happy thought.
uz: Agar men Countning uning ustidan bo'lgan qudrati uning bilim qudrati bilan bir qatorda o'lib ketishini o'ylasam, bu quvonchli fikr bo'lardi.

en: But I am afraid that it may not be so.
uz: Ammo qo'rqamanki, bunday bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: When she did speak, her words were enigmatical,Something is going out.
uz: U gapirganda, so'zlari g'ayritabiiy edi: Bir narsa chiqib ketyapti.

en: I can feel it pass me like a cold wind.
uz: Men uni sovuq shamol kabi o'tib ketayotganini his qila olaman.

en: I can hear, far off, confused sounds, as of men talking in strange tongues, ﬁerce falling water, and the howling of wolves. She stopped and a shudder ran through her, increasing in intensity for a few seconds, till at the end, she shook as though in a palsy.
uz: Uzoqlikda men g'alati tillarda gapirayotgan odamlarning g'alati tovushlarini, g'alati suv tushayotganini va bo'rilarning qichqirishini eshityapman. U to'xtadi va u bir necha soniya davomida kuchayib borayotgan titrishni eshitdi.

en: She said no more, even in answer to the Professor's imperative questioning.
uz: U boshqa hech narsa aytmadi, hatto professorning talabchan savollariga javob berganda ham.

en: When she woke from the trance, she was cold, and exhausted, and languid, but her mind was all alert.
uz: U transdan uyg'onganida, sovuq, charchagan va charchagan edi, ammo ongini uyg'otgan edi.

en: She could not remember anything, but asked what she had said.
uz: U hech narsani eslay olmagan, lekin nima deb aytganini so'radi.

en: When she was told, she pondered over it deeply for a long time and in silence.
uz: Bu so'zlarni eshitgach, u uzoq vaqt va xotirjamlik bilan bu haqda chuqur mulohaza yuritdi.

en: m.—We are near Galatz now, and I may not have time to write later.
uz: Biz hozir Galatz yaqinida yashayapmiz va keyinchalik yozishga vaqtim bo'lmasligi mumkin.

en: Sunrise this morning was anxiously looked for by us all.
uz: Bugun ertalab quyosh chiqishi hammamiz uchun tashvish bilan kutilgan edi.

en: Know- ing of the increasing difﬁculty of procuring the hypnotic trance, Van Hels- ing began his passes earlier than usual.
uz: Hipnotik transni olishning qiyin bo'layotganini bilib, Van Helsing o'z o'tishlarini odatdagidan ham erta boshladi.

en: They produced no effect, however, until the regular time, when she yielded with a still greater difﬁculty, only a minute before the sun rose.
uz: Biroq, ular odatdagi vaqtgacha hech qanday ta'sir ko'rsatmadilar, unda u quyosh chiqishidan faqat bir daqiqa oldin yanada qiyinchilik bilan voz kechdi.

en: The Professor lost no time in his questioning.
uz: Professor so'rov berishda vaqt o'tkazmadi.

en: Her answer came with equal quickness, All is dark.
uz: Uning javobi ham xuddi shu tezlik bilan keldi: Hamma narsa qorong'i.

en: I hear water swirling by, level with my ears, and the creaking of wood on wood.
uz: O'zimdan o'tgan suvni, quloqlarim bilan to'lib-toshganini, yog'ochning yog'och ustiga qichqirishini eshitaman.

en: There is another sound, a queer one like …  She stopped and grew white, and whiter still.
uz: Yana bir tovush bor, bu xuddi ...  U to'xtadi va oqib ketdi, yanada oqib ketdi.

en: Speak, I command you! said Van Helsing in an agonized voice.
uz: So'zlang, sizga amr beraman! - dedi Van Helsing og'ir ovoz bilan.

en: At the same time there was despair in his eyes, for the risen sun was reddening even Mrs.
uz: Shu bilan birga, uning ko'zlarida umidsizlik bor edi, chunki quyosh chiqishidan xotinning o'zi ham qizargan edi.

en: She opened her eyes, and we all started as she said, sweetly and seemingly with the utmost unconcern.
uz: U ko'zlarini ochdi va biz hammamiz u aytganidek, shirinlik bilan va ko'rinishda g'amxo'rlik qilmay boshladik.

en: Oh, Professor, why ask me to do what you know I can't?
uz: Oh, professor, nega menga qila olmaydigan ishni qilishimni so'raysiz?

en: I don't remem- ber anything. Then, seeing the look of amazement on our faces, she said, turning from one to the other with a troubled look, What have I said?
uz: Men hech narsani eslay olmayman. Keyin, yuzlarimizdagi hayronlik ko'rinishini ko'rib, u bir-biriga qayg'uli ko'rinish bilan qarab: Men nima dedim?

en: I know nothing, only that I was lying here, half asleep, and heard you say `go on!
uz: Men hech narsani bilmayman, faqat men bu yerda yotgan edim, yarim uyquda edim va sizdan ` go on' deyishingizni eshitdim!

en: speak, I command you!' It seemed so funny to hear you order me about, as if I were a bad child! Oh, Madam Mina, he said, sadly, it is proof, if proof be needed, of how I love and honor you, when a word for your good, spoken more earnest than ever, can seem so strange because it is to order her whom I am proud to obey! The whistles are sounding.
uz: Men sizga amr beraman! - deb, meni yomon bola kabi buyruq berayotganingizni eshitish juda qiziqarli tuyuldi! O, Madam Mina, - dedi u, xafa bo'lib, - bu, agar kerak bo'lsa, sizni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rishim va hurmat qilishimni isbotlaydi, chunki sizning manfaatingiz uchun gapirilgan so'z, har qachongidan ham jiddiyroq, juda g'alati tuyuladi, chunki bu mening g'urur bilan bo'ysunishim kerak bo'lgan ayolga buyruq berishdir! - deb o'ylaydi.

en: We are nearing Galatz.
uz: Galatz yaqinlashmoqda.

en: We are on ﬁre with anxiety and eagerness.
uz: Biz tashvish va g'ayrat bilan olovda yondiramiz.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL Mining Harker jurnalining jurnalini o'rganish

en: Morris took me to the hotel where our rooms had been ordered by telegraph, he being the one who could best be spared, since he does not speak any foreign language.
uz: Morris bizni mehmonxonaga olib bordi, u erda xonamiz telegraf orqali buyurtma qilingan edi, chunki u hech qanday chet tilini bilmaydigan bo'lgani uchun undan eng yaxshi qutqarish mumkin edi.

en: The forces were distributed much as they had been at Varna, except that Lord Godalming went to the Vice Con- sul, as his rank might serve as an immediate guarantee of some sort to the ofﬁcial, we being in extreme hurry.
uz: Qo'shinlar Varna shahrida bo'lgani kabi tarqaldi, faqat Lord Godalming Vitse-Konolga bordi, chunki uning darajasi mansabdor shaxsga qandaydir bevosita kafolat sifatida xizmat qilishi mumkin edi, chunki biz juda shoshilinch edik.

en: Jonathan and the two doctors went to the shipping agent to learn particulars of the arrival of the Czarina Catherine.
uz: Jonatan va ikkita shifokor Charina Ketrin kelishi haqida batafsil ma'lumot olish uchun kema agentiga borishdi.

en: Later.—Lord Godalming has returned.
uz: Keyinroq.Lord Godalming qaytib keldi.

en: The Consul is away, and the Vice Consul sick.
uz: Konsul tashqarida, vitse-konsul esa kasal.

en: So the routine work has been attended to by a clerk.
uz: Demak, odatdagi ishda bir ishchi ishtirok etgan.

en: He was very obliging, and offered to do anything in his power.
uz: U juda mehribon bo'lib, qo'lidan kelganini qilishga tayyor edi.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 October.—At nine o'clock Dr.
uz: JONATHAN HARKERning jurnalining 30 oktyabr kuni soat to'qqizlarda Dr.

en: Seward, and I called on Messrs.
uz: Seward va men xonimlarni ko'rib chiqdik.

en: Mackenzie & Steinkoff, the agents of the London ﬁrm of Hap- good.
uz: Mackenzie & Steinkoff, Londondagi Hap-good firmasining agentlari.

en: They had received a wire from London, in answer to Lord Godalm- ing's telegraphed request, asking them to show us any civility in their pow- er.
uz: Ular Lord Godalmning telegraf so'roviga javob sifatida Londondan telegram olishdi va bizdan o'z xizmatlarida har qanday xushmuomalalikni ko'rsatishlarini so'rashdi.

en: They were more than kind and courteous, and took us at once on board the Czarina Catherine, which lay at anchor out in the river harbor.
uz: Ular mehribon va xushmuomala bo'lishdan ko'ra, bizni darhol daryo daryosida quvib turgan Czarina Katarina kemasiga o'tkazishdi.

en: There we saw the Captain, Donelson by name, who told us of his voyage.
uz: O'sha yerda biz kapitan Donelsonni ko'rdik, u bizga o'z sayohatini aytib berdi.

en: He said that in all his life he had never had so favorable a run.
uz: U o'z hayotida hech qachon bu qadar yaxshi ko'rsatkichga ega bo'lmaganini aytdi.

en: Man! he said, but it made us afeard, for we expect it that we should have to pay for it wi' some rare piece o' ill luck, so as to keep up the aver- age.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bu bizni qo'rqitdi, chunki biz o'zimizni odat tusiga olish uchun buning evaziga ba'zi kamdan-kam omadsizlikka duch kelishimiz kerak deb o'yladik.

en: It's no canny to run frae London to the Black Sea wi' a wind ahint ye, as though the Deil himself were blawin' on yer sail for his ain purpose.
uz: Londondan Qora dengizga shamol bilan o'tish hech qanday yomon ish emas, xuddi deylning o'zi o'z maqsadi uchun yelkashlik qilgandek.

en: An' a' the time we could no speer a thing.
uz: Bir vaqtlar biz hech narsa bilan shug'ullanmas edik.

en: Gin we were nigh a ship, or a port, or a headland, a fog fell on us and travelled wi' us, till when after it had lifted and we looked out, the deil a thing could we see.
uz: Biz kema, port yoki boshlandiya yaqinida bo'lganimizda, ustimizga tuman tushdi va biz bilan sayohat qildi, hatto u ko'tarilganidan so'ng va biz tashqariga qaraganimizdan so'ng, biz biron bir narsani ko'rishimiz mumkin edi.

en: We ran by Gibraltar wi' oot bein' able to signal.
uz: Biz Gibraltarni bosib o'tdik va signal berish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldik.

en: An' til we came to the Dardanelles and had to wait to get our permit to pass, we never were within hail o' aught.
uz: Dardanellaga yetib kelib, ruxsatnoma olishni kutish kerak bo'lganimizcha, hech qachon qorib ketishga kirmagan edik.

en: At ﬁrst I in- clined to slack off sail and beat about till the fog was lifted.
uz: Boshida men yelkanni to'xtatishga moyil bo'ldim va bulut ko'tarilmaguncha harakat qildim.

en: But whiles, I thocht that if the Deil was minded to get us into the Black Sea quick, he was like to do it whether we would or no.
uz: Ammo men shuni bilamanki, agar bitim bizni Qora dengizga tezroq olib kirmoqchi bo'lsa, biz xohlasak ham, xohlamasak ham, uni amalga oshirishni xohlaydi.

en: If we had a quick voyage it would be no to our miscredit wi'the owners, or no hurt to our trafﬁc, an' the Old Mon who had served his ain purpose wad be decently grateful to us for no hin- derin' him. This mixture of simplicity and cunning, of superstition and commercial reasoning, aroused Van Helsing, who said,Mine friend, that Devil is more
uz: Agar biz tez sayohat qilsak, o'z sahifalarimizga noto'g'ri e'tibor bermaymiz, yo'l-yo'lakayimizga zarar yetkazmaymiz, o'z maqsadiga xizmat qilgan Old Mon unga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaganimiz uchun bizga munosib minnatdor bo'ladi. Bu soddalik va hiyla-nayranglik, shuhr va tijorat tafakkurlari aralashmasi Van Helsingni uyg'otdi va u shunday dedi: Do'stim, bu iblis ko'proq bor.

en: clever than he is thought by some, and he know when he meet his match! The skipper was not displeased with the compliment, and went on, When we got past the Bosphorus the men began to grumble.
uz: Ba'zilar o'ylagandan ko'ra aqlli va o'z tengdoshi bilan qachon uchrashishini biladi! - deb aytadi.Skipter bu maqomdan norozi bo'lmay, davom etdi: Biz Bosforni o'tgach, erkaklar g'azablanishni boshlashdi.

en: Some o' them, the Roumanians, came and asked me to heave overboard a big box which had been put on board by a queer lookin' old man just before we had started frae London.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari, ruminliklar, mendan Londonda fray boshlashdan oldin bir keksa yigit tomonidan o'rnatilgan katta quti ko'tarib olishimni so'radilar.

en: I had seen them speer at the fellow, and put out their twa ﬁn- gers when they saw him, to guard them against the evil eye.
uz: Men ularni o'sha odamga nayza tashlayotganini va uni ko'rganlarida o'zlarining ikkita qilichlarini o'chirib qo'yganini ko'rdim, bu esa ularni yovuz ko'zdan himoya qilish uchun edi.

en: but the supersteetion of foreigners is pairfectly rideeculous!
uz: Ammo chet elliklarning supersteetionlari juda yaxshi o'tadi!

en: I sent them aboot their business pretty quick, but as just after a fog closed in on us I felt a wee bit as they did anent something, though I wouldn't say it was again the big box.
uz: Men ularni o'z ishlariga tezroq yubordim, lekin bizni bulut qoplaganidan so'ng, ular biror narsa qilishayotganini biroz his qildim, ammo yana katta quti deb aytmasdim.

en: Well, on we went, and as the fog didn't let up for ﬁve days I joost let the wind carry us, for if the Deil wanted to get somewheres, well, he would fetch it up a'reet.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz bordik va besh kun davomida so'ng ham g'ildirak ko'tarilmaganligi sababli, shamol bizni ko'tarib borishiga yo'l qo'ydim, chunki agar Deil biror joyga bormoqchi bo'lsa, uni to'sib oladi.

en: An' if he didn't, well, we'd keep a sharp lookout anyhow.
uz: Bordi-yu, bunday qilmasa ham, biz hech bo'lmaganda o'zimizni aniq ko'rib turardik.

en: Sure eneuch, we had a fair way and deep water all the time.
uz: Shubhasiz, bizda doimo adolatli yo'l va chuqur suv bor edi.

en: And two days ago, when the mornin' sun came through the fog, we found ourselves just in the river opposite Galatz.
uz: Va ikki kun oldin, ertalab quyosh sisiqdan o'tib, biz o'zimizni Galatz tomonidagi daryoda topdik.

en: The Roumanians were wild, and wanted me right or wrong to take out the box and ﬂing it in the river.
uz: Rumoniylar yovvoyi bo'lishgan va mening qutini olib chiqib, daryoga tashlashimni xohlashgan.

en: I had to argy wi' them aboot it wi' a handspike.
uz: Men bu haqda qo'l cho'qqisi bilan bahslashishim kerak edi.

en: An' when the last o' them rose off the deck wi' his head in his hand, I had convinced them that, evil eye or no evil eye, the property and the trust of my owners were better in my hands than in the riv- er Danube.
uz: So'nggi o'zi boshini qo'lida ko'targanida, men ularni yovuz ko'z yoki hech qanday yovuz ko'z bo'lmagan taqdirda ham, egalarimning mol-mulki va ishonchi Donau daryosida bo'lganidan ko'ra mening qo'limda yaxshiroq ekanligiga ishontirgan edim.

en: They had, mind ye, taken the box on the deck ready to ﬂing in, and as it was marked Galatz via Varna, I thocht I'd let it lie till we dis- charged in the port an' get rid o't althegither.
uz: Ular, e'tibor bering, qadoqni qadoqqa olib kirishga tayyor edilar va u Galatz orqali Varna orqali belgilangani sababli, men uni portda to'ldirilmaguncha qo'yib yuboraman deb o'ylayman.

en: We didn't do much clearin' that day, an' had to remain the nicht at anchor.
uz: O'sha kuni biz ko'p yo'l tutmadik, shuning uchun anchorda qolmasligimiz kerak edi.

en: But in the mornin', braw an' airly, an hour before sunup, a man came aboard wi' an order, written to him from England, to receive a box marked for one Count Dracula.
uz: Ammo ertalab, bir soat quyosh chiqishdan oldin, Angliyadan unga yozib yuborilgan buyruq bilan bir kishi Dracula hidoyatida belgilangani uchun quti olish uchun kemaga keldi.

en: Sure eneuch the matter was one ready to his hand.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu masala uning qo'liga tayyor edi.

en: He had his papers a' reet, an' gla d I was to be rid o' the dam' thing, for I was beginnin' masel' to feel uneasy at it.
uz: O'z qog'ozlarini o'chirib qo'ygan edi, men damdan xalos bo'lishim kerak edi, chunki men bu bilan o'zimni noqulay his qila boshlagan edim.

en: If the Deil did have any luggage aboord the ship, I'm thinkin' it was nane ither than that same! What was the name of the man who took it? asked Dr.
uz: Deil kemasida biron-bir bagaj bor bo'lsa, u undan ham ko'proq bo'lgan deb o'ylayman! - deb so'radi doktor.

en: Van Helsing with restrained eagerness.
uz: Van Helsing ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qildi.

en: I'll be tellin' ye quick! he answered, and stepping down to his cabin, produced a receipt signed Immanuel Hildesheim. Burgen-strasse 16 was the address.
uz: Men tezda sizga aytaman! - deb javob berdi u va o'z kabinasiga tushib, imzolangan Immanuel Hildesheim rasvochasini keltirdi. Burgen-strasse 16 manzili edi.

en: We found out that this was all the Captain knew, so with thanks we came away.
uz: Biz kapitanning faqat shu narsani bilishini bilib oldik, shuning uchun minnatdorchilik bilan ketdik.

en: We found Hildesheim in his ofﬁce, a Hebrew of rather the Adelphi The- atre type, with a nose like a sheep, and a fez.
uz: Biz Hildesheymni uning ishxonasida topdik, u adelphi The-atre turiga ega bo'lgan ibroniy, qo'ychaga o'xshash burun va fezga ega edi.

en: His arguments were pointed with specie, we doing the punctuation, and with a little bargaining he told us what he knew.
uz: Uning dalillari specie bilan ko'rsatilgan edi, bizlar ustunlarni o'rnatdik va u bizga ozgina muzokaralar bilan bilganlarini aytdi.

en: This turned out to be simple but important.
uz: Bu oddiy, ammo muhim bo'ldi.

en: He had re- ceived a letter from Mr.
uz: U Mr.dan xat olgan edi.

en: de Ville of London, telling him to receive, if possi- ble before sunrise so as to avoid customs, a box which would arrive at Galatz in the Czarina Catherine.
uz: London shaharchasi de Ville, agar mumkin bo'lsa, quyosh chiqishidan oldin, bojxonadan qochish uchun, Galatz shahridagi Czarina Ketrinada bo'ladigan quti olishini aytdi.

en: This he was to give in charge to a certain Petrof Skinsky, who dealt with the Slovaks who traded down the river to the port.
uz: Bu ishni u daryo bo'ylab portga olib boruvchi slovaklar bilan shug'ullanadigan Petrof Skinskiyga topshirdi.

en: He had been paid for his work by an English bank note, which had been duly cashed for gold at the Danube International Bank.
uz: Uning ishi uchun unga ingliz tilidagi bank notasi to'langan edi, uni Dunyo Xalqaro Bankida oltin uchun to'lov qilib qo'yishgan edi.

en: When Skinsky had come to him, he had taken him to the ship and handed over the box, so as to save parterage.
uz: Skinskiy uning oldiga kelganida, u uni kemasiga olib borib, parterajni saqlab qolish uchun quti o'tkazdi.

en: That was all he knew.
uz: U faqat shularni bilardi.

en: We then sought for Skinsky, but were unable to ﬁnd him.
uz: So'ngra Skinskini qidirdik, lekin topolmadik.

en: One of his neighbors, who did not seem to bear him any affection, said that he had gone away two days before,no one knew whither.
uz: Uning qo'shnilaridan biri unga hech qanday mehr ko'rsatmagan bo'lib, u ikki kun oldin ketgani va qayerga borayotganini hech kim bilmasligini aytdi.

en: This was corroborated by his landlord, who had received by messenger the key of the house together with the rent due, in English money.
uz: Buni uning uy egasi tasdiqladi, u elchi orqali uyning kalitini va ijara pulini ingliz pulida olgan edi.

en: This had been between ten and eleven o'clock last night.
uz: Bu kechasi soat o'n va o'n bir o'rtasida bo'lgan.

en: We were at a standstill again.
uz: Yana bir bor to'xtab qoldik.

en: Whilst we were talking one came running and breathlessly gasped out that the body of Skinsky had been found inside the wall of the churchyard of St.
uz: Gapirganimizda, bir kishi yugurib kelib, Skinskining jasadi St. Petersburg shahridagi qabristonning devorida topilganini so'zlab qo'ydi.

en: Peter, and that the throat had been torn open as if by some wild ani- mal.
uz: Butrusning bo'yni xuddi yovvoyi farishta tomonidan yirtilgan bo'lsa kerak.

en: Those we had been speaking with ran off to see the horror, the women crying out.
uz: Biz gapirgan kishilar dahshatli voqealarni ko'rish uchun qochib ketishdi, ayollar qichqirishdi.

en: This is the work of a Slovak! We hurried away lest we should have been in some way drawn into the affair, and so detained.
uz: Bu slovakning ishi! - deb qochdik, chunki biz bu ishda bir yo'l bilan ishtirok etishimiz kerak edi va shu yo'sin hibsga olinishimiz kerak edi.

en: As we came home we could arrive at no deﬁnite conclusion.
uz: Uyga qaytganimizda aniq xulosa chiqarolmadik.

en: We were all convinced that the box was on its way, by water, to somewhere, but where that might be we would have to discover.
uz: Biz hammamiz quti qayerda bo'lishi mumkinligini aniqlab olishimiz kerak edi, ammo quti qayerda bo'lishi mumkinligini aniqlab olishimiz kerak edi.

en: With heavy hearts we came home to the hotel to Mina.
uz: Biz og'ir yuraklar bilan Mina shahridagi mehmonxonaga qaytib keldik.

en: When we met together, the ﬁrst thing was to consult as to taking Mina again into our conﬁdence.
uz: Uchrashganimizda, birinchi navbatda Minani yana o'zimizga ishonib topishga qaror qildik.

en: Things are getting desperate, and it is at least a chance, though a hazardous one.
uz: Vaziyat tushkunlikka tushib bormoqda va bu hech bo'lmaganda xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan imkoniyatdir.

en: As a preliminary step, I was released from my promise to her.
uz: Avvalo, men unga bergan va'damdan ozod bo'ldim.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 October, evening.—They were so tired and worn out and dispirited that there was nothing to be done till they had some rest, so I asked them all to lie down for half an hour whilst I should enter everything up to the mo- ment.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 oktyabr, kechqurun.Ular juda charchagan, charchagan va tushkun edilar, ular biroz dam olmagunlaricha hech narsa qilolmadi, shuning uchun men ulardan hammaga yarim soat uxlashlarini so'radim, men hamma narsani o'z vaqtida kiritaman.

en: I feel so grateful to the man who invented the Traveller's typewriter,
uz: Men Sahyorchi yozish mashinasini ixtiro qilgan kishiga juda minnatdorman.

en: Morris for getting this one for me.
uz: Morris menga buni olib kelganligi uchun.

en: I should have felt quite astray doing the work if I had to write with a pen … It is all done.
uz: Agar qalam bilan yozishim kerak bo'lganida, bu ishni bajarishda o'zimni juda adashgan his qilishim kerak edi ... Bu hammasi amalga oshdi.

en: Poor dear, dear Jonathan, what he must have suffered, what he must be suffering now.
uz: Yomon Jonatan, uning azob chekishi kerak, hozir azob chekishi kerak.

en: He lies on the sofa hardly seeming to breathe, and his whole body appears in collapse.
uz: U sofada o'tirib, nafas olishni qiyin deb hisoblaydi va butun tanasi buzilgan ko'rinadi.

en: His face is drawn with pain.
uz: Uning yuzi og'riq bilan chizilgan.

en: Poor fellow, maybe he is thinking, and I can see his face all wrinkled up with the concentration of his thoughts.
uz: Yomon odam, ehtimol u o'ylayapti, va men uning yuzini ko'rishim mumkin, uning fikrlari o'ziga xos bo'lganidan ko'rinadi.

en: if I could only help at all.
uz: Agar men yordam bera olsam.

en: I shall do what I can.
uz: Men qo'limdan kelganini qilaman.

en: Van Helsing, and he has got me all the papers that I have not yet seen.
uz: Van Helsing, va u menga hali ko'rmagan barcha qog'ozlarni olib keldi.

en: Whilst they are resting, I shall go over all carefully, and per- haps I may arrive at some conclusion.
uz: Ular o'tirgan paytda, men hamma narsani diqqat bilan o'rganib chiqaman va ehtimol ba'zi bir xulosaga kelishim mumkin.

en: I shall try to follow the Professor's example, and think without prejudice on the facts before me … I do believe that under God's providence I have made a discovery.
uz: Men professorning o'rnagiga ergashishga harakat qilaman va oldimda bo'lgan faktlarni o'ylayman ... Xudoning ko'magi ostida kashfiyot qildim deb o'ylayman.

en: I shall get the maps and look over them.
uz: Men xaritalarni olib, ularni ko'rib chiqaman.

en: I am more than ever sure that I am right.
uz: Men o'zim haq ekanligimga har qachongidan ham ko'ra aminman.

en: My new conclusion is ready, so I shall get our party together and read it.
uz: Yangi xulosalarim tayyor, shuning uchun partiyamizni yig'ib o'qib chiqaman.

en: It is well to be accurate, and every minute is precious.
uz: To'g'ri bo'lish yaxshidir va har bir daqiqa qimmatbaho.

en: MINA HARKER'S MEMORANDUM (ENTERED IN HER JOURNAL) Ground of inquiry.—Count Dracula's problem is to get back to his own place.
uz: MINA HARKER MEMORANDUM (O'zining jurnalida kiradi) so'rov uchun joy.Drakulaning muammosi - o'z joyiga qaytish.

en: (a) He must be brought back by some one.
uz: a) Uni kimdir qaytarib kelishi kerak.

en: For had he power to move himself as he wished he could go either as man, or wolf, or bat, or in some other way.
uz: Chunki u o'zi xohlagancha harakatlanish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lganida, u odam yoki bo'ri, urba yoki boshqa yo'l bilan yurishi mumkin edi.

en: He evidently fears discovery or interference, in the state of helplessness in which he must be, conﬁned as he is between dawn and sunset in his wooden box.
uz: U, aniqki, kashfiyot yoki aralashuvdan qo'rqadi, chunki u o'zining o'zidan bo'lgan yordamsizlik holatida, quyosh chiqish va quyosh botish o'rtasida o'zining yog'och qutidagi tuxumida bo'lishi kerak.

en: (b) How is he to be taken?—Here a process of exclusions may help us.
uz: b) Uni qanday qabul qilish kerak?Bu erda chetlatilish jarayoni bizga yordam berishi mumkin.

en: By road, by rail, by water?
uz: Yo'l, temir yo'l, suv yo'li bilan?

en: By Road.—There are endless difﬁculties, especially in leaving the city.
uz: Yo'l orqali.Aytib bo'lmaydigan qiyinchiliklar bor, ayniqsa shaharni tark etishda.

en: (x) There are people.
uz: (x) Odamlar bor.

en: And people are curious, and investigate.
uz: Odamlar qiziquvchan va izlanish olib boradi.

en: A hint, a surmise, a doubt as to what might be in the box, would destroy him.
uz: Bir ta'kidlash, taxmin qilish, qutidagi narsa haqida shubha qilish uni yo'q qiladi.

en: (y) There are, or there may be, customs and octroi ofﬁcers to pass.
uz: (y) Bojxona va octroi xodimlari bor yoki bo'lishi mumkin.

en: (z) His pursuers might follow.
uz: (z) Uni quvg'in qiluvchilar kuzatib borishi mumkin.

en: This is his highest fear.
uz: Bu uning eng katta qo'rquvidir.

en: And in order to prevent his being betrayed he has repelled, so far as he can, even his victim, me!
uz: O'ziga xiyonat qilmaslik uchun u imkon qadar hatto qurbonini ham menga qarshi chiqdi!

en: By Rail.—There is no one in charge of the box.
uz: By Rail.Qutxona uchun hech kim mas'ul emas.

en: It would have to take its chance of being delayed, and delay would be fatal, with enemies on the
uz: U kechikish xavfini qo'lga kiritishi kerak bo'ladi va kechikish o'limga olib kelishi mumkin bo'ladi, dushmanlar yo'lga qo'yilmoqda.

en: True, he might escape at night.
uz: To'g'ri, u kechasi qochib ketishi mumkin.

en: But what would he be, if left in a strange place with no refuge that he could ﬂy to?
uz: Ammo u qanday bo'ladi, agar u o'sha joyga uchib ketishi mumkin bo'lmagan begona joyda qoldirilsa?

en: This is not what he in- tends, and he does not mean to risk it.
uz: Bu uning maqsadi emas va u buni xavf ostiga qo'yishni xohlamaydi.

en: By Water.—Here is the safest way, in one respect, but with most dan- ger in another.
uz: Suv yo'li bilan.Bir jihatdan bu eng xavfsiz yo'l, ammo boshqa jihatdan esa eng xavfli yo'l.

en: On the water he is powerless except at night.
uz: Suvda u kechadan boshqa hech narsaga qodir emas.

en: Even then he can only summon fog and storm and snow and his wolves.
uz: Hatto o'shanda ham u faqat tuman, bo'ron, qor va o'z bo'rilarini chaqira oladi.

en: But were he wrecked, the living water would engulf him, helpless, and he would indeed be lost.
uz: Ammo agar u vayron bo'lsa, tirik suv uni qo'ldan boy bermay, o'zini yo'qotib qo'yadi.

en: He could have the vessel drive to land, but if it were unfriendly land, wherein he was not free to move, his position would still be desperate.
uz: U kemani quruqlikka olib borishi mumkin edi, lekin agar u dushmanlik qilmaydigan yer bo'lsa, unda u erkin harakatlanishga haqli bo'lmagan bo'lsa, uning mavqeyi hali ham noumid bo'ladi.

en: We know from the record that he was on the water, so what we have to do is to ascertain what water.
uz: Biz uning suvda bo'lganini ro'yxatdan bilamiz, shuning uchun nima qilishimiz kerakligini aniqlash kerak.

en: The ﬁrst thing is to realize exactly what he has done as yet.
uz: Avvalo, u hozircha nima qilganini aniq tushunish kerak.

en: We may, then, get a light on what his task is to be.
uz: Shunday ekan, uning vazifasi nimada ekanini bilib olamiz.

en: Firstly.—We must differentiate between what he did in London as part of his general plan of action, when he was pressed for moments and had to arrange as best he could.
uz: Birinchidan, u Londonda o'zining umumiy chora-tadbirlar rejasi doirasida nima qilganini farqlab ko'rishimiz kerak, chunki u bir necha daqiqaga bosim ostida bo'lgan va imkon qadar yaxshi tartibni o'rnatishi kerak edi.

en: Secondly we must see, as well as we can surmise it from the facts we know of, what he has done here.
uz: Ikkinchidan, uning bu yerda nima qilganini ko'rishimiz kerak va biz bilgan faktlar asosida buni taxmin qilishimiz mumkin.

en: As to the ﬁrst, he evidently intended to arrive at Galatz, and sent invoice to Varna to deceive us lest we should ascertain his means of exit from Eng- land.
uz: Birinchidan, u Galatzga kelish niyatida bo'lgan va bizni aldash uchun Varnaga hisobvaraq yuborgan, chunki biz uning Angliya mamlakatidan chiqish yo'llarini bilmasligimiz kerak edi.

en: His immediate and sole purpose then was to escape.
uz: O'shanda uning eng yaqin va yagona maqsadi qochish edi.

en: The proof of this, is the letter of instructions sent to Immanuel Hildesheim to clear and take away the box before sunrise.
uz: Buning isbotini Immanuel Hildesheymga quyosh chiqishidan oldin qutini tozalash va olib tashlash uchun yuborilgan yo'l-yo'riq xatida topamiz.

en: There is also the instruction to Petrof Skinsky.
uz: Shuningdek, Petrof Skinskiyga berilgan yo'l-yo'riq ham bor.

en: These we must only guess at, but there must have been some letter or mes- sage, since Skinsky came to Hildesheim.
uz: Bularni faqat taxmin qilishimiz kerak, lekin Skinskiy Hildesheymga kelganidan beri u erda biron bir xat yoki xabar bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: That, so far, his plans were successful we know.
uz: Hozircha uning rejalari muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganini bilamiz.

en: The Czarina Catherine made a phenomenally quick journey.
uz: Czarina Ketrin ajoyib tezlik bilan sayohat qildi.

en: So much so that Captain Donelson's suspicions were aroused.
uz: Shunday qilib, kapitan Donelsonning shubhalari uyg'onildi.

en: But his superstition united with his canniness played the Count's game for him, and he ran with his favoring wind through fogs and all till he brought up blindfold at Galatz.
uz: Ammo uning sehr-qiroli va qo'polligi uning uchun Countning o'yinini o'ynashdi va u o'zining eng yaxshi shamolini ko'tarib, Galatsda ko'zlarini bog'lagancha soya-shablar orqali yugurdi.

en: That the Count's arrange- ments were well made, has been proved.
uz: Countning tadbirlari yaxshi tuzilganligi isbotlandi.

en: Hildesheim cleared the box, took it off, and gave it to Skinsky.
uz: Hildesheim qutilarni tozalab, uni olib tashladi va Skinskiyga berdi.

en: Skinsky took it, and here we lose the trail.
uz: Skinskiy uni olib ketdi va biz izni yo'qotib qo'ydik.

en: We only know that the box is somewhere on the water, moving along.
uz: Biz faqatgina sumkaning suv ustida bir joyda bo'lganini bilamiz.

en: The cus- toms and the octroi, if there be any, have been avoided.
uz: Qo'riqchi minorasi tomonidan ko'rsatilgan cheklovlar va ruxsatnomalar, agar mavjud bo'lsa, chetlatildi.

en: Now we come to what the Count must have done after his arrival, on land, at Galatz.
uz: Endi biz Count Galatz shahriga yetib kelganidan so'ng nima qilganini ko'rib chiqamiz.

en: The box was given to Skinsky before sunrise.
uz: Qatlam quyosh chiqishidan oldin Skinskiyga berilgan edi.

en: At sunrise the Count could appear in his own form.
uz: Quyosh chiqish paytida Count o'z shaklida paydo bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: Here, we ask why Skinsky was chosen at all to aid in the work?
uz: Bu yerda biz, nega Skinskiy bu ishda yordam berish uchun tanlanganini so'raymiz?

en: In my husband's diary, Skinsky is mentioned as dealing with the Slovaks who trade down the river to the port.
uz: Erimning kundaligida Skinskiy, daryo bo'ylab portga savdo qiladigan slovaklar bilan shug'ullanayotganligi haqida aytilgan.

en: And the man's remark, that the murder was the work of a Slovak, showed the general feeling against his class.
uz: O'sha odamning qotillik Slovakning ishi bo'lganligi haqidagi e'tirozi uning sinfga qarshi umumiy his-tuyg'ularni ko'rsatdi.

en: The Count wanted isolation.
uz: Count izolyatsiya qilishni xohlagan.

en: My surmise is this, that in London the Count decided to get back to his castle by water, as the most safe and secret way.
uz: Mening taxminim shuki, Londonda Count eng xavfsiz va maxfiy yo'l sifatida suv yo'li bilan o'z qal'asiga qaytishga qaror qildi.

en: He was brought from the castle by Szgany, and probably they delivered their cargo to Slovaks who took the boxes to Varna, for there they were shipped to London.
uz: U Szgany tomonidan shahardan olib kelingan va ehtimol ular yuklarini Slovaklarga yetkazib berishgan, ular esa qutuqlarni Varnaga olib ketishgan, chunki u erda ular Londonga jo'natilgan.

en: Thus the Count had knowledge of the persons who could arrange this service.
uz: Shunday qilib, Count ushbu xizmatni tashkil etadigan shaxslar haqida ma'lumotga ega edi.

en: When the box was on land, before sunrise or after sunset, he came out from his box, met Skinsky and instructed him what to do as to arranging the carriage of the box up some river.
uz: Qutuq quruqlikda bo'lganida, quyosh chiqishidan oldin yoki quyosh botgandan keyin, u qutuqdan chiqib, Skinskiy bilan uchrashdi va unga qutuqni qaysidir daryoga olib borishni qanday rejalashtirish kerakligini ko'rsatdi.

en: When this was done, and he knew that all was in train, he blotted out his traces, as he thought, by murdering his agent.
uz: Buni amalga oshirganida va hamma narsa poyezdda ekanligini bilganida, u o'z agentini o'ldirib, o'z izlarini o'chirib yubordi.

en: I have examined the map and ﬁnd that the river most suitable for the Slo- vaks to have ascended is either the Pruth or the Sereth.
uz: Xaritani o'rganib chiqib, Slo-Voklarning ko'tarilishi uchun eng qulay daryo Prut yoki Seret deb topdim.

en: I read in the type- script that in my trance I heard cows low and water swirling level with my ears and the creaking of wood.
uz: O'qiganimcha, o'zimning transimda sigirlar va suvning balandligi quloqlarim bilan aylanib, yog'ochning qichqirishini eshitganman.

en: The Count in his box, then, was on a river in an open boat, propelled probably either by oars or poles, for the banks are near and it is working against stream.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, o'z qutidagi Count ochiq qayiqda daryo bo'yida edi, ehtimol, uni qutilar yoki ustunlar haydaydi, chunki qirg'oqlar yaqin va u oqimga qarshi ishlaydi.

en: There would be no such if ﬂoating down stream.
uz: Agar oqim pastida suzsa, bunday yo'l bo'lmaydi.

en: Of course it may not be either the Sereth or the Pruth, but we may possi- bly investigate further.
uz: Albatta, bu Seret yoki Prut emas, lekin biz yanada ko'proq izlanish olib borishimiz mumkin.

en: Now of these two, the Pruth is the more easily navi- gated, but the Sereth is, at Fundu, joined by the Bistritza which runs up round the Borgo Pass.
uz: Bu ikkovidan Prut eng oson kemaga o'tadi, ammo Seret Fundu shahrida Borgo o'tishining atrofida o'tadigan Bistritza bilan birlashadi.

en: The loop it makes is manifestly as close to Dracula's castle as can be got by water.
uz: U yaratgan buzoq Drakulaning shahriga suvdan yetib boradigancha yaqinroq.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL—CONTINUED When I had done reading, Jonathan took me in his arms and kissed me.
uz: Men o'qishni tugatganimda, Jonatan meni qo'liga olib, o'pdi.

en: The others kept shaking me by both hands, and Dr.
uz: Boshqalar menga qo'llarini silkitib turishdi va dr.

en: Van Helsing said, Our dear Madam Mina is once more our teacher.
uz: Van Helsing shunday dedi: Bizning aziz madam Mina yana bir bor o'qituvchimiz.

en: Her eyes have been where we were blinded.
uz: Uning ko'zlari biz ko'r bo'lgan joyda edi.

en: Now we are on the track once again, and this time we may succeed.
uz: Endi biz yana yo'lga chiqdik va bu safar biz muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishimiz mumkin.

en: Our enemy is at his most helpless.
uz: Dushmanimiz o'z kuchini yo'qotmaydi.

en: And if we can come on him by day, on the water, our task will be over.
uz: Va agar biz unga kunduzda, suvda qarshi chiqsak, bizning vazifamiz tugagan bo'ladi.

en: He has a start, but he is powerless to hasten, as he may not leave this box lest those who carry him may suspect.
uz: Uning boshi bor, ammo u shoshilishga qodir emas, chunki uni ko'tarib yurgan kishilar shubha ostiga qo'ymaslik uchun u shu qutudan chiqib ketmasligi mumkin.

en: For them to suspect would be to prompt them to throw him in the stream
uz: Ular uchun shubha ostiga qo'yish, uni daryoga tashlashga undashdir.

en: This he knows, and will not.
uz: Buni u biladi va bilmaydi.

en: Now men, to our Council of War, for here and now, we must plan what each and all shall do. I shall get a steam launch and follow him, said Lord Godalming.
uz: Endi, odamlar, bizning Urush kengashiga, chunki bu erda va hozir, biz har birimizning nima qilishimiz kerakligini rejalashtirishimiz kerak. Men bug'li ishga tushirishni olib, uning orqasidan ergashaman, dedi Lord Godalming.

en: And I, horses to follow on the bank lest by chance he land, said Mr.
uz: Men esa, to'satdan u yerga tushmasligi uchun, qirg'og'ida otlarni kuzatib boraman, dedi Mr..

en: Good! said the Professor, both good.
uz: Yaxshi! dedi professor, hammasi ham yaxshi.

en: But neither must go alone.
uz: Ammo hech biri yolg'iz borishi shart emas.

en: There must be force to overcome force if need be.
uz: Agar kerak bo'lsa, kuchni yengish uchun kuch bo'lishi kerak.

en: The Slovak is strong and rough, and he carries rude arms. All the men smiled, for amongst them they car- ried a small arsenal.
uz: Slovak kuchli va shafqatsiz va u qo'pol qo'llar bilan yuradi. Barcha erkaklar tabassum qilishdi, chunki ular o'rtasida kichik qurol-yarog'a bor edi.

en: Morris, I have brought some Winchesters.
uz: Morris: Men Winchesterlarni olib keldim.

en: They are pretty handy in a crowd, and there may be wolves.
uz: Ular ko'pchilik orasida juda qulay va bo'rilar bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The Count, if you remember, took some other precautions.
uz: Count, esingizda bo'lsa, boshqa ehtiyot choralarini ko'rdi.

en: He made some requisitions on others that Mrs.
uz: U ba'zi bir talablarni boshqalarga qo'yib berdi, bu bilan xonimning o'zi ham bu talabni bajardi.

en: Harker could not quite hear or understand.
uz: Harker eshitish yoki tushunish imkoniyatiga ega emas edi.

en: We must be ready at all points. Dr.
uz: Biz har qanday vaqtda tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak. - deydi doktor.

en: Seward said, I think I had better go with Quincey.
uz: Seward shunday dedi: Men o'ylaymanki, Quincey bilan ketishim kerak.

en: We have been ac- customed to hunt together, and we two, well armed, will be a match for whatever may come along.
uz: Biz birgalikda ovlashga moyilmiz va biz ikkovimiz, yaxshi qurollangan holda, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, o'zaro moslasha olamiz.

en: You must not be alone, Art.
uz: Siz yolg'iz bo'lmasligingiz kerak, Art.

en: It may be necessary to ﬁght the Slovaks, and a chance thrust, for I don't suppose these fellows carry guns, would undo all our plans.
uz: Slovaklar bilan jang qilish kerak bo'lishi mumkin va bu yigitlar qurol ko'tarib ketishgani sababli, biroz qo'l urish barcha rejalarimizni bekor qilmaydi.

en: There must be no chances, this time.
uz: Bu safar hech qanday imkoniyat bo'lmasligi kerak.

en: We shall not rest until the Count's head and body have been separated, and we are sure that he cannot reincarnate. He looked at Jonathan as he spoke, and Jonathan looked at me.
uz: Countning boshi va tanasi ajratilmaguncha, biz dam olmaymiz va biz uning qayta tug'ilishi mumkin emasligiga aminmiz. U gapirganida Jonataniga, Jonatan esa menga qarab turdi.

en: I could see that the poor dear was torn about in his mind.
uz: Men kambag'al azizning ongida g'alati bo'lganini ko'rardim.

en: Of course he wanted to be with me.
uz: Albatta, u men bilan birga bo'lishni xohlagan.

en: But then the boat service would, most likely, be the one which would destroy the … the … Vampire.
uz: Ammo u holda qayiq xizmati, ehtimol, Vampirni yo'q qiladigan bo'ladi.

en: (Why did I hesitate to write the word?) He was silent awhile, and during his silence Dr.
uz: (Nima uchun men so'zni yozishga ikkilanardim?) U bir muncha vaqt sukut saqladi va sukut saqlash paytida Dr.

en: Van Helsing spoke, Friend Jonathan, this is to you for twice reasons.
uz: Van Helsing so'zlab berdi: Dost Jonatan, bu sen uchun ikki sababga ko'ra.

en: First, because you are young and brave and can ﬁght, and all energies may be needed at the last.
uz: Birinchidan, siz yosh va jasoratli bo'lib, jang qila olasiz va oxirida barcha kuchlar kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And again that it is your right to destroy him.
uz: Va yana, uni yo'q qilish sizning huquqingiz ekanligini.

en: That, which has wrought such woe to you and yours.
uz: Bu esa sizga va sizning odamingizga katta baxtsizlik keltiradi.

en: Be not afraid for Madam Mina.
uz: Madam Mina uchun qo'rqmang.

en: She will be my care, if I may.
uz: U mening g'amxo'rligim bo'ladi.

en: My legs are not so quick to run as once.
uz: Oyoqlarim bir martagidek tez yugurmaydi.

en: And I am not used to ride so long or to pursue as need be, or to ﬁght with lethal weapons.
uz: Va men shuncha vaqt otishga, kerak bo'lgancha orqadan quvishga yoki o'limli qurollar bilan jang qilishga odat qilmaganman.

en: But I can be of other service.
uz: Ammo men boshqa xizmatda bo'lishim mumkin.

en: I can ﬁght in other way.
uz: Men boshqa yo'l bilan kurashishim mumkin.

en: And I can die, if need be, as well as younger men.
uz: Va agar kerak bo'lsa, men ham, yoshroq erkaklar ham o'lishim mumkin.

en: Now let me say that what I would is this.
uz: Endi aytamanki, men shunday qilsam bo'ladi.

en: While you, my Lord Godalming and friend Jonathan go in your so swift little steamboat up the river, and whilst John and Quincey guard the bank where perchance he might be landed, I will take Madam Mina right into the heart
uz: Sen, Lord Godalming va do'stim Jonatan daryo bo'ylab o'zingizning tezkor kemangizda ketayotganingizda va Jon va Quincey uning tushishi mumkin bo'lgan qirg'og'ini himoya qilayotganida, men Madam Minaga o'zimni yurakga olib boraman

en: of the enemy's country.
uz: dushman mamlakatining.

en: Whilst the old fox is tied in his box, ﬂoating on the running stream whence he cannot escape to land, where he dares not raise the lid of his cofﬁn box lest his Slovak carriers should in fear leave him to perish, we shall go in the track where Jonathan went, from Bistritz over the Borgo, and ﬁnd our way to the Castle of Dracula.
uz: Qariya tilkovi o'zining qutisiga bog'langan bo'lsa-da, u qirg'oqqa qochishi mumkin bo'lmagan daryoda ko'tarib, ko'krak qutisi qopqog'ini ko'tarishga jur'at etmaganida, uning Slovakiya tashuvchilari uni halok bo'lishidan qo'rqib qo'yib ketishidan qo'rqqanida, biz Jonatan ketgan yo'ldan, Bistritzdan Borgoga o'tib, Drakula qalʼasiga boramiz.

en: Here, Madam Mina's hyp- notic power will surely help, and we shall ﬁnd our way, all dark and un- known otherwise, after the ﬁrst sunrise when we are near that fateful place.
uz: Bu erda, Madam Minaning g'ayratli kuchi albatta yordam beradi va biz o'sha taqdirli joyga yaqin bo'lganimizda, birinchi quyosh chiqishdan keyin, qorong'i va boshqa ma'lumotni topmaymiz.

en: There is much to be done, and other places to be made sanctify, so that that nest of vipers be obliterated. Here Jonathan interrupted him hotly, Do you mean to say, Professor Van Helsing, that you would bring Mina, in her sad case and tainted as she is with that devil's illness, right into the jaws of his deathtrap?
uz: Bu yerda Jonatan uni qizg'in o'chirib, shunday dedi: Professor Van Helsing, siz o'sha yovuz kasallikka chalingan va shayton kasalligi bilan qorong'i bo'lgan Minaga o'lim tuzog'iga o'xshatishni xohlaysizmi?

en: Not for Heaven or Hell! He became almost speechless for a minute, and then went on, Do you know what the place is?
uz: Osmon yoki do'zax uchun emas! - deb so'zsiz qoldi u bir daqiqacha, so'ngra davom etdi: Bu joy nima ekanligini bilasizmi?

en: Have you seen that awful den of hellish infamy, with the very moonlight alive with grisly shapes, and ever speck of dust that whirls in the wind a devouring monster in embryo?
uz: O'sha dahshatli jahannam xorligi vodiysini ko'rganmisiz, oy nurlari dahshatli shakllarga to'lib-toshgan va shamolda yirtqich hayvonni yutib yuboradigan tuproq to'plamini ko'rganmisiz?

en: Have you felt the Vam- pire's lips upon your throat? Here he turned to me, and as his eyes lit on my forehead he threw up his arms with a cry, Oh, my God, what have we done to have this terror upon us? and he sank down on the sofa in a collapse of misery.
uz: Vam-pirning og'izlarini qo'lingizda his qildingizmi? - dedi u menga qarab, ko'zlari oldimga yoritib turganda, qo'llarini ko'tarib: Allohim, biz bu dahshatga duchor bo'lish uchun nima qildik? - deb baqirdi.

en: The Professor's voice, as he spoke in clear, sweet tones, which seemed to vibrate in the air, calmed us all.
uz: Professorning ovozi, havoda titrayotgandek ko'rinadigan aniq va shirin tovushlar bilan gapirganida, barchamizni tinchlantirgan.

en: Oh, my friend, it is because I would save Madam Mina from that awful place that I would go.
uz: Oh, do'stim, men Madam Minani o'sha dahshatli joydan qutqarganim uchun boraman.

en: God forbid that I should take her into that place.
uz: Xudo menga uni o'sha joyga olib bormasligini aytmasin.

en: There is work, wild work, to be done before that place can be purify.
uz: O'sha joy tozalashdan oldin ish, yovvoyi ish bo'lishi kerak.

en: Re- member that we are in terrible straits.
uz: Biz dahshatli qiyinchiliklarga duch keldik.

en: If the Count escape us this time, and he is strong and subtle and cunning, he may choose to sleep him for a cen- tury, and then in time our dear one, he took my hand, would come to him to keep him company, and would be as those others that you, Jonathan, saw.
uz: Agar konti bu safar bizdan qochib ketsa, u kuchli, nozik va hiyla-nayrang bo'lsa, uni kechki ovqat uchun uxlatishni tanlashi mumkin, keyin vaqt o'tib, azizimiz, - dedi u qo'limdan, - uning oldiga kelib, unga do'stlik qiladi va siz, Jonatan, ko'rgan boshqalarga o'xshaydi.

en: You have told us of their gloating lips.
uz: Siz ularga quvonchli og'izlari haqida gapirgansiz.

en: You heard their ribald laugh as they clutched the moving bag that the Count threw to them.
uz: Count ularga tashlagan ko'chma sumkani qo'lga olganlarida, ularning qichqiriqlarini eshitgansiz.

en: You shudder, and well may it be.
uz: Siz titraysiz va shunday bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Forgive me that I make you so much pain, but it is neces- sary.
uz: Sizni shuncha og'riqli qilganim uchun kechiringlar, lekin bu juda zarur.

en: My friend, is it not a dire need for that which I am giving, possibly my life?
uz: Do'stim, men berayotgan narsa, ehtimol o'z hayotim, juda zarur emasmi?

en: If it, were that any one went into that place to stay, it is I who would have to go to keep them company.
uz: Agar biror kishi o'sha joyga borsa, men u yerga borib, ularga do'stlik qilishim kerak bo'lardi.

en: Do as you will, said Jonathan, with a sob that shook him all over, we are in the hands of God! Later.—Oh, it did me good to see the way that these brave men worked.
uz: Siz xohlaganingizni qiling, - dedi Jonatan, ko'z o'ngida bir qichqiriq bilan, biz Xudoning qo'lidamiz! Keyinchalik.Oh, bu jasoratli odamlarning ishlashini ko'rish menga yaxshi bo'ldi.

en: How can women help loving men when they are so earnest, and so true, and so brave!
uz: Ayollar erkaklarni sevishlariga qanday yordam berishlari mumkin, chunki ular shunchalik samimiy, sodiq va jasoratli!

en: And, too, it made me think of the wonderful power of money!
uz: Shuningdek, bu menga pulning ajoyib qudrati haqida o'ylashga yordam berdi!

en: What can it not do when basely used.
uz: Asosan ishlatilganda nima qila olmaydi.

en: I felt so thankful that Lord Godalming is rich, and both he and Mr.
uz: Lord Godalmingning boyligi uchun juda minnatdorman, chunki u ham, Mr. Godalming ham boy.

en: Morris, who also has plenty of money, are will- ing to spend it so freely.
uz: Morrisning ham ko'p pullari bor, ammo uni erkin sarflashga tayyor.

en: For if they did not, our little expedition could not start,either so promptly or so well equipped, as it will within another hour.
uz: Aks holda, bizning kichik ekspeditsiyamiz bir soat ichida boshlanishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada tez yoki jihozlangan bo'lmas edi.

en: It is not three hours since it was arranged what part each of us was to do.
uz: Har birimiz qaysi vazifani bajarishimiz kerakligi to'g'risida qaror qabul qilinganidan uch soat o'tmagan.

en: And now Lord Godalming and Jonathan have a lovely steam launch, with steam up ready to start at a moment's notice.
uz: Va endi Lord Godalming va Jonatan ajoyib bug' ishga tushirishda ishtirok etishdi, bu esa bir lahzada ishga tushishga tayyor.

en: Morris have half a dozen good horses, well appointed.
uz: Morrisning yarim o'nlab yaxshi otlari bor.

en: We have all the maps and appliances of various kinds that can be had.
uz: Bizda turli xil xaritalar va qurilmalar mavjud.

en: Professor Van Helsing and I are to leave by the 11:40 train tonight for Veresti, where we are to get a carriage to drive to the Borgo Pass.
uz: Professor Van Helsing va men bugun soat 11:40 ga teng bo'lgan poyezdda Veresti shahriga ketamiz, u yerdan Borgo o'tish yo'nalishida mashinani olib ketamiz.

en: We are bringing a good deal of ready money, as we are to buy a carriage and horses.
uz: Biz tayyor pulni olib kelyapmiz, chunki biz arava va ot sotib olish uchun tayyormiz.

en: We shall drive ourselves, for we have no one whom we can trust in the matter.
uz: Biz o'zimizni boshqaramiz, chunki bu borada ishonishimiz mumkin bo'lgan hech kim yo'q.

en: The Professor knows something of a great many languages, so we shall get on all right.
uz: Professor ko'plab tillarni biladi, shuning uchun biz yaxshi munosabatda bo'lamiz.

en: We have all got arms, even for me a large bore revolver.
uz: Hammamizning qo'limizda qurol bor, hatto men uchun katta bo'ronli revolver ham bor.

en: Jonathan would not be happy unless I was armed like the rest.
uz: Agar men ham boshqalar kabi qurollanmasam, Jonatan baxtli bo'lmaydi.

en: I cannot carry one arm that the rest do, the scar on my forehead forbids that.
uz: Boshqalar kabi bir qo'limni ko'tarolmayman, oldimdagi yara buni taqiqlaydi.

en: Van Helsing comforts me by telling me that I am fully armed as there may be wolves.
uz: Van Helsing meni ta'minlab, men to'liq qurollanganman, chunki bo'rilar bo'lishi mumkinligini aytadi.

en: The weather is get- ting colder every hour, and there are snow ﬂurries which come and go as warnings.
uz: Havo har soatda sovuqlashib bormoqda va qor shovqinlari ogohlantirish sifatida keladi va ketadi.

en: Later.—It took all my courage to say goodby to my darling.
uz: Keyinchalik.Sevg'imni tark etish uchun butun jasoratim kerak bo'ldi.

en: We may nev- er meet again.
uz: Ehtimol, yana uchrashmaymiz.

en: The Professor is looking at you keenly.
uz: Professor sizga diqqat bilan qaraydi.

en: His look is a warning.
uz: Uning ko'rinishi ogohlantirishdir.

en: There must be no tears now, unless it may be that God will let them fall in gladness.
uz: Hozirgi paytda ko'z yoshlari bo'lmasligi kerak, agar Xudo ularni quvonchdan to'sishiga yo'l qo'ymasa.

en: JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 30 October, night.—I am writing this in the light from the furnace door of the steam launch.
uz: JONATHAN HARKERning JURNAL 30 oktyabr, kechasi.Men buni bug' ishga tushirilishining pech eshigidan ko'rinadigan nurda yozyapman.

en: Lord Godalming is ﬁring up.
uz: Lord Godalming o'q ko'tarmoqda.

en: He is an experienced hand at the work, as he has had for years a launch of his own on the Thames, and another on the Norfolk Broads.
uz: U ishda tajribali qo'l, chunki u yillar davomida Temzda, Norfolk Broadsda o'z qo'llarini ishga tushirdi.

en: Regarding our plans, we ﬁnal- ly decided that Mina's guess was correct, and that if any waterway was cho- sen for the Count's escape back to his Castle, the Sereth and then the Bistritza at its junction, would be the one.
uz: Rejalarimizga kelsak, Mina xayolimizda to'g'ri bo'lganini va agar Countning qal'asiga qaytishi uchun suv yo'li tanlangan bo'lsa, Seret va uning kesish joyidagi Bistritza o'sha yo'l bo'lishini nihoyatda hal qildik.

en: We took it, that somewhere about
uz: Biz uni olib ketdik, bu bir joyda taxminan

en: the 47th degree, north latitude, would be the place chosen for crossing the country between the river and the Carpathians.
uz: 47-darajali, shimoliy kenglik, daryo va Karpatlar orasidagi mamlakatni kesib o'tish uchun tanlangan joy bo'ladi.

en: We have no fear in running at good speed up the river at night.
uz: Kechasi daryo bo'ylab tezlikda yugurishdan qo'rqmaymiz.

en: There is plenty of water, and the banks are wide enough apart to make steaming, even in the dark, easy enough.
uz: Suv ko'p va banklar juda keng bo'lib, hatto qorong'ilikda ham bug'ni tayyorlashni osonlashtiradi.

en: Lord Godalming tells me to sleep for a while, as it is enough for the present for one to be on watch.
uz: Lord Godalming menga biroz uxlashimni aytadi, chunki hushyor turish uchun hozirning o'zi yetarli.
