en: But I cannot sleep, how can I with the terrible dan- ger hanging over my darling, and her going out into that awful place … My only comfort is that we are in the hands of God.
uz: Ammo men uxlay olmayman, qanday qilib men sevgilimning ustida bo'lgan dahshatli xavf-xatar bilan, uning o'sha dahshatli joyga ketishi bilan... Mening yagona tasalliyim - biz Xudoning qo'lida ekanligimizdir.

en: Only for that faith it would be easier to die than to live, and so be quit of all the trouble.
uz: Faqatgina shu imon tufayli yashashdan ko'ra o'lish osonroq bo'ladi va barcha muammolardan xalos bo'lish mumkin.

en: Seward were off on their long ride before we started.
uz: Biz boshlashdan oldin Seward uzoq safarda edi.

en: They are to keep up the right bank, far enough off to get on higher lands where they can see a good stretch of river and avoid the following of its curves.
uz: Ular o'ng qirg'og'ini to'g'ri yo'lga qo'yishlari kerak, bu yo'ldan yetarlicha uzoqda bo'lib, o'sha yerlarning yuqori darajadagi hududlarini ko'rishlari mumkin va daryo bo'shliqlarini ko'rishlaridan qochishlari kerak.

en: They have, for the ﬁrst stages, two men to ride and lead their spare horses, four in all, so as not to excite curiosity.
uz: Ular birinchi bosqichlarda qiziquvchanlikni qo'zg'atmaslik uchun ikki kishini o'z qo'shimcha otlariga otlab, ularni boshqarishga, jami to'rt kishini boshqarishga majburlaydilar.

en: When they dismiss the men, which shall be shortly, they shall themselves look after the horses.
uz: Erkaklarni ishdan bo'shatganlarida, bu yaqin orada bo'ladi, ular otlarni o'zlari boqishadi.

en: It may be nec- essary for us to join forces.
uz: Biz uchun kuchlarimizni birlashtirish zarur bo'lishi mumkin.

en: If so they can mount our whole party.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, ular butun partiyamizni yig'ishsin.

en: One of the saddles has a moveable horn, and can be easily adapted for Mina, if required.
uz: Sillalardan biri o'zgaruvchan shoxga ega bo'lib, agar kerak bo'lsa, Mina uchun osonlikcha moslashtirilishi mumkin.

en: It is a wild adventure we are on.
uz: Bu yovvoyi sarguzasht bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Here, as we are rushing along through the darkness, with the cold from the river seeming to rise up and strike us, with all the mysterious voices of the night around us, it all comes home.
uz: Mana, biz qorong'ilikda yugurib borayotganimizda, daryodagi sovuq bizga tushib, atrofimizdagi tunning sirli ovozlari bilan, hamma narsa o'z uyimizga keladi.

en: We seem to be drifting into unknown places and unknown ways.
uz: Biz noma'lum joylarga va noma'lum yo'llarga o'tib ketayotganimiz ko'rinadi.

en: Into a whole world of dark and dreadful things.
uz: Quru va qo'rqinchli narsalar butun dunyosiga.

en: Godalming is shutting the furnace door … 31 October.—Still hurrying along.
uz: Godalming pech eshikini yopmoqda ... 31 oktyabr.Hasta ham shoshilmoqda.

en: The day has come, and Godalming is sleeping.
uz: Kun keldi va Godalming uxlab qoldi.

en: The morning is bitterly cold, the furnace heat is grateful, though we have heavy fur coats.
uz: Ertalab juda sovuq, pech issiqligi minnatdor, garchi bizda og'ir cho'l kiyimlari bo'lsa ham.

en: As yet we have passed only a few open boats, but none of them had on board any box or package of anything like the size of the one we seek.
uz: Hozircha biz faqat bir nechta ochiq qayiqlardan o'tganmiz, ammo ularning hech biri qayiqda biz qidirayotgan qayiqning o'lchamiga o'xshash biron bir quti yoki paketga ega emas edi.

en: The men were scared every time we turned our electric lamp on them, and fell on their knees and prayed.
uz: Ular har safar elektr lampalarimizni yoqib qo'yganimizda qo'rqib qolar edilar va tiz cho'kib ibodat qilar edilar.

en: 1 November, evening.—No news all day.
uz: 1 noyabr, kechqurun.Kun bo'yi yangiliklar yo'q.

en: We have found nothing of the kind we seek.
uz: Biz qidirayotgan narsalarga hech narsa topmadik.

en: We have now passed into the Bistritza, and if we are wrong in our surmise our chance is gone.
uz: Endi biz Bistritzaga o'tdik va agar biz o'z fikrimizda xato qilsak, imkoniyatimiz yo'qolgan.

en: We have overhauled every boat, big and little.
uz: Biz katta va kichik barcha qayiqlarni ta'mirlab chiqdik.

en: Early this morning, one crew took us for a Government boat, and treated us accordingly.
uz: Erta tongda bir ekipaj bizni hukumat kemasiga olib bordi va unga muvofiq munosabatda bo'ldi.

en: We saw in this a way of smoothing matters, so at Fundu,where the Bistritza runs into the Sereth, we got a Roumanian ﬂag which we now ﬂy conspicuously.
uz: Biz bu vaziyatni yengillashtirish maqsadida ko'rdik, shuning uchun Fundu shahrida, Bistritza Seretga to'lib-toshgan joyda, Ruminiya bayrog'i paydo bo'ldi va biz uni ko'rinib turibmiz.

en: With every boat which we have over-
uz: Bizda mavjud bo'lgan har bir qayiq bilan...

en: hauled since then this trick has succeeded.
uz: O'shandan beri bu hiyla muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

en: We have had every deference shown to us, and not once any objection to whatever we chose to ask or do.
uz: Bizga hurmat ko'rsatildi va biz nimaiki so'rash yoki qilishni tanlagan bo'lsak, bunga hech qachon qarshilik ko'rsatilmagan.

en: Some of the Slovaks tell us that a big boat passed them, going at more than usual speed as she had a double crew on board.
uz: Slovakiyaliklarning ba'zilari bizga katta qayiq ularning yonidan o'tib, odatdagidan tezroq borayotganini aytib berishdi, chunki u qayiqda ikki kishiga ega edi.

en: This was before they came to Fundu, so they could not tell us whether the boat turned into the Bistritza or continued on up the Sereth.
uz: Bu ular Funduga kelishidan oldin sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun ular qayiq Bistritzaga aylanib chiqadimi yoki Seretga ko'tarilishadimi, deb bizga ayta olishmadi.

en: At Fundu we could not hear of any such boat, so she must have passed there in the night.
uz: Fundu shahrida biz bunday qayiq haqida eshitmagan edik, shuning uchun u kechasi u yerdan o'tib o'tgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: I am feeling very sleepy.
uz: Men o'zimni juda uxlab ketayotganimni his qilyapman.

en: The cold is perhaps beginning to tell upon me, and nature must have rest some time.
uz: Ehtimol, sovuq menga ko'rinishni boshlaydi va tabiat biroz dam olishi kerak.

en: Godalming insists that he shall keep the ﬁrst watch.
uz: Godalming birinchi navbatda uni kuzatib turishni istaydi.

en: God bless him for all his goodness to poor dear Mina and me.
uz: Xudo uni kambag'al Mina va menga qilgan barcha yaxshiliklari uchun duo qilsin.

en: 2 November, morning.—It is broad daylight.
uz: 2 noyabr kuni ertalab.Bu keng kun yorug'ligi.

en: That good fellow would not wake me.
uz: O'sha yaxshi odam meni uyg'otmaydi.

en: He says it would have been a sin to, for I slept peacefully and was forgetting my trouble.
uz: Uning aytishicha, bu gunoh bo'lgan bo'lardi, chunki men tinch uxlab, muammolarimni unutgan edim.

en: It seems brutally selﬁsh to me to have slept so long, and let him watch all night, but he was quite right.
uz: Men uchun shuncha vaqt uxlab, uni butun kecha kuzatib turish juda xudbin tuyuladi, ammo u to'liq haq edi.

en: I am a new man this morning.
uz: Men bugun ertalab yangi odamman.

en: And, as I sit here and watch him sleeping, I can do all that is nec- essary both as to minding the engine, steering, and keeping watch.
uz: Va men bu yerda o'tirib, uni uxlayotganini ko'rib turar ekanman, mashinani nazorat qilish, direksiyonni boshqarish va hushyor turish uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsani qila olaman.

en: I can feel that my strength and energy are coming back to me.
uz: O'zimga kuch va kuch qaytib kelayotganini his qila olaman.

en: I wonder where Mina is now, and Van Helsing.
uz: Mina va Van Helsing hozir qayerda ekan, deb o'ylayman.

en: They should have got to Veresti about noon on Wednesday.
uz: Ular chorshanba kuni tush atrofida Verestiga yetib kelishlari kerak edi.

en: It would take them some time to get the carriage and horses.
uz: Ular arava va otlarni olish uchun bir muncha vaqt kerak bo'ladi.

en: So if they had started and travelled hard, they would be about now at the Borgo Pass.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar ular sayohatni boshlashgan bo'lishgan va ko'p harakat qilgan bo'lishganida edi, hozir Borgo o'tishida bo'lishgan bo'lishgan.

en: God guide and help them!
uz: Xudo ularni yo'naltirib, yordam bersin!

en: I am afraid to think what may happen.
uz: Nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'ylashdan qo'rqaman.

en: If we could only go faster.
uz: Agar biz faqat tezroq borishga qodir bo'lsak.

en: The engines are throbbing and do- ing their utmost.
uz: Dvigatellar puflab, qo'llaridan kelganini qilishmoqda.

en: Morris are getting on.
uz: Morris davom etmoqda.

en: There seem to be endless streams running down the mountains into this riv- er, but as none of them are very large, at present, at all events, though they are doubtless terrible in winter and when the snow melts, the horsemen may not have met much obstruction.
uz: Tog'lardan past olib bu daryoga cheksiz daryolar oqib ketayotganga o'xshaydi, ammo ularning hech biri juda katta bo'lmaganligi sababli, hozirgi vaqtda ular qishda juda dahshatli bo'lishiga va qor erganda, otliqlar katta to'siqlarga duch kelmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I hope that before we get to Strasba we may see them.
uz: Umid qilamanki, Strasbaga yetib kelishimizdan oldin ularni ko'rishimiz mumkin.

en: For if by that time we have not overtaken the Count, it may be necessary to take counsel together what to do next.
uz: Chunki agar o'sha paytga kelib biz Countni orqaga surib bo'lmasak, keyin nima qilish kerakligini birgalikda maslahatlashishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 2 November.—Three days on the road.
uz: SEWARDning DYARI 2 noyabr.Uch kun yo'lda.

en: No news, and no time to write it if there had been, for every moment is precious.
uz: Yangiliklar yo'q, agar bo'lgan bo'lsa, uni yozish uchun vaqt yo'q, chunki har bir daqiqa qimmatbaho.

en: We have had only the rest needful for the horses.
uz: Bizda faqat otlar uchun zarur bo'lgan istisno bo'ldi.

en: But we are both bearing it wonderfully.
uz: Ammo ikkovimiz ham uni ajoyib tarzda ko'tarmoqdamiz.

en: Those ad- venturous days of ours are turning up useful.
uz: O'sha ad-venturous kunlarimiz foydali bo'lib bormoqda.

en: We shall never feel happy till we get the launch in sight again.
uz: Qayta ishga tushish ko'rinishini topmaguncha hech qachon xursand bo'lmaymiz.

en: 3 Novenber.—We heard at Fundu that the launch had gone up the Bistritza.
uz: 3 Novenber.Fundu-da biz o'sha jo'natishning Bistritza tepaligidan chiqib ketgani haqida eshitdik.

en: I wish it wasn't so cold.
uz: O'sha qadar sovuq bo'lmagan bo'lsa kerak.

en: There are signs of snow coming.
uz: Qar yog'ishining belgilari ko'rinmoqda.

en: falls heavy it will stop us.
uz: og'ir tushsa, bizni to'xtatadi.

en: In such case we must get a sledge and go on, Russian fashion.
uz: Bunday holatda biz sledge sotib olib, rus modasiga o'tishimiz kerak.

en: 4 Novenber.—Today we heard of the launch having been detained by an accident when trying to force a way up the rapids.
uz: 4 Novenber.Bugun biz o'zimiz eshitganimizdek, u o'z yo'lini tezkorlikka ko'tarishga urinayotganda avariya natijasida to'xtatilgan.

en: The Slovak boats get up all right, by aid of a rope and steering with knowledge.
uz: Slovakiya qayiqlari qo'lga chiqishi uchun qo'llanma qo'llanilishi va bilim bilan boshqarilishi kerak.

en: Some went up only a few hours before.
uz: Ba'zilari bir necha soat oldin ko'tarildi.

en: Godalming is an amateur ﬁtter himself, and evidently it was he who put the launch in trim again.
uz: Godalming o'zi ham o'yinchi montor bo'lib, shuni aytish joizki, u o'zining ishga tushirilishini qayta jihozlagan.

en: Finally, they got up the rapids all right, with local help, and are off on the chase afresh.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, mahalliy yordam bilan ular tezliklarni yaxshi ko'rishdi va yangi yo'lga chiqishdi.

en: I fear that the boat is not any better for the accident, the peas- antry tell us that after she got upon smooth water again, she kept stopping every now and again so long as she was in sight.
uz: Qo'rqamanki, qayiq baxtsiz hodisa uchun yaxshiroq emas, lekin o'simliklar bizga yana bir bor suyuq suvga tushib ketgach, ko'rinishda bo'lganida, vaqti-vaqti bilan to'xtab turishini aytishadi.

en: We must push on harder than ever.
uz: Biz har qachongidan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: Our help may be wanted soon.
uz: Ehtimol, yaqinda bizning yordamimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 31 October.—Arrived at Veresti at noon.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 31 oktyabr kuni.U kun yorlig'ida Verestiga yetib keldi.

en: The Professor tells me that this morning at dawn he could hardly hypnotize me at all, and that all I could say was, dark and quiet. He is off now buying a carriage and horses.
uz: Professor menga ertalab tongda meni hecham hipnoz qila olmaganini va men faqat quruq va xotirjam deb aytishim mumkinligini aytadi.

en: He says that he will later on try to buy additional horses, so that we may be able to change them on the way.
uz: Keyinchalik biz ularni yo'lda almashtirishimiz uchun qo'shimcha otlar sotib olishga harakat qilamiz, deydi u.

en: We have something more than 70 miles be- fore us.
uz: Bizdan 70 mildan ziyod oldimizda bir narsa bor.

en: The country is lovely, and most interesting.
uz: Mamlakat chiroyli va qiziqarli.

en: If only we were under different conditions, how delightful it would be to see it all.
uz: Agar biz boshqa sharoitlarda bo'lganimizda edi, bularning barchasini ko'rish naqadar yoqimli bo'lardi.

en: If Jonathan and I were driving through it alone what a pleasure it would be.
uz: Agar Jonatan va men yolg'iz o'sha yo'ldan o'tardik, bu naqadar katta zavq keltirardi.

en: To stop and see people, and learn something of their life, and to ﬁll our minds and memories with all the color and picturesqueness of the whole wild, beautiful country and the quaint people!
uz: To'xtatish va odamlarni ko'rish, ularning hayoti haqida o'rganish va ong va xotiralarimizni butun yovvoyi, chiroyli mamlakat va ajoyib odamlar rang-barangligi va chiroyliligi bilan to'ldirish!

en: Van Helsing has returned.
uz: Van Helsing qaytib keldi.

en: He has got the carriage and horses.
uz: Uning aravalari va otlari bor.

en: We are to have some dinner, and to start in an hour.
uz: Biz kechki ovqatga boramiz va bir soatdan keyin boshlanamiz.

en: The landlady is putting us up a huge basket of provisions.
uz: Uy egasi bizga ulkan to'plam ta'minotlarini qo'shadi.

en: It seems enough for a company of sol- diers.
uz: Bu sol-diyerlar kompaniyasi uchun yetarli bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: The Professor encourages her, and whispers to me that it may be a week before we can get any food again.
uz: Professor uni daldalab, menga bir hafta o'tib, yana ovqat olishimiz mumkinligini shov-shuv bilan aytadi.

en: He has been shopping too, and has sent home such a wonderful lot of fur coats and wraps, and all sorts of warm things.
uz: U ham xarid qilishga borgan va uyga shuncha ko'p quyuq liboslar, qadoqlar va har xil issiq narsalarni yuborgan.

en: There will not be any chance of our being cold.
uz: Biz sovuq bo'lishimizga hech qanday imkoniyat yo'q.

en: We shall soon be off.
uz: Yaqinda biz ketamiz.

en: I am afraid to think what may happen to us.
uz: Biz bilan nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'ylashdan qo'rqaman.

en: We are truly in the hands of God.
uz: Haqiqatan ham biz Xudoning qo'lidamiz.

en: He alone knows what may be, and I pray Him, with all the strength of my sad and humble soul, that He will watch over my beloved husband.
uz: Faqat U nima bo'lishi mumkinligini biladi va men Unga ibodat qilamanki, mening qayg'uli va kamtarlik ruhimning butun kuchi bilan U aziz erim ustidan g'amxo'rlik qiladi.

en: That whatever may happen, Jonathan may know that I loved him and honored him more than I can say, and that my latest and truest thought will be always for him.
uz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, Jonatan uni yaxshi ko'rganimni va hurmat qilganimni bilishi va so'nggi va eng haqiqiy fikrim har doim u uchun bo'lishini bilishi uchun.

en: CHAPTER 27 MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 November.—All day long we have travelled, and at a good speed.
uz: 27 - bob MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 1 - noyabr.Biz kun bo'yi sayohat qildik va yaxshi tezlikda sayohat qildik.

en: The horses seem to know that they are being kindly treated, for they go willing- ly their full stage at best speed.
uz: Otlar ularga mehribonlik bilan muomala qilinayotganini biladi, chunki ular eng yaxshi tezlikda to'liq bosqichga borishga tayyor.

en: We have now had so many changes and ﬁnd the same thing so constantly that we are encouraged to think that the jour- ney will be an easy one.
uz: Hozir bizda shuncha ko'p o'zgarishlar bo'lib, bir xil narsalarni doimo topamiz, shuning uchun biz kun oson bo'ladi deb o'ylashga rag'batlandik.

en: Van Helsing is laconic, he tells the farmers that he is hurrying to Bistritz, and pays them well to make the exchange of hors- es.
uz: Van Helsing lakonik bo'lib, fermerlarga Bistritzga borayotganini aytadi va atlar almashinuvini amalga oshirish uchun ularga yaxshi pul to'laydi.

en: We get hot soup, or coffee, or tea, and off we go.
uz: Biz issiq shoppani, kofe yoki choy olib ketamiz va ketamiz.

en: It is a lovely country.
uz: Bu chiroyli mamlakat.

en: Full of beauties of all imaginable kinds, and the people are brave, and strong, and simple, and seem full of nice qualities.
uz: Har qanday tasavvur qilinadigan go'zallikka to'la va odamlar jasoratli, kuchli, sodda va yoqimli fazilatlarga to'la bo'lib ko'rinadi.

en: They are very, very su- perstitious.
uz: Ular juda, juda ustun bo'lishadi.

en: In the ﬁrst house where we stopped, when the woman who served us saw the scar on my forehead, she crossed herself and put out two ﬁngers towards me, to keep off the evil eye.
uz: Biz to'xtatgan birinchi uyda xizmat qilgan ayol, peshanamdagi yara ko'rganida, o'zini kesib, yomon ko'zni yo'q qilish uchun menga ikki barmog'ini uzatdi.

en: I believe they went to the trou- ble of putting an extra amount of garlic into our food, and I can't abide gar- lic.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ular oziq-ovqatimizga qo'shimcha miqdorda sarimush qo'yish qiyinligiga duch kelishdi va men sarimushga chiday olmayman.

en: Ever since then I have taken care not to take off my hat or veil, and so have escaped their suspicions.
uz: O'shandan beri, to'plamni yoki pardaimni olib tashlamaslikka harakat qildim va shu sababli ularning shubhalaridan qochdim.

en: We are travelling fast, and as we have no dri- ver with us to carry tales, we go ahead of scandal.
uz: Biz tez sayohat qilyapmiz va hikoyalarni o'zimiz bilan olib yurish uchun hech qanday kuchimiz bo'lmagani uchun, biz skandaldan oldinga ketamiz.

en: But I daresay that fear of the evil eye will follow hard behind us all the way.
uz: Ammo men aytamanki, yomon ko'zning qo'rquvi bizdan uzoq davom etadi.

en: The Professor seems tireless.
uz: Professor charchamaydigan ko'rinadi.

en: All day he would not take any rest, though he made me sleep for a long spell.
uz: U kun bo'yi hech qanday dam olishni istamadi, garchi u meni uzoq vaqt uxlatishga majbur qilgan bo'lsa ham.

en: At sunset time he hypnotized me, and he says I answered as usu- al,darkness, lapping water and creaking wood. So our enemy is still on the river.
uz: Quyosh botganida u meni hipnoz qildi va men odatda quruqlik, cho'kkan suv va o'rmoqli yog'och deb javob berganimni aytdi.

en: I am afraid to think of Jonathan, but somehow I have now no fear for him, or for myself.
uz: Jonatan haqida o'ylashdan qo'rqaman, lekin hozir u yoki o'zim uchun qo'rqmayman.

en: I write this whilst we wait in a farmhouse for the horses to be ready.
uz: Men buni bir fermada otlar tayyor bo'lishini kutganimizda yozyapman.

en: Van Helsing is sleeping.
uz: Van Helsing uxlayapti.

en: Poor dear, he looks very tired and old and grey, but his mouth is set as ﬁrmly as a conqueror's.
uz: Kambag'al, u juda charchagan, qariya va quriq ko'rinadi, ammo og'zi g'alaba qozonuvchi og'ziga o'xshaydi.

en: Even in his sleep he is intense with resolution.
uz: Hatto uyqusida ham u qat'iy qarorga keladi.

en: When we have well started I must make him rest whilst I drive.
uz: Biz yaxshi boshlangandan so'ng, men haydash paytida uni dam olishga majburlashim kerak.

en: I shall tell him that we have days before us,
uz: Men unga yana bir necha kun qolganini aytaman.

en: and he must not break down when most of all his strength will be needed … All is ready.
uz: Va eng asosiysi, uning kuch-quvvatini kerak bo'lganda, u tushmasligi kerak ... Hamma narsa tayyor.

en: 2 November, morning.—I was successful, and we took turns driving all night.
uz: 2 noyabr kuni ertalab.Men muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldim va biz butun kecha bir-birimizga qarab haydashganmiz.

en: Now the day is on us, bright though cold.
uz: Endi kun o'z vaqtida, hatto sovuq bo'lsa-da, yorqin bo'ldi.

en: There is a strange heavi- ness in the air.
uz: Havoda g'alati og'irlik paydo bo'ladi.

en: I say heaviness for want of a better word.
uz: Men og'irlikni yaxshiroq so'zsiz aytaman.

en: I mean that it op- presses us both.
uz: Demak, bu ikkovimizga ham bosim o'tkazadi.

en: It is very cold, and only our warm furs keep us comfort- able.
uz: Bu juda sovuq va faqat bizning issiq furlarimiz bizga qulaylik beradi.

en: At dawn Van Helsing hypnotized me.
uz: Tongda Van Helsing meni hipnoz qildi.

en: He says I answered darkness, creaking wood and roaring water, so the river is changing as they ascend.
uz: U aytadiki, men quruqlik, qichqiriq daraxt va qichqiriq suv deb javob berdim, shuning uchun daryo o'zgarib bormoqda.

en: I do hope that my darling will not run any chance of danger, more than need be, but we are in God's hands.
uz: Umid qilamanki, azizim hech qanday xavf-xatarga duch kelmasligi kerak, lekin biz Xudoning qo'lidamiz.

en: 2 November, night.—All day long driving.
uz: 2 noyabr, kechasi.Butun kun davomida haydash.

en: The country gets wilder as we go, and the great spurs of the Carpathians, which at Veresti seemed so far from us and so low on the horizon, now seem to gather round us and tower in front.
uz: Qishloqqa borganimiz sayin mamlakat yovvoyilashib boradi va Karpatlarning katta qo'rqinchlari, Verestida bizdan shunchalik uzoq va horizontda shunchalik past ko'rinardi, endi atrofimizda to'planib, oldimizda turadi.

en: We both seem in good spirits.
uz: Ikkovimiz ham yaxshi ruhda bo'lib tuyulyapmiz.

en: I think we make an effort each to cheer the other, in the doing so we cheer ourselves.
uz: O'ylaymanki, biz bir-birimizni quvontirishga harakat qilamiz, shu yo'sin o'zimizni quvontiramiz.

en: Van Helsing says that by morning we shall reach the Borgo Pass.
uz: Van Helsingning aytishicha, ertalab Borgo o'tishqoliga yetamiz.

en: The houses are very few here now, and the Professor says that the last horse we got will have to go on with us, as we may not be able to change.
uz: Hozirda bu yerda uylar juda kam, professor esa so'nggi qo'lga kiritilgan ot biz bilan birga bo'lishi kerakligini aytadi, chunki biz o'zgartirolmaymiz.

en: He got two in addition to the two we changed, so that now we have a rude four-in-hand.
uz: Biz o'zgartirgan ikkitasiga qo'shimcha ikkitaga ega bo'ldi, shuning uchun endi bizda qo'pol to'rtta bor.

en: The dear horses are patient and good, and they give us no trouble.
uz: Qizig'i atlar sabrli va mehribon bo'lib, bizga hech qanday muammo keltirmaydi.

en: We are not worried with other travellers, and so even I can drive.
uz: Biz boshqa sayohatchilar haqida tashvishlanmaymiz, shuning uchun hatto men ham haydashga qodirman.

en: We shall get to the Pass in daylight.
uz: Quyosh tongda pasga yetamiz.

en: We do not want to arrive before.
uz: Biz ilgari kelishni istamaymiz.

en: So we take it easy, and have each a long rest in turn.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz o'zimizni tinch tutamiz va har birimiz o'z navbatida uzoq dam olsak.

en: Oh, what will tomorrow bring to us?
uz: Oh, ertangi kun bizga nima keltiradi?

en: We go to seek the place where my poor darling suffered so much.
uz: Biz kambag'al azizim shuncha azob chekkan joyni qidirishga ketamiz.

en: God grant that we may be guided aright, and that He will deign to watch over my husband and those dear to us both, and who are in such deadly peril.
uz: Alloh bizga to'g'ri yo'lni ko'rsatib, erim va o'lim xavfi ostida bo'lgan yaqinlarimiz ustidan g'amxo'rlik qilishga munosib bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilsin.

en: As for me, I am not worthy in His sight.
uz: Men esa Uning nazarida munosib emasman.

en: I am unclean to His eyes, and shall be until He may deign to let me stand forth in His sight as one of those who have not incurred His wrath.
uz: Men Uning nazarida nopokman va Uning g'azabiga duchor bo'lmaganlardan biri sifatida Uning nazarida turishga haqli bo'lmagunimcha shunday bo'laman.

en: MEMORANDUM BY ABRAHAM VAN HELSING 4 November.—This to my old and true friend John Seward, M.
uz: 4 noyabr kuni Ibrohim VAN HELSING tomonidan yozilgan xat.Bu mening eski va haqiqiy do'stim Jon Seward, M.ga.

en: D., of Pureﬂeet, London, in case I may not see him.
uz: D., Purefleet, London, agar men uni ko'rmasam.

en: It is morning, and I write by a ﬁre which all the night I have kept alive, Madam Mina aid- ing me.
uz: Bugun ertalab, men olov yonib yozyapman, butun kecha meni tirik qoldirgan Madam Mina menga yordam bermoqda.

en: So cold that the grey heavy sky is full of snow, which when it falls will settle for all winter as the ground is hardening to receive it.
uz: Shunday sovuq bo'lganki, bo'lak osmon qor bilan to'lib-toshgan bo'lib, qor tushib qolganda, yer uni qabul qilish uchun qattiq bo'lib borayotganidan butun qish uchun o'zgaradi.

en: It seems to have affected Madam Mina.
uz: Bu Madam Minaga ta'sir ko'rsatgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: She has been so heavy of head all day that she was not like herself.
uz: U kun bo'yi shunchalik og'ir bo'lganki, o'ziga o'xshamaydi.

en: She sleeps, and sleeps, and sleeps!
uz: U uxlaydi, uxlaydi va uxlaydi!

en: She who is usual so alert, have done literally nothing all the day.
uz: Odatda shunchalik hushyor bo'lgan u butun kun davomida hech narsa qilmagan.

en: have lost her appetite.
uz: uning ochko'zini yo'qotib qo'ygan.

en: She make no entry into her little diary, she who write so faithful at every pause.
uz: U o'zining kichkina kundalig'ida hech qanday yozuv qilmaydi, chunki u har bir to'xtash paytida juda sadoqatli ravishda yozadi.

en: Something whisper to me that all is not well.
uz: Biror narsa menga hamma narsa yaxshi emasligini shubha ostiga qo'yadi.

en: However, tonight she is more vif.
uz: Biroq, bu kecha u ko'proq jonli bo'ladi.

en: Her long sleep all day have refresh and restore her, for now she is all sweet and bright as ever.
uz: Uning kun bo'yi uzoq uxlashi uni ta'sirlanib, tiklaydi, chunki hozir u har doimgidek shirin va yorqin.

en: At sunset I try to hypnotize her, but alas!
uz: Quyosh botganda men uni hipnozlashga harakat qilaman, lekin vayl!

en: The power has grown less and less with each day, and tonight it fail me altogether.
uz: Kuch kundan-kunga kamayib bormoqda va bu kecha men uni butunlay yo'qotib yuboraman.

en: Well, God's will be done, whatever it may be, and whithersoever it may lead!
uz: Xudoning irodasi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, qayerga olib kelsa, shunday bo'lsin!

en: Now to the historical, for as Madam Mina write not in her stenography, I must, in my cumbrous old fashion, that so each day of us may not go unrecorded.
uz: Endi tarixiy mavzuga keling, chunki Madam Mina o'z stenografiyasida yozmaganidek, men o'zimning qachondir eski uslubim bilan har bir kunimizni yozib bo'lmaydi deb aytishim kerak.

en: We got to the Borgo Pass just after sunrise yesterday morning.
uz: Kecha ertalab quyosh chiqqanidan so'ng Borgo yo'lboshisiga yetib keldik.

en: When I saw the signs of the dawn I got ready for the hypnotism.
uz: Ertalabning belgilarini ko'rgach, men hipnotizm uchun tayyorgarlik ko'rdim.

en: We stopped our carriage, and got down so that there might be no disturbance.
uz: Biz mashinamizni to'xtatdik va hech qanday tartibsizlik bo'lmasligi uchun pastga tushdik.

en: I made a couch with furs, and Madam Mina, lying down, yield herself as usual, but more slow and more short time than ever, to the hypnotic sleep.
uz: Men to'qimalar bilan o'rindiqni yaratdim va Madam Mina o'tirib, odatdagidek, lekin hech qachon bo'lmagan darajada sekin va qisqa vaqt ichida hipnotik uyquga berilib ketadi.

en: As before, came the answer, darkness and the swirling of water. Then she woke, bright and radiant and we go on our way and soon reach the Pass.
uz: O'tmishdagidek, quruq va suvning sarosimalari degan javob keldi.Shundan so'ng u yorqin va yorqin o'zini uyg'otdi va biz yo'limizni davom ettirdik va tez orada o'tishga yetdik.

en: At this time and place, she become all on ﬁre with zeal.
uz: Shu vaqt va joyda u g'ayrat bilan yonib ketadi.

en: Some new guiding power be in her manifested, for she point to a road and say, This is the way. How know you it? I ask.
uz: U yo'lni ko'rsatib, yo'l mana shu, deb aytadi. Seni qayerdan bilasan? deb so'rayman.

en: Of course I know it,' she answer, and with a pause, add, Have not my Jonathan travelled it and wrote of his travel? At ﬁrst I think somewhat strange, but soon I see that there be only one such byroad.
uz: To'g'ri, bilaman, deb javob berdi u, biroz to'xtab qo'yib: Mening Jonatanim u yerga sayohat qilib, sayohatini yozmaganmidi? - deb aytdi.

en: It is used but little, and very different from the coach road from the Bukovina to Bistritz, which is more wide and hard, and more of use.
uz: U kamdan-kam ishlatiladi va Bukovinadan Bistritzgacha yo'ldan juda farq qiladi, bu kengroq, qiyinroq va ko'proq ishlatiladi.

en: So we came down this road.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz shu yo'ldan tushdik.

en: When we meet other ways, not always were we sure that they were roads at all, for they be neglect and light snow have fallen, the horses know and they only.
uz: Boshqa yo'llar bilan uchrashganimizda, ular yo'llar ekanligiga har doim ham amin bo'lmaganmiz, chunki ular beparvo va yengil qar yog'gan, atlar buni faqat ular biladi.

en: I give rein to them, and they go on so patient.
uz: Men ularga bosim o'tkazaman va ular juda sabrli bo'lishadi.

en: By and by we ﬁnd all the things which Jonathan have note in that wonderful diary of him.
uz: Yonatanning ajoyib kundalik kitobida yozilgan barcha narsalarni birma-bir topamiz.

en: Then we go on for long, long hours and hours.
uz: So'ngra biz uzoq, uzoq soatlar va soatlar davom etamiz.

en: At the ﬁrst, I tell Madam Mina to sleep.
uz: Boshida, Men Madam Minaga uxlashni aytaman.

en: She try, and she succeed.
uz: U harakat qiladi va muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.

en: She sleep all the time, till at the last, I feel myself to suspicious grow, and attempt to wake her.
uz: U doimo uxlaydi, oxirida men o'zimni shubhali his etib, uni uyg'otishga harakat qilaman.

en: But she sleep on, and I may not wake her though I try.
uz: Ammo u uxlab ketadi va men uni uyg'otishga harakat qilsam ham, uyg'otmayman.

en: I do not wish to try too hard lest I harm her.
uz: Men unga zarar yetkazmaslik uchun juda ko'p harakat qilishni istamayman.

en: For I know that she have suffer much, and sleep at times be all-in-all to her.
uz: Chunki uning ko'p azob chekganini bilaman va uyqu u uchun ba'zan hamma narsani o'z ichiga oladi.

en: I think I drowse myself, for all of sud- den I feel guilt, as though I have done something.
uz: O'zimni g'arq qilyapman deb o'ylayman, chunki shu paytgacha o'zimni aybdor his qilaman, xuddi biror narsa qilgan bo'lsam.

en: I ﬁnd myself bolt up, with
uz: Men o'zimni to'g'rilab qo'yganimni ko'rdim.

en: the reins in my hand, and the good horses go along jog, jog, just as ever.
uz: Mening qo'limdagi o'yinlar va yaxshi otlar har doimgidek yurishadi.

en: I look down and ﬁnd Madam Mina still asleep.
uz: Men pastga qarab, Madam Mina hali ham uxlab yotganini ko'rdim.

en: It is now not far off sunset time, and over the snow the light of the sun ﬂow in big yellow ﬂood, so that we throw great long shadow on where the mountain rise so steep.
uz: Hozir quyosh botish vaqti yaqinlashib qoldi va qor ustida quyosh nuri katta sariq to'lqin bilan oqib, tog'ning tog'ga ko'tarilgan joyga katta, uzoq soya tashlaymiz.

en: For we are going up, and up, and all is oh, so wild and rocky, as though it were the end of the world.
uz: Chunki biz ko'tarilamiz, ko'tarilamiz va hamma narsa oh, o'ta yovvoyi va toshbo'ron, xuddi dunyoning oxiri kabi.

en: Then I arouse Madam Mina.
uz: Keyin men Madam Minani uyg'otdim.

en: This time she wake with not much trouble, and then I try to put her to hypnotic sleep.
uz: Bu safar u ko'p muammolar bilan uyg'onadi va men uni hipnotik uyquga tushirishga harakat qilaman.

en: But she sleep not, being as though I were not.
uz: Ammo u uxlamaydi, xuddi men uxlamagan bo'lsam-da.

en: Still I try and try, till all at once I ﬁnd her and myself in dark, so I look round, and ﬁnd that the sun have gone down.
uz: Ammo men uni va o'zimni birdan qorong'ilikda topishga harakat qilaman, shuning uchun atrofimga qarab, quyosh botganini ko'raman.

en: Madam Mina laugh, and I turn and look at her.
uz: Xonim Mina kulishadi va men o'zimni o'zgartirib unga qarayman.

en: She is now quite awake, and look so well as I never saw her since that night at Carfax when we ﬁrst enter the Count's house.
uz: Hozir u juda uyg'ondir va men uni birinchi marta Kontning uyiga kirganimizdan beri Karfaksda o'sha kechadan beri ko'rmaganimdek ko'rinadi.

en: I am amaze, and not at ease then.
uz: Men hayronman va o'shanda xotirjam emasman.

en: But she is so bright and tender and thoughtful for me that I forget all fear.
uz: Lekin u men uchun shunchalik aqlli, mehribon va mehribon bo'lib, qo'rquvni unutib qo'yaman.

en: I light a ﬁre, for we have brought supply of wood with us, and she prepare food while I undo the horses and set them, tethered in shelter, to feed.
uz: Men olov yoqaman, chunki biz o'simliklarni olib keldik va u ovqat tayyorlaydi, men esa otlarni yo'q qilib qo'yaman va ularni to'ylash uchun uyga bog'lab qo'yaman.

en: Then when I return to the ﬁre she have my supper ready.
uz: Keyin men olovga qaytganimda, u mening kechki ovqatimni tayyorlaydi.

en: I go to help her, but she smile, and tell me that she have eat already.
uz: Men unga yordam berishga boraman, lekin u tabassum qilib, ovqat yeganini aytadi.

en: That she was so hungry that she would not wait.
uz: U shunchalik och ekanki, kutmaydi.

en: I like it not, and I have grave doubts.
uz: Menga yoqmaydi va jiddiy shubhalarim bor.

en: But I fear to affright her, and so I am silent of it.
uz: Ammo men uni qo'rqitishdan qo'rqaman va shu sababli men bu haqda gapirmayman.

en: She help me and I eat alone, and then we wrap in fur and lie beside the ﬁre, and I tell her to sleep while I watch.
uz: U menga yordam beradi va men yolg'iz ovqatlanaman, so'ngra to'qimaga o'rab, olov yonida yotamiz va men unga men ko'zimni ko'rsatayotganda uxlashini aytaman.

en: But presently I forget all of watching.
uz: Ammo hozirda men tomosha qilishni unutib qo'yaman.

en: And when I sudden remember that I watch, I ﬁnd her lying quiet, but awake, and looking at me with so bright eyes.
uz: Birdan men o'zim kuzatib turganimni eslab qolsam, uni xotirjamlik bilan, lekin uyg'oq holda yotgan holda ko'rib turaman va menga juda yorqin ko'zlar bilan qaraydi.

en: Once, twice more the same occur, and I get much sleep till before morning.
uz: Bir marta, ikki marta ham xuddi shunday holat yuz beradi va ertalabgacha ko'p uxlayman.

en: When I wake I try to hyp- notize her, but alas!
uz: U uyg'onganimda, uni hibsga olishga harakat qilaman, lekin afsuski!

en: Though she shut her eyes obedient, she may not sleep.
uz: Garchi u itoatkorlik bilan ko'zlarini yopsa-da, uxlamaydi.

en: The sun rise up, and up, and up, and then sleep come to her too late, but so heavy that she will not wake.
uz: Quyosh ko'tarilmoqda, ko'tarilmoqda va ko'tarilmoqda, keyin uyqu unga juda kech keladi, ammo u uyg'onmaydi deb juda og'ir.

en: I have to lift her up, and place her sleeping in the carriage when I have harnessed the horses and made all ready.
uz: Otlarni qo'lga olib, hamma narsani tayyorlaganimdan so'ng, uni ko'tarib, vagonada uxlab qo'yishim kerak.

en: Madam still sleep, and she look in her sleep more healthy and more redder than be- fore.
uz: Xonim hali ham uxlaydi va uxlaganida u avvalgidek sog'lom va qizilroq ko'rinadi.

en: And I am afraid, afraid, afraid!
uz: Va men qo'rqaman, qo'rqaman, qo'rqaman!

en: I am afraid of all things, even to think but I must go on my way.
uz: Men hamma narsadan qo'rqaman, hatto o'ylashdan ham qo'rqaman, lekin yo'limdan ketishim kerak.

en: The stake we play for is life and death, or more than these, and we must not ﬂinch.
uz: Biz o'zimiz uchun hayot va o'lim yoki undan ham ko'proq narsani o'ynashimiz kerak va biz qo'rqmasligimiz kerak.

en: 5 November, morning.—Let me be accurate in everything, for though you and I have seen some strange things together, you may at the ﬁrst think that I, Van Helsing, am mad.
uz: 5 noyabr kuni ertalab.Men hamma narsada aniq bo'lishim kerak, chunki siz va men birgalikda ba'zi g'alati narsalarni ko'rgan bo'lsak-da, boshida men, Van Helsing, aqldan ozgan deb o'ylashingiz mumkin.

en: That the many horrors and the so long strain on nerves has at the last turn my brain.
uz: Ko'p dahshatlar va uzoq vaqt davomida g'azabga to'lgan bosim mening miyamni so'nggi marta o'zgartirdi.

en: All yesterday we travel, always getting closer to the mountains, and mov- ing into a more and more wild and desert land.
uz: Kecha biz sayohat qildik, doimo tog'larga yaqinlashib, har doim yovvoyi va sahroli mamlakatga ko'chib o'tdik.

en: There are great, frowning precipices and much falling water, and Nature seem to have held sometime her carnival.
uz: U yerda katta, burun-burun bo'lgan vodiylar va ko'p suv tushadi va tabiat bir paytlar o'z karnavalini o'tkazgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Madam Mina still sleep and sleep.
uz: Xonim Mina hali ham uxlab yotgan.

en: And though I did have hunger and appeased it, I could not waken her, even for food.
uz: Garchi men och bo'lib, uni tinchlantirgan bo'lsam-da, uni uyg'ota olmadim, hatto ovqat uchun ham.

en: I began to fear that the fatal spell of the place was upon her, tainted as she is with that Vampire baptism.
uz: Men bu joyning dahshatli sehrining uning ustida bo'lgani uchun qo'rqishga tushdim, chunki u o'sha Vampir suvga cho'mish bilan bulg'angan.

en: Well, said I to myself, if it be that she sleep all the day, it shall also be that I do not sleep at night. As we travel on the rough road, for a road of an ancient and imperfect kind there was, I held down my head and slept.
uz: Agar u kun bo'yi uxlayotgan bo'lsa, men ham kechasi uxlamayman, - dedim o'zimga. Biz qattiq yo'lni bosib o'tganimizda, qadimgi va nomukammal yo'l bo'lgani uchun boshimni pastga olib uxladim.

en: Again I waked with a sense of guilt and of time passed, and found Madam Mina still sleeping, and the sun low down.
uz: Men yana o'zimni aybdor his etib uyg'onib, vaqt o'tib ketdi, va Men Madam Mina hali ham uxlab, quyosh tushayotganini ko'rdim.

en: But all was indeed changed.
uz: Ammo, albatta, hamma narsa o'zgardi.

en: The frowning mountains seemed further away, and we were near the top of a steep rising hill, on summit of which was such a castle as Jonathan tell of in his diary.
uz: O'z ko'zlarini ko'tarib turgan tog'lar uzoqroq ko'rinardi va biz baland tog'ning tepaligida, uning tepaligida Jonatan o'z kundalig'ida aytib o'tgan qal'a bor edi.

en: At once I exulted and feared.
uz: Men darhol quvonchga to'lib, qo'rqdim.

en: For now, for good or ill, the end was near.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda, yaxshi yoki yomon, oxirat yaqinlashib qoldi.

en: I woke Madam Mina, and again tried to hypnotize her, but alas!
uz: Men Xonim Minani uyg'otdim va uni yana hipnozlashga harakat qildim, lekin vay bo'lsin!

en: unavail- ing till too late.
uz: juda kechgacha unvail-ing.

en: Then, ere the great dark came upon us, for even after down sun the heavens reﬂected the gone sun on the snow, and all was for a time in a great twilight.
uz: Keyin, katta qorong'ilik boshimizga tushdi, chunki quyosh botganidan so'ng ham osmon qor ustida o'tib ketgan quyoshni aks ettirgan va hamma narsa bir muncha vaqt katta qorong'ilikda edi.

en: I took out the horses and fed them in what shelter I could.
uz: Atlarni olib chiqib, qo'limdan kelganicha ularga ovqat berardim.

en: Then I make a ﬁre, and near it I make Madam Mina, now awake and more charming than ever, sit comfortable amid her rugs.
uz: So'ngra olov yoqib, uning yonida esa endi uyg'onib, har qachongidan ham chiroyli bo'lgan Madam Minani o'z ko'tarmalarida qulay o'tirishga majbur qilaman.

en: I got ready food, but she would not eat, simply saying that she had not hunger.
uz: Men ovqat tayyorladim, lekin u ovqat yemadi, shunchaki och emasligini aytadi.

en: I did not press her, knowing her unavailingness.
uz: Men uni bosim o'tkazmadim, chunki uning noaniqligini bilardim.

en: But I myself eat, for I must needs now be strong for all.
uz: Ammo men o'zim ovqatlanaman, chunki hozir hammamiz uchun kuchli bo'lishim kerak.

en: Then, with the fear on me of what might be, I drew a ring so big for her comfort, round where Madam Mina sat.
uz: Keyin, nima bo'lishi mumkinligidan qo'rqqanim sababli, Madam Mina o'tirgan joy atrofida uning qulayligi uchun juda katta bag'ring chizdim.

en: And over the ring I passed some of the wafer, and I broke it ﬁne so that all was well guarded.
uz: Va men o'sha zaxira ustidan vaferning bir qismini o'tkazdim va uni yaxshi parchaladim, shunda hamma narsa yaxshi qo'riqlangan edi.

en: She sat still all the time, so still as one dead.
uz: U doim o'tirardi, xuddi o'lik kabi.

en: And she grew whiter and even whiter till the snow was not more pale, and no word she said.
uz: U qor ko'tarilmaguncha oqib-oqib borardi va hech bir so'z aytmadi.

en: But when I drew near, she clung to me, and I could know that the poor soul shook her from head to feet with a tremor that was pain to feel.
uz: Ammo men yaqinlashsam, u menga yopishib qoldi va men uning boshidan oyoqlarigacha dardini his qilgan bo'lsa-da, uning ruhi uni dardga to'ldirganini bilardim.

en: I said to her presently, when she had grown more quiet, Will you not come over to the ﬁre? for I wished to make a test of what she could.
uz: O'sha payt u o'zini tinch tutganida, men unga: Siz olovga o'tmaysizmi? - deb so'radim, chunki u nima qila olishini sinab ko'rmoqchi edim.

en: She rose obedient, but when she have made a step she stopped, and stood as one stricken.
uz: U itoatkorlik bilan turib oldi, lekin bir qadam qo'yganida to'xtadi va o'ziga yarasha to'xtadi.

en: Why not go on? I asked.
uz: Nega davom etmaysan? deb so'radim.

en: She shook her head, and coming back, sat down in her place.
uz: U boshini silkitdi va qaytib kelib o'z o'rinlariga o'tirdi.

en: Then, looking at me with open eyes, as of one waked
uz: Keyin, menga ko'zlari ochilgan holda qarab, uyg'ongan odam kabi ko'rindi.

en: from sleep, she said simply,I cannot! and remained silent.
uz: Uyqudan turib, u shunchaki: Men qila olmayman! - deb aytdi va soʻzsiz qoldi.

en: I rejoiced, for I knew that what she could not, none of those that we dreaded could.
uz: Men xursand bo'ldim, chunki u qila olmaydigan narsani biz qo'rqqanlarning hech biri ham qila olmasligini bilardim.

en: Though there might be danger to her body, yet her soul was safe!
uz: Garchi uning tanasi uchun xavf-xatar bo'lsa-da, uning ruhi xavfsiz edi!

en: Presently the horses began to scream, and tore at their tethers till I came to them and quieted them.
uz: Tez orada atlar qichqirib, men ularning oldiga kelib, ularni tinchlantirgunimcha, toʻgʻri yoʻldan ozdirishdi.

en: When they did feel my hands on them, they whinnied low as in joy,and licked at my hands and were quiet for a time.
uz: Mening qo'llarimni ular ustida his qilganlarida, ular quvonchga to'lib, qo'llarimni yaltirib, biroz tinch qolishdi.

en: Many times through the night did I come to them, till it arrive to the cold hour when all nature is at lowest, and every time my coming was with quiet of them.
uz: Kechasi ko'p marotaba ularning oldiga keldim, butun tabiat eng past holatda bo'lgan sovuq soatga yetgunga qadar, va har safar kelishimda ular xotirjam edi.

en: In the cold hour the ﬁre began to die, and I was about stepping forth to replenish it, for now the snow came in ﬂying sweeps and with it a chill mist.
uz: Soyuq soat ichida olov o'chishni boshladi va men uni to'ldirish uchun qadam qo'ymoqchi edim, chunki endi qor uchib ketadi va u bilan birga sovuq bulut ham keladi.

en: Even in the dark there was a light of some kind, as there ever is over snow, and it seemed as though the snow ﬂurries and the wreaths of mist took shape as of women with trailing garments.
uz: Hatto qorong'ilikda ham, qar ustida bo'lganidek, qandaydir bir nur paydo bo'lgan va qar shovqinlari va bulutlar ayollarning orqaga kiyinayotgan kiyimlari kabi shaklga ega bo'lganidek ko'rinardi.

en: All was in dead, grim silence only that the horses whinnied and cowered, as if in terror of the worst.
uz: Hamma narsa o'limda edi, faqat atlar qichqirib, qo'rqib ketishdi, xuddi eng yomon narsadan qo'rqib ketgandek.

en: I began to fear, horrible fears.
uz: Men qo'rqishga, dahshatli qo'rquvlarga duchor bo'ldim.

en: But then came to me the sense of safe- ty in that ring wherein I stood.
uz: Ammo o'sha paytda men turgan o'yinchoqda o'zimni xavfsiz his qilganman.

en: I began too, to think that my imaginings were of the night, and the gloom, and the unrest that I have gone through, and all the terrible anxiety.
uz: Men ham o'zimning tasavvurlarim kechasi, qorong'ilik, o'tkazgan tashvishlar va qo'rqinchli tashvishlar haqida o'ylay boshladim.

en: It was as though my memories of all Jonathan's horrid experience were befooling me.
uz: O'sha paytlarda Jonatanning dahshatli tajribasi haqida eslatmalar meni aldayotgandek bo'ldi.

en: For the snow ﬂakes and the mist be- gan to wheel and circle round, till I could get as though a shadowy glimpse of those women that would have kissed him.
uz: Qovushlar va bulutlar o'z-o'zidan aylanib chiqishi kerak edi, hatto uni o'pgan ayollarning ko'rinishini ko'rishga muvaffaq bo'lganman.

en: And then the horses cowered lower and lower, and moaned in terror as men do in pain.
uz: So'ngra otlar tobora pastga tushib, odamlarning og'rig'ida bo'lgani kabi qo'rquvdan yig'ib ketishdi.

en: Even the madness of fright was not to them, so that they could break away.
uz: Hatto qo'rquvning g'alati ham ular uchun yo'q edi, shuning uchun ular qochib ketishlari mumkin edi.

en: I feared for my dear Madam Mina when these weird ﬁgures drew near and circled round.
uz: Qizig'i Madam Mina uchun qo'rqardim, bu g'alati suratlar yaqinlashib, aylanib borganda.

en: I looked at her, but she sat calm, and smiled at me.
uz: Men unga qaradim, lekin u xotirjam o'tirib menga tabassum qildi.

en: When I would have stepped to the ﬁre to replenish it, she caught me and held me back, and whispered, like a voice that one hears in a dream, so low it was.
uz: Men olovni to'ldirish uchun olovga qadam bosganimda, u meni ushlab, ushlab turdi va tushda eshitadigan ovoz kabi shoshib gapirdi.

en: Here you are safe! I turned to her, and looking in her eyes said, But you?
uz: Mana, sen xotirjamsan! - deb uning ko'zlariga qaradim va: Agar sen bo'lsang?

en: It is for you that I fear! Whereat she laughed, a laugh low and unreal, and said, Fear for me!
uz: Men sizlardan qo'rqaman! - deb kulishardi u, ko'p o'rinsiz va realsiz kulish bilan: Men uchun qo'rqing!

en: None safer in all the world from them than I am,and as I wondered at the meaning of her words, a puff of wind made the ﬂame leap up, and I see the red scar on her forehead.
uz: Dunyoda ulardan mendan xavfsizroq hech kim yo'q, - dedi u. Men uning so'zlarining ma'nosini o'ylayotganimda, shamolning bir shovishi olovni ko'tardi va men uning peshanasida qizil yara ko'rdim.

en: Did I not, I would soon have learned, for the wheeling ﬁgures of mist and snow came closer, but keeping ever without the Holy circle.
uz: Agar shunday qilmasdim, tezda bilib olardim, chunki bulut va qorning to'g'rilashuvi yaqinlashdi, lekin muqaddas to'plamdan hech qachon chetda qolmadi.

en: Then they began to materi- alize till, if God have not taken away my reason, for I saw it through my
uz: Keyin ular, agar Xudo mening aql-idrokimni yo'q qilmagan bo'lsa, uni o'zim orqali ko'rdim, deb materiallashtirishni boshlashdi.

en: There were before me in actual ﬂesh the same three women that Jonathan saw in the room, when they would have kissed his throat.
uz: Jonatan xonada ko'rgan uchta ayolning o'zlari ham uning bo'yniga muhabbat bilan o'g'ib ketishgan edi.

en: I knew the swaying round forms, the bright hard eyes, the white teeth, the ruddy color, the voluptuous lips.
uz: Men o'z ko'zimni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'zlar, oq tishlar, qizil rang va chiroyli dudlar bilan tanishtirardim.

en: They smiled ever at poor dear Madam Mina.
uz: Ular kambag'al aziz Madam Minaga tabassum qilishdi.

en: And as their laugh came through the silence of the night, they twined their arms and pointed to her, and said in those so sweet tingling tones that Jonathan said were of the intolerable sweetness of the water glasses, Come, sister.
uz: Ular kechasi sukut bo'lgan paytda kulishlarini ko'tarib, qo'llarini bir-biriga tikib, unga ko'rsatishdi va Jonatan suv shishalarining sezgirligini ko'rsatgan o'ta shirin so'zlar bilan: Kel, singlim.

en: Come! In fear I turned to my poor Madam Mina, and my heart with gladness leapt like ﬂame.
uz: Qo'rqqanimdan, kambag'al Madam Minaga yuz o'girdim va yuragim shodlik bilan olov kabi cho'kib ketdi.

en: the terror in her sweet eyes, the repulsion, the hor- ror, told a story to my heart that was all of hope.
uz: Uning go'zal ko'zidagi dahshat, jirkanchlik va qo'rquv yuragimga umidvorlik bilan ta'sir qilgan hikoyani aytib berdi.

en: God be thanked she was not, yet of them.
uz: Xudoga shukurki, u ulardan biri emas edi.

en: I seized some of the ﬁrewood which was by me, and hold- ing out some of the Wafer, advanced on them towards the ﬁre.
uz: Men yonimda turgan yog'ochlardan bir qismini tutdim va bir qismini qo'yib, olovga yaqinlashdim.

en: They drew back before me, and laughed their low horrid laugh.
uz: Ular oldimda orqaga surib, o'zlarining qo'rqinchli kulishlari bilan kulishdi.

en: I fed the ﬁre, and feared them not.
uz: Men olovni o'chirib qo'ydim va ulardan qo'rqmadim.

en: For I knew that we were safe within the ring, which she could not leave no more than they could enter.
uz: Chunki men biz ringda xavfsiz ekanimizni bilardim, chunki u bu ringni ular kirishi mumkin bo'lganidek, tashlab ketishi mumkin emas edi.

en: The horses had ceased to moan, and lay still on the ground.
uz: Atlar yig'lashlarini to'xtatgan edilar va yer yuzida to'xtashgan edilar.

en: The snow fell on them softly, and they grew whiter.
uz: Ular ustiga salqin qar tushdi va ular oqib ketdi.

en: I knew that there was for the poor beasts no more of terror.
uz: Men kambag'al hayvonlar uchun qo'rquv yo'qligini bilardim.

en: And so we remained till the red of the dawn began to fall through the snow gloom.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz tongning qizig'i qor zulmatidan tushib ketmaguncha qoldik.

en: I was desolate and afraid, and full of woe and terror.
uz: Men charchagan va qo'rqqan edim, men qayg'u va dahshatga to'ldim.

en: But when that beautiful sun began to climb the horizon life was to me again.
uz: Ammo o'sha go'zal quyosh ko'rinishga ko'tarilgach, hayotim yana o'zgardi.

en: At the ﬁrst coming of the dawn the horrid ﬁgures melted in the whirling mist and snow.
uz: Erta tongda dahshatli suratlar burib, buzg'unchilikli bulut va qor ichida erib ketdi.

en: The wreaths of transparent gloom moved away towards the castle, and were lost.
uz: Ochiq zulmatning gʻayratlari qalʼa tomon koʻtarildi va yoʻqoldi.

en: Instinctively, with the dawn coming, I turned to Madam Mina, intending to hypnotize her.
uz: Ildiz tushib qolganida, instinktli ravishda Madam Minaga murojaat qilib, uni hipnozlash niyatida bo'ldim.

en: But she lay in a deep and sudden sleep, from which I could not wake her.
uz: Ammo u chuqur va to'satdan uxlab qoldi, men uni uyg'otolmadim.

en: I tried to hypnotize through her sleep, but she made no response, none at all, and the day broke.
uz: Men uning uyqusida hipnotizatsiya qilishga harakat qildim, lekin u hech qanday javob bermadi, umuman javob bermadi va kun bo'ldi.

en: I have made my ﬁre and have seen the horses, they are all dead.
uz: Men o'zimning olovimni yoqdim va atlarni ko'rdim, ularning barchasi o'lgan.

en: Today I have much to do here, and I keep waiting till the sun is up high.
uz: Bugun bu yerda ko'p ishlarim bor va quyosh ko'tarilmaguncha kutyapman.

en: For there may be places where I must go, where that sunlight, though snow and mist obscure it, will be to me a safety.
uz: Chunki men borishim kerak bo'lgan joylar bo'lishi mumkin, quyosh nuri, garchi qor va bulut uni qorong'i qilib qo'ysa ham, men uchun xavfsizlik bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I will strengthen me with breakfast, and then I will do my terrible work.
uz: Men o'zimni ertalabki ovqat bilan mustahkamlayman va keyin o'z qo'rqinchli ishimni bajaraman.

en: Madam Mina still sleeps, and God be thanked!
uz: Xonim Mina hali ham uxlaydi va Xudoga shukr!

en: She is calm in her sleep … JONATHAN HARKER'S JOURNAL 4 November, evening.—The accident to the launch has been a terrible thing for us.
uz: U uxlayotganda xotirjam... 4 noyabr kuni kechqurun Jonatan Harkerning jurnalida.Lunchning avjosi biz uchun dahshatli voqea bo'ldi.

en: Only for it we should have overtaken the boat long ago, and by
uz: Faqat shu maqsadda biz uzoq vaqt oldin qayiqni bosib o'tishimiz kerak edi, va bu bilan

en: now my dear Mina would have been free.
uz: Endi mening aziz Mina ozod bo'lgan bo'lar edi.

en: I fear to think of her, off on the wolds near that horrid place.
uz: U o'sha dahshatli joyga yaqin bo'lgan o'rmonlarda o'tirganidan qo'rqaman.

en: We have got horses, and we follow on the track.
uz: Bizda otlar bor va biz yo'lni kuzatib boramiz.

en: I note this whilst Godalming is getting ready.
uz: Men buni Godalming tayyorgarlik ko'rishi bilan kuzatyapman.

en: The Szgany must look out if they mean to ﬁght.
uz: Szganylar jang qilishni istasalar ehtiyot bo'lishlari kerak.

en: Oh, if only Morris and Seward were with us.
uz: Oh, agar Morris va Seward biz bilan birga bo'lganlarida edi.

en: If I write no more Goodby Mina!
uz: Agar men boshqa hech qanday Goodby Mina yozmagan bo'lsam!

en: God bless and keep you.
uz: Xudo sizni qut-baraka qilsin va saqlasin.

en: SEWARD'S DIARY 5 November.—With the dawn we saw the body of Szgany before us dashing away from the river with their leiter wagon.
uz: SEWARD'S DIARY 5 NOVEMBER.Shuning yorug'ida Szganiyning jasadini ko'rdik, u o'zlarining leiter vagonlari bilan daryodan yugurib ketayotgan edi.

en: They surrounded it in a cluster, and hurried along as though beset.
uz: Ular uni to'plamda o'rab olib, xuddi qo'rqinchga tushgan bo'lsa-da, shoshilib ketishdi.

en: The snow is falling lightly and there is a strange excitement in the air.
uz: Qar sekin tushib bormoqda va havoda g'alati hayajon paydo bo'lmoqda.

en: It may be our own feelings, but the depression is strange.
uz: Bu o'z his-tuyg'ularimiz bo'lishi mumkin, lekin depressiya g'alati.

en: Far off I hear the howling of wolves.
uz: Uzoqlikda boʻrilarning qichqirishini eshitaman.

en: The snow brings them down from the mountains, and there are dangers to all of us, and from all sides.
uz: Qar ularni tog'lardan olib tushadi va biz uchun hammamiz uchun xavf-xatarlar bor.

en: The horses are nearly ready, and we are soon off.
uz: Otlar deyarli tayyor bo'lib, biz tez orada jo'nab ketamiz.

en: We ride to death of some one.
uz: Biz birovning o'limiga otlanamiz.

en: God alone knows who, or where, or what, or when, or how it may be … DR.
uz: Kim, qayerda, nima, qachon yoki qanday bo'lishi mumkinligini faqat Xudo biladi ...

en: VAN HELSING'S MEMORANDUM 5 November, afternoon.—I am at least sane.
uz: VAN HELSING'S MEMORANDUM 5 noyabr kuni kechqurun.Men hech bo'lmaganda sog'lomman.

en: Thank God for that mercy at all events, though the proving it has been dreadful.
uz: Har holda, rahmdillik uchun Xudoga shukrlar, ammo buning isbotlanishi dahshatli bo'ldi.

en: When I left Madam Mina sleeping within the Holy circle, I took my way to the castle.
uz: Madam Minani Muqaddas to'plam ichida uxlab qoldirganimda, qal'aga yo'l oldim.

en: The blacksmith hammer which I took in the carriage from Veresti was useful, though the doors were all open I broke them off the rusty hinges, lest some ill intent or ill chance should close them, so that being entered I might not get out.
uz: Veresti aravachasidan olgan temirchi hamiri foydali edi, lekin eshiklar hamma ochiq bo'lsa-da, men ularni eskirgan eskirgilardan buzganman, ehtimol biron bir yomon niyat yoki omadsizlik ularni yopib qo'yadi, shuning uchun kirganimda men chiqolmayman.

en: Jonathan's bitter experience served me here.
uz: Jonatanning achchiq tajribasi bu yerda menga xizmat qildi.

en: By memory of his di- ary I found my way to the old chapel, for I knew that here my work lay.
uz: Uning jurnalini eslab, eski chapelga yo'l topdim, chunki bu yerda mening ishim borligini bilardim.

en: The air was oppressive.
uz: Havo shafqatsiz edi.

en: It seemed as if there was some sulphurous fume, which at times made me dizzy.
uz: O'zimni chalg'itadigan, ba'zan boshimni chalg'itadigan bir nechta kükürtli tutun paydo bo'lgani kabi ko'rinardi.

en: Either there was a roaring in my ears or I heard afar off the howl of wolves.
uz: Yoki quloqlarimda qichqiriq eshitildi yoki uzoqdan bo'rilarning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: Then I bethought me of my dear Madam Mina, and I was in terrible plight.
uz: Keyin men aziz xonim Mina haqida o'yladim va men dahshatli ahvolda edim.

en: The dilemma had me between his horns.
uz: Dilemma meni uning shoxlari o'rtasida o'tkazdi.

en: Her, I had not dare to take into this place, but left safe from the Vampire in that Holy circle.
uz: U, men bu joyga kirishga jur'at qilmadim, lekin o'sha muqaddas to'pkadagi Vampirdan omon qoldim.

en: And yet even there would be the wolf!
uz: Shunga qaramay, hatto boʻri ham boʻladi!

en: I resolve me that my work lay here, and that as to the wolves we must submit, if it were God's will.
uz: Men o'zimning ishimni bu yerda bajarishga qaror qildim va agar Xudoning irodasi bo'lsa, bo'rilarga bo'ysunishimiz kerak.

en: At any rate it was only death and freedom beyond.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bu faqat o'lim va undan keyingi erkinlik edi.

en: So did I choose for her.
uz: Men ham uni tanladim.

en: Had it but been for myself the choice had been easy, the maw of the wolf were better to rest in than the grave of the Vampire!
uz: Agar men o'zim uchun bo'lganida edi, tanlov oson bo'lardi, bo'rilarning qo'rqinchlari Vampir qabridan ko'ra yaxshiroq dam olishlari mumkin edi!

en: So I make my choice to go on with my work.
uz: Shunday qilib, men o'z ishimni davom ettirishni tanladim.

en: I knew that there were at least three graves to ﬁnd, graves that are inhab- it.
uz: Men kamida uchta qabr borligini bilardim, bu yerda odamlar yashaydigan qabrlar bor.

en: So I search, and search, and I ﬁnd one of them.
uz: Shunday qilib, men qidirib topdim, qidirib topdim va ulardan birini topdim.

en: She lay in her Vampire sleep, so full of life and voluptuous beauty that I shudder as though I have come to do murder.
uz: U o'zining Vampir uyqusida yotgan edi, u shunchalik hayotga to'lib-toshgan va go'zal bo'lganki, men o'ldirmoqchi bo'lganimdek titrarman.

en: Ah, I doubt not that in the old time, when such things were, many a man who set forth to do such a task as mine, found at the last his heart fail him, and then his nerve.
uz: Ah, men o'ylaymanki, qadimgi kunlarda bunday ishlar sodir bo'lganida, men kabi vazifani bajarishga qaror qilgan ko'plab odamlar oxir-oqibat yuragi va keyin g'ayratlari puchga chiqqanini ko'rishgan.

en: So he delay, and delay, and delay, till the mere beauty and the fascination of the wanton Undead have hypnotize him.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'limsiz o'likning go'zalligi va hayratlanarliligi uni hipnozlashmaguncha, kechiktiradi va kechiktiradi.

en: And he remain on and on, till sunset come, and the Vampire sleep be over.
uz: Va u quyosh botguncha davom etadi va Vampir uxlab qolguncha davom etadi.

en: Then the beautiful eyes of the fair woman open and look love, and the voluptuous mouth present to a kiss, and the man is weak.
uz: Keyin go'zal ayolning go'zal ko'zlari ochiladi va sevgiga o'xshaydi, o'ziga xos og'iz esa o'pishga tayyor bo'ladi va erkak zaif bo'ladi.

en: And there remain one more victim in the Vampire fold.
uz: Va Vampirlar qo'rqinchida yana bir qurbon qolmoqda.

en: One more to swell the grim and grisly ranks of the Undead!
uz: O'liklarning qorong'i va qo'rqinchli saflarini ko'tarish uchun yana bittasi!

en: … There is some fascination, surely, when I am moved by the mere presence of such an one, even lying as she lay in a tomb fretted with age and heavy with the dust of centuries, though there be that horrid odor such as the lairs of the Count have had.
uz: ... Bunday ayolning hozir bo'lishi menga juda hayajonli bo'lishi mumkin, hatto u asrlar davomida toshbo'ron bo'lgan va yoshga to'lgan qabrda yotganida, Countning qabrlari kabi dahshatli hidga ega bo'lsa-da.

en: I, Van Helsing, with all my pur- pose and with my motive for hate.
uz: Men, Van Helsing, barcha maqsadlarim va nafratning sabablari bilan.

en: I was moved to a yearning for delay which seemed to paralyze my faculties and to clog my very soul.
uz: Men kechiktirishga bo'lgan istakimni o'zgartirdim, bu esa o'z kuch-quvvatimni to'sib, ruhimni to'sib qo'ydi.

en: It may have been that the need of natural sleep, and the strange oppression of the air were beginning to overcome me.
uz: Ehtimol, tabiiy uyquga bo'lgan ehtiyoj va havoda paydo bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy zulm menga g'alaba qozonishni boshlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Certain it was that I was lapsing into sleep, the open eyed sleep of one who yields to a sweet fascination, when there came through the snow stilled air a long, low wail, so full of woe and pity that it woke me like the sound of a clarion.
uz: Shubhasizki, men uxlab ketayotgan edim, o'zimni go'zal ta'sirga berayotgan odamning ko'zi ochiq uyqusida bo'lganimda, qarga to'xtab qolgan havo orqali uzoq, past yig'ilar paydo bo'ldi, u qayg'u va achinish bilan to'lib-toshgan va meni tungi tungi tovush kabi uyg'otdi.

en: For it was the voice of my dear Madam Mina that I heard.
uz: Chunki men o'zimning sevimli Madam Mina ovozimni eshitgan edim.

en: Then I braced myself again to my horrid task, and found by wrenching away tomb tops one other of the sisters, the other dark one.
uz: Keyin men yana o'z qo'rqinchli vazifamni bajarishga harakat qildim va bir opamizning qabr ustunlarini yirtib tashlab, boshqa singlimizni topdim.

en: I dared not pause to look on her as I had on her sister, lest once more I should begin to be enthrall.
uz: Men unga qaraganimdek, singlisiga qaraganimdek, unga qarab turishga jur'at qilmadim, yana bir bor o'zimni hayratda qoldirmasligim uchun.

en: But I go on searching until, presently, I ﬁnd in a high great tomb as if made to one much beloved that other fair sister which, like Jonathan I had seen to gather herself out of the atoms of the mist.
uz: Ammo men qidirishni davom ettiraman, hozirgi vaqtda baland bir qabrda, xuddi sevimli bir kishiga tayyorlanganidek, boshqa go'zal singlimni topaman, u ham Jonatan singari o'zini bulut atomlaridan to'plaganini ko'rdim.

en: She was so fair to look on, so radiantly beautiful, so exquisitely voluptuous, that the very in- stinct of man in me, which calls some of my sex to love and to protect one of hers, made my head whirl with new emotion.
uz: U juda mehribon edi, juda chiroyli va chiroyli edi, shu bois mendagi erkaklik instinkt, men o'z jinsimdan ba'zilarini sevishga va o'z jinsidan birini himoya qilishga chaqiradigan bo'lib, boshimni yangi tuyg'ular bilan aylantirdi.

en: But God be thanked, that soul wail of my dear Madam Mina had not died out of my ears.
uz: Lekin Xudoga shukr, sevimli xonim Minaning ruhiy qayg'usi quloqlarimdan o'tib ketmagan edi.

en: And, before the spell could be wrought further upon me, I had nerved myself to my wild work.
uz: Bu sehr meni yanada ko'proq qamrab olishi mumkin bo'lganidan oldin, men o'zimni yovvoyi ishimga tashvishlantirgan edim.

en: By this tim e I had searched all the tombs in the chapel, so far as I could tell.
uz: Shu vaqtgacha men chapladagi barcha qabrlarni qidirib topdim.

en: And as there had been only three of these Undead phantoms
uz: Va bu o'liklardan faqat uchtalari mavjud bo'lgani sababli, ular o'z-o'zidan keyin paydo bo'lgan.

en: around us in the night, I took it that there were no more of active Undead existent.
uz: Kechasi atrofimizda bo'lganimizda, endi faol o'lik mavjud bo'lmaganini tushunib yetdim.

en: There was one great tomb more lordly than all the rest.
uz: Bir katta qabr bor edi, u boshqa qabrlardan ham buyukroq edi.

en: Huge it was, and nobly proportioned.
uz: Ulkan va noyob proporsiyali edi.

en: On it was but one word.
uz: U yerda faqat bitta so'z bor edi.

en: DRACULA This then was the Undead home of the King Vampire, to whom so many more were due.
uz: DRACULA O'sha paytda bu o'liklarning o'zi bo'lgan Vampir Podshohning uyi edi, unga ko'pgina o'liklar bor edi.

en: Its emptiness spoke eloquent to make certain what I knew.
uz: Uning bo'shligi men bilgan narsalarga ishonch hosil qilish uchun so'zlab berdi.

en: Before I began to restore these women to their dead selves through my aw- ful work, I laid in Dracula's tomb some of the Wafer, and so banished him from it, Undead, for ever.
uz: Men o'z mehnatim orqali bu ayollarni o'lim holatiga qaytarishni boshlashdan oldin, Dracula qabriga bir nechta vaferni qo'ydim va uni abadiy o'liklardan qutulganman.

en: Then began my terrible task, and I dreaded it.
uz: O'shanda dahshatli vazifam boshlandi va men undan qo'rqardim.

en: Had it been but one, it had been easy, comparative.
uz: Agar bu faqat bitta bo'lganida edi, u oson, qiyosiy bo'lgan bo'lardi.

en: To begin twice more after I had been through a deed of horror.
uz: Qo'rqinchli hodisani boshdan kechirganimdan so'ng yana ikki marta boshlash uchun.

en: For it was terrible with the sweet Miss Lucy, what would it not be with these strange ones who had survived through centuries, and who had been strenghtened by the passing of the years.
uz: Chunki go'zal Miss Lucy bilan juda dahshatli edi, asrlar davomida tirik qolgan va yillar o'tib, kuchga kirgan bu g'alati odamlar bilan ham shunday bo'lmasmidi?

en: Who would, if they could, have fought for their foul lives … Oh, my friend John, but it was butcher work.
uz: Agar ular imkoniyati bo'lganida, o'zlarining nopok hayoti uchun kurashgan bo'lar edilar... Yo'q, do'stim Jon, lekin bu qilichboz ishi edi.

en: Had I not been nerved by thoughts of other dead, and of the living over whom hung such a pall of fear, I could not have gone on.
uz: Agar boshqa o'lganlar va tiriklar haqida o'ylamaganimda va ularning ustiga qo'rquv qo'rquv qo'shiqlari osilganida g'alati bo'lmaganimda, bu ishni davom ettira olmasdim.

en: I tremble and tremble even yet, though till all was over, God be thanked, my nerve did stand.
uz: Men hali ham titrab-tiribman, ammo hamma narsa o'tgangacha, Xudoga shukr, g'azabim to'xtadi.

en: Had I not seen the repose in the ﬁrst place, and the gladness that stole over it just ere the ﬁnal dissolu- tion came, as realization that the soul had been won, I could not have gone further with my butchery.
uz: Agar men birinchi navbatda dam olishni va oxirgi xalos bo'lishdan oldin uni bosib o'tgan quvonchni va ruhning qo'lga kiritilganligini anglab yetmaganimda edi, o'g'limni o'ldirganimni ko'rmaganimda edi, o'g'limni o'ldirganimni ko'rmagan bo'lardim.

en: I could not have endured the horrid screeching as the stake drove home, the plunging of writhing form, and lips of bloody foam.
uz: O'g'limning o'ziga qaytib borayotgan qo'rqinchli qichqiriqlariga, burilgan shakli qulab ketishiga va qonli cho'g'li og'izlarga chiday olmasdim.

en: I should have ﬂed in terror and left my work undone.
uz: Men qo'rquvdan qochib ketib, ishimni bekor qoldirishim kerak edi.

en: And the poor souls, I can pity them now and weep, as I think of them placid each in her full sleep of death for a short moment ere fading.
uz: Endi esa kambag'al ruhlarga rahm qilib, yig'laya olaman, chunki ularning har biri o'lim uyqusida bir zum o'tib ketishdan oldin o'zini tinchlantirayotganini o'ylayman.

en: For, friend John, hardly had my knife severed the head of each, before the whole body began to melt away and crumble into its native dust, as though the death that should have come centuries agone had at last assert himself and say at once and loud,I am here! Before I left the castle I so ﬁxed its entrances that never more can the Count enter there Undead.
uz: Chunki, do'stim Jon, butun tanasi erib, o'z tug'ilgan tuproqga aylanishiga qadar, o'g'lim har birining boshini o'chirib tashlamagan edi, xuddi asrlar o'tib kelishi kerak bo'lgan o'lim o'zini nihoyat tasdiqlab, birdan baland ovoz bilan: Men bu yerdaman! - deb aytgandek, qal'ani tark etishdan oldin men uning eshiklarini shunday ta'mirlagan edimki, Count endi hech qachon o'liklarga kirolmaydi.

en: When I stepped into the circle where Madam Mina slept, she woke from her sleep and, seeing me, cried out in pain that I had endured too much.
uz: Men Madam Mina uxlagan doiraga kirganimda, u uxlaganidan uyg'onib, meni ko'rib, men juda ko'p azob chekganimni og'riqli so'zlab yubordi.

en: Come! she said, come away from this awful place!
uz: U: Kelin, bu dahshatli joydan ketinglar!

en: Let us go to meet my husband who is, I know, coming towards us. She was looking thin and pale and weak.
uz: Keling, erim bilan uchrashishga boraylik, u bizga yaqinlashib kelyapti, deb bilaman, - deb aytdi.

en: But her eyes were pure and glowed with fervor.
uz: Lekin uning ko'zlari sof va g'ayrat bilan nurlanardi.

en: to see her paleness and her illness, for my mind was full of the fresh horror of that ruddy vampire sleep.
uz: Uning bo'lakligi va kasalligini ko'rish uchun, mening ongim o'sha qizil vampir uxlashining yangi dahshatidan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: And so with trust and hope, and yet full of fear, we go eastward to meet our friends, and him, whom Madam Mina tell me that she know are coming to meet us.
uz: Shunday qilib, ishonch va umid bilan, ammo qo'rquvga to'lib-toshgan holda, do'stlarimiz va Madam Mina bizga qarshi ketayotganini biladigan odamni uchratish uchun sharqqa boramiz.

en: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 6 November.—It was late in the afternoon when the Professor and I took our way towards the east whence I knew Jonathan was coming.
uz: MINA HARKER'S JOURNAL 6 NOVEMBER.Professor va men Jonatan kelayotganini bilgan yerdan sharqqa borganimizda, kechki payt kechki payt edi.

en: We did not go fast, though the way was steeply downhill, for w e had to take heavy rugs and wraps with us.
uz: Biz tez yurmadik, ammo yo'l keskin tushdi, chunki biz bilan og'ir ko'kraklar va qadoqlarni olib ketishimiz kerak edi.

en: We dared not face the possibility of being left with- out warmth in the cold and the snow.
uz: Biz sovuq va qorda issiqliksiz qolish ehtimoliga duch kelishga jur'at etmadik.

en: We had to take some of our provisions too, for we were in a perfect desolation, and so far as we could see through the snowfall, there was not even the sign of habitation.
uz: Biz ham ba'zi rizq-ro'zlarimizni olib ketishimiz kerak edi, chunki biz mukammal cho'llikda edik va qar yog'ishi orqali ko'rishimiz mumkin bo'lgancha, hatto uy-joy ko'rinmas edi.

en: When we had gone about a mile, I was tired with the heavy walking and sat down to rest.
uz: Bir kilometrcha yurganimizda, men og'ir yurishdan charchadim va dam olishga o'tirdim.

en: Then we looked back and saw where the clear line of Dracula's castle cut the sky.
uz: Keyin orqaga qarab, Drakulaning qalʼasining aniq chizigʻi osmonni qayerda kesayotganini koʻrdik.

en: For we were so deep under the hill whereon it was set that the angle of per- spective of the Carpathian mountains was far below it.
uz: Chunki biz tog'ning ostida shunchalik chuqur bo'lgan edikki, Karpat tog'larining ko'rinish burchagi undan ancha past edi.

en: We saw it in all its grandeur, perched a thousand feet on the summit of a sheer precipice, and with seemingly a great gap between it and the steep of the adjacent moun- tain on any side.
uz: Biz uni butun ulug'vorligida ko'rdik, u o'ta baland va o'ta baland tog'ning tepalig'ida ming metr balandlikda joylashgan va uning o'rtasida katta bo'shliq paydo bo'lgan.

en: There was something wild and uncanny about the place.
uz: Bu joyda g'ayritabiiy va yovvoyi bir narsa bor edi.

en: We could hear the distant howling of wolves.
uz: Biz uzoqdan bo'lgan bo'rilarning qichqirishini eshitardik.

en: They were far off, but the sound, even though coming mufﬂed through the deadening snowfall, was full of terror.
uz: Ular juda uzoqda edilar, lekin bu tovush, hatto o'limga olib boradigan qor yog'ishi orqali so'nggilamagan bo'lsa-da, qo'rquvga to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: I knew from the way Dr.
uz: Men Dr.ning yo'lidan bilardim.

en: Van Helsing was searching about that he was trying to seek some strategic point, where we would be less exposed in case of attack.
uz: Van Helsing qidirib topganida, u biror strategik nuqtani izlashga harakat qilmoqda edi, u erda hujum bo'lganda biz kamroq zarar ko'rishimiz mumkin edi.

en: The rough roadway still led downwards.
uz: Qattiq yo'l hali ham pastga olib borardi.

en: We could trace it through the drifted snow.
uz: Biz uni qar ostidan o'tkazib yuborilgan qor orqali izlab topishimiz mumkin.

en: In a little while the Professor signalled to me, so I got up and joined him.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, professor menga ishora qildi, shuning uchun men o'rnidan turib unga qo'shildim.

en: He had found a wonderful spot, a sort of natural hollow in a rock, with an entrance like a doorway between two boulders.
uz: U ajoyib joyni topgan edi, toshdagi tabiiy tosh kabi, ikkita tosh o'rtasidagi eshik kabi kirish joyini topgan.

en: He took me by the hand and drew me in.
uz: U qo'limdan ushlab, meni ichkariga olib kirdi.

en: See! he said,here you will be in shelter.
uz: Qaranglar, dedi u, bu yerda siz boshpanaga joylashasiz.

en: And if the wolves do come I can meet them one by one. He brought in our furs, and made a snug nest for me, and got out some provisions and forced them upon me.
uz: Va agar bo'rilar kelsa, men ulardan bir-birini uchratishim mumkin. U terimizni olib kelib, menga o't qo'yib, past o't qo'ydi, ba'zi rizq-ro'zni olib chiqib, menga majbur qildi.

en: But I could not eat, to even try to do so was repulsive to me, and much as I would have liked to please him, I could not bring myself to the attempt.
uz: Ammo men ovqat yemayman, hatto bunday qilishga harakat qilish ham menga yoqimsiz edi va unga yoqtirishni xohlaganimcha, o'zimni tajriba qilishga majburlay olmadim.

en: He looked very sad, but did not re-
uz: U juda xafa ko'rinardi, ammo yana ko'rinmadi.

en: Taking his ﬁeld glasses from the case, he stood on the top of the rock, and began to search the horizon.
uz: O'z ko'zoynaklarini ishdan olib, toshning ustiga turdi va ko'rinishni qidirishni boshladi.

en: Suddenly he called out, Look!
uz: Toʻsatdan u: Qarang!

en: Madam Mina, look!Look! I sprang up and stood beside him on the rock.
uz: Xonim Mina, qarang!Qarang! - dedim va qo'lga tushib, uning yonida tosh ustida turdim.

en: He handed me his glasses and pointed.
uz: U menga ko'zoynaklarini uzatdi va ko'z o'ngimga ko'tardi.

en: The snow was now falling more heavily, and swirled about ﬁercely, for a high wind was beginning to blow.
uz: Hozir esa qor og'irroq tushib, kuchli shamol ushlab turardi.

en: However, there were times when there were pauses between the snow ﬂurries and I could see a long way round.
uz: Biroq, qar to'plamlari orasidagi to'qnashuvlar bo'lgan va men uzoqdan ko'rishim mumkin bo'lgan paytlar ham bo'lgan.

en: From the height where we were it was possible to see a great distance.
uz: Biz turgan balandlikdan katta masofa ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: And far off, beyond the white waste of snow, I could see the river lying like a black ribbon in kinks and curls as it wound its way.
uz: Uzoqlikda, qar oqidan o'sha-o'sha bo'lak-bo'lakdan o'sha-o'sha yo'lni ko'rib, daryo o'z yo'lini o'zgartirganida, o'ziga o'xshaydigan qora qovoqcha kabi o'tirib qolganini ko'rardim.

en: Straight in front of us and not far off, in fact so near that I wondered we had not no- ticed before, came a group of mounted men hurrying along.
uz: To'g'ri oldimizda va uzoq emas, aslida, shunchalik yaqinki, o'zimni o'zim bilmagan edimki, biz ilgari hech narsa qilmagan edik, deb hayron qoldim.

en: In the midst of them was a cart, a long leiter wagon which swept from side to side, like a dog's tail wagging, with each stern inequality of the road.
uz: Ularning o'rtasida arava bor edi, u bir tomondan boshqa tomonga ko'tarilgan, xuddi itning quyruqini toshbo'ron qilgandek, har bir yo'lning keskin tengsizligi bilan.

en: Outlined against the snow as they were, I could see from the men's clothes that they were peasants or gypsies of some kind.
uz: Ular qarga qaragan holda ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa-da, erkaklar kiyimidan ular qishloq yoki g'ayritabiiy kishilar ekanligini ko'rardim.

en: On the cart was a great square chest.
uz: Arabada katta kvadratli quti bor edi.

en: My heart leaped as I saw it, for I felt that the end was coming.
uz: Buni ko'rganimda yuragim qusdi, chunki oxirat yaqinlashib qolganini his qilardim.

en: The evening was now drawing close, and well I knew that at sunset the Thing, which was till then imprisoned there, would take new freedom and could in any of many forms elude pursuit.
uz: Kechki yaqinlashayotgan edi va men quyosh botganida u yerda qamoqda bo'lgan Buyum yangi erkinlikni oladi va ko'p jihatdan qochib ketishi mumkinligini bilardim.

en: In fear I turned to the Professor.
uz: Qo'rqib, professorga murojaat qildim.

en: To my consternation, however, he was not there.
uz: Biroq, mening hayajonimcha, u u yerda yo'q edi.

en: An instant later, I saw him below me.
uz: Bir zum o'tgach, uni yonimda ko'rdim.

en: Round the rock he had drawn a circle, such as we had found shelter in last night.
uz: U o'tgan kecha boshpana topganimiz kabi, qo'y atrofini aylanib chiqardi.

en: When he had completed it he stood beside me again saying, At least you shall be safe here from him! He took the glasses from me, and at the next lull of the snow swept the whole space below us.
uz: Uni tugatganida yana yonimda turib: O'sha odamdan hech bo'lmaganda siz xotirjam bo'lasiz! - deb aytdi. U mendan shishalarni olib ketdi va keyingi qar to'qnashida bizdan past bo'lgan butun joyni o'rab oldi.

en: See,he said,they come quickly.
uz: Qarang, ular tez keladilar, dedi u.

en: They are ﬂogging the horses, and galloping as hard as they can. He paused and went on in a hollow voice, They are racing for the sun- set.
uz: Ular otlarni urib, imkon qadar qattiq galoplashmoqdalar, - dedi u. U to'xtadi va chuqur ovoz bilan davom etdi: Ular quyosh botish uchun musobaqa qilmoqdalar.

en: God's will be done! Down came another blinding rush of driving snow, and the whole landscape was blotted out.
uz: Xudoning irodasi bajo kelsin! - deb, yana bir ko'r bo'lgan qar yog'ib, butun manzara o'chirildi.

en: It soon passed, however, and once more his glasses were ﬁxed on the plain.
