uz: Biroq, u tezda o'tib ketdi va yana ko'z ko'zguvlari o'lchovga o'rnatildi.

en: Then came a sudden cry, Look!
uz: Keyin to'satdan: Qarang!

en: See, two horsemen follow fast, coming up from the south.
uz: Mana, janubiy tomondan ikki otliq tezlik bilan orqasidan kelayotganini ko'ring.

en: It must be Quincey and John.
uz: Bu Quincey va Jon bo'lishi kerak.

en: Look before the snow blots it all out! I took it and looked.
uz: Qar hamma narsani o'chirib tashlamadan ko'ring! - dedim va uni olib, ko'rdim.

en: The two men might be Dr.
uz: Ikki kishi doktor bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I knew at all events that neither of them was Jonathan.
uz: Men ularning hech biri Jonatan emasligini har qanday holatda bilardim.

en: At the same time I knew that Jonathan was not far off.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Jonatan uzoq emasligini bilardim.

en: Looking around I saw on the north side of the coming party two other
uz: O'z atrofimni ko'rib, kelgusi partiyaning shimoliy tomonida yana ikki kishini ko'rdim.

en: men, riding at breakneck speed.
uz: Erkaklar, keskin tezlikda sayohat qilishadi.

en: One of them I knew was Jonathan, and the other I took, of course, to be Lord Godalming.
uz: Ulardan biri Jonatan ekanini bilardim, ikkinchisi esa Lord Godalming deb o'ylayman.

en: They too, were pursuing the party with the cart.
uz: Ular ham partiyani arava bilan quvg'in qilishgan.

en: When I told the Professor he shouted in glee like a schoolboy, and after looking intently till a snow fall made sight impossible, he laid his Winchester riﬂe ready for use against the boulder at the opening of our shelter.
uz: Men professorga u maktab o'quvchisi kabi quvonch bilan qichqirganini aytganimda, u qar tushishidan ko'rinmasligini ko'rmaguncha diqqat bilan ko'rib, Winchester o'q-pichoqini uyimizning ochilishida toshga qarshi qo'yib qo'ydi.

en: They are all converging, he said.When the time comes we shall have gypsies on all sides. I got out my revolver ready to hand, for whilst we were speaking the howling of wolves came louder and closer.
uz: Ularning barchasi bir-biriga yaqinlashmoqda, - dedi u. Vaqt kelganda, bizda hamma taraflarda g'ayriyahudiylar bo'ladi. Men o'z revolverimni qo'limga tayyor olib chiqdim, chunki gapirganimizda, bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari balandroq va yaqinroq bo'ldi.

en: When the snow storm abated a moment we looked again.
uz: Qovoshli bo'ron bir zumga kamayganida, yana ko'rdik.

en: It was strange to see the snow falling in such heavy ﬂakes close to us, and beyond, the sun shining more and more brightly as it sank down towards the far mountain tops.
uz: Biz yaqin atrofda va undan tashqarida qorni ko'rish g'alati edi, chunki quyosh uzoq tog'larning tepaligidan tushayotganda yanada yorqinroq parlashardi.

en: Sweeping the glass all around us I could see here and there dots moving singly and in twos and threes and larger numbers.
uz: O'z atrofimizdagi shishalarni ko'rib, bu erda va u erda bir-biridan va ikki va uchdan va katta raqamlarda harakatlanayotgan nuqtalarni ko'rardim.

en: The wolves were gather- ing for their prey.
uz: Qurtlar o'z ovlarini olish uchun yig'ilishardi.

en: Every instant seemed an age whilst we waited.
uz: Har bir daqiqa biz kutganimizda bir yoshga o'xshardi.

en: The wind came now in ﬁerce bursts, and the snow was driven with fury as it swept upon us in cir- cling eddies.
uz: Endi shamol kuchli bo'lib o'tadi va qor bizlarni to'p-to'p bo'lib o'rab olgan paytda g'azabga to'lib-toshgan.

en: At times we could not see an arm's length before us.
uz: Ba'zan biz o'zimizdan oldingi qo'limizni ko'rmay qolamiz.

en: But at others, as the hollow sounding wind swept by us, it seemed to clear the air space around us so that we could see afar off.
uz: Ammo boshqa joylarda esa, bizdan ko'tarilgan quruq shamol atrofimizdagi havo bo'shliqini tozalab, uzoqdan ko'rishimizga imkon yaratgan.

en: We had of late been so accus- tomed to watch for sunrise and sunset, that we knew with fair accuracy when it would be.
uz: So'nggi paytlarda biz quyosh chiqish va quyosh botish paytida kuzatib turish uchun shunchalik aybdor edikki, qachon bo'lishini aniq bilardik.

en: And we knew that before long the sun would set.
uz: Va tez orada quyosh botishini bilardik.

en: It was hard to believe that by our watches it was less than an hour that we waited in that rocky shelter before the various bodies began to converge close upon us.
uz: Bizning soatlarimizga ko'ra, turli jasadlar yaqinimizga yaqinlashib kelishidan oldin, biz bu toshli sotuvda bir soatdan kam vaqtni kutganimizga ishonish qiyin edi.

en: The wind came now with ﬁercer and more bitter sweeps, and more steadily from the north.
uz: Shamol endi shimoliy tomondan qattiqroq va keskinroq bo'lib, barqarorroq bo'ldi.

en: It seemingly had driven the snow clouds from us, for with only occasional bursts, the snow fell.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, u qor bulutlarini bizdan uzoqlashtirgan, chunki faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan qar yog'di.

en: We could distinguish clearly the individuals of each party, the pursued and the pursuers.
uz: Biz har bir partiyaning shaxslarini, quvg'in qilinadigan va quvg'in qiluvchilarni aniq ajratib olishimiz mumkin edi.

en: Strangely enough those pursued did not seem to realize, or at least to care, that they were pursued.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, quvg'in qilinganlar quvg'in qilinishini anglamaydilar yoki hech bo'lmaganda g'amxo'rlik qilishmaydilar.

en: They seemed, however, to hasten with redoubled speed as the sun dropped lower and lower on the mountain tops.
uz: Biroq, quyosh tog'larning tepaliklarida pastga tushayotganda, ular tezlikda ikki baravar tezroq harakat qilishgan.

en: Closer and closer they drew.
uz: Ular yanada yaqinlashdilar.

en: The Professor and I crouched down behind our rock, and held our weapons ready.
uz: Professor va men qo'llarimizni tayyorlab, tosh orqasida yonboshladik.

en: I could see that he was determined that they should not pass.
uz: Uning ular o'tmasligiga qat'iy qaror qilganini ko'rardim.

en: One and all were quite unaware of our presence.
uz: Ularning barchasi bizning borligimizni bilmas edilar.

en: All at once two voices shouted out to, Halt! One was my Jonathan's, raised in a high key of passion.
uz: Birdan ikki ovoz: To'xtating! - deb baqirib yubordi, bittasi jonatanimning, u katta ishtiyoq bilan o'sgan edi.

en: Morris' strong resolute tone of quiet command.
uz: Morrisning kuchli qat'iy va xotirjam qo'mondonligi.

en: The gypsies may not have known the language, but
uz: Giganlar tilni bilmagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ular bu tilni bilmas edilar.

en: there was no mistaking the tone, in whatever tongue the words were spo- ken.
uz: So'zlar qaysi tilda gapirilgan bo'lsa ham, so'z o'z o'rniga o'zgarib ketmadi.

en: Instinctively they reined in, and at the instant Lord Godalming and Jonathan dashed up at one side and Dr.
uz: Ular instinktli ravishda o'zlarining harakatlarini to'xtatishdi va Lord Godalming va Jonatan bir tomonga ko'tarildilar va doktor

en: Morris on the other.
uz: Boshqa tomondan Morris.

en: The leader of the gypsies, a splendid looking fellow who sat his horse like a centaur, waved them back, and in a ﬁerce voice gave to his companions some word to proceed.
uz: Giganlarning boshligʻi, otda centaur kabi oʻtirgan chiroyli yigit, ularni oʻziga qaytardi va shiddatli ovoz bilan qoʻshnilariga davom etish uchun soʻz berdi.

en: They lashed the horses which sprang forward.
uz: Ular orqaga chiqayotgan otlarni to'qnashtirib qo'yishdi.

en: But the four men raised their Winchester riﬂes, and in an unmistakable way commanded them to stop.
uz: Ammo to'rt kishi Winchester o'qlarini ko'tarib, ularga to'xtashga amr berdilar.

en: At the same moment Dr.
uz: Shu paytning o'zida Dr.

en: Van Helsing and I rose behind the rock and pointed our weapons at them.
uz: Van Helsing va men tosh orqasidan turib, qurollarimizni ularga qaratdik.

en: Seeing that they were surrounded the men tightened their reins and drew up.
uz: Odamlar o'zlarining atrofida ekanini ko'rib, o'zlarining qo'llarini qattiq qo'zg'atishdi va ko'tarildilar.

en: The leader turned to them and gave a word at which every man of the gypsy party drew what weapon he carried, knife or pistol,and held himself in readiness to attack.
uz: Lider ularga yuz o'girib, giganlar partiyasidagi har bir kishi o'z qo'lidagi qurolni - pichoqni yoki pichoqni ko'tarib, hujum qilishga tayyor bo'lgan so'zlarni aytdi.

en: Issue was joined in an instant.
uz: Bir lahzada nashrga qo'shildi.

en: The leader, with a quick movement of his rein, threw his horse out in front, and pointed ﬁrst to the sun, now close down on the hill tops, and then to the castle, said something which I did not understand.
uz: Boshliq tez harakat qilib, otini oldinga tashladi va avval quyoshga, keyin tog'ning tepaligidan o'girib, so'ngra qal'aga ishora qilib, men tushunmagan narsani aytdi.

en: For answer, all four men of our party threw themselves from their horses and dashed to- wards the cart.
uz: Javob sifatida, bizning to'rtta odamimiz ham otlaridan o'zlarini tashlab, arava tomon yugurib ketdilar.

en: I should have felt terrible fear at seeing Jonathan in such danger, but that the ardor of battle must have been upon me as well as the rest of them.
uz: Jonatanni bunday xavf ostida ko'rishdan qo'rqishim kerak edi, ammo jangning g'ayrati men va ularning qolganlari ustida bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: I felt no fear, but only a wild, surging desire to do something.
uz: Men hech qanday qo'rquvni his qilmadim, faqat biron bir ish qilish istagi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Seeing the quick movement of our parties, the leader of the gypsies gave a command.
uz: Bizning partiyalarimizning tez harakatlanishini ko'rib, g'iybatchilarning boshlig'i buyruq berdi.

en: His men instantly formed round the cart in a sort of undisci- plined endeavor, each one shouldering and pushing the other in his eager- ness to carry out the order.
uz: Uning odamlari darhol arava atrofida bo'lib, har biri buyrug'ini bajarishga tayyor bo'lib, bir-birini ko'tarib, silkitib turishdi.

en: In the midst of this I could see that Jonathan on one side of the ring of men, and Quincey on the other, were forcing a way to the cart.
uz: Bularning o'rtasida men Jonatanning bir tomondan va Quinceyning boshqa tomondan aravachaga yo'l urishini ko'rardim.

en: It was evi- dent that they were bent on ﬁnishing their task before the sun should set.
uz: Ular o'z vazifasini quyosh botishidan oldin tugatishga qat'iy qaror qilishgan.

en: Nothing seemed to stop or even to hinder them.Neither the levelled weapons nor the ﬂashing knives of the gypsies in front, nor the howling of the wolves behind, appeared to even attract their attention.
uz: Hech narsa ularni to'xtatishga yoki hatto to'sqinlikka tushirishga qodir bo'lmagan.O'ngdagi g'iybatchilarning o'rnatilgan qurollari ham, chaqmoqli pichoqlari ham, orqadagi bo'rilarning qichqiriqlari ham ularning e'tiborini jalb qilmasdi.

en: Jonathan's im- petuosity, and the manifest singleness of his purpose, seemed to overawe those in front of him.
uz: Jonatanning g'ayratliligi va maqsadining aniq birligi uning oldidagilarni ustun qo'yganiga o'xshardi.

en: Instinctively they cowered aside and let him pass.
uz: Ular instinktli ravishda yonma-yon qolib, uni o'tkazib yuborishdi.

en: In an instant he had jumped upon the cart, and with a strength which seemed incredible, raised the great box, and ﬂung it over the wheel to the ground.
uz: Bir lahzada u aravachaga tushib, ajoyib ko'rinadigan kuch bilan katta qutini ko'tarib, velosipedni yerga tashladi.

en: In the meantime, Mr.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Mr.

en: Morris had had to use force to pass through his side of the ring of Szgany.
uz: Morris Szgani borinchasining o'z tomonidan o'tish uchun kuch ishlatishi kerak edi.

en: All the time I had been breathlessly watching Jonathan I had, with the tail of my eye, seen him pressing desperately forward, and had
uz: Yonatanni nafassiz kuzatib yurganimda, uni ko'z o'ngimda ko'rib, umidsizlik bilan oldinga surib yurgan edim va uni ko'rdim.

en: seen the knives of the gypsies ﬂash as he won a way through them, and they cut at him.
uz: G'iyponlarning pichoqlarini ko'rib, u orqali o'tishni boshlaganida, ular unga kesib ketishdi.

en: He had parried with his great bowie knife, and at ﬁrst I thought that he too had come through in safety.
uz: U o'zining katta bowie pichoqlari bilan bahslashdi va dastlab men uning ham xavfsiz o'tganini his qildim.

en: But as he sprang beside Jonathan, who had by now jumped from the cart, I could see that with his left hand he was clutching at his side, and that the blood was spurting through his ﬁn- gers.
uz: Ammo u jang aravachasidan chiqdigan Jonatanning yonida sakrashganda, chap qo'li bilan qo'lini yonidan ushlab turganini va qonni qaniqlari orqali to'sib borayotganini ko'rdim.

en: He did not delay notwithstanding this, for as Jonathan, with desperate energy, attacked one end of the chest, attempting to prize off the lid with his great Kukri knife, he attacked the other frantically with his bowie.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u kechiktirmadi, chunki Jonatan tushkunlikka tushib, ko'krakning bir tomoniga hujum qilib, katta Kukri qilichini qo'lga kiritishga urinib ko'rganida, boshqasini o'z bowi bilan g'alati hujum bilan hujum qildi.

en: Under the efforts of both men the lid began to yield.
uz: Ikkala kishining ham harakatlari dastidan qo'rqinch tushdi.

en: The nails drew with a screeching sound, and the top of the box was thrown back.
uz: Tushlar qichqiriq tovushlari bilan chizildi va qutining yuqori qismi orqaga tashlandi.

en: By this time the gypsies, seeing themselves covered by the Winchesters, and at the mercy of Lord Godalming and Dr.
uz: O'sha paytgacha g'iybatchilar Winchesterlar tomonidan qoplanganini ko'rib, Lord Godalming va doktorning rahm-shafqati ostida qolishgan.

en: Seward, had given in and made no further resistance.
uz: Seward, qochib ketib, boshqa qarshilik ko'rsatmadi.

en: The sun was almost down on the mountain tops, and the shadows of the whole group fell upon the snow.
uz: Togʻlarning tepaliklarida quyosh deyarli botdi va butun guruhning soyasi qor ustiga tushib qoldi.

en: I saw the Count ly- ing within the box upon the earth, some of which the rude falling from the cart had scattered over him.
uz: Men Countni quti ichida yerga yotganini ko'rdim, uning ba'zi qismini aravachadan tushib tushayotgan qo'pol kishilar uning ustiga tarqatgan edi.

en: He was deathly pale, just like a waxen image, and the red eyes glared with the horrible vindictive look which I knew so well.
uz: U o'limdan ko'p oq edi, xuddi shamollangan tasvir kabi, qizil ko'zlar esa men yaxshi bilgan dahshatli qasosli ko'rinish bilan ko'rinardi.

en: As I looked, the eyes saw the sinking sun, and the look of hate in them turned to triumph.
uz: Ko'z o'ngimda, ko'zlarim quyosh botayotganini ko'rdi va ulardan nafrat ko'rinishi g'alabaga aylandi.

en: But, on the instant, came the sweep and ﬂash of Jonathan's great knife.
uz: Ammo, darhol, Jonatanning buyuk qilichining shov-shuvlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: I shrieked as I saw it shear through the throat.
uz: Qolg'imni kesib o'tishini ko'rgach, qichqirdim.

en: Whilst at the same moment Mr.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Mr.

en: Morris's bowie knife plunged into the heart.
uz: Morrisning bowie bo'g'i yuragini o'rab oldi.

en: It was like a miracle, but before our very eyes, and almost in the drawing of a breath, the whole body crumbled into dust and passed from our sight.
uz: Bu bir mo'jiza kabi edi, lekin ko'z oldimizda va deyarli nafas olishda butun tanamiz tuproqga aylanib, ko'zimizdan o'tib ketdi.

en: I shall be glad as long as I live that even in that moment of ﬁnal dissolu- tion, there was in the face a look of peace, such as I never could have imag- ined might have rested there.
uz: Hayotim bo'yi, hatto o'sha oxirgi halok bo'lish paytida ham yuzimda tinchlik ko'rinishi, men hech qachon tasavvur qila olmasdim.

en: The Castle of Dracula now stood out against the red sky, and every stone of its broken battlements was articulated against the light of the setting sun.
uz: Drakulaning qalʼasi endi qizil osmonga qarshi turibdi va uning vayron qilingan qoʻrqinchlarining har bir toshini qorongʻi quyoshning yorugʻligiga qarshi sozladi.

en: The gypsies, taking us as in some way the cause of the extraordinary dis- appearance of the dead man, turned, without a word, and rode away as if for their lives.
uz: Giganlar o'lik odamning noyob ko'rinishiga bizni sababchi deb hisoblab, bir so'z aytmasdan orqaga burildilar va o'z jonlari uchun o'tib ketishdi.

en: Those who were unmounted jumped upon the leiter wagon and shouted to the horsemen not to desert them.
uz: Otsiz qolganlar laiter vagoniga tushib, otliqlarga ularni tark etmasliklarini aytishdi.

en: The wolves, which had with- drawn to a safe distance, followed in their wake, leaving us alone.
uz: Xavfsiz masofada bo'lgan bo'rilar orqasidan ergashib, bizni yolg'iz qoldirishdi.

en: Morris, who had sunk to the ground, leaned on his elbow, holding his hand pressed to his side.
uz: Yerga cho'kkan Morris qo'lini yon tomoniga bosib, qo'liga tayandi.

en: The blood still gushed through his ﬁngers.
uz: Uning qoni hali ham barmoqlaridan oqib turardi.

en: him, for the Holy circle did not now keep me back, so did the two doctors.
uz: U, chunki Muqaddas to'plam meni endi orqaga qaytarmadi, ikkala shifokor ham.

en: Jonathan knelt behind him and the wounded man laid back his head on his shoulder.
uz: Jonatan uning orqasidan tiz cho'kdi va jarohatlangan odam boshini yelkasiga qo'ydi.

en: With a sigh he took, with a feeble effort, my hand in that of his own which was unstained.
uz: O'z qo'limni o'ziga xos qo'lidan olib ketdi, ammo qo'limni o'z qo'lidan olib qo'ydi.

en: He must have seen the anguish of my heart in my face, for he smiled at me and said, I am only too happy to have been of service!
uz: U yuzimda yuragimdagi azobni ko'rgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki u menga tabassum qilib, shunday dedi: Men juda xursandman, chunki men sizga yordam berishga muvaffaq bo'ldim!

en: Oh, God! he cried suddenly, struggling to a sitting posture and pointing to me.
uz: Oh, Xudoyim! - dedi u birdan, o'tirgan bo'lishga harakat qilib, menga ko'rsatdi.

en: It was worth for this to die!
uz: Bu uchun o'lishga arziydi!

en: Look! The sun was now right down upon the mountain top, and the red gleams fell upon my face, so that it was bathed in rosy light.
uz: Mana, quyosh endi tog'ning tepaligida tushdi va qizil chiroqlar yuzimga tushib, rosa nurga cho'mib ketdi.

en: With one impulse the men sank on their knees and a deep and earnest Amen broke from all as their eyes followed the pointing of his ﬁnger.
uz: Bir marta erkaklar tiz cho'kib, ko'zlari uning barmog'ining ko'rsatishiga qarab, chuqur va jiddiy Amin so'zi hammasi bilan bo'lib ketdi.

en: The dying man spoke, Now God be thanked that all has not been in vain!
uz: O'tib ketayotgan kishi gapirdi: Hndi Xudoga shukrki, bularning hammasi behuda bo'lmagan!

en: The snow is not more stainless than her forehead!
uz: Qar uning oldidan ko'ra rangsiz emas!

en: The curse has passed away! And, to our bitter grief, with a smile and in silence, he died, a gallant gentleman.
uz: La'nat o'tib ketdi! - deb, bizlarni og'ir xafa qildi va u, tabassum va jimlik bilan, jasoratli xudojo'y o'ldi.

en: NOTE Seven years ago we all went through the ﬂames.
uz: E'tibor bering, yetti yil oldin biz hammamiz olovdan o'tgan edik.

en: And the happiness of some of us since then is, we think, well worth the pain we endured.
uz: O'shandan beri ba'zilarning baxt-saodatlari biz boshdan kechirgan og'riqlarga arziydi deb o'ylashimiz mumkin.

en: It is an added joy to Mina and to me that our boy's birthday is the same day as that on which Quincey Morris died.
uz: O'g'limizning tug'ilgan kuni Quincey Morris vafot etgan kun bilan bir xil bo'lgani Mina va men uchun katta quvonchdir.

en: His mother holds, I know, the secret belief that some of our brave friend's spirit has passed into him.
uz: Uning onasi, men bilaman, jasoratli do'stimizning ruhi uning ichiga o'tganligiga sirli ishonadi.

en: His bundle of names links all our little band of men together.
uz: Uning ismlar to'plami bizning barcha kichik guruh odamlarimizni birlashtiradi.

en: But we call him Quincey.
uz: Lekin biz unga Quincey deb murojaat qilamiz.

en: In the summer of this year we made a journey to Transylvania, and went over the old ground which was, and is, to us so full of vivid and terrible memories.
uz: Shu yilning yozida biz Transilvaniyaga sayohat qilib, biz uchun juda hayajonli va dahshatli xotiralar bilan to'lgan va hozir ham mavjud bo'lgan eski yerni bosib o'tdik.

en: It was almost impossible to believe that the things which we had seen with our own eyes and heard with our own ears were living truths.
uz: O'z ko'zimiz bilan ko'rgan va o'z quloqlarimiz bilan eshitgan narsalarimiz tirik haqiqatlar ekaniga ishonish deyarli imkonsiz edi.

en: Every trace of all that had been was blotted out.
uz: O'tgan har bir holatning izlari yo'q qilindi.

en: The castle stood as before, reared high above a waste of desolation.
uz: Shahar avvalgidek turib, vayron bo'lib ketgan xonadonning yuqoriga ko'tarilgan edi.

en: When we got home we were talking of the old time, which we could all look back on without despair, for Godalming and Seward are both happily married.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelganimizda, biz eski vaqtlar haqida gapirgan edik, bu vaqtga hech kim umidsizlikka tushmasdi, chunki Godalming va Seward ikkalasi ham baxtli turmush qurgan.

en: I took the papers from the safe where they had been ever since our return so long ago.
uz: Men qog'ozlarni juda uzoq vaqt oldin qaytib kelganimizdan beri saqlangan joydagi sejfdan olib keldim.

en: We were struck with the fact, that in all the mass of ma- terial of which the record is composed, there is hardly one authentic docu- ment.
uz: Bizni taassurot qoldirgan narsa shundaki, ushbu yozuvlar tarkibida mavjud bo'lgan barcha materiallar orasida birgina haqiqiy hujjat ham yo'q.

en: Nothing but a mass of typewriting, except the later notebooks of Mina and Seward and myself, and Van Helsing's memorandum.
uz: Mina va Seward va o'zimning keyingi yozuvlar va Van Helsingning xatboshilaridan boshqa hech narsa yo'q.

en: hardly ask any one, even did we wish to, to accept these as proofs of so wild a story.
uz: Hech kimdan, hatto biz xohlaganimizda ham, bularni bunday yovvoyi hikoyaning isboti sifatida qabul qilishni so'rashni istamaymiz.

en: Van Helsing summed it all up as he said, with our boy on his knee.
uz: Van Helsing o'z so'zlariga ko'ra, o'g'limiz tiz cho'kkan holda hamma narsani qisqartirgan.

en: We ask none to believe us!
uz: Biz hech kimdan bizga ishonishini so'ramaymiz!

en: This boy will some day know what a brave and gallant woman his mother is.
uz: Bu o'g'il bir kun uning onasi qanchalik jasoratli va jasoratli ayol ekanini biladi.

en: Already he knows her sweetness and loving care.
uz: U allaqachon uning shirinligi va mehribon g'amxo'rligini biladi.

en: Later on he will understand how some men so loved her, that they did dare much for her sake.
uz: Keyinchalik u ba'zi erkaklarning uni shunchalik yaxshi ko'rganini va uning uchun ko'p harakat qilganini tushunadi.

en: CHAPTER 1 THE EVE OF THE WAR No one would have believed in the last years of the nineteenth century that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligences greater than man’s and yet as mortal as his own; that as men busied themselves about their various concerns they were scrutinised and studied, perhaps al- most as narrowly as a man with a microscope might scrutinise the transient creatures that swarm and multiply in a drop of water.
uz: 1 - bob Urush kechasida Hech kim o'n to'qqizinchi asrning so'nggi yillarida bu dunyoni insondan katta va o'zining o'zidan ham o'ta o'tkinchi aqlli insonlar diqqat bilan kuzatib borayotganini, odamlar o'z tashvishlari bilan shug'ullanayotganlarida, ular tekshirib ko'rilgan va o'rganilganini, ehtimol, mikroskop bilan odam bir tomchi suvda to'planayotgan va ko'payib borayotgan o'tkinchi mavjudotlarni tekshirib ko'rishi mumkin bo'lganidek, hech kim ishonmagan.

en: With inﬁnite compla- cency men went to and fro over this globe about their little affairs, serene in their assurance of their empire over matter.
uz: Odamlar o'zlarining kichik ishlari haqida cheksiz kamtarlik bilan butun dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilib borishgan, ular o'z imperiyalari ustidan g'alaba qozonishida xotirjam edilar.

en: It is possible that the infusoria under the microscope do the same.
uz: Ehtimol, mikroskop ostidagi infusoriyalar ham xuddi shunday qilishlari mumkin.

en: No one gave a thought to the older worlds of space as sources of human danger, or thought of them only to dis- miss the idea of life upon them as impossible or improbable.
uz: Hech kim qadimgi kosmik olamlarni insoniyat xavfi manbalari deb o'ylamagan yoki ular haqida faqat hayotning mavjudligi haqidagi g'oyani imkonsiz yoki ehtimoldan yiroq deb tan olmagan.

en: It is curious to recall some of the mental habits of those departed days.
uz: O'sha o'tgan kunlarning ba'zi aqliy odatlarini eslab qolish qiziqarli.

en: At most terrestrial men fancied there might be other men upon Mars, perhaps inferior to them- selves and ready to welcome a missionary enterprise.
uz: Aksariyat yer yuzidagi odamlar Marsda boshqa odamlar borligini, ehtimol o'zlaridan kamroq bo'lganlarini va maxsus vaʼzgo'ylik faoliyatini qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lganlarini o'ylashadi.

en: Yet across the gulf of space, minds that are to our minds as ours are to those of the beasts that per- ish, intellects vast and cool and unsympathetic, regarded this earth with en- vious eyes, and slowly and surely drew their plans against us.
uz: Biroq, koʻkdan-koʻkka koʻra, bizning ongimiz kabi onglarimiz ham oʻsha hayvonlarning onglariga ega, keng va sovuq va shafqatsiz onglar, bu yer yuziga gʻayratli koʻzlar bilan qaraydi va asta-sekin bizga qarshi rejalarini tuzadi.

en: And early in the twentieth century came the great disillusionment.
uz: XX asrning boshida esa katta umidsizlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: The planet Mars, I scarcely need remind the reader, revolves about the sun at a mean distance of 140,000,000 miles, and the light and heat it re- ceives from the sun is barely half of that received by this world.
uz: Mars sayyorasi, o'quvchiga eslatishimga hojat yo'q, Quyosh atrofida o'rtacha masofada 140 million mil atrofida aylanadi va u quyoshdan oladigan yorug'lik va issiqlik dunyoning yarmidan kam emas.

en: It must be, if the nebular hypothesis has any truth, older than our world; and long be- fore this earth ceased to be molten, life upon its surface must have begun its course.
uz: Agar bulutli g'oya g'oyasi haqiqat bo'lsa, u bizning dunyomizdan ham qadimroq bo'lishi kerak va uzoq vaqt oldin bu yer erib ketishidan to'xtashi kerak edi, uning yuzasida hayot o'z yo'lini boshlagan bo'lishi kerak.

en: The fact that it is scarcely one seventh of the volume of the earth must have accelerated its cooling to the temperature at which life could be- gin.
uz: Yerning hajmining yettidan bir qismiga teng bo'lgani uning sovuqlanishini hayot uchun qulay bo'lgan haroratga yetkazgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It has air and water and all that is necessary for the support of animated existence.
uz: Uning havo, suv va jonli mavjudot uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsa bor.

en: Yet so vain is man, and so blinded by his vanity, that no writer, up to the very end of the nineteenth century, expressed any idea that intelligent life might have developed there far, or indeed at all, beyond its earthly level.
uz: Biroq, odam o'ta befoyda va befoydaligi uni ko'rishga majbur qildi, shuning uchun o'n to'qqizinchi asrning oxirigacha hech bir yozuvchi o'zining yer yuzidagi darajasiga tashqarida aqlli hayot rivojlangan bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida hech qanday fikr bildirmagan.

en: Nor was it generally understood that since Mars is older than our earth, with scarcely a quarter of the superﬁcial area and remoter from the sun, it neces- sarily follows that it is not only more distant from time’s beginning but nearer its end.
uz: Shuningdek, Mars bizning Yerimizdan kattaroq bo'lgani, uning yuzi to'rtdan bir qismiga teng bo'lgani va Quyoshdan uzoqroq bo'lgani sababli, u nafaqat vaqt boshlanishidan uzoqroq, balki oxiriga ham yaqinroq ekanligi aniq tushunilmagan.

en: The secular cooling that must someday overtake our planet has already gone far indeed with our neighbour.
uz: Bir kuni sayyoramizni bosib o'tishi kerak bo'lgan dunyoviy sovuqlik allaqachon qo'shnimiz bilan uzoq davom etgan.

en: Its physical condition is still largely a mystery, but we know now that even in its equatorial region the midday temperature barely approaches that of our coldest winter.
uz: Uning jismoniy holati hali ham katta darajada sirdir, ammo hozir biz uning ekvatoriya mintaqasida ham kechki paytning haroratining eng sovuq qishimizga oz yaqinlashishini bilamiz.

en: Its air is much more attenuated than ours, its oceans have shrunk until they cover but a third of its surface, and as its slow seasons change huge snowcaps gather and melt about either pole and periodically inundate its temperate zones.
uz: Uning havolari bizning havolarimizdan ancha kamroq, okeanlari uchdan bir qismini o'rab olmaguncha qisqartirilgan va sekin mavsumlar o'zgarishi bilan katta qar qoplamalari to'planadi va har ikki qirg'oq atrofida erib ketadi va vaqti-vaqti bilan o'rtacha zonani suv bilan to'ldiradi.

en: That last stage of exhaustion, which to us is still incredibly remote, has be- come a present-day problem for the inhabitants of Mars.
uz: Biz uchun hali ham juda uzoq bo'lgan bu oxirgi to'sqinlik jarayoni, hozirgi kunda Mars aholisi uchun muammo bo'ldi.

en: The immediate pressure of necessity has brightened their intellects, enlarged their powers, and hardened their hearts.
uz: Darhol zaruratning bosimi ularning aqlini o'zgartirdi, kuchlarini kengaytirdi va qalblarini qattiq qildi.

en: And looking across space with instruments, and intelligences such as we have scarcely dreamed of, they see, at its nearest distance only 35,000,000 of miles sunward of them, a morning star of hope, our own warmer planet, green with vegetation and grey with water, with a cloudy atmosphere eloquent of fertility, with glimpses through its drifting cloud wisps of broad stretches of populous country and narrow, navy- crowded seas.
uz: Va ular o'zlarining kuchlari bilan ko'z o'rab, biz hech qachon tasavvur qilmagan narsalarni va aql-idroklarni ko'rishadi, ular eng yaqin masofada, quyoshdan faqat 35 million kilometr uzoqlikda, umidning ertalabki yulduzini, o'zimizning issiq sayyoramizni ko'rishadi, o'simlik bilan yashil va suv bilan qalin, tug'ishchanlikning bulutli muhitini ko'rishadi.

en: And we men, the creatures who inhabit this earth, must be to them at least as alien and lowly as are the monkeys and lemurs to us.
uz: Va biz odamlar, bu yer yuzida yashovchi mavjudotlar, ular uchun maymonga va lemurlarga o'xshaydigan, hech bo'lmaganda, o'zgacha va kamtarin bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: The intellectu- al side of man already admits that life is an incessant struggle for existence, and it would seem that this too is the belief of the minds upon Mars.
uz: Insonning intellektual tomoni hayot - bu mavjudot uchun doimiy kurash ekanligini tan oladi va bu ham Marsda onglarning e'tiqodiga o'xshaydi.

en: Their world is far gone in its cooling and this world is still crowded with life, but crowded only with what they regard as inferior animals.
uz: Ularning dunyosi sovuq bo'lib ketgan va bu dunyo hali ham hayot bilan to'la, lekin ular uchun kamroq hayvonlar bilan to'la.

en: To carry warfare sunward is, indeed, their only escape from the destruction that, generation after generation, creeps upon them.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, quyoshga qarshi jang qilish - bu ularning nasldan naslga yaqinlashib kelayotgan halokatdan qochishning yagona yo'li.

en: And before we judge of them too harshly we must remember what ruth- less and utter destruction our own species has wrought, not only upon ani- mals, such as the vanished bison and the dodo, but upon its inferior races.
uz: Va biz ularni juda qat'iy hukm qilishimizdan oldin, bizning o'z turimiz nafaqat yo'qolgan bizon va dodo kabi jonzotlarga, balki uning past irqlariga ham qanday halokatga uchratganini esdan chiqarmaylik.

en: The Tasmanians, in spite of their human likeness, were entirely swept out of existence in a war of extermination waged by European immigrants, in the
uz: Tasmaniyaliklar, o'zlarining insoniy o'xshashligiga qaramay, Yevropa muhojirlari tomonidan o'ldirilgan qirg'in urushida butunlay yo'q qilindi.

en: space of ﬁfty years.
uz: Ellik yillik makon.

en: Are we such apostles of mercy as to complain if the Martians warred in the same spirit?
uz: Agar marsiyaliklar xuddi shu ruhda jang qilsalar, biz ham rahmdillikning havoriylari bo'lsak, shikoyat qila olamizmi?

en: The Martians seem to have calculated their descent with amazing subtle- ty—their mathematical learning is evidently far in excess of ours—and to have carried out their preparations with a well-nigh perfect unanimity.
uz: Marsliklar o'zlarining kelib tushishlarini g'ayratli usullar bilan hisoblab chiqishgan bo'lib ko'rinadi- ularning matematik o'rganishi bizning o'zimizdan ancha ustundir va o'z tayyorgarliklarini mukammal bir ovozda amalga oshirgan.

en: Had our instruments permitted it, we might have seen the gathering trouble far back in the nineteenth century.
uz: Agar bizning asbob-uskunalarimiz ruxsat berganida, biz o'n to'qqizinchi asrda bu muammolarning ko'payishini ko'rgan bo'lardik.

en: Men like Schiaparelli watched the red planet —it is odd, by-the-bye, that for countless centuries Mars has been the star of war—but failed to interpret the ﬂuctuating appearances of the markings they mapped so well.
uz: Shiaparelli kabi odamlar qizil sayyorani kuzatib o'tishgan.Qizil sayyorani kuzatib o'tgan kishilar, ko'p asrlar davomida Mars urush yulduzi bo'lib kelganini, ammo ular xarita qilgan belgilarning o'zgaruvchan ko'rinishini yaxshi tushuntirib bermaganini bilish g'alati.

en: All that time the Martians must have been getting ready.
uz: Shu vaqt davomida marsiyaliklar tayyorgarlik ko'rishgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: During the opposition of 1894 a great light was seen on the illuminated part of the disk, ﬁrst at the Salt Lick Observatory, then by Perrotin of Nice, and then by other observers.
uz: 1894 yil muxolifat paytida diskning yorug'langan qismida katta yorug'lik ko'rildi, avval Salt Lick Observatoriyasida, keyinchalik Perrotin Nitsdan, keyin esa boshqa kuzatuvchilar tomonidan.

en: English readers heard of it ﬁrst in the issue of NATURE dated August 2.
uz: Ingliz tilidagi o'quvchilar ilk bor 2 avgustda nashr etilgan NATURE jurnalida bu haqda eshitishgan.

en: I am inclined to think that this blaze may have been the casting of the huge gun, in the vast pit sunk into their planet, from which their shots were ﬁred at us.
uz: Men o'ylashga moyilmanki, bu yong'in ularning sayyoralariga suzib o'tgan katta chuqurlikdagi ulkan qurolni o'tkazish bo'lishi mumkin edi, u yerdan ularning o'qlari bizga o'qilgan edi.

en: Peculiar markings, as yet unexplained, were seen near the site of that outbreak during the next two oppositions.
uz: Keyingi ikki qarshilik paytida bu portlash joyida hali tushuntirilmagan g'alati belgilar ko'rindi.

en: The storm burst upon us six years ago now.
uz: To'fon olti yil oldin boshimizga tushdi.

en: As Mars approached opposi- tion, Lavelle of Java set the wires of the astronomical exchange palpitating with the amazing intelligence of a huge outbreak of incandescent gas upon the planet.
uz: Mars muxolifatga yaqinlashganda, Javalik Lavelle astronomiya almashinuvining simlarini sayyoramizda yoritilgan yondashuvchi gazning ulkan portlashi haqidagi ajoyib aqlli hissiyot bilan palpitatsiya qilishini o'rnatdi.

en: It had occurred towards midnight of the twelfth; and the spectro- scope, to which he had at once resorted, indicated a mass of ﬂaming gas, chieﬂy hydrogen, moving with an enormous velocity towards this earth.
uz: U o'n ikkinchi kechasi yarim kechada sodir bo'lgan va u darhol foydalangan spektroma, olovli gazning, asosan gidrogenning, katta tezlikda yer yuziga qarab harakatlanayotganini ko'rsatgan.

en: This jet of ﬁre had become invisible about a quarter past twelve.
uz: Ushbu yong'in uchib borayotgan joyi soat 15 da ko'rinmay qoldi.

en: He com- pared it to a colossal puff of ﬂame suddenly and violently squirted out of the planet, “as ﬂaming gases rushed out of a gun.” A singularly appropriate phrase it proved.
uz: U buni to'satdan va zo'ravonlik bilan sayyoradan chiqib ketayotgan olovni o'xshatdi, xuddi olovli gazlar o'qadan chiqib ketgandek. Bu o'ziga xos o'rinli so'z edi.

en: Yet the next day there was nothing of this in the papers except a little note in the DAILY TELE- GRAPH, and the world went in ignorance of one of the gravest dangers that ever threatened the human race.
uz: Ammo ertasi kuni gazetalarda bu haqda hech narsa yo'q edi, faqat DAILY TELE-GRAPH gazetasida kichik bir notanish bor edi va dunyo insoniyatni xavf ostiga qo'ygan eng katta xavflardan birini bilmay qoldi.

en: I might not have heard of the eruption at all had I not met Ogilvy, the well-known astronomer, at Ottershaw.
uz: Agar Ottershawda tanilgan astronom Ogilvy bilan uchrashmaganimda, bu portlash haqida umuman eshitmagan bo'lar edim.

en: He was im- mensely excited at the news, and in the excess of his feelings invited me up to take a turn with him that night in a scrutiny of the red planet.
uz: U bu xabarni eshitib juda hayajonlangan edi va o'z his-tuyg'ularidan tashqari meni o'sha kecha o'zi bilan birga qizil sayyorani ko'rib chiqish uchun taklif qildi.

en: In spite of all that has happened since, I still remember that vigil very dis- tinctly: the black and silent observatory, the shadowed lantern throwing a feeble glow upon the ﬂoor in the corner, the steady ticking of the clockwork
uz: O'shandan beri sodir bo'lgan barcha narsalarga qaramay, men o'sha hushyorlikni hali ham juda aniq eslayman: qora va sukut saqlash observatoriyasi, soyasidagi chiroqlar burchakdagi yotoq ustiga chiroyli yorug'lik yuborgan, soatning doimiy tiklanishi

en: of the telescope, the little slit in the roof—an oblong profundity with the stardust streaked across it.
uz: Teleskopning tomidagi kichkina bo'g'i, tomning uzunli chuqurligi, uning ustida yulduz tuprog'i tarqalgan.

en: Ogilvy moved about, invisible but audible.
uz: Ogilvy ko'rinmas, ammo eshitilishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatlarni amalga oshirdi.

en: Looking through the telescope, one saw a circle of deep blue and the little round planet swimming in the ﬁeld.
uz: Teleskop orqali ko'rib turganimizda, chuqur ko'k rangli daraxt va maydonda suzayotgan kichik davra sayyorasi ko'rinardi.

en: It seemed such a little thing, so bright and small and still, faintly marked with transverse stripes, and slightly ﬂat- tened from the perfect round.
uz: U juda kichik, yorqin, kichik va xotirjam bo'lib, o'tkir chiziqlar bilan chiroyli belgilab qo'yilgan va mukammal to'plamdan biroz tekis bo'lgan narsa kabi ko'rinardi.

en: But so little it was, so silvery warm—a pin’s- head of light!
uz: Ammo u juda kam edi, juda kumushli issiq bir pinlar - yorug'lik boshi!

en: It was as if it quivered, but really this was the telescope vi- brating with the activity of the clockwork that kept the planet in view.
uz: Bu xuddi titrayotgandek edi, lekin aslida bu sayyorani ko'rinishda saqlaydigan soatning faolligi bilan hayratda turadigan teleskop edi.

en: As I watched, the planet seemed to grow larger and smaller and to ad- vance and recede, but that was simply that my eye was tired.
uz: Ko'z o'ngimda, sayyora kattaroq va kichiklashib, ko'tarilib-ko'tarilib borayotganini ko'rdim, lekin bu shunchaki ko'zim charchaganini ko'rsatdi.

en: Forty millions of miles it was from us—more than forty millions of miles of void.
uz: U bizdan 40 million mil uzoqroq bo'lgan, 40 million mildan ko'proq bo'shlik bor edi.

en: Few people realise the immensity of vacancy in which the dust of the material universe swims.
uz: Ko'pchilik material olamning tuproqlari suzishayotgan bo'sh joyning kattaligini tushunmaydi.

en: Near it in the ﬁeld, I remember, were three faint points of light, three tele- scopic stars inﬁnitely remote, and all around it was the unfathomable dark- ness of empty space.
uz: Xotira qilamanki, uning yonida nurning uchta yorug' nuqtasi, uchta teleskopik yulduz cheksiz uzoqda edi va atrofida bo'sh joyning tushunarsiz qorong'iligi bor edi.

en: You know how that blackness looks on a frosty starlight night.
uz: Qizil yulduz yorug'i kechasida bu qorong'ilik qanday ko'rinishini bilasiz.

en: In a telescope it seems far profounder.
uz: Teleskopda u ancha chuqurroq ko'rinadi.

en: And invisible to me because it was so remote and small, ﬂying swiftly and steadily towards me across that incredible distance, drawing nearer every minute by so many thousands of miles, came the Thing they were sending us, the Thing that was to bring so much struggle and calamity and death to the earth.
uz: Va men uchun ko'rinmas edi, chunki u juda uzoq va kichik edi, bu ajoyib masofadan tez va qat'iy o'tib, menga yaqinlashib, har bir daqiqada minglab kilometr yaqinlashib borardi, ular bizga yuborayotgan narsa keldi, bu narsa yer yuziga shuncha kurash, baxtsizlik va o'limni keltirib chiqaradi.

en: I never dreamed of it then as I watched; no one on earth dreamed of that unerring missile.
uz: O'shanda men uni ko'rib turganimda hech qachon orzu qilmaganman; yer yuzida hech kim o'sha xato qilmaydigan raketa haqida orzu qilmagan.

en: That night, too, there was another jetting out of gas from the distant plan- et.
uz: O'sha kecha ham uzoqdan boshqa gaz oqib ketgani yuz berdi.

en: A reddish ﬂash at the edge, the slightest projection of the outline just as the chronometer struck midnight; and at that I told Ogilvy and he took my place.
uz: Chronometr yarim tunni tutganida, chekkada qizil-qizil bir chaqmoq paydo bo'ldi va men Ogilvyga aytdim va u mening o'rnimni oldi.

en: The night was warm and I was thirsty, and I went stretching my legs clumsily and feeling my way in the darkness, to the little table where the siphon stood, while Ogilvy exclaimed at the streamer of gas that came out towards us.
uz: Kechasi issiq edi va men chanqadim va men qorong'ilikda oyoqlarimni o'tkirlab, yo'limni his etib, sifon turgan kichkina stolga bordim, Ogilvy esa biz tomon chiqadigan gaz oqishiga qarab baqirib yubordi.

en: That night another invisible missile started on its way to the earth from Mars, just a second or so under twenty-four hours after the ﬁrst one.
uz: O'sha kecha boshqa ko'rinmas raketa Marsdan Yerga yo'l boshladi, bu esa birinchi raketaga yetib kelganidan bir soniya yoki undan kamroq vaqt o'tgach sodir bo'ldi.

en: I re- member how I sat on the table there in the blackness, with patches of green and crimson swimming before my eyes.
uz: O'sha yerda, qorong'ilikda, ko'zlarim oldida yashil va qizil bo'laklar suzib turgan dasturxonda o'tirganimni eslayman.

en: I wished I had a light to smoke by, little suspecting the meaning of the minute gleam I had seen and all that it would presently bring me.
uz: O'zimda chekish uchun yorug'lik bor bo'lsa edi, lekin ko'rgan minut yorug'lik va u menga olib keladigan barcha narsalar haqida hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: Ogilvy watched till one, and then gave it up; and we lit the lantern and walked over to his house.
uz: Ogilvy bir soatgacha kuzatib turdi, keyin ham taslim bo'ldi; biz chiroqni yoqib, uning uyiga bordik.

en: Down below in the darkness
uz: Chiroq ichida pastga tushing

en: were Ottershaw and Chertsey and all their hundreds of people, sleeping in peace.
uz: Ottershaw va Chertsey va ularning yuzlab odamlari tinch uyqusida yotgan edilar.

en: He was full of speculation that night about the condition of Mars, and scoffed at the vulgar idea of its having inhabitants who were signalling us.
uz: O'sha kecha u Marsning holati to'g'risida g'oyalar bilan to'lib-toshgan va uning aholisi bizga signal berayotganini ko'rib masxara qilgan.

en: His idea was that meteorites might be falling in a heavy shower upon the planet, or that a huge volcanic explosion was in progress.
uz: Uning fikri shundaki, planetada kuchli yomg'ir yog'ganda meteoritlar tushib ketishi yoki ulkan vulkanik portlash sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

en: He pointed out to me how unlikely it was that organic evolution had taken the same direction in the two adjacent planets.
uz: U menga organik evolyutsiya ikki yonma-yon sayyorada ham xuddi shu yo'nalishda yuz berishiga hech qanday ishonchim yo'qligini ko'rsatdi.

en: “The chances against anything manlike on Mars are a million to one,” he said.
uz: Marsda erkaklarga o'xshash narsalarga qarshi imkoniyat millionga bir, - dedi u.

en: Hundreds of observers saw the ﬂame that night and the night after about midnight, and again the night after; and so for ten nights, a ﬂame each night.
uz: O'sha kecha yuzlab kuzatuvchilar olovni ko'rishdi, kechasi esa yarim kechada, keyin esa yana o'n kecha davomida olovni ko'rishdi.

en: Why the shots ceased after the tenth no one on earth has attempted to explain.
uz: Nima uchun o'ninchi marta o'qlash to'xtatilganini yer yuzidagi hech kim tushuntirishga urinmagan.

en: It may be the gases of the ﬁring caused the Martians inconve- nience.
uz: Bu o'tishning gazlari bo'lishi mumkin, chunki bu marsiyaliklarning g'alati oqibatlariga sabab bo'lgan.

en: Dense clouds of smoke or dust, visible through a powerful telescope on earth as little grey, ﬂuctuating patches, spread through the clearness of the planet’s atmosphere and obscured its more familiar features.
uz: Yer yuzidagi kuchli teleskop orqali ko'rinadigan katta tutun yoki chang bulutlari kichik griq, o'zgaruvchan maydonchalar sifatida sayyoramiz atmosferaining aniqligi orqali tarqalgan va uning tanish xususiyatlarini yashirgan.

en: Even the daily papers woke up to the disturbances at last, and popular notes appeared here, there, and everywhere concerning the volcanoes upon Mars.
uz: Hatto kunlik gazetalar ham nihoyat buzorani ko'rishdi va bu erda, u erda va har joyda Marsdagi vulqonlar haqida mashhur yozuvlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: The seriocomic periodical PUNCH, I remember, made a happy use of it in the political cartoon.
uz: Shuni eslaymanki, seriokomik periodik PUNCH siyosiy karikaturalarda undan xursandchilik bilan foydalandi.

en: And, all unsuspected, those missiles the Martians had ﬁred at us drew earthward, rushing now at a pace of many miles a sec- ond through the empty gulf of space, hour by hour and day by day, nearer and nearer.
uz: Shu bilan birga, Marsliklarning bizga o'tkazib yuborgan raketalari butunlay yer yuziga qarab, hozirda ko'p millar sekunda bo'sh bo'lgan ko'chma ko'rgazma orqali, soatdan-soat va kundan-kunga yaqinlashib bormoqda.

en: It seems to me now almost incredibly wonderful that, with that swift fate hanging over us, men could go about their petty concerns as they did.
uz: Hozir menga bu juda ajoyib tuyuladi, chunki biz o'zimiz uchun o'sha tezkor taqdirni ko'rib turibmiz, erkaklar o'zlarining kichik muammolarini o'zlarida davom ettirishlari mumkin.

en: I remember how jubilant Markham was at securing a new photograph of the planet for the illustrated paper he edited in those days.
uz: Markham o'sha kunlarda tahrir qilgan rasmli qog'oz uchun sayyoramizning yangi fotosuratini olishda qanchalik xursand bo'lganini eslayman.

en: People in these latter times scarcely realise the abundance and enterprise of our nineteenth- century papers.
uz: Ushbu oxirgi kunlarda odamlar o'n to'qqizinchi asrdagi gazetalarimizning ko'pligi va tadbirkorligi haqida umuman tushunmaydilar.

en: For my own part, I was much occupied in learning to ride the bicycle, and busy upon a series of papers discussing the probable devel- opments of moral ideas as civilisation progressed.
uz: O'zim esa velosiped haydashni o'rganish bilan band edim va sivilizatsiya rivojlanayotgani sayin axloqiy g'oyalarning ehtimoldan yiroq bo'lgan rivojlanishini muhokama qiladigan bir qator maqolalar bilan band edim.

en: One night (the ﬁrst missile then could scarcely have been 10,000,000 miles away) I went for a walk with my wife.
uz: Bir kecha (o'shanda birinchi raketa o'n million mil uzoqlikda bo'lishi mumkin edi) rafiqam bilan yurishga ketdim.

en: It was starlight and I explained the Signs of the Zodiac to her, and pointed out Mars, a bright dot of light creeping zenithward, towards which so many telescopes were pointed.
uz: Yulduz yorug'ligi edi va men unga Zodiakning belgilarini tushuntirib, Marsni ko'rsatib berdim, u yerga ko'plab teleskoplar ko'rsatilgan, shiddatli yorug'lik to'plamidir.

en: It was a warm night.
uz: Issiq kecha edi.

en: Coming home, a party of excursionists from Chertsey or Isleworth passed us singing and playing music.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelayotganda Chertsey yoki Isleworthdan kelgan sayohatchilar guruhi bizni kuylab, musiqa o'ynash bilan o'tib o'tdi.

en: There were lights in the up-
uz: Yuqorida yorug'lik bor edi.

en: per windows of the houses as the people went to bed.
uz: Odamlar uxlashga ketayotganda uylarning derazalari bo'yicha.

en: From the railway sta- tion in the distance came the sound of shunting trains, ringing and rum- bling, softened almost into melody by the distance.
uz: Uzoqda joylashgan temir yo'l stantsiyasidan poyezdlarning qichqiriqlari, qichqiriqlari va qichqiriqlarining ovozi eshitildi, uzoqlikda deyarli haroratga aylandi.

en: My wife pointed out to me the brightness of the red, green, and yellow signal lights hanging in a framework against the sky.
uz: Xotinim menga osmonga qarshi bo'lgan ramkada osilgan qizil, yashil va sariq signal chiroqlarining yorug'ligini ko'rsatdi.

en: It seemed so safe and tranquill.
uz: Bu juda xavfsiz va xotirjam ko'rinardi.

en: CHAPTER 2 THE FALLING STAR Then came the night of the ﬁrst falling star.
uz: 2 - bob Yulduz qulashi Keyin birinchi qulagan yulduz kechasi keldi.

en: It was seen early in the morn- ing, rushing over Winchester eastward, a line of ﬂame high in the at- mosphere.
uz: U erta tongda Winchesterni sharqqa surib borgan holda ko'rindi, bu havo atmosferasidagi olovni ko'tarib turadi.

en: Hundreds must have seen it, and taken it for an ordinary falling star.
uz: Yuzlab odamlar uni ko'rib, oddiy quyib ketayotgan yulduz deb o'ylashgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Albin described it as leaving a greenish streak behind it that glowed for some seconds.
uz: Albin uni o'z orqasida yashil rangni qoldirib, bir necha soniya davomida yoritib ketgan deb tasvirlagan.

en: Denning, our greatest authority on meteorites, stated that the height of its ﬁrst appearance was about ninety or one hundred miles.
uz: Meteoritlar bo'yicha bizning eng buyuk muallimimiz Denning, uning birinchi ko'rinishi balandligi taxminan to'qqiz yoki yuz milni tashkil etganini aytdi.

en: It seemed to him that it fell to earth about one hundred miles east of him.
uz: Unga u undan bir yuz kilometr sharqda yerga tushib ketgan bo'lib tuyuldi.

en: I was at home at that hour and writing in my study; and although my French windows face towards Ottershaw and the blind was up (for I loved in those days to look up at the night sky), I saw nothing of it.
uz: Men o'sha vaqtda uyda edim va o'zimning studiyamda yozgan edim; mening frantsuz oynalarim Ottershawga qaragan bo'lsa-da, ko'rlar ko'tarilgan edi (chunki men o'sha kunlarda kecha osmonini ko'rishni yaxshi ko'rardim), lekin men hech narsa ko'rmadim.

en: Yet this strangest of all things that ever came to earth from outer space must have fallen while I was sitting there, visible to me had I only looked up as it passed.
uz: Ammo kosmosdan yerga kelgan eng g'ayrioddiy narsa, men o'tirgan paytimda yerga tushdi, agar uni o'tayotgan paytimda ko'rishim mumkin edi.

en: Some of those who saw its ﬂight say it travelled with a hissing sound.
uz: Uning parvozini ko'rganlarning ba'zilari uning shishqiriq ovozi bilan sayohat qilganini aytishadi.

en: I myself heard nothing of that.
uz: O'zim bu haqda hech narsa eshitmaganman.

en: Many people in Berkshire, Surrey, and Middlesex must have seen the fall of it, and, at most, have thought that another meteorite had descended.
uz: Berkshyer, Surrey va Middlesexdagi ko'plab odamlar uning tushib ketishini ko'rishgan bo'lishi kerak va, eng ko'p hollarda, yana bir meteorit tushib ketgani haqida o'ylashgan.

en: No one seems to have troubled to look for the fallen mass that night.
uz: O'sha kecha hech kim o'lgan jonni qidirishga qiynalib ketmagan.

en: But very early in the morning poor Ogilvy, who had seen the shooting star and who was persuaded that a meteorite lay somewhere on the common between Horsell, Ottershaw, and Woking, rose early with the idea of ﬁnding it.
uz: Ammo ertalab juda erta tongda g'alati Ogilvy, u o'tib ketayotgan yulduzni ko'rgan va Horsell, Ottershaw va Woking o'rtasidagi umumiy joyda meteorit joylashganligiga amin bo'lgan edi.

en: Find it he did, soon after dawn, and not far from the sand pits.
uz: U buni yorug'likdan ko'p o'tmay topdi va qum quduqlaridan uzoq emas.

en: An enor- mous hole had been made by the impact of the projectile, and the sand and gravel had been ﬂung violently in every direction over the heath, forming heaps visible a mile and a half away.
uz: O'g'ilning ta'qibidan katta cho'l ochildi va qum va qirg'o'l har tomonga ko'tarilgan bo'lib, bir yarim mil masofada ko'rinadigan to'plamlar hosil bo'ldi.

en: The heather was on ﬁre eastward, and a thin blue smoke rose against the dawn.
uz: Chiroq sharq tomon yonayotgan edi va tongga qaraganda bir oz ko'k tutun ko'tarilgan edi.

en: The Thing itself lay almost entirely buried in sand, amidst the scattered splinters of a ﬁr tree it had shivered to fragments in its descent.
uz: Bu narsa deyarli to'liq qumda yotgan edi, u tushayotganda titragan bir fir daraxtining tarqalib ketgan bo'laklari orasida.

en: ered part had the appearance of a huge cylinder, caked over and its outline softened by a thick scaly dun-coloured incrustation.
uz: Bu qism katta silinderga o'xshaydi, uni to'plab qo'yilgan va uning konturlari qalin mayda rangli qalinlik bilan yumshatilgan.

en: It had a diameter of about thirty yards.
uz: Uning diametri taxminan o'ttiz metr edi.

en: He approached the mass, surprised at the size and more so at the shape, since most meteorites are rounded more or less completely.
uz: U o'lchamidan va shaklidan hayron bo'lib, massiga yaqinlashdi, chunki aksariyat meteoritlar ko'proq yoki kamroq to'liq yuziga aylangan.

en: It was, however, still so hot from its ﬂight through the air as to forbid his near approach.
uz: Biroq, u havo bo'ylab uchganidan keyin ham juda issiq bo'lib, uning yaqinlashishiga to'sqinlik qildi.

en: A stirring noise within its cylinder he ascribed to the un- equal cooling of its surface; for at that time it had not occurred to him that it might be hollow.
uz: Uning silindridagi shovqin tovushini u uning yuzasining tengsiz sovutishidan sabab deb hisoblaydi; chunki o'sha paytda uning tuxumli bo'lishi haqida o'ylamagan edi.

en: He remained standing at the edge of the pit that the Thing had made for itself, staring at its strange appearance, astonished chieﬂy at its unusual shape and colour, and dimly perceiving even then some evidence of design in its arrival.
uz: U, Buyum o'zi uchun yaratgan chuqurning chegarasida turib, uning g'ayrioddiy ko'rinishini ko'rib, asosan uning noyob shakli va rangidan hayron qoldi va hatto u erda ham biron-bir dizayn dalillarini ko'rib, o'ziga ko'rinmay qoldi.

en: The early morning was wonderfully still, and the sun, just clearing the pine trees towards Weybridge, was already warm.
uz: Erta tong chiroyli susaygan edi va quyosh nurli bo'lib, nurli daraxtlarni Weybridge yo'li bilan tozalab, endi issiq bo'lgan edi.

en: He did not remember hearing any birds that morning, there was certainly no breeze stirring, and the only sounds were the faint movements from within the cin- dery cylinder.
uz: U o'sha kuni ertalab qushlarni eshitganini eslay olmagan, chindan ham shamol harakatlanmagan va yagona tovushlar kinosilindr ichidagi salqin harakatlar edi.

en: He was all alone on the common.
uz: O'sha yerda u yolg'iz edi.

en: Then suddenly he noticed with a start that some of the grey clinker, the ashy incrustation that covered the meteorite, was falling off the circular edge of the end.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan shuni payqadiki, meteoritni qoplagan griz klinkerning bir qismi, atrofning aylanchli bo'yiga tushib ketayotganini payqadi.

en: It was dropping off in ﬂakes and raining down upon the sand.
uz: U cho'g'alarga aylanib, qum ustiga yomg'ir yog'ardi.

en: A large piece suddenly came off and fell with a sharp noise that brought his heart into his mouth.
uz: Toʻsatdan katta boʻlak tushib, ogʻziga yuragini tushirgan oʻtkir shovqin bilan qulab tushdi.

en: For a minute he scarcely realised what this meant, and, although the heat was excessive, he clambered down into the pit close to the bulk to see the Thing more clearly.
uz: U bir daqiqa davomida bu nimani anglatishini anglab yetmadi va issiqlik juda ko'p bo'lsa-da, u bu narsani yanada aniqroq ko'rish uchun to'plamga yaqin bo'lgan chuqurlikka tushdi.

en: He fancied even then that the cooling of the body might account for this, but what disturbed that idea was the fact that the ash was falling only from the end of the cylinder.
uz: U hatto o'sha paytda ham tanasining sovuqligi buning sababini aytishi mumkin deb o'ylagan edi, ammo bu fikrni buzib qo'ygan narsa esa ashlarning faqat silindrning oxiridan tushib ketishi edi.

en: And then he perceived that, very slowly, the circular top of the cylinder was rotating on its body.
uz: Keyin u silindrning aylanarli yuqori qismining uning tanasi ustida juda sekin aylanib borayotganini payqadi.

en: It was such a gradual movement that he discovered it only through noticing that a black mark that had been near him ﬁve min- utes ago was now at the other side of the circumference.
uz: Bu juda bosqichma-bosqich harakat edi, uni u faqat besh daqiqa oldin uning yonida bo'lgan qora nuqta endi atrofning boshqa tomoniga ko'targanini payqash orqali topdi.

en: Even then he scarcely understood what this indicated, until he heard a mufﬂed grating sound and saw the black mark jerk forward an inch or so.
uz: Hatto o'shanda ham u bu nimani anglatishini anglab yetmadi, lekin o'sha paytgacha o'zi to'xtatilgan qovurish ovozini eshitib, qora belgi bir santimetr yoki undan ko'proq oldinga shovqin qilganini ko'rdi.

en: Then the thing came upon him in a ﬂash.
uz: So'ngra u o'ziga to'g'ri keldi.

en: The cylinder was artiﬁcial—hollow—with an end that screwed out!
uz: Silindr sun'iy bo'lgan va oxirida buzilib ketgan!

en: Something within the cylinder was unscrewing the top!
uz: Silindr ichidagi biror narsa yuqori qismini o'chirib yuborgan edi!

en: “Good heavens!” said Ogilvy.
uz: Good heaven! dedi Ogilvy.

en: “There’s a man in it—men in it!
uz: Uda erkak bor!Uda erkaklar bor!

en: Half roasted to death!
uz: O'limga qadar yarim qovurilgan!

en: At once, with a quick mental leap, he linked the Thing with the ﬂash upon Mars.
uz: O'sha zahoti, tezda fikrlash tarzi bilan, u Ushbu narsani Marsdagi chaqmoq bilan bog'ladi.

en: The thought of the conﬁned creature was so dreadful to him that he for- got the heat and went forward to the cylinder to help turn.
uz: O'sha tuzilgan mavjudot haqida o'ylash unga shunchalik dahshatli bo'lganki, u issiqlikni olib, silindrga o'tishga yordam berish uchun oldinga bordi.

en: But luckily the dull radiation arrested him before he could burn his hands on the still-glow- ing metal.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, o'z qo'llarini hali parcha-parcha metallga yonib yuborishidan oldin, uni chiroyli radiatsiya ushlab qoldi.

en: At that he stood irresolute for a moment, then turned, scrambled out of the pit, and set off running wildly into Woking.
uz: U bir muncha vaqt qat'iy turdi, so'ngra o'girilib, chuqurlikdan chiqib, yovvoyilik bilan Wokingga yugurdi.

en: The time then must have been somewhere about six o’clock.
uz: O'sha paytda soat olti atrofida bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: He met a waggoner and tried to make him understand, but the tale he told and his appearance were so wild —his hat had fallen off in the pit— that the man simply drove on.
uz: U bir vagonchi bilan uchrashdi va uni tushunishga undadi, lekin u aytib bergan hikoya va uning tashqi ko'rinishi shunchalik yovvoyi bo'lganki, uning to'pkasi cho'lda tushib qolgan ediki, u kishi shunchaki mashinada o'tib ketdi.

en: He was equally unsuccessful with the potman who was just unlocking the doors of the public-house by Horsell Bridge.
uz: U Horsell ko'prisi bo'yida joylashgan jamoat xonadonining eshiklarini ochib o'tirgan maydonchi bilan ham muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan.

en: The fellow thought he was a lunatic at large and made an unsuccessful attempt to shut him into the taproom.
uz: U o'zini aqldan ozgan odam deb o'ylagan va uni taproomga qamab qo'yish uchun muvaffaqiyatsiz harakat qilgan.

en: That sobered him a little; and when he saw Henderson, the London journalist, in his garden, he called over the palings and made himself understood.
uz: Bu uni biroz aqldan ozdirdi va Londondagi jurnalist Xendersonni bog'ida ko'rganida, u o'z o'rnida o'tirganlarni chaqirib, o'zini tushunishga undadi.

en: “Henderson,” he called, “you saw that shooting star last night?” “Well?” said Henderson.
uz: Henderson, - deb qo'ng'iroq qildi u. - Siz o'tgan kecha o'tgan yulduzni ko'rdingizmi?

en: “It’s out on Horsell Common now.” “Good Lord!” said Henderson.
uz: Its out on Horsell Common now. Good Lord! dedi Henderson.

en: That’s good.” “But it’s something more than a meteorite.
uz: Bu yaxshi.   Ammo bu meteoritdan ko'ra ko'proq narsa.

en: It’s a cylinder—an artiﬁcial cylinder, man!
uz: Bu sun'iy silindr bo'lgan, yigit!

en: And there’s something inside.” Henderson stood up with his spade in his hand.
uz: Va ichkarida bir narsa bor. Henderson o'z qo'lida o'qini olib turdi.

en: “What’s that?” he said.
uz: Bu nima? - dedi u.

en: He was deaf in one ear.
uz: U bir quloqdan kar edi.

en: Ogilvy told him all that he had seen.
uz: Ogilvy unga ko'rganlarining barchasini aytib berdi.

en: Henderson was a minute or so tak- ing it in.
uz: Henderson bir daqiqa o'tgach uni o'ziga jalb qildi.

en: Then he dropped his spade, snatched up his jacket, and came out into the road.
uz: So'ngra o'z qilichini tashladi, kiyimini olib, yo'lga chiqdi.

en: The two men hurried back at once to the common, and found the cylinder still lying in the same position.
uz: Ikkala kishi darhol odat tusiga qaytib borishdi va silindr hali ham o'sha joyda yotganini topishdi.

en: But now the sounds inside had ceased, and a thin circle of bright metal showed between the top and the body of the cylinder.
uz: Ammo endi ichkaridagi tovushlar to'xtadi va silindrning yuqori qismi va tanasi o'rtasida yorqin metallning chekkasi paydo bo'ldi.

en: Air was either entering or escaping at the rim with a thin, sizzling sound.
uz: Havo o'z ichiga kirib yoki o'zidan chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: They listened, rapped on the scaly burnt metal with a stick, and, meeting with no response, they both concluded the man or men inside must be in- sensible or dead.
uz: Ular tinglashdi, cho'g'li yondirilgan metallga cho'g' bilan raplashdi va hech qanday javobsiz uchrashgan holda ikkalasi ham ichidagi odam yoki erkaklar aqldan ozgan yoki o'lgan bo'lishi kerak degan xulosaga kelishdi.

en: Of course the two were quite unable to do anything.
uz: Albatta, ikkalasi ham hech narsa qila olmagan.

en: They shouted conso- lation and promises, and went off back to the town again to get help.
uz: Ular tasalli va va'dalarni baqirib, yordam so'rab shaharga qaytishdi.

en: One can imagine them, covered with sand, excited and disordered, running up the little street in the bright sunlight just as the shop folks were taking down
uz: Ular qum bilan qoplangan, g'ayratli va tartibsiz bo'lib, do'kon egalari quvib ketayotganda, quyosh nurida ko'chaga yugurib ketayotganini tasavvur qilish mumkin.

en: their shutters and people were opening their bedroom windows.
uz: O'z ob'ektlari va odamlar o'z yotoqxonalarining oynalarini ochib turishgan.

en: Henderson went into the railway station at once, in order to telegraph the news to Lon- don.
uz: Henderson o'sha zahoti temir yo'l stantsiyasiga bordi va yangilikni Lon-donga telegraflashdi.

en: The newspaper articles had prepared men’s minds for the reception of the idea.
uz: Gazeta maqolalari odamlarning ongini ushbu g'oyani qabul qilish uchun tayyorlagan edi.

en: By eight o’clock a number of boys and unemployed men had already started for the common to see the “dead men from Mars.” That was the form the story took.
uz: Sekin soatgacha bir qator o'g'illar va ishsiz erkaklar Marsdan o'lgan odamlarni ko'rish uchun oddiy odamlarga yo'l ochib berishdi. Bu hikoyaning shakli edi.

en: I heard of it ﬁrst from my newspaper boy about a quar- ter to nine when I went out to get my DAILY CHRONICLE.
uz: Men birinchi bor gazeta yigitimdan to'qqiz soatdan to'qqiz soatgacha kunlik xronikamni olish uchun tashqariga chiqqanimda eshitgan edim.

en: I was naturally startled, and lost no time in going out and across the Ottershaw bridge to the sand pits.
uz: Tabiiyki, men qo'rqib ketdim va Ottershaw ko'prisi orqali qum quduqlariga chiqishga vaqt o'tkazmadim.

en: CHAPTER 3 ON HORSELL COMMON I found a little crowd of perhaps twenty people surrounding the huge hole in which the cylinder lay.
uz: 3 - bob AGO'NING O'TIMIGA QO'YILGAN O'ZIMGA O'TIMLIK TAShQIM O'ZIMGA TAShQIM O'TIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShQIM TAShIM TAShQIM TAShIM TAShQIM TAShIM TASh TAShIM TAShIM TASh TAShQIM TASh TAShIM TASh TASh

en: I have already described the appearance of that colossal bulk, embedded in the ground.
uz: Men allaqachon yer yuziga o'rnatib qo'yilgan bu ulkan to'plamning ko'rinishini tasvirladim.

en: The turf and gravel about it seemed charred as if by a sudden explosion.
uz: Uning atrofidagi o't va qirg'oq xuddi to'satdan portlash tufayli yoqilgan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: No doubt its impact had caused a ﬂash of ﬁre.
uz: Shubhasizki, uning ta'siridan yong'in chaqmoqlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: Henderson and Ogilvy were not there.
uz: Henderson va Ogilvy u yerda yo'q edi.

en: I think they perceived that nothing was to be done for the present, and had gone away to breakfast at Henderson’s house.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ular hozircha hech narsa qilolmasligini tushunib, Hendersonning uyiga kechki ovqatga ketishdi.

en: There were four or ﬁve boys sitting on the edge of the Pit, with their feet dangling, and amusing themselves—until I stopped them—by throwing stones at the giant mass.
uz: To'rt yoki besh o'g'il o'sha chuqurning chegaralarida o'tirib, oyoqlari oshib, o'zlarini o'yin-kulgi qilib o'tirgan edilar, men esa ulkan olomonga tosh tashlab, ularni to'xtatdim.

en: After I had spoken to them about it, they began playing at “touch” in and out of the group of bystanders.
uz: Men ular bilan bu haqda gaplashgandan so'ng, ular tomoshabinlar guruhiga kirgan va chiqgan joylarda touch bilan o'ynashni boshlashdi.

en: Among these were a couple of cyclists, a jobbing gardener I employed sometimes, a girl carrying a baby, Gregg the butcher and his little boy, and two or three loafers and golf caddies who were accustomed to hang about the railway station.
uz: Bular orasida bir nechta velosipedchi, ba'zan men ishlaydigan bog'bon, chaqaloq ko'tarib yurgan qiz, go'shtchi Gregg va uning kichkina o'g'li, shuningdek, poezd stantsiyasida to'xtab turadigan ikki yoki uchta golfchi va golf kaddi bor edi.

en: There was very little talking.
uz: U yerda juda kam gap-so'z bo'lgan.

en: Few of the common peo- ple in England had anything but the vaguest astronomical ideas in those days.
uz: Angliyadagi oddiy odamlar orasida o'sha davrdagi eng noaniq astronomik g'oyalardan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: Most of them were staring quietly at the big table like end of the cylinder, which was still as Ogilvy and Henderson had left it.
uz: Ularning aksariyati Ogilvy va Henderson tashlab ketgan katta stolga, xuddi silindrning oxiri kabi, sekin-sekin qarab turishgan.

en: I fancy the popular expectation of a heap of charred corpses was disappointed at this inanimate bulk.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ko'pchilikning ko'plab yoqilgan jasadlar to'plamini kutib olgani bu jonsiz to'plamdan norozi bo'lgan.

en: Some went away while I was there, and other people came.
uz: Men u yerda bo'lganimda, ba'zilari ketib ketishdi, ba'zilari esa keldi.

en: I clambered into the pit and fancied I heard a faint movement under my feet.
uz: Oʻzimni chuqurlikka chiqib, oyoqlarim ostida bir kamon harakatni eshitganimni his qildim.

en: The top had certainly ceased to rotate.
uz: Yuqori qism aylanishni to'xtatgan.

en: It was only when I got thus close to it that the strangeness of this object was at all evident to me.
uz: O'zim bunga shunchalik yaqin bo'lganimdagina, bu ob'ektning g'ayrioddiyligi menga aniq ko'rindi.

en: At the ﬁrst glance it was really no more exciting than an overturned carriage or a tree blown across the road.
uz: Bir qarashda bu aslida burilgan vagon yoki yo'l bo'ylab cho'kkan daraxtdan ko'ra hayajonli emas edi.

en: Not so much so, indeed.
uz: Aslida, shunchalik emas.

en: It looked like a rusty gas ﬂoat.
uz: Bu o'qilgan gaz suzib o'tadigan suvga o'xshardi.

en: It required a certain amount of scien- tiﬁc education to perceive that the grey scale of the Thing was no common
uz: Bu mavjudotning griys miqyosining keng tarqalmaganligini tushunish uchun ma'lum miqdorda ilmiy ta'lim talab etiladi

en: oxide, that the yellowish-white metal that gleamed in the crack between the lid and the cylinder had an unfamiliar hue.
uz: Oksid, qadoq va silindr o'rtasidagi bo'g'riqda shishayotgan sariq-oq metallning tanish bo'lmagan rangga ega bo'lganligi.

en: “Extra-terrestrial” had no mean- ing for most of the onlookers.
uz: Tashkilonlarning aksariyati uchun yerdan tashqarilar hech qanday ma'noga ega emas edi.

en: At that time it was quite clear in my own mind that the Thing had come from the planet Mars, but I judged it improbable that it contained any living creature.
uz: O'shanda bu narsa Mars sayyorasidan kelganligi mening fikrimda aniq edi, ammo u yerda biron bir jonzot mavjud bo'lishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas deb o'ylardim.

en: I thought the unscrewing might be automatic.
uz: Men o'yladimki, bu avtomatik bo'lishi mumkin.

en: In spite of Ogilvy, I still believed that there were men in Mars.
uz: Ogilvyga qaramay, men hali ham Marsda odamlar borligiga ishonardim.

en: My mind ran fancifully on the possibilities of its containing manuscript, on the difﬁculties in translation that might arise, whether we should ﬁnd coins and models in it, and so forth.
uz: Mening ongim o'z ichiga olgan qo'lyozmalarning imkoniyatlari, tarjima qilishda paydo bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan qiyinchiliklar, unda tanga va modellar topishimiz kerakmi va hokazolar haqida o'ylashdi.

en: Yet it was a little too large for assurance on this idea.
uz: Ammo bu g'oya haqida ishonchga ega bo'lish uchun u biroz katta edi.

en: I felt an impa- tience to see it opened.
uz: Men uni ochishni ko'rish uchun o'zimni juda xohladim.

en: About eleven, as nothing seemed happening, I walked back, full of such thought, to my home in Maybury.
uz: Taxminan soat 11 da hech narsa sodir bo'lmagandek tuyulgani uchun men o'zimni Mayburydagi uyimga qaytdim.

en: But I found it difﬁcult to get to work upon my abstract investigations.
uz: Ammo abstrakt tadqiqotlarimni amalga oshirish qiyin kechdi.

en: In the afternoon the appearance of the common had altered very much.
uz: Tush paytida oddiy odamning ko'rinishi juda o'zgarib ketdi.

en: The early editions of the evening papers had startled London with enormous headlines: “A MESSAGE RECEIVED FROM MARS.” “REMARKABLE STORY FROM WOKING,” and so forth.
uz: Kechki gazetalarning dastlabki nashrlari Londonni ulkan bosh sahifalar bilan hayratda qoldirdi: Marsdan kelgan xabar. Uyg'onishdan o'zgacha hikoya, va hokazolar.

en: In addition, Ogilvy’s wire to the Astronomical Exchange had roused every observatory in the three kingdoms.
uz: Bundan tashqari, Ogilvyning Astronomik almashinuviga yuborilgan telegramasi uchta shohlikning har bir observatoriyasini uyg'otdi.

en: There were half a dozen ﬂies or more from the Woking station standing in the road by the sand pits, a basket-chaise from Chobham, and a rather lordly carriage.
uz: Woking stantsiyasidan kelgan yarim o'nlab piyoz yoki undan ko'p kishi qum quduqlari yonida yo'lda turardi, Chobhamdan bir koshcha va bir nechta qudratli vagon bor edi.

en: Besides that, there was quite a heap of bicycles.
uz: Bundan tashqari, juda ko'p velosipedlar ham bor edi.

en: In addition, a large number of people must have walked, in spite of the heat of the day, from Woking and Chertsey, so that there was altogether quite a considerable crowd—one or two gaily dressed ladies among the others.
uz: Bundan tashqari, kunning issiqligiga qaramay, Woking va Chertsey shahridan ko'plab odamlar yurgan bo'lishi kerak edi, shuning uchun boshqalarning orasida juda katta xaloyiq bor edi.

en: It was glaringly hot, not a cloud in the sky nor a breath of wind, and the only shadow was that of the few scattered pine trees.
uz: U juda issiq edi, osmonda bulut ham, shamol ham yo'q edi, yagona soya esa bir necha tarqalgan cho'g'lar daraxtining soyasi edi.

en: The burning heather had been extinguished, but the level ground towards Ottershaw was black- ened as far as one could see, and still giving off vertical streamers of smoke.
uz: Yolg'izayotgan o'simlik o'chirib ketibdi, ammo Ottershawga qaray bo'lgan tekis yer ko'rinadigan darajada qora bo'lib, hali ham vertikal tutun oqimlarini chiqarib turardi.

en: An enterprising sweet-stuff dealer in the Chobham Road had sent up his son with a barrow-load of green apples and ginger beer.
uz: Chobham yo'lidagi shirinlik savdogari o'g'lini yashil olmalar va zambir pivalari bilan olib keldi.

en: Going to the edge of the pit, I found it occupied by a group of about half a dozen men—Henderson, Ogilvy, and a tall, fair-haired man that I after- wards learned was Stent, the Astronomer Royal, with several workmen wielding spades and pickaxes.
uz: O'sha cho'g'ning chegarasiga yetib borganimda, uni yarim o'nlab odamlardan iborat guruh egallab olganini ko'rdim.Henderson, Ogilvy va baland, chiroyli sochli kishi, men keyinchalik bilganimcha, Stent, Astronom Royal edi.

en: Stent was giving directions in a clear, high- pitched voice.
uz: Stent aniq, baland ovoz bilan yo'nalishlarni berayotgan edi.

en: He was standing on the cylinder, which was now evidently
uz: U silindr ustida turgan edi, hozir esa bu silindr ko'rinardi.

en: much cooler; his face was crimson and streaming with perspiration, and something seemed to have irritated him.
uz: Uning yuzi qizil va ter bilan to'lib-toshgan edi va bir narsa uni g'azabga soladi.

en: A large portion of the cylinder had been uncovered, though its lower end was still embedded.
uz: Silindrning katta qismi kashf etilgan edi, ammo uning pastki qismi hali ham o'rnatilgan edi.

en: As soon as Ogilvy saw me among the staring crowd on the edge of the pit he called to me to come down, and asked me if I would mind going over to see Lord Hilton, the lord of the manor.
uz: Ogilvy meni quduq bo'yida turgan ko'pchilik orasida ko'rganidan so'ng, pastga tushishimni so'radi va uy egasi Lord Hiltonni ko'rishga borishim mumkinmi deb so'radi.

en: The growing crowd, he said, was becoming a serious impediment to their excavations, especially the boys.
uz: Uning aytishicha, ko'payib borayotgan xaloyiq qazish ishlarida, ayniqsa, o'g'illarda jiddiy to'siq bo'lib qoldi.

en: They wanted a light railing put up, and help to keep the people back.
uz: Ular odamlar orqaga qaytishiga yordam berish uchun yorug' parchalar o'rnatishni xohlashdi.

en: He told me that a faint stirring was occasion- ally still audible within the case, but that the workmen had failed to un- screw the top, as it afforded no grip to them.
uz: U menga biroz o'zgarib qolganini aytdi- ammo ishchilar o'zlarining qo'lga olishlariga imkon bermagani sababli, ustiga o'zgarib o'tishga muvaffaq bo'lmagani haqida aytdi.

en: The case appeared to be enor- mously thick, and it was possible that the faint sounds we heard represented a noisy tumult in the interior.
uz: Jamoat juda katta bo'lib ko'rinardi va biz eshitgan so'zlar ichki joydagi shovqinli shovqinni ifodalashi mumkin edi.

en: I was very glad to do as he asked, and so become one of the privileged spectators within the contemplated enclosure.
uz: Men uning so'roviga quloq solganimdan xursand bo'ldim va shu yo'sin, o'ylayotgan ob'ektning imtiyozli tomoshabinlaridan biri bo'ldim.

en: I failed to ﬁnd Lord Hilton at his house, but I was told he was expected from London by the six o’clock train from Waterloo; and as it was then about a quarter past ﬁve, I went home, had some tea, and walked up to the station to waylay him.
uz: Lord Xiltonni uning uyida topolmadim, lekin unga Uaterloo shahridan olti soatdagi poyezdda Londondan kutilayotganini aytishdi; o'sha paytda soat beshdan to'rt o'ttiz atrofida bo'lgani uchun uyga qaytib, choy ichdim va uni yo'ldan ozdirish uchun stantsiyaga bordim.

en: CHAPTER 4 THE CYLINDER OPENS When I returned to the common the sun was setting.
uz: 4 - bob Silindr ochiladi Men o'zimni normal holatga qaytarganimda, quyosh botib ketayotgan edi.

en: Scattered groups were hurrying from the direction of Woking, and one or two persons were return- ing.
uz: Uzoq guruhlar Woking yo'nalishidan shoshilmoqda va bir yoki ikki kishi qaytib bormoqda.

en: The crowd about the pit had increased, and stood out black against the lemon yellow of the sky—a couple of hundred people, perhaps.
uz: Cho'g'ning atrofidagi xaloyiq ko'payib, osmondagi limon sariq rangga qaraganda bir necha yuz kishi, ehtimol, qora rangda ko'rindi.

en: There were raised voices, and some sort of struggle appeared to be going on about the pit.
uz: Ovozlar ko'tarildi va chuqurlik haqida kurash olib borilayotgandek ko'rindi.

en: Strange imaginings passed through my mind.
uz: O'zimni g'alati tasavvurlar hayratda qoldirgan.

en: As I drew nearer I heard Stent’s voice: “Keep back!
uz: Men yaqinlashayotganimda, Stentning ovozini eshitdim: Keep back!

en: Keep back!” A boy came running towards me.
uz: Orqaga qayt! Bir yigit menga yugurib keldi.

en: “It’s a-movin’,” he said to me as he passed; “a-screwin’ and a-screwin’ out.
uz: U o'tib ketayotganda menga: Bu bir harakat, - dedi.

en: I’m a-goin’ ’ome, I am.” I went on to the crowd.
uz: Men odamlarning ko'pligidan ketdim.

en: There were really, I should think, two or three hundred people elbowing and jostling one another, the one or two ladies there being by no means the least active.
uz: O'ylaymanki, ikki yoki uch yuz kishi bir-biriga qo'shilib qo'shilib, qo'shilib o'tirgan edi, bir-ikki xonim hech qachon kamroq faol bo'lmagan.

en: “He’s fallen in the pit!” cried some one.
uz: U chuqurlikka tushibdi! - deb ba'zilar baqirib yubordilar.

en: “Keep back!” said several.
uz: Keep back! dedi several.

en: The crowd swayed a little, and I elbowed my way through.
uz: Jamoa biroz o'z-o'zidan burib ketdi va men o'zimni qo'l qo'yib o'tdim.

en: Every one seemed greatly excited.
uz: Hammasi juda hayajonlangan ko'rinardi.

en: I heard a peculiar humming sound from the pit.
uz: O'sha chuqurlikdan g'alati bir qichqiriq eshitdim.

en: “I say!” said Ogilvy; “help keep these idiots back.
uz: Men aytaman! - dedi Ogilvy; - bu axloqsizlarni orqaga qaytarishga yordam bering.
