en: We don’t know what’s in the confounded thing, you know!” I saw a young man, a shop assistant in Woking I believe he was, standing on the cylinder and trying to scramble out of the hole again.
uz: Biz g'alati narsa nima ekanligini bilmaymiz, bilasiz! Men Wokingda do'kon yordamchisi bo'lgan bir yigitni ko'rdim, men o'ylaymanki, silindr ustida turib, yana cho'g'idan chiqib ketishga harakat qilardi.

en: The crowd had pushed him in.
uz: Xaloyiq uni ichkariga itdi.

en: The end of the cylinder was being screwed out from within.
uz: Silindrning oxiri ichkaridan chiqarib yuborilgan edi.

en: Nearly two feet of shining screw projected.
uz: Deyarli ikki fut shinam burchak ko'rsatilgan.

en: Somebody blundered against me, and I nar- rowly missed being pitched onto the top of the screw.
uz: Kimdir menga qarshi xato qildi va men o'zimni o'zimga o'xshatdim.

en: I turned, and as I did so the screw must have come out, for the lid of the cylinder fell upon the
uz: Men o'zimni aylantirdim va shunga o'xshab, burchak chiqishi kerak edi, chunki silindrning qopqog'i burchak ustiga tushib qoldi.

en: gravel with a ringing concussion.
uz: Qichqiriqli miya titrashuvi bilan.

en: I stuck my elbow into the person behind me, and turned my head towards the Thing again.
uz: Men qo'l qo'limni orqamdagi odamga urdim va boshimni yana Ushbu narsaga qaratdim.

en: For a moment that circu- lar cavity seemed perfectly black.
uz: Bir zum davomida bu to'liq qora ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan.

en: I had the sunset in my eyes.
uz: Ko'zlarimda quyosh botishi bor edi.

en: I think everyone expected to see a man emerge—possibly something a little unlike us terrestrial men, but in all essentials a man.
uz: O'ylaymanki, hamma odamning paydo bo'lishini kutardi, ehtimol biz yer yuzidagi odamlardan biroz farq qiladigan narsa, lekin barcha jihatlarda inson.

en: But, looking, I presently saw something stirring within the shadow: greyish bil- lowy movements, one above another, and then two luminous disks—like eyes.
uz: Ammo ko'z o'ngimda ko'rinayotgan bir narsani ko'rdim: bir-birining ustida bo'lgan griziq billi harakatlar va keyin ikki yorqin disk kabi ko'zlar.

en: Then something resembling a little grey snake, about the thickness of a walking stick, coiled up out of the writhing middle, and wriggled in the air towards me—and then another.
uz: So'ngra bir oz kichkina sariq ilonga o'xshaydigan, bir cho'pon o'g'irligicha bo'lgan bir narsa, buzib o'tadigan o'rta qismidan o'rab chiqib, havoga menga va yana bir narsaga qarab o'tadi.

en: A sudden chill came over me.
uz: Birdan men o'zimni sovuq his qildim.

en: There was a loud shriek from a woman be- hind.
uz: Bir ayolning baland ovoz bilan baqirishi eshitildi.

en: I half turned, keeping my eyes ﬁxed upon the cylinder still, from which other tentacles were now projecting, and began pushing my way back from the edge of the pit.
uz: Men yarim burib, ko'zlarimni silindrga qaratib turdim, undan boshqa tentakellar ko'tarildi va o'rning chetidan qaytishga harakat qildim.

en: I saw astonishment giving place to horror on the faces of the people about me.
uz: Men atrofdagi odamlarning yuzlarida hayratlanish dahshatga o'rin berayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I heard inarticulate exclamations on all sides.
uz: Har tarafdan so'zsiz ovozlar eshitdim.

en: There was a general movement backwards.
uz: Umumiy ravishda orqaga qarab harakatlar bo'ldi.

en: I saw the shopman strug- gling still on the edge of the pit.
uz: Men do'kon egasini ko'rdim, u hali ham quduq chetida kurashayotgan edi.

en: I found myself alone, and saw the people on the other side of the pit running off, Stent among them.
uz: O'zimni yolg'iz qolib, quduqning boshqa tomonidagi odamlarni yugurib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I looked again at the cylinder, and ungovernable terror gripped me.
uz: Silindrga yana nazar tashladim va meni qo'rqinchli dahshat qamrab oldi.

en: I stood petriﬁed and staring.
uz: Men toshbo'ron bo'lib, o'zimni ko'rib turardim.

en: A big greyish rounded bulk, the size, perhaps, of a bear, was rising slow- ly and painfully out of the cylinder.
uz: Balki g'ayratli, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinadigan, qush o'lchamiga ega bo'lgan katta griq ko'pchilik silindrdan sekin va og'riqli ravishda chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: As it bulged up and caught the light, it glistened like wet leather.
uz: U ko'tarilgan va yorug'likni o'z ichiga olganida, issiq teri kabi shinam edi.

en: Two large dark-coloured eyes were regarding me steadfastly.
uz: Ikki katta qorong'i ko'z menga qat'iy nazar ko'rsatardi.

en: The mass that framed them, the head of the thing, was rounded, and had, one might say, a face.
uz: Ularni o'rnatgan massani, buyumning boshini yuziga aylantirib, yuz ko'rinadi.

en: There was a mouth under the eyes, the lipless brim of which quivered and panted, and dropped saliva.
uz: Ko'zlar ostida bir og'iz bor edi, uning og'zaki bo'laklari titraydi, nafas oldi va shilib tushdi.

en: The whole creature heaved and pulsated convulsively.
uz: Butun mavjudot shov-shuv va shov-shuv bilan shov-shuv qildi.

en: A lank tentacular appendage gripped the edge of the cylinder, another swayed in the air.
uz: Chiroyli qo'shiq silindr chegaralarini ushlab turardi, yana biri havoda o'zboshdi.

en: Those who have never seen a living Martian can scarcely imagine the strange horror of its appearance.
uz: Hayotda bo'lgan marsiy odamni hech qachon ko'rmaganlar uning ko'rinishi qanchalik dahshatli bo'lishini tasavvur qila olmaydilar.

en: The peculiar V-shaped mouth with its pointed upper lip, the absence of brow ridges, the absence of a chin beneath the wedgelike lower lip, the incessant quivering of this mouth, the Gorgon groups of tentacles, the tumultuous breathing of the lungs in a strange at- mosphere, the evident heaviness and painfulness of movement due to the greater gravitational energy of the earth— above all, the extraordinary in- tensity of the immense eyes—were at once vital, intense, inhuman, crippled
uz: O'ziga xos V shakli og'zi o'zining o'tkir yuqori tili bilan, burunlar bo'laklari yo'qligi, burunlar bo'laklari ostida burun yo'qligi, bu og'zning uzluksiz titrashishi, Gorgonlar guruhi tentakllar, o'zgacha atmosferada o'pkalarning shov-shuvli nafas olishlari, eng asosiysi yerning eng katta gravitatsiya energiyasi tufayli harakatning og'irligi va og'irligi, katta ko'zlarning g'alati bir vaqtning o'zida jonli, kuchli, insonsiz, shikastlangan edi.

en: There was something fungoid in the oily brown skin, some- thing in the clumsy deliberation of the tedious movements unspeakably nasty.
uz: Bu yog'li qaroq ko'krak teri ichida biroz yumushli narsa bor edi, biroz - keskin harakatlarning bepul mulohazalarida so'zsiz jirkanch narsa bor edi.

en: Even at this ﬁrst encounter, this ﬁrst glimpse, I was overcome with disgust and dread.
uz: Hatto birinchi uchrashuvimda, birinchi ko'rinishimda ham, men nafrat va qo'rquvga berilib ketdim.

en: Suddenly the monster vanished.
uz: Toʻsatdan haykal yoʻq boʻlib ketdi.

en: It had toppled over the brim of the cylin- der and fallen into the pit, with a thud like the fall of a great mass of leather.
uz: U silindronning chekkasi ustida qulab, chuqurlikka tushdi va katta ter to'plamining tushib ketishi kabi bir shovqin bilan o'tdi.

en: I heard it give a peculiar thick cry, and forthwith another of these creatures appeared darkly in the deep shadow of the aperture.
uz: Men uni o'zgacha qalin qichqirishni eshitdim va darhol bu mavjudotlardan yana biri ochqichning chuqur soyasida qorong'ilik bilan paydo bo'ldi.

en: I turned and, running madly, made for the ﬁrst group of trees, perhaps a hundred yards away; but I ran slantingly and stumbling, for I could not avert my face from these things.
uz: Men o'girib, aqldan ozgan holda yugurib, yuz metr uzoqlikda bo'lgan daraxtlarning birinchi guruhiga yetib keldim, lekin bulardan yuz o'girib, qoqinib yugurdim.

en: There, among some young pine trees and furze bushes, I stopped, panti- ng, and waited further developments.
uz: O'sha yerda, yosh bo'ron daraxtlari va furze butalari orasida to'xtadim, panti-ng qildim va keyingi voqealarni kutdim.

en: The common round the sand pits was dotted with people, standing like myself in a half-fascinated terror, staring at these creatures, or rather at the heaped gravel at the edge of the pit in which they lay.
uz: Qum g'orlari atrofida odamlar ko'p bo'lgan, ular o'zim kabi qo'rqinchga to'lib, bu mavjudotlarga qarayotgandek, yoki aniqrog'i, ular yotgan g'or chegarasidagi to'plangan qirg'oqqa qarayotgandek turishgan.

en: And then, with a renewed horror, I saw a round, black ob- ject bobbing up and down on the edge of the pit.
uz: Keyin, yana bir dahshat bilan, chuqurlik chegaralarida yuziga to'lib, qora ob'ektni ko'rdim.

en: It was the head of the shopman who had fallen in, but showing as a little black object against the hot western sun.
uz: Bu do'kon egasining boshi edi, lekin u issiq g'arb quyoshida kichik qora ob'ekt sifatida ko'rinadi.

en: Now he got his shoulder and knee up, and again he seemed to slip back until only his head was visible.
uz: Endi u shohlari va dizlarini ko'tarib, yana boshini ko'rmaguncha orqaga chiqqandek ko'rinardi.

en: Suddenly he vanished, and I could have fancied a faint shriek had reached me.
uz: Toʻsatdan u yoʻq boʻlib ketdi va men oʻzimga oʻzimni kamroq qichqiriq bilan tanishtirganimni tasavvur qila olardim.

en: I had a momentary im- pulse to go back and help him that my fears overruled.
uz: Oʻshanda unga yordam berish uchun qaytib borishga harakat qildim va qoʻrquvlarimni yengdim.

en: Everything was then quite invisible, hidden by the deep pit and the heap of sand that the fall of the cylinder had made.
uz: O'shanda hamma narsa juda ko'rinmas edi, chuqur chuqurlik va silindrning tushib ketishi tufayli paydo bo'lgan qum to'plami ostida yashiringan edi.

en: Anyone coming along the road from Chobham or Woking would have been amazed at the sight—a dwindling multitude of perhaps a hundred people or more standing in a great irregular circle, in ditches, behind bushes, behind gates and hedges, saying little to one another and that in short, excited shouts, and staring, staring hard at a few heaps of sand.
uz: Chobham yoki Wokingdan yo'l bo'ylab kelayotgan har bir kishi, ehtimol yuz yoki undan ko'proq kishining ko'payib borayotgan ko'rinishini ko'rib hayron bo'lardi, katta tartibsiz to'plamda, quduqlarda, butalar ortida, darvozalar va to'siqlar ortida, bir-biriga oz gapirib, qisqacha aytganda, hayajonli qichqiriqlarni eshitib, bir necha qum to'pasiga qattiq qarayotgandir.

en: The barrow of ginger beer stood, a queer derelict, black against the burning sky, and in the sand pits was a row of deserted vehicles with their horses feeding out of nosebags or pawing the ground.
uz: Zincir pivalari bo'lgan maydon o'rnidan turibdi, o'ziga xos bo'lgan, qorong'i, olovli osmonga qarata qora edi, qum quduqlarida esa otlari burun qoplaridan ovqatlanayotgan yoki yerni to'xtatayotgan tashqarida bo'lgan tashqarida tashqarida turgan mashinalar qatorida edi.

en: CHAPTER 5 THE HEAT RAY After the glimpse I had had of the Martians emerging from the cylinder in which they had come to the earth from their planet, a kind of fascination paralysed my actions.
uz: 5 - bob Issiqlik shoyi Marsliklarning o'z sayyoralaridan Yerga kelgan silindrdan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rganimdan so'ng, o'zimning harakatlarim bir xil hayratlanishga to'lib-toshgan.

en: I remained standing knee-deep in the heather, staring at the mound that hid them.
uz: Men o'zimni to'p-to'p qilib, ularni yashirgan to'pga qaratib, to'p-to'p bo'lib turardim.

en: I was a battleground of fear and curiosity.
uz: Men qo'rquv va qiziquvchanlikning jang maydoni edim.

en: I did not dare to go back towards the pit, but I felt a passionate longing to peer into it.
uz: Men chuqurlikka qaytib borishga jur'at qilmadim, lekin chuqurlikka nazar tashlashim uchun juda ko'nglim tushdi.

en: I began walking, therefore, in a big curve, seeking some point of vantage and continually looking at the sand heaps that hid these new- comers to our earth.
uz: Shuning uchun men katta egrilikda yurishni boshladim, ba'zi bir nuqtai nazarni izlab, yer yuziga kelgan bu yangilarni yashirgan qum to'plamlariga doimiy ravishda qaradim.

en: Once a leash of thin black whips, like the arms of an octopus, ﬂashed across the sunset and was immediately withdrawn, and af- terwards a thin rod rose up, joint by joint, bearing at its apex a circular disk that spun with a wobbling motion.
uz: Bir marta qora cho'ponning qo'llari singari kam qora qamchilashlar bo'lib, quyosh botishidan o'tib ketadi va darhol olib tashlanadi. Shundan so'ng esa, yonma-yon bo'lib, bir-biriga bog'liq bo'lib, yonma-yon ko'tarib, yonma-yon ko'tarib boradigan aylanma diskni o'rnatadi.

en: What could be going on there?
uz: U yerda nima bo'lishi mumkin?

en: Most of the spectators had gathered in one or two groups—one a little crowd towards Woking, the other a knot of people in the direction of Chob- ham.
uz: Ko'pgina tomoshabinlar bir yoki ikki guruhga to'planib, biri Woking tomon kichik bir to'plam, ikkinchisi esa Chob-ham yo'nalishida bir to'plam odamlarga to'plangan edi.

en: Evidently they shared my mental conﬂict.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, ular mening ruhiy ziddiyatimni ham o'zlarida bo'lishardi.

en: There were few near me.
uz: Mening yonimda kamdan-kam odamlar bor edi.

en: One man I approached—he was, I perceived, a neighbour of mine, though I did not know his name—and accosted.
uz: Men yaqinlashgan odamlardan biri, uning ismini bilmasam ham, qo'shnim bo'lganini payqadim va yaqinlashdim.

en: But it was scarcely a time for articu- late conversation.
uz: Ammo bu vaqt o'z vaqtida so'zlashuvlar o'tkazishning vaqti emas edi.

en: “What ugly brutes!” he said.
uz: Qanday dahshatli hayvonlar! - dedi u.

en: What ugly brutes!” He repeat- ed this over and over again.
uz: Bu qanday dahshatli hayvon! U buni qayta-qayta takrorlagan.

en: “Did you see a man in the pit?” I said; but he made no answer to that.
uz: Qovurg'a ichidagi odamni ko'rdingizmi? - dedim men, lekin u bunga hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: We became silent, and stood watching for a time side by side, deriving, I fancy, a certain comfort in one another’s company.
uz: Biz sukut saqlab, biroz vaqt yonma-yon kuzatib turdik va bir-birimizning kompaniyasida o'zimiz uchun qulaylik paydo bo'ldi.

en: Then I shifted my position to a little knoll that gave me the advantage of a yard or more of elevation and when I looked for him presently he was walking towards Woking.
uz: So'ngra men o'z pozitsiyamni bir metr yoki undan ko'proq balandlikdagi afzallikka ega bo'lgan kichkina ko'tarilishga o'zgartirdim va uni qidirib topganimda u hozir Woking tomon yurgan edi.

en: The sunset faded to twilight before anything further happened.
uz: Quyosh botish hech narsa sodir bo'lmasdan oldin, yorug'likkacha o'zgarib ketdi.

en: The crowd far away on the left, towards Woking, seemed to grow, and I heard
uz: Shaharning chap tomonidagi, Woking tomonidagi xaloyiq ko'payib borayotgandek tuyuldi va men eshitganimni eshitdim.

en: now a faint murmur from it.
uz: Endi bu xilma-xil xilma-xillik.

en: The little knot of people towards Chobham dis- persed.
uz: Chobhamga yaqin odamlarning kichkina to'plami bo'linib ketdi.

en: There was scarcely an intimation of movement from the pit.
uz: Cho'g'dan harakatlanishning hech qanday ma'nosi yo'q edi.

en: It was this, as much as anything, that gave people courage, and I suppose the new arrivals from Woking also helped to restore conﬁdence.
uz: Odamlarga jasorat ato etgan narsa shu edi va men o'ylaymanki, Wokingdan kelgan yangilar ham ishonchni tiklashga yordam berdi.

en: At any rate, as the dusk came on a slow, intermittent movement upon the sand pits be- gan, a movement that seemed to gather force as the stillness of the evening about the cylinder remained unbroken.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, tun tushib qolganida qum quduqlari ustida sekin, aralashib harakatlanayotgan edi, bu harakat silindr atrofidagi kechqurun tinchligi bo'lganida kuch topgan bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: Vertical black ﬁgures in twos and threes would advance, stop, watch, and advance again, spreading out as they did so in a thin irregular crescent that promised to enclose the pit in its attenuated horns.
uz: Ikkita va uchta bo'lgan vertikal qora suratlar oldinga, to'xtatishga, kuzatib turishga va yana oldinga qadam qo'yishga harakat qilishadi, bu esa o'z qo'rqinchli shoxlari ichida chuqurlikni yopishga va'da bergan noaniq yarim oyda shunday qilib tarqalgan.

en: I, too, on my side began to move towards the pit.
uz: Men ham o'z tomonimda cho'g'ga qarab harakatlanishni boshladim.

en: Then I saw some cabmen and others had walked boldly into the sand pits, and heard the clatter of hoofs and the gride of wheels.
uz: Keyin men ba'zi qahramonlarni va boshqalarni qum quduqlariga jasorat bilan kirib kelganini ko'rdim va qo'llari va g'ildiraklarning qichqiriqlarini eshitdim.

en: I saw a lad trundling off the barrow of apples.
uz: O'g'limni o'g'limga o'xshatib o'tirganimda, o'g'lim o'g'ilga o'g'il bo'lib, o'g'limga o'g'il bo'lib o'tirganini ko'rdim.

en: And then, within thirty yards of the pit, advancing from the direction of Horsell, I noted a little black knot of men, the fore- most of whom was waving a white ﬂag.
uz: Keyin Horsell yo'nalishidan o'ttiz metr uzoqlikda bo'lgan cho'g'idan chiqib, men erkaklarning kichik qora to'plamini ko'rdim, ularning aksariyati oq bayroq bilan o'girib yurishgan edi.

en: This was the Deputation.
uz: Bu Deputatsiya edi.

en: There had been a hasty consultation, and since the Martians were evidently, in spite of their repulsive forms, intelligent creatures, it had been resolved to show them, by approaching them with sig- nals, that we too were intelligent.
uz: Shoshilinch maslahat o'tkazildi va marsiylar o'zlarining jirkanch shakllariga qaramasdan aqlli mavjudotlar bo'lgani sababli, ularga signallar bilan murojaat qilib, biz ham aqlli ekanimizni ko'rsatishga qaror qilindi.

en: Flutter, ﬂutter, went the ﬂag, ﬁrst to the right, then to the left.
uz: Flutter, flutter, bayroq o'tib ketdi, avvalo o'ng tomonga, so'ngra chap tomonga.

en: It was too far for me to recognise anyone there, but afterwards I learned that Ogilvy, Stent, and Henderson were with others in this attempt at communication.
uz: U yerda hech kimni tanib-bilib bo'lmagandim, lekin keyin Ogilvy, Stent va Hendersanning boshqa odamlar bilan muloqot qilishga harakat qilayotganini bilib oldim.

en: This little group had in its advance dragged inward, so to speak, the circum- ference of the now almost complete circle of people, and a number of dim black ﬁgures followed it at discreet distances.
uz: Ushbu kichik guruh o'z oldidan, demak, hozirda deyarli to'liq insonlar to'plamining atrofini o'ziga jalb qilgan edi va bir qator chiroyli qora tanli kishilar uning orqasidan uzoq masofalarda ergashgan edi.

en: Suddenly there was a ﬂash of light, and a quantity of luminous greenish smoke came out of the pit in three distinct puffs, which drove up, one after the other, straight into the still air.
uz: Toʻsatdan yorugʻlik chaqmoqlari paydo boʻldi va quduqdan uchta oʻzgacha puflashda yorqin yashil tutun koʻpligi toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri susaygan havoga chiqdi.

en: This smoke (or ﬂame, perhaps, would be the better word for it) was so bright that the deep blue sky overhead and the hazy stretches of brown com- mon towards Chertsey, set with black pine trees, seemed to darken abruptly as these puffs arose, and to remain the darker after their dispersal.
uz: Bu tutun (yoki olov, ehtimol, bu uchun eng yaxshi so'z bo'ladi) shunchalik yorqin ediki, chertseyga borayotgan chuqur ko'k osmon va qora borak daraxtlari bilan qoplangan qora rangli ko'rmonlar, bu puflar paydo bo'lganda birdan qorong'ayib, tarqalgandan keyin qorong'ayroq bo'lib qoldi.

en: At the same time a faint hissing sound became audible.
uz: Shu bilan birga, bir oz g'iybatlash tovushi ham eshitilishi mumkin bo'ldi.

en: Beyond the pit stood the little wedge of people with the white ﬂag at its apex, arrested by these phenomena, a little knot of small vertical black shapes upon the black ground.
uz: O'sha chuqurlikning orqasida oq bayroq bilan odamlarning kichkina bo'g'i turgan edi, bu hodisalar ularni qo'lga kiritgan edi, bu qora yer ustida kichik vertikal qora shakllarning kichkina bog'i edi.

en: As the green smoke arose, their faces ﬂashed out pallid green, and faded again as it vanished.
uz: Yashil tutun paydo bo'lganida, ularning yuzlari rang-barang yashil rangga aylandi va u yo'qolganida yana o'zgarib ketdi.

en: Then slowly the hissing
uz: So'ngra asta-sekin shishqirish.

en: passed into a humming, into a long, loud, droning noise.
uz: Bu ovoz qichqiriq, uzoq, baland ovozli ovozga aylandi.

en: Slowly a humped shape rose out of the pit, and the ghost of a beam of light seemed to ﬂicker out from it.
uz: Butunlab chuqurlikdan bir qovurilgan shakli chiqdi va u yerdan yorug'lik soyasining hayajonlari parcha-parcha parcha bo'lib chiqdi.

en: Forthwith ﬂashes of actual ﬂame, a bright glare leaping from one to an- other, sprang from the scattered group of men.
uz: Darhaqiqat, chindan ham olovning shovqinlari bilan bir-biridan o'zgaga o'tib ketayotgan chiroyli yorug'lik tarqalib ketgan erkaklar guruhidan paydo bo'ldi.

en: It was as if some invisible jet impinged upon them and ﬂashed into white ﬂame.
uz: Ko'rinmas bir jet ularning boshiga tushib, oq olovga aylanganidek edi.

en: It was as if each man were suddenly and momentarily turned to ﬁre.
uz: O'shanda har bir kishi birdan va bir zumda olovga aylangan bo'ldi.

en: Then, by the light of their own destruction, I saw them staggering and falling, and their supporters turning to run.
uz: Keyin, o'zlarining halokatining nurida, ularni hayron bo'lib, yiqilib ketayotganini va qo'llab-quvvatlovchilarining qochib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I stood staring, not as yet realising that this was death leaping from man to man in that little distant crowd.
uz: Men o'sha kichik va uzoq xaloyiqda odamdan odamga o'lim sarosimalarini ko'rib turibman.

en: All I felt was that it was something very strange.
uz: Men faqat o'zimni juda g'alati his qildim.

en: An almost noiseless and blinding ﬂash of light, and a man fell headlong and lay still; and as the unseen shaft of heat passed over them, pine trees burst into ﬁre, and every dry furze bush became with one dull thud a mass of ﬂames.
uz: To'g'ri shovqinsiz va ko'rqinchli yorug'lik chaqmoqlari paydo bo'ldi va bir kishi boshini cho'kib, to'xtab qoldi; ko'rinmas issiqlik o'tlari ular ustida o'tib ketayotganda, bo'ron daraxtlari olovga to'ldi va har bir quruq furze buta bir o't qo'rqinch bilan olovning to'plamiga aylandi.

en: And far away towards Knaphill I saw the ﬂashes of trees and hedges and wooden buildings suddenly set alight.
uz: Uzoq Knaphillga borganimda, daraxtlar, o'rmonlar va yog'och binolarning chaqmoqlarini ko'rdim.

en: It was sweeping round swiftly and steadily, this ﬂaming death, this invisi- ble, inevitable sword of heat.
uz: Bu olovli o'lim, bu ko'rinmas, oldini olmaydigan issiqlik qilichi tez-tez va barqaror o'rab-o'rab turardi.

en: I perceived it coming towards me by the ﬂash- ing bushes it touched, and was too astounded and stupeﬁed to stir.
uz: Men uni o'zimga yaqinlashayotganini ko'rdim, u tutgan chaqmoqli butalar orqali, va qo'zg'atish uchun juda hayratda va hayratda qoldim.

en: I heard the crackle of ﬁre in the sand pits and the sudden squeal of a horse that was as suddenly stilled.
uz: Qum g'ovlarida olov qichqirishini va to'satdan to'xtab qolgan otning qichqirishini eshitdim.

en: Then it was as if an invisible yet intensely heated ﬁnger were drawn through the heather between me and the Martians, and all along a curving line beyond the sand pits the dark ground smoked and crackled.
uz: So'ngra men va marsiyaliklar o'rtasida ko'rinmas, ammo qattiq issiq bo'lgan barmoq o'tkirilganidek bo'ldi va qum quduqlaridan past bo'lgan egri chiziq bo'ylab qorong'i yer tuxumlanib, charchagan.

en: Something fell with a crash far away to the left where the road from Wok- ing station opens out on the common.
uz: Woking stantsiyasidagi yo'l umumiy yo'lga ochilganda, bir narsa uzoq chap tomonga tushib tushdi.

en: Forth-with the hissing and humming ceased, and the black, dome-like object sank slowly out of sight into the pit.
uz: O'tib ketayotganda, shishish-shishishish va qichqiriq to'xtadi va qora, kubonga o'xshash ob'ekt sekin-sakin ko'rinmas bo'lib, chuqurlikka tushib ketadi.

en: All this had happened with such swiftness that I had stood motionless, dumbfounded and dazzled by the ﬂashes of light.
uz: Bularning barchasi shunchalik tez sodir bo'ldiki, men harakatsiz, hayron va yorug'lik chaqmoqlari bilan cho'zib qoldim.

en: Had that death swept through a full circle, it must inevitably have slain me in my surprise.
uz: Agar bu o'lim to'liq to'plamni o'rab olgan bo'lsa, unda u meni hayratda qoldirib o'ldirgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: But it passed and spared me, and left the night about me suddenly dark and unfamiliar.
uz: Ammo u o'tib, meni qutqardi va birdan atrofimda qorong'i va begona tunni qoldirdi.

en: The undulating common seemed now dark almost to blackness, except where its roadways lay grey and pale under the deep blue sky of the early night.
uz: To'lqinlangan umumiy joy endi deyarli qoralikkacha qorong'i ko'rinardi, faqat uning yo'llari erta tunning chuqur ko'k osmon ostida oq va oq bo'lgan joylarda edi.

en: It was dark, and suddenly void of men.
uz: Qorong'ilik bo'lib, birdan odamlar yo'q edi.

en: Overhead the stars were mus- tering, and in the west the sky was still a pale, bright, almost greenish blue.
uz: Yulduzlarning boshidan osmon ko'tarildi va g'arbda osmon hali ham o'tkir, yorqin, deyarli yashil ko'k rangda edi.

en: The tops of the pine trees and the roofs of Horsell came out sharp and black against the western afterglow.
uz: Pinarlarning tepaliklari va Horsellning tomlari g'arbiy yorug'likka qarshi keskin va qora ko'rindi.

en: The Martians and their appliances were alto-
uz: Marsliklar va ularning uskunalari baland-

en: gether invisible, save for that thin mast upon which their restless mirror wobbled.
uz: Ular ko'rinmas o'rindiqlarini ko'rinmas o'rindiqlari bilan o'rab olgan o'sha kichkinagina mastdan tashqari, ko'rinmas o'rindiqlarni ko'rishadi.

en: Patches of bush and isolated trees here and there smoked and glowed still, and the houses towards Woking station were sending up spires of ﬂame into the stillness of the evening air.
uz: Bu yerda-bu yerda butalar va alohida daraxtlar tuxumlanib, hali ham yoritib turardi va Woking stantsiyasiga borayotgan uylar kecha havo xotirjamligiga olov toʻgʻrilarini yuborgan edi.

en: Nothing was changed save for that and a terrible astonishment.
uz: Bu va dahshatli hayratdan tashqari hech narsa o'zgarmagan.

en: The little group of black specks with the ﬂag of white had been swept out of exis- tence, and the stillness of the evening, so it seemed to me, had scarcely been broken.
uz: Oq bayrog'i bo'lgan kichik qora to'qimalar guruhi mavjud bo'lib ketmadi va kechki paytning tinchligi, menga o'xshaydi, barchasi o'chirib ketmadi.

en: It came to me that I was upon this dark common, helpless, unprotected, and alone.
uz: O'shanda men o'zimni qo'pol, yordamsiz, himoyasiz va yolg'iz qolgan qorong'i joyda topganimni tushundim.

en: Suddenly, like a thing falling upon me from without, came—fear.
uz: Toʻsatdan, xuddi tashqaridan menga tushayotgan narsa kabi, qoʻrquv paydo boʻldi.

en: With an effort I turned and began a stumbling run through the heather.
uz: Bir bor harakat qilib, o'zimni burib, o'zimni to'g'ri tutishga harakat qildim.

en: The fear I felt was no rational fear, but a panic terror not only of the Mar- tians, but of the dusk and stillness all about me.
uz: His qilgan qo'rquvim oqilona qo'rquv emas edi, balki nafaqat martianlarning, balki atrofimdagi tong va tinchlikning qo'rquvi edi.

en: Such an extraordinary ef- fect in unmanning me it had that I ran weeping silently as a child might do.
uz: U meni odamsiz qoldirishda shunchalik ajoyib ta'sir ko'rsatdiki, bola kabi sukutdan yig'lab yugurdim.

en: Once I had turned, I did not dare to look back.
uz: Bir marta o'zimni o'zgartirganimda, orqaga qarab ko'rishga jur'at etmadim.

en: I remember I felt an extraordinary persuasion that I was being played with, that presently, when I was upon the very verge of safety, this mysteri- ous death—as swift as the passage of light—would leap after me from the pit about the cylinder and strike me down.
uz: Eslaymanki, men o'zim bilan o'yin o'tkazayotgan bo'lsam, hozirda, xavfsizlik chegarasida bo'lganimda, bu sirli o'lim nur o'tishi kabi tez, silindr atrofidagi chuqurlikdan ortimdan o'tib, menga tushib ketadi degan g'ayratni his qildim.

en: CHAPTER 6 THE HEAT-RAY IN THE CHOBHAM ROAD It is still a matter of wonder how the Martians are able to slay men so swift- ly and so silently.
uz: 6 bob Chobham yo'lidagi issiqlik radiyasi Hali ham hayron bo'lish kerakki, marsiyaliklar odamlarni qanday qilib shu qadar tez va hushyorlik bilan o'ldirishlari mumkin.

en: Many think that in some way they are able to generate an intense heat in a chamber of practically absolute non-conductivity.
uz: Ko'plar o'ylashadiki, ular deyarli mutlaqo o'tkazuvchan emaslik kamerasida kuchli issiqlik hosil qilishga qodir.

en: This in- tense heat they project in a parallel beam against any object they choose, by means of a polished parabolic mirror of unknown composition, much as the parabolic mirror of a lighthouse projects a beam of light.
uz: Ular ushbu kuchsiz issiqlikni o'zlari tanlagan har qanday ob'ektga qarshi parallel soya bilan, noma'lum tarkibdagi polizlangan parabolik ko'rinish orqali, chiroqning parabolik ko'rinishi nur soyasini namoyish etgani kabi, o'zlarining parvolik issiqligini namoyish etadilar.

en: But no one has ab- solutely proved these details.
uz: Ammo bu tafsilotlarni hech kim aniq isbotlamagan.

en: However it is done, it is certain that a beam of heat is the essence of the matter.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, ishning mohiyati issiqlik radiyasi ekanligi shubhasizdir.

en: Heat, and invisible, instead of visible, light.
uz: Issiqlik va ko'rinmas, ko'rinmas, balki yorug'lik.

en: Whatever is combustible ﬂashes into ﬂame at its touch, lead runs like water, it softens iron, cracks and melts glass, and when it falls upon water, incontinently that explodes into steam.
uz: Yanadigan narsa nima bo'lmasin, unga tegganida alangadir, oltin suv kabi oqib ketadi, temirni yumshatadi, qirg'oq va shisha eritadi, suvga tushib qolganda esa, u kontententsiyaviy ravishda bug'ga aylanadi.

en: That night nearly forty people lay under the starlight about the pit, charred and distorted beyond recognition, and all night long the common from Horsell to Maybury was deserted and brightly ablaze.
uz: O'sha kecha deyarli qirq kishi yulduz nurida yotgan edi, ko'mirlangan va tan olinmaydigan darajada buzilgan edilar va butun kecha Horselldan Mayburygacha bo'lgan shaharcha cho'zilgan va yonayotgan edi.

en: The news of the massacre probably reached Chobham, Woking, and Ot- tershaw about the same time.
uz: Qirg'inlik haqidagi xabar Chobham, Woking va Ot- tershawga taxminan bir vaqtning o'zida yetib kelgan.

en: In Woking the shops had closed when the tragedy happened, and a number of people, shop people and so forth, at- tracted by the stories they had heard, were walking over the Horsell Bridge and along the road between the hedges that runs out at last upon the com- mon.
uz: Wokingda fojia sodir bo'lganda do'konlar yopilgan edi va ko'plab odamlar, do'konchilar va boshqalar eshitgan hikoyalari tufayli Horsell ko'prisi ustida yurishardi va nihoyat qo'shni joyga yetib boradigan to'siqlar o'rtasidagi yo'l bo'ylab yurishardi.

en: You may imagine the young people brushed up after the labours of the day, and making this novelty, as they would make any novelty, the excuse for walking together and enjoying a trivial ﬂirtation.
uz: O'zingiz tasavvur qila olasizki, yoshlar kundalik ishdan keyin o'zlarining ko'ngillarini ko'tarib, bu yangilikni, ular qandaydir yangilikni yaratganidek, birga yurish va oddiy flirtsdan zavqlanish uchun bahona qilib olishadi.

en: You may ﬁgure to yourself the hum of voices along the road in the gloaming… As yet, of course, few people in Woking even knew that the cylinder had opened, though poor Henderson had sent a messenger on a bicycle to the
uz: Yo'l bo'ylab g'alati ovozlarning surgunini o'zingiz tasavvur qila olasiz... Hattoki, albatta, Wokingdagi ko'plab odamlar silindrning ochilganini bilmas edilar, ammo kambag'al Henderson velosipedda elchi yuboribdi.

en: post ofﬁce with a special wire to an evening paper.
uz: Pochtaxonada kechki gazetaga maxsus sim qo'shilgan.

en: As these folks came out by twos and threes upon the open, they found little knots of people talking excitedly and peering at the spinning mirror over the sand pits, and the newcomers were, no doubt, soon infected by the excitement of the occasion.
uz: Ushbu odamlar ochiq joyda ikki va uch kishilar bo'lib chiqib ketayotganda, ular ko'pgina odamlarning g'ayrat bilan gapirayotganini va qum quduqlari ustida aylanayotgan ko'rinishga qarayotganini ko'rishdi va yangi kelganlar, shubhasiz, tez orada bu hodisaning g'ayratidan zarar ko'rishdi.

en: By half past eight, when the Deputation was destroyed, there may have been a crowd of three hundred people or more at this place, besides those who had left the road to approach the Martians nearer.
uz: So'nggi soat sakkiz yarimdan keyin, Deputatsiya vayron qilinganida, bu joyda uch yuz yoki undan ortiq kishilar to'plangan bo'lishi mumkin edi, yo'ldan chiqib, yaqinroq bo'lgan marsiyaliklarga yaqinlashganlardan tashqari.

en: There were three po- licemen too, one of whom was mounted, doing their best, under instructions from Stent, to keep the people back and deter them from approaching the cylinder.
uz: Uchta politsiyachi ham bor edi, ulardan biri o'z mashinasiga o'tiribdi va Stentning ko'rsatmalari bo'yicha odamlarni orqaga qaytarish va silinderga yaqinlashishdan qaytarish uchun qo'llaridan kelganini qildi.

en: There was some booing from those more thoughtless and excitable souls to whom a crowd is always an occasion for noise and horse-play.
uz: Ko'pchilik har doim shov-shuv va o'yin-kulgi uchun sabab bo'lgan o'ylanmaydigan va hayajonli ruhlardan ba'zi bir qayg'ular paydo bo'ldi.

en: Stent and Ogilvy, anticipating some possibilities of a collision, had telegraphed from Horsell to the barracks as soon as the Martians emerged, for the help of a company of soldiers to protect these strange creatures from violence.
uz: Stent va Ogilvy, to'qnashish ehtimoli borligini ko'rib, Horselldan marsliklar paydo bo'lganidan so'ng, bu g'alati mavjudotlarni zo'ravonlikdan himoya qilish uchun qo'shinlar qo'shinining yordami uchun barakasiga telegraf orqali xabar berishdi.

en: After that they returned to lead that ill-fated advance.
uz: Shundan so'ng, ular o'sha baxtsiz avgustni boshqarishga qaytib kelishdi.

en: The descrip- tion of their death, as it was seen by the crowd, tallies very closely with my own impressions: the three puffs of green smoke, the deep humming note, and the ﬂashes of ﬂame.
uz: Ularning o'limi haqidagi ta'rif, ko'pchilik tomonidan ko'rilganidek, o'zimning taassurotlarim bilan juda mos keladi: yashil tutunning uchta puflanishi, chuqur qichqiriq va olov chaqmoqlari.

en: But that crowd of people had a far narrower escape than mine.
uz: Ammo bu xaloyiqning qochib ketish yo'li mennikiga qaraganda ancha tor edi.

en: Only the fact that a hummock of heathery sand intercepted the lower part of the Heat-Ray saved them.
uz: Faqatgina issiqlik nurining pastki qismini qirg'oq qumlari bilan qoplagan qo'rqinch ularni qutqardi.

en: Had the elevation of the parabolic mirror been a few yards higher, none could have lived to tell the tale.
uz: Agar parabolik ko'zguvchaning balandligi bir necha metr yuqori bo'lganida, hech kim hikoyani aytib berishga tirik qolmagan bo'lardi.

en: They saw the ﬂashes and the men falling and an invisible hand, as it were, lit the bushes as it hurried towards them through the twilight.
uz: Ular chaqmoqlarni, odamlarning tushib ketayotganini va ko'rinmas qo'lni ko'rishdi, xuddi shunday qilib, qorong'ilikda ularga yaqinlashib borayotgan butalarni yoritib yubordi.

en: Then, with a whistling note that rose above the droning of the pit, the beam swung close over their heads, light- ing the tops of the beech trees that line the road, and splitting the bricks, smashing the windows, ﬁring the window frames, and bringing down in crumbling ruin a portion of the gable of the house nearest the corner.
uz: So'ngra, chuqurning o'chirishidan yuqori ko'tarilgan pishiriq bilan, sho'r ularning boshi ustiga yaqinlashdi, yo'lni ko'rsatuvchi bukka daraxtlarining boshlarini yoritdi va toshlarni parchaladi, oynalarni buzdi, oynalar ramkalarini o'tkazdi va burchakga yaqin turgan uyning bir qismini vayron qildi.

en: In the sudden thud, hiss, and glare of the igniting trees, the panic-stricken crowd seems to have swayed hesitatingly for some moments.
uz: O'simliklarning to'satdan shov-shuvlari, g'iybatlari va yorug'ligi tufayli qo'rquvga to'lib-toshgan xaloyiq bir necha daqiqalar davomida shubha ostiga qolib ketdi.

en: Sparks and burning twigs began to fall into the road, and single leaves like puffs of ﬂame.
uz: Yo'lga chiroqlar va yonayotgan shoxlar tushib tushdi va bitta barglar olov puflariga o'xshardi.

en: Hats and dresses caught ﬁre.
uz: G'azab va kiyimlar olovga to'ldi.

en: Then came a crying from the common.
uz: So'ngra oddiy odamning yig'i keldi.

en: There were shrieks and shouts, and suddenly a mounted policeman came galloping through the confusion with his hands clasped over his head, screaming.
uz: Qichqiriq va qichqiriqlar bo'ldi va to'satdan hayqirib, qo'llarini boshi ustiga bog'lagan hayratga tushgan politsiya boshlig'i hayqirib keldi.

en: “They’re coming!” a woman shrieked, and incontinently everyone was turning and pushing at those behind, in order to clear their way to Woking again.
uz: Bir ayol qichqirdi va shoshilmasdan hamma orqaga qaytish uchun orqaga qarab, orqaga ergashganlarga shovqin qildi.

en: They must have bolted as blindly as a ﬂock of sheep.
uz: Ular qo'y suruvi kabi ko'r bo'lib o'tirgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Where the road grows narrow and black between the high banks the crowd jammed, and a desperate struggle occurred.
uz: Yuqori qirg'oqlar orasidagi yo'l siqilgan va qora bo'lgan joyda, xaloyiq to'xtab qoldi va umidsiz kurash yuz berdi.

en: All that crowd did not escape; three persons at least, two women and a little boy, were crushed and trampled there, and left to die amid the terror and the darkness.
uz: Hamma xaloyiq qochib ketmadi; kamida uch kishi, ikkita ayol va bir o'g'il, bu yerda cho'kib, oyoq osti qilib, qo'rquv va zulmat ichida o'lishga qo'yildi.

en: CHAPTER 7 HOW I REACHED HOME For my own part, I remember nothing of my ﬂight except the stress of blun- dering against trees and stumbling through the heather.
uz: 7 - bob Men uyga qaytib keldim. O'zim uchun uchuvchimdan tashqari, daraxtlarga qochib o'tish va o'simliklarni o'rab o'tishning stressidan boshqa hech narsa eslay olmayman.

en: All about me gath- ered the invisible terrors of the Martians; that pitiless sword of heat seemed whirling to and fro, ﬂourishing overhead before it descended and smote me out of life.
uz: Men atrofimda marsiyaliklarning ko'rinmas dahshatlari bor edi; o'sha shafqatsiz issiqlik qilichi o'z-o'zidan burib borar edi, u tushishdan oldin boshimdan o'sib, meni hayotdan mahrum qildi.

en: I came into the road between the crossroads and Horsell, and ran along this to the crossroads.
uz: Yo'l chekkasi va Horsell o'rtasidagi yo'lga tushib, shu yo'l bo'ylab yo'l chekkasiga yugurdim.

en: At last I could go no further; I was exhausted with the violence of my emotion and of my ﬂight, and I staggered and fell by the wayside.
uz: Nihoyat, bu ishni davom ettira olmadim; his-tuyg'ularim va qochishimning zo'ravonligi meni yorib qo'ydi va men qochib ketdim va yo'l bo'yiga yiqildim.

en: That was near the bridge that crosses the canal by the gasworks.
uz: Bu gaz zavodlari orqali kanalni kesib o'tadigan ko'prik yaqinida edi.

en: I fell and lay still.
uz: Men yiqilib, to'xtab qoldim.

en: I must have remained there some time.
uz: O'sha yerda bir muncha vaqt qolishim kerak edi.

en: I sat up, strangely perplexed.
uz: O'zimni o'tqazib, g'alati darajada g'alati his qildim.

en: For a moment, perhaps, I could not clearly understand how I came there.
uz: Ehtimol, bir muncha vaqt davomida men qanday qilib u yerga kelganimni aniq tushunolmadim.

en: My terror had fallen from me like a garment.
uz: Qo'rquvim kiyim kabi mendan tushdi.

en: My hat had gone, and my collar had burst away from its fastener.
uz: G'aptim yo'qolgan edi va bo'ynim o'z biriktiruvchidan burib ketgan edi.

en: A few minutes before, there had only been three real things before me—the im- mensity of the night and space and nature, my own feebleness and anguish, and the near approach of death.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa oldin, mening oldimda faqat uchta haqiqiy narsa bor edi: kechasi va makon va tabiatning noaniqligi, o'zimning zaifligim va qayg'u-alamim va o'lim yaqinlashib qolganligi.

en: Now it was as if something turned over, and the point of view altered abruptly.
uz: Endi bir narsa o'zgarib qolgan va nuqtai nazar keskin o'zgarib qolgan.

en: There was no sensible transition from one state of mind to the other.
uz: Bir fikr-mulohaza holatidan boshqasiga oqilona o'tish bo'lmadi.

en: I was immediately the self of every day again —a decent, ordinary citizen.
uz: Men darhol har kunning o'zi bo'ldim - munosib, oddiy fuqaro bo'ldim.

en: The silent common, the impulse of my ﬂight, the starting ﬂames, were as if they had been in a dream.
uz: O'zimning so'zsiz odatxonam, parvozimning urushi, yoqilg'i olovlari xuddi orzuda bo'lganidek edi.

en: I asked myself had these latter things indeed happened?
uz: O'zimdan shunday so'radimki, bu oxirgi voqealar haqiqatan ham sodir bo'lganmi?

en: I could not credit it.
uz: Men bunga e'tibor berolmadim.

en: I rose and walked unsteadily up the steep incline of the bridge.
uz: Men turdim va ko'prikning baland bo'g'inidan ko'tarilib, o'zimni o'zgartirib yurdim.

en: My mind was blank wonder.
uz: Mening ongim o'zidan-o'zidan hayratda edi.

en: My muscles and nerves seemed drained of their strength.
uz: Mushaklarim va hissiy hislarim o'z kuchlaridan mahrum bo'lib qolgan edi.

en: I dare say I staggered drunkenly.
uz: Men mast bo'lganimdan qochib ketganimni aytishga jur'at qilaman.

en: A head rose over the arch, and the ﬁgure of a workman carrying a basket appeared.
uz: Qo'rg'on ustida bosh ko'tarildi va ko'krak ko'tarib yurgan ishchi suratini ko'rsatdi.

en: Beside him ran a little boy.
uz: Uning yonida kichkinagina o'g'il yugurdi.

en: He passed me, wishing me good night.
uz: U meni o'tib ketib, yaxshi kechani tiladi.

en: I was minded to speak to him, but did
uz: Men u bilan gaplashmoqchi edim, lekin gapirdim.

en: I answered his greeting with a meaningless mumble and went on over the bridge.
uz: Men uning salomlashiga ma'nosiz gumam bilan javob berib, ko'prikdan o'tib ketdim.

en: Over the Maybury arch a train, a billowing tumult of white, ﬁrelit smoke, and a long caterpillar of lighted windows, went ﬂying south— clatter, clat- ter, clap, rap, and it had gone.
uz: Maybury arxi ustida poyezd, oq, olovli tutun va yonib turgan oynalar bilan to'lib-toshgan, uzoq bo'lib o'tadigan cho'g'lar o'tib o'tib ketdi. Klatter, clatter, clapping, rap, va u yo'qoldi.

en: A dim group of people talked in the gate of one of the houses in the pretty little row of gables that was called Oriental Terrace.
uz: O'sha paytlarda chiroyli, kichkina qatordagi uylardan birining darvozasida chiroyli odamlar to'plami suhbatlashardi.

en: It was all so real and so familiar.
uz: Hammasi juda haqiqiy va tanish edi.

en: It was fran- tic, fantastic!
uz: Bu juda ajoyib edi!

en: Such things, I told myself, could not be.
uz: O'zimga aytdimki, bunday narsalar bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Perhaps I am a man of exceptional moods.
uz: Ehtimol, men o'zgacha ruhdagi odamman.

en: I do not know how far my ex- perience is common.
uz: Mening tajribam qanchalik keng tarqalganini bilmayman.

en: At times I suffer from the strangest sense of detach- ment from myself and the world about me; I seem to watch it all from the outside, from somewhere inconceivably remote, out of time, out of space, out of the stress and tragedy of it all.
uz: Ba'zan men o'zimdan va atrofimdagi dunyodan ajralib turish hissi bilan azob chekaman; men hamma narsani tashqaridan, tasavvur qilinmaydigan darajada uzoq bir joydan, vaqtdan, makondan, stress va fojialardan o'zim kuzatib turaman.

en: This feeling was very strong upon me that night.
uz: O'sha kecha bu his-tuyg'u menga qattiq ta'sir qildi.

en: Here was another side to my dream.
uz: Mana, orzularimning yana bir tomoni bor edi.

en: But the trouble was the blank incongruity of this serenity and the swift death ﬂying yonder, not two miles away.
uz: Ammo muammo shundaki, bu tinchlik va tez o'lim ikki mil uzoqlikda uchib borayotgan bo'lsa-da, u yerda bo'lgan bejiz ziddiyat edi.

en: There was a noise of business from the gasworks, and the electric lamps were all alight.
uz: Gaz zavodlaridan biznesning shov-shuvlari eshitildi va elektr chiroqlari yonib ketdi.

en: I stopped at the group of people.
uz: Men odamlar guruhida to'xtadim.

en: “What news from the common?” said I.
uz: Odamlardan qanday yangiliklar bor? dedi I.

en: There were two men and a woman at the gate.
uz: Darvoza oldida ikki erkak va bir ayol turgan edi.

en: “Eh?” said one of the men, turning.
uz: Eh? dedi erkaklardan biri, o'girilib.

en: “What news from the common?” I said.
uz: Odamlardan qanday yangiliklar bor? dedim.

en: “’Ain’t yer just BEEN there?” asked the men.
uz: An yer faqat u erda BEEN? so'radilar erkaklar.

en: “People seem fair silly about the common,” said the woman over the gate.
uz: Odamlar oddiy odamlar haqida juda ahmoqona ko'rinishadi, dedi darvoza ustida turgan ayol.

en: “What’s it all abart?” “Haven’t you heard of the men from Mars?” said I; “the creatures from Mars?” “Quite enough,” said the woman over the gate.
uz: Bularning barchasi nimaga bog'liq?Siz Marsdan kelgan odamlarni eshitganmisiz? Men:Marsdan kelgan mavjudotlarni?To'g'ri, dedi darvoza ustida turgan ayol.

en: “Thenks”; and all three of them laughed.
uz: Thanks; va ularning uchasi ham kulishdi.

en: I felt foolish and angry.
uz: O'zimni ahmoq va g'azabga to'lgan his qildim.

en: I tried and found I could not tell them what I had seen.
uz: Men uni sinab ko'rishga harakat qildim va ko'rganlarim haqida ularga aytolmadim.

en: They laughed again at my broken sentences.
uz: Ular mening buzilgan gaplarimga yana kulishdi.

en: “You’ll hear more yet,” I said, and went on to my home.
uz: Siz yana ko'proq eshitasiz, - dedim men va o'z uyimga bordim.

en: I startled my wife at the doorway, so haggard was I.
uz: Xotinimni eshik oldida qo'rqitdim, shuning uchun men juda g'alati bo'ldim.

en: I went into the din- ing room, sat down, drank some wine, and so soon as I could collect myself sufﬁciently I told her the things I had seen.
uz: Men ovqatxonada o'tirib, biroz sharob ichdim va o'zimni to'g'ri yig'ib olganimdan so'ng, ko'rganlarim haqida unga aytib berdim.

en: The dinner, which was a cold one, had already been served, and remained neglected on the table while I told my story.
uz: Qizig'i bo'lgan kechki ovqat allaqachon xizmat qilingan edi va men hikoyamni aytib berayotganimda, u stol ustida tashqarida qoldirilgan edi.

en: “There is one thing,” I said, to allay the fears I had aroused; “they are the most sluggish things I ever saw crawl.
uz: Men aytganimdek, qo'rquvlarni yengish uchun bir narsa bor; ular men ko'rgan eng beparvo narsalardir.

en: They may keep the pit and kill peo- ple who come near them, but they cannot get out of it.
uz: Ular chuqurlikni saqlab, ularga yaqinlashayotganlarni o'ldirishlari mumkin, lekin ular undan chiqib ketolmaydi.

en: … But the horror of them!” “Don’t, dear!” said my wife, knitting her brows and putting her hand on mine.
uz: Ammo ularning dahshatliligi!Tarchang, azizim! - dedi xotinim, ko'z burchaklarini tikib, qo'lini mening qo'limga qo'ydi.

en: “Poor Ogilvy!” I said.
uz: Yomon Ogilvy! - dedim men.

en: “To think he may be lying dead there!” My wife at least did not ﬁnd my experience incredible.
uz: O'zini o'lik deb o'ylash! Xotinim hech bo'lmaganda mening tajribamni ajoyib deb topmadi.

en: When I saw how deadly white her face was, I ceased abruptly.
uz: Uning yuzi qanchadan-qancha oqligini ko'rgach, to'xtatdim.

en: “They may come here,” she said again and again.
uz: Ular bu yerga kelishi mumkin, - deb qayta-qayta aytdi u.

en: I pressed her to take wine, and tried to reassure her.
uz: Men uni sharob ichishga majburlab, uni tasalli berishga harakat qildim.

en: “They can scarcely move,” I said.
uz: Ular deyarli harakatlanmaydi, dedim men.

en: I began to comfort her and myself by repeating all that Ogilvy had told me of the impossibility of the Martians establishing themselves on the earth.
uz: Men Ogilvy menga Marsliklar yer yuzida o'zlarini o'rnatishi mumkin emasligi haqida aytgan barcha narsalarni takrorlab, o'zimni va uni tasalli berishni boshladim.

en: In particular I laid stress on the gravitational difﬁculty.
uz: Ayniqsa, men gravitatsiya qiyinchiliklariga e'tibor qaratdim.

en: On the surface of the earth the force of gravity is three times what it is on the surface of Mars.
uz: Yer yuzida gravitatsiya kuchi Mars yuzida uch baravar ko'p.

en: A Martian, therefore, would weigh three times more than on Mars, albeit his muscular strength would be the same.
uz: Shuning uchun, martian odamning og'irligi Marsdagiidan uch baravar ko'proq bo'ladi, ammo uning mushak kuchi bir xil bo'ladi.

en: His own body would be a cope of lead to him.
uz: Uning o'z tanasi unga yetakchi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: That, indeed, was the general opinion.

uz: Odam baliq ovchilari haqida gapiring, bu safar baliq jangchilari! - deb so'radi birinchi nutqchi. - Bu hayvonlarni o'ldirish uchun o'ldirilgan odam emas.

en: “Why not shell the darned things strite off and ﬁnish ’em?” said the little dark man.
uz: Nima uchun bu yovuz narsalarni o'z ichiga olmaydi va ularni tugatmaydi? - dedi kichik qorong'i odam.

en: “You carn tell what they might do.” “Where’s your shells?” said the ﬁrst speaker.
uz: Sizlar ularga nima qilishlari mumkinligini aytinglar.Qayerda o'zingizning qo'rquqlaringiz? - dedi birinchi nutq so'zlovchisi.

en: “There ain’t no time.
uz: Vaqt yo'q.

en: Do it in a rush, that’s my tip, and do it at once.” So they discussed it.
uz: Buni tezroq qiling, bu mening maslahatimdir va darhol qiling. Shunday qilib, ular bu haqda muhokama qildilar.

en: After a while I left them, and went on to the railway station to get as many morning papers as I could.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, ularni tashlab, imkon qadar ko'proq ertalabki gazetalarni olish uchun temir yo'l stantsiyasiga bordim.

en: But I will not weary the reader with a description of that long morning and of the longer afternoon.
uz: Ammo men o'quvchilarni o'sha uzoq ertalab va uzoq kechqurun tasvirlanishi bilan bezovta qilmayman.

en: I did not succeed in getting a glimpse of the common, for even Horsell and Chobham church towers were in the hands
uz: Men oddiy narsalarni ko'rishga muvaffaq bo'lmadim, chunki hatto Horsell va Chobham cherkovlarining ko'tarilgan minoralari ham qo'lda edi

en: of the military authorities.
uz: Harbiy hokimiyatning.

en: The soldiers I addressed didn’t know anything; the ofﬁcers were mysterious as well as busy.
uz: Men murojaat qilgan askarlar hech narsani bilmas edilar; ofitserlar sirli va mashg'ul bo'lishgan.

en: I found people in the town quite secure again in the presence of the military, and I heard for the ﬁrst time from Marshall, the tobacconist, that his son was among the dead on the common.
uz: Shahardagi odamlar harbiylar huzurida yana juda xavfsiz bo'lganini ko'rdim va ilk bor tamaki ishlab chiqaruvchi Marshalldan uning o'g'li oddiy hayotdan ko'z yumganlar orasida ekanligini eshitdim.

en: The soldiers had made the people on the outskirts of Horsell lock up and leave their houses.
uz: Askarlar Horsellning tashqarisida yashovchi odamlarni qulflab, uylaridan chiqib ketishga majburlashgan.

en: I got back to lunch about two, very tired for, as I have said, the day was extremely hot and dull; and in order to refresh myself I took a cold bath in the afternoon.
uz: Men soat ikkilarda tushlikka qaytdim, juda charchadim, chunki, aytganimdek, kun juda issiq va charchagan edi; va o'zimni ta'minlash uchun kechqurun sovuq suvga cho'mdim.

en: About half past four I went up to the railway station to get an evening paper, for the morning papers had contained only a very inaccurate description of the killing of Stent, Henderson, Ogilvy, and the others.
uz: Taxminan soat to'rt yarim o'tgach, kechki gazeta olish uchun temir yo'l stantsiyasiga bordim, chunki ertalabgi gazetalarda Stent, Henderson, Ogilvy va boshqalarning o'ldirilishi haqida faqat juda noto'g'ri tasvirlar mavjud edi.

en: But there was little I didn’t know.
uz: Ammo men bilmagan narsalar kam edi.

en: The Martians did not show an inch of them- selves.
uz: Marsliklar o'z-o'zlaridan bir santimetr ham ko'rsatmadilar.

en: They seemed busy in their pit, and there was a sound of hammering and an almost continuous streamer of smoke.
uz: Ular o'z quduqlarida mashg'ul bo'lib ko'rinardilar, bu yerda to'qnashish ovozi va deyarli doimiy ravishda tutun oqishi eshitildi.

en: Apparently they were busy getting ready for a struggle.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, ular jangga tayyorgarlik ko'rish bilan band edilar.

en: “Fresh attempts have been made to signal, but without success,” was the stereotyped formula of the papers.
uz: Signal berish uchun yangi urinishlar qilindi, lekin muvaffaqiyatsiz, bu qog'ozlarning stereotip formulasi edi.

en: A sapper told me it was done by a man in a ditch with a ﬂag on a long pole.
uz: Bir sapper bu ishni uzun ustunga bayroq qo'yib, quduqdagi bir kishi qilganini aytdi.

en: The Martians took as much notice of such advances as we should of the lowing of a cow.
uz: Marsliklar bunday yutuqlarni biz ham sigirning bo'g'i bo'lib o'tishi bilan solishtirgan edik.

en: I must confess the sight of all this armament, all this preparation, greatly excited me.
uz: Bu barcha qurol-yarog'ni ko'rish, tayyorgarlik ko'rish meni juda hayajonlantirganini aytishim kerak.

en: My imagination became belligerent, and defeated the invaders in a dozen striking ways; something of my schoolboy dreams of battle and heroism came back.
uz: Mening tasavvurim jangovar bo'lib, bir o'nlab ajoyib yo'llar bilan ishlovchilar ustidan g'alaba qozondi; maktab o'quvchisining jang va qahramonlik haqidagi orzularidan biri qaytib keldi.

en: It hardly seemed a fair ﬁght to me at that time.
uz: O'sha paytda bu menga adolatli jang kabi ko'rinmadi.

en: They seemed very helpless in that pit of theirs.
uz: Ular o'zlarining o'sha vodiysida juda yordamsiz ko'rinishgan.

en: About three o’clock there began the thud of a gun at measured intervals from Chertsey or Addlestone.
uz: Taxminan soat uchda Chertsey yoki Addlestone shahridan o'lchovli oraliqlarda qurol tovushi boshlandi.

en: I learned that the smouldering pine wood into which the second cylinder had fallen was being shelled, in the hope of de- stroying that object before it opened.
uz: Men ikkinchi silindr tushib qolgan cho'g'i yog'ochni ochishdan oldin bu ob'ektni yo'q qilish umidi bilan o'qilayotganini bilib oldim.

en: It was only about ﬁve, however, that a ﬁeld gun reached Chobham for use against the ﬁrst body of Martians.
uz: Biroq, soat besh atrofida, birinchi marsiyaliklarga qarshi foydalanish uchun Chobhamga maydon quroli yetib keldi.

en: About six in the evening, as I sat at tea with my wife in the summerhouse talking vigorously about the battle that was lowering upon us, I heard a mufﬂed detonation from the common, and immediately after a gust of ﬁr- ing.
uz: Kechqurun soat olti atrofida, xotinim bilan yozgi uyda choy o'tkazganimda, bizga yaqinlashib kelayotgan jang haqida g'ayrat ila gapirganimda, oddiy odamlardan bir ovozni eshitdim va darhol o'qishdan so'ng o'zimni qo'zg'atdim.

en: Close on the heels of that came a violent rattling crash, quite close to us, that shook the ground; and, starting out upon the lawn, I saw the tops of the trees about the Oriental College burst into smoky red ﬂame, and the tower of the little church beside it slide down into ruin.
uz: Uning orqasida bizdan juda yaqin bo'lgan dahshatli shov-shuv sodir bo'ldi va yer silkitdi; va o'tdan boshlanganimda, Oriental Kollej atrofidagi daraxtlarning tepaliklari tutli qizil olovga aylanib, yonidagi kichkina cherkovning minori vayron bo'lib ketishini ko'rdim.

en: The pinnacle of the mosque had vanished, and the roof line of the college itself looked as if a hundred-ton gun had been at work upon it.
uz: Masjidning cho'qqisi yo'qolgan edi va kollejning tomining o'zi yuz tonnalik qutuq ustida ishlayotganidek ko'rinardi.

en: One of our chimneys cracked as
uz: Chimniylarimizdan biri shunday bo'g'ilibdi:

en: if a shot had hit it, ﬂew, and a piece of it came clattering down the tiles and made a heap of broken red fragments upon the ﬂower bed by my study window.
uz: Agar unga o'q tushsa, u uchib ketadi va uning bir qismi to'g'ri-to'g'ri to'plam bo'lib, o'zimning o'quv xonadamning yonida bo'lgan gulxonada bo'lgan qizil parchalari to'plami bo'lib chiqadi.

en: I and my wife stood amazed.
uz: Xotinim va men hayratda qoldik.

en: Then I realised that the crest of Maybury Hill must be within range of the Martians’ Heat-Ray now that the college was cleared out of the way.
uz: Keyin Maybury togʻining qirgʻogʻi endi kollejni yoʻldan ozdirib tashlaganidan keyin Martians Issiqlik nurlari doirasidagi boʻlishi kerakligini tushundim.

en: At that I gripped my wife’s arm, and without ceremony ran her out into the road.
uz: Shu payt men xotinimning qo'lini ushlab, marosimsiz uni yo'lga chiqarib yubordim.

en: Then I fetched out the servant, telling her I would go upstairs my- self for the box she was clamouring for.
uz: Keyin xizmatkorni olib chiqdim va unga o'zim o'zim chiqib, u talab qilgan qutilarni olib ketishimni aytdim.

en: “We can’t possibly stay here,” I said; and as I spoke the ﬁring reopened for a moment upon the common.
uz: Men: Biz bu yerda qololmaymiz, - dedim va gapirganimda, olovlar bir muncha vaqt uchun oddiy odamlarga qayta ochildi.

en: “But where are we to go?” said my wife in terror.
uz: Ammo qayerga boramiz? - dedi rafiqam qo'rqib.

en: I thought perplexed.
uz: Men g'alati deb o'yladim.

en: Then I remembered her cousins at Leatherhead.
uz: Keyin men uning Leatherheaddagi qarindoshlari haqida esladim.

en: “Leatherhead!” I shouted above the sudden noise.
uz: Leatherhead! Men to'satdan kelgan shovqin ustidan qichqirdim.

en: She looked away from me downhill.
uz: U mendan pastga qarab ketdi.

en: The people were coming out of their houses, astonished.
uz: Odamlar hayron bo'lib, uylaridan chiqib ketayotgan edilar.

en: “How are we to get to Leatherhead?” she said.
uz: Leatherheadga qanday etib boramiz? dedi u.

en: Down the hill I saw a bevy of hussars ride under the railway bridge; three galloped through the open gates of the Oriental College; two others dis- mounted, and began running from house to house.
uz: Tog'dan tushayotganimda, temir yo'l ko'prisi ostida g'alaba qozonadigan huzarlar to'plamini ko'rdim; uch kishi Oriental kollejining ochiq darvozalari orqali galoplashdi; ikkitasi esa tushdi va uydan-uyga yugurishni boshladilar.

en: The sun, shining through the smoke that drove up from the tops of the trees, seemed blood red, and threw an unfamiliar lurid light upon everything.
uz: O'simliklarning tepaligidan chiqqan tutun orqali nur sochadigan quyosh qon qizil ko'rinardi va hamma narsaga begona yorug'lik yubordi.

en: “Stop here,” said I; “you are safe here”; and I started off at once for the Spotted Dog, for I knew the landlord had a horse and dog cart.
uz: Men: Bu yerda to'xtab turing, - dedim, bu yerda siz xavfsizsiz, - dedim va men tezda Tavlatli itga borishni boshladim, chunki uy egasining ot va it aravalari borligini bilardim.

en: I ran, for I perceived that in a moment everyone upon this side of the hill would be moving.
uz: Men yugurib ketdim, chunki bir daqiqada tog'ning bu tomonidagi hamma harakatlanayotganini payqadim.

en: I found him in his bar, quite unaware of what was going on behind his house.
uz: Men uni barida topdim, uyning orqasida nimalar bo'layotganini bilmay.

en: A man stood with his back to me, talking to him.
uz: Bir kishi menga orqasi bilan turib, u bilan gaplashardi.

en: “I must have a pound,” said the landlord, “and I’ve no one to drive it.” “I’ll give you two,” said I, over the stranger’s shoulder.
uz: Men bir funtga ega bo'lishim kerak, - dedi uy egasi, - va uni haydash uchun hech kimim yo'q. - Men sizga ikki funtni beraman, - dedim men, begona odamning yelkasidan.

en: “What for?” “And I’ll bring it back by midnight,” I said.
uz: Nima uchun?  Va men uni yarim kechaga qaytarib beraman, dedim.

en: “Lord!” said the landlord; “what’s the hurry?
uz: Shogird! dedi uy egasi; Shogird nima uchun shoshilinch?

en: I’m selling my bit of a pig.
uz: Men o'zimni maydoncha sotyapman.

en: Two pounds, and you bring it back?
uz: Ikki funt va siz uni qaytarib berasizmi?

en: What’s going on now?” I explained hastily that I had to leave my home, and so secured the dog cart.
uz: Endi nima bo'lyapti? Men darhol uyimdan chiqib ketishim kerakligini tushuntirdim va it aravachasini o'rnatdim.

en: At the time it did not seem to me nearly so urgent that the landlord should leave his.
uz: O'shanda uy egasining o'zidan ketishi kerakligi menga shunchalik muhim emas edi.

en: I took care to have the cart there and then, drove it off down the road, and, leaving it in charge of my wife and servant, rushed into
uz: Men aravachani u yerga joylashtirishga g'amxo'rlik qildim, keyin uni yo'l bo'ylab olib ketdim va uni xotinim va xizmatkorimning zimmasida qoldirib, u yerga yugurib bordim.

en: my house and packed a few valuables, such plate as we had, and so forth.
uz: uyimni va ba'zi qimmatbaho ashyolarni, bizda bo'lgan plakat va hokazolarni to'pladim.

en: The beech trees below the house were burning while I did this, and the pal- ings up the road glowed red.
uz: Men buni qilganday, uy ostidagi buk daraxtlari yonayotgan edi va yo'lning yuqori qismidagi yo'llar qizil rangda yoritilgan edi.

en: While I was occupied in this way, one of the dismounted hussars came running up.
uz: Men shu tarzda mashg'ul bo'lganimda, tushirilgan hussarlardan biri yugurib keldi.

en: He was going from house to house, warning people to leave.
uz: U uyma-uy borib, odamlarni u yerdan chiqib ketishga ogohlantirgan.

en: He was going on as I came out of my front door, lugging my treasures, done up in a tablecloth.
uz: U o'zimning eshikdan chiqib ketayotganimda, xazinalarimni ko'tarib, stol qopqog'ida to'lib-toshgan edim.

en: I shouted after him: “What news?” He turned, stared, bawled something about “crawling out in a thing like a dish cover,” and ran on to the gate of the house at the crest.
uz: Men uning orqasidan qichqirib: Qanday yangilik? - deb o'girdim.U o'girilib, ko'z o'ngidan qaradi, bir narsa deb qichqiradi, xuddi idish qopqog'iga o'xshaydigan narsa bilan chiqib ketayotganini, so'ngra uy darvozasiga yugurib boradi.

en: A sudden whirl of black smoke driving across the road hid him for a moment.
uz: Birdan yo'lni kesib o'tayotgan qora tutun to'plami uni bir daqiqaga yashirib qo'ydi.

en: I ran to my neighbour’s door and rapped to satisfy myself of what I already knew, that his wife had gone to London with him and had locked up their house.
uz: Qo'shnilar uyidan yugurib, rappini qo'zg'atdim va o'zimni o'zim bilgan narsa bilan qondirdim: uning xotini u bilan birga Londonga ketib, uyini qulflab qo'ydi.

en: I went in again, according to my promise, to get my servant’s box, lugged it out, clapped it beside her on the tail of the dog cart, and then caught the reins and jumped up into the driver’s seat beside my wife.
uz: Men va'damga binoan xizmatkorimning qutisini olish uchun yana kirdim, uni olib chiqdim, uning yonida it aravachasining quyruhiga qo'yib qo'ydim va so'ngra o'zimni boshqarishga majbur qilib, xotinimning yonida haydovchining o'rinbosariga o'tirdim.

en: In another mo- ment we were clear of the smoke and noise, and spanking down the oppo- site slope of Maybury Hill towards Old Woking.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada biz tutun va shov-shuvdan xalos bo'lib, Maybury Hillning qarshi tomonidagi tepaligidan Old Woking tomon tushdik.

en: In front was a quiet sunny landscape, a wheat ﬁeld ahead on either side of the road, and the Maybury Inn with its swinging sign.
uz: Oldinda xotirjam quyoshli manzara, yo'lning har ikki tomoniga bug'doy maydoni va Maybury Inn o'z ko'tarilgan belgisi bilan joylashgan edi.

en: I saw the doctor’s cart ahead of me.
uz: Men oldimda shifokor aravachasini ko'rdim.

en: At the bottom of the hill I turned my head to look at the hillside I was leaving.
uz: Togʻning pastki qismida men boshimni burib, ketayotgan togʻning tomoniga qaradim.

en: Thick streamers of black smoke shot with threads of red ﬁre were driving up into the still air, and throwing dark shadows upon the green treetops eastward.
uz: Qizil olov to'plamlari bilan o'qilgan qora tutunning qalin oqimlari tinch havoga ko'tarilib, sharqqa qarab yashil daraxtlarning boshlariga qorong'i soyalar yuborgan edi.

en: The smoke already extended far away to the east and west—to the Byﬂeet pine woods eastward, and to Woking on the west.
uz: Tush allaqachon sharq va g'arbga uzoq bo'lib o'tdi, Sharq tomon Byfleet borliq daraxtlariga va g'arbda Wokingga yetib bordi.

en: The road was dotted with people running towards us.
uz: Yo'lda odamlar biz tomon yugurib borishgan.

en: And very faint now, but very distinct through the hot, quiet air, one heard the whirr of a machine-gun that was presently stilled, and an intermittent cracking of ri- ﬂes.
uz: Endi juda zaif, lekin issiq va tinch havo orqali juda aniq, hozirda to'xtatilgan mashinasozning shovqinini va o'tkir-o'chir riflelarning qirib tashlanishini eshitish mumkin edi.

en: Apparently the Martians were setting ﬁre to everything within range of their Heat-Ray.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, Marsliklar issiqlik nurlari doirasidagi har bir narsaga olov qo'yishgan.

en: I am not an expert driver, and I had immediately to turn my attention to the horse.
uz: Men tajribali haydovchi emasman va darhol o'zimning e'tiborimni otga qaratishim kerak edi.

en: When I looked back again the second hill had hidden the black smoke.
uz: Men yana orqaga qarab ko'rdimki, ikkinchi tepalik qora tutunni yashirib qo'ygan edi.

en: I slashed the horse with the whip, and gave him a loose rein until Woking and Send lay between us and that quivering tumult.
uz: Men otni qamchilab o'chirib yubordim va unga to Woking va Send o'zimiz va o'sha titraydigan shov-shuv o'rtasida bo'lgunga qadar qo'yib berdim.

en: I overtook and passed the doctor between Woking and Send.
uz: Men shifokorni Woking va Send o'rtasida bosib o'tdim.

en: CHAPTER 10 IN THE STORM Leatherhead is about twelve miles from Maybury Hill.
uz: 10 - bob Shov-shuhratda Leatherhead Maybury tepaligidan taxminan o'n ikki mil uzoqlikda joylashgan.

en: The scent of hay was in the air through the lush meadows beyond Pyrford, and the hedges on ei- ther side were sweet and gay with multitudes of dog-roses.
uz: Pirforddan tashqaridagi bo'g'im-bo'g'im o'tlaridan ko'tarilib, havoda hay hidini ko'targan edi, u tomondagi qo'rqinchlar esa go'zal va go'zal edi, ko'pgina it-ro'zlar bilan.

en: The heavy ﬁring that had broken out while we were driving down Maybury Hill ceased as abruptly as it began, leaving the evening very peaceful and still.
uz: Maybury tepaligidan tushayotganimizda sodir bo'lgan og'ir o'qlar boshlanayotganidek to'xtadi va kechasi juda tinch va tinch bo'ldi.

en: We got to Leatherhead without misadventure about nine o'clock, and the horse had an hour's rest while I took supper with my cousins and commended my wife to their care.
uz: To'qqiz soat atrofida hech qanday baxtsiz hodisa bo'lmagan holda Leatherheadga yetib keldik va ot bir soatlik dam olishdi, men esa qarindoshlarim bilan kechki ovqatni yeb, xotinimni ularning g'amxo'rligi uchun maqtab qoldim.

en: My wife was curiously silent throughout the drive, and seemed oppressed with forebodings of evil.
uz: Xotinim sayohat davomida g'ayritabiiy tarzda sukut saqlashdi va yovuzlikning oldindan ko'rinishi bilan o'zini siqib olgan ko'rinardi.

en: I talked to her reassuringly, pointing out that the Martians were tied to the Pit by sheer heaviness, and at the utmost could but crawl a little out of it; but she answered only in monosyllables.
uz: Men u bilan tasalli beruvchi tarzda gaplashib, marsiyaliklar tubsizlikka og'irligi tufayli bog'langanligini va eng og'ir holatda esa undan biroz chiqib ketishlaridan boshqa narsa qilolmasligini aytdim; lekin u faqat monosillabellarda javob berdi.

en: Had it not been for my promise to the innkeeper, she would, I think, have urged me to stay in Leatherhead that night.
uz: Agar uy egasiga bergan va'dam bo'lmaganida, u o'sha kecha Leatherheadda qolishimni iltimos qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Her face, I remember, was very white as we parted.
uz: Xotira qilamanki, ajrashganimizda uning yuzi juda oq edi.

en: For my own part, I had been feverishly excited all day.
uz: O'zim esa kun bo'yi qizg'in hayajonlangan edim.

en: Something very like the war fever that occasionally runs through a civilised community had got into my blood, and in my heart I was not so very sorry that I had to re- turn to Maybury that night.
uz: O'shanda madaniyatli jamiyatda ba'zan o'tib ketadigan urush issiqligiga o'xshash narsa qonimga tushib qolgan edi va qalbimda o'sha kecha Mayburyga qaytishimga majbur bo'lganim uchun shunchalik afsuslanmagan edim.

en: I was even afraid that that last fusillade I had heard might mean the extermination of our invaders from Mars.
uz: Hatto o'zim eshitgan oxirgi o'q-qo'shqinlar Marsdan o'tgan zafarchilarni yo'q qilishdan qo'rqardim.

en: I can best express my state of mind by saying that I wanted to be in at the death.
uz: O'limda ishtirok etishni xohlaganimni aytish orqali fikrimni ifodalashim mumkin.

en: It was nearly eleven when I started to return.
uz: Men qaytib kelishni boshlaganimda deyarli o'n bir soat edi.

en: The night was unexpectedly dark; to me, walking out of the lighted passage of my cousins' house, it seemed indeed black, and it was as hot and close as the day.
uz: Kechasi kutilmagan darajada qorong'i edi; men o'g'limning uyidan nurli yo'ldan chiqib ketayotganimda, chindan ham qora ko'rinardi va kun kun kabi issiq va yaqin edi.

en: Overhead the clouds were driving fast, albeit not a breath stirred the shrubs about us.
uz: Osmonda bulutlar tez harakatlanayotgan edi, ammo bir nafas ham o'sha yerda o'simliklarni o'zgartirmagan edi.

en: My cousins' man lit both lamps.
uz: Oʻgʻillarimning oʻgʻli ikkala chiroqni yoqdi.

en: Happily, I knew the road intimately.
uz: Yaxshiyamki, men yo'lni yaxshi bilganman.

en: My wife stood in the light of the doorway, and watched me until I jumped up into the
uz: Xotinim eshikning yorug'ligida turib, meni ko'z o'ngimda ko'rib turardi.

en: Then abruptly she turned and went in, leaving my cousins side by side wishing me good hap.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan o'girilib kirdi va qarindoshlarimni yonma-yon qoldirib, menga omad tilab kirdi.

en: I was a little depressed at ﬁrst with the contagion of my wife's fears, but very soon my thoughts reverted to the Martians.
uz: Boshida rafiqamning qo'rquvlari bilan biroz tushkunlikka tushdim, lekin tez orada mening fikrlarim marsiyaliklarga qaytdi.

en: At that time I was absolute- ly in the dark as to the course of the evening's ﬁghting.
uz: O'sha paytda kechqurun janglar qanday o'tishi to'g'risida aniq bilmasdim.

en: I did not know even the circumstances that had precipitated the conﬂict.
uz: Hatto urushga sabab bo'lgan holatlarni ham bilmasdim.

en: As I came through Ock- ham (for that was the way I returned, and not through Send and Old Wok- ing) I saw along the western horizon a blood-red glow, which as I drew nearer, crept slowly up the sky.
uz: Ock-hamdan o'tganimda (man qaytib kelgan yo'l o'sha edi, lekin Old Wok-ing va Send-ning yo'lidan emas) g'arbiy ufq bo'ylab qon qizil nurni ko'rdim, u yaqinlashib borganimda, osmonni sekin-sakin ko'tardi.

en: The driving clouds of the gathering thunder- storm mingled there with masses of black and red smoke.
uz: U yerda to'plangan momaqaldiroq bulutlari qora va qizil tutunning ko'pligi bilan aralashdi.

en: Ripley Street was deserted, and except for a lighted window or so the vil- lage showed not a sign of life; but I narrowly escaped an accident at the cor- ner of the road to Pyrford, where a knot of people stood with their backs to me.
uz: Ripley ko'chasi charchagan edi va chiroqli deraza yoki shunga o'xshab bo'lsa-da, shaharda hayotning izlari yo'q edi; lekin men Pyrfordga yo'lning burchagida yuz bergan baxtsiz hodisaga to'xtamasdan qochdim.

en: They said nothing to me as I passed.
uz: O'tib ketayotganimda menga hech narsa aytmadilar.

en: I do not know what they knew of the things happening beyond the hill, nor do I know if the silent houses I passed on my way were sleeping securely, or deserted and empty, or ha- rassed and watching against the terror of the night.
uz: Ular tog'ning tashqarisida sodir bo'layotgan voqealar haqida nimalar bilganini bilmayman, yo'limda o'tgan bechora uylar xavfsiz uxlaganmi, yo bo'sh va bo'shmi, yoki tungi dahshatga qarshi ko'z tikib turishganmi yoki yo'qmi, bilmayman.

en: From Ripley until I came through Pyrford I was in the valley of the Wey, and the red glare was hidden from me.
uz: Ripleydan Pyrfordni o'tkazgunimcha, men Wey vodiysida edim va qizil yorug'lik mendan yashirin edi.

en: As I ascended the little hill beyond Pyrford Church the glare came into view again, and the trees about me shiv- ered with the ﬁrst intimation of the storm that was upon me.
uz: Pyrford cherkovidan tashqaridagi kichkina tepalikka ko'tarilganimda, yana bir bor yorqinlik ko'rindi va atrofimdagi daraxtlar menga to'satdan bo'lgan to'fonning birinchi tasdig'ini ko'rsatdi.

en: Then I heard midnight pealing out from Pyrford Church behind me, and then came the silhouette of Maybury Hill, with its tree-tops and roofs black and sharp against the red.
uz: Keyin men orqamdan Pyrford cherkovidan yarim kechasi ko'tarilganini eshitdim va keyin Maybury tog'ining silhueti paydo bo'ldi, uning daraxtlari va tomlari qora va qizil rangda qizil rangga o'xshaydi.

en: Even as I beheld this a lurid green glare lit the road about me and showed the distant woods towards Addlestone.
uz: Hatto buni ko'rganimda ham, atrofimda yo'lni yorug' yashil yorug'lik yoritib, Addleston tomon uzoq o'rmonlarni ko'rsatdi.

en: I felt a tug at the reins.
uz: Men o'zimni tirik his qildim.

en: I saw that the driving clouds had been pierced as it were by a thread of green ﬁre, sudden- ly lighting their confusion and falling into the ﬁeld to my left.
uz: Men ko'rdimki, haydovchilik bulutlari xuddi yashil olov to'g'riligi bilan o'rab olingan bo'lib, to'satdan ularning g'alati joylarini yorib, chap tomonimdagi maydonga tushdi.

en: It was the third falling star!
uz: Bu uchinchi quyilgan yulduz edi!

en: Close on its apparition, and blindingly violet by contrast, danced out the ﬁrst lightning of the gathering storm, and the thunder burst like a rocket overhead.
uz: O'z ko'rinishi yaqinida, va o'zgacha ko'rinishi bilan ko'r bo'lgan rang-barang, to'plangan bo'ronning birinchi chaqmoqlari raqsga tushdi va momaqaldiroq raketa kabi boshdan urdi.

en: The horse took the bit between his teeth and bolted.
uz: Ot tishlari orasidagi bitni olib, bo'g'ib ketdi.

en: A moderate incline runs towards the foot of Maybury Hill, and down this we clattered.
uz: Maybury tog'ining oyoq ostiga qarab o'rtacha bo'g'in yuradi va bu yoqqa tushib, biz to'qnashdik.

en: Once the lightning had begun, it went on in as rapid a succes- sion of ﬂashes as I have ever seen.
uz: Yomg'ir boshlanganidan so'ng, men hech qachon ko'rmagan chaqmoqlarning tezligi bilan davom etdi.

en: The thunderclaps, treading one on the heels of another and with a strange crackling accompaniment, sounded more like the working of a gigantic electric machine than the usual detonat-
uz: Bir-birining orqasidan qadam bosgan va g'alati qichqiriq bilan birga bo'lgan chaqmoqlar odatdagidan ko'ra ulkan elektr mashinasining ishiga o'xshaydi.

en: The ﬂickering light was blinding and confusing, and a thin hail smote gustily at my face as I drove down the slope.
uz: O'z ko'zi bilan ko'rmaydigan va chalg'itadigan yorug'lik ko'z o'ngimga tushdi va men tomondan yo'lni o'tib borayotganimda, kamroq yomg'ir yuzimga yoqimli o'tdi.

en: At ﬁrst I regarded little but the road before me, and then abruptly my at- tention was arrested by something that was moving rapidly down the oppo- site slope of Maybury Hill.
uz: Boshida men oldimda turgan yo'ldan boshqa hech narsaga e'tibor bermadim, keyin birdan Maybury Hillning qarshilik ko'tarilgan tomoniga tezda o'tib borayotgan narsa mening e'tiborimni to'xtatdi.

en: At ﬁrst I took it for the wet roof of a house, but one ﬂash following another showed it to be in swift rolling movement.
uz: Boshida men uni uyning suyuq tomini deb o'yladim, lekin bir chaqmoqdan keyin yana bir chaqmoq tez harakatlanayotganini ko'rsatdi.

en: It was an elusive vision—a moment of bewildering darkness, and then, in a ﬂash like daylight, the red masses of the Orphanage near the crest of the hill, the green tops of the pine trees, and this problematical object came out clear and sharp and bright.
uz: Bu g'alati ko'rinish edi - g'alati qorong'ilik bir daqiqa, so'ngra kunduz yorug'ligi kabi bir chaqmoqda tog'ning cho'qqisi yaqinidagi Yetimxona qizil ko'pligi, boraklarning yashil tepaliklari va bu muammoli ob'ekt aniq, keskin va yorqin ko'rindi.

en: And this Thing I saw!
uz: Va men ko'rgan bu narsa!

en: How can I describe it?
uz: Buni qanday tasvirlay olaman?

en: A monstrous tripod, higher than many houses, striding over the young pine trees, and smashing them aside in its career; a walking engine of glittering metal, striding now across the heather; articulate ropes of steel dangling from it, and the clattering tu- mult of its passage mingling with the riot of the thunder.
uz: Ko'pgina uylardan yuqori bo'lgan ulkan uchburchak, yosh bo'ron daraxtlari ustida qadam qo'yib, ularni o'z yo'lida parchalaydi; parcha-parcha metalldan yasalgan harakatlanuvchi dvigatel, endi o't qozonidan o'tib o'tadi; undan asfaltga asoslangan qo'llari oshib turadi va uning o'tishining shov-shuvli tu-tu-tu-tu-tu-tu o'zaro aralashadi.

en: A ﬂash, and it came out vividly, heeling over one way with two feet in the air, to vanish and reappear almost instantly as it seemed, with the next ﬂash, a hundred yards nearer.
uz: Bir chaqmoq va u bir yo'ldan ikki oyoq ko'targan holda ko'tarilib, o'z ko'rinishicha, o'sha chaqmoq bilan bir yuz metr yaqinroq yaqinlashib, deyarli darhol paydo bo'ldi.

en: Can you imagine a milking stool tilted and bowled violently along the ground?
uz: Yer bo'ylab tirnoq bo'lgan va kuchli bo'lib o'tirgan sutni quyish stoli haqida tasavvur qila olasizmi?

en: That was the impression those instant ﬂashes gave.
uz: O'sha darholgi chaqmoqlar shunday taassurot qoldirdi.

en: But instead of a milking stool imagine it a great body of machinery on a tripod stand.
