uz: Ammo bir sut qo'riqchisi o'rniga, uni tripodda katta mashinalar bilan tasavvur qiling.

en: Then suddenly the trees in the pine wood ahead of me were parted, as brittle reeds are parted by a man thrusting through them; they were snapped off and driven headlong, and a second huge tripod appeared, rushing, as it seemed, headlong towards me.
uz: Oʻshanda mendan oldingi borliq daraxtidagi daraxtlar birdan parchalanib ketdi, xuddi bir odam ularni oʻz ichiga oʻtkazgan boʻgʻir choʻgʻlar kabi; ular kesib ketib, bosh koʻtarib ketishdi va ikkinchi ulkan tripod paydo boʻldi, xuddi shunday koʻrinardi, bosh koʻtarib menga yaqinlashdi.

en: And I was galloping hard to meet it!
uz: Va men uni uchratish uchun qattiq galoplashdim!

en: At the sight of the second monster my nerve went altogether.
uz: Ikkinchi g'animni ko'rganimda, g'azabim butunlay o'tdi.

en: Not stopping to look again, I wrenched the horse's head hard round to the right and in another moment the dog cart had heeled over upon the horse; the shafts smashed noisily, and I was ﬂung sideways and fell heavily into a shallow pool of water.
uz: Yana bir bor ko'rishni to'xtatmay, otning boshini o'ng tomonga o'g'irlab yubordim va boshqa bir daqiqada it aravachi otning boshiga o'tdi; shaftlar shovqincha parchalanib ketdi va men yonma-yon toshib, chuqur suv hovuzida og'ir tushdim.

en: I crawled out almost immediately, and crouched, my feet still in the wa- ter, under a clump of furze.
uz: Men deyarli darhol tashqariga chiqib, oyoqlarim hali ham o'yinda bo'lib, bir to'plam furze ostida yonma-yon qolib ketdim.

en: The horse lay motionless (his neck was broken, poor brute!) and by the lightning ﬂashes I saw the black bulk of the over- turned dog cart and the silhouette of the wheel still spinning slowly.
uz: At harakatsiz yotgan edi (qo'llari buzilgan edi, qashshoq vahshiy!) va chaqmoq chaqmoqlari bilan men ko'rdim, ko'p o'zgartirilgan it aravalarining qora qismi va velosipedning silhueti hali ham sekin aylanib borayotgan edi.

en: In an- other moment the colossal mechanism went striding by me, and passed up- hill towards Pyrford.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada, ulkan mexanizm mendan o'tib ketib, Pirford tomon tog'ni ko'tarib o'tdi.

en: Seen nearer, the Thing was incredibly strange, for it was no mere insen- sate machine driving on its way.
uz: Yaqinda ko'rib turganimizdan, bu narsa juda g'alati edi, chunki u o'z yo'lida yurayotgan oddiy mashinadan ko'ra ko'proq narsa edi.

en: Machine it was, with a ringing metallic pace, and long, ﬂexible, glittering tentacles (one of which gripped a young pine tree) swinging and rattling about its strange body.
uz: U mashinada edi, u metallga o'xshaydi va uzoq, moslashuvchan, shishab turgan tentakellar bilan (ulardan biri yosh bo'ron daraxtini ushlab turardi) o'zining g'ayrioddiy tanasi atrofida o'ynagan va qichqirishgan.

en: It picked its road as it went striding along, and the brazen hood that surmounted it moved to and fro with the inevitable suggestion of a head looking about.
uz: O'z yo'lini o'zi o'ylab oldi va uning ustida joylashgan bronza kapka o'z o'rnidan-o'rnidan o'tib, atrofini ko'rib turgan boshning g'ayratli taassurotlari bilan harakatlanardi.

en: Behind the main body was a huge mass of white metal like a gigantic ﬁsherman's basket, and puffs of green smoke squirted out from the joints of the limbs as the mon- ster swept by me.
uz: Asosiy badan orqasida katta baliq koshiga o'xshaydigan oq metallning ulkan to'plami bor edi va mon-ster men tomonidan olib ketilganda, uzumlar bo'g'inlaridan yashil tutun puflashlari chiqardi.

en: And in an instant it was gone.
uz: Bir lahzada u yo'qoldi.

en: So much I saw then, all vaguely for the ﬂickering of the lightning, in blinding highlights and dense black shadows.
uz: O'shanda men juda ko'p narsani ko'rdim, hamma narsa chaqmoqning shovqinidan, ko'rgizadigan yorug'lik va zich qora soyalar bilan.

en: As it passed it set up an exultant deafening howl that drowned the thun- der—Aloo!
uz: O'tib ketayotganda u quvonchli qichqiriq qilib, Aloo!

en: Aloo!—and in another minute it was with its companion, half a mile away, stooping over something in the ﬁeld.
uz: Aloo! va yana bir daqiqada u o'z hamkori bilan yarim mil uzoqlikda bo'lib, daladagi biron bir narsa ustida yonboshlagan edi.

en: I have no doubt this Thing in the ﬁeld was the third of the ten cylinders they had ﬁred at us from Mars.
uz: Shubhasizki, maydondagi bu narsa o'n silindrdan uchinchi bo'lib, ular bizga Marsdan o'qlashgan edi.

en: For some minutes I lay there in the rain and darkness watching, by the intermittent light, these monstrous beings of metal moving about in the dis- tance over the hedge tops.
uz: Men bir necha daqiqa davomida yomg'ir va qorong'ilikda yotgan edim va o'tkinchi yorug'lik orqali bu dahshatli metall mavjudotlarni ko'rishni kuzatardim.

en: A thin hail was now beginning, and as it came and went their ﬁgures grew misty and then ﬂashed into clearness again.
uz: Hozirgi paytda yomg'ir boshlangan edi va u kelib-ketayotganda ularning suratlari bulutli bo'lib, keyin yana aniqlikka ko'tarildi.

en: Now and then came a gap in the lightning, and the night swallowed them up.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan chaqmoq ichida bo'lak paydo bo'ldi va tun ularni yutib yubordi.

en: I was soaked with hail above and puddle water below.
uz: Yuqorida yogʻoch, pastida esa quyosh suvi boʻlgan.

en: It was some time before my blank astonishment would let me struggle up the bank to a drier position, or think at all of my imminent peril.
uz: O'zimning bepul hayratlanishim meni bankni quruqroq joyga ko'tarishga yoki yaqinlashib kelayotgan xavf-xatarimni o'ylashga imkon bermasidan oldin bir muncha vaqt o'tdi.

en: Not far from me was a little one-roomed squatter's hut of wood, sur- rounded by a patch of potato garden.
uz: Mendan uzoq emas, kartoshka bog'i bo'ylab o'rab olingan, bitta xonani o'z ichiga olgan yog'ochdan yasalgan kichkina hovli bor edi.

en: I struggled to my feet at last, and, crouching and making use of every chance of cover, I made a run for this.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, to'g'ri yo'lga chiqish uchun kurashdim va qo'zg'algan va qo'rquvga ega bo'lgan har bir imkoniyatdan foydalanib, shunga qochdim.

en: I hammered at the door, but I could not make the people hear (if there were any people inside), and after a time I desisted, and, availing myself of a ditch for the greater part of the way, succeeded in crawling, unobserved by these monstrous machines, into the pine woods towards Maybury.
uz: Eshikni taqillatib turdim, lekin odamlarni eshitishga undashim mumkin emas edi (agar ichkarida biror kishi bo'lsa), va bir muncha vaqtdan keyin to'xtatdim va yo'lning katta qismini bo'yinturug'dan foydalanganimdan so'ng, bu dahshatli mashinalar ko'rmagan holda maybury tomon borayotgan bo'ron o'rmonlariga kirishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: Under cover of this I pushed on, wet and shivering now, towards my own house.
uz: Shu sababdan men qo'ldan tushib, qo'zg'ayib, o'z uyimga qarab orqaga surdim.

en: I walked among the trees trying to ﬁnd the footpath.
uz: Men daraxtlar orasida yurib, yo'lni topishga harakat qildim.

en: It was very dark indeed in the wood, for the lightning was now becoming infrequent, and the hail, which was pouring down in a torrent, fell in columns through the gaps in the heavy foliage.
uz: O'rmonda juda qorong'i edi, chunki chaqmoqlar endi kam bo'lib ketardi va daryoda yog'ib kelayotgan sovuq daraxtlar og'ir bargdagi bo'shliqlar orqali ustunlarga tushib tushdi.

en: If I had fully realised the meaning of all the things I had seen I should have immediately worked my way round through Byﬂeet to Street Cobham, and so gone back to rejoin my wife at Leatherhead.
uz: Agar men ko'rgan barcha narsalarning ma'nosini to'liq tushunganimda, men darhol Byfleetdan Cobham ko'chasigacha o'z yo'limni bosib o'tardim va xotinimga Leatherheadda qo'shilish uchun qaytib keldim.

en: But that night the strangeness of things about me, and my physical wretchedness, prevented me, for I was bruised, weary, wet to the skin, deafened and blinded by the storm.
uz: Ammo o'sha kecha atrofimdagi g'ayritabiiy narsalar va jismoniy qashshoqligim meni to'xtatdi, chunki men shikastlangan, charchagan, teriga cho'kgan, bo'ron tufayli kar va ko'r bo'lgan edim.

en: I had a vague idea of going on to my own house, and that was as much motive as I had.
uz: O'z uyimga borishni o'ylayman deb o'yladim va bu mening motivimdek edi.

en: I staggered through the trees, fell into a ditch and bruised my knees against a plank, and ﬁnally splashed out into the lane that ran down from the College Arms.
uz: O'simliklar o'rtasida cho'kib, qo'rg'oqga tushib, tiz cho'kib, taxtiga qarshi o'tirdim va nihoyat kollej qurollaridan tushadigan yo'lga tushib qoldim.

en: I say splashed, for the storm water was sweeping the sand down the hill in a muddy torrent.
uz: Men shovqinli deb aytaman, chunki to'fon suvlari to'r bo'lakdan pastga cho'kkan qumni to'lqinli torrentda to'kib o'tkazgan edi.

en: There in the darkness a man blundered into me and sent me reeling back.
uz: O'sha zulmatda bir kishi menga qarshi tushib, meni qaytib yubordi.

en: He gave a cry of terror, sprang sideways, and rushed on before I could gather my wits sufﬁciently to speak to him.
uz: U qo'rquvdan qichqirib, yon tomonga o'tib ketdi va men unga gapirish uchun yetarlicha aqlimni yig'ib olmagunimdan oldin yugurib ketdi.

en: So heavy was the stress of the storm just at this place that I had the hardest task to win my way up the hill.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, bu joyda bo'lgan to'fonning sifati shunchalik og'ir bo'lganki, tog'ning ustiga ko'tarilish men uchun eng qiyin ish edi.

en: I went close up to the fence on the left and worked my way along its palings.
uz: Men o'ng tomonidagi to'siqga yaqinlashib, uning bo'laklari bo'ylab harakat qildim.

en: Near the top I stumbled upon something soft, and, by a ﬂash of lightning, saw between my feet a heap of black broadcloth and a pair of boots.
uz: Yuqoriga yaqin bo'lganimda, yumush bir narsa bilan to'xtab qoldim va chaqmoq shovqinida oyoqlarim o'rtasida qora kiyim va bir juft poyabzal to'plami ko'rildim.

en: Before I could distinguish clearly how the man lay, the ﬂicker of light had passed.
uz: Odamning qanday yotganini aniq ko'rmasimdan oldin, yorug'lik chaqmoqlari o'tib ketdi.

en: I stood over him waiting for the next ﬂash.
uz: Men uning yonida turib, keyingi chaqmoqni kutdim.

en: When it came, I saw that he was a sturdy man, cheaply but not shabbily dressed; his head was bent under his body, and he lay crumpled up close to the fence, as though he had been ﬂung violently against it.
uz: U kelganida, men uning kuchli, arzon, lekin chiroyli kiyim kiygan, boshini tanasi ostiga egib qo'ygan va o'zini to'rqinchli qilib, to'rqinchga yaqin o'tirganini ko'rdim.

en: Overcoming the repugnance natural to one who had never before touched a dead body, I stooped and turned him over to feel for his heart.
uz: O'limdan oldin hech qachon o'lik jasadga qo'l tegizmagan odamning tabiiy jirkanchligini yengib, men uni yuvganman va yuragini ko'rishga harakat qildim.

en: Apparently his neck had been broken.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, uning bo'yni sindirib ketgan edi.

en: The lightning ﬂashed for a third time, and his face leaped upon me.
uz: Mashin uchinchi marta chaqnab, uning yuzi menga o'xshaydi.

en: I sprang to my feet.
uz: Men oyoqlarimga tushib qoldim.

en: It was the landlord of the Spotted Dog, whose conveyance I had taken.
uz: Bu men olib borgan Spotted Dog-ning egasi edi.

en: I stepped over him gingerly and pushed on up the hill.
uz: Men uning ustiga g'alati qadam tashlab, tog'ni ko'tarishga harakat qildim.

en: I made my way by the police station and the College Arms towards my own house.
uz: Politsiya bo'limi va Kollej qurollari orqali o'z uyimga bordim.

en: Nothing was burning on the hillside, though from the common there still came a red glare and a rolling tumult of ruddy smoke beating up against the drenching hail.
uz: Tog'ning tepasida hech narsa yonmas edi, ammo umumiy tomondan qizil bir yorug'lik va qizil tutunning shov-shuvini ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: So far as I could see by the ﬂashes, the houses about me were mostly uninjured.
uz: O'sha chaqmoqlardan ko'rib turganimcha, atrofdagi uylar ko'pincha jarohatlanmagan edi.

en: By the College Arms a dark heap lay in the road.
uz: Kollej qurollari yonida yo'lda qorong'u bir to'plam yotgan edi.

en: Down the road towards Maybury Bridge there were voices and the sound of feet, but I had not the courage to shout or to go to them.
uz: Maybury ko'prisiga borayotgan yo'lda ovozlar va oyoqlarning ovozi eshitildi, lekin qichqirish yoki ularning oldiga borish uchun jasoratim yo'q edi.

en: with my latchkey, closed, locked and bolted the door, staggered to the foot of the staircase, and sat down.
uz: O'zimning qulog'im bilan eshikni qulflab, qulflab qo'ydim, eshikni qulflab qo'ydim, eshik oyoqlariga yetib, o'tirdim.

en: My imagination was full of those striding metallic monsters, and of the dead body smashed against the fence.
uz: Mening tasavvurim o'sha yugurib borayotgan metalli qudratli hayvonlar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi va to'siqga qarshi vayron bo'lgan jasadlar bilan to'lgan edi.

en: I crouched at the foot of the staircase with my back to the wall, shivering violently.
uz: Men orqamni devorga tikib, sinchkovlik bilan titrab, mertar oyoqlari ostiga qochib qoldim.

en: CHAPTER 11 AT THE WINDOW I have already said that my storms of emotion have a trick of exhausting themselves.
uz: 11 bob O'ZIMNING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZINING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ZING O'ING O'ZING O'ING O'ZING O'ING O'ZING O'ING O'ZING O'ING O'ZING O'ZING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ZING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O'ING O

en: After a time I discovered that I was cold and wet, and with little pools of water about me on the stair carpet.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, men sovuq va suyuq ekanimni va o'z atrofimdagi kichik suv hovuzlari solinadigan cho'qqi bo'lganligini payqadim.

en: I got up almost mechanically, went into the dining room and drank some whiskey, and then I was moved to change my clothes.
uz: Men deyarli mexanik ravishda turib, ovqatxonada o'tirib viski ichdim va keyin kiyimni o'zgartirishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: After I had done that I went upstairs to my study, but why I did so I do not know.
uz: Buni qilgandan so'ng men o'z ishxonamga yuqoriga bordim, ammo nima uchun bunday qilganimni bilmayman.

en: The window of my study looks over the trees and the railway to- wards Horsell Common.
uz: O'quvxonamning darvozasidan daraxtlar va Horsell Common shahriga boradigan temir yo'l ko'rinadi.

en: In the hurry of our departure this window had been left open.
uz: Tashlab ketishning shoshqati bilan bu deraza ochiq qoldirilgan edi.

en: The passage was dark, and, by contrast with the picture the win- dow frame enclosed, the side of the room seemed impenetrably dark.
uz: O'tish qorong'i edi va xonadonning yon tomoni, o'z ichiga olgan rasmdan farqli o'laroq, o'z ichiga kirmaydigan darajada qorong'i ko'rinardi.

en: I stopped short in the doorway.
uz: Men eshikda to'xtab qoldim.

en: The thunderstorm had passed.
uz: Shov-shuhrat o'tib ketdi.

en: The towers of the Oriental College and the pine trees about it had gone, and very far away, lit by a vivid red glare, the common about the sand pits was visible.
uz: Sharqiy kollejning minoralari va atrofidagi borliq daraxtlari yo'qolgan edi va juda uzoqda, qizil qizil yorug'lik bilan yoritilgan holda, qum maydonlari atrofidagi umumiy narsa ko'rinardi.

en: Across the light huge black shapes, grotesque and strange, moved busily to and fro.
uz: Yorug'lik bo'ylab ulkan qora shakllar, grotesk va g'alati, mashg'ul bo'lib, bir-biriga ko'chib o'tishdi.

en: It seemed indeed as if the whole country in that direction was on ﬁre—a broad hillside set with minute tongues of ﬂame, swaying and writhing with the gusts of the dying storm, and throwing a red reﬂection upon the cloud scud above.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, o'sha yo'nalishdagi butun mamlakat o'tda yonib turgandek ko'rinardi - olovning kichik tillari bilan qoplangan keng tepalik, o'tib ketayotgan bo'ronning shamollari bilan o'z-o'zidan silkitib, burib ketadi va yuqoridagi bulutlar ustidan qizil o'rinni o'tkazadi.

en: Every now and then a haze of smoke from some nearer conﬂa- gration drove across the window and hid the Martian shapes.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan yaqinroq bo'lgan bir joydan tutun g'oyasi oynadan o'tib, marsiy shakllarni yashirib turardi.

en: I could not see what they were doing, nor the clear form of them, nor recognise the black objects they were busied upon.
uz: Ular nima qilayotganini, ularning aniq shaklini ko'rmagan edim, ular ko'tarilgan qora ob'ektlarni ham tanimagan edim.

en: Neither could I see the nearer ﬁre, though the reﬂections of it danced on the wall and ceiling of the study.
uz: Men ham yaqinroq turgan olovni ko'rmasdim, ammo uning o'rinlari o'quv xonasining devorlari va plafonda raqsga tushdi.

en: A sharp, resinous tang of burning was in the air.
uz: Havoda o'tkir, o'tkir yonayotgan tang ko'rinardi.

en: I closed the door noiselessly and crept towards the window.
uz: Men eshikni shovqincha yopdim va darcha tomon yugurdim.

en: As I did so, the view opened out until, on the one hand, it reached to the houses about Woking station, and on the other to the charred and blackened pine woods
uz: Buni qilgach, ko'rinish bir tomondan Woking stantsiyasi atrofidagi uylarga, boshqa tomondan esa ko'mirlangan va qoralashgan borak daraxtlariga yetib borguncha ochildi.

en: There was a light down below the hill, on the railway, near the arch, and several of the houses along the Maybury road and the streets near the station were glowing ruins.
uz: Togʻ pastida, temir yo'lda, archa yaqinida yorug'lik bor edi va Maybury yo'li bo'ylab ko'pgina uylar va stantsiyaning yaqinidagi ko'chalar yorqin vayron edi.

en: The light upon the railway puzzled me at ﬁrst; there were a black heap and a vivid glare, and to the right of that a row of yellow oblongs.
uz: Dastlab temir yo'lning yorug'ligi meni hayratda qoldirdi; qora to'plam va yorqin yorug'lik bor edi va uning o'ng tomonida sariq oblonglar qatorida.

en: Then I perceived this was a wrecked train, the fore part smashed and on ﬁre, the hinder carriages still upon the rails.
uz: Keyin shuni payqadimki, bu vayron etilgan poyezd edi, oldingi qismi parchalangan va yonayotgan edi, to'siq vagonlari hali ham poyezdlarda edi.

en: Between these three main centres of light—the houses, the train, and the burning county towards Chobham—stretched irregular patches of dark country, broken here and there by intervals of dimly glowing and smoking ground.
uz: Ushbu uchta asosiy yorug'lik markazi o'rtasida uylar, poezd va yonayotgan shaharcha Chobham tomon yo'l olg'aygan, qorong'i yurtning tartibsiz maydonlari bo'lib, bu yerda-bu yerda kam yorqin va tutqun yerning oralig'i bo'lib ketgan.

en: It was the strangest spectacle, that black expanse set with ﬁre.
uz: Bu eng g'alati ko'rinish edi, o'sha qora ko'rinish olov bilan qoplangan edi.

en: It re- minded me, more than anything else, of the Potteries at night.
uz: Bu menga kechasi Poteriyni eslatdi.

en: At ﬁrst I could distinguish no people at all, though I peered intently for them.
uz: Boshida men hech qanday odamni farqlay olmaganman, lekin ularni diqqat bilan kuzatganman.

en: Later I saw against the light of Woking station a number of black ﬁgures hurrying one after the other across the line.
uz: Keyinchalik Woking stantsiyasining nurida bir qator qora tanli kishilar chiziqni kesib o'tganini ko'rdim.

en: And this was the little world in which I had been living securely for years, this ﬁery chaos!
uz: Va bu men yillar davomida xavfsiz yashayotgan kichik dunyo edi, bu olovli xaroba!

en: What had happened in the last seven hours I still did not know; nor did I know, though I was beginning to guess, the relation be- tween these mechanical colossi and the sluggish lumps I had seen disgorged from the cylinder.
uz: So'nggi yetti soat ichida nima sodir bo'lganini hali ham bilmasdim; shuningdek, bu mexanik kolosslar va silindrdan chiqarilayotgan bepul to'plamlar o'rtasidagi munosabatni bilmasdim.

en: With a queer feeling of impersonal interest I turned my desk chair to the window, sat down, and stared at the blackened country, and particularly at the three gigantic black things that were going to and fro in the glare about the sand pits.
uz: Shaxsiy qiziqishning g'ayritabiiy hissi bilan men ish stolimni derazaga o'zgartirib, o'tirib, qoralashgan mamlakatga, ayniqsa, qum quduqlari atrofida ko'rinadigan uchta ulkan qora narsalarga qaradim.

en: They seemed amazingly busy.
uz: Ular juda mashg'ul bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: I began to ask myself what they could be.
uz: Men o'zimdan nima bo'lishi mumkinligini so'ra boshladim.

en: Were they intelligent mechanisms?
uz: Ular aqlli mexanizmlarmi?

en: Such a thing I felt was impossible.
uz: O'zimni imkonsiz deb hisoblaganimdek, bunday narsa bo'lmaydi.

en: Or did a Martian sit within each, ruling, directing, using, much as a man's brain sits and rules in his body?
uz: Yoki bir martalik kishi har birida o'tirib, odamning miyasi o'tirib, tanasi bilan hukmronlik qilganidek hukmronlik qilgan, yo'naltirgan, ishlaganmi?

en: I began to compare the things to human ma- chines, to ask myself for the ﬁrst time in my life how an ironclad or a steam engine would seem to an intelligent lower animal.
uz: Men narsalarni insonlar bilan solishtirishni boshladim, hayotimda birinchi marta o'zimga savol berdim, qanday qilib temir yoki bug' motori aqlli pastki hayvonga o'xshaydi.

en: The storm had left the sky clear, and over the smoke of the burning land the little fading pinpoint of Mars was dropping into the west, when a soldier came into my garden.
uz: To'fon osmonni toza qoldirdi va yonayotgan yer tutuni ustida o'sib borayotgan Marsning kichkina nuqtasi g'arbga tushib borayotgan edi, bir askar bog'imga kirdi.

en: I heard a slight scraping at the fence, and rousing my- self from the lethargy that had fallen upon me, I looked down and saw him dimly, clambering over the palings.
uz: Qo'rqinchli o't qo'ydi, o'zimni o'zimga tushirgan o'zimni uyg'otgan holda, pastga qarab, uni ko'rdim, u o'z ko'rinishlarini ko'targan.

en: At the sight of another human being my torpor passed, and I leaned out of the window eagerly.
uz: Boshqa bir insoniyatni ko'rganimda, mening torporim o'tib ketdi va men charchagan holda derazaga yopishib qoldim.

en: Hist! said I, in a whisper.
uz: Hist! - dedim men shoshib.

en: He stopped astride of the fence in doubt.
uz: U shubha ostiga qo'ydigan to'siqdan o'tib to'xtadi.

en: Then he came over and across the lawn to the corner of the house.
uz: So'ngra u uy burchasiga kelib, gazondan o'tib ketdi.

en: He bent down and stepped softly.
uz: U egrilib, sekin qadam bosdi.

en: Who's there? he said, also whispering, standing under the window and peering up.
uz: U yerda kim bor? - deb so'radi u, yana shoshib, darcha ostida turib, ko'z o'ngida ko'rinadi.

en: Where are you going? I asked.
uz: Qayerga ketyapsan? deb so'radim.

en: God knows. Are you trying to hide? That's it. Come into the house, I said.
uz: Alloh biladi. - O'zingizni yashirishga harakat qilyapsizmi? - O'sha bor. - Ushanga kiring, - dedim men.

en: I went down, unfastened the door, and let him in, and locked the door again.
uz: Men tushdim, eshikni ochdim, unga kirishga ruxsat berdim va eshikni yana qulflab qo'ydim.

en: I could not see his face.
uz: Uning yuzini ko'rmadim.

en: He was hatless, and his coat was unbuttoned.
uz: U to'plamsiz edi va kiyimini to'plamsiz qo'ydi.

en: My God! he said, as I drew him in.
uz: Ya'ni, Xudoyim! - dedi u, men uni olib kirganimda.

en: What has happened? I asked.
uz: Nima bo'ldi? deb so'radim.

en: What hasn't? In the obscurity I could see he made a gesture of despair.
uz: Nima bo'lmadi? - deb so'raganida, ko'rishimcha, u umidsizlikni ko'rsatdi.

en: They wiped us out—simply wiped us out, he repeated again and again.
uz: Ular bizni yo'q qildilar, shunchaki yo'q qildilar, - deb takrorlagan u.

en: He followed me, almost mechanically, into the dining room.
uz: U meni deyarli mexanik tarzda ovqatxonaga kuzatib bordi.

en: Take some whiskey, I said, pouring out a stiff dose.
uz: Bir oz viski oling, - dedim men, qattiq dozani quyib berdim.

en: Then abruptly he sat down before the table, put his head on his arms, and began to sob and weep like a little boy, in a perfect passion of emotion, while I, with a curious forgetfulness of my own recent despair, stood beside him, wondering.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan dasturxon oldida o'tirib, boshini qo'llariga qo'ydi va o'g'ilcha kabi o'ziga ko'z tikib yig'lay boshladi. Men esa, o'zimning o'sha paytdagi umidsizlikimni unutib qo'yib, uning yonida turib, o'zimni o'yladim.

en: It was a long time before he could steady his nerves to answer my ques- tions, and then he answered perplexingly and brokenly.
uz: Mening savollarimga javob berish uchun u juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazib yubordi, keyin esa g'alati va murakkab javob berdi.

en: He was a driver in the artillery, and had only come into action about seven.
uz: U to'qimachilikda haydovchi bo'lib, faqat yetti soat atrofida jangga chiqdi.

en: At that time ﬁring was going on across the common, and it was said the ﬁrst party of Martians were crawling slowly towards their second cylinder under cover of a metal shield.
uz: O'sha paytda qo'shni qavatdan o'q o'tkazilgan edi va Marsliklarning birinchi guruhi metal qalqon ostida ikkinchi silindr tomon sekin-sekin ortib borayotganini aytilgan.

en: Later this shield staggered up on tripod legs and became the ﬁrst of the ﬁghting-machines I had seen.
uz: Keyinchalik bu qalqon tripod oyoqlariga ko'tarildi va men ko'rgan birinchi jang mashinalari bo'ldi.

en: The gun he drove had been unlimbered near Horsell, in order to command the sand pits, and its arrival it was that had precipitated the action.
uz: U o'rnatgan qurol Horsell yaqinida qum g'ovlariga qo'mondonlik qilish uchun cheklanmagan edi va uning kelishi harakatni tezlashtirgan edi.

en: As the limber gunners went to the rear, his horse trod in a rabbit hole and came down, throwing him into a depression of the ground.
uz: O'simliklar orqaga qarab ketayotganda, uning otining otasi tungi cho'g'iga qadam qo'yib, pastga tushdi va uni yerga tashladi.

en: At the same moment the gun exploded behind him, the ammunition blew up, there was ﬁre all about him, and he found himself lying under a heap of charred dead men and dead horses.
uz: O'sha paytda uning orqasidan qurol portladi, ammolar portladi, atrofida olov paydo bo'ldi va u o'zini ko'mirlangan o'liklar va o'lik otlar to'plami ostida yotgan holda topdi.

en: I lay still, he said, scared out of my wits, with the fore quarter of a horse atop of me.
uz: U shunday dedi: Men o'zimni qo'rqitib, o'zimni to'xtatdim, ustimda otning birinchi choragi bor edi.

en: We'd been wiped out.
uz: Biz o'zimizni yo'q qilib tashladik.

en: And the smell— good God!
uz: Va xushbo'y tutun - yaxshi Xudo!

en: I was hurt across the back by the fall of the horse, and there I
uz: Atning tushib ketishi tufayli orqamdan jarohat oldim va o'sha yerda men o'zimni jarohatladim.

en: had to lie until I felt better.
uz: O'zimni yaxshi his qilguncha yolg'on gapirishim kerak edi.

en: Just like parade it had been a minute before— then stumble, bang, swish! Wiped out! he said.
uz: Xuddi bir daqiqa o'tganday, bir daqiqa o'tgandan so'ng qoqilib, bang, swish! - dedi u.

en: He had hid under the dead horse for a long time, peeping out furtively across the common.
uz: U uzoq vaqt o'lik ot ostida yashirinib, oddiy odamlarni yashirincha ko'rib turardi.

en: The Cardigan men had tried a rush, in skirmishing or- der, at the pit, simply to be swept out of existence.
uz: Kardigan erkaklari shunchaki yo'q bo'lish uchun o'z-o'zidan harakat qilishgan edi.

en: Then the monster had risen to its feet and had begun to walk leisurely to and fro across the com- mon among the few fugitives, with its headlike hood turning about exactly like the head of a cowled human being.
uz: So'ngra haykal oyoqlariga turib, bir necha qochoq o'rtasida shaharning orqasidan sekin-sakin yurishni boshladi, uning boshga o'xshaydigan qo'rqoqligi to'g'ri qoplangan insonning boshiga o'xshaydi.

en: A kind of arm carried a complicated metallic case, about which green ﬂashes scintillated, and out of the funnel of this there smoked the Heat-Ray.
uz: O'z qo'lida murakkab metall qopqoq bor edi, uning atrofida yashil chaqmoqlar chiroqlashardi va bu qopqoqdan Heat-Ray tutadi.

en: In a few minutes there was, so far as the soldier could see, not a living thing left upon the common, and every bush and tree upon it that was not already a blackened skeleton was burning.
uz: Bir necha daqiqadan so'ng, askar ko'rib turganidek, oddiy odamning ustiga hech qanday tirik mavjudot qolmadi va uning ustida bor bo'lgan har bir buta va daraxt allaqachon qoralashgan iskanal bo'lmagan edi.

en: The hussars had been on the road beyond the curvature of the ground, and he saw nothing of them.
uz: Husarlar yer bo'g'inining orqasida yo'lda bo'lgan edilar va u ulardan hech narsa ko'rmagan edi.

en: He heard the Martians rattle for a time and then become still.
uz: U marsiylarning bir muncha vaqt shov-shuv qilishlarini eshitib, so'ngra to'xtadi.

en: The giant saved Woking station and its cluster of houses until the last; then in a moment the Heat- Ray was brought to bear, and the town became a heap of ﬁery ruins.
uz: Ulug'lik Woking stantsiyasini va uning uylar guruhi oxirgigacha saqlab qoldi; keyin bir daqiqada issiqlik nurlari ishga tushdi va shahar o'tli vayronliklar to'plamiga aylandi.

en: Then the Thing shut off the Heat-Ray, and turning its back upon the artilleryman, began to waddle away towards the smouldering pine woods that sheltered the second cylinder.
uz: So'ngra Uchin Heat-Rayni o'chirib, to'qnashuvchiga orqa tikib, ikkinchi silindrni himoya qilgan g'ayratli bo'ronlarga qarab yo'l olishi boshladi.

en: As it did so a second glittering Titan built itself up out of the pit.
uz: Shunday qilib, ikkinchi shinam Titan o'zini chuqurlikdan tikladi.

en: The second monster followed the ﬁrst, and at that the artilleryman began to crawl very cautiously across the hot heather ash towards Horsell.
uz: Ikkinchi jondor birinchi jondorning orqasidan ergashdi va to'qnashuvchi Horsellga qarab issiq cho'g'li ashdan juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'tishni boshladi.

en: He managed to get alive into the ditch by the side of the road, and so escaped to Woking.
uz: U yo'l bo'yi bo'ylab bo'lgan quduqqa tirik qolishga muvaffaq bo'ldi va Vokingga qochib ketdi.

en: There his story became ejaculatory.
uz: U erda uning hikoyasi ejaculatory bo'ldi.

en: The place was impassable.
uz: Bu joy o'tish mumkin emas edi.

en: It seems there were a few people alive there, frantic for the most part and many burned and scalded.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u yerda bir necha kishi tirik edi, aksariyatlari g'alati va ko'plari yonib, yonib ketgan edi.

en: He was turned aside by the ﬁre, and hid among some almost scorching heaps of broken wall as one of the Martian giants returned.
uz: O't uni yonib qo'ydi va marsiy ulkanlardan biri qaytib kelganida, u devorlarning deyarli yonib ketadigan to'plamlari orasida yashirinib qoldi.

en: He saw this one pursue a man, catch him up in one of its steely tentacles, and knock his head against the trunk of a pine tree.
uz: U bu odamni kuzatib borayotganini ko'rdi, uni o'zining po'latli tentakellaridan biriga qo'yib, boshini bo'ron daraxtining tamg'asiga urdi.

en: At last, after nightfall, the artilleryman made a rush for it and got over the railway embankment.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, tun tushgandan so'ng, to'qnashuvchi shovqin qilib, temir yo'l qirg'og'idan o'tib ketdi.

en: Since then he had been skulking along towards Maybury, in the hope of getting out of danger Londonward.
uz: O'shandan beri u xavfdan xalos bo'lib, Londonga borishni umid qilib, Mayburyga qarab o'z yo'lidan yurgan edi.

en: People were hiding in trenches and cel- lars, and many of the survivors had made off towards Woking village and Send.
uz: Odamlar tranch va mahbusxonalarda yashiringan edilar va ko'pgina omon qolganlar Woking qishlog'i va Sendga qarab yo'lga chiqishgan edi.

en: He had been consumed with thirst until he found one of the water
uz: U suvlardan birini topmaguncha, chanqagan edi.

en: mains near the railway arch smashed, and the water bubbling out like a spring upon the road.
uz: Poyezd arxi yaqinidagi tarmoqlar parchalanib ketdi va suv yo'ldagi buloq kabi bo'lib chiqdi.

en: That was the story I got from him, bit by bit.
uz: Bu men undan biroz-biroz eshitgan hikoyam edi.

en: He grew calmer telling me and trying to make me see the things he had seen.
uz: O'shanda u menga gapirib, o'zi ko'rgan narsalarni ko'rishimga harakat qilib, kamroq xotirjam bo'ldi.

en: He had eaten no food since midday, he told me early in his narrative, and I found some mutton and bread in the pantry and brought it into the room.
uz: U tushdan beri ovqat yemagan edi, bu haqda menga dastlab aytib berdi, men esa omborxonada qo'zi go'shti va non topib, xonani olib keldim.

en: We lit no lamp for fear of attracting the Martians, and ever and again our hands would touch upon bread or meat.
uz: Biz marsiyaliklarni jalb qilishdan qo'rqqanimiz uchun chiroq yoqtirmadik va ko'p marotaba qo'llarimiz non yoki go'shtga tegardi.

en: As he talked, things about us came darkly out of the dark- ness, and the trampled bushes and broken rose trees outside the window grew distinct.
uz: U gapirganida, atrofimizdagi narsalar qorong'ilikdan qorong'ilik bilan chiqdi va darcha tashqarisida bo'lgan cho'g'lar va parchalangan roza daraxtlari aniq ko'rindi.

en: It would seem that a number of men or animals had rushed across the lawn.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, ko'plab odamlar yoki hayvonlar o't o't o't o'rniga ko'tarib o'tishdi.

en: I began to see his face, blackened and haggard, as no doubt mine was also.
uz: Men uning yuzini, meningki kabi qora va chiroyli ko'rishni boshladim.

en: When we had ﬁnished eating we went softly upstairs to my study, and I looked again out of the open window.
uz: Ovqatni yeyishdan so'ng, biz salomatlik bilan o'zimning ishxonamga ko'tardik va men yana ochiq deraza orqali ko'rdim.

en: In one night the valley had become a valley of ashes.
uz: Bir kecha ichida vodiy kulga aylandi.

en: The ﬁres had dwindled now.
uz: Endi yong'inlar susaygan edi.

en: Where ﬂames had been there were now streamers of smoke; but the countless ruins of shattered and gut- ted houses and blasted and blackened trees that the night had hidden stood out now gaunt and terrible in the pitiless light of dawn.
uz: Yong'inlar bo'lgan joylarda bug'ning oqimlari bor edi; lekin kechasi yashirib qo'ygan bo'lak-bo'lak va qorong'i bo'lgan uylar va daraxtlarning ko'pgina vayronliklari endi tongning shafqatsiz nurida dahshatli va dahshatli edi.

en: Yet here and there some object had had the luck to escape—a white railway signal here, the end of a greenhouse there, white and fresh amid the wreckage.
uz: Ammo shu yerda va u yerda biror bir ob'ekt oq temir yo'l signalidan, shu yerda issiqxona oxiridan, buzarliklar orasida oq va yangi bo'lganidan qochib ketish uchun omadli edi.

en: Never before in the history of warfare had destruction been so indiscriminate and so uni- versal.
uz: Hech qachon urush tarixida bu qadar halok bo'lmagani yo'q edi.

en: And shining with the growing light of the east, three of the metallic giants stood about the pit, their cowls rotating as though they were survey- ing the desolation they had made.
uz: Sharqning ko'payib borayotgan nurida uchta metall ulkan o'g'il chuqurlik atrofida turardi, ularning ko'kraklari xuddi o'zlari qilgan vayronliklarni ko'rib chiqayotgandek aylanib borardi.

en: It seemed to me that the pit had been enlarged, and ever and again puffs of vivid green vapour streamed up and out of it towards the brightening dawn—streamed up, whirled, broke, and vanished.
uz: O'shanda chuqurlik kenglashilgan va ko'p marotaba yashil bug'ning puflashi yorqin tongga qarab o'sib-o'sib borar edi, o'sib-o'sib borar edi va yo'q bo'lib ketar edi.

en: Beyond were the pillars of ﬁre about Chobham.
uz: Bundan tashqari, Chobham atrofidagi olov ustunlari bor edi.

en: They became pillars of bloodshot smoke at the ﬁrst touch of day.
uz: Ular kunning birinchi cho'qqisida qonli tutun ustunlariga aylandi.

en: CHAPTER 12 WHAT I SAW OF THE DESTRUCTION OF WEYBRIDGE AND SHEPPERTON As the dawn grew brighter we withdrew from the window from which we had watched the Martians, and went very quietly downstairs.
uz: 12 - bob Ueybridj va Sheppertonning vayron bo'lishi haqida ko'rganim.Tunlar ko'tarilganida, biz marsiyaliklarni kuzatib turgan deraza tomondan chiqib, pastga sekin-sakin tushdik.

en: The artilleryman agreed with me that the house was no place to stay in.
uz: Artilyer men bilan rozi bo'lib, uyda qolish uchun joy yo'qligini aytdi.

en: He proposed, he said, to make his way Londonward, and thence rejoin his battery—No.
uz: Uning aytishicha, u Londonga borishni taklif qildi va u yerdan o'z batareyasiga qo'shildi.

en: 12, of the Horse Artillery.
uz: 12, otlar artileriyasi.

en: My plan was to return at once to Leatherhead; and so greatly had the strength of the Martians impressed me that I had determined to take my wife to Newhaven, and go with her out of the country forthwith.
uz: Mening rejaim shunda ediki, men darhol Leatherheadga qaytib borishim kerak edi; marsiyaliklarning kuch-quvvatidan shunchalik ta'sir oldimki, xotinimni Nyuhavenga olib ketishga va darhol u bilan mamlakatdan chiqib ketishga qaror qildim.

en: For I already perceived clearly that the country about London must inevitably be the scene of a disastrous struggle before such creatures as these could be destroyed.
uz: Chunki men allaqachon London atrofidagi mamlakat bu kabi mavjudotlarni yo'q qilishdan oldin halokatli kurashning maydoni bo'lishi kerakligini aniq tushundim.

en: Between us and Leatherhead, however, lay the third cylinder, with its guarding giants.
uz: Biroq, biz va Leatherhead o'rtasida uchinchi silinder, uning himoyachi ulkanlari joylashgan.

en: Had I been alone, I think I should have taken my chance and struck across country.
uz: Agar yolg'iz bo'lganimda, o'ylaymanki, bu imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritib, mamlakatni bosib o'tgan bo'lar edim.

en: But the artilleryman dissuaded me: It's no kind- ness to the right sort of wife, he said, to make her a widow; and in the end I agreed to go with him, under cover of the woods, northward as far as Street Cobham before I parted with him.
uz: Ammo to'qnashuvchi meni: Uni beva qilib qo'yish - to'g'ri xotinga mehribonlik emas, - deb ishontirdi va oxir-oqibat men u bilan o'rmon ostida shimoliga borishga rozi bo'ldim.

en: Thence I would make a big detour by Epsom to reach Leatherhead.
uz: Shundan keyin Epsom orqali katta yo'ldan o'tdim va Leatherheadga yetib bordim.

en: I should have started at once, but my companion had been in active ser- vice and he knew better than that.
uz: Men darhol boshlashim kerak edi, lekin hamkorim faol xizmatda edi va u bundan ham yaxshiroq bilardi.

en: He made me ransack the house for a ﬂask, which he ﬁlled with whiskey; and we lined every available pocket with packets of biscuits and slices of meat.
uz: U meni uyni to'ldirib olib, bir shishaga viski bilan to'ldirdi va biz har bir mavjud kiyimni keksa va go'sht bo'laklari bilan to'ldirib qo'ydik.

en: Then we crept out of the house, and ran as quickly as we could down the ill- made road by which I had come overnight.
uz: Keyin biz uydan chiqib ketdik va kechasi kelgan yomon yo'ldan imkon qadar tezroq yugurdik.

en: The houses seemed deserted.
uz: Uylar chindan ham chiroyli ko'rinardi.

en: In the road lay a group of three charred bodies close together, struck dead by the Heat-Ray; and here and there were things that people had dropped—a clock, a slipper, a silver
uz: Yo'lda uchta ko'mirlangan jasadlar guruhi yonib, issiqlik radiosi tomonidan o'ldirilgan edi; bu yerda va bu yerda odamlar qo'yib tashlagan narsalar bor edi: soat, choriq, kumush.

en: spoon, and the like poor valuables.
uz: Qoshiq va shunga o'xshash qimmatbaho narsalar.

en: At the corner turning up towards the post ofﬁce a little cart, ﬁlled with boxes and furniture, and horseless, heeled over on a broken wheel.
uz: Burchakda pochtaxonaga qarab burilgan kichik arava, qutilar va mebellar bilan to'lgan va otsiz, buzilgan haykalga o'girilgan.

en: A cash box had been hastily smashed open and thrown under the debris.
uz: Pul qutisi tezda ochildi va buzoqqa tashlandi.

en: Except the lodge at the Orphanage, which was still on ﬁre, none of the houses had suffered very greatly here.
uz: Yetimxonaning uyidan tashqari, u yerda hali ham olov yonayotgan edi, hech bir uy bu yerda og'ir azob chekmagan edi.

en: The Heat-Ray had shaved the chim- ney tops and passed.
uz: Heat-Ray o'sha paytdagi chempionatning yuqori qismini o'rab, o'tib ketdi.

en: Yet, save ourselves, there did not seem to be a living soul on Maybury Hill.
uz: Ammo o'zimizni qutqargan holda, Maybury tepaligida tirik jon yo'qdek ko'rinardi.

en: The majority of the inhabitants had escaped, I sup- pose, by way of the Old Woking road—the road I had taken when I drove to Leatherhead—or they had hidden.
uz: Ko'pchilik aholisi Old Woking yo'li orqali qochib ketgan, deb taxmin qilaman, men Leatherheadga borganimda o'tgan yo'lni yoki ular yashirib qo'ygan yo'lni.

en: We went down the lane, by the body of the man in black, sodden now from the overnight hail, and broke into the woods at the foot of the hill.
uz: Biz yo'lni bosib, qora kiyimda bo'lgan odamning jasadini ko'rdik, endi kechasi yog'gan yomg'irdan o'tib ketdik va tog' oyoqidagi o'rmonga kirdik.

en: We pushed through these towards the railway without meeting a soul.
uz: Biz hech bir jon bilan uchrashmasdan, ularni temir yo'l yo'liga ushlab o'tdik.

en: The woods across the line were but the scarred and blackened ruins of woods; for the most part the trees had fallen, but a certain proportion still stood, dismal grey stems, with dark brown foliage instead of green.
uz: Chegara bo'ylab o'rmonlar faqat o'rmonlarning jarohatlangan va qoralashgan xarobalari edi; aksariyat daraxtlar qulab ketgan edi, ammo ba'zi bir qismi hali ham turgan edi, qorong'i sariq bo'g'imlar, yashil rangga o'rinli qora qora rangli varaqlar.

en: On our side the ﬁre had done no more than scorch the nearer trees; it had failed to secure its footing.
uz: Bizning tomonimizda yong'in yaqindagi daraxtlarni yondirib yuborishdan boshqa narsa qilmagan edi; u o'z poydevorini ta'minlamagan edi.

en: In one place the woodmen had been at work on Saturday; trees, felled and freshly trimmed, lay in a clearing, with heaps of sawdust by the sawing-machine and its engine.
uz: Bir joyda yogʻochchilar shanba kuni ishda boʻlishgan edi; kesilgan va yangidan kesilgan daraxtlar oʻtkir joyda joylashgan edi, u yerda pichoq mashinasi va uning dvigati tomonidan pichoq toʻplami bor edi.

en: Hard by was a temporary hut, deserted.
uz: Hard by vaqtinchalik cho'piq edi, vayron edi.

en: There was not a breath of wind this morning, and everything was strangely still.
uz: Bugun ertalab shamol bo'lmadi va hamma narsa g'alati darajada to'xtab qoldi.

en: Even the birds were hushed, and as we hurried along I and the artilleryman talked in whispers and looked now and again over our shoulders.
uz: Hatto qushlar ham o'z-o'zidan so'zsiz qolishdi va biz shoshilinch harakatlanayotganda, men va to'qnashuvchi shov-shuv bilan gaplashib, ba'zan yelkamizdan ko'tarib turardik.

en: Once or twice we stopped to listen.
uz: Bir-ikki marta tinglash uchun to'xtadik.

en: After a time we drew near the road, and as we did so we heard the clatter of hoofs and saw through the tree stems three cavalry soldiers riding slowly towards Woking.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, yo'lga yaqinlashdik va shunday qilib, qo'zg'oqlarning qichqirishini eshitdik va daraxt bo'g'inlari orqali uchta kavaleriya askarining Wokingga sekin-sakin borayotganini ko'rdik.

en: We hailed them, and they halted while we hurried towards them.
uz: Biz ularga salom berdik va ular biz ularga yaqinlashayotganda to'xtashdi.

en: It was a lieutenant and a couple of privates of the 8th Hussars, with a stand like a theodolite, which the artilleryman told me was a heliograph.
uz: Bu o'n sakkizinchi huzarlar bo'linmasining leytenanti va bir nechta harbiylari edi, ular teodolit kabi bo'lgan edilar, ammo artilyer menga u heliograf deb aytdi.

en: You are the ﬁrst men I've seen coming this way this morning, said the lieutenant.
uz: Sizlar bugun ertalab bu yo'ldan kelayotgan birinchi odamlarsiz, dedi leytenant.

en: What's brewing? His voice and face were eager.
uz: Nima tayyorlanmoqda? - deb so'raganida uning ovozi va yuzi g'ayratli edi.

en: The men behind him stared curiously.
uz: Uning orqasidagi erkaklar qiziquvchanlik bilan qarab turishdi.

en: The artilleryman jumped down the bank into the road and saluted.
uz: Artilyer qirg'og'idan yo'lga tushib, salom berdi.

en: Gun destroyed last night, sir.
uz: Kecha kechasi qurol yo'q qilindi, sir.

en: Trying to rejoin battery, sir.
uz: Batareyaga qaytishga harakat qilyapman, sir.

en: You'll come in sight of the Martians, I expect, about half a mile along this road. What the dickens are they like? asked the lieutenant.
uz: O'ylaymanki, siz bu yo'l bo'ylab yarim mil uzoqlikda Marsliklar ko'rinishini ko'rasiz. - Diknlar qanday? deb so'radi leytenant.

en: Giants in armour, sir.
uz: Jig'onlar qurol-yarog'ida, sir.

en: Three legs and a body like 'lu- minium, with a mighty great head in a hood, sir. Get out! said the lieutenant.
uz: Uchta oyoq va lu-minium kabi badanli, katta boshli, katta boshli bosh, xo'jayinim.

en: What confounded nonsense! You'll see, sir.
uz: Qanday bejiz gaplar! - deyishdi. Siz ko'rasiz, xo'jayinim.

en: They carry a kind of box, sir, that shoots ﬁre and strikes you dead. What d'ye mean—a gun? No, sir, and the artilleryman began a vivid account of the Heat- Ray.
uz: Ular o'zlarida o'q tutib, sizni o'ldiradigan quti-qudratni olib ketishadi, xudoim. Qo'zg'or qutuq nima? - deb so'rashadi. Yo'q, xudoim, - deb javob berdi artilyer.

en: Halfway through, the lieutenant interrupted him and looked up at me.
uz: Yarim yo'lda lotinent uni to'xtatib, menga ko'z tikdi.

en: I was still standing on the bank by the side of the road.
uz: Men hali ham yo'l bo'yi bo'ylab qirg'oqda turardim.

en: It's perfectly true, I said.
uz: Men: Bu mutlaqo haqiqat, - dedim.

en: Well, said the lieutenant, I suppose it's my business to see it too.
uz: - Eh, - dedi boshliq, - buni ko'rish ham mening ishimdir, deb o'ylayman.

en: Look here—to the artilleryman—we're detailed here clearing people out of their houses.
uz: Bu yerda Artilyerga qarang, biz odamlarni uylaridan chiqarib yuborish haqida batafsil ma'lumot beramiz.

en: You'd better go along and report yourself to Brigadier-General Mar- vin, and tell him all you know.
uz: O'zingizni brigadir-general Mar-vinga xabarlab, unga bilganingizning barchasini aytib bering.

en: Know the way? I do, I said; and he turned his horse southward again.
uz: Yo'lni bilasizmi? - dedim men va u otini yana janubiy tomonga burdi.

en: Half a mile, you say? said he.
uz: - Yarim mil, deysizmi? - dedi u.

en: At most, I answered, and pointed over the treetops southward.
uz: Men: Agar bo'lmasin, - deb javob berdim va daraxt boshlarini janubiy tomonga ko'rsatdim.

en: He thanked me and rode on, and we saw them no more.
uz: U menga minnatdorchilik bildirib, yo'lga otlandi va biz ularni boshqa ko'rmadik.

en: Farther along we came upon a group of three women and two children in the road, busy clearing out a labourer's cottage.
uz: Keyinchalik uchta ayol va ikkita bola to'plamini yo'lda uchratdik, ular ishchi uyini tozalash bilan band edilar.

en: They had got hold of a little hand truck, and were piling it up with unclean- looking bundles and shabby furniture.
uz: Ular kichik bir yuk mashinasini qo'lga olishdi va uni nopok ko'rinadigan to'plamlar va yomon mebellar bilan to'plashdi.

en: They were all too assiduously engaged to talk to us as we passed.
uz: Ular bizdan o'tib ketayotganda biz bilan gaplashish uchun juda g'ayratli edilar.

en: By Byﬂeet station we emerged from the pine trees, and found the country calm and peaceful under the morning sunlight.
uz: Byfleet stantsiyasida, biz cho'g'lar daraxtidan chiqib, ertalabgi quyosh nurida mamlakatni tinch va xotirjam deb topdik.

en: We were far beyond the range of the Heat-Ray there, and had it not been for the silent desertion of some of the houses, the stirring movement of packing in others, and the knot of soldiers standing on the bridge over the railway and staring down the line towards Woking, the day would have seemed very like any other Sunday.
uz: Biz u erda issiqlik radiosining chegarasidan ancha pastda edik va agar uylarning ba'zilarining sukut saqlashlari, boshqa uylarda to'plashlarning g'ayratli harakatlari va temir yo'l ko'prida turgan askarlar to'plamining Wokingga qarab chiziqni ko'tarib turishi bo'lmaganida edi, kun har qanday boshqa yakshanba kabi bo'lardi.

en: Several farm waggons and carts were moving creakily along the road to Addlestone, and suddenly through the gate of a ﬁeld we saw, across a stretch of ﬂat meadow, six twelve-pounders standing neatly at equal dis- tances pointing towards Woking.
uz: Addlestonga boradigan yo'l bo'ylab bir nechta ferma vagonlari va vagonlari o'rab-o'rab harakatlanayotgan edi va to'satdan, dala darvozasidan o'tib, biz tekis cho'l bo'yi bo'ylab olti o'n ikki funtlik o'simliklarni o'xshash bo'shliqlarda Wokingga qarab to'g'ri turganini ko'rdik.

en: The gunners stood by the guns waiting, and the ammunition waggons were at a business-like distance.
uz: O'qchilar o'qchilar yonida turib, ularni kutishardi, ammo o'q mashinalari biznesga o'xshaydigan masofada edi.

en: The men stood almost as if under inspection.
uz: Odamlar deyarli tekshiruv ostida turganlar.

en: That's good! said I.
uz: Bu yaxshi! - dedi men.

en: They will get one fair shot, at any rate. The artilleryman hesitated at the gate.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, ular bir marta adolatli o'q olishadi. Artilyer darvozasida shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: I shall go on, he said.
uz: Men davom etaman, dedi u.

en: Farther on towards Weybridge, just over the bridge, there were a number of men in white fatigue jackets throwing up a long rampart, and more guns behind.
uz: Uzoqroq Weybridge tomon, ko'prikdan biroz o'tib, oq charchash kiyimli bir qator erkaklar uzoq devorni va orqaga ko'proq qurollarni ko'tarib o'tirgan edilar.

en: It's bows and arrows against the lightning, anyhow, said the artillery- man.
uz: Bu esa chaqmoqga qarshi o'qlar va o'qlar, - dedi artileriyachi.

en: They 'aven't seen that ﬁre-beam yet. The ofﬁcers who were not actively engaged stood and stared over the treetops southwestward, and the men digging would stop every now and again to stare in the same direction.
uz: Ular hali o'sha yong'in nurini ko'rmagan edilar. Ish bilan band bo'lmagan ofitserlar o'rnidan turib, daraxtlarning janubi-g'arbiy tomoniga qarab turdilar, qazuvchilar esa vaqti-vaqti bilan to'xtab, bir xil yo'nalishda qarab turardilar.

en: Byﬂeet was in a tumult; people packing, and a score of hussars, some of them dismounted, some on horseback, were hunting them about.
uz: Byfleet g'alati bo'lib, odamlar to'plandi va bir do'zax huzarlar, ba'zilari tushdi, ba'zilari otda, ularni ovlab yurishdi.

en: Three or four black government waggons, with crosses in white circles, and an old omnibus, among other vehicles, were being loaded in the village street.
uz: Qishloqda uch yoki to'rtta qora hukumat vagonlari, oq doiralarda xochlar bo'lgan xochlar va boshqa transport vositalari orasida eski omnibus yuklanayotgan edi.

en: There were scores of people, most of them sufﬁciently sabbatical to have assumed their best clothes.
uz: Ko'p odamlar bor edi, ularning aksariyati eng yaxshi kiyim-kechaklarini kiyishga qodir edi.

en: The soldiers were having the greatest difﬁculty in making them realise the gravity of their position.
uz: Askarlar o'z mavqeylarining og'irligini anglashda eng og'ir qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishgan.

en: We saw one shrivelled old fellow with a huge box and a score or more of ﬂower pots containing orchids, angrily expostulating with the corporal who would leave them be- hind.
uz: Biz katta quti va orkidelarni o'z ichiga olgan ko'plab gul idishlari bo'lgan, g'azabda ularni qo'yib yuboradigan korpol bilan o'zaro suhbatlashayotgan bir keksa odamni ko'rdik.

en: I stopped and gripped his arm.
uz: Men to'xtatdim va uning qo'lini ushlab qoldim.

en: Do you know what's over there? I said, pointing at the pine tops that hid the Martians.
uz: O'sha yerda nima borligini bilasizmi? - dedim men, marsiyaliklarni yashirgan bo'rmonlar ustiga ko'rsatdim.

en: Eh? said he, turning.
uz: Eh? - dedi u, o'girilib.

en: I was explainin' these is vallyble. Death! I shouted.
uz: Men bularni vallyble ekanligini tushuntirib berayotgan edim.  O'lim! deb baqirdim.

en: Death! and leaving him to digest that if he could, I hurried on after the artillery-man.
uz: O'lim! deb so'rab, unga o'zini o'ldirishni qoldirib ketdim va agar iloji bo'lsa, men to'qnashuvchining orqasidan ergashdim.

en: At the corner I looked back.
uz: Burchada orqaga qarab ko'rdim.

en: The soldier had left him, and he was still standing by his box, with the pots of orchids on the lid of it, and staring vaguely over the trees.
uz: Askar uni tashlab ketib ketgan edi, u hali ham o'z quti oldida, qo'lning qopqog'ida orkideli idishlar bilan turib, daraxtlar ustiga ko'z tikib turgan edi.

en: No one in Weybridge could tell us where the headquarters were estab- lished; the whole place was in such confusion as I had never seen in any town before.
uz: Vaybridjdagi hech kim bizga bosh qarorgohi qayerda joylashganini ayta olmagan; butun joy shu qadar chalkash ediki, men hech qachon boshqa shaharda ko'rmagan edim.

en: Carts, carriages everywhere, the most astonishing miscellany of conveyances and horseﬂesh.
uz: Qayiqlar, aravalar hamma joyda, transport vositalari va ot go'shti eng hayratlanarli turlari.

en: The respectable inhabitants of the place, men in golf and boating costumes, wives prettily dressed, were packing, river-side loafers energetically helping, children excited, and, for the most part, highly delighted at this astonishing variation of their Sunday experi- ences.
uz: Bu joyning hurmatli aholisi, golf va kemada kiyingan erkaklar, chiroyli kiyim kiygan xotinlar, to'plash, daryo bo'ylab sayohatchilar kuch-quvvat bilan yordam berish, bolalar hayajonli va ko'pincha o'zlarining yakshanba tajribalarining bu hayratlanarli o'zgarishidan juda xursand edilar.

en: In the midst of it all the worthy vicar was very pluckily holding an early celebration, and his bell was jangling out above the excitement.
uz: Bularning hammasi o'rtasida munosib vikar juda jasorat bilan erta nishonlashni o'tkazgan va uning qo'ng'iroqlari hayajonning ustunida o'tirgan edi.

en: I and the artilleryman, seated on the step of the drinking fountain, made a very passable meal upon what we had brought with us.
uz: Men va to'qnashuvchi ichimlik quduqining boshiga o'tirib, o'zimiz bilan olib kelgan narsalarimizdan juda qulay ovqat tayyorlaganmiz.

en: Patrols of soldiers—
uz: Askarlar patrulyasi

en: here no longer hussars, but grenadiers in white— were warning people to move now or to take refuge in their cellars as soon as the ﬁring began.
uz: Bu yerda o'qchilar emas, oq kiyim kiygan granatachilar odamlarni hozir harakatlanishga yoki o'q boshlanayotganidan so'ng hovlilarda panoh topishga ogohlantirmoqda.

en: We saw as we crossed the railway bridge that a growing crowd of people had assembled in and about the railway station, and the swarming platform was piled with boxes and packages.
uz: Biz temir yo'l ko'prisini kesib o'tgach, temir yo'l stantsiyasi va uning atrofida ko'payib borayotgan xaloyiq to'planganini va to'plangan platformani ko'plab qutilar va paketlar bilan to'ldirganini ko'rdik.

en: The ordinary trafﬁc had been stopped, I be- lieve, in order to allow of the passage of troops and guns to Chertsey, and I have heard since that a savage struggle occurred for places in the special trains that were put on at a later hour.
uz: Chertseyga qo'shin va qurollar o'tishiga yo'l qo'yish uchun odatdagi harakatlar to'xtatilgan edi va o'sha paytdan beri maxsus poezdlarda joy olish uchun jang bo'lib o'tganini eshitganman.

en: We remained at Weybridge until midday, and at that hour we found our- selves at the place near Shepperton Lock where the Wey and Thames join.
uz: Biz Weybridjda tushgacha qoldik va o'sha soatda Shepperton qulfining yaqinidagi joyda bo'ldik, u yerda Wey va Temza suvlari birlashadi.

en: Part of the time we spent helping two old women to pack a little cart.
uz: Ikki keksa ayolga kichik arava yigʻishlariga yordam berishga sarflagan vaqtimizning bir qismi.

en: The Wey has a treble mouth, and at this point boats are to be hired, and there was a ferry across the river.
uz: Weyning o'tkir og'zi bor va shu paytda qayiqlar ijaraga olinadi va daryo bo'ylab kema bor edi.

en: On the Shepperton side was an inn with a lawn, and beyond that the tower of Shepperton Church—it has been replaced by a spire—rose above the trees.
uz: Shepperton tomonida gazonli mehmonxona bor edi va bundan tashqari Shepperton cherkovining minorasini daraxtlar ustida gullab-yashnagan spire o'rniga oldi.

en: Here we found an excited and noisy crowd of fugitives.
uz: Bu yerda biz g'ayratli va shov-shuvli qochqinlar to'plamini topdik.

en: As yet the ﬂight had not grown to a panic, but there were already far more people than all the boats going to and fro could enable to cross.
uz: Hattoki uchuv panikaga aylanmagan edi, lekin u yerga borayotgan barcha qayiqlarning kesib o'tishiga imkon bermagan odamlarning soni ancha ko'p edi.

en: People came panting along under heavy burdens; one husband and wife were even carrying a small out- house door between them, with some of their household goods piled there- on.
uz: Odamlar og'ir yuklar ostida ko'tarilib keldilar; bir juftlik hatto o'zlari o'rtasida kichik bir eshikni olib yurgan edi, u erda uy jihozlari to'plangan edi.

en: One man told us he meant to try to get away from Shepperton station.
uz: Bir kishi bizga Shepperton stantsiyasidan qochib ketmoqchi ekanini aytdi.

en: There was a lot of shouting, and one man was even jesting.
uz: Qichqiriqlar ko'p edi va hatto bir kishi hazillashib yurgan edi.

en: The idea peo- ple seemed to have here was that the Martians were simply formidable hu- man beings, who might attack and sack the town, to be certainly destroyed in the end.
uz: Bu yerda odamlarning fikri shundaki, marsiylar shunchaki dahshatli insoniy mavjudotlar bo'lib, shaharga hujum qilib, uni talon-toroj qilishlari mumkin edi va oxir-oqibat yo'q qilinadi.

en: Every now and then people would glance nervously across the Wey, at the meadows towards Chertsey, but everything over there was still.
uz: Vaqt-vaqti bilan odamlar Wey daryosini, Chertsey tomon o'tadigan o'tlar bo'ylab g'azabga to'lib ko'rinardilar, lekin u yerda hamma narsa to'xtamaydi.

en: Across the Thames, except just where the boats landed, everything was quiet, in vivid contrast with the Surrey side.
uz: Tems daryosidan o'tib, qayiqlar jo'natgan joydan tashqari, hamma narsa osoyishta edi, bu Surrey tomoniga o'xshamaydi.

en: The people who landed there from the boats went tramping off down the lane.
uz: Qayiqlardan u yerga tushgan odamlar yo'lni bosib o'tishdi.

en: The big ferryboat had just made a journey.
uz: Katta kemasi yaqinda sayohatni boshlagan edi.

en: Three or four soldiers stood on the lawn of the inn, staring and jesting at the fugitives, without offering to help.
uz: Uch yoki to'rt nafar askar mehmonxonadagi gazonda turib, qochoqlarga ko'z tikib, ularni mazax qilishgan, ammo yordam berishga taklif qilmagan.

en: The inn was closed, as it was now within prohibited hours.
uz: Mehmonxona endi taqiqlangan soatlarda bo'lgani kabi yopildi.

en: What's that? cried a boatman, and Shut up, you fool! said a man near me to a yelping dog.
uz: Bu nima? - deb baqirdi bir kemachi va yonimda turgan bir kishi itni yelpingga: O'zingni tutib qo'y, ahmoq! - dedi.

en: Then the sound came again, this time from the direc- tion of Chertsey, a mufﬂed thud—the sound of a gun.
uz: So'ngra yana tovush keldi, bu safar Chertsey yo'nalishidan, o'q otish qilichining tovushi.

en: The ﬁghting was beginning.
uz: Urushlar boshlanayotgan edi.

en: Almost immediately unseen batteries across the river to our right, unseen because of the trees, took up the chorus, ﬁring
uz: Darhol ko'rinmas batareyalar daryo o'ng tomonida, daraxtlar tufayli ko'rinmas, chorusni boshlashdi va o'qishni boshlashdi.

en: heavily one after the other.
uz: Bir-biridan ko'ra ko'pchilik.

en: Everyone stood arrested by the sudden stir of battle, near us and yet invisible to us.
uz: Har bir kishi bizdan uzoq bo'lmagan, ammo ko'rinmas jangning to'satdan ko'tarilgan shovqinida to'xtab turdi.

en: Nothing was to be seen save ﬂat meadows, cows feeding unconcernedly for the most part, and silvery pollard willows motionless in the warm sunlight.
uz: Tasavvurga sazovor bo'lgan yerlar, ko'pincha g'amxo'rliksiz ovqatlanayotgan sigirlar va issiq quyosh nurida harakatsiz bo'lgan kumushkiy pollard soyalardan boshqa hech narsa ko'rinmas edi.

en: The sojers'll stop 'em, said a woman beside me, doubtfully.
uz: Sojerslar ularni to'xtatadi, - dedi yonimda turgan ayol.

en: A haziness rose over the treetops.
uz: Daraxtlarning boshi ustida g'alati holat paydo bo'ldi.

en: Then suddenly we saw a rush of smoke far away up the river, a puff of smoke that jerked up into the air and hung; and forthwith the ground heaved under foot and a heavy explosion shook the air, smashing two or three win- dows in the houses near, and leaving us astonished.
uz: Toʻsatdan daryo ustiga uzoqdan tutun koʻrindi, tutun puflanishi havoga koʻtarildi va oshib ketdi; va darhol yer oyoq osti boʻlib ketdi va kuchli portlash havoga shovqin berdi, yaqindagi uylarda ikki yoki uchta uyni buzdi va bizni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: Here they are! shouted a man in a blue jersey.
uz: Bular bor! - deb baqirdi ko'k jersey kiygan kishi.

en: Yonder! Quickly, one after the other, one, two, three, four of the armoured Mar- tians appeared, far away over the little trees, across the ﬂat meadows that stretched towards Chertsey, and striding hurriedly towards the river.
uz: Tez orada, bir-biridan keyin, bitta, ikkita, uch, to'rtta zirehli martian paydo bo'ldi, kichik daraxtlar ustida, Chertsey tomon cho'zilgan tekis o'tlar bo'ylab, daryo tomon shoshilinch qadamlar qo'yib.

en: Little cowled ﬁgures they seemed at ﬁrst, going with a rolling motion and as fast as ﬂying birds.
uz: Boshida ular o'zlarini ko'p ko'targan, ko'tarilgan harakatda va uchib borayotgan qushlar kabi tez harakatda ko'rinishgan.

en: Then, advancing obliquely towards us, came a ﬁfth.
uz: So'ngra biz tomon o'zgarib o'tgan beshinchi o'rinbosari keldi.

en: Their armoured bod- ies glittered in the sun as they swept swiftly forward upon the guns, grow- ing rapidly larger as they drew nearer.
uz: Ularning qurol-yarog'i quyoshda parlashar edi, chunki ular qurollarni tezda oldinga ko'tarishdi va yaqinlashganda tezda kattaroq bo'lib borishdi.

en: One on the extreme left, the remotest that is, ﬂourished a huge case high in the air, and the ghostly, terrible Heat- Ray I had already seen on Friday night smote towards Chertsey, and struck the town.
uz: O'tkir chap tomondagi, ya'ni eng uzoqda joylashgan, havo ostida katta holat rivojlanib borardi va juma kuni kechasi ko'rgan hayajonli va dahshatli issiqlik nurlari Chertseyga qarab urib, shaharni bosib o'tdi.

en: At sight of these strange, swift, and terrible creatures the crowd near the water's edge seemed to me to be for a moment horror-struck.
uz: Ushbu g'ayrioddiy, tezkor va dahshatli mavjudotlarni ko'rib, suv bo'yiga yaqin turgan xaloyiq bir zumga dahshatga tushdi.

en: There was no screaming or shouting, but a silence.
uz: Qichqiriq yoki qichqiriq emas, balki xotirjamlik edi.

en: Then a hoarse murmur and a move- ment of feet—a splashing from the water.
uz: So'ngra qichqiriq va oyoqlarning harakatlari suvdan tushib chiqdi.

en: A man, too frightened to drop the portmanteau he carried on his shoulder, swung round and sent me stagger- ing with a blow from the corner of his burden.
uz: Bir kishi, omonida ko'tarilgan portmanteauni tashlab ketish uchun juda qo'rqqanidan so'ng, o'zini burchasiga tikib, meni og'irligi burchagidan urib yubordi.

en: A woman thrust at me with her hand and rushed past me.
uz: Bir ayol qo'li bilan menga urib, yonimdan o'tib ketdi.

en: I turned with the rush of the people, but I was not too terriﬁed for thought.
uz: Odamlarning shov-shuvidan yuz o'girdim, lekin o'ylamasdan qo'rqardim.

en: The terrible Heat-Ray was in my mind.
uz: Men dahshatli issiqlik nurini o'yladim.

en: Get under water! I shouted, unheeded.
uz: Suv ostida qoling! - deb baqirdim men, lekin hech kim menga e'tibor bermadi.

en: I faced about again, and rushed towards the approaching Martian, rushed right down the gravelly beach and headlong into the water.
uz: Men yana yuzma-yuz bo'lib, yaqinlashib kelayotgan marsiyalik kishiga qarab yugurib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qirg'oq sohilidan tushdim va boshim bilan suvga tushib qoldim.

en: Others did the same.
uz: Boshqalar ham xuddi shunday qildilar.

en: A boatload of people putting back came leaping out as I rushed past.
uz: Men orqamdan o'tib ketayotganimda, qayg'u to'plamdagi odamlar orqaga chiqib ketishdi.

en: The stones under my feet were muddy and slippery, and the river was so
uz: Oyoqlarim ostidagi toshlar lo'l va chiziqli edi, daryo esa shunchalik kuchli edi.

en: low that I ran perhaps twenty feet scarcely waist-deep.
uz: Ehtimol, yigirma fut pastga, belning chuqurligiga ham yetmagan bo'lsam kerak.

en: Then, as the Martian towered overhead scarcely a couple of hundred yards away, I ﬂung myself forward under the surface.
uz: So'ngra, marsiyalik uchib borayotganda, bir necha yuz metr masofada bo'lganida, men o'zimni yuzaga tashladim.

en: The splashes of the people in the boats leaping into the river sounded like thunderclaps in my ears.
uz: Daryoga suzib o'tadigan qayiqlardagi odamlarning shovqinlari quloqlarimda momaqaldiroq kabi eshitildi.

en: People were landing hastily on both sides of the river.
uz: Odamlar daryoning har ikki tomoniga tez-tez tushayotgan edi.

en: But the Martian machine took no more no- tice for the moment of the people running this way and that than a man would of the confusion of ants in a nest against which his foot has kicked.
uz: Ammo Mars mashinasi odamlar shu yo'ldan va boshqa yo'ldan yugurish payti uchun odam o'z oyoqlari cho'kkan yuvidagi burilishdagi murralarning chalg'ishiga qaraganda ko'proq e'tibor bermadi.

en: When, half suffocated, I raised my head above water, the Martian's hood pointed at the batteries that were still ﬁring across the river, and as it ad- vanced it swung loose what must have been the generator of the Heat-Ray.
uz: Yarim cho'kganimda, boshimni suv ustiga ko'targanimda, marsiyaliklarning qo'rqoqligi daryo bo'ylab hali ham otilgan batareyalarga ishora qildi va u o'tib ketayotganda, issiqlik nurining ishlab chiqaruvchisi bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsani bo'shashtirdi.

en: In another moment it was on the bank, and in a stride wading halfway across.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada u qirg'oqda edi va o'rta yo'ldan o'tib o'tadi.

en: The knees of its foremost legs bent at the farther bank, and in anoth- er moment it had raised itself to its full height again, close to the village of Shepperton.
uz: Uning oldingi oyoqlarining tizlari uzoqroq qirg'og'iga bog'langan va bir necha daqiqada u Shepperton qishlog'i yaqinida o'zini to'liq balandligiga qaytadan ko'targan.

en: Forthwith the six guns which, unknown to anyone on the right bank, had been hidden behind the outskirts of that village, ﬁred simultane- ously.
uz: O'ng tomondagi hech kim bilmagan oltita qurol o'sha qishloqda yashiringan bo'lib, bir vaqtning o'zida shovqin chiqardi.

en: The sudden near concussion, the last close upon the ﬁrst, made my heart jump.
uz: O'shanda boshimga to'satdan shovqin tushdi va yuragim sarosimaga tushib qoldi.

en: The monster was already raising the case generating the Heat- Ray as the ﬁrst shell burst six yards above the hood.
uz: Mushtak allaqachon issiqlik rayini ishlab chiqargan holda holatni ko'targan edi, chunki birinchi shell qopqoqdan olti metr yuqoriga burildi.

en: I gave a cry of astonishment.
uz: Men hayratda qoldim.

en: I saw and thought nothing of the other four Martian monsters; my attention was riveted upon the nearer incident.
uz: Men boshqa to'rtta marsiy qudratli hayvonlarni ko'rmaganman va ular haqida hech narsa o'ylamaganman; diqqatimni yaqinroq bo'lgan hodisaga qaratganman.

en: Si- multaneously two other shells burst in the air near the body as the hood twisted round in time to receive, but not in time to dodge, the fourth shell.
uz: Si- multaneously boshqa ikki qo'g'irchoq jasad yaqinida havoga burib ketadi, chunki kapka to'rtinchi qo'g'irchoqni olish uchun, lekin undan qochish uchun vaqt o'tgach, atrofida aylanib boradi.

en: The shell burst clean in the face of the Thing.
uz: Qo'rquv narsa yuziga to'lib-toshdi.

en: The hood bulged, ﬂashed, was whirled off in a dozen tattered fragments of red ﬂesh and glittering metal.
uz: Qo'lchoqning o'lchovli, yorqinligi bir do'zaynasi qizil go'sht va parcha-parcha metall parchalari bo'lib o'zgarib ketdi.

en: Hit! shouted I, with something between a scream and a cheer.
uz: Hit! - deb baqirdim men, bir qichqiriq va bir quvonch o'rtasida bir narsa bor edi.

en: I heard answering shouts from the people in the water about me.
uz: Men atrofimda suvda turgan odamlarning qichqiriqlariga javob berayotganini eshitdim.

en: I could have leaped out of the water with that momentary exultation.
uz: Men o'sha vaqtinchalik shodlik bilan suvdan chiqardim.

en: The decapitated colossus reeled like a drunken giant; but it did not fall over.
uz: Boshlari kesilgan koloss mast bo'lgan g'ayritabiiy bo'lib yugurdi, lekin u qulab tushmadi.

en: It recovered its balance by a miracle, and, no longer heeding its steps and with the camera that ﬁred the Heat-Ray now rigidly upheld, it reeled swiftly upon Shepperton.
uz: U moʻʼjizaviy tarzda muvozanatini tikladi va qadamlariga eʼtibor bermay, issiqlik radiyasini ishga tushirgan kamerani qattiq ushlab turgan holda Sheppertonni tezda bosib oldi.

en: The living intelligence, the Martian within the hood, was slain and splashed to the four winds of heaven, and the Thing was now but a mere intricate device of metal whirling to destruction.
uz: Hayotli intellekt, qo'rqinch ichida bo'lgan marsiyalik o'ldirildi va osmondagi to'rt shamolga tarqatib yuborildi va bu narsa endi vayron bo'lishga qaytayotgan metalldan iborat murakkab qurilma edi.

en: It drove along in a straight line, incapable of guidance.
uz: U to'g'ri yo'nalishda yo'l oldi, yo'l ko'rsatishga qodir emas edi.

en: It struck the tower of Shepperton Church, smashing it down as the impact of a battering ram
uz: U Shepperton cherkovining minorasini urib, uni bir qo'zi cho'qqisidan urib vayron qildi.

en: might have done, swerved aside, blundered on and collapsed with tremen- dous force into the river out of my sight.
uz: Ehtimol, o'zimni qo'yib, yonma-yon o'girib, o'zim ko'rmagan holda daryoga to'lib-toshgan bo'lar edim.

en: A violent explosion shook the air, and a spout of water, steam, mud, and shattered metal shot far up into the sky.
uz: Kuchli portlash havoni silkitdi va suv, bug', loy va parchalangan metallning bir tomiri osmonga ko'tarildi.

en: As the camera of the Heat-Ray hit the water, the latter had immediately ﬂashed into steam.
uz: Heat-Ray kamerasi suvga tushib qolganda, suv darhol bug'ga aylandi.

en: In another moment a huge wave, like a muddy tidal bore but almost scaldingly hot, came sweeping round the bend upstream.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada, to'lqinli, ammo deyarli issiq bo'lgan bo'lak kabi ulkan to'lqin o'rnidan o'tadi.

en: I saw people struggling shorewards, and heard their screaming and shouting faintly above the seething and roar of the Martian's collapse.
uz: Men odamlarni qirg'oqqa qarshi kurashayotganini ko'rdim va martianlarning qulashi va qichqirishining qaynoqligi ustida ularning qichqirishlarini va qichqirishlarini eshitdim.

en: For a moment I heeded nothing of the heat, forgot the patent need of self- preservation.
uz: Men bir zum davomida issiqlikka e'tibor bermadim, o'z-o'zimni saqlashning zarurligini unutib qo'ydim.

en: I splashed through the tumultuous water, pushing aside a man in black to do so, until I could see round the bend.
uz: Men buzg'unchi suvni cho'kib, qora kiyimda bo'lgan kishini yonga surib, bu ishni qilish uchun yonimga surdim, hatto buzg'uncha ko'rishimga qadar.

en: Half a dozen deserted boats pitched aimlessly upon the confusion of the waves.
uz: Yarim o'nlab bo'sh qayiq to'lqinlarning chalkashligiga befarqlik bilan tushdi.

en: The fallen Mart- ian came into sight downstream, lying across the river, and for the most part submerged.
uz: O'tib ketgan mart-yanlar daryo bo'ylab joylashgan va ko'pchiligi suvga cho'mgan suvda ko'rindi.

en: Thick clouds of steam were pouring off the wreckage, and through the tumultuously whirling wisps I could see, intermittently and vaguely, the gi- gantic limbs churning the water and ﬂinging a splash and spray of mud and froth into the air.
uz: G'alati bug' bulutlari xarobalardan oqib ketayotgan edi va shov-shuvli, g'alati-g'alati bo'lib o'tirgan qirg'oqlar orqali men, vaqti-vaqti bilan va kamsitib, suvni to'sib-tashlab, havoga cho'kib-chovib, balchiq va cho'g'ni cho'ktirgan ulkan bo'g'larni ko'rardim.

en: The tentacles swayed and struck like living arms, and, save for the helpless purposelessness of these movements, it was as if some wounded thing were struggling for its life amid the waves.
uz: Tentapelalar jonli qo'llar kabi o'z-o'zidan silkitib, urishardi va bu harakatlarning yordamsiz behudaligini istisno qilgan holda, o'z jonini to'ldirish uchun to'lqinlar ichida jang qilayotgan bir yaralangan narsa kabi edi.

en: Enormous quan- tities of a ruddy-brown ﬂuid were spurting up in noisy jets out of the machine.
uz: Mashinaning shov-shuvli jetslarida qizil-qora suyuqlikning ulkan miqdorlari chiqdi.

en: My attention was diverted from this death ﬂurry by a furious yelling, like that of the thing called a siren in our manufacturing towns.
uz: Mening e'tiborim bu o'lim to'lqinidan g'azablangan qichqiriq bilan chalg'ib ketdi, xuddi bizning ishlab chiqarish shaharlarimizda sirena deb nomlangan narsa kabi.

en: A man, knee- deep near the towing path, shouted inaudibly to me and pointed.
uz: To'lov yo'li yonida tiz cho'kkan bir kishi menga ovozli ovozda qichqirib, ko'rsatgich ko'rsatdi.

en: Looking back, I saw the other Martians advancing with gigantic strides down the riverbank from the direction of Chertsey.
uz: Orqaga nazar solib, boshqa marsiyaliklar Chertsey yo'nalishidan daryo bo'ylab ulkan qadamlar bilan harakatlanayotganini ko'rdim.

en: The Shepperton guns spoke this time unavailingly.
uz: Shepperton qurollari bu safar gapirgan.

en: At that I ducked at once under water, and, holding my breath until move- ment was an agony, blundered painfully ahead under the surface as long as I could.
uz: Shu zahoti men suv ostida qolib, nafasimni to'xtatib, harakat azob-uqubatga to'lib-toshganidan keyin, iloji boricha suv ostida og'irlik bilan oldinga burib ketdim.

en: The water was in a tumult about me, and rapidly growing hotter.
uz: Suv atrofimda g'alati bo'lib, tezda issiqlashib borardi.

en: When for a moment I raised my head to take breath and throw the hair and water from my eyes, the steam was rising in a whirling white fog that at ﬁrst hid the Martians altogether.
uz: Bir zum boshimni ko'tarib, nafas olib, soch va suvni ko'zlarimdan tashlaganimda, o'simlik o'sib borayotganda, boshida marsiylarni to'liq yashirgan to'p-to'p oq tuman ichida ko'tarildi.

en: The noise was deafening.
uz: Shov-shuv esa quloq solib ketdi.

en: Then I saw them dimly, colossal ﬁgures of grey, magniﬁed by the mist.
uz: So'ngra men ularni bulut tomonidan ko'paytirilgan, chiroyli bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lib ko'rdim.

en: me, and two were stooping over the frothing, tumultuous ruins of their comrade.
uz: Men va ikkitamiz o'z yo'ldoshlarining bulg'ovchi va bulg'ovchi vayronliklari ustida yonboshlagan edik.

en: The third and fourth stood beside him in the water, one perhaps two hun- dred yards from me, the other towards Laleham.
uz: Uchinchi va to'rtinchi yigitlar uning yonida suvda turgan edilar, biri mendan ikki metr uzoqlikda, ikkinchisi Laleham tomon.

en: The generators of the Heat-Rays waved high, and the hissing beams smote down this way and that.
uz: Issiqlik nurlari generatorlari yuqoriga o'girib turardi va o'sha yo'nalishdagi o'tlar shu yo'ldan va o'sha yo'ldan urildi.

en: The air was full of sound, a deafening and confusing conﬂict of noises— the clangorous din of the Martians, the crash of falling houses, the thud of trees, fences, sheds ﬂashing into ﬂame, and the crackling and roaring of ﬁre.
uz: Havo tovushlar bilan to'lib-toshgan, quloq oshuvchi va chalg'itadigan tovushlar to'qnashuvi, marsiyaliklar qichqiriqlari, yiqilgan uylarning qulashi, daraxtlarning qichqiriqlari, to'siqlar, olovga o'xshaydigan cho'pkalar, olovning qichqiriqlari va qichqiriqlari.

en: Dense black smoke was leaping up to mingle with the steam from the river, and as the Heat-Ray went to and fro over Weybridge its impact was marked by ﬂashes of incandescent white, that gave place at once to a smoky dance of lurid ﬂames.
uz: Daryodagi bug' bilan aralashib ketish uchun zich qora tutun ko'tarilgan edi va issiqlik nurlari Weybridge ustida o't-o't bo'lganida, uning ta'siri yoritilgan oq oq oq parchalar bilan belgilab qo'yilgan edi, bu esa darhol dahshatli olovlarning tutli raqsini keltirib chiqardi.

en: The nearer houses still stood intact, awaiting their fate, shadowy, faint and pallid in the steam, with the ﬁre behind them going to and fro.
uz: Yaqinda joylashgan uylar hali ham o'z taqdirini kutish uchun to'liq turgan edi, qorong'i, ojiz va bug'da bo'sh bo'lib, orqasidagi olov o'z-o'zidan burib ketayotgan edi.

en: For a moment perhaps I stood there, breast-high in the almost boiling wa- ter, dumbfounded at my position, hopeless of escape.
uz: Ehtimol, men bir daqiqa davomida, deyarli qaynaydigan suvda ko'krakni baland ko'tarib, o'z pozitsiyamni ko'rib hayron bo'lib, qochib ketishning umidi yo'q edi.

en: Through the reek I could see the people who had been with me in the river scrambling out of the water through the reeds, like little frogs hurrying through grass from the advance of a man, or running to and fro in utter dismay on the towing path.
