uz: O'simlik ichidan men daryoda men bilan birga bo'lgan odamlarni ko'rardim, ular suvdan cho'kib, qamallar ichidan chiqib ketayotganini ko'rardim, xuddi odamning oldidan o'simliklarni o'rab o'tirgan kichkina qaroqchalar kabi, yoki to'g'ri yo'ldan qo'rqib, orqaga-orqaga yugurib ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: Then suddenly the white ﬂashes of the Heat-Ray came leaping towards me.
uz: Keyin birdan Heat-Rayning oq chaqmoqlari menga yaqinlashdi.

en: The houses caved in as they dissolved at its touch, and darted out ﬂames; the trees changed to ﬁre with a roar.
uz: Uylar uning ta'siri bilan erib ketayotganda yiqilib tushdi va olovlar o'chib ketdi; daraxtlar bir qichqiriq bilan olovga aylandi.

en: The Ray ﬂickered up and down the towing path, licking off the people who ran this way and that, and came down to the water's edge not ﬁfty yards from where I stood.
uz: Ray chizib boruvchi yo'ldan ko'tarib, bu yo'ldan va o'sha yo'ldan yugurgan odamlarni yulib, men turgan joydan ellik metr uzoqlikda suv bo'yiga tushdi.

en: It swept across the river to Shepperton, and the water in its track rose in a boiling weal crested with steam.
uz: U daryo bo'ylab Sheppertonga yetib bordi va uning yo'nalishidagi suv bug' bilan qoplangan qaynoq o'simlikda ko'tarildi.

en: In another moment the huge wave, well-nigh at the boiling-point had rushed upon me.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada, qaynatish nuqtasiga yaqin bo'lgan ulkan to'lqin menga shovqin qildi.

en: I screamed aloud, and scalded, half blinded, agonised, I staggered through the leaping, hissing water towards the shore.
uz: Men baland ovoz bilan qichqirib, qizg'inlab, yarim ko'r bo'lib, og'ir azob chekib, sopoqlab o'tadigan, qirg'oqqa qarab suvni shishlab o'tirgan suvdan cho'zib ketdim.

en: Had my foot stumbled, it would have been the end.
uz: Agar oyoqlarim cho'kganida, bu oxirat bo'lardi.

en: I fell helplessly, in full sight of the Martians, upon the broad, bare gravelly spit that runs down to mark the an- gle of the Wey and Thames.
uz: Men Marsiyaliklar ko'z o'ngida, keng, yalang'och, ko'p ko'p bo'lgan cho'g'ga tushdim va Uey va Temis daryosi bo'ylab yo'lni belgilab qo'yganman.

en: I expected nothing but death.
uz: O'limdan boshqa hech narsa kutmaganman.

en: I have a dim memory of the foot of a Martian coming down within a score of yards of my head, driving straight into the loose gravel, whirling it this way and that and lifting again; of a long suspense, and then of the four carrying the debris of their comrade between them, now clear and then pres-
uz: Men o'zimning boshimdan bir necha metr narida tushib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'sh joyga o'tirib, uni shu yo'l va shu yo'l bilan aylanib, yana ko'targan, uzoq vaqt davom etayotgan, keyin to'rtta kishi o'zlarining oralarida qo'shnilarining maydonlarini ko'tarib yurgan, hozirgi vaqtda aniq va keyinchalik oldindan ko'tarilgan marvaridning oyoqlarini ko'tarib ketayotganini eslayman.

en: ently faint through a veil of smoke, receding interminably, as it seemed to me, across a vast space of river and meadow.
uz: O'zimga o'xshaydiganidek, cheksiz o'tmay, daryo va yaylovning keng maydoni bo'ylab cheksiz ravishda o'tib ketayotgan tutun qopqog'i orqali o'zimni charchatib qo'ydim.

en: And then, very slowly, I re- alised that by a miracle I had escaped.
uz: Keyin juda sekin o'zimni mo'ʼjizaviy tarzda qochib qutulganimni angladim.

en: CHAPTER 13 HOW I FELL IN WITH THE CURATE After getting this sudden lesson in the power of terrestrial weapons, the Martians retreated to their original position upon Horsell Common; and in their haste, and encumbered with the debris of their smashed companion, they no doubt overlooked many such a stray and negligible victim as my- self.
uz: 13 - bob: Men murabbiylar bilan qanday yo'l tutdim? Yerdagi qurollarning qudratidan dars olganidan so'ng, marsiyaliklar Horsell Commonning asl mavqega qaytishdi; va shoshilinchlik bilan va o'z yo'q bo'lgan hamkasblarining maydonlari bilan to'plangan holda, ular, shubhasiz, men kabi ko'plab adashgan va ahamiyatsiz qurbonlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirishdi.

en: Had they left their comrade and pushed on forthwith, there was noth- ing at that time between them and London but batteries of twelve-pounder guns, and they would certainly have reached the capital in advance of the tidings of their approach; as sudden, dreadful, and destructive their advent would have been as the earthquake that destroyed Lisbon a century ago.
uz: Agar ular qo'shnilarini tashlab, darhol davom ettirishganida edi, o'sha paytda ular bilan London o'rtasida o'n ikki kilogrammlik qurollar to'plamidan boshqa narsa yo'q edi va ular yaqinlashish haqidagi xabardan oldin poytaxtga yetib kelishgan bo'lishardi; ularning to'satdan, dahshatli va dahshatli kelishi bir asr oldin Lissabonni vayron qilgan zilzila kabi bo'lgan bo'lardi.

en: But they were in no hurry.
uz: Ammo ular shoshilmadilar.

en: Cylinder followed cylinder on its interplane- tary ﬂight; every twenty-four hours brought them reinforcement.
uz: Silindr o'z o'zaro samolyot uchishida silindrni kuzatib borardi; har yigirma to'rt soatda ularga qo'llab-quvvatlash keltirdi.

en: And meanwhile the military and naval authorities, now fully alive to the tremen- dous power of their antagonists, worked with furious energy.
uz: Shu bilan birga, harbiy va dengiz hokimiyati, endi dushmanlarining kuch-qudratidan to'liq tirik bo'lgan, g'azabga to'lgan kuch bilan ishlaydi.

en: Every minute a fresh gun came into position until, before twilight, every copse, every row of suburban villas on the hilly slopes about Kingston and Richmond, masked an expectant black muzzle.
uz: Har bir daqiqada yangi qurol o'rnatiladi, hatto kunduz tugashidan oldin, Kingston va Richmond atrofidagi tog'li tepaliklardagi shahar atrofidagi villalarning har bir safida, har bir qo'rqinch, har bir qatorida, qarama-qarshi qaramog'i paydo bo'ladi.

en: And through the charred and desolated area—perhaps twenty square miles altogether—that encircled the Martian encampment on Horsell Common, through charred and ruined villages among the green trees, through the blackened and smoking arcades that had been but a day ago pine spinneys, crawled the devoted scouts with the heli- ographs that were presently to warn the gunners of the Martian approach.
uz: Horsell Commondagi Marsdagi lagerni o'rab olgan ko'mirlangan va cho'qolgan hududdan, yashil daraxtlar orasidagi ko'mirlangan va vayron qilingan qishloqlardan, bir kun oldin bor edi, ammo bir kun oldin bor edi, degan qora va chekkan arcadesdan o'tgach, sadoqatli skautlar o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'zlarining o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'z o'

en: But the Martians now understood our command of artillery and the danger of human proximity, and not a man ventured within a mile of either cylin- der, save at the price of his life.
uz: Ammo marsiyaliklar bizning to'qnash qo'mondonligimizni va inson yaqinligi xavfini endi tushunishgan va hech bir odam o'z hayotini xavf ostiga qo'yib, bir milga yaqinlikda bo'lmagan.

en: It would seem that these giants spent the earlier part of the afternoon in going to and fro, transferring everything from the second and third cylin- ders—the second in Addlestone Golf Links and the third at Pyrford—to
uz: Ko'rinishicha, ushbu ulkanlar kechqurun birinchi qismini shu va shu tomon o'tkazish bilan o'tkazdilar, ikkinchi va uchinchi silindardan, ikkinchi Addlestone Golf Linksda va uchinchi Pyrfordda o'tkazilgan har bir narsani o'tkazdilar.

en: their original pit on Horsell Common.
uz: Horsell Common-da ularning asl quduqlari.

en: Over that, above the blackened heather and ruined buildings that stretched far and wide, stood one as sen- tinel, while the rest abandoned their vast ﬁghting-machines and descended into the pit.
uz: Uning ustida, uzoq va keng tarqalgan qora bo'lak va vayron qilingan binolar ustida, biri sen-tinel sifatida turardi, qolganlari esa o'z ulkan jang mashinalarini tashlab, chuqurlikka tushdilar.

en: They were hard at work there far into the night, and the tower- ing pillar of dense green smoke that rose therefrom could be seen from the hills about Merrow, and even, it is said, from Banstead and Epsom Downs.
uz: Ular kechasigacha u yerda mehnat qilar edilar va u yerdan ko'tarilgan qalin yashil tutun ustuni Merrow atrofidagi tog'lardan, hatto Banstead va Epsom Daunlardan ham ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: And while the Martians behind me were thus preparing for their next sal- ly, and in front of me Humanity gathered for the battle, I made my way with inﬁnite pains and labour from the ﬁre and smoke of burning Weybridge to- wards London.
uz: Mening orqamda bo'lgan marsiyaliklar o'z navbatdagi janglariga tayyorgarlik ko'rishganida va oldimda insoniyat jang uchun to'planganida, men o'zimning yo'limni cheksiz og'riq va mehnat bilan olib bordim.

en: I saw an abandoned boat, very small and remote, drifting down- stream; and throwing off the most of my sodden clothes, I went after it, gained it, and so escaped out of that destruction.
uz: Men quvib ketgan, juda kichik va uzoq bo'lgan qayiqni ko'rdim, daryo bo'ylab suzib borayotgan edi; va o'zimning ko'pgina kiyim-kechakimni tashlab, uning orqasidan ergashdim, uni qo'lga kiritdim va bu yo'qotishdan qochib qutuldim.

en: There were no oars in the boat, but I contrived to paddle, as well as my parboiled hands would allow, down the river towards Halliford and Walton, going very tediously and continually looking behind me, as you may well understand.
uz: Qayiqda qutilar yo'q edi, lekin men o'z qo'llarim bilan suvni bosib o'tishim mumkin bo'lganidek, padel o'rnatishga muvaffaq bo'ldim va halliford va waltonga qarab, juda charchagancha va doimiy ravishda orqamga qarab yurardim. Siz yaxshi tushunishingiz mumkin.

en: I followed the river, be- cause I considered that the water gave me my best chance of escape should these giants return.
uz: Men daryoga ergashdim, chunki suv bu ulkanlar qaytib kelsa, qochishimning eng yaxshi imkoniyatini berishini bilardim.

en: The hot water from the Martian's overthrow drifted downstream with me, so that for the best part of a mile I could see little of either bank.
uz: Martianning quvib o'tishidan kelib chiqqan issiq suv men bilan birga oqib o'tdi, shuning uchun bir milning eng yaxshi qismida men har ikki tomondan kamroq ko'rardim.

en: Once, however, I made out a string of black ﬁgures hurrying across the meadows from the direction of Weybridge.
uz: Biroq, bir marta men Weybridge yo'nalishidan o'tadigan o'tlar bo'ylab shoshayotgan qora figuralar qatorini yaratdim.

en: Halliford, it seemed, was deserted, and several of the houses facing the river were on ﬁre.
uz: Halliford, ko'rinib turganidek, vayron bo'lib qoldi va daryoga qaragan bir nechta uylar yonib ketdi.

en: It was strange to see the place quite tranquil, quite desolate under the hot blue sky, with the smoke and little threads of ﬂame going straight up into the heat of the afternoon.
uz: Issiq ko'k osmon ostida o'sha joyni juda xotirjam, chiroyli va chiroyli ko'rinish bilan ko'rish g'ayrioddiy edi, tutun va olovning kichik iplari kechki paytning issiqligiga to'g'ri kirib borardi.

en: Never before had I seen houses burning without the accompaniment of an obstructive crowd.
uz: Bundan oldin hech qachon uylar obstruktiv xaloyiqning qo'llab-quvvatlashisiz yonayotganini ko'rmagan edim.

en: A little farther on the dry reeds up the bank were smok- ing and glowing, and a line of ﬁre inland was marching steadily across a late ﬁeld of hay.
uz: Qirg'og'ining quruq qirg'og'ida biroz uzoqroq bo'lgan cho'g'lar tuxumli va yorug' edi va ichkari hududda yong'in liniyasi keskin o'simlik maydoni bo'ylab harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: For a long time I drifted, so painful and weary was I after the violence I had been through, and so intense the heat upon the water.
uz: Ko'p vaqt davomida men o'zimni tashlab ketdim, o'tgan zo'ravonlikdan keyin men juda og'riqli va charchagan edim va suvning issiqligi juda kuchli edi.

en: Then my fears got the better of me again, and I resumed my paddling.
uz: Keyin qo'rquvlarim meni yana yengdi va men yana padlingni davom ettirdim.

en: The sun scorched my bare back.
uz: Quyosh mening yalang'och orqa tomonimni yondirdi.

en: At last, as the bridge at Walton was coming into sight round the bend, my fever and faintness overcame my fears, and I landed on the Mid- dlesex bank and lay down, deadly sick, amid the long grass.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, Ualtondagi ko'prik burchak atrofida ko'rinishga tushib ketganda, sovuq va o'zimning qo'rqishimni yengdim va Mid-dlesexning qirg'og'iga tushib, o'limdan azob chekib, uzun o'tlar orasida o'tirib qoldim.

en: I suppose the time was then about four or ﬁve o'clock.
uz: O'shanda soat to'rt yoki besh atrofida edi.

en: I got up presently, walked perhaps half a mile without meeting a soul, and then lay down again in the shadow
uz: O'shanda o'zim turdim, o'n kilometr yurdim va hech kim bilan uchrashmadim, so'ngra yana soyasida uxladim.

en: I seem to remember talking, wanderingly, to myself during that last spurt.
uz: O'sha oxirgi sur'at paytida o'zim bilan suhbatlashayotganimni eslayman.

en: I was also very thirsty, and bitterly regretful I had drunk no more water.
uz: Men ham juda chanqadim va suv ichmaganimdan achchiq-achchiq afsuslanardim.

en: It is a curious thing that I felt angry with my wife; I cannot account for it, but my impotent desire to reach Leatherhead worried me excessively.
uz: Xotinimga g'azablanishim g'ayrioddiy; buning sababini tushuntira olmayman, lekin Leatherheadga yetib borish istagi meni haddan tashqari xavotirga solgan.

en: I do not clearly remember the arrival of the curate, so that probably I dozed.
uz: Ruhoniy kelganini aniq eslay olmayman, shuning uchun, ehtimol, uxladim.

en: I became aware of him as a seated ﬁgure in soot- smudged shirt sleeves, and with his upturned, clean-shaven face staring at a faint ﬂickering that danced over the sky.
uz: Men uni o'tirgan shaxs sifatida ko'rdim, buzuq kamiralar bilan, va uning burib ketgan, toza shavshan yuzida osmon ustidan raqs o'tkazgan salqin parcha-parchaga qaragan.

en: The sky was what is called a mackerel sky—rows and rows of faint down-plumes of cloud, just tinted with the midsummer sunset.
uz: Osmon makrel ko'klari deb ataladigan bo'lib, yozgi quyosh botishi bilan to'q bo'lgan soya-soyalar bilan qoplangan bulutlar bo'lib turardi.

en: I sat up, and at the rustle of my motion he looked at me quickly.
uz: Men o'tirib qoldim va harakatlarimning shov-shuvidan u tezda menga qaradi.

en: Have you any water? I asked abruptly.
uz: Sizda suv bormi? deb o'yladim.

en: You have been asking for water for the last hour, he said.
uz: Siz so'nggi bir soatdan beri suv so'rab kelyapsiz, dedi u.

en: For a moment we were silent, taking stock of each other.
uz: Biz bir zum sukut saqlab, bir-birimizni ko'rib chiqdik.

en: I dare say he found me a strange enough ﬁgure, naked, save for my water- soaked trousers and socks, scalded, and my face and shoulders blackened by the smoke.
uz: Men aytishga jur'at qilamanki, u menga to'q bo'lgan, to'q bo'lgan, o'zgacha bir shaxsni topdi, men suv bilan to'yilgan shorts va shortslarimni qo'yib qo'ydim, u qizg'in edi, yuzim va shoxlarim tutundan qora bo'ldi.

en: His face was a fair weakness, his chin retreated, and his hair lay in crisp, almost ﬂaxen curls on his low forehead; his eyes were rather large, pale blue, and blankly staring.
uz: Uning yuzi juda zaif edi, cho'qqisi orqaga chiqdi va sochlari past ma'noda chiroyli, deyarli laxtli bo'lib, peshanasida yotgan edi; ko'zlari ancha katta, ko'k ko'k va ko'rinmas edi.

en: He spoke abruptly, looking vacantly away from me.
uz: U to'satdan gapirdi va mendan uzoqroq ko'z tikdi.

en: What does it mean? he said.
uz: - Bu nimani anglatadi? - dedi u.

en: What do these things mean? I stared at him and made no answer.
uz: Bularning ma'nosi nimada? - deb unga tikilib qaradim va hech qanday javob bermadim.

en: He extended a thin white hand and spoke in almost a complaining tone.
uz: U oq qo'lini uzatdi va deyarli shikoyat soʻzi bilan gapirdi.

en: Why are these things permitted?
uz: Nima uchun bularga ruxsat berilgan?

en: What sins have we done?
uz: Biz qanday gunohlar qildik?

en: The morning service was over, I was walking through the roads to clear my brain for the afternoon, and then—ﬁre, earthquake, death!
uz: Ertalabgi xizmat tugadi, kechki payt uchun miyamni tozalash uchun yo'llar orqali yurardim va keyin o't, zilzila, o'lim!

en: As if it were Sodom and Go- morrah!
uz: Xuddi Sadoʻm va Goʻmoray boʻlgani kabi!

en: All our work undone, all the work—— What are these Martians? What are we? I answered, clearing my throat.
uz: Barcha ishlarimiz bekor qilindi, barcha ishlar Bu marsiyaliklar nimalar? - Biz nimalarmiz? - deb javob berdim va qo'limni ochib berdim.

en: He gripped his knees and turned to look at me again.
uz: U tiz cho'kib, yana menga qarab turdi.

en: For half a minute, perhaps, he stared silently.
uz: Ehtimol, yarim daqiqa davomida u xotirjamlik bilan qarab turardi.

en: I was walking through the roads to clear my brain, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: O'z miyamni tozalash uchun yo'llar bo'ylab yurgan edim.

en: And sud- denly—ﬁre, earthquake, death! He relapsed into silence, with his chin now sunken almost to his knees.
uz: Va shuddatli olov, zilzila, o'lim! - deb so'zlarni so'zlab berdi u, yana bir bor o'zini to'xtatgan holda, yana bir bor o'zini to'sib qo'ydi.

en: Presently he began waving his hand.
uz: O'sha zahoti u qo'lini o'girishni boshladi.

en: All the work—all the Sunday schools—What have we done—what has Weybridge done?
uz: Barcha ish, barcha yakshanba maktablari, biz nima qildik, Weybridge nima qildi?

en: Everything gone—everything destroyed.
uz: Hamma narsa yo'qolgan, hamma narsa yo'q qilingan.

en: rebuilt it only three years ago.
uz: Faqat uch yil oldin qayta qurilgan.

en: Swept out of existence!
uz: mavjud bo'lmay qolgan!

en: Why? Another pause, and he broke out again like one demented.
uz: Nima uchun? - degan savol tug'ilib, yana bir to'xtashdi va u aqldan ozgan odam kabi yana bir bor bo'lib chiqdi.

en: The smoke of her burning goeth up for ever and ever! he shouted.
uz: O'sha ayolning yonayotgan tutuni abadiy ko'tariladi! - deb baqirib yubordi u.

en: His eyes ﬂamed, and he pointed a lean ﬁnger in the direction of Weybridge.
uz: Uning ko'zlari olovga to'lgan va u bir barmog'i bilan Vaybridj tomon ko'rsatdi.

en: By this time I was beginning to take his measure.
uz: O'sha paytda men uning o'lchovini ko'rishni boshlaganman.

en: The tremendous tragedy in which he had been involved—it was evident he was a fugitive from Weybridge—had driven him to the very verge of his reason.
uz: U ishtirok etgan dahshatli fojia, u Weybridge shahridan qochoq bo'lgani aniq edi, uni aqli chanqoqligiga yetkazgan edi.

en: Are we far from Sunbury? I said, in a matter-of-fact tone.
uz: Biz Sunburydan uzoqdamizmi? - deb aytdim men.

en: What are we to do? he asked.
uz: Biz nima qilishimiz kerak? deb so'radi u.

en: Are these creatures everywhere?
uz: Bu mavjudotlar hamma joyda bormikin?

en: Has the earth been given over to them? Are we far from Sunbury? Only this morning I ofﬁciated at early celebration—— Things have changed, I said, quietly.
uz: Yer ularga topshirilganmi? Biz Sunburydan uzoqdamizmi? Bugun ertalabgina ertalab nishonlanishni boshladim Bular o'zgardi, - dedim men xotirjamlik bilan.

en: You must keep your head.
uz: Siz boshingizni saqlab qolishingiz kerak.

en: There is still hope. Hope! Yes.
uz: Hndi umid bor.  Umid! Ha, umid bor.

en: Plentiful hope—for all this destruction! I began to explain my view of our position.
uz: Bu butun vayronlik uchun umid bor! - dedim va o'z nuqtai nazarimni tushuntirishga tushdim.

en: He listened at ﬁrst, but as I went on the interest dawning in his eyes gave place to their former stare, and his regard wandered from me.
uz: Boshida u tinglagan edi, lekin men davom etgan sayin uning ko'zlarida paydo bo'lgan qiziqish ularning oldingi ko'zlariga o'rnashdi va uning e'tiborini mendan uzoqlashtirdi.

en: This must be the beginning of the end, he said, interrupting me.
uz: Bu oxiratning boshlanishi bo'lishi kerak, - dedi u, menga aralashib.

en: The great and terrible day of the Lord!
uz: Rabbimizning ulug' va dahshatli kuni!

en: When men shall call upon the mountains and the rocks to fall upon them and hide them—hide them from the face of Him that sitteth upon the throne! I began to understand the position.
uz: Odamlar tog'lar va toshlarni ularning ustiga tushib, ularni yashirganlarida, taxtda O'tirganning ko'zidan ularni yashiringlar! - deb so'rashdi.

en: I ceased my laboured reasoning, struggled to my feet, and, standing over him, laid my hand on his shoulder.
uz: Men o'zimning mehnatkash fikrlash tarzimni to'xtatdim, oyoqlarim bilan kurashdim va uning ustida turib, qo'limni uning yelkasiga qo'ydim.

en: You are scared out of your wits!
uz: Siz aqldan ozganingizdan qo'rqasiz!

en: What good is reli- gion if it collapses under calamity?
uz: Agar din musiqa ostida vayron bo'lsa, undan nima foyda?

en: Think of what earthquakes and ﬂoods, wars and volcanoes, have done before to men!
uz: Yer yuzidagi zilzilalar va to'lqinlar, urushlar va volkanlar insoniyatga qanday zarar yetkazganini bir tasavvur qiling!

en: Did you think God had ex- empted Weybridge?
uz: Siz Xudo Vaybridjni bo'sh qilgan deb o'yladingizmi?

en: He is not an insurance agent. For a time he sat in blank silence.
uz: U sug'urta agenti emas. Bir muncha vaqt u bepul so'zsiz o'tirdi.

en: But how can we escape? he asked, suddenly.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, qanday qilib qochib ketamiz? deb so'radi u, to'satdan.

en: They are invulnerable, they are pitiless. Neither the one nor, perhaps, the other, I answered.
uz: Ular zaif emaslar, shafqatsizdirlar, - deb javob berdim men.

en: And the mightier they are the more sane and wary should we be.
uz: Ular qanchalik kuchli bo'lsa, biz ham shunchalik aqlli va ehtiyotkor bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: One of them was killed yon- der not three hours ago.
uz: Ulardan biri uch soat oldin o'ldirilgan edi.

en: Killed! he said, staring about him.
uz: Qo'ldirildi! - dedi u, atrofini ko'rib.

en: How can God's ministers be killed? I saw it happen. I proceeded to tell him.
uz: Xudoning xizmatchilari qanday qilib o'ldirilishi mumkin? - deb so'raganimda, men buni ko'rdim.

en: We have chanced to come in for the thick of it, said I, and that is all. What is that ﬂicker in the sky? he asked abruptly.
uz: Men: Biz shunga to'g'ri kelganmiz va bu hammasi, - deb aytdim. Osmondagi shov-shuv nima? - deb u to'satdan so'radi.

en: I told him it was the heliograph signalling—that it was the sign of human help and effort in the sky.
uz: Men unga u heliograf signallash edi, bu osmonda inson yordami va saʼy-harakatining belgisi ekanligini aytdim.

en: We are in the midst of it, I said, quiet as it is.
uz: Men: Biz o'rtalaridamiz, - dedim, haqiqatan ham xotirjammiz.

en: That ﬂicker in the sky tells of the gathering storm.
uz: Osmondagi shovqin to'planayotgan bo'ron haqida gapiradi.

en: Yonder, I take it are the Martians, and London- ward, where those hills rise about Richmond and Kingston and the trees give cover, earthworks are being thrown up and guns are being placed.
uz: O'shanda, men o'ylaymanki, bu Marsliklar va London-vardi, Richmond va Kingston atrofida tog'lar ko'tarilgan va daraxtlar qoplangan joylar, yer xilma-xilligi va qurol-yarog'lar joylashtirilgan joylar.

en: Presently the Martians will be coming this way again. And even as I spoke he sprang to his feet and stopped me by a gesture.
uz: Hozirdan martliklar yana shu yo'ldan keladilar. Men gapirganimda, u o'z oyoqlariga tushib, meni imo-ishora bilan to'xtatib qo'ydi.

en: From beyond the low hills across the water came the dull resonance of distant guns and a remote weird crying.
uz: Suvdan o'tgan past tepaliklar orqasidan uzoqdagi o'q-quruqlarning chiroyli rezonansiyasi va uzoqdagi g'ayritabiiy yig'ilar eshitildi.

en: Then everything was still.
uz: Keyin hamma narsa to'xtab qoldi.

en: A cockchafer came droning over the hedge and past us.
uz: Bir qo'g'ircho'p o'sha qo'rg'onning ustiga tushib, bizdan o'tib ketdi.

en: High in the west the crescent moon hung faint and pale above the smoke of Weybridge and Shepperton and the hot, still splendour of the sunset.
uz: G'arbiy qismda o'rta oyning balandligi Weybridge va Sheppertonning tutug'i va quyosh botishining issiq, hali ham shodligi ustida chiroyli va rang-barang bo'lgan.

en: We had better follow this path, I said, northward.
uz: Men: Bu yo'ldan yursak yaxshi bo'lardi, - dedim.

en: CHAPTER 14 IN LONDON My younger brother was in London when the Martians fell at Woking.
uz: 14 - bob LONDONda Keksasi akam Wokingda marsyanlar tushib qolganda Londonda edi.

en: He was a medical student working for an imminent examination, and he heard nothing of the arrival until Saturday morning.
uz: U tez orada tibbiy ko'rikdan o'qigan talaba edi va shanba kuni ertalabgacha bu haqda hech narsa eshitmagan.

en: The morning papers on Satur- day contained, in addition to lengthy special articles on the planet Mars, on life in the planets, and so forth, a brief and vaguely worded telegram, all the more striking for its brevity.
uz: Saturn kunidagi ertalabgi gazetalarda Mars sayyorasi, sayyoradagi hayot va hokazolar haqida ma'lumotni o'qigan uzun maqolalar bilan birga, qisqacha va noaniq so'zlangan telegram mavjud edi.

en: The Martians, alarmed by the approach of a crowd, had killed a number of people with a quick-ﬁring gun, so the story ran.
uz: Marsliklar, xaloyiqning yaqinlashib kelishiga qo'rqib, tez o'qadigan qurol bilan bir qator odamlarni o'ldirgan edilar, shuning uchun hikoya davom etdi.

en: The telegram concluded with the words: Formidable as they seem to be, the Martians have not moved from the pit into which they have fallen, and, indeed, seem inca- pable of doing so.
uz: Telegram quyidagi so'zlar bilan yakunlandi: Marsliklar o'zlarini ko'rinishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada mustahkam bo'lishsa-da, ular qulagan chuqurlikdan o'tmagan va, albatta, bunday qilishga qodir bo'lmayotganga o'xshaydilar.

en: Probably this is due to the relative strength of the earth's gravitational energy. On that last text their leader-writer expanded very comfortingly.
uz: Ehtimol, buning sababi Yerning gravitatsiya energiyasining nisbiy kuchidir. Bu so'nggi matn haqida ularning yozuvchisi juda tasalli beruvchi tarzda kengaytirdi.

en: Of course all the students in the crammer's biology class, to which my brother went that day, were intensely interested, but there were no signs of any unusual excitement in the streets.
uz: Albatta, akam o'sha kuni o'tgan Crammerning biologiya sinfidagi barcha talabalar juda qiziqish ko'rsatishgan, ammo ko'chalarda hech qanday noyob hayajonning izlari yo'q edi.

en: The afternoon papers puffed scraps of news under big headlines.
uz: Kechki gazetalar katta bosh sahifalar ostida yangiliklarning ko'p qismini ko'rsatdi.

en: They had nothing to tell beyond the movements of troops about the common, and the burning of the pine woods between Woking and Weybridge, until eight.
uz: Ular faqat qo'shin harakatlari va Woking va Weybridge o'rtasida o'simlik o'rmonlarining yondirilishi haqida sakkiz soatgacha gapirishlari mumkin edi.

en: JAMES'S GAZETTE, in an extra-special edition, announced the bare fact of the interruption of tele- graphic communication.
uz: JAMES'S GAZETTE maxsus nashrida telegrafik aloqalar to'xtatilganligi haqida e'lon qildi.

en: This was thought to be due to the falling of burn- ing pine trees across the line.
uz: Buning sababi, deb o'ylashar edi, bu chiziqdan o'tgan cho'qqiz o'simliklarning tushib ketishi bilan bog'liq.

en: Nothing more of the ﬁghting was known that night, the night of my drive to Leatherhead and back.
uz: O'sha kecha, men Leatherheadga va qaytib borgan kecha, urushdan boshqa hech narsa ma'lum bo'lmadi.

en: My brother felt no anxiety about us, as he knew from the description in the papers that the cylinder was a good two miles from my house.
uz: Akam biz uchun tashvishlanmadi, chunki u qog'ozlardagi tavsiflardan silindr uyimdan ikki kilometr uzoqlikda ekanligini bilardi.

en: He made up his mind to run down that night to me, in order, as he says, to see the
uz: O'sha kecha, o'zi aytgandek, o'sha yerda ko'rish uchun, u menga yugurib borishga qaror qildi.

en: Things before they were killed.
uz: Ular o'ldirilishdan oldin narsalar.

en: He dispatched a telegram, which never reached me, about four o'clock, and spent the evening at a music hall.
uz: U soat to'rtlarda menga hech qachon yetib kelmagan telegramani yubordi va kechqurun musiqa zalida o'tkazdi.

en: In London, also, on Saturday night there was a thunderstorm, and my brother reached Waterloo in a cab.
uz: Shunga o'xshab, Londonda ham shanba kuni kechqurun momaqaldiroq sodir bo'ldi va akam taksi bilan Waterloo shahriga yetib keldi.

en: On the platform from which the mid- night train usually starts he learned, after some waiting, that an accident prevented trains from reaching Woking that night.
uz: Odatda tunning o'rtalarida poyezd boshlanadigan platformada, u biroz kutganidan so'ng, o'sha kecha poyezdlar Wokingga yetib borishiga to'sqinlik qilgan hodisa yuz berganini bilib oldi.

en: The nature of the acci- dent he could not ascertain; indeed, the railway authorities did not clearly know at that time.
uz: U o'sha paytdagi harakatning xususiyatini aniqlay olmagan; haqiqatan ham, temir yo'l hokimiyati o'sha paytda aniq bilmagan edi.

en: There was very little excitement in the station, as the of- ﬁcials, failing to realise that anything further than a breakdown between Byﬂeet and Woking junction had occurred, were running the theatre trains which usually passed through Woking round by Virginia Water or Guild- ford.
uz: Poytaxtimizdagi ishchilar Byfleet va Woking o'rtasidagi to'qnashishdan tashqari boshqa narsa sodir bo'lganini tushunmay, odatda Virginia Water yoki Guild-ford tomonidan Woking atrofidan o'tgan teatr poezdlarini boshqarishganligi sababli, stantsiyada juda kam hayajon bor edi.

en: They were busy making the necessary arrangements to alter the route of the Southampton and Portsmouth Sunday League excursions.
uz: Ular Southampton va Portsmouth yakshanba ligasi sayohatlarining yo'nalishini o'zgartirish uchun zarur chora-tadbirlar ko'rish bilan band edilar.

en: A noctur- nal newspaper reporter, mistaking my brother for the trafﬁc manager, to whom he bears a slight resemblance, waylaid and tried to interview him.
uz: Kechalik gazeta muxbiri, akamni yo'l boshqaruvchisi deb o'ylagan, unga biroz o'xshaydigan, uni yo'ldan ozdirib, intervyu berishga harakat qildi.

en: Few people, excepting the railway ofﬁcials, connected the breakdown with the Martians.
uz: Temir yo'l xodimlari bundan mustasno, ko'pchilik marsiyaliklar bilan kelishmovchilikni bog'lagan.

en: I have read, in another account of these events, that on Sunday morning all London was electriﬁed by the news from Woking. As a matter of fact, there was nothing to justify that very extravagant phrase.
uz: Shu voqealarning boshqa bir hikoyasida o'qiganimcha, yakshanba kuni ertalab Wokingdagi yangiliklar butun Londonni hayratda qoldirdi.

en: Plenty of London- ers did not hear of the Martians until the panic of Monday morning.
uz: Londonliklarning ko'pchiligi dushanba kuni ertalabgi dahshatga tushgunga qadar marsiyaliklar haqida eshitmagan.

en: Those who did took some time to realise all that the hastily worded telegrams in the Sunday papers conveyed.
uz: O'tganlar esa yakshanba gazetalari orqali tezda so'zlangan telegrammalarning barcha ta'sirini tushunishga vaqt ajratishdi.

en: The majority of people in London do not read Sunday papers.
uz: Londondagi aksariyat odamlar yakshanba kunlari gazeta o'qmaydilar.

en: The habit of personal security, moreover, is so deeply ﬁxed in the Lon- doner's mind, and startling intelligence so much a matter of course in the papers, that they could read without any personal tremors: About seven o'clock last night the Martians came out of the cylinder, and, moving about under an armour of metallic shields, have completely wrecked Woking sta- tion with the adjacent houses, and massacred an entire battalion of the Cardigan Regiment.
uz: Bundan tashqari, shaxsiy xavfsizlik odati Lon-donorning ongida shunchalik chuqur o'rnatilganki, uning aql-idroklari esa gazetada shu qadar tabiiy narsa bo'lganki, ular hech qanday shaxsiy titrashsiz o'qishlari mumkin edi: Kechki soat yettilarda martliklar silindrdan chiqib, metall qalqonlar qurollari ostida harakat qilib, Woking stansiyasini va qo'shni uylarni to'liq vayron qildilar va Kardigan regimentining butun batalyonini qirib tashladilar.

en: No details are known.
uz: tafsilotlari ma'lum emas.

en: Maxims have been absolutely useless against their armour; the ﬁeld guns have been disabled by them.
uz: Maksimlar o'z qurol-yarog'lariga qarshi mutlaqo foydasiz bo'lgan; ular tomonidan maydon qurollari o'chirib tashlangan.

en: Flying hussars have been galloping into Chertsey.
uz: Uchuvchi huzarlar Chertsey shahriga qochib ketmoqda.

en: The Martians appear to be moving slowly towards Chertsey or Windsor.
uz: Marsliklar Chertsey yoki Windsor tomon sekin harakatlanayotgandek ko'rinadi.

en: Great anxiety prevails in West Surrey, and earthworks are being thrown up to check the advance Londonward. That was how the Sunday SUN put it, and a clever and re-
uz: G'arbiy Surreyda katta tashvish hukm surmoqda va Londonga borayotgan avgustni nazorat qilish uchun yer xilma-xilligi ko'paymoqda. - deb yozdi yakshanba kuni nashr etilgan SUN gazetasi.

en: markably prompt handbook article in the REFEREE compared the affair to a menagerie suddenly let loose in a village.
uz: REFEREE jurnalidagi qo'llanma maqolasi bu muammoni bir qishloqda to'satdan bo'shashtirilgan menagerie bilan taqqosladi.

en: No one in London knew positively of the nature of the armoured Mar- tians, and there was still a ﬁxed idea that these monsters must be sluggish: crawling, creeping painfully—such expressions occurred in almost all the earlier reports.
uz: Londondagi hech kim o'sha martianlarning xususiyatlarini aniq bilmagan va hali ham bu g'ayritabiiy hayvonlar sust bo'lishi kerak degan fikr bor edi: deyarli barcha avvalgi hisobotlarda yo'l-yo'l, og'irlik bilan orqaga kirish degan iboralar paydo bo'lgan.

en: None of the telegrams could have been written by an eyewitness of their advance.
uz: Telegramlarning hech biri ularning oldinga borganining shohidi tomonidan yozilmagan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: The Sunday papers printed separate editions as further news came to hand, some even in default of it.
uz: Yakshanba gazetalari yangiliklar kelib chiqqanda alohida nashrlarni chop etishdi, ba'zilari hatto bu haqda noto'g'ri xabar berishdi.

en: But there was practi- cally nothing more to tell people until late in the afternoon, when the au- thorities gave the press agencies the news in their possession.
uz: Ammo odamlar kechki paytgacha boshqa hech narsa aytolmas edi, chunki bu vaqtdan boshlab hokimiyat o'zlariga tegishli yangiliklarni matbuot agentliklariga berdi.

en: It was stated that the people of Walton and Weybridge, and all the district were pouring along the roads Londonward, and that was all.
uz: Vaqt o'tgach, u yerda aytilishicha, Valton va Vaybridj aholisi va butun tumanlar London yo'llari bo'ylab to'lib-toshgan va bu hammasi edi.

en: My brother went to church at the Foundling Hospital in the morning, still in ignorance of what had happened on the previous night.
uz: Birodarim ertalab Foundling kasalxonasida cherkovga borgan edi, ammo o'tgan kechada nima sodir bo'lganini hali ham bilmagan edi.

en: There he heard allusions made to the invasion, and a special prayer for peace.
uz: U yerda u ishlov berishga ishora qilgan va tinchlik uchun maxsus ibodatni eshitgan.

en: Coming out, he bought a REFEREE.
uz: Chiqarganida, u REFEREEni sotib oldi.

en: He became alarmed at the news in this, and went again to Waterloo station to ﬁnd out if communication were restored.
uz: U ushbu yangiliklardan xavotirga tushdi va aloqa qayta tiklanadimi yoki yo'qmi bilish uchun yana Waterloo stantsiyasiga bordi.

en: The omnibuses, carriages, cyclists, and innumerable people walking in their best clothes seemed scarcely affected by the strange intelligence that the news venders were disseminating.
uz: Omnibuslar, vagonlar, velosipedchilar va eng yaxshi kiyimlarini kiygan son-sanoqsiz odamlar yangilik sotuvchilari tarqatayotgan g'ayritabiiy ma'lumotlardan kamdan-kam ta'sirlangan bo'lishdi.

en: People were interested, or, if alarmed, alarmed only on account of the local residents.
uz: Odamlar qiziqish ko'rsatishdi yoki, agar xavotirga tushsalar, faqat mahalliy aholi tufayli xavotirga tushdilar.

en: At the station he heard for the ﬁrst time that the Windsor and Chertsey lines were now interrupted.
uz: U stantsiyada birinchi marta Windsor va Chertsey liniyalari kesilganligini eshitdi.

en: The porters told him that several remarkable telegrams had been received in the morn- ing from Byﬂeet and Chertsey stations, but that these had abruptly ceased.
uz: Ularga Byfleet va Chertsey stantsiyalaridan ertalab bir nechta ajoyib telegrammalar qabul qilinganligi, ammo ular to'xtatilganligi haqida xabar berishdi.

en: My brother could get very little precise detail out of them.
uz: Birodarim ulardan juda oz aniq tafsilotlarni topib olishi mumkin edi.

en: There's ﬁghting going on about Weybridge was the extent of their information.
uz: Vaybridj haqida bahs-munozaralar bor - bu ularning ma'lumotlar soni edi.

en: The train service was now very much disorganised.
uz: Poyezd xizmati endi juda tartibsiz edi.

en: Quite a number of people who had been expecting friends from places on the South- Western network were standing about the station.
uz: Janubiy-g'arbiy tarmoqdagi joylardan do'stlarni kutgan ko'plab odamlar stantsiyaning atrofida turgan edi.

en: One grey-headed old gentleman came and abused the South-Western Company bitterly to my brother.
uz: Bir oq boshli keksa xonim kelib, Janubiy-G'arbiy kompaniyani akamga qattiq ta'qib qildi.

en: It wants showing up, he said.
uz: U ko'rinishni xohlaydi, dedi u.

en: One or two trains came in from Richmond, Putney, and Kingston, con- taining people who had gone out for a day's boating and found the locks closed and a feeling of panic in the air.
uz: Richmond, Putney va Kingstondan bir yoki ikkita poezd kelib, bir kunlik qayiqlash uchun chiqqan odamlarni qo'lga kiritdi va qulflar yopilgan va havoda qo'rqinch hissi paydo bo'ldi.

en: A man in a blue and white blazer addressed my brother, full of strange tidings.
uz: Ko'k va oq ko'ylak kiyimli kishi akamga g'alati xabarlar bilan murojaat qildi.

en: There's hosts of people driving into Kingston in traps and carts and things, with boxes of valuables and all that, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Kingstonga tuzoq, aravalar va boshqa narsalar bilan, qimmatbaho narsalarning qutuqlari va shunga o'xshash narsalar bilan sayohat qilayotgan odamlarning ko'pchiligi bor.

en: They come from Molesey and Weybridge and Walton, and they say there's been guns heard at Chertsey, heavy ﬁring, and that mounted soldiers have told them to get off at once because the Martians are coming.
uz: Ular Molesey, Weybridge va Waltondan kelgan va ular Chertsey shahriga o'q eshitildi, og'ir o'q eshitildi va martliklar yaqinlashib kelgani uchun otliq askarlar ularga darhol tushishni aytishdi.

en: We heard guns ﬁring at Hamp- ton Court station, but we thought it was thunder.
uz: Hamp-ton Court stantsiyasida o'q otishayotganini eshitdik, lekin momaqaldiroq deb o'yladik.

en: What the dickens does it all mean?
uz: Bularning barchasi nima degani?

en: The Martians can't get out of their pit, can they? My brother could not tell him.
uz: Marsliklar o'z qabridan chiqolmaydilar, shundaymi? - deb so'rashdi akam.

en: Afterwards he found that the vague feeling of alarm had spread to the clients of the underground railway, and that the Sunday excursionists began to return from all over the South-Western lung— Barnes, Wimbledon, Richmond Park, Kew, and so forth—at unnaturally early hours; but not a soul had anything more than vague hearsay to tell of.
uz: Keyinchalik u yer osti temir yo'llarining mijozlariga xavf-xatar hissi keng tarqalganini va yakshanba sayohatchilari butun Janubiy-G'arbiy tuyuqdan Barnes, Wimbledon, Richmond Park, Kew va hokazolardan tabiiy emas, balki erta soatlarda qaytishni boshlaganini aniqladi; lekin hech bir jonda so'zlab berilishi mumkin bo'lgan biron bir narsa yo'q edi.

en: Everyone connected with the terminus seemed ill-tempered.
uz: Terminal bilan bog'liq bo'lgan har bir kishi yomon hissiyotga ega bo'lgan.

en: About ﬁve o'clock the gathering crowd in the station was immensely ex- cited by the opening of the line of communication, which is almost invari- ably closed, between the South-Eastern and the South-Western stations, and the passage of carriage trucks bearing huge guns and carriages crammed with soldiers.
uz: Taxminan soat beshlarda stantsiyadagi to'plangan xaloyiq, janubi-sharqiy va janubi-g'arbiy stantsiyalar o'rtasida deyarli butunlay yopilgan aloqa liniyasining ochilishi va katta qurollarni olib yuradigan vagonlar va askarlar bilan to'lgan vagonlar o'tishi bilan juda hayajonlangan edi.

en: These were the guns that were brought up from Woolwich and Chatham to cover Kingston.
uz: Bu qurollar Kingstonni qoplash uchun Woolwich va Chatamdan olib kelingan.

en: There was an exchange of pleasantries: You'll get eaten! We're the beast- tamers! and so forth.
uz: Sizni yeb yuborishadi, Biz hayvonlar o'g'rilarmiz! va hokazo so'zlarni o'zaro almashtirishdi.

en: A little while af- ter that a squad of police came into the station and began to clear the public off the platforms, and my brother went out into the street again.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, politsiya to'plamlari stansiyaga kirib, odamlarni platformadan olib tashlashni boshlashdi va akam yana ko'chaga chiqdi.

en: The church bells were ringing for evensong, and a squad of Salvation Army lassies came singing down Waterloo Road.
uz: Cherkov qo'ng'iroqlari sovrin qo'shiqlari uchun qichqirdi va Qutlug' Armiyasining bir to'plami Waterloo yo'li bo'ylab qo'shiq kuylab keldi.

en: On the bridge a number of loafers were watching a curious brown scum that came drifting down the stream in patches.
uz: Ko'prikda ko'pgina ko'z-ko'z yurgan kishilar ko'rinishsiz rangli ko'z-ko'z ko'rinishlarini ko'rishardi.

en: The sun was just setting, and the Clock Tower and the Houses of Parliament rose against one of the most peaceful skies it is possi- ble to imagine, a sky of gold, barred with long transverse stripes of reddish- purple cloud.
uz: Quyosh hali quyosh botib ketayotgan edi va soat to'ri va Parlament uylari tasavvur qilish mumkin bo'lgan eng tinch osmonlardan biriga qarshi ko'tarildi, u oltin osmon bo'lib, qizil-qizil bulutning uzun bo'laklari bilan qoplangan edi.

en: There was talk of a ﬂoating body.
uz: O'sha paytlarda uchib turgan jasad haqida gap borardi.

en: One of the men there, a re- servist he said he was, told my brother he had seen the heliograph ﬂickering in the west.
uz: U yerda bo'lganlardan biri, u o'zini xizmatkor deb atashgan, ukamga heliografning g'arbda parcha-parcha ko'rganini aytdi.

en: In Wellington Street my brother met a couple of sturdy roughs who had just been rushed out of Fleet Street with still-wet newspapers and staring placards.
uz: Velington ko'chasida akam bir necha kuchli shovqinni uchratib qoldi, ular Fleet ko'chasidan hali ham suyuq gazetalar va ko'z o'ngidagi plakatlar bilan to'xtatilgan edilar.

en: Dreadful catastrophe! they bawled one to the other down Wellington Street.
uz: Ular Wellington ko'chasi bo'ylab bir-birlariga: Qahrli halokat! - deb baqirishdi.

en: Fighting at Weybridge!
uz: Weybridge shahrida jang!

en: London in Danger! He had to give threepence for a copy of that paper.
uz: London xavf ostida! deb yozganida, u ushbu qog'ozning nusxasi uchun uch tanga pul berishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Then it was, and then only, that he realised something of the full power and terror of these monsters.
uz: Keyin, va faqatgina keyin, u ushbu hayvonlarning to'liq kuchi va dahshatini angladi.

en: He learned that they were not merely a handful of small sluggish creatures, but that they were minds swaying vast mechani- cal bodies; and that they could move swiftly and smite with such power that even the mightiest guns could not stand against them.
uz: U ular shunchaki bir nechta kichik, bepul mavjudot emasligini, balki ulkan mexanik jismlarni o'zgartiradigan onglar ekanligini va ular tez harakatlanib, hatto eng kuchli qurollar ham ularga qarshi tura olmaydigan kuch bilan urishlari mumkinligini bilib oldi.

en: They were described as vast spiderlike machines, nearly a hundred feet high, capable of the speed of an express train, and able to shoot out a beam of intense heat. Masked batteries, chieﬂy of ﬁeld guns, had been planted in the country about Horsell Common, and especially between the Woking district and London.
uz: Ular o'smirga o'xshaydigan, qariyb yuz fut balandlikdagi, tez poezd tezligiga ega bo'lgan va kuchli issiqlik radiusini o'chirib yuborishga qodir bo'lgan ulkan mashinalar deb tasvirlangan edi.

en: Five of the machines had been seen moving towards the Thames, and one, by a happy chance, had been destroyed.
uz: Mashinadan beshtasi Temza daryosiga qarab harakatlanayotganini ko'rishgan edi va bittasi baxtsiz hodisa tufayli yo'q qilingan edi.

en: In the other cases the shells had missed, and the batteries had been at once annihilated by the Heat-Rays.
uz: Boshqa holatlarda qorong'ilar o'z yo'llarini yo'qotdi va batareyalar tezda issiqlik nurlari tomonidan yo'q qilindi.

en: Heavy losses of soldiers were mentioned, but the tone of the dispatch was optimistic.
uz: Askarlarning katta yo'qotishlari haqida aytilgan bo'lsa-da, xabarning mavzuida ijobiy fikrlar bildirilgan.

en: The Martians had been repulsed; they were not invulnerable.
uz: Marsliklar orqaga surilgan edilar; ular zaiflanmagan edilar.

en: They had retreated to their triangle of cylinders again, in the circle about Woking.
uz: Ular yana o'zlarining silindrli uchburchaklariga, Woking atrofidagi doiraga qaytishdi.

en: Signallers with heliographs were pushing forward upon them from all sides.
uz: Heliografli signal beruvchilar har tomondan ularga qarshi harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: Guns were in rapid transit from Windsor, Portsmouth, Aldershot, Woolwich —even from the north; among others, long wire-guns of ninety-ﬁve tons from Woolwich.
uz: Windsor, Portsmouth, Aldershot, Woolwichdan tez o'tadigan qurollar shimolidan ham, Woolwichdan yana to'qson besh tonnalik uzun temirli qurollar ham bor edi.

en: Altogether one hundred and sixteen were in position or be- ing hastily placed, chieﬂy covering London.
uz: Jami bir yuz olti olti kishi Londonni qamrab olgan joylarda yoki tezda joylashtirilgan joylarda edi.

en: Never before in England had there been such a vast or rapid concentration of military material.
uz: Angliyada hech qachon harbiy materiallar shunchalik keng yoki tez to'plangan bo'lmagan.

en: Any further cylinders that fell, it was hoped, could be destroyed at once by high explosives, which were being rapidly manufactured and distributed.
uz: Umidga ko'ra, qochib ketadigan boshqa silindrlar tezda ishlab chiqarilib, tarqatilayotgan kuchli portlovchi moddalar tomonidan yo'q qilinadi.

en: No doubt, ran the report, the situation was of the strangest and gravest de- scription, but the public was exhorted to avoid and discourage panic.
uz: Shubhasizki, hisobotda aytilishicha, vaziyat eng g'alati va ayanchli bo'lgan, ammo jamoatchilikni qo'rquvdan qochishga va qo'rquvni yo'qotishga undadi.

en: No doubt the Martians were strange and terrible in the extreme, but at the out- side there could not be more than twenty of them against our millions.
uz: Shubhasizki, marsiyaliklar juda g'alati va dahshatli edilar, ammo chetda ularning soni millionlab odamlarga qarshi yigirma kishidan ortiq bo'lishi mumkin emas edi.

en: The authorities had reason to suppose, from the size of the cylinders, that at the outside there could not be more than ﬁve in each cylinder—ﬁfteen altogether.
uz: Mamlakat xodimlari silindrlarning kattaligiga qarab, tashqi tomondan har bir silindrda 5 dan ortiq bo'lishi mumkin emasligini taxmin qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: And one at least was disposed of— perhaps more.
uz: Va hech bo'lmaganda bir kishi undan ko'proq narsani yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: The public would be fairly warned of the approach of danger, and elaborate measures were being taken for the protection of the people in the threatened south- western suburbs.
uz: Umumiy xavf-xatar yaqinlashayotganidan xabardor bo'lishi kerak edi va xavf ostida bo'lgan janubi-g'arbiy shaharlar atrofidagi odamlarni himoya qilish uchun keng ko'lamli choralar ko'rilmoqda.

en: And so, with reiterated assurances of the safety of London
uz: Shunday qilib, Londonda xavfsizlikka qat'iy ishonch hosil qiling

en: and the ability of the authorities to cope with the difﬁculty, this quasi- proclamation closed.
uz: Hukumatning qiyinchiliklarga dosh berish qobiliyati va bu deyarli e'lon yakunlandi.

en: This was printed in enormous type on paper so fresh that it was still wet, and there had been no time to add a word of comment.
uz: Bu qog'ozda juda katta bo'lib chop etilgan edi, u hali ham suyuq edi va biron bir sharh qo'shishga vaqt bo'lmagandi.

en: It was curious, my brother said, to see how ruthlessly the usual contents of the paper had been hacked and taken out to give this place.
uz: Akamning aytishicha, qog'ozning odatdagi tarkibi qanchalik shafqatsiz bo'lganini ko'rish qiziqarli edi.

en: All down Wellington Street people could be seen ﬂuttering out the pink sheets and reading, and the Strand was suddenly noisy with the voices of an army of hawkers following these pioneers.
uz: Wellington ko'chasi bo'ylab odamlar rosa varaqalar bilan o'qiganini ko'rish mumkin edi va Strand to'satdan shov-shuvli bo'lib, bu kashshoflarni kuzatib borayotgan haykalchilar armiyasining ovozlari bilan qichqirdi.

en: Men came scrambling off buses to secure copies.
uz: Erkaklar nusxalarni himoya qilish uchun avtobuslardan tushdi.

en: Certainly this news excited people intensely, whatever their previous apathy.
uz: Shubhasizki, bu yangilik odamlarni ilgarigi befarqligidan qat'i nazar, qattiq hayajonlantirdi.

en: The shutters of a map shop in the Strand were being taken down, my brother said, and a man in his Sunday raiment, lemon-yel- low gloves even, was visible inside the window hastily fastening maps of Surrey to the glass.
uz: Oʻgʻlim aytishicha, Stranddagi xarita doʻkonining obodliklari tushirilayotgan edi va uning yakshanba kiyimida, hatto limon sariq - past qoʻlqoplar kiygan bir kishi deraza ichida Surreyning xaritalarini shishaga shoshiltirib koʻrinardi.

en: Going on along the Strand to Trafalgar Square, the paper in his hand, my brother saw some of the fugitives from West Surrey.
uz: Strand bo'ylab Trafalgar maydoniga borib, qog'oz qo'lida bo'lganida, akam G'arbiy Surreydan qochib ketganlarning ba'zilarini ko'rdi.

en: There was a man with his wife and two boys and some articles of furniture in a cart such as green- grocers use.
uz: Bir kishi xotini, ikki o'g'li va ko'chada mebel mahsulotlari bor edi.

en: He was driving from the direction of Westminster Bridge; and close behind him came a hay waggon with ﬁve or six respectable-looking people in it, and some boxes and bundles.
uz: U Westminster ko'prisi yo'nalishida haydashayotgan edi; uning orqasidan besh yoki olti munosib ko'rinadigan odam, shuningdek, ba'zi qutuqlar va to'plamlar o'tkaziladigan cho'g'ir vagon keldi.

en: The faces of these people were haggard, and their entire appearance contrasted conspicuously with the Sab- bath-best appearance of the people on the omnibuses.
uz: Ushbu odamlarning yuzlari qaroqlangan edi va ularning butun ko'rinishi omnibusdagi odamlarning Sab-bath-ning eng yaxshi ko'rinishi bilan sezilarli darajada farq qilardi.

en: People in fashionable clothing peeped at them out of cabs.
uz: Moddiy kiyimda bo'lgan odamlar taksilardan ularni ko'rib turishdi.

en: They stopped at the Square as if unde- cided which way to take, and ﬁnally turned eastward along the Strand.
uz: Ular maydonda to'xtab, qaysi yo'ldan borishni bilmay, oxir-oqibat yo'lni ko'tarib Sharq tomoniga, Strand bo'ylab borishdi.

en: Some way behind these came a man in workday clothes, riding one of those old- fashioned tricycles with a small front wheel.
uz: Bularning orqasida ish kunida kiyim kiygan bir kishi bor edi va u kichik oldingi g'ildirakli qadimgi uch velosipedda o'tirgan edi.

en: He was dirty and white in the face.
uz: Uning yuzi qora va oq edi.

en: My brother turned down towards Victoria, and met a number of such people.
uz: Akam Viktoriya tomon burildi va bir qator bunday odamlarga duch keldi.

en: He had a vague idea that he might see something of me.
uz: U mening biron bir narsamni ko'rishi mumkinligi haqida noto'g'ri tasavvurga ega edi.

en: He noticed an unusual number of police regulating the trafﬁc.
uz: U trafikni tartibga soluvchi ko'plab politsiya xodimlarini ko'rdi.

en: Some of the refugees were exchanging news with the people on the omnibuses.
uz: Qochoqlardan ba'zilari omnibusdagi odamlar bilan yangiliklar almashayotgan edi.

en: One was profess- ing to have seen the Martians.
uz: Bir kishi marsiyaliklarni ko'rganini aytdi.

en: Boilers on stilts, I tell you, striding along like men. Most of them were excited and animated by their strange experience.
uz: Sizlarga aytamanki, qozonlar ustida qozonlar, erkaklar kabi harakatlanmoqdalar. Ularning aksariyati o'zlarining g'alati tajribasi tufayli hayajon va hayajonga to'lgan.

en: Beyond Victoria the public-houses were doing a lively trade with these arrivals.
uz: Viktoriya tashqarisida jamoat uylari bu tashrif buyuruvchilar bilan faol savdo-sotiq o'tkazgan.

en: At all the street corners groups of people were reading papers, talk- ing excitedly, or staring at these unusual Sunday visitors.
uz: Ko'chalarning har bir burchagida odamlar guruhlari gazetalarni o'qib, hayajon bilan gaplashib yoki bu odatiy bo'lmagan yakshanba tashrif buyuruvchilariga tikilib turgan edi.

en: increase as night drew on, until at last the roads, my brother said, were like Epsom High Street on a Derby Day.
uz: Kechasi o'sib borgan sari ko'proq yo'llar bor edi, nihoyat, ukam aytishicha, yo'llar Derby kunida Epsom yuqori ko'chasi kabi edi.

en: My brother addressed several of these fugitives and got unsatisfactory answers from most.
uz: Birodarim bu qochoqlarning bir nechtasiga murojaat qildi va ko'pchiligidan qoniqarsiz javoblar oldi.

en: None of them could tell him any news of Woking except one man, who assured him that Woking had been entirely destroyed on the previous night.
uz: Ulardan hech biri unga Woking haqida hech qanday yangilik aytolmadi, faqat bir kishi uni o'tgan kecha Woking butunlay yo'q qilinganini ishontirdi.

en: I come from Byﬂeet, he said; man on a bicycle came through the place in the early morning, and ran from door to door warning us to come away.
uz: U shunday dedi: Men Byfleet shahridanman; erta tongda velosipedda yurgan bir kishi o'sha joydan o'tib keldi va uydan-uyga yugurib, bizni ketishga ogohlantiradi.

en: We went out to look, and there were clouds of smoke to the south—nothing but smoke, and not a soul coming that way.
uz: Biz ko'rish uchun tashqariga chiqdik va janubiy tomonda tutun bulutlari paydo bo'ldi.Tushdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi va o'sha yo'ldan hech bir jon kelmasdi.

en: Then we heard the guns at Chertsey, and folks coming from Weybridge.
uz: So'ngra Chertseydagi qirg'oqanlarni va Weybridge shahridan kelgan odamlarni eshitdik.

en: So I've locked up my house and come on. At the time there was a strong feeling in the streets that the authorities were to blame for their incapacity to dispose of the invaders without all this inconvenience.
uz: Shunday qilib, uyimni qulflab qo'ydim va kelinglar.O'sha paytda ko'chalarda hokimiyat bu noqulayliklarsiz ishlovchilar bilan shug'ullanmaslik uchun aybdor bo'lishi haqida kuchli his-tuyg'u bor edi.

en: About eight o'clock a noise of heavy ﬁring was distinctly audible all over the south of London.
uz: Soat sakkizlarda Londonning janubiy qismida og'ir o'qlarning ovozi sezilarli darajada eshitildi.

en: My brother could not hear it for the trafﬁc in the main thoroughfares, but by striking through the quiet back streets to the river he was able to distinguish it quite plainly.
uz: Birodarim uni asosiy yo'llarda harakatlanayotgan trafik tufayli eshitolmadi, lekin xotirjam ko'chalar orqali daryoga yetib borganidan so'ng uni juda aniq ko'ra oldi.

en: He walked from Westminster to his apartments near Regent's Park, about two.
uz: U Westminsterdan Regent Park yaqinidagi o'z uylariga kira boshladi.

en: He was now very anxious on my account, and disturbed at the evident magnitude of the trouble.
uz: Endi u men uchun juda xavotirda edi va muammolarning kattaligini ko'rib, xavotirda edi.

en: His mind was inclined to run, even as mine had run on Saturday, on military details.
uz: Uning fikri, meningki kabi, shanba kuni harbiy tafsilotlarni ko'rib chiqishga moyil edi.

en: He thought of all those silent, expectant guns, of the suddenly nomadic countryside; he tried to imagine boilers on stilts a hundred feet high.
uz: U o'sha sukunatli, kutib turgan qurol-yarog'lar, to'satdan ko'chma qishloqlar haqida o'yladi; u bir yuz fut balandlikda qovushxonalar o'rnatilganini tasavvur qilishga harakat qildi.

en: There were one or two cartloads of refugees passing along Oxford Street, and several in the Marylebone Road, but so slowly was the news spreading that Regent Street and Portland Place were full of their usual Sunday-night promenaders, albeit they talked in groups, and along the edge of Regent's Park there were as many silent couples walking out together under the scattered gas lamps as ever there had been.
uz: Oksford ko'chasi bo'ylab bir yoki ikkita qochoq yuklari o'tib o'tgan edi, Marylebone yo'lida esa bir nechalari, lekin xabarlar shunchalik sekin tarqalganki, Regent ko'chasi va Portland Place odatdagidek yakshanba kuni kechasi sayohatchilar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi, ammo ular guruhlar bo'lib gapirishgan edi. Regent parkining chegaralarida esa, hech qachon bo'lmagan darajada ko'pgina xotirjam juftlar gaz lampalari ostida birga yotib ketayotgan edilar.

en: The night was warm and still, and a little oppressive; the sound of guns continued intermittently, and after midnight there seemed to be sheet lightning in the south.
uz: Kechasi issiq va xotirjam edi va biroz bosimli edi; qurollarning tovushi vaqti-vaqti bilan davom etdi va yarim tundan keyin janubiy tarafda chaqmoq parchalari paydo bo'ldi.

en: He read and re-read the paper, fearing the worst had happened to me.
uz: U menga eng yomon narsa yuz berganidan qo'rqib, qog'ozni qayta-qayta o'qidi.

en: He was restless, and after supper prowled out again aimlessly.
uz: U bezovta edi va kechki ovqatdan so'ng yana yo'lsiz chiqib ketdi.

en: He returned and tried in vain to divert his attention to his examination notes.
uz: U qaytib kelib, diqqatini imtihon notlariga qaratishga harakat qildi.

en: He went to bed a little after midnight, and was awakened from lurid dreams in the small hours of Monday by the sound of door knockers, feet running in the street,
uz: U yarim tun o'tgach uxlab ketib, dushanba kunlarining kichik soatlarida eshikdagi qichqiriqlarning ovozi, ko'chada yugurayotgan oyoqlarning ovozi bilan dahshatli orzularidan uyg'onildi.

en: distant drumming, and a clamour of bells.
uz: Uzoq drumming va qo'ng'iroqlar shovqin.

en: Red reﬂections danced on the ceiling.
uz: Suvda qizil o'rinlar raqsga tushdi.

en: For a moment he lay astonished, wondering whether day had come or the world gone mad.
uz: U bir daqiqa davomida hayratda yotgan edi va kun kelibdimi yoki dunyo g'alati bo'lib qolganmi deb o'ylagan edi.

en: Then he jumped out of bed and ran to the window.
uz: So'ngra u o'z yotoqidan tushib, darcha tomon yugurdi.

en: His room was an attic and as he thrust his head out, up and down the street there were a dozen echoes to the noise of his window sash, and heads in every kind of night disarray appeared.
uz: Uning xonasi xonadoni edi va u boshini ko'tarib, ko'chaga ko'targanida, o'nlab o'rindiqlar o'z derazalaridagi shovqinlar bilan eshitildi va har qanday kechasi tartibsizlikda boshlar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Enquiries were being shouted.
uz: So'rovlar qichqirildi.

en: They are coming! bawled a policeman, hammering at the door; the Mar- tians are coming! and hurried to the next door.
uz: O'shalar kelayotgan! - deb qichqirdi bir politsiyachi, eshikni taqillatdi, martianlar kelayotgan! - deb qo'shiq so'zladi va qo'shni eshikga yugurdi.

en: The sound of drumming and trumpeting came from the Albany Street Barracks, and every church within earshot was hard at work killing sleep with a vehement disorderly tocsin.
uz: Albany ko'chasi kasaraklaridan davra va surunkali tovushlar eshitildi va har bir cherkov quloq ostidagi toxin bilan uyquni o'ldirish uchun jon kuydirib ishlaydi.

en: There was a noise of doors opening, and window after window in the houses opposite ﬂashed from darkness into yel- low illumination.
uz: Eshiklar ochilishining shov-shuvlari eshitildi va qarama-qarshi uylardagi oyna-oynalar qorong'ilikdan yorug' nurga aylandi.

en: Up the street came galloping a closed carriage, bursting abruptly into noise at the corner, rising to a clattering climax under the window, and dy- ing away slowly in the distance.
uz: Ko'chaga ko'tarilgan aravacha galop bo'lib, burchada shov-shuv bo'lib, deraza ostida to'qnashgan darajaga yetib bordi va uzoqlikda sekin-sakin o'tib ketdi.

en: Close on the rear of this came a couple of cabs, the forerunners of a long procession of ﬂying vehicles, going for the most part to Chalk Farm station, where the North-Western special trains were loading up, instead of coming down the gradient into Euston.
uz: Bularning orqasida bir necha taksilar, uzoq parvozdagi uchib borayotgan transport vositalarining oldindan ketayotganlari, asosan Chalk Farm stantsiyasiga, Shimoliy-G'arbiy maxsus poezdlar Eustonga tushishning o'rniga, yuklab borayotgan joyga borayotgan edi.

en: For a long time my brother stared out of the window in blank astonish- ment, watching the policemen hammering at door after door, and delivering their incomprehensible message.
uz: Oʻgʻlim koʻp vaqt davomida oʻzidan-oʻzi hayratda turib, eshikdan eshikni taqillatayotgan politsiyachilarni koʻrib, tushunarsiz xabarni yetkazgan.

en: Then the door behind him opened, and the man who lodged across the landing came in, dressed only in shirt, trousers, and slippers, his braces loose about his waist, his hair disordered from his pillow.
uz: Keyin uning orqasidagi eshik ochildi va uyiga tushishning o'zi tomonida yashovchi kishi kirdi, u faqat kiyim, shorts va paltarlar kiygan, belining orqa tomonida bo'sh bo'lgan braçkalari, yostiqidan sochlari buzilgan edi.

en: What the devil is it? he asked.
uz: U: Bu nima? - deb so'radi.

en: What a devil of a row! They both craned their heads out of the window, straining to hear what the policemen were shouting.
uz: Qani, bu qaygʻu-shubha demakdir! - deb oʻzlarini oqidan koʻtarib, politsiyachilar qichqirishini eshitishga harakat qilishdi.

en: People were coming out of the side streets, and standing in groups at the corners talking.
uz: Odamlar yon ko'chalardan chiqib, burchaklarda guruh-guruhlar bo'lib suhbatlashayotgan edilar.

en: What the devil is it all about? said my brother's fellow lodger.
uz: Bu nima bo'ldi? - dedi akamning hamkori.

en: My brother answered him vaguely and began to dress, running with each garment to the window in order to miss nothing of the growing excitement.
uz: Akam unga g'alati javob berib, ko'payib borayotgan hayajonni yo'qotmaslik uchun har bir kiyim bilan derazaga chopib, kiyinishni boshladi.

en: And presently men selling unnaturally early newspapers came bawling into the street: London in danger of suffocation!
uz: Va shu zahotiyoq tabiiy bo'lmagan muddatli gazetalarni sotadigan erkaklar ko'chaga qichqirib kelib: London cho'kish xavfi ostida!

en: The Kingston and Richmond defences forced!
uz: Kingston va Richmondning mudofaa qo'shinlari majbur bo'ldi!

en: Fearful massacres in the Thames Valley!
uz: Temza vodiysida qo'rqinchli qirg'inlar sodir bo'ldi!

en: And all about him—in the rooms below, in the houses on each side and across the road, and behind in the Park Terraces and in the hundred other streets of that part of Marylebone, and the Westbourne Park district and St.
uz: Va uning atrofida - pastki xonalarda, har bir tomondagi uylarda va yo'l o'rtasida, Park Terraces-da va Marylebone shahrining bu qismidagi boshqa yuzlab ko'chalarda, Westbourne Park tumanida va St.

en: Pancras, and westward and northward in Kilburn and St.
uz: Pancras, g'arbiy va shimoliy Kilburn va St.

en: John's Wood and Hampstead, and eastward in Shoreditch and Highbury and Haggerston and Hoxton, and, indeed, through all the vastness of London from Ealing to East Ham—people were rubbing their eyes, and opening windows to stare out and ask aimless questions, dressing hastily as the ﬁrst breath of the coming storm of Fear blew through the streets.
uz: John's Wood va Hampstead, Shoreditch va Highbury, Haggerston va Hoxton shaharlarida sharqqa qarab, haqiqatan ham, Londonning butun kengligi bo'ylab, Ealingdan East Hamgacha odamlar ko'zlarini burib, darvozalarni ochib, maqsadsiz savollar berishga harakat qilishardi.

en: It was the dawn of the great panic.
uz: Buyuk qo'rqinch uyg'onishining yorug'ligi edi.

en: London, which had gone to bed on Sunday night oblivious and inert, was awakened, in the small hours of Monday morning, to a vivid sense of danger.
uz: Yakshanba kuni kechasi befarq va befarq uxlagan London dushanba kuni ertalabning kichik soatlarida xavf-xatar hissi bilan uyg'onildi.

en: Unable from his window to learn what was happening, my brother went down and out into the street, just as the sky between the parapets of the houses grew pink with the early dawn.
uz: Oʻgʻlim oʻz darvozasidan nima boʻlayotganini bilmay, koʻchaga tushdi, xuddi uylarning parametlari oʻrtasidagi osmon erta tong bilan rosa boʻlganidek.

en: The ﬂying people on foot and in ve- hicles grew more numerous every moment.
uz: Uchuvchi odamlar piyoda va ko'chma-ko'chma bo'lib, har daqiqadan ko'proq ko'payib borishdi.

en: Black Smoke! he heard peo- ple crying, and again Black Smoke! The contagion of such a unanimous fear was inevitable.
uz: Qara tutun! - deb hayqiriqlarni eshitdi u, yana Qara tutun! deb hayqirdi.

en: As my brother hesitated on the door- step, he saw an- other news vender approaching, and got a paper forthwith.
uz: Birodarim eshikdagi qadamda shubha ostiga qo'yganida, u yana bir yangilik sotuvchisi yaqinlashayotganini ko'rdi va darhol qog'oz oldi.

en: The man was running away with the rest, and selling his papers for a shilling each as he ran—a grotesque mingling of proﬁt and panic.
uz: O'sha kishi qolganlar bilan birga qochib ketib, har bir shillingga qog'ozlarini sotar edi va foyda va qo'rqinchning g'alati aralashuvini o'tkazardi.

en: And from this paper my brother read that catastrophic dispatch of the Commander-in-Chief: The Martians are able to discharge enormous clouds of a black and poi- sonous vapour by means of rockets.
uz: Ushbu qog'ozdan akam bosh qo'mondonining bu dahshatli xabarini o'qib chiqdi: Marsliklar raketalar yordamida qora va po'y-so'noli bug'ning ulkan bulutlarini chiqarib yuborishga qodir.

en: They have smothered our batteries, de- stroyed Richmond, Kingston, and Wimbledon, and are advancing slowly towards London, destroying everything on the way.
uz: Ular bizning batareyalarimizni to'kib tashladilar, Richmond, Kingston va Vimbledonni yo'q qildilar va yo'ldagi hamma narsani yo'q qilib, London tomon sekin-sekin harakatlanmoqdalar.

en: It is impossible to stop them.
uz: Ularni to'xtatish imkonsiz.

en: There is no safety from the Black Smoke but in instant ﬂight. That was all, but it was enough.
uz: Qora tutundan o'zga hech qanday xavfsizlik yo'q, lekin o'z vaqtida uchib ketadi. Bu hammasi edi, ammo bu yetarli edi.

en: The whole population of the great six- million city was stirring, slipping, running; presently it would be pouring EN MASSE northward.
uz: Ulkan olti millionlik shaharning butun aholisi harakatlanib, chiqqach, yugurib ketayotgan edi; hozirda u shimoliga EN MASSE quyib ketadi.

en: Black Smoke! the voices cried.
uz: Qara tutun! - deb baqirdilar ovozlar.

en: Fire! The bells of the neighbouring church made a jangling tumult, a cart care- lessly driven smashed, amid shrieks and curses, against the water trough up the street.
uz: Qo'shni cherkovning qo'ng'iroqlari shovqinli shov-shuvni keltirdi, ko'cha bo'ylab qichqiriq va la'natlar o'rtasida suv bo'ylab bir vagon o'g'irlab ketadi.

en: Sickly yellow lights went to and fro in the houses, and some of the passing cabs ﬂaunted unextinguished lamps.
uz: Uylar ichida kasal sariq yorug'liklarni ko'rishardi, o'tib o'tadigan taksilarning ba'zilarida o'chirib ketmagan chiroqlar bor edi.

en: And overhead the dawn was growing brighter, clear and steady and calm.
uz: Ustiga-boshqa tong yorqin, aniq, barqaror va xotirjam bo'lib borardi.

en: He heard footsteps running to and fro in the rooms, and up and down stairs behind him.
uz: Xonalar ichidan bir-biriga va orqasidan pastga va yuqoriga qadamlar solayotganini eshitdi.

en: His landlady came to the door, loosely wrapped in dress- ing gown and shawl; her husband followed ejaculating.
uz: Uning uy egasi eshikga kirib keldi, u kiyim va shaliga o'girilgan edi; uning eri esa ejakulyatsiya qilishni davom ettirgan.

en: As my brother began to realise the import of all these things, he turned hastily to his own room, put all his available money—some ten pounds alto- gether—into his pockets, and went out again into the streets.
uz: Akam bularning barchasining ahamiyatini anglay boshlaganida, darhol o'z xonasiga qaytib, bor-yo'g'ini pulini - taxminan o'n funtlik pulni - kiyimlariga qo'yib, yana ko'chalarga chiqdi.

en: CHAPTER 15 WHAT HAD HAPPENED IN SURREY It was while the curate had sat and talked so wildly to me under the hedge in the ﬂat meadows near Halliford, and while my brother was watching the fugitives stream over Westminster Bridge, that the Martians had resumed the offensive.
uz: 15 - bob SURREYda sodir bo'lgan voqealar Halliford yaqinidagi maydon o'tlaridagi o'rmon ostida ruhoniy o'tirgan va menga juda vahshiy gapirgan va akam Westminster ko'prisi ustida qochoqlar oqishini kuzatib turganida, marsiyaliklar hujumni davom ettirishdi.

en: So far as one can ascertain from the conﬂicting accounts that have been put forth, the majority of them remained busied with preparations in the Horsell pit until nine that night, hurrying on some operation that dis- engaged huge volumes of green smoke.
uz: O'tkazilgan to'qnashuvchi hisobotlardan ko'rinib turganidek, ularning aksariyati o'sha kecha soat to'qqizgacha Horsell chuqurida tayyorgarlik ko'rish bilan band edilar va katta miqdordagi yashil tutunni o'chirib yuboradigan operatsiyalarni boshlashga shoshilmoqdalar.

en: But three certainly came out about eight o'clock and, advancing slowly and cautiously, made their way through Byﬂeet and Pyrford towards Ripley and Weybridge, and so came in sight of the expectant batteries against the setting sun.
uz: Ammo uchta kishi soat sakkizlarda chiqdi va sekin va ehtiyotkorlik bilan Byfleet va Pyrford orqali Ripley va Weybridge tomon yo'lga tushib, quyosh botganida kutib turgan batareyalarning ko'zlariga tushdi.

en: These Martians did not advance in a body, but in a line, each perhaps a mile and a half from his nearest fellow.
uz: Ushbu marsiyaliklar to'plamda emas, balki qatorda, har biri eng yaqin do'stidan, ehtimol, bir mil yarim yo'l uzoqlikda, oldinga ko'tarildilar.

en: They communicated with one another by means of sirenlike howls, running up and down the scale from one note to another.
uz: Ular bir-biri bilan sirenaga o'xshash qichqiriqlar orqali muloqot qilishgan, bir notadan boshqasiga o'tish va o'tish bilan o'zlarining o'yinda turishgan.

en: It was this howling and ﬁring of the guns at Ripley and St.
uz: Bu Ripley va St.

en: George's Hill that we had heard at Upper Halliford.
uz: Yuqori Hallifordda eshitgan George's Hill.

en: The Ripley gunners, unseasoned ar- tillery volunteers who ought never to have been placed in such a position, ﬁred one wild, premature, ineffectual volley, and bolted on horse and foot through the deserted village, while the Martian, without using his Heat-Ray, walked serenely over their guns, stepped gingerly among them, passed in front of them, and so came unexpectedly upon the guns in Painshill Park, which he destroyed.
uz: Ripley qirg'oqchilari, bunday vaziyatga hech qachon joylashtirilmasligi kerak bo'lgan o'simlik qurollari bo'lmagan ko'ngillilar, bir xil yovvoyi, ertalabki, samarali bo'lmagan volleyni o'qdilar va ot va oyoq bilan charchagan qishloqqa o'tib ketishdi, Martian esa Issiqlik nuridan foydalangan holda o'z qirg'oqlaridan tinchlik bilan o'tib, ularning orasiga qadam bosdi, ularning oldidan o'tdi va shuning uchun u o'zi yo'q qilgan Painshill Parkdagi qirg'oqlarga kutilmaganda duch keldi.

en: George's Hill men, however, were better led or of a better mettle.
uz: Biroq, Jorj Xillning erkaklari yaxshiroq yo'naltirilgan yoki ko'proq jasoratga ega edi.

en: Hidden by a pine wood as they were, they seem to have been quite unsus- pected by the Martian nearest to them.
uz: Ular bor-yo'g'i bo'lgan bor-yo'g'i bo'ron daraxtida yashiringan bo'lsa-da, ularga eng yaqin bo'lgan martian odamlari tomonidan aniqlangan bo'lib tuyuladi.

en: They laid their guns as deliberately as if they had been on parade, and ﬁred at about a thousand yards' range.
uz: Ular o'z qurollarini xuddi parada bo'lgani kabi bila turib qo'ydilar va ming metr masofadan o'qlashdi.

en: The shells ﬂashed all round him, and he was seen to advance a few paces, stagger, and go down.
uz: Uning atrofida qorong'ilar o'tkazib yuborildi va u bir necha qadam oldinga borishi, cho'kib ketishi va pastga tushishi ko'rinardi.

en: Everybody yelled together, and the guns were re- loaded in frantic haste.
uz: Hamma bir joyda qichqirdi va qurollar g'azabda qayta to'ldirdi.

en: The overthrown Martian set up a prolonged ulula- tion, and immediately a second glittering giant, answering him, appeared over the trees to the south.
uz: O'g'irlangan marsiyalik uzoq vaqt shov-shuv qildi va shu zahoti unga javob berayotgan ikkinchi parcha-parcha ulkan o'simlik janubiy daraxtlar ustida paydo bo'ldi.

en: It would seem that a leg of the tripod had been smashed by one of the shells.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, tripodning bir oyoqining bir qismi o'g'irlangan.

en: The whole of the second volley ﬂew wide of the Martian on the ground, and, simultaneously, both his companions brought their Heat-Rays to bear on the battery.
uz: Ikkinchi to'lov butunlay yer ustida bo'lgan Marsdan uzoqroq uchdi va bir vaqtning o'zida uning hamkorlari o'z issiqlik radiallarini batareya ustiga olib kelishdi.

en: The ammunition blew up, the pine trees all about the guns ﬂashed into ﬁre, and only one or two of the men who were already running over the crest of the hill escaped.
uz: Oʻq-dorilar portlandi, oʻq-quruqlar atrofidagi borliq daraxtlar olovga aylandi va togʻning choʻqqisidan oʻtib yugurgan erkaklardan faqat bittasi yoki ikkitasi qochib ketdi.

en: After this it would seem that the three took counsel together and halted, and the scouts who were watching them report that they remained absolute- ly stationary for the next half hour.
uz: Bundan so'ng, uch kishi birgalikda maslahatlashib, to'xtashgan va ularni kuzatib turgan skautlar keyingi yarim soat davomida mutlaqo to'xtab qolishganini xabar qilishdi.

en: The Martian who had been overthrown crawled tediously out of his hood, a small brown ﬁgure, oddly suggestive from that distance of a speck of blight, and apparently engaged in the repair of his support.
uz: O'g'rilab ketilgan marsiyalik o'zining qo'zg'oridan charchagancha chiqib ketdi, u kichik qalin suratli, o'sha masofadan g'ayrioddiy ko'rinadi va ko'rinib turibdiki, u o'zining qo'llab-quvvatlanishini ta'mirlash bilan shug'ullandi.

en: About nine he had ﬁnished, for his cowl was then seen above the trees again.
uz: Taxminan to'qqiz soatdan so'ng u o'z ishini tugatdi, chunki uning qo'lqovoshi daraxtlar ustida yana ko'rindi.

en: It was a few minutes past nine that night when these three sentinels were joined by four other Martians, each carrying a thick black tube.
uz: O'sha kecha soat to'qqizdan bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, ushbu uchta soqchiga boshqa to'rtta marsiyalik qo'shildi, ularning har biri qalin qora quvurni o'z ichiga olgan edi.

en: A similar tube was handed to each of the three, and the seven proceeded to distribute themselves at equal distances along a curved line between St.
uz: Uchtadan har biriga o'xshash quvur berildi va yetti kishi o'zlarini St. o'rtasidagi egri chiziq bo'ylab teng masofada taqsimlashdi.

en: George's Hill, Weybridge, and the village of Send, southwest of Ripley.
uz: George's Hill, Weybridge va Ripleyning janubi-g'arbida joylashgan Send qishlog'i.

en: A dozen rockets sprang out of the hills before them so soon as they began to move, and warned the waiting batteries about Ditton and Esher.
uz: Ular harakatlanishni boshlashganida, o'nlab raketalar ularning oldidan tog'lardan chiqib, Ditton va Esher haqida kutayotgan batareyalarni ogohlantirdi.

en: At the same time four of their ﬁghting machines, similarly armed with tubes, crossed the river, and two of them, black against the western sky, came into sight of myself and the curate as we hurried wearily and painfully along the road that runs northward out of Halliford.
uz: Shu bilan bir vaqtda ularning to'rtta jang mashinalari, xuddi shu tarzda quvurlar bilan qurollangan, daryosini kesib o'tdilar va ulardan ikkitasi g'arbiy osmonga qarata qora bo'lgan holda men va ruhoniyning ko'zlariga tushdi, chunki biz Halliforddan shimoliy tomonga ketadigan yo'l bo'ylab charchagan va og'riqli ravishda harakatlanardik.

en: They moved, as it seemed to us, upon a cloud, for a milky mist covered the ﬁelds and rose to a third of their height.
uz: Ular bulut ustida harakatlanardi, chunki sutli bulut dalalarni qoplab, ularning balandligining uchdan bir qismiga ko'tarildi.

en: At this sight the curate cried faintly in his throat, and began running; but I knew it was no good running from a Martian, and I turned aside and crawled through dewy nettles and brambles into the broad ditch by the side of the road.
uz: Bu ko'rishni ko'rib, ruhoniy qo'lga bosdi va yugurishni boshladi; lekin men Marsdan qochib ketishning yomonligini bilardim, shuning uchun o'girib, yo'l bo'yidagi keng qo'rg'onga o'g'irlab ketdim.
