en: He looked back, saw what I was doing, and turned to join me.
uz: U orqaga qarab, nima qilayotganimni ko'rdi va menga qo'shilish uchun orqaga burildi.

en: The two halted, the nearer to us standing and facing Sunbury, the remoter being a grey indistinctness towards the evening star, away towards Staines.
uz: Ikkalasi to'xtadi, eng yaqinimiz Sunburyga qaragan holda turdi, uzoqdan esa oqshom yulduziga qarata bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lib, Steynesga qarab ketdi.

en: The occasional howling of the Martians had ceased; they took up their positions in the huge crescent about their cylinders in absolute silence.
uz: Marsliklarning vaqti-vaqti bilan qichqirishlari to'xtadi; ular o'zlarining silindrlari atrofidagi ulkan yarim oyda mutlaqo hushyorlik bilan o'z o'rinlarini egallab olishdi.

en: It was a crescent with twelve miles between its horns.
uz: Bu o'z shoxlari o'rtasida o'n ikki millik yarim oy edi.

en: Never since the devis- ing of gunpowder was the beginning of a battle so still.
uz: O'q-po'rdon ishlab chiqilganidan beri hech qachon bunday tinchliksiz jangning boshlanishi bo'lmagan.

en: To us and to an ob- server about Ripley it would have had precisely the same effect—the Mar- tians seemed in solitary possession of the darkling night, lit only as it was by the slender moon, the stars, the afterglow of the daylight, and the ruddy glare from St.
uz: Biz uchun va Ripley atrofidagi bir ob-server uchun bu aynan shunday ta'sir ko'rsatgan bo'lardiMartiyaliklar qorong'i tunning yolg'iz o'zida bo'lganiga o'xshaydilar, ular faqat oz oy, yulduzlar, kunduz yorug'ligi va Quddus shahrining qizil yorug'ligi bilan nurlangan.

en: George's Hill and the woods of Painshill.
uz: Jorj tog'i va Painshill o'rmonlari.

en: But facing that crescent everywhere—at Staines, Hounslow, Ditton, Esh- er, Ockham, behind hills and woods south of the river, and across the ﬂat grass meadows to the north of it, wherever a cluster of trees or village hous- es gave sufﬁcient cover—the guns were waiting.
uz: Lekin bu yarim oyga qaraganda har yerda - Staines, Hounslow, Ditton, Esh-er, Ockhamda, daryoning janubiy tomonida tog'lar va o'rmonlar ortida va daryoning shimolida bo'lgan tekis o'tlar bo'ylab, daraxtlar to'plami yoki qishloq uylari to'g'ri qoplama bergan joylarda qurollar kutishardi.

en: The signal rockets burst and rained their sparks through the night and vanished, and the spirit of all those watching batteries rose to a tense expectation.
uz: Sinyal raketalari portlashdi va kecha davomida o'z sparkasini yog'dirdi va yo'q bo'lib ketdi va batareyalarni kuzatuvchilarning ruhi g'ayratli kutishlargacha ko'tarildi.

en: The Martians had but to advance into the line of ﬁre, and instantly those motionless black forms of men, those guns glittering so darkly in the early night, would explode into a thunderous fury of battle.
uz: Marsliklar olov liniyasiga qadam bosishlari kerak edi va darhol o'sha harakatsiz qora insonlar, erta tunda juda qorong'i bo'lib parcha-parcha bo'lgan qilichlar jang g'azabini kuchaytiradi.

en: No doubt the thought that was uppermost in a thousand of those vigilant minds, even as it was uppermost in mine, was the riddle—how much they understood of us.
uz: Shubhasizki, o'sha o'ylaydigan ming kishi orasida eng yuqori fikr, mening o'yishimda eng yuqori fikr bo'lgani kabi, ular biz haqimizda qanchalik yaxshi tushunishganining siridir.

en: Did they grasp that we in our millions were organized, disciplined, working together?
uz: Ular biz millionlab odamlarning uyushgan, murabbiy va birgalikda ishlayotganimizni tushunishganmi?

en: Or did they interpret our spurts of ﬁre, the sudden stinging of our shells, our steady investment of their encampment, as we should the furious unanimity of onslaught in a disturbed hive of bees?
uz: Yoki ular bizning yong'in qo'zg'atishimizni, o'z qorong'ilarimizning to'satdan tiklanishini, ularning lagerini doimiy ravishda sarmoya kiritayotganimizni, biz bir oylik uyga hujum qilishning g'azablangan bir ovozini tushunishimiz kerak bo'lganidek tushuntirishdimi?

en: Did they dream they might exterminate us?
uz: Ular bizni yo'q qilishlarini orzu qilganmi?

en: (At that time no one knew what food they needed.) A hundred such questions struggled together in my mind as I watched that vast sentinel shape.
uz: (O'sha paytda hech kim ularga nima kerakligini bilmasdi) O'sha keng qo'riqchi shaklini ko'rib turganimda, yuzlab savollar mening ongimda to'plandi.

en: And in the back of my mind was the sense of all the huge unknown and hidden forces Londonward.
uz: Va mening ongimning orqasida Londonga yo'naltirilgan barcha ulkan noma'lum va yashirin kuchlarning hissi bor edi.

en: Had they prepared pitfalls?
uz: Ular tuzoqlarni tayyorlaganmi?

en: Were the powder mills at Hounslow ready as a snare?
uz: Hounslowdagi kukun zavodi tuzoq sifatida tayyormi edi?

en: Would the Londoners have the heart and courage to make a greater Moscow of their mighty province of houses?
uz: Londondagilar o'zlarining qudratli uy-joylar viloyatini katta Moskvaga aylantirish uchun jasorat va jasoratga ega bo'lishadimi?

en: Then, after an interminable time, as it seemed to us, crouching and peer- ing through the hedge, came a sound like the distant concussion of a gun.
uz: So'ngra, o'zimizga ko'rinishicha, uzluksiz vaqtdan so'ng, o'zimizni ko'tarib, to'siqdan o'tib o'tirganimizda, o'ng tomondan o'q otgan qorong'ilarning shovqinini eshitgan edik.

en: Another nearer, and then another.
uz: Yana bir yaqinroq, keyin yana bir yaqinroq.

en: And then the Martian beside us raised his tube on high and discharged it, gunwise, with a heavy report that made the ground heave.
uz: So'ngra yonimizdagi marsiyalik o'zining quvurini yuqoriga ko'tardi va uni qo'l ustiga qo'yib yubordi. Bu esa yerni ko'targan og'ir xabar bilan sodir bo'ldi.

en: The one towards Staines answered him.
uz: Staynesga yo'naltirilgan kishi unga javob berdi.

en: There was no ﬂash, no smoke, simply that loaded detonation.
uz: Hech qanday chaqmoq, hech qanday tutun yo'q edi, shunchaki to'ldirilgan portlash edi.

en: I was so excited by these heavy minute-guns following one another that I so far forgot my personal safety and my scalded hands as to clamber up into the hedge and stare towards Sunbury.
uz: Men bu og'ir o'q-quruqlarning bir-biriga ergashib ketayotganidan shunchalik hayajonlangan edimki, o'z xavfsizligimni va qo'llarimni unutib qo'ydimki, o'rtaga chiqib, Sunburyga qarab qaradim.

en: As I did so a second report followed, and a big projectile hurtled overhead towards Hounslow.
uz: Men shunday qilsam, ikkinchi xabar keldi va katta raketa Hounslowga qarab boshdan tushdi.

en: I expected at least to see smoke or ﬁre, or some such evidence of its work.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda tutun yoki olovni yoki uning ishini ko'rishni kutardim.

en: But all I saw was the deep blue sky above, with one solitary star, and the white mist spreading wide and low beneath.
uz: Ammo men faqat yuqorida chuqur ko'k osmonni, bitta yulduz bilan, uning pastida esa keng va past bo'lgan oq bulutni ko'rdim.

en: And there had been no crash, no answering explo- sion.
uz: Va hech qanday avariya, hech qanday javob beruvchi portlash bo'lmagan.

en: The silence was restored; the minute lengthened to three.
uz: Shoshilish tiklandi; daqiqa uch gacha davom etdi.

en: What has happened? said the curate, standing up beside me.
uz: Nima bo'ldi? - dedi ruhoniy, yonimda turib.

en: Heaven knows! said I.
uz: Osmon biladi! - dedi men.

en: A bat ﬂickered by and vanished.
uz: Bir tuxum o'tib ketdi va yo'qoldi.

en: A distant tumult of shouting began and ceased.
uz: Uzoq qichqiriqlarning shovqinlari boshlangan va to'xtalgan.

en: I looked again at the Martian, and saw he was now moving east- ward along the riverbank, with a swift, rolling motion, Every moment I expected the ﬁre of some hidden battery to spring upon him; but the evening calm was unbroken.
uz: Men yana martianchiga qaradim va ko'rdimki, u sharqqa qarab, daryo qirg'og'i bo'ylab, tez harakatlanib borayotgan edi. Har bir daqiqada uning ustiga yashirin batareyaning o'tlari tushib ketishini kutardim; lekin kechqurun tinchlik uzluksiz edi.

en: The ﬁgure of the Martian grew smaller as he receded, and presently the mist and the gathering night had swallowed him up.
uz: Marslikning shaxsiyati orqaga qaytgan sayin kichrayib borardi va ko'p o'tmay, bulut va yig'ilish kechasi uni yutib yubordi.

en: By a common impulse we clambered higher.
uz: Biz umumiy impuls orqali yuqoriga ko'tarilgan edik.

en: Towards Sunbury was a dark appearance, as though a conical hill had suddenly come into being there, hiding our view of the farther country; and then, remoter across the river, over Walton, we saw another such summit.
uz: Sunbury tomon qorong'i ko'rinish ko'rinardi, xuddi shunga o'xshab, birdan bir shkafli tog' u yerda paydo bo'lib, uzoqroq qishloqning ko'rinishini yashirib qo'ydi; so'ngra, daryo o'tishidan uzoqroq, Valtonning ustida, biz yana bir shunga o'xshash tepalikni ko'rdik.

en: These hill-like forms grew lower and broader even as we stared.
uz: Bu tog'ga o'xshash shakllar biz ko'z o'ngimizga qaraganimizda ham past va kengroq o'sib borardi.

en: Moved by a sudden thought, I looked northward, and there I perceived a third of these cloudy black kopjes had risen.
uz: To'satdan o'ylab ko'rgach, shimoliga qarab, bulutli qora ko'piklarning uchdan bir qismi ko'tarilganini payqadim.

en: Everything had suddenly become very still.
uz: Toʻsatdan hamma narsa osoyishta boʻldi.

en: Far away to the southeast, marking the quiet, we heard the Martians hooting to one another, and then the air quivered again with the distant thud of their guns.
uz: Uzoq janubi-sharqqa qarab, tinchlikni belgilab, martliklar bir-birlariga qo'shiq qo'yishganini eshitdik va keyin havo yana o'zlarining qurollarining uzoqdagi shovqinlari bilan titrab ketdi.

en: But the earthly ar- tillery made no reply.
uz: Ammo yerdagi armiya hech qanday javob bermadi.

en: Now at the time we could not understand these things, but later I was to learn the meaning of these ominous kopjes that gathered in the twilight.
uz: O'sha paytda biz bu narsalarni tushunolmasdik, lekin keyinchalik men bu qorong'ilikda to'plangan bu dahshatli kopjelarning ma'nosini bilib olishim kerak edi.

en: Each of the Martians, standing in the great crescent I have described, had discharged, by means of the gunlike tube he carried, a huge canister over whatever hill, copse, cluster of houses, or other possible cover for guns, chanced to be in front of him.
uz: Men tasvirlagan buyuk yarim oyda turgan Marsliklarning har biri o'zidan oldidagi qurolga o'xshash quvur yordamida, uning oldida turgan har qanday tepalik, qo'rqinch, uylar to'plami yoki boshqa qurollar uchun mumkin bo'lgan qoplama ustidan ulkan qo'riqchini tashlagan edi.

en: Some ﬁred only one of these, some two—as in the case of the one we had seen; the one at Ripley is said to have dis- charged no fewer than ﬁve at that time.
uz: Ba'zilar ulardan faqat bittasini, biz ko'rgan kishining holatida esa ikkitasini o'qlashgan; Ripleyda bo'lgan kishi o'sha paytda besh nafardan kam bo'lmagan ayblovlarni chiqargan deb aytiladi.

en: These canisters smashed on striking the ground—they did not explode—and incontinently disengaged an enor- mous volume of heavy, inky vapour, coiling and pouring upward in a huge
uz: Bu kanisterlar yerga urilganda parchalanib ketardi, lekin ular portlamadi va o'z-o'zidan tashqari og'ir, qora qora qora bug'ning ulkan hajmini to'sib, katta hajmda yuqoriga quyib yuboradi.

en: and ebony cumulus cloud, a gaseous hill that sank and spread itself slowly over the surrounding country.
uz: va eboniy kumulus bulutlari, atrofdagi mamlakat bo'ylab o'zini sekin-sekin tarqatgan va cho'kib ketgan gazli tepalik.

en: And the touch of that vapour, the inhaling of its pungent wisps, was death to all that breathes.
uz: O'sha bug'ning tuyg'usi, uning o'tkir teshiklarini nafas olish, nafas olganlarning barchasi uchun o'lim edi.

en: It was heavy, this vapour, heavier than the densest smoke, so that, after the ﬁrst tumultuous uprush and outﬂow of its impact, it sank down through the air and poured over the ground in a manner rather liquid than gaseous, abandoning the hills, and streaming into the valleys and ditches and water- courses even as I have heard the carbonic-acid gas that pours from volcanic clefts is wont to do.
uz: U og'ir edi, bu bug', eng zich tutundan og'ir edi, shuning uchun birinchi shovqinli ko'tarilish va uning ta'siridan keyin u havo orqali qulab, yer ustiga gazli emas, balki suyuq tarzda to'kib, tog'larni tashlab, vodiylar va chuqurliklar va suv tomoshalariga oqib o'tdi. Men vulqonlar bo'g'inlaridan oqib kelayotgan karbonik kislota gazini eshitganimdek, suv tomoshalariga oqib o'tdi.

en: And where it came upon water some chemical action occurred, and the surface would be instantly covered with a powdery scum that sank slowly and made way for more.
uz: Suvga tushib qolgan joyda kimyoviy ta'sir sodir bo'ldi va suvning yuzi darhol to'qima-to'qima bo'lib, sekin-sakin qulab ketadi va ko'proq narsalarga yo'l ochadi.

en: The scum was absolutely insolu- ble, and it is a strange thing, seeing the instant effect of the gas, that one could drink without hurt the water from which it had been strained.
uz: Bu chiqindilar mutlaqo halol bo'lmagan va gazning darhol ta'sirini ko'rib, odam suvni zararsiz ichishi mumkinligi ajablanarli.

en: The vapour did not diffuse as a true gas would do.
uz: Buvor haqiqiy gaz kabi tarqalmadi.

en: It hung together in banks, ﬂowing sluggishly down the slope of the land and driving reluctantly before the wind, and very slowly it combined with the mist and moisture of the air, and sank to the earth in the form of dust.
uz: U qirg'oqlarda bir-biri bilan bog'lanib, quruqlik bo'ylab sekin-sakin oqib, shamolga qarshi o'z xohishini yo'lga qo'ydi va juda sekin havodagi bulut va namlik bilan birlashtirib, tuproq shaklida yerga qulab tushdi.

en: Save that an unknown element giving a group of four lines in the blue of the spectrum is concerned, we are still entirely ignorant of the nature of this substance.
uz: Spektrning ko'k rangidagi to'rtta chiziqdan iborat guruhni tashkil etuvchi noma'lum element haqida gap ketmasa-da, biz bu modda xususiyatidan hali ham bexabarmiz.

en: Once the tumultuous upheaval of its dispersion was over, the black smoke clung so closely to the ground, even before its precipitation, that ﬁfty feet up in the air, on the roofs and upper stories of high houses and on great trees, there was a chance of escaping its poison altogether, as was proved even that night at Street Cobham and Ditton.
uz: Uning tarqalishining shov-shuvli shov-shuvlari tugagach, qora tutun yerga shunchalik yaqin yopishib qoldi, hatto yomg'ir yog'ishdan oldin ham, u o'n besh metr balandlikda, baland uylarning tomlarida va yuqori qavatlarida va katta daraxtlarda uning zaharidan butunlay qutulish imkoniyati bor edi, xuddi shu kecha Cobham va Ditton ko'chalarida ham isbotlanganidek.

en: The man who escaped at the former place tells a wonderful story of the strangeness of its coiling ﬂow, and how he looked down from the church spire and saw the houses of the village rising like ghosts out of its inky nothingness.
uz: Oldingi joyda qochgan kishi uning o'ziga xos oqimining g'ayrioddiyligi va u cherkov minoralaridan pastga qarab, qishloq uylari uning qora hech narsasidan ruhiy ruhlar kabi chiqib ketayotganini ko'rganidan ajoyib hikoyani aytib beradi.

en: For a day and a half he remained there, weary, starving and sun-scorched, the earth under the blue sky and against the prospect of the distant hills a velvet-black expanse, with red roofs, green trees, and, later, black-veiled shrubs and gates, barns, outhouses, and walls, rising here and there into the sunlight.
uz: U bir yarim kun davomida u erda, charchagan, och va quyosh yondirib, ko'k osmon ostidagi yer va uzoq tog'larning ko'rinishiga qaraganda, qizil toshlar, yashil daraxtlar va keyinchalik qora parda bilan qoplangan butalar va darvozalar, hovlilar, uylar va devorlar bilan quyosh nuriga ko'tarilgan, bir-biridan ko'tariladigan samoviy ko'k va qora qora ko'chatlar.

en: But that was at Street Cobham, where the black vapour was allowed to remain until it sank of its own accord into the ground.
uz: Ammo bu Cobham ko'chasida bo'lgan, u yerda qora bug' o'z-o'zidan yerga cho'kguncha qolishiga ruxsat berildi.

en: As a rule the Mar- tians, when it had served its purpose, cleared the air of it again by wading into it and directing a jet of steam upon it.
uz: Qoida bo'yicha, martianlar, u o'z maqsadiga xizmat qilganida, unga kirib, uymush uchirib yuborib, havoni yana tozaladilar.

en: This they did with the vapour banks near us, as we saw in the starlight from the window of a deserted house at Upper Halliford, whither we had returned.
uz: Biz qaytib kelgan Upper Halliforddagi bo'lak uyining derazasidan yulduz nurida ko'rganimizdek, ular bizga yaqin joylashgan bug' banklari bilan shunday qilishdi.

en: From there we could see the searchlights on Richmond Hill and Kingston Hill going to and fro, and about eleven the windows rattled, and we heard the sound of the huge siege guns that had been put in position there.
uz: U yerdan biz Richmond Hill va Kingston Hilldagi qidiruv chiroqlarini ko'rishimiz mumkin edi va taxminan o'n birta derazalar shov-shuvga tushdi va biz u erda joylashtirilgan ulkan qirg'inlarning ovozini eshitdik.

en: These continued intermittently for the space of a quarter of an hour, sending chance shots at the invisible Martians at Hampton and Ditton, and then the pale beams of the electric light vanished, and were replaced by a bright red glow.
uz: Bular bir chorak soat davomida aralashib, Hampton va Dittondagi ko'rinmas Marschilarga tasodifiy fotosuratlar yuboradi, so'ngra elektr yorug'ligining soyaq nurlari yo'q bo'lib, o'rniga yorug' qizil yorug'lik paydo bo'ladi.

en: Then the fourth cylinder fell—a brilliant green meteor—as I learned af- terwards, in Bushey Park.
uz: Keyin to'rtinchi silindr Bushy Parkda yuqorida bilib olganimda, yorqin yashil meteor tushdi.

en: Before the guns on the Richmond and Kingston line of hills began, there was a ﬁtful cannonade far away in the southwest, due, I believe, to guns being ﬁred haphazard before the black vapour could overwhelm the gunners.
uz: Richmond va Kingston tog'lari bo'ylab qurol-yarog'lar ishga tushirilishidan oldin janubi-g'arbiy qismda o'z-o'zidan o'tkir qo'zg'olonlar paydo bo'lgan, chunki qora bug'lar qorovullarni o'ldirishdan oldin qurol-yarog'lar tasodifan o'tkazib yuborilgan.

en: So, setting about it as methodically as men might smoke out a wasps' nest, the Martians spread this strange stiﬂing vapour over the Londonward country.
uz: Shunday qilib, odamlar o'simlik yuzini chekish kabi usulda harakat qilib, marsiyaliklar bu g'alati, o'tkir bug'ni Londonga yaqin mamlakatga tarqatishdi.

en: The horns of the crescent slowly moved apart, until at last they formed a line from Hanwell to Coombe and Malden.
uz: Yarim oyning shoxlari asta-sekin bo'linadi, nihoyat ular Hanwelldan Coombe va Maldengacha bo'lgan chiziqni tashkil etdilar.

en: All night through their destructive tubes advanced.
uz: Ular butun kecha davomida o'zlarining zararli quvurlari orqali oldinga qadam qo'yishdi.

en: Never once, after the Martian at St.
uz: Hech qachon, St.

en: George's Hill was brought down, did they give the artillery the ghost of a chance against them.
uz: George's Hill vayron qilinganida, ular to'qnashuvchilarga o'zlariga qarshi imkoniyat berishgan.

en: Wherever there was a possibility of guns being laid for them unseen, a fresh canister of the black vapour was discharged, and where the guns were openly displayed the Heat-Ray was brought to bear.
uz: Ular uchun ko'rinmas ravishda qurollar qo'yilishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday joyda, qora bug'ning yangi kanisterlari chiqarilardi va qurollar ochiq ko'rsatilgan joylarda issiqlik nurlari ishga tushirilardi.

en: By midnight the blazing trees along the slopes of Richmond Park and the glare of Kingston Hill threw their light upon a network of black smoke, blotting out the whole valley of the Thames and extending as far as the eye could reach.
uz: Tungi yarim kechaga kelib, Richmond Parkning tepaliklarida yonayotgan daraxtlar va Kingston Hillning yorug'ligi qora tutun to'pasiga yorug'liklarini yubordilar va butun Temis vodiysi o'tib, ko'z yetib borgancha kengaydi.

en: And through this two Martians slowly waded, and turned their hissing steam jets this way and that.
uz: Va bu orqali ikki marsiyaliklar sekin-sekin o'tdilar va o'zlarining g'iybatli bug' samolyotlarini shu yo'ldan va shu yo'ldan aylantirdilar.

en: They were sparing of the Heat-Ray that night, either because they had but a limited supply of material for its production or because they did not wish to destroy the country but only to crush and overawe the opposition they had aroused.
uz: Ular o'sha kecha issiqlik radiyasini saqlab qolishardi, chunki ular uni ishlab chiqarish uchun cheklangan materiallarga ega edilar yoki mamlakatni yo'q qilishni istamadilar, lekin ular qo'zg'atgan qarshilikni ezib tashlash va o'chirib tashlash uchun.

en: In the latter aim they certainly succeeded.
uz: Ikkinchi maqsadga erishish uchun ular albatta muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishdi.

en: Sunday night was the end of the organised opposition to their movements.
uz: Yakshanba kuni kechasi ularning harakatlariga qarshilik ko'rsatgan tashkilotlarning oxiri bo'ldi.

en: After that no body of men would stand against them, so hopeless was the enterprise.
uz: Shundan keyin hech bir odam ularga qarshi tura olmaydi, bu ish juda umidsiz edi.

en: Even the crews of the torpedo-boats and destroyers that had brought their quick-ﬁrers up the Thames refused to stop, mutinied, and went down again.
uz: Hatto torpedoli kemalar va qiruvchilar ekipajlari ham, tezkor o'qchilarini Temis daryosi bo'ylab olib borganlarida, to'xtamay, isyon ko'tarishdi va yana qulab tushishdi.

en: The only offensive operation men ventured upon after that night was the preparation
uz: O'sha kechadan keyin erkaklar qo'lga kiritgan yagona ofensiv operatsiya - tayyorgarlik edi

en: of mines and pitfalls, and even in that their energies were frantic and spasmodic.
uz: Minlar va tuzoqlar, hatto ularning energiyalari g'alati va spasmodik bo'lganligi sababli ham.

en: One has to imagine, as well as one may, the fate of those batteries to- wards Esher, waiting so tensely in the twilight.
uz: Biror kishi, xuddi shunday qilib, Esher shahriga boradigan, soqiy oyda juda g'amgin kutayotgan batareyalarning taqdirini tasavvur qilishi kerak.

en: Survivors there were none.
uz: Hech kim omon qolmadi.

en: One may picture the orderly expectation, the ofﬁcers alert and watchful, the gunners ready, the ammunition piled to hand, the limber gunners with their horses and waggons, the groups of civilian spectators standing as near as they were permitted, the evening stillness, the ambulances and hospital tents with the burned and wounded from Weybridge; then the dull reso- nance of the shots the Martians ﬁred, and the clumsy projectile whirling over the trees and houses and smashing amid the neighbouring ﬁelds.
uz: O'ylab ko'rish mumkinki, odatdagi kutilmish, ofitserlar hushyor va hushyor, o'qchilar tayyor, qo'lda to'plangan sursatlar, ot va vagonlari bilan o'qchilar, fuqarolar ko'z o'ngida turgan guruhlar, kechqurun tinchlik, Vaybridjdan yonib ketgan va jarohatlanganlar bilan shovqinlar va kasalxona chodirlari; so'ngra marsiyaliklar tomonidan o'qilgan o'qlarning chiroyli resonansiyasi va daraxtlar va uylar ustida aylanib borayotgan va qo'shni dalalar orasida parchalanib borayotgan noaniq raketalar.

en: One may picture, too, the sudden shifting of the attention, the swiftly spreading coils and bellyings of that blackness advancing headlong, tower- ing heavenward, turning the twilight to a palpable darkness, a strange and horrible antagonist of vapour striding upon its victims, men and horses near it seen dimly, running, shrieking, falling headlong, shouts of dismay, the guns suddenly abandoned, men choking and writhing on the ground, and the swift broadening-out of the opaque cone of smoke.
uz: Shuningdek, e'tiborning to'satdan o'zgarib ketishini, qorong'ilikning tezda tarqalgan boboklari va qorinlari bosh ko'tarib, osmon tomon ko'tarilganini, so'nggi kunlarni aniq qorong'ilikka aylantirganini, qurbonlari ustiga qadam bosgan g'alati va dahshatli bug'ning dushmani, uning yaqinidagi erkaklar va otlarni ko'rish, ko'rinish, yugurish, qichqiriq, bosh ko'tarib tushish, qo'rqinchning qichqiriqlari, qilichlar to'satdan tashlab ketilgan, odamlar yerga cho'kib, burib ketish va tutunning shaffof bo'lmagan konining tezda kenglashishini tasavvur qilish mumkin.

en: And then night and extinction—nothing but a silent mass of impenetrable vapour hiding its dead.
uz: Va keyin kechasi va o'lim - o'z o'liklarini yashirgan o'tkir tutunning xotirjam to'plamidan boshqa hech narsa emas.

en: Before dawn the black vapour was pouring through the streets of Rich- mond, and the disintegrating organism of government was, with a last ex- piring effort, rousing the population of London to the necessity of ﬂight.
uz: Quyosh tongidan oldin Richmondning ko'chalarida qora bug' oqib turardi va hukumatning buzib ketayotgan organizmi Londondagi aholini so'nggi bor kuch bilan qochishga majbur qildi.

en: CHAPTER 16 THE EXODUS FROM LONDON So you understand the roaring wave of fear that swept through the greatest city in the world just as Monday was dawning—the stream of ﬂight rising swiftly to a torrent, lashing in a foaming tumult round the railway stations, banked up into a horrible struggle about the shipping in the Thames, and hurrying by every available channel northward and eastward.
uz: 16 bob Londondan chiqib ketish Shunday qilib, dunyoning eng buyuk shahri bo'ylab o'tib ketgan qo'rquv to'lqinini tushunasiz, chunki dushanba kunlari yorug' bo'lganida uchuv oqimi daryoga tezda ko'tarildi, temir yo'l stansiyalari atrofida cho'g'ayib ketgan shov-shuvlarga to'lib-toshdi, Temzda dengiz tashish bilan bog'liq dahshatli kurashga to'lib-toshdi va har qanday mavjud kanal orqali shimoliy va sharqiy yo'nalishga shoshdi.

en: By ten o'clock the police organisation, and by midday even the railway organisations, were losing coherency, losing shape and efﬁciency, guttering, softening, running at last in that swift liquefaction of the social body.
uz: O'n soatga qadar politsiya tashkiloti, hatto kunduzigacha temir yo'l tashkilotlari ham qat'iylikni yo'qotishardi, shakli va samaradorligini yo'qotishardi, qo'zg'otishardi, yumshatishardi, nihoyat ijtimoiy tana tez-tez suyuqlashardi.

en: All the railway lines north of the Thames and the South-Eastern people at Cannon Street had been warned by midnight on Sunday, and trains were be- ing ﬁlled.
uz: Chempionatda Temsdan shimoliy va Kannon ko'chasidagi janubi-sharqiy odamlarning barcha temir yo'llari yakshanba kuni kechqurun ogohlantirilgan edi va poezdlar to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: People were ﬁghting savagely for standing- room in the carriages even at two o'clock.
uz: Odamlar hatto soat ikkilarda ham vagonlarda turish uchun vahshiy kurashishardi.

en: By three, people were being trampled and crushed even in Bishopsgate Street, a couple of hundred yards or more from Liverpool Street station; revolvers were ﬁred, people stabbed, and the policemen who had been sent to direct the trafﬁc, exhausted and infuriated, were breaking the heads of the people they were called out to protect.
uz: Uch soatga kelib, odamlar Bishopsgate ko'chasida ham, Liverpul ko'chasi stantsiyasidan bir necha yuz metr yoki undan ko'proq uzoqlikda cho'kib, cho'kib ketishardi; revolverlar o'qildi, odamlar o'ldirildi va trafikni yo'naltirish uchun yuborilgan politsiyachilar, charchagan va g'azabga to'lgan holda, himoya qilishlari kerak bo'lgan odamlarning boshlarini sindirishardi.

en: And as the day advanced and the engine drivers and stokers refused to return to London, the pressure of the ﬂight drove the people in an ever- thickening multitude away from the stations and along the northward-run- ning roads.
uz: Kun o'tib borar ekan va dvigatel haydovchilari va stokerlar Londonga qaytishni rad etar ekan, parvozning bosimi odamlarni tobora tobora ko'payib borayotgan to'plamda stansiyalardan uzoqlashtirib, shimoliy yo'llar bo'ylab olib borardi.

en: By midday a Martian had been seen at Barnes, and a cloud of slowly sinking black vapour drove along the Thames and across the ﬂats of Lambeth, cutting off all escape over the bridges in its sluggish advance.
uz: Tush paytida Barnesda marsiyalik ko'rishgan edi va qora bug'lar bulutlari Tasma suvi bo'ylab va Lambetning maydonlari bo'ylab harakatlanib, ko'priklar orqali o'zlarining sekinlik bilan harakatlanayotgan harakatlarini to'xtatgan.

en: An- other bank drove over Ealing, and surrounded a little island of survivors on Castle Hill, alive, but unable to escape.
uz: Boshqa bir bank Ealingni bosib o'tib, Castle Hilldagi tirik qolganlar orqasidan o'tgan kichik orolni o'rab oldi, ammo qochib ketolmadi.

en: After a fruitless struggle to get aboard a North-Western train at Chalk Farm—the engines of the trains that had loaded in the goods yard there PLOUGHED through shrieking people, and a dozen stalwart men fought to
uz: Chalk Farmda Shimoliy-G'arbiy poezdga o'tish uchun samarasiz kurashdan so'ng, u yerdagi tovar saroyida yuklangan poezdlarning dvigatellari qichqiriq qilib o'tgan odamlar orqali to'ldirdi va o'nlab kuchli kishilar uni himoya qilish uchun kurashdi.

en: keep the crowd from crushing the driver against his furnace—my brother emerged upon the Chalk Farm road, dodged across through a hurrying swarm of vehicles, and had the luck to be foremost in the sack of a cycle shop.
uz: Jamoat haydovchini o'tqazmaslikka to'sqinlik qilmasinO'g'lim Chalk Farm yo'lida paydo bo'ldi, tez-tez harakatlanayotgan transport vositalari to'plamidan o'tib o'tdi va velosiped do'konining to'plamida birinchi o'rinni egalladi.

en: The front tire of the machine he got was punctured in dragging it through the window, but he got up and off, notwithstanding, with no further injury than a cut wrist.
uz: U olgan mashinaning old tomiri o'g'ilni oynadan tortib o'tishi natijasida teshiklangan, ammo u o'z ko'zidan turib, o'tib ketgan, ammo qo'lni kesib tashlashdan boshqa jarohat ko'rmagan.

en: The steep foot of Haverstock Hill was impassable owing to several overturned horses, and my brother struck into Belsize Road.
uz: Haverstok tog'ining baland oyoqlari bir necha marta burilgan otlar tufayli o'tmas edi va akam Belsize yo'liga tushib qoldi.

en: So he got out of the fury of the panic, and, skirting the Edgware Road, reached Edgware about seven, fasting and wearied, but well ahead of the crowd.
uz: Shunda u dahshatli g'azabdan chiqib, Edgware yo'lidan o'tib, yetti soat atrofida Edgwarega yetib keldi, ro'za tutgan va charchagan edi, ammo xaloyiqdan ancha oldinda edi.

en: Along the road people were standing in the roadway, curious, won- dering.
uz: Yo'l bo'ylab odamlar yo'l yo'lida turib, qiziquvchan, g'ayratli edilar.

en: He was passed by a number of cyclists, some horsemen, and two motor cars.
uz: Uning yonidan bir nechta velosipedchilar, ba'zi otliqlar va ikkita avtomobil o'tib ketdi.

en: A mile from Edgware the rim of the wheel broke, and the ma- chine became unridable.
uz: Edgware-dan bir mil uzoqlikda haydovchining tekisining bo'yi parchalanib ketdi va mashinani yo'ldan ozdirish mumkin emasdi.

en: He left it by the roadside and trudged through the village.
uz: U uni yo'l bo'yiga qoldirib, qishloqqa yurdi.

en: There were shops half opened in the main street of the place, and people crowded on the pavement and in the doorways and windows, staring astonished at this extraordinary procession of fugitives that was beginning.
uz: Mahallaning asosiy ko'chasida yarim ochilgan do'konlar bor edi va odamlar piyoda, eshiklar va derazalarda to'planib, qochqinlarning boshlanayotgan ushbu noyob marosimini hayratda qoldirib kuzatib turishgan.

en: He succeeded in getting some food at an inn.
uz: U mehmonxonada ovqat olishda muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

en: For a time he remained in Edgware not knowing what next to do.
uz: U bir muncha vaqt Edgware-da qoldi va nima qilishni bilmay qoldi.

en: The ﬂy- ing people increased in number.
uz: Uchuvchilar soni ko'paydi.

en: Many of them, like my brother, seemed in- clined to loiter in the place.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi, akam singari, bu yerda yurishga moyil ko'rinardi.

en: There was no fresh news of the invaders from Mars.
uz: Marsdan kelgan ishlovchilar to'g'risida yangi xabar yo'q edi.

en: At that time the road was crowded, but as yet far from congested.
uz: O'sha paytda yo'l juda ko'p odamlarga to'lib-toshgan edi, ammo hali ham to'plangan yo'llardan uzoq edi.

en: Most of the fugitives at that hour were mounted on cycles, but there were soon motor cars, hansom cabs, and carriages hurrying along, and the dust hung in heavy clouds along the road to St.
uz: O'sha soatda qochoqlarning aksariyati velosipedda o'tirgan edi, ammo tez orada mashinalar, hanzom taksilar va vagonlar tezda yugurib ketayotgan edi va chang St. Petersburgga ketayotgan yo'l bo'ylab og'ir bulutlarda osilgan edi.

en: It was perhaps a vague idea of making his way to Chelmsford, where some friends of his lived, that at last induced my brother to strike into a qui- et lane running eastward.
uz: Ehtimol, uning do'stlari yashaydigan Chelmsfordga borishni o'ylash haqidagi g'ayritabiiy g'oya, oxir-oqibat akamni sharqqa borayotgan to'xtash yo'liga urishga undadi.

en: Presently he came upon a stile, and, crossing it, followed a footpath northeastward.
uz: O'sha zahoti u bir yo'nalish bilan uchrashdi va uni kesib o'tib, shimoli-sharqiy yo'nalishdagi yo'lni bosib o'tdi.

en: He passed near several farmhouses and some little places whose names he did not learn.
uz: U bir nechta ferma uylari va ba'zi kichik joylardan o'tib o'tdi, ularning ismlarini bilmagan.

en: He saw few fugitives until, in a grass lane towards High Barnet, he happened upon two ladies who be- came his fellow travellers.
uz: U o'z ko'zi bilan ko'pgina qochib ketayotganlarni ko'rdi, lekin o't-o't bo'ylab, yuqori barnetga borayotgan o't yo'lida, u ikki ayol bilan uchrashdi, ular uning yo'lovchi hamkasblari edi.

en: He came upon them just in time to save them.
uz: U ularni qutqarish uchun o'z vaqtida ularning oldiga keldi.

en: He heard their screams, and, hurrying round the corner, saw a couple of men struggling to drag them out of the little pony-chaise in which they had been driving, while a third with difﬁculty held the frightened pony's head.
uz: U ularning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi va burchada yugurib, bir necha kishining ularni haydash uchun kurashayotganini ko'rdi, uchinchi kishi esa qo'rqib ketgan ponining boshini qiyinchilik bilan ushlab turdi.

en: One of the ladies, a short woman dressed in white, was simply screaming;
uz: Xotinlardan biri oq kiyim kiygan kichik ayol shunchaki qichqirdi;

en: the other, a dark, slender ﬁgure, slashed at the man who gripped her arm with a whip she held in her disengaged hand.
uz: Ikkinchisi, qorong'i va chiroyli bo'lib, qo'lidan ajralgan qo'lidan ushlab turgan odamni qamchiladi.

en: My brother immediately grasped the situation, shouted, and hurried to- wards the struggle.
uz: Birodarim darhol vaziyatni tushunib oldi, qichqirdi va kurashni boshlashga shoshildi.

en: One of the men desisted and turned towards him, and my brother, realising from his antagonist's face that a ﬁght was unavoidable, and being an expert boxer, went into him forthwith and sent him down against the wheel of the chaise.
uz: O'g'lim, dushmanining ko'zidan jangning oldini olishning iloji borligini va bokschining mahoratli bo'lgani sababli, darhol uning ichiga kirib, uni to'shakning o'g'li ustiga tashladi.

en: It was no time for pugilistic chivalry and my brother laid him quiet with a kick, and gripped the collar of the man who pulled at the slender lady's arm.
uz: Bo'g'ishlovchi chivallik uchun vaqt bo'lmadi va akam uni shovqin bilan tinchlashtirdi va kamon ayolning qo'lini qo'yib olgan kishining bo'yinini ushlab qoldi.

en: He heard the clatter of hoofs, the whip stung across his face, a third antago- nist struck him between the eyes, and the man he held wrenched himself free and made off down the lane in the direction from which he had come.
uz: U to'qnashuvlarning qichqirishini, yuzidan qamchilab o'tirgan qamchani, uchinchi qo'rqinch uning ko'z o'rtasida urganini eshitdi va u ushlab turgan odam o'zini ozod qilib, o'zi kelgan yo'nalishdagi yo'lni yo'lga boshladi.

en: Partly stunned, he found himself facing the man who had held the horse's head, and became aware of the chaise receding from him down the lane, swaying from side to side, and with the women in it looking back.
uz: U qisman hayron bo'lib, otning boshini ushlab turgan odamga qaragan va o'sha o'rinbosarning yo'ldan orqaga chiqib, yonma-yon harakatlanayotganini va uning ichidagi ayollar orqaga qarab turganini ko'rgan.

en: The man before him, a burly rough, tried to close, and he stopped him with a blow in the face.
uz: Uning oldidagi odam, o'ta qattiq bo'lib, yopishga harakat qildi, lekin u uni yuziga urib to'xtatib qo'ydi.

en: Then, realising that he was deserted, he dodged round and made off down the lane after the chaise, with the sturdy man close behind him, and the fugitive, who had turned now, following remotely.
uz: Keyin u o'zidan voz kechganini anglab, o'zini o'ziga tashlab qo'ydi va o'rinbosari orqasidan ergashib, yo'ldan o'tdi, uning orqasidan kuchli kishi, endi o'zini o'zgartirgan qochqin esa uzoqdan kuzatib borardi.

en: Suddenly he stumbled and fell; his immediate pursuer went headlong, and he rose to his feet to ﬁnd himself with a couple of antagonists again.
uz: Toʻsatdan u qoqinib, yiqildi; uning yaqin quvchisi boshini ogʻirlab ketdi va yana bir necha dushman bilan boʻlish uchun oʻrnidan turdi.

en: He would have had little chance against them had not the slender lady very pluckily pulled up and returned to his help.
uz: Ularga qarshi kam imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, agar bu chiroyli ayol juda jasoratli bo'lib, unga yordam berishga qaytib kelmaganida edi.

en: It seems she had had a revolver all this time, but it had been under the seat when she and her companion were attacked.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u butun vaqt davomida qurol-yarog'i bilan birga bo'lgan, ammo u va uning hamkori hujumga uchrashganda, u o'rindiq ostida edi.

en: She ﬁred at six yards' distance, narrowly missing my brother.
uz: U olti metr masofadan o'q oldi va akamni kamdan-kam yo'qotdi.

en: The less courageous of the robbers made off, and his companion followed him, cursing his cowardice.
uz: O'g'rilar orasida eng jasoratli bo'lgan o'g'rilar qochib ketishdi va uning hamkori uning orqasidan ergashib, uning qo'rqoqligiga la'natib yurishdi.

en: They both stopped in sight down the lane, where the third man lay insensible.
uz: Ikkalasi ham ko'rinishda yo'lni to'xtatishdi, uchinchi odam esa o'z-o'zini his qilmayotgan edi.

en: Take this! said the slender lady, and she gave my brother her revolver.
uz: Buni oling! - deb aytdi kamolxo'r ayol va o'z revolverini akamga berdi.

en: Go back to the chaise, said my brother, wiping the blood from his split lip.
uz: O'tirishga qayting, - dedi akam, o'zining bo'linadigan og'izidan qon olib tashlab.

en: She turned without a word—they were both panting—and they went back to where the lady in white struggled to hold back the frightened pony.
uz: U so'zsiz o'girilib, ikkovi ham qo'rqqan ponini to'xtatish uchun oq kiyim kiygan xonim kurashgan joyga qaytib borishdi.

en: The robbers had evidently had enough of it.
uz: O'g'rilar shu bilan charchagan edi.

en: When my brother looked again they were retreating.
uz: Akam yana ko'z o'ngida bo'lganida, ular orqaga chiqdilar.

en: I'll sit here, said my brother, if I may; and he got upon the empty front seat.
uz: Men bu yerda o'tiraman, dedi akam, agar ruxsat bersa, - va u oldingi bo'sh o'rindiqga o'tirdi.

en: The lady looked over her shoulder.
uz: Ayol omonining orqasidan qarab qoldi.

en: Give me the reins, she said, and laid the whip along the pony's side.
uz: Menga boshliqlarni beringlar, - dedi u va ponyning yon tomonida qamchani qo'ydi.

en: In another moment a bend in the road hid the three men from my brother's eyes.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada yo'lning bir bo'yinida uchta odam akamning ko'zidan yashiringan.

en: So, quite unexpectedly, my brother found himself, panting, with a cut mouth, a bruised jaw, and bloodstained knuckles, driving along an unknown lane with these two women.
uz: Shunday qilib, ko'pincha akam o'zini ko'rmagan holda, o'z og'zidan kesilgan og'zini, bo'g'inini va qonli qo'l urgan qo'llari bilan, bu ikki ayol bilan noma'lum yo'l bo'ylab haydashda, nafas olib, o'zini topdi.

en: He learned they were the wife and the younger sister of a surgeon living at Stanmore, who had come in the small hours from a dangerous case at Pinner, and heard at some railway station on his way of the Martian ad- vance.
uz: U ular Stanmore shahrida yashovchi jarrohning xotini va singlisi ekanligini bilib oldi, u Pinner shahridagi xavfli ishdan bir necha soat o'tib kelib, yo'lda bo'lgan bir temir yo'l stantsiyasida marsiy advonsi haqida eshitdi.

en: He had hurried home, roused the women—their servant had left them two days before—packed some provisions, put his revolver under the seat—luckily for my brother—and told them to drive on to Edgware, with the idea of getting a train there.
uz: U darhol uyga qaytib keldi, ayollarni uyg'otdi, ularning xizmatkori ularni ikki kun oldin tashlab ketgan edi, ba'zi taomlarni to'pladi, o'z revolverini o'rinbosari ostiga qo'ydi va akam uchun omadli bo'lib, ularga Edgwarega borishni aytdi.

en: He stopped behind to tell the neighbours.
uz: U qo'shnilarga aytish uchun orqaga to'xtadi.

en: He would overtake them, he said, at about half past four in the morning, and now it was nearly nine and they had seen nothing of him.
uz: U ularni ertalab soat to'rt yarim atrofida kutib oladi va endi soat to'qqizga yaqin edi va ular uni hech narsa ko'rmagan edilar.

en: They could not stop in Edgware because of the growing trafﬁc through the place, and so they had come into this side lane.
uz: Ular Edgware-da to'xtab bo'lmadilar, chunki u yerdagi trafik ko'paygan edi, shuning uchun ular bu yon yo'nalishga kirishdi.

en: That was the story they told my brother in fragments when presently they stopped again, nearer to New Barnet.
uz: Oʻshanda ular birodarimga qisqacha aytib bergan hikoya edilar, ammo keyinchalik yana Nyu-Barnetga yaqinroq toʻxtab qolishdi.

en: He promised to stay with them, at least until they could determine what to do, or until the missing man ar- rived, and professed to be an expert shot with the revolver—a weapon strange to him—in order to give them conﬁdence.
uz: U ular bilan qolishga va'da berdi, hech bo'lmaganda ular nima qilish kerakligini aniqlaydigan bo'lmaguncha, yoki yo'qolgan odam ko'rib chiqilmaguncha, ular ishonch hosil qilishlari uchun unga noma'lum qurol bilan o'qishni bilgan mutaxassis bo'lganini aytdi.

en: They made a sort of encampment by the wayside, and the pony became happy in the hedge.
uz: Ular yo'l bo'yiga o'yin qurishdi va ponin o'z joyida baxtli bo'ldi.

en: He told them of his own escape out of London, and all that he knew of these Martians and their ways.
uz: U ularga Londondan qochib ketishining o'zi haqida va ushbu marsiyaliklar va ularning yo'l-yo'riqlari haqida bilgan barcha narsalarini aytib berdi.

en: The sun crept higher in the sky, and after a time their talk died out and gave place to an uneasy state of anticipation.
uz: Quyosh osmonda ko'proq ko'tarildi va vaqt o'tgach, ularning nutqlari so'nib, umidsizlik holatiga o'tdi.

en: Several wayfarers came along the lane, and of these my broth- er gathered such news as he could.
uz: Yo'l bo'ylab bir necha yo'lovchilar keldi va ulardan mening birodarim iloji boricha yangiliklarni to'pladi.

en: Every broken answer he had deepened his impression of the great disaster that had come on humanity, deepened his persuasion of the immediate necessity for prosecuting this ﬂight.
uz: Har bir buzilgan javob insoniyatga yuz bergan katta fojia haqidagi hissiyotini yanada chuqurlashtirdi, ushbu parvozni davom ettirishning darhol zarurligiga bo'lgan ishonchini yanada kuchaytirdi.

en: He urged the matter upon them.
uz: U bu masala yuzasidan ularga urg'u berdi.

en: We have money, said the slender woman, and hesitated.
uz: Bizda pul bor, - deb aytdi mayib ayol va shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: Her eyes met my brother's, and her hesitation ended.
uz: Uning ko'zlari akamning ko'zlarini uchratdi va uning ikkilanishi tugadi.

en: So have I, said my brother.
uz: Men ham shunday qildim, dedi akam.

en: She explained that they had as much as thirty pounds in gold, besides a ﬁve-pound note, and suggested that with that they might get upon a train at St.
uz: U o'ttiz funt oltin borligini, besh funtlik nota bilan birga o'ttiz funtlik oltin borligini tushuntirib, ular bilan St. Petersburgda poyezdda o'tishlarini taklif qildi.

en: Albans or New Barnet.
uz: Albans yoki New Barnet.

en: My brother thought that was hopeless, seeing the
uz: Birodarim bu umidsizlik deb o'ylagan, chunki u o'g'limni ko'rgan edi.

en: fury of the Londoners to crowd upon the trains, and broached his own idea of striking across Essex towards Harwich and thence escaping from the country altogether.
uz: Londondagilarning poezdlarga to'plangan g'azabini ko'tarib, Eseksni kesib o'tish va Harvichga borishni va o'sha yerdan butunlay qochib ketishni o'z g'oyasiga qo'shdi.

en: Elphinstone—that was the name of the woman in white—would lis- ten to no reasoning, and kept calling upon George; but her sister-in-law was astonishingly quiet and deliberate, and at last agreed to my brother's suggestion.
uz: Oq kiyimli ayolning ismi Elfinston bo'lgani uchun u hech qanday asoslanmay, Jorj deb murojaat qilardi, ammo uning qaynonasi hayratda qoldiradigan darajada xotirjam va mulohazakor bo'lib, oxir-oqibat akamning taklifini qabul qildi.

en: So, designing to cross the Great North Road, they went on to- wards Barnet, my brother leading the pony to save it as much as possible.
uz: Shunday qilib, Buyuk Shimoliy yo'lni kesib o'tishni rejalashtirganlarida, ular Barnetni to'g'riladilar, akam uni imkon qadar ko'proq qutqarish uchun ponini boshqaradi.

en: As the sun crept up the sky the day became excessively hot, and under foot a thick, whitish sand grew burning and blinding, so that they travelled only very slowly.
uz: Quyosh osmondan ko'tarilganida kun juda issiq bo'ldi va oyoq ostidagi qalin, oq qum yonib, ko'r bo'lib ketdi, shuning uchun ular juda sekin harakat qilishdi.

en: The hedges were grey with dust.
uz: Qo'rqinchlar chang bilan qora rangda edi.

en: And as they advanced to- wards Barnet a tumultuous murmuring grew stronger.
uz: Ular Barnetning tomonlariga yetib borayotganlarida, g'alati g'alati kuchayib borardi.

en: They began to meet more people.
uz: Ular ko'proq odamlar bilan uchrashishni boshlashdi.

en: For the most part these were staring before them, murmuring indistinct questions, jaded, haggard, unclean.
uz: Aksariyat hollarda bular o'zlariga qaraydigan, ko'rinmas savollar berayotgan, charchagan, charchagan, nopok savollar berayotgan edilar.

en: One man in evening dress passed them on foot, his eyes on the ground.
uz: Bir kishi kechki kiyimda, ko'zlari yerga tikilgan holda, ularni piyoda o'tib o'tdi.

en: They heard his voice, and, looking back at him, saw one hand clutched in his hair and the other beating invisible things.
uz: Ular uning ovozini eshitishdi va unga qarab, bir qo'lini sochlariga bog'lab, boshqasi ko'rinmas narsalarni urayotganini ko'rishdi.

en: His paroxysm of rage over, he went on his way without once looking back.
uz: G'azabning o'tishi o'tib, bir marta ham orqaga nazar solmay, yo'lidan ketdi.

en: As my brother's party went on towards the crossroads to the south of Bar- net they saw a woman approaching the road across some ﬁelds on their left, carrying a child and with two other children; and then passed a man in dirty black, with a thick stick in one hand and a small portmanteau in the other.
uz: Akamning partiyasi yo'l chekkasiga borayotganda, Bar-netning janubiy tomonida, ular bir ayolni ko'rishdi, u o'z chap tomonida bir nechta daladan o'tib yo'lga yaqinlashayotgan edi, bir bola va boshqa ikki bola bilan birga edi; keyin esa kirli qora kiyimda, bir qo'lida qalin tayoq va boshqa qo'lida kichik portmanteau bilan bir odamni o'tib o'tdi.

en: Then round the corner of the lane, from between the villas that guarded it at its conﬂuence with the high road, came a little cart drawn by a sweating black pony and driven by a sallow youth in a bowler hat, grey with dust.
uz: Keyin yo'lning burchagida, uni yo'l bilan uchib ketayotgan joyda himoya qiladigan uylar orasidan terib turgan qora ponining ko'tarib ketayotgan va tuproq bilan qora bo'lib qolgan bowler to'pka kiygan yosh yigit haydashgan kichkinagina arava keldi.

en: There were three girls, East End factory girls, and a couple of little children crowded in the cart.
uz: Arabada uchta qiz, East End fabrikasi qizlari va bir necha kichkina bola to'plangan edi.

en: This'll tike us rahnd Edgware? asked the driver, wild-eyed, white- faced; and when my brother told him it would if he turned to the left, he whipped up at once without the formality of thanks.
uz: Bu bizga tike rahnd Edgware? - deb so'radi haydovchi, yovvoyi ko'zlar, oq yuzli; akam unga chapga bursa bo'ladi deb aytganda, u darhol minnatdorchilik bildirmasdan o'zini qo'zg'atdi.

en: My brother noticed a pale grey smoke or haze rising among the houses in front of them, and veiling the white facade of a terrace beyond the road that appeared between the backs of the villas.
uz: Birodarim ularning oldidagi uylar orasida rang-barang oq tutun yoki bulut ko'tarilayotganini va villalarning orqa tomonlari o'rtasida paydo bo'lgan yo'ldan orqaga o'tgan terasaning oq fasadini qoplaganini payqadi.

en: Elphinstone suddenly cried out at a number of tongues of smoky red ﬂame leaping up above the houses in front of them against the hot, blue sky.
uz: Elfinston to'satdan issiq, ko'k osmonga qarata ko'z oldidagi uylarning ustiga ko'tarilgan tutli qizil olovning bir nechta tillariga baqirdi.

en: The tumultuous noise resolved itself now into the disorderly mingling of many voices, the gride of many
uz: Buzg'uncha shov-shuv endi ko'plab ovozlarning tartibsiz aralashuvida, ko'plab ovozlarning to'plamida o'z-o'zini yechirdi.

en: wheels, the creaking of waggons, and the staccato of hoofs.
uz: G'ildiraklar, vagonlarning qichqiriqlari va qo'ylarning staccato.

en: The lane came round sharply not ﬁfty yards from the crossroads.
uz: Yo'l chekkasi yo'l chekkasiga yetmish metr yo'l yo'l yo'q bo'lib o'tadi.

en: Good heavens! cried Mrs.
uz: Yomon osmonlar! deb baqirdi Xonim.

en: What is this you are driving us into? My brother stopped.
uz: Siz bizni nimaga haydab yuribsiz? - dedi akam.

en: For the main road was a boiling stream of people, a torrent of human be- ings rushing northward, one pressing on another.
uz: Chunki asosiy yo'l odamlarning qaynoq oqimi, odamlarning shov-shuvlari shimoliy tomonga shoshib, biri boshqaga bosim o'tkazadi.

en: A great bank of dust, white and luminous in the blaze of the sun, made everything within twenty feet of the ground grey and indistinct and was perpetually renewed by the hurrying feet of a dense crowd of horses and of men and women on foot, and by the wheels of vehicles of every description.
uz: Quyoshning olovida oq va yorug' bo'lgan katta tuproq to'plami yerdan yigirma futgacha bo'lgan hamma narsani griz va ko'rinmas qilib qo'ygan va otlar va erkaklar va ayollar piyoda bo'lgan zich to'plamning shoshilinch oyoqlari va har qanday tasvirlangan transport vositalarining velosipedlari tomonidan doimiy ravishda yangilanayotgan edi.

en: Way! my brother heard voices crying.
uz: Yaxshi! - deb yig'layotgan ovozlarni akam eshitdi.

en: Make way! It was like riding into the smoke of a ﬁre to approach the meeting point of the lane and road; the crowd roared like a ﬁre, and the dust was hot and pungent.
uz: Yo'l ochinglar! - deb, yo'l va yo'l uchrashadigan joyga yaqinlashishga o'xshaydigan o'tning tutunida o'tirib ketish edi; xaloyiq olov kabi qichqirib, chang issiq va o'tkir edi.

en: And, indeed, a little way up the road a villa was burning and send- ing rolling masses of black smoke across the road to add to the confusion.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, yo'ldan biroz uzoqroq bir villa yonayotgan edi va shubhani kuchaytirish uchun yo'l bo'ylab qora tutun to'plamlari yuborilgan edi.

en: Two men came past them.
uz: Ikki kishi ularning yonidan o'tib keldi.

en: Then a dirty woman, carrying a heavy bundle and weeping.
uz: So'ngra og'ir to'plamni ko'tarib yig'layotgan kirli ayol.

en: A lost retriever dog, with hanging tongue, circled dubiously round them, scared and wretched, and ﬂed at my brother's threat.
uz: O'g'limning tahdidiga ko'ra qo'rqqan va qashshoq bo'lib, o'z tilini asrab turgan yo'qolgan retriever itlari ularni shubhali ravishda aylanib o'tdilar.

en: So much as they could see of the road Londonward between the houses to the right was a tumultuous stream of dirty, hurrying people, pent in be- tween the villas on either side; the black heads, the crowded forms, grew into distinctness as they rushed towards the corner, hurried past, and merged their individuality again in a receding multitude that was swallowed up at last in a cloud of dust.
uz: O'ng tomondagi uylar o'rtasidagi London yo'lini ko'rish uchun, har ikki tomondagi uylar orasida to'p-to'p bo'lib turgan kirli, shoshilinch odamlar to'p-to'p bo'lib ketishgan edi; qora boshlar, to'p-to'p shakllar burchakga qarab shoshilganda, o'tib o'tish uchun shoshilganda va o'z individualliklarini yana bir marta to'sib borayotgan to'p-to'pga aylantirib, oxir-oqibat tuproq bulutida yutib ketgan.

en: Go on! cried the voices.
uz: O'shanda davom eting! - deb baqirdilar.

en: Way! One man's hands pressed on the back of another.
uz: Yo'q! - deb qo'llarini boshqa kishining orqasidan bosdi.

en: My brother stood at the pony's head.
uz: Oʻgʻlim ponining boshida turibdi.

en: Irresistibly attracted, he advanced slowly, pace by pace, down the lane.
uz: O'zini o'ziga jalb qilib, u sekin-sekin, tez-tez yo'lni bosib o'tdi.

en: Edgware had been a scene of confusion, Chalk Farm a riotous tumult, but this was a whole population in movement.
uz: Edgware chalk fermasi g'alati to'qnashuv, chalk fermasi g'alati to'qnashuv bo'lgan, ammo bu butun aholi harakatlanayotgan joy edi.

en: It is hard to imagine that host.
uz: O'sha uy egasini tasavvur qilish qiyin.

en: It had no character of its own.
uz: Uning o'ziga xos xususiyati yo'q edi.

en: The ﬁgures poured out past the corner, and re- ceded with their backs to the group in the lane.
uz: Raqamlar burchadan o'tib chiqib, yo'nalishdagi guruhga orqaga burildi.

en: Along the margin came those who were on foot threatened by the wheels, stumbling in the ditches, blundering into one another.
uz: Marjinada piyoda bo'lganlar to'g'irlar qo'rqinchli bo'lib, quduqlarda to'xtab, bir-birlariga to'xtab ketishdi.

en: The carts and carriages crowded close upon one another, making little way for those swifter and more impatient vehicles that darted forward every
uz: Arabonalar va vagonlar bir-biriga yaqinlashib, har safar oldinga shovqin qilgan tezroq va sabrsizlik bilan harakatlanayotgan transport vositalariga kam yo'l ochib berishdi.

en: now and then when an opportunity showed itself of doing so, sending the people scattering against the fences and gates of the villas.
uz: Endi va keyin imkoniyat paydo bo'lganida, odamlar villasning to'siqlari va darvozalariga tarqalib ketishdi.

en: Push on! was the cry.
uz: Qichqiriq: O'zingizni qo'zg'at! edi.

en: They are coming! In one cart stood a blind man in the uniform of the Salvation Army, ges- ticulating with his crooked ﬁngers and bawling, Eternity!
uz: Ular kelmoqdalar! - degan so'zlarni aytadi. - Bir aravachada Qutqaruv armiyasi uniformasiga kiygan ko'r kishi o'tirgan edi, u o'z bog'liq barmoqlari bilan gapirib, qichqirib: Abadiylik!

en: Eternity! His voice was hoarse and very loud so that my brother could hear him long after he was lost to sight in the dust.
uz: Abadiylik! Uning ovozi qichqiriq va juda baland edi, shuning uchun ukam uni ko'zdan ko'rinib qolgandan ko'p vaqt o'tgach ham eshitishi mumkin edi.

en: Some of the people who crowded in the carts whipped stupidly at their horses and quarrelled with other drivers; some sat motionless, staring at nothing with miserable eyes; some gnawed their hands with thirst, or lay prostrate in the bottoms of their conveyances.
uz: Qayiqlarda to'planganlarning ba'zilari o'z otlarini ahmoqona urib, boshqa haydovchilar bilan bahslashdilar; ba'zilari harakatsiz o'tirdilar, hech narsaga befarq ko'zlar bilan qaraydilar; ba'zilari chanqoqlik bilan qo'llarini teshdilar yoki transport vositalarining pastki qismida yiqildilar.

en: The horses' bits were covered with foam, their eyes bloodshot.
uz: Atlarning bo'g'imlari cho'g' bilan qoplangan, ko'zlari qon bilan to'lgan.

en: There were cabs, carriages, shop cars, waggons, beyond counting; a mail cart, a road-cleaner's cart marked Vestry of St.
uz: Taxiler, vagonlar, do'kon mashinalari, vagonlar ko'p bo'lgan; pochta aravachasi, yo'l tozalash aravachasi St.

en: Pancras, a huge timber waggon crowded with roughs.
uz: Pancras, deb aytadi, bu esa katta yog'och vagon bo'lib, u yerda taxtalar ko'payib boradi.

en: A brewer's dray rumbled by with its two near wheels splashed with fresh blood.
uz: Bir pivovarning qurg'oqchiligi uning ikkita yaqin to'g'irlari yangi qon bilan cho'kkan bo'lib o'tdi.

en: Clear the way! cried the voices.
uz: Yo'lni ochinglar! - deb baqirib yubordilar.

en: Clear the way! Eter-nity!
uz: Yo'lni ochinglar! - dedi. - Abadiylik!

en: Eter-nity! came echoing down the road.
uz: Abadiylik! - deb yo'l bo'ylab ovoz chiqardi.

en: There were sad, haggard women tramping by, well dressed, with children that cried and stumbled, their dainty clothes smothered in dust, their weary faces smeared with tears.
uz: O'sha joyda g'amgin, g'amgin, yaxshi kiyim kiygan, yig'lab-ichib qolib ketgan bolalar, toza cho'g'ga cho'kkan chiroyli kiyimlari, ko'z yoshlari bilan to'ldirilgan charchagan yuzlari bor edi.

en: With many of these came men, sometimes help- ful, sometimes lowering and savage.
uz: Ularning ko'pchiligi bilan erkaklar keldi, ba'zan yordamchi, ba'zan kamsitadigan va yovvoyi.

en: Fighting side by side with them pushed some weary street outcast in faded black rags, wide-eyed, loud- voiced, and foul-mouthed.
uz: Ular bilan yonma-yon jang qilish, charchagan qora kiyimda, keng ko'zli, baland ovozli va nopok og'izli, charchagan ko'chalaridagi bir nechta charchagan odamni qo'zg'atib yubordi.

en: There were sturdy workmen thrusting their way along, wretched, unkempt men, clothed like clerks or shopmen, struggling spasmodically; a wounded soldier my brother noticed, men dressed in the clothes of railway porters, one wretched creature in a nightshirt with a coat thrown over it.
uz: Bu yerda o'z yo'llarini ko'targan kuchli ishchilar bor edi, bechora, bezaksiz erkaklar, ishchilar yoki do'konchilar kabi kiyinib, spasmodik kurashishardi; bir jarohatlangan askar akamning ko'z o'ngida, temir yo'l tashuvchi kiyimida kiyinadigan erkaklar, bir bechora yaratilish bir kechki kiyimda, uning ustiga quti tashlangan.

en: But varied as its composition was, certain things all that host had in com- mon.
uz: Ammo uning tarkibi turlicha bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, uy egasining hamma narsalarida ba'zi bir narsa bor edi.

en: There were fear and pain on their faces, and fear behind them.
uz: Ularning yuzlarida qo'rquv va og'riq bor edi, ularning orqasida esa qo'rquv bor edi.

en: A tu- mult up the road, a quarrel for a place in a waggon, sent the whole host of them quickening their pace; even a man so scared and broken that his knees bent under him was galvanised for a moment into renewed activity.
uz: Yo'ldagi to'qnashuv, vagondagi o'rin uchun bahs, ularning butun qo'shinini tezroq harakat qilishga undadi; hatto shunchalik qo'rqqan va buzilgan kishi ham uning ostida tiz cho'kkan bo'lib, bir zumga qayta faollashtirildi.

en: The heat and dust had already been at work upon this multitude.
uz: Issiqlik va chang allaqachon bu xaloyiqqa ta'sir qilgan edi.

en: Their skins were dry, their lips black and cracked.
uz: Ularning terisi quruq, og'izlari qora va parchalangan edi.

en: They were all thirsty, weary, and footsore.
uz: Ularning barchasi chanqagan, charchagan va cho'zgan edi.

en: And amid the various cries one heard disputes, reproaches, groans of weariness and fatigue; the voices of most of them were hoarse and weak.
uz: Turli qichqiriqlar orasida bahs-munozaralar, haqoratlar, charchaganlik va charchaganlik g'azablari eshitildi; ularning aksariyatining ovozi qichqiriq va zaif edi.

en: Through it all ran a refrain:
uz: Bularning barchasi orqali bir qo'shiq o'tdi:

en: The Martians are coming! Few stopped and came aside from that ﬂood.
uz: Marsliklar kelayotgan! - deb so'zlarni aytdi.

en: The lane opened slantingly into the main road with a narrow opening, and had a delusive appearance of coming from the direction of London.
uz: Yo'nalish eng chekkasi bilan eng asosiy yo'lga yopilib, London yo'nalishidan kelib chiqqanini ko'rsatadi.

en: Yet a kind of eddy of people drove into its mouth; weaklings elbowed out of the stream, who for the most part rested but a moment before plunging into it again.
uz: Biroq, odamlarning bir toifalari uning og'ziga tushib kirdi; zaiflar daryodan qo'shilib chiqdilar, aksariyatlari esa bir daqiqa o'tirishdan oldin yana unga tushib ketishdi.

en: A little way down the lane, with two friends bending over him, lay a man with a bare leg, wrapped about with bloody rags.
uz: Yo'ldan biroz pastda, uning ustiga ikki do'st qolib, qonli to'qimalar bilan to'lib-toshgan, bechora oyoqli bir odam o'tirgan.

en: He was a lucky man to have friends.
uz: U do'stlarga ega bo'lgan omadli odam edi.

en: A little old man, with a grey military moustache and a ﬁlthy black frock coat, limped out and sat down beside the trap, removed his boot—his sock was blood-stained—shook out a pebble, and hobbled on again; and then a little girl of eight or nine, all alone, threw herself under the hedge close by my brother, weeping.
uz: Qizig'i o'g'ir kishi, o'g'ir harbiy mustasi va kirli qora kiyim kiyimli, tuzoqqa chiqib, tuzoqqa o'tirdi, poyabzallarini olib tashladi, qon bilan to'plangan so'kalarini olib chiqib, bir toshni qo'zg'atdi va yana qoqindi; so'ngra sakkiz yoki to'qqiz yoshli bir qiz o'zi yolg'iz o'zini akamning yonida bo'lgan to'siq ostida yig'lab tashladi.

en: I can't go on! My brother woke from his torpor of astonishment and lifted her up, speaking gently to her, and carried her to Miss Elphinstone.
uz: Men davom eta olmayman! - deb hayratda qolgan akam o'zini uyg'otdi va qizni ko'tarib, unga muloyimlik bilan gapirib, uni Xonim Elfinstonning oldiga olib keldi.

en: So soon as my brother touched her she became quite still, as if frightened.
uz: Birodarim unga qo'l tegizganida, u qo'rqqancha to'xtab qoldi.

en: Ellen! shrieked a woman in the crowd, with tears in her voice —Ellen! And the child suddenly darted away from my brother, crying Mother! They are coming, said a man on horseback, riding past along the lane.
uz: Ellen! - deb qichqirdi xaloyiq orasidagi bir ayol, ovozi ko'z yoshlari bilan Ellen! Bola esa to'satdan akamdan uzoqlashdi va Amma! deb baqirdi.

en: Out of the way, there! bawled a coachman, towering high; and my brother saw a closed carriage turning into the lane.
uz: Yo'ldan ketinglar, oltinglar! - deb hayqirdi yuqoriga ko'tarilgan vagonchi, ukam esa yopilgan vagonni yo'lga aylanib borayotganini ko'rdi.

en: The people crushed back on one another to avoid the horse.
uz: Odamlar otdan qochish uchun bir-birlarini ezib tashlashdi.

en: My brother pushed the pony and chaise back into the hedge, and the man drove by and stopped at the turn of the way.
uz: Birodarim ponini va o'rinni qo'lga qaytardi va u kishi o'tib o'tib, yo'l burishida to'xtadi.

en: It was a carriage, with a pole for a pair of horses, but only one was in the traces.
uz: Bu arava, bir juft ot uchun ustun bo'lgan, lekin faqat bitta ot izlarida edi.

en: My brother saw dimly through the dust that two men lifted out something on a white stretcher and put it gently on the grass beneath the privet hedge.
uz: Birodarim tozalikdan ko'rinishsiz ko'rib, ikki kishi oq ko'ylakdagi bir narsani ko'tarib, uni o't o'lchovning pastidagi o'tga muloyimlik bilan qo'yishdi.

en: One of the men came running to my brother.
uz: Bir kishi akamning oldiga yugurib keldi.

en: Where is there any water? he said.
uz: Qayerda suv bor? deb so'radi u.

en: He is dying fast, and very thirsty.
uz: U tez o'lib ketmoqda va juda chanqoq.

en: It is Lord Garrick. Lord Garrick! said my brother; the Chief Justice? The water? he said.
uz: Bu Lord Garrick. - dedi akam, - Lord Garrick, Chief sudya? - Suv? - dedi u.

en: There may be a tap, said my brother, in some of the houses.
uz: Akam shunday dedi: Ba'zi uylarda kran bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I dare not leave my people. The man pushed against the crowd towards the gate of the corner house.
uz: Men o'z xalqimni tashlashga jur'at etmayman. - deb aytdi u kishi.

en: Go on! said the people, thrusting at him.
uz: O'zingizni qo'lga olinglar! - deyishdi xalq unga shovqin bilan.

en: Go on! Then my brother's attention was distracted by a bearded, eagle- faced man lugging a small handbag, which split even as my brother's eyes rested on it and disgorged a mass of sovereigns that seemed to break up into sepa- rate coins as it struck the ground.
uz: Keyin akamning e'tiborini burchakli, qush yuzli bir kishi kichkina sumkani olib yurganida chalg'itdi, bu sumka akamning ko'zlari ushlab turgan paytda parchalandi va ko'pgina soveranlar yerga urilganida, ular yetti baravarlik tangalarga bo'lindi.

en: They rolled hither and thither among the struggling feet of men and horses.
uz: Ular odamlarning va otlarning kurashayotgan oyoqlari orasida bir-biriga aylanib borishdi.

en: The man stopped and looked stupidly at the heap, and the shaft of a cab struck his shoulder and sent him reeling.
uz: O'sha kishi to'xtadi va ahmoqona ko'rinishga qaradi va taksi shafti uning yelkasiga tushib, uni to'sib yuboradi.

en: He gave a shriek and dodged back, and a cartwheel shaved him narrowly.
uz: U qichqirdi va orqaga qaytdi, mashinasi u bilan chiroyli shavq qildi.

en: Way! cried the men all about him.
uz: Havay! - deb hayqirdi uning atrofidagi odamlar.

en: Make way! So soon as the cab had passed, he ﬂung himself, with both hands open, upon the heap of coins, and began thrusting handfuls in his pocket.
uz: Yo'l ochinglar! - deb, taksi o'tib ketgandan so'ng, u o'zini ikki qo'li ochiq tanga to'pasiga tashlab, o'z pochkasida qo'lcho'plarni to'play boshladi.

en: A horse rose close upon him, and in another moment, half rising, he had been borne down under the horse's hoofs.
uz: At unga yaqinlashdi va yana bir daqiqada, yarim ko'tarilganda, uni otning cho'g'iga tushirishdi.

en: Stop! screamed my brother, and pushing a woman out of his way, tried to clutch the bit of the horse.
uz: To'xtating! - deb qichqirdi akam, bir ayolni uning yo'lidan quvdi va otning bo'g'ini ushlab turishga harakat qildi.

en: Before he could get to it, he heard a scream under the wheels, and saw through the dust the rim passing over the poor wretch's back.
uz: U unga yetib kelishidan oldin, u velosipedlar ostida qichqirishni eshitdi va tuproqdan ko'rgach, kambag'alning orqasidan o'tayotgan bo'lakni ko'rdi.

en: The driver of the cart slashed his whip at my brother, who ran round behind the cart.
uz: Arka mashinasining haydovchisi birodarimga qamchiladi va u arka mashinasining orqasidan yugurdi.

en: The multitudinous shouting confused his ears.
uz: Ko'pchilik qichqiriqlari uning quloqlarini chalg'itdi.

en: The man was writhing in the dust among his scattered money, unable to rise, for the wheel had broken his back, and his lower limbs lay limp and dead.
uz: Bu kishi o'z pullari orasida tuproq ichida o'tirib, o'tirolmadi, chunki u o'z orqasini sindirib qo'ydi va uning pastki a'zolari o'lib-o'lib ketgan edi.

en: My brother stood up and yelled at the next driver, and a man on a black horse came to his assistance.
uz: Akam turib, keyingi haydovchiga qichqirdi va qora ot ustida yurgan kishi unga yordamga keldi.

en: Get him out of the road, said he; and, clutching the man's collar with his free hand, my brother lugged him sideways.
uz: U: Uni yo'ldan olib ketinglar, - dedi va akam uning bo'sh qo'li bilan bo'ynini ushlab, uni yon tomonga ko'tardi.

en: But he still clutched after his money, and regarded my brother ﬁercely, hammering at his arm with a handful of gold.
uz: Ammo u hali ham pulini qo'lga olgan va akamga qattiq qaragan, qo'liga bir qoshiq oltin bilan urgan.

en: Go on! shouted angry voices behind.
uz: O'shanda davom eting! - deb qichqirdi orqadan g'azablangan ovozlar.

en: Way! There was a smash as the pole of a carriage crashed into the cart that the man on horseback stopped.
uz: Yo'q! - deb hayron bo'ldi, arava ustunlari aravaga tushib, otliq kishi to'xtadi.

en: My brother looked up, and the man with the gold twisted his head round and bit the wrist that held his collar.
uz: Akam ko'z ko'tarib ko'rdi va oltinli kishi boshini burib, bo'yniga qo'yilgan qo'lni urdi.

en: There was a concussion, and the black horse came staggering sideways, and the carthorse pushed beside it.
uz: Oʻsha payt miya titrashuvi boʻldi va qora ot yon tomonga boʻlib keldi va kartoshka ot uning yonida shovqin qildi.

en: A hoof missed my brother's foot by a hair's breadth.
uz: Bir qovog'im ukamning oyoqidan soch kengligi bilan o'tdi.

en: He released his grip on the fallen man and jumped back.
uz: U tushib qolgan kishini qo'lga olib, orqaga sakrashdi.

en: He saw anger change to terror on the face of the poor wretch on the ground, and in a moment he was hidden and my brother was borne backward and carried past the entrance of the lane, and had to ﬁght hard in the torrent to recover it.
uz: U yer yuzidagi kambag'al odamning yuzida g'azabning dahshatga aylanishini ko'rdi va bir daqiqada u yashirinib qoldi va akam orqaga ko'tarilib, yo'lning eshikidan o'tib ketadi va uni olish uchun daryoda qattiq kurashishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: He saw Miss Elphinstone covering her eyes, and a little child, with all a child's want of sympathetic imagination, staring with dilated eyes at a dusty something that lay black and still, ground and crushed under the rolling wheels.
uz: U Elfinston xonimning ko'zlarini qoplaganini va bir bola ko'rganini ko'rdi, u bolalik tasavvurga muhtoj bo'lib, qora va to'xtab turgan, to'lqinli bir narsaga ko'z tikib, g'ildiraklar ostida cho'kgan va cho'kgan.

en: Let us go back! he shouted, and began turning the pony round.
uz: Biz qaytib boraylik! - deb baqirdi u va ponini aylantirishni boshladi.

en: We cannot cross this—hell, he said and they went back a hundred yards the way they had come, until the ﬁghting crowd was hidden.
uz: U: Biz bu jahannamni kesib o'tolmaymiz, - dedi va ular kelgan yo'ldan yuz metr orqaga qaytib ketishdi, hatto jang qilayotgan xaloyiq yashirinib qoldi.

en: As they passed the bend in the lane my brother saw the face of the dying man in the ditch under the privet, deadly white and drawn, and shining with perspiration.
uz: Ular yo'l bo'yiga o'tib ketayotganlarida, akam o'lib ketayotgan odamning yuzini ko'rdi, uning yuzi o'limdan ko'z yumgan edi, u o'limdan ko'z yumgan, oq va chiroyli edi.

en: The two women sat silent, crouching in their seat and shivering.
uz: Ikkala ayol o'z o'rinlarida o'tirib, titralib, sukut saqlashdi.

en: Then beyond the bend my brother stopped again.
uz: So'ngra burchakdan o'tgach, akam yana to'xtadi.

en: Miss Elphinstone was white and pale, and her sister-in-law sat weeping, too wretched even to call upon George. My brother was horriﬁed and perplexed.
uz: Miss Elphinstone oq va soya edi, qaynonasi esa yig'lab o'tirgan edi, hatto Jorj deb ham chaqirishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada qashshoq edi.

en: So soon as they had retreated he realised how urgent and unavoidable it was to attempt this crossing.
uz: Ular orqaga chiqib ketishganidan so'ng, u bu kesib o'tishga urinish qanchalik zarur va qo'rqinchli ekanini angladi.

en: He turned to Miss Elphinstone, suddenly resolute.
uz: U Miss Elphinstonega murojaat qilib, toʻsatdan qatʼiy qaror qildi.

en: We must go that way, he said, and led the pony round again.
uz: Biz shu yo'ldan borishimiz kerak, - dedi u va ponini yana bir bor olib bordi.

en: For the second time that day this girl proved her quality.
uz: O'sha kuni bu qiz o'z sifatini ikkinchi marta isbotladi.

en: To force their way into the torrent of people, my brother plunged into the trafﬁc and held back a cab horse, while she drove the pony across its head.
uz: Odamlar daryosida o'z yo'llarini zorlab o'tish uchun akam trafikga tushib, taksi otini ushlab qo'ydi, u esa ponini boshidan o'tkazdi.

en: A waggon locked wheels for a moment and ripped a long splinter from the chaise.
uz: Vaqtincha u mashinalarning g'ildiraklarini qulflab qo'ydi va o'rindiqdan uzoq bo'lakni yirtib yubordi.

en: In another moment they were caught and swept forward by the stream.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada ular tutildi va daryo tomonidan olib ketildi.

en: My brother, with the cabman's whip marks red across his face and hands, scrambled into the chaise and took the reins from her.
uz: Mening ukamning yuzida va qo'llarida cho'g'ir cho'g'ri belgisi bo'lgan cho'ntagim o'tirgan joyga kirib, u ayoldan boshpanalarni olib ketdi.

en: Point the revolver at the man behind, he said, giving it to her, if he presses us too hard.
uz: U ayolga qo'yib dedi: Agar u bizga juda qattiq bosim o'tkazsa, pulimizni orqadagi odamga qarat.

en: No!—point it at his horse. Then he began to look out for a chance of edging to the right across the road.
uz: Yo'q!o'zining otini ko'rsating. Keyin u yo'lning o'ng tomoniga o'tish imkoniyatini izlay boshladi.

en: But once in the stream he seemed to lose volition, to become a part of that dusty rout.
uz: Ammo oqimga kirganida, u o'z xohishini yo'qotib, o'sha tuproqli yo'lning bir qismi bo'lishga intildi.

en: They swept through Chipping Barnet with the torrent; they were nearly a mile beyond the centre of the town before they had fought across to the opposite side of the way.
uz: Ular Chipping Barnetni torrent bilan kesib o'tdilar; ular yo'lning qarshisidagi yo'lga qarshi jang qilishdan oldin shahar markazidan deyarli bir mil narida edilar.

en: It was din and confusion indescrib- able; but in and beyond the town the road forks repeatedly, and this to some extent relieved the stress.
uz: Bu tovush va g'alayonni tasvirlab bo'lmaydi; lekin shahar ichida va undan tashqarida yo'l ko'p marotaba bo'linadi va bu qaysidir darajada stressni yengillashtiradi.

en: They struck eastward through Hadley, and there on either side of the road, and at another place farther on they came upon a great multitude of people drinking at the stream, some ﬁghting to come at the water.
uz: Ular Sharq tomonga Hadli orqali o'tib, yo'lning har ikki tomoniga, undan uzoqroq bo'lgan joyda, ko'pchilikni suvdan ichib, ba'zilari suvga kelish uchun kurashayotgan kishilarga duch kelishdi.

en: And far- ther on, from a lull near East Barnet, they saw two trains running slowly one after the other without signal or order— trains swarming with people, with men even among the coals behind the engines—going northward along
uz: U yerdan uzoqroq, Sharqiy Barnet yaqinidagi to'xtashdan, ular ikki poezdni ko'rishdi, ular signalsiz yoki buyurtmasiz bir-birining orqasidan sekin-sakin harakatlanayotganini ko'rishdi.

en: the Great Northern Railway.
uz: Buyuk Shimoliy temir yo'l.

en: My brother supposes they must have ﬁlled out- side London, for at that time the furious terror of the people had rendered the central termini impossible.
uz: Oʻgʻlim ularning Londondagi hududni toʻldirib qoʻyganini taxmin qildi, chunki oʻsha paytda xalqning gʻazabli dahshatlari oʻrta termini imkonsiz qildi.

en: Near this place they halted for the rest of the afternoon, for the violence of the day had already utterly exhausted all three of them.
uz: Bu joy yaqinida ular kechqurun qolgan vaqtlarini to'xtatishdi, chunki kunning zo'ravonligi ularni uchini ham butunlay to'xtatgan edi.

en: They began to suffer the beginnings of hunger; the night was cold, and none of them dared to sleep.
uz: Ular ochlik boshlanishiga duch kelishdi; kechasi sovuq edi va hech kim uxlashga jur'at qilmadi.

en: And in the evening many people came hurrying along the road nearby their stopping place, ﬂeeing from unknown dangers before them, and going in the direction from which my brother had come.
uz: Kechqurun ko'plab odamlar to'xtash joylari yaqinidagi yo'l bo'ylab tezlik bilan kelishdi, ular oldidagi noma'lum xavf-xatarlardan qochib, akam kelgan yo'lga borishdi.

en: CHAPTER 17 THE THUNDER CHILD Had the Martians aimed only at destruction, they might on Monday have annihilated the entire population of London, as it spread itself slowly through the home counties.
uz: 17 - bob TUNDER CHILD Agar Marsliklar faqat halokatga qaratilgan bo'lganida, ular dushanba kuni butun London aholisini yo'q qilib yuborishlari mumkin edi, chunki u asta-sekin o'z mamlakatlari bo'ylab tarqalgan edi.

en: Not only along the road through Barnet, but also through Edgware and Waltham Abbey, and along the roads eastward to Southend and Shoeburyness, and south of the Thames to Deal and Broad- stairs, poured the same frantic rout.
uz: Faqatgina Barnet orqali o'tadigan yo'l bo'ylab emas, balki Edgware va Waltham abbeylari orqali, Sharq tomon Southend va Shoeburyness yo'llari bo'ylab va Temisdan janubiy tarafga Deal va Broad-poygachalar bo'ylab ham xuddi shunday dahshatli yo'l ko'rsatildi.

en: If one could have hung that June morn- ing in a balloon in the blazing blue above London every northward and eastward road running out of the tangled maze of streets would have seemed stippled black with the streaming fugitives, each dot a human agony of terror and physical distress.
uz: Agar o'sha iyun kuni ertalab Londondagi har bir shimoliy va sharqiy yo'lning o'tkir ko'chalar labirentidan chiqib ketayotganini o'tkir ko'kga o'rnatish mumkin bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, unda har bir nuqta insonning dahshatli azob-uqubatlari va jismoniy qayg'u-alamlari bilan qora bo'lib ko'rinardi.

en: I have set forth at length in the last chapter my brother's account of the road through Chipping Barnet, in order that my readers may realise how that swarming of black dots appeared to one of those concerned.
uz: O'quvchilarim qora nuqtalar to'plamini qanday qilib bir kishiga ko'rsatganini tushunishlari uchun, men o'g'limning Chipping Barnet yo'li haqidagi hikoyasini oxirgi bobda batafsil bayon qildim.

en: Never before in the history of the world had such a mass of human beings moved and suffered together.
uz: Dunyo tarixida hech qachon bunday ko'p insonlar birgalikda harakatlanib, azob chekmagan edi.

en: The legendary hosts of Goths and Huns, the hugest armies Asia has ever seen, would have been but a drop in that current.
uz: Goʻtlar va hunlarning afsonaviy qoʻshini, Osiyoda hech qachon koʻrgan eng ulkan armiyalar, bu oqimning bir tomiri boʻlgan boʻlishi mumkin edi.

en: And this was no disciplined march; it was a stampede —a stampede gigantic and terrible—without order and without a goal, six million people unarmed and unprovisioned, driving headlong.
