uz: Bu tartibsiz va maqsadsiz, olti million odam qurolsiz va jihozlanmagan, bosh ko'tarmay haydashga olib borgan dahshatli va dahshatli marsh edi.

en: It was the be- ginning of the rout of civilisation, of the massacre of mankind.
uz: Bu sivilizatsiyalarning vayron bo'lishi, insoniyatning qirg'inlanishi boshlanishi edi.

en: Directly below him the balloonist would have seen the network of streets far and wide, houses, churches, squares, crescents, gardens— already derelict—spread out like a huge map, and in the southward BLOTTED.
uz: Undan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pastda, ballonchi uzoq va keng ko'chalar tarmog'ini, uylar, cherkovlar, maydonlar, yarim oylar, bog'larni ko'rgan bo'ladi.

en: Over Ealing, Richmond, Wimbledon, it would have seemed as if some monstrous pen had ﬂung ink upon the chart.
uz: Over Ealing, Richmond, Wimbledon, bu qandaydir dahshatli qalamni grafikga momaqaldir deb ko'rinardi.

en: Steadily, incessantly, each black splash grew and spread, shooting out ramiﬁcations this way and that, now banking itself against rising ground, now pouring swiftly over a crest
uz: Turmush o'rtog'i o'sib borgan va tarqalgan har bir qora teshik o'sib borardi, bu yo'ldan va o'sha yo'ldan o'sib chiqardi, endi o'zini baland yerga qarshi qo'yib, endi yuqoriga tezlik bilan to'kib o'tadi

en: into a new-found valley, exactly as a gout of ink would spread itself upon blotting paper.
uz: Yangi topilgan vodiyga o'tish, xuddi qog'ozni o'chirib tashlaganda mat matning go'zi o'zini tarqatishi mumkin bo'lganidek.

en: And beyond, over the blue hills that rise southward of the river, the glit- tering Martians went to and fro, calmly and methodically spreading their poison cloud over this patch of country and then over that, laying it again with their steam jets when it had served its purpose, and taking possession of the conquered country.
uz: Va undan tashqari, daryoning janubiy tomonida ko'tariladigan ko'k tog'lar ustida, shinam Marsliklar bu yerga-bu yerga borib, o'zlarining zaharli bulutlarini tinchlik va usullar bilan bu yerning o'zi ustida, keyin esa o'sha yer ustida tarqatib, o'z maqsadiga xizmat qilganida, uni o'z bug' samolyotlari bilan qo'yib, bosib olingan mamlakatga egalik qilishdi.

en: They do not seem to have aimed at extermination so much as at complete demoralisation and the destruction of any opposi- tion.
uz: Ularning maqsadi o'lim emas, balki mutlaqo axloqsizlik va qarshiliklarning yo'q qilinishi edi.

en: They exploded any stores of powder they came upon, cut every tele- graph, and wrecked the railways here and there.
uz: Ular to'qnashgan har qanday tozalik do'konlarini portlatib, har bir telegrafni kesib tashladilar va bu va bu yerdagi temir yo'llarni vayron qildilar.

en: They were hamstringing mankind.
uz: Ular insoniyatni qiynayotgan edi.

en: They seemed in no hurry to extend the ﬁeld of their operations, and did not come beyond the central part of London all that day.
uz: Ular o'z faoliyatini kengaytirishda hech qanday shoshilinchlik ko'rinmagan va butun kun davomida Londondagi markazdan tashqariga chiqmagan.

en: It is possi- ble that a very considerable number of people in London stuck to their houses through Monday morning.
uz: Ehtimol, Londonda juda ko'p odamlar dushanba kuni ertalabgacha uylarida qolishgan.

en: Certain it is that many died at home suf- focated by the Black Smoke.
uz: Shubhasizki, ko'p odamlar qora tutun tufayli uylarida o'lishgan.

en: Until about midday the Pool of London was an astonishing scene.
uz: London hovuzida soat yarimgacha ajoyib ko'rinish bo'lgan.

en: Steam- boats and shipping of all sorts lay there, tempted by the enormous sums of money offered by fugitives, and it is said that many who swam out to these vessels were thrust off with boathooks and drowned.
uz: Buvli kemalar va har qanday kemalar bu yerda joylashgan edi, ular qochoqlar tomonidan taqdim etiladigan ulkan miqdordagi pulga moyil edilar va bu kemalarga suzilganlarning ko'pchiligi kemalar bilan quvib ketib, cho'kib ketgan deb aytiladi.

en: About one o'clock in the afternoon the thinning remnant of a cloud of the black vapour appeared between the arches of Blackfriars Bridge.
uz: Tush soat bir atrofida Blackfriars ko'prikining archalari orasidagi qora bug' bulutining kam bo'lgan qoldiqlari paydo bo'ldi.

en: At that the Poopy became a scene of mad confusion, ﬁghting, and collision, and for some time a multitude of boats and barges jammed in the northern arch of the Tower Bridge, and the sailors and lightermen had to ﬁght savagely against the people who swarmed upon them from the riverfront.
uz: Shu payt Poopy g'alati chalkashlik, jang va to'qnashuvlar ko'rinishiga aylandi va bir muncha vaqt davomida Tower Bridgening shimoliy arqasida ko'plab qayiq va barglar to'xtab qoldi va kemachilar va yomg'ir quyishchilar daryo bo'yida ularga qarshi to'planayotgan odamlarga qarshi vahshiy jangga borishdi.

en: People were actually clambering down the piers of the bridge from above.
uz: Aslida, odamlar ko'prikning ustunlariga yuqoridan chiqayotgan edilar.

en: When, an hour later, a Martian appeared beyond the Clock Tower and waded down the river, nothing but wreckage ﬂoated above Limehouse.
uz: Bir soat o'tgach, soat minorasining tashqarisida marsiyalik paydo bo'lib, daryo bo'ylab yurganida, Limehouse ustida faqatgina xaroba suzilgan edi.

en: Of the falling of the ﬁfth cylinder I have presently to tell.
uz: Beshinchi silindrning qulashi haqida hozirda aytib berishim kerak.

en: The sixth star fell at Wimbledon.
uz: Oltinchi yulduz Wimbledonda qulab tushdi.

en: My brother, keeping watch beside the women in the chaise in a meadow, saw the green ﬂash of it far beyond the hills.
uz: Birodarim cho'lda o'tirgan ayollarning yonida o'rindiqni saqlab, tog'larning orqasida yashil rangni ko'rdi.

en: On Tues- day the little party, still set upon getting across the sea, made its way through the swarming country towards Colchester.
uz: Talaba kuni kichik partiya dengizni kesib o'tishga tayyor bo'lib, ko'pchilik ko'pchilikni to'plab mamlakatlar orqali Kolchesterga yo'l oldi.

en: The news that the Mar- tians were now in possession of the whole of London was conﬁrmed.
uz: Martianlar endi butun Londonni egallab olganligi haqidagi xabar tasdiqlandi.

en: They had been seen at Highgate, and even, it was said, at Neasden.
uz: Ular Hay-Gate va hatto Neasdenda ko'rishgan.

en: But they did not come into my brother's view until the morrow.
uz: Ammo ular ertagacha akamning ko'zlariga tushmadi.

en: That day the scattered multitudes began to realise the urgent need of pro- visions.
uz: O'sha kuni tarqalib ketgan xaloyiq vahiylarning shoshilinch zarurligini anglay boshladi.

en: As they grew hungry the rights of property ceased to be regarded.
uz: Ular och bo'lganida, mulk huquqlariga e'tibor berilmay qo'ydi.

en: Farmers were out to defend their cattle-sheds, granaries, and ripening root crops with arms in their hands.
uz: Dehqonlar qo'llarida qurol bilan o'z chorvaxonalari, g'allaxonalari va o'simliklarini himoya qilishga harakat qilishgan.

en: A number of people now, like my brother, had their faces eastward, and there were some desperate souls even going back towards London to get food.
uz: Endi bir qator odamlar, akam kabi, yuzlarini sharqqa qarab ko'rishgan edi va hatto ba'zi umidsiz ruhlar ovqat olish uchun Londonga qaytib borishgan.

en: These were chieﬂy people from the northern suburbs, whose knowledge of the Black Smoke came by hearsay.
uz: Bular asosan shimoliy shahar chekkasi aholisi edi, ularning qora tutun haqidagi bilimlari eshitilgan gaplardan kelib chiqqan edi.

en: He heard that about half the members of the government had gathered at Birmingham, and that enormous quantities of high explosives were being prepared to be used in automatic mines across the Midland counties.
uz: U hukumat a'zolarining yarmiga yaqin Birminghamda yig'ilganini va Midland viloyatlarida avtomatik maydonlarda ishlatilishi uchun ulkan miqdorda kuchli portlovchi moddalar tayyorlanayotganini eshitdi.

en: He was also told that the Midland Railway Company had replaced the desertions of the ﬁrst day's panic, had resumed trafﬁc, and was running northward trains from St.
uz: Shuningdek, unga Midland temir yo'l kompaniyasi birinchi kundagi qo'rqinchli voqealarning o'rniga qochib ketgani, trafikni tiklaganligi va St. Petersburgdan shimoliy yo'nalishdagi poyezdlarni boshqarayotganligi aytildi.

en: Albans to relieve the congestion of the home counties.
uz: Albaniyaliklar o'z mamlakatlarining to'qnashuvini yengillashtirish uchun.

en: There was also a placard in Chipping Ongar announcing that large stores of ﬂour were available in the northern towns and that within twenty- four hours bread would be distributed among the starving people in the neighbourhood.
uz: Chipping Ongar shahrida ham unning katta do'konlari shimoliy shaharlarda mavjudligi va yigirma to'rt soat ichida och qolgan odamlar orasida non tarqatilishi haqida xabar beruvchi plakat bor edi.

en: But this intelligence did not deter him from the plan of es- cape he had formed, and the three pressed eastward all day, and heard no more of the bread distribution than this promise.
uz: Ammo bu aql-idrok uni o'zi tuzgan qochish rejasiga qarshi turishga to'sqinlik qilmadi va uchta kishi kun bo'yi sharqqa borishdi va non tarqatishdan boshqa hech narsa eshitmadilar.

en: Nor, as a matter of fact, did anyone else hear more of it.
uz: Aslida, bu haqda boshqa hech kim eshitmagan.

en: That night fell the seventh star, falling upon Primrose Hill.
uz: O'sha kecha Primrose tog'i ustiga tushib, yettinchi yulduz tushib qoldi.

en: It fell while Miss Elphinstone was watching, for she took that duty alternately with my brother.
uz: U Elfinston xonim kuzatib turgan paytda tushdi, chunki u akam bilan navbatma-navbat vazifani bajargan.

en: On Wednesday the three fugitives—they had passed the night in a ﬁeld of unripe wheat—reached Chelmsford, and there a body of the inhabitants, calling itself the Committee of Public Supply, seized the pony as provisions, and would give nothing in exchange for it but the promise of a share in it the next day.
uz: Chorshanba kuni uchta qochoq Chelmsfordga yetib kelgan o'tda o'tirgan bug'doy dalalarida o'tirgan edilar va u yerda o'zini Jamoat ta'minoti qo'mitasi deb atab yurgan aholi o'zlariga qo'shilgan qo'shin ponini ta'minot sifatida oldi va uning o'rniga ertaga unga ulush berish va'dasidan boshqa hech narsa bermadilar.

en: Here there were rumours of Martians at Epping, and news of the destruction of Waltham Abbey Powder Mills in a vain attempt to blow up one of the invaders.
uz: Bu yerda Eppingdagi Marsliklar haqida mish-mishlar bor edi va Waltham Abbey Powder Millsni vayron qilish uchun boshlovchilardan birini portlatishga urinish uchun yo'q qilinganligi haqida xabarlar bor edi.

en: People were watching for Martians here from the church towers.
uz: Bu yerda odamlar cherkov minoralaridan marsiyaliklarni kuzatib turishgan.

en: My brother, very luckily for him as it chanced, preferred to push on at once to the coast rather than wait for food, although all three of them were very hungry.
uz: Oʻgʻlim, u uchun juda baxtli boʻlgani uchun, ovqatni kutishdan koʻra, darhol qirgʻoqqa borishni afzal koʻrdi, garchi ularning uchasi ham juda och boʻlishgan boʻlsa-da.

en: By midday they passed through Tillingham, which, strangely enough, seemed to be quite silent and deserted, save for a few furtive plun- derers hunting for food.
uz: Tush paytida ular Tillinghamdan o'tib ketishdi, u, g'alati qilib aytganda, o'ta xotirjam va tashqarida bo'lib ko'rinardi, faqat ovqat izlab yurgan bir necha o'g'rilik bilan o'tib ketishdi.

en: Near Tillingham they suddenly came in sight of the sea, and the most amazing crowd of shipping of all sorts that it is possible to imagine.
uz: Totilingham yaqinida ular birdan dengiz va tasavvur qilish mumkin bo'lgan har qanday kema tashishining eng ajoyib to'plamini ko'rishdi.

en: For after the sailors could no longer come up the Thames, they came on to the Essex coast, to Harwich and Walton and Clacton, and afterwards to Foulness and Shoebury, to bring off the people.
uz: Chunki kemachilar endi Temis daryosidan chiqib ketolmagandan so'ng, Essex qirg'og'iga, Harvich, Valton va Klaktonga, keyin esa Foulness va Shoeburyga kelib, odamlarni olib ketishdi.

en: They lay in a huge sickle- shaped curve that vanished into mist at last towards the Naze.
uz: Ular ulkan sikka shaklidagi egrilikda o'tirgan edilar, u oxir-oqibat nayza bo'lib, natsistlarga qarab yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: Close inshore was a multitude of ﬁshing smacks— English, Scotch, French, Dutch, and Swedish; steam launches from the Thames, yachts, electric boats; and be- yond were ships of large burden, a multitude of ﬁlthy colliers, trim mer- chantmen, cattle ships, passenger boats, petroleum tanks, ocean tramps, an old white transport even, neat white and grey liners from Southampton and Hamburg; and along the blue coast across the Blackwater my brother could make out dimly a dense swarm of boats chaffering with the people on the beach, a swarm which also extended up the Blackwater almost to Maldon.
uz: Qo'shni qirg'oqda ko'pgina baliq ovlari bor edi Ingliz, skot, frantsuz, gollandiya va isveç; Temza, yachtlar, elektr qayiqlaridan bug' havo qo'zg'otishlari; shuningdek, katta yukli kemalar, ko'pgina nopok ko'mirlar, o'lchovchilar, chorvalik kemalari, yo'lovchilar kemalari, neft tanglari, okean tramplari, eski oq transport, hatto Southampton va Hamburgdan kelgan beparvo oq va griz linerlar; va qora suv bo'ylab ko'k qirg'oqning ko'k qirg'oqlarini qarama-qirg'oq ko'rinishida akam qirg'oqdagi odamlar bilan qirg'oqchilik qiladigan qirg'oqlarning zich ko'rinishini ko'ra ko'ra oladi.

en: About a couple of miles out lay an ironclad, very low in the water, al- most, to my brother's perception, like a water-logged ship.
uz: Bir necha kilometr uzoqlikda temir bilan qoplangan, suvda juda past, akamning ko'zlashicha, suv bilan to'lgan kema kabi bir kemani ko'rdim.

en: This was the ram THUNDER CHILD.
uz: Bu qo'zi TUNDER CHILD edi.

en: It was the only warship in sight, but far away to the right over the smooth surface of the sea—for that day there was a dead calm —lay a serpent of black smoke to mark the next ironclads of the Channel Fleet, which hovered in an extended line, steam up and ready for action, across the Thames estuary during the course of the Martian conquest, vigi- lant and yet powerless to prevent it.
uz: Bu ko'rinadigan yagona jang kemasi edi, ammo o'ng tomonda dengizning lazzatli yuzasida uzoqdan o'ng tomonda edi, chunki o'sha kuni o'lim xotirjamligi bo'lgan edi, Channel flotining keyingi temir qo'riqchilarini belgilash uchun qora tutunli ilon o'rnatilgan edi, bu dengizdan o'tib ketayotgan va harakatga tayyor bo'lgan, Tems daryosidan o'tib o'tgan Marsiy qo'lga olish jarayonida, uni oldini olish uchun tezda harakatlanayotgan va ammo hech qanday kuchsiz bo'lgan.

en: At the sight of the sea, Mrs.
uz: Dengiz ko'rinishida, xonim

en: Elphinstone, in spite of the assurances of her sister-in-law, gave way to panic.
uz: Elfinston, qaynonasi ta'kidlashiga qaramay, qo'rquvga berilib ketdi.

en: She had never been out of England before, she would rather die than trust herself friendless in a foreign country, and so forth.
uz: U ilgari hech qachon Angliyadan tashqarida bo'lmagan va o'lib ketishni afzal ko'rgan bo'lsa, chet elda do'stsiz o'zini ishonishdan ko'ra, o'lib ketishni afzal ko'rgan.

en: She seemed, poor woman, to imagine that the French and the Mar- tians might prove very similar.
uz: U, kambag'al ayol, fransuzlar va martianlar juda o'xshash bo'lishi mumkinligini tasavvur qilgan edi.

en: She had been growing increasingly hysteri- cal, fearful, and depressed during the two days' journeyings.
uz: Ikki kunlik sayohat davomida u haddan tashqari histerik, qo'rquv va tushkunlikka tushib qolgan edi.

en: Her great idea was to return to Stanmore.
uz: Uning ajoyib g'oyasi Stanmorega qaytish edi.

en: Things had been always well and safe at Stan- more.
uz: Stan-da hamma narsa doimo yaxshi va xavfsiz edi.

en: They would ﬁnd George at Stanmore.
uz: Ular Jorjni Stanmorda topishadi.

en: It was with the greatest difﬁculty they could get her down to the beach, where presently my brother succeeded in attracting the attention of some men on a paddle steamer from the Thames.
uz: Ular uni qirg'oqqa tushirish uchun eng qiyin bo'lgan joy edi, u yerda birodarim tez orada Temis daryosi bo'ylab uchib kelayotgan bir nechta odamning e'tiborini jalb qildi.

en: They sent a boat and drove a bargain for thirty-six pounds for the three.
uz: Ular qayiq yuborib, uch kishi uchun o'ttiz olti funtlik savdosiga borishdi.

en: The steamer was going, these men said, to Ostend.
uz: Bu kishilar buzg'unchi kema Ostendga ketayotganini aytishdi.

en: It was about two o'clock when my brother, having paid their fares at the gangway, found himself safely aboard the steamboat with his charges.
uz: Soat ikki atrofida akam yo'lovchilar uchun yo'lovlarni to'laganidan so'ng, o'zini o'z ayblovlari bilan bug'li kemada xavfsiz holda topdi.

en: There was food aboard, albeit at exorbitant prices, and the three of them contrived to eat a meal on one of the seats forward.
uz: Borda oziq-ovqat bor edi, garchi narxlari yuqori bo'lsa-da, va ularning uchasi oldingi o'rindiqlardan birida ovqatlanish uchun o'zlarini yaratdilar.

en: There were already a couple of score of passengers aboard, some of whom had expended their last money in securing a passage, but the captain lay off the Blackwater until ﬁve in the afternoon, picking up passengers un- til the seated decks were even dangerously crowded.
uz: U yerda allaqachon bir necha o'nlab yo'lovchilar bor edi, ulardan ba'zilari o'zlarining oxirgi pullarini yo'lni ta'minlashga sarflashgan edilar, lekin kapitan Blackwaterni kechki payt besh gacha qoldirdi va o'tirgan qovushlar xavfli darajada to'plangan bo'lmaguncha yo'lovchilarni olib bordi.

en: He would probably have remained longer had it not been for the sound of guns that began about that hour in the south.
uz: Ehtimol, janubiyda o'sha soat atrofida boshlangan qurollarning ovozi bo'lmaganida, u ko'proq vaqt qolishi mumkin edi.

en: As if in answer, the ironclad seaward ﬁred a small gun and hoisted a string of ﬂags.
uz: Demak javob sifatida, temir qorong'i dengizchi kichik quroldan otdi va bir qator bayroqlarni ko'tardi.

en: A jet of smoke sprang out of her funnels.
uz: Uning choriqlaridan tutun uchib chiqdi.

en: Some of the passengers were of opinion that this ﬁring came from Shoe- buryness, until it was noticed that it was growing louder.
uz: Yo'lovchilarning ba'zilari bu o'qlash Shoe-burynessdan kelib chiqqan deb o'ylashgan edi, ammo u yanada balandlashib borayotganini payqadilar.

en: At the same time, far away in the southeast the masts and upperworks of three ironclads rose one after the other out of the sea, beneath clouds of black smoke.
uz: Shu bilan bir vaqtda, uzoq janubi-sharqda uchta temir qo'riqchining ustlari va ustlari qora tutun bulutlari ostida dengizdan bir-biridan keyin ko'tarilib chiqdi.

en: But my brother's attention speedily reverted to the distant ﬁring in the south.
uz: Ammo akamning e'tiborini tezda janubiy qismdagi uzoq o'qlarga qaratdi.

en: He fancied he saw a column of smoke rising out of the distant grey haze.
uz: U uzoq bo'lakdan tutun ustunini ko'rganini tasavvur qildi.

en: The little steamer was already ﬂapping her way eastward of the big cres- cent of shipping, and the low Essex coast was growing blue and hazy, when a Martian appeared, small and faint in the remote distance, advancing along the muddy coast from the direction of Foulness.
uz: Kichik buyrug' kemasi allaqachon kemalarning katta markazidan sharqqa qarab harakatlanayotgan edi, Essexning past sohili esa ko'k va ko'k bo'lib borar edi, u erda uzoq masofalarda kichik va zaif bo'lgan martian paydo bo'lib, Foulness yo'nalishidan bo'lakli sohil bo'ylab harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: At that the captain on the bridge swore at the top of his voice with fear and anger at his own delay, and the paddles seemed infected with his terror.
uz: Shu payt ko'prikdagi kapitan o'zining kechikishidan qo'rqib va g'azablanib, o'z ovozini baland ovoz bilan qasam ichdi va pillalar uning qo'rquvi bilan infektsiyalashgan ko'rinardi.

en: Every soul aboard stood at the bulwarks or on the seats of the steamer and stared at that distant shape, higher than the trees or church towers inland, and advancing with a leisure- ly parody of a human stride.
uz: Sayohatdagi har bir jon buyrak kemasining qo'rqinchlariga yoki o'rindiqlariga qarab, o'sha uzoq shaklga qaradi, u yerdagi daraxtlar yoki cherkovlarning balandligidan yuqori va inson qadamlarining dam olish parodiyasi bilan o'tmoqda.

en: It was the ﬁrst Martian my brother had seen, and he stood, more amazed than terriﬁed, watching this Titan advancing deliberately towards the ship- ping, wading farther and farther into the water as the coast fell away.
uz: Bu akam ko'rgan birinchi marsiyalik edi va u qo'rqmasdan ko'proq hayron bo'lib, ushbu Titanni kemaga qasddan kirib borayotganini ko'rib turibdi.

en: Then, far away beyond the Crouch, came another, striding over some stunted trees, and then yet another, still farther off, wading deeply through a shiny mudﬂat that seemed to hang halfway up between sea and sky.
uz: Keyin, Crouchdan uzoqroq, yana bir kishi keldi, u ba'zi o'simliklar ustida qadam qo'ydi, keyin yana bir kishi, yanada uzoqroq, dengiz va osmon o'rtasida yarim yo'lda oshib qolgan ko'rinadigan yorqin maydon bo'ylab chuqur yurdi.

en: They were all stalking seaward, as if to intercept the escape of the multitudinous vessels that were crowded between Foulness and the Naze.
uz: Ularning barchasi dengiz bo'ylab kuzatib borar edilar, xuddi Foulness va Nazis o'rtasida to'plangan ko'pgina kemalarning qochishini to'xtatmoqchi bo'lganlardek.

en: In spite of the throbbing exertions of the engines of the little paddle-boat, and the pouring foam that her wheels ﬂung behind her, she receded with terrifying slowness from this ominous advance.
uz: Kichik padel qayiqining dvigatellari o'z kuchini puchga chiqarganidan va uning velosipedlari orqaga tashlagan cho'g'li cho'g'niga qaramay, u bu dahshatli avjordan qo'rqinchli sekinlik bilan orqaga qaytdi.

en: Glancing northwestward, my brother saw the large crescent of shipping already writhing with the approaching terror; one ship passing behind an- other, another coming round from broadside to end on, steamships whistling and giving off volumes of steam, sails being let out, launches rushing hither
uz: Shimoliy-g'arbiy tomonga qarab, akam kemaning katta yarim oyini ko'rdi, u allaqachon yaqinlashib kelayotgan dahshat bilan burib ketayotgan edi; bir kema bir-biri orqasidan o'tmoqda, boshqa kemani keng tomondan to'sib bormoqda, bug' kemasi pishirib, buyum hajmini chiqarmoqda, yelkalar chiqarib yuborilmoqda, uchish kemalari shu yoqqa shoshilmoqda

en: He was so fascinated by this and by the creeping danger away to the left that he had no eyes for anything seaward.
uz: U bu va o'ng tomonga ketayotgan xavf-xatardan shunchalik hayratda ediki, dengizdagi biron bir narsaga ko'zi yetmagan edi.

en: And then a swift move- ment of the steamboat (she had suddenly come round to avoid being run down) ﬂung him headlong from the seat upon which he was standing.
uz: Keyin kema tez harakatlanib, uni boshini ko'tarib, o'tirgan o'rindiqidan tashlab yubordi.

en: There was a shouting all about him, a trampling of feet, and a cheer that seemed to be answered faintly.
uz: Uning atrofida qichqiriq, oyoq bosish va shovqinlar paydo bo'ldi, ammo javob kamroq bo'lgan.

en: The steamboat lurched and rolled him over upon his hands.
uz: Usti kemasi tushib, uni qo'llari bilan o'girib yubordi.

en: He sprang to his feet and saw to starboard, and not a hundred yards from their heeling, pitching boat, a vast iron bulk like the blade of a plough tear- ing through the water, tossing it on either side in huge waves of foam that leaped towards the steamer, ﬂinging her paddles helplessly in the air, and then sucking her deck down almost to the waterline.
uz: U oyoqlariga tushib, o'ng tomonga qarab ko'rdi va ularning bo'g'inidan yuz metr uzoqlikda bo'lmagan qayiqni ko'tardi, u katta temir to'plamini suvdan o'tkazdi, uni har ikki tomondan katta chang to'lqinlari bilan suzib, bug'lik kemasiga qarab o'tadi, o'z pillalarini yordamsiz havoga tashlaydi va so'ngra deqni deyarli suv chizig'igacha sug'uradi.

en: A douche of spray blinded my brother for a moment.
uz: Birozga spray ducha akamni ko'r qilib qo'ydi.

en: When his eyes were clear again he saw the monster had passed and was rushing landward.
uz: Ko'zlari yana ochiq bo'lganida, u haykal o'tib ketayotganini va quruqlikka shoshayotganini ko'rdi.

en: Big iron upperworks rose out of this headlong structure, and from that twin fun- nels projected and spat a smoking blast shot with ﬁre.
uz: Ushbu to'qnashuvchan tuzilishdan katta temir uskunalar ko'tarildi va o'sha ikki quvonchli joylardan o't bilan tuxumli portlovchi shotslar ko'rindi.

en: It was the torpedo ram, THUNDER CHILD, steaming headlong, coming to the rescue of the threatened shipping.
uz: Bu torpedo qo'zi, Thunder Child bo'lib, xavf ostida bo'lgan kemalarni qutqarishga kelgan.

en: Keeping his footing on the heaving deck by clutching the bulwarks, my brother looked past this charging leviathan at the Martians again, and he saw the three of them now close together, and standing so far out to sea that their tripod supports were almost entirely submerged.
uz: Oʻgʻlim qoʻriqchilarni qoʻllab, balandlikdagi qadoqqa qadam qoʻyib, marsiyaliklarga yana bir bor qaraganida, u uchta kishini bir-biriga yaqinlashib, dengizga shunchalik uzoq turganini koʻrdiki, ularning tripod qoʻllari deyarli toʻliq suv ostida edi.

en: Thus sunken, and seen in remote perspective, they appeared far less formidable than the huge iron bulk in whose wake the steamer was pitching so helplessly.
uz: Shunday qilib, qulab ketishgan va uzoqdan ko'rinishda ko'rishganda, ular buzg'unchi shunchalik yordamsiz bo'lgan ulkan temir to'plamidan ancha kamroq qo'rqinchli ko'rinardi.

en: It would seem they were regarding this new antagonist with astonishment.
uz: Ko'rinishicha, ular bu yangi dushmanga hayronlik bilan qaraydigan edilar.

en: To their intelligence, it may be, the giant was even such another as themselves.
uz: Ehtimol, ularning aql-idroklariga ko'ra, ulkan odam o'zlari kabi boshqa bo'lgan.

en: The THUNDER CHILD ﬁred no gun, but simply drove full speed towards them.
uz: TUNDER CHILD esa hech qanday qurol o'chirmagan, balki ularga to'liq tezlikda harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: It was probably her not ﬁring that enabled her to get so near the enemy as she did.
uz: Ehtimol, uning o'qlamasligi unga dushmanga shuncha yaqin bo'lishga imkon bergan.

en: They did not know what to make of her.
uz: Ular u bilan nima qilishlarini bilmas edilar.

en: One shell, and they would have sent her to the bottom forthwith with the Heat-Ray.
uz: Bir shell, va ular uni tezda issiqlik-ray bilan quyiga yuboradi edi.

en: She was steaming at such a pace that in a minute she seemed halfway be- tween the steamboat and the Martians—a diminishing black bulk against the receding horizontal expanse of the Essex coast.
uz: U shunchalik tez harakatlanayotgan ediki, bir daqiqada u Eseks sohilidagi ortib ketayotgan gorizontal maydonga qaraganda, bug' kemasi va marsiyaliklar orasidagi o'rta yo'lni ko'rsatgan bo'lardi.

en: Suddenly the foremost Martian lowered his tube and discharged a canis- ter of the black gas at the ironclad.
uz: Toʻsatdan, eng yaxshi marsiyalik oʻz qutilarini pastga tushirdi va qora gazning bir qismini temirga tashladi.

en: It hit her larboard side and glanced off in an inky jet that rolled away to seaward, an unfolding torrent of Black Smoke, from which the ironclad drove clear.
uz: U uning bo'yiga tushib, dengiz tomoniga o'tib ketayotgan qora jetda ko'z ochdi, bu esa qora tutunning o'sib borayotgan daryosidir.

en: To the watchers from the
uz: ning kuzatuvchilari uchun

en: steamer, low in the water and with the sun in their eyes, it seemed as though she were already among the Martians.
uz: Buvli, suvda past va ko'zlarida quyosh bo'lgani uchun u allaqachon marsiyaliklar orasida bo'lganiga o'xshardi.

en: They saw the gaunt ﬁgures separating and rising out of the water as they retreated shoreward, and one of them raised the camera-like generator of the Heat-Ray.
uz: Ular qirg'oqqa qarab orqaga chiqib ketayotganda, o'zlaridan ajralib turadigan va suvdan chiqib ketayotgan bo'g'imlarni ko'rishdi va ulardan biri Heat-Rayning kameraga o'xshash generatorini ko'tardi.

en: He held it pointing obliquely downward, and a bank of steam sprang from the water at its touch.
uz: U uni yon tomonga ko'tarib turardi va u suvga tegganida uymizning bir to'plami suvdan chiqdi.

en: It must have driven through the iron of the ship's side like a white-hot iron rod through paper.
uz: U kemaning temir tomonidan qog'oz orqali oq issiq temir tayoq kabi o'tib ketgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: A ﬂicker of ﬂame went up through the rising steam, and then the Martian reeled and staggered.
uz: O'sib borayotgan bug'dan olovning bir chaqmoqligi oshib bordi va keyin marsiyalik o'z-o'zidan burib ketdi.

en: In another moment he was cut down, and a great body of water and steam shot high in the air.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada u o'ldirildi va katta bir suv va bug' havoga o'tadi.

en: The guns of the THUNDER CHILD sounded through the reek, going off one after the other, and one shot splashed the water high close by the steamer, ricocheted towards the other ﬂying ships to the north, and smashed a smack to matchwood.
uz: TUNDER CHILDning quroli o'qidan so'ng, bir-biridan so'ng o'tadi va bitta o'q suvni bug'lik kemasi yonida yuqoriga cho'kib, shimolga o'tgan boshqa uchib o'tgan kemalarga qarata o'tadi va o'tga yog'ochni cho'kib yubordi.

en: But no one heeded that very much.
uz: Ammo hech kim bunga jiddiy e'tibor bermadi.

en: At the sight of the Martian's collapse the captain on the bridge yelled inarticulately, and all the crowding passen- gers on the steamer's stern shouted together.
uz: Mars kemasining tushib ketishini ko'rib, ko'prikdagi kapitan so'zsiz qichqirdi va buzg'unchi kemaning qutidagi barcha to'plamli o'tkazuvchilar birgalikda qichqirdilar.

en: And then they yelled again.
uz: Keyin ular yana qichqirishdi.

en: For, surging out beyond the white tumult, drove something long and black, the ﬂames streaming from its middle parts, its ventilators and funnels spout- ing ﬁre.
uz: Chunki, oq nuqsondan tashqariga chiqib, uzoq va qora bir narsani haydashdi, olov uning o'rta qismlaridan oqib o'tdi, uning ventilatorlari va kanallari olovni chiqarib yubordi.

en: She was alive still; the steering gear, it seems, was intact and her engines working.
uz: U hali ham tirik edi; direksiyon, ko'rinib turibdiki, to'liq edi va uning dvigatellari ishlamoqda edi.

en: She headed straight for a second Martian, and was within a hun- dred yards of him when the Heat-Ray came to bear.
uz: U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ikkinchi marsiyalik kishiga yo'l oldi va issiqlik nurlari paydo bo'lganida undan bir metr narida edi.

en: Then with a violent thud, a blinding ﬂash, her decks, her funnels, leaped upward.
uz: So'ngra kuchli shovqin bilan, ko'z ochib yuboradigan chaqmoq bilan, uning decklari, choriqlari yuqoriga o'tardi.

en: The Martian staggered with the violence of her explosion, and in another moment the ﬂaming wreckage, still driving forward with the impetus of its pace, had struck him and crumpled him up like a thing of cardboard.
uz: Marsiyalik o'zining portlashi zo'ravonligi bilan hayron qoldi va yana bir daqiqada o'z ritmining shov-shuvida davom etayotgan olovli cho'g'lar uni urib, karton usti kabi bo'g'ib yubordi.

en: My brother shouted involuntarily.
uz: Oʻgʻlim oʻz ixtiyori bilan qichqirdi.

en: A boiling tumult of steam hid everything again.
uz: Buvning qaynayotgan to'qnashishi hamma narsani yana yashirdi.

en: Two!, yelled the captain.
uz: Kapten: Ikkala!, - deb baqirdi.

en: Everyone was shouting.
uz: Hamma qichqirib yurardi.

en: The whole steamer from end to end rang with frantic cheering that was taken up ﬁrst by one and then by all in the crowd- ing multitude of ships and boats that was driving out to sea.
uz: Butun bug'doy kemasi oxir-oqibatdan dengizga ketayotgan kemalar va qayiqlarning to'p-to'p to'plangan ko'pligida birinchi bo'lib bir kishi, so'ngra hammasi tomonidan qo'lga kiritilgan g'ayratli quvonch bilan ovoz chiqardi.

en: The steam hung upon the water for many minutes, hiding the third Mart- ian and the coast altogether.
uz: Buv ko'p daqiqalar davomida suv ustida bo'lib, uchinchi mart-yan va qirg'oqni butunlay yashirib qo'ydi.

en: And all this time the boat was paddling steadily out to sea and away from the ﬁght; and when at last the confusion cleared, the drifting bank of black vapour intervened, and nothing of the THUNDER CHILD could be made out, nor could the third Martian be seen.
uz: Bu vaqt davomida qayiq dengizda va jangdan uzoqlikda qat'iy qatnaydi va nihoyat chalkashlik o'chirib ketganda, qora bug'ning bo'g'ib ketayotgan banki aralashib ketdi va TUNDER CHILDning hech bir qismi aniqlanmadi, uchinchi martian ham ko'rinmadi.

en: ironclads to seaward were now quite close and standing in towards shore past the steamboat.
uz: Dengizdan dengizgacha bo'lgan temirlar endi juda yaqin edi va u kemadan o'tib qirg'oqqa qarab turardi.

en: The little vessel continued to beat its way seaward, and the ironclads re- ceded slowly towards the coast, which was hidden still by a marbled bank of vapour, part steam, part black gas, eddying and combining in the strangest way.
uz: Kichik kema dengizga yo'l urishni davom ettirdi va temir kemalari kemadan-kam qirg'og'iga qaytdi, bu esa hali ham buyum, qismida bug', qismida qora gazdan iborat marmorli bank tomonidan yashirilgan edi.

en: The ﬂeet of refugees was scattering to the northeast; several smacks were sailing between the ironclads and the steamboat.
uz: Qochoqlar donanmasi shimoli-sharqqa tarqalib borar edi; bir necha marta temir kemalari va bug' kemasi o'rtasida yelka yurar edi.

en: After a time, and before they reached the sinking cloud bank, the warships turned north- ward, and then abruptly went about and passed into the thickening haze of evening southward.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach va qulab ketayotgan bulutlar qirg'og'iga yetib kelishdan oldin, jang kemalari shimoliy tomon burildilar, keyin to'satdan atrofga aylanib, kechqurun janubiy tomon bo'lgan to'sib borayotgan bulutga o'tishdi.

en: The coast grew faint, and at last indistinguishable amid the low banks of clouds that were gathering about the sinking sun.
uz: Qirg'oq sohili charchagan quyosh atrofida toʻplangan bulutlarning past boʻlaklari orasidan oʻrinsiz va oxir-oqibat farqlanmaydigan boʻldi.

en: Then suddenly out of the golden haze of the sunset came the vibration of guns, and a form of black shadows moving.
uz: Keyin birdan quyosh botishining oltin bulg'asidan qilichlarning titrashuvi va harakatlanayotgan qora soyalar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Everyone struggled to the rail of the steamer and peered into the blinding furnace of the west, but nothing was to be distinguished clearly.
uz: Har bir kishi bug'doy kemasining raliga yetib borishga harakat qilib, g'arbning ko'r bo'lgan cho'g'iga qarardi, ammo hech narsa aniq farqlanmadi.

en: A mass of smoke rose slanting and barred the face of the sun.
uz: Tushning bir to'plami yonib, quyoshning yuzini o'rab oldi.

en: The steamboat throbbed on its way through an inter- minable suspense.
uz: Sovuq kemasi o'z yo'lida o'zaro mayda bo'lgan suspenssiya orqali urildi.

en: The sun sank into grey clouds, the sky ﬂushed and darkened, the evening star trembled into sight.
uz: Quyosh bo'sh bulutlarga tushib, osmon qizil va qorong'i bo'ldi, kechki yulduz ko'rinishda titrab qoldi.

en: It was deep twilight when the captain cried out and pointed.
uz: Kapten qichqirib, ko'rsatkichni ko'rsatganida, tong oqib qolgan edi.

en: My brother strained his eyes.
uz: Oʻgʻlim koʻzlarini yorib qoʻydi.

en: Something rushed up into the sky out of the greyness—rushed slantingly upward and very swiftly into the lumi- nous clearness above the clouds in the western sky; something ﬂat and broad, and very large, that swept round in a vast curve, grew smaller, sank slowly, and vanished again into the grey mystery of the night.
uz: O'rta osmondagi bulutlar ustida ko'rinadigan yorug'lik nurida bir narsa osmonga yugurib, o'z-o'zidan yugurib bordi va g'arb osmonidagi bulutlar ustida juda tezda ko'tarildi; katta va keng bo'lgan bir narsa katta bo'lib, katta bo'lib, kichikroq bo'lib, sekin-sakin qulab, yana kechaning griz sirida yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: And as it ﬂew it rained down darkness upon the land.
uz: U chiqayotganda, yer yuziga zulmat yog'di.

en: PART 2 THE EARTH UNDER THE MARTIANS
uz: 2 - QISMIDA MARSYANLAR ostida yashaydigan yer

en: CHAPTER 1 UNDER FOOT In the ﬁrst book I have wandered so much from my own adventures to tell of the experiences of my brother that all through the last two chapters I and the curate have been lurking in the empty house at Halliford whither we ﬂed to escape the Black Smoke.
uz: Birinchi kitobda men o'z hayotimdan shunchalik ko'p o'tdimki, akamning tajribalarini aytib berdimki, oxirgi ikki bobda men va ruhoniy Halliforddagi bo'sh uyda yashiringanmiz.

en: There I will resume.
uz: O'sha yerda davom etaman.

en: We stopped there all Sun- day night and all the next day—the day of the panic—in a little island of daylight, cut off by the Black Smoke from the rest of the world.
uz: Biz butun quyosh-kun kechasi va ertasi kuni, kunning birida, qorong'i tutun tomonidan dunyodan kesilgan kun yorug'ligi kichik orolda to'xtadik.

en: We could do nothing but wait in aching inactivity during those two weary days.
uz: O'sha ikki kun davomida bezovta bo'lib, bezovta bo'lishdan boshqa iloji yo'q edi.

en: My mind was occupied by anxiety for my wife.
uz: Fikrim xotinim haqida tashvishlanib yurgan.

en: I ﬁgured her at Leather- head, terriﬁed, in danger, mourning me already as a dead man.
uz: Men uni ko'nglimda ko'rardim, qo'rqib, xavf ostida, o'lgan odam sifatida menga qayg'urgan edi.

en: I paced the rooms and cried aloud when I thought of how I was cut off from her, of all that might happen to her in my absence.
uz: Xonalar bo'ylab o'tib, men uydan qanday kesilganimni, men yo'qligida unga nima bo'lishi mumkinligini eslab, baland ovoz bilan yig'ladim.

en: My cousin I knew was brave enough for any emergency, but he was not the sort of man to realise danger quickly, to rise promptly.
uz: O'g'lim har qanday favqulodda vaziyatda jasoratli bo'lganini bilardim, lekin u xavf-xatarni tezda tushunadigan, tezda turadigan odam emas edi.

en: What was needed now was not bravery, but cir- cumspection.
uz: Hozirda jasorat emas, balki mehribonlik kerak edi.

en: My only consolation was to believe that the Martians were moving London-ward and away from her.
uz: Mening yagona tasalli men Marsliklar Londonga qarab va undan uzoqlashayotganini bilaman.

en: Such vague anxieties keep the mind sensitive and painful.
uz: Bunday noaniq tashvishlar ongni sezgir va og'riqli qiladi.

en: I grew very weary and irritable with the curate's perpetual ejaculations; I tired of the sight of his selﬁsh despair.
uz: Kuratning doimiy echimlanishiga ko'ra men juda charchadim va g'azablanardim; uning xudbin umidsizlik ko'rinishidan charchadim.

en: After some ineffectual remonstrance I kept away from him, staying in a room—evi- dently a children's schoolroom—containing globes, forms, and copybooks.
uz: Ba'zi samarasiz noroziliklardan so'ng men undan uzoqlashdim va o'zimni bolalar maktabidagi xonaga qo'ydim, unda gullar, shakllar va nusxalar bor edi.

en: When he followed me thither, I went to a box room at the top of the house and, in order to be alone with my aching miseries, locked myself in.
uz: U menga ergashib borganida, men uyning yuqori qismidagi qutixonaga bordim va o'zimni o'zimning azob-uqubatlarim bilan yolg'iz qoldirish uchun o'zimni o'zimga qulflab qo'ydim.

en: We were hopelessly hemmed in by the Black Smoke all that day and the morning of the next.
uz: Biz o'sha kun ham, ertasi ertalab ham qora tutunning qo'rqinchida bo'ldik.

en: There were signs of people in the next house on Sun- day evening—a face at a window and moving lights, and later the slamming of a door.
uz: Quyosh kunida kechqurun qo'shni uyda odamlar paydo bo'lganidan belgilar ko'rindi.Oynaga yuz o'girib, chiroqlar harakatlanayotgan edi, keyin esa eshiklar qamalgan edi.

en: But I do not know who these people were, nor what became of them.
uz: Lekin bu odamlar kim edi va ularga nima bo'lganini bilmayman.

en: We saw nothing of them next day.
uz: Keyingi kuni ularning hech birini ko'rmadik.

en: The Black Smoke drifted slowly
uz: Qora tamaki sekin-sekin harakatlandi

en: riverward all through Monday morning, creeping nearer and nearer to us, driving at last along the roadway outside the house that hid us.
uz: Dushanba kuni ertalabdan boshlab daryoga qarab, bizga yaqinlashib, nihoyat bizni yashirgan uyning tashqarisidagi yo'lni bosib o'tishdi.

en: A Martian came across the ﬁelds about midday, laying the stuff with a jet of superheated steam that hissed against the walls, smashed all the windows it touched, and scalded the curate's hand as he ﬂed out of the front room.
uz: Bir marsiyalik soat yarim atrofida dalalarga tushib keldi va o'z mahsulotlarini devorlarga silkitib, qo'ng'iroq qilgan har qanday derazalarni buzdi va o'sha xonadan qochib ketayotganda ruhoniyning qo'lini qizdirdi.

en: When at last we crept across the sodden rooms and looked out again, the country northward was as though a black snowstorm had passed over it.
uz: Nihoyat, o'sha qo'rqinchli xonadonga kirib, yana ko'z ochganimizda, shimolidagi qishloq xuddi qora qor bo'ronining o'tib ketgani kabi edi.

en: Looking towards the river, we were astonished to see an unaccountable red- ness mingling with the black of the scorched meadows.
uz: Daryoga qaraganimizda, o'simliklarning qoraligi bilan o'zaro aralashayotgan bepul qizillikni ko'rib hayron qoldik.

en: For a time we did not see how this change affected our position, save that we were relieved of our fear of the Black Smoke.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida bu o'zgarish bizning mavqeyimizga qanday ta'sir ko'rsatganini ko'rmadik, faqat qora tutundan qo'rqqanimizdan xalos bo'ldik.

en: But later I perceived that we were no longer hemmed in, that now we might get away.
uz: Ammo keyinchalik biz endi o'zimizni qamrab olmaganimizni va endi qochib ketishimiz mumkinligini angladim.

en: So soon as I realised that the way of escape was open, my dream of action returned.
uz: Qutish yo'li ochiq ekanini anglaganimdan so'ng, harakat haqidagi orzuim qaytdi.

en: But the curate was lethargic, unreasonable.
uz: Ammo murabbiy o'z-o'zidan charchagan, aqldan ozgan edi.

en: We are safe here, he repeated; safe here. I resolved to leave him—would that I had!
uz: Biz bu yerda xavfsizmiz, - deb takrorladi u, bu yerda xavfsizmiz. Men uni tashlashga qaror qildim!

en: Wiser now for the artillery- man's teaching, I sought out food and drink.
uz: Endi to'qnashuv uchun aqlliroq - inson ta'limi, men ovqat va ichimlik izladim.

en: I had found oil and rags for my burns, and I also took a hat and a ﬂannel shirt that I found in one of the bed- rooms.
uz: Yolg'izilishlarim uchun yog' va to'qimalar topdim, shuningdek, yotoqxonalardan birida topgan gapi va flanel kiyimini olib ketdim.

en: When it was clear to him that I meant to go alone—had reconciled myself to going alone—he suddenly roused himself to come.
uz: Men yolg'iz ketishim kerakligini unga aniq ko'rganimda, o'zimni yolg'iz ketishga rozi qilganimda, u o'zini to'satdan kelishga undadi.

en: And all being quiet throughout the afternoon, we started about ﬁve o'clock, as I should judge, along the blackened road to Sunbury.
uz: Kun bo'yi butunlay xotirjam bo'lib, biz soat beshlarda, men o'ylagandek, Sunburyga yo'llangan qora yo'l bo'ylab boshladik.

en: In Sunbury, and at intervals along the road, were dead bodies lying in contorted attitudes, horses as well as men, overturned carts and luggage, all covered thickly with black dust.
uz: Sunburida va yo'l bo'ylab vaqti-vaqti bilan o'liklar aylanib, atlar ham, erkaklar ham, aravalar ham, bagajlar ham burildi, barchasi qora chang bilan qoplangan.

en: That pall of cindery powder made me think of what I had read of the destruction of Pompeii.
uz: O'sha ko'p cho'g'li cho'g'lar menga Pompei vayron bo'lgani haqida o'qiganimni eslatdi.

en: We got to Hampton Court without misadventure, our minds full of strange and unfamiliar appear- ances, and at Hampton Court our eyes were relieved to ﬁnd a patch of green that had escaped the suffocating drift.
uz: Biz Hampton Courtga hech qanday baxtsiz hodisalarsiz keldik, ongimiz g'alati va noma'lum ko'rinishlarga to'lib-toshgan edi, Hampton Courtda esa ko'zlarimiz o'zimizni cho'ktirgan suvdan qutulgan yashil parcha topib, taskin topgan edi.

en: We went through Bushey Park, with its deer going to and fro under the chestnuts, and some men and women hurrying in the distance towards Hampton, and so we came to Twickenham.
uz: Biz Bushey Parkdan o'tdik, uning g'iybonlari kastanlar ostiga qarab yurardi, bir nechta erkak va ayol uzoqlikda Hampton tomon shoshilmoqda va biz Twickenhamga keldik.

en: These were the ﬁrst people we saw.
uz: Bular biz ko'rgan birinchi odamlar edi.

en: Away across the road the woods beyond Ham and Petersham were still aﬁre.
uz: Yo'lning boshqa tomonida Ham va Petersham ortidan o'rmonlar hali ham olovda edi.

en: Twickenham was uninjured by either Heat-Ray or Black Smoke, and there were more people about here, though none could give us news.
uz: Twickenham issiqlik-ray yoki qora tutun tomonidan jarohatlanmagan va bu yerda ko'proq odamlar bor edi, ammo hech kim bizga yangilik bera olmagan.

en: For the most part they were like ourselves, taking advantage of a lull to shift their quarters.
uz: Aksariyat hollarda ular biz kabi bo'lib, o'z joylarini o'zgartiradigan vaqtdan foydalangan.

en: I have an impression that many of the houses here were still
uz: Mening fikrimcha, bu yerdagi ko'plab uylar hali ham mavjud edi.

en: occupied by scared inhabitants, too frightened even for ﬂight.
uz: Qo'rqqan aholi tomonidan egallab olingan, hatto uchish uchun ham qo'rqqan.

en: Here too the evidence of a hasty rout was abundant along the road.
uz: Bu yerda ham yo'l bo'ylab shoshilinch mag'lubiyatga uchragan dalillar ko'p edi.

en: I remember most vividly three smashed bicycles in a heap, pounded into the road by the wheels of subsequent carts.
uz: Men uchta velosipedni to'plamda buzganini, keyinchalik aravalarning velosipedlari yo'lga urganini aniq eslayman.

en: We crossed Richmond Bridge about half past eight.
uz: Taxminan soat sakkiz yarimdan Richmond ko'prini kesib o'tdik.

en: We hurried across the exposed bridge, of course, but I noticed ﬂoat- ing down the stream a number of red masses, some many feet across.
uz: Biz, albatta, ko'prikni kesib o'tishga shoshildik, lekin oqim bo'ylab ko'p qizil to'plamlar, ba'zilari ko'p metr kesib o'tganini ko'rdim.

en: I did not know what these were— there was no time for scrutiny—and I put a more horrible interpretation on them than they deserved.
uz: Men bularning nima ekanligini bilmasdim, ularni tekshirish uchun vaqt yo'q edi va ularga ular munosib bo'lmaganidan ham dahshatliroq ta'limotni berdim.

en: Here again on the Surrey side were black dust that had once been smoke, and dead bodies—a heap near the approach to the station; but we had no glimpse of the Mar- tians until we were some way towards Barnes.
uz: Surrey tomonida yana bir bor tutun bo'lgan qora chang bor edi va stantsiyaga yaqinlashadigan joyda o'liklarning to'plami bor edi; ammo biz Barnesga yaqinlashmagunimizcha, martianlarni ko'rmagan edik.

en: We saw in the blackened distance a group of three people running down a side street towards the river, but otherwise it seemed deserted.
uz: Biz qoralashgan masofada uch kishidan iborat guruhni ko'rdik, ular bir yo'l bo'ylab daryoga qarab yugurib ketayotgan edilar, ammo boshqa tomondan u sahroga aylangan edi.

en: Up the hill Richmond town was burning briskly; outside the town of Richmond there was no trace of the Black Smoke.
uz: Richmondning tepalig'idagi shahar o'ta qizg'in yonayotgan edi; Richmond shahri tashqarisida qora tutunning izlari yo'q edi.

en: Then suddenly, as we approached Kew, came a number of people run- ning, and the upperworks of a Martian ﬁghting-machine loomed in sight over the housetops, not a hundred yards away from us.
uz: Keyin birdan Kewga yaqinlashayotganimizda, ko'plab odamlar yugurib kelishdi va bizdan yuz metr uzoqlikda bo'lmagan xonadonlar ustida Marslik jang mashinasining yuqori qismlari ko'rinardi.

en: We stood aghast at our danger, and had the Martian looked down we must immediately have perished.
uz: Biz o'z xavfliligimizni ko'rib hayron qoldik va agar marsiyalik pastga qarasa, biz darhol halok bo'lgan bo'lamiz.

en: We were so terriﬁed that we dared not go on, but turned aside and hid in a shed in a garden.
uz: Biz shunchalik qo'rqib ketdikki, davom etishga jur'at etmay, o'zimizdan yuz o'girib, bog'dagi cho'nqaga yashirinib qo'ydik.

en: There the curate crouched, weeping silently, and refusing to stir again.
uz: O'sha yerda ruhoniy yig'lab yig'lab, o'zini qo'zg'atishni rad etdi.

en: But my ﬁxed idea of reaching Leatherhead would not let me rest, and in the twilight I ventured out again.
uz: Ammo Leatherheadga yetib borishimning fikrim meni dam olishga undamagan va tongda men yana tashqariga chiqdim.

en: I went through a shrubbery, and along a passage beside a big house standing in its own grounds, and so emerged upon the road towards Kew.
uz: O'zimning o'z hududimda turgan katta uyning yonida o'tadigan o't o'simliklardan o'tdim va Kew yo'liga tushib qoldim.

en: The curate I left in the shed, but he came hur- rying after me.
uz: Men qo'yilgan ruhoniy xonada qoldi, lekin u menga shoshilinchlik bilan ergashdi.

en: That second start was the most foolhardy thing I ever did.
uz: O'sha ikkinchi boshlang'ich men qilgan eng ahmoqona ish edi.

en: For it was manifest the Martians were about us.
uz: Chunki Marsliklar atrofimizda ekanligi aniq edi.

en: No sooner had the curate overtaken me than we saw either the ﬁghting-machine we had seen before or another, far away across the meadows in the direction of Kew Lodge.
uz: Ruhoniy meni orqaga surib ketgandan so'ng, biz avval ko'rgan jang mashinasini yoki boshqa mashinani Kew Lodge yo'nalishida cho'llardan uzoqdan ko'rganimizda ko'rdik.

en: Four or ﬁve little black ﬁgures hurried before it across the green-grey of the ﬁeld, and in a moment it was evident this Martian pursued them.
uz: To'rt yoki besh ta kichik qora suratlar uning oldidan ko'tarib, maydondagi yashil-quruq rangni bosib o'tishdi va bir zumda bu Marslik ularning orqasidan ergashib ketayotganini ko'rishdi.

en: In three strides he was among them, and they ran radiating from his feet in all directions.
uz: U uch qadamda ularning o'rtasida edi va ular uning oyoqlaridan har tomonga oqib ketardi.

en: He used no Heat-Ray to destroy them, but picked them up one by one.
uz: U ularni yo'q qilish uchun issiqlik nuridan foydalanmadi, lekin ularni birma-bir ko'rib chiqdi.

en: Apparently he tossed them into the great metallic carrier which projected behind him, much as a workman's basket hangs over his shoulder.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u ularni katta metallik transportga tashladi va u orqasidan o'tadi, xuddi ishchi koshi uning yelkasiga oshib turgani kabi.

en: It was the ﬁrst time I realised that the Martians might have any other pur- pose than destruction with defeated humanity.
uz: Men birinchi marta Marsliklar g'alaba qozongan insoniyatni yo'q qilishdan boshqa maqsadga ega bo'lishlarini angladim.

en: We stood for a moment petri- ﬁed, then turned and ﬂed through a gate behind us into a walled garden, fell into, rather than found, a fortunate ditch, and lay there, scarce daring to whisper to each other until the stars were out.
uz: Biz bir muncha vaqt turdik, so'ngra o'zgarib, ortimizdagi darvoza orqali devorli bog'ga qochib ketdik, topilmasdan, omadli bo'g'iga tushib, o'sha yerda yotgan edik, yulduzlar chiqib ketguncha bir-birlariga shoshib gapirishga jur'at qilmaymiz.

en: I suppose it was nearly eleven o'clock before we gathered courage to start again, no longer venturing into the road, but sneaking along hedgerows and through plantations, and watching keenly through the darkness, he on the right and I on the left, for the Martians, who seemed to be all about us.
uz: Deyarli soat o'n bir bo'lganidan so'ng yana boshlash uchun jasorat topdik, yo'lga qadam qo'ymadik, lekin o'zimizni qo'lga olib, o'tlar va plantatsiyalar bo'ylab o'zimizni past olib, qorong'ilik orqali diqqat bilan kuzatdik, u o'ng tomonida, men esa chap tomonida, biz atrofimizda bo'lgan marsiyaliklar uchun.

en: In one place we blundered upon a scorched and blackened area, now cooling and ashen, and a number of scattered dead bodies of men, burned horribly about the heads and trunks but with their legs and boots mostly intact; and of dead horses, ﬁfty feet, perhaps, behind a line of four ripped guns and smashed gun carriages.
uz: Bir joyda biz yonib ketgan va qoralashgan hududni, hozirgi paytda sovuq va kul bo'lgan joyni va bir qator tarqalib ketgan erkaklar jasadlarini ko'rdik, ularning boshlari va tamg'alari dahshatli ravishda yondirilgan, ammo oyoqlari va poyabzallari asosan to'liq bo'lgan; va o'lik otlarning, ehtimol, ellik fut, to'rtta yirtilgan qurol va parchalangan qurol aravalaridan iborat qator orqasida.

en: Sheen, it seemed, had escaped destruction, but the place was silent and deserted.
uz: Sheen, ko'rinishicha, yo'q bo'lib ketishdan qochgan edi, ammo u yer beva va cho'loq edi.

en: Here we happened on no dead, though the night was too dark for us to see into the side roads of the place.
uz: Bu yerda hech kim o'lib ketmadi, lekin tun juda qorong'i bo'lib, bu yerning yon yo'llarini ko'rish uchun imkon bo'lmagan.

en: In Sheen my companion suddenly complained of faintness and thirst, and we decided to try one of the houses.
uz: Sheen shahrida hamkorim birdan o'zidan xavotirlanib, ichimlik va chanqoqlikdan xavotirlandi va biz uylardan birini sinab ko'rishga qaror qildik.

en: The ﬁrst house we entered, after a little difﬁculty with the window, was a small semi-detached villa, and I found nothing eatable left in the place but some mouldy cheese.
uz: Biz kirgan birinchi uy, darcha bilan ozgina qiyinchiliklardan so'ng, kichik bir yarim qo'shilgan villa edi va men u yerda o'zgaruvchan cheesedan boshqa hech narsa topmadim.

en: There was, however, water to drink; and I took a hatchet, which promised to be useful in our next house-breaking.
uz: Biroq ichimlik suvi bor edi va men o'zimga kassa oldim, bu esa keyingi uyni buzish paytida foydali bo'lishiga va'da berdi.

en: We then crossed to a place where the road turns towards Mortlake.
uz: So'ngra yo'l Mortlake tomon burilgan joyga o'tdik.

en: Here there stood a white house within a walled garden, and in the pantry of this domicile we found a store of food—two loaves of bread in a pan, an un- cooked steak, and the half of a ham.
uz: Bu yerda devorli bog' ichida oq uy turardi va bu uyning omborxonasida oziq-ovqat zaxirasini topdik - panada ikkita non, pishirilmagan biftek va yarim shunk.

en: I give this catalogue so precisely be- cause, as it happened, we were destined to subsist upon this store for the next fortnight.
uz: Men ushbu katalogni juda aniq beraman, chunki sodir bo'lganidek, biz keyingi ikki hafta davomida ushbu do'konda yashash uchun taqdirlangan edik.

en: Bottled beer stood under a shelf, and there were two bags of haricot beans and some limp lettuces.
uz: Shrift ostida shishalar bo'lgan piva bo'lib turardi va u yerda ikki to'p baliqlari va bir nechta salotlar bor edi.

en: This pantry opened into a kind of wash-up kitchen, and in this was ﬁrewood; there was also a cupboard, in which we found nearly a dozen of burgundy, tinned soups and salmon, and two tins of biscuits.
uz: Ushbu oshxona o'ziga xos oshxonaga aylandi va u yerda yog'och bor edi; shuningdek, bir do'zaga yaqin burgundi, konserva supasi va salmon va ikkita piskut qadoqlari topilgan ombor bor edi.

en: We sat in the adjacent kitchen in the dark—for we dared not strike a light —and ate bread and ham, and drank beer out of the same bottle.
uz: Biz qo'shni oshxonada qorong'ilikda o'tirib qoldik, chunki biz nurni yoqishga jur'at etmadik va non va shunkni yeb, bir xil shishalardan pivo ichdik.

en: The curate, who was still timorous and restless, was now, oddly enough, for pushing on, and I was urging him to keep up his strength by eating when the thing hap- pened that was to imprison us.
uz: Hali ham qo'rqoq va qayg'urgan ruhoniy, g'alati, o'zini davom ettirishga majbur qildi va men uni ovqatlanish orqali kuchini saqlab qolishga undardim, chunki bu bizni hibsga olish uchun sodir bo'lgan.

en: It can't be midnight yet, I said, and then came a blinding glare of vivid green light.
uz: Men: Ha, hali tun yarim bo'lishi mumkin emas, - dedim va keyin yorug' yashil yorug'likning ko'z o'ngini ochib berdi.

en: Everything in the kitchen leaped out, clearly visible in green and black, and vanished again.
uz: Oshxonadagi hamma narsa yashil va qora rangda aniq ko'rinadigan bo'lib chiqib, yana yo'qoldi.

en: And then followed such a concussion as I have never heard before or since.
uz: So'ngra men bundan oldin ham, undan keyin ham hech qachon eshitmagan bevosita sarosima yuz berdi.

en: So close on the heels of this as to seem instantaneous came a thud behind me, a clash of glass, a crash and rattle of falling masonry all about us, and the plaster of the ceiling came down upon us, smashing into a multitude of fragments upon our heads.
uz: Bularning orqasidan o'sha zahotiyoq ko'rinadigan darajada yaqinlashib, orqamdan shishalar, shishalar to'qnashishi, atrofimizdagi eskirib tushayotgan temirchilikning shov-shov bo'lib ketishi va plafonning plastinasi ustimizga tushib, boshlarimizdagi ko'plab parchalariga aylanib tushdi.

en: I was knocked headlong across the ﬂoor against the oven handle and stunned.
uz: Men hovuzdagi ovning qo'lchagiga to'g'rilab qo'yildi va qo'rqinchli bo'ldim.

en: I was insen- sible for a long time, the curate told me, and when I came to we were in darkness again, and he, with a face wet, as I found afterwards, with blood from a cut forehead, was dabbing water over me.
uz: Ruhoniy menga uzoq vaqtdan beri o'zimni sezmayotganimni aytdi va qaytib kelganimda, biz yana qorong'ilikda edik va u, keyinchalik ko'rdimki, yuzidan suyuq, oldidan kesilgan qon bilan, menga suvni to'kib-to'kib qo'ydi.

en: For some time I could not recollect what had happened.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida nima sodir bo'lganini eslay olmaganman.

en: Then things came to me slowly.
uz: So'ngra ishlar sekin-sakin o'zimga keldi.

en: A bruise on my temple asserted itself.
uz: Ma'badimda o'simlik bo'lib qolgan.

en: Are you better? asked the curate in a whisper.
uz: Sening yaxshilanyapsanmi? - deb so'radi murabbiy.

en: At last I answered him.
uz: Oxir-oqibat men unga javob berdim.

en: Don't move, he said.
uz: Harakat qilmang, dedi u.

en: The ﬂoor is covered with smashed crockery from the dresser.
uz: Jannat maydoni sovutgichdan tushirilgan buyumlar bilan qoplangan.

en: You can't possibly move without making a noise, and I fancy THEY are outside. We both sat quite silent, so that we could scarcely hear each other breath- ing.
uz: Shov-shuvsiz harakatlanishga imkon yo'q va men O'Zlarining tashqarida ekanliklarini his qilaman. Ikkovimiz ham juda jim o'tirdik, shu sababli bir-birimizning nafas olishimizni oz eshitardik.

en: Everything seemed deadly still, but once something near us, some plas- ter or broken brickwork, slid down with a rumbling sound.
uz: Hamma narsa o'ta o'ta xavfli tuyulgan edi, lekin bir marta bizga yaqin bir narsa, plastik yoki buzilgan tikanlar, qichqiriq tovushlari bilan yerga yiqildi.

en: Outside and very near was an intermittent, metallic rattle.
uz: Tushida va juda yaqin atrofda biroz vaqtlar biroz metalli qichqiriq bo'lib turardi.

en: That! said the curate, when presently it happened again.
uz: Ushbu! - dedi murabbiy, hozirda bu yana sodir bo'ldi.

en: But what is it? A Martian! said the curate.
uz: - Lekin bu nima? - dedi murabbiy. - U marsiyalik.

en: It was not like the Heat-Ray, I said, and for a time I was inclined to think one of the great ﬁghting-machines had stumbled against the house, as I had seen one stumble against the tower of Shepperton Church.
uz: Bu issiqlik radiyasiga o'xshamaydi, - dedim men va bir muncha vaqt davomida buyuk jang mashinalaridan biri uyga tushib qolganini o'ylashga moyil edim, chunki men bir marta Shepperton cherkovining minorasini ushlab qolganini ko'rdim.

en: Our situation was so strange and incomprehensible that for three or four hours, until the dawn came, we scarcely moved.
uz: Vaziyatimiz shunchalik g'alati va tushunarsiz ediki, tonggacha uch yoki to'rt soat davomida juda oz harakatlanardik.

en: And then the light ﬁltered in, not through the window, which remained black, but through a triangular aperture between a beam and a heap of broken bricks in the wall behind us.
uz: So'ngra nur qora qolgan darcha orqali emas, balki biz ortimizdagi devorda bo'lgan toshlar to'plami va bir to'plam toshlar o'rtasida uchburchakli ochiqlik orqali filtrlandi.

en: The interior of the kitchen we now saw greyly for the ﬁrst time.
uz: Oshxonamizning ichki qismini endi birinchi marta grizli ko'rdik.

en: The window had been burst in by a mass of garden mould, which ﬂowed over the table upon which we had been sitting and lay about our feet.
uz: O'rindiqni bog'dagi o'simliklarning bir qismi buzdi va biz o'tirgan va oyoqlarimiz bilan yotgan stol ustida oqib ketdi.

en: Out- side, the soil was banked high against the house.
uz: Tashqi tomondan, tuproq uyga qarshi yuqoriga o'rnatib qo'yilgan edi.

en: At the top of the window
uz: Oynaning yuqori qismida

en: frame we could see an uprooted drainpipe.
uz: Biz o'zimizdan chiqarib tashlangan suv quvurini ko'rishimiz mumkin edi.

en: The ﬂoor was littered with smashed hardware; the end of the kitchen towards the house was broken into, and since the daylight shone in there, it was evident the greater part of the house had collapsed.
uz: Ertalabda buzilgan asbob-uskunalar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi; oshxonaning uy tomonidagi sohasi buzilgan edi va kun yorug'ligi u yerga kirib kelganligi sababli, uyning aksariyat qismi vayron bo'lganligi aniq edi.

en: Contrasting vividly with this ruin was the neat dresser, stained in the fashion, pale green, and with a number of copper and tin vessels below it, the wallpaper imitating blue and white tiles, and a cou- ple of coloured supplements ﬂuttering from the walls above the kitchen range.
uz: Bu vayronlikdan aniq farq qiladigan o'rinli, modada bo'yilgan, rang-barang yashil, pastida ko'p kumush va qalin idishlar, ko'k va oq plyonkalarni takrorlaydigan devor qog'ozlari va oshxonadan yuqori bo'lgan devorlardan to'plangan rangli qo'shimchalar to'plami edi.

en: As the dawn grew clearer, we saw through the gap in the wall the body of a Martian, standing sentinel, I suppose, over the still glowing cylinder.
uz: Tong yorug' bo'lgan sari, biz devordagi bo'shliqdan marsiyalikning jasadini ko'rdik, men o'ylaymanki, o'z navbatida, hali ham yoritib turgan silindr ustida turibdi.

en: At the sight of that we crawled as circumspectly as possible out of the twilight of the kitchen into the darkness of the scullery.
uz: Buni ko'rganimizda, biz oshxonadagi qorong'ilikdan imkon qadar ehtiyotkorlik bilan cho'kib, oshxonadagi qorong'ilikka kirdik.

en: Abruptly the right interpretation dawned upon my mind.
uz: To'g'ri ta'rifni to'g'ri tushunib o'yladim.

en: The ﬁfth cylinder, I whispered, the ﬁfth shot from Mars, has struck this house and buried us under the ruins! For a time the curate was silent, and then he whispered: God have mercy upon us! I heard him presently whimpering to himself.
uz: Beshinchi silinder, - deb shov-shuv qildim men, - Marsdan beshinchi o'q bu uyga tushib, bizni vayronlar ostida ko'mib qo'ydi! - deb bir muncha vaqtdan keyin ruhoniy xotirjam bo'lib, shov-shuv qildi: Alloh bizga rahm qilsin! - deb o'zi o'zi uchun g'ayratini eshitdim.

en: Save for that sound we lay quite still in the scullery; I for my part scarce dared breathe, and sat with my eyes ﬁxed on the faint light of the kitchen door.
uz: O'sha tovushdan tashqari, biz o'sha joyda to'xtab yotgan edik; men esa nafas olishga jur'at etmay, oshxonadagi eshikning yorug' yorug' yorug'ligiga ko'z tikib o'tirardim.

en: I could just see the curate's face, a dim, oval shape, and his collar and cuffs.
uz: Men faqat kuratning yuzini, kam, oval shaklini, bo'yinchoq va qo'ychoqlarini ko'rardim.

en: Outside there began a metallic hammering, then a violent hooting, and then again, after a quiet interval, a hissing like the hissing of an engine.
uz: Tushida metallga o'xshaydigan martalish boshlangan, so'ngra kuchli shovqinlar, keyin yana, tinch vaqtdan so'ng, mashina shovqinini o'xshaydigan shovqinlar boshlandi.

en: These noises, for the most part problematical, continued intermittently, and seemed if anything to increase in number as time wore on.
uz: Ko'p hollarda muammoli bo'lgan bu tovushlar vaqti-vaqti bilan davom etdi va vaqt o'tishi bilan ularning soni o'sib borar edi.

en: Presently a mea- sured thudding and a vibration that made everything about us quiver and the vessels in the pantry ring and shift, began and continued.
uz: O'shanda atrofimizdagi hamma narsani titraydigan, ombordagi idishlar o'zgardi va o'zgardi, deb o'ylaydigan bir shovqin va titrishni boshladi va davom ettirdi.

en: Once the light was eclipsed, and the ghostly kitchen doorway became absolutely dark.
uz: Bir marta yorug'lik qoplandi va hayajonli oshxona eshiklari chindan ham qorong'i bo'ldi.

en: For many hours we must have crouched there, silent and shivering, until our tired attention failed… At last I found myself awake and very hungry.
uz: Ko'p soatlar o'sha yerda, charchagan e'tiborimiz yo'qotib ketmaguncha, xotirjamlik va titrash bilan o'tirib turardik... Oxir-oqibat o'zimni uyg'onib, juda och qoldim.

en: I am inclined to believe we must have spent the greater portion of a day before that awakening.
uz: Men o'sha uyg'onishdan oldin kunning katta qismini o'tkazgan bo'lishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.

en: My hunger was at a stride so insistent that it moved me to action.
uz: Oʻzimning ochligim shunchalik kuchli ediki, bu meni harakatga undadi.

en: I told the cu- rate I was going to seek food, and felt my way towards the pantry.
uz: Men oziq-ovqat izlashga ketayotganimni ko'pchilikka aytdim va o'zimni oshxonaga borayotganimni his qildim.

en: He made me no answer, but so soon as I began eating the faint noise I made stirred him up and I heard him crawling after me.
uz: U menga hech qanday javob bermadi, lekin men ovqatlanishni boshlaganimdan so'ng, qo'zg'atdim va uning orqamdan o'tirganini eshitdim.

en: CHAPTER 2 WHAT WE SAW FROM THE RUINED HOUSE After eating we crept back to the scullery, and there I must have dozed again, for when presently I looked round I was alone.
uz: 2 - bob Yovuz uydan ko'rganimiz. Ovqat yeb, o'zimiz bilan o'tadigan joyga qaytib keldik va u yerda men yana uxlagan bo'laman, chunki atrofimga qarab, yolg'iz qoldim.

en: The thudding vibra- tion continued with wearisome persistence.
uz: Tushkan vibratsiyalar charchatadigan chidam bilan davom etdi.

en: I whispered for the curate sever- al times, and at last felt my way to the door of the kitchen.
uz: Men bir necha marta ruhoniyga shov-shuv qildim va nihoyat oshxonadagi eshikga borayotganimni his qildim.

en: It was still day- light, and I perceived him across the room, lying against the triangular hole that looked out upon the Martians.
uz: Hndi kun yorug' edi va men uni xonaning boshqa tomonida, marsiyaliklarga qaragan uchburchakli cho'lga qarshi yotganini ko'rdim.

en: His shoulders were hunched, so that his head was hidden from me.
uz: Uning shohlari egri bo'lib, boshini mendan yashirgan edi.

en: I could hear a number of noises almost like those in an engine shed; and the place rocked with that beating thud.
uz: Men bir nechta tovushlarni eshitardim, bu deyarli motorlar do'konidagi tovushlarga o'xshaydi; va joy o'sha urish bilan sarsadi.

en: Through the aperture in the wall I could see the top of a tree touched with gold and the warm blue of a tran- quil evening sky.
uz: Devordagi ochqichdan oltin bilan to'ldirilgan daraxtning yuqori qismini va kechqurun osmondagi iliq ko'k rangni ko'rish mumkin edi.

en: For a minute or so I remained watching the curate, and then I advanced, crouching and stepping with extreme care amid the broken crockery that littered the ﬂoor.
uz: Bir daqiqa yoki shunga o'xshash vaqt davomida ruhoniyga qarab turardim va so'ngra yotoqni to'ldirgan buzib ketgan xonadonlar o'rtasida juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'zimni qo'zg'atdim va qadamlar qo'ydim.

en: I touched the curate's leg, and he started so violently that a mass of plas- ter went sliding down outside and fell with a loud impact.
uz: Men kuratning oyoqlariga tegdim va u shunchalik kuchli bo'lib boshladiki, plastikning bir qismi tashqariga chiqib, kuchli ta'sir bilan qulab tushdi.

en: I gripped his arm, fearing he might cry out, and for a long time we crouched motionless.
uz: U qichqirishi mumkinligini qo'rqqanim uchun men uning qo'lini ushlab qoldim va ko'p vaqt davomida harakatsiz o'tirib qoldik.

en: Then I turned to see how much of our rampart remained.
uz: So'ng, qo'rqinchimizning qancha qolishidan xabardor bo'lish uchun o'zimni ko'rdim.

en: The detachment of the plaster had left a vertical slit open in the debris, and by raising myself cau- tiously across a beam I was able to see out of this gap into what had been overnight a quiet suburban roadway.
uz: Gipsning bo'linishi buzoqlar ichida vertikal bo'lakni ochib qo'ygan edi va o'zimni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bo'lakdan ko'tarib, bu bo'lakdan bir kecha ichida tinch shahar atrofidagi yo'l bo'lgan joyga ko'rishim mumkin edi.

en: Vast, indeed, was the change that we beheld.
uz: Darhaqiqat, biz ko'rgan o'zgarish juda keng edi.

en: The ﬁfth cylinder must have fallen right into the midst of the house we had ﬁrst visited.
uz: Beshinchi silinder biz birinchi bor tashrif buyurgan uyning o'rtasida tushib ketgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: The building had vanished, completely smashed, pul- verised, and dispersed by the blow.
uz: Binoning o'zi yo'qolgan, butunlay vayron bo'lgan, cho'kkan va cho'qqisidan tarqalgan edi.

en: The cylinder lay now far beneath the original foundations—deep in a hole, already vastly larger than the pit I had
uz: Silindr allaqachon original poydevorlardan ancha pastda, allaqachon mening qabrimdan ancha kattaroq bo'lgan cho'g'da chuqur joylashgan edi.

en: looked into at Woking.
uz: Wokingni ko'rib chiqdim.

en: The earth all round it had splashed under that tremendous impact—splashed is the only word—and lay in heaped piles that hid the masses of the adjacent houses.
uz: O'sha dahshatli ta'sir ostida butun yer yuzi cho'kkan edi, faqatgina cho'kkan so'zi bor va yonma-yon uylarning to'plamlarini yashirgan to'plamlarda yotgan edi.

en: It had behaved exactly like mud under the violent blow of a hammer.
uz: U o'z-o'zini to'g'ri o'tkazgan edi, xuddi o'g'ir cho'g'i ostida cho'g'iga o'xshaydi.

en: Our house had collapsed backward; the front portion, even on the ground ﬂoor, had been destroyed completely; by a chance the kitchen and scullery had escaped, and stood buried now under soil and ruins, closed in by tons of earth on every side save towards the cylinder.
uz: Uyimiz orqaga burildi; oldingi qism, hatto birinchi qavatda ham, butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketgan edi; tasodifan oshxona va idishxonalar qochib ketib, endi tuproq va vayronliklar ostida, silindrga qaraganda har tarafdan tonlab turadigan tuproq bilan qoplangan holda turgan edi.

en: Over that aspect we hung now on the very edge of the great circu- lar pit the Martians were engaged in making.
uz: Biz o'sha tomonni o'rab olganimizda, marsiyaliklar o'z ishini bajarayotgan katta aylanmaning chegarasida o'tirdik.

en: The heavy beating sound was evidently just behind us, and ever and again a bright green vapour drove up like a veil across our peephole.
uz: Og'ir urish ovozi biz ortimizda bo'lgani aniq, bir necha marta yorqin yashil bug'lar ko'z olg'imizdan parda kabi ko'tarildi.

en: The cylinder was already opened in the centre of the pit, and on the far- ther edge of the pit, amid the smashed and gravel-heaped shrubbery, one of the great ﬁghting-machines, deserted by its occupant, stood stiff and tall against the evening sky.
uz: Silindr allaqachon quduqning markazida ochilgan edi va quduqning o'tkir chegaralarida, buzilgan va qirg'oq bilan to'plangan butalar orasida, uning o'rinbosari tomonidan tark etilgan buyuk jang mashinalaridan biri kechki osmonga qarshi qattiq va baland turibdi.

en: At ﬁrst I scarcely noticed the pit and the cylinder, although it has been convenient to describe them ﬁrst, on account of the ex- traordinary glittering mechanism I saw busy in the excavation, and on ac- count of the strange creatures that were crawling slowly and painfully across the heaped mould near it.
uz: Boshida, chuqurlik va silinderni kamroq ko'rdim, ammo ularni birinchi bo'lib tasvirlash qulay bo'ldi, chunki qazish ishida mashg'ul bo'lgan ajoyib shishqoq mexanizm va uning yaqinidagi to'plamli o'simliklardan sekin va og'irlik bilan o'rab o'tirgan g'ayritabiiy mavjudotlar tufayli.

en: The mechanism it certainly was that held my attention ﬁrst.
uz: Shubhasiz, birinchi navbatda diqqatimni jalb qilgan mexanizm edi.

en: It was one of those complicated fabrics that have since been called handling- machines, and the study of which has already given such an enormous impetus to ter- restrial invention.
uz: Bu o'sha murakkab matolardan biri edi, u vaqtdan buyon ularni ushlab turish mashinalari deb atashgan va uning o'rganilishi allaqachon terestral ixtiroga juda katta ilhom bergan.

en: As it dawned upon me ﬁrst, it presented a sort of metallic spider with ﬁve jointed, agile legs, and with an extraordinary number of jointed levers, bars, and reaching and clutching tentacles about its body.
uz: O'zimni birinchi o'ylab ko'rganimda, u besh qo'shilgan, o'zgaruvchan oyoqlari bilan bir xil metalli o'g'irning o'rnida bo'lib, juda ko'p qo'shilgan daraxtlar, barlar va o'z tanasi atrofida yonboshlash va tutish tentaqalari bor edi.

en: Most of its arms were retracted, but with three long tentacles it was ﬁshing out a number of rods, plates, and bars which lined the covering and appar- ently strengthened the walls of the cylinder.
uz: Uning ko'pgina qo'llaridan biri orqaga chiqdi, ammo u uchta uzun tentakel bilan bir qator tayoq, plakat va barlarni o'rab oldi, bu esa qoplamani o'rnatdi va, ehtimol, silindr devorlarini mustahkamladi.

en: These, as it extracted them, were lifted out and deposited upon a level surface of earth behind it.
uz: Bularni olib chiqib ketayotganda, ular ko'tarilib, uning orqasida yer yuzining tekis yuziga joylashtirildi.

en: Its motion was so swift, complex, and perfect that at ﬁrst I did not see it as a machine, in spite of its metallic glitter.
uz: Uning harakatlari shunchalik tez, murakkab va mukammal bo'lganki, uning metall shishqoqligiga qaramay, men uni dastlab mashina sifatida ko'rmaganman.

en: The ﬁghting-machines were co- ordinated and animated to an extraordinary pitch, but nothing to compare with this.
uz: Urush mashinalari o'zaro tartibga solinadi va o'ziga xos mavzuga ko'rinadi, ammo buning o'xshashligi yo'q.

en: People who have never seen these structures, and have only the ill-imagined efforts of artists or the imperfect descriptions of such eye-wit- nesses as myself to go upon, scarcely realise that living quality.
uz: Ushbu tuzilmalarni hech qachon ko'rmagan va faqat san'atkorlarning o'ylamagan harakatlari yoki men kabi ko'zgu guvohlarning nomukammal tavsiflari bilan shug'ullanadigan odamlar hayotning bu sifatini kamdan-kam tushunishadi.

en: I recall particularly the illustration of one of the ﬁrst pamphlets to give a consecutive account of the war.
uz: Ayniqsa, urush haqida ketma-ket hikoya qilgan birinchi risolalardan birining tasvirlanganini eslayman.

en: The artist had evidently made a hasty study
uz: San'atkor shoshilinch tadqiqot o'tkazgan.

en: of one of the ﬁghting-machines, and there his knowledge ended.
uz: U jang mashinalaridan biri haqida o'rganayotgan edi va bu uning bilimining oxiri edi.

en: He pre- sented them as tilted, stiff tripods, without either ﬂexibility or subtlety, and with an altogether misleading monotony of effect.
uz: U ularni o'zidan oldinga tiklangan, qat'iy tripodlar sifatida, moslashuvchanlik va nozikliksiz va butunlay adashtiruvchi ta'sir monotoniyasi bilan taqdim etgan.

en: The pamphlet containing these renderings had a considerable vogue, and I mention them here simply to warn the reader against the impression they may have created.
uz: Ushbu tarjimalarni o'z ichiga olgan buklama juda mashhur bo'lgan va men ularni shunchaki o'quvchiga ular yaratgan taassurotdan ogohlantirish uchun bu erda aytib o'taman.

en: They were no more like the Martians I saw in action than a Dutch doll is like a human being.
uz: Gollandiyalik qo'g'irchoq inson kabi bo'lgani kabi, ular ham harakatda ko'rgan marsiyaliklarga o'xshamaydi.

en: To my mind, the pamphlet would have been much better without them.
uz: Mening fikrimcha, buklama ularsiz ancha yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

en: At ﬁrst, I say, the handling-machine did not impress me as a machine, but as a crablike creature with a glittering integument, the controlling Martian whose delicate tentacles actuated its movements seeming to be simply the equivalent of the crab's cerebral portion.
uz: Boshida, men aytamanki, ushlab turish mashinasi meni mashina sifatida emas, balki shovqinli to'liqligi bo'lgan, o'zlarining nozik tentakellari bilan harakatlarini harakatga keltirib chiqaradigan, nazorat qiluvchi martian yaratilish sifatida hayratda qoldirdi.

en: But then I perceived the resem- blance of its grey-brown, shiny, leathery integument to that of the other sprawling bodies beyond, and the true nature of this dexterous workman dawned upon me.
uz: Ammo o'shanda uning griq-qaroq, shishaq, charmli qismining boshqa keng ko'lamli jismlarga o'xshashligini angladim va bu mahoratli ishchining haqiqiy tabiati menga ayon bo'ldi.

en: With that realisation my interest shifted to those other creatures, the real Martians.
uz: O'sha tasavvur bilan mening qiziqishim boshqa mavjudotlarga, haqiqiy marsiyaliklarga o'tdi.

en: Already I had had a transient impression of these, and the ﬁrst nausea no longer obscured my observation.
uz: Men allaqachon bularning o'tkinchi taassurotini his qilgan edim va birinchi pichoqlik ko'z o'ngimga tushmadi.

en: Moreover, I was concealed and motionless, and under no urgency of action.
uz: Bundan tashqari, men yashirin va harakatsiz edim va hech qanday harakatning shoshilinchligi yo'q edi.

en: They were, I now saw, the most unearthly creatures it is possible to con- ceive.
uz: Ular, men hozir ko'rdimki, dunyoga xos bo'lmagan mavjudotlar edi.

en: They were huge round bodies—or, rather, heads—about four feet in diameter, each body having in front of it a face.
uz: Ular ulkan to'g'ri tanlar yoki, aksincha, to'rt fut diametrli boshlar edi, har bir taning oldida yuz bor edi.
