en: This face had no nostrils— indeed, the Martians do not seem to have had any sense of smell, but it had a pair of very large dark-coloured eyes, and just beneath this a kind of ﬂeshy beak.
uz: Bu yuzning burun teshiklari yo'q edi, albatta, marsiyaliklar hech qanday xushbo'ylikka ega bo'lishmagan, lekin uning juda katta qora rangli ko'zlari bor edi va uning ostiga bir xil go'shtli burchak bor edi.

en: In the back of this head or body—I scarcely know how to speak of it—was the single tight tympanic surface, since known to be anatomically an ear, though it must have been almost useless in our dense air.
uz: Bu bosh yoki taning orqasida - bu bitta qattiq timpanik yuza edi, chunki u anatomik jihatdan quloq deb tanilgan, garchi u bizning zich havoimizda deyarli befoyda bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa-da.

en: In a group round the mouth were sixteen slender, almost whiplike tenta- cles, arranged in two bunches of eight each.
uz: Og'iz atrofidagi guruhda o'n oltita chiroyli, deyarli pichoq kabi tentalar bor edi, har biri sakkiz kishidan iborat ikkita guruhga joylashtirilgan edi.

en: These bunches have since been named rather aptly, by that distinguished anatomist, Professor Howes, the HANDS.
uz: O'sha paytdan buyon bu guruhlar o'sha mashhur anatomist professor Howes tomonidan HANDS deb nomlangan.

en: Even as I saw these Martians for the ﬁrst time they seemed to be endeavouring to raise themselves on these hands, but of course, with the in- creased weight of terrestrial conditions, this was impossible.
uz: Ushbu marsiyaliklarni birinchi marta ko'rganimda, ular o'zlarini bu qo'llar bilan ko'tarishga harakat qilgani ko'rinardi, ammo, albatta, yer yuzidagi sharoitlarning o'sib borayotgan og'irligi sababli bu imkonsiz edi.

en: There is reason to suppose that on Mars they may have progressed upon them with some facility.
uz: Marsda ular ular ustida qandaydir qulaylik bilan o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin deb taxmin qilish uchun asos bor.

en: The internal anatomy, I may remark here, as dissection has since shown, was almost equally simple.
uz: Ichki anatomiya, men bu erda ta'kidlashim mumkin, chunki bu dizeksiya keyinchalik ko'rsatilganidek, deyarli xuddi shunday oddiy edi.

en: The greater part of the structure was the brain, sending enormous nerves to the eyes, ear, and tactile tentacles.
uz: Qurilishning katta qismi miya edi, u ko'zlar, quloq va tutish tentaqalariga ulkan asablarni yuboradi.

en: were the bulky lungs, into which the mouth opened, and the heart and its vessels.
uz: O'z og'zini ochgan katta o'qlari, yurak va uning idishlari edi.

en: The pulmonary distress caused by the denser atmosphere and greater gravitational attraction was only too evident in the convulsive movements of the outer skin.
uz: Atmosfera zichligi va yuqori gravitatsiya bilan bog'liq bo'lgan samolyotlarning tashqaridagi terining shovqinli harakatlari tufayli yuzaga keladigan pulmonal tashvishlar juda ko'rinardi.

en: And this was the sum of the Martian organs.
uz: Bu esa Marsdagi organlarning yig'imi edi.

en: Strange as it may seem to a human being, all the complex apparatus of digestion, which makes up the bulk of our bodies, did not exist in the Martians.
uz: Inson uchun g'alati tuyulsa-da, tanamizning katta qismini tashkil etadigan barcha murakkab o't qo'yish uskunalari martliklar orasida mavjud emas edi.

en: They were heads—merely heads.
uz: Ular boshlar edi, faqat boshlar edi.

en: Entrails they had none.
uz: Ular hech qanday entrailsga ega bo'lmagan.

en: They did not eat, much less digest.
uz: Ular ovqat yemaydilar, bundan ham kamroq o'zlarini sindirishadi.

en: Instead, they took the fresh, living blood of other creatures, and INJECTED it into their own veins.
uz: Buning o'rniga ular boshqa mavjudotlarning yangi, tirik qonini olib, uni o'z damarlariga o'tkazdilar.

en: I have myself seen this being done, as I shall mention in its place.
uz: Men o'zim bu ishni amalga oshirayotganini ko'rdim, bu haqda o'z o'rnida aytib o'tamiz.

en: But, squeamish as I may seem, I cannot bring myself to describe what I could not endure even to continue watching.
uz: Ammo, qanchalik qahramon bo'lishim mumkin bo'lsa-da, hatto ko'rishni davom ettirishim uchun ham ko'ra olmaydigan narsani tasvirlashga o'zimni majburlay olmayman.

en: Let it sufﬁce to say, blood obtained from a still living animal, in most cases from a human be- ing, was run directly by means of a little pipette into the recipient canal… The bare idea of this is no doubt horribly repulsive to us, but at the same time I think that we should remember how repulsive our carnivorous habits would seem to an intelligent rabbit.
uz: To'g'ri aytish kerakki, tirik hayvondan, aksariyat hollarda insondan olingan qon biroz pipet orqali qabul qiluvchi kanalga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tkaziladi... Biz uchun bu juda jirkanch fikr, shubhasiz, lekin shu bilan birga, mening fikrimcha, bizning go'shtvorlik odatlarimiz aqlli qush uchun qanchalik jirkanch bo'lishini esda tutishimiz kerak.

en: The physiological advantages of the practice of injection are undeniable, if one thinks of the tremendous waste of human time and energy occasioned by eating and the digestive process.
uz: Injeksiya qilishning fizyologik afzalliklari, agar inson ovqatlanish va ovqatlanish jarayonida odamning vaqt va energiyasining ulkan isrof qilinishini o'ylab ko'rsa, tanqid qilinmaydi.

en: Our bodies are half made up of glands and tubes and organs, occupied in turning heterogeneous food into blood.
uz: Bizning tanamiz yarmi bezlar, quvurlar va organlardan iborat bo'lib, geterogen oziq-ovqatlarni qonga aylantirish bilan band.

en: The digestive processes and their reaction upon the nervous system sap our strength and colour our minds.
uz: Chirish jarayonlari va ularning asabiy tizimga ta'sir qilishi bizning kuchimizni pasaytirib, ongimizni rang-barang qiladi.

en: Men go happy or miserable as they have healthy or unhealthy livers, or sound gastric glands.
uz: Erkaklar sog'lom yoki sog'lom bo'lmagan jigarlari yoki sog'lom oshqozonlari bo'lgani uchun baxtli yoki baxtsiz bo'lishadi.

en: But the Martians were lifted above all these organic ﬂuctuations of mood and emotion.
uz: Ammo marsiyaliklar ruh va his-tuyg'ularning organik o'zgarishlaridan ustun qo'yilgan.

en: Their undeniable preference for men as their source of nourishment is partly explained by the nature of the remains of the victims they had brought with them as provisions from Mars.
uz: Ularning oziq-ovqat manbai sifatida odamlarga bo'lgan tanqid qilishdan iborat bo'lgan afzalligi, qisman, o'zlari bilan birga Marsdan rizq-ro'z sifatida olib kelgan qurbonlarning qoldiqlari xususiyati bilan tushuntiriladi.

en: These creatures, to judge from the shrivelled remains that have fallen into human hands, were bipeds with ﬂimsy, silicious skeletons (almost like those of the silicious sponges) and feeble musculature, standing about six feet high and having round, erect heads, and large eyes in ﬂinty sockets.
uz: Odamlar qo'liga tushgan bu xilma-xil mavjudotlarni ko'rib chiqaylik, ular ikki oyoqli edilar, ular chiroyli, chiroyli skeletlarga ega edilar (deyarli chiroyli isponjlarga o'xshaydilar) va muskulyatsiyalari zaif edilar, ularning balandligi taxminan olti metr bo'lgan va ularning boshi to'g'ri, boshlari tiklangan va ko'zlari katta edi.

en: Two or three of these seem to have been brought in each cylinder, and all were killed before earth was reached.
uz: Ularning ikkitasi yoki uchasi har bir silinderga olib kelingan va ularning barchasi yer yuziga yetib kelishidan oldin o'ldirilgan.

en: It was just as well for them, for the mere attempt to stand upright upon our planet would have broken every bone in their bodies.
uz: Bu ular uchun ham yaxshi bo'ldi, chunki sayyoramizda to'g'ri turishga harakat qilish ularning tanasining har bir suyakini sindirib yuborardi.

en: And while I am engaged in this description, I may add in this place cer- tain further details which, although they were not all evident to us at the
uz: Ushbu tavsif bilan shug'ullanayotgan bo'lsam-da, ushbu joyda ba'zi tafsilotlarni qo'shishim mumkin, bularning barchasi biz uchun aniq bo'lmagan bo'lsa-da, bularning barchasi o'z vaqtida bizga ko'rinadi.

en: time, will enable the reader who is unacquainted with them to form a clear- er picture of these offensive creatures.
uz: Vaqt o'tib, ular bilan tanish bo'lmagan o'quvchi ushbu hujumli mavjudotlar haqida aniq tasavvurga ega bo'ladi.

en: In three other points their physiology differed strangely from ours.
uz: Boshqa uchta nuqtada ularning fiziologiyasi bizdan g'alati farq qilardi.

en: Their organisms did not sleep, any more than the heart of man sleeps.
uz: Ularning organizmlari inson yuragi uxlamaganidek, uyqusida ham bo'lmagan.

en: Since they had no extensive muscular mechanism to recuperate, that periodical extinc- tion was unknown to them.
uz: Ular o'zlarini tiklash uchun mushaklarning keng mexanizmlariga ega bo'lmaganligi sababli, o'sha davriy o'tish ularga noma'lum edi.

en: They had little or no sense of fatigue, it would seem.
uz: Ko'rinib turganidek, ular juda oz yoki hech qanday charchaganlik hissi bilan shug'ullanishgan.

en: On earth they could never have moved without effort, yet even to the last they kept in action.
uz: Yer yuzida ular hech qachon harakatsiz harakat qilolmas edilar, ammo hatto oxirgi kunlarigacha harakat qilishardi.

en: In twenty- four hours they did twenty-four hours of work, as even on earth is perhaps the case with the ants.
uz: Ular yigirma to'rt soat ichida yigirma to'rt soatlik ish qilishdi, hatto yer yuzida ham, ehtimol, qurtlar bilan shunday bo'lishi mumkin.

en: In the next place, wonderful as it seems in a sexual world, the Martians were absolutely without sex, and therefore without any of the tumultuous emotions that arise from that difference among men.
uz: Bundan so'ng, jinsiy olamda ajoyib tuyulsa-da, marsiyaliklar jinsiy aloqada bo'lmagan, shuning uchun erkaklar orasidagi bu farqdan kelib chiqadigan g'alati his-tuyg'ularsiz edilar.

en: A young Martian, there can now be no dispute, was really born upon earth during the war, and it was found attached to its parent, partially BUDDED off, just as young lilybulbs bud off, or like the young animals in the fresh-water polyp.
uz: Yosh marsiyalik, hozir hech qanday nizo bo'lmasligi mumkin, urush paytida yer yuzida tug'ilgan va u ota-onasiga bog'liq, qisman bo'sh bo'lgan, xuddi yosh lilybulblar o'sib chiqqanidek yoki shirin suv polipidagi yosh hayvonlar kabi topilgan.

en: In man, in all the higher terrestrial animals, such a method of increase has disappeared; but even on this earth it was certainly the primitive method.
uz: Odamlarda, barcha yuqori yer hayvonlarida bunday o'sish usuli yo'qolgan; lekin hatto bu yer yuzida ham bu primitiv usul bo'lgan.

en: Among the lower animals, up even to those ﬁrst cousins of the vertebrated animals, the Tunicates, the two processes occur side by side, but ﬁnally the sexual method superseded its competitor altogether.
uz: Pastki hayvonlar orasida, hatto orqa burchakli hayvonlarning birinchi qarindoshlari, Tunikatlar orasida, bu ikki jarayon yonma-yon sodir bo'ladi, ammo nihoyat jinsiy usul raqibini butunlayin o'zgartirdi.

en: On Mars, however, just the reverse has apparently been the case.
uz: Biroq, Marsda buning aksi sodir bo'lgan.

en: It is worthy of remark that a certain speculative writer of quasi- scientiﬁc repute, writing long before the Martian invasion, did forecast for man a ﬁ- nal structure not unlike the actual Martian condition.
uz: Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, marsiy invaziyadan ancha oldin yozgan, deyarli ilmiy obro'ga ega bo'lgan bir spekulativ yozuvchi insoniyat uchun haqiqiy marsiy holatga o'xshamaydigan yakuniy tuzilishni bashorat qilgan.

en: His prophecy, I re- member, appeared in November or December, 1893, in a long-defunct pub- lication, the PALL MALL BUDGET, and I recall a caricature of it in a pre- Martian periodical called PUNCH.
uz: Uning bashorati, men uning a'zosi, 1893 yil noyabr yoki dekabr oylarida uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lmagan nashrda, PALL MALL BUDGETda paydo bo'ldi va men buni PUNCH deb nomlangan pre-Mars davriy gazetasida karikatura qilganimni eslayman.

en: He pointed out—writing in a foolish, facetious tone—that the perfection of mechanical appliances must ultimate- ly supersede limbs; the perfection of chemical devices, digestion; that such organs as hair, external nose, teeth, ears, and chin were no longer essential parts of the human being, and that the tendency of natural selection would lie in the direction of their steady diminution through the coming ages.
uz: U ahmoqona, o'ziga xos so'zlar bilan yozganida, mexanik qurilmalarning mukammalligi oxir-oqibat a'zolarni almashtirishi kerakligini, kimyoviy qurilmalarning mukammalligi, sindirish; sochlar, tashqi burun, tishlar, quloq va burun kabi organlar insonning muhim qismlari emasligini va tabiiy tanlanish tendensiyasi kelgusi asrlarda ularning doimiy kamayishi borligini ta'kidlagan.

en: The brain alone remained a cardinal necessity.
uz: Faqatgina miyaning o'zi asosiy zarurat bo'lib qoldi.

en: Only one other part of the body had a strong case for survival, and that was the hand, teacher and agent of the brain. While the rest of the body dwindled, the hands would grow larger.
uz: Taning boshqa bir qismigina omon qolish uchun kuchli sababga ega edi va u qo'l, o'qituvchi va miyaning agenti edi.

en: There is many a true word written in jest, and here in the Martians we have beyond dispute the actual accomplishment of such a suppression of the animal side of the organism by the intelligence.
uz: Haqiqiy so'zlarning ko'pchiligi mayda-mayda yozilgan va bu erda marsiyaliklarda biz aql-idrok bilan organizmning hayvonot tomonini yo'q qilishning haqiqiy amalga oshirilishi shubhasiz.

en: To me it is quite credible that the Martians may be descended from beings not unlike ourselves, by a gradual development of brain and hands (the latter giving rise to the two bunches of delicate tentacles at last) at the expense of the rest of the body.
uz: Menimcha, marsiyaliklar biz kabi bo'lmagan mavjudotlardan kelib chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin, chunki o'z miyasi va qo'llari (bularning ikkalasi nihoyat ikki to'plam zaruriy tentakellarga sabab bo'lgan) o'zlarining rivojlanishi bilan, butun tanamizning zararidan kelib chiqqan.

en: Without the body the brain would, of course, become a mere selﬁsh intelli- gence, without any of the emotional substratum of the human being.
uz: Tanasiz miyamiz, albatta, faqat o'zboshimchalik bilan aqlga aylanadi, insonning hissiy substratumidan mahrum bo'ladi.

en: The last salient point in which the systems of these creatures differed from ours was in what one might have thought a very trivial particular.
uz: Ushbu mavjudotlarning tizimlari bizning tizimimizdan farqli o'laroq, oxirgi diqqatga sazovor nuqtasi juda oddiy bir xususiyat deb o'ylash mumkin edi.

en: Mi- cro-organisms, which cause so much disease and pain on earth, have either never appeared upon Mars or Martian sanitary science eliminated them ages ago.
uz: Yer yuzida shuncha kasallik va og'riq keltirib chiqaradigan mikroorganizmlar yoki Marsda hech qachon paydo bo'lmagan, yoki Mars sanitar olimlari ularni asrlar oldin yo'q qilib tashlagan.

en: A hundred diseases, all the fevers and contagions of human life, con- sumption, cancers, tumours and such morbidities, never enter the scheme of their life.
uz: Yuzlab kasalliklar, inson hayotidagi barcha issiq va yuqumli kasalliklar, konsumpsiya, saraton, o'simlik va boshqa kasalliklar hech qachon ularning hayot tarziga kirmaydi.

en: And speaking of the differences between the life on Mars and ter- restrial life, I may allude here to the curious suggestions of the red weed.
uz: Marsdagi hayot va yer yuzidagi hayot o'rtasidagi farqlar haqida gap ketganda, men bu yerda qizil o'tning g'ayrioddiy takliflariga ishora qilmoqchiman.

en: Apparently the vegetable kingdom in Mars, instead of having green for a dominant colour, is of a vivid blood-red tint.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, Marsdagi o'simliklar dunyosi yashil rangga ega bo'lishning o'rniga jonli qon qizil rangga ega.

en: At any rate, the seeds which the Martians (intentionally or accidentally) brought with them gave rise in all cases to red-coloured growths.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, marsiyaliklar o'zlari bilan olib kelgan urug'lar (maqsad bilan yoki tasodifan) barcha holatlarda qizil rangli o'sishlarga sabab bo'ldi.

en: Only that known popularly as the red weed, however, gained any footing in competition with terrestrial forms.
uz: Biroq, faqat qizil begona o't deb tanilgan o'simlik yerdagi shakllar bilan raqobatlashishda biron bir asosni egalladi.

en: The red creeper was quite a transitory growth, and few people have seen it growing.
uz: Qizil chiroyli o'simlik o'sishi juda ko'p bo'lgan va uni ko'rgan kishilar kam emas.

en: For a time, however, the red weed grew with astonishing vigour and luxuriance.
uz: Biroq, bir muncha vaqt davomida qizil begona o't o'sib, ajoyib kuch va hashamat bilan o'sdi.

en: It spread up the sides of the pit by the third or fourth day of our imprisonment, and its cactus-like branches formed a carmine fringe to the edges of our triangular window.
uz: Biz hibsga olinganimizning uchinchi yoki to'rtinchi kunida u chuqurlikning yonlariga tarqaldi va uning kaktuska o'xshash shoxlari uchburchakli derazalarimiz chegaralariga qadar karminning chegaralarini tashkil etdi.

en: And afterwards I found it broadcast throughout the country, and especially wherever there was a stream of water.
uz: Keyin esa uni butun mamlakat bo'ylab, ayniqsa, suv oqimi bor joylarda eshittirishni ko'rdim.

en: The Martians had what appears to have been an auditory organ, a single round drum at the back of the head-body, and eyes with a visual range not very different from ours except that, according to Philips, blue and violet were as black to them.
uz: Marsliklar eshitish organini, bosh tanasining orqasida bitta to'g'ri davomiy va bizning ko'zimizdan farq qilmaydigan ko'zlar bilan ko'rishgan, faqat Philipsning aytishicha, ko'k va violet ular uchun qora rangda edi.

en: It is commonly supposed that they communicated by sounds and tentacular gesticulations; this is asserted, for instance, in the able but hastily compiled pamphlet (written evidently by someone not an eye-witness of Martian actions) to which I have already alluded, and which, so far, has been the chief source of information concerning them.
uz: Odatda ular tovushlar va tentakulyatsiyalar orqali muloqot qilishgan deb taxmin qilinadi; bu, masalan, men allaqachon eslatib o'tgan va hozirgacha ular to'g'risida asosiy ma'lumot manbalari bo'lgan, ammo tezda tayyorlangan pamfletda (ko'rinib turibdiki, u Marsdagi harakatlarning shohidi bo'lmagan kishi tomonidan yozilgan) tasdiqlanadi.

en: Now no surviving human being saw so much of the Martians in action as I did.
uz: Endi hech bir tirik insoniyat men kabi Marsliklarning harakatini ko'rmagan.

en: take no credit to myself for an accident, but the fact is so.
uz: O'zimni baxtsiz hodisaga ayblamayman, lekin haqiqat shundaki, shunday.

en: And I assert that I watched them closely time after time, and that I have seen four, ﬁve, and (once) six of them sluggishly performing the most elaborately complicated operations together without either sound or gesture.
uz: Va men ularni vaqti-vaqti bilan diqqat bilan kuzatib borganimni va ulardan to'rt, besh va (bir marta) olti nafarini ovoz yoki imo-ishorasiz birgalikda eng murakkab operatsiyalarni sekinlik bilan bajarayotganini ko'rganimni aytaman.

en: Their peculiar hooting invariably preceded feeding; it had no modulation, and was, I believe, in no sense a signal, but merely the expiration of air preparatory to the suctional operation.
uz: Ularning o'ziga xos hootinglari ovqatlanishdan oldin o'tadi; bu hech qanday modulasiyaga ega bo'lmagan va, menimcha, hech qanday ma'noda signal bo'lmagan, balki sug'orish operatsiyasiga tayyorgarlik ko'rgan havo o'tishi edi.

en: I have a certain claim to at least an elementary knowledge of psychology, and in this matter I am convinced—as ﬁrmly as I am convinced of anything—that the Martians interchanged thoughts without any physical intermediation.
uz: Men psixologiyadan hech bo'lmaganda elementar bilimlarga ega bo'lishim kerakligini aytaman va bu borada marsiylar jismoniy vositachilik qilmasdan fikr almashishganligiga hamma narsadan qat'iy ishonaman.

en: And I have been convinced of this in spite of strong precon- ceptions.
uz: Va bu borada kuchli oldindan o'ylashlarga qaramay, o'zimni ishontirganman.

en: Before the Martian invasion, as an occasional reader here or there may remember, I had written with some little vehemence against the tele- pathic theory.
uz: Marsga bostirib kelishdan oldin, vaqti-vaqti bilan bu yoki bu erda o'qigan kishi eslab qolishi mumkin bo'lganidek, men telepatik nazariyaga qarshi biroz g'ayrat bilan yozgan edim.

en: The Martians wore no clothing.
uz: Marsliklar kiyim-kechak kiymagan.

en: Their conceptions of ornament and deco- rum were necessarily different from ours; and not only were they evidently much less sensible of changes of temperature than we are, but changes of pressure do not seem to have affected their health at all seriously.
uz: Ularning bezatish va dekor-rum haqidagi tasavvurlari bizdan farq qilardi; va nafaqat ular harorat o'zgarishlariga bizdan ko'ra ancha kamroq hissa qo'shishgan, balki bosim o'zgarishlari ularning sog'lig'iga jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatmagan.

en: Yet though they wore no clothing, it was in the other artiﬁcial additions to their bodily resources that their great superiority over man lay.
uz: Garchi ular kiyim-kechak kiymagan bo'lsa-da, odamlardan ustun bo'lishlari ularning jismoniy resurslariga qo'shimcha ravishda qo'shimcha qilingan boshqa sun'iy mahsulotlar bilan bog'liq edi.

en: We men, with our bicycles and road-skates, our Lilienthal soaring-machines, our guns and sticks and so forth, are just in the beginning of the evolution that the Mar- tians have worked out.
uz: Biz odamlar velosipedlarimiz va yo'l kayfiyatlarimiz, Liliental o'tish mashinalarimiz, qutuqlarimiz va tayoqlarimiz va hokazolar bilan, martianlar ishlab chiqgan evolyutsiya boshlanishida turibmiz.

en: They have become practically mere brains, wearing different bodies according to their needs just as men wear suits of clothes and take a bicycle in a hurry or an umbrella in the wet.
uz: Ular o'z ehtiyojlariga qarab turli jismlarni kiyib, xuddi erkaklar kiyim kiygan va shoshilinch velosiped yoki suvda cho'nqa olib yurganidek, deyarli o'zlarining miyasiga aylandilar.

en: And of their appli- ances, perhaps nothing is more wonderful to a man than the curious fact that what is the dominant feature of almost all human devices in mechanism is absent—the WHEEL is absent; among all the things they brought to earth there is no trace or suggestion of their use of wheels.
uz: Va ularning qo'llash usullaridan biri, ehtimol, odam uchun juda ajablanarli bo'lgan narsa, deyarli barcha insoniy mexanizmlardagi qurilmalarning asosiy xususiyati bo'lgan narsa yo'qligi; velosiped yo'qligi; ular yerga olib kelgan barcha narsalar orasida ularning velosipeddan foydalanishi haqida hech qanday iz yoki fikr yo'q.

en: One would have at least expected it in locomotion.
uz: Hech bo'lmaganda bu harakatda kutish mumkin edi.

en: And in this connection it is curious to re- mark that even on this earth Nature has never hit upon the wheel, or has preferred other expedients to its development.
uz: Shu munosabat bilan, hatto bu yer yuzida ham tabiat hech qachon haydovchini urmagan yoki o'zining rivojlanishiga qaraganda boshqa usullarni afzal ko'rganini ta'kidlash qiziqarli.

en: And not only did the Mar- tians either not know of (which is incredible), or abstain from, the wheel, but in their apparatus singularly little use is made of the ﬁxed pivot or rela- tively ﬁxed pivot, with circular motions thereabout conﬁned to one plane.
uz: Marsliklar nafaqat g'ildirak haqida bilmas edilar (ya'ni bu ajoyib), balki undan voz kechishardi, balki o'zlarining qurilmalarida qat'iy pivot yoki nisbatan qat'iy pivotdan juda kam foydalanadilar, bu erda aylanma harakatlar bir tekislikda cheklangan.

en: Almost all the joints of the machinery present a complicated system of slid- ing parts moving over small but beautifully curved friction bearings.
uz: Deyarli barcha mashinaning qo'shiqlari kichik, ammo chiroyli bo'g'ilgan chiroyli rulmanlar ustida harakatlanayotgan qatlamli qismlarning murakkab tizimini ko'rsatadi.

en: And while upon this matter of detail, it is remarkable that the long leverages of
uz: Va bu batafsillik masalasida bo'lsa-da, uzoq vaqt davomida o'tkazilgan o'zgarishlarning ta'sirini ko'rish diqqatga sazovor.

en: their machines are in most cases actuated by a sort of sham musculature of the disks in an elastic sheath; these disks become polarised and drawn closely and powerfully together when traversed by a current of electricity.
uz: Mashinalar ko'p hollarda elastik qopqoqda bo'lgan disklarning bir xil soxta muskulyatsiyasi bilan ishlatiladi; bu disklar elektr quvuri orqali o'tganda polarizatsiyaga aylanadi va yaqin va kuchli bir-biriga tortinadi.

en: In this way the curious parallelism to animal motions, which was so striking and disturbing to the human beholder, was attained.
uz: Shu yo'sin hayvonlarning harakatlari bilan g'alati parallellik, inson ko'ruvchisi uchun juda diqqatga sazovor va xavotirga soluvchi bo'ldi.

en: Such quasi-muscles abounded in the crablike handling-machine which, on my ﬁrst peeping out of the slit, I watched unpacking the cylinder.
uz: O'tkir mashinada shunday deyarli mushaklar ko'p edi, men birinchi marta bo'g'idan chiqib, silindrni to'plashni kuzatganimda.

en: It seemed inﬁnitely more alive than the actual Martians lying beyond it in the sunset light, panting, stirring ineffectual tentacles, and moving feebly after their vast journey across space.
uz: U quyosh botgan nurda uning orqasida yotgan haqiqiy marsiyaliklarga qaraganda cheksiz darajada tirik ko'rinardi, nafas olib, samarasiz tentakellarni harakatlantirib, keng ko'lamli kosmik sayohatlaridan keyin zaif harakatlanardi.

en: While I was still watching their sluggish motions in the sunlight, and not- ing each strange detail of their form, the curate reminded me of his presence by pulling violently at my arm.
uz: Men hali ham quyosh nurida ularning bepul harakatlarini kuzatganimda va ularning shaklidagi har bir g'ayrioddiy tafsilotlarni ko'rmaganimda, ruhoniy qo'limni zo'ravonlik bilan tortib, uning hozirligini eslatdi.

en: I turned to a scowling face, and silent, elo- quent lips.
uz: Oʻzimni qoʻrqinchli yuz va sukutli, soʻzsiz dudaklarga aylantirdim.

en: He wanted the slit, which permitted only one of us to peep through; and so I had to forego watching them for a time while he enjoyed that privilege.
uz: U o'sha bo'lakni xohlagan edi, bu esa faqat bittamizga o'sha bo'lakni ko'rish imkonini berardi; shuning uchun men ularni bir muncha vaqt kuzatib turishdan voz kechishim kerak edi, u esa bu imtiyozdan bahramand bo'lganida.

en: When I looked again, the busy handling-machine had already put togeth- er several of the pieces of apparatus it had taken out of the cylinder into a shape having an unmistakable likeness to its own; and down on the left a busy little digging mechanism had come into view, emitting jets of green vapour and working its way round the pit, excavating and embanking in a methodical and discriminating manner.
uz: Yana bir bor ko'rib chiqsam, mashg'ul harakatlanuvchi mashina silindrdan olib chiqqan bir nechta uskunalarni o'ziga o'xshatadigan shaklga qo'ygan edi; va chap tomonda esa o'z ichiga yashil bug'ning jetslarini chiqarib, chuqurlik atrofida ishlaydigan mashg'ul kichik qazish mexanizmi ko'rindi.

en: This it was which had caused the regular beating noise, and the rhythmic shocks that had kept our ruinous refuge quivering.
uz: Bu odatdagi urish shovqinini va bizning vayron qilinadigan panohimizni titratgan ritmik shoklarni keltirib chiqardi.

en: It piped and whistled as it worked.
uz: Ishlab borayotganda u pipoq va pishirgan.

en: So far as I could see, the thing was without a directing Martian at all.
uz: Ko'rib turganimcha, bu narsa marsiyalik yo'lboshchi yo'q edi.

en: CHAPTER 3 THE DAYS OF IMPRISONMENT The arrival of a second ﬁghting-machine drove us from our peephole into the scullery, for we feared that from his elevation the Martian might see down upon us behind our barrier.
uz: 3 - bob Ikkinchi jang mashinasining kelishi bizni o'z ko'rinishlarimizdan qo'rqitdi, chunki biz uning balandligidan marsiyalik bizni to'siq ortida ko'rib turishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardik.

en: At a later date we began to feel less in danger of their eyes, for to an eye in the dazzle of the sunlight outside our refuge must have been blank blackness, but at ﬁrst the slightest suggestion of approach drove us into the scullery in heart-throbbing retreat.
uz: Keyinchalik biz ularning ko'zlari uchun o'zimizni kamroq xavfli his qila boshladik, chunki bizning panohimiz tashqarisidagi quyosh nurining chiroqlashishi bilan ko'z o'ngida qora qoralik bo'lishi kerak edi, ammo dastlab eng kichik yondashish takliflari bizni yurak urib ketgan orqaga olib kirdi.

en: Yet terrible as was the danger we incurred, the attraction of peeping was for both of us irresistible.
uz: Ammo biz duch kelayotgan xavf qanchalik dahshatli bo'lsa-da, o'zimiz uchun ham qahramonlik qilishning joyi biz uchun chidamsiz edi.

en: And I recall now with a sort of wonder that, in spite of the inﬁ- nite danger in which we were between starvation and a still more terrible death, we could yet struggle bitterly for that horrible privilege of sight.
uz: Va men o'zimni o'zimni hayratda qoldirgan holda eslaymanki, ochlik va yanada dahshatli o'lim o'rtasidagi xavflilikka qaramay, biz ko'rishning dahshatli imtiyozi uchun qattiq kurashishimiz mumkin edi.

en: We would race across the kitchen in a grotesque way between eagerness and the dread of making a noise, and strike each other, and thrust and kick, within a few inches of exposure.
uz: Biz oshxonada g'ayrat va shovqin qilish qo'rquvlari orasidagi g'alati tarzda yugurib, bir-birimizga urib, bir necha santimetr vaqt ichida shovqin va shovqin bilan urib ketardik.

en: The fact is that we had absolutely incompatible dispositions and habits of thought and action, and our danger and isolation only accentuated the in- compatibility.
uz: Darhaqiqat, bizda fikrlash va harakat qilishning mutlaqo mos kelmaydigan xususiyatlari va odatlari bor edi va bizning xavf va izolyatsiyamiz mos kelmaslikni kuchaytirardi.

en: At Halliford I had already come to hate the curate's trick of helpless exclamation, his stupid rigidity of mind.
uz: Halifordda men ruhoniylarning yordamsiz qo'rqinchli so'zlash hiylalaridan, aqli qattiq bo'lgan ahmoqona fikrlaridan nafratlanardim.

en: His endless muttering monologue vitiated every effort I made to think out a line of action, and drove me at times, thus pent up and intensiﬁed, almost to the verge of crazi- ness.
uz: Uning to'xtamaydigan g'iybatli monologim har bir harakatimni o'ylab topishga undadi va ba'zan meni, shu yo'sin tushkunlikka tushib, kuchayib ketadigan, deyarli aqldan ozish chegarasiga yetkazadi.

en: He was as lacking in restraint as a silly woman.
uz: U ahmoq ayol kabi o'zini tuta bilish fazilatidan mahrum edi.

en: He would weep for hours together, and I verily believe that to the very end this spoiled child of life thought his weak tears in some way efﬁcacious.
uz: U bir-biri bilan soatlab yig'lar edi va men o'ylaymanki, oxir-oqibat bu buzg'unchi bola o'zining zaif ko'z yoshlarini qandaydir jihatdan samarali deb hisoblagan.

en: And I would sit in the darkness unable to keep my mind off him by reason of his importunities.
uz: Va men uning g'alatiligi tufayli uning fikrini o'zgartira olmay, qorong'ilikda o'tirardim.

en: He ate more than I did, and it was in vain I pointed out that our only chance of life was to stop in the house until the Martians had done with their pit, that in that long patience a time might presently come when we should need
uz: U mendan ko'proq ovqat yedi va men faqatgina marsiyaliklar o'z quduqlarini tutib bo'lmaguncha, uyda qolish va shu uzoq sabrlilikda kerak bo'lgan vaqt kelishi mumkinligini behuda aytdim.

en: He ate and drank impulsively in heavy meals at long intervals.
uz: U uzoq vaqt davomida og'ir ovqatlarda tez-tez ovqatlanardi va ichardi.

en: As the days wore on, his utter carelessness of any consideration so inten- siﬁed our distress and danger that I had, much as I loathed doing it, to resort to threats, and at last to blows.
uz: Kunlar o'tib borar ekan, uning hech qanday e'tiborga loyiq bo'lmaganligi, bizning tashvishlarimizni va xavf-xatarimizni shunchalik kuchaytirganki, men buni qilishdan nafratlangan bo'lsam ham, tahdidlarga va, nihoyat, hujumlarga qo'l urishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: That brought him to reason for a time.
uz: Bu esa uni bir muncha vaqt fikr yuritishga undagan.

en: But he was one of those weak creatures, void of pride, timorous, anaemic, hate- ful souls, full of shifty cunning, who face neither God nor man, who face not even themselves.
uz: Ammo u o'sha zaif mavjudotlardan biri edi, mag'rurlik yo'q, qo'rqoq, anemik, nafratga to'lgan jonlar, o'zlarining o'zlarini ham ko'rmaydigan, o'zlarini ham ko'rmaydigan, hiyla-nayrang va hiyla-nayrang bilan to'lgan.

en: It is disagreeable for me to recall and write these things, but I set them down that my story may lack nothing.
uz: Men uchun bu narsalarni eslab turish va yozish yoqimsiz, lekin men ularni hikoyamda hech narsa yetishmasligi uchun yozdim.

en: Those who have escaped the dark and terrible aspects of life will ﬁnd my brutality, my ﬂash of rage in our ﬁ- nal tragedy, easy enough to blame; for they know what is wrong as well as any, but not what is possible to tortured men.
uz: Hayotning qorong'i va dahshatli tomonlaridan qochganlar mening shafqatsizligimni, oxirgi fojiamizda g'azabning shovqinimni ayblash osonligini topadilar; chunki ular nima noto'g'ri ekanligini hamma kabi biladilar, ammo azob chekkan odamlarga nima mumkinligini bilmaydilar.

en: But those who have been un- der the shadow, who have gone down at last to elemental things, will have a wider charity.
uz: Ammo soya ostida bo'lganlar, oxir-oqibat elemental narsalarga tushganlar kengroq mehribonlikka ega bo'ladilar.

en: And while within we fought out our dark, dim contest of whispers, snatched food and drink, and gripping hands and blows, without, in the piti- less sunlight of that terrible June, was the strange wonder, the unfamiliar routine of the Martians in the pit.
uz: Va ichimizda biz g'alati, so'zlarning qorong'i musobaqasini o'tkazganimizda, oziq-ovqat va ichimliklarni o'rab olganimizda va qo'l-qo'l tutganimizda va urganimizda, o'sha dahshatli iyunning shafqatsiz quyosh nuri ostida, xudojo'y hayratlanarli va mashhur bo'lmagan marsiyaliklarning chuqurlikdagi mashg'ulotlari bo'lgan.

en: Let me return to those ﬁrst new experi- ences of mine.
uz: O'sha birinchi yangi tajribalarimga qaytishimga ruxsat bering.

en: After a long time I ventured back to the peephole, to ﬁnd that the new-comers had been reinforced by the occupants of no fewer than three of the ﬁghting-machines.
uz: Koʻp vaqt oʻtgach, men oʻsha choʻqqizga qaytib bordim va yangi kelganlar uchta jang mashinalarining oʻrinbosarlari tomonidan qoʻllab-quvvatlanganini koʻrdim.

en: These last had brought with them certain fresh appliances that stood in an orderly manner about the cylinder.
uz: Bularning ikkalasi ham silindr atrofida tartib bilan turadigan yangi uskunalarni olib kelishgan edi.

en: The second handling-machine was now completed, and was busied in serving one of the novel contrivances the big machine had brought.
uz: Ikkinchi ishlov berish mashinasi endi yakunlandi va katta mashinaning yangiliklaridan birini xizmatga taqdim etish bilan band edi.

en: This was a body resembling a milk can in its general form, above which oscillated a pear- shaped receptacle, and from which a stream of white powder ﬂowed into a circular basin below.
uz: Bu umumiy shaklida sut qadoqasiga o'xshaydigan jism edi, uning ustida bir pir shaklidagi idish oscillatsiya qilgan va undan pastdagi aylanma hovuzga oqib oqadigan oq oq toza kukun oqib kelgan.

en: The oscillatory motion was imparted to this by one tentacle of the han- dling-machine.
uz: Oscillatsiya harakatini bu mashinaning bir tentakli orqali o'z ichiga olgan.

en: With two spatulate hands the handling-machine was digging out and ﬂinging masses of clay into the pear-shaped receptacle above, while with another arm it periodically opened a door and removed rusty and blackened clinkers from the middle part of the machine.
uz: Ikki qo'li bilan o'z ustiga tuproqni qazib, katta miqdorda loydan ustundagi pir shakli idishga tashlaydi, boshqa qo'li bilan esa vaqti-vaqti bilan eshikni ochadi va mashinaning o'rta qismidan eskirgan va qoralashgan klinkerlarni olib tashlaydi.

en: Another steely ten- tacle directed the powder from the basin along a ribbed channel towards some receiver that was hidden from me by the mound of bluish dust.
uz: Yana bir po'latli o'n taxtli po'latni hovuzdan bo'lakli kanal bo'ylab, mendan yashirin bo'lgan ko'k rangli changga yo'naltirdi.

en: From this unseen receiver a little thread of green smoke rose vertically into the quiet air.
uz: Ushbu ko'rinmas qabul qiluvchidan yashil tutunning kichkina bo'g'i tinch havoga vertikal ravishda ko'tarildi.

en: As I looked, the handling-machine, with a faint and musical clink-
uz: Men ko'z o'ngimda turganimda, o'yinchi mashinasi sozsiz va musiqiy klink- bilan

en: ing, extended, telescopic fashion, a tentacle that had been a moment before a mere blunt projection, until its end was hidden behind the mound of clay.
uz: Uzoq, teleskopik shaklda o'rnatilgan, bir lahza o'tkazib yuborgan tentakel, uning oxiri loy to'plamining orqasida yashirin bo'lgunga qadar.

en: In another second it had lifted a bar of white aluminium into sight, untar- nished as yet, and shining dazzlingly, and deposited it in a growing stack of bars that stood at the side of the pit.
uz: Boshqa bir soniyada u o'ziga xos, hali o'zgarib qolgan, ko'rinadigan oq alyuminiy barni ko'tarib, uni quduq yonida turgan barlarning ko'payib borayotgan to'plamida joylashtirdi.

en: Between sunset and starlight this dex- terous machine must have made more than a hundred such bars out of the crude clay, and the mound of bluish dust rose steadily until it topped the side of the pit.
uz: Quyosh botish va yulduz yorug'ligi orasidagi vaqtlarda bu ustunlik bilan ishlaydigan mashina xom loydan yuzdan ko'proq shunga o'xshash barlarni yaratgan bo'lishi kerak va ko'k rangli chang to'plami chuqurlikning yon tomoniga yetgunga qadar doimiy ravishda ko'tarilgan.

en: The contrast between the swift and complex movements of these con- trivances and the inert panting clumsiness of their masters was acute, and for days I had to tell myself repeatedly that these latter were indeed the liv- ing of the two things.
uz: Ushbu g'alabalarning tezkor va murakkab harakatlari va o'z xo'jayinlarining g'ayratsiz va bezovta bo'lgan o'tkirliklari o'rtasidagi farq keskin edi va kunlar davomida men o'zimga bu ikkala narsa o'rtasidagi o'zgarish ekanligini qayta-qayta aytishim kerak edi.

en: The curate had possession of the slit when the ﬁrst men were brought to the pit.
uz: Birinchi odamlarni qabrga olib kelganda, o'sha bo'g'inning egasi ruhoniy bo'lgan.

en: I was sitting below, huddled up, listening with all my ears.
uz: Men pastda o'tirib, ko'p o'tirib, hamma quloqlarim bilan tinglagan edim.

en: He made a sudden movement backward, and I, fearful that we were observed, crouched in a spasm of terror.
uz: U to'satdan orqaga qarab harakat qildi va men, bizni kuzatishidan qo'rqqanim uchun, qo'rquvdan qo'zg'aladim.

en: He came sliding down the rubbish and crept beside me in the darkness, inarticulate, gesticulating, and for a moment I shared his panic.
uz: U cho'g'idan pastga o'tib, qorong'ilikda yonimga o'tib keldi, so'zsiz, imo-ishora qilib, bir daqiqaga uning qo'rqinchini o'z zimmamda qo'shdim.

en: His gesture suggested a resignation of the slit, and after a little while my curiosity gave me courage, and I rose up, stepped across him, and clambered up to it.
uz: Uning harakatlari bo'linishdan voz kechishni ko'rsatdi va bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, qiziquvchanligim meni jasoratga to'ldirdi va men o'rnidan turib, uning oldidan qadam bosdim va unga ko'tarildim.

en: At ﬁrst I could see no reason for his frantic be- haviour.
uz: Boshida uning g'alati xulq-atvorining hech qanday sababini ko'rmadim.

en: The twilight had now come, the stars were little and faint, but the pit was illuminated by the ﬂickering green ﬁre that came from the alumini- um-making.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda tong tushdi, yulduzlar kichik va yorqin edi, ammo chuqurlik aluminiy ishlab chiqaruvchidan kelgan yashil olov bilan yorug' bo'ldi.

en: The whole picture was a ﬂickering scheme of green gleams and shifting rusty black shadows, strangely trying to the eyes.
uz: Butun rasm yashil chiroqlar va o'zgaruvchan rangli qora soyalarning chiroyli shakli edi, g'ayrioddiy tarzda ko'zlarga ko'rinadi.

en: Over and through it all went the bats, heeding it not at all.
uz: Bu yerda urib o'tadigan urib o'tlar hech qanday e'tibor bermay ketishdi.

en: The sprawling Martians were no longer to be seen, the mound of blue-green powder had risen to cover them from sight, and a ﬁghting-machine, with its legs contracted, crumpled, and abbreviated, stood across the corner of the pit.
uz: Uzoq bo'lgan marsiyaliklar ko'rinmas edi, ko'rinmas ko'rinishda ularni qoplash uchun ko'k-yashil toz to'plami ko'tarilgan edi va cho'g'ning burchagida oyoqlari qisqartirilgan, bo'g'ib qolgan va qisqartirilgan jang mashinasi turgan edi.

en: And then, amid the clangour of the machinery, came a drifting suspicion of human voices, that I entertained at ﬁrst only to dismiss.
uz: Keyin mashinaning klangurida inson ovozi haqida g'alati gumon paydo bo'ldi, men uni boshida faqat rad etish uchun zavqlantirdim.

en: I crouched, watching this ﬁghting-machine closely, satisfying myself now for the ﬁrst time that the hood did indeed contain a Martian.
uz: Men bu jang mashinasini diqqat bilan kuzatib, o'zimni birinchi marta qondirganmanki, qo'rqinchda marsiyalik bor.

en: As the green ﬂames lifted I could see the oily gleam of his integument and the brightness of his eyes.
uz: Yashil olovlar ko'tarilganida, men uning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yog'li parvarishlarini va ko'zlarining yorqinligini ko'rardim.

en: And suddenly I heard a yell, and saw a long tentacle reaching over the shoulder of the machine to the little cage that hunched upon its back.
uz: Toʻsatdan bir qichqiriq eshitdim va mashinaning yelkasidan mashinaning orqasida oʻtirgan kichik kafesga yetib borayotgan uzoq tentakelni koʻrdim.

en: Then something—something struggling violently—was lifted high against the sky, a black, vague enigma against the starlight; and as this
uz: So'ngra biroz kuchli kurashayotgan bir narsa osmonga yuqoriga ko'tarildi, qora va noaniq ravshanlik yulduz yorug'ligiga qarshi ko'tarildi; va shu tarzda

en: black object came down again, I saw by the green brightness that it was a man.
uz: Yana qora ob'ekt tushdi, men yashil yorug'likdan odam ekanligini ko'rdim.

en: For an instant he was clearly visible.
uz: Bir zum uchun u aniq ko'rinardi.

en: He was a stout, ruddy, middle- aged man, well dressed; three days before, he must have been walking the world, a man of considerable consequence.
uz: U kuchli, qizil, o'rta yoshdagi, yaxshi kiyim kiygan odam edi; uch kun oldin u dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilib yurgan bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: I could see his staring eyes and gleams of light on his studs and watch chain.
uz: Uning ko'zlarini ko'rib turardim va uning qo'llari va soat zanjirida yorug'lik nurlari chiroqlar ko'rinardi.

en: He vanished behind the mound, and for a moment there was silence.
uz: U tog'ning orqasidan yo'qoldi va bir zum tinchlik hukm surdi.

en: And then began a shrieking and a sustained and cheerful hooting from the Martians.
uz: So'ngra xristian olamidagilarning qichqiriqlari va davomli va quvonchli shovqinlari boshlandi.

en: I slid down the rubbish, struggled to my feet, clapped my hands over my ears, and bolted into the scullery.
uz: Chiqindilar pastga surib, oyoqlarimga qarshi kurashdim, qo'llarimni qulog'imga taqillatdim va o'g'limni o'g'irlab, o'g'limni o'g'irlab qo'ydim.

en: The curate, who had been crouching silently with his arms over his head, looked up as I passed, cried out quite loudly at my desertion of him, and came running after me.
uz: O'z qo'llarini boshiga qo'yib, xotirjamlik bilan yonboshlagan ruhoniy men o'tib ketayotganimda ko'zlarini ko'tardi, uni tark etishimga qattiq baqirdi va ortimdan yugurib keldi.

en: That night, as we lurked in the scullery, balanced between our horror and the terrible fascination this peeping had, although I felt an urgent need of action I tried in vain to conceive some plan of escape; but afterwards, dur- ing the second day, I was able to consider our position with great clearness.
uz: O'sha kecha, qo'rqinchimiz va bu qahramonning dahshatli hayratlanuvchisi o'rtasida muvozanatli bo'lganimizda, harakat qilishning shoshilinch ehtiyojini sezganimda, qandaydir qochish rejasini tuzishga befoyda harakat qildim; lekin keyinchalik, ikkinchi kun davomida, o'z nuqtai nazarimizni juda aniq ko'rib chiqishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: The curate, I found, was quite incapable of discussion; this new and culmi- nating atrocity had robbed him of all vestiges of reason or forethought.
uz: O'zim bilganimcha, ruhoniy muzokara qilishga qodir emas edi; bu yangi va o'zboshimchalik bilan sodir bo'lgan yovuzlik uni aql-idrok va oldindan o'ylashga qodir bo'lmagan barcha holatlardan mahrum etgan edi.

en: Practically he had already sunk to the level of an animal.
uz: U deyarli allaqachon hayvon darajasiga ko'tarilgan edi.

en: But as the saying goes, I gripped myself with both hands.
uz: Ammo, masal aytishicha, men o'zimni ikki qo'lim bilan tutdim.

en: It grew upon my mind, once I could face the facts, that terrible as our position was, there was as yet no justiﬁca- tion for absolute despair.
uz: O'ylaymanki, haqiqatlarga duch kelganimda, bizning mavqeyimiz qanchalik dahshatli bo'lsa-da, hozircha mutlaq umidsizlik uchun hech qanday asos yo'q edi.

en: Our chief chance lay in the possibility of the Mar- tians making the pit nothing more than a temporary encampment.
uz: Bizning eng katta imkoniyatimiz shundaki, Martianlar bu quduqni vaqtincha lager qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishdi.

en: Or even if they kept it permanently, they might not consider it necessary to guard it, and a chance of escape might be afforded us.
uz: Yoki uni doimiy ravishda saqlagan bo'lsalar ham, uni himoya qilish kerak deb o'ylamasliklari mumkin va bizga qochish imkoniyati beriladi.

en: I also weighed very carefully the possibility of our digging a way out in a direction away from the pit, but the chances of our emerging within sight of some sentinel ﬁghting-machine seemed at ﬁrst too great.
uz: Shuningdek, chuqurlikdan uzoq bo'lgan yo'nalishda chiqish yo'lini qazish imkoniyatini juda diqqat bilan o'ylab ko'rdim, ammo ba'zi sentinel jang mashinasi ko'rinishida paydo bo'lish imkoniyati dastlab juda katta tuyulgan.

en: And I should have had to do all the digging my- self.
uz: Va men barcha qazishlarni o'zim qilishim kerak edi.

en: The curate would certainly have failed me.
uz: Shubhasiz, ruhoniy meni yo'qotib qo'ygan bo'lardi.

en: It was on the third day, if my memory serves me right, that I saw the lad killed.
uz: Uchinchi kuni, agar xotiram yaxshi bo'lsa, o'g'ilning o'ldirilishini ko'rdim.

en: It was the only occasion on which I actually saw the Martians feed.
uz: Bu men marsiyaliklar ovqatlanishini ko'rgan yagona imkoniyat edi.

en: After that experience I avoided the hole in the wall for the better part of a day.
uz: O'sha tajribadan so'ng, kunning ko'p qismida devordagi teshikdan qochdim.

en: I went into the scullery, removed the door, and spent some hours dig- ging with my hatchet as silently as possible; but when I had made a hole about a couple of feet deep the loose earth collapsed noisily, and I did not dare continue.
uz: Men kulxonaga kirdim, eshikni olib tashladim va bir necha soat davomida o'g'lim bilan iloji boricha sessiz qazdim; lekin bir necha metr chuqurlikdagi cho'g'ni yaratib bo'lgach, bo'sh yer shovqinli tushib ketdi va men davom etishga jur'at qilmadim.

en: I lost heart, and lay down on the scullery ﬂoor for a long time, having no spirit even to move.
uz: Men ko'nglim tushdi va ko'p vaqt davomida ko'ylakzorda yotgan edim, hatto harakatlanishga ham ruhim yo'q edi.

en: And after that I abandoned altogether the idea of escaping by excavation.
uz: Va shundan so'ng men qazish orqali qochib ketish g'oyasidan butunlay voz kechdim.

en: It says much for the impression the Martians had made upon me that at ﬁrst I entertained little or no hope of our escape being brought about by their overthrow through any human effort.
uz: Bu marsiyaliklar menga qo'ygan taassurotni juda ko'p ifodalaydi, chunki boshida men bizning qochishimiz ularning insoniy harakatlar bilan quvib tashlanishi bilan amalga oshishiga umidim yo'q edi.

en: But on the fourth or ﬁfth night I heard a sound like heavy guns.
uz: Ammo to'rt yoki beshinchi kecha men og'ir qurollar tovushini eshitdim.

en: It was very late in the night, and the moon was shining brightly.
uz: Kechasi juda kech edi va oy juda yorqin yorqinlik bilan porlagan edi.

en: The Martians had taken away the excavating-machine, and, save for a ﬁghting- machine that stood in the remoter bank of the pit and a handling-machine that was buried out of my sight in a corner of the pit immediately beneath my peephole, the place was deserted by them.
uz: Marsliklar qazish mashinasini olib ketishgan edi va, quduqning masofada joylashgan jang mashinasini va quduqning bir burchagida mening ko'zimdan o'tmagan bir mashinani qo'yib, ular o'sha joyni tashlab ketishdi.

en: Except for the pale glow from the handling-machine and the bars and patches of white moonlight the pit was in darkness, and, except for the clinking of the handling-machine, quite still.
uz: Xizmat mashinasidan ko'tarilgan sochiq shovqin va oq oy yorug'ligining barlari va maydonlari bundan mustasno bo'lganidan tashqari, chuqurlik qorong'ilikda edi va xizmat mashinasining qichqiriqlaridan tashqari, juda ham susaygan edi.

en: That night was a beautiful serenity; save for one planet, the moon seemed to have the sky to herself.
uz: O'sha kecha go'zal xotirjamlik bo'ldi; bir sayyoradan tashqari, oy osmonni o'zi uchun o'ziga ega bo'lganidek tuyuldi.

en: I heard a dog howling, and that familiar sound it was that made me listen.
uz: Men itning qichqirishini eshitdim va bu tanish tovush meni tinglashga undadi.

en: Then I heard quite distinctly a booming exactly like the sound of great guns.
uz: So'ngra men ajoyib qurollarning ovoziga o'xshaydigan shovqinni aniq eshitdim.

en: Six distinct reports I counted, and after a long interval six again.
uz: Oltita alohida hisobotni sanadim va uzoq intervaldan keyin yana olti.

en: CHAPTER 4 THE DEATH OF THE CURATE It was on the sixth day of our imprisonment that I peeped for the last time, and presently found myself alone.
uz: 4 bob Kuratning o'limi Biz qamoqda bo'lganining oltinchi kunida oxirgi marta o'zimni o'zimning yolg'izligim bilan ko'rdim.

en: Instead of keeping close to me and trying to oust me from the slit, the curate had gone back into the scullery.
uz: Ruhoniy menga yaqinlashib, meni keskinlikdan haydab yuborishning o'rniga, o'sha joyga qaytib ketdi.

en: I was struck by a sudden thought.
uz: Men to'satdan bir fikrga tushib qoldim.

en: I went back quickly and quietly into the scullery.
uz: Men tez va xotirjamlik bilan o'zimni qo'lga kiritdim.

en: In the darkness I heard the curate drinking.
uz: Qorong'ida ruhoniy ichayotganini eshitdim.

en: I snatched in the dark- ness, and my ﬁngers caught a bottle of burgundy.
uz: Men qorong'ilikda o'g'irlab ketdim va barmoqlarim burgundy shishaga tushib qoldi.

en: For a few minutes there was a tussle.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida bahs-munozaralar bo'lib o'tdi.

en: The bottle struck the ﬂoor and broke, and I desisted and rose.
uz: Shisha yerga tushib, parchalanib ketdi, men esa taslim bo'lib, o'sdim.

en: We stood panting and threatening each other.
uz: Biz bir-birimizni qo'rqitib, nafas olib turardik.

en: In the end I planted myself between him and the food, and told him of my determination to begin a discipline.
uz: Oxir-oqibat men o'zimni u bilan ovqat o'rtasida qo'ydim va unga tanbehni boshlash qarorimni aytdim.

en: I divided the food in the pantry, into ra- tions to last us ten days.
uz: Men oshxonadagi oziq-ovqatni o'n kunlik rizq-ro'z qilib bo'ldim.

en: I would not let him eat any more that day.
uz: O'sha kuni uni yana ovqatlanishiga yo'l qo'ymaganman.

en: In the afternoon he made a feeble effort to get at the food.
uz: Tush paytida u ovqatni olish uchun kamroq harakat qildi.

en: I had been dozing, but in an instant I was awake.
uz: Men uxlab yurgan edim, lekin bir daqiqada uyg'onib qoldim.

en: All day and all night we sat face to face, I weary but resolute, and he weeping and complaining of his immediate hunger.
uz: Kun bo'yi va kechasi yuzma-yuz o'tirib turdik, men charchadim, lekin qat'iy qaror qildim, u esa yig'lab, o'zining darhol ochligiga shikoyat qildi.

en: It was, I know, a night and a day, but to me it seemed—it seems now—an in- ter- minable length of time.
uz: Bilaman, bu kechasi va kunduzi edi, lekin men uchun bu endi uzoq vaqtga o'xshaydi.

en: And so our widened incompatibility ended at last in open conﬂict.
uz: Shunday qilib, keng ko'lamdagi kelishmovchiliklarimiz nihoyat ochiq ziddiyatlarga aylandi.

en: For two vast days we struggled in undertones and wrestling contests.
uz: Ikki kun davomida o'zimiz uchun kurash olib bordik.

en: There were times when I beat and kicked him madly, times when I cajoled and persuaded him, and once I tried to bribe him with the last bottle of bur- gundy, for there was a rain-water pump from which I could get water.
uz: Ba'zi paytlar uni g'alati urib urganman, ba'zi paytlar uni qo'ldan urib ishontirganman va bir marta uni so'nggi bir shisha bur-gundi bilan rentib olishga harakat qilganman, chunki men suv olishim mumkin bo'lgan yomg'ir suvli pompa bor edi.

en: But neither force nor kindness availed; he was indeed beyond reason.
uz: Ammo kuch ham, mehribonlik ham foydasi yo'q edi; u, haqiqatan ham, aqldan ozgan edi.

en: He would neither desist from his attacks on the food nor from his noisy babbling to himself.
uz: U oziq-ovqatga hujum qilishdan ham, o'zi uchun shovqinli gapirishdan ham voz kechmasdi.

en: The rudimentary precautions to keep our imprisonment endurable he would not observe.
uz: U qamoqxonamizni chidamli saqlash uchun qo'llaniladigan zaruriy ehtiyot choralarini kuzatib bormaydi.

en: Slowly I began to realise the complete overthrow of his intelligence, to perceive that my sole companion in this close and sickly darkness was a man insane.
uz: Yo'q-yo'q uning aql-idrokini to'liq buzganini anglay boshladim, bu yaqin va kasallik bilan qorong'ilikda mening yagona hamkorim aqldan ozgan odam ekanligini anglab yetdim.

en: From certain vague memories I am inclined to think my own mind wan- dered at times.
uz: Ba'zi noaniq xotiralardan kelib chiqqan holda, ba'zan o'z aql-idrokimni o'zgartirgan deb o'ylayman.

en: I had strange and hideous dreams whenever I slept.
uz: Men uxlaganimda har safar g'alati va dahshatli tushlar ko'rdim.

en: It sounds paradoxical, but I am inclined to think that the weakness and insanity of the curate warned me, braced me, and kept me a sane man.
uz: Bu g'alati tuyuladi, ammo men ruhoniylarning zaifligi va aqlsizliklari meni ogohlantirgan, mustahkamlagan va aqlli odam qilib qo'ygan deb o'ylashga moyilman.

en: On the eighth day he began to talk aloud instead of whispering, and noth- ing I could do would moderate his speech.
uz: Sakkizinchi kuni u pichoqlashning o'rniga baland ovoz bilan gapira boshladi va men qila olmagan narsa uning nutqini o'zgartiradi.

en: It is just, O God! he would say, over and over again.
uz: Ha, Xudoyim! - deb qayta-qayta aytardi u.

en: On me and mine be the punishment laid.
uz: Bu jazo mening va mening zimmamda bo'lsin.

en: We have sinned, we have fallen short.
uz: Biz gunoh qildik, kamchilik qildik.

en: There was poverty, sorrow; the poor were trodden in the dust, and I held my peace.
uz: Kambag'allik, qayg'u bor edi; kambag'allar tuproqga cho'mib ketishgan edi, men esa xotirjam edim.

en: I preached acceptable folly—my God, what folly!—when I should have stood up, though I died for it, and called upon them to repent-repent!
uz: Men qabul qilinadigan aqlsizlikni va'z qildim, ey Xudoyim, naqadar aqlsizlik! - deb aytdim. - Garchi men buning uchun o'lgan bo'lsam-da, turib, ularni tavba-tavba qilishga chaqirgan bo'lar edim.

en: … Oppressors of the poor and needy … !
uz: ... kambag'al va muhtojlarning zulmkorlari ... !

en: The wine press of God! Then he would suddenly revert to the matter of the food I withheld from him, praying, begging, weeping, at last threatening.
uz: Xudoning sharob cho'g'i! - deb so'rab, u mendan olib qo'ygan oziq-ovqat masalasiga to'satdan qaytadi, ibodat qiladi, yolvoradi, yig'laydi va oxir-oqibat qo'rqitadi.

en: He began to raise his voice—I prayed him not to.
uz: U ovozini ko'tarishni boshladi.Men buni qilmaslikka iltijo qildim.

en: He perceived a hold on me—he threatened he would shout and bring the Martians upon us.
uz: U menga qarshi qo'l urganini sezdi va u qichqirib, marsiyaliklarni ustimizga olib kelishi to'g'risida tahdid qildi.

en: For a time that scared me; but any concession would have shortened our chance of escape beyond estimat- ing.
uz: Bir vaqtlar bu meni qo'rqitdi; lekin har qanday qo'shilish qochib ketish imkoniyatimizni o'ylamasdan qisqartirgan bo'lardi.

en: I deﬁed him, although I felt no assurance that he might not do this thing.
uz: Men unga qarshi chiqdim, ammo u bunday ish qilmasligiga ishonch hosil qilmadim.

en: But that day, at any rate, he did not.
uz: Ammo o'sha kuni hech bo'lmaganda, u yo'q edi.

en: He talked with his voice rising slowly, through the greater part of the eighth and ninth days—threats, en- treaties, mingled with a torrent of half-sane and always frothy repentance for his vacant sham of God's service, such as made me pity him.
uz: U saksonchi va to'qqizinchi kunning ko'p qismida tahdidlar, shartnomalar, yarim sog'lom va har doim changli tavbalar oqimi bilan aralashtirilgan Xudoning xizmatidan bo'sh bo'lgan so'zlarini sekin-sekin ko'targan.

en: Then he slept awhile, and began again with renewed strength, so loudly that I must needs make him desist.
uz: Keyin u biroz uxladi va yana o'z kuchini tiklab, shunchalik baland ovoz bilan boshlandiki, uni to'xtatishga majburlashim kerak.

en: Be still! I implored.
uz: Shuningdek bo'ling! - deb iltijo qildim.

en: He rose to his knees, for he had been sitting in the darkness near the copper.
uz: U tiz cho'kkancha o'tirgan, chunki u temirning yonida qorong'ilikda o'tirgan edi.

en: I have been still too long, he said, in a tone that must have reached the pit, and now I must bear my witness.
uz: Men hali ham juda uzoq vaqt o'tdim, dedi u, o'zimni tubsizlikka yetkazgan ton bilan, va endi men guvohlik berishim kerak.

en: Woe unto this unfaithful city!
uz: Ushbu sadoqatsiz shaharga vayl bo'lsin!

en: To the inhabitants of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet—— Shut up! I said, rising to my feet, and in a terror lest the Martians should hear us.
uz: Yer yuzida yashovchilarga karnayning boshqa ovozlari tufayli: O'zingizni tutinglar! - deb aytdim va qo'rquvdan to'xtardim, chunki marsiyaliklar bizni eshitmasliklari mumkin edi.

en: For God's sake—— Nay, shouted the curate, at the top of his voice, standing likewise and extending his arms.
uz: Alloh uchun Yo'q, - deb baqirgan ruhoniy o'z ovozini ko'targan holda xuddi shunday turib, qo'llarini uzatdi.

en: The word of the Lord is upon me! In three strides he was at the door leading into the kitchen.
uz: Rabbimizning so'zi mening zimmamda! - deb so'raganida, u uch qadamdan so'ng oshxonadagi eshik oldida turgan edi.

en: I must bear my witness!
uz: Men o'z guvohligimni bildirishim kerak!

en: It has already been too long delayed.
uz: U allaqachon juda uzoq vaqt kechiktirildi.

en: I put out my hand and felt the meat chopper hanging to the wall.
uz: Qo'limni uzatdim va go'sht chopperining devorga osilganini his qildim.

en: In a ﬂash I was after him.
uz: Bir lahzada men uning orqasidan ergashdim.

en: I was ﬁerce with fear.
uz: Men qo'rquvdan qattiq qo'rqardim.

en: Before he was halfway across the kitchen I had overtaken him.
uz: U oshxonadan o'rta yo'lda bo'lishidan oldin men uni yutib yubordim.

en: With one last touch of humanity I turned the blade back and struck him with the butt.
uz: Oxirgi bir marta insonparvarlik ko'rsatib, men o'qni orqaga burdim va unga o'g'limni urdim.

en: He went headlong forward and lay stretched on the ground.
uz: U boshini ko'targancha oldinga borib, yerga yonboshladi.

en: I stumbled over him and stood panting.
uz: Men uning ustiga tushib, o'zimni qo'zg'atib turdim.

en: Suddenly I heard a noise without, the run and smash of slipping plaster, and the triangular aperture in the wall was darkened.
uz: Toʻsatdan men tashqarida shovqin eshitdim, shovqinli gipsning shovqin va choʻqqisi, devordagi uchburchak ochkoq qorongʻi boʻldi.

en: I looked up and saw the lower surface of a handling-machine coming slowly across the hole.
uz: Men ko'zimni ko'tardim va pastki yuzini ko'rdim, u yerda bir mashinani ushlab turish uchun, to'rka orqali sekin-sekin harakatlanayotganini ko'rdim.

en: One of its gripping limbs curled amid the debris; another limb appeared, feeling its way over the fallen beams.
uz: Uning bir qo'rqinchli a'zolari buzoqlar orasida o'girildi; yana bir a'zo paydo bo'ldi, u tushgan bo'laklar ustida o'z yo'lini sezdi.

en: I stood petriﬁed, staring.
uz: Men toshbo'ron bo'lib, ko'z o'ngimga qarab turardim.

en: Then I saw through a sort of glass plate near the edge of the body the face, as we may call it, and the large dark eyes of a Martian, peering, and then a long metal- lic snake of tentacle came feeling slowly through the hole.
uz: So'ngra, tanasining chegarasi yaqinidagi shisha teshiklaridan yuzni, biz buni shunday deb ataylik, va katta qorong'i ko'zlar bilan ko'rdim, bu yerda ko'z tikib turgan marsiyalik, keyin esa uzun metall-lik tentakelli ilon o'sha teshikdan asta-sekin o'tib keldi.

en: I turned by an effort, stumbled over the curate, and stopped at the scullery door.
uz: Men harakat bilan burib, ruhoniyga yuzma-yuz bo'ldim va o'g'illar do'konining eshigida to'xtadim.

en: The tentacle was now some way, two yards or more, in the room, and twisting and turning, with queer sudden movements, this way and that.
uz: Endi tentakel xonada bir yo'l, ikki metr yoki undan ko'proq bo'lib, bu yo'l va o'sha yo'l bilan o'zgarib-o'zgarib, o'zgarib-o'zgarib turardi.

en: For a while I stood fascinated by that slow, ﬁtful advance.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida men o'sha sekin, fitful oldinga qarab hayratda qoldim.

en: Then, with a faint, hoarse cry, I forced myself across the scullery.
uz: So'ngra o'zimni o'zimga o'zimni o'zimga o'zimni o'zimga o'zimga o'zimni o'zimga o'zimga o'zimga o'zimni o'zimga o'zimga o'zimga o'zimga o'zimga o'zimni o'zimga o'zimga o'xshatdim.

en: I trembled vio- lently; I could scarcely stand upright.
uz: Men juda sekin titrardim, to'g'ri tura olmasdim.

en: I opened the door of the coal cellar, and stood there in the darkness staring at the faintly lit doorway into the kitchen, and listening.
uz: Men ko'mir quti eshigini ochib, qorong'ilikda turganimda, oshxonaga kiradigan yorug' nurli eshikga tikilib, tingladim.

en: Had the Martian seen me?
uz: Marslik meni ko'rganmi?

en: What was it doing now?
uz: Endi u nima qilyapti?

en: Something was moving to and fro there, very quietly; every now and then it tapped against the wall, or started on its movements with a faint metallic ringing, like the movements of keys on a split-ring.
uz: Biror narsa juda sekin o'z-o'zidan harakatlanib borar edi; vaqti-vaqti bilan u devorga taqar edi yoki o'z harakatlarini metal rangli tovush bilan boshladi, xuddi bo'linish bag'ridagi kalitlarning harakatlari kabi.

en: Then a heavy body—I knew too well what—was dragged across the ﬂoor of the kitchen towards the opening.
uz: Keyin bir og'ir jism oshxona yostiga olib ketilganini juda yaxshi bilardim.

en: Irresistibly attracted, I crept to the door and peeped into the kitchen.
uz: O'zimni o'ziga jalb qilib, eshikga kirdim va oshxonada o'zimni ko'rdim.

en: In the triangle of bright outer sunlight I saw the Martian, in its Bri- areus of a handling- machine, scrutinizing the curate's head.
uz: Quyoshning yorug' uchburchakida, men martianni, o'zlarining mashg'ulotlarini boshqarish mashinasining Bri-areusida, kuratning boshini sinchkovlik bilan ko'rib chiqdim.

en: I thought at once that it would infer my presence from the mark of the blow I had given him.
uz: Oʻshanda men oʻzimning hozir boʻlishimni unga bergan urishimning belgisi bilan tugallashim mumkin deb oʻyladim.

en: I crept back to the coal cellar, shut the door, and began to cover myself up as much as I could, and as noiselessly as possible in the darkness, among the ﬁrewood and coal therein.
uz: Men ko'mir sotuviga qaytib kirdim, eshikni yopdim va o'zimni iloji boricha ko'proq va iloji boricha shovqinsiz qorong'ilikda, yonayotgan yog'och va ko'mir orasida yashirishni boshladim.

en: Every now and then I paused, rigid, to hear if the Martian had thrust its tentacles through the opening again.
uz: Vaqt-vaqti bilan men qattiq turardim, agar marsiyalik o'z tentakellarini yana bir bor ochko'zni bosib o'tgan bo'lsa, deb eshitardim.

en: Then the faint metallic jingle returned.
uz: So'ngra yengil metall jingle qaytib keldi.

en: I traced it slowly feeling over the kitchen.
uz: Men buni oshxonada asta-sekin sezganman.

en: Presently I heard it nearer—in the scullery, as I judged.
uz: O'sha paytda men uni, o'zim tasavvur qilganimdek, ko'ylakxonada yaqinroq eshitgan edim.

en: that its length might be insufﬁcient to reach me.
uz: Uning uzunligi menga yetib borishi uchun etarli emas.

en: It passed, scraping faintly across the cellar door.
uz: O'tib o'tdi, chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham

en: An age of almost intolerable suspense intervened; then I heard it fumbling at the latch!
uz: Deyarli chidamsiz suspenssiya davri o'tdi; keyin uni qulfdan qichqirganini eshitdim!

en: It had found the door!
uz: U eshikni topdi!

en: The Martians understood doors!
uz: Marsliklar eshiklarni tushunishgan!

en: It worried at the catch for a minute, perhaps, and then the door opened.
uz: Balki bir daqiqaga o'zidan tashvishlanib, keyin eshik ochildi.

en: In the darkness I could just see the thing—like an elephant's trunk more than anything else—waving towards me and touching and examining the wall, coals, wood and ceiling.
uz: Qorong'ilikda men faqat bir narsani ko'rardim - bu devorni, ko'mirni, yog'ochni va plafonni o'rab olib, tekshirib ko'rardi.

en: It was like a black worm swaying its blind head to and fro.
uz: Bu xuddi qora qurtning ko'r boshini burib-burib yurganidek edi.

en: Once, even, it touched the heel of my boot.
uz: Hatto bir marta u botamning cho'qqisiga ham tegdi.

en: I was on the verge of scream- ing; I bit my hand.
uz: Men qichqirishning chegaralarida edim; qo'limni o'g'irladim.

en: For a time the tentacle was silent.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida tentakel sukut saqlandi.

en: I could have fancied it had been withdrawn.
uz: Men uni olib qo'yilganini tasavvur qilgan bo'lardim.

en: Presently, with an abrupt click, it gripped something— I thought it had me!—and seemed to go out of the cellar again.
uz: O'shanda u to'satdan bosish bilan bir narsani ushlab oldi, men uni ushlab qoldim deb o'yladim va yana piyodadan chiqib ketayotganday tuyuldi.

en: For a minute I was not sure.
uz: Bir daqiqa davomida amin bo'lmadim.

en: Apparently it had taken a lump of coal to examine.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, uni tekshirish uchun ko'mir to'plami kerak bo'lgan.

en: I seized the opportunity of slightly shifting my position, which had be- come cramped, and then listened.
uz: Men fursatdan foydalanib, o'zimni biroz o'zgartirib, o'zimni kamsitgan bo'lsam ham, tingladim.

en: I whispered passionate prayers for safety.
uz: Men o'zimni xavfsiz saqlash uchun g'ayratli ibodatlar so'zlab berdim.

en: Then I heard the slow, deliberate sound creeping towards me again.
uz: So'ngra yana mening tomonimga sekin, qasddan keladigan tovushni eshitdim.

en: Slowly, slowly it drew near, scratching against the walls and tapping the furniture.
uz: Yo'q-yo'q, asta-sekin yaqinlashdi, devorlarga aralashib, mebellarga teshik qo'ydi.

en: While I was still doubtful, it rapped smartly against the cellar door and closed it.
uz: Men hali ham shubha ostiga qo'ygan edim, lekin u chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan ham chindan.

en: I heard it go into the pantry, and the biscuit- tins rattled and a bot- tle smashed, and then came a heavy bump against the cellar door.
uz: Uni oshxonaga kirganini eshitdim, keksa qoshiqlari shov-shuv qilib, botni parchalab yubordi va keyin hovli eshigini qattiq urdi.

en: Then si- lence that passed into an inﬁnity of suspense.
uz: So'ngra o'shandagina suspenssiya bo'lib o'tdi.

en: At last I decided that it had.
uz: Nihoyat, bu borligiga qaror qildim.

en: It came into the scullery no more; but I lay all the tenth day in the close darkness, buried among coals and ﬁrewood, not daring even to crawl out for the drink for which I craved.
uz: U endi kulxonaga kirmadi; lekin men o'ninchi kun davomida qorong'ilikda, ko'mir va yog'och o'rtasida ko'milgan edim, hatto men orzu qilgan ichimlik uchun tashqariga chiqishga ham jur'at qilmadim.

en: It was the eleventh day before I ventured so far from my security.
uz: O'n birinchi kun edi, xavfsizlikdan shunchalik uzoq safarga chiqishimdan oldin.

en: CHAPTER 5 THE STILLNESS My ﬁrst act before I went into the pantry was to fasten the door between the kitchen and the scullery.
uz: 5 - bob STILNESS Oshxonaga kirishdan oldin birinchi harakatim oshxona va oshxona o'rtasidagi eshikni o'rnatishdan iborat edi.

en: But the pantry was empty; every scrap of food had gone.
uz: Ammo oshxona bo'sh edi; oziq-ovqatning har bir toshbaqi yo'q edi.

en: Apparently, the Martian had taken it all on the previous day.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, marsiyalik kishi o'tgan kun hammasini olib ketgan.

en: At that discovery I despaired for the ﬁrst time.
uz: O'sha kashfiyotda men birinchi marta umidsizlikka tushdim.

en: I took no food, or no drink either, on the eleventh or the twelfth day.
uz: Men o'n bir yoki o'n ikkinchi kun hech qanday ovqat yemaganman va ichmaganman.

en: At ﬁrst my mouth and throat were parched, and my strength ebbed sensi- bly.
uz: Boshida og'zim va qo'lim quruq qoldi va kuchim susayib ketdi.

en: I sat about in the darkness of the scullery, in a state of despondent wretchedness.
uz: Men o'zimni qorong'ilikda, tushkunlikka tushib o'tirib qoldim.

en: My mind ran on eating.
uz: Mening ongim ovqatlanishga to'g'ri keldi.

en: I thought I had become deaf, for the noises of movement I had been accustomed to hear from the pit had ceased absolutely.
uz: O'zimni kar bo'lib qolganimni o'ylardim, chunki chuqurlikdan eshitadigan harakat tovushlari to'liq to'xtadi.

en: I did not feel strong enough to crawl noiselessly to the peephole, or I would have gone there.
uz: Men o'zimni o'zimni o'zimga kuchli his qilmayapman, chunki o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab, o'zimni o'zimga o'xshab qolaman.

en: On the twelfth day my throat was so painful that, taking the chance of alarming the Martians, I attacked the creaking rain-water pump that stood by the sink, and got a couple of glassfuls of blackened and tainted rain wa- ter.
uz: O'n ikkinchi kuni bo'yni shunchalik og'riqli bo'ldiki, marsiyaliklarni qo'rqitish imkoniyatidan foydalanib, sinamning yonida turgan shovqinli yomg'ir suvi pompasiga hujum qildim va bir necha stakan qora va qorong'u yomg'ir yog'dirdim.

en: I was greatly refreshed by this, and emboldened by the fact that no en- quiring tentacle followed the noise of my pumping.
uz: Bu menga juda tasalli berdi va hech qanday kuchsiz tentakel mening pompalash tovushimning shovqinini kuzatib bormaganidan quvonch topdim.

en: During these days, in a rambling, inconclusive way, I thought much of the curate and of the manner of his death.
uz: O'sha kunlar davomida men o'zimning ruhoniy va uning o'lim usuli haqida ko'p o'yladim.

en: On the thirteenth day I drank some more water, and dozed and thought disjointedly of eating and of vague impossible plans of escape.
uz: O'n uchinchi kuni men yana suv ichdim, uxlab ketdim va ovqatlanish va imkonsiz qochish rejalarini o'yladim.

en: Whenever I dozed I dreamt of horrible phantasms, of the death of the curate, or of sumptuous dinners; but, asleep or awake, I felt a keen pain that urged me to drink again and again.
uz: Har qachon uxlaganimda, dahshatli fantasmalar, ruhoniy o'limi yoki hashamatli kechki ovqatlar haqida orzu qilardim; lekin uxlab yoki uyg'onib, men qattiq og'riq his qilardim va uni qayta-qayta ichishga undardim.

en: The light that came into the scullery was no longer grey, but red.
uz: Skelleryga kirgan nur endi sariq emas, balki qizil edi.

en: To my disordered imagination it seemed the colour of blood.
uz: Mening tartibsiz tasavvurim uchun u qon rangida ko'rinardi.

en: On the fourteenth day I went into the kitchen, and I was surprised to ﬁnd that the fronds of the red weed had grown right across the hole in the wall, turning the half-light of the place into a crimson- coloured obscurity.
uz: O'n to'rtinchi kuni men oshxonada bo'lganimda, qizil o'tning barglari devordagi cho'qqizdan o'sib chiqib, o'sha joyning yarim yorug'ligini qizil rangli qorong'ilikka aylantirganini ko'rib hayron qoldim.

en: It was early on the ﬁfteenth day that I heard a curious, familiar sequence of sounds in the kitchen, and, listening, identiﬁed it as the snufﬁng and scratching of a dog.
uz: O'n beshinchi kuni ertalab men oshxonada g'alati, tanish tovushlarni eshitdim va tinglaganimda, uni itning qichqirish va qichqirishini aniqladim.

en: Going into the kitchen, I saw a dog's nose peering in through a break among the ruddy fronds.
uz: Oshxonaga kirganimda, qizil barglar o'rtasida bo'lgan bo'shliq orqali itning burunini ko'rdim.

en: This greatly surprised me.
uz: Bu meni juda hayratda qoldirdi.

en: At the scent of me he barked shortly.
uz: Mening hidimni ko'rib, u qisqa vaqt ichida qichqirdi.

en: I thought if I could induce him to come into the place quietly I should be able, perhaps, to kill and eat him; and in any case, it would be advisable to kill him, lest his actions attracted the attention of the Martians.
uz: O'yladimki, agar uni xotirjamlik bilan joyga olib kelishim mumkin bo'lsa, ehtimol uni o'ldirib yeb bo'lishim mumkin; hech bo'lmaganda uni o'ldirish tavsiya etiladi, chunki uning harakatlari marsiyaliklarning e'tiborini jalb qilmaydi.

en: I crept forward, saying Good dog! very softly; but he suddenly with- drew his head and disappeared.
uz: Men Yaxshi it! deb o'yladim, lekin u to'satdan boshini tortdi va yo'q bo'ldi.

en: I listened—I was not deaf—but certainly the pit was still.
uz: Men quloq solgan edim.Men kar emas edim, lekin albatta, chuqur o'rinsiz edi.

en: I heard a sound like the ﬂutter of a bird's wings, and a hoarse croaking, but that was all.
uz: Men qushning qanotlari qichqirishidan va qichqiriqidan o'xshash bir ovozni eshitdim, ammo bu hammasi edi.

en: For a long while I lay close to the peephole, but not daring to move aside the red plants that obscured it.
uz: Ko'p vaqt davomida men ko'z cho'g'iga yaqin o'tirdim, lekin uni yashirgan qizil o'simliklarni chetga surishga jur'at qilmadim.

en: Once or twice I heard a faint pitter-patter like the feet of the dog going hither and thither on the sand far below me, and there were more birdlike sounds, but that was all.
uz: Bir-ikki marta mendan pastki qumda itning oyoqlari kabi salqin qichqiriqlarni eshitdim va qushlarga o'xshaydigan tovushlar ko'proq edi, ammo bu hammasi edi.

en: At length, encouraged by the silence, I looked out.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, sessizlikdan dalda olgach, men tashqariga qaradim.

en: Except in the corner, where a multitude of crows hopped and fought over the skeletons of the dead the Martians had consumed, there was not a living thing in the pit.
uz: Qo'rqoqlarning ko'pchiligi o'liklarning kostyumlari uchun qochib uringan burchadan tashqari, chuqurlikda hech qanday tirik mavjudot yo'q edi.

en: I stared about me, scarcely believing my eyes.
uz: Men o'zimga qarab turdim, ko'zlarimga ishonmayapman.

en: All the machinery had gone.
uz: Barcha uskunalar yo'q edi.

en: Save for the big mound of greyish-blue powder in one corner, certain bars of aluminium in another, the black birds, and the skeletons of the killed, the place was merely an empty circular pit in the sand.
uz: Bir burchada bo'lgan katta bo'lak-boshqash toz, boshqa burchada aluminiy barlar, qora qushlar va o'ldirilganlarning kostyumlaridan tashqari, bu joy qumda bo'lgan bo'lak-bo'lak bo'lib qolgan.

en: Slowly I thrust myself out through the red weed, and stood upon the mound of rubble.
uz: Yo'q-yo'q o'zimni qizil begona o't o'rtasida sudrab, buzoqqa to'lib-toshgan joyga qo'ydim.

en: I could see in any direction save behind me, to the north, and neither Martians nor sign of Martians were to be seen.
uz: Men orqamdan, shimoliy tomondan boshqa har qanday yo'nalishda ko'rardim va marsiyaliklar ham, marsiyaliklar ham ko'rinmas edi.

en: The pit dropped sheerly from my feet, but a little way along the rubbish afforded a practica- ble slope to the summit of the ruins.
uz: Yovuzlik oyoqlarimdan tushib ketdi, ammo cho'g'lar bo'ylab bir oz yo'l yurib, bu yerlarning zirvalariga yo'l ochdi.

en: My chance of escape had come.
uz: Qutish imkoniyatim keldi.

en: I be- gan to tremble.
uz: Men titrashim kerak.

en: I hesitated for some time, and then, in a gust of desperate resolution, and with a heart that throbbed violently, I scrambled to the top of the mound in which I had been buried so long.
