uz: Bir muncha vaqt tortinib turdim, so'ngra umidsiz qarorga tushib, qattiq urib ketgan yuragim bilan uzoq vaqtdan beri ko'milgan ko'mning yuqoriga yugurdim.

en: I looked about again.
uz: Men yana atrofga qarab ko'rdim.

en: To the northward, too, no Martian was visible.
uz: Shimoliy tomondan ham hech bir martian ko'rinmas edi.

en: When I had last seen this part of Sheen in the daylight it had been a strag- gling street of comfortable white and red houses, interspersed with abun- dant shady trees.
uz: Sheenning ushbu qismini kun yorug'ligida oxirgi marta ko'rganimda, u qulay oq va qizil uylar bilan o'ralgan ko'cha edi.

en: Now I stood on a mound of smashed brickwork, clay, and
uz: Endi men toshbo'ronlangan toshbo'y, loy va toshbo'y toshlar to'plami ustida turardim.

en: gravel, over which spread a multitude of red cactus-shaped plants, knee- high, without a solitary terrestrial growth to dispute their footing.
uz: Qirg'iz, uning ustida ko'pgina qizil kaktus shaklidagi o'simliklar, tiz cho'kgan, yer yuzidagi o'sishsiz o'simliklar o'sib boradi.

en: The trees near me were dead and brown, but further a network of red thread scaled the still living stems.
uz: Mening yonimdagi daraxtlar o'lik va qora rangli edi, ammo yana qizil iplar tarmog'i hali ham tirik bo'lgan novdalarni ko'tardi.

en: The neighbouring houses had all been wrecked, but none had been burned; their walls stood, sometimes to the second story, with smashed win- dows and shattered doors.
uz: Qo'shni uylarning barchasi vayron bo'lgan, ammo hech biri yonmagan; ularning devorlari, ba'zan ikkinchi qavatgacha bo'lgan, buzilgan do'konlar va buzilgan eshiklar bilan to'g'ri turgan edi.

en: The red weed grew tumultuously in their rooﬂess rooms.
uz: Qizil begona o'tlar ularning xonadonsiz xonalarida g'alati o'sdi.

en: Below me was the great pit, with the crows struggling for its refuse.
uz: Mening pastligimda katta chuqurlik bor edi, qo'ylar uning chiqindilari uchun kurashayotgan edi.

en: A number of other birds hopped about among the ruins.
uz: Boshqa bir qator qushlar buzarliklar orasida o'tib o'tdilar.

en: Far away I saw a gaunt cat slink crouchingly along a wall, but traces of men there were none.
uz: Uzoqlikda men devor bo'ylab ko'z o'g'irlab yurgan g'alati mushukni ko'rdim, lekin erkaklarning izlari yo'q edi.

en: The day seemed, by contrast with my recent conﬁnement, dazzlingly bright, the sky a glowing blue.
uz: O'sha kun, so'nggi qamoqxonamdan farqli o'laroq, juda yorqin ko'rinardi, osmon chiroyli ko'k ko'rinardi.

en: A gentle breeze kept the red weed that cov- ered every scrap of unoccupied ground gently swaying.
uz: Yumshoq shamol har bir maydonni qoplagan qizil begona o'tni yengillik bilan aylantirib turardi.

en: the sweet- ness of the air!
uz: Havoning shirinligi!

en: CHAPTER 6 THE WORK OF FIFTEEN DAYS For some time I stood tottering on the mound regardless of my safety.
uz: 6 - bob O'n besh kunlik ish uchun bir muncha vaqt davomida men xavfsizlikka qaramay, to'rtaga titrab turardim.

en: With- in that noisome den from which I had emerged I had thought with a narrow intensity only of our immediate security.
uz: O'zim chiqqan bu shov-shuvli chuqurlikda faqat bizning xavfsizligimizni o'yladim.

en: I had not realised what had been happening to the world, had not anticipated this startling vision of unfamil- iar things.
uz: Dunyoga nimalar yuz berayotganini tushunmagan edim, oilaga tegishli bo'lmagan narsalarning bu dahshatli ko'rinishini kutib o'tirmagan edim.

en: I had expected to see Sheen in ruins—I found about me the land- scape, weird and lurid, of another planet.
uz: Men Sheenni vayron bo'lgan joyda ko'rishni kutgan edim.O'zim atrofimda boshqa sayyoradagi g'ayritabiiy va dahshatli landshaftni topdim.

en: For that moment I touched an emotion beyond the common range of men, yet one that the poor brutes we dominate know only too well.
uz: O'sha paytda men odamlarning umumiy doirasidan tashqarida bo'lgan, ammo biz hukmronlik qilayotgan kambag'al hayvonlar juda yaxshi biladigan tuyg'ularga qo'l urdim.

en: I felt as a rabbit might feel returning to his burrow and suddenly confronted by the work of a dozen busy navvies digging the foundations of a house.
uz: O'zimni tovuq o'z qo'rg'osiga qaytib borayotganini his qilganimdek his qildim va to'satdan uy asoslarini qazayotgan o'nlab bemorlarning ishi bilan yuzma-yuz bo'ldim.

en: I felt the ﬁrst inkling of a thing that presently grew quite clear in my mind, that op- pressed me for many days, a sense of dethronement, a persuasion that I was no longer a master, but an animal among the animals, under the Martian heel.
uz: O'zimni ko'p kunlar davomida bosim o'tkazgan, taxtdan o'tish hissi, men endi xo'jayin emasman, balki hayvonlar orasidagi hayvonman, deb o'ylayman.

en: With us it would be as with them, to lurk and watch, to run and hide; the fear and empire of man had passed away.
uz: Biz bilan ham xuddi ular bilan o'xshash bo'ladi: yashirin va kuzatuv, yugurish va yashirish; insonning qo'rquvi va imperiyasi o'tib ketdi.

en: But so soon as this strangeness had been realised it passed, and my domi- nant motive became the hunger of my long and dismal fast.
uz: Ammo bu g'ayritabiiylik tushunilganidan so'ng, u o'tib ketdi va mening asosiy maqsadim uzoq va dahshatli ro'za tutishimga aylandi.

en: In the direction away from the pit I saw, beyond a red-covered wall, a patch of garden ground unburied.
uz: O'sha chuqurlikdan uzoq yo'nalishda men qizil qoplangan devor ortidan ko'rardim, bog'dagi yerning bir qismi ko'milgan emas.

en: This gave me a hint, and I went knee- deep, and some- times neck-deep, in the red weed.
uz: Bu menga ishora qildi va men qizil o'tga tiz cho'kib, ba'zida bo'yniga cho'kib tushdim.

en: The density of the weed gave me a reas- suring sense of hiding.
uz: O'tlarning zichligi menga yashirinish hissi bilan ta'sir qildi.

en: The wall was some six feet high, and when I at- tempted to clamber it I found I could not lift my feet to the crest.
uz: Devorning balandligi taxminan olti fut edi va uni ko'tarib borishga moyil bo'lganimda, oyoqlarimni ko'tarishga ojiz qoldim.

en: So I went along by the side of it, and came to a corner and a rockwork that enabled me to get to the top, and tumble into the garden I coveted.
uz: Shunday qilib, men uning yonidan o'tib, bir burchakga va toshga yetib keldim, bu menga to'qqa chiqishga va orzu qilgan bog'imga tushishga imkon berdi.

en: Here I found some young onions, a couple of gladiolus bulbs, and a quantity of immature carrots, all of which I secured, and, scrambling over a ruined wall, went on my way through scarlet and crimson trees towards Kew—it was like walk-
uz: Bu yerda yosh soya, bir nechta gladiolus bulblari va bir nechta yetmagan karotlarni topdim, bularning barchasini o'zimga topshirdim va vayron bo'lgan devorni bosib o'tib, qizil va karmon daraxtlari orqali Kewit tomon yo'l tutdim.

en: ing through an avenue of gigantic blood drops—possessed with two ideas: to get more food, and to limp, as soon and as far as my strength permitted, out of this accursed unearthly region of the pit.
uz: Ikki g'oyaga ega bo'lgan ulkan qon tomchilariga o'tish: ko'proq oziq-ovqat olish va kuchim imkon qadar tezroq va uzoqroq bo'lsa ham, chuqurlikning bu la'natlangan yersiz hududidan chiqib ketish.

en: Some way farther, in a grassy place, was a group of mushrooms which also I devoured, and then I came upon a brown sheet of ﬂowing shallow water, where meadows used to be.
uz: Uzoqroq, o'tli joyda, men ham yegan bir guruh qo'ziqorinlar bor edi, keyin esa o'tkir suvning ko'k rangli varaqasini ko'rdim.

en: These fragments of nourishment served only to whet my hunger.
uz: Ushbu oziq-ovqat parchalari faqat ochligimni uyg'otishga xizmat qildi.

en: At ﬁrst I was surprised at this ﬂood in a hot, dry summer, but afterwards I discovered that it was caused by the tropical exu- berance of the red weed.
uz: Boshida men issiq, quruq yozda bu to'lqinni ko'rib hayron qoldim, lekin keyinchalik u qizil o'tlarning tropik o'simliklari tufayli yuz berganini payqadim.

en: Directly this extraordinary growth encountered water it straightway became gigantic and of unparalleled fecundity.
uz: Shu bilan birga, bu ajoyib o'sish suvga duch kelganida, u darhol ulkan va o'zgacha urug'lik hosilga ega bo'ldi.

en: Its seeds were simply poured down into the water of the Wey and Thames, and its swiftly growing and Titanic water fronds speedily choked both those rivers.
uz: Uning urug'lari shunchaki Wey va Temza suvlariga to'kilib, uning tez o'sib borayotgan va Titaniq suv barglari o'sha ikki daryoni tezda cho'ktirdi.

en: At Putney, as I afterwards saw, the bridge was almost lost in a tangle of this weed, and at Richmond, too, the Thames water poured in a broad and shallow stream across the meadows of Hampton and Twickenham.
uz: Keyinchalik ko'rganimcha, Putneyda ko'prik bu o'tlarning to'plamida deyarli yo'qolgan edi va Richmondda ham Temz suvi Hampton va Twickenham o'lchovlari bo'ylab keng va chuqur oqib o'tgan.

en: As the water spread the weed followed them, until the ruined villas of the Thames valley were for a time lost in this red swamp, whose margin I explored, and much of the desolation the Martians had caused was concealed.
uz: Suv tarqalganda, o'tlar ularning orqasidan ergashib, Temis vodiysining vayron bo'lgan villaslari men tadqiq qilgan qizil maydonchada biroz yo'qolgan va marsiyaliklar keltirib chiqargan zararning ko'p qismi yashirilgan.

en: In the end the red weed succumbed almost as quickly as it had spread.
uz: Oxir-oqibat, qizil begona o'tlar tarqalganida deyarli xuddi shunday tezda halok bo'ldi.

en: A cankering disease, due, it is believed, to the action of certain bacteria, pres- ently seized upon it.
uz: Ehtimol, bu kasallik ba'zi bakteriyalarning harakatidan kelib chiqqan bo'lib, bu kasallikka tushib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Now by the action of natural selection, all terrestrial plants have acquired a resisting power against bacterial diseases—they nev- er succumb without a severe struggle, but the red weed rotted like a thing already dead.
uz: Endi tabiiy tanlab olish tufayli barcha yerdagi o'simliklar bakteriya kasalliklariga qarshi chidamli kuchga ega bo'lishgan, ular qattiq kurashsiz o'lishgan, ammo qizil begona o'tlar allaqachon o'lgan narsa kabi buzib ketgan.

en: The fronds became bleached, and then shrivelled and brittle.
uz: Bog'lar oqib, keyin esa qisqartirildi va buzg'unchilikka uchradi.

en: They broke off at the least touch, and the waters that had stimulated their early growth carried their last vestiges out to sea.
uz: Ular kamroq ta'sirda bo'lib ketishdi va ularning ilk o'sishini rag'batlantirgan suvlar o'zlarining oxirgi qoldiqlarini dengizga olib chiqishdi.

en: My ﬁrst act on coming to this water was, of course, to slake my thirst.
uz: Bu suvga kelganimda birinchi bo'lib, albatta, chanqog'imni yumshatish uchun harakat qildim.

en: I drank a great deal of it and, moved by an impulse, gnawed some fronds of red weed; but they were watery, and had a sickly, metallic taste.
uz: Men ko'p ichdim va bir ilhom bilan qizil o't barglarini yirtdim; lekin ular suvli edi va kasal, metall ta'miniga ega edi.

en: I found the water was sufﬁciently shallow for me to wade securely, although the red weed impeded my feet a little; but the ﬂood evidently got deeper towards the river, and I turned back to Mortlake.
uz: Men suvni o'zimni xavfsiz yo'ldan ozdiradigan darajada past deb topdim, garchi qizil o't oyog'im uchun biroz to'siq bo'lsa-da; lekin suv daryo tomon chuqurroq bo'lganidan so'ng, Mortlakega qaytib bordim.

en: I managed to make out the road by means of occasional ruins of its villas and fences and lamps, and so pres- ently I got out of this spate and made my way to the hill going up towards Roehampton and came out on Putney Common.
uz: Yo'lni vaqti-vaqti bilan uning villalari, to'siqlari va chiroqlari vayron bo'lgan joylar yordamida aniqlashga muvaffaq bo'ldim va shu sababli tez orada bu to'lqindan chiqib, Roehampton tomon ko'tarilgan tepalikka bordim va Putney Commonda chiqdim.

en: Here the scenery changed from the strange and unfamiliar to the wreck- age of the familiar: patches of ground exhibited the devastation of a cy- clone, and in a few score yards I would come upon perfectly undisturbed spaces, houses with their blinds trimly drawn and doors closed, as if they had been left for a day by the owners, or as if their inhabitants slept within.
uz: Bu yerda manzara g'ayrioddiy va noma'lumdan tanishning vayron bo'lgan davrini o'zgartirdi: yer maydonlari siklonning halokatini ko'rsatdi va bir necha metr ichida men to'liq xalos bo'lgan joylarga, choriqlari chiroyli bo'lib, eshiklari yopilgan uylarga duch keldim, xuddi uy egalari tomonidan bir kun uchun qoldirilgan bo'lsa yoki uyda yashovchilar uxlagan bo'lsa kerak.

en: The red weed was less abundant; the tall trees along the lane were free from the red creeper.
uz: Qizil begona o'tlar kamroq bo'lgan; yo'l bo'yidagi baland daraxtlar qizil o'tlardan ozod edi.

en: I hunted for food among the trees, ﬁnding nothing, and I also raided a couple of silent houses, but they had already been broken into and ransacked.
uz: O'simliklar orasida oziq-ovqat qidirib topdim, lekin hech narsa topmadim, bir necha xotirjam uylarga ham bostirib kirdim, lekin ular allaqachon talon-toroj qilingan edi.

en: I rested for the remainder of the daylight in a shrubbery, be- ing, in my enfeebled condition, too fatigued to push on.
uz: Kun yorug'ligi davomida o'zimni zaif holatda, ko'p charchagan holda, ko'p o'tmay daraxtzorda dam oldim.

en: All this time I saw no human beings, and no signs of the Martians.
uz: Bu vaqt davomida hech qanday insonni va marsiyaliklarning izlarini ko'rmadim.

en: I en- countered a couple of hungry-looking dogs, but both hurried circuitously away from the advances I made them.
uz: Men bir necha och ko'rinadigan itlarga duch keldim, lekin ikkalasi ham men ularga yetkazgan yutuqlardan tezda uzoqlashdilar.

en: Near Roehampton I had seen two hu- man skeletons—not bodies, but skeletons, picked clean—and in the wood by me I found the crushed and scattered bones of several cats and rabbits and the skull of a sheep.
uz: Roehampton yaqinida men ikki inson skeletini ko'rdim - jasadlar emas, balki jasadlar, ularni tozalab oldim va o'rmonda bir nechta mushuk va qushlarning parchalangan va tarqalgan suyaklarini va qo'y qalqonini topdim.

en: But though I gnawed parts of these in my mouth, there was nothing to be got from them.
uz: Ammo bularning bir qismini og'zimga teshganimda ham, ulardan hech narsa olinmadi.

en: After sunset I struggled on along the road towards Putney, where I think the Heat-Ray must have been used for some reason.
uz: Quyosh botgandan so'ng men Putney yo'liga borayotgan yo'l bo'ylab kurashdim, u erda men o'ylaymanki, biron sababga ko'ra issiqlik nuridan foydalanilgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: And in the garden be- yond Roehampton I got a quantity of immature potatoes, sufﬁcient to stay my hunger.
uz: Va Roehampton atrofidagi bog'da men o'zimning ochligimni to'xtatish uchun yetarlicha ko'p o'simlik kartoshkalarni oldim.

en: From this garden one looked down upon Putney and the river.
uz: Ushbu bog'dan Putney va daryoga qarab turish mumkin.

en: The aspect of the place in the dusk was singularly desolate: blackened trees, blackened, desolate ruins, and down the hill the sheets of the ﬂooded river, red-tinged with the weed.
uz: Yashash paytida joyning ko'rinishi o'zgacha bo'lak edi: qoralab ketgan daraxtlar, qoralab ketgan, cho'qolgan vayronliklar va toshbo'ron bo'lgan daryo sahifalari toshbo'ron bo'lib, toshbo'ron bo'lib ketgan.

en: And over all—silence.
uz: Va butun xotirjamlik ustidan.

en: It ﬁlled me with indescrib- able terror to think how swiftly that desolating change had come.
uz: O'sha dahshatli o'zgarish qanchalik tez sodir bo'lganini o'ylash meni dahshatga tushirdi.

en: For a time I believed that mankind had been swept out of existence, and that I stood there alone, the last man left alive.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida men insoniyat yo'q qilinganligiga ishonardim va men o'zim, tirik qolgan oxirgi odam o'sha yerda yolg'iz qoldim.

en: Hard by the top of Putney Hill I came upon another skeleton, with the arms dislocated and removed several yards from the rest of the body.
uz: Putney Hillning yuqori qismida qattiq bo'lganimda, qo'llari bo'shatilgan boshqa bir kostyumga tushib qoldim va u boshqa tana qismidan bir necha metr uzoqroq edi.

en: As I proceeded I became more and more convinced that the extermination of mankind was, save for such strag- glers as myself, already accomplished in this part of the world.
uz: O'shanda odamzodni yo'q qilish, o'zim kabi jangchilar bundan mustasno, dunyoning bu qismida amalga oshirilganligiga yanada ko'proq amin bo'ldim.

en: The Mar- tians, I thought, had gone on and left the country desolated, seeking food elsewhere.
uz: Men o'yladimki, martianlar boshqa joyda oziq-ovqat izlab, mamlakatni tashlab ketishdi.

en: Perhaps even now they were destroying Berlin or Paris, or it might be they had gone northward.
uz: Ehtimol, ular hozirda ham Berlin yoki Parijni yo'q qilmoqchi bo'lishgan, yoki shimoliy tomonga borishgan.

en: CHAPTER 7 THE MAN ON PUTNEY HILL I spent that night in the inn that stands at the top of Putney Hill, sleeping in a made bed for the ﬁrst time since my ﬂight to Leatherhead.
uz: 7 - bob Putney Hilldagi odam Men o'sha kecha Putney Hillning yuqorida joylashgan mehmonxonada o'tkazdim va birinchi marta Leatherheadga parvoz qilganimdan so'ng tayyorlangan yotoqda uxladim.

en: I will not tell the needless trouble I had breaking into that house—afterwards I found the front door was on the latch—nor how I ransacked every room for food, un- til just on the verge of despair, in what seemed to me to be a servant's bed- room, I found a rat-gnawed crust and two tins of pineapple.
uz: O'sha uyga kirganim uchun keraksiz qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganimni aytib bermayman.Shundan so'ng esa, oldingi eshik qulflab qo'yilganini va har bir xonani oziq-ovqat uchun to'planganimni ko'rdim, lekin umidsizlik chegarasida bo'lganimda, menga xizmatkorning yotoqxonasi kabi ko'rinadigan joyda tovuq-g'aynoz qo'rg'asi va ikkita qadoq ananasni topdim.

en: The place had been already searched and emptied.
uz: Bu joy allaqachon qidirib topilgan va bo'shatilgan edi.

en: In the bar I afterwards found some bis- cuits and sandwiches that had been overlooked.
uz: Keyinroq men barda ko'pchilik uncha ko'rmagan kek va sendvichlarni topdim.

en: The latter I could not eat, they were too rotten, but the former not only stayed my hunger, but ﬁlled my pockets.
uz: Ikkinchisi men yemayman, ular juda yomon edi, lekin ikkinchisi nafaqat ochligimni saqlab qoldi, balki kiyimimni to'ldirdi.

en: I lit no lamps, fearing some Martian might come beating that part of London for food in the night.
uz: Men hech qanday chiroq yoqtirmadim, chunki kechasi ovqat uchun Londonning o'sha qismini urib yuborishi mumkin bo'lgan marsiyaliklardan qo'rqardim.

en: Before I went to bed I had an interval of restlessness, and prowled from window to window, peering out for some sign of these monsters.
uz: Yotoqdan oldin biroz bezovta bo'lib, derazalardan-doracha o'tirib, bu qudratli hayvonlarning ko'rinishini qidirardim.

en: As I lay in bed I found myself thinking consecutively— a thing I do not remember to have done since my last argu- ment with the curate.
uz: Yotoqda yotganimda, o'zimni bir-biri bilan uzluksiz o'ylayotgan holda ko'rdim - bu pastir bilan so'nggi bahsimdan beri qilgan ishimni eslay olmayman.

en: During all the intervening time my mental condition had been a hurrying succession of vague emotional states or a sort of stupid receptivity.
uz: O'sha vaqt davomida mening ruhiy holatim g'alati hissiy holatlarning shoshilinch ketma-ketligi yoki o'zgacha ahmoqona qabul qilishchanlik bo'lgan.

en: But in the night my brain, reinforced, I suppose, by the food I had eaten, grew clear again, and I thought.
uz: Ammo kechasi miyam, ovqatlanish bilan mustahkamlangan bo'lsa kerak, yana aniqlandi va men o'yladim.

en: Three things struggled for possession of my mind: the killing of the cu- rate, the whereabouts of the Martians, and the possible fate of my wife.
uz: Mening ongimga ega bo'lish uchun uchta narsa kurashdi: qu-rate o'ldirilishi, marsiyaliklar qaerda bo'lganligi va xotinimning ehtimoldan yiroq bo'lmagan taqdir.

en: The former gave me no sensation of horror or remorse to recall; I saw it simply as a thing done, a memory inﬁnitely disagreeable but quite without the qual- ity of remorse.
uz: Ilkgilar menga eslab qolish uchun dahshat yoki pushaymonlik hissi bermadi; men buni shunchaki bajarilgan narsa, cheksiz noqulay, ammo pushaymonlik hissi yo'q xotira sifatida ko'rdim.

en: I saw myself then as I see myself now, driven step by step towards that hasty blow, the creature of a sequence of accidents leading in- evitably to that.
uz: O'shanda o'zimni hozirgi o'zim kabi ko'rdim, bu shoshilinch urishga qadam bosib boraman, bu voqealar ketma-ketligiga olib boradigan avariyalar xurujidir.

en: I felt no condemnation; yet the memory, static, unprogres- sive, haunted me.
uz: Men hech qanday hukmni his qilmadim; ammo xotira, o'zgarmas, rivojlanmagan xotira meni qiynagan.

en: In the silence of the night, with that sense of the nearness of God that sometimes comes into the stillness and the darkness, I stood my
uz: Kechagi xotirjamlikda, ba'zan xotirjamlik va qorong'ilikka kirib keladigan Xudoga yaqinlik hissi bilan men o'zimni qo'yib turdim.

en: trial, my only trial, for that moment of wrath and fear.
uz: O'sha g'azab va qo'rquv payti uchun sinov, mening yagona sinovim.

en: I retraced every step of our conversation from the moment when I had found him crouching be- side me, heedless of my thirst, and pointing to the ﬁre and smoke that streamed up from the ruins of Weybridge.
uz: Men suhbatimizning har bir qadamini, u men bilan yonboshlagan, chanqog'imdan beparvo bo'lgan va Weybridge vayronchiligidan oqib kelayotgan olov va tutuni ko'rsatgan paytdan boshlab eslab qoldim.

en: We had been incapable of co-op- eration—grim chance had taken no heed of that.
uz: Biz hamkorlik qila olmagan edik, ammo sharoiti bu haqda hech narsa aytmagan edi.

en: Had I foreseen, I should have left him at Halliford.
uz: Agar buni oldindan bilgan bo'lsam, uni Halifordda qoldirishim kerak edi.

en: But I did not foresee; and crime is to foresee and do.
uz: Lekin men buni oldindan ko'rmaganman va jinoyatchilikni oldindan ko'rish va amalga oshirishdir.

en: And I set this down as I have set all this story down, as it was.
uz: Va men buni butun hikoyani shunday yozib qo'ydim, shunday qilib.

en: There were no witnesses—all these things I might have concealed.
uz: Men yashirgan bu narsalar haqida hech qanday guvoh yo'q edi.

en: But I set it down, and the reader must form his judgment as he will.
uz: Ammo men uni yozib qo'ydim va o'quvchi o'z fikrini o'zi xohlagancha shakllantirishga majbur.

en: And when, by an effort, I had set aside that picture of a prostrate body, I faced the problem of the Martians and the fate of my wife.
uz: Va men bir qadam qo'yib, o'zimni o'zimga bag'ishlagan jasad tasvirini qo'yib qo'yganimda, marsiyaliklar bilan bog'liq muammo va xotinimning taqdirini ko'rdim.

en: For the former I had no data; I could imagine a hundred things, and so, unhappily, I could for the latter.
uz: Oldingi uchun ma'lumotlarim yo'q edi; yuzlab narsalarni tasavvur qila olardim, shuning uchun, afsuski, ikkinchisi uchun ham qila olardim.

en: And suddenly that night became terrible.
uz: Toʻsatdan oʻsha kechasi dahshatli boʻldi.

en: I found myself sit- ting up in bed, staring at the dark.
uz: O'zimni qorong'ilikka qaratib, yotoqda o'tirib qoldim.

en: I found myself praying that the Heat-Ray might have suddenly and painlessly struck her out of being.
uz: O'zimni issiqlik radiyasi uni to'satdan va og'riqlarsiz o'ldirib qo'ymasligi uchun ibodat qilayotgan holda ko'rdim.

en: Since the night of my return from Leatherhead I had not prayed.
uz: Leatherheaddan qaytgan kechasidan beri ibodat qilmagan edim.

en: I had uttered prayers, fetish prayers, had prayed as heathens mutter charms when I was in extrem- ity; but now I prayed indeed, pleading steadfastly and sanely, face to face with the darkness of God.
uz: Men o'zimni nihoyatda og'ir his qilganimda, ibodatlar, fetich ibodatlari, butparastlar kabi o'yin-kulgilar bilan ibodat qilgan edim; lekin endi men chinakam ibodat qildim, qat'iy va aqlli ibodatda Xudoning zulmatiga qarata yolvorgan edim.

en: Strangest in this, that so soon as dawn had come, I, who had talked with God, crept out of the house like a rat leaving its hiding place—a creature scarcely larger, an inferior animal, a thing that for any passing whim of our masters might be hunted and killed.
uz: Bu juda g'alati bo'lib o'tdi, chunki erta tongda Xudo bilan suhbatlashgan men uydan bir tovuq o'z yashirin joyidan chiqib ketgandek chiqib ketdim - bu juda katta yaratilish, pastki hayvon, bizning xo'jayinlarimizning istalgan istalganlari uchun ovga tushish va o'ldirish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

en: Perhaps they also prayed conﬁdently to God.
uz: Ehtimol, ular Xudoga ishonch bilan ibodat qilishgan.

en: Surely, if we have learned nothing else, this war has taught us pity—pity for those witless souls that suffer our dominion.
uz: Albatta, agar biz boshqa hech narsa o'rganmagan bo'lsak, ushbu urush bizning hukmronligimizdan azob chekayotgan aqlsiz jonlarga rahmdillik ko'rsatishni o'rgatdi.

en: The morning was bright and ﬁne, and the eastern sky glowed pink, and was fretted with little golden clouds.
uz: Ertalab yorug' va chiroyli edi, sharqiy osmon rosa rangli bo'lib, kichik oltin bulutlar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

en: In the road that runs from the top of Putney Hill to Wimbledon was a number of poor vestiges of the panic tor- rent that must have poured Londonward on the Sunday night after the ﬁght- ing began.
uz: Putney Hill tepaligidan Wimbledongacha bo'lgan yo'lda jang boshlanishidan keyin yakshanba kuni kechqurun Londonga to'lib ketgan qo'rquv to'rqinining bir qator kamchilikli qoldiqlari bor edi.

en: There was a little two-wheeled cart inscribed with the name of Thomas Lobb, Greengrocer, New Malden, with a smashed wheel and an abandoned tin trunk; there was a straw hat trampled into the now hardened mud, and at the top of West Hill a lot of blood-stained glass about the over- turned water trough.
uz: Thomas Lobb, Greengrocer, New Malden nomli, parchalangan velosiped va tashlab ketilgan qalin quti bilan yozilgan kichik ikki haykalli arava bor edi; endi qattiq bo'lgan loydan cho'kkan cho'tka bor edi va West Hillning yuqori qismida juda ko'p qon bilan to'ldirilgan shishalar bo'lgan.

en: My movements were languid, my plans of the vaguest.
uz: Harakatlarim bevafo, rejalarim bevafo edi.

en: I had an idea of going to Leatherhead, though I knew that there I had the poorest chance of ﬁnding my wife.
uz: Men Leatherheadga borishni rejalashtirgan edim, ammo o'sha yerda xotinimni topishga eng kam imkoniyatim borligini bilardim.

en: Certainly, unless death had overtaken them suddenly, my cousins and she would have ﬂed thence; but it seemed to
uz: Albatta, agar o'lim ularni to'satdan ushlab qolmaganida, o'g'illarim va o'g'illarim u yerdan qochib ketishgan bo'lardi; lekin o'shanda shunday bo'lgan.

en: me I might ﬁnd or learn there whither the Surrey people had ﬂed.
uz: Surreyliklar qochib ketgan joyda o'zimni topishim yoki o'rganishim mumkin.

en: I knew I wanted to ﬁnd my wife, that my heart ached for her and the world of men, but I had no clear idea how the ﬁnding might be done.
uz: Men xotinimni topishni xohlaganimni, uning va erkaklar dunyosi uchun yuragim dard chekayotganini bilardim, ammo bu qanday topilishi haqida aniq tasavvurim bo'lmagan.

en: I was also sharply aware now of my intense loneliness.
uz: Men o'zimning qattiq yolg'izligim haqida ham o'yladim.

en: From the corner I went, under cover of a thicket of trees and bushes, to the edge of Wimbledon Common, stretch- ing wide and far.
uz: Bu burchadan men daraxtlar va butalar ostida, keng va uzoq bo'lgan Wimbledon Commonning chegaralariga yetib keldim.

en: That dark expanse was lit in patches by yellow gorse and broom; there was no red weed to be seen, and as I prowled, hesitating, on the verge of the open, the sun rose, ﬂooding it all with light and vitality.
uz: O'sha qorong'i maydonda sariq cho'g' va ko'tkir cho'g'lar bo'lib yoritilgan edi; hech qanday qizil begona o't ko'rinmas edi va men o'z-o'zimni ko'rmay, shubha ostiga qo'yib yurganimda, ochiq joyning chegarasida quyosh ko'tarildi va hamma narsani yorug'lik va jonlilik bilan to'ldirdi.

en: I came upon a busy swarm of little frogs in a swampy place among the trees.
uz: Daraxtlar orasidagi mo'l joyda kichkina qurtlar to'plamini uchratdim.

en: I stopped to look at them, drawing a lesson from their stout resolve to live.
uz: Men ularga qarab turdim va ularning tirik qarorlaridan saboq oldim.

en: And presently, turning suddenly, with an odd feeling of being watched, I beheld something crouching amid a clump of bushes.
uz: Oʻshanda, toʻsatdan oʻgirib, oʻzimni kuzatish hissi bilan, oʻzimni koʻrdimki, toshlar guruhi oʻrtasida bir narsa oʻtirib turibdi.

en: I stood regarding this.
uz: Men bu borada qat'iy turardim.

en: I made a step to- wards it, and it rose up and became a man armed with a cutlass.
uz: Men uni to'g'rilash uchun bir qadam qo'ydim, u o'rnidan turib, kesak bilan qurollangan odamga aylandi.

en: I ap- proached him slowly.
uz: Men unga sekin-sakin yaqinlashdim.

en: He stood silent and motionless, regarding me.
uz: U menga qarab, beparvo va xotirjam turdi.

en: As I drew nearer I perceived he was dressed in clothes as dusty and ﬁlthy as my own; he looked, indeed, as though he had been dragged through a culvert.
uz: O'zimnikiga yaqinlashayotganimda, uning kiyim-kechaklari meningki kabi tuproq va iflos edi, xuddi ko'ylakka tashlab ketgandek ko'rinardi.

en: Nearer, I distinguished the green slime of ditches mixing with the pale drab of dried clay and shiny, coaly patches.
uz: Yaqinroq bo'lganimda, o'tlarning yashil bo'g'imligi quritilgan loy va shishqoq, ko'mirli maydonlarning bo'g'imligi bilan aralashib qolgan.

en: His black hair fell over his eyes, and his face was dark and dirty and sunken, so that at ﬁrst I did not recognise him.
uz: Uning qora sochlari ko'z ustiga tushib qoldi, yuzida qorong'i, kirli va cho'kgan bo'lib qoldi, shuning uchun men uni boshida tanimaganman.

en: There was a red cut across the lower part of his face.
uz: Uning yuzidagi pastki qismida qizil kesiklik edi.

en: Stop! he cried, when I was within ten yards of him, and I stopped.
uz: To'xtating! - deb baqirdi u, men undan o'n metr narida bo'lganimda, men to'xtadim.

en: His voice was hoarse.
uz: Uning ovozi qichqiriq edi.

en: Where do you come from? he said.
uz: U: Sen qayerdan kelding? - deb so'radi.

en: I thought, surveying him.
uz: O'yladimki, uni ko'rib turibman.

en: I come from Mortlake, I said.
uz: Men: Men Mortlake shahridanman, - dedim.

en: I was buried near the pit the Martians made about their cylinder.
uz: Men marsiyaliklar silindrlari atrofida yaratgan quduq yaqinida ko'milganman.

en: I have worked my way out and escaped. There is no food about here, he said.
uz: Men o'z ishimni olib chiqib, qochib ketdim. Bu yerda hech qanday oziq-ovqat yo'q, dedi u.

en: This is my country.
uz: Bu mening mamlakatim.

en: All this hill down to the river, and back to Clapham, and up to the edge of the common.
uz: Bu butun tepalik daryogacha, keyin Claphamga qaytib, odatiy ahvolning chegaralarigacha boradi.

en: There is only food for one.
uz: Faqat bitta kishi uchun ovqat bor.

en: Which way are you going? I answered slowly.
uz: Qaysi yo'ldan ketyapsan? - dedim men sekin javob berdim.

en: I don't know, I said.
uz: Men: Bilmayman, - dedim.

en: I have been buried in the ruins of a house thirteen or fourteen days.
uz: Men o'n uch yoki o'n to'rt kun davomida bir uy xarobalarida ko'milganman.

en: I don't know what has happened. He looked at me doubtfully, then started, and looked with a changed expression.
uz: Men nima bo'lganini bilmayman. U menga shubhali ko'z bilan qaradi, so'ngra boshlaydi va o'zgartirilgan ko'z ko'rinishini ko'radi.

en: I've no wish to stop about here, said I.
uz: Men bu yerda to'xtashni istamayman, dedim men.

en: I think I shall go to Leather- head, for my wife was there. He shot out a pointing ﬁnger.
uz: O'ylaymanki, men Lather-headga boraman, chunki xotinim u erda edi, - deb o'zi o'qidi.

en: It is you, said he; the man from Woking.
uz: U: Bu siz, - dedi u, - Woking shahridagi kishi.

en: And you weren't killed at Weybridge? I recognised him at the same moment.
uz: Va siz Vaybridjda o'ldirilmaganmisiz? - deb so'raganimda, men uni o'sha zahoti tanib oldim.

en: You are the artilleryman who came into my garden. Good luck! he said.
uz: Sen mening bog'imga kirgan to'qnashuvchisan. - U shunday dedi: Yag'ri yo'l!

en: Fancy YOU! He put out a hand, and I took it.
uz: Fancy YOU! - deb qo'lini ko'tardi va men uni oldim.

en: I crawled up a drain, he said.
uz: U: Men suv oqimiga kirdim, - dedi.

en: But they didn't kill everyone.
uz: Ammo hamma odamlarni o'ldirmagan.

en: And after they went away I got off towards Walton across the ﬁelds.
uz: Ular ketgandan so'ng, men dalalardan o'tib Valtonga bordim.

en: But—— It's not sixteen days altogether— and your hair is grey. He looked over his shoulder suddenly.
uz: Ammo bu 16 kun emas va sochlaringiz oq bo'lib qoldi, - dedi u birdan yelkasiga qarab.

en: Only a rook, he said.
uz: U: Bola turibdi, - dedi.

en: One gets to know that birds have shadows these days.
uz: Bugun qushlarning ko'ylaklari borligini bilamiz.

en: Let us crawl under those bushes and talk. Have you seen any Martians? I said.
uz: Keling, bu butalar ostida o'tirib suhbatlashaylik. - Siz marsiyaliklarni ko'rdingizmi? - dedim men.

en: Since I crawled out—— They've gone away across London, he said.
uz: Men chiqib ketgandan buyon ular Londonda yo'q bo'lib ketishdi, - dedi u.

en: I guess they've got a big- ger camp there.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u erda katta ger lagerlari bor.

en: Of a night, all over there, Hampstead way, the sky is alive with their lights.
uz: Bir kecha, Hampstead yo'li bo'ylab, osmon ularning yorug'liklari bilan jonli.

en: It's like a great city, and in the glare you can just see them moving.
uz: Bu ajoyib shaharga o'xshaydi va ularning harakatlanayotganini ko'rish mumkin.

en: By daylight you can't.
uz: Kun yorug'ligida qila olmaysiz.

en: But nearer—I haven't seen them— (he counted on his ﬁngers) ﬁve days.
uz: Ammo yaqinroq, men ularni ko'rmaganman (o'zi barmoqlari bilan sanab o'tdi) besh kun.

en: Then I saw a couple across Hammer- smith way carrying something big.
uz: Keyin hammer smit yo'li bo'ylab katta bir juftlikni ko'rdim.

en: And the night before last—he stopped and spoke impressively—it was just a matter of lights, but it was some- thing up in the air.
uz: O'tgan kechasi u to'xtadi va ta'sirchan so'zlarni aytdi, bu shunchaki nurlar bilan bog'liq edi, lekin havoda bir narsa bor edi.

en: I believe they've built a ﬂying-machine, and are learning to ﬂy. I stopped, on hands and knees, for we had come to the bushes.
uz: Ular uchuvchi mashina qurib, uchishni o'rganishyapti deb o'ylayman. Men qo'lim va tiz cho'kib to'xtadim, chunki biz butalarga yetib keldik.

en: Fly! Yes, he said, ﬂy. I went on into a little bower, and sat down.
uz: Uch! - deb javob berdi u. Men kichkina bo'g'iga kirdim va o'tirib qoldim.

en: It is all over with humanity, I said.
uz: Men: Bu insoniyatning oxiriga yetdi, - dedim.

en: If they can do that they will simply go round the world. He nodded.
uz: Agar ular buni qila olishsa, ular shunchaki dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishadi, - dedi u.

en: But—— It will relieve things over here a bit.
uz: Ammo bu bu erda vaziyatni biroz yengillashtiradi.

en: And besides —— He looked at me.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u menga qaradi.

en: Aren't you satisﬁed it IS up with humanity?
uz: Bu insoniyat bilan bog'liq ekanligiga ishonchingiz komil emasmi?

en: We're down; we're beat. I stared.
uz: Biz tushdik; biz mag'lub bo'ldik. - dedim men.

en: Strange as it may seem, I had not arrived at this fact— a fact perfectly obvious so soon as he spoke.
uz: Qizig'i shundaki, u gapirganidan so'ng men bu haqiqatga yetib yetmagan edim.

en: I had still held a vague hope; rather, I had kept a lifelong habit of mind.
uz: Men hali ham noaniq umidni saqlab qolgan edim; aksincha, hayotim davomida fikrlash odatimni saqlab kelgan edim.

en: He repeated his words, We're beat. They carried absolute conviction.
uz: U o'z so'zlarini takrorladi: Biz mag'lubiyatga uchraganmiz. Ular mutlaqo ishonchga ega edi.

en: It's all over, he said.
uz: U: Butun narsa o'tdi.

en: They've lost ONE—just ONE.
uz: Ular ONEjust ONE-ni yo'qotishdi.

en: And they've made their footing good and crippled the greatest power in the world.
uz: Va ular o'z yo'llarini yaxshi ko'rishdi va dunyodagi eng katta qudratni to'xtatdilar.

en: The death of that one at Weybridge was an accident.
uz: Vaybridjdagi o'lim tasodifiy hodisa bo'lgan.

en: And these are only pioneers.
uz: Va bular faqat kashshoflar.

en: They kept on coming.
uz: Ular kelishda davom etishdi.

en: These green stars—I've seen none these ﬁve or six days, but I've no doubt they're falling somewhere every night.
uz: Bu yashil yulduzlarBesh yoki olti kun ichida hech birini ko'rmadim, lekin ular har kuni bir joyga tushib ketayotganidan shubhalanmayman.

en: Nothing's to be done.
uz: Hech narsa qilish kerak emas.

en: We're beat! I made him no answer.
uz: Biz mag'lub bo'ldik! deb javob bermadim.

en: I sat staring before me, trying in vain to devise some countervailing thought.
uz: Men o'zimga qaratib o'tirdim va behuda o'zimga qarshi kurashishga harakat qildim.

en: This isn't a war, said the artilleryman.
uz: Bu urush emas, - dedi artilyer.

en: It never was a war, any more than there's war between man and ants. Suddenly I recalled the night in the observatory.
uz: Bu hech qachon urush bo'lmagan, xuddi odam va qordirlar o'rtasida urush bo'lgani kabi. Birdan men observatordagi kechani esladim.

en: After the tenth shot they ﬁred no more—at least, until the ﬁrst cylinder came. How do you know? said the artilleryman.
uz: O'ninchi o'qidan so'ng ular hech bo'lmaganda, birinchi silindr kelmaguncha, boshqa o'q tutmadilar. - Siz qayerdan bilasiz? - dedi artilyer.

en: Something wrong with the gun, he said.
uz: U: Tavushka bilan nimalardir noto'g'ri.

en: But what if there is?
uz: Agar bor bo'lsa-chi?

en: They'll get it right again.
uz: Ular buni yana to'g'rilaydilar.

en: And even if there's a delay, how can it alter the end?
uz: Va agar kechlik bo'lsa ham, qanday qilib bu yakunni o'zgartirishi mumkin?

en: It's just men and ants.
uz: Bu faqat insonlar va burgutlar.

en: There's the ants builds their cities, live their lives, have wars, revolutions, until the men want them out of the way, and then they go out of the way.
uz: Bu yerdagi qurtlar o'z shaharlarini qurishadi, o'z hayotini o'tkazadilar, urushlar, inqiloblar o'tkazadilar, erkaklar ularni yo'ldan ozdirmoqchi bo'lmaguncha, keyin ular yo'ldan ozdiradilar.

en: That's what we are now—just ants.
uz: Biz endi xuddi shunday qurtlarmiz.

en: Only—— Yes, I said.
uz: Faqat Ha, - dedim men.

en: We're eatable ants. We sat looking at each other.
uz: Biz bir-birimizga qarab o'tirdik.

en: And what will they do with us? I said.
uz: Men: Ular biz bilan nima qilishadi? - deb so'radim.

en: That's what I've been thinking, he said; that's what I've been thinking.
uz: U: Men ham shu haqda o'yladim, shu haqda o'yladim.

en: After Weybridge I went south—thinking.
uz: Weybridjdan so'ng men janubiy fikrlash tarziga bordim.

en: Most of the people were hard at it squealing and exciting themselves.
uz: Aksariyat odamlar o'zlarini g'ayratli va g'ayratli his qilishgan.

en: But I'm not so fond of squealing.
uz: Ammo men qichqirishni yaxshi ko'rmayman.

en: I've been in sight of death once or twice; I'm not an orna- mental soldier, and at the best and worst, death—it's just death.
uz: O'limni bir-ikki marta ko'rdim; men o'z-o'zimni askar deb bilmayman va eng yaxshi va eng yomon holatlarda o'lim shunchaki o'limdir.

en: And it's the man that keeps on thinking comes through.
uz: Va bu odam o'ylab ko'rishni davom ettiradi.

en: I saw everyone tracking away south.
uz: Men hamma odamlarni janubiy tomonga qarab ketayotganini ko'rdim.

en: Says I, Food won't last this way, and I turned right back.
uz: Men: Oziq-ovqat bu tarzda davom etmaydi, - deb javob berdim va o'zimni o'ng tomonga o'zgartirdim.

en: I went for the Martians like a sparrow goes for man.
uz: Men marsiyaliklar uchun odam uchun qush kabi harakat qildim.

en: All round—he waved a hand to the horizon—they're starving in heaps, bolting, treading on each other… He saw my face, and halted awkwardly.
uz: U ko'rinishga qo'l urdi - ular o'zlarining ko'pchiliklari ochar, bir-birlarini bosib-bosib, to'plab o'tirmoqdalar...  U mening yuzimni ko'rib, noqulaylik bilan to'xtadi.

en: No doubt lots who had money have gone away to France, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Agar shubhasiz, pulga ega bo'lgan ko'p odamlar Fransiyaga ketishdi.

en: He seemed to hesitate whether to apologise, met my eyes, and went on: There's food all about here.
uz: U kechirim so'rashdan xavotirda bo'lib, ko'zlarimni ko'rdi va davom etdi: Bu yerda hamma yerda ovqat bor.

en: Canned things in shops; wines, spirits, mineral waters; and the water mains and drains are empty.
uz: Do'konlarda saqlanadigan narsalar; sharoblar, spirtli ichimliklar, mineral suvlar; shuningdek, suv tarmoqlari va oqovalar bo'sh.

en: Well, I was telling you what I was thinking.
uz: Xo'sh, men sizga o'ylayotganimni aytib berardim.

en: Here's intelligent things, I said, and it seems they want us for food.
uz: Men: Bular aqlli mavjudotlar va ular bizni oziq-ovqat uchun xohlagandek ko'rinadi.

en: First, they'll smash us up— ships, machines, guns, cities,
uz: Avvalo, ular bizni kemalari, mashinalari, qurollari, shaharlari, shaharlari bilan to'qib tashlaydilar.

en: all the order and organisation.
uz: butun tartib va tashkilot.

en: If we were the size of ants we might pull through.
uz: Agar biz chiroqlarning o'lchamiga teng bo'lganimizda, o'zimizdan o'tishimiz mumkin edi.

en: It's all too bulky to stop.
uz: Bu to'xtash uchun juda katta.

en: That's the ﬁrst certainty. Eh? I assented.
uz: Bu birinchi aniqlikdir. - deb aytdim. Men rozi bo'ldim.

en: It is; I've thought it out.
uz: Ha, shunday, men buni o'ylab ko'rdim.

en: Very well, then—next; at present we're caught as we're wanted.
uz: Juda yaxshi, so'ngra keyingi; hozirda biz o'zimizni xohlagan holda tutilganmiz.

en: A Martian has only to go a few miles to get a crowd on the run.
uz: Marslik kishi ko'pchilikni qochib ketish uchun faqat bir necha kilometr yo'l yurishi kerak.

en: And I saw one, one day, out by Wandsworth, picking houses to pieces and routing among the wreckage.
uz: Va men bir kuni Wandsworth atrofida bir kishini ko'rdim, u uylarni parchalab, xarobalar orasida yo'l o'tkazgan.

en: But they won't keep on doing that.
uz: Ammo ular bunday qilishni davom ettirishmaydi.

en: So soon as they've settled all our guns and ships, and smashed our railways, and done all the things they are doing over there, they will begin catching us systematic, picking the best and storing us in cages and things.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular bizning barcha qurol-yarog'imiz va kemalarimizni joylashtirganidan, temir yo'llarimizni buzganidan va u erda qilayotgan barcha ishlarni bajarganidan so'ng, ular bizni muntazam ravishda ushlab, eng yaxshilarini tanlab, qovurlarda va boshqa narsalarda saqlashni boshlaydilar.

en: That's what they will start doing in a bit.
uz: Ular birozdan shu ishni boshlashadi.

en: They haven't begun on us yet.
uz: Ular hali bizdan boshlanmagan.

en: Don't you see that? Not begun! I exclaimed.
uz: Buni ko'rmayapsanmi? - deb javob berdim.

en: All that's happened so far is through our not having the sense to keep quiet—worrying them with guns and such foolery.
uz: Hozircha sodir bo'lgan barcha narsa, ularning gapini tinglash uchun aql-idrokimiz yo'qligi tufayli, ularni qurol-yarog' va bunday axloqsizliklar bilan bezovta qilishimizdan iborat.

en: And losing our heads, and rushing off in crowds to where there wasn't any more safety than where we were.
uz: Boshlarimizni yo'qotish va ko'pchilik bilan biz turgan joydan ko'ra xavfsizroq bo'lmagan joyga ko'chib o'tish.

en: They don't want to bother us yet.
uz: Ular hali bizni bezovta qilishni xohlamaydilar.

en: They're making their things—making all the things they couldn't bring with them, getting things ready for the rest of their people.
uz: Ular o'z narsalarini ishlab, o'zlari bilan birga olib kelolmagan barcha narsalarni ishlab, qolgan odamlar uchun narsalarni tayyorlaydilar.

en: Very likely that's why the cylinders have stopped for a bit, for fear of hitting those who are here.
uz: Ehtimol, shu sababli silindrlar biroz to'xtadi, chunki ular bu erda bo'lganlarga urishdan qo'rqishadi.

en: And instead of our rushing about blind, on the howl, or getting dynamite on the chance of bust- ing them up, we've got to ﬁx ourselves up according to the new state of af- fairs.
uz: Va ko'r-ko'r bo'lish, yig'ish yoki ularni buzish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishning o'rniga, biz o'zimizni yangi savdo-sotiq holatiga muvofiqlashtirishimiz kerak.

en: That's how I ﬁgure it out.
uz: Men buni shunday tushunaman.

en: It isn't quite according to what a man wants for his species, but it's about what the facts point to.
uz: Bu odam o'z turi uchun nimani xohlayotganidan farq qiladi, lekin bu faktlar nimaga ishora qilayotganidan iborat.

en: And that's the principle I acted upon.
uz: Va men bu prinsipga amal qildim.

en: Cities, nations, civilisation, progress—it's all over.
uz: Shaharlar, millatlar, sivilizatsiya, taraqqiyot - bularning barchasi o'z nihoyasiga yetdi.

en: We're beat. But if that is so, what is there to live for? The artilleryman looked at me for a moment.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, unda nima uchun yashash kerak? - deb so'ragan artilyer menga bir daqiqa qarab turdi.

en: There won't be any more blessed concerts for a million years or so; there won't be any Royal Academy of Arts, and no nice little feeds at restaurants.
uz: Million yillar davomida hech qanday muborak konsertlar bo'lmaydi; hech qanday Royal Academy of Arts bo'lmaydi va restoranlarda hech qanday yaxshi ovqatlanmaydi.

en: If it's amusement you're after, I reckon the game is up.
uz: Agar siz o'yinni o'ynashni xohlayotgan bo'lsangiz, o'yin tugadi deb o'ylayman.

en: If you've got any drawing-room manners or a dislike to eating peas with a knife or dropping aitches, you'd better chuck 'em away.
uz: Agar sizda salon xulq-atvorlari bo'lsa yoki pichoqlarni pichoq bilan yeyish yoki pichoqlarni tashlash yoqtirmasa, ularni tashlab yuborish yaxshiroqdir.

en: They ain't no further use. You mean—— I mean that men like me are going on living—for the sake of the breed.
uz: Ular endi foydasi yo'q. Sen mening kabi odamlar irq uchun yashashni davom ettirishlarini aytmoqchimisan.

en: I tell you, I'm grim set on living.
uz: Sizlarga aytaman, men yashashga qattiq tayyorman.

en: And if I'm not mistaken, you'll show what
uz: Va agar men xato qilmasam, siz nima ekanligini ko'rsatasiz.

en: insides YOU'VE got, too, before long.
uz: Siz ham tez orada ichki ishlaringiz bo'ladi.

en: We aren't going to be exterminated.
uz: Biz yo'q qilinmaymiz.

en: And I don't mean to be caught either, and tamed and fattened and bred like a thundering ox.
uz: Va men ham o'zimni tutib, o'g'irlab, o'g'irlab, o'g'irlab, o'g'irlab, o'g'irlab ketishni istamayman.

en: Fancy those brown creepers! You don't mean to say—— I do.
uz: O'sha qora rangli shovqinlarni yoqtiring! - Siz aytmoqchi emassiz, Men aytaman.

en: I'm going on, under their feet.
uz: Men ularning oyoqlari ostida davom etaman.

en: I've got it planned; I've thought it out.
uz: Men buni rejalashtirganman; men buni o'ylab ko'rdim.

en: We don't know enough.
uz: Biz yetarlicha bilmaymiz.

en: We've got to learn before we've got a chance.
uz: Biz imkoniyatimiz bo'lishdan oldin o'rganishimiz kerak.

en: And we've got to live and keep independent while we learn.
uz: Va biz o'rganayotganimizda mustaqil yashashimiz va yashashimiz kerak.

en: That's what has to be done. I stared, astonished, and stirred profoundly by the man's resolution.
uz: Bu qilish kerak bo'lgan narsa. Men odamning qaroridan o'zimga qarab, hayratda qoldim va chuqur hayajonlandim.

en: Great God!, cried I.
uz: Great Xudo!, deb baqirdi men.

en: But you are a man indeed! And suddenly I gripped his hand.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, sen chindan ham bir insonsan! - dedim va birdan uning qo'lidan ushlab qoldim.

en: Eh! he said, with his eyes shining.
uz: Eh! - dedi u, ko'zlari yorqin.

en: I've thought it out, eh? Go on, I said.
uz: Men buni o'ylab ko'rdim, shundaymi? - dedim men.

en: Well, those who mean to escape their catching must get ready.
uz: Hokimlikdan qochmoqchi bo'lganlar tayyorgarlik ko'rishlari kerak.

en: I'm get- ting ready.
uz: Men tayyorman.

en: Mind you, it isn't all of us that are made for wild beasts; and that's what it's got to be.
uz: Shuni unutmangki, barchamiz yovvoyi hayvonlar uchun yaratilmaganmiz va bu shunday bo'lishi kerak.

en: That's why I watched you.
uz: Shuning uchun seni kuzatib turardim.

en: I didn't know that it was you, you see, or just how you'd been buried.
uz: O'zingiz bo'lganingizni yoki qanday qilib ko'milganingizni bilmasdim.

en: All these—the sort of people that lived in these houses, and all those damn little clerks that used to live down that way—they'd be no good.
uz: Bu uylarda yashovchilarning hammasi va o'sha kabi yashaydigan o'sha kichik ruhoniylar hech qanday foyda keltirmaydi.

en: They haven't any spirit in them—no proud dreams and no proud lusts; and a man who hasn't one or the other—Lord!
uz: Ular ichlarida ruh yo'q, mag'rur orzular yo'q, mag'rur istaklar yo'q, bir-biriga ega bo'lmagan kishi ham yo'q!

en: What is he but funk and precautions?
uz: U funk va ehtiyotkorlikdan boshqa nima?

en: They just used to skedaddle off to work—I've seen hundreds of 'em, bit of breakfast in hand, running wild and shining to catch their little season-ticket train, for fear they'd get dismissed if they didn't; working at businesses they were afraid to take the trouble to understand; skedaddling back for fear they wouldn't be in time for dinner; keeping indoors after dinner for fear of the back streets, and sleeping with the wives they married, not because they wanted them, but because they had a bit of money that would make for safety in their one little miserable skedaddle through the world.
uz: Ular shunchaki ishga ketishardiMen yuzlab odamlarni ko'rdim, biroz kechki ovqat qo'lda, o'zlarining kichkina mavsumiy poyezdlarini olish uchun g'ayritabiiy harakat qilib va shinam bo'lib ketishdi, agar ular ishdan bo'shatishidan qo'rqishardi, agar ular ishdan bo'shatishmagan bo'lsa, ishdan bo'shatishlaridan qo'rqishardi; tushunish uchun qiyinchilikka duch kelishlaridan qo'rqishardi; kechki ovqat uchun o'z vaqtida kelmasliklaridan qo'rqishardi; kechki ovqatdan keyin uyda qolishardi, ko'chalar qo'rquvidan qo'rqishardi va turmush qurgan xotinlari bilan uxlashardi, chunki ular ularni xohlaganlari uchun emas, balki dunyo bo'ylab o'zlarining kichkina qashshoqlikdagi o'yinlarida xavfsizlikni ta'minlaydigan biroz pullari bor edi.

en: Lives in- sured and a bit invested for fear of accidents.
uz: Hayotlar sug'urtalab, biroz sarmoya kiritilgan, chunki avariyalar qo'rquvidan.

en: And on Sundays—fear of the hereafter.
uz: Yakshanba kunlari esa oxiratdan qo'rqish.

en: As if hell was built for rabbits!
uz: To'g'ri, jahannam qushlar uchun qurilgan bo'lsa kerak!

en: Well, the Martians will just be a godsend to these.
uz: Xo'sh, marsiylar bularga faqatgina Xudoning hadyasi bo'lishadi.

en: Nice roomy cages, fattening food, careful breeding, no worry.
uz: Yaxshi xonali kafeslar, o'lchamli oziq-ovqat, ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'payish, hech qanday tashvish yo'q.

en: After a week or so chasing about the ﬁelds and lands on empty stom- achs, they'll come and be caught cheerful.
uz: Bir hafta yoki undan so'ng bo'sh bo'sh bo'lgan ko'chalarda va dalalarda yurib, ko'tarib bo'lgach, ular xursand bo'lib kelishadi.

en: They'll be quite glad after a bit.
uz: Bir ozdan keyin ular juda xursand bo'ladilar.

en: They'll wonder what people did before there were Martians to take care of them.
uz: Ular odamlarning ularga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun martliklar paydo bo'lishidan oldin nima qilishganini o'ylashadi.

en: And the bar loafers, and mashers, and singers—I can imagine them.
uz: Men ularni tasavvur qila olaman, bar loaferlari, masherlar va qo'shiqchilar.

en: I can imagine them, he said, with a sort of sombre gratiﬁcation.
uz: Men ularni tasavvur qila olaman, - dedi u, o'ziga xos qoniqarli qoniqish bilan.

en: any amount of sentiment and religion loose among them.
uz: Ular orasida har qanday his-tuyg'u va din bo'shashi mumkin.

en: There's hundreds of things I saw with my eyes that I've only begun to see clearly these last few days.
uz: O'z ko'zim bilan ko'rgan yuzlab narsalar faqatgina so'nggi kunlarda aniq ko'rishni boshlaganman.

en: There's lots will take things as they are—fat and stupid; and lots will be worried by a sort of feeling that it's all wrong, and that they ought to be doing something.
uz: Ko'pchilik narsalarni o'zlari kabi yumshoq va ahmoq deb qabul qiladi va ko'pchilik hamma narsa noto'g'ri va ular biror narsa qilishlari kerak degan tuyg'u bilan tashvishlanadi.

en: Now whenever things are so that a lot of people feel they ought to be doing something, the weak, and those who go weak with a lot of complicated thinking, always make for a sort of do-nothing religion, very pious and superior, and submit to persecution and the will of the Lord.
uz: Endi, har qachon vaziyat shunday bo'lsaki, ko'p odamlar biror narsa qilishlari kerak deb o'ylashsa, zaiflar va murakkab fikrlash tarzi bilan zaif bo'lganlar har doim hech narsa qilmaydigan, juda xudojo'y va ustun bo'lgan bir turdagi dinni topib, ta'qiblarga va Rabbimizning irodasiga bo'ysunishadi.

en: Very likely you've seen the same thing.
uz: Ehtimol siz ham xuddi shu narsani ko'rgan bo'lasiz.

en: It's energy in a gale of funk, and turned clean inside out.
uz: Bu funk to'rnasida energiya va ichkaridan tozalik.

en: These cages will be full of psalms and hymns and piety.
uz: Ushbu kafeslar sanolar, sanolar va xudojo'ylik bilan to'lib-toshadi.

en: And those of a less simple sort will work in a bit of—what is it?— eroticism. He paused.
uz: Va kamroq sodda turdagilar biroz erotizmda ishlaydi. - deb to'xtatdi u.

en: Very likely these Martians will make pets of some of them; train them to do tricks—who knows?—get sentimental over the pet boy who grew up and had to be killed.
uz: Ushbu Marsliklar ulardan ba'zilarini uy hayvonlariga aylantirishi mumkin; ularni hiyla-nayranglar bilan mashq qilishga o'rgatishi mumkin, kim biladi?U o'sgan va o'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan uy hayvonlari o'g'liga nisbatan hissiy munosabatlarga ega bo'lishi mumkin.

en: And some, maybe, they will train to hunt us. No, I cried, that's impossible!
uz: Va ba'zilari, ehtimol, bizni ovlash uchun mashq qilishadi. - Yo'q, - dedim men, bu mumkin emas!

en: No human being—— What's the good of going on with such lies? said the artilleryman.
uz: Hech bir inson yo'q - deb so'ragan artilyer: Bunday yolg'onlarni aytishning nima foydasi bor?

en: There's men who'd do it cheerful.
uz: Bu ishni quvonch bilan qiladigan erkaklar bor.

en: What nonsense to pretend there isn't! And I succumbed to his conviction.
uz: U yo'qdek tuyg'u qilish naqadar bejiz bo'ladi! - dedim va men uning e'tiqodlariga bo'ysundim.

en: If they come after me, he said; Lord, if they come after me! and sub- sided into a grim meditation.
uz: Agar ular orqamdan kelayotgan bo'lsalar, - deb javob berdi u. Rabbim, agar ular orqamdan kelayotgan bo'lsalar! - deb so'rab, o'z-o'zidan ko'ngilsizlik bilan mulohaza yuritdi.

en: I sat contemplating these things.
uz: Men bu narsalar haqida mulohaza yuritib o'tirdim.

en: I could ﬁnd nothing to bring against this man's reasoning.
uz: Men bu odamning fikrlash tarziga qarshi hech narsa topolmadim.

en: In the days before the invasion no one would have ques- tioned my intellectual superiority to his—I, a professed and recognised writer on philosophical themes, and he, a common soldier; and yet he had already formulated a situation that I had scarcely realised.
uz: Invasiondan oldingi kunlarda hech kim falsafa mavzularida tan olingan va tan olingan yozuvchi va oddiy askardan mening intellektual ustunligimni shubha ostiga qo'ymagan bo'lardi; ammo u hali ham men o'zimni anglamagan vaziyatni so'zlab bergan edi.

en: What are you doing? I said presently.
uz: Siz nima qilyapsiz? - deb so'radim.

en: What plans have you made? He hesitated.
uz: Siz qanday rejalar tuzgansiz? - deb u shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: Well, it's like this, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bunday bo'ladi.

en: What have we to do?
uz: Biz nima qilishimiz kerak?

en: We have to invent a sort of life where men can live and breed, and be sufﬁciently secure to bring the children up.
uz: Biz erkaklar yashashi, ko'payishi va bolalarni tarbiyalash uchun yetarlicha xavfsiz bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan hayotni yaratishimiz kerak.

en: Yes—wait a bit, and I'll make it clearer what I think ought to be done.
uz: Bir oz vaqt kuting, men nima qilish kerakligini aniqroq tushuntiraman.

en: The tame ones will go like all tame beasts; in a few generations they'll be big, beautiful, rich-blooded, stupid—rubbish!
uz: O'g'illar barcha o'g'illar kabi o'tadilar; bir necha avlod ichida ular katta, chiroyli, boy qonli, ahmoqona qamoq bo'ladilar!

en: The risk is that we who keep wild will go savage—degenerate into a sort of big, savage rat… You see, how I mean to live is underground.
uz: Biz yovvoyilikni saqlaydigan odamlar yovvoyilikka aylanib, katta va yovvoyi podshohga aylanish xavfi bor.

en: I've been thinking about the drains.
uz: Men suv oqimlari haqida o'yladim.

en: Of course those who don't know drains think horrible things; but un-
uz: Albatta, oqovalarni bilmaydiganlar dahshatli narsalarni o'ylaydilar; lekin u-

en: der this London are miles and miles—hundreds of miles— and a few days rain and London empty will leave them sweet and clean.
uz: Bu Londonda kilometrlar va kilometrlar, bir necha kun yomg'ir yog'adi va Londonda hech narsa yo'q bo'lib qolmaydi.

en: The main drains are big enough and airy enough for anyone.
uz: Asosiy oqovalar yetarlicha katta va har kim uchun yetarlicha havoli.

en: Then there's cellars, vaults, stores, from which bolting passages may be made to the drains.
uz: Keyin piyodalar, vaftlar, do'konlar mavjud, ulardan tortib o'tish yo'nalishlariga o'tish mumkin.

en: And the railway tunnels and subways.
uz: Va temir yo'l tunnellari va metro.

en: And we form a band— able-bodied, clean-minded men.
uz: Va biz kuchli, pok fikrli erkaklar guruhini tashkil etamiz.

en: We're not going to pick up any rubbish that drifts in.
uz: Biz hech qanday chiqindilarni olib kelmaymiz.

en: Weaklings go out again. As you meant me to go? Well—l parleyed, didn't I? We won't quarrel about that.
uz: Zaiflar yana tashqariga chiqadilar. Siz mening ketishimni xohlaganingizdek? To'g'ri kelmadimmi? Biz bu haqda bahslashmaymiz.

en: Go on. Those who stop obey orders.
uz: Shundan so'ng ketinglar. Agar buyruqlarga itoat qilishni to'xtatsangizlar.

en: Able-bodied, clean-minded women we want also—mothers and teachers.
uz: Kuchli, pok fikrli xotin-qizlarni, shuningdek, onalar va o'qituvchilarni ham xohlaymiz.

en: No lackadaisical ladies—no blasted rolling eyes.
uz: No lackadaisical ladiesno blasted rolling eyes.

en: We can't have any weak or silly.
uz: Bizda hech qanday zaif yoki ahmoqlik bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Life is real again, and the use- less and cumbersome and mischievous have to die.
uz: Hayot yana haqiqiy bo'lib qoldi va kamroq foydalanish, og'irlik va yovuzlik o'lib ketishi kerak.

en: They ought to be willing to die.
uz: Ular o'lishga tayyor bo'lishlari kerak.

en: It's a sort of disloyalty, after all, to live and taint the race.
uz: Axir, hayotda yashash va musobaqaning buzilishiga yo'l qo'yish - bu bir xil sadoqatsizlikdir.

en: And they can't be happy.
uz: Va ular baxtli bo'lishi mumkin emas.

en: Moreover, dying's none so dreadful; it's the funking makes it bad.
uz: Bundan tashqari, o'lish hech qanday dahshatli narsa emas; bu funking uni yomon qiladi.

en: And in all those places we shall gather.
uz: Va barcha joylarda biz yig'iladi.

en: Our dis- trict will be London.
uz: Bizning tumanimiz London bo'ladi.

en: And we may even be able to keep a watch, and run about in the open when the Martians keep away.
uz: Va biz hatto soatni saqlab, marsiyaliklar uzoqda bo'lganda ochiq joyda yugurib yurishimiz mumkin.

en: Play cricket, perhaps.
uz: Balki, kriket o'ynash mumkin.

en: That's how we shall save the race.
uz: Shunday qilib biz musobaqani qutqaramiz.

en: It's a possible thing?
uz: Bu mumkin bo'lgan narsa?

en: But saving the race is nothing in itself.
uz: Ammo musobaqani qutqarish o'z-o'zidan hech narsa emas.

en: As I say, that's only being rats.
uz: Aytganimdek, bu shunchaki tovuq bo'lishdir.

en: It's saving our knowledge and adding to it is the thing.
uz: Bu bilimlarimizni saqlab qolish va unga qo'shishdir.

en: There men like you come in.
uz: Siz kabi erkaklar kiradi.

en: There's books, there's models.
uz: Kitoblar bor, modellar ham bor.

en: We must make great safe places down deep, and get all the books we can; not novels and poetry swipes, but ideas, sci- ence books.
uz: Biz chuqur joylarda katta xavfsizlik joylarini yaratishimiz va iloji boricha ko'pgina kitoblarni olishimiz kerak; romanlar va she'rlarni emas, balki g'oyalarni, ilmiy kitoblarni olishimiz kerak.

en: That's where men like you come in.
uz: Mana siz kabi erkaklar o'sha joyga kirishadi.

en: We must go to the British Museum and pick all those books through.
uz: Biz Buyuk Britaniya muzeyiga borib, o'sha kitoblarning barchasini tanlab olishimiz kerak.

en: Especially we must keep up our science—learn more.
uz: Ayniqsa, biz o'z ilm-fanimizni rivojlantirib, ko'proq o'rganishimiz kerak.

en: We must watch these Martians.
uz: Biz bu marsiyaliklarni kuzatib turishimiz kerak.

en: Some of us must go as spies.
uz: Ba'zilarimiz kuzatuvchilar bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: When it's all working, perhaps I will.
uz: Bularning barchasi ishlashi mumkin bo'lganda, ehtimol men ham shunday qilaman.

en: And the great thing is, we must leave the Martians alone.
uz: Eng muhimi shundaki, biz marsiyaliklarni tinch qoldirishimiz kerak.

en: We mustn't even steal.
uz: Biz hatto o'g'irlashimiz ham mumkin emas.

en: If we get in their way, we clear out.
uz: Agar biz ularning yo'lida bo'lsak, biz chiqamiz.

en: We must show them we mean no harm.
uz: Biz ularga zarar yetkazishni istamayotganimizni ko'rsatishimiz kerak.

en: But they're intelligent things, and they won't hunt us down if they have all they want, and think we're just harmless vermin. The artilleryman paused and laid a brown hand upon my arm.
uz: Ammo ular aqlli narsalar va agar ular xohlagan hamma narsasiga ega bo'lsalar, bizni ovlamaslar va biz faqat zararsiz zararkunandalarmiz deb o'ylashadi, - deb aytdi.

en: After all, it may not be so much we may have to learn before—Just imagine this: four or ﬁve of their ﬁghting machines suddenly starting off— Heat-Rays right and left, and not a Martian in 'em.
uz: Axir, biz oldin o'rganishimiz kerak bo'lgan narsalar shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasligi mumkin: bir tasavvur qiling: ularning to'rt yoki beshta jang mashinalari to'satdan o'ng va chap tomonida issiqlik nurlari ishga tushadi va unda marsiyalik emas.

en: Not a Martian in 'em, but men—men who have learned the way how.
uz: Ularda marsiyalik emas, balki qanday yo'l tutishni o'rgangan odamlar bor.

en: It may be in my time, even—
uz: Bu mening davrimda bo'lishi mumkin, hatto

en: Fancy having one of them lovely things, with its Heat-Ray wide and free!
uz: O'sha chiroyli narsalardan birini, keng va bepul Heat-Ray-ni olishni zavqlantiradi!

en: Fancy having it in control!
uz: Uni nazorat qilish juda yoqimli!

en: What would it matter if you smashed to smithereens at the end of the run, after a bust like that?
uz: Agar siz bunday jabr-jabrdan so'ng, o'tishning oxirida toshbo'ron qilib qo'ygan bo'lsangiz, bu qanday ahamiyatga ega?

en: I reckon the Mar- tians'll open their beautiful eyes!
uz: Men o'ylaymanki, Martianlar o'z go'zal ko'zlarini ochadilar!

en: Can't you see them, man?
uz: Ularni ko'rmayapsanmi, yigit?

en: Can't you see them hurrying, hurrying—pufﬁng and blowing and hooting to their other mechanical affairs?
uz: Ular shoshilgani, shoshilgani, puflashgani, puflashgani va boshqa mexanik ishlarida g'ayratli bo'lganlarini ko'rmayapsizmi?

en: Something out of gear in every case.
uz: Har bir holatda biron bir narsa o'zgarmaydi.

en: And swish, bang, rattle, swish!
uz: Va swish, bang, rattle, swish!

en: Just as they are fumbling over it, SWISH comes the Heat-Ray, and, behold!
uz: Ular o'zlarining ko'z o'ngida bo'lgan paytda, SWISHning issiqlik radiyasi paydo bo'ldi va, mana!

en: man has come back to his own. For a while the imaginative daring of the artilleryman, and the tone of assurance and courage he assumed, completely dominated my mind.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida to'qnashuvchining o'ylash qobiliyati va u o'z ichiga olgan ishonch va jasorat so'zi mening ongimga to'liq ta'sir qildi.

en: I be- lieved unhesitatingly both in his forecast of human destiny and in the practi- cability of his astonishing scheme, and the reader who thinks me suscepti- ble and foolish must contrast his position, reading steadily with all his thoughts about his subject, and mine, crouching fearfully in the bushes and listening, distracted by apprehension.
uz: Men uning inson taqdirini bashorat qilishida ham, uning hayratlanarli rejasi amalga oshirilishiida ham o'ylayman va meni qo'rqinchli va ahmoq deb o'ylaydigan o'quvchi o'z nuqtai nazarini o'qib, o'z mavzusida o'z fikrlari bilan muntazam o'qiyotgan, mening fikrimni ham o'ylashi kerak, qorong'ilar ichida qo'rqib, tinglab, qo'rquvdan chalg'ilayotgan.

en: We talked in this manner through the early morning time, and later crept out of the bushes, and, after scanning the sky for Martians, hurried precipitately to the house on Putney Hill where he had made his lair.
uz: Biz erta tongda shunday suhbatlashdik va keyinchalik butalardan chiqib, osmonni marsiyaliklar uchun tekshirib ko'rganimizdan so'ng, o'z uyini qurgan Putney Hilldagi uyga tez-tez bordik.

en: It was the coal cellar of the place, and when I saw the work he had spent a week upon—it was a burrow scarcely ten yards long, which he designed to reach to the main drain on Putney Hill—I had my ﬁrst inkling of the gulf between his dreams and his powers.
uz: Bu yerning ko'mir quti edi va men uning bir hafta davomida qilgan ishlarini ko'rgach, u o'n metr uzunlikdagi, Putney Hilldagi asosiy oqovaga yetib kelish uchun yaratgan quduq edi.Men uning orzulari va kuchlari o'rtasidagi bo'shliq haqida birinchi tasavvurga ega bo'ldim.

en: Such a hole I could have dug in a day.
uz: Men bir kunda o'sha kabi chuqur qazishim mumkin edi.

en: But I believed in him sufﬁciently to work with him all that morning until past midday at his digging.
uz: Ammo men u bilan ertalabgacha, tushdan keyin ham qazish ishlarida ishlash uchun unga ishonardim.

en: We had a garden barrow and shot the earth we removed against the kitchen range.
uz: Bizda bog'da o't qo'yilgan bo'lak bor edi va biz olib tashlagan yerni oshxonada o'rnatgan bo'ldik.

en: We refreshed our- selves with a tin of mock- turtle soup and wine from the neighbouring pantry.
uz: Biz o'zimizni qo'shni omborxonadan bir qadoq soya va sharob bilan ta'minladik.

en: I found a curious relief from the aching strangeness of the world in this steady labour.
uz: Men bu doimiy mehnatda dunyoning og'rig'li g'ayrioddiyligidan g'alati yengillikni topdim.

en: As we worked, I turned his project over in my mind, and presently objections and doubts began to arise; but I worked there all the morning, so glad was I to ﬁnd myself with a purpose again.
uz: Ishlayotganimizda, uning loyihasini o'zimda o'zgartirdim va o'sha zahoti muammos va shubhalar paydo bo'ldi; lekin men u erda butun ertalab ishladim, shuning uchun o'zimni yana maqsadga ega bo'lganimdan juda xursand edim.

en: After working an hour I began to speculate on the distance one had to go before the cloaca was reached, the chances we had of missing it altogether.
uz: Bir soat ishlaganimdan so'ng, men klokaga yetib kelishdan oldin qancha yo'l bosib o'tish kerakligini, uni butunlay yo'qotish ehtimolimiz haqida gumon qilishga tushdim.

en: My immediate trouble was why we should dig this long tunnel, when it was possible to get into the drain at once down one of the manholes, and work back to the house.
uz: O'sha zahoti muammo shundaki, nega biz bu uzun tunnelni qazishimiz kerak edi, chunki bir marta manholelardan biriga tushish va uyga qaytib borish mumkin edi.

en: It seemed to me, too, that the house was inconveniently chosen, and required a needless length of tunnel.
uz: Men ham uyni noqulay tanlagan va keraksiz uzunlikdagi tunnelni talab qilgan deb o'yladim.

en: And just as I was beginning to face these things, the artilleryman stopped digging, and looked at me.
uz: Va men bu narsalarga duch kelishni boshlaganimda, to'qnashuvchi qazishni to'xtatdi va menga qaradi.

en: We're working well, he said.
uz: Biz yaxshi ishlayapmiz, dedi u.

en: He put down his spade.
uz: U o'z qilichini pastga qo'ydi.

en: Let us knock off a bit he said.
uz: Biz biroz to'xtab turaylik, dedi u.

en: I think it's time we reconnoitred from the roof of the house. I was for going on, and after a little hesitation he resumed his spade; and then suddenly I was struck by a thought.
uz: Men davom etishni xohlagan edim va u biroz tortishuvdan so'ng o'z qilichini davom ettirdi; keyin to'satdan men bir fikrga tushib qoldim.

en: I stopped, and so did he at once.
uz: Men to'xtatdim va u ham darhol to'xtadi.

en: Why were you walking about the common, I said, instead of being here? Taking the air, he said.
uz: Nima uchun siz bu yerda bo'lishning o'rniga oddiy odamlar atrofida yuribsiz? - dedim men. - U: Ham nafas olishda, - dedi.

en: It's safer by night. But the work? Oh, one can't always work, he said, and in a ﬂash I saw the man plain.
uz: Kechasi xavfsizroq. - Ammo ish? - dedi u. - Oh, har doim ham ishlashi mumkin emas, - dedi u. Bir lahzada odamni ko'rdim.

en: He hesitated, holding his spade.
uz: U o'z qilichini qo'lga olib, shubha ostiga qo'ydi.

en: We ought to reconnoitre now, he said, because if any come near they may hear the spades and drop upon us unawares. I was no longer disposed to object.
uz: U shunday dedi: Biz hozirni o'ylab ko'rishimiz kerak, chunki agar biror kishi yaqinlashib kelsa, o'zlarining o'qlarini eshitib, bizga o'ylamasdan tushishi mumkin.

en: We went together to the roof and stood on a ladder peeping out of the roof door.
uz: Biz birga xonadonga bordik va xonadon eshigidan chiqib ko'z tikib turardik.

en: No Martians were to be seen, and we ventured out on the tiles, and slipped down under shelter of the parapet.
uz: Hech qanday marsiyaliklar ko'rinmas edi, shuning uchun biz plyonkalarga chiqib, parapetning himoyasi ostida pastga surib tushdik.

en: From this position a shrubbery hid the greater portion of Putney, but we could see the river below, a bubbly mass of red weed, and the low parts of Lambeth ﬂooded and red.
uz: Bu joydan Putneyning katta qismini butalar yashirib qo'ydi, ammo biz pastdagi daryo, qizil o'tlarning bulbulli qismi va Lambethning past qismlari suv ostida va qizil bo'lganini ko'rishimiz mumkin edi.

en: The red creeper swarmed up the trees about the old palace, and their branches stretched gaunt and dead, and set with shriv- elled leaves, from amid its clusters.
uz: Qizil qo'rqinch eski saroy atrofidagi daraxtlarga to'lib-toshdi va ularning shoxlari o'tkir-o'tkir bo'lib, uning to'plamlari o'rtasida shriv-elled barglar bilan o'rnatildi.

en: It was strange how entirely dependent both these things were upon ﬂowing water for their propagation.
uz: Bularning ikkalasi ham o'z tarqalishi uchun oqib turgan suvga qanchalik bog'liq bo'lganligi g'alati edi.

en: About us neither had gained a footing; laburnums, pink mays, snowballs, and trees of arbor-vitae, rose out of laurels and hydrangeas, green and brilliant into the sunlight.
uz: Bizning atrofimizda hech biri o'z poydevorini topmagan edi; laburnumlar, rosa maylar, qar toʻplari va arbor-vitae daraxtlari laurel va hortansiyalardan ko'tarilgan, yashil va yorqin quyosh nurida yorug' bo'lgan.

en: Beyond Kensington dense smoke was rising, and that and a blue haze hid the northward hills.
uz: Kensington tashqarisida zich tutun ko'tarilib, bu va ko'k tuman shimoliy tomondagi tog'larni yashirib qo'ydi.

en: The artilleryman began to tell me of the sort of people who still remained in London.
uz: Artilyer menga Londonda hali ham qolishayotgan odamlarning turini aytib berishni boshladi.

en: One night last week, he said, some fools got the electric light in order, and there was all Regent Street and the Circus ablaze, crowded with painted and ragged drunkards, men and women, dancing and shouting till dawn.
uz: O'tgan hafta bir kecha, - dedi u, - ba'zi g'alatilar elektr chiroqlarini o'rnatishdi va Regent Street va Circus ko'chasi yonib ketdi, bu yerda bo'yilgan va chiroyli ichkilikbozlar, erkaklar va ayollar to'plandi, ular tonggacha raqs va qichqiriq qilishardi.

en: A man who was there told me.
uz: U yerda bo'lgan bir kishi menga aytdi.

en: And as the day came they became aware of a ﬁghting-machine standing near by the Langham and looking down at them.
uz: Kun yorug' bo'lganida ular Langhamning yonida turgan jang mashinasini ko'rishdi.

en: Heaven knows how long he had been there.
uz: Osmon biladi, u u yerda qancha vaqt bo'lgan.

en: It must have given some of them a nasty turn.
uz: Bu ularning ba'zilariga yomon holatni keltirib chiqargan bo'lishi kerak.

en: He came down the road towards them, and picked up nearly a hundred too drunk or frightened to run away. Grotesque gleam of a time no history will ever fully describe!
uz: U yo'lda ularning yoniga tushib, taxminan yuz kishini o'rab oldi, chunki u juda mast yoki qo'rqib qochib ketishga majbur edi. Tarix hech qachon to'liq tasvirlamaydigan davrning grotesk shishqoqligi!

en: From that, in answer to my questions, he came round to his grandiose plans again.
uz: O'sha paytdan boshlab, mening savollarimga javob berib, u yana o'zining ulkan rejalariga qaytdi.

en: He grew enthusiastic.
uz: U g'ayratli bo'ldi.

en: He talked so eloquently of the possibility of capturing a ﬁghting-machine that I more than half believed in him again.
uz: U jang mashinasini ushlab olish imkoniyati haqida shunchalik puxta gapirganki, men uning yarmidan ko'prog'iga unga yana ishonardim.

en: But now that I was beginning to understand something of his quality, I could divine the stress he laid on doing nothing precipitately.
uz: Ammo endi uning fazilatlarini tushunishni boshlaganimdan keyin, u hech narsa qilmaslikka qanchalik bosim o'tkazganini tasavvur qila olaman.

en: And I noted that now there was no question that he personally was to capture and ﬁght the great machine.
uz: Va men shuni ta'kidladimki, endi u shaxsan buyuk mashinani ushlab olish va unga qarshi kurashish haqida hech qanday shubha yo'q edi.

en: After a time we went down to the cellar.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt o'tgach, biz sotuvxonaga tushdik.

en: Neither of us seemed disposed to resume digging, and when he suggested a meal, I was nothing loath.
uz: Ikkovimiz ham qazishni davom ettirishga tayyor emasdik va u ovqatni taklif qilganda, men hech qanday nafratlanmadim.

en: He became suddenly very generous, and when we had eaten he went away and returned with some excellent cigars.
uz: Toʻsatdan u juda saxiy boʻldi va biz ovqatlangach, u ketib, ajoyib sigaretalar bilan qaytib keldi.

en: We lit these, and his optimism glowed.
uz: Biz bularni yoqib qo'ydik va uning ijobiy his-tuyg'ulari nurlandi.

en: He was inclined to regard my coming as a great occasion.
uz: U mening kelishimni katta sharaf deb bilishga moyil edi.

en: There's some champagne in the cellar, he said.
uz: U shunday dedi: Kellerda shampanjon bor.

en: We can dig better on this Thames-side burgundy, said I.
uz: Men: Biz ushbu Temza tomoni burg'onida yaxshiroq qazishimiz mumkin, deb aytdim.

en: No, said he; I am host today.
uz: Yo'q, - dedi u, - bugun men mehmonman.

en: We've a heavy enough task before us!
uz: Oldimizda yetarlicha og'ir vazifa bor!

en: Let us take a rest and gather strength while we may.
uz: Keling, imkonimiz bo'lganda dam olib, kuch topaylik.

en: Look at these blistered hands! And pursuant to this idea of a holiday, he insisted upon playing cards af- ter we had eaten.
uz: Mana, bu kulfatli qo'llarga! - deb aytdi va bayram haqidagi fikrga asoslanib, biz ovqatlanganimizdan keyin karta o'ynashni rag'batlantirdi.

en: He taught me euchre, and after dividing London between us, I taking the northern side and he the southern, we played for parish points.
uz: U menga euchre o'rgatdi va Londonni o'zimizga bo'lishgandan so'ng, men shimoliy tomonni, u esa janubiy tomonni oldim va biz parish punktlari uchun o'ynay boshladik.

en: Grotesque and foolish as this will seem to the sober reader, it is ab- solutely true, and what is more remarkable, I found the card game and sev- eral others we played extremely interesting.
uz: Bu o'quvchi uchun qanchalik g'alati va ahmoqona tuyulsa-da, bu mutlaqo haqiqatdir va bundan ham hayratlanarli narsa shundaki, karta o'yini va biz o'ynagan boshqa o'yinlarni juda qiziqarli deb topdim.

en: Strange mind of man!
uz: Odamning g'ayrioddiy ongi!

en: that, with our species upon the edge of extermina- tion or appalling degradation, with no clear prospect before us but the chance of a horrible death, we could sit following the chance of this painted pasteboard, and playing the joker with vivid delight.
uz: Bizning turimiz yo'q qilinish yoki dahshatli pasayish chegarasida, biz uchun dahshatli o'limdan boshqa aniq istiqbol yo'q, biz bu bo'yilgan kartonning imkoniyatidan o'tirib, joker o'ynashimiz mumkin.

en: Afterwards he taught me poker, and I beat him at three tough chess games.
uz: Keyinchalik u menga poker o'rgatdi va men uni uchta qiyin shaxmat o'yinida mag'lub qildim.

en: When dark came we decided to take the risk, and lit a lamp.
uz: Ko'k bo'lganda, biz xavf-xatarni qo'lga kiritishga qaror qildik va chiroq yoqdik.

en: After an interminable string of games, we supped, and the artilleryman ﬁnished the champagne.
uz: To'liq o'yinlardan so'ng, biz ovqatlanardik va artilyer shampanjni tugatdi.

en: We went on smoking the cigars.
uz: Biz sigaretlarni chekishni davom ettirdik.

en: He was no longer the energetic regenerator of his species I had encountered in the morning.
uz: U endi ertalab uchrashgan o'z turining energiyaviy regeneratoridan boshqa emas edi.

en: He was still optimistic, but it was a less kinetic, a more thoughtful opti- mism.
uz: U hali ham optimist edi, ammo bu kamroq kinetik, ko'proq o'ylaydigan optimizm edi.

en: I remember he wound up with my health, proposed in a speech of small variety and considerable intermittence.
uz: Eslaymanki, u sog'ligim bilan bog'liq bo'lib, kichik va ko'p vaqtinchalik nutq bilan taklif qildi.

en: I took a cigar, and went up- stairs to look at the lights of which he had spoken that blazed so greenly along the Highgate hills.
