uz: Men sigarani olib, u gapirgan va Highgate tog'lari bo'ylab yashil rangda yonayotgan chiroqlarni ko'rish uchun turg'alarni ko'tardim.

en: At ﬁrst I stared unintelligently across the London valley.
uz: Boshida men Londondagi vodiyning orqasidan o'zimni ko'rmagan holda ko'rdim.

en: The northern hills were shrouded in darkness; the ﬁres near Kensington glowed redly, and now and then an orange-red tongue of ﬂame ﬂashed up and vanished in the deep blue night.
uz: Shimoliy tog'lar qorong'ilikka to'lib-toshgan edi; Kensington yaqinidagi yong'inlar qizil rangda yoritilgan edi va vaqti-vaqti bilan olovning narxda-qizil tilini ko'p ko'k kechalarda ko'targan va yo'qolgan edi.

en: All the rest of London was black.
uz: Londonning qolgan qismi qora tanli edi.

en: Then, nearer, I per- ceived a strange light, a pale, violet- purple ﬂuorescent glow, quivering un- der the night breeze.
uz: Keyin, yaqinroq kelganimda, men bir g'ayrioddiy yorug'likni, rang-barang, violet-boshqash fluoresent shov-shuvni, kecha shamolidan titrab ko'rdim.

en: For a space I could not understand it, and then I knew that it must be the red weed from which this faint irradiation proceeded.
uz: Bir oz vaqt davomida men uni tushunolmadim, keyin esa bu yorug' nurlanish kelib chiqqan qizil begona o't bo'lishi kerakligini angladim.

en: With that realisation my dormant sense of wonder, my sense of the propor- tion of things, awoke again.
uz: O'sha tasavvur bilan hayratlanishimning uyqusidagi hissi, narsalarning nisbatini bilish hissi yana uyg'ondi.

en: I glanced from that to Mars, red and clear, glowing high in the west, and then gazed long and earnestly at the darkness of Hampstead and Highgate.
uz: Men o'sha yerdan qorong'i va yorug' bo'lib, g'arbda yoritib turgan Marsga qarab, Hampstead va Highgate qorong'iligiga uzoq va jiddiy qaradim.

en: I remained a very long time upon the roof, wondering at the grotesque changes of the day.
uz: Men juda uzoq vaqt davomida xonadonda qoldim va kunning gʻalati oʻzgarishlariga hayron qoldim.

en: I recalled my mental states from the midnight prayer to the foolish card-playing.
uz: Men o'sha paytdagi o'ylash holatlarini o'ylab ko'rdim: yarim kechasi ibodatidan boshlab, axmoqona karta o'yinlarigacha.

en: I had a violent revulsion of feeling.
uz: O'zimga kuchli his-tuyg'u tushdi.

en: I remember I ﬂung away the cigar with a certain wasteful symbolism.
uz: Xotira qilamanki, men bir xil ziyonli ramziylik bilan sigarani tashlab yubordim.

en: My folly came to me with glaring exaggeration.
uz: Mening aqlsizligim menga ko'rinmas darajada ko'tarildi.

en: I seemed a traitor to my wife and to my kind; I was ﬁlled with remorse.
uz: Xotinimga va o'z odamlarimga xiyonatchi kabi ko'rinardim; men afsus bilan to'ldim.

en: I resolved to leave this strange undisciplined dreamer of great things to his drink and gluttony, and to go on into London.
uz: Men bu g'ayrioddiy, intizomsiz buyuk narsalarga orzu qiluvchi odamni ichimlik va ochko'zlikka qoldirib, Londonga ketishga qaror qildim.

en: There, it seemed to me, I had the best chance of learning what the Martians and my fellowmen were doing.
uz: O'shanda men marsiyaliklar va o'z odamlarim nima qilayotganini o'rganish uchun eng yaxshi imkoniyatlarga ega bo'ldim.

en: I was still upon the roof when the late moon rose.
uz: Kechki oy ko'tarilganda men hali ham xonadonda edim.

en: CHAPTER 8 DEAD LONDON After I had parted from the artilleryman, I went down the hill, and by the High Street across the bridge to Fulham.
uz: 8 - bob O'lim Londoni Artilyerdan ajralib ketgandan so'ng, tog'dan pastga tushdim va Fulhamga boradigan ko'prikdan yuqori yo'l bo'ylab bordim.

en: The red weed was tumultuous at that time, and nearly choked the bridge roadway; but its fronds were already whitened in patches by the spreading disease that presently removed it so swiftly.
uz: O'sha paytda qizil begona o't g'alati edi va deyarli ko'prik yo'lni bo'g'ib qo'ygan edi; lekin uning barglari allaqachon tezda uni olib tashlagan tarqalgan kasallik tufayli qop-qorib oqlangan edi.

en: At the corner of the lane that runs to Putney Bridge station I found a man lying.
uz: Putney ko'prik stansiyasiga boradigan yo'l burchagida men bir odamni yolg'onchiqda topdim.

en: He was as black as a sweep with the black dust, alive, but helplessly and speechlessly drunk.
uz: U qora tuproq bilan to'ldirilganday qora edi, tirik edi, ammo yordamsiz va so'zsiz mast edi.

en: I could get nothing from him but curses and furious lunges at my head.
uz: Undan faqatgina la'natlar va g'azabga to'lib-toshgan g'alati so'zlarni eshitdim.

en: I think I should have stayed by him but for the brutal ex- pression of his face.
uz: O'ylaymanki, agar yuzidagi shafqatsiz bosim bo'lmaganida, men uning yonida qolishim kerak edi.

en: There was black dust along the roadway from the bridge onwards, and it grew thicker in Fulham.
uz: Ko'prikdan boshlab yo'l bo'ylab qora chang paydo bo'ldi va Fulhamda bu qoproq bo'ldi.

en: The streets were horribly quiet.
uz: Ko'chalar juda tinch edi.

en: I got food—sour, hard, and mouldy, but quite eatable—in a baker's shop here.
uz: Mening ovqatim qandoq, qattiq va o'tkir, lekin bu erda kekkachilik do'konida to'g'ri yeyilishi mumkin.

en: Some way to- wards Walham Green the streets became clear of powder, and I passed a white terrace of houses on ﬁre; the noise of the burning was an absolute re- lief.
uz: Walham Green shahriga borganimda, ko'chalar changdan toza bo'ldi va men olovga to'lgan uylarning oq terasidan o'tdim; yonishning shov-shuvlari esa o'ziga xosdi.

en: Going on towards Brompton, the streets were quiet again.
uz: Brompton tomon borayotganimizda, ko'chalar yana xotirjam bo'ldi.

en: Here I came once more upon the black powder in the streets and upon dead bodies.
uz: Mana, yana bir bor ko'chalardagi qora kukunni va o'liklarni ko'rdim.

en: I saw altogether about a dozen in the length of the Fulham Road.
uz: Fulham yo'li bo'ylab jami o'nlabni ko'rdim.

en: They had been dead many days, so that I hurried quickly past them.
uz: Ular ko'p kunlardan beri o'lik edilar, shuning uchun men ularni tezda o'tkazib yubordim.

en: The black powder covered them over, and softened their outlines.
uz: Qora kukun ularni yopiq qilib, ko'rinishlarini yumshatdi.

en: One or two had been disturbed by dogs.
uz: Bir yoki ikki kishini itlar bezovta qilgan edi.

en: Where there was no black powder, it was curiously like a Sunday in the City, with the closed shops, the houses locked up and the blinds drawn, the desertion, and the stillness.
uz: Qora tuproq yo'q joyda, shahardagi yakshanba kabi, do'konlar yopilgan, uylar qulflab qo'yilgan, pardalar ko'tarib qo'yilgan, desertsiya va tinchlik edi.

en: In some places plunderers had been at work, but rarely at other than the provision and wine shops.
uz: Ba'zi joylarda talonchilar ish joyida bo'lishgan, lekin faqatgina oziq-ovqat va sharob do'konlaridan tashqari boshqa joylarda kamdan-kam bo'lishgan.

en: A jeweller's window had been broken open in one place, but apparently the thief had been disturbed, and a number of gold chains and a watch lay scattered on the pavement.
uz: Bir joyda zargarlik oynasi ochilgan edi, ammo, ehtimol, o'g'ri buzib qo'yilgan bo'lsa kerak va ko'plab oltin zanjirlar va soat piyoda tarqalgan edi.

en: did not trouble to touch them.
uz: Ularga qo'l tegizishga qiynalmadi.

en: Farther on was a tattered woman in a heap on a doorstep; the hand that hung over her knee was gashed and bled down her rusty brown dress, and a smashed magnum of champagne formed a pool across the pavement.
uz: Keyinroq eshik ustunidagi to'plamda bo'lgan bir ayol bor edi; uning oyoq boshiga o'girilgan qo'li o'ldirildi va uning rang-barang rangli kiyimini qon bilan to'kib yubordi va buzilgan shampanj magnumini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

en: She seemed asleep, but she was dead.
uz: U uxlab yotgan ko'rinardi, lekin u o'lgan edi.

en: The farther I penetrated into London, the profounder grew the stillness.
uz: Londonga qanchalik yaqin kirsam, shuncha tinchlik o'sib borardi.

en: But it was not so much the stillness of death—it was the stillness of sus- pense, of expectation.
uz: Ammo bu o'limning xotirjamligi emas, balki fikr-mulohaza, kutish xotirjamligi edi.

en: At any time the destruction that had already singed the northwestern borders of the metropolis, and had annihilated Ealing and Kilburn, might strike among these houses and leave them smoking ruins.
uz: Metropolning shimoli-g'arbiy chegaralarini o'rab olgan va Ealing va Kilburnni yo'q qilgan vayronat bu uylar orasidan qaytib kelib, ularni halokatga aylantirishi mumkin.

en: It was a city condemned and derelict… In South Kensington the streets were clear of dead and of black powder.
uz: Bu hukm qilingan va tashlab ketilgan shahar edi... Janubiy Kensingtonda ko'chalar o'lik va qora kukundan toza edi.

en: It was near South Kensington that I ﬁrst heard the howling.
uz: O'sha payt South Kensington yaqinida birinchi marta qichqirishni eshitdim.

en: It crept almost imperceptibly upon my senses.
uz: U deyarli ko'rinmas ravishda his-tuyg'ularim ustiga kirib keldi.

en: It was a sobbing alternation of two notes, Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, keeping on perpetually.
uz: Bu ikki nuqta Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, deb o'zgartirilgan bir-biridan o'zgarib o'zgarib, ko'pincha davom etadi.

en: When I passed streets that ran northward it grew in volume, and houses and buildings seemed to dead- en and cut it off again.
uz: Shimoliy yo'ldan o'tgan ko'chalardan o'tganimda, u ko'paydi va uylar va binolar o'z-o'zidan o'tib, yana kesib ketadi.

en: It came in a full tide down Exhibition Road.
uz: Bu esa ko'rgazma yo'li bo'ylab to'la vaqt ichida sodir bo'ldi.

en: I stopped, staring towards Kensington Gardens, wondering at this strange, remote wailing.
uz: Men to'xtatdim va Kensington bog'lariga qarab, bu g'alati, uzoqdan yig'lab o'tirganini ko'rib hayron qoldim.

en: It was as if that mighty desert of houses had found a voice for its fear and solitude.
uz: O'sha uylarning qudratli sahrolari qo'rquv va yolg'izlik uchun ovoz topganidek edi.

en: Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, wailed that superhuman note—great waves of sound sweeping down the broad, sunlit roadway, between the tall buildings on each side.
uz: Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, - deb o'yladi insonlardan ustun bo'lgan notlar, har bir tomondagi baland binolar o'rtasida keng, quyoshli yo'l bo'ylab ovoz to'lqinlari.

en: I turned northwards, marvelling, towards the iron gates of Hyde Park.
uz: Men hayratda bo'lib, Hyde Parkning temir darvozalari tomon shimoliga qarab ketdim.

en: I had half a mind to break into the Natural History Museum and ﬁnd my way up to the summits of the towers, in order to see across the park.
uz: Tabiiy tarix muzeyiga kirib, bog'ni ko'rish uchun minoralarning cho'qqisigacha yo'l topishga o'zimning fikrim bor edi.

en: But I decided to keep to the ground, where quick hiding was possible, and so went on up the Exhibition Road.
uz: Ammo men tezda yashirish mumkin bo'lgan yerni saqlab qolishga qaror qildim va shuning uchun ko'rgazma yo'lidan bordim.

en: All the large mansions on each side of the road were empty and still, and my footsteps echoed against the sides of the houses.
uz: Yo'lning har bir tomonidagi barcha katta uylar bo'sh va to'sqin edi va qadamlarim uylarning yonlariga to'g'ri keldi.

en: At the top, near the park gate, I came upon a strange sight—a bus overturned, and the skeleton of a horse picked clean.
uz: Yuqorida, bog' darvozalari yaqinida men bir g'alati ko'rinishga duch keldim - avtobus burildi va otning skeletini tozaladi.

en: I puzzled over this for a time, and then went on to the bridge over the Serpentine.
uz: Men bu haqda bir muncha vaqt o'yladim va keyin Serpentine ko'prisiga bordim.

en: The voice grew stronger and stronger, though I could see nothing above the housetops on the north side of the park, save a haze of smoke to the northwest.
uz: Ovoz kuchayib borayotgan edi, ammo men parkning shimoliy tomonidagi xonadonlar ustida hech narsa ko'rmasdim, faqat shimol-g'arbiy tomondagi tutun bulutidan boshqa hech narsa ko'rmasdim.

en: Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, cried the voice, coming, as it seemed to me, from the district about Regent's Park.
uz: Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, - deb baqirdi ovoz, menga ko'rinishicha, Regent Park atrofidagi tumandan kelib turadi.

en: The desolating cry worked upon my mind.
uz: Qahramonlikni yo'qotgan qichqiriq ongimda ishladi.

en: The mood that had sustained me passed.
uz: Meni qo'llab-quvvatlagan ruhim o'tib ketdi.

en: The wailing took possession of me.
uz: Qichqiriq meni egallab oldi.

en: I found I was intensely weary, footsore, and now again hungry and thirsty.
uz: Men juda charchagan va charchagan bo'ldim va endi yana och va chanqoq edim.

en: It was already past noon.
uz: U allaqachon tushdan o'tib ketgan edi.

en: Why was I wandering alone in this city of the dead?
uz: Nima uchun men o'liklar shahri ichida yolg'iz yurardim?

en: Why was I alone when all London was lying in state, and in its black shroud?
uz: Nima uchun men yolg'iz bo'ldim, butun London o'z davlatida va uning qora qopqoqida yotgan bo'lsa?

en: I felt intolerably lonely.
uz: Men o'zimni juda yolg'iz his qildim.

en: My mind ran on old friends that I had for- gotten for years.
uz: Fikrim yillar davomida orttirgan eski do'stlarim haqida edi.

en: I thought of the poisons in the chemists' shops, of the liquors the wine merchants stored; I recalled the two sodden creatures of despair, who so far as I knew, shared the city with myself… I came into Oxford Street by the Marble Arch, and here again were black powder and several bodies, and an evil, ominous smell from the gratings of the cellars of some of the houses.
uz: Men kimyoviy do'konlardagi zaharlar, sharob savdogarlarining saqlagan ichimliklar haqida o'yladim; men o'zim bilganimcha, shaharni o'zim bilan bo'lishgan umidsizlikning ikki qudratli mavjudotlarini esladim... Men Oksford ko'chasini marmor arxi yonida bosib o'tdim va yana qora kukun va bir nechta jasadlar va ba'zi uylarning sotuvlarining qovuridan yovuz, dahshatli hid paydo bo'ldi.

en: I grew very thirsty after the heat of my long walk.
uz: Uzoq yurishimning issiqligidan keyin juda chanqadim.

en: With inﬁnite trouble I managed to break into a public-house and get food and drink.
uz: Ko'p qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganimda, jamoat uylariga kirib, ovqat va ichimlik sotib oldim.

en: I was weary after eating, and went into the parlour be- hind the bar, and slept on a black horsehair sofa I found there.
uz: Ovqatdan keyin charchagan edim va barning orqasidagi salonga kirdim va u yerda topgan qora ot sochli sofa ustida uxladim.

en: I awoke to ﬁnd that dismal howling still in my ears, Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla. It was now dusk, and after I had routed out some biscuits and a cheese in the bar—there was a meat safe, but it contained nothing but mag- gots—I wandered on through the silent residential squares to Baker Street —Portman Square is the only one I can name—and so came out at last upon Regent's Park.
uz: Men uyg'onib, quloqlarimda hali ham Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla deb qichqiriqlarni ko'rdim. Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla degan so'zlarni eshitganimda, endi kech kirgan edi va men bir nechta keksa va pishloqni barda olib tashlaganimdan so'ng, go'sht qutisi bor edi, lekin u yerda hech narsa yo'q edi.

en: And as I emerged from the top of Baker Street, I saw far away over the trees in the clearness of the sunset the hood of the Martian giant from which this howling proceeded.
uz: Baker ko'chasining yuqori qismidan chiqib ketayotganimda, quyosh botishining aniqligi ostida uzoqdagi daraxtlar ustida bu qichqiriqdan kelib chiqqan Mars urushi kabutini ko'rdim.

en: I came upon him as if it were a matter of course.
uz: Men unga o'zimni o'zim bilganim kabi duch keldim.

en: I watched him for some time, but he did not move.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt uni kuzatib turdim, lekin u hech narsa qilmadi.

en: He appeared to be standing and yelling, for no reason that I could discover.
uz: U turgan va qichqirishda edi, men buni aniqlay olmaganim uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q edi.

en: I tried to formulate a plan of action.
uz: Men harakat rejasini tuzishga harakat qildim.

en: That perpetual sound of Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, confused my mind.
uz: Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla ning doimiy ovozi ongimni chalg'itdi.

en: Perhaps I was too tired to be very fearful.
uz: Ehtimol men juda charchagan edim va juda qo'rqardim.

en: Certainly I was more curious to know the reason of this monotonous crying than afraid.
uz: Albatta, men qo'rqishdan ko'ra, bu monoton yig'lashning sababini bilishga ko'proq qiziqardim.

en: I turned back away from the park and struck into Park Road, intending to skirt the park, went along under the shelter of the terraces, and got a view of this stationary, howling Martian from the direction of St.
uz: Men parkdan yuz o'girib, Park yo'liga tushib, parkni chetlab o'tmoqchi bo'ldim, terasaning himoyasi ostida bordim va St.

en: A couple of hundred yards out of Baker Street I heard a yelp- ing chorus, and saw, ﬁrst a dog with a piece of putrescent red meat in his jaws coming headlong towards me, and then a pack of starving mongrels in pursuit of him.
uz: Baker ko'chasidan bir necha yuz metr uzoqlikda men yelp-ing chorusini eshitdim va birinchi navbatda, yonib-yotgan qizil go'shtning bir qismini bo'g'idalarida ko'rgan itni ko'rdim, keyin esa o'z orqamda och qolgan bir to'p qo'rqinchli qo'rqinchlar uni orqadan quvg'in qilishdi.

en: He made a wide curve to avoid me, as though he feared I might prove a fresh competitor.
uz: U mendan qochish uchun keng bo'g'ini qildi, xuddi men yangi raqib bo'lishimdan qo'rqqanidek.

en: As the yelping died away down the silent road, the wailing sound of Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, reasserted itself.
uz: Shoshilmas yo'ldan yelping o'lib ketayotganda, Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, degan qayg'u tovushi o'zini tasdiqladi.

en: I came upon the wrecked handling-machine halfway to St.
uz: Men St. Petersburgga borayotganda vayron bo'lgan mashinani uchratdim.

en: John's Wood station.
uz: John's Wood stantsiyasi.

en: At ﬁrst I thought a house had fallen across the road.
uz: Avvaliga men yo'lning o'rtasidan bir uy tushgan deb o'yladim.

en: clambered among the ruins that I saw, with a start, this mechanical Samson lying, with its tentacles bent and smashed and twisted, among the ruins it had made.
uz: O'zim ko'rgan vayronliklar orasidan, dastlab, bu mexanik Sanson o'tirib, tentakellari bo'g'ilib, parchalanib, burilgani bilan, o'zi yaratgan vayronliklar orasida o'tiribdi.

en: The forepart was shattered.
uz: Oldingi qism vayron bo'ldi.

en: It seemed as if it had driven blindly straight at the house, and had been overwhelmed in its overthrow.
uz: Ko'rinishicha, u ko'r bo'lib, uyga to'g'ri yo'l tutgan va o'z qulashi bilan o'z kuchini yo'qotgan.

en: It seemed to me then that this might have happened by a handling-machine escaping from the guidance of its Martian.
uz: O'shanda menga shunday tuyuldiki, bu o'z martianining yo'l-yo'riqidan qochib ketayotgan bir mashinada sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

en: I could not clamber among the ruins to see it, and the twilight was now so far advanced that the blood with which its seat was smeared, and the gnawed gristle of the Martian that the dogs had left, were invisible to me.
uz: Men uni ko'rish uchun vayronxonalar orasidan chiqib ketolmadim va kun yorug'ligi shunchalik oldinga yetib ketganki, uning o'rinbosari bilan to'ldirilgan qon va itlar qoldirgan marsiyaliklarning qovurilgan g'ishtlari menga ko'rinmas edi.

en: Wondering still more at all that I had seen, I pushed on towards Primrose Hill.
uz: Ko'rganlarimga yanada ko'proq hayron bo'lib, Primrose Hill tomon harakatlanardim.

en: Far away, through a gap in the trees, I saw a second Martian, as mo- tionless as the ﬁrst, standing in the park towards the Zoological Gardens, and silent.
uz: Uzoqda, daraxtlar orasidagi bo'shliq orqali, men ikkinchi marsiy odamni ko'rdim, u birinchi marsiy odam kabi harakatsiz edi, u bog'da zoologik bog'larga qarata turar edi va soʻzsiz edi.

en: A little beyond the ruins about the smashed handling-machine I came upon the red weed again, and found the Regent's Canal, a spongy mass of dark-red vegetation.
uz: Buzilgan mashinaning vayron bo'lganidan biroz o'tgach, men yana qizil o'tga duch keldim va Regent kanalini, qorong'i qizil o'simliklarning ko'plamli ko'plamini topdim.

en: As I crossed the bridge, the sound of Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, ceased.
uz: Ko'prikni kesib o'tayotganimda, Ulla, ulla, ulla, ulla, degan tovush to'xtadi.

en: It was, as it were, cut off.
uz: Demak, u kesilgan edi.

en: The silence came like a thunderclap.
uz: Shoshilish momaqaldiroq kabi keldi.

en: The dusky houses about me stood faint and tall and dim; the trees to- wards the park were growing black.
uz: Men atrofidagi qorong'i uylar o'z-o'zidan ko'p, baland va yomg'ir edi; bog'ning atrofidagi daraxtlar qoralashib borar edi.

en: All about me the red weed clambered among the ruins, writhing to get above me in the dimness.
uz: Butun atrofimdagi qizil begona o'tlar vayronliklar orasida o'rab-o'rab o'tirgan va so'nggi so'nggi so'zlar bilan mendan ustun bo'lishga harakat qilishgan.

en: Night, the moth- er of fear and mystery, was coming upon me.
uz: Qo'rquv va sirli kechasi menga yaqinlashdi.

en: But while that voice sounded the solitude, the desolation, had been endurable; by virtue of it London had still seemed alive, and the sense of life about me had upheld me.
uz: Ammo bu ovoz birginalik, vayronlik so'zlarini eshitganida, bu ko'tarilgan bo'ldi; bu tufayli London hali ham tirikdek ko'rindi va atrofimdagi hayotni his qilish meni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

en: Then sud- denly a change, the passing of something—I knew not what—and then a stillness that could be felt.
uz: Keyin to'satdan o'zgarish, biror narsa o'tib ketishi, nima ekanligini bilmasligim, keyin ham hissiyotga sazovor bo'lgan xotirjamlik paydo bo'ldi.

en: Nothing but this gaunt quiet.
uz: Faqat bu g'avlat xotirjamlikdir.

en: London about me gazed at me spectrally.
uz: Londonda meni ko'z o'ngida ko'rgan odamlar menga ko'z o'ngida ko'rinardi.

en: The windows in the white hous- es were like the eye sockets of skulls.
uz: Oq uydagi derazalar tengkalarning ko'z sohiblariga o'xshaydi.

en: About me my imagination found a thousand noiseless enemies moving.
uz: Mening tasavvurim haqida minglab g'ayratsiz dushmanlar harakatlanayotganini ko'rdim.

en: Terror seized me, a horror of my temerity.
uz: Men qo'rquvga tushdim, qo'rqqanimning dahshatini ko'rdim.

en: In front of me the road became pitchy black as though it was tarred, and I saw a contorted shape lying across the pathway.
uz: Oldimdagi yo'l o'tkir qora bo'lib ketdi, xuddi o'tkir bo'lganidek, va men yo'l bo'ylab o'tirgan buzilgan shaklni ko'rdim.

en: I could not bring myself to go on.
uz: O'zimni davom ettirishga majburlay olmadim.

en: John's Wood Road, and ran head- long from this unendurable stillness towards Kilburn.
uz: John's Wood Road yo'li, va bu chidamsiz xotirjamlikdan Kilburn tomon bosh-yo'q yugurdi.

en: I hid from the night and the silence, until long after midnight, in a cabmen's shelter in Harrow Road.
uz: Kechadan va xotirjamlikdan uzoq vaqt o'tgunga qadar Harrow yo'lidagi taksichilar uyida yashirindim.

en: But before the dawn my courage returned, and while the stars were still in the sky I turned once more towards Regent's Park.
uz: Ammo tong bo'lishidan oldin jasoratim qaytib keldi va yulduzlar hali osmonda bo'lganida, men yana Regent Park tomon burindim.

en: I missed my way among the streets, and presently saw down a long avenue, in the half-light
uz: Ko'chalar orasidagi yo'lni o'tkazib yubordim va yaqinda yarim yorug'likda uzoq yo'lni ko'rdim.

en: of the early dawn, the curve of Primrose Hill.
uz: Erta tongda, Primrose Hillning egriligi.

en: On the summit, towering up to the fading stars, was a third Martian, erect and motionless like the others.
uz: Charchayotgan yulduzlargacha baland bo'lgan sammitda uchinchi marsiyalik bor edi, u ham boshqa yulduzlar kabi to'g'ri va harakatsiz edi.

en: An insane resolve possessed me.
uz: Bir aqldan ozgan qaror meni egallab oldi.

en: I would die and end it.
uz: Men o'lib, bu ishni tugataman.

en: And I would save myself even the trouble of killing myself.
uz: Va hatto o'zimni o'ldirishning og'irligidan ham xalos bo'lardim.

en: I marched on recklessly to- wards this Titan, and then, as I drew nearer and the light grew, I saw that a multitude of black birds was circling and clustering about the hood.
uz: Men bu Titanni o'zboshimchalik bilan bosib o'tdim va keyin, yaqinlashib, yorug'lik ko'payganida, ko'pchilik qora qushlarning hovuz atrofida aylanib borayotganini ko'rdim.

en: At that my heart gave a bound, and I began running along the road.
uz: Shu payt yuragim o'zimni qo'zg'atdi va yo'l bo'ylab yugurishni boshladim.

en: I hurried through the red weed that choked St.
uz: Men St. Petersburgni cho'ktirgan qizil o't o'rtasida shovqin qildim.

en: Edmund's Terrace (I wad- ed breast-high across a torrent of water that was rushing down from the wa- terworks towards the Albert Road), and emerged upon the grass before the rising of the sun.
uz: Edmundning terasi (Men o'z ko'zimni ko'tarib, o'sha yerdan Albert yo'li yo'liga qarab oqib kelayotgan suv oqibati bo'ylab yurdim) va quyosh chiqishidan oldin o'tlar ustida paydo bo'ldi.

en: Great mounds had been heaped about the crest of the hill, making a huge redoubt of it—it was the ﬁnal and largest place the Martians had made—and from behind these heaps there rose a thin smoke against the sky.
uz: Tog'ning cho'qqisi atrofida ulkan to'plar to'plandi va bu marsiyaliklar yaratgan oxirgi va eng yirik joy edi.Bu to'plar orqasidan osmonga kamroq tutun ko'tarildi.

en: Against the sky line an eager dog ran and disappeared.
uz: Osmon chizig'iga qaraganda bir it yugurib ketdi va yo'qoldi.

en: The thought that had ﬂashed into my mind grew real, grew credible.
uz: Mening ongimga kelib tushgan fikr haqiqiy va ishonchli bo'ldi.

en: I felt no fear, only a wild, trembling exultation, as I ran up the hill towards the motionless mon- ster.
uz: Men qo'rquvni his qilmadim, faqat vahshiy, titrab-tirtirib quvonch his qildim, chunki tepalikka chiqib, harakatsiz yulduz tomon yugurdim.

en: Out of the hood hung lank shreds of brown, at which the hungry birds pecked and tore.
uz: Qo'rqinchli qushlar o'zlarining qo'rqinchli teshiklarini o'rab olib, qo'rqinchli teshiklarni qo'lga olishdi.

en: In another moment I had scrambled up the earthen rampart and stood upon its crest, and the interior of the redoubt was below me.
uz: Boshqa bir daqiqada men to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'g'ri to'ridan-to'g'ri to'ri to'g'ri to'ri to'g'ri to'ri to'g'ri to'ri bo'g'ridan bo'lib turdim.

en: A mighty space it was, with gigantic machines here and there within it, huge mounds of ma- terial and strange shelter places.
uz: U juda ulkan bo'lgan, u erda va u erda ulkan mashinalar, katta materiallar va g'ayrioddiy panoh joylari bo'lgan.

en: And scattered about it, some in their over- turned war-machines, some in the now rigid handling-machines, and a dozen of them stark and silent and laid in a row, were the Martians— DEAD!—slain by the putrefactive and disease bacteria against which their systems were unprepared; slain as the red weed was being slain; slain, after all man's devices had failed, by the humblest things that God, in his wis- dom, has put upon this earth.
uz: Va bu yerda tarqalib, ba'zilari o'zlarining o'zgartirilgan jang mashinalarida, ba'zilari hozirgi paytda qat'iy ishlaydigan mashinada, o'nlablari esa qat'iy va hushyor va qatorda o'tirgan edilar, marsiyaliklar o'lik edilar! o'zlarining tizimlari tayyorlanmagan buzuqlik va kasallik bakteriyalari tomonidan o'ldirilgan edilar; qizil o't o'ldirilganida o'ldirilgan edilar; barcha insoniy qurilmalar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganidan so'ng, Xudo o'z donoligi bilan yer yuziga qo'ygan eng kamtarin narsalar tomonidan o'ldirilgan edilar.

en: For so it had come about, as indeed I and many men might have foreseen had not terror and disaster blinded our minds.
uz: Chunki bu shunday sodir bo'lgan edi, albatta, men va ko'p odamlar qo'rquv va fojialiyat bizni ko'r qilmaganida edi.

en: These germs of disease have taken toll of humanity since the beginning of things— taken toll of our pre- human ancestors since life began here.
uz: Ushbu kasalliklarning bakteriyalari insoniyatni insoniyatning boshidan beri o'ldirgan, bu yerdagi hayot boshlanishidan beri bizning bashariy ota-bobolarimizning o'ldirgan.

en: But by virtue of this natural selec- tion of our kind we have developed resisting power; to no germs do we suc- cumb without a struggle, and to many—those that cause putrefaction in dead matter, for instance —our living frames are altogether immune.
uz: Ammo o'z turimizning bu tabiiy tanlanishi tufayli biz qarshilik ko'rsatishga qodir bo'ldik; biz hech qanday bakteriyaga qarshi kurashmasdan o'z kuchimizni yo'qotmaymiz va ko'pgina o'lik moddalarning buzilishiga sabab bo'lganlar, masalan, bizning tirik tuzilmalarimiz butunlay himoyalangan.

en: But there are no bacteria in Mars, and directly these invaders arrived, directly they drank and fed, our microscopic allies began to work their overthrow.
uz: Ammo Marsda bakteriyalar yo'q, va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bu bosqinchilar keldi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ular ichdilar va ovqatlandilar, bizning mikroskopik ittifoqchilarimiz ularni quvib yuborishga kirishdi.

en: Already when I watched them they were irrevocably doomed, dying and rotting even as they went to and fro.
uz: Men ularni ko'rganimda, ular o'lib ketayotganda o'lib ketib, o'lib ketishlariga qat'iy mahkum edilar.

en: By the toll of a bil- lion deaths man has bought his birthright of the earth, and it is his against all comers; it would still be his were the Martians ten times as mighty as they are.
uz: Bir milliard o'lim tufayli inson o'z ulug'lik huquqini sotib olgan va bu yer uning barcha odamlarga qarshi; agar marsiyaliklar ulardan o'n baravar kuchliroq bo'lganida, u hali ham uning bo'lardi.

en: For neither do men live nor die in vain.
uz: Insonlar behuda yashamaydi, behuda o'lmaydi.

en: Here and there they were scattered, nearly ﬁfty altogether, in that great gulf they had made, overtaken by a death that must have seemed to them as incomprehensible as any death could be.
uz: Bu yerda-bu yerda ular tarqalib ketishgan, deyarli ellik kishilar o'sha katta bo'shliqni bosib o'tgan edilar, o'lim ularga hech qanday o'lim bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada tushunarli bo'lmagan o'lim bilan o'tkazilgan.

en: To me also at that time this death was incomprehensible.
uz: O'shanda men uchun ham bu o'lim tushunarli emas edi.

en: All I knew was that these things that had been alive and so terrible to men were dead.
uz: Men faqat o'sha tirik va insonlar uchun dahshatli bo'lgan narsalarning o'lganini bilardim.

en: For a moment I believed that the destruc- tion of Sennacherib had been repeated, that God had repented, that the An- gel of Death had slain them in the night.
uz: Bir zum davomida men Sanxarivning yo'q qilinishi takrorlanganini, Xudo tavba qilganini, o'lim farishtasi ularni kechasi o'ldirganini his qildim.

en: I stood staring into the pit, and my heart lightened gloriously, even as the rising sun struck the world to ﬁre about me with his rays.
uz: Men chuqurlikka qarab turardim va yuragim ulug'vor tarzda yoritib ketdi, xuddi quyoshning chiqayotgan nurlari atrofimni o'chirib yuborganida.

en: The pit was still in darkness; the mighty engines, so great and wonderful in their power and complexity, so unearthly in their tortuous forms, rose weird and vague and strange out of the shadows towards the light.
uz: O't hali ham qorong'ilikda edi; kuchli dvigatellar, o'z kuchi va murakkabligi bilan juda buyuk va ajoyib, o'zlarining o'zgaruvchan shakllari bilan juda yerdan tashqari, soyalar orasidan yorug'likka qaraganda g'ayrioddiy, noma'lum va g'ayrioddiy tarzda ko'tarildilar.

en: A multitude of dogs, I could hear, fought over the bodies that lay darkly in the depth of the pit, far below me.
uz: Eshitganimcha, ko'pgina itlar mening pastligimda, chuqurlikdagi qorong'ilikda yotgan jasadlar uchun jang qilishgan.

en: Across the pit on its farther lip, ﬂat and vast and strange, lay the great ﬂying-machine with which they had been experimenting upon our denser atmosphere when decay and death arrested them.
uz: O'zining uzoqroq og'izidagi chuqurning o'rtasida, tekis va keng va g'ayrioddiy, katta uchuvchi mashina joylashgan edi, ular buzuqlik va o'lim ularni to'xtatganida, bizning zichroq atmosferamizda tajriba o'tkazgan edilar.

en: Death had come not a day too soon.
uz: O'lim bir kun ham tez kelmagan edi.

en: At the sound of a cawing overhead I looked up at the huge ﬁght- ing-machine that would ﬁght no more for ever, at the tattered red shreds of ﬂesh that dripped down upon the overturned seats on the summit of Prim- rose Hill.
uz: Boshning boshiga tushayotgan tovushdan ko'z oldimga qarab, endi hech qachon urushmas bo'lgan ulkan jang mashinasiga, Prim-rose Hillning tepaligidagi burilgan o'rindiqlarga tushib tushgan qizil go'sht maydonlariga qaradim.

en: I turned and looked down the slope of the hill to where, enhaloed now in birds, stood those other two Martians that I had seen overnight, just as death had overtaken them.
uz: Men orqamni o'zgartirib, tog'ning tepaligidan qarab, endi qushlar bilan to'lib-toshgan o'sha boshqa ikki martalik odamni ko'rdim, xuddi o'lim ularni o'rab olganida.

en: The one had died, even as it had been crying to its companions; perhaps it was the last to die, and its voice had gone on perpet- ually until the force of its machinery was exhausted.
uz: U o'lib ketgan edi, xuddi o'z sheriklariga qaytarib yurganidek; ehtimol, u o'lib qolgan oxirgi kishi edi va uning ovozi mashinasining kuch-quvvatini to'xtatgunga qadar davom etgan edi.

en: They glittered now, harmless tripod towers of shining metal, in the brightness of the rising sun.
uz: Ular endi yorqin quyoshning yorug'lig'ida, yorqin metalldan yasalgan zararsiz tripod tovorlari bilan parlashardi.

en: All about the pit, and saved as by a miracle from everlasting destruction, stretched the great Mother of Cities.
uz: O'sha chuqurlik atrofida bo'lgan va mo'ʼjizaviy tarzda abadiy yo'q qilinishdan qutqarilgan barcha narsalar buyuk shaharlar onasini uzatib turardi.

en: Those who have only seen London veiled in her sombre robes of smoke can scarcely imagine the naked clear- ness and beauty of the silent wilderness of houses.
uz: Londonni faqatgina uning qorong'i tutun kiyimlari bilan qoplangan holda ko'rganlar uylarning bevafo yovvoyi ahvolining yalang'och aniqligi va go'zalligini tasavvur qila olmaydilar.

en: Eastward, over the blackened ruins of the Albert Terrace and the splin- tered spire of the church, the sun blazed dazzling in a clear sky, and here
uz: Sharq tomonga qarab, Albert Terrassi va cherkovning bo'g'ilib ketgan spirtli spirtli cho'qqisining qora bo'lib qolgan vayronliklari ustida, ochiq osmonda quyosh parvarish qilib parvarish qilardi.

en: and there some facet in the great wilderness of roofs caught the light and glared with a white intensity.
uz: U yerda katta xonadon sahroidagi bir tomoni yorug'likni o'rab olib, oq rang bilan ko'rindi.

en: Northward were Kilburn and Hampsted, blue and crowded with houses; westward the great city was dimmed; and southward, beyond the Martians, the green waves of Regent's Park, the Langham Hotel, the dome of the Al- bert Hall, the Imperial Institute, and the giant mansions of the Brompton Road came out clear and little in the sunrise, the jagged ruins of Westmin- ster rising hazily beyond.
uz: Shimoliy tomondan Kilburn va Hampsted, ko'k va uylar bilan to'lgan edi; g'arb tomondan buyuk shahar ko'p bo'lgan edi; janubiy tomondan esa, marsiyaliklar ortidan Regent Park, Langham mehmonxonasi, Al-bert Hall, Imperial Institute va Brompton yo'li yirik uylari yashil to'lqinlar yorug'da ko'rinadi va quyosh chiqish paytida Westmin-sternning cho'qqiz cho'g'alaridagi xarobalari xavfli ravishda oshardi.

en: Far away and blue were the Surrey hills, and the towers of the Crystal Palace glittered like two silver rods.
uz: Uzoq va ko'k Surrey tog'lari bor edi va Kristal saroyining minoralari ikki kumush tayoq kabi shinam edi.

en: Paul's was dark against the sunrise, and injured, I saw for the ﬁrst time, by a huge gaping cavity on its western side.
uz: Poulning uylari quyosh chiqish paytida qorong'i edi va men birinchi marta g'arb tomoniga katta bo'sh bo'lgan yoriqni ko'rdim.

en: And as I looked at this wide expanse of houses and factories and church- es, silent and abandoned; as I thought of the multitudinous hopes and ef- forts, the innumerable hosts of lives that had gone to build this human reef, and of the swift and ruthless destruction that had hung over it all; when I realised that the shadow had been rolled back, and that men might still live in the streets, and this dear vast dead city of mine be once more alive and powerful, I felt a wave of emotion that was near akin to tears.
uz: Va men shu xonadonlar, fabrikalar va cherkovlarning bu keng maydoniga qaraganimda, xotirjam va tashlab ketilganda; bu insoniy resifni qurish uchun ko'pgina umidlar va kuch-qudratlar, ko'pgina hayotlar borligini va bularning barchasini bosib o'tgan tezkor va shafqatsiz halokatni o'ylayotganda; ko'z oldimga tushganda, soya o'zgarib ketganini va odamlar hali ham ko'chalarda yashashi mumkinligini va mening sevimli va ulkan o'lim shahri yana jonli va qudratli bo'lishi mumkinligini anglaganimda, ko'z yoshlarga o'xshaydigan tuyg'u to'lqinini his qildim.

en: The torment was over.
uz: Azob-azobi tugadi.

en: Even that day the healing would begin.
uz: Hatto o'sha kuni davolanish boshlanadi.

en: The sur- vivors of the people scattered over the country—leaderless, lawless, food- less, like sheep without a shepherd—the thousands who had ﬂed by sea, would begin to return; the pulse of life, growing stronger and stronger, would beat again in the empty streets and pour across the vacant squares.
uz: Qo'riqchi yo'lsiz, qonunsiz, oziq-ovqatsiz xalqning tirik qolganlari, cho'ponsiz qo'ylar kabi dengiz orqali qochib ketgan minglab kishilar qaytib kelishadi; hayot pulsi, kundan-kunga kuchliroq bo'lib, bo'sh ko'chalarda yana urib, bo'sh maydonlarda oqib ketadi.

en: Whatever destruction was done, the hand of the destroyer was stayed.
uz: Qayerda yo'q qilingan bo'lsa-da, yo'q qiluvchi qo'li qolmadi.

en: All the gaunt wrecks, the blackened skeletons of houses that stared so dismally at the sunlit grass of the hill, would presently be echoing with the hammers of the restorers and ringing with the tapping of their trowels.
uz: Qirg'izdagi quyoshli o'tga o'xshaydigan uylarning qoralashgan skeletlari va barcha vayronliklar, hozirda restoratorlarning martabasi bilan bir-birlariga javoban eshitib, o'zlarining qo'llari bilan qichqirishadi.

en: At the thought I extended my hands towards the sky and began thanking God.
uz: O'shanda men qo'llarimni osmonga ko'tarib, Xudoga shukr qilishni boshladim.

en: In a year, thought I—in a year… With overwhelming force came the thought of myself, of my wife, and the old life of hope and tender helpfulness that had ceased for ever.
uz: Bir yil o'tgach, bir yil o'tgach, o'zim, xotinim va abadiy yo'q bo'lgan umid va mehribonlik kabi eski hayot haqida o'ylash juda kuchli edi.

en: CHAPTER 9 WRECKAGE And now comes the strangest thing in my story.
uz: 9 - bob Yovuzlik va endi mening hikoyamda eng g'alati narsa keladi.

en: Yet, perhaps, it is not alto- gether strange.
uz: Ammo, ehtimol, bu hech qachon g'alati emas.

en: I remember, clearly and coldly and vividly, all that I did that day until the time that I stood weeping and praising God upon the summit of Primrose Hill.
uz: O'sha kuni qilgan ishimning barchasini aniq, sovuq va jonli eslayman, Primrose tog'ining cho'qqisida yig'lab, Xudoni ulug'lab turganimga qadar.

en: Of the next three days I know nothing.
uz: Keyingi uch kun haqida hech narsa bilmayman.

en: I have learned since that, so far from my being the ﬁrst discoverer of the Martian overthrow, several such wanderers as myself had already discovered this on the previous night.
uz: O'shandan beri, men marsiy avlodni birinchi kashf etgandan tashqari, o'zim kabi ko'pgina sayohatchilar buni oldingi kechada kashf etganini bilib oldim.

en: One man—the ﬁrst—had gone to St.
uz: Birinchi odam St. Petersburgga borgan edi.

en: Martin's-le- Grand, and, while I sheltered in the cabmen's hut, had contrived to telegraph to Paris.
uz: Martin-le-Grand, va men taksichilar cho'pkasida yashiringanimda, Parijga telegraf orqali borishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

en: Thence the joyful news had ﬂashed all over the world; a thousand cities, chilled by ghastly apprehensions, suddenly ﬂashed into frantic illuminations; they knew of it in Dublin, Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, at the time when I stood upon the verge of the pit.
uz: O'sha yerdan butun dunyoga quvonchli xabarlar tarqaldi; dahshatli qo'rquvlar dastidan sovuq bo'lgan minglab shaharlar birdan dahshatli yorug'likka tushib ketdi; Dublinda, Edinburgda, Manchesterda, Birmingemda men qabr bo'lib o'tirganimda, ular buni bilishgan.

en: Already men, weeping with joy, as I have heard, shouting and staying their work to shake hands and shout, were making up trains, even as near as Crewe, to descend upon London.
uz: Men eshitganimdek, erkaklar quvonchdan yig'lab, qo'l urish va qichqirish uchun qichqiriq qilib, ishlarida qolishardi, ular hatto Crewe kabi yaqin bo'lgan poezdlarni Londonga tushish uchun tayyorlab qo'yishardi.

en: The church bells that had ceased a fortnight since suddenly caught the news, until all Eng- land was bell-ringing.
uz: O'n ikki haftadan beri to'xtatilgan cherkov qo'ng'iroqlari to'satdan yangiliklarni eshitdi, butun ingliz yurti qo'ng'iroq qo'ng'iroqini eshitguniga qadar.

en: Men on cycles, lean-faced, unkempt, scorched along every country lane shouting of unhoped deliverance, shouting to gaunt, star- ing ﬁgures of despair.
uz: Velosipeddagi erkaklar, chiroyli yuzli, qo'pol, har bir qishloq yo'li bo'ylab yonib ketgan, umidsiz xalos etishni baqirib, g'alaba qozonish uchun baqirib, umidsizlikka uchraydigan suratlarni ko'tarib turadilar.

en: Across the Channel, across the Irish Sea, across the Atlantic, corn, bread, and meat were tearing to our re- lief.
uz: Kanaldan, Irlandiya dengizidan, Atlantika dengizidan o'tgach, don, don va go'sht bizning yurtimizga tushib qoldi.

en: All the shipping in the world seemed going Londonward in those days.
uz: O'sha paytlarda butun dunyodagi kemalar Londonga borayotgandek tuyulgan.

en: But of all this I have no memory.
uz: Ammo bularning barchasini eslay olmayman.

en: I drifted—a demented man.
uz: Men aqldan ozgan odamga aylanganman.

en: I found my- self in a house of kindly people, who had found me on the third day wan- dering, weeping, and raving through the streets of St.
uz: Men o'zimni mehribon odamlar uyida topdim, ular uchinchi kuni meni St. Petersburg ko'chalarida o'tirib, yig'lab-o'tirib, ko'rmay-ko'rmay ko'rgan edilar.

en: They have told me since that I was singing some insane doggerel about The Last Man Left Alive!
uz: O'sha paytdan beri menga So'nggi kishi tirik qoldi!

en: The Last Man Left Alive! Troubled as they were with their own affairs, these people, whose name, much as I would like to
uz: So'nggi odam tirik qoldi! - deb o'z ishlari bilan tashvishlanib, bu odamlarning ismlari, men ham ko'p o'ylayman

en: express my gratitude to them, I may not even give here, nevertheless cum- bered themselves with me, sheltered me, and protected me from myself.
uz: Ular uchun minnatdorligimni bildirish uchun, men bu erda hatto berolmayman, lekin ular men bilan muloqot qilishdi, meni himoya qilishdi va o'zimdan himoya qilishdi.

en: Apparently they had learned something of my story from me during the days of my lapse.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, ular mening hikoyamdan biroz o'rgangan edilar.

en: Very gently, when my mind was assured again, did they break to me what they had learned of the fate of Leatherhead.
uz: O'y-harakatlarim yana shak-shubhalanganda, ular Leatherheadning taqdirini bilib olganlarini menga muloyimlik bilan aytib berishdi.

en: Two days after I was impris- oned it had been destroyed, with every soul in it, by a Martian.
uz: Men hibsga olinganimdan ikki kun o'tgach, u o'z ichiga har bir jon bilan birga martian tomonidan yo'q qilingan edi.

en: He had swept it out of existence, as it seemed, without any provocation, as a boy might crush an ant hill, in the mere wantonness of power.
uz: O'shanda u o'zidan-o'zi hech qanday provokatsiya qilmasdan uni yo'q qilib tashlagan edi, chunki o'smir o'g'il shunchaki hokimiyatning befoydaligi tufayli shuma tog'ini ezib tashlashi mumkin edi.

en: I was a lonely man, and they were very kind to me.
uz: Men yolg'iz odam edim va ular menga juda mehribon bo'lishdi.

en: I was a lonely man and a sad one, and they bore with me.
uz: Men yolg'iz va qayg'uli odam edim va ular men bilan charchagan edilar.

en: I remained with them four days after my recovery.
uz: Men sog'ayganimdan to'rt kun o'tgach, ular bilan qoldim.

en: All that time I felt a vague, a growing craving to look once more on whatever remained of the little life that seemed so happy and bright in my past.
uz: O'sha vaqt davomida men o'tmishda juda baxtli va yorqin ko'rinadigan kichik hayotimdan qolgan narsalarni yana bir bor ko'rishni orttirib boradigan, ko'payib borayotgan ko'nglimni his qildim.

en: It was a mere hopeless desire to feast upon my misery.
uz: Bu mening azob-uqubatimdan zavqlanishim uchun umidsiz istak edi.

en: They did all they could to divert me from this morbidi- ty.
uz: Ular meni bu kasallikdan chalg'itish uchun qo'llaridan kelganini qildilar.

en: But at last I could resist the impulse no longer, and, promising faithfully to return to them, and parting, as I will confess, from these four-day friends with tears, I went out again into the streets that had lately been so dark and strange and empty.
uz: Ammo nihoyat, bu istakga qarshi tura olmadim va ularga qaytishga sodiqlik bilan va'da berib, to'rt kunlik do'stlarimdan ko'z yoshlar bilan ajralib ketayotganimni tan olib, so'nggi paytlarda juda qorong'u, g'alati va bo'sh bo'lgan ko'chalarga qaytdim.

en: Already they were busy with returning people; in places even there were shops open, and I saw a drinking fountain running water.
uz: Ular allaqachon qaytib kelayotgan odamlar bilan band edilar; ba'zi joylarda hatto do'konlar ochilgan edi va men ichimlik suvi oqib turgan buloqni ko'rdim.

en: I remember how mockingly bright the day seemed as I went back on my melancholy pilgrimage to the little house at Woking, how busy the streets and vivid the moving life about me.
uz: Wokingdagi kichkina uyga melanxollik bilan sayohat qilib qaytib borganimda, ko'chalar qanchalik mashg'ul va atrofimdagi hayot qanchalik hayajonli bo'lganini eslayman.

en: So many people were abroad every- where, busied in a thousand activities, that it seemed incredible that any great proportion of the population could have been slain.
uz: O'zga mamlakatlarda minglab ishlar bilan band bo'lgan odamlar shunchalik ko'p ediki, aholining katta qismi o'ldirilishi mumkinligi g'ayritabiiy tuyulgan.

en: But then I noticed how yellow were the skins of the people I met, how shaggy the hair of the men, how large and bright their eyes, and that every other man still wore his dirty rags.
uz: Ammo keyin men uchratgan odamlarning teri qanchalik sariq, erkaklarning sochlari qanchalik chiroyli, ko'zlari qanchalik katta va yorqinligini va har bir erkak hali ham o'z kirli kiyimlarini kiyganini payqadim.

en: Their faces seemed all with one of two expressions—a leaping exultation and energy or a grim resolution.
uz: Ularning yuzlari ikki ifodadan biriga o'xshaydi: quvonch va kuch-qudratga to'lib-toshadi yoki qorong'i qarorga ega bo'ldi.

en: Save for the expression of the faces, London seemed a city of tramps.
uz: Yuzlarning ifodasidan tashqari, Londonda ko'ngilsizliklar shahri ko'rinardi.

en: The vestries were indiscriminately distributing bread sent us by the French government.
uz: Vestiyerlar bizga frantsuz hukumati tomonidan yuborilgan nonni ajratib berishgan.

en: The ribs of the few horses showed dismally.
uz: Bir nechta otlarning qo'llari yomon ko'rindi.

en: Haggard special constables with white badges stood at the corners of every street.
uz: Har bir ko'cha burchagida oq nishonchalar bilan o'rnatilgan Haggard maxsus kontestblilari turardi.

en: I saw little of the mischief wrought by the Martians until I reached Wellington Street, and there I saw the red weed clambering over the buttresses of Waterloo Bridge.
uz: Men Velington ko'chasini qo'lga kiritmagunimcha, Marsliklar tomonidan sodir etilgan zararning ko'pini ko'rmadim, va u erda men Waterloo ko'prining ustunlari ustida qizil begona o'tlarni ko'rdim.

en: At the corner of the bridge, too, I saw one of the common contrasts of that grotesque time—a sheet of paper ﬂaunting against a thicket of the red weed, transﬁxed by a stick that kept it in place.
uz: Ko'prikning burchagida ham, o'sha g'alati davrning keng tarqalgan kontrastlaridan birini ko'rdim.Qizil begona o'tlarning cho'g'iga qarshi ko'tarilgan qog'oz varaqasi uni o'rnida ushlab turardi.

en: It was the placard of the ﬁrst newspaper to resume publication—the DAILY MAIL.
uz: Bu DAILY MAIL nashrini qayta nashr etgan birinchi gazetaning plakatidir.

en: I bought a copy for a blackened shilling I found in my pocket.
uz: O'zimning qopimda topgan qoralashtirilgan shillingga nusxa sotib oldim.

en: Most of it was in blank, but the solitary compositor who did the thing had amused himself by making a grotesque scheme of advertisement stereo on the back page.
uz: Ko'pchiligi bo'sh edi, ammo buni bajargan yolg'iz qo'shiqchi o'zini past sahifaga reklama stereolarining g'alati rejasi bilan zavqlantirgan edi.

en: The matter he printed was emotional; the news organisation had not as yet found its way back.
uz: U bosib chiqargan ma'lumotlar hissiy edi; yangilik tashkiloti hali o'z yo'lini topmagan edi.

en: I learned nothing fresh except that already in one week the examina- tion of the Martian mechanisms had yielded astonishing results.
uz: Men yangi hech narsa o'rgandim, faqat bir hafta ichida Mars mexanizmlarini o'rganish ajoyib natijalar keltirdi.

en: Among other things, the article assured me what I did not believe at the time, that the Secret of Flying, was discovered.
uz: Bu maqola menga o'sha paytda ishonmagan narsamni, jumladan, Uchuv sirining kashfi etilganligini ishontirdi.

en: At Waterloo I found the free trains that were taking people to their homes.
uz: Waterloo shahrida men odamlarni uylariga olib boradigan bepul poezdlarni topdim.

en: The ﬁrst rush was already over.
uz: Birinchi shovqin allaqachon tugadi.

en: There were few people in the train, and I was in no mood for casual conver- sation.
uz: Poyezdda kamdan-kam odamlar bor edi va men befarq muloqotga moyil emas edim.

en: I got a compartment to myself, and sat with folded arms, looking greyly at the sunlit devastation that ﬂowed past the windows.
uz: O'zim uchun bo'shxona sotib oldim va o'zimning qo'llarimni to'kib o'tirib, derazalardan o'tib o'tgan quyoshli vayronatga qurilib qaradim.

en: And just out- side the terminus the train jolted over temporary rails, and on either side of the railway the houses were blackened ruins.
uz: Terminusning chet tomonida poyezd vaqtincha poyezdlar ustida sarosimaga tushdi va temir yo'lning har ikki tomonida uylar qora bo'lib qolgan.

en: To Clapham Junction the face of London was grimy with powder of the Black Smoke, in spite of two days of thunderstorms and rain, and at Clapham Junction the line had been wrecked again; there were hundreds of out-of-work clerks and shopmen working side by side with the customary navvies, and we were jolted over a hasty relaying.
uz: Clapham Junctionda esa ikki kun davomida momaqaldor va yomg'ir yog'ishiga qaramay, Londondagi ko'rinish Black Smoke kukunidan qorong'i edi; Clapham Junctionda esa yo'l yana vayron bo'lgan edi; yuzlab ishsiz ishchilar va do'konchilar odatdagi dengiz qudratlari bilan yonma-yon ishlayotgan edi va biz shoshilinch relaying dastidan hayratlanardik.

en: All down the line from there the aspect of the country was gaunt and un- familiar; Wimbledon particularly had suffered.
uz: O'sha paytdan boshlab mamlakatning ko'rinishi ko'p bo'lmagan va tanish bo'lmagan edi; ayniqsa, Vimbledon azob chekdi.

en: Walton, by virtue of its un- burned pine woods, seemed the least hurt of any place along the line.
uz: Walton o'zining yonmagan borliq daraxtlari tufayli yo'l bo'yidagi eng kam zarar ko'rgan joyga o'xshaydi.

en: The Wandle, the Mole, every little stream, was a heaped mass of red weed, in appearance between butcher's meat and pickled cabbage.
uz: Wandle, Mole, har bir kichik oqim, butcher go'shti va pishirilgan cho'g'a o'rtasida ko'rinadigan qizil begona o'tlar to'plami edi.

en: The Surrey pine woods were too dry, however, for the festoons of the red climber.
uz: Biroq Surrey borliq o'rmonlari qizil tog' chizig'i uchun juda quruq edi.

en: Beyond Wimbledon, within sight of the line, in certain nursery grounds, were the heaped masses of earth about the sixth cylinder.
uz: Vimbledon tashqarisida, chiziqning ko'rinishi yaqinida, ba'zi bog'chalarda, taxminan oltinchi silindr atrofida yerning to'plami bor edi.

en: A number of people were standing about it, and some sappers were busy in the midst of it.
uz: Uning atrofida ko'plab odamlar turgan edi va ba'zi sapperlar uning o'rtasida mashg'ul bo'lishgan edi.

en: Over it ﬂaunted a Union Jack, ﬂapping cheerfully in the morning breeze.
uz: Uning ustida union-jak o'tkazilib, ertalabgi shamolda quvonch bilan o'tqazdi.

en: The nurs- ery grounds were everywhere crimson with the weed, a wide expanse of livid colour cut with purple shadows, and very painful to the eye.
uz: Kasalxonalar har joyda o'simlik bilan qizil, ko'z uchun juda og'riqli bo'lgan bo'lib, rang-barang rangli ko'rinish bo'lib, rang-barang soyalar bilan kesilgan edi.

en: One's gaze went with inﬁnite relief from the scorched greys and sullen reds of the foreground to the blue-green softness of the eastward hills.
uz: Birining ko'zlari oldindan ko'rinadigan o'tkir oq va qizil qizil ranglardan sharqiy tomondagi tog'larning ko'k-ko'k rangli yumshoqligiga cheksiz tasalli bilan o'tdi.

en: The line on the London side of Woking station was still undergoing re- pair, so I descended at Byﬂeet station and took the road to Maybury, past the place where I and the artilleryman had talked to the hussars, and on by the spot where the Martian had appeared to me in the thunderstorm.
uz: Woking stantsiyasining Londondagi yonidagi liniya hali ham qayta tiklanayotgan edi, shuning uchun men Byfleet stantsiyasidan tushdim va Mayburyga yo'l oldim, o'sha joydan o'tib, men va artilleriyan huzarlar bilan suhbatlashdik va momaqaldayoq marsiyalik menga paydo bo'lgan joyga o'tib bordim.

en: Here, moved by curiosity, I turned aside to ﬁnd, among a tangle of red fronds, the warped and broken dog cart with the whitened bones of the horse scattered and gnawed.
uz: Bu yerda men qiziquvchanlik tufayli o'girib, qizil barglar to'plamida buzilgan va parchalangan it aravachasini topdim, atning oqlangan suyaklari tarqalib, qovurilgan edi.

en: For a time I stood regarding these vestiges… .
uz: Bir muncha vaqt davomida men bu qoldiqlarni ko'rib turardim.

en: Then I returned through the pine wood, neck-high with red weed here and there, to ﬁnd the landlord of the Spotted Dog had already found burial, and so came home past the College Arms.
uz: So'ngra men o'simlik o'rmonidan qaytib keldim, bu erda-bu erda qizil o'tlar bilan bo'lgan bo'ynim baland edi, Spotted Dogning uy egasi allaqachon qabr topganini topdim va shuning uchun kollej qurollaridan o'tib uyga keldim.

en: A man standing at an open cot- tage door greeted me by name as I passed.
uz: Ochiq eshik oldida turgan bir kishi men o'tib ketayotganimda ismim bilan salomlashdi.

en: I looked at my house with a quick ﬂash of hope that faded immediately.
uz: Men o'z uyimga tezda umidvorlik bilan qaradim va bu umid darhol yo'q bo'ldi.

en: The door had been forced; it was unfast and was opening slowly as I approached.
uz: Eshik zorlangan edi; u mustahkam bo'lmagan va men yaqinlashayotganda sekin ochiladigan edi.

en: The curtains of my study ﬂuttered out of the open win- dow from which I and the artilleryman had watched the dawn.
uz: Ishxonamning pardalari men va to'qnashuvchining tongni kuzatib turgan ochiq ko'rgazma ostidan o'tib ketdi.

en: No one had closed it since.
uz: O'shandan beri uni hech kim yopmagan.

en: The smashed bushes were just as I had left them nearly four weeks ago.
uz: Buzilgan butalar men deyarli to'rt hafta oldin qoldirganimdek edi.

en: I stumbled into the hall, and the house felt empty.
uz: Men koridorga kirdim va uy bo'sh edi.

en: The stair car- pet was rufﬂed and discoloured where I had crouched, soaked to the skin from the thunderstorm the night of the catastrophe.
uz: Turg'a mashinasi buzilgan va ko'ylak bo'lib qolgan edi, men o'zimni qo'zg'atgan joyda bo'ldim, bu yovuzlik kechasi bo'lgan chaqmoqdan qorong'i bo'lib qoldi.

en: Our muddy footsteps I saw still went up the stairs.
uz: Ko'rgan maydoncha qadamlarimiz hali-haqiqatan ham poygachalarga ko'tarildi.

en: I followed them to my study, and found lying on my writing-table still, with the selenite paper weight upon it, the sheet of work I had left on the afternoon of the opening of the cylinder.
uz: Men ularni o'zimning studiyamga kuzatib borganimda, o'zimning yozish stolimda hali ham yotganini va selenit qog'ozining og'irligi ustida, silindrning ochilishida kechqurun qoldirgan ish varaqasini topdim.

en: For a space I stood reading over my abandoned arguments.
uz: O'zimning tashlab ketgan dalillarim ustidan o'qiganimda, bir oz vaqt o'tirdim.

en: It was a paper on the probable development of Moral Ideas with the development of the civilising process; and the last sen- tence was the opening of a prophecy: In about two hundred years, I had written, we may expect—— The sentence ended abruptly.
uz: Bu axloqiy g'oyalarning rivojlanishi va sivilizatsiya jarayonining rivojlanishi haqidagi maqola edi; so'nggi ma'no esa bashoratning ochilishidir: Yoxti ikki yuz yildan keyin, deb yozgan edim, biz kutishimiz mumkin Bu jumla to'satdan tugagani edi.

en: I remembered my inability to ﬁx my mind that morning, scarcely a month gone by, and how I had broken off to get my DAILY CHRONICLE from the newsboy.
uz: O'sha kuni ertalab, bir oy o'tgach, o'zimni o'ylashga qodir bo'lmasligimni va kundalik xronikaimni gazetachidan olish uchun qanday to'xtatganimni esladim.

en: I remembered how I went down to the garden gate as he came along, and how I had listened to his odd story of Men from Mars. I came down and went into the dining room.
uz: U kelganida men bog' darvozalariga tushganimni va uning Marsdan kelgan odamlar haqidagi g'alati hikoyasini tinglaganimni esladim.

en: There were the mutton and the bread, both far gone now in decay, and a beer bottle overturned, just as I and the artilleryman had left them.
uz: Qo'zi va non bor edi, ikkalasi ham endi buzib ketibdi, bir qadah piva ham o'tib ketdi, xuddi men va to'qnashuvchi ularni qoldirib ketgandek.

en: My home was desolate.
uz: Mening uyim vayron edi.

en: I perceived the folly of the faint hope I had cherished so long.
uz: Men shuncha vaqt davomida qadr-qimmatimni ko'rsatgan umidning ahmoqligini tushundim.

en: And then a strange thing oc- curred.
uz: Keyin bir g'alati narsa paydo bo'ldi.

en: It is no use, said a voice.
uz: Bu foydasi yo'q, - dedi bir ovoz.

en: The house is deserted.
uz: Uyning xonasi bo'lak qolgan.

en: here these ten days.
uz: Bu o'n kun davomida bu yerda.

en: Do not stay here to torment yourself.
uz: O'zingizni azoblash uchun bu yerda qolmang.

en: No one escaped but you. I was startled.
uz: Sizdan boshqa hech kim qochib ketmadi. - deb qo'rqdim.

en: Had I spoken my thought aloud?
uz: Fikrimni baland ovoz bilan aytdimmi?

en: I turned, and the French window was open behind me.
uz: Men o'girib, orqamdan frantsuz deraza ochildi.

en: I made a step to it, and stood looking out.
uz: Men unga qadam qo'yib, diqqat bilan qaradim.

en: And there, amazed and afraid, even as I stood amazed and afraid, were my cousin and my wife—my wife white and tearless.
uz: O'zim qo'rqib va hayron turganimda, o'sha yerda kuzim va xotinim - xotinim oq va ko'z yoshsiz edi.

en: She gave a faint cry.
uz: O'sha paytda u o'z ko'zidan ko'p yig'ladi.

en: I knew—knew—— She put her hand to her throat—swayed.
uz: Men bilardim - deb qo'lini qo'lini qo'yib qo'ydi.

en: I made a step forward, and caught her in my arms.
uz: Men bir qadam oldinga ko'tardim va uni qo'limga oldim.

en: CHAPTER 10 THE EPILOGUE I cannot but regret, now that I am concluding my story, how little I am able to contribute to the discussion of the many debatable questions which are still unsettled.
uz: 10 - bob Epilog'da hikoyamni yakunlayotganimda, hali ham hal qilinmagan ko'plab bahsli savollar muhokamasiga qanchalik oz hissa qo'shayotganimdan afsuslanaman.

en: In one respect I shall certainly provoke criticism.
uz: Bir tomondan men tanqidga sabab bo'lishim kerak.

en: My particu- lar province is speculative philosophy.
uz: Xususan mening viloyatim spekulativ falsafadadir.

en: My knowledge of comparative phys- iology is conﬁned to a book or two, but it seems to me that Carver's sug- gestions as to the reason of the rapid death of the Martians is so probable as to be regarded almost as a proven conclusion.
uz: Mening taqqoslash fiziologiyasi haqidagi bilimim bir-ikki kitobga cheklangan, ammo menga Carverning marsiyaliklar tez o'lishining sababi bo'yicha takliflari deyarli isbotlangan xulosa deb hisoblanishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada ehtimoldan yiroq emas.

en: I have assumed that in the body of my narrative.
uz: Men buni o'z hikoyamda nazarda tutganman.

en: At any rate, in all the bodies of the Martians that were examined after the war, no bacteria except those already known as terrestrial species were found.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, urushdan so'ng ko'rib chiqilgan marsiyaliklarning barcha jasadlarida yer yuzidagi turlardan tashqari hech qanday bakteriya topilmagan.

en: That they did not bury any of their dead, and the reckless slaughter they perpetrated, point also to an entire ignorance of the putrefactive process.
uz: Ular o'z o'liklaridan hech kimni ko'mmaganligi va o'zlarining beparvo qirg'inliklari bularning barchasi bu parchalanish jarayoni haqida butunlay bexabarlikni ko'rsatadi.

en: But probable as this seems, it is by no means a proven conclusion.
uz: Ammo bu ehtimoldan yiroq emas, lekin bu hech qachon isbotlangan xulosa emas.

en: Neither is the composition of the Black Smoke known, which the Mar- tians used with such deadly effect, and the generator of the Heat- Rays re- mains a puzzle.
uz: Martianlar o'ta o'ldiruvchi ta'sir bilan ishlatgan qora tutunning tarkibi ham ma'lum emas va issiqlik nurlarining generatorlari puzzlni qayta yaratadi.

en: The terrible disasters at the Ealing and South Kensington laboratories have disinclined analysts for further investigations upon the lat- ter.
uz: Ealing va Janubiy Kensington laboratoriyalarida sodir bo'lgan dahshatli ofatlar tahlilchilarni oxirgi hodisalarni ko'proq o'rganishga undamagan.

en: Spectrum analysis of the black powder points unmistakably to the pres- ence of an unknown element with a brilliant group of three lines in the green, and it is possible that it combines with argon to form a compound which acts at once with deadly effect upon some constituent in the blood.
uz: Qora kukunning spektrli tahlili yashil rangdagi uchta chiziqdan iborat chiroyli guruhga ega bo'lgan noma'lum elementning mavjudligini aniq ko'rsatadi va u argon bilan birgalikda qondagi biron bir tarkibiy qismga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatadigan birikmani hosil qilish mumkin.

en: But such unproven speculations will scarcely be of interest to the general reader, to whom this story is addressed.
uz: Ammo bunday isbotlanmagan taxminlar ushbu hikoya yo'naltirilgan umumiy o'quvchi uchun qiziqish uyg'otmaydi.

en: None of the brown scum that drift- ed down the Thames after the destruction of Shepperton was examined at the time, and now none is forthcoming.
uz: Shepperton vayron bo'lganidan so'ng Temza daryosi bo'ylab ko'tarilgan ko'k buzuqlarning hech biri o'sha paytda tekshirilmagan va hozirgi paytda ham hech biri tekshirilmagan.

en: The results of an anatomical examination of the Martians, so far as the prowling dogs had left such an examination possible, I have already given.
uz: Marsliklarning anatomiyaviy tekshiruv natijalarini, agar aylanuvchi itlar bunday tekshiruvni amalga oshirish imkonini bergan bo'lsalar, men allaqachon taqdim etganman.

en: But everyone is familiar with the magniﬁcent and almost complete speci- men in spirits at the Natural History Museum, and the countless drawings that have been made from it; and beyond that the interest of their physiolo- gy and structure is purely scientiﬁc.
uz: Ammo tabiiy tarix muzeyidagi ajoyib va deyarli to'liq ruhiy hayvonlar va ulardan ko'pgina rasmlar bilan har kim tanish; bundan tashqari ularning fiziologiya va tuzilishi qiziqishi sof ilmiy.

en: A question of graver and universal interest is the possibility of another attack from the Martians.
uz: O'ta jiddiy va umumjahon manfaatdor masala - bu marsiyaliklar tomonidan yana bir hujum qilish ehtimoli.

en: I do not think that nearly enough attention is be- ing given to this aspect of the matter.
uz: Menimcha, bu masalaga deyarli yetarlicha e'tibor qaratilmayapti.

en: At present the planet Mars is in con- junction, but with every return to opposition I, for one, anticipate a renewal of their adventure.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda Mars sayyorasi bir-biri bilan bog'liq, ammo har safar qarshilikka qaytganimda, men ularning sarguzashtlarining yangilanishini kutaman.

en: In any case, we should be prepared.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, biz tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak.

en: It seems to me that it should be possible to deﬁne the position of the gun from which the shots are discharged, to keep a sustained watch upon this part of the planet, and to anticipate the arrival of the next attack.
uz: Menga o'xshaydiki, o'qlarni chiqaradigan qurolning joyini aniqlash, sayyoramizning bu qismini doimiy ravishda kuzatib turish va keyingi hujumni oldindan kutish mumkin.

en: In that case the cylinder might be destroyed with dynamite or artillery before it was sufﬁciently cool for the Martians to emerge, or they might be butchered by means of guns so soon as the screw opened.
uz: Bunday holatda silindr dynamit yoki artilleriya bilan yo'q qilinishi mumkin, agar u martliklar ko'tarilishlari uchun yetarlicha sovuq bo'lmasdan oldin, yoki ular pichoq ochilganidan so'ng qurollar yordamida so'yilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: It seems to me that they have lost a vast advantage in the failure of their ﬁrst surprise.
uz: Menga o'xshaydiki, ular birinchi kutilmagan ishlarida katta afzallikni yo'qotib qo'yishdi.

en: Pos- sibly they see it in the same light.
uz: Ehtimol, ular buni bir xil ko'rinishda ko'rishadi.

en: Lessing has advanced excellent reasons for supposing that the Martians have actually succeeded in effecting a landing on the planet Venus.
uz: Lessing, marsiylar Venus sayyoralariga tushishda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishlarini taxmin qilish uchun ajoyib sabablarni taqdim etdi.

en: Seven months ago now, Venus and Mars were in alignment with the sun; that is to say, Mars was in opposition from the point of view of an observer on Venus.
uz: Yetti oy oldin Venera va Mars Quyosh bilan to'g'rilashuvda edilar; ya'ni Mars Veneradagi kuzatuvchi nuqtai nazaridan qarama-qarshi edi.

en: Subsequently a peculiar luminous and sinuous marking appeared on the unillumined half of the inner planet, and almost simultaneously a faint dark mark of a similar sinuous character was detected upon a photograph of the Martian disk.
uz: Keyinchalik ichki sayyoraning yorug'liksiz yarmida o'zgacha yorug'lik va bo'lak belgilari paydo bo'ldi va deyarli bir vaqtning o'zida Mars diskining fotosuratida o'xshash bo'lak belgilarining chiroyli qorong'i belgilari aniqlandi.

en: One needs to see the drawings of these appearances in or- der to appreciate fully their remarkable resemblance in character.
uz: Ularning ajoyib o'xshashligini to'liq tushunish uchun bu ko'rinishlarning chizmalarini ko'rish kerak.

en: At any rate, whether we expect another invasion or not, our views of the human future must be greatly modiﬁed by these events.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, biz yana bir invasionni kutyapmizmi yoki yo'qmi, bu hodisalar insoniyat kelajagi haqidagi tasavvurlarimizni keskin o'zgartirishi kerak.

en: We have learned now that we cannot regard this planet as being fenced in and a secure abid- ing place for Man; we can never anticipate the unseen good or evil that may come upon us suddenly out of space.
uz: Hozir bilib oldikki, biz ushbu sayyorani inson uchun to'siq va xavfsiz yashash joy deb hisoblay olmaymiz; biz hech qachon ko'rinmas yaxshi yoki yomonlikni ko'rmaymiz.

en: It may be that in the larger design of the universe this invasion from Mars is not without its ultimate beneﬁt for men; it has robbed us of that serene conﬁdence in the future which is the most fruitful source of decadence, the gifts to human science it has brought are enormous, and it has done much to promote the conception of the com- monweal of mankind.
uz: Ehtimol, koinotning keng ko'lamli dizayni bo'yicha, Marsdan kelgan bu invaziya insonlar uchun o'zining eng yaxshi foydasi yo'qdir; bu bizga o'tkinchilikning eng samarali manbai bo'lgan kelajakka bo'lgan ishonchni o'g'irlab qo'ygan, inson ilm-fanini o'ziga jalb qilgan sovg'alar ulkan va u insoniyatning umumiy farovonligi tasavvurini rivojlantirishda katta yordam bergan.

en: It may be that across the immensity of space the Mar- tians have watched the fate of these pioneers of theirs and learned their les-
uz: Ehtimol, kosmosning kengligi bo'ylab martianlar o'zlarining bu kashshoflarining taqdirini kuzatib, o'z darslarini o'rganishgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: son, and that on the planet Venus they have found a securer settlement.
uz: va Venus sayyorasida ular xavfsizroq joy topganini aytishdi.

en: Be that as it may, for many years yet there will certainly be no relaxation of the eager scrutiny of the Martian disk, and those ﬁery darts of the sky, the shooting stars, will bring with them as they fall an unavoidable apprehen- sion to all the sons of men.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, ko'p yillar davomida marsiy diskni sinchkovlik bilan tekshirib ko'rish hech qanday xalos bo'lmaydi va osmondagi o'tli o'qlar, o'tib ketadigan yulduzlar, ular tushib ketganda barcha insonlar uchun qo'rqinch keltiradi.

en: The broadening of men's views that has resulted can scarcely be exagger- ated.
uz: Natijada erkaklarning fikrlash tarzi kenglashgani esa, chindan ham o'lchab bo'lmaydi.

en: Before the cylinder fell there was a general persuasion that through all the deep of space no life existed beyond the petty surface of our minute sphere.
uz: Silindr tushib ketishidan oldin, keng keng ko'lamdagi koinotda bizning kichik sferamizning kichik yuzidan tashqarida hech qanday hayot mavjud emasligi haqida umumiy e'tiqod bor edi.

en: If the Martians can reach Venus, there is no reason to suppose that the thing is impossible for men, and when the slow cooling of the sun makes this earth uninhabitable, as at last it must do, it may be that the thread of life that has begun here will have streamed out and caught our sister planet within its toils.
uz: Agar marsiylar Veneraga yetib borsalar, bu insonlar uchun imkonsiz deb taxmin qilishning hech qanday asoslari yo'q va quyoshning sekin sovutishi bu yerni yashashi mumkin bo'lmagan qilib qo'yganida, nihoyat bu shunday bo'lishi kerak, ehtimol, bu yerda boshlangan hayot tarzi o'tib chiqib, opamiz sayyoramizni o'z ishida tutgan bo'lishi mumkin.

en: Dim and wonderful is the vision I have conjured up in my mind of life spreading slowly from this little seed bed of the solar system throughout the inanimate vastness of sidereal space.
uz: Quyosh tizimining bu kichkina urug'li yotoqidan sayyora kosmosining jonsiz kengligi bo'ylab sekin-sekin tarqalgan hayot haqida o'yladim.

en: But that is a remote dream.
uz: Ammo bu uzoq orzu.

en: It may be, on the other hand, that the destruction of the Martians is only a reprieve.
uz: Boshqa tomondan, marsiyaliklarning yo'q qilinishi faqat bir muddatga teng bo'lishi mumkin.

en: To them, and not to us, perhaps, is the future ordained.
uz: Ehtimol, kelajak biz uchun emas, balki ular uchun belgilab qo'yilgan.

en: I must confess the stress and danger of the time have left an abiding sense of doubt and insecurity in my mind.
uz: Shuni tan olishim kerakki, o'sha davrdagi stress va xavf-xatar mening ongimda doimiy shubha va xavfsizlikni qoldirdi.

en: I sit in my study writing by lamp- light, and suddenly I see again the healing valley below set with writhing ﬂames, and feel the house behind and about me empty and desolate.
uz: Ishxonamda chiroq yoritib yozaman va to'satdan pastdagi davolash vodiysi yonayotgan olov bilan to'lib-toshganini ko'rib, ortimdagi va atrofimdagi uyni bo'sh va charchagan his qilaman.

en: I go out into the Byﬂeet Road, and vehicles pass me, a butcher boy in a cart, a cabful of visitors, a workman on a bicycle, children going to school, and suddenly they become vague and unreal, and I hurry again with the ar- tilleryman through the hot, brooding silence.
uz: Men Byfleet yo'liga chiqib ketaman va transport vositalari yonimdan o'tadi, aravachaga o'tirgan qilichboz o'g'li, tashrif buyuruvchilar to'la taksi, velosipedda ishchi, maktabga borayotgan bolalar, birdan ular nodon va haqiqiy bo'lib qolmaydi, men issiq, g'alati so'zsizlikka o'tgach, artiller bilan yana shoshilishga harakat qilaman.

en: Of a night I see the black pow- der darkening the silent streets, and the contorted bodies shrouded in that layer; they rise upon me tattered and dog-bitten.
uz: Bir kechaning qora to'g'rimini ko'rib, sukut saqlashli ko'chalarni qorong'u qilib qo'yganman va bu qatlamga to'lib-toshgan buzg'unlangan tanani ko'ryapman; ular menga bo'g'ib ketgan va itning urishi bilan ko'tariladi.

en: They gibber and grow ﬁercer, paler, uglier, mad distortions of humanity at last, and I wake, cold and wretched, in the darkness of the night.
uz: Ular g'alati bo'lib, nihoyat insoniyatning qizg'inroq, soyaroq, yomonroq va aqldan ozgan buzilishlariga aylanadilar va men kechasi qorong'ilikda sovuq va qashshoq holda uyg'onaman.

en: I go to London and see the busy multitudes in Fleet Street and the Strand, and it comes across my mind that they are but the ghosts of the past, haunt- ing the streets that I have seen silent and wretched, going to and fro, phan- tasms in a dead city, the mockery of life in a galvanised body.
uz: Londonga borib, Fleet Street va Stranddagi mashhur xaloyiqni ko'rsam, ular o'tmishda ko'rgan ko'chalarimni bezovta qilib, bechora va nozik ko'rganman, bu yerga va bu yerga boryapman, o'lik shaharda jon kuydirib yuryapman, galvanizatsiya qilingan badandagi hayotning masxara qilyapman, deb o'ylayman.

en: And strange, too, it is to stand on Primrose Hill, as I did but a day before writing this last chapter, to see the great province of houses, dim and blue through the haze of the smoke and mist, vanishing at last into the vague lower sky, to see the
uz: Primrose tepalig'ida turib, oxirgi bobni yozishdan bir kun oldin qilganimdek, katta uylar viloyatini ko'rish juda ajablanarli, bug'u tutun va g'urug'ning bulg'asiga o'xshaydi, oxir-oqibat ko'rinmas osmonga o'tib ketadi.

en: people walking to and fro among the ﬂower beds on the hill, to see the sight-seers about the Martian machine that stands there still, to hear the tu- mult of playing children, and to recall the time when I saw it all bright and clear-cut, hard and silent, under the dawn of that last great day… And strangest of all is it to hold my wife's hand again, and to think that I have counted her, and that she has counted me, among the dead.
uz: Odamlar togʻdagi gullar toʻplari orasida yurib, oʻsha yerda toʻxtamay turgan Mars mashinasini koʻrishni, bolalar oʻynashining koʻpligini eshitishni va oʻsha oxirgi ulugʻ kunning tongida hamma narsani yorqin va aniq, qattiq va xotirjam koʻrgan paytlarni eslab qolishni... Va eng gʻayrioddiy narsa, xotinimning qoʻlini yana ushlab, uni sanab qoʻyganimni va u meni oʻliklar orasida sanab qoʻyganini oʻylashdir.

en: This house, with its slate-covered roof, was built between a passage-way and a narrow street that led to the river.
uz: Bu uy, shifer bilan qoplangan tom bilan, yo'lak va daryoga olib boruvchi tor ko'cha o'rtasida qurilgan edi.

en: The interior was so unevenly graded that it caused people to stumble.
uz: Ichki qism shunchalik notekis baholangan ediki, odamlarning qoqilib ketishiga sabab bo'ldi.

en: A narrow hall separated the kitchen from the parlour, where Madame Aubain sat all day in a straw armchair near the window.
uz: Oshxonani mehmonxonadan tor zal ajratib turardi, u yerda Madame Aubain butun kun davomida deraza yonidagi somon kresloda o'tirardi.

en: Eight mahogany chairs stood in a row against the white wainscoting.
uz: Sakkizta marjonli stul oq mayinkalar ustida qatorda turardi.

en: An old piano, standing beneath a barometer, was covered with a pyramid of old books and boxes.
uz: Barometr ostida turgan eski pianino eski kitoblar va qutilarning piramidi bilan qoplangan edi.

en: On either side of the yellow marble mantelpiece, in Louis XV.
uz: Sariq marmar chodirning ikki tomonida, Lyudovik XV da.

en: style, stood a tapestry armchair.
uz: Uslub, duradgorlik kreslosida turardi.

en: The clock represented a temple of Vesta; and the whole room smelled musty, as it was on a lower level than the garden.
uz: Soat Vesta ibodatxonasini ifodalardi; va butun xona g'ovak hidni his qilardi, chunki u bog'dan pastroq edi.

en: On the first floor was Madame’s bed-chamber, a large room papered in a flowered design and containing the portrait of Monsieur dressed in the costume of a dandy.
uz: Birinchi qavatda Madamning yotoq xonasi joylashgan edi, unda gullar bilan bezatilgan va dandy libosida kiyingan janob portretini o'z ichiga olgan katta xona bor edi.

en: It communicated with a smaller
uz: U kichikroq bilan muloqot qildi.

en: room, in which there were two little cribs, without any mattresses.
uz: Xona, unda hech qanday matrassiz ikkita kichkina karavot bor edi.

en: Next, came the parlour (always closed), filled with furniture covered with sheets.
uz: Keyin, doimo yopiq bo'lgan, choyshablar bilan qoplangan mebellar bilan to'ldirilgan salon keldi.

en: Then a hall, which led to the study, where books and papers were piled on the shelves of a book-case that enclosed three quarters of the big black desk.
uz: Keyin zal, u yerda kitoblar va qog'ozlar katta qora stolning uch chorak qismini o'rab turgan kitob javonining javonlariga to'plangan edi.

en: Two panels were entirely hidden under pen-and-ink sketches, Gouache landscapes and Audran engravings, relics of better times and vanished luxury.
uz: Ikki panel qalam va siyoh bilan ishlangan eskizlar, Gouache landshaftlari va Audran o'ymalari, yaxshiroq davrlar qoldiqlari va yo'qolgan hashamat ostida butunlay yashiringan edi.

en: On the second floor, a garret-window lighted Felicite’s room, which looked out upon the meadows.
