uz: Ikkinchi qavatda, Felicitning o'tloqlarga qaragan xonasini garret-deraza yoritib turardi.

en: She arose at daybreak, in order to attend mass, and she worked without interruption until night; then, when dinner was over, the dishes cleared away and the door securely locked, she would bury the log under the ashes and fall asleep in front of the hearth with a rosary in her hand.
uz: U tong otishida turib, namozga bordi va kechgacha tinimsiz ishladi; keyin, kechki ovqat tugagach, idishlar tozalanib, eshik mahkam qulflangandan so'ng, yog'ochni kul ostida ko'mib, qo'lida tasbeh bilan o'choq oldida uxlardi.

en: Nobody could bargain with greater obstinacy, and as for cleanliness, the lustre on her brass sauce-pans was the envy and despair of other servants.
uz: Hech kim undan ko'ra ko'proq qaysarlik bilan kelisha olmas edi, va tozalikka kelsak, uning mis sous-panidagi yaltiroqligi boshqa xizmatchilarning hasadi va umidsizlikidir.

en: She was most economical, and when she ate she would gather up crumbs with the tip of her finger, so that nothing should be wasted of the loaf of bread weighing twelve pounds which was baked especially for her and lasted three weeks.
uz: U juda tejamkor edi va yeyayotganda barmog'ining uchi bilan mayda-chuyda mayda non yig'ardi, shunda o'zi uchun maxsus pishirilgan va uch hafta davom etadigan o'n ikki funt og'irlikdagi nonning hech narsa isrof bo'lmas edi.

en: Summer and winter she wore a dimity kerchief fastened in the back with a pin, a cap which concealed her hair, a red skirt, grey stockings, and an apron with a bib like those worn by hospital nurses.
uz: Yozda va qishda u orqa tomondan igna bilan mahkamlangan xira ro'mol, sochlarini yashiradigan shapka, qizil yubka, kulrang paypoq va shifoxona hamshiralari kiygan kabi ko'krakli apron kiygan edi.

en: Her face was thin and her voice shrill.
uz: Uning yuzi ingichka edi va ovozi qichishardi.

en: When she was twenty-five, she looked forty.
uz: U yigirma besh yoshda bo'lganida, qirq ko'rinardi.

en: After she had passed fifty, nobody could tell her age; erect and silent always, she resembled a wooden figure working automatically.
uz: U ellikdan o'tgach, hech kim uning yoshini ayta olmadi; doim tik va jim, u avtomatik ravishda ishlaydigan yog'och qomatga o'xshardi.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 2 Like every other woman, she had had an affair of the heart.
uz: Har bir ayol kabi, uning ham yuragida ishtiyoq bor edi.

en: Her father, who was a mason, was killed by falling from a scaffolding.
uz: Uning otasi, duradgor bo'lgan, scaffoldingdan yiqilib o'ldirildi.

en: Then her mother died and her sisters went their different ways; a farmer took her in, and while she was quite small, let her keep cows in the fields.
uz: Keyin onasi vafot etdi va singillari o'zlarining turli yo'llariga ketishdi; bir dehqon uni qabul qildi va u hali kichkina bo'lganida, dalalarda sigir boqishga ruxsat berdi.

en: She was clad in miserable rags, beaten for the slightest offence and finally dismissed for a theft of thirty sous which she did not commit.
uz: U achinarli lattalar bilan qoplangan edi, eng kichik haqorat uchun kaltaklangan va nihoyat o'ttiz sous o'g'irligi uchun ishdan bo'shatilgan edi, lekin u qilmagan.

en: She took service on another farm where she tended the poultry; and as she was well thought of by her master, her fellow- workers soon grew jealous.
uz: U boshqa fermada xizmat ko'rsatdi, u yerda parranda boqardi; va xo'jayini uni yaxshi o'ylaganidek, hamkasblari tez orada rashk qilishdi.

en: One evening in August (she was then eighteen years old), they persuaded her to accompany them to the fair at Colleville.
uz: Avgust oyining bir oqshomida (o'shanda u o'n sakkiz yoshda edi), uni ular bilan Kollevilldagi ko'rgazmaga borishga ko'ndirishdi.

en: She was immediately dazzled by the noise, the lights in the trees, the brightness of the dresses, the laces and gold crosses, and the crowd of people all hopping at the same time.
uz: U darhol shovqindan, daraxtlardagi chiroqlardan, ko'ylaklarning yorqinligidan, bog'ichlar va oltin xochlardan va bir vaqtning o'zida sakrayotgan odamlarning olomonidan ko'zini qamashtirdi.

en: She was standing modestly at a distance, when presently a young man of well-to-do appearance, who had been leaning on the pole of a wagon and smoking his pipe, approached her, and asked her for a dance.
uz: U uzoqda kamtarona turardi, o'shanda yaqin atrofda ko'rinishi yaxshi yigit, aravaning ustuniga suyanib, quvurini dudlayotgan edi, unga yaqinlashib, undan raqs so'radi.

en: He treated her to cider and cake, bought her a silk shawl, and then, thinking she had guessed his purpose, offered to see her home.
uz: U uni sidr va tort bilan siydi, ipak shawl sotib oldi va keyin, uning maqsadini anglagan deb o'ylagan holda, uning uyida ko'rishni taklif qildi.

en: When they came to the end of a field he threw her down brutally.
uz: Ular dala oxiriga yetib borgach, u uni shafqatsizlarcha pastga uloqtirdi.

en: But she grew frightened and screamed, and he walked off.
uz: Ammo u qo'rqib, qichqirdi va u ketdi.

en: One evening, on the road leading to Beaumont, she came upon a wagon loaded with hay, and when she overtook it, she recognised Theodore.
uz: Bir kuni kechqurun, Beaumontga olib boruvchi yo'lda u pichan yuklangan aravaga duch keldi va undan o'tib ketgach, Teodorni tanidi.

en: He greeted her calmly, and asked her to forget what had happened between them, as it “was all the fault of the drink.” She did not know what to reply and wished to run away.
uz: U uni xotirjamlik bilan kutib oldi va ular o'rtasida nima bo'lganini unutishni so'radi, chunki bu "hammasi ichimlikning aybi edi". U nima deb javob berishni bilmas edi va qochishni xohlardi.

en: Presently he began to speak of the harvest and of the notables of the village; his father had left Colleville and bought the farm of Les Ecots, so that now they would be neighbours.
uz: Hozirda u hosil va qishloq zodagonlari haqida gapira boshladi; otasi Kollevillni tark etib, Les Ekots fermasini sotib olgan edi, shunda ular endi qo'shni bo'lishardi.

en: “Ah!” she exclaimed.
uz: "Ah!" deb hayqirdi u.

en: He then added that his parents were looking around for a wife for him, but that he, himself, was not so anxious and preferred to wait for a girl who suited him.
uz: Keyin u ota-onasi unga xotin qidirayotganini, lekin o'zi unchalik tashvishlanmaganini va unga mos keladigan qizni kutishni afzal ko'rishini qo'shimcha qildi.

en: He then asked her whether she had ever thought of marrying.
uz: Keyin undan turmush qurish haqida hech qachon o'ylab ko'rganmi, deb so'radi.

en: She replied, smilingly, that it was wrong of him to make fun of her.
uz: U jilmayib javob berdi, uning uni masxara qilishi noto'g'ri edi.

en: no, I am in earnest,” he said, and put his left arm around her waist while they sauntered along.
uz: Yo'q, men jiddiy gapiryapman, - dedi u va ular saf tortishayotganda chap qo'lini uning beliga qo'ydi.

en: The air was soft, the stars were bright, and the huge load of hay oscillated in front of them, drawn by four horses whose ponderous hoofs raised clouds of dust.
uz: Havo yumshoq edi, yulduzlar yorqin edi va ularning oldida katta somon yuklari tebranardi, to'rtta ot tomonidan tortilgan edi, ularning og'ir tuyoqlari chang bulutlarini ko'tarardi.

en: Without a word from their driver they turned to the right.
uz: Haydovchisidan bir so'z so'ramasdan, ular o'ngga burilib ketishdi.

en: He kissed her again and she went home.
uz: U uni yana o'pdi va u uyiga ketdi.

en: The following week, Theodore obtained meetings.
uz: Keyingi hafta Teodor uchrashuvlarga erishdi.

en: They met in yards, behind walls or under isolated trees.
uz: Ular hovlilarda, devorlar ortida yoki alohida daraxtlar ostida uchrashardi.

en: She was not ignorant, as girls of well-to-do families are—for the animals had instructed her;—but her reason and her instinct of honour kept her from falling.
uz: U johil emas edi, xuddi badavlat oilalardagi qizlar kabi  chunki hayvonlar unga ta'lim bergan edi;  lekin uning aql-idrok va hurmat instinkti uni yiqilishdan saqlardi.

en: Her resistance exasperated Theodore’s love and so in order to satisfy it (or perchance ingenuously), he offered to marry her.
uz: Uning qarshiligi Teodorning muhabbatini g'azablantirdi va shuning uchun uni qondirish uchun (yoki ehtimol mohirona) unga turmushga chiqishni taklif qildi.

en: She would not believe him at first, so he made solemn promises.
uz: U dastlab unga ishonmadi, shuning uchun u tantanali va'dalar berdi.

en: But, in a short time he mentioned a difficulty; the previous year, his parents had purchased a substitute for him; but any day he might be drafted and the prospect of serving in the army alarmed him greatly.
uz: Ammo, qisqa vaqt ichida u bir qiyinchilikni tilga oldi; o'tgan yili ota-onasi unga o'rnini bosuvchi sotib olgan edi; lekin har qanday kuni u harbiy xizmatga chaqirilishi mumkin edi va armiyada xizmat qilish istiqboli uni juda xavotirga soldi.

en: To Felicite his cowardice appeared a proof of his love for her, and her devotion to him grew stronger.
uz: Felitga uning qo'rqoqligi uning unga bo'lgan muhabbatining dalili ko'rindi va uning unga bo'lgan sadoqati kuchaydi.

en: When she met him, he would torture her with his fears and his entreaties.
uz: U bilan uchrashganda, u uni o'z qo'rquvlari va iltijolari bilan qiynardi.

en: At last, he announced that he was going to the prefect himself for information, and would let her know everything on the following Sunday, between eleven o’clock and midnight.
uz: Nihoyat, u ma'lumot olish uchun prefektga o'zi borishini va unga keyingi yakshanba kuni, soat o'n birdan yarim tungacha hamma narsani xabar berishini e'lon qildi.

en: When the time grew near, she ran to meet her lover.
uz: Vaqti yaqinlashganda, u sevgilisi bilan uchrashish uchun yugurdi.

en: But instead of Theodore, one of his friends was at the meeting- place.
uz: Lekin Teodor o'rniga uning do'stlaridan biri uchrashuv joyida edi.

en: He informed her that she would never see her sweetheart again; for, in order to escape the conscription, he had married a rich old woman, Madame Lehoussais, of Toucques.
uz: U unga sevgilisini boshqa hech qachon ko'rmasligini aytdi; chunki chaqiruvdan qochish uchun u Touk shahridan bo'lgan badavlat keksa ayol, Lehoussais xonimga turmushga chiqqan edi.

en: The poor girl’s sorrow was frightful.
uz: Bechora qizning qayg'usi dahshatli edi.

en: She threw herself on the ground, she cried and called on the Lord, and wandered around desolately until sunrise.
uz: U o'zini yerga tashladi, yig'ladi va Rabbiyga yolvordi, quyosh chiqguncha xarobazor bo'lib yurdi.

en: Then she went back to the farm, declared her intention of leaving, and at the end of the month, after she had received her wages, she packed all her belongings in a handkerchief and started for Pont-l’Eveque.
uz: Keyin u fermaga qaytib ketdi, ketish niyatini e'lon qildi va oy oxirida, maoshini olgandan so'ng, barcha narsalarini ro'molga solib, Pont-lEvequega yo'l oldi.

en: In front of the inn, she met a woman wearing widow’s weeds, and upon questioning her, learned that she was looking for a cook.
uz: Mehmonxona oldida u beva begona oʻt kiygan bir ayolni uchratdi va uni soʻroq qilgach, u oshpaz qidirayotganini bilib qoldi.

en: The girl did not know very much, but appeared so willing and so modest in her requirements, that Madame Aubain finally said: “Very well, I will give you a trial.” And half an hour later Felicite was installed in her house.
uz: Qiz uncha ko'p narsa bilmasdi, lekin o'z talablariga shunchalik rozi va kamtarin ko'rinardiki, Madame Aubain nihoyat dedi: "Xo'p, men sizga bir sinov beraman." Va yarim soatdan keyin Felicite uning uyiga joylashtirildi.

en: At first she lived in a constant anxiety that was caused by “the style of the household” and the memory of “Monsieur,” that hovered over everything.
uz: Avvaliga u doimiy xavotirda yashagan, bunga sabab bo'lgan "maishiy uslub" va "Monsieur" xotirasi edi, u hamma narsa ustida ko'tarilardi.

en: Paul and Virginia, the one aged seven, and the other barely four, seemed made of some precious material; she carried them pig-a-back, and was greatly mortified when Madame Aubain forbade her to kiss them every other minute.
uz: Pol va Virjiniya, biri yetti yoshda, ikkinchisi esa deyarli to'rt yoshda, qandaydir qimmatbaho narsadan yasalgan ko'rinardi; u ularni cho'chqa kabi ko'tarib yurardi va Madame Aubain unga har ikki daqiqada o'pishni taqiqlaganida juda xafa bo'ldi.

en: But in spite of all this, she was happy.
uz: Lekin shunga qaramay, u xursand edi.

en: The comfort of her new surroundings had obliterated her sadness.
uz: Uning yangi muhitining qulayligi uning qayg'usini yo'q qildi.

en: Every Thursday, friends of Madame Aubain dropped in for a game of cards, and it was Felicite’s duty to prepare the table and heat the foot-warmers.
uz: Har payshanba kuni Madame Aubainning do'stlari karta o'yiniga kelishardi va Felicite'ning vazifasi stolni tayyorlash va oyoq isitgichlarni isitish edi.

en: They arrived at exactly eight o’clock and departed before eleven.
uz: Ular aynan soat sakkizda yetib kelishdi va o'n birdan oldin jo'nab ketishdi.

en: Every Monday morning, the dealer in second-hand goods, who lived under the alley-way, spread out his wares on the sidewalk.
uz: Har dushanba kuni ertalab, xiyobon ostida yashovchi ikkinchi qo'l tovarlari sotuvchisi o'z buyumlarini yo'lakka yoyardi.

en: Then the city would be filled with a buzzing of voices in which the neighing of horses, the bleating of lambs, the grunting of pigs, could be distinguished, mingled with the sharp sound of wheels on the cobble-stones.
uz: Shunda shahar otlarning hurishi, qo'zichoqlarning o'kirishi, cho'chqalarning g'ijirlashi bilan ajralib turadigan, tosh toshlaridagi g'ildiraklarning keskin ovozi bilan aralashgan ovoz bilan to'lib ketardi.

en: About twelve o’clock, when the market was in full swing, there appeared at the front door a tall, middle-aged peasant, with a hooked nose and a cap on the back of his head; it was Robelin, the farmer of Geffosses.
uz: Taxminan soat o'n ikkilarda, bozor to'lib-toshgan paytda, old eshik oldida burni ilgakli va boshida qalpoqli bo'lgan, o'rta yoshdagi baland bo'yli dehqon paydo bo'ldi; u Geffosses dehqoni Robelin edi.

en: Shortly afterwards came Liebard, the farmer of Toucques, short, rotund and ruddy, wearing a grey jacket and spurred boots.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, Liebard keldi, Touk dehqoni, kalta, qizg'ish va qizg'ish, kulrang kurtka va poyabzal kiygan.

en: Both men brought their landlady either chickens or cheese.
uz: Ikkala erkak ham uy bekasiga tovuq yoki pishloq olib kelishdi.

en: Felicite would invariably thwart their ruses and they held her in great respect.
uz: Felicit ularning hiylalarini doim yo'qqa chiqarardi va ular uni katta hurmat bilan ushlab turishardi.

en: At various times, Madame Aubain received a visit from the Marquis de Gremanville, one of her uncles, who was ruined and lived at Falaise on the remainder of his estates.
uz: Turli vaqtlarda, Madame Aubain Markiz de Gremanvildan tashrif buyurgan, uning amakilaridan biri, vayronaga aylangan va Falaise shahrida o'z mulklarining qolgan qismida yashagan.

en: He always came at dinner-time and brought an ugly poodle with him, whose paws soiled their furniture.
uz: U har doim kechki ovqat paytida kelardi va o'zi bilan chirkin pudel olib kelardi, uning panjalari mebellarini ifloslashtirardi.

en: In spite of his efforts to appear a man of breeding (he even went so far as to raise his hat every time he said “My deceased father”), his habits got the better of him, and he would fill his glass a little too often and relate broad stories.
uz: Garchi u o'zini ko'payish odamiga aylantirishga harakat qilganiga qaramay (har safar "Mening marhum otam" deb aytganida, shapkasini ko'tarishgacha borardi), odatlari undan ustun keldi va u o'z stakanini biroz tez-tez to'ldirardi va keng hikoyalarni aytib berardi.

en: Felicite would show him out very politely and say: “You have had enough for this time, Monsieur de Gremanville!
uz: Felicite uni juda odob bilan ko'rsatib, dedi: Bu safarga yetding, janob de Gremanvil!

en: Hoping to see you again!” and would close the door.
uz: Sizni yana ko'rishga umid qilaman! va eshikni yopardi.

en: She opened it gladly for Monsieur Bourais, a retired lawyer.
uz: U buni nafaqaga chiqqan advokat janob Bourais uchun xursandchilik bilan ochdi.

en: His bald head and white cravat, the ruffling of his shirt, his flowing brown coat, the manner in which he took snuff, his whole person, in fact, produced in her the kind of awe which we feel when we see extraordinary persons.
uz: Uning kal boshi va oq ko'ylagi, ko'ylagining g'ijirlashi, oq jigarrang palto, snuffni qanday qabul qilishi, butun shaxsiyati aslida unda g'ayrioddiy shaxslarni ko'rganda his qiladigan hayratni keltirib chiqardi.

en: As he managed Madame’s estates, he spent hours with her in Monsieur’s study; he was in constant fear of being compromised, had a great regard for the magistracy and some pretensions to learning.
uz: U Madamning mulklarini boshqarar ekan, u bilan Monsieurning xonasida soatlab vaqt o'tkazardi; u doimiy ravishda xavf ostida edi, advokatlikka katta hurmat qo'yardi va o'rganishga ba'zi da'volar bilan shug'ullanardi.

en: In order to facilitate the children’s studies, he presented them with an engraved geography which represented various scenes of the world; cannibals with feather head-dresses, a gorilla kidnapping a young girl, Arabs in the desert, a whale being harpooned, etc.
uz: Bolalarning o'qishini osonlashtirish maqsadida, u ularga dunyoning turli manzaralarini aks ettiruvchi o'yilgan geografiyani taqdim etdi: patli bosh kiyimli kanniballar, yosh qizni o'g'irlayotgan gorilla, sahroda arablar, qamallayotgan kit va hokazo.

en: Paul explained the pictures to Felicite.
uz: Pol Felicitga rasmlarni tushuntirdi.

en: And, in fact, this was her only literary education.
uz: Va, aslida, bu uning yagona adabiy ta'limi edi.

en: The children’s studies were under the direction of a poor devil employed at the town-hall, who sharpened his pocket-knife on his boots and was famous for his penmanship.
uz: Bolalarning o'qishlari shahar hokimiyatida ishlaydigan bechora shaytonning rahbarligida edi, u oyoq kiyimidagi cho'ntak pichog'ini o'tkirlashtirardi va o'z qalamchiligi bilan mashhur edi.

en: When the weather was fine, they went to Geffosses.
uz: Ob-havo yaxshi bo'lganda, ular Geffossesga borishdi.

en: The house was built in the centre of the sloping yard; and the sea looked like a grey spot in the distance.
uz: Uy qiya hovlining markazida qurilgan edi; va dengiz uzoqda kulrang dog'ga o'xshardi.

en: Felicite would take slices of cold meat from the lunch basket and they would sit down and eat in a room next to the dairy.
uz: Felicit tushlik savatidan sovuq go'sht bo'laklarini olardi va ular sut mahsulotlari yonidagi xonada o'tirib ovqatlanardilar.

en: This room was all that remained of a cottage that had been torn down.
uz: Bu xona buzib tashlangan kottejdan qolgan yagona narsa edi.

en: The dilapidated wall-paper trembled in the drafts.
uz: Xaroba bo'lgan devor qog'ozi loyihalarda titradi.

en: Madame Aubain, overwhelmed by recollections, would hang her head, while the children were afraid to open their mouths.
uz: Xotiralar bilan to'lib-toshgan Madame Aubain boshini osib qo'yardi, bolalar esa og'zlarini ochishga qo'rqardilar.

en: Then, “Why don’t you go and play?” their mother would say; and they would scamper off.
uz: Shunda ularning onasi: Nega borib oynamaysan? der edi; va ular ogirlab ketishardi.

en: Paul would go to the old barn, catch birds, throw stones into the pond, or pound the trunks of the trees with a stick till they resounded like drums.
uz: Pol eski omborxonaga borardi, qushlarni tutardi, hovuzga toshlar uloqtirardi yoki daraxtlarning poyalarini tayoq bilan urardi, toki ular barabanlar kabi yangradi.

en: Virginia would feed the rabbits and run to pick the wild flowers in the fields, and her flying legs would disclose her little embroidered pantalettes.
uz: Virjiniya quyonlarni boqardi va dalalardagi yovvoyi gullarni terish uchun yugurardi, uning uchib yurgan oyoqlari esa o'zining kashtado'z pantalettasini ko'rsatardi.

en: One autumn evening, they struck out for home through the meadows.
uz: Bir kuz oqshomida ular maysazorlar orqali uyga yo'l olishdi.

en: The new moon illumined part of the sky and a mist hovered like a veil over the sinuosities of the river.
uz: Yangi oy osmonning bir qismini yoritdi va daryoning burchaklari ustida parda kabi tuman suzib yurdi.

en: Oxen, lying in the pastures, gazed mildly at the passing persons.
uz: O'tloqlarda yotgan ho'kiz o'tib ketayotgan odamlarga muloyimlik bilan tikilib turardi.

en: In the third field, however, several of them got up and surrounded them.
uz: Uchinchi maydonda esa ulardan bir nechtasi o'rnidan turdi va ularni o'rab oldi.

en: “Don’t be afraid,” cried Felicite; and murmuring a sort of lament she passed her hand over the back of the nearest ox; he turned away and the others followed.
uz: Qo'rqma, deb baqirdi Felicit; va g'uvillab, eng yaqin ho'kizning orqasiga qo'lini uzatdi; u orqaga burilib, boshqalar ham ergashdi.

en: But when they came to the next pasture, they heard frightful bellowing.
uz: Ammo ular keyingi yaylovga yetib borgach, dahshatli g'uvillashni eshitdilar.

en: It was a bull which was hidden from them by the fog.
uz: Bu ulardan tuman ostida yashiringan buqa edi.

en: He advanced towards the two women, and Madame Aubain prepared to flee for her life.
uz: U ikki ayol tomon oldinga siljidi va Madame Aubain uning hayoti uchun qochishga tayyorlandi.

en: not so fast,” warned Felicite.
uz: unchalik tez emas,  deb ogohlantirdi Felicite.

en: Still they hurried on, for they could hear the noisy breathing of the bull behind them.
uz: Shunga qaramay, ular shoshilishdi, chunki ular orqasidagi buqaning shovqinli nafasini eshitishardi.

en: His hoofs pounded the grass like hammers, and presently he began to gallop!
uz: Uning tuyoqlari o'tni bolg'alar kabi urardi va shu zahoti u poyga qila boshladi!

en: Felicite turned around and threw patches of grass in his eyes.
uz: Felicit orqaga o'girilib, ko'zlariga o't bo'laklarini uloqtirdi.

en: He hung his head, shook his horns and bellowed with fury.
uz: U boshini osib qo'ydi, shoxlarini chayqadi va g'azab bilan qichqirdi.

en: Madame Aubain and the children, huddled at the end of the field, were trying to jump over the ditch.
uz: Madame Aubain va bolalar dala oxirida yashirinib, ariqdan sakrab o'tishga harakat qilishardi.

en: Felicite continued to back before the bull, blinding him with dirt, while she shouted to them to make haste.
uz: Felicit buqa oldidan orqaga qaytishda davom etdi, uni kir bilan ko'r qildi, u esa ularga shoshilishni faryod qildi.

en: Madame Aubain finally slid into the ditch, after shoving first Virginia and then Paul into it, and though she stumbled several times she managed, by dint of courage, to climb the other side of it.
uz: Madame Aubain nihoyat ariqqa sirg'alib kirdi, avval Virjiniyani, keyin Polni unga itarib kirgandan so'ng, bir necha marta qoqilib ketgan bo'lsa ham, jasorat bilan uning narigi tomoniga ko'tarildi.

en: The bull had driven Felicite up against a fence; the foam from his muzzle flew in her face and in another minute he would have disembowelled her.
uz: Buqa Felicitni panjaraga haydab chiqardi; uning tumshug'idan chiqqan ko'pik uning yuziga uchib tushdi va bir daqiqadan so'ng uni o'rab tashlardi.

en: She had just time to slip between two bars and the huge animal, thwarted, paused.
uz: U ikki panjara va ulkan hayvon o'rtasida sirpanishga vaqti bor edi, to'sqinlik qildi, to'xtadi.

en: For years, this occurrence was a topic of conversation in Pont- l’Eveque.
uz: Yillar davomida bu hodisa Pont-lEveque shahrida suhbat mavzusi bo'lgan.

en: But Felicite took no credit to herself, and probably never
uz: Lekin Felitsit o'ziga hech qanday e'tiroz bildirmadi, va ehtimol hech qachon.

en: knew that she had been heroic.
uz: Uning qahramonona ish qilganini bilardi.

en: Virginia occupied her thoughts solely, for the shock she had sustained gave her a nervous affection, and the physician, M.
uz: Virjiniya faqatgina o'z fikrlarini o'yladi, chunki uning boshidan kechirgan zarbasi unga asabiy mehr berdi va shifokor, M.

en: Poupart, prescribed the salt-water bathing at Trouville.
uz: Poupart Trouvilleda sho'r suvda cho'milishni buyurdi.

en: In those days, Trouville was not greatly patronised.
uz: O'sha kunlarda Trouville unchalik homiylik qilinmas edi.

en: Madame Aubain gathered information, consulted Bourais, and made preparations as if they were going on an extended trip.
uz: Madame Aubain ma'lumot to'pladi, Bourais bilan maslahatlashdi va xuddi uzoq safarga ketayotgandek tayyorgarlik ko'rdi.

en: The baggage was sent the day before on Liebard’s cart.
uz: Yuk bir kun oldin Liebardning aravachasida jo'natilgan edi.

en: On the following morning, he brought around two horses, one of which had a woman’s saddle with a velveteen back to it, while on the crupper of the other was a rolled shawl that was to be used for a seat.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab u ikki otni olib keldi, ulardan birida ayolning velvet egari orqaga o'ralgan, ikkinchisining ustida esa o'rindiq uchun ishlatiladigan o'ralgan shawl bor edi.

en: Madame Aubain mounted the second horse, behind Liebard.
uz: Madame Aubain ikkinchi otga, Liebard orqasida o'tirdi.

en: Felicite took charge of the little girl, and Paul rode M.
uz: Felicite kichkina qizni o'ziga oldi, Paul esa M ga mindi.

en: Lechaptois’ donkey, which had been lent for the occasion on the condition that they should be careful of it.
uz: Lechaptois eshak, ular undan ehtiyot bo'lishlari shartida, bu tadbir uchun qarzga olingan edi.

en: The road was so bad that it took two hours to cover the eight miles.
uz: Yo'l shunchalik yomon ediki, sakkiz milni bosib o'tish uchun ikki soat ketardi.

en: The two horses sank knee-deep into the mud and stumbled into ditches; sometimes they had to jump over them.
uz: Ikki ot tizzalari qadar loyga botdi va ariqlarga adashib tushdi; ba'zan ularning ustidan sakrashga to'g'ri keldi.

en: In certain places, Liebard’s mare stopped abruptly.
uz: Ba'zi joylarda Liebardning suzgichi to'satdan to'xtadi.

en: He waited patiently till she started again, and talked of the people whose estates bordered the road, adding his own moral reflections to the outline of their histories.
uz: U sabr bilan uning yana boshlashini kutdi va ularning yerlari yo'l bilan chegaradosh bo'lgan odamlar haqida gapirdi, o'z axloqiy mulohazalarini ularning tarixining konturlariga qo'shdi.

en: Thus, when they were passing through Toucques, and came to some windows draped with nasturtiums, he shrugged his shoulders and said: “There’s a woman, Madame Lehoussais, who, instead of taking a young man—” Felicite could not catch what followed; the horses began to trot, the donkey to gallop, and they turned into a lane; then a gate swung open, two farm-hands appeared and they all dismounted at the very threshold of the farm-house.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular Touquesdan o'tib, nasturtiumlar bilan qoplangan derazalarga yetib kelganlarida, u yelkalarini qimirlatdi va dedi: Bir ayol bor, Lehoussa xonim, u yigitni olib ketish o'rniga  Felicite undan keyin nima kelishini ushlab tura olmadi; otlar yurishni boshladi, eshaklar yugurdi va ular yo'lga aylandi; keyin darvoza ochildi, ikki fermer qo'li paydo bo'ldi va ular hammasi fermaga o'tirgan joyda tushishdi.

en: Mother Liebard, when she caught sight of her mistress, was lavish with joyful demonstrations.
uz: Ona Liebard, o'z bekasini ko'rganida, quvonchli namoyishlar bilan dabdabali edi.

en: She got up a lunch which comprised a leg of mutton, tripe, sausages, a chicken fricassee, sweet cider, a fruit tart and some preserved prunes; then to all this the good woman added polite remarks about Madame, who appeared to be in better health, Mademoiselle, who had grown to be “superb,” and Paul, who had become singularly sturdy; she spoke also of their deceased
uz: U bir oyog'i qo'y go'shti, tripe, kolbasalar, tovuq frrikazi, shirin sir, meva torti va ba'zi konservalangan archalardan iborat tushlikka chiqdi; keyin bularning barchasiga yaxshi ayol sog'lig'i yaxshiroq ko'rinadigan xonim, "ajoyib" bo'lib ulg'aygan xonim va birdan mustahkam bo'lib qolgan Paul haqida odobli so'zlarni qo'shib qo'ydi; u o'zlarining

en: grandparents, whom the Liebards had known, for they had been in the service of the family for several generations.
uz: Liebardlar bilgan buvi-buvilar, chunki ular bir necha avloddan beri oila xizmatida bo'lishgan.

en: Like its owners, the farm had an ancient appearance.
uz: Xuddi egalari kabi, fermada ham qadimiy ko'rinish bor edi.

en: The beams of the ceiling were mouldy, the walls black with smoke and the windows grey with dust.
uz: Shiftning to'sinlari mog'or edi, devorlari tutundan qora, derazalari esa changdan kulrang edi.

en: The oak sideboard was filled with all sorts of utensils, plates, pitchers, tin bowls, wolf-traps.
uz: Dub yon taxtasi har xil idishlar, plitalar, pitcherlar, qalay kosalar, bo'ri tuzoqlari bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

en: The children laughed when they saw a huge syringe.
uz: Bolalar katta shpritsni ko'rgach, kulishdi.

en: There was not a tree in the yard that did not have mushrooms growing around its foot, or a bunch of mistletoe hanging in its branches.
uz: Hovlida oyoqlari atrofida qo'ziqorinlar o'smagan yoki shoxlarida bir to'da ko'rshapalak osilmagan daraxt yo'q edi.

en: Several of the trees had been blown down, but they had started to grow in the middle and all were laden with quantities of apples.
uz: Bir nechta daraxtlar puflab tushirilgan edi, lekin ular o'rtasida o'sishni boshlagan edi va ularning barchasi ko'p miqdorda olmalar bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

en: The thatched roofs, which were of unequal thickness, looked like brown velvet and could resist the fiercest gales.
uz: Qalinligi notekis bo'lgan somon tomlari jigarrang baxmalga o'xshardi va eng shiddatli zarbalarga bardosh bera olardi.

en: But the wagon-shed was fast crumbling to ruins.
uz: Ammo aravacha-saroy tezda vayronaga aylanib ketdi.

en: Madame Aubain said that she would attend to it, and then gave orders to have the horses saddled.
uz: Madame Aubain unga e'tibor berishini aytdi, so'ngra otlarni egarlashga buyruq berdi.

en: It took another thirty minutes to reach Trouville.
uz: Trouvillega yetib borish uchun yana o'ttiz daqiqa kerak bo'ldi.

en: The little caravan dismounted in order to pass Les Ecores, a cliff that overhangs the bay, and a few minutes later, at the end of the dock, they entered the yard of the Golden Lamb, an inn kept by Mother David.
uz: Kichkina karvon Les Ecoresdan o'tish uchun tushdi, bu qo'ltiq qo'ltig'i ustida joylashgan qoya edi va bir necha daqiqadan so'ng, dok oxirida ular Ona Dovud tomonidan saqlanadigan Oltin Qo'zi hovlisiga kirishdi.

en: During the first few days, Virginia felt stronger, owing to the change of air and the action of the sea-baths.
uz: Dastlabki bir necha kun ichida Virjiniya havo o'zgarishi va dengiz cho'milishlarining ta'siri tufayli o'zini kuchliroq his qildi.

en: She took them in her little chemise, as she had no bathing suit, and afterwards her nurse dressed her in the cabin of a customs officer, which was used for that purpose by other bathers.
uz: U ularni o'zining kichkina ko'ylagida oldi, chunki unda cho'milish kostyumi yo'q edi, keyin hamshira uni bojxona xodimining kabinasida kiyintirdi, bu kabina boshqa hammomchilar tomonidan shu maqsadda ishlatilgan edi.

en: In the afternoon, they would take the donkey and go to the Roches-Noires, near Hennequeville.
uz: Tushdan keyin ular eshakni olib, Hennequeville yaqinidagi Roches-Noiresga borar edilar.

en: The path led at first through undulating grounds, and thence to a plateau, where pastures and tilled fields alternated.
uz: Yo'l dastlab to'lqinsimon yerlardan o'tib, keyin tekislikka olib bordi, u yerda yaylovlar va dehqonchilik maydonlari almashinuvda edi.

en: At the edge of the road, mingling with the brambles, grew holly bushes, and here and there stood large dead trees whose branches traced zigzags upon the blue sky.
uz: Yo'l chetida, g'o'lalar bilan aralashib, g'adir-budur butalar o'sdi va bu yerda katta o'lik daraxtlar turardi, ularning shoxlari ko'k osmonda zigzaglarni izlardi.

en: Ordinarily, they rested in a field facing the ocean, with Deauville on their left, and Havre on their right.
uz: Odatda, ular dengizga qaragan dalada dam olishardi, chap tomonda Deauville va o'ng tomonda Havre bor edi.

en: The sea glittered brightly in the sun and was as smooth as a mirror, and so calm that they could scarcely distinguish its murmur; sparrows chirped joyfully and the immense canopy of heaven spread over it all.
uz: Dengiz quyoshda yorqin porlardi va oyna kabi tekis edi, shunchalik sokin ediki, ular uning shivirlashini deyarli farqlay olishmas edi; chumchuqlar xursandchilik bilan qichqirardi va osmonning ulkan soyasi hammasi ustidan tarqaldi.

en: Madame Aubain brought out her sewing, and Virginia amused herself by braiding
uz: Madame Aubain o'zining tikuvini olib chiqdi, Virjiniya esa o'ziga o'rilgan holda xursandchilik qildi.

en: reeds; Felicite wove lavender blossoms, while Paul was bored and wished to go home.
uz: Qamish; Felicite lavanda gullarini to'qidi, Paul esa zerikkan edi va uyga qaytishni xohlardi.

en: Sometimes they crossed the Toucques in a boat, and started to hunt for sea-shells.
uz: Ba'zan ular Tuxka daryosini qayiqda kesib o'tishardi va dengiz qobiqlarini ovlashni boshlashardi.

en: The outgoing tide exposed star-fish and sea- urchins, and the children tried to catch the flakes of foam which the wind blew away.
uz: Chiqayotgan to'lqin dengiz yulduzlari va dengiz chumolilarini ko'rsatdi, bolalar shamol esgan ko'pik bo'laklarini ushlashga harakat qilishdi.

en: The sleepy waves lapping the sand unfurled themselves along the shore that extended as far as the eye could see, but where land began, it was limited by the downs which separated it from the “Swamp,” a large meadow shaped like a hippodrome.
uz: Qumni sog'ingan uyqu to'lqinlari ko'zga ko'rinadigan darajada cho'zilgan qirg'oq bo'ylab o'zini ochdi, lekin quruqlik qayerdan boshlansa, u yerda uni "botqoqlik"dan ajratib turuvchi quyiliklar bilan cheklangan edi, bu esa gippodromga o'xshash katta o'tloq edi.

en: When they went home that way, Trouville, on the slope of a hill below, grew larger and larger as they advanced, and, with all its houses of unequal height, seemed to spread out before them in a sort of giddy confusion.
uz: Ular shu yo'l bilan uyga borganlarida, Trouville, pastdagi tepalik yonbag'rida, oldinga siljigan sari tobora kattaroqlashib borardi va barcha notekis balandlikdagi uylari bilan ularning oldida bir xil chalkashlikda tarqalgandek ko'rinardi.

en: When the heat was too oppressive, they remained in their rooms.
uz: Issiqlik juda bosim o'tkazganda, ular o'z xonalarida qolishdi.

en: The dazzling sunlight cast bars of light between the shutters.
uz: Quyoshning ko'zni qamashtiruvchi nuri derazalar orasiga nur sochdi.

en: Not a sound in the village, not a soul on the sidewalk.
uz: Qishloqda hech qanday ovoz yo'q, yo'lakda hech qanday jon yo'q.

en: This silence intensified the tranquility of everything.
uz: Bu sukunat hamma narsaning xotirjamligini kuchaytirdi.

en: In the distance, the hammers of some calkers pounded the hull of a ship, and the sultry breeze brought them an odour of tar.
uz: Uzoqda, ba'zi xodalarning bolg'alari kemaning korpusini urdi va achchiq shabada ularga loy hidini olib keldi.

en: The principal diversion consisted in watching the return of the fishing-smacks.
uz: Asosiy chalg'ituvchi mashg'ulot baliq ovlash baliqlarining qaytishini kuzatishdan iborat edi.

en: As soon as they passed the beacons, they began to ply to windward.
uz: Ular mayoqlardan o'tishlari bilanoq, shamolga qarab yo'lga tushishni boshladilar.

en: The sails were lowered to one third of the masts, and with their fore-sails swelled up like balloons they glided over the waves and anchored in the middle of the harbour.
uz: Yelkanlar ustunlarning uchdan bir qismiga tushirildi va old yelkanlari sharlar kabi shishgan holda to'lqinlar ustidan sirg'alib, port o'rtasida mahkamlandi.

en: Then they crept up alongside of the dock and the sailors threw the quivering fish over the side of the boat; a line of carts was waiting for them, and women with white caps sprang forward to receive the baskets and embrace their men-folk.
uz: Keyin ular dok yonida sudrab o'tishdi va dengizchilar titroq baliqlarni qayiq yonidan uloqtirishdi; ularni bir qator aravalar kutardi, oq qalpoqli ayollar savatlarni olish va o'z erkaklarini quchoqlash uchun oldinga sakrashdi.

en: One day, one of them spoke to Felicite, who, after a little while, returned to the house gleefully.
uz: Bir kuni ulardan biri Felitit bilan gaplashdi, u bir oz vaqtdan keyin xursand bo'lib uyga qaytib keldi.

en: She had found one of her sisters, and presently Nastasie Barette, wife of Leroux, made her appearance, holding an infant in her arms, another child by the hand, while on her left was a little cabin-boy with his hands in his pockets and his cap on his ear.
uz: U o'z opa-singillaridan birini topgan edi va hozirda Lerouxning xotini Nastasie Barette ko'rinish berdi, qo'lida go'dakni, qo'lida yana bir bolani ushlab, chap tomonida qo'llari cho'ntaklarida va qulog'ida qalpoq bilan kichik bir bola edi.

en: At the end of fifteen minutes, Madame Aubain bade her go.
uz: O'n besh daqiqa oxirida, Madame Aubain uni jo'natdi.

en: They always hung around the kitchen, or approached Felicite when she and the children were out walking.
uz: Ular doim oshxonada osilib yurishardi, yoki u va bolalar sayr qilganda Felishitga yaqinlashishardi.

en: The husband, however,
uz: Er esa,

en: did not show himself.
uz: O'zini ko'rsatmadi.

en: Felicite developed a great fondness for them; she bought them a stove, some shirts and a blanket; it was evident that they exploited her.
uz: Felicit ularga katta mehr qo'ydi; u ularga pechka, ko'ylaklar va adyol sotib oldi; ular uni ekspluatatsiya qilishlari aniq edi.

en: Her foolishness annoyed Madame Aubain, who, moreover did not like the nephew’s familiarity, for he called her son “thou”; —and, as Virginia began to cough and the season was over, she decided to return to Pont-l’Eveque.
uz: Uning ahmoqligi xonim Aubainni bezovta qildi, u, bundan tashqari, jiyanining tanishligini yoqtirmasdi, chunki u o'g'lini "sen" deb atardi; va Virjiniya yo'talga tushib, mavsum tugagach, u Pont-lEvequega qaytishga qaror qildi.

en: Monsieur Bourais assisted her in the choice of a college.
uz: Monsieur Bourais unga kollej tanlashda yordam berdi.

en: The one at Caen was considered the best.
uz: Keendagi eng yaxshisi deb hisoblangan edi.

en: So Paul was sent away and bravely said good-bye to them all, for he was glad to go to live in a house where he would have boy companions.
uz: Shunday qilib, Pavlus jo'nab ketdi va ularning hammasi bilan jasorat bilan xayrlashdi, chunki u o'g'il bolalari bo'ladigan uyga borishdan xursand edi.

en: Madame Aubain resigned herself to the separation from her son because it was unavoidable.
uz: Madame Aubain o'g'lidan ajralishga rozi bo'ldi, chunki bu muqarrar edi.

en: Virginia brooded less and less over it.
uz: Virjiniya bu haqda tobora kamroq o'yladi.

en: Felicite regretted the noise he made, but soon a new occupation diverted her mind; beginning from Christmas, she accompanied the little girl to her catechism lesson every day.
uz: Felicit shovqinidan afsuslandi, lekin tez orada yangi mashg'ulot uning ongini chalg'itdi; Rojdestvodan boshlab, u kichkina qizni har kuni katexizm darsiga kuzatib borardi.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 3 After she had made a curtsey at the threshold, she would walk up the aisle between the double lines of chairs, open Madame Aubain’s pew, sit down and look around.
uz: U ostonada kursiy yasaganidan so'ng, u stullarning ikki qatorlari orasidagi yo'lakka chiqardi, Madame Aubainning o'rindig'ini ochardi, o'tirardi va atrofga qarardi.

en: Girls and boys, the former on the right, the latter on the left-hand side of the church, filled the stalls of the choir; the priest stood beside the reading-desk; on one stained window of the side-aisle the Holy Ghost hovered over the Virgin; on another one, Mary knelt before the Child Jesus, and behind the altar, a wooden group represented Saint Michael felling the dragon.
uz: Qizlar va o'g'il bolalar, birinchisi o'ng tomonda, ikkinchisi chap tomonda cherkovning javonlarini to'ldirdi; ruhoniy o'qish stoli yonida turardi; yon yo'lakning bir dog'li oynasida Muqaddas Ruh Bokira Maryam ustida osilib turardi; ikkinchisida Maryam Bola Iso oldida tizzalab turardi, va qurbongoh ortida esa avliyo Mixailning ajdaholarni kesayotganini tasvirlagan yog'och guruhi bor edi.

en: The priest first read a condensed lesson of sacred history.
uz: Ruhoniy avvalo muqaddas tarixning qisqacha darsini o'qidi.

en: Felicite evoked Paradise, the Flood, the Tower of Babel, the blazing cities, the dying nations, the shattered idols; and out of this she developed a great respect for the Almighty and a great fear of His wrath.
uz: Felicit Jannatni, To'fonni, Bobil minorasini, olovli shaharlarni, o'layotgan xalqlarni, parchalangan butlarni eslatdi; va bundan u Qodir Tangriga katta hurmat va Uning g'azabidan katta qo'rquvni rivojlantirdi.

en: Then, when she had listened to the Passion, she wept.
uz: Keyin, U azobni tinglaganidan so'ng, u yig'ladi.

en: Why had they crucified Him who loved little children, nourished the people, made the blind see, and who, out of humility, had wished to be born among the poor, in a stable?
uz: Nega ular Kichkina bolalarni sevgan, xalqni oziqlantirgan, ko'rlarni ko'rsatgan va kamtarlikdan kambag'allar orasida, o'rmonda tug'ilishni istagan Zotni xochga mixlashdi?

en: The sowings, the harvests, the wine- presses, all those familiar things which the Scriptures mention, formed a part of her life; the word of God sanctified them; and she loved the lambs with increased tenderness for the sake of the Lamb, and the doves because of the Holy Ghost.
uz: Urug'lar, hosillar, vino presslari, Muqaddas Kitobda tilga olingan barcha tanish narsalar uning hayotining bir qismini tashkil etdi; Xudoning so'zi ularni muqaddas qildi; va u Qo'zi uchun qo'zichoqlarni, Muqaddas Ruh uchun kaptarlarni yanada mehr bilan sevdi.

en: She found it hard, however, to think of the latter as a person, for was it not a bird, a flame, and sometimes only a breath?
uz: Ammo unga oxirgisini inson sifatida o'ylash qiyin edi, chunki u qush, olov va ba'zan faqatgina nafas emasmidi?

en: Perhaps it is its light that at night hovers over swamps, its breath that propels the clouds, its voice that renders church-bells harmonious.
uz: Balki tunlari botqoqliklar ustida suzuvchi nuridir, bulutlarni haydaydigan nafasidir, cherkovi qo'ng'iroqlarini uyg'unlashtiradigan ovozidir.

en: And Felicite worshipped devoutly, while enjoying the coolness and the stillness of the church.
uz: Va Felitsit cherkovning salqinligi va sokinligidan zavqlanib, sadoqat bilan ibodat qildi.

en: As for the dogma, she could not understand it and did not even try.
uz: Dogmaga kelsak, u buni tushunmadi va hatto urinib ham ko'rmadi.

en: The priest discoursed, the children recited, and she went to sleep, only to awaken with a start when they were leaving the church and their wooden shoes clattered on the stone pavement.
uz: Ruhoniy nutq so'zladi, bolalar o'qidilar va u uxlashga ketdi, faqat ular cherkovdan ketayotganlarida uyg'onib, yog'och poyabzallari tosh qoplamasida to'qnashdi.

en: In this way, she learned her catechism, her religious education having been neglected in her youth; and thenceforth she imitated all Virginia’s religious practices, fasted when she did, and went to confession with her.
uz: Shu yo'l bilan u o'z katexizmini o'rgandi, diniy ta'limi yoshligida e'tibordan chetda qolgan edi; va shundan keyin u Virjiniyaning barcha diniy amaliyotlariga taqlid qildi, ro'za tutdi va u bilan birga iqror bo'lishga kirdi.

en: At the Corpus-Christi Day they both decorated an altar.
uz: Corpus-Christi kunida ikkalasi ham qurbongohni bezashdi.

en: She worried in advance over Virginia’s first communion.
uz: U Virjiniyaning birinchi ziyofatidan oldindan xavotirda edi.

en: She fussed about the shoes, the rosary, the book and the gloves.
uz: U poyabzallar, tasbeh, kitob va qo'lqoplar haqida qayg'urardi.

en: With what nervousness she helped the mother dress the child!
uz: Qanday asabiylik bilan u onasiga bolani kiyintirishga yordam berdi!

en: During the entire ceremony, she felt anguished.
uz: Butun marosim davomida u qayg'uda edi.

en: Monsieur Bourais hid part of the choir from view, but directly in front of her, the flock of maidens, wearing white wreaths over their lowered veils, formed a snow-white field, and she recognised her darling by the slenderness of her neck and her devout attitude.
uz: Monsieur Bourais xorning bir qismini ko'zdan yashirdi, lekin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning oldida, pastki pardalari ustida oq gulchambarlar taqib, qor-oq maydon hosil qildi va u o'z azizini bo'ynining ingichkaligi va sadoqatli munosabati bilan tanidi.

en: All the heads bent and there was a silence.
uz: Barcha boshlar egildi va jimlik hukm surdi.

en: Then, at the peals of the organ the singers and the worshippers struck up the Agnes Dei; the boys’ procession began; behind them came the girls.
uz: Keyin, organning eng yuqori cho'qqisida qo'shiqchilar va ibodat qiluvchilar Agnes Deiga qo'ng'iroq qilishdi; o'g'il bolalar yurishi boshlandi; ularning orqasidan qizlar keldi.

en: With clasped hands, they advanced step by step to the lighted altar, knelt at the first step, received one by one the Host, and returned to their seats in the same order.
uz: Qo'llarini mahkam ushlagan holda, ular qadam-baqadam yoritilgan qurbongohga tomon borishdi, birinchi qadamda tiz cho'kishdi, G'ayridinlarni birma-bir qabul qilishdi va o'z o'rindiqlariga xuddi shu tartibda qaytishdi.

en: When Virginia’s turn came, Felicite leaned forward to watch her, and through that imagination which springs from true affection, she at once became the child, whose face and dress became hers, whose heart beat in her bosom, and when Virginia opened her mouth and closed her lids, she did likewise and came very near fainting.
uz: Virjiniyaning navbat kelganda, Felicite unga qarash uchun egilib turdi va haqiqiy mehrdan kelib chiqadigan o'sha tasavvur orqali u darhol o'ziga xos bo'lgan bolaga aylandi, uning yuzi va libosi o'ziniki bo'ldi, yuragi uning ko'kragida urardi, va Virjiniya og'zini ochib, qopqoqlarini yopganda, u ham xuddi shunday qildi va juda hushdan ketishga yaqinlashdi.

en: The following day, she presented herself early at the church so as to receive communion from the cure.
uz: Ertasi kuni u davolanishdan komunion olish uchun cherkovga erta keldi.

en: She took it with the proper feeling, but did not experience the same delight as on the previous day.
uz: U buni to'g'ri his bilan qabul qildi, lekin o'tgan kundagidek zavqni his qilmadi.

en: Madame Aubain wished to make an accomplished girl of her daughter; and as Guyot could not teach English or music, she decided to send her to the Ursulines at Honfleur.
uz: Madame Aubain o'z qizidan yetuk qizni yaratmoqchi edi; va Guyot ingliz tili yoki musiqani o'rgata olmasligi sababli, uni Honfleurdagi Ursulinlarga yuborishga qaror qildi.

en: The child made no objection, but Felicite sighed and thought Madame was heartless.
uz: Bola hech qanday e'tiroz bildirmadi, lekin Felitsit oh tortdi va xonimning yuragi achchiq deb o'yladi.

en: Then, she thought that perhaps her mistress was right, as these things were beyond her sphere.
uz: Keyin u, ehtimol, uning bekasi haqdir, chunki bu narsalar uning doirasidan tashqarida edi, deb o'yladi.

en: Finally, one day, an old fiacre stopped in front of the door and a nun stepped out.
uz: Nihoyat, bir kuni eshik oldida keksa bir rohiba to'xtadi va rohiba tashqariga chiqdi.

en: Felicite put Virginia’s luggage on top of the carriage, gave the coachman some instructions, and smuggled six jars of jam, a dozen pears and a bunch of violets under the seat.
uz: Felicite Virjiniyaning yukini vagon ustiga qo'ydi, vagonga ko'rsatmalar berdi va o'rindiq ostidan oltita murabbo banka, o'nlab nok va bir dasta binafshalarni kontrabanda qildi.

en: At the last minute, Virginia had a fit of sobbing; she embraced her mother again and again, while the latter kissed her on the forehead, and said: “Now, be brave, be brave!” The step was pulled up and the fiacre rumbled off.
uz: So'nggi daqiqada Virjiniya yig'lab yubordi; u onasini qayta-qayta quchoqladi, onasi esa uni peshonasidan o'pdi va dedi: "Endi jasoratli bo'l, jasoratli bo'l!" Qadam yuqoriga tortildi va fyakr g'uvilladi.

en: Then Madame Aubain had a fainting spell, and that evening all her friends, including the two Lormeaus, Madame Lechaptois, the ladies Rochefeuille, Messieurs de Houppeville and Bourais, called on her and tendered their sympathy.
uz: Shunda Aubain xonimning hushidan ketish sehrlari paydo bo'ldi va o'sha oqshom uning barcha do'stlari, jumladan ikkita Lormeaus, Lechaptois xonim, Rochefeuille xonimlari, Houppeville xonimlari va Bourais ham uni chaqirib, o'z hamdardliklarini bildirishdi.

en: At first the separation proved very painful to her.
uz: Avvaliga ajralish unga juda og'riqli bo'lib chiqdi.

en: But her daughter wrote her three times a week and the other days she, herself, wrote to Virginia.
uz: Lekin uning qizi unga haftada uch marta xat yozgan, qolgan kunlari esa u o'zi Virjiniyaga xat yozgan.

en: Then she walked in the garden, read a little, and in this way managed to fill out the emptiness of the hours.
uz: Keyin u bog'da sayr qildi, ozgina o'qidi va shu yo'l bilan soatlarning bo'shlig'ini to'ldirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

en: Each morning, out of habit, Felicite entered Virginia’s room and gazed at the walls.
uz: Har kuni ertalab, odatdan tashqari, Felicite Virjiniyaning xonasiga kirib, devorlarga tikilardi.

en: She missed combing her hair, lacing her shoes, tucking her in her bed, and the bright face and little hand when they used to go out for a walk.
uz: U sochlarini tarashni, poyafzallarini bog'lashni, uni to'shagida ushlab turishni, shuningdek, sayrga chiqqanlarida yorqin yuz va kichkina qo'lini sog'inardi.

en: In order to occupy herself she tried to make lace.
uz: O'zini band qilish uchun u dantel yasashga harakat qildi.

en: But her clumsy fingers broke the threads; she had no heart for anything, lost her sleep and “wasted away,” as she put it.
uz: Ammo uning g'alati barmoqlari iplarni uzdi; u hech narsaga yuragi yo'q edi, uyqusini yo'qotdi va "behuda ketdi", dedi u.

en: In order to have some distraction, she asked leave to receive the visits of her nephew Victor.
uz: Biroz chalg'itish uchun u jiyanining Viktorga tashrif buyurish uchun ruxsat so'radi.

en: He would come on Sunday, after church, with ruddy cheeks and bared chest, bringing with him the scent of the country.
uz: U yakshanba kuni, cherkovdan keyin, qizargan yonoqlari va ochiq ko'kragini ko'tarib, o'zi bilan mamlakat hidini olib kelardi.

en: She would set the table and they would sit down opposite each other, and eat their dinner; she ate as little as possible, herself, to avoid any extra expense, but would stuff him so with food that he would finally go to sleep.
uz: U stolni qo'yardi va ular bir-biriga qarama-qarshi o'tirib, kechki ovqatlarini yeyishardi; u hech qanday qo'shimcha xarajatlardan qochish uchun imkon qadar kamroq yeyardi, lekin uni shunday ovqat bilan to'ldirardiki, u nihoyat uxlardi.

en: At the first stroke of vespers, she would wake him up, brush his trousers, tie his cravat and walk to church with him, leaning on his arm with maternal pride.
uz: Kechki oqshomning birinchi zarbasida uni uyg'otardi, shimlarini artardi, uning karavotini bog'lardi va u bilan birga cherkovga, onalik faxri bilan uning qo'liga suyanib borardi.

en: His parents always told him to get something out of her, either a package of brown sugar, or soap, or brandy, and sometimes even
uz: Uning ota-onasi unga doim undan nimadir olishni aytishardi, xoh bir paket jigarrang shakar, xoh sovun, xoh brendi, ba'zan hatto...

en: He brought her his clothes to mend, and she accepted the task gladly, because it meant another visit from him.
uz: U unga o'z kiyimlarini tuzatish uchun olib keldi va u bu topshiriqni xursandchilik bilan qabul qildi, chunki bu uning yana bir tashrifi edi.

en: In August, his father took him on a coasting-vessel.
uz: Avgust oyida otasi uni qirg'oq kemasiga olib bordi.

en: It was vacation time and the arrival of the children consoled Felicite.
uz: Ta'til vaqti edi va bolalarning kelishi Felicitga tasalli berdi.

en: But Paul was capricious, and Virginia was growing too old to be thee-and-thou’d, a fact which seemed to produce a sort of embarrassment in their relations.
uz: Lekin Pol injiq edi, Virjiniya esa sen-u-sen bo'lish uchun juda keksalashib borayotgan edi, bu fakt ularning munosabatlarida qandaydir noqulaylik tug'dirardi.

en: Victor went successively to Morlaix, to Dunkirk, and to Brighton; whenever he returned from a trip he would bring her a present.
uz: Viktor ketma-ket Morlaixga, Dunkirkga va Brightonga borardi; safardan qaytib kelganida, unga sovg'a olib kelardi.

en: The first time it was a box of shells; the second, a coffee-cup; the third, a big doll of ginger-bread.
uz: Birinchi marta bu qobiq qutisi edi; ikkinchisi, qahva kosasi; uchinchisi, katta zanjabil-non qo'g'irchog'i.

en: He was growing handsome, had a good figure, a tiny moustache, kind eyes, and a little leather cap that sat jauntily on the back of his head.
uz: U o'sib borayotgan edi, tashqi ko'rinishi yaxshi edi, kichkina mo'ylovli, mehribon ko'zlari bor edi va boshining orqa tomonida mayin o'tirgan kichkina charm qalpoq bor edi.

en: He amused his aunt by telling her stories mingled with nautical expressions.
uz: U xolasiga dengiz iboralari bilan aralashtirilgan hikoyalarni aytib, xursand qildi.

en: One Monday, the ൢ൥th of July, ൢ൩ൢ൪ (she never forgot the date), Victor announced that he had been engaged on a merchant-vessel and that in two days he would take the steamer at Honfleur and join his sailer, which was going to start from Havre very soon.
uz: Bir dushanba kuni, iyul oyining  sanasi (u sanani hech qachon unutmagan), Viktor o'zining savdo kemasida bo'lganini va ikki kundan keyin Honfleurdagi bug' kemasini olib, tez orada Havrdan jo'naydigan yelkanchisiga qo'shilishini e'lon qildi.

en: Perhaps he might be away two years.
uz: Balki u ikki yil yo'q bo'lishi mumkin.

en: The prospect of his departure filled Felicite with despair, and in order to bid him farewell, on Wednesday night, after Madame’s dinner, she put on her pattens and trudged the four miles that separated Pont-l’Eveque from Honfleur.
uz: Uning ketish istiqboli Felicitni umidsizlikka soldi va unga xayrlashish uchun, chorshanba kuni kechqurun, xonimning kechki ovqatidan so'ng, u o'z patinalarini kiydi va Pont-lEveque'ni Honfleurdan ajratib turuvchi to'rt mil masofani bosib o'tdi.

en: When she reached the Calvary, instead of turning to the right, she turned to the left and lost herself in coal-yards; she had to retrace her steps; some people she spoke to advised her to hasten.
uz: U Kalvariyaga yetib borgach, o'ng tomonga burilib o'tirmasdan, chap tomonga burilib, ko'mir konlarida adashib qoldi; qadamlarini qaytarishga majbur bo'ldi; ba'zi odamlar bilan gaplashdi va unga tezroq kelishni maslahat berdi.

en: She walked helplessly around the harbour filled with vessels, and knocked against hawsers.
uz: U kemalari bilan to'la port bo'ylab ojiz yurdi va kemachilarga qarshi urildi.

en: Presently the ground sloped abruptly, lights flitted to and fro, and she thought all at once that she had gone mad when she saw some horses in the sky.
uz: Hozirda yer keskin qiyalashdi, chiroqlar bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa sayr qildi va u birdan osmonda otlarni ko'rib, aqldan ozganini o'yladi.

en: Others, on the edge of the dock, neighed at the sight of the ocean.
uz: Boshqalar esa, dok chekkasida, okean ko'rinishida so'lishdi.

en: A derrick pulled them up in the air, and dumped them into a boat, where passengers were bustling about among barrels of cider, baskets of cheese and bags of meal; chickens cackled, the captain swore and a cabin-boy rested on the railing, apparently indifferent to his surroundings.
uz: Ularni bir tentak havoga tortdi va qayiqqa uloqtirdi, u yerda yo'lovchilar sidr bochkalari, pishloq savatlari va o't qoplari orasida shov-shuv bilan yurishardi; tovuqlar qichqirardi, kapitan qasam ichardi va bir bola, ko'rinishidan, atrofga befarq bo'lib, panjarada yotardi.

en: Felicite, who did not recognise him, kept shouting:
uz: Felicit, uni tanimagan holda, baqiraverardi:

en: “Victor!” He suddenly raised his eyes, but while she was preparing to rush up to him, they withdrew the gangplank.
uz: Viktor! U birdaniga kozlarini kotardi, lekin u unga shoshilishga tayyorlanayotganda, ular toplamni olib tashlashdi.

en: The packet, towed by singing women, glided out of the harbour.
uz: Paket, qo'shiqchi ayollar tomonidan tortib olingan holda, portdan sirpanadi.

en: Her hull squeaked and the heavy waves beat up against her sides.
uz: Uning korpusi g'ijirladi va kuchli to'lqinlar uning yon tomonlariga urildi.

en: The sail had turned and nobody was visible;— and on the ocean, silvered by the light of the moon, the vessel formed a black spot that grew dimmer and dimmer, and finally disappeared.
uz: Yelkan ag'darilib ketdi va hech kim ko'rinmas edi;  va okeanda, oy nuri bilan kumushga aylangan holda, kema xiralashib borayotgan qora dog'ni hosil qildi va nihoyat yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

en: When Felicite passed the Calvary again, she felt as if she must entrust that which was dearest to her to the Lord; and for a long while she prayed, with uplifted eyes and a face wet with tears.
uz: Felitsit yana Kalvariyadan o'tgach, go'yo o'ziga eng aziz bo'lgan narsani Rabbiyga topshirish kerakdek his qildi; va uzoq vaqt davomida ko'zlari ko'tarilib, yuzi yosh bilan ho'l holda ibodat qildi.

en: The city was sleeping; some customs officials were taking the air; and the water kept pouring through the holes of the dam with a deafening roar.
uz: Shahar uxlab yotgan edi; ba'zi bojxona xodimlari havo olayotgan edi; va suv to'g'on teshiklaridan kar qiluvchi g'uvillash bilan oqib kelayotgan edi.

en: The town clock struck two.
uz: Shahar soati soat ikkiga tegdi.

en: The parlour of the convent would not open until morning, and surely a delay would annoy Madame, so, in spite of her desire to see the other child, she went home.
uz: Monastir xonasi ertalabgacha ochilmasdi va albatta kechikish xonimni bezovta qilardi, shuning uchun u boshqa bolani ko'rishga intilishiga qaramay, uyiga ketdi.

en: The maids of the inn were just arising when she reached Pont-l’Eveque.
uz: Mehmonxonaning xizmatkorlari Pont-lEvequega yetib borganlarida endigina turishardi.

en: So the poor boy would be on the ocean for months!
uz: Shunday qilib, bechora bola oylab okeanda bo'lardi!

en: His previous trips had not alarmed her.
uz: Uning avvalgi safarlari uni xavotirga solmagan edi.

en: One can come back from England and Brittany; but America, the colonies, the islands, were all lost in an uncertain region at the very end of the world.
uz: Angliya va Brittaniyadan qaytish mumkin; lekin Amerika, mustamlakalar, orollar, dunyoning eng oxirida noaniq hududda yo'qolgan edi.

en: From that time on, Felicite thought solely of her nephew.
uz: O'sha vaqtdan boshlab Felitsit faqat jiyanini o'yladi.

en: On warm days she feared he would suffer from thirst, and when it stormed, she was afraid he would be struck by lightning.
uz: Iliq kunlarda u chanqog'idan azob chekishidan qo'rqardi va u bo'ron bo'lganda, u chaqmoq urishidan qo'rqardi.

en: When she harkened to the wind that rattled in the chimney and dislodged the tiles on the roof, she imagined that he was being buffeted by the same storm, perched on top of a shattered mast, with his whole body bend backward and covered with sea-foam; or,—these were recollections of the engraved geography—he was being devoured by savages, or captured in a forest by apes, or dying on some lonely coast.
uz: U mo'riga urilgan shamolga va tomdagi plitkalarni ag'darganida, u xuddi shu bo'ron tomonidan urilayotganini, butun tanasi orqaga bukilib, dengiz ko'piklari bilan qoplangan, singan ustun ustida qolib ketayotganini tasavvur qildi; yoki, bular o'yilgan geografiyaning xotiralari edi  u yovvoyi yovvoyilar tomonidan yeyilmoqda, yoki maymunlar tomonidan o'rmonda asirga olingan, yoki qaysidir yolg'iz sohilda o'layotgan edi.

en: She never mentioned her anxieties, however.
uz: Lekin u hech qachon o'z xavotirlarini tilga olmadi.

en: Madame Aubain worried about her daughter.
uz: Madame Aubain o'z qizi haqida qayg'urardi.

en: The sisters thought that Virginia was affectionate but delicate.
uz: Opa-singillar Virjiniya mehribon, lekin nozik deb o'ylashardi.

en: The slightest emotion enervated her.
uz: Eng kichik his-tuyg'ular uni hayajonga soldi.

en: She had to give up her piano lessons.
uz: U pianino darslaridan voz kechishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: Her mother insisted upon regular letters from the convent.
uz: Uning onasi monastirdan muntazam xatlar olishni talab qilardi.

en: One morning, when the postman failed to come, she grew impatient
uz: Bir kuni ertalab pochta xodimi kelmagach, u sabrsizlikni boshladi.

en: and began to pace to and fro, from her chair to the window.
uz: va o'z stulidan derazaga qarab, bu yoqqa va bu yoqqa qadam tashlay boshladi.

en: It was really extraordinary!
uz: Bu haqiqatan ham g'ayrioddiy edi!

en: No news since four days!
uz: To'rt kundan beri hech qanday yangilik yo'q!

en: In order to console her mistress by her own example, Felicite said: “Why, Madame, I haven’t had any news since six months!—” “From whom?—” The servant replied gently: “Why—from my nephew.” “Oh, yes, your nephew!” And shrugging her shoulders, Madame Aubain continued to pace the floor as if to say: “I did not think of it.— Besides, I do not care, a cabin-boy, a pauper!—but my daughter— what a difference!
uz: Xo'jayiniga o'z misoli bilan tasalli berish maqsadida, Felicite dedi: Nega, xonim, olti oydan beri hech qanday yangilik eshitmadim! Kimdan? Xizmatkor muloyimlik bilan javob berdi: Nega  jiyanimdan. Oh, ha, jiyaningiz! Va yelkalarini qisib, xonim Aubain xuddi shunday dedi: Men buni o'ylamagandek, Qolaversa, menga farqi yo'q, kulba bola, kambag'al! Lekin mening qizim  nima farqi bor!

en: just think of it!—” Felicite, although she had been reared roughly, was very indignant.
uz: Shunchaki o'ylab ko'ring!Felicit, garchi qo'pol tarbiyalangan bo'lsa ham, juda g'azabda edi.

en: Then she forgot about it.
uz: Keyin u buni unutdi.

en: It appeared quite natural to her that one should lose one’s head about Virginia.
uz: Unga Virjiniya haqida aqldan ozdirishi tabiiy tuyuldi.

en: The two children were of equal importance; they were united in her heart and their fate was to be the same.
uz: Ikki bola bir xil ahamiyatga ega edi; ular uning qalbida bir edi va ularning taqdiri bir xil bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: The chemist informed her that Victor’s vessel had reached Havana.
uz: Kimyogar unga Viktor kemasi Gavanaga yetib kelganini aytdi.

en: He had read the information in a newspaper.
uz: U bu ma'lumotni gazetada o'qigan edi.

en: Felicite imagined that Havana was a place where people did nothing but smoke, and that Victor walked around among negroes in a cloud of tobacco.
uz: Felitsit Havanani odamlar chekishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmaydigan joy deb tasavvur qildi va Viktor tamaki bulutida qora tanlilar orasida aylanib yurardi.

en: Could a person, in case of need, return by land?
uz: Inson zarurat tug'ilganda quruqlik orqali qaytib kelishi mumkinmi?

en: How far was it from Pont-l’Eveque?
uz: Pont-lEveque'dan qancha masofa bor edi?

en: In order to learn these things, she questioned Monsieur Bourais.
uz: Bu narsalarni o'rganish uchun u janob Burayni so'roq qildi.

en: He reached for his map and began some explanations concerning longitudes, and smiled with superiority at Felicite’s bewilderment.
uz: U xaritasiga qo'lini cho'zdi va uzunliklar haqidagi ba'zi tushuntirishlarni boshladi va Felicitening hayratidan ustunlik bilan jilmaydi.

en: At last, he took a pencil and pointed out an imperceptible black point in the scallops of an oval blotch, adding: “There it is.” She bent over the map; the maze of coloured lines hurt her eyes without enlightening her; and when Bourais asked her what puzzled her, she requested him to show her the house Victor lived in.
uz: Nihoyat, u qalamni oldi va oval dog'ning po'stlog'idagi sezilmas qora nuqtani ko'rsatib, qo'shib qo'ydi: "Mana u." U xaritadan pastga egildi; rangli chiziqlar uning ko'zlariga zarar yetkazdi, lekin uni yoritmadi; va Bourais undan uni nima chalkashtirgani haqida so'raganida, u undan Viktor yashagan uyni ko'rsatishni so'radi.

en: Bourais threw up his hands, sneezed, and then laughed uproariously; such ignorance delighted his soul; but Felicite failed to understand the cause of his mirth, she whose intelligence was so limited that she perhaps expected to see even the picture of her nephew!
uz: Bourais qo'llarini ko'tardi, aksirdi va keyin g'azab bilan kuldi; bunday jaholat uning ruhini quvontirdi; lekin Felicite uning quvonchi sababini tushunmadi, uning aqli shunchalik cheklangan ediki, u hatto jiyani suratini ham ko'rishni kutgan bo'lishi mumkin edi!

en: It was two weeks later that Liebard came into the kitchen at market-time, and handed her a letter from her brother-in-law.
uz: Ikki hafta o'tgach, Liebard bozor vaqti bilan oshxonaga kirib, unga qaynonasining xatini topshirdi.

en: neither of them could read, she called upon her mistress.
uz: Ularning ikkalasi ham o'qiy olmasdi, u xo'jayiniga chaqirib oldi.

en: Madame Aubain, who was counting the stitches of her knitting, laid her work down beside her, opened the letter, started, and in a low tone and with a searching look said: “They tell you of a—misfortune.
uz: O'z tikuvlarining choklarini sanayotgan Madame Aubain, o'z ishini uning yoniga qo'ydi, xatni ochdi, boshladi va past ohangda va izlanuvchan nigoh bilan dedi: Sizga baxtsizlik haqida aytishadi.

en: Your nephew—” He had died.
uz: Jiyangiz  U vafot etgan edi.

en: The letter told nothing more.
uz: Xat boshqa hech narsa demadi.

en: Felicite dropped on a chair, leaned her head against the back, and closed her lids; presently they grew pink.
uz: Felicite stulga tushib, boshini orqaga suyanib, qopqoqlarini yopdi; hozir ular pushti rangga aylandi.

en: Then, with drooping head, inert hands and staring eyes she repeated at intervals: “Poor little chap!
uz: Keyin, boshini egib, inert qo'llari va tikilib turgan ko'zlari bilan u vaqti-vaqti bilan takrorlardi: Bechora kichkina do'st!

en: poor little chap!” Liebard watched her and sighed.
uz: Bechora kichkina bola! Liebard uni kuzatdi va xo'rsindi.

en: Madame Aubain was trembling.
uz: Madame Aubain titrayotgan edi.

en: She proposed to the girl to go to see her sister in Trouville.
uz: U qizga singlisini Trouvillega borishni taklif qildi.

en: With a single motion, Felicite replied that it was not necessary.
uz: Birgina harakat bilan Felitsit bunga hojat yo'qligini javob berdi.

en: There was a silence.
uz: Tinchlik hukm surdi.

en: Old Liebard thought it about time for him to take leave.
uz: Keksa Liebard uning ta'tilga chiqishi vaqti keldi deb o'yladi.

en: Then Felicite uttered: “They have no sympathy, they do not care!” Her head fell forward again, and from time to time, mechanically, she toyed with the long knitting-needles on the work-table.
uz: Shunda Felicite shunday dedi: Ularga hech qanday rahm yo'q, ularga farqi yo'q! Uning boshi yana oldinga yiqildi va vaqti-vaqti bilan, mexanik tarzda, u ish stolida uzun to'quv ignalari bilan o'ynardi.

en: Some women passed through the yard with a basket of wet clothes.
uz: Ba'zi ayollar hovlidan ho'l kiyimlar savati bilan o'tib ketishardi.

en: When she saw them through the window, she suddenly remembered her own wash; as she had soaked it the day before, she must go and rinse it now.
uz: U ularni derazadan ko'rib, birdaniga o'zining yuvinishini esladi; chunki u bir kun oldin ho'l qilgan edi, endi borib yuvishi kerak edi.

en: So she arose and left the room.
uz: Shunday qilib, u o'rnidan turdi va xonadan chiqdi.

en: Her tub and her board were on the bank of the Toucques.
uz: Uning vannalari va taxtasi Tuxkalar qirg'og'ida edi.

en: She threw a heap of clothes on the ground, rolled up her sleeves and grasped her bat; and her loud pounding could be heard in the neighbouring gardens.
uz: U bir uyum kiyimni yerga tashladi, yenglarini o'rab, ko'rshapalakni ushladi; va uning baland urishi qo'shni bog'larda eshitilardi.

en: The meadows were empty, the breeze wrinkled the stream, at the bottom of which were long grasses that looked like the hair of corpses floating in the water.
uz: Oʻtloqlar boʻm-boʻsh edi, shamol ariqni ajinlardi, uning ostida suvda suzuvchi murdalarning tuklariga oʻxshagan uzun oʻtlar bor edi.

en: She restrained her sorrow and was very brave until night; but, when she had gone to her own room, she gave way to it, burying her face in the pillow and pressing her two fists against her temples.
uz: U qayg'usini tiydi va tungacha juda jasur edi; lekin, o'z xonasiga borgach, unga yo'l berdi, yuzini yostiqqa ko'mib, ikki mushtini ibodatxonalariga bosdi.

en: A long while afterward, she learned through Victor’s captain, the circumstances which surrounded his death.
uz: Ko'p vaqt o'tgach, u Viktorning kapitanidan uning o'limiga sabab bo'lgan vaziyatlarni bilib oldi.

en: At the hospital they had bled him too much, treating him for yellow fever.
uz: Kasalxonada uni juda ko'p qon quyishdi, sariq isitma uchun davolashdi.

en: He died almost instantly, and the chief surgeon had said: “Here goes another one!” His parents had always treated him barbarously; she preferred not to see them again, and they made no advances, either from forgetfulness or out of innate hardness.
uz: U deyarli bir zumda vafot etdi va bosh jarroh dedi: Mana yana biri! Uning ota-onasi unga doim shafqatsizlarcha munosabatda bo'lishgan; u ularni qayta ko'rmaslikni afzal ko'rardi va ular na unutilishdan, na tug'ma qattiqqo'llikdan oldinga siljishmadi.

en: Virginia was growing weaker.
uz: Virjiniya zaiflashib borardi.

en: A cough, continual fever, oppressive breathing and spots on her cheeks indicated some serious trouble.
uz: Yo'tal, doimiy isitma, bosimli nafas olish va uning yonoqlarida dog'lar jiddiy muammoga ishora qilardi.

en: Monsieur Popart had advised a sojourn in Provence.
uz: Janob Popart Provansda qolishni maslahat bergan edi.

en: Madame Aubain decided that they would go, and she would have had her daughter come home at once, had it not been for the climate of Pont-l’Eveque.
uz: Madame Aubain ular ketishga qaror qilishdi va u Pont-lEveque iqlimi bo'lmaganida, qizini darhol uyga qaytargan bo'lardi.

en: She made an arrangement with a livery-stable man who drove her over to the convent every Tuesday.
uz: U har seshanba kuni uni monastirga haydab keladigan, hayotiy barqaror erkak bilan kelishuv tuzdi.

en: In the garden there was a terrace, from which the view extends to the Seine.
uz: Bog'da bir ayvon bor edi, undan Seyna daryosiga qarab ko'rinadi.

en: Virginia walked in it, leaning on her mother’s arm and treading the dead vine leaves.
uz: Virjiniya onasining qo'liga suyanib, o'lik tok barglarini bosib yurdi.

en: Sometimes the sun, shining through the clouds, made her blink her lids, when she gazed at the sails in the distance, and let her eyes roam over the horizon from the chateau of Tancarville to the lighthouses of Havre.
uz: Ba'zan quyosh bulutlar orasidan porlab, uni uzoqdagi yelkanlarga tikilib turganda, qopqog'ini miltillatardi va ko'zlari Tancarville qasridan Havre mayoqlarigacha ufqdan o'tib turardi.

en: Then they rested on the arbour.
uz: Keyin ular kamonga dam olishdi.

en: Her mother had bought a little cask of fine Malaga wine, and Virginia, laughing at the idea of becoming intoxicated, would drink a few drops of it, but never more.
uz: Onasi bir piyola mayda Malaga vinosini sotib olgan edi va Virjiniya mast bo'lish fikridan kulgan holda, undan bir necha tomchi ichardi, lekin hech qachon boshqa.

en: Her strength returned.
uz: Uning kuchi qaytib keldi.

en: Felicite began to reassure Madame Aubain.
uz: Felicit Madame Aubainni tinchlantira boshladi.

en: But, one evening, when she returned home after an errand, she met M.
uz: Ammo, bir kuni kechqurun, u topshiriqdan keyin uyga qaytib kelganida, M. bilan uchrashdi.

en: Boupart’s coach in front of the door; M.
uz: Boupartning vagoni eshik oldida; M.

en: Boupart himself was standing in the vestibule and Madame Aubain was tying the strings of her bonnet.
uz: Boupartning o'zi chodirda turardi va Madame Aubain o'z qalpoqlarining iplarini bog'lab turardi.

en: “Give me my foot-warmer, my purse and my gloves; and be quick about it,” she said.
uz: "Oyog'imni isitgich, hamyonim va qo'lqoplarimni bering; va tezroq shunga tayyor bo'ling," dedi u.

en: Virginia had congestion of the lungs; perhaps it was desperate.
uz: Virjiniyada o'pka tiqilinchi bor edi; ehtimol, bu umidsizlik edi.

en: “Not yet,” said the physician, and both got into the carriage, while the snow fell in thick flakes.
uz: Hali emas,  dedi shifokor va ikkalasi ham aravaga chiqdilar, qor esa qalin bo'laklarga bo'linib tushdi.

en: It was almost night and very cold.
uz: Deyarli kech edi va juda sovuq edi.

en: Felicite rushed to the church to light a candle.
uz: Felicit sham yoqish uchun cherkovga shoshildi.

en: Then she ran after the coach which she overtook after an hour’s chase, sprang up behind and held on to the straps.
uz: Keyin u bir soatlik ta'qibdan keyin yetib kelgan murabbiyning orqasidan yugurdi, orqaga sakradi va tasmalarni ushladi.

en: But suddenly a thought crossed her mind: “The yard had been left open; supposing that burglars got in!”
uz: Ammo birdaniga uning xayolidan bir fikr o'tdi: Hovli ochiq qoldirilgan edi; taxmin qilaylikki, o'g'rilar kirgan!

en: And down she jumped.
uz: Va pastga sakradi.

en: The next morning, at daybreak, she called at the doctor’s.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, tong otishida u shifokorga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

en: He had been home, but had left again.
uz: U uyda edi, lekin yana ketdi.

en: Then she waited at the inn, thinking that strangers might bring her a letter.
uz: Keyin u mehmonxonada kutdi, begona odamlar unga xat olib kelishi mumkin deb o'yladi.

en: At last, at daylight she took the diligence for Lisieux.
uz: Nihoyat, kunduzgi yorug'likda u Lisieux uchun tekshiruvni o'tkazdi.

en: The convent was at the end of a steep and narrow street.
uz: Monastir tik va tor ko'chaning oxirida edi.

en: When she arrived about at the middle of it, she heard strange noises, a funeral knell.
uz: U taxminan o'rtasiga yetib borgach, g'alati shovqinlar, dafn marosimi qo'ng'irog'ini eshitdi.

en: “It must be for some one else,” thought she; and she pulled the knocker violently.
uz: "Bu boshqa birov uchun bo'lishi kerak," deb o'yladi u; va u taqillatgichni shiddat bilan tortdi.

en: After several minutes had elapsed, she heard footsteps, the door was half opened and a nun appeared.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tgach, u qadamlarni eshitdi, eshik yarim ochildi va rohiba paydo bo'ldi.

en: The good sister, with an air of compunction, told her that “she had just passed away.” And at the same time the tolling of Saint-Leonard’s increased.
uz: Yaxshi opa-singil, achchiqlanib, unga "u endigina vafot etdi" dedi. Shu bilan birga, Sent-Leonardning to'lovi oshdi.

en: Felicite reached the second floor.
uz: Felicite ikkinchi qavatga yetib keldi.

en: Already at the threshold, she caught sight of Virginia lying on her back, with clasped hands, her mouth open and her head thrown back, beneath a black crucifix inclined toward her, and stiff curtains which were less white than her face.
uz: Darvozada u Virjiniyaning orqa tomonda, qo'llari qisilgan holda, og'zi ochiq va boshi orqaga uloqtirilgan holda, unga moyil qora xoch ostida va yuziga qaraganda kamroq oq bo'lgan qattiq pardalar ostida yotganini ko'rdi.

en: Madame Aubain lay at the foot of the couch, clasping it with her arms and uttering groans of agony.
uz: Madame Aubain divanning etagida yotardi, uni qo'llari bilan qisib, azobdan ingradi.

en: The Mother Superior was standing on the right side of the bed.
uz: Ona Superior karavotning o'ng tomonida turardi.

en: The three candles on the bureau made red blurs, and the windows were dimmed by the fog outside.
uz: Ofisdagi uchta sham qizil xiraliklarni keltirib chiqardi va derazalar tashqi tuman tufayli xiralashdi.

en: The nuns carried Madame Aubain from the room.
uz: Rohibalar Madame Aubainni xonadan olib chiqishdi.

en: For two nights, Felicite never left the corpse.
uz: Ikki kecha davomida Felitsit jasadni hech qachon tark etmadi.

en: She would repeat the same prayers, sprinkle holy water over the sheets, get up, come back to the bed and contemplate the body.
uz: U bir xil duolarni takrorlardi, choyshablar ustiga muqaddas suv separdi, turardi, karavotga qaytib, jasadni o'ylardi.

en: At the end of the first vigil, she noticed that the face had taken on a yellow tinge, the lips grew blue, the nose grew pinched, the eyes were sunken.
uz: Birinchi uyg'onish oxirida u yuzining sariq rangga kirganini, lablari ko'karganini, burni chimchilaganini, ko'zlari cho'kganini payqadi.

en: She kissed them several times and would not have been greatly astonished had Virginia opened them; to souls like this the supernatural is always quite simple.
uz: U ularni bir necha marta o'pdi va Virjiniya ularni ochganida unchalik hayratlanmagan bo'lardi; bunday jonlarga g'ayritabiiy narsa doim juda oddiy bo'lardi.

en: She washed her, wrapped her in a shroud, put her into the casket, laid a wreath of flowers on her head and arranged her curls.
uz: U uni yuvdi, choyshabga o'radi, tobutga soldi, boshiga gulchambar qo'ydi va jingalaklarini joylashtirdi.

en: They were blond and of an extraordinary length for her age.
uz: Ular sarg'ish va uning yoshiga nisbatan g'ayrioddiy uzunlikdagi edilar.

en: Felicite cut off a big lock and put half of it into her bosom, resolving never to part with it.
uz: Felicite katta qulfni kesib, uning yarmini ko'kragiga soldi va hech qachon undan ajralmaslikka qaror qildi.

en: The body was taken to Pont-l’Eveque, according to Madame Aubain’s wishes; she followed the hearse in a closed carriage.
uz: Jasad Madame Aubainning xohishiga ko'ra Pont-lEvequega olib ketildi; u yopiq aravacha ichida dafn aravachasiga ergashdi.

en: After the ceremony it took three quarters of an hour to reach the cemetery.
uz: Marosimdan so'ng qabristonga yetib borish uchun uch chorak soat ketdi.

en: Paul, sobbing, headed the procession; Monsieur Bourais followed, and then came the principal inhabitants of the town, the women covered with black capes, and Felicite.
uz: Pavlus yig'lab, marshrutni boshladi; janob Buray ergashdi, so'ngra shaharning asosiy aholisi, qora kepka kiygan ayollar va Felicite keldi.

en: The memory of her nephew, and the thought that she had not been able to render him these honours, made her doubly unhappy, and she felt as if he were being buried with Virginia.
uz: Jiyani xotirasi va unga bu sharaflarni bera olmaganligi haqidagi fikr uni ikki barobar baxtsiz qildi va u Virjiniya bilan birga dafn etilgandek his qildi.

en: Madame Aubain’s grief was uncontrollable.
