uz: Madame Aubainning qayg'usi nazorat qilib bo'lmas edi.

en: At first she rebelled against God, thinking that he was unjust to have taken away her child—she who had never done anything wrong, and whose conscience was so pure!
uz: Avvaliga u Xudoga qarshi isyon ko'tardi, uning farzandini olib qo'ygani adolatsiz deb o'yladi  u hech qachon yomon ish qilmagan va vijdoni shunchalik toza edi!

en: she ought to have taken her South.
uz: U o'zining janubini olishi kerak edi.

en: Other doctors would have saved her.
uz: Boshqa shifokorlar uni qutqargan bo'lardi.

en: She accused herself, prayed to be able to join her child, and cried in the midst of her dreams.
uz: U o'zini aybladi, farzandiga qo'shilish uchun ibodat qildi va tushlari orasida yig'ladi.

en: Of the latter, one more especially haunted her.
uz: Ikkinchisidan yana biri uni ayniqsa ta'qib qilardi.

en: Her husband, dressed like a sailor, had come back from a long voyage, and with tears in his eyes told her that he had received the order to take Virginia away.
uz: Uning eri, dengizchi kabi kiyingan holda, uzoq safardan qaytib kelgan edi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan Virjiniyani olib ketish buyrug'ini olganini aytdi.

en: Then they both consulted about a hiding- place.
uz: Keyin ikkalasi ham yashirinish joyini maslahatlashdilar.

en: Once she came in from the garden, all upset.
uz: U bog'dan kirgach, butunlay xafa edi.

en: A moment before (and she showed the place), the father and daughter had appeared to her, one after the other; they did nothing but look at her.
uz: Bir oz oldin (va u joyni ko'rsatdi), ota va qiz unga birin-ketin ko'rinish berishdi; ular unga faqatgina qarashardi.

en: During several months she remained inert in her room.
uz: Bir necha oy davomida u xonasida inert bo'lib qoldi.

en: Felicite scolded her gently; she must keep up for her son and also for the other one, for “her memory.” “Her memory!” replied Madame Aubain, as if she were just awakening, “Oh!
uz: Felitsit uni muloyimlik bilan tanbeh berdi; u o'g'lini ham, boshqasini ham "uning xotirasi" uchun o'z o'rnini bosishi kerak edi. "Uning xotirasi!" - deb javob berdi Madame Aubain go'yo endigina uyg'onayotgandek, "Oh!

en: yes, yes, you do not forget her!” This was an allusion to the cemetery where she had been expressly forbidden to go.
uz: Ha, ha, sen uni unutmaysan! Bu unga qat'iyan borishga taqiqlangan qabristonga ishora edi.

en: But Felicite went there every day.
uz: Lekin Felitit u yerga har kuni borardi.

en: At four o’clock exactly, she would go through the town, climb the hill, open the gate and arrive at Virginia’s tomb.
uz: Soat to'rtda u shahar bo'ylab o'tib, tepalikka chiqardi, darvozani ochardi va Virjiniyaning qabriga yetib borardi.

en: It was a small column of pink marble with a flat stone at its base, and it was surrounded by a little plot enclosed by chains.
uz: U pushti marmardan yasalgan kichik ustun edi, tagida tekis tosh bor edi va uni zanjirlar bilan o'ralgan kichik bir uchastka o'rab turardi.

en: The flower-beds were bright with blossoms.
uz: Gulzorlar gullari bilan yorqin edi.

en: Felicite watered their leaves, renewed the gravel, and knelt on the ground in order to till
uz: Felicit barglarini sug'ordi, shag'alni yangilab, yerga tizzalab, ekin ekdi.

en: When Madame Aubain was able to visit the cemetery she felt very much relieved and consoled.
uz: Madame Aubain qabristonga tashrif buyurishga muvaffaq bo'lganida, u juda xotirjam va tasalli topdi.

en: Years passed, all alike and marked by no other events than the return of the great church holidays: Easter, Assumption, All Saints’ Day.
uz: Yillar o'tdi, hammasi bir xil va buyuk cherkov bayramlarining qaytishidan boshqa hech qanday voqea bilan nishonlanmadi: Pasxa, Assumption, All Saints' Day.

en: Household happenings constituted the only data to which in later years they often referred.
uz: Maishiy hodisalar keyingi yillarda ular tez-tez murojaat qiladigan yagona ma'lumotni tashkil etdi.

en: Thus, in ൢ൩ൣ൦, workmen painted the vestibule; in ൢ൩ൣ൨, a portion of the roof almost killed a man by falling into the yard.
uz: Shunday qilib, da ishchilar ayvonni bo'yashdi; da, tomning bir qismi hovliga tushib, odamni deyarli o'ldirdi.

en: In the summer of ൢ൩ൣ൩, it was Madame’s turn to offer the hallowed bread; at that time, Bourais disappeared mysteriously; and the old acquaintances, Guyot, Liebard, Madame Lechaptois, Robelin, old Gremanville, paralysed since a long time, passed away one by one.
uz: Yozda , muqaddas nonni taklif qilish xonimning navbatida edi; o'sha paytda Bourais sirli tarzda g'oyib bo'ldi; va eski tanishlar, Guyot, Liebard, Xonim Lechaptois, Robelin, eski Gremanvil, uzoq vaqtdan beri falaj bo'lgan, birma-bir vafot etdi.

en: One night, the driver of the mail in Pont-l’Eveque announced the Revolution of July.
uz: Bir kuni kechasi Pont-lEveque shahridagi pochta haydovchisi Iyul inqilobini e'lon qildi.

en: A few days afterward a new sub-prefect was nominated, the Baron de Larsonniere, ex-consul in America, who, besides his wife, had his sister-in-law and her three grown daughters with him.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng yangi sub-prefekt nomzodi ko'rsatildi, u Baron de Larsonniere, Amerikadagi sobiq konsul edi. Uning rafiqasidan tashqari, uning qaynsog'i va uning uchta yetuk qizi ham bor edi.

en: They were often seen on their lawn, dressed in loose blouses, and they had a parrot and a negro servant.
uz: Ularni ko'pincha gazonlarida, bo'sh ko'ylaklarda ko'rishardi va ularning to'tiqush va qora xizmatkori bor edi.

en: Madame Aubain received a call, which she returned promptly.
uz: Madame Aubain qo'ng'iroq oldi va u zudlik bilan javob berdi.

en: As soon as she caught sight of them, Felicite would run and notify her mistress.
uz: U ularni ko'rishi bilanoq, Felicite yugurib, xo'jayiniga xabar berardi.

en: But only one thing was capable of arousing her: a letter from her son.
uz: Lekin uni faqat bir narsa uyg'otishga qodir edi: o'g'lining xati.

en: He could not follow any profession as he was absorbed in drinking.
uz: U hech qanday kasbga kirisha olmadi, chunki u ichishga berilib ketgan edi.

en: His mother paid his debts and he made fresh ones; and the sighs that she heaved while she knitted at the window reached the ears of Felicite who was spinning in the kitchen.
uz: Onasi uning qarzlarini to'ladi va u yangi qarzlarni tayyorladi; va u derazada to'qiganida yig'lagan ohlar oshxonada aylanib yurgan Felicitening qulog'iga yetdi.

en: They walked in the garden together, always speaking of Virginia, and asking each other if such and such a thing would have pleased her, and what she would probably have said on this or that occasion.
uz: Ular birga bog'da sayr qilishardi, doim Virjiniya haqida gapirishardi va bir-birlaridan shunday narsa unga yoqqanmi yoki yo'qmi, va u bu yoki bu vaziyatda nima degan bo'lishi mumkin edi, deb so'rashardi.

en: All her little belongings were put away in a closet of the room which held the two little beds.
uz: Uning barcha mayda buyumlari ikki kichkina karavotni o'z ichiga olgan xonaning shkafiga joylashtirildi.

en: But Madame Aubain looked them over as little as possible.
uz: Ammo Madame Aubain ularga imkon qadar kamroq qaradi.

en: One summer day, however, she resigned herself to the task and when she opened the closet the moths flew out.
uz: Ammo bir yoz kuni u bu vazifaga taslim bo'ldi va shkafni ochganida ko'rshapalaklar uchib ketdi.

en: Virginia’s frocks were hung under a shelf where there were three dolls, some hoops, a doll-house, and a basic which she had used.
uz: Virjiniyaning ko'ylaklari uchta qo'g'irchoq, bir nechta halqalar, qo'g'irchoq uyi va u ishlatgan oddiy narsa bor tokcha ostiga osib qo'yilgan edi.

en: Felicite and Madame Aubain also took out the skirts, the handkerchiefs, and the stockings and spread them on the beds,
uz: Felicite va Madame Aubain ham yubkalar, ro'mollar va paypoqlarni olib, karavotlarga yoyishdi.

en: before putting them away again.
uz: ularni yana uzoqlashtirishdan oldin.

en: The sun fell on the piteous things, disclosing their spots and the creases formed by the motions of the body.
uz: Quyosh behayo narsalarga tushdi, ularning dog'larini va tana harakatlari natijasida hosil bo'lgan burmalarni ochib berdi.

en: The atmosphere was warm and blue, and a blackbird trilled in the garden; everything seemed to live in happiness.
uz: Atmosfera iliq va ko'k edi, bog'da bir qora qush uchib yurardi; hamma narsa baxtda yashayotgandek edi.

en: They found a little hat of soft brown plush, but it was entirely moth-eaten.
uz: Ular yumshoq jigarrang, yumshoq shapka topishdi, lekin u butunlay ko'rshapalaklar tomonidan yeyilgan edi.

en: Felicite asked for it.
uz: Felicite so'radi.

en: Their eyes met and filled with tears; at last the mistress opened her arms and the servant threw herself against her breast and they hugged each other and giving vent to their grief in a kiss which equalised them for a moment.
uz: Ularning ko'zlari bir-biriga to'lib, ko'z yoshlari bilan to'ldi; nihoyat bekasi qo'llarini ochdi va xizmatkor o'zini ko'kragiga tashladi. Ular bir-birlarini quchoqlab, bir lahzaga tenglashtirgan o'pichda qayg'usini yo'qotishdi.

en: It was the first time that this had ever happened, for Madame Aubain was not of an expansive nature.
uz: Bu birinchi marta sodir bo'lgan edi, chunki Madame Aubain keng xarakterga ega emas edi.

en: Felicite was as grateful for it as if it had been some favour, and thenceforth loved her with animal- like devotion and a religious veneration.
uz: Felicit bu uchun xuddi qandaydir bir marhamatdek minnatdor edi va bundan keyin uni hayvonga o'xshagan sadoqat va diniy hurmat bilan sevdi.

en: Her kind-heartedness developed.
uz: Uning mehribonligi rivojlandi.

en: When she heard the drums of a marching regiment passing through the street, she would stand in the doorway with a jug of cider and give the soldiers a drink.
uz: Ko'chadan o'tayotgan yurish polkining barabanlarini eshitganda, u eshik oldida bir banka sidr bilan turardi va askarlarga ichimlik berardi.

en: She nursed cholera victims.
uz: U xolera qurbonlariga emizdi.

en: She protected Polish refugees, and one of them even declared that he wished to marry her.
uz: U polshalik qochqinlarni himoya qildi va ulardan biri hatto unga turmushga chiqishni xohlashini e'lon qildi.

en: But they quarrelled, for one morning when she returned from the Angelus she found him in the kitchen coolly eating a dish which he had prepared for himself during her absence.
uz: Ammo ular janjallashdilar, chunki bir kuni ertalab u Angelusdan qaytib kelganida, uni oshxonada uning yo'qligida o'zi uchun tayyorlagan taomni salqinlik bilan yeyayotganini topdi.

en: After the Polish refugees, came Colmiche, an old man who was credited with having committed frightful misdeeds in ‘൪൤.
uz: Polshalik qochqinlardan keyin Colmiche keldi, u da dahshatli jinoyatlarni sodir etgan deb hisoblangan keksa odam edi.

en: He lived near the river in the ruins of a pig-sty.
uz: U daryo yaqinida, cho'chqaxona xarobalarida yashardi.

en: The urchins peeped at him through the cracks in the walls and threw stones that fell on his miserable bed, where he lay gasping with catarrh, with long hair, inflamed eyelids, and a tumour as big as his head on one arm.
uz: Chumolilar unga devorlardagi yoriqlar ichidan tikilib turardi va uning bechora karovatida toshlar uloqtirardi. U yerda u katarradan, uzun sochlar, yallig'langan qovoqlardan va bir qo'lida boshidek katta o'sma bilan shivirlab yotardi.

en: She got him some linen, tried to clean his hovel and dreamed of installing him in the bake-house without his being in Madame’s way.
uz: U unga choyshab olib berdi, hovlisini tozalashga harakat qildi va uni xonimning yo'liga to'sqinlik qilmasdan, pishirish xonasiga joylashtirishni orzu qildi.

en: When the cancer broke, she dressed it every day; sometimes she brought him some cake and placed him in the sun on a bundle of hay; and the poor old creature, trembling and drooling, would thank her in his broken voice, and put out his hands whenever she left him.
uz: Saraton kasalligi chiqqanida, u uni har kuni kiyitardi; ba'zan unga tort olib kelardi va quyoshda bir bog' somon ustiga qo'yardi; va bechora keksa maxluq, titrab va shivirlab, unga singan ovozida minnatdorchilik bildirardi va uni tark etganida qo'llarini cho'zardi.

en: Finally he died; and she had a mass said for the repose of his soul.
uz: Nihoyat u vafot etdi; va u uning ruhining dam olishi uchun bir tarozi aytdi.

en: That day a great joy came to her: at dinner-time, Madame de Larsonniere’s servant called with the parrot, the cage, and the perch and chain and lock.
uz: O'sha kuni unga katta quvonch keldi: kechki ovqat paytida Larsonniere xonimning xizmatkori to'tiqush, qafas, perch, zanjir va qulf bilan birga chaqirdi.

en: A note from the baroness told Madame Aubain
uz: Baronessning Madame Aubainga bergan xabari.

en: that as her husband had been promoted to a prefecture, they were leaving that night, and she begged her to accept the bird as a remembrance and a token of her esteem.
uz: Uning eri prefekturaga ko'tarilganligi sababli, ular o'sha kechasi ketayotgan edilar va u undan qushni xotira va hurmat belgisi sifatida qabul qilishni iltimos qildi.

en: Since a long time the parrot had been on Felicite’s mind, because he came from America, which reminded her of Victor, and she had approached the negro on the subject.
uz: Felicitning xayolida to'tiqush ancha vaqtdan beri bor edi, chunki u Amerikadan kelgan edi, bu unga Viktorni eslatib turardi va u bu mavzuda negroga yaqinlashgan edi.

en: Once even, she had said: “How glad Madame would be to have him!” The man had repeated this remark to his mistress who, not being able to keep the bird, took this means of getting rid of it.
uz: Bir marta u shunday degan edi: Xonim uning borligidan qanchalik xursand bo'lardi! Erkak bu gapni xotiniga takrorlagan edi, u qushni saqlab qola olmagani uchun undan qutulishning bu vositasini qo'llagan edi.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 4 He was called Loulou.
uz: U Loulou deb atalgan.

en: His body was green, his head blue, the tips of his wings were pink and his breast was golden.
uz: Uning tanasi yashil, boshi ko'k, qanot uchlari pushti va ko'kragi oltin edi.

en: But he had the tiresome tricks of biting his perch, pulling his feathers out, scattering refuse and spilling the water of his bath.
uz: Ammo u o'zining tayanchini tishlash, patlarini tortib olish, axlatni to'kish va vannasining suvini to'kish kabi zerikarli hiylalarga ega edi.

en: Madame Aubain grew tired of him and gave him to Felicite for good.
uz: Madame Aubain undan zerikib ketdi va uni Felicitga butunlay berdi.

en: She undertook his education, and soon he was able to repeat: “Pretty boy!
uz: U uning ta'limini o'z zimmasiga oldi va tez orada u takrorlay oldi: Go'zal bola!

en: I salute you, Marie!” His perch was placed near the door and several persons were astonished that he did not answer to the name of “Jacquot,” for every parrot is called Jacquot.
uz: Salom senga, Mariya! Uning ustuni eshik yoniga qo'yildi va bir necha kishi u "Jacquot" nomiga javob bermaganiga hayron bo'lishdi, chunki har bir to'tiqush Jacquot deb ataladi.

en: They called him a goose and a log, and these taunts were like so many dagger thrusts to Felicite.
uz: Ular uni g'oz va g'o'la deb atashdi va bu masxaralarFelicitga ko'plab xanjar zarbalariga o'xshardi.

en: Strange stubbornness of the bird which would not talk when people watched him!
uz: Odamlar uni kuzatganda gapirmaydigan qushning g'alati qaysarligi!

en: Nevertheless, he sought society; for on Sunday, when the ladies Rochefeuille, Monsieur de Houppeville and the new habitues, Onfroy, the chemist, Monsieur Varin and Captain Mathieu, dropped in for their game of cards, he struck the window-panes with his wings and made such a racket that it was impossible to talk.
uz: Shunga qaramay, u jamiyatni izladi; chunki yakshanba kuni, Rochefeuille xonimlari, Monsieur de Houppeville va yangi odatdagilar, Onfroy, kimyogar, Monsieur Varin va kapitan Mathieu karta o'yinlari uchun tushganda, u qanotlari bilan deraza panellariga urdi va shunday racket qildi, gapirishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: Bourais’ face must have appeared very funny to Loulou.
uz: Bouraisning yuzi Louluga juda kulgili ko'ringan bo'lishi kerak.

en: As soon as he saw him he would begin to roar.
uz: Uni ko'rishi bilanoq, u g'uvillay boshlaydi.

en: His voice re-echoed in the yard, and the neighbours would come to the windows and begin to laugh, too; and in order that the parrot might not see him, Monsieur Bourais edged along the wall, pushed his hat over his eyes to hide his profile, and entered by the garden door, and the looks he gave the bird lacked affection.
uz: Uning ovozi hovlida qayta eshitildi, qo'shnilar ham derazalarga kelib, kulishni boshlashardi; va to'tiqush uni ko'rmasligi uchun, janob Buray devor bo'ylab qisqa bo'lib, ko'zlarini yashirish uchun shapkasini ko'zlariga surib, bog' eshigi orqali kirdi va u qushga bergan qarashlari mehrga to'la edi.

en: Loulou, having thrust his head into the butcher-boy’s basket, received a slap, and from that time he always tried to nip his enemy.
uz: Loulou boshini qassob bolaning savatiga tiqdi va shapaloq oldi, va o'shandan beri u doimo dushmanini chaqishga harakat qilardi.

en: Fabu threatened to ring his neck, although he was not cruelly inclined, notwithstanding his big whiskers and
uz: Fabu bo'yniga uzuk qo'yish bilan tahdid qildi, garchi u shafqatsizlarcha moyil bo'lmasa ham, katta mo'ylovlariga qaramay va

en: On the contrary, he rather liked the bird, and, out of devilry, tried to teach him oaths.
uz: Aksincha, u qushni yaxshi ko'rardi va yovuzlikdan kelib chiqib, unga qasam ichishni o'rgatishga harakat qilardi.

en: Felicite, whom his manner alarmed, put Loulou in the kitchen, took off his chain and let him walk all over the house.
uz: Felicite, uning xulq-atvori uni xavotirga soldi, Louluni oshxonaga qo'ydi, zanjirini yechdi va butun uy bo'ylab yurishga qo'ydi.

en: When he went downstairs, he rested his beak on the steps, lifted his right foot and then his left one; but his mistress feared that such feats would give him vertigo.
uz: U pastga tushganda, tumshug'ini zinapoyalarga qo'ydi, o'ng oyog'ini, keyin chap oyog'ini ko'tardi; lekin uning bekasi bunday harakatlar unga aylanib ketishidan qo'rqardi.

en: He became ill and was unable to eat.
uz: U kasal bo'lib qoldi va ovqat yeya olmadi.

en: There was a small growth under his tongue like those chickens are sometimes afflicted with.
uz: Uning tili ostida ba'zan o'sha tovuqlarga o'xshagan kichik o'sish bor edi.

en: Felicite pulled it off with her nails and cured him.
uz: Felicite uni tirnoqlari bilan tortib oldi va uni davoladi.

en: One day, Paul was imprudent enough to blow the smoke of his cigar in his face; another time, Madame Lormeau was teasing him with the tip of her umbrella and he swallowed the tip.
uz: Bir kuni Pol o'z sigaretining tutunini yuziga otib yuborishga qadar beparvo edi; boshqa safar esa, Lormeau xonim uni soyabonining uchi bilan masxara qilayotgan edi va u uchini yutdi.

en: Finally he got lost.
uz: Nihoyat adashib ketdi.

en: She had put him on the grass to cool him and went away only for a second; when she returned, she found no parrot!
uz: U uni sovutish uchun o'tga qo'ygan edi va bir soniyaga ketdi; qaytib kelganida, hech qanday to'tiqush topmadi!

en: She hunted among the bushes, on the bank of the river, and on the roofs, without paying any attention to Madame Aubain who screamed at her: “Take care!
uz: U butalar orasida, daryo qirg'og'ida va tomlarda ov qilardi, unga baqirayotgan Madame Aubainga e'tibor bermasdan: "O'zingni ehtiyot qil!"

en: you must be insane!” Then she searched every garden in Pont- l’Eveque and stopped the passers-by to inquire of them: “Haven’t you perhaps seen my parrot?” To those who had never seen the parrot, she described him minutely.
uz: Siz aqldan ozgan bo'lsangiz kerak! Keyin u Pont-lEveque shahridagi har bir bog'ni qidirdi va o'tib ketayotganlarni so'rash uchun to'xtatdi: Siz mening to'tiqushimni ko'rmaganmisiz? To'tiqushni hech qachon ko'rmaganlarga u uni nozik tasvirladi.

en: Suddenly she thought she saw something green fluttering behind the mills at the foot of the hill.
uz: To'satdan u tepalik etagidagi tegirmonlar ortida yashil narsa hilpirayotganini ko'rdim deb o'yladi.

en: But when she was at the top of the hill she could not see it.
uz: Ammo u tepalikning tepasida bo'lganida, uni ko'ra olmadi.

en: A hod-carrier told her that he had just seen the bird in Saint-Melaine, in Mother Simon’s store.
uz: Bir ko'r-ko'rona tashuvchi unga Saint-Melaine'da, Ona Simon do'konida qushni ko'rganini aytdi.

en: She rushed to the place.
uz: U joyga shoshildi.

en: The people did not know what she was talking about.
uz: Odamlar uning nima haqida gapirayotganini bilishmas edi.

en: At last she came home, exhausted, with her slippers worn to shreds, and despair in her heart.
uz: Nihoyat u uyga charchagan holda, oyoq kiyimlari maydalanib, yuragida umidsizlik bilan keldi.

en: She sat down on the bench near Madame and was telling of her search when presently a light weight dropped on her shoulder—Loulou!
uz: U xonim yonidagi skameykada o'tirardi va qidiruvini aytib berayotgan edi, shunda uning yelkasiga yengil og'irlik tushdi  Loulou!

en: What the deuce had he been doing?
uz: U nima qilib yurardi o'zi?

en: Perhaps he had just taken a little walk around the town!
uz: Balki u shahar bo'ylab ozgina sayr qilgan bo'lgandir!

en: She did not easily forget her scare; in fact, she never got over it.
uz: U o'z qo'rquvini oson unutmadi; aslida, u hech qachon undan o'tib ketmadi.

en: In consequence of a cold, she caught a sore throat; and some time later she had an earache.
uz: Shamollash natijasida uning tomoq og'rig'i paydo bo'ldi; va bir oz vaqtdan keyin quloq og'rig'i paydo bo'ldi.

en: Three years later she was stone deaf, and spoke in a very loud voice even in church.
uz: Uch yil o'tgach, u tosh kar edi va hatto cherkovda ham juda baland ovozda gapirardi.

en: Although her sins might have been proclaimed throughout the diocese without any shame to
uz: Garchi uning gunohlari butun yeparxiyada hech qanday uyatsiz e'lon qilingan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: herself, or ill effects to the community, the cure thought it advisable to receive her confession in the vestry-room.
uz: o'zi, yoki jamiyatga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lsa, davolash uning e'tirofini vestry-xonasida olishni maqsadga muvofiq deb hisobladi.

en: Imaginary buzzings also added to her bewilderment.
uz: Xayoliy g'uvillashlar uning hayratlanishiga ham qo'shildi.

en: Her mistress often said to her: “My goodness, how stupid you are!” and she would answer: “Yes, Madame,” and look for something.
uz: Uning bekasi unga tez-tez: "Ey Xudoyim, naqadar ahmoqsan!" der edi, u esa: "Ha, xonim," deb javob berardi va nimadir qidirardi.

en: The narrow circle of her ideas grew more restricted than it already was; the bellowing of the oxen, the chime of the bells no longer reached her intelligence.
uz: Uning g'oyalarining tor doirasi allaqachon bo'lganidan ham cheklangan edi; ho'kizlarning hurishi, qo'ng'iroqlarning shovqini endi uning aqliga yetib bormadi.

en: All things moved silently, like ghosts.
uz: Hamma narsa arvohlar kabi jim harakatlanardi.

en: Only one noise penetrated her ears; the parrot’s voice.
uz: Uning quloqlariga faqat bitta shovqin kirdi; to'tiqushning ovozi.

en: As if to divert her mind, he reproduced for her the tick-tack of the spit in the kitchen, the shrill cry of the fish-vendors, the saw of the carpenter who had a shop opposite, and when the door-bell rang, he would imitate Madame Aubain: “Felicite!
uz: Go'yo uning ongini chalg'itgandek, u unga oshxonadagi tupurgichning tick-tack soundini, baliq sotuvchilarning shirillatgan faryodini, do'koni qarshisida bo'lgan duradgorning arra soundini ko'rsatdi va eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringlaganda, u Madame Aubainga taqlid qilardi: Felicite!

en: go to the front door.” They held conversations together, Loulou repeating the three phrases of his repertory over and over, Felicite replying by words that had no greater meaning, but in which she poured out her feelings.
uz: Old eshikga boring. Ular birgalikda suhbatlashdilar, Loulu o'z repertuarining uchta iborasini qayta-qayta takrorlardi, Felicite esa hech qanday katta ma'noga ega bo'lmagan, lekin o'z his-tuyg'ularini to'kkan so'zlar bilan javob berardi.

en: In her isolation, the parrot was almost a son, a love.
uz: Uning yolg'izligida to'tiqush deyarli o'g'il, sevgi edi.

en: He climbed upon her fingers, pecked at her lips, clung to her shawl, and when she rocked her head to and fro like a nurse, the big wings of her cap and the wings of the bird flapped in unison.
uz: U uning barmoqlariga chiqdi, lablariga tishladi, shaliga yopishib oldi, va u hamshira kabi boshini burib-burib yurganida, uning qalpoqining katta qanotlari va qushning qanotlari bir ovozdan urildi.

en: When clouds gathered on the horizon and the thunder rumbled, Loulou would scream, perhaps because he remembered the storms in his native forests.
uz: Osmon bo'ylab bulutlar to'planib, momaqaldiroq gumburlaganida, Loulu baqirardi, ehtimol ona o'rmonlaridagi bo'ronlarni eslagani uchun.

en: The dripping of the rain would excite him to frenzy; he flapped around, struck the ceiling with his wings, upset everything, and would finally fly into the garden to play.
uz: Yomg'ir tomchilari uni jahli chiqardi; u qaltirab, qanotlari bilan shiftga urildi, hamma narsani buzdi va nihoyat bog'ga o'ynash uchun uchib kirardi.

en: Then he would come back into the room, light on one of the andirons, and hop around in order to get dry.
uz: Keyin u xonaga qaytib kirardi, bir xil andironlarni yoqardi va quruq bo'lish uchun atrofga sakrab o'tardi.

en: One morning during the terrible winter of ൢ൩൤൨, when she had put him in front of the fire-place on account of the cold, she found him dead in his cage, hanging to the wire bars with his head down.
uz: Bir kuni, dahshatli qish paytida, sovuq tufayli uni kamin oldiga qo'yganida, u uni qafasida o'lik holda, boshini pastga tushirib sim panjaralariga osilib turgan holda topdi.

en: He had probably died of congestion.
uz: U, ehtimol, tiqilib o'lgan bo'lardi.

en: But she believed that he had been poisoned, and although she had no proofs whatever, her suspicion rested on Fabu.
uz: Lekin u uning zaharlanganligiga ishongan edi va garchi uning hech qanday dalili bo'lmasa ham, uning shubhasi Fabuda edi.

en: She wept so sorely that her mistress said: “Why don’t you have him stuffed?” She asked the advice of the chemist, who had always been kind to the bird.
uz: U shunchalik achchiq yig'ladi, xo'jayini: "Nega uni to'ldirmaysan?" dedi. U qushga doim mehribon bo'lgan kimyogarning maslahatini so'radi.

en: He wrote to Havre for her.
uz: U Havrega uning uchun xat yozdi.

en: A certain man named Fellacher consented to do the work.
uz: Fellacher ismli bir odam ishni qilishga rozi bo'ldi.

en: But, as the diligence driver often lost parcels entrusted to him, Felicite resolved to take her pet to Honfleur herself.
uz: Lekin, tekshiruv haydovchisi ko'pincha unga ishonib topshirilgan posilkalarni yo'qotganligi sababli, Felicite o'z uy hayvonini Honfleurning o'ziga olib borishga qaror qildi.

en: Leafless apple-trees lined the edges of the road.
uz: Yo'l chetlarida bargli olma daraxtlari yotardi.

en: The ditches were covered with ice.
uz: Ariqlar muz bilan qoplangan edi.

en: The dogs on the neighbouring farms barked; and Felicite, with her hands beneath her cape, her little black sabots and her basket, trotted along nimbly in the middle of the sidewalk.
uz: Qo'shni fermer xo'jaliklarida itlar hurdi; Felicite esa, qo'llari qopqoq ostiga, kichik qora etiklari va savatchasi bilan, yo'lak o'rtasida chaqqonlik bilan yurardi.

en: She crossed the forest, passed by the Haut-Chene, and reached Saint- Gatien.
uz: U o'rmondan o'tib, Haut-Chene daryosidan o'tib, Sent-Gatienga yetib keldi.

en: Behind her, in a cloud of dust and impelled by the steep incline, a mail-coach drawn by galloping horses advanced like a whirlwind.
uz: Uning orqasida, chang bulutida va tik qiyalik tomonidan itarilgan holda, chavandoz otlar tomonidan tortilgan pochta-trener bo'ron kabi oldinga siljidi.

en: When he saw a woman in the middle of the road, who did not get out of the way, the driver stood up in his seat and shouted to her and so did the postilion, while the four horses, which he could not hold back, accelerated their pace; the two leaders were almost upon her; with a jerk of the reins he threw them to one side, but, furious at the incident, he lifted his big whip and lashed her from her head to her feet with such violence that she fell to the ground unconscious.
uz: Yo'l o'rtasida turgan bir ayolni ko'rgach, u yo'ldan qochmagan edi, haydovchi o'rindig'idan turib, unga baqirdi va potilon ham shunday qildi. U to'xtata olmagan to'rtta ot esa tezlashdi; ikki yetakchi deyarli unga yaqin edi; jilovlarini bir tomonga tashladi, lekin voqeadan g'azablanib, katta qamchisini ko'tarib, uni boshidan oyoqlariga shunday zo'ravonlik bilan urdiki, u hushsiz holda yerga yiqildi.

en: Her first thought, when she recovered her senses, was to open the basket.
uz: Uning birinchi o'ylashi, o'z his-tuyg'ularini tiklaganida, savatni ochish edi.

en: Loulou was unharmed.
uz: Loulu hech qanday zarar ko'rmadi.

en: She felt a sting on her right cheek; when she took her hand away it was red, for the blood was flowing.
uz: U o'ng yonoqida achchiqlanish his qildi; qo'lini olib tashlaganida, u qizardi, chunki qon oqardi.

en: She sat down on a pile of stones, and sopped her cheek with her handkerchief; then she ate a crust of bread she had put in her basket, and consoled herself by looking at the bird.
uz: U bir uyum toshga o'tirdi va yuzini ro'molchasi bilan artdi; so'ngra savatga qo'ygan bir qobig'i nonni yedi va qushga qarab o'zini ovutdi.

en: Arriving at the top of Ecquemanville, she saw the lights of Honfleur shining in the distance like so many stars; further on, the ocean spread out in a confused mass.
uz: Ekkuemanvilning cho'qqisiga yetib borgach, u uzoqda Honfleur chiroqlarining ko'plab yulduzlar kabi porlaganini ko'rdi; undan keyin esa okean chalkash massivda tarqaldi.

en: Then a weakness came over her; the misery of her childhood, the disappointment of her first love, the departure of her nephew, the death of Virginia; all these things came back to her at once, and, rising like a swelling tide in her throat, almost choked her.
uz: Keyin unga bir zaiflik tushdi; uning bolalikdagi azob-uqubatlari, birinchi muhabbatining umidsizliklari, jiyanining ketishi, Virjiniyaning o'limi; bularning barchasi birdan unga qaytib keldi va bo'g'zida shishgan to'lqindek ko'tarilib, uni deyarli bo'g'ib qo'ydi.

en: Then she wished to speak to the captain of the vessel, and without stating what she was sending, she gave him some instructions.
uz: Keyin u kemaning kapitani bilan gaplashmoqchi edi va nima yuborayotganini aytmasdan, unga ba'zi ko'rsatmalar berdi.

en: Fellacher kept the parrot a long time.
uz: Fellacher to'tiqushni uzoq vaqt saqladi.

en: He always promised that it would be ready for the following week; after six months he announced the shipment of a case, and that was the end of it.
uz: U har doim keyingi haftaga tayyor bo'lishini va'da qilardi; olti oydan so'ng u ish jo'natilganini e'lon qildi va bu uning oxiri edi.

en: Really, it seemed as if Loulou would never come back to his home.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, Loulu hech qachon o'z uyiga qaytmagandek tuyuldi.

en: “They have stolen him,” thought Felicite.
uz: "Uni o'g'irlashdi," deb o'yladi Felicite.

en: Finally he arrived, sitting bold upright on a branch which could be screwed into a mahogany pedestal, with his foot in the air, his head on one side, and in his beak a nut which the naturalist, from love of the sumptuous, had gilded.
uz: Nihoyat, u yetib keldi, mo'ynali poydevorga burab o'rnatish mumkin bo'lgan shoxda dadil tik o'tirardi, oyog'i havoda, boshi bir tomonda va tumshug'ida tabiiyist hashamatga bo'lgan muhabbatidan tillalab qo'ygan gayka bor edi.

en: She put him in her room.
uz: U uni o'z xonasiga joylashtirdi.

en: This place, to which only a chosen few were admitted, looked like a chapel and a second-hand shop, so filled was it with devotional and heterogeneous things.
uz: Bu joy, faqat tanlangan ozchilik qabul qilingan joy, ibodatxona va ikkinchi qo'l do'koniga o'xshardi, shuning uchun u sadoqatli va geterogen narsalar bilan to'la edi.

en: The door could not be opened easily on account of the presence of a large wardrobe.
uz: Eshik katta shkaf borligi sababli oson ochilmadi.

en: Opposite the window that looked out into the garden, a bull’s-eye opened on the yard; a table was placed by the cot and held a wash-basin, two combs, and a piece of blue soap in a broken saucer.
uz: Bog'ga qaragan derazaning ro'parasida hovliga bir buqa ko'zi ochildi; karavot yonida stol o'rnatildi va sindirilgan idishda kir yuvish havzasi, ikkita taroq va bir bo'lak ko'k sovun bor edi.

en: On the walls were rosaries, medals, a number of Holy Virgins, and a holy-water basin made out of a cocoanut; on the bureau, which was covered with a napkin like an altar, stood the box of shells that Victor had given her; also a watering-can and a balloon, writing-books, the engraved geography and a pair of shoes; on the nail which held the mirror, hung Virginia’s little plush hat!
uz: Devorlarda tasbehlar, medallar, bir qator Muqaddas Bokiralar va kokosdan yasalgan muqaddas suv havzasi bor edi; qurbongoh kabi salfetka bilan qoplangan ofisda Viktor unga bergan qobiq qutisi bor edi; shuningdek, suv quyish idishi va shar, yozuv kitoblari, o'yilgan geografiya va bir juft poyabzal; oynani ushlab turgan mixga Virjiniyaning kichkina yumshoq shapkasi osilib turardi!

en: Felicite carried this sort of respect so far that she even kept one of Monsieur’s old coats.
uz: Felicite shunday hurmatni shunchalik ko'rsatdiki, hatto janobning eski paltolaridan birini saqlab qoldi.

en: All the things which Madame Aubain discarded, Felicite begged for her own room.
uz: Madame Aubain tashlagan barcha narsalar, Felicite o'z xonasi uchun yolvordi.

en: Thus, she had artificial flowers on the edge of the bureau, and the picture of the Comte d’Artois in the recess of the window.
uz: Shunday qilib, uning burosi chetida sun'iy gullar bor edi, derazaning teshigida esa graf dArtoisning surati bor edi.

en: By means of a board, Loulou was set on a portion of the chimney which advanced into the room.
uz: Loulou taxtasi yordamida xonaga kirib boradigan mo'rining bir qismiga o'rnatildi.

en: Every morning when she awoke, she saw him in the dim light of dawn and recalled bygone days and the smallest details of insignificant actions, without any sense of bitterness or grief.
uz: Har kuni ertalab uyg'onganida, u uni tongning xira nurida ko'rardi va o'tgan kunlarni, ahamiyatsiz harakatlarning eng kichik detallarini hech qanday achchiqlik yoki qayg'u hissiz eslardi.

en: As she was unable to communicate with people, she lived in a sort of somnambulistic torpor.
uz: U odamlar bilan muloqot qila olmagani uchun, u o'ziga xos uyqusimon bezovtalikda yashardi.

en: The processions of Corpus-Christi Day seemed to wake her up.
uz: Korpus-Xristi kuni yurishlari uni uyg'otgandek tuyuldi.

en: She visited the neighbours to beg for candlesticks and mats so as to adorn the temporary altars in the street.
uz: U qo'shnilarga ko'chadagi vaqtinchalik qurbongohlarni bezash uchun shamlar va gilamchalar so'rab bordi.

en: In church, she always gazed at the Holy Ghost, and noticed that there was something about it that resembled a parrot.
uz: Cherkovda u doimo Muqaddas Ruhga tikilardi va u yerda to'tiqushga o'xshagan narsa borligini payqardi.

en: The likenesses appeared even more striking on a coloured picture by Espinal, representing the baptism of our Saviour.
uz: Espinal tomonidan yaratilgan rangli rasmda, Najotkorimizning cho'qintirilishini aks ettiruvchi o'xshashliklar yanada yaqqolroq ko'rindi.

en: With his scarlet wings and emerald body, it was really the image of Loulou.
uz: Qizil qanotlari va zumrad tanasi bilan bu haqiqatan ham Louluning tasviri edi.

en: bought the picture, she hung it near the one of the Comte d’Artois so that she could take them in at one glance.
uz: Rasmni sotib oldi, ularni bir qarashda ko'ra olishi uchun graf d'Artoisnikiga yaqin osib qo'ydi.

en: They associated in her mind, the parrot becoming sanctified through the neighbourhood of the Holy Ghost, and the latter becoming more lifelike in her eyes, and more comprehensible.
uz: Ularning ongida to'tiqush Muqaddas Ruhning qo'shniligi orqali muqaddas bo'lib, oxirgisi esa uning ko'zlariga yanada hayotiy va tushunarli bo'lib borishi bog'langan edi.

en: In all probability the Father had never chosen as messenger a dove, as the latter has no voice, but rather one of Loulou’s ancestors.
uz: Katta ehtimol bilan, Ota hech qachon kaptarni elchi sifatida tanlamagan, chunki uning ovozi yo'q, balki Louluning ajdodlaridan biri bor edi.

en: And Felicite said her prayers in front of the coloured picture, though from time to time she turned slightly towards the bird.
uz: Felicite rangli rasm oldida o'z ibodatlarini aytdi, garchi vaqti-vaqti bilan qushga ozgina burilsa ham.

en: She desired very much to enter in the ranks of the “Daughters of the Virgin.” But Madame Aubain dissuaded her from it.
uz: U juda ham "Buyuk Qizlar" qatoriga kirishni xohlardi. Ammo Madame Aubain uni bundan qaytardi.

en: A most important event occurred: Paul’s marriage.
uz: Eng muhim voqea sodir bo'ldi: Pavlusning nikohi.

en: After being first a notary’s clerk, then in business, then in the customs, and a tax collector, and having even applied for a position in the administration of woods and forests, he had at last, when he was thirty-six years old, by a divine inspiration, found his vocation: registrature!
uz: Avval notarius, keyin biznes, keyin bojxona va soliq yig'uvchi bo'lganidan so'ng, hatto o'rmon va o'rmonlarni boshqarishga ariza berganidan so'ng, u nihoyat, o'ttiz olti yoshida, ilohiy ilhom bilan o'z kasbini topdi: ro'yxatga olish!

en: and he displayed such a high ability that an inspector had offered him his daughter and his influence.
uz: va u shunchalik yuqori qobiliyatni namoyish etdi, hatto bir inspektor unga qizini va uning ta'sirini taklif qilgan edi.

en: Paul, who had become quite settled, brought his bride to visit his mother.
uz: Paul, ancha o'rnashib olganidan so'ng, kelini onasini ziyorat qilishga olib keldi.

en: But she looked down upon the customs of Pont-l’Eveque, put on airs, and hurt Felicite’s feelings.
uz: Ammo u Pont-lEveque urf-odatlariga past nazar bilan qaradi, havoga botdi va Felicitening his-tuyg'ulariga zarar yetkazdi.

en: Madame Aubain felt relieved when she left.
uz: Madame Aubain ketganida xotirjamlik his qildi.

en: The following week they learned of Monsieur Bourais’ death in an inn.
uz: Keyingi haftada ular Monsieur Bouraisning mehmonxonada vafot etganini bilishdi.

en: There were rumours of suicide, which were confirmed; doubts concerning his integrity arose.
uz: O'z joniga qasd qilish haqidagi mish-mishlar bor edi, bular tasdiqlandi; uning halolligiga shubhalar paydo bo'ldi.

en: Madame Aubain looked over her accounts and soon discovered his numerous embezzlements; sales of wood which had been concealed from her, false receipts, etc.
uz: Madame Aubain o'z hisoblarini ko'zdan kechirdi va tez orada uning ko'plab talon-torojlarini, undan yashirilgan yog'och sotuvlarini, soxta kvitansiyalarni va hokazolarni aniqladi.

en: Furthermore, he had an illegitimate child, and entertained a friendship for “a person in Dozule.” These base actions affected her very much.
uz: Bundan tashqari, u noqonuniy farzand ko'rdi va "Dozilida bir odam" bilan do'stlashdi. Bu beodob harakatlar unga juda ta'sir qildi.

en: In March, ൢ൩൦൤, she developed a pain in her chest; her tongue looked as if it were coated with smoke, and the leeches they applied did not relieve her oppression; and on the ninth evening she died, being just seventy- two years old.
uz: Mart oyida, , ko'kragida og'riq paydo bo'ldi; tili xuddi tutun bilan qoplangan kabi ko'rindi va ular surgan zımparalar uning zulmini yengillashtirmadi; va to'qqizinchi oqshomda u atigi yetmish ikki yoshda vafot etdi.

en: People thought that she was younger, because her hair, which she wore in bands framing her pale face, was brown.
uz: Odamlar uni yoshroq deb o'ylashardi, chunki uning sochlari, oq yuzini o'rab olgan holda, jigarrang edi.

en: regretted her loss, for her manner was so haughty that she did not attract them.
uz: U o'z yo'qotishidan afsusda edi, chunki uning xulq-atvori shunchalik takabbur ediki, ularni o'ziga tortmadi.

en: Felicite mourned for her as servants seldom mourn for their masters.
uz: Felicit unga motam tutdi, xuddi xizmatkorlar xo'jayinlari uchun kamdan-kam motam tutganidek.

en: The fact that Madame should die before herself perplexed her mind and seemed contrary to the order of things, and absolutely monstrous and inadmissible.
uz: Xonimning o'z oldida o'lishi uning ongini chalkashtirdi va bu narsa tartibga zid, mutlaqo dahshatli va qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan ko'rindi.

en: Ten days later (the time to journey from Besancon), the heirs arrived.
uz: O'n kundan keyin (Besankondan sayohat qilish vaqti) merosxo'rlar yetib kelishdi.

en: Her daughter-in-law ransacked the drawers, kept some of the furniture, and sold the rest; then they went back to their own home.
uz: Qiz kelini tortmalarni talon-toroj qildi, mebellarning bir qismini saqlab qoldi va qolganini sotdi; keyin ular o'z uylariga qaytishdi.

en: Madame’s armchair, foot-warmer, work-table, the eight chairs, everything was gone!
uz: Xonimning kreslosi, oyoq isitgichi, ish stoli, sakkizta stul, hammasi yo'q edi!

en: The places occupied by the pictures formed yellow squares on the walls.
uz: Rasmlar egallagan joylar devorlarda sariq kvadratlar hosil qildi.

en: They had taken the two little beds, and the wardrobe had been emptied of Virginia’s belongings!
uz: Ular ikkita kichkina karavotni olib qo'yishdi va shkaf Virjiniyaning buyumlaridan bo'shatildi!

en: Felicite went upstairs, overcome with grief.
uz: Felicite qayg'u bilan yuqoriga ko'tarildi.

en: The following day a sign was posted on the door; the chemist screamed in her ear that the house was for sale.
uz: Ertasi kuni eshikga belgi qo'yildi; kimyogar uning qulog'iga uy sotilayotganini qichqirdi.

en: For a moment she tottered, and had to sit down.
uz: Bir lahzaga u titradi va o'tirishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: What hurt her most was to give up her room,—so nice for poor Loulou!
uz: Uni eng ko'p xafa qilgan narsa xonasidan voz kechish edi, bechora Loulu uchun juda yaxshi!

en: She looked at him in despair and implored the Holy Ghost, and it was this way that she contracted the idolatrous habit of saying her prayers kneeling in front of the bird.
uz: U unga umidsizlik bilan qaradi va Muqaddas Ruhga yolvordi, va aynan shu yo'l bilan u butparastlik odatini qo'lga kiritdi, ya'ni qush oldida tiz cho'kib duo qilishdi.

en: Sometimes the sun fell through the window on his glass eye, and lighted a spark in it which sent Felicite into ecstasy.
uz: Ba'zan quyosh uning oynasidagi ko'zidan deraza orqali tushib, unda Felicitni hayajonga soladigan uchqun yoqardi.

en: Her mistress had left her an income of three hundred and eighty francs.
uz: Uning bekasi unga uch yuz sakson frank daromad qoldirgan edi.

en: The garden supplied her with vegetables.
uz: Bog' uni sabzavotlar bilan ta'minladi.

en: As for clothes, she had enough to last her till the end of her days, and she economised on the light by going to bed at dusk.
uz: Kiyimga kelsak, u kunlarining oxirigacha yetarli edi va u quyosh botishi bilan yotish orqali yorug'likdan tejaladi.

en: She rarely went out, in order to avoid passing in front of the second-hand dealer’s shop where there was some of the old furniture.
uz: U kamdan-kam hollarda tashqariga chiqardi, eski mebellar bo'lgan ikkinchi qo'l sotuvchining do'koni oldidan o'tmaslik uchun.

en: Since her fainting spell, she dragged her leg, and as her strength was failing rapidly, old Mother Simon, who had lost her money in the grocery business, came very morning to chop the wood and pump the water.
uz: U hushidan ketgach, oyog'ini sudrab yurdi va kuchi tezda kamayib borayotganda, oziq-ovqat savdosida pulini yo'qotgan keksa Ona Simon erta tongda yog'ochni kesish va suvni nasoslash uchun keldi.

en: Her eyesight grew dim.
uz: Uning ko'zi xiralashdi.

en: She did not open the shutters after that.
uz: U shundan keyin derazalarni ochmadi.

en: But the house did not sell or rent.
uz: Lekin uy sotilib ham, ijaraga ham berilmadi.

en: Fearing that she would be put out, Felicite did not ask for repairs.
uz: Felicite o'zi chetlatilishidan qo'rqib, ta'mirlash so'ramadi.

en: roof were rotting away, and during one whole winter her bolster was wet.
uz: Tom chirib ketayotgan edi va butun bir qish davomida uning tayanchi ho'l edi.

en: After Easter she spit blood.
uz: Pasxadan keyin u qon sepdi.

en: Then Mother Simon went for a doctor.
uz: Keyin Ona Simon shifokorga bordi.

en: Felicite wished to know what her complaint was.
uz: Felicite uning shikoyati nima ekanligini bilishni xohlardi.

en: But, being too deaf to hear, she caught only one word: “Pneumonia.” She was familiar with it and gently answered:—“Ah!
uz: Lekin, eshitishga quloqsiz bo'lgani uchun, u faqat bir so'zni tushundi: Pnevmoniya. U buni yaxshi bilardi va muloyimlik bilan javob berdi: Ah!

en: like Madame,” thinking it quite natural that she should follow her mistress.
uz: Xonim kabi  xo'jayiniga ergashishi tabiiy deb o'ylaydi.

en: The time for the altars in the street drew near.
uz: Ko'chadagi qurbongohlar vaqti yaqinlashdi.

en: The first one was always erected at the foot of the hill, the second in front of the post-office, and the third in the middle of the street.
uz: Birinchisi har doim tepalik etagida, ikkinchisi pochta oldida, uchinchisi esa ko'chaning o'rtasida o'rnatilgan.

en: This position occasioned some rivalry among the women and they finally decided upon Madame Aubain’s yard.
uz: Bu pozitsiya ayollar o'rtasida biroz raqobatga sabab bo'ldi va ular nihoyat Madame Aubainning hovlisiga qaror qilishdi.

en: Felicite’s fever grew worse.
uz: Felicitning isitmasi yomonlashdi.

en: She was sorry that she could not do anything for the altar.
uz: U qurbongoh uchun hech narsa qila olmasligidan afsusda edi.

en: If she could, at least, have contributed something towards it!
uz: Agar u hech bo'lmaganda, bunga qandaydir hissa qo'sha olsa edi!

en: Then she thought of the parrot.
uz: Keyin u to'tiqush haqida o'yladi.

en: Her neighbours objected that it would not be proper.
uz: Uning qo'shnilari bu to'g'ri bo'lmasligi haqida e'tiroz bildirishdi.

en: But the cure gave his consent and she was so grateful for it that she begged him to accept after her death, her only treasure, Loulou.
uz: Ammo davo uning roziligini berdi va u bundan shunchalik minnatdor ediki, o'limidan keyin uning yagona xazinasi, Louluni qabul qilishni iltimos qildi.

en: From Tuesday until Saturday, the day before the event, she coughed more frequently.
uz: Seshanbadan shanbagacha, tadbirdan bir kun oldin, u ko'proq yo'taldi.

en: In the evening her face was contracted, her lips stuck to her gums and she began to vomit; and on the following day, she felt so low that she called for a priest.
uz: Kechqurun uning yuzi qisildi, lablari milklariga yopishib qoldi va u qusishni boshladi; va ertasi kuni u o'zini shunchalik past his qildi, hatto ruhoniyni chaqirib oldi.

en: Three neighbours surrounded her when the dominie administered the Extreme Unction.
uz: Uchta qo'shni uni o'rab olgan edi, chunki hukmronlik haddan tashqari namlashni amalga oshirdi.

en: Afterwards she said that she wished to speak to Fabu.
uz: Keyin u Fabu bilan gaplashmoqchi ekanligini aytdi.

en: He arrived in his Sunday clothes, very ill at ease among the funereal surroundings.
uz: U yakshanba kiyimlarida, dafn marosimi atrofida juda xotirjam holda keldi.

en: “Forgive me,” she said, making an effort to extend her arm, “I believed it was you who killed him!” What did such accusations mean?
uz: "Kechirasiz," dedi u qo'lini cho'zishga harakat qilib, "Men uni o'ldirganingiz deb o'ylagandim!" Bunday ayblovlar nimani anglatardi?

en: Suspect a man like him of murder!
uz: U kabi odamni qotillikda gumon qiling!

en: And Fabu became excited and was about to make trouble.
uz: Va Fabu hayajonlandi va muammo yaratmoqchi edi.

en: “Don’t you see she is not in her right mind?” From time to time Felicite spoke to shadows.
uz: Ko'rmayapsanmi, u aqli raso emas? Vaqti-vaqti bilan Felitsit soyalarga murojaat qilardi.

en: The women left her and Mother Simon sat down to breakfast.
uz: Ayollar uni tark etishdi va Ona Simon nonushtaga o'tirdi.

en: A little later, she took Loulou and holding him up to Felicite: “Say good-bye to him, now!” she commanded.
uz: Birozdan keyin u Louluyni olib, uni Felicitga ko'tarib keldi: "Endi u bilan xayrlash!" - deb buyurdi u.

en: Although he was not a corpse, he was eaten up by worms; one of his wings was broken and the wadding was coming out of his body.
uz: Garchi u murda bo'lmasa ham, uni qurtlar yeb qo'ydi; qanotlaridan biri sindi va vadding tanasidan chiqayotgan edi.

en: But Felicite was blind now, and she took him and laid him against her cheek.
uz: Ammo Felitit hozir ko'r edi, va u uni olib, yuziga qo'ydi.

en: Then Mother Simon removed him in order to set him on the altar.
uz: Shundan so'ng Ona Simon uni qurbongohga qo'yish uchun olib tashladi.

en: Cඐඉ඘ගඍක 5 The grass exhaled an odour of summer; flies buzzed in the air, the sun shone on the river and warmed the slated roof.
uz: Cඉගක 5 Oʻt yozgi hidni chiqardi; havoda pashshalar gʻuvilladi, quyosh daryoda porladi va chiziqli tomni isitdi.

en: Old Mother Simon had returned to Felicite and was peacefully falling asleep.
uz: Keksa Ona Simon Felicitga qaytib keldi va tinchgina uxlab yotgan edi.

en: The ringing of bells woke her; the people were coming out of church.
uz: Qo'ng'iroqlarning jiringlashi uni uyg'otdi; odamlar cherkovdan chiqib ketayotgan edi.

en: Felicite’s delirium subsided.
uz: Felicitning maftuni susaydi.

en: By thinking of the procession, she was able to see it as if she had taken part in it.
uz: Processiya haqida o'ylab, u uni xuddi unda ishtirok etganidek ko'ra oldi.

en: All the school-children, the singers and the firemen walked on the sidewalks, while in the middle of the street came first the custodian of the church with his halberd, then the beadle with a large cross, the teacher in charge of the boys and a sister escorting the little girls; three of the smallest ones, with curly heads, threw rose leaves into the air; the deacon with outstretched arms conducted the music; and two incense-bearers turned with each step they took toward the Holy Sacrament, which was carried by M.
uz: Barcha maktab o'quvchilari, qo'shiqchilar va o't o'chiruvchilar yo'laklarda yurishardi, ko'cha o'rtasida esa avval cherkov qo'riqchisi xaltasi bilan keldi, keyin katta xochli munchoq, o'g'il bolalarga mas'ul o'qituvchi va kichkina qizlarni kuzatib borayotgan opa; eng kichkintoylaridan uchtasi jingalak boshlari bilan gul barglarini havoga uloqtirardi; cho'zilgan qo'llari bilan diakon musiqa ijrolardi; va har qadamda ikki tutatqichi Muqaddas Sakramentga tomon burilishardi, uni M.

en: le Cure, attired in his handsome chasuble and walking under a canopy of red velvet supported by four men.
uz: Le Cure, o'zining chiroyli chiroyli kiyimida va to'rt kishi tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlangan qizil baxmal soyabon ostida yuribdi.

en: A crowd of people followed, jammed between the walls of the houses hung with white sheets; at last the procession arrived at the foot of the hill.
uz: Oq choyshablar osilgan uylarning devorlari orasiga tiqilib qolgan olomon ergashdi; nihoyat marosim tepalik etagiga yetib keldi.

en: A cold sweat broke out on Felicite’s forehead.
uz: Felicitning peshonasida sovuq ter chiqdi.

en: Mother Simon wiped it away with a cloth, saying inwardly that some day she would have to go through the same thing herself.
uz: Ona Simon uni bir mato bilan artib tashladi va ich-ichidan bir kun kelib o'zi ham xuddi shu narsani boshidan kechirishga majbur bo'lishini aytdi.

en: The murmur of the crowd grew louder, was very distinct for a moment and then died away.
uz: Olomonning shivirlashi kuchayib ketdi, bir lahzaga juda o'zgacha edi, so'ngra o'ldi.

en: A volley of musketry shook the window-panes.
uz: Oyna panellari musketeriya to'plami bilan silkitildi.

en: It was the postilions saluting the Sacrament.
uz: Bu Sakramentni ziyorat qilayotgan postilionlar edi.

en: Felicite rolled her eyes, and said as loudly as she could: “Is he all right?” meaning the parrot.
uz: Felicit ko'zlarini ag'dardi va imkon qadar baland ovozda dedi: U yaxshimi? ya'ni to'tiqush.

en: Her death agony began.
uz: Uning o'lim azoblari boshlandi.

en: A rattle that grew more and more rapid shook her body.
uz: Uning tanasini tobora tezlashib borayotgan shovqin larzaga soldi.

en: Froth appeared at the corners of her mouth, and her whole frame trembled.
uz: Og'zining burchaklarida ko'pik paydo bo'ldi va butun tanasi titradi.

en: In a little while could be heard the music of the bass horns, the clear voices of the children and the men’s deeper notes.
uz: Birozdan so'ng bas karnaylarining musiqasi, bolalarning tiniq ovozlari va erkaklarning chuqurroq notalari eshitilardi.

en: At intervals all was still, and their shoes sounded like a herd of cattle passing over the grass.
uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan hamma narsa jim edi va ularning poyabzallari o't ustida o'tayotgan qoramol suruvidek eshitilardi.

en: The clergy appeared in the yard.
uz: Ruhoniylar hovlida paydo bo'lishdi.

en: Mother Simon climbed on a chair to reach the bull’s-eye, and in this manner could see the altar.
uz: Ona Simon buqa ko'ziga yetib borish uchun stulga chiqdi va shu tarzda qurbongohni ko'ra oldi.

en: It was covered with a lace cloth and draped with green wreaths.
uz: U dantelli mato bilan qoplangan va yashil gullar bilan qoplangan edi.

en: In the middle stood a little frame containing relics; at the corners were two little orange-trees, and all along the edge were silver candlesticks, porcelain vases containing sun-flowers, lilies, peonies, and tufts of hydrangeas.
uz: O'rtada yodgorliklar solingan kichik ramka turardi; burchaklarda ikkita kichik apelsin daraxti bor edi, va butun chetida kumush shamlar, quyosh gullari, nilufarlar, piyozlar va gortenziya o'tlari solingan chinni vazalar bor edi.

en: This mount of bright colours descended diagonally from the first floor to the carpet that covered the sidewalk.
uz: Bu yorqin ranglar to'plami birinchi qavatdan yo'lakni qoplagan gilamga diagonal ravishda tushdi.

en: Rare objects arrested one’s eye.
uz: Kam uchraydigan narsalar ko'zni qamashtirdi.

en: A golden sugar-bowl was crowned with violets, earrings set with Alencon stones were displayed on green moss, and two Chinese screens with their bright landscapes were near by.
uz: Oltin shakar kosasi binafsha ranglar bilan tojlandi, Alenkon toshlari bilan bezatilgan sirg'alar yashil g'o'lalarda namoyish etildi va ularning yorqin manzaralariga ega ikkita Xitoy ekrani yaqin edi.

en: Loulou, hidden beneath roses, showed nothing but his blue head which looked like a piece of lapis-lazuli.
uz: Loulu, atirgullar ostida yashiringan holda, faqat ko'k boshini ko'rsatdi, u lapis-lazuli bo'lagiga o'xshardi.

en: The singers, the canopy-bearers and the children lined up against the sides of the yard.
uz: Qo'shiqchilar, soyabon ko'taruvchilar va bolalar hovlining yon tomonlariga saf tortishdi.

en: Slowly the priest ascended the steps and placed his shining sun on the lace cloth.
uz: Ruhoniy asta-sekin zinapoyalarga ko'tarilib, o'zining porlayotgan quyoshini dantelli matoga qo'ydi.

en: There was deep silence; and the censers slipping on their chains were swung high in the air.
uz: Chuqur sukut hukm surdi; va zanjirlari bilan sirpanayotgan sensorlar havoda baland tebranardi.

en: A blue vapour rose in Felicite’s room.
uz: Felicitening xonasida ko'k bug' atirgul.

en: She opened her nostrils and inhaled with a mystic sensuousness; then she closed her lids.
uz: U burun teshiklarini ochdi va sirli his bilan nafas oldi; keyin qopqoqlarini yopdi.

en: The beats of her heart grew fainter and fainter, and vaguer, like a fountain giving out, like an echo dying away;—and when she exhaled her last breath, she thought she saw in the half-opened heavens a gigantic parrot hovering above her head.
uz: Uning yuragining urishi tobora zaiflashib borardi va noaniqlashib borardi, xuddi favvora tarqalgandek, xuddi o'chayotgan aks-sado kabi; va u oxirgi nafasini olgach, yarim ochilgan osmonda boshining ustida ulkan to'tiqushni ko'rdim deb o'yladi.

en: One thousand and one nights Foreword
uz: Ming bir kecha bashorati

en: A Few Words About the Stories Hildegarde Hawthorne A good story belongs to the whole world.
uz: Hildegarde Hawthorne haqidagi hikoyalar haqida bir necha so'z Yaxshi hikoya butun dunyoga tegishli.

en: At that point East and West meet, no matter how different they may be in training, government, religion or habit of living.
uz: O'sha nuqtada Sharq va G'arb uchrashadi, ularning ta'limi, hukumati, dini yoki yashash odatlari qanchalik farq qilmasin.

en: The stories known as the Thousand and One Nights are very old.
uz: Ming bir kecha nomi bilan tanilgan hikoyalar juda qadimiy.

en: They are known to have existed in their present form as early as the Thirteenth Century, and many of them were told, quite possibly, as early as the Ninth.
uz: Ularning hozirgi shaklida o'n uchinchi asrdan beri mavjud bo'lgani ma'lum va ularning ko'pchiligi, ehtimol, to'qqizinchi asrdan beri aytilgan.

en: They fol­lowed naturally upon the half-spoken, half-chanted poems celebrating heroic deeds and reciting gallant adventures which the Arabs were accustomed to listen to from one of their number as they rested in the evening about their campfire in the desert.
uz: Ular, tabiiyki, yarim aytilgan, yarim kuylangan, qahramonlik ishlarini nishonlaydigan va arablar cho'lda o'zlarining lager olovlari haqida kechqurun dam olayotganda, ularning biridan eshitishga odatlangan jozibali sarguzashtlarni aytib beradigan she'rlarga befarq bo'lishardi.

en: They were handed down from one to another, since there were no books and both history and romance must live in man’s memory or else die.
uz: Ular bir-biridan o'tib ketardi, chunki kitoblar yo'q edi va tarix ham, romantika ham inson xotirasida yashashi kerak edi, aks holda o'lishi kerak edi.

en: That man who had a genius for memorizing and for improvising was a great man in his tribe, and people would come from far away to hear one of these orators.
uz: O'sha yodlash va improvizatsiya qilish iste'dodiga ega bo'lgan odam o'z qabilasi ichida buyuk odam edi va odamlar bu notiqlardan birini eshitish uchun uzoqdan kelishardi.

en: After the spoken word came the written word, as always.
uz: Og'zaki so'zdan keyin har doimgidek yozilgan so'z keldi.

en: And so the Thousand and One Nights came finally to be written in the beautiful Arabic scrip, on fine pieces of parchment.
uz: Shunday qilib, Ming bir kecha nihoyat go'zal arab yozuvida, nozik qog'oz bo'laklariga yozilgan.

en: Men still recited them, but they were usually readers then, who had memorized them.
uz: Erkaklar ularni hali ham tilovat qilishardi, lekin ular odatda o'sha paytdagi o'quvchilar edi, ularni yod olganlar.

en: They altered them somewhat, and other collections were written, but on the whole the stories kept their form and it was always Scheherazade, or Shirazad as it is often spelled, who told them to save her life from the unjust decree of the sultan whom she had married.
uz: Ular ularni biroz o'zgartirdilar va boshqa to'plamlar yozildi, lekin umuman olganda hikoyalar o'z shaklini saqlab qoldi va har doim Sheherazade yoki ko'pincha yoziladigan Shirazad ularga turmushga chiqqan sultonning adolatsiz farmonidan uning hayotini saqlab qolishni aytdi.

en: The stories originally numbered about 250, split up into the thousand and one parts in which the sultaness told them, but since that first definite collection other tales have been added and there have been some changes, not very important.
uz: Hikoyalar dastlab taxminan 250 ta bo'lib, sultan ayol ularga aytgan ming bir qismga bo'lindi, lekin o'sha birinchi aniq to'plamdan beri boshqa hikoyalar qo'shildi va ba'zi o'zgarishlar bo'ldi, unchalik muhim emas.

en: Europe first came to know the stories in 1704–1712, when Antoine Galland, a Frenchman, published a translation in twelve volumes.
uz: Yevropa bu hikoyalarni birinchi marta 17041712 yillarda, fransuz Antuan Galland o'n ikki jilddan iborat tarjimasini nashr etganida bilgan.

en: They had a great success among the rather restricted public who could get hold of the books, and gradu­ally their fame spread.
uz: Ular kitoblarni qo'lga kiritishga qodir bo'lgan, ancha cheklangan jamoatchilik orasida katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdilar va asta-sekin ularning shuhrati tarqaldi.

en: In 1811 a certain Jonathan Scott brought out a partial translation in English, which did not become generally known, and in 1840 E.
uz: 1811-yilda bir Jonatan Skott ingliz tiliga qisman tarjima qildi, u umuman ma'lum bo'lmadi, va 1840-yilda E.

en: Lane, the scholar and writer, brought out his edition, not complete, as he omitted parts of many stories and some entire tales, but still a careful and accurate work.
uz: Layn, olim va yozuvchi, o'zining to'liq bo'lmagan nashrini chiqardi, chunki u ko'plab hikoyalarning qismlarini va ba'zi butun hikoyalarni o'chirib tashlagan, ammo baribir ehtiyotkorlik va aniq asardir.

en: From then on the One thousand and one nights kept increasing in popularity.
uz: Shundan so'ng Ming bir kecha mashhurligi tobora ortib bordi.

en: Since then it has gone into more countries and is known more generally the whole world over than any other book except the Bible, and the stories have become part of the literature of every land that has one.
uz: Shundan beri u ko'proq mamlakatlarga yo'l oldi va Injildan boshqa har qanday kitobdan ko'ra butun dunyoga kengroq ma'lum bo'ldi, hikoyalar esa har bir mamlakat adabiyotining bir qismiga aylandi.

en: Aladdin’s palace, and its unfinished win­dow, the magic words “Open Sesame,” Ali Baba himself, these are as familiar to you as they are to a merchant of Bag­dad or an Arab of the desert, as they are to a child in Italy or France.
uz: Aladdin saroyi va uning tugallanmagan shamollari, Ochiq kunjut sehrli so'zlari, Ali Babaning o'zi, sizga xuddi Bag'dod savdogari yoki sahro arabisi uchun Italiyadagi yoki Fransiyadagi bola uchun qanday tanish bo'lsa, xuddi shunday tanishdir.

en: Scheherazade is as well known as the Sleeping Beauty and more so, and so is Sinbad the Sailor.
uz: Scheherazade Uxlayotgan go'zal va undan ham ko'proq narsa sifatida tanilgan, xuddi dengizchi Sinbad ham shunday.

en: When you read the stories you must remember that they were told by a race and in a time far removed from our own.
uz: Hikoyalarni o'qiganingizda, ular irq tomonidan va biznikidan ancha uzoq vaqt ichida aytilganini yodda tutishingiz kerak.

en: They come from a different world than any we know, with manners and beliefs quite removed from any we pos­sess.
uz: Ular biz bilgan dunyodan boshqacha dunyodan kelishadi, odoblari va e'tiqodlari bizda mavjud bo'lgan dunyodan ancha uzoq.

en: The people who told them believed quite simply that be­sides the human beings and animals and birds of the natural world there were other and magic creatures who mixed themselves up in the affairs of men, helping or hindering as they chose.
uz: Ularga aytgan odamlar tabiiy olamdagi insonlar, hayvonlar va qushlardan tashqari, odamlarning ishlarida aralashib, xohlaganidek yordam beradigan yoki xalaqit beradigan boshqa sehrli mavjudotlar ham borligiga ishonishardi.

en: They also believed in charms and talismen, in sorcerers and magicians.
uz: Ular sehrlar va talismanlarga, sehrgarlar va sehrgarlarga ham ishonishardi.

en: The genii were usually wicked and dangerous, the peris always kind and good, and there were good and bad fairies.
uz: Donolar odatda yovuz va xavfli edilar, parilar doim mehribon va yaxshi, yaxshi va yomon parilar ham bor edi.

en: These fairies are quite different from those of Western fancy, however, not tiny creatures but per­‐ sons with the appearance of men and women, capable of vanishing and of changing themselves into what form they chose.
uz: Bu parilar G'arb tasavvuridan butunlay farq qiladi, ammo ular mayda maxluqlar emas, balki erkaklar va ayollar ko'rinishiga ega bo'lgan, yo'qolib ketishga va o'zlarini xohlagan shaklga o'zgartirishga qodir bo'lgan o'g'il bolalardir.

en: The genii might be controlled if you found the proper charm or talisman, but the fairies and the peris were too clever for that.
uz: Agar to'g'ri joziba yoki talisman topsangiz, daholar nazorat qilinishi mumkin edi, lekin parilar va parilar buning uchun juda aqlli edilar.

en: All these strange beings, with talking birds and animals, are to be found in the tales.
uz: Bu g'alati mavjudotlarning barchasi, gapiradigan qushlar va hayvonlar bilan ertaklarda uchraydi.

en: Justice and good government as we think of them did not exist.
uz: Adolat va biz o'ylagandek yaxshi hukumat mavjud emas edi.

en: The caliph was a tyrant with unlimited power, the of­ficials under him ruled by graft and fear, if they were bad, and they usually were.
uz: Xalifa cheksiz hokimiyatga ega bo'lgan zolim edi, uning ostidagi amaldorlar, agar yomon bo'lsalar va odatda yomon bo'lsalar, o'g'irlik va qo'rquv bilan hukmronlik qilishardi.

en: A good vizier or imaun could not de­pend upon being safe because he was good.
uz: Yaxshi vazir yoki imom yaxshi bo'lgani uchun xavfsiz bo'lishiga bog'liq bo'lmas edi.

en: His caliph could have him executed for a whim no matter how good he might be.
uz: Uning xalifasi uni qanchalik yaxshi bo'lmasin, xurofot tufayli qatl etishi mumkin edi.

en: So the main business was to please the caliph.
uz: Demak, asosiy ish xalifani xursand qilish edi.

en: The beggars were legion.
uz: tilanchilar legion edi.

en: Some of them were religious brotherhoods, like the dervishes and the calenders, others just plain beggars.
uz: Ularning ba'zilari dindor birodarlar edi, masalan, dervishlar va kalendarlar, boshqalari esa oddiy tilanchilar edi.

en: The people were cruel, and used to seeing death and torture.
uz: Odamlar shafqatsiz edilar va o'lim va qiynoqlarni ko'rishga odatlangan edilar.

en: Beatings were a popular form of punishment, executions were public.
uz: Zo'rlash jazolashning ommabop usuli edi, qatl qilish esa ommaviy edi.

en: Hands were cut off for trifling offences, and heads for those not much more serious.
uz: Qo'llar mayda jinoyatlar uchun kesilgan, boshlari esa unchalik jiddiy bo'lmaganlar uchun.

en: All these things are reflected in the stories.
uz: Bularning barchasi hikoyalarda aks etadi.

en: Everything was in extremes, there was the most marvellous luxury side by side with the most terrible poverty, slaves were common, pirates and robbers abounded.
uz: Hamma narsa haddan tashqari edi, eng ajoyib hashamat eng dahshatli qashshoqlik bilan yonma-yon edi, qullar oddiy edi, qaroqchilar va qaroqchilar ko'p edi.

en: It was a wild world, where any adventure might be waiting around the corner.
uz: Bu yovvoyi dunyo edi, u yerda har qanday sarguzasht kutib turishi mumkin edi.

en: The women were kept secluded, but they managed to get out more or less, or to circumvent their masters in one way or another, and some of them had a quite amazing amount of freedom, if they were rich and widowed, or powerful in their connections.
uz: Ayollar chetda saqlanardi, lekin ular kammi-ko'pmi chiqib ketishga yoki xo'jayinlarini bir yo'l bilan chetlab o'tishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi va ularning ba'zilari, agar boy va beva bo'lishsa yoki o'z aloqalarida kuchli bo'lishsa, juda ajoyib miqdorda erkinlikka ega edilar.

en: Of course very little was known of the outside world, and so all sorts of things were imagined about it.
uz: Albatta, tashqi dunyo haqida juda kam narsa ma'lum edi, shuning uchun u haqida har xil narsalar tasavvur qilingan edi.

en: Valleys strewn with diamonds, islands where queer people and queerer ani­mals were found, fantastic birds and serpents, giants, dwarfs and what not, lay in wait for the bold traveler who left Bag­dad and set out to see for himself.
uz: Olmoslar bilan to'la vodiylar, g'alati odamlar va g'alati hayvonlar topilgan orollar, ajoyib qushlar va ilonlar, ulkanlar, mittilar va hokazo Bag'dadni tark etgan va o'zi ko'rishga otlangan jasur sayohatchini kutishardi.

en: It was a highly colored life, and it lost nothing in the tales men told of it.
uz: Bu juda rang-barang hayot edi va odamlar u haqida aytgan ertaklarda hech narsa yo'qotmadi.

en: Only a very few of the stories are contained in this book, but they are among the most famous.
uz: Ushbu kitobda hikoyalarning juda oz qismi mavjud, lekin ular eng mashhurlaridan biridir.

en: You will find the English a little quaint, not just what is used to tell a story today, but not enough so to be a bother.
uz: Siz inglizlarni bugungi kunda hikoya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan narsalar emas, balki bezovta qiluvchi bo'lish uchun yetarli bo'lmagan biroz g'alati deb topasiz.

en: As you read you must fancy that it is Scheherazade who is speaking, in her low and musical voice, while her slave girl lies at her feet and the sultan sits beside her on the rich couch with its Eastern
uz: O'qiyotganingizda, shuni tasavvur qilishingiz kerakki, gapirayotgan Sheherazad, uning past va musiqiy ovozi bilan, uning qul qizi uning oyoqlari ostida yotadi va sulton uning yonida sharqiy divan bilan boy o'tiradi.

en: Remember that she is telling each story to save her life, and the lives of the many maidens who would follow her to death if she should fail to hold the interest of her husband.
uz: Esda tutingki, u har bir hikoyani o'z hayotini va erining manfaatlarini saqlab qolmasa, unga ergashib o'limga olib boradigan ko'plab qizlarning hayotini saqlab qolish uchun aytib bermoqda.

en: She breaks off as day comes, and always she tries to do this at a point that will make him anxious to hear more.
uz: U kun kelib uzib ketadi va har doim buni uni ko'proq eshitishga ishtiyoqli qiladigan nuqtada qilishga harakat qiladi.

en: It is she who invented the continued story.
uz: U davom etayotgan hikoyani o'ylab topgan.

en: Through the tall, narrow windows, with their arched tops, veiled with silken curtains, the sun at length pierces, and at that signal she must stop—safe, she hopes, for another day.
uz: Baland, tor derazalar orqali, ularning egri tepaliklari bilan, ipak pardalar bilan qoplangan holda, quyosh oxir-oqibatda teshib kiradi va shu signalga u to'xtashi kerak  xavfsiz, u yana bir kun umid qiladi.

en: And now I will stop, and let you get to the tales themselves.
uz: Endi men to'xtayman va sizga ertaklarning o'ziga o'tishga ruxsat beraman.

en: Scheherazade It is written in the chronicles of the Sassanian monarchs that there once lived an illustrious prince, beloved by his own subjects for his wisdom and prudence, and feared by his enemies for his courage, and for the hardy and well-disciplined army of which he was the leader.
uz: Sheherazad Sassoniy monarxlarining yilnomalarida shunday yozilganki, bir vaqtlar o'z hukmdorlari tomonidan donoligi va donoligi uchun sevilgan, dushmanlari tomonidan jasorati va yetakchisi bo'lgan qat'iy va yaxshi intizomli armiyasi uchun qo'rqargan mashhur shahzoda yashagan.

en: This prince had two sons, the elder called Schah-riar, and the younger Schah-zenan, both equally good and deserving of praise.
uz: Bu shahzodaning ikki o'g'li bor edi: kattasi Schah-riar va kichigi Schah-zenan, ikkalasi ham bir xilda yaxshi va maqtovga loyiq edi.

en: The old king died at the end of a long and glorious reign, and Schah-riar, his eldest son, ascended the throne and reigned in his stead.
uz: Qari shoh uzoq va shonli hukmronlikning oxirida vafot etdi va uning to'ng'ich o'g'li Shax-riar taxtga o'tirdi va uning o'rniga hukmronlik qildi.

en: A friendly contest quickly arose between the two brothers as to which could best promote the happiness of the other.
uz: Ikki aka-uka o'rtasida tezda do'stona bahs boshlandi, bir-birining baxtini qaysi biri eng yaxshi ko'tarishi mumkinligi haqida.

en: The younger, Schah-zenan, did all he could to show his loyalty and affection, while the new sultan loaded his brother with all possible honors, and in order that he might in some degree share his own power and wealth, bestowed on him the kingdom of Great Tartary.
uz: Kichigi Shah-zenan o'z sadoqatini va mehrini ko'rsatish uchun qo'lidan kelgancha harakat qildi, yangi sulton esa akasiga barcha imkoniyatlar bilan yukladi va u o'z qudrati va boyligini ma'lum darajada baham ko'rishi uchun unga Buyuk Tartariya shohligini berdi.

en: Schah-zenan left to take possession of the empire allotted him, and fixed his residence at Samarcand, the chief city.
uz: Shah-zenan imperiyani egallab olish uchun ketdi, unga taqsimladi va bosh shahri bo'lgan Samarqandda o'z qarorgohini o'rnatdi.

en: After a separation of ten years Schah-riar ardently desired to see his brother, and sent his first vizier, with a splendid embassy, to invite him to revisit his court.
uz: O'n yillik ajralishdan so'ng Schah-riar akasini ko'rishni juda xohladi va o'zining birinchi vazirini, ajoyib elchixonasi bilan, uni saroyiga qayta tashrif buyurishga taklif qildi.

en: Schah-zenan being informed of the approach of the vizier, went out to meet him with all his ministers, magnificently dressed for the occasion, and urgently inquired after the health of the sultan, his brother.
uz: Shah-zenan vazirning yaqinlashgani haqida xabar topgach, uni barcha vazirlari bilan kutib olishga chiqdi, bu tadbir uchun ajoyib tarzda kiyingan va zudlik bilan sultonning, akasining sog'lig'ini so'radi.

en: Having replied to these affectionate inquiries, the vizier unfolded the more especial purpose of his coming.
uz: Vazir bu mehrli so'rovlarga javob berib, kelishining yanada maxsus maqsadini ochdi.

en: Schah-zenan, much affected at the kindness of his brother, then addressed the vizier in these words: “Sage vizier, the sultan, my brother, does me too much honor.
uz: Schah-zenan, akasining mehribonligidan juda ta'sirlanib, keyin vazirga shunday dedi: Dono vazir, sultan, mening akam meni juda ko'p hurmat qiladi.

en: It is impossible that his wish to see me can exceed my anxious desire of again beholding him.
uz: Uning meni ko'rishni istagani, uni qayta ko'rishga bo'lgan tashvishli istakimdan ham oshib ketishi mumkin emas.

en: You have come at an opportune moment.
uz: Siz qulay lahzaga keldingiz.

en: My kingdom is tranquil, and in ten days’ time I will be ready to depart with you.
uz: Mening shohligim tinch, va o'n kundan keyin siz bilan ketishga tayyor bo'laman.

en: In the meanwhile pitch your tents on this spot.
uz: Ayni paytda shu joyga chodirlaringizni qo'ying.

en: I will order every refreshment and accommodation for you and your whole train.” At the end of ten days everything was ready.
uz: Siz va butun poyezdingiz uchun har bir dam olish va turar joy buyurtma beraman. O'n kun oxirida hamma narsa tayyor edi.

en: Schah-zenan took a tender leave of the queen, his consort, and accompanied by such officers as he had appointed to attend him, left Samarcand in the evening, to be near the tents of his brother’s ambassador, with the intention of proceeding on
uz: Shah-zenan malika va uning turmush o'rtog'idan mehribonlik so'radi va unga tashrif buyurishga tayinlagan ofitserlar hamrohligida kechqurun Samarkandni tark etib, akasining elchisi chodirlariga yaqinlashdi va davom etish niyatida edi.

en: Schah-Zenan Took a Tender Leave of the Queen his journey early on the following morning.
uz: Schah-Zenan keyingi kuni erta tongda qirolichaning sayohatidan nozik ta'til oldi.

en: Wishing, however, once more to see his queen, whom he tenderly loved, and whom he believed to return his love with an equal affection, he returned privately to the palace, and went directly to her apartment, when, to his extreme grief, he found that she loved a slave better than himself.
uz: Biroq, u yana bir bor o'z malikasi bilan ko'rishni xohladi, uni mehr bilan sevardi va u o'z muhabbatini teng darajada qaytarib berishiga ishonuvchan edi, u saroyga alohida qaytib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning kvartirasiga bordi va nihoyatda qayg'uga to'lib, uning o'zidan ko'ra yaxshiroq qulni sevganini aniqladi.

en: The unfortunate monarch, yielding to the first outburst of his indignation, drew his scimitar, and with one rapid stroke slew them both.
uz: Bechora monarx g'azabining birinchi portlashiga taslim bo'lib, o'zining simitarini tortdi va bir tez zarba bilan ikkalasini ham o'ldirdi.

en: After that he threw their bodies into the foss or great ditch that surrounded the palace.
uz: Shundan so'ng u ularning jasadlarini saroyni o'rab turgan chuqurga yoki katta ariqqa tashladi.

en: Having thus satisfied his revenge, he left the city as privately as he had entered it, and returned to his pavilion.
uz: Shunday qilib, o'z qasosini qondirib, u shaharga kirganidek, o'z holicha chiqib ketdi va o'z paviloniga qaytdi.

en: On his arrival, he did not mention to any one what had happened, but ordered the tents to be struck, and began his journey.
uz: U yetib kelganida, nima bo'lganini hech kimga aytmadi, lekin chodirlarni urishni buyurdi va o'z safarini boshladi.

en: It was scarcely daylight when they commenced their march to the sound of drums and other instruments.
uz: Ular barabanlar va boshqa asboblar ovozi bilan yurishni boshlaganlarida, kun deyarli yorim edi.

en: The whole train was filled with joy, except the king, who could think of nothing but his queen’s treachery, and became a prey to the deepest grief and melancholy.
uz: Butun poyezd quvonchga to'ldi, faqatgina qirolidan boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylamaydigan va eng chuqur qayg'u va tushkunlikka duchor bo'lgan shoh bundan mustasno.

en: When he approached the capital of Persia, he perceived the Sultan Schah-riar and all his court coming out to greet him.
uz: U Fors poytaxtiga yaqinlashganda, u Sulton Shah-riorni va uning butun saroyi uni kutib olish uchun chiqayotganini ko'rdi.

en: As soon as they met the two brothers alighted and embraced each other; after a thousand expressions of regard, they remounted and entered the city amid the acclamations of the multitude.
uz: Ular ikki aka-uka uchrashgan zahoti pastga tushib, bir-birlarini quchoqlashdi; ming hurmat izhoridan so'ng, ular qayta ko'tarilib, olomon olqishlari orasida shaharga kirishdi.

en: The sultan conducted the king, his brother, to a palace which had been prepared for him.
uz: Sulton o'z akasini shoh uchun tayyorlangan saroyga olib bordi.

en: It communicated by a garden with his own and was even more magnificent.
uz: U o'z bog'i bilan bog'lashardi va undan ham ulug'vorroq edi.

en: Schah-riar left the King of Tartary, in order that he might have time to bathe and change his dress after the fatigues of the journey; on his return from the bath he went to him again.
uz: Shah-riar Tatariston Qirolini yo'ldagi charchoqdan keyin cho'milishga va ko'ylaklarini almashtirishga ulgurishi uchun tark etdi; vannaxonadan qaytib kelgach, u yana uning oldiga bordi.

en: They seated themselves and conversed with each other at their ease, after so long an absence; and seemed even more united by affection than blood.
