uz: Ular o'tirishdi va uzoq vaqtdan so'ng xotirjamlikda bir-birlari bilan suhbatlashdilar; va hatto qondan ham mehr bilan birlashgan ko'rinishardi.

en: They dined together and after their repast they again conversed, till Schah-riar, perceiving the night far advanced, left his brother to repose.
uz: Ular birga ovqatlanishdi va ovqatdan keyin yana suhbatlashdilar, toki Schah-riar tun ancha oldinga o'tib ketganini anglab, akasini dam olishga qoldirdi.

en: The unfortunate Schah-zenan retired to his couch; but if the presence of the sultan had for a while suspended his grief, it now returned with redoubled force.
uz: Bechora Shax-zenan o'z divaniga chekindi; lekin agar sultonning hozirligi uning qayg'usini bir muddatga to'xtatib turgan bo'lsa, u endi kuch bilan qaytdi.

en: Every circumstance of the queen’s wickedness lived in his mind and kept him awake, impressing such a look of sorrow on his countenance that the sultan next morning could not fail to remark it.
uz: Qirolichaning yovuzligining har bir holati uning xayolida yashagan va uni uyg'otgan holda saqlagan, yuziga shunday qayg'u nigohini singdirganki, ertalab sulton buni sezmay qolmasdi.

en: Conscious that he had done all in his power to testify to his continued love and affection, he sought diligently to amuse his brother, but the most splendid entertainments and the gayest fêtes only served to increase his melancholy.
uz: U o'zining doimiy muhabbati va mehrini ko'rsatish uchun bor kuchini sarflaganini anglab, akasini xursand qilishga astoydil harakat qildi, ammo eng ajoyib ko'ngilochar tadbirlar va eng gey ziyofatlar uning qayg'usini kuchaytirishga xizmat qildi.

en: Schah-riar having one morning given orders for a grand hunting party, at the distance of two days’ journey from the city, Schah- zenan requested permission to remain in his palace, excusing himself on account of a slight indisposition.
uz: Shah-riar bir kuni ertalab shahardan ikki kunlik masofada bo'lgan katta ov partiyasiga buyruq berganidan so'ng, Shah-zenan ozgina noqulaylik tufayli o'z saroyida qolishga ruxsat so'radi.

en: The sultan wishing to please him, gave his consent and went with all his court to partake of the sport.
uz: Sulton uni xursand qilishni xohlab, rozilik berdi va sportda ishtirok etishga butun saroyi bilan bordi.

en: The King of Tartary was no sooner alone than he shut himself up in his apartment, and gave way to sorrowful recollection of the calamity which had befallen him.
uz: Tartariya qiroli o'z xonadoniga qamalib, boshiga tushgan falokatni qayg'uli tarzda eslashga yo'l qo'yganicha, u yolg'iz qolmadi.

en: As he sat thus grieving at the open
uz: U ochiq havoda shunday qayg'urib o'tirar edi.

en: window looking out upon the beautiful garden of the palace, he suddenly saw the sultana, the beloved wife of his brother, meet in the garden and hold secret conversation with a man.
uz: Saroyning go'zal bog'iga qaragan deraza, u birdan akasining suyukli xotini bo'lgan sultonni bog'da uchrashayotganini va bir odam bilan yashirincha suhbatlashayotganini ko'rdi.

en: Upon witnessing this, Schah-zenan determined within himself that he would no longer give way to inconsolable grief for a misfortune which came to other husbands as well as to himself.
uz: Bunga guvoh bo'lgan Schah-zenan o'zida boshqa erlariga ham, o'ziga ham kelgan baxtsizlik uchun taskin bermaydigan qayg'uga yo'l qo'ymasligini aniqladi.

en: He ordered supper to be brought, and ate with a better appetite than he had before done since his departure from Samarcand, and even enjoyed the fine concert performed while he sat at table.
uz: U kechki ovqatni olib kelishni buyurdi va Samarqanddan ketganidan beri hech qachon qilmaganidan yaxshiroq ishtaha bilan yedi va hatto dasturxonda o'tirganida ijro etilgan ajoyib konsertdan ham bahramand bo'ldi.

en: Schah-riar, on his return from hunting at the close of the second day, was delighted at the change which he found had taken place in his brother, and urgently pressed him to explain both the cause of his former deep depression, and of its sudden disappearance.
uz: Schah-riar ikkinchi kunning oxirida ovdan qaytganida, akasida sodir bo'lgan o'zgarishdan xursand bo'ldi va uni avvalgi chuqur depressiyasining sababini ham, uning to'satdan yo'qolishini ham tushuntirishga zudlik bilan majburladi.

en: The King of Tartary being thus pressed, related to his brother the narrative of his wife’s misconduct, and of the severe punishment which he had visited on the offenders.
uz: Tartariya qiroli shunday bosim ostida bo'lib, akasiga xotinining xatti-harakatlari va jinoyatchilarga yetkazilgan qattiq jazosining hikoyasini aytdi.

en: Schah-riar expressed his full approval.
uz: Schah-riar o'zining to'liq roziligini bildirdi.

en: “I own,” he said, “had I been in your place, I should have been less easily satisfied.
uz: Menga tegishli,  dedi u,  agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, men kamroq qoniqishim kerak edi.

en: I should not have been contented with taking away the life of one woman, but would have sacrificed a thousand to my resentment.
uz: Men bir ayolning hayotini olib qo'yish bilan kifoyalanmagan bo'lardim, balki o'z nafratimga mingta qurbonlik qilgan bo'lardim.

en: Since, however, it has pleased God to afford you consolation, and as I am sure it is as well founded as the cause of your grief, inform me I beg of that also and make me acquainted with the whole.” The reluctance of Schah-zenan to relate what he had seen yielded at last to the urgent entreaties of his brother, and he revealed to him the faithlessness of his own queen.
uz: Ammo, Xudo sizga tasalli berishni xohlaganligi sababli va bu sizning qayg'uingizga sabab bo'lgani kabi asosli ekanligiga amin bo'lganim uchun, menga bu haqda ham xabar bering va meni butunlay tanishtiring. Shah-zenanning ko'rganlarini aytishga ikkilanishi oxir-oqibat akasining shoshilinch iltimoslariga javob berdi va u o'z malikasining xiyonatini unga oshkor qildi.

en: On hearing these dreadful and unexpected tidings, the rage and grief of Schah-riar knew no bounds.
uz: Bu dahshatli va kutilmagan xabarlarni eshitgach, Schah-riarning g'azabi va qayg'usi cheklanmagan edi.

en: He far exceeded his brother in his fury.
uz: U g'azabida akasidan ancha ustun edi.

en: He immediately sentenced to death his unhappy sultana and the unworthy accomplice of her guilt; and not content with this, he bound himself by a solemn vow, that to prevent the possibility of such misconduct in future, he would marry a new wife every night, and command her to be strangled in the morning.
uz: U darhol o'zining baxtsiz sultonasi va uning aybdorligiga loyiq bo'lmagan sherikini o'limga hukm qildi; va bundan qoniqmay, o'zini kelajakda bunday xatti-harakatlarning oldini olish uchun har kecha yangi xotin bilan turmushga chiqishini va ertalab uni bo'g'ib o'ldirishni buyurishini so'zlab, tantanali qasam ichdi.

en: Having imposed this cruel law upon himself, he swore to observe it immediately on the departure of the king his brother, who soon after had a solemn audience of leave,
uz: O'ziga bu shafqatsiz qonunni yuklaganidan so'ng, u o'z akasi podshohning ketishi bilan uni zudlik bilan kuzatib borishga qasam ichdi, u tez orada tantanali ta'til marosimiga ega bo'ldi.

en: and returned to his own kingdom, laden with the most magnificent presents.
uz: va o'z saltanatiga qaytdi, eng ulug'vor sovg'alar bilan to'ldirilgan holda.

en: When Schah-zenan was gone, the Sultan began to put into execution his terrible oath.
uz: Shah-zenan ketganidan so'ng, Sulton o'zining dahshatli qasamini ijro eta boshladi.

en: He married every night the daughter of some one of his subjects, who, the next morning, was ordered out to execution, and thus every evening was a maiden married and every morning a wife sacrificed.
uz: U har kecha o'z fuqarolaridan birining qizi bilan turmushga chiqardi, u ertalab qatl etilishi buyurilgan edi, shuning uchun har oqshom bir qiz turmushga chiqardi va har ertalab bir xotin qurbonlik qilardi.

en: However repugnant these commands were to the benevolent grand vizier, he was obliged to submit at the peril of the loss of his own head.
uz: Bu buyruqlar mehribon buyuk vazirga qanchalik jirkanch bo'lmasin, u o'z boshini yo'qotish xavfi ostida bo'lishga majbur edi.

en: The report of this unexampled inhumanity spread a panic of universal consternation through the city.
uz: Bu misli ko'rilmagan insoniylik haqidagi xabar shahar bo'ylab universal xavotir vahimaini tarqatdi.

en: In one place a wretched father was in tears for the loss of his daughter; in another, the air resounded with the groans of tender mothers, who dreaded lest the same fate should attend their offspring.
uz: Bir joyda bechora ota qizini yo'qotgani uchun yig'lardi; boshqa joyda esa, xuddi shunday taqdir ularning avlodlariga ham yetib kelmasligidan qo'rqayotgan mehribon onalarning ingrashlari bilan havo yangradi.

en: And, instead of the praises and blessings with which his subjects had loaded their monarch, they now poured out imprecations on his head.
uz: Va, uning fuqarolari o'z monarxlarini yuklagan maqtovlar va barakalar o'rniga, ular endi uning boshiga malomatlar to'kishdi.

en: The grand vizier, who, as has been mentioned, was the unwilling agent of this horrid injustice, had a daughter called Scheherazade.
uz: Buyuk vazir, aytib o'tilganidek, bu dahshatli adolatsizlikning beixtiyor agenti bo'lgan, Scheherazade ismli qizi bor edi.

en: Scheherazade was possessed of a degree of courage beyond her sex.
uz: Sheherazada o'z jinsidan tashqari bir darajadagi jasoratga ega edi.

en: She had read much, and had so great a memory, that she never forgot anything once learned; her beauty was only equaled by her virtuous disposition.
uz: U juda ko'p o'qigan va xotirasi shunchalik buyuk ediki, bir marta o'rgangan hech narsani hech qachon unutmasdi; uning go'zalligi faqat fazilatli xarakteri bilan teng edi.

en: The vizier was passionately fond of so deserving a daughter.
uz: Vazir shunchalik munosib qizni ishtiyoq bilan yoqtirardi.

en: As they were together one day, she begged, to his great astonishment, that she might have the honor of becoming the sultan’s bride.
uz: Ular bir kuni birga bo'lganlarida, u uning hayratidan kelib chiqib, sultonning kelini bo'lish sharafiga ega bo'lishini so'radi.

en: The grand vizier endeavored to dissuade his daughter from her intention by pointing out the fearful penalty of the immediate death attached to the favor which she sought.
uz: Buyuk vazir qizini uning niyatidan qaytarishga harakat qilib, u izlagan marhamatga qo'rqinchli o'lim jazosiga ishora qildi.

en: Scheherazade, however, persisted in her request, telling her father that she had in mind a plan, which she thought might be successful in putting a stop to the dreadful cruelty exercised by the Sultan toward his subjects.
uz: Sheherazad esa uning iltimosiga qat'iy turdi va otasiga Sultonning o'z fuqarolariga nisbatan qo'llayotgan dahshatli shafqatsizlikka chek qo'yishda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylagan reja borligini aytdi.

en: “Yes, my father,” said this heroic woman, “I am aware of the danger I run, but it does not deter me from my purpose.
uz: Ha, otam,  dedi bu qahramon ayol,  men qochayotgan xavfdan xabardorman, lekin bu meni maqsadimdan to'xtatmaydi.

en: If I die, my death will be glorious; and if I succeed, I shall
uz: Agar o'lsam, o'limim ulug'vor bo'ladi; agar muvaffaqiyatga erishsam, men...

en: render my country a great service.” The vizier was most reluctant to allow his beloved child to enter on so dangerous an enterprise, and endeavored to dissuade her from her purpose but all in vain.
uz: Mamlakatimga katta xizmat ko'rsating. Vazir o'zining suyukli farzandiga bunday xavfli korxonaga kirishga eng ko'p ikkilandi va uni o'z maqsadidan qaytarishga harakat qildi, lekin bularning bari befoyda edi.

en: “Do not, sir,” pleaded Scheherazade, “think ill of me if I still persist in my sentiments.
uz: Yo'q, janob,  iltijo qildi Sheherazade,  agar men hali ham o'z his-tuyg'ularimda davom etayotgan bo'lsam, mendan yomon gumon qilmang.

en: Pardon me, too, if I add, that your opposition will be useless; for if your paternal The Sultana held conversation with a man
uz: Meni ham kechiring, agar qo'shsam, sizning qarshiligingiz befoyda bo'ladi; chunki agar sizning otangiz Sultonasi bir kishi bilan suhbatlashsa.

en: tenderness should refuse the request I make, I will present myself alone to the sultan.” At length the vizier, overcome by his daughter’s firmness, yielded to her entreaties; and although he was in despair at not being able to conquer her resolution, he immediately went to Schah-riar, and announced to him that Scheherazade herself would be his bride on the following night.
uz: Mehribonlik men so'ragan so'rovni rad etsa, men o'zimni sultonga yolg'iz ko'rsataman. Nihoyat, vazir qizining qat'iyatidan g'olib bo'lib, uning iltimoslariga rozi bo'ldi; va uning qarorini zabt eta olmaslikdan umidsiz bo'lsa ham, u darhol Shah-riarga bordi va unga Scheherazadening o'zi keyingi kechada uning kelini bo'lishini e'lon qildi.

en: The sultan was much astonished at the sacrifice.
uz: Sulton qurbonlikdan juda hayratda edi.

en: “Is it possible,” said he, “that you can give up your own child?” “Sire,” replied the vizier, “she has herself made the offer.
uz: Mumkinmi,  dedi u,  o'z farzandingizni tashlab yuborishingiz mumkinmi?  Oliy hazrat,  javob berdi vazir,  bu taklifni u o'zi qilgan.

en: The dreadful fate that hangs over her does not alarm her; and she resigns her life for the honor of being the consort of your majesty, though it be but for one night.” “Vizier,” said the sultan, “do not deceive yourself with any hopes; for be assured that, in returning Scheherazade to your charge to-morrow, it will be with an order for her death; if you disobey, your own head as well as hers will be the forfeit.” “Although,” answered the vizier, “I am her father, I will answer for the fidelity of this arm in fulfilling your commands.” When the grand vizier returned to Scheherazade, she thanked her father; and observing him to be much afflicted, consoled him slightly by saying that she hoped he would be so far from repenting her marriage with the sultan, that it would become a subject of joy to him for the remainder of his life.
uz: Uning ustida osilgan dahshatli taqdir uni qo'rqitmaydi; va u sizning oliyjanobingizning rafiqasi bo'lish sharafi uchun hayotdan voz kechadi, garchi bu faqat bir kechaga bo'lsa ham. Vazir, dedi sulton, o'zingizni hech qanday umid bilan aldamang; chunki ishonch hosil qilingki, ertaga Sheherazadani sizga qaytarib, uning o'limiga buyruq beriladi; agar siz itoat qilmasangiz, o'zingizning boshingiz ham, uning o'zi ham kechiriladi. Chunchaki, dedi vazir, Men uning otasiman, bu qo'lingizning sadoqatini bajarishda javob beraman. Vazir Sheherazadga qaytib kelganida, u otasiga minnatdorchilik bildirdi; va uni ko'rib, u unga nisbatan juda katta xursand bo'ladi, chunki u bilan u...

en: Before Scheherazade went to the palace, she called her favorite slave girl Dinarzade, aside, and said, “As soon as I shall have presented myself before the sultan, I will entreat him to suffer you to sleep in the bridal chamber, that I may enjoy for the last time your company.
uz: Sheherazad saroyga borishdan oldin, u o'zining sevimli qul qizi Dinarsadani bir chetga chaqirib dedi: Men o'zimni sulton huzuriga ko'rsatishim bilanoq, uni kelin xonasida uxlashga ruxsat berishga yolvoraman, shunda men oxirgi marta sizning hamrohligingizdan bahramand bo'lishim mumkin.

en: If I obtain this favor, as I expect, remember to awaken me to-morrow morning an hour before daybreak, and say, ‘If you are not asleep, my mistress, I beg of you, till the morning appears, to recount to me one of those delightful stories you know.’ I will immediately begin to tell one; and I flatter myself that by these means I shall free the kingdom from the terror in which it is.” Dinarzade promised to do what was required.
uz: Agar men bu marhamatni olsam, men kutganimdek, ertaga ertalab tong otishidan bir soat oldin meni uyg'otishni unutmang va Agar uxlamasangiz, xo'jayinim, ertalab paydo bo'lguncha, menga o'sha yoqimli hikoyalardan birini aytib berishni iltimos qilaman. Men darhol aytib berishni boshlayman; va o'zimga maqtov beramanki, shu yo'llar bilan qirollikni uning terroridan ozod qilaman. Dinarzade talab qilingan narsani qilishga va'da berdi.

en: Within a short time Scheherazade was conducted by her father to the palace, and was admitted to the presence of the sultan.
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida Sheherazad otasi tomonidan saroyga olib borildi va sulton huzuriga kiritildi.

en: They were no sooner alone than the sultan ordered her to take off her veil.
uz: Ular sulton unga pardalarini yechishni buyurganidan ko'p o'tmay, yolg'iz qolishdi.

en: He was charmed with her beauty; but perceiving that she wept, he demanded the cause.
uz: U uning go'zalligiga hayratda edi; lekin uning yig'layotganini sezgach, sababini talab qildi.

en: “Sire,” answered Scheherazade, “I have a slave girl whom I love—I earnestly wish that she might be permitted to pass the night in this apartment, that we may again see each other, and once more take a tender farewell.
uz: Janob,  javob berdi Sheherazade, Mening sevgan bir qul qizim bor  men unga bu kvartirada tunashga ruxsat berilishini chin dildan tilayman, toki biz yana bir-birimizni ko'rishimiz va yana bir bor samimiy xayrlashishimiz mumkin bo'lsin.

en: Will you allow me the
uz: Menga ruxsat berasizmi?

en: consolation of giving her this last proof of my affection?” Schah-riar having agreed to it, they sent for Dinarzade, who came directly.
uz: Unga o'z mehrimning so'nggi isbotini berishdan tasallimi?  Schah-riar bunga rozi bo'lib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelgan Dinarzade'ni chaqirib yuborishdi.

en: The sultan passed the night with Scheherazade on an elevated couch, as was the custom among the eastern monarchs, and Dinarzade slept at the foot of it on a mattress, prepared for the purpose.
uz: Sulton Sheherazad bilan birga sharqiy monarxlar odatdagidek baland divanda tunadi va Dinarzade uning etagida, shu maqsadda tayyorlangan matrasda uxladi.

en: Dinarzade, having waked about an hour before day, did what her mistress had ordered her.
uz: Dinarzade, kunidan taxminan bir soat oldin uyg'onganidan so'ng, xo'jayinining buyurganini qildi.

en: “My dear lady,” she said, “if you are not asleep, I entreat you, as it will soon be light, to relate to me one of those delightful tales you know.
uz: Azizim,  dedi u, agar uxlamasangiz, iltimos qilaman, chunki tez orada yorug'lik paydo bo'ladi, menga o'sha yoqimli hikoyalardan birini aytib bering.

en: It will, alas, be the last time I shall hear one.” Instead of returning any answer to her slave, Scheherazade addressed these words to the sultan: “Will your majesty permit me to indulge my slave in her request?” “Freely,” replied he.
uz: Afsuski, bu oxirgi marta eshitishim bo'ladi. Uning quliga hech qanday javob qaytarish o'rniga, Sheherazade sultonga shunday so'zlarni aytdi: Sizning oliyjanobligingiz menga qulimni uning so'roviga rozi qilishimga ruxsat beradimi? Erkin, deb javob berdi u.

en: Scheherazade began as follows:
uz: Scheherazade quyidagicha boshlandi:

en: The Merchant and the Genie The Story of the Merchant and the Genie There was formerly a merchant, who was possessed of great wealth, in land, merchandise, and ready money.
uz: Savdogar va jin Savdogar va jin hikoyasi Bir vaqtlar yer, tovar va tayyor pulga ega bo'lgan katta boylikka ega bo'lgan bir savdogar bor edi.

en: Having one day an affair of great importance to settle at a considerable distance from home, he mounted his horse, and with only a sort of cloak-bag behind him, in which he had put a few biscuits and dates, he began
uz: Bir kuni uydan ancha uzoq masofada joylashishi kerak bo'lgan juda muhim ish bo'lganidan so'ng, u otga chiqdi va orqasida bir nechta pechenye va xurmo qo'ygan bir xil xalat sumkasi bilan, u boshladi.

en: He arrived without any accident at the place of his destination; and having finished his business, set out on his return.
uz: U o'z manziliga hech qanday tasodifsiz yetib keldi; va ishini tugatgach, qaytib ketishga yo'l oldi.

en: On the fourth day of his journey, he felt himself so incommoded by the heat of the sun, that he turned out of his road, in order to rest under some trees, by which there was a fountain.
uz: Sayohatining to'rtinchi kunida u quyoshning issig'idan shunchalik noqulay his qildi, yo'lidan chiqib, bir nechta daraxtlar ostida dam olish uchun ketdi, ularning yonida favvora bor edi.

en: He alighted, and tying his horse to a branch of the tree, sat down on the bank of the pool to eat some biscuits and dates from his little store.
uz: U tushdi va otini daraxt shoxiga bog'lab, hovuz qirg'og'iga o'tirib, o'zining kichkina do'konidan pechenye va xurmo yeydi.

en: When he had satisfied his hunger, he amused himself with throwing about the stones of the fruit with considerable force.
uz: Ochligini qondirgandan so'ng, u mevaning toshlarini sezilarli kuch bilan tashlab, o'zini xursand qildi.

en: Finally he washed his hands, his face, and his feet, and repeated a prayer, like a good Mussulman.
uz: Nihoyat u qo'llarini, yuzini va oyoqlarini yuvdi va yaxshi musulmon kabi duo takrorladi.

en: He was still on his knees, when he saw a genie, white with age, and of enormous stature, advancing toward him with a scimitar in his hand.
uz: U hali tizzalab turgan edi, o'shanda u yoshida oq va ulkan bo'yli bir jinni ko'rdi, qo'lida qo'ltig'i bilan unga qarab harakatlanayotgan edi.

en: As soon as he was close he cried in a terrible tone: “Get up, that I may kill thee with this scimitar, as thou hast caused the death of my son.” He accompanied these words with a dreadful yell.
uz: U yaqinlashishi bilanoq, dahshatli ohangda qichqirdi: Tur, o'g'limning o'limiga sabab bo'lganingdek, seni shu qo'rqoq bilan o'ldiraman. U bu so'zlarga dahshatli qichqiriq bilan hamroh bo'ldi.

en: The merchant, alarmed by the horrible figure of this genie, as well as the words he heard, replied in trembling accents: “How can I have slain him?
uz: Savdogar, bu jinning dahshatli qiyofasidan, shuningdek, eshitgan so'zlaridan xavotirda titroq bilan javob berdi: Uni qanday qilib o'ldirgan bo'lishim mumkin edi?

en: I do not know him, nor have I ever seen him.” “Didst thou not,” replied the genie, “on thine arrival here, sit down, and take some dates from thy wallet; and after eating them, didst thou not throw the stones about on all sides?” “This is all true,” replied the merchant; “I do not deny it.” “Well, then,” said the other, “I tell thee thou hast killed my son; for while thou wast throwing about the stones, my son passed by invisible; one of them struck him in the eye, causing his death and thus hast thou slain my son.” “Ah, sire, forgive me,” cried the merchant.
uz: Men uni tanimayman, hech qachon ko'rmaganman ham. Sen kelmadingmi,  javob berdi jin, bu yerga kelganingda o'tir, hamyoningdan biroz xurmo ol; va ularni yeganingdan so'ng, har tomonga tosh tashlamadingmi? Bu hammasi rost,  javob berdi savdogar; Men buni inkor etmayman.  Xo'sh,  dedi ikkinchisi, Senga aytaman, sen o'g'limni o'ldirgan eding; chunki sen toshlarni tashlayotganingda, o'g'lim ko'zdan o'tib ketdi; ulardan biri unga ko'ziga urib, uni o'ldirdi va shu tariqa o'g'limni o'ldirdi. Ah, hazrat, meni kechiring,  deb baqirdi savdogar.

en: “I have neither forgiveness nor mercy,” added the genie; “and is it not just that he who has inflicted death should suffer it?” “I grant that; but I have done so innocently, and therefore I entreat you to pardon me, and suffer me to live.” “No, no,” cried the genie, “I must destory thee, as thou hast done my son.” At these words, he took the merchant in his arms, and having thrown him with his face on the ground, he lifted up his scimitar, in order to strike off his head.
uz: Menda na kechiruv, na rahm-shafqat yoq, deb qoshib qoydi jin; va olimga sabab bolgan odam azob chekishi adolatdan emasmi? Men bunga rozilik beraman; lekin men begunohlik bilan shunday qildim, shuning uchun sizdan meni kechirishni va yashashga ruxsat berishni sorayman.Yoq, yoq, deb baqirdi jin, Men seni yoq qilishim kerak, xuddi oglim kabi. Shu sozlardan song, u savdogarni qoliga oldi va uni yuzini yerga tashlab, boshini urish uchun oz qozgasini kotardi.

en: Scheherazade, at this instant, perceiving it was day, broke off.
uz: Scheherazade, shu lahzada, kun ekanligini anglab, uzildi.

en: “What a wonderful story,” said Dinarzade.
uz: Qanday ajoyib hikoya, dedi Dinarzade.

en: “The conclusion,” answered Scheherazade, “is still more surprising, as you would confess if the Sultan would suffer me to live another day, and in the morning permit me to continue the relation.” Schah-riar, who had listened with interest to the narration, told her he would wait till to-morrow to order her execution, that she might finish her story.
uz: Xulosa,  javob berdi Sheherazade,  yanada hayratlanarli, chunki agar Sulton menga yana bir kun yashashga ruxsat bersa va ertalab munosabatni davom ettirishga ruxsat bersa, tan olasiz. Shah-riar, rivoyatni qiziqish bilan tinglagan holda, unga ertagacha uning qatl etilishini buyurishni kutishini, u o'z hikoyasini tugatishi mumkinligini aytdi.

en: He arose, and having prayed, went to the council.
uz: U o'rnidan turdi va ibodat qilib, kengashga bordi.

en: The grand vizier, in the meantime, was in a state of cruel suspense.
uz: Ayni paytda bosh vazir shafqatsiz xavotirda edi.

en: Unable to sleep, he passed the night in lamenting the approaching fate of his daughter, whose executioner he was compelled to be.
uz: Uxlay olmasdan, u tunni qizining yaqinlashib kelayotgan taqdiridan qayg'urib o'tkazdi, uning jallodi bo'lishga majbur edi.

en: Dreading to meet the sultan, how great was his surprise in seeing him enter the council chamber without giving him the horrible order he expected!
uz: Sulton bilan uchrashishdan qo'rqib, uning o'zi kutgan dahshatli buyruqni bermasdan kengash palatasiga kirganini ko'rib, qanchalik hayratga tushdi!

en: The sultan spent the day, as usual, in regulating the affairs of his kingdom, and on the approach of night, retired with Scheherazade to his apartment, Dinarzade again sleeping at the foot of the couch.
uz: Sulton odatdagidek kunini o'z saltanatining ishlarini tartibga solib o'tkazdi va tun yaqinlashganda, Sheherazad bilan o'z xonadoniga ketdi, Dinarzade yana divanning etagida uxlab qoldi.

en: The next morning, the sultan did not wait for Scheherazade to ask permission to continue her story, but said, “Finish the tale of the genie and the merchant: I am curious to hear the end of it.” Scheherazade immediately went on as follows: When the merchant, sire, perceived that the genie was about to execute his purpose, he cried aloud: “One word more, I entreat you; have the goodness to grant me a little delay; give me only one year to go and take leave of my dear wife and children, and I promise to return to this spot, and submit myself entirely to your pleasure.” “Take Allah to witness of the promise thou hast made me,” said the other.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, sulton Sheherazadadan o'z hikoyasini davom ettirishga ruxsat so'ramasdan, balki dedi: Jinni va savdogarning hikoyasini tugating: men uning oxirini eshitishga qiziqaman. Sheherazad darhol quyidagicha davom etdi: Savdogar, janob, jin o'z maqsadini amalga oshirishni anglaganida, baland ovozda qichqirib dedi: Yana bir so'z, iltimos qilaman, menga biroz kechikish uchun yaxshilik bering; menga faqat bir yil borib, aziz xotinim va bolalarimdan ketishimga va bu yerga qaytishga va o'zimni to'liq sizning roziligingizga topshirishga va'da beraman. Allohni menga bergan va'dingizga guvoh bo'ling, dedi boshqasi.

en: “Again I swear,” replied he, “and you may rely on my oath.” On this the genie immediately disappeared.
uz: Yana qasam ichaman,  javob berdi u,  va siz mening qasamimga ishonishingiz mumkin.  Shundan song jin darhol goyib boldi.

en: The merchant, on reaching home, related faithfully all that had happened to him.
uz: Savdogar uyga yetib borgach, unga bo'lgan hamma narsani sadoqat bilan aytib berdi.

en: On hearing the sad news, his wife uttered the
uz: Achinarli xabarni eshitgach, xotini shunday dedi:

en: most lamentable groans, tearing her hair and beating her breast; and his children made the house resound with their grief; while the father mingled his tears with theirs.
uz: Eng achinarli ingrashlar, sochlarini yirtib, ko'kragini urish; va uning bolalari uyni qayg'usi bilan yangradilar; ota esa ko'z yoshlari bilan ularning ko'z yoshlari aralashdi.

en: The year quickly passed away.
uz: Yil tez o'tib ketdi.

en: The good merchant having settled his affairs, paid his just debts, given alms to the poor, and made provision to the best of his ability for his wife and family, tore himself away amid the most frantic expressions of grief; and mindful of his oath, arrived at the destined spot on the very day he had promised.
uz: Yaxshi savdogar o'z ishlarini hal qilib, adolatli qarzlarini to'lab, kambag'allarga sadaqa berdi va xotini va oilasini qo'lidan kelgancha ta'minladi, qayg'uning eng g'amgin ifodalari orasida o'zini yo'q qildi; va qasamini eslab, o'zi va'da qilgan kunning o'zida belgilangan joyga yetib keldi.

en: While he was waiting for the arrival of the genie, there suddenly appeared There Appeared an Old Man Leading a Hind an old man leading a hind, who, after a respectful salutation, inquired what brought him to that desert place.
uz: U jinning kelishini kutayotganida, birdan bir Keksa odam paydo bo'ldi. U hindni yetaklab ketayotgan edi. Keksa odam hindni yetaklab ketayotgan edi. U hurmat bilan salom berganidan so'ng, uni o'sha cho'l joyiga nima olib kelganini so'radi.

en: The merchant informed him of the dreadful reason, on which the old man expressed a wish to witness the interview with the genie.
uz: Savdogar unga dahshatli sababni aytdi, shu sababli chol jin bilan suhbatga guvoh bo'lish istagini bildirdi.

en: He had scarcely finished saying so when another old man, accompanied by two black dogs, came in sight, and having heard the tale of the merchant, determined also to remain to see the event.
uz: U buni deyarli tugatmagan edi, shunda yana bir chol, ikki qora it hamrohligida ko'rindi va savdogarning ertakini eshitib, voqeaga ko'rishga qaror qildi.

en: Soon they perceived coming toward the plain a thick vapor or smoke, like a column of dust raised by the wind.
uz: Tez orada ular tekislik tomon qalin bug' yoki tutunni sezishdi, xuddi shamol ko'targan chang ustunidek.

en: approached them, and then suddenly disappearing, they saw the genie, who, without noticing the newcomers, went toward the merchant, with his scimitar in his hand; and taking him by the arm, “Get up,” said he, “That I may kill thee, as thou hast slain my son.” Both the merchant and the two old men, struck with terror, began to weep and fill the air with their lamentations.
uz: Ularning yoniga yaqinlashdilar, so'ngra birdaniga g'oyib bo'lib, jinni ko'rdilar. U yangi kelganlarni sezmasdan, qo'lidagi o'q-dori bilan savdogarning yoniga bordi va uni qo'lidan ushlab, Tur, dedi u, Seni o'ldirganingdek o'ldiraman. Savdogar ham, ikki keksa odam ham dahshatga tushib, yig'lab, havoni o'z motamlari bilan to'ldira boshladilar.

en: When the old man who conducted the hind saw the genie lay hold of the merchant, and about to murder him without mercy, he threw himself at the monster’s feet, and, kissing them, said, “Lord Genie, I humbly entreat you to suspend your rage, and hear my history, and that of the hind, which you see; and if you find it more wonderful and surprising than the adventure of this merchant, whose life you wish to take, may I not hope that you will at least grant me one half of the blood of this unfortunate man?” After meditating some time, the genie answered, “Very well, I agree.”
uz: Orqa teshikni boshqargan chol, jin savdogarning ushlab turganini ko'rib, uni shafqatsiz o'ldirishga tayyor bo'lganida, o'zini maxluqning oyoqlariga tashladi va ularni o'pib dedi: Ey jin, men sizni g'azabingizni to'xtatib, mening tariximni va orqa teshikning o'z tarixini eshitishga yolvoraman, buni ko'ryapsiz; va agar siz bu savdogarning sarguzashtidan ko'ra ajoyibroq va hayratlanarliroq deb hisoblasangiz, agar siz uning hayotini olib qo'ymoqchi bo'lsangiz, hech bo'lmasa, menga bu baxtsiz odamning qonining yarmini bermasligingizga umid qilmaysizmi?

en: The History of the First Old Man and the Hind The hind, whom you, Lord Genie, see here, is my wife.
uz: Birinchi Keksa Odam va Hindning Tarixi. Siz, Janob Rabbiy, bu yerda ko'rayotgan hind, mening xotinim.

en: I married her when she was twelve years old, and we lived together thirty years, without having any children.
uz: Men uni o'n ikki yoshida turmushga chiqardim va biz o'ttiz yil birga yashadik, hech qanday farzand ko'rmadik.

en: At the end of that time I adopted into my family a son, whom a slave had borne.
uz: O'sha vaqt oxirida men o'g'il farzand ko'rdim, uni qul tug'gan edi.

en: This act of mine excited the hatred and jealousy of my wife against the mother and her child.
uz: Mening bu harakatim xotinimning ona va farzandiga nisbatan nafratini va rashkini uyg'otdi.

en: She took the opportunity during my absence on a journey, by her knowledge of magic, to change the slave and my adopted son into a cow and a calf, and sent them to my farm to be fed and taken care of by the steward.
uz: U safarda yo'qligimda, sehrli bilimlari bilan, qulni va mening asrab olingan o'g'limni sigir va buzoqqa aylantirish imkoniyatini qo'lga kiritdi va ularni fermer xo'jaligimga boqish va xizmatkor tomonidan parvarish qilish uchun yubordi.

en: Immediately on my return, I inquired after my child and his mother.
uz: Qaytishim bilanoq, bolam va uning onasidan so'radim.

en: “Your slave is dead,” said she, “and it is now more than two months since I have beheld your son; nor do I know what is become of him.” I was deeply affected at the death of the slave; but as my son had only disappeared, I flattered myself that he would soon be found.
uz: Qulingiz oldi,  dedi u,  va hozir oglingizni korganimga ikki oydan koproq vaqt boldi; uning nima bolganini ham bilmayman.  Qulning olimidan juda tasirlandim; lekin oglim yoqolib ketgan edi, shuning uchun tez orada topilishiga ozimni maqtadim.

en: Eight months, however, passed and he did not return; nor could I learn any tidings of him.
uz: Ammo sakkiz oy o'tdi va u qaytib kelmadi; men ham undan hech qanday xabar ololmadim.

en: In order to celebrate the festival of the great Bairam, which was approaching, I ordered my bailiff to bring me the fattest cow I possessed, for a sacrifice.
uz: Yaqinlashib kelayotgan buyuk Bayram bayramini nishonlash maqsadida, sud xodimiga qurbonlik uchun menda bor eng semiz sigirni olib kelishni buyurdim.

en: He obeyed my commands.
uz: U mening buyruqlarimga itoat etdi.

en: Having bound the cow, I was about to make the sacrifice, when at the very instant she lowed most sorrowfully, and the tears even fell from her eyes.
uz: Sigirni bog'lab, qurbonlik qilmoqchi edim, o'sha zahoti u juda qayg'uli tarzda pastga tushdi va hatto ko'zlaridan yoshlar ham oqdi.

en: This seemed to me so extraordinary, that I could not but feel compassion for her, and was unable to give the fatal blow.
uz: Bu menga shunchalik g'ayrioddiy tuyuldi, men unga rahm-shafqat bilan qarashdan o'zimni tiya olmadim va halokatli zarbani bera olmadim.

en: I therefore ordered her to be taken away, and another brought.
uz: Shuning uchun men uni olib ketishga buyurdim va yana biri olib kelindi.

en: My wife, who was present, seemed very angry at my compassion, and opposed my order.
uz: Xotinim, hozir bo'lganda, mening rahm-shafqatimga juda g'azablandi va buyrug'imga qarshi chiqdi.

en: I then said to my steward, “Make the sacrifice yourself; the lamentations and tears of the animal have overcome me.” The steward was less compassionate, and sacrificed her.
uz: Shunda men xizmatkorimga aytdim: O'zing qurbonlik qil; hayvonning motamlari va ko'z yoshlari meni qamrab oldi. Xizmatkor rahm-shafqatli emas edi va uni qurbon qildi.

en: On taking the skin off we found hardly anything but bones, though she appeared very fat.
uz: Teri olib tashlaganimizda, suyaklardan boshqa deyarli hech narsa topmadik, garchi u juda semiz ko'rinardi.

en: “Take her away,” said I to the steward, truly
uz: Uni olib ket, dedim men styuardga, haqiqatan ham.

en: chagrined, “and if you have a fat calf, bring it in her place.” He returned with a remarkably fine calf, who, as soon as he perceived me, made so great an effort to come to me, that he broke his cord.
uz: xafa bo'lib, va agar semiz buzoq bo'lsa, uni o'z o'rniga olib kel dedi. U juda nozik buzoq bilan qaytib keldi. U meni sezishi bilanoq, menga kelish uchun shunchalik katta harakat qildi, kiyimini sindirdi.

en: He lay down at my feet, with his head on the ground, as if he endeavored to excite my compassion, and to entreat me not to have the cruelty to take away his life.
uz: U oyoqlarimga yotdi, boshi yerga qo'yilgan holda, go'yo mening rahm-shafqatimni qo'zg'atishga va uning hayotini olib tashlash shafqatsizligiga duch kelmasligimni so'rashga harakat qilgandek edi.

en: “Wife,” said I, “I will not sacrifice this calf, I wish to keep “My son!
uz: Xotin, dedim men, Men bu buzoqni qurbon qilmayman, men O'g'limni saqlab qolishni xohlayman!

en: him; do not you, therefore, oppose it.” She, however, did not agree to my proposal; and continued to demand his sacrifice so obstinately, that I was compelled to yield.
uz: unga qarshi turma, shuning uchun unga qarshi turma. U esa mening taklifimga rozi bo'lmadi; va uning qurbonligini shunchalik qat'iyat bilan talab qilaverdiki, men rozi bo'lishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: I bound the calf, and took the fatal knife to bury it in his throat, when he turned his eyes, filled with tears, so persuasively upon me, that I had no power to execute my intention.
uz: Men buzoqni bog'ladim va o'lim pichog'ini uning tomoqqa ko'mib qo'ydim, u ko'zlarini yoshga to'ldirib, menga shunday ishontirardiki, niyatimni amalga oshirishga kuchim yetmadi.

en: The knife fell from my hand, and I told my wife I was determined to have another calf.
uz: Pichoq qo'limdan tushib ketdi va men xotinimga yana bir buzoqqa ega bo'lishga qaror qilganimni aytdim.

en: She tried every means to induce
uz: U undash uchun hamma narsani qildi.

en: me to alter my mind; I continued firm, however, in my resolution, in spite of all she could say; promising, for the sake of appeasing her, to sacrifice this calf at the feast of Bairam on the follow­ing year.
uz: meni fikrimni o'zgartirishga undadim; lekin, u nima deyishiga qaramay, qat'iy qarorimda davom etdim; uni tinchlantirish uchun, kelgusi yilda Bairam bayramida bu buzoqni qurbon qilishga va'da berdim.

en: The next morning my steward desired to speak with me in private.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab mening styuardim men bilan alohida gaplashishni xohladi.

en: He informed me that his daughter, who had some knowledge of magic, wished to speak with me.
uz: U menga sehr haqida ma'lumotga ega bo'lgan qizi men bilan gaplashmoqchi ekanligini aytdi.

en: On being admitted to my presence, she informed me how during my absence, my wife had turned the slave and my son into a cow and calf, that I had already sacrificed the cow, but that she could restore my son to his own shape, if I would give him to her for her husband, and allow her to visit my wife with the punishment her cruelty had deserved.
uz: Mening huzurimga kirganidan so'ng, u menga xabar berdi, men yo'qligimda xotinim qulni va o'g'limni sigir va buzoqqa aylantirib qo'yganini, men allaqachon sigirni qurbon qilganimni, lekin u o'g'limni o'z shakliga qaytarishi mumkinligini, agar men uni eriga bersam va unga xotinimga shafqatsizligi munosib jazo bilan tashrif buyurishiga ruxsat bersam.

en: To these proposals I gave my consent.
uz: Bu takliflarga men roziligimni berdim.

en: The damsel then took a vessel full of water, and pronouncing over it some words I did not understand, she threw the water over the calf, which instantly regained my son’s form.
uz: Ayol keyin suv to'la idishni oldi va uning ustida men tushunmagan so'zlarni aytib, suvni buzoqqa tashladi, buzoqning shaklini darhol tikladi.

en: my son!” I exclaimed, and embraced him with transport; “this damsel has destroyed the horrible charm under which you suffered.
uz: O'g'lim! deb baqradim va uni transport bilan quchoqladim; bu qizaloq sen azob chekkan dahshatli jozibangni yo'q qildi.

en: I am sure your gratitude will induce you to marry her, as I have already promised for you.” He joyfully consented; but before they were united the damsel changed my wife into this hind, which you see here.
uz: Ishonchim komilki, sizning minnatdorchiligingiz sizni unga turmushga chiqishga undaydi, xuddi siz uchun allaqachon va'da berganimdek. U xursandchilik bilan rozi bo'ldi; lekin ular birlashmasidan oldin, qiz xotinimni bu hindga o'zgartirdi, buni siz bu yerda ko'ryapsiz.

en: Since this, my son has become a widower, and is now traveling.
uz: Shundan beri o'g'lim beva bo'lib qoldi va hozir sayohatda.

en: Many years have passed since I have heard anything of him; I have, therefore, now set out with a view to find him; and as I did not like to trust my wife to the care of any one during my search, I thought proper to carry her along with me.
uz: U haqida hech narsa eshitmaganimdan beri ko'p yillar o'tdi; shuning uchun ham hozir uni topish maqsadida yo'lga chiqdim; va qidiruvim davomida xotinimni hech kimga ishonib topshirishni xohlamaganim uchun, uni o'zim bilan olib yurishni maqsad qildim.

en: This is the history of myself and this hind; can anything be more wonderful?
uz: Bu mening va bu hindning tarixim; bundan ham ajoyibroq narsa bormi?

en: “I agree with you,” said the genie, “and in consequence, I grant to you a half of the blood of this merchant.” As soon as the first old man had finished, the second, who led the two black dogs, made the same request to the genie for a half of the merchant’s blood, on the condition that his tale exceeded in interest
uz: Men senga qoshilaman,  dedi jin,  va natijada senga bu savdogarning qonining yarmini beraman. Birinchi chol tugatishi bilanoq, ikki qora itni yetaklagan ikkinchisi ham xuddi shu sorovni jinga savdogarning qonining yarmini soradi, uning hikoyasi qiziqish bilan ortishi sharti bilan.

en: the one that had just been related.
uz: Hozirgina bog'langan edi.

en: On the genie signifying his assent, the old man began.
uz: Jin uning roziligini bildirganda, chol boshladi.

en: The History of the Second Old Man and the Two Black Dogs Great Prince of the genii, you must know that these two black dogs and myself are three brothers.
uz: Ikkinchi Keksa Odam va Ikki Qora Itning Tarixi Geniylarning Buyuk Shahzodasi, bilishingiz kerakki, bu ikki qora it va men uchta aka-uka.

en: Our father, when he died, left us one thousand sequins each.
uz: Otamiz vafot etganida, bizga har biriga mingta qovurg'a qoldirdi.

en: With this sum we all embarked in business as merchants.
uz: Shu mablag' bilan biz hammamiz savdogarlar sifatida biznesga kirdik.

en: My two brothers de­termined to travel, that they might trade in foreign parts.
uz: Mening ikki akam sayohat qilishga qaror qilishdi, shunda ular xorijiy qismlar bilan savdo qilishlari mumkin edi.

en: They were both unfortunate, and returned at the end of two years in a state of abject poverty, having lost their all.
uz: Ular ikkalasi ham baxtsiz edilar va ikki yil oxirida juda qashshoq ahvolda, hammasini yo'qotgan holda qaytib kelishdi.

en: I had in the meanwhile prospered, and I gladly received them, gave them one thousand sequins each, and again set them up as merchants.
uz: Men shu vaqt ichida rivojlandim va ularni mamnuniyat bilan qabul qildim, har biriga ming qirg'ich berdim va yana ularni savdogarlar sifatida tayinladim.

en: My brothers frequently proposed to me that I should make a voyage with them for the purpose of traffic.
uz: Akalarim menga tez-tez ular bilan transport maqsadida sayohat qilishimni taklif qilishardi.

en: Knowing their former want of success, I refused to join them, until at the end of five years I at length yielded to their repeated solicita­tions.
uz: Ularning avvalgi muvaffaqiyatsizliklarini bilgan holda, ularga qo'shilishdan bosh tortdim, to besh yil oxirida ularning takroriy takliflariga rozi bo'ldim.

en: merchandise to be bought for the voyage, I discovered that nothing remained of the thousand sequins I had given to each.
uz: Sayohat uchun sotib olinadigan tovarlar, har biriga bergan mingta qirg'ichdan hech narsa qolmaganini aniqladim.

en: I did not reproach them; on the contrary, as my capital was increased to six thousand sequins, I gave them each another one thousand sequins, kept a like sum myself, and concealed the other three thousand in a corner of my house, in order that if our voyage proved unsuccessful, we might be able to console ourselves and begin again.
uz: Men ularni tanqid qilmadim; aksincha, mening kapitalim olti ming chivinga ko'paygani sababli, ularga bir-biriga ming chivin berdim, o'zim ham shunga o'xshash summani saqladim va qolgan uch mingni uyimning bir burchagida yashirdim, toki safarimiz muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, o'zimizni ovutib, yana boshlashimiz mumkin bo'lsin.

en: We purchased our goods, embarked in a vessel, which we ourselves freighted, and set sail with a favorable wind.
uz: Biz tovarlarimizni sotib oldik, kemaga chiqdik, uni o'zimiz yukladik va qulay shamol bilan jo'nadik.

en: After sailing about a month, we arrived at a port, where we landed, and had a most advantageous sale for our merchandise.
uz: Taxminan bir oy suzib yurganimizdan so'ng, portga yetib keldik, u yerga qo'ndik va tovarlarimiz uchun eng foydali sotuvga ega bo'ldik.

en: I, in particular, sold mine so well, that I gained ten for one.
uz: Men, ayniqsa, o'zimnikini shunchalik yaxshi sotdimki, o'n kishiga bitta oldim.

en: About the time that we were ready to embark on our return, I accidentally met on the seashore a female of great beauty, but very poorly dressed.
uz: Qaytishga tayyor bo'lganimizda, tasodifan dengiz sohilida ajoyib go'zallikdagi, lekin juda yomon kiyingan bir urg'ochi ayol bilan uchrashdim.

en: She accosted me by kissing my hand, and entreated me most earnestly to permit her to be my wife.
uz: U meni qo'limdan o'pib yaqinlashtirdi va uni xotinim bo'lishiga ruxsat berishga chin dildan iltimos qildi.

en: I made many difficulties to such a plan; but at length she said so much to persuade me that I ought not to regard her poverty, and that I should be well satisfied with her conduct, that I was won to consent.
uz: Men bunday reja uchun ko'p qiyinchiliklarga duch keldim; lekin oxir-oqibat u meni uning qashshoqligiga e'tibor bermasligim kerakligi va uning xulq-atvoridan yaxshi qoniqishim kerakligi, rozi bo'lishga ko'ndirilishim kerakligi haqida ko'p gapirdi.

en: I procured proper dresses for her, and after marrying her in due form, she embarked with me, and we set sail.
uz: Men unga munosib ko'ylaklar sotib oldim va unga munosib tarzda turmushga chiqqandan so'ng, u men bilan jo'nab ketdi va biz suzib ketdik.

en: During our voyage, I found my wife possessed of so many good qualities, that I loved her every day more and more.
uz: Sayohatimiz davomida xotinimda shunchalik ko'p yaxshi fazilatlar borligini angladimki, uni har kuni tobora ko'proq sevardim.

en: In the mean time my two brothers, who had not traded so advantageously as myself, and who were jealous of my prosperity, began to feel exceedingly envious.
uz: Ayni paytda mening ikki akam, ular o'zim kabi foydali savdo qilmagan va mening farovonligimga hasad qilayotgan edilar, juda ham hasad qila boshladilar.

en: At last they went so far as to conspire against my life; and one night, while my wife and I were asleep, they threw us into the sea.
uz: Nihoyat, ular hayotimga qarshi fitna uyushtirishgacha borishdi; va bir kecha, xotinim bilan uxlayotganimizda, bizni dengizga uloqtirishdi.

en: I had hardly, however, fallen into the water, before my wife took me up and transported me to an island.
uz: Lekin xotinim meni ko'tarib, orolga olib ketguncha, suvga deyarli tushmagan edim.

en: As soon as it was day she thus addressed me: “You must know that I am a fairy, and being upon the shore when you were about to sail, I wished to try the goodness of your heart, and for this purpose I presented myself before you in the disguise you saw.
uz: Kunduz bo'lishi bilanoq u menga shunday dedi: Bilishing kerakki, men pari edim va sen suzib ketmoqchi bo'lganingda, sohilda bo'lganimda, sening yuragingning yaxshiligini sinab ko'rishni xohlardim va shu maqsadda men o'zimni sen ko'rgan niqobda senga taqdim etdim.

en: You acted most generously, and I am therefore delighted to find an occasion of showing my gratitude, and I trust, my husband, that in saving your
uz: Siz juda saxiylik qildingiz va shuning uchun minnatdorchilik bildirish uchun bir imkoniyat topganimdan xursandman va ishonaman, erim, sizning...

en: life, I have not ill rewarded the good you did me.
uz: Hayot, menga qilgan yaxshiliging uchun yomon mukofot bermadim.

en: But I am enraged against your brothers, nor shall I be satisfied till I have taken their lives.” I listened with astonishment to the discourse of the fairy, and thanked her, as well as I was able, for the great service she had done me.
uz: Lekin men sening aka-ukalaringdan g'azablanaman, ularning jonini olmaguncha qoniqmayman. Men pariyaning nutqini hayrat bilan tingladim va unga menga qilgan buyuk xizmati uchun imkon qadar minnatdorchilik bildirdim.

en: “But, madam,” said I to her, “I must entreat you to pardon my brothers.” I related to her what I had done for each of them, but my account only increased her anger.
uz: Lekin, xonim,  dedim men unga,  sizdan aka-ukalarimni kechirishingizni so'rasam kerak.  Men unga ularning har biri uchun qilgan ishimni aytib berdim, lekin mening hisobim uning g'azabini kuchaytirdi.

en: “I must instantly fly after these ungrateful wretches,” cried she, “and bring them to a just punishment; I will sink their vessel, and precipitate them to the bottom of the sea.” “No, beautiful lady,” replied I, “for heaven’s sake, moderate your indignation, and do not execute so dreadful an intention; remember they are still my brothers, and that we are bound to return good for evil.” No sooner had I pronounced these words, than I was transported in an instant from the island, where we were, to the top of my own house.
uz: Men darhol bu noshukr bechoralarning orqasidan uchib borishim kerak,  deb baqirdi u,  va ularni adolatli jazoga tortaman; men ularning kemasini choktirib, dengiz tubida tashlayman.  Yoq, gozal xonim,  javob berdim men,  osmon uchun gazabingizni ozgartiring va bunchalik dahshatli niyatni amalga oshirmang; eslang, ular hali ham mening birodarlarim, va biz yomonlik uchun yaxshilik qaytarishga majburmiz.

en: I descended, opened the doors, and dug up the three thousand sequins which I had hidden.
uz: Men pastga tushdim, eshiklarni ochdim va yashirgan uch mingta qovurg'amni qazib oldim.

en: I afterward went to my shop, opened it, and received the congratulations of the merchants in the neighborhood on my arrival.
uz: Keyin do'konimga bordim, uni ochdim va qo'shnimdagi savdogarlarning kelishim bilan tabriklarini oldim.

en: When I returned home, I perceived these two black dogs, which came toward me with a submissive air.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelganimda, men bu ikki qora itni ko'rdim, ular menga itoatkorona ruhda yaqinlashdilar.

en: I could not imagine what this meant, but the fairy, who soon appeared, satisfied my curiosity.
uz: Bu nimani anglatishini tasavvur qila olmadim, lekin tez orada paydo bo'lgan pari mening qiziqishimni qondirdi.

en: “My dear husband,” said she, “be not surprised at seeing these two dogs in your house; they are your brothers.” My blood ran cold on hearing this, and I inquired by what power they had been transformed into that state.
uz: Azizim, erim, dedi u, uyingda bu ikki itni ko'rib hayron bo'lma; ular sening aka-ukalaringdir. Buni eshitib, qonim sovuq ketdi va men ularning qanday kuch bilan o'sha holatga aylanganini so'radim.

en: “It is I,” replied the fairy, “who have done it, and I have sunk their ship; for the loss of the merchandise it contained, I shall recompense you.
uz: Men,  javob berdi pari,  buni qilganman va ularning kemasini choktirdim; uning ichida bolgan tovar yoqolgani uchun, men sizga javob beraman.

en: As to your brothers, I have condemned them to remain under this form for ten years, as a punishment for their perfidy.” Then informing me where I might hear of her, she disappeared.
uz: Aka-ukalaringiz haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, men ularni xiyonatlari uchun o'n yil shu holatda qolishga hukm qildim. Keyin u haqida qayerdan eshitishim mumkinligini menga xabar qilib, g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: “The ten years are now completed, and I am traveling in search of her.
uz: O'n yil endi tugadi va men uni izlab sayohat qilyapman.

en: This, O Lord Genie, is my history; does it not appear to you of a most extraordinary nature?” “Yes,” replied the genie, “I confess it is
uz: Ey Rabbiy Jin, bu mening tarixim; bu sizga juda g'ayrioddiy tabiatga o'xshamaydimi? Ha,  javob berdi jin,  tan olaman.

en: most wonderful, and therefore I grant you the other half of this merchant’s blood,” and having said this, the genie disappeared, to the great joy of the merchant and of the two old men.
uz: juda ajoyib, shuning uchun men sizga bu savdogarning qonining qolgan yarmini beraman,  va buni aytib, jin yo'qoldi, savdogarning va ikki keksa odamning katta quvonchiga.

en: The merchant did not omit to bestow many thanks upon his liberators, who, bidding him adieu, proceeded on their travels.
uz: Savdogar o'z ozodkorlariga ko'p minnatdorchilik bildirishni o'zidan chetda qoldirmadi, ular unga xayr aytib, sayohatlarini davom ettirishdi.

en: He remounted his horse, and returned home to his wife and children, and spent the remainder of his days with them in tranquillity.
uz: U otini qayta o'rnatdi va uyga, xotini va bolalariga qaytdi va qolgan kunlarini ular bilan xotirjamlikda o'tkazdi.

en: Scheherazade, perceiving that day had not yet come, asked the sultan whether he would care to hear another of her stories, since there was still time.
uz: Sheherazad, o'sha kun hali kelmaganini anglab yetgach, sultondan uning yana bir hikoyasini eshitishga qiziqadimi, deb so'radi, chunki hali vaqt bor edi.

en: He assured her that nothing would give him greater pleasure, and she forthwith began the strange story of the three Calenders in these words:
uz: U unga hech narsa undan katta zavq bermasligiga ishontirdi va u darhol uch Kalender haqidagi g'alati hikoyani quyidagi so'zlar bilan boshladi:

en: The Three Calenders The Three Calenders, Sons of Kings, and Five Ladies of Bagdad In the reign of Caliph Haroun al Raschid, there was at Bagdad a porter, a fellow of wit and humor.
uz: Uch Kalendar Bag'dodning Uch Kalendari, Shohlar O'g'illari va Besh Xonimlari Xalifa Horun al-Rashid hukmronligida Bag'dodda hazilkash va hazilkash bo'lgan bir ko'taruvchi bor edi.

en: One morning as he was at the place where he usually waited for employment, with his great basket before him, a lady, covered with a muslin veil, accosted him, and said with a pleasant air, “Hark you, porter, take your basket and follow me.” The delighted porter took his basket immediately, set it on his head, and followed the lady, exclaiming, “Oh, happy day, oh, day of good luck!” In a short time the lady stopped before a gate and knocked: a Christian, with a venerable long white beard, opened it, and she put money into his hand without speaking; but the Christian, who knew
uz: Bir kuni ertalab, u odatdagidek ishga joylashishini kutgan joyida, uning oldida katta savatchasi bor edi, muslin parda bilan qoplangan bir ayol unga yaqinlashdi va yoqimli havoda dedi: Egam, ko'tarib yur, savatingni olib, menga ergashing. Quvonchli ko'tarib yurgan odam darhol savatini oldi, uni boshiga qo'ydi va xonimga ergashib, dedi: Oh, baxtli kun, oh, omadli kun! Qisqa vaqt ichida xonim darvoza oldida to'xtab, taqillatdi: hurmatga sazovor uzun soqolli bir xristian uni ochdi va u uning qo'liga pul qo'ydi; lekin xristian,

en: what she wanted, went in, and shortly after brought out a large jar of excellent wine.
uz: U nima xohlasa, shunga kirdi va ko'p o'tmay ajoyib vino bilan katta banka olib chiqdi.

en: “Take this The Porter Took His Basket and Followed the Lady jar,” said the lady to the porter, “and put it into the basket.” This being done, she walked on; the porter still exclaiming, “Oh, day of happiness!
uz: Buni olib keling. Portyor Savatini olib, Xonimning idishini kuzatib keldi,  dedi xonim portlovchiga,  va uni savatga soling. Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, u davom etdi; portlovchi hali ham baqirdi: Oh, baxt kuni!

en: Oh, day of agreeable surprise and joy!” The lady stopped at a fruit shop, where she bought some apples, apricots, peaches, lemons, citrons, oranges, myrtles, sweet basil, lilies, jessamine, and some other plants.
uz: Oh, yoqimli ajablanarli va quvonchli kun! Xonim meva do'konida to'xtadi, u yerda olma, o'rik, shaftoli, limon, limon, apelsin, mirtil, shirin rayhon, nilufar, jessamin va boshqa o'simliklarni sotib oldi.

en: She told the porter to put all those things into his basket and follow her.
uz: U tashuvchiga o'sha narsalarning hammasini savatga solib, uning orqasidan ergashishini aytdi.

en: Passing by a butcher’s shop, she ordered five and twenty pounds of his finest meat to be weighed, which was also put into the porter’s basket.
uz: Qassobning do'koni yonidan o'tib, u uning eng yaxshi go'shtidan yigirma besh funt tortishni buyurdi, uni ham ko'tarib yurgan odamning savatchasiga solishdi.

en: At another shop she bought capers, small cucumbers, parsley, and other herbs; at another, some pistachios, walnuts, hazelnuts, almonds, kernels of the pine, and other similar fruits; at a third, she purchased all sorts of almond patties.
uz: Boshqa do'konda u qayin, mayda bodring, petrushka va boshqa o'tlarni sotib oldi; boshqa do'konda esa, ba'zi pistalar, yong'oqlar, yong'oqlar, bodomlar, qarag'ay yadrolari va shunga o'xshash boshqa mevalarni; uchinchi do'konda esa turli xildagi bodomli patties sotib oldi.

en: The porter, in putting all these things into his basket, said, “My good lady, you should have told me that you intended buying so many things, and I would have provided a camel, for if you buy ever so little more, I shall not be able to carry
uz: To'quvchi bu narsalarning hammasini savatga solib dedi: Ey yaxshi xonim, menga shunchalik ko'p narsa sotib olishni rejalashtirganingizni aytishingiz kerak edi va men bir tuyani ta'minlagan bo'lardim, chunki agar siz bundan kamroq narsa sotib olsangiz, men...

en: it.” The lady laughed and ordered him to follow her home.
uz: U. Xonim kuldi va unga uyiga ergashishni buyurdi.

en: They walked till they came to a magnificent house, whose front was adorned with fine columns, and had a gate of ivory.
uz: Ular sayr qilishdi, toki old tomoni nozik ustunlar bilan bezatilgan va fil suyagi darvozasi bor ajoyib uyga yetib kelishdi.

en: There they stopped and the lady knocked softly.
uz: U yerda to'xtashdi va xonim sekin taqillatdi.

en: Another lady soon came to open the gate, and the three, after passing through a handsome vestibule, entered a spacious court, surrounded by an open gallery, which communicated with many magnificent apartments, all on the same floor.
uz: Tez orada darvozani ochish uchun yana bir ayol keldi va uch kishi, chiroyli chodirdan o'tgandan so'ng, ochiq galereya bilan o'ralgan keng hovliga kirishdi, u bir qavatdagi ko'plab ajoyib kvartiralar bilan bog'langan edi.

en: At the end of this court there was a dais richly furnished, with a couch in the middle, supported by four columns of ebony, enriched with diamonds and pearls of an extraordinary size, and covered with red satin, relieved by a bordering of Indian gold.
uz: Bu hovlining oxirida boy jihozlangan, o'rtasida divan bo'lgan, to'rtta qora tanli ustun bilan tayanadigan, g'ayrioddiy o'lchamdagi olmoslar va marvaridlar bilan boyitilgan va qizil satin bilan qoplangan, hind oltining chegarasi bilan yengillashtirilgan diys bor edi.

en: In the middle of the court was a large basin lined with white marble, and full of the clearest water, which rushed from the mouth of a lion of gilt bronze.
uz: Hovlining o'rtasida oq marmar bilan qoplangan va eng tiniq suvga to'la katta havza bor edi, u oltin bronza sher og'zidan oqardi.

en: But what principally attracted the attention of the porter, was a third beautiful lady, who was seated on the couch before mentioned.
uz: Lekin asosiy e'tiborni tortgan narsa, avval aytib o'tilgan divanda o'tirgan uchinchi go'zal xonim edi.

en: This lady was called Zobeide, she who opened the door was called Safie, and the name of the one who had been for the provisions was Amina.
uz: Bu xonim Zobeide deb atalgan, eshikni ochgan ayol Safie deb atalgan va ta'minot uchun kelgan odamning ismi Amina edi.

en: Zobeide, accosting the other two, said “Sisters, do not you see that this honest man is ready to sink under his burden, why do not you ease him of it?” Then Amina and Safie took the basket, the one before and the other behind; Zobeide also assisted, and all three together set it on the ground, then emptied it; and when they had done, the beautiful Amina took out money, and paid the porter liberally.
uz: Zobeide qolgan ikki kishini qo'llab-quvvatlab, dedi: Singillar, bu halol odamning yuk ostida cho'kishga tayyorligini ko'rmayapsizlarmi, nega uni yengillashtirmaysizlar? Shunda Amina va Safie savatni oldi, biri oldinda, ikkinchisi orqada; Zobeide ham yordam berdi, va uchalasi birgalikda uni yerga qo'ydi, keyin bo'shatdi; va ular buni qilgach, go'zal Amina pul oldi va tashuvchiga bemalol to'ladi.

en: The porter was well satisfied, but when he ought to have departed, he was chained to the spot by the pleasure of be­ holding three such beauties, who appeared to him equally charming; for Amina having now laid aside her veil, proved to be as handsome as either of the others.
uz: Portasher yaxshi qoniqardi, lekin u ketishi kerak bo'lganida, u o'ziga bir xilda jozibali ko'ringan uchta go'zalni ushlab turish zavqi tufayli joyida zanjirband bo'ldi; chunki Amina endi parda tashlab, qolganlaridan biridek chiroyli ko'rindi.

en: “Madam,” said he, addressing Zobeide, “I am sensible that I act rudely in staying longer than I ought, but I hope you will have the goodness to pardon me, when I tell you that I am astonished not to see a man with three ladies of such extraordinary beauty; and you
uz: Xonim,  dedi u Zobeidega murojaat qilib, Men ozimga kerak bolganidan kora koproq qolishda qopollik qilganimga tushunaman, lekin umid qilamanki, men sizga bunday gayrioddiy gozallikdagi uchta xonim bilan odamni kormaganimdan hayronman, deb aytganimda meni kechirishga jurat etasiz; va

en: know that a company of women without men is as melancholy as a company of men without women.” To this he added some pleasantries in proof of what he advanced, and did not forget the Bagdad proverb, “That the table is not completely furnished, except there be four in company;” so concluded, that since they were but three, they wanted another.
uz: Erkaklarsiz ayollar jamoasi, ayollarsiz erkaklar jamoasi kabi qayg'uli ekanligini biling. Bunga u ilgari surgan gaplarining isboti sifatida ba'zi yoqimli so'zlar qo'shdi va Bag'dod maqolini unutmadi: Dasturxon to'liq jihozlanmagan, faqat to'rt kishi birga bo'lsa; Shunday qilib, ular uch kishi bo'lgani uchun, yana bir kishi xohlashdi.

en: The ladies fell a laughing at the porter’s reasoning; after which Zobeide gravely addressed him, “Friend, you presume rather too much; but though you do not deserve it, I have no objection to inform you that we are three sisters, who transact our affairs with so much secrecy that no one knows anything of them.
uz: Xonimlar yukchining mulohazalariga kulishdi; shundan so'ng Zobeide unga jiddiy murojaat qildi: Do'stim, sen juda ko'p narsa deb o'ylaysan; lekin bunga loyiq bo'lmasang ham, senga xabar berishga qarshi emasmanki, biz uch opa-singilmiz, biz o'z ishlarimizni shunchalik yashirib yuramizki, hech kim ular haqida hech narsa bilmaydi.

en: A good author says, ‘Keep thy own secret, and do not reveal it to any one.
uz: Yaxshi yozuvchi aytadi: O'z siringni saqla va uni hech kimga oshkor qilma.

en: He that makes his secret known is no longer its master.
uz: O'z sirini oshkor qilgan odam endi uning xo'jayini emas.

en: If thy own breast cannot keep thy counsel, how canst thou expect the breast of another to be more faithful?’ ” The porter was about to retire in confusion, when Amina took his part, saying to Zobeide and Safie, “My dear sisters, I conjure you to let him remain; he will amuse us.
uz: Agar o'z ko'kraging maslahatingni saqlay olmasa, boshqa birovning ko'kragini qanday qilib sadoqatliroq bo'lishini kutishing mumkin?  Tashuvchi chalkashib ketmoqchi edi, Amina o'z qismini olib, Zobeide va Safiyaga dedi: Azizimli opa-singillarim, uni qoldirishingizni iltimos qilaman; u bizni xursand qiladi.

en: Were I to repeat to you all the amusing things he addressed to me by the way, you would not feel surprised at my taking his part.” At these words of Amina, the porter fell on his knees, kissed the ground at her feet, and raising himself up, said, “Most beautiful lady, you began my good fortune to-day, and now you complete it by this generous conduct; I cannot adequately express my acknowledgments.
uz: Agar men sizga u yo'l-yo'lakay menga aytgan barcha kulgili narsalarni takrorlasam, siz ham uning ishtirokida bo'lishimdan hayron bo'lmaysiz. Aminaning bu so'zlaridan so'ng, tashuvchi tizzalari bilan yiqildi, uning oyoqlari ostidagi yerni o'pdi va o'rnidan turdi va dedi: Eng go'zal xonim, siz bugun mening omadimni boshladingiz va endi buni shu saxiy xatti-harakat bilan yakunlaysiz; men o'z minnatdorchiligimni yetarli darajada ifodalay olmayman.

en: As to the rest, ladies,” said he, addressing himself to all three sisters, “since you do me so great an honor, I shall always look upon myself as one of your most humble slaves.” When he had spoken these words he would have returned the money he had received, but Zobeide ordered him to keep it.
uz: Qolganiga kelsak, xonimlar,  dedi u o'zi uchala opa-singilga murojaat qilib,  chunki siz menga shunchalik katta sharaf ko'rsatasiz, men doimo o'zimni eng kamtar qullaringizdan biri sifatida ko'raman. U bu so'zlarni aytganida, olgan pulini qaytarib bergan bo'lardi, lekin Zobeide unga uni saqlashni buyurdi.

en: “What we have once given,” said she, “we never take back.
uz: Bir marta bergan narsamizni, dedi u, hech qachon qaytarib olmaymiz.

en: We are willing to allow you to stay on one condition, that you keep secret and do not ask the reason for anything you may see us do.
uz: Sizga bir shart bilan qolishga ruxsat berishga tayyormiz, sir saqlang va biz qilayotganini ko'rishingiz mumkin bo'lgan hech narsa uchun sabab so'ramang.

en: To show you,” said Zobeide, with a serious countenance, “that what we demand of you
uz: Sizga ko'rsatish uchun, - dedi Zobeide jiddiy qiyofa bilan, - biz sizdan talab qilayotgan narsa shu.

en: is not a new thing among us, read what is written over our gate on the inside.” The porter read these words, written in large characters of gold: “He who speaks of things that do not concern him, shall hear things that will not please him.” “Ladies,” said he, “I swear to you that you shall never hear me utter a word respecting what does not relate to me, or wherein you may have any concern.” These preliminaries being settled, Amina brought in supper, and after she had lighted up the room with tapers made of aloe-wood and ambergris, which yield a most agreeable perfume as well as a delicate light, she sat down with her sisters and the porter.
uz: Bizda yangi narsa emas, ichkarida darvozamiz ustida yozilgan narsani o'qing. To'quvchi katta oltin harflarda yozilgan bu so'zlarni o'qidi: O'ziga tegishli bo'lmagan narsalar haqida gapiradigan odam, unga yoqmaydigan narsalarni eshitadi. Xonimlar, dedi u, Sizga qasam ichaman, menga tegishli bo'lmagan yoki sizga hech qanday tashvish bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa haqida meni hech qachon eshitmaysiz.

en: They began to eat and drink, to sing and repeat verses.
uz: Ular yeb-ichishni, kuylashni va she'rlarni takrorlashni boshladilar.

en: When they were all as merry as possible, they suddenly heard a knocking at the gate.
uz: Ularning hammasi imkon qadar xursand bo'lganlarida, to'satdan darvozada taqillatish eshitildi.

en: Safie, whose office it was, went to the porch, and quickly returning, told them thus: “There are three calenders at the door, all blind of the right eye, and have their heads, beards, and eyebrows shaved.
uz: Safiye, uning ofisi shu yerda edi, ayvonga bordi va tezda qaytib kelib ularga shunday dedi:  Eshik oldida uchta taqvim bor, ularning hammasi ong kozi kor, boshlari, soqollari va qoshlari qirilgan.

en: They say that they are only just arrived at Bagdad, where they have never been before; and, as it is dark, and they know not where to lodge, they knocked at our door by chance; and pray us to show compassion, and to take them in.
uz: Ular aytishlaricha, ular Bagdodda endigina yetib kelishgan, u yerda hech qachon bo'lmaganlar; va qorong'u bo'lgani va qayerda turishni bilmaganlari sababli, tasodifan eshigimizni taqillatishdi; va bizdan rahm-shafqat ko'rsatishimizni va ularni qabul qilishimizni so'rashdi.

en: They care not where we put them, provided they obtain shelter.
uz: Ularga ularni qayerga qo'ysak ham farqi yo'q, agar ular boshpana olishsa.

en: They are young and handsome; but I cannot, without laughing, think of their exact likeness to each other.
uz: Ular yosh va kelishgan; lekin men ularning bir-biriga aniq o'xshashligini kulmasdan o'ylay olmayman.

en: My dear sisters, pray permit them to come in; they will amuse us and put us to little charge, because they desire shelter only for this night, and promise to leave us as soon as day appears.” The sun having now risen, Scheherazade stopped her story at this point, with a sigh.
uz: Aziz opa-singillarim, ularga kirishga ruxsat beringlar; ular bizni xursand qilishadi va arzimaydi, chunki ular faqat shu kecha uchun boshpana so'rashadi va kunduz paydo bo'lishi bilanoq bizni tark etishga va'da berishadi. Quyosh endi chiqqandan so'ng, Sheherazade o'z hikoyasini shu nuqtada xo'rsinish bilan to'xtatdi.

en: “Shall we then never hear the end of these surprising adventures?” asked her slave girl.
uz: Unda bu hayratlanarli sarguzashtlarning oxirini hech qachon eshitmaymizmi? deb so'radi uning quli.

en: But the sultan interposed: “We will put off your unhappy execution for another day,” said he.
uz: Ammo sulton aralashdi: Biz sizning baxtsiz qatlingizni yana bir kunga kechiktiramiz,  dedi u.

en: “To-morrow you must relate the rest of the tale you have so well begun.”
uz: Ertaga siz shunday yaxshi boshlagan ertakning qolgan qismini aytib berishingiz kerak.

en: Accordingly, the following morning, Scheherazade took up the story where she had ended the day before.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni ertalab Sheherazade o'zi bir kun avval tugatgan hikoyani davom ettirdi.

en: “Go then,” said Zobeide, “and bring them in, but make them read what is written over the gate.” Safie ran out with joy, and in a little time after returned with the three calenders.
uz: Unda bor,  dedi Zobeide,  va ularni olib kir, lekin darvoza ustida yozilgan narsani oqishga majbur qil.  Safie xursandchilik bilan yugurib ketdi va bir ozdan song uchta taqvim bilan qaytib keldi.

en: At their entrance they made a profound obeisance to the ladies, who rose up to receive them, told them courteously that they were welcome, that they were glad of the opportunity to oblige them and to contribute toward relieving the fatigues of their journey, and invited them to sit down with them.
uz: Ular kirishda ayollarga chuqur taslim bo'lishdi, ular ularni kutib olish uchun turishdi, xushmuomalalik bilan ularni qabul qilishganini, ularga xizmat qilish va sayohat charchoqlarini yengillashtirishga hissa qo'shish imkoniyatidan xursand ekanliklarini va ular bilan birga o'tirishga taklif qilishdi.

en: When the calenders were seated, the ladies served them with meat; and Safie, being highly pleased with them, did not let them want for wine.
uz: Taqvimlar o'rnatilganda, ayollar ularga go'sht tortib berishdi; Safi esa ulardan juda mamnun bo'lib, ularga vino yetishmasligini aytmadi.

en: When the calenders had finished their repast, they said they wished to entertain the party with a concert if they had any instruments in the house, and would cause them to be brought; the ladies willingly accepted the proposal, and Safie went to fetch them.
uz: Taqvimlar taomlarini tugatgach, ular uyda biror asbob-uskunalari bo'lsa, ziyofatni konsert bilan o'tkazishni xohlashlarini va ularni olib kelishni buyurishlarini aytishdi; xonimlar bu taklifni ixtiyoriy ravishda qabul qilishdi va Safie ularni olib ketishga ketdi.

en: Each man took the instrument he liked and all three together began to play a tune.
uz: Har bir odam o'ziga yoqqan asbobni oldi va uchalasi birgalikda bir kuy chalishni boshladilar.

en: The ladies, who knew the words of a merry song that suited the air, joined with their voices; but the words of the song made them now and then stop, and fall into excessive laughter.
uz: Xonimlar, havoga mos keladigan quvnoq qo'shiqning so'zlarini bilgan holda, ularning ovozlari bilan birlashgan edilar; lekin qo'shiqning so'zlari ularni vaqti-vaqti bilan to'xtatib, haddan tashqari kulishga majbur qilardi.

en: While their amusement was at its height, there was a knock of unwonted loudness at their gate.
uz: Ularning xursandchiligi eng yuqori cho'qqida bo'lganida, ularning darvozasida kutilmagan balandlik urildi.

en: Now, it was the custom of the sultan Haroun al Raschid, to go sometimes during the night through the city, in disguise, in order to discover whether everything was quiet.
uz: Endi Sulton Horun al-Rashidning odati bor edi, tun davomida shahar bo'ylab ba'zan niqobda yurib, hamma narsa sokinligini aniqlash uchun.

en: On this evening he set out from his palace, accompanied by Giafar, his grand vizier, and Mesrour, chief of the household, all three disguised as merchants; and he it was, who, in passing through the street, and attracted by the noise of the music and of the peals of laughter, had desired his grand vizier to knock at the gate, and to demand admittance for three strangers who knew not where to seek shelter for the night.
uz: Shu kuni kechqurun u saroyidan jo'nab ketdi, u bilan birga uning buyuk vaziri Giafar va xonadon boshlig'i Mesrour ham bor edi, ularning uchalasi savdogar qiyofasida edilar; va u ko'chadan o'tib, musiqa shovqini va kulgi shovqinidan o'ziga tortgan holda, buyuk vazirining darvozani taqillatishini va tunni qayerga boshpana topishni bilmaydigan uchta begona odamga kirishni talab qilishni xohlagan edi.

en: Safie, who had opened the door, came back and obtained permission of her sisters to admit the newly arrived strangers.
uz: Safi, eshikni ochgan edi, qaytib keldi va yangi kelgan notanish odamlarni qabul qilish uchun opa-singillaridan ruxsat oldi.

en: The caliph and his attendants, upon their entrance, most courteously made obeisance to the ladies and to the calenders.
uz: Xalifa va uning xizmatkorlari kirganlarida, xonimlarga va taqvimlarga juda odob bilan sajda qilishdi.

en: All returned their salutations, supposing them to be merchants.
uz: Hamma salomlarini qaytardi, ularni savdogarlar deb o'ylashdi.

en: Zobeide, as the chief, addressed them with serious countenance, and said, “You are welcome.
uz: Zobeide boshliq sifatida ularga jiddiy munosabatda bo'ldi va dedi: Xush kelibsiz.

en: But while you are here, you must have eyes, but no tongues; you must not ask the reason of anything you may see, nor speak of anything that does not concern you, lest you hear and see what will by no means please you.” “Madam,” replied the vizier, “you shall be obeyed.
uz: Lekin siz bu yerda bo'lganingizda, ko'zlaringiz bo'lishi kerak, lekin tilingiz bo'lmasligi kerak; ko'rgan narsaning sababini so'ramang, sizga tegishli bo'lmagan hech narsa haqida gapirmang, aks holda eshitib ko'rib, hech qanday tarzda sizga yoqmaydigan narsani ko'rmaysiz. Xonim,  javob berdi vazir,  sizga itoat etiladi.

en: It is enough for us to attend to our business, without meddling with what does not concern us.” After this, each seated himself, and the conversation became general.
uz: Bizga tegishli bo'lmagan narsalarga aralashmasdan, o'z ishimizga e'tibor berishimiz kifoya. Shundan so'ng, har bir kishi o'z o'rniga o'tirdi va suhbat umumiy bo'lib ketdi.

en: The caliph ceased not from admiring the beauty, elegance, and lively disposition of the ladies; while the appearance of the three calenders, all blind of the right eye, surprised him very much.
uz: Xalifa ayollarning go'zalligi, nafosati va jonli xarakteriga qoyil qolishdan to'xtamadi; o'ng ko'zi ko'r bo'lgan uchta taqvimning ko'rinishi esa uni juda hayratga soldi.

en: He wished to learn the cause of this singularity, but the conditions that had been imposed upon him and his companions prevented any inquiry.
uz: U bu yagonalikning sababini bilmoqchi edi, lekin unga va uning hamrohlariga yuklangan sharoitlar har qanday so'rovga yo'l qo'ymadi.

en: The guests continued their conversation, when, after an interval, Zobeide rose up, and taking Amina by the hand, said to her, “Come, sister, the company shall not prevent us from doing as we have always been accustomed.” Amina at once got up, and took away the dishes, tables, bottles, glasses, and also the instruments on which the calenders had played.
uz: Mehmonlar suhbatlarini davom ettirishdi, shundan so'ng Zobeide o'rnidan turdi va Aminaning qo'lidan ushlab, unga dedi: Keling, opa, kompaniya bizga doim odatdagidek harakat qilishimizga to'sqinlik qilmasin. Amina darhol o'rnidan turdi va idish-tovoqlarni, stollarni, butilkalarni, stakanlarni, shuningdek, taqvimlar chalgan asboblarni olib tashladi.

en: Nor did Safie remain idle; she snuffed the candles, and added more aloe-wood and ambergris.
uz: Safi ham bekor turmadi; u shamlarni dimladi va yana aloe va ambergris qo'shdi.

en: Having done this, she requested the three calenders to sit on a sofa on one side, and the caliph and his company on the other.
uz: Buni qilib bo'lgach, u uchta kalendarni bir tomonda divan ustida, xalifa va uning kompaniyasini esa boshqa tomonda o'tirishni so'radi.

en: “Get up,” said she then to the porter, “and be ready to assist in whatever we want you.” Amina next came in with a seat, which she placed in the middle of the room.
uz: Tur,  dedi u o'shanda ko'tarib yuruvchiga,  va biz senga xohlagan narsada yordam berishga tayyor bo'l.  Amina keyin o'rindiq bilan kirdi, uni xonaning o'rtasiga joylashtirdi.

en: She then went to the door of a closet, and having opened it, she made a sign to the porter to approach.
uz: Keyin u shkafning eshigi oldiga bordi va uni ochib, ko'tarib yuruvchiga yaqinlashishga ishora qildi.

en: “Come and assist me,” she cried.
uz: Keling, menga yordam bering, deb baqirdi u.

en: He did so, and went in with her, and returned a moment after, followed by two black dogs, each of them secured by a collar and chain, and brought them into the middle of the court.
uz: U shunday qildi va u bilan birga kirdi, bir ozdan keyin qaytib keldi, orqasidan ikki qora it keldi, ularning har biri yoqasi va zanjiri bilan mahkamlangan edi va ularni hovlining o'rtasiga olib keldi.

en: Zobeide, rising from her seat between the calenders and the caliph, moved sadly toward the porter.
