uz: Zobeide taqvimlar va xalifa o'rtasidagi o'rindiqdan turib, xafalik bilan tashuvchi tomon harakatlandi.

en: “Come,” said she, heaving a deep sigh, “let us perform our duty.” She then tucked up her sleeves above her elbows, and receiving a rod from Safie, “Porter,” said she, “deliver one of the dogs to my sister Amina, and bring the other to me.” The porter did as he was commanded.
uz: Keling,  dedi u chuqur ingrab, vazifamizni bajara olaylik. Keyin u yenglarini tirsaklari ostiga qoydi va Safiydan tayoq oldi. Kotarib bor, dedi u, itlardan birini singlim Aminaga topshiring, ikkinchisini esa menga olib keling. Kotarib boruvchi unga buyurilganidek qildi.

en: Upon this the dog that he held in his hand began to howl, and turning toward Zobeide, held her head up in a supplicating posture; but Zobeide, having no regard to the sad countenance of the animal, nor to its cries that resounded through the house, whipped her with the rod till she was out of breath; and having spent her strength, threw down the rod, and taking the chain from the porter, lifted up the dog by her paws, and looking upon her with a sad and pitiful countenance, they both wept; after which, Zobeide, with her handkerchief, wiped the tears from the dog’s eyes, kissed her, returned the chain to the porter, desired him to carry her to the place whence he took her, and to bring the other.
uz: Shundan so'ng, uning qo'lida ushlab turgan it o'kirishni boshladi va Zobeidga qarab, uning boshini yolvorish holatida ko'tardi; lekin Zobeide hayvonning qayg'uli qiyofasini ham, uyning ichida yangragan qichqiriqlarini ham e'tiborga olmagan holda, uni tayoq bilan urdi, nafasini yo'qotdi; va kuchini sarflab, tayoqni tashladi, tashuvchi tomonidan zanjirni oldi, itni uning panjalaridan ko'tardi, va unga qayg'uli va achinarli ko'rinish bilan qaradi, ikkalasi ham yig'ladi; shundan so'ng, Zobeid, o'zining qattiq qo'li bilan, itning ko'zlaridan yoshlarni artib, uni o'pdi, zanjirni tashuvchiga qaytardi, uni olib kelgan joyiga olib borishni buyurdi va boshqa qo'lini olib keldi.

en: Then taking the whip, she served this in the same manner; she then wept with it, dried its tears, kissed it, and returned it to the porter.
uz: So'ngra qamchini oldi va xuddi shunday tarzda unga berdi; so'ngra u bilan birga yig'ladi, ko'z yoshlari bilan quritdi, uni o'pdi va tashuvchiga qaytarib berdi.

en: The three calenders, with the caliph and his companions, were extremely surprised at this exhibition, and could not comprehend why Zobeide, after having beaten the two dogs, should weep with them, wipe off their tears, and kiss them.
uz: Uchta kalendar, xalifa va uning hamrohlari bilan birga, bu ko'rgazmadan juda hayratda qolishdi va Zobeide ikki itni urgandan so'ng, ular bilan birga yig'lashi, ko'z yoshlari tozalanib, ularni o'pishi kerakligini tushuna olmadilar.

en: They muttered among themselves; and the caliph, being more impatient than the rest, could not forbear making signs to the vizier to ask the question.
uz: Ular o'zaro g'udranishdi; va xalifa, qolganlardan ko'ra sabrsizroq bo'lgani uchun, vazirga savol berish uchun imo-ishora qilishdan to'xtata olmadi.

en: The vizier turned his head another way; but being pressed by repeated signs, he answered by others, that it was not yet time for the caliph to satisfy his curiosity.
uz: Vazir boshini boshqa tomonga o'girdi; lekin takroriy belgilar bosgan holda, u boshqalar xalifaning o'z qiziqishini qondirish vaqti hali kelmaganini javob berdi.

en: Zobeide sat still some time in the middle of the room, where she had whipped the two dogs, to recover herself of her emotion; and Safie called to her, “Dear sister, will you not be pleased to return to your place, that I may also act
uz: Zobeide bir oz vaqt xonaning o'rtasida o'tirdi, u yerda o'z his-tuyg'ularidan xalos bo'lish uchun ikki itni qamchilagan edi; va Safi unga chaqirib dedi: Azizim, singlim, o'z joyingga qaytishdan xursand bo'lmaysanmi, shunda men ham...

en: Amina Brought Out a Case Covered with Yellow Satin my part?” “Yes, sister,” replied Zobeide; and then went and sat down upon the sofa, having the caliph, Giafar, and Mesrour, on her right hand, and the three calenders, with the porter, on her left.
uz: Amina sariq Satin bilan qoplangan sumkani olib chiqdi? Ha, opa,  javob berdi Zobeide; songra borib divan ustiga otirdi, uning ong qolida xalifa, Giafar va Mesrour, chap qolida esa uchta taqvim, tashuvchi bilan.

en: The whole company remained silent for some time.
uz: Butun kompaniya bir muncha vaqt sukut saqladi.

en: At last Amina rose, and went into another closet near to that where the dogs were, and brought out a case covered with yellow satin, richly embroidered with gold and green silk.
uz: Nihoyat Amina o'rnidan turdi va itlar yotgan joyga yaqin boshqa shkafga kirdi va sariq satin bilan qoplangan, oltin va yashil ipak bilan boy kashtado'zlik qilingan quti chiqardi.

en: She went toward Safie and opened the case, from whence she took a lute, and presented it to her; and after some time spent in tuning it, Safie began to play, and, accompanying the instrument with her voice, sang a song about the torments that absence creates to lovers.
uz: U Safiye tomon bordi va g'ilofni ochdi, u yerdan lyutani oldi va unga taqdim etdi; va uni sozlashga sarflagan bir muncha vaqtdan so'ng, Safiye chalishni boshladi va o'z ovozi bilan asbobni hamroh qilib, yo'qlik sevishganlar uchun yaratadigan azoblar haqida qo'shiq kuyladi.

en: Having sung with much passion and sweetness, she said to Amina, “Pray take it, sister, for my voice fails me; oblige the company with a tune and a song in my stead.” “Very willingly,” replied Amina, and taking the lute from her sister Safie, sat down in her place.
uz: Ko'p ishtiyoq va shirinlik bilan kuylaganidan so'ng, u Aminaga dedi: Iltimos, qabul qil, opa, chunki ovozim yetmayapti; mening o'rnimga ohang va qo'shiq ayt, dedi Amina va singlisi Safiydan lyutani olib, uning o'rniga o'tirdi.

en: Having sung most delightfully, the caliph expressed his admiration.
uz: Eng zavqli tarzda kuylagan xalifa o'z hayratini bildirdi.

en: While he was doing so, Amina fainted away; and on opening her robe to give her air, they discovered that her breast was covered with fearful scars.
uz: U shunday qilayotgan paytda, Amina hushidan ketardi; va ko'ylagini ochib, unga havo berar ekan, uning ko'kragi dahshatli chandiqlarga to'lganini aniqladilar.

en: While Zobeide and Safie ran to assist their sister, the caliph asked a calender, “Can you inform me about these two black dogs, and this lady, who appears to have been so ill-treated?” “Sir,” said the calender, “we never were in this house before now, and entered it only a few minutes sooner than you did.” This increased the astonishment of the caliph.
uz: Zobeide va Safie singlisiga yordamga yugurib ketayotganlarida, xalifa bir kalendardan so'radi: Menga bu ikki qora it va bu xonim haqida xabar bera olasizmi? Janob, dedi kalender, biz bu uyda ilgari hech qachon bo'lmaganmiz va unga sizdan bir necha daqiqa oldin kirganmiz. Bu xalifaning hayratini yanada oshirdi.

en: “Perhaps,” said he, “the man who is with you can give you some information?” The calender made signs to the porter to draw near, and asked him if he knew why the black dogs had been beaten, and why the bosom of Amina was so scarred.
uz: Ehtimol,  dedi u,  siz bilan birga bo'lgan odam sizga ma'lumot bera oladimi?  Kalender ko'chakka yaqinlashishni so'radi va undan qora itlar nega urilganini va Aminaning ko'kragi nega bunchalik chandiq bo'lganini biladimi, deb so'radi.

en: “Sir,” replied the porter, “if you know nothing of the matter, I know as little as you do.
uz: Janob,  javob berdi portlovchi,  agar siz bu borada hech narsa bilmasangiz, men ham siz bilganchalik kam bilaman.

en: I never was in the house until now; and if you are surprised to see me here, I am as much so to find myself in your company.” The caliph, more and more perplexed at all he heard, determined that he would have the explanation of these mysterious proceedings.
uz: Men shu paytgacha uyda bo'lmaganman; va agar meni bu yerda ko'rib hayron bo'lsangiz, men ham sizning hamrohligingizda bo'lishga majburman. Xalifa, eshitganlari bilan tobora hayron bo'lib, bu sirli jarayonlarning izohiga ega bo'lishini aniqladi.

en: But the question was, who should make the inquiry?
uz: Lekin savol shundaki, so'rovni kim qilishi kerak edi?

en: The caliph endeavored to persuade the calenders to speak first, but they excused themselves.
uz: Xalifa kalendarlarni avval gapirishga ko'ndirishga harakat qildi, lekin ular o'zlarini oqladilar.

en: At last they all agreed that the porter should be the man.
uz: Nihoyat, hammasi tashuvchi odam bo'lishi kerakligiga rozi bo'lishdi.

en: While they were consulting how to put the question, Zobeide herself, as Amina had recovered from her fainting, approached them, and said, “What are you talking of?—what is your dispute about?” The porter then addressed her as follows: “These gentlemen, madam, entreat you to explain why you wept with those dogs, after having treated them so ill, and how it has happened that the lady who fainted has her bosom covered with scars?” At these words Zobeide put on a stern look, and turning toward the caliph and the rest of the company: “Is it true, gentlemen,” said she, “that you desired him to ask me these questions?” All of them, except the vizier Giafar, who spoke not a word, answered, “Yes.” On which she exclaimed, in a tone of resentment: “Before we granted you the favor of receiving you into our house we imposed the condition that you should not speak of anything that did not concern you,
uz: Ular savolni qanday berish haqida maslahatlashayotganlarida, Amina hushidan ketgani sababli, Zobeide o'zi ularga yaqinlashdi va dedi: Nima haqida gapiryapsiz? Sizning bahsingiz nima haqida? Shunda yuk ko'taruvchi unga quyidagicha murojaat qildi: Bu janoblar, xonim, siz ulardan nega o'sha itlar bilan yig'laganingizni tushuntirishingizni so'rayman, ularga bunchalik yomon munosabatda bo'lganingizdan so'ng, va qanday qilib hushidan ketgan xonimning ko'kragi chandiq bilan qoplangan?

en: lest you might hear that which would not please you; and yet,
uz: Toki sizga yoqmaydigan narsani eshitmasligingiz uchun; va shunga qaramay,

en: after having accepted our entertainment, you make no scruple to break your promise.
uz: Bizning ko'ngilochar dasturlarimizni qabul qilganingizdan so'ng, va'dangizni buzishga hech qanday ikkilanmaysiz.

en: Our easy compliance with your wishes may have occasioned this, but that shall not excuse your rudeness.” As she spoke these words, she gave three stamps with her foot, and clapping her hands as often together, cried, “Come quickly!” Upon this a door flew open, and seven black slaves rushed in; each one seized a man, threw him on the ground, and dragged him into the middle of the room, brandishing a scimitar over his head.
uz: Sizning istaklaringizga oson rioya qilishimiz bunga sabab bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu sizning qo'polligingizni oqlamaydi. U bu so'zlarni aytganida, oyoqlari bilan uchta shtamp qo'ydi va qo'llarini tez-tez bir-biriga qarsak chalib, Tezroq keling! deb baqirdi. Shundan so'ng bir eshik ochilib, yetti qora qul shoshilib kirdi; har biri bir odamni ushladi, uni yerga tashladi va xonaning o'rtasiga sudrab kirdi, uning boshiga qo'zg'atdi.

en: We may easily conceive the alarm of the caliph.
uz: Biz xalifaning signalini osongina tasavvur qilishimiz mumkin.

en: He repented, too late, that he had not taken the advice of his vizier, who, with Mesrour, the calenders, and porter, were, horn his ill-timed curiosity, on the point of forfeiting their lives.
uz: U kechroq tavba qildi, vazirining maslahatini qabul qilmaganidan, Mesrour bilan birga kalendarlar va tashuvchi ham uning yovuz qiziqishida jonini yo'qotmoqchi edi.

en: Before they gave the fatal stroke, one of the slaves said to Zobeide and her sisters, “Would it not be right to interrogate them first?” On which Zobeide said, “Answer me, and say who you are, otherwise you shall not live one moment longer.
uz: Ular halokatli zarba berishlaridan oldin, qullardan biri Zobeide va uning opa-singillariga dedi: Ularni avval so'roq qilish to'g'ri bo'lmaydimi? Shunda Zobeide dedi: Menga javob ber va kimligingni ayt, aks holda bir lahzaga ham yashamaysan.

en: I cannot believe you to be honest men, or persons of authority or distinction in your own countries; for, if you were, you would have kept the promise made us.” The caliph, naturally, was infinitely more indignant than the rest to find his life depending upon the command of a woman: but he began to conceive some hopes, when he found she wished to know who they all were; for he imagined that she would by no means take away his life, when she should be informed of his rank.
uz: Sizni o'z mamlakatingizda halol odamlar, yoki hokimiyat yoki farq qiluvchi shaxslar deb ishonmayman; chunki, agar shunday bo'lganingizda, bizga bergan va'dangizni bajargan bo'lar edingiz. Xalifa, tabiiyki, qolganlardan ko'ra, o'z hayotini ayolning buyrug'iga bog'liq holda topishga cheksiz g'azablanardi: lekin u ularning barchasini bilishni xohlaganini topgach, ba'zi umidlarni o'ylay boshladi; chunki u o'z darajasidan xabar berilganda, hech qanday tarzda uning hayotini olib qo'ymasligini tasavvur qilardi.

en: He whispered to his vizier, who was near him, instantly to declare who he was.
uz: U o'ziga yaqin turgan vazirga o'zining kimligini darhol e'lon qilish uchun pichirladi.

en: But this wise vizier, being more prudent, resolved to save his master’s honor, and not let the world know the affront he had brought upon himself by his own imprudence; and therefore answered, “We have what we deserve.” Zobeide, meanwhile, having turned to the calenders, and seeing them all blind with one eye, asked if they were brothers.
uz: Ammo bu dono vazir, aqlliroq bo'lgani uchun, xo'jayinining obro'sini saqlab qolishga qaror qildi va o'zining beparvoligi tufayli o'ziga yetkazilgan haqoratni dunyoga bildirmaslikka qaror qildi; shuning uchun javob berdi: Bizga loyiq narsa bor. Zobide esa, taqvimlarga qarab, ularning hammasini bir ko'zi bilan ko'r holda ko'rib, ularning aka-uka ekanliklarini so'radi.

en: One of them answered, “No, madam, not otherwise than as we are calenders; that is to say, as we observe the same rules.” “Were you born blind of the right eye?” continued she.
uz: Ulardan biri javob berdi: Yoq, xonim, biz kalendarlardagidek emas; yani, bir xil qoidalarga rioya qilganimizdek. Siz ong kozingiz kor bolib tugilganmisiz? deb davom etdi u.

en: “No madam,” answered he; “I lost my eye in such a surprising adventure, that it would be
uz: Yo'q, xonim,  javob berdi u; Men shunday hayratlanarli sarguzashtda ko'zimni yo'qotdimki, u...

en: instructive to every one to hear it.” Zobeide put the same question to the others in their turn, when the last she addressed replied, “Pray, madam, show some pity on us, for we are all the sons of kings.
uz: Har kimga buni eshitish uchun ibrat beradi. Zobeide boshqalarga ham xuddi shu savolni berdi, oxirgi marta murojaat qilganida esa javob berdi: Iltimos, xonim, bizga rahm qiling, chunki biz hammamiz shohlarning o'g'illarimiz.

en: Although we have never seen each other before this evening, we have had sufficient time to become acquainted with this circumstance; and I can assure you that the kings our fathers, have made some noise in the world!” During this speech Zobeide became less angry, and said to the slaves, “Give them their liberty a while, but remain where you are.
uz: Garchi biz hech qachon shu oqshomgacha bir-birimizni ko'rmagan bo'lsak-da, bu vaziyat bilan tanishishga yetarli vaqt topdik; va men sizga ishontira olamanki, ota-bobolarimizning podshohlari dunyoda shovqin ko'tarishdi! Bu nutq davomida Zobeide kamroq g'azablandi va qullarga dedi: Ularga bir oz ozodlik bering, lekin qayerda bo'lsangiz, o'sha yerda qoling.

en: Those who tell us their history, and the occasion of their coming, do them no hurt, let them go where they please; but do not spare those who refuse to give us that satisfaction.” The three calenders, the caliph, the grand vizier Giafar, the captain of his guard, and the porter were placed in the middle of the hall, seated upon a carpet before the three ladies, who reclined upon a sofa, while the slaves stood ready to do whatever their mistresses should command.
uz: Bizga o'z tarixini va kelish sababini aytib beradiganlarga hech qanday zarar yetkazmang, xohlagan joylariga boringlar; lekin bizga bu qoniqishni berishni istamaganlarni ayamang. Uch kalendar, xalifa, bosh vazir Giafar, uning qo'riqchilari sardori va posbon zalning o'rtasiga joylashtirildi, gilamga o'tirgan uch xonim divan ustida yotardi, qullar esa xo'jayinlari buyurgan har qanday ishni qilishga tayyor turardi.

en: The porter spoke first, and briefly related the adventures of the morning with Amina, and the kind favors to him of herself and her fair sisters in the evening, which he declared to be the whole of his history.
uz: Portyor birinchi bo'lib gapirdi va Amina bilan ertalabki sarguzashtlarni, shuningdek, kechqurun unga va uning go'zal opa-singillariga qilgan mehribonliklarini qisqacha hikoya qildi, buni u o'z tarixining butun qismi deb e'lon qildi.

en: When the porter had concluded, Zobeide said, “Save thyself and begone, nor ever let us see thee again.” “I beg of you, madam,” replied he, “to let me remain a little longer.
uz: To'quvchi yakunlaganidan so'ng, Zobeide dedi: O'zingni qutqar va ket, seni hech qachon ko'rmaylik. Iltimos qilaman, xonim, dedi u, menga yana biroz qolishimga ruxsat bering.

en: It would be unfair that I should not hear their histories, after they have had the pleasure of hearing mine.” Saying this he took his place at the end of the sofa, truly delighted at finding himself free from the danger which so much alarmed him.
uz: Ularning tarixlarini eshitmasligim adolatsizlik bo'lardi, chunki ular mening tariximni eshitish zavqiga ega bo'lishdi. Shunday qilib, u divanning oxirida o'rin oldi va o'zini shunchalik xavotirga solayotgan xavfdan xalos bo'lganidan chin dildan xursand edi.

en: One of the calenders, addressing himself to Zobeide, next spoke.
uz: Kalendarlardan biri Zobeidega murojaat qilib, keyin gapirdi.

en: The History of the First Calender Madam, I am the son of a sultan.
uz: Birinchi Kalendarning tarixi Madam, men bir sultonning o'g'limman.

en: My father had a brother, who reigned over a neighboring kingdom.
uz: Mening otamning bir akasi bor edi, u qo'shni davlat ustidan hukmronlik qilardi.

en: His son, my cousin, and I were nearly of the same age.
uz: Uning o'g'li, amakivachcham va men deyarli bir xil yoshda edik.

en: I went regularly every year to see my uncle, at whose court I amused myself for a month or two, and then returned home.
uz: Men har yili muntazam ravishda amakimni ko'rishga borardim, uning saroyida bir-ikki oy o'zimni xursand qildim, keyin uyga qaytdim.

en: On one occasion I arrived at my father’s capital, where, contrary to custom, I found a numerous guard at the gate of the palace.
uz: Bir safar otamning poytaxtiga yetib keldim, u yerda odatga zid ravishda saroy darvozasi oldida ko'plab qo'riqchilarni topdim.

en: They surrounded me as I entered.
uz: Kirganimda meni o'rab olishdi.

en: The commanding officer said, “Prince, the army has proclaimed the grand vizier sultan, instead of your father, who is dead, and I take you prisoner in the name of the new sultan.” This rebel vizier had long entertained a mortal hatred against me.
uz: Qo'mondon ofitser aytdi: Ey shahzoda, armiya otangizning o'rniga buyuk vazir sultanni e'lon qildi va men sizni yangi sulton nomidan asirga olaman. Bu isyonkor vazir menga nisbatan uzoq vaqtdan beri o'lik nafrat uyg'otgan edi.

en: When I was a boy I loved to shoot with a cross bow; and being one day upon the terrace of the palace, a bird happening to come by, I shot at but missed him, and the bolt by misfortune hit the vizier, who was taking the air upon the terrace of his own house, and put out one of his eyes.
uz: Bolaligimda xoch kamon bilan otishni yoqtirardim; va bir kuni saroy terassasida bir qush kelayotgan edi, men unga o'q uzdim, lekin uni o'tkazib yubordim, va bolt baxtsiz hodisa tufayli o'z uyining terassasida havoni olayotgan vazirga urildi va uning bir ko'zini o'chirdi.

en: He never forgave me, and, as opportunity offered, made me sensible of his resentment.
uz: U meni hech qachon kechirmadi va menga imkoniyat sifatida o'zining xafaligini anglatdi.

en: But now that he had me in his power, he came to me like a mad-man, and thrusting his finger into my right eye, pulled it out, and thus I became blind of one eye.
uz: Ammo endi u meni o'z qudratida ushlab turganidan so'ng, u menga telbalikdek keldi va o'ng ko'zimga barmog'ini tiqib, uni chiqarib oldi va shu tariqa men bir ko'zimni ko'r bo'lib qoldim.

en: His cruelty did not stop here; he commanded the executioner to cut off my head, and leave me to be devoured by birds of prey.
uz: Uning shafqatsizligi shu yerda to'xtamadi; u jallodga boshimni kesib tashlashni va meni o'lja qushlariga yeyishga qo'yishni buyurdi.

en: The executioner conveyed me to the place of execution to complete this barbarous sentence; but by my prayers and tears, I moved the man’s compassion: “Go,” said he to me, “get you speedily out of the kingdom, and never return, or you will destroy yourself and me.” I thanked him, and as soon as I was left alone, comforted myself for the loss of my eye, by considering that I had very narrowly escaped a much greater evil.
uz: Jallod meni bu shafqatsiz hukmni tugatish uchun qatl joyiga olib bordi; lekin mening duolarim va ko'z yoshlarim bilan odamning rahm-shafqatini uyg'otdim: Bor, dedi u menga, shoshilinch ravishda shohlikdan chiqib ket, hech qachon qaytib kelma, aks holda o'zingni ham, meni ham yo'q qilasan. Men unga rahmat aytdim va yolg'iz qolishim bilanoq, ko'zimni yo'qotishdan o'zimni ovutdim, chunki men ancha kattaroq yomonlikdan juda oz qutulib qolganimni hisobga oldim.

en: Being thus surrounded with sorrows and persecuted by fortune, I had recourse to a stratagem, which was the only means left me to save my life: I caused my beard and eyebrows to be shaved, and putting on a calender’s habit, I passed, unknown by any, out of the city.
uz: Shunday qilib, qayg'ular bilan o'ralgan va omad ta'qib qilgan holda, hayotimni saqlab qolish uchun yagona yo'l bo'lgan bir hiylaga murojaat qildim: soqol va qoshlarimni qirqdim va kalendar odatini kiyib, hech kimga ma'lum bo'lmagan holda shahardan chiqib ketdim.

en: I avoided the towns till I arrived in the empire of the commander of the faithful, the renowned caliph Haroun al Raschid, when I ceased to fear.
uz: Men shaharlardan qochardim, toki dindorlar qo'mondoni, mashhur xalifa Horun al-Rashid imperiyasiga yetib kelgunga qadar, qo'rqishni to'xtatdim.

en: I resolved to come to Bagdad and throw myself at the feet of this great monarch.
uz: Men Bag'dodda kelishga va o'zimni bu buyuk monarxning oyoqlariga tashlashga qaror qildim.

en: I shall move him to compassion, said I to myself, by the relation of my misfortunes, and without doubt he will take pity on a persecuted prince, and not suffer me to implore his assistance in vain.
uz: Men uni rahm-shafqatga undayman, deb o'zimga aytdim, noqulayliklarimga nisbatan, va shubhasiz, u ta'qib qilingan shahzodaga rahm qiladi va menga behuda yordam so'rashga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

en: In short, after a journey of several months, I arrived yesterday at the gate of this city, into which I entered at dusk: and as I entered, another calender came up; he saluted me, and I him.
uz: Xullas, bir necha oylik sayohatdan so'ng, kecha shu shaharning darvozasiga yetib keldim, unga quyosh botishi bilan kirdim: va kirganimda, yana bir kalendar paydo bo'ldi; u menga salom berdi, men esa unga.

en: “You appear,” said I, “to be a stranger, as I am.” “You are not mistaken,” replied he.
uz: Sen,  dedim men,  men kabi begona bo'lish uchun paydo bo'lasan. Sen adashmaysan,  javob berdi u.

en: He had no sooner returned this answer, than a third calender overtook us.
uz: U bu javobni tezroq qaytarmaguncha, bizni uchinchi kalendar bosib o'tdi.

en: He saluted us, and told us he was a stranger newly come to Bagdad; so that as brethren we joined together, resolving not to separate from one another.
uz: U bizni salomladi va Bag'dodda yangi kelgan begona ekanligini aytdi; shuning uchun biz bir-birimizdan ajralmaslikka qaror qilib, birodarlar sifatida birgamiz.

en: It was now late, and we knew not where to seek a lodging in the city, where we had never been before.
uz: Endi kech edi va biz shaharda qayerga turar joy izlashni bilmas edik, bu yerda biz hech qachon bo'lmagan edik.

en: But good fortune having brought us to your gate, we made bold to knock, when you received us with so much kindness, that we are incapable of rendering suitable thanks.
uz: Ammo omad bizni sizning darvozangizga olib kelganidan so'ng, bizni shunchalik mehribonlik bilan qabul qilganingizdan so'ng, qo'rqmasdan taqillatib qo'ydik, shunda biz munosib minnatdorchilik bildirishga qodir emasmiz.

en: This, madam, is in obedience to your commands, the account I was to give how I lost my right eye, wherefore my
uz: Bu, xonim, sizning buyruqlaringizga itoatkorlik bilan, o'ng ko'zimni qanday yo'qotganimni aytishim kerak edi, shuning uchun mening...

en: beard and eyebrows are shaved, and how I came to be with you at this time.
uz: Soqol va qoshlar qirilgan, va men bu vaqtda siz bilan qanday bo'lishga kelganim.

en: “It is enough,” said Zobeide; “you may retire to what place you think fit.” The calender begged the ladies’ permission to stay till he had heard the relations of his two comrades, “whom I cannot,” said he, “leave with honor;” and that he might also hear those of the three other persons in company.
uz: kifoya,  dedi Zobeide;  o'zingiz munosib deb hisoblagan joyga ketishingiz mumkin.  Kalender xonimlardan o'z ikki o'rtoqining munosabatlarini eshitmaguncha qolishga ruxsat so'radi,  men esa ularni eshitolmayman,  dedi u,  sharaf bilan keting;  va u ham boshqa uch kishining gapini eshitishi uchun.

en: He had no sooner finished than the second calender began, and addressing himself to Zobeide, spoke as follows: The History of the Second Calender Madam, to obey your commands, and to show you by what strange accident I became blind of the right eye, I must give you the account of my life.
uz: U ikkinchi kalendar boshlanishidan ko'p o'tmay tugatdi va Zobeidega murojaat qilib, quyidagicha dedi: Ikkinchi Kalender xonimning tarixi, sizning buyruqlaringizga bo'ysunish va sizga qanday g'alati tasodifan o'ng ko'zni ko'r bo'lib qolganimni ko'rsatish uchun, men sizga hayotimning hisobini aytishim kerak.

en: I was yet a youth, when the sultan, my father, perceived that I was endowed with good natural ability, and spared nothing proper for improving it.
uz: Men hali yosh edim, o'shanda sulton, otam, meni yaxshi tabiiy qobiliyatga ega ekanligini anglab yetdi va uni yaxshilash uchun hech qanday kerakli narsani ayamasdi.

en: No sooner was I able to read and write, but I learned the Koran from beginning to end by heart, all the traditions collected from the mouth of our prophet, and the works of poets.
uz: Tez orada o'qishga va yozishga qodir bo'lmadim, lekin Qur'onni boshidan oxirigacha yurakdan o'rgandim, payg'ambarimizning og'zidan to'plangan barcha an'analarni va shoirlarning asarlarini.

en: I applied myself to geography, chronology, and to speak the Arabian language in its purity; not forgetting in the mean
uz: Men o'zimni geografiyaga, xronologiyaga va arab tilida sof so'zlash uchun qo'ydim; o'rtacha narsani unutmaslikka.

en: time all such exercises as were proper for a prince to understand.
uz: shahzoda tushunishi kerak bo'lgan barcha mashqlarni vaqt bilan o'tkazing.

en: But the thing which I was most fond of, and best succeeded in, was penmanship: wherein I surpassed all the celebrated scribes of our kingdom.
uz: Lekin men eng ko'p yoqtirgan va eng yaxshi muvaffaqiyatga erishgan narsa yozuvchilik edi: unda men qirolligimizdagi barcha mashhur kotiblardan o'zib ketdim.

en: The fame of my learning reached the Emperor of Hindustan, who sent an embassy with rich presents to my father and invited me to his court.
uz: Mening bilimlarimning shuhrati Hindiston imperatoriga yetdi, u otamga boy sovg'alar bilan elchixona yubordi va meni uning saroyiga taklif qildi.

en: I departed with the ambassador.
uz: Men elchi bilan ketdim.

en: We had been about a month on our journey, when we saw in the distance an immense cloud of dust, and soon after we discovered fifty fierce horsemen, sons of the desert, well armed.
uz: Sayohatimizda taxminan bir oy bo'lgandan so'ng, uzoqda ulkan chang bulutini ko'rdik va ko'p o'tmay sahro o'g'illari bo'lgan, yaxshi qurollangan ellik shafqatsiz chavandozni topdik.

en: Not being able to repel force by force, we told them we were the ambassadors of the sultan of India; but the sons of the desert insolently answered, “Why do you wish us to respect the sultan, your master!
uz: Kuch bilan kuchni qaytarolmay, ularga Hindiston sultonining elchilari ekanligimizni aytdik; lekin sahro o'g'illari beparvolik bilan javob berishdi: Nega siz bizga sultonni hurmat qilishni xohlaysiz, xo'jayiningizni!

en: We are not his subjects, nor even within his realm.” They attacked us on all sides.
uz: Biz uning fuqarolari emasmiz, hatto uning hukmronligi ichida ham emasmiz. Ular bizga har tomondan hujum qilishdi.

en: I defended myself as long as I could, but finding that I was wounded, and that the ambassador and all our attendants were overthrown, I took advantage of the remaining strength of my horse, and escaped.
uz: O'zimni iloji boricha himoya qildim, lekin men yaralanganimni va elchi va barcha xizmatkorlarimiz ag'darilganini bilib, otimning qolgan kuchidan foydalandim va qochib ketdim.

en: My horse was wounded and suddenly fell dead under me.
uz: Otim yaralandi va to'satdan tagimda o'lib yiqildi.

en: Alone, wounded, and a stranger, I bound up my hurt and walked on the rest of the day, arriving at the foot of a mountain, where I perceived a cave; I stayed there that night, after I had eaten some fruits that I gathered by the way.
uz: Yolg'iz, yaralangan va begona odam bo'lib, o'z jarohatimni bog'ladim va kunning qolgan qismida yurdim, tog' etagiga yetib keldim va u yerda g'orni sezdim; o'sha kecha yo'l bo'ylab yig'ilgan mevalardan yeb bo'lgandan keyin o'sha yerda qoldim.

en: I continued my journey for many days without finding any place of abode; but after a month’s time I came to a large town, well inhabited—it was surrounded by several streams, so that it seemed to enjoy perpetual spring.
uz: Men sayohatimni ko'p kunlar davomida hech qanday joy topmasdan davom ettirdim; lekin bir oy o'tgach, men yaxshi yashaydigan katta shaharga keldim  u bir nechta daryolar bilan o'ralgan edi, shuning uchun u abadiy bahordan bahramand bo'lgandek tuyuldi.

en: My face, hands, and feet were black and sunburnt; for by my long journey, my boots were quite worn out, so that I was forced to walk barefoot; and my clothes were all in rags.
uz: Yuzim, qo'llarim va oyoqlarim qora va quyoshdan kuygan edi; chunki uzoq safarim tufayli etiklarim butunlay eskirgan edi, shuning uchun yalangoyoq yurishga majbur bo'ldim; va kiyimlarimning hammasi latta edi.

en: I entered the town and addressed myself to a tailor that was at work in his shop; who made me sit down by him, and asked me who I was, whence I came, and what had brought me thither.
uz: Men shaharga kirdim va o'z do'konida ishlayotgan tikuvchiga murojaat qildim; u meni uning yoniga o'tqazdi va mendan kimligimni, qayerdan kelganimni va meni u yerga nima olib kelganimni so'radi.

en: I did not conceal anything that had befallen me, nor made I any scruple to reveal my rank.
uz: Menga tushgan hech narsani yashirmadim, o'z darajamni oshkor qilish uchun hech qanday jur'at qilmadim.

en: listened to me with attention; and brought me something to eat, and offered me an apartment at his house, which I accepted.
uz: meni diqqat bilan tingladi; va menga yeyishga narsa olib keldi, va uning uyida menga kvartira taklif qildi, men uni qabul qildim.

en: Some days after my arrival, the tailor asked me if I knew anything by which I could acquire a livelihood.
uz: Kelganimdan bir necha kun o'tgach, tikuvchi mendan tirikchilik uchun biror narsa bilishimni so'radi.

en: I told him that I was well versed in the science of laws, both human and divine; that I was a grammarian, a poet, and, above all, that I wrote remarkably well.
uz: Men unga qonunlar, ham insoniy, ham ilohiy fanidan yaxshi xabardor ekanligimni, grammatik, shoir ekanligimni va eng muhimi, juda yaxshi yozganimni aytdim.

en: “None of these things will avail you here.
uz: Bu narsalarning hech biri sizga bu yerda foyda keltirmaydi.

en: If you will follow my advice,” he added, “you will procure a short jacket, and as you are strong and in good health, you may go into the neighboring forest, and cut wood for fuel.
uz: Agar mening maslahatimga amal qilsangiz,  deb qoshimcha qildi u,  qisqa kurtka sotib olasiz va kuchli va soglom bolganingiz uchun qoshni ormonga borib, yoqilgi uchun yogoch kesishingiz mumkin.

en: You may then expose it for sale in the market.
uz: Keyin uni bozorda sotuvga chiqarishingiz mumkin.

en: By these means, you will be able to wait till the cloud which hangs over you, and obliges you to conceal your birth, shall have blown over.
uz: Shu yo'llar bilan siz osmondan osilgan va sizni tug'ilganingizni yashirishga majbur qiladigan bulut uchib o'tguncha kutishingiz mumkin bo'ladi.

en: I will furnish you with a cord and hatchet.” The next day the tailor brought me a rope, a hatchet, and a short jacket, and recommended me to people who gained their bread after the same manner, that they might take me into their company.
uz: Men senga arqon va bolg'a bilan ta'minlayman. Ertasi kuni tikuvchi menga arqon, bolg'a va kalta kurtka olib keldi va meni xuddi shu usulda non topgan odamlarga tavsiya qildi, toki ular meni o'z kompaniyasiga qabul qilishsin.

en: They conducted me to the wood, and the first day I brought in as much upon my head as procured me half a piece of gold of the money of that country; for though the wood was not far distant from the town, yet few would be at the trouble of fetching it for themselves.
uz: Meni o'rmonga olib borishdi, va birinchi kuni boshimga oltinning yarmi o'sha yurt pulidan yetgan miqdorni olib keldim; garchi o'rmon shahardan uncha uzoqda bo'lmasa ham, uni o'zlari uchun olib kelish qiyin bo'lardi.

en: I gained a good sum of money in a short time, and repaid my tailor what he had lent me.
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida yaxshigina pul topdim va tikuvchimga qarz berganini qaytardim.

en: I continued this way of living for a whole year.
uz: Men bu hayot tarzini butun bir yil davomida davom ettirdim.

en: One day, having by chance penetrated farther into the wood than usual, I happened to light on a pleasant spot, where I began to cut; and in pulling up the root of a tree I espied an iron ring, fastened to a trap door of the same metal.
uz: Bir kuni, odatdagidan ko'ra adashib o'rmonga kirib, yoqimli joyga duch keldim, u yerda kesishni boshladim; va daraxt ildizini tortib olgach, xuddi shu metalldan yasalgan tuzoq eshigiga mahkamlangan temir uzukni kuzatdim.

en: I took away the earth that covered it, and having lifted it up, discovered a flight of stairs, which I descended with my ax in my hand.
uz: Men uni qoplagan tuproqni olib tashladim va uni ko'tarib, zinapoya uchishini topdim, undan boltam bilan pastga tushdim.

en: When I reached the bottom, I found myself in a palace, as well lighted as if it had been above ground.
uz: Pastga yetganimda, o'zimni yer ustida yoritilgandek yaxshi yoritilgan saroyda topdim.

en: I went forward along a gallery supported by pillars of jasper, the base and capitals being of massy gold; suddenly I saw a lady of a noble and graceful air, and extremely beautiful, coming toward me.
uz: Men yaspis ustunlar bilan tayanadigan galereya bo'ylab oldinga bordim, taglik va poytaxtlar katta oltindan iborat edi; to'satdan men oliyjanob va nafis havoga ega, nihoyatda go'zal bir xonimning menga yaqinlashayotganini ko'rdim.

en: I hastened to meet her; and
uz: Men uni kutib olishga shoshildim; va

en: as I was making a low obeisance, she asked me, “Are you a man, or a genie?” “A man, madam,” said I.
uz: Men pastdan ta'zim qilayotganimda, u mendan so'radi: Sen erkakmisan, jinmisan? Bir odam, xonim,  dedim men.

en: “By what adventure, said she, fetching a deep sigh, “are you come hither?
uz: Qanday sarguzasht bilan, dedi u chuqur ingrab,  bu yerga keldingmi?

en: I have lived here twenty-five years, and you are the first man I have beheld in that time.” Her great beauty, and the sweetness and civility wherewith she received me, emboldened me to reply.
uz: Men bu yerda yigirma besh yil yashadim va o'sha davrda ko'rgan birinchi odam sensan. Uning buyuk go'zalligi, meni qabul qilgan shirinligi va odobliligi javob berishga undadi.

en: “Madam, before I satisfy your curiosity, give me leave to say that I am infinitely gratified with this unexpected meeting which offers me an occasion of consolation in the midst of my affliction; and perhaps it may give me an opportunity of The Princess had great beauty
uz: Xonim, men sizning qiziquvchanligingizni qondirishdan oldin, shuni aytishga ruxsat beringki, men bu kutilmagan uchrashuvdan cheksiz mamnunman, u menga azobim orasida taskin berish imkoniyatini beradi; va ehtimol, bu menga Malikaga katta go'zallik bergan imkoniyat berishi mumkin.

en: making you also more happy than you are.” I then related my story to her from beginning to end.
uz: seni ham sendan ko'ra baxtliroq qiladi. Keyin men o'z hikoyamni unga boshidan oxirigacha aytib berdim.

en: prince,” she replied, sighing, “the most enchanting spots cannot afford delight when we are there against our wills.
uz: shahzoda, - deb javob berdi u ingrab, - eng sehrli joylar biz o'z xohishimizga zid ravishda u yerda bo'lganimizda rohatlanishga qurbi yetmaydi.

en: But hear now my history.
uz: Lekin endi mening tariximni eshiting.

en: I am a princess, the daughter of a sultan, king of the Ebony Island, so called because of the precious wood found in it.
uz: Men malika, Ebony orolining shohi bo'lgan sultonning qizi, u yerda topilgan qimmatbaho yog'och tufayli shunday nomlanganman.

en: “The king, my father, had chosen for my husband a prince, who was my cousin; but on the very night of the bridal festivities, in the midst of the rejoicings of the court, a genie took me away.
uz: Shoh, otam, erim uchun amakivachcham bo'lgan shahzohni tanlagan edi; lekin aynan kelin bayramlari kechasi, saroy xursandchiligi o'rtasida, bir jin meni olib ketdi.

en: I fainted with alarm, and when I recovered I found myself in this place.
uz: Men xavotirdan hushdan ketdim va tuzalganimda o'zimni shu joyda topdim.

en: I was long inconsolable; but time and necessity have reconciled me.
uz: Men uzoq vaqt tasalli topolmas edim; lekin vaqt va zarurat meni yarashtirdi.

en: Twenty-five years I have passed in this place, in which I have everything necessary for life and splendor.
uz: Yigirma besh yil shu joyda o'tkazdim, unda hayot va hashamat uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsa bor.

en: “Every ten days,” continued the princess, “the genie visits me.
uz: Har on kunda,  deb davom etdi malika,  jin meni ziyorat qiladi.

en: In the mean time, if I have any occasion for him, I have only to touch a talisman, and he appears.
uz: Ayni paytda, agar unga biror imkoniyatim bo'lsa, faqatgina bir talismanni tegishim kerak, va u paydo bo'ladi.

en: It is now four days since he was here, and I have therefore to wait six days more before he again makes his appearance.
uz: Uning bu yerda bo'lganiga to'rt kun bo'ldi, shuning uchun u yana paydo bo'lishidan oldin yana olti kun kutishim kerak.

en: You, therefore, may remain five with me, if it be agreeable to you, in order to keep me company; and I will endeavor to regale and entertain you as befits your merit and dignity.” The princess then conducted me to a bath, the most commodious and sumptuous imaginable; and when I came forth, instead of my own clothes I found waiting a costly robe.
uz: Shunday qilib, agar sizga ma'qul bo'lsa, men bilan birga bo'lish uchun beshta kishi qolishingiz mumkin; va men sizni o'z qadringiz va qadr-qimmatingizga mos ravishda dam olishga va ko'ngil ochishga harakat qilaman. Keyin malika meni eng qulay va hashamatli tasavvur qilinadigan vannaga olib bordi; va men chiqqanimda, o'z kiyimlarim o'rniga qimmatbaho xalat kutib turganini ko'rdim.

en: We sat down to a table with several dishes of delicate meats.
uz: Biz bir nechta nozik go'shtli taomlar bilan birga stolga o'tirdik.

en: We ate, and passed the remaining part of the day, as also the evening very pleasantly together.
uz: Biz ovqatlandik va kunning qolgan qismini, shuningdek, kechani birga juda yoqimli o'tkazdik.

en: The next day I said to her, “Fair princess, you have been too long buried alive in this subterranean palace; come—follow me and enjoy the light of day, of which you have been deprived so many years.” “Prince,” replied she, with a smile, “if you out of ten days will grant me nine, and resign the tenth to the genie, the light of day would be nothing to me.” “Princess,” said I, “the fear of the genie makes you speak thus; for my part I regard him so little, that I will break in pieces his talisman, with the spell that is written about it.
uz: Ertasi kuni men unga aytdim: Adolatli malika, sen bu yer osti saroyida juda kop vaqt tirik holda komilgansan; kel, menga ergashing va kunduzgi nurdan zavqlan, undan shuncha yil mahrum bolganing uchun. Adolatli shahzoda, dedi u tabassum bilan, agar on kun ichida menga toqqizta bersang va ondan birini jinga topshirsang, kunduzgi nur menga hech narsa bolmas edi. Adolatli qiz, dedim men, jinning qorquvi seni shunday gapirishga majbur qiladi; chunki men unga juda kam qarayman, uning sehrida, u haqida yozilgan sehr bilan sindirib tashlayman.

en: Let him come; and however brave or powerful he be, I will defy him.” On saying this I gave the talisman a kick with my foot, and broke it in pieces.
uz: U kelsin; va qanchalik jasur yoki qudratli bo'lmasin, men unga qarshi chiqaman. Shunday deyish bilan men talismanni oyog'im bilan tepdim va uni maydalab tashladim.

en: The talisman was no sooner broken than the whole palace shook as if ready to fall to atoms, and the walls opened to give entrance to the genie.
uz: Talisman butun saroy atomlarga aylanishga tayyordek qaltirab, devorlar jinga kirish imkonini berish uchun ochilgandan so'ng tezda sindi.

en: I had no sooner felt the shock than, at the earnest
uz: Men bunday hayratni hech qachon, chin dildan his qilmagan edim.

en: request of the princess, I took to flight.
uz: Malika so'roviga ko'ra, men uchib ketdim.

en: Having hastily put on my own robe, I ascended the stairs leading to the forest, and reached the town in safety.
uz: Shoshilinch ravishda o'z xalatimni kiyib, o'rmonga olib boruvchi zinapoyalarga chiqdim va shaharga xavfsiz yetib bordim.

en: My landlord, the tailor, was very glad to see me.
uz: Uy egam, tikuvchi, meni ko'rib juda xursand bo'ldi.

en: I had, however, in my haste, left my hatchet and cord in the princess’s chamber.
uz: Lekin shoshilinch ravishda, boltam va arqonimni malika xonasida qoldirdim.

en: Shortly after my return, while I was brooding over this loss, and lamenting the cruel treatment to which the princess would be exposed, the tailor came in and said, “An old man, whom I do not know, brings your hatchet and cord, and wishes to speak to you, for he will deliver them to none but yourself.” At these words I changed color, and fell a-trembling.
uz: Qayta qaytganimdan ko'p o'tmay, men bu yo'qotishdan xavotirda va malika duch keladigan shafqatsiz muomaladan qayg'urib yurganimda, tikuvchi kelib dedi: Men tanimaydigan bir qari odam sizning bolg'angiz va arqoningizni olib keladi va siz bilan gaplashishni xohlaydi, chunki u ularni faqat o'zingizdan boshqa hech kimga topshirmaydi. Shu so'zlardan keyin rang o'zgartdim va titroqdan yiqildim.

en: While the tailor was asking me the reason, my chamber door opened, and the old man appeared with my hatchet and cord.
uz: Tikuvchi mendan sababini so'raganida, xonamning eshigi ochildi va keksa odam boltam va arqonim bilan paydo bo'ldi.

en: “I am a genie,” said he, speaking to me, “a grandson of Eblis, prince of genii.
uz: Men jinman,  dedi u menga gapirib,  Eblisning nabirasiman, jinlar shahzodasi.

en: Is not this your hatchet and are not these your cords?” After the genie had put these questions to me he gave me no time to answer.
uz: Bu sening ilmoqing emasmi va bu sening arqonlaring emasmi? Jin menga bu savollarni berganidan so'ng, javob berishga vaqt bermadi.

en: He grasped me by the middle, dragged me out of the chamber, and mounting into the air carried me up to the skies with extraordinary swiftness.
uz: U meni o'rtadan ushladi, xonadan sudrab chiqardi va havoda ko'tarilib, g'ayrioddiy tezlik bilan osmonga ko'tardi.

en: He descended again in like manner to the earth, which on a sudden he caused to open with a stroke of his foot, when I found myself in the enchanted palace, before the fair princess of the Isle of Ebony.
uz: U xuddi shunday tarzda yana yerga tushdi, u birdaniga oyoq urishi bilan ochildi, men o'zimni sehrli saroyda, Ebony orolining go'zal malikasi oldida topganimda.

en: what a spectacle was there!
uz: Qanday ajoyib tomosha edi u yerda!

en: I saw what pierced me to the heart; the poor princess lay dead.
uz: Meni yuragimga sanchgan narsani ko'rdim; bechora malika o'lik holda yotardi.

en: I fainted at the sight.
uz: Men bu manzarani ko'rib hushdan ketdim.

en: When I was come to myself again, I cried, “Strike, for I am ready to die, and await death as the greatest favor you can show me.” But instead of killing me, he said, “Behold how genii revenge themselves on those who offend them.
uz: O'zimga qaytganimda, baqirdim: Ur, chunki men o'lishga tayyorman va o'limni menga ko'rsatishingiz mumkin bo'lgan eng katta marhamat sifatida kuting. Lekin meni o'ldirish o'rniga, u dedi: Mana, jinlar ularni xafa qilganlardan qanday qasos olishadi.

en: Thou art the least to blame, and I will content myself with transforming thee into a dog, ape, lion, or bird; take thy choice of any of these, I will leave it to thyself.” These words gave me some hopes of being able to appease him.
uz: Sen eng kam aybdorsan va men seni itga, maymunga, sherga yoki qushga aylantirish bilan kifoyalanaman; bularning har birini tanla, o'zingga qo'yaman. Bu so'zlar menga uni tinchlantirishga qodir bo'lishga umid berdi.

en: “O genie,” said I, “restrain your rage, and since you will not take away my life, pardon me freely, as a good dervish pardoned one who envied him.” “And how was that?” said he.
uz: Ey jin,  dedim men,  g'azabingni ushlab tur, va sen mening jonimni olmayotganing uchun, meni bemalol kechir, xuddi yaxshi dervish unga hasad qilgan odamni kechirganidek. Va bu qanday edi? dedi u.

en: I answered as follows:
uz: Men quyidagicha javob berdim:

en: But with these words Scheherazade ceased, and turning to the sultan, said sadly: “Sire, I perceive that the day has surprised us before I have related the whole story of the Calenders and the Ladies of Bagdad.
uz: Ammo bu so'zlar bilan Sheherazad to'xtadi va sultonga murojaat qilib, qayg'uli tarzda dedi: Janobi Oliylari, Bag'dod Kalendarlari va Xonimlarining butun hikoyasini aytib berishdan oldin, kun bizni hayratga solganini anglayman.

en: If you could once more postpone the date of my execution, I can to- morrow morning continue the relation, which grows ever more surprising.” To this the sultan made no objection.
uz: Agar meni qatl qilish sanasini yana bir bor kechiktirsangiz, ertaga ertalab munosabatni davom ettirishim mumkin, bu esa tobora hayratlanarli bo'lib bormoqda. Bunga sulton hech qanday e'tiroz bildirmadi.

en: The grand vizier, waiting in terror for the fatal command, was once again made happy by hearing that his beloved daughter was to live for yet another day.
uz: Buyuk vazir, halokatli buyruqni dahshat bilan kutgan holda, suyukli qizi yana bir kun yashashi kerakligini eshitib yana xursand bo'ldi.

en: The next morning, an hour before day, Scheherazade, not waiting for her slave to speak to her, began where she had previously left off.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, bir soat oldin, Sheherazade qulining unga gapirishini kutmay, avval to'xtatgan joyida boshladi.

en: The History of the Envious Man and of Him Who Was Envied In a certain town there were two men who lived next door to each other.
uz: Hasadgo'y va Hasadgo'yning tarixi. Bir shaharda bir-biriga qo'shni yashovchi ikki kishi bor edi.

en: One of them was so excessively envious of the other that the latter resolved to change his abode.
uz: Ularning biri ikkinchisiga shunchalik hasad qildi, hatto ikkinchisi ham o'z maskanini o'zgartirishga qaror qildi.

en: He therefore sold his house, and
uz: Shuning uchun u uyini sotdi va

en: went to another city at no great distance, and bought a convenient house.
uz: Uzoq masofada bo'lmagan boshqa shaharga bordi va qulay uy sotib oldi.

en: It had a good garden and a moderate court, in which there was a deep well, that was not now used.
uz: U yerda yaxshi bog' va o'rtacha hovli bor edi, unda endi ishlatilmayotgan chuqur quduq bor edi.

en: The good man having made this purchase, put on the habit of a dervish, and in a short time he established a numerous society of dervishes.
uz: Yaxshi odam bu xaridni amalga oshirdi, dervish odatini kiydirdi va qisqa vaqt ichida ko'plab dervishlar jamiyatini tashkil etdi.

en: He soon came to be known by his virtues through which he acquired the esteem of many and was much honored and courted by all ranks.
uz: U tez orada o'zining fazilatlari bilan tanildi, shu orqali ko'pchilikning hurmatini qozondi va barcha darajadagilar tomonidan juda hurmatga sazovor bo'ldi.

en: People came from afar to recommend themselves to his prayers; and all who visited him, spoke in praise of the blessings they received through his means.
uz: Uzoqdan odamlar uning ibodatlariga tavsiya qilish uchun kelishdi; va unga tashrif buyurganlarning barchasi uning orqali olgan barakalari haqida maqtashdi.

en: The reputation of this honest man having spread to the town from whence he had come, it touched the envious man so much to the quick, that he left his own house and affairs with a resolution to ruin him.
uz: Bu halol odamning obro'si o'zi kelgan shaharga tarqalganidan so'ng, hasadgo'y odamni shunchalik ta'sirlantirdi-ki, u uni yo'q qilishga qaror qilib, o'z uyini va ishlarini tashlab ketdi.

en: With this intent he went to the new convent of dervishes, of which his former neighbor was the head, who received him with all imaginable tokens of friendship.
uz: Shu niyat bilan u yangi dervishlar monastiriga bordi, uning boshlig'i sobiq qo'shnisi edi va u uni do'stlikning barcha tasavvurga sig'adigan belgilari bilan kutib oldi.

en: The envious man told him that he was come to communicate a business of importance, which he could not do but in private; “and that nobody may hear us,” he said, “let us take a walk in your court; and seeing night begins to draw on, command your dervishes to retire to their cells.” The chief of the dervishes did as he was requested.
uz: Hasadgo'y odam unga muhim bir ishni yetkazish uchun kelganini, buni faqatgina shaxsiyda qila olmasligini aytdi;  va hech kim bizni eshitmasligi uchun,  dedi u,  keling, sizning hovlingizda sayr qilaylik; va tun yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib, darveshlaringizni o'z xonalariga qaytishga buyuring. Darveshlar boshlig'i so'ralganidek qildi.

en: When the envious man saw that he was alone with the good man, he began to tell him a pretended errand, walking side by side in the court, till he saw his opportunity; and getting the good man near the brink of the well, he gave him a thrust, and pushed him into it.
uz: Hasadgo'y odam yaxshi odam bilan yolg'iz ekanligini ko'rgach, unga soxta topshiriq aytib bera boshladi, hovlida yonma-yon yurib, imkoniyatni ko'rmaguncha; yaxshi odamni quduq qirg'og'iga olib kelib, unga bir tayanch berdi va unga itarib kirdi.

en: Now the old well was inhabited by peris and genii, which happened luckily for the head of the convent; for they received and supported him, and carried him to the bottom, so that he got no hurt.
uz: Endi eski quduqda parilar va daholar yashardi, bu esa monastir boshlig'i uchun omadli bo'ldi; chunki ular uni qabul qilishdi va qo'llab-quvvatlashdi, uni tubga olib ketishdi, shunda unga zarar yetmadi.

en: He perceived that there was something extraordinary in his fall, which must otherwise have cost him his life; but he neither saw nor felt anything.
uz: U o'z qutida g'ayrioddiy narsa borligini angladi, aks holda bu uning hayotiga zarar yetkazgan bo'lishi kerak edi; lekin u hech narsani ko'rmadi ham, his qilmadi ham.

en: He presently heard a voice, however, which said, “Do you know what honest man this is, to whom we have done this piece of service?” Another voice answered, “No.” To which the first replied, “Then I will tell you.
uz: U darhol bir ovozni eshitdi: Bu qanday halol odam ekanligini bilasizmi, biz unga bu xizmatni qildikmi? Boshqa bir ovoz javob berdi: Yo'q. Birinchi ovoz javob berdi: Keyin sizga aytaman.

en: This man, out of charity, left the town he lived
uz: Bu odam xayriya tufayli yashayotgan shahrini tark etdi.

en: in, and established himself in this place, in hopes to cure one of his neighbors of the envy he had They Supported Him and Carried Him to the Bottom conceived against him; he acquired such a general esteem, that the envious man, not able to endure it, came hither on purpose to kill him; and he would have accomplished this design, had it not been for the assistance we have given this honest man, whose reputation is so great that the sultan, who keeps his residence in the neighboring city, was to pay him a visit to-morrow, to recommend the princess his daughter to his prayers.” Another voice asked, “What need had the princess of the dervish’s prayers?” To which the first answered, “She is possessed by a genie.
uz: U yerga kirib, o'zini shu joyga joylashtirdi, qo'shnilaridan birining hasadidan shifo topishga umid qildi. Ular uni qo'llab-quvvatladilar va unga qarshi o'ylab topilgan quyi qavatga olib ketishdi; u shunday umumiy hurmatga ega bo'ldiki, hasadgo'y odam uni o'ldirish uchun bu yerga qasddan keldi; va u bu niyatni amalga oshirgan bo'lardi, agar biz bu halol odamga bergan yordamimiz bo'lmaganida, uning obro'si shunchalik katta ediki, qo'shni shaharda o'z qarorgohini saqlab turgan sulton ertaga unga tashrif buyurdi, malikaga qizini duolariga tavsiya qildi.

en: But I know how this good dervish may cure her.
uz: Lekin men bu yaxshi dervish uni qanday davolashi mumkinligini bilaman.

en: He has a black cat in his convent, with a white spot at the end of her tail, about the bigness of a small piece of Arabian money; let him only pull seven hairs out of the white spot, burn them, and smoke the princess’s head with the fumes, and she will not only be immediately cured, but be so safely delivered from the genie, that he will never dare to approach her again.”
uz: Uning monastirida qora mushuk bor, dumining oxirida oq dog' bor, u Arab pulining kichik bir bo'lagi kabi kichkina bo'lsa ham; faqat oq dog'dan yetti soch olib, yoqib yuborib, malika boshini tutun bilan tutatsin, shunda u nafaqat darhol tuzalib ketadi, balki jinlardan shunchalik xavfsiz qutuladi, hech qachon unga yaqinlashishga jur'at eta olmaydi.

en: The head of the dervishes remembered every word of the conversation between the fairies and the genii, who remained silent the remainder of the night.
uz: Darveshlar boshlig'i parilar va jinlar o'rtasidagi suhbatning har bir so'zini esladi, ular tunning qolgan qismini jim o'tkazdilar.

en: The next morning, as soon as daylight appeared, the well being broken down in several places, he saw a hole, by which he crept out with ease.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, kunduzgi yorug'lik paydo bo'lishi bilanoq, quduq bir necha joyda singan edi, u teshikni ko'rdi va undan bemalol chiqib ketdi.

en: The other dervishes, who had been seeking for him, were rejoiced to see him; he gave them a brief account of the wickedness of the man to whom he had given so kind a reception the day before, and retired into his cell.
uz: Uni qidirayotgan boshqa darveshlar uni ko'rib xursand bo'lishdi; u ularga o'tgan kuni shunday mehmondo'stlik bilan kutib olgan odamning yovuzligi haqida qisqacha ma'lumot berdi va o'z qamoqxonasiga chekindi.

en: Shortly after, the black cat, which the fairies and genii had mentioned, came to fawn upon her master, as she was accustomed to do; he took her up, and pulled seven hairs from the white spot that was upon her tail, and laid them aside for his use when occasion should serve.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, parilar va jinlar tilga olgan qora mushuk, odatdagidek, xo'jayiniga yoqib keldi; u uni olib, dumidagi oq dog'dan yetti tukni tortib oldi va vaqti kelganda foydalanishi uchun chetga qo'ydi.

en: Soon after sunrise, the sultan, who would leave no means untried that might restore the princess to health, arrived at the gate of the convent.
uz: Quyosh chiqishi bilanoq, malika sog'lig'ini tiklash uchun hech qanday usul qoldirmaydigan sulton monastir darvozasiga yetib keldi.

en: He commanded his guards to halt, while he with his principal officers went in.
uz: U o'z qo'riqchilariga to'xtashni buyurdi, u esa bosh ofitserlari bilan ichkariga kirdi.

en: The dervishes received him with profound respect.
uz: Darveshlar uni chuqur hurmat bilan kutib olishdi.

en: The sultan called their chief aside, and said, “Good Sheik, you may know the cause of my visit.” “Yes, Sire,” he answered gravely, “if I do not mistake, it is the disease of the princess which procures me this unmerited honor.” “That is the case,” replied the sultan.
uz: Sulton ularning boshliqini chetga chaqirib, dedi: Yaxshi Shayx, mening tashrifim sababini bilishingiz mumkin. Ha, hazrat, dedi u jiddiy javob berib, agar men adashmasam, bu menga bu munosib bo'lmagan sharafni olib keladigan malika kasalligi. Ha, dedi sulton.

en: “You will give me new life if your prayers restore my daughter’s health.” “Sire,” said the good man, “if your majesty will be pleased to let her come hither, I am in hopes, through God’s assistance and favor, that she will be effectually cured.” The prince sent immediately for his daughter, who soon appeared with a numerous train of ladies and attendants, veiled, so that her face was not seen.
uz: Siz menga yangi hayot berasiz, agar duolaringiz qizimning sogligini tiklasa. Janobi Oliylari,  dedi yaxshi odam, agar oliyjanobingiz uni bu yerga kelishga rozi bolsa, men Xudoning yordami va marhamati bilan u samarali davolanishiga umid qilaman. Shahzoda darhol qizi uchun xabar yubordi, u tez orada koplab ayollar va xizmatchilar bilan paydo boldi, yuzi korinmasligi uchun niqob bilan.

en: The chief of the dervishes placed a lighted brazier before the princess and caused a carpet to be held over her head, and he had no sooner thrown the seven hairs upon the burning coals, than the genie uttered a great cry and, without being seen, left the princess at liberty; upon which she took the veil from her face, and rose up to see where she was, saying, “Where am I,
uz: Darveshlar boshlig'i malika oldiga yoritilgan brzelni qo'ydi va uning boshiga gilam qo'ydi. U yetti tukni yonayotgan ko'mirga tashlaganidan ko'p o'tmay, jin katta faryod chiqardi va ko'rinmasdan malika ozod bo'lib ketdi; unga ko'ra u yuzidan parda olib, qayerda ekanligini ko'rish uchun turdi va dedi: Men qayerdaman?

en: and who brought me hither?” At these words, the sultan, overcome with excess of joy, embraced his daughter and kissed her eyes; he also kissed the sheik’s hands, and said to his officers, “What reward does he deserve that has thus cured my daughter?” They all cried, “He deserves her in marriage.” “That is what I had in my thoughts,” said the sultan; “and I make him my son-in-law from this moment.” Some time after, the grand vizier died, and the sultan conferred the place on the dervish.
uz: va meni bu yerga kim olib keldi? Shu so'zlardan so'ng, sulton haddan tashqari xursand bo'lib, qizini quchoqladi va uning ko'zlarini o'pdi; u shayxning qo'llarini ham o'pdi va ofitserlariga dedi: Qizimni shunday davolagani uchun unga qanday mukofot kerak? Ular barchasi baqirishdi: U unga turmushga chiqishga loyiq. Men shunday o'ylagandim,  dedi sulton;  va men uni shu lahzadan boshlab kuyovimga aylantirdim. Bir necha vaqt o'tgach, buyuk vazir vafot etdi va sulton darveshga joy berdi.

en: The sultan himself also died without male heirs; upon which the religious orders and the army consulted together, and the good man was acknowledged sultan by general consent.
uz: Sultonning o'zi ham erkak vorislarsiz vafot etdi; bunga ko'ra diniy amrlar va armiya birgalikda maslahatlashdi va yaxshi odam umumiy rozilik bilan sultan deb tan olindi.

en: As the new sultan was one day in the midst of his courtiers on a march, he espied the envious man among the crowd that stood as he passed along; and calling one of the viziers that attended him, whispered in his ear, “Go bring me that man you see there; but take care you do not frighten him.” The vizier obeyed, and when the envious man was brought into his presence, the sultan said, “Friend, I am extremely glad to see you.” Upon which he called an officer.
uz: Yangi sulton bir kuni o'z saroy a'zolari orasida yurish paytida bo'lganida, u o'tib ketayotgan olomon orasida turgan hasadgo'yni kuzatdi; va unga xizmat qilayotgan vazirlardan birini chaqirib, qulog'iga pichirladi: Boring, o'sha odamni olib keling; lekin uni qo'rqitmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling. Vazir itoat qildi va haddan tashqari hasadgo'y odam uning huzuriga olib kelinganida, sulton dedi: Do'stim, men seni ko'rganimdan xursandman. Shunda u bir ofitserni chaqirdi.

en: “Go immediately,” said he, “and cause to be paid to this man out of my treasury, one hundred pieces of gold; let him have also twenty loads of the richest merchandise in my storehouses, and a sufficient guard to conduct him to his house.” After he had given this charge to the officer he bade the envious man farewell, and proceeded on his way.
uz: Tezroq bor, dedi u, va bu odamga mening xazinamdan yuz tilla to'lang; uning omborlarimda eng boy tovarlarning yigirma yuklari ham bo'lsin, va uni o'z uyiga olib boradigan yetarli qo'riqchi bo'lsin. U bu topshiriqni ofitserga berganidan so'ng, hasadgo'y bilan xayrlashdi va yo'lga chiqdi.

en: When I had finished the recital of this story to the genie, I employed all my eloquence to persuade him to imitate so good an example, and to grant me pardon; but it was impossible to move his compassion.
uz: Bu hikoyani jinlarga aytib bo'lgandan so'ng, men uni shunday yaxshi namunaga taqlid qilishga va menga kechirim berishga ko'ndirish uchun bor notiqligimni sarfladim; lekin uning rahm-shafqatini siljitishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: “All that I can do for thee,” said he, “is to grant thee thy life, but I must place thee under enchantments.” So saying, he seized me violently, and carried me through the arched roof of the subterraneous palace, which opened to give him passage.
uz: Sening uchun qo'limdan kelgani shuki, senga jon beraman, lekin seni sehrlar ostiga qo'yishim kerak, dedi u. Shunday qilib, u meni zo'ravonlik bilan ushladi va yer osti saroyining archli tomidan olib o'tdi, u unga yo'l berish uchun ochildi.

en: He ascended with me into the air to such a height, that the earth
uz: U men bilan havoda shunday balandlikka ko'tarildi, yer...

en: appeared like a little white cloud.
uz: Ozgina oq bulutga o'xshab ko'rindi.

en: He then descended again like lightning, and alighted upon the summit of a mountain.
uz: Keyin u yana chaqmoq kabi pastga tushdi va tog' cho'qqisiga tushdi.

en: Here he took up a handful of earth, and, muttering some words which I did not understand, threw it upon me.
uz: U yerda u bir hovuch tuproqni oldi va men tushunmagan ba'zi so'zlarni shivirlab, menga uloqtirdi.

en: “Quit,” said he, “the form of a man and take that of an ape.” He instantly disappeared, and left me alone, transformed into an ape, in a strange country, not knowing whether I was near or far from my father’s dominions.
uz: Qo'ying,  dedi u,  odam qiyofasini oling va maymun qiyofasini oling.  U darhol g'oyib bo'ldi va meni yolg'iz qoldirdi, begona mamlakatda maymunga aylandi, otam hukmronligidan yaqin yoki uzoqda ekanligimni bilmas edi.

en: I descended the mountain, and entered a level country, which took me a month to travel over, and then I came to the sea.
uz: Men tog'dan tushdim va tekis bir mamlakatga kirdim, uni bosib o'tishga bir oy ketdi, keyin dengizga keldim.

en: It happened at the time to be perfectly calm, and I espied a vessel about a half league from the shore.
uz: O'sha paytda butunlay xotirjam bo'lib qoldi va men qirg'oqdan taxminan yarim ligada joylashgan kemani kuzatdim.

en: Unwilling to lose so good an opportunity, I broke off a large branch from a tree, carried it into the sea, and got astride upon it, with a stick in each hand, to serve me for oars.
uz: Shunday yaxshi imkoniyatni boy berishni istamasdan, bir daraxtdan katta shox uzdim, uni dengizga olib kirdim va ustiga minib, har bir qo'lida tayoq bilan menga eshkaklar uchun xizmat qildim.

en: I launched out on this frail bark, and rowed toward the ship.
uz: Men bu mo'rt po'stlog'ida uchib chiqdim va kema tomon eshkak eshdim.

en: When I had approached sufficiently near to be seen, the seamen and passengers on the deck regarded me with astonishment.
uz: Men ko'rinadigan darajada yaqinlashganimda, kemadagi dengizchilar va yo'lovchilar menga hayrat bilan qarashdi.

en: In the mean time I got on board, and laying hold of a rope, jumped upon the deck, but having lost my speech, I found myself in great perplexity; and indeed the risk I ran was not less than when I was at the mercy of the genie.
uz: Ayni paytda men bortga chiqdim va arqonni ushlab, palubaga sakradim, lekin nutqimni yo'qotib, o'zimni juda chalkashib qoldim; va haqiqatan ham, men qo'ygan xavf, jinlarning rahm-shafqati ostida bo'lganimdan kam emas edi.

en: The merchants, being superstitious, thought if they received me on board I might be the occasion of some misfortune to them during their voyage.
uz: Savdogarlar xurofotparast bo'lib, meni bortga qabul qilsalar, men ularning sayohatlari davomida ularga biror baxtsizlik keltirib chiqarishi mumkin deb o'ylashdi.

en: On this account they said, “Let us throw him into the sea.” Some one of them would not have failed to carry this threat into execution, had I not gone to the captain, thrown myself at his feet, and taken hold of his robe in a supplicating posture.
uz: Shuning uchun ular: Uni dengizga tashlaymiz, deyishdi. Ularning bir nechtasi bu tahdidni amalga oshirishdan to'xtamasdi, agar men kapitan oldiga borib, uning oyoqlariga tashlanmaganimda va uning ko'ylagini iltijo bilan ushlab turganimda edi.

en: This action together with the tears which he saw gush from my eyes, moved his compassion.
uz: Bu harakat, uning ko'zlarimdan chiqqan ko'z yoshlari bilan birga, uning rahm-shafqatini uyg'otdi.

en: He took me under his protection, and loaded me with a thousand caresses.
uz: U meni o'z himoyasiga oldi va mingta erkalash bilan yukladi.

en: On my part, though I had not power to speak, I showed by my gestures every mark of gratitude in my power.
uz: O'z navbatimda, gapirishga kuchim bo'lmasa-da, o'z qo'limdagi har bir minnatdorchilik belgisini imo-ishoralarim bilan ko'rsatdim.

en: The wind that succeeded the calm continued to blow in the same direction for fifty days, and brought us safe to the port of a city, well
uz: Tinchlikka erishgan shamol ellik kun davomida bir xil yo'nalishda esishda davom etdi va bizni bir shahar portiga xavfsiz olib keldi, xo'sh.

en: peopled, and of great trade, where we cast anchor.
uz: Aholi ko'p va savdo-sotiq juda ko'p, u yerda langar tashlaymiz.

en: Our vessel was instantly surrounded with multitudes of boats full of people.
uz: Bizning kemamiz darhol odamlar bilan to'la ko'plab qayiqlar bilan o'raldi.

en: Among the rest, some officers of the sultan came on board, and said, “Our master rejoices in your safe arrival, and he beseeches each of you to write a few lines upon this roll.
uz: Qolganlarning orasida sultonning ba'zi ofitserlari bortga kelib, dedilar: Ustozimiz sizning xavfsiz yetib kelganingizdan xursand va u har biringizdan bu rulonga bir necha qator yozishni so'raydi.

en: The grand vizier, who, besides possessing great abilities for the management of public affairs, could write in the highest perfection, died a few days since, and the sultan has made a solemn vow not to give the place to anyone who cannot write equally well.
uz: Bosh vazir, davlat ishlarini boshqarish uchun katta qobiliyatga ega bo'lishidan tashqari, eng yuqori mukammallikda yozishi mumkin bo'lgan, bir necha kundan keyin vafot etdi va sulton bu joyni teng yaxshi yozmaydiganlarga bermaslikka tantanali qasam ichdi.

en: No one in the empire has been judged worthy to supply the vizier’s place.” Those of the merchants who thought they could write well enough to aspire to this high dignity wrote one after another what they thought fit.
uz: Imperiyadagi hech kim vazirning o'rnini ta'minlashga loyiq deb topilmadi. Bu yuqori qadr-qimmatga intilish uchun yetarlicha yaxshi yozish mumkin deb o'ylagan savdogarlar birin-ketin o'zlari mos deb hisoblagan narsalarni yozishdi.

en: After they had done, I advanced and took the roll, but all the people cried out that I would tear it or throw it into the sea, till they saw how properly I held the roll, and made a sign that I would write in my turn.
uz: Ular tugatgandan so'ng, men oldinga chiqib, rulonni oldim, lekin barcha odamlar uni yirtib tashlashimni yoki dengizga uloqtirishimni baqirishdi, toki ular rulonni qanday to'g'ri ushlab turganimni ko'rmaguncha va men o'z navbatimda yozadigan belgi yasashdi.

en: Their apprehensions then changed into wonder.
uz: Ularning xavotirlari keyin hayratga aylandi.

en: However, as they had never seen an ape that could write, and could not be persuaded that I was cleverer than others of my kind, they wished to take the roll out of my hand; but the captain took my part once more.
uz: Ammo, ular hech qachon yoza oladigan maymunni ko'rmaganlari va men o'zimga o'xshash boshqalardan ko'ra aqlliroq ekanligimga ishontira olmaganlari sababli, ular qo'limdan rolni olishni xohlashdi; lekin kapitan yana bir bor mening qismimni oldi.

en: “Let him alone,” said he; “allow him to write.” I then took the pen, and wrote six sorts of hands used among the Arabians, each specimen containing an extemporary quatrain in praise of the sultan.
uz: Uni qoyib yuboring,  dedi u;  yozishga ruxsat bering. Keyin qalamni oldim va arablar orasida ishlatiladigan oltita qolni yozdim, har bir namuna sultonni maqtash uchun zamonaviy tortlikni oz ichiga olgan edi.

en: When I had done, the officers took the roll, and carried it to the sultan.
uz: Men tugatganimdan so'ng, ofitserlar rolikni olib, sultonga olib borishdi.

en: The sultan took little notice of any of the writings except mine, which pleased him so much that he said to the officers, “Take the finest horse in my stable, with the richest trappings, and a robe of the most sumptuous brocade to put on the person who wrote the six hands, and bring him hither.” At this command the officers could not forbear laughing.
uz: Sulton mening yozuvlarimdan boshqa hech kimga e'tibor bermadi, bu unga shunchalik yoqqan ediki, u ofitserlarga dedi: Mening otxonamdagi eng yaxshi otni, eng boy tuzoqlarni va eng hashamatli brokat libosini olti qo'l yozgan odamga kiydirib, uni bu yerga olib keling. Bu buyruqda ofitserlar kulishdan tiyilmadilar.

en: The sultan was incensed at their rudeness, and would have punished them, had they not explained.
uz: Sulton ularning qo'polligidan g'azablangan edi va ular tushuntirmasa, ularni jazolagan bo'lardi.

en: “Sire,” said they, “we humbly beg your majesty’s pardon.
uz: Janob,  deyishdi ular,  biz sizdan oliyjanobligingizni kechirim so'raymiz.

en: These hands were not written by a man, but by an ape.” “What do you say?” exclaimed the sultan.
uz: Bu qo'llar inson tomonidan yozilmagan, balki maymun tomonidan yozilgan. Nima deysiz? deb baqirdi sulton.

en: “Those admirable characters, are they not written by a man?”
uz: O'sha hayratlanarli qahramonlar, ularni bir inson yozmaganmi?

en: “No, Sire,” replied the officers; “we assure your majesty that it was an ape, who wrote them in our presence.” The sultan was too much surprised not to desire a sight of me, and therefore said, “Do what I command you, and bring me speedily that wonderful ape.” The officers returned to the vessel, and showed the captain their order, who answered, “The sultan’s command must be obeyed.” Whereupon they clothed me with the rich brocade robe, and carried me ashore, where they set me on horseback, while the sultan waited for me at his palace with a great number of courtiers.
uz: Yoq, hazratim,  javob berdi ofitserlar; Sizning oliyjanobligingizga ishonchimiz komilki, bu maymun edi, u ularni bizning huzurimizda yozgan edi. Sulton meni korishni xohlamasdan juda hayron boldi va shuning uchun dedi: Sizga buyurganimni qiling va menga tezda osha ajoyib maymunni olib keling. Ofitserlar kemaga qaytib kelishdi va kapitanga oz buyrugini korsatdilar, u javob berdi: Sultonning buyrugiga itoat qilish kerak. Keyin ular meni boy koylak bilan kiydirishdi va meni qirgoqqa olib ketishdi, u yerda meni otda ornatishdi, shu paytda sultan esa ozining saroyida koplab saroylari bilan meni kutib turardi.

en: The procession commenced; the harbor, the streets, the public places, windows, terraces, palaces, and houses were filled with an infinite number of people of all ranks, who flocked from every part of the city to see me; for the rumor was spread in a moment that the sultan had chosen an ape to be his grand vizier; and after having served as a spectacle to the people, who could not forbear to express their surprise by shouts, I arrived at the sultan’s palace.
uz: Marosim boshlandi; port, ko'chalar, jamoat joylari, derazalar, ayvonlar, saroylar va uylar shaharning har bir qismidan meni ko'rish uchun oqib kelgan cheksiz sonli odamlar bilan to'ldi; chunki sultan o'zining buyuk vaziri sifatida maymun tanlaganligi haqidagi mish-mish bir zumda tarqaldi; va hayratlarini baqirishdan to'xtamaydigan xalqqa tomosha bo'lgach, men sultan saroyiga yetib keldim.

en: I found the prince on his throne in the midst of the grandees; I made my obeisance three times very low, and at last kneeled and kissed the ground before him, and afterward took my seat in the posture of an ape.
uz: Men shahzodani shohlarning o'rtasida o'z taxtida topdim; men sajdaimni uch marta juda pastga tushirdim va nihoyat uning oldida tizzalab, yerga o'pdim va keyin maymun qiyofasida o'tirdim.

en: The whole assembly viewed me with admiration, and could not comprehend how it was possible that an ape should so well understand how to pay the sultan his due respect; and he himself was more astonished than any.
uz: Butun yig'ilish menga hayrat bilan qaradi va maymun qanday qilib sultonga o'z hurmatini qanday ko'rsatishni shunchalik yaxshi tushunishi mumkinligini tushunmadi; va u o'zi hammadan ham hayratda edi.

en: The sultan dismissed his courtiers, and went from his chamber of audience into his own apartment, where he ordered dinner to be brought.
uz: Sulton o'z saroy a'zolarini haydab yubordi va majlis xonasidan o'z xonadoniga bordi, u yerda kechki ovqatni olib kelishni buyurdi.

en: As he sat at table, he made me a sign to approach and eat with him; to show my obedience, I kissed the ground, arose, placed myself at the table, and ate.
uz: U dasturxonda o'tirganida, u menga yaqinlashib, u bilan birga ovqatlanish uchun ishora qildi; itoatimni ko'rsatish uchun men yerga o'pdim, o'rnidan turdim, stolga o'tirdim va yedim.

en: Before the table was cleared, I espied a fruit stand which I made a sign to have brought me; having got it, I wrote upon a large peach some verses expressive of my acknowledgment to the sultan; who, having read them, after I had presented the peach to him, was still more astonished.
uz: Stol ochilishidan oldin, men mevalar stendini kuzatdim, uni olib kelganim uchun belgi qildim; olganimdan so'ng, katta shaftolaga sultonga minnatdorligimni ifodalovchi ba'zi misralarni yozdim; u ularni o'qib, shaftopni unga taqdim etganimdan keyin, yanada hayratda qoldi.

en: When the table was cleared they brought him a
uz: Stol tozalangandan so'ng, unga olib kelishdi.

en: particular wine of which he caused them to give me a glass.
uz: aynan shu vinoni menga bir stakan berishlariga majbur qildi.

en: I drank, and wrote upon the glass some new verses, which explained the state of happiness I was now in, after many sufferings.
uz: Men ichdim va shisha ustiga ko'p azoblardan so'ng hozirda qanday baxtda ekanligimni tushuntiruvchi yangi misralar yozdim.

en: The sultan read these likewise, and said, “A man capable of composing such poetry would rank among the greatest.” The sultan commanded the attendants to bring him a chess- board, and asked me by a sign if I understood that game, and would play with him.
uz: Sulton bularni ham o'qidi va dedi: Bunday she'r yozishga qodir odam eng buyuklar qatorida turadi. Sulton xizmatchilarga unga shaxmat taxtasini olib kelishni buyurdi va mendan o'sha o'yinni tushunishimni va u bilan o'ynashimni belgilab so'radi.

en: I kissed the ground; and laying my hand upon my head, signified that I was ready to play.
uz: Men yerga o'pdim; va qo'limni boshimga qo'yib, o'ynashga tayyor ekanligimni bildirdim.

en: He won the first game; but I won the second and third.
uz: U birinchi o'yinda g'alaba qozondi; lekin men ikkinchi va uchinchi o'yinlarda g'alaba qozondim.

en: So many circumstances appearing to the sultan beyond what had ever either been seen or known of apes, he determined not to be the only witness of these prodigies himself, but having a daughter, called the Lady of Beauty, sent for her, that she should share his pleasure.
uz: Sultonga maymunlar haqida hech qachon ko'rmagan yoki bilmagan ko'p holatlar ko'rindi, shuning uchun u bu mo'jizalarga o'zi shohid bo'lishga qaror qilmadi, balki go'zallik xonimi deb nomlangan qizi bor edi, u uning zavqini baham ko'rishi uchun uni chaqirdi.

en: The princess, who had her face unveiled, no sooner came into the room than she put on her veil, and said to the sultan, “Sire, I am surprised that you have sent for me to appear before a man.
uz: Malika, yuzi ochilgan holda, xonaga tezroq kirib, parda kiydirib, sultonga dedi: Janobi Oliylari, meni bir odamning oldiga chaqirib yuborganingizdan hayronman.

en: That seeming ape is a young prince, son of a powerful sultan, and has been metamorphosed into an ape by enchantment.
uz: O'sha go'yo maymun yosh shahzoda, qudratli sultonning o'g'li va sehr bilan maymunga aylantirilgan.

en: When I was just out of the nursery, an old lady who waited on me was a most expert magician, and taught me seventy rules of magic.
uz: Men endigina bolalar xonasidan chiqqanimda, meni kutib turgan bir kampir juda tajribali sehrgar edi va menga yetmishta sehr qoidasini o'rgatardi.
