en: By this science I know all enchanted persons at first sight: I know who they are, and by whom they have been enchanted; therefore do not be surprised if I should forthwith restore this prince, in spite of the enchantments, to his own form.” “Do so, then,” interrupted the sultan, “for you cannot give me greater pleasure, as I wish to have him for my grand vizier, and bestow you upon him for a wife.” “I am ready.
uz: Shu fan orqali men bir qarashda barcha sehrlangan odamlarni bilaman: ularning kimligini va kim tomonidan sehrlanganini bilaman; shuning uchun, agar men darhol bu shahzodani sehrlarga qaramay, o'z shakliga qaytarsam, ajablanmang. Shunday qilsangiz, dedi sulton, chunki siz menga undan katta zavq bera olmaysiz, chunki men uni o'z vazirimga olishni va sizga xotinlik qilishingizni xohlayman. Men tayyorman.

en: Sire,” answered the princess, “to obey you in all things you please to command.” The princess, the Lady of Beauty, went into her apartment, and brought thence a knife, which had some Hebrew words engraven on the blade: she made the sultan, a little slave, and myself, descend into a private court of the palace, and there left us under a gallery
uz: Janob,  javob berdi malika,  sizga buyurgan hamma narsada itoat etish uchun. Malika, Go'zallik xonimi, o'z xonadoniga kirdi va u yerdan pichoqqa ibroniycha so'zlar o'yilgan pichoq olib keldi: u sultonni, kichkina qulni va o'zimni saroyning shaxsiy hovlisiga tushirdi va u yerda bizni tashlab ketdi.

en: She placed herself in the middle of the court, where she made a great circle, and within it she wrote several words in ancient Arabian characters.
uz: U o'zini hovlining o'rtasiga joylashtirdi, u yerda katta doira yaratdi va uning ichida qadimgi arab harflarida bir nechta so'z yozdi.

en: When she had finished, she placed herself in the center of the circle, where she began incantations, and repeated verses of the Koran.
uz: U tugatgach, o'zini doiraning markaziga joylashtirdi, u yerda sehrlashni boshladi va Qur'on oyatlarini takrorladi.

en: The air grew dark, as if it had been night; we found ourselves struck with consternation, and our fear increased when we saw the genie appear suddenly in the shape of a lion of gigantic size.
uz: Havo qorong'ilashdi, go'yo tun bo'lgandek; biz dahshatga tushdik va jinning to'satdan ulkan o'lchamdagi sher shaklida paydo bo'lishini ko'rganimizda qo'rquvimiz kuchaydi.

en: “Thou shalt pay dearly,” said the lion, “for the trouble thou hast given me in coming here.” In saying this, he opened his horrible jaws, and advanced forward to devour her; but she, being on her guard, jumped back, and had just time to pluck out a hair; and pronouncing two or three words, she changed it into a sharp scythe, with which she immediately cut the lion in two pieces, through the middle.
uz: Siz qimmat to'laysiz, dedi arslon, bu yerga kelishim uchun menga bergan tashvish uchun. Shunday deb, u dahshatli jag'larini ochdi va uni yutish uchun oldinga bordi; lekin u ehtiyot bo'lib, orqaga sakradi va bir tukni yechishga ulgurdi; va ikki-uch so'z aytib, uni o'tkir pichoqqa aylantirdi, u bilan darhol arslonni ikki bo'lakka, o'rtadan kesib tashladi.

en: The two parts of the lion disappeared, and in their place we saw a large scorpion.
uz: Arslonning ikki qismi g'oyib bo'ldi va ularning o'rnida katta bir chayonni ko'rdik.

en: The princess then took the form of a serpent, and fought the scorpion, which, finding itself defeated, changed into an eagle, and flew away.
uz: Malika shundan so'ng ilon shaklini oldi va o'zini mag'lub etgan holda burgutga aylangan va uchib ketgan chayon bilan kurashdi.

en: But the serpent then became another eagle, black, and very large, and went in pursuit of it.
uz: Ammo ilon keyin yana bir burgutga aylandi, qora va juda katta, va uni ta'qib qildi.

en: We now lost sight of them for some time.
uz: Biz ularni bir muncha vaqtga ko'zdan qochirdik.

en: Shortly after they had disappeared, the earth opened before us, and a black and white cat appeared, the hairs of which stood quite on end, and which made a most horrible mewing.
uz: Ular yo'qolib ketganidan ko'p o'tmay, yer oldimizda ochildi va qora va oq mushuk paydo bo'ldi, uning tuklari butunlay tik turardi va bu juda dahshatli o't ochardi.

en: A black wolf directly followed after her, and gave her no time to rest.
uz: Qora bo'ri uning orqasidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ergashib, unga dam olishga vaqt bermadi.

en: The cat, being thus hard pressed, changed into a worm, and hid itself in a pomegranate which lay by accident on the ground; but the pomegranate swelled immediately, becoming as big as a gourd, which rose to the roof of the gallery, rolled there for some time backward and forward and then fell down again into the court, where it broke into several pieces.
uz: Mushuk, shunday qattiq bosilgan holda, qurtga aylandi va o'zini yerga tasodifan yotgan anorga yashirdi; lekin anor darhol shishib, galereyaning tomiga ko'tarilgan go'ngdek katta bo'lib, u yerda bir oz vaqt orqaga va oldinga ag'darilib, keyin yana hovliga tushdi va u yerda bir necha bo'laklarga bo'linib ketdi.

en: The wolf had in the meanwhile transformed itself into a cock, and now fell to picking up the seeds of the pomegranate one after
uz: Bo'ri shu vaqt ichida xo'rozga aylandi va endi anor urug'larini terishga tushdi.

en: another; but finding no more, he came toward us with his wings spread, making a great noise, as if he would ask us whether there were any more seeds.
uz: boshqa; lekin boshqa hech narsa topmadi, u qanotlarini yoyib, bizga yaqinlashdi va katta shovqin chiqardi, go'yo bizdan yana urug'lar bormi deb so'rayotgandek edi.

en: There was one lying on the brink of the fountain, which the cock perceiving as he went back, ran toward; but just as he was going to pick it up the seed rolled into the water and turned into a little fish.
uz: Favvora qirg'og'ida yotgan biri bor edi, uni xo'roz qaytib ketayotganda sezdi va unga qarab yugurdi; lekin u uni olmoqchi bo'lganida urug' suvga o'ralib, kichkina baliqqa aylandi.

en: The cock flying toward the fountain, turned into a pike, and pursued the small fish; they continued both under water above two hours, and we knew not what was become of them; but suddenly we heard terrible cries, which made us tremble, and a little while after we saw the genie and princess rise from the water in flames.
uz: Xo'roz favvora tomon uchib, cho'riga aylandi va kichkina baliqlarni ta'qib qildi; ular ikkalasi ham suv ostida ikki soatdan ko'proq davom etishdi va biz ularning nima bo'lganini bilmadik; lekin birdaniga dahshatli qichqiriqlarni eshitdik, bu bizni titratdi va birozdan keyin jin va malika olovda suvdan ko'tarilganini ko'rdik.

en: They threw flashes of fire out of their mouths at each other, till they came to close combat; then the two fires increased, with a thick, burning smoke, which mounted so high that we had reason to apprehend it would set the palace on fire.
uz: Ular og'izlaridan bir-biriga olov chaqnatib yuborishdi, to jangni yakunlashga yaqinlashguncha; keyin ikki olov kuchaydi, qalin, yonayotgan tutun bilan, u shunchalik baland ko'tarildi, biz saroyga o't qo'yishini tushunishga asosimiz bor edi.

en: But we very soon had a more pressing occasion of fear, for the genie having got loose from the princess, came to the gallery where we stood, and blew flames of fire upon us.
uz: Ammo tez orada qo'rquvning yanada dolzarb holati paydo bo'ldi, chunki ruh malikaga qo'yib yuborib, biz turgan galereyaga keldi va ustimizga olov alangasini uchirdi.

en: We must have perished had not the princess, running to our assistance, forced him to retire, and defend himself against her; yet, notwithstanding all her exertions, she could not hinder the sultan’s beard from being burned, and his face scorched, nor a spark from entering my right eye, and making it blind.
uz: Agar malika bizga yordamga yugurib, uni iste'foga chiqishga va undan himoyalanishga majbur qilmaganida, halok bo'lardik; ammo, barcha harakatlariga qaramay, u sultonning soqolini kuyib ketishiga, yuzi kuyib ketishiga, o'ng ko'zimga kirishiga va uni ko'r qilishiga to'sqinlik qila olmasdi.

en: The sultan and I looked for nothing but death, when we heard a cry of “Victory, victory!” and instantly the princess appeared in her natural shape; but the genie was reduced to a heap of ashes.
uz: Sulton va men faqat o'limni qidirdik, qachonki G'alaba, g'alaba! degan qichqiriq eshitdik va darhol malika o'zining tabiiy shaklida paydo bo'ldi; lekin jin kulga aylandi.

en: The princess approached us and hastily called for a cupful of water, which the young slave, who had received no hurt, brought her.
uz: Malika bizga yaqinlashdi va shoshilinch ravishda bir piyola suv chaqirdi, uni hech qanday zarar ko'rmagan yosh qul olib keldi.

en: She took it, and after pronouncing some words over it, threw it upon me saying, “If thou art become an ape by enchantment, change thy shape, and take that of a man, which thou hadst before.” These words were hardly uttered, when I again became a man in every respect as I was before my transformation, except for the loss of my eye.
uz: U uni oldi va bir necha so'z aytib bo'lgach, menga uloqtirdi va dedi: Agar sehr bilan maymunga aylanib qolsang, shaklingni o'zgartirib, avvalgidek odamga o'xshating. Bu so'zlar deyarli aytilmadi, qachonki men o'zgarishimdan oldingi har qanday nuqtai nazardan odamga aylandim, faqat ko'zimni yo'qotdim.

en: I wished to express to the princess my thanks, but she prevented me by saying to her father: “Sire, I have gained the victory over the genie; but it is a victory that costs me dear.
uz: Men malikaga minnatdorchiligimni bildirmoqchi edim, lekin u otasiga: Janobi Oliylari, men jin ustidan galaba qozondim; lekin bu menga qimmatga tushadigan galaba.  deb tosdi.

en: I have but a few minutes to live; the fire has pierced me during the terrible combat, and I find it is gradually consuming me.
uz: Mening yashashimga bir necha daqiqa qoldi; dahshatli jang davomida olov meni teshdi va asta-sekin meni yo'q qilib borayotganini anglayman.

en: This would not have happened, had I perceived the last of the pomegranate seeds, and swallowed it, as I did the others when I was changed into a cock; the genie had fled thither as to his last intrenchment, and upon that the success of the combat depended.
uz: Agar men anor urug'larining oxirini sezganimda va uni yutib yuborganimda, xuddi xo'rozga aylanganimda boshqalarni yutib yuborganimda bo'lganidek, bu sodir bo'lmas edi; jin o'zining oxirgi urinishiga qarab u yerga qochib ketgan edi va jangning muvaffaqiyati shunga bog'liq edi.

en: This oversight obliged me to have recourse to fire, and to fight with it as I did, between heaven and earth, in your presence; in spite of all, I made the genie know that I understood more than he; I have conquered and reduced him to ashes, but I cannot escape death, which is approaching.” Suddenly the princess exclaimed, “I burn, I burn!” She found that the fire had at last seized upon her vital parts, which made her still cry, “I burn;” until death had put an end to her intolerable pains.
uz: Bu nazorat meni olovga murojaat qilishga va u bilan jang qilishga majbur qildi, xuddi men kabi, osmon va yer o'rtasida, sening huzuringda; shunga qaramay, men jinni undan ko'ra ko'proq tushunishimni bildirdim; men uni yengdim va kulga aylantirdim, lekin yaqinlashib kelayotgan o'limdan qochib qutula olmayman. To'satdan malika: Men kuyaman, men kuyaman! dedi. U olov nihoyat uning muhim qismlariga o'tib ketganini angladi, bu uni hali ham yig'latdi, Men kuyaman; toki o'lim uning chidab bo'lmas azoblariga chek qo'ymasin.

en: The effect of the fire was so powerful, that in a few moments she too was wholly reduced to ashes.
uz: Olovning ta'siri shunchalik kuchli ediki, bir necha daqiqada u ham butunlay kulga aylandi.

en: I cannot tell you, madam, how much I was grieved at so dismal a spectacle; I had rather all my life have continued an ape or a dog, than to have seen my benefactress thus miserably perish.
uz: Sizga ayta olmayman, xonim, bunday dahshatli tomoshaga qanchalik qayg'urganimni; butun hayotim davomida maymun yoki it bo'lib yurganimni, xayrixohimning shunday achinarli halok bo'lganini ko'rganimdan afzal ko'rgan bo'lardim.

en: The sultan cried piteously, and beat himself on his head and breast, until, being quite overcome with grief, he fainted away.
uz: Sulton achchiqlab qichqirdi va boshini va ko'kragini urdi, toki qayg'udan butunlay o'tib, hushidan ketdi.

en: In the mean time, the attendants and officers came running at the sultan’s lamentations, and with much difficulty brought him to himself.
uz: Shu bilan birga, xizmatchilar va amaldorlar sultonning motamlariga yugurib kelishdi va uni ko'p qiyinchilik bilan o'ziga olib kelishdi.

en: When the knowledge of the death of the princess had spread through the palace and the city, all the people greatly bewailed her loss.
uz: Malika vafot etganligi haqidagi xabar saroy va shahar bo'ylab tarqalgach, barcha odamlar uning yo'qotilishidan qattiq qayg'urishdi.

en: Public mourning was observed for seven days.
uz: Yetti kun davomida ommaviy motam kuzatildi.

en: The ashes of the genie were thrown into the air; but those of the princess were collected into a precious urn, to be preserved; and the urn was deposited in a superb mausoleum constructed for that purpose on the spot where the princess had been consumed.
uz: Jinlarning kullari havoga uloqtirildi; lekin malika kullari qimmatbaho savatga yig'ildi, saqlanishi kerak edi; va savat shu maqsadda qurilgan ajoyib maqbaraga, malika yoqilgan joyga qo'yildi.

en: The grief of the sultan for the loss of his daughter confined him to his chamber for a whole month.
uz: Sultonning qizi yo'qolgani uchun qayg'usi uni butun bir oyga xonasiga qamab qo'ydi.

en: Before he had fully recovered his
uz: U toʻliq tuzalib ketishidan oldin

en: strength, he sent for me and said, “You are the cause of all these misfortunes; depart hence therefore in peace, but without further delay, and take care never to appear again in my dominions on penalty of death.” I was obliged to quit the palace, again an outcast from the world.
uz: kuch, u meni chaqirib yubordi va dedi: Sen bu barcha musibatlarning sababchisisan; shuning uchun bu yerdan tinch ket, lekin kechiktirmasdan, va o'lim jazosi ostida mening hukmdorliklarimda hech qachon ko'rinmaslikka harakat qil. Men saroydan ketishga majbur bo'ldim, yana dunyodan chetlatilgan holda.

en: Before I left the city, I went into a bagnio, where I caused my beard and eyebrows to be shaved, and put on a calender’s robe.
uz: Shaharni tark etishimdan oldin, bagnioga kirdim, u yerda soqol va qoshlarimni qirqib, kalender xalatiga kiydim.

en: I passed through many countries without making myself known; at last I resolved to visit Bagdad, in hopes of meeting with the Commander of the Faithful, to move his compassion by relating to him my unfortunate adventures.
uz: Men o'zimni ko'rsatmasdan ko'p davlatlardan o'tdim; nihoyat Bagdodda bo'lishga qaror qildim, Mo'minlar Qo'mondoni bilan uchrashish, uning rahm-shafqatini u bilan bog'lash orqali mening baxtsiz sarguzashtlarimga hissa qo'shish umidida.

en: I arrived this evening; and the first man I met was this calender, our brother, who spoke before me.
uz: Men bugun kechqurun keldim; va men uchratgan birinchi odam bu kalendar edi, mening akamiz, u mendan oldin gapirdi.

en: You know the remaining part, madam, and the cause of my having the honor to be here.
uz: Qolgan qismini bilasiz, xonim, va bu yerda bo'lish sharafiga muyassar bo'lishimning sababini.

en: When the second calender had concluded his story, Zobeide, to whom he had addressed his speech, said, “It is well; you are at liberty:” but instead of departing he also petitioned the lady to show him the same favor vouchsafed to the first calender, and went and sat down by him.
uz: Ikkinchi kalendar o'z hikoyasini tugatgach, Zobeide, unga murojaat qilib, dedi: Xo'p, ozod bo'ldingiz: lekin ketish o'rniga u xonimdan ham birinchi kalendarga berilgan o'sha marhamatni ko'rsatishni iltimos qildi va u bilan birga o'tirdi.

en: Then the third calender, knowing it was his turn to speak, addressed himself, like the others, to Zobeide, and began his history as follows: Dawn had come as Scheherazade reached the conclusion of the second calender’s story, but the sultan, not waiting for her to ask, remarked that as it was time now for him to arise, they would put off hearing the story of the third calender until the following day, at which time Scheherazade began with these words:
uz: Keyin uchinchi kalendar, gapirish o'z navbatida ekanligini bilgach, boshqalarga o'xshab Zobeidega murojaat qildi va o'z tarixini quyidagicha boshladi: Scheherazade ikkinchi kalendar hikoyasining yakuniga yetganida tong chiqdi, lekin sultan uning so'rashini kutmasdan, uning paydo bo'lish vaqti kelgani sababli, ular uchinchi kalendar hikoyasini keyingi kungacha eshitishni kechiktirishlarini aytdi, shu paytda Scheherazade quyidagi so'zlar bilan boshladi:

en: The History of the Third Calender My story, O honorable lady, differs from those you have already heard.
uz: Uchinchi kalendar tarixi Mening hikoyam, hurmatli xonim, siz allaqachon eshitganlardan farq qiladi.

en: The two princes who have spoken before me have each lost an eye by events beyond their own control; but I lost mine through my own fault.
uz: Mendan oldin gaplashgan ikki shahzoda har biri o'z nazoratidan tashqari voqealar tufayli ko'zlarini yo'qotdi; lekin men o'z aybim bilan o'zimniki yo'qotdim.

en: I am the son of a sultan.
uz: Men bir sultonning o'g'liman.

en: After his death I took possession of his dominions, and continued in the city where he had resided.
uz: Uning vafotidan so'ng men uning hukmronliklarini egalladim va u yashagan shaharda davom etdim.

en: My kingdom is composed of several fine provinces upon the mainland, besides a number of valuable islands.
uz: Mening shohligim materik ustidagi bir nechta nozik viloyatlardan, bir qator qimmatli orollardan tashqari, iborat.

en: My first object was to visit the provinces: I afterward caused my whole fleet to be fitted out, and went to my islands to gain the hearts of my subjects by my presence, and to confirm them in their loyalty.
uz: Mening birinchi maqsadim viloyatlarga tashrif buyurish edi: keyin men butun flotimni jihozlashga majbur qildim va o'z hududlarimga o'z mavjudligim orqali o'z fuqarolarimning yuragini zabt etish va ularni sadoqatda tasdiqlash uchun bordim.

en: These voyages gave me some taste for navigation, in which I took so much pleasure that I resolved to make some discoveries beyond my own territories; to which end I caused ten ships to be fitted out, embarked, and set sail.
uz: Bu sayohatlar menga navigatsiya uchun biroz did berdi, undan shunchalik zavqlandimki, o'z hududlarimdan tashqarida ham ba'zi kashfiyotlar qilishga qaror qildim; buning uchun o'nta kemani jihozlash, jo'natish va jo'nashga majbur qildim.

en: Our voyage was very pleasant for forty days successively: but on the forty-first night the wind became contrary, and so boisterous that we were nearly lost.
uz: Bizning sayohatimiz ketma-ket qirq kun davomida juda yoqimli bo'ldi: lekin qirq birinchi tunda shamol teskari bo'lib, shunchalik shovqinli ediki, deyarli adashib qoldik.

en: I gave orders to steer back to my own coast; but I found that my pilot knew not where we were.
uz: Men o'z qirg'og'imga qaytish haqida buyruq berdim; lekin uchuvchim qayerda ekanligimizni bilmasligini angladim.

en: day, a seaman being sent to look out for land from the masthead, gave notice that right ahead he perceived a great blackness.
uz: kun, mastdan quruqlik izlashga yuborilgan dengizchi oldinda katta qoralik borligini sezganini xabar berdi.

en: The pilot changed color at this account, and throwing his turban on the deck with one hand, and beating his breast with the other, cried, “O sir, we are all lost; not one of us can escape; and with all my skill it is not in my power to effect our deliverance.” I asked him what reason he had thus to despair.
uz: Uchuvchi bu gapdan rangini o'zgartirdi va bir qo'li bilan deckga turbanini tashladi, ikkinchi qo'li bilan ko'kragini urib, qichqirdi: Ey janob, hammamiz adashdik; hech birimiz qochib qutula olmaymiz; va butun mahoratim bilan bizni qutqarishga qodir emasman. Men undan umidsizlikka tushishining sababini so'radim.

en: He exclaimed, “The tempest has brought us so far out of our course, that to-morrow about noon we shall be near the black mountain, or mine of lodestone which at this very minute draws all your fleet toward it by virtue of the iron in your ships; and when we approach within a certain distance, the attraction of the lodestone will have such force, that all the nails will be drawn out of the sides and bottoms of the ships, and fasten to the mountain, so that your vessels will fall to pieces and sink.
uz: U shunday dedi: Bo'ron bizni shunchalik uzoqqa olib chiqdiki, ertaga tush paytida qora tog'ga yaqin bo'lamiz, yoki kemangizdagi temir tufayli shu daqiqada butun flotingizni unga tortuvchi tosh koniga yaqinlashamiz; va ma'lum masofaga yaqinlashsak, toshning tortishi shunday kuchga ega bo'ladiki, barcha mixlar kemalarning yon va pastki qismlaridan tortiladi va tog'ga mahkamlanadi, shunda kemalaringiz parchalanib ketadi va cho'kadi.

en: This mountain,” continued the pilot, “is almost inaccessible.
uz: Bu tog',  dedi uchuvchi davom etib,  deyarli yetib bo'lmas.

en: On the summit there is a dome of fine brass, supported by pillars of the same metal, and on the top of that dome stands a horse, likewise of brass, with a rider on his back, who has a plate of lead fixed to his breast, upon which some talismanic characters are engraven.
uz: Cho'qqida xuddi shu metall ustunlar bilan tayanadigan nozik mis gumbaz bor va u gumbazning tepasida xuddi shunday tosh ot turadi, uning orqa tomonida qo'rg'oshin plitasi o'rnatilgan, unga ba'zi talisman qahramonlari o'yib ishlangan.

en: Sir, the tradition is, that this statue is the chief cause why so many ships and men have been lost and sunk in this place, and that it will ever continue to be fatal to all those who have the misfortune to approach, until it shall be thrown down.” The pilot having finished his discourse, began to weep afresh, and all the rest of the ship’s company did the same, while they took farewell of each other.
uz: Janob, an'ana shuki, bu haykal bu joyda shuncha kema va odamning yo'qolib, cho'kib ketishiga asosiy sabab bo'lib, u hech qachon yaqinlashadigan baxtsizlikka uchraganlarning barchasiga halokatli bo'lib qoladi, toki u qulab tushirilmaguncha. Uchuvchi nutqini tugatgach, yana yig'lay boshladi va kema kompaniyasining qolgan qismi ham xuddi shunday qildi, ular bir-birlari bilan xayrlashdilar.

en: The next morning we distinctly perceived the black mountain.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab biz qora tog'ni aniq angladik.

en: About noon we were so near, that we found what the pilot had foretold to be true; for all the nails and iron in the ships flew toward the mountain, where they fixed, by the violence of the attraction, with a horrible noise; the ships split asunder, and their cargoes sank into the sea.
uz: Tush paytida shunday yaqinlashdikki, uchuvchi bashorat qilgan narsani rost deb topdik; chunki kemalardagi barcha mixlar va temir tog'ga qarab uchib, u yerda jozibadorlikning zo'ravonligi bilan dahshatli shovqin bilan qo'zg'alishdi; kemalar yorilib ketdi va ularning yuklari dengizga botdi.

en: All my people were drowned, but God had mercy on me, and permitted me to save myself by means of a plank, which the wind drove ashore just at the foot of the mountain.
uz: Mening butun xalqim cho'kib ketdi, lekin Xudo menga rahm qildi va menga o'zimni taxta yordamida qutqarishga ruxsat berdi, uni shamol tog'ning etagida qirg'oqqa haydab yubordi.

en: receive the least hurt; and my good fortune brought me to a landing-place, where there were steps that led up to the summit of the mountain.
uz: Eng kam zararni oldim; va omadim meni tog' cho'qqisiga olib boradigan zinapoyalar bor joyga olib keldi.

en: At last I reached the top without accident.
uz: Nihoyat tasodifan tepaga yetib bordim.

en: I went into the dome and kneeling on the ground, gave God thanks for His mercies.
uz: Men gumbazga kirdim va yerga tiz cho'kib, Xudoga Uning marhamati uchun shukr qildim.

en: I passed the night under the dome.
uz: Men tunni gumbaz ostida o'tkazdim.

en: In my sleep an old man appeared to me, and said, “Hearken, Agib; as soon as thou art awake dig up the ground under thy feet: thou wilt find a bow of brass, and three arrows of lead.
uz: Uxlab yotganimda bir qari odam paydo bo'ldi va dedi: Eshiting, Agib; uyg'onishing bilanoq oyoqlaring ostidan yer kovlab chiq: mis kamon va uchta qo'rg'oshin o'qini topasan.

en: Shoot the three arrows at the statue, and the rider and his horse will fall into the sea; this being done, the sea will swell and rise to the foot of the dome.
uz: Haykalga uchta o'q oting, shunda chavandoz va uning oti dengizga tushib ketadi; bu amalga oshganda, dengiz shishib, gumbaz etagiga ko'tariladi.

en: When it has come so high, thou wilt perceive a boat with one man holding an oar in each hand; this man is also of metal.
uz: U shunchalik balandga ko'tarilganda, har bir qo'lida eshkak ushlab turgan bir odam bor qayiqni ko'rasiz; bu odam ham metalldan.

en: Step on board, but without mentioning the name of God, and let him conduct thee.
uz: Kemaga chiqing, lekin Xudoning ismini tilga olmasdan, va U sizni yetaklasin.

en: He will in ten days’ time bring thee into another sea, where thou shalt find an opportunity to return to thy country, provided, as I have told thee, thou dost not mention the name of God during the whole voyage.” When I awoke I felt much comforted by the vision, and did not fail to observe everything that the old man had commanded me.
uz: U seni o'n kundan keyin boshqa dengizga olib boradi, u yerda o'z yurtingga qaytish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lasan, agar senga aytganimdek, butun sayohat davomida Xudoning ismini tilga olmasang. Uyg'onganimda, bu vahiy meni juda tasalli berdi va keksa odam menga buyurgan hamma narsaga amal qilishni unutmadim.

en: I took the bow and arrows out of the ground, shot at the horseman, and with the third arrow I overthrew him and the horse.
uz: Men kamon va o'qlarni yerdan oldim, chavandozga o'q uzdim va uchinchi o'q bilan uni va otni ag'darib tashladim.

en: In the mean time, the sea rose up by degrees.
uz: Ayni paytda dengiz asta-sekin ko'tarildi.

en: When it came as high as the foot of the dome upon the top of the mountain, I saw, afar off, a boat rowing toward me, and I returned God thanks.
uz: Tog'ning tepasidagi gumbaz poydevorigacha baland bo'lganda, men uzoqdan menga qarab ketayotgan qayiqni ko'rdim va Xudoga minnatdorchilik bildirdim.

en: When the boat made land, I stepped aboard, taking great heed not to pronounce the name of God, neither spoke I one word.
uz: Qayiq qirg'oqqa chiqqanida, men Xudoning ismini talaffuz qilmaslikka, birorta so'z ham aytmaslikka juda ehtiyot bo'lib, kemaga chiqdim.

en: I sat down, and the man of metal began to row off from the mountain.
uz: Men o'tirdim va metall odam tog'dan eshkak eshishni boshladi.

en: He rowed without ceasing till the ninth day, when I saw islands, which gave me hopes that I should reach safety.
uz: U to'qqizinchi kungacha tinimsiz eshkak eshdi, shunda men orollarni ko'rdim, bu esa menga xavfsizlikka erishishimga umid berdi.

en: The excess of my joy made me forget what I was forbidden: “God is great, God be praised!” said I.
uz: Quvonchimning haddan tashqari ko'pligi meni taqiqlangan narsani unuttirdi: Xudo buyuk, Xudo poklansin! - dedim men.

en: I had no sooner spoken than the boat and man sank, casting me upon the sea.
uz: Men qayiq va odam cho'kib, meni dengizga uloqtirgandan oldin gapirmagan edim.

en: I swam until night, when, as my strength I Got Up into a Thick Tree began to fail, a wave vast as a mountain threw me on the land.
uz: Men tungacha suzdim, keyin, kuchim Qalin Daraxtga ko'tarilganimda, qula boshladi, tog'dek ulkan to'lqin meni quruqlikka uloqtirdi.

en: The first thing I did was to strip, and to dry my clothes.
uz: Mening birinchi qilgan ishim yechinish va kiyimlarimni quritish edi.

en: The next morning, I set forth to discover what sort of country I was in.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab men qanday mamlakatda ekanligimni aniqlash uchun yo'lga chiqdim.

en: I had not walked far before I found I was upon a deserted though a very pleasant island, abounding with trees and wild shrubs bearing fruit.
uz: Men uzoq yurmagan edim, shunda juda yoqimli bo'lsa-da, cho'l orolda, daraxtlar va mevali yovvoyi butalar bilan to'lib-toshganimni angladim.

en: I recommended myself to God, and prayed Him to dispose of me according to His will.
uz: Men o'zimni Xudoga tavsiya qildim va Uning irodasiga ko'ra meni yo'q qilishini so'radim.

en: Immediately after, I saw a vessel coming from the mainland, before the wind, directly toward the island.
uz: Shundan so'ng darhol qit'adan, shamol oldidan, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri orolga qarab kelayotgan kemani ko'rdim.

en: I got up into a thick tree, from whence, though unseen, I might safely view what should occur.
uz: Men qalin daraxtga chiqdim, undan, garchi ko'rinmas bo'lsa ham, nima sodir bo'lishi kerakligini xavfsiz ko'ra olardim.

en: The vessel came into a little creek, where ten slaves landed, carrying a spade and other instruments for digging up the ground.
uz: Kema kichik bir ariqqa tushdi, u yerda o'nta qul yerga tushdi, ular pichoq va yer qazish uchun boshqa asboblarni olib ketishardi.

en: They went toward the middle of the island, where they dug for a considerable time, after which they lifted up a trap-door.
uz: Ular orolning o'rtasiga tomon yo'l olishdi, u yerda ancha vaqt qazishdi, shundan so'ng tuzoq eshigini ko'tarishdi.

en: They returned again to the vessel and unloaded several sorts of provisions and furniture, which they carried
uz: Ular yana kemaga qaytib kelishdi va bir nechta turdagi oziq-ovqat va mebellarni tushirishdi, ularni olib ketishdi.

en: to the place where they had been digging; they then descended into a subterranean dwelling.
uz: Ular qazigan joyga; keyin yer osti maskaniga tushdilar.

en: I saw them once more go to the ship, to return soon after with an old man, who led a handsome lad of about fifteen years of age.
uz: Men ularni yana bir bor kemaga ketayotganini ko'rdim, tez orada bir keksa odam bilan qaytib kelish uchun, u taxminan o'n besh yoshli chiroyli yigitni yetakchilik qilardi.

en: They all descended when the trap-door had been opened.
uz: Ular hammasi tuzoq eshigi ochilganda pastga tushishdi.

en: After they had again come up, they let down the trap-door, covered it over with earth, and returned to the creek where the ship lay; but I saw not the young man in their company.
uz: Ular yana yuqoriga ko'tarilgandan so'ng, tuzoq eshigini pastga tushirishdi, uni tuproqqa to'sishdi va kema yotgan daryoga qaytishdi; lekin men yigitni ularning safida ko'rmadim.

en: Evidently he had stayed behind in the subterranean cavern.
uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, u yer osti g'orida qolgan edi.

en: The old man and the slaves returned on board, and steered their course toward the mainland.
uz: Keksa odam va qullar kemaga qaytib, materik tomon yo'nalishlarini yo'naltirishdi.

en: When they had proceeded to such a distance that I could not be seen by them, I came down from the tree, and went to the place where I had seen the ground broken.
uz: Ular shunchalik uzoqqa borgach, meni ular ko'ra olmaganda, men daraxtdan tushib, yer yorilganini ko'rgan joyimga bordim.

en: I removed the earth by degrees, till I came to a stone two or three feet square.
uz: Yerni asta-sekin silkitdim, to ikki-uch fut kvadrat bo'lgan toshga yetib keldim.

en: I lifted it up, and found that it covered the head of a flight of stairs, also of stone.
uz: Uni ko'tardim va topdimki, u zinapoyalarning boshini, shuningdek toshdan ham qoplagan edi.

en: I descended, and at the bottom found myself in a large room, brilliantly lighted, and furnished with a carpet, a couch covered with tapestry, and cushions of rich stuff, upon which the young man sat reading.
uz: Men pastga tushdim va pastda o'zimni ajoyib tarzda yoritilgan va gilam bilan jihozlangan katta xonada topdim, gilamlar bilan qoplangan divan va boy narsalar bilan qoplangan yostiqlar, ustida yigit o'tiribdi.

en: He, when he perceived me, was considerably alarmed; but I made a low obeisance, and said to him, “Sir, do not fear.
uz: U meni sezganida ancha vahimaga tushdi; lekin men pastdan sajda qildim va unga: Janob, qo'rqmang.

en: I am a king, and I will do you no harm.
uz: Men shohman va sizga hech qanday zarar yetkazmayman.

en: On the contrary, it is probable that your good destiny may have brought me hither to deliver you out of this tomb, where it seems you have been buried alive.
uz: Aksincha, ehtimol, sizning yaxshi taqdiringiz meni sizni bu qabrdan qutqarish uchun bu yerga olib kelgan bo'lishi mumkin, u yerda siz tiriklayin ko'milgan ko'rinadi.

en: But what surprises me (for you must know that I have seen all that passed since your coming to this island) is, that you suffered yourself to be entombed in this place without any resistance.” The youth, much assured at these words, with a smiling countenance requested me to sit myself by him.
uz: Lekin meni hayratda qoldiradigan narsa (chunki siz bilishingiz kerakki, bu orolga kelganingizdan beri o'tgan hamma narsani ko'rdim) shundaki, siz hech qanday qarshiliksiz bu joyga ko'milishga bardosh bergansiz. Yoshlar bu so'zlarga juda ishonib, tabassum bilan o'zimni uning yonida o'tirishimni so'rashdi.

en: As soon as I was seated, he said, “Prince, my story will surprise you.
uz: Men o'tirgan zahoti u dedi: Hikoyam sizni hayratga soladi, shahzoda.

en: My father is a jeweler.
uz: Mening otam zargar.

en: He had been long married without having issue when he dreamt that he should have a son, though his life would be but short.
uz: U uzoq vaqtdan beri turmush qurgan edi, hech qanday muammosi yo'q edi, lekin hayotining qisqa bo'lishiga qaramay, o'g'il ko'rishini tushida ko'rdi.

en: Some time after, I was born, which occasioned great joy in the family.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, men tug'ildim, bu oilada katta quvonch uyg'otdi.

en: My father, who had observed the very moment of my birth,
uz: Mening tug'ilgan lahzamni kuzatgan otam,

en: consulted astrologers about my nativity, and was answered, ‘Your son shall live happily till the age of fifteen, when his life will be exposed to a danger, which he will hardly be able to escape.
uz: Men tug'ilganligim haqida astrologlar bilan maslahatlashdim va javob berdim: O'g'ling o'n besh yoshga to'lgunga qadar baxtli yashaydi, shunda uning hayoti xavfga duchor bo'ladi, undan qochib qutula olmaydi.

en: But if his good destiny preserve him beyond that time, he will live to a great age.
uz: Lekin agar uning yaxshi taqdiri uni o'sha vaqtdan keyin ham saqlab qolsa, u katta umr ko'radi.

en: It will be,’ said they, ‘when the statue of brass, that stands upon the summit of the mountain of lodestone, shall be thrown into the sea by Prince Agib, that, as the stars prognosticate, your son will be killed fifty days afterward by that prince.’ “My father took all imaginable care of my education until this year, which is the fifteenth of my age.
uz: Ular aytdilar: Lodosh togining choqqisida turgan mis haykal shahzoda Agib tomonidan dengizga uloqtirilganda, yulduzlar bashorat qilganidek, oglingiz shu shahzoda tomonidan ellik kundan keyin oldiriladi. Otam mening talimim haqida shu yilgacha, yani mening on beshinchi yoshimgacha barcha tasavvurga sigadigan gamxorlik qildi.

en: He had notice given him yesterday that the statue of brass had been thrown into the sea about ten days ago.
uz: U unga kecha mis haykali dengizga o'n kuncha oldin uloqtirilganligi haqida xabar bergan edi.

en: This news alarmed him much; and, in consequence of the prediction of the astrologers, he took the precaution to form this subterranean habitation to hide me in during the fifty days after the throwing down of the statue; and therefore, as it is ten days since this happened, he came hastily hither to conceal me, and promised at the end of forty days to return and fetch me away.
uz: Bu xabar uni juda xavotirga soldi; va, astrologlarning bashoratiga ko'ra, u haykal tashlanganidan keyin ellik kun ichida meni yashirish uchun bu yer osti yashash joyini tashkil etish uchun ehtiyot choralarini ko'rdi; va shuning uchun, bu sodir bo'lganiga o'n kun bo'lgani uchun, u meni yashirish uchun shoshilinch ravishda shu yerga keldi va qirq kun oxirida qaytib kelib, meni olib ketishga va'da berdi.

en: For my own part, I am sanguine in my hopes, and cannot believe that Prince Agib will seek for me in a place under ground, in the midst of a desert island.” He had scarcely done speaking, when I told him, with great joy, “Dear sir, trust in the goodness of God, and fear nothing.
uz: Men o'z umidlarimda sog'lomman va shahzoda Ajib meni yer ostida, cho'l orolining o'rtasida qidirishiga ishonmayman. U deyarli gapirib bo'lmadi, men unga katta quvonch bilan aytdim: Aziz janob, Xudoning yaxshiligiga ishoning va hech narsadan qo'rqmang.

en: I will not leave you till the forty days have expired, of which the foolish astrologers have made you apprehensive; and in the meanwhile I will do you all the service in my power; after which, with leave of your father and yourself, I shall have the benefit of getting to the mainland in your vessel; and when I am returned into my kingdom, I will remember the obligations I owe you, and endeavor to They danced before me with great skill
uz: Sizni ahmoqona astrologlar sizni xavotirga solgan qirq kun o'tmaguncha tashlab ketmayman; va shu vaqt ichida men sizga qo'limdan kelgan barcha xizmatni qilaman; shundan so'ng, otangiz va o'zingizning ruxsatingiz bilan, men sizning kemangizda materikka yetib borish afzalligiga ega bo'laman; va qachonki mening shohligimga qaytsam, men sizdan qarzdor bo'lgan majburiyatlarni eslayman va ular oldimda katta mahorat bilan raqsga tushishdi.

en: demonstrate my gratitude by suitable acknowledgments.” These words encouraged the jeweler’s son, and inspired him with confidence.
uz: Minnatdorligimni tegishli e'tiroflar bilan namoyish eting. Bu so'zlar zargarning o'g'lini ruhlantirdi va unga ishonch baxsh etdi.

en: I took care not to inform him I was the very Agib whom he dreaded, lest I should awaken his fears.
uz: Men unga o'zim uning qo'rqqan Agib ekanligimni aytmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ldim, aks holda uning qo'rquvlarini uyg'otardim.

en: I found the young man of ready wit, and partook with him of his provisions, of which he had enough to have lasted beyond the forty days, though he had had
uz: Men yosh yigitni tayyor holatda topdim va u bilan birga uning taomlaridan ovqatlandim, undan qirq kundan ortiq vaqtga yetadigan narsa bor edi, garchi u...

en: more guests than myself.
uz: O'zimdan ko'ra ko'proq mehmonlar.

en: In short, madam, we spent, thirty-nine days in the pleasantest manner possible, in this subterranean abode.
uz: Xullas, xonim, biz o'ttiz to'qqiz kunni shu yer osti maskanida imkon qadar yoqimli tarzda o'tkazdik.

en: The fortieth day appeared; and in the morning, when the young man awoke, he said to me, with a joy that he could not restrain, “Prince, this is the fortieth day, and I am not dead, thanks to God and your good company.
uz: Qirqinchi kun paydo bo'ldi; va ertalab yigit uyg'onganida, u menga o'zini tiya olmaydigan quvonch bilan dedi: Ey shahzoda, bu qirqinchi kun, va men o'lmaganman, Xudoga va sizning yaxshi hamrohligingizga shukr.

en: My father will not fail to make you, very shortly, every acknowledgment of his gratitude for your attentions, and will furnish you with every necessity for your return to your kingdom.
uz: Otam sizni tez orada e'tiboringiz uchun minnatdorchilik bildiradi va qirolligingizga qaytishingiz uchun barcha zarur narsalarni taqdim etadi.

en: But,” continued he, “while we are waiting his arrival, dear prince, let us refresh ourselves with a melon.” Out of the several melons that remained he took the best, and laid it on a plate; and as I could not find a knife to cut it with, I asked the young man if he knew where there was one.
uz: Lekin,  deb davom etdi u,  biz uning kelishini kutayotganimizda, aziz shahzoda, bir qovun bilan tetiklanaylik. Qolgan bir nechta qovunlardan eng yaxshisini olib, bir idishga qo'ydi; va uni kesish uchun pichoq topa olmaganim uchun, yigitdan qayerda borligini bilishini so'radim.

en: “There is one,” said he, “upon the cornice over my head.” I accordingly saw it there, and made so much haste to reach it, that, while I had it in my hand, my foot being entangled in the carpet, I fell most unhappily upon the young man, and the knife pierced his heart.
uz: Bitta bor,  dedi u,  boshim ustidagi korniz ustida.  Men uni u yerda ko'rdim va unga yetishga shunchalik shoshildim, qo'limda bor edi, oyog'im gilamga o'ralganida, yigit ustiga juda achinarli tarzda yiqildim va pichoq uning yuragini teshib ketdi.

en: At this spectacle I cried out with agony.
uz: Bu tomoshada men azob chekib qichqirdim.

en: I beat my head, my face, and breast; I tore my clothes; I threw myself on the ground with unspeakable sorrow and grief.
uz: Boshimni, yuzimni va ko'kragimni urdim; kiyimlarimni yirtib tashladim; o'zimni tilga olinmas qayg'u va qayg'u bilan yerga tashladim.

en: Nevertheless, considering that all my tears and sorrows would not restore the young man to life, and, the forty days being expired, I might be surprised by his father, I quitted the subterranean dwelling, laid down the great stone upon the entrance, and covered it with earth.
uz: Shunga qaramay, barcha ko'z yoshlarim va qayg'ularim yigitni hayotga qaytarmasligini va qirq kun o'tib, otam meni hayratga solishi mumkinligini hisobga olib, yer osti maskani tark etdim, kirish joyiga katta toshni qo'ydim va uni tuproqqa to'ldirdim.

en: I again ascended into the tree which had previously sheltered me, and soon I saw the expected vessel approaching the shore.
uz: Men avval boshpana olgan daraxtga yana ko'tarildim va tez orada kutilayotgan kemaning qirg'oqqa yaqinlashayotganini ko'rdim.

en: The old man with his slaves landed immediately, and advanced toward the subterranean dwelling, with a countenance that showed some hope; but when they saw the earth had been newly removed, they changed color, particularly the old man.
uz: Keksa odam o'z qullari bilan darhol yerga tushdi va yer osti turar joyiga tomon oldinga siljidi, yuzida biroz umid bor edi; lekin ular yerning yangi olib tashlanganini ko'rgach, rangi o'zgardi, ayniqsa keksa odam.

en: They lifted up the stone, and descended the stairs.
uz: Ular toshni ko'tarib, zinadan pastga tushishdi.

en: They called the young man by his name, but no answer was returned.
uz: Ular yigitni ismining nomi bilan chaqirishdi, lekin javob berilmadi.

en: Their fears redoubled.
uz: Ularning qo'rquvi ikki barobar oshdi.

en: They searched and at last found him stretched on his couch, with the knife through his heart, for I had not had the courage to draw it out.
uz: Ular qidirishdi va nihoyat uni divanida cho'zilgan holda, yuragida pichoq bilan topishdi, chunki uni tortishga jur'atim yetmagan edi.

en: On seeing this, they uttered such lamentable cries that my tears flowed afresh.
uz: Buni ko'rib, ular shunday achinarli faryodlar aytdiki, ko'zlarim yoshlandi.

en: The unfortunate father continued a long while insensible, and made them more than once despair of his life: but at last he came to himself.
uz: Bechora ota uzoq vaqt davomida hissiz bo'lib qoldi va ularni bir necha bor hayotidan umidsizlantirdi: lekin nihoyat o'ziga keldi.

en: The slaves then brought up his son’s body, dressed in his best apparel, and when they had made a grave they buried it.
uz: Qullar keyin o'g'lining jasadini olib kelishdi, uning eng yaxshi kiyimida, va qabr qurganlaridan so'ng uni dafn etishdi.

en: The old man, supported by two slaves, and his face covered with tears, threw the first earth upon the body, after which the slaves filled up the grave.
uz: Keksa odam, ikki qul tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlangan va yuzi yosh bilan qoplangan holda, birinchi tuproqni jasadga tashladi, shundan so'ng qullar qabrni to'ldirdilar.

en: This being done, all the furniture was brought up, and, with the remaining provisions, put on board the vessel.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, barcha mebellar olib kelindi va qolgan ta'minot bilan birga kemaga qo'yildi.

en: The old man, overcome with sorrow, was carried upon a litter to the ship, which stood out to sea, and in a short time was out of sight.
uz: Qari odam qayg'u bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, to'shak ustida dengizga chiqib turgan kemaga olib borildi va qisqa vaqt ichida ko'zdan g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: After the old man and his slaves were gone, I was left alone upon the island.
uz: Keksa odam va uning qullari ketgach, men orolda yolg'iz qoldim.

en: I lay that night in the subterranean dwelling, which they had not cared to shut up, and when the day came, I walked round the island.
uz: O'sha kecha ular yopishni xohlamagan yer osti maskanida yotdim va kun kelgach, orolni aylanib chiqdim.

en: I led this wearisome life for a whole month.
uz: Men bu zerikarli hayotni butun bir oy davomida olib bordim.

en: Then to my amazement I perceived that the sea had sunk so low, that there remained between me and the continent but a small stream, which I crossed, and the water did not reach above the middle of my leg.
uz: Keyin hayratga tushdimki, dengiz shunchalik pastga cho'kkan ediki, men bilan qit'a o'rtasida faqat kichik bir soy qolgan edi, uni kesib o'tdim va suv oyog'imning o'rtasidan yuqoriga yetib bormagan edi.

en: At last I got upon more firm ground; and when I had proceeded some distance from the sea, I saw a good way before me something that resembled a great fire, which gave me some comfort; for I said to myself, I shall here find some persons, it not being possible that this fire should kindle of itself.
uz: Nihoyat, yanada mustahkamroq yerga yetdim; va dengizdan biroz uzoqroq yurganimda, oldimda katta olovga o'xshash yaxshi yo'lni ko'rdim, bu menga biroz tasalli berdi; chunki men o'zimga aytdim: Bu yerda ba'zi odamlarni topaman, bu olov o'z-o'zidan yonishi mumkin emas.

en: As I drew nearer, however, I found my error, and discovered that what I had taken for a fire was a castle of red copper, which the beams of the sun made to appear at a distance like flames.
uz: Ammo yaqinlashar ekanman, adashganimni aniqladim va olov deb o'ylagan narsam qizil misdan yasalgan qal'a ekanligini angladim, quyosh nurlari uni olov kabi uzoqlikda ko'rsatdi.

en: As I wondered at this magnificent building, I saw ten handsome young men coming along; but what surprised me was that they were all blind of the right eye.
uz: Bu ajoyib binoga hayron bo'lganimda, o'n nafar chiroyli yigit kelayotganini ko'rdim; lekin meni hayratga solgani ularning barchasi o'ng ko'zi ko'r edi.

en: They were accompanied by an old man, very tall, and of a venerable aspect.
uz: Ularga juda uzun bo'yli va hurmatga sazovor ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan bir keksa odam hamrohlik qildi.

en: As I was conjecturing by what adventure these men could come together, they approached, and seemed glad to see me.
uz: Bu odamlar qanday sarguzashtga duch kelishi mumkinligini taxmin qilayotganimda, ular yaqinlashdilar va meni ko'rishdan xursand bo'lishdi.

en: After we had made our salutations, they inquired what had brought me
uz: Salomlarimizni aytganimizdan so'ng, ular mendan nima olib kelganini so'radilar.

en: I told them my story, which filled them with great astonishment.
uz: Men ularga o'z hikoyamni aytib berdim, bu ularni katta hayratga soldi.

en: After I had concluded my account, the young men prayed me to accompany them into the palace, and brought me into a spacious hall, where there were ten small blue seats set round, separate from one another.
uz: Hisobimni tugatganimdan so'ng, yigitlar meni saroyga hamroh qilishimni so'rashdi va meni keng zalga olib kirishdi, u yerda bir-biridan alohida joylashgan o'nta kichik ko'k o'rindiq bor edi.

en: In the middle of this circle stood an eleventh seat, not so high as the rest, but of the same color, upon which the old man before mentioned sat down, and the young men occupied the other ten.
uz: Bu doiraning o'rtasida o'n birinchi o'rindiq turardi, qolganlari kabi baland emas, balki xuddi shu rangda edi, unga avval aytib o'tilgan chol o'tirardi va yigitlar qolgan o'nta o'rinni egalladi.

en: But as each seat could only contain one man, one of the young men said to me, “Sit down, friend, upon that carpet in the middle of the room, and do not inquire into anything that concerns us, nor the reason why we are all blind of the right eye.” The old man, having sat a short time, arose, and went out; but he returned in a minute or two, brought in supper, distributed to each man separately his portion, and likewise brought me mine, which I ate apart, as the rest did; and when supper was almost ended, he presented to each of us a cup of wine.
uz: Lekin har bir o'rindiq faqat bitta odamni sig'dira olgani uchun, yigitlardan biri menga dedi: Do'stim, xonaning o'rtasidagi o'sha gilamga o'tir, bizga tegishli hech narsa haqida so'ramang, va nega hammamiz o'ng ko'zimizni ko'r bo'lishimizning sababi haqida ham so'ramang. Keksa odam bir oz o'tirgach, o'rnidan turdi va tashqariga chiqdi; lekin bir-ikki daqiqadan so'ng qaytib keldi, kechki ovqatni olib keldi, har birimizga alohida qismini berdi va xuddi shunday qilib, menga ham o'zimniki olib keldi, uni ham qolganlar kabi yeb tashladim; va kechki ovqat tugashiga yaqin bo'lgach, har birimizga bir piyola vino berdi.

en: One of the young men observing that it was late, said to the old man, “You do not bring us that with which we may acquit ourselves of our duty.” At these words the old man arose, and went into the closet, and brought out thence upon his head ten basins, one after another, all covered with black stuff; he placed one before every gentleman, together with a light.
uz: Yosh yigitlardan biri kech bo'lganini kuzatib, keksa odamga dedi: Siz bizga o'z vazifamizdan xalos bo'lishimiz mumkin bo'lgan narsani olib kelmayapsiz. Shu so'zlarni eshitgach, keksa odam o'rnidan turdi va shkafga kirdi va u yerdan o'z boshida qora narsa bilan qoplangan o'nta choynakni, birin-ketin olib chiqdi; u har bir janobning oldiga bittasini qo'ydi, birga chiroq ham bor edi.

en: They uncovered their basins, which contained ashes and powdered charcoal; they mixed this together, and rubbed and bedaubed their faces with it; and having thus blackened themselves, they wept and lamented, beating their heads and breasts, and crying continually, “This is the fruit of our idleness and curiosity.” They continued this strange employment nearly the whole of the night.
uz: Ular o'z havzalarini ochdilar, unda kul va changlangan ko'mir bor edi; ular buni bir-biriga aralashtirdilar, va yuzlarini u bilan ishqalashdi; va shu tariqa o'zlarini qoralashtirib, yig'lashdi va yig'lashdi, boshlarini va ko'kraklarini urib, tinimsiz Bu bizning beparvoligimiz va qiziquvchanligimiz mevasi deb yig'lashdi. Ular bu g'alati bandlikni deyarli butun tun davomida davom ettirishdi.

en: I wished a thousand times to break the silence which had been imposed upon me, and to ask the reason for their strange proceedings.
uz: Menga yuklangan sukutni buzishni va ularning g'alati harakatlarining sababini so'rashni ming marta xohlardim.

en: The next day, soon after we had arisen, we went out to walk, and then I said to them, “I cannot forbear asking why you
uz: Ertasi kuni, biz turgandan ko'p o'tmay, piyoda yurishga chiqdik, keyin ularga aytdim: Nega deb so'rashdan o'zimni tiyolmayman.

en: bedaubed your faces with black, and how it has happened that each of you has but one eye.
uz: Yuzlaringizni qora rang bilan bo'yalgansiz va har biringizda faqat bitta ko'z borligi qanday bo'ldi.

en: I conjure you to satisfy my curiosity.” One of the young men answered on behalf of the rest, “Once more we advise you to restrain your curiosity; it will cost you the loss of your right eye.” “No matter,” I replied; “be assured that if such a misfortune befall me, I will not impute it to you, but to myself.” He further represented to me, that when I had lost an eye, I must not hope to remain with them, if I were so disposed, because their number was complete, and no addition could be made to it.
uz: Sizni qiziqishimni qondirishingizni so'rayman. Qolgan yigitlardan biri javob berdi: Sizga yana bir bor qiziqishingizni tiyishni maslahat beramiz; bu sizga o'ng ko'zingizni yo'qotishga olib keladi. Mayli, deb javob berdim men; Agar menga bunday baxtsizlik yetsa, men uni sizga emas, balki o'zimga yuklayman. U menga yana shuni ta'kidladiki, agar men ko'zimni yo'qotgan bo'lsam, ular bilan qolishga umid qilmasligim kerak, agar men bunchalik tayyor bo'lsam, chunki ularning soni to'liq edi va bunga qo'shimcha narsa qo'sha olmasdim.

en: I begged them, let it cost what it would, to grant my request.
uz: Men ulardan iltimos qildim, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, so'rovimni qondirishlarini.

en: The ten young men, perceiving that I was fixed in my resolution, took a sheep, killed it, and after they had taken off the skin, presented me with a knife, telling me it would be useful to me later, as they would explain.
uz: O'n nafar yigit mening qarorimga sodiq qolganimni anglab, bir qo'yni oldi, uni o'ldirdi va terisini yechgach, menga pichoq taqdim etdilar va keyinroq menga foydali bo'lishini aytdilar, xuddi ular tushuntirishlaricha.

en: “We must sew you in this skin,” said they, “and then leave you; upon which a bird of a monstrous size, called a roc, will appear in the air, and, taking you for a sheep, will pounce upon you, and soar with you to the sky.
uz: Sizni shu terida tikishimiz kerak, deyishdi ular, va keyin sizni tark etamiz; unda havoda qoya deb ataladigan dahshatli o'lchamdagi qush paydo bo'ladi va sizni qo'y deb o'ylab, ustingizga sakrab, siz bilan birga osmonga uchadi.

en: But let not that alarm you; he will descend with you again, and lay you on the top of a mountain.
uz: Lekin bu sizni xavotirga solmasin; u yana siz bilan tushadi va sizni tog'ning cho'qqisiga qo'yadi.

en: When you find yourself on the ground, cut the skin with your knife, and throw it off.
uz: O'zingizni yerda topsangiz, terini pichoq bilan kesib tashlang va tashlang.

en: As soon as the roc sees you, he will fly away.
uz: Rok sizni ko'rishi bilanoq, u uchib ketadi.

en: Do not stay, but walk on till you come to a spacious palace, covered with plates of gold, large emeralds, and other precious stones.
uz: Qolmang, balki keng saroyga yetguncha yuring, u yerda oltin plitalar, katta zumradlar va boshqa qimmatbaho toshlar bilan qoplangan.

en: Go up to the gate, which always stands open, and walk in.
uz: Doimo ochiq turgan darvozaga chiqing va ichkariga kiring.

en: We have each of us been in that castle, but will tell you nothing of what we saw, or what befell us there; you will learn by your own experience.
uz: Har birimiz o'sha qasrda bo'lganmiz, lekin u yerda ko'rganlarimiz yoki bizga nima bo'lganini sizga hech narsa aytmaymiz; o'z tajribangiz orqali bilib olasiz.

en: All that we can inform you is, that it has cost each of us our right eye; and the penance which you have been witness to, is what we are obliged to observe in consequence of having been there; but we cannot explain ourselves further.” When the young man had thus spoken, I wrapt myself in the sheep’s skin, held fast the knife which was given me; and after the young men had been at the trouble to sew the skin about me, they retired into the hall, and left me alone.
uz: Sizni xabardor qila oladigan yagona narsa shuki, bu har birimizning o'ng ko'zimizga qimmatga tushdi; va siz guvoh bo'lgan tavba, u yerda bo'lganimiz sababli kuzatishga majburmiz; lekin o'zimizni bundan ortib tushuntira olmaymiz. Yigit shunday deganidan so'ng, men o'zimni qo'y terisiga o'rab oldim, menga berilgan pichoqni ushladim; va yigitlar atrofimda terini tikishga qiynalgach, ular zalga chekinishdi va meni yolg'iz qoldirishdi.

en: The roc they spoke of soon
uz: Ular tez orada gaplashgan rok.

en: arrived; he pounced upon me, took me in his talons and carried me up to the summit of the mountain.
uz: yetib keldi; u menga sakradi, meni o'z qo'llariga oldi va tog' cho'qqisiga ko'tardi.

en: As soon as I found myself on the ground, I cut the skin with the knife, and throwing it off, the roc at the sight of me flew away.
uz: O'zimni yerga topishim bilanoq, pichoq bilan terini kesib tashladim va uni tashlab yuborganimda, meni ko'rgan odam uchib ketdi.

en: This roc is a white bird of a monstrous size; his strength is such that he can lift up elephants from the plains, and carry them to the tops of mountains, where he feeds upon them.
uz: Bu qoya dahshatli o'lchamdagi oq qushdir; uning kuchi shundaki, u fillarni tekisliklardan ko'tarib, ularni tog'larning cho'qqisiga olib boradi va u yerda ulardan oziqlanadi.

en: Being impatient to reach the palace, I lost no time, but made so much haste that I got thither in half a day’s journey; and I must say that I found it surpassed the description they had given me of its magnificence.
uz: Saroyga yetib borishga sabrsizlik qilib, hech qanday vaqtni yo'qotmadim, lekin shunchalik shoshildimki, yarim kunlik yo'lda u yerga yetib bordim; va aytishim kerakki, men uni ular menga bergan ulug'vorlik ta'rifidan ham yuqori deb topdim.

en: Once again the coming day surprised Scheherazade in the midst of her story.
uz: Kelgusi kun yana bir bor Sheherazadani o'z hikoyasi o'rtasida hayratga soldi.

en: But the sultan indicated that he would have the rest of it on the morning following.
uz: Ammo sulton qolgan qismini ertasi kuni ertalab olishini ko'rsatdi.

en: When he had departed the two women smiled at each other.
uz: U ketganidan so'ng, ikki ayol bir-biriga tabassum qilishdi.

en: “How long,” inquired Dinarzade, “can you continue these wonderful tales?” “For a thousand and one nights,” returned Scheherazade, “and then it is but the beginning of all I have heard and remembered.” And the next morning she continued where she had broken off.
uz: Qachongacha, so'radi Dinarzade, bu ajoyib hikoyalarni davom ettira olasizmi? Ming bir kecha, javob berdi Sheherazade, va keyin bu men eshitgan va eslagan hamma narsaning boshlanishi xolos. Va ertasi kuni ertalab u uzilgan joyida davom etdi.

en: The gate being open, I entered a square court, so large that there were round it ninety-nine gates of wood of sandal and aloes, and one of gold, without reckoning those of several superb staircases, that led to apartments above, besides many more which I could not see.
uz: Darvoza ochiq bo'lganidan so'ng, men kvadrat hovliga kirdim, shunchalik katta ediki, uning atrofida to'qson to'qqizta sandal va aloe yog'ochidan yasalgan darvozalar, shuningdek, yuqoridagi kvartiralarga olib boradigan bir nechta ajoyib zinapoyalarni hisobga olmaganda, yana ko'plarini ko'ra olmasdim.

en: I saw a door standing open just before me, through which I entered into a large hall.
uz: Oldimda ochiq turgan eshikni ko'rdim, undan katta zalga kirdim.

en: Here I found forty young women, of such perfect beauty as imagination could not surpass, all most exquisitely clad.
uz: Bu yerda men qirq nafar yosh ayolni topdim, ularning go'zalligi tasavvurga sig'maydigan darajada mukammal edi, ularning hammasi juda nafis kiyimda edi.

en: As soon as they saw me they arose, and without waiting my salutations, said to me, with tones of joy, “Welcome!
uz: Ular meni ko'rishlari bilanoq turdilar va salomlarimni kutmasdan, quvonch ohanglarida menga dedilar: Xush kelibsiz!

en: have long expected you.
uz: Sizni uzoq kutdim.

en: You are our lord, master, and judge, and we are your slaves, ready to obey your commands.” After these words were spoken, the damsels vied with each other in their eager solicitude to do me all possible service.
uz: Siz bizning xo'jayinimiz, xo'jayinimiz va hakamimizsiz, biz esa sizning amrlaringizga itoat etishga tayyor qullaringizmiz. Bu so'zlar aytilgandan so'ng, qizlar menga barcha imkon qadar xizmat ko'rsatish uchun o'zaro g'ayrat bilan kurashdilar.

en: One brought hot water to wash my feet; a second poured sweet-scented essences on my hands; others brought me all kinds of necessaries and change of apparel; others again brought in a magnificent collation; and the rest came, with jugs in their hands, to fill me delicious wines in the most charming manner possible.
uz: Biri oyoqlarimni yuvish uchun issiq suv olib keldi; ikkinchisi qo'llarimga xushbo'y hidli essensiyalar quydi; boshqalar menga har xil zarur buyumlar va kiyim-kechaklarni olib kelishdi; boshqalar yana ajoyib taom olib kelishdi; qolganlari esa qo'llarida bankalar bilan meni eng jozibali tarzda mazali vinolar bilan to'ldirish uchun kelishdi.

en: Some of the damsels brought in musical instruments, and sang most delightful songs; while others danced before me, two and two, with admirable grace.
uz: Ba'zi qizlar musiqa asboblarini olib kelishdi va eng yoqimli qo'shiqlarni kuylashdi; boshqalari esa men oldida ikki-ikki raqsga tushishdi, hayratlanarli nafosat bilan.

en: In short, honored madam, I must tell you that I passed a whole year of happy life with these forty damsels.
uz: Xullas, hurmatli xonim, sizga shuni aytishim kerakki, men bu qirqta xonim bilan butun bir yil baxtli hayot kechirdim.

en: At the end of that time, I was greatly surprised to see these damsels show sorrow and to hear them say, “Adieu, dear prince, adieu!
uz: O'sha vaqt oxirida, men bu qizlarning qayg'uni ko'rsatganini ko'rib va ularning Xayr, aziz shahzoda, xayr! deganini eshitib juda hayron bo'ldim.

en: for we must leave you.
uz: Chunki biz sizni tark etishimiz kerak.

en: We are princesses, daughters of kings.
uz: Biz malikalarmiz, qirollarning qizlarimiz.

en: We live here together in the manner you have seen; but at the end of every year we are obliged to be absent forty days, for reasons we are not permitted to reveal; afterward we return again to this palace.
uz: Biz bu yerda siz ko'rganidek birga yashaymiz; lekin har yil oxirida qirq kun yo'q bo'lishga majburmiz, chunki bizga buni oshkor qilishga ruxsat yo'q; keyin yana bu saroyga qaytamiz.

en: Before we depart we will leave you the keys of everything, especially those of the hundred doors, where you will find enough to satisfy your curiosity, and to relieve your solitude during our absence.
uz: Ketishdan oldin sizga hamma narsaning kalitlarini, ayniqsa yuz eshiklarning kalitlarini qoldiramiz, u yerda qiziquvchanligingizni qondirish va yo'qligimizda yolg'izligingizni yengillashtirish uchun yetarli narsa topasiz.

en: But we entreat you to forbear opening the golden door; for if you do, we shall never see you again; and this is the cause of our grief.” We separated and I remained alone in the castle.
uz: Lekin biz sizdan oltin eshikni ochmasligingizni so'raymiz; chunki agar ochsangiz, biz sizni hech qachon ko'rmaymiz; va bu bizning qayg'umizga sabab bo'ladi. Biz ajrashdik va men qal'ada yolg'iz qoldim.

en: I determined not to forget the advice they had given me not to open the golden door; but as I was permitted to satisfy my curiosity in everything else, I took the first of the keys of the other doors, which were hung in regular order.
uz: Men ularning oltin eshikni ochmaslik haqidagi maslahatini unutmaslikka qaror qildim; lekin menga boshqa hamma narsada qiziqishimni qondirishga ruxsat berilganligi sababli, boshqa eshiklarning birinchi kalitini oldim, ular muntazam tartibda osilib turardi.

en: I opened the first door, and entered an orchard, which I believe the universe could not equal.
uz: Men birinchi eshikni ochdim va bog'ga kirdim, menimcha, uni olam tenglasha olmaydi.

en: The admirable order of the trees, the abundance and diversity of unknown fruits, their freshness and beauty, delighted me.
uz: Daraxtlarning hayratlanarli tartibliligi, noma'lum mevalarning mo'l-ko'lligi va xilma-xilligi, ularning yangiligi va go'zalligi meni xursand qildi.

en: Small channels carried water to the roots of the trees whose fruit far exceeded in
uz: Kichik kanallar suvni mevali daraxtlarning ildizlariga olib borardi.

en: I Opened the Third Door and Found a Large Aviary size the ordinary fruits in our gardens.
uz: Uchinchi eshikni ochdim va bog'larimizdagi oddiy mevalar kabi katta parranda o'lchamini topdim.

en: I shut the door, and opened the next.
uz: Men eshikni yopdim va keyingisini ochdim.

en: Instead of an orchard, I found here a flower-garden, which was no less extraordinary in its kind.
uz: Bog' o'rniga, bu yerda o'ziga xos bo'lgan gul bog'ini topdim.

en: The roses, jessamines, violets, daffodils, hyacinths, anemones, tulips, pinks, lilies, and an infinite number of flowers, which do not grow in other places but at certain times, were there flourishing all at once; and nothing could be more delicious than the fragrance they emitted.
uz: Atirgullar, jessaminlar, binafsha ranglar, nargislar, gitsintlar, anemonlar, lolalar, pushtilar, nilufarlar va boshqa joylarda o'smaydigan, ammo ma'lum vaqtlarda unib chiqadigan cheksiz miqdordagi gullar bir vaqtning o'zida gullab-yashnadi; va ular tarqatgan xushbo'y hiddan ko'ra mazaliroq hech narsa bo'lmas edi.

en: I opened the third door, and found a large aviary, paved with marble of several fine and uncommon colors.
uz: Uchinchi eshikni ochdim va bir nechta nozik va g'ayrioddiy ranglardagi marmar bilan qoplangan katta parrandaxonani topdim.

en: The trelliswork was made of sandalwood and wood of aloes.
uz: Trellis yog'och sandal va aloy yog'ochidan yasalgan edi.

en: It contained a vast number of nightingales, goldfinches, canary-birds, larks, and other singing birds, and the vessels that held their seed were of the most sparkling jasper or agate.
uz: Unda juda ko'p bulbullar, goldenfinchlar, kanarey qushlari, laqqalar va boshqa qo'shiqchi qushlar bor edi va ularning urug'ini ushlab turgan idishlar eng yorqin yaspis yoki ag'atdan edi.

en: The sun went down, and I retired, charmed with the notes of the multitude of birds, who then began to perch upon such places as suited them for repose during the night.
uz: Quyosh botdi va men qushlarning ko'p sonli qo'shiqlariga maftun bo'lib, chekindim, ular keyin tun davomida dam olish uchun mos bo'lgan joylarga qo'na boshladilar.

en: went to my chamber, resolving on the following days to open all the rest of the doors, excepting that of gold.
uz: Men o'z xonamga bordim va keyingi kunlarda oltindan tashqari qolgan barcha eshiklarni ochishga qaror qildim.

en: The next day I opened the fourth door.
uz: Ertasi kuni to'rtinchi eshikni ochdim.

en: I entered a large court, surrounded with forty gates, all open, and through each of them was an entrance into a treasury.
uz: Men katta hovliga kirdim, uning atrofida qirqta darvoza bor edi, hammasi ochiq edi va ularning har biri orqali xazinaga kirish joyi bor edi.

en: The first was stored with heaps of pearls.
uz: Birinchisi marvaridlar uyumi bilan saqlangan edi.

en: In the second treasury, were diamonds, carbuncles, and rubies; in the third, emeralds; in the fourth, ingots of gold; in the fifth, objects of carven ivory; in the sixth, ingots of silver; and in the two following, money.
uz: Ikkinchi xazinada olmoslar, karbunkullar va rubinlar bor edi; uchinchisida zumradlar; to'rtinchisida oltindan yasalgan teshiklar; beshinchisida o'yilgan fil suyagi buyumlari; oltinchisida kumushdan yasalgan teshiklar; va keyingi ikkitasida pul bor edi.

en: The rest contained amethysts, chrysolites, topazes, opals, turquoises, agate, jasper, cornelian, and coral, of which there was a storehouse filled, not only with branches, but whole trees.
uz: Qolgan qismida ametizmlar, xrizollitlar, topazlar, opallar, turkuazlar, agate, yasper, korneliya va marvaridlar bor edi, ulardan faqat shoxlar bilan emas, balki butun daraxtlar bilan to'ldirilgan ombor bor edi.

en: Thus, day by day, I went through these various wonders.
uz: Shunday qilib, kun sayin men bu turli mo'jizalarni boshdan kechirdim.

en: Thirty- nine days afforded me but just as much time as was necessary to open ninety-nine doors, and to admire all that presented itself to my view, so that there was only the hundredth door left, which I was forbidden to open.
uz: O'ttiz to'qqiz kun menga imkon berdi, lekin to'qson to'qqizta eshikni ochish va ko'zimga ko'rinadigan hamma narsaga qoyil qolish uchun zarur bo'lgan shuncha vaqt, shunda faqat yuzinchi eshik qoldi, uni ochish menga taqiqlangan edi.

en: The fortieth day after the departure of the princesses arrived, and had I but retained the self-command I ought to have had, I should have been this day the happiest of all mankind, whereas now I am the most unfortunate.
uz: Malikalarning ketishidan keyingi qirqinchi kun keldi va agar men o'zimga bo'ysunishim kerak bo'lgan hukmronlikni saqlab qolganimda edi, bugun butun insoniyat orasida eng baxtli bo'lardim, hozir esa eng baxtsizman.

en: But through my weakness, which I shall ever repent, I opened that fatal door!
uz: Lekin men hech qachon tavba qilmaydigan zaifligim tufayli, o'sha halokatli eshikni ochdim!

en: Before I had moved my foot to enter, a smell, pleasant enough, but too powerful for my senses, made me faint away.
uz: Oyog'imni ichkariga kirishga harakat qilmasimdan oldin, bir hid, yetarlicha yoqimli, lekin sezgilarim uchun juda kuchli bo'lgani, meni hushdan ketishga majbur qildi.

en: However, I soon recovered; instead of taking warning from this incident to close the door and restrain my curiosity, I entered, and found myself in a spacious vaulted apartment, illuminated by several large tapers placed in candlesticks of solid gold.
uz: Biroq, tez orada tuzalib ketdim; eshikni yopish va qiziquvchanligimni tiyish uchun bu hodisadan ogohlantirish o'rniga, ichkariga kirdim va o'zimni keng gumbazli kvartirada topdim, unda bir nechta katta chiroqlar qattiq oltindan yasalgan shamdonlarda yoritilgan edi.

en: Among the many objects that attracted my attention was a black horse, of the most perfect symmetry and beauty.
uz: E'tiborimni tortgan ko'plab ob'ektlar orasida eng mukammal simmetriya va go'zallikka ega bo'lgan qora ot bor edi.

en: I approached in order the better to observe him, and found he had on a saddle and bridle of massive gold, curiously wrought.
uz: Men uni yaxshiroq kuzatish uchun yaqinlashdim va uning katta oltindan yasalgan, g'aroyib tarzda yasalgan egari va jilovini topdim.

en: One part of his manger was filled with clean barley, and the other with rose water.
uz: Uning bir qismi toza arpa bilan, ikkinchisi esa atirgul suvi bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

en: I laid hold of his bridle, and led him out to view him by daylight.
uz: Men uning tumshug'ini ushladim va uni kunduzgi yorug'likda ko'rishga olib chiqdim.

en: and endeavored to make him move; but finding he did not stir, I struck him with a switch I had taken up in his magnificent stable.
uz: Va uni harakatlantirishga harakat qildim; lekin u qimirlamayotganini ko'rib, uni uning ulug'vor o'rmonida olgan kalitim bilan urdim.

en: He had no sooner felt the whip, than he began to neigh in a most horrible manner, and extending wings, He Flew Up with Me into the Air which I had not before perceived, flew up with me into the air.
uz: U qamchini sezmasidan oldin, u juda dahshatli tarzda qichqirishni boshladi va qanotlarini cho'zgan holda, u men bilan birga Havoda uchdi, men ilgari sezmagan narsa, men bilan birga havoga uchdi.

en: My thoughts were fully occupied in keeping my seat; and considering the fear that had seized me, I sat well.
uz: Mening fikrlarim o'rnimni ushlab turishga to'liq band edi; va meni qamrab olgan qo'rquvni hisobga olgan holda, men yaxshi o'tirdim.

en: At length he directed his course toward the earth, and lighting upon the terrace of a palace, without giving me time to dismount, shook me out of the saddle with such force as to throw me behind him, and with the end of his tail struck out my eye.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u yerga qarab yo'naldi va saroy terassasida yoritib, menga tushishga vaqt bermasdan, meni orqasiga tashlaydigan darajada kuch bilan egardan chiqarib yubordi va dumining uchi ko'zimga urdi.

en: Thus it was I became blind of one eye.
uz: Shunday qilib, men bir ko'zimni ko'r bo'lib qoldim.

en: I then recollected the predictions of the ten young gentlemen.
uz: Keyin o'nta yosh janobning bashoratlarini esladim.

en: The horse again took wing, and soon disappeared.
uz: Ot yana qanot oldi va tez orada g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: I got up, sorrowing at the misfortune I had brought upon myself.
uz: O'zimga yetkazgan baxtsizlikdan qayg'urib, o'rnimdan turdim.

en: For a while I walked upon the terrace, covering my eye with one of my hands, for it pained me exceedingly, and then descended, and entered into a hall.
uz: Bir oz vaqt davomida ayvonda yurdim, ko'zimni bir qo'lim bilan yopdim, chunki u meni juda og'ritardi, keyin pastga tushdim va zalga kirdim.

en: I soon discovered by the ten seats in a circle and the eleventh in the middle, lower than
uz: Tez orada doira ichidagi o'nta o'rindiq va o'rtadagi o'n birinchi o'rindiqni, pastroq ekanligini aniqladim.

en: the rest, that I was in the castle whence I had been carried by the roc.
uz: Qolgani, men qoyalar tomonidan olib ketilgan qasrda edim.

en: The ten young men seemed not at all surprised to see me, nor at the loss of my eye; but said, “We are sorry that we cannot congratulate you on your return, as we could wish; but we are not the cause of your misfortune.” “I should do you wrong,” I replied, “to lay it to your charge; I have only myself to accuse.” “If,” said they, “it be a subject of consolation to know that others share your sufferings, you have in us this alleviation of your misfortune.
uz: O'nta yigit meni ko'rib hech qanday ajablanmadi, ko'zimni yo'qotishga ham; lekin ular dedilar: Sizni qaytib kelganingiz bilan biz xohlaganimizdek tabriklay olmasligimizdan afsusdamiz; lekin biz sizning baxtsizligingizga sababchi emasmiz. Sizga yomonlik qilishim kerak edi, deb javob berdim men, Senga ayblash uchun; faqat o'zimni ayblashim kerak edi. Agar, deyishsa, Boshqalar sizning azoblaringizni baham ko'rishini bilish tasalli beradi, sizda sizning baxtsizligingizning yengilligi bor.

en: All that has happened to you we have endured; we each of us tasted the same pleasures during a year; and we would enjoy them yet, had we not opened the golden door, when the princesses were absent.
uz: Sizga bo'lgan hamma narsani biz bardosh berdik; har birimiz bir yil davomida bir xil lazzatlarni tatib ko'rdik; va biz hali ham ulardan bahramand bo'lardik, agar biz malikalar yo'qligida oltin eshikni ochmaganimizda edi.

en: You have been no wiser than we, and have incurred the same punishment.
uz: Siz bizdan donoroq emassiz va xuddi shunday jazoga duchor bo'ldingiz.

en: We would gladly receive you into our company, to join us in the penance to which we are bound, and the duration of which we know not.
uz: Sizni kompaniyamizga qabul qilishdan mamnun bo'lardik, biz bog'langan va davomiyligi noma'lum bo'lgan tavbada bizga qo'shilishingiz uchun.

en: But we have already told you the reasons that render this impossible; depart, therefore, and proceed to the court of Bagdad, where you will meet with the person who is to decide your destiny.” After they had explained to me the road I was to travel, I departed.
uz: Lekin biz sizga buni imkonsiz qiladigan sabablarni allaqachon aytib bo'ldik; shuning uchun keting va Bag'dod saroyiga boring, u yerda taqdiringizni hal qiladigan odam bilan uchrashasiz. Ular menga qanday yo'l bilan borishim kerakligini tushuntirganlaridan so'ng, men ketdim.

en: On the road I caused my beard and eyebrows to be shaven, and assumed a calender’s habit.
uz: Yo'lda soqol va qoshlarimni qirqishga majbur bo'ldim va kalendar odatini qabul qildim.

en: I have had a long journey, but at last I arrived this evening, and met these, my brother calenders, at the gate.
uz: Uzoq safar qildim, lekin nihoyat shu oqshom yetib keldim va bularni, akamning taqvimlarini, darvozada uchratdim.

en: We were mutually surprised to see that we were all blind of the same eye; but we had not leisure to converse long on the subject of our misfortunes.
uz: Biz hammamiz bir ko'z bilan ko'r ekanligimizni ko'rib, o'zaro hayron qoldik; lekin baxtsiz hodisalarimiz mavzusida uzoq suhbatlashishga vaqtimiz bo'lmadi.

en: The third calender having finished the relation of his adventures, Zobeide addressed him and his fellow-calenders thus: “Go wherever you think proper; you are at liberty.” But one of them answered, “Madam, we beg you to pardon our curiosity, and permit us to hear the stories of your other guests who have not yet spoken.” Then the lady turned to the caliph, the vizier Giafar, and Mesrour, and said to them, “It is now your turn to speak.”
uz: Uchinchi kalendar o'z sarguzashtlari haqidagi ma'lumotni tugatgach, Zobeide unga va uning hamkasblariga shunday dedi: Qayerga to'g'ri deb o'ylasangiz, boring; ozod bo'lasiz. Ammo ulardan biri javob berdi: Xonim, biz sizni qiziqishimizni kechirishingizni va hali gapirmagan boshqa mehmonlaringizning hikoyalarini eshitishga ruxsat beramiz. Shunda xonim xalifa, vazir Giafar va Mesrourga murojaat qildi va ularga dedi: Endi gapirish uchun navbat keldi.

en: The grand vizier answered Zobeide: “Madam, we need only repeat what we have already said to the fair lady who opened the door.
uz: Bosh vazir Zobeidega javob berdi: Xonim, eshikni ochgan gozal xonimga aytganlarimizni takrorlashimiz kifoya.

en: We are merchants come to Bagdad to sell our merchandise, which lies in the khan where we lodge.
uz: Biz Bag'dodda joylashgan xonada joylashgan tovarlarimizni sotish uchun kelgan savdogarlarmiz.

en: We dined to-day with several other persons of our condition, at a merchant’s house of this city; who after he had treated us with choice dainties and excellent wines, sent for men and women dancers and musicians.
uz: Bugun biz bir nechta boshqa odamlar bilan shu shaharlik savdogarning uyida ovqatlandik; u bizga ajoyib taomlar va ajoyib vinolar bilan munosabatda bo'lgandan so'ng, erkaklar va ayollar raqqoslari va musiqachilarini taklif qildi.

en: The great noise we made brought in the watch, who arrested some of the company, but we had the good fortune to escape; it being already late, and the door of our khan shut up, we knew not whither to go.
uz: Biz chiqargan katta shovqin soatga olib kirdi, ular kompaniyaning bir qismini hibsga olishdi, lekin biz qochishga omadimiz keldi; allaqachon kech bo'lgani va xonimizning eshigi yopilib qolgani sababli, qayerga borishni bilmas edik.

en: We chanced, as we passed along this street, to hear music at your house, which made us determine to knock at your gate.
uz: Biz shu ko'chadan o'tayotganimizda, uyingizda musiqa eshitishga muvaffaq bo'ldik, bu esa bizni sizning darvozaingizga taqillatishga majbur qildi.

en: This is all the account that we can give you, in obedience to your commands.” “Well, then,” said Zobeide, “you shall all be equally obliged to me: I pardon you all, provided you immediately depart.” Zobeide having given this command, the caliph, the vizier, Mesrour, the three calenders, and the porter, departed; for the presence of the seven slaves with their weapons awed them into silence.
uz: Bu sizning buyruqlaringizga itoatkorlik bilan sizga bera oladigan barcha hisobot. Xo'sh, unda,  dedi Zobeide, hammangiz menga teng majburiyatdor bo'lasiz: men hammangizni kechiraman, agar siz darhol ketsangiz. Zobeide bu buyruqni berganidan so'ng, xalifa, vazir, Mesrour, uchta taqvim va ko'tarib boruvchi ketdi; chunki ularning qurollari bilan yetti qulning hozirligi ularni jim qildi.
