en: As soon as they had quitted the house, and the gate was closed after them, the caliph said to the calenders without making himself known, “You, gentlemen, who are newly come to town, which way do you design to go, since it is not yet day?” “It is this,” they replied, “that perplexes us.” “Follow us,” resumed the caliph, “and we will convey you out of danger.” He then whispered to the vizier: “Take them along with you, and to-morrow morning bring them to me.” The vizier Giafar took the three calenders along with him; the porter went to his quarters, and the caliph and Mesrour returned to the palace.
uz: Ular uydan chiqib ketishlari bilanoq, darvoza ulardan keyin yopilganida, xalifa o'zini ko'rsatmasdan kalendarlarga dedi: Siz, janoblar, shaharga yangi kelganlar, hali kunduz bo'lmagani uchun qanday yo'l bilan borishni rejalashtiryapsizlar? Shuningdek, deyishdi ular, bu bizni hayratga soladi. Bizga ergashinglar, xalifa davom etdi, va biz sizni xavfdan xalos qilamiz. Keyin u vazirga pichirladi: Ularni o'zingiz bilan olib ketinglar, ertaga ertalab menga olib kelinglar. Vazir Giafar uchta kalendarni o'zi bilan olib ketdi; portier o'z xonalariga bordi va xalifa va Mesrour saroyga qaytdi.

en: On the following morning, as the day dawned, the Sultan Haroun al Raschid arose, went to his council-chamber, and sat upon his throne.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, tong otishi bilanoq, Sulton Horun al-Rashid o'rnidan turdi, o'zining kengash xonasiga bordi va taxtga o'tirdi.

en: The grand vizier entered soon after, and made his obeisance.
uz: Buyuk vazir tez orada ichkariga kirdi va taslim bo'ldi.

en: “Vizier,” said the caliph, “go, bring those ladies and the calenders; make haste, and remember that I impatiently expect your return.”
uz: Vazir, dedi xalifa, bor, o'sha xonimlarni va kalendarlarni olib kel; shoshiling va eslangki, men sizning qaytishingizni sabrsizlik bilan kutaman.

en: The vizier, who knew his master’s quick and fiery temper, hastened to obey.
uz: Vazir, xo'jayinining tezkor va olovli g'azabini bilgan holda, itoat etishga shoshildi.

en: When they had arrived, the caliph turned toward the ladies and said, “I was last night in your house, disguised in a merchant’s habit; but I am Haroun al Raschid, the fifth caliph of the glorious house of Abbas, and hold the place of our great prophet.
uz: Ular yetib kelganlarida, xalifa ayollarga qarab dedi: Men kecha kechqurun sizning uyingizda savdogarlik odatida yashirinib yurgan edim; lekin men Abbasning ulugvor uyining beshinchi xalifasi Horun al-Rashidman va buyuk paygambarimizning ornini egallayapman.

en: I have sent for you to know who you are, and to ask for what reason one of you, after severely whipping the two black dogs, wept with them.
uz: Sizni kimligingizni bilish uchun yubordim va sizlardan biri ikki qora itni qattiq qamchilab, ular bilan birga nima uchun yig'laganini so'rash uchun.

en: And I am no less curious to know why another of you has her bosom scarred.” Upon hearing these words, Zobeide thus related her story.
uz: Va men ham sizlardan yana biringizning ko'kragingiz nima uchun chandiqlanganini bilishga qiziqaman. Bu so'zlarni eshitgach, Zobeide o'z hikoyasini shunday hikoya qildi.

en: The History of Zobeide Commander of the Faithful, my story is truly wonderful.
uz: Zobeide Dindorlar Qo'mondonining tarixi, mening hikoyam haqiqatan ham ajoyib.

en: The two black dogs and myself are sisters by the same father and mother.
uz: Ikki qora it va men bir otadan va bir onadan opa-singilmiz.

en: The two ladies who are now here are also my sisters, but by another mother.
uz: Hozir bu yerda bo'lgan ikki xonim ham mening opa-singillarim, lekin boshqa ona tomonidan.

en: After our father’s death, the property that he left was equally divided among us.
uz: Otamiz vafotidan so'ng, u qoldirgan mulk biz o'rtamizda teng taqsimlandi.

en: My two half sisters left me, that they might live with their mother.
uz: Mening ikki o'gay singlim meni onasi bilan yashashlari uchun tashlab ketishdi.

en: My two sisters and myself remained with our own mother.
uz: Mening ikki singlim va men o'z onamiz bilan qoldik.

en: At her death she left us three thousand sequins each.
uz: U o'limida bizga har biriga uch ming qunduk qoldirdi.

en: Shortly after my sisters had received their portions,
uz: Singillarim o'z ulushlarini olgandan ko'p o'tmay,

en: they married; but their husbands, having spent all their fortunes, found some pretext for divorcing them, and put them away.
uz: Ular turmush qurishdi; lekin erlari butun mol-mulklarini sarflab, ularni ajrashish uchun biron bir bahona topib, ularni turmushga chiqarib yuborishdi.

en: I received them into my house, and gave them a share of all my goods.
uz: Men ularni uyimga qabul qildim va barcha mol-mulkimdan ularga bir ulush berdim.

en: At the end of a twelvemonth, my sisters again resolved to marry, and did so.
uz: O'n ikki oy oxirida, opa-singillarim yana turmushga chiqishga qaror qilishdi va shunday qilishdi.

en: After some months were passed, they returned again in the same sad condition; I admitted them to live with me as before, and we dwelt together for the space of a year.
uz: Bir necha oy o'tgach, ular yana o'sha qayg'uli holatda qaytishdi; men ularni oldingidek men bilan yashashga qabul qildim va biz bir yil davomida birga yashadik.

en: After this I determined to engage in a commercial speculation.
uz: Shundan so'ng men tijorat spekulyatsiyasiga kirishishga qaror qildim.

en: For this purpose I went with my two sisters to Bussorah, where I bought a ship ready fitted for sea, and loaded her with merchandise I had carried with me from Bagdad.
uz: Shu maqsadda men ikki singlim bilan Bussoraga bordim, u yerda dengiz uchun tayyor kemani sotib oldim va unga Bag'dodda o'zim bilan olib kelgan tovarlarni yukladim.

en: We set sail with a fair wind and the twentieth day saw land.
uz: Biz go'zal shamol bilan suzib ketdik va yigirmanchi kuni quruqlikni ko'rdik.

en: It was a high mountain, at the bottom of which we perceived a great town; having a fresh gale, we soon reached the harbor, and cast anchor.
uz: Bu baland tog' edi, uning ostida biz katta shaharni sezardik; yangi shamol esgach, tez orada portga yetib keldik va langar tashladik.

en: I had not patience to wait till my sisters were dressed to go along with me, but went ashore alone in the boat.
uz: Singillarim men bilan birga ketish uchun kiyinganini kutishga sabrim yetmadi, lekin qayiqda yolg'iz qirg'oqqa chiqdim.

en: Making directly to the gate of the town, I saw there a great number of men upon guard, some sitting, and others standing with weapons in their hands; and they had all such dreadful countenances that I was greatly alarmed; but perceiving they remained stationary, and did not so much as move their eyes, I took courage, and went nearer, when I found they were all turned into stone.
uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri shahar darvozasiga borar ekanman, u yerda juda ko'p qo'riqlanadigan odamlarni ko'rdim, ba'zilari o'tirgan, boshqalari esa qo'llarida qurol bilan turgan; va ularning barchasi shunday dahshatli qiyofaga ega ediki, men juda vahimaga tushdim; lekin ularning qotib qolganini va ko'zlarini ko'p qimirlatmaganini payqaganimda, jasorat ko'rdim va yaqinlashdim, qachonki ularning hammasi toshga aylanganini ko'rsam.

en: I entered the town and passed through several streets, where at different intervals stood men in various attitudes, but all motionless and petrified.
uz: Men shaharga kirdim va bir nechta ko'chalardan o'tdim, u yerda turli xil holatdagi odamlar turli oraliqlarda turardi, lekin ularning hammasi harakatsiz va toshga aylangan edi.

en: In the quarter inhabited by the merchants I found most of the shops open; there I likewise found the people petrified.
uz: Savdogarlar yashaydigan hududda do'konlarning ko'pchiligini ochiq topdim; u yerda odamlarning toshbo'ronligini ham ko'rdim.

en: Having reached a vast square, in the heart of the city, I perceived a large folding gate, covered with plates of gold, which stood open; a curtain of silk stuff was drawn before it; a lamp hung over the entrance.
uz: Shaharning markazida joylashgan keng maydonga yetib borgach, ochiq turgan, oltin plitalar bilan qoplangan katta buklanadigan darvozani ko'rdim; uning oldida ipakdan yasalgan parda tortilgan edi; kirish joyi ustida chiroq osilgan edi.

en: After I had surveyed the building, I made no doubt but it was the palace of the prince who reigned over that country; and being much astonished that I had not met with one living creature, I approached in hopes to find some.
uz: Binoni ko'zdan kechirganimdan so'ng, shubhalanmadimki, bu o'sha mamlakat ustidan hukmronlik qilgan shahzoda saroyi edi; va birorta tirik mavjudot bilan uchrashmaganimdan juda hayron bo'lib, uni topishga umid qilib yaqinlashdim.

en: I lifted up the curtain, and was surprised at beholding no one but the guards in the vestibule, all petrified.
uz: Men parda ko'tardim va hayron bo'ldim, faqat oldidagi qo'riqchilardan boshqa hech kimni ko'rmadim, ularning hammasi toshbo'ron edi.

en: I came to a large court.
uz: Men katta sudga keldim.

en: I went from thence into a room richly furnished, where I found a lady also turned into a statue of stone.
uz: U yerdan boy jihozlangan xonaga kirdim va u yerda tosh haykalga aylangan bir xonimni topdim.

en: The crown of gold on her head, and a necklace of pearls about her neck, each of them as large as a nut, proclaimed her to be the queen.
uz: Uning boshidagi oltin toj va bo'ynida marvaridlar bog'lami, ularning har biri gayka kabi katta, uni malika deb e'lon qildi.

en: I quitted the chamber where the petrified queen was, and passed through several other apartments richly furnished, and at last came into a large room, where there was a throne of massy gold, raised several steps above the floor, and enriched with large inchased emeralds.
uz: Men toshbo'ron qirolicha yotgan xonadan chiqdim va boy jihozlangan bir nechta boshqa xonadonlardan o'tdim, nihoyat katta oltindan yasalgan taxta, poldan bir necha qadam yuqoriga ko'tarilgan va katta injasli zumradlar bilan boyitilgan katta xonaga kirdim.

en: What surprised me most was a sparkling which came from above the throne.
uz: Meni eng hayratda qoldirgani taxt tepasidan chiqqan chaqnash edi.

en: Being curious, I ascended the steps, and saw a diamond as large as the egg of an ostrich; it was so pure that I could not find the least blemish in it, and it sparkled with so much brilliancy, that I could not endure its luster.
uz: Qiziqib, zinapoyalarga ko'tarildim va tuyaqushning tuxumi kabi katta olmosni ko'rdim; u shunchalik toza ediki, undagi eng kam nuqsonni topa olmasdim va shunchalik yorqinlik bilan porlardi, uning yaltirog'iga chiday olmasdim.

en: The doors being all open, I surveyed some other apartments, that were as beautiful as those I had already seen.
uz: Eshiklar hammasi ochiq bo'lgani uchun, men allaqachon ko'rganlarimdek go'zal bo'lgan boshqa kvartiralarni ko'zdan kechirdim.

en: In the mean time night came on, and I tried to return by the way I had entered, but I could not find it; I lost myself among the apartments; and perceiving I was come again to the large room, where the throne stood, I resolved to take my night’s lodging there, and to depart the next morning early, to get aboard my ship.
uz: Ayni paytda tun tushdi va men kirgan yo'ldan qaytishga harakat qildim, lekin uni topa olmadim; xonadonlar orasida adashib qoldim; va taxtim turgan katta xonaga qaytganimni anglab yetib, u yerda tunab qolishga qaror qildim va ertasi kuni ertalab jo'nab, kemamga chiqishga qaror qildim.

en: I laid myself down upon a beautiful couch, not without some dread to be alone in a desolate place; and this fear hindered my sleep.
uz: Men o'zimni go'zal divanga yotqizdim, hech qanday qo'rquvsiz, vayrona joyda yolg'iz qolishga yo'l qo'ymadim; va bu qo'rquv uyquimga to'sqinlik qildi.

en: About midnight I heard a man reading the Koran, in the same tone as it is read in our mosques.
uz: Taxminan yarim tunda men bir odamni masjidlarimizda o'qilgan ohangda Qur'onni o'qiyotganini eshitdim.

en: I immediately arose, going toward the sound of the voice until I found myself in an oratory.
uz: Men darhol o'rnidan turdim, ovoz tovushiga qarab ketdim, toki o'zimni notiqlikda topsam.

en: It had, as we have in our mosques, a niche, to direct us whither we are to turn to say our prayers: there were also lamps hung up, and two candlesticks with large tapers of white wax burning.
uz: Bizning masjidlarimizda bo'lgani kabi, bizni duo qilish uchun qayerga murojaat qilishimiz kerakligiga yo'naltiradigan joy bor edi: shuningdek, osilgan chiroqlar va oq mumdan yasalgan katta uchlari bor ikkita shamdon bor edi.

en: I saw a comely young man sitting on a carpet reading with great devotion the Koran, which lay before him on a desk.
uz: Men go'zal bir yigitni gilam ustida o'tirib, Qur'onni katta e'tiqod bilan o'qiyotganini ko'rdim, Qur'on uning oldida stol ustida yotardi.

en: I wondered how it came to pass that he should be the only living creature in a town where all the people were turned into stone, and I did not doubt but there was something in the circumstance very extraordinary.
uz: O'yladimki, u butun odamlari toshga aylangan shaharda yagona tirik mavjudot bo'lishi qanday qilib sodir bo'lishi mumkin edi va men shubhalanmadim, lekin vaziyatda juda g'ayrioddiy narsa bor edi.

en: I exclaimed, “Bismillah!
uz: Men: Bismillah! deb faryod qildim.

en: Praise be to God.” The young man turned toward me, and, having saluted me, inquired what had brought me to this desolate city.
uz: Xudoga hamd bo'lsin. Yigit menga o'girilib, salom berib, meni bu vayrona shaharga nima olib kelganini so'radi.

en: I told him in a few words my history, and I prayed him to tell me why he alone was left alive in the midst of such terrible desolation.
uz: Men unga o'z tariximni bir necha so'z bilan aytib berdim va undan nega bunday dahshatli vayronagarchilik ichida yolg'iz o'zi tirik qolganini aytishini so'radim.

en: At these words he shut the Koran, put it into a rich case, and laid it in the niche, and thus addressed me: “Know that this city was the metropolis of a mighty kingdom, over which the sultan, who was my father, reigned.
uz: Shu so'zlardan so'ng u Qur'onni yopdi, uni boy qutiga soldi va nişga qo'ydi va shunday qilib menga murojaat qildi: Bilaginki, bu shahar qudratli bir shohlikning metropoliyasi edi, uning ustidan otam bo'lgan sultan hukmronlik qilardi.

en: That prince, his whole court, the inhabitants of the city, and all his other subjects, were magi, worshipers of fire instead of God.
uz: O'sha shahzoda, uning butun saroyi, shahar aholisi va uning barcha boshqa fuqarolari sehrgarlar, Xudo o'rniga olovga sig'inuvchilar edi.

en: “But though I was born of an idolatrous father and mother, I had the good fortune in my youth to have a nurse who was a good Mussulman, believing in God and in His prophet.
uz: Lekin men butparast ota va onadan tug'ilgan bo'lsam ham, yoshligimda Xudoga va Uning payg'ambariga ishonuvchi, yaxshi musulmon bo'lgan hamshiraga ega bo'lish baxtiga muyassar bo'ldim.

en: ‘Dear prince,’ would she oftentimes say, ‘there is but one true God; take heed that you do not acknowledge and adore any other.’ She died, but not before she had perfectly instructed me in the Mussulman religion.
uz: Aziz shahzoda, der edi u ko'pincha, haqiqiy Xudo faqat bitta; boshqa hech kimni tan olmasligingizga va unga sig'inmasligingizga e'tibor bering. U vafot etdi, lekin u menga musulmon dinini mukammal o'rgatmasidan oldin emas.

en: After her death, I persisted in worshiping according to its directions; and I abhor the adoration of fire.
uz: Uning o'limidan so'ng, men uning yo'riqnomalariga ko'ra ibodat qilishda davom etdim; va olovga sig'inishni nafratlandim.

en: “About three years and some months ago, a thundering voice sounded so distinctly through the whole city, that nobody could miss hearing it.
uz: Taxminan uch yil va bir necha oy oldin, butun shahar bo'ylab momaqaldiroq ovozi shunchalik aniq eshitilardi, uni hech kim eshitmay qolmasdi.

en: The words were these: ‘Inhabitants, abandon the worship of fire, and worship the only God who shows mercy.’ This voice was heard three years successively, but no one was converted.
uz: So'zlar shunday edi: Aholisi, olovga sig'inishni tark etinglar va faqat rahm-shafqat ko'rsatuvchi Xudoga sig'ininglar. Bu ovoz ketma-ket uch yil eshitildi, lekin hech kim iymonga kelmadi.

en: On the last day of that year, at the break of day, all the inhabitants were changed in an instant into stone, every one in the condition and posture he happened to be in.
uz: O'sha yilning oxirgi kunida, kunduzgi tongda, barcha aholi bir zumda toshga aylandi, ularning har biri o'z holatida va holatida edi.

en: The sultan, my father, and the queen, my mother, shared the same fate.
uz: Sulton, otam va malika, onam bir xil taqdirga ega edilar.

en: “I am the only person who did not suffer under that heavy judgment, and ever since I have continued to serve God with more fervency than before.
uz: Men o'sha og'ir hukm ostida azob chekmagan yagona odamman va shundan beri Xudoga avvalgidan ham ko'proq ishtiyoq bilan xizmat qilishni davom ettirdim.

en: I am persuaded, dear lady, that He has sent you hither for my comfort, for which I render Him infinite thanks, for I must own that I have become weary of this solitary life.” On hearing these words, I said, “Prince, who can doubt that Providence has brought me into your port, to afford you an
uz: Men ishonaman, aziz xonim, U sizni bu yerga mening tasalliim uchun yuborgan ekanligiga, shuning uchun Unga cheksiz minnatdorchilik bildiraman, chunki men bu yolg'iz hayotdan charchaganimni anglashim kerak. Bu so'zlarni eshitganimda, men aytdim: Ey shahzoda, meni Quruqlik sizning portingizga olib kelganligiga shubha qila oladigan, sizga imkon berish uchun...

en: opportunity of withdrawing from this dismal place.
uz: Bu dahshatli joydan chiqib ketish imkoniyati.

en: I am a lady of Bagdad, where I have considerable property; and I dare engage to promise you sanctuary there, until the mighty Commander of the Faithful, caliph of our prophet, whom you acknowledge, shows you the honor that is due your merit.
uz: Men Bag'dodning xonimman, menda katta boylik bor; va men sizga u yerda muqaddas joy va'da qilishga jur'at etaman, toki siz tan olgan mo'minlarning qudratli qo'mondoni, payg'ambarimizning xalifasi sizga o'z merosiga loyiq bo'lgan hurmatni ko'rsatmaguncha.

en: Stay no longer in a city where you can only renew your grief; my vessel is at your service, where you may absolutely command as you shall think fit.” He accepted the offer, and as soon as it was day we left the palace, and went aboard my ship, where we found my sisters, the captain, and the slaves, all much troubled at my absence.
uz: Endi qayg'ungizni yangilash mumkin bo'lgan shaharda qolmang; mening kemam sizning xizmatingizda, u yerda siz o'zingiz xohlagancha qat'iy buyruq berishingiz mumkin. U taklifni qabul qildi va kun bo'lishi bilanoq saroyni tark etib, kemamga bordik, u yerda mening opa-singillarim, kapitan va qullar meni yo'qligimdan juda bezovta bo'lganini topdik.

en: After I had presented my sisters to the prince, I told them what had hindered my return the day before, how I had met with the young prince, his story, and the cause of the desolation of so fine a city.
uz: Opa-singillarimni shahzodaga ko'rsatganimdan so'ng, ularga bir kun avval qaytib kelishimga nima to'sqinlik qilganini, yosh shahzoda bilan qanday uchrashganimni, uning hikoyasini va shunchalik go'zal shaharning vayron bo'lishining sababini aytdim.

en: The seamen were taken up several days in unlading the merchandise I brought with me, and embarking in its stead many of the precious things in the palace, especially jewels, gold, and money.
uz: Dengizchilar men olib kelgan tovarlarni bir necha kun davomida tushirishdi va uning o'rniga saroydagi ko'plab qimmatbaho narsalarni, ayniqsa javohirlar, oltin va pulni olib ketishdi.

en: After we had laden the vessel with what we thought most desirable, we took such provisions and water aboard as were necessary for our voyage; at last we set sail with a favorable wind.
uz: Kemani eng maqbul deb hisoblagan narsalarimiz bilan yuklaganimizdan so'ng, sayohatimiz uchun zarur bo'lgan barcha taomlar va suvni bortga oldik; nihoyat, qulay shamol bilan jo'nadik.

en: The young prince, my sisters, and myself passed our time very agreeably.
uz: Yosh shahzoda, opa-singillarim va men o'z vaqtimizni juda yoqimli o'tkazdik.

en: this good understanding did not last long, for my sisters grew jealous of the friendship between the prince and myself, and maliciously asked me one day, what we should do with him when we came to Bagdad.
uz: Bu yaxshi tushunish uzoq davom etmadi, chunki opa-singillarim shahzoda va men o'rtasidagi do'stlikdan rashk qilishdi va bir kuni mendan Bag'dodga kelganimizda u bilan nima qilishimiz kerakligini yomon niyat bilan so'rashdi.

en: Resolving to put this question off with a joke, I answered, “I will take him for my husband;” and upon that, turning myself to the prince, said, “Sir, I humbly beg of you to give your consent, for as soon as we come to Bagdad I design to offer you my person to be your slave, to do you all the service that is in my power, and to resign myself wholly to your commands.” The prince replied, “I know not, madam, whether you be in jest or no; but for my part, I seriously declare before these ladies, your sisters, that from this moment I heartily accept your offer, not with any intention to have you as a slave, but as my lady and wife.” At
uz: Bu savolni hazil bilan to'xtatib qo'yishga qaror qilib, javob berdim: Uni erim uchun olaman; va shundan so'ng shahzodaga o'girilib, aytdim: Janob, men sizdan rozilik so'rayman, chunki Bagdodda kelishimiz bilan sizga o'z odamimni qulingiz bo'lishga, sizga qo'limdan kelgan barcha xizmatni bajarishga va sizning buyruqlaringizga butunlay taslim bo'lishga qaror qilaman. Shahzoda javob berdi: Men bilmayman, xonim, sizda yoki yo'qligingizni; lekin o'z navbatimda, men bu xonimlar, opa-singillaringiz oldida jiddiy ravishda e'lon qilamanki, shu paytdan boshlab men sizni qul sifatida emas, balki xonim va rafiqam sifatida qabul qilish niyatidaman.

en: these words my sisters changed color, and I could perceive afterward that they did not love me as before.
uz: Bu so'zlar singillarimning rangi o'zgardi va keyinchalik ular meni avvalgidek sevmasligini angladim.

en: We entered the Persian Gulf, and had come within a short distance of Bussorah when, in the night, while I was asleep, my sisters watched their opportunity and threw me overboard.
uz: Biz Fors ko'rfaziga kirdik va Bussoradan biroz uzoq bo'lmagan joyga yetib keldik. Kechasi, men uxlayotganimda, opa-singillarim o'z imkoniyatlarini kuzatib, meni dengizdan tashqariga uloqtirishdi.

en: They did the same to the prince, who was drowned.
uz: Ular cho'kib ketgan shahzodaga ham xuddi shunday qilishdi.

en: I floated some minutes on the water, and by good fortune, or rather miracle, I felt ground.
uz: Men suvda bir necha daqiqa suzib yurdim va omad, to'g'rirog'i mo'jiza tufayli o'zimni yerga tushgan his qildim.

en: I went toward a dark spot that seemed to be land, and which, when day appeared, I found to be a deserted island, lying about twenty miles from The Serpent flew away
uz: Men quruqlikdek tuyulgan qorong'u nuqtaga tomon bordim va u, kunduz paydo bo'lgach, Yalang'ochdan yigirma milya uzoqlikda joylashgan, cho'l orol ekanligini topdim.

en: I soon dried my clothes in the sun, and as I walked along I found several kinds of fruit, and likewise fresh water, which gave me some hopes of preserving my life.
uz: Tez orada kiyimlarimni quyoshda quritdim va yo'lda ketayotib bir nechta mevalar va shuningdek, hayotimni saqlab qolishga umid beradigan chuchuk suvni topdim.

en: I had just laid myself down to rest in the shade, when I perceived a very large winged serpent coming toward me, with an irregular waving movement, and hanging out its tongue, which induced me to conclude it had received some injury.
uz: Men soyada dam olish uchun cho'kkalab yotgandim, o'shanda menga qarab kelayotgan juda katta qanotli ilonni, g'ayrioddiy tebranish harakatini va tilini osib turganini payqadim, bu esa uni qandaydir jarohat olgan deb xulosa qilishga undadi.

en: I instantly arose and perceived
uz: Men darhol o'rnidan turdim va angladim.

en: that it was pursued by a larger serpent which had hold of its tail and was endeavoring to devour it.
uz: Uni dumini ushlab turgan va uni yutishga urinayotgan kattaroq ilon ta'qib qilayotgan edi.

en: This excited my pity; instead of retreating, I took up a stone that lay near me, and threw it with all my strength at its pursuer, whom I hit upon the head and killed.
uz: Bu menga achinish uyg'otdi; chekinish o'rniga, yonimda yotgan toshni oldim va uni butun kuchim bilan uning ta'qibchisiga tashladim, uni boshimga urib o'ldirdim.

en: The other, finding itself at liberty, took wing and flew away.
uz: Boshqasi esa o'zini erkin his qilib, qanot oldi va uchib ketdi.

en: I looked after it for some time till it disappeared.
uz: Men unga bir oz vaqt g'amxo'rlik qildim, toki u yo'qolguncha.

en: I then sought another shady spot for repose, and fell asleep.
uz: Keyin dam olish uchun yana bir soyali joy qidirdim va uxladim.

en: Judge what was my surprise when I awoke, to see standing by me a black woman of lively and agreeable features, who held in her hand two dogs of the same color fastened together.
uz: Uyg'onganimda nima ajablanishimni o'ylab ko'ring, yonimda jonli va yoqimli ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan, qo'lida bir xil rangdagi ikki itni birga bog'lab turgan qora tanli ayol turardi.

en: I sat up, and asked her who she was.
uz: Men o'tirdim va undan kimligini so'radim.

en: “I am,” said she, “the serpent whom you lately delivered from my mortal enemy, and I wish to requite the important service you have rendered me.
uz: Men,  dedi u,  oxirgi paytlarda olimkor dushmanimdan qutqargan ilondaman va siz menga korsatgan muhim xizmatingizga javob bermoqchiman.

en: These two black dogs are your sisters, whom I have transformed into this shape.
uz: Bu ikki qora it sizning opa-singillaringizdir, ularni men shu shaklga aylantirdim.

en: But this punishment will not suffice; and my will is that you treat them hereafter in the way I shall direct.” As soon as she had spoken the fairy took me under one of her arms, and the two black dogs under the other, and conveyed us to my house in Bagdad, where I found in my storehouses all the riches with which my vessel had been laden.
uz: Lekin bu jazo yetarli bo'lmaydi; va mening irodam shuki, siz ularga bundan keyin ham men ko'rsatadigan yo'l bilan munosabatda bo'ling. U gapirgan zahoti pari meni bir qo'liga, ikki qora it esa ikkinchisining qo'liga oldi va bizni Bag'doddagi uyimga olib keldi, u yerda mening omborlarimda kemam yuklangan barcha boyliklarni topdim.

en: Before she left me, she delivered to me the two dogs, and said, “If you would not be changed into a similar form, I command you to give each of your sisters every night one hundred lashes with a rod, as the punishment of the crime they have committed against yourself and the young prince, whom they have drowned.” I was forced to promise obedience.
uz: U meni tashlab ketishidan oldin, u ikki itni menga topshirdi va dedi: Agar siz ham xuddi shunday shaklga o'zgartirilmasangiz, men sizga har bir singlingizga har kecha o'zingizga va cho'ktirgan yosh shahzodaga nisbatan sodir etgan jinoyati uchun bir yuz tayoq bilan qamchilashni buyuraman. Men itoatkorlikni va'da qilishga majbur bo'ldim.

en: Since that time I have whipped them every night, though with regret, whereof your majesty has been a witness.
uz: O'shandan beri men ularni har kecha qamchiladim, garchi afsus bilan, bunga Sening ulug'vorliging guvoh bo'lganing uchun.

en: After the caliph had heard Zobeide with much astonishment, he desired his grand vizier to request Amina to tell him wherefore her breast was disfigured with so many scars.
uz: Xalifa Zobeideni hayrat bilan eshitgandan so'ng, o'zining oliy vaziridan Amindan ko'kragi nega bunchalik ko'p chandiqlar bilan buzilganini aytishini so'rashni so'radi.

en: The sun rose and shone into the chamber as Scheherazade concluded the story of Zobeide.
uz: Quyosh chiqdi va xonaga porladi, Sheherazad Zobeide haqidagi hikoyani yakunladi.

en: But the sultan, who was anxious to
uz: Lekin sulton, kimga tashvishlangan edi...

en: hear that of Amina, bade her be ready to continue her narrative on the following morning.
uz: Amina haqida eshitib, uning ertalab ertalab o'z hikoyasini davom ettirishga tayyor bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: This she was quite content to do.
uz: Bu ishdan u juda mamnun edi.

en: The History of Amina Commander of the Faithful, that I may not repeat the things which your majesty has heard from my sister, I will only mention, that my mother, having taken a house to pass her widowhood in private, first bestowed me in marriage on the heir of one of the richest men in this city.
uz: Amina Dindorlar Qo'mondonining tarixi, sizning oliyjanobligingiz singlimdan eshitgan narsalarni takrorlamasligim uchun, faqat shuni aytib o'tamanki, onam bevaligini yashirincha o'tkazish uchun uy olib, avval meni bu shahardagi eng boy odamlardan birining vorisiga turmushga bergan edi.

en: I had not been married quite a year before my husband died.
uz: Erim vafot etguncha, turmush qurmaganimga ancha yil bo'lgan edi.

en: I thus came into possession of all his property, which amounted to above ninety thousand sequins.
uz: Shunday qilib, men uning butun mulkiga ega bo'ldim, uning mol-mulki to'qson mingdan ortiq bo'lgan edi.

en: One day, when I had been a widow more than a year a lady desired to speak to me.
uz: Bir kuni, bir yildan ortiq beva bo'lganimda, bir ayol men bilan gaplashishni xohladi.

en: I gave orders that she should be admitted.
uz: Men uning qabul qilinishiga buyruq berdim.

en: She was a very old woman.
uz: U juda keksa ayol edi.

en: She saluted me by kissing the ground, and said to me, kneeling, “Dear lady, the confidence I have in your charity makes me thus bold.
uz: U meni yerga o'pib salom berdi va tizzalab dedi: Aziz xonim, sizning xayriyangizga bo'lgan ishonchim meni shunchalik jasoratli qiladi.

en: I have a daughter, whose wedding is on this night.
uz: Mening bir qizim bor, uning to'yi shu kechada.

en: She and I are both strangers, and have no acquaintance in this town.
uz: U ham, men ham begonalarmiz va bu shaharda hech qanday tanishim yo'q.

en: Therefore, most beautiful lady, if you would vouchsafe to honor the wedding with your presence, we shall be infinitely
uz: Shunday qilib, eng go'zal xonim, agar siz to'yni sizning huzuringizda hurmat qilishga jur'at qilsangiz, biz cheksiz...

en: obliged, because the family with whom we shall be allied will then know that we are not regarded here as unworthy and despised persons.
uz: Majburiy, chunki biz ittifoqchi bo'ladigan oila shundan so'ng biladiki, biz bu yerda loyiq va nafratlanuvchi shaxslar sifatida ko'rilmaymiz.

en: But, alas, madam, if you refuse this request, how great will be our mortification!—we know not where else to apply.” The poor woman’s address, which she spoke with tears, moved my compassion.
uz: Lekin, afsuski, xonim, agar siz bu so'rovni rad etsangiz, bizning xorlashimiz naqadar buyuk bo'ladi!Biz boshqa qayerga murojaat qilishni bilmaymiz. Bechora ayolning ko'z yoshlari bilan gapirgan manzili mening rahm-shafqatimni uyg'otdi.

en: “Good woman,” said I, “do not afflict yourself; I will grant you the favor you desire.
uz: Yaxshi ayol,  dedim men,  o'zingni azoblama; senga xohlagan marhamatingni beraman.

en: Tell me whither I must go, and I will meet you as soon as I am dressed.” The old woman was so transported with joy at my answer, that she kissed my feet before I had time to prevent her.
uz: Qayerga borishim kerakligini ayting, kiyinishim bilanoq siz bilan uchrashaman. Kampir javobimdan shunchalik xursand bo'ldiki, men uni to'xtatishga ulgurmasimdan oyoqlarimdan o'pdi.

en: “Compassionate lady,” said she, rising, “God will reward the kindness you have showed to your servants, and make your heart as joyful as you have made theirs.
uz: Rahmdil xonim,  dedi u ornidan turib,  Xudo xizmatkorlaringizga korsatgan mehribonligingizni mukofotlaydi va ularning qalbi kabi quvonch bagishlaydi.

en: You need not at present trouble yourself; I will call for you in the evening.” As soon as she was gone, I selected the garment I liked best, with a necklace of large pearls, bracelets, pendants for my ears, and rings set with the finest and most sparkling diamonds, and prepared to attend the ceremony.
uz: Sizga hozir tashvish kerak emas; men sizni kechqurun chaqiraman. U ketishi bilanoq, men o'zimga eng yoqqan kiyimni tanladim, unda katta marvaridlar, bilaguzuklar, quloqlarim uchun osmalar va eng yaxshi va eng yorqin olmoslar bilan bezatilgan halqalar bor edi va marosimga tayyorgarlik ko'rdim.

en: When the night closed in, the old woman called upon me and said, “Dear lady, the relations of my son-in-law, who are the principal ladies of the city, are now met together.
uz: Tun yopilganda, kampir menga qo'ng'iroq qilib dedi: Aziz xonim, shaharning asosiy ayollari bo'lgan kuyovimning munosabatlari endi birgalikda qabul qilindi.

en: You may come when you please; I am ready to conduct you.” We immediately set out; she walked before me, and I was followed by a number of my women and slaves, richly robed for the occasion.
uz: Siz xohlaganingizda kelishingiz mumkin; men sizni olib borishga tayyorman. Biz darhol yo'lga tushdik; u mendan oldin yurdi va meni bir qator ayollarim va qullarim kuzatib borishdi, ular bu tadbir uchun boy kiyim kiygan edilar.

en: We stopped in a wide street, newly swept and watered, at a spacious gate with a lamp, by the light of which I read this inscription, in golden letters, over the entrance: “This is the continual abode of pleasure and joy.” The old woman knocked, and the gate was opened immediately.
uz: Biz keng ko'chada to'xtadik, yangi tozalanib, suv bilan sug'orilgan, chiroqli keng darvozada, uning nurida kirish joyining ustida oltin harflarda yozilgan quyidagi yozuvni o'qidim: Bu doimiy lazzat va quvonch maskani. Kampir taqillatdi va darhol darvoza ochildi.

en: I was conducted into a large hall, where I was received by a young lady of exceeding beauty.
uz: Meni katta zalga olib kirishdi, u yerda meni nihoyatda go'zal yosh bir ayol kutib oldi.

en: She drew near, and after having embraced me, made me sit down by her upon a daïs, on which was raised a throne of precious wood set with diamonds.
uz: U yaqinlashdi va meni quchoqlab olganidan so'ng, olmoslar bilan bezatilgan qimmatbaho yog'ochdan yasalgan taxta o'rnatilgan daïs ustiga meni uning yoniga o'tqazdi.

en: “Madam,” said she, “you are brought hither to assist at a wedding; but I hope it will be a different wedding from what you expected.
uz: Xonim, dedi u, siz bu yerga to'yda yordam berish uchun olib kelingansiz; lekin umid qilamanki, bu siz kutganidan boshqacha to'y bo'ladi.

en: I have a brother, one of the handsomest men in the world; his fate depends wholly
uz: Mening bir ukam bor, dunyodagi eng go'zal erkaklardan biri; uning taqdiri butunlay bog'liq.

en: upon you, and he will be the unhappiest of men if you do not take pity on him.
uz: Sizlarga qarshi, agar unga rahm qilmasangiz, u eng baxtsiz odam bo'ladi.

en: If my prayers, madam, can prevail, I shall join them with his, and humbly beg you will not refuse the proposal of being his wife.” After the death of my husband, I had not thought of marrying again; but I had no power to refuse the solicitation of so charming a lady.
uz: Agar duolarim o'z kuchini qozonsa, xonim, men ham unga qo'shilaman va sizdan uning xotini bo'lish taklifini qabul qilmasligingizni so'rayman. Erim vafotidan keyin, men yana turmush qurish haqida o'ylamagan edim; lekin bunday jozibali xonimning taklifini rad etishga kuchim yetmagan edi.

en: As soon as I had given consent by my silence, accompanied with a blush, the young lady clapped her hands, and immediately a curtain was withdrawn, from behind which came a young man of so majestic an air, and so handsome a countenance, that I thought myself happy to have made such a conquest.
uz: Mening sukutimga rozilik bergan zahoti, qizarish bilan birga, yosh xonim qo'llarini qarsak chaladi va darhol parda tortildi, orqasidan shunday ulug'vor va chiroyli ko'rinishga ega yigit keldi, men bunday zabt etishdan xursandman deb o'yladim.

en: He sat down by me, and I found from his conversation that his merits far exceeded the account of him given by his sister.
uz: U yonimda o'tirdi va men uning suhbatidan uning fazilatlari singlisi tomonidan berilgan hisobdan ancha yuqori ekanligini angladim.

en: When she perceived that we were satisfied with one another, she clapped her hands a second time, and a cadi, with four witnesses, entered, who wrote and signed our contract of marriage.
uz: U bir-birimizdan mamnun ekanligimizni anglaganida, u qo'llarini ikkinchi marta qarsak chaladi va to'rtta guvoh bilan birga nikoh shartnomamizni yozgan va imzolagan kadida kirdi.

en: There was only one condition that my new husband imposed upon me, that I should not be seen by nor speak to any other man but himself; and he vowed to me that, if I complied in this respect, I should have no reason to complain of him.
uz: Mening yangi erim menga faqat bir shart qo'ydi: meni o'zidan boshqa hech kim ko'rmasligi va gaplashmasligi kerak edi; va u menga va'da berdi: agar men bu borada rioya qilsam, undan shikoyat qilishga hech qanday asosim bo'lmasligi kerak edi.

en: About a month after our marriage, having occasion for some stuffs, I asked my husband’s permission to go out to buy them, which he granted; and I took with me the old woman of whom I spoke before, she being one of the family, and two of my own female slaves.
uz: Turmush qurganimizdan taxminan bir oy o'tgach, ba'zi narsalar uchun imkoniyat bo'lganda, erimdan ularni sotib olish uchun chiqish uchun ruxsat so'radim, u rozi bo'ldi; va men avval gaplashgan kampirni, u oilaning bir a'zosi va o'zimning ikki ayol qulimni o'zim bilan olib ketdim.

en: When we came to the street where the merchants reside, the old woman said, “Dear mistress, since you want silk stuffs, I must take you to a young merchant of my acquaintance, who has a great variety; I can assure you that you will find in his shop what no other can furnish.” I was easily persuaded, and we entered the shop belonging to the young merchant.
uz: Savdogarlar yashaydigan ko'chaga kelganimizda, kampir dedi: Aziz xo'jayin, siz ipak buyumlar xohlayotgandek, sizni tanishimning yosh savdogariga olib borishim kerak, u juda xilma-xil; sizni ishontira olaman, uning do'konida boshqa hech kim ta'minlay olmaydigan narsalarni topasiz. Meni osonlik bilan ishontirishdi va biz yosh savdogarning do'koniga kirdik.

en: I sat down, and bade the old woman desire him to show me the finest silk stuffs he had.
uz: Men o'tirdim va kampirning undan eng yaxshi ipak buyumlarini ko'rsatishini so'raganini aytdim.

en: The woman wanted me to speak myself; but I told her it was one of the
uz: Ayol o'zim gapirishimni xohlardi; lekin men unga bu...

en: articles of my marriage-contract not to speak to any man but my husband.
uz: Nikoh shartnomamning moddalari - erimdan boshqa hech kimga gapirmaslik.

en: The merchant showed me several stuffs, of which one pleased me better than the rest; and I bade her ask the price.
uz: Savdogar menga bir nechta narsalarni ko'rsatdi, ulardan biri qolganlaridan ko'ra menga ko'proq yoqdi; va men undan narxni so'rashni buyurdim.

en: He answered the old woman: “I will not sell it for gold or money; but I will make her a present of it, if she will give me leave to kiss her cheek.” I ordered the old woman to tell him that he was very rude to propose such a freedom.
uz: U kampirga javob berdi: Uni na oltin, na pulga sotmayman; lekin agar u menga uning yuziga o'pishga ruxsat bersa, undan unga sovg'a qilaman. Men kampirga bunday erkinlikni taklif qilish uchun juda qo'pol ekanligini aytishni buyurdim.

en: But instead of obeying me, she said, “What the merchant desires of you is no such great matter; you need not speak, but only present him your cheek.” The stuff pleased me so much, that I was foolish enough to take her advice.
uz: Lekin menga itoat etish o'rniga, u dedi: Sohdogarning sendan xohlaganlari unchalik katta ahamiyatga ega emas; gapirishing shart emas, faqatgina yuzingni ko'rsatishing kerak. Bu narsa menga shunchalik yoqdiki, uning maslahatiga quloq solishga ahmoq bo'ldim.

en: The old woman and my slaves stood up, that nobody might see, and I put up my veil; but instead of kissing me, the merchant bit me so violently as to draw blood.
uz: Kampir va mening qullarim hech kim ko'rmasligi uchun o'rnidan turdilar, va men parda o'rnatdim; lekin meni o'pish o'rniga, savdogar meni qon to'kish uchun qattiq tishladi.

en: The pain and my surprise were so great, that I fell down in a swoon, and continued insensible so long, that the merchant had time to escape.
uz: Og'riq va hayratim shunchalik katta ediki, men hushdan ketdim va shunchalik uzoq hissizlikda davom etdimki, savdogarning qochishga vaqti bo'ldi.

en: When I came to myself, I found my cheek covered with blood.
uz: O'zimga kelganimda, yuzimni qon bilan qoplangan holda topdim.

en: The old woman and my slaves took care to cover it with my veil, and the people who came about us could not perceive it, but supposed I had only had a fainting fit.
uz: Kampir va mening qullarim uni mening parda bilan yopishga g'amxo'rlik qilishdi, va atrofimizga kelgan odamlar buni sezishmadi, lekin menimcha, men faqat hushdan ketayotgan holatga duch kelgan edim.

en: The old woman who accompanied me being extremely troubled at this accident, endeavored to comfort me.
uz: Menga hamroh bo'lgan kampir bu baxtsiz hodisadan juda tashvishlanib, meni ovutishga harakat qildi.

en: “My dear mistress,” said she, “I beg your pardon, for I am the cause of this misfortune, having brought you to this merchant, because he is my countryman; but I never thought he would be guilty of such a villainous action.
uz: Azizim, xo'jayinim, dedi u, kechirasiz, chunki men bu baxtsizlikning sababchisiman, sizni bu savdogarga olib kelganim uchun, chunki u mening vatandoshim; lekin men hech qachon uning bunday yovuz ishda aybdor bo'lishini o'ylamagan edim.

en: But do not grieve; let us hasten home, I will apply a remedy that shall in three days so perfectly cure you, that not the least mark shall be visible.” The fit had made me so weak that I was scarcely able to walk.
uz: Lekin qayg'urma; keling, uyga shoshiling, men uch kundan keyin sizni shunday mukammal davolaydigan davo qo'llaymanki, hech qanday belgi ko'rinmasin. Sog'lomligim meni shunchalik zaiflashtirdiki, deyarli yurishga qodir emasdim.

en: But at last I got home, where I again fainted, as I went into my chamber.
uz: Lekin nihoyat uyga keldim, u yerda yana hushdan ketdim, xonamga kirganimda.

en: Meanwhile, the old woman applied her remedy.
uz: Ayni paytda kampir o'z davolanishini qo'lladi.

en: I came to myself, and went to bed.
uz: O'zimga keldim va yotdim.

en: My husband came to me at night, and seeing my head bound up, asked me the reason.
uz: Erim kechasi menga keldi va boshim bog'langanini ko'rib, sababini so'radi.

en: I told him I had the headache, which I hoped
uz: Men unga bosh og'rig'im borligini aytdim, umid qilgan edim.

en: would have satisfied him; but he took a candle, and saw my cheek was hurt.
uz: Uni qoniqtirgan bo'lardim; lekin u sham oldi va mening yuzimning shikastlanganini ko'rdi.

en: “How comes this wound?” he said.
uz: Bu yara qanday paydo bo'ladi? dedi u.

en: Though I did not consider myself as guilty of any great offense, yet I could not think of owning the truth.
uz: Garchi o'zimni hech qanday katta gunohda aybdor deb hisoblamasam ham, haqiqatga egalik qilish haqida o'ylay olmasdim.

en: I therefore said, “As I was going, under your permission, to purchase a silk stuff, a camel, carrying a load of wood, came so near to me in a narrow street, that one of the sticks grazed my cheek, but has not done me much hurt.” “If that is the case,” said my husband, “to-morrow morning, before sunrise, the grand vizier Giafar shall be informed of this insolence, and cause all the camel drivers to be put to death.” “Pray, sir,” said I, “let me beg of you to pardon them, for they are not guilty.” “How, madam,” he demanded, “what, then, am I to believe?
uz: Shuning uchun men aytdim: Sizning ruxsatingiz bilan ipak buyum sotib olishga ketayotganimda, bir yog'och yuk ko'targan tuyaning tor ko'chada shunday yaqinlashdiki, tayoqlardan biri yuzimni o'tqazdi, lekin menga uncha zarar yetkazmadi.  Agar shunday bo'lsa,  dedi erim,  ertaga ertalab, quyosh chiqishi oldidan, katta vazir Giafar bu beodoblik haqida xabardor bo'ladi va barcha tuyaning haydovchilarini o'ldirishga majbur qiladi. Iltimos, janob,  dedim,  sizdan kechirim so'rayman, chunki ular aybdor emas.  Qanday qilib, xonim,  u so'radi,  unda men nima deb ishonaman?

en: Speak; for I am resolved to know the truth from your own mouth.” “Sir,” I replied, “I was taken with a giddiness, and fell down, and that is the whole matter.” At these words my husband lost all patience.
uz: Gapir; chunki men haqiqatni o'z og'zingdan bilishga qaror qildim. Janob, javob berdim men, Men chalkashib ketdim va yiqildim, va bu butun masala. Bu so'zlardan erim butunlay sabrini yo'qotdi.

en: “I have,” said he, “too long listened to your tales.” As he spoke, he clapped his hands, and in came three slaves.
uz: Men,  dedi u,  sening ertaklaringga juda uzoq quloq soldim. U gapirayotganda, qo'llarini qarsak chalib, uchta qul kirib keldi.

en: “Strike,” said he; “cut her in two, and then throw her into the Tigris.
uz: Ur,  dedi u;  uni ikkiga bo'ling, so'ngra Tigrisga tashlang.

en: This is the punishment I inflict on those to whom I have given my heart, when they falsify their promise.” I had recourse to entreaties and prayers; but I supplicated in vain, when the old woman, who had been his nurse, coming in just at that moment, fell down upon her knees, and endeavored to appease his wrath.
uz: Bu men yuragimni berganlarga, ular o'z va'dalarini yolg'onga chiqarganlarida, beradigan jazoimdir. Men iltijolar va duolarga murojaat qildim; lekin bejizga iltijo qildim, o'sha paytda uning hamshirasi bo'lgan kampir uning g'azabini tinchlantirishga harakat qilib, tizzalariga yiqildi.

en: “My son,” said she, “since I have been your nurse, and brought you up, let me beg you to consider, ‘he who kills shall be killed,’ and that you will stain your reputation and forfeit the esteem of mankind.” She spoke these words in such an affecting manner, accompanied with tears, that she prevailed upon him at last to abandon his purpose.
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi u,  men sizning hamshiring bo'lganimdan va sizni tarbiyalaganimdan beri, iltimos, o'ylab ko'ring, kim o'ldirsa, o'ldirilgan bo'ladi va siz obro'ingizni bulg'asangiz va insoniyat hurmatini yo'qotasiz. U bu so'zlarni shunday ta'sirli tarzda, ko'z yoshlari bilan birga aytdiki, u oxir-oqibatda uning maqsadini tashlab yuborishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: “Well, then,” said he to his nurse, “for your sake I will spare her life; but she shall bear about her person some marks to make her remember her offense.” When he had thus spoken, one of the slaves, by his order, gave me upon my sides and breast so many blows with a little cane, that he threw me into a swoon.
uz: Xo'sh, unda,  dedi u hamshiraga,  sen uchun uning hayotini ayamayman; lekin u o'z xatosini eslatish uchun uning atrofida belgilar ko'tarishi kerak. U shunday deganidan so'ng, qullardan biri, uning buyrug'i bilan, menga yon tomonlarimga shunday ko'p zarba berdi va kichkina tayoq bilan ko'krak urdi, hatto meni o'ldirib tashladi.

en: In this state my husband caused the same slaves, the executioners of his will, to
uz: Bu holatda erim o'z vasiyatini ijro etuvchi xuddi shu qullarga sabab bo'ldi.

en: carry me back to bed, and the old woman took care of me.
uz: Meni to'shakka qaytarib olib boring, kampir esa menga g'amxo'rlik qildi.

en: I kept my bed for four months.
uz: Men to'shagimni to'rt oy davomida saqladim.

en: At last I recovered.
uz: Nihoyat tuzalib ketdim.

en: The scars which, contrary to my wish, you saw yesterday, have remained ever since.
uz: Mening xohishimga zid ravishda, siz kecha ko'rgan yaralar shundan beri saqlanib qolgan.

en: As soon as I was able to walk and go abroad, I resolved to retire to the house which was left me by my first husband, but I could not find the site whereon it stood, as my second husband had caused it to be leveled with the ground.
uz: Chet elga piyoda borib ketishim bilanoq, birinchi erimdan qolgan uyga pensiyaga chiqishga qaror qildim, lekin u turgan joyni topa olmadim, chunki ikkinchi erim uni yer bilan yakson qildi.

en: Being thus left destitute and helpless, I went to my dear sister Zobeide.
uz: Shunday qilib, bechora va ojiz qolgan holda, men aziz singlim Zobeidega bordim.

en: She received me with her accustomed goodness, and advised me to bear with patience my affliction, from which, she said, none are free.
uz: U meni odatdagi mehribonligi bilan qabul qildi va menga azobimni sabr bilan ko'tarishni maslahat berdi, undan hech kim xalos bo'lmaydi, dedi u.

en: In confirmation of her remark, she gave me an account of the loss of the young prince occasioned by the jealousy of her two sisters.
uz: Uning gapini tasdiqlab, u menga ikki singlisining rashkidan kelib chiqqan yosh shahzoda yo'qolishi haqidagi hisobotni berdi.

en: She told me also how they were transformed into dogs; and in the last place, after a thousand testimonials of her love toward me, she introduced me to my youngest sister, who had likewise taken sanctuary with her after the death of her mother; and we have continued to live together in the house in which we received the guests whom your highness found assembled on your visit last night.
uz: U menga ularning qanday qilib itlarga aylanganini ham aytdi; va oxirida, menga bo'lgan muhabbatining mingta guvohligidan so'ng, meni onasining vafotidan keyin ham u bilan birga panoh topgan kichik singlim bilan tanishtirdi; va biz kecha kechqurun oliyjanobingiz sizning tashrifingizda yig'ilgan mehmonlarni qabul qilgan uyda birga yashashni davom ettirdik.

en: The caliph expressed his admiration of what he had heard, and inquired of Zobeide, “Madam, did not this fairy whom you delivered, and who imposed such a rigorous command upon you, tell you where her place of abode was or that she would ever restore your sisters to their natural shape?” “Commander of the Faithful,” answered Zobeide, “the fairy did leave with me a bundle of hair, saying that her presence would one day be of use to me; and then, if I only burned two tufts of this hair, she would be with me in a moment.” “Madam,” demanded the caliph, “where is the bundle of hair?” She answered, “Ever since that time I have been so careful of it, that I always carry it about me.” Upon which she pulled it out of the case which contained it, and showed it to him.
uz: Xalifa eshitgan narsalariga qoyil qolishini bildirdi va Zobeidadan so'radi: Xonim, siz yetkazgan va sizga shunday qattiq buyruq bergan bu pari sizga uning yashash joyi qayerda ekanligini yoki opa-singillaringizni qachondir o'z shakliga qaytarishini aytmaydimi?  Dindorlar qo'mondoni,  javob berdi Zobeid,  pari menga bir bog' soch qoldirdi, uning hozir bo'lishi bir kun menga foydali bo'lishini aytdi; va keyin, agar men bu sochdan faqat ikki bog' yoqsam, u bir zumda men bilan bo'lardi. Xonim,  javob berdi xonim,  soch bog'chasi qayerda? U: Men bu haqda shunday bo'lganimdan beri, men uni doim ehtiyotkorlik bilan olib yuraman,  dedi u.

en: “Well, then,” said the caliph, “let us bring the fairy hither; you could not call her at a better time, for I long to see her.”
uz: Xo'sh, unda,  dedi xalifa,  keling, pariyani bu yerga olib kelaylik; undan yaxshiroq vaqtda uni chaqira olmas edingiz, chunki men uni ko'rishni juda xohlayman.

en: Zobeide having consented, fire was brought in, and she threw the whole bundle of hair into it.
uz: Zobeide rozi bo'lgach, olov olib kirildi va u butun tuk bog'ichini unga tashladi.

en: The palace at that instant began to shake, and the fairy appeared before the caliph in the form of a lady very richly dressed.
uz: O'sha zahoti saroy titray boshladi va pari xalifaning oldida juda boy kiyingan xonim ko'rinishida paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Commander of the Faithful,” said she to the prince, “you see I am ready to receive your commands.
uz: Sodiqlarning qo'mondoni, dedi u shahzodaga, ko'ryapsanmi, men sening buyruqlaringni qabul qilishga tayyorman.

en: At your wish I will not only restore these two sisters to their former shape, but I will also cure this lady of her scars, and tell you who it was that abused her.” The caliph sent for the two dogs from Zobeide’s house, and when they came a glass of water was brought to the fairy by her desire.
uz: Sizning xohishingizga ko'ra, men nafaqat bu ikki singilni o'zlarining avvalgi shakliga qaytaraman, balki bu xonimni ham yaralaridan tozalayman va uni kim haqorat qilganini aytaman. Xalifa Zobeide'ning uyining ikki itini chaqirib yubordi va ular kelganlarida, uning xohishi bilan pariga bir stakan suv olib kelindi.

en: She pronounced over it some words, which nobody understood; then throwing some part of it upon Amina, and the rest upon the dogs, the latter became two ladies of surprising beauty, and the scars that were upon Amina disappeared.
uz: Uning ustida hech kim tushunmaydigan so'zlarni aytdi; keyin uning bir qismini Amina ustiga, qolgan qismini itlarga tashladi, bu so'nggi ikki xonim hayratlanarli go'zallikka ega bo'ldi va Amina ustidagi yaralar yo'qoldi.

en: After which the fairy said to the caliph, “Commander of the Faithful, I must now discover to you the unknown husband you inquire after.
uz: Shundan so'ng pari xalifaga dedi: Ey Mo'minlar qo'mondoni, endi siz so'rayotgan noma'lum erni sizga topishim kerak.

en: He is Prince Amin, your eldest son, who by stratagem brought this lady to his house, where he married her.
uz: U shahzoda Amin, sizning to'ng'ich o'g'lingizdir, u hiyla bilan bu xonimni o'z uyiga olib keldi va u yerda unga turmushga chiqdi.

en: As to the blows he caused to be given her, he is in some measure excusable; for this lady, his spouse, by the excuses she made, led him to believe she was more faulty than she really was.” At these words she saluted the caliph, and vanished.
uz: U unga bergan zarbalarga kelsak, u ma'lum darajada uzrli; chunki bu xonim, uning turmush o'rtog'i, uning bergan bahonalari bilan uni o'zi aslida bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq aybdor ekanligiga ishontirdi. Shu so'zlardan so'ng u xalifaga salom berdi va yo'qoldi.

en: The caliph, much satisfied with the changes that had happened through his means, acted in such a manner as will perpetuate his memory to all ages.
uz: Xalifa o'z vositalari orqali sodir bo'lgan o'zgarishlardan juda mamnun bo'lib, barcha davrlarda xotirasini abadiylashtiradigan tarzda harakat qildi.

en: First, he sent for his son Amin, told him that he was informed of his secret marriage, and how he had ill-treated Amina upon a very slight cause.
uz: Avval u o'g'li Aminni chaqirib yubordi, unga o'zining maxfiy nikohi haqida xabar berilganini va Aminga juda kichik bir sababga ko'ra qanday yomon munosabatda bo'lganini aytdi.

en: Upon this, the prince, at his father’s command, received her again immediately.
uz: Shundan so'ng, shahzoda otasining buyrug'iga ko'ra, uni darhol yana qabul qildi.

en: After which Haroun al Raschid declared that he would give his own heart and hand to Zobeide, and offered the other three sisters to the calenders, sons of sultans, who accepted them for their brides with much joy.
uz: Shundan so'ng Horun al-Rashid o'z yuragi va qo'lini Zobeidega berishini e'lon qildi va qolgan uch singlini kalendarlarga taklif qildi, sultonlarning o'g'illari, ular ularni kelinlari sifatida katta xursandchilik bilan qabul qilishdi.

en: The caliph assigned each of them a magnificent palace in the city of Bagdad, promoted them to the highest dignities of his empire, and admitted them to his councils.
uz: Xalifa ularning har biriga Bag'dod shahrida ajoyib saroy tayinladi, ularni o'z imperiyasining eng yuqori martabali lavozimlariga ko'tardi va o'z kengashlariga kiritdi.

en: The chief cadi of Bagdad being called, with witnesses, wrote the contracts of marriage; and the caliph, in promoting by his patronage the happiness of many persons who had The Chief Cadi Wrote the Contracts of Marriage suffered such incredible calamities, drew a thousand blessings upon himself.
uz: Bag'dodning bosh qodimi guvohlar bilan birga nikoh shartnomalarini yozdi; va xalifa, o'z homiyligi bilan Bosh Qodimi Nikoh shartnomalarini yozgan ko'plab odamlarning baxtini targ'ib qilib, bunday aql bovar qilmas ofatlarga duch keldi va o'ziga mingta baraka yog'di.

en: “I had hoped,” said Scheherazade, “to tell your majesty the astonishing story of the wonderful lamp of Aladdin, but I perceive that it is so near day that there will not be opportunity.
uz: Umid qilgan edim,  dedi Sheherazade,  Oliy hazratlari, Aladdinning ajoyib chiroqining hayratlanarli hikoyasini aytib berishga, lekin men kun shunchalik yaqin ekanligini anglaymanki, imkoniyat bo'lmaydi.

en: Although the story which I have just brought to so happy an ending is full of surprises and enchantments, yet this one, too, has some singular incidents—” “We will hear it to-morrow,” the sultan declared, rising.
uz: Garchi men endigina shunday baxtli yakun topgan hikoya kutilmagan hodisalar va sehrlarga to'la bo'lsa-da, bu hikoyaning ham ba'zi bir noyob hodisalari borErtaga eshitamiz, dedi sulton ko'tarilib.

en: “I should not like to miss hearing a story you recommend so highly.” Accordingly, next morning, the sultaness began the story which follows.
uz: Siz juda tavsiya qiladigan hikoyani eshitishni o'tkazib yuborishni xohlamayman. Shunga ko'ra, ertasi kuni ertalab sultanlik quyidagi hikoyani boshladi.

en: Aladdin The Story of Aladdin; Or, the Wonderful Lamp In one of the large and rich cities of China, there once lived a tailor named Mustapha.
uz: Aladdin Aladdin hikoyasi; Yoki, Ajoyib Chiroq Xitoyning katta va boy shaharlaridan birida bir vaqtlar Mustafa ismli tikuvchi yashagan.

en: He could hardly, by his daily labor, maintain himself and his family, which consisted only of his wife and a son.
uz: U kundalik mehnati bilan o'zini va faqat xotini va o'g'lidan iborat bo'lgan oilasini ta'minlay olmasdi.

en: His son, who was called Aladdin, was a very careless and idle fellow.
uz: Uning Oladdin deb atalgan o'g'li juda beparvo va beparvo edi.

en: He was disobedient to his father and mother, and would go out early in the morning and stay all day, playing in the streets and public places with idle children of his own age.
uz: U otasi va onasiga itoatsiz edi va erta tongda tashqariga chiqib, butun kun davomida ko'chalarda va jamoat joylarida o'z tengdoshlari bilan bekorchi bolalar bilan o'ynardi.

en: When he was old enough to learn a trade his father took him into his own shop and taught him how to use his needle; but all his father’s endeavors to keep him to his work were vain, for no sooner was his back turned, than the boy was gone for that day.
uz: U hunar o'rganishga yetganida, otasi uni o'z do'koniga olib bordi va ignasidan qanday foydalanishni o'rgatdi; lekin otasining uni ishida ushlab turish bo'yicha barcha urinishlari befoyda bo'ldi, chunki u o'sha kunga ketganidan ko'p o'tmay orqaga qaytdi.

en: chastised him, but Aladdin was incorrigible, and his father was forced to abandon him to his idleness; which so much troubled him, that he fell sick and died in a few months.
uz: Uni jazoladi, lekin Aladdin tuzalib qolmadi va otasi uni bekorchilikka tashlab ketishga majbur bo'ldi; bu uni shunchalik bezovta qildi, bir necha oy ichida kasal bo'lib vafot etdi.

en: Aladdin, now no longer restrained by the fear of a father, gave himself entirely over to his idle habits, and was always in the streets with his companions.
uz: Aladdin, endi otadan qo'rqish bilan cheklanmay, o'zining behuda odatlariga butunlay berilib ketdi va doimo o'z hamrohlari bilan ko'chada edi.

en: This course he followed till he was fifteen years old, without giving his mind to any useful pursuit, or the least reflection on what would become of him.
uz: U bu kursni o'n besh yoshgacha davom etdi, hech qanday foydali ishga yoki undan keyin nima bo'lishini hech qanday o'ylamasdan.

en: As he was one day playing with his evil associates, a stranger passing by stood to observe him.
uz: Bir kuni u yovuz do'stlari bilan o'ynayotganida, uni kuzatish uchun o'tib ketayotgan notanish odam turdi.

en: This stranger was a sorcerer, known as the African magician, but two days arrived from Africa, his native country.
uz: Bu notanish odam afrikalik sehrgar sifatida tanilgan sehrgar edi, lekin ikki kun o'z ona yurti bo'lgan Afrikadan keldi.

en: The African magician, observing in Aladdin something which assured him that he was a fit boy for his purpose, inquired his name and history of one of his companions, and when he had learnt all he desired to know, went up to him, and taking him aside from his comrades, said, “Child, was not your father called Mustapha the tailor?” “Yes, sir,” answered the boy, “but he has been dead a long time.” At these words the African magician threw his arms about Aladdin’s neck, and kissed him several times, with tears in his eyes, saying, “I am your uncle.
uz: Afrikalik sehrgar Aladdinni o'z maqsadiga mos bola ekanligiga ishontiruvchi narsani kuzatdi, uning ismini va bir hamrohining tarixini so'radi va bilmoqchi bo'lgan hamma narsani bilgach, uning oldiga bordi va uni o'rtoqlaridan uzoqlashtirib, dedi: Bolam, otang Mustafa tikuvchimasmidi? Ha, janob,  dedi bola,  lekin u allaqachon o'lgan. Shu so'zlardan so'ng Afrikalik sehrgar Aladdinning bo'yniga qo'llarini tashladi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan uni bir necha marta o'pdi va dedi: Men sizning amakisiz.

en: Your worthy father was my own brother.
uz: Sizning munosib otangiz mening o'z akam edi.

en: I knew you at first sight, you are so like him.” Then he gave Aladdin a handful of small money, saying, “Go, my son, to your mother, give my love to her, and tell her that I will visit her to-morrow, that I may see where my good brother lived so long, and ended his days.” Aladdin ran to his mother, overjoyed at the money his uncle had given him.
uz: Sizni bir qarashda bilardim, siz unga o'xshaydingiz. Keyin u Aladdinga bir hovuch mayda pul berdi va dedi: Bor, o'g'lim, onangga, unga muhabbatimni ber va unga ertaga uni ziyorat qilishimni ayt, shunda men yaxshi akamning qayerda uzoq yashaganini va kunlarini tugatganini ko'rishim mumkin. Aladdin amakisi bergan puldan xursand bo'lib, onasiga yugurdi.

en: “Mother,” said he, “have I an uncle?” “No, child,” replied his mother, “you have no uncle either by your father’s side or mine.” “I am just now come,” said Aladdin, “from a man who says he is my uncle and my father’s brother.
uz: Ona,  dedi u,  menda amakim bormi?  Yoq, bola,  javob berdi onasi,  na otang yonida, na menikida amaking yoq.  Men endigina keldim,  dedi Aladdin,  mening amakim va otamning ukam ekanligini aytadigan odamdan.

en: He cried and kissed me when I told him my father was dead, and gave me money, sending his love to you, and promising to come and pay you a visit, that he may see the
uz: U yig'ladi va meni o'pdi, men unga otam o'lganini aytganimda, va menga pul berdi, senga muhabbatini yubordi va kelib, seni ko'rishga va'da berdi.

en: house my father lived and died in.” “Indeed, child,” replied the mother, “your father had no brother, nor have you an uncle.” The next day the magician found Aladdin playing in another part of the town, and embracing him as before, put two pieces of gold into his hand, and said to him, “Carry this, child, to your mother; tell her that I will come and see her to-night, and bid her get us something for supper; but first show me the house where you live.” Aladdin showed the African magician the house, and carried the two pieces of gold to his mother, who went out and bought provisions.
uz: Otam yashagan va vafot etgan uy. Ha, bola, javob berdi ona,  otangning akasi yoq edi, sening ham amaking yoq edi. Ertasi kuni sehrgar Aladdinni shaharning boshqa bir qismida oynayotganini topdi va uni avvalgidek quchoqladi, qoliga ikkita oltin soldi va unga dedi: Buni olib bor, bola, onangga; unga ayt, men bugun kechqurun uni korib chiqaman va bizga kechki ovqat uchun biror narsa olib beraman; lekin avval u yashaydigan uyni korsat. Aladdin afrikalik sehrgarga uyni korsatdi va ikki oltinni onasiga olib bordi, u chiqib, oziq-ovqat sotib oldi.

en: She spent the whole day in preparing the supper; and at night, when it was ready, said to her son, “Perhaps the stranger knows not how to find our house; go and bring him, if you meet with him.” Aladdin was just ready to go, when the magician knocked at the door, and came in loaded with wine and all sorts of fruits, which he brought for a dessert.
uz: U butun kunni kechki ovqatni tayyorlash bilan o'tkazdi; va kechasi tayyor bo'lgach, o'g'liga dedi: Balki begona odam uyimizni qanday topishni bilmasligi mumkin; agar u bilan uchrashsangiz, uni olib keling. Aladdin ketishga hozir edi, sehrgar eshikni taqillatdi va vino va har xil mevalar bilan yuklangan holda keldi, uni desertga olib keldi.

en: After he had given what he brought into Aladdin’s hands, he saluted his mother, and desired her to show him the place where his brother Mustapha used to sit; and when she had so done, he cried out, with tears in his eyes, “My poor brother!
uz: U Aladdinning qo'liga olib kelgan narsasini berganidan so'ng, onasiga salom berdi va undan akasi Mustafa o'tirgan joyni ko'rsatishini so'radi; va u shunday qilganidan so'ng, ko'zlarida yosh bilan qichqirdi: Sehrli akam!

en: how unhappy am I, not to have come soon enough to give you one last embrace.” Aladdin’s mother desired him to sit down in the same place, but he declined.
uz: Qanday baxtsizman, senga oxirgi quchoqlash uchun yetarlicha tez kelmaganimdan. Aladdinning onasi uni o'sha yerda o'tirishini xohladi, lekin u rad etdi.

en: “No,” said he, “I shall not do that; but give me leave to sit opposite to it, that although I see not the master of a family so dear to me, I may at least behold the place where he used to sit.” When the magician had sat down, he began to enter into discourse with Aladdin’s mother.
uz: Yoq, dedi u, Men buni qilmayman; lekin menga uning roparasida otirishga ruxsat bering, garchi menga juda yaqin oila egasini kormasam ham, hech bolmaganda u otirgan joyni korishim mumkin. Sehrgar otirgach, u Aladdinning onasi bilan suhbatlashishni boshladi.

en: “My good sister,” said he, “do not be surprised at your never having seen me all the time you have been married to my brother Mustapha of happy memory.
uz: Yaxshi singlim,  dedi u,  baxtli xotiraga ega Mustafa akamga turmushga chiqqaningdan beri meni hech qachon ko'rmaganingga hayron bo'lma.

en: I have been forty years absent from this country, and during that time have traveled into the Indies, Persia, Arabia, Syria, and Egypt, and afterwards crossed over into Africa, where I took up my abode.
uz: Men bu mamlakatdan qirq yil yo'q edim va shu vaqt davomida Hindiston, Fors, Arabiston, Suriya va Misrga sayohat qildim, so'ngra Afrikaga o'tib, u yerda yashashga qaror qildim.

en: At last, as is natural, I was desirous to see my native country again, and to embrace my dear brother; and finding I had strength enough
uz: Nihoyat, tabiiyki, men o'z ona yurtimni yana ko'rishni va aziz akamni quchoqlashni xohlardim; va yetarli kuchga ega bo'ldim.

en: to undertake so long a journey, I made the necessary preparations, and set out.
uz: Shunday uzoq safarni boshdan kechirish uchun zarur tayyorgarlik ko'rdim va yo'lga chiqdim.

en: Nothing ever afflicted me so much as hearing of my brother’s death.
uz: Hech narsa meni akamning o'limini eshitgandan ko'ra ko'proq tashvishga solmagan.

en: But God be praised for all things!
uz: Lekin Xudo hamma narsa uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'lsin!

en: It is a comfort for me to find, as it were, my brother in a son, who has his features.” The African magician perceiving that the widow wept at the remembrance of her husband, changed the conversation, and turning toward her son, asked him, “What business do you follow?
uz: Menga o'ziga xos xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan o'g'il ukamni topishim tasalli beradi. Afrikalik sehrgar beva erini eslab yig'laganini anglab, suhbatni o'zgartirdi va o'g'liga qarab so'radi: Siz nima bilan shug'ullanasiz?

en: Are you of any trade?” At this question the youth hung down his head, and was not a little abashed when his mother answered, “Aladdin is an idle fellow.
uz: Siz biror kasb egasmisiz? Bu savolga yigit boshini osib qo'ydi va onasi javob berganda unchalik hayratlanmadi: Aladdin bekorchi yigit.

en: His father, when alive, strove all he could to teach him his trade, but could not succeed; and since his death, notwithstanding all I can say to him, he does nothing but idle away his time in the streets, as you saw him, without considering he is no longer a child; and if you do not make him ashamed of it, I despair of his ever coming to any good.
uz: Otasi tirikligida unga o'z hunarini o'rgatishga bor kuchini sarfladi, lekin muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmadi; va o'limidan beri, unga aytishim mumkin bo'lgan hamma narsaga qaramay, u ko'chalarda vaqtini bekor o'tkazishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmaydi, xuddi siz ko'rganingizdek, u endi bola emasligini o'ylamagan holda; va agar siz uni bundan uyaltirmasangiz, uning hech qanday yaxshilikka kelishiga umid qilaman.

en: For my part I am resolved, one of these days, to turn him out of doors, and let him provide for himself.” After these words, Aladdin’s mother burst into tears; and the magician said, “This is not well, nephew; you must think of helping yourself, and getting your livelihood.
uz: Men o'z navbatimda, shu kunlardan birida uni eshiklardan tashqariga chiqarib yuborishga va o'zi g'amxo'rlik qilishiga qaror qildim. Bu so'zlardan so'ng, Aladdinning onasi yig'lab yubordi; va sehrgar dedi: Bu yaxshi emas, jiyan; o'zingizga yordam berish va tirikchilikni olish haqida o'ylashingiz kerak.

en: There are many trades; perhaps you do not like your father’s, and would prefer another; I will help you.
uz: Ko'plab savdolar bor; balki otangizniki yoqmasligi mumkin va boshqachasini afzal ko'rasiz; men sizga yordam beraman.

en: If you have no mind to learn any handicraft, I will take a shop for you, furnish it with all sorts of fine stuffs and linens; and then with the money you make of them you can lay in fresh goods, and live in an honorable way.
uz: Agar biror hunarmandchilikni o'rganishga aqlingiz bo'lmasa, men siz uchun do'kon olib, uni har xil nozik buyumlar va choyshablar bilan ta'minlayman; keyin ulardan topgan pulingiz bilan yangi mahsulotlar bilan to'yib, hurmat bilan yashay olasiz.

en: Tell me freely what you think of my proposal; you will always find me ready to keep my word.” This plan suited Aladdin, who hated manual work.
uz: Menga taklifim haqida nima deb o'ylashingizni bemalol ayting; meni har doim so'zimni bajarishga tayyor deb topasiz. Bu reja qo'lda ishlashni yomon ko'radigan Aladinga mos keldi.

en: He told the magician he had a greater inclination to that business than to any other, and that he would be much obliged to him for his kindness.
uz: U sehrgarga bu ishga boshqalarga qaraganda ko'proq moyilligini va uning mehribonligi uchun unga juda minnatdor bo'lishini aytdi.

en: “Well then,” said the African magician, “I will carry you with me to- morrow, clothe you as handsomely as the best merchants in the city, and afterward we will open a shop as I mentioned.”
uz: Xo'sh,  dedi afrikalik sehrgar,  seni ertaga o'zim bilan olib boraman, seni shahardagi eng yaxshi savdogarlar kabi chiroyli kiydiraman, keyin men aytganimdek do'kon ochamiz.

en: The widow, after his promises of kindness to her son, no longer doubted that the magician was her husband’s brother.
uz: Beva ayol o'g'liga mehribonlik va'dalaridan so'ng, sehrgar uning erining akasi ekanligiga endi shubha qilmadi.

en: She thanked him for his good intentions; and after having exhorted Aladdin to render himself worthy of his uncle’s favor, served up supper, at which they talked of indifferent matters; then the magician took his leave.
uz: U unga yaxshi niyatlari uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi; va Aladdinni amakisining marhamatiga loyiq bo'lishga undaganidan so'ng, kechki ovqatni taqdim etdi, unda befarq narsalar haqida gaplashdilar; keyin sehrgar ketdi.

en: He came the next day, as he had promised, and took Aladdin with him to a merchant, who sold all sorts of clothes and bade Aladdin choose those he preferred, which he paid for.
uz: U ertasi kuni va'da berganidek keldi va Aladdinni o'zi bilan savdogarga olib bordi. U har xil kiyimlarni sotardi va Aladdin o'zi afzal ko'rganlarini tanlardi, ular uchun pul to'lardi.

en: When Aladdin found himself so handsomely equipped, he returned his uncle thanks, who answered him: “As you are soon to be a merchant, it is proper you should frequent these shops, and be acquainted with them.” He then showed him the largest and finest mosques, carried him to the khans or inns where the merchants and travelers lodged, and afterward to the sultan’s palace, where he had free access; and at last brought him to his own khan, where, meeting with some merchants he had become acquainted with since his arrival, he gave them a feast, to bring them and his pretended nephew together.
uz: Aladdin o'zini shunchalik chiroyli jihozlanganini ko'rgach, amakisiga minnatdorchilik bildirdi va u unga javob berdi: Siz tez orada savdogar bo'lasiz, bu do'konlarga tashrif buyurishingiz va ular bilan tanishishingiz maqsadga muvofiqdir. Keyin u unga eng katta va eng yaxshi masjidlarni ko'rsatdi, savdogarlar va sayohatchilar tunab yotgan xonlar yoki mehmonxonalarga olib bordi, so'ngra sulton saroyiga, u yerda erkin kirish imkoniyati bor edi; va nihoyat uni o'z xonlariga olib keldi, u yerga kelganidan beri tanish bo'lgan ba'zi savdogarlar bilan uchrashgach, ularni va o'zini jiyan deb ko'rsatadiganlarini ziyofat qildi.

en: This entertainment lasted till night, when Aladdin would have taken leave of his uncle to go home; the magician would not let him go by himself, but conducted him to his mother who bestowed a thousand blessings upon the magician.
uz: Bu ko'ngilochar mashg'ulot Aladdin amakisi bilan uyiga ketishga rozi bo'lgan kechagacha davom etdi; sehrgar uni yolg'iz qo'yib yubormadi, balki onasining oldiga olib bordi, u sehrgarga ming barakali edi.

en: Early the next morning, the magician called again for Aladdin, and said he would take him to spend that day in the country, and on the next he would purchase the shop.
uz: Ertasi kuni erta tongda sehrgar Aladdinni yana chaqirib, uni o'sha kuni qishloqqa olib borishini va ertasi kuni do'konni sotib olishini aytdi.

en: He led him out at one of the gates of the city, to some magnificent palaces, to each of which belonged beautiful gardens, into which anybody might enter.
uz: U uni shahar darvozalaridan birida, har birida go'zal bog'lar bo'lgan, har kim kirishi mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib saroylarga olib chiqdi.

en: At every building he came to, he asked Aladdin if he did not think it fine; the youth agreed crying out at each new one they saw, “Here is a finer house, uncle, than any we have yet seen.” By this artifice, the cunning magician led Aladdin some way into the country.
uz: Har bir binoga kelganida, u Aladdindan buni yaxshi deb hisoblamasligini so'radi; yoshlar har bir yangi binoni ko'rganlarida, Mana, amaki, biz ko'rganlardan ham zo'rroq uy. Shu hiyla bilan, ayyor sehrgar Aladdinni qishloqqa qandaydir yo'l bilan olib kirdi.

en: The magician next pulled from his girdle a package of cakes and fruit, and during this short repast he exhorted his nephew to leave
uz: Sehrgar keyin o'zining kamaridan bir paket tort va meva oldi va shu qisqa taom paytida jiyanini ketishga undadi.

en: off bad company, and to seek that of wise and prudent men, to improve by their conversation; “For,” said he, “you will soon be at man’s estate, and you cannot too early begin to imitate their example.” When they had eaten as much as they liked, they got up, and pursued their walk through gardens separated from one another only by small ditches, which marked out the limits without interrupting They Pursued Their Walk Through the Gardens the communication; so great was the confidence the inhabitants reposed in each other.
uz: Yomon do'stlikdan uzoqroq bo'lish va suhbatlari orqali yaxshilanish uchun dono va oqil odamlarni izlash; Chunki, dedi u, tez orada insonlar mulkiga ega bo'lasiz va ularning namunasini erta boshlay olmaysiz. Ular xohlagancha ovqatlanib bo'lgach, o'rnidan turdilar va bir-biridan ajratilgan bog'lar bo'ylab kichik ariqlar bilan yurishdi, bu esa cheklovlarni uzluksiz belgilardi. Ular Bog'lar bo'ylab yurishlarini davom ettirishdi.

en: At last they arrived between two mountains of moderate height and equal size, divided by a narrow valley, which was the place where the magician intended to execute the design that had brought him from Africa to China.
uz: Nihoyat, ular o'rtacha balandlikdagi va teng o'lchamdagi ikki tog' o'rtasida yetib kelishdi, ular tor vodiy bilan bo'linishgan edi, bu yerda sehrgar uni Afrikadan Xitoyga olib kelgan dizaynni amalga oshirishni niyat qilgan edi.

en: “We will go no farther now,” said he to Aladdin; “I will show you here some extraordinary things, which, when you have seen them, you will thank me for: but gather up all the loose dry sticks you can see, to kindle a fire with.”
uz: Endi uzoqqa bormaymiz,  dedi u Aladdinga; Men senga bu yerda bazi gayrioddiy narsalarni korsataman, ularni korganingda menga rahmat aytasan: lekin kora oladigan barcha bosh quruq tayoqlarni yigib, olov yoq.

en: Aladdin found so many dried sticks, that he soon collected a great heap.
uz: Aladdin shunchalik ko'p quritilgan tayoq topdiki, tez orada katta bir uyum yig'di.

en: The magician presently set them on fire; and when they were in a blaze, threw in some incense, pronouncing several magical words, which Aladdin did not understand.
uz: Sehrgar ularni darhol yoqib yubordi; va ular olovda bo'lganlarida, tutatqi tashladi, Aladdin tushunmagan bir nechta sehrli so'zlarni aytdi.

en: He had scarcely done so when the earth opened just before the magician, and discovered a stone with a brass ring fixed in it.
uz: U zo'rg'a shunday qilgan edi, qachonki yer sehrgar oldida ochildi va unda mis halqali toshni topdi.

en: Aladdin was so frightened that he would have run away, but the magician caught hold of him, and gave him such a box on the ear that he knocked him down.
uz: Aladdin shunchalik qo'rqqan ediki, qochib ketardi, lekin sehrgar uni ushladi va qulog'iga shunday quti qo'ydi, uni yiqitdi.

en: Aladdin got up trembling, and with tears in his eyes said to the magician, “What have I done, uncle, to be treated in this severe manner?” “I am your uncle,” answered the magician; “I supply the place of your father, and you ought not to question my acts.
uz: Aladdin titrab turdi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan sehrgarga dedi: Amaki, men bunchalik qattiq munosabatda bo'lish uchun nima qildim? Men sizning amakingizman,  javob berdi sehrgar; Men otangizning o'rnini ta'minlayman, va siz mening harakatlarim haqida shubha qilmasligingiz kerak.

en: But, child,” added he, softening, “do not be afraid; for I shall not ask anything of you, but that you obey me punctually, if you would reap the benefits which I intend to give you.
