uz: Lekin, bolam,  dedi u yumshoqlashib,  qo'rqma; chunki men sendan hech narsa so'ramayman, faqat menga o'z vaqtida itoat etishingni, agar senga bermoqchi bo'lgan foydalardan bahramand bo'lsang.

en: Know, then, that under this stone there is hidden a treasure, destined to be yours, and which will make you richer than the greatest monarch in the world.
uz: Shunday ekan, bilginki, bu tosh ostida seniki bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan va seni dunyodagi eng buyuk monarxdan boyroq qiladigan xazina yashiringan.

en: No person but yourself is permitted to lift this stone, or enter the cave; so you must punctually execute what I command, for it is a matter of great consequence both to you and me.” Aladdin, amazed at all he saw and heard, forgot what was past, and rising said, “Well, uncle, what is to be done?
uz: O'zingizdan boshqa hech kimga bu toshni ko'tarishga yoki g'orga kirishga ruxsat yo'q; shuning uchun men buyurgan narsani o'z vaqtida bajarishingiz kerak, chunki bu siz va men uchun katta oqibatga olib keladi. Aladdin, ko'rgan va eshitgan narsalariga hayron bo'lib, o'tmishni unutdi va o'rnidan turib dedi: Xo'sh, amaki, nima qilish kerak?

en: Command me, I am ready to obey.” “I am overjoyed, child,” said the African magician, embracing him.
uz: Menga buyruq ber, men itoat etishga tayyorman. Men juda xursandman, bola,  dedi afrikalik sehrgar uni quchoqlab.

en: “Take hold of the ring, and lift up that stone.” “Indeed, uncle,” replied Aladdin, “I am not strong enough; you must help me.” “You have no occasion for my assistance,” answered the magician; “if I help you, we shall be able to do nothing.
uz: Uzukni ushla va o'sha toshni ko'tar. Ha, amaki,  javob berdi Aladdin, Men yetarlicha kuchga ega emasman; siz menga yordam berishingiz kerak. Sizda menga yordam berish uchun hech qanday imkoniyat yo'q,  javob berdi sehrgar; agar men sizga yordam bersam, biz hech narsa qila olmaymiz.

en: Take hold of the ring, and lift it up; you will find it will come easily.” Aladdin did as the magician bade him, raised the stone with ease, and laid it on one side.
uz: Uzukni ushla va uni ko'tar, oson keladi. Aladdin sehrgar unga buyurganidek qildi, toshni osonlik bilan ko'tardi va bir tomonga qo'ydi.

en: When the stone was pulled up, there appeared a staircase about three or four feet deep, leading to a door.
uz: Tosh ko'tarilganda, taxminan uch-to'rt fut chuqurlikdagi, eshikga olib boruvchi zinapoya paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Descend, my son,” said the African magician, “and open that door.
uz: Kiring, oglim,  dedi afrikalik sehrgar,  va osha eshikni och.

en: It will lead you into a palace, divided into three great halls.
uz: U sizni uchta buyuk zalga bo'lingan saroyga olib boradi.

en: In each of these you will see
uz: Bularning har birida ko'rasiz:

en: four large brass cisterns placed on each side, full of gold and silver; but take care you do not meddle with them.
uz: Har bir tomonda oltin va kumushga to'la to'rtta katta mis idish bor edi; lekin ularga aralashmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling.

en: Before you enter the first hall, be sure to tuck up your robe, wrap it about you, and then pass through the second into the third without stopping.
uz: Birinchi zalga kirishdan oldin, ko'ylagingizni mahkam o'rang, uni o'rab oling va keyin to'xtovsiz ikkinchi zaldan uchinchi zalga o'ting.

en: Above all things, have a care that you do not touch the walls so much as with your clothes; for if you do, you will die instantly.
uz: Eng muhimi, devorlarga kiyimingiz kabi tegmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling; agar shunday qilsangiz, darhol o'lasiz.

en: At the end of the third hall, you will find a door which opens into a garden, planted with fine trees loaded with fruit.
uz: Uchinchi zal oxirida mevalar bilan to'ldirilgan nozik daraxtlar ekilgan bog'ga ochiladigan eshikni topasiz.

en: Walk directly across the garden to a terrace, where you will see a niche before you, and in that niche a lighted lamp.
uz: Bog' bo'ylab to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ayvonga o'ting, u yerda oldingizda joy bor, o'sha joyda esa yoritilgan chiroqni ko'rasiz.

en: Take the lamp down and put it out.
uz: Chiroqni olib, o'chiring.

en: When you have thrown away the wick and poured out the liquor, put it in your waistband and bring it to me.
uz: So'rg'ichni tashlab, spirtli ichimlik to'kkaningizdan so'ng, uni belbog'ingizga solib, menga olib keling.

en: Do not be afraid that the liquor will spoil your clothes, for it is not oil, and the lamp will be dry as soon as it is thrown out.” After these words the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin’s, saying, “It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.
uz: Ichimlik kiyimingizni buzishidan qo'rqmang, chunki u moy emas, chiroq esa tashlanganda qurib qoladi. Shundan so'ng sehrgar barmog'idan uzuk tortib oldi va uni Aladdin'ning ustiga qo'ydi va dedi: Bu barcha yovuzliklarga qarshi talisman, agar menga itoat qilsangiz.

en: Go, therefore, boldly, and we shall both be rich all our lives.” Aladdin descended the steps, and, opening the door, found the three halls just as the African magician had described.
uz: Shunday ekan, jur'at bilan bor, shunda ikkalamiz ham umrbod boy bo'lamiz. Aladdin zinadan tushdi va eshikni ochib, afrikalik sehrgar tasvirlaganidek uchta zalni topdi.

en: He went through them with all the precaution the fear of death could inspire, crossed the garden without stopping, took down the lamp from the niche, threw out the wick and the liquor, and, as the magician had desired, put it in his waistband.
uz: U o'lim qo'rquvi uyg'otishi mumkin bo'lgan barcha ehtiyot choralari bilan ularning ichidan o'tdi, bog'ni to'xtovsiz kesib o'tdi, chiroqni nishadan olib, qamish va spirtni tashladi va sehrgar xohlaganidek, uni belbog'iga soldi.

en: But as he came down from the terrace he stopped in the garden to observe the trees, which were loaded with extraordinary fruit of different colors.
uz: Ammo u terassadan tushayotganda, turli xil rangdagi g'ayrioddiy mevalarga to'la daraxtlarni kuzatish uchun bog'da to'xtadi.

en: The white were pearls; the clear and transparent, diamonds; the deep red, rubies; the paler, ballas rubies; the green, emeralds; the blue, turquoises; and the purple, amethysts.
uz: Oqlari marvaridlar edi; tiniq va shaffoflari olmoslar; to'q qizillari, rubinlar; paler, ballas rubinlar; yashillari, zumradlar; ko'klari, turkuazlar; va binafshalari, ametizmlar.

en: Aladdin, ignorant of their value, would have preferred figs, or grapes, or pomegranates; but he resolved to gather some of every sort.
uz: Aladdin ularning qadrini bilmagan holda, anjirlar, uzumlar yoki anorlarni afzal ko'rardi; lekin u har xil turdagi anjirlarni yig'ishga qaror qildi.

en: Having filled the two new purses his uncle had bought for him with his clothes, he wrapped more up in the skirts of his vest, and crammed his bosom as full as it could hold.
uz: Amaki unga sotib olgan ikkita yangi hamyonni kiyimlari bilan to'ldirgach, u jiletining yubkalariga ko'proq o'radi va ko'kragini sig'adigan darajada to'ldirdi.

en: Aladdin, having thus loaded himself with riches of which he knew not the value, returned through the three halls with the utmost precaution, and soon arrived at the mouth of the cave, where the African magician awaited him with impatience.
uz: Aladdin, o'ziga qimmatini bilmaydigan boyliklar bilan to'lib-toshgan holda, uchta zaldan juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan qaytdi va tez orada g'or og'ziga yetib keldi, u yerda afrikalik sehrgar uni sabrsizlik bilan kutdi.

en: As soon as Aladdin saw him, he cried, “Pray, uncle, lend me your hand, to help me out.” “Give me the lamp first,” replied the magician; “it will be troublesome to you.” “Indeed, uncle,” answered Aladdin, “I cannot now, but I will as soon as I am up.” The African magician was determined that he would have the lamp before he would help him up; and Aladdin, who had encumbered himself so much with his fruit that he could not well get at it, refused to give it to him till he was out of the cave.
uz: Aladdin uni ko'rishi bilanoq, u qichqirib dedi: Iltijo qiling, amaki, qo'lingizni uzating, meni yordam bering. Avval menga chiroq bering, dedi sehrgar; bu sizga noqulay bo'ladi. Ha, amaki, dedi Aladdin, Endi qila olmayman, lekin uyg'onishim bilanoq olaman. Afrikalik sehrgar unga yordam berishdan oldin chiroq bo'lishiga qaror qildi; va Aladdin, o'z mevasi bilan shunchalik yuklanganki, unga yetib bora olmas edi, g'ordan chiqmaguncha unga berishni istamadi.

en: The African magician, provoked at this obstinate refusal, flew into a passion, threw a little of his incense into the fire, and pronounced two magical words, when the stone which had closed the mouth of the staircase moved into its place, with the earth over it in the same manner as it lay at the arrival of the magician and Aladdin.
uz: Afrikalik sehrgar, bu qat'iy rad etishdan jahli chiqib, ehtirosga tushdi, o'zining tutasidan ozgina olovga tashladi va zinapoyaning og'zini yopgan tosh o'z joyiga ko'chganda, xuddi sehrgar va Aladdin kelganida yotganidek, yer ustida turganidek, ikkita sehrli so'z aytdi.

en: This action revealed to Aladdin that the magician was no uncle of his, but one who designed him evil.
uz: Bu harakat Aladdinga sehrgar uning amakisi emasligini, balki uni yomonlik bilan o'ylab topgan odam ekanligini ko'rsatdi.

en: The truth was that he had learnt from his magic books the secret and the value of this wonderful lamp, the owner of which would be made richer than any earthly ruler, and hence his journey to China.
uz: Haqiqat shundaki, u o'zining sehrli kitoblaridan bu ajoyib chiroqning sirini va qiymatini o'rgangan edi, uning egasini har qanday dunyoviy hukmdordan boyroq qilish mumkin edi, shuning uchun u Xitoyga sayohat qilgan edi.

en: His art had also told him that he was not permitted to take it himself, but must receive it as a voluntary gift from the hands of another person.
uz: Uning san'ati unga uni o'zi olishga ruxsat etilmasligini, balki uni boshqa birovning qo'lidan ixtiyoriy sovg'a sifatida qabul qilishi kerakligini ham aytgan edi.

en: Hence he employed young “Deliver me from this place”
uz: Shuning uchun u yoshlarni ishga oldi: Meni bu joydan qutqar.

en: Aladdin, and hoped by a mixture of kindness and authority to make him obedient to his word and will.
uz: Aladdin, va uni o'z so'zi va irodasiga itoatkor qilish uchun mehribonlik va hokimiyat aralashmasidan umid qildi.

en: When he found that this attempt had failed, he set out to return to Africa, but avoided the town, lest any person who had seen him leave in company with Aladdin should make inquiries after the youth.
uz: U bu urinish muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini bilgach, Afrikaga qaytishga otlandi, lekin Aladdin bilan birga ketayotganini ko'rgan har qanday odam yoshlikdan keyin so'roq qilmasligi uchun shaharni chetlab o'tdi.

en: Aladdin being suddenly enveloped in darkness, cried and called to his uncle to tell him he was ready to give him the lamp; but in vain, since his cries could not heard.
uz: Aladdin to'satdan zulmatga g'arq bo'lib, faryod qildi va amakisiga chiroq berishga tayyorligini aytish uchun chaqirib yubordi; lekin befoyda, chunki uning faryodlari eshitilmadi.

en: He descended to the bottom of the steps, with a design to get into the palace, but the door, which was opened before by enchantment, was now shut by the same means.
uz: U zinapoyalarning pastki qismiga tushdi, saroyga kirish uchun mo'ljallangan edi, lekin avval sehr bilan ochilgan eshik endi xuddi shu usul bilan yopilgan edi.

en: He then redoubled his cries and tears until, exhausted, he sat down on the steps without any hope of seeing light again, in expectation of passing from the present darkness to a speedy death.
uz: Keyin u o'zining faryodlari va ko'z yoshlari bilan to'xtadi, to charchab, yana yorug'likni ko'rishga umidi yo'q holda zinapoyalarga o'tirdi va hozirgi zulmatdan tezkor o'limga o'tishni kutdi.

en: In this great emergency he said, “There is no strength or power but in the great and high God;” and in joining his hands to pray he rubbed the ring which the magician had put on his finger.
uz: Ushbu katta favqulodda vaziyatda u dedi: Buyuk va oliy Xudodan boshqa kuch ham, qudrat ham yoq; va qollarini qoshib ibodat qilar ekan, sehrgar barmogiga qoygan uzukni ishqaladi.

en: Immediately a genie of frightful aspect appeared, and said, “What wouldst thou have?
uz: Darhol qo'rqinchli ko'rinishga ega jin paydo bo'ldi va dedi: Senga nima kerak edi?

en: I am ready to obey thee.
uz: Men senga itoat qilishga tayyorman.

en: I serve him who possesses the ring on thy finger; I, and the other slaves of that ring.” At another time Aladdin would have been frightened at the sight of so extraordinary a figure, but the danger he was in made him answer without hesitation, “Whoever thou art, deliver me from this place.” He had no sooner spoken these words, than he found himself on the very spot where the magician had last left him, and no sign of cave or opening, nor disturbance of the earth.
uz: Men sening barmog'ingdagi uzukga ega bo'lgan zotga xizmat qilaman; men ham, o'sha uzukning boshqa qullari ham. Boshqa safar Aladdin bunday g'ayrioddiy qiyofani ko'rib qo'rqib ketardi, lekin uning ichida bo'lgan xavfi uni hech ikkilanmasdan javob berishga majbur qildi: Sen kim bo'lsang, meni bu joydan qutqar. U bu so'zlarni aytishdan oldin sehrgar uni oxirgi marta tashlab ketgan joyda o'zini topdi va g'or, ochilish, yerning bezovtaligi alomatlari yo'q edi.

en: Returning God thanks to find himself once more in the world, he made the best of his way home.
uz: Xudoga qaytib, o'zini dunyoga yana bir bor topgani uchun, u uyga borishga harakat qildi.

en: When he got within his mother’s door, the joy of seeing her and his weakness for want of sustenance made him so faint that he remained for a long time as dead.
uz: U onasining eshigiga kirgach, uni ko'rish quvonchi va tirikchilik yetishmasligi uni shunchalik hushidan ketkazdiki, u uzoq vaqt o'likdek qoldi.

en: As soon as he recovered, he related to his mother all that had happened to him, and they were both vehement in their complaints of the cruel magician.
uz: U tuzalib ketishi bilanoq, onasiga unga bo'lgan barcha voqealarni aytib berdi va ularning ikkalasi ham shafqatsiz sehrgar haqida shikoyat qilishda qat'iy edilar.

en: Aladdin slept soundly till late the next morning, when the first thing he said to his mother was that he wished she would give him his breakfast.
uz: Aladdin ertaga ertalabgacha sog'lom uxladi, o'shanda onasiga birinchi aytgan so'zi uning unga nonushtasini berishini tilardi.

en: child,” said she, “I have not a bit of bread to give you; you ate up all the provisions I had in the house yesterday; but I have a little cotton which I have spun; I will go and sell it, and buy bread and something for our dinner.” “Mother,” replied Aladdin, “keep your cotton for another time, and give me the lamp I brought home with me yesterday; I will go and sell it, and the money I get
uz: Bolam, dedi u, Senga beradigan biroz ham nonim yo'q; kecha uyda bor bo'lgan barcha taomlarni yeb tashlading; lekin ozgina paxtam bor, uni o'g'irladim; borib sotaman, non va kechki ovqatimiz uchun nimadir sotib olaman. Ona, javob berdi Aladdin, paxtangni yana bir vaqtga saqla, va kecha uyga olib kelgan chiroqni menga ber; men borib sotaman, va pulni...

en: for it will serve both for breakfast and dinner, and perhaps supper too.” Aladdin’s mother took the lamp and said to her son, “Here it is, but it is very dirty; if it were a little cleaner I believe it would bring something more.” She took some fine sand and water to clean it; but had no sooner begun to rub it, than in an instant a hideous genie of gigantic size appeared and said in a voice of thunder, “What wouldst thou have?
uz: Chunki u nonushta va kechki ovqat uchun ham xizmat qiladi, balki kechki ovqat hamdir. Aladdinning onasi chiroqni olib, o'g'liga dedi: Mana u, lekin juda iflos; agar biroz tozaroq bo'lsa, menimcha, yana nimadir olib kelishi mumkin edi. U tozalash uchun mayda qum va suv oldi; lekin uni ishqalashga ulgurmagan edi, bir zumda ulkan o'lchamdagi jirkan jin paydo bo'lib, momaqaldiroq ovozi bilan dedi: Nima xohlarding?

en: I am ready to obey thee as thy slave, and the slave of all those who have that lamp in their hands; I and the other slaves of the lamp.” Day had already come some time when Scheherazade broke off.
uz: Men senga quling sifatida va qo'lida o'sha chiroq bo'lganlarning hammasining quli sifatida itoat etishga tayyorman; men va chiroqning boshqa qullari. Sheherazade uzilgan kun allaqachon bir oz vaqtga yetgan edi.

en: “It is time your majesty went to the council,” she said, “and time for me to cease talking.” “But you must begin again to-morrow,” said her husband, “and finish what you have so well told to-day.” This she accordingly promised to do, and took up, on the following night, at the point where she had ended.
uz: Sizning oliyjanobingiz kengashga boradigan vaqti keldi, dedi u, va men gapirishni toxtatadigan vaqt keldi. Lekin eringiz ertaga yana boshlashingiz kerak, dedi u, va bugun aytgan gapingizni tugatishingiz kerak. Buni u shunga mos ravishda qilishga vada berdi va ertasi kuni kechasi, ozi tugatgan joyda boshladi.

en: Aladdin’s mother, terrified at the sight of the genie, fainted; but Aladdin, having seen such a phantom in the cavern, snatched the lamp out of his mother’s hand, and said to the genie boldly, “I am hungry, bring me something to eat.” The genie disappeared immediately, and in an instant returned with a large silver tray, holding twelve covered dishes of the same metal, which contained the most delicious viands; six large white bread cakes on two plates, two flagons of wine, and two silver cups.
uz: Aladdinning onasi jinni ko'rib dahshatga tushib, hushidan ketdi; lekin Aladdin g'orda bunday arvohni ko'rib, onasining qo'lidan chiroqni tortib oldi va jinga dadillik bilan dedi: Men ochman, menga ovqat olib keling. Jin darhol yo'qoldi va bir zumda katta kumush patnis bilan qaytib keldi, ustida eng mazali go'shtlarni o'z ichiga olgan o'n ikkita qoplamali idish bor edi; ikkita idishda oltita katta oq non pirog, ikkita vino va ikkita kumush piyola bor edi.

en: All these he placed upon a carpet and disappeared before Aladdin’s mother recovered from her swoon.
uz: Bularning hammasini gilamga qo'ydi va Aladdinning onasi hushidan ketishidan oldin yo'qoldi.

en: The Genie Disappeared Immediately Aladdin fetched some water, and sprinkled it in her face to recover her.
uz: Jinni darhol yo'qoldi. Aladdin suv olib keldi va uni tiklash uchun yuziga sepdi.

en: Whether that or the smell of the meat affected her cure, it was not long before she came to herself.
uz: Uning shifosiga shu yoki go'shtning hidi ta'sir qilgan bo'lsa ham, u o'ziga kelishiga ko'p vaqt ketmadi.

en: “Mother,” said Aladdin, “be not afraid: get up and eat; here is what will put you in heart, and at the same time satisfy my extreme hunger.” His mother was much surprised to see the great tray, twelve dishes, six loaves, the two flagons and cups, and to smell the savory odor which exhaled from the dishes.
uz: Ona,  dedi Aladdin,  qorqma: tur va ye, mana senga yoqadigan narsa, shu bilan birga mening haddan tashqari ochligimni ham qondir. Onasi katta patnisni, on ikki taomni, olti nonni, ikki qadahni va piyolalarni korib, taomlardan chiqqan shirin hidni hidlagandan juda hayratda edi.

en: “Child,” said she, “to whom are we obliged for this great plenty and liberality?
uz: Bola,  dedi u,  biz bu buyuk boylik va saxiylik uchun kimga qarzdormiz?

en: Has the sultan been made acquainted with our poverty, and had compassion on us?” “It is no matter, mother,” said Aladdin, “let us sit down and eat; for you have almost as much need of a good breakfast as myself; when we have done, I will tell you.” Accordingly, both mother and son sat down and ate with the better relish as the table was so well furnished.
uz: Sulton bizning qashshoqligimiz bilan tanishtirildimi va bizga rahm qilindimi? Mayli emas, ona,  dedi Aladdin,  keling, otirib ovqatlanamiz; chunki sizga ozim kabi yaxshi nonushta kerak; tugatganimizdan keyin sizga aytaman. Shunga kora, ona ham, ogil ham otirib, stol juda yaxshi jihozlanganidan kora yaxshiroq tam bilan ovqatlanishdi.

en: But all the time Aladdin’s mother could not forbear looking at and admiring the tray and dishes, though she could not judge whether they were silver or any other metal, and the novelty more than the value attracted her attention.
uz: Lekin har doim Aladdinning onasi patnis va idishlarga qarashdan va ularga qoyil qolishdan bosh tortmasdi, garchi ularning kumush yoki boshqa metall ekanligini baholay olmasdi va qadriyatdan ko'ra ko'proq yangilik uning e'tiborini tortardi.

en: The mother and son sat at breakfast till it was dinner-time, and then they thought it would be best to put the two meals together; yet, after this they found they had enough left for supper, and two meals for the next day.
uz: Ona va o'g'il nonushtada kechki ovqat vaqti kelguncha o'tirishdi va keyin bu ikki taomni birga qo'yish yaxshiroq deb o'ylashdi; ammo, shundan so'ng ular kechki ovqat uchun yetarli va ertasi kun uchun ikki taom qolganini aniqladilar.

en: When Aladdin’s mother had taken away and set by what was left, she sat down by her son on the sofa, saying, “I expect now that you will tell me exactly what passed between the genie and you while I was in a swoon;” which he readily complied with.
uz: Aladdinning onasi olib ketib, qolgan narsani qo'lga kiritgach, u o'g'lining yonida divanda o'tirdi va dedi: Endi siz jin va siz o'rtasida men bedor bo'lganimda nima sodir bo'lganini aniq aytib berishingizni kutaman; va u bunga bemalol rozi bo'ldi.

en: She was in as great amazement at what her son told her, as at the appearance of the genie; and said to him, “But, son, what have we to do with genii?
uz: U o'g'lining aytganlariga xuddi jin paydo bo'lgandek hayratda edi va unga dedi: Ammo, o'g'lim, biz jinlar bilan nima aloqamiz bor?

en: I never heard that any of my acquaintance had ever seen one.
uz: Hech qachon hech bir tanishim uni ko'rganini eshitmaganman.

en: How came that vile genie to address himself to me, and not to you, to whom he had appeared before in the cave?” “Mother,” answered Aladdin, “the genie you saw is not the one who appeared to me.
uz: Qanday qilib o'sha jirkanch jin g'orda avval paydo bo'lgan sizga emas, balki menga murojaat qilishga keldi? Ona,  javob berdi Aladdin,  siz ko'rgan jin menga paydo bo'lgan emas.

en: If you remember, he that I first saw called himself the slave of the ring on my finger; and this you saw, called himself the slave of the lamp you had in your hand; but I believe you did not hear him, for I think you fainted as soon as he began to speak.” “What!” cried the mother, “was your lamp then the occasion of that cursed genie’s addressing himself rather to me than to you?
uz: Agar eslasangiz, men birinchi marta ko'rgan odam o'zini barmog'imdagi uzukning quli deb atadi; va bu ko'rgan narsangiz, o'zini qo'lingizdagi chiroqning quli deb atadi; lekin menimcha, uni eshitmadingiz, chunki u gapira boshlagan zahoti hushdan ketdingiz deb o'ylayman. Nima! deb baqirdi ona, sening chiroqing o'sha la'nati jinning o'zini sizga emas, balki menga murojaat qilishining sababi edi?

en: my son, take it out of my sight, and put it where you please.
uz: O'g'lim, uni ko'z oldimdan olib tashla va xohlagan joyingga qo'y.

en: I had rather you would sell it than run the hazard of being frightened to death again by touching it; and if you take my advice, you will also part with the ring, and not have anything to do with genii, who, as our prophet has told us, are only devils.” “With your leave, mother,” replied Aladdin, “I shall take care how I sell a lamp which may be so serviceable both to you and me.
uz: Men uni sotganingni afzal ko'rardim, unga tegib, yana o'limga qo'rqib ketish xavfini boshdan kechirganingdan ko'ra; va agar mening maslahatimga quloq solsang, sen ham uzuk bilan ajralib ketasan va payg'ambarimiz aytganidek, ular faqat shaytonlardir. Ruxsat bilan, ona,  javob berdi Aladdin, Men sizga ham, menga ham juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan chiroqni qanday sotishimga e'tibor beraman.

en: That false and wicked magician would not have undertaken so long a journey to secure this wonderful lamp if he had not known its value to exceed that of gold and silver.
uz: O'sha soxta va yovuz sehrgar bu ajoyib chiroqni qo'lga kiritish uchun bunchalik uzoq sayohatga bormagan bo'lardi, agar uning qiymati oltin va kumushdan ustun ekanligini bilmaganida.

en: And since we have honestly come by it, let us make a profitable use of it, without making any great show, and exciting the envy and jealousy of our neighbors.
uz: Va biz undan halol kelib qolgan ekanmiz, keling, undan hech qanday katta ko'z-ko'z qilmasdan, qo'shnilarimizning hasad va rashkini qo'zg'atmasdan foydali foydalanaylik.

en: However, since the genii frighten you so much, I will take it out of your sight, and put it where I may find it when I want it.
uz: Ammo, jinlar sizni bunchalik qo'rqitgani uchun, uni ko'zingizdan olib tashlayman va xohlagan vaqtimda topishim mumkin bo'lgan joyga qo'yaman.

en: resolve to part with; for without that you had never seen me again; and though I am alive now, perhaps, if it were gone, I might not be so some moments hence; therefore, I hope you will give me leave to keep it, and to wear it always on my finger.” Aladdin’s mother replied that he might do what he pleased; for her part, she would have nothing to do with genii, and never say anything more about them.
uz: Usiz meni boshqa hech qachon ko'rmas edingiz; va agar men hozir tirik bo'lsam ham, agar u yo'qolganida, ehtimol, bir lahzaga bunday bo'lmas edim; shuning uchun, umid qilamanki, siz menga uni saqlashga ruxsat berasiz va uni doimo barmog'imda taqishga ruxsat berasiz. Aladdinning onasi javob berdi: u o'zi xohlagan narsani qilishi mumkin; uning o'zi esa, u daholar bilan hech qanday aloqasi bo'lmas edi va ular haqida hech qachon boshqa hech narsa demasdi.

en: By the next night they had eaten all the provisions the genie had brought; and the next day Aladdin, who could not bear the thought of hunger, putting one of the silver dishes under his vest, went out early to sell it, and addressing himself to a Jew whom he met in the streets, took him aside, and pulling out the plate, asked him if he would buy it.
uz: Ertasi kuni ular jin olib kelgan barcha taomlarni yeb bo'lishdi; va ertasi kuni Aladdin ochlik fikrini ko'tara olmadi, ko'ylagi ostiga kumush idishlardan birini qo'yib, uni sotish uchun erta chiqib, ko'chada uchragan yahudiyga murojaat qilib, uni chetga olib ketdi va idishni tortib, undan sotib olishni so'radi.

en: The Jew took the dish, examined it, and as soon as he found that it was good silver, asked Aladdin at how much he valued it.
uz: Yahudiy idishni oldi, uni ko'rib chiqdi va uning yaxshi kumush ekanligini bilishi bilanoq, Aladindan uni qanchalik qadrlashini so'radi.

en: Aladdin, who had never been used to such traffic, told him he would trust to his judgment and honor.
uz: Aladdin, bunday harakatga hech qachon o'rganib qolmagan, unga o'z hukmi va sha'niga ishonishini aytdi.

en: The Jew was somewhat confounded at this plain dealing; and doubting whether Aladdin understood the material or the full value of what he offered to sell, took a piece of gold out of his purse and gave it him, though it was but the sixtieth part of the worth of the plate.
uz: Yahudiy bu oddiy ishdan biroz hayratda edi; va Aladdin bu narsani yoki sotmoqchi bo'lgan narsaning to'liq qiymatini tushunmasligiga shubha qilib, hamyonidan bir dona oltin olib, unga berdi, garchi bu plastinkaning oltmishdan bir qismi bo'lsa ham.

en: Aladdin, taking the money eagerly, made off with so much haste, that the Jew, not content with the exorbitancy of his profit, was vexed he had not penetrated into his ignorance, and was going to run after him, to endeavor to get some change out of the piece of gold; but Aladdin ran so fast, and had got far, that it would have been impossible for the Jew to overtake him.
uz: Aladdin pulni ishtiyoq bilan olib, shunchalik shoshilinch ravishda yo'lga chiqdiki, yahudiy o'z foydasidan norozi bo'lib, u o'z jaholiga kirmaganidan xafa bo'ldi va uning orqasidan yugurib, oltin tangaga pul olishga harakat qilmoqchi edi; lekin Aladdin shunchalik tez yugurdi va uzoqga yetib bordiki, yahudiy uni quvib o'tishi mumkin emas edi.

en: Before Aladdin went home, he called at a baker’s, bought some bread, changed his money, and on his return gave the rest to his mother, who went and purchased provisions enough to last them some time.
uz: Aladdin uyga ketishidan oldin, bir novvoyxonaga qo'ng'iroq qildi, bir oz non sotib oldi, pulini almashtirdi va qaytib kelganda qolganini onasiga berdi. Ona borib, ularni biroz vaqtga yetkazadigan oziq-ovqat sotib oldi.

en: After this manner they lived, till Aladdin had sold the twelve dishes singly, as necessity pressed, to the Jew, for the same money; who, after the first time, durst not offer him less, for fear of losing so good a bargain.
uz: Shunday qilib, ular shunday yashashdi, toki Aladdin o'n ikki taomni birma-bir, zaruratga ko'ra, yahudiyga bir xil pulga sotmaguncha; u, birinchi safardan keyin, juda yaxshi kelishuvni yo'qotishdan qo'rqib, unga kamroq taklif qilishga jur'at eta olmadi.

en: When he had sold the last dish, he had recourse to the tray, which weighed ten times as much as the dishes, and would have carried it to his old purchaser, but that it was too large and heavy; therefore he was obliged to bring him to his
uz: U oxirgi taomni sotgach, idishlardan o'n barobar og'irroq bo'lgan patnisga murojaat qildi va uni eski xaridorga olib bormoqchi edi, lekin u juda katta va og'ir edi; shuning uchun uni o'ziga olib kelishga majbur edi.

en: mother’s, where, after the Jew had exclaimed at the weight of the tray, he laid down ten pieces of gold, with which Aladdin was very well satisfied.
uz: onasining, u yerda, yahudiy patnis og'irligida qichqirganidan so'ng, Aladdin juda mamnun bo'lgan o'n dona oltinni qo'ydi.

en: When all the money was spent, Aladdin had recourse again to the lamp.
uz: Barcha pul sarflangandan so'ng, Aladdin yana chiroqga murojaat qildi.

en: He took it, looked for the part where his mother had rubbed it with the sand, and rubbed it also, when the genie immediately appeared, and said, “What wouldst thou have?
uz: U uni oldi, onasi uni qum bilan ishqalagan joyni qidirdi va u bilan ham ishqaladi, shunda jin darhol paydo bo'ldi va dedi: Senga nima kerak edi?

en: I am ready to obey thee as thy slave, I and the other slaves of the lamp.” “I am hungry,” said Aladdin, “bring me something to eat.” The genie disappeared, and presently returned with a tray, the same number of covered dishes as before, set them down, and vanished.
uz: Men senga quling sifatida itoat etishga tayyorman, men va chiroqning boshqa qullari. Men ochman,  dedi Aladdin,  menga yeyishga narsa olib kel. Jin yoqoldi va tez orada avvalgidek kop bolgan patnis bilan qaytib keldi, ularni qoydi va yoqoldi.

en: As soon as Aladdin found that their provisions were again expended, he took one of the dishes, and went to look for his Jew chapman; but passing by a goldsmith’s shop, the goldsmith called to him and said, “My lad, I imagine that you have something to sell to the Jew, whom I often see you visit; but perhaps you do not know that he is the greatest of rogues.
uz: Aladdin ularning ta'minoti yana sarflanganini bilishi bilanoq, idishlardan birini oldi va yahudiy chafmanini qidirishga ketdi; lekin bir zargarning do'konidan o'tib, zargar unga chaqirib dedi: Ey yigit, men tasavvur qilamanki, sizda ko'p marta tashrif buyurgan yahudiyga sotadigan narsa bor; lekin ehtimol u eng zo'r badbo'y ekanligini bilmaysiz.

en: I will give you the full worth of what you have to sell, or I will direct you to other merchants who will not cheat you.” This offer induced Aladdin to pull his plate from under his vest and show it to the goldsmith; who at first sight saw that it was made of the finest silver, and asked him if he had sold such as that to the Jew.
uz: Sizga sotadigan narsangizning to'liq qiymatini beraman, yoki sizni aldamaydigan boshqa savdogarlarga yo'naltiraman. Bu taklif Aladdinni paltosini ko'ylagi ostidan tortib oltinchiga ko'rsatishga undadi; u dastlab eng yaxshi kumushdan yasalganini ko'rdi va undan bunday narsani yahudiyga sotganmi, deb so'radi.

en: Aladdin told him that he had sold him twelve such, for a piece of gold each.
uz: Aladdin unga o'n ikki dona tilla sotib berganini aytdi, har biri bir bo'lak oltin uchun.

en: “What a villain!” cried the goldsmith.
uz: Qanday yomon odam! deb baqirdi zargar.

en: “But, what is past cannot be recalled.
uz: Lekin, o'tmishni eslab bo'lmaydi.

en: By showing you the value of this plate, which is of the finest silver we use in our shops, I will let you see how much the Jew has cheated you.” The goldsmith took a pair of scales, weighed the dish, and assured him that his plate would fetch by weight sixty pieces of gold, which he offered to pay down immediately.
uz: Sizga do'konlarimizda ishlatiladigan eng yaxshi kumushdan bo'lgan bu plastinaning qiymatini ko'rsatib, yahudiy sizni qancha miqdorda aldaganini ko'rsataman. Zargar bir juft tarozi olib, idishni tortdi va uning plastinasi og'irligi bo'yicha oltmish dona oltin olib kelishiga ishontirdi, uni darhol to'lashni taklif qildi.

en: Aladdin thanked him for his fair dealing, and never after went to any other person.
uz: Aladdin unga adolatli muomalasi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi va keyin hech qachon boshqa odamga bormadi.

en: Aladdin now frequented the shops of the principal merchants, where they sold cloth of gold and silver, linens, silk stuffs, and jewelry, oftentimes joining in their conversation, and so acquired a knowledge of the world, and a desire to improve himself.
uz: Aladdin endi asosiy savdogarlarning do'konlariga borardi, u yerda ular oltin va kumush, choyshablar, ipak buyumlar va zargarlik buyumlarini sotishardi, tez-tez ularning suhbatlariga qo'shilishardi va shu tariqa dunyo haqida bilim va o'zini yaxshilash istagini qo'lga kiritardi.

en: By his acquaintance among the jewelers, he came to know that the fruits which he had gathered when he took the lamp were, instead of colored glass, stones of inestimable value; but he had the prudence not to mention this to any one, not even to his mother.
uz: Zargarlar bilan tanishishi tufayli, u lampochkani olganida yig'gan mevalari rangli shisha o'rniga bebaho qimmatbaho toshlar ekanligini bilib oldi; lekin u buni hech kimga, hatto onasiga ham aytmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ldi.

en: One day as Aladdin was walking about the town, he heard an order proclaimed, commanding the people to shut up their shops and houses, and keep within doors while the Princess Buddir al Buddoor, the sultan’s daughter, went to the bath and returned.
uz: Bir kuni Aladdin shahar bo'ylab sayr qilayotganida, odamlarga do'konlari va uylarini yopishni, eshiklar ichida qolishni buyurib, malika Buddir al Buddoor, sultonning qizi vannaga borib qaytganini eshitdi.

en: This proclamation inspired Aladdin with eager desire to see the princess, which he determined to gratify, by placing himself behind the door of the bath, so that he could not fail to see her face.
uz: Bu e'lon Aladdinni malika bilan uchrashishga ishtiyoq bilan ilhomlantirdi, u uni xursand qilishga qaror qildi va hammom eshigi ortiga o'zini qo'ydi, shunda u uning yuzini ko'rmaslikka qodir edi.

en: Aladdin had not long concealed himself before the princess came.
uz: Aladdin malika kelguncha uzoq yashirinmadi.

en: She was attended by a great crowd of ladies, slaves, and mutes, who walked on each side and behind her.
uz: Unga katta olomon ayollar, qullar va o'tirgan odamlar tashrif buyurdi, ular uning orqasidan va har tomondan yurishdi.

en: When she came within three or four paces of the door of the bath, she took off her veil, and gave Aladdin an opportunity of a full view of her face.
uz: U vanna eshigidan uch-to'rt qadam narida kelgach, pardalarini yechdi va Aladdinga uning yuzini to'liq ko'rish imkoniyatini berdi.

en: The princess was a noted beauty: her eyes were large, lively, and sparkling; her smile bewitching; her nose faultless; her mouth small; her lips vermilion.
uz: Malika diqqatga sazovor go'zallik edi: uning ko'zlari katta, jonli va yaltiroq edi; uning tabassumi sehrli edi; burni benuqson edi; og'zi kichkina edi; lablari qizil rangda edi.

en: It is not therefore surprising that Aladdin, who had never before seen such a blaze of charms, was dazzled and enchanted.
uz: Shunday ekan, Aladdinning bunday jozibali olovni ilgari hech qachon ko'rmaganligi hayratlanarli emas, u ko'zni qamashtirgan va sehrlangan edi.

en: After the princess had passed by and entered the bath, Aladdin quitted his hiding-place, and went home.
uz: Malika o'tib, vannaga kirgandan so'ng, Aladdin yashirin joyini tark etib, uyiga ketdi.

en: His mother perceived him to be thoughtful and melancholy and asked what had happened to make him so, or if he was ill.
uz: Uning onasi uni o'ychan va qayg'uli deb hisobladi va nima uni shunday qilishga sabab bo'lganini yoki u kasalmi, deb so'radi.

en: He then told his mother his adventure, and concluded by declaring, “I love the princess more than I can express, and am resolved that I will ask her in marriage of the sultan.”
uz: Keyin u onasiga o'z sarguzashtini aytib berdi va xulosa qilib dedi: Men malika bilan so'zlashdan ko'ra ko'proq sevaman va undan sultonga turmushga chiqishni so'rashga qat'iy qaror qildim.

en: Aladdin’s mother laughed aloud.
uz: Aladdinning onasi baland ovozda kuldi.

en: child,” said she, “what are you thinking of?
uz: Bolam, dedi u, nima haqida o'ylayapsan?

en: You must be mad to talk thus.” “I assure you, mother,” replied Aladdin, “that I am not mad, but in my right senses.
uz: Siz bunday gapirish uchun aqldan ozgan bo'lishingiz kerak. Sizni ishontiraman, ona,  javob berdi Aladdin,  men aqldan ozgan emasman, balki o'z aql-idrokim bilan.

en: I foresaw that you would reproach me with folly and extravagance; but I must tell you once more, that I am resolved to demand the princess of the sultan in marriage; nor do I despair of success.
uz: Siz meni ahmoqlik va dabdaba bilan tanqid qilishingizni oldindan ko'rdim; lekin yana bir bor sizga aytishim kerakki, men sulton malikaga turmushga chiqishga qaror qildim; shuningdek, muvaffaqiyatdan umid qilmayman.

en: I have the slaves of the lamp and of the ring to help me, and you know how powerful their aid is.
uz: Menga yordam berish uchun chiroq va uzuk qullari bor va ularning yordami qanchalik kuchli ekanligini bilasiz.

en: And I have another secret to tell you: those pieces of glass, which I got from the trees in the garden of the subterranean palace are jewels of inestimable value, fit for the greatest monarchs.
uz: Va sizga yana bir sir aytmoqchiman: yer osti saroyining bog'idagi daraxtlardan olgan shisha bo'laklari bebaho qimmatbaho javohirlardir, eng buyuk monarxlarga mos keladi.

en: All the precious stones the jewelers have in Bagdad are not to be compared to mine for size or beauty; and I am sure that the offer of them will secure the favor of the sultan.
uz: Bag'dodda zargarlarning barcha qimmatbaho toshlari o'lchami yoki go'zalligi bo'yicha menikiga teng kelmaydi; va men ularning taklifi sultonning marhamatini qozonishiga aminman.

en: You have a large porcelain dish fit to hold them; fetch it, and let us see how they will look, when we have arranged them according to their different colors.” Aladdin’s mother having brought the china dish, he took the jewels out of the two purses in which he had kept them, and placed them in order, according to his fancy.
uz: Sizda ularni ushlab turishga mos keladigan katta chinni idish bor; uni olib keling, biz ularning turli xil ranglariga ko'ra qanday ko'rinishini ko'raylik. Aladdinning onasi xitoy taomini olib kelganidan so'ng, u ularni saqlagan ikkita hamyonidan javohirlarni chiqarib, o'z xohishiga ko'ra tartiblantirdi.

en: But the brightness and luster they emitted in the daytime, and the variety of the colors, so dazzled the eyes both of mother and son, that they were astonished beyond measure.
uz: Ammo kunduzi ular taratgan yorqinlik va yaltiroqlik, ranglarning xilma-xilligi ona va o'g'ilning ko'zlarini shunchalik qamashtirdiki, ular cheksiz hayratda qoldilar.

en: Aladdin’s mother, emboldened by the sight of these rich jewels, complied with his request, and promised to go early the next morning to the palace of the sultan.
uz: Aladdinning onasi, bu boy javohirlarni ko'rib ruhlanib, uning iltimosiga javob berdi va ertalab erta tongda sulton saroyiga borishga va'da berdi.

en: Aladdin rose before daybreak, awakened his mother, pressing her to go to the sultan’s palace, and to get admittance, if possible, before the grand vizier, the other viziers, and the great officers of state went in to take their seats in the divan, where the sultan always attended in person.
uz: Aladdin tong otishidan oldin uyg'onib, onasini uyg'otdi, uni sulton saroyiga borishga va imkon bo'lsa, oliy vazir, boshqa vazirlar va davlatning buyuk amaldorlari divanga o'tirish uchun kirishdan oldin kirishga undadi, u yerda sulton har doim shaxsan qatnashardi.

en: Aladdin’s mother took the china dish in which they had put the jewels, wrapped it in two fine napkins, and set forward for the sultan’s palace.
uz: Aladdinning onasi zargarlik buyumlarini solgan xitoy taomini oldi, uni ikki xil nozik salfetkaga o'rab, sulton saroyiga yo'l oldi.

en: When she came to the gates, the grand vizier, the other viziers, and most distinguished lords of the court were just gone in; but notwithstanding the crowd of people was great, she got into the divan, a spacious hall, the entrance into which was
uz: U darvozalarga yetib borgach, bosh vazir, boshqa vazirlar va saroyning eng hurmatli amirlari endigina kirishdi; lekin odamlarning olomon ko'p bo'lishiga qaramay, u divanga, keng zalga kirdi, uning kirish joyi...

en: She placed herself just before the sultan, who was seated with the grand vizier, and the great lords, who sat in council, on his right and left hand.
uz: U o'zini o'ng va chap qo'llarida, oliy vazir bilan birga o'tirgan sulton va kengashda o'tirgan buyuk xo'jayinlar oldida joylashtirdi.

en: Several cases were called, according to their order, pleaded and adjudged, until the time the divan generally broke up, when the sultan, rising, returned to his apartment, attended by the grand vizier; the other viziers and ministers of state then retired, as also did all those whose business had called them thither.
uz: Ularning buyrug'iga ko'ra bir nechta ishlar chaqirildi, da'vo qilindi va hukm qilindi, toki divan odatda tarqalib ketguncha, sultan o'rnidan turib, o'z xonadoniga qaytdi, unda bosh vazir ishtirok etdi; qolgan vazirlar va davlat vazirlari keyin nafaqaga chiqdi, shuningdek, ularga tegishli bo'lgan barcha odamlar ham.

en: Aladdin’s mother, seeing the sultan and all the people depart, judged rightly that he would not sit again that day, and resolved to go home; and on her arrival said, with much simplicity, “Son, I have seen the sultan, and am very well persuaded he has seen me, too, for I placed myself just before him; but he was so much taken up with those who attended on all sides of him that I pitied him, and wondered at his patience.
uz: Aladdinning onasi, sulton va butun xalq ketayotganini ko'rib, u o'sha kuni yana o'tirmasligini to'g'ri baholadi va uyga qaytishga qaror qildi; va u kelganida, juda soddalik bilan dedi: O'g'lim, men sultonni ko'rdim va u meni ham ko'rganligiga juda ishonaman, chunki men o'zimni uning oldiga qo'ydim; lekin u uning har tomoniga kelganlar bilan shunchalik band ediki, unga achinardim va uning sabr-toqatidan hayron bo'ldim.

en: At last I believe he was heartily tired, for he rose up suddenly, and would not hear a great many who were prepared to speak to him, but went away, at which I was well pleased, for indeed I began to lose all patience, and was extremely fatigued with staying so long.
uz: Nihoyat, menimcha, u yuragidan charchagan edi, chunki u to'satdan turdi va unga gapirishga tayyor bo'lgan ko'pchilikni eshitmasdi, lekin ketdi, bundan juda xursand bo'ldim, chunki men butun sabrimni yo'qota boshladim va bunchalik uzoq qolishdan juda charchadim.

en: But there is no harm done; I will go again to-morrow; perhaps the sultan may not be so busy.” The next morning she repaired to the sultan’s palace with the present, as early as the day before; but when she came there, she found the gates of the divan shut, it being held only on alternate days.
uz: Lekin hech qanday zarar yo'q; ertaga yana boraman; balki sulton unchalik band bo'lmasligi mumkin.  Ertasi kuni ertalab u sulton saroyiga oldingi kundagidek, hozirgi narsa bilan yo'l oldi; lekin u yerga kelgach, divanning darvozalarini yopiq holda topdi, u faqat almashinuv kunlarida o'tkazilayotgan edi.

en: She went six times afterward on the days appointed, placing herself always directly before the sultan, but with as little success as the first morning.
uz: U keyin belgilangan kunlarda olti marta bordi, o'zini doimo to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sulton oldida joylashtirdi, lekin birinchi ertalabdagidek kam muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

en: On the sixth divan, however, after the sultan returned to his own apartment he said to his grand vizier: “I have for some time observed a certain woman, who attends constantly every day that I give audience, with something wrapped up in a napkin; she always stands up from the beginning to the breaking up of the audience, and takes care to place herself just before me.
uz: Oltinchi divan kuni esa, sulton o'z xonadoniga qaytib kelganidan so'ng, u o'zining katta vaziriga dedi: Men bir muncha vaqtdan beri bir ayolni kuzatdim, u har kuni men ko'rsatayotgan tomoshaga muntazam ravishda salfetkaga o'ralgan narsa bilan keladi; u doim boshidan tomoshabinlar tarqalguniga qadar turadi va o'zini oldimda joylashtirishga harakat qiladi.

en: If this woman comes to our next audience, do not fail to call her, that I may hear what she has to say.” The grand vizier made answer by lowering his hand,
uz: Agar bu ayol keyingi tomoshabinimizga kelsa, uni qo'ng'iroq qilishdan tortinmang, shunda men uning nima deyayotganini eshitishim mumkin. Buyuk vazir qo'lini pastga tushirib javob berdi.

en: and then lifting it up above his head, signifying his willingness to lose it if he failed.
uz: so'ngra uni boshidan yuqoriga ko'tarib, agar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrasa, uni yo'qotishga tayyorligini anglatadi.

en: On the next audience day, when Aladdin’s mother went to the divan, and placed herself in front of the sultan as usual, the grand vizier immediately called the chief of the mace-bearers, and pointing to her bade him bring her before the sultan.
uz: Keyingi tinglov kuni Aladdinning onasi divanga borib, odatdagidek sultonning oldiga o'tirganda, bosh vazir darhol tayoqchilar boshlig'ini chaqirib, unga ishora qilib, uni sulton huzuriga olib kelishni buyurdi.

en: The old woman at once followed the mace-bearer, and when she reached the sultan bowed her head down to the carpet which covered the platform of the throne, and remained in that posture until he bade her rise, which she had no sooner done than he said to her, “Good woman, I have observed you to stand many days from the beginning to the rising of the divan; what business brings you here?” Aladdin’s mother prostrated herself a second time; and when she arose, said, “Monarch of monarchs, I beg of you to pardon the boldness of my petition, and to assure me of your forgiveness.” “Well,” replied the sultan, “I will forgive you, be it what it may, and no hurt shall come to you; speak boldly.” When Aladdin’s mother had taken these precautions, for fear of the sultan’s anger, she told him faithfully the errand on which her son had sent her, and the event which led to his making so bold a request
uz: Kampir darhol tayoqchiga ergashib ketdi va u sultonga yetgach, boshini taxta platformasini qoplagan gilamga egdi va u o'rnidan turguncha shu holatda qoldi. U unga shunday dedi: Ey yaxshi ayol, men seni divanning ko'tarilishigacha ko'p kun turganingni kuzatdim; senga bu yerga nima kelyapti? Aladdinning onasi ikkinchi marta sajda qildi; va u o'rnidan turgach, dedi: Monaxlar monarxi, men sizdan iltimos qilaman, iltimosimning jur'atidan kechiring va meni kechirishingizga ishontiring. Xo'sh, dedi sulton, Men sizni kechiraman, nima bo'lsa ham, senga hech qanday ish kelmaydi. Aladdinning onasi unga shunday bir g'azab va g'azabni yuborishidan qo'rqib,

en: in spite of all her remonstrances.
uz: Uning barcha ta'mirlashlariga qaramay.

en: The sultan hearkened to this discourse without showing the least anger; but before he gave her any answer, asked her what she had brought tied up in the napkin.
uz: Sulton bu nutqni hech qanday g'azabni ko'rsatmasdan tingladi; lekin unga javob berishidan oldin, salfetkada nima olib kelganini so'radi.

en: She took the china dish which she had set down at the foot of the throne, untied it, and presented it to the sultan.
uz: U taxt etagiga qo'ygan xitoy taomini oldi, uni yechdi va sultonga topshirdi.

en: The sultan’s amazement was inexpressible, when he saw so many large, beautiful, and valuable jewels collected in the dish.
uz: Sultonning hayrati ifodalab bo'lmas edi, u idishda shunchalik ko'p katta, go'zal va qimmatbaho javohirlarni ko'rib qoldi.

en: He remained for some time lost in admiration.
uz: U bir muncha vaqt hayratda qoldi.

en: At last, when he had recovered himself he received the present saying, “How rich, how beautiful!” After he had admired and handled all the jewels one after another, he turned to his grand vizier, and said, “Behold, admire, wonder!
uz: Nihoyat, o'zini tiklaganidan so'ng, u sovg'ani qabul qildi: Qanday boy, qanday go'zal! U barcha javohirlarni birma-bir hayratda ko'rib, ularga qo'l urganidan so'ng, u o'zining katta vaziriga o'girilib dedi: Mana, hayratlan, hayratlan!

en: and confess that your eyes never beheld jewels so rich and
uz: va tan olingki, ko'zlaringiz hech qachon bunchalik boy va

en: beautiful before.” The vizier was charmed.
uz: Ilgari chiroyli edi. Vazir sehrlangan edi.

en: “Well,” continued the sultan, “what sayest thou to such a present?
uz: Xo'sh,  davom etdi sulton,  bunday sovg'aga nima deysiz?

en: Is it not worthy of the princess my daughter?
uz: Bu malika qizimga loyiq emasmi?

en: And ought I not to bestow her on one who values her at so great a price?” “I cannot but own,” replied the grand vizier, “that the present is worthy of the princess; but I beg of your majesty to grant me three months before you come to a final resolution.
uz: Va men uni shunchalik qimmat baholaydigan odamga sovg'a qilmasam bo'ladimi? Men bunga ega bo'lishdan o'zimni tiya olmayman,  javob berdi oliy vazir, ki bu sovg'a malikaga munosib; lekin sizdan oliyjanobligingizni so'rayman, yakuniy qarorga kelishingizdan oldin uch oy vaqt bering.

en: I hope, before that time, my son, whom you have regarded with favor, will be able to make a nobler present than this Aladdin, who is an entire stranger to your majesty.” The sultan granted his request, and said to the old woman, “Good woman, go home, and tell your son that I agree to the proposal you have made me; but I cannot marry the princess my daughter for three months; at the expiration of that time come again.” Aladdin’s mother returned home more gratified than she had expected, and told her son with much joy the condescending answer she had received from the sultan’s own mouth; and that she was to come to the divan that day three months.
uz: Umid qilamanki, o'sha vaqtgacha, siz mehribonlik bilan qaragan o'g'lim, sizning oliyjanobligingizga butunlay begona bo'lgan Aladdindan ko'ra olijanobroq sovg'a qila oladi. Sulton o'z iltimosini qondirdi va kampirga dedi: Yaxshi ayol, uyga bor va o'g'lingizga siz bergan taklifga rozi ekanligimni ayt; lekin men malika qizimga uch oyga turmushga chiqa olmayman; o'sha vaqt o'tgach, yana keling. Aladdinning onasi uyga kutganidan ko'ra ko'proq xursand bo'lib qaytdi va o'g'liga o'sha kunning o'z og'zidan olgan past javobni ko'p xursandchilik bilan aytdi; va u o'sha kuni uch oyda divanga kelishi kerak edi.

en: Aladdin thought himself the most happy of all men at hearing this news, and thanked his mother for the pains she had taken in the affair.
uz: Aladdin bu xabarni eshitib, o'zini barcha odamlardan eng xursand deb hisobladi va onasiga bu ishda ko'rgan azoblari uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

en: He counted every day, week, and even hour as it passed.
uz: U har bir kunni, haftani va hatto soatni o'tishi bilan sanardi.

en: When two of the three months were gone, his mother one evening, having no oil in the house, went out to buy some, and found a general rejoicing—the houses dressed with foliage, silks, and carpeting, and all the people striving to show their joy according to their ability.
uz: Uch oydan ikkitasi o'tib ketganida, onasi bir kuni kechqurun uyda yog'i yo'q bo'lib, biroz sotib olishga chiqdi va umumiy xursandchilikni topdi  barglar, ipaklar va gilamlar bilan bezatilgan uylar va barcha odamlar o'z qobiliyatlariga ko'ra quvonchlarini ko'rsatishga harakat qilishdi.

en: The streets were crowded with officers in habits of ceremony, mounted on horses richly caparisoned, each attended by a great many footmen.
uz: Ko'chalar marosim odatlari bo'yicha ofitserlar bilan gavjum edi, ularning har biri juda ko'p piyodalar bilan birga bo'lgan, mo'ljallangan otlarga minib yurardi.

en: Aladdin’s mother asked the oil merchant what was the meaning of all this public festivity.
uz: Aladdinning onasi neft sotuvchidan bu ommaviy bayramning ma'nosi nima ekanligini so'radi.

en: “Whence came you, good woman,” said he, “that you know not that the grand vizier’s son is to marry the Princess Buddir al Buddoor, the sultan’s daughter, to-night?
uz: Qanday qilib kelding, yaxshi ayol,  dedi u, ki, buyuk vazirning ogli shu kecha sultanning qizi malika Buddir al Buddurga turmushga chiqishini bilmaysan?

en: She will presently return from the bath; and these officers whom you see are to assist at the cavalcade to the palace, where the ceremony is to be solemnized.”
uz: U tez orada vannaxonadan qaytadi; va siz ko'rayotgan bu ofitserlar saroyga otda yordam berishadi, u yerda marosim tantanali tarzda o'tkaziladi.

en: Aladdin’s mother, on hearing this ran home very quickly.
uz: Aladdinning onasi buni eshitgach, juda tez uyga yugurdi.

en: “Child,” cried she, “you are undone!
uz: Bolam,  deb baqirdi u,  sen yo'qsan!

en: The sultan’s fine promises will come to nought.
uz: Sultonning nozik va'dalari hech narsaga aylanadi.

en: This night the grand vizier’s son is to marry the Princess Buddir al Buddoor.” Aladdin was thunderstruck.
uz: Bugun kechasi bosh vazirning o'g'li malika Buddir al Buddurga turmushga chiqadi. Aladdin hayratga tushdi.

en: However, he bethought himself of the lamp, and of the genie who had promised to obey him; and without indulging in idle words against the sultan, the vizier, or his son, he determined, if possible, to prevent the marriage.
uz: Ammo u o'zini chiroq va unga itoat etishga va'da bergan jinlar haqida o'yladi; va sultonga, vazirga yoki uning o'g'liga qarshi bekorchi so'zlarga berilmasdan, iloji bo'lsa, nikohning oldini olishga qaror qildi.

en: He went into his chamber, took the lamp, rubbed it in the same place as before, when immediately the genie appeared, and said to him, “What wouldst thou have?
uz: U o'z xonasiga kirdi, chiroqni oldi, avvalgidek joyida ishqalladi, shunda darhol jin paydo bo'ldi va unga dedi: Senga nima kerak?

en: I am ready to obey thee as thy slave; I, and the other slaves of the lamp.” “Hear me,” said Aladdin; “thou hast hitherto obeyed me, but now I am about to impose on thee a harder task.
uz: Men senga quling sifatida itoat etishga tayyorman; men ham, chiroqning boshqa qullari ham. Menga quloq sol,  dedi Aladdin; sen menga shu paytgacha itoat qilding, lekin endi senga qiyinroq vazifa yuklamoqchiman.

en: The sultan’s daughter, who was promised me as my bride, is this night married to the son of the grand vizier.
uz: Sultonning qizi, menga kelinim sifatida va'da qilingan, shu kecha buyuk vazirning o'g'liga turmushga chiqdi.

en: Bring them both hither to me immediately they retire to their bedchamber.” “Master,” replied the genie, “I obey thee.” Aladdin supped with his mother as was their wont, and then went to his own room, and sat up to await the return of the genie.
uz: Ularning ikkalasi ham darhol menga olib kelinglar, ular o'z yotoqxonalariga qaytadilar. Ustoz,  javob berdi jin, Men sizga itoat qilaman. Aladdin onasi bilan odatdagidek ovqatlandi, so'ngra o'z xonasiga bordi va jinning qaytishini kutish uchun o'tirdi.

en: In the mean time the festivities in honor of the princess’s marriage were conducted in the sultan’s palace with great magnificence.
uz: Ayni paytda malika to'yi sharafiga bag'ishlangan tantanalar sulton saroyida katta ulug'vorlik bilan o'tkazildi.

en: The ceremonies were at last brought to a conclusion, and the princess and the son of the vizier retired to the bedchamber prepared for them.
uz: Marosimlar nihoyat yakunlandi va malika va vazirning o'g'li ular uchun tayyorlangan yotoqxonaga chekindilar.

en: No sooner had they entered it and dismissed their attendants than the genie, the faithful slave of the lamp, to the great amazement and alarm of the bride and bridegroom, took up the bed, and transported it in an instant into Aladdin’s chamber, where he set it down.
uz: Ular u yerga kirib, xizmatkorlarini quvib yuborishlariga ko'ra, jin, chiroqning sadoqatli quli, kelin va kuyovning katta hayrat va vahimaga to'lib, karovatni olib, bir zumda Aladdinning xonasiga olib kirdi va u yerda uni o'rnatdi.

en: “Remove the bridegroom,” said Aladdin to the genie, “and keep him a prisoner till to-morrow dawn, and then return with him here.” Aladdin being left alone with the princess, endeavored to assuage her fears, and explained to her the treachery practiced upon him by the sultan her father.
uz: Kelinni olib tashlang, dedi Aladdin jinga, va uni ertaga tong otguncha asir tuting, so'ngra u bilan bu yerga qayting. Aladdin malika bilan yolg'iz qolgach, uning qo'rquvlarini yengillashtirishga harakat qildi va otasi sulton tomonidan unga nisbatan qilingan xiyonatni unga tushuntirdi.

en: He then laid himself down beside her,
uz: So'ngra u uning yoniga yotdi.

en: putting a drawn scimitar between them, to show that he was determined to secure her safety, and to treat her with the utmost possible respect.
uz: Ularning o'rtasiga chizilgan simitar qo'yib, uning xavfsizligini ta'minlashga va unga imkon qadar hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'lishga qat'iy ekanligini ko'rsatdi.

en: At break of day, the genie appeared at the appointed hour, bringing back the bridegroom, whom by breathing upon he had left motionless and entranced at the door of Aladdin’s chamber during the night, and at Aladdin’s command transported the couch with the bride and bridegroom on it, by the same invisible agency, into the palace of the sultan.
uz: Kunduzgi tongda jin tayinlangan soatda paydo bo'ldi va kuyovni qaytarib olib keldi. U uni nafas olib, tun davomida Aladdinning xonasi eshigiga harakatsiz qoldirdi va hayratga soldi. Aladdinning buyrug'iga ko'ra, kelin va kuyov o'tirgan divanni xuddi shu ko'rinmas vosita orqali sulton saroyiga olib kirdi.

en: At the instant that the genie had set down the couch with the bride and bridegroom in their own chamber, the sultan came to the door to offer his good wishes to his daughter.
uz: Jin kelin va kuyov bilan birga o'z xonalariga yotqizgandan so'ng, sulton qiziga yaxshi tilaklarini bildirish uchun eshik oldiga keldi.

en: The grand vizier’s son, who was almost perished with cold because of standing in his thin under-garment all night, no sooner heard the knocking at the door than he got out of bed and ran into the robing-chamber where he had undressed himself the night before.
uz: Buyuk vazirning o'g'li, tun bo'yi ingichka ichki kiyimida turgani uchun sovuqdan deyarli halok bo'lgan, eshik taqillatishini eshitmasdan turib, o'rnidan turdi va o'tgan kecha yechingan o'g'irlik xonasiga yugurdi.

en: The sultan having opened the door, went to the bedside and kissed the princess on the forehead, but was extremely surprised to see her look so melancholy.
uz: Sulton eshikni ochib, karavotga o'tdi va malika peshonasidan o'pdi, lekin uning bunchalik qayg'uli ko'rinishini ko'rib juda hayron bo'ldi.

en: He questioned her, but she only cast him a sorrowful look, expressive of great affliction.
uz: U uni so'roq qildi, lekin u unga faqat qayg'uli nigoh bilan qaradi, bu esa katta azobni ifodalardi.

en: He suspected there was something extraordinary in this silence, and went immediately to the sultaness’s apartment, told her in what a state he found the princess, and how she had received him.
uz: U shu sukut ichida g'ayrioddiy narsa bor deb gumon qildi va darhol sultonning xonadoniga bordi, unga malika qanday holatda ekanligini va uni qanday qabul qilganini aytdi.

en: “Sire,” said the sultaness, “I will go and see her; she will not receive me in the same manner.” The princess met her mother with sighs and tears, and signs of deep dejection.
uz: Hazratim, dedi sulton, Men uni ko'rishga boraman; u meni xuddi shunday qabul qilmaydi. Malika onasini oh-voh va ko'z yoshlar bilan, chuqur tushkunlik alomatlari bilan kutib oldi.

en: At last, her mother pressing on her the duty of telling her all her thoughts, she gave to the sultaness a precise description of what had happened to her during the night; on which the sultaness enjoined on her the necessity of silence and discretion, as no one would give credence to so strange a tale.
uz: Nihoyat, onasi unga barcha fikrlarini aytish vazifasini yuklab, u sultanlikka kechasi unga nima bo'lganini aniq tasvirladi; bunda sultan unga sukut saqlash va ehtiyotkorlik zarurligini buyurdi, chunki hech kim bunday g'alati hikoyaga ishonmas edi.

en: The grand vizier’s son, elated with the honor of being the sultan’s son-in-law, kept silence on his part, and the events of the night were not allowed to cast the least gloom on the festivities on the following day, in continued celebration of the royal marriage.
uz: Buyuk vazirning o'g'li, sultonning kuyovi ekanligi bilan faxrlanar ekan, o'z tomondan sukut saqlardi va tun voqealariga keyingi kundagi bayramlarga, qirollik nikohini davom ettirishda hech qanday xiralik qoldirmasdi.

en: When night came, the bride and bridegroom were again attended to their chamber with the same ceremonies as on the preceding evening.
uz: Kech kirganda, kelin va kuyov yana oldingi oqshomdagidek marosimlar bilan o'z xonalariga tashrif buyurishdi.

en: Aladdin, knowing that this would be so, had already given his commands to the genie of the lamp; and no sooner were they alone than their bed was removed in the same mysterious manner as on the preceding evening; and having passed the night in the same unpleasant way, they were in the morning conveyed to the palace of the sultan.
uz: Aladdin, bu shunday bo'lishini bilgan holda, allaqachon chiroq joniga buyruq bergan edi; va ular o'tgan oqshomdagidek sirli tarzda to'shaklari olib tashlanganidan ko'p o'tmay, ertalab ular sulton saroyiga yetkazildi.

en: Scarcely had they been replaced in their apartment, when the sultan came to make his compliments to his daughter.
uz: Ular kvartirasida deyarli almashtirilmagan edi, qachonki sulton o'z qiziga maqtovlar aytgani kelgan edi.

en: The princess could no longer conceal from him the unhappy treatment she had been subject to, and told him all that had happened as she had already related it to her mother.
uz: Malika endi undan o'ziga duch kelgan baxtsiz muomalani yashira olmadi va unga sodir bo'lgan hamma narsani onasiga aytib bergan edi.

en: The sultan, on hearing these strange tidings, consulted with the grand vizier; and finding from him that his son had been subjected to even worse treatment by an invisible agency, he determined to declare the marriage canceled, and the festivities, which were yet to last for several days, to be terminated.
uz: Sulton bu g'alati xabarni eshitgach, bosh vazir bilan maslahatlashdi; va undan o'g'lining ko'rinmas agentlik tomonidan yanada yomonroq muomalaga duchor bo'lganini bilib, nikohni bekor qilishni va bir necha kun davom etadigan bayramlarni bekor qilishga qaror qildi.

en: This sudden change in the mind of the sultan gave rise to various speculations and reports.
uz: Sultonning ongidagi to'satdan bo'lgan bu o'zgarish turli xil taxminlar va xabarlarga sabab bo'ldi.

en: Nobody but Aladdin knew the secret, and he kept it with the most scrupulous silence; and neither the sultan nor the grand vizier, who had forgotten Aladdin and his request, had the least thought that he had any hand in the strange adventures that befell the bride and bridegroom.
uz: Aladdindan boshqa hech kim sirni bilmas edi va u uni eng sinchkovlik bilan sukut saqlardi; va Aladdin va uning so'rovini unutgan sulton ham, oliy vazir ham kelin va kuyovning boshiga tushgan g'alati sarguzashtlarga uning aloqasi bor deb hech qanday o'ylamagan edi.

en: On the very day that the three months contained in the
uz: Xuddi uch oy ichida bo'lgan o'sha kuni...

en: The Sultan Directed His Vizier to Have Her Brought Before Him sultan’s promise expired, the mother of Aladdin went to the palace, and stood in the same place in the divan.
uz: Sulton o'z vazirini uning oldiga olib kelishga buyurdi. Sultonning va'dasi tugagandan so'ng, Aladdinning onasi saroyga bordi va divanda o'sha yerda turdi.

en: The sultan knew her again, and directed his vizier to have her brought before him.
uz: Sulton uni yana tanidi va vazirini uni o'ziga olib kelishga buyurdi.

en: After having prostrated herself, she made answer, in reply to the sultan: “Sire, I come at the end of three months to ask of you the fulfillment of the promise you made to my son.” The sultan who had no mind to marry his daughter to the son of a poor woman took counsel with his vizier, who suggested that the sultan should attach such conditions to the marriage as no one of the humble condition of Aladdin could possibly fulfill.
uz: Sakrab olganidan so'ng, u javob berdi va sultonga dedi: Hazratim, men sizdan o'g'limga bergan va'dangizning bajarilishini so'rash uchun uch oy oxirida keldim. Qizini kambag'al ayolning o'g'liga turmushga chiqarishni o'ylamagan sulton o'z vaziri bilan maslahatlashdi, u esa sultonga nikohga Aladdinning hech biri bajarolmaydigan shunday shartlar qo'yishni taklif qildi.

en: The sultan therefore replied to the mother of Aladdin: “Good woman, it is true sultans ought to abide by their word, and I am ready to keep mine, by making your son happy in marriage with the princess my daughter.
uz: Sulton Aladdinning onasiga shunday javob berdi: Yaxshi ayol, haqiqiy sultonlar o'z so'zlariga sodiq qolishlari kerak, men esa o'g'lingizni malika qizim bilan turmush qurgan holda baxtli qilish orqali o'z so'zimga sodiq qolishga tayyorman.

en: But as I cannot marry her without some further proof of your son being able to support her in royal state, you may tell him, I will fulfill my promise as soon as he shall send me forty trays of massy gold, full of the
uz: Lekin men unga o'g'lingiz uni qirollik davlatida qo'llab-quvvatlay olishini yana bir bor isbotlamasdan turmushga chiqa olmas ekanman, unga aytishingiz mumkinki, u menga qirq patnis katta oltin to'ldirgan zahotiyoq va'damni bajaraman.

en: same sort of jewels you have already made me a present of, and carried by the like number of black slaves, who shall be led by as many young and handsome white slaves, all dressed magnificently.
uz: Xuddi shu turdagi javohirlarni menga sovg'a qilib qo'ydingiz va xuddi shunday miqdordagi qora qullar bilan olib yuribsiz, ularni juda ko'p yosh va chiroyli oq qullar boshqaradi, ularning barchasi ajoyib tarzda kiyingan.

en: On these conditions I am ready to bestow the princess my daughter upon him; therefore, good woman, go and tell him so, and I will wait till you bring me his answer.” Aladdin’s mother prostrated herself a second time before the sultan’s throne, and retired.
uz: Shu shartlarda men malika qizimni unga sovg'a qilishga tayyorman; shuning uchun, yaxshi ayol, borib unga ayt, men sening javobingni menga keltirishingni kutaman. Aladdinning onasi sulton taxti oldida ikkinchi marta sajda qildi va nafaqaga chiqdi.

en: On her way home, she laughed within herself at her son’s foolish imagination.
uz: Uyga qaytayotganda, u o'g'lining ahmoqona tasavvuridan o'zida kuldi.

en: “Where,” said she, “can he get so many large gold trays, and such precious stones to fill them?
uz: Qayerda,  dedi u,  bunchalik katta oltin patnislar va ularni toldirish uchun bunchalik qimmatbaho toshlarni olishi mumkinmi?

en: It is altogether out of his power, and I believe he will not be much pleased with my embassy this time.” When she came home, full of these thoughts, she told Aladdin of her interview with the sultan, and the conditions on which he consented to the marriage.
uz: Bu uning qo'lidan umuman kelmaydi va menimcha, u bu safar mening elchixonamdan unchalik mamnun bo'lmaydi. U uyga kelganida, bu fikrlarga to'lib-toshgan holda, u Aladdinga sulton bilan qilgan intervyusi va u nikohga rozi bo'lgan shartlari haqida aytib berdi.

en: “The sultan expects your answer immediately,” said she; and then added, laughing, “I believe he may wait long enough!” “Not so long, mother, as you imagine,” replied Aladdin.
uz: Sulton sizning javobingizni darhol kutadi,  dedi u; va keyin kulgan holda qoshib qoydi: Menimcha, u yetarlicha kutishi mumkin! Unda uzoq emas, onam, tasavvur qilganingizdek,  javob berdi Aladdin.

en: “This demand is a mere trifle, and will prove no bar to my marriage with the princess.
uz: Bu talab shunchaki mayda-chuyda narsa va malika bilan nikohimga hech qanday to'siq bo'lmasligini isbotlaydi.

en: I will at once satisfy the sultan’s request.” Aladdin, as soon as he was alone, summoned the genie of the lamp, and required him to present the gift, before the sultan closed his morning audience.
uz: Men sultonning so'rovini darhol qondiraman. Aladdin yolg'iz qolishi bilanoq, chiroq jinini chaqirib, sulton ertalabki auditoriyasini yopishdan oldin undan sovg'ani taqdim etishni talab qildi.

en: The genie professed his obedience to the owner of the lamp, and disappeared.
uz: Jin chiroq egasiga itoatkorligini tan oldi va g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: Within a short time, a train of forty black slaves, led by the same number of white slaves, appeared opposite the house in which Aladdin lived.
uz: Qisqa vaqt ichida Aladdin yashagan uyning ro'parasida qirq nafar qora tanli quldan iborat poyezd, oq tanli qullar bilan boshchiligida paydo bo'ldi.

en: Each black slave carried on his head a tray of massy gold, full of pearls, diamonds, rubies, and emeralds.
uz: Har bir qora qul boshiga marvaridlar, olmoslar, yoqutlar va zumradlar bilan to'la ulkan oltindan yasalgan patnisni olib yurardi.

en: Aladdin then called to his mother: “Madam, pray lose no time; before the sultan and the divan rise, I would have you return to the palace with this present as the dowry demanded for the princess, that he may judge by my diligence and exactness of the ardent and sincere desire I have to procure myself the honor of this alliance.” As soon as this magnificent procession, with Aladdin’s mother at its head, had begun to march from Aladdin’s house, the streets were
uz: Aladdin onasiga qo'ng'iroq qilib dedi: Xonim, vaqtni yo'qotmang; sulton va divan ko'tarilishidan oldin, sizdan saroyga shu sovg'a bilan, malika uchun talab qilinadigan marh bilan qaytishingizni so'rayman, shunda u mening mehnatsevarligim va o'zimga bu ittifoq sharafini olishim kerak bo'lgan chin dildan va samimiy niyatim haqida hukm chiqarishi mumkin edi. Aladdinning onasi boshchiligida bo'lgan bu ajoyib marsh Aladdin uyining tomondan yurishni boshlagan zahoti ko'chalar...

en: filled with crowds of people desirous to see so grand a sight.
uz: Bunday ulkan manzarani ko'rishni istagan odamlar olomoni bilan to'lib-toshgan.

en: The graceful bearing, elegant form, and wonderful likeness of each slave; their grave walk at an equal distance from each other, the luster of their jeweled girdles, and the brilliancy of the aigrettes of precious stones in their turbans, excited the greatest admiration in the spectators.
uz: Har bir qulning nafis ko'rinishi, nafis shakli va ajoyib o'xshashligi; ularning bir-biridan teng masofada yurishi, javohir bezaklarining yaltirashi va turbanlardagi qimmatbaho toshlarning yorqinligi tomoshabinlarda eng katta hayrat uyg'otdi.

en: As they had to pass through several streets to the palace, the whole length of the way was lined with files of people.
uz: Ular saroyga bir nechta ko'chalardan o'tishlari kerak bo'lganida, yo'lning butun uzunligi odamlarning fayllari bilan qoplangan edi.

en: Nothing, indeed, was ever seen so beautiful and brilliant in the sultan’s palace, and the richest robes of the emirs of his court were not to be compared to the costly dresses of these slaves, whom the crowd supposed to be kings.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, sulton saroyida hech narsa bunchalik go'zal va yorqin ko'rinmagan edi va uning saroyi amirlarining eng boy liboslari bu qullarning qimmatbaho liboslariga tenglashtirilmas edi, chunki olomon ularni shoh deb hisoblardi.

en: As the sultan, who had been informed of their approach, had given orders for them to be admitted, they met with no obstacle, but went into the divan in regular order, one part turning to the right, and the other to the left.
uz: Sulton ularning yaqinlashgani haqida xabar topib, ularni qabul qilishga buyruq berganida, hech qanday to'siq bo'lmadi, lekin ular divanga muntazam ravishda kirishdi, bir qismi o'ngga, ikkinchi qismi esa chapga burildi.

en: After they were all entered, and had formed a semi-circle before the sultan’s throne, the black slaves laid the golden trays on the carpet, prostrated themselves, touching the carpet with their foreheads, and at the same time the white slaves did likewise.
uz: Ularning hammasi kirganidan so'ng va sulton taxti oldida yarim doira shakllanib bo'lgandan so'ng, qora qullar gilamga oltin patnislarni qo'ydilar, peshonalari bilan gilamga tegib, sajda qildilar va ayni paytda oq qullar ham xuddi shunday qildilar.

en: When they rose, the black slaves uncovered the trays, and then all stood with their arms crossed over their breasts.
uz: Ular ko'tarilganlarida, qora qullar patnislarni ochdilar va keyin hamma qo'llarini ko'kraklari ustida o'rab turdilar.

en: In the mean time, Aladdin’s mother advanced to the foot of the throne, and having prostrated herself, said to the sultan, “Sire, my son knows this present is much below the notice of Princess Buddir al Buddoor; he hopes, nevertheless, that your majesty will accept it, and make it agreeable to the princess, and with the greater confidence since he has endeavored to conform to the conditions you were pleased to impose.” The sultan, overpowered at the sight of such more than royal magnificence, replied without hesitation to the words of Aladdin’s mother: “Go and tell your son that I wait with open arms to embrace him; and the more haste he makes to come and receive the princess my daughter from my hands, the greater pleasure he will do me.” As soon as Aladdin’s mother had retired, the sultan put an end to the audience; and rising from his throne ordered that the princess’s
uz: Shu bilan birga, Aladdinning onasi taxt etagiga yaqinlashdi va sajda qilib, sultonga dedi: Janobi Oliylari, oglim bu sovga malika Buddir al Buddurning etiboridan ancha past ekanligini biladi; shunga qaramay, u oliyjanobingiz uni qabul qilishiga va malikaga mos kelishiga umid qiladi, va u siz buyurgan shartlarga moslashishga harakat qilganligi sababli katta ishonch bilan. Sulton, bunday shohlik ulugvorligini korib, Aladdinning onasining sozlariga hech ikkilanmasdan javob berdi: Bor va oglingizga uni quchoqlash uchun ochiq qol bilan kutaman; va u tezroq kelib, qizimni qolimdan oladi, u menga katta mamnuniyat beradi.

en: attendants should come and carry the trays into their mistress’s apartment, whither he went himself to examine them with her at his leisure.
uz: Xizmatchilar kelib, patnislarni xo'jayinning xonadoniga olib kirishlari kerak edi, u yerga u o'zi borardi, u bilan birga ularni dam olish vaqtida tekshirardi.

en: The fourscore slaves were conducted into the palace; and the sultan, telling the princess of their magnificent apparel, ordered them to be brought before her apartment, that she might see through the lattices how he had not exaggerated in his account of them.
uz: To'rtta qul saroyga olib kirildi; va sulton malikaga ularning ajoyib kiyimlarini aytib, ularni uning xonadoni oldiga olib kelishni buyurdi, toki u panjaralar orqali ularning haqidagi hikoyasida qanday haddan tashqari gapirmaganini ko'rishi mumkin edi.

en: In the mean time Aladdin’s mother reached home, and showed in her air and countenance the good news she brought to her son.
uz: Shu bilan birga Aladdinning onasi uyiga yetib keldi va o'g'liga olib kelgan xushxabarni uning havosi va yuzida ko'rsatdi.

en: “My son,” said she, “you are arrived at the height of your desires.
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi u,  sen o'z istaklaringning eng cho'qqisiga yetding.

en: The sultan has declared that you shall marry the Princess Buddir al Buddoor.
uz: Sulton malika Buddir al Buddurga uylanishingni e'lon qildi.

en: He waits for you with impatience.” Aladdin, enraptured with this news, hastened to his chamber.
uz: U sizni sabrsizlik bilan kutmoqda. Aladdin bu xabarga mahliyo bo'lib, o'z xonasiga shoshildi.

en: There he rubbed his lamp, and the obedient genie appeared.
uz: U yerda u chiroqini ishqaladi va itoatkor jin paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Genie,” said Aladdin, “convey me at once to a bath, and supply me with the richest and most magnificent robes ever worn by a monarch.” No sooner were the words out of his mouth than the genie transported him into a bath of the finest marble of all sorts of colors; where he was undressed, without seeing by whom, in a magnificent and spacious hall.
uz: Jin,  dedi Aladdin,  meni darhol vannaga olib boring va monarx kiygan eng boy va ulugvor liboslar bilan taminlang. Uning ogzidan chiqqan sozlar tez orada jin uni har xil rangdagi eng yaxshi marmardan iborat vannaga olib kirdi; u yerda u hech kim kormasdan, ajoyib va keng zalda yechiladi.

en: He was then well rubbed and washed with various scented waters.
uz: Keyin u yaxshilab ishqalandi va turli xil xushbo'y suvlar bilan yuvildi.

en: After he had passed through several degrees of heat, he came out quite a different man from what he was before.
uz: U bir necha daraja issiqlikdan o'tib bo'lgandan so'ng, avvalgidek butunlay boshqacha odam bo'lib chiqdi.

en: His skin was clear as that of a child, his body lightsome and free; and when he returned into the hall, he found, instead of his own poor raiment, garments the magnificence of which astonished him.
uz: Uning terisi boladagidek tiniq, tanasi yorqin va erkin edi; va u zalga qaytib kirgach, o'zining bechora kiyimlari o'rniga uni hayratga soladigan kiyimlarni topdi.

en: The genie helped him to dress, and when he was done, transported him back to his own chamber, where he asked him if he had any other commands.
uz: Jin unga kiyinishga yordam berdi va u tayyor bo'lgach, uni o'z xonasiga qaytarib olib bordi va u yerda undan boshqa buyruqlari bormi deb so'radi.

en: “Yes,” answered Aladdin, “bring me a charger that surpasses in beauty and goodness the best in the sultan’s stables; with a saddle, bridle, and other caparisons to correspond with his value.
