uz: Ha,  javob berdi Aladdin,  menga gozallik va yaxshilikda sultonning ustaxonalaridagi eng yaxshilardan ustun bolgan yuklagichni olib keling; uning qadriyatiga mos keladigan egar, jilvir va boshqa caparisonlar bilan.

en: Furnish also twenty slaves, as richly clothed as those who carried the present to the sultan, to walk by my side and follow me, and twenty more to go before me in two ranks.
uz: Shuningdek, yigirmata qulni ham jihozlang, ular sovg'ani sultonga olib borganlar kabi boy kiyimda, yonimda yurib menga ergashishlari uchun va yana yigirmata qul mening oldimdan ikki qatorda ketishlari uchun.

en: Besides these, bring my mother six women slaves to attend her, as richly dressed as any of the Princess Buddir al Buddoor’s,
uz: Bundan tashqari, onamga oltita qul ayolni olib keling, ular malika Buddir al Buddurning har qanday malikasi kabi boy kiyimda bo'lishsin.

en: each carrying a complete dress fit for any sultaness.
uz: Har biri har qanday sultonlik uchun mos keladigan to'liq libosni olib yurgan.

en: I want also ten thousand pieces of gold in ten purses; go, and make haste.” “Behold, Sire, day has returned,” said Scheherazade, “and The Sultan and Aladdin ate by themselves
uz: Men ham o'n mingta oltinni o'n hamyon ichida xohlayman; borib shoshiling. Mana, hazratim, kun qaytdi,  dedi Sheherazad,  va Sulton va Aladdin o'zlari ovqatlanishdi.

en: I must cease my tale at this point.
uz: Men o'z hikoyamni shu nuqtada to'xtatishim kerak.

en: This is unfortunate, as the better part remains to be told.” “Then we will hear it to-morrow,” the sultan replied.
uz: Bu achinarli, chunki eng yaxshi qismi hali aytilishi kerak.  Unda ertaga eshitamiz,  javob berdi sulton.

en: And it was as he had said.
uz: Va u aytganidek bo'ldi.

en: As soon as Aladdin had given these orders, the genie disappeared, but presently returned with the horse, the forty slaves, ten of whom carried each a purse containing ten thousand pieces of gold, and six women slaves, each carrying on her head a splendid dress for Aladdin’s mother, wrapt up in a piece of silver tissue.
uz: Aladdin bu buyruqlarni bergan zahoti jin g'oyib bo'ldi, lekin tez orada ot bilan birga qaytib keldi, qirq qul, ularning har biri o'n ming tilla bo'lgan hamyonni, va olti ayol qul, har biri Aladdinning onasi uchun ajoyib ko'ylakni boshida olib, kumush mato bilan o'ralgan edi.

en: Aladdin presented the six women slaves to his mother, telling her they were her slaves, and that the dresses they had brought were for her use.
uz: Aladdin oltita ayol qulini onasiga taqdim etib, ular uning qullari ekanligini va ular olib kelgan ko'ylaklar uning foydasi uchun ekanligini aytdi.

en: Of the ten purses Aladdin gave four to his mother, telling her they were to supply her with necessaries; the other six he left in the hands of the slaves who brought them, with an order to throw the money by handfuls among the people as they went to the sultan’s palace.
uz: Aladdin o'nta hamyonning to'rttasini onasiga berdi va unga zarur narsalar bilan ta'minlashlari kerakligini aytdi; qolgan oltitasini ularni olib kelgan qullarning qo'lida qoldirdi, pulni odamlar orasida bir hovuchlab tashlash buyrug'i bilan, ular sulton saroyiga borar edilar.

en: The six slaves who carried the purses he ordered likewise to march beside him, three on the right hand and three on the left.
uz: Hamyonlarni ko'tarib yurgan oltita qulga ham uning yonida yurishni buyurdi, o'ng tomonda uchta va chap tomonda uchta.

en: When Aladdin had thus prepared himself for his first interview with the sultan, he dismissed the genie and immediately mounting his charger, began his march, and though he never was on horseback before, appeared with a grace the most experienced horseman might envy.
uz: Aladdin shu tariqa sulton bilan birinchi suhbatga tayyorgarlik ko'rganidan so'ng, jinni qo'yib yuborib, darhol chargerga o'tirdi, yurishini boshladi va garchi ilgari hech qachon otda bo'lmagan bo'lsa ham, eng tajribali chavandoz hasad qilishi mumkin bo'lgan nafosat bilan paydo bo'ldi.

en: The innumerable concourse of people through whom he passed made the air echo with their acclamations, especially every time the six slaves who carried the purses threw handfuls of gold among the populace.
uz: Uning o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan son-sanoqsiz odamlarning suhbatlari ularning olqishlari bilan havo aks-sado berardi, ayniqsa har safar sumkalarni ko'tarib yurgan oltita qul xalq orasida bir hovuch oltin uloqtirganda.

en: On Aladdin’s arrival at the palace, the sultan was surprised to find him more richly and magnificently robed than he had ever been himself, and was impressed with his good looks and dignity of manner, which were so different from what he expected in the son of one so humble as Aladdin’s mother.
uz: Aladdin saroyga kelganida, sulton uni o'zi bo'lganidan ham boyroq va ulug'vorroq kiyimda topganiga hayron bo'ldi va uning chiroyli ko'rinishi va odob-axloqi bilan hayratda qoldi, bu Aladdinning onasi kabi kamtarin odamning o'g'lidan kutganidan juda farq qilardi.

en: He embraced him with demonstrations of joy, and when Aladdin would have fallen at his
uz: U uni xursandchilik namoyishlari bilan quchoqladi va Aladdin uning oldida yiqilganida...

en: feet, held him by the hand, and made him sit near his throne.
uz: oyoqlari, uni qo'lidan ushladi va taxtining yoniga o'tqazdi.

en: He shortly after led him amidst the sounds of trumpets, and hautboys to a magnificent entertainment, at which the sultan and Aladdin ate at a table by themselves, and the great lords of the court, according to their rank and dignity, sat at different tables.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay u uni karnaylar va hakamlar ovozi orasida ajoyib ko'ngilxushlikka olib bordi, unda sultan va Aladdin o'zlari stol ustida ovqatlanishardi va saroyning buyuk amirlari o'z darajasi va qadr-qimmatlariga ko'ra turli xil stollarda o'tirishardi.

en: After the feast, the sultan sent for the chief cadi, and commanded him to draw up a contract of marriage between the Princess Buddir al Buddoor and Aladdin.
uz: Bayramdan so'ng, sulton bosh kadini chaqirib yubordi va unga malika Buddir al Buddoor va Aladdin o'rtasida nikoh shartnomasini tuzishni buyurdi.

en: While the contract was being drawn, the sultan asked Aladdin if he would stay in the palace and complete the ceremonies of the marriage that day.
uz: Shartnoma tuzilgan paytda, sulton Aladdindan saroyda qolishini va o'sha kuni nikoh marosimlarini yakunlashini so'radi.

en: “Sire,” said Aladdin, “though great is my impatience to enter on the honor granted me by your majesty, yet I beg you to permit me first to build a palace worthy to receive the princess your daughter.
uz: Janob,  dedi Aladdin,  garchi oliyjanobingiz menga bergan sharafga kirish uchun sabrsizlikim juda katta boʻlsa-da, lekin avval sizdan malika qizingizni qabul qilishga arziydigan saroy qurishga ruxsat berishingni soʻrayman.

en: I pray you to grant me sufficient ground near your palace, and I will have it completed with the utmost expedition.” The sultan granted Aladdin his request, and again embraced him.
uz: Sendan saroying yaqinida yetarli yer berishingni so'rayman, shunda uni eng zo'r ekspeditsiya bilan yakunlayman. Sulton Aladdinning iltimosini qondirdi va yana uni quchoqladi.

en: After which Aladdin took his leave with as much politeness as if he had been bred at court.
uz: Shundan so'ng Aladdin xuddi saroyda tarbiyalanganidek odob bilan ketdi.

en: Aladdin returned home in the order he had come, amidst the acclamations of the people, who wished him all happiness and prosperity.
uz: Aladdin kelgan tartibida uyga qaytdi, xalqning olqishlari orasida, ular unga barcha baxt va farovonlik tilashdi.

en: As soon as he dismounted, he went to his room, took the lamp, and summoned the genie.
uz: U o'tirgan zahoti o'z xonasiga bordi, chiroqni oldi va jinni chaqirib oldi.

en: “Genie,” said Aladdin, “build me a palace fit to receive the Princess Buddir al Buddoor.
uz: Jin, dedi Aladdin, Menga malika Buddir al Buddurni qabul qilishga mos saroy qur.

en: Let its materials be made of nothing less than porphyry, jasper, agate, lapis lazuli, and the finest marble.
uz: Uning materiallari porfir, yaspis, agate, lapis lazuli va eng sara marmardan kam bo'lmagan narsalardan tayyorlansin.

en: Let its walls be massive gold and silver bricks laid alternately.
uz: Uning devorlari oltin va kumush g'ishtlar bilan navbatma-navbat yotqizilsin.

en: Let each front contain six windows, and let the lattices of these (except one, which must be left unfinished) be enriched with diamonds, rubies, and emeralds, so that they shall exceed everything of the kind ever seen in the world.
uz: Har bir old tomonda oltita deraza bo'lsin va ularning panjaralari (biridan tashqari, tugallanmagan holda qoldirilishi kerak) olmos, qora yoqut va zumradlar bilan boyitilsin, shunda ular dunyoda ko'rilgan barcha turdagi narsalardan ustun bo'lsin.

en: Let there be an inner and outer court and a spacious garden; but above all things, provide a safe treasure-house, and fill it with gold and silver.
uz: Ichki va tashqi hovli va keng bog' bo'lsin; lekin eng muhimi, xavfsiz xazina uyini ta'minlang va uni oltin va kumush bilan to'ldiring.

en: Let there be also kitchens and storehouses, stables full of the finest horses, with their equerries and grooms, and hunting equipage, officers, attendants, and slaves, both men and women, to form a retinue for the princess and myself.
uz: Shuningdek, oshxonalar va omborxonalar, eng yaxshi otlarga to'la otxonalar, ularning otlari va kuyovlari, shuningdek, ov anjomlari, ofitserlar, xizmatchilar va qullar, erkaklar va ayollar, malika va men uchun jamoa tashkil etish uchun bo'lsin.

en: Go and execute my wishes.”
uz: Borib, tilaklarimni amalga oshiring.

en: When Aladdin gave these commands to the genie, the sun was set.
uz: Aladdin jinlarga bu buyruqlarni berganida, quyosh botdi.

en: The next morning at daybreak the genie presented himself, and, having obtained Aladdin’s consent, transported him in a moment to the palace he had made.
uz: Ertasi kuni tong otishida jin o'zini ko'rsatdi va Aladdinning roziligini olganidan so'ng, uni bir zumda o'zi yasagan saroyga olib bordi.

en: The genie led him through all the apartments, where he found officers and slaves, habited according to their rank and the services to which they were appointed.
uz: Jin uni barcha xonadonlar bo'ylab olib bordi, u yerda ofitserlar va qullarni topdi, ular o'z darajasiga va tayinlangan xizmatlarga qarab yashashardi.

en: The genie then showed him the treasury, which was opened by a treasurer, where Aladdin saw large vases of different sizes, piled up to the top with money, ranged all round the chamber.
uz: Jinni unga xazinani ko'rsatdi, uni xazinachi ochgan edi, u yerda Aladdin turli o'lchamdagi katta vazalarni ko'rdi, ular tepada pul bilan to'plangan, xonaning butun atrofida joylashgan edi.

en: The genie thence led him to the stables, where were some of the finest Arabian horses in the world, and the grooms with them; from thence they went to the storehouses, which were filled with all things necessary, both for food and ornament.
uz: Jinni uni o'sha yerdan dunyodagi eng yaxshi arab otlari va ular bilan birga bo'lgan otxonalarga olib bordi; u yerdan ular oziq-ovqat va bezak uchun zarur bo'lgan barcha narsalar bilan to'ldirilgan omborxonalarga bordilar.

en: When Aladdin had examined every portion of the palace, and particularly the hall with the four-and-twenty windows, and found it exceeded his expectations, he said, “Genie, there is one thing wanting, a fine carpet for the princess to walk upon from the sultan’s palace to mine.
uz: Aladdin saroyning har bir qismini, ayniqsa yigirma to'rt derazali zalni ko'rib chiqqach va bu uning kutganidan ham oshib ketganini aniqlagandan so'ng, u dedi: Jin, bir narsa yetishmayapti, malika uchun sulton saroyidan mening saroyimga yurish uchun mayin gilam.

en: Lay one down immediately.” The genie disappeared, and Aladdin saw what he desired executed in an instant.
uz: Darhol yotqizib qo'ying. Jin g'oyib bo'ldi va Aladdin o'zi xohlagan narsani bir zumda amalga oshganini ko'rdi.

en: The genie then returned, and carried him back to his own home.
uz: Jin keyin qaytib keldi va uni o'z uyiga qaytarib olib ketdi.

en: When the sultan’s porters came early that morning to open the gates, they were amazed to find what had been an unoccupied square filled with a magnificent palace, and a splendid carpet extending to it all the way from the sultan’s palace gates.
uz: O'sha erta tongda sultonning darvozabonlari darvozalarni ochish uchun erta kelishganda, ular ajoyib saroy bilan to'ldirilgan, mast bo'lmagan maydonni va sultonning saroy darvozalaridan ungacha cho'zilgan ajoyib gilamni topib hayratda qolishdi.

en: They told the strange tidings to the grand vizier, who informed the sultan, who exclaimed, “It must be Aladdin’s palace, which I gave him leave to build for my daughter.
uz: Ular g'alati xabarni buyuk vazirga aytishdi, u sultonga xabar berdi va u shunday dedi: Bu Aladdin saroyi bo'lishi kerak, men unga qizim uchun qurishga ruxsat berdim.

en: He has wished to surprise us, and let us see what wonders can be done in a single night.” Aladdin, after returning to his own home, requested his mother to go to the Princess Buddir al Buddoor, and tell her that the palace would be ready for her reception that evening.
uz: U bizni hayratga solmoqchi edi va bir kecha ichida qanday mo'jizalar qilish mumkinligini ko'raylik. Aladdin o'z uyiga qaytgach, onasidan malika Buddir al Buddoorning oldiga borishni so'radi va unga saroy o'sha oqshom uni qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lishini aytdi.

en: She went, attended by her women slaves, in the same order as on the preceding day.
uz: U o'tgan kundagidek, ayol qullari hamrohligida bordi.

en: Shortly after her arrival at the princess’s apartment, the sultan himself came in, and was surprised to find her, whom he knew as a
uz: Uning malika xonadoniga kelishi bilanoq, sultonning o'zi kirdi va uni topib hayron bo'ldi, uni u... deb biladi.

en: suppliant at his divan in such humble guise, to be now more richly and sumptuously attired than his own daughter.
uz: Shunday kamtarona qiyofada divaniga yolvorib, endi o'z qizidan ko'ra boyroq va dabdabaliroq kiyinadi.

en: Shortly after his mother’s departure, Aladdin, mounting his horse, attended by his retinue of magnificent retainers, left his paternal home forever, and went to the palace in the same pomp as on the day before.
uz: Onasining ketishidan ko'p o'tmay, Aladdin otga minib, o'zining ajoyib askarlari bilan birga, otasining uyini abadiy tark etib, o'tgan kundagidek hashamat bilan saroyga bordi.

en: Nor did he forget to take with him the Wonderful Lamp, to which he owed all his good fortune, nor to wear the Ring which was given him as a talisman.
uz: U o'zi bilan butun boyligi bor ajoyib chiroqni olib yurishni ham unutmadi, shuningdek, unga talisman sifatida berilgan uzukni ham kiyishni unutmadi.

en: The sultan entertained Aladdin with the utmost magnificence, and at night, on the conclusion of the marriage ceremonies, the princess took leave of the sultan her father.
uz: Sulton Aladdinni juda ham ulug'vorlik bilan ko'z-ko'z qildi va kechasi, nikoh marosimlari tugagandan so'ng, malika otasi sultan bilan xayrlashdi.

en: Bands of music led the procession, followed by a hundred state ushers, and the like number of black mutes, in two files, with their officers at their head.
uz: Musiqa guruhlari marshrutga boshchilik qildi, undan keyin yuz nafar davlat qo'mondoni va shunga o'xshash miqdordagi qora dumbalar, ikki faylda, o'z ofitserlari boshida.

en: Four hundred of the sultan’s young pages carried flambeaux on each side, which, together with the illuminations of the sultan’s and Aladdin’s palaces, made it as light as day.
uz: Sultonning yosh sahifalaridan to'rt yuztasi har bir tomonda olov chiroqlari bilan birga edi, ular sultan va Aladdin saroylarining yoritilishi bilan birga uni kunduzgidek yengil qildi.

en: In this order the princess, in her litter and accompanied by Aladdin’s mother, also in a superb litter and attended by her women slaves, proceeded on the carpet which was spread from the sultan’s palace to that of Aladdin.
uz: Shu tartibda malika, o'z to'shagida va Aladdinning onasi hamrohligida, ajoyib to'shagida va ayol qullari hamrohligida, sulton saroyidan Aladdin saroyiga cho'zilgan gilam ustida yo'l oldi.

en: Aladdin received her at the entrance, and led her into a large hall, illuminated with an infinite number of wax candles, where a noble feast was served.
uz: Aladdin uni kirish joyida kutib oldi va cheksiz miqdordagi mum shamlari bilan yoritilgan katta zalga olib kirdi, u yerda olijanob ziyofat o'tkazildi.

en: The dishes were of massy gold, and contained the most delicate viands.
uz: Idishlar juda katta oltindan edi va eng nozik go'shtlarni o'z ichiga olgan edi.

en: The princess, dazzled to see so much riches collected in one place, said to Aladdin, “I thought, prince, that nothing in the world was so beautiful as my father’s palace, but the sight of this hall alone is sufficient to show I was mistaken.” When the supper was ended, there entered a company of Nautch girls who performed, according to the custom of the country, singing at the same time verses in praise of the bride and bridegroom.
uz: Malika, bir joyda shuncha boylik to'planganini ko'rib, Aladdinga dedi: Men, shahzoda, dunyoda otam saroyidan ko'ra go'zalroq narsa yo'q deb o'ylagandim, lekin bu zalning ko'rinishi yolg'iz adashganimni ko'rsatishga yetarli. Kechki ovqat tugagach, mamlakat odatiga ko'ra, kelin va kuyovni maqtovchi misralarni bir vaqtning o'zida kuylab ijro etuvchi Nautch qizlari jamoasi kirdi.

en: About midnight Aladdin’s mother conducted the bride to the nuptial apartment, where he soon followed her.
uz: Taxminan yarim tunda Aladdinning onasi kelinni to'y xonadoniga olib bordi, u yerda u tez orada unga ergashdi.

en: The next morning the attendants of Aladdin presented themselves to dress him, and brought him another habit, as rich and magnificent as that worn the day before.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Aladinning xizmatkorlari uni kiyintirish uchun paydo bo'lishdi va unga o'tgan kundagidek boy va ulug'vor yana bir odatni olib kelishdi.

en: He then ordered one of the
uz: Keyin u biridan buyurtma berdi:

en: horses to be got ready, mounted him, and went in the midst of a large troop of slaves to the sultan to entreat him to take a repast in the new palace, attended by his grand vizier and all the lords of his court.
uz: Otlar tayyor bo'lishi kerak edi, unga minib, katta qullar to'dasi o'rtasida sultonga yangi saroyda ziyofat qilishni iltimos qilish uchun bordilar, unda uning katta vaziri va uning saroyining barcha beklari ishtirok etishdi.

en: The sultan consented with pleasure, rose up immediately, and preceded by all the great lords of his court, accompanied Aladdin.
uz: Sulton mamnuniyat bilan rozi bo'ldi, darhol o'rnidan turdi va Aladdin bilan birga uning saroyidagi barcha buyuk xo'jayinlar oldidan bordi.

en: The nearer the sultan approached Aladdin’s palace, the more he was struck with its beauty; but when he entered it, came into the hall, and saw the windows, enriched with diamonds, rubies, emeralds, all large perfect stones, he was completely surprised, and said to his son-in-law, “This palace is one of the wonders of the world; for where besides shall we find walls built of massy gold and silver, and diamonds, rubies, and emeralds decorating the windows?
uz: Sulton Aladdin saroyiga qanchalik yaqinlashsa, uning go'zalligi uni shunchalik hayratga soldi; lekin u unga kirgach, zalga kirdi va derazalarni olmoslar, qirindilar, zumradlar, barcha katta mukammal toshlar bilan boyitilgan holda ko'rdi. U butunlay hayratda bo'ldi va kuyoviga dedi: Bu saroy dunyoning mo'jizalaridan biridir; bundan tashqari, oltin va kumushdan yasalgan devorlarni, shuningdek, derazalarni bezatgan olmoslar, qirindilar va zumradlarni qayerdan ham topamiz?

en: But it amazes me that a hall of this magnificence should be left with one of its windows incomplete and unfinished.” “Sire,” answered Aladdin, “the omission was by design, since I wished that you should have the glory of finishing this hall.” “I take your intention kindly,” said the sultan, “and will give orders about it immediately.” After the sultan had enjoyed the magnificent entertainment, provided for him and for his court by Aladdin, he was informed that the jewelers and goldsmiths had arrived; upon which he returned to the hall, and showed them the unfinished window.
uz: Lekin meni hayratga soladi, bu ulug'vorlik zalining bir derazalari to'liq bo'lmagan va tugallanmagan holda qolishi kerak. Janobi Oliylari,  javob berdi Aladdin, bu xato niyat bilan sodir bo'ldi, chunki men sizdan bu zalni tugatish sharafiga ega bo'lishni xohlardim. Sizdan iltimos qilaman,  dedi sultan, va bu haqda darhol buyruq beraman. Sulton Aladdin tomonidan o'zi va uning saroyi uchun taqdim etilgan ajoyib ko'ngilxushlikdan bahramand bo'lgandan so'ng, unga zargarlar va zargarlar kelganligi haqida xabar berildi; shundan so'ng u zalga qaytib, ularga tugallanmagan oynani ko'rsatdi.

en: “I sent for you,” said he, “to adorn this window in as great perfection as the rest.
uz: Men seni chaqirtirdim,  dedi u,  bu oynani qolganlari kabi mukammallik bilan bezash uchun.

en: Examine them well, and make all the dispatch you can.” The jewelers and goldsmiths examined the three-and-twenty windows with great attention, and after they had consulted together, to know what each could furnish, they returned, and presented themselves before the sultan, whose principal jeweler, undertaking to speak for the rest, said, “Sire, we are all willing to exert our utmost care and industry to obey you; but among us all we cannot furnish jewels enough for so great a work.” “I have more than are necessary,” said the sultan; “come to my palace, and you shall choose what may answer your purpose.”
uz: Ularni yaxshilab tekshiring va qo'lingizdan kelgancha jo'nating. Zargarlar va zargarlar uch yigirmata derazani katta e'tibor bilan tekshirdilar va ularning har biri nima ta'minlay olishini bilish uchun maslahatlashganlaridan so'ng, qaytib kelishdi va o'zlarini sulton huzuriga topshirishdi. Uning asosiy zargarasi qolganlar uchun gapirishga qaror qilib, dedi: Janob, biz hammamiz sizga itoat qilish uchun bor kuchimizni sarflashga tayyormiz; lekin biz hammamiz orasida bunday katta ish uchun yetarli zargarlik buyumlarini ta'minlay olmaymiz. Menda zaruratdan ko'proq narsa bor, dedi sulton; saroyimga keling, siz o'z maqsadingizga javob beradigan narsani tanlaysiz.

en: When the sultan returned to his palace, he ordered his jewels to be brought out, and the jewelers took a great quantity, particularly those Aladdin had made him a present of, which they soon used, without making any great advance in their work.
uz: Sulton o'z saroyiga qaytib kelganida, uning zargarlik buyumlarini olib chiqishni buyurdi va zargarlar juda ko'p miqdorda olib ketishdi, ayniqsa Aladdin unga sovg'a qilgan buyumlarni, ular tez orada o'z ishlarida katta yutuqlarga erishmasdan ishlatishdi.

en: They came again several times for more, and in a month’s time had not finished half their work.
uz: Ular yana bir necha marta ko'proq kelishdi va bir oy ichida ularning ishlarining yarmini tugatishmadi.

en: In short, they used all the jewels the sultan had, and borrowed of the vizier, yet the work was not half done.
uz: Xullas, ular sultonning bor va vazirdan qarz olgan barcha zargarlik buyumlaridan foydalandilar, ammo ish yarim tugallanmadi.

en: Aladdin, who knew that all the sultan’s endeavors to make this window like the rest were in vain, sent for the jewelers and goldsmiths, and not only commanded them to desist from their work, but ordered them to undo what they had begun, and to carry all their jewels back to the sultan and to the vizier.
uz: Aladdin, bu derazani qolganlar kabi yasash uchun sultonning barcha urinishlari behuda ekanligini bilgan holda, zargarlar va zargarlarni chaqirib yubordi va ularga nafaqat ishdan to'xtashni buyurdi, balki boshlaganlarini bekor qilishni va barcha javohirlarini sultonga va vazirga olib borishni buyurdi.

en: They undid in a few hours what they had been six weeks making, and retired, leaving Aladdin alone in the hall.
uz: Ular bir necha soat ichida olti hafta ishlab yurgan narsalarini yechdilar va Aladdinni zalda yolg'iz qoldirib, nafaqaga chiqishdi.

en: He took the lamp, rubbed it, and the genie appeared.
uz: U chiroqni oldi, uni ishqaladi va jin paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Genie,” said Aladdin, “I ordered thee to leave one of the four-and-twenty windows of this hall imperfect, and thou hast executed my commands punctually; now I would have thee make it like the rest.” The genie immediately disappeared.
uz: Jin, dedi Aladdin, Senga bu zalning yigirma to'rtta derazasidan birini mukammal bo'lmagan holda qoldirishni buyurdim, va sen mening buyruqlarimni o'z vaqtida bajarding; endi men seni ham qolganlarga o'xshab qilmoqchiman. Jinni darhol g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: Aladdin went out of the hall, and returning soon after, found the window like the others.
uz: Aladdin zaldan chiqib ketdi va tez orada qaytib kelib, boshqalarga o'xshab oynani topdi.

en: In the mean time, the jewelers and goldsmiths repaired to the palace, and were introduced into the sultan’s presence; where the chief jeweler presented the precious stones which he had brought back.
uz: Ayni paytda zargarlar va zargarlar saroyga qayta tiklandilar va sulton huzuriga olib kelindilar; u yerda bosh zargar o'zi olib kelgan qimmatbaho toshlarni taqdim etdi.

en: The sultan asked them if Aladdin had given them any reason for so commanding, and they answering that he had given them none, he ordered a horse to be brought, which he mounted, and rode to his son-in-law’s palace, with some few attendants on foot, to inquire why he had ordered the completion of the window to be stopped.
uz: Sulton ulardan Aladdin ularga bunday buyruq berish uchun biron bir sabab berganmi, deb so'radi. Ular javob berishdi: U ularga hech narsa bermagan, deb. U ot olib kelishni buyurdi, unga minib, bir necha piyoda xizmatchilar bilan kuyovining saroyiga bordi va nega u derazani to'xtatishni buyurganini so'radi.

en: Aladdin met him at the gate, and without giving any reply to his inquiries conducted him to the hall, where the sultan, to his great surprise, found the window exactly like the others.
uz: Aladdin uni darvozada kutib oldi va so'rovlariga hech qanday javob bermasdan uni zalga olib bordi, u yerda sultan hayratda qolganlar kabi oynani topdi.

en: He fancied at first that he was mistaken, and examined the two windows on each side, and afterward all the four-and-twenty; but when he was convinced that the window which several workmen had been so long about had now been finished in so short a time, he embraced
uz: U dastlab adashgan deb o'yladi va har bir tomondagi ikkita oynani, keyin esa barcha yigirma to'rtta oynani ko'zdan kechirdi; lekin bir necha ishchi shunchalik uzoq vaqt davomida aylanib yurgan deraza endi shunchalik qisqa vaqt ichida tugatilganligiga amin bo'lgach, u...

en: Aladdin and kissed him between his eyes.
uz: Aladdin uni ko'z o'rtasida o'pdi.

en: “My son,” said he, “what a man you are to do such surprising things always in the twinkling of an eye!
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi u,  sen qanday odamsan, doim ko'z ochib yumguncha bunchalik hayratlanarli ishlarni qilasan!

en: There is not your fellow in the world; the more I know you, the more I admire you.” Aladdin, while he paid all respect to the sultan, won by his affable behavior and liberality the affections of the people.
uz: Dunyoda senga o'xshagan hech kim yo'q; seni qanchalik ko'p bilsam, shunchalik ko'p qoyil qolaman. Aladdin, o'zining mehribonligi va erkinligi bilan xalqning mehrini qozonib, sultonga hurmat bajo keltirdi.

en: Several years passed thus in happiness, when the African magician, who had dismissed Aladdin from his mind, determined at last to inform himself with certainty whether the boy had perished in the subterranean cave or not.
uz: Shunday qilib, bir necha yil baxt bilan o'tdi, Aladdinni xayolidan chiqarib yuborgan afrikalik sehrgar nihoyat o'ziga bola yer osti g'orida halok bo'lganmi yoki yo'qmi, aniq ma'lumot berishga qaror qildi.

en: He resorted to a long course of magic ceremonies, and cast a horoscope by which to ascertain Aladdin’s fate.
uz: U uzoq vaqt davomida sehrli marosimlarga murojaat qildi va Aladdin taqdirini aniqlash uchun xoroskop otdi.

en: What was his surprise to find the appearances declare that Aladdin, instead of dying in the cave, had made his escape, and was living in royal splendor, by the aid of the genie of the wonderful lamp!
uz: Aladdin g'orda o'lish o'rniga qochib ketgani va ajoyib chiroqning jinnining yordami bilan qirollik hashamatida yashayotganini e'lon qilayotgan ko'rinishlarni topib qanday hayratga tushdi u!

en: On the very next day, the magician set out and traveled with the utmost haste to the capital of China, where, on his arrival, he took up his lodgings in a khan.
uz: Ertasi kuni sehrgar jo'nab ketdi va eng shoshilinch tarzda Xitoy poytaxtiga yo'l oldi, u yerga yetib borgach, u yerda xonda turar joy oldi.

en: He quickly learned about the wealth, charities, happiness, and splendid palace of Prince Aladdin.
uz: U tezda shahzoda Aladdinning boyligi, xayriyalari, baxtlari va ajoyib saroyi haqida bilib oldi.

en: Directly he saw the wonderful fabric, he knew that none but the genii, the slaves of the lamp, could have performed such wonders, and, In this order they proceeded to the palace
uz: U bevosita ajoyib matoni ko'rdi, u faqat daholar, chiroq qullaridan boshqa hech kim bunday mo'jizalar qila olmasligini bildi va, shu tartibda ular saroyga yo'l olishdi.

en: enraged at Aladdin’s good fortune, he returned to the khan.
uz: Aladdinning omadidan g'azablanib, u xonga qaytib keldi.

en: On his return he had recourse to an operation of geomancy to find out where the lamp was—whether Aladdin carried it about with him, or where he left it.
uz: Qaytib kelganida, u chiroq qayerda ekanligini aniqlash uchun geomantika operatsiyasiga murojaat qildi  Aladdin uni o'zi bilan olib yurganmi yoki qayerda qoldirganmi.

en: The result of his consultation informed him, to his great joy, that the lamp was in the palace.
uz: Uning maslahatlashuvi natijasi unga katta quvonchga to'lib, chiroq saroyda ekanligini ma'lum qildi.

en: “Well,” said he, rubbing
uz: Xo'sh,  dedi u, ishqalab.

en: his hands in glee, “I shall have the lamp, and I shall make Aladdin suffer for stealing it.” The next day the magician learnt, from the chief superintendent of the khan where he lodged, that Aladdin had gone on a hunting expedition, which was to last for eight days, of which only three had expired.
uz: Uning qo'llari quvonchda edi: Men chiroqni olaman va Aladdinni uni o'g'irlagani uchun azob chekishga majbur qilaman. Ertasi kuni sehrgar o'tirgan xonning bosh nazoratchisidan Aladdin sakkiz kun davom etadigan ov ekspeditsiyasiga borganini, shundan faqat uch kun o'tganini bilib qoldi.

en: The magician wanted to know no more.
uz: Sehrgar boshqa bilishni xohlamadi.

en: He resolved at once on his plans.
uz: U o'z rejalariga darhol qaror qildi.

en: He went to a coppersmith, and asked for a dozen copper lamps to be ready the next day, and desired the smith to take care that they should be handsome and well polished.
uz: U mischiga bordi va ertasi kuni o'nlab mis chiroqlar tayyor bo'lishini so'radi, shuningdek, ular chiroyli va yaxshi sayqallangan bo'lishiga g'amxo'rlik qilishni so'radi.

en: The next day the magician called for the twelve lamps, put them into a basket hanging on his arm, and went directly to Aladdin’s palace.
uz: Ertasi kuni sehrgar o'n ikki chiroqni chaqirib, ularni qo'liga osilib turgan savatga soldi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Aladdin saroyiga bordi.

en: As he approached, he began crying, “New lamps for old!” As he went along, a crowd of children collected, who hooted, and thought him, as did all who chanced to be passing by, a madman or a fool, to offer to change new lamps for old ones.
uz: U yaqinlashar ekan, u baqirib boshladi: Eski uchun yangi chiroqlar! U yo'lda ketar ekan, bir olomon bolalar yig'ilib, ularda g'uvillab yurishardi va uni o'ylab, xuddi oldindan o'tib ketayotganlarning hammasi kabi, telba yoki ahmoq bo'lib, eski chiroqlar uchun yangi chiroqlarni almashtirishni taklif qilishardi.

en: The African magician regarded not their scoffs, but still continued crying, “New lamps for old!” He repeated this so often, walking backward and forward in front of the palace, that the princess, who was then in the hall with the four-and-twenty windows, hearing a man cry something, and seeing a great mob crowding about him, sent one of her women slaves to know what he cried.
uz: Afrikalik sehrgar ularning masxaralariga e'tibor bermadi, lekin baribir yig'lab turardi: Eskiga yangi chiroqlar! U buni shunchalik tez-tez takrorlardi, saroy oldida oldinga va orqaga yurib, o'sha paytda yigirma to'rt derazali zalda bo'lgan malika, bir odamning nimadir deb baqirganini eshitib, va uning atrofida katta olomon to'planayotganini ko'rib, uning nima deb baqirganini bilish uchun ayol qullaridan birini yubordi.

en: The slave returned, laughing so heartily that the princess rebuked her.
uz: Qul qaytib keldi, shunchalik ko'ngildan kuldiki, malika uni tanbeh berdi.

en: “Madam,” answered the slave, still laughing, “who can forbear being amused to see an old man with a basket on his arm, full of fine new lamps, asking to change them for old ones?
uz: Xonim,  javob berdi qul, hali ham kuladi,  qo'lida savatli, yangi chiroqlar bilan to'la eski chiroqlarni almashtirishni so'rayotgan keksa odamni ko'rib xursand bo'lishdan kim ham to'xtay oladi?

en: The children and mob crowding about him, so that he can hardly stir, make all the noise they can in derision of him.” Another female slave hearing this, said, “Now you speak of lamps, I know not whether the princess may have observed it, but there is a shabby old one upon a shelf of the Prince Aladdin’s robing room.
uz: Bolalar va olomon uning atrofida shovqin solayotgan edi, shuning uchun u zo'rg'a harakatlana olardi, uni masxara qilish uchun qo'llaridan kelgancha shovqin chiqarardi. Boshqa bir qul ayol buni eshitib, dedi: Endi siz chiroqlar haqida gapiryapsiz, malika buni kuzatganmi yoki yo'qmi bilmayman, lekin shahzoda Aladdinning o'g'irlik xonasining javonida bir chiroyli keksa odam bor.

en: If the princess chooses, she may have the pleasure of trying if this old man is so silly as to give a new lamp for an old one, without taking anything for the exchange.”
uz: Agar malika tanlasa, agar bu keksa odam eski chiroq uchun yangi chiroq berishga shunchalik ahmoq bo'lsa, hech narsa almashinmasdan, sinab ko'rishdan zavqlanishi mumkin.

en: The princess, who knew not the magic value of this lamp, entered into the pleasantry, and commanded a slave to take it and make the exchange.
uz: Malika, bu chiroqning sehrli qiymatini bilmagan holda, mehmonxonaga kirdi va qulga uni olib, almashtirishni buyurdi.

en: The slave obeyed, went out of the hall, and no sooner got to the palace gates than she saw the African magician, called to him, and showing him the old lamp, said, “Give me a new lamp for this.” The magician knew at once that this was the lamp he “Give Me a New Lamp for This” wanted.
uz: Qul itoat qildi, zaldan chiqdi va saroy darvozalariga yaqinlashganda, u afrikalik sehrgarni ko'rdi, u unga chaqirib, eski chiroqni ko'rsatib, dedi: Menga buning uchun yangi chiroq ber. Sehrgar darhol bu chiroq ekanligini bildi, u Menga buning uchun yangi chiroq ber deb xohlardi.

en: There could be no other such in this palace, where every utensil was gold or silver.
uz: Bu saroyda bunday boshqa narsa bo'lishi mumkin emas edi, unda har bir idish oltin yoki kumush edi.

en: He snatched it eagerly out of the slave’s hand, and thrusting it as far as he could into his breast, offered her his basket, and bade her choose which she liked best.
uz: U uni qulning qo'lidan ishtiyoq bilan tortib oldi va ko'kragidan iloji boricha uzoqroqqa itarib, unga savatini taklif qildi va unga eng yoqqanini tanlashni buyurdi.

en: The slave picked out one and carried it to the princess; the change was no sooner made than the place rang with the shouts of the children, deriding the magician’s folly.
uz: Qul bittasini tanlab, uni malikaga olib bordi; o'zgarish bolalarning qichqiriqlari va sehrgarning ahmoqligini masxara qiladigan joydan tezroq sodir bo'ldi.

en: The African magician stayed no longer near the palace, nor cried any more, “New lamps for old,” but made the best of his way to his khan.
uz: Afrikalik sehrgar saroy yaqinida qolmadi, Eski uchun yangi chiroqlar deb ham qichqirmadi, balki xon tomon borishga harakat qildi.

en: As soon as he was out of sight of the two palaces, he hastened down the least-frequented streets; and having no more occasion for his lamps or basket, set all down in a spot where nobody saw him and pursuing his way at length reached a lonely spot, where he stopped till the night.
uz: U ikki saroydan ko'rinmay qolishi bilanoq, eng kam uchraydigan ko'chalarga shoshilib tushdi; va chiroqlari yoki savatlari uchun endi hech qanday imkoniyat bo'lmagani uchun, hech kim ko'rmaydigan joyga joylashdi va oxir-oqibat yolg'iz joyga yetib bordi, u yerda tungacha to'xtadi.

en: When it became quite dark, he pulled the lamp out of his breast and rubbed it.
uz: Qorong'u tushib qolgach, u chiroqni ko'kragidan chiqarib, ishqaladi.

en: At that summons the genie appeared, and said, “What wouldst thou have?
uz: Shundan so'ng jin paydo bo'ldi va dedi: Senga nima kerak edi?

en: I am ready to obey thee as thy slave, and the slave of all those who have that lamp in their hands; both I and the other slaves of the lamp.” “I command thee,” replied the magician, “to transport me immediately, and the palace which thou and the other slaves of the lamp have built in this city, with all the people in it, to Africa.” The genie made no reply, but with the assistance of the other genii, the slaves of the lamp, immediately transported the magician and the palace, entire, to a spot in Africa.
uz: Men senga quling sifatida va qo'lida o'sha chiroq bo'lganlarning hammasining quli sifatida itoat etishga tayyorman; men ham, chiroqning boshqa qullari ham. Men senga buyruq beraman,  javob berdi sehrgar,  meni darhol ko'chirishni va sen va chiroqning boshqa qullari bu shaharda, u yerdagi barcha odamlar bilan birga qurgan saroyni Afrikaga olib borishni. Jin javob bermadi, lekin boshqa jinlar yordamida, chiroq qullari, darhol sehrgar va saroyni butunlay, Afrikadagi bir joyga olib ketishdi.

en: Early the next morning, when the sultan, according to custom, went to contemplate and admire Aladdin’s palace, his amazement was unbounded to find that it could nowhere be seen.
uz: Ertasi kuni erta tongda, odatga ko'ra, sulton Aladdin saroyini o'ylab ko'rishga va unga qoyil qolishga borganda, uning hayrati hech qayerga ko'rinmasligini anglab yetmadi.

en: He could not understand how a palace which he had seen plainly every day for some years, could vanish so soon, and not leave the least trace behind.
uz: U bir necha yil davomida har kuni aniq ko'rgan saroy qanday qilib bunchalik tezda yo'q bo'lib ketishi va hech qanday iz qoldirmasligini tushunmas edi.

en: In his perplexity he ordered the grand vizier to be sent for with haste.
uz: O'zining chalkashligida u bosh vazirni shoshilinch ravishda chaqirib yuborishni buyurdi.

en: The grand vizier, who, in secret, bore no good will to Aladdin, intimated his suspicion that the palace was built by magic, and that Aladdin had made his hunting excursion an excuse for the removal of his palace with the same suddenness with which it had been erected.
uz: Ulug' vazir, Aladdinga yashirincha hech qanday yaxshi niyat qilmagan, uning saroy sehr bilan qurilganligi va Aladdin o'zining ov safarini saroy qurilgan bir xil tezda olib tashlash uchun bahona qilganligi haqidagi gumonini ko'rsatardi.

en: He induced the sultan to send a detachment of his guard, and to have Aladdin seized as a prisoner of state.
uz: U sultonni o'z qo'riqchilari otryadini yuborishga va Aladdinni davlat asirlari sifatida hibsga olishga undadi.

en: This being done and his son-in-law brought before him, the sultan would not hear a word from him, but ordered him to be put to death.
uz: Buni amalga oshirib, kuyovi uning oldiga olib kelinganidan so'ng, sulton undan birorta so'z eshitmadi, balki uni o'ldirishga buyurdi.

en: But the decree caused so much discontent among the people, whose affection Aladdin had secured by his largesses and charities, that the sultan, fearful of an insurrection, was obliged to grant him his life.
uz: Ammo farmon xalq orasida shunchalik norozilikka sabab bo'ldi, ularning mehrini Aladdin o'zining saxiyliklari va xayriyalari bilan ta'minlagan ediki, sultan isyondan qo'rqib, unga o'z hayotini berishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: When Aladdin found himself at liberty, he begged to be
uz: Aladdin o'zini ozodlikda topganida, iltimos qildi:

en: allowed to see the sultan and the interview being granted, he spoke in these words: “Sire, I pray you let me know the crime by which I have thus lost the favor of thy countenance.” “Your crime!” answered the sultan, “wretched man!
uz: Sultonni ko'rishga ruxsat berildi va intervyu berilgach, u quyidagi so'zlarni aytdi: Janobi Oliylari, iltimos, men sizning yuzingizdan qanday jinoyatga uchraganimni bildiring. Sizning jinoyatingiz! dedi sulton, bechora odam!

en: Follow me, and I will show you.” The sultan then took Aladdin into the apartment from whence he was wont to look at and admire the palace, and said, “You ought to know where your palace stood; look, and tell me what has become of it.” Aladdin did so, and being utterly amazed at the loss of his palace, was speechless.
uz: Menga ergashing, men senga ko'rsataman. Shunda sulton Aladdinni saroyga qarab, hayratlanishga odatlangan kvartiraga olib kirdi va dedi: Saroyingiz qayerda ekanligini bilishingiz kerak edi; qarang, va menga nima bo'lganini ayting. Aladdin shunday qildi va saroyining yo'qolganidan butunlay hayratda bo'lib, jim qoldi.

en: At last recovering himself, he said, “It is true, I do not see the palace.
uz: Nihoyat o'zini tiklab, u dedi: To'g'ri, men saroyni ko'rmayapman.

en: It is vanished; but I had no concern in its removal.
uz: U yo'q bo'lib ketdi; lekin uni olib tashlashda menga hech qanday tashvish yo'q edi.

en: I beg you to give me forty days, and if in that time I cannot restore it, I will offer my head to be disposed of at your pleasure.” To this the sultan consented.
uz: Sizdan iltimos qilaman, menga qirq kun bering, va agar o'sha vaqt ichida uni tiklay olmasam, boshimni sizning xohishingizga ko'ra yo'q qilish uchun taklif qilaman. Bunga sulton rozi bo'ldi.

en: Aladdin went out of the sultan’s palace in a condition of frantic despair.
uz: Aladdin sulton saroyidan umidsizlik holatida chiqib ketdi.

en: The lords who had courted him in the days of his splendor, now declined to have any communication with him.
uz: Uni ulug'vorlik davrida hurmat qilgan amirlar endi u bilan hech qanday aloqada bo'lishdan bosh tortishdi.

en: For three days he wandered about the city, exciting the wonder and compassion of the multitude by asking everybody he met if they had seen his palace, or could tell him anything of it.
uz: U uch kun davomida shahar bo'ylab kezib yurdi, olomonning hayratini va rahm-shafqatini uyg'otib, u uchratgan har bir kishidan uning saroyini ko'rganmi yoki unga bu haqda biror narsa ayta oladimi, deb so'radi.

en: On the third day he wandered into the country, and as he was approaching the river, he fell down the bank with so much violence that he rubbed the ring which the magician had given him by holding on the rock to save himself.
uz: Uchinchi kuni u qishloqqa sayohat qildi va daryoga yaqinlashar ekan, shunchalik zo'ravonlik bilan qirg'oqqa yiqildi, sehrgar unga toshga ushlab, o'zini qutqarish uchun bergan uzukni ishqaladi.

en: Immediately the same genie appeared whom he had seen in the cave where the magician had left him.
uz: Darhol sehrgar uni tashlab ketgan g'orda ko'rgan o'sha jin paydo bo'ldi.

en: “What wouldst thou have?” said the genie.
uz: Senga nima kerak edi? dedi jin.

en: “I am ready to obey thee as thy slave, and the slave of all those that have that ring on their finger; both I and the other slaves of the ring.” Aladdin, who had quite forgotten the ring and its magic power, agreeably surprised at an offer of help so little expected, replied, “Genie, show me where the palace I caused to be built now stands, or transport it back where it first stood.” “Your command,” answered the genie, “is not in my power; I am only the slave of the ring, and not of the lamp.” “I command thee, then,” replied Aladdin, “by the power of the ring, to transport me to the spot where my palace stands, in what part of the world soever it may be.” These words
uz: Men senga qul bo'lishga tayyorman, va barmog'ida o'sha uzuk borlarning qulidirman; ham men, ham uzukning boshqa qullari. Uzuk va uning sehrli kuchini butunlay unutgan Aladdin, yordam taklifidan juda kam kutilgan holda, rozi bo'ldi va javob berdi: Jinni, men qurishga buyurgan saroy hozir qayerda turishini ko'rsat, yoki uni avval turgan joyiga qaytarib olib qayt. Sizning buyrug'ingiz, Jinni javob berdi,  mening qo'limda emas; men faqat uzukning qulidirman, chiroqning emas. Men sizga buyruq beraman, Aladdin javob berdi,  meni saroyim turgan joyga, dunyoning qayerda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa, olib boring.

en: were no sooner out of his mouth, than the genie transported him into Africa, to the midst of a large plain, where his palace stood, at no great distance from a city, and placing him exactly under the window of the princess’s apartment, left him.
uz: Tezroq uning og'zidan chiqmadi, jin uni Afrikaga, katta tekislik o'rtasiga olib bordi, u yerda uning saroyi shahardan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan joyda turardi va uni aynan malika xonadonining oynasi ostiga qo'yib, tashlab ketdi.

en: But at this instant the sun rose, upon which the sultaness stopped her story.
uz: Ammo shu zahoti quyosh chiqdi, shunda sulton ayol o'z hikoyasini to'xtatdi.

en: The sultan got up immediately, but before leaving the apartment he said to his consort: “Let me hear the rest of this strange adventure of Aladdin and the Lamp to-morrow night.” Accordingly, long before the dawn, Scheherazade began again: Aladdin had stood there but a moment when one of the attendants of the Princess Buddir al Buddoor, looking through the window, perceived him and instantly told her mistress.
uz: Sulton darhol o'rnidan turdi, lekin kvartirani tark etishdan oldin u turmush o'rtog'iga dedi: Aladdin va Chiroqning bu g'alati sarguzashtining qolgan qismini ertaga kechasi eshitay. Shunga ko'ra, tong otishidan ancha oldin, Shhezerad yana boshlandi: Aladdin o'sha yerda bir lahzaga turdi, shunda malika Buddir al Buddurning xizmatchilaridan biri deraza orqali qarab, uni sezdi va darhol xotiniga aytdi.

en: The princess, who could not believe the joyful tidings, hastened to the window, and seeing Aladdin, immediately opened it.
uz: Shahzoda xursandchilik xabarlariga ishonmay, derazasiga shoshildi va Aladinni ko'rib, darhol uni ochdi.

en: The noise of opening the window made Aladdin look up, and seeing the princess, he saluted her with an air that expressed his joy.
uz: Derazaning ochilish shovqini Aladdinni yuqoriga ko'tardi va malikaga ko'ra, u unga quvonchini ifodalovchi havo bilan salom berdi.

en: “To lose no time,” said she to him, “I have sent to have the private door opened for you; enter and come up.” The private door, which was just under the princess’s apartment, was soon opened, and Aladdin conducted up into the chamber.
uz: Vaqtni yoqotmaslik uchun,  dedi u unga,  Men senga shaxsiy eshikni ochishga yubordim; kir va yuqoriga chiq. Shahzoda xonadonining ostida joylashgan shaxsiy eshik tez orada ochildi va Aladdin uni xonaga olib kirdi.

en: It is impossible to express the joy of both at seeing each other, after so cruel a separation.
uz: Ikkalasi ham bir-birini shunday shafqatsiz ajralishdan so'ng ko'rishganidan xursand ekanligini ifodalab bo'lmaydi.

en: After embracing and shedding tears of joy, they sat down, and Aladdin said, “I beg of you, beloved, tell me what is become of an old lamp which stood upon a shelf in my robing- chamber.” “Alas!” answered the princess, “I was afraid our misfortune might be owing to that lamp; and what grieves me most is, that I have been the cause of it.
uz: Quchoqlanib, quvonchdan ko'z yoshlarini to'kkanlaridan so'ng, ular o'tirdilar va Aladdin dedi: Iltimos qilaman, azizim, mening o'g'irlik xonamdagi javonda turgan eski chiroqga nima bo'lganini ayting. Alas! dedi malika, Men o'sha chiroq tufayli baxtsizligimiz bo'lishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardim; va meni eng ko'p xafa qiladigan narsa, bunga men sabab bo'lganman.

en: I was foolish enough to change the old lamp for a new one, and the next morning I found myself in this unknown country, which I am told is Africa.”
uz: Men eski chiroqni yangisiga almashtirishga ahmoqlik qildim va ertasi kuni ertalab o'zimni bu noma'lum mamlakatda topdim, menga Afrika deb aytildi.

en: “Princess,” said Aladdin, interrupting her, “you have explained all by telling me we are in Africa.
uz: Malika,  dedi Aladdin unga aralashib,  siz menga Afrikada ekanligimizni aytib, hammasini tushuntirdingiz.

en: I desire you only to tell me if you know where the old lamp now is.” “The magician carries it carefully wrapt up in his bosom,” said the princess; “and this I can assure you, because he pulled it out before me, and showed it to me in triumph.” “Princess,” said Aladdin, “I think I have found the means to deliver you and to regain possession of the lamp, on which all my prosperity depends; to execute this design, it is necessary for me to go to the town.
uz: Sizdan faqatgina eski chiroq hozir qayerda ekanligini bilsangiz, aytishingizni so'rayman. Jodugar uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'kragiga o'rab olib yuradi,  dedi malika; va men sizga shuni ishontira olaman, chunki u uni oldimdan tortib oldi va menga g'alaba bilan ko'rsatdi. Malika,  dedi Aladdin, Men sizni qutqarish va butun farovonligim bog'liq bo'lgan chiroqga egalik qilish uchun vosita topdim, bu loyihani amalga oshirish uchun men shaharga borishim kerak.

en: I shall return by noon, and will then tell you what must be done by you to help insure success.
uz: Men tush paytida qaytib kelaman va keyin muvaffaqiyatni ta'minlashga yordam berish uchun nima qilish kerakligini aytaman.

en: In the mean time, I shall disguise myself, and I beg that the private door may be opened at the first knock.” When Aladdin was out of the palace, he looked round and perceiving a peasant going into the country, hastened after him; and when he had overtaken him, made a proposal to him to change clothes, to which the man agreed.
uz: Shu bilan birga, men o'zimni niqoblayman va iltimos qilamanki, shaxsiy eshik birinchi taqillatishda ochilsin. Aladdin saroydan chiqqanida, atrofga qaradi va qishloqga kirayotgan bir dehqonni ko'rib, uning orqasidan shoshiladi; va u undan o'tib ketganidan so'ng, unga kiyim almashtirish taklifini berdi, bu odam rozi bo'ldi.

en: When they had made the exchange, the countryman went about his business, and Aladdin entered the neighboring city.
uz: Ular almashinuvni amalga oshirgandan so'ng, qishloq odami o'z ishi bilan shug'ullanib ketdi va Aladdin qo'shni shaharga kirdi.

en: After traversing several streets, he came to that part of the town where the merchants and artisans had their particular streets according to their trades.
uz: Bir nechta ko'chalarni kesib o'tgandan so'ng, u shaharning o'sha qismiga keldi, u yerda savdogarlar va hunarmandlar o'z kasblariga ko'ra o'z ko'chalariga ega edilar.

en: He went into that of the druggists; and entering one of the largest and best furnished shops, asked the druggist for a certain powder.
uz: U giyohvandlar do'koniga kirdi; va eng katta va eng yaxshi jihozlangan do'konlardan biriga kirib, giyohvanddan ma'lum bir kukun so'radi.

en: The druggist, judging Aladdin by his habit to be very poor, told him he had it, but that it was dear; upon which Aladdin pulled out his purse, and showing him some gold, asked for half a dram of the powder; which the druggist weighed and gave him, telling him the price was a piece of gold.
uz: Aladdinni odatidan juda kambag'al deb hisoblagan dorixonachi unga borligini, lekin qimmat ekanligini aytdi. Shunda Aladdin hamyonini chiqarib, unga oltin ko'rsatib, yarim dram kukun so'radi; dorixonachi uni tortdi va unga berdi, narxi bir bo'lak oltin ekanligini aytdi.

en: Aladdin put the money into his hand, and hastened to the palace, which he entered at once by the private door.
uz: Aladdin pulni qo'liga soldi va saroyga shoshilib kirdi, u darhol shaxsiy eshikdan kirdi.

en: When he came into the princess’s apartment, he said to her, “Princess, you must take your part in the scheme which I propose for our deliverance.
uz: U malika xonadoniga kirgach, unga dedi: Malika, siz bizning qutqarilishimiz uchun taklif qilayotgan sxemada ishtirok etishingiz kerak.

en: You must overcome your aversion to the magician, and assume a friendly manner toward him, and ask him to oblige you by partaking of a supper in your apartments.
uz: Sehrgarga bo'lgan nafratingizni yengib o'tishingiz, unga nisbatan do'stona munosabatda bo'lishingiz va undan xonadoningizda kechki ovqatdan bahramand bo'lishni so'rashingiz kerak.

en: leaves, ask him to exchange cups with you, which he, gratified at the honor, will gladly do, when you must give him the cup containing this powder.
uz: Qolib ketadi, undan siz bilan piyola almashishni so'rang, u bu sharafdan mamnun bo'lib, unga shu kukunni o'z ichiga olgan piyola berishga majbur bo'lganda, xursandchilik bilan qiladi.

en: On drinking it he will instantly fall asleep, and we will obtain the lamp, whose slaves will do all our bidding, and restore us and the palace to the capital of China.” The princess obeyed her husband’s instructions.
uz: Uni ichgach, u bir zumda uxlab qoladi va biz chiroqni olamiz, uning qullari barcha buyruqlarimizni bajaradi va bizni va saroyni Xitoy poytaxtiga qaytaradi. Malika erining ko'rsatmalariga itoat qildi.

en: She assumed a look of pleasure on the next visit of the magician, and asked him to sup with her which he did most willingly.
uz: U sehrgarning keyingi tashrifida zavq bilan ko'rindi va undan u bilan kechki ovqat qilishni so'radi, bu esa u eng ko'p xohish bilan qildi.

en: At the close of the evening, during which the princess had tried all she could to please him, she asked him to exchange cups with her, and giving the signal, had the drugged cup brought to her, which she gave to the magician.
uz: Kechning oxirida, malika uni xursand qilishga bor kuchini sarflagan paytda, undan o'zi bilan piyola almashishni so'radi va signal berib, unga giyohvandlik bilan to'ldirilgan piyola olib kelindi, uni sehrgarga berdi.

en: He drank it out of compliment to the princess to the very last drop, when with a cry, he fell backward lifeless on the sofa.
uz: U buni malikaga oxirgi tomchigacha maqtov sifatida ichdi, keyin u qichqiriq bilan divanda jonsiz holda orqaga yiqildi.

en: The princess had so placed her women from the entrance of the great hall to the foot of the staircase, that the word was no sooner given that the African magician was fallen backward, than the door was opened, and Aladdin admitted to the hall.
uz: Malika o'z ayollarini katta zalning kirish qismidan zinapoya etagiga shunday joylashtirdiki, afrikalik sehrgar orqaga yiqilganidan ko'ra, eshik ochildi va Aladdin zalga kirdi.

en: The princess rose from her seat, and ran, overjoyed, to embrace him; but he stopped her, and said, “Princess, retire to your apartment; and let me be left alone, while I endeavor to transport you back to China as speedily as you were brought here.” When the princess, her women, and slaves were gone out of the hall, Aladdin shut the door, and going directly to the dead body of the magician, opened his vest, took out the lamp which was carefully wrapped up, and rubbing it, the genie immediately appeared.
uz: Malika o'rindig'idan turdi va yugurib, uni quchoqlash uchun juda xursand bo'ldi; lekin u uni to'xtatdi va dedi: Malika, xonangizga qaytib keling; meni yolg'iz qoldiring, seni bu yerga olib kelinganingizdek tezroq Xitoyga olib ketishga harakat qilyapman. Malika, uning ayollari va qullari zaldan chiqib ketgach, Aladdin eshikni yopdi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sehrgarning o'limiga bordi, ko'ylagini ochdi, ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'ralgan chiroqni olib chiqdi va uni ishqalab, jin darhol paydo bo'ldi.

en: “Genie,” said Aladdin, “I command Alladin saluted her with joy
uz: Jin, dedi Aladdin, Men Alladinning unga quvonch bilan salom berishini buyuraman.

en: thee to transport this palace instantly to the place from whence it was brought.” The genie bowed his head in token of obedience, and disappeared.
uz: Seni bu saroyni darhol olib kelgan joyiga olib borish uchun. Jin itoatkorlik belgisi sifatida boshini egdi va g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: Immediately the palace was transported into China, and its removal was only felt by two little shocks, the one when it was lifted up, the other when it was set down, and both in a very short interval of time.
uz: Darhol saroy Xitoyga ko'chirildi va uning olib ketilishi faqat ikkita kichik zarba bilan sezilib turdi, biri ko'tarilganda, ikkinchisi esa pastga tushirilganda va ikkalasi ham juda qisqa vaqt ichida.

en: On the morning after the restoration of Aladdin’s palace, the sultan was looking out of his window, and mourning over the fate of his daughter, when he thought that he saw the vacancy created by the disappearance of the palace to be again filled up.
uz: Aladdin saroyi restavratsiyadan keyingi ertalab, sulton derazasidan qarayotgan edi va qizining taqdiriga motam chekayotgan edi, u saroyning yo'qolishi natijasida yaratilgan bo'shliqni yana to'ldirilishini ko'rganini o'yladi.

en: Rubbing his eyes he looked again and was convinced beyond the power of doubt that it was his son-in-law’s palace.
uz: Ko'zlarini ishqalab, u yana qaradi va shubhasiz, bu uning kuyovining saroyi ekanligiga amin bo'ldi.

en: Joy and gladness succeeded to sorrow and grief.
uz: Quvonch va shodlik qayg'u va qayg'uga o'tdi.

en: He at once ordered a horse to be saddled, which he mounted that instant, and with a half dozen attendants rode over to the palace.
uz: U darhol otga egar berishni buyurdi, unga o'sha zahoti o'tirdi va yarim o'n xizmatkor bilan saroyga yo'l oldi.

en: Aladdin rose that morning by daybreak, put on one of the most magnificent habits his wardrobe afforded, and went up into the hall of twenty-four windows, where he waited till he saw the sultan approaching, receiving him at the entrance to the court, and helping him to dismount.
uz: Aladdin o'sha kuni ertalab tong otishi bilan uyg'onib, shkafining eng ajoyib odatlaridan birini kiydi va yigirma to'rt derazali zalga chiqdi. U yerda sultanning yaqinlashayotganini ko'rib, uni saroy eshigida kutib oldi va unga tushishga yordam berdi.

en: He led the sultan into the princess’s apartment.
uz: U sultonni malika xonadoniga olib kirdi.

en: The happy father embraced her with tears of joy.
uz: Baxtli ota uni quvonch ko'z yoshlari bilan quchoqladi.

en: After a short interval, devoted to mutual explanations of all that had happened, the sultan restored Aladdin to his favor, and expressed his regret for the harshness with which he had treated him.
uz: Qisqa tanaffusdan so'ng, sodir bo'lgan barcha voqealarni o'zaro tushuntirishga bag'ishlangan holda, sulton Aladdinni o'z foydasiga qaytardi va unga nisbatan shafqatsiz munosabatda bo'lganidan afsusda ekanligini bildirdi.

en: “My son,” said he, “be not displeased at my proceedings against you; they arose from my paternal love, and therefore you ought to forgive the excesses to which it hurried me.” “Sire,” replied Aladdin, “I have not the least reason to complain of your conduct, since you did nothing but what your duty required.
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi u,  senga qarshi ko'tarilgan ishlarimdan norozi bo'lma; ular otamning muhabbatidan kelib chiqqan, shuning uchun meni shoshgan haddan tashqari ishlarni kechirishing kerak. O'g'lim,  javob berdi Aladdin,  Sizning xulq-atvoringizdan shikoyat qilishga hech qanday sababim yo'q, chunki siz faqat o'z burchingiz talab qilgan narsani qildingiz.

en: This infamous magician, the basest of men, was the sole cause of my misfortune.” Thus was Aladdin delivered from the persecution of the wicked magician.
uz: Bu mash'um sehrgar, eng past odam, mening baxtsizlikimga yagona sabab edi. Shunday qilib, Aladdin yovuz sehrgar ta'qibidan qutqarildi.

en: When a few years afterward, the sultan died in a good old age, the Princess Buddir al Buddoor succeeded him, and she and Aladdin reigned together many years, and left a numerous and illustrious posterity.
uz: Bir necha yil o'tgach, sulton yaxshi keksalikda vafot etganida, malika Buddir al Buddoor uning o'rniga keldi va u Aladdin bilan birga ko'p yillar hukmronlik qildi va ko'plab va shonli avlod qoldirdi.

en: Day not yet having come, Dinarzade begged for another story, and
uz: Kun hali kelmaganidan so'ng, Dinarzade yana bir hikoya so'radi va

en: the Sultan signifying his consent, Scheherazade, after a short space for thought, began as follows:
uz: Sulton o'z roziligini bildirar ekan, Sheherazade, qisqa fikrlashdan so'ng, quyidagicha boshlandi:

en: The Caliph Haroun Al Raschid The Adventures of the Caliph Haroun al Raschid The Caliph Haroun al Raschid was accustomed to visit the city of Bagdad in disguise, that he might see into the condition of the people, and hear their reports of his court and government.
uz: Xalifa Horun Al Rasxid Xalifa Horun al Rasxidning sarguzashtlari Xalifa Horun al Rasxid Bag'dod shahriga niqobda tashrif buyurishga odatlangan edi, shunda u odamlarning ahvolini ko'rishi va o'z saroyi va hukumati haqidagi hisobotlarini eshitishi mumkin edi.

en: On one such occasion, he and his grand vizier Giafar disguised themselves as foreign merchants, and went their way through the different parts of the city.
uz: Shunday bir holatda u va uning oliy vaziri Giafar o'zlarini chet el savdogarlari sifatida ko'rsatishdi va shaharning turli qismlaridan o'tib ketishdi.

en: As they entered on a bridge which connected together the two parts of the city of Bagdad, divided by the river Euphrates, they met an old blind man, who asked alms.
uz: Ular Bag'dod shahrining ikki qismini birlashtiruvchi, Furot daryosi bilan bo'lingan ko'prikka kirayotganlarida, sadaqa so'rayotgan keksa ko'r odamga duch kelishdi.

en: The caliph put a piece of gold into his hand, on which the blind man caught hold of his
uz: Xalifa qo'liga bir dona oltin soldi, unga ko'r odam uni ushladi.

en: hand, and stopped him, saying, “Sir, pray forgive me; I desire you would either give me a box on the ear, or take your alms back again, for I cannot receive it but on that condition, without breaking a solemn oath which I have sworn to God; The Caliph Put a Piece of Gold into His Hand and if you knew the reason, you would agree with me that the punishment is very slight.” The caliph, unwilling to be detained any longer, yielded to the importunity of the blind man, and gave him a very slight blow; whereupon the beggar thanked and blessed him.
uz: qo'lini olib, uni to'xtatib, dedi: Janob, iltimos, meni kechirasiz; sizdan yoki qulog'imga quti berishni xohlayman, yoki sadaqangizni yana qaytarib olishingizni so'rayman, chunki men uni faqat shu shartda qabul qila olmayman, lekin Xudoga qasam ichganimni buzmasdan; Xalifa Qo'liga bir bo'lak oltin qo'ydi va agar siz sababni bilsangiz, jazo juda yengil ekanligiga men bilan rozi bo'lardingiz. Xalifa uzoqroq ushlab turilishni istamadi, ko'r odamning befarqligiga ko'nadi va unga juda yengil zarba berdi; shundan so'ng tilanchi unga rahmat aytdi va duo qildi.

en: The next day, the caliph called the grand vizier.
uz: Ertasi kuni xalifa bosh vazirni chaqirib oldi.

en: “I must see that unfortunate beggar,” said he.
uz: Men o'sha bechora tilanchiga ko'rishim kerak, dedi u.

en: “Go and tell him to come to my palace.” When afternoon prayers were over the blind man accordingly prostrated himself before the throne, and when he rose up, the caliph asked him his name.
uz: Bor va unga saroyimga kelishini ayt. Kunduzgi ibodatlar tugagach, ko'r odam taxt oldiga sajda qildi va u o'rnidan turgach, xalifa undan uning ismini so'radi.

en: He answered that it was Baba Abdalla.
uz: U javob berdi: Bu Baba Abdalla edi.

en: “Baba Abdalla,” explained the caliph, “I ordered you to come hither, to know from yourself why you made the indiscreet oath of which you told me.
uz: Baba Abdalla,  tushuntirdi xalifa,  senga bu yerga kelishni buyurdim, menga aytgan beparvo qasamingni nega qilganingni o'zingdan bilishga.

en: Tell me freely, for I will know the truth.” Baba Abdalla cast himself a second time at the foot of the caliph’s throne, with his face to the ground, and when he rose up said, “Commander of the Faithful, I must humbly ask your pardon for my presumption in requiring you to box my ear.
uz: Menga bemalol ayting, chunki men haqiqatni bilaman. Baba Abdalla xalifaning taxtining etagiga ikkinchi marta, yuzini yerga tashladi va u o'rnidan turgach dedi: Ey Mo'minlar qo'mondoni, men sizdan qulog'imni qisib qo'yishni talab qilgan kamtarligim uchun sizdan kamtarlik bilan kechirim so'ramoqchiman.

en: As to the extravagance of my action, I own that it must seem strange; it is however a slight penance for an enormous crime of which I have been guilty, and for which, if all the people in the world were each to give me a box on the ear, it would not be a sufficient atonement.” The Story of Baba Abdalla Commander of the Faithful, continued Baba Abdalla, I was born at Bagdad.
uz: Mening harakatimning dabdabaliligi haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, bu g'alati tuyulishi kerak; lekin bu men aybdor bo'lgan ulkan jinoyat uchun ozgina tavba, va agar dunyodagi barcha odamlar har biri menga qulog'imga quti bersa, bu yetarli kechiruv bo'lmas edi. Mo'minlar qo'mondoni Baba Abdalla hikoyasi, deb davom etdi Baba Abdalla, men Bagdadda tug'ilganman.

en: My father and mother died while I was yet a youth, and I inherited from them an ample estate.
uz: Mening otam va onam hali yoshligimda vafot etdilar va men ulardan katta mulkka meros qoldirdim.

en: Although young, I neglected no opportunity to increase it by my industry.
uz: Yosh bo'lsam ham, uni o'z sanoatim orqali oshirish imkoniyatini e'tibordan chetda qoldirmadim.

en: I soon became rich enough to purchase fourscore camels, which I let out to merchants, who hired them, at a considerable profit to me, to carry their merchandise from one country to another.
uz: Tez orada to'rtburchak tuyalar sotib olishga yetarlicha boy bo'ldim, ularni savdogarlarga sotdim, ular ularni bir mamlakatdan ikkinchi davlatga tovarlarini olib borish uchun menga ancha foyda keltirishdi.

en: As I was returning one day with my unloaded camels from Bussorah, whither I had carried some bales that were to be embarked for the Indies, I met a dervish, who was walking to Bussorah.
uz: Bir kuni tushirilgan tuyalarim bilan Bussoradan qaytayotganimda, u yerga Hindiston orollariga jo'natilishi kerak bo'lgan ba'zi ballarni olib ketayotgan edim, Bussoraga ketayotgan bir dervishni uchratdim.

en: I asked him whence he came and where he was going; he put the same questions to me; and when we had satisfied each other’s curiosity, we produced our provisions and ate together.
uz: Men undan qayerdan kelganini va qayerga ketayotganini so'radim; u menga ham xuddi shu savollarni berdi; va biz bir-birimizning qiziqishimizni qondirgandan so'ng, oziq-ovqatimizni ishlab chiqardik va birga ovqatlandik.

en: During our repast, the dervish told me of a spot not far from where we sat, in which such immense riches were collected that if all my fourscore camels were loaded with the gold and jewels that might be taken from it, they would not be missed.
uz: Ovqatlanish paytimizda dervish bizga biz o'tirgan joydan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan joy haqida aytib berdi, u yerda shunchalik ulkan boyliklar yig'ilganki, agar mening to'rtburchak tuyalarim undan olinishi mumkin bo'lgan oltin va javohirlar bilan yuklangan bo'lsa, ular o'tkazib yuborilmas edi.

en: I was overjoyed at this intelligence.
uz: Men bu razvedkadan juda xursand bo'ldim.

en: “You say,” continued the dervish, “that you have fourscore camels.
uz: Siz aytyapsiz,  davom etdi dervish,  sizda tortburchak tuyalar bor.

en: I am ready to conduct you to the place where the treasure lies, and we will load them with as much jewels and gold as they can carry, on condition that when they are so loaded, you will let me have one- half, and you be contented with the other; after which we will separate, and take our camels where we may think fit.
uz: Sizni xazina yotgan joyga olib borishga tayyorman va biz ularni ko'tarishga qodir bo'lgancha ko'p javohirlar va oltin bilan yuklaymiz, sharti shuki, ular yuklanganida menga yarmini bering va ikkinchisidan qoniqasiz; shundan so'ng ajralib ketamiz va tuyalarimizni qayerga mos kelishini o'ylagan bo'lsak, o'sha yerga olib ketamiz.

en: There is nothing but what is strictly equitable in this division; for if you give me forty camels, you will procure by my means wherewithal to purchase thousands.” I assented to his proposal, at once collected all my camels, and set out with the dervish.
uz: Bu bo'limda qat'iy adolatdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q; chunki agar menga qirqta tuyani bersang, minglab sotib olish uchun o'z mablag'im bilan ta'minlaysan. Men uning taklifiga rozi bo'ldim, darhol barcha tuyalarimni yig'ib, darvesh bilan yo'lga chiqdim.

en: After we had traveled some time, we came to a pass, so narrow that two camels could not go abreast.
uz: Bir muncha vaqt sayohat qilganimizdan so'ng, ikki tuya birga ketolmaydigan darajada tor bo'lgan bir dovonga keldik.

en: The two mountains which bounded this valley were so high and steep that there was no fear of our being seen by anybody.
uz: Bu vodiyni o'rab turgan ikki tog' shunchalik baland va tik ediki, bizni hech kim ko'rmaslikdan qo'rqmasdi.

en: When we came into the valley between these two mountains, the dervish bade me stop the camels.
uz: Ikki tog' orasiga vodiyga kirganimizda, dervish menga tuyalarni to'xtatishni buyurdi.

en: He proceeded to gather some sticks and light a fire: he then cast some incense into it, pronouncing certain words which I did not understand and presently a thick cloud arose.
uz: U bir oz tayoq yig'ib, olov yoqdi: keyin unga tutatqi tashladi, men tushunmagan ba'zi so'zlarni aytdi va hozirda qalin bulut paydo bo'ldi.

en: This soon dispersed, when the rock worming the side of the valley opened, and exposed to view a magnificent palace in the hollow of the mountain.
uz: Bu tez orada tarqalib ketdi, vodiy yonidagi qoya ochilib, tog'ning chuquridagi ajoyib saroyni ko'rish uchun ochiq bo'ldi.

en: So eager was I for the treasures which displayed themselves to my view, that, like an eagle seizing her prey, I fell upon the first heap of golden coin that was near me.
uz: Men ko'zimga ko'rinadigan xazinalarga shunchalik ishtiyoq bilan qarardimki, xuddi burgut o'z o'ljasini ushlagandek, yonimda joylashgan birinchi oltin tanga uyumga yiqildim.

en: My sacks were all large, and I would have filled them all, but I was obliged to proportion my burden to the strength of my camels.
uz: Xaltalarimning hammasi katta edi va men ularning hammasini to'ldirgan bo'lardim, lekin men o'z yukimni tuyalarimning kuchiga moslashtirishga majbur edim.

en: The dervish paid more attention to the jewels than the gold, and I soon followed his example, so that we took away more jewels than gold.
uz: Darvesh zargarlik buyumlariga oltindan ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor qaratdi va men tez orada uning namunasiga ergashdim, shuning uchun biz oltindan ko'ra ko'proq zargarlik buyumlarini olib ketdik.

en: After we had filled our sacks, and loaded our camels, the dervish used the same incantations to shut the treasury as he had done to open it, when the doors closed, and the rock seemed as solid and entire as it was before.
uz: Xaltalarimizni to'ldirganimizdan va tuyalarimizni yuklaganimizdan so'ng, dervish xazinani ochish uchun qilganidek, xuddi shunday sehrlar bilan yopdi, eshiklar yopilganda, tosh avvalgidek mustahkam va butun ko'rindi.

en: I observed, however, that the dervish, before he went away, took a small bottle out of the cave and put it into his breast, first showing me that it contained only a glutinous sort of ointment.
uz: Lekin men dervish ketishidan oldin g'ordan kichik bir butilkani olib, ko'kragiga solganini payqadim va avval uning ichida faqat bir xil yirtqich moy borligini ko'rsatdi.

en: We now divided our camels.
uz: Endi biz tuyalarimizni bo'ldik.

en: I put myself at the head of the forty which I had reserved for myself, and the dervish placed himself at the head of those which I had given him.
uz: Men o'zim uchun saqlab qo'ygan qirq kishining boshida o'zimni qo'ydim, dervish esa unga berganlarimning boshida o'zini qo'ydi.

en: We came out of the valley by the way we had entered, and traveled together till we came to the great road, where we were to part; the dervish to go to Bussorah, and I to Bagdad.
uz: Biz vodiydan kirgan yo'limizdan chiqdik va birga sayohat qildik, toki katta yo'lga yetib keldik, u yerda ajralib ketishimiz kerak edi; dervish Bussoraga, men esa Bagdadda boradigan edi.

en: To thank him for so great a kindness, I made use of the most expressive terms, testifying my gratitude for the preference he had given me before all other men in letting me have a share of such riches.
uz: Unga shunchalik buyuk mehribonligi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirish uchun men eng ifodalovchi so'zlardan foydalandim, u menga bunday boyliklarning ulushiga ega bo'lishga ruxsat bergan barcha odamlardan ko'ra menga bergan afzalligi uchun minnatdorchiligimni ko'rsatib.

en: We embraced each other with joy and taking our leave pursued our different routes.
uz: Biz bir-birimizni quvonch bilan quchoqladik va xayrlashuvimizdan so'ng turli yo'nalishlarga yo'l oldik.

en: I had not gone far, following my camels, which paced quietly on in the track I had put them into, before the demon of ingratitude and envy took possession of my heart, and I deplored not only the loss of my other forty, but the riches wherewith they were loaded.
uz: Men uzoqga bormagan edim, ularni joylashtirgan yo'lda sokin yurgan tuyalarimga ergashib, minnatdorchilik va hasad shaytonining yuragimni egallab olgunga qadar, va men nafaqat boshqa qirq farzandimning yo'qolganidan, balki ularning yuklangan boyligidan ham afsuslandim.

en: “The dervish,” said I to myself, “has no occasion for all this wealth, since he is master of the treasure, and may have as much as he pleases;” so I determined immediately to take the camels with their loading from him.
uz: Darvesh,  dedim men ozimga ozim,  bu boylikka hech qanday hojati yoq, chunki u xazinaning egasi va xohlagancha ega bolishi mumkin; shuning uchun men darhol tuyalarni yuklari bilan undan olishga qaror qildim.

en: To execute this design I ran after the dervish, calling to him to stop, which he accordingly did.
uz: Ushbu loyihani amalga oshirish uchun men dervishning orqasidan yugurdim, uni to'xtashga chaqirdim, u esa shunga mos ravishda shunday qildi.

en: When I came up to him, I said, “Brother, I had no sooner parted from you, but a thought came into my head, which neither of us had reflected on before.
uz: Uning oldiga kelganimda, aytdim: Ey birodar, men sizdan oldinroq ajralmagan edim, lekin miyamga bir fikr keldi, bu haqda hech birimiz ilgari o'ylamagan edik.

en: You are a recluse dervish, used to live in tranquillity, disengaged from all the cares of the world, and intent only upon serving God.
uz: Siz xotirjamlikda yashashga odatlangan, dunyoning barcha tashvishlaridan xoli va faqat Xudoga xizmat qilishga intilayotgan sayohatchi darveshsiz.

en: You know not, perhaps, what trouble you have taken upon yourself to take care of so many camels.
uz: Balki bilmaysan, bunchalik ko'p tuyaga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun qanday tashvish chekkaningni.

en: If you would take my advice you would keep but thirty; you will find them sufficiently troublesome to manage.
uz: Agar mening maslahatimga quloq solsangiz, faqat o'ttiztasini saqlaysiz; ularni boshqarish yetarli darajada qiyin deb topasiz.

en: Take my word; I have had experience.” “I believe you are right,” replied the dervish; “choose which ten you please, and take them, and go on in God’s keeping.” I chose ten and put them in the road to follow my others.
uz: Mening so'zimga ishoning; men tajribam bor. Men sizning haq ekanligingizga ishonaman, javob berdi dervish; o'ntagini tanlang, ularni oling va Xudoning himoyasida davom eting. Men o'ntagini tanladim va ularni yo'lga qo'ydim, qolganlarimga ergashish uchun.

en: I had not imagined that the dervish would be so easily persuaded to part with his camels and I began to think that it would be no hard matter to get ten more: wherefore, instead of thanking him, I said to him again, “Brother, I cannot part from you without desiring you to consider once more how difficult a thing it is to govern thirty loaded camels, especially for you who are not used to such work; you will find it much better to return me as many more as you have done already.” The dervish gave me, without any hesitation, the other ten camels; so that he had but twenty left, and I was master of sixty, and might boast of greater riches than any sovereign prince.
uz: Men dervish o'z tuyalaridan shunchalik oson ajralishga ko'ndirilishini tasavvur qilmagan edim va o'ylay boshladimki, yana o'nta olish qiyin emas: shuning uchun, unga minnatdorchilik bildirmasdan, yana aytdim: Ey birodar, men sizdan yana bir bor o'ylab ko'rmasdan ajralmayman, chunki o'ttiz yuklangan tuyani boshqarish qanchalik qiyin, ayniqsa siz bunday ishga odatlanmaganlar uchun; siz menga allaqachon qilganingizdek ko'pni qaytarganingiz yaxshiroq bo'ladi. Dervish menga hech qanday ikkilanmasdan boshqa o'nta tuyani berdi; shuning uchun u yigirmatta qoldi, men esa oltmishtaga ega edim va har qanday hukmdor shahzodadan ham ko'ra katta boylik bilan maqtanishim mumkin edi.

en: Any one would have thought I would now be content, but the more we have, the more we want; and I became yet more greedy and desirous of the other twenty camels.
uz: Har kim meni hozir mamnun bo'laman deb o'ylardi, lekin qancha ko'p bo'lsa, shuncha ko'p xohlaymiz; va men qolgan yigirmata tuyani yanada ochko'z va istakli bo'lib qoldim.

en: I redoubled my solicitations and importunities to make the dervish grant me ten of the twenty, which he did with a good grace: and as to the other ten he had left, I embraced him, kissed his feet, caressed and entreated him, so that he gave me these also.
uz: Men darveshga yigirmatdan o'ntasini berish uchun iltimoslarimni va g'amxo'rliklarni ikki barobar ko'paytirdim, u buni yaxshilik bilan qildi: qolgan o'ntaligini esa, men uni quchoqladim, oyoqlarini o'pdim, erkaladim va iltimos qildim, shuning uchun u ham menga bularni berdi.

en: “Make a good use of them, brother,” said the dervish, “and remember that God can take away riches as well as give them.”
uz: Ulardan yaxshi foydalan, birodar,  dedi dervish,  va esda tutingki, Xudo boyliklarni ham olib, ham berishi mumkin.

en: I was not yet content, though I had my forty camels again, and knew they were loaded with treasure.
uz: Hali ham qoniqmadim, garchi yana qirq tuyalarim bor edi va ular xazina bilan to'ldirilganini bilardim.
