en: A thought came into my head, that the little box of ointment which the dervish Presently a thick cloud arose showed me contained something of inestimable value, and I determined to obtain it.
uz: Miyamga shunday fikr keldi: dervish hozir qalin bulut ko'targan kichik moy qutisi menga bebaho qimmatga ega narsa ekanligini ko'rsatdi va men uni olishga qaror qildim.

en: I had bade him adieu, when I again
uz: Men unga xayr aytgandim, qachonki yana...

en: returned, and said, “That little box of ointment seems such a trifle, it is not worth your carrying away.
uz: qaytib keldi va dedi: U kichkina malham qutisi shunchalik mayda-chuyda ko'rinadiki, uni olib ketishga arzimaydi.

en: I entreat you to make me a present of it.
uz: Sizdan uni menga sovg'a qilishingizni so'rayman.

en: What occasion has a dervish, who has renounced the vanities of the world, for perfumes, or scented unguents?” The dervish pulled it out of his bosom, and presenting it to me, said, “Here, take it, brother, and be content; if I can do more for you, you need but to ask me—I shall be ready to satisfy you.” When I had the box in my hand, I opened it, and looking at the unguent, said, “Since you are so good, I am sure you will not refuse to tell me the use of this ointment.” “The use is very surprising and wonderful,” replied the dervish.
uz: Dunyo behuda narsalaridan voz kechgan darveshning qanday vazifasi bor, atirlar yoki xushbo'y moylar uchunmi? Darvesh uni ko'kragidan chiqarib oldi va menga taqdim etib, dedi: Mana, uni ol, aka, va rozi bo'l; agar men senga ko'proq yordam bera olsam, mendan so'rashing kifoya. Quti qo'limda bo'lganida, uni ochdim va moyga qarab, dedi: Sen juda yaxshi ekansan, shu moyni menga aytishdan bosh tortmasligingga aminman. Foydalanish juda ajablanarli va ajoyib, javob berdi darvesh.

en: “If you apply a little of it upon the lid of the left eye, you will see all the treasures contained in the bosom of the earth; but if you apply it to the right eyelid, it will make you blind.” “Take the box,” said I to the dervish, “and apply some to my left eyelid; you understand how to do it better than I.” The dervish had no sooner done so, than I saw immense treasures and such prodigious riches, that it is impossible for me to give an account of them; but as I was obliged to keep my right eye shut, I desired the dervish to apply some of the pomatum to that eye.
uz: Agar chap ko'zning qopqog'iga ozgina surtsangiz, yerning ko'kragida joylashgan barcha xazinalarni ko'rasiz; lekin agar uni o'ng qovoqqa surtsangiz, u sizni ko'r qiladi. Qutini oling, dedim men dervishga, va chap qovoqqa surting; buni qanday qilishni mendan yaxshiroq tushunasiz. Dervish buni hech qachon oldinroq qilmagan edi, lekin men ulkan xazinalar va shunchalik ulkan boyliklarni ko'rdimki, ularning hisobini berishim mumkin emas edi; lekin o'ng ko'zimni yopiq tutishga majbur bo'lganim uchun dervishga o'sha ko'zga bir oz pomatumni surtishni xohladim.

en: “I am ready to do it,” said the dervish; “but you must remember what I told you, that if you put any of it upon your right eye, you will go blind; such is the virtue of the ointment.” Far from being persuaded of the truth of what the dervish said, I imagined, on the contrary, that there was some new mystery, which he meant to hide from me.
uz: Men buni qilishga tayyorman,  dedi dervish;  lekin sizga aytganimni eslashingiz kerak, agar siz o'ng ko'zingizga birortasini qo'ysangiz, ko'r bo'lasiz; moyning fazilati shunda.  Dervish aytgan gapining haqiqatligiga ishonganimdan yiroq, aksincha, u mendan yashirmoqchi bo'lgan yangi sir bor deb tasavvur qildim.

en: “Brother,” replied I, smiling, “I see plainly you wish to mislead me; it is not natural that this ointment should have two such contrary effects.” “The matter is as I tell you,” replied the dervish.
uz: Aka,  javob berdim men, jilmayib,  Ko'rinib turibdiki, meni adashtirmoqchisiz; bu moyning bunday ikki xil teskari ta'siri bo'lishi tabiiy emas.

en: “You ought to believe me, for I tell the truth.” The dervish made all the resistance possible; but seeing that I would take no refusal, he took a little of the ointment, and applied it
uz: Siz menga ishonishingiz kerak, chunki men rost gapiryapman. Darvesh barcha qarshiliklarni imkon qadar qildi; lekin men rad etmasligimni ko'rib, malhamdan biroz oldi va surtdi.

en: I ceased at once to distinguish anything with either eye, and became blind as you see me now.
uz: Men darhol ikki ko'zim bilan hech narsani farqlashni to'xtatdim va hozir ko'rib turganingizdek ko'r bo'lib qoldim.

en: “Ah, dervish!” I exclaimed, in agony, “what you forewarned has proved true.
uz: Oh, darvesh! deb faryod qildim azob chekib,  sen ogohlantirgan narsa rost bo'ldi.

en: I am now sensible what a misfortune I have brought upon myself by my insatiable desire of riches; but you, dear brother,” cried I, addressing myself to the dervish, “who are so charitable and good, among the many wonderful secrets you are acquainted with, have you not one to restore to me my sight again?” “Miserable man!” answered the dervish, “you might have avoided this misfortune, but you have your deserts.
uz: Men endi o'zimga to'ymas boylikka bo'lgan ishtiyoqim tufayli qanday baxtsizlik keltirganimni angladim; lekin sen, aziz aka,  deb qichqirdim men, darveshga murojaat qilib,  shunchalik xayriya va yaxshi bo'lganing uchun, senga tanish bo'lgan ko'plab ajoyib sirlar orasida, menga yana ko'rishimni qaytaradigan hech kim yo'qmi? Baxtsiz odam! deb javob berdi darvesh, sen bu baxtsizlikdan qochgan bo'lishing mumkin edi, lekin sening cho'llaring bor.

en: The blindness of your mind was the cause of the loss of your eyes.
uz: Aqlingizning ko'rligi ko'zlaringizni yo'qotishingizga sabab bo'ldi.

en: I have no power to restore to you your sight.
uz: Sizning ko'zingizni tiklashga kuchim yo'q.

en: Pray to God, therefore; it is he alone that can restore it to you.
uz: Shunday ekan, Xudoga iltijo qiling; uni sizga qaytarib bera oladigan yagona Zot u.

en: He gave you riches, of which you were unworthy; and on that account He takes them from you again, and will by my hands give them to a man not so ungrateful as yourself.” The dervish said no more, but left me to myself, overwhelmed with confusion and grief.
uz: U senga sen loyiq bo'lmagan boyliklarni berdi; shuning uchun ham U ularni sendan qaytarib oladi va mening qo'llarim bilan ularni o'zing kabi noshukr bo'lmagan odamga beradi. Darvesh boshqa gapirmadi, lekin meni chalkashib ketgan va qayg'uga to'lib ketgan holda o'zimga tashladi.

en: He then collected my camels, and drove them away to Bussorah.
uz: Keyin u mening tuyalarimni yig'di va ularni Bussoraga haydab ketdi.

en: I cried out loudly as he was departing, and entreated him not to leave me in that miserable condition, but to conduct me at least to the first caravanserai; but he was deaf to entreaties.
uz: U ketayotganda baland ovoz bilan qichqirdim va undan meni shu bechora ahvolda qoldirmaslikni, hech bo'lmaganda birinchi karvon saroyiga olib borishini iltimos qildim; lekin u iltimoslarga quloqsiz edi.

en: Thus deprived of sight and of all I had in the world, I should have died with affliction and hunger, if the next day a caravan returning from Bussorah had not received me charitably, and brought me back to Bagdad.
uz: Shunday qilib, dunyodagi ko'zlarim va bor-budimsiz qolgan holda, agar ertasi kuni Bussoradan qaytayotgan karvon meni xayriya bilan qabul qilmaganida va Bag'dodga qaytarib olib kelmaganida, azob va ochlikdan o'lgan bo'lardim.

en: I was thus reduced, without remedy, from a condition of great wealth to a state of poverty.
uz: Shunday qilib, men hech qanday chora ko'rmasdan, katta boylik holatidan qashshoqlik holatiga tushdim.

en: I had no other way to subsist but by asking charity, which I have done till now.
uz: Mening tirik qolishning boshqa yo'li yo'q edi, faqat sadaqa so'rashdan boshqa, shu paytgacha qilganim.

en: But to expiate my offense against God, I enjoined on myself, by way of penance, a box on the ear from every charitable person who should commiserate my condition and give me alms.
uz: Lekin Xudoga qarshi qilgan gunohimni oqlash uchun, tavba qilish yo'li bilan, mening ahvolimni yomonlashi va menga sadaqa berishi kerak bo'lgan har bir xayriya qiluvchi odamdan quloqqa quti qo'yishni o'zimga buyurdim.

en: This, Commander of the Faithful, is the motive which caused me to make so strange a request to you.
uz: Bu, Mo'minlar Qo'mondoni, meni sizga g'alati so'rov bildirishimga sabab bo'lgan sababdir.

en: I ask your pardon once more
uz: Sizdan yana bir bor kechirim so'rayman.

en: as your slave, and submit to receive the chastisement I deserve.
uz: qulingiz sifatida va men loyiq bo'lgan jazoga ega bo'lish uchun taslim bo'ling.

en: “Baba Abdalla,” the caliph said, “your sin has been great; but, God be praised, your self-inflicted penance proves your sorrow.
uz: Baba Abdalla,  dedi xalifa,  sening gunohing katta boldi; lekin, Xudoga hamd bolsin, ozingga yetkazilgan tavbangiz qayguningni isbotlaydi.

en: That you may forego your daily asking of alms, I give you henceforth four silver dirhems a day, which my grand vizier shall present to you daily with the penance you have imposed on yourself.” At these words, Baba Abdalla prostrated himself before the caliph’s throne, returned him thanks, and wished him all happiness and prosperity.
uz: Siz har kuni sadaqa so'rashdan voz kechishingiz uchun, bundan buyon sizga kuniga to'rtta kumush dirham beraman, uni buyuk vazirim har kuni o'zingizga yuklagan tavba bilan taqdim etadi. Shu so'zlardan so'ng, Baba Abdalla xalifaning taxti oldida sajda qildi, unga minnatdorchilik bildirdi va unga barcha baxt va farovonlik tiladi.

en: “But I see that dawn has come,” Scheherazade concluded.
uz: Lekin men tong kelganini ko'ryapman, deb xulosa qildi Sheherazade.

en: “There is, however, a tale of forty thieves which has been considered by some to be fully as entertaining as any of the stories I have yet related.” “I should not like to miss that story,” answered the sultan, “and therefore, at the same time to-morrow you may continue.” With these words he departed.
uz: Lekin, qirq ogri haqidagi ertak bor, uni bazilar men hikoya qilgan har qanday hikoya kabi toliq qiziqarli deb hisoblashgan. Men bu hikoyani otkazib yuborishni xohlamayman, javob berdi sulton, va shuning uchun, shu bilan birga ertaga davom etishingiz mumkin. Shu sozlar bilan u ketdi.

en: Scheherazade, going later to see her father, told him to be of good heart, for he could see that it was not unlikely that she would win in her plan to make the sultan forego his unhappy resolution.
uz: Sheherazad keyinroq otasini ko'rishga borgach, unga yaxshi niyatda bo'lishni aytdi, chunki u sultanning baxtsiz qaroridan voz kechishi uchun uning rejasida g'alaba qozonishi ehtimoli kam emasligini ko'rdi.

en: The next night she began the story as follows:
uz: Ertasi kuni kechasi u hikoyani quyidagicha boshladi:

en: Ali Baba The History of Ali Baba, and of the Forty Robbers Killed by One Slave There once lived in a town of Persia two brothers, one named Cassim and the other Ali Baba.
uz: Ali Baba Ali Babaning tarixi va Bir qul tomonidan o'ldirilgan qirq qaroqchining tarixi Bir vaqtlar Fors shahrida ikki aka-uka yashagan, ulardan biri Kassim, ikkinchisi esa Ali Babaning ismi edi.

en: Their father divided a small inheritance equally between them.
uz: Ularning otasi o'rtasida kichik merosni teng taqsimladi.

en: Cassim married a rich wife, and became a wealthy merchant.
uz: Kassim boy xotin bilan turmushga chiqdi va boy savdogarga aylandi.

en: Ali Baba, who married a woman as poor as himself, lived by cutting wood, and bringing it upon three asses into the town to sell.
uz: Ali Baba, o'zi kabi kambag'al ayolga turmushga chiqqan, yog'och kesib yashardi va uni sotish uchun uchta eshak ustida shaharga olib kirardi.

en: One day, when Ali Baba was in the forest, cutting wood enough to load his asses, he saw at a distance a great cloud of dust, which seemed to approach him.
uz: Bir kuni Ali Baba o'rmonda bo'lib, eshaklarini yuklash uchun yetarli daraxt kesayotganida, uzoqdan katta chang bulutini ko'rdi, u unga yaqinlashgandek edi.

en: He observed it with attention, and distinguished a body of horsemen, who he suspected might be robbers.
uz: U buni diqqat bilan kuzatdi va o'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin deb gumon qilgan chavandozlar to'dasini ajratib ko'rdi.

en: He determined to hide his asses and to save himself.
uz: U o'z eshaklarini yashirishga va o'zini qutqarishga qaror qildi.

en: He climbed a large tree, planted on a high rock, whose branches were
uz: U baland toshga ekilgan katta daraxtga chiqdi, uning shoxlari...

en: thick enough to conceal him, and yet enabled him to see all that passed without being discovered.
uz: Uni yashirish uchun yetarli qalinlik, ammo shunga qaramay, unga topilmasdan o'tgan hamma narsani ko'rishga imkon berdi.

en: The troop, who numbered forty, all well mounted and armed, came to the foot of the rock on which the tree stood, and there dismounted.
uz: Qirq kishi bo'lgan, barcha yaxshi o'tirgan va qurollangan qo'shin daraxt turgan toshning etagiga keldi va u yerdan tushdi.

en: Every man unbridled his horse, tied him to some shrub, and hung about his neck a bag of corn which had been brought with them.
uz: Har bir kishi otini bo'shatdi, uni bir butaga bog'ladi va o'zi bilan olib kelgan makkajo'xori xaltasini bo'yniga osib qo'ydi.

en: Then each took off his saddle-bag, which seemed to Ali Baba to be full of gold and silver.
uz: Keyin har biri Ali Boboga oltin va kumushga to'la ko'ringan egar sumkasini yechdi.

en: One, whom he took to be their captain, came under the tree in which Ali Baba was concealed; and making his way through some shrubs, pronounced these words: “Open, Sesame!” As soon as the captain of the robbers had thus spoken, a door opened in the rock; and after he had made all his troop enter before him, he followed them, when the door shut again of itself.
uz: U o'zlarining sardori deb bilgan biri Ali Bobo yashiringan daraxt ostiga keldi; va bir nechta butalar orasidan o'tib, shunday so'zlarni aytdi: Ochiq, Sesam! Qaroqchilar sardori shunday degan zahoti toshda eshik ochildi; va u butun qo'shinini uning oldiga kiritgandan so'ng, eshik yana o'zi yopilganda, u ularning ortidan ergashdi.

en: The robbers stayed some time within the rock, during which Ali Baba, fearful of being caught, remained in the tree.
uz: Qaroqchilar bir oz vaqt tosh ichida qoldilar, shu vaqt ichida Ali Baba qo'lga tushishdan qo'rqib, daraxt ichida qoldi.

en: At last the door opened again, and as the captain went in last, so he came out first, and stood aside to see them all pass by him; when Ali Baba heard him make the door close by pronouncing these words, “Shut, Sesame!” Every man at once bridled his horse, fastened his saddle-bag, and mounted again.
uz: Nihoyat eshik yana ochildi va kapitan oxirgi marta kirganida, u birinchi bo'lib chiqdi va ularning hammasi uning yonidan o'tishini ko'rish uchun chetga turdi; Ali Baba uni eshikni yopib, bu so'zlarni aytganini eshitdi: Jim bo'lsin, Sesam! Har bir kishi darhol otini mahkamladi, egar sumkasini mahkamladi va yana o'tirdi.

en: When the captain saw them all ready, he put himself at their head, and they returned the way they had come.
uz: Komendant ularning hammasini tayyor holda ko'rgach, o'zini ularning boshiga qo'ydi va ular kelgan yo'ldan qaytishdi.

en: Ali Baba followed them with his eyes as far as he could see them; remaining in the tree a considerable time before he descended.
uz: Ali Baba ularni ko'zlari bilan ko'ra oladigan darajada kuzatdi; pastga tushishdan oldin daraxtda ancha vaqt qoldi.

en: Remembering the words the captain of the robbers used to cause the door to open and shut, he had the curiosity to try if his pronouncing them would have the same effect.
uz: Qaroqchilar sardori eshikni ochilishi va yopilishiga sabab bo'ladigan so'zlarni eslab, ularni talaffuz qilishda ham xuddi shunday ta'sir bo'lishini sinab ko'rishga qiziqdi.

en: Accordingly, he went among the shrubs, and perceiving the door concealed behind them, stood before it, and said, “Open, Sesame!” The door instantly flew wide open.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u butalar orasiga kirdi va orqasida yashiringan eshikni ko'rib, uning oldida turdi va dedi: Ochiq, Sesam! Eshik darhol keng ochildi.

en: Ali Baba, who expected a dark, dismal cavern, was surprised to see a well-lighted and spacious chamber, which received the light from an opening at the top of the rock, and in which were all sorts
uz: Qorong'u, xira g'or kutgan Ali Baba, tosh tepasidagi teshikdan yorug'likni olgan va unda har xil narsalar bor bo'lgan yaxshi yoritilgan va keng xonani ko'rib hayron bo'ldi.

en: of fine merchandise, rich bales of silk, stuff, brocade, and valuable carpeting, piled upon one another; gold and silver ingots in great heaps, and money in bags.
uz: nozik mahsulotlar, ipakdan boy bo'laklar, narsalar, brokat va qimmatbaho gilamlar, bir-birining ustiga to'plangan; katta to'plamlarda oltin va kumush idishlar, sumkalarda pullar.

en: The sight of all these riches made him suppose that this cave must have been occupied for ages by robbers, who had succeeded one another.
uz: Bu boyliklarning barchasini ko'rib, u bu g'orni asrlar davomida bir-biridan o'tib ketgan qaroqchilar bosib olgan bo'lishi kerak deb taxmin qildi.

en: Ali Baba went boldly into the cave, and collected as much of the gold coin, which was in bags, as he thought his three asses could carry.
uz: Ali Baba jasorat bilan g'orga kirdi va uchta eshagisi ko'tara oladigan darajada ko'p oltin tangalarni yig'di.

en: When he had loaded them with the bags, he laid wood over them in such a manner that they could not be seen.
uz: U ularni sumkalar bilan yuklaganidan so'ng, ular ko'rinmaydigan tarzda yog'ochni ularning ustiga qo'ydi.

en: When he had finished he stood before the door, and pronouncing the words, “Shut, Sesame!” the door closed of itself.
uz: U tugatgach, u eshik oldida turdi va Shut, Sesam! degan so'zlarni aytib, eshik o'z-o'zidan yopildi.

en: He then made the best of his way to town.
uz: Keyin u shaharga borishga harakat qildi.

en: When Ali Baba got home, he drove his asses into a little yard, shut the gates very carefully, threw off the wood that covered the panniers, carried the bags into his house, and He Emptied the Bags of Gold ranged them in order before his wife.
uz: Ali Baba uyga kelganida, eshaklarini kichkina hovliga haydab kirdi, darvozalarni juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan yopdi, paypoqlarni qoplagan yog'ochni tashladi, sumkalarni uyiga olib kirdi va U Oltin Sumkalarni bo'shatdi, ularni xotini oldidan tartibli ravishda joylashtirdi.

en: He then emptied the bags, which raised such a great heap of gold as dazzled his wife’s eyes,
uz: Keyin u xaltalarni bo'shatdi, ular xotini ko'zini qamashtiradigan darajada katta oltin to'plamini ko'tarardi.

en: and then he told her the whole adventure from beginning to end, and, above all, recommended her to keep it secret.
uz: va keyin u unga butun sarguzashtni boshidan oxirigacha aytib berdi va eng muhimi, uni sir saqlashni tavsiya qildi.

en: The wife rejoiced greatly at their good fortune, and would count all the gold piece by piece.
uz: Xotin ularning omadidan juda xursand bo'ldi va barcha oltin tangalarni bo'lak-bo'lak sanardi.

en: “Wife,” replied Ali Baba, “you do not know what you undertake, when you pretend to count the money; you will never have done.
uz: Xotin,  javob berdi Ali Baba,  pulni sanayotgandek ko'rsangiz, nimaga kirishayotganingizni bilmaysiz; hech qachon buni qilmagan bo'lasiz.

en: I will dig a hole, and bury it.
uz: Men teshik qazaman va uni ko'maman.

en: There is no time to be lost.” “You are in the right, husband,” replied she, “but let us know, as nigh as possible, how much we have.
uz: Yo'qotilishga vaqt yo'q. To'g'ri aytdingiz, erim,  javob berdi u,  lekin imkon qadar yaqinroq, qancha borligini bizga xabar bering.

en: I will borrow a small measure, and measure it, while you dig the hole.” Away the wife ran to her brother-in-law who lived just by, and addressing herself to Cassim’s wife, asked her to lend her a measure.
uz: Men bir oz o'lchov olib, siz teshik qazayotganda o'lchayman.  Xotin yonida yashovchi qaynasiga yugurib bordi va Kassimning xotiniga murojaat qilib, undan o'lchov berishni so'radi.

en: Her sister-in-law inquired whether she would have a great or a small one.
uz: Uning qaynsisi katta yoki kichik bo'lishini so'radi.

en: The other asked for a small one.
uz: Boshqasi kichigini so'radi.

en: The sister-in-law, as she knew Ali Baba’s poverty, was curious to know what sort of grain his wife wanted to measure, and artfully putting some suet at the bottom brought it to her, with an excuse that she was sorry that she had made her wait so long, but that she could not find it sooner.
uz: Qaynsingil, Ali Babaning qashshoqligini bilgani uchun, uning xotini qanday donni o'lchamoqchi ekanligini bilishga qiziqardi va uni pastga mohirona qilib kostyum qo'yib, unga olib keldi, bahonasi bilan uni bunchalik uzoq kutganidan afsusda edi, lekin uni tezroq topa olmasdi.

en: Ali Baba’s wife went home, set the measure by the heap of gold, filled it and emptied it till she had done, when she was very well satisfied to find the number of measures amounted to so many as they did, and went to tell her husband, who had almost finished digging the hole.
uz: Ali Babaning xotini uyga bordi, o'lchovni oltin uyumiga qo'ydi, to'ldirdi va to'ldirguncha bo'shatdi. U o'lchovlar soni ularning soniga teng ekanligidan juda mamnun bo'lgach, teshik qazishni deyarli tugatgan eriga aytdi.

en: While Ali Baba was burying the gold, his wife, to show her diligence to her sister-in-law, carried the measure back again, but without taking notice that a piece of gold had stuck to the bottom.
uz: Ali Baba oltinni ko'mayotgan paytda, uning rafiqasi, qaynonasining mehnatkashligini ko'rsatish uchun, o'lchovni yana ko'tardi, lekin bir bo'lak oltin tubiga yopishib qolganini sezmasdan.

en: “Sister,” said she, “you see that I have not kept your measure long.
uz: Opa,  dedi u,  ko'rib turibsizki, men sizning o'lchovingizni uzoq ushlab turmadim.

en: I am obliged to you for it, and return it with thanks.” As soon as Ali Baba’s wife was gone, Cassim’s wife looked at the bottom of the measure, and was inexpressibly surprised to find a piece of gold sticking to it.
uz: Men sizdan buning uchun minnatdorman va uni minnatdorchilik bilan qaytaraman. Ali Babaning xotini ketishi bilanoq, Kassimning xotini o'lchovning pastki qismiga qaradi va unga yopishtirilgan bir bo'lak oltinni topib, ifodasiz hayron bo'ldi.

en: Envy immediately possessed her breast.
uz: Hasad darhol uning ko'kragini egallab oldi.

en: “What!” said she, “has Ali Baba gold so plentiful as to measure it?
uz: Nima!  dedi u,  Ali Babada shunchalik kop oltin borki, uni olchash mumkinmi?

en: Whence has he all this wealth?”
uz: Uning bu boyligi qayerdan keldi?

en: Cassim, her husband, was at his counting-house.
uz: Uning eri Kassim uning hisob-kitobxonasida edi.

en: When he came home, his wife said to him, “Cassim, I know you think yourself rich, but Ali Baba is infinitely richer than you.
uz: U uyga kelganida, xotini unga dedi: Kasim, bilaman, o'zingni boy deb o'ylaysan, lekin Ali Baba sendan cheksiz boyroq.

en: He does not count his money, but measures it.” Cassim desired her to explain, which she did, showing him the piece of money, which was so old that they could not tell in what prince’s reign it was coined.
uz: U o'z pulini sanamaydi, lekin o'lchaydi. Kassim undan tushuntirishni xohladi, u shunday qildi va unga shu qadar eski bo'lgan pul parchasini ko'rsatdi, ular uning qaysi shahzoda davrida yaratilganini aniqlay olishmadi.

en: Cassim, after he had married the rich widow, had never treated Ali Baba as a brother and now, instead of being pleased, he conceived a base envy at his brother’s prosperity.
uz: Kassim, boy bevaga turmushga chiqqandan so'ng, Ali Babani hech qachon aka-uka sifatida qabul qilmagan edi va endi xursand bo'lish o'rniga, akasining farovonligiga nisbatan past hasad tuyg'usini o'ylab topdi.

en: He could not sleep all that night, and went to him in the morning before sunrise.
uz: U butun tun davomida uxlay olmadi va ertalab quyosh chiqmasidan oldin uning oldiga bordi.

en: “Ali Baba,” said he, “I am surprised at you; you pretend to be miserably poor, and yet you measure gold.
uz: Ali Baba,  dedi u,  Senga hayronman; sen o'zingni juda kambag'al ko'rsatyapsan, ammo oltin o'lchayapsan.

en: My wife found this at the bottom of the measure you borrowed yesterday.” By this, Ali Baba perceived that Cassim and his wife, through his own wife’s folly, knew what he had so much reason to conceal; but what was done could not be undone.
uz: Xotinim buni kecha qarzga olgan o'lchovingizning pastki qismida topdi. Shu bilan Ali Baba Kassim va uning rafiqasi o'z xotinining ahmoqligi orqali yashirishga shunchalik ko'p sababga ega ekanligini angladilar; lekin qilingan ishni bekor qilib bo'lmaydi.

en: Therefore, without showing the least surprise or trouble, he confessed all, and offered his brother part of his treasure to keep the secret.
uz: Shuning uchun, hech qanday hayrat yoki tashvish ko'rsatmasdan, u hammasini tan oldi va akasiga xazinasining bir qismini sir saqlash uchun taklif qildi.

en: “I expect as much,” replied Cassim haughtily; “but I must know exactly where this treasure is, and how I may visit it myself when I choose; otherwise, I will go and inform against you, and then you will not only get no more, but will lose all you have, and I shall have a share for my information.” Ali Baba told him all, even to the words he must use to gain admission into the cave.
uz: Men shuncha kutaman,  javob berdi Kassim takabburlik bilan;  lekin men bu xazinaning qayerda ekanligini aniq bilishim kerak va ozim xohlaganimda uni qanday ziyorat qilishim mumkinligini bilishim kerak; aks holda, men sizga qarshi borib xabar beraman, shunda nafaqat hech narsa olmaysiz, balki bor narsangizni ham yoqotasiz va mening malumotlarim uchun ulushga ega bolaman. Ali Baba unga hamma narsani aytdi, hatto gorga kirish uchun ishlatishi kerak bolgan sozlarni ham.

en: Cassim rose the next morning long before the sun, and set out for the forest with ten mules bearing great chests, which he designed to fill.
uz: Kassim ertasi kuni quyoshdan ancha oldin turib, katta sandiqlarni ko'tarib yurgan o'nta mul bilan o'rmonga yo'l oldi va uni to'ldirishni rejalashtirdi.

en: It was not long before he reached the rock, and found out the place, by the tree and other marks which his brother had given him.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay u qoyaga yetib keldi va joyni, akasi unga bergan daraxt va boshqa belgilar orqali topdi.

en: When he reached the entrance of the cavern, he pronounced the words, “Open, Sesame!” The door immediately opened, and, when he was in, closed upon him.
uz: U g'orning kirishiga yetgach, u shunday so'zlarni aytdi: Ochiq, Olxo'ri! Darhol eshik ochilib, u kirgach, unga yopildi.

en: In examining the cave, he was greatly excited to find more riches than he had expected from Ali Baba’s
uz: G'orni o'rganar ekan, u Ali Babadan kutganidan ko'ra ko'proq boylik topishdan juda hayajonlangan edi.

en: He quickly laid as many bags of gold as he could carry at the door of the cavern; but his thoughts were so full of the great riches he would possess, that he could not remember the necessary word to make it open, and instead of “Sesame,” said, “Open, Barley!” He was much amazed to find that the door remained fast shut.
uz: U darhol g'or eshigiga olib yurgancha ko'p oltin qoplarni qo'ydi; lekin uning xayoli o'ziga xos bo'ladigan ulkan boyliklarga shunchalik to'la ediki, uni ochish uchun zarur so'zni eslay olmadi va Sezam o'rniga Ochiq, Arpa! dedi. U eshikning qattiq yopilganini topib juda hayratda qoldi.

en: He named several sorts of grain, but still the door would not open.
uz: U bir nechta don turlarini nomladi, lekin baribir eshik ochilmadi.

en: Cassim had never expected such an incident, and was so alarmed at the danger he was in, that the more he endeavored to remember the word “Sesame,” the more his memory failed and he forgot it as completely as if he had never heard it.
uz: Kassim bunday hodisani hech qachon kutmagan edi va o'zi duch kelayotgan xavfdan shunchalik xavotirda ediki, u Sezam so'zini eslashga qanchalik harakat qilsa, xotirasi shunchalik buzilib, uni hech qachon eshitmagandek butunlay unutdi.

en: He threw down the bags he had loaded himself with, and walked distractedly up and down the cave, without having the least regard to the riches that were around him.
uz: U o'zi yuklagan sumkalarni tashladi va atrofidagi boyliklarga hech qanday e'tibor bermasdan, g'orda chalg'ib yurdi.

en: About noon the robbers visited their cave.
uz: Taxminan tush paytida qaroqchilar ularning g'origa tashrif buyurishdi.

en: At some distance they saw Cassim’s mules straggling about the rock, with great chests on their backs.
uz: Uzoq masofada ular Kassimning tosh atrofida katta ko'kraklar bilan sudralib yurgan o'g'illarini ko'rishdi.

en: Alarmed at this, they galloped full speed to the cave.
uz: Bundan xavotirlanib, ular g'orga to'liq tezlikda chopishdi.

en: They drove away the mules, who strayed through the forest and were soon out of sight, and went directly, with their naked sabers in their hands, to the door, which, on their captain pronouncing the proper words, immediately opened.
uz: Ular o'rmon ichidan adashib ketgan va tez orada ko'zdan g'oyib bo'lgan o'rmonlarni haydab yuborishdi va qo'llarida yalang'och qilichlari bilan to'g'ri eshikga borishdi, u o'z kapitanining to'g'ri so'zlarni aytganida darhol ochildi.

en: Cassim, who heard the noise of the horses’ feet, at once guessed the arrival of the robbers, and resolved to make one effort for his life.
uz: Kassim otlarning oyoqlarining shovqinini eshitib, darhol qaroqchilarning kelishini taxmin qildi va o'z hayoti uchun bir harakat qilishga qaror qildi.

en: He rushed to the door, ran out and threw the leader down, but could not escape the other robbers, who slew him with their scimitars.
uz: U eshik tomon shoshildi, yugurib chiqdi va yetakchini pastga uloqtirdi, lekin boshqa qaroqchilardan qochib qutula olmadi, ular uni o'z qo'rqoqlari bilan o'ldirishdi.

en: The first care of the robbers after this was to examine the cave.
uz: Bundan keyin qaroqchilarning birinchi g'amxo'rligi g'orni tekshirish edi.

en: They found all the bags Cassim had brought to the door, ready to load his mules, and carried them again to their places, but they did not miss what Ali Baba had taken away before.
uz: Ular Kassim eshik oldiga olib kelgan barcha sumkalarni topdilar, ular o'z g'uluvlarini yuklashga tayyor edilar va ularni o'z joylariga qaytarib olib ketishdi, lekin Ali Babaning avval olib ketgan narsalarini o'tkazib yubormadilar.

en: Then holding a council they guessed that Cassim, when he was in, could not get out again, but could not imagine how he had learned the secret words by which alone he could enter.
uz: Keyin ular kengash o'tkazilib, Kassim, u ichkarida bo'lganida, yana tashqariga chiqa olmasligini taxmin qilishdi, lekin u qanday qilib faqat shu orqali kirishi mumkin bo'lgan maxfiy so'zlarni o'rganganini tasavvur qila olishmasdi.

en: To terrify any person or accomplice who should attempt the same thing, they agreed to cut Cassim’s body into four quarters—to hang two on one side, and two on the other, within the door of the cave.
uz: Xuddi shu ishni qilishga urinishi kerak bo'lgan har qanday odamni yoki sherikni dahshatga solib, ular Kassimning jasadini to'rtta qismga bo'lishga rozi bo'lishdi  ikki qismini bir tomondan, ikkitasini esa boshqa tomondan g'or eshigi ichida osib qo'yish uchun.

en: They had no sooner taken this resolution than they put it in execution; and when they had nothing more to detain them, left the place, mounted their horses, and went to beat the roads again, and to attack the caravans they might meet.
uz: Ular bu qarorni amalga oshirishdan ko'p o'tmay qabul qilishdi; va ularni ushlab turishga hech narsa qolmaganda, joydan chiqib, otlariga minib, yana yo'llarni urishga va ular duch kelishi mumkin bo'lgan karvonlarga hujum qilishga ketishdi.

en: In the mean time, Cassim’s wife was very uneasy when night came, and her husband had not returned.
uz: Ayni paytda, Kassimning xotini tun tushganda juda xavotirda edi va eri qaytib kelmagan edi.

en: She ran to Ali Baba in great alarm, and said, “Brother-in-law, you know Cassim is gone to the forest, and upon what account; it is now night, and he has not returned; I am afraid some misfortune has happened to him.” Ali Baba told her that she need not frighten herself, for that certainly Cassim would not think it proper to come into the town till the night was pretty far advanced.
uz: U qattiq xavotirda Ali Babaning oldiga yugurib keldi va dedi: Qaynopa, Cassim ormonga ketganini bilasiz va nima sababdan; endi tun boldi va u qaytib kelmadi; men qorqaman, unga biror baxtsiz hodisa boldi. Ali Baba unga ozini qorqitishga hojat yoqligini aytdi, chunki Cassim tun ancha oldinga otmaguncha shaharga kelishni togri deb hisoblamas edi.

en: Cassim’s wife realizing how much it concerned her husband to keep the business secret, was persuaded to believe her brother-in- law.
uz: Kassimning xotini erining biznes sirini saqlash qanchalik tashvishlanishini anglab yetgach, kuyoviga ishonishga ko'ndirdi.

en: She went home again, and waited patiently till midnight.
uz: U yana uyga bordi va yarim tungacha sabr bilan kutdi.

en: Then her fear redoubled.
uz: Keyin uning qo'rquvi ikki barobar kuchaydi.

en: She repented her foolish curiosity, and cursed her desire of prying into the affairs of her brother and sister-in-law.
uz: U ahmoqona qiziquvchanligidan tavba qildi va akasi va qaynonasining ishlariga aralashish istagini la'natladi.

en: She spent all the night in weeping; and as soon as it was day went to them, telling them, by her tears, the cause of her coming.
uz: U butun tun yig'lab o'tdi; va kunduz bo'lishi bilanoq ularning oldiga bordi va ko'z yoshlari bilan ularning oldiga kelish sababini aytdi.

en: Ali Baba did not wait for his sister-in-law to desire him to go to see what was become of Cassim, but departed immediately with his three asses, begging her first to moderate her affliction.
uz: Ali Baba qaynonasining Kassimga nima bo'lganini ko'rishni xohlashini kutmadi, lekin darhol uchta eshagini olib ketib, avval uning dardini yumshatishni iltimos qildi.

en: When he came near the rock, having seen neither his brother nor the mules in his way, he was seriously alarmed at finding some blood spilt near the door, which he took for an ill omen; but when he had pronounced the word, and the door had opened, he was struck with horror at the dismal sight of his brother’s body.
uz: U toshga yaqinlashganda, yo'lida na akasi, na mullarini ko'rgach, eshik yonida qon to'kilganini ko'rib qattiq xavotirga tushdi va buni yomon bashorat deb hisobladi; lekin u so'zni aytib, eshik ochilganidan so'ng, akasining jasadini xira ko'rish uni dahshatga soldi.

en: He went into the cave, to find something to enshroud the remains; and having loaded one of his asses with them, covered them over with wood.
uz: U g'orga kirib, qoldiqlarni yopish uchun biror narsa topdi; va eshaklaridan birini ular bilan yuklab, ularni yog'och bilan qopladi.

en: The other two asses he loaded with bags of gold, covering them also with wood; and then bidding the door shut,
uz: Qolgan ikki eshakni ham oltin qoplar bilan yukladi, ularni yog'och bilan ham yopdi; keyin eshikni yopishni buyurdi.

en: came away; but was careful to stop some time at the end of the forest, that he might not go into the town before night.
uz: U yo'lga tushdi; lekin tun bo'lishidan oldin shaharga kirmasligi uchun o'rmonning oxirida biroz to'xtashga ehtiyot bo'ldi.

en: When he came home, he drove the two asses loaded with gold into his little yard, and left the care of unloading them to his wife, while he led the other to his sister-in-law’s house.
uz: U uyga kelganida, oltin bilan yuklangan ikkita eshakni o'zining kichkina hovlisiga haydab kirdi va ularni tushirishni xotiniga qoldirdi, boshqasini esa qaynonasining uyiga olib bordi.

en: Ali Baba knocked at the door, which was opened by Morgiana, a clever, intelligent slave.
uz: Ali Baba eshikni taqillatdi, uni Morgiana, aqlli, aqlli qul ochdi.

en: Once in the court, he unloaded the ass, and taking Morgiana aside, said to her, “You must observe an inviolable secrecy.
uz: Sudga kirgach, u eshakni tushirdi va Morgionani chetga olib, unga dedi: Siz daxlsiz sirga rioya qilishingiz kerak.

en: Your master’s body is contained in these two panniers.
uz: Sizning xo'jayiningizning jasadi shu ikki taom ichida joylashgan.

en: We must bury him as if he had died a natural death.
uz: Uni go'yo tabiiy o'lim bilan o'lganidek dafn etishimiz kerak.

en: Go now and tell your mistress.
uz: Hozir borib, xo'jayiningga ayt.

en: I leave the matter to your wit and skillful devices.” Ali Baba helped to place the body in Cassim’s house, again recommended Morgiana to act her part well, and then left with his ass.
uz: Men masalani sizning aql-idrokingiz va mohirona usullaringizga qoldiraman. Ali Baba jasadni Kassimning uyiga joylashtirishga yordam berdi, yana Morgianaga o'z qismini yaxshi bajarishni tavsiya qildi va keyin orqasini olib ketdi.

en: The sultan could not conceal his impatience when the coming of day brought Scheherazade to a conclusion.
uz: Sulton kun kelishi Sheherazadani yakuniga yetkazganda, sabrsizlikni yashira olmadi.

en: He told her that he would wait as usual until a like hour on the night to come for what remained of her story, and took an affectionate leave of her.
uz: U unga odatdagidek kechasi bir soatgacha uning hikoyasidan qolgan narsani olish uchun kutishini aytdi va undan mehr bilan xayr oldi.

en: The next night she began in these words: Morgiana went out early the next morning to a druggist, and asked for a sort of lozenge which was considered efficacious in the most dangerous disorders.
uz: Ertasi kuni u quyidagi so'zlardan boshladi: Morgiana ertasi kuni ertalab dorixonaga chiqib, eng xavfli kasalliklarda samarali deb hisoblangan bir turdagi lozenge so'radi.

en: The apothecary inquired who was ill.
uz: Dorixonachi kim kasalligini so'radi.

en: She replied, with a sigh, her good master Cassim himself: and that he could neither eat nor speak.
uz: U xo'jayinining o'zi Kassimni oh-voh bilan javob berdi: va u na ovqatlay olmasdi, na gapira olmasdi.

en: In the evening Morgiana went to the same druggist’s again, and with tears in her eyes, asked for an essence which they used to give to sick people only when at the last extremity.
uz: Kechqurun Morgiana yana o'sha dorixonaga bordi va ko'zlarida yosh bilan, ular kasal odamlarga faqat oxirgi oxirida beradigan mohiyatni so'radilar.

en: “Alas!” said she, taking it from the apothecary, “I am afraid that this remedy will have no better effect than the lozenges; and that I shall lose my good master.” As Ali Baba and his wife were often seen to go between Cassim’s and their own house all that day, and to seem melancholy, nobody
uz: Afsus!  dedi u dorixonadan olib,  Qo'rqamanki, bu vosita pardozlardan yaxshiroq ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi; va men yaxshi xo'jayinimni yo'qotaman. Ali Baba va uning rafiqasi o'sha kuni ko'pincha Kassimning o'z uylari bilan o'rtasida ketayotganini ko'rishardi, va hech kim xafa bo'lib ko'rinmas edi.

en: was surprised in the evening to hear the lamentable shrieks and cries of Cassim’s wife and Morgiana, who gave out everywhere that her master was dead.
uz: Kechqurun Kassimning xotini va Morgiananing qayg'uli qichqiriqlari va faryodlarini eshitib hayron bo'ldi, ular xo'jayining o'lganini hamma joyda e'lon qilishdi.

en: The next morning at daybreak, Morgiana went to an old cobbler whom she knew to be always early at his stall, and bidding him good-morrow, put a piece of gold into his hand, saying, “Baba Mustapha, you must bring with you your sewing tackle, and come with me; but I must tell you, I shall blindfold you when you have come part way.” Baba Mustapha hesitated a little at these words.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, Morgiana doimo erta kelishini bilgan keksa g'isht teruvchi odamning oldiga bordi va unga Xayrli tong deb, qo'liga bir dona oltin qo'ydi va dedi: Baby Mustafa, siz o'zingiz bilan tikuv moslamangizni olib kelishingiz kerak va men bilan keling; lekin men sizga aytishim kerakki, siz to'xtab kelganingizda ko'zlaringizni bog'layman. Baba Mustafa bu so'zlardan biroz ikkilandi.

en: you would have me do something against my conscience, or against my honor?” “God forbid,” said Morgiana, putting another piece of gold into his hand, “that I should ask anything that is contrary to your honor!
uz: Siz mendan vijdonimga zid yoki sha'nimga zid biror narsa qilishimni xohlaysizmi? Xudo saqlasin,  dedi Morgiana qo'liga yana bir oltin qo'shib,  men sizning sha'ningizga zid bo'lgan har qanday narsani so'rasam kerak!

en: Only come along with me and fear nothing.” Baba Mustapha went with Morgiana, who, after she had bound his eyes with a handkerchief at the place she had mentioned, led him to her deceased master’s house, and never unloosed his eyes till he had entered the room where she had put the corpse together.
uz: Faqat men bilan birga keling va hech narsadan qo'rqmang. Baba Mustafa Morgiana bilan birga bordi. Morgiana uning ko'zlarini o'zi tilga olgan joyda ro'mol bilan bog'laganidan so'ng, uni marhum xo'jayinining uyiga olib bordi va u jasadni yig'gan xonaga kirmaguncha hech qachon ko'zlarini ochmadi.

en: “Baba Mustapha,” said she, “you must make haste and sew the parts of this body together; and when you have done, I will give you another piece of gold.” After Baba Mustapha had finished his task, she blindfolded him again, gave him the third piece of gold as she had promised, and recommending secrecy to him carried him back to the place where she first bound his eyes, pulled off the bandage, and let him go home, but watched him till he was quite out of sight, for fear he should have the curiosity to dodge her; she then went home.
uz: Baba Mustafa,  dedi u,  shoshilmay, bu tanani bir-biriga tikib qo'yishing kerak; va qilgandan so'ng, senga yana bir dona oltin beraman.  Baba Mustafa o'z vazifasini tugatgandan so'ng, uni yana ko'zini bog'ladi, va'da qilganidek, uchinchi dona oltin berdi va unga sir saqlashni tavsiya qilib, uni avval ko'zlarini bog'lagan joyiga qaytarib olib bordi, bog'ichni yechdi va uyiga qo'yib yubordi, lekin uni butunlay ko'zdan qochguncha kuzatib turdi, chunki u undan qochish uchun qiziquvchan bo'lishi kerak edi; keyin u uyga ketdi.

en: Morgiana, on her return, warmed some water to wash the body, and then Ali Baba perfumed it with incense, and wrapped it in the burying clothes with the accustomed ceremonies.
uz: Morgiana qaytib kelgach, jasadni yuvish uchun biroz suv isitdi, so'ngra Ali Baba uni tutatqi bilan xushbo'yladi va odatdagi marosimlar bilan dafn liboslariga o'radi.

en: Not long after the proper officer brought the bier, and when the attendants of the mosque, whose business it was to wash the dead, offered to perform their duty, she told them that it was done already.
uz: Yaxshi ofitser pichoqni olib kelganidan ko'p o'tmay, o'liklarni yuvish ishi bo'lgan masjid xizmatchilari o'z vazifalarini bajarishni taklif qilishganda, u ularga bu allaqachon qilinganini aytdi.

en: Shortly after this the imaun and the other ministers of the mosque arrived.
uz: Shundan ko'p o'tmay, imom va masjidning boshqa vazirlari yetib kelishdi.

en: Four neigh­bors carried the corpse to the burying-ground, following
uz: To'rt qo'shni jasadni dafn maydoniga olib borishdi, keyin...

en: the imaun, who recited some prayers.
uz: Imon, ba'zi ibodatlarni o'qigan.

en: Ali Baba came after with some neighbors, who often relieved the others in carrying the bier to the burying-ground.
uz: Ali Baba ba'zi qo'shnilar bilan birga keldi, ular ko'pincha boshqalarni pichoqni dafn joyiga olib borishda yordam berishardi.

en: Morgiana, as a slave to the deceased, followed in the procession, weeping, beating her breast, and tearing her hair.
uz: Morgiana, marhumning quli sifatida, marshrutga ergashib, yig'lab, ko'kragini urib va sochlarini yirtdi.

en: Cassim’s wife stayed at home mourning, uttering lamentable cries with the women of the neighborhood, who came, according to custom and joining their lamentations with hers filled the quarter far and near with sounds of sorrow.
uz: Kassimning xotini uyda motam tutdi, mahalla ayollari bilan birga achinarli faryodlar aytdi. Ular odatga ko'ra kelib, o'z motamlarini uning motamlariga qo'shib, butun mahallani qayg'u tovushlari bilan to'ldirishdi.

en: In this manner Cassim’s murder was hushed up by Ali Baba, his widow, and Morgiana, his slave, with so much cleverness that nobody in the city had the least knowledge or suspicion of it.
uz: Shunday qilib, Kassimning o'ldirilishi Ali Baba, uning bevasi va Morgiana, uning quli tomonidan shunchalik aqllilik bilan o'chirilgan ediki, shaharda hech kim bundan hech qanday xabardor yoki gumon qilmagan edi.

en: Three or four days after the funeral, Ali Baba removed his few goods openly to his sister-in-law’s house, in which it was agreed that he should in future live; but the money he had taken from the robbers he conveyed thither by night.
uz: Dafn marosimidan uch-to'rt kun o'tgach, Ali Baba o'zining oz-ozdan mol-mulkini ochiqchasiga qaynonasining uyiga olib bordi, u yerda kelajakda yashashga kelishib olindi; lekin o'g'rilardan olgan pulini u yerga kechasi yetkazdi.

en: As for Cassim’s warehouse, he intrusted it entirely to the management of his own son.
uz: Kassimning omboriga kelsak, u uni butunlay o'z o'g'lining boshqaruviga topshirdi.

en: While these things were being done, the forty robbers again visited their retreat in the forest.
uz: Bu ishlar bajarilayotgan paytda, qirq nafar qaroqchi yana o'rmondagi oromgohlariga tashrif buyurishdi.

en: Great was their surprise to find Cassim’s body taken away, with some of their bags of gold.
uz: Ularning Cassimning jasadini olib ketilganini va oltindan yasalgan ba'zi sumkalarini topib, hayratda qolishlari juda ajoyib edi.

en: “We are certainly discovered,” said the captain.
uz: Biz aniqlanganmiz,  dedi kapitan.

en: “The removal of the body, and the loss of some of our money, plainly shows that the man whom we killed had an accomplice: and for our own lives’ sake we must try and find him.
uz: Jasadni olib tashlash va pulimizning bir qismini yo'qotish, biz o'ldirgan odamning hamkori borligini aniq ko'rsatadi: va o'z hayotimiz uchun uni topishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.

en: What say you, my lads?” All the robbers unanimously approved of the captain’s proposal.
uz: Sizlar nima deysizlar, yigitlarim? Barcha qaroqchilar kapitanning taklifini bir ovozdan ma'qullashdi.

en: “Well,” said the captain, “one of you must go into town, disguised as a traveler and a stranger, to try if he can hear any talk of the man whom we have killed, and endeavor to find out who he was, and where he lived.
uz: Xo'sh,  dedi kapitan,  sizlardan biri sayohatchi va notanish odam qiyofasida shaharga kirib, biz o'ldirgan odam haqida biror gap eshitsa, uni eshitishga harakat qilish kerak, va u kimligini va qayerda yashaganini aniqlashga harakat qiling.

en: This is a matter of the first importance, and for fear of any treachery, I propose that whoever undertakes this business without success, even though the failure arises only from an error of judgment, shall suffer death.” Without waiting for the sentiments of his companions, one of the robbers started up, and said, “I submit to this condition, and think it
uz: Bu birinchi darajali masala, va har qanday xiyonatdan qo'rqib, men bu ishni muvaffaqiyatsiz amalga oshirgan har bir kishi, garchi muvaffaqiyatsizlik faqatgina hukm xatoligidan kelib chiqsa ham, o'limga duchor bo'lishini taklif qilaman. O'z sheriklarining his-tuyg'ularini kutmasdan, qaroqchilardan biri ishga tushdi va dedi: Men bu shartga bo'ysunaman va o'ylaymanki,

en: an honor to expose my life to serve the troop.” After this robber had received great commendations from the captain and his comrades, he disguised himself so that nobody would discover him for what he was; and taking his leave of the troop that night, went into the town just at The robber disguised himself
uz: Hayotimni qo'shin xizmatida xavf ostiga qo'yish sharafi. Bu qaroqchi kapitan va uning o'rtoqlaridan katta maqtovlar olgandan so'ng, hech kim uni nima ekanligini anglamasligi uchun o'zini niqobladi; va o'sha kecha qo'shinni tark etib, shaharga kirdi.

en: He walked up and down, till accidentally he came to Baba Mustapha’s stall, which was always open before any of the shops.
uz: U yuqoriga va pastga yurdi, toki tasodifan Baba Mustafaning do'koniga keldi, u doimo har qanday do'kondan oldin ochiq edi.

en: Baba Mustapha was seated with an awl in his hand, just beginning work.
uz: Baba Mustafa qo'lida g'altak bilan o'tirardi, endi ishga kirishdi.

en: The robber saluted him, bidding him good-morrow; and perceiving that he was old, said, “Honest man, you begin to work very early: is it possible that one of your age can see so well?
uz: O'g'ri unga salom berdi, ertaga salom berdi; va uning keksa ekanligini anglab, dedi: Honishmand, sen juda erta ishga kirishing mumkin: sizning yoshingdagi odam bunchalik yaxshi ko'ra olishi mumkinmi?

en: I question, even if it were somewhat lighter, whether you could see to stitch.” “You do not know me,” replied Baba Mustapha; “for old as I am, I have extraordinary eyes; and you will not doubt it when I tell you that I sewed the body of a dead man together in a place where I had not so much light as I have now.” “A dead body!” exclaimed the robber, with affected amazement.
uz: Men shubha qilaman, hatto biroz yengilroq bo'lsa ham, tikuvni ko'ra olasizmi? Siz meni tanimaysiz,  javob berdi Baba Mustapha; men qadim bo'lganim uchun ajoyib ko'zlarim bor; va men sizga o'lik odamning jasadini hozirgidek ko'p yorug'lik bo'lmagan joyda birga tikkanimni aytganimda, shubha qilmaysiz. O'lik jasad! dedi qaroqchi ta'sirlangan hayrat bilan.

en: “Yes, yes,” answered Baba Mustapha, “I see you want to have me speak out, but you shall know no more.” The robber felt sure that he had discovered what he sought.
uz: Ha, ha,  javob berdi Baba Mustafa,  Korib turibman, meni gapirishga majbur qilmoqchisiz, lekin bundan keyin hech narsa bilmaysiz.  Qaroqchi ozi qidirayotgan narsani topganligiga amin edi.

en: He pulled out a piece of gold, and putting it into Baba Mustapha’s hand, said to him, “I do not want to learn your secret, though I can assure you you might safely trust me with it.
uz: U bir bo'lak oltinni oldi va uni Baba Mustafaning qo'liga soldi va unga dedi: Men sening siringni bilishni xohlamayman, garchi senga ishonch bilan ishonishing mumkinligiga ishontira olaman.

en: The only thing I desire of you is to show me the house where you stitched up the dead body.” “I cannot do you that favor,” replied Baba Mustapha, “I was taken to a certain place, whence I was led blindfolded to the house, and afterward brought back again in the same manner; you see, therefore, the impossibility of my doing what you desire.” “Well,” replied the robber, “you may remember a little of the way that you were led blindfolded.
uz: Sizdan so'raydigan yagona narsa - menga o'lik jasadni tikkan uyingizni ko'rsating. Men sizga bu ishni qila olmayman,  javob berdi Baba Mustapha, Meni ma'lum bir joyga olib ketishdi, u yerdan ko'zlarimni bog'lab uyga olib kelishdi va keyin xuddi shu tarzda qaytarib kelishdi; shuning uchun, siz xohlaganingizni qilishimning imkonsizligini ko'ryapsiz. Xo'sh,  javob berdi qaroqchi,  siz qanday qilib ko'zlaringizni bog'lab olib kelishganingizni biroz eslay olasiz.

en: Come, let me bind your eyes at the same place.
uz: Kel, ko'zlaringni shu joyga bog'lay.

en: We will walk together; and as everybody ought to be paid for their trouble, there is another piece of gold for you; gratify me in what I ask you.” So saying, he put another piece of gold into the old man’s hand.
uz: Biz birga yuramiz; va har kim o'z tashvishidan haq olishi kerak bo'lganidek, siz uchun yana bir oltin bor; mendan so'ragan narsangizdan meni mamnun qiling. Shunday qilib, u keksa odamning qo'liga yana bir oltin soldi.

en: The two pieces of gold were a great temptation to Baba Mustapha.
uz: Ikki oltin tanga Baba Mustafaga katta vasvasaga sabab bo'ldi.

en: He looked at them a long time without saying a word, but at last he pulled out his purse and put them in.
uz: U ularga bir so'z demay uzoq tikilib turdi, lekin nihoyat hamyonini chiqarib, ularni ichiga soldi.

en: said he to the robber, “that I can remember the way; but since you desire, I will try what I can do.” At these words Baba Mustapha rose up, to the great joy of the robber, and led him to the place where Morgiana had bound his eyes.
uz: U qaroqchiga dedi: Men yo'lni eslay olaman; lekin sen xohlaganing uchun, qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qilaman. Shu so'zlardan so'ng, Baba Mustafa qaroqchining katta quvonchiga ko'tarilib, uni Morgiana ko'zlarini bog'lagan joyga olib bordi.

en: “It was here,” said Baba Mustapha, “I was blindfolded; and I turned this way.” The robber tied his handkerchief over his eyes, and walked by him till he stopped directly at Cassim’s house, where Ali Baba then lived.
uz: Bu yerda edi,  dedi Baba Mustafa,  kozlarim boglangan edi; va men shu tomonga burilib ketdim.  Qaroqchi romolni kozlariga bogladi va togridan-togri Kassimning uyiga toxtashgacha uning yonidan otib ketdi, u yerda Ali Baba yashardi.

en: The thief before he pulled off the band, marked the door with a piece of chalk, which he had ready in his hand, and then asked him if he knew whose house that was; to which Baba Mustapha replied, that as he did not live in that neighborhood, he could not tell.
uz: O'g'ri tasmani yechishdan oldin, eshikni qo'lida tayyorlangan bir bo'lak gil bilan belgiladi va keyin undan bu kimning uyi ekanligini biladimi, deb so'radi; bunga Baba Mustafa javob berdi: u o'sha mahallada yashamaganligi sababli, buni ayta olmas edi.

en: The robber, finding he could discover no more from Baba Mustapha, thanked him for the trouble he had taken, and left him to go back to his stall, while he returned to the forest, sure that he should be very well received.
uz: Qaroqchi, Bobo Mustafadan boshqa hech narsa topa olmasligini anglab yetgach, unga tashvishga tushgan ishi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi va uni o'z do'koniga qaytib ketishga qo'yib yubordi, shu bilan birga o'rmonga qaytib keldi, u juda yaxshi qabul qilinishi kerakligiga amin edi.

en: A little after the robber and Baba Mustapha had parted, Morgiana went out of Ali Baba’s house upon some errand, and upon her return, seeing the mark the robber had made, stopped to observe it.
uz: Qaroqchi va Baba Mustafa ajrashganidan ko'p o'tmay, Morgiana Ali Babaning uyidan biror ish bilan chiqdi va qaytib kelgach, qaroqchi qilgan belgini ko'rib, unga qarash uchun to'xtadi.

en: “What can be the meaning of this mark?” said she to herself; “somebody intends my master no good: however, with whatever intention it was done, it is advisable to guard against the worst.” Accordingly, she fetched a piece of chalk, and marked two or three doors on each side in the same manner, without saying a word to her new master or mistress.
uz: Bu belgining ma'nosi nima bo'lishi mumkin? dedi u o'ziga o'zi; kimdir xo'jayinimga hech qanday yaxshi niyat qilmayapti: ammo, nima niyat bilan qilingan bo'lsa ham, eng yomonidan ehtiyot bo'lish maqsadga muvofiqdir. Shunga ko'ra, u bir bo'lak maydalani olib keldi va yangi xo'jayiniga yoki bekasiga bir so'z demasdan, bir xil tarzda ikki-uchta eshikni belgiladi.

en: In the mean time, the robber rejoined his troop in the forest, and recounted to them his success, expatiating upon his good fortune in meeting so soon with the only person who could have told him what he wanted to know.
uz: Shu bilan birga, qaroqchi o'z qo'shiniga o'rmonga qayta qo'shildi va ularga o'zining muvaffaqiyatini aytib berdi, o'ziga kerakli narsani aytib bera oladigan yagona odam bilan tez orada uchrashish baxtiga shoshildi.

en: All the robbers listened to him with the utmost satisfaction; and the captain, after commending him, addressing himself to them all, said, “Comrades, we have no time to lose: let us set off well armed, but that we may not excite any suspicion, let only one or two go into the town together, and join at our rendezvous, which shall be the great square.
uz: Barcha qaroqchilar uni juda mamnuniyat bilan tinglashdi; va kapitan uni maqtatib, hammaga murojaat qilib dedi: O'rtoqlar, yo'qotadigan vaqtimiz yo'q: yaxshi qurollanib yo'lga chiqamiz, lekin hech qanday shubha uyg'otmaslik uchun, faqat bir-ikki kishi birga shaharga kirsin va uchrashuvimizga qo'shilsin, bu katta maydon bo'ladi.

en: In the mean time, our comrade who
uz: Ayni paytda, o'rtoqimiz...

en: brought us the good news and I will go and observe the house, that we may consult what had best be done.” This plan was approved by all, and they were soon ready.
uz: Bizga xushxabarni olib keldi va men borib uyni kuzataman, nima qilish kerakligini maslahatlashishimiz uchun. Bu reja hamma tomonidan ma'qullandi va ular tez orada tayyor bo'lishdi.

en: They filed off in parties of two each, and got into the town without being suspected.
uz: Ular har biri ikki kishilik partiyalarga bo'linib ketishdi va hech kimga gumon qilinmasdan shaharga kirishdi.

en: The captain and the robber who had visited the town in the morning as spy, came in last.
uz: Kapitan va ertalab shaharga josuslik qilgan qaroqchi oxirgi marta keldi.

en: He led the captain into the street where he had marked Ali Baba’s residence; and when they came to the first of the houses which Morgiana had marked, he pointed it out.
uz: U kapitanni Ali Babaning yashash joyini belgilagan ko'chaga olib kirdi; va ular Morgiana belgilagan birinchi uyga yetib borgach, u uni ko'rsatdi.

en: But the captain observed that the next door was chalked in the same manner, and in the same place; and showing it to his guide, asked him which house it was, that, or the first.
uz: Lekin kapitan qo'shni eshikning xuddi shu tarzda va xuddi shu joyda qoplanganini kuzatdi; va uni o'z yo'lboshchisiga ko'rsatib, u qaysi uy ekanligini, o'sha yoki birinchisini so'radi.

en: The guide was so confounded that he knew not what answer to make; and was still more puzzled, when he and the captain saw five or six houses similarly marked.
uz: Yo'lboshchi shunchalik hayratda ediki, qanday javob berishni bilmas edi; va u kapitan bilan birga beshta yoki oltita xuddi shunday belgilangan uyni ko'rganda, yanada hayratda edi.

en: He assured the captain, with an oath, that he had marked but one, and could not tell who had chalked the rest, so that he could not distinguish the house at which the cobbler had stopped.
uz: U kapitanni qasam ichib, faqat bittasini belgilaganini va qolganini kim chalganini aniqlay olmasligini ishontirdi, shuning uchun kulol to'xtatgan uyni ajrata olmadi.

en: The captain, finding that their plan had failed, went directly to the place of rendezvous, and told his troop that they had lost their labor, and must return to their cave.
uz: Kapitan ularning rejasi muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini anglab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uchrashuv joyiga bordi va o'z qo'shinlariga mehnatlarini yo'qotganliklarini va g'orlariga qaytishlari kerakligini aytdi.

en: He himself set the example, and they all returned as they had come.
uz: U o'zi namuna bo'ldi va ularning hammasi kelganidek qaytdilar.

en: When the troop was all got together, the captain told them the reason of their returning; whereupon the conductor was declared by all worthy of death.
uz: Qo'shinlarning hammasi yig'ilganda, kapitan ularning qaytib kelish sababini aytdi; shundan so'ng, dirijyor barcha tomonidan o'limga loyiq deb topildi.

en: He agreed, acknowledging that he ought to have taken better precaution, and willingly received the stroke from him who was appointed to cut off his head.
uz: U rozi bo'ldi, yaxshiroq ehtiyot chorasini ko'rishi kerak edi, deb tan oldi va boshini kesish uchun tayinlangan odamdan o'z xohishi bilan zarbani oldi.

en: But as the safety of the troop required the discovery of the second intruder into the cave, another of the gang presented himself, and his offer being accepted, he went to Baba Mustapha, as the first had done; and being shown the house, marked it in a place more remote from sight, with red chalk.
uz: Ammo qo'shin xavfsizligi g'orga ikkinchi bostirib kiruvchi odamni topishni talab qilgani sababli, guruhdan yana bir kishi o'zini ko'rsatdi va uning taklifi qabul qilinib, u avvalgidek Baba Mustafaga bordi; va uy ko'rsatilgach, uni ko'zdan uzoqroq joyga, qizil qayin bilan belgiladi.

en: Not long after, Morgiana, whose eyes nothing could escape, went out, and seeing the red chalk, and arguing with herself as she had
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, ko'zlaridan hech narsa qochib qutula olmaydigan Morgiana tashqariga chiqdi va qizil boldirni ko'rib, o'zi bilan shunday bahslashdi.

en: done before, marked the other neighbors’ houses in the same place and manner.
uz: Avvalroq qilingan, boshqa qo'shnilarning uylarini bir xil joyda va uslubda belgilab qo'yilgan.

en: The robber, on his return to his company, boasted of the precaution he had taken, which he looked upon as an infallible way of distinguishing Ali Baba’s house from the others; and the captain and all of them thought with him.
uz: O'g'ri o'z kompaniyasiga qaytib kelganida, o'zi qo'llagan ehtiyot chorasi bilan maqtanardi, uni Ali Babaning uyini boshqalardan ajratib turishning xatosiz usuli deb hisoblardi; kapitan va ularning barchasi u bilan birga fikrlashardi.

en: They entered the town with the same precaution as before; but when the robber and his captain came to the street, they were met by the same difficulty; at which the captain was enraged, and the robber in as great confusion as his predecessor.
uz: Ular shaharga avvalgidek ehtiyotkorlik bilan kirishdi; lekin o'g'ri va uning sardori ko'chaga kelganlarida, ularga xuddi shu qiyinchilik duch keldi; bundan kapitan g'azablanib, o'g'ri ham o'zidan oldingi kabi katta chalkashlikda edi.

en: Thus the captain and his troop were forced to retire a second time, and much more dissatisfied; while the robber who had been the author of the mistake underwent the same punishment, which he willingly submitted to.
uz: Shunday qilib, kapitan va uning qo'shini ikkinchi marta nafaqaga chiqishga majbur bo'lishdi va bundan ham ko'proq norozi bo'lishdi; xatosining muallifi bo'lgan o'g'ri esa xuddi shu jazoga duch keldi, unga u ixtiyoriy ravishda bo'ysundirdi.

en: The captain, having lost two brave fellows of his troop, was afraid of diminishing it too much by pursuing this plan to find the residence of their plunderer.
uz: Kapitan o'z qo'shinidan ikki jasur yigitini yo'qotganidan so'ng, o'g'rining qarorgohini topish uchun bu rejani amalga oshirish orqali uni juda ham kamaytirishdan qo'rqardi.

en: He therefore resolved to take upon himself the important commission.
uz: Shuning uchun u muhim topshiriqni o'z zimmasiga olishga qaror qildi.

en: Accordingly, he went to Baba Mustapha, who did him the same service he had done the other robbers.
uz: Shunga ko'ra, u Baba Mustafaga bordi, u unga boshqa qaroqchilar qilgan xizmatni qildi.

en: But the captain set no particular mark on the house, examining it instead so carefully that it was impossible for him to mistake it.
uz: Lekin kapitan uyga aniq belgi qo'ymadi, uni shunchalik diqqat bilan tekshirdiki, uni adashtirishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: Well satisfied with his attempt, and informed of what he wanted to know, he came to the cave, where the troop waited for him, and said, “Now, comrades, nothing can prevent our full revenge, as I am certain of the house; and I have thought how to put it into execution, but if any one can form a better expedient, let him communicate it.” He then told them his contrivance; and as they approved of it, ordered them to go into the villages about, and buy nineteen mules, with thirty-eight large leather jars, one full of oil, and the others empty.
uz: U o'z urinishidan mamnun bo'ldi va bilmoqchi bo'lganidan xabardor bo'ldi. U g'orga keldi, u yerda uni qo'shin kutdi va dedi: Endi, o'rtoqlar, bizning to'liq qasosimizdan hech narsa to'sqinlik qila olmaydi, chunki men uyni aniq bilaman; va uni qanday amalga oshirishni o'ylab ko'rdim, lekin agar kimdir undan yaxshiroq usulni yaratsa, u buni yetkazsin. Keyin u ularga o'z hiylasini aytdi; va ular buni ma'qullaganlarida, ularni qishloqlarga borib, o'n to'qqizta mulakni sotib olishga buyurdi, ularda o'ttiz sakkiz katta charm idish bor edi, biri yog' bilan to'la edi va qolganlari ham.

en: In two or three days’ time the robbers had purchased the mules and jars, and as the mouths of the jars were rather too narrow for
uz: Ikki-uch kun ichida o'g'rilar mullar va bankalarni sotib olishdi, va bankalarning og'zlari ancha tor bo'lgani uchun...

en: his purpose, the captain caused them to be widened, and after having put one of his men into each, with the weapons which he thought fit, leaving open the seam which had been undone to give them room to breathe, he rubbed the jars on the outside with oil from the full vessel.
uz: Uning maqsadi, kapitan ularning kengayishiga sabab bo'ldi va har biriga o'z odamlaridan birini, o'zi mos deb hisoblagan qurollarni joylashtirgandan so'ng, nafas olish uchun joy ajratish uchun yechilgan chokni ochib qo'yib, tashqaridagi idishlarni to'la idishdan yog' bilan ishqaladi.

en: Things being thus prepared, when the nineteen mules were loaded with thirty-seven robbers in jars, and the jar of oil, the captain, as their driver, set out with them, and reached the town by the dusk of the evening, as he had intended.
uz: Shunday qilib, tayyorgarlik ko'rilgach, o'n to'qqizta o'g'ri o'ttiz yetti qozi bilan idishga yuklanganida va yog' idishi bo'lganida, kapitan ularning haydovchisi sifatida ular bilan jo'nab, kechqurunning oqshomida shaharga yetib bordi, o'zi niyat qilganidek.

en: He led them through the streets, till he came to Ali Baba’s house whom he found sitting at the door after supper to take a little fresh air.
uz: U ularni ko'chalar bo'ylab yetakladi, toki Ali Babaning uyiga keldi. U kechki ovqatdan keyin biroz toza havo olish uchun eshik oldida o'tirganini topdi.

en: He stopped his mules, saying, “I have brought some oil a great way, to sell at to-morrow’s market; and it is now so late that I do not know where to lodge.
uz: U o'z o'g'illarini to'xtatib dedi: Men ertaga bozorda sotish uchun ajoyib yog' olib keldim; endi esa qayerda tunashni bilmayman, juda kech bo'ldi.

en: If I should not be troublesome to you, do me the favor to let me pass the night with you, and I shall be very much obliged for your hospitality.” Though Ali Baba had seen the captain of the robbers in the forest, and had heard him speak, it was impossible to know him in the disguise of an oil merchant.
uz: Agar men sizga noqulaylik tug'dirmasam, iltimos, tunni siz bilan o'tkazishga ruxsat bering, va men sizning mehmondo'stligingiz uchun juda minnatdor bo'laman. Ali Baba o'rmonda qaroqchilar sardorini ko'rgan bo'lsa ham va uning gapirganini eshitgan bo'lsa ham, uni neft savdogari qiyofasida tanishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: He told him he was welcome, and immediately opened his gates for the mules to go into the yard.
uz: U unga xush kelibsiz dedi va darhol hovliga kirishi uchun darvozalarini ochdi.

en: At the same time he called to a slave, and ordered him, when the mules were unloaded, to put them into the stable, and to feed them; and then went to Morgiana, to bid her get a supper for his guest.
uz: Shu bilan birga u bir qulni chaqirib, g'o'lalar tushirilganda, ularni o'txonaga joylashtirishni va ularga ovqat berishni buyurdi; so'ngra Morgiana huzuriga borib, unga mehmon uchun kechki ovqat taklif qildi.

en: After they had finished supper, Ali Baba, charging Morgiana afresh to take care of his guest, said to her, “To-morrow morning I am going to the bath before day; take care my bathing linen be ready, give it to Abdalla (which was the slave’s name), and make me some good broth against I return.” After this he went to bed.
uz: Ular kechki ovqatni tugatgandan so'ng, Ali Baba Morgianaga mehmonini g'amxo'rlik qilishni buyurdi va unga dedi: Ertaga ertalab ertalab ertalab hammomga boraman; cho'milish choyshabimni tayyorlang, Abdallaga bering (bu qulning ismi edi), va qaytishimga qarshi menga yaxshi bulyon tayyorlang. Shundan so'ng u yotishga kirdi.

en: In the mean time the captain of the robbers went into the yard, lifted the lid of each jar, and gave his men orders what to do.
uz: Ayni paytda qaroqchilar sardori hovliga kirib, har bir banka qopqog'ini ko'tardi va o'z odamlariga nima qilish kerakligini buyurdi.

en: Beginning at the first jar, and so on to the last, he said to each man: “As soon as I throw some stones out of my chamber window, do not fail to come out, and I will immediately join you.” After this he returned to the house, when Morgiana, taking up a light, conducted
uz: Birinchi idishdan boshlab, oxirgisigacha, u har bir kishiga dedi: Men xonam oynasidan tosh otishim bilanoq, tashqariga chiqinglar, men darhol sizga qoshilaman. Shundan song u uyga qaytib keldi, Morgiana chiroqni kotarib,

en: him to his chamber, where she left him; and he, to avoid any suspicion, put the light out soon after, and laid himself down in his clothes, that he might be the more ready to rise.
uz: Uni o'z xonasiga olib bordi, u yerda uni tashlab ketgan edi; va u, hech qanday shubha bo'lmasligi uchun, tez orada chiroqni o'chirdi va o'zining kiyimlariga yotdi, toki u ko'proq turishga tayyor bo'lsin.

en: Morgiana, remembering Ali Baba’s orders, got his bathing linen ready, and ordered Abdalla to set on the pot for the broth; but while she was preparing it the lamp went out, and there was no more oil in the house, nor any candles.
uz: Morgiana Ali Babaning buyrug'ini eslab, cho'milish zig'irini tayyorladi va Abdallaga bulyon uchun idishga o'rnatishni buyurdi; lekin uni tayyorlayotganida chiroq o'chdi va uyda na yog', na sham qolmadi.

en: What to do she did not know, for the broth must be made.
uz: U nima qilishni bilmas edi, chunki bulyon tayyorlanishi kerak edi.

en: Abdalla, seeing her very uneasy, said, “Do not fret yourself, but go into the yard, and take some oil out of one of the jars.” Morgiana thanked Abdalla for his advice, took the oil-pot, and went into the yard; when she came nigh the first jar, the robber within said softly, “Is it time?” Though naturally much surprised at finding a man in the jar instead of the oil she wanted, she immediately felt the importance of keeping silence, feeling sure that Ali Baba, his family, and herself were in great danger.
uz: Abdalla, uning juda xavotirda ekanligini ko'rib, dedi: O'zingni tashvishlantirma, lekin hovliga kir, va idishlardan biridan yog' ol. Morgiana Abdallaga maslahat uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi, yog' idishini oldi va hovliga kirdi; birinchi idishga yaqinlashganda, ichidagi qaroqchi sekinlik bilan dedi: Vaqtmi? Tabiiyki, u xohlagan yog' o'rniga idishdagi odamni topganidan juda hayratda bo'lsa-da, u darhol jim bo'lish muhimligini his qildi, Ali Baba, uning oilasi va o'zi katta xavf ostida ekanligiga amin edi.

en: Collecting herself, without showing the least emotion, she answered, “Not yet, but presently.” She went quietly in this manner to all the jars, giving the same answer, till she came to the jar of oil.
uz: O'zini yig'ishtirib, hech qanday hissiyot ko'rsatmasdan, u javob berdi: Endi emas, lekin hozircha. U shu tarzda barcha bankalarga bordi va xuddi shu javobni berdi, toki yog' bankaga kelguncha.

en: By this means Morgiana found that her master Ali Baba had admitted thirty-eight robbers into his house, and that the pretended oil merchant was their captain.
uz: Shu yoʻl bilan Morgina oʻz xoʻjayini Ali Babaning uyiga oʻttiz sakkizta qaroqchini kiritganini va soxta neft sotuvchisi ularning sardori ekanligini aniqladi.

en: She made what haste she could to fill her oil-pot, and returned into her kitchen, where as soon as she had lighted her lamp, she took a great kettle, went again to the oil-jar, filled the kettle, set it on a large wood fire and as soon as it boiled, went and poured enough of the boiling oil into every jar to destroy the robber within.
uz: U iloji boricha shoshilmay moy idishini to'ldirdi va oshxonasiga qaytdi. U yerda chiroqini yoqishi bilanoq, katta choynak oldi, yana moy idishiga bordi, choynakni to'ldirdi, katta yog'och olovga qo'ydi va qaynashi bilanoq, har bir idishga qaynoq yog'ni quyib, ichidagi qaroqchini yo'q qildi.

en: When this action, worthy of the courage of Morgiana, was executed, she returned into the kitchen with the empty kettle; and having put out the great fire she had made to boil the oil, and leaving just enough to make the broth, put out the lamp also, and remained silent, resolving not to go to rest till she had observed
uz: Morgiananing jasoratiga loyiq bo'lgan bu harakat amalga oshgach, u bo'sh choynak bilan oshxonaga qaytdi; va moy qaynatish uchun tayyorlagan katta olovni o'chirdi, va bulyon tayyorlash uchun yetarli miqdorda qolganidan so'ng, chiroqni ham o'chirdi va sukut saqladi, dam olishga bormaslikka qaror qildi, toki u...

en: what might follow through a window of the kitchen, which opened into the yard.
uz: Oshxonaning derazasidan nima o'tib ketishi mumkin edi, u hovliga ochildi.

en: She had not waited long before the captain of the robbers got up, opened the window, and finding no light, and hearing no noise, or any one stirring in the house, gave the appointed signal, by throwing little stones, several of which hit the jars, as he could tell by the sound they gave.
uz: U ko'p kutmadi, qaroqchilar sardori o'rnidan turdi, derazani ochdi va hech qanday yorug'lik topmadi, uyda hech qanday shovqin yoki hech kim aralashayotganini eshitmadi, belgilangan signalni berdi, kichik toshlarni uloqtirdi, ularning bir nechtasi idishlarga urildi, buni ularning ovoziga qarab sezdi.

en: He listened, but not hearing or perceiving anything whereby he could judge that his companions stirred, he began to grow uneasy, threw stones a second and also a third time, and could not understand why none of them answered his signal.
uz: U tingladi, lekin o'z hamrohlari qo'zg'alganini baholash uchun hech narsa eshitmadi yoki sezmadi, u xavotirlana boshladi, ikkinchi va uchinchi marta tosh otdi va ularning hech biri uning signalini nega javob bermasligini tushunmadi.

en: Much alarmed, he went softly down into the yard, and going to the first jar smelt the hot boiled oil, which sent forth a steam out of the jar.
uz: Juda vahimaga tushib, u sekin hovliga tushdi va birinchi bankaga borib, qaynoq qaynatilgan yog'ni eritdi, bu esa banka bug'ini chiqardi.

en: Examining all the jars, one after another, he found that all his gang was dead; and, enraged to despair at having failed in his design, he forced the lock of a door that led from the yard to the garden, and climbing over the walls made his escape.
uz: Barcha bankalarni birin-ketin tekshirib, u butun guruhining o'lik ekanligini aniqladi; va o'z loyihasida muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganidan umidsizlikka tushgach, u hovlidan bog'ga olib boradigan eshik qulfini majburladi va devorlardan oshib qochdi.

en: When Morgiana saw him depart, she went to bed, pleased to have succeeded so well in saving her master and family.
uz: Morgiana uni ketayotganini ko'rgach, xo'jayini va oilasini qutqarishda shunchalik muvaffaqiyatga erishganidan xursand bo'lib, uxlashga ketdi.

en: “I am sorry not to have been able to finish the story of Ali Baba,” Scheherazade interrupted herself to say at this moment, “but you perceive, my lord, that day has come.” “We must then wait until the coming night for the remainder,” the sultan replied, and smiling at his wife, he departed.
uz: Ali Babaning hikoyasini tugatolmaganimdan afsusdaman,  Sheherazad shu paytda ozini toxtatib dedi,  lekin sezyapsan, hazratim, osha kun keldi.  Keyin qolganini kechagacha kutishimiz kerak,  dedi sulton va xotiniga qarab kulib, ketdi.

en: She, therefore, began again as follows, once the time had come: When Ali Baba returned from the baths, he was very much surprised to see the oil-jars, and that the merchant was not gone with the mules.
uz: Shunday qilib, u yana shunday boshladi, vaqti kelgach: Ali Baba vannalardan qaytib kelganida, moy idishlarini ko'rib juda hayron bo'ldi va savdogar mullar bilan birga ketmagan edi.

en: He asked Morgiana, who opened the door, the reason of it.
uz: U eshikni ochgan Morgianadan buning sababini so'radi.

en: “My good master,” answered she, “God preserve you and all your family.
uz: Yaxshi xo'jayinim,  javob berdi u,  Xudo seni va butun oilangni asrasin.

en: You will be better informed of what you wish to know when you have seen what I have to show you, if you will follow me.”
uz: Agar menga ergashsangiz, men sizga ko'rsatadigan narsalarni ko'rganingizdan so'ng, bilmoqchi bo'lganlaringiz haqida yaxshiroq xabardor bo'lasiz.

en: As soon as Morgiana had shut the door, Ali Baba followed her, when she requested him to look into the first jar, and Ali Baba Examined All the Jars see if there was any oil.
uz: Morgiana eshikni yopishi bilanoq, Ali Baba uning orqasidan ergashdi, u undan birinchi bankaga qarashni so'radi va Ali Baba barcha bankalarni tekshirib, neft bor-yo'qligini ko'rdi.

en: Ali Baba did so, and seeing a man, started back in alarm, and cried out.
uz: Ali Baba shunday qildi va bir odamni ko'rib, xavotirda qaytdi va baqirdi.

en: “Do not be afraid,” said Morgiana, “the man you see there can neither do you nor anybody else any harm.
uz: Qo'rqma,  dedi Morgiana,  u yerda ko'rayotgan odam na senga, na boshqa hech kimga zarar yetkazolmaydi.

en: He is dead.” “Ah, Morgiana,” said Ali Baba, “what is it you show me?
uz: U o'ldi.  Oh, Morgiana,  dedi Ali Baba,  menga nimani ko'rsatyapsan?

en: Explain yourself.” “I will,” replied Morgiana.
uz: O'zingni tushuntir. Men qilaman,  javob berdi Morgiana.

en: “Moderate your astonishment, and do not excite the curiosity of your neighbors; for it is of great importance to keep this affair secret.
uz: Hayratingizni tiying va qo'shningizning qiziquvchanligini qo'zg'atmang; chunki bu ishni sir saqlash juda muhim.

en: Look into all the other jars.” Ali Baba examined all the other jars, one after another; and when he came to that which had the oil in, found it prodigiously sunk, and stood for some time motionless, sometimes looking at the jars, and sometimes at Morgiana, without saying a word, so great was his surprise.
uz: Boshqa barcha bankalarni birma-bir ko'zdan kechirdi. Ali Baba boshqa barcha bankalarni birma-bir ko'zdan kechirdi; va yog'i bor joyga yetib borgach, u dahshatli darajada cho'kib ketganini ko'rdi va bir oz vaqt davomida harakatsiz turdi, ba'zan bankalarga qaradi, ba'zan esa Morgianaga, bir so'z demasdan, uning hayrati juda katta edi.

en: At last, when he had recovered himself, he said, “And what is become of the merchant?”
uz: Nihoyat, o'zini tiklaganidan so'ng, u dedi: Va savdogarning ahvoli nima bo'ldi?

en: “Merchant!” answered she; “he is as much one as I am.
uz: Savdogar!  javob berdi u;  u ham men kabi.

en: I will tell you who he is, and what is become of him; but you would better hear the story in your own chamber; for it is time for your health that you had your broth after your bathing.” Morgiana then told him all she had done, after first observing the mark upon the house, to the destruction of the robbers, and the flight of their captain.
