uz: Men senga uning kimligini va undan nima bo'lganini aytaman; lekin bu hikoyani o'z xonangda eshitishing yaxshiroq; chunki cho'milgandan keyin bulyoning bo'lishi sog'lig'ing uchun vaqt keldi. Morgiana unga uydagi belgiga birinchi bo'lib rioya qilganidan so'ng, qaroqchilarning halok bo'lishi va ularning sardorining qochishigacha qilgan barcha ishlarini aytdi.

en: On hearing of these brave deeds from the lips of Morgiana, Ali Baba said to her—“God, by your means, has delivered me from the snares these robbers laid for my destruction.
uz: Ali Baba Morgiana og'zidan bu jasoratli ishlarni eshitib, unga dedi: Xudo, sen orqali, meni bu qaroqchilar meni yo'q qilish uchun qo'ygan tuzoqlardan qutqardi.

en: I owe, therefore, my life to you; and, for the first token of my acknowledgment, give you your liberty from this moment, till I can complete your recompense as I intend.” Ali Baba’s garden was long, and shaded at the further end by large trees.
uz: Shunday qilib, men hayotimdan sizdan qarzdorman; va, tan olishimning birinchi belgisi sifatida, sizga shu lahzadan ozodligingizni beraman, toki men o'zim xohlaganimdek to'lovingizni bajara olgunimcha. Ali Babaning bog'i uzun edi va uzoqroq qismida katta daraxtlar soyabon edi.

en: Near these he and the slave Abdalla dug a trench, long and wide enough to hold the bodies of the robbers; and as the earth was light, they were not long in doing it.
uz: Bularning yaqinida u va qul Abdalla qaroqchilarning jasadlarini ushlab turish uchun yetarlicha uzun va keng bo'lgan xandaq qazishdi; va yer yengil bo'lgani uchun, bu ishni uzoq vaqt qilmadilar.

en: When this was done, Ali Baba buried the dead men, hid the jars and weapons and as he had no occasion for the mules, sent them at different times to be sold in the market by his slave.
uz: Bu ish tugagandan so'ng, Ali Baba o'lik odamlarni ko'mib tashladi, bankalar va qurollarni yashirdi va mullarga hech qanday imkoniyat bo'lmagani sababli, ularni turli vaqtlarda qullari tomonidan bozorda sotish uchun jo'natdi.

en: While Ali Baba took these measures, the captain of the forty robbers returned to the forest with inconceivable mortification.
uz: Ali Baba bu choralarni ko'rganda, qirq qaroqchining sardori o'rmonga tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydigan o'ldirish bilan qaytdi.

en: He did not stay long; the loneliness of the gloomy cavern became frightful to him.
uz: U uzoq qolmadi; xira g'orning yolg'izligi unga dahshat bo'lib qoldi.

en: He determined, however, to avenge the fate of his companions, and to accomplish the death of Ali Baba.
uz: Ammo u o'z hamrohlarining taqdirini qasos olishga va Ali Babaning o'limiga erishishga qaror qildi.

en: For this purpose he returned to the town, took a lodging in a khan, and disguised himself as a merchant in silks.
uz: Shu maqsadda u shaharga qaytib keldi, xonda turar joy oldi va o'zini ipak savdogari qiyofasida ko'rsatdi.

en: Under this assumed character, he gradually conveyed a great many sorts of rich stuffs and fine linen to his lodging from the cavern.
uz: Shu taxminiy xarakter ostida u asta-sekin g'ordan o'z turar joyiga juda ko'p xil boy narsalar va nozik zig'ir matolarni olib kirdi.

en: In order to dispose of the merchandise, when he had thus amassed it together, he took a warehouse, which happened to be opposite Cassim’s counting- house, which Ali Baba’s son had occupied since the death of his uncle.
uz: Tovarlarni tashlab yuborish uchun, uni yig'ib bo'lgandan so'ng, u bir omborni oldi, u Kassimning hisob-kitob uyi ro'parasida joylashgan edi, uni Ali Babaning o'g'li amakisi vafotidan beri egallab kelgan edi.

en: He took the name of Cogia Houssain, and as a new-comer was, according to custom, extremely civil and complaisant to all the merchants his neighbors.
uz: U Cogia Houssain nomini oldi va yangi kelgan odam sifatida odatga ko'ra, o'ta xushmuomala va qo'shnilarining barcha savdogarlariga xushmuomala edi.

en: Ali Baba’s son was one of the first to converse with Cogia Houssain, who strove to cultivate his friendship more particularly.
uz: Ali Babaning o'g'li Cogia Houssain bilan birinchilardan bo'lib suhbatlashdi, u o'z do'stligini yanada rivojlantirishga intildi.

en: Two or three days after the false merchant was settled, Ali Baba came to see his son, and the captain of the robbers recognized him at once, and soon learned who he was.
uz: Soxta savdogar joylashtirilgandan ikki-uch kun o'tgach, Ali Baba o'g'lini ko'rishga keldi va qaroqchilar sardori uni darhol tanib oldi va tez orada uning kimligini bilib oldi.

en: After this he increased his assiduities toward the son, made him some small presents, and often asked him to dine and sup with him, when he treated him very handsomely.
uz: Shundan so'ng u o'g'liga nisbatan qat'iyatni kuchaytirdi, unga kichik sovg'alar tayyorladi va ko'pincha u bilan birga ovqatlanish va kechki ovqatni taklif qilardi, u esa unga juda mehribonlik bilan munosabatda bo'lardi.

en: Ali Baba’s son did not choose to lie under such obligation to Cogia Houssain; but for want of room in his house, he could not entertain him there.
uz: Ali Babaning o'g'li Kogia Husseenning bunday majburiyati ostida yotishni tanlamadi; lekin uyida joy yo'qligi sababli, uni u yerda ko'rtara olmadi.

en: He therefore acquainted his father, Ali Baba, with his wish to return the newcomer’s civilities.
uz: Shuning uchun u otasi Ali Babani yangi kelgan odamning fuqaroligini qaytarish istagi bilan tanishtirdi.

en: Ali Baba with great pleasure took the treat upon himself.
uz: Ali Baba katta xursandchilik bilan shirinlikni o'ziga oldi.

en: “Son,” said he, “to-morrow being Friday, which is a day that the shops of such great merchants as Cogia Houssain and yourself are shut, get him to accompany you hither.
uz: O'g'lim,  dedi u,  ertaga juma kuni bo'ladi, bu kuni Cogia Houssain va o'zingiz kabi buyuk savdogarlarning do'konlari yopiq bo'ladi, uni bu yerga sizga hamroh qilib kelishga majbur qiling.

en: I will order Morgiana to provide a supper.” The next day Ali Baba’s son and Cogia Houssain met by appointment, took their walk, and as they returned Ali Baba’s son led Cogia Houssain through the street where his father lived, and when they came to the house, stopped and knocked at the door.
uz: Men Morgianaga kechki ovqat berishni buyuraman. Ertasi kuni Ali Babaning o'g'li va Cogia Houssain uchrashuvda uchrashdilar, sayr qilishdi va Ali Babaning o'g'li otasi yashaydigan ko'chadan Cogia Houssainni olib borar ekanlar, uyga kelgach, to'xtashdi va eshikni taqillatishdi.

en: “This, sir,” said he, “is my father’s house, who, from the account I have given him of your friendship, charged me to procure him the honor of your acquaintance; and I desire you to add this pleasure to those for which I am already indebted to you.” Though it was the sole aim of Cogia Houssain to introduce himself into Ali Baba’s house, that he might kill him without hazarding his own life, yet he excused himself, and offered to take his leave; but a slave having opened the door, Ali Baba’s son took him by the hand, and politely forced him in.
uz: Bu, janob,  dedi u,  otamning uyi, men unga dostligingiz haqida bergan hisobotdan kelib chiqib, menga uning tanishuvi sharafini taminlashni buyurdi; va men sizdan bu lazzatni sizga allaqachon qarzdor bolganlarga qoshishni xohlayman. Garchi Cogia Houssainning yagona maqsadi Ali Babaning uyiga ozini tanishtirish, uni oz hayotiga xavf solmasdan oldirish bolsa ham, u ozini oqladi va ruxsat berishni taklif qildi; lekin bir qul eshikni ochgach, Ali Babaning ogli uni qolidan ushladi va odob bilan majburladi.

en: Ali Baba received Cogia Houssain with a smiling countenance, and in the most obliging manner he could wish.
uz: Ali Baba Cogia Houssainni tabassum bilan qabul qildi va u eng hurmatli tarzda xohlashi mumkin edi.

en: He thanked him for all the favors he had done his son; adding withal, the obligation was the greater as he was a young man, not much acquainted with the world.
uz: U o'g'liga qilgan barcha yaxshiliklari uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirdi; qo'shimcha qilib aytganda, majburiyat undan ham kattaroq edi, chunki u yosh yigit edi, dunyo bilan unchalik tanish emas edi.

en: Cogia Houssain returned the compliment by assuring Ali Baba, that though his son might not have acquired the experience of older men, he had good sense equal to the experience of many others.
uz: Cogia Houssain Ali Babani o'g'li katta erkaklar tajribasiga ega bo'lmasligi mumkin edi, lekin u ko'pchilikning tajribasiga teng aql-idrokka ega edi, deb ishontirib, maqtovga javob berdi.

en: After a little more conversation on different subjects, he offered again to take his leave, when Ali Baba, stopping him, said, “Where are you going, sir, in so much haste?
uz: Turli mavzularda yana biroz suhbatlashgandan so'ng, u yana ta'til berishni taklif qildi, Ali Baba uni to'xtatib, dedi: Qayerga ketyapsiz, janob, bunchalik shoshilmayapsizmi?

en: I beg you do me the honor to sup with me, though my entertainment may not be worthy of your acceptance; such as it is, I heartily offer it.” “Sir,” replied Cogia Houssain, “I am thoroughly persuaded of your good-will; but the truth is, I can eat no victuals that have any salt in them; therefore judge how I should feel at your table.” “If that is the only reason,” said Ali Baba, “it ought not to deprive me of the honor of your company; for, in the first place, there is no salt ever put into my bread, and as to the meat we shall have to-night, I promise you there shall be none in that.
uz: Sizdan men bilan birga ovqatlanish sharafini so'rayman, garchi mening ko'ngilxushligim sizning qabulingizga loyiq bo'lmasa ham; shunday bo'lsa ham, men uni chin dildan taklif qilaman.  Janob,  javob berdi Cogia Houssain, Men sizning yaxshi niyatingizga to'liq ishonaman; lekin haqiqat shuki, men hech qanday tuzli taom yeyolmayman; shuning uchun sizning dasturxonangizda qanday his qilishim kerakligini o'ylab ko'ring. Agar bu yagona sabab bo'lsa,  dedi Ali Baba,  meni sizning kompaniyangiz sharafidan mahrum qilmaslik kerak; chunki, avvalo, mening nonimga hech qanday tuz solinmaydi, va kechasi yeyishga tayyor bo'ladigan go'shtga kelsak, sizga va'da beraman, unda hech qanday tuz bo'lmaydi.

en: Therefore you must do me the favor to stay.
uz: Shunday ekan, menga qolish uchun yordam berishingiz kerak.

en: I will return immediately.” Ali Baba went into the kitchen, and ordered Morgiana to put no salt to the meat that was to be cooked that night; and to make quickly two or three dishes besides what he had ordered, but to be sure to put no salt in them.
uz: Men darhol qaytib kelaman. Ali Baba oshxonaga kirdi va Morgianaga o'sha kechasi pishiriladigan go'shtga tuz solmaslikni buyurdi; va buyurganidan tashqari tezda ikki-uchta taom tayyorlashni buyurdi, lekin ularga tuz solmaslikni ta'minladi.

en: Morgiana, who was always ready to obey her master, could not help being surprised at his order.
uz: Doimo xo'jayinining buyrug'iga bo'ysunishga tayyor bo'lgan Morgiana uning buyrug'iga hayron bo'lishdan o'zini tiya olmadi.

en: “Who is this man,” said she, “who eats no salt with his meat?
uz: Bu odam kim,  dedi u,  go'shti bilan tuz yemaydigan odam?

en: Your supper will be spoiled, if I keep it back so long.” “Do not be angry, Morgiana,” replied Ali Baba; “he is an honest man, therefore do as I bid you.” Morgiana obeyed, though with no little reluctance, and had a curiosity to see this man who ate no salt.
uz: Kechki ovqatingiz buziladi, agar men uni bunchalik uzoq ushlab tursam. G'azablanma, Morgiana,  javob berdi Ali Baba; u halol odam, shuning uchun senga aytganimni qil. Morgiana hech qanday ikkilanishsiz bo'lsa ham, itoat qildi va tuz yemaydigan bu odamni ko'rishga qiziqdi.

en: To this end, when she had finished what she had to do in the kitchen, she helped Abdalla to carry up the dishes; and looking at Cogia Houssain, knew him at first
uz: Shu maqsadda, oshxonada qiladigan ishlarini tugatgach, u Abdallaga idishlarni ko'tarishga yordam berdi; va Cogia Houssainga qarab, uni dastlab tanidi.

en: sight, notwithstanding his disguise, to be the captain of the robbers, and examining him very carefully, perceived that he had a dagger under his garment.
uz: Qaroqchilar sardori bo'lishga qaramay, uni juda diqqat bilan tekshirib, kiyimining ostida pichoq borligini angladi.

en: “I am not in the least amazed,” said she to herself, “that this wicked man, who is my master’s greatest enemy, would eat no salt with him, since he intends to assassinate him; but I will see as to that!” Morgiana, while they were at supper, determined to Morgiana danced with much grace
uz: Men hech qanday hayron emasman,  dedi u oziga ozi,  bu yovuz odam, xojayinimning eng katta dushmani, uni oldirishni niyat qilgani uchun, u bilan tuz yemaydi; lekin men bunga etibor beraman! Morgiana, ular kechki ovqatda bolganlarida, Morgianaga juda mehribonlik bilan raqsga tushishga qaror qildi.

en: execute one of the boldest acts ever meditated.
uz: Meditatsiya qilingan eng jasur harakatlardan birini amalga oshiring.

en: When Abdalla came for the dessert of fruit, and had put it with the wine and glasses before Ali Baba, Morgiana retired, dressed herself beautifully, with a suitable head-dress like a dancer, girded her waist with a silver-gilt girdle, to which there hung a poniard with a hilt and guard of the same metal, and put a handsome mask on her face.
uz: Abdalla meva desertga kelganida va uni Ali Babadan oldin vino va stakanlar bilan birga qo'yganida, Morgiana nafaqaga chiqdi, chiroyli kiyindi, raqqosaga o'xshagan mos bosh kiyim bilan, beliga kumush-guldon kamar taqdi, unga xuddi shu metalldan yasalgan tutqich va qo'riqlovchi poniard osilib turardi va yuziga chiroyli niqob qo'ydi.

en: When she had thus disguised herself, she said to Abdalla, “Take your tabor, and let
uz: U o'zini shunday niqoblaganidan so'ng, u Abdallaga dedi: Tabaringni ol va

en: us go and divert our master and his son’s friend, as we do sometimes when he is alone.” Abdalla took his tabor and played all the way into the hall before Morgiana, who, when she came to the door, made a low obeisance by way of asking leave to exhibit her skill, while Abdalla left off playing.
uz: Biz borib, xo'jayinimiz va uning o'g'lining do'stini chalg'itamiz, xuddi u yolg'iz bo'lganda ba'zan qilganimizdek. Abdalla o'z taboriga ega bo'ldi va Morgiana eshik oldiga kelganda, o'z mahoratini namoyish etish uchun ruxsat so'rab past taslim bo'ldi, Abdalla esa o'ynashni to'xtatdi.

en: “Come in, Morgiana,” said Ali Baba, “and let Cogia Houssain see what you can do, that he may tell us what he thinks of your performance.” Cogia Houssain, who did not expect this diversion after supper, began to fear he would not to be able to take advantage of the opportunity he had found; but hoped, if he now missed his aim, to secure it another time, by keeping up a friendly correspondence with the father and son; therefore, though he could have wished Ali Baba would have declined the dance, he pretended to be obliged to him for it, and had the tact to express his satisfaction at what he saw, which pleased his host.
uz: Kiring, Morgiana, dedi Ali Baba, va Cogia Houssain sizning chiqishingiz haqida nima qila olishingizni ko'rsin, shunda u bizga sizning chiqishingiz haqida nima deb o'ylashini aytishi mumkin. Kechki ovqatdan keyin bu chalg'itishni kutmagan Cogia Houssain, topgan imkoniyatidan foydalana olmasligidan qo'rqishni boshladi; lekin umid qildi, agar u endi maqsadidan qochsa, otasi va o'g'li bilan do'stona aloqani saqlab, uni yana bir bor ta'minlaydi; shuning uchun, u Ali Babaning raqsdan bosh tortishini xohlagan bo'lsa ham, u bunga majbur bo'lganini va mehmonini xursand qilganidan mamnunligini bildirish taktiga ega edi.

en: As soon as Abdalla saw that Ali Baba and Cogia Houssain had done talking, he began to play on the tabor, and to sing an air, to which Morgiana, who was an excellent performer, danced in such a manner as would have created admiration in any company.
uz: Abdalla Ali Baba va Cogia Houssain gapirishni tugatganini ko'rishi bilanoq, u taborda chalishni boshladi va ajoyib ijrochi bo'lgan Morgiana har qanday kompaniyada hayrat uyg'otadigan tarzda raqsga tushadigan havoni kuylay boshladi.

en: After she had danced several dances with much grace, she drew the poniard, and holding it in her hand, began to dance, in which she outdid herself.
uz: U bir necha raqsga juda nafis tushgandan so'ng, poniardni tortdi va uni qo'lida ushlab, raqsga tushdi, unda o'zini o'zib ketdi.

en: Sometimes she figured to strike at one of the company, sometimes at another, and oftentimes at herself.
uz: Ba'zan u kompaniyaning bir a'zosiga, ba'zan boshqa a'zosiga va ko'pincha o'ziga zarba berishni o'ylardi.

en: At last, she snatched the tabor from Abdalla with her left hand and holding the dagger in her right presented the reverse side of the tabor, after the manner of those who get a livelihood by dancing, and solicit the liberality of the spectators.
uz: Nihoyat, u chap qo'li bilan Abdallaning taborini tortib oldi va o'ng qo'lida xanjarni ushlab, raqsga tushib tirikchilik qiladiganlarning uslubida taborning orqa tomonini ko'rsatdi va tomoshabinlarning erkinligini so'radi.

en: Ali Baba put a piece of gold into the tabor, as did also his son; and Cogia Houssain seeing that she was coming to him, pulled his purse out of his bosom to make her a present; but while he was doing this, Morgiana, with a courage and resolution worthy of herself, plunged the poniard into his heart.
uz: Ali Baba bir bo'lak oltinni taborga qo'ydi, o'g'li ham shunday qildi; va Cogia Houssain uning oldiga kelayotganini ko'rib, unga sovg'a qilish uchun hamyonini ko'kragidan chiqarib oldi; lekin u buni qilayotganda, Morgiana o'ziga munosib jasorat va qat'iyat bilan poniardni uning yuragiga botirdi.

en: Ali Baba and his son, shocked at this action, cried out aloud.
uz: Ali Baba va uning o'g'li bu harakatdan hayratda qolishib, baland ovozda baqirishdi.

en: “Unhappy woman!” exclaimed Ali Baba, “what have you done to ruin me and my family?” “It was to preserve, not to ruin you,” answered Morgiana; “for see here,” continued she, opening the pretended Cogia Houssain’s garment, and showing the dagger, “what an enemy you had entertained?
uz: Baxtsiz ayol! deb baqirdi Ali Bobo, Meni va oilamni vayron qilish uchun nima qilding? Bu seni vayron qilish uchun emas, balki seni saqlab qolish uchun edi, javob berdi Morgiana; Mana koraylik, dedi u, soxta Cogia Houssainning kiyimini ochib, xanjarni korsatib, siz qanday dushmanni ozlashtirgan edingiz?

en: Look well at him, and you will find him to be both the fictitious oil merchant, and the captain of the gang of forty robbers.
uz: Unga yaxshilab nazar soling, shunda uni ham xayoliy neft savdogari, ham qirq qaroqchi guruhi sardori ekanligini aniqlaysiz.

en: Remember, too, that he would eat no salt with you; and what do you need more to convince you of his wicked design?
uz: Shuni ham yodda tutingki, u siz bilan tuz yemaydi; va uning yovuz rejasiga sizni ishontirish uchun sizga bundan ko'ra nima kerak?

en: I suspected him as soon as you told me you had such a guest.
uz: Siz menga bunday mehmoningiz borligini aytganingiz zahoti undan gumon qildim.

en: You now find that my suspicion was not groundless.” Ali Baba, who immediately felt the new obligation he had to Morgiana for saving his life a second time, embraced her.
uz: Endi mening shubham asossiz emasligini angladingiz. Ali Baba, Morgianaga o'z hayotini ikkinchi marta saqlab qolgani uchun unga bo'lgan yangi majburiyatni darhol his qilib, uni quchoqladi.

en: “Morgiana,” said he, “I gave you your liberty and then promised you that my gratitude should not stop there, but that I would soon give you higher proofs of its sincerity, which I now do by making you my daughter-in-law.” Then addressing himself to his son, he said, “I believe you, son, to be so dutiful a child, that you will not refuse Morgiana for your wife.
uz: Mortiana, dedi u, Men senga erkinligingni berdim va keyin senga minnatdorchiligim shu bilan toxtab qolmasligiga vada berdim, balki tez orada uning samimiyatidan yuqori dalillar beraman, buni endi seni kelinim qilib olaman. Keyin ogliga murojaat qilib, u dedi: Men senga ishonaman, oglim, shunchalik mehribon bola boldingki, Morgionani xotining uchun rad etma.

en: You see that Cogia Houssain sought your friendship with a treacherous design to take away my life; and if he had succeeded, there is no doubt but he would have sacrificed you also to his revenge.
uz: Ko'rib turibsizki, Cogia Houssain mening hayotimni olib ketish uchun xiyonatkorona niyat bilan do'stligingizni izlagan edi; va agar u muvaffaqiyatga erishganida, shubhasiz, u sizni ham o'z qasosi uchun qurbon qilgan bo'lardi.

en: Consider, by marrying Morgiana you marry the preserver of my family and of your own life.” The son, far from showing any dislike, readily consented to the marriage; not only because he would not disobey his father, but also because it was agreeable to his inclination.
uz: O'ylab ko'ring, Morgiana bilan turmush qurish orqali siz mening oilam va o'z hayotingizni saqlab qoluvchiga turmushga chiqasiz. O'g'il hech qanday nafrat ko'rsatmasdan, nikohga tayyorlik bilan rozi bo'ldi; nafaqat otasiga itoat etmaganligi uchun, balki uning moyilligiga ham rozi bo'lganligi uchun.

en: After this they decided to bury the captain of the robbers with his comrades, and did it so privately that nobody discovered their bones till many years after, when no one had any concern in the publication of this remarkable history.
uz: Shundan so'ng ular qaroqchilar sardorini o'z safdoshlari bilan birga dafn etishga qaror qilishdi va buni shunchalik maxfiy qilishdiki, ularning suyaklarini ko'p yillar o'tguncha hech kim topmadi, o'shanda bu ajoyib tarixning nashr etilishidan hech kim tashvishlanmas edi.

en: A few days afterward, Ali Baba celebrated the nuptials of his son and Morgiana with great solemnity, a sumptuous feast, and the usual dancing and spectacles; and had the satisfaction to see that his friends and neighbors, who were not unacquainted with Morgiana’s good qualities commended his generosity and goodness of heart.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, Ali Baba o'g'li va Morgiananing to'y marosimini katta tantanalar, dabdabali ziyofat, odatdagi raqs va tomoshalar bilan nishonladi; va Morgiananing yaxshi fazilatlari bilan befarq bo'lmagan do'stlari va qo'shnilarining uning saxiyligi va yuragi yaxshiligini maqtashlarini ko'rishdan mamnun edi.

en: Ali Baba did not visit the robbers’ cave for a whole year, fearing that the two robbers of whom he could get no account might be alive.
uz: Ali Baba butun bir yil davomida qaroqchilar g'origa bormadi, chunki u hech qanday hisob topolmagan ikki qaroqchi tirik bo'lishi mumkinligidan qo'rqardi.

en: At the year’s end, when he found they had not made any attempt to disturb him, he had the curiosity to make another journey.
uz: Yil oxirida, ular uni bezovta qilishga urinishmaganini aniqlaganida, u yana bir safarga borishga qiziqdi.

en: When he came to the cave he alighted, tied his horse to a tree, approaching the entrance, and pronouncing the words, “Open, Sesame!” when the door opened.
uz: U g'orga yetib borgach, pastga tushdi, otini daraxtga bog'ladi, kirish joyiga yaqinlashdi va eshik ochilganda: Ochiq, Sesam! deb talaffuz qildi.

en: He entered the cavern, and by the condition he found things in, judged that nobody had been there since the captain had fetched the goods for his shop.
uz: U g'orga kirdi va narsa topgan holatiga ko'ra, kapitan do'koni uchun buyumlarni olib kelganidan beri u yerda hech kim bo'lmagan deb hisobladi.

en: He believed he was the only person in the world who had the secret of opening the cave, and that all the treasure was at his sole disposal.
uz: U g'orni ochish sirini dunyodagi yagona odamga ega ekanligiga va butun xazina uning ixtiyorida ekanligiga ishongan edi.

en: Putting as much gold into his saddle-bag as his horse would carry, he returned to town.
uz: Otga yetadigan darajada ko'p oltinni egar sumkasiga solib, u shaharga qaytib keldi.

en: Some years later he carried his son to the cave and taught him the secret, which he handed down to his posterity, who, using their good fortune with moderation, lived in great honor and splendor.
uz: Bir necha yildan so'ng u o'g'lini g'orga olib bordi va unga sirni o'rgatdi, uni avlodlariga meros qilib berdi, ular o'z omadlaridan mo'tadil foydalanib, katta sharaf va ulug'vorlikda yashashdi.

en: Since day had not come, Scheherazade, without waiting for permission, began at once on the following story.
uz: Kun kelmagani uchun, Sheherazade ruxsat so'ramasdan, darhol quyidagi hikoyani boshladi.

en: Sindbad the Sailor The Story of Sindbad the Sailor In the reign of the same caliph, Haroun al Raschid, of whom we have already heard, there lived at Bagdad a poor porter, called Hindbad.
uz: Sindbad dengizchi. Sindbad dengizchining hikoyasi. Xuddi shu xalifa Horun al-Rashid hukmronligida, biz allaqachon eshitganimizdek, Bag'dodda Hindbad deb nomlangan bir kambag'al to'lovchi yashagan.

en: One day, when the weather was excessively hot, he was employed to carry a heavy burden from one end of the town to the other.
uz: Bir kuni, ob-havo haddan tashqari issiq bo'lganida, u shaharning bir chekkasidan ikkinchi chekkasiga og'ir yukni tashish uchun ishlayotgan edi.

en: Being much fatigued, he took off his load, and sat upon it, near a large mansion.
uz: U juda charchagan holda, yukini yechdi va katta saroy yaqinida uning ustiga o'tirdi.

en: He was happy, sitting there; for the agreeable smell of wood of aloes and of pastils that came from the house, mixing with the scent of the rose-water, completely perfumed and embalmed the air.
uz: U o'sha yerda o'tirganidan xursand edi; uydan kelayotgan alo va pastil yog'ochining yoqimli hidi, atirgul suvi hidi bilan aralashib, havoni butunlay xushbo'y va balzam qilgan edi.

en: Besides, he heard from within a concert of instrumental music, accompanied with the harmonious notes of nightingales and other birds.
uz: Qolaversa, u ichkaridan bulbullar va boshqa qushlarning uyg'un notalari bilan birga, instrumental musiqa konsertini eshitdi.

en: This charming melody, and the smell of several sorts of savory dishes, made the porter conclude there was a feast, with great
uz: Bu jozibali ohang va bir nechta xil mazali taomlarning hidi ko'tarib yurgan odamni ziyofat bo'lganiga ishontirdi, katta...

en: His business seldom leading him that way, he knew not to whom the mansion belonged; but he went to some of the servants, whom he saw standing at the gate in magnificent apparel, and asked the name of the proprietor.
uz: Uning ishi uni kamdan-kam hollarda shu yo'lga olib borardi, u uy kimniki ekanligini bilmas edi; lekin u ba'zi xizmatkorlarning oldiga bordi, ularni hashamatli kiyimda darvozada turganini ko'rib, egasining ismini so'radi.

en: “How,” replied one of them, “do you live in Bagdad, and know not that this is the house of Sindbad the sailor, that famous voyager, who has sailed round the world?” The porter lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, loud enough to be heard, “Almighty Creater of all things, consider the difference between Sindbad and me!
uz: Qanday qilib,  javob berdi ulardan biri,  Bagdodda yashaysanmi va bilmaysanmi, bu dengizchi Sindbadning uyi, dunyo boylab suzib yurgan mashhur sayohatchi ekanligini?  Yuk kotaruvchi kozlarini osmonga kotardi va baland ovozda dedi:  Barcha narsaning Yaratuvchisi, Sindbad va men ortasidagi farqni korib chiq!

en: I am every day exposed to fatigues and calamities, and can scarcely get coarse barley-bread for myself and my family, while happy Sindbad profusely expends immense riches, and leads a life of continual pleasure.
uz: Men har kuni charchoq va falokatlarga duchor bo'laman va o'zim va oilam uchun qo'pol arpa nonini zo'rg'a topa olmayman, shu bilan birga baxtli Sindbad ulkan boyliklarni sarflaydi va doimiy rohatda yashaydi.

en: What has he done to obtain from Thee a lot so agreeable?
uz: U Sendan bunchalik yoqimli narsa olish uchun nima qildi?

en: And what have I done to deserve one so wretched?” While the porter was thus indulging his sentiments, a servant came out of the house, and taking him by the arm, bade him come along, for Sindbad, his master, wanted to speak to him.
uz: Va men bunchalik bechora odamga munosib bo'lish uchun nima qildim? To'quvchi o'z his-tuyg'ularini shu yo'l bilan bajara turib, uydan bir xizmatchi chiqib, uni qo'lidan ushladi va unga kelishni buyurdi, chunki uning xo'jayini Sindbad u bilan gaplashmoqchi edi.

en: The servants brought him into a great hall, where a number of people sat round a table, covered with all sorts of savory dishes.
uz: Xizmatkorlar uni katta zalga olib kirishdi, u yerda bir qator odamlar turli xil mazali taomlar bilan qoplangan stol atrofida o'tirishardi.

en: At the upper end sat a comely, venerable gentleman, with a long white beard, and behind him stood a number of officers and domestics, all ready to attend his pleasure.
uz: Yuqori qismida uzun oq soqolli, chiroyli, hurmatli janob o'tirardi, uning orqasida esa bir qator ofitserlar va xizmatchilar turardi, ularning barchasi uning rohatini kutishga tayyor edi.

en: This person was Sindbad.
uz: Bu odam Sindbad edi.

en: Hindbad, embarrassed at the sight of so many people, and of a banquet so sumptuous, saluted the company, trembling.
uz: Hindbad, shunchalik ko'p odamni ko'rib, shunchalik dabdabali ziyofatdan xijolat bo'lib, titroqdan odamlarga salom berdi.

en: Sindbad bade him draw near, and seating him at his right hand, served him himself, and gave him excellent wine, of which there was abundance upon the sideboard.
uz: Sindbad uni yaqinlashtirdi va o'ng tomoniga o'tirdi, unga o'zi xizmat qildi va unga ajoyib vino berdi, uning yon tomoniga mo'l-ko'l edi.

en: Now, Sindbad had heard the porter complain, and this it was that induced him to have him brought in.
uz: Endi Sindbad ko'chmanchining shikoyatini eshitdi va aynan shu uni olib kelishga undadi.

en: When the repast was over, Sindbad addressed Hindbad, and inquired his name and employment, and said, “I wish to hear again what it was you lately said in the street.” At this request, Hindbad hung down his head in confusion, and replied, “My lord, I confess that my fatigue put me out of humor and
uz: Ovqat tugaganidan so'ng, Sindbad Hindbadga murojaat qildi va uning ismini va ish joyini so'radi va dedi: Men yaqinda ko'chada nima deganingizni yana eshitishni xohlayman. Shu so'rovga javoban, Hindbad chalkashib boshini osib qo'ydi va javob berdi: Egam, men charchoq meni hazildan chiqarib yuborganini tan olaman va

en: made me utter some indiscreet words, which I beg you to pardon.” “Do not think I am so unjust,” said Sindbad, “as to resent such a complaint.
uz: Mendan ba'zi nojo'ya so'zlarni aytishga majbur qildi, men sizni kechirishingizni so'rayman. Men bunday shikoyatga qarshi bo'lish uchun juda adolatsizman deb o'ylamang, dedi Sindbad.

en: But I must rectify your error concerning myself.
uz: Lekin men o'zim haqidagi xatoyingizni tuzatishim kerak.

en: You think, no doubt, that I have acquired without labor and trouble the ease and indulgence which I now enjoy.
uz: Sizningcha, shubhasiz, men hozir zavqlanayotgan yengillik va rohatni mehnat va tashvishsiz qo'lga kiritdim.

en: But do not mistake; I did not attain to this happy condition without enduring for several years more trouble of body and mind than can well be imagined.
uz: Lekin adashmang; men bu baxtli holatga tasavvur qilish mumkin bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq tana va ong azoblariga bir necha yil bardosh bermasdan erishmadim.

en: Yes, gentlemen,” he added, speaking to the whole company, “I assure you that my sufferings and adventures have been of an extravagant nature; and as an opportunity now offers, I will, with your leave, relate the dangers I have encountered, for I think they will not be uninteresting to you.” The First Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor My father was a wealthy merchant of much repute.
uz: Ha, janoblar, - dedi u butun kompaniyaga gapirib, - sizni ishontirib aytamanki, mening azoblarim va sarguzashtlarim dabdabali xarakterga ega edi; va hozir taklif qilayotgan imkoniyat sifatida, sizning ruxsatingiz bilan men duch kelgan xavf-xatarlarni sizga yetkazaman, chunki ular sizga befarq bo'lmaydi deb o'ylayman.

en: He bequeathed me a large estate, which I wasted in riotous living.
uz: U menga katta mulk meros qilib berdi, uni shov-shuvli hayotda behuda sarfladim.

en: I finally perceived my error, and realized that I was misspending my time, which is of all things the most valuable.
uz: Nihoyat xatosimni angladim va barcha narsalardan eng qimmatli bo'lgan vaqtimni noto'g'ri sarflayotganimni angladim.

en: I remembered the saying of the great Solomon, which I had frequently heard from my father, “A good name is better than precious ointment,” and again, “Wisdom is good with an inheritance.” Struck with these reflections, I resolved to walk in my father’s ways, and entered into a contract with some merchants, embarking with them on board a ship we had jointly fitted out.
uz: Men buyuk Sulaymonning otamdan tez-tez eshitgan so'zlarini esladim: Yaxshi nom qimmatbaho moydan yaxshiroqdir, va yana, Hikmat meros bilan yaxshi. Shu mulohazalardan hayratga tushdim, otamning yo'lidan borishga qaror qildim va ba'zi savdogarlar bilan shartnoma tuzdim, ular bilan birga biz jihozlagan kemada uchib ketdim.

en: We set sail, and steered our course toward the Indies, through the Persian Gulf, touching at several islands, where we sold or exchanged our goods.
uz: Biz jo'nab ketdik va Hindiston tomon yo'nalishimizni yo'naltirdik, Fors qo'ltig'idan o'tib, bir nechta orollarga yetib bordik, u yerda tovarlarimizni sotardik yoki almashtirardik.

en: One day, while under sail, we were becalmed near a small island, but little elevated above the level of the water, and resembling a green meadow.
uz: Bir kuni, yelkan ostida bo'lganimizda, biz kichik orol yaqinida tinchlanardik, lekin suv sathidan biroz yuqori va yashil maysazorga o'xshardik.

en: The captain ordered his sails to be furled, and permitted such persons as were so inclined to land; of this number I was one.
uz: Kapitan o'z yelkanlarini g'altak bilan o'rashni buyurdi va quruqlikka moyil bo'lgan odamlarga ruxsat berdi; men bu sonlardan biriman.

en: But while we were enjoying ourselves and recovering ourselves from the fatigue of the sea, the island on a sudden trembled terribly.
uz: Ammo biz o'zimizni xursand qilib, dengiz charchoqidan tuzalib turganimizda, orol birdaniga dahshatli darajada titradi.

en: The trembling of the island was perceived on board the ship, and we were called upon to re-embark speedily, or we should all be lost; for what we took for an island proved to be the back of a sea monster.
uz: Orolning titrashi kemada sezildi va biz tezda qaytishga chaqirildi, aks holda hammamiz yo'qolishimiz kerak edi; chunki orol deb o'ylagan narsamiz dengiz maxluqi orqasi ekanligi isbotlandi.

en: The nimblest got into the sloop, others betook themselves to swimming; but as for myself, I was still upon the island when it disappeared into the sea, and I had only time to catch hold of a piece of wood that we had brought out of the ship to make a fire.
uz: Eng zaiflari sloopga o'tirdi, boshqalar suzishga o'zlarini majburlashdi; lekin o'zimga kelsak, u dengizga g'oyib bo'lganda orolda edim va kemadan olov yoqish uchun olib chiqqan bir bo'lak yog'ochni ushlashga vaqtim yetardi.

en: Meanwhile the captain, having received those on board who were in the sloop, and taken up those that swam, failed to see me and hoisting his sails pursued his voyage, so that it was impossible for me to recover the ship.
uz: Ayni paytda kapitan, kemadagilarni qabul qilib olib, suzuvchilarni olib, meni ko'rmadi va yelkanlarini ko'tarib, o'z sayohatini davom ettirdi, shuning uchun kemani qaytarib olishimning iloji bo'lmadi.

en: Thus was I exposed to the mercy of the waves all the rest of the day and the following night.
uz: Shunday qilib, men butun kun davomida va keyingi tun davomida to'lqinlarning rahm-shafqatiga duch keldim.

en: By this time I found my strength gone, and despaired of saving my life, when happily a wave threw me against an island.
uz: Shu vaqtga kelib, kuchim yo'qolganini va hayotimni saqlab qolishdan umidsizlikka tushganimni angladim, shunda xursandchilik bilan to'lqin meni orolga tashladi.

en: The bank was high and rugged, so that I could scarcely have got up had it not been for some roots of trees which I found within reach.
uz: Qirg'oq baland va mustahkam edi, shuning uchun qo'lim yetadigan daraxt ildizlari bo'lmaganida, men deyarli turolmasdim.

en: When the sun arose, though I was very feeble, both from exposure and want of food, I crept along to find some herbs fit to eat, and had the good luck not only to procure some, but likewise to discover a spring of excellent water, which contributed much to my recovery.
uz: Quyosh chiqishi bilan, garchi juda zaif bo'lsam ham, ta'sirlanib va oziq-ovqat yetishmasligi tufayli, yeyishga yaroqli o'tlarni topishga sudrab bordim va nafaqat ba'zilarini topishga, balki sog'ayishimga katta hissa qo'shgan ajoyib suv bulog'ini topishga ham omadim keldi.

en: After this I walked farther and at last reached a fine plain, where I perceived some horses feeding.
uz: Shundan so'ng uzoqroq yurdim va nihoyat nozik tekislikka yetib bordim, u yerda ba'zi otlarning ovqatlanayotganini sezdim.

en: I went toward them, when I heard the voice of a man, who immediately appeared, and asked me who I was.
uz: Men ularga tomon bordim, bir odamning ovozini eshitdim, u darhol paydo bo'ldi va mendan kimligimni so'radi.

en: I related to him my adventure, after which he led me into a cave, where there were several other people, no less amazed to see me than I to see them.
uz: Men unga o'z sarguzashtimni hikoya qildim, shundan so'ng u meni g'orga olib kirdi, u yerda bir nechta boshqa odamlar ham bor edi, ular meni ko'rishdan hayratda edilar, men ularni ko'rishdan ham hayratda edim.

en: I partook of some provisions which they offered me.
uz: Ular menga taklif qilgan ba'zi taomlardan qabul qildim.

en: I then asked them what they did in such a desert place; to which they answered, that they were grooms belonging to the maharaja, sovereign of the island, and that every year they brought thither the king’s horses for pasturage.
uz: Keyin ulardan bunday cho'lda nima qilishayotganini so'radim; ularga javob berishdi: ular orol hukmdorlari bo'lgan monarxga tegishli kuyovlar ekanliklari va har yili u yerga podshoh otlarini o'tloq uchun olib kelishayotganlari haqida.

en: They added that they were to return home on the morrow, and had I been one day later I must have perished, because the inhabited part of the island was a great distance off, and it would have been impossible for me to have reached it without a guide.
uz: Ular ertaga uyga qaytishlari kerakligini qo'shdilar va agar men bir kundan keyin bo'lganimda, halok bo'lardim, chunki orolning aholi yashaydigan qismi juda uzoqda edi va men yo'lboshchisiz unga yetib borishimning iloji bo'lmas edi.

en: Next morning they returned to the capital of the island, took me with them, and presented me to the maharaja.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab ular orol poytaxtiga qaytib kelishdi, meni o'zlari bilan olib ketishdi va meni monarxga taqdim etishdi.

en: He asked me who I was, and by what adventure I had come into his dominions.
uz: U mendan kimligimni va uning hukmronligiga qanday sarguzasht bilan kelganimni so'radi.

en: After I had explained he told me he was sorry for my misfortune, and at the same time ordered that I should want for nothing; which command his officers were careful to see exactly fulfilled.
uz: Tushuntirganimdan so'ng, u menga noqulayligimdan afsusda ekanligini aytdi va shu bilan birga menga hech narsa kerak emasligini buyurdi; bu amr uning ofitserlariga aniq bajarilishini ko'rishga e'tibor qaratdi.

en: Being a merchant, I frequented men of my own profession, and particularly inquired for those who were strangers, that perchance I might hear news from Bagdad, or find an opportunity to return.
uz: Savdogar bo'lganim sababli, o'z kasbimdagi odamlarga tez-tez murojaat qilardim va ayniqsa Beg'uborlardan xabar eshitishim yoki qaytib kelish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishim mumkinligini so'rardim.

en: For the maharaja’s capital is situated on the seacoast, and has a fine harbor, where ships arrive daily from the different quarters of the world.
uz: Chunki monarxning poytaxti dengiz sohilida joylashgan va u yerda dunyoning turli burchaklaridan har kuni kemalar keladigan ajoyib port bor.

en: As I was one day at the port, the ship arrived in which I had embarked at Bussorah.
uz: Bir kuni portda bo'lganimda, Bussoraga chiqqan kemam keldi.

en: I at once knew the captain, and went and asked him for my bales.
uz: Men darhol kapitanni tanib oldim va borib undan o'tlarimni so'radim.

en: “I am Sindbad,” said I, “and those bales marked with his name are mine.” When the captain heard me speak thus, “Heavens!” he exclaimed, “whom can we trust in these times!
uz: Men Sindbadman,  dedim men,  va uning nomi bilan belgilangan oqlar meniki. Kapitan meni shunday deyayotganimni eshitib, Osmon! dedi u, bu zamonda kimga ishonishimiz mumkin!

en: I saw Sindbad perish with my own eyes, as did also the passengers on board, and yet you tell me you are that Sindbad.
uz: Men Sindbadning o'z ko'zlarim bilan halok bo'lganini ko'rdim, xuddi bortdagi yo'lovchilar ham shunday qilishganini, ammo siz menga o'sha Sindbad ekanligingizni aytasiz.

en: What impudence is this!
uz: Bu qanday beodoblik!

en: and what a false tale to tell, in order to possess yourself of what does not belong to you!” “Have patience,” replied I; “do me the favor to hear what I have to say.” The captain was at length persuaded that I was no cheat; for there came people from his ship who knew me, and expressed much joy at seeing me alive.
uz: va qanday yolg'on rivoyat aytish kerak, o'zingga tegishli bo'lmagan narsani o'zingni egallash uchun! S Sabr qil, javob berdim men; Menga aytadigan gaplarimni eshitishga yordam ber. Kapitan oxir-oqibat meni firibgar emasligimga ishontirdi; chunki uning kemasidan meni biladigan odamlar keldi va meni tirik ko'rishdan juda xursand bo'lishdi.

en: At last he recollected me himself, and embracing me, “Heaven be praised,” said he, “for your happy escape!
uz: Nihoyat, u meni o'zi esladi va meni quchoqlab, dedi: Osmonga maqtov bo'lsin, baxtli qochishingiz uchun!

en: I cannot express the joy it affords me.
uz: U menga taqdim etadigan quvonchni ifodalay olmayman.

en: There are your goods; take and do with them as you please.” I took out what was most valuable in my bales, and presented these to the maharaja, who asked me how I came by such valuables.
uz: Bu yerda sizning tovarlaringiz bor; ularni o'zingiz xohlaganingizcha oling va qiling. Men o'z bilaklarimdagi eng qimmatli narsani olib, ularni maharajga taqdim etdim, u mendan bunday qimmatbaho narsalardan qanday kelib qolganimni so'radi.

en: He was pleased to hear of my good luck, accepted my present, and in return gave me one much more considerable.
uz: U mening omadimni eshitib xursand bo'ldi, sovg'amni qabul qildi va evaziga menga ancha qimmatbaho sovg'a berdi.

en: Upon this I took leave of him, and went aboard the same ship after I had exchanged my goods for the commodities of that country.
uz: Shundan so'ng men u bilan xayrlashdim va o'sha mamlakat tovarlariga mol-mulkimni almashtirgandan so'ng, xuddi shu kemada bordim.

en: with me wood of aloes, sandalwood, nutmegs, cloves, pepper, and ginger.
uz: Men bilan aloy yog'ochi, sandal yog'ochi, muskat yong'og'i, tirnoq, murch va zanjabil.

en: We passed by several islands, and at last arrived at Bussorah, from whence I came to this city, with one hundred thousand sequins as the result of my venture.
uz: Biz bir nechta orollardan o'tib, nihoyat Bussoraga yetib keldik, shundan bu shaharga keldim, sarguzashtim natijasida yuz ming qin bilan.

en: Sindbad stopped here, and ordered the musicians to proceed with their concert.
uz: Sindbad shu yerda to'xtadi va musiqachilarga konsertlarini davom ettirishni buyurdi.

en: When evening came, Sindbad sent for a purse of one hundred sequins, and giving it to the porter, said, “Take this, Hindbad, return to your home, and come back to-morrow to hear more of my adventures.” The porter went away, astonished at the honor done him.
uz: Kech bo'lganda, Sindbad bir cho'ntakni, yuzta qirg'ichdan so'rab jo'natdi va uni ko'tarib yuruvchiga berdi va dedi: Buni ol, Hindbad, uyingga qaytib kel, ertaga mening sarguzashtlarim haqida eshitib kel. Ko'tarib yuruvchi unga qilingan sharafdan hayratda ketdi.

en: The account of his adventure proved very agreeable to his wife and children, who did not fail to return thanks for what Providence had sent them by the hand of Sindbad.
uz: Uning sarguzasht haqidagi hikoyasi uning rafiqasi va bolalariga juda yoqdi, ular Providence Sindbad qo'li bilan ularga yuborgan narsalariga minnatdorchilik bildirishdan tortinmadilar.

en: Hindbad put on his best robe next day, and returned to the bountiful traveler, who received him with a pleasant air.
uz: Hindbad ertasi kuni eng yaxshi ko'ylagini kiydi va saxiy sayohatchiga qaytib keldi, u uni yoqimli ruh bilan kutib oldi.

en: When all the guests had arrived, dinner was served, and when it was ended, Sindbad, addressing himself to the company, said, “Gentlemen, be pleased to listen to the adventures of my second voyage.
uz: Barcha mehmonlar yetib kelganida, kechki ovqat tortilgan edi va u tugagach, Sindbad kompaniyaga murojaat qilib dedi: Janoblar, mening ikkinchi sayohatimning sarguzashtlarini tinglashdan mamnun bo'ling.

en: They deserve your attention even more than those of the first.” “The day is here,” said Scheherazade, “and I must stop.
uz: Ular sizning e'tiboringizga, avvalgidan ham ko'proq loyiqdir.  Kun shu yerda,  dedi Sheherazad,  va men to'xtatishim kerak.

en: But I will not conceal from your majesty that the following voyages of Sindbad are infinitely more marvellous than this his first.” “We do not doubt it,” returned her lord, “and we intend that you shall tell us of all these voyages.” Accordingly, the following night, Scheherazade took up the tale at the point where she had left off.
uz: Lekin men sizning ulug'vorligingizdan yashirmaymanki, Sindbadning keyingi safarlari uning birinchi sayohatiga qaraganda cheksiz ajoyibroqdir. Biz bunga shubha qilmaymiz,  javob berdi uning xo'jayini, va siz bizga bu safarlarning hammasini aytib berishni niyat qilamiz. Shunga ko'ra, keyingi kechasi, Sheherazade ertakni u to'xtatgan joyda davom ettirdi.

en: The Second Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor I intended, after my first voyage, to spend the rest of my days at Bagdad, but it was not long ere I grew weary of an indolent life, and I put to sea a second time, with merchants of known probity.
uz: Sindbad dengizchining ikkinchi sayohati. Birinchi safarimdan so'ng, qolgan kunlarimni Bag'dodda o'tkazmoqchi edim, lekin ko'p o'tmay, dangasa hayotdan charchadim va ikkinchi marta dengizga otlandim, ma'lum darajada to'g'ri savdogarlar bilan.

en: We embarked on board a good ship, and, after recommending ourselves
uz: Biz yaxshi kemaga bordik va o'zimizni tavsiya qilganimizdan keyin...

en: We traded from island to island, and exchanged commodities with great profit.
uz: Biz oroldan orolga savdo qildik va katta foyda bilan tovarlar almashdik.

en: One day we landed on an island covered with several sorts of fruit trees, but we could see neither man nor animal.
uz: Bir kuni biz bir nechta turdagi mevali daraxtlar bilan qoplangan orolga qo'ndik, lekin na odamni, na hayvonni ko'ra olmadik.

en: We walked in the meadows, along the streams that watered them.
uz: Biz o'tloqlarda, ularni sug'oradigan soylar bo'ylab sayr qildik.

en: While some diverted themselves with gathering flowers, and others fruits, I sat down near a stream betwixt two high trees, which formed a thick shade.
uz: Ba'zilar gul yig'ish bilan, boshqalari esa meva yig'ish bilan chalg'ishayotgan bir paytda, men ikki baland daraxt o'rtasida joylashgan, qalin soyani hosil qiluvchi soyga yaqin o'tirdim.

en: I made a good meal of the wine and provisions I had brought from the ship and afterward fell asleep.
uz: Men kemadan olib kelgan vino va taomlardan yaxshi taom tayyorladim va keyin uxladim.

en: I cannot tell how long I slept, but when I awoke the ship was gone.
uz: Men qancha uxlaganimni aniqlay olmayman, lekin uyg'onganimda kema yo'q edi.

en: Not knowing what to do, I climbed up to the top of a lofty tree, from whence I looked about on all sides, to see if I could discover anything that would give me hopes.
uz: Nima qilishni bilmay, baland daraxtning tepasiga chiqdim, undan umid beradigan biror narsa topib bera olamanmi, deb har tomondan qaradim.

en: When I gazed toward the sea I could see nothing but sky and water; but looking over the land, I beheld afar off something white; and coming down, I took what food I had left and went toward it, the distance being so great that I could not distinguish what it was.
uz: Dengizga qaraganimda, faqat osmon va suvni ko'rdim; lekin yer ustiga qarab, uzoqdan oq narsa ko'rdim; va pastga tushgach, qolgan ovqatimni olib, unga tomon yo'l oldim, masofa shunchalik katta ediki, u nima ekanligini farqlay olmasdim.

en: As I approached, I thought it to be a white dome, of a prodigious height and extent; and when I came up to it, I touched it, and found it to be very smooth.
uz: Yaqinlashar ekanman, uni ajoyib balandlik va o'lchamga ega bo'lgan oq gumbaz deb o'yladim; va unga yaqinlashsam, unga tegdim va juda silliq deb topdim.

en: I went round to see if it was open on any side, but saw it was not, and that there was no climbing up to the top, as it was so smooth.
uz: Men uning har qanday tomondan ochiqligini ko'rish uchun aylandim, lekin u ochiq emasligini va cho'qqiga ko'tarilishning iloji yo'qligini ko'rdim, chunki u juda silliq edi.

en: It was at least fifty paces round.
uz: Bu kamida ellik qadam aylana edi.

en: All of a sudden the sky became as dark as if it had been covered with a thick cloud.
uz: To'satdan osmon xuddi qalin bulut bilan qoplanganidek qorong'ilashdi.

en: I was much astonished at this sudden darkness, but much more when I found it was occasioned by a bird of monstrous size, that came flying toward me.
uz: Men bu to'satdan paydo bo'lgan zulmatga juda hayron bo'ldim, lekin undan ham ko'proq uni menga qarab uchib kelayotgan dahshatli o'lchamdagi qush sabab bo'lganini aniqladim.

en: I remembered that I had often heard mariners speak of a miraculous bird called the roc, and conceived that the great dome which I so much admired must be its egg.
uz: Esladimki, men dengizchilarning ko'pincha rok deb nomlangan mo'jizaviy qush haqida gapirganini eshitgan edim va men juda qoyil qolgan ulkan gumbaz uning tuxumi bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylagandim.

en: In short, the bird alighted, and sat over the egg.
uz: Xullas, qush tushdi va tuxum ustiga o'tirdi.

en: As I perceived her coming, I crept close to the egg, so that I had before me one of the legs of the bird, which was as big as the trunk of a tree.
uz: Uning kelayotganini sezganimda, tuxumga yaqinroq kirib bordim, shunda oldimda qushning bir oyog'i bor edi, u daraxt tanasidan katta edi.

en: I tied myself strongly to it with my turban, in hopes that the roc next morning would carry me with her out of this desert island.
uz: Men o'zimni qattiq turbanim bilan bog'ladim, umid qilamanki, ertalab tosh meni u bilan shu cho'l oroldan olib ketadi.

en: Sure enough the bird flew away as soon as it was daylight, and carried me so high, that I could not see the earth; she afterward
uz: Albatta, qush kunduzgi yorug'lik bilan uchib ketdi va meni shunday baland ko'tardiki, yerni ko'ra olmadim; u keyin

en: descended with so much rapidity that I almost lost my senses.
uz: shunchalik tez tushdiki, deyarli hushimni yo'qotdim.

en: But finding myself on the ground, I speedily released myself, and had scarcely done so, when the roc, having taken up a serpent of a monstrous length in her bill, flew away.
uz: Lekin o'zimni yerda topib, tezda ozod bo'ldim va buni deyarli qilmagan edim, qachonki qoya o'z qo'lida dahshatli uzunlikdagi ilonni ko'tarib, uchib ketdi.

en: The spot where the roc left me was surrounded by The Spot Where the Roc Left Me Was Surrounded by Mountains mountains, that seemed to reach above the clouds, and were so steep that there was no possibility of getting out of the valley.
uz: Meni qoya tashlagan joy The Spot Where the Rock Left Me bilan o'ralgan edi. U yerda tog'lar, bulutlardan yuqoriga yetib boradigan va vodiydan chiqishning iloji yo'qdek tik tog'lar bor edi.

en: So that when I compared this place with the desert island from which the roc had brought me, I found that I had gained nothing by the change.
uz: Shunday qilib, bu joyni qoyalar meni olib kelgan cho'l orol bilan solishtirsam, o'zgarishdan hech narsa yutmaganimni angladim.

en: As I walked through this valley, I perceived it was strewed with diamonds, some of which were of surprising bigness.
uz: Bu vodiydan o'tayotganimda, u olmoslar bilan to'ldirilganini payqadim, ularning ba'zilari hayratlanarli darajada katta edi.

en: I also saw a great number of serpents, so monstrous that the least of them was capable of swallowing an elephant.
uz: Men shuningdek, juda ko'p ilonlarni ko'rdim, shunchalik dahshatli ediki, ulardan eng kichigi filni yutishga qodir edi.

en: They retired in the day-time to their dens, where they hid themselves from the roc, their enemy, and came out only in the night.
uz: Ular kunduzi o'z uyalariga chekinishdi, u yerda dushmanlaridan yashirinib, faqat kechasi chiqdilar.

en: I spent the day in walking about in the valley.
uz: Kunni vodiyda sayr qilish bilan o'tkazdim.

en: When night came on I went into a cave, where I thought I might repose in safety.
uz: Kech kirgach, g'orga kirdim, u yerda xavfsiz dam olishim mumkin deb o'yladim.

en: I secured the entrance, which was low and narrow, with a great stone, to preserve me from the serpents; but not so as to exclude the air.
uz: Men kichik va tor bo'lgan kirishni katta tosh bilan mahkamladim, meni ilonlardan saqlab qolish uchun; lekin havoni chiqarish uchun emas.

en: I supped on part of my provisions, but the serpents, which began hissing round me, put me into such extreme fear that I did not sleep.
uz: Men o'z taomlarimning bir qismidan ovqatlandim, lekin atrofimda shivirlay boshlagan ilonlar meni shunchalik qo'rqitib yubordiki, uxlay olmadim.

en: When day appeared the serpents crawled off, and I came out of the cave trembling.
uz: Kunduz paydo bo'lganda ilonlar sudrab ketishdi va men g'ordan titrab chiqdim.

en: I can justly say that I walked upon diamonds without feeling any inclination to touch them.
uz: Men haqli ravishda aytishim mumkinki, olmoslarga tegishga hech qanday moyillik sezmasdan, ularning ustida yurdim.

en: At last I sat down, and notwithstanding my apprehensions, not having closed my eyes during the night, fell asleep, after having eaten a little more of my diminishing food.
uz: Nihoyat o'tirdim va xavotirlarimga qaramay, kechasi ko'zlarimni yummagan holda, ozroq ovqatdan biroz ko'proq yeganimdan keyin uxladim.

en: But I had scarcely shut my eyes when something that fell by me with a great noise awakened me.
uz: Lekin men ko'zlarimni zo'rg'a yumgandim, qachonki menga katta shovqin bilan tushgan narsa uyg'otdi.

en: This was a large piece of raw meat; and at the same time I saw several others fall down from the rocks in different places.
uz: Bu katta xom go'sht bo'lak edi; va ayni paytda men yana bir nechta odamning turli joylardagi toshlardan yiqilganini ko'rdim.

en: I had always regarded as fabulous what I had heard sailors and others relate of the Valley of Diamonds, and of the stratagem employed by merchants to obtain them.
uz: Men dengizchilar va boshqalar Olmoslar vodiysi haqida va ularni olish uchun savdogarlar tomonidan qo'llaniladigan hiyla haqida aytganlarini doim ajoyib deb hisoblardim.

en: But now I found that they had told nothing but the truth.
uz: Ammo endi ular faqat haqiqatni aytganlarini angladim.

en: For the fact The Sky became dark
uz: Haqiqatan ham Osmon qorong'ilashdi.

en: is that the merchants come to the heights above this valley, when the eagles have young ones, and throw great joints of meat into the valley, to which some diamonds stick; the eagles, which are stronger in this country than anywhere else, pounce with great force upon the pieces of meat and carry them to their nests on the precipices to feed their young: the merchants run to the nests, drive off the
uz: Bu vodiydan yuqori cho'qqilarga kelgan savdogarlar burgutlarning bolalari bo'lganda, vodiyga katta go'sht bo'g'inlarini uloqtirishadi, unga ba'zi olmoslar yopishadi; bu mamlakatda boshqa hech qayerdan kuchliroq bo'lgan burgutlar go'sht bo'laklariga katta kuch bilan sakrab, ularni o'z uyalariga olib ketishadi va bolalarini boqish uchun teshiklariga olib borishadi: savdogarlar uyalarga yugurib, haydab yuborishadi.

en: eagles by their shouts, and take away the diamonds that stick to the meat.
uz: Burgutlar o'z qichqiriqlari bilan, va go'shtga yopishtirilgan olmoslarni olib tashlaydi.

en: I perceived in this device the means of my deliverance.
uz: Men bu qurilmada o'zimni qutqarish vositasini idrok qildim.

en: Having collected together the largest diamonds I could find, and put them into the leather bag in which I used to carry my provisions, I took the largest of the pieces of meat, tied it close round me with the cloth of my turban, and then laid myself upon the ground, with my face downward, the bag of diamonds being made fast to my girdle.
uz: Topgan eng katta olmoslarimni yig'ib, ularni oziq-ovqatimni olib yuradigan charm sumkaga joylashtirdim. Eng katta go'sht bo'laklarini oldim, to'shagimning matosi bilan mahkam bog'ladim va keyin yuzimni pastga qaratib yerga yotdim, olmosdan yasalgan sumka kamarimga mahkam tortildi.

en: I had scarcely placed myself in this posture when one of the eagles, having taken me up with the piece of meat to which I was fastened, carried me to his nest on the top of the mountain.
uz: Men o'zimni shu holatga deyarli joylashtirmagan edim, qachonki burgutlardan biri meni bog'langan go'sht bo'lagi bilan olib, tog' tepasidagi uyaga olib borganida.

en: The merchants immediately began their shouting to frighten the eagles; and when they had obliged them to quit their nests, one of them came to that where I was.
uz: Savdogarlar darhol burgutlarni qo'rqitish uchun baqirishni boshladilar; va ularni uyalarini tashlab ketishga majbur qilganlaridan so'ng, ulardan biri men turgan joyga keldi.

en: He was much alarmed when he saw me; but recovering himself, instead of inquiring how I came thither, began to quarrel with me, and asked why I stole his goods.
uz: U meni ko'rganida juda xavotirda edi; lekin o'zini tutib, u yerga qanday kelganimni so'rash o'rniga, men bilan janjallashishni boshladi va nega uning mol-mulkini o'g'irlaganimni so'radi.

en: “Do not be uneasy,” I told him; “I have diamonds enough for you and myself, more than all the other merchants together.
uz: Xavotir olma, dedim men unga; Menda senga va o'zimga yetadigan olmoslar bor, boshqa barcha savdogarlardan ko'ra ko'proq.

en: Whatever they have they owe to chance; but I selected for myself, in the bottom of the valley, those which you see in this bag.” I had scarcely done speaking, when the other merchants came crowding about us, much astonished to see me; but they were much more surprised when I told them my story.
uz: Ularning nimaiki bo'lsa, tasodif tufayli bor; lekin men o'zim uchun vodiyning tubida, bu sumkada ko'rayotganlarni tanladim.  Men deyarli gapira olmagan edim, boshqa savdogarlar bizni ko'rib hayratga tushishdi, meni ko'rib; lekin men ularga o'z hikoyamni aytganimda ular ancha hayratga tushishdi.

en: They conducted me to their encampment; and there having opened my bag, they were surprised at the largeness of my diamonds, and confessed that they had never seen any of such size and perfection.
uz: Ular meni o'zlarining lagerlariga olib borishdi; va u yerda sumkamni ochib, olmoslarimning ulkanligidan hayratda qolishdi va hech qachon bunday o'lcham va mukammallikni ko'rmaganliklarini tan olishdi.

en: I prayed the merchant who owned the nest to which I had been carried (for every merchant had his own) to take as many for his share as he pleased.
uz: Men meni olib ketilgan uyaga ega bo'lgan savdogardan (chunki har bir savdogarning o'z uyi bor edi) o'z ulushi uchun xohlagancha ko'p odamni olishini so'radim.

en: He contented himself with one, and that, too, the least of them; and when I pressed him to take more, without fear of doing me any injury, “No,” said he, “I am very well satisfied with this, which is valuable enough to save me the
uz: U bir kishi bilan kifoyalandi, va u ham ularning eng kichiginasidan; va men uni ko'proq olishga majbur qilganimda, menga zarar yetkazishdan qo'rqmasdan, u dedi: Yo'q, men bundan juda mamnunman, bu meni qutqarishga arziydi.

en: trouble of making more voyages, and will raise as great a fortune as I desire.” I spent the night with the merchants, to whom I related my story a second time, for the satisfaction of those who had not heard it.
uz: Ko'proq sayohat qilish muammosi bor edi va men xohlagan qadar katta boylik orttirardim.  Men kechani savdogarlar bilan o'tkazdim, ularga hikoyamni ikkinchi marta aytib berdim, eshitmaganlarning mamnunligi uchun.

en: I could not moderate my joy when I found myself delivered.
uz: O'zimni yetuk deb topganimda, xursandligimni o'ziga torta olmadim.

en: I thought myself in a dream, and could scarcely believe myself safe.
uz: Men o'zimni tushda deb o'ylagandim va o'zimni xavfsiz deb deyarli tasavvur qila olmasdim.

en: The merchants had thrown their pieces of meat into the valley for several days; and each of them being satisfied with the diamonds that had fallen to his lot, we left the place the next morning, and traveled through high mountains, where there were serpents of a prodigious length, which we had the good fortune to escape.
uz: Savdogarlar bir necha kun davomida o'z go'sht bo'laklarini vodiyga tashlashdi; va ularning har biri o'z ulushiga tushgan olmoslardan mamnun bo'lib, ertasi kuni ertalab joydan chiqib, baland tog'lar bo'ylab sayohat qildik, u yerda ulkan uzunlikdagi ilonlar bor edi, ulardan qochishga omadimiz keldi.

en: We took shipping at the first port we reached, and touched at the isle of Roha, where grow trees that yield camphor.
uz: Biz yetib kelgan birinchi portda yuk tashdik va Roha oroliga yetib bordik, u yerda kanfor beradigan daraxtlar o'sadi.

en: This tree is so large, and its branches so thick, that one hundred men may easily sit under its shade.
uz: Bu daraxt shunchalik katta va shoxlari shunchalik qalinki, uning soyasi ostida yuz kishi bemalol o'tirishi mumkin.

en: The juice of which the camphor is made exudes from a hole bored in the upper part of the tree, and is received in a vessel, where it thickens and becomes what we call camphor.
uz: Kamforning sharbati daraxtning yuqori qismidagi teshikdan chiqadi va idishda qabul qilinadi, u yerda qalinlashadi va biz kamfor deb ataydigan narsaga aylanadi.

en: After the juice is thus drawn out, the tree withers and dies.
uz: Sharbat shu tarzda tortilgandan so'ng, daraxt qurib, o'ladi.

en: I pass over many other things peculiar to this island, lest I should weary you.
uz: Sizni charchatmaslik uchun bu orolga xos bo'lgan boshqa ko'plab narsalarni ham o'tkazib yuboraman.

en: Here I exchanged some of my diamonds for merchandise.
uz: Bu yerda olmoslarimdan ba'zilarini tovarlarga almashtirdim.

en: We went to other islands, and at last, having touched at several trading towns of the continent, we landed at Bussorah and I returned to Bagdad.
uz: Biz boshqa orollarga bordik va nihoyat, qit'aning bir nechta savdo shaharlariga qo'ng'iroq qilib, Bussoraga qo'ndik va Bag'dodda qaytdim.

en: There I immediately gave large presents to the poor, and lived honorably upon the vast riches I had brought back gained with so much fatigue.
uz: U yerda darhol kambag'allarga katta sovg'alar berdim va shunchalik charchoq bilan orqaga olib kelgan ulkan boyliklarimdan faxr bilan yashadim.

en: Thus Sindbad ended the relation of the second voyage, gave Hindbad another hundred sequins, and invited him to come the next day to hear the account of the third voyage.
uz: Shunday qilib, Sindbad ikkinchi sayohat munosabatlarini yakunladi, Hindbadga yana yuz bir qichqiriq berdi va uni ertasi kuni uchinchi sayohat haqidagi xabarni eshitish uchun kelishga taklif qildi.

en: This he gladly did and was received as before, and, dinner over, Sindbad took up the tale of his adventures as follows.
uz: U buni xursandchilik bilan qildi va avvalgidek qabul qilindi. Kechki ovqat tugaganidan so'ng, Sindbad o'z sarguzashtlari haqidagi hikoyani quyidagicha davom ettirdi.

en: The Third Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor
uz: Sindbad dengizchining uchinchi sayohati

en: I soon again grew weary of living a life of idleness, and, hardening myself against the thought of any danger, I embarked with some merchants on another long voyage.
uz: Tez orada yana beparvolik hayotidan charchadim va har qanday xavf haqida o'ylashdan o'zimni qattiq saqlab, ba'zi savdogarlar bilan yana bir uzoq sayohatga otlandim.

en: We touched at several ports, where we traded.
uz: Biz bir nechta portlarga tegdik, u yerda savdo qildik.

en: One day we were overtaken by a dreadful tempest, which drove us from our course.
uz: Bir kuni bizni dahshatli bo'ron kutib oldi va u bizni yo'limizdan haydab chiqdi.

en: The storm continued for several days, and brought us before the port of an island, which the captain was unwilling to enter but was obliged to in order to cast anchor.
uz: Bo'ron bir necha kun davom etdi va bizni orol portiga olib keldi. Kapitan kirishni xohlamadi, lekin langar tashlash uchun majbur bo'ldi.

en: When we had furled our sails, the captain told us that this and some other neighboring islands were inhabited by hairy savages, who would speedily attack us; and though they were but dwarfs, yet that we must make no resistance, for they were more in number than the locusts; and if we happened to kill one, they would all fall upon us and destroy us.
uz: Biz yelkanlarimizni payvandlaganimizdan so'ng, kapitan bizga bu va boshqa qo'shni orollarda tukli yovvoyi hayvonlar yashayotganini aytdi, ular bizga tezda hujum qilishardi; va garchi ular kichik bo'lsalar ham, qarshilik ko'rsatmasligimiz kerak edi, chunki ular chigirtkalardan ko'p edi; va agar biz bittasini o'ldirsak, ularning barchasi ustimizga tushib, yo'q qilishardi.

en: We soon found that what the captain had told us was but too true.
uz: Tez orada kapitanning bizga aytganlari juda ham to'g'ri ekanligini aniqladik.

en: An innumerable multitude of frightful savages, about two feet high, covered all over with red hair, came swimming toward our ship.
uz: Taxminan ikki fut balandlikdagi, butun boshini qizil sochlar bilan qoplagan dahshatli yovvoyilarning son-sanoqsiz olomon kemamizga qarab suzib keldi.

en: They chattered as they came near, but we understood not their language.
uz: Ular yaqinlashar ekan, gaplashib ketishdi, lekin biz ularning tilini tushunmadik.

en: They climbed up the sides of the ship with an agility that surprised us.
uz: Ular bizni hayratga soladigan chaqqonlik bilan kemaning yon tomonlariga ko'tarilishdi.

en: They took down our sails, cut the cable, and hauling our ship to the shore, made us all get out, and took the ship to another island, from which they had come.
uz: Ular yelkanlarimizni olib tashlashdi, kabelni kesishdi va kemamizni qirg'oqqa olib kelishdi, hammamizni undan chiqarib, kemani o'zlari kelgan boshqa orolga olib ketishdi.

en: As we advanced, we perceived at a distance a vast building, and made toward it.
uz: Oldinga siljiganimiz sari, uzoqdan ulkan binoni sezdik va unga qarab yo'l oldik.

en: We found it to be a palace, elegantly built, and very lofty, with a gate of ebony, which we opened.
uz: Biz uni hashamat bilan qurilgan va juda baland saroy deb topdik, biz ochgan qora tanli darvozasi bor edi.

en: Entering, we saw before us a large apartment, with a porch, having on one side a heap of human bones, and on the other a vast number of roasting spits.
uz: Kirib, oldimizda katta kvartira ko'rdik, ayvon bilan, bir tomoni inson suyaklari, ikkinchi tomoni esa qovurilgan tikanlar bilan bezatilgan.

en: We trembled at this spectacle, and were seized with deadly apprehension, when suddenly a door of the apartment opened with a loud crash, and there appeared the horrible figure of a black man, as tall as a palm tree.
uz: Biz bu tomoshabadan titradik va o'limga olib keladigan xavotirga tushdik, to'satdan kvartiraning eshigi baland ovozda ochildi va palma daraxti kabi bo'yli qora tanli odamning dahshatli qiyofasi paydo bo'ldi.

en: He had but one eye, and that in the middle of his forehead, where it blazed bright as a burning coal.
uz: Uning faqat bir ko'zi bor edi, va u peshonasining o'rtasida edi, u yerda yonayotgan ko'mir kabi porlardi.

en: His fore-teeth were very long and sharp, and stood out of his mouth, which was as deep as that of a horse.
uz: Uning old tishlari juda uzun va o'tkir edi, va otning og'zidan chiqib turardi, og'zi otnikidek chuqur edi.

en: His upper lip hung down upon his breast.
uz: Uning yuqori lablari ko'kragiga osilib turardi.

en: His ears resembled those of an elephant, and covered his shoulders; and his nails were as long and crooked as the talons of the greatest
uz: Uning quloqlari fil quloqlariga o'xshardi va yelkalarini yopardi; tirnoqlari esa eng kattalarning teshiklari kabi uzun va egri edi.

en: At the sight of so frightful a creature, we become insensible and lay like dead men.
uz: Bunday dahshatli maxluqni ko'rib, biz hissiz bo'lib qolamiz va o'lik odamdek yotamiz.

en: At last we came to ourselves, and saw him sitting on the porch looking at us.
uz: Nihoyat o'zimizga keldik va uni ayvonda bizga qarab o'tirganini ko'rdik.

en: Next he advanced toward us, and laying his hand upon me, took me up by the nape of my neck, and turned me around, as a butcher would do a sheep’s head.
uz: Keyin u bizga qarab oldinga bordi va qo'lini menga qo'yib, bo'ynimdan ushladi va go'shtxo'r qo'y boshini qilgandek, meni orqaga burdi.

en: After having examined me, and perceiving me to be so lean that I was nothing but skin and bone, he let me go.
uz: Meni tekshirib, shunchalik ozg'in ekanligimni anglab yetgandan so'ng, meni faqat teri va suyakdan boshqa narsa emasligimni anglab yetgach, u meni qo'yib yubordi.

en: He took up the rest one by one, and viewed them in the same manner.
uz: U qolganlarni birin-ketin oldi va ularga xuddi shunday qaradi.

en: The captain being the fattest, he held him with one hand, as I would do a sparrow, and thrust a spit through him; he then kindled a great fire, roasted, and ate him for his supper.
uz: Qo'mondon eng semiz bo'lgani uchun, uni bir qo'li bilan ushladi, xuddi men chumchuq kabi, va unga tupurdi; so'ngra katta olov yoqdi, qovurdi va kechki ovqat uchun yedi.

en: Having finished his repast, he returned to his porch, where he fell asleep, snoring louder than thunder.
uz: Ovqatlanishni tugatgach, u ayvoniga qaytib keldi va u yerda momaqaldiroqdan ham balandroq xirillab uxladi.

en: He slept thus till morning.
uz: U shunday qilib ertalabgacha uxladi.

en: As to ourselves, it was not possible for us to enjoy any rest, and we passed the night in the most painful apprehension that can be imagined.
uz: O'zimizga kelsak, bizga hech qanday dam olishning imkoni bo'lmadi va biz tunni tasavvur qilish mumkin bo'lgan eng og'riqli xavotirda o'tkazdik.

en: When day appeared the giant awoke, got up, went out, and left us in the palace.
uz: Kunduz paydo bo'lganda, ulkan odam uyg'onib, o'rnidan turdi, tashqariga chiqdi va bizni saroyda qoldirdi.

en: We determined to revenge ourselves on the brutish giant, and did so in the following manner.
uz: Biz shafqatsiz gigantdan o'zimizni qasos olishga qaror qildik va buni quyidagi usulda qildik.

en: That night after he had again made his frightful supper on another of our seamen, he lay down on his back, and fell asleep.
uz: O'sha kechasi u yana bir dengizchimizga dahshatli kechki ovqat tayyorlagandan so'ng, orqaga yotdi va uxladi.

en: As soon as we heard him snore according to his custom, nine of the boldest among us, with myself, took each of us a spit, and putting the points of them into the fire till they were red hot, we thrust them into his eye all at once, and blinded him.
uz: Uning odatiga ko'ra xirillayotganini eshitishimiz bilanoq, men ham, oramizdagi eng jasur to'qqiz kishi ham har birimizga tupurib, qizarib ketguncha o'tga sepib, bir zumda uning ko'ziga tiqdik va ko'r qildik.

en: The pain made him break out into a frightful yell: he started up, and stretched out his hands in order to sacrifice some of us to his rage; but we ran to such places as he could not reach; and after having sought for us in vain, he groped for the gate, and went out, howling in agony.
uz: Og'riq uni dahshatli qichqiriqga aylantirdi: u o'rnidan turdi va qo'llarini cho'zdi, bizlardan ba'zilarimizni g'azabiga qurbon qilish uchun; lekin biz u yetib bora olmaydigan joylarga yugurdik; va bizni behuda qidirib, darvozani ushladi va tashqariga chiqib, azobda o'kirdi.

en: We immediately left the palace, and made for the shore, where we built rafts with timber that lay about in great quantities, each large enough to carry three men.
uz: Biz darhol saroyni tark etdik va qirg'oqqa yo'l oldik. U yerda juda ko'p yog'ochdan yasalgan, har biri uch kishini tashish uchun yetarli bo'lgan balkalar qurdik.

en: We waited till day in order to get upon them, for we hoped if the giant did not appear by sunrise and should stop his howling, which we still heard, that he would prove to be
uz: Biz ularga yetib olish uchun kunduzgacha kutdik, chunki biz ulkan odam quyosh chiqishi bilan paydo bo'lmasligini va u hali ham eshitayotgan o'kirishini to'xtatishini umid qilardik, shunda u o'zini ko'rsatardi.

en: dead; and if that happened to be the case, we resolved to stay on the island, and not to risk our lives upon the rafts.
uz: o'lik; va agar shunday bo'lib qolsa, biz orolda qolishga qaror qildik va kemalarda jonimizni xavf ostiga qo'ymaslikka qaror qildik.

en: But day had scarcely appeared, when we perceived our cruel enemy, accompanied by two others, almost of the same size, leading him; and a great number more coming at a quick pace.
uz: Ammo kun deyarli ko'rinmadi, qachonki biz shafqatsiz dushmanimizni, deyarli bir xil o'lchamdagi yana ikki kishini hamrohligida, yetaklab kelayotganini va tez sur'atlar bilan kelayotgan ko'p sonni sezardik.

en: We hurried to take to our rafts, and put to sea with all the speed we could.
uz: Biz qayiqlarimizga shoshildik va imkon qadar tezroq dengizga otdik.

en: The giants, on seeing this, took up great stones, and running to the shore, entered the water up to the middle, and threw so exactly that they sunk all the rafts but that I was upon; and all my companions, except the two with me, were drowned.
uz: Ulkanlar buni ko'rib, katta toshlarni ko'tarib, qirg'oqqa yugurib kirishdi, suvga o'rtasigacha kirishdi va shunday uloqtirdilarki, men bo'lganidan boshqa barcha kemalarni cho'ktirdilar; va men bilan birga bo'lganlardan tashqari barcha hamrohlarim cho'kib ketdi.

en: We rowed with all our might, and at last got out of reach of the giants.
uz: Biz bor kuchimiz bilan eshkak eshdik va nihoyat ulkanlarning qo'lidan chiqib ketdik.

en: But out at sea we were exposed to the mercy of the waves and winds, and spent that day and the following night under the most painful conditions.
uz: Lekin dengizda biz to'lqinlar va shamollarning rahm-shafqatiga duch keldik va o'sha kunni va keyingi tunni eng og'riqli sharoitlarda o'tkazdik.

en: But next morning we had the good fortune to be thrown upon an island, where we landed with much joy.
uz: Ammo ertasi kuni ertalab biz orolga tashlanish baxtiga muyassar bo'ldik, u yerda juda xursandchilik bilan qo'ndik.

en: Here we found excellent fruit, which recruited our strength.
uz: Bu yerda ajoyib meva topdik, u bizning kuchimizni jalb qildi.

en: At night we went to sleep on the seashore; but we were awakened by the noise of a serpent of surprising length and thickness, whose scales made a rustling noise as he wound himself along.
uz: Kechasi dengiz sohilida uxlashga bordik; lekin bizni hayratlanarli uzunlik va qalinlikdagi ilon shovqini uyg'otdi, uning tarozilari o'zini o'rab yurganida shovqin chiqardi.

en: It swallowed up one of my comrades, notwithstanding his loud cries, and the efforts he made to escape; dashing him several times against the ground, it crushed him, and we could hear it gnaw and tear the poor fellow’s bones, though we had fled to a considerable distance.
uz: U bir o'rtoqimni yutib yubordi, uning baland baqirig'iga va qochishga urinishlariga qaramay; uni bir necha marta yerga urib, ezdi, va biz uni g'ijirlatib, bechoraning suyaklarini yirtib tashlaganini eshitardik, garchi ancha uzoqroqqa qochgan bo'lsak ham.

en: The following day, as we walked about, we saw a tall tree, upon which we decided to pass the night; and having satisfied our hunger with fruit, we mounted it accordingly.
uz: Ertasi kuni, aylanib yurganimizda, baland daraxtni ko'rdik, ustida tunab qolishga qaror qildik; va ochligimizni meva bilan qondirib, unga mos ravishda o'tirdik.

en: Shortly after, the serpent came hissing to the foot of the tree, raised itself up against the trunk of it, and reaching my comrade, who sat lower than I, swallowed him at once, and went off.
uz: Ko'p o'tmay, ilon daraxt etagiga shivirlab keldi, uning tanasiga o'zini ko'tardi va mendan pastroq o'tirgan o'rtoqimga yetib kelib, uni darhol yutdi va ketdi.

en: I remained upon the tree till it was day, and then came down, more like a dead man than one alive, expecting the fate of my two companions.
uz: Men daraxt ustida kunduzgacha qoldim, keyin esa tirik odamdan ko'ra o'lik odamdek pastga tushdim, ikki hamrohimning taqdirini kutdim.

en: This filled me with such horror, that I advanced some steps to throw myself into the sea; but I withstood this dictate of
uz: Bu meni shunchalik dahshatga soldi-ki, o'zimni dengizga tashlash uchun bir necha qadam oldinga qadam tashladim; lekin men bu buyruqqa bardosh berdim.

en: despair, and submitted myself to the will of God, who disposes of our lives at His pleasure.
uz: umidsizlikka tushdim va o'zimni Xudoning irodasiga bo'ysundim, U bizning hayotimizni O'z xohishiga ko'ra sarflaydi.

en: During the day I collected together a great quantity of small wood, brambles, and dry thorns, and making them up into faggots, made a wide circle with them round the tree, and also tied some of them to the branches.
uz: Kunduzi men juda ko'p miqdorda kichik yog'och, tikanlar va quruq tikanlarni yig'dim va ularni tikanlarga aylantirib, daraxt atrofida keng doira yasadim, shuningdek, ba'zilarini shoxlarga bog'ladim.

en: Having done this, when the evening came I shut myself up within this circle.
uz: Buni qilib bo'lgach, oqshom bo'lgach, men o'zimni shu doira ichida mahkamladim.

en: The serpent failed not to come at the usual hour, and went round the tree, seeking for an opportunity to devour me, but was prevented by the rampart I had made; so that he lay till day, like a cat watching in vain for a mouse that has fortunately reached a place of safety.
uz: Ilon odatdagi soatda kelmaslikka muvaffaq bo'ldi va daraxt atrofida aylanib, meni yutish imkoniyatini izladi, lekin men qilgan to'siqqa to'sqinlik qildi; shuning uchun u kun bo'yi yotdi, xuddi mushuk kabi, omadli ravishda xavfsiz joyga yetib kelgan sichqonchaga behuda qarab turardi.
