en: When day We found it to be a gate of ebony
uz: Qachonki kun Biz uni qora rangli darvoza deb topdik.

en: appeared, he retired, but I dared not to leave my fort until the sun rose.
uz: Ko'rindi, u nafaqaga chiqdi, lekin quyosh chiqmaguncha qal'amdan ketishga jur'at etmadim.

en: God took compassion on my hopeless state; for just as I was going, finally in desperation, to throw myself into the sea, I perceived a ship in the distance.
uz: Xudo mening umidsiz ahvolimga rahm qildi; chunki men nihoyat umidsizlikda o'zimni dengizga tashlashga ketayotganimda, uzoqda bir kemani sezdim.

en: I called as loud as I could, and unfolding the linen of my turban, displayed it, that they might observe me.
uz: Qo'limdan kelgancha baland ovozda chaqirdim va to'shagimning zig'irini ochib, ular meni kuzatishlari uchun uni namoyish etdim.

en: This had the desired effect; the crew perceived me, and the captain sent
uz: Bu kerakli effektga ega bo'ldi; ekipaj meni sezdi va kapitan jo'natdi.

en: As soon as I came on board, the merchants and seamen flocked about me, to know how I came to that desert island.
uz: Men kemada bo'lishim bilan, savdogarlar va dengizchilar men atrofimga to'planishdi, ular o'sha cho'l orolga qanday kelganimni bilish uchun.

en: After I had related to them all that had befallen me, the oldest among them said they had several times heard of the giants that dwelt on that island, and that they were cannibals and also of the serpents.
uz: Menga tushgan hamma narsani ularga aytib berganimdan so'ng, ularning eng keksalari o'sha orolda yashovchi ulkanlar, shuningdek, ular kanniballar va ilonlar haqida bir necha marta eshitganliklarini aytdilar.

en: After having expressed their joy at my escape from so many dangers, they brought me the best of their provisions and took me before the captain, who, seeing that I was in rags, gave me one of his own suits.
uz: Ko'plab xavflardan qochganimdan xursand bo'lishganlaridan so'ng, ular menga o'zlarining eng yaxshi taomlarini olib kelishdi va meni kapitan huzuriga olib kelishdi. kapitan esa, men mato kiyganimni ko'rib, menga o'z kostyumlaridan birini berdi.

en: Looking steadfastly upon him, I knew him to be the person who, in my second voyage, had left me in the island where I fell asleep, without sending to seek for me.
uz: Unga qat'iy nazar bilan qaraganimda, uni ikkinchi safarimda meni uxlagan orolga tashlab ketgan, meni qidirishga yubormagan odam deb bilardim.

en: I was not surprised that he, believing me to be dead, did not recognize me.
uz: U meni o'lgan deb o'ylab, meni tanimaganiga hayron bo'lmadim.

en: “Captain,” said I, “look at me, and you may know that I am Sindbad, whom you left on that desert island.” The captain, having considered me attentively, recognized me.
uz: Kapitan,  dedim men,  menga qarang, shunda bilishingiz mumkinki, men Sindbadman, uni o'sha cho'l orolda qoldirgansiz. Kapitan meni diqqat bilan ko'rib, tanib oldi.

en: “God be praised!” said he, embracing me; “I rejoice that fortune has rectified my fault.
uz: Allohga hamd bo'lsin! dedi u meni quchoqlab; Men omad mening aybimni to'g'rilagani uchun xursandman.

en: There are your goods, which I always took care to preserve.” I took them from him, and made him my acknowledgments for his care of them.
uz: Sizning mol-mulklaringiz bor, ularni doimo saqlab qolishga g'amxo'rlik qildim. Men ularni undan oldim va ularga g'amxo'rlik qilganligi uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirdim.

en: We continued at sea for some time, touched at several is­ lands, and at last landed at that of Salabat, where sandalwood is obtained, which is much used in medicine.
uz: Biz dengizda bir muncha vaqt davom etdik, bir nechta quruqliklarda qo'lga tushdik va nihoyat Salabatga qo'ndik, u yerda sendal daraxti olinadi, u tibbiyotda ko'p qo'llaniladi.

en: From the isle of Salabat we went to another, where I furnished myself with cloves, cinnamon, and other spices.
uz: Salabat orolidan boshqasiga bordik, u yerda o'zimga mixlar, dolchin va boshqa ziravorlar bilan ta'minladim.

en: In short, after a long voyage, I arrived at Bussorah, and returned to Bagdad with so much wealth that I knew not its extent.
uz: Xullas, uzoq sayohatdan so'ng, Bussoraga yetib keldim va Bag'dodda shunchalik boylik bilan qaytdimki, uning hajmini bilmasdim.

en: I gave a great deal to the poor, and bought another considerable estate in addition to what I had already.
uz: Men kambag'allarga juda ko'p narsa berdim va allaqachon menda bo'lganidan tashqari yana bir sezilarli mulkni sotib oldim.

en: Thus Sindbad finished the history of his third voyage.
uz: Shunday qilib, Sindbad o'zining uchinchi sayohatining tarixini yakunladi.

en: He gave another hundred sequins to Hindbad and invited him to dinner again the next day, to hear
uz: U Hindbadga yana yuz dona qovun berdi va ertasi kuni uni yana kechki ovqatga taklif qildi, eshitish uchun.

en: The Fourth Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor After I had rested from the dangers of my third voyage, my passion for trade and my love of novelty again prevailed.
uz: Sindbad dengizchining to'rtinchi sayohati. Uchinchi safarimdagi xavflardan xalos bo'lgandan so'ng, savdoga bo'lgan ishtiyoqim va yangiliklarga bo'lgan muhabbatim yana ustun keldi.

en: I therefore settled my affairs, and provided a stock of goods fit for the traffic I meant to engage in.
uz: Shunday qilib, ishlarimni hal qildim va men qatnashmoqchi bo'lgan trafik uchun mos keladigan tovarlarni ta'minladim.

en: I took the route to Persia, traveled over several provinces, and arrived at a port, where I embarked.
uz: Men Forsga yo'l oldim, bir nechta viloyatlarni kezib o'tdim va portga yetib keldim, u yerga tushdim.

en: On putting out to sea, we were We Stayed Near the Place Where We Had Been Cast Ashore overtaken by a sudden tempest that obliged the captain to lower his yards, and take all necessary precautions to prevent being wrecked.
uz: Dengizga chiqishdan so'ng, Biz Ashorga tashlangan joyimiz yaqinida qoldik. To'satdan bo'ron kelib tushdi va kapitan o'z hovlisini pastga tushirishga va halokatga uchramaslik uchun barcha zarur choralarni ko'rishga majbur bo'ldi.

en: The sails were split in a thousand pieces, and the ship was stranded; some of the merchants and seamen were drowned, and the cargo was lost.
uz: Yelkanlar ming bo'lakka bo'linib ketdi va kema qolib ketdi; ba'zi savdogarlar va dengizchilar cho'kib ketdi va yuk yo'qoldi.

en: I had the good fortune, with several of the merchants and mariners, to get upon some planks, and we were carried by the current to an island which lay before us.
uz: Menga bir nechta savdogar va dengizchilar bilan birga bir nechta taxtalarga chiqish baxtiga muyassar bo'ldim va biz oqim orqali oldimizda turgan orolga olib ketildik.

en: There we found fruit and
uz: U yerda meva topdik va

en: spring water, which preserved our lives.
uz: Bahor suvi, hayotimizni saqlab qolgan.

en: We stayed all night near the place where we had been cast ashore.
uz: Biz qirg'oqqa uloqtirilgan joy yaqinida butun tunni qoldik.

en: Next morning, as soon as the sun was up, we explored the island, and saw some houses, which we approached.
uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab, quyosh chiqishi bilanoq, orolni o'rganib chiqdik va yaqinlashayotgan ba'zi uylarni ko'rdik.

en: As soon as we drew near, we were encompassed by a great number of negroes, who seized us, shared us among them, and carried us to their respective habitations.
uz: Yaqinlashishimiz bilanoq, bizni juda ko'p miqdorda qora tanlilar o'rab oldi, ular bizni ushlashdi, ular orasida bo'lishdi va o'z yashash joylariga olib ketishdi.

en: I and five of my comrades were carried to one place; here our captors made us sit down, and gave us a certain herb, which they made signs to us to eat.
uz: Men va beshta hamrohim bir joyga olib ketildi; bu yerda asirlarimiz bizni o'tirtirtirdi va bizga ma'lum bir o't berdi, uni bizga yeyishga belgi qilib berishdi.

en: My comrades not noticing that the blacks ate none of it themselves, thought only of satisfying their hunger, and ate with greediness.
uz: O'rtoqlarim qora tanlilarning o'zlari hech narsa yemayotganini sezmay, faqat o'zlarining ochliklarini qondirish haqida o'ylashardi va ochko'zlik bilan yeyishardi.

en: But I, suspecting some trick, would not so much as taste it, which happened well for me; for in a little time I perceived my companions had lost their senses, and that when they spoke to me they knew not what they said.
uz: Lekin men, qandaydir hiyla gumon qilib, uni tatib ko'rishni ham xohlamasdim, bu men uchun yaxshi sodir bo'ldi; chunki bir oz vaqt ichida men sheriklarim aqldan ozganini va ular men bilan gaplashganda nima deyayotganlarini bilmasligini angladim.

en: The negroes fed us afterward with rice, prepared with oil of cocoa-nuts; and my comrades, who had lost their reason, ate of it freely.
uz: Qora tanlilar keyin bizni guruch bilan oziqlantirishdi, u kakao yong'oq yog'i bilan tayyorlangan edi; aqldan ozgan o'rtoqlarim esa undan bemalol yeyishardi.

en: I also partook of it, but very sparingly.
uz: Men ham unda qatnashdim, lekin juda tejamkor.

en: They gave us that herb at first to deprive us of our senses, that we might not be aware of the destiny prepared for us; and they gave us rice to fatten us; for, being cannibals, their design was to eat us as soon as we grew fat.
uz: Ular bizga o'sha o'tni dastlab bizni his-tuyg'ularimizdan mahrum qilish uchun berishdi, toki biz uchun tayyorlangan taqdirdan xabardor bo'lmasligimiz uchun; va ular bizga guruch berishdi, bizni semirtirish uchun; chunki, kannibal bo'lganlari uchun, ularning maqsadi bizni semirib ketishimiz bilan yeyish edi.

en: This accordingly happened, and they gradually devoured my comrades, who were not sensible of their condition; but my senses being entire, you may easily guess that instead of growing fat, as the rest did, I grew leaner every day.
uz: Shunday bo'ldi va ular asta-sekin o'z holatlarini anglamagan o'rtoqlarimni yeb bitirdilar; lekin sezgilarim butun bo'lgani uchun, qolganlar kabi semirish o'rniga, har kuni ozg'inroq bo'lib borayotganimni osongina taxmin qilishingiz mumkin.

en: The fear of death under which I labored, turned all my food into poison.
uz: Mening mehnat qilgan o'lim qo'rquvim butun ovqatimni zaharga aylantirdi.

en: I fell into a languishing illness, which proved my safety; for the negroes, having killed and eaten my companions, finding me to be withered, lean, and sick, deferred my death.
uz: Men azob chekayotgan kasallikka tushdim, bu mening xavfsizligimni isbotladi; chunki negrlar, o'ldirgan va yegan hamrohimni, meni so'lg'in, ozg'in va kasal holda topib, o'limimni kechiktirdilar.

en: Meanwhile I had much liberty, so that scarcely any notice was taken of what I did, and this gave me an opportunity one day to get to a distance from the huts, and to make my escape.
uz: Ayni paytda menda juda ko'p erkinlik bor edi, shuning uchun qilgan ishim haqida deyarli hech narsa e'tiborga olinmadi va bu menga bir kun kulbalardan uzoqroqqa yetib borish va qochish imkoniyatini berdi.

en: An old man who saw me, and suspected my design, called to me as loud as he could to return; but instead of obeying him, I redoubled my speed,
uz: Meni ko'rgan va mening loyihamdan gumon qilgan bir chol menga qaytib kelishga imkon qadar baland ovozda chaqirib yubordi; lekin unga itoat etish o'rniga, tezligimni ikki barobar oshirib yubordim.

en: and quickly got out of sight.
uz: va tezda ko'zdan g'oyib bo'ldi.

en: At that time there was none but the old man about the village, the rest being abroad, and not to return till night, which was usual with them.
uz: O'sha paytda qishloq atrofida faqat keksa odam bor edi, qolganlari esa chet elda edilar va ular odatdagidek kechgacha qaytib kelmas edilar.

en: Therefore, being sure that they could not arrive in time to pursue me, I went on till night, when I stopped to rest a little, and to eat some of the provisions I had taken along; but I speedily set forward again and traveled seven days, avoiding those places which seemed to be inhabited, and lived for the most part upon cocoa-nuts, which served me both for meat and drink.
uz: Shuning uchun, ular meni ta'qib qilish uchun vaqtida yetib bora olmasligiga ishonch hosil qilib, kechgacha davom etdim, shunda biroz dam olib, o'zim bilan olgan ba'zi taomlarni yeyish uchun to'xtadim; lekin tezda oldinga chiqib, yetti kun sayohat qildim, go'yo odamlar yashaydigan joylardan qochib, asosan kakao yong'oqlari bilan yashadim, ular menga ham go'sht, ham ichimlik uchun xizmat qilardi.

en: On the eighth day I came near the sea, and saw some white people, like myself, gathering pepper, of which there was great plenty in that place.
uz: Sakkizinchi kuni men dengizga yaqinlashdim va o'zimga o'xshagan oq tanli odamlarni qalampir yig'ayotganini ko'rdim, u yerda juda ko'p qalampir bor edi.

en: The people who gathered pepper came to meet me as soon as they saw me, and asked me in Arabic who I was and whence I came.
uz: Qalampir yig'gan odamlar meni ko'rishlari bilanoq kutib olishdi va arab tilida kimligimni va qayerdan kelganimni so'rashdi.

en: I was overjoyed to hear them speak in my own language, and satisfied their curiosity by giving them an account of my shipwreck, and how I fell into the hands of the negroes.
uz: Ularning o'z tilimda gapirishayotganini eshitib juda xursand bo'ldim va ularga kemamning halokatini va qanday qilib negalarning qo'liga tushganimni aytib, qiziqishlarini qondirdim.

en: “Those negroes,” replied they, “eat men; by what miracle did you escape their cruelty?” I related to them the circumstances I have just mentioned, at which they were greatly surprised.
uz: Ular javob berishdi: Osha qora tanlilar, odamlarni ye, qanday mojiza bilan ularning shafqatsizligidan qutulding? Men ularga men hozir aytib otgan holatlarni aytib berdim, ulardan juda hayratda qolishdi.

en: I stayed with them till they had gathered their pepper, and then sailed with them to the island from whence they had come.
uz: Men ularning qalampirini yig'ib olguncha ular bilan qoldim, keyin ular kelgan orolga ular bilan suzib ketdim.

en: They presented me to their king, who was a good prince.
uz: Ular meni o'zlarining shohiga taqdim etishdi, u yaxshi shahzoda edi.

en: He had the patience to hear the relation of my adventures, which surprised him; and he afterward gave me clothes, and commanded care to be taken of me.
uz: U meni hayratga solgan sarguzashtlarim haqidagi xabarni eshitishga sabr qildi; keyin menga kiyim berdi va mendan olinishni buyurdi.

en: The island was well peopled, plentiful in everything and the capital a place of great trade.
uz: Orol yaxshi aholisi bor edi, hamma narsada mo'l-ko'l edi va poytaxt katta savdo joyi edi.

en: This agreeable retreat was very comfortable to me after my misfortunes, and the kindness of the generous prince completed my satisfaction.
uz: Bu yoqimli dam olish maskani noqulayliklarimdan keyin men uchun juda qulay edi va saxovatli shahzodaning mehri mening qoniqishimni to'ldirdi.

en: In a word, there was not a person more in favor with him than myself, and consequently every man in court and city sought to oblige me; so that in a very little time I was looked upon rather as a native than a stranger.
uz: Bir so'z bilan aytganda, unga mendan ko'ra ko'proq yoqadigan odam yo'q edi, shuning uchun saroy va shahardagi har bir odam meni majburlamoqchi edi; shuning uchun juda qisqa vaqt ichida men begona odamdan ko'ra mahalliy odam sifatida qaraldim.

en: As I paid my court very constantly to the king, he said to me one day, “Sindbad, I love thee.
uz: Men saroyimni podshohga doimiy ravishda to'lar ekanman, u bir kuni menga dedi: Sindbad, men seni sevaman.

en: I have one thing to demand of thee,
uz: Sendan bir narsani talab qilmoqchiman.

en: which thou must grant.
uz: Sen berishing kerak bo'lgan.

en: I have in mind thou shouldst marry, that so thou mayst stay in my dominions, and think no more of thy own country.” I durst not resist the prince’s will, and he gave me one of the ladies of his court, noble, beautiful, and rich.
uz: Menimcha, sen turmushga chiqishing kerak, shunda mening hukmdorligimda qola olasan va o'z mamlakating haqida boshqa o'ylama. Men shahzodaning irodasiga qarshilik ko'rsatishga jur'at eta olmadim, va u menga saroyidagi ayollardan birini berdi, olijanob, go'zal va boy edi.

en: The ceremonies of marriage being over, I dwelt with my wife, and for some time we lived together in perfect harmony.
uz: Nikoh marosimlari tugagach, men xotinim bilan yashadim va bir muncha vaqt birga mukammal uyg'unlikda yashadik.

en: I was not, however, content with my banishment, but wished to return to Bagdad, which my present life, how advantageous soever, could not make me forget.
uz: Lekin men surgunimdan qoniqmadim, balki Bag'daddga qaytishni xohlardim, buni hozirgi hayotim, qanchalik foydali bo'lmasin, unutib yubormasdi.

en: At this time the wife of one of my neighbors, with whom I had contracted a friendship, fell sick and died.
uz: Ayni paytda qo'shnilarimdan birining rafiqasi, men bilan do'stlashdim, kasal bo'lib vafot etdi.

en: I went to see and comfort him in his affliction, and finding him absorbed in sorrow, I said to him as soon as I saw him, “God preserve you and grant you a long life.” “Alas!” replied he, “how do you think that could happen?
uz: Men uni ko'rgani bordim va uning dardida tasalli berdim, va uni qayg'uga botganini ko'rib, uni ko'rgan zahoti unga dedim: Xudo seni asrasin va uzoq umr bersin. U javob berdi: Alas! Bu qanday sodir bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylayapsan?

en: I have not above an hour to live, for I must be buried this day with my wife.
uz: Mening bir soatdan ko'p umr ko'rishim yo'q, chunki bugun xotinim bilan birga dafn etilishi kerak.

en: The living husband is interred with the dead wife, and the living wife with the dead husband.” While he was giving me an account of this barbarous custom, the very relation of which chilled my blood, his kindred, friends, and neighbors came to assist at the funeral.
uz: Tirik er o'lik xotin bilan, tirik xotin esa o'lik er bilan ko'milgan. U menga bu vahshiyona odat haqida hikoya qilayotganida, uning o'zi mening qonimni sovutgan edi, uning qarindoshlari, do'stlari va qo'shnilari dafn marosimida yordamga kelishdi.

en: They dressed the corpse of the woman in her richest apparel and all her jewels, as if it had been her wedding-day; then they placed her on an open bier, and began their march to the place of burial.
uz: Ular ayolning jasadini uning eng boy kiyimlari va barcha taqinchoqlariga go'yo to'y kuni bo'lgandek kiydirishdi; so'ngra uni ochiq choyshabga qo'yishdi va dafn joyiga yurishni boshlashdi.

en: The husband walked first, next to the dead body.
uz: Er birinchi bo'lib, o'lik jasad yonida yurdi.

en: They went to a high mountain, and when they reached it, they took up a large stone which formed the mouth of a deep pit, and let down the body with all its apparel and jewels.
uz: Ular baland tog'ga chiqishdi va unga yetib borgach, chuqur chuqurning og'zini tashkil etuvchi katta toshni ko'tarib, jasadni barcha kiyimlari va taqinchoqlari bilan pastga tushirishdi.

en: Then the husband, embracing his kindred and friends, suffered himself to be placed on another bier, with a pot of water, and seven small loaves, and was let down in the same manner.
uz: Shunda er o'z qarindoshlari va do'stlarini quchoqlab, o'zini boshqa bir idishga, bir qozonga suv va yetti kichik non bilan qo'yishga ruxsat berdi va xuddi shunday qilib pastga tushirildi.

en: The ceremony being over, the mouth of the pit was again covered with the stone, and the company returned.
uz: Marosim tugagach, chuqurning og'zi yana tosh bilan qoplandi va kompaniya qaytib keldi.

en: I mention this ceremony the more particularly, because I was in a few weeks’ time to be the principal actor on a similar occasion.
uz: Men bu marosimni ayniqsa alohida tilga olaman, chunki men bir necha hafta ichida shunga o'xshash tadbirda asosiy aktyor bo'lgan edim.

en: my own wife fell sick and died.
uz: Mening o'z xotinim kasal bo'lib, vafot etdi.

en: I made every remonstrance I could to the king not to expose me, a foreigner, to this inhuman law.
uz: Men podshohga o'zimni, begona odamni, bu insoniy qonunga duchor qilmaslik uchun qo'limdan kelgancha qarshilik ko'rsatdim.

en: The king and all his court, with the most considerable persons of the city, sought merely to soften my sorrow by honoring the funeral ceremony with their presence; and at the termination of the ceremony I was lowered into the pit with a vessel full of water, and seven loaves.
uz: Shoh va uning butun saroyi, shaharning eng nufuzli shaxslari bilan birga, dafn marosimini o'zlarining ishtiroklari bilan hurmat qilish orqali g'amimni yumshatishga harakat qilishdi; marosim tugagandan so'ng, meni suv to'la idish va yetti non bilan chuqurga tushirishdi.

en: As I approached the bottom I discovered, by the aid of the little light that came from above, the nature of this subterranean place; it seemed an endless cavern, and might be about fifty fathoms deep.
uz: Pastga yaqinlashar ekanman, yuqoridan kelayotgan kichik yorug'lik yordamida bu yer osti joyining tabiatini angladim; u cheksiz g'orga o'xshardi va taxminan ellik fathom chuqurlikda bo'lishi mumkin edi.

en: I lived for some time in this awful place upon my bread and water, when, one day, as it was about gone I heard something tread, and breathing or panting as it moved.
uz: Men bir muncha vaqt shu dahshatli joyda non va suv ustida yashadim, bir kuni, deyarli yo'q bo'lib ketayotganda, nimadir oyoq urayotganini eshitdim va u harakatlanayotganda nafas oldim yoki oh tortdim.

en: I followed the sound.
uz: Men tovushga ergashdim.

en: The animal seemed to stop sometimes, but always fled and breathed hard as I approached.
uz: Hayvon ba'zan to'xtayotgandek tuyuldi, lekin men yaqinlashganda doim qochib, qattiq nafas olardi.

en: I pursued it for a considerable time, till at last I perceived a light, resembling a star; I went on, sometimes losing sight of it, but always finding it again, and at last discovered that it came through a hole in the rock, which I got through, and found myself upon the seashore, at which I felt exceeding joy.
uz: Men uni ancha vaqt davom ettirdim, oxiri yulduzga o'xshash nurni sezdim; ba'zan uni ko'zdan qochirib, doim qayta topib yurdim va nihoyat u toshdagi teshikdan o'tganini angladim, undan o'tib, dengiz sohilida o'zimni topdim, undan haddan tashqari xursand bo'ldim.

en: I prostrated myself on the shore to thank God for this mercy, and shortly afterward I perceived a ship making for the place where I was.
uz: Men bu marhamat uchun Xudoga minnatdorchilik bildirish uchun qirg'oqqa cho'kdim va ko'p o'tmay men o'tirgan joyim uchun kemaning harakatlanayotganini payqadim.

en: I made a sign with the linen of my turban, and called to the crew as loud as I could.
uz: Men turbanimning zig'iridan belgi yasadim va ekipajni imkon qadar baland ovozda chaqirdim.

en: They noticed me, and sent a boat to bring me on board.
uz: Ular meni payqashdi va meni bortga olib kelish uchun qayiq yubordilar.

en: We put to sea again, and touched at several other ports; but at last I arrived happily at Bagdad.
uz: Biz yana dengizga otlandik va bir nechta boshqa portlarga qo'ndik; lekin nihoyat Bag'dodda xursand bo'lib yetib keldim.

en: Here Sindbad made a new present of one hundred sequins to Hindbad, whom he requested to return with the rest of the guests next day at the same hour, to dine with him and hear the story of his fifth voyage.
uz: Bu yerda Sindbad Hindbadga yuzta qovurg'adan iborat yangi sovg'a qildi va undan keyingi kuni shu soatdagi qolgan mehmonlar bilan birga qaytishni, u bilan birga ovqatlanishni va beshinchi safarining hikoyasini eshitishni so'radi.

en: “You will see that day has come, my lord,” the sultaness broke off to say, “and that I cannot now tell you the surprising adventures of Sindbad’s fifth voyage.
uz: Siz o'sha kun kelganini ko'rasiz, xo'jayin,  dedi sultonim,  va endi Sindbadning beshinchi safaridagi ajablanarli sarguzashtlarni sizga aytib bera olmayman.

en: But to-morrow, if it pleases you, I am ready to go on.” And the next night she did go on, relating the further adventures of Sindbad.
uz: Lekin ertaga, agar sizga yoqsa, men davom etishga tayyorman. Va ertasi kuni kechasi u davom etib, Sindbadning keyingi sarguzashtlarini hikoya qildi.

en: The Fifth Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor All the troubles and calamities I had undergone could not cure me of my inclination to make new voyages.
uz: Sindbad dengizchining beshinchi sayohati. Boshimdan o'tgan barcha tashvishlar va ofatlar meni yangi sayohatlar qilishga bo'lgan moyilligimdan xalos qila olmadi.

en: I therefore bought goods, departed with them for the best seaport, and there, that I might not be obliged to depend upon a captain, but have a ship at my own command, I had one built on purpose, at my own charge.
uz: Shunday qilib, men tovarlar sotib oldim va ular bilan eng yaxshi dengiz portiga jo'nab ketdim. U yerda, kapitanga bog'lanishga majbur bo'lmasligim uchun, balki o'z qo'mondonim bo'yicha kemaga ega bo'lishim uchun, o'z hisobimdan maxsus kema qurdirdim.

en: When the ship was ready I went on board with my goods; but not having enough to load her, I agreed to take with me several merchants of different nations, with their merchandise.
uz: Kema tayyor bo'lgach, men o'z mol-mulkim bilan bortga bordim; lekin uni yuklashga yetarli bo'lmagani uchun, turli millatlardan bo'lgan bir nechta savdogarlarni o'zim bilan olib ketishga rozi bo'ldim, ularning mol-mulki bilan.

en: We sailed with the first fair wind, and the first place we touched at was a desert island, where we found the egg of a roc, equal in size to that I had formerly seen.
uz: Biz birinchi yaxshi shamol bilan suzdik va birinchi qo'limizga tekkan joy cho'l orol edi, u yerda men avval ko'rgan o'lchamga teng bo'lgan tosh tuxumini topdik.

en: There was a young roc in it, just ready to be hatched, and its beak had begun to break the egg.
uz: Unda yosh tosh bor edi, endigina chiqishga tayyor edi va uning tumshug'i tuxumni sindira boshlagan edi.

en: The merchants who landed with me broke the egg with hatchets, pulled out the young roc and roasted it.
uz: Men bilan qo'lga tushgan savdogarlar tuxumni g'altaklar bilan sindirishdi, yosh toshni olib chiqishdi va qovurishdi.

en: I in vain entreated them not to meddle with the egg.
uz: Men ulardan bejizga tuxumga aralashmaslikni iltimos qildim.

en: Scarcely had they finished their feast, when there appeared in the air, at a considerable distance, two great clouds.
uz: Ular ziyofatlarini deyarli tugatmaganlarida, havoda ancha uzoqlikda ikkita katta bulut paydo bo'ldi.

en: The captain of my ship, knowing by experience what they meant, said they were the male and female parents of the roc, and pressed us to re-embark with all speed, to prevent if possible the misfortune which would otherwise befall us.
uz: Mening kemamning kapitani, ularning nimani nazarda tutganini tajriba orqali bilib, ular rokning erkak va ayol ota-onalari ekanligini aytdi va iloji bo'lsa, boshimizga tushadigan baxtsizlikning oldini olish uchun, barcha tezlik bilan qaytishga majbur qildi.

en: The two rocs approached with a frightful noise, which they redoubled when they saw the egg broken, and their young one gone.
uz: Ikki qoya dahshatli shovqin bilan yaqinlashdi, ular tuxumning singanini va ularning kichkintoylari yo'qolganini ko'rgach, uni ikki barobar ko'paytirishdi.

en: They flew over us with horrid cries and then back in the direction they had come, and disappeared for some time, while we made all the sail we could to endeavor to escape that which unhappily befell us.
uz: Ular bizdan dahshatli faryodlar bilan uchib o'tib, keyin kelgan yo'nalishlariga qaytib, bir muncha vaqt yo'qolishdi, biz esa baxtsiz hodisalardan qochishga harakat qilish uchun bor kuchimizni sarfladik.

en: They soon returned, and we observed that each of them carried between its talons an enormous rock.
uz: Ular tez orada qaytib kelishdi va biz ularning har biri tumshug'i orasida ulkan toshni ko'tarib yurganini kuzatdik.

en: When they came directly over my ship, they hovered, and one of them let go his rock; but by the dexterity of the steersman it missed us and fell into the sea.
uz: Ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri mening kemam ustiga yetib kelgach, ular suzib yurishdi va ulardan biri qoyasidan qochdi; lekin haydovchining mahorati tufayli u bizni o'tkazib yubordi va dengizga quladi.

en: The other, however, so exactly hit the middle of the ship as to split it into
uz: Boshqasi esa kemaning o'rtasiga shunday urdiki, uni bo'laklarga bo'ldi.

en: The mariners and passengers were all crushed to death or fell into the sea.
uz: Dengizchilar va yo'lovchilar hammasi maydalanib o'ldi yoki dengizga yiqildi.

en: I myself was among the latter; but, as I came up again, I fortunately caught hold of a piece of the wreck, and swimming, sometimes with one hand and sometimes with the other, but always holding fast to the plank, the wind and the tide favoring me, I came to an island, and got safely ashore.
uz: Men o'zim ham oxirgilardan edim; lekin, yana ko'tarilganimda, omadga ko'ra, halokatning bir bo'lagini ushladim va suzib, ba'zan bir qo'l bilan, ba'zan boshqa qo'l bilan, lekin doim taxtani mahkam ushladim, shamol va to'lqin menga yordam berdi, bir orolga keldim va xavfsiz qirg'oqqa chiqdim.

en: I sat down upon the grass, to recover myself from my fatigue, after which I went into the island to explore it.
uz: Men charchoqdan xalos bo'lish uchun o'tga o'tirdim, shundan so'ng uni o'rganish uchun orolga kirdim.

en: It seemed to be a delicious garden.
uz: U juda mazali bog'dek tuyuldi.

en: I found trees everywhere, some of them bearing green and others ripe fruits, and streams of fresh pure water.
uz: Men hamma joyda daraxtlarni topdim, ularning ba'zilarida yashil mevalar, boshqalari esa pishgan mevalar bor edi va toza toza suv oqimlari bor edi.

en: I ate of the fruits, which I found excellent; and drank of the water, which was good.
uz: Men mevalardan yedik, ular menga juda yaxshi edi; va suvdan ichdim, ular yaxshi edi.

en: When I had gone some way I saw an old man, who appeared very weak and infirm.
uz: Bir yo'ldan borganimda, juda zaif va zaif ko'ringan bir keksa odamni ko'rdim.

en: He was sitting on the bank of a stream, and at first I took him to be one who had been shipwrecked like myself.
uz: U bir daryo qirg'og'ida o'tirardi, va dastlab men uni o'zim kabi kemada halokatga uchragan odam deb o'ylagandim.

en: I went toward him and saluted him, but he only slightly bowed his head.
uz: Men uning yoniga borib salom berdim, lekin u faqatgina boshini biroz egdi.

en: I asked him why he sat so still; but instead of answering me, he made a sign for me to take him upon my back, and carry him over the brook.
uz: Men undan nega bunchalik jim o'tirganini so'radim; lekin u menga javob berish o'rniga, uni orqamga olib, soy bo'ylab olib o'tishim uchun ishora qildi.

en: Believing him to stand in need of my assistance, I took him upon my back, and having carried him over, bade him get down, and for that end stopped, that he might get off with ease; but instead of doing so, the old man, who to me appeared quite decrepit, threw his legs nimbly about my neck.
uz: Uning yordamga muhtoj ekanligiga ishonib, uni yelkamga oldim va uni ko'tarib, pastga tushishini buyurdim, shuning uchun ham bemalol tushishi uchun to'xtadi; lekin bunday qilish o'rniga, menga ancha eskirgan ko'rinadigan chol oyoqlarini bo'ynimga chaqqonlik bilan tashladi.

en: He sat astride upon my shoulders, and held my throat so tight that I thought he would have strangled me, and I fainted away.
uz: U yelkamga minib o'tirdi va tomoqimni shunday qattiq ushladiki, meni bo'g'ib qo'ymoqchi deb o'yladim, va men hushdan ketdim.

en: Notwithstanding my fainting, the ill-natured old fellow still kept his seat upon my neck.
uz: Garchi hushdan ketishimga qaramay, yomon tabiatli keksa odam hali ham bo'ynimda o'rindi.

en: When I had recovered he thrust one of his feet against my side, and struck me so rudely that he forced me to rise up, against my will.
uz: Sog'ayganimdan so'ng, u oyoqlaridan birini yonimga tiqdi va meni shunchalik qo'pol urdiki, meni o'z xohishimga zid ravishda o'rnimdan turishga majbur qildi.

en: Having arisen, he made me carry him under the trees, and forced me now and then to stop, that he might gather and eat fruit.
uz: U o'rnidan turib, meni uni daraxtlar ostiga olib yurishga majbur qildi va vaqti-vaqti bilan to'xtatishga majbur qildi, toki u meva yig'ib yeydi.

en: He never left his seat all day; and when I laid down to rest at night, he laid himself down with me, holding still fast about my neck.
uz: U kun bo'yi o'z o'rindig'idan chiqmadi; va men kechasi dam olish uchun yotganimda, u men bilan birga yotdi, bo'ynimga mahkam ushladi.

en: Every morning he pinched me to make me awake, and
uz: Har kuni ertalab meni uyg'otish uchun chimchilab turardi va...

en: afterward obliged me to get up and walk, and spurred me with his feet.
uz: Keyin meni turishga va yurishga majbur qildi va oyoqlari bilan itarib yubordi.

en: By degrees I became weak and feared I must die.
uz: asta-sekin zaiflashdim va o'lishimdan qo'rqdim.

en: One day I found several dry calabashes that had fallen from a tree.
uz: Bir kuni daraxtdan tushib ketgan bir nechta quruq Calabeshni topdim.

en: I took a large one, and after cleaning it, pressed into it the juice of grapes, which abounded in the island; having filled the calabash, I put it by in a convenient place, and going thither again some days after, I tasted it, and found the wine so good, that it gave me new vigor, and so exhilarated my spirits, that I began to sing and dance as I carried my burden.
uz: Men katta birini oldim va uni tozalagandan so'ng, orolda mo'l-ko'l bo'lgan uzum sharbati bilan ichdim; Calaboshni to'ldirib, qulay joyga qo'ydim va bir necha kundan keyin u yerga qaytib, uni tatib ko'rdim va vino shunchalik yaxshi ediki, u menga yangi kuch berdi va ruhimni shunchalik hayajonlantirdi, yukimni ko'tarib yurganimda qo'shiq va raqsga tushdim.

en: The old man, perceiving the effect the juice had upon me, and that I carried him with more ease than before, made me a sign to give him some of it.
uz: Keksa odam, sharbatning menga ta'sirini va uni avvalgidan ko'ra osonroq ko'targanimni anglab yetgach, unga undan biroz berish uchun ishora qildi.

en: I handed him the calabash, and the liquor pleasing his palate, he drank it off.
uz: Men unga Calaboshni uzatdim va ta'ziga yoqqan spirtli ichimlik uni ichdi.

en: There being a considerable quantity of it, he soon began to sing, and to move about from side to side in his seat upon my shoulders, and by degrees to loosen his legs from about me.
uz: U juda ko'p bo'lgani uchun, u tez orada qo'shiq ayta boshladi va yelkamda o'tirgan o'rindig'ida yonma-yon harakatlana boshladi, asta-sekin oyoqlarini mendan uzoqlashtirdi.

en: Finding at length that he did not press me as before, I threw him upon the ground, where he lay without motion; I then took up a great stone and slew him.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u oldingidek menga bosim o'tkazmasligini anglab yetdim, uni yerga uloqtirdim, u yerda harakatsiz yotardi; keyin katta toshni olib, o'ldirdim.

en: I was extremely glad to be thus freed forever from this terrible burden.
uz: Men bu dahshatli yukdan abadiy ozod bo'lganimdan juda xursand edim.

en: I now walked toward the beach, where I met the crew of a ship that had cast anchor, to take in water; they were surprised to see me, but more so at hearing the particulars of my adventures.
uz: Men endi plyajga qarab yurdim, u yerda suvga tushish uchun langar tashlagan kemaning ekipajini uchratdim; ular meni ko'rib hayron bo'lishdi, ayniqsa mening sarguzashtlarim tafsilotlarini eshitishardi.

en: “You fell,” said they, “into the hands of the old man of the sea, and are the first who ever escaped strangling by his malicious embraces.
uz: Ular aytdilar: Sen dengiz keksa odamining qo'liga tushding va uning yovuz quchoqlari bilan bo'g'ilib qutulgan birinchi odamsan.

en: He never quitted those he had once made himself master of, till he had destroyed them, and he had made this island notorious by the number of men he has slain.” They took me with them to the captain, who received me with great kindness.
uz: U bir vaqtlar o'zini xo'jayin qilganlarni hech qachon tark etmagan, toki ularni yo'q qilmaguncha va o'ldirgan odamlari soni bilan bu orolni mashhur qilmaguncha. Ular meni o'zlari bilan kapitan huzuriga olib borishdi, u meni juda mehribonlik bilan qabul qildi.

en: He put out again to sea, and after some days’ sail, we arrived at the harbor of a great city, the houses of which overhung the water.
uz: U yana dengizga chiqdi va bir necha kundan so'ng suzib, uylari suv ustida turgan ulkan shaharning portiga yetib keldik.

en: One of the merchants who had become my friend invited me to go ashore with him.
uz: Do'stimga aylangan savdogarlardan biri meni u bilan qirg'oqqa borishga taklif qildi.

en: He gave me a large sack, and having recommended me to some people of the town desired them to take me with them.
uz: U menga katta xaltani berdi va meni shahardagi ba'zi odamlarga tavsiya qilib, ular meni o'zlari bilan olib ketishlarini xohladi.

en: “Go,” said he, “follow them, and act as you see them
uz: Bor,  dedi u,  ularning ortidan bor va ularni ko'rganingdek qil.

en: do; but do not separate from them, otherwise you may endanger your life.” Having thus spoken, he gave me provisions for the journey, and I went with them.
uz: Shunday qilinglar; lekin ulardan ajralmanglar, aks holda hayotingizga xavf solib qo'yasiz. Shunday qilib, u menga yo'l uchun ta'minot berdi va men ular bilan bordim.

en: We came to a thick forest of cocoa trees, very lofty, with trunks so smooth that it was not possible to climb to the branches that bore the fruit.
uz: Biz qalin kakao daraxtlari o'rmoniga keldik, juda baland edi, tanasi shunchalik silliq ediki, meva beradigan shoxlarga chiqishning iloji yo'q edi.

en: But as soon as we entered the forest we saw a great number of apes of several sizes, who fled when they perceived us, and climbed to the tops of the trees with amazing swiftness.
uz: Ammo o'rmonga kirishimiz bilan bir nechta o'lchamdagi maymunlarning juda ko'pligini ko'rdik. Ular bizni sezganlarida qochib ketishdi va hayratlanarli tezlik bilan daraxtlarning tepasiga ko'tarilishdi.

en: The merchants with whom I was gathered stones, and threw them at the apes on the trees.
uz: Men bilan birga bo'lgan savdogarlar tosh to'pladilar va ularni maymunlar ustiga, daraxtlarga uloqtirdilar.

en: I did the same; and the apes, out of revenge, threw cocoa-nuts at us with great fury.
uz: Men ham xuddi shunday qildim; va maymunlar qasos olish uchun katta g'azab bilan bizga kakao yong'oqlarini uloqtirdilar.

en: We gathered up the cocoa-nuts, and from time to time threw more stones to provoke the apes; so that by this stratagem we filled our bags with cocoa-nuts.
uz: Biz kakao yong'oqlarini yig'dik va vaqti-vaqti bilan maymunlarni qo'zg'atish uchun ko'proq tosh otardik; shuning uchun shu hiyla bilan qoplarimizni kakao yong'oqlari bilan to'ldirib qo'ydik.

en: I thus gradually collected enough cocoa-nuts to bring me a considerable sum.
uz: Shunday qilib, asta-sekin menga sezilarli summani olib kelish uchun yetarli miqdorda kakao yong'oqlarini yig'dim.

en: Having laden our vessel with nuts, we set sail, and passed by the islands where pepper grows in great plenty.
uz: Kemamizni yong'oqlar bilan to'ldirganimizdan so'ng, biz suzib ketdik va qalampir mo'l-ko'l o'sadigan orollar yonidan o'tdik.

en: From thence we went to the Isle of Comari, where the best species of wood of aloes grows.
uz: U yerdan biz Comari oroliga bordik, u yerda aloy yog'ochining eng yaxshi turlari o'sadi.

en: I exchanged my nuts in those two islands for pepper and wood of aloes, and went with other He made me stop that he might gather fruit
uz: Men o'sha ikki oroldagi yong'og'imni murch va alo yog'ochiga almashtirdim va boshqa yog'ochlar bilan bordim. U meni to'xtatdi, toki u meva yig'sin.

en: merchants pearl-fishing.
uz: Savdogarlar marvarid baliq ovlash.

en: I hired divers, who brought me up some pearls that were very large and pure.
uz: Men g'avvoslarni yolladim, ular menga juda katta va toza bo'lgan marvaridlarni olib kelishdi.

en: I then embarked in a vessel that happily arrived at Bussorah and returned to Bagdad, where I realized vast sums from my pepper, wood of aloes, and pearls.
uz: Keyin men Bussoraga xursandchilik bilan yetib kelgan kemaga chiqdim va Bag'dodda qaytib keldim, u yerda qalampir, aloy yog'ochlari va marvaridlarimdan ulkan mablag'lar oldim.

en: I gave the tenth of my gains in alms, as I had done upon my return from my other voyages, and rested from my fatigues.
uz: Men topgan narsalarimning o'ndan bir qismini sadaqa qildim, xuddi boshqa safarlarimdan qaytganimda va charchoqlarimdan dam olganimda qilganimdek.

en: Sindbad here ordered one hundred sequins to be given to Hindbad, and requested him and the other guests to dine with him the next day, to hear the account of his sixth voyage.
uz: Sindbad bu yerda Hindbadga yuz dona qovun berishni buyurdi va undan va boshqa mehmonlardan uning oltinchi safarining hisobini eshitish uchun ertasi kuni u bilan birga ovqatlanishlarini so'radi.

en: The Sixth Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor I know, my friends, that you will wish to hear how, after having been shipwrecked five times, and escaped so many dangers, I could resolve again to tempt fortune, and expose myself to new hardships.
uz: Sindbad dengizchining oltinchi sayohati. Do'stlarim, besh marta kemaning halokatidan va ko'plab xavflardan qutulganimdan so'ng, men yana omadni vasvasaga solishga va o'zimni yangi qiyinchiliklarga duchor qilishga qaror qilganimni eshitishni xohlashingizni bilaman.

en: I am myself astonished at my conduct when I reflect upon it, and must have been ruled by my destiny, from which none can escape.
uz: Men o'z xulq-atvorimga hayron qolaman, uni o'ylab ko'rsam, va hech kim qochib qutula olmaydigan taqdirim hukmron bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak.

en: Be that as it may, after a year’s rest I prepared for a sixth voyage, notwithstanding the entreaties of my kindred and friends, who did all in their power to dissuade me.
uz: Qanday bo'lmasin, bir yillik ta'tildan so'ng, qarindoshlarim va do'stlarimning iltijolariga qaramay, oltinchi safarga tayyorlandim, ular meni qaytarish uchun bor kuchlari bilan harakat qilishdi.

en: Instead of taking my way by the Persian Gulf, I traveled once more through several provinces of Persia and the Indies, and arrived at a seaport, where I embarked in a ship, the captain of which was bound on a long voyage.
uz: Fors ko'rfazi bo'ylab yo'l olish o'rniga, men yana bir bor Fors va Hindiston viloyatlari bo'ylab sayohat qildim va dengiz portiga yetib keldim, u yerda kemaga chiqdim, uning kapitani uzoq safarga majbur edi.

en: Suddenly after we had been many days at sea, the captain began uttering loud lamentations.
uz: Dengizda ko'p kun bo'lgandan so'ng, kapitan to'satdan baland faryodlar ayta boshladi.

en: He threw off his turban, pulled his beard, and beat his head like a madman.
uz: U turbanini tashladi, soqolini tortdi va telbalikdek boshini urdi.

en: We asked him the reason; he answered that we were in the most dangerous place in all the ocean.
uz: Biz undan buning sababini so'radik; u biz butun okeanning eng xavfli joyida ekanligimizni aytdi.

en: “A rapid current carries the ship along with it, and we shall all perish in less than a quarter of an hour.
uz: Tez oqim kemani o'zi bilan birga olib ketadi va biz hammamiz chorak soatdan kamroq vaqt ichida halok bo'lamiz.

en: Pray to God to deliver us from this peril; we cannot escape, if He does not take pity on us.” At these words he ordered the sails to be lowered; but all the ropes broke, and the ship was carried by the current to the foot of an inaccessible mountain, where she struck and went to pieces; yet in such a manner that we saved our lives, our provisions, and the best of our goods.
uz: Xudodan bizni bu xavfdan qutqarish uchun ibodat qiling; agar U bizga rahm qilmasa, biz qutulib qola olmaymiz. Shu so'zlardan so'ng u yelkanlarni tushirishga buyurdi; lekin barcha arqonlar uzildi va kema oqim bilan yetib bo'lmaydigan tog'ning etagiga olib ketildi, u yerda urildi va parchalanib ketdi; ammo shunday qilib, biz hayotimizni, oziq-ovqatimizni va eng yaxshi mol-mulkimizni saqlab qoldik.

en: The mountain at the foot of which we found ourselves was covered with wrecks, with a vast number of human bones, and with an incredible quantity of goods and riches of all kinds.
uz: Biz o'zimizni topgan tog' vayronalar bilan qoplangan edi, unda inson suyaklari juda ko'p edi va har xil turdagi tovarlar va boyliklar nihoyatda ko'p edi.

en: In all other places it is usual for rivers to run from their channels into the sea; but here a river of fresh water runs from the sea into a dark cavern, whose entrance is high and spacious.
uz: Boshqa barcha joylarda daryolar o'z kanallaridan dengizga oqib ketishi odatiy hol; lekin bu yerda dengizdan chuchuk suvli daryo baland va keng kirish joyi bo'lgan qorong'u g'orga oqib kiradi.

en: What is most remarkable in this place is, that the rocks of the mountain are of crystal, rubies, or other precious stones.
uz: Bu joyning eng diqqatga sazovor joyi shundaki, tog' toshlari kristall, rubin yoki boshqa qimmatbaho toshlardan iborat.

en: There is also a sort of fountain of pitch or bitumen, that runs into the sea, which the fish swallow, and evacuate soon afterward, turned into ambergris; and this the waves throw up on the beach in great quantities.
uz: Shuningdek, dengizga quyiladigan, baliqlar yutib yuboradigan va tez orada ambergrisga aylanadigan bitum yoki bitumdan yasalgan bir favvora ham bor; va bu to'lqinlar sohilga ko'p miqdorda ko'tariladi.

en: Trees also grow here, most of which are of wood of aloes, equal in goodness to those of Comari.
uz: Bu yerda daraxtlar ham o'sadi, ularning aksariyati aloe yog'ochidan bo'lib, yaxshilikda Comari yog'ochlariga teng.

en: To finish the description of this place, it is not possible for ships to get off when once they approach within a certain distance.
uz: Ushbu joy ta'rifini yakunlash uchun, kemalar ma'lum masofaga yaqinlashganda tushishi mumkin emas.

en: If they be driven thither by a wind from the sea, the wind and the current impel them toward the island; and they come to it when a land wind blows, which might seem to favor their getting out again, but the height of the mountain suddenly cuts off the wind, and occasions a calm, so that the force of the current carries them ashore; and what completes the misfortune is, that there is no possibility of ascending the mountain.
uz: Agar ularni dengizdan kelgan shamol u yerga haydagan bo'lsa, shamol va oqim ularni orol tomon itarib yuboradi; va ular quruqlikdagi shamol esganda unga kelishadi, bu ularning yana chiqishlariga yordam berishi mumkin, lekin tog'ning balandligi birdaniga shamolni uzadi va tinchlikni keltirib chiqaradi, shuning uchun oqim kuchi ularni qirg'oqqa olib chiqadi; va baxtsizlikni to'ldiradigan narsa, tog'ga chiqishning imkoni yo'q.

en: We continued upon the shore, at the foot of the mountain, in a state of despair, death coming closer every day.
uz: Biz qirg'oq bo'ylab, tog' etagida, umidsizlik holatida davom etdik, o'lim har kuni yaqinlashardi.

en: On our first landing we had divided our provisions as equally as we could, and thus every one lived a longer or a shorter time, according to his temperance, and the use he made of his provisions.
uz: Birinchi qo'nishda biz o'z ta'minotimizni imkon qadar teng taqsimladik va shuning uchun har bir kishi o'z me'yorida va o'z ta'minotidan foydalanishiga qarab, uzoqroq yoki qisqaroq umr ko'rdi.

en: I survived all my companions; and when I buried the last I had so little food remaining that I thought I could not long survive, and I dug a grave, resolving to lie down in it because there was no one left to pay me the last offices of respect.
uz: Men barcha hamrohlarimdan omon qoldim; va oxirgi marta dafn qilganimda, menda shunchalik kam ovqat qolgan ediki, uzoq umr ko'ra olmasligimni o'yladim va qabr qazdim, unda yotishga qaror qildim, chunki menga oxirgi hurmat xizmatlarini beradigan hech kim qolmadi.

en: But it pleased God once more to take compassion on me, and put it in my mind to go to the bank of the river which ran into the great cavern.
uz: Lekin Xudo menga rahm-shafqat ko'rsatgani yana bir bor ma'qul keldi va xayolimga ulkan g'orga oqib o'tuvchi daryo qirg'og'iga borishni o'rnatdi.

en: Considering its probable course with great attention, I said to myself, “This river, which runs thus underground, must somewhere have an issue.
uz: Ehtimoliy yo'nalishini katta e'tibor bilan ko'rib chiqib, o'zimga dedim: Bunday yer ostida oqib o'tadigan bu daryoda qayerdadir muammo bo'lishi kerak.

en: If I make a raft, and leave myself to the current, it will convey me to
uz: Agar men to'r yasatsam va o'zimni tokga tashlasam, u meni olib boradi.

en: some inhabited country, or I shall perish.
uz: Biror aholi yashaydigan yurt bo'lmasa, yo'q bo'lib ketaman.

en: If I be drowned, I lose nothing, but only change one kind of death for another.” I immediately went to work upon large pieces of timber and cables, for I had a choice of them from the wrecks, and tied them together so strongly that I soon made a very solid raft.
uz: Agar cho'kib ketsam, hech narsa yo'qotmayman, faqat bir turdagi o'limni boshqasiga almashtiraman. Darhol katta yog'och va kabellar ustiga ishga kirdim, chunki halokatdan ularni tanlashim mumkin edi va ularni shunday mustahkam bog'ladimki, tez orada juda mustahkam to'r yasadim.

en: When I finished, I loaded it with some chests of rubies, emeralds, ambergris, rock-crystal, and bales of rich stuffs.
uz: Tugatganimdan so'ng, uni rubin, zumrad, ambergris, tosh-krastal va boy narsalar bilan to'ldirgan qutilar bilan to'ldirdim.

en: Having balanced my cargo exactly, and fastened it well to the raft, I went on board with two oars that I had made, and leaving it to the course of the river, resigned myself to the will of God.
uz: Yukimni to'g'ri muvozanatga keltirib, to'lga yaxshilab mahkamlab, o'zim yasagan ikkita eshkak bilan kemaga bordim va uni daryo oqimiga tashlab, Xudoning irodasiga taslim bo'ldim.

en: As soon as I entered the cavern I lost all light, and the stream carried me I knew not whither.
uz: G'orga kirishim bilanoq, butun yorug'lik yo'qoldi va oqim meni qayerga olib ketayotganini bilmasdim.

en: Thus I floated on in perfect darkness, and once found the arch so low, that it very nearly touched my head, which made me cautious afterward to avoid the like danger.
uz: Shunday qilib, men mukammal zulmatda suzib ketdim va bir marta kamonni shunchalik pastda topdimki, u boshimga juda yaqin tegdi, bu esa keyinchalik xuddi shunday xavfdan qochish uchun meni ehtiyotkor qildi.

en: All this while I ate nothing but what was just necessary to support nature; yet, notwithstanding my frugality, my provisions were finally spent.
uz: Bularning hammasi men tabiatni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun zarur bo'lgan narsalardan boshqa hech narsa yemaganimda edi; shunga qaramay, beparvoligimga qaramay, mening ta'minotlarim nihoyatda sarflandi.

en: Then I became insensible.
uz: Keyin men hissiz bo'lib qoldim.

en: I cannot tell how long I continued so; but when I revived, I was surprised to find myself on the brink of a river, where my raft was tied, amidst a great number of negroes.
uz: Qancha davom etganimni bilmayman; lekin tirilganimda, o'zimni daryo qirg'og'ida, kemam bog'langan joyda, ko'plab qora tanlilar orasida topganimdan hayron bo'ldim.

en: I got up as soon as I saw them, and saluted them.
uz: Ularni ko'rishim bilanoq o'rnimdan turdim va salom berdim.

en: They spoke to me, but I did not
uz: Ular menga gapirishdi, lekin men aytmadim.

en: The Stream Carried Me I Knew Not Wither understand their language.
uz: Sharq meni olib ketdi. Men ularning tilini tushunmasligini bilardim.

en: I was so transported with joy, that I cried aloud, “Call upon the Almighty, He will help thee; thou needest not perplex thyself about anything else: shut thy eyes, and while thou art asleep, God will change thy bad fortune into good.” One of the negroes, who understood Arabic, hearing me speak thus, came toward me, and said, “Brother, be not surprised to see us; we are inhabitants of this country, and water our fields from this river, which comes out of the neighboring mountain.
uz: Men shunchalik xursand bo'ldimki, baland ovozda qichqirdim: Qodir Tangriga murojaat qiling, U sizga yordam beradi; boshqa hech narsa haqida o'zingizni tashvishlantirishga hojat yo'q: ko'zingizni yuming, va uxlayotganingizda Xudo sizning yomon omadingizni yaxshilikka aylantiradi. Arab tilini tushunadigan bir qora tanli, meni shunday gapirayotganimni eshitib, menga yaqin keldi va dedi: Birodar, bizni ko'rib ajablanmang; biz bu yurtning aholisimiz va dalalarimizni qo'shni tog'dan chiqqan shu daryodan sug'oramiz.

en: We saw your raft, and one of us swam into the river, and brought it hither, where we fastened it, as you see, until you should awake.
uz: Biz sizning to'lingizni ko'rdik va birimiz daryoga suzib kirdik va uni bu yerga olib keldik, u yerda uni mahkamladik, ko'rib turganingizdek, uyg'onmaguningizcha.

en: Pray tell us your history.
uz: Iltimos, bizga o'z tarixingizni ayting.

en: Whence did you come?” I begged of them first to give me something to eat.
uz: Qayerdan kelding? Avval ulardan ovqat berishlarini iltimos qildim.

en: They gave me several sorts of food, and when I had satisfied my hunger, I related all that had befallen me, to which they listened to with attentive surprise.
uz: Ular menga bir nechta xil taomlar berishdi va men ochligimni qondirgandan so'ng, boshimga tushgan hamma narsani aytib berdim, ularga diqqat bilan hayrat bilan quloq solishdi.

en: As soon as I had finished, they told me, by the one who spoke Arabic and interpreted to the rest what I said, that I must go along with them, and tell my story to their king myself; it being too extraordinary to be related by any other than the person to whom the events had happened.
uz: Tugatishim bilanoq, menga arab tilida gapiradigan va qolganlarga aytganlarimni talqin qiladigan odam tomonidan aytishdi: men ular bilan birga borishim va o'z hikoyamni o'z shohiga aytishim kerak; bu voqealar sodir bo'lgan shaxsdan boshqa hech kimga aytish uchun juda g'ayrioddiy narsa edi.

en: They immediately got a horse, and having helped me to mount, some of them walked before to show the way, while the rest took my raft and cargo and followed.
uz: Ular darhol otga ega bo'lishdi va menga minishga yordam berishdi, ulardan ba'zilari yo'l ko'rsatish uchun oldinga yurishdi, qolganlari esa mening to'g'rim va yukimni olib, ergashdilar.

en: We marched till we came to the capital of Serendib, for it was on that island I had landed.
uz: Biz Serendib poytaxtiga yetguncha yurdik, chunki men shu orolda qo'ngan edim.

en: The negroes presented me to their king; I approached his throne, and saluted him as I used to do the kings of the Indies; that is to say, I prostrated myself at his feet.
uz: Negrlar meni o'zlarining shohiga taqdim etishdi; men uning taxtiga yaqinlashdim va Hindiston shohlari kabi unga salom berdim; ya'ni, men uning oyoqlariga sajda qildim.

en: The prince ordered me to rise, received me with an obliging air, and made me sit down near him.
uz: Shahzoda menga o'rnimdan turishni buyurdi, meni xushmuomalalik bilan qabul qildi va uning yoniga o'tqazdi.

en: I concealed nothing from the king; but related to him all that I have told you.
uz: Men shohdan hech narsani yashirmadim; lekin senga aytgan hamma narsani unga aytdim.

en: At last my raft was brought in, and the bales opened in his presence: he admired the quantity of wood of aloes and ambergris; but, above all, the emeralds, for he had none in his treasury that equaled them.
uz: Nihoyat, mening to'g'rim olib kelindi va uning huzurida ballar ochildi: u alo va ambergris yog'ochining ko'pligiga hayratda edi; lekin, eng muhimi, zumradlar, chunki uning xazinasida ularga teng keladigan hech kim yo'q edi.

en: Observing that he looked on my jewels with pleasure, and handled the most remarkable among them, one after another, I fell prostrate at his feet, and took the liberty to say to him, “Sire, not only my person is at your majesty’s service, but the cargo of the raft, and I would beg of you to dispose of it as your own.” He answered me with a smile, “Sindbad, I will take nothing of yours; far from lessening your wealth, I design to augment it, and will not let you quit my dominions without marks of my liberality.” He then charged one of his officers to take care of me, and ordered people to serve me at his own expense.
uz: Uning mening javohirlarimga zavq bilan qaraganini kuzatdim va ularning eng ajoyiblarini birin-ketin qo'lga oldim, uning oyoqlariga yiqildim va unga aytishga erkinlik oldim: Janobi Oliylari, nafaqat mening odamim sizning oliyjanobligingiz xizmatida, balki to'r yukim ham bor, va sizdan uni o'zingiznikidek tashlab yuborishingizni so'rayman. U menga tabassum bilan javob berdi: Sindbad, men sizdan hech narsa olmayman; sizning boyligingizni kamaytirishdan yiroq, uni ko'paytirishni rejalashtiryapman va siz o'z hukmdorligimdan voz kechmasligingizni xohlayman. Keyin u o'z ofitserlaridan biriga menga g'amxo'ulrlik qilishni buyurdi va odamlarga o'z hisobidan xizmat qilishni buyurdi.

en: The officer was faithful in the execution of his commission, and caused all the goods to be carried to the lodgings provided for me.
uz: Ofitser o'z topshirig'ini sadoqat bilan bajardi va barcha tovarlarni men uchun ta'minlangan turar joylarga olib borishga majbur qildi.

en: I prayed the king to allow me to return to my own country, and he granted me permission in the most obliging and honorable manner.
uz: Men shohdan o'z yurtimga qaytishimga ruxsat berishini so'radim va u menga eng hurmatli va sharafli tarzda ruxsat berdi.

en: He forced a rich present upon me; and at the same time charged me with a letter and present for the Commander of the Faithful, our sovereign, saying to me, “I pray you give this present for me, and this letter, to the Caliph Haroun al Raschid, and assure him of my friendship.”
uz: U menga boy sovg'a majbur qildi; va shu bilan birga, meni Mo'minlar Qo'mondoni, hukmdorimiz uchun xat va sovg'a bilan aybladi va menga dedi: Iltimos, menga bu sovg'ani va bu xatni xalifa Horun al-Rashidga ber, va unga do'stligimni ishontir.

en: The letter from the King of Serendib was written on the skin of a certain animal of great value, very scarce, and of a yellowish color.
uz: Serendib qirolining xati qimmatbaho, juda kam uchraydigan va sarg'ish rangdagi ma'lum bir hayvon terisiga yozilgan edi.

en: The characters of this letter were of azure, and the contents as follows: “The King of Serendib, before whom march one hundred elephants, who lives in a palace that shines with one hundred thousand rubies, and who has in his treasury twenty thousand crowns enriched with diamonds, to Caliph Haroun al Raschid.
uz: Ushbu xatning belgilari ko'k rangda edi va mazmuni quyidagicha edi: Serendib shohi, uning oldida yuz fil yuradi, yuz ming ruby bilan porlaydigan saroyda yashaydi va xazinasida olmos bilan boyitilgan yigirma ming toj bor, xalifa Horun al-Rashidga.

en: “Though the present we send you be inconsiderable, receive it, however, as a brother and a friend, in consideration of the hearty friendship which we bear for you, and of which we are willing to give you proof.
uz: Garchi sizga yuborayotgan sovg'amiz ahamiyatsiz bo'lsa ham, uni birodar va do'st sifatida qabul qiling, siz uchun ko'targan chin dildan bo'lgan do'stligimizni hisobga olgan holda va biz sizga bunga dalil berishga tayyormiz.

en: We desire the same part in your friendship, considering that we believe it to be our merit, as we are both kings.
uz: Biz sizning do'stligingizda xuddi shu qismni xohlaymiz, chunki biz buni o'zimizning afzalligimiz deb hisoblaymiz, chunki biz ikkalasi ham shohmiz.

en: We send you this letter as from one brother to another.
uz: Sizga bu xatni xuddi bir birodardan boshqasiga yuborayotgandek yuboryapmiz.

en: Farewell.” The present consisted (1) of one single ruby made into a cup, about half a foot high, an inch thick, and filled with round pearls of half a drachm each.
uz: Xayrlashuv. Sovg'a 1) bir dona misdan yasalgan, taxminan yarim fut balandlikdagi, bir dyuym qalinlikdagi va har biri yarim drachmlik dumaloq marvaridlar bilan to'ldirilgan rubindan iborat edi.

en: (2) The skin of a serpent, whose scales were as bright as gold, and had the virtue to preserve from sickness those who lay upon it.
uz: 2) Ilon terisi, uning tarozisi oltindek yorqin edi va unga yotganlarni kasallikdan saqlab qolish fazilatiga ega edi.

en: (3) Fifty thousand drachms of the best wood of aloes, with thirty grains of camphor as big as pistachios.
uz: Ellik (3) ming draxm eng yaxshi aloe yog'ochidan, o'ttiz dona kanfordan, pista kabi katta.

en: And (4) a female slave of great beauty, whose robe was covered over with jewels.
uz: Va 4) juda go'zal ayol qul, uning ko'ylagi zargarlik buyumlari bilan qoplangan edi.

en: The ship set sail, and after a successful voyage we landed at Bussorah, and I went to the city of Bagdad, where the first thing I did was to acquit myself of my commission.
uz: Kema jo'nab ketdi va muvaffaqiyatli sayohatdan so'ng biz Bussoraga qo'ndik va men Bag'dod shahriga bordim, u yerda qilgan birinchi ishim topshirig'imdan o'zimni oqlash edi.

en: I took the King of Serendib’s letter, with the presents to the gate of the palace of the Commander of the Faithful, and was immediately conducted to the throne of the caliph.
uz: Men Serendib Qirolining xatini, sovg'alar bilan birga Mo'minlar Qo'mondonining saroyi darvozasiga olib bordim va darhol xalifaning taxtiga olib borildim.

en: I made my obeisance, and presented the letter and gifts.
uz: Men ta'zim qildim va xat va sovg'alarni taqdim etdim.

en: When he had read what the King of Serendib wrote to him, he asked me if that prince were really so rich and potent as he represented himself in his letter.
uz: U Serendib qirolining unga yozganlarini o'qiganidan so'ng, mendan shahzoda haqiqatan ham o'z xatida o'zini tasvirlagan darajada boy va qudratli ekanligini so'radi.

en: I prostrated myself a second time, and rising again, said, “Commander of the Faithful, I can assure your majesty he doth not
uz: Men o'zimni ikkinchi marta sajda qildim va yana o'rnidan turdim va aytdim: Ey Mo'minlar amiri, men sizning oliyjanobligingizga ishontira olaman, u qilmaydi.

en: Nothing is more worthy of admiration than the magnificence of his palace.
uz: Uning saroyining ulug'vorligidan ko'ra hayratga loyiqroq narsa yo'q.

en: When the prince appears in public, he has a throne fixed on the back of an elephant, and rides betwixt two ranks of his ministers, favorites, and other people of his court.
uz: Shahzoda omma oldida paydo bo'lganda, uning taxti filning orqa tomoniga o'rnatiladi va u o'z vazirlari, sevimlilari va saroyidagi boshqa odamlar o'rtasida ikki qatorga o'tiradi.

en: Before him, seated upon the same elephant, an officer carries a golden lance, in his hand; and behind him there is another, who stands with a rod of gold, on the top of which is an emerald, half a foot long and an inch thick.
uz: Uning oldida, xuddi shu fil ustida o'tirgan, bir ofitser qo'lida oltin nayza ko'tarib yuribdi; va uning orqasida yana biri bor, u oltin tayoq bilan turibdi, uning ustida yarim fut uzunlikdagi va bir dyuym qalinlikdagi zumrad bor.

en: He is also attended by a guard of one thousand men, clad in cloth of gold and silk, and mounted on elephants richly caparisoned.
uz: Unga shuningdek, ming kishidan iborat soqchi ham tashrif buyuradi, ular oltin va ipak matoga kiyingan va boy kaparizatsiya qilingan fillarga minib ketishgan.

en: The officer who is before him on the same elephant, cries from time to time, with a loud voice, ‘Behold the great monarch, the potent and redoubtable Sultan of Serendib, the monarch greater than Solomon, and the powerful Maharaja.’ After he has pronounced those words, the officer behind the throne cries, in his turn, ‘This monarch, so great and so powerful, must die, must die, must die.’ And the officer before replies, ‘Praise alone be to Him who liveth for ever and ever.’ ” The caliph was much pleased with my account, and sent me home with a rich present.
uz: Uning oldida bir xil fil ustida turgan ofitser vaqti-vaqti bilan baland ovozda qichqiradi: Mana buyuk monarx, Serendibning qudratli va qorqinchli sultoni, Sulaymondan buyuk monarx va qudratli Maharaja. U bu sozlarni aytganidan song, taxt ortidagi ofitser oz navbatida qichqiradi: Bu monarx, shunchalik buyuk va qudratli, olishi kerak, olishi kerak. Avvalgi ofitser javob beradi: Abadiy yashaydigan Zotga hamd bolsin. Xalifa mening hisobimdan juda mamnun boldi va meni boy sovga bilan uyiga yubordi.

en: Here Sindbad commanded another hundred sequins to be paid to Hindbad, and begged his return on the morrow to hear his seventh and last voyage.
uz: Bu yerda Sindbad Hindbadga yana yuzta sequin to'lashga buyurdi va uning yettinchi va oxirgi safarini eshitish uchun ertasi kuni qaytib kelishini iltimos qildi.

en: “There is still one more voyage of Sindbad’s to narrate to your highness,” said Scheherazade, at this point.
uz: Sizning oliy hazratlaringizga hikoya qilish uchun Sindbadning yana bir sayohati bor,  dedi Sheherazade shu nuqtada.

en: “Do you desire that I shall do so to-morrow?” And on the following night she continued her tale as follows: The Seventh and Last Voyage of Sindbad the Sailor On my return home from my sixth voyage, I entirely gave up all thoughts of again going to sea; for, besides that my age now required rest, I was resolved no more to expose myself to such risks
uz: Ertaga shunday qilishimni xohlaysizmi? Va ertasi kuni u o'z hikoyasini quyidagicha davom ettirdi: Sindbad dengizchining yettinchi va oxirgi sayohati Oltinchi safarimdan uyga qaytganimda, yana dengizga borish haqidagi barcha o'ylardan butunlay voz kechdim; chunki, hozirgi yoshim dam olishni talab qilgani bilan birga, men o'zimni bunday xavflarga duchor qilishga qaror qilmadim.

en: as I had encountered.
uz: men duch kelganimdek.

en: One day, however, an officer of the caliph’s inquired for me.
uz: Bir kuni xalifaning bir ofitseri meni so'radi.

en: “The caliph,” said he, “has sent me to tell you that he must speak with you.” I followed the officer to the palace, where, being presented to the caliph, I saluted him by prostrating myself at his feet.
uz: Xalifa,  dedi u,  meni siz bilan gaplashishi kerakligini aytish uchun yubordi. Men ofitserning orqasidan saroyga bordim, u yerda xalifaga taqdim etilgach, uning oyoqlari ostida sajda qilib, unga salom berdim.

en: “Sindbad,” said he to me, “I stand in need of your service; you must carry my answer and present to the King of Serendib.” This command of the caliph was to me like a clap of thunder.
uz: Sindbad, dedi u menga, men sizning xizmatingizga muhtojman; javobimni olib borib, Serendib qiroliga taqdim etishingiz kerak. Xalifaning bu buyrug'i men uchun momaqaldiroq chaqnashidek edi.

en: “Commander of the Faithful,” I replied, “I am ready to do whatever your majesty shall think fit to command; but I beseech you most humbly to consider what I have undergone.
uz: Ey Mo'minlar qo'mondoni,  javob berdim men, Men oliyjanobingiz buyurishga loyiq deb hisoblagan har qanday ishni qilishga tayyorman; lekin sizdan boshimdan o'tkazgan narsalarni ko'rib chiqishni juda kamtarlik bilan so'rayman.

en: I have also made a vow never again to leave Bagdad.” But the caliph insisted upon my compliance, until I submitted, and told him that I was willing to obey.
uz: Men Bag'dodni boshqa hech qachon tark etmaslikka ham qasam ichdim. Ammo xalifa mening roziligimni talab qildi, toki men taslim bo'lgunimcha va unga itoat etishga tayyor ekanligimni aytdi.

en: He was very well pleased, and ordered me one thousand sequins for the expenses of my journey.
uz: U juda xursand bo'ldi va safar xarajatlarim uchun menga ming dona qovun buyurtma berdi.

en: I prepared for my departure in a few days.
uz: Men bir necha kundan keyin jo'nab ketishga tayyorlandim.

en: As soon as the caliph’s letter and present were delivered to me, I went to Bussorah, where I embarked, and had a prosperous voyage.
uz: Xalifaning xati va sovg'asi menga yetkazilgandan so'ng, men Bussoraga bordim va u yerda muvaffaqiyatli sayohat qildim.

en: Having arrived at the Isle of Serendib, I was conducted to the palace with much pomp, where I prostrated myself before the king.
uz: Serendib oroliga yetib kelganimdan so'ng, meni saroyga katta dabdaba bilan olib borishdi va u yerda shoh oldida sajda qildim.

en: “Sindbad,” said the king, “you are welcome; I have many times thought of you; I bless the day on which I see you once more.” I made my compliments to him, and thanked him for his kindness, and delivered the gifts from my august master.
uz: Sindbad, dedi shoh, sen xush kelibsan; men seni ko'p marta o'ylab yurganman; seni yana bir bor ko'rgan kunimni barakali qilaman. Men unga maqtovlar aytdim, uning mehribonligi uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdim va ulug'vor xo'jayinimdan sovg'alarni yetkazdim.

en: The caliph’s letter was as follows: “Greeting, in the name of the Sovereign Guide of the Right Way, from the servant of God, Haroun al Raschid, whom God hath set in the place of viceregent to His Prophet, after his ancestors of happy memory, to the potent and esteemed Raja of Serendib.
uz: Xalifaning maktubi quyidagicha edi: Solih Yolboshchisi nomi bilan, Xudoning quli Horun al-Rashiddan salom, uni Xudo oz Paygambarining orinbosariga, baxtli xotira ajdodlaridan keyin, Serendibning qudratli va hurmatli Rajaga tayinladi.

en: “We received your letter with joy, and send you this from our imperial residence, the garden of superior wits.
uz: Biz sizning xatingizni xursandchilik bilan qabul qildik va buni imperatorlik qarorgohimizdan, oliy aql bog'idan sizga yuboryapmiz.

en: We hope, when you look upon it, you will perceive our good intention, and be pleased with it.
uz: Umid qilamizki, unga nazar tashlaganingizda, bizning yaxshi niyatimizni anglaysiz va undan mamnun bo'lasiz.

en: The caliph’s present was a complete suit of cloth of gold, valued at one thousand sequins; fifty robes of rich stuff, a hundred of white cloth, the finest of Cairo, Suez, and Alexandria; a vessel of agate, more broad than deep, an inch thick, and half a foot wide, the bottom of which represented in bass-relief a man with one knee on the ground, who held a bow and an arrow, ready to discharge at a lion.
uz: Xalifaning sovg'asi to'liq oltindan yasalgan mato bo'lib, uning narxi ming qo'ltiqga teng edi; boy buyumlardan ellikta xalat, oq matodan yuzta, Qohira, Suvaysh va Iskandariyaning eng yaxshilari; chuqurdan kengroq, bir dyuym qalinroq va yarim fut kengroq bo'lgan agate idishi, uning tubi pastki relyefda bir tizzasi bilan yerga tushgan, kamon va o'qni ushlab turgan, sherga otishga tayyor odamni aks ettirardi.

en: He sent him also a tablet, which, according to tradition, belonged to the great Solomon.
uz: U unga, an'anaga ko'ra, buyuk Sulaymonga tegishli bo'lgan lavhani ham yubordi.

en: The King of Serendib was highly gratified at the caliph’s acknowledgment of his friendship.
uz: Serendib qiroli xalifaning o'z do'stligini tan olganidan juda mamnun edi.

en: A little time after this audience, I solicited leave to depart, and with difficulty obtained it.
uz: Bu auditoriyadan biroz vaqt o'tgach, men ketish uchun ruxsat so'radim va uni qiyinchilik bilan oldim.

en: The king, when he dismissed me, made me a very considerable present.
uz: Shoh meni ishdan bo'shatganida, menga juda katta sovg'a qildi.

en: I embarked immediately to return to Bagdad, but had not the good fortune to arrive there so speedily as I had hoped.
uz: Men darhol Bagdodda qaytishga otlandim, lekin umid qilganimdek tezroq u yerga yetib borishga omadim yetmadi.

en: God ordered it otherwise.
uz: Xudo boshqacha buyurdi.

en: Three or four days after my departure, we were attacked by pirates, who easily seized upon our ship, because it was not a vessel of war.
uz: Mening jo'nab ketishimdan uch-to'rt kun o'tgach, bizga qaroqchilar hujum qilishdi va ular bizning kemamizni osonlik bilan egallab olishdi, chunki u urush kemasi emas edi.

en: Some of the crew offered resistance, which cost them their lives.
uz: Ekipajning ba'zi a'zolari qarshilik ko'rsatishdi, bu ularga hayotlarini xavf ostiga qo'ydi.

en: But for myself and the rest, who
uz: Lekin o'zim uchun ham, qolganlar uchun ham, kim

en: He Carried Me to a Forest Some Leagues from Town were not so imprudent, the pirates saved us, and carried us into a remote island, where they sold us.
uz: U meni o'rmonga olib bordi. Shahardan bir necha kilometr uzoqlikda bo'lgan joy unchalik beparvo emas edi, qaroqchilar bizni qutqardilar va uzoq orolga olib borishdi, u yerda bizni sotishdi.

en: I fell into the hands of a rich merchant, who, as soon as he bought me, took me to his house, treated me well, and clad me handsomely as a slave.
uz: Men bir boy savdogarning qo'liga tushdim. U meni sotib olishi bilanoq, meni o'z uyiga olib bordi, menga yaxshi munosabatda bo'ldi va meni qul kabi chiroyli tarzda kiydirdi.

en: Some days after, he asked me if I understood any trade.
uz: Bir necha kundan so'ng, u mendan biron bir savdoni tushunishimni so'radi.

en: I answered that I was no mechanic, but a merchant, and that the pirates who sold me had also robbed me.
uz: Men javob berdimki, men mexanik emasman, balki savdogarman va meni sotgan qaroqchilar ham meni o'g'irlagan ekan.

en: “Tell me,” he asked, after consoling with me, “can you shoot with a bow?” I answered that the bow was one of my exercises in my youth.
uz: Ayting-chi,  dedi u men bilan maslahatlashib,  kamon bilan otish mumkinmi? Men javob berdimki, kamon yoshligimda mashqlarimdan biri edi.

en: He gave me a bow and arrows, and taking me behind him on an elephant, carried me to a thick forest some leagues from the town.
uz: U menga kamon va o'qlar berdi va meni orqasidan filda olib, shahardan bir necha kilometr uzoqlikdagi qalin o'rmonga olib bordi.

en: We penetrated a great way into the wood, and when he thought fit to stop, he bade me alight and, showing me a great tree, “Climb up that,” said he, “and shoot at the elephants as you see them pass by, for there are many of them in this forest, and if any of them fall, come and give me notice.” Having spoken thus, he left me victuals, and returned to the town, and I sat in the tree all night, seeing no elephants till break of day, when I perceived a great number.
uz: Biz katta yo'ldan o'rmonga kirib keldik, va u to'xtashga haqli deb o'ylaganida, meni pastga tushishga buyurdi va menga katta daraxtni ko'rsatib, dedi: Shu daraxtga chiqing, va ularni o'tib ketayotganini ko'rayotgan fillarga o'q uzing, chunki bu o'rmonda ularning ko'pchiligi bor, agar ulardan biri qulasa, menga xabar bering. Shunday qilib, u menga oziq-ovqat qoldirdi va shaharga qaytib keldi.

en: I shot several arrows among them; and at last one of the elephants fell.
uz: Ularning orasida bir nechta o'q otdim; va nihoyat fillardan biri yiqildi.

en: The rest retired immediately, leaving me at liberty to go and report my success.
uz: Qolganlar darhol nafaqaga chiqdilar, meni bemalol borib muvaffaqiyatimni xabar berishga majbur qilishdi.

en: We went afterward together to the forest, where we dug a hole for the elephant; my patron meaning to return when it was rotten, and take the tusks to trade with.
uz: Keyin birga o'rmonga bordik, u yerda fil uchun teshik qazdik; mening homiyim u chiriganida qaytishni va tirnoqlarni savdo qilish uchun olishni xohlardi.

en: I continued this work for two months.
uz: Men bu ishni ikki oy davom ettirdim.

en: One morning, as I looked for the elephants, I perceived with extreme amazement that, instead of passing by as usual, they stopped, and came toward me with a horrible noise, in such numbers that the ground shook under them.
uz: Bir kuni ertalab, fillarni qidirar ekanman, ular odatdagidek o'tish o'rniga to'xtab, dahshatli shovqin bilan menga yaqinlashayotganini juda hayrat bilan sezdim, shunchalik ko'pki, yer ularning ostida titradi.

en: They surrounded the tree in which I was concealed, with their trunks uplifted, and all fixed their eyes upon me.
uz: Ular men yashiringan daraxtni o'rab olishdi, tanasi ko'tarilgan holda, va ularning barchasi menga tikilib turishdi.

en: At this alarming spectacle I was so much terrified, that my bow and arrows fell out of my hand.
uz: Bu dahshatli tomoshaga shunchalik dahshatlandimki, kamon va o'qlarim qo'limdan tushib ketdi.

en: My fear was not without cause; for after the elephants had stared upon me some time, one of the largest of them put his trunk round
uz: Mening qo'rquvim bejiz emas edi; chunki fillar menga bir muncha tikilib turgandan so'ng, ulardan eng kattasi o'z sumkasini o'rab oldi.

en: the foot of the tree, plucked it up, and threw it on the ground.
uz: Daraxtning oyog'ini yulib, yerga tashladi.

en: I fell with the tree, and the elephant, taking me up with his trunk, threw me on his back, where I lay more like one dead than alive, with my quiver on my shoulder.
uz: Men daraxt bilan yiqildim, fil esa meni o'z sumkasi bilan ko'tarib, orqasiga uloqtirdi, u yerda tirikdan ko'ra o'likdek yotardim, yelkamda qimirlagan holda.

en: He put himself at the head of the rest, who followed him in line, one after the other, for a considerable way, then laid me down on the ground, and went off with all his companions.
uz: U o'zini qolganlarning boshida ko'rsatdi, ular ketma-ket, ancha yo'ldan ketma-ket uning orqasidan ergashdilar, keyin meni yerga yotqizdilar va barcha hamrohlari bilan ketishdi.

en: After having lain some time, and seeing the elephants gone, I got up, and found I was upon a long and broad hill, almost covered with the bones and tusks of elephants.
uz: Bir oz yotgach va fillar ketganini ko'rib, o'rnimdan turdim va deyarli fil suyaklari va tirnoqlari bilan qoplangan uzun va keng tepalikda ekanligimni aniqladim.

en: I doubted not but that this was the burial-place of the elephants, and that they had carried me there on purpose to tell me that I should forbear to kill them, as now I knew where to get their ivory without inflicting injury on them.
uz: Men bu fillarning dafn etilgan joyi ekanligiga shubha qilmadim, va ular meni ataylab u yerga olib ketishgan, ularni o'ldirishdan bosh tortishim kerakligini aytish uchun, chunki endi ularning fil suyagini ularga zarar yetkazmasdan qayerdan olishni bilardim.

en: I did not stay on the hill, but turned toward the city; and after having traveled a day and a night, I came to my patron.
uz: Men tepalikda qolmadim, balki shaharga qarab burildim; bir kun va bir kecha yurib, homiyimga keldim.

en: As soon as my patron saw me, “Ah, poor Sindbad,” exclaimed he, “I was in great trouble to know what had become of you.
uz: Homiyim meni ko'rishi bilanoq, Oh, bechora Sindbad, dedi u, Senga nima bo'lganini bilishga juda qiynaldim.

en: I have been to the forest, where I found a tree newly pulled up, and your bow and arrows on the ground, and I despaired of ever seeing you more.
uz: Men o'rmonga bordim, u yerda yangi o'rilgan daraxtni va sizning kamoningiz va o'qlaringizni yerda topdim va sizni hech qachon ko'rmaslikdan umid qilgandim.

en: Tell me what befell you.” I satisfied his curiosity, and we both of us set out next morning to the hill.
uz: Sizga nima bo'lganini ayting. Men uning qiziqishini qondirdim va ertasi kuni ertalab ikkovimiz tepalikka yo'l oldik.
