en: We loaded the elephant which had brought us with as many tusks as he could carry; and when we had returned, my master said: “Hear now what I shall tell you.
uz: Biz bizga olib kelgan filni u ko'tarishi mumkin bo'lgancha ko'p tish bilan yukladik; va qaytib kelganimizda, xo'jayinim dedi: Endi sizga nima deyishimni eshiting.

en: The elephants of our forest have every year killed a great many slaves, whom we sent to seek ivory.
uz: O'rmonimiz fillari har yili juda ko'p qullarni o'ldirdi, ularni fil suyagi izlab yubordik.

en: In spite of all precautions the crafty animals destroyed them one time or another.
uz: Barcha ehtiyot choralariga qaramay, ayyor hayvonlar ularni bir vaqtlar yoki boshqa vaqtlarda yo'q qilishdi.

en: God has delivered you from their fury, and has bestowed that favor upon you only.
uz: Alloh sizni ularning g'azabidan qutqardi va bu marhamatni faqat sizga berdi.

en: It is a sign that He loves you, and has some use for your service in the world.
uz: Bu Uning seni sevishining va dunyodagi xizmating uchun ma'lum bir foydasi borligining belgisidir.

en: You have procured me incredible wealth; and now our whole city is enriched by your means, without any need of exposing the lives of our slaves.
uz: Siz menga aql bovar qilmas boylik olib keldingiz; va endi butun shahrimiz sizning vositangiz bilan boyidi, qullarimiz hayotini fosh qilishning hojati yo'q.

en: After such a discovery, I can treat you no more as a slave, but only as a brother.
uz: Bunday kashfiyotdan so'ng, men seni endi qul sifatida emas, balki faqat aka-uka sifatida ko'ra olaman.

en: God bless you with all happiness and prosperity.
uz: Xudo sizni barcha baxt va farovonlik bilan barakali qilsin.

en: I henceforth give you your liberty; I will also give you riches.” To this I replied, “Master, God preserve you.
uz: Bundan buyon senga erkinlik beraman; senga boylik ham beraman. Bunga javob berdim: Ustoz, Xudo seni asrasin.

en: I desire no other reward for the service I had the good fortune to do to you and your
uz: Sizga va sizning xizmatingizga qilgan omadim uchun boshqa mukofotni xohlamayman.

en: city, but leave to return to my own country.” “Very well,” said he, “the monsoon will in a little time bring ships for ivory.
uz: Shahar, lekin o'z yurtimga qaytish uchun keting. Yaxshi, dedi u, qisqa vaqt ichida musson fil suyagi uchun kemalar olib keladi.

en: I will then send you home.” I stayed with him while waiting for the monsoon; and during that time we made so many journeys to the hill, that we filled all his warehouses with ivory.
uz: Keyin seni uyga jo'nataman. Men u bilan birga mussonni kutdim; va o'sha vaqt ichida tepalikka shunchalik ko'p sayohat qildikki, uning barcha omborlarini fil suyagi bilan to'ldirib yubordik.

en: The other merchants who traded in it did the same; for my master made them partakers of his good fortune.
uz: U yerda savdo qilgan boshqa savdogarlar ham xuddi shunday qildilar; chunki xo'jayinim ularni o'z boyligidan sherik qildi.

en: The ships arrived at last, and my master himself having made choice of the ship wherein I was to embark, loaded half of it with ivory on my account, laid in provisions in abundance for my passage, and besides obliged me to accept a present of some curiosities of the country of great value.
uz: Oxir-oqibat kemalar yetib keldi va xo'jayinimning o'zi men boradigan kemani tanlab, uning yarmini men hisobimga fil suyagi bilan yukladi, mening sayohatim uchun mo'l-ko'l ta'minot joylashtirdi va bundan tashqari, meni mamlakatning ba'zi qimmatli narsalaridan sovg'a qabul qilishga majbur qildi.

en: After I had returned him a thousand thanks for all his favors, I went aboard.
uz: Unga barcha marhamatlari uchun ming minnatdorchilik bildirganimdan so'ng, kemaga bordim.

en: I at last arrived safe at Bagdad, and immediately waited upon the caliph, to give him an account of my embassy.
uz: Nihoyat Bagdodda omon yetib keldim va darhol xalifaga elchixonam haqida hisobot berish uchun kutdim.

en: He loaded me with honors and rich presents, and I have ever since devoted myself to my family, kindred, and friends.
uz: U meni sharaflar va boy sovg'alar bilan to'ldirdi va shundan beri o'zimni oilam, qarindoshlarim va do'stlarimga bag'ishladim.

en: Sindbad here finished the relation of his seventh and last voyage, and then addressing himself to Hindbad, “Well, friend,” said he, “have you ever heard of any person that suffered so much as I have done?
uz: Sindbad bu yerda o'zining yettinchi va oxirgi sayohatini yakunladi, so'ngra Hindbadga murojaat qilib dedi: Xo'sh, do'stim, u dedi: Siz hech qachon men kabi azob chekkan odam haqida eshitganmisiz?

en: Is it not reasonable that, after all this, I should enjoy a quiet and pleasant life?” As he said these words, Hindbad kissed his hand, and said, “Sir, my afflictions are not to be compared with yours.
uz: Shunchaki, shundan keyin ham tinch va yoqimli hayotdan zavqlanishim oqilona emasmi? U bu so'zlarni aytib turganida, Hindbad uning qo'lini o'pdi va dedi: Janob, mening azoblarim sizniki bilan solishtirilmaydi.

en: You not only deserve a quiet life, but are worthy of all the riches you possess, since you make so good a use of them.
uz: Siz nafaqat sokin hayotga loyiqsiz, balki sizda bor bo'lgan barcha boyliklarga ham loyiqsiz, chunki ulardan juda yaxshi foydalanasiz.

en: May you live happily for a long time.” Sindbad ordered him to be paid another hundred sequins, and told him to give up carrying burdens as a porter, and to eat henceforth at his table, for he wished that he should all his life have reason to remember that he henceforth had a friend in Sindbad the sailor.
uz: Uzoq vaqt baxtli yashasang. Sindbad unga yana yuz bir qunduk pul to'lashni buyurdi va yuk tashish yuklarini tashishdan voz kechishni va bundan buyon o'z dasturxonasida ovqatlanishni aytdi, chunki u butun umri davomida Sindbadda dengizchida do'sti borligini eslashga sabab bo'lishini xohlardi.

en: In this manner Scheherazade continued for one thousand and one
uz: Shu tarzda Sheherazad ming bir yil davom etdi.

en: nights to entertain the sultan her husband with her stories.
uz: tunlari erining hikoyalari bilan sultonni xursand qilish uchun.

en: The more she told, the more she seemed to have to tell.
uz: U qancha ko'p gapirsa, shuncha ko'p gapirishga majbur bo'lgandek edi.

en: At the end of that time he had learned to value her rare virtue, her cheerfulness and good courage, quite as much as her prodigious memory and the excellent manner of her narration.
uz: O'sha vaqt oxirida u uning noyob fazilatlarini, quvnoqligini va yaxshi jasoratini, ajoyib xotirasini va ajoyib hikoya uslubini shunchalik qadrlashni o'rgangan edi.

en: He had long since resolved to abjure his wicked vow, and one morning he told her so.
uz: U allaqachon o'zining yomon qasamini bekor qilishga qaror qilgan edi va bir kuni ertalab unga shunday dedi.

en: “Lovely princess,” said he, “not only do I free you from the sentence of death imposed upon you through your marriage with me, but I will proclaim throughout my entire kingdom and the whole world that it is you, and you alone, who have saved countless damsels from the fate that has hung over them.
uz: Sevgilim malika,  dedi u,  nafaqat men seni men bilan turmush qurish orqali o'lim hukmidan ozod qilaman, balki butun shohligim va butun dunyoga e'lon qilamanki, bu sen, va faqat sen, son-sanoqsiz qizlarni o'z taqdiridan qutqarding.

en: I realize the rashness of my vow, and refuse any longer to be bound by it.
uz: Men qasamning shoshilinchligini anglayman va endi unga bog'lanishdan bosh tortaman.

en: I trust that we shall have many long years yet to live together in happiness, and that I shall hear many more relations from you, when you are moved to tell me of your stories.” It is easy to imagine the joy of the grand vizier at these tidings.
uz: Ishonamanki, biz hali ko'p uzoq yillar birga baxtda yashaymiz va sizdan o'z hikoyalaringizni aytib berishga harakat qilganingizda, ko'proq munosabatlarni eshitaman. Bu xabarlardan buyuk vazirning quvonchini tasavvur qilish oson.

en: The news was received throughout the kingdom with the wildest rejoicing, and the blessings of the entire people were showered upon Scheherazade, whose wit, courage and devotion had saved not only her own life, but that of many other young women.
uz: Bu xabar butun qirollik bo'ylab eng katta quvonch bilan qabul qilindi va butun xalqning barakasi Sheherazaddaga yog'ildi, uning donoligi, jasorati va sadoqati nafaqat o'z hayotini, balki ko'plab boshqa yosh ayollarning hayotini ham saqlab qoldi.

en: Thank you for reading with Alice & Books.
uz: Alice & Books bilan o'qiganingiz uchun rahmat.

en: This edition was prepared from public-domain sources for free distribution.
uz: Ushbu nashr bepul tarqatish uchun davlat mulkiy manbalardan tayyorlangan.

en: We hope it brings you closer to the author’s voice.
uz: Umid qilamizki, bu sizni muallifning ovoziga yaqinlashtiradi.

en: Persuasion  ‘I must be ready to hear the name Captain Wentworth at any time now,’ Anne thought sadly, ‘and I must be ready to meet him again soon, too.
uz: Ishontirish Men har qanday vaqtda kapitan Ventvort nomini eshitishga tayyor bo'lishim kerak,  deb o'yladi Anna qayg'uli holda, va men ham tez orada u bilan uchrashishga tayyor bo'lishim kerak.

en: I must try to forget my love for him.’  Not many people are interested in Anne.
uz: Men unga bo'lgan muhabbatimni unutib qo'yishga harakat qilishim kerak. Annaga ko'pchilik qiziqmaydi.

en: She is the quiet second daughter of Sir Walter Elliot and lives in Somersetshire with him and her sister, Elizabeth.
uz: U Ser Uolter Elyotning sokin ikkinchi qizi bo'lib, u Somersetshirda u va uning singlisi Elizabet bilan yashaydi.

en: She has only one good friend, Lady Russell.
uz: Uning faqat bitta yaxshi do'sti bor, Ledi Rassel.

en: Years ago, it was different.
uz: Yillar oldin, bu boshqacha edi.

en: Then, Frederick Wentworth loved her, and she loved him.
uz: Keyin Frederik Ventvort uni yaxshi ko'rardi, va u ham uni yaxshi ko'rardi.

en: But Frederick went into the navy and went away...
uz: Lekin Frederik dengiz flotiga kirdi va ketdi...

en: When his sister and her husband move to Somersetshire, Frederick visits them, and stays, and Anne must meet him.
uz: Uning singlisi va eri Somersetshirga ko'chib o'tganda, Frederik ularni ziyorat qiladi va qoladi, Anna esa u bilan uchrashishi kerak.

en: Now, he is different: he is an important man, the captain of a ship.
uz: Endi u boshqacha: u muhim odam, kema kapitani.

en: Will he remember her?
uz: U uni eslaydimi?

en: Or must Anne forget him — again?
uz: Yoki Anna uni yana unutishi kerakmi?

en: Jane Austen is one of the most important of all English writers.
uz: Jeyn Ostin barcha ingliz yozuvchilarining eng muhimlaridan biridir.

en: She was born in 1775 in Hampshire in the south of England, the seventh of eight children.
uz: U 1775-yilda Angliyaning janubidagi Gempshirda sakkizta farzandning yettinchisi sifatida tug'ilgan.

en: She only went to school for two years, from when she was seven.
uz: U yetti yoshidan boshlab faqat ikki yil maktabga bordi.

en: After that, she learnt from her father and older brothers.
uz: Shundan so'ng, u otasidan va akalaridan o'rgangan.

en: She began to write when she was a child, and finished her first books in her early twenties.
uz: U bolaligida yozishni boshlagan va o'zining birinchi kitoblarini yigirmanchi yoshlarida tugatgan.

en: She always lived at home with her family and never left the south of England.
uz: U doim o'z oilasi bilan uyda yashardi va hech qachon Angliya janubini tark etmadi.

en: Her books are clever, interesting stories about the people of her time.
uz: Uning kitoblari o'z davridagi odamlar haqida aqlli, qiziqarli hikoyalardir.

en: She often wrote about young men and women and love.
uz: U ko'pincha yosh yigitlar, ayollar va sevgi haqida yozardi.

en: Her most famous books are Sense and Sensibility (1811), Pride and Prejudice (1813), Mansfield Park (1814), Emma (1815), Northanger Abbey (1817) and Persuasion (1818).
uz: Uning eng mashhur kitoblari Sens and Sensibility (1811), Pride and Prejudice (1813), Mansfield Park (1814), Emma (1815), Northanger Abbey (1817) va Persuasion (1818).

en: She died quite young, in 1817.
uz: U 1817-yilda ancha yosh vafot etdi.

en: Many people love her books today, nearly two hundred years after she wrote them.
uz: Ko'pchilik uning kitoblarini bugun, u ularni yozganidan deyarli ikki yuz yil o'tgach, yaxshi ko'radi.

en: Si RTI nee Brean     Sir Walter Elliot lived at Kellynch Hall with two of his daughters, Elizabeth and Anne.
uz: Agar RTI yoki Brean Sir Walter Elliot Kellynch Hallda ikki qizi, Elizabeth va Anne bilan yashardi.

en: CHAPTER ONE Kellynch  Sir Walter Elliot lived at Kellynch Hall, in Somersetshire, with two of his daughters, Elizabeth and Anne.
uz: BIRINCHI BOB Kellynch Ser Walter Elliot Somersetshirdagi Kellynch Hallda ikki qizi, Elizabeth va Anne bilan yashardi.

en: His third daughter, Mary, did not live at the Hall.
uz: Uning uchinchi qizi, Meri, zalda yashamagan.

en: She met Mr Charles Musgrove; they married and Mary went away to live at Charles’s home, in the village of Uppercross, not very far from Kellynch.
uz: U janob Charlz Musgrov bilan uchrashdi; ular turmush qurishdi va Meri Charlzning uyida, Kellynchdan uncha uzoqda bo'lmagan Uppercross qishlog'ida yashash uchun ketdi.

en: Sir Walter was fifty-four years old and was a handsome man.
uz: Ser Uolter ellik to'rt yoshda edi va chiroyli yigit edi.

en: But he was not a clever man.
uz: Lekin u aqlli odam emas edi.

en: He only thought about his hair and his moustache, or the colour of his coat or shirt or trousers.
uz: U faqat sochlari va mo'ylovlari, yoki palto, ko'ylak yoki shimining rangi haqida o'yladi.

en: He never wanted to think about other things.
uz: U hech qachon boshqa narsalar haqida o'ylashni xohlamadi.

en: His wife, Lady Elliot — a beautiful, clever and friendly woman — was now dead.
uz: Uning rafiqasi, Lady Elliot  go'zal, aqlli va do'stona ayol  hozir vafot etgan edi.

en: The two girls stayed with their father at the Hall, but they often visited their mother’s good friend, Lady Russell, and she often visited them.
uz: Ikki qiz otasi bilan zalda qolishdi, lekin ular onasining yaxshi do'sti Ledi Rasselni ko'p ziyorat qilishardi va u ham ularni ko'p ziyorat qilardi.

en: Lady Russell lived in another big house, not far from Keltynch Hall.
uz: Ledi Rassel Keltynch Halldan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan boshqa katta uyda yashardi.

en: She loved her friend’s three daughters very much, but she loved the second daughter, Anne, more than the other two.
uz: U do'stining uch qizini juda yaxshi ko'rardi, lekin ikkinchi qizini, Anni, qolgan ikkitasidan ham ko'proq yaxshi ko'rardi.

en: Anne was a pretty, but very quiet young woman.
uz: Anna chiroyli, lekin juda sokin yosh ayol edi.

en: She was the cleverest of the three girls.
uz: U uch qizdan eng aqlli edi.

en: She liked thinking; she liked talking to other people; she liked reading good books.
uz: Unga fikrlash yoqardi; boshqa odamlar bilan gaplashishni yoqtirardi; yaxshi kitoblar o'qishni yoqtirardi.

en: But her father loved Elizabeth and Mary more than he loved Anne.
uz: Lekin uning otasi Elizabet va Maryamni Annaga qaraganda ko'proq sevardi.

en: He never talked about things with her.
uz: U hech qachon u bilan narsalar haqida gaplashmas edi.

en: He wasn’t interested in her.
uz: U unga qiziqmas edi.

en: For Sir Walter, Anne was ...
uz: Ser Uolter uchun Anna ... edi.

en: Elizabeth looked after the Hall with its big gardens and beautiful park, and Anne helped her.
uz: Elizabet zalga katta bog'lari va go'zal bog'i bilan qaradi va Anna unga yordam berdi.

en: Mary sometimes came to visit them.
uz: Meri ba'zan ularni ziyorat qilishga kelardi.

en: Sir Walter, their father, never wanted to think about
uz: Ser Uolter, ularning otasi, hech qachon o'ylashni xohlamagan.

en: He liked buying new things for the house.
uz: U uy uchun yangi narsalarni sotib olishni yoqtirardi.

en: He liked buying new jackets and shoes.
uz: Unga yangi kurtka va poyabzal sotib olish yoqardi.

en: He liked driving in expensive new carriages.
uz: Unga qimmat yangi vagonlarda haydash yoqardi.

en: But he never asked, “Where does the money come from?
uz: Lekin u hech qachon so'ramadi: Pul qayerdan keladi?

en: How much money have we got?’ He did not like thinking about it.
uz: Bizda qancha pul bor? U bu haqda o'ylashni yoqtirmasdi.

en: So, after some years, the Elliot family didn’t have much money.
uz: Xullas, bir necha yildan so'ng, Elliot oilasining uncha puli yo'q edi.

en: Sir Walter spoke to Elizabeth about it.
uz: Ser Uolter bu haqda Elizabetga gapirdi.

en: Elizabeth spoke to Lady Russell about it.
uz: Elizabet bu haqda Ledi Rassel bilan gaplashdi.

en: She asked Lady Russell to help them.
uz: U Ledi Rasseldan ularga yordam berishni so'radi.

en: “What can we do?’ she asked her mother’s old friend.
uz: Nima qilaylik? deb so'radi u onasining keksa do'stidan.

en: ‘I do not know, but I can ask my friend Mr Shepherd,’ Lady Russell answered.
uz: Bilmayman, lekin do'stim janob Shepherddan so'rasam bo'ladi,  deb javob berdi Ledi Rassel.

en: ‘He is clever with money.
uz: U pul bilan juda aqlli.

en: He can help us.’  ¢ o o o Lady Russell came to the Hall with her friend, Mr Shepherd.
uz: U bizga yordam bera oladi. ¢ o o o Lady Russell do'sti janob Shepherd bilan zalga keldi.

en: They talked to Sir Walter and to Elizabeth.
uz: Ular Ser Uolter va Elizabet bilan gaplashdilar.

en: “You must leave Kellynch Hall,’ Mr Shepherd told them.
uz: Siz Kellynch Halldan ketishingiz kerak, dedi janob Shepherd ularga.

en: ‘This big house is too expensive for you.
uz: Bu katta uy siz uchun juda qimmat.

en: You must go and live in a smaller house.’  They all looked at Sir Walter.
uz: Siz borib, kichikroq uyda yashashingiz kerak. Ularning hammasi Ser Uolterga qarashdi.

en: He said nothing for a minute or two, but then he answered.
uz: U bir-ikki daqiqa hech narsa demadi, lekin keyin javob berdi.

en: We must leave Kellynch Hall and find a smaller house to live in.
uz: Kellynch Halldan chiqib, yashash uchun kichikroq uy topishimiz kerak.

en: Perhaps we can look for a house in Bath.
uz: Balki Bathda uy qidirishimiz mumkindir.

en: It is not very far from here, and I like living in Bath.
uz: Bu yer bu yerdan uncha uzoqda emas va men Bathda yashashni yaxshi ko'raman.

en: It is a beautiful city.
uz: Bu go'zal shahar.

en: A lot of interesting, rich families live in Bath, you know!’  Anne listened.
uz: Bathda juda ko'p qiziqarli, boy oilalar yashaydi, bilasiz-ku!  dedi Anna tinglab.

en: She did not like Bath — she remembered her three unhappy years at school there, after her mother died.
uz: Unga Bat yoqmasdi  u yerda maktabda o'qigan uch baxtsiz yilini, onasi vafot etganidan keyin esladi.

en: But they didn’t ask Anne.
uz: Lekin ular Anndan so'ramadilar.

en: Sir Walter was not interested in Anne.
uz: Ser Uolter Annaga qiziqmas edi.

en: They were going to leave her beautiful home, Kellynch Hall.
uz: Ular uning go'zal uyi, Kellynch Hallni tark etishmoqchi edi.

en: Bath was going to be her new home.
uz: Bath uning yangi uyi bo'lishi kerak edi.

en: o A o o     ‘You must leave Kellynch Hall.
uz: O O O Siz Kellynch Hallni tark etishingiz kerak.

en: This house is too expensive for you.’  One day soon after this, Mr Shepherd was in Taunton, a town quite near Kellynch Hall.
uz: Bu uy siz uchun juda qimmatga tushdi. Bundan bir kun o'tgach, janob Shepherd Kellynch Hallga yaqin joylashgan Tauntonda edi.

en: He met a man called Admiral Croft there, and his wife, Mrs Croft.
uz: U yerda admiral Croft ismli odam va uning rafiqasi Mrs. Croft bilan uchrashdi.

en: The Crofts had no children and they were rich.
uz: Kroftlarning farzandlari yo'q edi va ular boy edilar.

en: Admiral Croft and his wife wanted to find a big house in Somersetshire, near Taunton.
uz: Admiral Croft va uning rafiqasi Somersetshirda, Taunton yaqinida katta uy topmoqchi edilar.

en: ‘Tam in the navy,’ the Admiral told Mr Shepherd, ‘but I have a holiday now for some months and I want to take a nice, quiet house near here for our holiday.’  Mr Shepherd told Admiral and Mrs Croft about Kellynch Hall.
uz: Men dengiz flotida edim, dedi admiral janob Shepherdga, lekin hozir bir necha oylik ta'tilga boraman va shu yerda ta'tilimiz uchun chiroyli, sokin uy olmoqchiman. Janob Shepherd admiral va xonim Croftga Kellynch Hall haqida aytdi.

en: They were very interested.
uz: Ular juda qiziqishardi.

en: They wanted to see it.
uz: Ular buni ko'rishni xohlashardi.

en: “When can we visit Sir Walter Elliot and see his house, do you think, Mr Shepherd?’ asked Mrs Croft.
uz: Sir Walter Elliotni qachon ziyorat qilib, uning uyini ko'rishimiz mumkin, deb o'ylaysizmi, janob Shepherd?  deb so'radi Croft xonim.

en: Mr Shepherd asked Sir Walter the same question and the Crofts visited the Hall with Mr Shepherd one afternoon, a week later, for tea.
uz: Janob Shepherd Ser Uolterga xuddi shu savolni berdi va Kroftslar bir kuni tushdan keyin, bir hafta o'tgach, janob Shepherd bilan zalga choy ichish uchun tashrif buyurishdi.

en: They met Sir Walter, Elizabeth and Anne and they all sat together and had tea.
uz: Ular Ser Uolter, Elizabet va An bilan uchrashdilar va ularning barchasi birga o'tirib, choy ichishdi.

en: The Admiral and his wife liked the house and its gardens very much — they asked many questions about it.
uz: Admiral va uning xotini uy va uning bog'lari juda yoqardi  ular bu haqda ko'p savollar berishdi.

en: Mr Shepherd wanted to know more about the Crofts too, so he asked them some questions.
uz: Janob Shepherd Crofts haqida ham ko'proq bilmoqchi edi, shuning uchun u ulardan bir nechta savol so'radi.

en: ‘And, you know, Sir Walter,’ Mr Shepherd said later, ‘Mrs Croft comes from Somersetshire too.
uz: Va, bilasiz-ku, Ser Uolter,  dedi janob Shepherd keyinroq, Xonim Croft ham Somersetshirdan keladi.

en: Her brother lives quite near Kellynch, she said.
uz: Uning akasi Kellynchga juda yaqin yashaydi, dedi u.

en: But what did she say her brother’s name was, now?
uz: Ammo u akasining ismi nima ekanligini aytdi, endi?

en: I cannot remember.’  Anne listened.
uz: Eslay olmayman. Anna tingladi.

en: She waited and then said quietly, ‘Mr Went- worth is his name, I think.’  ‘That is the name!
uz: U kutdi va keyin sekin dedi: Janob Vent-worth uning ismi, menimcha. Bu ism!

en: Thank you, Miss Elliot.’  Anne stood up suddenly and walked quickly out, into the garden.
uz: Rahmat, Miss Elliot. Ann birdaniga o'rnidan turdi va tezda tashqariga, bog'ga kirdi.

en: She was excited; her face was hot and red and she did not want the other people in the room to see.
uz: U hayajonda edi; uning yuzi issiq va qizargan edi va xonadagi boshqa odamlarning ko'rishini xohlamadi.

en: ‘In a few months, perhaps, he is going to be here ...
uz: Bir necha oy ichida, ehtimol, u bu yerda bo'ladi...

en: at Kellynch!’ she said quietly.
uz: Kellynchda!  dedi u sekin.

en: + ¢ + +  Mrs Croft had two brothers.
uz: Xonim Croftning ikki akasi bor edi.

en: One of her brothers lived near Kellynch, in Somersetshire, but her second brother was a young officer in the navy.
uz: Uning bir akasi Somersetshirdagi Kellynch yaqinida yashardi, lekin uning ikkinchi akasi dengiz flotida yosh ofitser edi.

en: His name was Captain Frederick Wentworth.
uz: Uning ismi kapitan Frederik Ventvort edi.

en: Some years before, in the summer of 1806, the young Captain Wentworth came to stay with his older brother in Somersetshire.
uz: Bundan bir necha yil oldin, 1806-yil yozida, yosh kapitan Ventvort Somersetshireda akasi bilan qolishga keldi.

en: He was a very handsome, clever and strong young man.
uz: U juda chiroyli, aqlli va kuchli yigit edi.

en: He met Anne, a pretty young nineteen-year-old girl, and the two young people soon fell in love.
uz: U o'n to'qqiz yoshli, chiroyli qiz Anne bilan uchrashdi va ikki yosh yigit tez orada sevib qolishdi.

en: They were very happy together, but only for a short time.
uz: Ular birga juda baxtli edilar, lekin faqat qisqa vaqtga.

en: Captain Wentworth spoke to Sir Walter one day.
uz: Kapitan Ventvort bir kuni ser Uolter bilan gaplashdi.

en: 10     The Crofts visited the Hall with Mr Shepherd one afternoon, for tea.
uz: 10 The Crofts bir kuni tushdan keyin janob Shepherd bilan zalga choy ichish uchun tashrif buyurishdi.

en: ‘Your daughter, Anne, and I are in love, sir,’ he said.
uz: Sizning qizingiz, Anna va men sevibmiz, janob, dedi u.

en: “We are very happy together.
uz: Biz birgalikda juda xursandmiz.

en: I am here to ask you, Sir Walter, for your daughter’s hand.
uz: Men sizdan, Ser Uolter, qizingizning qo'lini so'rash uchun shu yerdaman.

en: We want to marry.’  Sir Walter did not say ‘yes’ or ‘no’.
uz: Biz turmush qurmoqchimiz. Ser Uolter ha yoki yo'q demadi.

en: He was cold and unfriendly to Captain Wentworth and he was not interested in his daughter, Anne.
uz: U kapitan Ventvortga sovuq va do'stona munosabatda emas edi va u o'zining qizi Annaga qiziqmas edi.

en: He did not want to help her to marry the young man she loved.
uz: U unga sevgan yigitiga turmushga chiqishiga yordam berishni xohlamadi.

en: He did not want Anne to be happy.
uz: U Anning baxtli bo'lishini xohlamadi.

en: Lady Russell wanted Anne to be happy but she too did not want Anne to marry Captain Wentworth — she thought Anne was too young.
uz: Ledi Rassel Annaning baxtli bo'lishini xohlardi, lekin u ham Annaning kapitan Ventvortga turmushga chiqishini xohlamadi  u Annaning juda yosh deb o'yladi.

en: Anne was only nineteen.
uz: Anna atigi o'n to'qqiz yoshda edi.

en: And Captain Went- worth had no money.
uz: Kapitan Ventning hech qanday puli yo'q edi.

en: She wanted Anne to wait and find a richer, more important man to marry, not a young officer in the navy.
uz: U Anning dengiz flotida yosh ofitser emas, balki boyroq, muhimroq erkakni topishini xohlardi.

en: Anne listened carefully to Lady Russell.
uz: Anna Ledi Rasselni diqqat bilan tingladi.

en: The older woman’s persuasion slowly began to work.
uz: Keksa ayolning ishontirishi asta-sekin ish boshladi.

en: Slowly, Anne started to think her love for Captain Wentworth was wrong.
uz: Sekin-asta Anna kapitan Ventvortga bo'lgan muhabbati noto'g'ri deb o'ylay boshladi.

en: ‘Perhaps I am too young,’ she thought.
uz: Balki men juda yoshdirman, deb o'yladi u.

en: ‘And perhaps I cannot help Frederick to be happy.
uz: Va ehtimol Frederikning baxtli bo'lishiga yordam bera olmayman.

en: I must think of his work in the navy — perhaps he can do better without me.
uz: Men uning dengiz flotida qilgan ishlari haqida o'ylashim kerak  balki u mensiz yaxshiroq uddalay olar.

en: Perhaps Lady Russell is right — I know she loves me and is my friend.’  She saw Captain Wentworth one last time that summer.
uz: Balki Ledi Rassel haqdir  bilaman, u meni sevadi va mening do'stimdir. U o'sha yozda kapitan Ventvortni oxirgi marta ko'rdi.

en: Her face was very sad.
uz: Uning yuzi juda qayg'uli edi.

en: ‘I am very sorry, Captain Wentworth,’ she said to him, ‘but I cannot marry you.’  ‘But we are happy together, Miss Elliot!’ he answered.
uz: Men juda afsusdaman, kapitan Ventvort,  dedi u unga, lekin men sizga turmushga chiqa olmayman. Ammo biz birgalikda baxtlimiz, Miss Elliot! deb javob berdi u.

en: ‘I do not understand this.
uz: Men buni tushunmayman.

en: ‘I cannot say,’ Anne answered, ‘but that is my last word.
uz: Men ayta olmayman,  javob berdi Anna,  lekin bu mening oxirgi so'zim.

en: We cannot marry.’  Captain Wentworth left Kellynch Hall that afternoon, and soon he left the country.
uz: Biz turmushga chiqa olmaymiz. Kapitan Ventvort o'sha kuni tushdan keyin Kellynch Hallni tark etdi va tez orada mamlakatni tark etdi.

en: He went to sea again in his ship.
uz: U yana o'z kemasida dengizga ketdi.

en: Her pretty face was often sad.
uz: Uning chiroyli yuzi ko'pincha xafa edi.

en: She loved Captain Wentworth.

en: CHAPTER THREE Lyme  For two or three days after the long walk and the drive in the carriage with the Crofts, Anne did not see Captain Went- worth at Uppercross.

en: He went to visit his old friend Captain Harville in the town of Lyme, by the sea, seventeen miles from Uppercross.

uz: U qaytib kelganida, ularga Lyme go'zal kichik shahri haqida aytib berdi.

uz: Hozir noyabr edi, lekin ob-havo ancha iliq edi.

uz: To'rtta yosh ayol  Meri, Anna, Henrietta va Luiza  katta aravachaga o'tirishdi, Charlz va kapitan Ventvort esa ularning orqasidan kichikroq aravachaga o'tishdi.

en: The two carriages arrived in Lyme after twelve o’clock, so there was not much time to see the town that afternoon.
uz: Ikki vagon Lyme shahriga soat o'n ikkidan keyin yetib keldi, shuning uchun o'sha kuni shaharni ko'rishga ko'p vaqt qolmadi.

en: They went first to find rooms in a small hotel.
uz: Ular birinchi bo'lib kichik mehmonxonada xona topishga borishdi.

en: They asked for their dinner to be ready at seven o’clock, then they all walked down to the sea together.
uz: Ular kechki ovqatlarini soat yettida tayyor bo'lishini so'rashdi, keyin hammasi birga dengizga tushishdi.

en: They walked past Captain Harville’s house, near the beach, and Captain Wentworth went inside to say ‘hello’ to his friends there.
uz: Ular kapitan Harvilning uyining yonidan, plyaj yaqinidan o'tib ketishdi va kapitan Ventvort o'sha yerdagi do'stlariga salom deyish uchun ichkariga kirdi.

en: The others went down to the beach.
uz: Qolganlar plyajga tushishdi.

uz: Ko'p o'tmay, ular kapitan Ventvortni uch do'sti bilan ularni kutib olish uchun plyajda ko'rishdi.

uz: Kapitan Vent-worth Kapitan Harvill va uning rafiqasi hamda dengiz flotidagi yana bir yosh ofitser, Kapitan Benvik bilan birga edi.

uz: Ularning hammasi The Cobbda uchrashishdi va birgalikda Harvilles uyiga qaytishdi.

en: Anne and Henrietta were the first people to be up early the next morning, so they went for a short walk down to the sea together before breakfast.
uz: Anna va Henrietta ertasi kuni ertalab turadigan birinchi odamlar edi, shuning uchun ular nonushtadan oldin birga dengizga qisqa sayr qilishdi.

en: The wind from the sea was cold in the early morning but it was another beautiful November day.
uz: Dengizdan kelgan shamol erta tongda sovuq edi, lekin bu yana bir chiroyli noyabr kuni edi.

en: After some time, they turned to go back to the hotel, and there on the beach they saw Captain Wentworth.
uz: Biroz vaqt o'tgach, ular mehmonxonaga qaytish uchun burilishdi va u yerda plyajda kapitan Ventvortni ko'rishdi.

en: They all walked back to the hotel together.
uz: Ularning hammasi birga mehmonxonaga qaytishdi.

en: At the door of the hotel, they met another gentleman, coming out.
uz: Mehmonxonaning eshigida ular yana bir janob bilan uchrashishdi, u tashqariga chiqdi.

en: His carriage waited by the door.
uz: Uning aravachasi eshik oldida kutib turardi.

en: They didn’t know him.
uz: Ular uni bilishmas edi.

en: He was about thirty years old — not handsome, but he had a nice face.
uz: U taxminan o'ttiz yoshda edi  chiroyli emas edi, lekin chiroyli yuziga ega edi.

en: He moved back quickly and opened the hotel door for them very politely.
uz: U tezda orqaga qaytdi va mehmonxona eshigini ularga juda odob bilan ochdi.

en: ‘Thank you, sir,’ said Anne.
uz: Rahmat, janob, dedi Anna.

en: She looked at the polite gentleman and she saw in his eyes that he thought she was beautiful.
uz: U xushmuomala janobga qaradi va uning ko'zlarida u uni go'zal deb o'ylayotganini ko'rdi.

en: Anne was very pretty that morning, after her walk in the early morning by the sea.
uz: Anna o'sha kuni erta tongda dengiz bo'yidagi sayridan keyin juda chiroyli edi.

en: Captain Wentworth saw the quick look in the polite gentleman’s eyes, too, and he looked more carefully at Anne.

en: His eyes suddenly seemed to say ‘Yes, you are beautiful this morning.
uz: Uning ko'zlari birdaniga shunday dedi: Ha, bugun ertalab go'zalsiz.

uz: Bu men yetti yildan ortiq vaqt oldin tanigan va sevgan aynan o'sha Anne Elliot. Nonushta paytida kapitan Ventworth mehmonxonadagi odamlardan biriga eshik oldidagi janob haqida so'radi.

en: ‘Can you tell us his name?’  “Yes, sir,’ the man answered.

en: ‘That is a Mr William Elliot.
uz: Bu janob Elliot William.

en: A very rich gentleman, sir.
uz: Juda boy janob, janob.

uz: U kecha Sidmutdan kemada yetib keldi.

uz: U bu yerdan Batga, keyin esa Londonga ketyapti, menimcha, janob. Vilyam Elliot! dedi Meri.

en: ‘That must be our cousin, Anne!
uz: Bu bizning amakivachcham bo'lishi kerak, Anna!

en: And here in the same hotel with us!
uz: Mana biz bilan bir mehmonxonada!

en: He is going to be the next head of the Elliot family, when father dies, you know, Captain Wentworth.’  ‘Iam happy to know that the next head of the family is a gentleman...’ Anne said, but she left her words unfinished because Captain and Mrs Harville and Captain Benwick arrived and took them for a walk in Lyme.
uz: U Elliot oilasining keyingi boshlig'i bo'ladi, otasi vafot etganda, bilasizmi, kapitan Ventvort. Oilaning keyingi boshlig'i janob ekanligini bilganimdan xursandman... dedi Anna, lekin u so'zlarini tugallanmagan holda qoldirdi, chunki kapitan, xonim Harvill va kapitan Benvik kelib, ularni Lyme shahrida sayrga olib ketishdi.

en: ¢ o o o They walked first through the streets of the old town.

en: Then Henrietta started to cry, ‘Louisa!

uz: Anna birinchi marta kapitan Ventvortga oshiq bo'ldi.

uz: Anna amakivachchasi bilan mehmonxona tashqarisida uchrashdi.

en: d Captain Wentworth wrote to Anne and toid her that he loved her.
uz: Kapitan Ventvort Annaga yozdi va unga uni sevishini aytdi.

uz: Kapitan Ventvort va An uzoq vaqtdan keyin yana uchrashdi.

uz: 43-betdagi kichkina bog'da Anna va kapitan Ventworth bir-biriga nima deyishdi?

uz: Sharh 1 Sizga bu kitob yoqdimi?

uz: Do'stlaringizga Persuasionni o'qishni aytasizmi?

en: White Nights A Sentimental Story from the Diary of a Dreamer Chapters  (not listed in original) First Night Second Night Nastenka's History Third Night Fourth Night Morning
uz: Oq kechalar - orzuchi kitobining sentimental hikoyasi (originalda ro'yxatdan o'tmagan) Birinchi kecha Ikkinchi kecha Nastenka tarixi Uchinchi kecha To'rtinchi kecha ertalab

en: FIRST NIGHT IT was a wonderful night, such a night as is only possible when we are young, dear reader.
uz: Birinchi kecha bu ajoyib kecha edi, biz yosh bo'lganimizdagina mumkin bo'lgan kecha, aziz o'quvchi.

en: The sky was so starry, so bright that, looking at it, one could not help asking oneself whether ill-humoured and capricious people could live under such a sky.
uz: Osmon shunchalik yulduzli, shunchalik yorqin ediki, uni ko'rib, odam o'ziga savol bermas edi: Qo'rgiz va qo'rqinchli odamlar bunday osmon ostida yashashi mumkinmi?

en: That is a youthful question too, dear reader, very youthful, but may the Lord put it more frequently into your heart!
uz: Bu ham yoshlik masalasi, aziz o'quvchi, juda yoshlik masalasi, lekin Rabbimiz uni ko'proq ko'pincha qalbingizga joylashtirsin!

en: Speaking of capricious and ill-humoured people, I cannot help recalling my moral condition all that day.
uz: Qarshi va yomon ruhiy hissiyotga ega bo'lgan odamlar haqida gap ketganda, o'sha kun bo'yi axloqiy ahvolimni eslab turishimga to'g'ri keladi.

en: From early morning I had been oppressed by a strange despondency.
uz: Erta ertalabdan boshlab men g'alati tushkunlikka tushdim.

en: It suddenly seemed to me that I was lonely, that every one was forsaking me and going away from me.
uz: Toʻsatdan men yolgʻiz ekanimni, hamma meni tashlab ketayotganini va mendan uzoqlashib ketayotganini his qildim.

en: Of course, anyone is enti- tled to ask who everyone was.
uz: Albatta, har kim har kim deb so'rashga majbur bo'ladi.

en: For though I had been living almost eight years in Petersburg I had hardly an acquaintance.
uz: Chunki men Petersburgdan sakkiz yilga yaqin o'tgan bo'lsam-da, hech kim bilan tanishib bo'lmadim.

en: But what did I want with acquaintances?
uz: Ammo men tanishlardan nima istayman?

en: I was acquainted with all Petersburg as it was; that was why I felt as though they were all deserting me when all Petersburg packed up and went to its summer villa.
uz: Men butun Sankt-Peterburgni o'zim bilgan edim; shuning uchun men butun Sankt-Peterburg to'plamini yig'ib, yozgi villasida bo'lganimda, hamma meni tark etgani kabi his qildim.

en: I felt afraid of being left alone, and for three whole days I wandered about the town in profound dejection, not knowing what to do with myself.
uz: O'zimni yolg'iz qoldirishdan qo'rqardim va uch kun davomida o'zim bilan nima qilishim kerakligini bilmay, chuqur xafa bo'lib, shahar atrofida yurardim.

en: Whether I walked in the Nevsky, went to the Gar- dens or sauntered on the embankment, there was not one face of those I had been accustomed to meet at the same time and place all the year.
uz: Nevsky-da yurganmanmi, Gar-g'onlarga borganmanmi yoki qirg'og'ida o'tirganmanmi, yil davomida bir vaqtning o'zida va joyda uchrashishga odatlangan odamlarning hech biri yo'q edi.

en: They, of course, do not know me, but I know them.
uz: Albatta, ular meni tanimaydilar, lekin men ularni bilaman.

en: I know them intimately, I have almost made a study of their faces, and am delighted when they are gay, and downcast when they are under a cloud.
uz: Men ularni yaqindan bilaman, deyarli yuzlarini o'rganib chiqdim va ular gey bo'lganlarida juda xursandman, bulut ostida bo'lganlarida esa tushkunlikka tushaman.

en: I have almost struck up a friendship with one old man whom I meet every blessed day, at the same hour in Fontanka.
uz: Fontankada har kuni bir soatdan keyin uchratadigan bir keksa kishi bilan do'stlikka erishdim.

en: Such a grave pensive countenance; he is always whispering to himself and brandishing his left arm, while in his right hand he holds a long gnarled stick with a gold knob.
uz: O'zi o'ziga har doim shovqin qilib, chap qo'lini ko'taradi, o'ng qo'lida esa oltin tuxum bilan uzun, o'tkir cho'g'ini ushlab turadi.

en: He even notices me and takes a warm inter- est in me.
uz: U hatto meni ko'rib, menga samimiy qiziqish ko'rsatadi.

en: If I happen not to be at a certain time in the same spot in Fontan- ka, I am certain he feels disappointed.
uz: Agar men Fontan-ka shahridagi muayyan vaqtda o'sha joyda bo'lmasam, u o'zini ko'ngilsizlikda his qilishi shubhasizdir.

en: That is how it is that we almost bow to each other, especially when we are both in good humour.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz deyarli bir-birimizga sajda qilamiz, ayniqsa, agar ikkovimiz ham yaxshi humorda bo'lganimizda.

en: The other day when we had not seen each other for two days and met on the third, we were actually touching our hats, but, realising in time, dropped our hands and passed each other with a look of interest.
uz: O'tgan kun ikki kun bir-birimizni ko'rmaganimizda va uchinchi kuni uchrashganimizda, biz aslida to'plarimizga qo'l urgan edik, lekin vaqt o'tib tushunib, qo'llarimizni pastga tushirib, bir-birimizdan qiziqish bilan o'tib ketdik.

en: I know the houses too.
uz: Men ham uylarni bilaman.

en: As I walk along they seem to run forward in the streets to look out at me from every window, and almost to say: Good- morning!
uz: Yolg'iz yurganimda, ko'chalarga yugurib kelib, har bir derazadan menga qarab, deyarli: Xayrli kunlar! deb aytishadi.

en: I am quite well, thank God, and I am to have a new storey in May, or, How are you?
uz: Xudoga shukr, men juda yaxshiman va may oyida yangi qavatga ega bo'laman yoki Siz qandaysiz?

en: I am being redecorated tomorrow;
uz: Men ertaga qayta bezovta qilinmoqdaman;

en: or, I was almost burnt down and had such a fright, and so on.
uz: yoki: Men deyarli yonib ketdim va juda qo'rqdim, va shu kabilar.

en: I have my favourites among them, some are dear friends; one of them intends to be treated by an architect this summer.
uz: Ular orasida mening sevimlilarim bor, ba'zilari yaqin do'stlarimdir; ulardan biri bu yozda arxitekt tomonidan muomalaga ega bo'lishni rejalashtirmoqda.

en: I shall go every day on purpose to see that the operation is not a failure.
uz: Har kuni operatsiyaning muvaffaqiyatsiz qolmasligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun qasddan boraman.

en: But I shall never forget an in- cident with a very pretty little house of a light pink colour.
uz: Ammo men hech qachon chiroyli, yorug' rozasi bo'lgan juda chiroyli kichik uyga ega bo'lgan odamni unutmayman.

en: It was such a charming little brick house, it looked so hospitably at me, and so proudly at its ungainly neighbours, that my heart rejoiced whenever I happened to pass it.
uz: Bu chiroyli kichik tikanli uy edi, u menga juda mehmondo'st va o'z qo'shnilariga g'urur bilan qaradi, shuning uchun men uni o'tkazib borganimda yuragim xursand bo'ladi.

en: Suddenly last week I walked along the street, and when I looked at my friend I heard a plaintive, They are painting me yellow! The villains!
uz: O'tgan hafta ko'cha bo'ylab yurganimda, do'stimga qaraganimda: Meni sariq rangga bo'yintirishyapti! - degan shikoyatni eshitdim.

en: They had spared nothing, neither columns, nor cornices, and my poor little friend was as yellow as a canary.
uz: Ular hech narsa, ustunlar ham, korniklar ham qutqarmagan edilar va mening kambag'al do'stim kanar kabi sariq edi.

en: It almost made me bilious.
uz: Bu meni deyarli milliardga yetkazdi.

en: And to this day I have not had the courage to visit my poor disﬁgured friend, painted the colour of the Celestial Empire.
uz: Shu kungacha esa osmon imperiyasining rangini bo'yashgan kambag'al do'stimga tashrif buyurishga jasoratim yetmagan.

en: So now you understand, reader, in what sense I am acquainted with all Petersburg.
uz: Shunday qilib, endi siz o'quvchi, men butun Sankt-Peterburg bilan qanday ma'noda tanish ekanligimni tushunasiz.

en: I have mentioned already that I had felt worried for three whole days be- fore I guessed the cause of my uneasiness.
uz: Men uch kun davomida o'zimni tashvishlanib qolganimni aytib o'tgan edim, bundan oldin esa noqulayligimning sababini aniqladim.

en: And I felt ill at ease in the street —this one had gone and that one had gone, and what had become of the other?—and at home I did not feel like myself either.
uz: Men ko'chada o'zimni noqulay his qildim - bu o'tib ketdi va o'sha o'tib ketdi va boshqa narsa nima bo'ldi?Uyda o'zimni o'zimdek his qilmadim.

en: For two evenings I was puzzling my brains to think what was amiss in my corner; why I felt so uncomfortable in it.
uz: Ikki kecha davomida mening burchimda nima noto'g'ri bo'lganini o'ylash uchun o'z miyamni g'alati qilardim; nega men bu yerda o'zimni noqulay his qilardim.

en: And in perplexity I scanned my grimy green walls, my ceiling covered with a spider's web, the growth of which Matrona has so successfully encouraged.
uz: Va g'alati bo'lib, men o'zimning qora yashil devorlarimni, Matrona o'sib-ulg'aygan o'simliklarning o'sishini juda muvaffaqiyatli rag'batlantirgan o'rinli o'rinli o'rinli o'yinlar bilan qoplangan plafonimni ko'rdim.

en: I looked over all my furniture, examined every chair, wondering whether the trouble lay there (for if one chair is not stand- ing in the same position as it stood the day before, I am not myself).
uz: Men barcha mebellarimni ko'rib chiqdim, har bir o'rinni ko'rib chiqdim va muammo shu yerda turibdimi deb o'yladim (agar bitta o'rin o'rnida o'tirmagan bo'lsa, men o'zim emasman).

en: I looked at the window, but it was all in vain … I was not a bit the better for it!
uz: Oynaga qarab ko'rdim, lekin bularning hammasi befoyda edi... Men bu ish uchun o'zimni yaxshi his qilmasdim!

en: I even bethought me to send for Matrona, and was giving her some fa- therly admonitions in regard to the spider's web and sluttishness in general; but she simply stared at me in amazement and went away without saying a word, so that the spider's web is comfortably hanging in its place to this day.
uz: Hatto Matronaga chaqirib yuborishni ham o'yladim va unga o'rinli ogohlantirishlar berardim: o'rinbosarning to'qasi va umuman o'rinbosarligi haqida; lekin u menga hayratda turib qarab, bir so'z aytmasdan ketib ketdi, shuning uchun o'rinbosarning to'qasi bugungi kungacha o'z joyida oshib turadi.

en: I only at last this morning realised what was wrong.
uz: Nihoyat, bu ertalab nima noto'g'ri ekanini angladim.

en: Why, they are giving me the slip and making off to their summer villas!
uz: Ular meni qo'yib, o'zlarining yozgi uylariga ketishmoqda!

en: Forgive the trivi- ality of the expression, but I am in no mood for ﬁne language … for every- thing that had been in Petersburg had gone or was going away for the holi- days; for every respectable gentleman of digniﬁed appearance who took a cab was at once transformed, in my eyes, into a respectable head of a
uz: Bu so'zlarning soddaligini kechiringlar, lekin men yaxshi tilga moyil emasman ... chunki Sankt-Peterburgda bo'lgan har bir narsa muqaddas kunlar uchun ketib ketgan yoki ketib ketayotgan edi; chunki taksiga o'tirgan har bir hurmatli va munosib ko'rinishli gentleman o'z ko'z o'ngida, mening ko'zimda, hurmatli bir boshga aylandi.

en: household who after his daily duties were over, was making his way to the bosom of his family, to the summer villa; for all the passers-by had now quite a peculiar air which seemed to say to every one they met: We are only here for the moment, gentlemen, and in another two hours we shall be going off to the summer villa. If a window opened after delicate ﬁngers, white as snow, had tapped upon the pane, and the head of a pretty girl was thrust out, calling to a street-seller with pots of ﬂowers—at once on the spot I fancied that those ﬂowers were being bought not simply in order to enjoy the ﬂowers and the spring in stuffy town lodgings, but because they would all be very soon moving into the country and could take the ﬂowers with them.
uz: Kundalik vazifalari tugaganidan so'ng, o'z oilasi qoshiga, yozgi uyga yo'l o'tayotgan oila a'zolari bor edi; chunki yo'lovchilarning hammasi allaqachon juda o'ziga xos havoga ega edilar va u uchratgan har bir kishiga: Biz hozirgina keldik, xonimlar, yana ikki soatdan keyin yozgi uyga ketamiz deb aytadigan bo'ldi.Agar kichkina barmoqlar ochilgan, qor oq bo'lgan, paneliga urib, go'zal qizning boshi ko'chaga toshgan bo'lsa, ko'cha sotuvchisiga gul quroqlari bilan chaqirgan.Bir marta men o'zimning tasavvurimga ko'ra, gullar ko'chalarda gul va bahardan bahramand bo'lish uchun sotib olinmayapti, balki ular tez orada mamlakatga ko'chib o'tib, shunchaki gullarni o'zlari bilan olib ketishi mumkin edi.

en: What is more, I made such progress in my new peculiar sort of inves- tigation that I could distinguish correctly from the mere air of each in what summer villa he was living.
uz: Bundan tashqari, yangi o'ziga xos tadqiqotlarimda shunchalik muvaffaqiyat qozongan edimki, har bir kishi qaysi yozgi uyda yashayotganini shunchaki havodan to'g'ri farq qila olardim.

en: The inhabitants of Kamenny and Aptekarsky Islands or of the Peterhof Road were marked by the studied elegance of their manner, their fashionable summer suits, and the ﬁne carriages in which they drove to town.
uz: Kamenny va Aptekarskiy orollari yoki Peterhof yo'li aholisi o'z xulq-atvorlari, moddiy yozgi kiyimlari va shaharga boradigan chiroyli aravalari bilan tanilgan.

en: Visitors to Pargolovo and places further away im- pressed one at ﬁrst sight by their reasonable and digniﬁed air; the tripper to Krestovsky Island could be recognised by his look of irrepressible gaiety.
uz: Pargolovoga va undan uzoq joylarga tashrif buyuruvchilar o'zlarining oqilona va munosib havolari bilan birinchi qarashda hayratda qoldirishgan; Krestovskiy orolining sayyorasi esa o'z ko'rinishi bilan tan olinadi.

en: If I chanced to meet a long procession of waggoners walking lazily with the reins in their hands beside waggons loaded with regular mountains of furni- ture, tables, chairs, ottomans and sofas and domestic utensils of all sorts, frequently with a decrepit cook sitting on the top of it all, guarding her mas- ter's property as though it were the apple of her eye; or if I saw boats heavi- ly loaded with household goods crawling along the Neva or Fontanka to the Black River or the Islands—the waggons and the boats were multiplied ten- fold, a hundredfold, in my eyes.
uz: Agar men o'zimga o'xshaydigan ko'z o'g'li kabi o'z xo'jayinimning mol-mulkini himoya qilib, ularning ustida o'tirgan, ko'pincha o'zidan-o'zga ko'rinmaydigan oshpazlar bilan to'la to'plangan vagonlarning yonida o'z qo'llarida to'g'rilik bilan yurgan va'rinlarni uchratgan bo'lsam, stollar, o'rinlar, ottomanlar va sofalar va har qanday uy jihozlari bilan to'ldirilgan vagonlar ortida, tez-tez, o'n baravar, yuz baravar ko'payib, Neva yoki Fontanka bo'ylab uy-joy jihozlari bilan to'lgan qayiqlarni ko'rsam, vagonlar va qayiqlar o'n baravar ko'payib ko'payib borardi.

en: I fancied that everything was astir and moving, everything was going in regular caravans to the summer villas.
uz: Men hamma narsa chiroyli va harakatlanayotgandek tuyulgan, hamma narsa yozgi villaslarga odatdagi karavanlarda ketayotgan edi.

en: It seemed as though Petersburg threatened to become a wilderness, so that at last I felt ashamed, mortiﬁed and sad that I had nowhere to go for the holi- days and no reason to go away.
uz: O'shanda Sankt-Peterburg cho'lga aylanishi xavfli bo'lib tuyuldi, shuning uchun oxir-oqibat men o'zimni sharmanda, xor va xafa his qildim, chunki muqaddas kunlar uchun qaerga borishim mumkin emas va ketish uchun hech qanday sababim yo'q edi.

en: I was ready to go away with every waggon, to drive off with every gentleman of respectable appearance who took a cab; but no one—absolutely no one—invited me; it seemed they had forgot- ten me, as though really I were a stranger to them!
uz: Men har bir vagon bilan ketishga tayyor edim, taksiga kirgan har bir munosib ko'rinishda bo'lgan xonim bilan ketishga tayyor edim; lekin hech kim meni taklif qilmadi; ular meni unutib qo'yganiga o'xshardi, xuddi men ularga begona odamdek!

en: I took long walks, succeeding, as I usually did, in quite forgetting where I was, when I suddenly found myself at the city gates.
uz: Uzoq sayohatlar qildim va odatda, qayerda ekanimni unutib, shahar darvozalarida o'zimni topdim.

en: Instantly I felt light- hearted, and I passed the barrier and walked between cultivated ﬁelds and meadows, unconscious of fatigue, and feeling only all over as though a bur-
uz: O'zimni darhol yengil his etib, to'siqdan o'tib, ekinzorlar va o'tlar o'rtasida yurganimda, charchaganligimni sezmay, hamma joyda o'zimni bir bur- kabi his qilardim.

en: den were falling off my soul.
uz: jonimdan tushib ketayotgan edi.

en: All the passers-by gave me such friendly looks that they seemed almost greeting me, they all seemed so pleased at something.
uz: Yo'lovchilarning hammasi menga shunchalik mehribon ko'rinish ko'rsatishdiki, ular meni deyarli kutib olishdi, hammalari bir narsadan juda xursand bo'lishdi.

en: They were all smoking cigars, every one of them.
uz: Ularning hammasi, har biri sigar chekayotgan edi.

en: And I felt pleased as I never had before.
uz: Va men bundan oldin hech qachon ko'rmagan darajada xursand bo'ldim.

en: It was as though I had suddenly found myself in Italy—so strong was the effect of nature upon a half-sick townsman like me, almost stiﬂing between city walls.
uz: O'zimni Italiyada to'satdan topganimdek bo'ldim, chunki tabiatning ta'siri men kabi yarim kasal shahar aholisiga shunchalik kuchli ediki, deyarli shahar devorlari o'rtasida bo'lgan.

en: There is something inexpressibly touching in nature round Petersburg, when at the approach of spring she puts forth all her might, all the powers bestowed on her by Heaven, when she breaks into leaf, decks herself out and spangles herself with ﬂowers.
uz: Petersburg atrofidagi tabiatda so'zsiz hayajonli narsa bor, chunki bahor yaqinlashganda u o'zining barcha kuchlarini, osmon tomonidan unga berilgan barcha kuchlarni ishga soladi, u yarim-yarim bo'lib ketadi, o'zini qoplaydi va o'zini gullar bilan cho'kadi.

en: Somehow I cannot help being re- minded of a frail, consumptive girl, at whom one sometimes looks with compassion, sometimes with sympathetic love, whom sometimes one sim- ply does not notice; though suddenly in one instant she becomes, as though by chance, inexplicably lovely and exquisite, and, impressed and intoxicat- ed, one cannot help asking oneself what power made those sad, pensive eyes ﬂash with such ﬁre?
uz: Bir yo'l bilan, men o'zimni bir xil his qila olmayman, bu bir zaif, iste'molchi qizdir, unga ba'zan rahm-shafqat bilan qaraydi, ba'zan mehribonlik bilan, ba'zan shunchaki e'tibor bermaydi, lekin bir lahzada u birdan, bir lahzada, ehtimol tasodifan, befarq qilib chiroyli va chiroyli bo'lib qoladi, va ta'sirlanib, mast bo'lib, o'z-o'zidan nima kuchini so'rashdan bosh tortmay olmayman, bu qayg'uli, mulohaza yuritadigan ko'zlarni bunday olov bilan chaqirdi?

en: What summoned the blood to those pale, wan cheeks?
uz: O'sha so'm-so'm va yig'inlarga qon keltirish uchun nima kerak edi?

en: What bathed with passion those soft features?
uz: O'sha yumshoq xususiyatlarni havas bilan yuvgan nima?

en: What set that bosom heaving?
uz: Bu ko'krakni nima qo'zg'atdi?

en: What so suddenly called strength, life and beauty into the poor girl's face, making it gleam with such a smile, kindle with such bright, sparkling laughter?
uz: Qizning yuziga to'satdan kuch, hayot va go'zallik kirib, uni shunday tabassum bilan yorqin qilib, shunday yorqin, chiroqli kulgi bilan yoqtirgan narsa nima?

en: You look round, you seek for some one, you conjecture.
uz: Siz atrofingizga qarab, kimnidir qidirasiz, gumon qilasiz.

en: .But the moment passes, and next day you meet, maybe, the same pen- sive and preoccupied look as before, the same pale face, the same meek and timid movements, and even signs of remorse, traces of a mortal anguish and regret for the ﬂeeting distraction.
uz: Ammo vaqt o'tib ketadi va ertasi kuni siz avvalgidek qayg'urgan va qayg'urgan ko'rinishni, xuddi shunday so'nggi yuzni, xuddi shunday muloyim va qo'rqinchli harakatlarni va hatto tavba izlarini, o'lim azobini va vaqtinchalik chalg'itish uchun afsuslanish izlarini ko'rasiz.

en: .And you grieve that the momentary beauty has faded so soon never to return, that it ﬂashed upon you so treach- erously, so vainly, grieve because you had not even time to love her.
uz: Va vaqtinchalik go'zallikning o'tib ketgani uchun qayg'urasiz, hech qachon qaytib kelmaydi, u sizga shunchalik xiyonatkor, befoyda ko'rinadi, uni sevishga ham vaqtingiz bo'lmagani uchun qayg'urasiz.

en: And yet my night was better than my day!
uz: Shunga qaramay, kechasi kunimdan ham yaxshiroq edi!

en: This was how it happened.
uz: Shunday qilib sodir bo'ldi.

en: I came back to the town very late, and it had struck ten as I was going to- wards my lodgings.
uz: Shaharga juda kech qaytdim va men uylarimga borayotganimda o'ntaga urildi.

en: My way lay along the canal embankment, where at that hour you never meet a soul.
uz: Mening yo'lim kanal bo'ylab joylashgan bo'lib, o'sha soatda hech qachon jon bilan uchrashmayapman.

en: It is true that I live in a very remote part of the town.
uz: To'g'ri, men shaharning juda chekka qismida yashayman.

en: I walked along singing, for when I am happy I am always humming to myself like every happy man who has no friend or acquaintance with whom to share his joy.
uz: Men qo'shiq kuylab yurardim, chunki baxtli bo'lganimda, har doim o'zimga o'zim kabi quvonchimni baham ko'radigan do'st yoki tanishim bo'lmagan har qanday baxtli odam kabi qichqiraman.

en: Suddenly I had a most unexpected adventure.
uz: Toʻsatdan men juda kutilmagan sayohatga duch keldim.

en: Leaning on the canal railing stood a woman with her elbows on the rail; she was apparently looking with great attention at the muddy water of the
uz: Kanal railingida tiklanayotgan bir ayol qo'lqoplari railingda turgan edi; u, ko'rinib turibdiki, o'z diqqatini o'z ichiga olgan balchiq suvga qaratgan.

en: She was wearing a very charming yellow hat and a jaunty little black mantle.
uz: U juda yoqimli sariq to'pka va kichik qora choriq kiygan edi.

en: She's a girl, and I am sure she is dark, I thought.
uz: Men o'zimni o'ylab: U qiz va men uning qorong'i ekanidan shubhalanaman, - deb o'yladim.

en: She did not seem to hear my footsteps, and did not even stir when I passed by with bated breath and loudly throbbing heart.
uz: U qadamlarimni eshitmayotgandek tuyuldi va men o'tib ketayotganimda hatto harakat qilmadi. Men nafas tushirib, yuragim baland ovoz bilan urib borardi.

en: Strange, I thought; she must be deeply absorbed in something, and all at once I stopped as though petriﬁed.
uz: Men o'yladim: O'zgacha, u bir narsaga chuqur aralashgan bo'lishi kerak, va birdan men xuddi toshbo'ron bo'lib qolganimdek to'xtadim.

en: I heard a mufﬂed sob.
uz: O'zimni o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zim o'zimdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdekdim.

en: I was not mistaken, the girl was crying, and a minute later I heard sob after sob.
uz: Men xato qilmagan edim, qiz yig'layotgan edi va bir daqiqa o'tgach, yig'lab-yig'lab yig'layotganini eshitdim.

en: And timid as I was with women, yet this was such a moment!
uz: Men ayollarga nisbatan juda qo'rqinchli va qo'rqinchli edim, ammo bu o'sha payt edi!

en: … I turned, took a step towards her, and should certainly have pronounced the word Madam! if I had not known that that exclamation has been uttered a thousand times in every Russian society novel.
uz: ... Men o'girib, uning yoniga qadam bosdim va, albatta, Madam! degan so'zni aytishim kerak edi, agar bu qo'rqinch har bir rus jamiyatida ming marta so'zlanganini bilmasam.

en: It was only that reﬂection stopped me.
uz: Faqat o'sha tafakkur meni to'xtatdi.

en: But while I was seeking for a word, the girl came to herself, looked round, start- ed, cast down her eyes and slipped by me along the embankment.
uz: Ammo men bir so'z izlayotganimda, qiz o'ziga kelib, atrofga qarab, boshladi va ko'zlarini pastga tashladi.

en: I at once followed her; but she, divining this, left the embankment, crossed the road and walked along the pavement.
uz: Men darhol uning orqasidan ergashdim, lekin u buni oldindan bilganidan so'ng, qirg'oqdan chiqib, yo'lni kesib, yo'l bo'ylab yurdi.

en: I dared not cross the street after her.
uz: Men uning orqasidan ko'chadan kesib o'tishga jur'at qilmadim.

en: My heart was ﬂuttering like a captured bird.
uz: Yuragim tutilgan qush kabi to'qnashgan edi.

en: All at once a chance came to my aid.
uz: Birdan menga yordam berish imkoni paydo bo'ldi.

en: Along the same side of the pavement there suddenly came into sight, not far from the girl, a gentleman in evening dress, of digniﬁed years, though by no means of digniﬁed carriage; he was staggering and cautiously leaning against the wall.
uz: Yo'lning o'sha tomonida birdan, qizdan uzoq bo'lmagan joyda, munosib yillar davomida kechki kiyim kiygan, lekin munosib arava yo'q bo'lgan bir gentleman ko'rindi; u hayron va ehtiyotkorlik bilan devorga tayanayotgan edi.

en: The girl ﬂew straight as an arrow, with the timid haste one sees in all girls who do not want any one to volunteer to accompany them home at night, and no doubt the staggering gentleman would not have pur- sued her, if my good luck had not prompted him.
uz: Qiz o'q kabi to'g'ri uchib ketdi, barcha qizlarda ko'rinadigan qo'rqinchli shoshilinchlik bilan, hech kim kechasi ularni uyga jo'natishni xohlamaydigan qizlar, va shubhasiz, agar mening omadim uni qo'llab-quvvatlamasa edi, hayratlanarli xonim uni to'g'ri sudlamagan bo'lardi.

en: Suddenly, without a word to any one, the gentleman set off and ﬂew full speed in pursuit of my unknown lady.
uz: Toʻsatdan, hech kimga soʻz aytmasdan, bu yigit mening nomaʼlum xonimni izlab, toʻla tezlikda uchib ketdi.

en: She was racing like the wind, but the staggering gentleman was overtaking—overtook her.
uz: U shamol kabi yugurib borar edi, lekin hayratda qoldiruvchi yigit uni yutib qo'ydi.

en: The girl uttered a shriek, and.
uz: Qiz qichqiriq qildi va.

en: I bless my luck for the excellent knotted stick, which hap- pened on that occasion to be in my right hand.
uz: Men o'ng qo'limda o'tgan ajoyib bog'langan tayoq uchun omadimni kutaman.

en: In a ﬂash I was on the other side of the street; in a ﬂash the obtrusive gentleman had taken in the posi- tion, had grasped the irresistible argument, fallen back without a word, and only when we were very far away protested against my action in rather vig- orous language.
uz: Bir lahzada men ko'chadan boshqa tomonda bo'ldim; bir lahzada g'azablangan xonim o'z pozitsiyasini egallab oldi, qarshiliksiz dalilni tushunib oldi, so'zsiz orqaga qaytdi va biz juda uzoqda bo'lganimizda, o'zimning harakatimga nisbatan juda kuchli tilda norozilik bildirdi.

en: But his words hardly reached us.
uz: Ammo uning so'zlari bizga yetib bormadi.

en: Give me your arm, I said to the girl.
uz: Men qizga: Menga qo'lingni ber, - dedim.

en: And he won't dare to annoy us further.
uz: U bizni bundan keyin ham bezovta qilishga jur'at qilmaydi.

en: She took my arm without a word, still trembling with excitement and ter- ror.
uz: U bir so'z aytmasdan qo'limdan ushlab, hali ham hayajon va dahshatdan titrab yurdi.

en: Oh, obtrusive gentleman!
uz: Oh, g'ayritabiiy gentleman!

en: How I blessed you at that moment!
uz: O'sha paytda men sizga naqadar baraka berardim!

en: I stole a glance at her, she was very charming and dark—I had guessed right.
uz: Men uni ko'rdim, u juda chiroyli va qorong'i edi, men to'g'ri tasavvur qilgan edim.

en: On her black eyelashes there still glistened a tear—from her recent terror or her former grief—-I don't know.
uz: Uning qora ko'z burchaklarida hali ham uning yaqindagi dahshatidan yoki sobiq qayg'usidan ko'z yoshlari chiroqlashardi.

en: But there was already a gleam of a smile on her lips.
uz: Ammo uning og'izlarida allaqachon tabassum nurlari bor edi.

en: She too stole a glance at me, faintly blushed and looked down.
uz: U ham menga bir nazar tashlab, biroz qizargan va pastga qarab ko'rdi.

en: There, you see; why did you drive me away?
uz: Bilasizmi, nima uchun meni quvib yubordingiz?

en: If I had been here, nothing would have happened.
uz: Agar men bu yerda bo'lganimda, hech narsa yuz bermasdi.

en: . But I did not know you; I thought that you too.
uz: Ammo men sizlarni tanimagan edim, men ham sizlarni taniganimni o'ylardim.

en: . Why, do you know me now? A little!
uz: Nima uchun, endi meni taniysiz? - Bir oz!

en: Here, for instance, why are you trembling? Oh, you are right at the ﬁrst guess! I answered, delighted that my girl had intelligence; that is never out of place in company with beauty.
uz: Misol uchun, bu yerda nima uchun titraysiz? - deb so'radim, qizimning aql-idrokli bo'lishiga xursand bo'lib, javob berdim: Oh, siz birinchi taxminda to'g'ri gapirasiz! Bu go'zallik bilan birga hech qachon o'rinsiz emas.

en: Yes, from the ﬁrst glance you have guessed the sort of man you have to do with.
uz: Ha, birinchi qarashdan siz qanday odam bilan shug'ullanayotganingizni tasavvur qila olasiz.

en: Precisely; I am shy with women, I am agitated, I don't deny it, as much so as you were a minute ago when that gentleman alarmed you.
uz: To'g'ri; men ayollarga nisbatan uyalganman, g'ayratlanaman, buni inkor etmayman, xuddi siz bir daqiqa oldin o'sha gentleman sizni qo'rqitganida edi.

en: I am in some alarm now.
uz: Men hozir biroz xavotirga tushdim.

en: It's like a dream, and I never guessed even in my sleep that I should ever talk with any woman. What?
uz: Bu xuddi orzu kabi va hatto uyquda ham biron bir ayol bilan gaplashishim kerakligini tasavvur qilmaganman.

en: . Yes; if my arm trembles, it is because it has never been held by a pretty little hand like yours.
uz: Ha, agar qo'lim titrar ekan, bu sizning qo'lingiz kabi chiroyli qo'lim tomonidan hech qachon ushlab qolinmagani uchun.

en: I am a complete stranger to women; that is, I have never been used to them.
uz: Ayollar uchun men mutlaqo begona odamman; ya'ni men hech qachon ularga o'zlashtirilmaganman.

en: I don't even know how to talk to them.
uz: Men ular bilan qanday gaplashishni ham bilmayman.

en: Here, I don't know now whether I have not said something silly to you!
uz: Mana, men sizga o'yin-kulgi gapirmaganimni endi bilmayman!

en: Tell me frankly; I assure you beforehand that I am not quick to take offence?.
uz: O'zingizni ochiq-oydin so'zlab bering, men sizni tezda xafa bo'lmasligimni oldindan ta'kidlayman.

en: . No, nothing, nothing, quite the contrary.
uz: Yo'q, hech narsa, hech narsa emas, aksincha.

en: And if you insist on my speak- ing frankly, I will tell you that women like such timidity; and if you want to know more, I like it too, and I won't drive you away till I get home. You will make me, I said, breathless with delight, lose my timidity, and then farewell to all my chances.
uz: Va agar siz men bilan ochiqchasiga gaplashishimni istayotgan bo'lsangiz, men sizga ayollar bunday qo'rqinchlilikni yaxshi ko'rishlarini aytaman; va agar siz ko'proq bilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, men ham buni yaxshi ko'raman va uyga qaytmaguncha sizni haydab yubormayman.

en: What chances—of what?
uz: Qanday imkoniyat nima?

en: That's not so nice.
uz: Bu juda yaxshi emas.

en: I beg your pardon, I am sorry, it was a slip of the tongue; but how can you expect one at such a moment to have no desire.
uz: Kechirasizlar, kechirim so'rayman, bu tilni o'g'irlatgan gap edi, lekin bunday paytda odamning istaksizligini qanday kutishingiz mumkin?

en: . To be liked, eh? Well, yes; but do, for goodness' sake, be kind.
uz: Sevgi bo'lish uchun, shundaymi? - Ha, shunday, lekin yaxshilik uchun mehribon bo'ling.

en: Here, I am twenty-six and I have never seen any one.
uz: Mana, men yigirma olti yoshdaman va hech qachon hech kimni ko'rmaganman.

en: How can I speak well, tact- fully, and to the point?
uz: Qanday qilib men yaxshi, aniq va aniq gapirishim mumkin?

en: It will seem better to you when I have told you everything openly.
uz: Sizga hamma narsani ochiq-oydin aytib berganimda, bu sizga yaxshiroq tuyuladi.

en: .I don't know how to be silent when my heart is speak- ing, Well, never mind.
uz: Qalbim gapirayotganda qanday qilib jim bo'lishni bilmayman.

en: Believe me, not one, woman, never, never!
uz: Menga ishoning, hech kim, ayol, hech qachon, hech qachon!

en: No acquaintance of any sort!
uz: Hech qanday tanish yo'q!

en: And I do nothing but dream every day that at last I shall meet someone.
uz: Va men har kuni birov bilan uchrashishni orzu qilaman.

en: Oh, if only you knew how often I have been in love in that way.
uz: Oh, agar siz bilgan bo'lsangiz, men qancha marta bunday muhabbatga duch keldim.

en: . Why, with no one, with an ideal, with the one I dream of in my sleep.
uz: Nima uchun, hech kim bilan, ideal bilan, uyquda orzu qilganim bilan.

en: I make up regular romances in my dreams.
uz: Orzularimda muntazam ravishda romantik izlanishlar o'tkazaman.

en: Ah you don't know me!
uz: Ah, siz meni bilmaysiz!

en: It's true, of course, I have met two or three women, but what sort of women were they?
uz: To'g'ri, men ikki yoki uchta ayol bilan uchrashganman, lekin ular qanday ayollar edi?

en: They were all landladies, that.
uz: Ularning barchasi yer egasi edi.

en: But I shall make you laugh if I tell you that I have several times thought of speaking, just simply speaking, to some aristocratic lady in the street, when she is alone, I need hardly say; speaking to her, of course, timidly, respectfully, passionately; telling her that I am perishing in solitude, begging her not to send me away; saying that I have no chance of making the acquaintance of any woman; impress- ing upon her that it is a positive duty for a woman not to repulse so timid a prayer from such a luckless man as me.
uz: Ammo sizga aytsam, men ko'p marta ko'chadagi aristokratik ayolga gapirishni, shunchaki gapirishni o'yladim; u yolg'iz bo'lganida, aytishim kerak emas; albatta, uyatchan, hurmatli, ishtiyoq bilan gapirish; yolg'izlikda halok bo'layotganimni aytish, meni yo'q qilmaslikka iltijo qilish; hech qanday ayol bilan tanishish imkoniyati yo'qligini aytish; ayol uchun men kabi baxtsiz kishining ibodatini rad etishning o'ziga yarasha vazifasi ekanligini unga ta'kidlash.

en: That, in fact, all I ask is, that she should say two or three sisterly words with sympathy, should not repulse me at ﬁrst sight; should take me on trust and listen to what I say; should laugh at me if she likes, encourage me, say two words to me, only two words, even though we never meet again afterwards!
uz: Aslida, faqatgina uning ikki yoki uchta opamizlik so'zini hamdardlik bilan aytishi, meni birinchi qarashda rad etmasligi, ishonchimga ega bo'lib, aytganlarimga quloq solishi, yoqtirsa, menga kulishi, dalda berishi, menga ikkita so'z aytishi, faqat ikkita so'z aytishi kerak, hatto keyinchalik hech qachon uchrashmasak ham!

en: But you are laugh- ing; however, that is why I am telling you.
uz: Ammo siz kulyapsiz; ammo, shuning uchun sizga aytyapman.

en: . Don't be vexed; I am only laughing at your being your own enemy, and if you had tried you would have succeeded, perhaps, even though it had been in the street; the simpler the better.
uz: . Xafsuslanmang, men faqat sizning o'zingizning dushmaningiz bo'lishingizdan kulyapman va agar siz harakat qilganingizda, ehtimol, ko'chada bo'lgan bo'lsangiz ham, muvaffaqiyatga erishgan bo'lar edingiz; qanchalik sodda bo'lsangiz, shunchalik yaxshi.

en: No kind-hearted woman, unless she were stupid or, still more, vexed about something at the moment, could bring herself to send you away without those two words which you ask for so timidly.
uz: Hech bir yaxshi ayol, axloqsiz bo'lmasa yoki hozirgi paytda biror narsa bilan xafa bo'lmasa, sizni o'sha ikki so'zsiz yo'qotib yuborishga majbur bo'lmaydi.

en: But what am I saying?
uz: Lekin men nima deyapman?

en: Of course she would take you for a
uz: Albatta, u sizdan o'zingizni o'g'ilsiz deb o'ylaydi.

en: I was judging by myself; I know a good deal about other people's lives. Oh, thank you, I cried; you don't know what you have done for me now! I am glad!
uz: Men o'zimni o'zim hukm qilardim; men boshqalarning hayoti haqida ko'p narsani bilaman. Oh, rahmat, deb yig'ladim men; Siz mening uchun endi nima qilganingizni bilmaysiz! Men xursandman!

en: But tell me how did you ﬁnd out that I was the sort of woman with whom … well, whom you think worthy.
uz: Ammo menga ayt, men o'zimni munosib deb hisoblagan ayolning o'rnagi ekanimni qayerdan bilib olding?

en: of attention and friendship … in fact, not a landlady as you say?
uz: e'tibor va do'stlik ... aslida, siz aytgandek uy egasi emasmi?

en: What made you decide to come up to me? What made me?
uz: Menga yaqinlashishga sizni nima undagan?

en: But you were alone; that gentle-man was too inso- lent; it's night.
uz: Ammo siz yolg'iz edingiz; bu mehribon odam juda kech edi; kechasi.

en: You must admit that it was a duty.
uz: Bu sizning majburiyatingiz edi, deb tan olishingiz kerak.

en: . No, no; I mean before, on the other side you know you meant to come up to me. On the other side?
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, men ilgari, boshqa tomondan menga yaqinlashmoqchi ekanligingizni bilaman.

en: Really I don't know how to answer; I am afraid to.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, qanday javob berish kerakligini bilmayman; qo'rqaman.

en: Do you know I have been happy to-day?
uz: Bugun baxtli bo'lganimni bilasizmi?

en: I walked along singing; I went out into the country; I have never had such happy moments.
uz: Men qo'shiq kuylab yurganman; qishloq joylarga chiqdim; hech qachon bunday baxtli damlarni boshdan kechirmaganman.

en: perhaps it was my fancy.
uz: Ehtimol, bu mening o'ylashim edi.

en: Forgive me for referring to it; I fancied you were cry- ing, and I.
uz: U haqda gapirganim uchun kechiringlar; men siz yig'layotganingizni tasavvur qilgan edim va men ham.

en: could not bear to hear it.
uz: Buni eshitishga chiday olmaganman.

en: it made my heart ache.
uz: Bu yuragimni og'ritardi.

en: Surely I might be troubled about you?
uz: Shubhasizki, men siz haqingizda tashvishlanaman.

en: Surely there was no harm in feeling brotherly compassion for you.
uz: Shubhasizki, sizga birodarlik rahm-shafqatini his etishda hech qanday zarar yo'q edi.

en: I beg your pardon, I said com- passion.
uz: Kechirasizlar, men hamisha o'ylayman.

en: Well, in short, surely you would not be offended at my involun- tary impulse to go up to you?
uz: Qisqa qilib aytganda, albatta, siz mening sizga murojaat qilish istagi bilan xafa bo'lmasmidingiz?

en: . Stop, that's enough, don't talk of it, said the girl, looking down, and pressing my hand.
uz: Toʻxtating, bu yetarli, bu haqda gapirmang, - dedi qiz, pastga qarab, qoʻlimni bosdi.

en: It's my fault for having spoken of it; but I am glad I was not mistaken in you.
uz: Bu haqda gapirganim uchun men aybdorman, lekin sizda xato qilmaganimdan xursandman.

en: But here I am home; I must go down this turning, it's two steps from here.
uz: Ammo men uyda bo'ldim; men bu burchakdan tushishim kerak, bu yerdan ikki qadam uzoqlikda.

en: Good-bye, thank you!
uz: Xo'sh, xayr, rahmat!

en: surely you don't mean.
uz: Shubhasiz, siz buni nazarda tutmaysiz.

en: that we shall never see each other again?
uz: Biz bir-birimizni boshqa hech qachon ko'rmaymiz?

en: Surely this is not to be the end? You see, said the girl, laughing, at ﬁrst you only wanted two words, and now.
uz: Bilasizlarmi, - dedi qiz, - boshida siz faqat ikki so'z istardingiz, endi esa.

en: However, I won't say anything.
uz: Biroq, men hech narsa aytmayman.

en: perhaps we shall meet.
uz: Ehtimol, uchrashamiz.

en: . I shall come here to-morrow, I said.
uz: Men: Ertaga bu yerga kelaman, - dedim.

en: Oh, forgive me, I am already making demands.
uz: Oh, meni kechiring, men allaqachon talablar qo'yyapman.

en: . Yes, you are not very patient.
uz: Ha, siz juda sabrli emassiz.

en: you are almost insisting.
uz: Siz deyarli istaysiz.

en: Listen, listen! I interrupted her.
uz: Quloq solinglar, quloq solinglar! - dedim men unga aralashib.

en: Forgive me if I tell you something else.
uz: Agar sizga yana bir narsani aytsam, meni kechiring.

en: I tell you what, I can't help coming here tomorrow, I am a dreamer; I have so little real life that I look upon such moments as this now, as so rare, that I cannot help going over such moments again in my dreams.
uz: Men sizga nima deyman, men ertaga bu yerga kelishdan bosh tortolmayman, men orzuchi bo'laman; mening haqiqiy hayotim shunchalik oz, hozirgi paytlarni shunchalik kam uchratamanki, orzularimda bunday paytlarni qayta ko'rishdan bosh tortolmayman.

en: I shall be dreaming of you all night, a whole week, a whole year.
uz: Men seni butun kecha, butun hafta, butun yil davomida orzu qilaman.

en: I shall cer- tainly come here to-morrow, just here to this place, just at the same hour, and I shall be happy remembering today.
uz: Men ertaga shu yerda, shu yerda, shu vaqtning o'zida shu yerga kelaman va bu kunni eslab, xursand bo'laman.

en: This place is dear to me already.
uz: Bu joy menga allaqachon yoqimli.

en: I have already two or three such places in Petersburg.
uz: Sankt-Peterburgda endi ikkita yoki uchta o'xshash joyim bor.

en: I once shed tears over memories.
uz: Bir marta xotiralar ustiga ko'z yoshim oqdi.

en: Who knows, perhaps you were weeping ten min- utes ago over some memory.
uz: Kim biladi, ehtimol o'n daqiqa oldin bir nechta xotira tufayli yig'lab yurgan bo'lar edingiz.

en: But, forgive me, I have forgotten myself again; perhaps you have once been particularly happy here.
uz: Ammo kechiringlar, men o'zimni yana unutdim; ehtimol siz bir vaqtlar bu yerda ayniqsa baxtli bo'lgansiz.

en: . Very good, said the girl, perhaps I will come here tomorrow, too, at ten o'clock.
uz: - Juda yaxshi, - dedi qiz, - ehtimol ertaga ham o'n soatdan keyin bu yerga kelishim mumkin.

en: I see that I can't forbid you.
uz: Ko'rib turibmanki, men sizga taqiqlashim mumkin emas.

en: The fact is, I have to be here; don't imagine that I am making an appointment with you; I tell you before- hand that I have to be here on my own account.
uz: Darhaqiqat, men bu yerda bo'lishim kerak; siz bilan uchrashuv o'tkazayotganimni tasavvur qilmang; men sizga oldindan aytamanki, bu erda bo'lishim kerak.

en: well, I tell you straight out, I don't mind if you do come.
uz: To'g'ri aytamanki, kelishingiz menga xalaqit bermaydi.

en: To begin with, something unpleas- ant might happen as it did today, but never mind that.
uz: Avvaliga, bugun sodir bo'lganidek, yoqimli bo'lmagan narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin, ammo bu hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas.

en: In short, I should simply like to see you.
uz: Qisqacha aytganda, men sizni ko'rishni xohlayman.

en: to say two words to you.
uz: Sizga ikkita so'z aytmoqchiman.

en: Only, mind, you must not think the worse of me now!
uz: Faqat, o'ylab ko'ring, endi mendan yomonroq narsani o'ylamasligingiz kerak!

en: Don't think I make appointments so lightly.
uz: O'ylamangki, men tanlovlarni shunchalik yengillik bilan o'tkazaman.

en: I shouldn't make it except that.
uz: Faqat shundan tashqari, men buni amalga oshirishim kerak emas.

en: But let that be my secret!
uz: Ammo bu mening sirim bo'lsin!

en: Only a com- pact beforehand.
uz: Faqat oldindan shartnoma tuzish kerak.

en: Speak, tell me, tell me all beforehand; I agree to anything, I am ready for anything, I cried delighted.
uz: Ayting, ayting, oldindan ayting; men har qanday narsaga rozi bo'laman, har qanday narsaga tayyorman, - deb xursand bo'lib yig'ladim.

en: I answer for myself, I will be obedient, respectful.
uz: Men o'zim uchun javob beraman, itoatkor va hurmatli bo'laman.

en: . It's just because I do know you that I ask you to come tomorrow, said the girl, laughing.
uz: Seni tanib-bilganim uchun senga ertaga kelishni so'rayman, - dedi qiz, kulish bilan.

en: I know you perfectly.
uz: Men sizni mukammal darajada bilaman.

en: But mind you will come on the condition, in the ﬁrst place (only be good, do what I ask—you see, I speak frankly), you won't fall in love with me.
uz: Ammo fikringiz sharti bilan keladi, birinchi navbatda (faqat yaxshi bo'ling, so'rayotganimni bajaring), siz men bilan muhabbatga tushmaysiz.

en: That's impossible, I assure you.
uz: Bu imkonsiz, sizga ishontiraman.

en: I am ready for friendship; here's my hand.
uz: Men do'stlikka tayyorman; mana qo'lim.

en: But you mustn't fall in love with me, I beg you! I swear, I cried, gripping her hand.
uz: Lekin menga muhabbat qilmasang kerak, iltijo qilaman! - dedim. - Qasam qilaman, - deb yig'ladim men, uning qo'lini ushlab turdim.

en: Hush, don't swear, I know you are ready to ﬂare up like gunpowder.
uz: Hush, qasam ichma, men bilamanki, siz qorong'i kabi o'chishga tayyorsiz.

en: Don't think ill of me for saying so.
uz: Buni aytganim uchun mendan yomon fikrga tushmang.

en: I, too, have no one to whom I can say a word, whose advice I can ask.
