uz: Siz butun kun bobonangiz bilan birga o'tirganingiz charchatmayaptimi? - dedi u. - Men buni so'raganimda, nima sababini bilmayman, qizg'inlab qo'ydim, o'zimni o'zimdan o'yladim va yana o'zimni ranjitdim, chunki boshqa odamlar menga bu haqda so'rashni boshlashdi.

en: I wanted to go away without answering, but I hadn't the strength.
uz: Javob bermasdan ketmoqchi edim, lekin kuchim yo'q edi.

en: 'Listen,' he said, 'you are a good girl.
uz: Quloq sol, dedi u, Sen yaxshi qizsan.

en: Excuse my speaking to you like that, but I assure you that I wish for your welfare quite as much as your grandmother.
uz: Siz bilan shunday gaplashishim uchun uzr so'raysiz, lekin sizga shuni ta'kidlaymanki, men sizning buvimdek sizning ham farovonligingizni tilayman.

en: Have you no friends that you could go and visit?' I told him I hadn't any, that I had had no friend but Mashenka, and she had gone away to Pskov.
uz: Sizda tashrif buyurishingiz mumkin bo'lgan do'stlaringiz yo'qmi? Men unga hech qanday do'stim yo'qligini, Mashenkadan boshqa do'stim yo'qligini va u Pskovga ketganini aytdim.

en: 'Listen,' he said, 'would you like to go to the theatre with me?' 'To the theatre.
uz: Quloq solinglar, dedi u, men bilan teatrga borishni xohlaysizmi? Teatrga.

en: What about grandmother?' 'But you must go without your grandmother's knowing it,' he said.
uz: Oʻgʻli haqida nima deyish mumkin? Agar siz buni onangiz bilmasdan ketishingiz kerak, - dedi u.

en: 'No,' I said, 'I don't want to deceive grandmother.
uz: Yo'q, dedim men, men buvimni aldashni istamayman.

en: Good-bye.' 'Well, good-bye,' he answered, and said nothing more.
uz: Xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh, xo'sh.

en: Only after din- ner he came to see us; sat a long time talking to grandmother; asked her whether she ever went out anywhere, whether she had acquaintances, and suddenly said: 'I have taken a box at the opera for this evening; they are giv- ing The Barber of Seville.
uz: Kishi ovqatdan keyingina bizni ko'rishga keldi; buvim bilan uzoq vaqt suhbatlashdi; u hech qachon biron bir joyga chiqqanmi, tanishlari bormi, deb so'radi va birdan: Men bu kecha uchun operaxonada quti olib keldim; ular Sevillaning barberini taqdim etmoqdalar.

en: My friends meant to go, but afterwards refused, so the ticket is left on my hands.' 'The Barber of Seville,' cried grandmother; 'why, the same they used to act in old days?' 'Yes, it's the same barber,' he said, and glanced at me.
uz: Do'stlarim ketmoqchi edilar, lekin keyinchalik rad etishdi, shuning uchun bilet mening qo'limda qoladi. - deb qayg'urdi buvim; Nima uchun ular qadimgi kunlarda xuddi shunday harakat qilishardi? - deb so'radi.

en: I saw what it meant and turned crimson, and my heart began throbbing with suspense.
uz: Men uning ma'nosini ko'rib, qizil rangga aylandim va yuragim g'ayrat bilan urishni boshladi.

en: 'To be sure, I know it,' said grandmother; 'why, I took the part of Rosina myself in old days, at a private performance!'
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, buni bilaman, - dedi buvim; - nega, eski kunlarda Rosinaning o'rnini men o'zim o'ynadim, xususiy namoyishda!

en: 'So wouldn't you like to go to-day?' said the lodger.
uz: 'Shuning uchun bugun borishni istamaysizmi?' deb so'radi uy egasi.

en: 'Or my ticket will be wasted.' 'By all means let us go,' said grandmother; why shouldn't we?
uz: Yo'q, chiptaim ziyon ketadi. Agar yo'q bo'lsa, ketaylik, - dedi buvim; nima uchun ketmaylik?

en: And my Nastenka here has never been to the theatre.' My goodness, what joy!
uz: Mening Nastenkam esa teatrga hech qachon bormagan.

en: We got ready at once, put on our best clothes, and set off.
uz: Biz darhol tayyorgarlik ko'rdik, eng yaxshi kiyimlarimizni kiydik va yo'lga chiqdik.

en: Though grandmother was blind, still she wanted to hear the mu- sic; besides, she is a kind old soul, what she cared most for was to amuse me, we should never have gone of ourselves.
uz: Garchi buvim ko'r bo'lsa-da, u musiqa tinglashni istardi; bundan tashqari, u mehribon keksa ruhdir, eng ko'p qayg'urgan narsa meni o'yin-kulgi qilishga qaratilgan edi, biz hech qachon o'zimizdan ketmasligimiz kerak edi.

en: What my impressions of The Barber of Seville were I won't tell you; but all that evening our lodger looked at me so nicely, talked so nicely, that I saw at once that he had meant to test me in the morning when he proposed that I should go with him alone.
uz: Sevill shabkiridan qanday taassurot qoldirganimni sizga aytmayman; lekin o'sha kecha bo'yi uy egasi menga shunchalik yaxshi ko'rindi, shunchalik yaxshi gapirdiki, ertalab uni o'zi bilan yolg'iz ketishimni taklif qilganida, u meni sinovdan o'tkazmoqchi ekanini darhol tushundim.

en: I went to bed so proud, so gay, my heart beat so that I was a little feverish, and all night I was raving about The Barber of Seville.
uz: Men o'zimni juda faxr bilan, juda gey qilib, yuragim biroz og'irlanib ketib, uxladim va butun kecha Sevill shaberi haqida o'yladim.

en: I expected that he would come and see us more and more often after that, but it wasn't so at all.
uz: O'shanda u bizni ko'proq va ko'proq ko'rib turishini kutardim, lekin umuman shunday bo'lmagan.

en: He almost entirely gave up coming.
uz: U deyarli butunlay kelishni to'xtatdi.

en: He would just come in about once a month, and then only to invite us to the theatre.
uz: U faqat oyiga bir marta kelib, bizni teatrga taklif qilardi.

en: We went twice again.
uz: Biz yana ikki marta bordik.

en: Only I wasn't at all pleased with that; I saw that he was simply sorry for me because I was so hardly treated by grandmother, and that was all.
uz: Faqat men bundan umuman mamnun emas edim; men buni ko'rdimki, u menga shunchaki achinadi, chunki buvim meni juda oz muomala qilgan edi va bu hammasi edi.

en: As time went on, I grew more and more restless, I couldn't sit still, I couldn't read, I couldn't work; sometimes I laughed and did some- thing to annoy grandmother, at another time I would cry.
uz: Vaqt o'tgach, men ko'proq qayg'urganman, to'xtamay o'tirolmadim, o'qira olmadim, ish qila olmadim; ba'zida men kulgan va buvimni xafa qilish uchun biron-bir narsa qildim, boshqa payt esa yig'lardim.

en: At last I grew thin and was very nearly ill.
uz: Nihoyat, sovunib, kasallikka chalinganman.

en: The opera season was over, and our lodger had quite given up coming to see us; whenever we met—always on the same staircase, of course—he would bow so silently, so gravely, as though he did not want to speak, and go down to the front door, while I went on standing in the middle of the stairs, as red as a cherry, for all the blood rushed to my head at the sight of him.
uz: Opera mavsumining oxiri bo'lgan edi va uy egasi bizni ko'rishni to'xtatgan edi; biz har doim bir xil qadamda uchrasak, albatta, u gapirishni istamaganidek, juda sukut bo'lib, gapirishni istamaganidek, chuqur o'zini egib, eshikga tushardi, men esa uning ko'rinishida butun qon boshimga yog'ib, qadamning o'rtasida, cherry kabi qizil holda turardim.

en: Now the end is near.
uz: Endi oxirat yaqinlashib qoldi.

en: Just a year ago, in May, the lodger came to us and said to grandmother that he had ﬁnished his business here, and that he must go back to Moscow for a year.
uz: Bir yil oldin, may oyida, uy egasi bizga kelib, bu yerda ishini tugatganini va bir yil uchun Moskvaga qaytishi kerakligini buvisiga aytdi.

en: When I heard that, I sank into a chair half dead; grandmother did not notice anything; and having informed us that he should be leaving us, he bowed and went away.
uz: Buni eshitganimda, o'zim yarim o'limga tushdim; buvim hech narsaga e'tibor bermadi; va u bizni tark etishi kerakligini aytgandan so'ng, o'zini egib ketib ketdi.

en: I thought and thought and fretted and fretted, and at last I made up my mind.
uz: Men o'yladim va o'yladim va qayg'urdim va qayg'urdim va nihoyat qarorimni qabul qildim.

en: Next day he was to go away, and I made up my mind to end it all that evening when grandmother went to bed.
uz: Ertasi kuni u ketishi kerak edi va men bu ishni o'sha kechqurun bobom uxlashga ketganda tugatishga qaror qildim.

en: I made up all my clothes in a parcel—all the linen I needed—and with the parcel in my hand, more dead than alive, went upstairs to our lodger.
uz: Men barcha kiyim-kechakimni kerakli matolar bilan to'ldirib, qo'limda bo'lgan paketni tirikdan ko'proq o'lgan holda ushlab, uy egasiga bordim.

en: I believe I must have stayed an hour on the staircase.
uz: O'ylaymanki, men bir soatlik turar joyda turardim.

en: When I opened his door he cried out as he looked at me.
uz: Men eshikni ochganimda, u menga qaraganida baqirib yubordi.

en: He thought I was a ghost, and rushed to give me some water, for I could hardly stand up.
uz: U meni hayajon deb o'yladi va menga suv berishga shoshildi, chunki men to'xtashim ham qiyin edi.

en: My heart beat so violently that my head ached, and I did not know what I was doing.
uz: Qalbim shunchalik qattiq urib ketdiki, boshim og'riqli bo'ldi va nima qilayotganimni bilmasdim.

en: When I recovered I began by laying my parcel on his bed, sat down beside it, hid my face in my hands and went into ﬂoods of tears.
uz: Oʻzimni sogʻaytirganimda, parselimni uning yotoq ustiga qoʻyib, uning yonida oʻtirib, yuzimni qoʻllarimda yashirdim va koʻz yoshlarga toʻlib-toshdim.

en: I think he understood it all at once, and looked at me so sadly that my heart was torn.
uz: O'ylaymanki, u hamma narsani bir lahzada tushunib, menga shunchalik xafa bo'lib qaradiki, yuragim tishlab ketadi.

en: 'Listen,' he began, 'listen, Nastenka, I can't do anything; I am a poor man, for I have nothing, not even a decent berth.
uz: Quloq sol, Nastenka, men hech narsa qila olmayman; men kambag'al odamman, chunki men hech narsaga ega emasman, hatto munosib joyga ham ega emasman.

en: How could we live, if I were to marry you?' 'We talked a long time; but at last I got quite frantic, I said I could not go on living with grandmother, that I should run away from her, that I did not want to be pinned to her, and that I would go to Moscow if he liked, be- cause I could not live without him.
uz: Agar men siz bilan turmushga chiqsam, qanday yashashimiz mumkin?  Biz uzoq vaqt gaplashdik; lekin nihoyat, men juda g'alati bo'ldim, buvim bilan yashashni davom ettira olmasligimni, undan qochib ketishim kerakligini, unga bog'lanishimni istamasligimni va agar u xohlasa, Moskvaga borishimni aytdim, chunki men usiz yashay olmasligimni aytdim.

en: Shame and pride and love were all clam- ouring in me at once, and I fell on the bed, almost in convulsions, I was so afraid of a refusal.
uz: Sharm, mag'rurlik va sevgi birdan ichimga tushdi va men to'shagimga tushib qoldim, deyarli sarosimaga tushdim, rad etishdan juda qo'rqardim.

en: He sat for some minutes in silence, then got up, came up to me and took me by the hand.
uz: U bir necha daqiqacha xotirjamlik bilan o'tirdi, so'ngra o'rnidan turib, yonimga kelib, qo'limdan ushlab oldi.

en: 'Listen, my dear good Nastenka, listen; I swear to you that if I am ever in a position to marry, you shall make my happiness.
uz: 'Quloq sol, aziz yaxshi Nastenka, quloq sol; agar men turmushga chiqsam, sen mening baxtimni yaratasan, deb senga qasam ichaman.

en: I assure you that now you are the only one who could make me happy.
uz: Sizga shuni ta'kidlaymanki, endi meni baxtli qila oladigan yagona odam sizsiz.

en: Listen, I am going to Mos- cow and shall be there just a year; I hope to establish my position.
uz: Quloq solinglar, men Mos-vaqaga boryapman va u erda bir yil bo'laman; umid qilamanki, o'z pozitsiyamni o'rnataman.

en: When I come back, if you still love me, I swear that we will be happy.
uz: Men qaytib kelganimda, agar siz meni hali ham sevsangiz, biz baxtli bo'lamiz, deb qasam ichaman.

en: Now it is im- possible, I am not able, I have not the right to promise anything.
uz: Endi bu mumkin emas, men bunga qodir emasman, hech narsa va'da berishga haqim yo'q.

en: Well, I re- peat, if it is not within a year it will certainly be some time; that is, of course, if you do not prefer any one else, for I cannot and dare not bind you by any sort of promise.' That was what he said to me, and next day he went away.
uz: Men yana aytamanki, agar bir yil ichida bo'lmasa, albatta, bu bir muncha vaqt o'tib ketadi; ya'ni, albatta, agar siz boshqa hech kimni afzal ko'rmasangiz, chunki men sizni hech qanday va'da bilan bog'lashga jur'at qilmayman va jur'at qilmayman.

en: \We agreed together not to say a word to grandmother: that was his wish.
uz: Biz buvimga bir so'z aytmaslikka rozi bo'ldik: bu uning xohishi edi.

en: tory is nearly ﬁnished now.
uz: Tory endi deyarli tugadi.

en: Just a year has past.
uz: Faqatgina bir yil o'tdi.

en: He has arrived; he has been here three days, and—and—— And what? I cried, impatient to hear the end.
uz: U keldi; u uch kundir bu yerda, vaand Va nima? - dedim men so'nggi so'zlarni eshitish uchun intizorlik bilan.

en: And up to now has not shown himself! answered Nastenka, as though screwing up all her courage.
uz: Nastenka shunday javob berdi: O'zi hozirgacha ko'rsatmagan! - deganiga o'zi jasoratini buzgandek bo'ldi.

en: There's no sign or sound of him. Here she stopped, paused for a minute, bent her head, and covering her face with her hands broke into such sobs that it sent a pang to my heart to hear them.
uz: Undan hech qanday iz yoki tovush yo'q. Bu yerda u to'xtadi, bir daqiqa to'xtadi, boshini egib, yuzini qo'llari bilan qoplab, shunchalik yig'lab yubordiki, ularni eshitish uchun yuragimga og'ir tushdi.

en: I had not in the least expected such a dénouement.
uz: Men hech qachon bunday yakunni kutmagan edim.

en: Nastenka, I began timidly in an ingratiating voice, Nastenka!
uz: Nastenka, - deb qo'rqqanimdan boshlandi men qo'pol ovoz bilan, Nastenka!

en: For goodness' sake don't cry!
uz: Xudo uchun yig'lamang!

en: Perhaps he is not here yet.
uz: Ehtimol, u hali kelmagan.

en: . He is, he is, Nastenka repeated.
uz: Nastenka yana aytdi: U bor, bor.

en: He is here, and I know it.
uz: U bu yerda va men buni bilaman.

en: We made an agreement at the time, that evening, before he went away: when we said all that I have told you, and had come to an understanding, then we came out here for a walk on this embankment.
uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun, u ketishdan oldin, biz kelishuvga erishdik: men sizga aytgan hamma narsani aytdik va kelishuvga erishdik, so'ngra bu qirg'oqdan yurish uchun bu yerga keldik.

en: It was ten o'clock; we sat on this seat.
uz: Soat o'n edi va biz shu o'rindiqga o'tirdik.

en: I was not crying then; it was sweet to me to hear what he said.
uz: O'shanda men yig'lamagan edim; uning gapirganini eshitish menga yoqimli bo'ldi.

en: And he said that he would come to us directly he arrived, and if I did not refuse him, then we would tell grandmother about it all.
uz: U bizga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelishini aytdi va agar men uni rad qilmasam, biz buni buvisiga aytardik.

en: Now he is here, I know it, and yet he does not come! And again she burst into tears.
uz: Endi u bu yerda, men buni bilaman, lekin u kelmaydi! - deb yana yig'lab yubordi u.

en: Good God, can I do nothing to help you in your sorrow? I cried, jump- ing up from the seat in utter despair.
uz: Yaxshi Xudoyim, sening qaygʻuningda menga yordam berish uchun hech narsa qilsam boʻlmasmidi? - deb qaygʻurdim va oʻtirgan joyimdan tushkunlikka tushib oʻtirdim.

en: Tell me, Nastenka, wouldn't it be pos- sible for me to go to him? Would that be possible? she asked suddenly, raising her head.
uz: Menga ayting, Nastenka, men uning oldiga borishim mumkin emasmi? - deb so'radi u to'satdan boshini ko'tarib.

en: No, of course not, I said pulling myself up; but I tell you what, write a letter. No, that's impossible, I can't do that, she answered with decision, bend- ing her head and not looking at me.
uz: Yo'q, albatta, yo'q, - dedim men o'zimni ko'targan holda, lekin sizga nima deyman, xat yozing. Yo'q, bu mumkin emas, men buni qila olmayman, deb qaror bilan javob berdi u, boshini egib, menga qaramasdi.

en: How impossible—why is it impossible? I went on, clinging to my idea.
uz: Nega bu mumkin emas? deb so'radim va o'z g'oyamni qo'llab-quvvatladim.

en: But, Nastenka, it depends what sort of letter; there are letters and letters and.
uz: Ammo, Nastenka, bu harfning turiga bog'liq; harflar va harflar bor va.

en: Ah, Nastenka, I am right; trust to me, trust to me, I will not give
uz: Ah, Nastenka, men haqliman; menga ishoning, menga ishoning, men bermayman

en: It can all be arranged!
uz: Hamma narsa tartibga solinadi!

en: You took the ﬁrst step—why not now? I can't.
uz: Siz birinchi qadamni qo'ydingiz, nima uchun endi qilmaysiz? - Bo'lmayman.

en: It would seem as though I were forcing myself on him.
uz: O'zimni unga majburlayotganim kabi ko'rinardi.

en: . Ah, my good little Nastenka, I said, hardly able to conceal a smile; no, no, you have a right to, in fact, because he made you a promise.
uz: Aha, yaxshi Nastenkam, - dedim men, tabassumni yashirishni qiyinlashtirgan holda; yo'q, yo'q, siz bunga haqingiz bor, chunki u sizga va'da berdi.

en: Besides, I can see from everything that he is a man of delicate feeling; that he behaved very well, I went on, more and more carried away by the logic of my own arguments and convictions.
uz: Bundan tashqari, men uning hissiyotlari puch bo'lgan inson ekanligini, juda yaxshi xulq-atvor ko'rsatganini hamma narsadan ko'rishim mumkin, - deb davom ettirdim men, o'z fikrlarim va e'tiqodlarimning mantiqiy ta'siridan ko'proq zavq oldim.

en: He bound himself by a promise: he said that if he married at all he would marry no one but you; he gave you full liberty to refuse him at once.
uz: U o'ziga va'da berdi: agar u erga tegsa, sizdan boshqa hech kimga turmushga chiqmasligini aytdi; unga darhol rad etish uchun sizga to'liq erkinlikni berdi.

en: Under such circumstances you may take the ﬁrst step; you have the right; you are in the privileged po- sition—if, for instance, you wanted to free him from his promise.
uz: Bunday sharoitlarda siz birinchi qadam qo'yishingiz mumkin; siz haqingiz bor; agar, masalan, uni va'dasidan ozod qilishni istasangiz, siz imtiyozli joyda bo'lasiz.

en: . Listen; how would you write? Write what? This letter. I tell you how I would write: 'Dear Sir'.
uz: . Quloq soling, qanday yozasiz? Nima yozasiz? Bu xat. Men sizga qanday yozishni aytaman: Hamram.

en: . Must I really begin like that, 'Dear Sir'? You certainly must!
uz: . Men chindan ham shunday boshlashim kerak, Hokim? Siz albatta shunday qilishingiz kerak!

en: Though, after all, I don't know, I imagine.
uz: Garchi, oxir-oqibat, bilmayman, deb o'ylayman.

en: . Well, well, what next? 'Dear Sir,—I must apologise for——' But, no, there's no need to apolo- gise; the fact itself justiﬁes everything.
uz: Hmm, nima bo'ladi? - deb so'radi. - Hmm, endi nima bo'ladi? - deb so'radi. - Hmm, yaxshi, nima bo'ladi? - Hmm, aziz sir,Men kechirim so'rashim kerak. Ammo, yo'q, kechirim so'rashning hojati yo'q; bu faktning o'zi hamma narsani oqlaydi.

en: Write simply:— 'I am writing to you.
uz: Sodda qilib yoz: 'Men sizga yozyapman.

en: Forgive me my impatience; but I have been happy for a whole year in hope; am I to blame for being unable to endure a day of doubt now?
uz: Sabrsizlikimni kechiringlar; lekin men butun yil davomida umid bilan baxtli bo'ldim; endi shubha kunini chiday olmasligim uchun meni ayblash kerakmi?

en: Now that you have come, perhaps you have changed your mind.
uz: Endi kelgani uchun, ehtimol, fikringizni o'zgartirgansiz.

en: If so, this letter is to tell you that I do not repine, nor blame you.
uz: Agar shunday bo'lsa, bu maktub sizga men sizni ayblamayman va ayblamayman, deb aytish uchun.

en: I do not blame you because I have no power over your heart, such is my fate!
uz: Men sizni ayblamayman, chunki sizning yuragingiz ustidan hech qanday hokimiyatim yo'q, bu mening taqdirimdir!

en: 'You are an honourable man.
uz: 'Siz hurmatli odamsiz.

en: You will not smile or be vexed at these im- patient lines.
uz: Bu sabrsiz so'zlarga ko'ra siz tabassum qilmaysiz yoki xafa bo'lmaysiz.

en: Remember they are written by a poor girl; that she is alone; that she has no one to direct her, no one to advise her, and that she herself could never control her heart.
uz: Shuni yodda tutingki, ular kambag'al qiz tomonidan yozilgan; u yolg'iz; unga yo'l ko'rsatadigan, maslahat beradigan hech kim yo'q va u o'z yuragini hech qachon nazorat qila olmaydi.

en: But forgive me that a doubt has stolen—if
uz: Lekin menga kechiringlar, agar shubha o'g'irlagan bo'lsa.

en: only for one instant—into my heart.
uz: Faqat bir daqiqa uchun qalbimga kirdim.

en: You are not capable of insulting, even in thought, her who so loved and so loves you.' Yes, yes; that's exactly what I was thinking! cried Nastenka, and her eyes beamed with delight.
uz: Siz sizni juda yaxshi ko'rgan va sizni juda yaxshi ko'radigan ayolni hatto o'ylashingiz bilan ham haqoratlashga qodir emassiz. - Ha, ha, men aynan shu haqda o'yladim! - deb baqirdi Nastenka va uning ko'zlari quvonchdan to'lib-toshdi.

en: Oh, you have solved my difﬁculties: God has sent you to me!
uz: Oh, siz mening muammolarimni hal qildingiz: Xudo sizni menga yubordi!

en: Thank you, thank you! What for?
uz: Rahmat, rahmat! Nima uchun?

en: For God's sending me? I answered, looking de- lighted at her joyful little face.
uz: Chunki Xudo meni yubordi, - deb javob berdim va uning quvonchli yuziga ko'z tikdim.

en: Why, yes; for that too. Ah, Nastenka!
uz: Nega, ha, shu uchun ham.  Ah, Nastenka!

en: Why, one thanks some people for being alive at the same time with one; I thank you for having met me, for my being able to remem- ber you all my life! Well, enough, enough!
uz: Birov bilan bir vaqtning o'zida tirik bo'lganingiz uchun ba'zi odamlarga minnatdorchilik bildiraman, men bilan uchrashganingiz uchun, butun hayotim davomida sizlarni eslab qolishim uchun minnatdorman!

en: But now I tell you what, lis- ten: we made an agreement then that as soon as he arrived he would let me know, by leaving a letter with some good simple people of my acquaintance who know nothing about it; or, if it were impossible to write a letter to me, for a letter does not always tell everything, he would be here at ten o'clock on the day he arrived, where we had arranged to meet.
uz: Ammo endi sizga nima deyman: o'sha paytda biz kelishuvga erishdikki, u kelganida menga xabar beradi, bu haqda hech narsa bilmaydigan ba'zi yaxshi oddiy odamlar bilan xat qoldiradi; yoki agar menga xat yozish imkonsiz bo'lsa, chunki xat har doim ham hamma narsani aytmaydi, u kelgan kuni soat o'nlarda bu erda bo'ladi, biz uchrashishni rejalashtirgan joyda.

en: I know he has ar- rived already; but now it's the third day, and there's no sign of him and no letter.
uz: Bilaman, u allaqachon ko'rib chiqilgan, lekin endi uchinchi kun bo'ldi va uning izlari ham, xatlari ham yo'q.

en: It's impossible for me to get away from grandmother in the morning.
uz: Men ertalab buvimdan qochishim mumkin emas.

en: Give my letter to-morrow to those kind people I spoke to you about: they will send it on to him, and if there is an answer you bring it to-morrow at ten o'clock. But the letter, the letter!
uz: Ertaga maktubimni sizga aytgan mehribon odamlarga beringlar: ular uni unga yuboradilar va agar javob bo'lsa, ertaga soat o'nlarda keltiringlar.

en: You see, you must write the letter ﬁrst!
uz: Ko'rib turganingizdek, avval siz maktubni yozishingiz kerak!

en: So per- haps it must all be the day after to-morrow. The letter.
uz: Shunday qilib, ehtimol hamma narsa ertangi kun bo'lishi kerak.

en: . said Nastenka, a little confused, the letter.
uz: . dedi Nastenka biroz chalg'ib, harf.

en: . But she did not ﬁnish.
uz: Ammo u bitmadi.

en: At ﬁrst she turned her little face away from me, ﬂushed like a rose, and suddenly I felt in my hand a letter which had evi- dently been written long before, all ready and sealed up.
uz: Boshida u o'zining kichkina yuzini mendan yuz o'girib, gullab-yashnaydi va to'satdan qo'limda uzoq vaqt oldin yozilgan, tayyor va muhrlangan xatni his qildim.

en: A familiar sweet and charming reminiscence ﬂoated through my mind.
uz: Mening ongimda tanish, shirin va chiroyli xotiralar o'rab turardi.

en: R, o—Ro; s, i—si; n, a—na, I began.
uz: R, oRo; s, isi; n, ana, deb boshladim.

en: Rosina! we both hummed together; I almost embracing her with de- light, while she blushed as only she could blush, and laughed through the tears which gleamed like pearls on her black eyelashes.
uz: Rosina! - deb hammamiz bir joyda qichqirdik; men uni de-yush bilan quchoqlab oldim, u faqat o'zi qichqirishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada qizardi va qora ko'z burchaklarida marvaridlar kabi parlashayotgan ko'z yoshlari orqali kuldi.

en: Come, enough, enough!
uz: Qo'sh, yetarli, yetarli!

en: Good-bye now, she said, speaking rapidly.
uz: Xo'sh, endi xayrlashamiz, - dedi u, tez gapirib.

en: Here is the letter, here is the address to which you are to take it.
uz: Mana xat, mana uni olib ketish uchun manzil.

en: Good-bye, till we meet again!
uz: Xo'sh, yana uchrashuvga qadar!

en: Till tomorrow! She pressed both my hands warmly, nodded her head, and ﬂew like an arrow down her side street.
uz: Ertaga qadar! - deb qo'limdan qo'l urdi, boshini bosdi va yon ko'chasi bo'ylab o'q kabi uchdi.

en: I stood still for a long time following her with my eyes.
uz: Ko'zlarim bilan uni uzoq vaqt davomida kuzatib turardim.

en: till tomorrow! was ringing in my ears as she vanished from my sight.
uz: Ertagacha! - deb quloqlarimga qichqirdi u ko'zimdan yo'qolganida.

en: THIRD NIGHT Today was a gloomy, rainy day without a glimmer of sunlight, like the old age before me.
uz: Uchinchi kecha Bugun qorong'i, yomg'irli kun edi, quyosh nurining bir nishi yo'q edi, xuddi oldingi yoshlar kabi.

en: I am oppressed by such strange thoughts, such gloomy sensations; questions still so obscure to me are crowding into my brain— and I seem to have neither power nor will to settle them.
uz: Men o'zgacha fikrlar, nozik his-tuyg'ular bilan ovora bo'ldim; menga hali ham noma'lum bo'lgan savollar miyamga to'lib-toshmoqda va men ularni hal qilishga kuch ham, xohish-irodam ham yo'qdek tuyuladi.

en: It's not for me to settle all this!
uz: Bularning barchasini hal qilish men uchun emas!

en: Today we shall not meet.
uz: Bugun uchrashmaymiz.

en: Yesterday, when we said good-bye, the clouds began gathering over the sky and a mist rose.
uz: Kecha, biz salom berayotganimizda, bulutlar osmon ustidan to'planib, bulut ko'tarildi.

en: I said that tomorrow it would be a bad day; she made no answer, she did not want to speak against her wishes; for her that day was bright and clear, not one cloud should obscure her happiness.
uz: Men unga ertaga yomon kun bo'lishini aytdim; u hech qanday javob bermadi, xohishiga qarshi gapirishni istamadi; chunki unga o'sha kun yorqin va aniq edi, hech bir bulut uning baxtini yashirmaslikka majbur emas edi.

en: If it rains we shall not see each other, she said, I shall not come. I thought that she would not notice today's rain, and yet she had not come.
uz: U: Yog'ursa ko'rishmaymiz, - deb aytdi, men kelmayman. Men uning bugungi yomg'irga e'tibor bermasligini o'yladim, ammo u kelmagan edi.

en: Yesterday was our third interview, our third white night.
uz: Kecha uchinchi suhbatimiz, uchinchi oq kechamiz edi.

en: But how ﬁne joy and happiness makes any one!
uz: Ammo hech kimga qanday ajoyib quvonch va baxt keltiradi!

en: How brimming over with love the heart is!
uz: Qalb naqadar sevgi bilan to'lib-toshgan!

en: One seems longing to pour out one's whole heart; one wants everything to be gay, everything to be laughing.
uz: Biror kishi o'zining butun qalbini to'kib solishni orzu qiladi; hamma narsa gey bo'lishini, hamma narsa kulishishini xohlaydi.

en: And how infectious that joy is!
uz: Va bu quvonch qanchalik yuqumli!

en: There was such a softness in her words, such a kindly feeling in her heart towards me yesterday.
uz: Uning so'zlarida shunday yumshoqlik bor edi, uning yuragida o'sha kuni menga nisbatan shunday mehribon his-tuyg'u bor edi.

en: How solicitous and friendly she was; how tenderly she tried to give me courage!
uz: U qanchalik mehribon va mehribon edi; menga jasorat berishga qanchalik mehribonlik bilan harakat qildi!

en: Oh, the coquetry of happiness!
uz: Oh, baxtning quvonchli koketiri!

en: I took it all for the genuine thing, I thought that she.
uz: Men hammasini haqiqiy narsa deb o'yladim, o'yladim.

en: But, my God, how could I have thought it?
uz: Ammo, ey Xudoyim, men buni qanday tasavvur qilgan bo'lardim?

en: How could I have been so blind, when everything had been taken by another already, when nothing was mine; when, in fact, her very tenderness to me, her anxiety, her love.
uz: Qanday qilib men shu qadar ko'r bo'lgan bo'lsam bo'ladi, chunki hamma narsa boshqa birov tomonidan o'tkazilgan edi, hech narsa mening emas edi; aslida, uning menga bo'lgan mehribonligi, tashvishlari, sevgisi.

en: yes, love for me, was nothing else but joy at the thought of seeing another man so soon, desire to include me, too, in her happiness?
uz: Ha, men uchun bo'lgan sevgi, boshqa bir odamni tezda ko'rish fikridan quvonch va meni ham o'z baxtida qo'shish istagidan boshqa narsa emasmi?

en: When he did not come, when we waited in vain, she frowned, she grew timid and dis- couraged.
uz: U kelmaganida, biz bekorga kutganimizda, u ko'z o'ngida, qo'rqinchli va jasoratsiz bo'lib qoldi.

en: Her movements, her words, were no longer so light, so playful, so gay; and, strange to say, she redoubled her attentiveness to me, as though instinctively desiring to lavish on me what she desired for herself so anx- iously, if her wishes were not accomplished.
uz: Uning harakatlari, so'zlari endi shunchalik yengil, o'yinchan va gey emas edi; g'alati gap, u menga nisbatan e'tiborini ikki baravar ko'paytirdi, xuddi o'z xohishi amalga oshmasa, o'zi uchun nima xohlaganini menga haddan tashqari berishni istar edi.

en: My Nastenka was so down- cast, so dismayed, that I think she realized at last that I loved her, and was
uz: Mening Nastenkam shunchalik tushkunlikka tushdi, shunchalik xafa bo'ldiki, o'ylaymanki, u nihoyat men uni yaxshi ko'rganimni va uni sevganimni angladi.

en: sorry for my poor love.
uz: Mening kambag'al sevgim uchun uzr so'rayman.

en: So when we are unhappy we feel the unhappiness of others more; feeling is not destroyed but concentrated.
uz: Shunday qilib, biz baxtsiz bo'lganimizda, boshqalarning baxtsizligini ko'proq his qilamiz; his-tuyg'ular yo'q qilinmaydi, balki o'zimizga qaratilgan.

en: I went to meet her with a full heart, and was all impatience.
uz: Men uni kutib olish uchun butun qalbim bilan bordim va juda sabrsizlik bilan bordim.

en: I had no pre- sentiment that I should feel as I do now, that it would not all end happily.
uz: Hozirgi his-tuyg'ularimni o'zimda his qilishim kerak, bularning barchasi baxtli yakunlanmasligi haqida hech qanday tasavvurim bo'lmagan.

en: She was beaming with pleasure; she was expecting an answer.The answer was himself.
uz: U zavq-shavq bilan quvonardi; javob kutardi.Javobi o'zi edi.

en: He was to come, to run at her call.
uz: U kelishi kerak edi, uning chaqirig'i bilan yugurishi kerak edi.

en: She arrived a whole hour before I did.
uz: U mendan bir soat oldin keldi.

en: At ﬁrst she giggled at everything, laughed at every word I said.
uz: Boshida u hamma narsaga kulishardi, aytgan har bir so'zimga kulishardi.

en: I began talking, but relapsed into silence.
uz: Men gapira boshladim, lekin so'zsizlikka qaytdim.

en: Do you know why I am so glad, she said, so glad to look at you?— why I like you so much today? Well? I asked, and my heart began throbbing.
uz: U shunday dedi: Seni ko'rib, nega xursand bo'lganimni bilasizmi? Nima uchun bugun seni juda yaxshi ko'raman? - Men so'radim va yuragim urishga tushdi.

en: I like you because you have not fallen in love with me.
uz: Seni yoqtiraman, chunki sen menga muhabbat qilmagan eding.

en: You know that some men in your place would have been pestering and worrying me, would have been sighing and miserable, while you are so nice! Then she wrung my hand so hard that I almost cried out.
uz: O'zingizning o'rningizda bo'lgan ba'zi erkaklar meni xavotirga solishlari va xavotirga solishlari mumkinligini bilasiz, lekin siz juda mehribon bo'lasiz!  - dedi. Keyin u qo'limni shunchalik qattiq urdiki, deyarli qichqirib yubordim.

en: Goodness, what a friend you are! she began gravely a minute later.
uz: Bir daqiqadan so'ng u jiddiy ravishda: Alloh, qanday do'st ekansan! - deb boshladi.

en: God sent you to me.
uz: Xudo seni menga yubordi.

en: What would have happened to me if you had not been with me now?
uz: Agar sen hozir men bilan bo'lmaganingda, menga nima bo'lar edi?

en: How disinterested you are!
uz: Siz qanchalik befarqsizsiz!

en: How truly you care for me!
uz: Siz men uchun qanchalik g'amxo'rlik qilyapsiz!

en: When I am married we will be great friends, more than brother and sister; I shall care almost as I do for him.
uz: Men turmush qurganimdan so'ng, birodar va singlimizdan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi do'st bo'lamiz; men ham unga qaraganda ko'proq g'amxo'rlik qilaman.

en: . I felt horribly sad at that moment, yet something like laughter was stir- ring in my soul.
uz: O'sha paytda men juda xafa bo'ldim, ammo ruhimda kulgi kabi bir narsa o'z-o'zini uyg'otdi.

en: You are very much upset, I said; you are frightened; you think he won't come. Oh dear! she answered; if I were less happy, I believe I should cry at your lack of faith, at your reproaches.
uz: Men: Siz juda xafa bo'libsiz, qo'rqasiz, u kelmaydi, deb o'ylaysiz, - dedim. Agar men bundan kamroq baxtli bo'lsam, sizning imonsizligingiz, tanqidlaringiz uchun yig'lar edim.

en: However, you have made me think and have given me a lot to think about; but I shall think later, and now I will own that you are right.
uz: Biroq, siz meni o'ylashga undashdingiz va ko'p narsalarni o'ylashga undashdingiz; lekin keyinroq o'ylayman va endi siz haq ekanligingizni anglayman.

en: Yes, I am somehow not myself; I am all suspense, and feel everything as it were too lightly.
uz: Ha, men o'zim emasman, faqat o'zim bo'lib qoldim va hamma narsani juda yengil his qilaman.

en: that's enough about feelings.
uz: His-tuyg'ular haqida shu qadar gap ketadi.

en: . At that moment we heard footsteps, and in the darkness we saw a ﬁgure coming towards us.
uz: O'sha paytda biz qadamlarni eshitdik va qorong'ilikda bizga yaqinlashib kelayotgan shaxsni ko'rdik.

en: We both started; she almost cried out; I dropped her
uz: Ikkalasi ham boshladik; u deyarli qichqirdi; men uni tashlab yubordim

en: hand and made a movement as though to walk away.
uz: qo'lini ko'tarib, xuddi ketgandek harakat qildi.

en: But we were mistaken, it was not he.
uz: Ammo biz xato qildik, bu u emas edi.

en: What are you afraid of?
uz: Siz nimaga qo'rqasiz?

en: Why did you let go of my hand? she said, giv- ing it to me again.
uz: Nima uchun qo'limni qo'yib yubording? - dedi u, yana qo'limni qo'yib berdi.

en: We will meet him together; I want him to see how fond we are of each other. How fond we are of each other! I cried.
uz: U bilan birga uchrashamiz; men uning bir-birimizga qanchalik mehribon ekanimizni ko'rishini istayman. Biz bir-birimizga qanchalik mehribonmiz! - deb o'yladim men.

en: (Oh, Nastenka, Nastenka, I thought, how much you have told me in that saying!
uz: Oh, Nastenka, Nastenka, - deb o'yladim men, - o'sha so'zlar bilan menga qanchalar ko'p gapirgansiz!

en: Such fondness at cer- tain moments makes the heart cold and the soul heavy.
uz: Ba'zi paytlarda bunday sevgi yurakni sovuq va ruhni og'ir qiladi.

en: Your hand is cold, mine burns like ﬁre.
uz: Sizning qo'lingiz sovuq, mening qo'lim olov kabi yonadi.

en: How blind you are, Nastenka!
uz: Qancha ko'rsan, Nastenka!

en: Oh, how unbearable a happy person is sometimes!
uz: Ba'zan baxtli odam qanchalik chidamsiz bo'ladi!

en: But I could not be angry with you!) At last my heart was too full.
uz: Ammo men sen bilan g'azablanolmasdim!) Oxir-oqibat yuragim juda to'lib-toshdi.

en: Listen, Nastenka! I cried.
uz: Quloq sol, Nastenka! - deb yig'ladim men.

en: Do you know how it has been with me all day? Why, how, how?
uz: Men bilan kun bo'yi qanday bo'lganini bilasizmi? Nima uchun, qanday, qanday?

en: Why have you said nothing all this time? To begin with, Nastenka, when I had carried out all your commissions, given the letter, gone to see your good friends, then .
uz: Nega shuncha vaqt davomida hech narsa aytmading? - Birinchidan, Nastenka, men sizning barcha topshiriqlaringizni bajarganimdan, maktubni berganimdan, yaxshi do'stlaringizni ko'rish uchun ketganimdan keyin .

en: then I went home and went to bed. Is that all? she interrupted, laughing.
uz: Keyin uyga borib uxladim. - Mana shularmi? - dedi u kulish bilan.

en: Yes, almost all, I answered restraining myself, for foolish tears were already starting into my eyes.
uz: Ha, deyarli hamma, deb javob berdim men o'zimni tiyib, chunki ko'zlarimda aqlsiz ko'z yoshlari allaqachon boshlangan edi.

en: I woke an hour before our appointment, and yet, as it were, I had not been asleep.
uz: Biz tayinlangan kunimizdan bir soat oldin uyg'onib qoldim, ammo, bir so'z bilan aytganda, uxlamagan edim.

en: I don't know what happened to me.
uz: Menga nima bo'lganini bilmayman.

en: I came to tell you all about it, feeling as though time were standing still, feel- ing as though one sensation, one feeling must remain with me from that time for ever; feeling as though one minute must go on for all eternity, and as though all life had come to a standstill for me.
uz: Men bu haqda sizga hamma narsani aytib berishga keldim, o'zimni vaqt to'xtab turgandek his qildim, o'zimni bir hissiyot, bir hissiyot o'sha paytdan boshlab mendan abadiy qolishi kerak, bir daqiqa abadiy davom etishi kerak, butun hayotim to'xtab qolganidek his qildim.

en: When I woke up it seemed as though some musical motive long familiar, heard somewhere in the past, forgotten and voluptuously sweet, had come back to me now.
uz: O'shanda uyg'onganimda, uzoq vaqtdan beri tanish, o'tmishda eshitilgan, unutilgan va yoqimli musiqiy motiv endi menga qaytib keldi.

en: It seemed to me that it had been clamouring at my heart all my life, and only now.
uz: O'zimga o'xshab, bu butun hayotim davomida qalbimda va faqat hozirda ro'za tutgan.

en: … Oh my goodness, my goodness, Nastenka interrupted, what does all that mean?
uz: Nastenka: Ya'ni, ey Xudoyim, mening Xudoyim, bularning barchasi nima degani?

en: I don't understand a word.
uz: Men bir so'zni ham tushunmayapman.

en: Ah, Nastenka, I wanted somehow to convey to you that strange impres- sion.
uz: Ah, Nastenka, men sizga o'sha g'alati taassurotni qandaydir tarzda yetkazmoqchiman.

en: . I began in a plaintive voice, in which there still lay hid a hope, though a very faint one.
uz: . - deb qo'shib boshladim.Uda hali ham juda zaif bo'lsa-da, umid yashiringan.

en: Hush! she said, and in one instant the sly puss had guessed.
uz: Xush bo'l! - dedi u, bir lahzada esa o'g'lim o'g'il g'ayritabiiy fikrda edi.

en: Suddenly she became extraordinarily talkative, gay, mischievous; she took my arm, laughed, wanted me to laugh too, and every confused word I uttered evoked from her prolonged ringing laughter.
uz: Toʻsatdan u juda gapiradigan, gey, yovuz boʻlib qoldi; mening qoʻlimdan ushlab, kuldi, men ham kulishimni xohladi va aytgan har bir gʻalati soʻzim uning uzoq vaqt oʻqigan kulgisidan paydo boʻldi.

en: I began to feel an- gry, she had suddenly begun ﬂirting.
uz: Men o'zimni o'ylay boshladim, u to'satdan flirt qila boshladi.

en: Do you know, she began, I feel a little vexed that you are not in love with me?
uz: Bilasizmi, deb boshladi u, men bilan muhabbatga ega emasligingiz uchun biroz xafa bo'laman.

en: There's no understanding human nature!
uz: Inson tabiatini tushunishning iloji yo'q!

en: But all the same, Mr.
uz: Ammo hammasi bir xil, Mr.

en: Un- approachable, you cannot blame me for being so simple; I tell you every- thing, everything, whatever foolish thought comes into my head. Listen!
uz: O'zingizga yaqin bo'lmaydigan, sodda bo'lganim uchun meni ayblashingiz mumkin emas; men sizga hamma narsani, hamma narsani, boshimga kelgan har qanday ahmoqona fikrni aytib beraman.

en: That's eleven, I believe, I said as the slow chime of a bell rang out from a distant tower.
uz: Bu o'n bir soat, deb o'ylayman, - dedim men uzoq bir minardan chiroyli qo'ng'iroq tovushini eshitganimda.

en: She suddenly stopped, left off laughing and began to count.
uz: U to'xtadi, kulishni to'xtatdi va hisoblashni boshladi.

en: Yes, it's eleven, she said at last in a timid, uncertain voice.
uz: Ha, soat o'n bir, - dedi u oxir-oqibat o'zidan o'ta xotirjam va o'ta xotirjam ovoz bilan.

en: I regretted at once that I had frightened her, making her count the strokes, and I cursed myself for my spiteful impulse; I felt sorry for her, and did not know how to atone for what I had done.
uz: Men uni qo'rqitganimdan, urishlarni sanab o'tkazganimdan darhol afsuslandim va o'zimni o'zimga la'natladim; men uning uchun achinardim va qilgan ishim uchun qanday to'lov qilishni bilmadim.

en: I began comforting her, seeking for reasons for his not coming, advanc- ing various arguments, proofs.
uz: Men uni tasalli berishni boshladim, uning kelmasligi sabablarini izlab, turli dalillar, dalillar keltirib chiqardim.

en: No one could have been easier to deceive than she was at that moment; and, indeed, any one at such a moment listens gladly to any consolation, whatever it may be, and is overjoyed if a shadow of excuse can be found.
uz: O'sha paytdagi ayoldan ko'ra hech kimni aldash osonroq bo'lmas edi; haqiqatan ham, bunday paytdagi har bir kishi tasalli qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uni quvonch bilan tinglaydi va uzr soyasi topilsa, xursand bo'ladi.

en: And indeed it's an absurd thing, I began, warming to my task and ad- miring the extraordinary clearness of my argument, why, he could not have come; you have muddled and confused me, Nastenka, so that I too, have lost count of the time.
uz: - Haqiqatan ham bu absurd narsa, - deb boshladim men, vazifasiga jon kuydirib, dalillarimning noyob aniqligiga e'tibor berib, - nima uchun u kelolmagan? - Siz meni chalg'itib, chalg'itib qoldingiz, Nastenka, shuning uchun men ham vaqtni yo'qotdim.

en: Only think: he can scarcely have received the let- ter; suppose he is not able to come, suppose he is going to answer the letter, could not come before tomorrow.
uz: Faqat bir o'ylab ko'ring: u xatni kamdan-kam qabul qilgan bo'lishi mumkin; agar u kelolmasa, javob bermoqchi bo'lsa, ertaga kelib bo'lmaydi.

en: I will go for it as soon as it's light tomor- row and let you know at once.
uz: Men ertalab yorug' bo'lganda uni olib ketaman va sizga darhol xabar beraman.

en: Consider, there are thousands of possibilities; perhaps he was not at home when the letter came, and may not have read it even now!
uz: Bir o'ylab ko'ring, minglab imkoniyatlar bor; ehtimol u maktub kelganida u uyda bo'lmagan va hozir ham uni o'qimagan bo'lishi mumkin!

en: Anything may happen, you know.
uz: Hamma narsa bo'lishi mumkin, bilasiz.

en: Yes, yes! said Nastenka.
uz: Ha, ha! dedi Nastenka.

en: I did not think of that.
uz: Men bu haqda o'ylamaganman.

en: Of course anything may happen? she went on in a tone that offered no opposition, though some other far-away thought could be heard like a vexatious discord in it.
uz: Albatta, biror narsa bo'lishi mumkin, - deb davom etdi u hech qanday qarshilik ko'rsatmagan so'z bilan, garchi u erda boshqa uzoq fikrlar g'azablantiruvchi ziddiyat kabi eshitilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da.

en: I tell you what you must do, she said, you go as early as possible tomorrow morning, and if you get anything let me know at once.
uz: Men sizga nima qilishingiz kerakligini aytaman, ertaga ertalab iloji boricha erta borasiz va agar biron narsa topsangiz, darhol menga xabar bering.

en: You know where I live, don't you? And she began repeating her address to me.
uz: Siz mening qaerda yashayotganimni bilasiz, shunday emasmi? - deb so'zlashdi u. Keyin u menga murojaatini takrorlay boshladi.

en: Then she suddenly became so tender, so solicitous with me.
uz: Keyin u to'satdan menga nisbatan juda mehribon va mehribon bo'ldi.

en: She seemed to listen attentively to what I told her; but when I asked her some question she was silent, was confused, and turned her head away.
uz: U men aytgan so'zlarimni diqqat bilan tinglagan bo'lib tuyuladi; lekin men unga savol bersam, u jim qoldi, chalg'ib qoldi va boshini o'zgartirdi.

en: I looked into her eyes—yes, she was crying.
uz: Men uning ko'zlariga qaradim, ha, u yig'layotgan edi.

en: Oh, what a baby you are!
uz: Oh, siz qanday bolasiz!

en: what childish- ness!
uz: Bu naqadar bolalikdir!

en: Come, come! She tried to smile, to calm herself, but her chin was quivering and her bo- som was still heaving.
uz: Kel, kel! - deb tabassum qilib, o'zini tinchlantirishga harakat qildi, lekin uning qani titraydi va bo-som hali ham ko'tarildi.

en: I was thinking about you, she said after a minute's silence.
uz: Seni o'yladim, - dedi u bir daqiqalik xotirjamlik so'ng.

en: You are so kind that I should be a stone if I did not feel it.
uz: Siz shunchalik mehribonsizki, agar uni his qilmasam, men tosh bo'laman.

en: Do you know what has oc- curred to me now?
uz: Endi menga nima sabab bo'lganini bilasizmi?

en: I was comparing you two.
uz: Men siz ikkovingizni solishtirgan edim.

en: He is not as good as you, though I love him more than you. I made no answer.
uz: U siz kabi yaxshi emas, ammo men uni sizdan ko'ra ko'proq sevaman. - deb javob bermadim.

en: She seemed to expect me to say something.
uz: O'shanda u mendan biror narsa aytishimni kutardi.

en: Of course, it may be that I don't understand him fully yet.
uz: Albatta, men uni hali to'liq tushunmagan bo'lishim mumkin.

en: You know I was always as it were afraid of him; he was always so grave, as it were so proud.
uz: O'zingiz bilasiz, men har doim undan qo'rqardim, u har doim juda jiddiy va g'ururli edi.

en: Of course I know it's only that he seems like that, I know there is more tenderness in his heart than in mine.
uz: Albatta, men faqat uning shunday ko'rinishini bilaman, uning yuragida mening yuragimda bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq mehr borligini bilaman.

en: I remember how he looked at me when I went in to him—do you remember?—with my bundle; but yet I respect him too much, and doesn't that show that we are not equals? No, Nastenka, no, I answered, it shows that you love him more than anything in the world, and far more than yourself. Yes, supposing that is so, answered Nastenka naïvely.
uz: Men uning yoniga kirganimda u menga qanday qarashini eslayman, eslaysizmi?Qo'plam bilan; lekin men unga juda hurmat qilaman va bu biz teng emasligimizni ko'rsatmaydi? - Yo'q, Nastenka, yo'q, deb javob berdim men, bu uni dunyodagi har qanday narsadan ko'ra va o'zingdan ko'ra ko'proq sevganingni ko'rsatadi. - Ha, agar shunday bo'lsa, - dedi Nastenka naiflik bilan javob berdi.

en: But do you know what strikes me now?
uz: Ammo hozir meni nima hayratda qoldirganini bilasizmi?

en: Only I am not talking about him now, but speaking generally; all this came into my mind some time ago.
uz: Faqat men hozir u haqida emas, balki umuman gapiryapman; bularning barchasi bir muncha vaqt oldin mening ongimga keldi.

en: Tell me, how is it that we can't all be like brothers together?
uz: Ayting-chi, nima uchun hammamiz bir joyda birodarlar kabi bo'la olmaymiz?

en: Why is it that even the best of men always seem to hide something from other people and to keep something back?
uz: Nima uchun hatto eng zo'r insonlar hamisha boshqalardan biror narsani yashirib, biror narsani yashirishadi?

en: Why not say straight out what is in one's heart, when one
uz: Nima uchun inson yuragida nima borligini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytmaydi?

en: knows that one is not speaking idly?
uz: O'zingiz bilganingizdek, bu gap behuda gapirmaydi.

en: As it is every one seems harsher than he really is, as though all were afraid of doing injustice to their feelings, by being too quick to express them. Oh, Nastenka, what you say is true; but there are many reasons for that, I broke in, suppressing my own feelings at that moment more than ever.
uz: Har kim o'z his-tuyg'ularini ifoda etishda juda tez bo'lib, o'z his-tuyg'ularidan qo'rqqanidek, aslida bo'lganidan ko'ra qattiqroq tuyuladi. Oh, Nastenka, sen gapirayotgan gaping haq; lekin buning ko'p sabablari bor, - dedim men, o'sha paytda o'z his-tuyg'ularimni har qachongidan ko'ra ko'proq bosib o'tdim.

en: No, no! she answered with deep feeling.
uz: Yo'q, yo'q! deb javob berdi u chuqur hissiyot bilan.

en: Here you, for instance, are not like other people!
uz: Masalan, siz bu yerda boshqa odamlar kabi emassiz!

en: I really don't know how to tell you what I feel; but it seems to me that you, for instance.
uz: Haqiqatan ham, o'zimni qanday his qilishimni sizga qanday aytishni bilmayman; lekin menga o'xshaydiki, siz, masalan.

en: at the present moment.
uz: Hozirgi vaqtda.

en: it seems to me that you are sacriﬁcing something for me, she added timidly, with a ﬂeeting glance at me.
uz: Menga o'xshaydiki, siz men uchun biror narsani qurbon qilyapsiz, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u qo'rqqancha, menga ko'z tikib.

en: Forgive me for saying so, I am a simple girl you know.
uz: Buni aytish uchun meni kechiring, men oddiy qizman.

en: I have seen very little of life, and I really sometimes don't know how to say things, she added in a voice that quivered with some hidden feeling, while she tried to smile; but I only wanted to tell you that I am grateful, that I feel it all too … Oh, may God give you happiness for it!
uz: Men hayotdan juda oz narsani ko'rdim va ba'zan men nima deyishni bilmayman, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u, tabassum qilishga harakat qilib, yashirin his-tuyg'u bilan titragan ovoz bilan. - Lekin men sizga faqat minnatdorligimni aytmoqchiman, men ham buni his qilaman... Oh, Xudo sizga buning uchun baxt bersin!

en: What you told me about your dreamer is quite untrue now—that is, I mean, it's not true of you.
uz: Orzuchi haqida menga aytganingiz endi to'liq yolg'on, ya'ni siz haqingizda emas.

en: You are recovering, you are quite a different man from what you described.
uz: Siz sog'ayib ketyapsiz, o'zingiz tavsiflagan odamdan ancha farq qilyapsiz.

en: If you ever fall in love with some one, God give you happi- ness with her!
uz: Agar siz biror kishiga muhabbat qozongan bo'lsangiz, Xudo sizga u bilan baxt bersin!

en: I won't wish you anything for her, for she will be happy with you.
uz: Men unga hech narsa tilamayman, chunki u siz bilan birga baxtli bo'ladi.

en: I know, I am a woman myself, so you must believe me when I tell you so. She ceased speaking, and pressed my hand warmly.
uz: Men bilaman, men o'zim ham ayolman, shuning uchun sizga aytganimda ishonishingiz kerak.U gapirishni to'xtatdi va qo'limni iliq bosdi.

en: I too could not speak without emotion.
uz: Men ham hissiyotsiz gapira olmasdim.

en: Some minutes passed.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tdi.

en: Yes, it's clear he won't come to-night, she said at last raising her head.
uz: Ha, u kechasi kelmaydi, - dedi u, nihoyat boshini ko'tardi.

en: It's late. He will come tomorrow, I said in the most ﬁrm and convincing tone.
uz: Kuni kech.  U ertaga keladi, - dedim men eng qat'iy va ishontiruvchi tomonda.

en: Yes, she added with no sign of her former depression.
uz: Ha, - deb qo'shib qo'ydi u, avvalgi tushkunligidan hech qanday alomat yo'q edi.

en: I see for myself now that he could not come till tomorrow.
uz: Men hozir o'zim ko'rib turibmanki, u ertaga kelib bo'lmaydi.

en: Well, good-bye, till tomorrow.
uz: Xo'sh, keling, ertaga uchraymiz.

en: If it rains perhaps I shall not come.
uz: Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, ehtimol men kelmayman.

en: But the day after tomorrow, I shall come.
uz: Ammo ertasi kuni kelishim kerak.

en: I shall come for certain, whatever happens; be sure to be here, I want to see you, I will tell you everything. And then when we parted she gave me her hand and said, looking at me candidly: We shall always be together, shan't we? Oh, Nastenka, Nastenka!
uz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, albatta kelaman; bu yerda bo'lishdan qat'i nazar, sizni ko'rishni xohlayman, sizga hamma narsani aytib beraman. Keyin ajrashganimizda, u menga qo'lini uzatdi va menga ochiqchasiga qarab: Biz har doim birga bo'lamiz, shunday emasmi? - dedi.

en: If only you knew how lonely I am now!
uz: Endi men qanchalik yolg'iz ekanimni bilsangiz edi!

en: As soon as it struck nine o'clock I could not stay indoors, but put on my things, and went out in spite of the weather.
uz: To'qqiz soat bo'lganidan so'ng men uyda qololmay, o'z narsalarimni kiyib, ob-havoga qaramay tashqariga chiqdim.

en: I was there, sitting on our seat.
uz: Men o'sha yerda o'tirgan edim.

en: I went to her street, but I felt ashamed, and turned back without looking at their windows, when I was two steps from her door.
uz: Men uning ko'chasiga bordim, lekin o'zimni uyalganman va uning eshigidan ikki qadam uzoq bo'lganimda, darchalariga nazar solmasdan orqaga qaytib ketdim.

en: I went home more de- pressed than I had ever been before.
uz: Uyga qaytib kelganimda, o'zimdan ham ko'proq xafa bo'ldim.

en: What a damp, dreary day!
uz: Bu qanday nam va chiroyli kun edi!

en: If it had been ﬁne I should have walked about all night.
uz: Agar yaxshi bo'lganida, men butun kecha yurgan bo'lar edim.

en: But tomorrow, tomorrow!
uz: Ammo ertaga, ertaga!

en: Tomorrow she will tell me everything.
uz: Ertaga u menga hamma narsani aytib beradi.

en: The let- ter has not come today, however.
uz: Biroq, bugungi kunda yozuv kelmagan.

en: But that was to be expected.
uz: Ammo bu kutilmagan edi.

en: They are to- gether by now.
uz: Ular allaqachon to-gether bor.

en: FOURTH NIGHT My God, how it has all ended!
uz: To'rtinchi kecha, ey Xudoyim, bularning barchasi qanday yakunlandi!

en: What it has all ended in!
uz: Bularning barchasi qanday yakunlandi!

en: I arrived at nine o'clock.
uz: Men to'qqizlarda keldim.

en: She was already there.
uz: U allaqachon u erda edi.

en: I noticed her a good way off; she was stand- ing as she had been that ﬁrst time, with her elbows on the railing, and she did not hear me coming up to her.
uz: Men uni uzoqdan ko'rdim; u birinchi marta bo'lganidek, qo'lqovushlari parcha ustida turibdi va menga yaqinlashayotganimni eshitmadi.

en: Nastenka! I called to her, suppressing my agitation with an effort.
uz: Nastenka! - deb unga chaqirib, tashvishimni bir harakat bilan yo'q qildim.

en: She turned to me quickly.
uz: U tezda menga murojaat qildi.

en: Make haste! I looked at her in perplexity.
uz: Shoshil! - deb o'yladim.

en: Well, where is the letter?
uz: Ha, xat qayerda?

en: Have you brought the letter? she repeated clutching at the railing.
uz: Xatni olib keldingizmi? - deb so'zlarni takrorladi u, railingni qo'lga olib.

en: No, there is no letter, I said at last.
uz: Yo'q, hech qanday xat yo'q, - dedim men nihoyat.

en: Hasn't he been to you yet? She turned fearfully pale and looked at me for a long time without moving.
uz: U qo'rquvga to'lib, qo'rqqancha soʻlib ketdi va uzoq vaqt menga ko'z tikmay qaradi.

en: I had shattered her last hope.
uz: Men uning oxirgi umidini buzgan edim.

en: Well, God be with him, she said at last in a breaking voice; God be with him if he leaves me like that. She dropped her eyes, then tried to look at me and could not.
uz: Albatta, Xudo unga yordam bersin, - dedi u nihoyat og'ir ovoz bilan; Agar meni shunday qoldirsa, Xudo unga yordam bersin. U ko'zlarini tushirdi, so'ngra menga qarashga harakat qildi, lekin qila olmadi.

en: For several minutes she was struggling with her emotion.
uz: Bir necha daqiqa davomida u his-tuyg'ulari bilan kurashdi.

en: All at once she turned away, leaning her elbows against the railing and burst into tears.
uz: Birdan u o'z ko'kraklarini railingga tikib, orqaga burildi va ko'z yoshlariga tushib ketdi.

en: Oh don't, don't! I began; but looking at her I had not the heart to go on, and what was I to say to her?
uz: Yo'q, yo'q! - deb boshladim men; lekin unga qaraganimda davom etish uchun yuragim yetmadi va unga nima deyishim kerak edi?

en: Don't try and comfort me, she said; don't talk about him; don't tell me that he will come, that he has not cast me off so cruelly and so inhumanly as he has.
uz: Meni tasalli berishga harakat qilma, dedi u, u haqida gapirmang, u kelishini, meni o'zi kabi shafqatsiz va insofsiz yo'qotganini aytma.

en: Can there have been something in my letter, that unlucky letter? At that point sobs stiﬂed her voice; my heart was torn as I looked at her.
uz: Mening maktubimda biron narsa bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkinmi, o'sha omadsizlikka uchragan maktub? - deb so'radi u. O'sha paytda uning ovozini yig'lab o'chirib qo'ydi; unga qaraganimda yuragim charchagan edi.

en: Oh, how inhumanly cruel it is! she began again.
uz: Oh, bu qanchalik shafqatsiz! - dedi u yana boshlandi.

en: And not a line, not a line!
uz: Va yo'q chiziq, yo'q chiziq!

en: He might at least have written that he does not want me, that he rejects me—but not a line for three days!
uz: U hech bo'lmaganda meni xohlamasligini, rad etishini yozgan bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin uch kun davomida hech qanday navbatni qo'ymagan!

en: How easy it is for him to wound, to insult a poor, defenceless girl, whose only fault is that she loves him!
uz: U uchun kambag'al, himoyasiz qizni jarohatlash, haqoratlash juda oson, uning yagona aybi uni sevishdir!

en: Oh, what I've suffered during these three days!
uz: Oʻsha uch kun ichida men qanchalik azob chekdim!

en: When I think that I was the
uz: Men o'zimni o'zim deb o'ylagandim.

en: ﬁrst to go to him, that I humbled myself before him, cried, that I begged of him a little love!
uz: Avvalo uning oldiga borishni, uning oldida o'zimni past olib, yig'lab, biroz mehr-muhabbat so'rab iltijo qilishni boshladim.

en: Listen, she said, turning to me, and her black eyes ﬂashed, it isn't so!
uz: Quloq soling, dedi u, menga qarab, qora ko'zlari bilan: U shunday emas!

en: It can't be so; it isn't natural.
uz: Bu shunday bo'lishi mumkin emas; bu tabiiy emas.

en: Either you are mistaken or I; perhaps he has not received the letter?
uz: Yoki siz xato qilyapsiz yoki men; ehtimol u maktubni olmagan?

en: Perhaps he still knows nothing about it?
uz: Ehtimol, u hali ham bu haqda hech narsa bilmaydi?

en: How could any one—judge for yourself, tell me, for good- ness' sake explain it to me, I can't understand it—how could any one behave with such barbarous coarseness as he has behaved to me?
uz: Qanday qilib hech kim o'zi uchun hukm qila oladi, menga ayt, menga buni yaxshilik uchun tushuntira oladi, men buni tushunmayman, qanday qilib hech kim menga nisbatan bunday barbaroy qo'pollik bilan yo'l tutishi mumkin?

en: Why, the lowest creature on earth is treated more compassionately.
uz: Axir, yer yuzidagi eng past mavjudotga ham ko'proq rahmdillik ko'rsatiladi.

en: Perhaps he has heard something, perhaps some one has told him something about me, she cried, turning to me inquiringly: What do you think? Listen, Nastenka, I shall go to him tomorrow in your name. Yes? I will question him about everything; I will tell him everything. Yes, yes? You write a letter.
uz: Ehtimol u biror narsani eshitgan, ehtimol kimdir unga men to'g'risida biror narsa aytib bergan bo'lsa-da, - deb baqirdi u, so'rab menga qarab: Sen nima deb o'ylaysan? - Qo'ng, Nastenka, men ertaga uning oldiga sening noming bilan boraman. - Ha? - Men unga hamma narsa haqida savol beraman; men unga hamma narsani aytaman. - Ha, ha? - Sen xat yozasan.

en: Don't say no, Nastenka, don't say no!
uz: Yo'q demang, Nastenka, yo'q demang!

en: I will make him respect your action, he shall hear all about it, and if—— No, my friend, no, she interrupted, Enough!
uz: Men unga sizning harakatingizni hurmat qilishga undayman, u bu haqda hamma narsani eshitadi va agar u Yo'q, do'stim, yo'q deb aytsa, u To'g'ri!

en: Not another word, not an- other line from me—enough!
uz: Men uchun yana bir so'z ham, boshqa so'z ham yetarli emas!

en: I don't know him; I don't love him any more.
uz: Men uni tanimayman; men uni endi sevmayman.

en: forget him. She could not go on.
uz: Uni unutib qo'ying. U davom eta olmadi.

en: Calm yourself, calm yourself!
uz: O'zingizni tinchlang, o'zingizni tinchlang!

en: Sit here, Nastenka, I said, making her sit down on the seat.
uz: Bu yerda o'tir, Nastenka, - dedim men va uni o'rindiqga o'tirtirishga majbur qildim.

en: It's only tears, they will soon dry.
uz: Bu faqat ko'z yoshlari, ular tez orada qurib ketadi.

en: Why, do you imagine I shall do away with myself, that I shall throw myself into the river? My heart was full: I tried to speak, but I could not.
uz: Nima uchun, o'zimni daryoga tashlab ketishimni o'ylaysizmi? - deb o'ylayotgandim, yuragim to'lib-toshdi: gapirishga harakat qildim, lekin qila olmadim.

en: Listen,she said tak- ing my hand.
uz: Quloq solinglar, dedi u, qo'limni qo'yib.

en: Tell me: you wouldn't have behaved like this, would you?
uz: Menga ayting: siz bunday yo'l tutmas edingiz, shundaymi?

en: You would not have abandoned a girl who had come to you of herself, you would not have thrown into her face a shameless taunt at her weak foolish heart?
uz: Siz o'z-o'zidan sizga kelgan qizni tashlab ketmas edingizmi?

en: You would have taken care of her?
uz: Siz unga g'amxo'rlik qilgan bo'larmidingiz?

en: You would have realized that she was alone, that she did not know how to look after herself, that she could not guard herself from loving you, that it was not her fault, not her fault— that she had done nothing .
uz: Siz uning yolg'iz ekanligini, o'ziga g'amxo'rlik qilishni bilmasligini, sizni sevishdan o'zini himoya qila olmasligini, hech narsa qilmagani uning aybidir, uning aybidir emasligini anglar edingiz.

en: Nastenka! I cried at last, unable to control my emotion.
uz: Nastenka! - deb yig'ladim men, nihoyat, his-tuyg'ularimni nazorat qila olmayman.

en: Nastenka, you torture me!
uz: Nastenka, sen meni azoblayapsan!

en: You wound my heart, you are killing me, Nastenka!
uz: Sen yuragimni yaralayotgansan, meni o'ldiryapsan, Nastenka!

en: I must speak at last, give utterance to what is surging in my heart! As I said this I got up from the seat.
uz: Oxir-oqibat gapirishim kerak, yuragimdagi so'zlarni aytishim kerak! - deb aytganimda, o'rindiqdan turib qoldim.

en: She took my hand and looked at me in surprise.
uz: U qo'limdan ushlab, menga hayronlik bilan qaradi.

en: What is the matter with you? she said at last.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u: Senga nima bo'ldi? - dedi.

en: Listen, I said resolutely.
uz: Men qat'iylik bilan: Quloq solinglar, - dedim.

en: Listen to me, Nastenka!
uz: Meni tingla, Nastenka!

en: What I am going to say to you now is all nonsense, all impossible, all stupid!
uz: Men sizga hozir nima deyishimni aytyapman: bularning hammasi behuda, imkonsiz, ahmoqlikdir!

en: I know that this can never be, but I cannot be silent.
uz: Bu hech qachon bo'lmasligini bilaman, lekin men sukut saqlashim mumkin emas.

en: For the sake of what you are suffering now, I beg you beforehand to forgive me! What is it?
uz: Hozir siz azob chekayotgan narsangiz uchun oldindan kechirim so'rayman!

en: What is it? she said drying her eyes and looking at me in- tently, while a strange curiosity gleamed in her astonished eyes.
uz: Bu nima? - deb so'radi u ko'zlarini quritib, menga ko'z tikib, hayron qolgan ko'zlarida g'ayritabiiy qiziqish paydo bo'ldi.

en: What is the matter? It's impossible, but I love you, Nastenka!
uz: Nima bo'ldi? - Bu mumkin emas, lekin men seni sevaman, Nastenka!

en: Now everything is told, I said with a wave of my hand.
uz: Endi hamma narsa aytildi, - dedim men qo'limni tikib.

en: Now you will see whether you can go on talking to me as you did just now, whether you can listen to what I am going to say to you. .
uz: Hndi ko'rasiz, hozirgina menga gapirganingizdek, menga gapirishni davom ettirishingiz mumkinmi, nima deyishimni tinglashingiz mumkinmi.

en: Well, what then? Nastenka interrupted me.
uz: O'shanda nima bo'ladi? - dedi Nastenka meni kesib o'tdi.

en: I knew you loved me long ago, only I always thought that you simply liked me very much.
uz: Siz meni yaxshi ko'rasiz, deb bilar edim, lekin men doim siz meni juda yaxshi ko'rasiz deb o'ylardim.

en: Oh dear, oh dear! At ﬁrst it was simply liking, Nastenka, but now, now!
uz: O'z navbatida, boshida bu shunchaki yoqimli bo'ldi, Nastenka, lekin hozir, hozir!

en: I am just in the same position as you were when you went to him with your bundle.
uz: Men faqat siz o'zingizning to'plamingiz bilan uning oldiga borganingizda bo'lgan holatda edim.

en: In a worse position than you, Nastenka, because he cared for no one else as you do. What are you saying to me!
uz: Sizdan ham og'irroq holatda, Nastenka, chunki u siz kabi boshqa hech kimga g'amxo'rlik qilmadi.

en: I don't understand you in the least.
uz: Men sizni hech qachon tushunmayman.

en: But tell me, what's this for; I don't mean what for, but why are you .
uz: Lekin menga ayting, bu nima uchun; men nima uchun emas, balki nima uchun gapiryapman .

en: Oh dear, I am talking nonsense!
uz: Oh, aziz, men behuda gapiryapman!

en: . And Nastenka broke off in confusion.
uz: Nastenka esa g'alati holda bo'lib ketdi.

en: Her cheeks ﬂamed; she dropped her eyes.
uz: Uning yig'inlari olovga to'lib, ko'zlari tushdi.

en: What's to be done, Nastenka, what am I to do?
uz: Nastanka, nima qilish kerak, men nima qilishim kerak?

en: I have abused your .
uz: Men sizning huquqingizni suiiste'mol qildim.

en: But no, no, I am not to blame, Nastenka; I feel that, I know that, because my heart tells me I am right, for I cannot hurt you in any way, I cannot wound you!
uz: Ammo yo'q, yo'q, men aybdor emasman, Nastenka; men o'zimni shunday his qilaman, bilaman, chunki yuragim menga haqligimni aytadi, chunki men sizga hech qanday zarar yetkaza olmayman, sizni jarohatlay olmayman!

en: I was your friend, but I am still your friend, I have be-
uz: Men sizning do'stingiz edim, lekin men hali ham sizning do'stingizman, men...

en: Here my tears are falling, Nastenka.
uz: Mana, ko'z yoshlarim to'kmoqda, Nastenka.

en: Let them ﬂow, let them ﬂow—they don't hurt anybody.
uz: Ular oqishiga yo'l qo'yinglar, oqishiga yo'l qo'yinglar, hech kimga zarar etkazmaydilar.

en: They will dry, Nastenka. Sit down, sit down, she said, making me sit down on the seat.
uz: Ular quruq bo'ladi, Nastenka. O'tir, o'tir, dedi u, meni o'tirishga majbur qildi.

en: Oh, my God! No, Nastenka, I won't sit down; I cannot stay here any longer, you can- not see me again; I will tell you everything and go away.
uz: - Yo'q, Nastenka, men o'tirmayman, bu yerda ko'proq qololmayman, sen meni yana ko'rmaysan, men senga hamma narsani aytib ketaman.

en: I only want to say that you would never have found out that I loved you.
uz: Faqatgina aytmoqchimanki, men seni sevganimni hech qachon bilmas eding.

en: I should have kept my secret.
uz: Sirimni saqlab qolishim kerak edi.

en: I would not have worried you at such a moment with my egoism.
uz: Men o'z xudbinligim bilan bunday paytda sizni tashvishlantirmagan bo'lardim.

en: But I could not resist it now; you spoke of it yourself, it is your fault, your fault and not mine.
uz: Ammo men hozir unga qarshi tura olmayman; siz o'zingiz bu haqda gapirgansiz, bu sizning aybingiz, mening aybim emas, sizning aybingiz.

en: You cannot drive me away from you.
uz: Siz meni o'zingizdan uzoqlashtirolmaysiz.

en: . No, no, I don't drive you away, no! said Nastenka, concealing her con- fusion as best she could, poor child.
uz: Yo'q, yo'q, men sizni haydab yubormayman, yo'q! - dedi Nastenka, o'z qo'lidan kelganicha o'z tuzumini yashirib, kambag'al bola.

en: You don't drive me away?
uz: Sen meni quvib chiqarmaysanmi?

en: But I meant to run from you myself.
uz: Lekin men o'zim ham sizdan qochmoqchi edim.

en: I will go away, but ﬁrst I will tell you all, for when you were crying here I could not sit unmoved, when you wept, when you were in torture at being— at being—I will speak of it, Nastenka—at being forsaken, at your love be- ing repulsed, I felt that in my heart there was so much love for you, Nasten- ka, so much love!
uz: Men ketaman, lekin avvalambor hammangizga aytaman, chunki siz yig'layotganingizda men ko'nglimni tiyib o'tirolmadim, siz yig'layotganingizda, siz azob chekayotganingizda, men bu haqda gapiraman, Nastenka tashlab ketilganda, sizning sevgingiz rad etilganda, yuragimda sizga nisbatan shunchalik ko'p sevgi borligini his qildim, Nastenka, shunchalik ko'p sevgi!

en: And it seemed so bitter that I could not help you with my love, that my heart was breaking and I .
uz: Va bu shunchalik achchiq ko'rinardiki, men sizga sevgim bilan yordam bera olmasdim, yuragim sindirib ketardi va men .

en: I could not be silent, I had to speak, Nastenka, I had to speak! Yes, yes!
uz: Men sukut saqlay olmasdim, gapirishim kerak edi, Nastenka, gapirishim kerak edi!

en: tell me, talk to me, said Nastenka with an indescribable ges- ture.
uz: Menga ayting, men bilan gaplashing, - dedi Nastenka so'zlab bo'lmaydigan so'z bilan.

en: Perhaps you think it strange that I talk to you like this, but .
uz: Menga shunday gapirishim g'alati deb o'ylayotgandirsiz, lekin .

en: I will tell you afterwards!
uz: Keyin sizga aytaman!

en: I will tell you everything. You are sorry for me, Nastenka, you are simply sorry for me, my dear little friend!
uz: Men senga hamma narsani aytib beraman. Sen men uchun achinarsan, Nastenka, sen shunchaki menga achinarsan, aziz do'stim!

en: What's done can't be mended.
uz: Amalga oshirilgan ishlarni tuzatish mumkin emas.

en: What is said cannot be taken back.
uz: Aytilganlarni qaytarib olish mumkin emas.

en: That's the starting-point.
uz: Bu boshlanish nuqtasi.

en: Now it's all right, only listen.
uz: Endi bu yaxshi, faqat tinglang.

en: When you were sitting crying I thought to myself (oh, let me tell you what I was thinking!), I thought, that (of course it cannot be, Nastenka), I thought that you .
uz: Sen yig'lab o'tirganingda men o'zimga o'yladim (oh, nima haqida o'ylayotganimni aytaman!), o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'yladim, o'zimga o'ylayman, o'zimga o'ylayman.

en: I thought that you somehow .
uz: Oʻshanda men buni siz deb oʻylardim .

en: quite apart from me, had ceased to love him.
uz: Mendan tashqari, uni sevishni to'xtatdim.

en: Then—I thought that yester- day and the day before yesterday, Nastenka—then I would—I certainly would—have succeeded in making you love me; you know, you said your- self, Nastenka, that you almost loved me.
uz: O'shanda men o'zimni o'ylab o'tdimki, kecha va bir kun oldin, Nastenka, albatta men sizni meni sevishga undashga muvaffaq bo'lardim; bilasizmi, siz o'zingizni, Nastenka, deyarli meni sevganingizni aytdingiz.

en: Well, that's near- ly all I wanted to tell you; all that is left to say is how it would be if you
uz: Xo'sh, men sizga aytmoqchi bo'lganim deyarli shu bo'ldi; aytish kerak bo'lgan yagona narsa - agar siz aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qanday bo'lar edi?

en: loved me, only that, nothing more!
uz: Meni yaxshi ko'rgan, faqat shu, boshqa hech narsa emas!

en: Listen, my friend—for any way you are my friend—I am, of course, a poor, humble man, of no great consequence; but that's not the point (I don't seem to be able to say what I mean, Nasten- ka, I am so confused), only I would love you, I would love you so, that even if you still loved him, even if you went on loving the man I don't know, you would never feel that my love was a burden to you.
uz: Quloq sol, do'stim, qanday qilib bo'lmasin, sen mening do'stimsan.Men, albatta, kambag'al, kamtar odamman, hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emasman; lekin bu muhim narsa emas (men nimani nazarda tutganimni aytishga qodir bo'lmagandek tuyuladi, Nasten-ka, men juda chalg'ib qoldim), faqat men seni sevaman, seni shunday sevaman, hatto uni hali ham sevgan bo'lsangiz ham, men tanimagan kishini sevgan bo'lsangiz ham, mening sevgim sizga og'ir yuk bo'lganini hech qachon his qilmaysiz.

en: You would only feel every minute that at your side was beating a grateful heart, a warm heart ready for your sake.
uz: Har bir daqiqada o'zingizning yoningizda minnatdorlik yuragi urib, siz uchun tayyor bo'lgan iliq yurak borligini his qilasiz.

en: Oh Nastenka, Nastenka!
uz: Oh Nastenka, Nastenka!

en: What have you done to me? Don't cry; I don't want you to cry, said Nastenka, getting up quickly from the seat.
uz: Menga nima qilding? - dedi Nastenka, o'rindiqdan tez turib. - Yig'lamang, yig'lashni istamayman.

en: Come along, get up, come with me, don't cry, don't cry, she said, drying her tears wth her handkerchief; let us go now; maybe I will tell you something.
uz: U: Kelib kel, tur, men bilan birga kel, yig'lama, yig'lama, - dedi, ko'z yoshlariga ko'ylakni qo'shib, yo'limizga boraylik; ehtimol men sizga bir narsa aytaman.

en: If he has forsaken me now, if he has forgotten me, though I still love him (I do not want to deceive you) .
uz: Agar u meni endi tashlab ketsa, agar u meni unutsa, men uni hali ham sevaman (sizni aldashni istamayman).

en: but listen, answer me.
uz: Lekin tinglang, menga javob bering.

en: If I were to love you, for instance, that is, if I only.
uz: Masalan, agar men sizni sevgan bo'lsam, ya'ni faqat men sevgan bo'lsam.

en: Oh my friend, my friend!
uz: Oh, do'stim, do'stim!

en: To think, to think how I wounded you, when I laughed at your love, when I praised you for not falling in love with me.
uz: O'ylashga, seni qanday jarohatlaganimni, sevgingga kulganimda, meni sevmaganing uchun seni maqtab, maqtashimga o'ylashga.

en: How was it I did not foresee this, how was it I did not foresee this, how could I have been so stupid?
uz: Qanday qilib men buni oldindan ko'rmagan edim, qanday qilib men buni oldindan ko'rmagan edim, qanday qilib men bu qadar ahmoqona bo'lishim mumkin edi?

en: Well, I have made up my mind, I will tell you. Look here, Nastenka, do you know what?
uz: Men qarorimni qabul qildim, sizga aytaman. - Buni ko'ring, Nastenka, bir narsani bilasizmi?

en: I'll go away, that's what I'll do.
uz: Men ketaman, shuni qilaman.

en: I am simply tormenting you.
uz: Men shunchaki sizni azoblayapman.

en: Here you are remorseful for having laughed at me, and I won't have you .
uz: Mana, siz menga kulganingiz uchun afsuslanasiz va men sizdan voz kechaman .

en: in addition to your sorrow.
uz: Sizning qayg'uingizga qo'shimcha ravishda.

en: Of course it is my fault, Nastenka, but good-bye! Stay, listen to me: can you wait? What for?
uz: Albatta, bu mening aybim, Nastenka, lekin salom! - O'tir, meni tingla: kutib ko'rsa bo'ladimi? - Nima uchun?

en: How? I love him; but I shall get over it, I must get over it, I cannot fail to get over it; I am getting over it, I feel that.
uz: Qanday qilib? Men uni yaxshi ko'raman; lekin men buni yenga olaman, buni yenga olaman, buni yenga olmay olaman; men buni yenga olaman, shunday his qilaman.

en: Perhaps it will all end to-day, for I hate him, for he has been laughing at me, while you have been weeping here with me, for you have not repulsed me as he has, for you love me while he has never loved me, for in fact, I love you myself.
uz: Ehtimol, bularning barchasi bugun tug'iladi, chunki men uni nafratlayman, chunki u menga kulgan, siz men bilan birga yig'lagan bo'lsangiz, chunki siz meni u kabi rad etmagansiz, chunki siz meni sevasiz, ammo u meni hech qachon sevmagan, aslida men sizni o'zim sevaman.

en: I love you as you love me; I have told you so before, you heard it yourself—I love you because you are better than he is, because you are nobler than he is, because, because he——
uz: Men seni sen meni sevganidek sevaman; men buni senga oldin ham aytgan edim, sen o'zing eshitgan eding.Men seni sevaman, chunki sen undan yaxshiroqsan, chunki sen undan ham azizsan, chunki, chunki u

en: The poor girl's emotion was so violent that she could not say more; she laid her head upon my shoulder, then upon my bosom, and wept bitterly.
uz: Qizning his-tuyg'ulari shunchalik kuchli ediki, u boshqa gapirishdan to'xtamaydi; boshini yelkamga, so'ngra ko'nglimga qo'ydi va achchiq-achchiq yig'ladi.

en: I comforted her, I persuaded her, but she could not stop crying; she kept pressing my hand, and saying between her sobs: Wait, wait, it will be over in a minute!
uz: Men uni tasalli berardim, uni ishontirardim, lekin u yig'lashni to'xtata olmadi; u qo'limni bosib, o'z ko'z o'ngida: Tasavvur qiling, bu bir daqiqada tugaydi!

en: I want to tell you .
uz: Men sizga aytmoqchiman .

en: you mustn't think that these tears—it's nothing, it's weakness, wait till it's over. .
uz: Bu ko'z yoshlari hech narsa emas, balki zaiflik deb o'ylamaslik kerak.

en: At last she left off crying, dried her eyes and we walked on again.
uz: Nihoyat u yig'lashni to'xtatdi, ko'zlarini quritdi va yana davom ettirdik.

en: I wanted to speak, but she still begged me to wait.
uz: Men gapirishni istardim, lekin u meni kutib turishga iltijo qildi.

en: At last she plucked up courage and began to speak.
uz: Oxir-oqibat u jasorat topib, gapira boshladi.

en: It's like this, she began in a weak and quivering voice, in which, how- ever, there was a note that pierced my heart with a sweet pang; don't think that I am so light and inconstant, don't think that I can forget and change so quickly.
uz: Bu shunday, - deb boshladi u zaif va titraydigan ovoz bilan, qaysi, nima bo'lganda ham, yuragimni yonib o'tgan bir nota bor edi; men shunchalik yengil va beqarorman, shunchalik tez unutib o'zgarishim mumkin, deb o'ylamang.

en: I have loved him for a whole year, and I swear by God that I have never, never, even in thought, been unfaithful to him.
uz: Men uni to'liq bir yildan beri sevaman va Xudoga qasam ichamanki, men hech qachon, hatto o'ylashimcha ham unga sadoqatsiz bo'lmaganman.

en: He has despised me, he has been laughing at me—God forgive him!
uz: U meni kamsitdi, menga kuldi Xudo uni kechirsin!

en: But he has insulted me and wounded my heart.
uz: Lekin u meni haqoratlab, yuragimni yaraladi.

en: I do not love him, for I can only love what is magnanimous, what understands me, what is generous; for I am like that myself and he is not worthy of me—well, that's enough of him.
uz: Men uni sevmayman, chunki men faqat saxiy, meni tushunadigan, saxiy bo'lgan narsani sevishim mumkin; chunki men o'zim ham shundayman va u menga munosib emas.

en: He has done better than if he had deceived my expectations later, and shown me later what he was.
uz: Keyinchalik mening umidlarimni aldatib, keyinchalik o'zi nima ekanligini ko'rsatganidan ko'ra, u yaxshiroq ish qildi.

en: But who knows, my dear friend, she went on pressing my hand, who knows, perhaps my whole love was a mistaken feeling, a delusion—perhaps it began in mischief, in nonsense, because I was kept so strictly by grandmother?
uz: Ammo kim biladi, aziz do'stim, - dedi u qo'limni bosib, - kim biladi, ehtimol mening butun sevgim noto'g'ri his-tuyg'u, aldash edi, ehtimol bu yomonlikdan, behudalikdan boshlandi, chunki meni buvim qattiq ushlab turardi.
