en: Perhaps I ought to love another man, not him, a different one, who would have pity on me and .
uz: Ehtimol, men boshqa odamni sevishim kerak, lekin uni emas, boshqa odamni sevishim kerak, u menga rahm qiladi va .

en: But don't let us say any more about that, Nastenka broke off, breathless with emotion, I only wanted to tell you .
uz: Ammo bu haqda ko'proq gapirmaylik, - dedi Nastenka, hissiy hissiyotlar bilan nafas olmagan holda, Men sizga aytmoqchi edim .

en: I wanted to tell you that if, although I love him (no, did love him), if, in spite of this you still say.
uz: Men sizga aytmoqchimanki, agar men uni yaxshi ko'rsam ham (yo'q, men uni yaxshi ko'rardim), agar bunga qaramay siz hali ham shunday deysizmi.

en: If you feel that your love is so great that it may at last drive from my heart my old feel- ing—if you will have pity on me—if you do not want to leave me alone to my fate, without hope, without consolation—if you are ready to love me always as you do now—I swear to you that gratitude .
uz: Agar sening sevgining shunchalik katta bo'lganini his qilsangki, u nihoyat qalbimdan eski his-tuyg'ularimni o'chirib tashlaydi-agar sen menga rahm qilsang-agar meni o'zimning taqdirimga yolg'iz qoldirmoqchi bo'lmaysan, umidsiz, tasallisiz-agar sen meni har doim hozirgi kabi sevishga tayyor bo'lsang, men senga bu minnatdorchilikni qasam ichaman.

en: that my love will be at last worthy of your love.
uz: Mening sevgim nihoyat sizning sevgingizga loyiq bo'ladi.

en: Will you take my hand? Nastenka! I cried breathless with sobs.
uz: Qo'limdan ushlab turasizmi? - Nastenka! deb yig'ladim.

en: Nastenka, oh Nastenka! Enough, enough!
uz: Nastenka, oh Nastenka! Toʻgʻri, yetarli!

en: Well, now it's quite enough, she said, hardly able to control herself.
uz: Endi bu yetarli, - dedi u, o'zini nazorat qila olmay.

en: Well, now all has been said, hasn't it?
uz: Hndi hamma narsa aytilgan, shunday emasmi?

en: happy—I am happy too.
uz: Men ham baxtli.

en: Not another word about it, wait; spare me .
uz: Bu haqda yana bir so'z aytmang, kutib turing; meni qutqaring .

en: talk of something else, for God's sake. Yes, Nastenka, yes!
uz: - Ha, Nastenka, ha! - deb javob berdi.

en: Enough about that, now I am happy.
uz: Bu bilan yetarlicha, endi men baxtliman.

en: I——Yes, Nas- tenka, yes, let us talk of other things, let us make haste and talk.
uz: Ha, Nas-tenka, ha, boshqa narsalar haqida gaplashaylik, shoshilinch bo'lib gaplashaylik.

en: I am ready. And we did not know what to say: we laughed, we wept, we said thou- sands of things meaningless and incoherent; at one moment we walked along the pavement, then suddenly turned back and crossed the road; then we stopped and went back again to the embankment; we were like children.
uz: Men tayyorman. Biz nima deyishni bilmas edik: kulganmiz, yig'laganmiz, gaplarimiz mazmunsiz va behuda edi; bir paytlar yo'l bo'ylab yurgan edik, keyin to'satdan orqaga qaytib, yo'lni kesib o'tdik; keyin to'xtadik va yana qirg'oqga qaytib keldik; biz bolalarday edik.

en: I am living alone now, Nastenka, I began, but to-morrow!
uz: Men hozir yolg'iz yashayapman, Nastenka, deb boshladim men, lekin ertaga!

en: Of course you know, Nastenka, I am poor, I have only got twelve hundred roubles, but that doesn't matter. Of course not, and granny has her pension, so she will be no burden.
uz: Albatta, bilasiz, Nastenka, men kambag'alman, faqat o'n ikki yuz rubl pulga egaman, ammo bu muhim emas.

en: We must take granny. Of course we must take granny.
uz: Biz onamizni olib ketishimiz kerak. Agar bo'lmasa, onamizni olib ketishimiz kerak.

en: But there's Matrona. Yes, and we've got Fyokla too! Matrona is a good woman, but she has one fault: she has no imagina- tion, Nastenka, absolutely none; but that doesn't matter. That's all right—they can live together; only you must move to us tomorrow. To you?
uz: Ammo u yerda Matrona bor. Ha, bizda ham Fyokla bor! Matrona yaxshi ayol, lekin uning bir kamchiligi bor: u tasavvurga ega emas, Nastenka, mutlaqo hech narsa; lekin bu muhim emas. Ular birga yashashlari mumkin, faqat siz ertaga biz bilan birga yashashingiz kerak. Senga?

en: All right, I am ready. Yes, hire a room from us.
uz: To'g'ri, men tayyorman. Ha, bizdan xonani ijaraga oling.

en: We have a top ﬂoor, it's empty.
uz: Bizda eng yuqori qavat bor, u bo'sh.

en: We had an old lady lodging there, but she has gone away; and I know granny would like to have a young man.
uz: U yerda bir keksa ayol yashardi, lekin u yo'qoldi va men buni bilaman, buvim yosh yigitga ega bo'lishni istaydi.

en: I said to her, 'Why a young man?' And she said, 'Oh, be- cause I am old; only don't you fancy, Nastenka, that I want him as a hus- band for you.' So I guessed it was with that idea. Oh, Nastenka! And we both laughed.
uz: Men unga: Nega yosh yigit? deb so'radim va u: O, chunki men keksaman; faqat, Nastenka, men uni sen uchun er-xotin sifatida xohlayman, deb o'ylamaysan, - dedi.

en: Come, that's enough, that's enough.
uz: Yay, shu yetarli, shu yetarli.

en: But where do you live?
uz: Ammo siz qayerda yashayapsiz?

en: I've forgotten. Over that way, near X bridge, Barannikov's Buildings.
uz: Men unutib qoldim.  O'sha yo'ldan, X ko'prik yaqinida, Barannikov binolari.

en: It's that big house? Yes, that big house. Oh, I know, a nice house; only you know you had better give it up and come to us as soon as possible. Tomorrow, Nastenka, tomorrow; I owe a little for my rent there, but that doesn't matter.
uz: Bu katta uymi? Ha, katta uymi? Oh, bilaman, chiroyli uy; faqat siz buni tashlab, imkon qadar tezroq bizga kelishingiz kerakligini bilasiz. Ertaga, Nastenka, ertaga; men u erda ijara uchun biroz qarzdorman, lekin bu muhim emas.

en: I shall soon get my salary. And do you know I will perhaps give lessons; I will learn something myself and then give lessons. Capital!
uz: Tez orada ish haqiga ega bo'laman. Ushbu erda men, ehtimol, dars beraman, o'zim ham biror narsani o'rganaman, keyin esa dars beraman.

en: And I shall soon get a bonus. So by tomorrow you will be my lodger. And we will go to The Barber of Seville, for they are soon going to give it again. Yes, we'll go, said Nastenka, but better see something else and not The Barber of Seville. Very well, something else.
uz: Va men tez orada bonus olishim kerak. Demak, ertaga siz mening uy egam bo'lasiz. Va biz Sevill shaberi ga boramiz, chunki ular tez orada uni yana berishadi. Ha, boramiz, dedi Nastenka, lekin Sevill shaberi emas, boshqa bir narsa ko'rish yaxshidir.  Chindan ham yaxshi, boshqa narsa.

en: Of course that will be better, I did not think —— As we talked like this we walked along in a sort of delirium, a sort of in- toxication, as though we did not know what was happening to us.
uz: Albatta, bu yaxshiroq bo'ladi, deb o'ylamaganman  Shunday gapirganimizda, biz bir xil deliriumda, bir xil zaharlanishda yurardik, xuddi bizga nima bo'layotganini bilmayotgandek.

en: At one moment we stopped and talked for a long time at the same place; then we went on again, and goodness knows where we went; and again tears and again laughter.
uz: Bir lahzada biz to'xtatib, bir joyda uzoq vaqt gaplashdik; keyin yana davom ettirdik va Xudo biladi qayerga ketdik; yana ko'z yoshlari va yana kulgilar.

en: All of a sudden Nastenka would want to go home, and I would not dare to detain her but would want to see her to the house; we set off, and in a quarter of an hour found ourselves at the embankment by our seat.
uz: Toʻsatdan Nastenka uyga bormoqchi boʻldi va men uni ushlab turishga jurʼat qilmasdim, lekin uni uyga olib borishni xohlardim; biz yoʻlga chiqdik va bir chorak soat oʻtgach, oʻz oʻrinimiz oldida qirgʻoqqa tushib qoldik.

en: Then she would sigh, and tears would come into her eyes again; I would turn chill with dismay.
uz: Keyin u nafas oladi va ko'zlariga yana ko'z yoshlari tushadi; men dahshatga tushaman.

en: But she would press my hand and force me to walk, to talk, to chatter as before.
uz: Ammo u qo'limni bosib, meni avvalgidek yurishga, gapirishga va gapirishga majbur qilardi.

en: It's time I was home at last; I think it must be very late, Nastenka said at last.
uz: Nihoyat uyda bo'lish vaqti keldi; o'ylaymanki, juda kech bo'lishi kerak, dedi Nastenka nihoyat.

en: We must give over being childish. Yes, Nastenka, only I shan't sleep to-night; I am not going home. I don't think I shall sleep either; only see me home. I should think so! Only this time we really must get to the house.
uz: Biz bolalik qilishdan voz kechishimiz kerak.  Ha, Nastenka, faqat men bu kecha uxlamayman; uyga bormayman.  Men ham uxlamayman, faqat meni uyga ko'ring.  Men shunday o'ylamayman! Bolaki bu safar biz uyga borishimiz kerak.

en: We must, we must. Honour bright?
uz: Biz bor, biz bor.  Honour bright?

en: For you know one must go home some time! Honour bright, I answered laughing.
uz: Chunki bir kuni uyga qaytish kerakligini bilasiz! - deb javob berdim.

en: Well, come along! Come along!
uz: Hmm, kelinglar! - deb aytadi.

en: Look at the sky, Nastenka.
uz: Osmonga qarang, Nastenka.

en: Tomorrow it will be a lovely day; what a blue sky, what a moon!
uz: Ertaga go'zal kun bo'ladi; naqadar ko'k osmon, naqadar oy!

en: Look; that yellow cloud is cover- ing it now, look, look!
uz: Qaranglar, o'sha sariq bulut hozir uni qoplab turibdi, qaranglar, qaranglar!

en: No, it has passed by.
uz: Yo'q, u o'tib ketdi.

en: Look, look! But Nastenka did not look at the cloud; she stood mute as though turned to stone; a minute later she huddled timidly close up to me.
uz: Mana, qarang! - deb so'radi, lekin Nastenka bulutga nazar solmadi; u xuddi toshga aylangan kabi soqov bo'lib turdi; bir daqiqa o'tib u qo'rqmasdan yonimga yaqinlashdi.

en: Her hand trem- bled in my hand; I looked at her.
uz: Uning qo'li mening qo'limda titraydi va men unga qaradim.

en: She pressed still more closely to me.
uz: U menga yanada yaqinroq bosim o'tkazdi.

en: At that moment a young man passed by us.
uz: O'sha paytda bir yigit bizdan o'tib o'tdi.

en: He suddenly stopped, looked at us intently, and then again took a few steps on.
uz: U to'xtadi, bizga diqqat bilan qaradi va yana bir necha qadam davom etadi.

en: My heart began throbbing.
uz: Qalbim urishni boshladi.

en: Who is it, Nastenka? I said in an undertone.
uz: Bu kim, Nastenka? - dedim men o'zim.

en: It's he, she answered in a whisper, huddled up to me, still more closely, still more tremulously.
uz: Bu u, deb javob berdi u shoshib, menga yaqinlashib, yanada yaqinroq, yanada dahshatli bo'ldi.

en: I could hardly stand on my feet.
uz: Men o'zimning oyoqlarim bilan to'xtamay qolaman.

en: Nastenka, Nastenka!
uz: Nastenka, Nastenka!

en: It's you! I heard a voice behind us and at the same moment the young man took several steps towards us.
uz: Bu sen! - degan so'zlarni eshitdim va o'sha paytda yigit bizga bir necha qadam qo'ydi.

en: My God, how she cried out!
uz: Hy Xudoyim, u qanchalik baqirib yubordi!

en: How she tore herself out of my arms and rushed to meet him!
uz: O'zini qo'llarimdan qanday qirib tashlab, uni uchratishga shoshildi!

en: I stood and looked at them, utterly crushed.
uz: Men toʻxtatdim va ularga qattiq koʻz tikib qaradim.

en: But she had hardly given him her hand, had hardly ﬂung herself into his arms, when she turned to me again, was beside me again in a ﬂash, and before I knew where I was she threw both arms round my neck and gave me a warm, tender kiss.
uz: Ammo u o'z qo'lini unga qo'yib bermagan, o'zini uning qo'liga tashlab yubormagan edi, yana menga qarab, birdan yonimda bo'ldi va men qayerda ekanimni bilmasdan oldin, u qo'llarini bo'yniga tashlab, meni iliq va iliq o'pdi.

en: Then, without saying a word to me, she rushed back to him again, took his hand, and drew him after her.
uz: Keyin menga hech narsa aytmasdan, u yana uning oldiga yugurib kelib, qo'lidan ushlab, orqasidan tortib oldi.

en: I stood a long time looking after them.
uz: Men uzoq vaqt turib, ularga g'amxo'rlik qilardim.

en: At last the two vanished from my sight.
uz: Oxir-oqibat ikkalasi ham ko'zimdan yo'qoldi.

en: MORNING My night ended with the morning.
uz: Ertalab Mening kecham ertalab bilan yakunlandi.

en: The rain was falling and beating disconsolately upon my window pane; it was dark in the room and grey outside.
uz: Yomg'ir yog'ib, darvozamning o'ng tomoniga tushdi va tashqarida qorong'i va sariq edi.

en: My head ached and I was giddy; fever was stealing over my limbs.
uz: Boshim og'rig'i va ko'nglim burib ketdi, og'zimni ham issiq tutdi.

en: There's a letter for you, sir; the postman brought it, Matrona said stoop- ing over me.
uz: Siz uchun xat bor, xo'jayinim; pochtachi uni olib keldi, - dedi Matrona menga qarab.

en: From whom? I cried, jumping from my chair.
uz: Kimdan? deb o'tirganimda, o'rindiqdan o'tib yig'ladim.

en: I don't know, sir, better look—maybe it is written there whom it is from. I broke the seal.
uz: Bilmayman, xo'jayinim, yaxshi ko'ring, ehtimol u erda kimdan kelganligi yozilgan. Men muhrni buzdim.

en: Oh, forgive me, forgive me!
uz: Oh, meni kechiring, meni kechiring!

en: I beg you on my knees to forgive me!
uz: Sening oldida tiz cho'kib, meni kechirishingni iltijo qilaman!

en: I de- ceived you and myself.
uz: Men sizlarni va o'zimni yo'q qildim.

en: It was a dream, a mirage.
uz: Bu bir orzu, bir mirage edi.

en: My heart aches for you today; forgive me, forgive me!
uz: Bugun yuragim siz uchun og'riydi; meni kechiring, meni kechiring!

en: Don't blame me, for I have not changed to you in the least.
uz: Meni ayblamang, chunki men siz uchun hech narsa o'zgarmaganman.

en: I told you that I would love you, I love you now, I more than love you.
uz: Men seni sevaman, deb aytgan edim, hozir seni sevaman, seni ko'proq sevaman.

en: If only I could love you both at once!
uz: Sizlarni bir vaqtning o'zida sevishim mumkin bo'lganida!

en: Oh, if only you were he! (Oh, if only he were you, echoed in my mind.
uz: Oh, agar sen uning o'rnagingda bo'lsang! (Oh, agar u sening o'rnagingda bo'lsa edi, deb o'yladim.

en: I remembered your words, Nastenka!) God knows what I would do for you now!
uz: Men sizning so'zlaringizni esladim, Nastenka!) Xudo biladi, men endi siz uchun nima qilishim mumkin!

en: I know that you are sad and dreary.
uz: Men sizning qayg'uli va g'amgin ekanligingizni bilaman.

en: I have wounded you, but you know when one loves, a wrong is soon forgotten.
uz: Men sizni jarohatladim, lekin bilasiz, sevganingizda, xato tezda unutiladi.

en: Thank you, yes, thank you for that love!
uz: Rahmat, ha, sevgingiz uchun rahmat!

en: For it will live in my memory like a sweet dream which lingers long after awakening; for I shall remem- ber for ever that instant when you opened your heart to me like a brother and so generously accepted the gift of my shattered heart to care for it, nurse it, and heal it .
uz: Chunki u mening xotiramda uyg'onganidan keyin uzoq davom etayotgan shirin tush kabi yashaydi; chunki sen o'z yuragingni birodarim kabi menga ochganing va uni parvarishlash, parvarishlash va sog'aytirish uchun yorqin yuragim sovg'asini saxiy qabul qilganingni abadiy eslayman.

en: If you forgive me, the memory of you will be exalt- ed by a feeling of everlasting gratitude which will never be effaced from my soul.
uz: Agar meni kechirsangiz, ruhimdan hech qachon o'chirilmaydigan abadiy minnatdorchilik hissi bilan sizning xotirog'ingizni ulug'layman.

en: I will treasure that memory: I will be true to it, I will not betray it, I will not betray my heart: it is too constant.
uz: O'sha xotirani qadrlayman: unga sodiq bo'laman, unga xiyonat qilmayman, yuragimga xiyonat qilmayman: u juda doimiy.

en: It returned so quickly yesterday to him to whom it has always belonged.
uz: Kecha u har doim unga tegishli bo'lgan kishiga juda tez qaytdi.

en: We shall meet, you will come to us, you will not leave us, you will be for ever a friend, a brother to me.
uz: Biz uchrashamiz, sen biz tomon kelasan, bizni tashlab ketmaysan, sen mening do'stim, birodarim bo'lib abadiy yashaysan.

en: And when you see me you will give me
uz: Va siz meni ko'rganingizda menga berasiz

en: You will give it to me, you have forgiven me, haven't you?
uz: Siz uni menga berasiz, meni kechirdingiz, shunday emasmi?

en: You love me as before?
uz: Meni avvalgidek sevyapsizmi?

en: Oh, love me, do not forsake me, because I love you so at this moment, because I am worthy of your love, because I will deserve it .
uz: Oh, meni seving, meni tashlab ketma, chunki men seni shu paytda juda yaxshi ko'raman, chunki men sening sevgingga loyiqman, chunki men uni munosib bo'laman.

en: Next week I am to be married to him.
uz: Kelgusi hafta men u bilan turmush quraman.

en: He has come back in love, he has never forgotten me, You will not be angry at my writing about him.
uz: U qaytib keldi, meni hech qachon unutmadi, U haqda yozganlarimga g'azablanmaysiz.

en: But I want to come and see you with him; you will like him, won't you?
uz: Lekin men u bilan birga seni ko'rishni xohlayman; unga yoqasiz, shunday emasmi?

en: Forgive me, remember and love your NASTENKA. I read that letter over and over again for a long time; tears gushed to my eyes.
uz: Meni kechiring, o'z NASTENKAingizni eslang va seving. Men o'sha maktubni ko'p vaqt davomida takror-takror o'qib, ko'zimdan yoshlar oqib ketdi.

en: At last it fell from my hands and I hid my face.
uz: Nihoyat, u qo'llarimdan tushib qoldi va men yuzimni yashirdim.

en: I say, dearie—— Matrona began.
uz: Men aytaman, azizim, - dedi Matrona.

en: What is it, Matrona? I have taken all the cobwebs off the ceiling; you can have a wedding or give a party. I looked at Matrona.
uz: Nima bo'ldi, Matrona? - deb so'radi. Men barcha o'tlar to'fonidan olib tashladim; siz to'y yoki partiya o'tkazishingiz mumkin.  Men Matronaga qaradim.

en: She was still a hearty, youngish, old woman, but I don't know why all at once I suddenly pictured her with lustreless eyes, a wrinkled face, bent, decrepit.
uz: U hali ham jonli, yosh, keksa ayol edi, lekin nega birdan uni shishaqsiz ko'zlar, burqlangan yuz, burqilgan, o'zboshimchalik bilan tasavvur qilganimni bilmayman.

en: I don't know why I suddenly pictured my room grown old like Matrona.
uz: Nima uchun birdan xonam Matrona kabi qariya bo'lganini tasavvur qildim?

en: The walls and the ﬂoors looked discoloured, everything seemed dingy; the spiders' webs were thicker than ever.
uz: Devorlar va pollar rang-barang ko'rinardi, hamma narsa bo'sh ko'rinardi; o'g'irchoqlarning to'qimalari har qachongidan katta edi.

en: I don't know why, but when I looked out of the window it seemed to me that the house opposite had grown old and dingy too, that the stucco on the columns was peeling off and crumbling, that the cornices were cracked and black- ened, and that the walls, of a vivid deep yellow, were patchy.
uz: Nima uchun, bilmayman, lekin darchaga qaraganimda, qarama-qarshi uy ham keksa va bo'g'ayib ketgan, ustunlardagi stukka qovurib, parchalanayotgan, korniklar parchalangan va qoralashgan va yorqin sariq rangdagi devorlar o'z-o'zidan o'zgarib qolgan edi.

en: Either the sunbeams suddenly peeping out from the clouds for a moment were hidden again behind a veil of rain, and everything had grown dingy again before my eyes; or perhaps the whole vista of my future ﬂashed be- fore me so sad and forbidding, and I saw myself just as I was now, ﬁfteen years hence, older, in the same room, just as solitary, with the same Matrona grown no cleverer for those ﬁfteen years.
uz: Yoki bulutlar orasidan bir zumga ko'tarilayotgan quyosh nurlari yana yomg'ir qopqog'ining orqasidan yashirinib, ko'zlarim oldida hamma narsa yana bo'g'ayib ketgan edi; yoki, ehtimol, mening kelajagimning butun ko'rinishi men uchun juda xafa va taqiqlovchi edi va men o'zimni hozirgicha, o'n besh yildan keyin, katta, bir xonada, yolg'iz, o'sha o'n besh yil davomida o'sib borgan matrona bilan o'zimni xuddi shunday ko'rdim.

en: But to imagine that I should bear you a grudge, Nastenka!
uz: Ammo men sizga g'azabni ko'tarishim kerakligini tasavvur qiling, Nastenka!

en: That I should cast a dark cloud over your serene, untroubled happiness; that by my bitter reproaches I should cause distress to your heart, should poison it with secret remorse and should force it to throb with anguish at the moment of bliss; that I should crush a single one of those tender blossoms which you have twined in your dark tresses when you go with him to the altar.
uz: O'zimning qayg'uchan tanbehlarim bilan yuragingizni qayg'urib, sirli afsus bilan uni zaharlab, baxtsizlik paytida qayg'u bilan urishga majbur qilaman; siz u bilan qurbongohga ketayotganingizda qorong'i bo'g'inlaringiz bilan bog'lagan o'sha tender gullardan birontasini ham ezib tashlayman.

en: Oh never never!, May your sky be clear, may your sweet smile be bright and untrou- bled, and may you be blessed for that moment of blissful happiness which you gave to another, lonely and grateful heart!
uz: Oh hech qachon! Sizning osmoningiz toza bo'lsin, sizning shirin tabassumingiz yorqin va haqiqatdan bexabar bo'lsin va siz boshqa yolg'iz va minnatdor yurakga bergan baxtli damangiz uchun muborak bo'ling!

en: My God, a whole moment of happiness!
uz: Hy Xudoyim, butun baxtli daqiqa!

en: Is that too little for the whole of a man's life?
uz: Bu odamning butun hayoti uchun juda kammi?
